Snow-covered Inn With Sauna Room.name:
覆雪旅店（带桑拿房）
Snow-covered Inn With Sauna Room

Text.text:
穿越户外刺骨的霜寒后，你望见一间如画的旅店，厚厚积雪覆在屋顶上，像给丰润的点心抹了一层糖霜。你走近门槛时小心绕开檐口边缘垂挂成群的粗大冰凌。踏入室内，公共厅里炉火熊熊，热腾腾的饭食与柔软的床铺都诱人得不可思议；可对一个被寒意缠身的人而言，真正的牵引却不那么容易为众人所见——那是一间桑拿室，潮润而安抚，裹着能把骨头都烘暖的蒸汽。
After your trek through the frosty clime outdoors, you spy a picturesque inn covered in snow so thick it resembles a frosted rich pastry. You carefully avoid the larger icicles gathered at the edge of the roof’s overhang as you approach the threshold. Inside, a blazing fire in the common room, the promise of a hot meal, and a cozy bed hold incredible allure, but the true draw for one touched by chill is one not so easily viewed by the public: a sauna room, humid and comforting in its bone-warming steam.

Mephits In Mud Bath.name:
泥浴中的小魔蝠
Mephits In Mud Bath

Text.text:
咯咯怪笑与尖叫在空气中回荡，硫磺般的臭味同样弥漫不散。前方，一间蒸汽氤氲的石砌房间里，地面被一汪翻滚冒泡的灰色泥浆池占满。几只细小的有翼小恶魔在淤泥里嬉闹翻腾。它们的躯体松散黏糊、仿佛随时会融开，却长着乌亮如珠的黑眼睛和过分细长、向下钩弯的鼻子。它们的玩闹把房间与相邻走廊都糊成了一层灰色浆泥——每一处表面都被浸透，天花板还不停往下滴落。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Chortles and hoots fill the air, as does a sulfurous smell. Ahead, a pool of bubbling gray mud fills the floor of a steamy chamber lined with stone. Several tiny, winged imps cavort in the sludge. Their forms are loose and oozy, but with beady black eyes and overlong, hooked noses. Their play has coated the room and adjacent hallway in a gray slurry that runs on every surface and drips from the ceiling.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

[隐匿] 在外行人眼里，它只是个朴素却结实的木盒；但只要细看，便会发现盒盖内侧刻着一对用龙语书写的符文。两枚符文分别意为“旅行”与“水”。 [激活] 只消片刻，在你把命令词大声说话出口后，木盒便猛然爆发般动了起来，以快得令人眼花的速度自行展开。不可思议的是，这小盒的木料不断延伸、翻折，竟化作一艘船，足以载人，与同类的普通船只别无二致。 [Concealed] Appearing to the layperson as a simple if sturdy wooden box, careful examination reveals a pair of runes, scribed in Draconic, carved along the inside of the lid. The two runes read as “Travel” and “Water.” [Activated] Within moments of speaking aloud the command word, the wooden box explodes into motion, unfolding more quickly than the eye can follow. Inexplicably, the wood from the small box continues to extend and unfold into a boat, capable of carrying passengers, and indistinguishable from any normal vessel of its type.

即便只是让一名工匠粗略扫上一眼，也能看出这把匕首的刃是由某种巨型生物的獠牙雕琢而成——也许甚至出自巨龙或泰拉斯克。尽管它毫无打磨开刃的痕迹，你却确信，哪怕拿它去试锋，也足以与最上等的锁子甲，乃至板甲一较高下。
Even a cursory glance by an artificer would identify the dagger blade as carved from the tooth of an enormous creature, perhaps even a dragon or a tarrasque. Despite the fact that it carries no marks of sharpening, you are certain that you could test its quality against the finest chain or even plate armor.

Reloading Pump Shotgun.name:
泵动式霰弹枪装填
Reloading Pump Shotgun

Text.text: 你看着子弹一枚枚滑入装填口，在将它们推入的同时，顺畅的动作带来一丝满足。你用chk-chk一声拉动滑套上膛，肾上腺素如涟漪般在体内扩散，你不由得一阵悸动。 You watch the shells disappear into the loading port as you feed them in, taking a measure of satisfaction from the fluid motion. Cocking the slider with a chk-chk, you feel a thrill as adrenaline ripples through your body.

Obvious Enhanced Foot.name:
显而易见的强化脚
Obvious Enhanced Foot

Text.text:
那只未穿靴的脚明显经过改造，带着仿生装甲的冷光点缀与流线型的空气动力外形。稍作扫描便能看出，使用者能跑得更快、跳得更高；一套高科技弹簧系统将本能的移动放大到极致，让哪怕最费力的动作也显得毫不费劲。
The bootless foot is visibly modified, with bionic accents and an aerodynamic design. A quick scan reveals that the user can run faster and jump higher, with a high-tech spring system that amplifies natural movement, making even strenuous activities seem effortless.

Cold And Impersonal Corporate-owned Bank.name:
冰冷而无情的企业控股银行
Cold And Impersonal Corporate-owned Bank

Text.text:
[外面] 银行如同一座巨大的巨石方尖碑，孤傲地矗立在无尽拥挤的摩天楼之间——石砌的堡垒，森严而不可攻破。它以古老的新古典主义风格铸就，入口处石柱列阵；其上，一座石台向钢与玻璃无缝延伸——无边无际的企业空间直刺平流层。门前不见守卫，却有一种无法逃离的感觉：你正被注视着。

[里面] 大厅是不洁之地——阴沉、压迫，头顶是高耸的镜面玻璃穹顶。你能在大理石地面上看见自己的倒影。接待台像一件装置艺术，是一整块未雕琢的石坯，旁边站着一名灰暗单调的仿生人。角落里蜷着一群哀怨的可怜虫，把贷款申请紧紧抱在胸前。安检闸机旁立着一道单薄却慑人的身影，目光落在虚无处，一动不动，也不说话。

[Outside] Like a great monolith, the bank stands apart from endless crowded skyscrapers—an edifice of stone, formidable and impregnable. Crafted in an ancient neoclassical style, stone pillars line the entrance while above a stone dais blends into steel and glass—an endless corporate space stretching to the stratosphere. There are no guards at the entrance, yet there’s an inescapable feeling that you are being watched.

[Inside] The lobby is an unholy place—dark, imposing, with high ceilings of mirrored glass. You can see your reflection in the marbled floor. Like an art installation, the reception desk is an uncarved block of stone manned by an android in drab gray colors. A group of plaintive wretches cower in the corner, clutching loan applications to their chests. A single imposing figure stands next to waist-height security gates, looking at nothing, not moving or speaking.

Winged Saber-toothed Tiger.name:
翼刃剑齿虎
Winged Saber-toothed Tiger

Text.text:
那只巨大的猫科猛兽从岩石上一跃而下，双翼豁然张开，黄褐色的羽毛与它沙色的皮毛无缝交融。它张开剑齿森森的巨口，发出震天怒吼。这幅景象既凯旋又骇人——一头威严而强悍的掠食者振翅腾空。
The massive cat leaps from the rock, spreading its wings wide, tawny feathers blending seamlessly with its sandy fur coat. It spreads its saber-toothed maw into a mighty roar. The vision is triumphant and terrifying all at once, a majestic and capable predator taking flight.

Party Engages In Combat With A Cyberpsyc.name:
小队与一名赛博精神病患者交战
Party Engages In Combat With A Cyberpsycho

Text.text:
他们的身体像被钓线猛拽来回的木偶般抽动，盲目而狂乱地扑向任何威胁，手脚胡乱挥舞。嘴边泛起黄粉色的泡沫，狂野的眼睛布满血丝。缠绕并贯穿全身的义体迸发出光芒，所有流程与程序同时启动，以双倍速度狂奔运转。拳打、刀刺、子弹都无法阻住他们——任何撕裂血肉的伤口都任由新鲜而黯黑的血液汩汩涌出。他们仍在癫狂地猛攻，拳头像铁锤般砸落，力量之大让你听见骨头碎裂的脆响。靠得足够近时，他们甚至朝你龇咬，试图一口咬下去。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

Their body moves like a puppet yanked to and fro by a fishing line, throwing themself toward any threat in a blind, flailing rage. Their mouth foams yellow-pink and their wild eyes are shot through with veins. The cybernetics winding over and through their body surge with light, every process and program activated and running double-time. They aren’t hindered by punches, stabs, or bullets—any wound goring their flesh runs free with fresh, dark blood. They continue their rabid assault, fists landing like hammers, so forceful you hear their bones crunch. They even gnash their teeth at you as they get close enough to take a bite.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

City Slums In Icy Winter.name:
冰封寒冬的城市贫民窟
City Slums In Icy Winter

Text.text:
被寒冬冰冷的钳握紧紧挤压，你拖着沉重的脚步穿行于城市贫民窟，翻涌的白雾般呼吸将你自己遮蔽。在这片冻结的肮脏迷宫里，被积雪堵塞的巷道成了瑟瑟发抖的可怜虫的栖身之所，他们乞求一口食物，凄楚的哭腔撕扯人心。苍白的薄雾如寒冽幽灵般充满街巷，遮住了破败的楼群，也遮住了那些盘桓其间的影子。
Pinched by the icy grip of winter, you plod through city slums, masked by your own billowing breath. Among this labyrinth of frozen squalor, snow-choked alleyways are home to shivering wretches begging for food, their pitiful weeping hearts wrenching. Pallid mists fill the streets like frigid phantoms, obscuring the dilapidated buildings and those who haunt them.

稀疏的绿灌木与高矮不一的棕榈沿着水池边缘生长。清澈的池水带着甜润的气息，沙质池底、水栖植物与游鱼都一览无余。水鸟悠然浮游在水面上，柔和温暖的微风拂出细细涟漪，阳光在其间粼粼闪烁。岸边，两根方形的白石柱标示着一段铺石台阶向池中延伸而下，最底一级已完全没入水中。
Sparse green brush and palms of varying heights line this pool. The sweet smelling water is clear, making it easy to see the sandy bottom, aquatic plants, and fish. Waterfowl swim lazily on the surface and sunlight sparkles on the gentle ripples the soft, warm breeze creates. On the bank, two square pillars of white stone mark paved stairs that descend into the pool, with the bottom step completely submerged.

Pirate Captain Slaying His Assailant.name:
海盗船长斩杀来袭刺客
Pirate Captain Slaying His Assailant

Text.text:
在起伏的甲板上，血水浸透了倒下者的躯体。你看见一名高个男人，头戴宽檐帽，帽侧别着一根硕大的白羽；花哨的大衣下是一件锁子甲，脚蹬高筒宽口靴。他发出讥诮的笑声，身形轻灵，险之又险地闪过一记黏腻凶狠、直取腹间的刺击。随即他一把扣住袭击者的手臂，猛然一拽，将对方硬生生送上自己前刺的弯刀——力道之大，你清楚看见足有半尺长的钢刃从那人背后突出。敌人的脸被痛楚覆上一层死灰般的面具，身躯随即软塌塌地倒在甲板上。
On the heaving deck awash in the blood of the fallen, you see a tall man wearing a wide brimmed hat adorned with a large white feather, a chain shirt under an ornamental greatcoat, and wide topped boots. He laughs sardonically as he lithely dodges a viscous stab at his midsection. He grabs his assailant’s arm, pulling him onto his thrusting scimitar with so much force you see a half foot of steel jut out from the assailant’s back. A mask of pain shrouds his enemy’s face as the body collapses to the deck.

Sundries From A Satyr.name:
萨堤尔杂货铺
Sundries From A Satyr

Text.text:
他的衣着朴素却染得鲜亮——一件火橙色短上衣罩在一件酒红色蓬松衬衫之上。他的排箫在髋侧下方被压得粉碎，身上既无武器也无金币。你倒在他短上衣里摸到一张纸条，因年代久远而泛黄。那是一位仰慕者留下的便笺，用古旧的字迹写就。
His clothes are simple but brightly dyed—a jerkin of fire-orange over a flouncy burgundy shirt. His pan flute lies smashed beneath his hip and he is bereft of weaponry and gold. You do find a slip of paper tucked into his jerkin, yellowed with age. It is a note from an admirer written in archaic script.

结构看似简单：一块方形油布被拉展开来，覆在两根插入泥土的短杆上，再用细绳钉系固定在地面。可这顶朴素的帐篷，恰好容得下四人，却足以在风雨寒霜中，成为生与死之间的分界线。
Deceptively simple in its construction, the square piece of oilcloth is stretched out over two short poles driven into the earth and staked down with twine. Yet this humble tent, just large enough for four, could spell the difference between survival and death from exposure to the elements.

Descent Into The Astral Sea.name:
坠入星界之海
Descent Into The Astral Sea

Text.text:
翻涌的能量破火山口环绕着你，流动如水面上的油膜。你在下沉，周遭苍穹永不停歇地翻卷着，愈发深入创世的原初混沌；一种诡异的感受开始在你体内显形——无限的力量。于朦胧虚空之中，思绪以骇人的速度化作现实；你试图攫住那足以摧毁心智的真相时，意识在无尽可能性前剧烈摇晃。一阵冰冷的恐惧如潮水般袭来，一个念头掠过脑海——若落入不该拥有之手，这股力量足以将造物本身抹除。

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

A roiling caldera of energy surrounds you, moving like oil on water. The firmament around you is in permanent motion as you descend, deeper into the raw chaos of creation, and feel a strange sensation begin to manifest within you—the feeling of unlimited power. Thought becomes reality with terrifying haste in the nebulous void, and your mind reels as you try to grasp the limitless possibilities of that mind-shattering truth. A cold wave of dread washes over you as a notion crosses your mind—in the wrong hands this power could undo creation itself.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

积雪唯独不肯覆上几处地面。雪花尚未触到裸露的泥土便已消隐，化作缕缕雾丝向上飘散，随即无影无踪。这些光秃的斑块边缘既无冰封也无泥泞。若说有什么变化，便是靠近它们时，空气反而更冷。
Snow refuses to cling to a few patches of ground. Flakes fade before touching the bare dirt, forming tendrils of mist that float upward and disappear. These naked patches have no ice or slush around their edges. If anything, the air is colder near them.

Channel Divinity: Invoke Duplicity.name:
引导神力：唤起分身
Channel Divinity: Invoke Duplicity

Text.text:
你身形一闪。轮廓开始模糊，整个人从视野中褪去。紧接着，在一眨眼间，你又如同先前消散那样，闪烁着重现于世。只是这一次，你身旁多了一个孪影。那分身朝你眨了眨眼……还是说，是你在朝它眨眼？ [Move Duplicate] 只需一个念头，你便将那虚假孪影送往你想让它去的地方。 [Cast through Duplicate] 你的虚假孪影映照着你的施法，法术不再从你的双手迸发，而是从它的手中施放。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

You flicker. Your edges blur, and you fade from view. Then, in a blink, you shimmer back into existence much the way you faded. Only, now, you have a twin who has appeared nearby. The duplicate winks at you… or is that you winking at it? [Move Duplicate] With only a thought, you send your false twin where you’d like it to go. [Cast through Duplicate] Your false twin mirrors your casting, and the spell comes from its hands rather than yours.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

柜台后的老矮人皮肤晒得黝黑，身上套着一件皮革围裙。你一踏进他的冒险者装备店，他便如鹰隼般盯着你不放。起初他沉默地打量你磨损的装备与衣着，过了片刻，显然才判断你是上门的客人，而非想偷货的匪徒或游手好闲的无赖。可即便他开口招呼、问你需要什么帮忙，你仍能感觉到这位商人把几把上弦的手弩藏在柜台后头，而且真要用起来也绝不含糊。
Tanned and dressed in a leather smock, the aged dwarf behind the counter watches you like a hawk as you enter his adventuring-equipment store. It takes him a few moments of gauging your worn equipment and clothing before he evidently decides that you are potential customers, not brigands or layabouts looking for goods to steal. Yet, even as he greets you and asks what he might do to assist, you can sense that this merchant has several loaded hand crossbows concealed behind the counter, and the wherewithal to use them.

Old Spirewych & Elderview Hall In Winter.name:
冬日里的老尖塔女巫与远景厅
Old Spirewych & Elderview Hall In Winter

Text.text:
这片街区——新旧楼宇尽披白雪——宛如节庆时节摆在壁炉台上的微缩模型小镇般如画。市长的一群工作人员从埃尔德维尤大厅走出，边走边聊着午餐的打算与将至的假期。
This district—old and new buildings blanketed in snow—is as picturesque as the model towns that are placed on mantels in the festive season. A group of the mayor’s staff exits Elderview Hall, chattering of lunch plans and the upcoming holidays.

细如铜币、大如茅舍的冰块漂浮在开阔水面上。它们自四周由积雪压实的峭壁崩解而来；更巨大的冰山在水中翻转，露出相对平坦的表面——而其大部分体量已沉入刺骨寒水之下。
Chunks of ice as small as copper pieces and as large as cottages float in the open water. Calved from the surrounding cliffs of compounded snow, larger icebergs have turned in the water to present relatively flat surfaces—with most of their mass sunk in the frigid water.

你的言辞如雷霆般碰撞，如雪崩般倾泻。你手中的石头轰然碎裂，化作尘埃——从指缝间簌簌洒落。沉重的寂静压下片刻，随即大地轰鸣：先是脚下轻微的颤动，旋即迅速攀升为剧烈的震颤。地面开裂、隆起，喷涌的尘土与碎屑冲入空中。泥浆翻涌着冒出地表，建筑在沸腾的泥浪中沉没无踪。
Your words clash like thunder, like an avalanche. The stone in your hand shatters, becoming dust—spilling between your fingers. A moment of heavy silence passes, then the ground rumbles, beginning as a slight vibration at your feet but growing quickly to an intense tremor. The ground splits and heaves, sending gouts of dust and debris into the air. Mud bubbles to the surface, and structures disappear beneath the roil.

Campsite By Trail.name:
步道旁的营地
Campsite By Trail

Text.text:
小径在荒野中蜿蜒前行，但左侧却有一处寒酸的营地，篝火仍在闷闷冒着余烬。一段帆布搭在倒下的原木上，充作简陋的帐篷。帐篷上挂着一枚古怪的图腾，或许是精灵所制。火堆旁的泥地里丢着一只挎包。你翻开一看：足够吃上好几天的口粮（风干鹿肉、发硬的面包和一条熏鱼）、一张褪色的区域地图、一捆麻绳，以及一把做工精良的钢匕首。搭起这营地的人离开得很仓促。
The trail winds its way through the wilderness, but to the left sits a meager campsite, its fire still smoldering. A length of canvas draped over a felled log serves as a simple tent. A strange totem, possibly elven-made, hangs from the tent. A satchel lies in the dirt near the fire. Inside, you find enough rations for several days (dried venison, stale bread, and a smoked fish), a faded map of the area, a bundle of hempen rope, and a steel dagger of fine make. Whoever pitched this camp left in a hurry.

Dragon's Breath (Cold) Cast On Ally.name:
龙之吐息（寒冷）施放于盟友
Dragon's Breath (Cold) Cast On Ally

Text.text:
你一口咬下辣椒，迎来的不是热浪翻涌，而是一阵冰冷刺痛。你伸出手，接触你的盟友。胸腔里盘旋的暴风雪随即散去，魔法沿着你伸展的手臂奔涌而出，化作一阵覆着白霜的寒风，身后拖曳着点点闪光的雪晶。你的盟友肩膀猛然宽阔起来，下颚紧紧咬住。胸口迸出一声低吼，听起来像雪崩滚落的轰鸣。
Biting down on the pepper does not result in a rush of heat but an icy sting. You reach out and touch your ally. The blizzard swirling in your chest dissipates when the magic flows from your outstretched arm as a white, frosted wind with motes of shining snowflakes in its wake. Your ally’s shoulders broaden and their jaw clenches. A growl emits from their chest that sounds like the tumble of an avalanche.

Greetings From A Trader Of Rare Items.name:
来自珍稀物品商人的问候
Greetings From A Trader Of Rare Items

Text.text:
“我向你保证，我卖的都是上上等的好货——来自遥远国度的稀罕奇珍，里头有些稀有到连我都不知道它们从哪儿来的。我的意思是，你瞧瞧这玩意儿！我也不知道它是什么，但我敢打赌，它藏着各式各样的秘密。尽管随心挑选、细细端详，但也请记住：一经售出，概不退换；若因此引发任何怪事，或招来什么带诗意的后果，我们一概不负责。”
“I assure you, I offer quality goods of the highest order—rare and exotic items from distant lands, some so rare even I don’t know where they came from. I mean, look at this thing! Don’t know what it is, but I bet it holds all sorts of secrets. Browse and peruse to your heart’s content, but do remember that all sales are final and we are not responsible for any strange happenings or poetic consequences that occur.”

Darrick Eversharp, Hunting Party Leader.name:
达里克·埃弗夏普，狩猎队队长
Darrick Eversharp, Hunting Party Leader

Text.text:
矮人那黝黑、饱经风霜的面庞上，三道斜斜交错的深长裂痕纵横其间——那是旧日宿敌留下的伤。长柄象牙烟斗夹在他唇间，他深吸一口，你看见那双钢铁般的灰眼在永远紧蹙的眉下透出冷硬的决意。可怖的巨斧倚在他身侧，斧身铭刻的符文在酒馆的昏暗光照中泛起柔和的蓝光。
Deep, ragged scars cross the dark, weathered skin of the dwarf’s face in three diagonal lines—a wound from an old rival. As he draws on the long-stemmed ivory pipe resting between his lips, you see steely gray eyes set in stoic determination beneath a permanently knitted brow. A fearsome greataxe rests by his side, inscribed with runes that glow a soft blue in the dim light of the tavern.

Treasure Chest On Cave Ledge.name:
洞穴岩架上的宝藏箱
Treasure Chest On Cave Ledge

Text.text:
你瞥见那道绝无仅有的金色闪光。在阴影里——就在高高突岩的边缘——一只宝箱炸裂般敞开着，箱中之物倾泻四散，宛如倒下敌手的血肉横陈。你猛然醒悟，自己想到鲜血并非全凭想象：宝箱周围的裂石上，正积着一汪猩红。
You catch sight of the unmistakable glint of gold. In the shadows—at the very edge of a high ledge—sits a treasure chest burst open, its contents spilled around it like the gore of a fallen foe. You realize with a start that more than imagination made you think of blood: something red pools on the cracked stone around the chest.

Giant Wolf Spider.name:
巨型狼蛛
Giant Wolf Spider

Text.text:
与更庞大的近亲相比，巨狼蛛堪称潜行大师；即便体型更小，危险也丝毫不减。它善用蛛网、在网间穿行如履平地，再加上偏好伏击的习性，让它那一口毒咬的威力成倍放大。
A master of stealth compared to its larger cousins, the giant wolf spider is no less dangerous for its smaller size. Its use and easy traversal of webs coupled with its penchant for ambush are force multipliers for its bite.

表面坚实如铁，无法通行。但你以心灵触及，并将咒语说话般朗声吐出，坚固的表面随之分开，裂出一道开口。一条通道随之显现，穿行于这座构造之中。
The surface is solid, impassable. But you reach out with your mind and, speaking the words aloud, part the solid surface and form an opening. A passage appears, leading through the structure.

I Cast Find Steed.name:
我施放【寻觅坐骑】
I Cast Find Steed

Text.text:
我吟诵着法术的言辞，仿佛在呼唤一位久别的老友回到身旁，空气里那熟悉的嗡鸣随之渐渐高涨。我的坐骑之躯在眼前开始凝聚，于神圣光辉的点点微尘中成形；它亦以呼唤回应，我们再一次重逢。
I project the words of the spell, as if beckoning an old friend to my side, and feel a familiar hum grow in the air. As my steed’s body begins to coalesce before me, in motes of divine light, it calls out in response and we are reunited once again.

Sundries From A Nycaloth: Horns.name:
尼卡洛斯的杂货：号角
Sundries From A Nycaloth: Horns

Text.text:
从这生物筋肉虬结的肩头刺出的尖角呈灰白色，底色苍淡，仿佛曾经纯净的雪花石膏被污血浸染。生物黄绿斑驳的额脊上，两根象牙角如两柄军刀的刃锋般向上延展。它们看上去与恶魔战斧柄上所用的象牙同出一源——一种带着金色光泽的骨质，粗糙得像鲨皮。可惜那柄战斧已断落在地，斧刃碎裂成无数片。
The spiked horns poking out of the creature’s sinewed shoulders are grayish in hue with a pale undertone, like once pure alabaster stained with ichor. On the creature’s yellowish-green, mottled brow, two ivory horns extend up like the blades of two sabers. They appear to be the same kind of ivory used in the handle of the demon’s axe: a kind of golden bone rough like sharkskin. The axe, unfortunately, lies broken on the ground, its blade fractured into numerous pieces.

I Reach Into My Bag Of Devouring.name:
我把手伸进吞噬之袋中
I Reach Into My Bag Of Devouring

Text.text:
我刚掀开袋口的翻盖，熟悉的热湿气流便扑面而来——像是从幽深食道里传出的喘息。我咬紧牙关把手伸进去，暗自希望我放在这里的物品还在。指尖抓住了所需之物，可当我试着把手抽回时，却感到一股飘渺的拉扯。我的手臂被拽进袋中，直至肘部——只持续了片刻。随即袋子又把我和那件物品一并吐了出来，而我在猛地合上袋口时，仍听见远处传来一声低沉、幽幽的窃笑。
As soon as I lift the flap of the bag, I feel the familiar rush of hot, wet air—a panting breath from a cavernous gullet. I grit my teeth before reaching inside, hoping the items I placed here are still there. My hand grasps what I need, but as I attempt to pull my hand back out I feel an ethereal tug. My arm is pulled into the bag up to my elbow—for a moment. Then the bag releases me and the item, though I hear a distant, deep chuckle as I quickly snap the bag shut.

Scimitar Of Life Stealing.name:
夺命噬生弯刀
Scimitar Of Life Stealing

Text.text:
这把暗刃弯刀以邪异的弧度勾勒出更为浓烈的恶魔气息。宛如动脉的蚀刻沿着刀身弧线蜿蜒而下，随时准备将能量从任何不幸触及刃锋的存在体内，径直导向持用者。
The wicked curve of this dark-bladed scimitar accentuates its devilish aura. Etchings like arteries course down the sword's arc, ready to channel energy straight to the user from any entity unfortunate enough to meet the blade's edge.

Puzzle Door Opening.name:
谜题门开启
Puzzle Door Opening

Text.text:
最后一块拼图嵌入原位后，似乎什么也没有发生；那扇顽固的门依旧沉寂，仿佛神祇才知道它已如此多久。忽然，一声刺破耳膜的尖啸宣告着行动骤起，门上的板片开始折叠、滑移、咬合，整扇门塌缩进墙内的凹槽——露出其后深渊般的黑暗。一缕柔风轻拂你的脸颊，裹挟着时代凝滞的微妙气息，以及被遗忘已久的记忆。
Nothing seems to happen after the last piece of the puzzle is inserted into place, the unyielding door remaining dormant, as it has been for gods know how long. An ear-piercing screech announces sudden activity and panels begin to fold, slide, and interlock as the whole door collapses into a recess in the wall—revealing an abyssal darkness beyond. A soft breeze caresses your cheek, carrying with it the hint of time stood still, and memories long forgotten.

一头猫科生物通体鲜橙，覆着深黑条纹，悄然向前潜行。四只爪子皆伸出一排弯钩般的利爪，然而每一步都轻得无声、沉稳而克制。虎躯上每一块隆起的肌肉都绷紧如弓，只待那双掠食者般的眼睛捕捉到一丝弱点，便会立刻扑杀而出。
A feline creature of vibrant orange striped with deep black prowls forward. All four paws feature an array of hooked claws, yet each step is quiet and deliberate. Every hulking muscle in the tiger's body is tensed, ready to pounce the moment its predatory eyes detect a sign of weakness.

Third Year Fellowship Ritual.name:
第三年同盟仪式
Third Year Fellowship Ritual

Text.text:
三年级学期休假第一天，职业举办了一场仪式盛宴。众人同席而食，随后结伴走上附近小丘的顶端，迎着寒冷的夜色眺望。他们手牵着手，施放一道只需意念的共同法术——团结之咒。那法术极其艰难，这一次第一次尝试失败了，第二次也未能成形。学生们将近凌晨四点才各自回到宿舍，倒头扑进床铺里。
On the first day of their third-year term break, the class has a ritual feast. They eat together, then walk to the top of a nearby hill and look out on the cold night. They hold hands and cast a communal spell of unity that is only thought. It is a difficult spell, and this time the first effort fails, then the second. The students return to their houses at nearly four in the morning and fall into their beds.

I Cast Regenerate.name:
我施放《再生术》
I Cast Regenerate

Text.text:
当我接触我的目标时，我感到他们的每一个细胞都在对我的魔法作出反应，嗡嗡作响，仿佛迫不及待要俯冲进花海的蜂群。我的咒语化作对它们的鼓励之词：请它们止住出血、缝合伤口，并以闪电般的速度照料扭伤与拉伤。
As I touch my target, I sense every one of their cells reacting to my magic, buzzing like bees eager to descend on a field of flowers. My incantation becomes words of encouragement to them: asking them to halt bleeding, knit cuts, and tend to sprains at lightning speed.

Colt Aqua Phoenix.name:
柯尔特·碧水凤凰
Colt Aqua Phoenix

Text.text:
这个男人皮肤湛蓝，头发却像燃烧的烈焰般翻腾，是奥术元素的悖论化身。他的肌肤滚烫得近乎灼人，嗓音如鲸歌般悠远回荡——然而他眼底那一抹分明的狡黠火花，清清楚楚地泄露了一个无赖的本性。

~ 由一位英雄 Played

With blue skin and hair of burning fire, this man is a paradox of the arcane elements. His skin is feverishly hot, and his voice is like a whale song—though the look in his eye has the telltale spark of a rogue.

~ Played by a Hero

抖落林地腐屑的残渣，两只古怪的纤维生物以狼般的腿肢站起，咆哮的巨口转向你——它们的獠牙被阴毒的倒刺荆棘所取代。它们看似狼形，却仿佛完全由斑驳褐色的植物质构成。

~ 构想：Steve Adamski

Shaking off the detritus of the forest floor, two strange fibrous creatures rise on lupine legs and turn snarling maws toward you, their fangs replaced by wicked, barbed thorns. Though they have the appearance of wolves, these monsters seem to be created entirely from mottled-brown plant matter.

~ Envisioned by Steve Adamski

一股旋转的尘涡伴着起伏扭曲的尖啸拔地而起。翻卷的身影不断变幻，始终未能完全凝成实体；就在刹那间，一张恶魔般的面孔从流沙乱舞的旋风中探出。那可憎的身形——生角露獠——露出小鬼般阴毒的狞笑，以龙卷般的肢体抽击四周的一切。
A whirling vortex of dust rises with an undulating scream. The swirling figure shifts, never fully materializing, and for an instant a devilish visage looks out from the cyclone of shifting sand. A horrible figure—horned and fanged—sneers its impish malice as it buffets those around it with tornado limbs.

I Forage For Food.name:
我四处觅食
I Forage For Food

Text.text:
我在荒野间穿行，目光与双手轻拂过沿途的草木，搜寻可入口的食物。我在一丛被蛛网蒙成薄雾的灌木上，摘下几把饱满的浆果。我潜行追踪，循着兔子逃窜时晃动的蓬松尾巴，穿过灌丛与枯枝的遮掩，最终逮住了两只。我又找到一棵桉胶树，剥下树皮，收拢成一捆，轻轻松松夹在腋下带走。我低声自嘲地笑了笑——我知道这玩意儿能吃，却硬得像皮革，多半不会成为我的伙伴们的心头好。
I weave through the wilderness, eyes and hands grazing the flora for foodstuffs. I find a few handfuls of plump berries on a bush clouded with spiderwebs. I stalk and eventually catch a couple of rabbits, following their bushy tails as they fled from me through the underbrush. I find a gum tree and strip it of its bark, gathering a bundle I can easily carry under my arm. I chuckle quietly to myself, as I know this edible but tough-as-leather snack will not be a favorite among my companions.

一名半精灵倒卧在一根巨大的石柱下，身下血泊正缓缓在铺砖地面上蔓延。她呼吸沉重而断续，紧攥着颈间链子上悬挂的圣徽，低声祈求援助。
A half-elf lies beneath a large stone column, in a pool of blood that is spreading slowly across the tiled floor. Her breathing is heavy and ragged, and she clings to the symbol hanging from a chain about her neck, praying for aid.

Falling In The Plane Of Air.name:
空气位面的坠落
Falling In The Plane Of Air

Text.text:
你在空中翻滚，天旋地转，狂风以远古般的蛮力在你周身嘶吼。你努力稳住心神，四下搜寻任何能让你辨明方向的东西。却什么也看不见。这里没有地平线，没有陆地或群星可供指引——只有无垠的苍穹，在无休无止的循环动荡中翻涌。

~ Sahlonahl 于 Discord

You tumble through the air, head over heels, as the wind howls around you with primordial strength. The world spins as you try to get your bearings, looking for anything to orient yourself with. You don't see a thing. There is no horizon here, no landmasses or stars to guide you—only the endless, cyclic tumult of the open sky.

~ Sahlonahl on Discord

安保站里的监视屏幕忽明忽暗、抽搐般跳闪，蓝色的代码斑块悄然渗入根系。沿着能量电池一路下行，穿过线缆，钻进残留自我影像的矩阵里，一个小女孩浮现出来，指着一串ID代码说道：他们干的。最好阻止他们。/span>

~ 由一位Hero Envisioned

 The monitors in the security stations flicker and twitch as blue patches of code insinuate themselves into the root systems. Down the power cells, through the wiring, and into the matrix of residual self-images, a little girl appears, pointing at a string of ID code and saying, They did it. Better stop them./span>

~ Envisioned by a Hero

White Knight On Horseback.name:
白马上的白骑士
White Knight On Horseback

Text.text:
骑士跨坐在战马之上，摆出英勇的姿态。耀眼的白钢铠甲覆身，精巧的头盔遮住了他们的神情；然而他们执缰的手从容而笃定，长矛也握得轻松自如，那份熟稔是数十年马背生涯淬炼出的。
The knight strikes a heroic pose atop the stallion. Plated in gleaming white steel, their expression is concealed behind an elaborate helm, but their grip on the reins is easy and sure, and they carry a spear with an ease born of decades in the saddle.

Divine Home Of A Goddess Of The Moon.name:
月之女神的神圣居所
Divine Home Of A Goddess Of The Moon

Text.text:
月之女神永远是访客，是旅人，乘着一缕苍白的反光而来，寻求款待；可她的家却是一座白垩筑成的城堡，孤零零立在尘埃与碎岩的旷野之上。她宫廷的众多成员栖居于银色地板、蓝色帷幕垂落的房间里。城堡外观寂寥而幽暗，可一踏入其中，尽是光与色彩。它的一些窗户在玻璃中放大了大地的海洋，如同浩瀚潮汐近在眼前。另一些则映出恋人彼此寻到对方，向女神吟诵诗句。
The Goddess of the Moon is always a visitor, a traveler on a pale beam of reflected light seeking hospitality, but her home is a castle of white chalk standing alone on an expanse of dust and broken rock. The many members of her court live in silver-floored and blue-draped rooms. The castle looks lonely and dark, but inside it is full of light and color. Some of its windows magnify the seas of the earth in their glass. Others display lovers finding one another and reciting poetry to the goddess.

镶满宝石的长袍披覆在这名精灵健壮的身躯上——肩背宽阔、肌肉结实，银灰色的皮肤上交织着密密的疤痕——腰间一条龙皮腰带上，挂着一柄华丽的弯刀。他的眼睛泛着金光，闪烁着压抑的狡黠。他寡言少语，几乎不外露情绪，却仿佛时时刻刻都准备拔刀出手——肌肉紧绷、蓄势待发，像捕食者一般。

~ 由 Andy 11409 扮演 Played 并附

Jewel-encrusted robes drape the athletic form of this elf—broad and muscled, silver-gray skin a latticework of scars—and an ornate scimitar hangs from his belt of dragon hide. His eyes gleam gold, shining with a subdued cunning. He speaks little, betrays few emotions, but seems at all times prepared to draw his blade and strike—muscles taut and ready, like a predator.

~ Played by Andy 11409 with

Nightmare About Being Puppeted.name:
被操控成傀儡的噩梦
Nightmare About Being Puppeted

Text.text:
你醒来时，下巴垂抵在胸口，歪斜的脖颈僵硬得刺痛。你想抬手揉一揉拉伤的肌肉，却发现自己根本动不了。你睁开眼，看见双脚悬在离地仅仅几寸的地方。地面溅着一片血色，你挣扎着对抗这麻痹时，又有几滴血啪嗒落地。随即，你听见一阵尖细的嗡鸣。钢丝猛地勒紧你的脖颈与额头，一股魅影般的力量抬起并扭转你的头，让你得以看见自己身体的其余部分。你的皮肉与衣物一片猩红。更多钢丝缠上你的手腕、手肘、膝盖与腰腹，深深割进皮肤。它们的末端如木偶的线般向上攀升，没入纯粹阴影的天空。钢丝开始动作，金属铮鸣，猛地一抽一拽，将你的身体扯成痛彻骨髓的痉挛。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

You awake with your chin lowered against your chest, your crooked neck painfully stiff. You try to lift your hand to rub at the strained muscles only to find you cannot. Your eyes open, and you see your feet dangling just above the ground. A spattering of blood colors the floor, a few drops plinking against the ground as you try to move against this paralysis. Then you hear a tinny whine. Wires tighten about your neck and forehead as some phantom force lifts and swivels your head, allowing you to look at the rest of your body. Your flesh and clothes run red. More wires wrap about your wrists, elbows, knees, and waist, cutting deep into your skin. Their ends ascend upward like a puppet's strings, into a sky of pure shadow. The wires move, metal twanging, jerking your body in agonizing spasms.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Ask My Luck Blade For A Wish.name:
我向幸运之刃许下一个愿望
I Ask My Luck Blade For A Wish

Text.text:
开口相求自有风险，疲惫也将随之而来，但这必须去做。这把武器蕴藏着我未来的终极力量——我在柄首的每一颗宝石中都能感到它，在我将刀刃横于身前时，那微微震颤也在掌心回响。我以自己的方式向它诉说，然后等待我最宏大希望的应验。
There is risk in the asking, and fatigue will follow, but it must be done. This weapon has the ultimate power of my future, and I feel it in every jewel on the pommel, in the vibration of the blade as I hold it before me. I address it in my fashion, and wait for the fulfilment of my grandest hope.

I Channel A Divine Strike: Cleric Of The.name:
我引导神圣打击：神域牧师
I Channel A Divine Strike: Cleric Of The Divine Domain

Text.text:
生命之光任我拨弄，我将这股力量贯穿全身，灌入我所执之物——使我的武器辉映光辉。当这些器具击中我的敌人时，神圣的辉耀会将他们的生命灼烧殆尽。
The light of life is mine to manipulate, and I channel this power through my body into the objects I wield—it illuminates my weapons. When these instruments strike my foes, this divine radiance burns the life from them.

浓彩织锦铺陈在厅室四壁，高耸的穹顶下，一盏枝形吊灯被某种奥术之力悬托半空，熠熠生辉。缕缕天青能量绕着水晶盘旋，向下洒落水栖般的幽光，映照着下方交际的宾客。一隅里，室内乐师奏起小夜曲，却无人随之起舞。人们只在各自挑选的圈子里徘徊，低声交换的尽是流言与人情——只与这座城最富有、最丑闻缠身的人相关。

~ 由 Girlhead 构想

Richly dyed tapestries dress the walls of the room, its high ceiling alight with a chandelier suspended by some arcane force. Wisps of cerulean energy twirl around the crystal and cast an aquatic glow on the guests mingling below. In one corner, chamber musicians play a serenade to which no one dances. People instead mill in their selective circles, quiet voices exchanging gossip and favors relevant only to the wealthiest and most scandalous of the city.

~ Envisioned by Girlhead

Farmer’s Field In Late Summer.name:
夏末的农田
Farmer’s Field In Late Summer

Text.text:
虫鸣嗡嗡，充盈着温润的空气。你眼前，一片农夫的田地沐浴在阳光柔和的抚触下，随风摇曳的作物在微风里起伏如浪。蜜蜂在一丛丛野花间穿梭飞舞，以勤勉而急切的节奏为绚烂的花朵授粉。空气里隐约飘着收成的气息，预告着富饶——工人们照料着日渐饱满的庄稼，感念这一季的赋礼。
The buzz of insects fills the balmy air. Before you, a farmer’s field basks in the sun’s gentle caress, its swaying crops moving in the breeze. Bees flit between clumps of wildflowers, pollinating vibrant blossoms with diligent urgency. The air carries a hint of harvest, promising abundance as the workers tend to the ripening crops, grateful for the season’s gift.

Aagni And Barh’s Searflight Taproom In W.name:
冬日里的阿格尼与巴尔的“灼翼”酒馆
Aagni And Barh’s Searflight Taproom In Winter

Text.text:
许多人从外头的刺骨寒意里逃进来，换取热腾腾的盘中食物、蜜酒的醇香，以及红龙裔那灼人的吐息。阿格尼朝巨大的壁炉喷出一道炽烈的火焰光束，引得酒客们拍手喝彩。白鳞的巴尔穿着单薄的衬衫和长裤，笑着嘲弄阿格尼咯咯作响的牙关与颤抖的脊刺。他给一桌游侠与猎人又添上一轮蜜酒——他们头发被风吹得凌乱，衣物磨旧发白。他们说话的口音与镇上大多数人不同，装备却一看就足以放倒最庞大、最凶险的猎物。
Many folk have escaped the outside chill for the warmth of hot plates of food, mead, and the fiery breath of a red dragonborn. Aagni breathes a searing beam of fire into the great hearth, to which patrons clap in appreciation. Barh, white-scaled and dressed in a thin dress shirt and pants, laughs at Aagni’s chattering teeth and shaking spines. He serves another round of mead to a table of rangers and hunters, hair windswept and clothes worn. They speak in a different accent than most of the other folk in town, and seem equipped to take down the largest and most dangerous of prey.

这间屋子不大，陈设简朴却舒适。空气里弥漫着旧纸、墨水与蜡的气味。一对书桌相对而立，每张都堆满书籍、羽毛笔、墨水瓶、一叠叠羊皮纸，以及半融的蜡烛。墙边一侧被上下铺占据，床单与枕头因学生们辗转不安的浅眠而纠作一团。
The room is small, spartan but comfortable. It smells of old paper, ink, and wax. A pair of desks stand opposite each other, each laden with books, quills, inkwells, sheafs of parchment, and half-melted candles. Bunk beds dominate one wall, their sheets and pillows tangled from the fitful sleep of students.

View From The Palace Of An Elven Capital.name:
从精灵王都宫殿眺望
View From The Palace Of An Elven Capital

Text.text:
双手倚在宫殿被日光晒得发烫的栏杆上，你俯瞰这座辽阔的城市——方正的砂岩建筑由立柱支撑，铺瓦的屋顶呈金盏花般的焦橙色。远远下方，市民们各自奔忙，穿梭在道路之间；路旁高耸的柏树成行，像沉默的卫兵。

~ Envisioned by Goblin Man

Resting your hands against the palace’s sun-soaked balustrade, you gaze down at the expansive city—square, sandstone buildings supported by columns, their tiled roofs the burnt orange of marigolds. The citizens far below go about their business, weaving along roads lined with tall cypress trees.

~ Envisioned by Goblin Man

疯长的杂草从深深龟裂的石径间探出，沿路指向那座陷落墙垣的农舍。曾经结实的木梁撑起屋架，如今却在二层的重压下无力下垂。曾安放在窗框里的细小玻璃碎片散落在尘土飞扬、饱经摧残的木地板上。远处墙边堆着一大堆沉重的石块，是多年前烟囱坍塌后留下的残骸。锈蚀的工具仍挂在墙上的原位，仿佛在等待那位曾经使用它们的人归来。
Overgrown weeds poke through the deeply cracked stone path leading towards the sunken walls of the farmhouse. The once-sturdy wooden beams making up the frame of the house are now feebly dipping under the weight of the second story. Small shards of glass that once rested in their respective window frames litter the dusty, battered floorboards. A large pile of hefty stones lie against the far wall, remnants from the long-ago collapsed chimney. Rusted tools still hang from their places on the wall, awaiting the return of one who used them.

I Cast Destroy Water.name:
我施放「摧毁水」
I Cast Destroy Water

Text.text:
当我吟诵出法术的最后一个词，将一把砂砾撒入水中时，口腔里涌起一股粗粝的干涩。骤然间，炽烈的热浪伴着一阵疾风席卷整间屋子，水体化作蒸汽翻腾升起，随即消散无踪。我的舌头像被烈日曝晒的尸体般干硬，双手的皮肤则如干涸河床里的黏土般枯皱龟裂。
A coarse dryness fills my mouth as I intone the last word of the spell and cast the grains of sand into the water. A sudden, intense heat fills the room with a rush of wind as the water turns to steam then dissipates. My tongue feels like a sunbaked corpse and the skin on my hands is withered and cracked like clay in a dry riverbed.

这片干旱的山谷几乎养不起什么植被——放眼所及，只有枯干的灌木与一丛丛褐色、脆裂的干草。脚下的土地干涸开裂，夯得坚硬，仿佛一触即碎。曾经有河流在此蜿蜒穿行，或许终有一日会再度归来，但绝不是今天。
The arid valley supports little vegetation—only dry shrubs and clusters of brown, brittle grass can be seen. The earth here is dry and cracked, hard-packed and brittle. Rivers once wound through here, and may yet again, but not today.

Data Heist Goes Awry.name:
数据劫案失控
Data Heist Goes Awry

Text.text:
被重重防火墙层层封锁的金色发光数据，终于近在眼前。你伸手触及它的一刻，灰色脉冲骤然荡开，随之而来的是低沉而不祥的轰鸣。“操操操！”安保系统又在重新启动。银白色墙壁凭空凝结，封死了退路。紫色旋涡孕育出杀毒无人机，喷吐出灼烧般的侵入数据光束。你的队员们彼此对视，面容紧绷，忧惧写在每一道线条里。
The glowing golden data, kept behind so many firewalls, is finally in sight. As you reach for it there is a gray pulse, and a deep and ominous noise. “Oh shit, oh shit, oh shit!” The security systems are booting up again. Silvery walls materialize, cutting off escape. Purple swirls give birth to antivirus drones, burning lines of intrusive data. Your crew looks at each other, faces taut with worry.

Helcral's Distillery.name:
赫尔克拉尔的酒坊
Helcral's Distillery

Text.text:
低矮的天花板、长凳与桌子，都在迁就酒坊最主要的客人：同为矮人、喉咙干得冒烟的酒友。这座洞窟被改作酒馆，墙壁与家具皆由山岩直接凿刻而成。就连吧台也是一整块灰色石板，嵌着钢蓝与鎏金的金属细饰，勾出锐利的几何纹样。壁灯托架上的火焰烧得明亮，橙红火光在墙面上跳跃，映在酒客被汗水抛亮的脸上，来回反射。 豪爽的老板托起一只托盘，上面摆着六只翻涌起泡的酒杯，他的笑容张得很开，在浓密的赤褐胡须间露出缺口的牙。对着一张挤得满满的桌子，他放声大笑，客人们则舔着干裂的嘴唇，迫不及待。与此同时，他的妻子站在一座蒸馏器旁，铜制外壳亮得像新扣子。她咬着拇指指甲，沾满墨渍的手指把些许颜色蹭到了牙上。

~ 构想：Azbolg

The low ceilings, benches, and tables prioritize the distillery’s primary clientele: fellow dwarves with parched throats. The walls and furniture are carved directly from mountain stone in this cavern turned taproom. Even the bar is a long slab of gray stone, inlaid with steely blue and golden filigree in sharp, geometric patterns. The fires from the sconces burn bright, the orange flamelight dancing along the walls, bouncing off the sweat-shined faces of the patrons. The gregarious owner holds up a platter with six frothing tankards, his smile wide and gapped within his full auburn beard. He laughs uproariously at one of the packed tables, customers licking their chapped lips in anticipation. Meanwhile, his wife stands near one of their stills, the copper exterior bright as a new button. She chews her thumbnail, her ink-stained fingers transferring some of the color onto her teeth.

~ Envisioned by Azbolg

On The Planet Born Dead.name:
死寂诞生之星
On The Planet Born Dead

Text.text:
这片大气沉重而黏稠，压迫的不止是你的肉身；连你的精神也仿佛被无休无止地拽向行星的核心。你的眉骨沉沉覆在眼上，除非低头盯着那稀疏、灰白的泥土，否则每一次抬眼都刺痛难忍——脚步落下时，地面微微下陷，触感古怪地柔软发泡。放眼望去，唯有苍白、无草的丘陵起伏其间，头顶则是赤与黑交织的地狱般云幕。潮湿的风猛地掠过，浑浊、刺鼻，像钝针扎进皮肤。

~ 由Stefano ImperialeEnvisioned

The atmosphere, oppressive and dense, weighs on more than just your body; your spirit too, feels as if it’s being pulled perpetually toward the planet’s core. Your brow hangs heavily over your eyes, making it painful to look anywhere except down at the sparse, gray earth—ground that sinks slightly as you step, feeling strangely spongy. The landscape is nothing more than pale, grassless hills under a hellish canopy of red and black clouds. A humid wind rushes over you, stale and stinging.

~ Envisioned by Stefano Imperiale

Emotion-altering Drug, “Guts”.name:
改变情绪的药物：“胆气”
Emotion-altering Drug, “Guts”

Text.text:
黄铜色的罐体闪耀如古战士擦拭得锃亮的胸甲。内里压缩的致幻气体，一旦吸入，便会麻痹大脑的恐惧反应。只需一口气，使用者便会变得彻底无畏——但那阵亢奋一旦散去，杏仁核就像嘉年华的游戏机般骤然亮起，把人猛地拖进只属于自己的、神经战栗的私密地狱。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The brass-colored canister gleams like an ancient warrior’s polished breastplate. The mind-altering gas compressed within deadens the fear response in the brain when inhaled. One breath makes the user utterly unafraid—but once that high is over, the amygdala lights up like a carnival game, plunging the user into their own private hell of nervous terror.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Mentors' Bedrooms.name:
导师们的卧室
Mentors' Bedrooms

Text.text:
一处简洁利落的空间，每间房都配有一张床、一张边桌，以及一只用于存放私人物品的大箱子。其中四间房已划归给资深的公会成员——他们常驻于此，负责指导新入会的学徒。
A simple and tidy space, each room features a bed, a side table, and a large chest for personal belongings. Four such rooms have been designated for experienced guild members who remain on-site to tutor initiates.

一望无际的惨白雪冰铺满寒冽的海面，仿佛把冰冷的水域彻底堵死。较大的冰块周围漂着更小的碎块与一层碎冰泥浆。你沿着地平线搜寻传说中那种冻结漂浮的冰山——据说可能是白龙的巢穴——却反而看见远处一道水柱猛然喷向空中，随即一头鲸的隆起背脊没入水下，消失无踪。
Flat white expanses of snowy ice clog the frigid waters as far as the eye can see. Around larger pieces float smaller chunks and a slush of fragments. You scan the horizon for one of the frozen, floating mountains you know from stories might be lair of a white dragon, but instead you are rewarded by the sight of a distant plume of water sprayed into the air and a whale’s disappearing hump.

Possessed Cows.name:
被附身的母牛
Possessed Cows

Text.text:
它们沿着粗糙的木栅栏一字排开，半打之数，有的嚼着反刍的草料，有的低低哞叫。随后它们忽然齐齐停住，盯向你。那眼神不再空洞，黑色瞳孔里涌起一股恶意——一种憎恨。其间一头抬起前蹄猛踹栅栏，其他的也转身用后蹄狠踢。木头应声炸裂、碎屑四溅。它们口中挤出像是词句的低吼。栅栏轰然坍塌。它们正对着你，露出带着亵渎寒光的笑意，随即冲锋而来。
They stand along a rough, timbered fence line, a half dozen of them chewing cud or lowing softly. Then they all stop at once and stare at you. Their eyes become less vacant, and a malevolence wells up in their black pupils. A hate. One of them raises her front hooves and kicks at the fence. Others turn and kick out with rear hooves. The wood splinters. Growls that sound like words emerge from their mouths. The fence collapses. They face you, smile with an unholy gleam, and charge.

Grassy Plains With Winding Road.name:
蜿蜒道路穿过的草原
Grassy Plains With Winding Road

Text.text:
辽阔的原野铺展开来，金黄与翠绿相间，如浪起伏。风捎来泥土的醇厚气息，混着青草与昨夜雨水的余韵。孤零零的树木枝条瘦长，在平原上投下稀薄的阴影，枝杈吱呀作响。一条被车辙与蹄印深深碾出的土路蜿蜒穿过草原，延伸至地平线之外。
Sprawling fields, gold and emerald, roll like waves. The wind carries the loamy scent of earth, grass, and yesterday’s rainfall. The spindly branches of lone trees creak as they cast meager shadows across the plains. A road, rutted by wagon wheels and hooves, winds its way through the plains, leading over the horizon.

Sundries From A Barghest's Pouch.name:
地狱猎犬腰囊里的杂货
Sundries From A Barghest's Pouch

Text.text:
凶恶魔犬那双恶毒的眼睛里，只剩下死亡迟钝的微光。它的脖颈上系着一个小袋，被浓密的鬃毛遮掩。袋中是一张画得粗糙的羊皮纸地图、一截木炭，以及一堆古怪的杂物：几块土坷垃、几绺头发、和几片衣物碎布。
Only the dull gleam of death is left in the barghest’s malevolent eyes. A pouch is strapped around its neck, hidden by its thick mane. Inside the pouch is a crudely drawn map on a piece of parchment, a stub of charcoal, and an odd assortment of clods of dirt, hanks of hair, and scraps of clothing.

Monster Overcome With Anguish.name:
被痛苦吞没的怪物
Monster Overcome With Anguish

Text.text:
那生物站在倒下的敌人身旁，喘息粗重，凝视着自己那骇人的杰作。鲜血自它的双手滴落，脸色瞬间惨白。它的双眼骤然睁大，呼吸愈发急促。愤怒被疼痛取代；恐惧盖过嗜血。痛楚与悔恨催生泪意，涌上那生物的眼眶，宛如决堤之水轰然奔泄。

~ Envisioned by Lord Malort

The creature stands over their downed foe, their breathing labored as they look upon their grisly work. Blood drips from their hands and their face goes pallid. Their eyes widen, and their breath comes quicker now. Pain replaces anger; fear overtakes bloodlust. Anguish brings tears to the creature’s eyes, breaking forth like a burst dam.

~ Envisioned by Lord Malort

Dust Of Dryness.name:
干燥之尘
Dust Of Dryness

Text.text:
这张小小折起的羊皮纸里，裹着好几撮耀眼的蔚蓝粉末。你把鼻子凑近纸包的开口，小心翼翼地嗅了一下，生怕把哪怕一粒尘粉吸进肺里。气味在一瞬间接连变幻：海的咸湿、暴风雨来临前的空气、挂着露水的青草地，还有你学游泳时呛进鼻子里的那口水的味道。
This tiny fold of parchment holds several pinches of brilliant blue powder. You put your nose near the opening of the packet and take a hesitant sniff, careful not to inhale any of the dust. It smells of several things in quick succession: the sea, the air before a storm, a dewy field of grass, the smell of the water that went up your nose when you were learning to swim.

Loot From A Young Black Dragon.name:
来自一条年轻黑龙的战利品
Loot From A Young Black Dragon

Text.text:
你在一处隐秘密室中发现了巨龙的宝藏，往昔的珍奇在幽光里闪烁。大理石雕像、粼粼珠宝、古老兵刃与一箱箱黄金塞满了黑暗、腐臭的空间，空气沉闷得令人窒息。你估算这批收获约值5000枚金币——前提是卖给合适的商人。
Secreted away in a hidden chamber, you find the dragon’s hoard, glittering with treasures of the past. Marble statues, shimmering jewelry, ancient weapons, and chests of gold fill the dark, fetid space, and the air is stifling. You estimate the value of the haul to be around 5000 gold pieces—to the right merchants.

Gnome Asks For Help Reaching Top Shelf.name:
侏儒请求帮忙够到顶层搁板
Gnome Asks For Help Reaching Top Shelf

Text.text:
“神祇或许没赐你机灵的脑子，但他们给了你那双长得惊人的胳膊。现在，劳驾，能替我把那个拿来吗？”

~ 构想 by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

“The gods may not have blessed you with wit, but they gave you those impressively long arms. Now, if you’d be so kind, could you fetch that for me?"

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Mage School's Bakery.name:
法师学院的面包坊
Mage School's Bakery

Text.text:
在一所声名显赫的法师学院巍峨巨塔脚下，坐落着一间砖墙斑驳的面包房，半边墙面被白色黏土灰泥胡乱抹盖。来客——法师学徒、导师与访客——埋头享用各式点心、厚切酸种面包与油炸甜饼。面包师终日满身面粉，穿梭于桌与桌之间，为陶杯添满菊苣根咖啡。
At the foot of a prestigious mage school's monolithic tower is a worn brick bakery, partially daubed over with white cob. The clientele—mage students, instructors, and visitors—dive into pastries, slabs of sourdough, and beignets. The baker, perpetually covered in flour, flits from table to table, refilling clay mugs with chicory root coffee.

Living Unseen Servant Encounter.name:
隐形仆役遭遇
Living Unseen Servant Encounter

Text.text:
一名闪烁着微光、半透明的人形正忙着清洁并擦亮一件物品。那无形的身影停下手中的活计，用一种近乎迟钝的意识望向你，嘴唇微动，像是在努力挤出一抹微笑。
A shimmering, translucent humanoid is busy at work cleaning and polishing an item. The incorporeal figure pauses its work to look at you with a kind of dull awareness, its mouth moving in what looks like an attempt at a smile.

Quasi-elemental Plane Of Radiance.name:
准元素位面：辉耀位面
Quasi-elemental Plane Of Radiance

Text.text:
一道晶莹的光芒，色泽如虹，仿佛从每一寸表面渗出。此地的辉耀——几乎令人睁不开眼。由原初之火催生的热浪，与灼目的强光一样压迫而来。一个美丽的位面——灿烂而明耀。但你也知道，它同样致命，只要你稍作停留。
A crystalline light, rainbow in its hues, seems to emanate from every surface. The shine of this place—it's almost blinding. The heat, fueled by primal fire, overwhelms nearly as much as the searing light. A beautiful plane—radiant and luminous. But you know, too, deadly, if you linger.

Dragon: Facing An Angry Dragon.name:
巨龙：直面暴怒的巨龙
Dragon: Facing An Angry Dragon

Text.text:
巨龙的暴怒如铁锤般砸在你身上，你的心神却仍在飞速吞咽眼前的一切。它的身躯骤然爆发出移动，仿佛数座火山同时喷发。它的尾巴撕裂空气，肌肉虬结的四肢挥击而出，恐怖的利爪带着毁灭之势；双翼拍击并格挡，宛如两只巨大的蹼掌。与此同时，那条蜿蜒的长颈托起巨大的獠牙巨口，咆哮震天，许诺以撕咬或吐息赐你死亡。
The dragon’s wrath hits you like a hammer blow as your mind rushes to take in the scene before you. Its body erupts into movement, like several volcanoes exploding at once. Its tail slashes the air, powerfully muscled limbs strike out with terrible claws, even as wings flap and fend off, like great webbed hands. All the while, its huge, fanged maw roars from its sinuous neck, promising death by bite or breath.

Felled By Opponent With Weapon And Shiel.name:
被手持武器与盾牌的对手击倒
Felled By Opponent With Weapon And Shield

Text.text:
你将重心压在前脚上，挥击对手的头侧——他们的盾牌举得太低，根本来不及拦下这一击。可你随即一惊：敌人并未试图格挡，而是在千钧一发之际俯身闪过斩击，眼神清明得可怕。

你不愿失去势头，立刻将武器横拉过身，准备以凶狠的回摆补上一记。然而就在这一瞬间，对手猛然前冲，如疾风般突进，用盾面狠狠撞上你的手臂，把你的武器死死压在身侧，动弹不得。

你本能地急退，想从压制中抽身脱离——却已经晚了。他们抡起武器的长柄，重重砸在你的太阳穴上。刹那间，四肢像被抽空般软了下去，视野迅速暗淡，你无力地瘫倒在地，只剩任人宰割的虚弱。
You put your weight on your forward foot as you swing at the side of your opponent’s head, their shield held too low to intercept the blow. You are therefore surprised as the enemy has the presence of mind to duck the strike instead of deflecting it. Not willing to lose your momentum, you pull your weapon across your body to deliver a powerful backswing, but in that split second, your adversary lunges forward in a quick charge, smashing the face of their shield into your arm and pinning your weapon to your body. In an instant, you try to backpedal out of their pin to disengage, but too late, as they smash the haft of their weapon into your temple. Your limbs instantly go slack, and your vision begins to fade as you slump to the ground, helpless.

Warship: Battle-ravaged Bridge.name:
军舰：饱经战火的舰桥
Warship: Battle-ravaged Bridge

Text.text:
刺鼻的浓烟与飞溅的火花充斥着舰桥，警报声在一间被霓虹般猩红的应急灯光浸透的舱室里尖啸不止。尸体横陈在地，皮肉焦黑，早已在这场攻击中被烧灼得面目全非。舰长座椅上，一名身受致命伤的军官痛苦地扭曲着脸，徒劳地试图按住腹部参差不齐的伤口，鲜血仍从中汩汩渗出。
Acrid smoke and sparks fill the bridge as sirens blare in a room bathed in neon-red emergency lights. Bodies lie on the floor, their flesh blackened and charred beyond recognition in the attack. In the captain’s chair a mortally wounded officer grimaces as they try to staunch the blood oozing from a ragged wound in their abdomen.

这匹坐骑身强体健、毛色光亮，打理得一丝不苟，早已习惯马鞍、衔铁与缰绳。它是骑乘用的上等良驹：骨骼粗壮结实，肌肉精瘦以换取更高的速度，气息绵长确保卓越耐力；双眼清亮，听得懂你舌尖的轻响与手势的指引，反应迅捷。
Fine of fettle and well-groomed, this mount is accustomed to a saddle, bit, and bridle. An exceptional specimen for riding, the horse features good strong bones, lean muscle for speed, sufficient wind to ensure superior stamina, clear eyes, and quick responses to your clicks and direction.

在一场清醒的梦里，你忆起那由大理石与玻璃铸就的高塔，林荫大道与花园，空气里松烟与熏香交织的气味。某个温暖而干燥的日子，你曾在一家街角小店吃过一顿饭。守护者与诸多种族的存在在街上交谈，带着孩子去公园，在星空下的暮色音乐会上成群结队。那座城市依旧漂浮在平流层附近，悬于大陆与海洋之上，遥不可及，却是美丽设计的典范。

~ Envisioned by Morgan from Mindflayed Mondays

In a waking dream you recall the towers of marble and glass, the boulevards and gardens, a scent of pine smoke and incense in the air. You had a meal at a bodega one warm, dry day. The guardians and the beings of many races talked in the street, took their children to parks, flocked to evening concerts under the stars. The city still floats near the stratosphere, above continents and oceans, out of reach, but a model of beautiful design.

~ Envisioned by Morgan from Mindflayed Mondays

Zombies Rising From Swamp.name:
沼泽尸潮崛起
Zombies Rising From Swamp

Text.text:
沼泽的水面猛然一颤，四周的淤泥里接连涌出一具具类人身影。那些不死的尸体肿胀湿烂，咕哝着、冒着泡般的低吟再度活动起来。沼水从他们的脸上淌落，也从那一处处腐败的孔洞里滴出——鱼儿与其他生物曾在那儿啃食过他们。鱼卵黏在他们身上，起起伏伏，像多出上百只眼睛。僵尸抬起双臂，开始蹚着水朝你蹒跚逼近，每一步都笨拙却执拗，发出沉重的哗啦泥水声。
The surface of the swamp lurches as humanoid forms surge from the muck all around you. Undead corpses, swollen and squelching, groan and gurgle as they reanimate. Bog water drains from their faces and the holes in their decaying bodies where fish and other creatures have fed upon them. Fish eggs stick to them, bobbing like hundreds of extra eyes. The zombies raise their arms and begin to shamble through the water toward you, each step a clumsy, persistent slosh.

比海洋的顶级掠食者更致命的是什么？是它的巨型版本——弯刀般的利齿，嗜血的肉欲永无止境。
What’s deadlier than the apex predator of the ocean? A giant version, with teeth like scimitars and a bottomless appetite for bloody meat.

Approaching A Terrified Village.name:
走近一座惊惧的村庄
Approaching A Terrified Village

Text.text:
没有一扇门敞开，也没有一扇窗——连遮帘都拉得严严实实。仍在营业的店铺外，民兵与村卫混杂把守，长矛与弓箭蓄势待发。有人攥着神殿钟绳不放。村子里大多数人都聚在那儿，低声祈祷。铁匠们为赶制盾牌与头盔几乎累到脱力，而那名过路的炼金术士也早已把每一道护符与防护咒售卖一空。这里的气氛让人无法不抬眼望向天空，猜想究竟会有什么自天而降。
Not a door is open, nor a window—and shades are drawn. Shops that remain open are guarded by a mix of militia and village watch, spears and bows ready. Someone holds the temple bell rope. Most of the village is there, praying. The smiths are working themselves to exhaustion producing shields and helmets, and the traveling alchemist has sold out of every ward and protection charm. The atmosphere of this place makes it impossible not to glance to the sky and wonder what might descend.

I Use Deflect Missiles.name:
我使用“拨挡飞射物”。
I Use Deflect Missiles

Text.text:
我记得小时候在训练场的石板地上玩抛接，前方是一片柔软延展的草地，远处的栅栏边开着花的树排成一线，一颗球或一块石头朝我飞来。我的小手会伸出去，张开迎接。如今，站在我对面的却是一名技艺高超的弓手。弓弦低吟，箭矢逼近，在我们之间只是一粒黑点。有时结局是一道划开皮肤的疼痛，箭头撞进地面或墙壁。有时我发现自己正握着箭杆，指间一转，将制箭匠的心血原封不动地掷回它来处。
I remember playing catch as a child on the flagstones of the training ground, the soft stretch of grass ahead of me, blossoming trees along the far fence line, a ball or stone coming toward me. My little hands would stretch out, welcoming. Now, across from me is a skilled archer. The bowstring sings and the arrow approaches, a dot between us. Sometimes the end is a slash across my skin, and the arrow strikes the ground or a wall. Sometimes I find myself holding the shaft of the arrow, spinning and returning the fletcher’s work from whence it came.

Alien Gladiator Arena.name:
异形角斗场竞技场
Alien Gladiator Arena

Text.text:
角斗场高耸的墙壁与龟裂的地面上，旧血新血交叠飞溅，斑驳成片。看台高高架在场地之上，人群从上方俯视，饥渴地为下一批斗士喝彩、嘘骂。场地一侧的百叶门后有一丝移动的闪影，喊声随之陡然拔高，愈发狂烈。
Blood stains both old and new are splattered along the high walls and cracked floor of the gladiatorial ring. Stands are situated high above the arena, with the crowds looking down from above to cheer and jeer hungrily for the next combatants. There’s a flicker of movement behind the shutter door on one side, and the shouts increase in intensity.

Warning About Facing A Dangerous Foe.name:
关于迎战强敌的警告
Warning About Facing A Dangerous Foe

Text.text:
“你是中了什么邪？你真以为自己有能耐去直面那样的恐怖？我早已习惯敬佩你的勇气，但我向你保证——你若现在执意开战，我接下来要敬佩的，就只是一具尸体。”
“What madness has taken you? Do you believe yourself capable of facing such a horror? I have grown accustom to admiring your bravery, but I assure you, if you choose to fight now, I’ll be admiring a corpse.”

Sundries From A White Dragon Lair.name:
白龙巢穴的杂物
Sundries From A White Dragon Lair

Text.text:
在广袤的地下巨窟中，冰雪在脚下嘎吱作响，你在巨龙漫长数百年的生命里所收集的物件间细细翻找。尽管这里堆满了闪耀夺目的财宝，这座宝库也同样收容着许多寻常与秘奥的杂物——想必对这头巨龙自有特殊意义——例如一只裂开的木质高脚杯，竟有你头颅般大小；一面巨大的反光盘；以及一架覆着霜花、边沿结冰的雪橇。
Snow and ice crunch underfoot in the vast subterranean cavern as you pick through the objects the dragon collected over its centuries-long life. While there are many gleaming treasures, the hoard is also home to many mundane and esoteric items—presumably with personal significance to the wyrm—like a cracked wooden goblet the size of your head, a large reflective plate, and a frost-rimed sled.

Fitted Cap With Ar Holographic Display.name:
带AR全息显示的贴合棒球帽
Fitted Cap With Ar Holographic Display

Text.text:
这件头戴式装备嗡鸣着潜能，是精通科技的市民最极致的配饰。流线型外观配合高端全息显示，使用者眨眼间即可许可进入虚拟世界。显示器将关键信息、生物体征与新闻通知直接投射进使用者的视野，让多线程处理轻而易举——而且够酷、够有型。
The headwear hums with potential, the ultimate accessory for tech-savvy citizens. With a sleek design and high-end holographic display, the user can access a virtual world in the blink of an eye. The display projects vital information, biometrics, and news notifications directly into the user's field of vision, making multitasking easy—and stylish.

妮克丝最令人捉摸不透——美与谜交织，黑暗与光明相拥。优雅的精灵女子身姿惊艳，银丝掺杂的乌鸦黑长发与那双熠熠生辉的紫罗兰眼眸形成鲜明对照。她苍白的美同样被压低的深色兜帽衬得愈发冷冽，而腰间一圈沉甸甸的多袋腰带更添几分干练与危险。她携带着一件古怪而压迫感十足的武器——某种长柄兵器，一端是厚重的短棍，另一端则伸出弯曲的尖钉，轮廓宛如死神的镰刀。若被激怒或遭到威胁，她的从容会在瞬间翻覆：眼神沉暗下去，缭绕的影烟在她周身盘旋。

~ 扮演者 Gerry

Nyx is, above all, a conundrum—an alluring mingling of beauty and mystery, darkness and light. The elegant elf woman strikes a gorgeous figure, her silver-streaked, raven-black hair contrasting starkly with gleaming, violet eyes. Her pale beauty, too, is juxtaposed by a dark cowl pulled low, as well as the heavy belt of pouches ringing her waist. She carries an odd and imposing weapon—a polearm of sorts, with a heavy cudgel at one end and a curved spike at the other, its silhouette evoking that of a reaper’s scythe. If angered or threatened, in an instant, her graceful demeanor shifts as her eyes darken, and shadowy smoke swirls about her.

~ Played by Gerry

巫妖凝视着你，双眼宛如祖母绿的火焰；它探出一根修长的骸骨手指，缓缓向前伸来。披在枯槁身躯上的华丽长袍松松垮垮地垂落，猩红的血点溅染其上，将曾经精美的织物污得斑驳不堪。它腐烂的脸上扯开一道可憎的笑，朝你招了招手，示意你走近。
The lich peers at you, eyes like emerald flames, as it reaches forward one long, skeletal finger. Ornate robes that hang loosely from its emaciated body are stained with splatters of crimson blood, marring the once beautiful fabric. A wretched grin stretches across its decomposing face as it beckons you forward.

你接触那件武器，它骤然炽亮，如同太阳从暗云背后重现般灼目。那光辉既是火炬，也是灯塔，更是信仰的旌旗。
You touch the weapon and it incandesces, glaringly so, like the sun reappearing from behind a dark cloud. The radiance serves as a torch, a beacon, and a banner of faith.

年轻的半身人甩了甩四肢，原地蹦跳着热身。他穿着贴身长裤和格子衬衫，头戴一顶木制头盔。那匹棕色小马额头点着白斑，躲在长长的棕色睫毛下看着他。它兴奋地轻嘶，蹄子咚咚敲着地面，半身人从衬衫口袋里摸出一块方糖。小马咂吧咂吧开心地嚼着甜点时，半身人也做完了最后几下伸展。动作熟练而利落，他攀上马鞍。“嗨——哟！”他喊道，小马便轻快地小跑起来。
The young halfling shakes out their limbs and hops up and down. They wear tight pants and a checkered shirt, as well as a wooden helmet. Their white-dotted, brown pony watches them from under long brown eyelashes. He knickers excitedly, thumping his hooves against the ground, as the halfling digs a cube of sugar from their shirt pocket. As the pony smacks happily away at the treat, the halfling finishes their stretches. With well-practiced celerity, they clamber up into the pony’s saddle. "Hip-ho!" they cry, and the pony begins to trot buoyantly.

一具孤零零的骷髅（特征）半埋在洞口拱门旁流动的沙丘里，剑柄上那条猩红缎带在干燥的风中凄然飘荡。尽管烈日当空，你仍几乎看不清拱门门槛之后那张开的幽深洞窟。古老的符文被刻进门框风化崩落的石头上，早已被裹挟砂砾的狂风磨得圆钝光滑。
A lone skeleton lies buried in the drifting sand beside the cave archway, the crimson ribbon of their sword fluttering mournfully in the arid breeze. Though the sun blazes overhead you can barely see past the threshold of the arch into the yawning cavern beyond. Ancient runes, worn smooth by sand-blasted winds, have been carved into the crumbling stone of the doorway.

一片葱翠的山谷在你眼前铺展开来，四周是层峦叠嶂，山色浓淡交错。最远处的山坡上，一道白练般的溪流倾泻而下，继而在谷中蜿蜒成河，潺潺流淌。泪滴形的树木在风中沙沙作响，金黄的叶片摇曳，把幽谷点染出一片片明亮的斑光。
A green valley rolls out before you, bounded by hills painted in verdant shades. A white stream tumbles down the farthest hill before trickling through the valley as a winding river. Teardrop-shaped trees rustle golden leaves in the wind, painting the glen with brilliant spots.

Discovery Of Life On Ice World.name:
在冰封世界上发现生命
Discovery Of Life On Ice World

Text.text:
场地像一团匍匐的激光钻探装备，在炽亮阳光下反射出刺目的光芒。周围的白色冰原上，常设帐篷与半圆形活动营房一字排开，嗡鸣运转着各项分析；其中一间里传来循环不止的清脆提示音。巨大的屏幕上浮现出一张六角格地图，其中一格被红光勾勒出边界。那格子迅速被数据填满，随后凝成一幅影像——一个小小的黑点……却似乎长着四肢。
The site is a squatting mass of laser drilling equipment reflecting the bright sun. Around it on the white ice are perma-tents and Quonset huts running their analyses, and inside one of them a repeating chime sounds. On a large screen, a hex map appears, with one of the hexes bordered in red light. The shape fills with data, before coalescing into an image of a small black dot… which appears to have limbs.

Waking Up In The Traveling Inn.name:
在旅途客栈醒来
Waking Up In The Traveling Inn

Text.text:
你醒来时，身躯沉重地陷在床上。昨夜一路纠缠你的暴雨，想必把你摇进了深沉的睡眠。你吸入清冽的晨空气息，视线在光里缓缓对焦，这才意识到这里并非那间粗陋的乡野小屋。墙面洁净如新，陈设时髦，尽是最新的风尚。窗外传来城市的喧嚣，人声与车轮声交织，与你昨夜行走的那条路相隔千里。远处，一座巫师高塔直刺天穹，塔尖没入云海之中。

~ Envisioned by Cuddly

You awaken, body heavy upon the bed. The downpour that had been the bane of your journey the night before must have lulled you into a deep slumber. As you breathe in the cool morning air and your vision adjusts to the light, you realize this is not the rugged, country shack you took shelter in. The walls are clean and the decor is of the latest fashion. Outside your window, you hear the bustle of a city, far flung from the road you had been traveling. In the distance, a wizard tower stretches high into the sky, disappearing into the clouds.

~ Envisioned by Cuddly

Flamboyant Elder Gnome.name:
浮夸的年长侏儒
Flamboyant Elder Gnome

Text.text:
她侏儒般的身形披着奢华翻涌的花纹丝绸，繁复珠宝层层缠绕；衣领上的字迹昭示她是“玛图阿洛斯夫人”。她从头到脚都无愧于那位闻名遐迩、摄人心魄的女主人。她明亮而热烈的眼眸里盛着对生命的贪恋，渴望日复一日把它一饮而尽。尽管她只及数尺高，这位夫人却能在任何她踏入的空间夺走所有目光——无论是舞会厅，还是妓院。

~ 构想：Sahlonahl，来自 Discord

Her gnomish frame is wreathed in a luxurious swirl of patterned silks and elaborate jewelry, with writing on her collar identifying her as a Madam Martoualos. She is every inch the beguiling host she is famed to be. Her bright, exuberant eyes are filled with a lust for life and a desire to drink it dry each and every day. Though she stands only a few feet tall, the Madam commands the attention of any room she inhabits, from ballrooms to brothels.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Three Day Of Travel By Foot On Road.name:
徒步沿路旅行三日
Three Day Of Travel By Foot On Road

Text.text:
你沿着大道旅行，每天黎明出发，循着它蜿蜒的路向前。旅途的第一天平安无事，你在路旁一棵树的荫影下铺开行囊歇息。第二天，你发现一辆翻覆的马车，早已被洗劫一空，凡值钱之物皆不剩。你不禁猜想袭击马车的强盗是否仍在这条路上出没，却又把这份担忧强压下去。你顶着疲惫继续赶路，到了第三天——当夕阳沉入远处的丘陵之后——你触及了目标。
You travel by road, setting out at dawn each day and following its winding path. The first day of the journey passes uneventfully and you bed down in the shade of a tree by the roadside. The next day, you find an overturned cart, long-ago ransacked of anything valuable. You wonder if the bandits who attacked the cart still frequent this road, but shove the worry aside. You press on, despite your weariness, and on the third day— as the sun dips behind the distant hills—you reach your objective.

Whirlpool At Sea.name:
海上漩涡
Whirlpool At Sea

Text.text:
你在翻涌的浪涛之外瞥见一抹白色泡沫。紧接着，奔流般的水声突兀地传入耳中。洋流骤然一变，开始无可阻挡地将你拖向浪间的一处凹陷。你终于明白自己面对的是什么——可也许已经太迟。大海正被吸入、卷下一个巨大的旋涡深渊，而你已在它的边缘打着圈。
You spy a white froth beyond the churning waves. Then the incongruous sound of rushing water reaches you. The current shifts, beginning an inexorable pull toward a depression in the surf. You realize what you face, but it might already be too late. The sea is being sucked into and down a great whirling vortex—and you’re already circling its edge.

Red Kobold With Broken Sword.name:
断剑红狗头人
Red Kobold With Broken Sword

Text.text: 那生物的眼睛闪烁着余烬般的橙光，如针尖般刺破昏暗，映在拉长的爬行类笑容上。覆鳞的小家伙攥着一把断剑，剑刃崩裂，一旦命中必会撕出参差不齐的伤口。它压低身形蓄势待发，随时猛扑而上，带着不计后果的狂劲儿砰地一记横抽。 The creature’s eyes glow as ember-orange pinpricks over a stretched reptilian smile. The scaled tyke holds a broken sword with a cracked edge sure to deliver a ragged bite if it meets its mark. They crouch, ready to spring and thwack with reckless abandon.

Paladin's Oath Of The Ancients.name:
圣武士的远古誓约
Paladin's Oath Of The Ancients

Text.text:
圣武士合上双眼，睫毛上凝着泪水的露光。甲胄与锁子甲已被搁在一旁，他只穿一件轻薄的长袖棉衫，配着同样款式的长裤。赤脚踩地。胸前绣着一轮太阳：金线与钱币交织成纹，让天穹之上那颗真恒星的光辉，能为这具拟像注入生机。他张开双臂，袖口边缘垂下长长的彩虹流苏。随即起舞旋转，衣上钱币迸出炽亮的火光；他挥臂如风，流苏齐飞，扇开成棱彩般的双翼。

~ Envisioned by christoffer

The paladin closes his eyes, his lashes glittering with a dew of tears. Plate and mail set aside, he wears a light cotton shirt with long sleeves and pants of a similar style. His feet are bare. An image of the sun emblazons his front: golden thread woven with coin, so the rays of the true star above might bring the simulacrum to life. He spreads his arms wide, revealing long, rainbow-colored tassels hanging from the edge of his sleeves. He begins to dance and spin, the coins on his shirt glittering radiant fire, the tassels flying together as he waves his arms, fanning like prismatic wings.

~ Envisioned by christoffer

I Put On My Arm Prosthetic Of Strength.name:
我戴上了象征力量的义肢
I Put On My Arm Prosthetic Of Strength

Text.text:
我熟练利落地扣上那笨重的义肢，金属肢体充能的瞬间，一股澎湃力量猛然涌入体内。虹彩般的金属表面上镌刻的符文迸发出耀眼的奥术光辉，我屈伸它的手指，清晰感到这条手臂被强化后的力量。

~ 构想：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Affixing the bulky prosthetic with practiced ease, a rush of power surges through me as the metallic limb charges up. Runes engraved into the iridescent metal surface glow brightly with arcane light, and I feel the enhanced strength of the arm as I flex its fingers.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

由于灯笼的染色纸罩，灯光在墙上投下一幅天青色的影像。纸上的纹样是嶙峋的群山与一座座小金字塔。然而，墙面上却浮现出一个新的形状：两个圆，一个套在另一个里面，形成一道圆环。这是纪念碑、埋藏的宝藏，还是某种警告？
The light casts a sky-blue image on the wall due to the lantern’s dyed paper. The patterns on the paper feature jagged mountains and small pyramids. However, on the wall, a new shape has appeared: two circles, one drawn within the other to form a ring. Is it a memorial, a buried treasure, or a warning?

I Cast Heal.name:
我施放治疗术
I Cast Heal

Text.text:
我感到体内的魔法潮汐汹涌上涨，托举着我的灵魂攀向新的高处，爱意在我生命的核心奔涌流淌。我将双手覆在胸口，低声吟诵法术的词句，把那股能量牵引而出，化作一缕闪烁的光带，指向我的朋友。我欣喜地看着光带在空气中起舞，旋即将他们裹入一阵治疗能量的浪潮之中。
I feel the tide of magic rise within me, lifting my spirit to new heights as love flows through the core of my being. Placing my hands over my heart, I intone the words of the spell, drawing the energy out in a shimmering ribbon I point toward my friend. I watch with delight as the ribbon dances through the air, enveloping them in a wave of healing energy.

I Throw A Bead From My Necklace Of Fireb.name:
我从我的火球项链上掷出一颗珠子
I Throw A Bead From My Necklace Of Fireballs

Text.text:
有时，一道强劲、朴素、原始的法术才是正道，而此刻对此的渴求尤为迫切。这是一种牺牲——从项链上摘下为数不多的一颗珠子——但当它落下时，他们将付出更大的代价。我掷出那颗珠子，注视着它化作烈焰，将我的敌人吞没。
A strong, simple, primitive spell is sometimes just the right way to go, and right now the need for one seems great. It’s a sacrifice, plucking one of the few beads from the necklace, but their sacrifice will be greater when it lands. I throw the bead and watch as it engulfs my foe in flames.

松与冷杉兀立——笔直的灰色线条，既坚实又似幻影。薄雾游移，仿佛法官鬓边袅袅的烟斗烟，又如哨兵脚下池水的微漾。地衣、蕨类与苔藓的蓝绿尽被寒意浸透，冷成湿润的剑刃金属色与珍珠光。
The pines and firs stand—straight gray lines at once solid and apparitional. Mist moves not unlike pipe smoke around the hair of judges, or a pond at the feet of sentinels. The blues and greens of lichen, ferns, and moss are all chilled to the damp colors of sword metal and pearl.

此处地面隆起成几堆湿漉漉的泥土丘，从中传来断断续续的咕嘟冒泡声。你凝视之际，一座小小的圆锥土丘猛地喷出一团泥浆——随即四散如雨落下——紧接着，一股逸散的蒸汽噗地喷出。
The ground here rises in several wet piles of dirt, from which you hear an irregular bubbling. As you watch, a splatter of mud spurts up from one of the little conical hills—then rains down around it—followed by a released puff of steam.

一副硕大的护目镜像发箍般把她的头发拢到脑后，她俯身贴近工作台，透过一只比她脑袋还大的放大镜凝视细节。她正摆弄一支尚未成形的步枪——螺钉、线圈与各式金属零件整齐成堆，随时待用。她的双手布满老茧，沾着机油的污痕，却动作沉稳老练。她停下来揉了揉手腕，眉间皱起思索的纹路。她轻轻发出一声啧，将护目镜拉到眼前，扣紧系带。随后，她拾起一件像钢笔般的金属器具，银与玉的笔身刻满符文。她咬着舌尖凝神，将笔尖按在活塞上——刹那间，一道闪光迸现，翠绿的火花四散飞溅。 Hair held out of her face by a large pair of goggles worn as a headband, she leans over her workbench and peers through a magnifying glass larger than her head. She tinkers with a half-formed rifle—screws, coils, and other metal bits standing ready in neat piles. Her hands, calloused and stained with oil, work in a steady and practiced manner. She pauses to massage her wrist, forehead wrinkling in thought. With a tut, she brings her goggles down to her eyes and tightens the strap. She then picks up a metal implement resembling a pen, silver and jade body riddled with runes. Tongue between her teeth in concentration, she presses the tip to the piston and, with a flash, green sparks begin to fly.

Adult Faerie Dragon Encounter.name:
成年妖精龙遭遇
Adult Faerie Dragon Encounter

Text.text:
斑驳的阳光点点洒落，一条猫般大小的龙懒洋洋地卧在圆木上，蝶翼舒展，尽情汲取午后的暖意。它的紫罗兰色鳞片闪烁生辉，每一片周围都悬着虹彩流光的细微光尘，仿佛被魔力充盈的彩虹光环环绕。兜帽般的眉脊下，顽皮的眼睛紧盯着你的一举一动。它带刺的尾巴轻轻一抽，慢吞吞地撑起小小的身子，随即一跃腾空——咧嘴笑得兴味盎然。
Speckled with dappled sunlight, a cat-sized dragon lounges atop a log, butterfly wings soaking up the warmth of the afternoon. Its violet scales sparkle, iridescent motes of light surrounding each in a corona of magically charged rainbows. Beneath hooded brows, mischievous eyes watch your every move. Its barbed tail twitches as it languidly climbs to its tiny feet and springs into the air—grinning with mirth.

春花盛放的庆典正如火如荼地进行着，村民们在聚落广场中央，伴着铜管乐队的乐声起舞。季节集市的场地上，一场孩子们的短跑正在进行——父母在一旁高声喝彩——离不远处的派饼大胃王比赛只隔着一片喧闹。另一边，几名壮实的身影正合力竖起五月柱，为日落时分即将开始的仪式舞蹈作准备。
The celebration of spring blooms is in full swing, with villagers dancing to music from a brass band at the center of the settlement plaza. At the seasonal fairgrounds a footrace between children—parents cheering from the sidelines—is being held near a pie-eating competition. Elsewhere, several strong individuals erect a maypole in advance of the ceremonial dance to take place at sunset.

Heavy Weapon Overclocked Specialist.name:
重型武器超频专家
Heavy Weapon Overclocked Specialist

Text.text:
年轻女子正蹲在一挺巨大的加特林机枪前忙活着，厚重的焊工面罩遮住了她的脸。她直起身，掀开面罩，露出一张年轻而棱角分明的面孔，嘴角裂开一抹令人不安的狂热笑容。粉色短发修剪得利落，整齐的精灵头贴在头侧；一只结实有力的肌肉臂膀上覆着一幅夸张的复古女郎风格大纹身。她身上的脏兮兮马甲和工装裤满是油渍，厚重的劳保靴也早已磨得不成样子。
The young woman is crouched over an enormous minigun, a heavy welding mask obscuring her face as she works. She stands, removing the visor, and reveals a youthful, angular face split by an unsettlingly frenzied smile. Her cropped pink hair is styled in a neat pixie cut, and a large pinup-style tattoo covers one of her toned, muscular arms. The grimy vest and cargo pants she wears are covered in oil stains, and her thick, heavy work boots have seen better days.

Creepy Abandoned Castle.name:
阴森的废弃古堡
Creepy Abandoned Castle

Text.text:
利维坦城堡的高墙在你周遭绵延铺展，冰冷而死寂的石面被苔藓与常春藤撕开一道道缝隙。强劲的穿堂风灌满空气——从地面与头顶近六十英尺高的天花板上那些孔洞与裂缝中呼啸而来。风里夹着幽魂与恶魔的低语，仿佛将寒意一路送进城堡的骨髓；这里的一切都只配得上死亡，以及一个失败政权残存的、淡薄如烟的余烬。
The great walls of the leviathan castle sprawl around you, cold and lifeless stone breached by moss and ivy. A strong draft fills the air—emanating from holes and cracks in both the floor and the ceiling nearly sixty feet above you. The faint whispers of ghosts and demons haunt the wind, seeming to send chills throughout the castle itself, which befits nothing but death and the faint wisps of a failed government.

一道裂痕劈开数字与以太的迷雾，一阵感觉刺入你体内，像鞭梢舔过皮肤般火辣。你那无形之躯的双手伴随一声尖锐的撕裂，从手臂上硬生生扯离，宛如金属被凶狠剪断的惨烈啸鸣。你的意识漂在震骇与狂怒之间的夹缝里，这才明白：你被削成了远不如初入赛博空间时那般致命。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

A crack slices through the fog of numbers and ether, and a sensation reaches you with a sting like a lash licking out at skin. The hands of your incorporeal form tear free from your arms with a shrill rip, akin to the vicious shearing of metal. Your mind floats in a limbo between shock and fury, and you realize you have been rendered much less lethal than when you first entered cyberspace.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Emotions After Loss Of An Ally In Battle.name:
战场失去一位盟友后的情绪
Emotions After Loss Of An Ally In Battle

Text.text:
尽管疼痛难忍，你仍忍不住在脑海里一遍遍重放那场战斗，从每个角度审视每一次击打，试图找出究竟哪里做错了，自己如何辜负了那位并肩受福的同伴。理智告诉你这不是你的错，你已尽了所能——可你的心与脑都不肯让你休息；你执拗地盯着那些“本可以”的分岔口：若是再快一点、再警觉一点，你或许就能救下他们。不知为何你很清楚，今晚的休息不会轻易降临——你的思绪像个窃贼般，不断把无用的解法塞进梦里，试图撬开一把不可能开启的锁——麻木，徒劳，无休无止。

~ 构想：snepai

Despite the pain, you cannot help but replay the fight in your head, examining every blow from every angle, trying to determine just what you did wrong, how you failed your boon companion. You know intellectually that it is not your fault, you did what you could—but your heart and head won’t let you rest as you focus on what you could have done differently, how you could have saved them if you had only been a little faster, more aware. Somehow you know that your rest will not come easily this evening, your mind constantly plugging useless solutions into your dreams like a thief trying to pick an impossible lock—mindlessly, endlessly.

~ Envisioned by snepai

Paladin Receives Their Calling.name:
圣武士接受他们的感召
Paladin Receives Their Calling

Text.text:
光将你唤醒，暖意覆在脸上。起初刺得你睁不开眼——那灼人的亮度，纯白的辉光几乎要吞没一切——但你的双眼渐渐适应，你眨着眼与之抗衡，终于能望向更远处。你察觉自己并非独自一人，身处这片朦胧的、空荡的空间；也察觉到你或许仍在沉睡，可这一点无从分辨。也许是梦，但这道光与它的温度真实得足以让人信服。耳畔的嗡鸣攀升成和谐而澄澈的音符，凌驾于万籁之上清亮回响；一道被锐利光芒裹住的身影向前一步，轮廓在光中显现。没有面容可供凝视，你却感到安慰，一股安宁的气息从他们身上缓缓溢出。那身影向你伸出手。你会握住吗？

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The light wakes you, warm upon your face. It’s blinding at first—a searing brightness that threatens to swallow everything in its pure, white radiance—but your eyes adjust, and you blink against it to see beyond. You become aware that you are not alone here in this liminal, empty space, and also that you might still be asleep, but it’s impossible to discern. A dream it may be, but the light and its warmth feel real enough. The hum in your ears rises to a harmonious, clear note, ringing above all else, and a figure shrouded in the piercing light steps forward, silhouetted. There’s no face to look upon, yet you are comforted, and feel an air of calm exuding from them. The figure offers you their hand. Do you take it?

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这是一间小巧的青绿色隔间，配着一扇半透明的玻璃门。隔间侧面以无衬线字体印着：GlazerTech: Your Own Private World。标语旁是公司的徽标：一片掠过的黄色星座弧光，悬在两块方形面板上方——一块泛着绿色微光，另一块则毫无颜色。门把手上压印着工厂标准的感应科技握把纹路。 This is a small, turquoise cubicle with a translucent glass door. Along the side of the booth, GlazerTech: Your Own Private World is printed in sans-serif font. Next to the slogan is the company logo: a swished yellow constellation above two square panels, one glowing green, the other without color. The door handle is imprinted with a factory-standard sensetech grip.

Werewolf With Skin Disease.name:
患皮肤病的狼人
Werewolf With Skin Disease

Text.text:
银灰色皮毛的狼人低吼着猛然甩头对准你，长长的獠牙在近似人类的牙齿间森然露出，鲜红的舌头耷拉在外。它呼出的热气蒸腾，带着铁锈、血肉与令人作呕的腐陈气味。它左脸缺了一块毛皮，露出粗糙的鳞状皮肤，黄色脓液从每片鳞之间渗出。那只被炎肿包围的左眼像受痛般眯成一线。相同的苦难也让这生物的肩头起伏扭曲，它屈起右爪，护着那处伤处不让你看见。
The silver-furred werewolf whips its head toward you with a snarl, exposing its long fangs framed with humanoid teeth and a lolling red tongue. Its steaming breath smells of iron, meat, and a sickening staleness. A patch of fur is missing from the left side of its face, revealing rough, scaly skin with yellow pus seeping from between each scale. Its left eye, surrounded by this inflammation, squints into a narrow slit as if pained. The same affliction corrugates the creature’s shoulder, which it blocks protectively with its flexed right claw.

Rostik Yuvelir.name:
罗斯蒂克·尤维利尔
Rostik Yuvelir

Text.text:
他跪伏在嶙峋岩丘的顶端，将长步枪贴肩，透过瞄准镜锁定那可能出现的目标。风掠起几缕雪白发丝，拂过他猫科般的面容，但那双银蓝色的眼睛丝毫不移。雪开始落下，黑色条纹的皮毛却拒绝冬日刺骨的寒意。下方山谷里，有个强大的身影在林间潜行——一头恐狼。罗丝提克宽阔而结实的肩膀绷紧，钉饰皮甲随之轻微吱呀作响。他缓缓吐息，扣下扳机。火枪与巨狼几乎同时咆哮，银弹沉沉贯入目标。罗丝提克猛然挺身至全高，甩背起仍在冒烟的武器，顺势一气呵成地拔出那柄华丽的枪刃。他纵身跃下山坡去终结野兽，狼人之血在体内轰鸣，獠牙毕露，狂暴的吼声撕裂长空。

~ Played by a Hero

Kneeling atop a rocky tor, sighting down the scope of his long rifle, Rostik awaits his potential target. The wind flicks strands of snow-white hair across his feline features but silver-blue eyes do not waver. It begins to snow but black striped fur refuses winter's icy bite. In the valley below, something powerful prowls among the trees—a dire wolf. Rostik's muscular shoulders tense, studded leather armor creaking in sympathy. He exhales and fires. The musket and huge wolf roar in tandem as the silver bullet hammers home. Rostik surges to his full height, slings his smoking weapon, and draws his ornate gunblade in one fluid motion. He bounds down the hill to finish the beast, wereblood pounding, fangs bared, and savage roars filling the air.

~ Played by a Hero

Witch Ritual Pyre.name:
女巫的仪式火葬堆
Witch Ritual Pyre

Text.text:
火焰起初稀疏而断续，噼啪作响的舌焰舔舐着枝桠与碎裂的木梁——它们彼此堆叠成金字塔般的形状。柴堆上垂挂着图腾：树皮被编成一缕缕绳索，缠着骨头与羽毛。很快，堆叠的木材被引燃，骤然迸出刺目的闪光，火势随即染上一抹异界般的猩红，将诡异的光芒向四面八方投射开去。木头在燃烧中焦黑、崩裂，一声嘶嘶作响的尖叫随之逸出。
The fire begins as sparse, sputtering flames licking at the boughs and splintered timbers stacked against one another in a pyramidal shape. Totems dangle from the pyre, strands of bark braided with bones and feathers. Soon the stacked wood catches, lighting in a blinding flash, and the flames take on an otherworldly red hue, casting an eerie light in all directions. As the wood burns, charring and splintering, a hissing scream issues forth.

Cigar-chomping Editor.name:
叼着雪茄的编辑
Cigar-chomping Editor

Text.text:
男人那双细小的眼睛紧盯着手持平板上的文字，屏幕苍白的微光与他嘴角叼着的、被嚼得短粗的雪茄残端里暗红的余烬形成鲜明对比。他抬眼瞥了你一瞬，咕哝一声算作招呼，注意力却已重新落回平板上。“打印！”他用沙哑粗砺的嗓音朝隔壁房间里的某个人喊道。
The man's beady eyes pore over the text on a handheld tablet, its pale glow contrasting with the embers of a chewed, stubby cigar held in the side of his mouth. He glances up just long enough to see you and grunts in acknowledgement, but his focus has already returned to the tablet. "Print it!" he calls in a gravelly voice to somebody in the other room.

这只蜥蜴状生物身长两英尺，站在短却结实的后肢上，粗短的脚趾上糊满了泥。它那颗不大的头顶着带刺的颈褶，沉稳地转动着，审视四周。它深色鳞片上的斑驳花纹与热带灌丛融为一体，而尾端那片柔韧的扇状鳍膜，远远看去就像随风摇摆的草叶。
The two-foot-long saurian stands on short but sinewed hind legs, the stubby toes caked in mud. Its small head, crowned with a spiked frill, turns stolidly as it surveys its surroundings. The mottled pattern of its dark scales blends well with the tropical brush, and the flexible fan on its tail resembles wavering blades of grass.

Gilded City On Floating Island.name:
漂浮岛上的鎏金之城
Gilded City On Floating Island

Text.text:
层层叠叠、数以百计的金色阶梯金字塔在无遮无挡的日光下熠熠生辉——一座悬于天穹的城池，端坐在云之王座上。露台、花园与水道交织其间，人们沉醉于四周的辉煌：有人慵懒地倚在铺着软枕的长榻上，有人摘食垂枝上结出的果实，那枝叶为步道投下清凉的阴影；也有人把穿着凉鞋的双脚从屋顶边缘晃荡出去，静看云海流过。他们的肌肤溅染着金色颜料，有些人几乎被涂满，仿佛镀金的机关人，混在血肉之躯的人群里一同穿行。尽管城池浮在空中，却并不在天际漂移。蓝灰色的金属巨链粗如树干，自城腹垂下，穿过云层，直抵下方清冷、雾气蒸腾的海面。

~ Envisioned by April

Cascading tiers of hundreds of golden ziggurats glimmer in the unobstructed light of the sun—a sky-borne city seated on a throne of clouds. Amid the terraces, gardens, and waterways, people revel in the splendor of their surroundings. Some lounge on pillowed couches, others feast on the fruit of the overhanging branches that shade the walkways, while others swing their sandaled feet from rooftops to watch the clouds go by. Their skin is splashed with golden paint, some so covered they seem gilded automatons mingling with folk of flesh and blood. Though the city does float in the air, it does not move from its spot in the sky. Blue-gray metal chains, thick around as tree trunks, descend from the underbelly of the city down through the clouds and to the cool, misting sea below.

~ Envisioned by April

Summons To The Unseelie Court.name:
召至不羁妖精宫廷
Summons To The Unseelie Court

Text.text:
一阵阴冷骤然袭来，诡谲而凶险，突如其来的寒意让你的呼吸在眼前凝成白雾。影子加深，向前拖长；在泛着银辉的微光里，你感到一种沉重的压迫感，催逼你继续前行，深入那片幽暗的荒野。你被召唤了。
A chill overtakes you, sudden and sinister, and your breath plumes before you in the unexpected cold. The shadows deepen, lengthening before you, and in the silver-tinged glow, you feel an oppressing urge to move forward, deeper into the dark wilderness. You have been summoned.

Fake Armor Of Invulnerability.name:
无敌护甲（伪）
Fake Armor Of Invulnerability

Text.text:
你认定时机已到，唤醒板甲内封存的魔法，让它变得更加坚韧。你进行启动时，护甲立刻开始以炫目的彩虹光轮番闪烁——几乎成了向敌人指路的灯塔。你不禁心头一沉：也许已经太迟，你的魔法护甲真的在按应有的方式运作吗？
You decide the time is right to awaken the magic contained within your plate armor and make it even more resilient. As you perform the activation, your armor begins flashing a dazzling cycle of rainbow colors—practically a beacon for your enemies. You wonder, perhaps too late, if your magic armor is working as it should.

Compliment From A Fighter On Form.name:
来自战士对姿势的称赞
Compliment From A Fighter On Form

Text.text:
“现在，这才是咱们的本事！这才叫战场上的一记狠抡，而且够劲儿。先别忙着自夸。照样再来！”
“Now, that’s what we’re all about! That’s a war swing, that is, and a strong one at that. Don’t pat yourself on the back yet. More of the same!”

你面前的存在美得不可思议，那张脸妖冶诱人，令你一瞬间连呼吸都忘了。世上竟会有如此惊人的人，令你心神恍惚、心口怦然乱跳。此人必定是王族——若非如此，也必然是某种领袖；是那种你愿意为之穿越烈焰、匍匐过碎玻璃的人。
The being before you is so beautiful, the face so alluring, that for a moment you forget to breathe. That someone so stunning should exist boggles your mind and makes your heart flutter. This person must be royalty, or if not, surely a leader of some sort—someone for whom you’d walk through fire and crawl through glass.

厚厚一层尘埃覆着这只瓶子，玻璃幽暗得如同无星之夜。标签早已褪色，只能依稀辨出几枚字母，似是用古旧的手写体潦草写就。它至今仍未启封。
A thick layer of dust coats this bottle, the glass as dark as a starless night. The label has long since faded, though the few letters you can make out appear hand-written in an old-fashioned script. It has yet to be uncorked.

Ioun Stone Of Awareness.name:
洞察艾欧石
Ioun Stone Of Awareness

Text.text:
宛如自暮色黄昏中摘取的一颗钻石，这枚深蓝色宝石令人目眩神迷。你将它握入掌心时，你的感官如晶体的棱角般骤然锋利，超自然地预知周遭的一切——仅在刹那之间。
Like a diamond plucked from the evening twilight, this dark blue stone is stunning to behold. As you take it in your hand, your senses sharpen like the edges of the crystal, and you become supernaturally prescient of your surroundings—for a moment.

Puppet Of Interpretation.name:
诠释之傀儡
Puppet Of Interpretation

Text.text:
木偶在你眼前活了过来。淡淡的蓝光浸透了覆在纤细木质躯干上的布料；曾经普通的舞台道具，如今成了无需丝线牵引、能行走又能表情丰富的提线人偶。它用细小的黑珠眼仰望着你，用尖细的嗓音问道：“你需要帮忙吗？”它那出奇灵巧的手指随着话语节奏飞快变换手势。显然，这是一件魔法物品，用来帮助你用手语交流。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The puppet comes to life before your eyes. A faint blue glow suffuses the fabric covering the slender wooden body, and what was once an ordinary stage prop is now a walking, emoting marionette without the strings. It looks up at you with beady black eyes and asks “Do you need some help?” in a high-pitched voice. Its surprisingly nimble fingers make rapid shapes in time with its speech. Apparently this is a magical item intended to help you communicate in sign language.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Loot From An Aranea.name:
夺自蛛女妖的战利品
Loot From An Aranea

Text.text:
阿拉尼亚蛛那蜘蛛般的长腿在死亡的僵直中蜷缩到身下。它就这样一动不动，你注意到它驼起的腹部上绑着一只挎包，颜色与它那蓬乱的刚毛几乎一模一样。挎包里有一封装着裁缝针的针包、三卷丝线——白色、淡紫与淡绿——以及一件叠得整整齐齐的丝质长袍，工艺精绝，华美无双。
The aranea’s spidery legs curl beneath its body in a rigor of death. Thus immobilized, you notice a satchel, roughly the same color as the spider’s bristly hair, strapped to its hunched abdomen. Inside the satchel is an envelope of tailors’ needles, three spools of silk thread—white, pale violet, and pale green—and a neatly folded silk robe of exquisite craftsmanship and beauty.

House Lion Commons (The Lion's Den).name:
狮家公共厅（雄狮巢穴）
House Lion Commons (The Lion's Den)

Text.text:
每个季节第一天的课后，学舍的学生们便会重整巢穴：挪动陈设，重新布置——甚至连窗户的朝向都要改。顺应草原上游牧骄族的传统，这处巢穴本就是临时之所。它最恒久的特征，是那股近似蜜酒大厅的气息：中央燃着篝火，四周围绕着用餐与歇息的地方，仿佛一切生活都绕火而生。狮子学舍也是男女混住的学舍之一，因此有着严苛的行为准则，并由其首席教授定期监督执行。
After class on the first day of each season, the students of the house rearrange the den, redecorate—even reorient its windows. In keeping with the nomadic prides of the grasslands, the den is temporary. Its most consistent characteristic is that it feels a bit like a mead hall, with a bonfire in the center, eating and sleeping places arranged around it. House Lion is also one of the co-ed houses, so it has strict codes of conduct regularly monitored by its head professor.

Loot From A Phoenix.name:
来自凤凰的战利品
Loot From A Phoenix

Text.text:
灰烬与余烬如雨洒落在这片满目疮痍的荒原上，空气闷得令人窒息。你顶着灼热继续向爆炸的中心推进，却不见那头曾扬言要以烈焰吞没世界的巨型生物的任何踪影。你确实发现了一枚巨大的发光余烬——形如蛋——安卧在爆炸凿出的陨坑里。隔着几步远你就能感到它散出的热浪，暗红的灼光随内部的心跳节律一明一灭。
A rain of ash and ember falls over the blasted landscape, the air stifling. Pressing onward toward the epicenter of the explosion, you find no sign of the gargantuan creature that threatened to consume the world in fire. You do find a large glowing ember—egg shaped—nestled in a crater caused by the blast. You feel the heat emanating from it from a few feet away, the smolder flaring with the cadence of the heartbeat within.

Door Mimic Blocks Path.name:
门形拟态怪堵住去路
Door Mimic Blocks Path

Text.text:
木材以吱呀作响的节奏呼吸着，几个明亮的黄色眼睛在节疤的孔洞里倏然睁开；一张巨大的、涎水淋漓的嘴——配着刺眼的粉红舌头——将木料生生裂开。这生物似乎对你并无恶意，却坚决不肯放行，除非你说出密码。
The wood breathes with a creaking rhythm, and several bright yellow eyes open in the knotholes as a large, slavering mouth—replete with a garish pink tongue—splits the timber. The creature bears no malice toward you, it seems, but it staunchly refuses entry without the password.

金属撞上瓷器的脆响攫住了你的注意力，你循声望去——王室一家正坐在高台上的宏大长桌旁。一个身着猩红华服的年轻人，你认得他正是王位继承人，猛地抬起一只青铜手按住喉咙，张口喘息却吸不进半点空气。你周围的人群先是低声骚动，继而在惊恐中爆发出尖叫——他的双眼骇然凸出，血管在日渐绷薄的皮肤下鼓胀跳动。就在他用最后一口沙哑的喘息坠落，重重趴倒在桌面上的瞬间，四下骤然死寂。
The sound of metal hitting china catches your attention, and you look to where the royal family is seated by a grand table upon a raised platform. A young man in red finery, whom you know is the heir to the throne, holds a bronze hand to his throat as he gasps for air. The crowds around you begins to murmur, then shout in horror as his eyes protrude out, his veins pulsing against the thinning skin. All goes still as he drops onto the table with one final raspy breath.

Seduction Line About A Part Of Me.name:
关于我一部分的勾引台词
Seduction Line About A Part Of Me

Text.text:
“我心里有一小部分，只有在你身边才会存在。那是个鲜活又欢快的人，只会在你面前现身。我很喜欢这个人，也不愿失去他/她。”
“There is a small part of me that only exists when I’m with you. A lively and joyous person who will only emerge in your presence. I like this person a lot, and I’d hate to lose them.”

Gray Robe Of The Archmagi.name:
大法师的灰袍
Gray Robe Of The Archmagi

Text.text:
这件长袍呈石墨般清冷的蓝灰色。尽管剪裁利落，且显然是一件魔法衣装——你能看见缝在内衬里的符文线迹——它的风格却低调得近乎沉默。它是浮华的克星，是宣言的缺席。
The robe is the cool blue-gray of graphite. Though it is sharply tailored and an obviously magical garment—you can see the runes threaded into the lining—its style is muted. It is the bane of flamboyance, the absence of statement.

Locking Pit Trap.name:
锁闭陷坑陷阱
Locking Pit Trap

Text.text:
[已察觉] 你猛然僵住，后颈的寒毛根根竖起——就在你前方不过几步之遥，一块地砖微微抬起，高出周围石面些许。昏暗的地面角落里有一道金属冷光攫住你的视线：一枚锁扣铰链巧妙地藏在那块地砖的边沿下方。

[已触发] 你一迈步，脚下地面骤然塌陷，伴着呼啸旋动，洞口向下方的黑暗豁然张开。你徒劳地在空中乱抓，整个人直坠坑底。你重重砸在坑底石地上后，头顶的暗门带着恶意般“啪”地回弹合拢，牢牢锁死，将你投入彻底的黑暗之中。

[Perceived] You freeze, and the hairs on the back of your neck stand on end—mere feet in front of you, a single flagstone stands raised slightly higher than the surrounding stones.
