A glint of metal draws your eye to a shadowed corner of the floor, where a locking hinge sits cleverly hidden beneath the lip of the flagstone.

[Triggered] As you step forward, the floor suddenly gives way, opening with a whir to the darkness below. You claw helplessly at the air as you drop to the bottom. After you crash onto the floor of the pit, the trap door above you swings back upward with a spiteful snap, locking securely and plunging you into total darkness.

Remnants Of War Zone.name:
战争遗迹区
Remnants Of War Zone

Text.text:
从一片泥泞里竖出一截断裂的长矛柄，斜倚着，像个疲惫的旅人。破烂的旗帜挂在上面，如同蓬乱的头发，无力再抬起脸，去面对战场的惨剧。腐朽的尸体在锈蚀的护甲凹陷处溃烂，或整具、或残片，散落四处，像被随手丢开的湿毛巾。护甲一半染着旗帜的颜色，另一半只剩扭曲报废的残骸。一只乌鸦对另一只乌鸦聒噪抱怨。云层缓慢漂过这片原野，像迟来的哀悼者，为这些早已崩溃的前线战士送终。

~ Envisioned by SorcererMemeSupreme

Sticking up from a muddy patch, a broken pike handle leans as if it were a weary traveler. A tattered banner hangs from it like unkempt hair, too tired to raise its face again on the tragedy of the field. Corpses decomposed in the hollows of rusted armor lay scattered, whole or in fragments, like wet towels thrown aside. Half the armor is the banner’s color, the other half simply mangled refuse. A crow complains to another crow. The clouds drift, slow over the field, late mourners to these warriors of frontlines long broken.

~ Envisioned by SorcererMemeSupreme

Loot From A Hippogriff.name:
狮鹫的战利品
Loot From A Hippogriff

Text.text:
一枚戒指像穿孔饰品那样戴着，套在这头鹫马的左前蹄上，价值12枚金币。尸身上最上等的几根羽毛还能卖给一位书法家，另得8枚金币。
A ring, worn the way someone would wear a piercing, is in the hippogriff’s left hoof. It is worth 12 gold pieces. The best few feathers on the body may be sold to a calligrapher for an additional 8 gold pieces.

Occupied Cave.name:
被占据的洞窟
Occupied Cave

Text.text:
从幽暗洞窟的深处，你听见一声低沉而充满威胁的咆哮——紧接着，一双巨大的黄色眼睛自昏暗中凝视着你。血液仿佛在血管里瞬间冻结，肾上腺素却猛然冲上全身。洞穴主人的沉重踏步声踩着厚实的脚掌，正一步步逼近。
From deep within the shadowy cavern, you hear a low, threatening growl—followed by large yellow eyes peering at you from the gloom. Your blood freezes in your veins as adrenaline rushes through you. The heavy padding footsteps of the cave’s occupant grow closer.

尽管雨已落尽，雨后薄雾间的烈日依旧灼热，可潮气仍侵吞着每一件裙裾或罩袍、看台上的每一张座位。马上比武时，战马在泥地里打滑，不得不放慢步子稳住蹄下；混战更是笑料百出，泥浆糊满全身，谁是谁都分不清。贵族们索性不再徒劳地护着衣裳不沾泥；到了正午，大人也加入孩子们，笑着在水洼里跺脚嬉闹，溅起一片泥水。
Even though the rain has fallen and the sun shines hot through the mists of its aftermath, the damp overtakes every dress or tabard, every seat in the stands. The horses slip and slow to keep their footing during the joust, and the melee is a hilarious mess of indistinguishable combatants. Nobles give up on keeping the mud from their clothes, and by midday the adults have joined the children laughing and stomping about in the puddles.

Rival Corporation Firefight On Street.name:
宿敌公司街头交火
Rival Corporation Firefight On Street

Text.text:
子弹从两侧泼洒而出；两支小小的舰队彼此对轰，一边是西装笔挺却僵硬如木的家伙，一边是衣着杂陈、风格古怪的故障排除者。可不管穿什么，倒在空旷街面上的每个人，风格都被猩红染透；他们睁大的眼睛将永远凝固，直直盯着头顶那一座座压迫而来的企业摩天楼。与此同时，高管们从同样的窗后俯瞰，远离自己决策所带来的后果。
Bullets spray from both sides, each small armada composed of a mix of suited stiffs and eclectically dressed troubleshooters. Yet no matter the clothes, red stains the style of each person lying on the open street, wide eyes forever fixed on the corporate skyscrapers looming above. All while the executives look down from the windows of those same structures, far removed from the consequences of their decisions.

Mists Of The Dread Plane.name:
恐惧位面的迷雾
Mists Of The Dread Plane

Text.text:
你察觉到周遭近处有一层雾毯贴着地面蜿蜒而来。起初稀薄，却很快遮住了你的双脚；无论你往哪边移动，雾都随之抬升，且每一瞬都愈发浓稠不透。短短数息，白雾便厚到连你面前一英尺的手都看不见，黏滞得令人窒息，连声音也被一并吞没。又是骤然之间，雾气开始褪去、散开；你震惊地发现，自己已不在雾起之处。你站在一片乡野边缘，旁侧是一座阴郁的森林，林中的树木扭曲苍白，仿佛此地从不见日光。远处，一声刺骨的嚎叫撕裂了空气。

~ 由一位英雄在 Envisioned 构想

You become aware of a blanket of fog clinging to the ground in your immediate surroundings. Thin at the outset, it quickly obscures your feet from view, and no matter which way you move, the fog rises and grows more opaque with each passing moment. Within seconds, the mists obscure your view to the point where you cannot see your hand a mere foot from your face, so thick and cloying that all sounds are drowned out as well. Just as suddenly, the fog begins to fade and clear, and you realize with a shock that you are no longer in the place where the mist appeared. You are standing in a patch of countryside bordering a gloomy forest, the trees within twisted and pale, as if the sun never shines here. In the distance, a bone-chilling howl splits the air.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Magical Ambush By Desert Assassins.name:
沙漠刺客的魔法伏击
Magical Ambush By Desert Assassins

Text.text:
一道旋涡般的传送门在你面前轰然苏醒，狂风卷起沙粒，抽打在你裸露的皮肤上。沙漠的热浪逼人，数道身影踏门而出，个个身披华饰锦衣，骄傲地展示着你一眼就认得的色彩——你王室家族的旗色。他们唇间没有战吼，也没有宣告；刺客们只是猛然冲来，刀锋在沙漠烈日下寒光逼人。

~ Envisioned by crunchyzombies on Discord

A swirling portal roars to life before you, whipping sand across your exposed skin. The desert heat is palpable as figures step through, each clad in decorated garb proudly displaying colors you recognize—your royal house. No battle cry or declaration escapes their lips as the assassins rush forward, blades shining menacingly in the desert sun.

~ Envisioned by crunchyzombies on Discord

在村庄秋日忧郁的美里，南瓜静静躺着，青绿与深橘相间，偎在更小的同类之间；粗壮藤蔓间或点缀几片叶子，蜿蜒缠绕瓜地，像卷草纹般铺陈开来。疲惫的人们从田间与店铺归家，向那巨大分瓣的葫芦点头致意，仿佛那是巨人的头颅，也能回以一记沉重的颔首。
In the melancholy beauty of a village autumn, the pumpkin rests, green and deep orange, among its smaller cousins and the thick vines with occasional leaves that wind around the patch like scrollwork. Tired folk walking home from fields and shops nod approval at the enormous sectioned gourd, as if it were a giant’s head that could nod back.

Person Wearing A Poor Disguise.name:
乔装拙劣的人
Person Wearing A Poor Disguise

Text.text:
你努力不去盯着眼前那人发愣，可他们那身拙劣到极点的伪装几乎让人无法移开视线。某个时刻，那副歪斜地架在鼻梁上的眼镜想必还装着镜片，如今却已空空如也。头顶那顶摇摇欲坠的假发套更像一座被拆得七零八落的鸟巢，而不像真正的头发。
You try not to gawk at the figure before you, but it is nearly impossible given the extremely poor quality of their disguise. At some point, the spectacles resting askew upon the bridge of their nose must have contained lenses, but they are missing now. The false hairpiece perched unsteadily atop their head resembles a half-demolished bird’s nest more than an actual head of hair.

空气变得潮湿而沉重，洞穴里原本的低回静响被头顶倾泻而下的水声轰鸣彻底淹没。洞窟尽头，一条地下河自瀑布奔流而下。水汇入一处巨大、澄澈如晶的洞潭，幽暗中泛着蓝绿荧光的生物发光藻类投下微弱光晕。石笋与钟乳石环绕洞室，如同巨石兽口的森森利齿，潮冷湿润，滴滴答答。
The air becomes humid and heavy as the quiet echoes of the cave are drowned out by the roar of water cascading from above. A subterranean river flows down a waterfall at the back of the cavern. The water pools into a large crystal-clear grotto, lit dimly by the blue-green glow of bioluminescent algae. Stalagmites and stalactites ring the cavern like the teeth of a massive stone maw, damp and dripping.

Pair Of Caravan Guards.name:
一对商队护卫
Pair Of Caravan Guards

Text.text:
守卫们身上的皮护甲早已磨得发旧，明显不合身，松垮垮地挂在各自的骨架上。每人都拄着一杆长矛，走在商队旁时更像把它当作手杖而非武器。最左边那名肩宽背阔的半兽人，腰带上别着一把手斧。另一名人类头顶一只大得离谱的罐盔，摇摇欲坠地扣在头上，旧短剑还老老实实待在剑鞘里。两人看上去都谈不上训练有素，也没有老兵那种挺胸抬头的硬气。可他们臂膀上绷紧的筋肉与一道道淡白的旧疤，却暗示着被掩藏的力量——能一路走到这里，想必多少还是有两把刷子。
The guards wear worn leather armor, clearly not fitted for their frames. Each holds a spear, using them more like walking sticks than weapons as they walk alongside the caravan. The leftmost guard, a broad-shouldered half-orc, has a handaxe on their belt. The other, a human with an oversized pot helm teetering upon their head, keeps an old shortsword in a scabbard. Neither seem particularly trained, nor do they walk with the straight-backed bravado of a career soldier. The sinewy muscles in their arms and the numerous pale scars along their arms hint, however, at a belied strength. They must be doing something right to have made it this far.

在欧姆电话幽暗、尘埃弥漫的内舱微光里，一个诡异的身影永远栖居其间。角质甲壳裹住这生物扭曲的形体，尖刺甲片下有黯淡的光在闷燃。它骤然、迅疾地抽动时伴着窸窣的啮响，螯与颚节咔嗒作声，敲出令人不安的节拍。然而，尽管躯体怪诞而畸曲，恩塔克那双夺目的绿眼仍从阴影笼罩的面容里探出，亮着一种近乎人类的狡黠。硫磺般的吐息如蒸汽般翻涌，灼热刺鼻；恩塔克把他那短小的螯缓缓探入眼前平静的水池中。
In the dim, dust-strewn light of the Omniphone’s interior, an uncanny figure resides eternally. A chitinous carapace shrouds the creature’s twisted form, and a dull glow smolders beneath the spiked plates. A chittering accompanies the creature’s sudden, rapid movements, his pincers and mandibles clicking an unnerving rhythm. And yet, despite his monstrous, contorted body, Entac’s striking green eyes peer from his shadowed visage, alight with a strangely human cunning. Sulfuric breath plumes like steam, hot and acrid, as Entac dips his stunted pincers into the placid pool before him.

Halloween-style Party.name:
万圣节风格派对
Halloween-style Party

Text.text:
欢快的乐声充盈空气，戴着面具的狂欢客大口痛饮一大壶壶温热的苹果酒，在酒馆地板上踏着轻快的舞步。吧台上摆满墓碑、骷髅与老巫婆等阴森装饰——却都带着几分俏皮的荒诞。打扮成可怖怪物的孩子们来回穿梭，用印着南瓜的小袋子收集甜点；而几位装束尤为精致的客人则朝着阶段走去，参加一年一度的化装竞赛。

~ Ben on Discord

Jovial music fills the air as masked revelers quaff great flagons of warm cider and dance a merry jig across the tavern floor. Morbid decorations of tombstones, skulls, and hags decorate the bar—though each has a distinctly whimsical quality. Children dressed as fearsome monsters scurry to and fro, collecting sweet treats in small sacks marked with a pumpkin, and several of the more elaborately dressed patrons make their way to the stage for the annual costume contest.

~ Ben on Discord

精灵敏捷地穿过灌木丛，悄无声息地掠过。轻巧的步伐既不惊扰走兽，也不折损草木；他们攀上树干，长弓随即就位。凭借熟练到近乎本能的精准，他们抽出一支箭搭上弦，弓臂后拉，下一瞬便在一气呵成的动作中放箭而出。
The elf moves quickly through the underbrush, passing silently. Their nimble steps disturb neither animal nor plant as they scale the tree and bring their longbow to bear. With practiced precision, they slide free an arrow and nock it, drawing back on the bow and loosing the projectile in one fluid motion.

它像是一只被放大到骇人尺度的吸血蝙蝠，双翼展开，足以将整个人形生物覆罩在阴影之下。然而，那姿态与那生物幽光闪烁的双眼所透出的神情，却昭示着更高的智慧——以及更令人胆寒的愉悦。
It looks like a vampire bat made gargantuan, the wings large enough to blanket an entire humanoid. The posture, however, along with the look in the creature’s glowing eyes, indicates a greater intelligence—and a more terrifying pleasure.

Ship In Pursuit.name:
紧追不舍的追击舰
Ship In Pursuit

Text.text:
你望见地平线上一点黑影，映着西沉的落日——而它正迅速变大。随着船只以令人心惊的速度逼近，帆与桅杆的轮廓逐渐清晰。你转头看向自己早已尽数张开的船帆，这才意识到：这名追猎者只需几分钟便会追上你。

~ 一位英雄所构想

You notice a dot on the horizon, silhouetted against the setting sun—and it is growing larger. The outline of sails and masts appears as the ship draws closer at an alarming rate. You look to your own fully unfurled sails and realize that this pursuer will be upon you in only minutes.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Midnight Assassin Ambush.name:
午夜刺客伏击
Midnight Assassin Ambush

Text.text:
一阵轻风，轻得像羽毛，拂过你的脸颊。你的眼皮猛地弹开，还没来得及动一下，胸口就被什么坚硬的东西狠狠撞上。一个披着黑暗斗篷的身影用膝盖将你死死按在地上。他们用一只粗糙的手紧紧捂住你的嘴，陈旧皮革与汗味猛地灌入鼻腔。你感觉到一把刀锋利的刃口抵在你的喉间。

~ 由 Tammy 构想

A gust of air, soft as a feather, brushes across your face. Your eyelids pop open as, before you have a chance to move, something hard slams into your chest. A figure cloaked in darkness pins you to the ground with their knee. They clasp a rough hand over your mouth and the smell of old leather and sweat floods your nose. You feel the sharp edge of a knife against your throat.

~ Envisioned by Tammy

Eriza, Potions Alchemist.name:
埃丽莎，药剂炼金术士
Eriza, Potions Alchemist

Text.text:
她的面容仿佛由淡淡星辉凝成。冰蓝的眼眸即使在阴翳与暗影里也泛着浅光，乌黑的长发左侧划过一缕银色彗痕。思维锋利、目光敏锐；高耸的颧骨与清瘦的身形，勾勒出一位自律的年轻女子。她周围的桌面铺满药剂研究与配方，隔壁的实验室正忙着为小瓶注入馥郁的风味，以及强劲的效果。

~ 由 Alice 饰演

She has a face that seems made of faint starlight. Ice-blue eyes possess a pale glow even in shade or shadow, with a silver comet running through the left side of her long black hair. Sharp of mind and keen of eye, her high cheekbones and slimness indicate a young woman of discipline. The tables around her are covered with potions research and recipes, and an adjacent lab is busy infusing vials with aromatic style as well as potent effect.

~ Played by Alice

Violently Transformed Into Werewolf.name:
被狂暴地变成狼人
Violently Transformed Into Werewolf

Text.text:
银白的光从高处如飞矢般刺落，打在你身上。你的五脏翻搅，随即灼烈的剧痛涌入四肢与头颅。关节噼啪作响，把你摔得四肢着地。你的脸裂开。血的味道与腥气瞬间淹没你，视野摇晃浮动，颜色开始扭曲变换。鼻梁向前拉长、逐渐发黑，牙齿扭曲着生长、变得更长。粗硬的灰毛噼啪作响，几秒间从你全身疯长而出。漆黑的利爪从指端迸裂，指甲被震得飞散。你拱起脊背，仰头长嚎，狂怒吞没了你最后一丝清醒的念头。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Silvery light hits you like darts from on high. Your guts squirm, then searing agony surges into your limbs and head. Joints pop, hurling you to all fours. Your face splits. The taste and smell of blood overwhelm you as your vision swims, colors changing. Your nose extends and darkens, and your teeth twist and lengthen. Coarse gray hair crackles, growing from your body in seconds. Black claws burst from your digits, sending your nails flying. You arch your back and howl, rage silencing your last coherent thoughts.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Shimmering Veils: Magic Suppressed.name:
微光帷幕：魔法受压制
Shimmering Veils: Magic Suppressed

Text.text:
你在听觉边缘捕捉到一丝声响——低沉的隆隆回荡，仿佛压抑的呜咽——空气也随之变得沉重。你隐约感觉到某种力量被强行遏住，像一场雪崩在坠落的刹那被冻住。这个念头刚浮现，你便意识到这种悬停并不稳固；那股足以将你吞没的威胁，随时都可能卷土重来。
You detect a sound at the edge of your hearing, a kind of low rumble or moan, and you sense a heaviness in the air. You get the impression of power held at bay, like an avalanche frozen in the act of falling. As the idea occurs to you, you realize that the suspension seems impermanent, and whatever threatens to overwhelm you could soon return.

尽管你紧握在手中的物体已遭受伤害，按理说通常得请手艺精湛的匠人出手修补；但当你低声念完那句短促的咒语后，它完好如初，仿佛从未破碎过一般。
Though the object you clutch in your hands has suffered damage that might ordinarily require the attention of a skilled craftsman to repair, after you utter your short incantation, one would never know that it had been broken in the first place.

这座由冰白鳞片铸成的堡垒般身躯，轻而易举便扛起全身板甲的重负；臂上扣着钢盾，背后负着一柄威猛的战锤。一袭飘动的斗篷自他宽阔的肩头垂落，为他的气度添了几分庄严。他具备了伟大而可畏的战士应有的一切行头——战场上的压倒性力量……然而呢？焦虑却从他淡蓝色的眼中一圈圈漾开，让覆鳞的眉脊也显得困惑不安。他满口利齿的巨颚紧紧抿成愁容，头侧伸展的褶冠也无精打采地垂下，浸透了忧虑。他不停拨弄着利爪，咔哒咔哒的声响里，还夹着他分叉舌尖紧张的轻弹声。

~ 由 Played Tyler Kamstra（RPGBOT.net）使用

This bastion of ice-white scales effortlessly bears the burden of full plate armor, a steel shield on his arm and a mighty warhammer on his back. A flowing cloak draped from his broad shoulders adds a stateliness to his air. He has all the trappings of a magnificent and formidable fighter, of a tour de force on the battlefield… and yet? Anxiety ripples out from his pale blue eyes, befuddling his scaled brow. His toothy maw is furled into a frown and the frill extending from the sides of his head droops, sodden with fret. He twiddles his claws, the clacking sound accompanied by a nervous click of his forked tongue.

~ Played by Tyler Kamstra of RPGBOT.net with

I Cast Bewitching Whispers.name:
我施放《惑心低语》
I Cast Bewitching Whispers

Text.text:
我说着欲望的秘语，声音与目光都满溢激情。我在原地旋身，向周遭众人招手示意——他们屏息凝神的注视，正泄露出谁已落入我的掌控。我指向我想让他们站立的地方，而他们就必须前往那里。
I speak a secret language of desire, my voice and my eyes full of passion. I turn in place, beckoning those around me—rapt attention telling me who among them has fallen under my power. I point to the place I want them to be, and there they must go.

Massive Metal Worm.name:
巨型金属蠕虫
Massive Metal Worm

Text.text:
巨大的蛇形构装体那一片片镶嵌拼接的护甲板缝隙间，鲜艳的紫光如脉搏般跃动，将整座洞窟浸染在柔和的紫罗兰色辉光里。刺耳杂乱的碾磨声充斥空气——它那张大张的巨口中，布满尖刺的滚轮在期待中飞旋，四处搜寻着新的目标。究竟在诸界之中，谁会造出这种东西？

~ 由 Envisioned 主持，master_builder75 于 Discord 提出

Vibrant purple light pulses between the tessellated armor plates of the enormous serpentine construct, bathing the cavern in a soft violet hue. A cacophonous grinding fills the air as the spiked rollers in its gaping maw spin in anticipation as it searches for a new target. Why in all the realms would anyone create this?

~ Envisioned by master_builder75 on Discord

Brute-force Cyberattack.name:
暴力破解网络攻击
Brute-force Cyberattack

Text.text:
你不再讲究手法，而是决定用海量的请求、指令、查询和其他垃圾代码把站点淹没。服务器被拖得步履维艰，只能竭力应答。它吐出了一段本该更严密保护的代码，而它就躺在那里：你要的漏洞。你等于是把门硬生生撞开了——响亮、粗暴、无礼。该插槽开跑了。让管理员们找到的，只有一地残骸。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Instead of finesse, you decide to flood the site with requests, commands, queries, and other junk code. The server bogs and responds as best it can. It kicks out some code that ought to be better protected, and there it is: the exploit you want. You just rammed down the door, though—loud, crude, and rude. Time to slot and run. Let the admins find nothing but debris.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Approach To Necropolis.name:
通往亡城之路
Approach To Necropolis

Text.text:
越过几汪清澈而浅的绿洲水潭，一道盒状峡谷在红岩台地上豁然张开。高大而方正的石柱矗立在裂谷前，沿着两侧一字排开。峡谷边缘的沙质沟壑更衬出那种不自然的笔直——仿佛被刻意凿削而成。一条白色瓷砖铺就的小径，镶着蓝色边框，通向一扇敞开的石门，石门的质地与石柱一致。由同样苍白岩石雕成的巨大手掌托举着一尊巍然巨像：蓝肤、多臂的存在。或许是一位神祇。
Just beyond shallow, clear oasis pools, a box canyon opens in a mesa of red rock. Tall, square pillars stand before the ravine and line its sides. Sandy gulches bordering it emphasize an unnatural straightness that must have been carved. A path of white tiles with blue borders leads to an open doorway of stone that matches the pillars. Massive hands cut from the same pale rock support a gigantic statue of a blue-skinned, multiarmed being. A deity perhaps.

这些驮袋以粗糙的帆布与手工鞣制的皮革精心打造，尺寸恰到好处，能稳妥装下多份小件货物：一捆捆口粮、一套套备用衣物，或是一袋袋金币。
Fashioned expertly from coarse canvas cloth and hand-tooled leather, these saddlebags are perfectly sized to carry multiple small loads: packs of rations, sets of spare clothing, or sacks of coin.

Sundries From A Xorn.name:
异岩魔的杂货
Sundries From A Xorn

Text.text:
这只生物张开的巨口呕出一大堆金属碎屑。大多被它异界般的消化过程扭曲折弯，表面还留着酸蚀伤害鼓起的皱疤。这里找不到任何有价值的东西。
The creature’s gaping maw vomits forth a slew of metal scraps. Most are bent and warped from its otherworldly digestion and bear the puckered welts of acid damage. There is nothing of value to be found here.

Tournament Melee Combatants.name:
锦标赛混战斗士
Tournament Melee Combatants

Text.text:
战士们分成两队，沉默对峙，戴着铁手套的手死死攥紧武器，面甲扣得严严实实。他们的护甲满是凹痕，罩袍破裂沾泥，盾牌伤痕累累，边缘被砸得参差不齐。他们屏息等待，呼气成雾，目光始终不离对手。号角一响，两队猛然爆发，踏起飞沙疾冲而上，沙哑的喊杀声灌满空气。
The fighters stand in two silent groups, weapons gripped in gauntleted hands, visors clamped shut. Their armor is a mass of dents, surcoats torn and muddied, shield scarred and edges battered. They wait, breath misting, eyes never leaving their foes. A clarion sounds, and the teams burst into motion, kicking up sand as they power toward each other, hoarse cries filling the air.

Ghost Ship With Female Captain.name:
女船长的幽灵船
Ghost Ship With Female Captain

Text.text:
低语在那艘骇人船只Drowned Maiden上轻易流转，从唇到耳，再从耳到唇；它的幽影船长立于腐朽甲板之上，指挥着一支受诅咒的船员。他们说，有一层肉眼无法穿透的迷雾是此船的先兆——那雾会封死你的命运。自那迷雾中，缚灵（特征）船长的骷髅船员猛然冲出，臃肿的腐肉仍挂在他们佝偻的躯壳上，弯刀锋利如他们死去的那一天。随后，她出现了——Drowned Maiden——在无月夜空下如一抹沉黑，船体朽烂腐败，船帆破碎褴褛，索具扭曲缠绞，在风里翻腾蠕动，像一群可憎的蛆虫。而在舵旁，点燃着死亡惨白的微光，缚灵（特征）船长向你降临；侍奉她的，正是多年前将她抛下船舷的那群船员。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Whispers pass easily from lips to ear to lips of the ghastly vessel Drowned Maiden, whose spectral captain commands a cursed crew from upon a rotting deck. They say a mist, impenetrable to the eye, is the ship’s harbinger—that the fog seals your doom. From that mist charges the wraith captain’s skeletal crew, bloated flesh still hanging from their slouched forms, sabers as sharp as the day they died. Then she appears—the Drowned Maiden—dark against a moonless sky, its hull rotted and decayed, its sails tattered, its rigging twisting, writhing in the wind like wretched worms. And at its wheel, alight with death’s pale glow, the wraith captain descends upon you, served by the very crew who threw her overboard so many years past.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Paranoid Alien Pawnbroker.name:
偏执的外星典当商
Paranoid Alien Pawnbroker

Text.text:
这名当铺老板浑身都散发着偏执的气息。他的眼睛神经质地乱转，匆匆忙忙地摆弄着手头的活计，视线在柜台与店门之间来回扫过，仿佛随时会有人闯进来要了他的命。他那多足的身躯也没能解除这份紧张的观感——积压的躁动令他好几只脚同时急促地敲击着地面。
Everything about the pawnbroker reeks of paranoia. Eyes move frantically as he hurries over his work, scanning from shop counter to door, as if he expects someone to burst in and kill him. His multi-legged physique does little to dispel the nervous image as he taps several feet in unison from pent-up energy.

I Use Elemental Affinity.name:
我运用元素亲和力
I Use Elemental Affinity

Text.text: 法术的能量催动我体内的龙裔血脉——元素之力骤然迸发。魔力在我灵魂深处共鸣，使法术更为强盛，也令其伤害性的结果愈发凶猛。 [获得抗力] 我凝神于灵性的谐振。元素之力回流入体，自内而外点亮我的躯壳。当这抹诡秘光辉逐渐褪去，它在一段时代里令我对同样的能量更为坚韧。 The spell’s energy quickens my draconic blood—the elemental power flares. Magical forces resonate within my soul, intensifying the spell and its harmful results. [Gain Resistance] I focus on the spiritual harmony. The element feeds back into my body, illuminating it from within. As this eldritch light fades, it leaves me toughened to the same energies for a time.

这看起来像是宇宙残骸被完美地层层码放，堆成一座二十英尺高的箱形塔。然而，根本没有箱子。燃烧的球体在巨石簇与尘云之间愤怒地旋转。水从底部升起——被塔无形的边界所收束——直至化作蒸汽；蒸汽又在空中塑成灵动的形影，随即消散。四面各有一扇门：一扇铁门，一扇火门，一扇瀑门，另一扇则是敞开的拱门。它们的门槛处积着一滩滩水，像夜空般盛满繁星与无尽的虚无。

~ 由一位英雄构想

This looks like cosmic debris stacked perfectly into a box twenty feet tall. But there is no box. Burning spheres whirl angrily amid clusters of boulder and clouds of dust. Water rises from the bottom—contained by the tower’s invisible boundaries—until it turns to steam, which then takes animated shapes in the air before disappearing. On each of the four sides is a door: one of iron, another of flame, one a waterfall, and another an open arch. At their thresholds are puddles that look like night skies full of starry oblivion.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Kidnapped Bard Becomes Friends With Drag.name:
被绑架的吟游诗人与掳走他的巨龙成了朋友
Kidnapped Bard Becomes Friends With Dragon Captor

Text.text:
龙裔爪牙的热血还黏在你的衣襟上，你拐过转角，眼前却撞上一幕古怪至极的景象。你那“被绑走”的同伴正与巨龙谈笑风生……而且笑得开怀。吟游诗人朝你挥手，示意你上前来见见他们那位鳞甲相对的“同类”，还挑起眉梢，用难以置信的神情看着你。那头庞大的古龙一见到你便欢快得像在蹦跳，震得洞里四散的宝藏堆如泥浆滑动般移位，叮当作响地散落到洞窟地面。你的同伴转身对着巨龙——深深一揖，腰弯得极低——随后回过头，冲你露出一抹揶揄的笑，耸了耸肩。

~ 由 Clara C. Potter 在 Discord 上 构想

With the blood of the dragon's minions hot on your clothes, you turn the corner to find a most peculiar sight. Your so-called kidnapped companion and the dragon are engaged in lively conversation… and laughing. The bard waves you forward, beckoning you to come and meet their scaly counterpart, and they raise their eyebrows incredulously at you. The huge wyrm skips with delight as it sees you, causing the mounds of treasure scattered around the cave to shift like sliding mud and scatter across the cavern floor. Your companion turns back to the dragon—bowing low and deep—before offering you a wry smile and a shrug.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

一层分节、坚硬如铁的甲壳包裹着这只生物，它令人毛骨悚然地融合了龙虾、螃蟹与类人的形态。触手自那东西的嘴边垂落扭动，每条前肢的末端都长着一只巨大而狰狞的钳爪，力道足以碾碎骨头。它散发着腐烂与海水的腥咸气味，四条多节的腿逼近你时，你听见一道嘶声从它口中逸出。
A segmented, iron-hard carapace enshrouds the creature, which evokes a horrifying combination of lobster, crab, and humanoid. Tentacles writhe as they droop from the thing's mouth, and each forelimb ends in a massive, wicked claw with strength enough to crush bone. It smells of rot and saltwater, and as it closes on you with four multi-jointed legs you hear a hiss escape its mouth.

I Cast Earthquake.name:
我施放【地震术】
I Cast Earthquake

Text.text:
我凝视掌心的施法材料，将思绪牢牢锁定在自然那原始而毁灭的力量上。我开始吟诵——陌生、低沉、蛮荒的言语，仿佛出自比世界更古老的存在。待我完成在空中勾画的几何纹式，便解开束缚，唤出塑造大地、随我心意而动的伟力。
I stare intently at the components in my palm, focusing my thoughts on the raw, destructive power of nature. I begin the incantation—words alien, deep, and primal—crafted by beings older than the world. Completing the geometric pattern I have been tracing through the air, I unlock the power to shape the land as I will.

这艘船酷似分室鹦鹉螺的螺壳，就像你在沙滩探险时可能捡到的那种。它在空间中流畅滑行，你过了片刻才意识到：那只“螺壳”正朝你而来。刺耳的心灵杂音轰然爆发——喉音般的尖啸与细碎的低语交叠，你却无法分辨其意——这无疑是异常灵能的明确信号。船越逼近，你看见船艏绘着一双燃烧般的红眼，让整艘船仿佛正以炽烈的憎恨死死盯住你。也许留下并不明智。可当螺壳上林立的弩炮与投石机映入眼帘，这个念头立刻变得更为迫切。

~ 由 ​LazerScythe构想

The ship resembles a chambered nautilus shell, something you might find while exploring a sandy beach. It moves fluidly through space, and it takes a moment for you to realize that the shell is coming toward you. An intense mental cacophony erupts—guttural screeching and whispering that you can’t decipher—a clear sign of aberrant psionic power. As the ship gets closer, you notice burning red eyes painted on the bow, making it appear as though the ship is staring directly at you with an intense hatred. Perhaps staying is unwise. This thought is only made more pressing when the shell’s various ballistae and catapults come into view.

~ Envisioned by ​LazerScythe

Sundries From An Adult Gold Dragon.name:
来自成年金龙的杂物
Sundries From An Adult Gold Dragon

Text.text:
即便血淋淋地倒毙于地，金龙的尸身仍显得威严非凡，鳞光依旧熠熠生辉。你沿着这具庞大的躯体来回搜寻，却几乎无物可取——激战的代价已将一切榨干。来到龙口前，你小心翼翼地把手探入其中，轻轻拈出一枚琥珀：一只苍蝇被囚在其多棱的牢笼里。
Majestic even sprawled in bloody death, the body of the gold dragon glitters still. Moving about the vast body, you find little to harvest, the battle having taken its toll. Reaching the mouth, you gingerly reach inside, plucking out a single piece of amber, a fly imprisoned within its faceted cage.

Sundries From A Plump Goblin.name:
胖墩地精的杂货
Sundries From A Plump Goblin

Text.text:
地精脸朝下趴在泥土里，长长的耳朵软塌塌地垂着，像只被放倒的兔子。他背上的大背包鼓鼓囊囊，外侧挂着各式铁器。你凑近细看，才发现它们并非地精惯用的捣乱工具——什么小刀、刺棒、布陷阱的机关——而是一套炊具：一把黑铁叉，细长的叉齿像枯枝；一只大汤勺；一口油腻发亮的锅。你掀开他的背包，里面装着你猜会让除地精之外任何人都反胃的“食材”：长满病斑的蘑菇、爬着蛆的面包，还有一袋碎肉块——你也说不准——看着像是被剁下来当炖肉的手指和脚趾。
The goblin lies face down in the dirt, long ears drooping down like a felled rabbit. His large pack balloons out from his back, various iron implements hanging on the outside of it. As you examine them more closely, you realize they are not instruments of goblin mischief like knives or prods or trap-setting mechanisms. Rather, they are cooking utensils: a black iron fork with spindly teeth, a large ladle, a greasy pot. You open up his pack to find what you guess to be ingredients stomach-churning to anyone but a goblin: blight-ridden mushrooms, maggoty bread, and a bag of meaty bits that could be—you’re not sure—fingers and toes chopped up into stew meat.

Jail Cell With Manacles And Restraints.name:
带镣铐与束缚具的牢房
Jail Cell With Manacles And Restraints

Text.text:
这间恶臭的牢房里，墙上刻满了涂鸦，记录着多年来无数囚徒的姓名与心声。远处墙上垂着锈迹斑斑的镣铐与颈枷，悬在石壁上一片仿佛渗入岩中的阴影里——那阴影由曾被囚于此者的汗水、污垢与鲜血浸染而成。
Graffiti etched into the walls of this stinking cell records the names and thoughts of many prisoners over the years. Rust-coated manacles and a neck restraint hang from the far wall, dangling in a shadow stained into the stone from the sweat, grime, and blood of those held here.

司机把车窗摇下，只留一道缝隙，让刺目的光线从中射入；他眯起眼睛，像要把那道光也挤成细线。一只手戴着手套的指尖在方向盘上笃笃敲着，另一只手捋过他那一头五彩斑斓的头发。“还愣着干什么！赶时间呢！”他喊道，与车载音响里低低流淌的轻音乐形成鲜明反差。
The driver rolls down the window just enough for a slit of light to glare through, his eyes narrowed to match. One hand's gloved fingers drum on the wheel of the vehicle while the other runs through his multicolored hair. "Places to be!" he calls out, in contrast to the easy-listening music humming out of the stereo.

Vampire Duel With Swords.name:
吸血鬼（特征）剑斗决战
Vampire Duel With Swords

Text.text:
两道灰烬般的身影绕着彼此游走，獠牙毕露，嘶嘶作响，低吼不断。其一拔钢之快，剑锋已然平举，出鞘的声响却还未及传来。另一名决斗者以裸露的利刃应答。两人同时腾跃而起，致命的弧光在离地高处相撞。金铁炸响，诉说着一阵疾风骤雨般的交击与格挡。随即他们朝不同方向分开，各自擦着粗砺的卵石路面滑行，猛然刹住。然后回身，龇牙咆哮，摆好剑势，再度纵身扑上。
Two ashen figures circle one another, fangs bared; they hiss and growl. One draws steel so quickly that the blade levels before the unsheathing sound can be heard. The other duelist answers with a naked blade. They both leap, their deadly arcs meeting high above the ground. Metallic reports tell of a flurry of blows exchanged and parried. They separate in different directions, each warrior skidding to a stop on the rough cobbles. Then they turn, snarl, ready their swords, and jump again.

Divine Home Of A Supreme Deity.name:
至高神祇的神圣居所
Divine Home Of A Supreme Deity

Text.text:
这栋房子品味上乘，却家境朴素；处处是讨人喜欢的小角落，盛着美与生机的碎光，舒适得不带半分威仪。这里总有你爱吃爱喝的食物与饮品，却从不堆得过量；每一件陈设都像一条柔软的毯子般顺眼、贴身。光线安静地落在一条遍布相似房屋的街上，邻里温厚可亲；夜里，所有在此休息的人都能睡得安稳，梦也香甜。这是一处谦逊的居所，靠着精湛的手艺、谨慎的取舍，以及恰到好处的气流与芬芳，在花园水池旁悄然成形。通往上层卧室与日光房的楼梯下方，有一扇门。门把周围的空气微微荡漾，像热浪起伏，提醒你那金属烫得灼人。
The house is a home of good taste but modest means, full of delightful little corners of beauty and life, comforts that declare no majesty. There is always food and drink that one loves, but not too much, and each furnishing is as appealing as a comfortable blanket. The light lands peacefully on a street full of similar houses, filled with kindly neighbors, and at night, all who rest here dream well. This is a humble enclave of good craftsmanship, careful choices, and the perfect flow and scent of air, near a garden pool. Under the stairwell that leads to upper floors of beds and sunrooms is a door. The air around its handle shimmers, letting you know it is scalding hot.

Nanotech Golem.name:
纳米科技魔像
Nanotech Golem

Text.text:
一团黑云聚成类人之形——却又不尽然。它更为庞大，缕缕烟触盘旋伸展，化作千变万化的肢体。其上半身与头部覆着一层半透明的护甲，如玻璃般分节铠片叠合。加冕的头盔之中，一只无所不见的眼在闪烁：一抹猩红圆环，清晰、确凿、无可否认。躯体的烟雾怀抱阴凶的意志，随生物所需塑出腿与臂。
A cloud of black takes humanoid shape; well, not quite humanoid. It’s much larger, with tendrils of smoke forming multivarious limbs. The upper torso and head bear a translucent armor, plated like glass. Within the crowned helm, an all-seeing eye flickers: a red circle, definite and undeniable. The smoke of the body wields a fell purpose, shaping legs and arms to the creature’s needs.

蛞蝓、乌贼、鱼——你所知的任何生物，都没有一个词能恰如其分地形容这团庞大、黏滑的血肉烂团。它从臃肿的身躯上抬起一处肉瘤，你看见墨黑的椭圆——想必是它的眼睛——以三角形排列。三条又长又厚的肉板从它体表剥离、舒展开来，显出带着吸盘的触手。它将触手收回，微微倾首，像是在向你致意。
Slug, squid, fish—no word for any creature you know aptly describes this massive mess of slimy flesh. It raises a nodule of its bulbous body, and you see inky black ovals that must be its eyes arranged in a triangle. Three long slabs of flesh detach and uncoil from its body, revealing themselves to be suckered tentacles. It pulls these back and inclines its head as if greeting you.

I Cast Call Lightning.name:
我施放了【召雷术】
I Cast Call Lightning

Text.text:
雷鸣与狂风自我唇间迸发，催生出一团低垂的云，迅速铺展开来。它阴沉厚重，回应着我的召唤，内里被点燃，幽光在云体中疾驰流窜。随即，我抬手如指挥者般一引，云中初生的电意骤然汇聚，轰然向下劈落。
The sounds of thunder and wind erupt from my lips, causing a low cloud to form and spread. Dark and heavy, it answers my call and ignites within, a glow racing through it. Then, as I draw my hand like a conductor, the young electricity in the cloud gathers and strikes downward.

当你蓄势待发、准备挥击之际，致命的翠绿能量骤然迸发，炽烈的火焰旋风轰然卷起，将你的武器笼罩其中。跃动的火舌散出灼人的热浪，你感到汗珠在皮肤上沁出，仿佛正俯身于熔炉之前苦作。
Virulent green energy bursts into life as you prepare to strike, shrouding your weapon in a coruscating whirlwind of fire. Heat radiates from the dancing flames, and you feel your skin bead with sweat, as if you labor over a forge.

Birds Circling The Mountaintop.name:
群鸟盘旋于山巅
Birds Circling The Mountaintop

Text.text:
几只大型鸟类在上空翱翔，绕着下方的山巅缓缓盘旋，划出宽阔的圆弧。它们究竟是在追猎那些顽强到能栖身峰顶的猎物，还是在四处搜寻可用来筑巢的材料，一时难以分辨。
Several large birds fly above, gliding in wide circles around the mountain peak below. It’s not immediately clear whether they’re hunting anything hardy enough to live on the mountaintop or searching for materials to build their nest.

I Cast Absorb Elements.name:
我施放了【吸收元素】
I Cast Absorb Elements

Text.text:
那股凶猛的冲击波正呼啸而来，直奔我而至。我只来得及在脑海中瞬息凝成法术，抬手作出护身的手势，将本该伤我的能量化作属于我的力量。待一切结束，我感到它在体内奔流，沉入深处，蓄存待发。

~ Envisioned by Blind Swordsman Wolf

The forceful blast is on its way, traveling in my direction. I have only an instant to form the spell in my mind, raise my hand in a warding gesture, and then convert energy that would harm me into my own power. When I finish, I feel it course through me, stored and ready.

~ Envisioned by Blind Swordsman Wolf

Hiring Player Characters In A Corrupt Ci.name:
在腐败之城雇佣玩家角色
Hiring Player Characters In A Corrupt City

Text.text:
“守卫们不想插手。我不知道他们是害怕，还是有人塞了钱让他们睁一只眼闭一只眼，但这座城市里潜伏着黑暗；若不加以遏止，我担心它会把我们所有人都吞噬。”
“The guards don’t want to deal with it. I don’t know if they’re scared or someone’s lining their pockets to look the other way, but a darkness lurks in this city, and if it’s not dealt with, I fear it will consume us all.”

你挥击时，信念如怒潮般撑起你的力量；当钢刃狰狞地完成它的使命，你将那份信念灌注进武器。伴随着你的打击，一道炫目耀眼的圣辉骤然迸闪，灼烧血肉。
You strike with a strength bolstered by conviction, and as your steel does its grisly work, you channel that conviction into the weapon. A flash of dazzling, radiant light accompanies your blow, scorching flesh.

Vehicle-mounted Explosive Shell Cannon.name:
车载爆裂炮弹加农炮
Vehicle-mounted Explosive Shell Cannon

Text.text:
两个粗大的炮管从沉重的长方形弹药箱中拔起，弹药箱通过精密的弹链系统，将丑陋粗硕的炮弹源源不断送入炮身。整件武器涂成迷彩绿，彻头彻尾是军用风格。优雅的碳合金管线将火炮与载具相连，磁悬浮支架分担着巨大炮管的重量。一根橙色导线将武器与载具融为一体，让驾驶员能无缝掌控开火机构。
Two broad barrels rise from a heavy rectangular ammo casing that feeds ugly shells up to the cannon via a sophisticated belt system. The entire weapon is painted camo green and is a thoroughly military affair. Elegant carbon alloy tubing connects the cannon to the vehicle, with mag-lev supports lessening the weight of the enormous barrels. A single orange wire unifies the weapon with the vehicle, allowing the driver seamless control of the firing mechanism.

Warning About The Faerie Plane.name:
关于妖精位面的警告
Warning About The Faerie Plane

Text.text:
“对啊，刚开始就是派对和一堆可爱的小家伙——直到其中一个小混蛋为了取乐，决定把你的脑袋变成南瓜为止。”
“Yeah, it’s all parties and adorable critters, until one of those little bastards decides to turn your head into a pumpkin for a laugh.”

Edge Of A Deciduous Forest In Winter.name:
冬日落叶林边缘
Edge Of A Deciduous Forest In Winter

Text.text:
你站在一片骸骨般的森林边缘，呼吸化作一团朦胧雾云；被剃净叶片的枝桠披着霜衣，在冷光下闪烁。树木赤裸而脆弱，伸出光秃的枝条触及苍穹，仿佛祈求春日迅速归来。森林缓缓吐息，寒风低语着冰冷的气息——沉眠的灵魂在此蛰伏，等待重生。自然沉睡，拥抱寂静——并在生命的轮回中许诺复苏。
Your breath is a misty cloud as you stand at the border of a skeletal forest, the leaf-shorn boughs glittering beneath a frosty cloak. Trees, bare and vulnerable, reach naked branches to the heavens, as if praying for spring’s swift return. The forest exhales, wind whispering its icy breath, a forest of dormant souls awaiting the rebirth. Nature sleeps, embraces the stillness—and promises revival in the circle of life.

Sundries From A Solar.name:
来自太阳号的杂货
Sundries From A Solar

Text.text:
你走近那名已被击败的天使，发现他们身上有一件奇异的物品。其一侧前臂上缠着一串精美绝伦的祈祷念珠，每一颗珠子都刻着灼灼生辉的天界符文。
Approaching the defeated angel, you notice a curious item on their person. Wrapped around one forearm is a string of exquisite prayer beads, each bead engraved with a radiant celestial rune.

A Bitter Goodbye.name:
苦涩的诀别
A Bitter Goodbye

Text.text:
“我们一同熬过无数惨剧，也跨过了远超想象的险境。但如今，这个队伍里有东西在腐烂。或许这是不可避免的，可我觉得自己必须在被它传染之前离开。”
“We have endured many tragedies together and overcome more than could ever be expected. But now there is something rotting in this group. Perhaps it is inevitable, but I feel I must leave before I become infected by it.”

Ranger Presented With First Firearm.name:
游侠初次获赠火器
Ranger Presented With First Firearm

Text.text:
这把火器的硬木枪托大得像一张椅背，搬运它需要熊地精（特征）般的蛮力。枪机——以黄铜精工打造，布满繁复的机械纹路——装着一枚怪异的旋转装置，能从枪托内部抽取并装填弹丸，连发六次后才需重新装填。枪身还配有一件抑音附件：青铜管制成，内填层层圆盘隔片，可扣锁在枪管末端，并紧贴一圈树脂密封圈。

~ Skaythe Shadowburne 构想

The firearm has a hardwood stock as big as the back of a chair, and a bugbear’s strength is required to carry it. The breach—worked brass with complex mechanical designs—is fit with a strange rotating device that draws and loads shot from inside the stock six times before needing reloading. The gun comes with a sound-suppressing attachment of bronze tubing, filled with disc plates, that latches to the end of the barrel against a resin seal.

~ Envisioned by Skaythe Shadowburne

Sparse Storeroom.name:
储物间（空荡稀疏）
Sparse Storeroom

Text.text:
一只火盆里只剩将熄的余烬在微微摇曳；这里的光寥寥无几，正如这间屋子本身的陈设一般空乏。昏暗的光勉强照出两只木箱，木板蒙着厚灰，泛着灰白。房间最阴暗的角落里，蛛网隐隐闪着微光，网中住客只剩长腿的轮廓。你靠近蛛网，便发现几只体形硕大、獠牙森然的蜘蛛，毛茸茸的腹部与木箱同样呈灰褐色。它们那多眼的面孔固然骇人，可一察觉到附近的移动，这些蛛形怪便猛地一缩腿，更深地蜷进阴影里。
One brazier flickers with dying embers; the light is sparse here, as sparse as the contents of the room itself. The dim glow barely illuminates two crates, their wooden planks gray with dust. In the darkest corners of the room, a minor glint of spiderwebs can be seen, their occupants long-legged silhouettes. Approaching the webs, you find large, fanged spiders with furry abdomens the same grayish brown as the crates. Frightful as their many-eyed faces may be, the arachnids retract their legs with a jolt when they sense nearby movement, nestling deeper into the shadows.

Sleeping Werewolf Pack.name:
沉睡的狼人族群
Sleeping Werewolf Pack

Text.text:
在林间一处嶙峋的岩丘上，一群生灵沉沉睡去；无人守夜。其中有体型与毛色各异的狼，它们蜷伏在那些高大健壮的人形身旁或怀里——每一个都披着浓密皮毛，利爪如钩，顶着狼一般的头颅。与野兽与兽形者纠缠成团的，还有些寻常人，有的穿着衣物，有的赤裸着。
On a rocky mound amid the trees, a group of beings sleeps; none keep watch. Some are wolves of diverse sizes and hues. They curl against or around big, muscular humanoids, each with fur, claws, and wolflike head. Tangled with the beasts and the bestial are normal folk, some clothed and some not.

一股挥之不去的恶臭从那蜷结成团的棕色毛皮里渗出，仿佛他走到哪儿，都把下水道的腥腐一并带到哪儿。破烂的黑斗篷下，生锈的刀刃安静地躺在横跨护甲的弹带里，与那片片剥落的皮胸甲上覆着铜绿的铆钉相互映衬。那双猩红的眼睛坚硬而锐利，像投毒者的针尖般不停游移；而一缕剧毒般的翠绿能量之刃，则一次又一次在他抽搐的利爪间被召出又散去，像江湖骗子漫不经心地把硬币在指间翻来覆去。

~ 由一位英雄 扮演

A pervasive stench emanates from the matted brown fur of the twitching ratfolk, as if he carries the reek of the sewers wherever he goes. Beneath a tattered black cloak, rusted blades rest in the bandoliers which cover his armor, matching the verdigris-encrusted studs of the flaking leather cuirass. Solid red eyes, sharp as a poisoner’s needle, move constantly, and a blade of virulent green energy is repeatedly summoned and dismissed from his twitching claw like a charlatan idly flipping a coin.

~ Played by a Hero

你掌心的钻石尘在你念完咒语的瞬间微光流转、熠熠生辉。它猛然炸开，化作一蓬夺目的晶尘飞瀑，随即凝聚成一道闪耀的白色光墙。光幕明亮得近乎刺痛，逼得所有人都不由自主地闭上眼睛，直到视线渐渐适应为止。
The diamond dust in your hand glimmers and shines as you complete the incantation. It bursts forth in a dazzling spray, coalescing into a wall of sparkling white light. The field is so bright it’s almost painful, and it forces everyone’s eyes closed until they can adjust.

Orc Bearing Bloodstained Banner.name:
兽人扛着血迹斑斑的战旗
Orc Bearing Bloodstained Banner

Text.text:
兽人带着阴沉的自豪擎起血迹斑斑的战旗，优雅的弯刀高举在手，蓄势待发。猩红浸透布面，如同令人作呕的艺术点缀，成了那柄仿佛以黑墨涂染的利刃背后的血色飞溅。
The orc holds the bloodstained banner with grim pride, their elegant scimitar raised and at the ready. The soak of crimson on the cloth is a visceral artistic flourish, serving as the backsplash for a sword painted in black ink.

Band Of Novice Adventurers.name:
新手冒险者小队
Band Of Novice Adventurers

Text.text:
这三人起初并未注意到你——这对他们的财运而言可不是什么好兆头；不过他们想必正是在追逐财运，连同冒险者一路攒下的名声或恶名一并揽入怀中。那精灵自称是个法师，但你很怀疑他腋下夹着的那本厚得吓人的书里究竟写了多少真材实料。那名人类女子把自己打扮成花哨的皮衣配蓬松衬衫——这种行头该在舞台上招摇，而不是在街头。一个圆滚滚的矮人把队伍补齐了——字面意义上的“补齐”。他在护甲外佩着圣徽，至少等局势急转直下时，他们还有个能救命的。天哪，神祇在上，你当年也曾看起来这么年轻吗？
The trio don’t notice you at first, which is not a good sign for their fortunes, though surely it is fortune they seek, along with whatever fame or infamy adventurers collect. The elf styles himself a wizard, but you doubt much is written in that impressively thick book under his arm. The human has dressed herself in fancy leathers and a flouncy shirt that belong on the stage, not the street. A portly dwarf rounds out the group, quite literally. He wears a holy symbol over his armor, so at least they’ll have a healer for when things go south. Ye gods, did you ever look that young?

知足是一种他人也能感到的气息，从某个人身上散发出来，就像橙子的清香充满一间屋子；又像深秋时分，壁炉里的火与饱腹的温热，单单如此便已足够。曾有疼痛背负得太久，久到你以为那就是常态，而如今它消失了。多么温柔的慈悲。安慰的毯子覆上你的脸。这是对的，也是好的——一种独特的告别。
Contentment is an aura others can feel, emanating from someone the way the scent of an orange fills a room, or when in the late fall the fire in the hearth and a full belly is simply enough. There was pain carried for so long that it felt normal, and now it’s gone. A beautiful mercy. The blanket of comfort falls over your face. This is right and good—its own special goodbye.

Loot From An Imp.name:
小鬼的战利品
Loot From An Imp

Text.text:
小恶魔的蝎尾可由炼金术师加工制成一瓶毒药。装在一个能抵御风雨侵蚀的皮囊里，小恶魔还带着2枚铂金币。
The imp’s scorpion tail can be crafted by an alchemist into a bottle of poison. In a pouch resistant to the elements, the imp carries 2 platinum pieces.

Fighter's Training Ground.name:
战士训练场
Fighter's Training Ground

Text.text:
庭院被划分为四个象限，每一块的次元都一模一样。四周立着训练武器的架子——长剑、长枪、战斧，以及介于其间的每一种武器。盾牌也挂在层层叠叠的支架上；一排搁板上摆着填充软垫的训练头盔、胸甲与护手，体型从最小到最大一应俱全。空气里弥漫着陈旧汗味，你还能看到几处清晰的深色斑痕——那是血迹曾经泼洒，干涸后留下的印记。
The yard is split into quadrants, each identical in its dimensions. Racks of training weapons adorn each side—swords, spears, axes, and every weapon between. Shields, too, hang upon tiered racks, and a shelf carries padded training helms, breastplates, and gauntlets of every size. The smell of stale sweat permeates the air, and you see distinct dark spots where blood has spilled and dried.

Lint Brush Of Prestidigitation.name:
戏法幻刷
Lint Brush Of Prestidigitation

Text.text:
这是一把由黑曜石制成的粘毛刷，做工华丽，以珍珠母精细镶嵌出一只细节繁复的孔雀图案。所用的兽毛是你此生触过最柔软的触感。为一位身份不明的公主在十三岁生日时施加了魔法，这把粘毛刷能以优雅与从容……几乎不费你分毫力气，便将任何一件衣物清理得一尘不染。
This is a lint brush made of obsidian, ornately inlayed with mother of pearl in a highly detailed peacock design. The animal fur used is the softest you’ve ever felt. Enchanted for an unknown princess for her thirteenth birthday, this lint brush will clean any item of clothing with elegance, grace… and little effort on your part.

Graveyard Infested With Zombies.name:
僵尸横行的墓园
Graveyard Infested With Zombies

Text.text:
满月低悬在这片墓园上空，橘红如火；腐烂与污水的恶臭沉沉滞留在空气里。人形身影在地表墓冢、更大的陵寝与小径间的泥泞水洼中或踉跄、或拖行、或以违逆常理的姿势僵立。墓穴的封闭物——石质棺盖或铁栅门——被砸碎或被推到一旁；有些竟是从里面被打开的。
The full moon looms low and orange over this cemetery, and the stench of rot and foul water hangs in the air. Humanoid figures lurch, shamble, or stand in unnatural poses amid above-ground tombs, larger mausoleums, and muddy pools on pathways. Closures—stone lids or iron gates—of crypts have been smashed or pushed aside. Some were opened from within.

它像梦游者般漂浮游荡，这头巨大而令人作呕的蠕虫状生物呕出酸橙绿的胆汁。它介于一只庞大的漂浮蛞蝓与一团可能性的云雾之间。被吞噬的梦之缕丝在它周围的空气中倾泻飘散，怀旧的气味猛然冲入你的嗅觉。突触脉冲在生物体内四处迸散，短暂地点亮它米色的皮肤。你在它表面看见些许怪异、斑驳的皮肤痕迹，暗示它或许曾经是别的什么。
Drifting along like a sleepwalker, this huge, repulsive wormlike creature vomits forth lime-green bile. It is something between a colossal floating slug and a cloud of possibilities. Wisps of eaten dreams cascade through the air around it, sending nostalgic smells rocketing through your olfactory sense. Synaptic pulses scatter throughout the creature, coloring its beige skin briefly. You spot traces of odd, patchy skin on the creature’s surface, indicating perhaps it was once something else.

A Recurring Nightmare.name:
一场反复纠缠的噩梦
A Recurring Nightmare

Text.text:
一名身着白裙的女人正从一名不知名的袭击者手中夺路狂奔。泪痕纵横她的脸颊，心跳在胸腔与耳畔轰鸣，裙摆长长的拖尾在身后乱舞，仿佛幽魂伸爪要攫住她的脚跟。近乎无尽的鹅卵石小径将她困在野兽逼近的路线之前。但你知道结局会如何：她冲到尽头，望见脚下熟悉的山谷向远处铺展开去。又一次，满月的冷光几乎照不透下方的裂谷与河流，浓雾扼住喉咙般翻涌而上，攀上垛口。她翻身跃过城墙，在坠落前回身直面那头野兽。映入眼帘的，只有一张悲伤而受尽折磨的表情。雾气将她整个吞没，她在下坠之中，你才惊觉那女人就是你——而你的双眼猛然睁开，迎向昏暗的清晨。
A woman in a white dress runs from an unknown assailant. Her face is streaked with tears, her heart pounding in her chest and ears, and the train of her dress flails behind her like ghosts clawing at her heels. An almost endless path of cobblestone traps her in front of the beast's path. But you know how this ends: she reaches a dead end and sees the familiar valley that stretches below her. Again, the full moon barely illuminates the chasm and river below as mist chokes its way up to the parapet. She hurls herself over the walls, turning to face the beast before she plummets. All she sees is a sad, tortured expression. As the mist swallows her whole and she falls, you realize that she is you—and your eyes snap open to the dim morning.

Bones Of The Earth.name:
大地之骨
Bones Of The Earth

Text.text:
你抬起双手，世界以大地爆裂的轰鸣作答。锯齿般的石柱从破碎的地面猛然迸出，宛如某位沉埋已久的神祇舒展的指骨。它们攀升近十余步之高，才在沉重的呻吟中戛然而止。
You raise your hands, and the world answers with a roar of exploding earth. Jagged pillars of stone erupt from the shattered ground like the stretching fingers of some long-buried god. They rise nearly a dozen paces before groaning to a halt.

Mountaintop Portal: Portal Opens.name:
山巅传送门：门户开启
Mountaintop Portal: Portal Opens

Text.text:
魔法在空气中撕开一道裂口，那声音仿佛利刃剖开某头泰坦巨兽的腹腔。此刻，世界与世界之间的门扉张口大开，断续喘噎般将周遭空气吞吸而入，而现实本身也在折磨中发出凄厉的尖啸。
The magic ripped a hole in the air with a sound like a knife carving open the guts of some titanic beast. Now the gateway between worlds yawns open, sucking the surrounding air through it in sputtering gasps as reality itself screams in torment.

巨型蜈蚣在地面上爬行时，成排的细小足肢整齐划一地律动，本该是令人目眩神迷的景象——若非这生物本身怪异得令人不寒而栗。蜈蚣的体型越大，其毒咬带给受害者的痛楚便越剧烈；而这只足有四英尺长的家伙，危险至极。
The scores of tiny legs, moving in concert as the giant centipede makes its way across the ground, are a mesmerizing sight—or it would be if the creature itself weren’t so oddly disturbing. As the size of a centipede determines how painful its toxic bite can be to its victims, this creature, at four feet long, is dangerous indeed.

Check-cashing Franchise.name:
支票兑现连锁店
Check-cashing Franchise

Text.text:
绝望的市民死死守在队伍里，偶尔在闪烁的灯带下，拖着步子向前挪过那块污渍斑驳、阴沉发灰的地毯。他们用指节发白的手紧攥着勉强糊口的工资票，等着那位无聊又低效的收银员喊他们上前，走向那间装着防弹玻璃的小隔间。
Desperate citizens hold their place in line, occasionally shuffling forward across the dismally stained gray carpet under the flickering strips of lights. They clutch wage chits barely enough for survival in white-knuckled hands, waiting for the bored, inefficient cashier to call them forward to the small booth fitted with bulletproof glass.

Ringmaster's Welcome To Faerie Carnival.name:
马戏团长的欢迎致辞：踏入妖精嘉年华大帐篷
Ringmaster's Welcome To Faerie Carnival Big Top

Text.text:
白日里，他们演出的所在尽是尘土与灰霾
帆布的条纹也显得憔悴破败、磨损开裂

可在女巫之光下，伴着月影的掠行，杂技演员翻腾旋落
花斑与杂色的小丑喧闹滚作一团，跌跌撞撞，大失败不断
随着马戏团主那场魔法炫目的召唤而来。

帷幕后，翅翼愈发疾振，洒落妖精般的斑斓色雨
直至你被卷走，又远去，再远去。 By day, where they play is all dusty and gray
and the stripes of the canvas look haggard and frayed

but by witch light, in moon flight, the acrobats tumble
and piebald and motley clowns rumble and fumble
to the call of the ringmaster’s magic display.

The wings faster flutter in sprays of fey color
’til you’re carried away and away.

Spike Pit Trap.name:
尖刺坑陷阱
Spike Pit Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 有传闻说，一位盗贼大师曾说：“讲究人布的是干净的陷阱，野蛮人布的是肮脏的陷阱。”眼前这显然是野蛮人的手笔——一张张开的嘴，满口磨尖的利齿，等着有人往里丢上一块肉。

[触发！] 你刚意识到脚下已不再有地面，便瞥见坑壁从两侧掠过。身体在半空中翻转，让你看清底部的尖刺——一张张开的嘴，满口磨尖的利齿，而你，就是那块肉。

[Perceived] A master thief is rumored to have said, “There are the clean traps of the refined, and then there are the dirty traps of the savage.” This is clearly the savage brand—an open mouth full of sharpened teeth, waiting to be thrown some meat.

[Triggered!] Just as you realize the floor is no longer underfoot you see the sides of the pit. Your body turns in midair so that you can see the bottom spikes—an open mouth full of sharpened teeth, and you’re the meat.

Loot From A Quickling.name:
迅灵的战利品
Loot From A Quickling

Text.text:
系在它腰带上的刀刃，对大多数类人生物而言不过折刀般大小，却由铁木打造。刀柄上蚀刻着盘绕蔓藤的纹样。妖精背上挂着一摞三枚金色钱币，像背包似的晃荡。
The blade strapped to its belt, though no larger than a penknife to most humanoids, is crafted of ironwood. The hilt is etched with designs of twisting vines. On the fey's back, a stack of three golden coins hangs like a backpack.

I Become Terrified Of A Glyph Of Fear.name:
我被一枚恐惧符文吓得魂飞魄散
I Become Terrified Of A Glyph Of Fear

Text.text:
一声哀恸而刺耳的尖啸撕裂我的头骨；当我望见那枚被诅咒的符号，四周骤然浮现出不祥的猩红眼眸。恐惧以冰冷的指爪绞紧我的腹腔。原初的惊怖攫住我的四肢，我为活命而亡命奔逃。
A mournful, screeching wail pierces my skull, and ominous red eyes appear all around me as I behold the cursed symbol. Fear twists my gut with its icy fingers. A primordial terror controls my limbs as I flee for my life.

General Mordecai Winter.name:
莫德凯·温特将军
General Mordecai Winter

Text.text:
将军以古老精灵血脉特有的严谨姿态伫立。他身披职业所需的朴素红色鳞甲，将开面头盔夹在臂弯。左侧肩甲装着一枚用于冲锋的尖刺。他的面容苍白、疤痕纵横，冷硬得如同他的护甲，唯有那双琥珀色眼睛——四下游移，疑虑重重，烦躁不安。他的双手巨剑以黑金铸就，刃缘淬着深红锻纹，几乎就是咒刃邪术师的徽记。他锁定一个脆弱的目标，随即一笑，露出另一支古老血统所赋予的修长犬齿。

~ Played by Marrogh12

The general stands with the precise posture of his ancient elven line. He wears the plain, red scale of his profession and carries his open helm under his arm. The left pauldron is fit with a spike for charging. His face is pale and scarred, as implacable as his armor, except for his amber eyes—which dart around, suspicious and bothered. His zweihander is crafted in black and gold with crimson smithed along the edge, practically a symbol of the hexblade warlock. He finds a vulnerable target and smiles, revealing the long incisors of his other ancient lineage.

~ Played by Marrogh12

这片草甸大多被丰茂的青草与苔藓覆盖，却零星点缀着一块块裸露的斑秃地。每一处暴露的区域都留有岩石与泥土被炸裂、龟裂或熔融的痕迹。有些地方散落着碎玻璃，闪闪发光；另一些地方则能看见护甲或武器被腐蚀后残存的遗骸。
Lush grass and moss covers most of this meadow, but it is dotted with bare patches. Each exposed area has signs of blasted, cracked, or melted rock and soil. Bits of glass glitter in a few. In others, the corroded remains of armor or weapons are visible.

这名人形生物的身躯完美无瑕，深褐色的肌肤闪烁着光泽，散发出柔美与柔和的金色辉光。阳光自他们沉静的眼眸中折射出点点光芒。成熟麦穗般的长辫沿着头皮编成，垂落至背后。轻柔的亚麻色长袍披覆在这具发光而纤细的躯体上，看不出任何能将其辨为男性或女性的明显特征。
Perfectly formed, this humanoid has dark brown skin that sparkles and radiates loveliness and a soft aureate light. Sunbeams glint from their calm eyes. Long braids the color of ripe wheat line their scalp and dangle down their back. Soft, flaxen robes drape the luminous person’s lithe body, revealing no obvious features to mark them as male or female.

Riding A Horse Wearing Horseshoes Of Spe.name:
骑乘一匹钉着速度马蹄铁的马
Riding A Horse Wearing Horseshoes Of Speed

Text.text:
这匹马本就已够迅捷，配得上马蹄铁，浑身生机勃勃；可当它放蹄疾驰时，一切都变了——那是一段令人屏息、咬紧牙关的飞驰，呼啸的风从飘扬的鬃毛与摇摆的头颅后掠过，坐骑周身洋溢着触手可及的欢愉，只需寻常的力气，便能把任何普通坐骑远远甩在身后。
This horse is already fast enough, well worthy of the shoes and full of life, but then the gallop becomes something else—a gripping, jaw-clenching flight through the whistling wind behind a blowing mane and wagging head, the animal exuding a palpable joy as the horse outstrips any common mount with only common effort.

此人因背上的驼峰而广为人知、也因此得名。乍看之下，他们显得不太友善，怯生生的，甚至有点鬼祟。可当那带着气声的方言腔——有时才会成为他们的嗓音——轻轻响起，他们却说得温和，一边把食指轻轻相触，一边用那鹰钩鼻对准某个可能成为朋友的人。那难得一见的笑容里露出一排硕大的门牙，并不难看。既是个盗贼，也是个“柜中马”——头发总被静电拨弄得一跳一跳——他们爱穿华丽行头：繁复纽扣、天鹅绒与层层褶边，且常常更换。白色的实验室小鼠珀迪塔愿意让他们抱着，只要他们没在打斗里挥舞那两把锋利得骇人的库克里刀。

~ Played by E. Dancer with

Known and named for the hump on their back, this person seems at first unfriendly, timid, even shady. But in the whispery brogue that is sometimes their voice, they speak kindly, touching their index fingers together and aiming their hooked nose at a potential friend. The rare smile is full of large front teeth, not unattractive. A rogue and a closet horse—their hair constantly twitching with static electricity—they dress in various finery of ornate buttons and velvet and ruffles, changing often. Perdita the white lab rat lets them carry her when they’re not wielding two incredibly sharp kukri in a scuffle.

~ Played by E. Dancer with

这根闪亮的圆筒被精心卷制，密封成中空。它一端覆着抛光的木质握柄，胶合并以蜡封牢；另一端则嵌着同材木球，底部削平。工艺的平衡拿捏得恰到好处，手杖竟能自行稳稳立起；而它也比它所替代的那条腿轻得多。

~ 构想：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

This shining cylinder is carefully rolled and sealed hollow. It is capped at one end with a polished wooden handle glued and waxed into place, and at the other with a sphere of the same wood, flattened on the bottom. The cane can stand on its own, so well balanced is the workmanship, and it is considerably lighter than the leg for which it stands.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Anabolic Steroid Patch.name:
合成代谢类固醇贴片
Anabolic Steroid Patch

Text.text:
不自然、刺眼的色彩把你的目光硬生生拽向那只小小的包装袋；蒸汽波风格的设计像挟持注意力般牢牢钉住你。袋子正面，在品牌夸张的标志字体下方印着一名跑者的剪影。翻到背面，密密麻麻的小字多到仿佛一份合同。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Unnatural, garish colors draw your eye to the small packet, the vaporwave design holding your attention hostage. A runner’s silhouette marks the front of the bag beneath the exaggerated font of the brand logo. On the reverse of the packet is a contract’s worth of small print.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

红色的光之种子疾掠长空，快得你眨眼都来不及。你在合上眼睑、抵御那随之咆哮而来的烈焰爆冲时，仍能看见它在眼皮内侧留下的残影。再睁开眼，你依旧能捕捉到那枚猩红珠点奔向致命终点的轨迹余痕。
The red seed of light zips through the air faster than you can blink. You see its trace against your eyelids as you shut them against the fiery blast that roars as a result. Opening your eyes, you still see traces of the crimson bead’s path toward its deadly end.

Retiree's Cottage.name:
退休者的小屋
Retiree's Cottage

Text.text:
皮革与烟草的气息弥漫在空间之中。壁炉上方的墙面挂着精挑细选的武器。尽管件件都引人注目，最夺目的却是一柄波刃长剑，起伏的刃身让人想起下方炉火吐出的火舌。一只盛着醇厚棕色烈酒的水晶醒酒瓶摆在边桌上，旁边是一张舒适、内衬毛皮的扶手椅。
The scent of leather and tobacco pervades the space. Choice weapons hang on the wall above the fireplace. Though all are eye-catching, the most striking is a wave-bladed sword, its undulation recalling the tongues of flames of the hearth fire below. A crystal decanter holding a rich, brown liquor sits on a side table next to a cozy, fur-lined armchair.

那怪物追逐着——不歇不止，永不疲倦。它高耸如塔，像一具隐约的人形剪影，由骇人的血肉与歪斜的肢体拼凑而成。骨片与断裂的韧带从它那臃肿的躯块中刺出，旁边还挤着腐臭、搏动的脏器。它那拼凑的负载由十来个生物组成，有人形的，也有别的形态。它身上飘来的恶臭——腐烂与湿土的气味，如同刚从坟里掘出的尸体——几乎将你熏得窒息；而它仍一步步逼近。在这无休止的冲锋中，它只会短暂停下，捞起沿途留下的残破尸身，将其揉进自身，让每一次血腥的添补都令它愈发庞大。

~ An RPGBOT.NET Nightmare

The monstrosity pursues—ceaselessly, tirelessly. It towers, a vaguely humanoid silhouette of macabre flesh and askew limbs. Shards of bone and broken ligaments protrude from its bulbous mass alongside putrid, pulsating organs. A dozen creatures, humanoid and otherwise, make up its cobbled-together bulk. The stench wafting from it—rot and loam, the aroma of a freshly-exhumed corpse—nearly overpowers you as it draws closer and closer still. In its incessant charge, it pauses only to scoop up the bodies of those left dead and mangled in its wake, incorporating their mass into its own, growing larger with each grisly addition.

~ An RPGBOT.NET Nightmare

巨蜂腹端那根倒刺毒针，锋锐凶险得宛如钩镰；但与大多数钩镰不同的是，它很可能裹着足以夺命的剧毒。并且像那些更小的黄蜂一样，这家伙多半也隶属于某个蜂巢。
The barbed stinger at the end of the giant wasp’s abdomen looks as sharp and dangerous as a bill hook, but, unlike most bill hooks, it likely carries venom of a strength that could threaten your life. And like smaller wasps, this one is probably part of a hive.

Rasputin Fiddle-bender Puffington.name:
拉斯普廷·拨弦拧琴手·帕芬顿
Rasputin Fiddle-bender Puffington

Text.text:
不止是身高而已。半精灵往往身形高挑而纤细——哪怕是像这位一样的游侠贵族，也衣着考究、目光锐利。他体内有歌利亚的血，也有卓尔的影，那种混合怪异又迷人，丝毫不逊于任何一位奇械师的作品。他随身带着一把左轮手枪与哨兵盾，而你在几台机器之间发现了他：他微微俯身，贴近一具构装体那由齿轮、轮盘、孔径与仪器交织成的复杂结构，像翻书一样读懂它们。

~ 由这位 dnd 爱好者 Played，并附上

It’s more than just the height. Half-elves are often tall and slender—even rogue nobles like this one, well-dressed and sharp-eyed. There is goliath in him, and drow, a mix as strange and intriguing as any artificer’s. He carries a revolver and sentinel shield, and you find him among several machines, leaning into a construct’s complexity of gears, wheels, apertures, and instruments, reading them like a book.

~ Played by the dnd lover with

寒意先从四肢末端爬起，拳头不由自主地攥紧，脚也重重跺地。接着，膝盖与肘关节相继僵硬。然后，一股沉重的困意在你的眼后漫上来。皮肤变得干燥，结成一层硬壳，带着些许疼痛开裂，随即迅速褪去，只留下麻木。你先是迟缓，继而动作僵滞，随后几乎无法挪动，最后彻底静止。寒冷一路深入，钻进肋骨，抵达心脏。你的意识退回到一座洞窟深处。你甚至看不清，那尊灰色的你，最终定格成了怎样的姿势。

~ 由 Nappa4000 构想

It begins with a chill in the extremities, a clenching of fists and a stamping of feet. The knees and elbows follow after. Then, a heavy sleepiness comes on behind your eyes. Your skin dries, turning into a crust that cracks with some pain and then fades quickly to numbness. You slow, then move stiffly, then barely, then not at all. The chill reaches deep, in the ribs and to the heart. Your awareness recedes into a cave. You cannot even see what pose the gray statue of you has chosen.

~ Envisioned by Nappa4000

A Necromancer’s Friends.name:
死灵法师的朋友们
A Necromancer’s Friends

Text.text:
“随你怎么说，但我的造物从不吼叫，从不撒谎，也从不轻蔑我。它们只会以耐心与顺从静静倾听。它们是我能奢求到的最好的朋友。”
“Say what you want, but my creations never yell, or lie, or scorn me. They simply listen with patience and obedience. They are the best friends I could ever ask for.”

Arrow-embedded Orc Chieftain.name:
箭矢嵌身的兽人酋长
Arrow-embedded Orc Chieftain

Text.text:
在翻涌的混战之中，正当大门砰然合拢，你瞥见了某个非同寻常的身影。那名战士——一名体型魁梧得骇人的兽人——端坐在一张覆着毛皮与象牙的王座上，以一种从不被打个措手不及之人的冷峻神情注视着你。无数式样各异的箭矢取代了他的头发，深深刺入颅骨，汇成一蓬不可思议的鬃冠，满是斑斓的箭羽——可他看起来并未受伤。你闯入的瞬间，他的嘴角因明显的不悦而微微抽动；但真正令你血液发冷的，是他那双深褐色眼眸里冰寒而坚定的决意。

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

In the swirling melee, you catch a glimpse of something remarkable just as the doors slam shut. The warrior—an orc of tremendous size—sits upon a throne draped in furs and ivory, and regards you with the stoic countenance of one who is never caught unawares. Arrows of innumerable design puncture his skull in place of hair, forming an incredible mane of colorful fletchings—though he does not seem injured. His lip twitches in marked irritation at your intrusion, but it is the cold determination in his deep, brown eyes that chills your blood.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

这支曲子若用更高的调来弹，或许会显得轻快、欢快。然而此刻的旋律却低沉如雷——一场骇人而哀恸的进行曲。地板在声浪中颤抖，震动自一架没有玩家的钢琴向外扩散。琴键自行按下，每一枚键面都溅满一层薄薄的蓝绿色黏渍。待这首裂颅的乐章终了，从房间的每个角落都传来若有若无的掌声。
The tune might be jaunty, merry, if played in higher keys. But the melody is low and thunderous—a horrendous, mournful march. Floorboards shake with the sound, tremoring out from a piano without a player. The keys press down of their own accord, each one splattered with a filmy blue-green substance. As the skull-splitting song comes to an end, a faint applause can be heard from every corner of the room.

这是幼稚又暴躁的天空开的一场恶作剧。起初只撒下几把坚硬的白色弹丸，叮叮当当地从屋顶弹开。那声响想必取悦了天空，很快便有一阵阵齐射猛砸所有水平的表面，在街面上跳跃翻滚，仿佛从冷冽空气里凭空变出。灰色的少年在怒气里胡闹，把所有人都赶回屋内，也惊醒了圈舍与马厩里的牲畜。一条小溪看上去既冻结又沸腾。它来得突兀，去得更快，情绪转瞬消散，只留下街上融化的冰。
Here is a prank from a childish, angry sky. It starts with a few handfuls of hard white shot that bounce off the rooftops. The sound must entertain the sky, because soon volleys hammer everything horizontal, bounce in the streets, conjured from the cold air. The juvenile in its gray tantrum drives everyone indoors and wakes the farm animals in their coops and stables. A creek appears both frozen and boiling. More suddenly than it started the mood passes, leaving ice melting in the streets.

Observer Drone.name:
观察者无人机
Observer Drone

Text.text:
甲虫状的无人机嗡鸣着悬停巡弋，机身中央一枚红外镜头灼灼如血，泛起猩红光芒。由铆钉固定的薄金属板拼成的甲壳，既显得凶悍，又透着脆弱。六条带钩的附肢像蛛足般从腹下垂荡；机首两条以夹钳为末端的机械臂按固定节奏咔哒合拢，仿佛在试咬。两钳之间还伸出最后一条加固的肢体，端头指向你们的，是一座手枪大小的三管炮塔。炮口涌动着红光，能量在其中汇聚，蓄势待发。
The beetle-shaped drone hovers in humming surveillance, an infrared lens burning crimson in the center of its body. The carapace of riveted sheets of thin metal manages to look both menacing and fragile. Six hooked appendages dangle from its body like spider legs, while at its front, two arms ending in clamps snap at set intervals. A final fortified limb extends between the clamps, pointing a three barreled turret the size of a pistol at your party. The gun surges with red light, collecting energy as it readies to fire.

一条鞭似的巨龙劈开云与天，从三分裂的巨口中尖啸而出。它那三重口器内排布着剃刀般锋利的獠牙，舌头舔卷，带着野兽般的饥渴。那生物的身躯扭动盘旋，如一笔紫绿交织的书法长线写在空中。它的嘶鸣震耳欲聋，是饥饿迸发的音浪脉冲。
A whiplike dragon cuts through cloud and sky, screeching out from a tripartite maw. Razor-sharp fangs line its threefold mouths, tongues lapping with animal hunger. The creature’s body is a writhing coil, like a line of calligraphy writ in purplish green. Its scream is deafening, a sonic pulse of hunger.

Unarmed Finesse Disarm Attack Against Ar.name:
徒手巧劲缴械：对武装对手的攻击
Unarmed Finesse Disarm Attack Against Armed Opponent

Text.text:
敌人以为你赤手空拳，正是最容易下手的目标，便步步逼近。他们举起武器压上来——却偏偏缺少那将你与寻常斗殴者区分开来的东西：纪律、迅捷与见识。  

当他们冲你侧身架势猛扑而来，你身形轻灵一晃，避开来势，顺势转轴切到对手侧面。你那历练得坚硬的手牢牢扣住他们的手腕，暂且不理会武器本身，猛然一拧；与此同时，另一条手臂如钩般搭上他们伸直的肘关节。就在那一瞬，他们的骨节结构背叛了他们：手指不由自主地松开，武器哐啷一声坠落在地。
Believing that your unarmed status makes you an easy target, the enemy closes in on you. They bring their weapon to bear—only they do not possess that which sets you apart from mere brawlers: discipline, quickness, and knowledge. As they lunge at you in your sideways stance, you sway nimbly away from the strike, pivoting to your opponent’s side. Your toughened hand takes a firm grasp over theirs, ignoring the weapon itself for the moment, twisting quickly, as your other arm hooks over their extended elbow. In that moment, their very anatomy betrays them: their hand opens of its own accord, and their weapon clatters to the ground.

Starry Night, Full Moon.name:
星夜，满月
Starry Night, Full Moon

Text.text:
一轮皎洁的明月悬在繁星点点的夜空，宛如一堆珠宝之巅的巨大宝石。你能将月面尽收眼底，而澄澈的天空让人恍惚觉得，只要伸手便能触及并接触那一道道坑洼的斑痕，粗粝地刻在它的表面。
A brilliant moon glows in the starry sky, like an enormous gem atop a pile of jewels. You can see the whole of the moon’s face, and the clear sky makes it seems like you could reach out and touch the pockmarks that mar it surface.

Enchanter Academy Chair Of Abjuration Te.name:
附魔师学院·防护学讲席教授
Enchanter Academy Chair Of Abjuration Teaching

Text.text:
“你真是个天才啊，伙计！你昨晚就该把那道法术抄好了！别看我，我不过是一把老椅子！看书去，你个蠢货！”
“You’re a savant, man! You should have had that spell copied last night! Don’t look at me, I’m just an old chair! Look at the book, ya quot!”

Runner Escapes Pursuers Along Rooftop.name:
奔行者沿屋顶疾驰，甩脱追兵
Runner Escapes Pursuers Along Rooftop

Text.text:
一名奔跑者从上方的屋顶间纵身跃过空隙，落地时顺势一滚，随即以最高速度疾驰而去，脚步轻快如雨点。片刻之后，四人组成的追兵小队紧随其后，同样凌空飞跃，却明显少了几分利落，落地时砰然一声更沉更重。然而他们欠缺的，都用执拗补上——他们连一刻休息都不肯给自己，手脚并用地紧追不舍。
A runner leaps across the gap between rooftops above, landing with a roll and pounding away at top speed with light footfalls. A squad of four pursuers follow a few moments later, sailing through the air with noticeably less grace and landing with a heavier thud. But anywhere they lack, they make up for it with persistence, scrambling after the runner without a moment's rest.

Sundries From A Vampire Spawn.name:
来自吸血鬼（特征）眷属的杂物
Sundries From A Vampire Spawn

Text.text:
在这被诅咒的怪物那枯槁的指骨上，你发现了他们曾为人时残存的一点痕迹：一枚朴素的青铜戒指，戒圈上刻着首字母A.R.——那是唯一的线索，指向一段被不死的怨憎与苦楚吞没的逝去人生。
Upon the withered finger of the cursed monster you find a remnant of the person they once were. A simple ring, cast in bronze, with the initials A.R. engraved on the band—the only clue to a life lost in the hateful misery of undeath.

Periapt Of Health.name:
健康护符
Periapt Of Health

Text.text:
只是把玩这条镶嵌石榴石的金项链，一股奇异的战栗便沿着你的血脉窜过。你过了一会儿才察觉——旅行的酸痛不再困扰你，你也不再有咳嗽或抽鼻子的冲动。
Simply handling this golden, garnet-studded necklace sends a peculiar thrill through your veins. It takes a little while to notice it, but the aches and pains of travel no longer bother you, and you feel no need to cough or sniff.

Blind Bard.name:
盲眼吟游诗人
Blind Bard

Text.text:
衣着考究，帽檐压低遮住双眼，吟游诗人一边奏乐一边起舞，满室目光皆惊叹凝望。每一次旋身，铃铛点缀的袖口与绑腿叮当作响，透出紧实精瘦的肌理与多年磨炼的身手。乐声与欢呼充盈房间，钱币落入银碗的清脆叮鸣不绝于耳。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Stylishly dressed and with a hat covering their eyes, the bard dances while playing, and the room looks on in amazement. With certain turns, the cling of belled sleeves and leggings reveals a physique of lean muscle and years of training. The room fills with music and cheers over the ring of coins dropped in a silver bowl.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

[察觉] 你前方某处，空气微微荡起涟漪，仿佛有人拨动帘幕，又悄然落回休息。你辨出一股魔法气息。几件你确信原本落在那里的小物件已然消失，而残留的以太能量像气味般萦绕，告诉你它们并非只是隐形。

[发现] 你在一口深坑里找到一座囚牢，台阶一路向下通往中心。每间牢房都散发着与先前那道魔法气息相同的以太法术残痕。这里存在传送门魔法。它的隐匿令人惊叹，运作机理彻底而奥秘。

[触发] 你下一步踏出时，色彩与声响被甩在身后，坠入一片灰白的映像——银边一闪的刹那。随即，你发现自己站在一间铁栅围成的腐臭囚室里。牢房没有门。周围还有许多囚室，全都排列在深坑底部，一道土石阶梯通向外界。

[Perceived] At a certain point ahead of you, the air ripples slightly, as if someone touched a curtain that settled back to rest. You recognize an aura of magic. A few small items you are sure were on the floor there have disappeared, and residual energy of the ethereal, like a scent, tells you they aren’t simply invisible.

[Discovered] You find a prison in a deep pit, with stairs descending to the center. Each cell gives off the same residue of ethereal spellcraft as the magical aura you discovered before. There is portal magic here. Its invisibility is impressive, its mechanism thoroughly arcane.

[Triggered] Your next step is from color and sound into a gray representation, a fast flash of a silver-edged moment. Just as suddenly, you find yourself standing in a putrid cell of iron bars. The cell has no door. There are many other cells around you, and all of them are arranged at the bottom of a deep pit with an earthen staircase leading out of it.

男人的尸体面朝下漂在河里污浊恶臭的水面上，斑驳湿冷的皮肤泛着令人作呕的病态青绿。你走近几步，腐烂败坏的浓烈臭味直钻鼻腔，逼得你一阵干呕。这具尸体至少已经死了好几天。
The man’s body floats face down in the fetid water of the river, his mottled, clammy skin a sickening shade of green. As you get closer, the overwhelming smell of rot and decay reaches into your nostrils, causing you to gag. This corpse is several days old at least.

这套板甲在蕾丝般的金色花丝映照下熠熠生辉。每一块甲片的边缘都闪闪发亮，藤蔓般的卷纹沿着表面蜿蜒攀爬。头盔或许是装饰得最华美的一件——却也格外古怪。它的面甲被塑成一朵巨大的花，眼孔与口孔被巧妙嵌入花瓣上反复出现的“眼”与“口”的纹样之中。
This plate armor shines with lacy gold filigree. The edge of every piece of plate glitters, and vine-like whorls crawl across their surfaces. The helmet might be the most beautifully adorned—although it is also rather strange. The face plate of the helmet takes the form of a huge blossom, with holes for the eyes and mouth worked into a repeated pattern of eyes and mouths on the flower’s petals.

City Raid By Red Dragon: Aftermath.name:
红龙突袭城市：余波
City Raid By Red Dragon: Aftermath

Text.text:
那头横冲直撞的巨龙带来的迫近威胁已然过去，但你周围的城市仍在燃烧。滚滚浓烟灌满空气，野狗四处乱窜，狂吠不止。几乎听不见别人的声音——要么已经死了，要么早已逃亡。就算你不知从哪儿弄来足够的水，也已无人能去扑灭这些火焰。
The immediate threat of a rampaging dragon has passed, but the city around you burns, filling the air with smoke and the barking of dogs run wild. Of other people you hear little. They are either dead or have fled. There’s no one left to put out the fires, even if you somehow had enough water to do it.

I Craft A Weird Gadget.name:
我制作一个古怪的小装置
I Craft A Weird Gadget

Text.text:
一位酿酒师把一大篮坏软木塞倒进垃圾里，而我把它们全捡了回来。我的店里有一块旧铁栅，我把它烧热到能弯曲的程度，然后掰成一只圆筒。底部装上轮子，再加一台发条马达，圆筒便在地面上疯狂又飞快地旋转。等我把软木塞全都塞进去，派对就开始了。
A vintner dumps a huge basket of bad corks in the trash, and I collect them. In my shop is an old grate, which I heat until it is flexible and then bend into a cylinder. Wheels on the bottom and a clockwork motor make the cylinder spin crazily and fast around the floor. Once I fill it with the corks, the party begins.

那动物如一根披覆灰色护甲的巨柱，稳若山麓，静若原野。他低垂着头，大小两支角如同某种毁灭性武器的准星般直指前方。犀牛的腿宛如强劲的活塞，末端是贴地铺开的石质脚趾。他伫立着，蓄势待冲。
The animal is a cylinder covered in gray armor, as immovable as a foothill, as quiet as a field. His head is down, the large and small horns aimed forward like the sights of some devastating weapon. The rhino’s legs are powerful pistons and end in stone toes laid flat on the ground. He stands ready to charge.

细小的齿轮与机件在这枚奇异的投射物上交织成一列咬合严密的方阵，每一枚都与相邻者分毫不差地契合。一阵柔和而无尽的滴答声自箭矢中渗出，仿佛在暗示其内部所藏的机械奇观。
Tiny gears and cogs form an interlocking phalanx across the strange projectile, each one perfectly attuned to its neighbors. A soft, endless ticking emanates from the arrow, hinting at the mechanical wonders hidden within.

I Inspect A Precious Art Object.name:
我检视一件珍贵的艺术物体
I Inspect A Precious Art Object

Text.text:
这件杰作的细节精妙绝伦。我不由得驻足凝望，继而越看越近。思绪沿着每一道匠心的笔触游走，细细揣摩其中纹理与节奏。我试着想象，是怎样的时代与文化推挤、点燃着艺术家，使他走向这条道路，而非另一条。
Such fine detail in this masterwork. I cannot help but stare, and I find myself studying it more closely. My mind traces the patterns of each artistic stroke. I try to imagine how time and culture pushed and inspired the artist this way instead of another.

I Throw My Hammer Of Thunderbolts.name:
我掷出雷霆巨槌
I Throw My Hammer Of Thunderbolts

Text.text:
自我戴着铁护手的掌心，在腰带力量的推动下，战锤脱手飞出。它离手时像一条迫不及待要奔跑的巨犬——又像弦上离弦的箭——贴着一条平直的轨迹掠过距离。命中的一刻轰然爆响，仿佛荒野上席卷开阔原野的致命风暴，带着野蛮的力量。雷鸣与随之而来的震荡冲击横扫开来，几乎在八分之一英里内都能感到这一击。
From my gauntleted hand, with the power of the belt behind it, the hammer flies. It leaves my hand like a great hound eager to run—an arrow from the string—and covers the distance on a flat line. Its connection booms with the barbaric force of a deadly storm over an open field. Almost an eighth of a mile is hit with the thunder, and the concussive force that attends it.

你张开双手，十指如扇般舒展，却记得让两只拇指相扣相连；烈焰随即在宏大的位面上轰然奔涌。火舌自你指尖前方寸许处骤然迸发，疾射出十余尺远，随即化作缕缕薄烟，消散无踪。
You fan out your hands, spreading your fingers but remembering to keep your thumbs connected, and flames roar outward in a great plane. They start inches from your fingertips and shoot over a dozen feet before vanishing into thin smoke.

Taunt From A Dragon About Ruling.name:
巨龙的治世嘲讽
Taunt From A Dragon About Ruling

Text.text:
“我们曾统治这个世界。那时，它宁静而美丽。后来你们来了，像某个庞大蜂群的嗡鸣般席卷而至，把一切都毁了。为此，你们将受苦。”
“We used to rule this world. Back then, it was quiet, beautiful. Then you came, like the buzzing of some great swarm, and ruined it. For that, you will suffer.”

Confusing Abstract Portrait.name:
令人困惑的抽象肖像
Confusing Abstract Portrait

Text.text:
对比强烈的色块如同被随手泼洒在画布上，凌乱而突兀。眯起眼、歪着头细看，几乎能辨出眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴的轮廓——可每一处五官都错位扭曲，以彼此不相符的角度歪斜着。
Blocky shapes of contrasting colors seem to be splashed haphazardly across the canvas. With eyes squinted and head tilted, one could almost see eyes, a nose, a mouth. But every feature is in the wrong place and skewed at a mismatched perspective.

I Use Multiattack Defense.name:
我使用【多重攻击防御】
I Use Multiattack Defense

Text.text:
每个生物的战斗都有可预测的套路。每一次攻击都会让身体顺势摆出自然的后续姿态。被击中时，我能感到这股流势。我预判下一波攻势，并施以切实的反制。这里一记格挡，那里一个侧步，就足以避开接踵而来的杀招。
Every creature fights in a predictable pattern. Each attack positions the body for a natural follow-up. When struck, I sense this flow. I predict the next assault and apply a practical counter. A parry here or a sidestep there is all I need to avoid what comes next.

Hacker Manipulates Security Cameras.name:
黑客操控安保摄像头
Hacker Manipulates Security Cameras

Text.text:
黑客收尾收工，安保摄像头在重启中瞬间“瘫软”，再亮起时已落入黑客掌控。粗糙颗粒的监控画面挤满了技术宅的屏幕，他们拨弄着视角与镜头，指挥摄像头去记录一些没那么……指控性十足的……活动。
The hacker completes their work, and the security cameras go limp as they reboot, now under the hacker’s control. Grainy CCTV images fill the tech-head’s display as they manipulate the cameras, directing them to record less… incriminating… activities.

Approach To The Stargazer.name:
通往观星者之路
Approach To The Stargazer

Text.text:
你头顶那艘威严的巨舰在寒冷的夜风里安然轻晃，粗壮盘绕的缆绳牢牢系在天坞上结实的黄铜系缆栓上。巨大的翼状帆在灿然明月前投下剪影，随风噼啪作响、鼓胀翻涌，船员们正将货物拖拽着装上船。一道柔和的嗡鸣——更像是被身体感到而非耳朵听见——如轻拍岸石的波涛般起落回旋，托举飞船的符文立柱完成了又一次循环。
The majestic vessel above you sways peacefully in the chill night air, moored by thick, coiled ropes to sturdy brass cleats on the sky-dock. Huge wing-like sails, silhouetted against a resplendent moon, snap and billow in the breeze as the crew haul cargo aboard. A gentle hum—felt more than heard—rises and falls like softly lapping waves, as the rune-pillars keeping the craft aloft complete another cycle.

Speech About The Plight Of Poor Townspeo.name:
关于贫苦镇民困境的演说
Speech About The Plight Of Poor Townspeople

Text.text:
“这些人的敌人并非那些偷走他们牲畜的巨魔，也并非他们付钱雇我们去屠的巨龙，而是那些逼他们在这般污秽困苦中受煎熬的领主！”
“The enemies of these people are not the trolls that steal their livestock or the dragons they pay us to slay, but the lords who have forced them to suffer in this squalor!”

I Cast Mage Hand.name:
我施放法师之手
I Cast Mage Hand

Text.text:
一只金色的幽灵之手绽放般现形，手指时而紧握、时而舒张，仿佛在熟悉这片位面的存在。它在我的指令下悬浮半空，动作诡异却流畅——像头足类触腕那般柔滑起伏。
A golden, spectral hand blooms into existence, fingers clenching and unclenching as if to become accustomed to this plane of existence. The movements are strange as it floats in the air at my command: fluent like the smooth undulation of cephalopod tentacles.

一颗名为“jack”的小白球——像高尔夫球却更加光滑——静静地躺在一片草地上，距离两名玩家约十英尺。每名玩家手里都握着一颗结实的球，大小如西柚。其中一人缓缓向前迈出一步，滚出一颗红球。它划出一道弧线，最后停在离jack约一英尺处。另一名玩家掷出一颗深绿色的球，猛地撞开红球，将它击飞数英尺远，而自己的球则停在那颗小小白色目标球旁，几乎只有寸许之隔。
A small white ball called the jack, like a golf ball but smooth, sits about ten feet in front of the two players on a stretch of lawn. Each player holds a solid grapefruit-sized ball in one hand. One of them takes a slow step forward and rolls a red ball. It ttakes a curving path and stops about a foot from the jack. The other player bowls a deep-green ball, which knocks the red one several feet away and stops inches from the little white target ball.

I Cast Identify.name:
我施放《鉴定术》
I Cast Identify

Text.text:
当我用猫头鹰羽毛掠过目标，并以绝对专注开始咒文时，珍珠开始共鸣，泛起奥术能量的微光。随着魔法不断积聚，珍珠逸散的光芒攀升至刺目的强烈——信息随之灌入我的脑海。
The pearl begins to resonate and glow with arcane energy as I trace the owl feather over the target and start the incantation with absolute focus. The light emanating from the pearl grows to a blinding intensity as the magic builds—and information fills my mind.

Flooded City.name:
被洪水吞没的城市
Flooded City

Text.text:
尽管上涨的水淹没了这座城市，许多残破的建筑却矛盾地显露出火焚的痕迹。你不禁想：究竟有多少千人葬身于此，他们临终前惊惶失措的最后时刻会是怎样？他们的尸体是否仍滞留在自家屋内？此处看似寂静，却并不像已让它的亡魂得以休息。
Though the rise of the water drowned this city, many of its ruined buildings paradoxically show signs of fire. You can’t help but wonder how many thousands died and what their final panicked moments might have been like. Could their bodies still abide in their homes? As quiet as it seems, this place does not feel like it has put its ghosts to rest.

那位乱发鼓手的脸被一道鲨鱼般的狞笑撕开，他们在皮革鼓面上猛砸出节拍。你能感觉到他们以充当音乐心跳为乐，那份满足感笃定而规律，如同血脉中跃动的脉搏。即便偶尔即兴变奏，他们也能行云流水般让节奏丝毫不断。
The wild-haired drummer’s face is split with a sharklike grin as they hammer out a beat on the skin drumheads. You sense their satisfaction in providing the heartbeat of the music, as sure and regular as the pulse beating through your veins. They seamlessly keep the rhythm going even through their occasional improvisations.

Taunt From A Mortally Wounded Dragon.name:
来自濒死巨龙的嘲讽
Taunt From A Mortally Wounded Dragon

Text.text:
“你们这类人，非要等到我们只剩回忆，才肯停止你们的野蛮吗？而当我们最后一个倒在你们暴行的余烬里，那又如何？像你们这般凶残而愚昧的生物，究竟能建起什么？总有一天，最后一棵树会落尽叶子，大地会腐烂，而你们所剩下唯一可征服的，便只剩彼此。”
“Will your kind not cease its barbarism until we are just a memory? And once the last one of us lies dead in the wake of your violence, what then? What can such vicious, ignorant creatures build? Some day, the last tree will shed its leaves, the lands will rot, and the only thing you’ll have left to conquer will be each other.”

Aberration's Lair.name:
畸变怪的巢穴
Aberration's Lair

Text.text:
洞壁的石头变得光滑，起初你怀疑是高温所致——墙面仿佛在融化的半途被骤然冻结。但随即你在岩石里看见了诡异的形状，规整得不可能天然生成——令人不安地像一根根肋骨——而天花板上起伏的隆起，则像皮肤之下的脊柱般蜿蜒。
The stone of the cave becomes smooth, and at first you suspect the cause to be heat, for the walls seem frozen in the midst of melting. But then you see strange shapes in the rock, too regular to be natural—disturbingly like ribs—and undulating bumps in the ceiling, like a spine beneath skin.

Self-defense Against Vampire Assassin.name:
对抗吸血鬼刺客的自卫技巧
Self-defense Against Vampire Assassin

Text.text:
刺客带着令人作呕的傲慢，大剌剌地自阴影中现身，步伐诡异而优雅，径直走到他们的目标面前。冰冷无情的眼睛审视着猎物，怜悯与厌恶交织其间；刺客用刀锋贴着受害者跳动的咽喉缓缓划过。可当目标将一瓶圣水猛地掷向这名游侠无懈可击的面庞——玷污了那永恒的美——那层傲慢的薄壳瞬间崩裂，取而代之的是赤裸的恶意。

~ 由 Andrew Sanguine 于 Discord 上 构想

With sickening arrogance the assassin emerges, boldly, from the shadows, striding with unnatural grace to stand before their target. Cold, merciless eyes regard the mark with a mixture of pity and disgust as the assassin traces their blade along the victim's pulsing throat. The veneer of arrogance is replaced by naked malice when the target hurls a flask of holy water into the rogue's impeccable face—marring its timeless beauty.

~ Envisioned by Andrew Sanguine on Discord

Magic Item Shop.name:
魔法物品商店
Magic Item Shop

Text.text:
店铺被密密麻麻挤在一处的奇珍异物塞得逼仄得令人喘不过气。尘埃微粒在堆满杂物的桌面与柜台上方轻舞——从布袋与盒子，到水晶与蜡烛，还有扇子、羽毛、长笛，以及看似寻常的石头，杂七杂八一应俱全。木质书架占满店内四壁，其上层层叠叠堆着书本与更多古怪玩意。若不是空气里那一丝昭然的魔法嗡鸣，这地方本可平平无奇。
The shop is claustrophobic with the sheer number of curios clustered together in one place. Motes of dust dance over tables and cabinets crammed with a motley of objects—from cloth bags and boxes to crystals and candles, as well as fans, feathers, flutes, and mundane-looking stones. Wooden shelves occupy every wall of the shop, stacked with books and other oddities. The shop might be unremarkable if not for the telltale hum of enchantment in the air.

Mage Commands Magical Marionette.name:
法师指令：魔法提线木偶
Mage Commands Magical Marionette

Text.text:
女法师牢牢握住法杖，杖首是一只金色的禽爪，攫着一枚赤红宝珠。杖身镶嵌的宝石与她额前紧箍的冠饰上那颗一模一样，藏在艳紫斗篷的兜帽之下。她眼中寒光闪烁，透出近乎死寂的决绝；她以魔力丝线牵着一具木制提线人偶。明亮的紫罗兰细线自她指尖滴垂而下，将人偶钉在内八、膝并的僵硬姿势里。
The mage holds the staff secure, its head a golden avian talon holding a red orb. The gem set in the staff matches the one in the coronet clamped to her forehead, beneath the hood of her vibrant purple cloak. Her eyes gleam with a deathly determination as she holds a wooden marionette by magical strings. Bright violet wires drip down from her fingertips, holding the puppet still in a knock-kneed stance.

Dispel Evil Misses.name:
解除邪恶失手
Dispel Evil Misses

Text.text:
几粒铁屑在指间轻轻碾转的简陋起手式，再加上几句饱含力道的咒词，如今却陡然变得复杂难解。你决定将法术由守转攻，重新摆正双手的方向。你命令敌人滚回它自己的位面，并猛然一推。它甚至连回头嘶声都没有，更别说就此消失。法术从你掌间扭曲划弧，你舌尖泛起一丝铁锈味——像是鼻血倒灌——而你的对手却被你彻底偏过，毫发无伤。
From the simplicity of a few iron filings rolled between your fingers, a few words energetically spoken, now it’s all gone complicated. You decide to turn the spell from defense to offense and reorient your hands. You order your foe back to its own plane, and push. It doesn’t even turn and hiss, let alone disappear. The spell curves from your hands, you taste a little iron—like a nosebleed—and you miss your adversary entirely.

取自落基山脉一处林地，这根纤细的天然魔杖两端被锯平，仍覆着黑斑点点的白色树皮。握柄处施加了一道法术，使魔杖下方三分之一带着微黏的触感。它的魔力在户外与群山之间更为强盛。
Taken from a Rocky Mountain grove, this thin natural wand is sawn at each end and still covered in its black-speckled white bark. The grip is a spell that gives the bottom third of the wand a tacky feel. Its magical strength increases outdoors and in mountains.

Call Lightning Cast Above Player.name:
在玩家头顶施放召唤闪电
Call Lightning Cast Above Player

Text.text:
臭氧的气味渗透你的感官，你的身体刺痛着原始的恐慌。头顶的天空像淤青般蔓延成骇人的漆黑，轰鸣声层层叠起，化作刺耳喧嚣的高潮。空气噼啪作响，奥术云团仓促成形。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The smell of ozone permeates your senses as your body prickles with primordial panic. The sky above bruises to a dreadful black, ushering forth a crescendo of cacophonic booming. The atmosphere crackles as arcane clouds hastily form.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Pair Of Timpani Drums.name:
一对定音鼓
Pair Of Timpani Drums

Text.text:
这些鼓宛如架在沉重带轮底座上的黄铜巨釜，绷得极紧的硕大牛犊皮蒙在其上。鼓沿一圈木栓竖起，仿佛巨鼓成了报时的巨钟，宣告着时代的流逝。鼓声在大地被拉紧的腹腔上滚过，如雷霆碾压；而鼓手只需两支白毡槌，便能唤来风暴，将一支乐团化作一支营队。
Like brass cauldrons on heavy wheeled stands, these drums are fitted with massive calfskins stretched tight. Pegs around the rims stand up as if the drums were giant clocks telling the time. They roll like thunder over the stretched belly of the earth, and with just two mallets of white felt, the drummer can call the storm and turn an orchestra into a battalion.

Gillamedy Copperkettle.name:
吉拉梅迪·铜壶
Gillamedy Copperkettle

Text.text:
小个子男人摘下厚重的黄铜边护目镜，露出温和的灰色眼睛，咧嘴一笑。他面前瓶中的最新调制品微微发光，蓝与绿的旋涡交织流转，其间银色碎光闪烁。它让他费力地站直身子——关节因年代而僵硬——他在磨得发旧的长袍上拂了拂手，调整姿势时，腰带上一排色彩斑斓的药剂瓶轻轻叮当作响。他将新混合物举到眼前，以多年钻研淬炼出的老练目光细细审视。

~ 扮演 by The Sleep

The small man reveals kind gray eyes as he removes his thick, brass-rimmed goggles and smiles widely. His latest concoction glows softly in the bottle before him in swirling hues of blue and green, shimmering with flecks of silver. Standing with difficulty, his joints stiff with age, he brushes his hands on a well-worn robe, causing the colorful potion bottles on his belt to clink softly as he adjusts his posture. He raises the new mixture to his face and scrutinizes it with an expert eye born from years of study.

~ Played by The Sleep

Longsword Of Life Stealing.name:
噬命长剑
Longsword Of Life Stealing

Text.text:
剑柄末端看起来与寻常长剑别无二致：圆形剑首、缠束的握柄，以及宽阔的护手。然而剑刃却独树一帜。它并非逐渐收尖，而是自中段起向外张开，并在刃尖处分裂成两点，中间留出一个钥匙孔形的空间。每次挥斩，风都会穿过那道缺口尖啸，仿佛唱响一曲血腥杀戮之歌。
The hilt end appears just like any other sword: a round pommel, a bound grip, and a wide guard. But the blade is unique. Instead of tapering, it flares from the halfway point, separating at the tip into two points with a key-hole shaped space between them. The wind whistles through the gap with each swing, singing a song of carnage.

倒下的武僧一身紧绷的僧袍早已被鲜血浸透，胸膛被撕开一道巨大骇人的裂口，皮肉翻卷，骨骼碎裂外绽。僧人的双手攥成铁一般坚硬的拳头——战士的技法即便死去也依旧无懈可击——血迹沿着他那布满老茧的指节抹开。
The tight robes of the fallen martial artist are saturated with blood, and a large, gaping wound has ruptured their chest, parting flesh and splintering bone. The monk’s hands are balled into iron-hard fists—the warrior’s technique immaculate even in death—and blood smears their calloused knuckles.

这支步枪是消灭目标的尖端之作，仅供军方黑色行动单位与顶级企业特工使用。它以致命为核心而设计，配备可适配各类任务环境的附件与多种改型。无论你是在刺眼的暴风雪中追踪目标，穿越喧闹的城市街头，还是在彻底的黑暗里行动，这件武器都值得信赖，能把任务干净利落地完成。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The cutting edge of target elimination, this rifle is only available to military black ops units and top-tier corporate operatives. Designed with lethality firmly in mind, this weapon comes with attachments and variants for every operational environment. Whether tracking a target through a blinding snowstorm, across a bustling city street, or in total darkness, this weapon can be relied upon to get the job done.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

一个浓髭满脸的男人穿着印花棉布衣，举起一枚铜币，又摊开另一只手，向一群街头小鬼招手示意。他在摊开的手上“啪”地一打响指，铜币瞬间不见。接着他指向一个男孩的口袋——男孩伸手一摸，惊奇地掏出一枚铜币。魔术师又指向其他孩子的口袋，他们也一样在自己身上找到了铜子。孩子们欢呼着一哄而散，唯独留下一个神情黯淡的小女孩。她的裙子没有口袋。魔术师这才恍然，懊恼地拍了拍额头，向女孩展示自己两只空空的手，同时双手打响指——每只手里各冒出一枚铜币。女孩喜滋滋地一把抢走两枚，蹦跳着跑远了。
A thickly mustachioed man in calico clothes holds a copper piece and an open hand up before a gaggle of street urchins. He snaps the fingers of his open hand, and the coin vanishes. He points to the pocket of a boy—who reaches into it and wonderingly removes a copper piece. Then the magician points at the pockets of the other kids, and they likewise find coppers in their possession. They run off in a happy uproar, leaving one sad-looking girl behind. Her dress has no pockets. The magician strikes his forehead at his thoughtlessness, shows the girl his two open hands and snaps both fingers at once to reveal a copper in each. She happily snatches them both and scampers off.

Divine Studio Of A God Of Art.name:
艺术之神的神圣工坊
Divine Studio Of A God Of Art

Text.text:
