在一座大理石砌成的庄园里，光亮与黑暗的厅室簇拥着一间休憩长廊：沙发与酒饮，烟斗烟草，果碗盈香。每一门艺术各有一室——亚麻籽油与凿刻尘屑的气息交织；一间摆着椅子与乐谱架，另一间立着画架，或是炉火与窑炉的灼热。未完成的佳作静静生长，抹布与湿陶一片狼藉，工具铺满墙面——它们共同织就一件宏大的艺术品：那座创造之屋，在此，真实与想象的世界彼此相接。
In a manor of marbled stone, chambers of light and darkness cluster around a lounge of sofas and drinks, pipe tobacco, and bowls of fruit. One chamber for each art, the aromas of linseed oil and chisel dust, a room of chairs and music stands, another for easels, or for furnaces and kilns. Beautiful works in progress, messes of rags and wet clay, walls of tools--they all create their own great work of art, the house of creation where the real and imaginary worlds meet.

战争巨擎巍然矗立，新刷的木材泛着莹润的湛蓝。链条与绳索自高悬的斗臂垂落，祈祷的彩带在风中猎猎翻飞。阳光掠过金色的撑杆与铆钉，将木与钢紧紧扣合。铆在悬于巨大配重之上的抛光铭牌上写着 碎石者。 The engine of war stands tall, its freshly painted timber a lustrous blue. Chains and ropes dangle from the elevated cup while devotional ribbons flap in the breeze. Sunlight catches the golden struts and bolts binding wood to steel. The polished nameplate riveted to the huge counterweight suspended above reads Stone Smiter.

I Cast Lesser Restoration.name:
我施放了次级复原术
I Cast Lesser Restoration

Text.text:
他们病容憔悴、残躯瑟缩，在我面前战栗。我将魔法凝聚于他们形体的中心。自我的接触处荡开一圈蓝色光纹，魔法奔涌作响，宛如伟大神祇的一次吐息。他们的发丝与衣袂向上翻飞，仿佛一条迅疾却温柔的河流从他们身上掠过。
Their sickened face and crippled body shuddering before me, I focus my magic on the center of their form. A ripple of blue light rings out from my touch and the magic rushes audibly, like a great, deific exhale. Their hair and clothes flutter upward, as if a swift yet gentle river passes over them.

尽管比武大会喧闹夺目、盛况空前，在场边的围栏旁，两位恋人仍悄悄分享着一段浪漫时刻。骑士将一朵鲜花献给心上人，以此象征深切的爱意，她羞红了脸，喜悦在眼底流转。两人目光交汇，交换了一个心照不宣的微笑，在仪式与排场的簇拥之中，他们的爱意悄然绽放。
Despite the excitement and spectacle of the tourney, near the list, two sweethearts share a romantic moment. The knight presents his lady with a flower, as a symbol of deep affection, and she blushes with delight. Their gazes meet and they exchange a secret smile, their love blooming amid the ceremony and pomp of the event.

The Button Man's Atelier.name:
纽扣匠的工坊
The Button Man's Atelier

Text.text:
工坊是一处朴素的空间：长长的工作台、冷峻的墙面、巨大的窗户。无脸的人台从绳索上软塌塌地悬着，绳索向上延伸，没入高耸天花板的阴影里。面色蜡黄的工人们低着头，低得几乎与那些下垂的木偶齐平，缓慢地在各自的工序间移动。“欢迎！”一声豪迈的嗓音从工坊后方那间小小的围墙办公室里回荡出来。一个精灵男人现身了，走路略显跛拐，却笑容灿烂、眼神明亮。“别被人台吓着。我喜欢看我的衣服动起来，”他一边说，一边兴奋地抖动双手。最近的那具人台绳线微微一颤，木制躯壳吱呀作响地抬起了头与双手。

~ 出自惊艳的 TTRPG 增补The Vineyard

The atelier is a simple space of long tables, stark walls and large windows. Faceless mannequins hang limply from ropes extending up and disappearing into the shadows of the tall ceiling. Sallow-faced workers, heads bent as low as the drooping dummies, move slowly through their tasks. “Welcome!” The boisterous voice echoes from a small walled office at the back of the atelier. An elven man appears, walking in a slightly hitched manner, his smile broad and eyes bright. “Don’t be alarmed by the mannequins. I like to see my garments in action,” he says with a lively shake of his hands. The strings of the nearest mannequin shift, and the wooden dummy creakily lifts its head and hands.

~ Found in the amazing TTRPG supplement The Vineyard

I Cast Ray Of Enfeeblement From My Staff.name:
我从我的权杖之力中施放【衰弱射线】
I Cast Ray Of Enfeeblement From My Staff Of Power

Text.text:
当我唤出那股死灵能量时，杖柄上刻蚀的符文便亮起一种病态而苍白的幽绿。我舌尖尝到血腥，胃里翻涌抽搐得令人作呕；一道深夜般漆黑、对生命而言的禁忌之光自法杖顶端迸射而出，撕裂空气，直扑我的敌人。
The runes etched along the haft glow a sickly, pallid green when I summon the necrotic energy forth. I taste blood and feel a visceral churning in my gut as a beam of midnight black, anathema to life, springs from the head of my staff and streaks toward my foes.

Swarmkeeper's Rage.name:
虫群守卫之怒
Swarmkeeper's Rage

Text.text:
起初只是低沉的嗡鸣，转瞬便攀升为震耳的轰响——成千上万的昆虫从周遭地貌中倾涌而出，在你身侧盘旋汇聚，卷成一股旋转的涡流。蜂群的力量灌注你体内，令你信心暴涨；它随你的每一次移动而重塑形态，托举你离地，推送你向前，直扑战场。
What begins as a soft drone quickly rises into a loud hum as thousands of insects come streaming from the surrounding landscape, creating a spinning vortex around you. The power of the swarm fills you with confidence as it reshapes to your every movement. It lifts you off the ground and propels you forward into combat.

Lost Treatment Bag.name:
遗失的医疗包
Lost Treatment Bag

Text.text:
一只旧帆布袋显得久经使用：边缘磨得起了毛，接缝处的布料也薄得发虚。袋盖用一个顺手的金属按扣牢牢扣住，避免里面的东西洒出来——看起来既有魔法物件，也有寻常杂物。乍一看，你能看见一只皮革护腕、一瓶贴着标签的药剂：Draught of Calm，以及一块能握在手里的小石头，石面上刻着一个古怪的符号。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

An old canvas bag has the look of being well-used: frayed around its edges and thinning at its seams. An easy metal snap keeps the flap tightly shut so as not to spill the contents, which seem to be an array of magical and mundane items. At first glance, you see a leather wrist guard, a potion labeled: Draught of Calm, and a small, graspable stone with a strange symbol carved into its face.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Temple Of The Stormcaller.name:
唤暴者神殿
Temple Of The Stormcaller

Text.text:
一队朝圣者列队而行，沿着短促却陡峭的山路攀登，只为触及风暴召唤者神殿。神殿高踞于哈肯谷之上；这座自傲而多山的重镇将它托举得更高，甚至压过西北方宏伟的哈肯大厅。宽阔敞开的门槛之上，石柱撑起的檐口浮雕描绘着一位强大神祇——体型如巨人——正从山巅踏步下行；每一步落下，都像在宣告一阵雷霆闪电的齐射。居于此地、照料神殿的僧侣团对来访者几乎不加理会，只带着淡漠、甚至近乎厌倦的神情，照常忙着他们的日常事务。
A procession of worshippers make the short but steep climb to reach the Temple of the Stormcaller. The structure looms over Harkenvale, this proud, mountainous seat raising it even higher than the grand Harken Hall to the northwest. The cornices above the wide, open threshold—held aloft by stone pillars—picture a mighty deity, giant in size, descending the mountain, each step hailing a barrage of lightning. The order of monks that live and tend to this temple pay little heed to any of the visitors, going about their daily tasks with mild, even bored expressions.

Vampire Explaining The Thirst.name:
吸血鬼（特征）阐释渴血之欲
Vampire Explaining The Thirst

Text.text:
“它缓慢地堆积起来，直到每一粒微小生命的脉动都在我耳边轰鸣，哀求我啜饮，然后……我屈服。每一次。也许一天，也许一周——取决于我有多恨自己——但我终究会这么做。可事后涌来的那份安宁，那种我旧日人生里从未有过的澄澈平静。如此完整而美丽的感觉，怎么可能是邪恶的结果？”
“It builds slowly, until the life of every tiny thing is pounding in my ears, begging me to drink, and then… I succumb. Every time. It can take a day, maybe a week depending how much I hate myself, but I do. Yet the peace I feel afterwards, a serenity unlike anything in my old life. How could such a whole and beautiful feeling be the result of evil?”

I Cast Irresistible Dance.name:
我施放《无法抗拒之舞》
I Cast Irresistible Dance

Text.text:
我用轻快的节拍拍手，每一次击掌都激起一阵炽热的火花，从我掌间飞窜到目标的脚边。

[豁免失败] 他们起初还会蹦跳闪躲那刺痛的余烬……可很快，双脚竟也跟着踏点、滑步，踩着一段并不存在的旋律。双手来回挥舞，脚下却不停地挪步、跳跃、急转——演出一场彻头彻尾、荒唐可笑的小丑行径。

I clap my hands in a jaunty beat, each slap causing a surge of fiery sparks to fly from my hands to my target’s feet.

[Failed Save] They skip and hop at first to avoid the stinging embers… but then their feet join in to tap and slide to a nonexistent tune. Their hands wave back and forth while their feet continue to shuffle, skip, swerve—creating an altogether ridiculous little caper.

Tinkerer's Lament In A Laboratory.name:
实验室里的修补匠哀歌
Tinkerer's Lament In A Laboratory

Text.text:
“我的神祇啊，拜托！我到底还要把冶金参数校准到奥术商数多少次！？要是我现在就施放这道护甲法术，我穿上的可就是一间牢房！”
“My gods, puh-leez! How many times do I have to calibrate the metallurgy to the arcana quotient!? If I cast this armor spell now, I’ll be wearing a prison cell!”

Cave Painting Of A Gorgosaurus Hunting S.name:
一幅洞穴壁画：一头戈尔戈龙正猎杀数只诺斯罗尼奇
Cave Painting Of A Gorgosaurus Hunting Several Nothronychi

Text.text:
墙上挂着一幅画，画中一只巨大的双足蜥蜴张着满口森然利齿，正用獠牙死死咬住一只巨大的不会飞的鸟；猎物的长颈软软垂落，折断无力。猎手周围，同类的受害者正四散奔逃，拼命远离那头怪物掺着血色的獠牙。
On the wall, you see a painting depicting a huge bipedal lizard with rows of sharp fangs clutching a large flightless bird in its jaws, the prey’s long neck hanging limp and broken. Around the hunter, several of the victim’s ilk are fleeing, away from the bloody jaws of their monstrous predator.

Expert Herbalist's Yard.name:
专家草药师的庭院
Expert Herbalist's Yard

Text.text:
庭院仿佛一幅由香气绘就的画卷，一首由感官谱成的歌；你仅仅穿行其间，便被悄然蛊惑。狭窄的小径在精心打理的蓝莲、幸运玉与柠檬香蜂草间蜿蜒穿过。盛着月桂的陶盆沿着通往门前台阶的碎石路一字排开。目之所及没有一朵残花、没有一片萎叶，也没有任何一株植物显出半分干渴。
The yard is a painting of scents, a song of senses that enchants you just walking through it. Narrow paths meander through the careful landscaping of blue lotus, lucky jade, and lemon balm. Clay pots of bay laurel line the stony path to the front step. There isn’t a deadhead or wilted leaf in sight, nor is a single plant thirsty.

Act Ii Of The Hierospite: Encounter At T.name:
《圣祭寄生体》第二幕：雅典娜·普罗马科斯雕像前的遭遇
Act Ii Of The Hierospite: Encounter At The Statue Of Athena Promechos

Text.text:
他出现在一尊新近雕成的雅典娜·普罗马科斯雕像前——正是两千年前她最初被雕刻的地方。岛上的烈日烘烤着空气，可他仍穿着外套，巨大的银质徽章垂在挺括的白衬衫外。“巫师们发现了魔法，这种能把自然之力扭向自己意志的力量——然后他们做了什么？医治病人？喂饱饥民？不。他们把自己供成神祇，逼迫全人类匍匐在他们脚下。”他抬头望向雕像，露出微笑。“不管她多想扮演神祇，等死亡来收她时，她求饶的声音听起来还是太像凡人了。”伊万杰琳·梅普尔斯在他身旁现身，影像像被抹开的扭曲污迹，缓慢凝成形体。她开始准备一道法术。

He appears in front of a freshly carved statue of Athena Promechos, at the site of her original sculpting two millennia before. It is hot under the island sun, but he wears his coat, his giant silver medallion hanging over a crisp white shirt. “Wizards discover magic, the power to bend the forces of nature to their will and what do they do? Heal the sick? Feed the starving? No. They set themselves up as gods and force all mankind to grovel at their feet.” He looks up at the statue and smiles. “No matter how much she wanted to play god, when death came for her, her pleas for mercy sounded all too human.” Evangeline Maples appears next to him in a smeared, warped image of herself that slowly takes shape. She prepares a spell.

I Cast Mirror Image.name:
我施放镜像术
I Cast Mirror Image

Text.text:
我打了个响指，三道与我形貌分毫不差的幻影自我的肉身剥离而出。它们体内传来魔法低沉的嗡鸣，绕着我悄然游走。我每一次移动，无论细微或宏大，在它们完美的模仿乱舞中都只剩一瞬的视觉闪烁。
I snap my fingers and three perfect copies of my image separate from my corporeal form. I hear the quiet whir of magic within them as they move around me. Each movement I make, slight or grand, is a mere visual flicker among the flurry of their perfect mimicry.

Tract Of Land Shifting Into The Faerie P.name:
一片土地正移入妖精位面
Tract Of Land Shifting Into The Faerie Plane

Text.text:
起伏的乡野被秋天赤褐的手掌轻轻抚过。一株孤独的橡树矗立在群丘之间，树冠燃着火红的叶片，如同守望的哨兵。冷冽而干燥的风裹挟着丁香与栗子的气息，迎面拍打而来。微风掠过山丘上枯褐的草地时，你忽然能看穿每一座土丘的内里：一群群生灵——妖精？——围坐共宴；每座小丘都是一处家园，盛满食物、酒饮与欢聚的暖意。然而风声一歇，幻景也随之消散。土丘与那株橡树再度归于寻常。
The rolling countryside has been touched by the auburn hands of autumn. A single oak tree, with its crown of fire-red leaves, stands as a sentinel amongst the hills. A chill dry wind, bearing the scent of cloves and chestnut, buffets you. As the breeze passes over the brown grass of the hills, you can suddenly see inside each mound. Groups of creatures—faeries?—feasting with one another, each hill a home filled with food, drink and fellowship. However, as soon as the wind fades, so do the visions. The hillocks and their oak tree are mundane once again.

I Use My Helm Of Teleportation.name:
我启用我的传送头盔
I Use My Helm Of Teleportation

Text.text:
戴上这顶头盔时，我能感到以太界的氛围，仿佛自己始终站在一座伸入迷雾的长桥一侧。旅程几乎不比我想去哪里的一个念头更长。轻微的眩晕，短短一瞬的定向与平衡，我便忆起了通往此处的路。
When wear this helmet I can feel the atmosphere of the ethereal, as if I am always standing at one side of a long bridge arching into mist. The journey is hardly longer than the thought of where I want to go. A touch of vertigo, a mere second of orientation and balance, and I have remembered my way here.

阳光斑驳而温暖地洒在辽阔的草甸上，为青草与盛放的花朵镀上一层闪耀的金色露光。空气里弥漫着一股宜人却又带着清冽锋芒的香气交织——紫菀、皇后蕾丝、松果菊、秋英、百合、菊苣与雏菊——浓郁得几乎能触碰。蜜蜂与蜻蜓在花蕾间穿梭，翅振的细微嗡鸣无处不在。草丛之中，兔子忽而窜出，忽而隐没。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

The sun falls dappled and warm on the sprawling meadow, tinging the grass and blooming flowers with a gleaming, golden dew. A pleasant yet sharp mingling of aromas—astra, queen’s lace, coneflower, cosmos, lily, chicory, and daisy—hangs heavy on the air. Bees and dragonflies flit from bud to bud, the subtle buzz of their wings omnipresent. Among the grass, rabbits dart here and there.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Sundries From An Undead Dragonborn.name:
亡灵龙裔的杂物
Sundries From An Undead Dragonborn

Text.text:
在这生物破碎的护甲残片间，你发现了一件古怪的物品。一枚金币——铸造风格你从未见过——其上被人刻意玷污，印着一道诡异的黑色印记。你虽不识其意，却只要凝视它，便胃里翻涌作呕。
Amid the tattered remnants of the creature’s armor you find a curious item. A gold coin—minted in a style you don’t recognize—has been defaced with a strange black sigil. Though you don’t know the symbol, it turns your stomach to gaze upon it.

Party Awakens With Missing Memories.name:
众人醒来，记忆尽失
Party Awakens With Missing Memories

Text.text:
群狼的长嗥合唱迎接着初升的太阳，黎明越过你们营地残骸的边缘。轻快的嘉年华乐声在缀满露珠的空气里叮当闪烁，仿佛从一场被遗忘的梦中回荡而来，而你们发现自己正凝视着一群陌生人。尽管你们对在此之前的人生毫无记忆，那些面孔却诡异地令人眼熟；似曾相识的阴冷抚触在脑海里竖起寒毛，窸窣作响。

~ Rane构想

A chorus of lupine howls greets the rising sun as dawn crests over the remnants of your campsite. Jaunty carnival music twinkles through the dew-laced air as if echoing from a forgotten dream, and you find yourselves staring at a group of strangers. Though you have no recollections of your lives before this point, the faces seem curiously familiar and the eerie caress of déjà vu bristles through your minds.

~ Envisioned by Rane

一头蓬乱的赤褐短发，与这位半身人肩头披着的褪色白色毛皮形成鲜明对比。男人的五官圆润稚气，神情像迷失在甜美的白日梦里，柔和的榛色眼眸飘向远方地平线。 一只手搭在横放于膝上的、雕工精美的白蜡木长弓弓身上，另一只手则轻轻抚摸着蜷卧在身旁的小白龙的头。那兽贴着游侠磨旧的皮靴亲昵地蹭着，发出满足的低咕声，张合的鼻孔间吐出一团带霜的寒气。

~ Played by Vmaster1995 with

A crop of tousled auburn hair stands in stark contrast to the faded white fur the halfling wears around his shoulders. The man has round, boyish features and appears lost in a happy daydream, his soft, hazel eyes drifting to the horizon beyond. One hand rests upon the body of a beautifully carved ash-wood bow, laid across his lap, whilst the other gently strokes the head of a small white dragon curled beside him. The beast nuzzles the ranger’s worn leather boots and grumbles affectionately, causing a puff of frosted air to escape its flaring nostrils.

~ Played by Vmaster1995 with

金色的皮毛宛如极乐境闪烁的原野，从蹄到獠牙覆满这只小小生物的全身；四片羽翼轻柔的拍击声，为这灵体的现身送上悦耳的伴奏。它那如明珠般发亮的眼眸闪着顽皮与喜悦的光彩，天界的长鼻兽扬鼻鸣叫，向来者献上欢迎。
Golden fur like the shimmering fields of Elysium covers the small creature’s body from hoof to tusk, and the soft beating of four wings provides a pleasing accompaniment to the spirit’s presence. Eyes like shining pearls sparkle with mirth and joy as the heavenly pachyderm trumpets a welcome.

雪无声飘落，裹住了整片大地。荒野被一阵不自然的寂静吞没——那静止既令人不安，又莫名抚慰。自旷野的阴影中，一头巨大的生物踏雪而出，体量惊人，仿佛一座踉跄移动的山峦。它高如猛犸，是血肉与皮毛筑起的壁垒。雄鹿的皮毛洁白如雪，点缀银斑，在霜寒中熠熠生辉。它头顶的鹿角如峻伟王冠般隆起，掠过四周树梢最高的枝桠，震落簌簌积雪。它是君王，是兽群之王；雄鹿昂然迈步而过，如同自然本身的力量。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Snow falls silently, shrouding the landscape. An unnatural quiet overtakes the wilderness—a stillness both unnerving and comforting. From the shadow of the wilds, a massive creature emerges, staggering in its scope. It stands as tall as a mammoth, a bulwark of flesh and fur. The stag’s hide is white, dappled silver, and shines in the frost. The antlers cresting its head form a mighty crown, knocking snow from the highest boughs of the surrounding trees. A monarch, a king among beasts, the stag strides by, a force of nature.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Insult About Weaker Party Member.name:
对较弱队友的辱骂
Insult About Weaker Party Member

Text.text:
“我们这支队伍，真是妙不可言！你，拥有群山般的力量；你，兼具鹰隼的优雅与凶猛；而你……老实说我本以为你早该死了，可你偏偏还活着——这也算是另一种了不起。”
“Such a company we have assembled! You, with the strength of the mountains, and you, with the grace and ferocity of a hawk, and you… To be honest I thought you’d be dead by now, but you’re not, and that’s impressive in its own way.”

你念出抹消咒语，将上一道法术残留从你的法器中抹去，同时一记斩落劈开面前的魔法武器。你移动时，身后拖曳出一条绚烂的赤红光尾。法器也亮起同样的霓虹红芒，框架之内噼啪作响、火花四溅，声响清晰可闻。片刻之后，法器的光芒渐渐暗下，恢复成原本的模样。空气中短暂残留着一丝烘烤般的暖香，随后彻底消散。
You speak the words to erase the remnants of your last spell from your focus, slicing the magical weapon in front of you. A tail of brilliant red light follows your movement. The focus glows the same neon-red, sparking and crackling audible from within its frame. After a moment, the focus dims back to its normal appearance. A toasty smell lingers in the air for a moment before dissipating completely.

Spectral Hand Interrupts Warrior’s Attac.name:
幽灵之手打断战士的攻击
Spectral Hand Interrupts Warrior’s Attack

Text.text: 战士龇牙低吼，巨大的圆盾稳稳挡在身前。他屈膝蓄势，钢头战斧向后抡起，随时准备冲锋。然而，就在他的下一次攻击将要爆发之际，肩后一点火花夺走了他的注意——一只由青蓝烟雾与光凝成的幽灵之手叹息般浮现。手指张开，如蜘蛛的长足般伸展，猛然向前扑去，直取战士的头颅。 The warrior snarls, his great round shield held sturdy before him. He reels back his steel-headed battle axe as he bends his legs, ready to charge. But a spark over his shoulder distracts from his impending attack—a spectral hand of teal smoke and light sighs into existence. The fingers splay like the legs of a spider and surge forward, aiming for the warrior’s head.

Astriapi Warden.name:
阿斯特里亚庇守望者
Astriapi Warden

Text.text:
宽阔的几丁质甲壳如同护甲般以盾牌之势护住这只生物，橙与蓝的妖异纹路沿着四肢盘旋而下，汇入强健的手掌与生着利爪的足部。四片云色之翼自躯体舒展，振翅如幻，以不可思议的昆虫般速度颤动。那张巨口亦是昆虫的模样，满布颚钳与感知触须；它们微微偏头，仿佛正冷静地分析一切。腰间别着一把轻巧的手枪与一柄看上去凶残的利刃。
A broad chitin carapace shields this creature like armor and lurid lines of orange and blue swirl down limbs to powerful hands and clawed feet. Four cloud-colored wings stretch from the body, fluttering at impossible insectoid speeds. The maw too is that of an insect, replete with mandibles and sensory antennae, and they cock their head as if analyzing. A lightweight pistol and a brutal looking blade sit at their waist.

I Throw A Dart At A Larger Target.name:
我把飞镖掷向更大的目标
I Throw A Dart At A Larger Target

Text.text:
借着我矮小的身形占尽便宜，我灵巧地跃上墙面，沿着垂直的石壁以惊人的速度飞奔而过。我探手摸向胸前的弹带，抽出一支带羽的飞镖，甩手放飞；与此同时，我借势从墙上猛然一蹬，身影在空中一掠而过。

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Using my diminutive stature to my advantage, I leap dexterously onto the wall, running across its surface at speed. I reach for the bandolier at my chest, withdrawing a feathered dart and letting it fly, pushing off the wall as I do so.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

你取出一根发着微光的香棒，在空中挥动，画出一个个方形，构筑起一只想象的立方体；随后你小心翼翼地将施法材料居中安置，仿佛把蜡烛放入提灯。待你终于调整到恰到好处，空气中骤然爆开一团璀璨的万花筒光潮——旋舞翻卷——在你的指引下游走四方，令周遭目眩神迷；紧接着它又忽地一闪而灭，只留下他们眨着眼回神。
You take a glowing stick of incense and wave it in squares to create an imaginary cube within which you carefully center the component, as if placing a candle in a lantern. When you’ve managed to get it just right, a brilliant kaleidoscope erupts in the air—whirling and twirling—dazzling those around which it roams at your direction, before it suddenly winks out, leaving them blinking.

新生的兽人毫不浪费时代，立刻用咆哮宣泄他们的不满，露出已从牙龈间顶出的细小獠牙。它们已然拥有令人不安的怪力，绿意皮肤下的细小肌肉绷紧起伏，抓住身边触手可及的任何东西，猛塞进嘴里，试图缓解一降生便随之而来的出牙痛楚。
The newborn orc wastes no time in voicing their displeasure. They roar, displaying tiny tusks already jutting from their gums. They possess an uncanny strength already, the tiny muscles beneath their green-hued skin flexing as they grab at anything nearby, jamming it into their mouth to soothe teething pains that manifest as soon as they enter the world.

Killed In Combat With A Knife.name:
持刀战死
Killed In Combat With A Knife

Text.text:
刺客以灵巧而阴狠的刀花一抖，将那柄小刀硬生生推进士兵的护甲缝隙；刀锋先在板甲与锁子甲间叮当作响，继而没入布料与血肉。被刺的士兵脸色在彻底的震骇中坠落，笨拙的戴甲手慌忙去抓刀柄——可持刀者咬紧牙关，双手并用，将刀刃狠狠拖过他的腹部。伴随一道刺耳的尖啸回荡空中，他们弧线般一甩，将刀猛地拔出；随之而来的是一蓬血雨。血也从士兵口中喷溅、拉出黏稠的血丝，他沉重地跪倒一膝，手中长剑松垮地垂着。另一只空手徒劳地按住腹部，想把肠子塞回去。他含混地嘟囔着听不清的字句，眼中燃起不祥的火光……可他的诅咒终究消散在苍白的唇间。随即他倒向地面，腹间与口边渗出的黑暗血泊迅速向外漫开。

~ Envisioned by Tate.W

In a flourish of nimble, wicked knife work, the assailant pushes the small blade past the soldier’s armor, clinking against plate and chain before sinking into cloth and flesh. Face falling in abject shock, the stabbed soldier tries to grab the knife with his clumsy, gauntleted hand—but the knife-bearer grits their teeth, using both hands to drag the blade across his stomach. With a piercing cry that echoes through the air, they wrench the knife out in an arced swipe; it’s followed by a spray of blood. Blood also sputters and trails out of the soldier’s mouth as he falls clunkily to one knee, sword hanging loose in his hand. He holds his free hand to his stomach in a futile attempt to keep his guts in place. He mumbles something indiscernible as a baleful fire ignites in his eyes… but his curse is lost on pale lips. He falls to the ground, dark pools spreading out from his stomach and mouth.

~ Envisioned by Tate.W

这只山羊心不在焉地嚼着饲料，滑稽得几乎让人发笑；但这头如挽马般巨大的生物头顶那对犄角，一旦被激怒，足以狠狠干上一记。
The goat is almost comical as it chews absently at its feed, but the horns atop the head of this draft-horse-sized creature could deliver quite a wallop if provoked.

Vial Of Antitoxin.name:
抗毒剂小瓶
Vial Of Antitoxin

Text.text:
这只矮短的玻璃小瓶上贴着一张字迹工整的标签，但在旅行途中大半都已被蹭得模糊不清。或许早料到会如此，封住瓶口的软木塞上被人用烧热的针细细烙刻：一个医疗十字旁，勾着一条细小的蛇，獠牙间垂落着滴滴毒液。
This short, squat glass vial has been labeled with careful lettering, but much of it has smudged in travel. Possibly anticipating this, the cork sealing the vial has been etched, using a heated needle to depict a medical cross next to a line drawing of a tiny snake with venom dripping from its fangs.

Dragon Dance Of The Claw Style: S-dobrad.name:
龙爪流·龙之舞：S-折步
Dragon Dance Of The Claw Style: S-dobrado

Text.text:
你在negachiva中将身形压得极低，贴近地面，一脚向前探出；随即腿部一摆、双臂一旋，猛然一拧，竟以单手倒立翻转而起。仿佛巨龙腾空，冲入疾疾回旋的狂风之中——庞然之躯却轻若飘叶。转瞬之间，你已突进到对手面前，近得几乎鼻尖相抵。

~ 由一位英雄设想

Squatting down low to the ground in the negachiva, one foot out in front, you rise in a swing of a leg, a circling of the arms, and a sudden turn, upside down, on one hand. It is as if a dragon were taking off into a fast, whirling wind, an enormous figure at once light as a leaf. All at once you have advanced, face-to-face, on your opponent.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Cast Modify Memory.name:
我施放「篡改记忆」
I Cast Modify Memory

Text.text:
我的意志沉入我目标的心智，像熔融金属流进铁匠的模具。我穿行于过往的脉络与暗袋之间，直到找到我所需的那一刻。我紧攥拳头，看着它融化成可塑之物——然后将其重新塑造成由我亲手设计的回忆。
My will sinks into the mind of my target like molten metal flowing into a blacksmith’s mold. I travel through the trails and pockets of the past until I find the moment I need. I clench my fist tight and watch it melt into something malleable—and then I re-form it into a reminiscence of my own design.

一股非自然的静滞笼罩着这片狭小的高原：声音骤然消失，仿佛你踏过了一道无形的门槛，进入了某个隐秘国度里超凡脱俗的安宁。悬崖边缘矗立着一块巨大的乳光岩石，其上刻着星辰般的纹饰——嵌在石中的宝石随之脉动，散发出柔和的蔚蓝光辉。
Unnatural stillness permeates this small plateau: a sudden absence of sound, as if you have crossed an invisible threshold into a hidden realm of otherworldly tranquility. A large, opalescent rock bearing celestial carvings sits at the cliff’s edge—the stones set within pulsing with a soft, azure light.

当这些芯片被整合进VR头显时，它们会向前额叶皮层发射磁脉冲。那感觉就像有人在你的头骨上轻轻敲击。机遇正在敲门，为你送上一种焕然一新的生命视角——你的大脑神经元与突触在电势中齐声鸣唱。冷静又有魅力？自信且强势？恐惧被抹去，焦虑被平息？这些芯片能赐予植入的性格与被伪造的记忆行为，按任何需求量身定制。

~ 由一位英雄构想

When integrated into VR headsets, these chips emit magnetic pulses into the prefrontal cortex. The sensation is like someone tapping on your skull. Opportunity is knocking, offering you a whole new outlook on life, as your brain’s neurons and synapses sing with electric potential. Calm and charismatic? Confident and assertive? Fears erased, anxieties quelled? The chips bestow implanted characteristics and falsely remembered behaviors, tailored to any need.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Joke About Hunger.name:
拿饥饿开玩笑
Joke About Hunger

Text.text:
“我也走过那种旅程——一连好几周滴米未进。但我后来才明白，真正的食粮，是我们一路结下的情谊与同伴。”
“I’ve been on journeys where we had to go weeks without food. But I realized that the real food was the friends we made along the way.”

尽管身形矮壮而轻盈——即便披着沉重的锁子甲——监工仍散发着不可撼动的威权。那双清癯的眼睛，仿佛能洞穿魔法本身，以铁一般的注视将你钉在原地。他一手紧攥着刻有神祇印记的石质坠饰，另一手抡起沉重的钉头锤猛然砸入大地。轰然一击的浑厚震波裹挟着厉声号令，传向其余的灰矮人，像无可抗拒的战斗召唤般将他们唤醒。随即，监工开始祈祷——他的吟诵声浪节节攀升，体型也随之膨胀，直到他高高耸立在你面前，如今已达十英尺之高。
Though squat and light—even beneath heavy chainmail—the taskmaster exudes unassailable authority. Ascetic eyes, capable of boring through magic itself, hold you in their iron regard. While clutching a stone pendant etched with a god's mark in one hand, his other swings a heavy maul down into the earth. The impact's sonorous shockwave carries a barked order to the other duergar, animating them in an undeniable call to arms. Then the taskmaster begins to pray, his chanting swelling in volume as his body swells in size, until they tower over you, now ten feet tall.

一名身着梅紫色袴的男子俯身而下，将手搭在一只由阴影塑成的狐形生物头顶；它的胭红双眼透着狡黠的锋芒。男子直起身，露出半被眼罩遮住的类地精面孔，皮肤如落日般焦橙。他的神情冷得像洞窟岩石，握住武士刀刀柄的手却松弛从容。那生物仍在他身旁闷燃，邪恶的魔法红线沿着它浑浊的轮廓奔流。

~ Played by Max

A man in a plum-purple hakama stoops low to rest his hand on the head of a vulpine creature crafted of shadow, its carmine eyes cut with cunning. The man rises, revealing a goblinoid face partially masked by a blindfold, his skin the burnt-orange of a sunset. His expression is as cool as cavern stone and he keeps a relaxed grip on the hilt of his katana. The creature continues to smolder next to him, red lines of fell magic coursing along its murky silhouette.

~ Played by Max

治安官的眼睛被歪斜的帽檐遮去大半，他们以锐利的目光细细掂量每一个过路人。远处传来一阵喧闹的声响，他们的手倏地探进那件饱经风尘的夹克里。随即他们抬起头，更清楚地露出一张布满旧疤、眉间刻着深深皱纹的脸——那皱纹泄露了漫长岁月里累积的艰辛与忧惧。

~ Envisioned by Tactical Rash

The sheriff's eyes are partially concealed by their tilted hat, and they carefully measure each passerby with a piercing gaze. A clatter of noise in the distance sends their hand darting inside their road-worn jacket. They look up, giving a better view of a face marked with old scars and deep frown lines that betray a long life of hardship and worry.

~ Envisioned by Tactical Rash

这座方盒般的石墓前，熟铁大门向外弯折，仅靠一侧铰链歪斜悬挂。门廊两旁的装饰立柱也已破损不堪。上方的山花饰带被利爪抓痕与崩裂撕扯得面目全非，早已无法辨认；屋脊顶端同样残缺的天使像俯瞰而下，宛如在守夜。此地弥漫着浓烈的死臭。墓内幽暗深处传来咔嚓作响的咀嚼与撕扯声。
The wrought-iron gate to this boxlike stone tomb is bent outward, hanging from one hinge. The ornamental columns around the doorway are damaged, too. Above, the pediment bears a frieze so disfigured with claw marks and breakage as to be unreadable, and a likewise mutilated angelic figure watches from the roof’s apex. The place reeks of death. A crunching and tearing sound issues from the gloom inside it.

Divine Home Of A God Of Magic.name:
魔法之神的神圣居所
Divine Home Of A God Of Magic

Text.text:
在一楼，穿过一扇朴素未上锁的门——更像学校而非神殿——便是一间房室，中央唯有一张舒适的扶手椅。螺旋楼梯向下蜿蜒坠入黑暗，向上则通往数层挑高的房间：人声鼎沸的图书馆、玻璃墙的实验室、奢华的卧室。高塔几乎每一寸表面都仿佛被文字编织而成：力量之语、防护符印、秘奥字母表——或刻入其中，或涂绘其上，或以粉笔勾勒。有时笔迹线条分明、井然有序；有时又如失控的喷溅般，爆裂成令人心惊的混沌。
On the ground floor, through a simple unlocked door more reminiscent of a school than a temple, is a chamber with only a comfortable armchair in its center. A spiral staircase travels downward into darkness and up toward several floors of high-ceilinged rooms: teeming libraries, glass laboratories, opulent bedchambers. Nearly every surface of the tower looks as if it were woven together with writing: words of power, protective glyphs, alphabets of esoterica, all engraved, or painted, or chalked. Sometimes the writing is linear and orderly; sometimes it appears in shocking sprays of chaos.

Cleric Binding Wounds Without Magic.name:
牧师：不借助魔法缚紧伤口
Cleric Binding Wounds Without Magic

Text.text:
魔法的潮汐渐渐衰弱。你整日追逐冒险，力量与专注也随之流逝。如今你只能依靠自己的双手，以及先辈代代医者传下的知识。你低声背诵着许多月前学会的流程，一步不差地用亚麻布为同伴包扎伤口，按压止血，将渗出的鲜红硬生生逼回去。他们绝望地呻吟着，但至少——他们还活着。

~ Tusker2zero on Discord

The tides of magic grow weak. Your strength and focus have ebbed away in the pursuit of adventure throughout the day. Now you must rely on your own hands and the knowledge passed down from generations of healers before you. Reciting the steps of the process you learned many moons ago, you bind your companion's wounds with linen and staunch the bleeding while applying pressure. They groan despondently, but at least they are alive.

~ Tusker2zero on Discord

Fountain Room: Pool Of Elemental Arcana.name:
喷泉厅：元素秘奥之池
Fountain Room: Pool Of Elemental Arcana

Text.text:
你俯瞰这片宽阔的水池，仿佛正凝视一幅海景。风暴云在黝黑的海面上翻滚，海水被搅成满是白色浪冠的泡沫；细小的闪电不时炸裂，雷声在迷蒙的雾霭中低沉滚过。你正惊叹凝望时，水池上方的云层忽然倾泻成幕幕雨帘，砸落在翻涌的波涛之上。
You look over this broad pool and seem to be staring at a seascape. Storm clouds roil over a dark ocean frothed into whitecaps, while tiny flashes of lightning explode and thunder rumbles in the haze. As you watch in wonderment, the clouds above the pool drop sheets of rain down on the waves.

The River Narrows Into A Steep Gorge.name:
河道收束，陡然切入峭壁峡谷
The River Narrows Into A Steep Gorge

Text.text:
河水的流速骤然加快，你听见前方激流轰鸣。峡谷石壁向河道逼近，吞噬了岩岸与垂直峭壁之间的空间。转眼间，水面化作一片翻滚的白浪，在深壑陡峭的两侧之间奔涌而下。
The flow of the river picks up its pace, and you hear the roar of rushing water ahead. Canyon walls close in around the waterway, eating up the space between the rocky shore and sheer stone walls. In the blink of an eye, the surface becomes a mass of churning whitewater rushing between the steep sides of a gorge.

Talisman Of Ultimate Evil.name:
终极邪恶护符
Talisman Of Ultimate Evil

Text.text:
一股近乎有意识的威胁、暴力与贪婪洪流自那枚缟玛瑙与翡翠护符中脉动涌出，席卷过你。只要你身处其旁，清醒的思绪便被屠戮与废墟的景象塞满。
An almost-conscious flood of menace, violence, and greed pulses forth from the onyx and emerald talisman, washing over you. Your waking thoughts are filled with scenes of slaughter and ruin while you are in its presence.

Blind Tiefling Warlock.name:
失明的提夫林邪术师
Blind Tiefling Warlock

Text.text:
木杖轻轻一声plink，先于这位提夫林施法者沉稳的脚步传来；他卷曲的双角如两缕灰烟，仿佛凝结硬化、结晶成形。头上系着一条薄布——深色织物上绣着盘旋的线纹，金属般闪烁——将他的双眼完全遮住。杖头是一团鼓胀的瘤木，内里透出橙色光芒，像闷燃火堆里的木柴。他靠近时，先将杖端在前方轻点，借此引路。

~ 由 Played 扮演：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The plink of a wooden staff precedes the measured steps of this tiefling spellcaster, his curling horns like two gray furls of smoke hardened and crystallized. A piece of thin cloth—a dark fabric embroidered with swirling threads that glint like metal—is tied about his head, covering his eyes completely. The head of his staff is a burl of bulging wood, glowing orange from within like a log in a smoldering fire. He moves closer, tapping the end of his staff ahead of him to guide his way.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

这名疲惫不堪的矿工穿着厚重的靴子、磨旧的长裤和皮制罩衫，在提灯人的灯光指引下，将一筐未加工的矿石倾倒进旁边的矿车里。他停下来用水勺喝了口水，重新点燃火把，随即沿着隧道更深处继续前行。
Dressed in heavy boots, well-worn trousers, and a leather smock, the beleaguered miner dumps his load of raw ore into a nearby cart, using the light of a lantern man to guide his motion. He pauses to drink from a dipper of water, relights his torch, and then moves on down the tunnel.

曾经繁盛的湖床如今只剩盐晶与其他矿物的结晶，反射着阳光的利刃直刺向你，晃得你眼前发白、灼得皮肤发烫。你眺望这片闪耀的白色盐沼时，遮住双眼几乎是绝对必要的。龟裂结痂的土壤暴露出地面的不稳定，每走一步脚下都咔嚓作响、踏碎下陷，使徒步旅行既艰难又危险。
The crystals of salt and other minerals of the once-thriving lake bed reflect the sun’s rays up toward you, blinding and baking you. Shielding your eyes is absolutely mandatory as you look out over the shining, white landscape of the salt flats. Crusty soil betrays the unstable nature of the ground and your foot crunches through with every step, making foot travel both difficult and dangerous.

Dragon Skull Embedded In Volcanic Rock.name:
嵌在火山岩中的龙颅
Dragon Skull Embedded In Volcanic Rock

Text.text:
那巨大的颅骨半嵌在黝黑的火成岩中，乍看像是某种被夸张放大的史前生物；可你再靠近些，便辨出那标志性的头冠与下颌轮廓——这是一头早已死去的巨龙。你继续逼近，才发现龙口后方竟有一道通往地下的裂口，像是某条隐秘甬道的入口——然而关于不死巨龙的传闻，让你在纵身跃入前不由得三思。
The massive skull half-baked into the dark igneous rock at first appears to be that of an overgrown prehistoric creature, but as you draw closer you make out the telltale crest and jawline of a long-dead dragon. As you draw nearer still you see that there is some sort of opening to a subterranean passage in the rear of the dragon’s maw—though tales of undead dragons lead you to think twice before taking the plunge.

Foundation Of The Net (The World Tree).name:
网之基石（世界树）
Foundation Of The Net (The World Tree)

Text.text:
在赛博宇宙的无垠穹野中，世界树之谜如同一枚晦秘的支点伫立——那株世界幼苗已然参天，缠绕着纳米现实的无底深渊与物质世界。它仿佛一位实证的导体，在算术交响的洪流里指挥和声，编织难以捕捉的连贯毛细脉络；而那位典范者则踏入网格那团无定形的星云，寻觅愿意共鸣的化身。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Within the infinite expanse of the cyberverse, the enigma of the World Tree stands as a cryptic fulcrum, the world seedling grown huge, entwining the fathomless depths of nanoreality with the physical world. Like an empirical conductor, orchestrating harmony amid the arithmetic symphony and weaving elusive capillaries of coherence, the paragon wades through the amorphous nebula of the grid in search of receptive avatars.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Cheerful Wizard's Advice About The Simpl.name:
欢快魔法师关于魔法简明之道的忠告
Cheerful Wizard's Advice About The Simplicity Of Magic

Text.text:
“魔法或许看起来令人望而生畏，但其实并没那么复杂。它的能量在我们周围流淌，渴望被人运用。你只需学会如何开口请求。”
“Magic may seem daunting, but it’s really not that complicated. Its energy flows all around us, eager to be used. One must only learn to ask.”

别人比你更早察觉。他们盯着你的脸皱眉、发愣，先是瞪大眼睛，随即又尴尬地移开视线。镜中的倒影里站着的，是一个像你却仿佛遭遇过惨烈事故的人。也许你仍清晰记得当时有人说过的那句话，又或者你拼命回想这事究竟在何时、以何种方式发生。无论如何，你已被重新拼凑、改换了模样。
Others notice before you do. They grimace or gawk at your face, wide-eyed then embarrassed. Your reflection in the mirror shows someone who resembles you after a terrible accident. Maybe you remember quite vividly the words that were spoken, or perhaps you try to recall how and when this could have happened. Either way, you have been rearranged.

Island Natives Spurning Contact.name:
岛民土著拒绝接触
Island Natives Spurning Contact

Text.text:
在海滩那一尘不染的白沙上，你看见一群人聚在一起，敌意如刺，身着本地装束，手握骇人的武器。你清楚地感到他们审视的重量——而当他们将弓弦拉至满弦时，这种压迫感更是节节攀升。他们的讯息再明白不过：再靠近一步，我们就放箭。

~ 构想：Clara C. Potter（Discord）

On the flawless white sands of the beach you see a crowd gathered, bristling with hostility, clad in native garb, and wielding fearsome weapons. You feel the weight of their scrutiny keenly—a feeling that only increases as they pull their bows to full draw. Their message is clear: come closer and we will fire.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

带着连风都要嫉妒的流畅身姿，半身人轻巧地翻身落上吧台高凳，娴熟的优雅让她几乎无声着地。她以街头叫卖者般锐利的目光打量着你，仿佛正嗅探你的弱点、你的癖好。她指间灵巧地转着一把薄刃小刀。
With a fluidity the wind would envy, the halfling swings herself onto a barstool, her practiced grace landing her with nary a sound. She regards you with the piercing eyes of a street hawker, anticipating your weaknesses, your vices. She twirls a thin knife deftly in her hand.

Quip From A Restless Party Member.name:
一名坐立不安的队员的俏皮话
Quip From A Restless Party Member

Text.text:
“这份平静让我浑身不自在，仿佛每过一分钟，我就又死去一点。乡间有没有什么野兽在游荡，能让我去追猎？现在就算来只不听话的野猫，我也认了。”
“All this calm makes me uncomfortable, like I’m dying a little more with every minute that goes by. Is there some beast roaming the countryside I could hunt? I’d settle for an unruly cat at this point.”

Wizard Tower Interior.name:
巫师塔内部
Wizard Tower Interior

Text.text: 塔内，法师高塔的底层陈设简约，只有几把不起眼的椅子和一张餐边柜。餐边柜上摆着一只水晶醒酒瓶，盛满琥珀色的液体，像是特意为受邀宾客备下。壁炉火光熊熊，热浪向室内吐息；炉上方，一幅格调雅致的塔主肖像俯瞰前厅，仿佛静静主持着这处空间。 [Permission granted] 几乎就在允许进入的那一刻，一道盘旋的楼梯骤然显现，宽得足以容下三名类人生物并行，仿佛它一直都在，只是此刻才愿意被看见。你注意到，随着你一步步向上攀登，每踏上一阶，阶面上一串淡蓝色符文便依次亮起，持续为你照亮通往主人的实验室、以及其内奥秘的道路。 Inside, the base of the wizard tower is spare, with only a few unremarkable chairs and a sideboard. Upon the sideboard sits a crystal decanter full of some amber liquid left out for invited guests. A tasteful painting of the tower's owner presides over the foyer from its place above the blazing hearth, which emits heat into the room. [Permission granted] As soon as permission to enter is given, a winding staircase wide enough for three humanoids suddenly appears, as if it had been there all along. You notice that with every new stair you climb as you ascend to the top, a series of pale blue runes on the steps themselves continue lighting your way upward to the master’s laboratory and the mysteries within.

I Paint With My Marvelous Pigments.name:
我以瑰奇颜料作画
I Paint With My Marvelous Pigments

Text.text:
手握画笔，我思量二十五枚金币的价值，以及它们能买来些什么。我拿它来做个试验：在眼前稀薄的空气画布上，描出一只小小的铁砧。我勾勒出它的次元线条，再以色彩填满其形，便有一只小钢砧立在那儿。我一把抓起，五指收紧。它应声碎裂，化作白垩般的粉末，崩散成尘。正如其局限所示，我转而着手更为合理的造物。
With brush in hand, I contemplate the value of twenty-five pieces of gold and the things they can buy. I test this, painting a small anvil on the canvas of thin air before me. I paint the lines of its dimensions, then fill the form with color, and there stands a small steel anvil. I grab it and squeeze. It crushes into white chalk, disintegrating to dust. True to its limitations, I instead begin work on something more reasonable.

一只巨大的四足蟑螂迈着灵巧的肢体疾窜而出，黑绿相间的甲壳在光下泛着冷硬的光泽。它足有十三英尺高、重达数吨，庞然身影一现便令整个房间为之噤然。它身披显然象征高阶地位的长袍，上面缀着细小的金属勋章与一条条五彩缎带。它停住脚步，将两只几丁质的手合拢，做出虔敬而沉思的姿势。淡淡的灵能嗡鸣萦绕在这只生物周身。
A massive four-legged cockroach with a black-and-green carapace skitters forth on dexterous limbs. Thirteen feet tall and weighing several tons, its humungous presence instantly commands the room. It wears robes of obvious rank, decorated with small metallic medals and little strips of multicolored ribbon. It pauses, bringing together two chitinous hands in a reverent, thoughtful gesture. The faint hum of psychic potential surrounds the creature.

Divine Studio Of A God Of Bards.name:
吟游诗神的神圣工坊
Divine Studio Of A God Of Bards

Text.text:
在一间俯瞰花园的玻璃暖房里，拼花木地板的中央摆着一张细脚小桌，桌上静静搁着一只破碎的节拍器。暖房靠住宅墙的一侧，壁炉里有一小撮芳香的柴火噼啪作响。旁边是一把柔软却陈旧的椅子，一根手杖斜倚在椅侧。巨大的书架塞满了古老的巨著与乐谱。椅旁的谱架上放着一张空白的五线谱纸，上面用狡黠的笔迹横写着一句话：他们说音符该写在这里……
On a spindly little table at the center of a parquet floor, in a conservatory of glass overlooking a garden, there sits a broken metronome. A small, aromatic crackles in a fireplace on the conservatory’s house wall. Near it is a soft old chair, against which leans a walking stick. Ancient tomes and musical scores pack a large set of bookshelves. On a music stand by the chair is a sheet of blank staff paper. Written across it in a crafty script are the words: They say the notes go here...

Shepherd With Flock.name:
牧羊人与羊群
Shepherd With Flock

Text.text:
男孩看起来还没到能独自跑到离镇子这么远的年纪，但话说回来，他身边有狗、有羊群作伴。他只比羊背高出一颗头，羊群为躲避那只游走逼近的牧羊犬而连连跳闪时，你一时间竟看不见他。你看着男孩把手指送到唇边，吹出一声尖亮的长哨；牧羊犬立刻应声而动，倏然改向，转而把羊群驱往另一侧。
The boy doesn’t look old enough to be alone so far from town, but then again, he’s with his dog and the flock. Barely a head taller than the sheep’s backs, you lose sight of him for a moment as they leap to evade the prowling dog. You watch the boy put fingers to mouth and emit a loud whistle, to which the dog instantly responds, changing direction and driving the sheep the other way.

Mage In Simple Clothes.name:
朴素便装的法师
Mage In Simple Clothes

Text.text:
这女人的衣着朴素，却在那份实用里透出明确的用途：结实的靴子、耐磨的绑腿、无袖的合身上衣以免碍事，腰间还挂着两个小袋——每一个想必都塞满了法术材料。她不带任何武器，但站姿里有种从容自信，仿佛随时能从虚空里扯出烈焰，并在一瞬间唤来护甲。
The woman’s clothes are simple but their very practicality hints at a purpose: good boots, durable leggings, a fitted shirt with no sleeves to get in the way, and two hip pouches—each no doubt filled with spell components. She carries no weapons but her posture has the confidence of someone who can pull fire from thin air and summon armor at an instant.

Hayliel Beleseul.name:
海莉埃尔·贝勒瑟尔
Hayliel Beleseul

Text.text:
一个身影踉跄向前，她颤抖的呼吸不止诉说着疼痛，更裹挟着无边的哀恸。那原本看似巨大斗篷的阴影，此刻清晰显露为一对展开足有十二英尺的巨翼。白羽破败不堪，皱褶纠结，被黑红的血污黏得一绺一绺。她费力抬起头，露出一张因痛苦而扭曲的、近似精灵的面孔。肌肤是榛果般的红褐色，双眼亦有同样浓郁的色泽，却因极度疲惫而蒙上一层失焦的光。黑色的辫发垂落肩头，许多丝缎般的发束已从绑绳中扯断散开。她双手握着一柄折断的长柄刀的两截，刃头已从长杆上崩裂脱落。那扇形刀刃银光冷冽，形状宛如一片倒翻的鹰翼。

~ 由一位英雄 扮演

A figure stumbles forward, the shuddering of their breath indicating not only pain but also an immense sorrow. The shadow of what seemed to be a large cloak is clearly revealed to be a pair of vast wings, twelve feet across. The white feathers are ragged, crumpled, and matted with ichor. The figure raises her head with effort, revealing a grimacing elf-like face. Her skin is the red-brown of hazelnuts, and her eyes are similarly rich in hue though glazed by exhaustion. Her black, braided hair dangles over her shoulder, many of the silken strands torn free from their ties. In her hands she holds the two ends of a broken glaive, the head snapped free from the pole. The fanned blade shines as bright as silver, its shape reminiscent of an upturned eagle wing.

~ Played by a Hero

Bastien's Tunisian Vestments.name:
巴斯蒂安的突尼斯礼服
Bastien's Tunisian Vestments

Text.text:
这家店里的衣服贵得离谱，可巴斯蒂安偶尔会报出一个好得离奇、好得令人起疑的价格。铺子里多是沙漠风的衣物：轻薄亚麻与埃及棉。角落里还堆着一片带着霉味的长袍，他说那是“给盎格鲁人和其他野蛮人穿的”。传言这些袍子根本没在那儿垂挂几十年——昂贵、令人作呕、无人问津——但私语却说，一旦有哪件长袍越过海峡，它不仅会恢复得洁净如新，还会显露出一项由巴斯蒂安亲手织进布里的魔法能力。
The clothes in this shop are wildly overpriced, but sometimes Bastien offers a surprisingly, suspiciously, great price. The clothing is mostly of the desert variety: light linen and Egyptian cotton. There is a section of musty robes he says are “for the Angles and other barbarians.” Rumor has it the robes haven’t actually drooped there for decades—expensive, repulsive, and unbought—rather the whispers suggest that once one of the robes crosses the Channel, it not only restores itself to pristine condition but also demonstrates a magical ability woven into it by Bastien himself.

Gem Of Brightness.name:
光辉宝石
Gem Of Brightness

Text.text:
这枚多面切割的宝石在柔和的内蕴光辉中闪烁，棱角分明的表面在接触时传来令人舒适的温暖。宝石周围萦绕着一阵细微的嗡鸣，仿佛在低声歌唱，静候着将自己的光芒分享给世界。
This faceted gemstone glimmers with a soft internal radiance, its angular surfaces pleasantly warm to the touch. A subtle hum surrounds the gem, as if it is singing, waiting to share its light with the world.

Cave Painting Of Mustachios And Pith Hat.name:
胡子与遮阳盔的洞穴壁画
Cave Painting Of Mustachios And Pith Hats

Text.text:
你审视着这幅诡异的洞窟壁画，确信这画里必定有哪里出了错。岩壁上随意涂抹的图像呈现在你眼前：一群身影围拢着一队外来者——以人物身上所用的彩色黏土作记号——可这批新来的却被画上了怪异的武器与服饰。旅人身后，一片圆形的空洞被旋涂成盘旋的紫色线条，仿佛在无声地吞噬光影。
You scrutinize the strange cave painting, sure that there must be some mistake in the artwork. Before you, daubed on the rock, you see figures gathered around a group of outsiders—denoted by the colored clay used for the characters—but the new group is painted with strange weapons and dress. Behind the travelers, a circular void has been painted in swirling purple lines.

An Infernal Knight Appears.name:
一名炼狱骑士现身
An Infernal Knight Appears

Text.text:
它踏着传送门硫磺般刺鼻的恶臭走出——一名来自地狱的魔裔骑士。它披覆着由烟与残躯铸成的护甲，浸透酷刑与绝望。骑士摆开战姿，双脚分立，面孔扭曲成一副阴狠的面具，带着残忍快意的狞笑，将沉重的武器高高举起。那恶魔仿佛刀枪不入，散发着其恐怖位面的气息，宛如一处吞噬万物的虚无——所有善意与怜悯都被拖入其中，碾碎殆尽。

~ 构想：Camel

Through the brimstone reek of the portal, it steps, a fiendish knight from the hells. It bears armor of smoke and carcass, torture and despair. The knight prepares itself for battle, its feet planted apart and its face a twisted and sinister mask of vicious pleasure as it brings a heavy weapon up. The demon seems impermeable, emanating the energy of its horrible plane, acting as a void into which all goodness or sympathy have been drawn and destroyed.

~ Envisioned by Camel

那平民步伐迟疑，浑身不安。双手颤抖着摸索支撑，勉强让自己站稳。他们咳嗽不止，呼吸艰涩，带着嘶哑的喘鸣。黏液自鼻端滴落。他们踉跄几步，终于失去平衡，摔倒在地。
The commoner moves with a hesitance, an unease. Their hands tremble as they find purchase to hold themselves upright. They cough, their breath labored and wheezing. Mucus drips from their nose. They stumble, toppling over.

Super-volcano Eruption Viewed From Orbit.name:
从轨道俯瞰的超级火山大喷发
Super-volcano Eruption Viewed From Orbit

Text.text:
它起初只是行星表面上一点针尖般的微光，远在下方。有那么一瞬间，翻涌的烟云遮蔽了最初的喷发，微光几乎消失不见。但熔岩迅速铺展开来，在地表奔涌蔓延，直到那点针光扩张成一整片猩红发亮的光幕，撕裂并玷污了整颗行星。
It starts as a pinprick of light on the planet's surface, far below. For a moment, it almost disappears as a billowing cloud of smoke covers the initial eruption. But the lava spreads rapidly, moving across the surface until the pinprick has grown into a glowing sheet of red, marring the planet.

Wild Magic Surge: Sobriety.name:
狂野魔法涌动：清醒
Wild Magic Surge: Sobriety

Text.text:
你法术的奥术残渣沉入体内。你几乎能感觉到魔法在血脉中奔涌，洗涤着你的内脏。你莫名被灌注了一种自信：就算把酒馆里最能喝的酒鬼都灌趴在桌下，你也仍能保持清醒。
The arcane dregs of your spell sink into your body. You can almost feel the magic flow through your bloodstream, cleansing your internal organs. You are inexplicably instilled with the confidence that you could drink even the most robust barfly under the table and remain sober.

Mouthpiece For An Insectile Hive Mind.name:
虫群蜂巢心智的传声筒
Mouthpiece For An Insectile Hive Mind

Text.text:
异形的眼珠向上翻白，蜂巢心智接管了躯壳，借它的眼口说话，宛如活生生的傀儡。宿主的四肢骤然僵硬，神经系统被群体意识劫持，下颌因不适而紧咬。它的嗓音变得更低沉、更浑厚，仿佛正跨越幽深的巨大空洞传递讯息。
The alien’s eyes roll back as the hivemind assumes control, speaking through them like a living puppet. The host’s limbs go rigid as their nervous system is hijacked by the gestalt consciousness, their jaw clenching in discomfort. Their voice becomes deeper, more resonant, like they are communicating across a cavernous expanse.

Beasthide Bard Protector.name:
兽皮吟游守护者
Beasthide Bard Protector

Text.text:
你在马鞍上打量着对手。你看出其中一人的步态——只要你烙下毫不动摇的印记，就能轻易让他失衡。另一个趾高气扬、又蠢又愣，正适合来一记令人火冒三丈的嘲讽。对，他们很快都会朝你冲来。你翻身下马，扭了扭脖子，护甲之下皮肤一阵发麻——像有什么在你皮下爬行，顺着肌理向上蔓延，覆上你的脸。你咧嘴一笑，用犬齿在指尖划出一滴血，抬手指向那些敌人，施放bane。那一张张自鸣得意的脸顿时浮起迟疑，你还哼起了一段小调。

~ 由 Colby Poulson 在 Played 上演，来自 d4: D&D Deep Dive

From the saddle you observe your opponents. You spot the walk of one you can easily upset with an unwavering mark. Another, cocky and doltish, is ready for an infuriating taunt. Yeah, they'll all be rushing you soon. You dismount, stretch your neck, and beneath your armor your hide prickles—crawling up your skin to cover your face. You smile, nick your finger on a canine for a drop of blood, point at your foes, and cast bane. The smug faces fall into doubt, and you hum a little tune.

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

尽管长着皮革般的翼膜，这只蝙蝠却因那双又大又圆的眼睛与一身短绒毛，比起鸟类更像一只小狗或老鼠。它那分叉的鼻端在空气中嗅探，仿佛要辨明你究竟是朋友，还是敌人。
In spite of its leather-like wings, the bat, with its large round eyes and its short fur, resembles a dog or a rat more closely than a bird. The split nose of the small mammal sniffs at the air as if to determine whether you are its friend or a foe.

Request Of Eternal Servitude From A Poss.name:
被附身山羊提出的永恒奴役请求
Request Of Eternal Servitude From A Possessed Goat

Text.text:
“我赐你挣脱凡俗镣铐的自由，但这般恩赐必以牺牲相偿。你将献我鲜血与敬拜……或许还要带我去一片长草漫腰的原野？顺带一提，我耳后正有一阵地狱般的痒，你得用指甲替我挠个痛快，把它彻底驱散。”
“I offer you freedom from your mortal shackles, but such gifts demand sacrifice. You will give me blood and reverence… and perhaps take me to a field where the grass grows long? And while we’re at it, I have an infernal itch just behind my ear that you must purge with scratches.”

Nas Naur, Fire Elemental Island.name:
纳斯·瑙尔，火元素之岛
Nas Naur, Fire Elemental Island

Text.text:
透过温暖的薄雾，能看见黑暗而嶙峋的岩石怪影。橙色的光辉与嘶嘶作响的声息充塞在空气里。越靠近海浪轻拍之处，雾霭越显稀薄——那里有一座渣锥从浪间拔起，宽阔而低矮，岩浆沿着平缓的坡面缓缓渗流而下。黏滞的熔岩先在洼地里聚成迟缓的池沼，继而再向外漫流。破碎的破火山口壁有一段被炸飞，令那前方炽烈的火口一览无遗，也给通往其中的道路敞开了。

~ 由 Josh Murphy Envisioned

Dark, jagged rock formations are visible through a warm mist. An orange glow and a hissing sound pervade the air. The haze thins closer to where a cinder cone rises from the lapping surf—wide and low, magma oozing down its gradual slopes. The sluggish lava pools in hollows before flowing on. Part of the caldera wall has been blown away, providing an easy view of, and path to, the fiery crater beyond.

~ Envisioned by Josh Murphy

Jeanique Markel.name:
珍妮克·马尔克尔
Jeanique Markel

Text.text:
伤疤纵横交错，爬满这名高大的女人乌檀般的肌肤——从光秃的头顶一路延伸到小腿肚。她身上的硬皮胸甲、护臂、腰侧甲裙与靴子也刻着相似的伤痕。护甲内衬着细密的灰色短毛，一件同样由兽皮缝成的披风覆在她肩头，垂落至脚踝。她背负着一把又长又沉的剑。她的骨架与筋肉看上去足以驾驭这样的武器，但她的左臂在肩下不远处便戛然而止。

~ Played by Minoru

Scars crisscross this towering woman’s ebony skin, from the top of her hairless head to her calves. The hardened leather cuirass, bracers, waist tassets, and boots she wears bear similar marks. Fine gray fur lines the armor, and a cloak of similar pelts swathes her shoulders, hanging to her ankles. She bears a long, heavy sword on her back. Her frame and thews seem well able to handle such a weapon, but her left arm ends just below the shoulder.

~ Played by Minoru

Transformation Of An Ancient Dragon.name:
远古巨龙的蜕变
Transformation Of An Ancient Dragon

Text.text:
精灵随手将一绺焦橙色的乱发拨到一旁，露出一双几乎带着金属光泽的眼睛。那轻松、歪斜的笑意尚未散去，变化便已开始。精灵长大——起初几乎察觉不到，旋即光芒猛然暴涨，火花如雨四溅。四肢拉长，鳞片覆上被阳光烘成古铜的肌肤，一声雄浑咆哮撕裂寂静。那身影迸发的光亮令人短暂失明，随后渐渐褪去，显露出原本站立之处：一条覆满青铜鳞片的巨龙。尽管巨兽体型骇人，它的气息却友善而亲近，仿佛在欢迎来客。龙角自颅顶隆起，向后弯曲；鳞片上刻出的奥术符文滋滋作响，像将要溢出的闪电被勉强束缚在其中。

~ 构想：The Dreaded DM

The elf tosses a shock of burnt orange hair aside, revealing eyes that gleam with an almost metallic sheen. An easy, lopsided smile precedes the transformation. The elf grows—imperceptibly at first, then suddenly with a surge of light and a shower of sparks. Limbs elongate, scales enshroud sun-bronzed skin, and a mighty roar splits the silence. The light emanating from the figure blinds momentarily, before fading to reveal a massive, bronze-scaled dragon where the elf once stood. Despite the beast’s immense size, its aura is friendly, welcoming. Horns crest the dragon’s skull, curving backward, and arcane runes carved into scales sizzle with barely contained lightning.

~ Envisioned by The Dreaded DM

清凉的薄荷膏抚平你牙龈里那阵钝痛，恰到好处，让你得以把它忘掉——至少能忘上一会儿。那团黏稠的绿色糊状物看起来不起眼，可对你而言，它却是必需的慰藉与解脱：从一种大多数人很少真正经历、甚至很少想起的疼痛里暂时脱身——除非他们咬到一口硬邦邦的甜面包卷，或是在酒吧斗殴里挨了拳头。

~ 构想：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The cool menthol balm soothes the dull ache in your gums just enough for you to forget it—for a while, at least. The stodgy green paste may not look like much, but to you it offers needed succor and release from a pain most people rarely experience—or think about—unless they bite into a hard sweet roll or get into a bar fight.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Futuristic Fast-food Outlet.name:
未来风快餐店
Futuristic Fast-food Outlet

Text.text:
一阵可被勉强称作音乐的喧嚣——但对你这种族而言绝非如此——灌满了这间霓虹闪烁的小店。空气里漂着油脂与煎炸食物的香气，还有几缕勾人却说不上名的怪异香料味，牵引着你走向一侧的电子柜台。可对那些已经下单的人而言，真正的焦点在中央：一名多臂厨师正忙得不可开交，紫色触须般的肢体在空中翻涌盘旋，刀起刀落间同时切、撒、煎、盛，把柜上那些诱人的美味珍馐一份份端出。
The blare of what could be described as music—but not to your species—fills the small neon-lit emporium. An aroma of oils, frying foods, and tantalizing, odd spices you can't quite place drifts through the air, pulling you toward the electronic counter to the side. Yet, the center of attention to those who already placed their orders is a multiarmed cook, whose purplish tentacle-like limbs swirl in the air as they simultaneously chop, season, fry, and serve the delectable treasures on offer.

Corporate Gum, Corpcandy.name:
企业口香糖，企业糖果
Corporate Gum, Corpcandy

Text.text:
亮粉色的包装像炸开般迸出一簇卡通徽标。各式源流的书法点缀着这款人气商品，手感如缎，接触时滑润柔顺。打开后，口香糖以整齐的缎带扭结弹出。咀嚼之际，一股辛爽直冲喉后，能量奔涌上行，直窜脑海。糖果留下鲜明的印记，将食用者的牙齿染成霓虹万花筒般的色彩。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Bright pink packaging bursts with a collection of cartoon logos. Calligraphy of all different origins decorates this popular product, which feels like satin to the touch. Inside, the gum pops out in a neat ribbon twist. Upon chewing, a rush of zest hits the back of the throat, coursing energy up into the brain. The candy leaves its mark, staining the user’s teeth a kaleidoscope of neon colors.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

No-nonsense Building Contractor.name:
不讲废话的建筑承包商
No-nonsense Building Contractor

Text.text:
她的下颌绷得像花岗岩地基般坚硬，双臂交叠，稳如桥梁。发丝被紧紧束在明亮的黄色安全帽下，腰间垂着一条沉甸甸的工具腰带，塞满各式工具与小装置。她以精明而审视的目光打量着你，你隐约感觉到，她绝不容忍有人浪费她的时代。
The woman’s jaw is set like a granite foundation, her crossed arms as sturdy as any bridge. Her hair is bunched tightly below a luminous yellow hard hat, and a weighty belt hangs from her waist, filled with all manner of tools and gadgets. As she regards you with a shrewd, appraising gaze, you get the sense she doesn’t take kindly to those who waste her time.

他俯视着自己目标的尸体，男人阴沉着脸，咯吱咯吱地啃着苹果，活像一头被冒犯的倔骡。他抬脚狠狠干了尸体一下，随后垂头丧气地在旁边的木桶上坐下。从外套里抽出一卷羊皮纸，他愤怒地把一个名字——以及他们本该死去的日期——狠狠划掉。为什么他们非得主动来找他？当目标变得大胆——或者愚蠢——合约总会因此变得麻烦。

~ 构想：Ameria，发布于 Discord

Looking down at the corpse of his target the man scowls, crunching through an apple like an indignant mule. He gives the body a firm kick, then sits dejectedly on a nearby barrel. Unfurling a scroll from his jacket he crosses out a name—and the date they were supposed to die—with outrage. Why did they have to come looking for him? It always complicated contracts when the target got brave—or stupid.

~ Envisioned by Ameria on Discord

Secret Smuggler's Warehouse.name:
秘密走私者的仓库
Secret Smuggler's Warehouse

Text.text:
这座摇摇欲坠的仓库几乎从不引人侧目，但今晚却有些不同。蒙尘的窗格后起初像幽影般有动静：朦胧的黑影从一块窗玻璃漂到另一块。可木头刮擦石面的刺响、车轮吱呀的呻吟，以及压低的耳语声，都在暗示那是再寻常不过的行动……又或者，是见不得光的勾当。
This ramshackle warehouse hardly ever gets a passing glance, but tonight something is different. Activity within the clouded windows seems spectral at first: shadowed shapes floating from pane to pane. Yet the scraping of wood against stone, the creaking of wheels, and the hushed whispers suggest activities mundane… or perhaps illicit.

Magical Stone Circle: Spooky Whispers.name:
魔法石环：阴森低语
Magical Stone Circle: Spooky Whispers

Text.text:
这圈竖立的巨石蕴藏着力量。不知以何种方式，它在此汇聚，被从群山彼端牵引而来，注入这些立石之中。你能感觉到它从你身旁掠过，如同一阵风。它拽动你身上的汗毛，甚至隔着衣物也不放过。可被困在这里的，远不止魔法。风的低语里夹带着仿佛人声的回响。难道连灵魂也一并囚在此处？
This circle of standing stones holds power. It gathers here somehow, drawn into the menhirs from beyond the mountain. You feel its passage by you like a wind. It pulls at the hairs on your body, even under your clothes. But something more than magic has been trapped here. The whisper of the wind carries what sounds like voices. Could souls be trapped here as well?

Giant And Halfling Comparing Weapons.name:
巨人与半身人比对武器
Giant And Halfling Comparing Weapons

Text.text:
两人正吵得面红耳赤，完全没注意到你已经走近。体型更大的那位，几米高的一团肉山般耸立着，却为了照顾他那袖珍同伴而弯腰佝偻。另一位又矮又圆，像个塞满馅的肉派；圆脸红润，带着那种沉醉于美食佳酿之人的光泽。他们正比着武器，嗓门震天，硬说自己的那把更大。可真相是：巨人的匕首与半身人的巨剑，其实体型一模一样。

~ Naelynn 于 Discord

Engaged in heated discussion, the pair are quite oblivious to your arrival. The larger of the two is a mountain of flesh several meters tall, though he is stooped to accommodate his diminutive companion. The second is small and rotund like a potpie, his round face bearing the ruddy complexion of one who delights in fine food and wine. They are comparing weapons, loudly declaring theirs to be the larger of the two. In reality, both the giant's dagger and the halfling's greatsword are the same size.

~ Naelynn on Discord

军官们的床铺一张张以军纪般的精准铺就，沿着房间四周等距摆放。每张床脚处都放着一只抛光的木箱——用沉重的挂锁牢牢扣住——像忠实的猎犬般守在旁边。室内干净而简朴，陈设一目了然：实用压过舒适。
The officers’ beds, each made with military precision, are spaced evenly around the room. At the foot of each, a polished wooden box—secured with a heavy padlock—rests like a faithful hound. The room is clean and sparse, clearly arranged for practicality over comfort.

I Am Struck By A Blade.name:
我被利刃所伤
I Am Struck By A Blade

Text.text:
我感觉剑锋擦中我，刀刃利落地横切过血肉。暗红的鲜血从伤口汩汩涌出，浸透了我的皮肤与衣装。随着生命之血的流失，我的头脑一阵发轻，尚未来得及稳住身形、继续战斗，眼前的世界便已化作一片模糊。
I feel the edge of the sword catch me, the blade slicing clean across flesh. Dark red blood pours out of the wound, soaking my skin and garb. My head grows light with the loss of lifeblood, and the world becomes a blur before I have a chance to steady myself and continue the fight.

I Use Eldritch Master.name:
我施展《异界主宰》
I Use Eldritch Master

Text.text:
我站起身，双臂张开，目光投向远处的虚空。说话间念出我宗主的名讳，我祈求力量重燃。我低下头，恭敬地细述那些遵照契约完成的事迹。我抬起双眼，也抬高声音，骄傲地宣告那些超越字面约定的作为。我再次说话，唤出我宗主的名字，不再请求。“把力量给我！”
I stand, arms outstretched, gazing into the middle distance. Speaking my patron’s name, I ask for renewed power. I bow my head, and respectfully relate deeds done in accord with my pact. I raise my eyes and my voice. Proudly, I declare the acts that go beyond the letter of my agreement. I speak my patron’s name again, no longer asking. “Give me the power!”

你跨过门槛，发现自己置身于一间一尘不染的屋子。厨房干净得发亮，连一条茶巾都没有放错位置。每一处表面都被掸净抛光，崭新般熠熠生辉。书架上的书像列队的文学士兵般笔直站立，按体型与色调整齐排开。屋主客气地请你把靴子脱掉。
You step over the threshold and find yourself in a home meticulously clean. The kitchen is spotless, with nary a tea towel out of place. Each surface, dusted and polished, gleams like new. Books stand in their shelves lined up like literary soldiers, ordered by size and shade. The owner asks you nicely to take off your boots.

Village Built On An Older Townsite.name:
建在旧镇遗址上的村庄
Village Built On An Older Townsite

Text.text:
这座蔓延开来的小镇由朴素结实的原木小屋与泥泞街道拼成。它建在一座更古老城市的废墟之间，甚至覆在其上——那座旧城的大部分早已被时代蚕食殆尽。镇民多是粗壮的劳工，早已习惯乡野更艰苦的生活。淘金者推着独轮车在工地与镇上来回奔走，背上斜挂着鹤嘴锄。伐木工从周围森林里运来木材，那片林子仍充满野生生灵与迷离的谜影。农夫在田里埋头苦干，活计总像永远也做不完。

~ Bangalulu 构想

The sprawling town is made up of simple, sturdy log cabins and muddy streets. It has been built among, and over, the ruins of a much older city—most of which has wasted away with time. Many of the townspeople are hard laborers accustomed to the rougher living of the countryside. Prospectors haul wheelbarrows to and from their sites, picks slung across their backs. Loggers gather the lumber from the surrounding forest, which is still full of wildlife and mystery. And farmers toil away in their fields, their work never quite done.

~ Envisioned by Bangalulu

这道法术在触碰目标前的最后一个手势，如同撒出一张网，而从某种意义上说，这正是它的效果。自魔法织纹中抽出的发光纤维短暂浮现，交织缠绕，宛如一面蛛网之墙。这些蓝白色的细丝转瞬即逝，被牵引贴覆在身躯之上，像护甲般将其守护。
The final gesture of this spell before touching the target is like casting a net, and in some sense that is its effect. Glowing fibers drawn from the weave of magic briefly appear to enmesh and entwine, like a wall of webs. These blue-white filaments swiftly vanish, drawn onto the body where they protect it like armor.

Greeting From A Sketchy Spaceport.name:
来自可疑太空港的问候
Greeting From A Sketchy Spaceport

Text.text:
“对接程序期间，请将所有武器与弹药妥善收起。一并提醒：对接费用已包含所有贿赂款项，但可能在未提前通知或征得同意的情况下随时变更。”
“Please keep all weapons and munitions stowed during docking procedures. A reminder that docking fees come with all bribes included, though they are subject to change without warning or consent.”

Ruins Of Artificer City.name:
工匠师之城的废墟
Ruins Of Artificer City

Text.text:
废墟铺展在一座宽阔的碗状山谷里，四周是嶙峋的丘陵，岩石般的山体上密密麻麻布满矿井的黑口。铺着卵石却被杂草噎住的道路自北、南、东、西蜿蜒而来，最终汇入城市那道金属与石砌的城墙——其轮廓宛如一枚巨齿轮——巨大的城门洞开，无人把守，像是在邀请任何人踏入那一格格棋盘般的街道。寂静的小巷里漂浮着各种色泽的蒸汽，如幽魂游荡；有些甚至逆着微风滑行。所有主干大道都像巨轮的辐条一般旅行，通向城中心的一座高塔。这座龟裂的建筑渗漏着液体与雾气，塔基堆满碎石，宛如崩落的碎屑坡；尽管塔顶处有一道锯齿般的断裂，那里一簇五彩火焰正跳动不息，它仍刺破低垂的云层。

~ Envisioned by DMDragon

The ruins spread across a broad, bowl-shaped valley surrounded by rugged hills, their stony faces pierced with the mouths of countless mines. Cobbled but weed-choked roads wind in from north, south, east, and west. They meet at the city’s metal and stone wall—which forms the outline of a titanic cog—where great gates yawn, unguarded, inviting anyone into the gridded streets. Vapors of various hues drift in the silent lanes like wraiths. Some move against the breeze. All the main avenues travel, like spokes in a great wheel, toward a tower in the city center. This cracked edifice, leaking fluid and mist, and with rubble strewn at its base like scree, pierces the low-slung clouds despite the jagged break in its top where a multicolored flame dances.

~ Envisioned by DMDragon

他抬手将一缕不听话的发丝从眼前拂开，那瘦削的身影裹在晦暗的皮制护甲里，顺势调整了火枪的握持。动作熟稔地将枪管斜搭在右肩，左手轻抚山羊胡，尽管神情疏离，目光仍在四周游移，悄然审视着环境。

~ 由 Alice 扮演

Brushing back an errant lock from his eyes, the slight figure in darkened leather armor shifts his grip on his musket. He leans the barrel across his right shoulder in a practiced motion. With his left hand he strokes his goatee, gaze flickering over his surroundings despite his aloof expression.

~ Played by Alice

Rigger Auto And Drone Shop.name:
驾驶员改装与无人机工坊
Rigger Auto And Drone Shop

Text.text:
在涂满涂鸦的卷帘门下，一排排半成品机器一路延伸到远方。有些硬件来头不小——警用级无人机、改得火力十足的跑车——你甚至看见天花板上吊着一根被剥得精光、掏空内里的坦克炮管。各式各样的工具被钉在墙上，密密麻麻。穿着脏兮兮工装的人影来回游荡；每个工人的钢质脑干上都垂着加固线束，末端接着丑陋的碳质插头。有个装配工倒挂在椽梁间，把头部接口插进那根坦克炮管。下一瞬，巨大的武器骤然苏醒，迸出沉雄轰鸣，震得空气发颤。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Under graffiti-marked shutters, rows of half-built machines stretch off into the distance. Some of the hardware is serious stuff—police-grade drones and souped-up cars—and you even spot, suspended from the ceiling, a stripped and gutted tank barrel. Numerous tools of every description are nailed to the walls. Figures clad in dirty overalls meander back and forth; reinforced wiring dangles from each worker’s steel brain stem, ending in ugly carbon plugs. One rigger hangs from the rafters, plugging his headjack into the tank barrel. Suddenly, the colossal weapon flares to life, emitting a great sonorous roar.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

它尖叫着拍动皮革般的翅膀，从头顶掠过；那蝙蝠在渐盈的月光前投下剪影，仿佛迫不及待要捕捉一只掠过的飞蛾。它兴奋地吱吱作响，迅速逼近那倒霉的小虫，小小的颌张得大大，等待一顿丰盛美餐。
Shrieking as it darts overhead on leathery wings, the bat silhouetted against the waxing moon seems eager to catch a passing moth. It chitters excitedly as it closes on the unfortunate insect, tiny jaws wide in anticipation of a sumptuous meal.

Strip Club With Questionable Clientele.name:
客源成谜的脱衣舞俱乐部
Strip Club With Questionable Clientele

Text.text:
一块嗡嗡作响的霓虹招牌上，描绘着摆出撩人姿势的舞者，正迎接着一群鱼龙混杂的客人踏入脱衣舞俱乐部。门口那座由血肉与肌肉堆砌成的“山”戴着时髦的遮阳镜，阴沉地盯着可能惹事的人，警告意味不言而喻。里头传来砰砰作响的音乐与此起彼伏的喝彩声，酒客们用喧嚣表达着对眼前诱惑的赏识。
A buzzing neon sign depicting a provocatively posed dancer welcomes a seedy clientele to the strip club. The mountain of flesh and muscle guarding the door glowers at potential troublemakers over a stylish visor, the intent clear. Thumping music and cheering can be heard from inside as punters show their appreciation for the temptations on offer.

Headstone: “Which” In Winter.name:
墓碑：“哪一块”于冬季
Headstone: “Which” In Winter

Text.text: 这座覆雪的坟冢看起来与周遭别无二致。墓碑上刻着一句疑问：你会选择什么——漫长的一生，还是精彩的一生？ This snow-covered grave looks much like the others. Its headstone asks a question: Which would you choose, a long life or a good one?

Giant's Storeroom.name:
巨人的储藏室
Giant's Storeroom

Text.text:
高耸的厅室里，巨大的橡木书架自地面直抵天花板，层层堆满沉重的木箱与形状怪异的石块。武器——如小树般粗大的重棍、以巨石为槌头的短棒、以及以黑曜石为锋的长矛——与一旁的奇异工具一同挂在墙上：或用于锻造、采掘，或另有用途，你一时难以揣测。
The massive, oaken shelves span from floor to ceiling in the soaring room, laden with heavy crates and odd-shaped stones. Weapons—heavy clubs the size of small trees, cudgels topped with boulders, and spears tipped with obsidian—hang against the wall beside strange tools: for crafting, mining, or other purposes, you can't surmise.

欢饰的屋舍沿着蜿蜒小径层层跌落，粉刷成白、在阳光下耀眼夺目，最终挤满了避风的海湾四周。紧密的茅草屋顶高高托起用稻草扎成的兽形饰物，墙面则绘着鸟与鱼的图案，尤以窗棂与门框周边最为醒目。倘若这里的日子并不快乐，人们也把它装点得像极了快乐。
Gaily decorated homes, whitewashed and brilliant in the sun, tumble down a winding pathway to crowd around the sheltered bay. Tightly thatched roofs hold aloft animal shapes made from straw, while building walls bear images of birds and fish, particularly about windows and doors. If life is not happy here, the people make a good show of it.

Arrival In The City Of Kari.name:
抵达卡里城
Arrival In The City Of Kari

Text.text:
缤纷的灯笼在湖面上成片漂流，耀目如织，将水色染成虹彩斑斓；港湾里，一艘艘修长雅致的长舟轻轻起伏，似在静观庆典，花纹繁复的帆收拢如翼。夕阳将一座宏伟的神庙勾勒成剪影，那巍峨殿宇如警醒的守护者般俯瞰全城；下方装点华丽、熙攘喧闹的街巷里，成群的龙裔类人挤满人潮。空气里跃动着欢快的乐声，百般本地佳肴的香气从小吃摊间飘来，诱人得令人难以抗拒。

~ 由 Markus the Felled King Envisioned

Colorful lanterns drift upon the lake in a dazzling swathe, painting the waters in prismatic hues, while elegant longboats bob gently in the harbor observing the festivities, their patterned sails folded like wings. A large temple is silhouetted by the setting sun, the grand building towering over the city like a watchful guardian, and throngs of draconic humanoids fill the bustling, decorated streets below. The air is alive with upbeat music, and the scents of a hundred local dishes drift temptingly from food stalls.

~ Envisioned by Markus the Felled King

Dumpster Fire Elemental.name:
垃圾箱火焰元素
Dumpster Fire Elemental

Text.text:
焚烧垃圾的恶臭在一场硫磺般的爆炸中轰然迸发，垃圾箱的铁壁鼓胀外凸。小巷里四散的秽物接连燃起，鼠群惊惧尖叫，仓皇遁入夜色，只求逃离正在融化的混凝土与令人窒息的浓烟——而一抹灵体正从火焰深处步步逼近。

~ 由 Discord 上的 Murmur 构想

The smell of burning refuse ignites in a sulfurous explosion as the dumpster’s walls balloon outward. The scattered garbage of the alleyway combusts, and rodents shriek in fear as they flee into the night, desperate to escape the melting concrete and choking smoke as a spirit advances from within the flames.

~ Envisioned by Murmur on Discord

Nacreous Clouds In The Sky.name:
天空中的珠光云
Nacreous Clouds In The Sky

Text.text:
你眺望着绚丽多彩的地平线，得以在片刻间忘却刺骨冰冷的寒气；天际线宛如一幅印象派画作，仿佛苍穹本身就是艺术家挥洒的画布。
Your view of the varicolored horizon allows you to momentarily ignore the cruel bite of the freezing cold air, the skyline resembling an impressionist painting wherein the firmament itself is the artist’s canvas.

I Cast Insect Plague Using A Divine Focu.name:
我用一件神圣法器物品施放虫群瘟疫
I Cast Insect Plague Using A Divine Focus Item

Text.text:
如同旧日的神罚瘟疫，我以神圣法器引来神祇狂暴的怒涛，在施展之际献上一句谦卑的祈祷。可怖的嗡鸣骤然充塞空气，我伸出指控的手指直指敌人，将其标记为神圣报应的目标；霎时间，虫群在他们周身爆裂般苏醒，化作一片啮咬蜇刺的翻涌毒云。
Like the divine plagues of old, I summon the tempestuous wrath of the gods through my divine focus, offering a humble prayer as I do so. A terrible buzzing fills the air as I point an accusing finger toward my foe, marking them for divine retribution, and insects burst into swarming life around them in a biting, stinging cloud.

当女法师施放她的法术时，一抹炫目的翠绿光芒点燃了她的双眼；自紧握的拳头处，翡翠般的晶体开始疯长，层层蔓延，包裹住她的前臂。她以缓慢而严谨的节奏吟诵力量之词，仿佛铁匠的锤击落在砧上，专注始终不曾动摇。她身周的符文泛起病态的绿光，随着魔法不断堆叠而愈发刺目，如同增幅器般放大施法者的咒语。
A scintillating green glow ignites the mage’s eyes as she casts her spell, and jade begins to grow from a clenched fist to envelop her forearm. She intones the words of power with slow, methodical rhythm, like a blacksmith’s strike upon their anvil, her focus never wavering. The runes about her person glow with a sickly green light as the magic builds, acting as amplifiers for the caster’s incantation.

它显现为一粒黑暗的微尘，嘶嘶作响，噼啪迸裂。斑点一旦具现，世界便呻吟扭曲——像一面畸形镜中映出的悖谬倒影。心智为之眩晕。感官从这片空间中的缺席、这不断扩张的虚空中本能退缩。物体缓慢朝那墨色幽晦滑去。随着它旋转膨胀，越发清晰的是：在这无物之中，栖居着一抹恶意的意识。凡被它触及之物，皆不复存在。

~ 由一位英雄构想

It appears as a mote of darkness, hissing and popping. When the spot manifests, the world groans and twists—a perverse image in a malformed mirror. The mind reels. Senses recoil from this absence in space, this growing void. Objects move slowly toward the inky gloom. That a malign awareness exists within the nothingness becomes more apparent as it spirals and grows. Anything it touches ceases to be.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Use My Ethereal Casting Hand.name:
我用我虚无的施法之手
I Use My Ethereal Casting Hand

Text.text:
幽影般的手指翩然起舞——我施放法术时，它们编织出奥秘的纹路——不再背负血肉与骨骼的重量。尽管虚无缥缈，那只手却像是我本身的一部分，是我奥术意志的具象延伸。它以令人惊叹的精确度行动，每一个手势都分毫不差，只为引导那看不见的世界里翻涌沸腾的巫术能量。

~ 构想：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Ghostly fingers dance—weaving arcane patterns as I cast the spell—unburdened by the weight of flesh, blood, and bone. Though ethereal, the hand feels a part of my being, an extension of my arcane will made manifest. It moves with incredible precision, each gesture perfectly executed to channel the roiling, sorcerous energies of the unseen world.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Supply Convoy Ambushed On Highway.name:
公路上的补给车队遭到伏击
Supply Convoy Ambushed On Highway

Text.text:
一支小型车队在高速公路上拥挤的路段里蜿蜒前行。忽然，几辆改装卡车猛地逼上来，将车队车辆团团夹住；蒙面人举起各式武器指向车队：突击武器噼啪连响，在车身上凿出密密麻麻的弹孔；脉冲枪则喷吐出离子能量的幽光。车队护卫立刻还以颜色，车顶机枪率先咆哮，一轮齐射将其中一辆袭击卡车撕得支离破碎。一个劫匪朝最近的车队车辆甩出抓钩。左侧卡车上，喷火器先是嘶嘶作响，随即轰然点燃，黄色火流如洪水般倾泻而出，瞬间将两名护卫吞没。
A small convoy winds its way through a crowded spot on the highway. Suddenly, souped-up trucks box in the convoy vehicles and masked figures level an assortment of weaponry: assault weapons create bullet holes while pulse guns unleash ionic energy. The convoy guards return in kind, opening with a salvo from a roof-mounted machine gun that tears up one of the attacking trucks. A hijacker swings a grappling hook at the nearest convoy vehicle. From the left-side truck, a flamethrower sputters and roars to life, dousing two guards in a torrent of yellow flame.

一枚圣徽被刻在这只小小的玻璃瓶上。瓶中隐隐散出令人安心的暖意，轻轻晃动时，液体里便会有点点光屑一闪即逝。你将它塞进背包，瓶身分量恰到好处，握在手里令人愉悦，你为这份发现而欣喜。你希望，在这片危机四伏的土地上，它足以护你周全。
A holy symbol is carved into the small glass bottle. A comforting warmth emanates from within and motes of light flicker momentarily in the liquid when agitated. The bottle has a pleasing weight as you slip it into your pack, happy with your discovery. You hope it will be enough to protect you in this perilous land.

Undead Beholder Above Magical Forge.name:
魔法熔炉上方的亡灵眼魔
Undead Beholder Above Magical Forge

Text.text:
不死的守望者悬浮在一团恶臭与腐烂的云雾里，慵懒的触须末端长着眼睛，起伏摆动。它下方，熔炉里那些液态的咒文咕嘟翻涌、噼啪炸裂，蒸腾的气体凝成种种效应，等待被引导到卷轴上、灌进书页里。空气被它们点燃，地面嘶嘶作响——两具僵尸拖拽着各自的尸体，在石地上磨出令人牙酸的声响……朝着你而来。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The undead watcher hovers in its cloud of stench and rot, its lazy tentacles tipped with eyes undulating. Under it, the liquid spells of the forge bubble and pop, their gasses forming into effects to be channeled onto scrolls and into books. The air is afire with them, and the floor hisses with the sound of two zombies dragging their corpses along the stone… toward you.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

你一踏进来，草药与敷膏的气味便刺得鼻腔发痛。两侧墙边一排排简易病榻紧贴而立，地面虽已打扫干净，却仍隐约留下柔软的暗红痕迹。远处墙边的架子上摆满了各式外科器械：从不同形制的刀具到一把看着就令人心惊的钢锯。工具旁，棉垫与一卷卷纱布绷带整齐备好，随时可用。
The smells of herbs and poultices sting your nostrils as you step in. The walls on each side are lined with cots, and the floor—while clean—has soft red stains. On shelves against the far wall lie a multitude of surgical instruments: from varied knives to a rather alarming-looking hacksaw. Pads of cotton and rolls of gauze bandage sit ready beside the tools.

Offer From Shady Character Leaning Again.name:
倚墙而立的可疑角色的提议
Offer From Shady Character Leaning Against Wall

Text.text:
“*嘘* 喂……十金币，四小时，不问缘由。你只需要一把短刃和绝佳的平衡感——得非常绝佳。回家还能赶上早餐。”
“*Psst* Hey… It’s ten gold, four hours, no questions, and all you need is a short blade and a good sense of balance. Really good. Home for breakfast.”

工作台上的这件厚重工具看起来用过不少，等离子刀刃寒光闪烁。尽管外表粗犷，它既能进行精准切割，也能胜任常规舱壁拆除，是先进制造、施工与空间探索中不可或缺的利器。鲜亮的黄色机身上贴满了各式贴纸，警示着潜在危险。
The bulky tool on the workbench looks used, its plasma blades gleaming. Despite this rugged appearance, it seems capable of precise incisions as well as standard bulkhead removal, making it an indispensable tool for advanced manufacturing, construction, and space exploration. Multiple stickers cover its bright yellow chassis, warning of potential hazards.

I Cast Moonbeam.name:
我施放月光束
I Cast Moonbeam

Text.text:
我的法术之光刹那间驱散了我们周遭的一切黑暗。随着魔法平息，它凝聚成一道独一的乳白光柱——美得令人屏息，却也同样毁灭无情。凡置身光束之内者，尽皆轰然燃起刺目的白焰，以神祇般的狂烈灼烧万物。
The light of my spell, for a moment, drives away all the darkness around us. As the magic calms, it settles into a single cylinder of opalescent light—its beauty matched only by its devastation. Those within the beam combust into blazing white flames that sear with ferocity divine.

幽灵般的钟声以刺耳的不协和轰鸣回荡，兜帽身影在战场上步步逼近，漆黑的眼眸如陷入恍惚般死死凝住。扭曲挣扎的敌人沿着他们的行迹接连倒下，鲜血从指缝间滴落，双手徒劳地想捂住那低沉、撕裂耳膜的钟鸣。那名谜一般的旅人腰侧，数种发光而黏稠的液体在圆鼓鼓的瓶腹里翻涌——每一只都印着一枚黑色骷髅。

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

Spectral bells resound in a discordant cacophony as the hooded figure stalks across the battlefield, their dark eyes fixed as if in a trance. Writhing foes collapse in their wake, blood dribbling between fingers as hands desperately try to muffle the sonorous, rupturing peals. At the enigmatic traveler’s hip churn several luminescent, viscous liquids in round, bulbous flasks—each marked with a black skull.

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

Mountain Outpost Gate.name:
山地前哨哨门
Mountain Outpost Gate

Text.text:
城门由粗砍成形的巨木搭建而成，这些树木本应生长在远低于此处海拔的地方。门体厚重结实，足以承受强力撞槌的猛击。门框支撑着一道瓮城门，其上方是一条石质步道。闸门落下，既可封锁门洞，也可将闯入者夹困在两道闸门之间。城门两侧的城墙由花岗岩石柱构成，石柱沿着打孔立起的竖直木材一段段排列。瓮城门两侧没有守卫室——只有冷硬的墙体。
The gate is made of rough-hewn timbers of trees that grow well below this altitude. It is stout, built to withstand a powerful battering ram. Its frame supports a chamber gate with a stone walkway above. Portcullises drop to guard their doors or trap an offender between them. On either side of the gate is a wall composed of granite pillars spaced along post-holed vertical timbers. There is no guardhouse on either side of the chamber gate—only the wall.

Thorn Whip Misses.name:
荆棘鞭笞未命中
Thorn Whip Misses

Text.text: 从一截带刺的小小植物茎上长出一条鞭子，有种华丽而残忍的诗意。你估量鞭梢的触及，吐出尖利的号令词，挥臂一甩。它向外滑出，仿佛只是穿过空气生长而出，你的目标旁传来一声响亮的啪裂。落空。鞭子回返，反弹着缩回你手中那截带刺的小小茎干。 There’s a gorgeous, sadistic poetry to growing a whip out of a little thorny plant stem. You gauge the reach of the lash, speak the sharp command word, and swing. It slides outward as if simply growing through the air, and there is a loud crack near your target. A miss. The whip returns and recoils back to the prickly little stem in your hand.

Loot From A Grick.name:
从石爪兽身上搜刮的战利品
Loot From A Grick

Text.text:
洞穴里那堆一文不值的碎石之中，夹着若干未经切割的红玉髓、碧玉、黑曜石与石英，每颗约值5枚金币——若由珠宝匠加工，则可达15枚。另有约价值250枚金币的钱币，被人硬塞进一块巨石的裂缝里。
Among the worthless rocks in the cave are a number of uncut carnelians, jasper, obsidian, and quartz, each worth about 5 gold pieces—15 if worked by a jeweler. About 250 gold pieces worth of coins has been pushed into a crack in a large boulder.

A Sapphire Great Wyrm Awakens.name:
一头蓝宝石太古巨龙苏醒
A Sapphire Great Wyrm Awakens

Text.text:
[寻找蓝宝石巨龙] 洞窟豁然开阔成一片宽广、穹顶高耸的空间，而你一路行来的路径止步于一道深渊的断崖边缘——裂隙向下坠入黑暗。石质尖柱上布满又长又参差的抓痕，仿佛某种利爪生物常常栖落其上。这里的空气被魔法浸透，化作苔藓般的绿灰色微光尘点，漂浮在空中。跨越这片巨大深坑，对面的岩壁上攀升着一条蛇形的蓝宝石长带，两侧如翼般的附肢自其间向外舒展。 [召唤蓝宝石巨龙] 你朝巨龙呼唤。大地传来低沉的轰鸣，蓝宝石开始挪动，仿佛鼓泡般翻涌，继而苏醒。那身影以一整团庞然之势从岩壁中撕裂而出，落到一根石柱上，弓起脊背，惬意地伸展，浓郁的深蓝利爪深深抠入岩石。它的嘴裂开，发出干涩的哈欠，旋即坠入低吼。它的嗓音震得整座洞窟都随之颤动。

~ 构想：Goblin Man

[Finding the Sapphire Wyrm] The cavern opens into a wide, high-ceilinged space, and the path you’ve been traveling ends at the precipice of a chasm that descends into darkness. Spindles of stone are riddled with long jagged marks, as if a sharp-clawed creature perches upon them often. The air here is drenched in magic, visible as mossy green-gray motes floating in the air. Across the vast pit, a serpentine stretch of sapphires extends up the rocky walls, with two wing-like appendages fanning out from it. [Beckoning the Sapphire Wyrm] You call out to the wyrm. There is a rumble in the earth, and the sapphires begin to shift, as if bubbling, and come alive. The figure tears out from the wall in one, huge mass. It descends to one of the pillars and arches its back in a satisfying stretch, its rich-blue claws digging into the stone. Its mouth cracks open in a dry yawn that devolves into a growl. The entire cavern shakes with the sound of its voice.

~ Envisioned by Goblin Man

小半身人婴儿把食物一把塞进嘴里，咀嚼得津津有味，接着大口灌下几口温牛奶，把一切都顺了下去。随后他们带着黏乎乎的小手和沾满食渍的围嘴，开始四处探索。
The infant halfling shoves food into their mouth, chewing happily, then washing it all down with a guzzle of warm milk. They set about exploring with sticky fingers and a food-stained bib.

Caligni Dancer.name:
卡利格尼舞者
Caligni Dancer

Text.text:
苍白的皮肉如同被烈日漂白的羊皮纸，紧绷得过分，勉强覆在那具枯瘦类人身影的长骨之上。它散发着湿岩般的气味，在曲折的洞窟间游走，步态如午夜潮汐般无声起伏。它的身躯缠裹着一条条漂白的布带，贴着骨架起伏，随着动作一并滑移。怪异的羽毛与沾满烟灰的布条飘带松松垂落，生物在你周围嬉跃翻腾时拖曳出令人目眩的残影——优雅之下，却掩不住浅薄的凶性。最令人不安的，是从生物体内某处传来的噼啪作响声。
Pale flesh, like sun-bleached parchment, is stretched too thin over the long bones of the gaunt humanoid figure. It smells like wet rock and moves like midnight tides through winding caverns. Its body is wrapped in strips of bleached cloth that hug its frame as it moves. Strange feathers and ribbons of soot-stained fabric hang loose, leaving a mesmerizing afterimage as the creature frolics around you—grace belying shallow savagery. Most disconcerting of all is the crackling sound coming from somewhere within the creature.

Vornsten’s Hearth And Home Hostels.name:
沃恩斯滕的炉火与归家旅舍
Vornsten’s Hearth And Home Hostels

Text.text:
三栋一模一样的房子一字排开，正对着炉火与归宿旅舍的办事处。办事处门上方，两把矮人战斧交叉悬挂——那是主人家传承的象征。产业的女主人把一名旅人的双手握在掌心里，用明亮而热烈的热情欢迎他来到这座城市。她领着他走向其中一栋房子，三栋皆是矮人风格的设计。还有两名矮人在院里忙碌：一人正整理某个屋顶松动的木瓦，另一人把一大袋洗好的衣物甩在肩上搬运。你闻到从北边飘来的咖啡烘烤香气，馥郁诱人。
A row of three identical houses face the office of Hearth and Home Hostels. Above the office door, two dwarven axes are crossed, a symbol of the owners’ heritage. The matriarch of the property takes the hands of a traveler in hers, welcoming him to the city with bright enthusiasm. She leads him to one of the homes, all of which appear dwarvish in design. Two other dwarves mill about the property, one tending to the loose shingles of one of the roofs and the other carrying a large sack of laundry over his shoulder. You smell the roasted, enticing aroma of coffee wafting from the north.

这把华丽长剑最惹眼的细节，莫过于剑柄上嵌着的那只血色小瓶——猩红血液在其中盘旋翻涌。剑身带着一股非尘世的气息：轻若无物，却坚韧得毫不退让，以你从未见过的方式公然违逆常理。究竟是谁铸造了它？

~ 由 Discord 上的 Sahlonahl 在 Envisioned 之作

By far the most eye-catching detail of the ornate sword is the sanguine vial, swirling with crimson vitae, embedded in the hilt. There is something otherworldly about the blade, light yet unflinchingly robust it defies convention in a way you have never seen. Who created it?

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Slick Infiltration Specialist.name:
老练的渗透专家
Slick Infiltration Specialist

Text.text:
他身披一套深色及身潜行服，身为亚裔的男子静立其间，蓄势待发。头顶发丝向后梳得油亮利落，唯有一缕染成纯白。十号手指尽数被优雅的黄铜色改造件取代。潜行服的面罩已降下，止于下颌，连成一圈光泽冷冽的高领。身形修长矫健、个子高挑，浑身透着天赋使然的傲气。他单手把一枚信用芯片上下轻抛，完美的面庞挂着一抹讥诮的笑。
Clad in a dark body-length stealth suit, a man of Asian descent stands poised and ready. His head is crowned with slicked-back hair, one single strand dyed white. All ten of his fingers have been replaced with elegant brass-colored modifications. The stealth suit’s mask is lowered, ending at the chin in a glossy turtleneck. Lithe and tall, he bears the arrogance of natural talent. He flicks a cred chip up and down in one hand, a smirk on his perfect face.

Calling A Blood Elemental.name:
感召 血之元素
Calling A Blood Elemental

Text.text:
最后一名邪教徒在倒下的同伴间踉跄起身，兜帽深处传出一段骇人的咒唱。他猛地抬起双手，地上的血迹便朝他渗去、汇拢。他的词句愈发高亢，愈发阴森。猩红的液体从尸体上横流过瓷砖，竟不留一丝血痕；躯壳在抽干中迅速枯萎。一汪血潭随之成形，又以违背常理的姿态隆起，凝出类人的轮廓，短短数秒便膨胀得庞然如山。咒唱戛然而止，一头血之巨兽摇晃着涌上前来，抬起渗淌不止的肢体。

~ Envisioned by Koltova

The final cult member staggers to his feet among his fallen allies, a hideous chant coming from within the recesses of his hood. He throws his hands up, and blood on the floor seeps toward him. His words grow louder and more ominous. Crimson fluid streams across the tiles from the dead, leaving no trails. Corpses wither as they drain. A pool forms. It rises, unnaturally, taking humanoid shape that grows enormous in mere seconds. The chanting ends, and a behemoth of blood sloshes forward, raising its oozing limbs.

~ Envisioned by Koltova

寒风裹着浓雾在你身周盘旋，忽然裂开一线——山巅赫然在前，薄雪覆顶，冰光粼粼。它直插天际，峰顶没入云海之中。
The fog, swirling around you with a frigid wind, parts—and before you lies the peak of the mountain, dusted with snow and gleaming with ice. It soars upward, its top disappearing into the clouds.

Snobbish Noble And Lackeys.name:
势利贵族与走狗
Snobbish Noble And Lackeys

Text.text:
一名人类男子骑在一匹俊美的栗色骏马上，身披精致而锃亮的抛光护甲；他把头发向后梳得油光水滑——而那撇小胡子更是油得发亮。讥笑从他脸上散开，也同样挂在他那群跟班的嘴角；他们徒步尾随其后，像讨主人垂青的哈巴狗般亦步亦趋。
Sitting astride a beautiful chestnut horse and clad in elaborate, polished armor is a human man with slicked-back, oiled hair—and an even oilier moustache. A sneer radiates from him as well as his cronies, who follow him on foot like lapdogs begging for their master's attention.

被强行塑成类人形的闪电在房间里来回踱步，所经之处尽是焦黑迸火的斑痕。空气在大气压力下震颤，你的全身泛起一阵刺痛般的麻痒。生物的本质在被魔法束缚的形体内翻涌扭曲，宛如困兽在囚笼中狂怒撞击桎梏。
Lightning forced into humanoid shape paces back and forth across the room, leaving blackened, sparking patches wherever it treads. The air trembles with atmospheric pressure, and a tingling sensation spreads across your body. The creature’s essence writhes and contorts within its magically bound form like a caged beast raging against confinement.

Sundries From A Pit Fiend.name:
来自深坑魔的杂物
Sundries From A Pit Fiend

Text.text:
恶魔那对余烬般的眼睛光芒渐黯，冷却成灰白；它地狱般的灵火终于被彻底掐灭。随着生命流逝，那令人胆寒的压迫感也在消散，你终于能够走近尸身。它的武器已经粉碎——在濒死的痉挛中，这魔鬼曾将其狠狠砸向大地，硬生生震裂崩散。它颈间还挂着一枚奖章，但在炼狱法术的灼热中，那金属仿佛被活生生嫁接进它覆着红鳞的胸膛。其上刻着的徽记尽管形象扭曲狰狞，却依稀像是一枚家族纹章。
The light of the fiend’s ember eyes dims to a cool gray, the fire of its infernal spirit finally snuffed out. Its fearful presence diminishing with its life, you find yourself able to approach the body. Its weapon has shattered, broken apart when the devil smote it against the earth in its fitful death. A medallion hangs around its neck, but in the heat of its hellish spells, it seems to have grafted into its red-scaled chest. The symbol upon it, though grotesque in its imagery, resembles a coat of arms.

Speech From A Bitter Jailer.name:
怨狱官的苦涩演说
Speech From A Bitter Jailer

Text.text:
“你会惊讶我们在那片黑暗里逮到多少潜伏的东西。有一半的时候，我觉得镣铐和铁栏根本不够，我们就该把这地方连同里面那些卑劣的住客一起烧成灰。也许是我在这儿干得太久了，可这堵墙里活着的东西……嗯，你自己去看，就能下结论。”
“You’d be amazed what we catch lurking out there in the dark. Half the time, I think manacles and bars aren’t enough and we should just burn this place to the ground with all its vile inhabitants. Maybe I’ve just been working here too long, but the things that live within these walls… Well, you can decide for yourself.”

Sundries From An Ooze.name:
软泥怪的杂货
Sundries From An Ooze

Text.text:
被啃得一丝血肉不剩的白骨散落在区域各处。大多是啮齿类的骸骨，但也有几个倒霉的人形生物似乎同样没能逃过软泥那迅猛起效的消化酸液。
Bones, picked clean of flesh and blood, litter the area. The skeletons are mostly of rodent origin, but a few unfortunate humanoids seem to have succumbed to the ooze’s fast-acting digestive juices as well.

Headband Of Intellect.name:
智力头带
Headband Of Intellect

Text.text:
镶嵌在精致额带上的宝石熠熠生辉，仿佛将同等的璀璨加诸佩戴者。金色环带如一顶工艺绝伦的冠冕，周缘环绕着细密雕刻的奥术流文，蜿蜒流淌。
Gemstones inlaid in the delicate headband shine like the brilliance it bestows upon the wearer. The golden band is a crown of exquisite craftsmanship, and boasts fine engravings of flowing arcane script around the circumference.

Pirate Ghost Ship Attacking A Naval Port.name:
海盗幽灵船突袭海军港口
Pirate Ghost Ship Attacking A Naval Port

Text.text:
当皎月高悬，幽银般的月光覆上尖顶屋脊与鹅卵石街道，港口城市被安宁的寂静轻轻笼罩。水手与码头工人在各处穿梭徘徊，多数收工归家，准备入睡；也有人踉跄钻进酒馆，用酒精冲刷一天的苦涩。浓雾沿街巷蜿蜒滑落，沉重而遮蔽视线，惶惶低语在城中滚动蔓延。忽然，那诡异的沉默被猛烈撕裂——夜色里尖叫炸开，紧接着是兵刃嘶嘶相撞的厉响与炮声的轰鸣震彻。雾幕深处，鬼影般的身形纷纷现出，凹陷眼眶的空洞里燃着怒火。幽魂海盗紧握弯刀与长矛，带着不死者的饥渴狞笑，怀揣恶意扑向这座城市。

~ 构想：Tate.W

Serene quiet falls over the port city as the moon rises high in the sky, casting its ghostly silver light across steepled roofs and cobbled roads. Sailors and dockhands mill about here and there, most returning home for the evening to sleep, others stumbling into taverns to drink away the day’s hardships. A fog slithers down the streets and alleys, heavy and obscuring, and anxious murmurs roll through the city. The eerie silence breaks suddenly and violently as screams erupt in the night, followed quickly by the hissing clash of weapons and the thunderous report of cannons.
