Though not tall, the man is solidly built and moves with aplomb, his attention split in all directions yet not weakened by the divide. His eyes, the stained red-brown of cherry pits, flicker to a downed opponent, and his gun bucks as a silver bullet delivers bleak mercy.

~ Played by SilasKey with

Act I Of The Hierospite: Evangeline And.name:
《圣侍之幕》第一章：伊万杰琳与穿骆驼毛外套的男人
Act I Of The Hierospite: Evangeline And The Man In The Camel Hair Coat

Text.text:
在连接飞龙院与巨龙院公共休息室的走廊里，一个高挑瘦长的男人身着考究的驼绒大衣，将一根异常修长的食指几乎戳到伊万杰琳·梅普尔斯的脸上。“我得提醒你，这个学期我们已经非常宽容了，但我们的耐心也有极限。要是这些人知道你那点溜进城里的小出游，你觉得他们会怎么说？你正漂在鳗鱼的海里——而他们一旦知道你究竟是什么，连眨眼都不会就把你吞得干干净净。”

她从蓬乱如鬃的发下抬眼，毫不退让地回瞪。“真是一篇长篇大论。可惜我没有接受老疯子的威胁这种习惯，而且我上课要迟到了。”他察觉周围有人在看，便礼貌地对她微笑，后退一步。他抬起挂在颈间的一枚巨大的银色徽记——并非奥术之物——自信地仰头一望，随即消失无踪。

In the corridor connecting the common rooms of Houses Wyvern and Dragon, a tall, lanky man in a formal camel-hair overcoat points an abnormally long index finger into the face of Evangeline Maples. “I will remind you that we have been very generous over this semester, but our patience does have limits. What do you think these people would say if they knew about your little excursions into town? You are afloat in a sea of eels, and the moment they learn what you truly are, they will devour you without a second thought.”

She stares back defiantly from under her mane of hair. “Quite the speech. Unfortunately, I’m not in the habit of taking threats from old lunatics, and I’m late for class.” He sees that they are being watched, smiles at her politely, and steps back. He lifts a large silver symbol, not arcane, hanging around his neck, looks up with confidence, then disappears.

I Navigate By Observing The Stars.name:
我仰观星辰辨方向
I Navigate By Observing The Stars

Text.text:
我举起手向着苍穹，眯起一只眼，将拇指与食指对准地平线上方闪烁的群星，衡量那些天际标记的间距。意识到旅程几近终点，我不由得露出笑意，并向神祇致谢。群星永远在那里，指引我回家。
Holding up my hand to the heavens, I close one eye and align my thumb and forefinger with the glittering stars above the horizon, judging the distance of the celestial markers. I smile as I realize my journey is almost over, and I give thanks to the gods. The stars are always there to guide me home.

你看着法术如银色微尘汇成的激流般向前涌去。它们悬停片刻，随即如蜂鸟般迅疾地朝四面八方射散，颜色转为暗红。微尘的光芒愈发炽亮，直至在一场暴怒的细小爆裂中炸开成闪粉。那些闪耀的云雾旋即消散，归于虚无。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

You watch the spell surge forward in a stream of silver motes. They hover for a moment and then shoot off into different directions, quick as hummingbirds, turning a dark red. The motes glow brighter and brighter until they burst in a furious tiny explosion of glitter. These sparkling clouds dissipate into nothing.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Dueling The Hierospite And The Pursuants.name:
与圣灵侍者及其追随者决斗
Dueling The Hierospite And The Pursuants

Text.text:
追随者们的眼睛闪着光，法术从他们的施法媒介中迸发而出；他们的嗓音在说话，吐出带着致命锋刃的奥秘指令。一名黑衣女子像有意识的影子般游动，以魔法之力把岩石以子弹般迅疾的速度朝你的头颅甩来；其中一块几乎要削开你的施法手臂。与此同时，那名Hierospite在幻术法术的效果中逼近，一只骇人的猛禽冷眼旁观这场冲突，嘴角挂着恶毒的冷笑。“若我们此刻退缩，追随者们，我们将迎来我主之矛的暴怒终局！”他将权杖直指苍穹，一束钢铁般的光将其包裹。光的两端不断延展，直到Hierospite手中握着一柄铬色标枪。他的徽章在法术的光芒下闪出刺骨的银辉。他抬起手臂，蓄势欲掷那把凭空造出的武器，映亮的面孔因狂喜的笑意而扭曲起皱。“愿她的正义迅捷而残酷！”
The Pursuants’ eyes shine as spells burst forth from their foci, their voices speaking arcane commands cut with deadly edges. A woman dressed in black moves like a sentient shadow, magically slinging rocks at bullet-quick speed toward your head; one comes close to slicing through your casting arm. All the while, the Hierospite looms with the effect of an illusory spell, a terrifying bird of prey observing the conflict with a malicious smirk. “If we falter now, Pursuants, we meet the wrathful end of our lady’s spear!” He points his scepter directly to the sky, and a beam of steely light encapsulates it. Each end extends until the Hierospite holds a chrome javelin. His medallion flashes a chilling silver in the light of his spell. He raises his arm, poised to throw the conjured weapon, his illumined face creased in a gleeful grin. “May her justice be swift and brutal!”

Secret Passage In A Manor.name:
庄园中的密道
Secret Passage In A Manor

Text.text: [察觉] 这宅邸带着年代与继承沉淀下来的尘埃与天鹅绒般的气息。拱门高挑，其上嵌着家族纹章；墙上的画作描绘着那些神情严肃的长辈如何筹谋运作，筑起家族的财富。此处的明珠是书房：墙面一圈排满卷轴柜与厚重典籍，中央一张书桌上摆着羽毛笔、墨水与一盏提灯。两排书架之间那幅巨大的肖像画歪斜着。 [发现] 书桌抽屉里的一片羊皮纸碎上写着一道咒文，而画后墙面上有一圈极细的黑色尘线，勾出一个长方形，仿佛用粉笔在墙上划过。你朗读咒文时，那段墙面向内退去，露出一条向下延伸、通往黑暗的甬道。 [触发] 肖像画后有一圈极细的黑色尘线，勾出一个长方形——一扇暗门。看上去只要用力一推就能打开，可它仅仅向内缩进了一指宽。某种带粉质的黑色烟扑到你脸上，你开始感到它的影响。 [Perceived] The house carries the dusty, velvet atmosphere of age and inheritance. Arches peaked with the family crest and paintings on the walls depict the serious elder machinations who built a family fortune. The jewel of the house is the study, walls lined with scroll cabinets and tomes, a desk at the center with quills and ink and a lantern. An enormous portrait between two sets of shelves is crooked. [Discovered] Written on a scrap of parchment in the desk drawer is an incantation, and behind the painting is a fine line of black dust in a rectangle, as if chalked onto the wall. When you read the incantation, the section of wall recedes into a passageway leading down into darkness. [Triggered] Behind the painting is a fine line of black dust in a rectangle. A hatch. It looks as if it will give to a strong push, but it only recedes into the wall a finger’s width. A black puff of something chalky hits you in the face, and you begin to feel its effects.

Gnarled Face Appearing In A Tree.name:
树干上浮现的扭曲人脸
Gnarled Face Appearing In A Tree

Text.text:
伴随着一阵低沉的呻吟，剥落的树皮开始蠕动，那看似无害的树瘤扭曲变形，逐渐勾勒出一张近似人脸的轮廓。双眼收紧成危险的细缝，而那仿佛是嘴的位置向下扯出一抹狞笑。他们显然对被唤醒毫无欣喜。
With a groaning sound, the peeling bark begins to shift, the seemingly innocent burl twisting into something resembling a face. The eyes narrow into threatening slits, and what appears to be their mouth pulls down into a snarl. They seem less than thrilled with being awoken.

Sundries From A Wish Digger.name:
来自许愿掘客的杂货
Sundries From A Wish Digger

Text.text:
在这只古怪的掘洞生物身上，你找到一只小袋子，里面塞着几枚弯折的琥珀金钱币，另有一只顶针和两根蜡烛。果然，仙灵一族深不可测。
On the strange tunneling creature, you find several bent electrum coins in a pouch with a thimble and two candles. Truly, the faeries are an inscrutable people.

刀刃没入他们的腹肉，受害者喉间挤出痛苦而咕噜作响的低吼。他们单膝跪地，双手徒劳地攥在刀刃边缘。“结束了。”袭击者说道，同时将武器扭转着更深地绞进对手的肠腹。
The blade sinks into the flesh of their stomach, eliciting a pained, gurgling growl from the victim. They drop to one knee, hands gripping uselessly around the edges of the blade. “It’s over,” says the assailant as he twists the weapon deeper into their opponent’s guts.

Blight \"Freakshow\" Everwalk.name:
枯疫“怪胎秀”永行者
Blight "Freakshow" Everwalk

Text.text:
你看着那名半土裔男子为所有愿意驻足的人织出一段传奇；无论朋友还是陌生人，都被他从容自信的笑容与金色眼眸一闪而过的光芒所迎接。他身形精瘦，炭灰色的石质肌肤仿佛岩层，久经磨损却华丽的皮质护甲勾勒出他利落的体魄。一对晶莹的角从他银白、泛着蓝调的头发间突起；他草草将头发束在脑后，扎成凌乱的马尾。腰侧贴身不离的，是一件古怪却致命的武器：一把手枪，长长的枪管下悬着弯刀般的刀刃。它似乎噼啪作响，迸射出耀眼而未知的能量。

~ Played by Hoodwink

You watch as the half-earthbonded man spins a tale for all who’ll listen; friends and strangers alike are welcomed with an easy, confident grin and a flash of his golden eyes. He’s lean, with charcoal-gray skin of stone and an athletic build made apparent by his well-worn but ornate-looking leather armor. A pair of crystalline horns jut from his silver, blue-tinged hair, which he keeps hastily tied back into an unkempt ponytail. At his side, he keeps close an odd but deadly looking weapon: a pistol with a scimitar-like blade slung under a long barrel. It seems to crackle with a dazzling, unknown energy.

~ Played by Hoodwink

Burst Of Super Rain.name:
超级暴雨爆发
Burst Of Super Rain

Text.text:
毫无预兆，晴空忽聚乌云，伴着一声沉闷的雷鸣，天穹豁然裂开。落下的不是雨点，而是洪瀑，仿佛有人正把一只永不见底的水桶倾倒在你身上。暴雨的巨力砸向大地，泥浆被击得喷射成弧，直冲天际。紧接着，又在下一瞬间，雨声戛然而止，世界只剩下寂静的滴答，缓缓垂落。
Without warning, clear skies gather clouds, and with a dark rumble of thunder the heavens open. Water comes down, not in drops, but as a flood, like someone is pouring an unending bucket over you. The force of the deluge hits the ground, arcing jets of mud skyward. And then, in another instant, the rain stops, and the world is left quietly dripping.

Dead Tree In Swamp.name:
沼泽中的枯树
Dead Tree In Swamp

Text.text:
这片被遗弃的沼泽里几乎长不出什么东西。几丛干瘪的灌木从泥浆里艰难蜿蜒而出，枯骨般的树木沿着险恶的小径列作两旁。可就在此处，却矗立着一株强壮而古老的橡树，它的粗枝大杈想必曾被繁叶遮蔽。然而，腐蚀性的污水与恶臭的烂泥早已耗尽它的生机，如今它形容枯槁、衰败不堪，树干脆裂。风起时它发出不祥的吱呀声——骨白的枝条簌簌作响——仿佛随时都会侧倒进污泥与泥沼之中，像这处可憎之地的一切那样被吞没。
Little grows in this forsaken swamp. A few shriveled shrubs wind their way out of the mud, while skeletal trees line the perilous paths. But here stands a mighty, ancient oak, its boughs and branches likely once shrouded in leaves. But the caustic water and stinking mud have taken their toll, and the tree now stands gaunt and decrepit, its trunk brittle. It creaks ominously in the wind—bone-white branches rattling—threatening to topple sideways into the muck and the mire, to be consumed like everything else in this wretched place.

Large Wine Cellar.name:
大型酒窖
Large Wine Cellar

Text.text:
酒窖仿佛延伸到无穷尽，层层酒架从地面直抵天花板，摆满了成百——也许上千——瓶酒。红的、白的，以及介于其间乃至更离奇的色泽，每一瓶都按原产国、年份与风味特征分门别类地编目。大多数酒瓶覆着一层灰尘，有些标签褪色得再也辨认不出。空气干燥而温暖，隐隐飘着醋意与软木塞的气息。
The cellar seems to go on forever, and innumerable shelves stand floor-to-ceiling, laden with hundreds—maybe thousands—of bottles. Reds, whites, and everything between and beyond, each catalogued by country of origin, year, and flavor profile. Dust covers most of the bottles, and some of the labels are faded beyond recognition. The air, dry and warm, smells faintly of vinegar and cork.

第一次直面那强大而异界的宿敌时，你或许兜兜转转又回到了谦卑之中。也许你想起了自己第一次握住真正的武器；第一次戴上的头盔，或那一小袋法术材料。力量已变得如此玄奥，如此属于物质之外的领域，你需要一些提醒，把你重新钉回店铺、农田与屋舍构成的世界。

你如今能以曾经只敢在梦里、或从故事里听来的方式去旅行；能挥舞一柄足以驱逐不死军团的武器。统御一国，也早已在你掌中触手可及。你曾经服从的一切，如今都在服从你。
The first time you faced a mighty, otherworldly foe, you may have come full circle back into humility. Perhaps you recalled holding your first real weapon. Your first helmet or pouch of spell components. Power has become so mystical, so much a part of what is beyond the material, that you need reminders to root you in the world of shops and farms and houses. You can travel in ways you once dreamed of or heard in stories, wield a weapon capable of banishing armies of the undead. Commanding a nation is well within your grasp. What you once obeyed obeys you.

High-quality Forged Papers.name:
高品质伪造证件
High-quality Forged Papers

Text.text:
这份伪造品几乎天衣无缝。哪怕是举世闻名的专家在状态最巅峰的一天，也未必能看穿其中的虚假。然而，一旦时运不济，或是被一双格外锐利的眼睛逮住了破绽，那么这些文件的持有人将面临数个无期徒刑接连加身。
The forgery is almost flawless. It would take a world-renowned expert on their best day to see through the falsehood. However, if bad luck or an especially keen eye catches something amiss, then the owner of these documents will be serving consecutive life sentences.

Children's Rhyme About Kelpies.name:
关于水鬼马的童谣
Children's Rhyme About Kelpies

Text.text:
小马靠着睡莲池，
守在芦苇里。
小马说：“上来呀，上来呀！”
领你奔向水里。

小马踏得浪花翻，
哗啦哗啦疾驰。
小马说：“回家呀，回家呀！”
领你穿过水里。

小马沉了又沉又沉，
鬃毛缠满水草丝。
小马说：“够了呀，够了呀！”
在水里，小马进食。

~ 构想：Girlhead

Horsie near the lilypond,
Waiting in the reeds.
Horsie says, “Hop on, hop on!”
To water, Horsie leads.

Horsie tramples all to foam,
Splish and splash, he speeds.
Horsie says, “To home, to home!”
Through water, Horsie leads.

Horsie sinks and sinks and sinks,
His mane a web of weeds.
Horsie says, “No more, no more!”
In water, Horsie feeds.

~ Envisioned by Girlhead

Animal Tongue: Ingested.name:
兽语：经口摄入
Animal Tongue: Ingested

Text.text:
想借沙漠鸟儿的眼睛窥探，就得先拿出意志，咬牙吞下一剂兽舌膏。那糊状物散着青翠的气息，入口时能稍稍压住你翻涌的干呕。几乎立刻，你的意识与周遭野兽之间仿佛有一层薄纱被掀起。你深吸一口气，扩展自身的存在，向它们发问，恳求它们自愿交出掌控。药性在你脑中澄明成一句告诫：生命无高低贵贱——也预示着它摇摆不定的宿醉效果：对其他动物的戒惧，几乎逼近恐惧症。

~ 由一位英雄构想

One needs the will to spy through the eyes of desert birds to commit to a dosing of animal tongue. The paste’s verdant scent helps calm your gag reflex when ingesting it. Almost immediately, a veil lifts between your consciousness and that of beasts in the vicinity. You inhale, extending your presence, asking them to surrender control willingly. The drug clarifies in your mind that there are no lower or higher forms of life, presaging its pendulous hangover effect: a wariness of other animals that borders on phobia.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The Dragon Awakens Angrily.name:
巨龙怒然苏醒
The Dragon Awakens Angrily

Text.text:
伴着一声闷哑的叹息，灼热的蒸汽被它缓缓呼出，巨龙苏醒了。它如巨蟒般舒展盘蜷的身躯，四肢与长腿自那覆满鳞片、流光闪烁的躯体中层层展开。一道低吼自它胸腔与咽喉深处升起，震颤着巢穴的每一寸空间，撼落尘土与碎屑。你不知它沉眠了多久，只知你一到，它便睁眼起身，强壮的后肢撑起身躯，肌肉如盘绕的钢索在不可穿透的皮下因期待而战栗。鳞片彼此摩擦发出嘶响，宛如护甲铁片相互错动；利爪如恶毒的弯刀，在岩石上刮出森冷的锐意；巨翼大得不可思议，遮蔽了外界的光。那自巨龙膨胀胸膛深处滚出的低吼，终于化作雷鸣般、撼地的咆哮——而在它张开的巨口之中，热量正不断攀升。

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl

With a muffled sigh that exhales searing steam, the dragon stirs. It uncoils itself like a serpent, limbs and legs unfurling from its scaled, shimmering body. A growl rises in its chest and throat, rumbling through its lair and dislodging dust and debris. You know not how long the dragon has slumbered, only that it awakens at your arrival, rising on its powerful haunches, muscles like coiled steel vibrating with anticipation beneath its impenetrable hide. Scales hiss as they slide against one another like plates of armor, claws like wicked sabers keen against the stone, and wings impossible in scale obscure outside light. The growl from deep within the dragon’s swelling chest becomes a roar, thunderous, earthshaking—and from its maw, a heat grows.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl

Muddy Crossroads.name:
泥泞的岔路口
Muddy Crossroads

Text.text:
道路钻入一片泥泞的沼泽般纠缠小径。地势略微下陷处的十字路口困住了近来雨水的湿气，人、马与车辙的反复碾压把两条路都搅成了深陷的泥潭——迫使许多旅人绕开路口行走，而绕行的脚步又把那一带的土壤翻得更烂。想不弄脏就通过，几乎不可能。
The road enters a muddy morass of tangled pathways. A crossroads in a slight depression of the landscape has trapped the moisture of recent rains, and the passage of people, horses, and carts have churned both roads into deep mires—driving many travelers to pick routes around the crossing, which in turn has roiled the soil there. You’ll be hard-pressed to pass without getting dirty.

Mantle Of Spell Resistance.name:
法术抗力斗篷
Mantle Of Spell Resistance

Text.text:
这件短斗篷的织造细密得惊人，与之形成反差的，是那毫无纹饰的布料上朴素到近乎乏味的蓝色——无疑是大多数织工所能买到的最廉价染料。然而，凡是具备奥术感官、将察觉投向斗篷持有者的人，都会发现自己的感官竟会莫名其妙地从穿戴者身上滑开，如水从鱼皮上滚落一般。仿佛魔法在这层素布表面几乎无处着力。
The fine weave of this short cloak belies the unadorned cloth’s rather plain color of unremarkable blue, doubtlessly the most inexpensive dye available to most weavers. And yet, those possessing arcane senses turning their perception toward the bearer of the cloak would find their senses inexplicably slide off the wearer as water slides off a fish’s skin. It as if magic can find little purchase along the surface of this plain cloth.

Interplanetary Drive-thru.name:
星际穿梭得来速
Interplanetary Drive-thru

Text.text:
浮夸的霓虹招牌让这座小小的空间站在两颗姊妹星球之间那片辽阔而空荡的太空航道中格外扎眼。飞船在杂乱无章的队列里怠速停引擎等待，两台无人机来回穿梭，在队首的船只与免下船餐厅的气闸之间传递指令与食物。
Glitzy neon signs make the small space station stand out like a sore thumb in the vast, empty spaceway between two sister planets. Ships idle their engines in a haphazard queue, waiting as two drones relay instructions and food back and forth between the vessel at the front and the drive-thru restaurant’s airlock.

Emmad Lorskan Grizzlywood.name:
艾玛德·洛斯坎·灰木镇
Emmad Lorskan Grizzlywood

Text.text:
这名敦实的龙裔覆着森林般的深绿皮肤，鳞片之间却晕染成浓郁的黑，头冠与颈褶黑得如同沥青。他的眼眸只会像纯粹的黑曜石那样发亮——不借一丝光源，仍有缥缈的银色火花在目光深处跳舞。两把短剑交叉收在背后的剑鞘里，一把长剑悬在腰侧的皮带上。尽管他满身魔性与刀剑寒光，神情却出奇无辜：睁得圆圆的眼、柔和的眉，满口利齿的巨口总爱颤着收成一条好奇的弧线。

~ Played by the dnd lover

The portly dragonborn’s forest-green hide darkens to a rich black between the scales, his head crest and frill as dark as pitch. His eyes gleam only as pure obsidian can—and ethereal sparks of silver dance within his gaze without the aid of light. Two shortswords sit crossed in scabbards upon his back, and a longsword hangs from the leather belt at his hip. Despite his magical look and bevy of blades, his overall expression is rather innocent: wide-eyed and soft-browed, his toothy maw prone to wobbling into a curious line.

~ Played by the dnd lover

Conference Of Shadow Queen And Faerie Qu.name:
暗影女王与妖精女王的密会
Conference Of Shadow Queen And Faerie Queen

Text.text:
一位高挑枯槁的女子——身形裹在优雅飘舞的影丝之中——飘然来到石桌旁。她的双眼如黑曜石般闪烁。苍白的脸庞在衣袍间泛着光，宛如多云夜里的一轮月。她冷笑着，黑色的唇瓣分开，说道：“又一次，我们——强大而美丽的影之东道主——怀着慈善与和平的精神，认为有必要与我们可爱的逐日兄弟交谈。毕竟凭借我们浩瀚的力量，我们大可施以怜悯，放过我们空洞的表亲，以维护那——”她停顿片刻，嗤笑一声。“——洒满阳光的森林的神圣。”

更矮一些却光彩夺目，一位古铜肤色的女子身着层叠的秋色长裙，金饰垂坠叮当，贴近而来，站在她阴暗的对面。她蓝色的眼睛像清澈的水潭般闪耀。她昂起下巴，修长的手指轻轻一挥，说道：“多谢您，最仁慈也最阴郁的陛下。没有您这般晦暗的在场，这场会谈确实不算完整。一如既往，您那拙劣的文明与魅力尝试……真是场‘奇观’。我们会让谈判尽快结束，好让您省下更多时间，去您无疑早已安排好的湿冷洞窟里继续沉思忧郁。”

~ 构想：RJ Poplawski

A tall, emaciated woman—her form swathed in elegant wisps of dancing shadow—drifts to the stone table. Eyes the color of obsidian glitter. Her pale face shines among her garb like the moon on a cloudy night. She sneers, her black lips parting to say, “Once again, we, the strong and beautiful host of shadow, have seen fit to converse, in the spirit of charity and peace, with our adorable day-faring brethren. For in our vast power, we can afford to be merciful and spare our vapid cousins for the sanctity of the—” She pauses to scoff. “—sun-dappled forest.”

Shorter but luminous, a bronze-skinned woman dressed in a layered gown of autumnal colors, dripping with gold baubles, sidles up opposite her dark counterpart. Her blue eyes sparkle like limpid pools. She holds her chin high, giving a wave of her long-fingered hands and saying, “Many thanks, your most benevolent and dreary majesty. This conference would indeed be incomplete without your gloomy presence. As always, your flailing attempts at civility and charm are a… spectacle. We shall make these talks brief, so as to spare you more time for all that brooding in damp caverns you, no doubt, have planned.”

~ Envisioned by RJ Poplawski

披着斗篷的身影是个精灵——那修长的身形与毫不费力的优雅立刻暴露了身份。一缕耀眼得不可思议的白发从兜帽下滑落出来，当他抬手将其拨回去时，你猛然意识到：你原以为是深色手套的东西，其实是卓尔那如乌玉般漆黑的肌肤。
The cloaked figure is an elf, the lithe body and easy grace give up the game immediately. A lock of shockingly white hair falls out of the hood, and when they raise a hand to tuck it back in, you realize with a shock that what you thought were dark gloves are in fact the drow’s jet black skin.

Castle Servants' Quarters.name:
城堡仆役宿舍
Castle Servants' Quarters

Text.text:
朴素的宿舍陈设简陋却一尘不染，每张床上都整齐地叠放着熨得笔挺的制服。空气里隐约飘着肥皂的清香，角落深处一把磨得发亮的旧扫帚静静倚着，无人问津。
The humble dormitory is sparse but immaculate, with uniforms neatly pressed and folded on each of the beds. The air smells faintly of soap, and a well-worn broom sits idly in the far corner.

你察觉到钟楼最高处有个纤细而无声的身影栖着，俯瞰整座小镇，目光眷恋地投向地平线。你走近时，那身影将斗篷兜帽向后一掀，露出一张鸟类的面孔——如乌鸦般覆着黑羽，深褐色的眼睛沉凝如实，审视着你。忽然，他从斗篷下抽出一支排箫，吹出两音的问候致意，随即从栖处一跃而下，跳到近旁的屋顶上。

~ 由 Damon Mumaw 饰演

You become aware of the slight, silent figure perched on the highest part of the clock tower overlooking the town, looking longingly at the horizon. As you approach, the figure pushes back the cowl of his cloak to reveal an avian face, covered in black feathers like a raven, solid dark brown eyes surveying you. Abruptly, he pulls a pan flute out from under his cloak and blows a two-note salute of greeting to you, then hops down from his perch to a nearby roof.

~ Played by Damon Mumaw

High Elven Lord's Moonblade.name:
高等精灵领主的月刃
High Elven Lord's Moonblade

Text.text:
这件近乎神话的神器——初代高等精灵领主的远古妖精武器——赋予持有者号令精灵族群的能力。它的力量深不可测，围绕它流传着无数传说。王者之刃会选择并守护下一任高等精灵领主——一位当之无愧的继承者，能引领精灵走向更好的归宿。它最后一次现身，是被一名萨堤尔在妖精位面的一处树洞洞窟中目睹；其旁更有夏之女王亲自守卫。
The almost mythical artifact—an ancient fey weapon of the first high elven lord—grants its wielder the ability to command the elven race. Its powers are unfathomable and many legends surround it. The kingmaker blade chooses and protects the next High Elven Lord, a worthy heir who can lead the elves to a better place. It was last seen by a satyr inside a tree cave in the Plane of Faerie, guarded by the Queen of Summer herself.

Warning About A Town’s Curse.name:
关于一座城镇诅咒的警告
Warning About A Town’s Curse

Text.text:
“白天，我们的小镇和别处没什么两样。我们照常忙着自己的事，死死维系着那一线薄如刀锋的正常。我们假装一切安好，假装夜晚只会带来沉睡与安宁。可这里有黑暗。我不知道它从何而来，也不知道它为何选中此地，但每到夜里，它就愈发肆无忌惮。”
“During the day, our town is like any other. We go about our business maintaining that razor-thin sense of normalcy. We pretend that nothing is wrong, that night will only bring slumber and peace. But there is a darkness here. I don’t know where it comes from or why it’s chosen this place, but every night, it grows bolder.”

Arrival Of The The Ferryman Charon.name:
摆渡人卡戎的到来
Arrival Of The The Ferryman Charon

Text.text:
你环顾四周，周遭的物质仿佛一幅银色帷幕被无形之手拨开。前方一艘摇摇欲坠的木船船首从虚无中显现，像是凭空召来。一个高耸的身影披着褐色破烂长袍，自不可见的深渊中撑篙而出，划破现实的涟漪。
As you survey your surroundings, the matter around you is pulled aside like a silvery curtain. The bow of a rickety wooden vessel materializes, conjured from nothing. A towering figure, clothed in brown tattered robes, poles through the ripples of reality from an unseen void.

I Drink My Potion Of Climbing.name:
我喝下我的攀爬药水
I Drink My Potion Of Climbing

Text.text:
我在瓶中摇晃的液体呈现出交替的浅褐与深棕色调，宛如被海风与浪花亲吻过的峭壁岩面。我拔开瓶塞，将药剂一饮而尽；沙砾般的质感在味蕾与喉间轻轻作痒。随着魔法的效果发作，我感觉手臂与背部的肌肉鼓胀隆起。掌心多余的汗意迅速干去，指甲也变得更厚更硬。我觉得自己像一只正要攀上树干的野猫般，充满力量与把握。
The liquid I swirl around the bottle has alternating shades of tan and brown, much like the face of a sea-kissed cliff. I uncork the potion and drink it down, the sandy texture tickling at my taste buds and throat. As the magic takes effect, I feel the muscles of my arms and back swell. My palms dry of excess sweat and my nails thicken. I feel as capable as a wildcat about to scale a tree.

Rolf, Son Of A Shepherd Druid.name:
罗尔夫，牧羊人德鲁伊之子
Rolf, Son Of A Shepherd Druid

Text.text:
男人双眼闪烁，抬手便自地面唤起荆棘。这个肩宽背阔的年轻牧师，身上并非神殿祭衣的华彩，而是樵夫般冷峻朴素的装束。他敬奉自然的翠绿神祇——腰间悬着木与骨的护符小物，磨得发亮，源自德鲁伊父母的旧物传承。他那无瑕的面容在看见土地遭人糟践时便骤然冷硬如岩，威胁般的目光专为那些欲玷污大地之人而留。他的意志与信念并肩生长，如种子在正义决心的光里抽芽。

~ Played by Austin W

The man’s eyes twinkle as he calls forth thorns from the ground. The broad-shouldered young cleric is garbed not in the resplendence of temple vestments but rather the austere simplicity of a woodsman. He reveres the green gods of nature—at his belt hang wooden and bone trinkets, well-worn and handed down from a druidic parent. His unblemished visage turns stern and stony when he sees the land treated poorly, with a threatening glare reserved for those who would despoil the earth. His will and faith grow in tandem, seeds sprouting in the light of righteous resolve.

~ Played by Austin W

青藤般的绿线纹样点缀着这辆金丝雀黄的篷车，篷车立在红色车轮上。车尾两扇门敞开着，露出一个紧凑而舒适的内部空间。你看见矮矮的睡铺、一张可折起贴在墙上的小桌、一台炉灶，烟管直通天花板，还有储物柜、书架，以及一只鸟笼，笼里有只鸟。各式各样、体型不一的锅、盘、罐和水壶也一应俱全。
Green lines representing vines decorate the canary-yellow caravan standing on red wheels. Two doors hang open at the back, revealing an interior that looks compact and comfortable. You see short sleeping bunks, a little table that folds up against the wall, a cooking-stove with pipe to the ceiling, lockers, bookshelves, and a birdcage with a bird in it. There are also pots, pans, jugs, and kettles of every size and variety.

一对年迈的夫妇教授骑扫帚、保养与竞赛。他们已近退休之年，各自一头漫长的雪白发丝从高高的尖帽下倾泻而出，帽檐宽阔。两人的面容饱经风霜，却洋溢着蓬勃的热情；尽管布满皱纹、双手斑驳，他们的身手却远比外表所暗示的更为矫健。他们跨上扫帚便如同一体腾空而起，飞行时分毫不差、完美同步；而他们的课程永远讲解清晰，指令利落高效。
An elderly couple teaches broom riding, maintenance, and competition. They are nearing retirement, and each has long, snow white hair flowing from under tall, pointed hats with wide brims. Their faces are weathered but full of exuberance, and they are far more fit than their wrinkles and spotty hands would imply. They mount their brooms and fly as one, in perfect synchronization, and their lessons are always clear and efficiently given.

你所勾勒的并非如今的自己，而是渴望成就的模样。你吐出晦涩的奥秘咒音，那幅幻象便化作真实。起初变化痛彻骨髓——骨骼崩裂作响，形体扭曲变形，脏器重新归位——但很快，一种诡异的感受取而代之：你的感官开始偏移，你也随之蜕变为截然不同的存在。
You envision not who you are, but what you want to become. As you speak the arcane words, the vision becomes reality. The change is painful at first—cracking bones, warping forms, rearranging organs—but soon a strange sensation takes its place as your senses shift and you become something different.

Cleric's Lament About Chronic Pain.name:
牧师对慢性疼痛的哀叹
Cleric's Lament About Chronic Pain

Text.text:
“我试遍了所有法术和臭气熏天的药剂，可这疼痛似乎偏偏缠上了我。它能把人折磨得生不如死，但久而久之，几乎成了个伴儿——提醒我即便身陷苦楚，也要多使一分力，仍旧保持善良。”

~ 构想 by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

“I’ve tried every spell and foul-smelling concoction, but it seems this pain is quite taken with me. It can make you miserable, but after so long, it’s become almost a companion, reminding me to put in that little extra effort to remain kind in spite of my own suffering.”

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

这位武器大师是月光下的一抹暗影，挥舞着寒光凛冽的刀刃，宛如指挥家奏响致命二重奏。身形如水银般迅疾，心如钢铁般冰冷，他们以凶狠的笔触涂抹黑夜，在暮色的死亡之舞中，躯体本身便是一件真正的武器。
This weapon master is a shadow in the moonlight, wielding gleaming blades like a maestro conducting a deathly duet. Quicksilver movements and a heart as cold as steel, they paint the night with vicious strokes, their body a veritable weapon in the twilight's dance of death.

兜帽下的身影如潜伏的猛兽般悄然逼近。起伏翻涌的斗篷上别着一枚诡异的秘印；其下双臂裸露，肌肉线条紧致流畅，苍白的疤痕与黢黑的纹身在皮肤上纵横交错。弯刀扭曲的刀柄从腰带间斜斜探出。靴子踝下的皮革泛起令人不安的猩红色泽。
The hooded figure stalks like a prowling beast. Their rippling cloak is pinned with an eldritch emblem; underneath, their arms are bare, sleek with muscle, canvases of pale scars and dark tattoos. The twisted hilt of a scimitar juts from their belt. The leather of their boots takes on an unsettling crimson cast below the ankles.

Introduction Of A Criminal.name:
罪犯的登场
Introduction Of A Criminal

Text.text:
“我把人生中最好的年华都耗在这座城市溃烂的伤疤里——公民社会的裂缝中，各种肮脏恶毒的东西在那里滋生。但过了一段时间，我才明白……决定一处地方本质的，不是法庭与会客厅，而是那些裂缝——绝望的人在那儿苟活。其余的，不过是粉饰门面。”
“I spent the best years of my life in the festering scars of this city. The cracks in civil society where all sorts of nasty things grow. But after a while, I realized… it’s not the courtrooms and parlors that make a place what it is, it’s those cracks, where the desperate survive. The rest is just window dressing.”

Nightmare About A Terrible Choice.name:
关于一个可怕抉择的噩梦
Nightmare About A Terrible Choice

Text.text:
绝望的呼喊声此起彼伏——每一道都熟悉得令人心痛——在迷宫蜿蜒扭曲的回廊间回荡。他们乞求拯救，而你不可能救下所有人。汗珠在你额前凝结，你的头在一条条岔道间急速来回转动。你会救谁？

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

Desperate voices cry out—each one painfully familiar—echoing through the twisting corridors of the maze. They beg for salvation, but you can’t save them all. Sweat beads your brow as your head whips back and forth between the passageways. Who will you save?

~ Envisioned by a Hero

[外部]  靠近镇中心处，矗立着一座建筑，体量足有邻街民宅的四倍之大。每处入口上方都悬挂着织工精心编成的长幅挂毯，其上绣着镇徽。宽大的双开门为人群同时涌入而设，庆典、集会或紧急时刻皆可一并放行。 [内部]  走进镇政厅，拱顶下的承重梁上垂着粗壮的铁制吊灯，油灯燃着稳定的光，将厅堂照得暖意融融；火焰轻颤，把忽明忽暗的影子投在切割整齐的石质地面上。一侧整齐码放着节庆时用的桌子，旁边还有用老林原木削切打磨而成的长凳。大厅尽头搭起一座平台，正中央立着一只讲台，上面饰着镇徽。 [Outside]  Near the center of town stands a building easily four times as large as the houses in neighboring streets. Long woven tapestries featuring the town’s seal hang above every entrance. The large double-doors are designed to admit crowds all at once in times of celebration, meeting, or emergency. [Inside]  Inside the town hall, stout iron chandeliers hang from the support beams of a vaulted ceiling, filling the hall with a steady light and a pleasing warmth from their oil lamps, which cast flickering shadows on the cut stone floors. To one side, tables are stacked neatly for use in times of festival, as well as long benches cut and polished from old-growth logs. At the far side of the hall a platform has been erected, on which, front and center, sits a lectern adorned with the town’s seal.

Graffiti-covered Convenience Store.name:
涂鸦遍布的便利店
Graffiti-covered Convenience Store

Text.text:
交错的涂鸦线条像蛛网般铺满玻璃窗与混凝土墙面——粗重笔画彼此撞作一团，早已难以辨认；屋内嗡鸣的荧光灯从背后透出冷光，将它们映得发亮。一个熟客用肩膀挤进门里，双手牢牢插在牛仔裤口袋中。一只老旧的铃铛发出轻微的叮当声。门缓缓合上，铰链在年代与疏于打理的重压下发出低沉的呻吟。顾客以熟稔的语气朝店主喊了声——“嘿！”——店主疲惫地回道：“怎么了？”他戴着手套的拳头托住下巴，手臂上杂乱植入的金属条与电线一路盘绕，沿着臂膀蜿蜒而上。
Competing streaks of graffiti web over the glass windows and concrete walls—unreadable as they collide in a tangle of bold lines, backlit by the humming fluorescent lights of the interior. A patron pushes through with his shoulder, both hands squarely in the pockets of his jeans. An antiquated bell jingles faintly. The door swings closed slowly, the hinges moaning with the weight of age and neglect. The customer calls out to the shop owner with a friendly familiarity—“Hey!”—which the owner responds to with a weary “What’s up?” He rests his chin against his gloved fist, a messily implanted bar of metal and wire weaving up his arm.

Power Word Kill.name:
律令：死亡
Power Word Kill

Text.text:
古老的魔法只剩下寥寥数语。在世界尚未成形、现实尚无法被诸界所界定之时，古老的神祇以几近被遗忘的语言，将自身思绪宣诸于世。此法术仅由那异乡之舌的一段残片构成。它当年的含义无人知晓，但它如今的意思很简单：死亡。
There are few words of the old magic left. Before the world, when reality could not be defined by planes, old gods gave issue to their thoughts in a language all but forgotten. This spell consists of just one fragment of that alien tongue. What it meant then no one knows, but what it means now is simple: death.

Drow Captain Promoted.name:
卓尔队长晋升
Drow Captain Promoted

Text.text:
营里流言嗡嗡作响——关于那场排场，关于缎带与金色奖章静卧在天鹅绒衬里的盒中，关于那段短促却字字带刺的致辞。他们站在湿漉漉的鹅卵石路上，破裂凹陷的道具上沾着汗臭与血腥，低声私语。私语说，或许正是一次专家级的战术神来之笔，才让上尉平步青云。又或许，那是一次精心落下的致命一击，让前任上尉在恰到好处的时机、在足够幽暗的阴影里倒下。
There is talk buzzing through the battalion—about the pomp, the ribbon and its golden medallion in a velvet-lined box, the brief but pointed speech. They stand on wet cobbles, reeking of sweat and gore in sliced and dented gear, whispering. Whispering it was perhaps an expert stroke of tactical brilliance that advanced the captain. Or perhaps it was a carefully placed stroke that dropped the previous captain, at just the right time in a just-dark-enough shadow.

Flesh Chamber With Container Mound.name:
带容器堆丘的血肉囚室
Flesh Chamber With Container Mound

Text.text:
这片空间由筋膜勾勒轮廓，又被一层有机的内脏隆起包裹其外。尽管你必定身处某个活体生物之内，却仍能看出智慧设计的痕迹。房间正中央立着一座直径四英尺的肉丘。它覆满层层褶皱的血肉，如同一枚由生肉铸成的松果；每一道褶皱都像一处可能的藏匿之所。
This space is framed by sinew and encased in an organic swell of viscera. Though you must be inside some living creature, there are signs of intelligent design. In the very center of the chamber sits a mound four feet across. It is covered with folds of flesh, like a pinecone made of raw meat, each one looking like a potential cache.

Positive Energy Plane.name:
正能量位面
Positive Energy Plane

Text.text:
除了光，什么都没有——刺目、灼烧的光。你在那光里眨眼，抬手遮挡比太阳更耀眼的辉辉，却仿佛它正渗入你每一寸毛孔，让你体内的每一个细胞都被它的光点燃。伤口合拢，疤痕褪去，一切病痛尽数消散——但远不止于此，你明白，凡人绝不可能在这里存活。
There is nothing but light—blinding, burning light. You blink against it, shielding your eyes from light more radiant than the sun, but it seems to bleed into every pore, setting every cell in your body alight with its glow. Wounds close, scars fade, any ailments disappear—but it goes beyond that, and you know no mortal could possibly survive here.

Raised Small Village.name:
抬升的小村庄
Raised Small Village

Text.text:
粗壮的梁木由交错成格的支撑桁架加固——年复一年不断补强——将整座村落高高托起，远离地表。村子由一间间泥草搭成的茅屋组成，彼此以栈道相连，无需什么广场；可人们仍会聚在数条栈道交汇之处，交换消息与货物。然而风势一大，还是乖乖待在屋里更明智。
Thick timbers reinforced with a lattice of intersecting struts—reinforced over the years—keep the entire village aloft, away from the surface. The village, consisting of individual huts of mud and straw with walkways between them, has no need of a square, but  people congregate at a spot where several walkways intersect, to share news and trade; however, when the winds are high, one would be well-advised to stay indoors.

Fiery Triad Red Pole.name:
烈焰三合会红棍
Fiery Triad Red Pole

Text.text:
这个女人是个杀手。她眼中的杀意寒光，锋利得如同在她修长、布满纹身的指间翻飞起舞的刀刃。她将乌鸦般的黑发利落地扎成马尾，其中一道刺目的猩红如长矛般贯穿其间，正与她那件改装夹克上的龙纹装饰相互映衬。
The woman is a killer. The murderous glint in her eyes is as sharp as the knife dancing in her long, tattooed fingers. The streak of vibrant red lancing through the raven black hair she has pulled into a neat ponytail matches the draconic decoration on her customized jacket.

Synthetic Suppressant Drug, Sober Time.name:
合成抑制药物，清醒时代
Synthetic Suppressant Drug, Sober Time

Text.text:
一小瓶半透明的药剂瓶中，独特的虹彩粉末闪耀着微光。细碎的晶粒里藏着平息过量负担的秘密。只要迅速吸入，它便能压下大多数麻醉品的凶性，赐予片刻从那阴险桎梏中挣脱的自由。然而，当沙漏翻转一回合，被压抑的诅咒便会卷土重来，纠缠之力加倍。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

A unique iridescent powder gleams within this translucent vial. The shimmering grains hold the secret to quelling the burdens of excess. Snorted swiftly, it tempers the savagery of most narcotics, granting fleeting freedom from their insidious grasp. However, upon the hourglass’s turn, the suppressed curse returns, its tenacity doubled.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Converse With A Brass Dragon.name:
我与一条黄铜龙交谈
I Converse With A Brass Dragon

Text.text:
“哦，最华丽、最宏伟的生物啊，我跋涉千里，历经磨难，只为求得你的指引。我必须知道——为了王国——若有人骑在你背上，随着你翱翔天际，你会有多能接受？纯属假设。”
“Oh, most splendid and magnificent creature, I have journeyed far and suffered much to seek your guidance. I must know, for the sake of the realm, how okay would you be with having someone ride on your back while you fly around? Totally hypothetical.”

Saturn Noir.name:
土星黑色诺瓦
Saturn Noir

Text.text:
一双钢蓝色的目光以不眨眼的冷寂死死钉住你，仿佛那张嶙峋的面孔并非活生生会呼吸，而是出自某位阴郁画师之手，以凌厉而辛辣的笔触涂抹而成。他的护甲处处显出财富的痕迹——黑色甲片无缝折合相扣，胸口烙着家族纹章，每一块护甲的边缘都刻满繁复纹饰。背上束着的巨剑像钻石般闪耀，几近透明，却与他的眼睛同样泛着灰蓝的色调。他那迫人的身高与宽肩的负载令他轻松背负武器与护甲，脊背笔直不弯；每一步落下，都像远雷低滚。褪色的黑色刺青线条从颈甲下悄然爬上来，暗示着下面还有更庞大的一幅图案。

~ Played by S Geist

A steely-blue gaze fixates with unblinking stillness, as if the gaunt visage it is set within is not living, breathing, but painted by some brooding artist in stark, acerbic strokes. His armor bears the marks of wealth—black plates fold seamlessly together, the chest bears the emblem of his house, and the edge of each piece of armor is marked by intricate designs. The greatsword strapped to his back gleams as diamonds do, nearly transparent, though the hue is the same grayish blue as his eyes. His looming height and broad-shouldered bulk allow him to carry the weapon and armor with ease, back unbent, each of his steps a subtle roll of thunder. Faded black tattoo lines creep up from underneath his neck guard, hinting at a larger piece underneath.

~ Played by S Geist

Druid Transforms Into A Constellation.name:
德鲁伊化作一片星座
Druid Transforms Into A Constellation

Text.text:
双眼辉耀如灿烂天穹，你的同伴举臂指向星夜，牵引穹苍的天界伟力。星尘翻涌成一场璀璨旋风，虚无羽翼在其身后舒展，超凡的魔法嗡鸣充盈空气。德鲁伊的肌肤上浮现出一道道白色能量纹路，织成夺目的图案；他们的肉身开始扭曲、淡化，与星界位面融为一体。伴随一道刺目的闪光，你的同伴挣脱凡躯枷锁，化作纯粹的星光。

~ 由 Charleyyy182.0 构想

Eyes glowing like the resplendent heavens, your companion raises their arms to the starry night and channels the celestial power of the firmament. Stardust swirls in a glittering whirlwind when ethereal wings unfold behind them, and the hum of transcendent magic fills the air. Lines of white energy appear across the druid’s skin in dazzling patterns as their corporeal form begins to shift and fade, becoming one with the astral plane. With a blinding flash, your companion slips their mortal bonds and transforms into pure starlight.

~ Envisioned by Charleyyy182.0

湿透的地面塌陷下去，原本缓缓起伏的山坡崩坍开来，露出一道泥泞的断崖。你在崖顶的土层下方一两英尺处发现了古怪之物：一圈厚实的冰带，像岩石般层层叠压。显然这片地形立于一处冻结的压实积雪之上——而这场泥滑坡若能说明什么，那就是它或许正在融化。
The soggy ground has fallen away, collapsing what was a gradual hill to reveal a muddy cliff. A foot or two beneath the soil at the top of the cliff you spot something curious: a thick band of ice, like a layer of stone. Apparently the terrain stands upon a frozen deposit of compacted snow—and if this mudslide is any indication, it might be melting.

Compliment About A Remarkable Companion.name:
对一位非凡同伴的赞美
Compliment About A Remarkable Companion

Text.text:
“你当真非同凡响；你知道吗？像你这样的人，就算再自私也照样会被人仰慕。可你偏偏不这样——你才华横溢，却同样温柔良善。”
“You are truly extraordinary; do you know that? Someone like you could be as selfish as they wanted and still be admired. Yet, instead, you are as kind as you are talented.”

Sundries From A Mummy Lord.name:
木乃伊（特征）领主的杂物
Sundries From A Mummy Lord

Text.text:
木乃伊（特征）的裹布毫无价值，甚至可能有害，除非用某种方式唤起其防腐之力，同时不让其中的腐朽带来任何风险。若能成功处理，它们或许可以充当一剂治疗药水。
The mummy’s bandages are worthless, perhaps even harmful, unless something is used to invoke their preservative powers with no risk of the rot in them. If successfully prepared, they may be able to serve as a healing potion.

外头沙暴翻涌咆哮，这几间屋子却仿佛未曾受过风霜。冰凉的石材铺满墙壁与地面，每一块砖上都刻着难以辨认的纹饰。沙漠夜晚的寒气被困在此处不散，沿着脊背一路沁入骨髓。一只小蜥蜴倏地窜过，随即钻回那风化砂浆的裂缝深处，消失在它的巢里。
Outside, the sandstorm roils, but these rooms seem unweathered. Cool stone lines the walls and floors, each brick etched with indistinguishable carvings. The frigid air of desert nights lingers trapped, sending a chill down your spine. A small lizard skitters past and returns to its home within the cracks in the crumbling mortar.

Microwave Power Array In Heliocentric Or.name:
日心轨道微波能量阵列
Microwave Power Array In Heliocentric Orbit

Text.text:
微波阵列如迷途旅人般漂游在苍穹之中，孤独地绕着恒星巡行，面板浸在炽烈的太阳辉光里。卫星在无声的沉思中穿行，于体量不可思议的行星之间缓缓游荡，在它们独眼巨人般的巍峨壮观上投下转瞬即逝的一抹微影。
Drifting through the firmament like a lost traveler, the microwave array follows a lonesome journey around the system’s star, its panels bathed in solar radiance. The satellite travels in silent contemplation as it meanders between planetary bodies of impossible magnitude, passing as the merest shadow over their cyclopean grandeur.

River Journey: Anchored By Night.name:
河上旅程：夜泊锚定
River Journey: Anchored By Night

Text.text:
船在这条河道僻静的回湾里随和缓的波浪轻轻摇曳。头顶夜空繁星闪烁，宛如精灵的微光，倒映在水面上。和煦的微风拨弄着一片未系牢的帆布边角，除此之外，几乎没有什么打破此刻的安宁与闲适。
The ship sways on gentle waves in this quiet cul-de-sac of the river. Above you the night sky glitters with stars, their fairy glimmer reflected in the water. A gentle breeze trifles with an unbound flap of the sails, but little else disturbs the peace and ease of the moment.

Temple To A God Of War.name:
战争之神的神殿
Temple To A God Of War

Text.text:
火盆的烈焰将会众的脸映得猩红如血。各级士兵排成长龙，在祭坛前奉上供品——那是一整块砂岩——两名身披粗帆布僧袍的僧侣侍立一旁。一名将军上前低声祷告，摘下插羽盔，屈膝跪地，只求荣耀高于一切。祭坛后方，一幅巨大的壁画描绘两军无尽厮杀、永不停歇；画中士兵的面孔尽被磨花抹去，唯有战神的面容高悬在这片杀戮之上，带着冷硬而满足的神情。
The flames of the braziers wash the faces of the congregants in bloody crimson. Soldiers of every rank line up to make offerings at the altar—a block of sandstone—attended by two monks wearing robes of canvas. A general has stepped forward to mutter a prayer, removing his plumed helm and bending his knee, wishing for glory above all else. Behind the altar, a great mural depicts two armies clashing in endless battle. The faces of the painted soldiers are scuffed out, while the face of the War God shines above the mural of carnage with a grimly satisfied expression.

一层薄雾起初几乎难以察觉，却渐渐遮蔽了头顶的天空。远处的群山在一堵被狂风卷起的烟幕后褪色消隐。空气里，你闻到了焦灼的气味。很快，浓黑翻滚的烟柱随之而来；放眼远方，你看见火海正熊熊燃烧——一场体型与规模都骇人的野火，吞没着遥远的林地。灼热的气浪自那片烈焰中飘荡而至，即便在这相隔数里之处，依旧逼人。
A haze, almost imperceptible at first, obscures the sky overhead. The distant mountains fade behind a wall of windswept smoke. In the air, you smell burning. Dark, roiling smoke follows soon after, and in the distance, you see the fires blazing—a wildfire of immense size and scale, overtaking the distant forest. Heat wafts from those flames, even here, leagues away.

一具六肢的虫形钢铁腹部托举着这台庞大骑士构装体的前躯；它遍体覆甲，厚重的护甲如王者加冕般将其包裹与冠饰。他们是一台战争机器，胸腔里燃着地狱般的意志。躯干中央，一张巨口喷吐出昏黄的火焰；其上，加冠的头盔内嵌着两只发光的眼睛，灼亮如将熄的星辰。左手紧握一根镶嵌红宝石的金杖，右手则垂着一张结构繁复的网状织罩。
A six-limbed insectile abdomen wrought of steel props up the forebody of a great knightly construct, plated and crowned like a king in thick armor. They are a war machine burning with hellish will. At the midbody, a great maw belches forth yellow flame; above, the crowned helm houses two glowing eyes that burn like dying stars. A gold staff inlaid with ruby-red jewels lies in their left grip, and in their right dangles a complex netted mesh.

Traveling Mobility Aid Salesperson.name:
旅行助行器推销员
Traveling Mobility Aid Salesperson

Text.text:
马车车轮还裹着新鲜的泥浆，在村庄草地上咯吱一声停下；一名圆滚滚的男人穿着飘逸长袍，从车夫座上轻巧跃下。他一把拽住卷起的帆布旁垂下的绳索，伴着魔法的号角般声响，帆布戏剧性地“哗”然展开。上面写着：穆尔根的奇妙助行器具：助你踏上旅途。 他注意到聚拢的人群，笑着抚平那条又长又打了蜡的髭须；随即以老练的卖艺腔调轻叩车厢，车身两侧便翻开成一间临时店面，陈列着各式各样的助行器具。轮椅、手杖、助行架与拐杖琳琅满目；更玄秘的货品则锁在泛着微光的玻璃柜里。覆着怪异象形符号的精致皮革背带、以金线绣成的眼罩、以及一根带着纯正龙骨独特纹理的手杖，都从镀金的橱窗里撩拨着顾客的目光——但万物皆有价格。

~ 由 Played 扮演，Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

 The cart, its wheels slick with fresh mud, rolls to a halt on the village green, and a rotund man in flowing robes hops down from the driving seat. He pulls a rope hanging from a rolled-up canvas, causing it to unfurl dramatically with a magical fanfare. It reads: Murgen’s Marvelous Mobility Aids: Helping you on your journey. Noticing the gathering crowd, he smiles, smoothing out his long, waxed moustache, and taps the wagon with an air of practiced showmanship, causing the sides to open into a storefront replete with mobility aids of all kinds. Wheelchairs, canes, walkers, and crutches of all styles mingle with more esoteric stock locked in shimmering glass cases. Exquisite leather harnesses covered in strange hieroglyphs, an eyepatch embroidered with golden thread, and a cane bearing the distinct marbling of pure dragon bone all tease customers from their gilded windows—but everything has a price.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

尽管还很年幼，这头可怖的恐龙已然带着同族致命的烙印。幼崽口中排列着短而针尖般的利齿，粗短的蜥足趾间也正冒出细小的爪尖。小小的掠食者在母亲警惕的注视下追逐着同窝的兄弟姐妹；当幼崽们凭着本能的悍劲彼此扑跃扭作一团时，母兽发出轻快的颤鸣，似在赞许。
Though it is only young, this fearsome dinosaur already bears the lethal hallmarks of its kin. Short, needlelike teeth line the baby's mouth, and tiny claws have begun their eruption from stubby saurian toes. The tiny predator chases its siblings beneath the watchful eye of their mother, who trills approvingly as the young ones leap upon each other with instinctive vigor.

Mature Adult Horacalcum Dragon.name:
成年期欧拉卡勒姆巨龙
Mature Adult Horacalcum Dragon

Text.text:
一颗彗星划破长空，随即凝出形体：一头由活生生的星铁铸就的巨兽，通身蓝褐锈色，棱角嶙峋。紧接着它揭开真容——来自遥远群星的巨龙，鳞片上点缀着虚空残渣的斑痕。它抬翼昂首，攀至凯旋般的极致高度，翼上碎片四散飞溅，锋利金属的火花在周身闪烁。蜥蜴般的嘶声在你脑后深处反弹回响。
A comet passes through the sky, then takes shape: a beast of living starmetal, all blue-brown rust and jagged edges. Then it unveils itself, a dragon from distant stars, scales flecked with remnants of the void. Fragments scatter off the wings of the dragon as they rear up to their full triumphal height in a sparkle of sharp metal. A lizard-like hiss ricochets within the rear of your head.

一条被踩得发亮的小径引向一口朴素的水井。打水的装置看起来久无人问津，连水桶的影子也不见，但区域其余部分却被打理得一尘不染。井边石块洁净如新，一圈小小的花圃环绕着井座。几枚不同面额的钱币被人遗忘在花茎间，而探头望向井下，则能看见清澈的青铜与白银闪烁着粼粼光泽——甚至还隐约透出几抹金色。
A well-worn path leads the way to a humble well. The mechanism to draw water looks long-neglected, with no bucket in sight, but the rest of the area is beautifully maintained. The stones are clean, and a small garden of flowers circles the base. A few coins of varying value lay forgotten among the stems, and a glimpse down into the well reveals a sparkling sheen of clean bronze and silver—and even a few hints of gold.

The Sanctuary: Abandoned Humanoid-sized.name:
圣所：废弃的人形尺度蜂巢
The Sanctuary: Abandoned Humanoid-sized Apiary

Text.text:
一圈巨大而断裂的木栅栏围住一座庞大的农舍，破败之态一目了然。通往前门的石板路几乎被杂草吞没——那扇门只剩一枚合页勉强吊着——茅草屋顶上还横亘着几个大洞。墙边斜倚着一辆坏掉的独轮车，以及一把被硬生生折成两截的草叉。你胡须微颤，嗅到屋里飘来一股甜腻却令人作呕的气味，远处还传来一阵震耳的嗡鸣声。
A gigantic, broken wooden fence encircles a huge farmhouse in obvious disrepair. Weeds cover most of the slate tiles leading to the front door—which hangs on one hinge—and several large holes mar the thatched roof. A broken wheelbarrow and a pitchfork that’s been snapped in half lean against the wall. Your whiskers twitch as you catch a whiff of something sweet and unpleasant coming from inside the house, and you hear a loud buzzing in the distance.

Powerful Explosion Nearby.name:
附近发生猛烈爆炸
Powerful Explosion Nearby

Text.text:
爆炸的冲击将你猛地掀退。你还来不及思索那声巨响究竟有多震耳，耳中便已嗡鸣不止，头颅仿佛被血潮重重撞击。你下意识紧闭的双眼重新睁开，映入眼帘的是一片烟雾弥漫、混乱不堪的景象。
The blast rocks you back. Before you can even think how loud it was, your ears ring and your head pounds with blood. You open eyes, which you closed on reflex, to a scene of smoke and confusion.

Soaring Peak Vineyard.name:
翱翔峰葡萄园
Soaring Peak Vineyard

Text.text: 娇嫩的白葡萄垂在藤蔓上，宛如糖霜般的露珠凝结其间。透过一扇窗子，可以看见这处产业的人类酿酒师：他穿着利落的马甲与正装长裤，一条金链从胸前口袋垂落。他在店内巡看那几张不多却布置得极雅致的餐桌，抚平桌布上任何一道褶皱，或将高脚杯擦拭到晶莹透亮、毫无瑕疵。门外的招牌写着Tengfei’s Soaring Peak，字迹柔和，雪白如新落的霜。 Delicate white grapes hang like frosting dewdrops upon their vines. The human vintner who owns this property can be seen through one of the windows in a smart waistcoat and dress pants, a golden chain dangling from his breast pocket. He inspects the few but beautifully set up tables in his establishment, flattening any crease in the tablecloths or polishing goblets to perfect clarity. The sign outside, displaying the name Tengfei’s Soaring Peak, is written in soft, snow-white lines.

这头麋鹿比其他鹿类样本大得多，在穿行于自己的领地时，周身透着一股警觉的气息。它那对惊人的鹿角尖端锋利得近乎凶险，再加上肌肉虬结的长腿所带来的速度，你立刻明白为何体型较小的掠食者往往会选择避其锋芒。
Much larger than other examples of deer, the elk projects an air of alertness as it traverses its territory. The tips of its impressive antlers look wickedly sharp, and coupled with the speed of its muscular legs, you understand why smaller predators tend to stay out of its way.

Young Dragons Dueling In The Sky.name:
幼龙在苍穹中对决
Young Dragons Dueling In The Sky

Text.text:
云层像棉絮烟火般轰然炸裂，幼龙在其中决斗，撞破天穹，宛如披鳞的火箭。鲜艳的绿色毒气喷流与刺骨寒风的吐息交织翻涌，两者缠斗不休，各自试探对方防线的弱点。然而每次相撞都未见血溅，尽管震耳欲聋的咆哮随之席卷四方。也许它们只是在练习。

~ 构想：Jugs Dones

Clouds burst like cotton fireworks as the young dragons duel, crashing through the skies like scaled rockets. Jets of vibrant green gas mingle with blasts of frigid air as the two fight, each testing the other’s defenses for weakness. But when they clash no blood is spilled, despite the deafening bellows that accompany such instances. Perhaps they are just practicing.

~ Envisioned by Jugs Dones

这家酒馆像是东拼西凑起来的，多半是在店主曾祖父的时代搭起的：随手捡来的石块胡乱垒砌，用厚厚的灰浆硬生生糊合在一起；此后几十年里又不断往外加盖、扩建。酒馆马厩旁还贴着一座粗陋却结实的木棚，里面拴着几只动物——不是坐骑，而是家禽和用来挤奶的牲口。

推开那扇吱呀作响、经常更换的木质前门，映入眼帘的是一间温暖朴实的乡野酒馆。吧台被反复打磨又打磨，浸透了无数次洒落的麦酒。公共厅里散落着大小不一的桌子，甚至属于不同的时代；不过大多数客人更愿意挤在后方那座石砌壁炉旁，离火越近越好。墙上这些年陆续挂起了各式小玩意儿、本地手工艺品和零碎装饰，东一件西一件，成了人们闲聊时顺手指点的谈资。
This tavern was lashed together in what was probably the time of the proprietor’s great-grandsire, built inexpertly with gathered stones fitted with thick layers of mortar and expanded upon in the decades since. A crude but sturdy wooden shelter built along the side of the tavern stables several animals, not mounts but fowl and animals kept for their dairy contributions. 

Past the often-replaced creaky wooden front door, you are greeted with the sight of a homey country tavern, the bar sanded and re-sanded, sodden with countless spilled ales. Tables of various sizes and, indeed, of different eras litter the common room, though most of the clientele prefers to sit as close as possible to the stone fireplace at its rear. Various knick-knacks, objects of local art, and other gewgaws have been mounted here and there on the walls as conversation pieces over the years.

你周遭的景象微微荡漾，一只巨大的手凭空显现，巍然耸立的手指仿佛在模仿你自己的动作。魔法带着刺鼻的臭氧气息在空气中游荡，如同不远处营火升起的烟，令无形的奥术瘴雾将你彻底浸透。那只手悬浮在原地，静候你的号令。
Your surroundings shimmer as the giant hand manifests itself, the towering digits mimicking the movements of your own. The ozone tang of magic drifts through the air like smoke from a nearby campfire, saturating you in the unseen arcane miasma. The hand floats in place, awaiting your command.

Weapons Shop Sword & Scale.name:
武器店「剑与鳞」
Weapons Shop Sword & Scale

Text.text: [外面]  “剑与衡”是一间朴素的军械铺，卵石砌成的墙面托着深色染木的屋顶。建筑后方的烟囱有节奏地吐出滚滚黑烟。外墙旁接着一处自助磨刃抛光台，配有木制投币锁箱；上方挂着一块牌子：风险自负！屋旁还有个小型搏斗沙坑，弓靶齐备，另有豺狼人稻草假人——在无数次修补中被缝了又缝、补了又补。 [里面]  你一踏进门，角落里那座常年开火的锻炉便将暖意迎面送来。一个敦实的矮人女子在背后黄焰的映照下忙碌穿梭，衣物与深红色头发上糊着厚厚的煤灰斑块。不同尺寸的木制人偶沿墙排开，每个都披着一种不同的护甲。柜台后方的墙面像画廊陈列艺术品般展示着各式武器，每一件都安放在专属铭牌上，刻着名字与价格。一个肤色黝黑的人类男子笑意满满地拍了拍手，见你打量店内便说道：“啊，欢迎，欢迎！今天想让我们为你配上什么家伙？” [Outside]  The Sword & Scale is a simple armory made of cobblestone walls and a dark-stained wood roof. Black smoke billows from a chimney on the back of the building in a rhythmic pattern. Attached to the exterior of the building is a self-use sharpening and shining station with a wooden coin-drop lockbox; a sign hangs up above it: Use at your own risk! Beside the building is a small combat sand pit, complete with archery targets and straw dummies of gnolls that have been stitched and re-stitched during their many repairs. [Inside]  You step inside and are warmed by a well-used forge being worked in a back corner. A stout dwarvish woman, her clothes and dark red hair coated in thick splotches of soot, orbits around its yellow blaze. Wooden mannequins of various sizes line the walls, each wearing a different type of armor. The wall behind the counter displays assorted weaponry as a gallery might display works of art, each resting upon its own plaque engraved with a name and price. A joyful dark-skinned human man claps his hands as you take in the shop. “Ah welcome, welcome! What may we arm you with today?”

Paparazzi Surround A Rich And Famous Cou.name:
狗仔队团团围住一对富豪名流夫妻
Paparazzi Surround A Rich And Famous Couple

Text.text:
像饥饿的鲨鱼般，他们蜂拥向那对光鲜夺目的情侣，镜头死死咬住名流不放，仿佛已嗅到血腥。闪光灯在盛放的光雾中连连爆裂，摄影师们为抢占位置推搡挤撞，一个个冲着猎物般的人物吼出问题，迫不及待要夺下独家猛料。
Like hungry sharks, they swarm around the glamorous couple, their lenses trained on the socialites like they’ve smelled blood. Flashes erupt in blooming clouds as photographers jostle for position, each one barking questions at their prey, eager for an exclusive scoop.

Twisting Mountain Path.name:
盘曲山径
Twisting Mountain Path

Text.text:
一侧，陡峭的山崖直刺云端；另一侧，幽深的裂谷张着大口，引人坠入。小径在山口间蜿蜒前行，你们前方传来碎石滑落山坡的簌簌声。狂风呼啸掠过，仿佛在催逼你们贴向崖边。
On one side the steep crags of the mountain soar into the clouds above, on the other a yawning chasm beckons. The path winds its way through the pass, and ahead you hear the rattle of debris sliding down the mountain's side. The wind whips by, urging you toward the cliff's edge.

Remote Government Base In Alien Jungle.name:
异星丛林深处的远程政府基地
Remote Government Base In Alien Jungle

Text.text:
在浓密而致命的丛林深处，一处秘密基地匍匐其间，宛如这颗异星上人类探索的灯塔。基地被奇异的外来植被层层环抱，流线型的建筑轮廓间点缀着射程各异的扫描器与空中节点，暗示着内部封存的尖端科技。政府与军方人员像蚂蚁般在设施间穿梭，目光始终不敢离开林木的阴影。
Amid the dense, dangerous jungle squats a clandestine base, a beacon of human exploration on this alien world. Surrounded by exotic flora, the base's sleek design is punctuated with a range of scanners and aerial nodes, hinting at the advanced tech contained within. Government and military personnel crawl about the structure like ants, eyes never leaving the trees.

一名双足异族展开宽阔的昆虫翼，粗犷的几丁质外骨骼随之绷紧。它高挑却脆弱，躯体上雕刻着一枚装饰性的蜘蛛纹样。腰间悬着一把凶狠骇人的匕首，另有三支小瓶在旁摇曳，瓶中液体翻涌着遥远星云般的色彩。胸前一圈飞镖成束环绕。它咔咔磨动颚钳，涎液与诡异的琥珀色液体一同滴落，渗出粘稠的绿色唾沫。
A bipedal alien with a rugged exoskeleton of chitin flexes broad insectoid wings. It stands tall but delicate, and a decorative spider shape has been carved into its body. Around its waist hangs a brutal-looking knife and three vials swirling with the colors of a distant nebula. A brace of darts rings its chest. It gnashes its mandibles, oozing green spit and a strange amber liquid.

昏暗的大厅里，矮人们围拢在一张结实的木桌旁，桌上摆满了朴实丰盛的食物。有人用粗壮有力的手攥着麦酒大杯，有人则切开烤得喷香的整块肉腿。他们的笑声在角落的楼梯间回荡，讲述着被击倒的强敌与寻获的珍宝。
In the dimly lit hall, dwarves gather around a sturdy wooden table laden with wholesome fare. Some grasp tankards of ale with their strong hands while others cut into haunches of roasted meat. Their laughter echoes up the stairs in the corner as they share stories of foes defeated and treasures discovered.

半身人忽然停住——目光落在你身上，仿佛在权衡什么。霎时间，他张口无声地尖叫，变形就此开始。毛发自他的脊背疯长，利爪从指间迸裂而出，牙齿也随之拉长。你面前那丑怖的生物咬得长长的门牙咯咯作响，随即猛扑而上发动攻击。
The halfling pauses—looking at you as if considering something. Suddenly, his mouth opens in a silent scream as the transformation begins. Fur sprouts from his spine, claws burst from his fingers, and his teeth elongate. The grotesque creature before you gnashes its long front teeth, and lunges to attack.

Sundries From A Shield Guardian.name:
来自盾卫魔像的杂物
Sundries From A Shield Guardian

Text.text:
一堆木板与金属片杂乱地堆成一团，那顶曾充作头颅的面甲头盔侧倒在堆顶。你在沉重而毫无动静的残骸间拨弄搜寻，金铁碰撞声此起彼伏，却几乎找不到什么值钱的东西。这个守卫由廉价而粗陋的零件拼成：凹陷未抛光的铁片，以及制作者连打磨上色都懒得认真处理的木板。
A pile of wood and metal sheets sits in a cluttered mass, the visored helmet that served as a head laid sideways atop the pile. Clattering through the heavy, motionless debris, you don’t find much worth. The guardian was made of cheap and simple parts: dented, unpolished iron and boards of wood the crafter had not even bothered to properly sand and stain.

帐篷沿着一条伸入马蹄形渗湖的沙洲成簇扎起，艳丽的布面在干燥的风里猎猎翻飞。它们排成一线，最前方是一座最大的长方形大帐，后方更小的帐篷与行军床沿着湖岸铺展开去。营地中央立着一处石圈火坑，仍残留着昨夜炊火的余烬，暗红微熏。
The tents stand in a cluster along the sandy spit of land jutting into the horseshoe-shaped seep lake, their colorful cloth fluttering in the arid breeze. The tents are pitched in a line, with the largest rectangular structure at the head, and smaller tents and cots spreading along the shore. A firepit surrounded with stone stands at the center of the cluster, still smoldering from the previous night’s cookfire.

Perscitia/phalsindra The Golden.name:
珀尔西提娅／法尔辛德拉·金色者
Perscitia/phalsindra The Golden

Text.text:
镶着抛光钢饰的金色长袍披垂在这名女子高挑而强健的身躯上，灿金映衬着她古铜色的肌肤。两支犄角自她的黑发间弧扫而出，长发编成辫子垂落肩头。辫梢点染的紫罗兰色与她的眼眸相映，也与那一道道在她肌肤上闪烁的鳞片光泽相合。那双眼瞳孔如裂缝般收束，目光灼烈，而她的神情却依旧难以捉摸。她抬起原本倚着的巨剑，双手握住剑柄，金色光辉在她周身翻涌旋绕。她的身形随之膨胀，龙裔之翼在肩后成形……

~ Played by Uchihavenger

Golden robes with adornments of polished steel drape this woman’s tall, strong form, the color accenting her bronzed skin. Two horns sweep from her dark hair, which falls in braids over her shoulders. The violet highlighting the ends of these braids matches her eyes and the gleaming scales that stripe her skin. Those eyes, with their slitted pupils, are intense, her look otherwise inscrutable. She raises the greatsword she was leaning on, placing both hands on the grip as her form swirls with gold light. Her body expands, draconic wings taking shape over her shoulders…

~ Played by Uchihavenger

巨大的扇叶横贯船尾，舒展如一只巨鸟的双翼，迎风捕捉每一缕气流。主舵上方弥漫着机油与油脂的气味，显然未曾被这艘船的奥术推进所触及，仍需依靠非魔法的方式来保养维修。舵叶笔直而傲然地矗立着，随时准备将船只引向任何航向。
Huge fan blades span the stern of the ship, spread like the wings of an enormous bird to catch the wind. The smell of oil and grease hangs over the main rudder, clearly untouched by the arcane propulsion of the vessel and in need of non-magical maintenance. The rudder blade stands straight and proud ready to guide the ship on any course.

Combat Drone Opens Fire.name:
战斗无人机开火
Combat Drone Opens Fire

Text.text:
无人机的机体像一枚黑色圆盘，顶端微微隆起，掠过天际时安静而慵懒，仿佛随手抛出的飞盘。就连它的灯光也刻意收敛，在它俯瞰的霓虹街道刺目的光潮前显得黯淡无力。忽然，它猛地一颤，急刹般悬停在空中。顶部“嗤”地弹出一根天线，柔和的浅色灯瞬间被灼目的猩红取代。一枚投射出的红色准星在楼宇间闪烁游移，随即锁定目标——它开火了，迸溅着火花的弹流朝一处屋顶倾泻而去，碎石与尘土被撕开、卷起，翻涌成带着灼焰与呛人气味的云团。金属猛砸混凝土的声响挤进车流的喧嚣与广告牌的轰鸣里，竟与这座城市的声景贴合得毫不突兀。
The drone, its chassis a black disk with a slightly rounded top, skims through the sky with the quiet, lazy ease of a tossed frisbee. Even its lights are subdued, overpowered by the glaring neon streets it surveys. Suddenly, it comes to a shuddering halt. An antenna shoots out of its top and soft pale lights are replaced with searing red. A projected red reticle flickers over the buildings. It finds its mark and fires a sparkling stream of bullets toward a rooftop, sending rubble and dust billowing in a noxious, flaming cloud. The sound of metal hammering concrete joins the din of traffic and blaring billboards, fitting into the city’s soundscape all too easily.

Subterranean Temple For Summoning.name:
用于召唤的地下神殿
Subterranean Temple For Summoning

Text.text:
一段诡异而轻摇的吟唱在空旷的空间里回荡。神殿直接从洞窟岩壁中凿刻而成，浑然一体的石质结构，显然出自技艺精湛、虔诚投入的双手。立柱上雕着离奇而超凡的形象——有的像人，有的狰狞如兽，还有的彻底陌异得无法归类——自地面一路延伸到穹顶。尽头的祭坛前方，地面被深深刻出一圈圆环，环缘密布符文。祭坛上的烛火微颤，摇曳的光在召唤者的身影上游移。
A strange, lilting chant reverberates through the cavernous space. The temple has been carved from the rock of the cave, a seamless structure of stone crafted by expert, devoted hands. Pillars adorned with strange and otherworldly figures—some appear human, others monstrous, and still more are completely alien—stretch from floor to ceiling. An altar at the far end stands before a circle carved deep into the ground, ringed with runes. Candles atop that altar flicker, shedding wavering light over the forms of the summoners.

半精灵的身影化作一阵疾风般的移动，如同死亡之舞。凭借精准而娴熟的步伐，他们在敌群中穿行，翻滚、侧闪，令每一次攻击都落空。箭矢被他们拨开，利刃被他们借势格回持刀者。武僧猛然出拳，瞬间废掉一名对手，紧接着一记飞踢，将另一人踹翻在地。那双以布缠绕的拳头仿佛泛起金色光辉，当武僧将其倾注于下一名敌人时，光芒愈发灼亮。
The half-elf is a flurry of movement, a dance of death. With precise, practiced movements, they wade through enemies, tumbling and sidestepping. No attacks find their mark. Arrows are knocked aside, blades are turned back on their wielders. The monk punches out, disabling a foe, then follows up with a kick, dropping another to the ground. Those fists, wrapped in cloth, seem to glow with a golden energy as the monk brings them to bear against their next foe.

“哦，你就等着吧——等你那疲惫的双脚踩上那绵软得令人心醉的青草，疼痛的脚底都像被抚慰了一般——简直就像走在天堂的花园里，真就是这么回事。太阳那金灿灿的光芒天天照进来，暖到骨头里，把缠在脑子上的蛛网一并驱散——而我还没跟你说呢，Applebottom 夫人的苹果酒！简直就像神祇的甘露，真就是这么回事……”

~ Envisioned by Dwayne on Discord

"Oh, just wait ’til your weary feet feel the blissfully soft grass ’neath your achin’ soles—like walkin’ in the garden of heaven so it is. Nary a day goes by without the golden rays o’ the sun warming your bones and chasin’ away those cobwebs cloudin’ your mind—An’ I haven’ even told you about Mrs. Applebottom's Cider! Like the nectar of the gods so it is…"

~ Envisioned by Dwayne on Discord

这座要塞的石墙曾在某个过往时刻被烈焰亲吻，熏成焦黑；此刻它们仿佛在你逼近时一寸寸拔高，阴沉地压向你的身影。垛口檐下有移动掠过你的余光，你这才看清：成排的吸血蝙蝠倒挂在石构的下侧，密密麻麻，违和得近乎诡异——至于它们会留下来捍卫巢穴，还是一受惊便振翼散去，谁也说不准。通往要塞内部的甬道被精心雕琢、打磨，做成一张巨口大张的模样，像某种早被遗忘的庞大生物的咽喉，足以一口吞下马与车；那股寒意顺着你的脊背攀爬，怎么也压不下去。淡淡的血腥味——或许是刻意布置的假象，或许是真实的鲜血——被冷风裹挟着飘来，而那阵冷风竟像是从要塞自身深处吐出的呼息。
The stone walls of this keep, blackened by the kiss of flames at some point in its past, seem to loom over your approach. Movement from under the eaves of the parapet draws your eye, and you realize that rows of vampire bats cling to the underside of the stone structure, somehow—though whether they would stay to defend their homes or simply take wing if startled is anyone's guess. The passage leading into the keep has been shaped and polished to resemble the gaping maw of some long-forgotten creature large enough to swallow a horse and carriage in one gulp, sending a chill down your spine that is difficult to suppress. The faint smell of blood, either artificial or genuine, wafts on a cold wind that somehow seems to emanate from the keep itself.

Party Follows The Chosen One.name:
队伍追随天选之子
Party Follows The Chosen One

Text.text:
命运会格外留意它选中的棋子——哪怕他们自己并不明白，即将到来的风暴里他们扮演着什么角色。有些事超越凡俗的理解边界；命运的丝线盘结扭曲，浩瀚得令人无法想象，唯有极少数被选中的人才能窥见其一角。你面前的年轻女子照常在城中集市里度过一天，与顾客闲谈，和巡逻的卫兵擦肩而过，时光在喧嚣中流走；她浑然不觉，自己的生命即将以最出人意料的方式被彻底改写。

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

Fate takes great notice of its chosen players—even if they do not understand their role in what’s to come. Some things lie beyond mere mortal comprehension, and the twisting skeins of destiny are incomprehensibly vast to all but a chosen few. The young woman before you goes about her day in the city market, chatting with customers and passing guards as the hours pass, completely unaware that her life is about to change in the most unexpected of ways.

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

Dedicated Medical Ship: Sick Bay.name:
专用医疗舰：病舱
Dedicated Medical Ship: Sick Bay

Text.text:
当你踏入这艘医疗船洁净无瑕、白墙环绕的病房时，消毒剂那股刺鼻的化学气味轻轻撩拨着你的喉咙。身着笔挺制服的工作人员怀着怜悯与技能各司其职——照料着沿墙一排排安置在舒适病床上的病人。医疗器械的声响在此交织成一种奇异的节拍，仿佛这间房就是整艘船跳动的心脏。
The chemical tang of disinfectant tickles your throat as you enter the pristine white-walled sick bay of the medical vessel. Staff in pressed tunics go about their work with compassion and skill—managing patients in comfortable beds lined up along each wall. The sounds of medical apparatus form a curious rhythm here, as if this room is the very heart of the ship.

Cursed: Disadvantage On Ability Checks A.name:
诅咒：与体质相关的能力检定与豁免检定具有劣势
Cursed: Disadvantage On Ability Checks And Saving Throws Tied To Constitution

Text.text:
在一次全力挥动武器或施放高等级法术之后，在弓弦拉满又多撑了几秒之后，或是举起盾牌之后，你听见自己在喘鸣。血猛地冲上头顶，你愣了一瞬——没想到这一下竟要付出如此代价。骨头像要碎裂般脆弱，手腕与膝盖都在抗拒。每一次呼吸都像吞咽湿沙，而不管你此刻在做什么，你都只盼它快点结束。
After a full-force swing of a weapon or casting a high-level spell, after holding the pull on a bow for a few extra seconds or lifting your shield, you hear yourself wheezing. There’s a rush of blood to your head and a moment of surprise that the action cost you so much. Your bones feel brittle, your wrists and knees reluctant. Every breath feels like wet sand, and whatever you’re doing at the moment, you’d like it to end.

Tar Baby Ice.name:
焦油冰娃
Tar Baby Ice

Text.text:
你的手指怀着险恶的意图猛敲键盘。打破系统的渴望充斥全身，强烈到让你开始疏忽。你一失手，入侵反制措施立刻反扑，将你套住拖入数字虚空，死死捆缚。你被链接锁死，无法逃离——黑暗中一粒无助的微尘。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Your fingers pummel at the keyboard with nefarious intent. The need to break the system fills you, so much so, you become sloppy. Reacting to your screw-up, the intrusion countermeasures retaliate, ensnaring you and binding you in a digital void. You're link-locked, unable to flee—a helpless mote in the dark.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Plea From A Scorned Lover.name:
来自被弃恋人的哀求
Plea From A Scorned Lover

Text.text:
“若我的存在招致憎恶，那就让它来吧。与其你对我毫不在意，我宁愿你憎我入骨。”
“If my presence causes loathing, then so be it. I’d rather you despise me than spare me no thought at all.”

Loot From A Grig.name:
从格里格身上搜刮到的战利品
Loot From A Grig

Text.text:
你找到一只价值4金币的托盘。通往它的位置有一道痕迹，显示它曾被人费尽力气一路拖拽到此。拖痕旁还有几道细小的足迹，看起来像是蟋蟀留下的踪迹。
You find a platter worth 4 gold pieces. A trail up to it reveals that it was painstakingly dragged to its position. Alongside the drag mark are what appear to be cricket tracks.

Temple To A Dwarven God.name:
矮人神祇的神殿
Temple To A Dwarven God

Text.text:
铁与硫的锐烈气味、铁锤敲击铁砧的铿锵回响、锻炉灼人的热浪——神殿的一切景象、声响与触感，都被雕琢得一丝不苟的石柱所收拢；它们高高擎起穹顶，直冲云霄。每一面墙上连绵的壁画，描绘着矮人丰饶而沉重的历史：城市的兴建、战争的暴烈、余波之后的哀恸。闪烁的矿脉如银线般穿行于墙壁与立柱之间，在燃烧的火盆与噼啪吐火的火把照耀下，迸出凛冽的光。祭坛——实则是一座巨大的黑铁砧——上安放着此地信众视若生命的圣物：一柄嵌着符文的战锤，以及一只因数十年使用而被磨得温润光滑的酒杯。
The sharp smell of iron and sulfur, the ringing of hammers on anvils, and the blistering heat of the forge—the sights, sounds, and sensations of the temple are contained by immaculately carved stone pillars hoisting a soaring ceiling. Murals along each wall depict the rich history of the dwarves: the building of cities, the violence of war, the woe of aftermath. Streams of glittering minerals vein the walls and pillars, gleaming fiercely in the light of burning braziers and sputtering torches. An altar, in reality a massive black iron anvil, holds those artifacts vital to the worshippers here: a hammer inlaid with runes, and a tankard worn smooth from decades of use.

它几乎只比你的手掌大一点，细枝般的腿支撑着这只死鸟，显得脆弱得近乎不真实。生物的羽毛如同倾泻的瀑布，层层流淌着闪烁的蓝与绿；而它明亮的黄色胸脯仍倔强地鼓起，仿佛在抗拒既定的命运。
Barely larger than your palm, with twiglike legs, the dead bird seems impossibly delicate. The creature’s plumage is a beautiful cascade of shimmering blues and greens, like a tumbling waterfall, and its bright yellow chest is still puffed out in defiance of its fate.

Heirloom Description Overheard At The Ta.name:
传家宝描述：酒馆里偷听到的闲谈
Heirloom Description Overheard At The Tavern

Text.text:
“这把刀？在我家传了好多年了，没错。鬼知道它最早从哪儿来的。不过它确实有点邪门——满月底下会发光。”
“This knife? Been in my family for years, yeah. No idea where it came from. It’s an odd thing, though—seems to glow under a full moon.”

红羽血鹰与同伴一道在头顶盘旋，凶相毕露，搜寻着能轻易撕碎的猎物，好用它们刀锋般锐利的喙将其肢解。就连水牛或狮子这般大型生物，也曾被这些空中猎手夺去性命；你不由得一次又一次抬眼向上，确认它们今天是否也在觊觎类人生物的血肉盛宴。
The red-feathered blood hawk circles menacingly overhead with its fellows, searching for easy prey to tear apart with their razor-sharp beaks. Even large creatures such as buffalo or lions have been known to meet their end from these aerial hunters, and you cannot help but slide your eyes upward from time to time to make certain that they are not looking to feast upon humanoid flesh this day.

Aberrant Spelljammer Emerges Spectacular.name:
畸变的拼接魔船自月面壮丽破出，惊世登场
Aberrant Spelljammer Emerges Spectacularly From Moon

Text.text:
你脚下的阳台忽然震颤起来。你抬眼一瞥，目睹不可能之景。两轮月亮如常低悬夜空，但那颗较小的卫星却仿佛正在扭曲、变异，表面隆起鼓胀，肉眼可见地变形。紧接着，那布满坑洼的外壳轰然炸裂——一场撼天动地的喷发将月岩狂吐进虚无——而在翻涌的碎屑云中，一艘鹦鹉螺形的飞船轰鸣着冲入空间。它银色的船体随着逸散的能量明灭脉动，宛如末日的先兆。

~ 一位英雄设想

The balcony you stand upon suddenly vibrates. Glancing upward, you witness impossibility. The two moons hang low in the night sky as usual, but the smaller satellite seems to be distorting, mutating, its surface bulging and deforming. Then the pitted crust bursts—a titanic eruption of lunar rock vomiting into the void—and from the cloud of debris a nautilus shaped craft powers into space. Its silvery hull pulses with discharging energies, like a harbinger of doom.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Glamoured Studded Leather.name:
魅惑铆钉皮甲
Glamoured Studded Leather

Text.text:
随着一句咒言，锃亮的皮质护甲骤然变幻，化作截然不同的新形态。一阵粼粼的光波掠过整套装备，点亮胸甲铆钉上精雕细琢的魔法符号——幻象随之成形。
With a word, the polished leather armor transforms, taking on a completely new form. A shimmering wave washes over the set, activating the magical symbols etched delicately into the studs of the cuirass—and an illusion takes shape.

High Seas: Speeding Through The Waves.name:
公海：乘风破浪疾驰
High Seas: Speeding Through The Waves

Text.text:
船身压着浪头疾驰，木板在风帆的牵拽下咯吱作响，像套上车辕的马在挽具里绷紧肌肉。你知道那匹马本能跑得比这艘船更快，可当你望着船首下方飞掠而过的世界时，却很难把这种速度想象成马蹄的奔腾。
The ship bears down over the waves, wood straining under the pull of the sails like a horse in a wagon’s harness. You know that horse could run faster than the ship, but it’s hard to imagine it as you watch the world race by beneath the bow.

Gloves Of Swimming And Climbing.name:
游泳与攀爬手套
Gloves Of Swimming And Climbing

Text.text:
将这双带有罗纹与纹理的棕色手套套上双手时，你对其触感大感意外——既非皮革，亦非布料，而是介于两者之间的异样材质。掌心部分在按压坚硬表面时会隐约泛出黏涩感，或许能在攀墙时助你一臂之力，却丝毫不妨碍你对武器的操控。手套贴合得近乎严丝合缝，你几乎相信它们能防水，却并不令人难受。它们是否也能在游泳时派上用场？
Pulling these ribbed and textured brown gloves onto your hands, you are surprised at the feel of the material—neither leather nor cloth, but something between the two. The material along the palms feels vaguely tacky when pressed against a solid surface, which might help if scaling a wall, yet does not interfere with your weapon handling. The gloves are so tight that you believe them to be waterproof, yet are not uncomfortable. Might they also assist in swimming?

地形崎岖嶙峋，锯齿般尖利，一块块岩板以怪异而歪斜的角度突兀翘起——宛如龟裂的石板路。穿行其间将异常艰难，危险的棱缘随时会勾住靴底、马蹄铁与车轮。
The terrain is rugged, jagged, with plates of stone jutting up at odd and crooked angles—resembling cracked flagstones. It will be difficult to traverse, with perilous edges prone to snagging on boots, horseshoes, and wagon wheels.

Arrival To The Faerie Plane.name:
抵达妖精位面
Arrival To The Faerie Plane

Text.text:
你落在起伏草甸那海绵般柔软的草地上，触感鲜明得仿佛远处轻轻奏起的乐声也能握在掌心。壁炉旁的古老传说、由华丽戏班搬演的剧目在你脑海里嗡鸣，像一团团长着翅膀的小生灵云雾盘旋。空气里满是回响——从精灵的嗓音到远古原初者的吐息……你怀疑落地时是否磕到了头，眨了眨眼，却见一切既美丽又令人胆寒——明耀的丘陵与幽暗的林地——林间有一棵树，独自诉说着跨越诸世的编年史。
You land on the spongy grass of a rolling meadow, as palpable as the distant music softly playing. Old stories from the hearth and plays delivered by flamboyant troupes buzz in your mind like little clouds of winged beings. The air is filled with echoes—from elven voices to the breathing of ancient Primordials . . . You wonder if you knocked your head on the landing and blink your eyes, but all is beautiful and intimidating—brilliant hills and dark woods—where one tree in a grove tells a chronicle of ages.

Insult From A Mortally Wounded Noble.name:
来自一位濒死贵族的辱骂
Insult From A Mortally Wounded Noble

Text.text:
“遗言？我有一大堆，但会随我一同带走。你的耳朵不配听。”
“Last words? I have many, but they’re coming with me. Your ears aren’t worthy of hearing them.”

Road Through Farmland.name:
穿越农田的道路
Road Through Farmland

Text.text:
朴素的土路在乡野间蜿蜒穿行，将一望无际的麦田、玉米地与稻田一分为二。桥梁横跨小溪与灌溉水渠，清冽的水流沿着沟渠奔走，把甘泉送往四周的庄稼。远处有细小的人影在田里劳作，顶着烈日弓着背，一刻不停地耕作。偶尔，你会瞥见一座农舍孤零零地立在辽阔的天际线上，烟囱里升起袅袅炊烟，也不禁想象那窗缝间飘出的诱人香气。
The simple, dirt road winds across the countryside, bisecting sprawling fields of wheat, corn, and rice. Bridges span streams and irrigation channels that carry fresh water to the surrounding crops. Tiny figures work the fields in the distance, hunched over in the sun as they toil. Occasionally, you catch sight of a farmhouse perched on the vast horizon, smoke curling from its chimney, and imagine enticing smells wafting from its windows.

I Calm An Upset Horse.name:
我安抚一匹受惊的马
I Calm An Upset Horse

Text.text:
我摊开手掌，小心翼翼地朝那只惊惶的野兽挪步，低声轻哄着安抚它。我缓缓吐出受控的长息，一步步逼近，确保自己的存在沉稳而克制，同时将手伸向它。它在我的接触下微微惊起、浑身紧绷，但当我轻柔地抚过它、以安慰的力道拍了拍它的肋侧时，我能感觉到它的身体渐渐松弛下来。
With an open hand, I step gingerly toward the frantic beast, cooing softly to reassure them. I exhale slow, controlled breaths and advance, ensuring my presence is calm and collected as I reach out to them. They bridle at my touch, but I feel their body relax when I stroke them softly and pat their flank with comforting pressure.

Quip By A Paladin About Honor.name:
圣骑士关于荣誉的俏皮话
Quip By A Paladin About Honor

Text.text:
“我行事守荣，不是为了换取通往浩瀚众界的路。荣誉不是对未来的投资；它是对当下的反叛。它蔑视虚伪，也蔑视我们那些逼迫我们自私行事的卑劣本能。它证明我们这些凡人，纵然肉身脆弱、寿命短暂，也能凭自身成就为神祇。”
“I do not behave honorably to ensure my passage to the great beyond. Honor is not an investment in the future; it is a rebellion against the present. A defiance of dishonesty and all of our baser instincts that demand we behave selfishly. It is proof that we mortals, despite our frail bodies and short lives, can become gods in our own right.”

Falling Block Trap.name:
坠落方块陷阱
Falling Block Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 你的移动在脚尖即将触到一根埋伏的绊线前戛然而止，仅差几寸。它巧妙地伪装在小径尘土之中。顺着绊线的走向，你发现墙边暗藏着一套机关，一路延伸到天花板——显然是要在毫无戒心的闯入者头顶上“塌房”。只要抬脚跨过去就能简单绕开，但若有盗贼工具包里的油灰与钢丝钳，你确信可以轻松将其解除。

[触发] 有人绊到了那根线。尽管你竭力躲避机关的杀招，伤害仍可能降临。唯一的警告，是一阵令人作呕的碾磨声——石与石相互咬碎的惨响——随后，一块巨大的岩石块径直砸落在你身上，冷酷无情，致命至极。

[Perceived] You stop your movement mere inches before your foot touches a waiting tripwire, cleverly camouflaged in the surrounding dust of the path. Following the track of the wire, you see that a mechanism hidden along the wall leads up to the ceiling, presumably to bring down the house on any unwitting intruders. It can be simply bypassed by stepping over it, but with some putty and wire cutters from a thieves’ toolkit, you believe this trap can be easily disarmed.

[Triggered] Someone has tripped the wire. Despite the care taken in avoiding the trap’s payload, harm may yet befall you. A hideous grinding sound, that of stone on stone, is your only warning before an enormous block of rock simply falls on you, merciless and deadly.

I Use Horde Breaker.name:
我使用“破阵斩群”
I Use Horde Breaker

Text.text:
目标挨得这么近，我便瞄准那些能让我的攻击贯穿一名敌人、再撞上另一名的角度。每一发力道十足的射击，我都要它同时带走两个目标，而不是一个。看着同伴倒下，我的对手该明白这是警告：要么立刻散开，要么就让这场战斗更快结束在失败里。
With targets so close to each other, I aim at places that increase the chance of my attacks blowing through one foe into another. Each mighty shot I mean for two targets instead of one. Watching comrades fall, my opponents should take warning. Either scatter or lose this fight all the faster.

Rockslide Destroys Bridge.name:
落石崩塌摧毁桥梁
Rockslide Destroys Bridge

Text.text:
山巅附近翻涌起一团土黄色的尘雾，巨石开始沿着山坡失控狂冲，翻滚着碾过大地、破空而下。地面随之轰鸣震颤，巨石砸落时雷霆般的冲击将草地轰成焦灼的赤红裸土，又在山脚的河面上炸起一柱柱白色水花。横跨河流的一座桥——一座宏伟的木制构架，连接着两侧峭壁——在震耳欲聋的崩塌声中被碎石雨猛击。忽然，一块巨岩从尘雾里猛然闯出，狠狠撞上桥身，生生扯裂支撑。整座桥轰然坠向下方河道，砸进翻腾的急流之中。
Tan dust billows near the peak of a mountain as large rocks begin to careen down the mountainside, tumbling over the earth and through the air. The ground rumbles as the rocks land with thundering impacts that turn grass to blasted, red earth and send up columns of white spray in the river at the mountain’s feet. A bridge over the water—a grand wooden construct connecting two cliffs—is pummeled by the rubble in a deafening clatter. Suddenly, a boulder lurches from the dust and hits the bridge, sundering its supports. The entire thing falls to the river below, crashing into the churning rapids.

Temple Encompassed By Magical Dome.name:
被魔法穹顶笼罩的神殿
Temple Encompassed By Magical Dome

Text.text:
这座神殿以许多代人之前的土质厚重石块工法筑成。仿佛仍归属于脚下的大地，它显得岿然不动、固若金汤。你无法跨过门槛；当你试图迈入时，便隐约觉出，这里既是神殿，也是巢穴。就在那一刻，屏障浮现——一座苍白的魔法能量穹顶向外蔓延。它让石材崩解，碾磨剥落，露出其下隐藏的繁复而精致的纹饰。

~ 构想：Mitch Prince

The temple is built with earthy, solid block techniques from many generations before. As if it still belongs to the ground beneath it, the temple seems immovable, impregnable. You cannot pass the threshold, and when you try, you get the sense that this is as much a lair as it is a temple. That is when the barrier emerges, a dome of pale magical energy creeping outward. It crumbles the stone, grinding it away to the intricate and delicate designs hidden underneath.

~ Envisioned by Mitch Prince

Magical Detection Of An Artificer's Clas.name:
魔法侦测：奇械师的职业
Magical Detection Of An Artificer's Class

Text.text:
你的魔法洞见只在你眼中显现：一张金色网格缠绕在你的目标身上，宛如一幅数学制图，标注着象征性的量测数据与参照代码。随着目标移动，这些代码与图样随之变动——重新演算——继而渐渐淡去。
Your magical insight appears, only to you, as a golden mesh wrapped around your target: a mathematical drawing complete with symbolic measurements and reference codes. As the target moves, the codes and designs change—recount—then fade away.

Loot From An Mezzoloth.name:
来自一名安·梅佐洛斯的战利品
Loot From An Mezzoloth

Text.text:
它的躯体被撕裂成两半，终极罗刹倒伏死去，淡紫色的血浸染了它那身精致的丝绸衣裳。你在它的腰带上发现一只缀着刺绣的精美皮囊，里面装着它完成上一份契约后得到的报酬：1000枚金币与50枚铂金币，但这些钱币的铸纹却陌生而诡异。
Its body rent asunder, the Ultroloth lies dead, lilac blood staining its fine silk clothing. On its belt you find an embroidered pouch of exquisite leather containing the payment for its last completed contract: 1000 gold pieces and 50 platinum pieces, though the coins are minted in a strange design.

Half-orc Uses Cry Of Destruction.name:
半兽人发出毁灭之嚎
Half-orc Uses Cry Of Destruction

Text.text:
女人扎稳脚跟，脸上扯出野兽般的狞笑，猛地倒吸一口气，胸膛随之鼓胀。两根寒光闪烁的獠牙衬得她的下颌更显骇人；当她挟着暴风般的怒意放声咆哮，一道音波自口中轰然奔涌，爆裂般的力量席卷而出。

~ Envisioned by Puffernami

Planting her feet, the woman wearing a bestial snarl takes a sharp intake of breath as her chest swells. Two gleaming tusks accentuate her formidable jaw, and, as she bellows with tempestuous fury, a sonic wave rushes from her mouth with explosive force.

~ Envisioned by Puffernami

I Practice Martial Arts To Release Stres.name:
我练武来释放压力
I Practice Martial Arts To Release Stress

Text.text:
我踏入这片空间，将日常责任的桎梏尽数卸下。披上熟悉的装备，扯紧那条彩色腰带，赤足贴地，让自己稳稳扎根。无论对手是陪练伙伴还是沙袋，我都能感觉压力从体内蒸发殆尽。
I’ve removed the trappings of my daily obligations by stepping into this space. Pulling on the familiar kit and tugging on the colored belt, I ground myself on bare soles. Whether my opponent is a sparring partner or a punching dummy, I feel stress evaporate from my body.

你掌中那只由红宝石雕琢的纤细小瓶闪耀如凝火结晶。你以恶魔的语言高声呼喝，嗓音冷硬而不容置疑。你倾斜小瓶，将一汪血之奠酒洒在脚边。你俯身行礼，指尖挥洒如运笔行书，倏然划过血泊。血液随即翻涌嘶鸣，所书的符印灼烙般自地面浮现。猩红的烈焰骤然绽放——一尊骇人的灵体显现，披着可怖恶魔的外貌。
The slender vial carved from ruby gleams like crystallized fire in your hand. You call out in a fiendish tongue, your voice hard and unyielding. You tilt the vial and pour a libation of blood at your feet. Bowing, your finger swoops through the blood with calligraphic aplomb. The blood begins to seethe and hiss, as the scribed glyph brands itself into the ground. An inferno of scarlet appears—and a fearsome spirit, clothed in the guise of a terrible fiend.

这片海底森林一眼望不到尽头。高长的茎秆与成簇的绿叶在海潮温柔的推拉间摇曳。生物穿梭于繁茂的植丛之间，其中不乏线条流畅、灰色的鲨鱼。
This underwater forest stretches as far as the eye can see. The long stalks and bunches of green leaves sway in the gentle push and pull of the sea. Creatures weave between the growths, including sleek, gray sharks.

这是一名战士的面容与风姿——一位光辉的天界圣武士。自发光的光环与羽翼起，直至那柄绿刃镶边、金饰收口的巨剑剑尖，她既散发慈和，又以威仪令人肃然。她白发垂肩，映着古铜色的脸庞，一双璀璨的翠绿眼眸如星芒灼亮。身形精瘦而强韧，年轻的生命力在她周身流光般跃动。天界血裔披着锁子甲而立，双肩方正，荣誉如铠。

~ Played by Atomika with

Here is the countenance and bearing of a soldier, a celestial paladin of radiance. From a luminous halo and wings to the tip of a green-edged greatsword trimmed in gold, she commands respect even while she emanates kindness. Her hair is white and falls to her shoulders around a tan face with brilliant green eyes. She is lean and strong, glowing with vital youth. The celestialkin stands clad in chainmail, her shoulders squared with honor.

~ Played by Atomika with

One Day Of Travel By Horse On Road.name:
在道路上骑马旅行的一天
One Day Of Travel By Horse On Road

Text.text:
黎明时分，你跨上坐骑，沿着道路蜿蜒的曲线策马前行。途经一汪宁静的池塘时，你让马低头啜饮澄澈的清水；你又两次停下，用一顿寒酸的饭果腹，也放任马儿在路旁啃食草叶，它感激地咀嚼着。路标一路指引你抵达目的地；当夕阳沉入远方丘陵之后，你终于在眼前找到了目标。你轻拍坐骑的颈项。
You mount your steed at dawn and ride along the road's winding path. When you pass a tranquil pond, you allow the horse to drink from the clear water, and you stop twice for a meager meal, allowing the horse to graze, which it does thankfully. Signage directs you to your destination, and as the sun dips behind the distant hills, you find your objective before you. You pat your mount's neck.

车轮滚动的喧嚣与商贩的叫卖声在广场上回荡。靠近中央，一座雕饰繁复的大理石与铜质喷泉汩汩作响，溅起零星水珠，落在下方的鹅卵石路面上。区域外缘一排长椅依次排开，三五成群的人们在此逗留，谈笑声轻快。长椅之外，店铺正对广场，每一家都人气鼎盛，无论镇民还是旅人都趋之若鹜。
The clamor of rolling wagons and shouting merchants carries through the square. Near the center, an ornate marble and copper fountain gurgles, splashing stray droplets onto the cobblestone below. Several benches line the outer rim of the area, where small groups loiter and cheerily. Past the benches, shops face the square, and each seems to be popular with townspeople and travelers alike.

Wild Magic Surge: Regeneration.name:
狂野魔法涌动：再生
Wild Magic Surge: Regeneration

Text.text:
你完成法术，随即感到复苏的魔法如襁褓般将你拥入怀中——振奋、支撑、治疗。宛如抚慰体魄的一剂药膏。
You complete your spell, then feel the swaddling embrace of recuperative magic around you—invigorating, supporting, healing. A balm for your constitution.

Bronze Buckle For A Wide Belt.name:
宽腰带用青铜扣
Bronze Buckle For A Wide Belt

Text.text:
搭扣呈板状，如同一面盾牌，上面刻着家族纹章，边缘以一缕细若游丝的蓝色玻璃镶饰。
The buckle is plate-shaped, like a shield, engraved with a family crest and trimmed with a fine thread of blue glass.

Cyberpsychosis Support Group.name:
赛博精神病支援小组
Cyberpsychosis Support Group

Text.text:
仓库里一盏作业灯下，几把椅子围成半圆。每把椅子都刻意拉开距离，预留出与会者可能突然痉挛的空间。在场每个人身上都留着被摘除义体强化的痕迹：缺失的肢体，或胸口与头颅上深深的凹陷。

“今天谁愿意先开始？”一个眼神疲惫、山羊胡凌乱的男人问道。他的声音轻柔，带着父亲般的安抚意味，双臂向外张开，像是在欢迎也像在恳求。他的手臂上纵横着沟槽——那里曾经嵌着粗大的线缆。

一个头侧有巨大空腔的人举起了手。他消瘦的脸上，眼睛显得格外大而遥远。“我——我——我昨晚梦到我妈妈了，”他们带着轻微的结巴说道，“这次她是她的真、真脸。不是——不是那种雪花。”他们打了个寒战，像被阴影纠缠着。

Chairs sit in a semicircle under one of the working lights in the warehouse, each chair set far enough apart from the others to account for the unpredictable spasms from the attendees. Every person present bears the mark of a removed cybernetic enhancement: missing limbs or deep divots in their chests and heads.

“Who would like to start us off today?” asks a man with tired eyes and a messy goatee. He speaks in a soft, paternal tone, and holds his arms out in welcoming supplication. Trenches run up his arms, where thick wiring used to be.

A person with a deep cavity on one side of their head raises a hand, their eyes large and distant in their gaunt face. “I-I-I dreamt of my mom last night,” they say with a slight stutter. “She had her r-real face this time. N-not the—not the static.” They shiver, hauntedly.

I Cast Wind Walk From My Necklace Of Pra.name:
我从祈祷珠项链中施放了《化风成行》
I Cast Wind Walk From My Necklace Of Prayer Beads

Text.text:
我祈祷着，项链覆在手背上，珠子静躺在掌心，朋友们环绕在我身旁。短短几秒，我便感到身轻如羽、胸中气息充盈。随后不过半分钟，我们都成了朦胧的轮廓，仿佛池水里映出的自己。再往后的每隔几秒，我们愈发化作雾，再凝成一小团云，一同升起，像身后有狂风推动般疾行而去。
At prayer with the necklace over my hand and the bead in my palm, my friends surround me. Over a few seconds, I feel buoyant and full of breath. Then, in half a minute, we are all vague shapes, like reflections of ourselves in a pool. Every few seconds that follow we turn more to mist, and then to a small cloud, lifting together and traveling as if a gale were behind us.

I Cast Fiendish Vigor.name:
我施放邪魔活力
I Cast Fiendish Vigor

Text.text:
我停下脚步，深深吸了一口气。无数幽光般的微粒——大小不一——随我的呼吸浮现，悄然钻入体内。它们在我胸腔里流淌，短暂地自内而外点亮了我。我的眼眸一闪。光点逐一熄灭时，我也随之重焕生机。
I pause and inhale deeply. Specks of ghostly light—many sizes—appear and slip into me with my breath. They flow in and illuminate me briefly from inside. My eyes flash. As the lights wink out, I am revitalized.

I Cast Eldritch Spear.name:
我施放「怪异长矛」
I Cast Eldritch Spear

Text.text:
我吟诵咒文，召来一枚嘶嘶作响、翻涌着幽蓝能量的飞镖。我没有用手势将它轻轻弹出，而是蓄势一拧身，伴着一声凶厉的怒喝将它猛掷出去，命令它若有必要便飞出百步之遥。它撕裂空气疾射而去，替我夺命。
I incant to summon a hissing dart of roiling blue force. Instead of flicking it forth with a gesture, I wind up and hurl it with a fierce cry, commanding it to fly a hundred paces if it must. It streaks away to deal death for me.

I Convince A Patron To Hire Me.name:
我说服一位赞助人雇用我
I Convince A Patron To Hire Me

Text.text:
“我敢肯定你见过不少佣兵和受雇的刀客，但真正的英雄——抱歉，我靴子上还粘着一小片龙鳞……好了。现在我向你保证，我和我那群快活的伙伴不只是把胜利送到你手上；我们还会以足够的风采完成你的委托，风采到足以让人传唱多年。”
“I’m sure you’ve met your fair share of mercenaries and blades for hire, but how many genuine heroes— Sorry, a little dragon scale still stuck to my boot… There we go. Now, I promise you, me and my merry band will not just deliver victory, but we’ll accomplish your task with enough style to guarantee it is sung about for years to come.”

Magical Tattoo Of Enhance Ability.name:
强化能力的魔法纹身
Magical Tattoo Of Enhance Ability

Text.text:
纹身是一只轮盘，轮盘的每一根辐条末端都是一颗兽首。它在奥术能量的嗡鸣中苏醒，在皮肤下缓缓转动。熊首转到眼前时低吼，狐首眯眼嘶嘶作响。它依次掠过鹰与鸮，公牛与猫，直到你接触轮盘，说出其中一只动物的魔法真言。你感到它的效果——强化你自身能力中那股原始的冲动。

~ 由 SuperDave 构想的

The tattoo is a wheel, and each of its spokes is the head of an animal. It activates with a hum of arcane energy and slowly turns on the skin below it. The bear growls as it comes around, the fox squints and hisses. It cycles through eagle and owl, bull and cat, until you touch the wheel and speak the magical word of one of the animals. You feel its effect, strengthening the primal urge of your own ability.

~ Envisioned by SuperDave
