[外景] 漫漫长路足以磨蚀最坚定的意志，拖垮最强健的身躯。而此刻——你浑身糊满泥尘，寒意透骨，饥肠辘辘——路边客栈的身影映入眼帘：一顿热饭与一张暖床的寄望，催着你加快脚步。道路旁那栋朴素而结实的建筑一侧挨着小马厩，另一侧则是石砌水井与仓房。瓶玻璃窗映着来路，门楣上的木牌以粗犷的刻字写着旅店之名。 [内景] 炉火的暖意与食物的香气一阵阵飘来，将你牵到桌旁：一大杯泛着泡沫的麦酒、一盘堆满肉食的餐盘，再加上侍者递来的笑容，只需寥寥几枚铜币的微薄价格便可换得。 [Outside] The road wears down even the strongest of wills, even the hardiest of bodies. And now—caked as you are in mud and dust, chilled and hungry—the sight of the roadhouse, the promise of a hot meal and a warm bed, spurs you forward. The simple, sturdy building beside the road is flanked on one side by a small stable, and on the other by a stone well and a storehouse. The bottle-glass windows look out onto the road, and a placard over the door gives the inn's name in blocky, etched letters. [Inside] The warmth of the fire and the wafting aromas of food draw you to a table, where a foaming tankard, a plate laden with meat, and a smile from the server come at the meager price of a few coppers.

空气愈发阴冷，一道幽魂般的身影自阴影中凝现，空灵而哀戚。她的气场散发出令人窒息的孤寂感，举手投足皆承载着千年的苦难。沉沦于悲恸的深渊，她在无声的哀伤中徘徊，宛如倦怠与深重哀痛的化身。
The air grows chill, and from the shadows materializes a spectral figure, etheric and mournful. Her aura emanates a crushing feeling of forlornness, her movements bearing millennia of suffering. Lost in a gulf of grief, she wanders in silent sorrow, an avatar of ennui and profound woe.

Beacon Of Aid.name:
援助灯塔
Beacon Of Aid

Text.text:
如果使用者远离近在咫尺的援助，这座信标的光芒便骤然暴涨，随即笔直射入天穹。它从一只由陶瓷与咒唤魔法铸成的罐中涌出，将一道脉冲沿光柱向上送去，直到那呼唤在云层上炸开，洒出醒目的讯号。

~ 构想：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

If the user is far enough from immediate help, this beacon’s light flares and then fires straight into the sky. It emits from a pot of ceramic and conjuration magic, sending a pulse up through the light beam until it splashes the clouds with its call.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

New Kickboxing Studio.name:
全新开张的踢拳馆
New Kickboxing Studio

Text.text:
健身房里的一切都崭新而清爽。这里还没有那种渗进墙缝与器械深处、混杂着汗水与拼搏的陈旧气味，尽管有几位正在沙袋前挥拳的客人正竭尽全力想把它“养”出来。他们的喘息与击打声很快被沿墙高端音箱里震耳欲聋的音乐吞没。
Everything in the gym is new and fresh. There's no deep-seated smell of sweat and effort yet, though several patrons working on punching bags are doing their best to change that. Their sounds of exertion and impact are drowned out by blaring music from high-end speakers along the walls.

Secret Chest Cast With An Expensive Repl.name:
用昂贵的赝品施放的秘宝箱
Secret Chest Cast With An Expensive Replica

Text.text:
人们常说轻装旅行更划算。可这回，代价反倒高得惊人。你要藏在以太位面上的那只箱子本身就是一份宝藏，而你用来把它取回的微缩复制品也绝非便宜货。
They say it pays to travel light. In this case, it’s rather expensive. The chest you’re going to hide on the Ethereal Plane is a treasure in its own right, and the miniature replica you’ll use to retrieve it didn’t come cheap either.

Stony Beach: Rain.name:
岩石海滩：雨
Stony Beach: Rain

Text.text:
连绵不绝的倾盆大雨将目之所及的一切浇得透湿，雨水如雾般充塞空中，把地平线拉得更近。沙滩的低洼处积起水洼，新生的细流沿着岸线奔淌，汇入翻涌的浪花。噼啪四溅的雨点声吞没了部分涛声，而浪涛又反过来将雨声吞入其中。
A steady downpour drenches everything in sight, drawing the horizon closer as the rain fills the air like fog. Water pools in depressions on the beach, and new streams run down the shore into the waves. The spattering patter of drips swallows some of the sound of the waves, but the waves swallow the rain in turn.

Ogre Eating At Campfire.name:
篝火旁进食的食人魔
Ogre Eating At Campfire

Text.text:
一头神色警惕的食人魔坐在倒塌的树干上，身旁篝火噼啪作响，他一边品味着手中的食物，一边在这片未驯的荒野里偷得片刻安宁。每一口都慢而有序，显然在享受滋味；可他的目光却始终谨慎地扫过四周，提防着不速之客。
Sitting on a collapsed tree, a wary-looking ogre savors his meal beside a crackling fire, finding a modicum of peace here in the untamed wilds. Each bite is slow, methodical, obviously enjoying the food, but he scans his surroundings with cautious eyes, watchful for intruders.

Magical Bookseller's Boat.name:
魔法书商之舟
Magical Bookseller's Boat

Text.text:
这艘船看起来更像一座漂浮的工坊，而不是一条普通小艇：平坦的甲板上摆着几摞方方正正、高矮不一的堆叠物，一根细长的烟囱咕嘟咕嘟喷吐出一团紫与银交织的烟云。一名海精灵掌着舵，他的皮肤覆着万花筒般的绿蓝鳞纹；船尾立着一座抬高的平台，舵位就升在其上。他纹身密布的双手随意搭在黄铜舵轮上，朝下方的船员吆喝。他的同伴是蝾螈族——步态扭摆，皮肤上炸开橙、绿、蓝的斑斓飞溅——正忙忙碌碌穿梭于甲板之间。一人照看着船上狭长的帆，帆面绘着一册书与其上方繁星王冠的徽记。另一人小心翼翼抱着一只箱子，尾巴绷得像探水杖一般，船身在水面起伏摇晃，他却稳稳保持着平衡。

~ Pirate King 构想的 Envisioned

The vessel seems more a floating workshop than a simple boat: a few square stacks of different heights sit on a flat deck, and a thin funnel pumps out a cloud of purple and silver. A sea elf, skin a kaleidoscopic pattern of green and blue scales, captains the helm, which rises up on a platform at the stern. His tattooed hands rest casually on the brass wheel as he calls down to his crew. His mates are salamander-folk—their gaits wiggly and skin bursting with splashes of orange, green, and blue—bustling about the deck. One tends to the boat’s oblong sails, painted with the symbol of a book bearing a starry crown. Another carries a crate with the utmost care, his tail taut as a dowsing rod, keeping his balance as the boat bobs in the water.

~ Envisioned by Pirate King

Bane The Merciful, Aka \"Tim\".name:
慈悲的灾厄，又名“提姆”
Bane The Merciful, Aka "Tim"

Text.text:
宽松的棕黑层叠长袍披在身上，再加上一张描绘着毫无表情的人类面孔的面具，让人几乎无法分辨这名高挑瘦削的男人究竟是谁。面具上刻着一只骷髅手掌与一枚对称的白色十字，而他右肩上也有一枚与之成对的十字。褐发被他剪得很短，露出微微尖起的耳朵。他的双手修长，肤色苍白，关节突起分明。他随身带着好几个小袋与两只挎包，腰带里还别着几把小刀。

~ 扮演者 aSeptagonBullet，使用

Loose, layered robes of brown and black, and a mask depicting an emotionless human face, make it hard to tell who this tall, lean man is. The mask bears a skeletal hand, along with a symmetrical white cross, which has a twin on his right shoulder. He keeps his brown hair cropped short, revealing slightly pointed ears. His hands are slender, pale skinned with prominent joints. He carries several pouches and two satchels, along with a few small knives tucked into his belt.

~ Played by aSeptagonBullet with

刀柄一经接触便透着温热，抛光的黑曜石在你掌心下光滑如镜。长剑震鸣着几乎难以遏制的力量——如同沉睡的火山——当你吐出命令词时，一股肾上腺素般的激流刺穿全身。剑刃轰然爆燃，迸发出炽白耀目的烈焰。
The blade’s hilt is warm to the touch, the polished obsidian smooth against your palm. The sword resonates with barely contained power—like a dormant volcano—and a rush of adrenaline lances through you as you speak the command word. The blade erupts with incandescent flames.

Nightmare About A Murderous Ogre.name:
关于嗜杀食人魔的噩梦
Nightmare About A Murderous Ogre

Text.text:
食人魔把你撞翻在地，将那只恶臭的脚重重踩在你胸口，把你肺里的气硬生生挤了出去。他那未经洗涤的皮肉气味与景象充斥你的意识。他低吼一声，抡起木棒。随着他的重心一移，你体内猛然炸开剧痛——几根肋骨在触感里接连断裂。片刻之后，你朋友的头也砸在你身旁的地上，脖颈扭曲，双眼凝固，嘴巴大张……皮肉毫无血色。巨人带着恶意的欢愉俯视着你，木棒高高举起。武器砸落。

~ Envisioned by BigMacDaddy

The ogre knocks you down and plants his fetid foot on your chest, forcing the wind out of you. The scent and view of his unwashed flesh fills your awareness. He grunts, swinging his club. As his weight shifts, agony shoots through you as you feel several ribs give. Your friend’s head hits the ground alongside yours after a moment, neck twisted, eyes fixed, mouth agape… flesh bloodless. The giant stares down at you with malicious glee, club raised. The weapon comes down.

~ Envisioned by BigMacDaddy

法术的最后一个音节化作一声嗡鸣，从你唇间震颤而出。随之你的身影扭曲颤动，在你周身分裂出十余个阴影化身，抖跳着环绕你的身体。
The last syllable of the spell comes out as a hum that vibrates your lips. In response your image shifts and shudders, creating a dozen shadow selves that judder about your body.

这只袋子看起来毫不起眼：边缘磨损、颜色褪去，甚至还带着一股说不出的怪味。然而，布面上缝着的诡异符号、它沉甸甸的分量，以及从袋内隐约渗出的细微低语——你明白，这绝非寻常的小袋。探手进去，你摸到的是一把干豆子——每一颗都是一种可能，每一颗都是一次机缘。里面潜伏着怎样的凶险？又将引发何等奇妙的事件？
The bag seems innocuous: frayed, faded, an odd smell to it even. But the strange symbol stitched on the fabric, the weight of it, and the barely perceptible whispers emanating from within—you know this is no mere pouch. Inside, you find dried beans—each a possibility, each an opportunity. What dangers lurk within? What wondrous events await to transpire?

缝衣针般的尖牙扭成一抹施虐的笑，小魔怪（特征）歪着头向你致意。生物琥珀色的眼睛闪烁着无魂的恶意，头颅两侧折叠的耳朵轻轻抽动，迫不及待想要见血。它用一只破旧的袜子当作兜裆布，其余精瘦的身躯尽数裸露。皮肉呈新淤青般的紫色，在头骨与肩膀处裂开，石质般的角突刺破而出。它握着一把巨大的铁钥匙当作匕首，磨得锋利，带着阴冷的锐意。
Teeth like sewing needles twist into a sadistic smile as the gremlin tilts their head in greeting. The creature's amber eyes twinkle with soulless malice, and the folded ears extending from the sides of their head twitch, eager for violence. They wear a raggedy sock as a loincloth, leaving the rest of their lean body exposed. Their flesh is the purple of a new bruise and splits around the skull and shoulders where stone-like protrusions of horn poke through. They carry a large iron key like a dagger, sharpened to a bitter edge.

Prehistoric Dinosaur Breeders.name:
史前恐龙饲育者
Prehistoric Dinosaur Breeders

Text.text:
孵化洞窟温暖而昏暗，潮湿的空气被洞穴下方隆隆作响的地热喷口不断送来新息。沿着绘满纹彩的洞壁，凿出的壁龛里堆着一窝窝收拢的稻草，安稳地托着一簇簇卵，静静躺在其中。两名育种者在洞内来回巡行，细心照看着卵群，警惕着任何即将破壳而出的征兆。
The hatchery is warm and dark as the humid air is constantly refreshed by the rumbling geothermal vents beneath the cave. Nests of gathered straw rest snugly in alcoves carved along the painted cavern walls with clutches of eggs nestled safely within. A pair of breeders make their way around the cave, attending to the eggs and watching for any signs of arrival.

Speech About The Thrill Of The Hunt.name:
关于狩猎快感的演讲
Speech About The Thrill Of The Hunt

Text.text:
“你们这些弱者根本不懂——你们怎么可能懂？狩猎的快感无可比拟：原始的鼓点在耳畔擂动，血液奔涌，推着你突破一切极限，步步逼近。还有那甜美而诱人的恐惧气息——当你的猎物意识到末日将至。没有比这更美妙的了。”

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

"You weaklings don't understand—how could you? There's nothing like the thrill of the hunt, the primal beat in your ears as the blood rushes through you, pushing you past any limits as you close in. The sweet, tantalizing scent of fear as your prey realizes their doom. There's nothing better."

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

你仰望苍穹，伴着一团团呵气与叹息吟出法术的咒词，缕缕白雾自唇间逸散。你以指尖划过天幕，用绵絮般的云层作墨，将你的讯息写在天空之上。
Gazing upward, you speak the words of the spell in puffs and sighs, wisps of vapor escaping your lips. You trace a finger over the sky, penning your message with fleecy clouds as your ink.

Tiny Single-person Three-wheeled Runabou.name:
微型单人三轮小跑车
Tiny Single-person Three-wheeled Runabout

Text.text:
这辆载具的轮廓滑稽可笑：底盘造型古怪，三轮支撑得歪歪斜斜，却偏偏结实耐用，是个行之有效的代步工具。车厢勉强容得下一个人，内部狭窄逼仄，哪怕车主费尽心思装点，坐进去依旧憋屈难受。显然，车主下了大功夫想给它添点“街头派头”——在刚刷新的外壳上又加了几道赛车条纹。
The vehicle has a comical silhouette with its oddly shaped chassis and three-wheeled bearing, but it is a  sturdy and effective mode of transportation. Barely large enough for a single occupant, the interior is cramped and uncomfortable despite the efforts of the owner to spruce it up. Indeed, the owner seems to have taken great pains to try and improve the street cred of the vehicle by adding racing stripes to the freshly painted exterior.

Aberrant Sea Oddity.name:
畸变海异象
Aberrant Sea Oddity

Text.text:
原本平静的夜海轻拍船身，却被某种东西刮凿船壳的低吼骤然打断。一张灰白肿胀的脸从黑色涟漪的中心浮起——半是鱼类，半是远古的人形。它的利爪牵扯着其余身躯，肌肉上覆着油滑的肥厚褶瓣，从水中拖拽而出，攀上船壳，翻过船尾栏杆，啪嗒一声摔上甲板。它以四根粗壮的触手站立，双眼迅速锁定一个目标。怪异的生物从背后背带中抽出一柄三叉戟，用筋肉虬结的手臂将武器高高举起。

~ 由一位英雄构想

An otherwise calm nighttime sea lapping against the ship is interrupted by the growl of something gouging the hull. A bulbous gray face—part fish, part primordial humanoid—surfaces in the center of black ripples. Its claws pull the rest of its body, slick with flaps of fat over muscle, up out of the water, up the hull, and over the taffrail to flop onto the deck. It stands on four thick tentacles, its eyes picking out a target. The odd creature pulls a trident from a sling on its back and raises the weapon with a sinewy arm.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

那滩水洼起初看着平平无奇，可如今——当它向前滑动——你才意识到自己犯下了致命的错误。它缓缓隆起，抬升成形，黏滑的触须自其中抽出，探来攫住你。在这生物无定形的胶质之中，你看见先前猎物的骸骨漂浮其间，正被那东西腐蚀性的内腔缓慢溶解。怪物那团块状的身躯里传出一声动静，像是一只靴子从泥里被硬生生抽离。
The puddle appeared mundane enough, but now—as it slides forward—you realize your grave error. It rises, taking form, tendrils emerging to grasp at you. Floating within the creature's amorphous mass, you see the bones of previous prey, slowly dissolving in the thing's caustic innards. A sound, not unlike a boot sliding free of mud, issues from the monster's blob-like body.

一道银光乍闪，随之溅起的水花提醒你：鱼就在这里——这想必是村子的蓄鱼池。芦苇环绕的水潭仿佛生机沸腾。宝石般的蜻蜓掠水疾飞，浅滩深处传来一片蛙鸣合唱，阳光在水面上闪烁，如同熔金般耀眼。
A silvery flash and resulting splash alert you to the presence of fish in what must be the village’s stock pond. The reed-fringed pool seems abuzz with life. Jewel-like dragonflies zip over the water, a chorus of frogs sing from somewhere in the shallows, and the sun glimmers off its surface like shining gold.

Paint Or Dye!.name:
涂上去！或染出来！
Paint Or Dye!

Text.text:
吟游诗人的长杖是一支需双手握持的画笔。他以超乎常理的灵巧挥使，巨大的笔锋先是利落一挑，随即蘸入一口巨大的颜料罐。大地便是吟游诗人的画布，笔触疾速而精确，显露出他早已将这一切演练过百次。这门艺术既古老，又只属于此刻的当下。

~ 由鹅构想

The bard’s quarterstaff is a paintbrush that they hold with two hands. They wield it with such preternatural dexterity that the giant brush accomplishes a quick flourish before dipping into an enormous pot of paint. The bard’s canvas is the ground itself, their brushstrokes fast and calculated, revealing how they've done this a hundred times before. It is an art both ancient and of this immediate moment.

~ Envisioned by the goose

Swamp Hag.name:
沼泽鬼婆（特征）
Swamp Hag

Text.text:
她从一层苍蝇织成的帘幕后现身。她挥臂一扫，蝇群四散而飞，却仍有几只黏在覆盖她全身的浓稠黏液上。她阴沉地皱眉，露出嵌在泛绿牙龈中的尖利鳄齿。湿淋淋的芦苇从她的肩头与胯侧垂落，勉强拼成披巾与短裙。她低吼一声，跛着脚逼近，脚踝与足部的水泡里鼓胀着蘑菇。
She emerges from a veil of flies. They scatter at a wave of her arms, though a few stick to the thick slime covering her skin. She scowls, revealing sharp crocodile-teeth set into greenish gums. Sopping reeds hang from her shoulders and hips as a meager shawl and skirt. With a growl, she hobbles to close the gap between you, her ankles and feet blistering with mushrooms.

学院塔楼众多回廊露台之一，咒法露台允许学生拼合所需元素，以创造物体。露台中央燃着一堆篝火。午夜第十二声钟鸣响起时，一块黑板会魔法般浮现，上面列出当天课程所需的全部法术材料。在这里，植物与动物忽隐忽现，闪电骤然劈落，通往骇人之地的大门忽开忽合——甚至通向其他次元。
One of the many verandas on the Academy tower, the Conjuration Terrace allows students to assemble the elements they need to create objects. In the center of the terrace is a bonfire. At the twelfth chime of midnight a chalkboard magically appears listing all the spell components needed for the day’s classes. Here plants and animals appear and disappear, lightning strikes, and doors open and shut on terrifying places—even other dimensions.

一层薄雾般的迷霭掠过战场，上一轮攻击的残骸散落在泥泞里。壕沟中挤满了尖叫的伤兵与沉默的死者。老鼠欢快地在战争废墟间窜行，胡须染得猩红，嘴里塞得鼓鼓囊囊。工兵试图修补被法术摧毁的防线，仍在燃烧的余烬令他们本能一缩，又被残留的毒气团呛得直咳。满身污泥的牧师跪在泥浆中祈求救赎，而骨头都累透的战士守在恶臭的通道上，饱受法术震撼的眼睛因恐惧而睁得滚圆。
A haze of mist drifts across the battlefield, the remnants of the last attack littering the mud. The trenches are full of screaming wounded and silent dead. Rats scamper gleefully through the detritus of war, their whiskers crimson, mouths full. Sappers attempt to repair spell-damaged defenses, flinching from still-burning embers and choking on pockets of lingering gas. Filth-smeared clerics kneel in the mud, praying for deliverance, while bone-weary fighters man the stinking walkways, their spell-shocked eyes wide with fear.

Loot From A Lamia.name:
来自拉弥亚的战利品
Loot From A Lamia

Text.text: 拉弥亚那身一尘不染的狮皮散发出没药的香气，偶尔又掺着一丝硫磺味。靠近火焰时，这层皮革会渗出一股阴森的奥术气息。在这生物那些开裂而廉价的饰物之间，有一枚青金石，灌注着charm person。 The pristine leonine hide of the lamia gives off the scent of myrrh, occasionally tinged with sulfur. Near a fire, the hide emanates a sinister arcane quality. Among the creature’s cracked, cheap adornments is a lapis lazuli charged with charm person.

Speech By A Martial Character Learning O.name:
一名武艺角色得知兄弟死讯后的演说
Speech By A Martial Character Learning Of His Brother's Death

Text.text:
“所以，一切都结束了——最痛的一击，竟不是出自刀剑，而是这片薄薄的羊皮纸。兄弟，对不起；我未能替你受死，这份悔恨深到你永远也无法知晓。我无法弥补自己的缺席，但我发誓会找出是谁做的。也许，在我身后留下的一具具破碎躯体之间，我能挣得你原谅的一点点。小家伙，安心休息吧，你已在苦难的触及之外。我会在血腥之事了结之后再见你——到那时，我们将再度以血亲之名，共同纵情欢庆。”

~ 由一位英雄所构想

“So that’s it then, the most painful blow delivered, not by a sword, but through this scrap of parchment. Brother, I am sorry, more than you will ever know, that I was not there to be struck down in your stead. I can never make up for my absence, but I promise I will find who did this, and perhaps, in each broken body I leave in my wake, I will earn a portion of your forgiveness. Rest easy now little one, you are beyond the reach of suffering. I will see you again, when the bloody deed is done, and we will revel together as kin once more.”

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这块巨岩的一侧覆着一层光润的祖母绿苔毯，葱茏的苔藓又在嶙峋的岩体上零星蔓延成片。尽管石面风蚀斑驳、饱经捶打，那抹青翠的叶幕却依旧生机勃勃。
A lustrous, emerald green carpet of verdant moss covers one side of this boulder, and spreads out in patches across the rocky edifice. Though the stone is weathered and beaten, the virid cloak of foliage is thriving.

Site Of A Sylvan Ritual.name:
林间仪式之地
Site Of A Sylvan Ritual

Text.text:
一道明亮光照——银、蓝与白交织，宛如月之正面——在这座辽阔的厅室中央绽放。绿莹莹的光点如萤火般在室内四处闪烁，飘过时叮当作响，像细小的铃声。七个铺盖围着光芒排成半圆，北墙边靠放着两只箱子。空灵的辉光中央立着一截树桩，周围簇拥着一群漂浮的孢子；每一枚都是白色绒球，中央凹陷着一颗深色斑点，使它们诡异地像一只只眼睛。树桩的根须伸向每一面墙，穿过石质地面，如线穿布般交织延展。那灼人的银白月光之源，似乎正是树桩周围地面上写下的文字——它们环绕成圈，将树桩围在中央。那优雅流畅的字迹微微震颤，涌动着魔法。
A bright light—silver, blue, and white, like the face of the moon—blooms at the center of this vast chamber, and green motes flicker like fireflies all about the room, tinkling like small bells as they waft by. Seven bedrolls create a semicircle around the light, and two chests sit against the northern wall. A tree stump in the center of the ethereal illumination is attended by a flock of floating spores, each one a puffball of white indented with a single dark spot, giving them an uncanny resemblance to eyes. The stump’s roots stretch to each wall, weaving through the stone floor like thread through fabric. The source of the searing, silvery-white, lunar light appears to be the words written on the ground around the stump, encircling it. The graceful, flowing script thrums with magic.

Wand Of Fear.name:
恐惧魔杖
Wand Of Fear

Text.text:
以兽骨雕琢而成，并塑形为一具骇人怪物的头骨模样；仅仅握住这根魔杖，你臂上的寒毛便齐刷刷竖起。
Carved from an animal bone and shaped to resemble the skull of a terrifying monster, simply holding this wand causes the hairs on your arms to stand at attention.

Rogue's Speech Of Self-deprecation.name:
盗贼的自嘲之辞
Rogue's Speech Of Self-deprecation

Text.text:
“谁不是个贼？我以前总拿这话给自己的行当开脱，可当我也就和所有人一样能耐时，又凭什么自圆其说？不是我，是运气；不是我手指的技能，是锁的毛病。不是我的刀锋，是我的目标身上的软处。我还不如在膝盖上绑两面钹。”
“Who isn’t a thief? I used to say that to justify my occupation, but when I’m only as good as everyone else, what justifies that? It’s not me but luck. It’s not the skill of my fingers but the fault of the lock. Not my blade but the soft places of my target. I may as well strap cymbals to my knees.”

Sickening Odors Of Dark Faerie Swamp.name:
黑妖精沼泽的令人作呕的恶臭
Sickening Odors Of Dark Faerie Swamp

Text.text:
一股腐臭像守护法术般裹住这片区域。你本能地皱起脸抵抗这股恶臭的侵袭，眼、鼻、口都被刺得生疼。这气味混杂着多重腐败：朽烂的木头、甜得发腻的烂果，以及交给蛆虫翻涌的死肉。每当一团气泡从淤泥里鼓起，臭味就更浓一分。胃里翻起一阵干呕，堵住喉咙，仿佛下一刻就要把上一顿饭全吐出来。
A putrid stench coats the area like a spell of warding. Your face crumples instinctively against this fetid assault, your eyes, nose, and mouth stinging. This odor is a mix of different decay: rotting wood, fruit turned sickly sweet, and dead flesh turned over to maggots. Each time a swell of air bubbles up from the muck, the stench becomes stronger. A gag roils up from your stomach and clogs your throat, threatening to unleash your last meal.

无情的灰色浪涛浸透了古老的石质栈堤，拍击着它低矮的堤壁，在无尽的循环中反复碎裂。黏滑的绿藻紧贴着龟裂的石面，像一具泡胀尸体纠结的湿发——对任何愚蠢到来此旅行的人而言，都是不祥的危害。附近系泊的船只吱呀作响，在汹涌的水面上惴惴起伏——仿佛它们也害怕待在这里。
Relentless gray waves soak the ancient stone of the jetty, breaking against its shallow walls in an unending cycle. Slick green seaweed clings to the cracked stone like the matted hair of a waterlogged corpse—a prophetic hazard for anyone foolish enough to travel here. Creaking boats moored nearby bob nervously on the tumultuous waters—as if they are afraid to be here.

Dust Of Disappearance.name:
消失之尘
Dust Of Disappearance

Text.text:
你找到的丝绸小袋里装的似乎是寻常的白沙，只是被研磨得格外细腻。然而你注意到，当一粒粒粉尘从小袋口沿处洒落时，那一小片被覆盖的地方竟变得彻底透明。凭这点粉末的分量，你觉得足以让好几只生物隐形。
The silken bag you have found appears to be filled with common, if well-pulverized, white sand. Yet you notice that where the individual motes of dust scatter over the lip of the small pouch, that patch becomes completely transparent. With the amount of powder you have found, you think you could render several creatures invisible.

I Cast Disintegrate.name:
我施放了解离术
I Cast Disintegrate

Text.text:
我吐出这道法术复杂而喉音低沉的字句，补全那足以逆转造化的符号，凝神锁定我的目标。随着咒文最后的音节从齿间滚落，我将手指指向我的目标，释放出终极毁灭的威能。力量洪流贯穿全身，撕扯般的剧痛席卷而来——我召来的纯粹破坏之力在体内冲撞，仿佛要将这具躯壳撑裂。
Uttering the complex, guttural words of the spell, I complete the symbols needed to unmake creation and focus on my target. I point my finger toward my target as I intone the last syllables of the incantation and unleash the power of ultimate destruction. The power rushes through me, wracking my body with pain as it struggles to contain the raw destructive force I have summoned.

Drinking From The Goblet Of Divulgence.name:
饮下宣露之杯
Drinking From The Goblet Of Divulgence

Text.text:
酒液入口如琼浆玉露，天鹅绒般的触感掠过舌面、滑入喉间，轻松得像一次呼吸。胡椒与黑醋栗的香气涌入鼻腔。脑海里被一幅画面占据：葡萄在藤上挂着露珠，于初升的阳光里鲜亮欲滴。美好持续着——直到你感觉舌头在口中萎缩。你想要喊叫，却因喉咙肿胀，声音只挤出一声尖细的吱响。房间里笑容疯长……嘴巴张开到超出常理，沿着头颅一路撕裂般扩展。眼睛化作坩埚，滴落熔融的白色金属。未得你的指挥与同意，你开始开口。你吐露……任何事。一切事。你脑中闪过的第一个蠢念头。你对屋内其他人的瞬间评断。此刻你最深的恐惧。

~ 出自精彩的 TTRPG 增补 The Vineyard

The wine tastes ambrosial, the velvet mouthfeel passing over your tongue and down your throat with the ease of taking a breath. The aroma of pepper and currant floods your nose. An image of grapes, dewy on the vine and vibrant in the rising sun, takes over your mind. All is wonderful until you feel your tongue atrophy in your mouth. You attempt to cry out, but your voice comes out in a squeak as your throat swells. Smiles burgeon throughout the room… mouths widening beyond normal capacity, stretching all the way around heads. Eyes become crucibles dripping molten white metal. Without your command or consent, you begin to speak. You reveal… anything. Everything. The first inane thought that comes to your mind. Your snap judgments of the others in the room. Your deepest fear at this moment.

~ Found in the amazing TTRPG supplement The Vineyard

Cone Of Cold Hitting Player.name:
寒冰锥命中玩家
Cone Of Cold Hitting Player

Text.text:
就是这一刻，你想。这就是冻死的滋味——化作一尊冰雕，成了某个二流施法者脑海里关于胜利的回忆。你试图抵抗，试图回想烈日下炽热的行军，或海滩上温暖的细沙。你咬紧牙关，先是打了个寒颤，接着浑身战栗，最后无法自控地剧烈颤抖；寒意穿透你的衣物、你的皮肤，最终钻进你的骨头里。
This is it, you think. This is what it’s like to freeze to death, to become a statue of ice and a memory of victory in the mind of some second-rate spellcaster. You try to resist, to remember hot marches in the sun or the warm sands of a beach. You clench, then shiver, then begin to shake uncontrollably as the cold permeates your clothes, your skin, and finally your bones.

水面清澈透亮，冷冽爽净，由一条蜿蜒北流的河水注入。你瞥见水下鱼影来回穿梭，嬉戏于西北方那座残破高塔投下的阴影里。
The water is clear, crisp, fed by a meandering river flowing north. You spy fish flitting here and there beneath the surface, playing in the shadow of the ruined tower to the northwest.

高耸的厅室两侧排着一张张长桌与长凳，中央留出宽阔的通道，引人走向尽头那张略微抬高的长桌。桌后立着几把高背座椅，后方整面墙覆着一幅宏大的壁画。壁画与其余墙上悬挂的挂毯一样，描绘着荒野风光、追猎的队伍与他们的猎物，以及丰饶的园圃；但它还借助墙面的高度铺陈出连绵群山，并以高处的圆形窗作为太阳。
Long tables and benches line the sides of this high-ceilinged chamber, leaving a wide central walkway to approach the raised table at the far end. Several high-backed chairs stand behind it, and a vast mural covers the wall. As with the tapestries that decorate the other walls, the mural depicts a wild landscape, hunting parties and their quarry, and fruitful gardens, but it also uses the height of wall to display mountains and a high circular window to serve as the sun.

Sundries From A Blight Dragon And Its Ri.name:
枯疫巨龙与其骑手的杂物
Sundries From A Blight Dragon And Its Rider

Text.text:
枯疫巨龙是一团骇人的烂摊子：松垮、腐烂的血肉被黑皮革挽具捆扎着，像屠宰后的肉块般吊束。它污秽的鳞片从躯体上淌落，肥硕的苍蝇在它的尸身上饕餮盛宴。它的骑手已然毙命，被甩到一旁；被灼焦的邪教长袍如裹尸布般覆着，袍摆边缘还缀着淋漓血污。
The blighted dragon is a horrid mess of loose, putrefying flesh, trussed up like butchered meat in its harness of black leather. Its begrimed scales drizzle from its body as fat flies feast upon its corpse. Its rider lies dead, thrown off to one side, singed cult robes draped like a shroud, the hem trimmed in gore.

I Throw My Ivory Goats Figurine Of Wondr.name:
我掷出我的奇妙法器“象牙山羊雕像”，召唤出一只恐怖山羊。
I Throw My Ivory Goats Figurine Of Wondrous Power To Summon A Goat Of Terror

Text.text:
我召唤出这组三尊小像中最大的一尊，一只真正如大象般巨硕的山羊从召唤的烟云中现身。它出现时是坐着的，四肢蜷在沉重的身躯下。它用红色的眼睛打量着我，竖瞳里点点银斑闪烁。它前腿与头部那纯黑的毛发，仿佛天鹅绒般柔软，令人想去接触；而背上则覆着最纯净的白色绒毛，蓬松如云，软得像枕。它沉沉地向我俯下头——剃刀般锋利、延展极长的角在低鸣，嗡嗡震颤着魔法。
I summon the largest of the figurine’s trio, and a truly elephantine goat emerges from the cloud of summoning smoke. It shows up seated, legs curled beneath its hefty body. It regards me with red eyes, the vertical pupil speckled with silver. The pure black fur of its forelegs and head seems velvet-soft to the touch, and the back is covered in pillowy, cloudlike fur of purest white. It bends its head heavily toward me—razor-sharp, long-reaching horns humming with magic.

Reindeer With Glowing Antlers.name:
发光鹿角的驯鹿
Reindeer With Glowing Antlers

Text.text:
极光在天际铺开巨大而绚烂的色弧，遮没了苔原上方的群星。发光的苍穹照出苍白的平原，稀薄的积雪间，一簇簇耐寒的草尖顽强探出。驯鹿群懒散地徘徊着，或大或小，弯曲的鹿角如枝杈伸展，深褐的皮毛下覆着一层白色的腹毛。它们之所以清晰可见，并非源自天空幽灵般的光辉，而是因为那头最大、最苍白的鹿，其鹿角正散出冷冽的纯白光。

~ 设想：Ethan

Auroras form great arcs of color in the sky, obscuring the stars over the tundra. The glowing heavens reveal wan plains, with their clumps of hardy grass poking through thin snow. A herd of reindeer mills idly. Large and small, they bear curving antlers and dark brown coats with white undersides. These features are visible not due to the sky’s spectral glow, but because the antlers of the largest, palest deer shed crisp white light.

~ Envisioned by Ethan

I Pilot A Flying Car.name:
我驾驶一辆飞行汽车
I Pilot A Flying Car

Text.text:
一旦我启动汽车的推进器，骤然加速的冲击力便将我死死压在座椅上——整辆车以令人窒息的速度向前狂飙。方向柱在我手中猛烈颠簸、拼命抗拒，汽车在空中呼啸穿梭；但我还是稳住了这头桀骜不驯的钢铁猛兽，牢牢守住航线。
The force of the acceleration pins me in my seat once I engage the car’s thrusters—and hurtle forward at breakneck speed. The steering column bucks in my hands, fighting me as the car whizzes through the air, but I manage to control the unruly vehicle and stay on course.

“我这辈子一直都准备着打架。每次跟人说话，我都会想象场面会变得难看。不是他们说了什么，就是我说了什么，然后就会爆发。那样活着让你时刻绷紧，警觉不松。可我现在累了，也不再幻想暴力了；我满脑子想的，反倒是那些被我吓跑的朋友，还有那些我错过的对话。”
“I’ve been ready for a fight my whole life. Every time I talk with someone, I picture it turnin’ ugly. They’ll say somethin’ or I’ll say somethin’ and then it’ll start. Keeps you alert, livin’ like that. But I’m getting tired, and I don’t fantasize about violence no more, instead it’s all the friends I’ve scared away and conversations I’ve missed.”

最先映入心头的是寂静。没有小兽窸窣的动静，连鸟鸣都不见。你面前铺展开一片辽阔草原，起伏的丘陵上点缀着体型与色泽都异常惊人的怪植。空气里飘着诡异的焦灼气味，带着刺鼻的酸涩。然而盖革计数器的噼啪作响泄露了真相——这是一片放射性荒原。那场事故想必已是许多个轮回之前；植物重新生长了出来，却……不知为何变了样。如今，草叶高过你两倍身量。
It’s the quiet you notice first. No rustle of small fauna, not even the sound of birds. A vast grassland lies before you, undulating hills dotted with odd plants of startling color and size. The scent of strange burning, an acidic tang to the air. But the crackle of your Geiger counter gives it away. A radioactive expanse. The accident must have been many moons ago; the plants have regrown, but… different somehow. Now, the grass stands twice your height.

一道身影在小巷间潜行，穿梭于阴影之间，步伐轻巧而短促。乍看之下，她像个年幼的孩子：肌肤白得像纸，细腻得近乎脆弱。她那对异色的眼眸里，一只宛如空白纸页上泼落的一点猩红墨渍，另一只则像金色的钟面，刻痕规整，间距均匀如时辰的刻度。乌鸦般的长发束成双马尾，发梢没入裙装的哥特层叠之中——黑色欧根纱与红色锦缎交织闪烁，仿佛披着一圈奥术能量的光冠。她携着一把手枪与一本魔导书，脸上却端着一副精心培育的无辜面具。

~ Played by Ararion

A figure stalks the alleys, weaving between shadows, their steps light and short. At first glance, she appears young: a child with skin as white and delicate as paper. One of her heterochromatic eyes shines like a blot of crimson ink on an empty page, the other glows like a golden clock dial, its markings as evenly spaced as hour indices. Her hair is bound in raven pigtails, the ends lost in the gothic layers of her dress—its black organza silk and red brocade shimmering with a corona of arcane energy. She carries a pistol and a grimoire, and wears a cultivated mask of innocence.

~ Played by Ararion

大腹便便的狱卒把脚翘在一张粗糙拼凑的木桌上，半眯着一只眼，盯着他面前走廊两侧一排排牢房。偶尔，他会用穿过警棍手柄的皮绳将警棍甩得呼呼作响，一如既往地祈祷能来点乱子，好打破这份无名又吃力的差事带来的单调——却从未想过，他很快就会如愿以偿。
Sitting at a crudely-made wooden table with his feet up, the pot-bellied jailer keeps one eye on the row of cells lining the hall in front of him. He occasionally whirls his billy club by the leather thong threaded through its handle, praying as he always does for some kind of trouble to break up the monotony of his thankless job—never imagining that he might just get his wish.

她以鬼祟的移动穿行于镇中，披着毛皮的精灵女子步伐轻捷，醒目的红眸圆睁，警觉地扫视四周。粗硬的白色毛皮与她丝缎般的长发相映，缀在那身深色皮革护甲之上；一颗龇牙咆哮的狼头覆在她头顶，如同她自己的面孔延伸出的野性。她每一次动作都伴着一声轻柔的clink——那声音来自她身体与护甲上密密匝匝的骨片与兽牙饰物相互碰撞。她身侧，一只蓬松的林狼欢快地小跑着，鲜亮的粉色舌头从喘息的口鼻间垂下，洋溢着无忧的雀跃。

~ 由一位携带 的英雄 Played

With furtive movements, the fur-clad elf makes her way through the town, her striking red eyes wide and alert. Coarse white fur, matching her silken hair, adorns the dark leather armor about her person, and a snarling wolf’s head rests atop her own. A soft clink accompanies the woman’s every movement, emanating from the myriad bones and teeth decorating her body and armor. At her side, a shaggy timber wolf lollops playfully, his vibrant pink tongue hanging joyfully from a panting muzzle.

~ Played by a Hero with

House Of Worship For A Goddess Of Fortun.name:
供奉幸运女神的神殿
House Of Worship For A Goddess Of Fortune

Text.text:
僧侣们盘坐在低矮的桌旁，身下是柔软的靠垫，沉迷于各种碰运气的游戏：掷骰、打牌，甚至只是随手抛硬币。有人干脆把袍袖从衣上撕下，肩头的布边被扯得毛糙破碎，夸张地散着线。桌边不时爆出欢呼与窃笑，每一次胜负或平局都被当作神明降下的征兆。每当喧声乍起，大殿里一盏盏灯笼便随之微微颤闪，仿佛无声地鼓掌。
Monks sit on plush pillows around low tables, playing games of chance: dice, cards, and even simple coin flips. Their sleeves have been torn from their shirts, the edges around their shoulders frayed dramatically. Cries of delight and snickers of scorn come from the table, each win, loss or draw taken as a sign from the divine. With each outburst, the lanterns throughout the hall flicker in silent applause.

I Absorb A Spell With My Ioun Stone Of G.name:
我用强效吸收艾欧石吸收了一道法术
I Absorb A Spell With My Ioun Stone Of Greater Absorption

Text.text:
这枚小石头里盘旋着薰衣草紫与碧绿的纹路，妖异得像一场王室假面舞会。它在飞行时散发出强烈的奥术共鸣场。一道强大的法术逼近——威胁满溢——石头便自行漂到我面前，像抹布吸走桌面的水那样，将法术的魔法尽数吞噬。石头的飞行轨迹下沉了一寸，速度也慢了些，但我安然无恙，而我的对手少了一道法术。
The whorls of lavender and green throughout the small stone look monstrous, a royal masquerade. It emanates a strong field of arcane resonance during its flight. A powerful spell approaches—full of threat—so the stone floats in front of me, soaking up the spell’s magic like so much water from a table. The stone’s flight path lowers an inch, and it slows, but I stand safe, and my adversary is down one spell.

Pep Talk To A Fighter.name:
给战士的打气演说
Pep Talk To A Fighter

Text.text:
“你是顶级掠食者。你的肌肉如铁索般绷紧。神祇为你呼吸！所以你不会疲惫，你不会停下——你只会赢。”
“You’re the apex predator. Your muscles are corded iron. The gods breathe for you! So you will not tire, you will not stop—you will only win.”

Watchers On The Way.name:
路上的守望者
Watchers On The Way

Text.text:
一座小小的灰色建筑守在通往城内的西侧道路旁。门上装饰着一幅蓝松鸦的图案，两侧以一对弯曲枝条作框。身披蓝色罩袍的卫兵懒散地在院内巡逻，不时在岗亭里，或在后院那片小果树林的树荫下彼此闲聊。一名骑马的卫兵沿路小跑而过，腰间垂着一支黑色单筒望远镜。
A small gray building stands guard at the western road that leads into the city. The door is decorated with an image of a blue jay framed between a pair of curved branches. Guards in their blue tabards patrol the grounds casually, taking time to chat with one another within the post or under the shade of the small grove of fruit trees in the backyard. A guard on horseback canters along the road, a black spyglass hanging from his waist.

Exterminator-class Infiltration Robot.name:
灭绝者职业渗透机器人
Exterminator-class Infiltration Robot

Text.text:
那个人起初看上去就像你曾无数次见过的熟面孔，随后又在拥挤的人潮中变得模糊——不过是个再普通不过的路人。可哪里不对。你看得够仔细吗？他们的皮肤微微抽搐。瞳孔是两个完美的三角形。笑容过于轻易就能卸下你的防备。空气里还飘着细碎的滋滋声，仿佛一枚高功率处理器正悄然运转。
The person appears at first as someone you’ve seen many times before, then they become a blurred figure in the crowd—just an ordinary pedestrian. But something is wrong. Have you looked close enough? There is a twitch to their skin. The pupils are two perfect triangles. The smile a little too disarming. And an ambient fizzle, like a high-powered processor ticking away.

水波轻轻拍打着遍布卵石的滩岸。两侧芦苇在微风里沙沙作响，你从它们深处的某个角落听见青蛙啾啾鸣叫。湖面如镜般在你眼前铺展开来——灰暗而冰冷。
Water laps gently on a pebble-strewn beach. Reeds rustle in the breeze to either side, and from somewhere among them you hear frogs chirruping. The glassy surface of the lake stretches out before you—gray and cold.

一位年迈的兽人女人，冰冷的蓝眼下紧咬着牙关，把覆着白色绒毛的下巴高高扬起，骄傲而警惕地巡视着四周。她对战斗的刺痛并不陌生：低陷的面颊与泛黄的獠牙上缠着道道伤疤；她的板甲和厚重马裤也因凹痕与泥垢而发灰发暗。一把长剑越过她筋肉虬结的肩头直立而起，一只皮革背包则由斜跨全身的背带吊着。包里传来叮当碰撞的声响，像是玻璃与金属在轻轻磕碰。再加上那股辛辣刺鼻的气味，暗示其中装着医疗工具与敷膏。她抬起一只风霜侵蚀的手，凑到脸前若有所思地扯了扯自己的獠牙。那漫不经心的一拉让长牙在牙龈里晃了晃，她不由得吃痛地抽了口气。

~ Played by Puffernami

An old orc woman, jaw clenched tight under cold blue eyes, holds her white-fuzzed chin high in proud surveillance. She is not unfamiliar with the sting of battle, her low cheeks and yellowing tusks laced with scars, and her plate armor and heavy breeches dingy with dent and dirt. A bastard sword rises over her sinewy shoulder, and a leather pack hangs from a strap slung across her body. The rattle and clink suggest glass and metal within. This, as well as the acerbic stink, hints at medicinal tools and poultices. She brings a weathered hand up to her face to tug thoughtfully at her tusk. She winces as the absentminded move causes the long tooth to wobble in her gums.

~ Played by Puffernami

A Devil’s Justification.name:
恶魔的辩白
A Devil’s Justification

Text.text:
“我们立下契约的人，并不善良，也不体面。也许是绝望吧，但绝望本身并不算美德。我们是在把他们推上必败之局吗？也许。但说到底，我们是在给他们一个机会，让他们的人生做点有用的事。若他们任由自己的弱点将其吞没，那他们也许就活该待在这下面。”
“The people we make pacts with are not kind or decent. Desperate maybe, but that’s not a virtue by itself. Do we set them up to fail? Maybe. But truly we are offering them a chance to do something productive with their lives. If they allow their weakness to overtake them, then maybe they deserve to be down here.”

Flying Car Traffic Jam.name:
飞车大堵塞
Flying Car Traffic Jam

Text.text:
这座庞大巨型都市的天际线令人目眩神迷：成千上万的升降车挤满空域，堵成一场史诗级的空中车阵。喧嚣骇人至极——引擎与喇叭以震耳欲聋的烈度彼此争抢。那混杂轰鸣足以把任何人逼疯，暴怒的司机们在丑陋的拥塞中拼命穿行。这是一幕彻底的混乱，环保主义者最可怕的噩梦。
The skyline of the vast megapolis is a mesmerizing sight as thousands of lift-cars fill the airspace in a traffic jam of epic proportions. The cacophony is horrific: engines and horns competing with deafening intensity. The amalgam is enough to drive anyone insane, as the raging drivers attempt to navigate the hideous congestion. It is a chaotic scene, an environmentalist’s worst nightmare.

锐利而好奇的目光从那副巨大的圆框眼镜后探出。年轻的半精灵把头发剪得很短，偏向一侧梳拢，身上穿着富裕贵族的装束。然而她凌乱的模样——以及那只塞满书籍、卷轴与羊皮纸、沉甸甸的挎包——却暗示着一段混乱的学术生涯；外套袖口的墨渍更暴露出她对华服与礼数全然不放在心上。
Sharp, inquisitive eyes peer from behind massive, circular spectacles. The young half-elf keeps her hair short, swept to the side, and wears the garb of a well-off noble. But her disheveled state—and satchel heavy with books, scrolls, and parchment—hints at a chaotic life of academia, and the ink stains on the cuffs of her jacket reveal her lack of concern for finery or decorum.

Spring Tournament Crowd.name:
春季锦标赛的观众人潮
Spring Tournament Crowd

Text.text:
看台上挂满花环与绚丽旗幡，人潮挤挤攘攘，欢呼声与嬉闹声汇成一片。座无虚席，贵族与贫民同样涌入席间，脸庞因兴奋或酒意——亦或两者兼有——而泛着红光。冬日仓皇退却，春意趁势侵染整场比武大会。
Sporting garlands and colorful banners, the press of spectators cheer and make merry. No seat is left empty, as noble and pauper alike have flocked to the stands, faces aglow with excitement or alcohol—or both. With winter fleeing, the spring atmosphere has infected the entire tourney.

Threat To A Corrupt King.name:
对腐败之王的威胁
Threat To A Corrupt King

Text.text:
“你以为这地方是你的。你的城堡，你的仆从——都不过是你血脉所赐、天命般的特权。但所谓占有，只是一纸约定；一句狠话就能撕碎，一把快刀就能从肋骨间捅进去。”
“You think you own this place. Your castle, your servants—all owed to some divine entitlement of your blood. But ownership is just an agreement, one easily broken with a harsh word and quick knife between the ribs.”

Master Of Fate.name:
命运主宰
Master Of Fate

Text.text:
一阵突如其来的幻象灌入你的脑海：一位浩瀚的命运主宰，隐伏在现实的阴影里，宛如巨影压境。他手中的牌组充满致命的可能性……或辉煌的机遇。只见他潇洒一挥，抽出一张牌——这一次，是死亡的先兆。乌黑云团之中，炽白闪电喷吐而出，瞬间将某个不幸之人灼焦，眨眼间便断了他们的命线。你心有余悸地醒来，那可怖的景象如雾般散去。
A sudden vision fills your mind, a vast master of fate looming in the shadows of reality. The deck he wields is full of lethal possibility… or glorious opportunity. With a flourish, he draws a single card, this time a harbinger of demise. From ebon clouds, actinic lightning vomits forth, crisping some poor soul, parting their coil in a blink of an eye. You thankfully wake, the horrid vision fading like mist.

那男人头发梳理得一丝不乱，身上是剪裁利落、质地考究的富商长袍，正朝你绽开明媚的笑容。明明理智提醒你该多几分戒心，你却在他开口之前，就忍不住想先给他几分信任。
Well-coiffed and sharply dressed in rich merchant’s robes, the man beams at you with a sunny smile. Despite your best judgment you find yourself wanting to give him the benefit of the doubt before he even says a word.

你双手飞快结出一连串手印，高声呼唤你的召唤。一道光焰冲腾而起，灵体在其中显现，轮廓朦胧难辨。璀璨的灵光环绕着它，散发出温煦的召引，仿佛在呼唤伤者与病者前来依偎。
Your hands flash a sequence of signs, and you cry out your summons. A spirit manifests in a plume of light, its outline hazy and indistinct. A scintillating aura envelops the spirit, and seems to beckon to the injured and ailing with its warmth.

Adult Red Dragon.name:
成年红龙
Adult Red Dragon

Text.text:
弯曲的犄角冠于那硕大的龙首之上。那高耸的生物动作如爬行类般冷硬，鳞片燃烧般闪耀着宝石红的烈焰光泽。它的鼻孔猛然翕张，随即在吐息间喷出一股滚烫的蒸汽。骨白的利齿一闪而过，低沉的咆哮自巨兽胸腔深处滚出，喉间同时透出灼红的光芒。当你终于真正意识到它的体型与那异界般的存在感，恐惧便紧紧攫住了你。
Curving horns crest the massive draconic head. The towering creature, reptilian in its movements, has scales of flaming, ruby red. Its nostrils flare, then issue a gout of steam as it exhales. Teeth, bone-white, flash as a low growl emanates from the beast, accompanied by a red-hot glow in its throat. Fear grips you as you fully reckon its size, its otherworldly presence.

那男人脖子上挂着一只小小的保险匣，像你见过有些人佩戴的施舍箱。但他的这件很古怪——它分成两格。其一如常在盖子上开了投币口，循着旧例；另一格却从正面开启。你一时摸不着这第二格的用处，直到他掏钥匙打开，偷偷从里面捻出一撮什么，凑到鼻前深深一吸。
The man wears a little strongbox around his neck, like you’ve seen some folk wear alms boxes. But his is peculiar. It has two chambers. One has the coin slot in its lid, as is traditional, but the other opens at the front. The purpose of this second eludes you until he unlocks it to sneak a pinch of something from inside and inhale it deeply through his nose.

Crossroads With Rope-worn Posts.name:
绳痕磨蚀的路口木桩
Crossroads With Rope-worn Posts

Text.text:
你行走的车辙小径沿着一条古老堤道的岸坡向上攀去。陡峭的斜坡顶端，小径两侧各竖着一根粗壮的木桩，桩身刻满深深的磨痕——几十年来的旅行者把绳索绕在桩上，借力将货车拖上堤岸。翻过坡顶，你又看见一对被绳索磨得发亮的木桩立在路旁，像门框般夹着小径；前方道路再度下坠，没入泥泞的沼泽地形之中。
The rutted trail you travel runs up the bank of an ancient causeway. Two thick posts jut from atop the steep incline on either side of your path, each engraved with deep marks from decades of travelers wrapping ropes around the posts to haul wagons up the embankment. Cresting the hill, you see another set of rope-worn posts framing the path as it descends again into boggy terrain.

Haggling Warrior.name:
讨价还价的战士
Haggling Warrior

Text.text:
“这代价实在太高了。但你给我的感觉多少还有几分荣誉，所以我向你发起单挑挑战——就为那件闪亮的玩意儿。”
“These costs are simply too high. But you strike me as a person with some honor, so I challenge you to single combat for the shiny thing.”

高耸的立柱托举着高高的穹顶天花板；柱身以大理石精雕细琢，蜿蜒的藤蔓盘绕其上，石质的花苞含苞欲放。枝形烛台仿佛由树苗雕成，托着摇曳的烛火。
Soaring pillars, intricately carved with snaking vines and flowering buds of marbled stone, hold aloft a high, domed ceiling. Candelabras, seemingly carved from tree saplings, hold flickering candles.

Cracked Stone Coffin.name:
裂纹石棺
Cracked Stone Coffin

Text.text:
走廊尽头的石棺棺盖裂开了一道缝——一道裂痕沿着石面纵贯全长。然而碎裂的部分仍勉强拼合在一起，依旧遮掩着其中的内容。那道裂缝究竟是拙劣工艺所致……还是更为恶毒之物所为？
The lid of the coffin at the end of the hall is split—a crack running the length of the stone. Yet the piece holds together enough to continue concealing its contents. Was the crack caused by shoddy craftsmanship… or something more malicious?

I Repair My Accordion.name:
我修理我的手风琴
I Repair My Accordion

Text.text:
我的乐器简直像被人一拳打在嘴上，断牙参差，惨不忍睹。我摊开皮革工具包。螺丝刀、钳子、油壶和其他家伙彼此轻轻一撞，叮当作响。我用螺丝刀拧下栅盖，露出键片、轴芯与弹簧暗藏的内里。尽管要花上好一阵子，靠着我细致入微的耐心与反复琢磨，我还是把断裂的键片一一拆下，换上新的。随后我把整架手风琴彻底擦亮，确保每一道机括都运转顺滑——顺便也让那红木外壳英气逼人。
My instrument might as well have been punched in the mouth, for all its broken teeth. I unfurl my leather tool bag. My screwdriver, pliers, oil jar, and other tools clink together as they nudge each other. I use my screwdriver to unscrew the grill, revealing the hidden part of the keys, spindles, and springs. Though it takes a good while for all my care and meticulous finicking, I remove the broken keys and replace them. I give the whole accordion a thorough polish, making sure each machination works smoothly—and that the redwood exterior looks dashing, to boot.

当你念完咒文，一股怪异的牵扯与蠕动感自体内升起。那感觉不断堆叠，你一声喊叫，将其彻底释放。你手中的蛛丝猛然铺展开来，先是缠绕住你的手掌，随即在一道闪光中消失；就在同一瞬间，一张铺天盖地的蛛网骤然迸发而出。
A strange, tugging, wriggling sensation rises within you as you complete the incantation. You feel the sensation build, and with a shout, release it. The webbing in your hand spreads suddenly, wrapping itself around your hand before vanishing in a flash, and in the same instant, a sprawling spiderweb springs forth.

一丛光秃、木质的灌木在微风里沙沙作响，细长的枝条咔啦咔啦地碰撞。灌木忽然一颤，根须竟自行从泥土中拔出，整株植物抬起身来，挪动着。虬结的枝干扭曲缠绕，拼出一副矮短而瘦长的人形躯体——粗壮的腿支撑着，修长的手臂末端伸出带刺的爪。枝条纠结成一团，缓缓挪动，直到像是顶在肩上的头颅，其上凹陷出两只幽暗而平静的眼窝。生物彻底挣脱土壤，悄然逼近，喉中挤出令人不寒而栗的粗砺咆哮，仿佛枯朽老树的枝杈在吱呀作响。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

A bare, woody shrub rustles in the breeze, its spindly branches rattling. The shrub shifts suddenly, its roots pulling themselves from the soil as the plant rises and shifts. The gnarled branches twist and coil together, forming a stunted, gangly humanoid body complete with stout legs and lanky arms that end in thorny claws. A knot of branches shifts until it resembles a head atop the thing’s shoulders, complete with the hollow impressions of two dark, placid eyes. The creature frees itself from the soil and stalks forward with an unnerving, rasping roar like the creaking boughs of a withered tree.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Blood On The Trail.name:
血迹在路上
Blood On The Trail

Text.text:
一条泥泞的痕迹从环绕树桩的枝杈纠结处的一个豁口蜿蜒而出。泥土的颜色暗得诡异，再靠近一步，你便明白了原因。穿过新割麦秆的清香与坠落雨水的湿润气息，扑面而来的是血液的铜腥味，以及死亡腐烂的恶臭。树桩周围的地面已被鲜血浸透。
A trail of muddy ground runs out of an opening in the tangle of branches encircling the tree stump. The mud looks oddly dark, and with another step closer you understand why. Through the fresh scents of cut wheat and falling rain comes the coppery odor of blood, and the rotting aroma of death. The ground around the stump is soaked in blood.

侧边的盾牌是亮得晃眼的抛光钢板，但其中一面只剩一排参差不齐的尖牙挂在框架上，被某种飞射物击得粉碎。厚实的左镜片依旧完好地嵌在铆钉固定的黄铜镜框里，映着日光泛出冷亮。右边那片却有一道裂纹从正中疾速贯下，到了下缘又分叉开来，像一道劈落的闪电。若戴在谁的脸上，它们会同时让人感到贫寒与令人胆寒的硬气。
The side shields are brightly polished steel, but one is only a set of uneven fangs attached to the frame, shattered by some projectile. The thick left lens remains intact inside its riveted brass frame, reflecting the sunlight. The right, however, has a crack racing down the center and branches like a lightning strike at the bottom rim. On someone’s face, they give the combined impression of poverty and intimidating toughness.

I Command Obedience With My Rod Of Ruler.name:
我以统御权杖下令，令其俯首听命
I Command Obedience With My Rod Of Rulership

Text.text:
我挺直身躯站到最高，微微仰起下巴，举起权杖，竭力模仿一位专横的统治者。权杖在我引导其力量时低鸣，华丽杖首泛起柔和的光芒。法术如浪潮般向外扩散，迫使周围所有人都将我视作他们的领袖。
I draw myself to my full height and tilt my chin upward as I present the Rod, doing my best impression of an imperious ruler. The Rod hums as I channel its power, a soft light emerging from its ornate head. The spell flows outward in a wave, compelling everyone nearby to see me as their leader.

Green Elemental Slime.name:
绿色元素黏浆
Green Elemental Slime

Text.text:
在短暂而罕见的瞬间，那团混乱、循环翻涌的藤蔓黏泥竟显得安宁，像苔藓与叶簇在树桩上悄然蔓生。它旋转着，仿佛被骤然加速般拔高变长；然而与此同时，那元素般的绿色却愈发贫瘠，质地如脓，毒绿的感染蔓延开来，伸出细长的臂膀，渴求与什么东西接触。

~ 由一位英雄构想

At brief, infrequent moments, the chaotic, looping mass of viny slime seems peaceful, like a rise of moss and leafy growth over a tree stump. It turns, as if accelerated, and grows taller. But as it does, the elemental green seems less fertile, its texture like pus, a poison-green infection that reaches out its long arms for something to touch.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Storm Giant's Throne Room.name:
风暴巨人的王座厅
Storm Giant's Throne Room

Text.text:
一扇巨大的双开门由抛光木材制成，每扇门上都嵌着半棵银色金属的风格化树影。门一开，便通向一座为最庞大的巨人量身打造的王座厅。大厅尽头，一根天然象牙——一枚泰坦般的巨牙——自地面直抵穹顶。王座被直接雕刻在巨牙的根部，两侧则以透明材质构成高耸的窗扉，簇拥着那道象牙的苍白光辉。以银色灰浆勾缝的白色大理石铺成地面、拱顶与部分墙体，墙面如框架般围拢着一幅幅宏伟的浮雕。那些刻痕讲述着一位巨人的传奇：他曾是年轻的士兵，立下赫赫功绩——从击败其他巨人到屠戮巨龙——最终崛起，统领同族。

~ 构想：Teramin

A massive double door of polished wood, each door set with half a stylized tree in silvery metal, opens into a throne room sized for the largest giants. Natural ivory—a titanic tusk—stretches from floor to ceiling on the chamber’s far side. A throne is carved into the tusk’s base, and transparent material forms tall windows to either side of the ivory. White marble mortared with silver forms the floor, the vaulted ceiling, and parts of the walls, which frame massive carved images. These engravings tell the story of a giant who served as a young soldier, performed great deeds—from defeating other giants to slaying dragons—and rose to command others of his kind.

~ Envisioned by Teramin

冲在队伍最前方，那头猎犬从掩蔽处窜出又猛地停下，喘着粗气。她肩高五英尺，身形精瘦，短而厚实的皮毛紧贴肌理，狼一般的面孔冷硬森然。她左右转动脑袋，眼中泛着精灵般的绿光，毛皮上闪烁着星辉，蓝色的符文咒文如同流光般游走。她身后传来其余同伴的窸窣声响，还有他们那位骇人的首领逼近的动静。
Out ahead of the pack, the hound breaks from cover and stops, panting. She is five feet tall at the shoulder and lean, with tight, thick fur and a face like a wolf. She turns her head left to right, eyes glowing green with faerie light and coat glittering with starlight and blue runic script. From behind her comes the rustling sound of the others and their terrifying leader.

Weapon Of High Elf Craftsmanship.name:
高等精灵匠艺武器
Weapon Of High Elf Craftsmanship

Text.text:
刀身泛着收敛的星辉，银色微光使你视野边缘的阴影愈发深沉。金属柔韧却坚韧，剑柄缠着柔软的绿色皮革。它让人想起一片修长的叶子，尖端渐细，细致蚀刻的薄膜状纹理如蛇般沿着血槽蜿蜒而上。
The blade gleams with subdued starlight, a silver glow that deepens the shadows in your periphery. The metal is pliable but resilient, with a hilt wrapped in soft, green leather. It evokes a long, slender leaf, tapering at its tip, and finely etched membranous lines snake up along the fuller.

Gaining Control Of A Device.name:
夺取装置控制权
Gaining Control Of A Device

Text.text:
对外行而言，这是一项令人惊叹的专长；可对你来说，不过是个小小的戏法。只需快速诊断一遍，随手改动几行代码，再伪造一份授权，就能完成所有权转移。你迅速试着激活被控制的装置，确认你已成了它的新主人。

~ 一位英雄所构想

While it’s an impressive feat to the uninitiated, this is barely more than a parlor trick to you. It takes only a quick diagnostic, a few manipulations of code, and a duped authorization to transfer ownership. You quick-test activation of the controlled device to confirm you as its new master.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

营地背风处的草地里，几截树桩突兀地刺出地面。它们像是早已枯死的朽木，和你在周围林地里瞥见的几棵死树如出一辙。附近明明尽是葱郁挺立的健康树木，却偏偏有好几棵死在同一处，显得格外反常。也许是一场病害，或某种虫患，专门侵袭了某一类树木。
Several stumps jut up from the grass in the lee of the campsite. They look to have been dead wood, like a few of the trees you see in the surrounding wood. With so many green and healthy trees standing nearby, seeing several dead ones in one place seems odd. Perhaps a sickness or infestation affected a particular type of tree.

Approach To Lake.name:
通往湖畔之路
Approach To Lake

Text.text:
湖畔草甸中矗立着一间小木屋，由粗锯木板与刨光圆木搭建而成。通往此处的草地小径被两条宽阔的泥土路夹在中间。屋旁是一座围栏圈起的菜园。再往外是一片湖泊，水面如镜，映出对岸森林的倒影。细薄的炊烟从小屋烟囱里袅袅升起。
Amid a lakeside meadow stands a small cabin of rough-cut lumber and shaved logs. The grassy approach is framed by two wide dirt paths. Next to the house is a fenced garden. Beyond is a lake with a glassy surface, reflecting the forest on the opposite bank. Thin smoke curls from the cabin’s chimney.

Big Box Electronic Store.name:
大型盒式电子卖场
Big Box Electronic Store

Text.text:
“欢迎光临！”一台漂浮的无人机用滑稽又滋滋作响的嗓音向你招呼。它靠着一个吵得过分的风扇推进，嗡嗡地贴着你的头侧盘旋；它的“脸”是一块方形屏幕，上面跳动着由蓝色像素拼成的表情符号。“今天想要我们为你做些什么？”

你一边准备回答，一边打量这间开阔得像仓库一样的商店。越过一排排家电与小器械的货架，你看见后墙从地面一直铺到天花板，密密麻麻挂满了不同尺寸、不同清晰度的电视屏幕。它们全都在循环同一幅画面：一名女性仿生人把嘴唇贴在自己卷起的指节上，强忍着一声窃笑。

其中一条过道里摆着一整支相同仿生人的“军团”，个个垂着头，身体赤裸却毫无细节。商店的另一个角落陈列着一辆飞行汽车，完美无瑕的车身在刺眼的灯光下泛着冷亮。它悬浮在防护隔离带后方，把眼里冒光的顾客隔开，免得他们靠近那强劲的螺旋桨与灼热的推进器。
“Welcome!” a floating drone greets you with a funny, fizzling voice. Propelled by a too-loud fan, the drone buzzes near your head, its face a square screen bearing a shifting emoticon made of blue pixels. “What can we do for you today?” It awaits your response as you take in the expansive, warehouse-sized store. Beyond the aisles of appliances and gadgets, you see the back wall is covered floor to ceiling in TV screens of various sizes and definitions. They all show the same recurring image: a feminine android pressing her lips on her curling fingers, suppressing a giggle. One aisle features a legion of this same android, heads drooped downward, bodies naked yet featureless. Another corner of the store sports a flying car, its blemish-free chassis gleaming under the blaring lights. It floats behind a protective barrier, keeping starry-eyed customers away from its powerful propellers and scorching thrusters.

Invitation To Join A Party.name:
加入队伍的邀请
Invitation To Join A Party

Text.text:
“你真想在这地方虚掷一生吗？用庸俗的节庆与家族聚会来标记每一年流逝？还是说，你想加入我们，为了钱去宰掉那些邪恶之物？”
“Do you really wish to while away your life in this place? Marking each passing year with banal holidays and family gatherings? Or do you want to join us and kill evil things for money?”

Crowded Deli.name:
拥挤的熟食店
Crowded Deli

Text.text:
柜台下的橱柜里塞满了腌制熟肉与奶酪，拥挤的熟食店里空气被热烈的谈笑声填得满满当当。食客们排着长队一直蜿蜒到门外，每个人都攥着一张小小的红色票券，仿佛那是无价的钻石。忽然一阵骚动爆开——有人被指责插队，扭打的对头一离开队伍，其他顾客便立刻蜂拥上前填补空隙。店主只淡淡扫了一眼，眉梢一挑，便又低头继续忙活手上的活计。
Seasoned meats and cheeses cram the cabinet under the counter, and the air is filled with lively conversation in the crowded deli. Patrons queue out of the door, each clutching a small red ticket as if it were a priceless diamond. A commotion erupts as someone is accused of cutting in, and customers rush to fill the gap left by the scuffling adversaries. The owner spares a glance and a raised brow for the incident before resuming their work.

一阵清凉的微风卷入，搅动了这片潮湿腐闷、停滞不前的空气。寂静的房间里，骨撞石的刺耳咔哒声回荡不绝。它迈着缓慢而不匀的步伐走来。巫妖嶙峋的骨颚间白齿咯咯作响，火焰般的双眼闪烁跳动，幽绿的鬼光一明一灭。它那邪毒的面孔扭曲成一副纯粹、不加掩饰的恶意与残酷。长而飘荡的翡翠色长袍遮掩了它的骸骨躯体，但裸露的双手与面容解除了一切误解——这存在，不是活物。
A cool breeze rolls in, disturbing the dank, stale air. The harsh click of bone-on-stone resonates through the silent room. It walks with slow, uneven steps. White teeth rattle in the boney maw of the lich, its fiery eyes glow and pulse with a ghastly green light. Its wicked face is twisted into a display of pure, unadulterated malice and cruelty. Long, flowing emerald robes disguise its skeletal figure, but the exposed hands and face dispel any misconception. This being is not alive.

Nightmare About Watchers In The Wood.name:
林中守望者的噩梦
Nightmare About Watchers In The Wood

Text.text:
每一脚咯吱踩碎林地的枯叶，都像是在招来死亡。你知道有什么在盯着你。你就是知道。你加快脚步，呼吸急促起来……忽然，一根细枝“咔”的一声折断。你猛地回头，却只看见同样一排排树干与遍地死叶。喉咙刺痛、干得发涩，你仍咬牙向前。你的脚踝突然深深陷进腐殖层里，猛地一扭。你摔倒在地，听见一阵窸窣的响。还有别的东西——坚硬、冰冷、顶着你——就藏在落叶底下。你还没来得及挣扎起身，冰冷、无皮的手指已穿过你张开的手掌，像恋人十指相扣般缠住——一只骷髅手死死攥住了你。它那骨节突起的指尖深深掐进你的皮肉。地底涌起一片空洞的尖啸，你感觉又有上百只手伸来，揪住你的头发、皮肤与衣物。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

Each crunching foot onto the forest floor feels like a call for death. You know something is watching you. You just know. Your breath quickens as you pick up the pace… and a twig snaps. You whip your head behind you but only see the same stretch of trunks and dead leaves. Throat stinging, desiccated, you press on. Your ankle suddenly sinks too far into the duff, twisting. You fall to the ground and hear a rattle. Something else—hard, cold, and poking—lies beneath the leaves. Before you can scramble back to your feet, cold, skinless fingers weave through your splayed hand like lovers’ hands entwining—a skeletal hand grasping your own. The points of its bony fingers dig into your flesh. A chorus of hollow shrieks rise up from the ground and you feel a hundred more hands grab at your hair, skin, and clothes.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Cast Faerie Fire.name:
我施放妖火
I Cast Faerie Fire

Text.text:
光在我手上流淌，织出耀眼的纹样，我唤起法术的能量。旋转的魔法光珠在我身周闪烁跳动，温热随之升腾；它们越转越快，越来越急切，仿佛迫不及待要被释放。
Light plays over my hand in dazzling patterns as I summon the energies of the spell. A warmth grows around the swirling baubles of magic as they flicker about me, faster and faster, desperate to be unleashed.

这把朴素的弓以山核桃木削制而成，并以亚麻籽油细细揉擦养护；做工不事繁华，却处处见用心。弓身几乎没有装饰，唯有握柄上刻着一列六枚粗犷的符文——猎手们常用的印记——其中已被注入某种德鲁伊的魔法。
Carved from hickory and carefully rubbed with linseed oil, this uncomplicated bow was crafted simply but with great care. Though the bow lacks much in terms of decoration, a series of six rustic runes inscribed upon the grip, commonly used by game hunters, have been infused with some form of druidic magic.

Quip About A Jungle.name:
关于丛林的俏皮话
Quip About A Jungle

Text.text: “为什么我们非得走这条路？这地方寸寸都活着，在那儿扭动蠕爬。” “Why did we have to come this way? Every inch of this place is alive and wriggling.”

凉夜的寒意在残破墙垣内侧便被温润的暖气取代。地面上，蛇群沿着怪异砖石之间的沟槽悄然滑行。或大或小，它们在瓦砾间游猎、盘卧取暖，宛如晴暖日头下的景象。有些则从每块地砖四角张开的孔洞里钻出。此地散发着一种分明的气息：这里不属于温血之物。
The cool night gives way to balmy air just inside the ruined walls. Across the floor, snakes slide in the grooves between the odd tiles. Large and small, they hunt and bask amid the rubble as if on a warm day. Some emerge from holes that open at every tile’s corners. The place radiates the feeling that this is no place for the warm-blooded.

Complicated Drink Order.name:
复杂的饮料点单
Complicated Drink Order

Text.text:
“先拿一个矮胖的小罐子，体型跟拳头差不多，把桑葚金酒倒进去，一指深。用青柠在杯口抹一圈，别挤汁。再放片薄荷和一点水，够让猫满意就行。然后用接骨木花汤力粗粗一冲，再把罐子晃两下把它摇醒。哈！”
“Start with a short, fat jar the size of a fist and put the mulberry gin there, a finger’s width. You rub the lime around the rim, and don’t squeeze it. Then a mint and some water, just enough to please a cat. Rough it up with some elderflower tonic, then wave the jar around a bit to wake it up. Ha!”

Sobbing Stranger In A Storm.name:
暴风雨中的啜泣陌客
Sobbing Stranger In A Storm

Text.text:
细雨轻敲窗玻璃，如一串串小铃叮当作响，远处雷声在山谷上空滚滚回荡。来往的车马把镇上的土路翻搅成一片泥泞沼泽，酒馆里挤满了浑身湿透、急着躲雨的旅人——但并非所有人都愿意进门。就在酒馆外不远的镇广场上，你看见一名半身人女子独自跪在地上，哭得撕心裂肺，怎么也止不住。

~

Gentle rain patters against the glass of the window like the ringing of tiny bells, just as distant thunder resounds over the valley. Passing carts have churned the dirt roads of the town to a muddy quagmire, and the tavern is bustling with drenched travelers eager to shelter from the storm—but not all are so inclined. In the town square just beyond the tavern, you see a lone halfling woman on her knees, sobbing inconsolably.

~

Seedy Wayside Inn.name:
肮脏的路边客栈
Seedy Wayside Inn

Text.text: [外面]  这家曾经体面的驿站旅店早已风光不再。马厩的屋顶塌得像旁边拴在木桩上的那匹灰老母马的脊背——而旅店本体更离谱，瞧着像是大风一刮就要散架。若不是那匹马还在，还有那歪斜烟囱里卷上来的白色木烟的气味与影子，你多半会以为这里早已荒废。不过除去几片缺失的瓦片、龟裂的墙面和半悬的窗板，这地方倒也算得上“还挺像回事”。嗯……总比睡沟里强。大概吧。 [里面]  穿过沉重木门下那道低矮门楣，酒馆的地面铺满了稻草，看上去像是“刚铺不久”……大约是去年的春天。长凳、桌子东拼西凑，倒扣的木桶和水桶也被拿来当座位，给那些愿意走到这里来的少数本地人落座。油腻头发的店主咧开缺牙的笑，一把从吧台上抄起写着 Prices 的粉笔牌，狠命地擦拭，把上头原本写着的东西统统抹掉。 [Outside]  This once-fine coaching inn has seen better days. The roof of the stables is as sway-backed as the old gray mare tied to a post beside it—notably not inside the building itself, which looks like it might collapse in a strong wind. Were it not for the horse, and the sight and smell of the white woodsmoke curling up from its tilted chimney, you’d guess it was abandoned. But besides some missing shingles, cracked walls, and dangling shutters, the inn looks welcoming enough. Well… better than sleeping in a ditch. Probably. [Inside]  Beyond the low lintel of the heavy door, the floor of the inn’s taproom is covered in straw that looks like it was freshly laid… sometime last spring. Mismatched benches, tables, and overturned buckets and barrels serve as seating to the few locals who bother to walk here. The greasy-haired innkeeper gives you a gap-toothed smile as he snatches a chalkboard labelled Prices off the bar and rubs it furiously, cleaning away whatever was written there.

Huge Corporate Enclave In The Heart Of T.name:
城市心脏地带的庞大企业飞地
Huge Corporate Enclave In The Heart Of The City

Text.text:
企业总部是一座玻璃与钢铁铸就的擎天巨构，如同压迫的泰坦般在城市心脏之上阴沉耸立。它俯视着下方被契约束缚的民众，几近无处不在。
The corporate headquarters is a towering edifice of glass and steel, looming like an oppressive titan over the heart of the city. It gazes at the indentured populace below, almost omnipresent.

Binli Oskar, Hill Dwarf Necromancer.name:
宾利·奥斯卡，丘陵矮人死灵法师
Binli Oskar, Hill Dwarf Necromancer

Text.text:
她的脸仿佛由她亲手挖出的泥土捏塑而成。她身后，一头瘦骨嶙峋的骡子摇着头，苍蝇在它的驮包与耳边飞舞盘旋。宾莉的神情平静如止水，近乎冥想；她用两只巨大的手握着铁锹柄，像在致敬它，也致敬那座尚未完工的坟。那双手上的纹身赋予她掩埋的力量，也赐她掘尸的庇护。有些尸体必须入土。有些必须被唤起。
Her face seems shaped from the clay she digs. Behind her, a scrawny mule shakes his head. Flies dance around his pack and ears. Binli’s face is placid, meditative, and she holds the shovel handle with both massive hands, in reverence to it and to the unfinished grave. The tattoos on those hands give her strength to bury and protection to disentomb. Some corpses must be put in the ground. Some must be raised.

一块布满伤痕的巨石横在路中央，挡住了你的去路。它古老而风化，褶皱般的凹陷里零星生着苔藓。你下意识捕捉到一丝移动，停顿片刻才看清那份变化：裂缝豁然张开，露出煤黑的眼睛与中央一张巨口——锯齿般的洞穴沉积物森然交错，带着冰冷的饥渴咔嚓咬合，死死盯着你。你脚下传来令人牙酸的碾磨声，那半埋在地里的巨石轰隆向前，滚动着扑来，准备大快朵颐。
A scarred boulder stands blocking your path. Ancient and weathered, patches of moss grow sporadically inside creased recesses. You subconsciously register movement and take a moment to notice the change: the cracks have split wide to reveal coal eyes and a central maw of serrated speleothems that gnashes with cold hunger as it regards you. You feel a grinding beneath your feet as the half-burrowed boulder rumbles forward to feast.

Dingy Sporting Goods Store.name:
昏暗的体育用品店
Dingy Sporting Goods Store

Text.text: 后巷小店里，头顶的灯光令人烦躁地闪烁，空气中隐约飘着一股汗味。各种运动装备——大多陈旧得可怜——被胡乱塞在高低不平的架子上，几乎看不出有人用心整理；而那些官方商品的拼写错误更是随处可见。 The lighting flickers irritatingly overhead in the back-alley store, and the air smells faintly of sweat. Sporting equipment—most of it woefully antiquated—has been crammed on uneven shelves with little care or attention, and most of the official merchandise has spelling errors.

Carbon Steel Combat Knife.name:
碳钢战斗匕首
Carbon Steel Combat Knife

Text.text:
这是一把务实的刀具，通体朴素，没有任何贴花或标志。它收纳在一只长方形碳纤维刀鞘中，后侧装有腰带固定扣。握柄以合成橡胶为芯，外缠碳线缝织的细绳，确保握持稳固不滑。刀身漆黑，刃口泛着银光，末端收束成锯齿般的尖点。一侧全为锯齿刃，另一侧则锋利如剃刀。
A practical tool, this knife is unadorned with any decals or logos. It sits in a rectangular carbon sheath, with a rear-mounted belt attachment. The handle is synthetic rubber wound over with carbon-stitched twine to ensure good grip. The blade itself is black with a silver edge, ending in a jagged point. One side of the blade is entirely serrated, the other razor sharp.

Tritur, The Newtkin Hunter.name:
特里图尔，新蜥裔猎手
Tritur, The Newtkin Hunter

Text.text:
猎人叉腰而立，四指利爪紧握长矛，随时待发。他披着由树叶与沼泽藤蔓编成的兜裆布，湿亮的蝾螈皮几乎尽数暴露在外。大半肌肤呈黑蓝相间的斑纹，唯有胸膛、腹部与掌心泛着如余烬般炽亮的橙光。沼泽的青绿苔藓黏在他的脚踝、矛尖末端，以及那条修长、带冠的尾巴腹侧。它静如磐石，在浑浊的泥水里不激起一丝涟漪、不发出半点声响，只死死盯着那被他察觉的威胁方向。
The hunter stands with legs and arms akimbo, one four-fingered claw holding a spear at the ready. He wears a loincloth made of leaves and swamp vines so that his glistening newt hide is nearly on full display. While most of his flesh is marbled black and blue, his chest, stomach, and palms gleam an ember-bright orange. Teal moss of the swamp clings to his ankles, the end of his spear, and the underside of his long, crested tail. Still as stone, causing no ripple or sound in the murk, he stares in the direction of a perceived threat.

你感到这次攻击带来的痛楚，报复的狂怒随之将你吞没。你猛地朝罪魁祸首甩出一只手臂，指着对方伸出控诉的手指，同时吐出污秽的诅咒。黑暗的力量回应你的呼唤，宣判般的烈焰在你的敌人周身轰然爆发。
You feel the pain of the attack and a retaliatory rage engulfs you. You fling an arm toward the guilty party, uttering a foul curse as you point an accusing finger. A dark power answers your call, and condemning fire erupts around your foe.

Caution From A Quest Giver About Rogues.name:
委托人对盗贼的警告
Caution From A Quest Giver About Rogues

Text.text:
“你们当中没人是游荡者，对吧？几年前我雇过一队那种人。活儿本来挺简单，可等到背后捅刀、两面三刀都折腾完，他们全死在我客厅里，而我的钱包也不翼而飞。”
“None of you are rogues, right? Hired a party of those types a few years back. Simple enough job, but by the time all the backstabbing and double crossing was done they were all dead in my living room and my wallet was missing.”

Loot From A Young White Dragon.name:
幼年白龙的战利品
Loot From A Young White Dragon

Text.text:
生物凶残的巨颚大张着，曾驱动那致命噬抱的肌肉如今在死亡中松垮无力。霜痕覆满巨龙骇人的獠牙——每一枚都足有一只手掌那么长——你不禁琢磨，或许它们能用于打造武器、调制药剂，以及更为玄秘的制品。
The creature’s ferocious jaws hang open, the muscles that once animated their deadly embrace now limp and slack in death. Frost rimes the dragon’s formidable fangs—each one a full hand in length—and you wonder if they might be useful in crafting weapons, potions, and more esoteric fare.

Rift In Space-time Opens.name:
空间-时代裂隙开启
Rift In Space-time Opens

Text.text:
一缕不可能存在的红-蓝-金裂光在你面前闪烁。光芒刺目，令你难以直视其内。裂隙之中，成千上万种可能的现实在你眼前电闪而过：无尽的靛蓝城市、覆着冰冠的残酷群山、蒸腾翻涌的气态巨行星，以及呼啸狂啮的烈风。裂隙猛地一颤，随即稳定下来，边缘变得平滑——不再参差，不再暴戾——它终于停止了移动。此刻，你面前悬着一个球形的空洞——通往另一处所在的门径……也许，通往另一个时代。
An impossible sliver of red-blue-gold shimmers before you. It dazzles you to look inside. Within the tear, thousands of possible realities flash before your eyes: endless indigo cities, cruel ice-capped mountains, steaming gas giants, and howling gales. The rift judders then stabilizes, the edge smooths—less ragged, less violent—as it ceases to move. Now there is a spherical hole before you—a gateway to a different place… perhaps a different time.

A Merry Tune In A Dank Tavern.name:
阴湿酒馆里的欢快曲调
A Merry Tune In A Dank Tavern

Text.text:
你踏入这间昏暗的酒馆时，陈年麦酒的霉味夹杂着油腻肉块凝固的腥香扑面而来。几乎每张桌子旁都挤满了肮脏、汗湿的身影，他们弓着背伏在兑了水的酒杯上，低声说话。吟游诗人小提琴奏出的明亮欢快旋律在室内跳跃盘旋，嘲弄着酒客们阴郁的神情，为潮湿发霉的空气添上一层扭曲的和声。
The musty scent of old ale mingled with the aroma of congealing greasy meat greets you as you step into the dimly lit tavern. Dirty, sweaty bodies hunched over tankards of watered-down ale crowd around almost every table, speaking in hushed tones. The bright and merry tune from a minstrel’s fiddle mocks the dour mood of the patrons as it dances around the room, adding a warped harmony to the dank atmosphere.

这把霰弹枪包覆在坚固的聚碳酸酯外壳中，外壳专为模块化加装而设计；它的装填与击发顺滑利落，像一名训练有素的士兵般一丝不苟。比街头常见的货色强得多，这件武器在紧张的近距离交火中可靠得像你的后背一样值得托付。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

Clad in a sturdy, polycarbonate housing designed for modular attachments, this shotgun has the smooth loading and firing action of a well-drilled soldier. Better than anything you’d usually find on the street, this weapon can be relied on to have your back in a tense, close-quarters engagement.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Approaching Riverside Border Town In Spr.name:
春日逼近河畔边境镇
Approaching Riverside Border Town In Spring

Text.text:
当你触及边境时，太阳已低垂在天际。湍急的河水对岸立着一座朴素的小镇：木造房舍一律刷成白色，屋顶覆着红色石板，檐下垂挂着扭绞的芦苇花环。镇民在繁忙的街道上穿梭奔走，提着篮筐，彼此高声呼唤。  

一座坚固的桥横跨河面，几辆大车缓缓驶过，车上货物用结实的油布严严实实地遮盖着。每一辆车都被拦下搜查：身着皮甲的守卫一丝不苟，长矛紧握在手，神情却透着紧张与不安。仿佛这里发生了什么，打破了这春日应有的宁静。
The sun is low in the sky by the time you reach the border. Across the fast-moving river stands a modest town, its wooden buildings painted a uniform white, topped with red slate roofs and garlands of twisted reeds. Townsfolk bustle through the busy streets, carrying baskets and calling out to each other. A sturdy bridge spans the river, and several large wagons, their loads covered with durable tarps, pass over it. Each wagon is stopped and searched by diligent guards garbed in leather, with spears clutched in their hands, and nervous looks on their faces. Something seems to have happened here to break the tranquility of the spring day.

她以你最渴望的模样显现，然而你仍看不真切——她炽白的光辉太过强烈，刺得视线发痛。无论她是端丽如雕像，抑或纤巧玲珑；无论她张扬放肆，抑或含蓄矜持，这位女神祇都毋庸置疑地强大而机巧。她既栖身于魔法的边界之外，也端坐于万千真实交汇的枢纽之中。世间一切凡俗所需与神圣欢愉，一切秩序与混沌，皆在她可怖的凝视下存在。你明白，与其说她关照凡人，不如说她更在意其他神祇与女神祇；但她仍被我们侥幸的猜测逗得兴味盎然、心生迷醉，而她的神情暗示着——此刻，她或许也愿意回赠一段蛊惑。
She appears as you wish to see her, though you cannot see her clearly, for her incandescent aura is too strong. Whether she is statuesque or petite, brazen or modest, the goddess is unquestionably powerful and ingenious. She lives both beyond the limits of magic, and the nexus of all realities. All of the mundane necessities and sacred joys of the world, all order and chaos, exist under her fearsome gaze. You know that her cares about mortals are superseded by her concerns for the other gods and goddesses, but she is amused and enchanted by our lucky guesses, and her expression suggests that at the moment, she may be willing to enchant in return.

你将物品捧在掌心，低声吟诵咒文。一道炽亮的闪光刺透你的眼睑，昭示着法术正在生效。你睁开眼，只见发光的魔法丝线自虚空中被牵引而出，穿梭缠绕，编织在物体的表里之间。凭借它们的色泽、粗细，以及织网的紧密程度与纹路走向，你便能辨出其中蕴藏的魔法类别——并且清楚知道该如何使用它。
You hold the item in your hands and chant the incantation. A flare pierces your eyelids, indicating the spell is working. You open your eyes to see glowing threads of magic being drawn from thin air to weave around and through the object. By their color, their thickness, and the tightness and pattern of the weave, you can discern the type of magic within—and exactly how to use it.

住处不大，陈设略显清简，却绝不至于令人不适。一张羽绒床占据了一整面墙，上头堆着厚被与枕头。旁边是一只沉重的橡木脚箱，铁箍加固，挂着锁扣得严严实实。一张小书桌上摆着羊皮纸、墨水、羽毛笔，以及一支烧到一半的蜡烛。门边的木钉上挂着一条剑带，剑鞘饰着那位骑士家族的颜色。再往旁边，是一幅挂毯，虽被年代磨得褪色，却被细心照料着；其上描绘一名同样披着那些颜色的骑士，策马迎向一群不死者的潮涌。或许，是某位祖先？
The quarters are small, somewhat spartan, but far from uncomfortable. A feather bed dominates one wall, piled with quilts and pillows. A heavy footlocker of oak and banded iron sits padlocked nearby. A small writing desk holds parchment, ink, quill, and a half-burned candle. A sword belt hangs on a peg by the door, its scabbard adorned with the colors of the knight's house. And beside that hangs a tapestry, faded with age but well cared for, depicting a knight garbed in similar colors riding against a horde of undead. An ancestor, maybe?

Dungeon: Crumbling Rock Wall.name:
地城：崩塌的岩壁
Dungeon: Crumbling Rock Wall

Text.text:
这道墙的石块早已风化剥蚀，碎裂处露出其后掩藏的泥土。你面前的一块石头忽然松脱，毫不客气地坠落在地，发出一声沉闷的钝响。还有好几块看起来随时都会撑不住。
The stones of this wall are weathered and degraded, exposing the earth hidden behind them. One stone gives way right before you, dropping unceremoniously to the floor with a dull thud. Several more look ready to give out at any moment.

Stone Age River.name:
石器年代河流
Stone Age River

Text.text:
河水翻涌起白沫，奔流又急又深，激流随时都能不费吹灰之力将你卷走。河岸黏土淤积，树根从中爆裂般探出，宛如细长扭曲的指爪，拖曳在流动的水里。
The foaming waters of the river run fast and deep, and the rapids they form could snatch you away without effort. Tree roots erupt from the clay-filled banks of the river like long, gnarled fingers trailing in the flowing water.

这里是城里最贫穷的城区，之所以得名，是因为眺望附魔师学院高塔的视线被埃尔德维尤的庞然楼宇彻底遮断。断景区的建筑都更新，却也更廉价。最初的规划是要盖得比埃尔德维尤更高，可他们的钱花光了，于是此地大多只剩一层的小店，下面配着狭窄的下沉式地下室公寓。几家店铺透着可疑的气息，这座步行小镇的栈道旁路灯破损失明；一群群粗野之徒聚在街角与阴影里，像随时会涌出的暗潮。
This is the poorest ward in the city, named because its view of the Enchanter Academy tower is obstructed by the edifices of Elderview. The buildings of Breakview are all newer but cheaper. The original plan was to build taller than Elderview, but they ran out of money, so it mostly consists of one-story businesses with small walkdown basement apartments. Several of the businesses are suspicious, and the walkways of this pedestrian town have broken streetlights; clusters of rough characters stand on the corners and in the shadows.

Circle Of Power.name:
力量圣环
Circle Of Power

Text.text:
光芒浸透你的形体，在你周身起伏流淌。伴随着一阵宛如倒吸一口气的骤然声响，光沉入你的体内——世界仿佛在瞬间暗了一下——随即，耀眼的光自你体内轰然迸发。一个透明的球形护罩将你笼罩其中，直径三十英尺。魔法同时带来多重触感：像一只安抚的手搭在你肩上，像一条温暖的毯子，像一面高塔盾。
Light suffuses your form, undulating over and around you. With a sudden rush of sound like a gasp, the light sinks into you—and the world seems darker for a moment—before, brilliantly, the light explodes outward. A transparent sphere surrounds you, thirty feet in diameter. The magic feels like many things at once: a reassuring hand on your shoulder, a warm blanket, a tower shield.

Offer Of A Quest For A Family Heirloom.name:
为家族传世遗物所献的任务邀约
Offer Of A Quest For A Family Heirloom

Text.text:
“我不习惯向你们这种人求助，可外头埋着一样本该属于我的东西，却被人硬生生从我手里夺走。我的家人出于某种含糊的迷信想把它藏起来，但那是我的，我需要几位身怀绝技的你们，把它给我取回来。”
“I’m not used to asking for help from your sort but there is something buried out there that has been denied to me. My family sought to hide it out of some vague superstition, but it is mine, and I need some people of your unique talents to fetch it.”

Derelict Spelljammer Approaches.name:
废弃的法术飞舟逼近
Derelict Spelljammer Approaches

Text.text:
这艘舰船在空间的漆黑中漂流，像逼近的风暴般一点点向你的飞船迫近。它既未向你发出呼叫，也不见任何生命迹象，可某种不对劲的感觉正在蔓延，你后颈的汗毛骤然竖起，像在警告你：相信直觉。

~ DaveDaWanderer 于 Discord

The vessel drifts through the blackness of space, edging ever closer to your craft like an approaching storm. The ship has not hailed you or shown any signs of life, but something is amiss, and the hair on the nape of your neck stiffens, warning you to trust your instincts.

~ DaveDaWanderer on Discord

Menauros, The Third Circle Of Hell.name:
梅瑙罗斯，地狱第三环
Menauros, The Third Circle Of Hell

Text.text:
在被酸雨砸得叮当作响的金属屋檐下，觅食者们围坐在一张长桌旁；盘盘珍馐堆得像小山，却没有一滴能入口的饮水。他们望着恶臭沼泽腾起的热汽，与酸性绿雾在空中相撞、纠缠。长桌尽头摆着一张空椅，像是在嘲弄收获女神。他们一边吞咽一边受苦，腹中饱胀却仍饥馑，口干舌燥，牙关咬得咯咯作响。他们想着，也许走出这片金属屋檐会更好——但没有一个人真的踏出去。
Sheltering under a metal roof pelted by a rain of acid, the feeders sit at a long table, the most delicious of foods heaped on platters, but nothing to drink. They watch the steam off the stinking bog meet the acidic green haze. At the head of the table is an empty seat, mocking the Goddess of the Harvest. They eat and suffer, full but famished, mouths dry and champing. They wonder if it might be better to walk out from under the metal roofs, but not one of them does.

一声原初的咆哮撕裂你的躯体，回音震彻世界。大地震颤，水分被从根与叶、从空气与云、从你脸颊的泪珠与刺痛皮肤的毛孔中强行抽离，汇聚成一道元素之力的壁垒。它宽如三头鲸鱼首尾相接，亦高至同等，巨浪轰然席卷大地，宛如成群战象冲锋——自然颤抖的伟力彻底解放。
A primordial bellow rips through your body and echoes through the world. The ground shakes as water is pulled from root and leaf, air and cloud, from the tears on your cheek and the pores of your prickling skin to form a rampart of elemental force. As wide as three whales stretched nose to tip and rising just as tall, the wave thunders across the land like a herd of charging elephants—the quaking power of nature unleashed.

有人将死亡具象化，眼前浮现出一尊由纯粹黑暗铸成的泰坦巨影——凡人恐惧的帝王——可日常的死亡很少如此张扬。寻常的死亡耐心、沉静、悄无声息——甚至称得上专业——就像你面前这位穿着铆钉皮甲的健壮男子，嘴角挂着公事公办的微笑。
Some imagine death embodied and see a titanic figure of pure darkness—an emperor of mortal terror—but day-to-day death is rarely so ostentatious. Everyday death is patient, calm, and quiet—professional even—someone like the athletic man in studded leather before you, bearing a business-like smile.

Silver Crossbow And Bolts.name:
银色弩与弩矢
Silver Crossbow And Bolts

Text.text:
这把精制弩以抛光红木制成弩身与弩托，其上镌刻着如枝杈蔓延的纹路。锃亮的钢材构成了脚蹬、弩臂、触发、卡扣、弩槽与瞄准环。整件武器遍布银丝花纹点缀，足见其对美感的考究。随弩配的弩矢为短短的实木矢杆，刻出羽状翼片以稳定飞行；每一支末端皆镶着细长的银色金字塔形矢头。
This fine crossbow has a body and stock of polished mahogany, engraved with branching patterns. Gleaming steel makes up its stirrup, prod, trigger, catch, bolt groove, and sighting loop. Care to its aesthetic is demonstrated by the silver filigree that decorates the whole weapon. The bolts with the bow are short shafts of solid wood carved with fins to stabilize their flight. An elongated pyramidal head of silver tips each one.

I Activate My Pearl Of Power.name:
我启动我的法力珍珠
I Activate My Pearl Of Power

Text.text:
当我将这颗珍珠握在掌中，只需知晓一个词，便足以复原整道法术的语言。我将那词低声呢喃进宝石里，顿觉魔力奔涌而起，而这颗珍珠却仿佛缓缓沉入深沉的睡梦之中。
With this pearl in my hand, the knowledge of one word is sufficient to restore the language of an entire spell. I whisper the word into the gem and feel a surge of magical force, even while the pearl seems to drift into a deep sleep.

I Use My Robe Of Scintillating Colors.name:
我使用【炫彩长袍】
I Use My Robe Of Scintillating Colors

Text.text:
我连连疾旋，接连做出几次迅捷的旋转。薄如蝉翼的长袍随之飞舞，轮廓宛如钟形的天使号角花；衣摆末端俏皮而缠绕，如触须般在空中飘荡，伴我旋转而起落。每一次扭身，衣料便泛起虹彩——万千颜色同时流转——迸出火石反复撞击岩石般的明亮火星。随后，宛若一道闪电乍现，它骤然变得灿然刺目：一条缀满星光、亮得无法直视的披肩。
I spin in a series of quick pirouettes. My sheer robe whirls, its shape akin to the bell-like angel's trumpet flower, its perky, tendriled ends floating through the air as I spin. With each twist, the garment shines iridescent—a thousand colors at once—and sparks bright like flint being struck repeatedly against stone. Then, with a flash like lightning, it becomes brilliant, eye-searing: a starry shawl too bright to behold.

I Cast Commune With Nature In The Outdoo.name:
我在户外施放了【自然交感】
I Cast Commune With Nature In The Outdoors

Text.text:
我的法术是一连串元素之问，用的是早于时代的语言。周遭世界以神圣的智慧作答。我将双手举向空中，随后接触大地，便能知晓方圆数里之内，哪里能找到我所需之物。
My spell is a set of elemental questions, in languages that predate time. The world around me answers with its divine wisdom. I raise my hands to the air and then touch the earth, and learn for miles around me where to find what I need.

Large Jungle Encampment Of Soldiers.name:
大型丛林士兵营地
Large Jungle Encampment Of Soldiers

Text.text:
身着轻皮甲的士兵在营地里来回晃荡。人数多得难以清点——帐篷在林间空地里零零散散地扎起，哪里有空间就往哪里安。汗水在他们脸上发亮，热带丛林的闷湿几乎要把人压垮，许多人只得用盾牌给自己扇风。有人在磨尖矛头或修补护甲；也有人用骰子和纸牌打发时代。更多的人只是坐着，捧着酒水慢慢啜饮，满心纳闷自己到底怎么会沦落到这里，又到底什么时候才能回家。
The soldiers, garbed in light leathers, mill about the camp. It's hard to count how many—the tents are pitched in clearings here and there, as space allows. Sweat shines on their faces, and many fan themselves with their shields in the overwhelming humidity of the jungle. Many sharpen spearpoints or repair armor; others pass the time with dice and cards. Most simply sit, nursing drinks, wondering how the hell they ended up here, and when they get to go home.

Alley Encounter With A Boneclaw.name:
与骨爪的巷道遭遇
Alley Encounter With A Boneclaw

Text.text:
你沿着狭窄的巷子更深处走去，发现守卫的尸体浸在一滩新鲜的血泊里，暗得像陈酒。他的脸可怖得令人反胃——塌陷、扭曲，仿佛被凶狠地挤压成了烂泥。你还来不及做任何事，一只骨白的利爪便从黑暗中探出，悬在尸体上方微微颤抖。紧随其后，一张脸探入光里：眼睛是两口漆黑的深坑，薄唇覆在宽大而尖利的牙齿之上。那生物脖颈一歪，发出“咔”的一声，对你露出微笑。它开口说话，血红的舌头从丑陋的狞笑后弹出。 “看来，你并没有伤害我的主人，”它用孩童的声音说道——也许是个女孩，最多十一二岁。“真可惜。我本来会很乐意继续玩下去。”它抬起一根细长的骨指抵在唇边，嘶声吐出一记“嘘——”，随即如蛇般滑回黑暗，悄无声息地沉入其中，仿佛潜入水面。

~ Envisioned by Garwen Kazúl

Moving far into the thin alley, you find the guard’s body steeped in a pool of fresh blood, dark as wine. His face is a horrid, stomach-turning sight, sunken and twisted as if viciously squeezed to pulp. Before you can do anything, a bone-white claw emerges from the shadows, hovering over the corpse and trembling. A face comes into the light after it with dark pits as eyes and thin lips over broad, sharp teeth. The creature tilts its head with a crick and smiles at you. It speaks, a blood-red tongue flicking out from behind its hideous grin. “You have not harmed my master, it seems,” it says in the voice of a child—a girl, perhaps, no older than eleven or twelve. “What a pity. I would have loved to keep playing.” It puts a long, bony finger up to its lips, hissing out a “shhh” before sinking back into darkness like a snake gliding silently into water.

~ Envisioned by Garwen Kazúl

Compact Laser.name:
紧凑型激光器
Compact Laser

Text.text:
手枪的枪管被塑成棱角分明的盒状，枪管与下方握把之间隔着一层厚实的材质。扣下触发时毫无后坐力，然而枪口会喷射出一道粗壮的红色光束，仿佛要把所触及的一切尽数灼穿。
The handgun's barrel is shaped into box with hard corners, and a layer of thick material separates that barrel from the grip below. There's no recoil when the trigger is pulled, but a thick beam of red light shoots from the muzzle, threating the burn anything it touches.

I Study To The Point Of Exhaustion.name:
我埋头苦学，直至精疲力竭
I Study To The Point Of Exhaustion

Text.text: 再撑一章。天快亮了，我能看见尖塔巫奇外的农田在从山坡倾泻而下的晨光里泛起粉红的微光。我的眼睛灼痛，肿胀的眼眶像把它们死死卡住；我努力不去想床上那厚重的毯子。再来一个耐力小戏法，再读完Formulae Numerica这一章，我就能睡一会儿。可还不行。别打哈欠了，我！ One more chapter. It’s near dawn, and I can see the farms outside Spirewych start to glow pink in the light that pours down the hill. My eyes burn, jammed into swollen sockets, and I try not to think about the heavy blankets on my bed. Just another stamina cantrip and this chapter in the Formulae Numerica and I can sleep a little. But not yet. Stop yawning, me!

I Cast Darkness.name:
我施放黑暗
I Cast Darkness

Text.text:
我用指尖揉搓着那团沥青与蝙蝠毛绒成的球，向灵魂深处探去，寻找我内心的黑暗。我闭上双眼，从胸腔最深处扯出一团想象中的黏稠黑色污泥。我睁开眼，将这幅画面牢牢钉在脑海里，随即把材料抛向我的目标。它们一落地，一枚无法穿透的黑暗之球轰然迸发，遮蔽一切。
Rolling the ball of pitch and bat fur in my fingers, I reach deep into my soul, searching for my inner darkness. I close my eyes and from deep in my chest pull forth an imagined mass of sticky, black sludge. I open my eyes with this image fixed firmly in my mind and cast the components toward my target. As they land, a sphere of impenetrable darkness erupts, obscuring all.

Lesson From Mentor In Carpentry.name:
木匠师傅的教诲
Lesson From Mentor In Carpentry

Text.text:
“脚下踏板放慢点。你又不是在弹风琴。对。把斜口凿换成—— 车床速度稳住—— 好。换主轴圆凿。踩着踏板的同时把它换上。节奏别乱。现在圆凿要轻，正沿着那条线走。”
“Step slower on the pedal. You aren’t playing an organ. There. Switch out the skew chisel to the— Keep the lathe at steady speed— Okay. The spindle gouge. Change to it while you work the pedal. Keep the rhythm. Gentle with the gouge now, right on that line.”

Taunt From A Dragon About Motivations.name:
来自巨龙的嘲弄：动机何在
Taunt From A Dragon About Motivations

Text.text:
“你为何来此？为财富？为复仇？都无关紧要；凡踏入此地的英雄，终将以同样的方式离开：化作风中飞灰。”
“Why do you come here? Wealth? Vengeance? It matters little; all heroes that enter this place leave the same way: as ashes on the wind.”

Luxury Candy Bar.name:
奢华糖果棒
Luxury Candy Bar

Text.text:
这款加大号巧克力棒的包装上印着一段简短的动画：一个孩子咬下甜点，眼里瞬间盈满星光。就连摆放糖果的展示架也奢华得过分——明艳的色彩与闪烁的灯光争相夺目，把视线径直牵向那堆精心码放的存货。
The packaging on the double-sized candy bar features a short animation of a child biting into the treat, eyes filling with stars. Even the display for the candy is extravagant, with bright colors and flashing lights drawing the eye straight to the artfully stacked supply.

Rite Of Hunter's Bane.name:
猎人克星仪式
Rite Of Hunter's Bane

Text.text:
快如鞭影，半精灵从背后的鞘中抽出他的银剑。他用赤裸的掌心掠过剑刃——那刺痛他早已习惯，紧随而来的抽痛也轻易被肾上腺素的轰鸣淹没。灼肉的焦臭霎时充斥空气，明艳的赤红火焰缠绕上剑身，将林木映成地狱般的光景。树干与枝杈之间，他看见猎物那对闪烁、反光的眼睛。生物低吼，声音自桶状的胸腔里滚出，像警告的闷雷。但猎人也龇出野兽般的狞笑，双手紧握燃烧的长剑，鲜血沿着剑柄滴落。

~ Envisioned by Vmaster1995

Quick as a whip, the half-elf pulls his silver sword from the scabbard on his back. He runs his bare palm across the blade, a sting he’s well used to, the subsequent throb of pain easily drowned out with the thrum of adrenaline. The smell of seared flesh floods the air as bright red flames wreathe his sword, casting the trees in a hellish glow. Between the trunks and boughs, he sees the glinting, reflective eyes of his quarry. The creature growls, the sound a warning rumbling from its barrel chest. But the hunter bares his own bestial snarl and grips the flaming sword with both hands, his blood dripping down the hilt.

~ Envisioned by Vmaster1995

Loot From A Skeleton Carriage Driver.name:
来自骷髅马车夫的战利品
Loot From A Skeleton Carriage Driver

Text.text: 马车门松垮垮地敞着，像一侧脱臼的下颌。昏暗的车厢里垂着被蛀得千疮百孔的丝绸帘幕。你拨开这层磨得稀薄的帷幔，瞥见曾经华丽的天鹅绒座椅如今褪成灰白，散着花瓶里隔夜死水般的陈味。某个软垫座位下方，一点金属寒光闪过：一只深色皮匣，角上嵌着银色护边。匣子轻轻一掀，发出干脆的click，里面铺着乌黑如墨的丝绸，两把短匕被牢牢束在其中。它们小巧得足以细心藏进臂甲或袖口之内。 The carriage door hangs open, slack, like a jaw unhinged on one side. The shadowed interior is curtained by moth-eaten silk. Passing through the threadbare veil, you see once lush velvet seats, now faded to gray, that smell like the stale water of a flower vase. Underneath one of the cushioned seats, you see the glint of metal: a dark leather case with silver-braced corners. It opens with an easy click to an interior of jet-black silk with two short daggers strapped in place. They are small enough to be hidden carefully within a vambrace or sleeve.

Lair Of The Siren: Anticipation.name:
海妖的巢穴：预感
Lair Of The Siren: Anticipation

Text.text: 笑声里带着幽默，却没有半分暖意，只有令人发寒的期待。有人——某种东西——在那片迷雾缭绕的黑暗中知道你在这里，并一直等着你。前方传来一阵咯咯轻笑，可随即你右侧又回荡起一声低沉的嗤笑，快得不可能悄无声息地移动过去。听起来像是同一个声音，所以无论等待你的是谁——或是什么——都拥有超自然的力量。 The laughter has humor in it, but no warmth, just a chilling anticipation. Someone—some thing—out there in the misty darkness knows you’re here and has been waiting for you. A giggle comes from up ahead, but then a throaty chuckle echoes from your right, too fast to have moved there in silence. It sounds like the same voice, so whoever—whatever—awaits you possesses supernatural powers.

夜的薄纱缓缓掀起，让位于柔和的粉与淡淡的黄，渲染着清晨天幕上翻涌褶皱的云絮，掠过天际。太阳的暖辉小心翼翼地从地平线探出头来，仿佛要确认月亮已然沉睡。昏暗光照与轻柔的微风一同抚亮近处的景物——它们在黎明前还恰恰停在黑暗的边缘之外。
The veil of night lifts, giving way to soft pinks and pale yellows that stain the ruffled sheet of clouds sweeping across the morning sky. The warm glow of the sun peeks warily over the horizon, as if to confirm the moon’s slumber. Dim light and a gentle breeze illuminate the nearby surroundings, which had laid just beyond the edge of darkness until dawn.

古老洞窟神龛的祭坛上，干枯的供品与新鲜莹润的花朵交织陈列；摇曳的烛火将它们笼进柔和的琥珀色光晕里。融化的蜡脂不疾不徐地滴落在石面上，在洞穴地面汇成一滩滩蜡质小洼，朝圣者们静候着轮到自己的回合献上贡礼。
Dried offerings mingle with fresh, lustrous blooms on the altar of the ancient cave shrine, with flickering candles casting them in a soft amber light. Melting tallow drips steadily onto the stone, pooling in waxy puddles on the cavern floor as pilgrims await their turn to offer tribute.

I Cast Circle Of Death.name:
我施放「死亡之环」
I Cast Circle Of Death

Text.text:
我的拳心里攥着一粒价值不菲的小黑珍珠磨成的粉末。我将话语指向何处，空着的那只手又指向何处，一点黑斑便在半空浮现、悬停。它悸动着膨胀，如同卵石落水激起的涟漪向外扩散——向外十尺、三十尺、六十尺。一颗巨大的坏死之球。一间虚空之室。
Inside the sphere of my fist is the powder of a little black pearl of considerable value. Where I direct my words and aim my free hand, a black dot appears, hovering. It pulses and grows, like ripples flowing out from the landing of a pebble, ten feet outward, thirty, sixty. A great sphere of necrosis. A chamber of the void.

Scale Mail Armor +1.name:
鳞甲护甲+1
Scale Mail Armor +1

Text.text:
