这套精致的护甲由层层鳞片叠覆而成，或许并非金属，却能像最上等的精钢般将伤害尽数弹开。你不禁猜想，这些鳞片是否源自巨龙——那一抹金属般的冷辉，是否出自一头伟大古龙。每一次移动，鳞片相互轻轻叮当作响，清脆悦耳。
The layered scales of this fine suit of armor might not be metal, but they turn damage aside like the finest steel. You wonder if the scales are draconic in origin, if the metallic shine to their surface originates from a great wyrm. They clink together pleasantly with every movement.

这条巨大而缓慢流淌的水道表面泛起细小的涟漪，映出天穹的颜色。它向两端无尽延伸，宽深得无法涉渡。你也许得旅行数日，才能找到一处浅得足以徒步穿过的地方——或窄到有人曾在此架起桥梁的所在。
The surface of this great, slow-moving waterway glimmers with small ripples, reflecting the color of the sky. It seems to go on forever in both directions, too broad and deep to ford. You might have to travel for days to find a spot shallow enough to cross on foot—or narrow enough for a bridge to have been built.

肌肤惨白，心怀阴晦，这名吸血鬼骑士带着贵族般的冷笑伫立着。猩红如王袍的披风垂落在她古老的全身板甲之上。她的目光在房间里游移，眼底渴求着新鲜的血液。空气冰冷，她却不吐一丝白气，不死的气息昭然若揭。她抽出一柄乌黑长刃，身形如影般滑步逼近，舔过自己肿胀的嘴唇。
Pale of skin and dark of intent, this vampiric knight stands with an aristocratic sneer. A regal red cloak drapes over her ancient suit of plate. She gazes around the room, her eyes hungering for fresh blood. The air is chill, but she exudes no breath, her aura of undeath obvious. Drawing an ebon blade, she glides forward, licking her swollen lips.

I Cast Slow Using Components.name:
我用施法材料施放【迟缓术】
I Cast Slow Using Components

Text.text:
我轻轻倾斜一小罐糖蜜，让那甜腻的棕黑色丝带缓缓越过罐沿渗出——我也以同样沉缓的节奏吟诵我的法术。等那一滴糖蜜终于坠落时，我屏息凝神，死死盯着它，看那扭曲时代的魔法是否会黏附其上。
I tip a small pot of molasses until a sweet-smelling, brown-black ribbon oozes over the rim—and I chant my spell just as ponderously. When the drop of molasses finally falls, I watch with intense focus to see if the time-warping magic sticks.

Cowboy Mage With Magic Pistols.name:
手持魔法手枪的牛仔法师
Cowboy Mage With Magic Pistols

Text.text:
法师猛地掀开那件风霜磨旧的长风衣，将一只小袋子掷向对手，身形灵巧地侧扑闪开。袋子轰然炸裂，迸出一团炫目的磷光亮粉云——把他的目标尽数裹覆——与此同时，他从腰带上抽出一对左轮手枪。枪身上精细繁复的六角咒纹骤然点燃，泛起熔岩般炽烈的火光；每根枪管都喷跃出火焰，伴随木裂般的噼啪爆响。法师落地含笑，将枪收入套——敌人只剩焦黑炭化的空壳。

~ 由 ThunderWolf 构想

Flinging open his weathered duster, the mage hurls a small pouch at his adversaries and dives nimbly to the side. The pouch erupts in a dazzling cloud of phosphorescent glitter—coating his targets—as he draws a pair of revolvers from his belt. The intricate, hexographic carvings etched into the weapons ignite with a fiery, volcanic hue as flames leap from each barrel with a splintering crackle. The mage lands with a smile and holsters the weapons—his foes naught but charred and blackened husks.

~ Envisioned by ThunderWolf

这只高大纤长的昆虫披着粉黄相间的甲壳。它那带棱的几丁质螯爪——活像掘洞啮齿动物的前爪——不停刨抓着地面。一张狭长的虫面在碎屑间眯眼窥视。泥土从它背上簌簌滑落，都是它方才掘挖留下的痕迹。
This large, slender insect bears a pinkish-yellow carapace. Its ridged, chitinous claws—not unlike those of a burrowing rodent—paw at the ground. A narrow insectile face squints through the detritus. Soil sloughs off its back, remnants of its recent digging.

Spotting Dagne, Bride Of Ruin.name:
发现毁灭新娘达格妮
Spotting Dagne, Bride Of Ruin

Text.text:
一个身影——披着厚重的黑袍——双手合拢立着，骷髅（特征）般纤细的手指交错扣紧。她的脸与头颅被轻薄如雾的棉纱或丝绢层层缠裹，密不透风。她来回转动头颅，审视着四周。随即，那张毫无五官的面孔转向你——刹那间，你听见铺天盖地的甲壳摩擦声，尖利得仿佛那些生物正爬行在你的颅骨之内。刺耳的碎裂喧嚣中，一个女性的声音穿透而出：“你是来作见证的吗？现在还不是时候，但别绝望；我有无数世界要给你看。”你的视野被一片片黑斑吞没，像成千上万的螨虫爬过你的眼睛……而后，视线骤然清明。那悉悉索索的刮擦声沉了下去。你的脖颈与后脑涌起一阵灼痛的针刺感，像麻木的肢体里血液重新回流。那身影——不论她是谁——已经消失无踪。
A figure—draped in a heavy black robe—stands with hands clasped, their skeleton-thin fingers interlaced. Face and head are entirely wrapped in wispy layers of cotton or silk. They turn their head back and forth, surveying their surroundings. Then, their featureless face turns toward you, and suddenly you hear an overwhelming, chitinous scratching, so loud it’s as if these creatures are crawling inside your very skull. A feminine voice breaks through the crunching cacophony: “Have you come to bear witness? Now is not the time, but do not despair; I have such worlds to show you.” Your vision clouds with dark spots, like a thousand mites crawling across your eyes… and then your vision clears. The scritching and scraping quiets. Your neck and the back of your head flood with a painful prickling, like blood flowing back into a numb limb. The figure, whoever she was, is gone.

当你冗长的咒诵终于收束，镶满宝石的碗开始微微震颤、抖动，你的伙伴们满怀期待地注视着。碗以一种令视线短暂扭曲的方式，吐出了超乎一切理性想象的盛宴：八道菜的晚宴，既有熟悉的佳肴与美酒，也有异域的珍馐与奇饮。如此饕餮之席，足以让冒险者在即将到来的最严酷境地前，也重振精神、鼓起勇气。
Your companions look on expectantly as your long mantra comes to a close and the gem-encrusted bowl begins to shake and quiver. In a manner that twists the eye for a moment, the bowl produces a magnificent feast, beyond all reasonable imagining: an eight-course dinner featuring food and drink both familiar and exotic. Such a repast can hearten adventurers against even the direst circumstances to come.

Quip About Retreat And Cowardice.name:
关于撤退与怯懦的俏皮话
Quip About Retreat And Cowardice

Text.text:
“我知道大多数时候我们都努力去做正确而高尚的事，但也许就这一次，我们可以试着懦弱一回？我宁愿感到内疚与羞耻，也不愿什么都感觉不到。”
“I know that in most cases we strive to do the right and noble thing, but perhaps just this once we could experiment with cowardice? I’d rather feel guilt and shame than nothing at all.”

你面前这道威严的身影高挑而修长，容貌美得近乎不真实。苍白的肌肤如打磨过的大理石般无瑕，与那一头纯白长发浑然一体。弯弓般的眉峰衬出一双锐利的蓝眼，仿佛藏着凡人难以窥见的秘辛。那张脸带着异界般的气息，既摄人心魄又令人胆寒；纤薄的唇角爬上一抹轻佻的笑，像利刃般卸下你的防备。蝠翼自肩胛处戏剧性地展开，仿佛为其注入一股超自然的威势。衣装与气场同样夺目，裁剪得恰到好处，更衬出那份贵胄般的挺拔。满溢着近乎流血的自信，他们踏着灯火通明的大道前行，举手投足都在索要敬畏。

~ Played by redhawk2085 with

The majestic figure before you is a tall, slender being with a sublimely striking appearance. Their pale skin is unblemished like polished marble, homogeneous with their long, white hair. Arched brows frame their piercing blue eyes, which seem to hold secrets beyond the ken of mere mortals. The face has an otherworldly quality, both captivating and intimidating, with a disarming smirk crawling across their slender lips. Batlike wings rise dramatically from their shoulders, seeming to infuse them with a sense of preternatural power. Their garb is as impressive as their aura, cut to augment such noble bearing. Bleeding overconfidence, they stride down the well-lit boulevard, their demeanor demanding respect.

~ Played by redhawk2085 with

Kobold Dragon Mage.name:
狗头人龙法师
Kobold Dragon Mage

Text.text:
缀满金色钱币的银白长袍披垂在你面前那矮壮的龙形生物赤红的鳞片上。它宽阔的头颅上点缀着绿色斑驳，从紧挨着吻端前方那对珠粒般的琥珀眼一路蔓延到颅骨根部那对鹿角般的犄角。生物四指紧握一根翠玉法杖，杖身雕成巨龙之形——这无疑昭示着这位法师对其更为强大的庇护者怀有深切的敬畏与崇拜。
Argent robes stitched with gold coins drape the ruby scales of the squat draconic creature that stands before you. Their broad head is freckled with green blotches that extend from the beady amber eyes set just before their snout to the antlerlike horns at the base of their skull. A jade staff carved into the likeness of a dragon is held in the creature’s four-fingered grip, an obvious sign of this mage’s reverence for their much more powerful patron.

一声刺骨的长嚎自你喉间迸出；你的双手以死灵的手势切割空气，宛如一位大师提琴手在演奏。阴影为你面前横陈的尸体披上外衣。那些躯壳抽搐、战栗，随即起身：受召者奔赴这场骇人的舞会——踏着阴森奇诡的舞步——在一出死亡之外的生命哑剧中起舞。
A chilling ululation springs from your throat; your hands saw the air with necromantic gestures, like a master fiddler at play. Shadows clothe the corpses splayed before you. The bodies twitch, shudder, then arise: callers come to a ghastly ball—to trip a grim fantastic—in a pantomime of life beyond death.

Ruins Patrolled By Dangerous Aquatic Hum.name:
由危险的水栖类人巡逻的废墟
Ruins Patrolled By Dangerous Aquatic Humanoids

Text.text:
蔚蓝的水域随蜿蜒的水流起伏荡漾，水流在海带森林翠绿的茎秆间穿梭编织。掩映在植物之间，如同一处陈旧的隐修所，坐落着供奉一位纵欲却赐福安泰之神的神庙遗迹。头顶的阴影聚成颤动的云团，一群水栖（特征）的人形幼体从海带中猛然爆散而出，亢奋的嚎叫在水中回荡不绝。

~ Inbal 于 Discord 构想

The cerulean waters oscillate with the meandering currents weaving between the veridian stalks of sea kelp forests. Sequestered amid the plants, like an antiquated retreat, lie the temple ruins dedicated to a salubrious god of excess. Shadows form trembling clouds overhead as swarms of juvenile aquatic humanoids explode from the kelp, their ebullient howls resonating through the water.

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

一道身影从灌木的轮廓中无声地凝出轮廓，向前迈步时才显出与枝叶分离的存在。他身着衣物与皮质护甲，染成与地形相融的色调；你还看见，连他的装备也被熏黑或遮掩处理，确保没有一丝金属会在光线里反出微芒，暴露他的位置。
A figure silently resolves as something separate from the brush as he steps forward. He wears clothing and leather armor dyed in hues to match the terrain, and you see that even his equipment has been blackened or masked, so that nothing metal will glint in light and give his position away.

Thick Velvet Robe Of Scintillating Color.name:
绚彩流光的厚天鹅绒长袍
Thick Velvet Robe Of Scintillating Colors

Text.text: 这件厚实的天鹅绒长袍在你指间滑过如水般顺畅，表面光滑如丝，与面料本身的蓬松绒感形成奇妙的反差。它的颜色徘徊在纯黑、深蓝与浓郁梅紫之间那难以分辨的射程里；你越是凝视，越难说清究竟是哪一种色调。穿上它后，这件长袍会显露出一种诡异的能力——无论是觐见女王，还是在后巷与本地犯罪集团接头，它都同样得体，仿佛天生属于那一刻。 [启动] 你呼出一口气，轻拽长袍袖口。以你立足之处为中心，三十英尺内四面八方迸射出耀目的彩光光束。璀璨的色彩交融流转，衍生出无尽的虹彩变奏；那光影的戏法，比王室烟火表演最令人屏息的落幕还要摄人心魄。 This thick velvet robe slips like water between your hands, the smooth, silky surface at odds with the plushness of the fabric. The color lies in that indistinguishable range between pure black, deep blue, and rich plum, and the closer you look, the more difficult it is to pinpoint the exact shade. Once worn, this robe has the uncanny ability to look equally appropriate for an audience with the queen and a back-alley meeting with the local crime syndicate. [Activation] You tug the sleeves of your robe with an exhale. Dazzling beams of color burst forth at all angles thirty feet from where you stand. The brilliant hues blend and shift to form infinite variations of the rainbow, and the play of light is more mesmerizing than the jaw-dropping conclusion of a royal fireworks display.

Potion Of Mind Reading.name:
读心药剂
Potion Of Mind Reading

Text.text:
你将瓶身朝不同方向轻轻倾斜，黏稠的紫色液体紧贴着瓶壁缓缓滑动，身后拖出一道道半透明的残痕。更奇的是，你越是晃动药水，瓶子中央那抹闪烁的轮廓就越发清晰——那似乎是一枚带着玫瑰色光泽的椭圆体，每隔几秒便忽隐忽现，仿佛在眨眼。
As you tilt the jar one way and another, the viscous purple liquid clings to the sides of the bottle and leaves translucent trails in its wake. Further, the more you move the potion about, the clearer a glittery shape appears in the center of the bottle. It seems to be a rosy-hued oval that winks in and out of sight every few seconds.

I Throw My Dust Of Disappearance Into Th.name:
我把隐身尘撒向空中
I Throw My Dust Of Disappearance Into The Air

Text.text:
我将细腻、闪烁的沙粒抛向头顶，划出一道弧线，随即如同璀璨的雨幕纷纷落下。沙尘所过之处，一层魔法的帷幕轻柔降临，像飘雪般覆上我的身躯；我的身体在其掩映下渐渐褪去身形，当尘埃将我盖住时，我已彻底隐形。
I hurl the fine, twinkling sand in an arc above me and it falls like glittering rain. A shroud of magic descends delicately in its wake, blanketing me like drifting snow as my body fades away, becoming totally invisible when the dust covers me.

Ancient Green Dragon.name:
远古绿龙
Ancient Green Dragon

Text.text:
一层刺鼻的浓雾沉沉压在空气中，裹住一团庞然巨影。雾里有什么掠过——像被巨人甩出的树干；不，不是树：那是一条修长、带鳍的尾巴。远处起伏的草丘仿佛拔地而起，旋即在震耳欲聋的轰鸣中豁然张开，雾幕被撕得粉碎，一头巨龙的可怖威仪随之显现。
An acrid fog hangs thick in the air, shrouding a massive shape. A tree flies by through the haze as if whipped by a giant—no, not a tree: a long, finned tail. Great grassy hills seem to rise up then open with a thunderous boom, shredding the fog and revealing the terrible majesty of an enormous dragon.

一袭纤尘不染的纯白长袍，配以无瑕的淡色丝质长手套，再加上一只同样冷冽苍白的面罩与方巾，使这名男子除了护目用的风镜外，整个人都诡异得近乎失色。那风镜是棕色皮革制成，镜片呈浅淡的青绿色。他凝视着你，神情全然难以捉摸，也无法辨认。
Robes of spotless white, long gloves of flawless pale silk, and a facemask and kerchief of a similarly stark nature make this man eerily colorless except for the goggles he wears to protect his eyes. These are brown leather with lenses of pale green. He regards you, completely inscrutable and unrecognizable.

Farm Yard And House.name:
农家院与住宅
Farm Yard And House

Text.text:
两座低矮的建筑以层层叠砌的石块垒成，覆着茅草屋顶；齐腰高的石墙围出一处中央庭院。靠着一面墙的泥泞圈栏里，猪哼哼地拱着泥；对面的敞棚里，牛群拖着蹄子缓缓挪动。穿过木门，庭院对面便是主屋。它朴实而温暖，有人特意在窗板上绘了花朵，让这份简陋多了几分体贴。
Two low buildings, built from stacked stone and roofed in thatch, and waist-high stone walls form a central courtyard. Pigs grunt in a muddy enclosure along one wall, while cattle shuffle in the open-sided barn opposite them. The house stands across the courtyard, through the wooden gate. It looks homely and humble with someone having taken the time to paint flowers on its shutters.

Coven Meeting In A Ruined Temple.name:
在废墟神殿中的女巫集会
Coven Meeting In A Ruined Temple

Text.text:
吟诵声先于你看见那群女巫团，她们围拢在一座破败神殿的祭坛旁。月光从倾塌崩裂的石墙间渗出，坠落在聚集者披袍隐影的身形上——她们高举双手，迎来仪式的终末。白骨散落在符文圆环周遭的空间里，圆环以鲜血在石面上绘就。
Chanting precedes the sight of the coven, who encircle the altar of a ruined temple. Moonlight bleeds through the toppled, crumbling stone, falling upon the shadowed, robed forms of the assembled as they raise their hands into the air in the culmination of their ritual. Bones litter the space surrounding the runic circle, drawn with blood upon the stone.

门轴在门被向内压开时发出凄厉的呻吟，金属顽强地抵抗着这股力量，直到你一记记粗暴的猛推终于让它屈服。三座火盆幽幽发亮，明明这间密室被封死，炭火却依旧跃动。粗大的褐色根须在此处盘踞，穿透四面石墙奔涌而出——其中最巨的一条俯压在房间北侧那座龟裂的石祭坛之上。成排空荡的木长椅在祭坛前整齐列队，如同士兵般笔直均匀，却不见任何信众。一阵突如其来的寒意席卷整个区域，伴随着一声破败而拖沓的叹息般声响。就在入口左侧、越过一条探伸的根须之后，一具石棺开始微微震动，发出低沉刺耳的摩擦声。
The hinges wail as the door is pressed inward, the metal resisting mightily against the effort before eventually giving away to your forceful shoves. Three braziers glow, coals active despite the barring of this chamber. Large brown roots abound here, surging through each of the four stone walls—the largest looming over the cracked stone altar in the northern section of the room. Rows of empty wooden pews stand as neatly and evenly as soldiers before this altar, bereft of any attendants. A sudden cold washes over the area in tandem with a sound like a ragged sigh. Directly to the left of the entrance, beyond one of the reaching roots, a stone coffin begins to stir with a low, grating sound.

Priest Of A Dragon God.name:
龙神祭司
Priest Of A Dragon God

Text.text:
一位年迈的祭司拖着步子，在这座朴素神龛的圣墙之间踱行；那双爬行类的眼睛里跳动着顽皮的微光。他风霜刻下的面容低声诉说着数十年的智慧，却又暗藏未曾言明的谜团。他的存在带着一种古怪的鲜活感，低沉的嗓音回荡着一丝微妙、近乎异界的音色。

~ 由 Walt M. Envisioned

An elderly priest, a mischievous twinkle in his reptilian eyes, shuffles within the sacred walls confining this modest shrine. His weathered countenance whispers of decades of wisdom, yet hints at mysteries unspoken. There's a peculiar vibrancy in his presence, and his deep voice resonates with a subtle, almost otherworldly, timbre.

~ Envisioned by Walt M.

Fairy Barbarian Leaves The Horde.name:
妖精野蛮人离开兽群
Fairy Barbarian Leaves The Horde

Text.text:
一阵不由自主的战栗掠过，仙灵望着伙伴们肆意的破坏与随之而来的狂欢，翅翼如刺般竖起。如此毫无意义的毁灭，究竟为了什么？若你不敬奉祖先的道路，又为何要拒绝文明的理想与约束？她眉头紧蹙，忽有一丝领悟如掠过的蝴蝶般停落心头——这不是正道。她垂下眼帘，悄然从那群喧嚣的暴徒中抽身而退，隐入周遭残存的林影之中，消失无踪。

~ 由 Bilal 在 Discord 上 构想

An involuntary shudder causes the fairy's wings to bristle as she observes the wanton destruction by her companions, and the revelry that follows. Such meaningless destruction, and for what? Why reject the ideals and constraints of civilization if you do not honor the ways of the ancestors? Her brow furrows as a realization settles over her like a passing butterfly—this is not the way. Eyes downcast, she slips away from the horde, vanishing into what remains of the surrounding forest.

~ Envisioned by Bilal on Discord

Divine Vaults Of A Goddess Of Commerce.name:
商业女神的神圣宝库
Divine Vaults Of A Goddess Of Commerce

Text.text: [外部] 这座巨大的、无懈可击的金库，永远处于紧急戒备与密不透风的安保之中；它由一颗完整的钻石雕琢而成，入口隐秘而充满魔法。世间所有交易——每一笔买卖、每一座行会大厅的建立、每一次新现金的铸造、跨世代的投资、受祝福或见不得光的冒险……都在这座宝库中以其灵性形态发生。 [内部] 钻石房间里立着一圈等身雕像，却是用廉价松木粗刻而成。它们代表每一个种族，彼此相对，围成圆环。每一尊都把手伸向圆心，仿佛要与谁握手。任何人一旦握住某尊雕像的手，立刻会意识到：自己王国的全部财富正等候在金库之外的世界。随即，那人被吞没进木纹与刻痕之中，化作其中一尊。 [Outside] The great impervious vault of constant emergency and impenetrable security is constructed of a single diamond with a secret and magical entrance. All the transactions of the world, every trade, every formation of a guild hall or minting of a new currency, generational investments, ventures blessed and illicit... all take place in their spiritual form within this treasury. [Inside] Within the diamond room is a set of life-sized statues carved in cheap pine. Representing every race, they stand in a circle facing one another. Each reaches toward the center for a handshake. Anyone who shakes the hand of a statue immediately realizes the entire wealth of his or her own kingdom, waiting in the world outside the vault. The person is then subsumed into the wooden carvings and becomes one of them.

Mad Scientist's Lab: Cages.name:
疯狂科学家的实验室：囚笼
Mad Scientist's Lab: Cages

Text.text:
肮脏的铁丝笼沿着墙壁一排排摆开，笼身以电线与金属管路彼此相连。那些线缆又一路延伸，接入几台古怪的装置——它们以诡异的节奏咔哒作响——以及几只装满冒着热汽液体的玻璃槽。

笼中小小的身躯一动不动：有的覆毛，有的披鳞，有的生羽——还有些混杂其间。鲜少还能看出活着的迹象；更有几具干瘪的尸体正明显腐败，把刺鼻的化学恶臭里又添上一层令人作呕的腥腐气。

这房间的某处，其中一个小笼子里关着一只生物，像婴儿般嚎啕大哭——可你却忍不住怀疑，它究竟还有几分人性。
Filthy wire cages line the walls, connected by wires and metal tubing. Those cords in turn run to strange, rhythmically clicking contraptions and glass vats filled with steaming liquids. Small bodies lie still in the cages: some furred, some scaled, some feathered—some a mixture. Few show signs of life, and some desiccated corpses clearly decay, adding a foul undertone to the acrid chemical stench. Somewhere in this room, one of the small cages holds a creature that is bawling like a babe, but you find yourself doubting its humanity.

这名披着皮毛的人形生物身形轻捷柔韧，却掩不住那一眼可见的力量。不同大小的包裹层层堆在背负架上，支架稳稳顶在他们的肩胛之间。他们以冷静从容的目光扫视四周，簇毛的耳尖来回轻摆。手中没有任何导航板，脚上是一双磨得发旧的鞋。这是一位踏遍无数世界的旅人。他们看起来有点像一只停在换毛季中途的北极狐，毛色杂斑，点点斑驳。
This furred humanoid’s lithe and supple form belies an obvious strength. Packages of various sizes are stacked on a carrier braced at their shoulder blades. They eye up their surroundings with a cool comfort, flicking their tufted ears back and forth. They wield no navpad and wear well-worn shoes. This is a figure who has trod upon many worlds. They look a little like an arctic fox caught halfway between seasonal forms, piebald and spotted.

Heorot Garress.name:
希奥罗特·加雷斯
Heorot Garress

Text.text:
这位仪态贵气的绅士倚着路灯，灯火洒落，让他高挑身形上缀满的无数宝石一齐迸出碎光。他像在等人，鹰钩般的轮廓绷得紧紧的，钴蓝的眼睛里闪着顽皮的冷光。一阵风拂乱他的黑发，那道雪白的发缕像蛇一样扭动起舞；他从光里退开，闲庭信步走进阴影，灰蓝长袍微微分开，露出镀银的锁子甲，甲环的光泽仿佛在摹拟他偏爱的青金石。忽然，他猛地一旋身，脑袋像鸟般一歪，颈间那只小沙漏吐出一股蓝宝石色的细沙，洒向暮色的空气。一名扫路工走近，伸出扫帚去收拢贵族靴边休息着的枯枝。贵族抬起一只修整得无可挑剔的手，指尖轻颤，工人便僵在原地。那些木枝竟在魔力中相互并拢、黏合、束缚，随即像个迷你木偶般哒哒窜走。

~ Played by Third with

The noble-looking gentleman leans against a lamppost, the light it gives off causing the myriad jewels adorning his tall frame to sparkle. He seems to be waiting for someone, his aquiline features taut, cobalt eyes glinting with mischief. A breeze tousles his dark hair, causing its alabaster streak to dance like a snake, as he steps away from the light and strolls into the shadows, gray-blue robes parting to expose silvered mail, the links mimicking the lapis lazuli he seems to favor. Abruptly he spins, head cocked like a bird, the small hourglass about his neck spitting a stream of sapphire sand into the evening air. A road sweeper approaches and reaches out with his brush to collect the bracken resting near the noble’s boots. The aristocrat raises a manicured hand, fingers twitching, and the workman stops in his tracks. The sticks magically merge, bond, bind together, then scamper off, like a tiny wooden marionette.

~ Played by Third with

I Press The Third Button On My Rod Of Lo.name:
我按下贵胄威能之杖上的第三枚按钮（+3 长矛）
I Press The Third Button On My Rod Of Lordly Might (+3 Spear)

Text.text: 当我按下第三枚按钮时，权杖带凸缘的杖首随即折叠收束，杖身发出刺耳的嗡鸣，继而以惊人的速度迅猛延长。权杖那活生生的金属扭曲翻涌、重塑成形，内里热度节节攀升，几乎能用皮肤触到。伴随着一声click的脆响，一根凶狠的尖刺猛然弹出——权杖最终完成蜕变，化作一柄威势逼人的长枪。 When I press the third button, the Rod’s flanged head folds and the haft hums loudly before growing rapidly in length. The living metal of the Rod twists and reforms, a palpable heat building within. A vicious spike springs forth with a click as the Rod completes its transformation into a mighty spear.

I Track Aberrant Game.name:
我追踪《异变》游戏
I Track Aberrant Game

Text.text:
黏附在洞窟穹顶那道垂直井壁上的恶臭黏液，是再明显不过的铁证。这些东西——尽管邪异而不自然——却仍像是遵循着某些自然法则。它们同任何活着的生物一样需要食物与栖身之所，只不过偏偏钟爱那种没有翅膀、或缺个好心法师就根本进不去的藏身处。
The noxious slime clinging to the sides of the vertical shaft in the roof of the cavern is a dead giveaway. These things—as wrong and unnatural as they are—do still seem to follow some laws of nature. They need food and shelter like any other living creature. They just happen to favor hideouts you need wings or a helpful wizard to get into.

Elf Warrior With One Arm Boasts About St.name:
独臂精灵战士夸耀自己的力量
Elf Warrior With One Arm Boasts About Strength

Text.text:
“人们总爱吹嘘自己单枪匹马宰了什么怪物，可我做任何事，向来就只有这一种方式。”

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

“People always brag that they killed some beast singlehandedly, but that’s the only way I do anything.”

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Working-class Passenger Airship.name:
工薪阶层客运飞艇
Working-class Passenger Airship

Text.text:
在那艘补丁摞补丁的飞船下方，吊着的多半是一片金属脚手架的网格，其上装着焊工座椅，管道之间拉着破碎的帆布碎片，勉强挡住头顶的天空。网格的船尾用几间简陋的舱室粗粗围起——脆弱不堪，但至少装着木板包覆的舱门，通常还能扣得住。为了不让乘客染上高空反应，船只贴着地面低飞。引擎低沉咆哮，仿佛把希望寄托在船上多少有几个人懂修理。
Below the much-patched dirigible hangs mostly a gridwork of metal scaffolding mounted with welding seats, with shreds of canvas stretched between the pipes as defense against the sky. The stern of the gridwork is boxed in with several basic compartments, flimsy but at least fixed with wood-paneled doors that usually latch. The ship flies low to avoid the passengers contracting altitude sickness. Its engine growls with the hope that some of the folks on board are mechanics.

Disabling A Data Bomb.name:
停用数据炸弹
Disabling A Data Bomb

Text.text:
检查这份文件时，你认出了某人数据炸弹的痕迹。对这种下作的把戏来说，它竟然优雅得过分。你屏息，剥离缠绕在你所需文件周围的一缕缕易爆代码——它们熔接得恰到好处，逼得你必须进行精确删除。随后你呼出一口气，那是对自己技能的笃定致意。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Examining the file, you recognize the signs of someone’s data bomb. It’s elegant, really, for such a dirty trick. Holding your breath, you peel away the strands of volatile code—fused well enough to require precise deletions—that wind around the file you need. Then you exhale, a confident acknowledgement of your own skill.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Sphere Of Annihilation.name:
湮灭之球
Sphere Of Annihilation

Text.text:
那张可憎的石面孔从墙里探出，目不转睛，嘴巴大张。你也凑近窥视，可无论把自己逼得多近，视线都无法刺穿其中那片墨一般的黑暗。你感觉到……有什么。某种存在。某种诡异而无可抗拒的意志，牵引着你更深地坠入其中。
The wretched stone face peers out from the wall, unblinking, its mouth agape. You peer into it, but your vision cannot pierce the inky blackness within, no matter how close you allow yourself. You sense... something. A presence. A strange, inexorable will that pulls you deeper.

Arrival To Hell.name:
抵达地狱
Arrival To Hell

Text.text:
穿过传送门的感觉，像囚室门被打开时那道绝望的声音，紧接着又是它在你身后金属般猛然合拢所许诺的可怖命运。如今，你裹在红宝石般的光辉与灼喉的热浪里，彻底自由的开阔大地在前方延展。这里发生的一切，都是献给恶毒与癫狂之人的取乐。
Passing through the portal felt like the hopeless voice of a jail cell door opening, and then the horrible fate promised by its metallic slam behind you. Now, wrapped in ruby glow and the parching heat, the open land of complete freedom stretches ahead. Everything done here is entertainment for the malicious and insane.

Elite Magical Academy.name:
精英魔法学院
Elite Magical Academy

Text.text:
峭壁如石之壁垒般拔地而起，陡峭而高耸。绝壁之巅盘踞着一张由塔楼与城垣织就的巨网：蜿蜒的长廊、阴森的栅墙、陡直的阶梯与刺破天幕的尖塔。整座建筑的剪影宛如一头佝偻扭曲的生物——嶙峋骨架冠以棘刺与羽簇，遍布其身的“眼”幽幽发亮。浓重的不祥感沿着你的脊背爬行。一层薄翳仿佛将它遮蔽；尽管彩绘玻璃窗后烛光摇曳，古老的石墙仍渗出更深的黑暗。

~ 由 Ela Morana 构想

The cliff-face rises like a bulwark of stone, sheer and soaring. Perched upon the precipice sits a web of towers and ramparts, twisting halls and grim palisades, steep stairs and soaring spires. The silhouette of the structure evokes a hunched and twisted creature, a skeletal form crested with spines and quills, eyes aglow across its expanse. A deep foreboding tickles your spine. A haze seems to obscure the structure, and though candlelight flickers from stained glass windows, a deep darkness oozes from the ancient stone.

~ Envisioned by Ela Morana

I Spot Cheating During A Dice Game.name:
我在掷骰游戏中当场发现有人在作弊
I Spot Cheating During A Dice Game

Text.text:
骰子砸在桌面上的力道重得不合常理，接着它们滚动起来——而且掷得很好，好得过了头。我眯起眼，看着对手把赢来的赌注一把揽走，却强压着不发作，只抬手示意他们再掷一次。又是一声可疑的闷响，随之而来的仍是一次胜利的掷骰。我的耐性迅速见底。
The dice hit the table with more weight than they should and they roll well—too well. I narrow my eyes as my opponent scoops up their winnings, but I hold my tongue and gesture for them to roll again. A suspicious thud precedes another winning roll. My patience wears thin.

毫无疑问，这柄古老的三叉戟曾是某位战车御手的私人武器——其血脉或为贵族，甚至可能出自王室。它由一种早在无尽岁月前便沉入历史迷雾的合金铸成；戟锋不但永远锋利、仿佛不可折断，三枚戟齿的角度更是精确得近乎残酷，使持有者只需一次迅捷的拧转，便能钳住并绞断对手的刀刃。
Doubtless the personal weapon of some charioteer of noble or even royal blood, this ancient trident, formed of some alloy lost eons ago to the mists of history, features tines that are not only perpetually sharp and seemingly unbreakable, but perfectly angled to allow its wielder to trap and sunder an opponent’s blade with little more than a quick twist.

Quip About Being Beaten Unconscious.name:
调侃自己被打到昏厥
Quip About Being Beaten Unconscious

Text.text:
“哇，太刺激了！我从没被人打到昏迷过。这真是值得记进日志的一笔，不过下次能不能换个人走在前面？”
“Wow, what a rush! I’ve never been beaten unconscious before. Truly an experience to add to the journal, but maybe next time someone else could go in front?”

Templar Glade.name:
圣殿林间空地
Templar Glade

Text.text:
夕阳将沉重的腹部缓缓压向地平线，温暖的目光掠过翡翠色的林间空地。树木在柔和的风里摇曳，战争的低语越过自然的宁静飘荡而来，一名身披闪亮护甲的骑士伫立其间。他举起那柄磨损的长剑，疲惫而凌乱，恰如他那颗倦怠的心；剑身迎上落日的金辉——护手浸在一片流金之中。随后他将剑垂回身侧，头顶的枝桠仿佛自发结成他神圣的十字形，残余的日光将他的圣洁灼刻进这片空地。他转身离去，只在松软的泥土里留下新掘的坟茔，坟上放着一枝浆果，夜色以昏暗的怀抱缓缓落下。

~ Daer Averna

The sun's warming gaze crosses the emerald glade as it lowers its heavy belly to the horizon. The trees sway in a gentle gust, whispers of war carrying themselves over the peace of nature, as a knight in shining armor stands. He raises his worn blade, as tired and unkempt as his own weary heart, and it catches the setting sun's golden light—its cross-guard bathing itself in gold. As he drops it back down to his side, the branches above seem to keep themselves in the form of his holy cross, the remnants of sunlight blazing his holiness into the glade. He walks away, leaving a fresh grave in the soft soil, a sprig of berries upon its breast, as night falls with a dusky embrace.

~ Daer Averna

Rogue's Speech Of Self-affirmation.name:
盗贼的自我肯定宣言
Rogue's Speech Of Self-affirmation

Text.text:
“抛下你的勇武、你的慈悲、你的理智。把那些将你一生牵缚的琐碎意义统统剥离，只需专注于你的心。它的每一次搏动才是唯一重要的。竭尽所能让它一直跳动下去——那便是无悔的一生。”
“Shed your valor, your compassion, and your reason. Rid yourself of all petty meanings that string you through life, and focus on your heart. Its beat is all that matters. Keep it beating as long as you can and it will be a life well lived.”

Wild Magic Surge: Poisoning.name:
狂野魔法涌动：中毒
Wild Magic Surge: Poisoning

Text.text:
你的法术结算后，你看见近旁鼓起一枚毒绿得发狠的魔法余溢气泡，迅速膨胀。它砰然爆裂，将刺鼻的黏液喷溅到最近的旁观者身上。受害者踉跄摇晃，显然浑身不适。
After your spell resolves, you see a virulently green bubble of excess magic swell up close by. It pops, spraying the nearest bystander with noxious ooze. The victim appears to sway, clearly feeling unwell.

Rathlin The Trickster.name:
拉斯林：诡术师
Rathlin The Trickster

Text.text:
幽深侏儒满怀热忱地朝你走来，伸出手来，光线在他乌黑发亮的光头上折射出冷光。他的白色眉毛挑起又抖动，向你献上一招魔法把戏。黑色铆钉皮甲与褪色的绿斗篷，再加上腰间的短剑，让他看起来像是介于嘉年华戏法师与狡黠冒险者之间的混合体。他抵达你身旁时，一只黑羽白脸的猫头鹰也落在他旁边；你只看见他双手疾如风的动作，根本分不清头尾。等他擦肩而过，你放钱袋的位置却莫名轻了许多。

~ Played by a Hero with

The deep gnome approaches you with all kinds of enthusiasm, hand out, his bald ebony head reflecting the light. His white eyebrows raise and twitch, and he offers you a magic trick. The black studded leather and faded green cloak, along with the shortswords at his hip, mark him as a cross between a carnival act and a sharkish adventurer. A black owl with a white face lands alongside him as he reaches you, and you can’t make heads or tails of the rapid motions of his hands. As he passes by, where your coin purse rests feels unusually light.

~ Played by a Hero with

Bleeding-edge Hacking Rig.name:
尖端黑客作业台
Bleeding-edge Hacking Rig

Text.text:
学徒即使用着大师的道具，技艺也未必胜过旁人分毫，但这套装备无疑令人震撼。这台黑入装置早已超越顶级规格，或许甚至是实验性科技；若要在不把自己置于巨大风险之下的前提下发挥其效用，操作者必须具备相当高超的技能。他们担得起这份挑战吗？
An apprentice using a master’s tools is no more skilled than any other, but the gear is undoubtedly impressive. This hacking rig is beyond top of the line, perhaps even experimental tech, and it would take an operator of considerable skill to use it effectively without significantly endangering themselves. Are they up to the task?

Insult About A Terrible Leader.name:
羞辱：烂透的领袖
Insult About A Terrible Leader

Text.text:
“我曾以为所有的领袖都会回应那份伟业的召唤，只要给他们一个机会，就会被点燃，渴望因做了正确之事而被铭记。可权力带给你的，只有剥去你最后的体面，把你变成一个孩子。你在自己的殿堂里踉跄踱步，满心恐惧又愤愤不平——非要每一个幼稚的要求都被满足——身边围着一群懦夫，连一句真话都不敢对你说。”
“I used to think all leaders would answer a call to greatness, roused by a chance to be remembered for doing what was right. But all power has done is stripped you of your decency and turned you into a child. You waddle about your halls fearful and indignant—demanding that every infantile request be met—surrounded by those too cowardly to tell you otherwise.”

Taunt From A Demonic Presence.name:
来自恶魔般存在的嘲弄
Taunt From A Demonic Presence

Text.text:
“你在黑暗中低语的每一个秘密，都会辗转流向我这里。我了解你。你所有的罪孽，你所有的弱点……都在我掌心里休息着。我倒想知道，要是我让你的秘密脱口而出，你的朋友们会怎么看你？”
“Every secret you whisper in darkness finds its way to me. I know you. All your sin, all your weakness… They rest in the palm of my hand. I wonder what your friends would think of you if I let your secrets slip free?”

在码头讨生活的人都知道，夜里要避开那片货物坟场。成片的木箱、集装箱与备件堆成一座蔓延的钢铁丛林——雾幕的昏暗里，有东西潜伏其间，循着猎物而行。多年来，莽撞的工人、惹事的少年、满脸风霜的佣兵与追逐战利品的猎人，都被那场雾带走了。有人说这不过是传说，可凡是在漆黑、浓雾笼罩的夜里，听过狂风穿过那片荒废堆场的哀嚎的人，都知道事实并非如此。
Those working the docks know to avoid the cargo graveyard at night. Something lurks amid the sprawling jungle of crates, containers, and spare parts—hunting in the gloom of the fog. Foolhardy workers, delinquent youths, grizzled mercenaries, and trophy hunters have all been taken by the fog over the years. Some say it’s just a legend, but anyone who has heard the wind howling through that forsaken yard on a dark, fog shrouded night knows different.

Quip About Miserable Intelligence.name:
关于悲惨智力的俏皮话
Quip About Miserable Intelligence

Text.text:
“你知道你毛病出在哪儿吗？你书读得太多了，脑子学会了不管发生什么都能把自己绕进痛苦里。所以我才让自己的念头干净利落、简单明了——更好掌控。”
“Do you know what your problem is? You read too many books and now your mind has figured out how to think itself into misery no matter what’s going on. That’s why I keep my thoughts nice and simple. Easier to control.”

Half-submerged Chapel In Swamp.name:
沼泽中半没的礼拜堂
Half-submerged Chapel In Swamp

Text.text:
这座矮壮的石砌建筑所剩无几，却仍能辨出它曾经的轮廓：某种小礼拜堂，高耸的钟楼，宽阔的橡木双开门。自它倾覆以来，已过去数十年，或许数百年。人不禁想——让礼拜堂崩塌的，是时代缓慢而无情的推进，将石块抛向四周的沼泽，让柔软而攫握的泥土重新吞回它的地基？还是一场突如其来的灾厄，一场足以终结世界的风暴掀倒钟楼、撕裂墙垣？无论如何，如今的废墟只容得下阴影与潜行的掠食者。
Little remains of the squat, stone structure, but one can discern its previous silhouette: a chapel of sorts, with a soaring bell tower and wide, oaken double doors. Decades, possibly centuries, have passed since its toppling. One wonders—was it the slow, inexorable march of time that brought the chapel down, casting its stones to the surrounding fen and allowing the soft, grasping earth to reclaim its foundations? Or was it a sudden calamity, a world-ending storm that toppled the belltower and sundered the walls? Either way, the ruins now house only shadows and slinking predators.

Hell Minotaur With Blazing Eyes.name:
烈焰双眼的地狱牛头怪
Hell Minotaur With Blazing Eyes

Text.text:
既是折磨者，也是受折磨者——迷宫的肌肉虬结、蹄足踏地的守卫，尖角森然，手握巨斧伫立。暴怒的半牛魔是同类之王。它的双角被混沌与狂怒扭曲，自头颅两侧各伸出三尺之长。盯紧那对分趾蹄：当它刮擦地面，低下犄角，双眼燃起火焰般的光，一次冲锋就要来了。
Tormentor and tormented, the muscled and hooved guardian of the maze stands sharp-horned with axe in hand. The angry demi-bull is lord of its kind. Its horns are twisted by chaos and rage, spanning three feet from each side of its head. Watch the cloven hoof. When it scrapes the ground, and the horns drop, and the eyes blaze with fire, a charge is coming.

Viking Scaling Wooden Wall.name:
维京式可攀木墙
Viking Scaling Wooden Wall

Text.text:
战士那条赤褐色的发辫在攀墙时如钟摆般来回甩动；层层叠起的木桩给了他斧刃一个轻松咬入的着力点。他几秒间便攀上顶端，剃得干净的后脑与两侧才刚刚沁出一层汗珠。他把斧头的弯钩挂在头顶上方，双手紧握武器猛地一撑，翻身越过墙头，发出一声凯旋般的长嚎。
The warrior’s braid of auburn hair swings like a pendulum as he climbs the wall, its stacked wooden logs providing easy purchase for the biting head of his axe. He reaches the top in seconds, the shaved back and sides of his head just barely beading with sweat. He hooks the crook of his axe overhead and, holding on to his weapon with both hands, lurches upward to crest the wall with a triumphant yowl.

I Cast Cone Of Cold Using A Glass Cone.name:
我举起一只玻璃锥体，施放冷冻锥形术
I Cast Cone Of Cold Using A Glass Cone

Text.text:
我掌心托着一枚微缩的法术，仿佛它自空中瞄准而来，直指我的皮肤。随着我吟诵那蔚蓝的奥秘、冰雾的咒辞，玻璃自掌心升起，蒸汽缠绕着它蜿蜒盘旋。我用空着的那只手对准目标，圆锥的扁平底面正对着我的对手。那片玻璃在空中复制自身——在末端扩展到直径六十尺，沿途噼啪作响——随后那小小的玻璃锥又坠回我的掌心。
Balanced on my palm is the spell in miniature, as if it were aimed from the air at my skin. As I recite the blue arcana of frozen mist the glass rises from my palm, steam curling from it. With my free hand I aim, the flat circle of the cone facing my opponent. The glass piece replicates itself, but sixty feet in diameter at its end, crackling on its way, then the little glass cone drops back into my palm.

Hacker Executes Armor Program In The Net.name:
黑客在网络中执行护甲程序：武士主题
Hacker Executes Armor Program In The Net: Samurai Theme

Text.text:
黑客摆出肃穆的架势，启动他们的护甲程序；猩红的闪烁光芒中，一套传统武士的甲胄在他们身上迅速成形。厚重而棱角分明的肩甲与甲裙相连，配合坚实的胸甲构筑出可怖的防御——面罩上那张狰狞跳动的恶鬼面容，更为其画上句点。
Adopting a solemn pose, the hacker executes their armor program and the suit of a traditional samurai forms around them in flickering crimson light. Thick, angular shoulder plates combine with an armored skirt and robust breastplate to create a formidable defense—completed by the animated demonic visage on the facemask.

Compliment About A Barbarian’s Ferocious.name:
对野蛮人凶猛一击的赞美
Compliment About A Barbarian’s Ferocious Blow

Text.text:
“我从没想过，一个人竟能这么快被打成一滩血肉烂泥。干得漂亮！”
“I never realized someone could be turned from person to bloody paste so quickly. Well done!"

I Cast Spirit Guardians Of Ghostwater.name:
我施放《幽水之魂卫》
I Cast Spirit Guardians Of Ghostwater

Text.text:
我挥动双臂，如搅拌海潮般转动，几缕深蓝的魔法在我周身盘旋缠绕。咸涩的海风钻入鼻腔，一道漩涡自脚下升起，直没到肩头，我的双脚随之离地。漩涡之中，我感到鲨鱼的身躯——我的守卫者——在水里游弋。它们的饥饿对我而言触手可及，像从水体深处传来的低沉震颤，撩拨得我也胃口大开。我抬起手，将一柄鱼叉召入掌心：珊瑚般的叉杆上嵌着一片鲨齿的尖碎。我将敌人纳入视线，后撤蓄势。鲨鱼的尾鳍因狂野的期待而抽打水流。

~ Envisioned by the Cynical Cleric

I move my arms in a stirring motion and wisps of deep blue magic begin to swirl around me. I smell salty sea air as a whirlpool forms up to my shoulders, and my feet lift off the ground. I feel the bodies of sharks—my guardians—within the vortex. Their hunger is palpable to me, felt as a rumble through the water that whets my own appetite. I raise my hand and conjure a harpoon into my palm, the coral shaft fitted with a splinter of sharks’ teeth. I line up my enemy in my sights and reel back the harpoon. The sharks’ tails whip with wild anticipation.

~ Envisioned by the Cynical Cleric

Sacred Cherry Tree.name:
神圣樱树
Sacred Cherry Tree

Text.text:
这棵高贵的树仿佛存在于某个超越时代的所在，任凭无数岁月流逝，也无法撼动它在天穹景致中的宁静。空气中萦绕着新鲜樱桃的甜香，撩拨着你的感官；薄如轻纱的花瓣——淡粉微晕——在微风里起舞，掠过高原的原野。
This noble tree seems to exist somewhere beyond time, immune to the passage of countless years on its heavenly vista. The sweet scent of fresh cherries lingers on the air, tantalizing your senses, as gossamer-thin petals—blush pink—dance in the breeze across the plateau.

Brimble Flamehair.name:
布林布尔·焰发
Brimble Flamehair

Text.text:
铃铛叮当，敲在改造过的板甲上；一个身形矮小的男人放声大笑，直到他尖尖的耳朵都笑红了。他的淡蓝宝石色眼眸因不受拘束的好奇而闪着愉悦的光，打量着你。像盾牌般固定在他手臂上的，是一片巨龙鳞甲，其上刻着一道巨人的符文。注意到你在注意，他做了个毫无威胁的手势，咯咯笑着吐出一个古怪的词：“Battapus。”一具钢铁造物应声而来：蹼足、鸭嘴、海狸般的尾巴与水獭的身躯，靠着一双扑扇的靴子在空中笨重地踉跄前行。

~ 由 FreeRange Slacker 扮演

Bells clink against modified plate as a diminutive man with pale skin and fiery hair laughs until his pointed ears turn red. Lazuline eyes shimmer with the mirth of unbound curiosity as he regards you. Affixed to his arm like a shield is a single dragon scale scored with a giant glyph. Noticing you noticing, he makes a nonthreatening gesture and giggles out an odd word: “Battapus.” A web-footed, duck-billed contraption of steel with a beaver-like tail and an otter’s body lumbers through the air on fluttering boots to answer the call.

~ Played by FreeRange Slacker

Icehouse Of A Manor.name:
庄园冰库
Icehouse Of A Manor

Text.text:
冰窖由整齐切削的石墙围拢而成，里面堆着数十块覆着锯末的冰板，使此处冷冽得足以将几具动物尸体与其他易腐之物保存数周之久。屋门旁的挂钩上吊着几套冰钳和一把冰锯，皆以油布裹缠，以防生锈。
The cut stone walls of the icehouse surround several dozen slabs of ice covered in sawdust, keeping this place cool enough to store several animal carcasses and other perishables for weeks. Hanging on hooks next to the house’s door are several sets of tongs and an ice saw, wrapped in oily rags to prevent rust.

False Cobbles.name:
虚假的鹅卵石
False Cobbles

Text.text:
薄雾在这里的白色铺路石间盘旋，一缕轻微的冷风从地面渗出。沙砾与碎石从鹅卵石间刺出，仿佛那些材料已与铺石融为一体。此处的空气比雾中其他地方更为寒冷。
Mist swirls around the white paving stones here, as a slight draft emerges from the ground. Sand and broken stone poke above the cobbles in a way that makes those materials seem to be merged with the paving. The air is colder here than elsewhere in the haze.

Old Cobblestone Road.name:
旧鹅卵石路
Old Cobblestone Road

Text.text:
你面前的道路颠簸不平，铺路的鹅卵石既被风雨侵蚀，也被来往行人车马反复碾磨得圆钝。磨损的石缝间拱起泥土，偶尔还钻出几株野草；你不由得替那些不得不在这条路上受罪的商队车马感到一阵同情。
The road before you is bumpy and uneven, its cobblestones worn down by both natural elements and frequent use. Dirt and the occasional weed rise up between the scuffed stones, and you feel a pang of sympathy for any merchant cart that has to endure a journey on this path.

巨大的齿轮在脚下翻滚轰鸣，古老得早已超出任何活人的记忆。平台缓缓下沉，被远古的锁链悬吊着——每一节链环都有啤酒桶那么大。它最终以一声干脆的闷响落定，震得附近的召唤拉杆簌簌落灰；同时，平台中央弹起一块小小的方形踏板——也许是开关？
Titanic gears, older than living memory, churn and bellow as the platform descends, held aloft by ancient chains—each link the size of an ale barrel. It comes to rest with a decisive thud, shaking dust from the nearby summoning lever, as a small square platform pops up at its center—a switch perhaps?

若说学校是知识的神殿，那这里无疑便是天堂。成百上千本书籍、成千上万卷羊皮卷塞满了一排排书架。漂浮的光点如同灯笼的幽魂，在书堆间缓缓摇曳穿行。但这并非魔法的唯一征兆。有些书架被不灼人的火焰缠绕，或笼罩在不自然的黑暗之中；另一些仿佛被寒冰封住，或被藤蔓层层裹紧。它们当然只是幻象——可为何要如此？
If a school is a temple of knowledge, then surely this is heaven. Books by the hundred and scrolls by the thousand stuff each rank of shelves. Floating lights, like the ghosts of lanterns, bob through the stacks. But this is not the only sign of magic. Some shelves stand wreathed in flames that do not burn, or shadowed by an unnatural darkness. Others seem encased in ice or enwrapped in vines. These are illusions, surely, but why?

Stone Dragon Statue.name:
石龙雕像
Stone Dragon Statue

Text.text:
它俯视着你，龙类面容上凝着骇人的咆哮与阴沉怒意；这尊雕像的雕工精湛至极，石质躯壳上一片片鳞甲都能被细心的观者逐一辨出。尽管天气与时代的推移已将雕像的石材蚀成黯淡的灰色，雕刻者的匠心依旧清晰可见。
Glowering down at you with a fearsome snarl upon its draconic visage, this statue has been so expertly sculpted that individual scales of its stony hide can be picked out by a careful viewer. Though weather and the march of time have aged the statue’s stone to a dull gray, the efforts of its sculptor are still evident.

City Witch In Her Apartment.name:
公寓里的都市女巫
City Witch In Her Apartment

Text.text:
城外的喧嚣嗡鸣如黄蜂振翅，撞上这间狭小公寓里凝滞的寂静。一个佝偻的女人披着黑袍，在家具间摇曳穿行；她的鸡毛掸轻轻掠过一簇簇精心摆放的水晶与粗陋的巫术符号。她步步都像精确丈量，仿佛与不可见之物共舞。熏香的烟雾也自顾自旋起舞步，携着广藿香与鼠尾草的澄明气息袅袅上升。忽然，女巫与烟雾交缠在一起，幽影般的触须疯狂编排成一段癫狂的舞序；她的肉身动作成了那场异界仪式的躯体性相，仿佛将这房间里最深处的能量一并洗净、重焕新生。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

The wasp buzz of the city outside clashes with the quietude inside the small apartment. A bent woman in black robes sashays around furniture, her feather duster brushing over clusters of carefully arranged crystals and crude Wiccan symbols, her every step measured as she waltzes with the unseen. Incense smoke rises in its own dance as it carries clarifying aromas of patchouli and sage. Suddenly the witch and smoke intertwine, moving in a crazed choreography of spectral tendrils, her physical movements a somatic aspect to an otherworldly ritual where the room’s very energies are refreshed.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Heavy Rain In The Mountains.name:
群山暴雨
Heavy Rain In The Mountains

Text.text:
雨点无情地敲打着林间的叶片与枝桠，连绵成不息的鼓点。树皮被浸得发黑，枯死的叶子从细枝与枝条上脱落，飘落去与林地上湿软的腐殖残屑混作一处。灰褐色的水流汇成一道道急湍，顺坡奔泄，灌满掘洞生物的孔穴，并将落叶层与碎石卷往新的地势。
Rain pelts the leaves and boughs of the forest in relentless percussion. The bark of the trees darkens with the soak, with dying leaves jettisoning from twigs and branches to join the spongy detritus of the forest floor. Gray and brown streams form and rush downhill, filling the holes of burrowing creatures and carrying duff and rocks to new ground.

Graydon Drake.name:
格雷登·德雷克
Graydon Drake

Text.text:
格雷登·德雷克的一切都向前逼进——从他灰蓝眼眸里逼人的锐光、鹰钩般锋利的鼻梁，到他说话的方式——如同他的头发一般盐与胡椒、冷硬而有棱角。他的黑色鳞片、红色斗篷，以及那点轻微的跛足，落在一位圣武士骑士身上同样令人意外；对那些只看见表象的人而言，他像一道难解的谜。然而他那严厉而自以为是的正义感，那层阴沉如黑鹰的外壳，却是执行公义的利器——有时甚至比他的长柄斧与弩更为有效。它也掩盖了一点：德雷克虽然英俊、善于说服人，却并非什么天才。

~ Played by Tom Baker

Every feature of Graydon Drake aims forward, from the intensity of his gray-blue eyes and sharp aquiline nose to the manner of his speech—as salt-and-pepper as his hair. His black scales, red cloak, and slight limp are also surprising on a paladin knight, a puzzle for those who only see him. But his stern self-righteousness, that grim black hawk exterior, is an effective method for doing justice. Sometimes more effective than his halberd and crossbow. It also hides that while attractive and convincing, Drake is no genius.

~ Played by Tom Baker

一盘难看的塑料托盘从餐食包装里滑了出来，每个格槽里都塞着同样倒胃口的真空封装食块。那些食物甚至没把槽位填满，仿佛厂家对这产品的分量抱有过分乐观的期待。
A tray of unattractive plastic slides out of the meal's packaging, with equally unappetizing blocks of vacuum-sealed food tucked into its compartments. The food doesn't even fill the slots, as if the manufacturer had been optimistic about the value of the product.

小小的树屋像雏鸟蜷在巢中般依偎在巨树枝杈间，从令人艳羡的高处俯瞰四周森林。它以结实的木板与木杆搭建而成，能抵御大多数风雨侵袭，同时让住客免受来自地面的威胁。
Nestled amid the branches of a large tree like a baby bird in its nest, the small treehouse looks out over the surrounding forest from an enviable vantage. Constructed from sturdy wooden planks and poles, the treetop dwelling can withstand most of the elements while keeping its occupants safe from ground-based threats.

Merchant Of Paranormal Wards.name:
超自然护符商
Merchant Of Paranormal Wards

Text.text:
一个矮壮的男人挎着药囊朝你走来。他那张死灰般惨白的脸泛着铅灰色，剃得短短的茬发下尽是疤痕与深刻的皱纹。一只银质镰刀耳坠垂在耳垂上，耳坠刺出的细小红点在他下颌边缘星星点点，像是饰物刚咬过一口。他的斗篷薄如蝠翼，内衬缀着闪烁的符文，却在这距离上淡得看不真切。他从扣得死紧的衣领上方，用一只鹰黄的眼睛斜睨着你，灰色的嘴唇勾起一抹冷笑。随后他彬彬有礼地躬身，随着他的移动，药囊里叮当作响。
A short, stout man carrying a medicine bag approaches you. His deathly pale head is gray with shaved stubble and lined with scars. A silver sickle earring hangs from one lobe, and pinpricks of red on his jowl show where the bauble has taken its bite. His cloak is as thin as batwings, lined with glimmering runes too faint to make out at this distance. He leers at you with an eagle-yellow eye from over his tightly clasped collar, gray lips forming a smirk. He bows, genteel, his bag clinking with his movement.

Adult Blue Dracolich.name:
成体蓝色龙巫妖
Adult Blue Dracolich

Text.text:
在暴雨亲吻过的天穹之下，你望见一尊自雷霆般的死亡中诞生的不死泰坦。覆着霉苔的鳞片曾经蔚蓝如天，如今却泛起幽冥般的磷光；旧伤口里拖曳出缕缕尸雾。它的双眼是无生的深潭，燃着亵渎的光。残翼破碎、骨架森然，它从巢穴中爬出，向这被臭氧与电荷浸透的夜色吐出一道炫灼的憎恨光柱。
Under a storm-kissed sky, you spot an undead titan birthed from thunderous demise. Mold-covered scales, once bright with cerulean glory, give off a spectral luminescence, traces of corpse mist trailing from old wounds. The eyes, pools of unlife, blaze with unholy light. Torn-winged and skeletal, it crawls from its lair and spits a coruscating column of hate into the ozone-charged night.

Vexbane’s Schoolhouse.name:
灾祸克星的校舍
Vexbane’s Schoolhouse

Text.text:
一位教师披着朴素的棕色斗篷，带着学生们走出那间简陋的校舍。茅草屋顶看起来有些干燥，似乎需要修补一下。“我们去检定一下我们的蝌蚪！”教师说着，把一顶淡紫色、宽檐的帽子扣在自己剃光的脑袋上。孩子们欢呼起来，跟着他们沿着林间小径跑去。透过树影，你能看见小径通向一处泛着绿意的小池塘。孩子们像一串发抖的小鸭子，摇摇晃晃地排成队，终于从课桌前被放出来的兴奋在他们之间嗡嗡作响。一个侏儒男孩用胳膊肘轻轻顶了顶一位红色龙裔女孩的肋骨，两人对着某个秘密笑话窃笑不止。一个深褐肤色的半身人孩子骑在一位瘦长的精灵男孩背上，那男孩鼻子有些歪。
A teacher, dressed in a simple brown cloak, leads their students out of the humble schoolhouse. Its thatched roof seems a bit dry and in need of a touch-up. "Let's go check on our tadpoles!" the teacher says, placing a mauve, wide-brimmed hat atop their shaved head. The children cheer, following them down a wooded path. Through the trees, you can see it leads to a small, greenish pond. The children waddle in a tremulous duckling line, buzzing with the excitement of being freed from their desks. A gnome boy nudges the ribs of a red dragonborn girl as they both snicker at some secret joke. A halfling child with deep-brown skin rides piggyback on a spindly elvish boy with a crooked nose.

你清了清嗓子，提高了声音。你语无伦次地胡扯着，既像什么都在说，又像什么都没说，讲得跟穿着大衣的牡蛎一样毫无道理——而你正是借着这些话语编织出这道法术。你的努力如预期般收获了耸肩、皱眉、歪头与痛苦的表情。
You clear your throat and raise your voice. You babble about nothing and everything, making as much sense as an oyster in an overcoat—and through these words you weave the spell. Your effort reaps its expected reward of shrugged shoulders, furrowed brows, cocked heads, and pained expressions.

Greeting From A Tree Person.name:
树人之问候
Greeting From A Tree Person

Text.text:
“你已闯入不该踏足之地。回到你那玻璃与灰浆堆砌的森林去。你们这些人，对我族血肉那贪婪噬咬的饥渴，在这片林地里绝不容忍。”
“You have wandered where you do not belong. Return to your forests of glass and mortar. Your people, their ravenous hunger for the flesh my kind, are not tolerated in these woods.”

Joust Combatant Barely Stays In The Sadd.name:
马上比武者险些没能稳住鞍座
Joust Combatant Barely Stays In The Saddle

Text.text:
骑士们轰然相撞。那名身披黑貂色甲胄的骑手仓促举盾，硬生生拨开刺来的长枪，而他们的对手就没这么走运。伴随着金铁相啸的刺耳尖鸣，第二名骑士几乎被掀下鞍去，却奇迹般一把攥住华丽的缰绳，硬撑着没掉落。两匹战马不管不顾地继续犁地般冲前，那名受创的骑手在鞍上摇摆不定，像风中的树一般。
The knights collide. The hastily raised shield of the sable-armored rider deflects the incoming lance, their foe not so lucky. With a scream of metal on metal, the second knight is almost pitched from the saddle but miraculously manages to grasp the elaborate reins and hang on. The stallions plow onward regardless, the stricken rider swaying like a tree in the wind.

Dentures Of Translation.name:
翻译用假牙
Dentures Of Translation

Text.text:
这副假牙出奇地轻，尽管看上去像是用石头雕成的。颜色深如板岩，表面在接触时带着些微的砂砾感。每一颗牙的背面，你都能摸到一个符号的压痕，或许是一枚魔法符文。把这件物体凑近耳边，便能听见一阵若有若无的低语合唱——听起来像有千百种不同的语言在说话。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

This set of false teeth is lightweight, though they appear to be made of stone. Their color is as dark as slate, and the texture slightly grainy to the touch. Behind each tooth, you can feel the imprint of a symbol, perhaps a magical rune. Bringing the object closer to your ear, a faint chorus of whispers can be heard—and it sounds like they are speaking in a thousand different languages.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Modern Dinosaur Hunter.name:
现代恐龙猎人
Modern Dinosaur Hunter

Text.text:
女人咧嘴一笑，拉动猎枪的枪机，又检查了一眼瞄准镜。她把叼在嘴角的牙签取下，用手语从吉普车后座向队伍打信号，同时把帽檐往上一挑。车队在令人窒息的泥沼里缓缓停下，泥浆飞溅到她的靴子上；她纵身跳下车，开始对她的伙伴厉声下令。
The woman smirks as she racks the bolt of her hunting rifle and checks the telescopic sight. Taking the toothpick from the corner of her mouth, she signals to her team from the back of the jeep with sign language and tips the brim of her hat upwards. The convoy rolls to a stop in the cloying mud, which splatters across her boots as she jumps down and begins to bark orders at her companions.

I Have The Dark One's Blessing.name:
我得到了黑暗之主的祝福
I Have The Dark One's Blessing

Text.text:
当我的敌人倒下时，它体内亮起一抹橙色光芒，沿着躯干向头颅游移。一缕微小的火焰钻出，在空中扭动挣扎。我将它猛然吸入，咽下喉去。伴着一阵战栗，我咧嘴而笑——它在我的血肉里安顿下来，在一段时代里为我注入更强的力量。
As my enemy falls, an orange light kindles in its middle, moving toward its head. A tiny flame emerges, wriggling in midair. I suck it in and swallow. With a shudder, I grin as it settles in my flesh, bolstering me for a time.

Huge Draconic Tail.name:
巨龙般的龙尾
Huge Draconic Tail

Text.text:
一条巨大的分节长尾，长如酒馆庭院，轻而易举、令人胆寒地盘绕在山脊之上。覆甲的鳞片描绘着璀璨的星空，织成一道密不透风的防护穹幕，内里透出柔和的宇宙辉光。长尾懒散地左右摆动——随意间就将近旁的巨石碾碎。
A great segmented tail the length of a tavern courtyard coils around the mountain ridge with terrifying ease. Armored scales depicting a scintillating star-scape form an impenetrable canopy of defense, lit from within by a soft cosmic radiance. The tail sways side-to-side with idle motion—casually crushing boulders nearby.

Relentless Prosecuting Attorney.name:
穷追不舍的检察官
Relentless Prosecuting Attorney

Text.text:
一头红色卷发覆在一张因专注而紧绷的脸上，雀斑点点。女律师的移动几近狂乱：对着助理喋喋不休，哗啦哗啦翻着卷宗，啜饮咖啡，又飞快刷过她的新闻植入体。她的嗓音里带着火，整个人透着一种不可阻挡的劲头。浓重的黑眼圈压在眼下，昂贵西装宽大的翻领上还沾着食物的污渍。
Red curly hair sits atop a face pinched with concentration and speckled with freckles. The attorney is in a frenzy of movement: jabbering at her assistant, flipping through files, sipping coffee, and flicking through her news implant. There’s a fire in her voice, an unstoppable energy about her. Big black bags sit beneath her eyes, and the wide lapels of her expensive suit are stained with food.

I Break Through A Wall With My Enhanceme.name:
我凭强化撞破一面墙
I Break Through A Wall With My Enhancements

Text.text:
我像一辆装甲运兵车般携着蛮力撞穿墙壁，混凝土碎块如手雷般在我身边炸裂；我几乎不停顿，在拔出我的武器时也只微微放缓。尘土翻涌成浓厚的旋云，呛得人喘不过气；爆裂的管道把内容物泼洒满地，宛如被切开的动脉汩汩喷涌。
Chunks of concrete explode around me like grenades as I burst through the wall with the force of an APC, barely slowing down as I draw my weapon. Dust chokes the room in a thick, swirling cloud and burst pipes spill their contents across the floor like severed arteries.

Draconian Mastermind.name:
龙裔智谋宗师
Draconian Mastermind

Text.text:
这名类人生物长着一颗生有獠牙的龙首，身形匀称，皮肤覆着暗淡金色的鳞片。它的头顶硕大而光秃，没有颈褶也没有角；面孔扁鼻前缩，下颌突起。它身上唯一的衣物是一套皮革挽具：一条厚腰带与层叠的裆布。唯有残忍的利爪——自每根指节弯钩般伸出——是它显露出的唯一武器。那双惨白的眼睛扫视四周，带着轻蔑的咆哮与紧握的拳爪。
This humanoid being has the head of a tusked dragon, a well-proportioned body, and skin covered in scales of dull gold. Their pate is oversized and bald, without frill or horn, the face pug-nosed with an underbite. A harness of leather with a thick belt and layered loincloth make up its only clothing. Cruel claws—curving from every digit—are the only apparent weapon. With white eyes, the creature gazes around with a snarl of contempt and clenching hands.

Sigrid, Lady Of The Avarician Steppe.name:
西格丽德，阿瓦里西亚草原的女领主
Sigrid, Lady Of The Avarician Steppe

Text.text:
暮色沉降，仍旧喧闹的集市被拉出一道道细长的影子。人潮之中，有个身影与众不同——宛如泥偶间的一尊雕像。她高挑纤细，步履带着超自然的优雅。苍白的肌肤在渐暗的光里几近半透明。黑如乌墨的长发如瀑倾泻，层层乌亮的发丝勾勒出一张美得令人心惊的面庞。然而真正令人不安的是她的眼睛：两汪金色的深池，仿佛盛着异界的秘密与超凡的魔法。她掠过摊位与人群，像被阴影裹住的谜团，唇边的微笑是一幅傲然却勉强容忍的肖像。

~ 由 Walt M. 扮演

Dusk settles, casting elongated shadows over the still-bustling market. Among the crowd, a figure stands apart—a sculpture among clay figurines. She is tall and slender, moving with supernatural grace. Her pale skin is almost translucent beneath the fading light. Her hair, an ebon, inky cascade of sable locks, frames a face that is alarmingly beautiful. Yet it is her eyes that truly unsettle: golden pools that seem to hold the secrets of alien worlds and otherworldly magic. She glides through the market, an enigma wrapped in shadows, her smile a picture of haughty tolerance.

~ Played by Walt M.

血淋淋的伤口玷污了这具龙裔尸体原本优雅的鳞片，蜥蜴般的肌理上裂开一道道狰狞的豁口。一枚朴素的木制护符挂在他们颈间——上面刻着符文，却出自笨拙的手笔——而他们紧握的羊皮纸上也被鲜血染得斑驳。
Bloody wounds mar the elegant scales of the dragonborn corpse, gaping fissures in their reptilian flesh. A simple wooden charm—engraved with runes by a clumsy hand—rests around their neck, and blood stains the parchment clutched in their grasp.

Great Stone Wall In Ruins.name:
残破的巨石城墙
Great Stone Wall In Ruins

Text.text:
尽管它曾经是传奇，如今这道城墙却成了横贯一国的博物馆展品。导弹与攀爬者把女墙啃得残缺不全，像一名荒废守卫缺失的牙齿。正面有一两块石料被碾碎的地方，耐心的绿藤又将别的石块一点点撬松。相隔数英里的位置，崩塌的缺口一直砸到基石，露出通往墙顶步道的内侧阶梯。这些碎石豁口处的地面，至今仍显出当年一万只靴子冲破城墙时留下的伤害。
While it may have been legendary once, the wall is now a museum piece the length of a nation. Missiles and climbers have chipped away parapets, like missing teeth on a derelict guardian. Where one or two stones were crushed on the front, patient green vines worked others free. Many miles apart, crushed openings down to the foundation stones reveal the inner staircases up to the walkway. The ground at these tumble-stone gaps still shows the damage of the ten thousand boots that breached the wall long ago.

你停下片刻，飞快地吐出几段短促的音节，随即一阵寒意掠过全身，魔法让你颈后与手臂的汗毛尽数竖起。你说不清是世界变慢了，还是你变快了——又或两者皆然——但你感觉自己每迈出一步，都能比从前走得更远。
You take a moment to say a few short syllables in quick succession, then shudder with a chill as the magic raises the hair on your neck and arms. You are unsure if the world is a little slower or you are just faster—or both—but it seems each step you take can carry you farther than before.

Hannah Von Mansford.name:
汉娜·冯·曼斯福德
Hannah Von Mansford

Text.text:
光在她黑色皮革护甲的铆钉上荡开细碎的涟漪，又掠过她深如午夜的长发。她颈间佩着一枚坠饰：一枚黑石圆片，被一弯银色新月从侧面托住。匕首绑在她的胯侧——握柄如烟雾般扭曲，柄首铸成骷髅。刀刃裸露在外，却远不及她那道蓝宝石般的凝视来得锋利。她既美丽又令人不安，因为她眼中藏着一种迫不及待的恶意——仿佛好几桩卑劣的勾当正要由她亲手掀起。

~ Played by Paul

Light ripples over the studs of her black leather armor and through her midnight dark hair. She wears a pendant about her neck: a round of black stone cradled on one side by a crescent of silver. Daggers are strapped at her hips—the hilts twisted like smoke, the pommels shaped into skulls. The blades are exposed, but their edges do not cut as deftly as her sapphire stare. She is both pretty and perturbing, for there is an expectant devilment in her eyes—as if several foul deeds are about to occur by her hand.

~ Played by Paul

Secondhand Enhancements, Freshly Sanitiz.name:
二手强化件，刚刚消过毒
Secondhand Enhancements, Freshly Sanitized

Text.text:
强化体上弥漫着医用乙醇的刺鼻气味，像令人作呕的香水般飘散开来，提醒着你它们阴森的来历。它们绝非崭新之物，处处可见前任“主人”留下的磨损与损耗，诉说着那些先来者的故事——以及他们失去了什么。
The pervading stench of medical ethanol wafts from the enhancements like off-putting perfume, reminding you of their grim provenance. Far from new, they all show signs of wear and tear from their previous “owners,” telling the stories of those who came before—and what they lost.

法师将自己披在纯粹暮光织就的轻纱长袍中，长袍自肩头倾泻而下，宛如星云流光般闪烁。其一臂怀抱着一本如铁砧般巨大的魔导书，另一臂握着一根虬结的紫杉法杖，杖顶镶着一枚粗琢的黄玉。胸前银链垂挂着一枚金色护身符，形如咆哮巨龙的面容——当法师从魔导书中诵读时，护身符的双眼随之亮起，法师说话间吐出能号令造化诸元素的词句。
The mage drapes themself in gossamer robes of pure twilight, glimmering like nebulae cascading from their shoulders. In one arm, they cradle a grimoire the size of an anvil, in the other, a gnarled staff of yew topped with a rough-hewn topaz. An amulet, golden and resembling the roaring visage of a dragon, hangs on a silver chain around their neck—the eyes of the amulet glow as the mage reads from their grimoire, speaking words that command the elements of creation themselves.

以一部分由陨铁构成的合金锻造而成，这柄无刃的长剑剑柄看上去堪称同类中的极品，甚至精美绝伦。然而细细端详之下，你找不到任何断裂的参差边缘，甚至连容纳剑身柄茎的坐骑都没有。究竟是谁会如此用心去打造一柄根本无法装上剑刃的剑柄，你百思不得其解。
Forged from an alloy partially composed of meteoric iron, the disembodied longsword hilt looks like an exceptionally fine, even exquisite, example of its like. Yet under close examination, you can find no jagged edges or even a mount for the blade’s tang. Why someone would put such care into crafting a sword hilt that cannot be used with a blade is beyond you.

当你入睡时，产品就在你的眼皮底下。你上一次忘记那道数字化闪光是什么时候？那种公司文化的闪烁？产品。只有产品。一团闪耀的霓虹从近旁的屏幕里向你探出。它抽搐了一下，刹那间化作一张阴暗、狰狞的脸。随后又变回产品。它的标志从显示器上拉出一道长长的影子，寸寸逼近。
The product is under your eyelids when you sleep. When was the last time you forgot the digitized flash? The flicker of corporate culture? The product. There is only the product. A glittering mass of neon reaches out toward you from a nearby screen. It shudders, for a moment becoming a dark, snarling face. And then it is the product again. Its logo stretches a long shadow out from the display, inching closer.

Convoy Arrives To Rescue Stranded Sailor.name:
护航船队抵达，救援受困水手
Convoy Arrives To Rescue Stranded Sailors

Text.text:
船帆如初升的朝阳般越过地平线，为被困的幸存者带来新的希望。缤纷的三角旗在清冽的海风中自桅索交织的网间噼啪作响，水手的呼喊声掠过起伏的浪涛传来。尖锐的风笛声骤然响起，小艇调转船头，朝着随波起伏的船只划去。

~ Inbal 于 Discord

Sails crest the horizon like the dawning sun, giving new hope to the stranded survivors. Colorful pennants snap in the crisp sea breeze from webs of rigging, and the cries of the deckhands carry across the rolling waves. A shrill hornpipe rings out as the rowboats turn toward the bobbing vessels.

~ Inbal on Discord

Riding An Airship Above The Forest.name:
乘坐飞空艇，翱翔在森林之上
Riding An Airship Above The Forest

Text.text:
你站在飞空艇的木质甲板上，四周是点缀着轻柔云朵的湛蓝天空。遥远下方，森林树冠的顶端掠过视野，你在旅行中朝着目的地前行。
You stand upon the wooden deck of an airship, surrounded by blue sky dotted with gentle clouds. The top of the forest canopy, far below you, passes by as you travel towards your destination.

一具由钙化骨骼拼成的人形骷髅（特征）迈步向前，沉默而不可阻挡。它枯槁的躯体披着一袭如午夜般的斗篷，破烂不堪，腰间以锈蚀的锁链束紧。那身影挥舞着一柄巨大的镰刀，长柄由熔合的哺乳动物椎骨构成，古老的刀刃上刻满了受害者临终尖啸的图景。兜帽之下，这生物失去视力的目光直直钻入你体内，寒意穿髓而过，冷到你甚至害怕自己的骨头会在可怖的冬日里像霜裂的枫木般轰然炸开。
A humanoid skeleton of calcified bones strides forward, silent and inevitable. Draped across its gaunt form is a midnight cloak, tattered and cinched around the waist by corroded chains. The figure wields a massive scythe, the haft made from fused mammalian vertebrae and the ancient blade etched in depictions of its victims’ final screams. Beneath the hood, the creature's sightless gaze bores into you, chilling your marrow to the point that you fear your bones may explode like frost-cracked maples in a dreadful winter.

Purify Food And Drink.name:
净化食粮与饮水
Purify Food And Drink

Text.text:
你朝面前的给养大幅一挥手，微风随之扬起。霉斑、杂质与污秽尽数随风消散，仿佛灰烬被轻风卷走。
You gesture broadly toward the provisions before you, and a slight wind picks up. Any mold, impurities, or corruption vanishes with the wind, taken like ash on the breeze.

Malin Colavar.name:
马林·科拉瓦尔
Malin Colavar

Text.text:
紧绷的肌肉在茄紫色的夜色肌肤下起伏流转，那道身影毫无预兆地自阴影中显现，白发在身后束成修长马尾，随动作飞扬。在粗陋的斗坑昏暗光照里，她几乎隐形，凭着千锤百炼的本能，轻易融入四周的黑暗。她猛然扑向倒霉的对手，疾风骤雨般打出一连串精准狠辣的击打；而敌手只能徒劳地想要锁定攻击的来源。她那双红宝石般的眼眸闪着兴奋的光，被上方醉醺醺人群的喧嚣喝彩推得更狂。对手瘫倒在地，她高举双臂宣告胜利，又引来粉丝们一阵更响的欢呼。她身上的红色皮衣早已磨旧褪色，却正合她所求——只需装饰般的存在。见过她出手的人都明白：护甲只会碍她的事。

~ Played by Mindwolf with

Toned muscles rippling beneath skin the color of nightshade, the figure appears without warning from the shadows, her white hair dancing in a lengthy ponytail behind her. In the dim light of the crude fighting pit, she is all but invisible, effortlessly blending into the darkness around her with practiced ease. She falls upon her hapless opponent in a flurry of expertly placed strikes, while the adversary desperately tries to pinpoint the source of the attacks. Her ruby-red eyes flash with glee, spurred on by the raucous cheering of the drunken crowd above. Her opponent crumples to the floor and she raises her arms in triumph, securing another cheer from her fans. The red leather clothing she wears is well-worn and faded, but serviceable as the decoration she intends it to be. Anyone who has seen her fight knows armor would just get in her way.

~ Played by Mindwolf with

I Hide In Plain Sight.name:
我藏身于众目睽睽之下
I Hide In Plain Sight

Text.text:
我选定一处藏身点。随后我在区域里翻找搜罗：这儿抓一把泥，那儿捧些尘土与碎石。细枝、落叶、残屑——全都是好用的伪装。我匆匆将这些天然遮蔽抹在身上，刻意打散自身原有的轮廓。此刻，我已能贴着选定的背景悄然消失。
I choose a hiding place. Then I scrounge about the area, taking mud here, dirt and rocks there. Twigs, leaves, debris—it’s all useful camouflage. I hastily apply this natural concealment in ways that obscure my natural shape. I can now disappear against my chosen backdrop.

Vampire Emerges From Their Mist Form.name:
吸血鬼（特征）自雾化形态中现身
Vampire Emerges From Their Mist Form

Text.text:
一声嘶响撕破林间寂静，一缕薄雾在黑暗中盘旋蜿蜒。它在灌木丛里穿行，绕过树干，如蛇般游走，直到在你面前几步处停下。转瞬之间，它翻卷聚拢成一团云霭，继而拉长伸展，勾勒出类人的轮廓。雾气退去，血肉浮现，一张脸显露出来：惨白的皮肤紧绷在锋利的眉骨与颧骨上。幽魂般的面容裂开，黄色的眼睛骤然睁裂。薄唇向后翻起，露出血红的牙龈与一抹阴毒的獠牙笑容。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

A hiss breaks the silence of the forest as a trail of mist coils through the darkness. It snakes within the undergrowth and around the trees, until it stops a few paces before you. In seconds, it rolls and gathers itself into a cloud, then elongates until it forms a humanoid silhouette. Fog gives way to flesh, and a face appears, pallid skin stretching over sharp brow and cheekbones. The ghostly visage splits as yellow eyes break open. Thin lips peel back to reveal blood-red gums and a wicked, fanged smile.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

A Tenday Of Travel By Foot On Road Throu.name:
沿路徒步旅行十日，季节转入秋天
A Tenday Of Travel By Foot On Road Through A Change To Fall

Text.text:
盛夏的余温在你跋涉于尘土飞扬的道路上时一点点被抽走，清冽的秋风钻入衣襟，寒意沁骨。眼前的路被烈日烤得干硬龟裂，可到了第二天，落叶已在坑洼的路面上翻飞起舞；摇曳的树木为你投下斑驳阴影，卷曲的枝梢被一抹抹赤红与鎏金悄然染上。第三天，你经过一处旧战场，泥泞的荒地上散落着锈蚀的武器与护甲残骸；第四天，近旁的田野愈发点缀着一座座坟冢，像无声的碑记，提醒着早已远去的岁月。接下来的几天里，树木开始褪去繁叶，劲爽的秋风一拂，叶片便簌簌脱落。到了第十天，你终于抵达目的地，疲惫不堪，却也为自然的瞬息万变而心生震撼。
The summer warmth is leeching away as you trudge down the dusty road to begin your journey, and a crisp autumn breeze chills the air. The road before you is baked dry, but by day two fallen leaves dance upon its pitted length, and the swaying trees that shadow your path have hints of red and gold painting their curling tips. On the third day you pass an old battlefield, the muddy field littered with rusted remains of weapons and armor, and on day four the nearby fields are increasingly dotted with burial mounds, silent reminders of times gone by. Over the next couple of days trees start to shed, their leaves tickled free by brisk autumn winds. On the tenth day you reach your destination, weary but awed by just how mutable nature is.

Painted Portal To Another World.name:
通往异世界的彩绘传送门
Painted Portal To Another World

Text.text:
一幅惊世骇俗的巨画铺满整面墙。走近细看，你才发现它是活的——更像一扇魔法之窗，以笔触勾勒出一个呼吸着的世界。画中，太阳低悬，将斜斜光束穿过城市的尖塔与街巷。无云的天际，鸟儿轻快掠过。身着绚丽衣饰、戴着各式头巾与帽饰的人们结伴漫步在鹅卵石大道上，在色彩明亮的摊棚间讨价还价。孩子们随着一位微笑的街头乐师无声的拨弦起舞拍手；乐师也跟着舞动，站在一座桥的桥头，桥下是一条温柔而浅浅的河流。

~ Envisioned by Naelynn

A prodigious painting covers the wall. Upon closer inspection, you see that it’s alive. More like a magical window, it depicts a living world rendered in brushstrokes. There, the sun hangs low, casting rays through city spires and streets. Birds flit through the cloudless sky. People in colorful clothing and headwear stroll with one another along cobbled avenues. They trade at booths with bright-hued awnings. Children dance and clap to the soundless strumming of a smiling street musician. He dances, too, at the entrance to a bridge over a gentle, shallow river.

~ Envisioned by Naelynn

山体一侧逐渐变成碎石坡与翻滚堆叠的巨岩。上方峭壁间歇坠落的落石，堆出一道漫长的石肩。看上去可以攀爬，但在陡峭处一旦失足，便可能一路翻滚跌落，滚出很远。
The side of the mountain becomes a slope of gravel and tumbled boulders. Periodic rockfalls from the cliffs above have made a long shoulder of stones. It looks climbable, but a slip in a steep spot could lead to a long tumble.

奇异而隐约阴森的光在茶馆四壁垂落的帷幕上摇曳，空气里弥漫着草木气息浓郁的陌生香料，彼此纠缠得令人胸口发闷。这里的蜡烛燃着猩红与翠玉色的火焰，炭火未尽的炉膛闷燃着，将一抹湛蓝的幽辉铺洒在杂乱的空间里。每一面墙从地到顶都排满架子，架上是装着干茶叶与药草的罐子与小瓶。房间中央立着一张深色未经处理的长圆木桌，四周环着几把虬结扭曲的椅子。桌上放着一副镀金卡牌，光在刻着金纹的牌面上游走，将其上描绘的身影照得清晰分明。有种无形的压力在把你往那边推，像在恳求你抽出一张牌，让它被读出其意。

~ Envisioned by Zandelar

Strange, vaguely sinister light wavers on the curtains draping the walls of the tea shop, and the air is thick with the herbaceous mingling of unknown spices. The candles here burn with flames of crimson and jade, with a smoldering hearth that casts its azure glow across the cluttered space. Shelves containing jars and vials of dried tea leaves and herbs line each wall from floor to ceiling, and in the room’s center stands an oblong table carved from dark, untreated wood, ringed with gnarled chairs. A gilded deck of cards sits upon the table, the light playing across the gold-etched surface and illuminating the figures portrayed there. There’s a pressure pushing you toward it, begging for a card to be drawn and read.

~ Envisioned by Zandelar

一名龙裔女子，鳞片如琥珀麦酒般透亮，在夜晚生意最火爆的时候穿梭于一张张桌子之间。她绕开障碍的身姿轻巧得像被溪流卷走的落叶，闪避着挪动的椅子与乱挥的手臂。遇到那些闹哄哄的酒客——想找茬，或是想从她那些同伴酒吧女侍那里讨来更多关注——她便抡起尾巴，“啪”地一声抽在对方肋骨上。若他们哀嚎，她只会笑得更灿烂，牙缝间隐约探出几缕细小的火舌。

~ 一位英雄 Envisioned

A dragonborn, scales the color of amber ale, bustles from table to table as the nightly business booms. She weaves around obstacles as easily as a leaf taken by a stream, dodging shifting chairs and flailing arms. Rowdy patrons—those seeking a fight or perhaps more attention from her fellow barmaids—receive a sound slap of her tail against their ribcage. If they wail, she only smiles brighter, little fingers of fire peeking from between her teeth.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

没有一丝光能穿透这片冰冷的灰石与坚铁之地。没有音乐能振奋人心，也没有笑声。唯有镣铐的叮当作响、囚徒的低声咕哝，以及守卫偶尔厉声喝令，才会打破笼罩一切的沉重死寂。铁栏之间探出的瘦削面孔也如同他们的环境：灰暗、坚硬而肃穆。
No light penetrates this place of cold, gray stone and hard iron. No music lifts the spirit, nor laughter. Only the clinking of manacles, mutterings of the imprisoned, and the occasional barked order from a guard break the oppressive silence looming over everything. The gaunt faces peering between the bars resemble their surroundings: gray, hard, and solemn.

Primal Savagery: Teeth.name:
原始野性：獠牙
Primal Savagery: Teeth

Text.text:
你的手指蜷起，抬手去抓挠自己的脸。伴随着一声刺耳的爆响，你的下颚扭曲变形，好让匕首般修长的獠牙从牙龈前端顶穿而出。你的口中涌满酸液，像垂涎的瀑布般沿着肿胀拉长的下颚滴落。那灼痛之中，掠食者的饥渴诞生了，你嗜血的双眼游移扫视，带着贪婪的饥饿在饥荒般的渴求里搜寻猎物。
Your fingers curl as you bring them up to scratch at your face. A loud pop fills your hearing when your jaw morphs to accommodate the dagger-length fangs that push through the front of your gums. Your mouth pools with acid, dripping like a slobbering waterfall down your distended jaw. With that sting, a predator’s hunger is born, and your bloodthirsty eyes rove in ravenous starvation.

一名紫罗兰色皮肤的人形生物轻柔地漂浮在空中，模样像是孩子与蝴蝶的混血，翅膀拍动着恒定的节拍。祂带着几分女性的气息，却一刻也静不下来。祂脸上绽开一个灿烂的笑容，那笑意让你想起顽皮的孩童。而在这戏谑的外表之下——那双眼睛里，闪烁着远古星光般的璀璨。
A violet-skinned humanoid, looking like a cross between a child and a butterfly, floats softly in the air, their wings beating a constant rhythm. They are somewhat feminine, perhaps, but cannot remain still. A broad smile breaks across their face, a smile that reminds you of a naughty child. And beneath the whimsical exterior—eyes that sparkle with ancient starlight.

G'varhodir Gvybodythe.name:
格瓦霍迪尔·格维博迪瑟
G'varhodir Gvybodythe

Text.text:
如液的月光轻吻着苍白的女祭司，她从身前浩瀚的藏书中抽出一部沉甸甸的巨册。她的欧泊色长发以镶满宝石的发梳束起，宝石切面折射的冷辉与她那难以捉摸的眼眸相互呼应。长裙勾勒出她柔美的身形，她几乎无声地滑向桌边，将那本词典轻放其上。银白的光掠过她腕间华丽的手镯，钴蓝的辉芒映照着她腰侧的短剑。屋外，一声猫头鹰的尖啸划破夜色，令她的手骤然跃至喉间，纤细的指尖轻抚那枚贴伏其上的微微发光的火欧泊。其湛蓝光泽染上她近乎半透明的肌肤。她深深叹息，坐下，开始阅读，那张精致的面容上浮着一抹淡淡的轻蔑。

~ Played by Marc Clark

Liquid moonlight kisses the pallid priestess as she takes a weighty tome from the vast collection of books before her. Her opal hair is cinched with gem-encrusted combs, the facets of the jewels matching her inscrutable eyes. Her gown enunciates her feminine form as she glides to a table and places the lexicon down. Silvery light catches the ornate bracelet she wears, its cobalt glow mirroring the shortsword at her hip. Outside, an owl screams, causing the woman’s hand to leap to her throat, her delicate fingers caressing the softly glowing fire opal nestling there. Its azure light stains her almost translucent skin. Sighing deeply, she sits and begins to read, a look of faint disdain upon her exquisite face.

~ Played by Marc Clark

被附近吞噬深坑中不断、不可阻挡地渗出的黑暗污泥之潮染成漆黑，焦油砂地上散落着不幸受害者被漂白的骸骨。动物与见多识广的旅人都会避开这片区域，有些人相信此地所受的诅咒，早已超出单纯的自然异象。

~ 由 David 在 Discord 上 构想

Stained black by the relentless, inexorable tide of dark sludge oozing from the sucking pits nearby, the tar sands are littered with the bleached bones of unfortunate victims. Animals and wise travelers avoid this area, some believing it to be cursed beyond mere natural phenomena.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

I Cast Insect Plague Using An Arcane Foc.name:
我用一件奥术法器物品施放【虫群瘟疫】
I Cast Insect Plague Using An Arcane Focus Item

Text.text:
空气中逐渐堆起一阵低沉的嗡鸣，力量在我的奥术法器内噼啪作响，挣扎着要冲破这件物品的实体束缚。我将法器指向敌手，念出那嗡嗡作响、带着鼻音的咒词，随即释放出一群凶猛的昆虫，化作翻涌不息的狂乱虫云。
A droning hum builds in the air as power crackles inside my arcane focus, struggling against the physical form of the item. Pointing my focus toward my foe, I speak the buzzing, nasal words of the incantation, and unleash a swarm of ferocious insects in a tumultuous cloud.

Ancient Vampire.name:
远古吸血鬼（特征）
Ancient Vampire

Text.text:
一具身披陈旧霉烂长袍的生物从棺椁中缓缓坐起。它的皮肤上，细小的黑色血管如水蛭般蠕动爬行；那层皮紧绷着，像一袭轻若蛛纱的裹尸布，覆在曾经美丽的五官之上。它的双眼倏然睁开——目光如刀，脉动着死灵的能量。
Rising from the coffin is a creature dressed in old, moldering robes. Skin—with tiny black veins crawling like leeches over it—is stretched like a gossamer burial shroud across once-beautiful features. Its eyes flick open—piercing, pulsing with necrotic energy.

一抹丁香色的辉光浸透了法师乌檀般的肌肤，他们双手攥握着汹涌的能量，噼啪的静电令一头白发违逆常理地翻卷鼓胀。学徒咬紧牙关仍不肯停下，深信自己天赋过人，却在与远超掌控的力量角力。
A lilac glow suffuses the ebony skin of the mage as they grapple with the tumultuous energies in their hands, the static charge causing their white hair to billow unnaturally around them. Gritting their teeth, the apprentice carries on, convinced of their own aptitude as they wrestle with forces beyond their control.

Approaching Cliffside Border Town In Sum.name:
盛夏逼近峭壁边境镇
Approaching Cliffside Border Town In Summer

Text.text:
你眼前的景象宛如孩童的画作。一轮鼓胀的太阳自钴蓝天空炽烈倾照，将层理分明的小镇浸在金色光辉里。数百条晾衣绳挂满各式衣物，横跨蜿蜒街巷，沿着粉白的白垩峭壁一路攀升。峭壁脚下有一道矮墙环绕；巡逻在刷白壁垒上的边境卫兵彼此打着手势，随着你靠近而指指点点。
The view before you resembles a child's painting. A swollen sun blazes down from the cobalt-blue sky, bathing the striated town with golden light. Hundreds of washing lines, bedecked with all manner of clothing, span the twisting streets climbing the chalky cliffside. A low wall surrounds the foot of the escarpment; the border guards patrolling the white-washed barrier gesture to each other and point as you draw closer.

Barehanded Vs Greatsword.name:
徒手对决巨剑
Barehanded Vs Greatsword

Text.text:
赤手的斗士打量着刀刃与对手，带着一丝希冀做了几下虚空试拳，仿佛只要能尽可能多地打出几记漂亮命中就够了。那把大武器迟缓笨重，但拔出它的斗士却在笑——因为哪怕只是擦到一下也算数。对方逼近，沉身抡出势大力沉的一击；而当那位手无寸铁的敌手轻轻一滑便避开时，自信的冷笑瞬间僵在脸上。
The barehanded fighter sizes up the blade and the opposition, taking a few shadowboxing swings with a look of hope to get in as many good hits as necessary. The big weapon is slow, but the fighter drawing it smiles, because any kind of hit at all will do. They approach and bear down with a powerful swing, and the self-assured smirk disappears when their weaponless adversary easily slides out of the way.

Polished Gigolo.name:
精心打扮的男妓
Polished Gigolo

Text.text:
他抬手潇洒一抹，摘下飞行员墨镜，露出一双如黑色天鹅绒般幽暗而性感的眼睛。紫色西装外套与扣领衬衫在胸前敞开，若隐若现地勾勒出他雕塑般完美的胸肌——剃得干净，刚抹过油，泛着新鲜的光泽。腰带扣被铸成公牛头的形状，双眼亮起光芒。他缓缓将拇指移向扣面，轻轻描过那道轮廓。“喜欢你看到的吗？”他轻点扣环，衣物瞬间变得透明，一层淡淡的紫雾覆在身上，却再也遮不住任何细节。他又迅速点了一下，西装重新相位归位，严丝合缝。他抬起手掌：掌心与指腹贴着一层合成材质的补片，色泽与周围皮肤略有差异。一道付款请求从掌心投影浮现，显示出他的价格。
He takes off his aviator sunglasses with a smooth swipe of his hand, revealing eyes dark and sensuous like black velvet. His purple suit jacket and button-up flare open at the chest to hint at his perfectly sculpted pectorals, shaved and newly oiled. His belt buckle is fashioned in the shape of a bull’s head, the eyes glowing with light. He slowly brings a thumb toward the buckle and traces lightly over it. “Like what you see?” He taps the buckle and his clothes become transparent, the slight purple haze over him leaving nothing to the imagination. He quickly taps the buckle again and his suit phases back into place. He raises his hand. His palm and finger pads are patched with some synthetic material, the hue different from the rest of his skin. A request for payment projects from his palm, revealing his price.

Massive Jungle Cavern With Dwarven Ruins.name:
巨型丛林洞窟与矮人遗迹
Massive Jungle Cavern With Dwarven Ruins

Text.text:
你踏入一个世界中的世界：一座地下的……山？四周是天然石壁——其间有些刻着带矮人工艺风格的纹饰——一路拔起，直抵嶙峋的穹顶。高塔般的孔洞从上方刺入光芒，日光柱在洞底缓缓游移，所及之处撑起一片片植物生机。空间静得像墓穴，唯有水声不息：清水自分岔的长方形石门里细细淌出，汇成缕缕溪线，最终在洞窟一隅汇入一泓小湖。其余部分则被那座人造山体占据，仿佛仿照某座遥远的名峰塑成。半明半暗间，你看见山体上布满矮人身量的门洞，每一扇都像在某场被历史吞没的灾厄里被砸得粉碎、敞开着。

~ 构想：Dameon Guiles

You emerge into a world within a world: an underground… mountain? Around you, natural stone walls—some bearing carvings with a dwarven aesthetic—rise toward a craggy ceiling. Light stabs into the cavern from tower-high punctures above, the sunbeams supporting plant life in the swathes they touch on their daily sojourn across the floor. The space is quiet as a tomb, save for the water that runs in rivulets from bifurcated rectangular stone gates. These thin streams gather at a small lake in one quadrant of the cavern. The rest is dominated by the artificial mountain, perhaps modeled after some far-removed peak. In the half-light, you notice it is riddled with dwarf-sized doors, each one seemingly smashed open in a calamity lost to history.

~ Envisioned by Dameon Guiles

棱角分明的金饰如同辉煌的全副甲胄般披挂在这位贵族身上，流光溢彩，映照着他蛇一般的双眼那夺目的金黄色泽。一顶覆鳞的头盔端庄地栖在他头上，宛如王冠般尊贵，尺寸严丝合缝，显然为他量身定制。他斗篷的金色扣环上压着一枚封印——或许正是他的纹章？
Angular golden jewelry adorns the noble in a gleaming panoply of splendor, mirroring the striking yellow hue of his serpentine eyes. A scaled helmet rests graciously upon his head like a crown, perfectly fitted and clearly bespoke. A seal is stamped into the golden clasp of his cloak—his sigil perhaps?

Wild Magic Surge: Vibrant Blue.name:
狂野魔法涌动：绚丽蓝
Wild Magic Surge: Vibrant Blue

Text.text:
当你完成施法后，指尖残留的刺痒沿着手臂向上攀爬——一阵冬青般冰凉的寒潮扫过，所经之处将你的身躯染上颜色：无痛的淤痕瞬间绽开、迅速晕熟，化作一片均匀夺目、矢车菊般的蓝。
After you finish your casting, a lingering tingle in your fingertips traverses up your arms, a wintergreen-chilly wave that paints your body in its wake: a painless bruise that instantly blooms and ripens to a uniform, eye-catching cornflower blue.

这把短柄斧的斧刃以炉火淬炼之钢打造，刃口毫无崩缺；然而斧刃两侧却遍布战痕，昭示它曾历经多少劈砍。樱桃木斧柄经人精雕细琢、反复打磨，握在手中重心恰到好处，投掷平衡堪称完美。你本能地觉得，只要在射程之内，你几乎能把这柄手斧精准地掷向任何目标。
The forge-tempered steel of the hatchet’s axe head is entirely free of notches, though the sides of the blade show plenty of evidence of the action it has seen. The cherrywood handle has been carved and polished with great care to provide a perfect throwing balance. Instinctively you feel as if you could throw this handaxe accurately at any target within range.

The Ingenue Catches A Rat.name:
天真少女逮住一只老鼠
The Ingenue Catches A Rat

Text.text:
一连串急促的吱吱声引得你把目光投向一具伏在地上的身影。那是个骨架纤细的女孩，蜘蛛般屈膝蹲着，裙摆被她高高撩到膝头；她用纤巧的手死死攥着一只惊恐的老鼠。她越攥越紧，啮齿动物的腿与尾巴疯狂乱甩，豆粒般的眼睛在恐惧中闪着寒光。那身影站起，薄纱般的长裙瀑布似的垂落，重新覆上她细瘦的腿。她的脸终于清晰起来——纯真者！——她那明亮的眼睛半垂着沉重的眼睑，冷冷注视着老鼠徒劳挣扎。忽然，她另一只手抓住老鼠乱蹬的后腿，把它圆滚滚的肚皮抬到嘴边。她的嘴唇拉成夸张的裂口般大张，一口咬下，肉浆噗嗤作响，鲜血四溅。她长长地吞咽，一口接一口，那双明亮的眼睛因解脱——因快感——而蒙上一层呆滞的光泽，老鼠的身体则在她手中缓慢地缩小。

~ 出自精彩的TTRPG补充资料 The Vineyard

A rapid series of squeaks draws your attention toward a figure hunched over the ground. A thin-framed girl, her dress hiked up to her knees in her spider-legged crouch, clutches a panicked rat in her dainty hand. She tightens her grip as the rodent’s legs and tail whirl, its beady eyes gleaming with terror. The figure stands, gauzy gown cascading back down over thin legs. Her face becomes clear—the Ingenue!—her luminous eyes watching the rat struggle under heavy lids. Suddenly, she grabs the rodent’s scrambling back legs with her other hand and brings its round belly up to her mouth. Her lips stretch into a wide gape and she bites down, meat squelching and blood spewing. She swallows in long gulps, her luminous eyes glazed over with relief—with pleasure—as the rat’s body slowly shrinks.

~ Found in the amazing TTRPG supplement The Vineyard

The Chaos Cage.name:
混沌囚笼
The Chaos Cage

Text.text:
血迹斑斑的加固铁栏围出一座囚笼般的斗坑——混沌牢笼。厚重的淬硬金属板封住通往地下隧道的大小洞口，隧道里，参战的生物与它们的驯手静候血腥竞技开场。斗坑边缘一圈，观众兴奋地揣测首位竞争者的底细：一头无眼、披甲的庞然巨物，长而带刺的舌头自它的巨口间探出。那丑恶的生物嗅着空气，污秽竞技场另一端的舱门猛然掀开……

~ 由一位英雄 设想

Bloodstained bars of reinforced iron form an enclosure around the fighting pit known as the Chaos Cage. Heavy slabs of hardened metal cover different sized openings that lead to underground tunnels, within which the fighting creatures and their handlers wait for the blood sport to begin. Around the perimeter of the pit, spectators eagerly speculate on the strengths of the first competitor, an eyeless, armored behemoth with a long, spiky tongue emerging from its maw. As the hideous creature sniffs at the air, the hatch at the opposite end of the filthy arena swings open…

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Blink Dog At The Dog Park.name:
闪烁犬在狗公园
Blink Dog At The Dog Park

Text.text:
一名咯咯大笑的侏儒把一片圆形皮革高高抛向空中，任由风抓住那张皮，在旋转中翻飞。忽然，一道犬形伴着欢快的吠声显现，强壮的颚一口咬住圆盘——随即又在一阵淡紫色火花雨中消失不见。

~ Tusker2zero on Discord

A laughing gnome hurls a patch of circular leather high into the air, allowing the wind to catch the hide as it spins. Suddenly a canine form materializes with a joyful bark and seizes the disk in powerful jaws—before disappearing again in a shower of lilac sparks.

~ Tusker2zero on Discord

Adult Blue Dragon.name:
成年蓝龙
Adult Blue Dragon

Text.text:
那头巨大的龙类生物体型宽阔，外形几乎像鲨鱼一般，从远处冷冷打量着你。它高耸如塔，目光锐利而狡黠，鳞片呈天青石般虹彩流转的湛蓝。它鼻孔翕张，深深吸入你的气味，随即露出带倒钩的獠牙。你闻到刺鼻的臭氧味，静电在空气中游走，每一根汗毛都竖了起来。当你终于真正意识到它的体型时，恐惧瞬间攫住了你。
The massive draconic creature, broad and almost shark-like in appearance, eyes you from a distance. The towering creature has eyes sharp and cunning, and scales the iridescent blue of azurite. Its nostrils flare as it breathes in your scent, and it flashes barbed teeth. You smell ozone, and every hair on your body stands on end as static laces the air. Fear grips you as you fully reckon its size.

Stone Age Bird Nest.name:
石器年代鸟巢
Stone Age Bird Nest

Text.text:
宛如闪耀的珠宝，一窝巨大的斑驳卵蛋安卧在怪物般的巢穴中，头顶树枝垂覆，削弱了烈日无情的注视。四周灌木丛的浓荫里，一只狐狸潜行而出，盯紧这场椭圆盛宴，粉红的舌头舔着嘴唇，垂涎欲滴。忽然它僵在原地——一声震耳欲聋的尖啸宣告那巨大的母兽归来。
Like glinting jewels, a clutch of large dappled eggs is nestled within a monstrous nest, the unforgiving sun’s attention lessened by the branches of an overhanging tree. From the thicket of surrounding bushes, a fox stalks, intent on the oval feast, pink tongue licking its chops. Suddenly it freezes, as a deafening screech proclaims the return of the gigantic mother.

I Tinker With A Flying Bike.name:
我捣鼓着一辆飞行摩托
I Tinker With A Flying Bike

Text.text:
我蹲在摩托车下，打开引擎侧板，熟练地动起手来。那由霓虹管、导线与电路板交织成的繁复网格，足以难倒除最天才的技师之外的所有人——比如我。我开始进行改装，护目镜下的嘴角扬起自信的笑。
Crouching beneath my bike, I open the engine panel and set to work with practiced ease. The complex web of neon tubes, wires, and circuit boards would baffle all but the most gifted mechanics—like me. I begin the alterations, a confident grin spreading below my goggles.

Subterranean Smuggling Complex.name:
地下走私枢纽
Subterranean Smuggling Complex

Text.text:
地堡阴影重重的巢穴里空气陈腐，你穿行于狭窄的甬道，探头窥视空荡的拘留囚室与荒芜的手术间，脚下不止一次打滑失足。你经过时，兜帽遮面的身影投来充满恨意的目光；整座设施里的敌意几乎触手可及，仿佛暴力随时都会爆发。你继续前行，一道结痂般的干涸血迹在前方蜿蜒，标记着你的路线。最好别太认真去想它从何而来。#REF!
The air is stale in the shadowy warrens of the bunker, and you lose your footing more than once as you traverse the narrow tunnels and peer into empty holding cells and barren operating rooms. Hooded figures glare hatefully as you pass, and the hostility in the complex is palpable, as if violence could erupt at any moment. A crusty trail of dried blood marks your path as you press on. It is probably best not to think too hard about where it came from.#REF!

水井是一座由砂浆砌合石块搭成的简朴结构。苔藓沿着井壁悄然攀爬。覆瓦的井棚遮住井口，一根绳索从固定在支援横梁上的简易绞盘与滑轮间垂落下来。井底被黑暗笼罩，但你仍捕捉到极其微弱的水光，在极远、极远的下方闪烁。诡异的声响自井深处传来——也许是一道声音？
The well is a simple structure of mortared stone. Moss creeps up its sides. A shingled roof covers the opening, and a rope dangles from a simple winch and pulley attached to its support beam. The bottom of the well is shrouded in darkness, but you detect the barest gleam of water far, far below. Strange sounds emanate from the depths of the well—a voice, perhaps?

Rallying Speech Invoking Roben Stormride.name:
鼓舞人心的演说：呼唤罗本·风暴骑士
Rallying Speech Invoking Roben Stormrider

Text.text:
“当我们整装待发、即将投身战阵之际，要知道风暴骑士本人正为我们守夜。记住，刀刃不过是一块铁，沉寂无言、毫无目的。引它走向善或恶的，是持刃者的心智。风暴骑士明白生命何其珍贵，也明白胜利并不需要屠戮。你们只需击溃敌人的心智，他们的身体自会随之倒下。”
“As we prepare to plunge into the fray, know that Stormrider himself watches over us. Remember that the blade is only iron, inert and without purpose. It is the mind of the wielder that leads it toward good or ill. Stormrider knew that life was precious, that victory does not demand slaughter. You must only defeat the mind of the enemy and their body will follow.”

Shimmering Veils: Distortion.name:
摇曳帷幕：扭曲
Shimmering Veils: Distortion

Text.text:
你的视线一阵模糊，你眨了眨眼想让它清晰些。然而当你再度睁开眼，周遭的世界竟像波纹玻璃上的倒影般扭曲弯折。你更用力地闭上眼，再睁开时，一切已恢复如常——可那股诡异的晃动感却转移到了你体内，搅得你胃里一阵发酸。
Your vision blurs, and you blink to clear it. But when you open your eyes, the world about you seems to warp and bend like a reflection on rippled glass. You close your eyes harder, and when you open them again, everything looks as it should—but the queer sense of motion has moved inside you, turning your stomach sour.

Widow Mary’s Apothecary In Winter.name:
冬日的寡妇玛丽药剂铺
Widow Mary’s Apothecary In Winter

Text.text:
药剂师的窗户都结了一层白霜，屋檐边垂着一排排冰锥。一个半兽人女人披着厚实紧密织就的长袍，獠牙上还套着银帽，正同一名几乎把整张脸都裹进围巾里的男人说话。你听见她把一只沙沙作响的纸袋递给那位眼泡浮肿的客人时说道：“别把叶子烫坏了。”她把他的手握在自己掌心里，细细查看他的指尖。“三撮能煮四杯——一天就该喝这么多，亲爱的。”客人抽着鼻子，感激地点点头。半兽人转身望向自己覆霜的家，疲惫地叹了口气。她在掌心凭空唤出火焰，手掌轻轻拂过屋顶与窗沿，所到之处冰霜消融，冷白的硬壳缓缓化开。
The windows of the apothecary are frosted over, icicles dangling over the edge of the roof. A half-orc woman in a thickly woven robe and with silver-capped tusks speaks with a man whose face is wrapped almost entirely in a scarf. “Don’t scald the leaves,” you hear her say as she hands a crinkling bag over to the puffy-eyed patron. She takes his hand in hers, inspecting his fingers. “Three pinches should get you four cups, and that’s how many you’ll want to drink in a day, darlin’.” The patron sniffles and nods his head in gratitude. The half-orc turns to her frosted home with a beleaguered sigh. She conjures fire in her palm and passes her hand gently along the roof and over her windows, melting the ice away.

Dragon's Breath (Lightning) Cast On Ally.name:
巨龙吐息（闪电）施放于盟友
Dragon's Breath (Lightning) Cast On Ally

Text.text:
你嘶嘶作响的咒语愈发低沉，化作巨龙般的嗡鸣。词句自你喉间轰隆滚出，如酝酿中的风暴；你攥紧拳中的深红辣椒，炽热的果肉从指缝间渗出，灼烧的痛楚转为噼啪作响的静电震颤，沿着手臂一阵阵鼓荡上涌。你将手臂伸向你的盟友，一道灼烫的幽蓝电弧自指尖跃出，将魔法传递过去。对方张口仿佛要咆哮，然而没有声音——取而代之的是一道闪电的漩涡在口中成形，蓄势待发，随时倾泻而出。
Your hissing incantation deepens to a draconic drone. The words rumble from you like a brewing storm as you squeeze a crimson pepper in your fist.
