Fiery pulp oozes between your knuckles, the intense burn transforming into a static thrum that pulses up your arm. You extend your arm toward your ally, and an arc of blistering blue leaps from your fingertips, transferring the magic. Their mouth opens as if to roar, but instead of sound, a vortex of lightning forms, ready to be unleashed.

Quip By A Gnome.name:
侏儒的俏皮话
Quip By A Gnome

Text.text:
“我的族人或许不如某些人那般显赫，但我们宁可同心谦卑，也不愿孤身自傲。”
“My people may not be as grand as some others, but we’d rather be humble together than proud and alone.”

Dwarfhold With A Central Forge.name:
中央熔炉矮人堡
Dwarfhold With A Central Forge

Text.text:
矮人要塞里回荡着铁砧的叮当与钢铁的尖啸。光滑的石壁向外吐出热与光，使得遍布每一寸表面的符文更显深沉。由山体之石直接凿刻出的圆顶居所与高耸塔楼，如石笋般贯穿地面与穹顶之间的空间；其间铺就的匠心大道上，矮人们往来奔忙。这里有十余座铁匠铺炉火不息，却都笼罩在城市中央大熔炉的阴影下——那巨炉如同隆起的熔岩穹丘般巍然矗立。由岩浆驱动的大熔炉所散发的热与光，足以温暖整座向外延展的城市。
The dwarfhold sings with ringing anvils and keening steel. The smooth stone walls radiate heat and light, deepening the runes carved across every surface. Domed dwellings and soaring towers carved from the stone of the mountain span the space between floor and ceiling like stalagmites, and on roads masterfully crafted between, dwarves bustle about. A dozen smithies work their forges here, but all stand in the shadow of the city’s central forge, looming like a lava dome. The heat and light radiating from the magma-fueled forge is enough to warm the entire city spanning outward from it.

一道瘦削、苍白的身影伸展开翅翼与鞭状长尾。它已许多天未曾饱食，如今四处搜寻猎物，准备汲吸其血。这些蝙蝠对某些人只是烦扰，对另一些人却是致命威胁。尾巴根部泄露了秘密：一枚球形毒囊正有节奏地搏动，毒素沿着半透明的毛细血管流淌，直达那同名的毒刺。
A thin, pale shape extends its wings and whiplike tail. It has gone many days without gorging and now searches for prey to suck upon. These bats are a nuisance for some, a danger for others. The base of the tail reveals the secret: a spherical sack of poison pulses, its toxins traveling through translucent capillaries to the eponymous stinger.

塔楼二层的一隅，是一间令人心情愉快的教室：过道上铺着一条长长的地毯，沿途展示着各家族的纹章；一张张书桌舒适而整齐。这里教授的是“把物体变成另一个物体”的法门。更危险的是，活物也会被变成死物，再变回来——但愿能变回来——而那令人脊背发凉的伪装咒也在此生效。曾有一堂课里，所有人都被逼真地变成同一个学生，结果他们费了好大劲，才分辨出谁才是最初的那一个。
A pleasant classroom with a runner displaying all the house sigils down the aisle and comfortable desks takes up a small space on the second floor of the tower. In this room objects are changed to other objects. More dangerously, are living beings transformed into non-living things and back—hopefully—and the chilling spells of disguise work. In one class, everyone was so convincingly transformed into the same student that they had a difficult time figuring out who was the original.

Morally Ambiguous Pirate Lord.name:
道德暧昧的海盗领主
Morally Ambiguous Pirate Lord

Text.text:
海盗冲你闪过一抹风流倜傥的笑意，锋利得不逊任何弯刀，凭魅力将你卸了防备……只是一瞬。他的道德像潮汐般起落，随性涌退，从不在同一处久留。你不知道能否信他，可此刻你只有他——而且他心知肚明。

~ 由 Sahlonahl 在 Discord 上 构想

The pirate flashes you a debonair smile sharp as any cutlass, disarming you with his charm… for a moment. The whims of his morality seem to ebb and flow like the tide, never settling in one place for long. You don't know if you can trust him, but right now he’s all you've got—and he knows it.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

The Sanctuary: Atop The Waterfall.name:
圣所：瀑布之巅
The Sanctuary: Atop The Waterfall

Text.text:
奔涌的急流发出狂暴的咆哮，震得你耳膜发痛，河水在巨瀑之巅翻卷成浪。陡峭绝壁的边缘勾勒出苔原地带的南部疆界，俯瞰东南方壮丽却致命的草原远景，以及西南方幽深的森林。漂浮的冰排与湿滑的岩石勉强提供一条危险的涉渡之路，但只要一步踏空，你便会被卷入下方翻腾的白沫激流之中。
The violent roar of rushing water fills your ears as the river crests a massive waterfall. The edge of the sheer cliffs mark the southern border of the tundra region and overlook a beautiful but deadly vista of the steppes to the southeast and the forests to the southwest. Drifting ice floes and slick rocks offer a dangerous way across the water, but one slip would send you tumbling into the frothy water below.

Loot From Leeches.name:
从水蛭身上搜刮的战利品
Loot From Leeches

Text.text:
这些水蛭保存得相当完整，炼金术士或许能从中提炼出温和的毒素，或是一种抗凝血剂。那黏稠的体液可用来涂覆刀刃或箭头。
The leeches are intact enough that they may be used by an alchemist to extract either a mild poison or an anticoagulant. The viscous fluid can coat blades or arrowheads.

一层芬芳的蒸汽帷幕沉沉垂在空气里，辛烈的熏香、花香四溢的香草干花与浓郁的精油彼此交织。照明只靠几支蜡烛与一扇高窗投下的一束日光。昏暗的厅室里摆着各式各样、大小不一的浴池，专为那些手头阔绰的人准备。一个魁梧的半兽人浸在下沉式浴池中，水面漂着玫瑰花瓣；不远处，一对矮人一边冲洗、给胡子抹油，一边喝着麦酒、抽着烟草。生灵们汗珠晶亮，披着毛巾，赤着脚与上身，彼此低声交谈。
A curtain of fragrant steam hangs heavy in the air, a mingling of sharp incense, flowery potpourri, and rich oils. Candles and a single high window allowing in a shaft of daylight provide the only illumination. The dim chambers contain baths of all shapes and sizes, catering to those with coin to spare. A hulking half-orc soaks in a sunken tub with floating rose petals; nearby a pair of dwarves rinse and oil their beards while enjoying ale and pipeweed. Creatures, dewy with sweat and draped in towels, and with bare feet and torsos, talk quietly amongst themselves.

My Ring Of Regeneration Heals Me.name:
我的再生戒指治愈着我
My Ring Of Regeneration Heals Me

Text.text:
我们的审判结束几分钟后，翠绿的光点从我的戒指里飘起。它们像无害的孢子般在我身周盘旋，随后轻轻落在我的伤口上。光芒微微闪烁，继而消散无形，缓缓治疗皮肤表面或深处的淤青、割伤与其他创损。我还没有完全痊愈……但疼痛，以及压在胸口的那份焦虑的重量，确实减轻了一些。
A few minutes after our trial ends, verdant lights float up from my ring. They hover about my body like harmless spores until they land gently upon my wounds. The light shimmers before fading to nothing, gradually healing the bruises, cuts, and other damages upon or beneath my skin. I’m not fully healed… but the pain, and the weight of anxiety in my chest, has lessened a bit.

Tome Of Understanding.name:
理解之书
Tome Of Understanding

Text.text:
这本皮革装帧的书被深红色污渍浸透，泛黄的书页边角卷起，书脊因长期翻阅而弯折。掩蔽上写着一种久已湮没的古老文字，但栖居在那些符文中的魔法渗入每一页。表面看来，它不过是一本陈旧的厚书。也许这本书自己就知道，外表往往会骗人。
The leather-bound book is stained a deep red, and the yellowed pages are furled at the corners, the spine bent from use. The cover houses script from a language long ago forgotten, but the magic that resides in those glyphs permeates each page. Outwardly, it appears to be little more than an old tome. Perhaps the book itself knows that appearances can be deceiving.

Tournament In Severe Heat.name:
酷暑中的比武大会
Tournament In Severe Heat

Text.text:
盛夏繁花本该令人愉悦，若不是这稠闷如汤的空气里，万物与众人都在枯萎。护甲一 接触 便灼烫，头盔令人窒息，战马沿着斜坡疾驰时也只剩半 速度。盛典队伍终于现身，可舞者与侍从在歌声响起前就已被汗水浸透。王族面色烦躁而阴沉，匆匆挥手催人呈上名册。混战不过持续了短短几分钟，爱之女王便起身鼓掌，挥手将众人引入城堡清凉的石厅与喷泉之间。
The summer profusion of flowers would be cheery if everything, and everyone, wasn’t wilting in the soupy air. Armor burns to the touch, helmets suffocate, and the horses run at half speed along the tilt. The pageant appears, but the dancers and attendants are all soaked with sweat before the singing begins. The royals look bothered and angry and wave the lists through quickly. The melee barely lasts a few minutes before the queen of love stands, claps, and waves everyone into the cool stone of the castle and fountains.

Bard’s Speech About Amanda.name:
吟游诗人关于阿曼达的演说
Bard’s Speech About Amanda

Text.text:
“我以前谱写叙事歌谣时总是困难重重，总觉得少了点什么。直到我遇见阿曼达——我的初恋。我们一同演奏时，音符仿佛从某个更高的位面倾泻而下，超出我们所能想象。我能遇见阿曼达·琳，真是幸运至极。”
“I used to have a great deal of trouble composing my ballads. It always felt as though I was missing something. Until I met Amanda, my first love. When we played together it was as if the notes flowed from some greater plane, beyond our reckoning. I was so very lucky to find Amanda Lynn.”

Speech About A Lost Loved One.name:
关于逝去挚爱的致辞
Speech About A Lost Loved One

Text.text:
“如果我能穿过帷幕触及他们，告诉他们一件事，那就是：自我记事以来第一次，我很幸福。”
“If I could reach through the veil and tell them one thing it would be that, for the first time in as long as I can remember, I’m happy.”

Dockside Dive Bar.name:
码头边的潜水酒吧
Dockside Dive Bar

Text.text:
容纳酒吧的那栋建筑结实而低矮，仿佛建造者担心它会被海浪卷走。咸涩的海风对外墙与室内都毫不留情，墙上以锈迹与污垢为主要“装饰”。但酒客们似乎并不在意，大多数人只是盯着自己酒杯里廉价的酒水出神。
The building housing the bar is sturdy and low to the ground, as if the builders were worried it might be washed away by the sea. The salty air has not treated either the outside or the inside well, with rust and dirt being the predominant decorations on the walls. The patrons don't seem to care though. Most stare into the cheap contents of their drinking glasses.

肃穆的桃花心木边框将那幅贵族肖像牢牢圈起，它栖在壁炉台上方，阴沉地俯视着你。画中之人威仪迫人，冷峻的目光以毫厘不差的精准追随着你。忽然，绘就的身影活了过来，自行挪动；由颜料与画布凝成的双手扭转翻飞，结出奥秘的手势。
Austere mahogany frames the noble portrait glowering down upon you from its perch above the mantel. The figure within exudes authority, their stern gaze following you with unerring precision. Suddenly, the painted likeness comes alive, moving of its own accord as hands of pigmented canvas twist into arcane gestures.

Spore Servants Move To Attack.name:
孢子仆从逼近发动攻击
Spore Servants Move To Attack

Text.text:
五具沾满孢子尘埃的人类尸体在真菌魔法的驱策下复苏，并被牢牢奴役：那种既等待又仿佛未曾等待的静止，终于终结。他们从牢房里走出，以非人的目光扫视着区域。下一瞬，他们齐齐锁定队伍。下一瞬，他们齐齐发动攻击。

~ 由 Ethan 构想

The five human corpses dusted with spores are revitalized and enthralled by the fungal magic: their waiting without waiting has ended. They emerge from the cell and scan the area with inhuman gaze. As one they spot the party. As one they attack.

~ Envisioned by Ethan

这只大猩猩佝偻着蹲伏在地，卷曲的指节撑在近似人类的脚掌旁；它的眼神里隐约透出一抹逼近智慧的思绪。它那双长臂肌肉如绳索般盘结，天生适合以摆荡攀跃的方式在林间移动。不难想象，一旦被激怒，这头生物会造成何等可怕的伤害。
Hunched on the ground and resting its curled knuckles on humanlike feet, the great ape's eyes hint at a mind that approaches sapience. Its long arms, ropy with muscle, are ideally shaped for movement through brachiation. Unsurprisingly, it is easy to imagine what kind of damage this creature could inflict if angered.

黑毛水牛披着乌亮的皮毛，头顶一对巨大而向下弯曲的长角，聚成一群喧腾的牛群，足有百头以上。它们一边啃食游走，一边缓慢穿行大地，硕大下垂的耳朵不停拍动，把恼人的苍蝇驱赶开去。
Black-coated buffalo, capped with great, downward-curving horns, form a thronging herd of a hundred or more. They flap their large, drooping ears to bat flies away as they graze and roam, making their gradual journey across the land.

Skulls Atop A Stone Coffin.name:
石棺之上的骷髅
Skulls Atop A Stone Coffin

Text.text:
这口棺材周围的地面上散落着枯败的花束与各式小饰物，相较于葬礼厅里的其他棺材显得格外凌乱。似乎有人将它们从棺盖上拂落，转而在原处堆起了一摞象牙骷髅头。
Old flowers and trinkets are strewn about the floor around this coffin, in relative disarray compared to the others in the burial hall. It appears somebody brushed them off the lid and stacked a pile of ivory skulls in their place.

Promise Of A Warrior To A Magic-user.name:
战士对魔法使的誓约
Promise Of A Warrior To A Magic-user

Text.text:
“我挨过揍，被烧过，被打得血肉模糊，被吞噬过，被利爪撕扯过，还被世上已知的一切腐蚀性物质与黏稠液体浇得满身都是……以及好几种未知的。但那是因为我扛得住。只要我能替你多争取一点时代，让你去收拾这周又在终结世界的那套魔法胡闹，那就都值了。”
“I’ve been beaten, burned, bloodied, consumed, clawed, and covered in every corrosive substance and viscous fluid known… and several that are unknown. But that’s because I can take it. And if I can buy you a little bit more time to fix whatever magical nonsense is ending the world this week, then it’s all worthwhile.”

褐色的灌木草零星点缀着辽阔而干旱的平原。马匹与马车沿着道路行进，身后扬起滚滚尘烟；远处风势卷起一股尘土旋风，在地平线上翻卷疾旋。
Brown scrub grass dots the sprawling, arid plain. Dust rises in great plumes in the wake of horses and wagons on the road; and in the distance the wind kicks up a dust cyclone that spins across the horizon.

帆船的残骸在海底的黑暗中缓缓显现；破烂腐朽的船帆随洋流起舞，在幽影深处如幽魂般飘荡。船体的木质残躯宛如陨落利维坦的白骨，而在其内部——谁又知道有什么宝藏在等待？
The remains of the sailing ship slowly become visible in the darkness of the sea floor; sails, tattered and rotting, dance on the ocean's current, appearing ghostlike in the shadowed depths. The ship's wooden carcass resembles the bones of a fallen leviathan, and inside—who knows what treasures await?

Federal Building With Reinforced Barrier.name:
设有加固屏障的联邦大楼
Federal Building With Reinforced Barriers

Text.text:
这栋建筑平淡无奇、毫不起眼，若非外墙上骄傲地悬挂着联邦政府徽章，几乎不会引人多看一眼。两道加固路障之间蜷伏着一处岗亭——由面色阴沉的安保人员把守——掌控着通往宽阔停车场以及其后建筑的出入。
Nondescript and pedestrian, this building would be entirely unremarkable were it not for the federal government badge proudly displayed on the façade. A guard post—manned by dour security personnel—squats between two reinforced barriers, controlling entry to the sprawling parking lot and the building beyond.

Illusory Red Dragon.name:
幻象红龙
Illusory Red Dragon

Text.text:
巨龙庞大得惊人，猩红鳞片如钢般闪光，几乎塞满整座洞窟。它低下长角的头颅，猛然冲锋，誓要将敌人撞飞，再以铁蹄碾碎。 [Breath Weapon] 巨龙喷鼻、跺地、深深吸气。它的颈项、喉管与大张的巨口炽红发亮，随即吐出一团燃烧的余烬与浓烟。热浪不如想象中猛烈，但那股烟雾却让四肢与关节僵硬发紧。 [Illusion Fails] 巨龙的身形变得幽渺，近乎透明。那层庞大的幻象之下，竟是一头公牛：长而锐利的角，覆着甲片般的厚皮，通体银灰如钢。它低哼喘息，鼻孔与口中涌出翠绿的烟雾。

~ Envisioned by Battersby

The enormous dragon, its scarlet scales gleaming like steel, barely fits in the cavern. It lowers its horned head and charges forward, intent on slamming into its enemies and trampling them. [Breath Weapon] The dragon snorts, stamps, and inhales. Its neck, throat, and open maw glow red hot, and then the beast exhales a cloud of fiery embers and smoke. The heat is less intense than might be expected, but the fumes cause limbs and joints to stiffen. [Illusion Fails] The dragon becomes ghostly, almost transparent. Underneath the massive illusion is a bull with long, sharp horns and a plated hide, all the silver-gray color of steel. As it grunts and huffs, green fumes pour from its nostrils and mouth.

~ Envisioned by Battersby

穿过嶙峋林地回荡的声响，尖啸夹着嘶鸣，几乎已辨不出那是巨龙的嗓音。在一片粗陋的林间空地上，巨龙瘦得皮包骨，张口喘息。它的鳞片柔软而苍白，一条腿已残废；一侧翅膀被压在一棵倒木下——那树似乎是它逃窜时奋力撞倒的。它一只眼已盲，另一只眼却满含乞求，求你施以慈悲，结束它的痛苦。

~ 一位英雄Envisioned

The sound that carries through the rocky woodland, a whine and a hiss, is barely recognizable as a dragon’s voice. In a rough clearing of trees, the dragon lies emaciated, panting. Its scales are soft and pale, a leg is maimed; one wing is trapped under a tree it looks to have brought down while trying to escape. Blinded in one eye, it begs with the other for the mercy of ending its misery.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Brew A Poison.name:
我调制一剂毒药
I Brew A Poison

Text.text:
工具包齐全，装配也足够简单；那些混合物散发出的刺鼻恶臭告诉我进展顺利。我戴上一只厚重的羊毛面罩，里面塞满香囊花草，再滴入最后一滴腐臭的液体——催化剂。随后我把蜡封与麻绳拉环绕在瓶颈上，最后将这瓶令人作呕的酿物塞进外套口袋里。
The kit is complete and easy enough to set up, and the noxious odor of the combinations tells me I am making good progress. I put on a heavy wool mask, stuffed with potpourri, and add the final drop of putrid liquid, a catalyst. Then I wrap the wax seal and twine release cord around the bottle neck, and I drop the foul brew in my coat pocket.

Friendly, Blind Giant.name:
友善的盲眼巨人
Friendly, Blind Giant

Text.text:
巨人朝你这边竖起耳朵，随即转过身来，让你清楚地看见她的面容。你发现她那双巨大的眼睛上都覆着一层乳白的薄膜。此刻她虽已转向你，却并不与你对视，而是张开双手，朝地面探去。她咧嘴露出宽大的笑容，那笑意看起来真诚无伪。
The giant cocks an ear in your direction and then turns, giving you a clear view of her face. You see that both her enormous eyes have white film across them. Although turned now to face you, she does not make eye contact, instead casting out open hands toward the ground. She smiles broadly in what seems a genuine way.

头顶枝叶间忽然传来一声喷鼻，把你吓了一跳。你立刻绷紧准备迎战，却什么也没出现。你眯眼望向树上，只见阴影里有一团巨大的隆起。那团东西又喷了口气，你这才放松下来——树上那人不知怎么竟然睡着了。也许站岗实在太无聊了。
A snort comes from the branches above, startling you. You ready for battle but nothing comes. Peering up into the tree, you spy a large lump among the shadows. Then the lump snorts again, and you relax. Whoever it is in up there has somehow managed to fall asleep. Perhaps guard duty got too boring.

Fake Arrow Of Slaying.name:
伪屠戮箭
Fake Arrow Of Slaying

Text.text:
就在此刻：你将特制箭矢搭上弓弦，瞄准敌人的弱点，松手放箭。箭矢猛然扎入你的对手——却在瞬间碎裂。更糟的是，它似乎并未对你的目标造成多大影响。
This is the moment: you nock the purpose-made arrow to your bowstring, aim for the enemy’s weak point, and let fly. The arrow plunges into your foe—and shatters. Worse, it seems to have had no great impact on your target.

在桥的阴影下，桥身挡住了瀑布喧嚣的轰鸣，让你得以听见河水奔流时的回旋与咯咯轻笑。一只蜻蜓闪着宝石般的光彩疾掠而来，短暂悬停在睡莲敞开的花瓣上方，随即一头扎进随风摇晃、轻轻点头的香蒲丛的庇护里。不知为何，它的举动让你想起了雨；你抬头望向天空，一滴雨点先打在你的脸颊上，紧接着又一滴落在你的手背。
Here in the shadow of the bridge, the structure blocks some of the waterfall’s noisy rumble, allowing you to hear the whirl and chuckle of the flowing river. A dragonfly, glittering with gem-like color, zips into view to hover briefly over the open flowers of water lilies before it dives into the shelter of cattails bobbing in the breeze. For some reason, the animal’s action makes you think of rain, and when you look to the sky a drop strikes your cheek, then another strikes your hand.

Orcish King Seated In His Wheelchair.name:
坐在轮椅上的兽人之王
Orcish King Seated In His Wheelchair

Text.text:
国王今晨正在开庭。你被引入王座厅时，起初并未看见王座——只有一幅威严的兽人国王肖像：盛装华服，长须编成粗辫，垂落至膝。侍从推来一把金光夺目的轮椅，凡是能见到的表面皆覆以螺旋纹的精巧金丝镂饰。你屏息而视——国王自私室中被六名侍从抬出，伏在他们背上，如同一座沉甸甸的王权，被安置在你面前的椅中。他以历经无数试炼的领主般冷硬目光盯着你。若想在此人身上取得任何实质进展，非得巧舌如簧不可。
The king is holding court this morning. As you’re ushered into the throne room, you see no throne initially—only a portrait of the regal orcish king in full adornment, with a long, braided beard that rests upon his knee. An attendant brings out a glittering golden wheelchair, every available surface of it covered with spiral pattern filigree. You watch with awe as the king is carried out from his private chamber on the backs of six attendants and placed into the chair in front of you. He stares at you with the hard eyes of a lord that has seen many trials. A silver tongue will be required to get anywhere productive with this man.

I Use A Dummy For Target Practice.name:
我用假人当靶练习
I Use A Dummy For Target Practice

Text.text:
我放出投射物，目送它飞入假人那颗桶状的脑袋。木制人偶被这一击的力道打得向后弯折，随即吱呀作响地弹回原位，发出一声仿佛久经磨损的叹息。木头上布满箭矢与弩矢留下的孔洞，还点缀着几道焦痕——那是施法者练习准头时留下的印记。
I loose my projectile, watching it sail into the bucket head of the dummy. The wooden figure bends backward from the force of the shot, creaking back into place with a sound like a well-worn sigh. The wood is riddled with the holes of arrows and bolts, as well as a few scorch marks from spellslingers practicing their aim.

Hidden Pirate Port.name:
隐秘的海盗港
Hidden Pirate Port

Text.text:
任何漫不经心沿着海岸巡航的船主，都很容易把这处毫不起眼的小海湾当作寻常景致而径直驶过。可知情者明白，就在视线之外有一道狭窄峡谷，通往一座喧嚣的港口——那港口专为想躲开海上官署耳目的家伙而建。停泊在这座港城码头的每一艘船都高悬骷髅旗。这里是各地海盗船与海盗团的避风港，以盗贼的荣誉相系，并由盘踞在这座摇摇欲坠的破城里的帮派铁腕维持秩序。
Any ship handler casually cruising along the coastline could be forgiven for sailing right past this innocuous-looking cove. For those in the know, just out of sight is a narrow canyon which leads to a bustling port— one constructed specifically for those looking to avoid the notice of seagoing officials. Every vessel moored at the docks of this port city flies the Jolly Roger. It is a haven for pirate crews and ships of all lands, bound by the honor of thieves and enforced by the gangs holding dominance over the ramshackle city.

在迷雾重重的往昔某个时刻，这把制作精良的短弓从其 rightful owner 手中辗转流落。弓身上的符文昭示着它曾属于一位精灵的法师与斥候；这件俊美的武器失落之后，他无疑曾为此黯然良久。
Liberated at some point in the shrouded past from its rightful owner, the runes on this well-crafted shortbow indicate that it was once the property of an elvish wizard and scout, who undoubtedly felt the loss of this handsome weapon for some time.

A Guide After Death.name:
死后指南
A Guide After Death

Text.text:
黑暗亮起，化作一幅星辰织锦。四周景色的轮廓与色彩都变得更为锋利鲜明。远方天际泛起黎明的微光。自那边而来的一阵宜人清风，捎来新落雨后的清新气息。

“你已越过门槛。”一个低沉而浑厚的声音说道，仿佛回答了未曾出口的疑问。就在片刻之前他还不在——一个光头、漆黑如墨的男人，披着白色亚麻长袍，眼中盛满无尽的安宁与喜悦。他赤足绕到你身侧，伸出右手。“来吧。是时候重新开始了。”

~ Envisioned by JD

Darkness brightens into a tapestry of stars. All around, the landscape seems sharper in form and color. Dawn lightens the sky in the distance. From there, a pleasant breeze carries the smell of fresh-fallen rain.

“You have passed the threshold,” says a deep, resonant voice, answering a question unasked. He wasn’t there a moment ago, this bald, pitch-black man in a robe of white linen, his eyes filled with infinite bliss. Stepping around you on bare feet, he extends his right hand. “Come. It is time to begin again.”

~ Envisioned by JD

Speech By A Monk About The Serenity Of C.name:
一位僧侣关于战斗宁静的演说
Speech By A Monk About The Serenity Of Combat

Text.text:
“我在战斗中寻得一种珍贵的宁静——那是一片空间，尘世万般重压在此尽数融化；而我每一次挥击，都是一声掷地有音的宣言，清澈而真实，回荡在宇宙冷漠的沉默里。”
“There is a precious peace I find in combat—a space where all the stresses of the world melt away and my every strike is a statement that rings true and clear against the indifference of the universe.”

Cursed: Disadvantage On Ability Checks A.name:
诅咒：与感知相关的能力检定与豁免检定具有劣势
Cursed: Disadvantage On Ability Checks And Saving Throws Tied To Wisdom

Text.text:
所有人都在为一个你听不懂的笑话大笑。你发现自己四下张望，想从周遭找出答案，从记忆里翻出线索来解开这道谜题。可当旁人开始揣测时，他们的每一种说法听起来都不对——哪怕彼此争得面红耳赤、互相矛盾——你也不禁觉得，今天的祈祷或许毫无用处：那祷词是念给一位洞见深远的神祇，却对你的祈求充耳不闻。
Everyone’s laughing at a joke you don’t get. You find yourself looking around for answers in your surroundings, memories to solve a puzzle. When those around you speculate they all sound wrong, even when they disagree with one another, and you think that maybe prayer today will be useless—recited to a deity of great insight but deaf to your petitions.

Dragonborn Smith Attracts Curious Elemen.name:
龙裔铁匠引来好奇的元素精灵
Dragonborn Smith Attracts Curious Elemental Spirits

Text.text:
他用两只利爪紧扣锻造锤的木柄，熔炉火光一照，鳞片仿佛被催醒般跃动出流彩：白、青蓝、金、紫、绿。他以熟练得近乎本能的节奏低声祈祷，分叉的舌尖轻叩尖齿，发出细碎的嗒嗒声。火星噼啪炸响，而当炉火深处传来轻柔细微的说话声时，这名龙裔的眼睛——金与绿斑点拼成的马赛克——轻颤着睁开。紧接着，火焰像被风搅乱般摇曳变调；在一道白色闪光与一阵细小嗓音的合唱里，微小的身影自熔炉中涌出。黑曜石般旋舞的面具悬在明亮火焰铸就的身躯之上。龙裔单膝跪地，任由那些生灵如烟如雾地飘向他。更大胆的灵体跃上他的铁砧，直直端详着他，噼啪作响的手臂叉在身侧，面具微微倾斜，满是好奇；其余的则紧紧簇成一团，面具含蓄地垂向地面。

~ Envisioned by The1WiTheGun

He clasps the handle of his smithing hammer with both claws, the light of the forge’s fire spurring his scales to dance with color: white, teal, gold, purple, green. He mutters quietly in practiced prayer, forked tongue clicking against his sharp teeth. The fire pops, and the dragonborn’s eyes—a mosaic of gold and green flecks—flutter open when voices, slight and soft, come from within. The fire then warbles as if disturbed by wind and, with a white flash and chorus of small voices, tiny figures emerge from the forge. Swirling masks of obsidian suspend on bodies of bright flame. The dragonborn kneels down on one knee as the creatures waft toward him. The bolder spirits stand atop his anvil to regard him directly, crackling arms akimbo and masks tilted in curious regard, while others cluster tightly together, their masks turned demurely downward.

~ Envisioned by The1WiTheGun

一把传奇般的武器，由一位天赋异禀的精灵打造，而其姓名早已湮没于时代尘埃之中。弓臂闪耀着晶莹的纯白，金色细线自靠近鎏金握把处那一对圆形、熠熠生辉的太阳纹饰起，沿着弓身弧度延伸至两端。握柄上雕刻着神情凌厉的精灵面孔，目光穿透前方，直指敌人。细若发丝的金弦在拉弓之手中安然贴合，仿佛在耳畔低语一段誓言……
A weapon of legendary proportion crafted by a prodigious elf whose name is lost to time. The limbs of this bow are a glittering white. A line of gold traces to the ends of the arc from the circular gleaming sun symbols resting near its aureate grip. Glaring elvish faces are carved into its handle, staring out towards the enemy. The fine golden string rests comfortably in the drawing hand; it whispers an oath…

Quip About Different Forms Of Beauty.name:
关于不同形态的美的俏皮话
Quip About Different Forms Of Beauty

Text.text:
“性别？体型？种族？用这种荒唐又随意的标准来决定欲望，未免太可笑了。若你执意把自己关在门外，拒绝这世界大多数的欢愉，我想那也是你的选择。但我会在一切形态的美之中，追寻我所渴望的光彩。”
“Gender? Body type? Species? What an incredibly arbitrary way to dictate attraction. If you wish to lock yourself away from the majority of pleasure this world has to offer, I suppose that is your decision. But I choose to seek out beauty in all its forms.”

I Drink My Potion Of Necrotic Resistance.name:
我喝下我的死灵抗力药水
I Drink My Potion Of Necrotic Resistance

Text.text:
药剂入口涩得发紧，可那股苦与灼烧很快退去，紧随其后的是沁凉的洁净感……以及一种笃定：腐化再也无法在我体内扎根。
The potion has an astringent taste, but the bitterness and burning is soon followed by a cool, cleansing sensation… and a confidence that corruption cannot find root within me any longer.

Dungeon: Staircase Leading Down.name:
地城：通往下方的楼梯
Dungeon: Staircase Leading Down

Text.text:
地面渐渐让位于一段平缓的长阶，沿着柔和的坡度一路向下，通往地城深处。台阶上满是岁月与脚步留下的划痕，你脚下石面曾经的瑕疵早已被磨得圆滑无痕。随着下行，空气仿佛悄然变冷，地城的阴影也愈发浓重。
The floor gives way to a gentle slope of long stairs leading down into the depths of the dungeon. The steps are scarred with marks of use, any imperfections in the stone beneath your feet long ago worn smooth. The air seems to grow slightly colder in the descent, and the dungeon slightly darker.

Bugbear Battle: Victory.name:
熊地精战斗：胜利
Bugbear Battle: Victory

Text.text:
你们赢下了这场战斗。熊地精不是逃了，就是死了，或是倒在地上奄奄一息。外头仅剩的零星残兵，一边龇牙咆哮、一边舔舐伤口，或许还会再度发起一次攻击，但眼下它们已然溃散，士气全无、阵脚大乱。你长长吐出一口气，转头望向己方，确认还有谁仍能站立，又有谁需要援助。
You’ve won the battle. The bugbears have fled, are dead, or lie dying. What few remain out there, snarling as they lick their wounds, might mount another attack, but for now they’ve run, dispirited and disorganized. You heave a sigh of relief and look to your own to see who still stands and who might require aid.

这把一手半剑的宽阔剑身，品质与分量都恰到好处；你敢打赌，只需一记劈斩，就能轻易斩断——甚至将一把普通士兵的佩剑一分为二。事实上，光是把玩这柄精工好剑，就足以让你生出这样的冲动——只要你不介意得罪那位士兵。
The broad blade of this hand-and-a-half is of sufficient quality and weight that a chopping stroke would easily sunder or even bisect a common soldier’s sword, you would wager. In fact, simply handling this fine sword puts you in a mood to do just that, so long as you do not mind offending said soldier.

这根法杖约七英尺长，粗得需要一只大手才能稳稳握住；由法术淬炼的陶瓷制成，中空。两端各有一圈细小针孔，像舱门般开合。杖身半灌清水，使其在近身搏斗时前端更具份量与冲势。水亦被施以魔法，可随口令激发多种奇效：可沸可凝，可净化为饮用之水，亦可自开启的针孔喷射而出——甚至让一间小屋充满蒸汽。
About seven feet long and thick enough to require a large hand, the staff is spell-hardened ceramic and hollow. At each end are rings of tiny pinholes that open and shut like hatches. It is half filled with water, which gives it forward weight and momentum in physical combat. The water is also enchanted to produce various magical effects on command. It can boil or freeze, purify for drinking, or spray from the open pinholes—even fill a small room with steam.

Fantasy Candy Shop.name:
奇幻糖果铺
Fantasy Candy Shop

Text.text:
墙面仿佛活着般不断流动，旋卷着糖霜、巧克力、糖浆与甜酒。某个时刻，墙上鼓起一个气泡，可能只有一枚硬币的大小，也可能大到一只杯垫；随后它自我塑形，像一颗利口酒糖那样轻轻一拧便成形，或像棒棒糖那样一旋便绘出绚丽的纹路。每面墙上成百上千次，糖果从鼓泡中涌出又坠落，叮当滑入通往陈列柜台的锡制滑槽。它们最终整齐地躺在托盘里，置于悬浮的展示柜中，在魔法灯光下熠熠生辉。

~ 一位英雄 所构想

The surfaces of the walls are in motion, whirling with icings, chocolates, sugar solutions, and liqueurs. At some point, a bubble forms on the wall, the size of a dime or the size of a coaster, and then shapes itself with the little twist of a cordial or paints itself with a twirl like a lollipop. Hundreds of times per wall the candies bubble up and drop into tin chutes that travel to the display counters. They appear in neatly ordered trays in hovering display cases under magical lights.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Armory In Building.name:
建筑内军械库
Armory In Building

Text.text:
这间小小的房室里，墙边一排排武器与弹药整齐陈列；同类装备的支架与木桶又在室内排出一条条过道：箭矢、长矛、盾牌成堆，还有一副架子托着长剑与战斧。远墙下并排放着三只大箱子，上方的托架里塞满了长柄武器。
Racks of weapons and ammunition line the walls of this small chamber, while stands and barrels of similar equipment form aisles: arrows, spears, and shields aplenty, along with a frame holding swords and axes. Three large chests line the far wall under a bracket filled with polearms.

Cove With Docks For Mind Flayer Boats.name:
设有码头的海湾，用于停泊夺心魔船只
Cove With Docks For Mind Flayer Boats

Text.text:
浅灰色的海水掀起沮丧的浪头，拍打着一艘异星飞船那有机质的船体。在这阴沉的海湾里，岩石被凿刻成粗陋的码头，供更多令人不安的畸形怪船停泊。

~ 构想 by Rexx

Shallow gray water laps in despondent waves against the organic hull of an alien vessel. In the dismal oceanic cove, the rock has been sculpted into rudimentary docks for more of the unsettling aberrant ships.

~ Envisioned by Rexx

Trendy Mall-based Implant Store.name:
潮流商场植入体专卖店
Trendy Mall-based Implant Store

Text.text:
明亮的霓虹映衬着店门口广告里的人群。一名女子笑得灿烂夺目，她的有机眼球被取出，取而代之的是一枚义体植入物的机械构件——齿轮与金属部件盘旋着钻入眼窝。流行乐从扬声器里震耳欲聋地轰鸣，逼得店员只能扯着嗓子，向凑近的顾客喊出各式植入体的参数与规格。
Bright neon backs the people in the advertisements at the front of the store. One woman smiles radiantly as her organic eye is removed, replaced by the mechanical workings of a cybernetic implant swirling into the socket. Pop music blares from speakers, forcing the staff to shout the specifications of various implants to interested customers.

Dragon Bone Necklace.name:
龙骨项链
Dragon Bone Necklace

Text.text:
古老的化石獠牙与新近拔下的象牙獠牙在这串龙骨项链上交错相缠，其间点缀着斑斓的珠子。它在你手中轻若无物，却以一根朴素的皮绳承载着亿万年的沉重；其中汇聚的巨龙史诗令人震撼得近乎不可思议。
Ancient, fossilized fangs mingle with their freshly pulled ivory counterparts on the dragon bone necklace, punctuated by colorful beads. Though light in your hands, the necklace carries the weight of eons upon a simple leather cord, the draconic history compiled within being nothing short of astounding.

I Lucid Dream To An Aquatic Realm.name:
我在清明梦中坠入水栖之境
I Lucid Dream To An Aquatic Realm

Text.text:
在梦里，我双臂交叉抱在胸前，任由自己向后倒去。本该狠狠摔在地上的瞬间，背部却以一声巨响砸进水里，水花四溅。我彻底沉入一片水的国度，可梦中的我却能从容呼吸。我抬头望向原以为会在遥远天空中摇曳的太阳所在之处，映入眼帘的却只有无边无际的水，直至视线尽头。幽蓝的青绿光浸透一切，却找不到任何明确的光源。
In my dream, I cross my arms over my chest and let myself fall backwards. Rather than crashing to the ground, my back strikes water with a loud splash. I’m fully submerged in a watery realm, but my dream self breathes comfortably. I look up to where I expect to see a wavering sun in a distant sky, but there is only water as far as the eye can see. A turquoise light suffuses it with no distinguishable source.

I Blow My Horn Of Valhalla.name:
我吹响瓦尔哈拉号角
I Blow My Horn Of Valhalla

Text.text:
我握住冰冷的金属，将号角举到唇边。它弯如公牛的角、野猪的獠牙，向上回旋，抵达那宽阔号口外一圈古旧的边缘。那是远古世界的大胆锻纹——绳索与浪涛、麋鹿与长船——在表面起伏成触手可及的纹理。它的声音在石砌大厅里回荡成一记清冽的长鸣，感召战争之灵，他们一个接一个现身。那些身影既有形又超脱尘世：披熊皮、束狼带，肌肉虬结，战意逼人的目光灼灼，眼中盛着他们生前以血与铁换来的永恒荣光。
I hold the cold metal and lift the horn to my lips. It curves like a bull’s horn or boar’s tusk, turning upward to an old rim around its wide mouth. Bold hammer work of the ancient world—ropes and waves, elk and ship—is textured onto its surface. Its voice is a ringing tone of the stone hall, calling the spirits of war, who appear one by one. They are material but otherworldly, bear-shirted and wolf-belted, muscled, glaring with battle eyes full of the eternal glory they earned in life.

Stone Couatl Icons.name:
石质羽蛇神图标
Stone Couatl Icons

Text.text:
这无疑是出于至诚的奉献之举：这座神庙的建造者在入口两侧竖起了两尊巨大的羽蛇圣像，守护般分立其旁。它们足有常人三倍之高，巨大的寇阿特石像在有限的石质体量中被雕琢到极致的细密。建造者并未用终将褪色剥落的颜料点染，而是将半宝石橄榄石镶嵌进每尊石像的羽冠，打磨成羽毛与鳞片的形状，光泽如同凝固的翠绿。可这份匠心终究至少有一部分付诸徒然——左侧那尊已从基座上倾倒，身躯横陈在神庙顶层平台之上，头颅与躯干分离。
In what was no doubt an act of utter devotion, the builders of this temples raised two prodigious icons of the feathered serpents themselves to flank the entrance to their temple. Fully three times the height of a human, the couatl statues were carved with as much detail as their stone shapes would contain. Instead of being picked out with paint that would eventually fade and chip over time, the plumed crest of each statue has been inlaid with semiprecious peridot fashioned to resemble feathers and scale. Yet, the great care the builders took was at least partially in vain, as the statue on the left has toppled from its pedestal, its length laid out across the temple’s top platform, the head separated from the body.

I Cast Passwall.name:
我施放了【穿墙术】
I Cast Passwall

Text.text:
我像獾刨山坡般用爪子抓挠墙壁，墙体却轻易崩解。起初我的手法看上去一团糟，但很快，一道拱门就在我头顶成形，显出通往另一侧的通道。碎屑残块自行滚拢，彼此熔合进通道两侧，替我把路让得干干净净。我退后一步，欣赏自己的杰作——双手纤尘不染，却仍被魔法的余韵刺得微微发麻。
I claw at the wall like a badger at a hill, and it gives away with ease. Though my method appears messy at first, an archway quickly rises above my head, revealing a passage to the other side. The bits of debris roll together and meld into the sides of the passage, keeping the way clear. I step back and admire my work—my hands clean but still tingling with magic.

Dive Bar With Aggressive Speed Metal Mus.name:
播放着攻击性速度金属的地下酒吧
Dive Bar With Aggressive Speed Metal Music

Text.text:
这首歌就是一次攻击。鼓点从音箱里如暴雨般砸落，试图压过尖啸的吉他与破碎嘶哑的人声。这个破酒吧里的常客看起来如鱼得水，身披破烂的黑衣，在廉价酒水长长一口的间隙里，随着底层节拍的律动按着时代点头。
The song is an attack. Drumbeats rain from the speakers, trying to overpower the screeching guitar and ragged vocals. The patrons of the dive bar seem right at home, dressed in their tattered black and moving their heads in time to the underlying beat between long pulls at their cheap drinks.

Dome Of The Great Mausoleum.name:
大陵寝之穹顶
Dome Of The Great Mausoleum

Text.text:
穹顶上镶嵌的金饰与深邃的绿松石瓦片在设计上举世无双，仿佛神祇与建筑师暗中合谋，在这座死亡之宫里以此荣耀自身。上层是他们的楼层，他们的圣像俯瞰着被祝圣的亡者，循着道路走向地下的海。
The gold inlay and deep turquoise tile of the dome are peerless in design, as if the gods conspired with the architects and so honor themselves in this palace of demise. The upper floor is their floor, their icons looking down on the consecrated dead making their way to the hypogean sea.

烟灰熏染的皮围裙像盖在马车上的篷布般覆着铁匠的尸体，一柄沉重的铁锤还搁在他们摊开的手中。一截短刃从他们背后突兀地刺出。铁匠的肌肉坚硬如淬火钢铁，然而到头来，却被阴谋与卑怯的偷袭所放倒。
The soot-stained leather apron drapes the blacksmith’s corpse like a tarp atop a wagon, and a weighty hammer rests in their open hand. A small blade juts out from their back. The smith’s muscles were hard as tempered steel, yet in the end they were laid low by subterfuge and simple cowardice.

Employee Commuting To Bland Office Job.name:
员工通勤去那份乏味的办公室工作
Employee Commuting To Bland Office Job

Text.text:
一个身影——身高普通、各方面都普通——弓着背站着，埋头在通讯板上摆弄设置。他是量产型的公司社畜，无数个清晨赶着早高峰通勤的人之一。昨晚狂刷最新视频卡带又灌啤酒，眼睛还浮着困倦的血丝。身上是沉闷的衬衫，五件一包打折买的。棕色头发乱得像被揉过——说真的，谁他妈还会在乎这份工作？换汤不换药，一天又一天。
A figure—average height, average everything—stands hunched over his comm pad, fiddling with the settings. He's a mass-market corpo drone, one of so many up early for the rush-hour commute. Bleary eyes from a night of binging the latest vid cartridges and beer. Dreary shirt, bought in packs of five for a discount price. Messy brown hair because—let’s face it—who really gives a fuck about this job? Same shit, different day.

他翠绿的皮肤上点缀着紫水晶般的鳞片，一路沿着脊背延展。以他的族裔而言，他个子相当高挑，金发披肩，长久如新，仿佛永远带着刚被晨光拂过的光泽。他明亮的精灵眼与惊艳的地精耳始终警觉，在朋友身旁守望——以海姆之名，他们的守护者。身披他用锅碗瓢盆拼凑锻成的护甲，他追随一缕唯有自己能看见的命运丝线。卸下警戒时，他便神游天外，戴着那条魔法头带，啜饮山羊奶，沉浸在这段迷人生命当下的璀璨里。

~ Played by Wark55 with

His verdant skin is touched with amethyst scales that run down his back. For his race he is quite tall, and his golden hair long and somehow always new looking. His bright elvish eyes and spectacular goblin ears are ever vigilant, as he stands watch over his friends—their protector, by Helm. In the armor he fashioned from pots and pans, he follows a thread of fate only he can see. When he is off watch he daydreams, wearing his magical headband, drinking goat’s milk, and living in the present brilliance of his fascinating life.

~ Played by Wark55 with

J'zargo The Warlock.name:
术士杰扎戈
J'zargo The Warlock

Text.text:
这名虎斑毛色的猫人举止轻松又带着几分顽皮，尖牙一笑便自然浮上猫科的面庞，翡翠般的绿眼角随之微微皱起。他在贴身的皮质护甲外披着斗篷与兜帽，磨得发旧的材质让他能在严酷的地形上自如移动。猫人那带爪的双手握着一根灰白如烬的木杖。就像它的持有者一样，这根法杖低低嗡鸣，蕴着克制而内敛的力量。

~ 由 Tate 扮演

This tabby-furred catfolk carries himself with a playful ease, a fanged grin coming quickly and easily to his feline features, crinkling the corners of his jade-green eyes. He wears a cloak and hood over tight-fitting leather armor, the well-worn material allowing for ease of movement across harsh terrain. In his clawed hands, the catfolk carries a staff of gray, ashen wood. Much like its wielder, the staff thrums with a subdued power.

~ Played by Tate

Three Cyclopes From Afar.name:
远处的三名独眼巨人
Three Cyclopes From Afar

Text.text:
即便沙漠沙丘上翻涌的热浪扭曲了视线，你仍瞥见几道高耸的身影正向你逼近。三个，外形近似人形，却足有三个人那么高。他们将带倒刺的巨棒扛在肩上；待他们走得更近，你看清他们每个额头正中央都嵌着一只独眼——那是寻常生物本该有两只眼的位置。

~ 设想：Elliott Crawford

Even through the heat haze wavering off the desert dunes, you spy the towering figures stalking toward you. Three of them, humanoid in appearance, but standing as tall as three humans. They heft barbed clubs over their shoulders, and as they grow closer, you see they each have a single eye in the center of their forehead where a typical creature would have two.

~ Envisioned by Elliott Crawford

新生的半身人骨架敦实，脚背与脚趾上零星覆着一层细毛。他们一落地便急切地寻求乳食，把手指、脚趾，乃至身边能碰到的一切都往嘴里塞。
The newborn halfling has a stout frame and a smattering of hair across their feet and toes. They immediately seek nourishment, sticking fingers, toes, and anything nearby into their mouth.

狂野之力在你体内堆叠翻涌。它自你胸口升起，渐渐发烫，沿着四肢蔓延，直达指尖与脚趾。就在那扭动不驯的力量几乎要将你的躯体撑裂之际，你猛然一击地面。伴随一声惊雷般的爆响，力量化作浪潮自你体内奔涌而出。大地在你脚下开裂崩断，裂缝向外迅速扩散；声与毁灭的浪潮席卷你的敌人，撕裂血肉与骨骼，震破耳膜，击碎武器与护甲。
Power untamed builds. It rises in you, growing warm in your chest and extending through your limbs, to the tips of your fingers and toes. Just as the writhing power seems too much for your body to contain, you strike the ground. And with a thunderclap the power leaves you in a wave. The ground splits, sundering beneath you, the cracks spreading outward as the wave of sound and destruction washes over your opponents, rending flesh and bone, rupturing ears, shattering weapons and armor.

主路掠过十字路口，径直钻入林影之中；那片森林仿佛随着土路的延伸而不断膨胀，愈发粗野。另一侧的田地由庄稼渐渐换成牧场，篱墙之外传来牛群遥远而低沉的哞鸣。
The main road runs past the crossroads and into the shadow of a forest that seems to grow in size and wildness as the dirt lane travels on. The fields on the others side switch from crops to pastures, and beyond the hedgerow you hear the distant lowing of cattle.

巨大的伞菌夹立在石径两侧，从巍然的猩红巨根之间破土而出。它们散发着金色的辉光，仿佛还有一阵古怪的嗡鸣自其中荡开，和谐而悠远。前方道路分岔，一段石阶向上隐没而去，尽头有一道凶烈的蓝光在等待。
Massive toadstools flank the stone path, sprouting between immense crimson roots. They emit a luminous, golden glow, and a strange hum seems to emanate from them, harmonious. Ahead, the path branches off, and a set of stone stairs disappear upward, to where a fierce blue glow awaits.

I Pilot A Flying Board.name:
我驾驶一块飞行板
I Pilot A Flying Board

Text.text:
以惊人的速度疾驰而过，肾上腺素在我体内奔涌，那股冲击令人沉醉。我操控着滑板，天际线在眼前化作一片模糊的残影，清晰地意识到自己正在冒多大的风险。一步踏错，我这副残破的身躯就得从下方的水泥地上被人刮下来。可若不站在边缘，你真的算活着吗？
Hurtling along at incredible speed, the rush of the adrenaline pumping through me is intoxicating. The skyline is a blur as I pilot my board, keenly aware of the risk I am taking. One wrong move and my broken body will need to be scraped off the concrete below. But are you really living if you’re not on the edge?

I Scale A Coastal Cliff.name:
我攀上海岸峭壁
I Scale A Coastal Cliff

Text.text:
海鸟的啼鸣在我身周嶙峋的礁岩间回荡，我沿着参差破碎、风化崩落的峭壁艰难向上攀登。清冽的海风迎面猛扑而来，裹挟着下方咸涩海水的飞沫刺痛我的双眼。浪涛不知疲倦地撞击着崖壁。
The cries of seabirds echo from the craggy rocks around me as I make my way up the jagged, crumbling cliff. A fresh ocean breeze pummels me, stinging my eyes with the spray from the salty waters below. Waves crash relentlessly against the cliffside.

Plea From A Refugee For Aid.name:
一名难民的求援呼声
Plea From A Refugee For Aid

Text.text:
“死亡与毁灭吞噬了我们的城市。街道上满是死者渗出的油脂，湿滑黏腻。求求你们，若你们之中还有人能战斗，这座崩塌城墙之内仍有零星的生命据点——那些无辜之人仍在守护我们家园渐息的心跳。请去救救他们。”
“Death and ruin have taken our city. The streets are slick with the grease of the dead. Please, if any among you can fight, there are still a few pockets of life left within its crumbling walls—innocents who keep alive the fading heart of our home. Please help them.”

Expensive Sushi Platter Meal.name:
昂贵的寿司拼盘套餐
Expensive Sushi Platter Meal

Text.text:
半机械女侍将食物摆到你面前时微微欠身，盘中如同一幅艺术品。每一份精巧的分量都是根源与科技的交融，风味与口感的拼接混合，足以撩拨人的味蕾。标出的价格高得近乎敲诈，但对那些常来这间酒馆的名流来说，为一次超越常规的体验付出这点代价，不过是微不足道的价格。
The cyborg waitress bows as she places the food in front of you, art on a plate. Each delicate portion is a fusion of tradition and technology, an amalgam of flavors and textures to excite one's palate. The price tag is extortionate, but for the socialites who frequent this saloon, it's a tiny price to pay for an experience that transcends the norm.

Armored Van Plows Through Construction Z.name:
装甲厢式货车犁开施工区
Armored Van Plows Through Construction Zone

Text.text:
混凝土碎块向外炸裂，像陨石般在空中翻滚；面包车碾过涂着危害条纹的护栏，工人们扑向掩蔽。那头披甲的巨兽在施工区里横冲直撞，身后只剩彻底的毁灭；驾驶员拼命想甩掉后方紧追不舍的警车。
Concrete chunks explode outward, tumbling through the air like meteors as the van plows through the hazard-striped barrier and workers dive for cover. The armored behemoth careens through the construction zone, leaving utter devastation in its wake as the driver desperately tries to escape the police cars behind them.

弓弦嗡然作响，箭矢扎进草靶，发出空洞的噗咚声。这处射程设有三面靶子，专为想精进短弓与弩具技能的人提供挑战。落箭散满地面，断裂的箭杆与磨损的羽翎混在泥土里。 Bowstrings twang, and arrows sink into hay targets with hollow thunks. The range, outfitted with three targets, offers a challenge to those seeking to improve their skill with short bows and crossbows. Fallen arrows litter the ground, splintered shafts and frayed feathers mingling in the dirt.

起初只是一缕气息，像针尖般在你的感官边缘轻轻发痒。很快，它变成一种令人作呕的甜腻气味，让你不由自主地流口水，仿佛身体正要把上一顿的残余全都呕出来。一阵声响——笑声、咳嗽声、咕噜声——在墙壁间回荡；随后你看见它：一颗山羊头从黑暗中探出，正盯着你。那颗头开始上升，随着它站起——升到四英尺、五英尺、六英尺。它血淋淋的巨口与双手饥饿而痛楚地张合，仿佛几个月未曾进食。一条带着恶毒倒刺的尾巴缠绕在它毛茸茸、兽性的腿上，滴落黏稠的毒液，迫不及待要刺入血肉。它打量你时，脓疱渗出浊液；从它眼中癫狂的神色来看，它已经得出结论。
It starts as a whiff, a scent tingling at the edge of your senses. It becomes a wretchedly sweet smell that makes you drool as if your body is about to purge itself of its last meal. A noise—laughter, coughing, gurgling—echoes across the walls; then you see it, a goat’s head peering at you from the darkness. The head begins to rise as it stands—rising four, five, six feet. Its blood-soaked maw and hands flex hungrily and painfully, as if it hasn't eaten in months. A wickedly barbed tail wraps around its hairy, animalistic legs, dripping with viscous venom eager to penetrate flesh. Pustules ooze as it sizes you up, and by the crazed look in its eyes, it has reached its conclusion.

Exiting Through A Malfunctioning Airlock.name:
通过故障的气闸逃离
Exiting Through A Malfunctioning Airlock

Text.text:
你踏入故障的气闸舱时，身后的船内舱门砰然合拢，金属尖啸刺耳作响，像是不祥的警报，昭示着它此刻的状态。很长一段时间里，什么都没有发生。你等待着那标志性的嘶嘶声——压力开始平衡，意味着你已安全——而寂静却如浓雾般灌满舱室。仿佛过了漫长的永恒，熟悉的泄压声终于在室内回荡，随后外侧舱门缓缓滑开。
The interior doors of the ship close noisily behind you as you enter the malfunctioning airlock, their metallic screeching a worrying indicator of its current functionality. For a long moment nothing happens. Silence fills the cabin like a dense fog as you wait for the telltale hiss of the pressure equalizing—signaling your safety. After what seems like an eternity, the familiar sound of decompression fills the room, then the external doors slide open.

I Cast Cone Of Cold.name:
我施放寒冰锥
I Cast Cone Of Cold

Text.text:
这些话我已经念过无数遍。它们相当简单，顺口易念。真正需要我全神贯注的是姿势成分：引导这枚小水晶的形态，在脑海里先把那道锥形的轮廓比划成形，直到我在掌心里感到法术的刺痛——冰冷——冻结。终于，那道蓝白色的霜锥开始凝出，水汽从其上缭绕翻卷。它猛然迸射而出，向前六十尺，铺开成一扇宽阔而致命的寒霜之幕。即便一个强大法术的消耗正从我体内抽离，我仍因那一瞬的释放而热血沸腾。
I’ve spoken these words many times. They’re fairly simple, easy on the tongue. It’s the somatic component that demands my focus, channeling the form of this little crystal, gesturing the cone into being in my mind before I feel the spell in my hands, stinging. Freezing. Finally, the cone of blue-white frost begins to emerge, water vapor curling from it. It fires out, sixty feet forward and in a wide, deadly fan. I am exhilarated despite the drain of a major spell leaving me.

温步·巧指头顶那一抹刺眼的雪白发丝，被无形之风拂动——那风如轻柔的波纹起伏，仿佛正从这位风裔元素本身悄然逸出。他粉蓝色的肌肤承接着日光的金辉，映出近乎水晶般的质感；健美的身形裹在一套匠心独运的皮革护甲中，染作黄玉与紫罗兰的层叠色调，边缘以银与黄铜细细收束。天空般湛蓝的眼眸里闪着笃定的自信，目光却总在他人的武器、护甲与衣装间游走，冷静衡量其做工与品相。腰侧安放着一柄华美繁复的匕首，两侧则伴着铁匠的工具。

~ 由 Nathan Played

The stark white hair atop Windstep Lightfinger’s head ripples with an unseen wind—a softly undulating air that seems to emanate from the windblooded elemental himself. His skin, powder blue, catches the golden gleam of the sun to take on an almost crystalline quality, and his athletic form is wrapped by masterfully crafted leather armor, dyed shades of topaz and violet, trimmed with silver and brass. A steadfast confidence shines in his sky-blue eyes, which roam always over the weapons, armor, and clothing of others, assessing quality. A beautifully ornate dagger rests upon his hip, flanked by the tools of a smith.

~ Played by Nathan

I Cast A Blinding Light With My Gem Of B.name:
我用光辉宝石放出一道致盲强光
I Cast A Blinding Light With My Gem Of Brightness

Text.text:
空气中渐渐响起一阵哀怨的嗡鸣，宝石开始以脉动的能量泛起光芒。待那声音攀至顶点，宝石骤然爆裂，迸发出炫目的强光——宛如从苍穹摘下的一颗星辰——逼得近旁众人纷纷抬臂遮眼。
A whining hum builds in the air as the gem begins to glow with pulsing energy. When the noise reaches a crescendo, the gem erupts in a dazzling flash of light—like a star plucked from the heavens—causing those nearby to shield their eyes.

Contaminated Ruined City.name:
污染的毁城
Contaminated Ruined City

Text.text:
一座曾经辉煌的城市废墟在你面前铺展开来。灰色的石制建筑群，带着另一个时代的建筑风格，如今不是残破断裂，便是崩塌成瓦砾。刺鼻的化学气味笼罩着这片区域，诡异的蓝绿光点在空气中漂浮穿行。它们发出微弱的嗡鸣声，若有几粒飘得太近，便会让你的头发一阵发麻，根根竖起。你继续前行，疲惫愈发沉重，眼皮仿佛在哀求你合上。然而，即使你坐下休息，思绪也拒绝沉静，身体更是止不住地烦躁扭动。

~ Matt Black 构想

The ruins of a once impressive city sprawl before you. Its gray stone buildings, their architecture out of a different time, stand broken or crumbling to rubble. A pungent chemical smell overlays the area, and strange blue and green motes float through the air. These emit a faint buzzing sound, and cause your hair to prickle and stand on end if they waft too close. As you carry on, you grow wearier, your eyes begging to be shut. But, even if you sit to rest, your mind refuses quiet and your body cannot stop fidgeting.

~ Envisioned by Matt Black

浓雾凝滞如玄武岩板；透过雾气，隐约可见一块玄武岩巨板仿佛自天坠落，砰然一声闷响。巨翼鼓动与低沉嗓音的回响随那一瞬的错觉起落远近。巨板上的龙族符文霎时迸发电光。究竟哪些是幻象已难分辨——雾气仍带着电荷，空气里满是暴风雨将至的气息。
Fog remains still as a basalt slab, barely visible through it, seems to fall from the sky with a thud. The sound of giant wings and a deep voice rise and recede with that impression. Draconic runes on the slab briefly flare with lightning. It’s hard to tell what was illusion—the mist remains charged and smelling of a storm.

Small Unit Tactics: Counter Peel.name:
小队战术：反向剥离
Small Unit Tactics: Counter Peel

Text.text:
50口径子弹啃噬着你的掩蔽，你一边俯身躲闪，一边怒吼下令脱离。Alpha从废墟间猛然回撤，榨干每一寸掩蔽的价值；Bravo无畏固守阵地，泼洒压制火力掩护撤退。遭遇骤然炸裂成一场倒着下的混乱棋局，你们的撤离是精算后的冒险。敌人愚蠢地追击，自以为已将你击溃……却一头撞进你的陷阱，盲目而狼狈。

~ 一位英雄构想

Ducking as 50 cal rounds chew up your cover, you roar the order to peel off. Alpha surges back through the ruins, exploiting every scrap of cover; Bravo bravely holds ground, laying down covering fire. The encounter erupts into a hectic chess match in reverse, your team’s withdrawal a calculated risk. The foe stupidly gives chase, thinking they have broken you… and stumbling blindly into your trap.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

作为法术的最后一个手势，你咬了一口手中的食物，把剩下的递向那只动物。刹那间，生物平静下来。它并不取食，只是怯生生地打量你一眼，随即自顾自忙活起来，仿佛你根本不在场。
As the last gesture of the spell, you take a bite of the food in your hand and hold the rest out to the animal. Instantly, the creature calms. It doesn’t take the food, but regards you diffidently then goes about its business as if you were not there.

Velociraptors Using Pack Tactics.name:
运用群猎战术的迅猛龙
Velociraptors Using Pack Tactics

Text.text:
利爪叩击岩石的咔嗒声，是猎手来临的唯一征兆。迅疾而悄无声息，宛如闷覆而至的死亡，一群凶残、披羽的蜥蜴兽绕行盘旋，将你围得水泄不通。它们以粗壮的鸟类后肢挺立至肩高，前肢末端覆着剃刀般的利爪。野蛮的獠牙在狼群般的齐整节奏中咔咔作响，它们滑步逼近，开始编织你的终局。
The clicking of claws on rock is the only hint of the hunters’ arrival. Swift and soft as smothering death, the pack of vicious, plumed saurians circles and surrounds you. They stand shoulder high on thick avian legs and bear forelimbs capped by razor claws. Their barbarous fangs clack in lupine synchronicity as they glide forward to begin your end.

Oracle In The Net.name:
网中神谕
Oracle In The Net

Text.text:
在以太领域之中，她以占卜者之姿君临，宣讲至高算法的信条。数据洪流淹没她的感官，在熵乱之海里寻得预言的丝线。自破碎的代码中，预测绽放成花，使她得以引领她的信众。如同织工，她的手轻拨织机，编织命运之布，让它倾向她所拣选的人。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

Inside the etheric realm, she reigns as augur, preaching the almighty algorithm’s credo. Data floods her senses, finding threads of prophecy in the entropic. From fragmented code, predictions bloom, allowing her to guide her faithful. Like a weaver, her hand nudges the loom, weaving fate’s fabric to favor her chosen.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Ceremony Of Luck With Coins.name:
钱币祈运仪式
Ceremony Of Luck With Coins

Text.text:
馥郁的香料熏香为咸涩的海风染上一层怡人的芬芳；女祭司步履笃定地绕着船甲板行走，手中香炉倾吐缕缕烟雾。她绕行着三名女子——她们各自将一枚璀璨非凡的水晶捧在摊开的掌心，双手高举向天，以崇敬之姿献上赞颂。吟诵声落定后，女祭司命令水手们跪伏在她面前。随后，她依次从每位女子手中取走水晶，转而放上一枚金灿的钱币。钱币两面皆铸着一位光华夺目的女子：一面含笑，一面蹙眉——昭示命运的两面性。

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Fragrant incense tinges the salty air with a pleasing aroma as the priest strides confidently around the deck of the ship, her censer pouring smoke. She circles three women, each nurturing a magnificent crystal in her open hands, which are raised to the skies in adulation. As her chanting concludes, the priest bids the sailors to kneel before her. In turn she takes the crystal from each woman, replacing it with a golden coin. The coins bear the image of a resplendent woman on both sides, one smiling, the other frowning—highlighting the duality of fate.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Frozen World Setting.name:
冰封世界设定
Frozen World Setting

Text.text:
黑暗渐褪，柔和的黎明前微光漫开，揭开一片近乎单色的天地。第一缕光掠过黝黑的石质群山，将灰色染成橙褐相间的虎纹；然而太阳色谱带来的视觉暖意，并未立刻改变地表的温度。拂晓拉长的影子让冰原的隐秘肌理骤然清晰：巨大的多边形冰板、蓝冰冰川托着如冰山般的庞巨巨石，还有偶尔出现的平滑冻湖，湖面覆着被狂风抽打成泡沫般的雪霜。

当刺骨的白昼吞没更为酷寒的夜晚，掠食者开始骚动。飞行者最先接到清晨的讯息，从高耸的雪冠群山俯冲——又振翅高翔。很快，更多猎手自洞口、岩窟与冰裂隙中现身，急切地循着猎物夜间的旅行痕迹追踪。另一处，披毛的食草兽群起身抖落一夜蜷伏留下的残雪，开始在冻结的世界里沉重跋涉；它们纠结的毛毡般外衣上共生着地衣与其他植物，使兽群远望如一座缓慢移动的丘陵。一名哨探在冰下的某处地下聚居地里，以魔法远观兽群的动向。

地下居所的烟囱刺破冰面，吐出稳定的烟柱，如同不熄的信标。在这些隐蔽的穴巢里，地热与加热魔法与夜火并行。清晨带给熬得眼眶发涩的司火者些许解脱；他们与一支正为多日远征做准备的类人生物小队擦肩而过。若运气好，这群人将从野兽身上收集兽皮、骨骼、肉与粪便——或发现别的东西，用以巩固他们的社群。完成保存仪式后，他们扣紧装备的绑带，将护目镜拉到眼前，沿着通道攀上地表，把聚居地清冷的灯光换成明亮而苦寒的冰封世界。

Darkness fades into a soft pre-dawn illumination, unveiling a seemingly monochromatic landscape. The first rays of light over the dark stone mountains paint the gray an orange brindle, but the visual warmth of the solar palette has no immediate effect on the surface temperature. Elongated shadows of daybreak bring the hidden textures of the ice plain into focus: great polygonal plates, blue-ice glaciers carrying massive boulders like icebergs, and occasional smooth, frozen lakes topped with a wind-whipped meringue of snow.

As the frigid day overtakes the even colder night, predators stir. Fliers, first to receive morning’s message, fall—then soar—from the high snow-capped mountains. Soon, other hunters emerge from openings, caverns and crevasses, eager to track the night’s travel of their prey. Elsewhere, herds of woolly herbivores rise and shake off the snowy remnants of their overnight huddle. They begin a laborious plod across the frozen world, giving the impression of a moving hill thanks to the symbiotic lichens and other plants that grow on their matted coats. A spotter magically scries on the herd’s movements from one of the underground settlements below the ice.

Chimneys poke up from subterranean habitations, issuing steady beacons of smoke. In these hidden warrens, geothermal energy and heating magics work in tandem with the night-fires. Morning brings relief to the bleary-eyed fire-stokers. They pass a small party of humanoids preparing for a days-long expedition. With luck, the group will collect hides, bones, meat, and dung from the fauna—or discover something else to fortify their community. Their ritual of preservation complete, they secure their equipment straps, pull goggles over their eyes, and ascend to the surface, trading the cool lights of town for the bright and bitter frozen world.

这位外交官身着剪裁得体的礼装，却并不张扬或浮夸。朴素而利落的发型与其沉稳平静的气度相得益彰；鼻梁上架着一副眼镜，镜片后那双眼睛不动声色地游移打量着四周。
The diplomat wears a well-tailored dress, but not in a gaudy or outspoken fashion. Their understated but prim hairstyle pairs well with an even, calm demeanor, and their eyes roam from behind a pair of spectacles perched on their nose.

I Cast Invisibility.name:
我施放隐形术
I Cast Invisibility

Text.text:
我用双手为我的目标取景，掌心相对，将其圈在两掌之间，仿佛肖像边缘的暗角。魔法——阴影、光芒、棱彩般的流光骤雨——在我掌间汇聚，闪烁生辉。随着我合拢双手，我的目标开始消失。他们的身体与衣物渗出、铺散进环境之中，继而融化殆尽，化作虚无。
I frame my target with my hands, enclosing them between my palms like the vignette of a portrait. Magic—shadow, light, prismatic showers—gathers and glitters in my hands. As I close my hands together, my target begins to disappear. Their body and clothes seep and spread into the environment before melting away into nothing.

Sundries From A Troglodyte.name:
穴居人杂货摊
Sundries From A Troglodyte

Text.text:
在这具恶臭生物的尸体上，你找到一个破旧的皮革小袋，里面塞满各式各样的小骨头，一端都被削尖了。也许它随身带着牙签。
On the corpse of the stinking creature, you find a tattered leather pouch filled with an assortment of small bones sharpened at one end. Perhaps it was carrying toothpicks.

Farah Tanous In The Lobby.name:
法拉·塔努斯在大厅
Farah Tanous In The Lobby

Text.text: “照例，能再一次在这里见到诸位来捧场，真是盛大无比。毕竟你们当然也舍不得离开。Marhaba，我的宝贝们，marhaba！” “As always, it’s so grand to see you all here again for another performance. Not that you could stay away, of course. Marhaba, my babies, marhaba!”

一片灰白而平坦的混凝土荒原铺展开来，坑坑洼洼，溅满油渍，昭示着这里便是停车场。各式车辆蜷伏在模糊不清的车位里，像沙丁鱼般挤作一团，纠结成一片车阵死结。污浊的空气里刺鼻的机油味翻涌不散，垃圾在地面上翻滚飘移，宛如风滚草般四处漂荡。
A flat gray expanse of pockmarked, oil-splattered concrete marks the parking lot. Vehicles of all kinds squat in poorly marked spaces, packed in like sardines and forming a vehicular gridlock. The grimy air reeks of motor oil, and litter drifts across the ground like tumbleweed.

大多数狼都喜欢成群结队地旅行，以刺耳的长嚎彼此传讯。然而你用余光瞥见一只灰狼在林木间悄然潜行，尽管你已经好一阵子没听到那样的嚎声了。它那双黄色的眼睛锐利地注视着周遭的一举一动。
Most wolves like to travel in packs, communicating through piercing howls. Yet you catch a gray wolf slinking among the trees out of the corner of your eye, even though you've heard no such calls for some time. Its yellow eyes keenly watch the goings-on in its vicinity.

A Tenday Of Travel By Horse Through A Ch.name:
十日骑马旅行，季节转入盛夏
A Tenday Of Travel By Horse Through A Change To Summer

Text.text:
当你从群山一路下行，春天最后的残影被甩在身后，空气也开始回暖。接下来的几天风平浪静：你偶尔停下，让马饮水；寻到牧人留下的小屋里休息，坐骑就拴在近旁。第五天，一群持械的男人迎面而来，正在追寻一只发狂的狼；他们问你可曾见过那畜生。你摇了摇头，继续沿着山谷前行。远处的农舍零星点缀在葱郁的绿野上，牛铃声随风飘荡。直到第十天你终于抵达目的地，已是汗湿衣襟，只盼着来一杯冰凉的饮料。
The last vestiges of spring fall behind as you make your way down from the mountains, and the air begins to warm. The next few days pass without incident: stopping briefly to give your horse water, finding shepherds' huts in which to rest, your mount tethered nearby. On the fifth day you are approached by a group of armed men seeking a rabid wolf; they ask if you have seen the beast. Shaking your head, you continue down the valley. Distant farms dot the lush green landscape, and the sound of cowbells float in the wind. When you finally reach your destination, on the tenth day, you are sweating and looking forward to a cold drink.

Calm Day At Sea.name:
海上风平浪静的一天
Calm Day At Sea

Text.text:
众人各安其位，从容不迫；船帆向前鼓起，宛如巨鸟的胸脯；甲板在风里渐渐干爽。船底下，海面轻轻起伏，闪烁着湛蓝的光，点点白沫如碎冠，映照着天空，仿佛一面镜子。水手的歌声与海鸥的鸣叫回荡在船身四周，伴着它沿着稳健的航线前行。

~ 一位英雄所Envisioned

Everyone is easy at their stations, the sails curve forward like the breasts of great birds, and the deck is drying in the wind. Under the ship, the sea swells gently in glittering blues and small white caps, a mirror of the sky. The songs of men and the calls of gulls ring out over the craft on its steady course.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Fork In The Road.name:
岔路口
Fork In The Road

Text.text:
一条漫长的土路被车辙碾出深深沟槽，在此分岔成两条道路。一条大致沿着原路的方向延伸，蜿蜒没入林地的阴影，消失在远方。另一条则岔向别处，沿着树林的另一侧延展。岔口处立着一座路旁小神龛，或许是在纪念某个地方旧事，或是一位掌管旅行的神祇。
A long dirt lane, rutted by wagon traffic, splits into two roads. One road roughly follows the direction of the lane, wending off into the distance in the shadow of a woodland. The other road splits off to run on the other side of the wood. A roadside shrine stands where they separate, perhaps commemorating some local event or deity of travel.

Invasion Of Peaceful Kingdom.name:
和平王国的入侵
Invasion Of Peaceful Kingdom

Text.text:
战争巨鼓的轰鸣回荡在这片宁静王国的极乐原野上，天穹也被滚滚浓烟染得昏暗——蛮横的入侵者点燃了边陲农庄，将其付之一炬。逃难的难民队伍在道路上汇聚成列，朝着城墙的庇护狂奔而去；求生的绝望驱使他们以难以置信的速度向前。国王眉头紧锁，眼看疆土燃烧、子民哀求援助，随即下令开启城门。他感召诸位顾问集结，召开战事会议，这位老国王再次整装，准备重返战场。

~ Max_Slacker on Discord

The resonant thunder of war drums rings out across the elysian fields of the peaceful kingdom, and the sky grows dark with plumes of thick smoke as outlying farms are put to the torch by the savage invaders. Columns of fleeing refugees gather on the roads and rush toward the safety of the castle walls, their desperation to survive driving them forward with incredible speed. The king's brow furrows as he watches his lands burn and his people beg for aid, then gives the order to open the gates. Calling for his advisors to assemble a council of war, the old king readies himself for battle once again.

~ Max_Slacker on Discord

在掐下一撮辣椒并触碰红绸之后，你成功施放此法术，会令你的目标跳起舞来。他们会挑选一名不情愿的舞伴并领舞，竭尽所能在不松手的情况下魅惑对方。舞步是一支缓慢的探戈：先向一个方向走四步，骤然转身后再退回四步。魔法的乐声在舞者周围的空气中流淌回荡。
After pinching a chili and touching red silk, your successful casting of this spell causes your target to dance. They choose an unwilling participant and lead, doing their very best to charm their dancing partner without letting go. The dance is a slow tango, four steps in one direction and four back after the abrupt turn. Magical music fills the air around the dancers.

刚换上新弦并打磨抛光，这把时髦的吉他宛如一件静候行家之手的艺术品。饱满的漆面在一层透明清漆下闪耀，如同静谧湖水的粼粼波光；你端详之际，清新的抛光剂气息已浸透琴身。纤尘不染的指板嵌着锃亮的钢条，庄严地延伸至Stratocaster标志性的非对称琴头，弦钮旁以金色骄傲地烙印着制造商的名字。
Freshly restrung and polished, the stylish guitar is a thing of beauty waiting for an expert hand. A blooming finish glistens beneath a coat of clear lacquer, akin to the waters of a tranquil lake, and the scent of fresh polish suffuses the instrument as you admire it. A spotless fretboard inlaid with gleaming steel rises majestically to the iconic, asymmetric headstock of the Stratocaster, with the manufacturer’s name emblazoned proudly in gold beside the machine heads.

这间小屋的墙边排着一列列武器与护甲架——上头压着剑与长矛——每一处都用厚重的铁制托架牢牢固定。内侧墙边靠着一只沉重的箱子——被硕大的挂锁紧紧锁住——角落里还立着几只大木桶。空气里弥漫着一丝铁腥味：武器油膏的金属气息与墙上摇曳灯笼散出的灯油味混在一起，幽幽飘荡。
Weapon and armor racks—laden with swords and spears—line the walls of this small room, each secured by thick, iron brackets. A heavy chest—secured by a weighty padlock—rests against the inside wall and several large barrels stand in one corner. There is a ferrous tang in the air as the weapon polish mingles with the scent of lamp oil from the flickering lantern hanging on the wall.

Demonic Brute Emerging From Forest.name:
从森林中现身的恶魔蛮兽
Demonic Brute Emerging From Forest

Text.text:
这头邪狞的怪物高高耸立在你面前，庞然身躯硬生生挤过林木与灌丛，漫不经心地就将幼树咔嚓折断。它以六肢行走，每一肢末端都生着一簇凶恶利爪，抓裂泥土、撕扯根系，将盘结的树根生生掀出。蛤蟆与巨熊般的诡异拼合体——灰暗而布满鳞片的皮肤外，覆着厚重蓬松的羊毛般长毛——它直起身躯，张开那几乎将椭长头颅从中劈开的巨口，放出一声异界般的咆哮。无数血红的眼睛齐齐锁定你，它抬起其中四肢，准备猛击。

~ 一位英雄 Envisioned

The fiendish monstrosity towers over you as it forces its girth through the trees and underbrush, snapping saplings with careless ease. It moves on six limbs, each ending in a set of wicked claws that tear at the earth and rip roots free. A strange amalgamation of toad and bear, its gray and scaly hide shrouded with thick, wooly fur, the beast comes to its full height and looses an otherworldly roar from a maw so wide it splits the oblong head down its middle. A multitude of blood-red eyes zero in on you as it raises four of its limbs to strike.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Cast Silver Darts.name:
我施放银色飞镖
I Cast Silver Darts

Text.text:
敌人猛扑向我的朋友，武器前伸，眼中燃着嗜杀的凶光。我不假思索，毫不迟疑——凭着本能出手。时代仿佛放慢了脚步，我凝神屏息，将一口气压在胸腔里。我从身周的空气里牵引奥术之力，四肢与指尖先是一阵细微刺麻，随即感到那股躁动能量在体内奔窜，然后我将它释放出去。一束炫目的几何光流，银白而参差如刃，疾射而出。银光勾勒出敌人与我朋友的轮廓；就在那电光石火的一瞬迟疑间，武器带着尖啸，从我的盟友身旁擦掠而过。

~ Envisioned by Wikiwing

The enemy lunges at my friend, weapon outstretched, murderous intent alight in their eyes. I react without thinking, without hesitation—on instinct. Time seems to slow as I focus, holding in a breath. I pull arcane power from the air around me, and I feel the tingle of its volatile energy in my limbs, my fingers, before letting it fly. A dazzling stream of geometric lights, silvery and jagged, courses forth. Silver light outlines both my enemy and my friend, and with a split-second of hesitation, the weapon whistles past my ally.

~ Envisioned by Wikiwing

恶臭熏得你眼眶发酸，胃里一阵翻涌。若不是还得做出抉择——逃还是战？——这气味几乎足以让你瘫倒。最前排的几具既凄惨又骇人，你甚至希望这场面能滑稽一点。那个站街女。那个曾在自家地界朝孩子扔石头的老头。但下一排……下一排却全是孩子。
The stench makes your eyes water and your gorge rise. It would be enough to cripple you if you didn’t have to decide: run or fight? The first few ranks look sad as well as gruesome, and you’d even like this to be funny. The streetwalker. The old guy who used to throw rocks at children on his property. But the next rank . . . the next rank is made of children.

Silter, Druid Of Decay.name:
西尔特，腐朽德鲁伊
Silter, Druid Of Decay

Text.text:
一名年轻的野精灵与通晓世事的动物为伍，这位德鲁伊更偏爱它们，以及他的伙伴——那只被妖精之力浸染、名叫布雷文的老鼠——胜过人类与机器。常年风吹日晒，他肤色黝黑、脸颊点点雀斑；编成辫的头发像一片干草地，缠着野花；嘴唇染成云杉般的幽蓝。他把萨满式的流放岁月炼成大地的智慧与鼠群的机敏。戴着手套的手握着一柄刻满符文、以野猪獠牙制成的长矛；裸露的那只手则泄出土系魔法的光晕。颈间悬着长笛，背上弓与箭袋齐备，组成他的装备。护身斗篷也挡不住他身周蘑菇孢子翻涌的云雾——他正引领着一列村庄老鼠的队伍。

~ Played by Joorrekiin with

A young wild elf among learned animals, the druid prefers them and his companion—the fey-touched rat named Brevin—to men and machines. Tanned and freckled by life outdoors, braided hair a hayfield twined with flowers, and lips dyed spruce blue, he turns his shamanic exile into earth wisdom and rodent savvy. In his gloved hand is a runic spear of boar tusk, while his bare hand reveals an aura of earth magic; a flute around his neck and bow and quiver on his back complete his equipment. His protective cloak does little to reduce the cloud of mushroom spores as he leads a train of village rats.

~ Played by Joorrekiin with

Loot From A Kuo-toa.name:
夺自库奥托亚的战利品
Loot From A Kuo-toa

Text.text:
一串锁链缠在那具死去的鱼人类鳃状脖颈上，渔网与水草纠缠成团。乱麻之间，你瞥见点点黄光与银辉。你扯开湿滑的草蔓与刺得人发疼的倒钩网线，翻出几条项链，多半是从尸体上搜刮来的。其中最上乘的战利品，是一条由珍珠完全串成的项链。
A set of chains tangles around the gilled neck of the dead pescanoid, a mingling of netting and waterweed. Within the mess, you spy glints of yellow and silver. You tear away the slippery plant tendrils and painfully barbed netting to find some necklaces, most likely scavenged from corpses. The finest prize is a necklace made entirely of pearls.

丛林酷热难当，潮湿闷得人几乎喘不过气。浓密的枝叶间没有一丝风动，湿气如黏腻的怀抱将你紧紧裹住。背负着你的道具和补给，热浪更被放大。汗水成股顺着身上淌下，把衣物浸得透湿，仿佛成了第二层无法挣脱的皮肤，滑腻而紧贴。
The jungle is hot and oppressively humid. Not a breath of moving air stirs among the thick foliage, and the humidity enfolds you in its clammy embrace. The heat is magnified under the burden of your gear and supplies. Rivulets of sweat dampen your clothing until they feel like a second inescapable skin, slick and clinging.

Lich's Ritual Pyre.name:
巫妖的仪式柴堆
Lich's Ritual Pyre

Text.text:
一座由焦黑骨骸堆成的火盆里，冰蓝色的火焰如利爪般抓挠着黯沉的天空。它们并不散发热量——反倒像在吞噬一切温暖的迹象，使空气变得冰冷而窒闷。巫妖立于自己的火葬堆前，几乎与那火势同高。他张开骷髅般的双臂，虔敬膜拜，褴褛长袍的缕缕残絮翻涌着邪恶的魔法。他的奴仆也加入这场庆典，手臂高举，仿佛被无形的提线牵引。
From a brazier of blackened bones, icy blue flames claw at the dark sky. They do not radiate heat—rather they seem to absorb any suggestion of warmth, leaving the air cold and close. The lich stands before his pyre, nearly as tall as the blaze. He spreads his skeletal arms in adoration, the wisps of his threadbare robes roiling with fell magic. His thralls join him in his celebration, arms raised as if by puppet strings.

你以无比谨慎的双手，将一枚小小的钻石放在新近死者静止的胸口，低声念出简短的祷词，祈愿生命的火星能重返那位过早被夺离凡世的受害者。尸体的手指开始微微抽动，随即猛地吸入一口颤抖的气息——你知道，你的咒文已结出奇迹的果实。
With careful hands you place a small diamond on the still chest of the newly dead, whispering a quick prayer that the spark of life might return to the victim taken from the mortal realm too soon. The hand of the body begins to twitch, a single shuddering breath is indrawn, and you know that your incantation has born miraculous fruit.

Banishing A Summoned Spirit.name:
放逐被召唤的灵体
Banishing A Summoned Spirit

Text.text:
刺骨的寒意渗入房间，仿佛要从你的骨髓里抽走最后一丝暖意；你呼出的气在眼前凝成颤抖的雾团。那灵体死死瞪着你，洞悉你的意图——当你开始吟诵驱逐的咒文时，它的目光如刀般锋利。魅影（特征）尖声嘶鸣，身影如摇曳的烛焰般忽明忽暗，带着盲目而嗜杀的狂怒朝你猛扑而来。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

An icy chill permeates the room, leaching the warmth from your bones as your breath mists before you in trembling clouds. The spirit glares at you, fully aware of your intentions, as you begin the incantation of banishment. The phantom screeches, its image flickering like a wavering candle flame as it rushes toward you in blind, murderous fury.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这根精雕细琢的手杖以附魔雕刻的黑曜石打造，为持用者提供坚实的支援与无可比拟的防护。杖首塑成咆哮巨龙之姿，杖身暗藏的利刃乃一片锋锐至极的水晶碎片，能以行云流水般的轻易切开护甲。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，Forge Ahead: A Party To Access 创作

This exquisitely crafted cane provides robust support and incomparable defense for its wielder, being as it is made from enchanted carved obsidian. The head of the cane is styled in the manner of a roaring dragon, and the blade hidden within is a shard of razor-sharp crystal able to slice through armor with consummate ease.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

那颗宝珠从远处看似乎更小。可如今你站在一具泰坦的残骸前，体型的尺度感被彻底撼动。十来枚圆钝的牙齿在巨颅的沉重阴影下排成半弧；每一枚都有一扇正门那么大，釉质泛着黄与褐的斑驳光泽。下颌骨早已不见，它们便像凸出的楔子，硬生生咬进泥土。标记着倾斜鼻腔起点的凹陷高得够不着——除非借助魔法，或一架梯子。更高处，深陷的眼窝空洞地凝视着你，仿佛城墙顶端被弃置的岗亭。
The orb looked smaller from a distance. Now, standing before the remains of a titan, your sense of scale is challenged. A dozen rounded teeth, each the size of a front door and enameled in shades of yellow and brown, are arrayed in a semicircle beneath the gargantuan weight of the skull. In the absence of a jawbone, these protrude to bite into the earth. The depression marking the beginning of a sloping nasal cavity is out of reach without magic—or a ladder. Higher still, the deep eye sockets stare vacantly like abandoned guard stations atop a castle wall.

Intimidating Bad Guy.name:
令人胆寒的恶棍
Intimidating Bad Guy

Text.text:
酒馆里所有人的目光都钉在那个朝吧台走来的男人身上；木地板上传来的沉重脚步声几乎被盖过——客人们无意识地往后挪，椅脚在地面刮出刺耳的声响。那人肩宽如墙，比酒保还高出一个头，用低沉的咆哮开口——可你听不清他究竟说了什么。酒保倒酒的手在发抖，酒液晃荡着溢出，泼洒在吧台上。你瞥见一名侍者从拐角处探出身来，手里端着空托盘，却又连退两步，下意识把托盘举到胸前，仿佛想挡住自己的存在。吧台边的大汉一口灌尽杯中酒，随即转身阴恻恻地扫视众人，显然正享受着他们脸上掠过的惶恐神色。
All eyes in the tavern are on the man approaching the bar; you can barely hear his heavy footfalls on the wooden floor for the sound of the chair legs scraping as patrons unconsciously edge away from him. Heavy of shoulder and a head taller than the bartender, the man speaks in a low growl—though you cannot make out the exact words. The barman’s hand shakes as he pours the fellow’s drink, liquid slopping out onto the bar. You spy a server emerging from around a corner holding an empty tray, only to take two steps back, unconsciously raising their tray as if to shield themselves from notice. The large man at the bar shoots back his drink then turns to leer at the other patrons, obviously relishing the worried looks crossing their faces.

他双腿大开，姿态松弛而从容，浑身肌肉虬结，巨大的双刃战斧斜搭在左肩。头顶与两侧剃得干净，棕发却自后脑垂落得很长。他目光平静，嘴角微翘，露出门牙间一道缺口。细密的文字纹身覆在他宽阔裸露的胸肌上，洁净的亚麻长裤紧贴着他树干般的双腿。他那只硕大的右手，正按在一条灰色猎犬的头上——那犬吻宽塌、身形与他一样庞然。

~ Played by Bill

In a relaxed, wide-legged posture, this massively muscled man holds his double-headed axe over his left shoulder. Shorn on top and on the sides, his brown hair falls long from the back of his head. He looks on evenly, his slight grin revealing a single gap amid his front teeth. Fine script tattoos his vast, bare pecs, and trousers of clean linen cling to his tree-trunk legs. His huge right hand rests on the head of a baggy-snouted gray hound as outsized as he is.

~ Played by Bill

Ring Of Shooting Stars.name:
流星射击之戒
Ring Of Shooting Stars

Text.text:
这枚黑灰色的陨铁戒指镶着一颗硕大的紫色宝石，戒环其余部分亦嵌着更小的宝石，间距均匀。它在充足光线下并不显眼，但当你将它带入昏暗的区域时，便能看见宝石泛起微弱而空灵的光辉——点点闪烁衬着墨黑的戒面，如同夜空繁星。
This black-gray ring of meteoric iron has been set with one large purple gem, with accompanying smaller gems set along the rest of the band, evenly spaced. It is not readily obvious in full light, but when carried into a darkened area, you can see the gems glowing with a faint, ethereal light, sparkles standing out against the inky surface like stars in the night sky.

Lorsaire The Amethyst.name:
洛赛尔，“紫晶”
Lorsaire The Amethyst

Text.text:
现实骤然偏移，雾气间一抹夺目的身影小跑着闯入视野。披甲分形坐骑上的骑手抬起一副秘奥护目镜，露出锐利如刀的龙瞳。他将镜片一扣，挂在那条早已塞满杂物的腰带上，随即翻身下鞍，华饰板甲叮当作响，落地后立刻环顾四周。其存在本身就逼人注目，仿佛远古走来的泰坦。这个高耸的典范披着龙纹饰物，隐约透出被遮掩的智慧与神秘的冒险气息。阳光从他皮肤上游走的符文刺青间反射出冷光，那些刻痕的含义，是只属于他一人的秘密。他搔了搔厚胡须下风霜雕刻般的面容，离开坐骑，抬起一只手臂。一条猫般大小的幼龙在伸出的护臂上凭空显现，小脑袋微微偏着，专注聆听。它忽然嘶声警告，打破瞬间的宁静，纵身跃入空中。他以炽烈的速度作出反应，长柄刀与龙盾瞬间填满披甲的铁手套——迎接即将到来的任何东西。

~ Played by Nezalhualixtlan with

Reality shifts, and through the mist a striking figure trots into view. The rider atop a barded fractal lifts esoteric goggles to reveal piercing draconic eyes. Hooking the lenses onto an already cluttered belt, they dismount, ornate plate mail clattering as they clamber down to survey their surroundings. Their presence demands attention, like a titan from ancient times. This towering paragon, draped in draconic ornamentation, hints at hidden wisdom and mysterious adventure. Sunlight glints from runic tattoos that slither across their skin, the meaning of the etchings a secret only they know. Scratching at the thick beard framing a weathered face, they step away from their mount and lift an arm. A cat-sized dragon materializes atop the outstretched vambrace, tiny head cocked attentively. It suddenly hisses a warning, breaking the calm of the moment, and leaps into the air. Reacting with blistering speed, a glaive and dragon shield fill the armored gauntlets—ready for whatever comes.

~ Played by Nezalhualixtlan with

Halfling's Joke About Narcolepsy.name:
半身人的嗜睡笑话
Halfling's Joke About Narcolepsy

Text.text:
“偶尔走神也没什么不好。能让我一跃跳过那些无聊的片段。”

~ 构想 by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

“Drifting off now and then isn’t so bad. Helps me jump past all the boring bits.”

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

这道法术施放起来并不费时——只够你做上几次低缓而稳定的呼吸。你借此安抚心神、稳住手腕，用各类施法材料勾勒出符文。待你收笔，材料便尽数没入物体表面，化作一道阴狠的陷阱，专候敌人自投罗网。
The spell doesn’t take long to cast, just long enough for several low steady breaths, which you use to calm yourself and steady your hand as you draw the glyph with the various components. When you’re finished, they vanish into the object’s surface, creating a wicked trap for your foes.

Divine Stronghold Of A God Of Protection.name:
守护之神的神圣堡垒
Divine Stronghold Of A God Of Protection

Text.text:
一面嵌着钻石般纹理的花岗岩高墙直插云霄。墙上镶着一扇厚重的橡木门，以铁箍束紧，门侧只系着一条朴素的铃绳，通往一座立柱雕刻成林的巨大厅堂——几根柱子是手持盾牌的男子；也有一位女子怀抱婴儿；另一位女子身旁站着与她等高却仍显稚气的少年，手握长弓；还有一名身着官袍的使节，正抬手致礼。王座之处却立着一尊高达数百尺的巨像，擎着塔盾，周身放射出令人心悸的守护魔法。
A diamond-veined granite wall stretches up to the clouds. A thick oak door, bound in iron and affixed with a simple bell pull, leads into a great hall of carved pillars—several are men holding shields, but there is also a woman holding a baby in her arms; another with a boy her own height, still youthful, holding a bow; a diplomat in official robes, saluting. In place of a throne stands a colossus several hundred feet high, bearing a tower shield, radiating a daunting magic of warding.

Manor House On The Steppe Overlooking Th.name:
草原台阶上俯瞰村落的庄园宅邸
Manor House On The Steppe Overlooking The Village

Text.text:
在俯瞰那座朴素农耕村落的草原坡地上，矗立着一幢庄严的宅邸——外形与村中较大的屋舍并无全然不同，却以更苛刻的工艺与更高的标准建成，气势也远为恢宏。自此处，地主能将自家领地尽收眼底，一览无遗。陌生人或许会心生疑问：这里的领主在村民心中德高望重、与民为友？还是以苛重的价码榨尽百姓的每一枚铜钱？
Situated on a steppe overlooking the simple farming village, sits a stately manor, not entirely unlike the larger houses in the village but made to more exacting standards, and far grander. From it, the landowner has an unimpeded view of their holdings. A stranger might wonder: is the landlord here highly thought of, and a friend to the villagers? Or do they squeeze every copper out of the inhabitants with exorbitant costs?

这把匕首的握柄、护手与刃身黑得如同子夜的影子，仿佛由一整块实心金属一体雕成。要将这柄刀铸到如此苛刻的规格与这般精细的尖锋，想必耗费了数日锻造之功。
As black as a shadow at midnight, the grip, hilt, and blade of this dagger appear to have been shaped out of a single solid block of metal. It must have taken days to forge this blade to such an exacting set of specifications, and such a fine point.

I Throw My Onyx Dog Figurine Of Wondrous.name:
我掷出我的奇物黑玛瑙犬雕像
I Throw My Onyx Dog Figurine Of Wondrous Power

Text.text:
一卷卷轻薄如雾的丝绸——灰、白、银与黑——从小雕像上悬浮而起，织出一片飘荡的幽纱林。伴着一声震耳的吠啸，一只披着银色围巾的巨大黑獒在丝线间欢跃穿梭，用粗大的爪子将其踩实、扯裂。它粉红的舌头挂在松垂的嘴边，走近我时语气轻快而友善：“嘿，伙计。”随后它尽职地在后腿上坐定，尾巴欢快地摇个不停。
Diaphanous reams of silk—gray, white, silver, and black—levitate from the figurine, creating a wafting forest of ethereal fabric. With a bellowing bark, a large black mastiff in a silvery scarf gambols through the threads, tamping and tearing them with its large paws. A pink tongue lolls over droopy jowls as it approaches me, and its words are light with amity: “Heya, pal.” It then dutifully sits on its haunches, tail a-wagging.

Aberrant Goblinoid Horror.name:
畸变的哥布林类恐魔
Aberrant Goblinoid Horror

Text.text:
一阵骇人的感觉猛然攫住你：仿佛有一百只眼睛正死死盯着你。你听见一声刺耳尖啸，一抹猩红残影疾冲向一名守卫，利爪横扫过她的胸膛。鲜血溅洒在冰冷的地面上，她应声倒下，致命的伤口令她浑身发颤，喉间咯咯作响。狂风般的气流在你周身鞭挞翻卷，直到你被一群恐怖之物团团围住——每一个都长着一张张大却无眼的脸。它们头颅中央凹着两只空洞的眼窝，周围与深处的血肉都闪着湿亮的猩红。那些生物形似地精，尖耳、爪手、利齿森然。它们干瘦的躯体只有薄薄的裹裆布松垮垂在嶙峋的胯骨上。蜂巢状的粉红皮肤紧贴骨骼，腹部深深内陷，凹成空腔。不仅它们的血肉看起来生涩、受刺激般发红，身上更有成百上千的纤毛破肉而出。那些触手般的附肢颤动着伸展——从它们的口腔深处、腋下阴影里，以及头顶各处探出，四面八方向你触及。

~ Envisioned by ArielleVB

A dreadful sensation overcomes over you: the feeling of a hundred eyes staring in your direction. You hear a screech as a red blur rushes up to a guard and rakes a claw across her chest. Blood splatters across the cold ground as she falls, the mortal wound leaving her trembling and sputtering. Gusts of air whip about you until you are surrounded by a band of horrors, each with a gaping, eyeless face. Two hollow sockets sit in the center of their heads, the flesh about and within a glistening crimson. The creatures appear goblinoid, with pointed ears, clawed hands, and sharp teeth. Only thin loincloths hang loosely about the jagged hips of their emaciated forms. Hived, pinkish skin clings close to their bones and their stomachs sink inward, concave. Not only does their flesh seem raw, irritated, but hundreds of cilia sprout out from their bodies. These tentacular appendages quiver and reach out—from within their mouths, under their arms, and all over their heads.

~ Envisioned by ArielleVB

Spider-infested Ancient Library.name:
蛛群盘踞的古老图书馆
Spider-infested Ancient Library

Text.text:
霉腐的空气像爪子般抓挠着你的喉咙，你越往这座神圣的典藏库深处探去，四周便始终回荡着细碎疾奔的脚步声。尽管蜘蛛在你的火把前仓皇退散，你仍注意到，标记着许多书架的蛛丝薄缕已变得愈发密集。一个冰冷的念头倏然漫过心头，点燃了你扭动腹中最原始的反胃——它们……是在把你引向它们的巢穴吗？

~ 构想：TriggrHappyJakk（Discord）

The musty air claws at your throat as you venture further into the hallowed repository, the sound of skittering legs constant around you. Though the spiders flee from your torch, you notice that the wispy strands of cobwebs marking many of the shelves have grown much more prevalent. A chilling idea washes over you, igniting a primal nausea in your twisting gut—are they leading you to their lair?

~ Envisioned by TriggrHappyJakk on Discord

火焰从农舍与谷仓的窗户里猛然喷涌而出，浓黑的烟柱穿透茅草屋顶直往上窜。谷仓旁的圈栏里，受惊的绵羊与山羊凄厉咩叫。然而更刺耳的，是一头惊恐至极的猪发出的尖嚎。也不知怎的，一头母猪竟然着了火，背上的肥膘成了助燃的油脂，火舌沿着她的脊背狂舔。她在院子里疯了一般乱窜，划出失控的圆圈，所过之处把其他猪与鸡群冲得四散奔逃。
Fire erupts from the windows of the farmhouse and barn while thick smoke rises through their thatched roofs. Terrified sheep and goats bleat from their pen near the barn. But louder still are the screams of a panicked pig. A sow has somehow caught fire, her back fat fueling flames as she tears around the barnyard, scattering other pigs and chickens as she runs in wild circles.

一座城市依山而栖，一端是葱郁松林作屏，另一端则有一条自山巅蜿蜒而下的河流相伴。城中居民个个裹着厚重的麋鹿皮衣，忙着日常生计——多半都离不开伐木与搬运的粗重活计。河畔立着一座巨大的锯木厂，原木在此被锯开、劈裂，再送往各处派作他用。你看见城里多处架设着阿尔卑斯长号，像是一套警报系统，随时用来示警游荡的强盗、巨人或其他威胁。城墙由高高的木桩围成，粗绳紧缚，桩顶削尖如刺。前门处，一位半身人女子赶着一辆堆满木料的车驶入城中；她的两头驮兽是长毛牦牛，头顶戴着蓝白相间的花冠。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

A city lies nestled against the mountainside, framed on one end by a forest of lush pine and on the other by a river trailing down from the mountaintop. The denizens, all wrapped in heavy elk-hide clothing, go about their daily tasks—many of them involving lumbering work. A large mill sits on the river, where logs are cut and split for other uses. You see various alphorns stationed throughout the city, perhaps set up as an alarm system for roaming bandits, giants, or other such threats. The walls around the city are made of tall wooden poles, lashed together and sharpened into points at their tops. At the front gates, a halfling woman drives a wagon piled with lumber into the city. Her two beasts of burden are long-haired yaks, their heads crowned with blue and white flowers.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

深渊那浸透鲜血、近乎无穷的层层位面彼此堆叠，每一层都与前一层迥然不同，共同编织成一座令人疯狂、骇人狰狞的迷宫。白骨之山自干枯的血肉平原上拔地而起。血之河流穿过翻涌、具备意识的泥浆峡谷。冰封地牢的凛冽寒风里，锁链铮鸣不止。没有一间房相同；也没有任何一层缺少奇观，或是恐怖。
The blood-soaked and near-infinite layers of the Abyss lie atop one another, each as distinct as the last, altogether creating a maddening and monstrous labyrinth. Mountains of bone rise from plains of dessicated flesh. Rivers of blood flow through valleys of bubbling, sapient mud. Chains rattle in the frigid wind of a frozen dungeon. No room is alike; no layer is without its wonders, or its horrors.

他胯部微微前顶站着，生着利爪的双手懒散地搭在腰间两把燧发手枪的枪柄上，一名身形瘦削的地精静静沉思。短短的赤褐色头发在额前收成寡妇尖，光滑、泛红的发茬与粗砺如石、灰沉的皮肤形成刺目的对比。那双眼睛细长，像两汪靛蓝的深潭，其间点缀着银色微光。一个背包斜挎在一侧肩头，结实的斜背带勒出一道线条；包盖下探出一把巨大的扳手。

~ Played by the dnd lover

Standing with hips forward, clawed hands resting idly on the hilts of two flintlock revolvers at the hips, a slim-framed goblin ponders quietly. Short auburn hair comes to a widow’s peak, the smooth, reddish crop standing out starkly from skin as rough and gray as stone. The eyes are slender indigo pools speckled with silver motes. A backpack is slung over one shoulder with a sturdy crossbody strap, a large wrench poking out from under the flap.

~ Played by the dnd lover

Cliffside Border Town In Summer.name:
夏日悬崖边境小镇
Cliffside Border Town In Summer

Text.text:
你穿过敞开的城门时，满脸汗水的卫兵从低矮的城墙上探头俯视。热浪在狭窄的街巷间摇曳，阳光从粉白的峭壁与房舍上反射回弹。铺石路面上方高高悬着一排排新洗的衣物——迅速风干的布片为下方受煎熬的人们投下徒劳的薄影。
As you pass through the open gate, sweaty-faced guards peer down from the shallow wall. Heat shimmer fills the narrow streets, the sun’s rays bouncing from chalk-white cliff and building alike. High above the cobbles hang rows of fresh washing—the swiftly drying clothes offering ineffectual shade to those suffering below.

新鲜墨水与颜料的土腥气息从那张光滑得无瑕的画布上袅袅升起。经纬线以清晰利落、浓墨重彩的笔触将这片区域铺陈开来。地形用手绘水彩的不同色调加以区分：群山是森林般的深绿，沙漠是带红的浅褐，海洋则是幽深的靛蓝。罗盘玫瑰被张扬地点缀上金箔碎光——一抹不必要却确实增色的风采，使整幅作品更显华贵。
The earthy smell of fresh ink and paint wafts up from the perfectly smooth canvas. Crisp, bold lines of longitude and latitude clearly lay out the region. Terrain is differentiated in varying hues of hand-painted watercolor: mountains a forest green, deserts a reddish tan, and oceans a deep indigo. The compass rose has been flamboyantly decorated with flecks of gold leaf—a touch of flair that, while unnecessary, does add to the richness of the piece.

I Have Blindsense.name:
我拥有盲感
I Have Blindsense

Text.text:
我专注倾听身边近处的一切动静。我的思绪会把那些理所当然的声音筛掉——经验教会我捕捉任何不对劲、任何格格不入之处。一步踩错的落脚声、空气里掠过的振翅、衣料的窸窣，或是一口猝然的呼吸，都是潜藏身影的线索。只要有一点声响，我就知道你在那里。
I listen keenly to my close surroundings. My mind filters out the expected, experience having taught me to hear anything off or out of place. A misplaced footfall, a fluttering in the air, the rustle of clothing, or a sudden breath are all clues to a hidden presence. Any sound, and I know you’re there.

Observatory Telescope.name:
天文台望远镜
Observatory Telescope

Text.text:
这架望远镜被悉心保养——金属外壳擦拭得光可鉴人，镜片上连一粒尘埃都看不见。成排的旋钮与开关昭示它绝非寻常观测镜，只让人隐约窥见其内部精密而复杂的运作。
The telescope is meticulously cared for—its metal casing is polished to a reflective shine, and not a speck is visible on the glass. An array of knobs and switches exposes it as more than a common eyeglass and offers but a hint at the complex inner workings.

深兜帽遮住了他们的身份，但身上佩戴的饰物昭示着这名邪教徒的崇高地位。沉重的项链垂挂在颈间，其上悬着狂热虔信的象征。黑色斗篷之下，他们系着一条皮带，腰侧挂着鞘中的仪式匕首。萦绕周身的甜腻熏香掩不住其下潜伏的气味——牛脂蜡烛与焦灼血肉的余烬。
A deep hood shrouds their identity, but the ornaments they wear proclaim this cultist’s elevated status. Symbols of fanatic devotion hang from a heavy chain around their neck. Beneath a dark cloak, they wear a leather belt with a ceremonial dagger sheathed at the hip. The cloying perfume of incense that follows them fails to mask an undercurrent of tallow candles and burnt flesh.

小男孩别扭地站着，笨拙地拉扯着那身繁复华丽的制服。看台上的贵族们大多对他视若无睹——直到一声响指，他才慌忙小跑过去，手里托着盛满食物的银盘。满头大汗的小侍从舔了舔嘴唇，眼巴巴看着那些甜点被一一挑走。
The small boy stands awkwardly, tugging and pulling at his elaborate uniform. The nobles in the stand mostly ignore him—until a snap of fingers has him scurrying over to them, silver platter of food in hand. The sweating page licks his lips as the sweetmeats are selected.

Mess Hall Misunderstanding Between Human.name:
人类与非人类之间的食堂误会
Mess Hall Misunderstanding Between Human And Non-human

Text.text:
一个外星人带着惊慌的抗议尖叫把你扑倒在地。你猝不及防，你们俩在翻飞的食物与调料风暴中滚作一团，飞溅的碎屑啪嗒啪嗒拍上墙壁。你把他们推开，站起身——浑身都挂着你的晚餐——阴沉地瞪着对方。他们的神情在松一口气中软化下来，解释说他们刚刚把你从胡椒研磨器手下那种惨烈又痛苦的死亡里救了出来。

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

An alien tackles you to the ground with a panicked squawk of protest. Caught unawares, you both tumble to the floor amid a storm of upturned food and seasoning that spatters the walls. Pushing them off, you stand—covered in your meal—and glower at them. Relief softens their features as they explain how they just saved you from a terribly painful death at the hands of the pepper grinder.

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

Cave Passage Narrowing.name:
洞穴通道渐趋狭窄
Cave Passage Narrowing

Text.text:
你过了好一会儿才意识到，钻进脑海的并不只是幽闭恐惧的错觉——洞窟的岩壁确实正在缓缓合拢。你继续前行，通道愈发狭窄，窄到几乎只能侧身硬挤过去；两侧岩壁相距不过一肩之宽，贴得你寸步难移。你只能祈祷，某个洞穴掠食者不会利用这逼仄空间，在此发动一场残酷的伏击……
It takes a few moments to realize that it is not simply the sense of claustrophobia creeping into your mind, but that the cavern walls are indeed closing in. And as you continue onward, the cavern narrows to the point where you are scarcely able to squeeze through, the walls barely a shoulder width apart. You can only hope that a cave predator does not take advantage of these close quarters to mount a punishing ambush . . .

银铸的天使之翼自剑刃根部优雅舒展，化作精致的十字护手，映衬着这柄神圣武器的圣洁本质。长剑流溢着光辉，当你凝视它时，一股神圣的正义感在腹中悄然翻涌。剑身表面蚀刻着繁复到令人屏息的纹饰，剑柄上镶嵌的湛蓝蓝宝石闪耀着夺目的光泽。
Angelic wings, cast in silver, spread elegantly from the base of the blade to form an exquisite cross guard, mirroring the holy nature of this divine weapon. The sword radiates light, and a sense of divine righteousness begins to stir in your belly as you behold it.
