Decorative designs of stunning intricacy have been etched into the blade’s surface, and brilliant blue sapphires shine with radiant luster in the hilt.

这柄精致的硬头锤，其带棱的锤头被抛光得如镜面般明亮，将其上花卉纹饰的金箔映衬得熠熠生辉。抛光的桃花心木锤柄在底部缠覆着上油皮革，黄铜锤尾处则镶嵌着一枚光彩夺目的宝石。
The flanged head of this exquisite mace is polished to a mirror shine, highlighting the gold leaf of the floral decorations on it. A haft of polished mahogany is wrapped in oiled leather at the base, and a single radiant jewel adorns the brass pommel.

I Turn My Ring Of Mind Shielding Invisib.name:
我让我的心灵屏障戒指隐形
I Turn My Ring Of Mind Shielding Invisible

Text.text:
我用拇指抚过这枚戒指上紫粉色宝石那凹凸不平的边缘，掂量着它力量的深广。我心想，也许暂时把这样的物品藏起来更妥当。无需言语，我命令戒指变得隐形，指尖感觉它微微一颤，随即从视线中消失不见。
I pass my thumb over the bumpy edges of this ring’s purplish-pink gemstone, considering the breadth of its power. I decide it might be better to hide such an item, for now. Wordlessly, I command the ring to turn invisible, feeling it shudder slightly before it vanishes from sight.

Semi-aquatic Alien Warrior.name:
半水栖异星战士
Semi-aquatic Alien Warrior

Text.text:
他高大而骄傲地伫立着，身上仍淌着故乡世界的水意；两只湛蓝水箱输送着维系生命的清水，注入他颈侧蓝色皮肤下的鳃。自头至足，他披着闪耀的银色护甲——其上镌满华丽纹饰，描绘着异域的神话传说——掌中紧握一柄壮丽的三叉戟。上千名败北对手交织的痛苦，在他眼底点燃一抹炭火般的微光：那是战士之魂的辉耀。
He stands tall and proud, dripping with the water of his home-world, two aqua tanks supplying life-giving water to the gills in the blue skin of his neck. He’s clothed head to toe in sparkling silver armor—decorated with ornate patterns depicting a foreign mythos—and his hand clasps a magnificent trident. The mingled agony of one thousand bested opponents lights a cinder glow behind his eyes. The glow of a warrior spirit.

Werewolf Blood Pact.name:
狼人血契
Werewolf Blood Pact

Text.text:
你看着月光洒落的林间空地上，邪教徒围着古老祭坛吟诵高唱、踏步狂舞。每个人都赤身裸体，只系着一条兽皮兜裆布，皮肤上用靛蓝的菘蓝涂料抹着诡异的符文。主持仪式的女人发出野兽般的嚎叫，四肢在狂怒中扭曲变形，猩红乱发疯长，覆满那具新生的狼形躯壳。她站起身——如今已高出数尺——招手将众人唤近。她俯身，一人接一人将利齿刺入跪伏的祈求者颈侧，把自己的赋礼分赐给他们。
You watch as the cultists in the moonlit clearing chant and dance around the ancient altar. Each naked save for a loincloth of animal fur and the strange runic symbols daubed on their flesh in woad. The woman leading the ritual howls with bestial fury as her limbs twist and contort, her wild red hair growing to cover her new lupine form. She stands—several feet taller now—beckoning the others closer. One by one she sinks her teeth into the supplicants kneeling before her, sharing her gift with them.

天气决定法术的难度，以及其效果的强度与区域。它常被用作一年级期末考试的挑战，能引来干燥的雪花飘落。起初只是轻轻落下，但会随着时间与专注逐渐变得更密、更冷，冰晶更重，射程也随之扩展。通常，第一次施放只会在施法者自己头顶落下一小团飘雪。
The weather determines the difficulty of the spell and the strength and area of its result. Often used as a challenge on the final examination for first-years, it causes dry snow to fall. It begins lightly, but gains in density, ice, and range over time and with concentration. Typically, a first casting creates a tiny snowfall over one’s own head.

在一只小小的皮革袋里，你收着几片蛋壳碎屑与蛇蜕的脆片，像干枯的蜂巢般轻轻一碰就裂。取下一片皮、一声蛋壳的喀嚓，配上几句低语与手势——随后，一只半透明的巨手从地底升起，庞大得几乎与你的身躯等大。它如日光照亮的蒸汽般微微闪烁，紧随你手的动作而动：张开时挡在你前方拦截与推拒；合拢时攥成骇人的铁拳——任你号令，或护你周全，或夺人性命。
In a small leather pouch you keep the fragments of an eggshell and brittle pieces of snakeskin like dessicated honeycombs. A piece of skin and crunch of shell, a few words and gestures with your hand, and another hand, translucent and as large as your entire body, rises from the ground. It shimmers like sunlit steam. It follows the motion of your hand, opening to intercede or push, closing into a terrifying fist—protecting or slaying at your command.

一声令人血液凝固的尖啸撕裂空气。覆羽的鸟类翅膀伸展开来，试探般拍打着气流，随即又收拢，贴回那魁梧类人佝偻的脊背上——背上黏着一层油腻纠结的毛。它那异常修长的双臂结实而精瘦，尽头是猛禽般的利爪，拖擦着地面。它猛然张开参差不齐的喙，再度嘶鸣——这一次是粗砺刺耳的呱噪——同时过度伸展的双腿骤然收缩蓄力，随时就要弹射而起。
A blood curdling screech pierces the air. Feathered, avian wings stretch out and test the air before folding back against the large humanoid's hunched back, which is matted with greasy fur. Its abnormally long arms, dense with lean muscle, end in raptor-like claws that scrape the ground. It opens its jagged beak wide and calls again—this time, a harsh squawk—as its hyperextended legs compress, ready to launch.

Sundries From A Young Black Dragon.name:
来自一条年轻黑龙的杂物
Sundries From A Young Black Dragon

Text.text:
战场上散落着一片片黑色鳞片，体型如你的手掌，像被抛进沼泽泥潭的踏脚石般零星铺开。它们仍带着幼龙般的缎光质感，翻转时便将光线映得一闪一闪。
Black scales the size of your hand litter the battlefield like stepping-stones cast into a swampy quagmire. Still bearing the satin finish of draconic youth, they reflect the light when rotated.

I Draw In My Notebook To Release Stress.name:
我在笔记本上涂涂画画来缓解压力
I Draw In My Notebook To Release Stress

Text.text:
多数书多少都讲点条理，可我的笔记本私密到足以抛开一切组织。它是一部图像回忆录，记录我在生活里或在心眼中见过的任何——真的任何——事物。在一幅双足飞龙翅膀素描的下方空处，我先画了一个单独的圆；当我添上椭圆形的身体时，它便成了一只眼。接着我给那身体套上围兜式围裙，把工具的柄塞进围裙口袋里。他看起来像是小巫师随手召出来的东西。我就叫他加里。
While most books follow some sort of order, my notebook is private enough to eschew organization. It’s a pictorial memoir of anything—literally anything—I saw in life or in my mind’s eye. In a spot below the wing of a wyvern sketch, I draw a single circle, which becomes an eye when I add an oval-shaped body; then I dress the body in a bib apron, the handles of tools tucked into the pockets. He looks like something a child wizard would conjure. I’ll call him Gary.

Cory Mortem.name:
科里·莫尔特姆
Cory Mortem

Text.text:
方下巴、高个子与敦实的身形让这名男子格外显眼，更醒目的是他那一头惨白的长发，垂至小腿。他在锁子甲外披着精致的胸甲、胫甲与臂甲，手持一面铁箍包边的圆盾。然而他的肤色却有如尸体般惨淡——乳白的浑浊遮住了双眼，只透出一线幽蓝。他咬紧下颌，阴沉地瞪视着，一手探向腰侧的长剑；黑色剑刃伴着清脆的鸣响跃入掌中。与此同时，他身后数步处，一道他的魅影影像忽明忽灭地闪现出来。

~ Played by Slick

A square jaw, tall frame, and stout form distinguish this man, as does his stark-white hair, which hangs to his calves. He wears a fine breastplate, greaves, and vambraces over mail, and carries a round shield banded in iron. Yet he has a cadaver’s pallor—milkiness shrouds his eyes, leaving only a hint of blue. He sets his jaw and glares as he reaches for a sword at his hip, and the black blade leaps into his hand with a ringing sound. As it does, a phantom image of him flickers into existence several paces behind him.

~ Played by Slick

Illegal Street Clinic.name:
非法街头诊所
Illegal Street Clinic

Text.text:
一扇没有标记的金属门通向一条漆黑的走廊，霉味刺鼻。沿着它前行，你来到一片灯火通明的空地，几张塑料布在肮脏不洁的环境里苦苦支撑，竭力守护其中的人。浑浊的塑料帘后，模糊的医生与护士来回穿梭，近乎慌乱地忙碌着，仿佛要在最短的时代里把一切都做完。
An unmarked metal door leads to a dark hallway that stinks of mold. Following it, you come to a brightly lit clearing with sheets of plastic fighting against the unsanitary conditions to protect those within. Blurred doctors and nurses move behind the murky sheets, almost frantically, trying to get everything done in as little time as possible.

战士的双手戴着上等皮革手套，指节在腰间两柄细剑的宝石剑柄上微微绷紧。金色的脉络自指尖蜿蜒而上，沿着手臂、肩头与颈侧攀爬——那股魔法透过袖口与皮甲清晰可见。这道幽幻的金丝花纹止于太阳穴，令他的双眼被力量染亮，仿佛熔融的星辰被囚在血肉之中，灼灼生辉。他以不可思议的速度拔剑出鞘，朝着他的目标飞扑而去。他的身法如迷雾般令人目眩：俯身、闪避、迂回连成一片；剑锋则如跳动的钢之舌，闪烁着争夺落点的寒光。

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

The warrior's hands, gloved in fine leather, flex over the jeweled hilts of the rapiers on his belt. Veins of gold snake up from his fingers, along his arms, shoulders, and neck—the magic visible through his sleeves and jerkin. This phantasmal filigree ends at his temples, flushing his eyes with power. They beam like molten stars captured in flesh. With incredible speed, he unsheathes the swords and hurtles toward his mark. His movements are a mystifying flurry of ducks, weaves, and dodges; his blades, flickering tongues of steel vying for purchase.

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

这只小生物的大部分身体覆着蓬松的灰毛，脸部与深色、如手般的爪子处毛发稀薄。它头颅宽阔，顶部立着圆润的直立耳。黑眼周围浅深相间的毛斑勾勒出一副简易面具；短短的口鼻覆着胡须，尽头是一枚裸露的黑鼻头。那条小尾巴上，醒目的黑色环纹与灰色交替相间。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Puffy gray fur covers most of this small creature, thinning on the face and dark, handlike paws. Its head is broad with rounded, upright ears on top. Patches of light and dark fur around the animal’s black eyes look like a simple mask, and its short, whisker-covered snout ends in a bare, black nose. Distinctive black rings alternate with gray on the little beast’s tail.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Hacker Enters A Mercenaries-only Virtual.name:
黑客潜入网域中的“佣兵专属”虚拟酒吧
Hacker Enters A Mercenaries-only Virtual Bar In The Net

Text.text:
黑客无声滑过那对复古造型的酒馆摇门，门页一晃，酒吧的虚拟空间在载入其他在线化身时轻轻抽搐了一下。烟草气与浸透烈酒的木头味被写进了这片空间里。工作人员周身勾着一圈蓝色光晕，昭示他们只是模拟角色；而真正的用户则被金色轮廓描边。尽管在虚拟现实里随时能把自己捏得干净利落，这里的客人却依旧带着粗粝的边角。有些人干脆把牛仔主题当了真，化身顶着十加仑帽，披着牛皮背心，靴跟上挂着马刺。

“嗨，亲爱的，”那位泛着蓝光的酒吧女侍在黑客走近吧台时开口。她身后的架子上排满了威士忌酒瓶，每一瓶都贴着用真实现金标出的价格标签。

“想来点啥？”
The hacker glides seamlessly through the archaically fashioned saloon doors of the bar, the virtual space glitching slightly as it loads the other active avatars in it. The scent of tobacco and liquor-soaked wood has been programmed into the space. The staff are outlined in a blue aura, indicating them as simulated characters, while true users are outlined in gold. The clientele are rough around the edges in spite of the option to appear clean cut in virtual reality. Some have taken the cowboy theme to heart, their avatars wearing ten-gallon hats, cowhide vests, and spurs. “Hi, darlin’,” says the blue-tinged barmaid as the hacker approaches the bar. A row of whiskey bottles populate on the shelves behind her, all with price tags in real currency. “What can I get ya?”

I Disarm A Glyph Trap.name:
我解除一个符文陷阱
I Disarm A Glyph Trap

Text.text:
正如盗贼工具之于实体锁，魔法之于这道陷阱亦然。地板上的符号已然充能，弥漫着奥术力量的刺鼻气息。我以意念勾勒那道符文，反向拆解其结构，谨慎地一步步拨弄其中的机关。符文低鸣震颤，随即黯淡消散，空气也再度恢复了寻常。
As thieves’ tools are to a physical lock, so is magic to this trap. The symbol on the floor is charged, reeking of arcane power. I trace the glyph with my mind, reverse engineer it, and work through the mechanisms carefully. The glyph hums and fades, and the air feels normal again.

在这座巨大的洞窟中，矗立着一尊黄铜色金属铸成的巍峨类人巨像，形貌如同繁复的板甲护甲；它的头颅是一顶宽脊高冠的头盔，覆着一张如面具般、毫无情感的脸。胸腔与头部缺失的甲片露出血肉般的空腔——每一处凹陷里都塞着灰烬色的腐败组织。泰坦脚下摊开着熔炉与工坊，工具与各式材料散落一地，仿佛工匠们早已在仓皇中弃置离去。铁制脚手架以黄铜般的关节相连，层层围绕这金属巨人。最高的平台上，一名披袍身影，面容如骷髅般嶙峋，空洞的眼眶里燃着炽烈火光；它以一只骨手托着发光的金色球体，俯瞰着这尊黄铜造物。

~ Envisioned by Cap

In this enormous cavern stands a monumental humanoid of brass-colored metal, resembling elaborate plate armor, its head a broad-crested helm with a masklike, emotionless face. Missing plates in the chest and head reveal fleshy cavities—each hollow containing rotting tissue the color of ash. At the titan’s feet sprawl forges and workspaces, with tools and various materials scattered as if the workers left long ago and in haste. Scaffolding of iron with joints of brassy material surrounds the metallic giant. On the highest platform, a robed figure with a skull-like visage and hollow, burning eyes holds a glowing golden sphere in one skeletal hand while surveying the brazen construct.

~ Envisioned by Cap

Performance-enhancing Drug, Rhino: Inges.name:
强效兴奋药“犀牛”：口服
Performance-enhancing Drug, Rhino: Ingested

Text.text:
你啪地一声掀开小瓶，蒸腾的雾气猛地扑了你一脸。你深吸一口，立刻合上瓶盖，拧紧卡扣，整个人随之不由自主地战栗起来。寒栗般的鸡皮疙瘩从皮肤各处窜起，旋即凝结变硬，把你的血肉化作坚韧粗砺的卵石皮膜。新生的护甲之下，肌肉鼓胀隆起；你有那么一瞬间仿佛要被撑裂——但那股难受很快退去，取而代之的是一阵令人愉悦的酥麻微颤，轻轻催你加快脚步……最好还能顺便惹点麻烦。
Popping open the flask, the vapors flood your face. You inhale and close the cap quickly, tightening the clamp as your entire body begins to shudder. Goosebumps rise all over your skin and then harden, turning your flesh into a sturdy, pebbled hide. Your muscles swell under the new armor and you feel for a moment as if you’ll split apart—but the unpleasant sensation fades, replaced with a pleasant tingle that spurs you gently to get a move on… and hopefully find some trouble.

Segrum \"Iron Fist\" Stoneskin.name:
塞格鲁姆“铁拳”石肤
Segrum "Iron Fist" Stoneskin

Text.text:
他光头，辫须垂落；一双榛色眼睛里有着奴隶斗士那种望穿千里的目光。无战可打时，他沉默而温和，尽管他的身躯宛如纹身的拼贴画：那些描绘他最辉煌战斗的墨迹，沿着灰色矮人皮肤铺陈，爬过、绕过背上的道道伤疤。然而最不可能忽视的，是他那双像浇铸铁水凝成的前臂与手掌——色泽黯淡，映光不匀。那对永久的护手之上，皮肤仿佛被焊接过一般受损，像一道粗粝的焊缝。唯有手指未被金属玷染。

~ Played by SibunaIV

He is bald and braid-bearded, with the thousand-mile gaze of a slave fighter in his hazel eyes. He is quiet and gentle when there is no fight, though his body is a mosaic of tattoos depicting his best fights, the ink mapped over his gray dwarven skin and climbing over and around the scars on his back. Impossible to miss, however, are the forearms and hands of poured iron, dull and unevenly reflecting the light. Above the permanent gauntlets, his skin is damaged, like a welded seam. Only his fingers are unmarred by the metal.

~ Played by SibunaIV

Robe Of Eyes.name:
千眼长袍
Robe Of Eyes

Text.text:
这件醋栗色长袍的布料柔软得如同羔羊绒，但你的目光立刻被衣袍上那些以杂乱图案遍布的数十只风格化眼睛所攫住。没有任何两只眼睛一模一样。
The cloth of the currant-colored robe is as soft as lambswool, but your inspection is drawn immediately to the dozens of stylized eyes woven in a random pattern all over the garment. No two eyes look exactly alike.

[察觉] 当你穿行在冷酷无情的荒野中，目光扫过脚下的地面，你瞥见一条起初以为是蛇的东西。你猛地停住脚步，片刻后意识到它纹丝不动；再定睛一看，那竟是一根由草茎与藤蔓巧手编成的绳索，打成一个圈，静静留在路中央，等着有人一脚踏上去。你顺着绳索望去，只见它绕在树根上，又搭过一根树枝，配着粗陋的配重：典型的套索陷阱，用来捕捉猎物——却被特意做得更大，足以套住更庞然的东西。比如你。

[触发] 你沿着荒野小径前行，目光牢牢盯着前方的灌木丛，直到套索已经猛然收紧在你的脚踝上，你才察觉到它的存在。你隐约听见配重坠落的闷响，随即被毫不客气地拖曳着在地上滑行，身体粗暴地擦过泥土与碎石——然后你被猛地拽离地面，悬在离地约十英尺的半空，缓缓旋转；一只脚踝挂在树枝上的绳索里，另一条腿别扭地向外撇着。

~ 由 OntarioDad 在 Envisioned 构想

[Perceived] As you travel through the unforgiving wilderness, eyes sweeping the grounds before you, you spy what you originally take for a snake. Stopping in your tracks, you realize after a moment that it does not move, and further consideration reveals that it is a cord woven cunningly from grasses and vines, bound in a loop and left in the path for someone to tread upon. Following the cord with your gaze, you see that it has been looped around the base of a tree and over a branch with a primitive counterweight: a classic snare for trapping game, but constructed to catch something rather larger. Something like you.

[Triggered] Traveling along the wilderness path, your eyes locked firmly on the brush up ahead, you don’t detect the snare until it has already cinched around your ankle. You dimly hear a weight drop as you are dragged unceremoniously over the ground, your body sliding roughly over dirt and rocks—and then you are aloft, dangling from a cord some ten feet up, spinning slowly, one ankle hanging from a tree branch, the other jutting out akimbo.

~ Envisioned by OntarioDad

噼啪作响的火焰窜起如篝火般高，但却没有足够的燃料——它们凭空爆发，咆哮着直冲而上。然而热浪却是真实的。任何可燃之物一触及火焰，立刻化作灰烬与烟尘。随即，火焰开始移动，不是追随它所吞噬的东西，而像一个巨人向前迈步。它又踉跄着踏出一步。
The crackling flames rise as high as a bonfire, but there’s not enough fuel—they simply erupt out of nothing and roar upward. The heat is real, though. Anything flammable touching the fire immediately turns to cinder and smoke. Then the fire moves, not following something it consumes, but like a huge person stepping forward. It takes another wavering step.

他手中短柄长戟散发出淡淡的猩红光，将他高大魁梧的穴居人身影照得森然分明；他昂然立在一群徘徊啸叫的同类前方，像是在检阅一群野兽般的随从。紫黯的头冠与灰色皮肤形成刺眼对比，衬得他更显高耸。就像那柄武器一样，他身上的板甲护甲也与追随者手里粗陋的石木武器格格不入。腰带上印着深红的穴居人骷髅与交叉骨标记，他披着同色斗篷。那抹笑意间露出一枚钢制獠牙，却丝毫没能软化他冷硬如铁的目光。

~ 由 Ethan J 扮演

Illuminated in pale red light from the short halberd he wields, a towering, muscular troglodyte stands proudly before a gang of his milling, snarling fellows. His purplish crest contrasts against his gray skin and makes him seem taller. Like his weapon, the plate armor he wears doesn’t match the stone and wood weapons of his followers. His belt bears a crimson mark of trog skull and crossbones, and he wears a cloak to match. His smile, revealing a steel fang among his sharp teeth, does nothing to soften his hard gaze.

~ Played by Ethan J

I Cast Create Undead.name:
我施放【创造亡灵】
I Cast Create Undead

Text.text:
我无视那股黏腻刺骨的寒意在骨髓里滋长，继续手上的活计，将缟玛瑙石一一放到面前每具尸体上。我以缓慢的挽歌低声吟诵禁忌之词，同时把坟土撒遍房间，谨慎地在我的“委托”周围描出一圈毫无断裂的圆环。直到我把麻木的手指探入陶罐，朝每具尸体轻轻一弹，溅起咸涩浑浊的水珠——那是对祝福最残忍的嘲讽——密室里才开始积起一阵令人作呕的嗡鸣。嗡鸣攀升至顶点，胆汁涌满我的口腔，死灵能量在他们周身盘旋翻卷。它们站了起来。
I ignore the cloying chill growing in my bones as I continue my work, placing the onyx stones on each of the corpses in front of me. I chant the forbidden words in a slow dirge as I spread the grave dirt around the room, taking care to draw an unbroken circle around my charges. A sickening hum begins to build in the chamber when I dip my numb fingers into the clay pot and flick brackish water over each of the corpses—a cruel mockery of a blessing. The hum rises to a crescendo and bile fills my mouth as the necrotic energy swirls around them. They rise.

The Ghoulish Vineyard.name:
食尸鬼的葡萄园
The Ghoulish Vineyard

Text.text:
一片小小的葡萄园，只有几行朴素的藤架，藏在后院的角落里，在月光的映照下清晰可见。浓雾紧贴地面徘徊，厚得仿佛你会径直坠穿这层鼠尾草绿的薄纱，跌入另一个、魅影般的世界。然而当你穿行在栽种的行间，脚下确实触到柔软的泥土与碎裂作响的落叶。在你自己脚步声的间隙，你听见脑后传来轻柔、沉闷的吐息——近得过分，痛得过分，绝不可能只是风。

~ 出自精彩的 TTRPG 增补 The Vineyard

A small vineyard of just a few modest rows, tucked away in a back lot, is visible under the glow of the moon. A mist lingers so densely over the ground, it seems as though you may fall straight through this sage-green veil into another, phantom world. But soft earth and crunching leaves do indeed meet your feet as you walk through the planted rows. Between the sound of your own steps, you hear soft, muffled exhalations just behind your head—too near and too pained to be the wind.

~ Found in the amazing TTRPG supplement The Vineyard

“我不太擅长这些肉麻的东西，但还是谢谢你这么温柔。善意这种东西，我并不习惯。”
“I’m not great with this mushy stuff, but thank you for being kind. Kindness isn’t something I’m used to.”

Chandelier Of Skulls.name:
骷髅吊灯
Chandelier Of Skulls

Text.text:
淹没整个厅堂的蓝光来自高处一盏枝形吊灯，华丽得刺眼，却同样骇人得令人作呕。点着蜡烛的头骨对着门厅咧嘴而笑：人类、精灵、地精、熊地精（特征）、龙裔。蓝色火焰在它们空洞的眼眶里跳舞。锻铁栅条将那阴森的笑容牢牢固定，像噩梦般的藤蔓般盘绕在脆弱的骨头上。
The blue light flooding the chamber emanates from a chandelier high above, as gaudy as it is gruesome. Candled skulls smile down at the foyer: human, elf, goblin, bugbear, dragonborn. Blue flames dance within their hollow eyes. Wrought iron bars hold the ghastly grins in place, coiling like nightmarish vines about the fragile bone.

I Dip My Swan Boat Feather Token Into Th.name:
我将天鹅船羽符浸入水中
I Dip My Swan Boat Feather Token Into The Water

Text.text:
那枚小小的徽记像一根天鹅羽毛：形体纤长，触感光滑，只是颜色会随日子在刺目的雪白与深墨般的漆黑之间变换。我将羽毛投入水中，霎时迸出一团羽絮般的魔法光球——仿佛蒲公英被风拍打得蓬散的花冠——一艘天鹅船随之显现。除了体型与那份凝滞的静默，这船几乎与真鸟无异。它头顶与两侧的羽冠在风里簌簌轻颤，豆粒般的眼睛闪着傲慢的光。
The small token resembles a swan feather, with its slender shape and sleek feel, though the color ranges from stark white to inky black depending on the day. I drop the feather into the water and, in a burst of feathery, magical spheres—like the buffeted head of dandelion—a swan boat appears. Aside from its size and stillness, the boat truly resembles a real bird. Plumes of feathers on its head and sides flutter in the wind, and its beady eyes gleam with arrogance.

Thorogood Wisemeadow, Aka Short Round.name:
托罗古德·智草原，又名“短轮”
Thorogood Wisemeadow, Aka Short Round

Text.text:
一个圆滚滚的半身人整装待发，准备踏上冒险。他披着一件长外套，挺括的高领体面又挡雨；浑圆的肚皮顶着一条厚实的皮带，勉强托住他的短裤。他那双卷毛的半身人脚——当然是赤着的——脚底布满厚厚的老茧。凌乱的头发上扣着一顶插羽的帽子，帽檐俏皮地上翘。他那双醒目的紫色眼睛闪烁着对周遭世界兴奋而好奇的光。他手握一根虬结的法杖，藤蔓与枝条纠缠缠绕，杖身一路噼啪作响地迸裂出奥术火焰，颜色与他的眼眸如出一辙。

~ Played by a Hero

A plump halfling stands ready for adventure. He dons a long coat with a handsome high collar to ward off the rain, his round belly pressing against a thick leather belt holding up his short pants. His curly-haired halfling feet—bare, of course—are thickly calloused. A feathered hat sits on his head of disheveled hair, the brim tilted upward in a jaunty manner. His striking purple eyes flash with an excited curiosity for the world around him. He holds a gnarled staff, a tangle of vine and branch wound together, the length of it crackling with arcane flame that matches the color of his eyes.

~ Played by a Hero

那身影像蛇般穿行在纠结的灌木丛里，刻意避开附近的兽径，无声无息，不留半点痕迹。他身高不及半身人，却显得更为精瘦；他在前方跋涉，身后紧跟着一头未戴项圈的恐狼，金盏花般的眼睛越过那身影的头顶，冷冷窥视。忽然一停，身影与同伴齐齐偏头，动作如出一辙。一只娴熟的手压下斜背弩的握把，托起已上弦的弩矢；另一只手掀开土褐色披风的兜帽，露出出人意料的面孔：一张地精的脸，轮廓在晒黄的皮肤上以昏橘色刻出锋利的线条。若非他左耳垂着一只硕大的银色圆环，在一束散落的阳光里一闪而过，这一对几乎难以被察觉。确认再无动静后，地精俯身挠了挠同伴的耳后，随即愉快地咯咯笑起来——那头粗犷的狼从下巴一路舔到他的太阳穴，热湿的触感让他笑得更欢。

~ 由 Wellyn 扮演

The figure snakes through a tangle of brush, avoiding the nearby game trails, making no sound, leaving no trace. No taller than a halfling but noticeably leaner, he treks just ahead of an uncollared dire wolf, its marigold eyes peering over the figure’s crown. Stopping suddenly, the figure and his companion cock their heads in unison. A practiced hand pushes down the grip of a slung crossbow, tilting up a readied bolt, while the off-hand pulls back the hood of an earthy-brown cape to reveal an unexpected countenance: a goblin face, features etched out in dusky orange against tanned yellow skin. The pair would be difficult to spot but for a large silver hoop that hangs from the figure’s left ear, gleaming in a stray beam of sunlight. Sensing no further disturbance, the goblin leans over to scratch his companion behind the ears, then chuckles merrily as the rugged wolf licks his face from chin to temple.

~ Played by Wellyn

Duel Between House Wyvern And House Drag.name:
飞龙家族与巨龙家族的决斗
Duel Between House Wyvern And House Dragon

Text.text:
袍角猎猎翻飞，泥土与尘沙卷起成云，交织的魔力散出刺涩的气息，两支学院队伍在不祥的对决中轰然相撞。能量光束——一颗颗橙与绿的小彗星，拖着闪烁的尾辉——穿过其间的空间疾驰而过。有些在半途噗地熄灭坠地，留下焦黑的灼痕。命中目标时，学生们痛呼出声，死死按住被击中的部位。一束光撞上另一束光，炽白的火花如暴雨般倾泻在混乱之上。学生们抬臂掩住双眼，却仍有不少人被震得眼神涣散、脚步踉跄。
With the whipping of robes, clouds of dirt and dust, and the astringent scent of mingling magics, two house teams collide in a baleful duel. Beams of energy, small orange and green comets with glittering tails, fly across the intervening space. Some fizzle to the ground, leaving a charred mark behind. When they meet their target, students cry out in pain as they clutch the point of contact. One beam of light collides with another, sending a blinding rain of sparks over the tumult. Students raise their arms to cover their eyes, but many are left dazed and swaying.

一台由钢铁与煤烟铸成的庞然战争机器矗立在你面前。它没有任何可供驾驶员进入的舱门，却仍以自身残酷的意志行动。类人形的上部骨架压在巨大的船体之上，原型引擎的力量在其中脉动，机身外侧布满结构繁复的远程武装。它的迷彩装甲在疾掠间明灭闪烁——由无数精密的机械腿驱动——以令人心惊的速度穿梭。AHAV 以阴森的猩红烙印在它的船体上。 A humongous war machine of steel and soot stands before you. With no room for a pilot entry, this thing moves of its own brutal accord. A humanoid chassis sits above a vast hull pulsing with the power of prototype engines and bedecked with complex ranged weaponry. Its camouflage plating flickers as it scuttles—powered by numerous complex legs—with alarming speed. AHAV is emblazoned in a sinister scarlet upon its hull.

Excerpt From Arcana Draconica.name:
摘自《龙奥秘典》
Excerpt From Arcana Draconica

Text.text: [掩蔽] 这本龙类资料集的封面覆着一层可触的银蓝鳞片，在你掌中微微震颤低鸣——就像猫咪呼噜时，腹腔随之轻轻滚动。 [内容] 你翻到“Struttigon”一节，读到：Struttigon略像鸵鸟，是不会飞的龙，长颈、健腿、圆滚滚的臀部。它们的鳞片几近不可穿透，使其能在多种环境中存活，并具备喷吐火焰的能力。然而需注意的是，Struttigon最常见的喷火，多是兴奋得意时不小心打嗝般的火焰喷溅，极少出于愤怒而把火焰对准任何事物或任何人。与古时贪婪而毁灭性的恶龙不同，Struttigon通常友善又爱玩。它们温和的天性与惊人的韧性，使其成为风靡游戏“Enchanter’s Polo”的理想坐骑。 [Cover] This compendium of dragons, its cover a tactile layer of silvery blue scales, slightly rumbles within your hands—in the same way a cat’s stomach does as they purr. [Content] Flipping to the Struttigon section, you read: Slightly resembling ostriches, Struttigons are flightless dragons with long necks, powerful legs and rotund rumps. They have nearly impenetrable scales that allow them to survive in a variety of environments, as well the ability to breathe fire. However, it should be noted that Struttigons most often emit fire as accidental belches in fits of giddiness, and rarely target anything or anyone out of anger. Unlike the greedy, destructive dragons of yore, Struttigons are generally friendly and playful. Their amiable nature and remarkable resilience make them ideal mounts for the popular game of Enchanter’s Polo.

Galadir The Jester.name:
伽拉迪尔，小丑
Galadir The Jester

Text.text:
一名衣着考究的年轻男子骑在马上，湛蓝的眼睛里毫不掩饰地盛着惊叹，环顾四周。他的胸甲上镶着某个贵族家族的星与铁手套徽记。“哇哦，古斯托！”他勒住坐骑，试图下马——却一时失了重心。他身手灵巧地把跌势化作一记鞠躬，顺势潇洒一扬，掸去那顶硕大羽饰帽上的尘土，随后又将它端端正正戴回头上。

~ 由 Loba 扮演

A well-dressed young man on horseback gazes around with a look of undisguised awe in his blue eyes. His breastplate bears the star-and-gauntlet crest of a noble house. “Whoa, Gusto!” He reins in his steed and attempts to dismount—and loses his balance. He nimbly turns his tumble into a bow, dusting off his large, feathered hat by way of a flourish before placing it back on his head.

~ Played by Loba

Goblin With A Coconut.name:
拿着椰子的地精
Goblin With A Coconut

Text.text:
一阵尖锐的欢叫在厅室里回荡，你转头望去，只见一个矮小的人形身影披着破烂的黄绿裙子，横冲直撞地穿过空间，完全不管自己要往哪儿去，直到一头撞上石墙。它低声咕哝着从障碍前退开，一只手揉着被撞到的额头，另一只手仍死死攥着那枚吸引了它注意的褐色圆球。直到它终于注意到你，地精才嘶嘶作响，啐出几句刺耳的脏话，身子蜷起护住怀里那东西——你这才看清，它手中捧着的其实是一团毛茸茸的褐色小球。

~ Envisioned by D&D is for Nerds (S03E19)

A shrill screech of delight echoes within the chamber and you turn to see a small, humanoid figure clad in a tattered yellow and green dress race across the space, paying no attention to where it is going until it runs straight into a stone wall. It grumbles and turns away from the barrier, rubbing one hand where its head was hit, its other hand still holding tightly to the brown orb that had captured its attention. The goblin hisses and spits a few harsh words when it finally notices you, curling its body protectively around what you now see is a fuzzy, brown ball in its hands.

~ Envisioned by D&D is for Nerds (S03E19)

成堆钱币的金光倒映在地精商人锐利的黄眼中，他那开裂、污渍斑斑的指甲在桌面上咚咚敲响。放贷者凶狠而掠食般的笑容撕开他粗糙的绿色面孔，几乎不带半分暖意或友善。
The gold of piled coins is reflected in the goblin merchant’s keen yellow eyes as cracked, stained nails drum on the desk. The vicious, predatory smile of a moneylender splits his calloused green features, offering little in the way of warmth or friendship.

你血管里的鲜血奔涌翻腾，酸液般的灼烈辛呛在体内弥漫。你的手指猛然收紧，嘴巴张开却只吐出无声的龇咧；原始的狂猛充斥四肢百骸，令你的躯体扭曲变形。
The blood in your veins surges, searing with acridity as acid suffuses you. Your fingers flex, and your mouth opens in a soundless snarl as your body warps with primal vigor.

你将手按在树皮上——触到它那不屈的粗粝。你念出词句，做完手势，魔法便从树的纹理与纤维间悄然滑入，让你得以穿入其内，仿佛穿过一块布。里面是黑暗，却也安全——一种寂静的安宁。你感到树根与枝桠向外延展。你察觉附近还有别的树，而你只需像迈出一步那样轻松，便从另一棵树中走出，如同一道门。
You push your hand against the bark of the tree—feel the unyielding roughness of it. You speak the words, complete the gestures, and the magic slips through the folds and fibers of the tree, allowing you inside like walking through cloth. Within, darkness, but security—a quiet peace. You feel the roots and branches of the tree, spanning outward. You sense other trees nearby, and as easily as taking a step, you emerge from one like a doorway.

随着斯派尔威奇日渐壮大，当地居民将“巫伊奇河”的拼写现代化为“威克”。河水流经此处时，人们常称它为“好威克”。夏日里水色欢快明亮的蓝，点点覆草的沙洲散落其间，将河道分成辫状水脉，洲与洲之间形成蜿蜒却温顺的急湍。水深足以容纳河驳船通行——正是这些船只助力了城市的兴起。这里渔获丰饶，引得雄鹰常来盘旋；而据说已有百余年高龄的大角鸮，则栖居在两岸树影深处。入秋后，成群的雪鸮向南迁徙，沿河而下，去往啮齿动物遍地的新田野。
The spelling of the Wych River was modernized to Wick by the residents as Spirewych grew large. It is often called The Good Wick where it passes by. The water is a cheerful bright blue in summer, with grassy, sandy isles that create braided but easy rapids between them. The water is deep enough to handle the river barges, which helped build the city. The fishing is good, encouraging eagles to visit, and a great horned owl said to be more than a hundred years old lives among the trees along the banks. In the autumn, scores of snowy owls migrate south, following the river to new fields full of rodents.

她看上去更像会计或地理学家，而非法师——戴着眼镜，目光如隼，轮廓锐利。她把每一个数量、每一处地图上的位置都牢牢记住：哪里能交易、购买或采集原料，一清二楚。教室里的瓶瓶罐罐与碗盏按类别与字母顺序排得井井有条；她的清洁法术也完美无瑕，确保每张实验桌连同所有酿制器具，脏到什么程度，全看学生自己弄成什么样。
She seems like more of an accountant or geographer than a mage, spectacled and hawklike. She memorizes every quantity, every location on her maps where ingredients can be traded, bought, or gathered. The bottles and bowls of the classroom are arranged categorically and alphabetically, and her cleaning spells are perfect, so that each work desk and all of its brewing hardware is only as dirty as a student makes it.

I Strike Powerfully With My Staff Of Pow.name:
我挥动权杖之杖，猛力一击
I Strike Powerfully With My Staff Of Power

Text.text:
当我将法杖挥向敌手时，它在我掌中如同新锻之刃般目标明确。轻若羽毛却又坚实沉稳，击中之际，杖身先迸出清越的回响——紧随其后，是一声震耳欲聋的轰鸣。
As I bring it to bear against my foe, my staff feels as purposeful in my hands as a newly-forged blade. Light as a feather, yet solid, the staff rings out with a graceful chime as my strike connects—followed by a thunderous boom.

灰色皮肤上点缀着猩红斑点，包覆着一头巨大的、有翼爬行动物。它的头部长着一只几乎与腹部同样巨大的骇人喙。纤薄而精巧的翼膜折叠在细小带爪的手与生物脚踝之间，舒展开来便鼓胀成一对巨翼。它前额上突起一道经磨亮的骨质冠脊。
Gray skin flecked with spots of scarlet covers a large, winged reptile. Its head bears a gargantuan beak almost the size of its abdomen. Thin, delicate membranes folded between tiny, clawed hands and the creature’s ankles billow out to form huge wings. A crest of burnished bone protrudes up from its forehead.

Sundries From A Vine Blight.name:
藤蔓枯萎怪的杂物
Sundries From A Vine Blight

Text.text:
在那团多汁翠绿、纠缠蠕动的蔓藤之中，几簇怪异的蘑菇点缀在铜绿般的“肉”上。它们通体紫色，布着淡黄斑点，散发出一股腐败刺鼻的恶臭。
Amid the writhing mass of succulent, green creepers some curious mushrooms dot the verdigris flesh. Purple in hue and marked with pale yellow spots, the fungi emit a rancid odor.

Disease Warning Overheard At The Tavern.name:
在酒馆里偷听到的疫病警告
Disease Warning Overheard At The Tavern

Text.text:
“你也发现了吧？水喝起来一股怪味。给我把它煮沸，记住我的话——我们可不想再闹一场瘟疫。”
“Water’s been tasting foul, you noticed? Boil that, mark my words—we don’t want another outbreak.”

Thrandri Hammerhaft, Dwarf Ranger.name:
瑟兰德里·锤柄，矮人游侠
Thrandri Hammerhaft, Dwarf Ranger

Text.text:
老矮人站起身，拍去掌心的尘土。他笑了笑，灰色的眼睛里闪着历经世事的睿智；随即把一顶粗糙的羊毛兜帽拉到紧贴的短发上，又用手捋过那撮参差不齐、还夹着几粒食屑的胡子。他从背后抽出一柄大剑，龟裂而饱经风霜的皮护甲上露珠簌簌坠落，紧接着他便拔腿狂奔……
The old dwarf stands, brushing the dirt from his palms. He smiles, gray eyes shining with wisdom, as he pulls a rough woolen hood over closely cropped hair and runs a hand through an uneven beard peppered with food scraps. Droplets of dew fall from cracked, weather-worn leather armor as he draws a large sword from his back and breaks into a run…

Slipperui “Slippy” Peae.name:
斯利珀瑞“滑溜”皮伊
Slipperui “Slippy” Peae

Text.text:
这名身材高挑、颈项修长的鸟人披着上等丝绸裁成的考究长袍，华美而不失分寸。他羽色虹彩般蓝绿交织，翅上更深；头顶一簇长长的羽冠，蓝、绿、紫流光夺目。衣饰与羽毛相互映衬，皆无可挑剔、纤尘不染。一柄同样精致得近乎奢华的细剑，安置在上好的剑鞘中，悬于更为上乘的腰带之侧。他周身萦绕着淡淡的甜树脂香水气息；他昂首而立，越过那只修长的金色喙俯视你，黑色眼眸几乎不反光，冷而深。左手里，他托着一块巨大的水晶，内部封着一只羽状的眼，宛如孔雀翎端的眼斑。

~ Played by Curtis Carver

Tasteful robes of superb silk bedeck this tall, long-necked birdfolk. He has iridescent blue-green feathers, which are darker on the wings, and a crest of long plumage in dazzling blues, greens, and purples. Fashion and feathers match, both flawless and clean. An equally immaculate and elaborate rapier hangs in a fine scabbard from an even finer belt. The faint smell of sweet-resin perfume lingers around him, and he holds his head high, looking down past his long golden beak with black eyes that reflect little light. In his left hand, he holds a large crystal with a feathery eye, like the end of a peacock feather, encased in it.

~ Played by Curtis Carver

I Brew A Potion.name:
我调制一瓶药剂
I Brew A Potion

Text.text:
液体逐渐变得黏稠并翻涌起泡，随着我在坩埚中每一次搅动而轮转出不同的棱彩色泽。魔法的混合物翻搅沸腾，烟雾上方短暂凝成种种形状——每一个都在暗示我这剂调和之物的用途。混合物骤然暴烈鼓泡，几乎要如决堤之水般溢出——随即又归于平静。我微笑着，将完成的药剂舀入一只只小瓶中，整齐备好，随时可用。
The liquid thickens and bubbles, taking on a different prismatic hue with each rotation of my stirring in the cauldron. Shapes form momentarily in the smoke above as the magical mixture churns—each one hinting at the purpose of my concoction. The mixture bubbles violently, threatening to overflow like a river from a bursting dam—then it settles. I smile as I ladle my completed potion into small bottles ready for use.

Outside The Mountaintop Observatory.name:
山巅天文台之外
Outside The Mountaintop Observatory

Text.text:
这座天文台的奢华程度，远超人们对如此偏远之地的想象。精心铺砌的石材与繁复的星象纹样，即便置于城中上等街区也毫不违和。屋顶拱成穹顶，唯有一架宏伟巨望远镜的前端突兀伸出，打破了圆润的轮廓。
The observatory is more extravagant than one would expect in such a remote location. The carefully laid stones and intricate celestial designs would not look out of place in the finer districts of a city. The roof forms a dome, broken only by the jutting end of a monumental telescope.

歌者纤柔的嗓音攀升至令人目眩的高处，甜美而清澈，华丽的高音锋利夺目。那声音近乎天籁，惊人得仿佛不可能，竟触及人所难及的音域。
The singer’s feminine voice rises to dizzying heights, a sweet sound with crisp, impressive highs. Their voice is an impressive, almost angelic thing, achieving a register that seems impossible.

Illegal Arms Deal On Asteroid.name:
小行星上的非法军火交易
Illegal Arms Deal On Asteroid

Text.text:
两道人影由另外六人拱卫着，耐心地伫立在小行星贫瘠的地表上；队伍中每一面面罩都不透明，根本看不穿。人群里有两人握着沉重的枪械，更多不同式样的武器则搁在一只巨大的黑色箱子上，那几名身影正以战术队形将箱子团团围住。几颗戴盔的头颅不时抬起，扫视着上方那片浩瀚的空间，八成是在警戒是否有执法舰艇出现。
Two figures flanked by six more wait patiently on the asteroid’s barren surface, every visor in the group too opaque to see through. A couple in the group hold hefty firearms, and several more varieties of weapons rest atop a large black crate that the figures have tactically surrounded. A few helmeted heads scan the vast space above, likely watching for any law enforcement ships.

平民的脸颊消瘦而苍白，眼窝深陷。皮肤下方隐约可见血管，漆黑蜿蜒，如蛇般盘绕。他们咳嗽着，踉跄不稳。“我不 . . .”他们含混地嘟囔，“我感觉不太好。”他们摇晃着栽倒在地，浑身抽搐，口中涌出起泡的胆汁。
The commoner's face is gaunt, pale; their eyes, sunken. Veins are visible just beneath the skin, black and snaking. They cough, and stumble. "I don't . . ." they slur. "I don't feel so good." They topple, shaking, bile foaming in their mouth.

学者们柔软而带衬的脚步声打破了宁静的沉默，他们穿行在高塔层层叠叠的露台之间。莹亮的雪花石与内部辽阔的敞亮空间，为此地镀上一层轻盈而宜人的气息，宛如夏日里阳光斑驳的长廊。浓郁的紫色挂毯与旗帜自墙壁与露台垂落，骄傲地展示着灵能教团的纹章。

~ 由 A Damn Good DM 构想

The soft, padded footfalls of scholars break the peaceful silence as they traverse the tower’s many balconies. Gleaming alabaster stone, and the vast open spaces within, give the place a light and pleasing atmosphere, like a sun-dappled veranda on a summer day. Rich purple tapestries and banners hang from the walls and balconies, proudly displaying the heraldry of the psionic order.

~ Envisioned by A Damn Good DM

Broom Of Flying.name:
飞行扫帚
Broom Of Flying

Text.text:
这把歪斜嶙峋的扫帚，末端是一簇狂乱纠结的细枝，用粗纺麻绳一圈圈紧紧捆住。柄身光滑发亮，并非匠心打磨，而是经年磨损、反复使用所致。它外表寻常，可当你将它提起时，它却仿佛有那么一瞬自己也在抬升，几乎要漂浮起来。
The crooked, gnarled broom ends in a wild cluster of twigs, bundled with loops of rough-spun twine. The haft is smooth and polished, not from craftsmanship, but from wear and use. Despite its mundane appearance, as you lift it, it seems to do so on its own momentarily, levitating almost.

Potion Of Cloud Giant Strength.name:
云巨人之力药水
Potion Of Cloud Giant Strength

Text.text:
这只圆瓶几乎空空如也，只有一缕细细的白丝般之物漂浮其中，轻轻弹撞着玻璃内壁。你将药水来回晃动时，耳畔传来液体极轻、柔和的晃荡声。
The round bottle appears nearly empty, aside from what looks like a thin, white thread that floats and bounces against the edges of the glass. When you swish the potion to and fro, you hear a gentle, faint sloshing of liquid.

Sundries From A Kappa.name:
河童杂货
Sundries From A Kappa

Text.text:
河童身上挂着两副吊带、一把骨梳，以及一条儿童短裤。它腹部的育儿囊里装着几截削成笔状的小马骨——尖端用软木塞封住——还有一些揉皱的纸屑，上面用孩童水平的通用语写着怪诞阴郁的诗句。
Two sets of suspenders, a bone comb, and a pair of children’s britches are on the kappa and its stomach pouch contains a few small horse bones shaved into pens—corked on the sharp ends—along with some crumbled bits of paper with bizarre and moody poetry written in child-level Sylvan.

Loot From The Prince Of Dark Pleasures.name:
来自暗黑欢愉王子的战利品
Loot From The Prince Of Dark Pleasures

Text.text:
王子冒烟的尸体旁，躺着一把焰形剑——距离他利爪般的手掌仅差一线，仍未能触及。那柄波刃长剑浸在自身召来的酸液池中，剃刀般的刃口锯齿森然，宛如鲨鱼牙缘。
Next to the prince’s smoking corpse lies a flamberge—just out of reach of his taloned grasp. The wave-bladed sword sits in a pool of its own conjured acid, its razored edge serrated like the edges of shark teeth.

Cloak Of The Manta Ray.name:
蝠鲼斗篷
Cloak Of The Manta Ray

Text.text:
这件斗篷闪烁着微光，仿佛某种海生生物的皮肤；蓝黑色的表面在合适的光线下会流动般粼粼生辉。它接触起来粗糙，却依然轻盈舒适，同时带来温暖，并为穿戴者抵御风雨寒湿等恶劣环境。它的轮廓也颇为古怪：斗篷背后垂着一对“翼”，沿着穿戴者的背脊披落；还有一条细长如矛的“尾”，一路拖至地面。空气里还隐约带着一丝咸涩的海盐气味。
The cloak glimmers like the skin of some seaborne creature, a blue-black that in the right light seems to shimmer. Rough to the touch, it is nonetheless light and comfortable while providing warmth and protection from the elements. It bears an odd shape, with the cloak sporting a pair of “wings” that drape down the wearer’s back, as well as a long, spear-like “tail” that runs to the floor. It smells faintly of brine.

Crash Program.name:
紧急应急方案
Crash Program

Text.text:
他们的任务管理器根本来不及反应。你的黑入让数据包像湿海绵般膨胀——但不是柔软滴水，而是坚硬、棱角分明的东西：化作虚拟的蒺藜，拖慢你的目标。无论他们拖着残损继续前进，还是被迫瘫痪，抑或停下来重启，都无关紧要。他们的锋芒已经被你折断。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

Their task manager won’t know what hit it. Your hack causes data packets to expand like wet sponges, but instead of soft and sopping, these are hard and angular—virtual caltrops slowing your target. Whether they continue on, crippled, or pause to reboot is no matter. They’ve lost their edge.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

当你吐出咒语的最后一个音节，面前的香炉骤然腾起火光，缕缕烟丝如有灵性般探来，钻入你的鼻腔。霎时间，在你自我回响的思绪深处，一个温和的声音响起，开始吟诵你所点名之事的传说，仿佛一位藏书官正把遗失的秘闻典籍逐卷讲给新入门的侍学者听。
As you utter the final syllable of your incantation, the bowl of incense in front of you flares up and tendrils of smoke seek out and enter your nostrils. Immediately, a kindly voice within the echoes of your own mind begins reciting legends about the subject you named, as a librarian might recite tomes of forgotten lore to an acolyte.

Giant Snake Versus Barbarian.name:
巨蛇对决野蛮人
Giant Snake Versus Barbarian

Text.text:
致命厮杀的阴沉声响笼罩着这场冲突：一条狰狞巨蛇正与一位野性的人形勇士鏖战。獠牙尽露、鳞片寒光闪烁，巨蛇猛然扑向那英勇的野蛮人；他神情冷峻，武器高举，岿然不动。在这里，原始的暴烈撞上不屈的勇气——一场天然猎手与战士不灭之魂的对决。
The grim sound of lethal combat surrounds this conflict: a monstrous snake embattled with a feral humanoid champion. Fangs bared and scales glistening, the serpent lunges at the valiant barbarian, who stands stoic, weapon raised. Here, primal violence meets unwavering courage, a battle between a natural hunter and a warrior's indomitable soul.

如同他正在阅读的书本封面一般，这位学者的皮肉也被年代磨蚀，布满褶皱。敏锐的双眼——榴石般鲜亮的赤红——在泛黄的文字页间闪动，修长而黝褐的手指铺展在羊皮纸上。和他那一类的大多数同族一样，这只地精有着尖长的耳朵，以及一只硕大的鼻子，安在突出的眉骨之下；那眉间因专注而深深皱起。
Like the cover of the book he is reading, the scholar’s flesh is worn and creased with age. Keen eyes, the vibrant red of garnet, flash across the yellowed pages of text, as long, tanned fingers extend across the vellum. Like most of his ilk, the goblin has long, pointed ears and a large nose set beneath a prominent brow furrowed in concentration.

Headstone: “The” In Winter.name:
墓碑：“冬日里的”
Headstone: “The” In Winter

Text.text: 这块墓碑上刻着一道深深的铭文，竟未被积雪沾染。一圈文字环绕其上：人生的故事是一场无尽的悲伤循环，因为人们并未意识到——句末的“到”又接回开头的“人”，让这句墓志铭成了个阴冷的笑话。 This tombstone bears a deep inscription, untouched by snow. A circle of words: The story of life is an endless cycle of sorrow because people don’t realize that—the end of the sentence “that” leading back to the word “The” makes the epitaph a grim joke.

Humanoid Demonic Insect.name:
类人型恶魔昆虫
Humanoid Demonic Insect

Text.text:
这只与人等高的恶魔从昏暗的天穹俯冲而下，四只带钩利爪的手里，有两只紧攥着三叉戟与盾牌；猩红的复眼在可怖的幽暗中闪着恶毒的光。丑陋的颚钳细碎地咔哒作响，你这才意识到，那污秽的生物正低声咯咯发笑，仿佛光是想到要把你撕成碎片、扯得四分五裂，就已乐在其中

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

Armed with a trident and shield clutched in two of its four taloned hands, the man-sized fiend descends from the darkened skies, its red compound eyes glowing evilly in the horrid gloom. Hideous mandibles chitter softly, and you realize that the foul creature is giggling to itself, seemingly at the thought of rending you limb from limb

~ Envisioned by a Hero

A Tenday Of Travel By Foot On Road Throu.name:
盛夏更迭之际：沿路徒步旅行十日
A Tenday Of Travel By Foot On Road Through A Change To Summer

Text.text:
大地斑驳点缀着繁花，树篱间鸟声翻涌；在你这段无忧无虑的旅行的第一天里，春雨早已成了过去。农夫们在路旁向你挥手致意，象征性地收点小钱，便递来一杯冰凉的牛奶。可到了第四天，季节的燥热骤然加剧：温暖被灼人的酷暑取代。你常常不得不停下休息，疲惫得几乎抬不起脚。所幸又过了一天，咕嘟作响的小溪随处可见，想要清洗一番、解渴降温也容易多了。第八天你经过一条小河沟，孩子们在水里扑腾嬉闹，母亲们就在一旁搓洗衣物。每天都有与友善之人的遭遇，他们用轻松的笑容欢迎你。唯一令人不安的，是第九天你遭遇一辆侧翻的马车，却不见车主踪影。你记下地点，继续赶路，在第十号抵达目的地——汗如雨下，却满心欢喜。
The landscape is dappled with flowers, the hedgerows seething with birds, on your first carefree day of travel, spring rains a thing of the past. Farmers wave as you go by, offering you cold milk for a paltry sum. But by day four the torridity of the season intensifies: warmth is replaced by blistering heat. Often you are forced to rest, exhausted. Thankfully, a day later, gurgling brooks become abundant and refreshing yourself easier. On day eight you pass a creek, children swimming in its waters, and mothers washing clothes nearby. Each day brings encounters with friendly folk who welcome you with easy smiles. The only cause for concern is on day nine when you encounter an overturned cart with no sign of the owner. Noting the location, you press on, reaching your destination on day ten—sweating profusely but happy.

就连那些大胆到能安然待在狭窄空间里的人，也会觉得这玩意儿压迫得喘不过气。它像一顶与人同等体型的头盔，灰绿的竖直外壳上顶着一只玻璃钟罩般的凸起。铆钉环绕的密封垫边缘把这艘小潜艇箍合在一起，连钟罩处的舱门也不例外。一个沉重的红色弹扣拉杆扣在艇壳的释放装置上，螺旋桨沿着艇背一路排下去，仿佛一节节脊椎。底部则是一圈灯芯绒般的氧气瓶与软管环带。
Even those boldly comfortable with tight spaces would find this a bit claustrophobic of a device. It resembles a helmet the size of a person, with a glass bell poking up from the vertical gray-green casing. Gasket rims circled in rivets hold the submarine together, including the hatch at the bell. A heavy red snap lever attaches to a release in the hull, and propellers trace down the sub’s back like vertebrae. The bottom is a corduroy ring of oxygen tanks and hoses.

一名气势逼人的矮人咚咚踏进路旁旅店，她肌肉虬结的身形披着匠心独运的精制锁子甲。她摘下头盔，甩散深褐色的头发，又用戴着手套的手抹过那张栗色肌肤的脸。尽管外表如此强悍，她的神情却温暖可亲；她穿行于人群间，唇边挂着极具感染力的笑意，浑身散发着善意与爱。她解下盾牌——盾面上镌绘着自然与生长的纹章——这份对万物生灵的深切怜悯更显分明，随后在窗边落座。她将战锤与长矛放在铺着芦苇的地面上，那些昭然若揭的信仰印记在倾泻而入的明亮阳光中熠熠生辉，显然她忠于自己的女神，也忠于守护生命的使命。她深棕色的眼睛平静而稳健地扫过室内的人群与环境，或许正在寻找需要援手之人。

~ Played by Ethan

An imposing dwarf clumps into the wayside inn, her muscular form heavily armored in exquisitely crafted chain. Doffing her helm, she shakes out her brunette hair and wipes a gloved hand across her chestnut-skinned face. Despite such a formidable appearance, her expression is warm, and a contagious grin plays across her lips as she walks through the crowd, exuding kindness and love. Her deep compassion for living things is further emphasized when she unslings her shield—surface emblazoned with symbols of nature and growth—and takes a seat by the window. As she places her hammer and spears on the reed-strewn floor, the very obvious symbols of her faith catch the bright sunlight pouring in, and it's evident that she is devoted to her goddess and her mission to protect life. Her deep brown eyes scan the room, taking in the people and surroundings with a calm and steady gaze, perhaps searching for those in need of aid.

~ Played by Ethan

你低声咕哝着传送的咒词，意念在虚无中凿出一条通往彼岸的路。你强行撕开现实，将心神凝成一次以太旅行，脑海里描摹着你要抵达的确切所在。眨眼之间，你消失无踪。上一瞬你仍立于原地蓄势待发，下一瞬，只剩一团被挤开的空气在你曾站立之处沉沉回荡。
You mutter words of transportation, willing a path through nothingness to a place beyond. Forcing reality apart, you focus on etheric travel, picturing the exact place you wish to be. In a blink, you vanish. One moment you stand ready; the next, a belch of displaced air hangs where you were.

Industrial City Of Fire.name:
火焰工业城
Industrial City Of Fire

Text.text:
凿刻在火山之巅、又以闪烁的黑曜石点缀，这座流纹岩之城如热浪幻影般摇曳生辉。镐尖叩击岩石的清脆声从不停歇，穿过城市下方纵横蔓延的复杂矿道网——那是上百条矿井竖洞交织而成的回响迷宫。焰龙蜥在街巷间游弋，拖拽着满载玄武岩的车。居民们肤色红润、满身灰烬，穿着轻薄的亚麻与皮革——都染成深黑，好把永无止境的劳作污迹一并藏起。

~ 由 Xephyr 构想

Carved into the volcano’s peak and accented with glittering obsidian, the rhyolite city shimmers like a heat mirage. The incessant clink of pick on stone echoes through the hundred mineshafts that run in a complex sprawling web beneath the city. Firedrakes prowl the streets pulling carts of basalt. The denizens are ruddy, ash-smeared folk in light linens and leathers—stained black to hide the mess of their perpetual labor.

~ Envisioned by Xephyr

高贵王冠的雏形，已在幼崽头顶初生的骨质突起上隐约可见。小家伙在兽群间嬉闹，在旷野上追逐其他幼崽，发出欢快的鸣叫，恣意无忧地宣告胜利。年幼的龙王龙回到母亲身边——本能的感召将它牵引到她的侧畔——在她的接触下亲昵地轻颤鸣唱。
The beginnings of a noble crown can be seen in the budding nubs of bone on the baby's head. The youngling frolics among the herd, chasing other little ones across the plains, honking in joyous, carefree triumph. The young dracorex returns to its mother—instinct calling it to her side—and warbles affectionately at her touch.

Magical Street Drug, Hecate's Blessing:.name:
魔法街头毒品，“赫卡忒的祝福”：口服
Magical Street Drug, Hecate's Blessing: Ingested

Text.text:
水晶在你掌心溶解时，温热的力量猛然贯穿全身，令你不由抽搐。液态星辉取代了你的血液，你在层层倾泻、窸窣作响的雷霆回响中发光。你的心灵触及随之扩张，你攫住这宇宙的隐秘伟力，轻松得就像孩子伸手去拿自己最爱的玩具一般。

~ 一位英雄设想

As the crystal dissolves in your palm, your entire body twitches with warm power. Liquid starlight replaces your blood as you glow amid cascading peals of susurrating thunder. Your mental reach expands, and you grab the hidden powers of this universe as easily as a child reaching for their favorite toy.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Sundries From The Prince Of Wrath.name:
来自暴怒王子的杂物
Sundries From The Prince Of Wrath

Text.text:
由于他的荣耀与力量源自惊人的体型与虬结鼓胀的肌肉，这位王子几乎不穿能藏匿饰物或贵重物的衣物。他手腕上套着锈蚀的护臂，边缘深深割入皮肉；腰间只围着一条简陋的兽皮裆布，旧血凝结其上，结痂成褐与黑。
Since his glory and power derived from sheer size and bulging muscle, the prince wears little clothing in which trinkets or valuables may be hidden. Upon his wrists, rusted bracers cut into his skin, and about his waist is a simple hide loincloth crusted brown and black with old blood.

Lady Lasica, The Queen Lich.name:
拉西卡女士，巫妖女王
Lady Lasica, The Queen Lich

Text.text:
年代在这女人美丽的脸上刻下痕迹，却丝毫无损她惊人的华贵。碎红天鹅绒长袍披覆着她纤细的身躯，边缘镶着雅致的金色纹饰；她枯槁的手紧攥一根华丽的银杖。直到她转身正对你，她存在的真正恐怖才骤然显露。蛆虫啃食着腐败的血肉，在她端丽的面容上蠕动翻滚，仿佛烂苹果里穿行的虫群。一只眼睛的位置只剩下张开的空洞，幽幽巫光在其中燃亮；她以贵胄般的轻蔑打量着你。一个——曾经摄人心魄的——微笑懒懒地在她霉烂的唇上铺开，她起身迎你，以令人不寒而栗的殷勤致意。

~ Played by Vahlaron

Age lines the woman's beautiful face yet does nothing to diminish her remarkable splendor. Robes of crushed red velvet bordered by elegant golden designs drape her slender body, and her withered hand clutches an ornate silver staff. Only when she turns to face you does the true horror of her being become apparent. Maggots feast on decomposing flesh, writhing about her elegant visage like worms through a rotting apple. A gaping socket aglow with witchlight yawns wide in place of one eye, and she regards you with highborn contempt. A smile—once enchanting—spreads languidly across her moldering lips as she rises to greet you with unsettling hospitality.

~ Played by Vahlaron

Warning From A Werewolf.name:
来自狼人之警告
Warning From A Werewolf

Text.text:
“你们现在就该走。我感觉我的理智正被饥饿一点点撕碎，它……天啊，它来了……求求你们，不能放我出去，那些人他们……啊！杀了我，你们必须杀了我……杀……
肉……你皮肤下的脂肪……筋腱……骨头……
你们早该逃的。”
“You should leave now. I feel my mind giving way to hunger and it… Oh god, it’s happening… Please you can’t let me out, the people they… Argh! Kill me, you have to kill me… Kill…
Flesh… The fat beneath your skin… Sinew… Bone… 
You should have fled.”

Taunt From A New Vampire.name:
来自新生吸血鬼（特征）的嘲弄
Taunt From A New Vampire

Text.text:
“我几乎渴望有人用木桩刺穿我的心脏。每个夜晚醒来时，我都被一种不可战胜的恐惧填满。我的心智在这无精打采的永恒所张开的浩渺虚空前撕裂崩坏，可随后，饥饿苏醒了。它如灼烧的火焰般在我体内升腾，吞噬一切绝望与忧郁的念头。它此刻正呼唤着我……牵引我，奔向你们的喉咙。”
“I almost crave a stake through my heart. I wake up each night filled with an unconquerable dread. My mind tears itself apart at the vast void of this listless eternity, but then the hunger wakes. It rises through me like a burning flame, consuming any thought of desperation or melancholy. It calls to me now… pulling me toward your throats.”

Brave Little Soldier.name:
勇敢的小小士兵
Brave Little Soldier

Text.text:
指挥官扫视着士兵队列，等待着有人勇敢到足以应召。队列最左侧，一名瘦削的女兵走上前来——她几乎只到战友们的肩头。“我来。”她那顶过大的头盔下，金发泻落而出；浅色的眼眸里却掠过一瞬坚决的光。
The commander scans the line of soldiers, waiting for one brave enough to answer the call. Far to the left, a skinny female, barely taller than the shoulders of her comrades, steps forward. “I’ll do it.” Her golden hair spills from under her too-large helmet but determination flashes in her light eyes.

Prosthetic Leg Of Surety.name:
笃信义肢腿
Prosthetic Leg Of Surety

Text.text:
黑色钢条弯折成一条腿的轮廓，脚却收于三叉底座，酷似落地灯或衣帽架。透过扭缠金属织成的网，你看见每一叉内都缩着弧形刀刃，像猫收起的利爪；它们随时可弹出，撑稳这条腿与其穿戴者，任谁胆敢来挪动他们，都将被牢牢钉住。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，Forge Ahead: A Party To Access 提供

The black steel bars bend into the shape of a leg, though the foot ends in a three-pronged base much like a lamp or coatrack. Through the web of twisting metal, you see curved blades retracted into each prong of the foot, like a cat’s hidden claws, bracing the leg and its wearer against anything that would deign to try and move them.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Divine Workshop Of A God Of Craftsmanshi.name:
匠神的神圣工坊
Divine Workshop Of A God Of Craftsmanship

Text.text:
这里是一片杂糅的工坊群落：数座如大礼堂般宽阔的作业厅，顶着各不相同的屋顶样式，围合出一方院落。院中可作写生绘画、雕刻图腾般的石像，也可在直面天空的露天锻炉前抡锤起火。木工厅以满地锯末迎接你，窗外光束倾泻而入，空气里尽是新锯木料的清香。珠宝匠的作坊天花低矮，长桌一字排开，覆着天鹅绒，镜片与放大镜整齐铺陈。每一间厅堂都涌动着深沉的灵感：在此铸就的一切，都是世间万物造作的最初范本。
This is a jumble of grand hall-sized workshops under several styles of roof, a compound that surrounds a yard for plein air painting, totemic stone-sculpting, and working at a forge open to the sky. The carpentry hall greets you with sawdust on the floor, light streaming in through windows, and the smell of freshly-cut wood. The jeweler’s hall has a low ceiling and long, velvet-covered tables laid out with lenses. In each hall is the feeling of deep inspiration. Everything crafted here is the original template for whatever is crafted in the world.

一道灿然幻影悬浮空中，仿佛梦境化作血肉，有翼却从容不迫。它蛇形的身躯旋舞飘移，宛如一缕由闪耀鳞片织成的烟痕。在这令人沉醉的万花筒光影里，唯有一双眼睛静止不动，目光流露出至极的安宁与无尽的慈悲。
A resplendent vision hovers in the air, a dream made flesh, winged but unflappable. Its serpentine body whirls and drifts like a trail of smoke made of glittering scales. Amid this intoxicating kaleidoscope, two eyes hold still, their gaze expressing perfect calm and infinite compassion.

Divine Gambling Halls Of A Goddess Of Fo.name:
幸运女神的神圣赌坊
Divine Gambling Halls Of A Goddess Of Fortune

Text.text:
当你走近那扇门时，关于你身在何处的第一份确凿证据才被捕捉到。任何人都可前来求入，但所有人都将被随机接纳或拒之门外。有些厅堂浮华刺眼，彩光流转，在闪耀穹顶之下铺着厚实华贵的地毯；有些则肮脏腥臊，阴冷潮臭。这里的食物也和掷骰一样全凭运气，就像那些骰桌一般。但没有灌铅的骰子，没有做记号的纸牌。命运被保持得纯净无瑕。在某一座厅堂里有一栋屋子，而在屋子里有一家人。他们日日在劳作与奇迹之间求取平衡，而每一天，都会有人赢。
The first clear evidence of where you are is detected as you approach the door. Anyone is welcome to seek entry, but everyone is admitted or rejected at random. Some halls are gaudy, full of colored lights, richly carpeted under glittering domes. Some are seedy and rank. The food is as much a dice roll as the dice tables. But no dice are loaded, no cards marked. Fortune is kept pure. Within one of the halls is a house, and within the house, a family. Every day they balance work against wonder, and every day someone wins.

Ghosts Rising From Swamp.name:
沼泽幽影腾起
Ghosts Rising From Swamp

Text.text:
起初，它们像是沼泽里的几点微光——零落的月辉掠过水面。但那抹苍白的辉芒远不止如此。几枚幽光的光球自浅滩升起，携着鬼魅般的低语一同浮现。气温骤降。雾气在镜面般的水面上凝成薄纱，缠绕在芦苇间与湿地树木的黯影之中。光球渐渐聚合，化作稀薄发亮的人形轮廓，飘在空中，含混地喃喃低语，时而哀哼。
At first, they seem to be glimmers in the swamp—stray moonbeams catching the water. But the pale radiance is something more. Several orbs of spectral light rise from the shallows, bringing ghostly whispers with them. The temperature drops. Mist forms on the glassy surface, amid the reeds and dark forms of wetland trees. The orbs coalesce into wispy, luminous humanoid shapes that float in the air, muttering and moaning.

I Study Strange Symbols.name:
我研读那些诡异的符号
I Study Strange Symbols

Text.text:
文字的直线与弧线让我的视野一阵阵发虚，我竭力凝神去读，那些字符几乎在眼前起舞。语言彻底陌生，在那冗长的符号序列里，没有一个抽象的形态重复出现。为了破译这场语言噩梦，我的眼睛因用力而隐隐作痛——我必须休息。
The lines and curves of the text cause my vision to blur, the characters almost dancing around as I try to keep my focus to read them. The language is entirely alien, and not one of the abstract forms is repeated in the lengthy sequence of symbols. My eyes begin to ache from the effort of deciphering this linguistic nightmare—I must rest.

Loot From A Aarakocra.name:
来自一名阿拉科克拉的战利品
Loot From A Aarakocra

Text.text:
这名鸟人临死前的最后一刻，仍死死攥着腰带上一只硕大的皮革袋。你掰开它毫无生气的利爪，将袋子打开。里面是一卷封蜡密封的羊皮纸卷，以及一枚厚重的纯金圆环，直径约五英寸；圆环一侧打磨成平整的边缘，其上刻着太古文字。
The birdfolk clutches a large leather pouch on its belt as its final act before death. You pry the lifeless talons from the bag and open it. Inside is a sealed roll of parchment and a thick ring of solid gold, about five inches in diameter, with a flat edge engraved with primordial script.

Threat From A Paladin About Removing Wic.name:
一名圣武士威胁要肃清邪恶
Threat From A Paladin About Removing Wickedness

Text.text:
“你已从光明堕落得如此之深，但还不算太迟。我给你一次机会，弃绝你的罪恶；否则我将被迫将它——连同你的头颅——一并斩除。”
“You have fallen so far from the light, but it’s not too late. I offer you one chance to forsake your wickedness, or I will be forced to remove it—along with your head.”

Wand Of Wonder.name:
奇迹魔杖
Wand Of Wonder

Text.text:
这根笨重的魔杖由柔软的木材雕成，表面覆以光亮的釉彩。杖身上凌乱地——甚至像是随手乱撒般——嵌满了大小不一、涵盖所有基础色的珠粒。你得花上好一会儿，才能分辨出在启动它时究竟该握住哪一端。
Carved from a soft wood and enameled with a glossy finish, this cumbersome wand is covered haphazardly—even randomly—with beads of varying sizes in every basic color. It takes you several moments to figure out which end is meant to be held during its activation.

Arrow Of Time.name:
时代之矢
Arrow Of Time

Text.text:
箭矢悄无声息地飞行，直到撞上我的目标，一声凄厉的钟鸣轰然回荡。恐慌在他们眼中攀升——他们以不可思议的速度衰老，衣物腐朽成碎片，护甲与武器在枯槁的手中锈蚀崩坏。他们张口欲嚎，却发不出半点声响；随即身躯猛然内塌，向内崩碎，宛如地面塌陷的天坑。
The arrow flies silently until it impacts my target and a dolorous bell peals. Panic rises in their eyes as they age impossibly fast, their clothing rotting to scraps as armor and weapons rust in withering hands. Their mouth moves to scream, but they emit no sound as their body implodes, crumbling inward like a sinkhole.

I Cast Improved Divine Smite.name:
我施放【强化神圣惩击】
I Cast Improved Divine Smite

Text.text:
我的誓言烙印在灵魂深处，燃烧着灵性的辉光，并由我执剑之臂引导而出。这道神圣之光会流经我所挥使的任何武器，烈焰般焚尽不公与邪恶。
My oath is etched on my soul, burning with spiritual radiance, and channeled through my sword arm. This sacred light flows through any weapon I wield, blazing away injustice and wickedness.

Rickety Mountain Bridge.name:
摇摇欲坠的山间吊桥
Rickety Mountain Bridge

Text.text:
古老的桥在凛冽的山风中摇晃，缺失的木板让你看见鸟群在脚下掠过。如此高处，云雾穿过这条破败的栈道，朦胧的薄霭缠绕在磨损、覆满地衣的绳索上——它们勉强支援着这座曾经壮观的跨越。
The ancient bridge sways in the stiff mountain breeze, and the missing planks reveal birds swooping beneath you. Clouds pass through the dilapidated catwalk at this altitude, wisps of hazy fog clinging to the fraying, lichen-covered ropes that tenuously support this once spectacular crossing.

Street Doc Clinic.name:
街头医生诊所
Street Doc Clinic

Text.text:
这家诊所不在网格上，原因不言自明。坐落其上的破败贫民窟楼顶，一组高科技干扰阵列冷冷闪光。入口处只有一块只收现金的牌子作标记——肮脏不堪，猩红墨迹胡乱涂抹——就钉在阴湿昏暗的小巷尽头。来这里的人都知道该找什么。走进屋内，涂鸦与全息音乐海报把墙面铺得满满当当，震耳欲聋的迷幻电子乐在空气里轰鸣。穿过串珠门帘便是诊所本体：一张毛绒躺椅旁散落着偷来的科技零件。天花板上垂下一条阴森的金属机械臂。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The clinic is off the grid, for obvious reasons. On the roof of the decrepit slum in which the shop sits gleams a high-tech jamming array. Only a cash only sign—dirty and daubed in red ink—marks the entrance, right at the end of a dingy alleyway. Anyone coming here knows what to look for. Inside, graffiti and holographic music posters litter the walls and thumping psy-trance music sounds out. Through a beaded curtain is the clinic, stolen tech scattered beside a plush recliner chair. From the ceiling hangs a sinister metal arm.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

一对矮壮的石制塔楼夹立在城门两侧，塔身布满杀人孔。守卫在上方城垛间巡逻，人人身披皮质护甲，外罩绣有徽记的罩袍，手持粗壮的长矛。城门本身并未上闩，两名守卫把守着出入的人群。他们在铁盔檐下投来冷漠如机器的目光，只是看着，却不曾真正察觉。那扇城门以厚重橡木制成，外覆黑铁箍带，正中以宏阔的姿态镶示着城市的徽章。
A pair of squat stone turrets flank the city gates, each riddled with murder holes. Guards patrol the upper battlements, each garbed in leather armor with an emblematic tabard and carrying a stout spear. The gates themselves stand unbarred, with a pair of guards overseeing those coming and going. They watch with an absent machine-like gaze, seeing but not perceiving from under the rim of their iron helms. The gates themselves, heavy oak banded with black iron, display the city emblem in a grand fashion.

Loot From A Stoned Goblin.name:
从石化地精身上搜出的战利品
Loot From A Stoned Goblin

Text.text:
妖精狂野的眼神渐渐黯淡，带着一抹茫然的笑意，扑通一声倒进自己血泊里。在它那绿皮疙瘩遍布的手指上，你发现了几枚精致的戒指，显然是从粗心的旅人身上掠来的。
With their wild eyes growing dim, the goblin falls into a pool of its own blood with a bemused expression. On its green, warty fingers, you find several fine rings, clearly looted from careless travelers.

I Cast Astral Projection.name:
我施放【星界投影】
I Cast Astral Projection

Text.text:
价值三匹战马的橙色风信子石，安卧在它的设定之中，下方是一条银锭，银面以星界之风的纹路精雕细刻。那是一笔财富——如今已被我唤起的死灵精髓吞没。我们的形状，我们的躯体，在可见的灵体中倒映；那是被窃取的意识凝成的幽影，如钩坠于丝线，抛入我们想去的任意位面之流。我在这堆有形的财富上方大胆地吟诵并作势，心知当我化为无形之时，肉身将暴露在危险之中。
The orange jacinth, worth three warhorses, rests in its setting on a bar of silver elaborately carved in the patterns of astral winds. It’s a fortune, gone to the necromantic essence I speak into being. Our shapes, our bodies, are mirrored in visible spirits of our stolen consciousness, cast like hooks on lines into the stream of any plane we wish to visit. I speak and gesture over the material wealth in boldness, knowing my physical form will be at risk while I am immaterial.

Quip About A Father’s Advice.name:
关于父亲忠告的俏皮话
Quip About A Father’s Advice

Text.text:
“我爸是个聪明人。他常说，要是你碰上麻烦，就当它不存在，宇宙自会给你答案。没过多久，他腿上长了个瘤子，就这么死了。”
“My dad was a wise man. He used to say if you got a problem, just ignore it and the universe will provide an answer. He died of some growth on his leg not long after that.”

Rejection By A Captured Minion.name:
被俘爪牙的拒绝
Rejection By A Captured Minion

Text.text:
“我以前见过那种眼神，像猫盯着自己的猎物。我也在我主人的眼里见过。我不在乎你觉得自己是为了什么大义才杀人，但我看得出来你很享受。所以要么放了我，要么干脆点给我个痛快。我他妈什么都不会告诉你。”
“I’ve seen that look before, like a cat eyeing its kill. I’ve seen it in my master’s eyes too. I don’t care about whatever cause you think you’re killing for, but I can tell you enjoy it. So either let me go or get it over with. I’m not telling you a damn thing.”

Phase Spider Vanishing.name:
相位蜘蛛隐遁
Phase Spider Vanishing

Text.text:
那张亮蓝与冰川白交织的骇人面孔忽然开始融解，化作无形的薄雾消散。它那逐渐淡去、如钳般的腿节在甲壳吱呀作响中蜷缩收拢，随即一阵颤动——那是迫不及待者在期待近在咫尺的美味时，按捺不住的贪馋姿态。
The horrible visage of bright blue and glacial white suddenly begins to melt away, into thin air. Its fading, pincer-like legs curl in with chitinous creaks, and shudder: an eager gesture of one anticipating an imminent, tasty treat.

I Cast Healing Word.name:
我施放治疗之语
I Cast Healing Word

Text.text:
那词语如吐息般自我唇间逸出，携着焕新与疗愈的力量。空气微微颤亮，魔法穿行其间，朝我的友人飘去，仿佛清风里一支悦耳的旋律。
The word leaves my mouth like an exhaled breath, carrying the power to rejuvenate and heal. The air shimmers as the magic travels to my friend, drifting toward them like a pleasing tune on the breeze.

Approaching A Cottage Party.name:
走近小屋聚会
Approaching A Cottage Party

Text.text:
你沿着一条乡间小径信步而下，路旁是葱郁油亮的树篱；耳边传来欢笑与杯盏清脆相碰的声响。落日将天空涂抹成紫、蓝与橙交织的绝妙画卷，夜星在头顶欢快地闪烁。今天是庆祝的日子！当你转过最后一个弯，推开通往小屋的吱呀木门，迎接你的是一阵热烈的欢呼与高举的酒杯——你也随即融入朋友们的狂欢之中。

~ 由 David 在 Discord 上构想

You hear the sounds of laughter and clinking glasses as you meander down a country path flanked by verdant, lustrous hedges. The sunset paints the sky with a masterful blend of purple, blue, and orange, and the evening star twinkles joyfully above. This is a day of celebration! You are greeted with a rousing cheer and raised glasses as you round the final corner and open the creaking wooden gate to the cottage to join your friends in their revelry.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

矮人游戏店老板被几十本巨著、谜题与刻着纹样的木板团团围住，站在售货柜台后，正与对面高脚凳上的一位顾客对弈牌局。随着一张牌翻落，老板潇洒地一甩，将手里剩下的牌一并拍下，得意地高声宣告自己的胜利。与此同时，一名年轻的人类女孩俯身透过玻璃柜台，望着一只鱼缸——里面满满都是五彩斑斓、半透明的多面骰，形状各异，层层堆叠。
Surrounded by dozens of tomes, puzzles, and etched wooden boards, the gnomish shopkeeper of the games store stands at his sales counter, playing a card game with a customer sitting on a tall stool on the other side. With the turn of a card, the shopkeeper lays down the rest of his hand with a flourish, crowing over his victory. In the meantime, a young human girl looks through the glass countertop at a fishbowl overflowing with multicolored, translucent dice of different polyhedral shapes.

Primal Sprite.name:
原初小妖精（特征）
Primal Sprite

Text.text:
由矩阵原始数据纺成的一团晦秘聚合体凝结成一具小妖精（特征）的幽影形态。那幻影宛如一张翻涌的银色导线之网，向外舒展，如同一株古老巨树的根须，扎进赛博空间那看不见的土壤。其代码的精密分形彼此交织，汇成叶脉，在二进制太阳的空灵背光下隐隐发亮。它的本质随着野性心跳的节奏脉动，而这心跳以拨号上网音的回声诉说。

~ 一位英雄所构想

A cryptic amalgamation spun from the raw data of the matrix coalesces into the spectral form of a sprite. The apparition appears as a network of roiling silvery wires that fan out like the tendrils of an ancient tree rooted in the invisible soil of cyberspace. The intricate fractals of its code weave together, forming leaf veins backlit by the ethereal light of a binary sun. Its essence pulses with the rhythm of a wild heartbeat expressed in echoes of dial-up tone.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Faerie Plane: Mushroom-laden Path.name:
妖精位面：蘑菇密布的小径
Faerie Plane: Mushroom-laden Path

Text.text: 从石圈向左的小径，视野最佳：瀑布自两道银灰色峭壁分两级倾泻而下，化作蒸腾的白沫，最终注入下方的水潭。赤红的泥路蜿蜒环绕着被瀑布喂养、波光粼粼的池塘，路旁是鲜嫩的绿草、树木，以及一顶顶鲜红的蘑菇帽。潮湿泥土、湿石与熟透浆果的气息让空气都变得甜润。你听见青蛙的呱鸣，虫翼愉快的嗡嗡声，以及……一连串细小而富有弹性的噗叽声。你扫视湖边草地，发现几顶红白斑点的蘑菇帽在扭动，生气勃勃。又是一声富有弹性的 吱！ 一只蘑菇从草丛里蹦了出来，露出菌柄上、紧贴菌盖下方的一张小脸。它乌亮的黑眼睛盛满好奇，像涂鸦般的嘴角向上翘起，半张着笑——一副孩子般的雀跃神情。你听见它们的菌柄吱吱作响，蹦蹦跳跳地跟在你身后。 The path to the left from the circle of stones allows for the best view of the falls descending down two tiers of silvery-gray cliffs in a steamy froth, before ending in the pool below. A trail of red earth, surrounded by sprightly green grass, trees, and bright red mushroom caps, wraps around the glimmering pond fed by the waterfall. Scents of damp earth, wet stone, and ripe berries sweeten the air. You hear the croak of frogs, the happy hum of insect wings, and… a series of small rubbery noises. Scanning the grass around the lake, you spy some of the red and white-spotted mushroom caps wriggling, lively. With another elastic squeak! a mushroom hops out of the grass, revealing a small face set into the stalk just underneath the cap. Its shiny black eyes brim with curiosity and its squiggle of a mouth is upturned into a half-open smile—a look of childish glee. You hear their stalks squeak as they bounce along, following you.

一条粼粼闪光的河流在葱郁的绿野间蜿蜒流淌，水声轻柔地拍抚着河岸。松林簇拥着湖泊与溪涧，四季常开的花树为空气染上一缕淡雅却令人沉醉的芬芳。
A glittering river winds its way through a lush, green landscape. The river laps pleasantly at the banks. Pines cluster around lakes and streams, and constantly flowering trees scent the air with a subtle but intoxicating perfume.

Divination Final Exam.name:
占卜学期末考试
Divination Final Exam

Text.text:
占卜课教室的门在约定的时刻自动开启，最后一名学生踏入后又自行合拢。教授站在石室里一座朴素的祭坛后方。她一边说着“第一题：刀占”，一边凭空变出一把把匕首。刀刃纷纷落在祭坛上，姿态各异，其中一把从边缘滑落坠下。“解读。”

学生们埋头疾书数分钟后，她开口道：“第二题：雷占。”一声炸雷在室内爆响，几乎震得人耳膜发痛。“解读。还有，拉什小姐——是的，剩下二十四题。”
The door to the divination classroom opens magically at the appointed hour, closing after the final student enters. The professor stands behind a simple altar in a stone room. “Question one: Aichmomancy,” she says as she conjures a handful of knives. They drop onto the altar in various positions, one falls from the edge. “Read.” After minutes of students writing furiously she says, “Question two: Brontomancy.” A clap of thunder nearly deafens them. “Read. And yes, Ms. Rush, there are twenty-four questions remaining.”

Enchantress Uses Hypnotic Gaze.name:
妖姬施展催眠凝视
Enchantress Uses Hypnotic Gaze

Text.text:
一名高挑的女子端然伫立，双手在飘逸紫袍的长袖间交叠成塔，紫色与她乌鸦般的黑发相映成辉。“休息。”她低语，将这一个音节拖成柔软而撩人的咒般呢喃。她一遍遍重复，声音渐渐抬高，双眼泛起与长袍同色的紫光。她周遭的一切仿佛都慢了下来，仿佛连时代本身也无法抗拒她那摄人心魄的凝视。

~ 一位英雄Envisioned

A tall woman stands primly, hands steepled in the long sleeves of a flowing purple robe that complements her raven hair. "Rest," she whispers, drawing out the single syllable into a soft and enticing mantra. As she repeats the word, gradually increasing in volume, her eyes glow a purple sheen that matches her gown. Everything around her seems to slow, as if time itself can't resist her enchanting gaze.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Tropical Jungle: Jungle Daytime.name:
热带丛林：丛林·白昼
Tropical Jungle: Jungle Daytime

Text.text:
丛林里，生命喧嚣地活着。昆虫嗡鸣，群鸟啼唱，青蛙鸣叫，猴群彼此嚎啸——还夹杂着你辨不清的其他声响——在藤蔓缠结、树木如大教堂般密集的林间交织成一片永不停歇的轰鸣。
Life lives out loud in the jungle. Insects buzz, birds sing, frogs call, and monkeys howl to one another—along with other sounds you can’t identify—creating a constant din among the crowded cathedral of trees tangled with vines.

它们像老朋友一样，并排蜷在天鹅绒匣里打盹。光滑的玳瑁框托起圆润而笨重的轮廓，镜片厚得足以矫正佩戴者的散光。镜腿处伸出黄铜小环钉，用来系一截细链。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

These sit like old friends napping together in a velvet case. They are framed in smooth tortoise shell, roundish and bulky, with lenses thick enough for the wearer’s stigmatism. Brass gimlets for a little chain protrude from the earpieces.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Long-forgotten Cemetery.name:
久被遗忘的墓园
Long-forgotten Cemetery

Text.text:
清理掉墓碑上蔓生的草木也毫无收获：这里埋葬的是谁——他们生于何时、卒于何时——都无从得知，因为墓石早已被时代的侵蚀磨得光滑如石卵，名字与岁月一并被历史遗忘。或许正因如此，才无人打理这些亡者的休息之地。
Clearing the vegetative growth from the tombstone offers no clues about who was buried here—or when they lived or died—as the headstone has been worn smooth by the ravages of time, long forgotten to history. Perhaps that is why no one tends to the resting place of these dead.

A Tale Of Saint Jemmot.name:
圣杰莫特传说
A Tale Of Saint Jemmot

Text.text:
“艺术这位情人，反复无常。我对此再熟不过。喏，就在这间屋子里，至少有一半的人曾在某个时候用烂菜叶子砸过我。但每当我心情跌到谷底，我就会想起亲爱的老杰莫特的故事——那位举世无双的画师。他不只是描绘风景，而是把喜悦本身撕下一小片，封进画里。把他的一幅杰作挂在家中，就像推开一扇窗，迎进温热的夏日晴光。大多数人都听过他的作品，也知道他突然失踪，但很少有人知道缘由。

“嗯，我们亲爱的杰莫特并不满足于装点富裕男爵的厅堂与落满尘土的画廊。他想把作品献给一群从未被触及的观众：恶魔、神祇、怪物……无疑是自寻死路。大多数人都以为他在追寻中丧命，埋在冥暗深处的瓦砾里。但最近我听到传闻，说有人发现了新作——不在贵族的地下室，而在巨龙巢穴的墙上。所以，杰莫特的画也许还散落在世间某处，只是你大概看完也回不来了。”

“Art can be a fickle mistress. This I know all too well. Why, half the people in this very room have pelted me with produce at one time or another. But whenever I feel down, I remember the tale of dear old Jemmot, a painter without compare. He did not just capture landscapes but a little piece of joy itself. To hang one of his masterpieces in your home felt like opening a window to a warm summer’s day. Most know of his work and that he vanished suddenly, but few know why.

“Well, our dear Jemmot was not satisfied decorating the halls of wealthy barons and dusty galleries. He sought to bring his work to an entirely untapped audience: demons, gods, monsters… Suicide, surely. Most think he died in his pursuit, buried in some rubble in the stygian depths. But recently I have heard rumors of new works being found. Not in the basements of aristocrats but on the walls of dragons’ dens. So, there might be more of Jemmot’s art out there, though you likely won’t return from the viewing.”

Animal Friendship With A Friendly Animal.name:
与友善的动物结为伙伴
Animal Friendship With A Friendly Animal

Text.text:
你用哄孩子般的语气对那只动物说话，伸出手去，掌心向上，试着触及他们。他们警惕地嗅着你的气味。你告诉他们，你们两个是朋友，并在与他们对上视线后点了点头。他们眨了眨眼，然后又眨了一次——这次更慢。他们也点头回应。
You speak to the animal in a tone you’d use with a child and reach out to them, palm up. They sniff at you warily. You tell them that the two of you are friends and nod after making eye contact. They blink, and then they blink again—this time slower. They nod back.

岩石与泥土的碎片以不规则的间隔从一处巨大的天坑边缘簌簌滚落。坑口参差粗粝的断面显示这是一场自然塌陷——地下矿物被水流侵蚀带走所致——可这片骇人的凹陷深处，是否藏着一座洞窟？或许只有一种办法能揭晓。
Fragments of rock and soil tumble down the sides of an enormous sinkhole at random intervals. The rough edges of the hole would indicate a natural collapse—due to the removal of minerals through water erosion—but is there a cavern at the bottom of this massive depression? There may be only one way to find out.

Kobold Stalking Prey.name:
狗头人潜行猎物
Kobold Stalking Prey

Text.text:
在昏暗走廊的阴影深处，一名狗头人正悄然尾随猎物。它屏息潜行，寂静得近乎虔诚，匕首高举，蓄势待发。目标将火把高高举起，耀眼的光芒反倒遮蔽了对潜伏危机的察觉；那渺小的杀手一步步逼近，随时准备猛扑而上。
Within the shadows of the dimly lit corridor, a kobold stalks their prey. Stealthily, they slink with diligent silence, dagger raised in readiness. The target’s torch, held aloft, blinds them to the skulking danger as the tiny murderer edges ever closer, ready to pounce.

Black Hole Swallows Planet.name:
黑洞吞噬行星
Black Hole Swallows Planet

Text.text:
整颗行星仿佛在颤抖，地表成千上万的细小碎屑被掀起，升入空间，掠向近旁的黑洞。这样的景象持续了几秒，仿佛行星正拼命把自己攥紧，不让崩解。但那股力量终究越过临界点——行星骤然像被吸管抽走般塌陷，扭曲、翻卷，被拖入那饥渴的天体漩涡深处。
The entire planet seems to shake, thousands of tiny bits of its surface rising into space and flitting into the nearby black hole. This continues for a few seconds, as if the planet is trying to hold itself together. But the force hits a tipping point, and the planet suddenly looks like it’s being sucked down a straw as it crumples and swirls into the depths of the ravenous celestial vortex.

Young Copper Dragon.name:
幼年铜龙
Young Copper Dragon

Text.text:
阴影遮蔽了丘陵，自其中，一头体型如牛的蛇形生物以超凡脱俗的优雅现身，双翼紧贴在身侧。斑驳的日光掠过，映亮它一身闪着铜辉的鳞片。它吐出一声嘶鸣，冷冽而爬行般的质感；那双狡黠的眼睛盯住你，缓缓游弋盘旋——窥伺，等待。
Shadows obscure the hills, and from them a serpentine creature the size of an ox emerges with an otherworldly grace, wings tucked tight against its sides. The dappled sunlight catches scales of gleaming copper. A hiss issues forth, reptilian, as the creature regards you with cunning eyes and slowly circles—watching and waiting.

树木高耸如楼，一层层直上云霄；而在枝桠之间，你窥见了一座村落。半圆形的屋舍紧贴树干而建，屋与屋之间以绳索吊桥相连。栈道沿树干盘旋上下，将森林地面与村落连作一体，提供了通往村子的许可；可那纵横交错、令人眼花缭乱的栈桥网究竟该如何攀登，却难以看清——这无疑是一道对付盗匪与猛兽的绝佳防线。村民们来来往往，忙着各自的日常活计；还有数人巡弋在桥上，长弓近在手边，随时准备在必要时捍卫这座树冠上的聚落。
The trees tower stories tall, and in their boughs, you spy a village. Semicircular structures hug the trunks, and between them, ropes bridges span the trees. Walkways spiral up and down the trees, providing access to the village from the forest floor, and yet it's difficult to discern exactly how you scale the maddening lattice of catwalks and bridges–surely an effective defense against bandits and predators. The villagers move here and there, attending to their daily duties, and several patrol the bridges with longbows close at hand, poised to defend the treetop settlement if necessary.

Attempt To Charm A Vicious Dragon.name:
试图魅惑一条凶残的巨龙
Attempt To Charm A Vicious Dragon

Text.text:
“夸口也好，怒火也罢，可终日窝在洞穴里、被战利品团团围住的日子，真算得上活着吗？你就不寂寞？你的珍宝能陪你聊上几句吗？不如别动刀动爪，来点新鲜与欢闹作消遣！我们虽不是什么像你这般伟大的生灵，但我敢保证，我们的故事精彩得很，足以让你把这场小小的暴走抛到脑后。”
“All this boasting and fury, but surely life spent in a cave surrounded by loot is no life at all? Do you not get lonely? Do your treasures provide much in the way of conversation? Perhaps, instead of violence, you would settle for a dose of novelty and merriment! We may not be grand creatures like you, but I assure you we have some fascinating stories that’ll make you forget this little rampage.”

Huge Acidic Centipede Encounter.name:
巨型酸液蜈蚣遭遇
Huge Acidic Centipede Encounter

Text.text:
粘稠的绿色胆汁慵懒地从这头巨型生物的钳口间滴落，它在洞窟地面上疾窜，掀起旋涌的尘雾。伴随它的每一次移动，都会响起令人作呕的噼啪乱响——太多条腿以骇人的整齐步调一齐摆动。鼓胀的黑色复眼——闪烁着冰冷而掠食者般的恶意——转向你和你的伙伴。
Viscous green bile drips languidly from the pincers of the massive creature as it skitters across the cavern floor kicking up swirling clouds of dust. A hideous clattering follows its every movement as far too many legs move in horrid unison. Bulbous black eyes—shining with cold, predatory malice—turn toward you and your companions.

Enchanter Academy Summer Sunrise.name:
附魔师学院·夏日朝阳
Enchanter Academy Summer Sunrise

Text.text:
潮湿的薄雾在空气里氤氲，裹着青草与马匹的气息，混杂着肥皂般的沐浴香、凭空变出的古龙水，还有校区温室外那片香草园的清芬。壁炉前都覆上了屏风，屏上是各院的纹章或装饰艺术风的几何纹样。阳光无处不在。走廊里回荡着不耐、焦灼与欢腾——学期将尽的躁动，以及假期清晨温暖的光。
Humidity mists air filled with smells of grass and horses, soapy showers and conjured colognes, and the herb garden outside the campus greenhouse. Fireplaces have been covered with screens displaying house sigils or art deco designs. Sunlight is everywhere. The halls ring with impatience, angst, joy, the impending end of term, and the warm morning light of vacation.

Jack Wigglerribs, The Death Slayer.name:
杰克·扭肋，斩亡者
Jack Wigglerribs, The Death Slayer

Text.text:
此人所挥舞的那柄由黄金、钢铁与骸骨铸成的长镰，按理说对他这般修长轻灵的身形而言实在过于巨大——即便他身形高挑，也仍显得离谱。他身披连帽长礼服外套，着鳞片般的黑皮马裤，二者皆缀银色纽扣与金边。袖口翻折的骑士长靴与手套亦由相似却更轻的材质制成。在这层护身道具之下，他穿着精致的金色马甲、宽松白衬衫，并束一条深红腰绶。无纹的象牙面具覆住了他的脸，而面具之后，他的双眼燃着绿色的火焰。

~ Played by christoffer

The scythe of gold, steel, and bone this man wields seems much too large for his lithe form, tall as he is. He is dressed in a hooded frock coat and breeches of scaly black leather, both with silvery buttons and gold trim. Similar but lighter material makes up his cuffed cavalier boots and gloves. Under this protective gear he wears a fine gold vest, loose white shirt, and a crimson sash. A featureless ivory mask covers his face, but behind it his eyes burn with green flame.

~ Played by christoffer

Githyanki Warlock Emerges From Portal.name:
吉斯洋基术士自传送门现身
Githyanki Warlock Emerges From Portal

Text.text:
一道金色拱门咕嘟咕嘟地冒入视野，嘶嘶作响，轮廓愈发清晰。它闪烁着新铸钱币那带棱的边缘般的光泽，空灵的微尘在其中轻舞，柔软得像被风卷起的蒲公英种子。拱门中央浮现出一道剪影，瘦长而不起眼，仿佛一茎高草的叶片。那形体渐渐充盈、愈发分明——很快，你看见一名瘦高的人形生物，长而尖的耳朵，手持法杖。随着他们迈步向前，金色传送门便在空气中消散得无影无踪。新来者颧骨高耸，将那张黄绿皮肤的面庞拉出凌厉的线条，一眼便是施法者的气质。他们将大理石色法杖的杖端点在地上，空着的手臂下夹着一册厚重的大书。蓝色天鹅绒掩蔽之内，书页镀金的边缘熠熠生辉，恰如拱门消失前最后那一抹闪耀。

~ Envisioned by dig_bick_beau

A golden arch percolates into view, sizzling as it becomes clearer. It glimmers like the reeded edges of newly minted coins, ethereal motes dancing within it softly like windswept dandelion seeds. A silhouette appears in the center of the archway, thin and nondescript as a blade of long grass. The shape becomes fuller and more defined—soon, you see a lanky humanoid with long, pointed ears holding a staff. As they step forward, the golden portal dissipates into thin air. The new arrival, their high cheekbones drawing long the yellow-green skin of their face, has the look of a caster. They set the end of their marble-colored staff onto the ground and hold a large tome tucked under their free arm. Within the blue velvet cover, the gilded edges of the tome’s pages shine much like the arch had done just before.

~ Envisioned by dig_bick_beau

Ring Mail Armor +3.name:
环甲护甲 +3
Ring Mail Armor +3

Text.text:
一圈圈魔法金属环构成了这套卓绝的护甲，在恰到好处的光线下泛起近乎虹彩的流光。金属虽有明显的年代，却像新近锻造般鲜亮，闪着蓝紫色的冷辉，随着每一次细微的挪动发出清脆悦耳的叮当声。加固板覆盖在护甲的薄弱处，尤其是关节与上胸、肩部的接缝与缝隙之间；而内衬的皮革底衣则带来柔韧的舒适感，并额外提供一层缓冲与衬垫。
Rings of magical metal comprise the sublime suit of armor, which shines with an almost iridescent quality under the right light. The metal appears freshly forged despite its obvious age, gleaming with a blue-violet shine and clinking pleasantly with each subtle shift. Plates reinforce the suit’s weak points, particularly in the joints and crevices of the upper chest and shoulders, while a leather undersuit provides a layer of flexible comfort and additional padding.

Sundries From A Goblin In Oversized Armo.name:
穿着超大号护甲的地精杂货
Sundries From A Goblin In Oversized Armor

Text.text:
这副护甲能勉强维系不散的麻绳也许只有一弗隆长，仿佛随时都会崩断。护甲下的衬垫由被割开的皮革小袋、缝得歪歪扭扭的孩童枕头，以及鸟巢胡乱拼凑而成。
There is perhaps a furlong of twine from holding together the pieces of this armor to be salvaged. Padding under the armor is made from slashed leather pouches, badly stitched child’s pillows, and bird nests.

坠毁飞船的肋骨般骨架从地里拱起，宛如巨鲸的肋骨。破烂的帆布与磨断的索具在风中飘拍，边缘被火燎得焦黑。舵轮吱呀作响，懒洋洋地转着，早已被剥夺了昔日的用途。飞艇里一切值钱之物都被洗劫一空，唯有引擎大体完好——那是一根怪异的、长椭圆形的金属柱，从下层甲板贯穿而上，直刺船腹的中心。它侧面一排排通风口，用来排出多余的热量。你不由得揣测它如何运作——以及，这艘船是否还有再次翱翔天际的一天。
The ribs of the crashed vessel rise from the earth, not unlike whalebones. Tattered sails and frayed rigging, charred at their edges, flutter in the wind. The wheel creaks as it spins lazily, long-ago robbed of its purpose. The airship has been ransacked of anything valuable, but the engine stands mostly intact—a strange, oblong metal pylon, rising from the lower decks through the heart of the ship. Vents line its side, designed to expel excess heat. You wonder how it works—and if the ship will ever fly again.

Belt Of Frost Giant Strength.name:
霜巨人力量腰带
Belt Of Frost Giant Strength

Text.text:
一条宽阔的灰色皮带，这条束带内衬奢华的白色毛皮。它带有两条辅助束带，每条都有数个扣环，用于固定额外的道具。所有束带都配有银质五金，包括一枚大扣与两枚小扣。大扣铸成狼首，双眼镶着冰蓝色宝石。
A broad belt of gray leather, this girdle is lined with luxurious white fur. It has two auxiliary straps, each with several loops for fastening extra gear. All the straps have fittings of silver, including one large buckle and two smaller ones. The larger buckle is the face of a wolf with ice-blue gems for eyes.

Bree The Hummingbird.name:
蜂鸟布里
Bree The Hummingbird

Text.text:
约莫乌鸦般大小，却长着蜂鸟的面容与羽色；一名身形娇小的鸟人，紫羽覆面的她用灰色、覆鳞的脚向前蹦跳，轻盈得像只跳蚤。深色眼眸旁那一撮雪白的羽簇，让她的神情仿佛永远带着喜悦。然而，她那细长的喙频频埋进羽间梳理，又总爱让颈侧的虹彩羽毛在焦躁中蓬起成一圈乱翘的褶边，显然满身都是紧绷的神经劲儿。她腰带上，两道双刃弯刀的弧光一闪而过——旁边还用皮环挂着各式各样的药剂瓶。她的背包也鼓胀得像起了泡，塞满了鼓囊的口袋；从那些小袋与囊口间，飘来新鲜与风干草药交织的气息。

~ Played by a Hero with

About as large as a raven but with the face and coloring of a hummingbird, a diminutive birdfolk with a purple-feathered face hops forward on gray, scaled feet, buoyant as a flea. The white shock of feathers accenting her dark eyes give her an expression of perpetual delight. However, with the way her slender beak dives into her feathers to primp, and how often the iridescent plumes around her neck puff out in an agitated ruffle, it’s apparent she is full of nervous energy. Twin curves of a double-bladed scimitar glint from her belt—from which a variety of potion bottles hang on leather loops. Her backpack, too, blisters with stuffed pockets. The scent of fresh and drying herbs wafts from the various pouches.

~ Played by a Hero with

Werewolf Explaining The Hunger.name:
狼人讲解“饥饿”
Werewolf Explaining The Hunger

Text.text:
“事情发生时，我并没有彻底消失。我还留着零零碎碎的东西——恐惧、饥饿、狂怒。我不怀疑自己给这座镇子带来了苦难；我曾经吐出过一只孩子的鞋。但在我生命的大多数时候，在我能够掌控自己的时候，我是善良的。我修补我曾摧毁的一切，我养护那些我日后可能吞噬的东西。那些糟糕的夜里，我会把自己锁起来，可我很狡猾，所以有时我也会逃出去。我相信——我必须相信——我所做的善足以为那些恐怖之夜辩护。”
“When it happens, I’m not entirely gone. I keep bits and pieces—the fear, the hunger, the rage. I don’t doubt that I’ve inflicted misery on this town; I vomited up a child’s shoe once. But for most of my life, and for the time I am in control, I am kind. I rebuild what I have broken, I nurture what I might later devour. On the bad nights I lock myself up, but I am cunning, so sometimes I escape. What I believe, what I have to believe, is that I do enough good to justify those nights of horror.”

Battered Acoustic Guitar.name:
破旧的木吉他
Battered Acoustic Guitar

Text.text:
它孤零零地搁在角落的椅子上，宛如失落世界的遗物。那乐器破败不堪，染渍斑斑的木头拼凑而成，琴弦则用某种如今已被遗忘的合成材料制成。漏雨的屋顶滴下水珠，砸在弦上迸裂开来。随之而来的声响像幽魂般的哀鸣，诉说着一线凄然的希望。
It sits there in the corner chair, a relic of a lost world. The instrument is a ramshackle affair of stained wood, its strings crafted from some synthetic material now forgotten. Drops of water from the leaking roof burst upon their length. The sound produced is a haunting cry that speaks of forlorn hope.

若非金属本身的坚韧，你几乎会以为这些甲片是用白银锻成。甲片以柔韧的皮带与钢制搭扣牢牢固定，凸起的镶边上遍布细若尘埃的刻纹。黄铜嵌饰点缀着胸甲与肩甲，而护手与战靴上烙印的羽翼图案，勾勒出近乎天使般的姿态。这副护甲足以抵御敌人投来的任何打击——无论是利剑，还是巫术。
Were it not for the strength of the metal, you might assume these plates were forged of silver. The plates are secured by supple leather bands and steel buckles, and infinitesimal etchings run along their raised trim. Brass inlays decorate the breastplate and pauldrons, while wings emblazoned on the gauntlets and boots evoke an almost angelic appearance. The armor will protect against anything the enemy throws at you, be it sword or sorcery.

I Cast Dreadful Word.name:
我施放【恐怖之词】
I Cast Dreadful Word

Text.text:
我低吼出一句禁忌之语，手指指向某处。一个难以理解的诡秘符号短暂浮现，随我言语中那亵渎般的回响而震颤。空气迸裂。随之，近旁生物的心智也一同碎裂，在我凝聚意志之时，他们对现实的察觉被颠覆、扭曲。
I snarl a word of anathema and point to a spot. An incomprehensible eldritch symbol appears, briefly, reverberating with the abominable sound of my speech. The air cracks. With it, the minds of nearby creatures fracture, subverting their perception of reality while I focus my will.

I Drink My Potion Of Water Breathing.name:
我喝下我的水下呼吸药水
I Drink My Potion Of Water Breathing

Text.text:
咸涩的药剂掠过我的舌面、滑入喉咙时刺得发痛。它泼进腹中之际，我听见浪涛在头颅四周轰然拍碎的回响。我的肺猛然胀开，顶住肋骨。它们以意志驱使骨头与软骨挪移、撑裂般地舒展开来。
The salted potion stings as it passes over my tongue and down my throat. As it splashes into my belly, I hear the sounds of waves crashing all around my head. My lungs expand, pressing against my ribcage. They will the bones and cartilage to shift and spread.

I Snare A Missile With My Gloves Of Snar.name:
我用缠捕手套擒住一枚飞射而来的箭矢
I Snare A Missile With My Gloves Of Snaring

Text.text:
飞弹在空中掠行时仿佛逐渐变慢，像是穿过沥青般黏滞，而我的视野也随之收窄。我本能地抬起双手。手套脉动着奥术能量，将那枚投射物压制下来，我从半空中将它摘落。
The missile seems to slow as it flies, like it is passing through tar, and my vision narrows. Instinctively, I raise my hands. My gloves pulse with arcane energy as they subdue the projectile and I pluck it from the air.

I Cast Lesser Restoration From My Staff.name:
我从治疗法杖中施放次级复原术
I Cast Lesser Restoration From My Staff Of Healing

Text.text:
我一边吟诵复原的言辞，一边将法杖抵在同伴的胸口。炽烈的光辉环绕着我们，空气中魔法的嗡鸣渐渐高涨；随之而来的是一记令人心头一颤的能量震击，法术的效果随即显现。
I speak the restorative words as I hold my staff against the chest of my companion. Brilliant light encircles us as a hum of magic builds in the air, followed by a startling jolt of energy as the spell takes effect.

Loot From An Adult Blue Dragon.name:
成年蓝龙的战利品
Loot From An Adult Blue Dragon

Text.text:
你走近那条曾经威风凛凛的蓝龙，注意到它的脖颈上挂着一条金链，链上垂着三枚精美的戒指，每一枚都散发着柔和而明亮的微光。
Moving closer to the once-impressive blue dragon, you notice that about its neck is slung a golden chain, from which dangles three beautiful rings, each emitting a lambent luminescence.

Water Lily Font.name:
睡莲字体
Water Lily Font

Text.text:
喷泉以水落石上的清脆柔声欢唱，注入一方小小蓄水池；池体由精工石作砌成，内里还陈设着另外两处景观。其轮廓与地面绘画浑然一体。蓄水池的这一侧展出稀有的百合，纸薄般的绿叶舒展铺开，汇聚温暖的光线，映照出花朵从浅到深、各色粉红的层次。
The fountain has the cheerful soft voice of water on stone, and feeds a little cistern of carefully worked stonemasonry holding two other displays. The shape is integrated into the painting on the floor. This part of the cistern displays rare lilies, their papery green leaves splayed out and collecting the warm light for the flowers in various shades of pink.

Civilian Spacecraft Docking Bays And Shi.name:
民用飞船停泊舱与造船厂
Civilian Spacecraft Docking Bays And Shipyard

Text.text:
