船坞在工业的喧嚣中跃动不息，熏黑的地面不断被火花洗亮——焊工悬吊在干船坞里船只的船体旁，焊炬迸射的星雨倾泻而下。呼喊声在空旷如洞穴般的空间里回荡，身着肮脏工装的工人们在弥漫于巨型仓库内的烟霾中拖着脚步穿行。
The shipyard is alive with the clamor of industry, and the blackened floor is constantly bathed in sparks from welders suspended beside the hulls of dry-docked ships. Shouts ring through the cavernous space, and workers in grubby uniforms shuffle through the haze of smoke permeating the atmosphere inside the gigantic warehouse.

High Seas Battle: Hand-to-hand.name:
公海战斗：短兵相接
High Seas Battle: Hand-to-hand

Text.text:
即便你早已习惯海上的颠簸，这摇晃起伏的甲板也因横陈的尸体与泼洒的血污而变得步步惊险。你在敌人的眼中看见绝望——可下一刻，你也尝到了那股绝望。你的武器在掌中愈发沉重，你不确定自己还能再战多久。
Even though you have your sea legs, the pitching deck has become treacherous with fallen bodies and spilled gore. You see desperation in the eyes of your enemy, but then, you feel that desperation too. Your weapon grows heavy in your hand—you’re not sure how much longer you can fight.

Orc Chieftain's Transformation To Avatar.name:
兽人酋长蜕变为风暴化身
Orc Chieftain's Transformation To Avatar Of Storms

Text.text:
笑声在洞穴里轰然回荡，一名魁梧的兽人——双眼炽热发亮、渴望翻涌——掀开他居所的门帘踏出。目光陡然癫狂，他双手将一柄华丽的长柄巨斧高高举过头顶。雷霆自虚空劈落，击中那柄武器。蓝白电弧在兽人钢制护甲的鳞片般甲片上狂舞，继而自他眼中迸射，又在他大张的口腔里翻涌震颤。他的长辫无风自起，随后连同他那庞然身躯一并被托起。电光一闪、雷声滚过，他踏着充满臭氧的空气猛然扑前，巨斧蓄势待发，只为狂怒与鲜血。

~ Envisioned by Dustin

Laughter thunders through the cave as a massive orc—eyes eager and aglow—steps through the flaps of his dwelling. His eyes grow wild, and he lifts an ornate, long-hafted axe overhead with two hands. Lightning strikes the weapon from nowhere. Blue-white bolts dance across the scaled plates of the orc’s steel armor, arc from his eyes, and ripple through his open mouth. His long braids rise into the air, followed by his whole massive form. With a flash and a rolling boom, he surges forward on the ozone-laden air, axe held ready for fury and blood.

~ Envisioned by Dustin

当你从那座标示着城门的巍峨石拱下穿行而过，一股不自然的寒意渗入空气，直透骨髓。腐烂与败坏那股甜腻而令人作呕的气味像恶毒的香水般悬在四周，在惨淡月色下随阴风漂荡。街道上，你看见佝偻的身影在古老的鹅卵石路上漫无目的地蹒跚游走，空洞的眼睛里没有智慧，也没有意志。雷霆轰然撕裂长夜，暴雨倾盆，把这座古城浇成一片污浊的洪流；闪电在头顶划过，仿佛暴怒神祇挥下的利剑。就在那一瞬的亮光里，你仿佛看见中央高塔的窗中立着一道人影，红眼在幽暗中灼烧，如同炽热的煤火。

~ 由Nikki在Discord上构想

As you pass beneath the towering stone archway marking the entrance to the city, you feel an unnatural chill permeating the air. The sickly sweet smell of rot and decay hangs in the air like a vile perfume, adrift on fell winds beneath a pallid moon. In the streets, you see hunched figures shambling aimlessly across the ancient cobbles, their hollow eyes devoid of intelligence or purpose. A peal of thunder splits the night and rain douses the ancient city in a grungy deluge as lightning flashes like the sword of an angry god overhead. In that moment of illumination, you think you see a figure in the window of the central tower, their red eyes burning like hot coals in the gloom.

~ Envisioned by Nikki on Discord

穿着粗糙的土布衣裳、身上不带任何武器，平民日复一日地忙着自己的生计，几乎不会去想那些令冒险者焦头烂额的险恶忧患。对这个看似平凡无奇、甚至有些乏味的人而言，日常生活的辛劳已足够沉重——然而在一个充满混沌与阴谋的世界里，没有什么是稳妥的。可他们依旧活下去，甚至活得很好：操持手艺，抚养家庭，在所属的社群中结伴相扶，找到属于自己的情谊。
Clothed in rough homespun and carrying no weapons, the commoner goes about their day with little thought given to the dire concerns that plague the adventurous. For this seemingly plain and dull person, the rigors of daily living are enough—though nothing is sure in a world that brims with chaos and intrigue. Yet they survive, even thrive, plying their trades, raising families, and finding camaraderie in their communities.

一具骷髅般的身形颤抖着，从那完全裸露的头骨深处挤出一阵骇人的笑声——憔悴，却又亢奋。它的眼眶是通向虚无的深洞，里面没有情感，也没有生命。细长的手臂低垂至地，旧而断裂的肌肉丝线般缠在骨上；它移动时，巨大的骨爪拖擦地面，发出刺耳的刮响。指尖淌着如葡萄酒般深黑的血，在暗光中泛着湿亮；手指绷紧、抽动，伴随甲壳般的噼啪脆裂。尘埃与烟雾聚拢而来，披覆在它瘦削的轮廓上，仿佛一件斗篷，遮住森白的骨骼，以及那些不知为何仍死死黏附在躯体上的零星残肉。

~ Envisioned by MadCar

A skeletal form trembles as it emits a hideous laugh, haggard yet giddy, from within its fully exposed skull. Its eyes are cavernous pits that lead to a void bereft of any emotion or life. Long arms, threaded with strings of old, frayed muscle, hang low to the ground, with massive bony claws scraping against the floor as it moves. Blood as dark as wine glistens at the ends of its fingers, which tense and flick with a chitinous crackle. Dust and smoke coalesce and drape over its thin form as a sort of cloak covering the bones and the spare pieces of flesh that somehow still cling to its body.

~ Envisioned by MadCar

Insult From A Tree Person.name:
来自树人的侮辱
Insult From A Tree Person

Text.text:
“你们粗浅的语言里，根本没有足够的词汇去描绘这个世界真正的美，可你们却自以为有资格占有它。你们为了支配而挣扎、焚烧、屠杀，但大地对你们的野心毫不在意，很快就会向你们讨回这笔血债。”
“Your simple language does not possess the words necessary to describe the true beauty of this world, yet you think yourselves entitled to it. You thrash and burn and murder all in the name of dominance, but the earth cares little for your ambition and will soon have its revenge.”

Tiara Of Mind Fortification.name:
心智壁垒王冠
Tiara Of Mind Fortification

Text.text:
珠宝匠在这件作品上肯定过足了瘾。一顶精致的冠冕置于你眼前；你本以为它会璀璨夺目，可那宝石与金属却出奇地黯淡、低哑，令人莫名不适——仿佛它是为某个无法忍受强光的人打造的。凑近细看，便能看出宝石嵌放时的匠心，以及连接其间的细薄刻线：它们以一种陌生的纹路交织延伸。整体像一张网，而那些微小的宝石则如同节点，串联起每一道脉络。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

A jeweler certainly had the time of their life with this. A fine tiara sits before you, and though you expect it to dazzle and shine, the jewels and metal are uncomfortably dull, muted—as though it was built for someone who couldn’t tolerate bright lights. A closer look reveals the craftsmanship that went into the placement of the gems and the thin chiseled lines that connect them in an unfamiliar pattern. They seem to form a web, with the tiny jewels acting as connecting nodes.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

苍白的两趾脚掌掠过地面，钩爪般的趾尖在地上急促刮擦。那生物猛然一顿，两柄弯曲匕首从它那件油亮漆黑羽披的褶缝间甩出，已被它那带爪而灵巧的手稳稳握住、蓄势待发。它在兜帽深处低吼，嘴里密布细薄如针的尖牙。那双眼像黑曜石卵石般幽暗，却在阴影里诡异地闪光，凝着冰冷的恨意；更添寒意的，是它脸上本该是鼻子的地方伸出的一截锋利黑喙。
Pale, two-toed feet fly across the floor, taloned toes skittering. The creature pauses, two curved daggers flinging out from the folds of its cloak of oily black feathers, primed in clawed, nimble hands. It snarls from within its hood, its mouth needling with thin, pinprick teeth. Its eyes, obsidian pebbles that somehow glint from within, are hard with hatred; their chilling effect is enhanced by the sharp black beak that protrudes out of its face in place of a nose.

Nightmare On The Hunt In Dream World.name:
梦境世界：猎杀之夜噩梦
Nightmare On The Hunt In Dream World

Text.text:
这团心灵迷雾凝结成一幅影像，在梦境世界里潜行。它由做梦者最具体的恐惧与神话中那股渐次逼近的普遍寒意铸成，化作獠牙与利爪、瘦长纠结的肌肉，以及那双冷酷无情、紧盯猎物的凝视。它嗅闻着半成形的夜：蒸汽弥漫，奇异星座浮沉；继而又嗅到扭曲地貌上的泥泞。它抬头，忽然以超自然的速度狂奔。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

This monster of psychic mist congeals into an image, stalking the dreamworld. It is made of the specific fears of the dreamer and the general creeping dread of myth, taking form in fang and claw, gangly muscle, and the stare of merciless stalking. It sniffs the half-formed night of vapor and strange constellations, then the mud of a crooked landscape. It looks up and suddenly runs with preternatural speed.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

嵌在武器握柄里的黄铜护片上，镌刻着一幕幕震撼的画面：怪物猎人与猎物鏖战，暴怒与痛楚深深刻进每一张栩栩如生的面孔。小巧的十字弩以光滑抛光的木质打造，深色波纹如退潮的海面般在其上蜿蜒流淌。
Brass plates embedded in the grip of the weapon have been engraved with striking scenes of monster hunters battling their quarries, rage and pain etched upon each lifelike visage. The smooth, polished wood of the small crossbow is marbled with dark ripples like an ebbing tide.

Invited Into A Wealthy Home.name:
受邀进入富豪宅邸
Invited Into A Wealthy Home

Text.text:
一名阴沉的管家将你引入这座宫殿般的宅邸，几乎不加掩饰地流露出厌恶。奢华的前厅被铺天盖地的富贵缠绕——从金光灿灿的烛台，到你头顶那盏水晶吊灯，垂悬如神祇落下的一滴泪。烤肉与新出炉面包的香气撩拨着你的感官；你跟着仆役踏上宏伟的楼梯，走向上一层。

~ 构想：SeanB，来自 Discord

A dour butler ushers you into the palatial home, barely masking their disgust. The opulent foyer is wreathed in extravagance—from the golden candelabras to the crystal chandelier hanging above you like the tear of a god. The smell of roasting meat and fresh bread tantalizes your senses as you follow the servant up a magnificent staircase to the next floor.

~ Envisioned by SeanB on Discord

尖塔之间的缝隙、平顶的草甸以及四周的坡面，在不息的微风里依旧寂静无声。其间漂浮着一层幽幽发光的蓝色薄雾，雾顶平整如削，翻涌不定却从不抬升。细小的金色光点在雾中掠动，有的贴近雾面浮起，旋即又沉回去，渐渐黯淡消散。
Gaps between the spires, the flat-topped meadow, and the surrounding slopes are quiet, despite the constant breeze. Within them floats a dimly luminous blue mist with a flat upper surface that roils but never rises. Tiny golden lights flit through the fog. Some rise near the surface, then sink again and fade away.

营地热闹非凡，锦旗般的盛景里，五彩帐篷点缀着比武场地。每座帐亭都以专属纹样装点，织就一幅由雅致徽记交错而成的绚丽锦缎。旗帜与三角小旗迎风猎猎翻飞，宛如彩羽群鸟振翼。
The encampment is lively, a festive scene of multicolored tents dotting the tournament field. Each pavilion is adorned with its own bespoke design, creating a vibrant tapestry of elegant emblems. The banners and pennons flap in the breeze like the wings of colorful birds.

空气变得反常地冰冷，黑暗中你的呼吸开始凝成白雾，匍匐的霜意在地面上结出一层薄霜。空气微微荡漾，灵体在你面前凝聚成形，在幽暗里化作半透明的幽魂。那女子披着古老的护甲，双眼空洞失神，盛着一抹虚无的哀恸，寒意直透你的灵魂。
The air grows unnaturally cool, and your breath begins to mist in the darkness as a creeping frost rimes the ground. The air shimmers as the spirit coalesces before you, a translucent specter in the gloom. The woman is bedecked in ancient armor, and her eyes hold a vacant, hollow sadness which chills your soul.

Zalrin The Fallen.name:
堕落者扎尔林
Zalrin The Fallen

Text.text:
他的头颅向前耷拉着，仿佛悬在一圈宽阔的护颈里。头皮上稀疏垂下的黑发丝丝蠕动，轻薄如蛛网，他放出一阵战栗般的怪笑。胸前的胸甲凹陷斑驳，沾着久远战役留下的污渍，覆住他瘦得只剩骨架的躯干；而他那细长的腿像钟舌般悬荡。随后他呻吟着抬起头，那声音转瞬便变作野兽般的低吼。他的双眼喷吐出狐火般骇人的幽绿光芒，眼睑周围结着痂，颤抖不止。张开的嘴里飘出一股恶臭，下颌夸张地外翻，褐色牙齿上裹着浓稠起泡的唾液。

~ Played by Brannon

His head hangs forward, appearing suspended within a capacious gorget. Strings of black hair drooping sparsely from his scalp wriggle, wispy as cobwebs, as he lets loose a shuddery laugh. A breastplate, dented and stained from a long-ago battle, covers his rail-thin torso, and his spindly legs dangle like two clappers of a bell. He lifts his head with a groan that quickly transmutes into a bestial snarl. His eyes emit the ghastly green glow of foxfire, the lids about them crusted and quivering. A foul stench drifts from his open mouth, which gapes with extended jaw, brown teeth coated with thick, foaming spit.

~ Played by Brannon

Greeting From A Thriving Spaceport.name:
来自繁荣太空港的问候
Greeting From A Thriving Spaceport

Text.text:
“欢迎来到空间站！请提交你飞船的注册ID，我们会引导你前往合适的机库。对了，等待的时候不妨去看看我的网链账号。每周都有新鲜出炉的码头实况内容直送给你！”
“Welcome to the station! Please submit your ship’s registration ID and you will be directed to an appropriate hangar. And hey, while you wait, feel free to check out my netlink account. Fresh dock-based content coming at you every week!”

嵌在奥术工程师胸口的那枚金属碎片，周围是被灼焦的衣物与烙熟的血肉，宛如恐怖日晷上的一根针。旁边那张焦黑的书桌上摆着一台复杂得令人目眩的装置，扭曲的金属如花般向外绽开。工程师的面容上仍停着一抹浅笑，仿佛在殒命前的片刻，某个突破刚刚降临。
The shard of metal embedded in the arcane engineer’s chest is surrounded by scorched clothing and seared flesh, like a needle on a horrific sundial. A contraption of baffling complexity sits on the blackened desk nearby, warped metal blossoming out like a flower. A slight smile rests upon the engineer’s features, as if a breakthrough had graced them moments before their demise.

Nukrolir Onyxheart.name:
努克罗利尔·缟玛瑙之心
Nukrolir Onyxheart

Text.text:
背负长剑的辉光洒下，让这名源裔的黑曜石肌肤仿佛活了过来，浮动的光纹在其上摇曳不定。秘银甲片随着他的动作轻易屈伸，步伐稳得近乎机械。臂肘与指节咯吱作响，他单手抛掷、旋转一柄轻锤，像老练的杂技演员般轻松腾挪。源裔带着自负的咧笑注视着你，双眼闪着祖母绿般的光，却又透着几分疏离。

~ Played by Puffernami with

The glow of the sword strapped to his back makes the obsidian skin of the genasi come alive with wobbling light. Mithral plates flex readily over his body as he moves, steps almost mechanical in their surety. Joints of arm and finger grinding, he tosses and twirls a light hammer in one hand, juggling with the ease of a practiced acrobat. The genasi looks on with a cocksure grin, eyes shining emerald green, but also somewhat aloof.

~ Played by Puffernami with

Garbage In, Garbage Out.name:
输入垃圾，输出垃圾
Garbage In, Garbage Out

Text.text:
把盐倒进糖罐里只是恶作剧。可要是在你目标的设备上动动手脚，把两条基础指令悄悄重定向，这场调包就会立刻升级：比如“现在加速”变成“松油门”，或者 Scan File 变成 Delete。他们过度依赖肌肉记忆，十有八九会把错误指令一遍遍重复下去。选择两项输入或输出，然后尽情品尝那甜蜜——或咸涩——的结果。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

Salt in the sugar jar is a prank. Two redirects of basic commands on your mark’s device, and the switcheroo is elevated: accelerate now means throttle, or Scan File becomes Delete. An overreliance on muscle memory means they’ll probably repeat the erroneous commands. Choose two inputs or outputs, then enjoy the sweet—or salty—results.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这把弓的构造朴素：以单块木料削成可弯的弧形，以筋腱作弦。此武器既无握把，也毫无装饰可言，但弧心处的木面被持弓者的手磨得光亮温润，足以证明这把弓是一件可靠的工具。
The bow is simple in its composition: a flexible arc carved from a single piece of wood and strung with sinew. The weapon lacks a handle or, indeed, flourishes of any kind, but the wood is worn shiny and smooth at the center of its arc from a wielder’s hand, proving this bow to be a reliable tool.

这绝非寻常的农具。刀刃内侧的锋利弧线不见半点锈迹，银光般冷冽闪耀。它仿佛把日光吞入腹中，再吐出一层月辉；当你握紧那柄木质手柄——上面刻着月相的更迭——你感觉镰尖勾住了空气中无处不在的自然魔法之网。只要你在心中想起要施放的法术，一抹微光便沿着弧刃起舞，携着渐盈的威势光晕。

~ 一位英雄所构想

This is no mere farming implement. The sharpened inner curve of the blade is free of rust and shines like silver. It seems to drink in the daylight and reflect it as moonlight, and when you grip its wooden handle—carved with the lunar phases—you feel the sickle’s point catch on the omnipresent weave of nature-magic in the air. When you think of a spell you’d like to cast, a shimmer dances across the arc with a waxing aura of potency.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Creepy Grain Mill.name:
阴森的谷物磨坊
Creepy Grain Mill

Text.text:
在一层低雾贴地爬行、掠过荒芜田地的阴翳中，它矗立其间，像一位过气的王室暴君。外墙护板被天气侵蚀得斑驳不堪，底部霉烂发黑。风车的一片叶片朽坏得厉害，在死寂无风里也歪斜悬垂，只要有一丝微风便吱呀作响。磨坊里飘出腐败的气味；夜色降临时，磨坊角落的阴影里，一双双小眼睛悄然睁开。
Against a low fog crawling along the gloom of a fallow field, it stands like a royal despot past their prime. The siding is weather worn and moldy at the bottom. A blade of the windmill has degraded so badly that it lists in dead air, creaking in a slight breeze. The smell of rot comes from the mill, and as night falls, little pairs of eyes open in the shadows of the mill’s corners.

Dungeon: Corridor Turns Left.name:
地城：走廊向左转
Dungeon: Corridor Turns Left

Text.text:
走廊只再向前延伸一小段便向左拐去。右侧墙面坚实稳固——除非原路折返，否则想要继续前行，似乎只能取整转过拐角。
The corridor continues only a little farther before turning left. The wall on the right-hand side is solid and stable—it seems rounding the corner is the only way to venture on, unless one was to return the way they came.

Sundries From A Triceratops.name:
三角龙杂货铺
Sundries From A Triceratops

Text.text:
巨兽向前瘫倒，那庞大的爬行类负载终于在一滩猩红血泊中归于休息。你注意到它在最后那次冲锋里，有一截生物的角被生生崩断。那块坚硬的锥形骨片，必定大有用处。
The beast slumps forward, its immense reptilian bulk finally coming to a rest in a large pool of crimson blood. You notice that a piece of the creature’s horn snapped off in that last charge. The strong, conical piece of bone would certainly have some use.

Goblin Settlement In The Faerie Plane.name:
妖精位面的地精聚落
Goblin Settlement In The Faerie Plane

Text.text:
即便在这里——妖精界的幽深腹地——地精也能找到潮湿阴冷的洞穴，用来搭起他们粗制滥造的聚居地。高等精灵建筑的残骸被匆忙而笨拙地修补：碎木与回收的金属拼凑其上，又以巨型蜘蛛的蛛丝和它们几丁质的甲壳加固支撑。在洞窟般的空间黑暗里，妖精地精那乳白的眼睛一眨一眨，从他们的窝棚中窥视而出。
Even here, in the depths of the fey realm, goblins find dank holes in which to erect their slapdash settlements. Remnants of high elf structures, hastily and clumsily repaired with scraps of wood and salvaged metal, stand reinforced with the silk of massive spiders as well as their chitinous carapaces. In the darkness of the cavernous space, the milk-white eyes of fey goblins blink and peer out from their hovels.

大地震颤，一堵由毛皮与血肉筑成的庞然壁垒如攻城器械般碾过雪原。它左右摆动巨首前行，船只般巨大的獠牙横扫出一条通路。它的绒毛厚密，惨白如霜，腹下垂挂着冰凌，与四周的雪堆融为一体；而那双血红的眼睛游弋不定，搜寻着危险的踪影。白化巨兽用肌肉虬结的长鼻发出嘹亮的号鸣，吐息化作一团团刺骨的寒雾，滚滚喷涌。

~ Requested by Mr. Mischief

The ground trembles as the massive bulwark of fur and flesh moves like a siege engine through the snow, swaying its head from side to side as it sweeps a path with massive tusks the size of rowboats. Its wooly fur, stark white and hanging with icicles from its belly, blends in with the surrounding snow drifts, while its blood-red eyes roam in search of danger. The albino beast trumpets from its powerfully muscled trunk as it exhales breath in great plumes of frigid air.

~ Requested by Mr. Mischief

I Use Uncanny Dodge.name:
我使用【灵巧闪避】
I Use Uncanny Dodge

Text.text:
眼见那致命的攻击朝我逼近，我猛然拧身侧闪。绝境借予我的速度，正是我多苟活片刻所需的那一线优势。我翻身站稳，暗自筹划着我的反击。
Seeing the life-threatening attack coming toward me, I twist aside. Speed lent me by desperation, gives me the edge I need to survive just a bit longer. I roll to my feet, plotting my counterattack.

I Clash Weapons With A Demon Lord.name:
我与恶魔领主兵刃相交
I Clash Weapons With A Demon Lord

Text.text:
我们兵刃相撞的尖啸在我耳中回荡，沿着神经一路嗡鸣。我们死死缠斗在一起——彼此封住对方的推进，谁也不敢后退一步。恶魔领主的面孔在我眼前逼近，近得超出我所能容忍的界限。他们的眼中闪烁着对我以及我所珍爱一切的恶毒憎恨；当他们俯身凑来，那可憎的吐息在我皮肤上蒸腾，腐败的血肉与毒化的血腥味扑鼻而来。
The screech of our clashing weapons rings in my ears and sings in my nerves. We’re locked together—we block one another’s advance, and neither of us dares retreat. The face of the demon lord looms over me, closer than I ever would have wished. Their eyes gleam with a malignant hatred for me and everything I hold dear, and as they lean in, their wretched breath steams over my skin, reeking of corrupted flesh and poisoned blood.

你眼前那位慈祥如祖母般的幻影女子悄然滑开，露出其下非尘世的构造体：钢板覆身，弹簧关节咔哒作响，涂着油的肢体泛着幽光。那生物向前踏出一步，将一臂横叠在金属腹部，行了个彬彬有礼的鞠躬。就在这谄媚的斜坡姿态中，它的肩胛装甲错动分离，脊柱之位竟显出一柄手半剑。它并未触及那剑；而是挺直身形，站得无可挑剔，随即开口，嗓音如歌般悦耳，却又出奇地温暖。
The grandmotherly figure of the illusory woman before you slides away to reveal an unworldly construct comprised of steel plates, spring joints, and oiled appendages. The creature extends one foot forward and folds an arm across its metal abdomen in a courtly bow. In this obsequious incline, its scapular plates shift to reveal a bastard sword in place of a spine. It does not reach for the blade; instead, it straightens to perfect posture and begins to speak, its voice melodious and oddly warm.

I Perform Bardic Inspiration.name:
我施展吟游诗人的激励
I Perform Bardic Inspiration

Text.text:
我在心中回想命运的丝线。以心眼牢牢攫住那道幻象，我在琴弦上轻轻拨出几段音符。随后，我唱出朋友的名字，让那枚属于他们的音高在和声中击响一次。奥秘的旋律牵动他们的命数，使他们的动作与之同调。
I call to mind the strands of fate. With the vision held in my mind’s eye, I pluck a few notes on my strings. Then, singing my friend’s name, I hit their note once in harmony. The arcane melody moves their destiny and their actions into accord.

Tabasco The Tabaxi Actor.name:
塔巴斯科——塔巴西族角色
Tabasco The Tabaxi Actor

Text.text:
你们正朝酒馆走近，摇摆的沙龙门猛地炸开，一道人形身影像被人掷出去般飞出门外，重重落进尘土里，却迅速翻滚卸力，随即轻巧地站起身来。被轰出来的客人拍打着自己，你们这才发现，他真正的麻烦多半不是那身俗艳的紫色衣装，而是短短的、斑驳的黑色毛发里沾满的尘土。那猫科般的轮廓愈发清晰——这名猫族男性揉去眼角的尘，露出一双异色瞳：一只黄，一只蓝。他又从头到脚拍了拍，确认随身物件毫发无损，随后顿住，低头检查腰带上一只特定的小袋。下一刻，一只老鼠飞快从袋口钻出，爬上猫人的手腕背侧。

~ Played by Túlio Cerquize

As you approach the tavern, the saloon doors burst open and a humanoid figure flies through the air as if hurled, landing in the dust but rolling quickly to absorb the impact, and coming lightly to their feet. As the ousted customer brushes themselves down, you notice that their difficulties deal mostly with the dust gathered in their short, mottled black fur rather than their gaudy purple clothing. Distinctly feline features reveal themselves as the catfolk male rubs the dust from his eyes, which are heterochromatic, in yellow and blue. He pats himself down, making certain that no harm has come to his possessions, then stops and checks on one particular pouch located on his belt. A mouse quickly crawls out of the pouch and up onto the back of the cat person’s wrist.

~ Played by Túlio Cerquize

Nightmare About Broken Glass.name:
碎玻璃的噩梦
Nightmare About Broken Glass

Text.text:
如同一位反复无常的妖精女王的领地，这间狭小的房间里每一件物体都完全由澄澈通透的玻璃制成。你的倒影从千百个多棱切面的表面凝视着你——随即，那张与你一模一样的脸上绽开一抹恶毒的狞笑。伴着一声刺耳尖啸，房间轰然炸裂成一场无处可逃的暴风雨：剃刀般锋利的碎片四下狂舞，每一片都像刀子般撕开你的血肉，把你的身体绞成一团支离破碎的残躯与参差的内脏。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Like the domain of a capricious fey queen, every object in the small room is made entirely of crystal-clear glass. Your reflection gazes at you from a thousand multi-faceted surfaces—then a wicked grin spreads across your doppelganger’s face. With a keening screech the room explodes into an inescapable tempest of razor-sharp fragments, each one tearing into your flesh like a knife, leaving your body a shredded mass of ragged viscera.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Aboleth: Tentacle Disease.name:
底栖魔鱼：触手疫病
Aboleth: Tentacle Disease

Text.text:
触手落下之处一片冰冷，黏腻而污秽。

[豁免失败] 那股冰寒、肮脏的触感扩散开来。

[豁免失败后1分钟] 你的皮肤变得湿冷而半透明，在空气中迅速干燥。离开水域的念头令你不安。

[豁免失败后10分钟] 你的皮肤在干裂中开出细纹。它发痒、灼痛，并开始剥落成屑。你强烈渴望回到水里。立刻！

[豁免成功] 那股感觉逐渐消退。

Where the tentacle landed feels cold and soiled.

[Failed Save] The icy, unclean sensation spreads.

[1 Minute After a Failed Save] Your skin becomes clammy and translucent, drying quickly in the air. The idea of being out of the water unnerves you.

[10 Minutes After a Failed Save] Your skin cracks as it dries. It itches, burns, and starts to crumble. You feel a need to be in the water. Now!

[Successful Save] The feeling wanes.

Coming In From The Cold.name:
从寒冷中归来
Coming In From The Cold

Text.text:
你推开门时，一股暖意扑面而来，把你从刺骨的寒夜里招呼进去。昏暗的屋内，低垂的火盆与火把映出摇曳光影，香料热酒的辛甜气息像毯子一样覆在每位酒客的低声嘟囔之上。酒保冲你吼道：“嗬！进来把门给关上，成不？你把暖气都放跑啦。”
As you push open the door, a warm waft of air rushes toward you, beckoning you in from the frigid evening. The dusky room is lit with low-hanging braziers and torches, and the spiced smell of mulled spirits lies like a blanket over every patron’s muttered words. The bartender hollers at you: “Ho! Close that door after ye, yeah? Y’er letting all the warm out.”

Witchwood: The Woods.name:
巫林：林地
Witchwood: The Woods

Text.text:
林地静得诡异。你听见风的尖啸，可四周的树木仿佛在半个动作里凝固，黑黢黢的枝杈如同手指向上触及，想去抓挠灰蒙蒙的天空。泥泞的小径两侧挤满了无叶的枝条，密密匝匝，将你逼仄地夹在其中。远处传来一声兽鸣回荡，提醒你：在这座树之坟场里，确实仍有生命能存活。
The wood stands strangely still. You hear the whistle of the wind, but around you the trees seem frozen mid gesture as they reach their dark fingers to scratch the gray sky. A dense thicket of leafless branches lines the muddy trail, hemming you in. When you hear an animal’s call echoing from the distance, it reminds you that something can indeed live in this tomb of trees.

Wave-cut Platform At Low Tide.name:
低潮时的海蚀台
Wave-cut Platform At Low Tide

Text.text:
在陡峭海崖的崖脚处，一道如石凳般的岩脊与海岸相接，紧贴着浪涛的拍打。岩面上刻着古怪的起伏纹路，仿佛海浪自身的回声，历经漫长的岁月被一层层磨蚀进石里。海鸟栖息在上方的峭壁间，偶尔俯冲向潮池，叼起一小口海中生灵，带回去敲碎外壳，大快朵颐。
At the base of a sheer coastal cliff, a kind of stone bench meets the shore and the waves. Strange, undulating patterns carved into the rock evoke the waves themselves, worn into the surface over many eons. Seabirds roost in the cliffs above, occasionally diving for a tidal pool to snatch up a morsel of sea life to crack open and feast upon.

Loot From A Pursuant Minion Dunker.name:
来自穷追不舍的爪牙“扣篮者”的战利品
Loot From A Pursuant Minion Dunker

Text.text:
一枚锃亮的金属徽章挂在她颈间的金属链上。再仔细翻查她的长袍，你在她胸腹附近摸到一个暗藏的口袋，里面塞着一只装满钱币的小袋子。
A gleaming metal medallion hangs on a metal chain about her neck. Searching through the robes further, you find a hidden pocket near her torso and a pouch of coins within it.

Complicated Dinner Order.name:
复杂的晚餐点单
Complicated Dinner Order

Text.text:
“羊肉，但要先炖后煮——放香草枝，不要肉汁。上回太油腻，腥膻也重。现在听仔细了。布丁我要先上，冷的那种配奶油，但还要热、热的茶和蜂蜜。去办好，明白吗。”
“The mutton, but braise it before you boil it—and with the sprigs but not the gravy. Too heavy and gamey last time. Now, listen carefully. I want the pudding first, the cold one with cream, but also with hot, hot tea and honey. See to it, then.”

Warning From A Hunted People.name:
来自被追猎之民的警告
Warning From A Hunted People

Text.text:
“你们的人口口声声谈和平与和解，可你可曾想过，我并不甘心只被容忍？更何况还是被你们这种人。”
“Your people speak of peace and reconciliation, but has it occurred to you that I do not wish to be merely tolerated? Especially not by your kind.”

Crater On A Desolate Moon.name:
荒凉月面上的陨石坑
Crater On A Desolate Moon

Text.text:
陨坑在这颗荒凉的月球表面剜出一道巨大的、豁开的创口，向下坠入无光的深渊，深达数百英尺。参差破碎的月壳边缘在近旁恒星炽烈的光芒中化作剪影，恍若一片辽阔而陌生的群山脊线。
The crater gouges out a vast, gaping wound in the surface of the desolate moon, descending several hundred feet into lightless depths. The ragged edges of the crust are silhouetted against the blazing light of a nearby star, giving them the appearance of a vast alien mountain range.

Renewal Of The Tower Interior.name:
高塔内部的焕新
Renewal Of The Tower Interior

Text.text:
每年一次，教授与学生都会聚集在一起，呼唤复苏之神，并举行那场能加固、净化、并重新缝合塔内墙石块的仪式。他们绕着塔楼的前厅——被扩展到其物理极限——围成一圈，面向墙壁，吟诵仪式的开端。仪式结束时，他们转而彼此相对；而在他们身后，墙体自行重塑，牢牢合拢，再度坚固，以便在接下来的一年里稳稳容纳万千事物。
Once a year, the professors and students gather to call on the God of Renewal and perform the ritual that strengthens, cleans, and rejoins the stones of the tower’s interior wall. They circle the foyer of the tower—expanded to its physical limit—and face the wall, chanting the ritual’s beginning. They finish facing one another, as behind them the wall reforms itself to hold fast and contain multitudes for another year.

Site Of An Excavation In The Earth.name:
地底发掘现场
Site Of An Excavation In The Earth

Text.text:
鹤嘴镐、铁锹、锤子与凿子散落在坑沿四周。这坑约深十五尺、宽二十尺。泥土与碎石堆成一簇簇土包，围着工地杂乱堆叠。一座摇摇欲坠的木制脚手架通向下方的土坑，牵引着你的视线落在……某种残骸上。遗迹？雕像？坑底那怪异而令人不安的轮廓渐渐清晰，而你脑中几乎同时冒出两个疑问：那件物体究竟是什么？以及——把它挖出来的工人，都去哪了？
Pickaxes, shovels, hammers, and chisels lie discarded about the pit, roughly fifteen feet deep by twenty feet wide. Dirt and broken stone lie in piles about the site. A flimsy wooden scaffolding leads down into the earthen pit, drawing your gaze to the remnants of . . . something. A ruin? A statue? A strange, unnerving shape comes into focus at the bottom of the pit, and simultaneously you wonder two things: What is the object? And where are the workers who unearthed it?

Loot From A Nalfeshnee.name:
来自纳尔费什尼的战利品
Loot From A Nalfeshnee

Text.text:
在这名倒下的敌人腰间，一条由破烂布条与锁链编成的腰带上挂着些许战利品。一个粉红色皮革小袋里装着一小把来历各异的几枚钱币。腰带正中央，一枚嶙峋的黑岩扣环从内部泛起猩红幽光。它被雕成一颗咆哮的纳尔菲什尼头骨，獠牙化作黑色尖刺向外刺出。
Around the waist of this fallen foe, a belt of tattered cloth and chain bears some treasures. A pouch of pinkish leather holds a small collection of coins of varying origin. At the center of their belt, a buckle of gnarled black rock gleams crimson from within. It has been carved into the shape of a roaring nalfeshnee skull, with tusks protruding out in black spikes.

矮人婴儿带着明确的目的爬行，用粗壮的四肢奋力向前翻滚。无论是岩石还是泥土都无法拖慢他们——相反，他们似乎沉醉于泥尘之中，在探索时乐呵呵地把自己弄得脏兮兮的。
The infant dwarf crawls with a purpose, churning forward on stout limbs. Neither stone nor soil slows them—in fact, they seem to revel in the dirt, happily staining themselves as they explore.

Mob Surrounding City Hall.name:
市政厅外的人潮围堵
Mob Surrounding City Hall

Text.text:
暴民的喧嚣怒吼在广场上回荡——他们的诉求被愤怒与挫败的合唱吞没。许多人高举拳头猛力挥舞，另一些则挥动着粗陋的武器，如棍棒与长矛，或将火把高高擎起。还有几人挤到前方，重重捶打市政厅厚实的橡木大门，要求进入——要求发言的权利。城楼垛口上的守卫们彼此交换着不安的眼神，因为下方的人远比守住这座建筑的他们要多得多。

~ 构想：Girlhead

The clamoring shouts of the mob echo across the plaza—their demands lost in a chorus of anger and frustration. Many pump their fists in the air, while others brandish simple weapons like cudgels and spears, or hold torches aloft. A few step forward to bang on the heavy oaken doors of the city hall, demanding entrance—demanding the right to speak. The guards manning the parapets above exchange worried glances, for there are far more below than there are defending the building.

~ Envisioned by Girlhead

Ship Glitch Gremlin.name:
飞船故障小魔怪（特征）
Ship Glitch Gremlin

Text.text:
这只妖精灵体干瘦而敏捷，振翅穿行于空中时发出咯咯怪笑，肆意的欢愉像涎水般外溢，循着附近科技的蛛丝马迹直扑而去。它灰扑扑的小身躯生着两片蝙蝠似的翅膀，没完没了地拍打着，托着生物与它那带爪的小阴谋四处游荡。瘦骨嶙峋的躯干上顶着一颗三眼脑袋，鼓胀而诡异，挂着一抹恶毒的笑。脏兮兮的兜裆布下，一条彩色尾巴晃悠悠地垂着。
Wiry and spry, this fey spirit gibbers with a wanton glee as it wings its way through the air, homing in on signs of nearby tech. Its little gray body sports two batlike wings that flap incessantly, carrying the creature and its clawed little schemes. Atop the skinny body sits a three-eyed head, bulbous, smiling its nasty smile. A multicolored tail dangles from beneath a dirty loincloth.

Divine Hall Of A Goddess Of Pleasure.name:
欢愉女神的神圣殿堂
Divine Hall Of A Goddess Of Pleasure

Text.text:
这场盛宴颂扬着生命——既颂扬举箸之人，也颂扬邀请饥者入席之人。烛枝灯下的长桌泛着柔光，谈笑如泉，手或在桌下相扣，或隔着桌面相握。一位吟游诗人弹唱助兴。似乎无人主事，也根本不需要设什么上座。空气里尽是交谈与香气，葡萄酒与面包的气息，以及深沉的同心协作。几扇薄纱般遮掩的门通往别的房间，那里还有别样的欢愉。那份丰盈的满足感，让欢愉女神想起明日该去见她的姐妹——她们将谈论痛楚——以及感恩。
The meal celebrates the lives of those who eat and those who invite the hungry. Long tables under candelabras glow with good talk and hands held under or across the board. A bard sings and plays. No one seems to be in charge, nor is there need for a head of the table. The air is conversation and aroma, wine and bread and deep cooperation. Lightly veiled doors lead to other rooms for other pleasures. There is a rich contentment that reminds the Goddess of Pleasure to see her sister tomorrow, where they will discuss Pain—and gratitude.

Rigger's Apartment.name:
装配师的公寓
Rigger's Apartment

Text.text:
门一开，柔和的室内灯光随之亮起。门槛之外，是一间敞开的公寓，空气里混着塑料、金属与机油的气味。光学玻璃纤维覆盖了每一寸表面。这种材料在墙上铺展开一片片显示界面，满是设计图、数据流与不断滚动的计算。桌上散落着零件、工具与半成品装置；电线碎段、细小螺丝与卡扣、以及未加工材料的刨屑像地毯般铺满拼花木地板。水槽里碗碟堆叠如山，旁边则是一整面墙的3D打印机。只有房间中央那套光亮如新、宛如驾驶舱的装置仍旧干净而抛光，四周环绕着投影器。一只毛绒兔子从装置的冲击泡沫座椅上直勾勾地望着你。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Soft interior lights illuminate as the door opens. Beyond the threshold sprawls an open apartment that smells of plastic, metal, and oil. Optical fiberglass covers every surface. This material creates wall displays full of plans, feeds, and running calculations. Parts, tools, and half-finished devices litter the tables, while bits of wire, tiny screws and fasteners, and shavings of raw materials carpet the parquet. Dishes pile in the sink, alongside a wall of 3D printers. Only a glossy cockpit-like rig in the room’s center, surrounded with projectors, remains clean and polished. A stuffed rabbit stares from the rig’s impact-foam seat.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Ioun Stone Of Agility.name:
敏捷艾欧石
Ioun Stone Of Agility

Text.text:
这枚小巧、抛光得光滑如镜的球体闪耀着炫目的猩红，入手轻若羽毛。石质表面被细致地蚀刻着一个小小的符号——但你并不认得。球体散发出奥术的微光，柔和的嗡鸣在晶体中震颤回响。
The small, polished sphere is a scintillating shade of crimson and feels light as a feather. A small symbol has been etched delicately into the stone surface—though it is not one you recognize. The sphere glows with arcane light, and a soft hum vibrates through the crystal.

Adventuring Equipment Shop In Town.name:
城镇里的冒险装备店
Adventuring Equipment Shop In Town

Text.text:
一栋高大结实的建筑坐落在街角，由坚硬的灰色石块与粗壮的原木混砌而成。敞开的窗户把油脂与鞣制皮革的气味送到街上。厚重的木门上方悬着一块摇摆的招牌：一柄剑交叉压在一面盾牌上，下面醒目写着“补给”。

你迈步入内，环顾四周。墙面一排排挂满了长剑、盾牌以及各式各样的兵器。角落里，几套擦得锃亮的护甲端端正正立在架上，仿佛在炫耀。另一侧，雅致的长弓挂在支架上，为了妥善保管，弓弦已被卸下。房间深处，一张结实的木凳旁散放着磨刀石与皮革加工工具；不远处是一张刚打过蜡、桌面光可鉴人的长柜台，柜台后坐着店主。
A large, sturdy building sits at the corner, constructed from a mix of hard gray stone and wooden logs. Open windows allow the smell of oil and worked leather to waft out into the streets. Above the heavy wooden door hangs a swinging sign with a sword crossed atop a shield and the word "Supplies" emblazoned on it.
 
 You step inside and glance around. The walls are lined with swords, shields and all other manner of weaponry. In one corner impeccably polished suits of armor stand proudly upon their racks. In another, elegant bows hang from mountings, their strings removed for safekeeping. At the back of the room, whetstones and leatherworking tools lie by a stout wooden stool not far from the long glossy top of a freshly waxed desk, behind which sits the shopkeeper.

Corporate Security Closes In.name:
企业安保步步逼近
Corporate Security Closes In

Text.text:
印着企业徽标的载具在附近停下，身着黑色战术道具的安保部队持枪鱼贯而出。他们不受任何准则或信条约束，除了下一笔企业薪资；这群企业打手带着危险而难以捉摸的傲慢逼近，开口对你发话。
Vehicles bearing corporate livery stop nearby as security forces in black tactical gear emerge with weapons drawn. Unbound by any code or creed beyond their next corporate paycheck, the corpo goons approach with a dangerous, unpredictable arrogance as they address you.

Loot From A Sprite.name:
来自小妖精（特征）的战利品
Loot From A Sprite

Text.text:
在这妖精身上，你找到一袋由编织的槲寄生制成的箭矢。尽管这翠绿的弹药做工精美——且必然价值不菲——你却怀疑自己能否在实战中派上用场。
On the faerie, you find a quiver of arrows crafted from woven mistletoe. Though the viridian ammunition is beautifully made—and surely valuable—you doubt you could use them practically.

Seamless Sword Cane.name:
无缝剑杖
Seamless Sword Cane

Text.text:
整根手杖以抛光的黑木制成，顶端是一颗雕工精湛的乌鸦头。握柄轻轻一拧，接缝随即显露，一道细薄的刀刃无声地从暗藏的鞘中滑出。剑尖阴狠锐利，专为在出其不意的一击中令对手失去战力而打造。
The entire length of the cane is polished black wood, topped with an expertly carved raven's head. With a twist of the handle, the seams reveal themselves, and a thin blade glides silently out of its hidden sheath. The tip of the sword is wicked sharp, made to debilitate in one unexpected strike.

Neural Implant Emergency Broadcast Annou.name:
神经植入体紧急广播通告
Neural Implant Emergency Broadcast Announcement

Text.text:
毫无预兆，一道紧急广播信号在你的视网膜显示上骤然闪现，强行覆盖了所有程序。警报以粗体猩红字样告诉你：相邻星系已正式对你的星球宣战。广播循环播放了两遍，覆盖随即解除，你回过神来，只见自己湿冷发黏、微微发抖的双手正映入眼帘。
Without warning, an emergency broadcast signal flashes across your retinal display, overriding all programs. In bold red text the alert informs you that a neighboring system has officially declared war on your planet. The broadcast loops twice before the override stops and you find yourself staring at your clammy, shaking hands.

Island Of Vampire Pirates.name:
吸血鬼海盗之岛
Island Of Vampire Pirates

Text.text:
阴森的迷雾裹住寂静的海岸，你把船只系在码头上，轻轻一声闷响，仿佛棺盖最后一枚钉子被敲进木头里。拍岸的浪声被压得发闷，蝙蝠在头顶喋喋乱叫，一阵不祥的嚎叫撕开空气。悬崖之上，曾经熙攘的聚落如今只剩白骨般的残垣断壁，凄然望向海面，像一位寡妇守候着失踪的恋人归来。

~ Envisioned by SecretToEveryon3

A sinister fog envelops the silent shore as you moor your craft at the docks with a soft thud, like the final nail of a coffin lid being hammered home. The lapping waves are muted, and bats chitter overhead as a baleful howl cuts the air. On the cliffs above, the skeletal ruins of a once bustling settlement gaze mournfully across the sea, like a widow waiting for their lost love to return.

~ Envisioned by SecretToEveryon3

你吟诵之际，伸出一只手，像塑土般揉捏空气，仿佛亲眼看见大地被塑成你想要的模样。用两只手并不会让法术更好用——魔法懂得你的意志——但那感觉更为真实。双手并用时，你几乎能感觉到植物从指间滑过，随着你重塑地貌。
As you chant, you reach out a hand and mold the air as you would see the earth shaped. The spell doesn’t work any better with two hands—the magic understands your will—but it feels more real. With two hands you can almost feel the plants slipping between your fingers as you shape the landscape.

这名身形匀称的男子举止从容，面容坦然开朗，常年笑意在脸上刻下细纹；一头黑色脏辫间杂着灰白，勾勒出他的轮廓。榛绿色的眼睛闪着戏谑与好奇的光。胸背覆着伤痕斑驳的煮制皮甲，内衬一件朴素的短袖亚麻束衫。腰间系着一条宽阔、包铁加固的皮带，一侧挂着宽刃短剑，另一侧挂着长匕；背后斜挂一张弯曲短弓与一壶箭矢。及膝的亚麻裤让小腿裸露至简朴的凉鞋。外露皮肤上遍布海娜纹身，如同写满诗句的篇章，几乎遮住他手臂上的战痕。他披着一件精致的绿色披风，其上以金线绣着公羊纹样，脚踝处一圈金脚镯，与其余朴素装束形成微妙反差。

~ 由 Spac3cowboyy 以 Played 之名登场，角色卡见

This gracefully built man has an open face, lined from smiling, framed in dreadlocked black hair peppered with gray. His hazel eyes sparkle with mirth and curiosity. Scarred boiled leather covers his chest and back over a plain linen tunic with short sleeves. Girding his waist is a broad iron-shod belt, holding a broad shortsword on one hip, a long knife on the other; a curved shortbow and quiver of arrows hang at the back. His knee-length linen pants leave his lower legs bare down to his simple sandals. Henna tattoos, poetry, cover much of his exposed skin, almost hiding battle scars on his arms. His fine green mantle, embroidered with a gold-thread ram, and gold anklet belie the humility of the rest of his attire.

~ Played by Spac3cowboyy with

Jaeron Oathforge.name:
贾埃隆·誓铸者
Jaeron Oathforge

Text.text:
身着紫与黑的衣装，披着厚重的板甲，宛如他高贵家族中历代矮人骑士一般，这名矮人挺直肩膀，神情冷峻不露波澜。他用右手粗壮的手指抚平那把令人惊叹的胡须上四股编辫，左手稳稳握着一面浮雕盾牌。背上系着的战斧似乎丝毫不影响他的平衡，还被巧妙固定得恰到好处，不会妨碍他从腰背处抽出那两柄手斧。

~ 由 Will Ezell 扮演

Decked out in purple and black clothing, with heavy plate armor like the dwarf knights of his noble house before him, the dwarf squares his shoulders and adopts an impassive air. He smooths down the four braids of his impressive beard with the thick fingers of his right hand and holds an embossed shield in his left. The battleaxe strapped to his back does not appear to affect his balance in any meaningful way, and has been rigged in such a way so as not to interfere with the draw of the two handaxes at the small of his back.

~ Played by Will Ezell

Alien Senate Meeting.name:
异形参议院会议
Alien Senate Meeting

Text.text:
异星元老院在一座辉煌宏伟的大厅中召开会议，来自无数星球与诸多种族的代表齐聚一堂，商讨整个星系的命运。气氛凝重，议员们审议至关重要的议题；然而争辩声渐起，情绪愈发激烈。每一个文明的未来，都系于这座平等议政之厅里作出的抉择。
The alien senate convenes in a magnificent hall, delegates from myriad planets and species gathered to discuss the fate of the system. The mood is somber as the members deliberate crucial matters, but voices get raised and emotions run high. The future of every civilization hinges on decisions made in this chamber of equals.

Mature False Hydra.name:
成熟的假九头蛇
Mature False Hydra

Text.text:
爆裂的鹅卵石声渐渐沉下，化作石子簌簌的回响；被冲击波卷入的人群踉跄起身，双腿发软，许多面孔仍凝着惊骇。街心裂开一处空洞，如洞窟之口森然张开。你听见黑暗里血肉拖拽着泥土的沉重摩擦声，还有一阵像一群无赖在沙哑嗓音里窃笑的笑声。守卫高喊：“什么人？！”七条幽白的脖颈自洞中蜿蜒探出，托着七颗扭曲狰狞的头颅——长着类人的长牙与空洞无眼的眼窝——对着尖叫的镇民咧嘴而笑。一只类人手掌从它迟缓臃肿的躯体根部伸出，攫住此刻已在发抖的守卫腰间。守卫尖叫起来：先是一挤之力压得护甲变形、长剑折断，随后又被提向其中一颗咬合作响的头颅，那滴涎的下颚张裂得足以将他整个人吞入腹中。

~ 构想 by Steve Adamski

The sound of exploding cobblestones settles to a stony rattle, and the passersby caught in the blast begin to stand, shakily, many faces still shocked. A hole like the mouth of a cavern gapes in the middle of the street. You hear the weighty dragging of flesh over dirt within the dark, and a sound like a group of ne’er-do-wells chuckling in rasping voices. A guard shouts, “Who goes there?” Seven ghost-white necks snake out of the hole, supporting seven grimacing heads—with long humanoid teeth and eyeless sockets—that grin at the shrieking townsfolk. A humanoid hand stretches out from the sluggish base of its body, grabbing the now trembling guard about his waist. The guard shrieks as his body is first crushed by a squeeze that bends armor and snaps sword, and then lifted toward one of the gnashing heads, its drooling jaw stretching wide enough to swallow his body whole.

~ Envisioned by Steve Adamski

Black Dragon Lair.name:
黑龙巢穴
Black Dragon Lair

Text.text:
在这片最为阴森可怖的沼泽深处，你发现了一座洞穴，洞内灌满了咸涩发臭的污水。踏入其中的人无需费力搜寻，也不必久看，便能发现受害者的残骸——被强酸灼成焦黑，被利爪撕成碎片，被巨颚嚼得粉碎，或三者齐全。因为这里正是一头传奇怪物——黑龙——的巢穴，而踏足此地的探险者还能再见天日的概率，几乎微乎其微。
Deep within these most forbidding swamplands, you come across a cave filled with brackish, stinking water. One who enters such a cave would not have to look very hard, or very long, to find the remains of victims scorched with powerful acid, torn asunder by claws, crunched by massive jaws, or all three, for such a cave is the lair of a legendary monster, a black dragon, and the odds are quite infinitesimal that an explorer of this place will ever see daylight again.

I Brush And Braid My Beard.name:
我梳理并编起我的胡须
I Brush And Braid My Beard

Text.text: 我用梳子梳过胡须，齿间每一次拉扯都把卷曲的毛发拽得伸展开来，在光下微微闪亮。“Tcha,”我对自己啧了一声，扯到一处纠结时，连下巴与脖颈的皮肤都被拽得刺痛。好不容易理顺了大半的结与毡团，我捻起几缕胡须，开始编辫。我想，三股粗大的辫子会是个潇洒的选择。 I pass a brush through my beard, the curls glimmering as they stretch out with each pull of the teeth. “Tcha,” I tut to myself as I pull at a tangle, the skin of my chin and neck stinging. Once I’ve worked through most of the tangles and mats, I take a few strands between my fingers and begin to braid. I decide three large plaits would be a dashing choice.

Patre Orthronus.name:
帕特雷·奥瑟罗努斯
Patre Orthronus

Text.text:
一名神情严峻的水手立在船舷边，蓝色外套在咸湿的浪沫里翻卷，像一面旗帜猎猎作响。三角帽檐下，他的面庞被海上岁月晒成古铜色——他的名声也同样因英勇事迹而熠熠生辉。棕色眼睛被风霜刻出的细纹框起，死死锁定着一艘敌船。指挥官的命令已烙进脑海，他抽出一对燧发手枪，咬紧牙关，逼自己沉入战斗的冷静。

~ Played by Don with

A stern mariner stands at the ship’s railing, his blue coat rippling like an ensign in the salt spray. Beneath a tricorn hat, his face has been bronzed by a life at sea—his reputation likewise burnished by heroic deeds. Brown eyes, framed by weather-worn creases, are trained on an enemy vessel. With his commander’s orders seared into his mind, he draws a pair of pistols and steels himself for battle.

~ Played by Don with

她沉着从容，仪态端方，行走间带着老练战士般的猫科平衡感。微风伴她左右，拂面清凉，吹得她那条金色长辫轻轻摇曳。她肤色苍白，双眸湛蓝。这位半元素女性身着黑色皮甲与锁子甲，以磨炼她那玄秘的技艺；然而她的长剑、盾牌与弩同样致命，丝毫不逊于她的魔法。

~ 由一位英雄 Played

She is poised, dignified, and walks with the feline balance of a practiced fighter. A breeze attends her, cooling her face and making her long blond braid of hair sway. Her skin is pale, her eyes blue. The half-elemental woman wears black leather and chain mail to practice her eldritch skills, though her long sword and shield and crossbow are as deadly as her magic.

~ Played by a Hero

Invisible Stalker Attack.name:
隐形追猎者攻击
Invisible Stalker Attack

Text.text:
起初你还以为那只是风在呜咽般的呼啸，直到为时已晚，你才意识到这绝非寻常气流。一记猛撞攻击仿佛从虚空中袭来，将你撞得踉跄，你这才明白自己已成了某个隐形生物的猎物，必须抵御一个看不见的袭击者。
At first mistaken for a simple whistling of the wind, you realize too late that this is no mere draft. When a slam attack buffets you from seemingly nowhere, you realize you have become the prey of an invisible creature and must defend yourself against an assailant that cannot be seen.

Deserted House: Back To Safety.name:
废弃宅邸：重返安全之地
Deserted House: Back To Safety

Text.text:
你走出屋外，寂静如同一扇门猛地拍在你脸上，迎面砸来。一阵寒风掠过，贴着你裸露的皮肤卷起一层鸡皮疙瘩，吹向此刻沉寂的屋子，逼得木板发出轻微的吱呀声。你既看不见也听不见乌鸦的任何踪迹；屋墙之外的世界仿佛死去一般，毫无生气。
You step outside the house and the silence hits you like a door slammed in your face. A chill breeze raises goosebumps on your skin as it blows against the now-quiescent house, causing gentle creaking. You neither see nor hear any sign of the crows, as the world beyond the house’s walls seems lifeless.

Evil Mage's Quarters.name:
邪恶法师的居所
Evil Mage's Quarters

Text.text:
你踏入黑暗法师的私人居所，陈旧纸张与刺鼻药剂的气味猛地扑上鼻端。脚下原本或许是华丽的紫金地毯，如今却被踩得板结，破口累累。两座从地到顶的书柜占据整面后墙，塞满古老典籍与阴森小玩意，其中甚至有一只蜥蜴人风干成木乃伊的断手。角落里挤着一张衬着缎面的窄床，好腾出位置给一张巨大的石板工作台。台面斑驳布满奥术符文的刻痕，几只盛着毒烈液体的烧杯在其上咕嘟冒泡。羽毛笔与墨水搁在一本摊开的巨著旁，仿佛写字的人正写到一半，忽然停住。
The smell of old paper and chemicals assault your nose as you enter the personal quarters of the dark mage. The flooring that might once have been a fine purple and gold carpet is now matted and torn. Two floor-to-ceiling bookcases make up the back wall. They are filled with ancient tomes and dark trinkets, including a mummified lizard folk hand. A small satin-lined bed is pushed to the far corner to make space for a large, stone slab worktable. Carvings of arcane runes mottle the surface, while beakers of noxious fluids bubble atop it. A quill and ink lie beside an open tome as though a writer stopped mid-note.

Tracks In Mud.name:
泥泞中的足迹
Tracks In Mud

Text.text:
足迹陷入泥中的深度暴露了它的体重与速度，而爪痕的朝向则暗示这头野兽一边移动，一边可能不断转身窥视四周。泥里那些拖拽与扯拉的痕迹表明它不是正承受痛楚，就是带着旧伤。等泥地让位于更坚硬的地面，足迹便变得模糊难辨，追踪也随之愈发艰难。
The depth of the tracks gives away weight and speed, while the direction of the claws indicates that the animal might have been turning to watch its surroundings as it moved. Drags and pulls suggest that this beast is either in pain or has an old injury. When the mud disappears to harder ground, the tracks become less distinct and more challenging to follow.

Sleeping Elemental Hydra.name:
沉眠的元素九头蛇
Sleeping Elemental Hydra

Text.text:
你踏入地城尽头的宏伟厅堂，只见一具赤红的龙形躯体蜷伏在地，脊背起伏如瓦楞般的嶙峋棘脊正对着你。那怪物缓缓舒展开来，五颗头颅接连打着哈欠——九头蛇。最左的一颗头骨方硬，长着带角的吻端，仿佛专为掘地而生；第二条颈项生着褶边，如翼般舒张，鼻孔喷吐着白汽。居中的头颅相貌寻常，而第四颗却燃着火炬般的双眼，巨口张开如灿烂的落日；最后一颗则像漂在起伏海面上般上下点晃，涎水从口中滴落。随后，它们又再次休息。

~ 一位英雄所构想

You enter the great chamber at the end of the dungeon and see a red draconic body lying in a curl, the corrugated ridge of its spine to you. The beast uncurls and five heads yawn—a hydra. The leftmost has a blockish skull with a horned snout, as if for burrowing; the neck of the next has frills, like wings, while the nostrils puff steam. The central head has a normal visage, but the fourth is lit with eyes like torches and a mouth opening like a brilliant sunset; and the final head bobs and dips as if on a wavy ocean, slobber dripping from its mouth. Then they rest again.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The Valehaven Estate.name:
谷港庄园
The Valehaven Estate

Text.text:
作为斯派尔威奇最古老、最富有的两大家族之一，谷港庄园出产十七种不同作物，并经营着一座极为出色的葡萄园。家族成员多为金发至红发，素以容貌出众而闻名，衣着考究、风度翩翩。然而他们与奥登贝里家族势同水火，尽管这场世仇如今大多收敛成在镇上擦肩而过时互相投来的阴沉目光。
One of the two oldest and wealthiest families in Spirewych, the Valehaven Estate produces seventeen different crops and runs an excellent vineyard. The family tends to be blond to redheaded, famously attractive, and are dapper dressers. But they are bitter rivals with the Oldenberry family, although their feuding has mostly settled to scowls exchanged in town.

Grandpa The Sailor.name:
水手爷爷
Grandpa The Sailor

Text.text:
拥挤的酒馆里，人群簇拥着一位老者。他向后倚着吧台，手肘休息在擦得发亮的木面上。故事从他口中滚滚而出，每一次停顿都被水手般咸涩的粗口狠狠钉住。他的眼睛——像大海一样深邃而坦荡——让那段骇人听闻的经历显得句句属实。垂在下颌的灰白长须也遮不住他那恒久的笑意：那笑像刀子一样，在满是皱纹的脸上刻出一道道沟壑。岁月把他的鼻子与耳朵拉得又长又尖，可他高挑的骨架仍裹着精瘦、绷紧的筋肉，时代只让它更硬、更韧。他仰头从起泡的酒杯里痛快地灌下一大口，把话音一并冲进喉咙，然后穿过鼓掌的人群，走向中央的桌子。眉梢一挑，带着戏谑的挑战，他俯身探过桌面，伸出那条满是伤疤的手臂，邀人来一场掰手腕。

~ 由一位英雄 扮演

The crowded tavern congregates around an old man as he leans back against the bar, elbow resting on polished wood. He spins a story, each pause punctuated with a sailor's salty profanity. His eyes—as deep and open as the seas—evince the truth in his lurid tale. The hoary beard that drapes his jaw does little to hide the perpetual smile that has carved grooves across the wrinkles of his face. His nose and ears are long and pointed with age, but his tall frame remains bound in lean, corded muscle that time has only hardened. He washes away his words with a long pull from a foaming tankard and moves through the applauding crowd to the central table. With an eyebrow raised in jovial challenge, he leans across the table and holds out his scarred arm for a wrestle.

~ Played by a Hero

Traveling Elven Entertainers.name:
旅行的精灵艺人
Traveling Elven Entertainers

Text.text:
这辆篷车以精雕细琢的木材打造，外表被涂绘得宛如一座缤纷小屋，安坐在六只优雅的轮子上。鲜活的常春藤攀附在车壁与木瓦屋顶间，两头麋鹿拖曳着它前行。驾车者是个高挑而灵活的男子，身着艳丽衣装，尖耳朵、笑意随时挂在脸上，长发以辫子束起，利落地从额前收拢。旁边同乘一位同样明朗、衣着亮眼的女子，未束的长发如卷曲的瀑流垂落肩头。几名更矮小的精灵——家族与风格上的相似一眼便知——一边舞动一边跟着篷车奔跑，朝围观者挥手致意。

~ 构想：Walt M.

The finely carved wood of this wagon has been painted to resemble a colorful cottage on six elegant wheels. Living ivy grows on its walls and shingled roof, and two elk pull it. The driver is a tall, lithe man in vibrant clothing. He has pointed ears and a ready smile, his long hair bound back from his face in braids. Beside him rides an equally cheerful and brightly dressed woman, her unbound hair cascading in ringlets about her shoulders. Smaller elves—the family and style resemblances clear—wave at onlookers as they dance while keeping up with the wagon.

~ Envisioned by Walt M.

Diplomatic Council Chambers.name:
外交议会厅
Diplomatic Council Chambers

Text.text:
烟斗的烟香与洒落的波特酒气息涌入鼻腔，你的目光扫过室内深色的木质护墙板与柔软奢华的陈设。一张椭圆形长桌被一圈高背椅环绕，占据了这片空间的中心；而在巨大的壁炉旁，一组长沙发与几处如同酒馆卡座般的隔间则提供了更适合私密交谈的角落。
The scents of pipe smoke and spilt port fill your nose as your eyes take in the dark paneling and plush furniture of the room. An oval table surrounded by high-backed chairs dominates the space, but a collection of couches by a large fireplace and a couple of booths like you might find in a tavern offer spaces for more private conversations.

尽管驼背，这个可怖、满身疣痂的人形怪物依旧高得与食人魔一般。它皮肤泛绿，鼻子又长又弯，像根折弯的胡萝卜；嘴里臼齿与獠牙错乱嵌生，长着爪的长手上更是手指多得不对劲。它用紧缩的鼻孔吵闹地嗅着空气，粗重的眉脊下，一双黑眼深陷，四下窥伺。
Though hunchbacked, this horrible, warty humanoid still stands as tall as an ogre. Green-skinned and with a long bent-carrot nose, its mouth is a mess of misplaced molars and fangs, and it has too many fingers on its long, clawed hands. It noisily sniffs at the air through pinched nostrils and peers about with black eyes deep set under a heavy brow.

Winding Underground Passage.name:
蜿蜒的地下通道
Winding Underground Passage

Text.text:
蜿蜒的隧道一路盘旋向下，通往那令人窒息的黑暗，它掐灭光亮，就连目光最敏锐的人也难以看清前方几尺之外。你听见远处水滴落下的声音，在幽暗中回响。你粗重而湿热的呼吸声，正如火把的光一般，被这阴沉的黑暗吞没。
The winding tunnel twists ever downward, toward the dark that suffocates the light, making it difficult for even the most keen-eyed to see more than a few feet in front of them. You hear the distant drip of water echoing through the gloom. The noise of your thick, humid breath is, much like the light from your torches, swallowed by the dreary darkness.

Hacker Moves At Full Speed Past System C.name:
黑客以全速掠过网络中的系统构造体
Hacker Moves At Full Speed Past System Constructs In The Net

Text.text:
黑客核对着自己的路线，心神在数字荒原上星罗棋布的无面造物之间穿梭编织。他们能做到。随即猛然冲刺，在身后点燃一道流光尾迹，撕裂般横越赛博空间；系统徒劳地试图擒拿，他们却轻松俯身闪避、左右腾挪。转瞬之间，他们已然穿过回头望去，那些无面守卫重置自我、归位列阵——已被彻底击溃。
The hacker checks their route, mentally weaving between the faceless constructs dotting the digital expanse. They can make it. Sprinting forward, igniting a trail behind them, they tear across cyberspace, effortlessly ducking and dodging as the system tries in vain to apprehend them. In an instant, they are through, looking back at the faceless guardians who reset and take their places, having been thoroughly bested.

Gala: Sin And Commerce.name:
庆典：罪与商贸
Gala: Sin And Commerce

Text.text:
餐厅边缘一圈摆着长桌，几间前厅里支着餐板，堆满了各色食物。人们围在其间把酒言欢，或谈笑风生、或侧耳偷听，讨价还价，眉来眼去。随着众人取食举杯、豪饮下肚，财运也在此起彼伏间悄然翻覆。
Tables stand around the fringe of the ballroom, with antechambers holding boards heaped with food. Around them people wine and dine, sharing conversations and eavesdropping, deal making and romancing. Fortunes rise and fall as folk take up food and down drinks.

Flammulated Owl Familiar.name:
火纹角鸮魔宠
Flammulated Owl Familiar

Text.text:
这只体型娇小的小鸟神情困倦，以柔和而低沉的咕鸣唱出女中音。她在松林或白蜡树林里很难被发现——除了体型小之外，她的羽毛还酷似树木粗糙的灰色树皮。当她把头缩起、收拢翅膀时，几乎能与林木融为一体、彻底隐没。她只能递送轻量物品，却极擅长运送秘密讯息。她最爱以酥脆的昆虫作为报酬。
This petite little bird has a sleepy look and sings as an alto with a soft, low hoot. She is hard to spot in a pine or ash forest because, in addition to her size, her feathers resemble the rough gray bark of the trees. When she tucks her head and folds in her wings she can nearly disappear. She is only capable of light weight deliveries but excels at carrying secret messages. She loves crunchy insects as payment.

Loot From An Otyugh.name:
食腐怪身上的战利品
Loot From An Otyugh

Text.text:
你在内脏坑里翻找，黏稠的污泥贪婪地啧啧作响，像要把你的四肢一口口吞下。终于，在仿佛无尽的恶臭与黏滞之后，你在这怪物般的泥沼中摸到了金属碎片。你拽出几只钱袋和旅行包裹，一柄矮人风格打造的战锤，甚至还有一套被彻底浸透却仍可使用的鳞甲。
You search through the offal pit, the viscous muck slurping your limbs greedily as you do. Eventually, after what feels like ages of stench and sticking, you find pieces of metal in the monstrous mire. You pull out a few coin pouches and travel packs, a fighting hammer crafted in dwarvish style, and even a thoroughly drenched but still usable set of scale mail.

Streetwise Sanitation Worker.name:
街头门道的清洁工
Streetwise Sanitation Worker

Text.text:
她在心里默数着步伐的节拍，漫不经心地侧身一步，身旁的通风口猛地喷出一股蒸汽，吹得她那件霓虹橙色背心夸张地翻卷起来，宛如英雄的披风。她对这片街区的一切了如指掌：它如何运转，街道之下的内脏里又在发生什么。她戴着手套的手将油腻的头发从脸侧拨开，随着人行横道的信号灯按时转绿，她扬起一抹笑意——分秒不差。
Counting her steps with internalized timing, the woman nonchalantly steps to the side as a jet of steam erupts from the vent next to her, causing her neon-orange vest to billow dramatically like a heroic cape. She knows every bit of this neighborhood, what makes it tick and what occurs in the guts beneath the streets. She brushes greasy hair out of her face with a gloved hand and smiles as the crosswalk light turns green—right on schedule.

Best-selling Author On Book Tour.name:
畅销书作者巡回签售之旅
Best-selling Author On Book Tour

Text.text:
尽管名声横跨星球，这位作者却依旧谦逊自持——把自己缩进簇拥在身边的安保与媒体人员的人墙里。以巡回签售途经的大多数星球的标准来看，人群并不算多，可在这座小镇里，仿佛全镇的人都为了这场活动倾巢而出。作家朝签名桌走去——桌旁是一个尴尬微笑着的、自己面孔的全息影像——他们始终垂着眼，试图不引人注目。在这种场合下，这不过是徒劳。
The author carries themself humbly despite their star-spanning fame—shrinking into the huddle of security and media staff surrounding them. Though the crowd is modest by the standard of most planets on the book tour, it seems the entire town has come out for the event. As the writer makes their way to the autograph desk—beside an awkwardly smiling holo of their own face—they keep their eyes down, trying not to draw attention to themself. A futile endeavor given the circumstances.

Xavorin Bronzesorrow.name:
夏沃林·青铜哀伤
Xavorin Bronzesorrow

Text.text:
用势大力沉的一击将最后一个强盗打得昏死过去后，那名陌生人向前一步，朝蜷缩在一旁的那户人家伸出援手。夕阳为他镶出轮廓：合身的土色长袍衬得他凯旋般挺立，红发如丝绸般光泽流淌，披过宽阔结实的肩背。他柔和的紫罗兰色眼眸里点点金芒，映着身后落日的绮丽，真诚地闪烁着；他向众人露出仁善的微笑。光线落在他古铜、被日晒得微灼的皮肤上，竟泛起一抹诡异的金属光泽，更添几分摄人心魄的神秘魅力。

~ 由 Christoffer Played

Knocking the last bandit unconscious with a powerful strike, the stranger steps forward, offering a hand to the family cowering nearby. Framed by the setting sun, he cuts a truly magnificent figure as he stands triumphant in fitted earthen robes, lustrous curls of red hair flowing across his broad muscular shoulders. The flecks of gold in his soft violet eyes mirror the beauty of the sunset behind him, sparkling with sincerity as he graces the people with a benevolent smile. Where the light falls on his tan, sunbaked skin, it shimmers with a strange metallic hue, adding to his charismatic mystique.

~ Played by Christoffer

整座山顶都被奉作宗教用途。一排排半截圆木长凳陈列在一座圆形亭子前方，亭子由粗壮的木柱支撑。再往后，你看见一片打理得井井有条的墓地，遍布许多小小的土丘。你辨不出任何特定神祇的形象；取而代之的是收获场景的雕刻，而每根亭柱上都绑着一个由捆扎稻草编成的类人偶像，被绳索紧紧抽缚其上。
The whole of this hilltop has been given over to religious purpose. A series of half-log benches stand arrayed before a round pavilion held up by thick wood posts. Beyond that you see a well-tended cemetery with many small mounds of dirt. You can’t discern any depiction of a specific deity. Instead, carvings depict harvest scenes, and human-like figures made from bound straw are lashed to each of the pavilion’s pillars.

Crashing Airship.name:
坠毁的飞空艇
Crashing Airship

Text.text:
飞船在坠向大地时吱呀作响、尖啸不止，拖着烟与灰烬的长尾。索具如断骨般接连崩裂，船体进一步瓦解，残骸如雨洒向下方的土地。船上只剩船长一人，拼命想稳住舵轮——直到舵叶轰然碎裂。巨力一击，将这名天际水手掀得踉跄摔上甲板，离撞击只剩转瞬。

~ DaveDaWanderer on Discord

The ship creaks and screams as it plummets toward the ground, trailing smoke and ash. Rigging snaps like breaking bone as more of the vessel deteriorates, raining debris on the land below. The captain is the only one left aboard, desperately trying to keep the wheel steady—until the rudder shatters. The force of the blow sends the sky-sailor reeling onto the deck with only moments before impact.

~ DaveDaWanderer on Discord

University Lecturer Visiting From Anothe.name:
来自异星系的大学讲师来访
University Lecturer Visiting From Another System

Text.text: 这位讲师的无数眼柄各自托着一枚镜片，每一枚都镶在独一无二、精雕细琢的镜框里。客座演讲者穿行在校园间时，用短粗的鼻子嫌恶地一皱，对这些寒酸的楼宇嗤之以鼻，声音洪亮地夸耀他们的学术机构何等优越，以及他们所获得的经费如何丰厚。 Each of the lecturer’s many eye stalks holds a lens, each with a distinct and beautifully crafted frame. As they make their way around campus the guest speaker wrinkles a stubby nose at the inferior buildings, loudly commenting on the superiority of their academic institution and the funding they receive.

一个妖冶的身影栖在被海浪雕琢的礁石之巅，吟唱着摄魂的旋律。歌声渗入咸腥浓重的空气里，节拍间缠绕着阴森的寄望城。裸露的肌肤沾满盐雾凝成的珍珠般水珠，莹亮闪烁；她盘身直起，贝壳点缀的双臂舞出蛇一般的曲线，招引着毫无戒心的人再靠近些——去品尝深海那危险而致命的诱惑。
A sultry figure, perched atop a wave-carved rock, sings an enchanting melody. It permeates the brine-rich air, its cadence laced with sinister promise. Naked skin gleaming with pearls of salty spray, she coils upright, shell-adorned arms weaving a serpentine dance and beckoning the unwary to come closer—to taste the perilous allure of the deep.

Sundries From A Treant.name:
来自树人之物的杂货
Sundries From A Treant

Text.text:
在树人圣林的神龛旁休息时，你发现附近村庄的平民留下了一些供品：许多用麻绳扎起的干花束、一面小巧的银镜，以及一小瓶芳香油。
Resting on the shrine of the treant’s sacred grove, you find some offerings left by the common folk of the nearby village: many bouquets of dried flowers bound with twine, a small silver mirror, and a phial of scented oil.

Seedy Watering Hole.name:
肮脏的小酒馆
Seedy Watering Hole

Text.text:
“落魄”大概是形容这家酒吧客人的最佳词汇。浮肿的眼袋藏在一团团被干涸汗渍粘结的乱发下，他们的目光黏在酒杯里，几乎不敢抬眼去瞥同样酗酒的同伴一眼。店面本身也好不到哪去：桌子摇摇晃晃，仿木吧台缺口遍布，刮痕纵横，色泽褪得发白。
Run-down would be the best way to describe the patrons of this bar. Baggy eyes lurk beneath messes of hair matted with dry sweat, their eyes lingering on their drinks and barely risking glances up at their fellow alcoholics. The establishment isn't much better, with wobbling tables and a faux-wood bar that's chipped and scratched and faded.

I Clean My Cauldron With Magic.name:
我用魔法清洗我的坩埚
I Clean My Cauldron With Magic

Text.text:
我想起以前用百洁布，再加上那些夸特人所谓的“使劲儿”，把这种东西刷干净是什么滋味。现在好多了——像在指挥一支室内乐团。浮石皂沫腾跃俯冲，钢丝垫在一层陈年药剂结出的硬痂上打着节拍。我让桶里的水先做了几下过山车般的翻腾，随后哗啦一声把坩埚冲得锃亮；再一挥手，把水迹抹去，连带着它也一并蒸干。
I think about what it’s like to scrub one of these with scouring pads and what the quots call “elbow grease.” This is better—like conducting a chamber orchestra. The pumice soap leaps and dives and the wire pad keeps a rhythm against the crust of an old potion. I make the water from a bucket do a few roller-coaster moves before it splashes the cauldron clean, then swipe my hand and dry it up.

诸如时代与重力之类的事物——在魔法面前几乎无足轻重。你吟诵词句，完成手势，掌心的蛛丝便伴着一声轻响悄然消散。你走近那面墙……然后，踏着它向上行走。
Things like time and gravity—they matter little when it comes to magic. You speak the words and complete the gestures, and the spidersilk in your hand dissipates with a whisper. You approach the wall . . . and then walk up it.

I Tell A Calming Fireside Tale.name:
我讲述一个安抚人心的篝火边故事
I Tell A Calming Fireside Tale

Text.text:
“大家都围过来吧，我讲个故乡的故事，给咱们压压惊。以前我和母亲也总是这样围着火堆，她一边讲一边哄我——就像现在。故事里有个年轻的半身人面包师、一座魔法烤炉，还有全境最甜、金灿灿的面包！都坐稳放松点，朋友们，你们还没反应过来就会睡着——就算在这鬼地方也一样。”
“Gather ’round everyone, I’ll settle our nerves with a tale from my homeland. My mother used to tell it whilst we sat around the fire—just like this. It involves a young halfling baker, a magical oven, and the sweetest golden loaves in all the land! Settle in and get comfortable friends, you’ll be asleep before you know it—even in this awful place.”

Site Of A Recent Avalanche.name:
近期雪崩遗址
Site Of A Recent Avalanche

Text.text:
这片冬日荒原的寂静令人毛骨悚然——听不见鸟鸣，也不见任何兽类活动的动静。冰雪覆棚被撕裂剥落时那暴烈的炸裂与轰鸣，早已把一英里内的所有生物都吓得无影无踪；随之而来的静止更像废墟，而非安宁。望着那成吨移位的积雪，人会在本能深处明白：它本可以轻易化作一座猝不及防的坟墓——死于冷漠而无常的自然之手。就在高悬于地平线之上的苍穹，从高得令人不敢细想的高度，一声鹰唳刺破死寂。
The silence of this wintry landscape is eerie—lacking birdcall or stir of animal life. The violent crack and din accompanying the shearing off of this shelf of ice and snow has scared off every creature within a mile, and the accompanying stillness feels more like ruin than tranquility. One cannot behold the tons of shifted snow without recognizing on an instinctive level how easily it could have been an unexpected grave. Death at the hands of an uncaring and random act of nature. From high above the horizon, at an altitude too great to contemplate, the cry of a hawk breaks the silence.

这具男性人偶的躯干由雕琢而成的深色抛光木材构成，体型如同人类幼儿。他身着酒红色紧身上衣，金线刺绣点缀其间，内里是一件白衬衫，蕾丝领口与袖口层层翻折。短而蓬松的裤装呈叶色。浓密的黑发——真实的头发——从一顶扁平的祖母绿贝雷帽下翘出。人偶的关节工艺精妙，连手指都能完全屈伸，嘴巴与眼睑亦可开合转动。
Carved, dark, polished wood comprises the body of this masculine doll the size of a human toddler. He wears a burgundy doublet accented with gold embroidery over a white shirt with lace collars and cuffs. His short, blousy pants are the color of leaves. Thick black hair—real hair—sticks out from under a flat emerald-green beret. The doll’s joints are fine work, down to fully articulated fingers and moveable mouth and eyelids.

Short Travel Across The Elemental Plane.name:
横穿火元素位面的短途旅行
Short Travel Across The Elemental Plane Of Fire

Text.text:
你踏上旅程，却不确定会遇见什么。你穿行于熔岩与火焰原野之上——空气灼热如刀，四面八方的光芒刺得你睁不开眼。黄铜的城市在地平线上闪耀。你想着自己还能承受多少热浪，但终究，你触及了目的地。
You embark on your journey unsure of what you might find. You travel across magma and fields of fire—the air sears with heat, and light blinds you from all directions. Cities of brass gleam on the horizon. You wonder how much heat you can stand, but finally you reach your destination.

深渊横亘在你目力之外，向下坠落数百英尺，并在四面八方绵延数里。下方的天空里，群鸟盘旋，穿梭于终年不散、笼罩峡谷的迷雾之间。眼前的景象宏伟得近乎不真实，与其说是天然造物，不如说更像出自一位大师画笔——然而你无法否认它就在你面前。峡壁近乎垂直，几道渺小的身影正沿着峭壁小心挪移，摸索着向下行进。
The chasm spans beyond your sight, plunging hundreds of feet and sprawling for leagues in all directions. Birds wheel in the sky below, darting through the perpetual mist shrouding the canyon. Too awesome to be real, the sight more closely resembles a master painter's work than it does a natural formation—and yet you can't deny the reality before you. Tiny figures move, picking their way down the canyon's sheer walls.

Loot From A Black Dracolich's Lair.name:
黑色龙巫妖巢穴的战利品
Loot From A Black Dracolich's Lair

Text.text:
四具人形骷髅（特征）被吊笼高悬在巫妖巨龙巢穴里一座坍圮的石拱下。他们的骨骼呈陈旧羊皮纸般的颜色，腐蚀性的黏液滴落其上，蚀出蜂窝般的孔洞。每具骷髅（特征）都穿着或紧攥着一件未被时代或腐蚀侵扰的物件：一袭丝绸长袍、一根象牙魔杖、一本皮革装帧的典籍，以及一枚琥珀戒指。
Four humanoid skeletons hang gibbeted under a crumbling stone arch in the lich dragon’s lair. Their bones are the color of old parchment, honeycombed where caustic slime has dripped on them. Each skeleton wears or clutches something that appears unravaged by time or corrosion: a silk robe, an ivory wand, a leather-bound tome, and an amber ring.

Felling The Construct Dragon.name:
斩落构装巨龙
Felling The Construct Dragon

Text.text:
巨龙的鳞皮被撕裂，成股烈焰自它周身喷涌而出；震耳欲聋的尖啸撕裂长空，它那如水晶般的外皮开始扭曲、崩碎。伴随着如雪崩般喧嚣的咆哮，这头庞然生物在垂死挣扎中倾覆，像倾倒的城堡般轰然砸落大地——在它终于静止的躯体四周，滚烫的裂隙蒸腾着张开。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The Dragon’s skin is rent asunder causing gouts of flame to erupt all over its body, and a deafening keening fills the air as its crystalline skin begins to warp and shatter. With a cacophonous roar like an avalanche, the enormous creature pitches over in its death throes, slamming into the ground like a toppled citadel—causing steaming fissures to open around its now-still form.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The Endless Archive.name:
无尽秘档
The Endless Archive

Text.text:
多到人力无法计数的图书馆书架过道，塞满了迄今收集到的所有数字誊写文本，一路延伸，在虚拟地平线的尽头消失成一点。每排高耸书架旁都铺着旧橡木地板的步道，像一座座窄桥，横跨下方张口欲噬的黑暗深渊。这个档案库早于互联网时代，仍保留着令人怀旧的木制栏杆、沿黄铜管轨道滑行的梯子，甚至还飘着烟斗烟与纸张混合的气息。一些自由的数字灵体似乎在整理图书馆，但凑近细看才发现，它们其实是在搅乱馆藏，刻意模糊任何系统性的检索。它们和气地表示愿意帮你找到任何你想要的东西——交换条件是几段独一无二的代码。

~ 由一位英雄 所构想

Humanly uncountable aisles of library shelves, filled with all the digital transcriptions ever collected, disappear to a vanishing point on the virtual horizon. Walkways of old oak flooring border every set of high shelves, like narrow bridges over a yawning blackness below. The archive predates the internet and includes nostalgic woodwork railings, ladders on brass pipe tracks, even the scent of pipe smoke and paper. Some free digital spirits look to be organizing the library, but closer inspection reveals that they are actually mixing it up, obfuscating any systematic search. They kindly offer to help locate anything you like—in exchange for a few pieces of unique code.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Sundries From A Vampire Knight.name:
吸血鬼骑士的杂物
Sundries From A Vampire Knight

Text.text:
在那具不老战士的尸身上，你发现一截折断匕首的柄，塞在它的腰带里。尽管刃身已不知所踪，这钢制握柄——包着抹过油的黑色皮革——却精良得令人惊叹。完整的武器想必更是上乘之作。
On the ageless warrior’s corpse, you find the hilt of a broken dagger tucked into its belt. Though the blade is missing, the steel hilt—with a grip of oiled black leather—is of astonishing quality. The complete weapon must have been fine indeed.

A Bandit Leader Surrenders.name:
强盗头目投降
A Bandit Leader Surrenders

Text.text:
“你不必放了我，但求你……饶了我的弟兄们。他们只是想吓唬些人，弄点钱糊口。我们知道这是错的，可当你饿得前胸贴后背时，想做个好人，哪还有什么机会。”
“You don’t have to let me go, but please… spare my men. They’re only trying to scare some folk out of a bit of coin. We know it’s wrong, but there’s not much opportunity to be a good person when you’re starving.”

一只多触须的乌贼——披着高科技纳米织纤维——正摆弄着绑在战衣上的诸多工具之一。生物的头部占了它体型的一半，鼓胀如岩石般坚硬，小小的珠眼透过狭窄的目镜窥视着外界。另一对眼睛长在生物颅顶的末端，在眼眶里疯狂地滚动。它的触须带着谨慎的好奇，轻轻拨弄着地面。
A multi-tendriled squid—clad in high-tech nanoweave fiber—tinkers with one of the many tools strapped to its suit. The creature’s head is half its size, bulbous and stonelike, with little beady eyes peeking through a narrow visor. Another pair of eyes sits at the tip of the creature’s skull, rolling wildly in their sockets. Its tendrils paw at the ground with a careful curiosity.

Polished Private Security Administrator.name:
精明的私人安保管理员
Polished Private Security Administrator

Text.text:
高个子男人一边理顺他那件考究的夹克与利落的尖顶帽，一边用审慎的目光扫过夹在臂弯里的数据板。安保主管从一丝不苟的发型到量身定制皮鞋上无可挑剔的光泽，每一寸都被以冷硬而高效的秩序精确地编排妥当。
Straightening his stylish jacket and smart peaked cap, the tall man casts a judicious eye over the datapad in the crook of his arm. Every inch of the security administrator is precisely coordinated with rigid efficiency, from his perfectly styled hair to the flawless polish of his bespoke shoes.

Cut-down Machine Pistol.name:
锯短冲锋枪
Cut-down Machine Pistol

Text.text:
手枪的枪管被锯得离扳机极近，近到护手都被改装：加装了护盾与贴合的握把，好让人在后坐力的猛踢中仍能稳住控制。这终究不是单发枪，而是一把机关枪。加长弹匣上闪烁着一个数字，代表剩余子弹的数量。
The barrel of the pistol has been sawed off close to the trigger, so close that the handguard has been modified with a shield and fitted grip to maintain control with the kickback. This isn’t a single-shot after all, but a machine gun. The extended magazine flickers with a number representing the number of bullets remaining.

I Clean My Laser Pistol.name:
我擦拭我的激光手枪
I Clean My Laser Pistol

Text.text:
将内部系统设定为自我清除后，我开始清理我那把可靠手枪的外部。我用超细纤维布擦过这件武器流线的枪身，指尖掠过合金外壳上的每一道划痕与凹痕，往昔的冒险也随之在脑海中浮现。
Setting the internal system to purge itself, I begin cleaning the exterior of my trusty pistol. I run a microfiber cloth over the sleek frame of my weapon, noting each scratch and dent in the alloy casing as I recall past adventures.

Inside The Mountaintop Observatory.name:
山巅天文台内部
Inside The Mountaintop Observatory

Text.text:
天文台的双开门轻轻一推便向内荡开。里面，远墙旁的炉火噼啪作响，寒冽的山风刺骨感也渐渐退去。圆形厅室中央，望远镜下方的平台静静矗立，周围勤勉的工人如花般散开，忙碌其间。
The double doors to the observatory swing open easily. Inside, a fire crackles at the far wall, and the bite of the cold mountain air begins to fade. A platform below the observatory’s telescope sits in the center of the circular room, with dutiful workers blossoming out from around it.

Dingy Strip Mall.name:
昏暗破败的购物街区
Dingy Strip Mall

Text.text: 这座商铺长廊不过是一块灰扑扑的长方形，橱窗里与残破招牌上只有几抹褪色的颜色勉强点缀。整栋楼仿佛蒙着一层从未有人肯花时间彻底清理的油垢与尘灰。几个少年轮流踩着悬浮滑板，在一块No Hoverboards告示牌正前方耍着花样。 The strip mall is little more than a drab rectangle with minimal splashes of faded color in the windows and on the broken signs. The entire building seems to be coated in a layer of grime and dust that no one has ever taken the time to deep clean. A few teenagers take turns running tricks on their hoverboards right in front of a No Hoverboards sign.

Fighter's Speech Of Self-affirmation.name:
战士的自我肯定宣言
Fighter's Speech Of Self-affirmation

Text.text:
“你不是为自己而战；你也不是因恐惧而杀戮。你所做的一切，都是为了他们——为他们争取时代，让他们平安无恙。无论你面对的是利剑、利爪，还是烈火，都没有区别。你的朋友们一路护你活到现在。你至少该把这份情还回去。”
“You do not fight for yourself; you do not kill out of fear. Everything you do, you do for them—to buy them time, to keep them safe. Whether you face sword, claw, or fire, it makes no difference. Your friends have kept you alive this long. The least you can do is return the favor.”

Lavender Lantern, A Floating Pirate Town.name:
薰衣草灯笼，一座漂浮的海盗城镇
Lavender Lantern, A Floating Pirate Town

Text.text:
一艘巨大的船只高高耸立，俯瞰着一圈松散成环、以平铺外板法（carvel-built）建造的船队。它的两根桅杆之间，一面旗帜迎风翻飞，旗上绘着马与人——以深黑墨汁大胆镂刻在丝绸之上。旗缘毫无破损；这艘船的船长必定以非同寻常的谨慎守护着这件艺术品。你俯视那一圈更小的船只，每艘船的外侧都朝外立着一面独一无二的铁盾。有的盾面蚀刻着警告般的人脸，有的则刻着鲸鱼或其他航海主题。

~ 由 Pirate lord 构想

A large vessel towers over a loosely circular formation of carvel-built ships. Between two of its masts flutters a banner, displaying a scene of horses and humans—boldly stenciled on the silk in deep black ink. It shows no tattered edges; the ship’s captain must take extraordinary precautions to preserve this piece of art. You look down to the ring of lesser ships, each with a unique iron shield facing out. Some bear etched faces of warning, while others show whales or other nautical themes.

~ Envisioned by Pirate lord

Beautiful Steel Brooch.name:
美丽钢制胸针
Beautiful Steel Brooch

Text.text:
这件饰品明亮的巨大卷曲与波浪极为夺目。它欢快地覆在所依托的衣料之上——哪怕还配着一枚长长的别针——其形宛如寒海上的冰船，摹拟着远方女王端坐王座时的绝美风姿。
The bright great curls and waves of this piece draw attention. It plays cheerfully over the garment it holds—even with its long pin—shaped like an icy ship on a cold sea and simulating the beauty of distant queens on their thrones.

Sarcastic Bartender.name:
爱挖苦人的酒保
Sarcastic Bartender

Text.text:
品红色背心和皮裤紧紧贴在酒保那瘦长的身形上。他精瘦的手臂上用红黑墨纹满了图案：一群欢快的猴子举着清酒杯痛饮。

“听着。我本来……我本可以……”一个醉得不成样子的男人在吧凳上摇摇晃晃，食指软塌塌地举在半空。

“当个强手？”酒保问。“当个出名的太空客？当个A级主管？”他嘴角那抹轻蔑的冷笑，对眼神发雾的醉汉毫无意义；醉汉下唇耷拉着，沾着廉价杜松子酒的亮光。“听着，朋友。我这儿有个活儿给你。做了它，你就能当一晚上的英雄。今晚，你至少能当个还算像样的出手客。”他敲了敲嵌在吧台里的黑色屏幕。屏幕倏然亮起一抹刺眼的荧绿，将顾客的账单投射在他们之间的空间——上面还加了一笔丰厚的小费。

A magenta tank top and leather pants cling to the bartender’s reedy frame. His lean arms are inked red and black with images of joyful monkeys drinking from sake cups.

“Listen. I would’a… I could’a been…” A heavily intoxicated man sways in a barstool, his pointer finger limply raised in the air.

“A contender?” asks the bartender. “A famous spacer? An A-rank executive?” The scorn of his smirk is lost on the hazy-eyed inebriant, whose bottom lip droops and glistens with cheap gin. “Listen, friend. I got a job for you. Something that’ll make you a hero for just one night. Tonight, you can be a halfway-decent tipper.” He taps a black screen embedded into the bar top. It comes to life with a flash of bright green, projecting the customer’s bill in the space between them—with a generous gratuity added.

Punishing Cold And Darkness In A Realm O.name:
在妖精荒庭领域中的凛冽寒冷与黑暗
Punishing Cold And Darkness In A Realm Of The Unseelie

Text.text:
那道诱人的传送门彼端，藤蔓缠绕、气息明快——全是谎言。此处浸透了泥土般的寒意，像发霉的洞窟，或陵寝里棺椁的冷气。寒冷愈发加深——灌木与树木被冰雪割出参差的棱角，前方的道路灰暗而险恶。狂风在你周身抽打，视衣物如无物，怒啸着对抗魔法。愈发厚重的云层吞没星光，继而遮住月亮，而你在漆黑的狂飙里，听见一声恶毒的冷笑。
The inviting portal’s other side, with its vines and cheerful scent, was a lie. This side is saturated with an earthy chill, like a moldy cave or a mausoleum’s coffin. The cold intensifies—you see shrubs and trees jagged with ice and snow, and the path ahead is gray and treacherous. Wind whips around you, ignoring clothing and raging against magic. Thickening clouds blot out the starlight, then the moon, and you hear in the black gale a mean-spirited laugh.

那张脸像一尊凹凸不平的雕塑，带着冷峻的幽默。目光悠长而死寂。舌头忽然一甩，像在品尝空气的味道。它的脚与利爪比人类的时代更古老，它鳞片的护甲与肉质的尾部纹章，是失落世界的印记。随后，在日落的清凉里，它疾驰向某个隐秘之处，只留下空旷的地貌与潜伏的夜色。
That face is a bumpy sculpture of stern humor. The long, dead gaze. The sudden flick of a tongue tasting the air. Its feet and claws are older than human time, its armor of scales and fleshy tail emblems of the lost world. And then, in the cool of a sunset, it races to some hidden place, leaving behind only the empty landscape and the lurking night.

Active-camouflage Stealth Suit.name:
主动伪装潜行战衣
Active-camouflage Stealth Suit

Text.text:
这是一套顺滑的全身迷彩服，内置兜帽、护目镜与碳纤维面罩，连手脚也一并包覆。几乎看不出该从哪里穿进去。它似乎没有颜色——又或者颜色多得过头。无论哪种，都让人看得有些迷糊，仿佛它正扭曲着周围的空间织理。再凑近细看，面料其实由无数细小的镜面纤维构成，折射着光线，随风轻摆，像一片微缩的草甸。
This is a slick full-body camouflage suit with in-built hood, goggles, and carbon-fiber mask. It even covers the hands and feet. It’s hard to see how one would get inside. It doesn’t seem to have a color—or perhaps it has too many colors. Either way, the suit is a little confusing to look at, like it’s warping the fabric of space around it. On closer examination, the fabric is actually countless tiny, mirrored fibers refracting the light, swaying like a miniscule meadow of grass in the wind.

那只小生物张开脆薄惨白的翅膀，急切地尖叫着，迎接母亲衔食归来——一条粗大、扭动不止的鱼。幼崽覆鳞的皮肉皱褶绵软，细小的喙尚未硬化成同类那般可怖的长矛。然而，它的口中已列着一排排锋利的锯齿，昭示着它终有一日将化作残忍而高效的掠食者。
With its flimsy, pale wings outstretched, the small creature squawks urgently as its mother returns with food: a large wriggling fish. The baby's scaled flesh is wrinkled and soft, and its tiny beak has not yet hardened into the formidable lance of its kind. However, rows of sharp serrated teeth line its mouth, a precursor to the viciously efficient predator it will one day become.

一个精瘦的男人倚在巷子墙上，银色锁子甲衫披在褪色的蓝色牛仔裤外。一只手搭在腰间两只枪套之一上，另一只手抓挠着那一周未刮、在脸上扎起的胡茬。一本薄如小册的书被绑在他的手臂上，像一面小盾；棕色靴子上滋滋跃动着钴蓝色电光——同样噼啪作响的能量也在他锐利的凝视间跳舞。他脚边蜷着一匹灰狼，耳朵竖起，警惕地聆听四周。

~ Played by Chris Katrev with

A wiry man leans against the alley wall, his shirt of silver chain draped over faded blue jeans. One of his hands rests on one of two holsters at his hips, and the other scratches at the week-old beard that stubbles his face. A book the size of a thin journal is strapped to his arm like a small shield, and his brown boots sizzle with cobalt electricity—the same crackling energy that dances across his keen glare. A gray wolf lies curled near his feet, its ears perked in vigilance.

~ Played by Chris Katrev with

Deep Space Surveillance Hub: Control Cen.name:
深空监视枢纽：控制中心
Deep Space Surveillance Hub: Control Center

Text.text:
一幅细致入微的全息星空图铺满深空监视枢纽的控制中心，每一颗星辰巨体都被描绘成柔和闪烁的球形节点。全息投影以冷冽的蓝光浸染整个房间，更凸显出这里实用至上的气息。房间中央蹲着一张小巧的圆形桌，桌前正对着一把磨损明显的办公椅。
A detailed holographic starscape fills the control center of the Deep Space Surveillance Hub, with each astral giant depicted as a softly blinking spherical node. The hologram bathes the room in cool blue light, accentuating its utilitarian nature. A small circular desk squats at the center of the room with a well-worn office chair at its center.

她身披环带甲，军衔徽记沿着衣领一字排开；在清冷的晨光里，将军在一众军官簇拥下审视着战场。身经百战的老兵，她抽空回望身后渐渐苏醒的营地，心知自己必须先发表一番振奋人心的演说，随后便要把许多人送上赴死之途——以更宏大的事业之名。
Clad in banded mail with her rank insignia displayed along the collar, the general surveys the battlefield in the cold daylight of early morning, bolstered by a cadre of officers. A veteran of countless battles, she spares a glance for the camp coming to life behind her, knowing that she must make an inspiring speech before sending off many of her people to die in the name of a greater cause.

蜿蜒流淌的天蓝色魔法如同一条空灵的河流，慵懒地穿行于这片大地。于凡人世界中除最具魔法天赋者外皆不可见的这些地脉，在妖精位面却清晰得如同白昼——此地的居民正是充分利用了这一点。远处，更多的线条在特定节点交错相连，令整个区域都浸透在神秘的磷光辉芒之中。
The meandering flow of sky-blue magic drifts lazily through the landscape like an ethereal river. Invisible in the mortal world to all but the most magically gifted, these ley lines are as clear as day in the Faerie Plane—a fact the denizens of this place take full advantage of. In the distance, other lines cross and connect at specific points, suffusing the entire area with a mystical, phosphorescent glow.

The Trial Of The Sword.name:
剑之试炼
The Trial Of The Sword

Text.text:
传奇之刃开口道：“数百年来，我沉眠于黑暗之中，静候一位勇者，再度将我托举于月光之下。你并非我所期待的模样。但或许在这粗陋的外表之下，仍藏着一丝潜能的火花。我们拭目以待。做好准备吧——剑之试炼所索取的不仅是蛮力，而失败所付出的，也绝不仅仅是鲜血。”

~ 由 Ararion 构想

The legendary blade speaks: “For centuries I have rested in darkness, awaiting a champion to carry me once more beneath the light of the moon. You are not what I expected. But perhaps a spark of potential lies beneath this crude exterior. We shall see. Prepare yourself, for the Trial of the Sword will demand more than brawn, and failure will cost more than blood.”

~ Envisioned by Ararion

I Scale A Towering Tree.name:
我攀上参天巨树
I Scale A Towering Tree

Text.text:
我走近那粗壮得惊人的树干，抬头望向头顶的枝杈。我在能抓的地方下手——一块瘤节或一片粗糙的树皮——像青蛙般一蹬一跃，攀上第一条沉甸甸的粗枝。接着我一脚踩上又一脚踩上，穿过层层叶幕，摸索着落手点，拽拉、踏步，一路向上，直到肌肉酸痛。终于，我触及一处稳固的落脚点，藏在一簇交错的枝条间，探出头越过叶冠，在开阔的天空下大口喘息。
I step up to the massive trunk and view the branches above. I grab where I can, a burl or rough patch of bark, and frog myself up to the first heavy arm. After standing on limb after limb, ducking through leaves and finding handholds, pulling and stepping until my muscles ache, I reach a sturdy place among a cluster of branches and peek out above the leaves, panting in the open sky.

Feather Fall Cast In Midair.name:
半空施展羽落术
Feather Fall Cast In Midair

Text.text:
你迅猛的坠落戛然而止；那令人血脉偾张的下坠冲击被轻盈的失重感取代，你安然无恙地飘荡着，缓缓落向下方的地面。
Your rapid descent halts, and the exhilarating rush of falling is replaced with a feeling of weightlessness as you safely drift to the ground below.

塔盾如栅墙般森然矗立，金属铸成的壁垒几乎与持盾者等高等宽。然而它却是一件完美平衡的杰作，重量均匀分布于盾面之上，令你在最大机动性下仍能自如驾驭。金属本身看不出丝毫磨损与瑕疵，尽管它的年代似乎已相当久远。它牢牢系在你的臂上，手感灵动轻捷，但你确信，即便最致命的斩击也会被它轻易格开。
The tower shield looms like a palisade, a bulwark of metal nearly as tall and as wide as its wielder. And yet the shield is a perfectly balanced masterwork, its weight distributed across its surface to allow for maximum mobility. The metal itself appears unmarred, unblemished, despite its apparent age. Secured against your arm, the shield feels nimble, but you’re confident it will turn aside even the most deadly of strikes.

I Cast Hideous Laughter Using My Arcane.name:
我用我的奥术法器物品施放《狂笑术》
I Cast Hideous Laughter Using My Arcane Focus Item

Text.text:
我一字不差地遵循咒文，将魔法之网导入我的装置，无需任何施法成分，以近乎手术般的精准击中我的目标。

[Successful Save] 也许这道法术需要更真实的幽默感，因为我的对手几乎连嘴角都没动一下。

[Failed Save] 难道我要像训猫人那样挥舞一根羽毛？难道我要奉上一枚小小的果馅挞？没错，那些办法确实好笑，但现在我还能保住法师的体面。我将扭曲而自相矛盾的情绪灌入一件与我自身奥术能力相连的物体。于是，我的目标们反倒失了体面——也输掉了战斗。看看他们。那场面令人不安，却又令人无比满足：看着他们笑啊笑啊，停不下来。

I follow the incantation to the letter, channel the weave of magic through my device without need of components, and strike my target with clinical efficiency.

[Successful Save] Perhaps the spell requires more actual humor, because my opponent barely cracks a smile.

[Failed Save] Am I going to wave a feather around like a cat trainer? Am I going to offer up a tiny tart? Yes, those methods are hilarious, but now I get to keep my wizardly dignity. I channel twisted, contradictory emotions through an object linked to my own arcane ability. Now my targets lose their dignity instead—and the fight. Look at them. It’s disconcerting, but so satisfying, watching them laugh and laugh.

这只多口袋的布袋可展开成一条工具围裙。围裙上的绳环稳稳固定着一把木槌与一把钉锤、数把锥子、楦工钳、裁皮剪、线剪、量绳，以及可调式号铁。额外的内插袋还装着鞋钉与皮绳，另有一罐皮革油。
This multipocketed cloth pouch rolls out into a tool apron. Its loops hold a mallet and tack hammer, several awls, lasting pliers, leather-cutting shears, thread scissors, measuring string, and adjustable sizing irons. Extra inserts hold tacks and leather cord, along with a jar of leather oil.

Spacegoing Vessel: Practical Entertainme.name:
远航舰船：实用娱乐甲板
Spacegoing Vessel: Practical Entertainment Deck

Text.text:
这艘货运拖船上提供的消遣出奇地丰富，在灯火通明的走廊里，大多数人都能找到合心意的去处。喧闹的音乐从甲板中央那间人声鼎沸的酒吧里沉闷地轰鸣着，震动沿着舱面扩散开来；放纵无度的船员也常被人看见踉踉跄跄地穿过通道，跌跌撞撞回到自己的舱室。
The entertainment on offer aboard the cargo hauler is surprisingly varied, and something can be found for most within the brightly lit halls. The dull thrum of loud music resonates through the deck from the packed bar at its center, and uninhibited personnel can often be seen staggering through the corridors back to their quarters.

Sundries From A Redcap.name:
来自红帽子的杂物
Sundries From A Redcap

Text.text:
鲜血——带着铁锈与腐肉的恶臭——从帽檐下渗出。布料的颜色由猩红褪成惨淡的粉白，触感也从柔软平滑的织物，变作粗糙如皮革般的质地。
Blood—stinking of metal and rotten meat—seeps from beneath the hat. The fabric pales from crimson to a pale pink, and the texture shifts from soft, smooth cloth to a rough leather-like material.

Shambling Mound And Its Victim.name:
蹒跚丘坟怪与它的牺牲者
Shambling Mound And Its Victim

Text.text:
你猛然被一股气味击中：死亡与腐朽的恶臭。那堆东西动了起来，收紧缠绕着被压在下面、动弹不得的提夫林。伴随着咯吱作响与脆裂的折断声，暗绿色藤蔓蜿蜒滑行、相互扭缠，先塑出一双腿，继而是带臂的躯干；顶端又长出某种近似头颅的东西——锥形、无面。臃肿的生物在你面前逼近，腐烂的植物碎屑如雨般洒落在你身上。
It hits you: the stench of death and decay. The heap moves, constricting around a tiefling trapped beneath it. Crunching and snapping, dark green vines slither and twist in on themselves, forming first a pair of legs, then a torso with arms; something resembling a head—conical and faceless—tops the bizarre form. The bulky creature looms over you, showering you in rotting plant matter.

Starving, Blood-crazed Vampire.name:
饥饿如狂、嗜血成癫的吸血鬼（特征）
Starving, Blood-crazed Vampire

Text.text:
阴影里蜷动着一只枯瘦的吸血鬼（特征），双眼燃着疯狂的火光。它骨架般的躯体因无法餍足的饥渴而颤抖，苍白的皮肤龟裂绷紧，仿佛随时会被撑裂。漆黑如夜的獠牙在那痉挛般的狞笑中格外刺目，骇人的巨口大张。它一眼盯上你，这可怜的怪物便猛地窜来，肮脏的利爪伸向你……

~ 由一位英雄构想

In the shadows writhes an emaciated vampire, eyes ablaze with insanity. Its skeletal frame trembles with insatiable hunger, the pallid skin cracked and stretched to breaking point. Fangs, black as night, dominate the rictus grin as its horror of a mouth yawns wide. Spotting you, this pitiful monster scampers forward, filthy claws outstretched…

~ Envisioned by a Hero

你将双手向外伸展，感知周遭的草木。你触到植物的根系在泥土深处蜿蜒穿行；它们的叶片正贪婪吮吸着阳光。你嗅到土壤里湿润的腐殖气息。植物回应你的言语与动作，先是微微战栗，随即猛然向上、向外疯长，转眼在你身周层层蔓延，变得浓密而杂乱。
You stretch your hands outward, sensing the surrounding flora. You feel the plant roots, winding through the earth; their leaves, drinking in the sun's light. You smell the loam of the soil. Responding to your words and movements, the plants shudder before growing suddenly up and out around you, becoming thick and overgrown.

Twitchy Wheelman.name:
神经兮兮的车手
Twitchy Wheelman

Text.text:
男人守在车旁，眼珠四下乱窜，任何一丝游移与声响都逃不过他的捕捉。一只手死死攥着敞开的车门，指节因用力而泛白；另一只手则不停摆弄着钥匙，像怎么也安不下来。他那帮人要是能在他一脚把油门踩到底之前真正扑进车里，都算走运。
The man's eyes dart in every direction as he waits by his car, homing in on every stray movement and noise. One hand grips the open door with white knuckles while the other fiddles endlessly with the keys. His crew will be lucky if he waits for them to actually dive into the car before he floors the gas pedal.

Chain Hardware Store.name:
连锁五金店
Chain Hardware Store

Text.text:
你一踏进店里，一个永远挂着微笑的仿生人便迎上来招呼你。橱窗上贴满了俗气的海报，吹嘘着亮闪闪的新奇商品，几乎把玻璃都糊住了。成排成排的塑料货架平行延伸，上面摆着沉甸甸的金属工具——激光切割器、锤子、水平仪——还有一些你叫不出名字的：诡异发光的圆环、嘶嘶作响的小盒子、飞旋的圆盘。神情倦怠的店员拖着装得满满的悬浮推车，在过道间沉重地穿行。不远处，两位全身白衣、戴着兜帽的顾客正用一种咔哒作响的方言交谈。空气里飘着木屑味——多半是人造的。
An android with a permanent smile welcomes you as you enter the shop, passing by the tacky posters sporting bright shiny products that litter the windows. Parallel rows of plastic shelving hold chunky metal tools—laser cutters, hammers, spirit levels—and some you don’t recognize: strange glowing circles, small hissing boxes, spinning discs. Bored-looking employees drag heavily laden hover-carts down the aisles. Nearby, two hooded customers dressed all in white converse in a clicking dialect. There is a smell of sawdust—probably artificial.

I Use Flexible Casting For Creating Spel.name:
我用“灵活施法”来创造法术位
I Use Flexible Casting For Creating Spell Slots

Text.text:
我汲取灵魂中那股原始而可塑的魔力，从中切割出一部分力量。随着这股力量被剥离，我将其塑造成所需的奥术结构。如今，我可以用它来施展我已知的一道法术。
