Tapping into the raw, pliable magical energy in my soul, I carve off a portion of that power. As I do, I sculpt it into the arcane structure I need. Now, I can use it to cast a spell I know.

Cargo Hauler: Outer Hull.name:
货运拖船：外部船体
Cargo Hauler: Outer Hull

Text.text:
货运拖船的船体上，漆着一个褪色的标志，字母足有数米高。它在漫长的航行中被星界碎屑无数次擦撞，每一块都在这头星际巨兽身上留下独一无二的伤痕。
A faded logo is painted on the hull of the cargo hauler in letters several meters high. Astral debris has marked the vessel innumerable times on its travels, each piece leaving a unique mark on the interstellar behemoth.

力量从披着斗篷的牛头人身上以可触的波浪般辐射开来，他们抬手指向天空，将闪电召入掌心。每一根突出的犄角都被华丽的金色角套掩蔽，分趾的蹄子在石面上碾磨作响，法师正与自己释放的能量激烈角力。双眼燃着奥术的怒焰，他们紧攥镶宝的金色法杖，力量的咒词在峭崖之巅回荡，如神祇雷鸣。
Power radiates from the cloaked minotaur in palpable waves as they raise a hand to the sky, summoning lightning to their grasp. Ornate golden caps cover each protruding horn, and cloven hooves grind against the stone as the mage battles with the energies they have unleashed. Eyes alight with arcane fury, they grip a jeweled golden staff tight, as words of power echo like divine thunder atop the bluff.

Welcome From A Grungy Innkeeper.name:
来自肮脏旅店老板的欢迎
Welcome From A Grungy Innkeeper

Text.text:
“想让我为你做点什么？休息？吃顿饭？我们这儿有全镇最便宜的伙食。话先说在前头，除非你自认爱赌，不然别点汤。”
“What can I do you for? Rest? A meal? We got the cheapest grub in town. That being said, don’t order the soup unless you fancy yourself a gambler.”

Hiring The Player Characters To Deal Wit.name:
雇佣玩家角色去对付一群怪物
Hiring The Player Characters To Deal With A Pack Of Monsters

Text.text:
“找活儿？对。我这儿有个差事给你，不过脏得很。镇子边上，有时更近，一群怪物尝到了我们血肉的滋味。它们干出来的场面……血腥得叫人作呕……可我们既没战士，也没守卫。咱们的商贩连路上那道弯都过不去，更别提去城里了。你说你需要活儿。我愿出大价钱，只求再也别听见我们的人被活活撕成碎片的声音。”

~ 由一位英雄构想

“Looking for work? Aye. I’ve a job for you, though it’s a foul task. Edge o’ town, sometimes nearer, a pack of monsters has got a taste for our flesh. A grisly mess they make . . . And we’ve got no warriors, no watchmen. Not one of our traders can make it past the bend in the road, let alone to the city. You say you need work. I’d pay good coin to never ag’in hear one of our own bein’ torn limb-from-limb.”

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Enthralled By A Vampire.name:
被吸血鬼（特征）迷魂
Enthralled By A Vampire

Text.text:
一张苍白而夺目的面孔漂浮在你眼前，几乎占满了你的视野。美得惊人——无可匹敌的容颜——可那双黑色的眼睛与殷红的嘴唇却让你心底发毛。祂自黑暗中凝现，整个身形在你面前逐渐成形，一只手指修长的手缓缓探出，轻轻抚过你的脸颊。“别害怕，”祂用甜蜜得发腻的声音说道，“有我在，你很安全。”
A pale, striking face floats before you, dominating your vision. So lovely—a visage of unmatched beauty—yet something about their black eyes and red lips unnerves you. They materialize from the darkness, their full figure taking shape before you, and a long-fingered hand drifts out to caress your cheek. “Do not fear,” they say in a voice dripping with honey. “You are safe with me.”

Worn Spell Scroll Case.name:
旧损的法术卷轴匣
Worn Spell Scroll Case

Text.text:
这只磨损的皮革筒上，崩裂的皮面被烙上了诡异的符号。圆筒两端剥落的金属封帽上仍黏着些许金色碎片，顶部则嵌着一颗褪色的蓝色宝石，如冠般点缀其上。
The worn leather tube is covered with strange symbols burned into the crumbling hide. Fragments of gold cling to the flaking metal caps at each end of the cylindrical case and a faded blue gem crowns the top.

Albert \"Norticus\" Welmington.name:
阿尔伯特“诺提库斯”·韦尔明顿
Albert "Norticus" Welmington

Text.text:
一身暗青铜色的板甲包裹着这位高大健壮的老者。他的护手、胫甲与铁靴泛着虹彩般的蔚蓝光泽，他苍白的皮肤上也隐约透出相似的蓝色冷调。岁月在他脸上刻下深深皱纹，但他的头发与胡须依旧浓密雪白，梳理得一丝不苟。他神情严肃，冰蓝色的眼眸冷峻逼人，左眼覆着一片水晶单片镜。他解下风筝盾，抽出一柄精致的长剑，剑刃泛起寒彻的白光。

~ 扮演 由 Dagger 与

Plate armor the color of dark bronze covers this tall, strapping old man. His gauntlets, greaves, and sabatons have an iridescent azure tinge, with a similar bluish undertone standing out on his pale skin. Wrinkles crease his face, but his hair and beard are thick and white, immaculately styled. He has a serious look, with stern, ice-blue eyes, a crystal monocle covering the left. Unslinging his kite shield, he draws a fine longsword, its blade glowing a cold white.

~ Played by Dagger with

Amber Drop With Insect.name:
带虫的琥珀滴
Amber Drop With Insect

Text.text:
困在琥珀的囚笼之中，一只史前昆虫蜷缩着，陷入永恒的沉眠。它那节肢分明的躯体上舒展开金丝般的薄翼，却再也无缘振翅。半透明的口器仍鼓胀着最后一餐——取自早已灭绝的巨型蜥蜴怪的血液。
Trapped inside an amber prison, a prehistoric insect curls in perpetual slumber. Filigree wings spread from its segmented body, never to fly again. Its translucent proboscis is still full with its last meal, the blood of a saurian behemoth long since extinct.

Artificer's Speech Of Self-affirmation.name:
奇械师的自我肯定宣言
Artificer's Speech Of Self-affirmation

Text.text:
“你是开拓者！你不满足于在这世界苟活！你要驾驭它。宇宙之力无穷无尽，只要施以些许学识，再借锻炉之火，便能将其握于掌心。”
“You are a pioneer! You do not seek to live in this world! You seek to master it. The forces of the universe are infinite, and with a bit of applied knowledge and a forge’s fire, they can be held in your hand.”

Jade The Whalefolk.name:
翡翠·鲸民
Jade The Whalefolk

Text.text:
那位夺目的女子匆匆掠过，穿着凉鞋的脚掌啪嗒啪嗒拍在鹅卵石街面上。她浑身覆着富有弹性的鳞片——从额头一路到肚脐，如鲸骨般闪着莹白的光；其余部位则像焦油般泛着乌黑油亮。格纹短裙缠绕着她的腰身，一条宽鳍尾巴从裙摆下探出；珊瑚色的衬衣下摆特意裁开，好让背鳍穿出——那背鳍正从她靛蓝色的波浪长发间高高突起。

~ 由一位英雄扮演

The striking woman’s sandaled feet slap against the cobbled street as she hurries past. She is covered in rubbery scales that glitter white as whalebone from her forehead to her navel, and gleam black as tar everywhere else. A wide-finned tail pokes out from beneath a tartan skirt that winds up her waist to meet the hem of a coral chemise cut to accommodate the dorsal fin protruding through her wavy indigo hair.

~ Played by a Hero

一张猪般的绿脸躲在高举的战斧与盾牌后咆哮喷鼻，二者皆为金属武装，锈迹斑斑。盾面绘着一枚咧笑的骷髅，然而这只塌鼻的生物毫无半分笑意。伤疤与一道爪状裂痕撕开了它右眼上方的皮肉，双眼燃烧着如将熄余烬般猩红的光。
A green piglike visage growls and snorts behind a raised axe and shield, both metal armaments stained with rust. The shield bears the image of a grinning skull, though the pug-nosed creature shares none of its mirth. Scars, a clawlike slash, rend the flesh over its right eye, and both eyes blaze as red as dying embers.

Dungeon: Spike Pit Trap.name:
地城：尖刺陷坑陷阱
Dungeon: Spike Pit Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 你的皮肤一阵发麻，后颈的汗毛根根竖起。这里有什么东西，藏在粗略一扫之下难以发觉。你的目光掠过天花板、墙壁、地面——就在那儿，离你只有几尺远，一块石板微微翘起，几乎难以察觉；石板边缘下方还藏着一枚巧妙的铰链，仿佛随时准备翻开。

[触发] 一阵古怪的敲击声从你脚下的地板传来，紧接着你猛然坠入黑暗，天旋地转。微光从活板门的缝隙里漏下，映出你下方寒芒一闪——坑底铺着某种阴狠锋利的尖刃。你伸手猛抓，绝望地想要找到一处支点，却只摸到光滑湿冷的石面。

[Perceived] Your skin prickles, and the hairs on the back of your neck stand on end. There’s something here, hidden from cursory sight. Your eyes scan the ceilings, walls, floor—there, just a few feet in front of you, a single flagstone is slightly raised, barely perceptible, and a cleverly hidden hinge beneath the stone’s lip sits ready to swing open.

[Triggered] A strange knocking sound emanates from the floor beneath you, and you are suddenly disoriented by a drop into darkness. Light filters through the trap door to reveal a gleam beneath you—something wickedly sharp lining the bottom of the pit. You reach out, desperate for a handhold, but find only smooth, slick stone.

被附身者跪在大理石地面上，脊背弓起，像潮虫般蜷在青紫的膝盖上。她那一帘油腻、血污纠结的头发后方，滚出一声含混的低吼。驱魔人颤抖地叹了口气，在冰冷刺骨的空气里，他的呼吸在面前化作白雾。他一手摊开书卷，圣徽的链条缠在臂上。“我命令你，恶魔。放了她！”这道命令一出，被附身者的头猛地甩起，狞笑将五官扯成一张兽性而幽幻的面具。乳白的眼睛淌出猩红泪水，下颌吱呀作响地向下拉长。两点红光自她大张的喉咙里、那不断扩张的黑暗深处刺出。“放了她！”伴随女妖般的尖啸，一团红雾从她口中蜿蜒滑出。最后一丝雾气离体时，她浑身战栗，漆黑的脓血顺着下巴滴落。

~ 一位英雄所构想

The possessed kneels against the marble floor, back bent like a pill bug over bruised knees. A growl gurgles from behind her curtain of slick, gore-matted hair. The exorcist sighs shakily, his breath misting before him in the ice-cold air. He holds a book open in one hand, his holy symbol’s chain wrapped about his arm. “I command you, demon. Release her!” The possessed’s head whips upward at this order, a grimace stretching her features into a visage bestial, phantasmic. Milk-white eyes cry red tears as her lower jaw stretches down with a creak. Two pinpricks of red light shine from within the expanding darkness of her gaping throat. “Release her!” With a shriek like a banshee’s, a fog of red mist slithers out from her mouth. She shudders as the last of it leaves her, dark ichor dribbling down her chin.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

巍峨高塔傲然压住整片原野，粗凿的垛口毫不因那些俗艳的旗帜点缀其威势而稍显柔和。那森严的建筑在比武场上投下漫长而沉重的阴影——狭窄的窗洞冷冷俯视，如同不满的眼睛，嘲弄着这些把战争当儿戏的人。
The impressive tower dominates the field, its rough-hewn battlements unsoftened by the tawdry banners festooning its might. The formidable edifice casts a vast shadow across the list—its narrow windows glaring down, like disapproving eyes mocking those playing at war.

I Transform Into A Bat With My Cloak Of.name:
我用蝙蝠斗篷化作一只蝙蝠
I Transform Into A Bat With My Cloak Of The Bat

Text.text:
踏入黑暗后，我把斗篷紧紧裹在身上，让它替我像蝙蝠般思考。皮肤上冒出一簇簇细小的绒毛发痒，斗篷随之变得纤薄、半透明、皮革般柔韧。我的脸被牵拉、扭曲、压平，黑暗再也无法阻挡视线。世界化作银灰色。我张口说话，言语所触及的一切，都骤然变得锐利夺目、棱角分明。
After stepping into the dark, I pull the cloak tight around me and let it think like a bat for me. Small patches of fur prickle from my skin as the cloak becomes fine, translucent, and leathery. My face pulls, twists, and flattens, and the dark no longer blocks my vision. The world turns silvery gray. I open my mouth and speak, and everything my word hits turns brilliantly sharp-edged.

Blighted Crop Field.name:
枯萎的庄稼地
Blighted Crop Field

Text.text:
连乌鸦都已抛弃了这片曾经丰饶的庄稼地。泥土龟裂变色，那场席卷此地作物的可怖疫病让这片土地本身也化作荒芜。平日里会啄食残株败叶的食腐小兽也远远避开，任由毁灭的遗痕长久停留，直到类人生灵的双手找到办法，让这片阴沉刺目的荒地重获生机。
Even the crows have abandoned this once-abundant crop field. The soil is cracked and discolored, the dirt itself made fallow by the dread disease that ravaged the crops planted here. The scavengers that would normally devour the leavings of such plants stay away, ensuring the legacy of the devastation remains until humanoid hands find a way to revitalize the dreary eyesore.

Loot From A Shrieker.name:
尖啸菇的战利品
Loot From A Shrieker

Text.text:
尖啸菇的菌盖摇摇晃晃，橡胶般的菌柄在死亡中垂落。你在它周围搜寻，发现它的触须状菌根纠缠盘绕，像是刻意扎在几只箱子和一口箱柜周围——一处真菌藏储。打开这些箱柜并不费事；里面是一套用于地下求生的物资：一盏装满灯油的提灯、一捆火把、几块硬得像石头的面包和耐嚼的肉干，以及两瓶落满灰尘的治疗药水。
The shrieker’s cap leans to and fro, its rubbery trunk wilting in death. Searching around it, you see its tendril roots were planted in a tangle around a few crates and a chest—a fungal cache. It proves quick work to open these cases, and inside you find a collection of items for underground survival: a lantern full of oil, a bundle of torches, some rock-hard bread and tough jerky, and two dusty healing potions.

Corpse Of A Giant Ape.name:
巨猿尸骸
Corpse Of A Giant Ape

Text.text:
那头巨大的类猿生物用呆滞的玻璃般双眼空望苍穹，长着獠牙的嘴松松垮垮地半张着，像一扇坏掉的门。野兽身上大半毛发都被灼烧殆尽，只剩几绺脆硬的残毛与焦黑的皮肉，勉强覆在下方虬结绷紧的肌肉之上。
The huge, simian creature stares blankly at the heavens through glassy eyes, its fanged mouth hanging loosely ajar like a broken door. The beast’s hair has been seared away across much of its body, leaving only brittle tufts and charred flesh to cover the corded musculature beneath.

一道身影稳稳踏前一步，肌肉虬结的躯体仿佛由仇恨与战争锻造而成。它身披黑铁甲片，甲面刻满私人纹身，行走间摩擦作响。碳钢长刃在娴熟的挥舞中发出尖啸。恶毒的笑意爬上战士猩红的面孔，唇皮向后翻卷，露出一排丑陋的地精獠牙。
A figure takes a balanced step forward, its muscular body wrought of hate and war. The black iron plating it wears is etched with personal tattoos and grates as it moves. Its carbon steel blade whistles in practiced swings. A malicious smile makes its way across the warrior’s crimson face, peeled back over a set of ugly goblinoid fangs.

Find Greater Steed.name:
寻获高等坐骑
Find Greater Steed

Text.text:
一声刺耳的长哨撕裂空气，一位天界灵体自更高的位面被召来。它无定形的光辉流转变幻，凝塑成凡俗可见的形态。那野兽俯首臣服于施法者，颈项弯成一道悦目的弧线。
A piercing whistle breaks the air as a celestial spirit is called forth from the higher planes. Its amorphous light shifts to take mortal form. The beast bows in supplication to the caster, its neck arcing in a pleasant curve.

Imprisoned Party In Barbarians' Snowy Ca.name:
被囚的队伍身陷野蛮人雪原营地
Imprisoned Party In Barbarians' Snowy Camp

Text.text:
你们被关在各自独立的铁笼里，铁笼悬在离地不远处，摇摇欲坠。你向外望去，只见一片披着兽皮的帐篷与临时搭建的棚屋，围绕着中央的火坑簇拥成团。刺骨的狂风穿过覆雪的营地，裹挟着烟火与久未清洗的汗腥肉味。篝火噼啪作响，火光跳动，把魁梧野蛮人围坐的面孔映得忽明忽暗。他们粗砺的笑声与喧闹的歌唱塞满夜色。

~ Envisioned by JT

You are locked in separate cages, each hanging precariously off the ground. As you gaze out, you take in the collection of fur-draped tents and makeshift shelters clustered around a central firepit. Harsh wind whips through the snow-sheathed camp, carrying with it the scent of smoke and unwashed flesh. The fire crackles merrily, casting flickering shadows across the faces of the hulking barbarians huddled around it. Their coarse laughter and raucous singing fill the night air.

~ Envisioned by JT

阿瓦尔莎年轻而精瘦，黑发如瀑，双耳修长尖翘，秀美得近乎锋利。最夺目的是她那深蓝近黑的肤色上，烙着高等精灵卓尔特有的幽白发光之眼。她热烈而执拗，冷峻而复仇，带领部族进出险境时，身姿流畅得像墨迹滑过纸面。匕首与弓在手，这位卓尔游荡者将族群最出色的特质凝于一身。

~ Played by Haku

Awartha is young, lean with black hair and beautifully long and pointed ears. Most striking against her dark blue-black skin are the glowing white eyes of the high-elf drow. Full of passion, stern and vengeful, she leads her tribe into and out of danger with the smooth grace of ink gliding over a page. With dagger and bow this rogue of the drow embodies the best qualities of her people.

~ Played by Haku

Goblin Commando.name:
地精突击队员
Goblin Commando

Text.text:
这只地精像把混沌与屠戮拧成一团，硬生生压缩进一具矮小的躯壳里。它一生都冲在最前，早已把自己变得狰狞不堪：半张脸被烧得皮肉焦烂；另一侧的耳朵几乎被削掉一半，残余那点也萎缩枯瘪。它将一柄马斩刀高高举起，像擎着神圣的战旗，战吼从一声低语开始，缓慢攀升，最终化作癫狂的尖啸：“砍……砍、砍砍、砍砍砍，砍！砍！砍！砍——啊啊啊砍！”
This goblin is a maelstrom of chaos and carnage coalesced into a compact form. A life of leading from the front has left this warrior hideously disfigured. Over half their face consists of burned flesh; the opposite ear is half severed, and the remaining bit atrophied. It holds a horsechopper like a holy banner, raising it high as they begin their war cry as a whisper, which slowly crescendos into crazed screeching: “chop…chop, chop-chop, chopchop, CHOP! CHOP! CHOP! CHOOOOOOP!”

Fruit And Vegetable Shop.name:
水果蔬菜店
Fruit And Vegetable Shop

Text.text:
在宽大的篷布下，阴影遮住了女贩与客人们的面孔。你看见一张张桌子被丰盛的瓜果蔬菜淹没。你挤进熙攘的人潮时，草木的清气、果汁的甜香与泥土的腥润一齐扑面而来。胡萝卜的青叶与芜菁的叶片从木箱里溢出来，橙子与苹果在一旁堆成小山，紧挨着一箱箱红得像红宝石的草莓。一个走散的甜瓜笨拙地在众人脚边滚来滚去。女贩手臂抱满蔬果，见人靠近便高声吆喝，报价、还价声此起彼伏。
Under the broad tarp granting shade to the faces of the vendor and her patrons, you see tables overrun with an abundance of fruits and vegetables. The smells of greenery, juice, and dirt greet you as you join the busy throng. Leafy carrot tops and turnip leaves spill out of their crates as oranges and apples pile high next to boxes of strawberries red as rubies. A wayward melon rolls clumsily between people’s feet. The vendor shouts offers and counteroffers as folks approach, her arms full of produce.

Bard's Atelier.name:
吟游诗人的工坊
Bard's Atelier

Text.text:
弓松香、黄铜与机油的气味沉沉压在空气里。角落的一张书桌上，堆叠的羊皮纸写满乐谱记号，几十首未竟的曲子半途而止。弦乐器斜倚在远处的墙边，每一件都仿佛在无声嗡鸣，蓄着尚未释放的可能。房间中央只有一张矮凳，旁边立着乐谱架，上面夹着吟游诗人传世杰作的终稿。
The smell of bow rosin, brass, and oil hangs heavy in the air. On a desk in the corner, piles of parchment with musical notation hold half-finished songs by the dozens. Stringed instruments lean against the far wall, each humming with silent potential. A single stool sits at the center of the room, a music stand beside it holding the final draft of the bard's masterpiece.

侏儒婴儿站得笔直，那份自信远远超出他们的月龄。他们开始进行自己的实验：先把杯中的牛奶倒在地上，然后扑通跪下，凑近仔细观察会发生什么。你发誓自己听见了一声若有所思的低哼。
The infant gnome stands with a confidence well beyond their months. They set to conduct their experiment, pouring milk from a cup onto the ground, then dropping to their knees to inspect what happens. You swear you hear a thoughtful grunt.

Reaper Of Bhaal Encounter.name:
巴尔收割者遭遇
Reaper Of Bhaal Encounter

Text.text:
兜帽之人散发着死亡的气息；仅仅是他们的存在，就让你的血液在体内狂冲乱撞，化作令人眩晕的猩红怒潮与嗜战的狂热。尽管袭击者的面容被阴影遮蔽，你仍在兜帽的幽暗深处辨出两点黯红的眼光——那是一名冷酷杀手的眼睛。
The hooded figure exudes an aura of death, their very presence causing your blood to hurtle through you in a dizzying crimson tumult of rage and battle lust. Though the assailant’s face is shrouded, you make out two dull red eyes in the umbral depths of their hood: the eyes of a merciless killer.

Divine Summit Of A God Of Resilience.name:
坚韧之神的神圣峰会
Divine Summit Of A God Of Resilience

Text.text:
无论你曾经历过怎样的修行——在静坐中锤炼心志，靠领悟拨云见日；在图书馆里埋首求索，或在重重障碍间一步步攀越——通往山巅的这条路，都要你拿出全部的纪律与坚忍。选择飞越，就要迎着刺骨的狂风冰霜；选择掘进，就得在最坚硬的岩层上寸寸磨砺。到了顶峰，在一小片覆着岩与雪的平坦处，神明如挚友般现身——他们早已在此等待，带着愉悦、鼓励与赞许。你们并肩眺望整个世界。此刻，你比以往任何时候都更强大，而你也终于明白：下方那些挑战，你都能应付。
Whatever training you have endured, in meditation or through comprehension, whether in libraries or over obstacles, this path to the top of the mountain requires all your discipline. To fly it is to brave icy gales, and to burrow through is to grind at the hardest of rock. At the summit, on a small flat place of rock and snow, the god appears as a dear friend, where they have waited with cheer and encouragement and praise. Together, you look out over the entire world. Here you are stronger than you have ever been, and now you know: you can handle the challenges down there.

A Tribute To The Ghost Ship.name:
献给幽灵船的致敬
A Tribute To The Ghost Ship

Text.text:
“岛上姑娘编来哄水手掏钱的机灵故事！”一名水手喊道。

“你把我们当什么了，卡洛？一艘幽灵（特征）船，抢到十万枚金币才肯罢休？然后呢？带着战利品沉下去休息，让满船亡魂一起长眠？”

卡洛船长露出一抹像绞刑架般的狞笑。“不。‘无畏号’会在夺走最后一笔战利品后才休息。但它不会沉——它会归我们所有。”

浓雾骤然吞没船身，远处号角如野兽咆哮回荡。众人血液冰冷，脸色刷地褪尽，齐齐望向船长等待命令。

“放下划艇！”大副吼道，已在清点艇上的货。卡洛守夜般注视着那只在浪尖摇晃、几乎翻覆的小筏——他的财运压在其上。一生的宝藏，献给“无畏号”饥渴的亡魂。
"A clever tale told by island maidens to part sailors of their coin!" cries a deckhand. 

"What do you take us for, Carlow? A ghost ship plundering until it collects a hundred thousand gold pieces? Then what? It sinks with its bounty to rest with all its souls?"

Captain Carlow gives his crew a gallows grin. "No. The Dreadnaught will rest when it has claimed its last bounty. But it will not sink—it will be ours."

Fog suddenly engulfs the ship, and roaring horns echo in the distance. Blood chills and drains from every face as they look to their captain for orders.

"Lower the rowboat!" shouts the first mate, already checking its cargo. Carlow watches the rocking raft nearly capsize in the waves, his fortune its burden. A lifetime of treasure for the hungry souls of the Dreadnaught.

Belmorn The Smuggler.name:
走私者贝尔莫恩
Belmorn The Smuggler

Text.text:
这个半卓尔的街头混混又高又瘦，灰黑色的皮肤衬得那双黄色眼睛格外戏剧化。他看起来干这一行有些年头了：中年模样，下巴上浮着一层淡淡的影子——若是任其生长，本该是一把白胡子。他懂行话，知道何时该讨喜逗趣，更知道何时该用目光把人钉在原地。他穿着一件毛领夹克，敞开着，里面是扣领衬衫与贴身内衣；手上戴着一枚华丽的戒指，嵌着一颗假宝石。胸前斜挎着一条能挂三把匕首的弹带。

~ Played by a Hero with

This half-drow guttersnipe is tall and slender, his yellow eyes dramatic against his gray-dark skin. It seems he’s been at this a while, middle-aged and with a shadow of what would be a white beard if it were allowed to grow out. He knows the lingo, when to be charming and funny, and especially when to stare someone down. He wears a fur-collared jacket, open over a button-up shirt and an undershirt, as well as an ornate ring bearing a fake gemstone. Slung across his chest is a three-dagger bandolier.

~ Played by a Hero with

Light Tattoo Parlor.name:
轻纹刺青馆
Light Tattoo Parlor

Text.text: 这栋楼脏兮兮的窗户里透出光来，窗面上被繁复的设计点亮——多彩的光之漩涡盘旋交织。纹身店的门上挂着三块招牌：我们营业、无痛、不退款。店内完全浸在虹彩般的辉光里，几位纹身师弓着背伏在客人身上，用光的线条一笔笔刻入皮肤。可从顾客压抑的闷哼与突兀的尖叫听来，这“无痛”似乎并没有招牌上写得那么轻松。 The building's dingy windows are illuminated by intricate designs of multicolored swirls of light. Three signs hang on the door of the tattoo parlor: We're Open, Painless, and No Refunds. The inside is entirely cast in a rainbow glow, with several artists hunched over as they etch lines of light into their patron's skin. From the grunts and yelps of the customers, it doesn't sound quite as painless as advertised.

Savvy Drone Mechanic.name:
精明的无人机技师
Savvy Drone Mechanic

Text.text:
机修师从一架散得七零八落的无人机后探出一张沾满油污的脸。她似乎对眼前所见毫无兴趣，又把注意力移回那件死物上。她双手灵巧而优雅地翻飞，没多久便将机器重新拼装妥当。她带着几分宠溺地抚过机身，这才回过头看向你。“需要点什么？”
The mechanic pokes her grease-stained face out from behind a drone in disarray. Seemingly unimpressed with what she sees, she returns her attention to the inanimate. Her hands move with deft elegance as she reassembles the machine in short order. She runs a hand affectionately over the machine before turning her attention back to you. "Need something?"

Spellcaster Quip About True Power.name:
施法者关于真正力量的俏皮话
Spellcaster Quip About True Power

Text.text:
“你怎么能推回海洋的潮汐？又怎么能挺身对抗飓风的狂怒？或者执掌群山般的力量？靠魔法啊，傻瓜。”
“How can you push back the tides of the ocean? Or stand against the fury of a hurricane? Or wield the strength of a mountain? With magic, silly.”

Berserker Intimidation.name:
狂战士的威吓
Berserker Intimidation

Text.text:
战士裹着纠结成团、血迹斑斑的兽皮逼近，骇人的嗜战狂热蒙住了他们狂野的双眼。隆起的肌肉在饱经风霜的皮肤下绷得紧紧的，他们轻蔑而轻松地将巨斧高举过顶，血污淋漓的斧刃甩出一串血珠，划出令人作呕的弧线。
Clad in matted, blood-stained furs, the warrior advances, a terrible battle-lust clouding their wild eyes. Bulging muscles pull taut beneath weathered skin as they heft a greataxe overhead with contemptuous ease, causing the gore-drenched blade to hurl drops of blood in a sickening arc.

I Am Transported To A Neutral Demiplane.name:
我被传送到一处中立的半位面
I Am Transported To A Neutral Demiplane

Text.text:
我被一股蛮横的力量拽着穿过空间，踉跄跌入一处渺小的存在位面。高而起伏的草海将我环抱，虫鸣细厉，却反衬出一片安宁。昏蒙的天空下，烈日刺目，将草色烤得一片淡金。草甸上零星矗立着巨大的岩石突起，石灰岩般惨白，花岗岩似的玫瑰红。远方海岸送来阵阵风息，带着清凉的咸味，替热浪开一道口子，也捎来浪拍礁石的低语。
I am bodily wrenched through space and stagger into a minor plane of existence. A sea of tall, waving grass surrounds me, tranquil with the whine of insects. The sun glares from a hazy sky, parching the grass a pale gold. Monolithic stone outcrops dot the meadow, limestone-white and granite-rose. Breaths of wind from a distant coastline bring cool, salt-scented relief from the heat and the whisper of wave on rock.

Gala: The Dance Begins.name:
盛典：舞步初启
Gala: The Dance Begins

Text.text:
一座宏阔大厅的中央已被清空，留作舞池。宴会的宾客中，有些人渴望看见与被看见，迫不及待地冲入第一支舞；另一些人则得体地徘徊在边缘，矜持观望。乐师奏起一段陌生的曲调，但舞者们似乎胸有成竹，成对起步、轻快换伴，跳着一支看似简单却颇具章法的活泼舞步。
The center of a vast hall has been cleared for dancing. Some guests of the party, eager to see and be seen, rush to join the first dance while others linger decorously about the fringes. The musicians play an unfamiliar tune, but the dancers seem to know what they’re doing, pairing off and exchanging partners in a sprightly dance that looks deceptively simple.

Adult Black Dragon Encounter.name:
成年黑龙遭遇
Adult Black Dragon Encounter

Text.text:
从沼泽恶臭的深处，一头巨龙潜行而出，宛如噩梦的化身。它的黯色鳞片像被刻出的阴影凝成实体，披着一层守护的黑暗。它踏碎泥潭，肩撞红树林开道，眼中满是精算般的恶意。毒息从它獠牙密布的巨口中呕吐般喷涌而出，化作腐蚀性的毒云，所触之处尽被侵蚀；它以雷霆之势朝你轰然逼近。
From the stinking depths of the swamp, a huge dragon stalks, the very epitome of a nightmare. Its dark scales are like carven shadows given form, a coat of guardian darkness. It stamps through the bog, shouldering aside mangroves, its eyes full of calculating malignance. Toxic breath pukes from its fang-filled maw, a corrosive cloud eroding all it touches, as it thunders toward you.

Beholder With A Scarlet Pupil.name:
绯瞳眼魔
Beholder With A Scarlet Pupil

Text.text:
野兽的躯体近乎浑圆，由一团团青筋暴起的肉丘堆叠而成。它形体中央嵌着一只独眼，深绯色的瞳孔如同裂开的伤口；其下方是一张口，塞满参差嶙峋的利齿。背上垂挂着十号粗壮、触手般的眼柄。每只眼似乎都能各自独立转动，显露出不同的性情：有的飞快而紊乱地扫视，有的却迟缓凝定、专注不移；而每一只眼的虹膜又各呈异色。
Veiny mounds of flesh make up the roughly spherical shaped body of the beast. In the middle of its form sits one eye with a deep scarlet pupil, and, below it, a mouth filled with jagged teeth. Hanging from its back are ten thick tentacle-like eyestalks. Each eye seems to move independently, displaying different temperaments as some move quickly and randomly while others seem to lag and concentrate, and each sports an iris of a different color,

你从一只煤烟般漆黑的麻袋里掏出一颗镀金骷髅，恶意的寒光在你脸上闪烁扭曲。你周围的空气骤然变冷。阴森而迟滞的词句从你裂开的嘴唇间黏稠滴落，你的双眼泛起墓穴般的幽光。现实被撕开一道伤口，有什么可怖之物从中爬出，其形骇人至极。
A flicker of malice distorts your face as you produce a gilded skull from a soot-black sack. The air about you grows cold. Sinister, sluggish words drip from your splitting lips, your eyes glowing with sepulchral ambience. A wound rips open in reality and something dreadful crawls out, its form hideous to behold.

Quip About Sense Of Humor After Insult.name:
被辱骂后还打趣自己的幽默感
Quip About Sense Of Humor After Insult

Text.text:
“你怎么一脸不爽？穿成这副模样，我还以为你挺有幽默感呢。”
“Why do you look so upset? With an outfit like that I assumed you had a sense of humor.”

Cultists Arguing.name:
邪教徒的争吵
Cultists Arguing

Text.text:
“我跟你说，这办法就是错的！”

“古籍写得明明白白。你算什么东西，也敢驳斥它们的教诲？”

两名邪教徒的激烈争吵被数位兜帽遮面的旁观者紧紧盯着。尽管旁人一言不发——沉默得近乎僵硬——他们却在细微的挪动中，各自站到某个口头斗士身后，用脚步把自己的立场暴露无遗。

“I tell you, the method is wrong!”

“The ancient texts are clear. Who are you to gainsay their teachings?”

The heated exchange between the two cultists is closely observed by several hooded witnesses. Though the bystanders remain silent—stiffly so—their subtle shuffling to stand behind one verbal combatant or the other makes their allegiances clear.

Biomancy Classroom.name:
生体魔法教室
Biomancy Classroom

Text.text:
教室的墙壁由人工雕刻而成，并以法术技艺相辅。波浪、蕨类的分形纹样、鹦鹉螺的壳纹与黄金螺旋铺满每一寸。青蓝与翠绿的釉彩细节和斑驳痕迹强化了效果，而一道灌注的法术令色泽的浓淡如潮汐般起伏流转。坐在这间教室的课桌前，仿佛任由深海潮水牵引沉浮。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The walls of the classroom are carved by hand, aided by spellcraft. Waves and the fractal patterns of ferns, nautilus shells, and golden spirals cover every inch. Stains and enameled details of teal and green heighten the effect, and an imbued spell causes the colors to ebb and flow in intensity. Sitting at a desk in this classroom feels as if you are at the whim of the tides in a deep sea.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

慵懒地靠在旅店一张桌旁，那名神情如被梦魇缠身的矮人独坐着，作伴的只有一柄沉重的战锤与一面盾牌，整齐叠放在邻座的椅子上。尽管他肚腹不小，矮人那身黑色精金护甲与布满凹痕的铁匠围裙仍诉说着他一生既在炉火边挥锤，也在战场上浴血。纵使赤红胡须间掺着几缕白霜、面容严峻，他那矢车菊般湛蓝的眼睛却闪烁着壮年矮人独有的智慧与锋芒。

~ 由一位英雄扮演

Comfortably reclined at one of the inn’s tables, the dwarf with the haunted mien sits with only a sizable warhammer and shield for company, stacked in an adjoining chair. Despite his not inconsiderable belly, the dwarf’s black adamantine armor and pockmarked smith’s apron speak of a life spent at the forge as well as on the battlefield. Despite the white streaks in his red beard and his stern demeanor, his cornflower blue eyes sparkle with the wisdom and sharpness of a dwarf in his prime.

~ Played by a Hero

Command Affecting Player.name:
影响玩家的命令
Command Affecting Player

Text.text:
施法者的面容骤然变幻，先是王者般的威仪——继而摄人心魄，令人无法抗拒。那个词在成形，施法者的唇瓣开合，你却听不见半点声音。刹那间，整个世界仿佛在可怖的寂静里屏息凝滞；紧接着，那道命令在你颅内轰然炸响。回声荡漾，仿佛你成了一具空壳，只为承载那唯一的词——它驱使你照其意志行事。立刻。

~ Envisioned by Chris

The caster’s face changes expression, something regal—then riveting, impossible to defy. The word forms, the caster’s lips move, although you hear nothing. For an instant, all the world seems to wait in horrible silence, then your head booms with the command. It echoes as if you were an empty vessel, a carrier of only that one word, compelling you to do its bidding. Right now.

~ Envisioned by Chris

她步态从容、优雅得不费吹灰之力，穿行在商人公会华丽铺陈的长廊间，手中精致的金属长杖随着步伐轻点地面，敲出稳定的节拍。她颈间银链上垂着一只小小的玻璃瓶，走动时在剪裁极为考究的束腰上衣前轻轻弹跳，瓶中粘稠的液体随之荡漾，折射出虹彩般的深红光泽。她光滑的古铜色肌肤微微发亮，带着一种若有若无的惑人光晕，仿佛永远沐着日光的亲吻；当她走近书记官的桌前，抬手将一缕不听话的深色波浪发丝拂离面颊。她以那双锐利的眼锁住书记官——像热带海面般浓艳的蔚蓝——随即绽出训练有素的廷臣式微笑，摇曳生姿地步入会长的办公室。

~ 由一位拥有 Played 的英雄扮演，

Carrying herself with effortless grace, the woman moves confidently through the lavishly decorated halls of the Merchant’s Guild, her elegant metal staff tapping out a steady rhythm in line with her strides. A small vial adorning the silver chain around her neck bounces against her exquisitely tailored tunic as she walks, causing the viscous liquid inside to shimmer with an iridescent crimson hue. Her smooth, bronze skin glows with a subtly enchanting radiance, like she always bears the kiss of the sun’s rays, and as she approaches the clerk’s desk, she takes a moment to brush a wayward strand of dark, wavy hair from her face. Fixing the clerk with piercing eyes—the lurid, azure blue of tropical seas—she flashes a practiced courtier’s smile and sashays into the guildmaster’s office.

~ Played by a Hero with

I Disparage A Rival.name:
我贬损一名对手
I Disparage A Rival

Text.text:
“我还不至于小气到见了天赋就视而不见。说真的，你这些年的磨炼确实没有白费……只可惜，那张脸是没法补救了。”
“I am not so petty as to ignore talent when I see it. And truly, your many years of training have paid off… Shame nothing can be done about that face, though.”

I Use Repelling Blast.name:
我使用【排斥爆破】
I Use Repelling Blast

Text.text:
当我的力能箭矢轰然砸中敌手时，我目光如炬，继续以意志催逼。低沉回荡的重击声与我的心念相合。诡异的异界之力将对手直直掀飞，短距离地抛离开去。
As my bolt of force smashes into my foe, I glare and will it further. A reverberating thump joins my wishes. Eldritch forces hurl my adversary straight away for a short distance.

Beached Whale Corpse.name:
搁浅的鲸尸
Beached Whale Corpse

Text.text:
当你逼近那头巨鲸庞大的尸骸时，一股咸腥与腐烂海藻交织的恶臭扑面而来；当你的视线与它那对玻璃般空洞的眼珠相触，一阵刺痛般的悲伤猛地穿透心口。拾荒者早已开始了它们阴冷的活计，带着不知疲倦的狂热撕啄着尸身。
An overwhelming stench of brine and rotting seaweed washes over you as you approach the massive corpse of a whale, and a pang of sadness lances through you as your eyes connect with the glassy orbs of its gaze. Scavengers have already begun their grim work, picking at the body with relentless fervor.

Werewolf Paladin And Druid Fight Giant I.name:
狼人圣骑士与德鲁伊鏖战巨型昆虫
Werewolf Paladin And Druid Fight Giant Insect

Text.text:
巨型昆虫的甲壳在光里一闪，猛然跃起扑向一名挥舞细剑的狼人；细剑寒光回闪，针锋相对。那兽化者粗砺的嗓音高喊战祷，细剑随之泛起辉芒。不远处，一道月光降临——德鲁伊施放的闪烁光柱，如同晶莹的圆筒，立在战圈旁。紧接着，他又低吼着向神祇发出呼唤，挥剑斩落。雷鸣在他们周围轰然炸响。昆虫被那股力量掀得倒飞出去……正撞入月光之中。片刻之后，虫影已无。

~ Envisioned by ThunderWolf

The gigantic insect’s carapace flashes in the light as it jumps at a werewolf wielding a rapier that flashes back. The rough voice of the lycanthrope shouts a battle prayer and the rapier glows. A moonbeam, a shimmering cylinder cast by a druid, appears near the fight. Then he growls out another call to his god and strikes. Thunder booms around them. The insect flies backward from the force of it… into the moonbeam. A moment later there is no insect.

~ Envisioned by ThunderWolf

A Devil's Offer.name:
恶魔的交易
A Devil's Offer

Text.text:
“欢迎！我不禁觉得……能与你同处一室，实在是种幸运。没关系，放轻松。若我真想害你，你早该知道了。见鬼，你的家人与朋友也会知道。你看，我盯上你已经有一段时代了，我只想说一句……你在处决敌人时展露的那股野蛮凶性，足以令我这点卑微手段相形见绌。我来此并非要浇灭你的热忱，更不是要诱你跌入某种讽刺的堕落。不是的，我只是想把你的锋芒引向一头格外邪恶的生物。此人算是我的同僚，他制造的苦难无穷无尽，不仅落在我身上，也落在那些你誓要守护的贞洁而高尚之人身上。用鲜血或智计把他从他的位子上拉下来，我便能献上一份与你的付出相称的恩赐。事实上，就算你失败了，我也能保证你们的灵魂在诸地狱里得到一处相对安静的角落，好让你们削磨永恒。你意下如何？”

~ 由 Vmaster1995 所构想

“Welcome! I can’t help but feel… fortunate to be in your presence. It’s all right, relax. If I meant you any harm, you’d know it. Hell, your family and friends would know it. You see, I have had my eye on you for quite some time, and can I just say… the savagery you display when dispatching your foes puts my humble efforts to shame. I am not here to discourage your fervor, or even trick you into some ironic corruption. No, I merely wish to point your efforts toward a particularly wicked creature. This colleague of mine has caused endless misery, not only to myself but to the many chaste and virtuous people you seek to protect. Remove him from his station through blood or cunning and I can offer a boon worthy of your efforts. In fact, even if you fail, I can guarantee your souls a relatively quiet corner of the hells to whittle away eternity. What do you say?”

~ Envisioned by Vmaster1995

Sundries From An Adult Red Dragon.name:
成年红龙的零碎杂物
Sundries From An Adult Red Dragon

Text.text:
余温仍从那具残破的尸骸中渗出，仿佛那头红龙依旧活着。所幸并非如此，你也终于觉得足够安全，得以靠近。战斗的惨烈规模，将这头曾经威风凛凛的巨兽碾成一滩狰狞的烂肉。几乎没有什么值钱的东西幸存，除了几枚钱币，深深嵌在它腹底柔软的皮肉里。
Heat still bleeds from the ruined corpse, as if the red dragon still lived. Thankfully, it is not so, and you feel safe enough to approach. The scale of the battle has rendered the once mighty beast into a brutalized mess. Little of worth survives, bar the handful of coins embedded in the soft skin of its underbelly.

Threat From A Monstrous Species About Ea.name:
来自某个怪物种族关于“吃掉你”的威胁
Threat From A Monstrous Species About Eating

Text.text:
“我不确定你这身肉里的蛋白质合不合我的胃口——但你越是开口，我就越愿意冒这个险。”
“I’m not sure the protein in your flesh would agree with me—but the more you talk the more I’m willing to risk it.”

Road Into City.name:
通往城中的道路
Road Into City

Text.text:
你跋涉已久，如今靴底下的道路在车轮碾出的辙痕之间被磨得平整光滑。空气里飘着烟火味，你听见远处市集的喧闹声。你与来来往往的旅人擦肩而过，他们谈论着那座城市——他们说，就在下一个弯道之后。你快到了。你又从几辆满载货物的车队旁走过，车上堆着来自四面八方的珍品——绫罗绸缎、香料，以及更多令人目眩的奇物。
You've traveled far, but the road beneath your boots is now worn and flat between the wagon wheel ruts. You smell smoke on the air, and hear the distant clamor of a market. You pass other travelers, coming and going, who speak of the city—just around the next bend, they say. You're close. You pass wagons laden with goods from across the region—silks and spices and other wondrous things.

Rothgar The Bard.name:
诗人罗特加
Rothgar The Bard

Text.text:
他脖子上挂着一个吹奏支架，支架里夹着一把巧夺天工的口琴，尺寸正适合龙裔的口鼻。他的鳞片、翼膜与尾巴都泛着黄铜般的光泽；头发是温暖的赤铜色，双眼猩红如炭。他是音乐之火的艺人，用烈麦酒点燃的笑话逗人开怀。时而心不在焉，却始终真诚；他爱在一本旧吟游诗人学院的日志里捣鼓摇滚歌剧的点子。胸甲覆体、肩铠压肩，他佩着一柄与行当相称的细剑，也背负着从龙之教团逃离时带走的记忆。

~ Played by Nigel Green

In a blowholder around his neck he carries a most ingeniously crafted harmonica, fit to a dragonborn snout. His scales, wings, and tail are all brassy; his hair is a warm copper while his eyes are red. He is an entertainer of musical fire, telling jokes fueled by strong ale. Sometimes oblivious but always true, he enjoys tinkering with rock operas in an old Bard College journal. Breast-plated and pauldroned, he carries a rapier appropriate to his profession, along with the memories of the dragon cult he escaped.

~ Played by Nigel Green

神龛内仿佛有一处小小的阶段，左侧立着一只高高的烤制陶碗。两根细长的香自碗中直插而出，正缓缓燃烧，浓郁的香气在空气里氤氲飘散。点香的人必定就在附近；这些香看起来最多也只燃了几分钟。
A tall baked clay bowl stands on the left side of a sort of stage within this shrine. Two tall sticks of incense stick out of the bowl, burning slowly and sending a heady perfume wafting through the air. Whoever lit the incense must be nearby. It doesn’t seem like they could have been burning for more than a few minutes.

裹着尸身的白布静静躺在柴堆顶端，苍白的布面在四周木材的暗色中分外刺目。粗壮的原木构成火葬柴堆的基底，被精心堆叠成平衡的格架，让空气穿行其间，为那贪婪的烈焰添柴送风。
The shrouded body lies atop the pyre, its pale cloth stark against the surrounding wood. Robust logs form the pyre’s foundation, stacked in a carefully balanced lattice to feed the ravenous flames with air.

Sundries From An Otyugh.name:
来自食腐怪的杂物
Sundries From An Otyugh

Text.text:
你在生物的藏身坑里翻找时，那潮湿巢穴的麝臭像一层黏腻的薄膜，紧紧糊在你的双手与脸上。除了扑面而来的恶臭、泥污，以及来源不明的残渣秽物外，你几乎没在这具异怪尸体周围找到什么藏匿之物。
The musk of the dank den clings to your hands and face in a sticky film as you dig through the creature’s hiding pit. Besides a great load of stink, muck, and offal of unknown origin, you do not find much hidden around the corpse of this aberration.

Dragon's Breath (Cold) Cast On Self.name:
龙息（寒冷）施放于自身
Dragon's Breath (Cold) Cast On Self

Text.text:
一声刺骨的嘶喊撕裂你的喉咙，周遭空气随转瞬即逝的力量翻涌盘旋。你双眼褪成惨白，从衣褶深处掏出一枚胡椒。冬之言语从你干裂的唇间溢出，你抬起张开的手掌重重拍在胸口，嘴巴不可思议地大张，仿佛要吞尽一切。随即，一场撕咬般的冰寒雪崩自你峡谷般的巨口轰然喷薄而出。
A chilling shout rips from your throat, the air about you swirling with transient power. Your eyes go pale as you produce a pepper from the folds of your clothes. Words of winter spill from your cracked lips, and you slap an open hand upon your chest, your mouth yawning impossibly wide. An avalanche of biting cold erupts from your canyon-like maw.

Nothic Appears From The Shadows.name:
诺希克从阴影中现身
Nothic Appears From The Shadows

Text.text:
黑暗中，一只眼睛浮现——催眠般的翠绿眼球中央嵌着细小的黑色瞳孔，几乎像在幽幽发光——离地数尺悬停着。你凝视它时，才逐渐辨出那只眼后方佝偻、隐约类人的躯体，正从浑浊的阴影里凝成形。尖刺沿着它血肉的脊背向外放射，它缓慢地挪动带爪的臂与足，一寸寸朝你逼近。眼下方裂开一道惨白的满齿狞笑，唾丝在剃刀般锋利的牙间牵扯拉长，它发出蛇信般的嘶嘶低鸣。
From the shadows, an eye emerges—a small black pupil in the middle of a hypnotic green orb that almost seems to glow—hovering a few feet off the ground. As you gaze upon it, you begin to make out the stooped, vaguely humanoid body behind the eye, materializing from the murky dark. Spikes radiate out from along its fleshly back, and it slowly inches its clawed arms and feet forward toward you. A white, toothy grin appears beneath the eye, strings of saliva stretching between razor-sharp teeth as it issues a sibilant hiss.

Dream Of The Blue Veil.name:
蓝纱之梦
Dream Of The Blue Veil

Text.text:
当妖精般的酣眠悄然降临，躯体纷纷坠地，湛蓝烟雾蒙住受影响者的头颅。每个沉睡之人唇边都浮起一抹轻柔的微笑。空气里弥漫着熏香的气息。紧接着——一具接一具，身影在带着蓝色晕光的雾团中噗然消散。
Bodies drop to the ground as the fey slumber takes hold, blue smoke veiling the heads of those affected. A soft smile crosses the face of each sleeper. A scent of incense takes the air. Then—one by one—the bodies disappear in puffs of blue-tinged mist.

一条黏滑滴涎的长舌从拟形怪那层层交错的剃刀利齿间滑出。唾液拉成丝，在它口中织成黏网，腐肉般的恶臭从缝隙里渗出。它喉间滚出一声闷响，听着像打了个嗝。
A slithering, slobbering tongue spills out from between the mimic’s mesh of razor teeth. Strings of saliva web within its mouth, with a stink like rotting meat seeping out. It rumbles a noise that sounds like a belch.

The Volcano Erupts.name:
火山喷发
The Volcano Erupts

Text.text:
犬群的嚎叫与一阵骤然掠起的鸟翼扑响，是唯一的预兆——下一刻，大地便在你脚下猛然起伏、震颤翻涌。震动把人和牲畜都颠得东倒西歪，你不得不拼命稳住身形，仿佛置身于狂涛中的船甲板。先是一声低沉的隆隆闷响，继而爆出震耳欲聋的咆哮，山顶像巨口般喷吐出成吨炽热的火山灰与灼烫气体，直冲天穹。冲击波如铁锤般碾压而来——声浪与力量都大到让你听不见周围人的尖叫。即便是你这样的存在，也被火山的暴怒彻底压倒、震慑；你立刻本能地渴望寻找掩蔽——躲避致命的灰雨，以及那些已被吐向苍穹、燃烧着的液态岩石碎块。
The howling of dogs and a sudden flurry of bird wings are the only warning before the ground begins to buck and shake beneath your feet. The tremor jars people and animals alike, and you must fight to keep standing, as if you were on the deck of a ship in turbulent waters. With a deep rumbling, followed by a roar, the top of the mountain belches tons of burning ash and hot gases high into the sky. The shockwave pounds over you—so loud, and with such force, that you cannot hear those around you screaming. Even for such as you, the fury of the volcano is overpowering and terrifying, and you feel an immediate need to seek shelter—protection from the deadly ash and the burning chunks of liquid rock already spat into the firmament.

毫无疑问，这是某个巨型生物的股骨与骨盆。沿着这把武器的长度，以均匀的间距嵌入了数道暗沉灰色金属箍。任何人握住它天然形成的握柄、将这把临时凑成的战锤举起时，都会感到一股野兽般的蛮力在体内奔涌震颤。
Unquestionably the thigh bone and pelvis of some gargantuan creature, bands of a dull gray metal have been embedded at even intervals along the length of the weapon. Anyone who lifts the improvised hammer by its natural grip feels a bestial strength thrill through their body.

Setting A Swinging Log Trap.name:
设定 摇摆圆木陷阱
Setting A Swinging Log Trap

Text.text: 先前你看见那根圆木被锯成合适的体型，年轮层层叠叠，宛如靶心。接着你站在撞击点，抬起手指在空气中描出它的轨迹。估算那股速度。绳结的编织、圆木的悬挂、卡扣与绊线的设定——你不禁怀疑这一切是否值得费这番功夫……直到你听见走廊深处传来令人满足的呼啸与咔嚓 声。 First you saw the log to the proper size, its tree rings forming a bullseye. Then stand at the impact point, tracing the trajectory in the air with a finger. Judge the speed. The knot work, the hanging of the log, setting the catch and the tripwire—you wonder if the result will be worth the effort . . . until you hear the satisfying whoosh and crunch from up the hall.

Effects Of Heroes' Feast.name:
英雄盛宴的效果
Effects Of Heroes' Feast

Text.text:
金烛台上的残焰噼啪作响，在空盘上投下摇曳的光。用餐结束，你觉得饱足，却不胀不倦，毫无往日那种迟滞的慵懒。相反，一股发痒般的活力在体内窜动。舌尖仍残留着一丝肉桂的余香。你高高扬起下巴，双眼熠熠生辉。英雄的事业等待完成！

~ 由一位英雄构想

Guttering flames atop golden candlesticks flicker over empty plates. At the end of the meal, you feel sated but somehow neither bloated nor tired, with none of the customary lethargy. In fact, you feel a tingle of ticklish energy course through your body. A taste of cinnamon lingers on your tongue. You raise your chin high. Your eyes gleam bright. There is heroes’ work to be done!

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Capital City Docking Bay.name:
首都城码头泊船湾
Capital City Docking Bay

Text.text:
身着高能见度夹克的地勤人员在那头巨兽投下的阴影里忙得像蚂蚁，迎着它朝庞大船坞缓缓降落。宛如逼近的泰坦级巨影，这艘主力舰在震耳欲聋的推进器轰鸣中沉降，抵达码头边缘时卷起大气紊流的龙卷风。佩戴工业级耳罩的码头工人飞奔上前，在它靠泊的瞬间固定这头猛兽，用巨大的重力夹钳将舰体系住——那夹钳的规模，足以与整座体育场相提并论。
Ground crew in high-visibility jackets scurry like ants in the shadow of the behemoth descending toward the enormous docking bay. Like a looming titan, the capital ship descends on deafening thrusters, throwing up tornados of atmospheric disturbance as it reaches the quayside. Dockhands wearing industrial ear-protectors rush over to secure the beast as it docks, mooring the ship with enormous grav-clamps the size of sporting arenas.

乍一眼看去，这把带篮形护手的侧剑不过像件华而不实的摆设——一柄镶宝石的特兰特鲁姆，最适合挂在墙上，或在摆拍肖像时佩戴。然而，当你的双手伸向这件武器，你立刻感到一股不容错认的力量，从剑首一路浸透到剑尖，隐隐刺痛如电。若有战士持此剑，再配以技能，在战场上几乎无人能敌。
Upon first glance, the basket-hilted sidesword looks like nothing more than an ornamental piece—a jeweled trantlum best suited for hanging on a wall, or to be worn while posing for a portrait. Yet, as your hands reach toward the weapon, you feel the unmistakable tingle of power infused from pommel to tip. A warrior with such a sword, combined with skill, would be nearly unbeatable in battle.

狂风推搡着你的身躯，撕扯你的衣物，松散的衣角在风中噼啪翻飞。你本能地迎着阵风倾身顶住，可风势忽然一缓，反倒把你推得踉跄失衡。砂砾刺痛你的脸，不知从何卷起，又在狂风再度加强时被狠狠拍向你。
The wind pushes your body and rips at your clothes, causing loose ends to flap and snap. You instinctively lean into the force of the gust, but then it slackens, driving you off balance. Grit stings your face, picked up from somewhere and driven against you as the gale picks up again.

Improvised Orb.name:
临时拼凑的法球
Improvised Orb

Text.text:
“要是我的宝珠碎了怎么办？”这是被诸界选中的年轻学徒法师最常问的问题。简短的回答是：“那你就辜负了你的宝珠。”

但一盏灯也行。也许是实验室里，柜顶上端坐着的一枚头骨。在最危急的情况下，记住：眼睛也是宝珠。你凭借对原本宝珠的记忆，将你的号令投向这替代之物，向那股被你允许受损的力量致意，直到它被修复为止。
What if my orb breaks? is the most common question from young student mages chosen by the spheres. The short answer is: “Then you have failed your orb.”
But a lamp will do. Perhaps a skull sitting atop a cabinet in the laboratory. In the direst of circumstances, remember that an eye is an orb. You cast your command over the substitute from the memory of your original, honoring the power that you allowed to be damaged, until it can be repaired.

Durah Kendi, Founder Of House Lion.name:
杜拉·肯迪，狮家创始人
Durah Kendi, Founder Of House Lion

Text.text:
她身形精悍，面庞仿佛由乌木凿刻而成；这位令人胆寒的建筑师、学院最初几大分院之一的领袖，本身亦是战斗法师。她在半隐退、来到学院执教之前，便已名震非洲腹地；同样为人称道的，还有她那一头狂放的黑与沙色交织的鬃发。她身着白色亚麻长袍，边缘缀以斑马皮饰；授课时以令人筋疲力尽的严苛纪律鞭策学生，却也以守护般的慈爱相待，使他们对她忠诚得近乎狂热。
Lightly muscled and with a face that seemed chiseled from ebony wood, the fearsome architect and leader of one of the Academy’s original houses was a battle mage. She was known across the African interior before semi-retiring to teach at the Academy, and for her wild mane of black-and-sand hair. Dressed in robes of white linen trimmed in zebra hide, she taught her students with fatiguing discipline, but also a protective kindness that made them fiercely loyal to her.

伴娘身着丝绸与蕾丝，伴郎则在鲜亮的棉质紧身上衣下穿着亚麻衬衫。舞步愈发炽热时，雏菊花环在女子发间散开，碎作花瓣飘落；紧身上衣也被解开纽扣，甚至干脆被丢到一旁。锡碟里的蜡烛悬在椽梁下摇曳闪烁。麦酒又一次、又一次准时送到。暧昧在角落里滋长——一句对发式的赞美，一个拿手套与手打趣的双关。

~ 由 Erutan 构想

The bridesmaids wear silk and lace, the groomsmen have linen shirts under bright cotton doublets. As the dancing heats up, daisy chains fall apart to drift down in petals from the women’s hair, and the doublets are unbuttoned or abandoned. Flickering candles in tin saucers hang from the rafters. Ale arrives on time again and again. Flirtations spring up, a compliment on a hairstyle, a pun about gloves and hands.

~ Envisioned by Erutan

The Sanctuary: Abandoned Humanoid-sized.name:
圣所：废弃的人形尺寸小屋
The Sanctuary: Abandoned Humanoid-sized House

Text.text:
越过林线，你们看见河岸边矗立着一座庞然巨石建筑。建造它的巨人似乎早已离去，如今这座结构正逐渐坠落于荒废与破败之中。你们才一靠近，一个散发着堆肥气味的大箱子里便传来急促而夸张的窸窣声，紧接着，数只浣熊钻了出来，为一块陈得发黑的老食物撕扯争抢。
Beyond the tree line is a gargantuan stone building on the bank of a river. Whatever giant built it appears to be gone now, as the structure is falling into disrepair. As you approach, emphatic rustling in a large box smelling of compost precedes the appearance of multiple raccoons squabbling over a portion of very old food.

一具巍峨的身影盘踞着山谷，自那条修长蜿蜒的脖颈俯视而下。它小得出奇的头颅嵌着卵石般的眼睛，几乎淹没在生物厚重皮革上暗色的褶浪之间，难以分辨。末端生着尖角的鞭状长尾左右甩动，维持平衡；它随之转身，拖着四条短粗的腿缓缓踱过，每一步都轰鸣如磨盘滚动。
A towering figure dominates the valley, peering down from a long sinuous neck. Its tiny head, set with pebble eyes, is barely discernable among the dark ripples of the creature’s thick hide. A whiplike tail protruding with horns swishes to balance it as it turns to plod past on four squat legs that thunder like millstones.

Heavy Rain In A Settlement.name:
聚居地的暴雨
Heavy Rain In A Settlement

Text.text:
雨势如锤，没完没了地砸落，化作一面迷蒙的水帘。街道奔涌成河，屋顶倾泻出层层瀑帘般的水幕。你浑身每一寸都被雨水压得沉重：鞋底每一步都挤出咕叽的水声，斗篷甩起稀里哗啦的水珠，像黏腻的泪水抹上你的脸。除了这场无情暴雨的噼啪拍打，你再也听不见别的声音。
Rain pummels down in an endless, misting curtain. Streets run as rivers and rooftops stream their cascade-veils. Every inch of you is weighted with water: your shoes squelch with each step and your cloak smatters your face with driveling tears. You cannot hear anything aside from the slap and patter of the relentless shower.

尽管你以前也见过这样的连枷，但这件武器在动作的收放之间却莫名更显得心应手。即便链条纠缠的麻烦近在眼前，当连枷的三颗锤头绕着粗壮的握柄一圈圈旋转、每次回环都发出轻促的啁响时，你心里涌上的只有从容与自信。
Though you have seen flails such as this one before, this weapon somehow feels more comfortable in its economy of motion. Despite the complications involved with tangling the weapon’s chains, you feel nothing but ease and confidence as the flail’s three heads whirl and chirp with every revolution around its stout handle.

Orbital Defense Platform: Control Center.name:
轨道防御平台：控制中心
Orbital Defense Platform: Control Center

Text.text: 军事上的务实主义塑造了控制中心的每一处性相，室内一切都以精密计算的效率运转。长程扫描仪以柔和、脉动的嗡鸣持续扫掠周遭数秒差距，而一座线条利落的指挥控制台布满数据屏幕，霸占了房间的视觉中心。桌上，一个巨大的红色按钮被危害条纹边框的有机玻璃罩护在其下，上方醒目地显示着 武装防御。 Military pragmatism has shaped the control center’s every aspect, and everything in the room runs with calculated efficiency. Long range scanners constantly sweep the surrounding parsecs with a soft, pulsing hum, and a sleek command console replete with data screens dominates the room. On the desk, a large red button shelters beneath plexiglass framed in hazard stripes, the words arm defenses displayed prominently above it.

Sundries From Orcus, Prince Of Undeath.name:
来自不死王子奥喀斯的杂物
Sundries From Orcus, Prince Of Undeath

Text.text: 王子轰然坠地，落下时连大地都为之震颤。他那被烈焰缠绕的双眼热度迅速褪去，只在羊颅般的头骨深处残留几星冰冷的余烬红点。其余身躯一动不动，唯独腹部以一种不自然的方式胀起、蠕动。被血浸洗的皮肤之下，细小的突起开始鼓胀翻涌。随后，伴随着一声骇人的噗嗤，三具骷髅从他的腹中炸裂而出，乘着血与胆汁的浪潮喷涌而下。它们自空洞的喉腔里迸出凄厉尖啸，浑身颤抖着试图撑起身子。紧接着又瘫倒下去——这一次，才算真正死透——化作一滩湿漉漉、冒着蒸汽的烂堆。 The prince falls, his body shaking the very earth as he lands. The heat from his flame-wreathed eyes diminishes into cool, ember pinpricks within his ram’s-skull head. His belly, swollen in an unnatural manner, wriggles as the rest of him lies still. Small protrusions begin to bubble up from underneath his blood-washed skin. Then, with a horrible squelch, three skeletons burst out of his stomach riding a surge of blood and bile. They loose terrible shrieks from their hollow throats, shaking as they try to lift themselves off the ground. They collapse—now truly dead—in a wet, steaming pile.

伴着爽朗的咯咯笑声，这位魔法厨师将璀璨的星屑轻轻洒在精致的蛋糕上，薰衣草般的烟雾薄纱在他周身旋绕。他明亮而炽热的双眼在忙碌间泛起柔和的淡紫光辉，将魔法注入这份甜点佳作，使其滋味更醇、鲜度更盛。
With a gregarious chortle, the magical chef sprinkles the delicate cake with radiant stars as a patina of lavender smoke swirls around him. His bright, passionate eyes shine with a soft lilac hue as he works, imbuing the culinary delight with magic to enhance its taste and freshness.

伤痕与淤青是这名女子最显眼的特征，尤其集中在脸颊与前臂。她疲惫的眼睛扫过四周，一边为下一场打斗缠紧手腕，动作熟稔得如同本能。收尾后，她一跃而起，朝空气挥出几记无形的试探拳，随即皱眉闷哼，捂着肋骨坐回原处。
Scars and bruises are this woman's most prominent feature, mainly around the face and forearms. Her tired eyes scan her surroundings as she wraps her wrists for the next fight, the movements second nature. When she's done, she hops up, throwing a few shadow punches before wincing and sitting again with a hand on her ribs.

这把弩比大多数都要大上一圈，你把它抬到与视线齐平时，沉甸甸的重量立刻绷紧了你的手臂，你随即检查它的状态。松木弩身与铁制部件咬合紧密，只在几处显出些许锈斑。弩托上固定着一只铁制绞盘，两条绳索将它连到一根手指粗的弦上；若没有它，想让这头怪物抛射沉重的弩矢，几乎是不可能的。
The crossbow is bigger than most, and the weight strains your arms as you raise it to eye level and inspect its condition. The pine frame and iron parts feel well-joined and show only a few spots of rust. Affixed at the stock and connected by two cords to a finger-thick drawstring is an iron crank, without which flinging heavy bolts from this beast would be nigh impossible.

Threat By A Corpo Agent Negotiating For.name:
企业特工以情报为筹码的威胁谈判
Threat By A Corpo Agent Negotiating For Information

Text.text:
“这笔交易没有任何附加条件。用信用点换情报：不多不少。可你要是再敢耍我，这场谈判就得让回收小队和拖把一起上场了。”
“This deal doesn’t have any extra conditions. It’s credits for information: nothing more, nothing less. But if you keep screwing me around, these negotiations are going to involve a recyc team and a mop."

Deserted House: Get Out!.name:
荒宅：滚出去！
Deserted House: Get Out!

Text.text:
昆虫的嗡鸣、乌鸦的聒噪，以及墙内那该死的抓挠声无休无止地延续着。血液在你耳边轰然搏动，仿佛墙壁正向你逼近，在看不见的压力下吱呀作响。此地的幽灵不欢迎你。
The buzzing of the insects, the cawing of the crows and that infernal scrabbling inside the walls continues ceaselessly. Blood pounds in your ears as it seems like the walls press in toward you, creaking under the strain of unseen pressure. The spirits of this place do not want you here.

若恩典能够触摸并握持，若惊奇可以缰控并骑乘，若那令呼吸骤停的壮丽——落日余晖、繁星夜幕、寒夜满月——应当踏着轻巧的蹄步走出幕帘，轻快地小跑着闯入眼帘，你或许会以为总有一个词能概括你所见。然而事实如此，unicorn 只能如此。 If grace could be touched and held, if wonder might be reined and ridden, if the breath-stopping splendor of sunsets, starry skies, and the full moon on cold nights should step forth on dainty hooves and prance into view, you might think a word could encapsulate what you witness. As it is, unicorn must do.

Threat From A Noble Quest-giver About Pa.name:
来自贵族委托人关于报酬的威胁
Threat From A Noble Quest-giver About Pay

Text.text:
“本来我打算在你完成任务后付你一大笔酬金，但事到如今，我正考虑把这笔钱给别人，好让人替我摆脱你这碍事又沉重的存在。”
“Originally, I was going to pay you a healthy sum for completing your task, but at this point, I’m considering giving it to someone else to relieve me of your burdensome presence.”

Knight With Mace.name:
持钉头锤的骑士
Knight With Mace

Text.text:
骑士挺立如雕像般冷峻而骄傲，一柄带凸缘的钉头锤牢牢握在手中。若在另一种设定里，这男人定会被称作迷人俊朗：浓密的黑发与丰厚的络腮胡修剪得一丝不苟、打理得恰到好处，将他矫健的轮廓衬得更为分明。可远离宫廷的奢华，他的神情却染上令人胆寒的野蛮性相——他用尖锐如刃的目光钉住你……随后逼近。
The knight stands stoic and proud, a flanged mace firmly in hand. In another setting the man would be considered charming and handsome, both his rich dark hair and full beard neatly trimmed and styled to accentuate his athletic features. Far from the luxuries of court, his demeanor takes on a frighteningly savage aspect as he fixes you with a piercing glare… and advances.

Petrified Minotaur.name:
石化的米诺陶洛斯
Petrified Minotaur

Text.text:
尽管已被石化成冰冷的石头，牛头怪的脸上却丝毫未减那炽烈的决心。他从牛般的口鼻间咧出露齿的狰狞笑意，弯曲的犄角沉沉压在眉骨之上。他双剑高举，臂膀与腹部的肌肉依旧紧绷，仿佛下一瞬就要爆发。
Though petrified into cold stone, the minotaur’s face has lost none of its fiery determination. He sports a grimace of bared teeth from his bovine snout, and his brow is made heavier by the weight of curved horns. His dual swords are raised, the muscles of his arms and abdomen still taut with anticipatory tension.

Gladiator Corpse.name:
角斗士的尸体
Gladiator Corpse

Text.text:
鲜血染红了竞技场的沙地，角斗士已然倒下，护甲在致命猛攻的凶烈之下被撕裂成碎。沾满尘土的皮护腕仍死死攥着战士折断的长剑与凹陷的盾牌，参差的创口划破那具筋肉虬结之躯的威严。
Blood stains the arena sands where the gladiator has fallen, their armor rent asunder by the ferocity of a lethal onslaught. Dusty leather gauntlets still grip the warrior’s broken sword and dented shield, and ragged wounds mar the majesty of their muscular body.

Loot From A Rat Horde Lair.name:
鼠群巢穴的战利品
Loot From A Rat Horde Lair

Text.text:
它们的巢穴散发着恶臭的秽物、湿漉漉的皮毛与死亡的气息。这片阴湿的空间里，浸满污垢的角落散落着被啃到一半的尸体。然而，在这堆骇人的收藏之中，你瞥见了金属与玻璃的寒光，以及其他古怪的小物件。那些老鼠再怎么贪吃，也全然不在意这些行走的食粮身上携带的财物。你拨开肿胀的蓝灰色肢体，发现了装着钱币的挎包、几瓶药水，甚至还有镶嵌着宝石的首饰。
Their nest reeks of stinking refuse, wet fur, and death. Half-eaten corpses litter the grime-soaked corners of this dank space. Among the grotesque collection, however, you spy the glint of metal, glass, and other oddments. As voracious as these rats were, they cared nothing for the treasures their walking meals carried. Brushing away the bloated, blue-gray limbs, you find satchels of coins, a couple of potions, and even jewelry set with precious stones.

这种爬行生物的身躯既优雅又健壮，轮廓像一只长腿、长尾的蜥蜴——体型却有大狼般庞大。灰绿的鳞板覆在它的额头、背脊与尾部，更浅的鳞板沿着腹面排列。角冠立于这头如龙的头颅之上，一道带刺的背脊嵴从颈部一路延伸到尾端。它漆黑的眼睛闪烁着野性的狡黠，踏着利爪的足掌悄然前行。
The graceful and muscular body of this reptilian creature has the profile of a long-legged, long tailed lizard—one the size of a big wolf. Gray-green plates cover its forehead, back, and tail, while paler plates line its underside. Horns crown the beast’s draconic head, and a spined dorsal crest runs from neck to tail. The drake’s black eyes shine with feral cunning as it pads along on clawed feet.

阴影笼罩的巷弄里，碎屑残骸遍地，蜿蜒穿行于紧密挤作一团的排屋之间。死水洼间磨损的鹅卵石湿滑发亮，两侧高耸的建筑仿佛不断逼近，挤压着本就令人窒息的狭窄通道。满月洒下银辉，而在远处，有什么在嚎叫——不完全像人，也不完全像兽。
The shadowed alleys, littered with debris, wind their meandering way between tightly clustered rowhouses. The worn cobblestones between stagnant puddles are slick, and the buildings looming on either side seem to close in, crowding the already claustrophobic passage. The full moon casts its silver light, and in the distance, something howls—not quite human, not quite beast.

Approaching A Royal Casino.name:
靠近皇家赌场
Approaching A Royal Casino

Text.text:
[外部] 王家赌场在炽烈灯火与刺眼色彩中熠熠生辉。它浮夸的奢华许诺美食、玩乐与好运——只要你牌打得对。鲜艳的墙上海报催促来客：来吧，留下！放个假！玩！玩！玩！ 赌客潮水般涌入大门，形形色色令人目眩。

[内部] 豪客与落魄苦力肩挨肩站着。有人顶着张扬的发型，有人头生犄角、覆着鳞片。安保人员的眼与耳无所遁形，他们悄无声息地融入人群。赌场老板把这座罪恶乐园打理得井井有条——而且显然打算一直如此。

~ 由 Vahlaron 构想

[Outside] The royal casino is resplendent with blazing light and garish color. Its gaudy opulence promises good food, good fun, and good fortune—if you play your cards right. Vibrant wall posters encourage visitors: Come and stay! Make a holiday! Play! Play! Play! Patrons surge through the doors in dizzying variety.

[Inside] High rollers stand shoulder to shoulder with down-on-their-luck laborers. Some heads are topped with flamboyant hairstyles, others with horns and scales. Nothing escapes the eyes and ears of the security detail, who insinuate themselves unobtrusively into the crowds. The casino boss runs an orderly house of vice—and evidently intends to keep it that way.

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

尽管这把刀刃平衡得近乎完美，锋口亦寒光凛冽，你的目光却立刻被镶嵌在刃脊上的三颗不同寻常的半宝石所攫住。按理说，为了将这几枚既好看却并不稀罕的黄水晶石英嵌入武器之中，所耗费的心血与时代足以让人期待看到蓝宝石、祖母绿，甚至钻石。然而，当你仅仅握住刀刃的那一刻，胸口却涌起一种无法言明的……欢腾。
Though the blade is exquisitely balanced and its edge keen, your eye is immediately drawn to the three unusual, semiprecious stones embedded in the rib of the blade itself. For all the care and time it must have taken to set the handsome yet common citrine quartz into the weapon, one might expect sapphires, emeralds, or even diamonds. And yet, simply taking hold of the blade makes you feel inexplicably… jubilant.

Sundries From An Unseelie Queen.name:
来自不祥妖精女王的杂物
Sundries From An Unseelie Queen

Text.text:
在女王那团朦胧的手中，你发现了一件奇异的物品：一枚玻璃棋子。你虽认得它的造型，可这玻璃却更为玄奥。灰、黑、蓝的色泽在光里游移变幻——彼此流淌交融，仿佛暗影在催眠般起舞——当你在掌心转动它时，那景象令人目眩神迷。
Clutched in the nebulous hand of the queen you find a curious item: a glass chess piece. Though you recognize the design of the piece, the glass is of a much more esoteric nature. Hues of gray, black, and blue shift in the light—flowing into each other in a mesmerizing dance of shadows—as you rotate the piece in your hands.

Greeting From A Bitter Guard.name:
来自一名怨愤守卫的问候
Greeting From A Bitter Guard

Text.text:
“欢迎来到这座人们称之为城市的粪堆。强盗、骗子和贼几乎把这里的每一处角落缝隙都当成了窝——看你这副模样，想必很快就能融得进去。”
“Welcome to this dung heap people call a city. Brigands, liars, and thieves have taken up residence in just about every nook and cranny of this place, so, judging by the look of you, you should fit right in.”

Cruiser: Outer Hull.name:
巡洋舰：外部船壳
Cruiser: Outer Hull

Text.text:
巡洋舰如一座漂浮的大教堂，统御着周遭的空间。较小的舰船在这巨像的阴影下瑟缩退避，远远绕开这艘庞然大物。透过舰体湛蓝的舷窗，隐约可见身着洁白制服的细小身影——船员们照常忙碌着——仿佛附着在泰坦巨兽躯体上的螨虫。
Like a floating cathedral the cruiser dominates the space around it. Lesser vessels quail in the shadow of the colossus and give the humongous ship a wide berth. Tiny specks in crisp white uniforms can be seen through the cerulean windows of the vessel—as the crew go about their day—like mites on the body of a titanic beast.

Vampire Cloak.name:
吸血鬼（特征）斗篷
Vampire Cloak

Text.text:
缎面与天鹅绒锦缎的工艺、斗篷的裁剪，以及它的分量与长度——无不昭示着它超越了所属的时代。而那，已是数个世纪之前。它挂在一座高高的木质衣架上，宽阔的黑色貂皮下摆离地只差一线。衣领以一条金链固定，链扣铸成一位怒目天使的形状，它以审判般的姿态指向回链条，仿佛在谴责。
The workmanship of satin and velvet brocade, the cut of the cloak and its weight and length, these all mark it as ahead of its time. Which was many centuries ago. It hangs on a tall wooden valet, its wide black hem of sable not quite touching the ground. The collar is held in place with a gold chain and a clasp shaped like a furious angel, which points back to the chain in condemnation.

街道中央矗立着一根粗壮的砖柱——柱脚是一只石盆，雕刻成女子的水罐里有清水涓涓滴落其中。砖柱约有二十英尺高，顶端还托着另一只石盆。你听说过这种东西，却从未亲眼见过。水从远处、从高处沿着地下的沟渠或管道奔流而来；这座水塔掌控水压，将水分配到公共水盆以及周围部分建筑之中。
A thick pillar of brick stands in the street—a stone basin at its foot into which water trickles from the urn of sculpted woman. The pillar rises perhaps twenty feet into the air and has another stone basin atop it. You’ve heard of these but never seen one. Water flows from a great height and distance through channels or pipes in the ground;  this water tower controls the pressure and distributes water to the public basin and some of the surrounding buildings.

Recurring Nightmare Of Terrible Deed.name:
可怖恶行的反复梦魇
Recurring Nightmare Of Terrible Deed

Text.text:
英雄恍恍惚惚地走着，双腿——不由自主——将他们带回自己亲手酿成的现场。困在自己的脑海里，他们尖叫着，拼命想从那具行走的魅影手中夺回控制，阻止即将上演的可怖一幕。一遍又一遍地重演。哀求。刀光乍闪。鲜血。难道他们注定要受这折磨，直到生命尽头？有时他们觉得，自己活该。

~ 构想：Gixxer1st，来自 Discord

The hero walks in a stupor, legs carrying them—unbidden—to the scene of their deed. Trapped in their own mind, they scream, desperate to wrestle control from the walking phantom and avert the terrible events about to unfold. The living it over and over again. The pleading. The flash of the blade. The blood. Are they doomed to suffer this torment until their dying day? Sometimes they think they deserve to.

~ Envisioned by Gixxer1st on Discord

Magical Coral Reef.name:
魔法珊瑚礁
Magical Coral Reef

Text.text:
斑驳的日光穿过上方起伏的波浪洒下，照亮了珊瑚礁那令人目眩的彩虹光泽。珊瑚仿佛在蠕动翻卷，偶尔你会看见一只眼睑倏然睁合，或是一根触手懒洋洋地抽出，顺势卷住游过的鱼。那些簇拥成礁体的石质珊瑚虫也时不时像张开的嘴一般阖动，猛地将鱼吞走。
Dappled daylight coming through the waves above illuminates the dazzling rainbow of the reef. The coral seems to move and writhe, and occasionally you see an eyelid blink open, or a tentacle lash out lazily to snag a fish passing by. The stony polyps clustered to form the reef's body occasionally open like mouths to snatch fish as well.

The Sanctuary: Citadel.name:
圣所：要塞
The Sanctuary: Citadel

Text.text:
越过城池拱门，空气里弥漫着刺鼻的硫磺气息。门外通向一条条暗色石铺街道，偶尔被大片煤烟般的黑痕染得更深。小生灵们怯生生地在城中四处游荡，只敢低声说话。阴郁都会中央那座令人胆寒的高塔塔顶，时不时迸出一团团橙色火焰的闪光。
The prominent smell of sulfur suffuses the air beyond the arched gate of the city, which opens to streets of dark stone occasionally blackened further with large streaks of soot. Critters mill about timidly throughout the city, only speaking in whispers. The top of the menacing tower at the center of the morose metropolis occasionally flashes with bursts of orange flame.

苍白的疤痕纵横交错，爬满他的脸与裸露的手臂；隆起的肉脊像虫般蜿蜒，掠过他粗犷的五官与饱满、虬结的肌肉。他那身半身板甲贴着魁梧的体型起伏，甲面上也刻着同样的劈砍式纹饰。两把巨剑收在背后的剑鞘里，他的身高足以让他背着它们行走，剑尖也不至于拖擦地面。显然，他是个习惯于近身搏杀——也习惯于险境擦身而过的战士。他那张伤痕累累的脸上表情颇为淡漠；唯一泄露出的情绪，是浓褐色眼眸深处一抹微微闷燃的火光。

~ Played by Rocky with

Pale scars crisscross over his face and bare arms, the raised ridges of flesh worming over his features and full, bulging muscles. The half plate armor rounding over his hulking frame bears the same sort of slashed decoration. Two greatswords rest in sheaths on his back, his height allowing him to carry them about without their points scraping against the floor. Clearly, he is a warrior accustomed to close combat—to close calls. The expression on his scarred face is rather muted; the only hint of emotion is a slight smolder within his rich brown eyes.

~ Played by Rocky with

尽管地下空气冷冽，这间厅室却让人觉得温热，仿佛在字面意义上噼啪作响、充满力量。房间中央，一枚同色水晶迸射出道道绿色闪电；其狂野能量被宝石周围一座构装体的极柱所吸收。空气中的力量像是变得黏稠可触，裹挟着怒意与狂躁的暴怒，仿佛有什么在疯狂挣扎。那水晶里不只是能量——而是某个强大得不可思议的存在，正握着这股力量挥舞。

~ 由 XxRedrum 设想

Despite the cool subterranean air, the chamber feels warm, literally crackling with power. Bolts of green lightning shoot from a crystal of matching color in the center of the room, its wild energy being absorbed by the poles of a construct around the gem. The power in the air seems to physically thicken with a feeling of rage, of thrashing fury. It's not just energy in the crystal, but something incredibly powerful that wields it.

~ Envisioned by XxRedrum

North Coppice Ward In Winter.name:
冬日的北矮林区
North Coppice Ward In Winter

Text.text:
一辆樱桃红的跑车停在车行的停车场上，惹人目光；旁边一对情侣局促地听着修车工讲解冬季保养车辆的重要性。对街的蹄铁匠守夜般看着这一幕，一边揉着发酸的手肘，一边低声发笑。民宅的凸窗里，一只巧克力色的拉布拉多打着盹，鼻息把玻璃窗蒙出一层雾。空气中还飘着一股诱人的香气——甜而温暖，从东方随风吹来。
A cherry-red sports car draws the eye to the car shop lot and a couple listening sheepishly as the mechanic explains the importance of maintaining vehicles in winter. The farrier watches from across the way, chuckling as he massages an ache in his elbow. In the bay window of a residential home, a chocolate lab dozes, his nose steaming the window pane. And in the air there is an inviting scent, sweet and warm, blowing in from the east.

Tribal Warrior With Body Paint.name:
身披战纹的部族战士
Tribal Warrior With Body Paint

Text.text:
身体彩绘打散了她的轮廓：剃光的头颅一半亮白如雪，一半漆黑如墨。颜料一路向下延伸，在她的皮肤上划出条纹，直到没入染成黑色、缀满白骨的兽皮护甲之下。野猪的獠牙勾勒出她凶悍的面容，而她手持一杆长矛，燧石矛尖锋利得不输你曾挥舞过的任何钢制武器。
Body paint breaks up her outline, defining her shaven head with one half bright white, the other pitch black. The paint continues downward, striping her skin until it disappears beneath hide armor dyed black and decorated with bone. Her fierce face is framed by the tusks of a boar, and she carries a long spear with a flint tip that looks as sharp as any steel weapon you’ve wielded.

震耳欲聋的轰鸣拍打着发电站的混凝土墙面，巨大的涡轮以不可思议的速度疯狂旋转，大地随之颤抖。刺眼的荧光黄危害标识在建筑内无处不在，连安全道具上也贴满了。现代工程学的庞然堡垒以压倒性的规模让你感到自身渺小，这种感觉令人难以忽视。
A deafening roar buffets the concrete walls in the power station, and the ground trembles as gargantuan turbines spin impossibly fast. The day-glow yellow of hazard signs is omnipresent in the building, including on the safety gear. The colossal bastion of modern engineering imposes a sense of insignificance upon you that is hard to ignore.

Nearby Storefront Explodes Into Flames.name:
附近的店面轰然爆燃，瞬间化作一片火海
Nearby Storefront Explodes Into Flames

Text.text:
一阵尘土与碎裂混凝土从店铺里猛然炸出，紧接着是一波烈焰翻涌。猩红的烟雾让人根本看不清里面发生了什么——就算你能硬扛那堵灼热的热浪也无济于事。爆炸扭曲了建筑的外壳，而明亮的霓虹招牌与笑容满面的广告仍以唱反调般的乐观固执闪烁，甚至盖不住痛苦与混乱的尖叫。
A storm of dust and concrete bursts from the shop, followed shortly by a wave of flames. The red smoke makes it impossible to tell what's going on inside, even if you could face the wall of heat. The explosion distorted the edifice of the building, and bright neon signs and smiling advertisements persist in contrarian optimism even through the screams of pain and confusion.

Gray Ooze On Floor.name:
地板上的灰色软泥
Gray Ooze On Floor

Text.text: 地面上一滩潮湿的水渍微微颤动，仿佛有什么沉重之物在近处落地，可你却看不出缘由。紧接着，那滩水渍像被人掀起床单般剥离地面，起伏着向上翻卷。你的思绪迟了一拍才追上眼前的景象：那水洼并非积水，而是一只湿滑蠕动的生物，颜色与质地都与周遭石面如出一辙。 The puddle of dampness on the floor quivers, as if a great weight landed nearby, but you see no cause. Then the puddle peels and undulates upward, as if someone were flipping a bedsheet. It takes your mind a moment to register what your eyes see. The puddle is not a pool of water but a slick and slithery creature the same color and texture as the surrounding stone.

Ulfgrim Stoutblade.name:
乌尔夫格里姆·坚刃
Ulfgrim Stoutblade

Text.text:
穿行于雾缠的林间，一名身披赤褐猎装的猎人悄然潜行；他本该光秃的头顶正中留着一缕散发，任风拂动如旗。猫般的眼睛在树影间游移，从不曾停歇，所有心神都钉在猎物上。几簇雪花短暂栖在他编起的胡须辫里。右侧头皮烙着熊掌纹身；其下，一道暴怒般的疤痕横贯头顶。他那件补丁软甲的袖口卷至肘上，露出苍白前臂，上面扭动着诡秘的符文与护咒。他忽然驻足——察觉到了自己的猎物。短剑与手斧自鞘中嘶鸣而出，落入他粗砺的掌中。缓慢而刻意地，他将剑刃划过自己的手臂。符文与刀锋同时爆燃，迸发出炽亮的圣辉。

~ Played by Vmaster1995 with

Through mist-wreathed woods stalks a russet-garbed hunter, the stripe of loose hair adorning the middle of his otherwise bald head dancing in the wind. Catlike eyes scan the trees, never still, utterly focused on the hunt. Flurries of snow nest briefly in the braids of his beard. The right side of his head is emblazoned with a bear paw tattoo; below, an angry scar crawls across his scalp. The sleeves of his patched gambeson are rolled back, revealing pale forearms writhing with twisted esoteric runes and wardings. He stops, noticing his quarry. A shortsword and axe hiss from sheaths, filling his rugged hands. Slowly, deliberately, he runs the sword across his arm. Both the runes and the blade erupt with radiant light.

~ Played by Vmaster1995 with

你周遭的荒野在那有翼生物发动伏击前的一瞬，忽然凝滞无声。尖啸撕裂寂静，厚重的巨羽拍击声如雷点落。下一刻，它已扑到你眼前——巨鹰与恶魔般、长着蛇牙的雄鹿扭曲缝合而成的怪物。血红的眼睛灼然燃烧，它伸展覆鳞的脚掌，末端是阴毒的利爪，带着贪婪的狂喜，向着唾手可得的猎物一把攫来。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The wilderness around you becomes still and quiet in the moment before the winged creature springs its ambush. A screech splits the silence, punctuated by the beating of great, feathered wings. And then it’s upon you—a twisted amalgamation of giant eagle and fiendish, snake-toothed stag. Blood-red eyes blaze as it stretches scaled feet that end in wicked talons, grasping for easy prey with a voracious glee.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Cast Acid Arrow Using Components.name:
我用构材施放酸液箭
I Cast Acid Arrow Using Components

Text.text:
这个法术所求甚多，而我没有时间犹豫。蝰蛇的胃囊收在小袋里，研成粉的叶片混在我的一排小瓶之间。我把胃囊套上食指，随即启开小瓶，将粉末倾入另一只掌心。我嘶声吐出一个词，碾磨着粉末与蝰蛇胃囊相触，浓烈的大黄气味猛地冲起，囊膜随之湿润、鼓胀，咕嘟咕嘟冒起泡来。我抬手一指，射出一支酸蚀狂怒之箭。
This spell requires much, and I don’t have the time to hesitate. The adder’s stomach is in a pouch, the powdered leaf among my vials. I slide the stomach over my index finger, then pop the vial and pour out the powder into my other palm. I hiss a word, grinding the powder against the adder’s stomach, and the smell of rhubarb is strong as the sheath moistens and begins to bubble. I point and fire an arrow of acidic fury.

树木高耸入云，冠盖如幕，将阳光都压成阴影。它们的树干宽如屋舍，烙着林火留下的狰狞疤痕，却仍顽强屹立。苔藓覆满林地，悄然爬上横陈的倒木，那些枯躯如倒下的巨人。空气里沉甸甸地弥漫着腐殖土与朽烂的气味。你在纠结盘错的根系间穿行，脚下枯叶与细枝咯吱作响。树木沉默守望，注视着，倾听着。
The trees tower so large their canopies shadow the sun. Their trunks, wide as houses, bear the unmistakable scars of forest fires, and yet they persist. Moss coats the forest floor, creeping over deadfalls sprawled like fallen giants. The air smells heavy of loam and rot. Leaves and twigs crunch underfoot as you navigate tangled knots of roots. The trees stand silent vigil, watching, listening.

Camouflaged Hobgoblin With Longbow.name:
伪装的持长弓大地精
Camouflaged Hobgoblin With Longbow

Text.text:
你的目光掠过荒原与荆丛，捕捉到小鸟与小兽的移动；它们像这类生灵向来那样，几乎毫无惊惶。你放松了戒备，视线正要移开——却在那一瞬看见了它。灌木深处，一支灰褐色的鹿角，孤零零地藏着。你顺着那道弧线追过去，却没见到鹿的头骨，反倒瞥见一条棕色皮革束带……以及一只赤红皮肤的手紧绷着，琥珀眼的熊地精正微调他们鹿角长弓的准星。昏暗里，铁质箭头泛出一抹钝光，紧接着弓弦“嗡”地一响。鸟翼在惊恐中轰然振鸣，扑起一大团慌乱的云，而你猛地扑倒在地。
Your gaze rakes through the veld and brambles, noting the movement of small birds and animals, as free of alarm as such creatures ever are. You relax your guard, and your gaze begins to shift—but then you see it. A single gray-brown antler, hidden in a large bush. You follow its curve, but instead of a deer’s skull, you spot a brown leather strap… and a red-skinned hand tensed as the amber-eyed hobgoblin adjusts their antler-longbow’s aim. The dull glint of an iron arrowhead winks in the low light just before a twang sounds. The birds’ wings hum in a great fluttering cloud of panic as you throw yourself to the ground.

Reinhardt Dawnbreaker.name:
莱因哈特·破晓者
Reinhardt Dawnbreaker

Text.text:
这个犀人看起来坚不可摧。他的皮肤本身就是一层坚韧如革的护甲，表面却刻满细密的伤疤。能把他的犀角折断的东西，必定强到半神等级。他身上刺着盾牌纹身，手持一柄长戟。他浑身肌肉虬结，粗砺而压迫感十足，披着圣武士的护甲，作为族群的代表与守护者。

~ 由一位英雄扮演，其

This rhinofolk looks unbreakable. His skin is its own leathery armor, although its surface is etched with fine scars. Whatever it took to break his horn must have been something at the demigod level. He wears the tattoo of a shield and carries a halberd. He is all muscle, gruff, imposing, and dons the armor of a paladin, a representative and protector of his race.

~ Played by a Hero with

I Cast Dominate Monster From My Ring Of.name:
我从火元素统御之戒中施放【支配怪物】
I Cast Dominate Monster From My Ring Of Fire Elemental Command

Text.text:
额头汗珠闪亮，我抬起手，迎向眼前那张翻卷燃烧的火焰面孔。随着生物逼近，我的戒指灼热得几乎要烫穿皮肤，嵌在其中的橙色宝石骤然迸发出刺目的强光。元素被猛然震退，它那狂怒燃烧的双眼随之熄去几分，只剩恍惚而惊异的神色。它用太初之语开口，语调带着好奇……甚至友善。
Brow glistening with sweat, I raise a hand to the furling, fiery face before me. My ring grows blazing hot as the creature closes in, then the orange gem set within it flashes a blinding light. The elemental is thrown back, and its furious, burning eyes simmer down to a look of dazed wonder. It speaks in its primordial tongue, its tone curious… even friendly.

女子那双祖母绿般的眼眸几乎不可察觉地一动，便泄露了她情绪的转变。她微微挑眉，听着被她逼入死角的窃贼语无伦次的胡言乱语。她的衣着时髦却实用，外罩一层上过油的皮革护具，令她平添几分神秘与危险。灰金色的头发以利落的方式向后束起，露出略微尖翘的耳尖；被日晒过的面容上仍留着精灵族裔的痕迹——不过已隔了几代。她从腰带上抽出一柄细长的匕首，漫不经心地在纤细而精巧的指间转着刃光，给窃贼抛出一个选择：归还偷走的东西，从此再也别回来——否则，自食其果。

~ Played by a Hero

An almost imperceptible shift in the woman’s emerald eyes signifies her changing disposition. She arches an eyebrow and listens to the incoherent babble of the thief she has cornered. Her clothing is stylish but practical, the oiled leathers over her clothes giving her an edge of mystique and danger. Ash-blonde hair is tied back in a sensible style over her slightly pointed ears, and her tanned features bear the hallmarks of elven ancestry—a few generations removed. Taking a stiletto from her belt and casually spinning it between her slender, delicate fingers, she offers the thief a choice: return what was stolen and never come back—or suffer the consequences.

~ Played by a Hero

Subterranean Lava Channel.name:
地下熔岩通道
Subterranean Lava Channel

Text.text:
你踏入洞窟的瞬间，干燥而温暖的空气陡然化作炉膛般的热浪扑面而来，洞壁在橘色辉光与深红阴影中闪烁。低沉却压抑的轰鸣传入耳中，而光芒的源头印证了你最坏的预感：一条熔融岩石之河正穿过洞穴奔流不息。
The dry, warm air becomes a furnace blast of heat as you enter the cavern, and the walls glimmer with orange light and crimson shadows. A deep but quiet rumble reaches your ears, and the source of the light confirms your worst fear: a river of molten rock flows through the cave.

Potion Of Vitality.name:
活力药剂
Potion Of Vitality

Text.text:
玻璃瓶中的液体呈浓郁的血红色，浸透着柔和的微光，仿佛随某种熟悉的韵律脉动。就像把心跳的生命精髓封存于其中一般。
The liquid in the glass bottle is a rich, sanguine color, infused with a soft glow that pulses with a familiar rhythm. It’s as though the vital essence of a heartbeat has been captured within.

这道法术危险至极，你记得旁人曾告诫你：这绝非儿戏。如今你挥动羽毛，真切明白了那话的分量——你选定的目标立刻爆发出一阵撕裂般的歇斯底里狂笑，痛得无法自已。
The spell is dangerous, and you recall others telling you that it is no laughing matter. You know, now, the truth of that, as you wave a feather in the air and your intended target immediately bursts into a painful fit of hysterical laughter.

小小的毛茸茸生物呼出一口带着嘶鸣的气息，凝神聚力，汲取妖精位面那未经驯化的原始魔法。它肩头上方轻轻浮沉的魂光骤然停住，空气里缓缓飘落的尘埃微粒也随之凝结——狭窄的地道中，时代被拖拽得几近停滞。挖掘者抡起鹤嘴镐，立刻开凿矿壁，迫不及待要挖出洞窟岩层深处藏着的珍贵许愿石。
Breathing out with a wheeze, the small furry creature focuses its powers and draws in the raw magic of the Faerie Plane. The gentle bobbing of the Soul-Light over its shoulder stops, and the motes of dust trickling through the air freeze, as time slows to a crawl in the cramped tunnel. The digger hefts its pick and sets to work mining, eager to get to the precious wish stones hidden within the cavern walls.

卫兵站得很放松，却又透着一股随时能出手的警觉。身上的链甲保养得当，穿得从容，沉甸甸的分量被多年习惯磨成了轻松的姿态。一件斗篷披在肩头，覆着其职位所属的色彩与徽记。腰侧一把长剑随手挂着，剑鞘里松松地含着，仿佛只需一瞬便能出鞘。剑身毫无装饰，朴素——却为其用途打造得恰到好处。
The guard stands with a relaxed posture, but one that seems to indicate a readiness to act if necessary. They wear well-kept chain armor comfortably, bearing its weight with an ease born from years of use. A cloak drapes their shoulders, bearing the colors and sigil of their station. On one hip, a sword rests ready, loose in its scabbard. The blade is unadorned, simple—and perfectly built for its purpose.

Swarm Of Small Blights.name:
小型枯萎群
Swarm Of Small Blights

Text.text:
若只是一只生物，你或许会觉得它迷人——甚至可爱。但当十几只以上从灌木丛下窜出时，情况便截然不同：它们各自踩着由盘绕根须组成的两条腿疾奔而来。它们伸出由细枝拼成的手臂向你触及，而它们的面孔由枝条的瘤结与翠绿藤蔓交织而成，扭曲成一种阴森而期待的神情。
Were there a single creature, you might find it charming—even cute. But over a dozen of them emerge from the underbrush, each sprinting atop two legs composed of coiled roots. They reach for you with arms made up of twigs, and their faces, knotworks of branches and green vines, twist into expressions of macabre anticipation.

Spell Scrolls Dealer.name:
法术卷轴商人
Spell Scrolls Dealer

Text.text:
这间宽敞的店面里，嵌入墙壁的六边形格架宛如一座巨大的蜂巢。每个蜂房格内都放着六张法术卷轴，分别密封在独立的气密皮筒中，安然无虞。每个格子下方排列着一串字母与数字，而每支皮筒外侧又细细誊写着另一组同样晦涩的代码——这套高效却玄奥的编目系统，唯有店主与雇员才明白其中门道。
The hexagonal shelves built into the walls of this sizable storefront resemble an enormous honeycomb. Inside each honeycomb cell lie six spell scrolls, safe inside individual airtight leather tubes. A series of letters and numbers beneath each cell, and a separate, equally obscure code carefully penned on the outside of every tube are evidence of an efficient, if abstruse, cataloging system known only to the proprietor and employees.

Vampire Bat Swarm.name:
吸血鬼蝙蝠群
Vampire Bat Swarm

Text.text:
一团云压了下来——大得足以掩蔽月亮——浓稠的红雨般滴落，倾泻在你身上。皮革般的振翼声汇成刺耳的喧嚣，宣告着它们的饥渴。它们扁鼻獠牙，像从扭曲噩梦里爬出的微型石像鬼；斑驳的褐色毛皮吞噬你勉力捕捉的最后一丝光，而它们自己那狂乱的红宝石般眼睛，却在黑暗中如将熄的星辰般闪烁。单个不过是害虫，但如此蜂拥的群袭，足以在数秒内把最强壮的冒险者放干鲜血。它们尖厉的嘶鸣声，正以此为威胁。
Thick drops of red rain shower from a cloud—large enough to cover the moon—as it descends upon you. A cacophony of leathery flapping heralds their hunger. Snub-nosed and fanged, they look like tiny gargoyles from a grotesque nightmare, and their mottled brown fur absorbs what little light remains to your straining eyes, while their own rabid rubies shine like dying stars in the dark. Individually, they are little more than pests, but such a swarm could exsanguinate the hardiest of adventurers in seconds. The shrill sound of their screeching is threatening such a fate.

Sounds Of An Urban Cyberpunk Block.name:
都市赛博朋克街区的声音
Sounds Of An Urban Cyberpunk Block

Text.text:
城市天际线在远处以锂电或聚变电池驱动的引擎低鸣中嗡嗡作响，偶有一两架飞行器以速度掠过。尖锐的嘶鸣声仿佛一张罩住万物的薄布，用它的音色给楼宇与街道镀上一层震颤。零碎的乐声从巨型建筑的拱门间或公寓窗内飘出，又随即消散。
The cityscape hums with distant engines run on lithium or fusion cells, one or two flying by at speed. A high-pitched whine, like a sheet thrown over everything, coats the buildings and streets with its tone. Shards of music drift from archways in titanic structures or from apartment windows, then fade.

Challenge From Ruffian.name:
来自恶棍的挑战
Challenge From Ruffian

Text.text:
“这条胳膊，是我硬塞进一个聒噪鬼的喉咙里时丢的。要让你闭嘴，我很乐意把另一条也赔上。”

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，出自 Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

“Lost this arm shoving it down a loudmouth’s throat. I’ll gladly lose the other one shutting you up.”

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

这是一种潜伏在世界幽深黑暗之处的可憎异怪，专门猎杀脆弱之人。当它从幽影中现身，巨大的皮质鳍翼猛然舒展，兽形真容随之毕露——它如同魟鱼般俯冲而下，裹住猎物，将其吞噬殆尽，猩红的双眼闪烁着掠食者的狂喜。
A hideous aberration lurking in the deep, dark places of the world, this terrifying creature preys on the vulnerable. Unfurling huge leathery fins as it emerges from the gloom, the beast reveals its true nature, descending like a stingray upon its victim, to envelop and devour them, its red eyes shining with predatory glee.

苔藓般的发丝从这名兽人赭黄的秃顶两侧疯长出来。他虽高大，厚重的体量却让他显得矮墩墩的。躯体纠结隆起，布满颗粒般的疙瘩，像种子被紧紧压在荚壁下。兽人的双眼周围环着一圈暗沉破裂的皮肤，粗粝得如同风雨侵蚀的树皮。他行走时那纤长的步态里隐约带着一丝华尔兹的低语；当他挪动着步伐逼近，拉近你们之间的空间，你能感觉到大地正回应着他的移位而微微震颤。

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

Mossy hair sprouts from the sides of the orc’s ocher pate. Though tall, his mass makes him stumpy. His body is knotted and pebbled like seeds pressed against the skin of their pod. The orc’s two eyes are ringed by dark, broken skin, rough as weathered bark. There’s a whisper of a waltz in the willowy way he walks, and you can feel the earth responding to his shifting as he closes the space between you.

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

一只生物从灌木丛下钻出，双腿直立行走。它的手臂由细枝拼成，双腿几乎只是盘卷的根须，勉强凝成脚趾的轮廓。叶片从它的肩头与躯干抽生出来，恰似披着一身衣物的错觉。它的面孔由交缠的枝条与翠绿藤蔓结成，流露出几分好奇的神情。
A creature emerges from the underbrush, walking on two legs. Twigs make up its arms, and its legs are little more than coiled roots with a semblance of toes. Leaves sprout from its shoulders and torso, which create the illusion of garments. Its face, a knotwork of branches and green vines, evokes an expression of curiosity.

Glint From Scope Reveals Hidden Shooter.name:
瞄准镜的微光暴露了潜伏的枪手
Glint From Scope Reveals Hidden Shooter

Text.text:
你脑海深处某种原始的本能催促你更仔细地探查附近的建筑，目光扫过一扇扇窗户，搜寻潜藏的危险。然后你看见了：三层楼高的地方，一点瞄准镜的寒光闪过，正对着你这边。
Some primal part of your brain encourages you to investigate the nearby building more closely, scanning the windows for hidden dangers. Then you see it: the glint of a scope, three floors up and aiming in your direction.

Ghoul Paralyzes Player.name:
食尸鬼麻痹玩家
Ghoul Paralyzes Player

Text.text:
[豁免失败] 爪痕迅速变得冰冷。麻木自伤口飞快蔓延，继而化作僵硬。肌肉绷紧，关节锁死。你的身体不再响应任何驱使你移动的心念。

[后续豁免成功/麻痹结束] 冰冷的僵滞渐渐退去，只留下针刺般的酥麻感，随之而来的是重新能动的身体。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

[Failed Save] Scratches from the claws grow cold. Numbness spreads rapidly from the wounds, followed by rigidity. Muscles stiffen and joints lock. Your body stops responding to any mental command to move.

[Subsequent Successful Save/Paralysis Ends] The cold stiffness fades, leaving pins and needles and the ability to move again in its wake.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

亡者拖着残躯向前爬行，雾蒙蒙的眼窝里透出黯淡惨白的幽光。蛆虫从它们青灰发绿的腐肉孔洞中探出头来，随着宿主的碎块坠落地面，噗叽作响地四散蠕动。每迈出一步，骨头便咔哒咔哒地撞击作响。它们从污秽的喉咙里挤出沙哑的叹息，腐肉的恶臭随之弥漫在空气中。
The undead drag themselves forward, a dim and pallid light glowing within their fogged eyes. Maggots peek through holes in their green-grey flesh, squelching and scattering as pieces of their hosts fall to the floor. Bones click and clatter with each uneasy step. They release rasping sighs from their foul throats, filling the air with the stench of rotten flesh.

Javonn The Oathbreaker.name:
贾冯，“背誓者”
Javonn The Oathbreaker

Text.text:
年轻的圣骑士体内有一股盘旋的怒火在暗暗沸腾，像他苍白肌肤上那一道道带刺的纹痕般，绞扭着他的脏腑。他俊朗的面容被卷曲的乌发半遮半掩，却被一声凶狠的狞笑撕裂；双眼开始如炽热的煤块般发光。翻涌的狂怒在他体内蔓延，纹路染上猩红，光芒愈发炽亮，怒意层层堆叠，最终在胸腔里化作一座咆哮的熔岩巨釜。随着一声怒吼，战士骤然爆发，长柄斧戟缠绕着猩红能量的辉光，挥下时将敌人尽数斩落。

~ 由一位英雄扮演

A coiling rage simmers within the young paladin, twisting his innards like the barbed markings painting his pale flesh. A handsome face, framed by curling swathes of dark hair, is marred by a vicious snarl as his eyes begin to glow like hot coals. The seething fury spreads through him as his markings turn red, glowing brighter and brighter as the anger builds to a roiling caldera within him. With a cry, the warrior bursts into action, his halberd shimmering with crimson energy as he strikes down his foes.

~ Played by a Hero

全场观众屏住呼吸，只见一枚烟花直冲天际，在人群间刺耳的尖啸成了唯一的声响。它飞得太远，连声音也听不见了，漫长的寂静被硬生生拉长——直到那枚小火箭猛然炸开，化作一场绚烂的多彩火雨与光瀑。人群立刻爆发出震耳欲聋的欢呼，瞬间淹没了又一打烟花接连升空的轰鸣，它们纷纷加入这场盛大的庆典焰舞。
The entire audience holds their breath as a single firework streams into the sky, its high-pitched whine the only sound amid the crowd. It gets too far to hear, and the moment of silence drags on, until the little rocket bursts into a shower of multicolored fire and light. The crowd immediately erupts into cheers, drowning out the sound of a dozen new fireworks launching into the sky to join the celebratory display.

Breathtaking Ugliness Of Fey Creature.name:
妖精生物的惊心丑陋
Breathtaking Ugliness Of Fey Creature

Text.text:
一声惊叫卡在你干涩的喉咙里——一个丑恶的怪物赫然出现在你面前。它低吼着，浓稠的乳白唾液从布满疣瘤的腮肉间拖曳而下。它的牙齿斑驳腐败，舌头上鼓起一颗颗搏动的痈疮。本该生长毛发的地方却覆满厚重的真菌斑块，爬满头顶与胯间；它的眼睛鼓胀浑浊，如水晶球般蒙翳，仿佛正死死盯着你的嘴。
A yell catches in your dry throat as a hideous being appears before you. It snarls, thick, milky saliva trailing down its warty jowls. Its teeth are mottled with blight, and its tongue is stricken with pulsing carbuncles. Thick fungal patches grow where hair should be, over its head and groin, and its eyes, bulbous and cloudy as crystal balls, seem to stare at your mouth.

他带着蜥蜴人部族特有的口音，低声对着一枚精美的戒指呢喃，仿佛正与那颗硕大的红色宝石里藏着的某个存在交谈。戒指戴在他那只手上——那只手以鳞覆的蓝色手指夹着一根魔杖。颈间垂着一枚护身符，红得与戒指相映成辉。他的脸像一只野性十足、眼神发亮的壁虎，目光在一件又一件闪耀的奇物间游移；这些宝物与他的弩一并陈列在身侧。空着的那只手则拂过长袍，将近日发掘带来的尘土轻轻掸落。

~ 由一位英雄 扮演

He whispers—with the accent of his lizardfolk tribe—into a beautiful ring, as if having a conversation with someone inside the large red gemstone. He wears the ring on a hand holding a wand between scaly blue fingers. Around his neck hangs an amulet that matches the red of the ring. His face is like a wild-eyed gecko’s, and he shifts his gaze from one shiny artifact to the next, all set before him beside his crossbow. With his free hand, he brushes the dust of a recent dig from his robe.

~ Played by a Hero

Faerie Tax Fountain In Winter.name:
冬之妖精税赋喷泉
Faerie Tax Fountain In Winter

Text.text:
喷泉结着一层霜壳，一滴水也不流。每一层边缘上蹲着的仙灵雕像神情肃然，凝视着自己空空如也、向外摊开的掌心。它们的翅膀看起来有些蔫软，仿佛寒意夺走了它们原本的轻快灵性。喷泉最底层的边缘放着一只盛满牛奶的陶碗。一只知更鸟轻巧落下，好奇地啄了啄。
The fountain, crusted with frost, is not running any water. The faerie statues perched on the edges of each tier stare soberly into their empty, outstretched palms. Their wings appear a bit wilted, as if the chill has taken away their spritely nature. A ceramic bowl filled with milk sits on the edge of the fountain’s lowest tier. A robin alights and pecks at it curiously.

Professor Of Conjuration And Wands.name:
咒法与魔杖学教授
Professor Of Conjuration And Wands

Text.text:
他几乎总是坐在一张深蓝色、巨大的蓬松软椅上，那椅子被魔法托举，悬空漂浮。沉甸甸又喜气洋洋的他，滑行般掠过教室，一边讲解每个学生魔杖的特性与怪癖；而随着学生年复一年地进阶，他的课程也愈发精准、愈发刁钻，越来越难以掌握。待他凭空唤出一道烈焰，后墙被灼得恰到好处，焦痕分毫不差，可教室里别的任何一根线头、一片木屑却连一点温意都不曾沾上。随后他低低一笑，心满意足。
He is almost always seated in a magically hovering, giant poufy chair of deep blue. Heavy and happy, he glides about the room, explaining the features and peculiarities of each student’s wand, and his lessons grow more specific and difficult to master with each year a student advances. When he conjures a blast of flame, the back wall is perfectly scorched but not a thread or splinter of anything else in class is even warm. Then he laughs softly, satisfied.

Haunted House: Storage Room.name:
鬼屋：储藏室
Haunted House: Storage Room

Text.text:
通往储藏室的通道明亮而干燥，你所见之处，所有容器都完好无损。然而，当你经过一只寻常的木箱时，瞥见地上躺着一具中等大小的蜘蛛尸体——仰面朝天，死因成谜。离它六码远，又有一只……再一只……再一只。八具死蜘蛛排成一条痕迹，蜿蜒没入阴影深处。房间某处传来一声低沉的咆哮，浑厚如低音，在四壁间回荡不止。
