The route into the storage room is well-lit and dry, every container in perfect condition so far as you can tell. However, as you pass a typical crate, you see the body of a medium-sized spider lying on its back on the ground. The means of its death is a mystery. Six inches beyond it there lies another… and another… and another. A trail of eight dead spiders leads into the shadows. From somewhere in the room, a low bass growl sounds, and echoes throughout.

I Use Indomitable Might.name:
我动用【不屈之力】
I Use Indomitable Might

Text.text:
我的力量似乎在动摇，但我加倍努力。我低吼着，怒火的力量在体内奔涌。肌肉与筋腱屈从于我的意志与狂怒的威能。
My strength seems to waver, but I redouble my efforts. I growl and the power of my fury surges through me. Muscle and sinew obey the might of my will and rage.

Gathering Nuts And Berries.name:
采集坚果与浆果
Gathering Nuts And Berries

Text.text:
在一片荆棘丛生的灌木带中，部族之人熟练地穿梭翻找，采集坚果与浆果。凭着直觉与对周遭环境的深刻熟稔，他们将大地的馈赠一一收入囊中——每一次轻摘、每一次柔拧，都把果腹与生存编织在一起。他们顺应荒野原始的脉动，与之同息同行。
Within a swath of thorny growth, tribe folk skillfully scour the bushes, foraging for nuts and berries. Guided by instinct and intimate knowledge of their surroundings, they gather nature's bounty, weaving sustenance and survival with every pluck and gentle twist. They act in harmony with the primal rhythms of the wild.

Sullen Social Media Influencer.name:
阴郁的社交媒体网红
Sullen Social Media Influencer

Text.text:
在一群魁梧保镖的簇拥下，一个绿发的哥特女孩向后倚着她的推进背包，背包让她轻轻漂浮在离地数寸的高度，她漫不经心地滑动着，无尽刷过一条条爆火内容的资讯流。她宛如画中人般完美无瑕，脸是一张无可挑剔的瓷白面具，只在右眼下方点着一枚小巧精致的红色纹身。可即便这张完美的脸，也遮不住她那种彻底、赤裸的无聊神情。
Surrounded by hulking bodyguards, a green-haired goth leans back into her propulsion backpack that keeps her gently floating several inches above the ground, flicking through endless feeds of viral content. She’s picture perfect, her face a flawless porcelain mask, marked only by a single dainty red tattoo underneath her right eye. Yet even her perfect face cannot hide her look of abject boredom.

Fake Bracers Of Defense.name:
伪造的防御护腕
Fake Bracers Of Defense

Text.text:
当你捧起那对“魔法护臂”时，却沮丧地发现它在你掌中软塌塌地弯折。原本看似精巧的金色花丝，其实只是淡黄色的棉线，抹了胶才勉强挺硬。护臂的钩织工艺确实精美，却毫无半点魔力。
When you hold the magically armored bracers, you are dismayed to find that they bend flimsily in your grasp. What appeared to be delicate golden filigree is actually cotton thread of a pale yellow color, stiffened with glue. The bracers are beautifully crocheted, but not at all magical.

一道光柱自地表的孔洞倾泻而下，照亮了那片位于广阔水池中央的沙质小岛；池水澄澈如晶，泛着幽蓝。光芒仿佛刺穿了世界皮肤上一枚巨大的气泡顶端——宏伟的圆形洞窟石壁环抱着水面，向上攀升，直至顶端那道狭窄的开口。
A shaft of light coming through a hole in the earth illuminates a sandy island in the middle of a wide pool of crystalline blue. It pierces what seems like the top of a bubble in the skin of the world as the walls of a great circular cave wrap around the water and rise up to the narrow opening at the top.

一个身影从尘雾弥漫的昏暗中浮现。他散发着躁动不安的气息，与此地死一般的静寂形成刺目的对比。被阳光晒成古铜的皮肤粗粝如砂，诉说着长年行走在旷野之下的日子；短短的黑发利落贴服，让他看起来务实，甚至有些冷峻。那双锐利的金琥珀色眼睛——仿佛熔化的钱币——却闪着深沉的怜悯之光。自胸口一路划至下颌，一道锯齿般的疤痕横亘其间。他身披简朴的深色皮革，外罩一件磨旧的毛衬夹克，像是无数次远征留下的痕迹。腰间垂着一对黑色匕首——或许是游荡者的家伙事儿，但他的双手更像是为探寻而生，而非夺命。他以近乎苛刻的专注扫视四周，永不停歇，永远在寻找。动作间带着某种独特的风采，含蓄而优雅。他是个悖论：粗野与精致交织——坚硬的躯壳里，困着一颗不肯安宁的灵魂。

~ Played by TheAwksThief

A figure emerges from the dust-laden gloom. He emits a restless energy, a deep contrast to the stillness of this place. His tanned skin is rough, telling of a life spent beneath open skies, his short, black hair giving him a practical, almost severe look. Piercing, golden-amber eyes—like molten coins—glow with a deep well of empathy. A jagged scar stretches from his chest to his chin. He’s clothed in simple, dark leathers, overlaid with a worn fur-lined jacket that hints at countless past expeditions. Twin black daggers dangle at his belt—tools of a rogue, potentially, though his hands seem more inclined to explore than mete out death. He scans his surroundings with intense focus, ever moving, ever seeking. There’s a distinct flair to his movements, a muted elegance. He is a paradox, a mix of the untamed and the refined—a restless soul within a rugged frame.

~ Played by TheAwksThief

Warning About Overconfidence In The Wild.name:
荒野中的自信过头警告
Warning About Overconfidence In The Wilds

Text.text:
“我敢肯定，你那点虚张声势在你出生的那个狗洞里或许很好使，但到了外头，自信比任何野兽都更快要你的命。谨慎与恐惧才是荒野的语言。你要是不听，最后只会任它宰割。”
“I’m sure your bravado served you well in whatever hole you were born in, but out here confidence kills faster than any beast. Caution and fear are the language of the wilds. If you don’t listen, you’ll end up at its mercy.”

Temple To A Goddess Of Disease.name:
疫病女神神庙
Temple To A Goddess Of Disease

Text.text:
神殿一尘不染，光洁如新——却弥漫着压低嗓音的肃穆。主廊两侧的房间里摆满了床铺，专供那些病弱者歇息；他们来到此处，向“诸疾之母”乞求怜悯。男祭司与女祭司照料着这些祈求者，好更深刻地理解女神意志的使者。神殿中的每一间屋子都供着一尊疾病女神的雕像——兜帽遮面，面容与双手尽是枯败溃烂——以卑微而清醒的方式提醒众人她的权能与任性：既能降下病痛，也能将其收回。
The temple is immaculately clean and polished—and full of hushed solemnity. Rooms off the main corridor are full of beds, reserved for the ailing who have come to beg for mercy from the mother of maladies. Priests and priestesses tend to the supplicants, to better understand the messengers of the goddess’s will. Every room in the temple houses a statue of the goddess of disease—hooded, with blighted face and hands—as a humbling reminder of her power and whim: to inflict illness, or to take it away.

这只怪异的生物散发出陈年盐卤般的恶臭，浓得足以让你眼眶发酸。腐烂海藻的气味与那股令人作呕、仿佛实质般的不速心灵威压一并袭来，你望见这头野兽的瞬间，胃里便翻江倒海。它颚骨周围簇拥的肉质触手在品尝空气时微微颤动，嗅出新鲜猎物；巨大的螯钳咔哒作响，迫不及待地等待出击。
The stench of ancient brine exuded by this strange creature is enough to make your eyes water. The aroma of rotting seaweed, and the palpable nausea of an unwelcome psychic presence churn your stomach as you behold the beast. Fleshy tentacles bunched around its mandibles quiver as it tastes the air, sensing fresh prey, and huge pincers clack in anticipation.

Akroan Hoplite.name:
阿克洛安重装步兵
Akroan Hoplite

Text.text:
武勇之力的化身——金饰甲胄在日光下灼然夺目，古铜色肌肤上刻着荣耀的伤痕——放声咆哮，声浪竟压过战场的喧嚣。战士那双燃灼的眼眸，深邃如盛满轻蔑的黑潭，映照着战争之火，审视着眼前的杀局。高举盾与矛，他们悍然突进，羽饰与披风在风中猎猎翻卷。
An embodiment of martial might—their gilt panoply blazing in the sun and tanned skin bearing scars of valor—roars, their voice audible above the tumult of the battlefield. The warrior’s smoldering eyes, deep orbs of disdain, reflect the fires of war as they peruse the conflict. With shield and spear held high, they power forward, plume and cloak streaming in the wind.

Bard Forgetting Epic Poem.name:
吟游诗人遗忘的史诗长歌
Bard Forgetting Epic Poem

Text.text:
吟游诗人手掌一挥，便将听众卷入一段歌咏古老英雄与传奇怪物的抒情史诗。他们沉浸在演出里无法自拔，背诵却开始充满停顿与结巴。“那邪恶的食人魔面目狰狞，向骑士步步逼近。英雄挺身迎战，挥舞着……呃……他的早餐——一根……调味得很到位的香肠……？”
With a sweep of their hand, the bard whisks their audience away into a lyrical saga of ancient heroes and legendary monsters. They are so caught up in their performance that their recitation becomes fraught with pauses and stammers. “The villainous ogre bore down on the knight with a menacing visage. The hero gave battle and brandished… um… his breakfast—a… well-seasoned sausage…?”

一座毫无特征的立方体悬浮在你眼前，体型约等同于一栋三层楼高的建筑，静静伫立在这个全新的位面之中。你正想着这座结构的入口会在哪里——一扇门便以你所设想的样式，在恰到好处的位置凝成。你的目光掠过建筑其余部分，思绪随之勾勒出窗户、屋顶与更多细节。转眼间，你看见一处完全由你想象塑形而成的居所。
A featureless cube, about the size of a three-story building, stands suspended before you in this new plane. You wonder where the entrance to this structure might be—and a door materializes in the exact style you imagined. Your gaze scans the rest of the building, your mind conjuring windows, roofing, and many other features. You now see a dwelling formed entirely from your imagination.

Divine Armory Of A God Of Combat.name:
战神的神圣军械库
Divine Armory Of A God Of Combat

Text.text:
每一件装备都被精心打造与悉心照料，擦拭得锃亮，并被施以魔法，只为在劈斩时更凌厉、在格挡时更稳固。漫长的石砌大厅里，剑与长矛成排立在架上；其间摆着铺满匕首与异域利刃的长桌，还有成千上万支箭矢束在箭袋中。木桩钉成的一整面墙挂着弓与腰带，对面则是一面盾牌之墙，其中一些绘着初代帝国的纹章。这里是一座浸着血色历史的军械库，一座记录冲突的图书馆。军械库一端通向竞技场，另一端则是医务室。
Each piece of equipment is carefully crafted and tended, polished and enchanted for its best strike or deflection. Racks of swords and spears stand in the long stone hall; between them are tables of knives and exotic blades, and thousands of arrows in quivers. A wall of pegs holds bows and belts, facing a wall of shields, some painted in the heraldry of the first empires. This place is an arsenal of bloody history, a library of conflict. One end of the armory opens into an arena. At the other end is an infirmary.

Greater Demon Manifesting Via A Minion.name:
经由爪牙显现的高阶恶魔
Greater Demon Manifesting Via A Minion

Text.text:
它双眼蒙上一层虔敬的狂热，伴随着一团刺鼻的硫磺烟雾，小魔鬼在你面前显形，随即深深一鞠躬。它开口时，你注意到这生物的动作诡异得令人费解，像被技艺高超的操偶师牵线的木偶。那嗓音也同样格格不入，带着失真的回响，仿佛声音的主人远在天边。

~ Envisioned by Kazuma Bovino on Discord

Eyes glazed in reverent fervor, the imp materializes before you in a puff of sulfurous smoke before bowing deeply. As it speaks, you notice the creature’s movements seem perplexingly artificial, like a marionette in the hands of a skilled puppeteer. The voice too is oddly incongruous and echoes with distortion as if the owner is far away.

~ Envisioned by Kazuma Bovino on Discord

Baroque-styled Guitar.name:
巴洛克风格吉他
Baroque-styled Guitar

Text.text:
这把吉他的琴身两侧饰以条纹，琴轸与音孔花饰皆雕琢繁复。音板约四掌长，贴合膝上，抱持自如。品位由细韧的肠线捻成，并可调节，使这件乐器柔和的音色足以掩蔽各式调式的射程，任由玩家的指尖拨弄或扫弦，织出错综复杂的音型。
The sides of the body of this guitar are striped, and the pegs and rosette intricately decorated. Its sound board is a comfortable four palms long, easily held in one’s lap. The frets are made of fine strands of gut, and adjustable, so the instrument’s soft sound can cover a range of musical keys and complicated pattern plucked or strummed by a player’s fingers.

God Of Elemental Earth.name:
元素大地之神
God Of Elemental Earth

Text.text:
他从农田静谧而肥沃的土壤里聚拢成形，或把沙丘的砂粒编织成一具巨人般的身躯。他也许是山脉的活岩，是河流卵石的集合。今日他化作火成岩，多孔而粗砺，核心仍有熔岩在燃烧。他的五官如闷燃的炭火，他的每一次吐息都是令人窒息的毒烟。作为大地本身的力量，他高高矗立，俯视着你——那双眼见证过板块的漫长时代。
He forms up from the quiet, rich soil of a farm, or he is the sand of a dune composed into a gargantuan man. He may be the living rock of a mountain or the pebble collection of a river. Today he is igneous rock, porous and rough, lava still burning at his core. His features are smoldering coals, his very breath a choking fume. A force of the earth itself, he stands high above and gazes down at you through eyes that have seen the long ages of tectonic time.

I Drink My Potion Of Cloud Giant Strengt.name:
我喝下云巨人力量药水
I Drink My Potion Of Cloud Giant Strength

Text.text: 我晃了晃这瓶透明药水里漂浮的指甲，注意到它修剪得相当整齐。我一口迅捷地咕嘟灌下去，那片指甲像一缕长发似的滑进胃里。那股令人不适的触感随即化作轻盈，清凉如新的空气灌满我的肺。胸腔鼓胀出崭新的力量，手臂、背脊与双腿的肌肉也随之隆起。我感到既无比轻飘，又庞大得骇人，仿佛只需掌心轻轻一按，便能碾碎整片聚居地。 I slosh the fingernail floating within this transparent potion, noting that it’s rather well-manicured. I drink it down in one swift gulp, the nail sliding down to my stomach like a long string of hair. That unsettling sensation turns to one of lightness, as refreshing cool air fills my lungs. My chest swells with new strength, as do the muscles of my arms, back and legs. I feel weightless and immense, as if I could crush entire settlements with a gentle press of my hand.

I Use Heightened Spell.name:
我施放升阶法术
I Use Heightened Spell

Text.text:
当我施放法术时，我将意念凝聚于一个目标之上。我把那存在牢牢镌刻在脑海里，魔法便如其所应当的那般成形。然而，我耗费了比这道法术所需更多的力量——那股多余的冲击力像尖刺般在我选定受害者的防御上凿出一道道破口。
As I cast my spell, I concentrate my intent toward one target. I hold that being in mind and the magic takes shape as it should. However, I consume more of my power than needed for the spell—the extra force poking holes in my chosen victim’s defenses.

I Cast Color Spray Using Components.name:
我用材料施放了色彩喷射
I Cast Color Spray Using Components

Text.text:
当我抛出这一小撮鲜艳的沙粒，它便化作一场奇观。十五尺的光与染彩的空气铺展开来，像节庆纸喇叭般的锥形喷涌，随着我的咒语声闪烁辉映、流光爆闪。我的敌人再也无法视物，而那一粒粒沙砾也凝成致命的锋锐。
When I throw this little pinch of vibrant sand, it becomes a spectacle. It is fifteen feet of light and painted air, a cone like a party favor, that glimmers and flashes to the sound of my incantation. My foes cannot see anymore, and the granules of sand become a deadly sharpness.

Herbalist's Yard In Rain.name:
雨中的草药师庭院
Herbalist's Yard In Rain

Text.text:
野灌木与扦插培成的整株植物在阵雨中泛着湿润的翠光。土壤在一簇簇开花的香膏草周围愈发黝黑，矮篱旁，数十丛繁叶香草饱饮雨水，仿佛正举杯欢庆。几乎能听见它们随着水洼里有节奏的雨点噼啪作响而轻声歌唱。
The wild shrubs and cuttings grown to full plants glisten green under the rain shower. The soil darkens around clusters of flowering balms, and along the low fence, dozens of leafy herbs drink and celebrate. One can almost hear them sing to the rhythmic pattering of the rain in the puddles.

I Cast Hideous Laughter Using My Musical.name:
我用乐器施放《狂笑术》
I Cast Hideous Laughter Using My Musical Instrument

Text.text:
最初的几个音符就抓住了我目标的注意力，接下来的旋律让他们露出笑容。

[豁免成功] 然而在开场的那一句里，似乎有哪里不对劲。笑容渐渐褪去。我急忙冲向包袱、那记辛辣的点睛——却毫无锋芒。一个音被我拔得更尖，随即我看见了另一种笑。不是那种对的笑。

[豁免失败] 开场那一句就引来一声轻笑，我的花腔博得满堂喝彩，紧接着铺垫出一刻令人屏息凝神的期待。点睛一落，我的目标笑到停不下来——而且也做不了多少别的了。

The first few notes get my target’s attention, and the next bring a smile.

[Successful Save] During the opening line, however, something seems a bit off. The smile fades. I rush to the punchline, the zinger—but there’s no zing. I sharp a note, and then I see a different kind of smile. Not the right kind.

[Failed Save] During the opening line, I get a chuckle, my flourish goes over big, and then there’s the setup to a moment of riveted anticipation. The zinger lands, and my target can’t stop laughing—and they can’t do much else either.

Guildhall Stables.name:
公会大厅马厩
Guildhall Stables

Text.text:
五个马厩隔间静候它们的马儿归来，新鲜的干草沐浴在从木板缝隙间漏下的阳光里。最远、也最阴暗的隔间传来一阵窸窣声，吸引了你的注意。你走近时，看见一只猎犬，毛发粗硬、夹着灰白，垂着眼皮望着你。他湿润的鼻头在空气中轻轻抽动，辨认着你身上的气味；不多时，他的尾巴开始摇摆，把几缕干草扫得四散落在地上。
Five stalls await their equine residents' return, fresh hay basking in sun rays peeking through slatted windows. A shuffling sound draws your attention to the furthest and shadiest stall. As you draw near, you see a hunting hound with rough, graying fur regarding you with droopy eyes. His wet nose twitches in the air as he gets to know the scent of you, his tail eventually wagging and sending small strips of hay about the floor.

A Network Of Pipes In A Cave.name:
洞穴中的管道网络
A Network Of Pipes In A Cave

Text.text:
一条条管道从四面八方蜿蜒而来，通向洞窟的入口，仿佛尽数汇入那张张开的巨口。洞内，更多管道从墙壁与穹顶突兀伸出，彼此交错相连，硬生生长成一片金属森林。与之相伴的喧嚣也同样汹涌——螺栓哐啷作响，液体奔流不息，蒸汽一阵阵喷吐，热雾充塞空气，在洞壁间回荡不绝。
A trail of pipes lead into the mouth of a cave from multiple directions. Inside, they’re joined by even more that jut from the walls and ceilings, forming a veritable forest of metals. There’s noise to match as well—rattling bolts, flowing liquid, and puffs of steam flood the air and echo off the cave walls.

Hacker Executes Attack Program In The Ne.name:
黑客在网络空间中执行攻击程序：太空歌剧主题
Hacker Executes Attack Program In The Net: Space Opera Theme

Text.text:
黑客启动攻击程序时，一支滑稽得离谱的爆能步枪在他们早已伸出的手中成形；他们沉醉于这把夸张巨型武器带来的视觉快感。枪管多得像工业区的烟囱林，确实令人叹为观止。
A comically large blaster rifle forms in the hacker’s waiting hands as they activate their attack program, relishing the aesthetic of the oversized weapon. With more barrels than an industrial zone chimney stack, it is quite impressive indeed.

I Cast Blight.name:
我施放【枯萎术】
I Cast Blight

Text.text:
我的手化作利爪，紧攫猛挤，从目标体内榨出生命之水。我开口说话时，它随之收拢。一道自喉间迸出的法术，先是低吼，继而嘶鸣——那些词几乎难以辨作人言。愿你的叶片枯萎，你的血液沉睡，你的感官被溃烂与疫疠彻底吞没。
My hand is a claw, clutching and squeezing the water of life from my targets. It closes as I speak. A spell from the throat, a growl followed by a wheeze—the words are barely recognizable as speech. May your leaves wither, your blood sleep, your very senses be overtaken by canker and scourge.

Dragon Dance Of The Claw Style: Aú.name:
龙爪流派·龙舞：奥乌
Dragon Dance Of The Claw Style: Aú

Text.text:
从行云流水般的ginga中，你双手向外、向下探去，尽你所能触及的最远处，随即翻身成一个侧手翻，宛如飞龙凌空掷出一记翻滚。动作一气呵成——连绵不断，化作令对手难以捕捉的残影。

~ 由一位英雄构想

From the sweeping ginga, you dive your hands out and down, as far as you can reach, and turn into a cartwheel, like a dragon performing a roll in flight. It’s a constant motion—a blur to fight.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Invitation From A Prophetic Townsperson.name:
来自预言镇民的邀请
Invitation From A Prophetic Townsperson

Text.text:
“你们一定得来我们村子。它的美无与伦比。一条清澈的溪流轻轻穿过广场，孩子们的笑声回荡着追逐嬉闹。我们的酒馆夜夜客满，待客之道也无人能及。我建议你们尽快来，因为这里太过田园静好，让我生出一种诡异的预感……总有一天，这一切会被烈火吞没。”
“You must come to our village. Its beauty is unparalleled. A gentle stream runs through the square as children laugh and play. Our tavern is full every night and our hospitality unmatched. I’d recommend you come soon, as it is so idyllic that I get the strange feeling…it will all be on fire some day.”

Large Goblin Camp.name:
大型地精营地
Large Goblin Camp

Text.text:
地精在短时间内就筑起了令人惊叹的防御工事。营地大部分区域被一道深沟与高高堆起的土垒所环抱。你所能看到的屏障唯一缺口处，有骑乘座狼的地精在守卫。越过土垒顶端，你瞥见几顶巨大的圆形帐篷，但土垒几乎齐肩的高度让你根本无法清点数量。眼前展现出的调度与纪律，指向大地精的领导——这也意味着你必须提防熊地精的出现。
The goblins built impressive fortifications in a short time. A deep ditch surrounding mounded dirt encircles most of the camp. Goblins with worg mounts guard the only break in the barrier you can see. Over the top of the embankment you spy several large, round tents, but the shoulder height of the barrier makes it impossible to count their numbers. The logistics and discipline on display point to hobgoblin leadership, which means you need to be wary of bugbears too.

冰片沿着寒冽澄澈的急流翻滚而下。阳光下水光闪耀，越过岩石与弯道时白沫翻涌。
Fragments of ice tumble down the rapids of the frigid, clear water. It gleams in the sunlight, foaming as it rolls over rocks and bends.

Vessel Sailing Into A Magical Storm.name:
驶入魔法风暴的航船
Vessel Sailing Into A Magical Storm

Text.text:
船身不安地摇晃着，仿佛畏惧你们面前那道奥术风暴门槛之外的事物。风帆先是簌簌抖动，随即猛然绷紧，抓住一股催促船只前行的风。紫与绿的闪电鞭挞般抽落。雷霆轰鸣滚过，带着一种怪异、近乎水晶般清澈的音色。船员们低声嘀咕，人人都停下手头的活计，仰望那压顶的风暴前沿——翻涌的云层仿佛勾勒出憔悴的面孔与狞笑的骷髅。掌舵的船长咬紧牙关，下颌绷硬，船只穿过风暴的帷幕。

~ Envisioned by Krevlick

The ship rocks uneasily, as if it fears what lies beyond the threshold of the arcane storm before you. The sails flutter, then go taut, catching a wind that urges the vessel forward. Violet and green lightning lashes forth. The thunderclaps rumble with an odd, almost crystalline timbre. The crew mutters quietly to one another, everyone pausing in their duties to stare up at the looming stormfront, the roiling clouds that seem to evoke gaunt faces and leering skulls. The captain at the wheel grits their teeth, jaw set, as the ship crosses the storm's curtain.

~ Envisioned by Krevlick

Vampire Seduction.name:
吸血鬼（特征）魅惑
Vampire Seduction

Text.text:
“我从你的眼里看得一清二楚。那里面满是渴望。你真敢抛下我——让我冰冷地浸在不近人情的绝望里，让这胸口的隐痛一阵阵啃噬？你以为，在你称作生命的这只漏沙的沙漏里，我们还剩多少时代？抓住我吧，亲爱的。抓住这次机会——然后，与我一同，超越时代。”
“I see it in your eyes. They are full of wanting. Do you dare leave me—cold, with unfriendly despair and this ache in my chest? How much time do you think we have left in this leaking hourglass you call life? Seize me, my darling. Seize this chance—and, together, we can be timeless.”

Modern Dinosaur Keeper.name:
现代恐龙饲养员
Modern Dinosaur Keeper

Text.text:
饲养员双臂大张，伸出双手，不知怎地竟将那群猛兽逼得不敢近前。男人极其缓慢地倒退着走——目光始终不曾移开——一点点挪向围栏的闸门。恐龙歪着头，利爪竖起，紧盯他的一举一动，步步相随。只要他出一次错，他就会变成它们的盘中肉。
Arms spread wide, the keeper holds out his hands, somehow keeping the pack at bay. The man walks backwards very slowly—never breaking eye contact—edging toward the gate of the enclosure. The dinosaurs follow his every move with cocked heads and bristling claws. If he makes a mistake, he’s dead meat.

Worn Racing Jacket With Kevlar Plates.name:
带凯夫拉护板的旧赛车夹克
Worn Racing Jacket With Kevlar Plates

Text.text:
夹克就那样挂着，破旧磨损，外露的凯夫拉护板映着城市的霓虹。每一道裂口都在诉说一场旧日竞速、一次撞毁、一个疯狂的机动。它是不服从的象征，是对那个速度与危险年代的致敬……也向胆敢越界招惹其主人的人发出冷峻警告。
The jacket hangs there, battered and frayed, the visible Kevlar plates reflecting the neon lights of the city. Each tear describes a past race, a crash, an insane maneuver. It’s a symbol of insubordination, a tribute to a bygone era of speed and danger… a stark warning to those who dare cross its owner.

Lilleth, Huntress Of Assassins.name:
莉莉丝，刺客猎手
Lilleth, Huntress Of Assassins

Text.text:
那位成熟女性高等精灵抬手整理披在钉皮甲肩头的黑狼皮斗篷，微微偏着头，仿佛正努力捕捉某个细微声响。她光泽如墨的编发甩到一侧，与她乳白般苍白的肌肤形成鲜明对比。她的细剑与长弓一看便是精灵工艺，她佩戴得从容自然，像是昼夜之间都随时能把武器握在手中。
The mature high elf adjusts the black wolfskin cloak draped over the shoulders of her studded leather, head tilted as if trying to zero in on a sound. Her shining black braided hair is tossed to one side, a stark contrast to her milky, pale skin. Her rapier and longbow are clearly of elvish make, and she wears them with the ease of one who has weapons to hand at all times of the day and night.

City Skyline Lit By Illuminated Billboar.name:
被霓虹广告牌照亮的城市天际线
City Skyline Lit By Illuminated Billboards

Text.text:
在天际线上，混凝土、钢铁与玻璃铸就的巨型泰坦俯瞰着这座蔓延不息的都市，覆贴其上的巨幅广告牌在数英里外仍清晰可见。那是一场粗俗臃肿、肆意资本主义的盛宴，赤裸裸地映照出社会的优先取舍。
On the skyline, great titans of concrete, steel, and glass loom over the sprawling city, the enormous billboards plastered across them visible for miles around. A crass, bloated display of rampant capitalism mirroring the priorities of society.

Horseshoes Of A Zephyr.name:
踏风马蹄铁
Horseshoes Of A Zephyr

Text.text:
乍一看，这些旧马蹄铁毫不起眼，很容易被误认成寻常的装备。然而，目光敏锐的人会发现：尽管蹄铁陈旧，却没有任何上路磨损的痕迹——没有被碎石磕出的缺口或划痕，也没有因修补而变色的金属。每只蹄铁的外缘上，都几乎难以察觉地在金属里蚀刻着一根羽毛。
At first glance the old horseshoes look entirely unremarkable, easily mistaken for mundane equipment. However, the keen eye will see that, though the shoes are aged, they show no sign of use upon the road, no nicks or scratches from loose pebbles, no discolored metal from repairs. Along the outer rim of each shoe—almost imperceptibly—a feather has been etched into the metal.

A Ranger’s Comradery.name:
游侠的战友情谊
A Ranger’s Comradery

Text.text:
“在遇见你之前，我独自一人过了很久很久。孤独里有一种安宁，一种沉默，会把你对自我的感知放大。我不愿失去它，所以也许……我们可以都保持孤身一人……却在一起？”
“Before I met you, I was alone for a very long time. There is a peace in loneliness. A silence that amplifies your own sense of self. I’d hate to lose it, so perhaps we can all be alone… together?”

Forest Of Madness.name:
疯狂之森
Forest Of Madness

Text.text:
一种不自然的阴霾笼罩着这片林地——树与石一同渗出的摇曳阴影，覆在每一丛战栗的灌木、每一片颤动的叶上。空气凝滞、逼仄，带着霉腐的潮腥。它诡异地同时令人难受地温热又刺骨寒冷，一瞬即逝却不祥的触感爬上皮肤，令神经绷紧。虬结的树木向内逼近，枝桠如骷髅的肢体般伸手抓向你。忽然，一张脸自黑暗中逼视而来，空洞的眼窝怒瞪着你——可你随即发现，那并非人脸，而是树皮渗液处扭曲的纹理。更多“脸”浮现出来，每一张都被拧成惊恐、痛楚或折磨的表情，每一张都在淌着黑暗、黏稠的树脂。尽管这里惊人地没有任何生命迹象——无鸟亦无兽——你仍无法摆脱那种被注视、被尾随……被狩猎的感觉。

~ 由 Tiir 构想

An unnatural gloom shrouds these woods, a wavering shadow exuded by tree and stone alike, by every shuddering bush and fluttering leaf. The air feels still, close, and musky with mildew. It’s somehow uncomfortably warm and bitter cold all at once, a fleeting, foreboding feeling that prickles your skin and sets your nerves on edge. The gnarled trees close in, their branches grasping at you like skeletal limbs. A face suddenly looms at you from the darkness, the hollow pits of its eyes glaring—but then you realize the visage is no face at all but a twisted pattern in the oozing bark of a tree. More of these faces materialize, each warped into an expression of horror, pain, or torment, each bleeding dark, viscous sap. Despite the startling absence of any form of life here—no birds nor beasts—you cannot help but feel observed, stalked… hunted.

~ Envisioned by Tiir

Hacker Eludes Security Daemon In The Net.name:
黑客在网络中甩脱安保守护进程
Hacker Eludes Security Daemon In The Net

Text.text:
守护进程的电路发出几不可闻的嗡鸣，它在网络中扫视，搜寻任何未获许可的入侵迹象。这正是黑客受训的领域：潜行与伪装的艺术。黑客十指如飞，代码开始扭曲变形，每隔几毫秒就更换一次特征签名，竭力躲避侦测。可守护进程仍步步逼近，那股搏动的紫色虚拟存在如潮水般压来，逐寸收紧。然后——找到了！一个漏洞！就在它逼近的瞬间，一道空白的代码壁垒猛然升起，横亘在两者之间，将守护进程隔绝在外。暂时安全了。
There’s the faint whirring of the daemon's circuits as it scans the Net for any signs of unauthorized access. This is what the hacker is trained for: the art of subterfuge. The hacker types furiously, code beginning to morph and shift, changing its signature every few milliseconds in an effort to evade detection. The daemon is close, though, its throbbing purple virtual presence closing in on him. And then—yes! A vulnerability! As the daemon closes in, a blank barrier of code shoots up between the two of them, blocking the daemon out. Safe, for now.

爆炸的冲击在房间里回荡，震得所有人踉跄不稳。你捂着嗡鸣的耳朵，艰难地找回平衡，睁眼只见浓烟翻卷、混乱四起。透过被炸得粉碎的墙，你看见焦黑的街道上横七竖八地躺着尸体，人们扭曲纠缠，堆成一团团冒着余烟的残骸。爆炸的余热仍黏在空气里，你瞪着那骇人的景象说不出话。风卷起灰烬，夹着烧焦头发的气味扑面而来。耳中的嗡鸣渐渐退去，取而代之的是混杂的惊恐尖叫，奔逃者的脚步与撞击声在空中噼啪作响。
The blast had reverberated through the room, staggering everyone. Your ears ring as you struggle to regain your balance, and you open your eyes to a scene of smoke and confusion. Through the shattered wall you see bodies strewn about the charred street, people twisted together in tangled, smoldering heaps. The heat of the blast lingers as you gape at the horrific scene. The wind kicks up ash and wafts the scent of singed hair toward you. As the ringing in your ears subsides, it is replaced with the muddled screams of panic, and the clatter of people running fills the air.

Dragon Addresses Party.name:
巨龙向众人开口
Dragon Addresses Party

Text.text:
巨龙沉重地呼出一口气，缓缓低下那颗覆满鳞甲的硕大头颅，与你的目光相接；爬行类的眼眸闪烁着锐利的智慧。它察觉到你心中的战栗，面上浮现出近似微笑的神情——随即，古龙开口了。它以流畅的言语称呼你，嗓音低沉轰鸣，宛如远方风暴滚过群山。
With a ponderous exhalation, the dragon lowers their large, scaly head to meet your gaze, reptilian eyes shining with a keen intellect. Something akin to a smile spreads across their face as they sense your trepidation—then the wyrm speaks. In fluent language, they address you, their voice rumbling like a distant storm across the mountains.

成堆的啮齿动物尸体像肮脏的灰色山峦般环绕着你，它们死去的、圆溜溜的眼睛在黑暗中盯着你。老鼠们纠结成噩梦般的血肉与皮毛的混合体，个体早已无法从这团烂泥般的尸堆中分辨出来。
Heaps of rodent corpses surround you like dirty gray mountains, their dead, beady eyes watching you from the darkness. The rats have formed nightmarish amalgamations of flesh and fur, and individuals can no longer be picked out from the morass.

一头象形巨兽的惊人身姿高耸在你面前，令人屏息。蓬乱的铁锈色长毛自它盘卷的长鼻尖一路覆至庞大的后躯。它沉重地踱步前行，厚实毛皮下的肌肉如波涛般起伏。弯曲的长牙从生物隐没的口中突刺而出，其上方，一双睿智的琥珀色眼眸居高临下地审视着你。
Towering over you is the breathtaking form of an elephantine beast. Shaggy, rust-hued fur covers the beast from the tip of its coiled trunk to its massive hind. As it plods forward, slabs of muscle ripple beneath the thick coat. Wise amber eyes regard you from above the curved tusks jutting from the creature’s hidden mouth.

Sundries From A Black Dragon Wyrmling.name:
黑龙雏龙的杂货
Sundries From A Black Dragon Wyrmling

Text.text:
一条色彩斑斓的围巾打着结，系在那条被杀死的幼龙乌黑发亮的脖颈上。将布料徐徐展开，露出的竟是一面旗帜——破损、褴褛……上面还溅着早已干涸的血迹。
A colorful scarf is knotted around the slain wyrmling’s glossy black neck. Unfurling the fabric reveals a flag, torn, threadbare… and spattered with long-dried blood.

阿斯加德的宇宙拱桥横跨苍穹，在紧密簇拥的碎骸群中延展。每一块大地碎片多达数里之广，披覆着葱郁的绿意，其上尽是辽阔平原与巍峨群山。雪覆峰巅，也飘落在谷地之间。瀑布自每块漂浮的大地边缘倾泻而下，坠入下方天空时化作缥缈云雾。
The cosmic arches of Asgard span the cosmos in tightly clustered formations of debris. Each chunk of earth, most leagues-wide and draped with lush greenery, is dominated by sprawling plains and soaring mountains. Snow caps the peaks and falls on the valleys. Waterfalls cascade over the sides of each floating chunk, dissipating into mist in the sky below.

Kalo-mahoi Bloom.name:
卡洛-马霍伊花绽
Kalo-mahoi Bloom

Text.text:
绿意森森、腐烂溃坏的藻斑以骇人的速度疯长。无定形的芽簇迅速膨胀，继而绽出无数缤纷花朵，恍若你最珍视的记忆里曾存在过的那一束束颜色。你有多久未曾凝望过这样的景象？这无疑是一份穿越空间与时代双重汪洋而来的赋礼。
Green and gangrenous, the patch of algae multiplies with alarming speed. Amorphous buds grow rapidly, sprouting countless colorful flowers that resemble those that exist in your most cherished memories. How long has it been since you gazed upon such a sight? It is surely a gift borne across twin oceans of space and time.

Heroes Haggling With Shopkeeper.name:
英雄们与店主讨价还价
Heroes Haggling With Shopkeeper

Text.text:
“听着，卖小玩意儿的。要不是我们，你的店早就成了一堆瓦砾。我想，这怎么也值个小小的折扣。”
“Listen here, you peddler of trinkets. Were it not for us, your store would a pile of rubble. I believe that is worth a modest discount.”

Band Of Hardened Adventurers.name:
身经百战的冒险者团
Band Of Hardened Adventurers

Text.text:
那名穿着凹陷胸甲的女人一边扫视着区域，一边啐出一颗带血的牙齿，抬手示意一位年迈的半身人女祭司别再靠近。她其实多此一举。牧师正忙着照看一个满脸阴沉、留着胡子的半精灵；尽管他的太阳穴淌着血，她也在为他施治，他却一门心思对着一面镜子施放某个法术。最终他恼怒地放弃，任由镜子坠地，碎裂四散。一个你先前没注意到的披斗篷半身人忽然走入视线，蹲在碎镜上方，转眼就把完好无缺的镜子递回给那名半精灵。半精灵接过镜子，连句谢都没有，打了个响指把战士的注意力招来。四人迅速凑拢，低声围成一团。
The woman in a dented breastplate spits out a bloody tooth as she scans the area, holding up a hand to forbear the attentions of an elderly halfling priestess. She needn’t have bothered. The cleric attends a grouchy-looking, bearded half-elf, who, despite his bleeding temple and her ministrations, is focused on casting some spell on a mirror. He gives up in frustration and lets the mirror fall to the ground where it shatters. A cloaked halfling you hadn’t noticed suddenly steps into view to crouch over the shattered mirror. She hands it back, whole, to the half-elf who takes it without thanks and snaps his fingers to get the warrior’s attention. The foursome huddles.

Noir Hotel.name:
黑色电影旅馆
Noir Hotel

Text.text:
暴雨砰然砸在你面前这座高耸旅馆的肮脏窗玻璃上；它像独眼的巨神般俯压着下方的城市。大厅上方的红色霓虹招牌噼啪迸火、忽明忽暗，持续发出低沉哀鸣般的嗡响，一点点磨蚀人的理智。透过一楼巨大的落地窗，你看见一名饱经风霜的矮人正擦拭餐厅吧台。他粗壮结实的前臂因用力而绷紧，凸显出一枚褪色的徽记纹身。你正看着，那矮人皱起脸，龇牙露齿，发出骇人的低吼。他冲着附近阶段上正调试乐器的一群衣着体面的乐师吼了句什么，引得他们激动地争辩起来——却很快就结束了。

~ Elijah Richard 构想

Heavy rain pounds against the dirty windows of the towering hotel before you, looming like a cyclopean titan over the city below. A red neon sign sparks and flickers above the lobby, buzzing incessantly in a low dirge that slowly erodes one’s sanity. Through the large ground-floor windows, you see a grizzled dwarf polishing the restaurant bar. Their thick, muscular forearm tenses with the effort, highlighting a faded tattoo of an insignia. As you watch, the dwarf grimaces and bares their teeth in a menacing snarl. They bark something at the group of smartly dressed musicians tuning their instruments on the nearby stage, prompting an animated—and short—debate.

~ Envisioned by Elijah Richard

Aftermath Of A Brutal Battle.name:
一场惨烈战斗的余波
Aftermath Of A Brutal Battle

Text.text:
剑、盾牌与躯体在幽暗的土地上碎裂横陈——泥土与岩石被鲜血、脏器，以及更污秽的排泄物浸染。死者与垂死者堆叠处蒸腾的臭气，令你的喉头泛起一阵作呕的痉挛。血淋淋的断肢、躯干与凹陷的面孔层层垒起——那些曾披罩袍、戴头盔而令人胆寒的军阵，如今只剩粗陋拼凑的残骸——仍有尚未断气者在其中呻吟颤抖。他们踉跄受折磨，徘徊在死亡的悬崖边，倒下的战友与敌人的脸一同张口，仿佛在无声的歌里合唱。

~ 一位英雄所构想

Swords, shields, and bodies lie splintered on the dark earth—dirt and stone stained by blood, viscera, and other, fouler expulsions. The odors rising from the piles of dead and dying send a nauseating ripple through your throat. Stacks of bloodied limbs, torsos and sunken faces—slipshod amalgams of the battalions formerly fearsome in tabard and helm—moan and quiver with those still clinging to life. They teeter, tormented, on the precipice of death, the faces of fallen comrades and enemies agape together in silent song.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Ogre Necromancer Conjures Spell.name:
食人魔死灵法师施展法术
Ogre Necromancer Conjures Spell

Text.text:
食人魔裂开参差不齐的狞笑，从齿缝间嘶嘶作声，双手翻飞编织着魔法。一缕明亮的紫色魔法如绸带般在他掌心间舞动，将他裸露的胸膛与镶着骷髅的护肩映照在诡异的幽光之中。他抬起下巴，神情笃定，双眼也盈满了同样的紫色能量。
The ogre hisses through a jagged smile as he weaves magic with his hands. A ribbon of bright purple magic dances between his palms, lighting up his bare chest and skull-adorned pauldron in an eldritch glow. He raises his chin, confident, his eyes brimming with the same purple energy.

Robe Of Useful Items.name:
实用物品长袍
Robe Of Useful Items

Text.text:
尽管这件朴素长袍上缝满了大小不一、东一块西一块的补丁，丑得近乎刺眼，但那布料的精致与针脚的细密却明明白白地表明：它绝非一件随手丢弃的廉价衣物。
Though the simple robe is covered in mismatched patches of differing sizes, making for truly ugly fashion, the cloth is too finely made and stitched to suggest that this is a simple throwaway garment.

这只银制香炉升起的蒸汽带着浓烈而坚韧的辛香，刺得你鼻腔与口中微微发麻；然而总体而言，它像一道温暖而鲜活的屏障，抵御着不祥之夜的寒意。
The steam from this silver censer smells of strong, hardy spices. It leaves a bite in your nose and mouth, but overall it is a warm and vibrant ward against the chill of a foreboding night.

Loot From A Kappa.name:
河童的战利品
Loot From A Kappa

Text.text:
河童背甲完好无损，卖给铁匠或木匠都能换到一笔好钱；而它腹部的囊袋里装着十枚金币。它头顶凹盘里残留的那汪浅水，或许也能让药剂师出个价。
The kappa’s shell is perfectly intact and worth good coin to a smith or carpenter, and in its stomach pouch are ten gold pieces. The small pool of water left in its head plate might be of value to an apothecary.

Dragon Dance Of The Claw Style: Meia Lua.name:
爪式龙舞：半月回旋踢
Dragon Dance Of The Claw Style: Meia Lua De Compasso

Text.text:
脱离ginga，落回地面，你的手脚在一瞬脆弱中接触。你将背影留给对手，引诱他们误以为机会降临，随后以高位旋身踢的突袭与力量将其粉碎。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Out of the ginga and down to the ground, your hands and feet touch in an instant of vulnerability. Your back to your opponent lures them into a false sense of opportunity before the surprise and power of your high spinning kick.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

那道不祥的身影披着暗灰铁制的护甲，裂痕遍布、伤痕累累；胸甲上浮雕着一头龇牙咆哮的狼。面容隐没在一顶骇人的头盔之下——头盔被打造成贪婪恶狼的模样，空洞的眼窝却仿佛燃着怒火与野兽般的凶残。
The ominous figure wears cracked and battered armor of dull gray iron, and a snarling wolf is embossed on their breastplate. Their face is hidden beneath a fearsome helmet crafted to resemble a ravenous wolf, the hollow eyes somehow filled with rage and bestial savagery.

Insult About Inconsiderate Party Member.name:
对不体贴的队友的羞辱
Insult About Inconsiderate Party Member

Text.text:
“我并不想夸大其词，但我已经确信，迄今为止我所受的每一丝痛苦，全都是你这该死的错！”
“While I don’t wish to exaggerate, I’ve become convinced that every ounce of my suffering, thus far, has been your damn fault!”

Loot From A Toymaker Hag.name:
来自玩具匠鬼婆的战利品
Loot From A Toymaker Hag

Text.text:
一只巨大的木制玩具箱摆在鬼婆（特征）的店铺深处，上面覆着剥落的金色贴皮，几具悬吊的木偶在它上方轻轻摇晃。你鼓起勇气掀开箱盖，空气里立刻流淌起一段轻快的小调；箱内一座旋转的平台缓缓升起，一尊瓷偶随之现身。它无疑是匠人手中的杰作——价值不菲，却也带着一丝令人不安的寒意。
A large wooden toy chest covered in peeling gold veneer sits at the back of the hag’s shop beneath several dangling puppets. As you muster your courage and open the lid, a jaunty tune lilts through the air and a porcelain figure rises on a rotating platform from within. Truly an artisan’s masterpiece, this ornament is very valuable, if slightly unnerving.

Insult About An Immovable Imbecile.name:
对一个顽固蠢货的侮辱
Insult About An Immovable Imbecile

Text.text:
“世界永远在流转。四季更迭，潮汐来去，岁月流逝，而你却始终如一，面对这一切仍是个纹丝不动的蠢货。几乎让人感到安心。”
“The world is always shifting. Seasons change, the tides roll in and out, years pass, and yet you remain an immovable idiot in the face of all of it. It’s almost comforting.”

这具由枯枝与稻草扎成的偶人伫立着，身上披着下垂的粗麻布，布面被渐渐凝起的露水浸得潮湿。它皱褶的脸上只有模糊的五官，像是被人胡乱抹上去的，颜色可疑得宛如血迹。它的肩头与胸前横缝着粗陋的针脚，拼出各种动物的图案——那股暗沉粗硬的线，看起来仿佛是用毛发搓成的。
This figure of sticks and straw stands dressed in sagging sackcloth damp with gathering dew. Its wrinkled face possesses vague features smeared on in what looks suspiciously like blood. Crude stitching across its shoulders and chest depicts various animals—the dark and coarse thread used looks like it might be made from hair.

I Use Natural Recovery.name:
我使用自然恢复
I Use Natural Recovery

Text.text:
我们休息时，我在这片区域里找到最古老的那棵树，盘腿坐在它的根基旁。我任由心神游走，注意力一会儿坠落在蚂蚁切割叶片的细小轨迹上，一会儿又飘向随风流转的云群。我深深吸气，每一次呼吸都汲取大地的灵韵，修复并充盈我的魔法储备。
As we rest, I find the oldest tree in the area and sit cross-legged at its base. I allow my mind and spirit to wander, attention falling here on ants carving leaves and there on the windborne clouds. I breathe deeply, each breath taking in the spirit of the land and restoring my magic reserves.

巨狼悄无声息地从森林的灌木丛中滑出，没有半点动静泄露它的行踪；它的体型与力量都不输一匹成年骏马。它抬鼻嗅探空气，狰狞的巨犬龇出滴涎的獠牙，试图锁定新的猎物。
Padding out of the underbrush of the forest with nary a sound to betray its passage, the dire wolf is as large and powerful as a fully grown horse. Sniffing at the air, the monstrous canine bares its slavering fangs as it attempts to locate new prey.

Druid Speech About Weakness.name:
德鲁伊关于弱点的言辞
Druid Speech About Weakness

Text.text:
“没了城墙的庇护，没了门锁的阻隔，没了夜幕降临时你死死攥着的火把，你还能撑多久？我曾在森林赤裸的恐怖里活过；我可以告诉你，你们的城市并非文明的灼亮灯塔，而是弱点的避难所。”
“How long would you last without the protection of your walls, the locks on your doors, or the torchlight you cling to when night comes? I have lived in the naked terror of the forest, and I can tell you that your cities are not shining beacons of civilization, but sanctuaries of weakness.”

一声令人血液凝固的尖叫从隔壁房间回荡而来，紧随其后的是有节奏的吟诵。漆黑如深渊的地面被打磨得光滑如镜，将仪式火炬与蜡烛的光映照得阴森诡谲。房间前方燃着一团咆哮的烈火，吐出的浓烟辛辣刺喉，显然其燃料绝不可能只有木头。火焰之后矗立着一座卑劣的祭坛，厚厚一层新鲜血浆覆在其上，四周整齐陈列着拷问与献祭的器具——若你真能在两者之间分出差别的话。
A blood curdling scream echoes from a nearby room, followed by rhythmic chanting. The deep black floors are polished smooth and reflect the light of the ceremonial torches and candles in sinister ways. At the front of the room lies a roaring fire that releases a smoke so acrid that its fuel could not possibly be wood alone. Behind the fire lies a despicable altar coated in a thick layer of fresh blood and lined with instruments of torture and sacrifice, if you can find a difference between the two.

一瞬即逝的骇然抹去了一切理性思考：你正经过的石笋竟在滴涎的獠牙巨口上方，长出了一只猩红、闪烁的独眼。触须自它身躯暴起，鞭挞般探出，专门勾缠毫无防备的猎物作为下一餐；而它岩石般的外皮坚不可摧，除非遭遇最沉重的猛击。
A fleeting moment of horror blanks out all rational thought: the stalagmite you are passing has sprouted a single red, blinking eye above a slobbering, fanged mouth. Tendrils leap from its body, whipping out to snag the unwary for its next meal, the rocky hide proof against all but the strongest blows.

Inflict Wounds Misses.name:
造成伤口未命中
Inflict Wounds Misses

Text.text:
你冷冷地耗用魔法，提醒自己这是一道任何信徒都能施放的法术——正如人们所说，既可行善，亦可作恶。坏死——血肉的凋亡——在你爪形的双手间汇聚，蓄势待发，随时可倾泻而出。你发起攻击，但对手身形一错便避开了，你的双手随之回暖，仿佛周遭空气将你徒劳的力道尽数吞没。
The cold expenditure of your magic reminds you that this is a spell anyone of the faith can cast—for good or for ill, as they say. Necrosis, the killing of the flesh—it pools in your claw-shaped hands, ready to be inflicted. You attack, but your opponent shifts away, and your hands warm as the air around them absorbs the futility of your effort.

Kitchen Of A Manor.name:
庄园厨房
Kitchen Of A Manor

Text.text:
尽管不见厨役的身影，你仍能看出这片铺展开来的厨房要运转顺畅，必定需要数量惊人的洗碗杂役与仆从。此处处处可见他们的手笔：一侧的擀面杖与案板上覆着一层薄薄的面粉，烤盘也已提前开锅养护，只待为领主的晚餐派上用场。
Despite the absence of the staff, you can tell that the sprawling kitchens must need a terrific number of scullions and servants to keep it running smoothly. Their handiwork is evident: a thin layer of flour covers a rolling pin and board to one side, and the grill pans have been seasoned in preparation for the lord’s evening meal.

Collapsed Cavern With Open Roof.name:
穹顶坍塌、顶开天光的洞窟
Collapsed Cavern With Open Roof

Text.text:
瓦砾堆成高耸的山丘，尘土沉甸甸地悬在空气中。穹顶向内塌陷，如今这片空间敞开着，直通头顶的天空。曾从这座中央洞窟分岔出去的隧道，被挪移崩落的石块彻底堵死。你看见一些建筑的残骸，被塌方的重压碾成碎片。这里曾是谁的栖身之所，而他们又遭遇了什么？
Rubble lies in towering piles, and dust hangs heavy in the air. The roof collapsed inward and now the space opens to the sky above. Tunnels that once branched off this central cavern are blocked with displaced stone. You see the remnants of structures, crushed beneath the weight of the cave-in. Who dwelled here, and what became of them?

Kiirinta Shaman.name:
基伊林塔萨满
Kiirinta Shaman

Text.text:
一只身形矮小、似飞蛾般的异星生物踉跄疾行而来，前方两只肢体握着一根华丽的权杖。它身后拖着一团孢子般的粉尘云雾，来自一对靛蓝色翅膀的扑簌抖落；翅面布满繁复的纹饰。事实上，它的全身都覆着部族图样，难以分辨哪些与生俱来，哪些是后天刺下的。它羽绒般的触角轻轻一颤，魔法的涌流便在它的前肢周围凝聚成形。
A diminutive mothlike alien scuttles forward, wielding a decorative staff in its front two limbs. A cloud of sporous dust follows it, scattered from a pair of indigo wings decorated with intricate markings. Indeed, the alien’s entire body is marked in tribal patterns, and it is difficult to determine which are natural and which have been tattooed. With a ripple of its feathery antennae, a current of magic coalesces around its forelimbs.

I Conjure A Shadow Blade In Battle.name:
我在战斗中召唤出一柄暗影之刃
I Conjure A Shadow Blade In Battle

Text.text:
我发现自己在近身混战中手无寸铁——暴力的混乱在四周嘶嚎——于是我将它隔绝在外，迅速寻找我能找到的任何掩蔽。我只需要几秒钟，凝视着自己的掌心，想象阴影的触须彼此编织、缠绕，结成剑首，盘旋成剑柄，尖锐地向上生长，荆棘般狰狞而危险，直到剑刃完整成形，而战斗的喧嚣逼迫我迎上去，以阴影与技能回应。

~ 一位英雄设想

I find myself unarmed in the melee—chaos of violence howling around me—so I block it out and find what cover I can. I only need a few seconds, staring at the palm of my hand, imagining the tendrils of shadow braiding, binding into a pommel, curling out into a hilt, growing sharply upward, thorny and dangerous, until the blade is complete and the noise of battle demands that I meet it with shadow and skill.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

术士的双手以不可思议的速度翻飞，熟练得行云流水，结出繁复手势，又以手语编织出法术的词句，将施法的诸般要素融汇一处，宛如名厨调和馥郁香料。璀璨能量的旋风轰然爆起，如狂风倒卷般将他们的发丝与长袍向后掀起；法术臻至终点，魔法随之倾泻而出。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The sorcerer’s hands move with incredible speed, forming complex gestures with practiced ease as they weave the words of their spell in sign language, combining the elements of the casting like a master chef blending fragrant spices. A cyclone of scintillating energy erupts, whipping their hair and robes backward like a gale as the spell culminates and the magic is unleashed.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Ruined High Elf City-state.name:
毁灭的高等精灵城邦
Ruined High Elf City-state

Text.text:
昔日辉煌的高塔如今尽成残垣，倾倒坍塌，被根须与藤蔓吞没，在荒野不可阻挡的伟力牵引下被拖拽至地。描绘精灵历史中早已被遗忘人物的雕像仍矗立在城中辽阔的广场上，面容被风雨磨蚀得光滑平整、五官尽失。数十座塌陷的建筑覆满不依不饶的菌毯，而巨兽般的伞菌高高凌驾其上，洒落闪烁的孢子，使这片暮色弥漫的旷阔之地染上一层梦境般的朦胧。
Once resplendent towers lie in ruin, toppled and overtaken by root and vine, pulled to ground by the inexorable might of the wilds. Statues depicting long-forgotten figures of elf history still stand in the city’s sprawling square, their faces worn smooth and featureless by wind and rain. Dozens of caved-in structures are covered in a relentless fungus, and leviathan toadstools tower over all, shedding glittering spores that lend a dreamlike quality to the twilit expanse.

Dhampir With Psychic Daggers.name:
操控灵能匕首的吸血裔（特征）
Dhampir With Psychic Daggers

Text.text:
吸血裔（特征）那半生的心智，比他苍白而饥渴的肉身更强大——强到足以压倒一切、召唤万象、投入战斗。思念的魔法凝成一柄匕首，自掌间显形，掠入空气；吸血裔（特征）出手如吐信的蝮蛇。刀刃无视血肉，不留创口，随即归返。他不眨眼，沉入自我心海，掷出另一柄——而他的敌人却骤然感到一道伤口，既不需钢铁，也不洒血。

~ 设想者：风中独行

The half-living mind of a dhampir is more powerful than his pale and hungry flesh—strong enough to overcome, to conjure, to fight. A dagger forms in the magic of thought, manifests from the hand to the air, and the dhampir strikes like a spitting adder. The blade ignores flesh, leaves no wound, and returns. Unblinking, immersed in his psyche, he throws another, even as his foe suddenly feels a wound that requires no steel and produces no blood.

~ Envisioned by Alone In the Wind

I Cast Aid Using My Holy Symbol.name:
我高举圣徽，施放【援助术】
I Cast Aid Using My Holy Symbol

Text.text:
我举起圣徽，为同伴们低声祈祷、送上鼓舞。光辉自他们的心口与额前一闪而过，他们顿觉灵感涌动，士气大振。
I present my holy symbol and voice a prayer of encouragement for my friends. Radiance briefly shines from their hearts and heads, and they feel inspired and bolstered.

Portcullis In A Dungeon.name:
地城中的落闸铁栅
Portcullis In A Dungeon

Text.text:
黑铁在几处锈成了肉桂般的暗红，但那道网格、锯齿般的栅牙与铆钉依旧硬得像铁骨，根本不像能撬断。它的拉杆与绞盘藏在另一侧的阴影里。吊闸周围那道深陷的石拱门刻满令人不安的图腾符文，在摇曳的火把光里，仿佛正自己爬行书写着。
The black iron has rusted cinnamon red in a few places, but the grid and teeth and bolting still seem too strong to break. Its lever and winch are somewhere in shadow on the other side. The deep stone archway around the portcullis is carved in unsettling totemic glyphs that seem to be writing themselves in the flickering torchlight.

Loot From A Bearded Devil.name:
胡须魔鬼的战利品
Loot From A Bearded Devil

Text.text:
你在被杀死的恶魔尸体上搜寻值钱之物，发现它尖尖的耳朵上钉着四枚纯金耳钉。你警惕地探手到长须恶魔下巴那丛带毒的鞭须 beneath，摸到一条暗铁链项圈——坠着一枚黑珍珠吊坠——正挂在它的脖颈上。
You inspect the corpse of the slain devil for valuables and discover four solid gold studs piercing its pointed ears. Warily, you check beneath the poisonous whips on the bearded devil’s chin. A necklace of dark iron chain—with a black-pearl pendant—hangs around its neck.

Sundries From A Pursuant Minion Roller.name:
来自紧追不舍的仆从滚轮的杂物
Sundries From A Pursuant Minion Roller

Text.text:
他身上没带多少东西。就连那枚挂在脖子上的奖章也从链子上挣脱断落。胸前口袋里塞着一张揉皱的纸，上面用潦草的字迹涂着几行随手记下的笔记——像是某种清单，又像一局进展不顺的刽子手游戏。
He doesn’t have much on him. Even the medallion that swung from his neck has snapped free of its chain. A crumpled piece of paper in his breast pocket has a few scribbled notes in poor penmanship—a checklist of some kind, or a game of hangman that wasn’t going well.

无数金色鳞片闪烁，如同千枚金币般璀璨。每踏出一步，光芒便在单片鳞甲上跳跃，在周遭表面描绘出绚丽的纹样。它金色的鬃毛松散地垂落，环绕着修长的马形身躯，在额前分开，露出一根长长的铜色独角根部。它迈着威严的步伐向前行进，青铜色的蹄子轻轻踏过脚下的地面，仿佛无重地行走在云端。
An uncountable number of golden scales glimmer like a thousand gold coins. With each step, the light bounces off individual scales, painting beautiful patterns on the surrounding surfaces. Its golden mane hangs loosely around its long equine form, parting on its forehead to reveal the base of a long copper-colored horn. With a majestic stride, it walks forward, its bronze hooves softly padding the ground below as if weightlessly walking on a cloud.

Tasha's Otherworldly Guise.name:
塔莎的异界假面
Tasha's Otherworldly Guise

Text.text:
你抽出一件爬满异界符文的物体，开始吟诵。你的言语沉甸甸地裹挟着嬗变能量，向彼岸触及。它们束缚你所呼唤位面的精髓，并汲取其威能。一阵超自然的能量脉冲扭曲了你周遭的空气，你的形体开始模糊、变异。
Withdrawing an object crawling with otherworldly runes, you begin to chant. Your words are heavy with transmutative energies that reach out into the beyond. They bind the essence of the plane you call to and siphon its potency. A pulse of supernatural energy distorts the air around you, your form beginning to blur and mutate.

Schala The Aberration.name:
斯卡拉·异变体
Schala The Aberration

Text.text:
一个年轻女孩的轮廓向你伸来。她留着短短的银发，长着诡异的黄色眼睛，像圆珠般，被灰色贯穿。她的双手张开，招引着你，可它们僵硬而不均匀地抽动，仿佛系在细线的末端。更多的手从她裙装下伸出的袖口里抬起——还不止。整整一打张开的手召你向前，要将你抱住，而你只祈祷那不是虚空邪恶的拥抱。

~ Rekksos 构想

The shape of a young girl reaches out to you. She has short silver hair and strange yellow eyes, like round beads shot through with gray. Her hands open, beckoning, but they lurch stiffly and unevenly, as if they were on the ends of wires. More hands rise from sleeves that emerge from her dress—and more still. A dozen open hands call you forward, to hold you in what you pray is not the sinister embrace of the void.

~ Envisioned by Rekksos

这座蔓延铺展的宏伟建筑，珍藏着跨越数世纪的知识——艺术与文学、雕塑与乐章尽汇于此。描绘历史伟大瞬间、受人敬仰的人物与抽象理念的画作，装点着数不清的厅室墙面；而巍然耸立的大理石巨像与精妙绝伦的湿壁画，在穹顶玻璃洒落的阳光中熠熠生辉。来访者在长廊与厅室间缓缓穿行，眼中尽是惊叹。一位馆员衣装利落，神情严峻却不失温和，细致地注视着人群，随时准备为任何开口询问的人解答疑惑。
The sprawling structure contains centuries of knowledge, of art and literature, of statuary and music. Paintings depicting great moments in history, venerable figures, and abstract ideas, adorn the walls of rooms beyond counting, while towering statues of marble and masterful frescoes shine in the sunlight streaming through the glass of domed roofs. Patrons filter through the hallways and chambers, eyes wide. A curator, their outfit crisp and face severe yet kind, watches patrons carefully, eager to answer questions to any who would ask.

Loot From A Werewolf Child.name:
来自狼人孩童的战利品
Loot From A Werewolf Child

Text.text:
这只小小的狼人身无长物；在一个冷酷无情、容不下他的世界里，他只能尽力过着朝不保夕的日子。那一小把铜钱币——毫无疑问是在粗糙的石板街头乞讨换来的——对这个瘦骨嶙峋的流浪儿而言，简直如同巨龙的宝藏。
The tiny werewolf has nothing of value; he was living day to day as best he could in a harsh and unforgiving world that didn’t accept him. The handful of copper coins—no doubt earned begging on the rough, cobbled streets—would have been like a dragon’s hoard to the emaciated urchin.

Cybernetically Enhanced Young Blue Drago.name:
义体强化的幼年蓝龙
Cybernetically Enhanced Young Blue Dragon

Text.text:
一道蓝色光痕伴随着凯旋般的咆哮撕裂天穹。巨响落地，巨龙振翼一抖，逸散的狂风骤然拍击四方。它的身躯呈深钴蓝，修长而健壮，青春的雄姿在肌肉纹理间起伏流动。两处醒目的改装在龙鳞上留下金属般的冷光，破坏了那份天然的完美：一只义体眼泛着猩红凶光；而一把巨大的弧能步枪架在它的右肩，低鸣嗡响，宛如深邃飞船通风口的轰鸣。
A streak of blue bursts through the sky with a triumphant roar. Landing with a crash, the dragon flutters their wings, sending an errant wind buffeting out. Their lithe body is a cobalt blue, slender and muscular, rippling with the magnificence of youth. Two obvious augments mar the dragon’s skin with a metallic sheen: one cybernetic eye glowing a menacing red and a huge arc rifle perched on its right shoulder, humming like a cavernous spaceship vent.

Nightmare About Becoming Tiny.name:
变得渺小的噩梦
Nightmare About Becoming Tiny

Text.text:
你脚下这片粉彩般的干旱平原，是一幅令人眩晕的壁画：地势急促弯折，过早地卷向地平线，稀薄、芦苇似的植被在风里发硬。你试着扶住其中一株稳住身形，那圆柱状的茎却向你生长迎来——又或是你的手缩小去迎向它？你开始看见地面上爬满细小生物，昆虫般的颚器正钻入剥落的土壳——巨大的虱子，以及更大的跳蚤。你如今不比它们大。你呼吸一窒。你正在缩减，缩到看不见、缩到无法被察觉——缩到不存在。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The pastel-colored, arid plain on which you stand is a fresco of disorienting visuals, with its rapid curvature to a premature horizon and thin, reedy flora. When you try to steady yourself against one of the plants, the cylinder grows to meet you—or did your hand shrink to meet it? You begin to spy tiny creatures covering the ground, insectile mandibles burrowing the flaking earth—giant lice and even bigger fleas. You are no bigger than them now. Your breath catches. You are reducing beyond sight, beyond detection—beyond existence.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Headstone: “You” In Winter.name:
墓碑：“你”在寒冬
Headstone: “You” In Winter

Text.text: 这块墓碑前的土堆比其余的都要小。也许这里埋葬的是个孩子，或是一位半身人。墓碑上的铭文几乎看不出端倪：你伫立在一座坟前，可若坟墓不是用来提醒生命何其珍贵，又还能是什么？ The mound before this headstone is smaller than the rest. Perhaps a child or a halfling was buried here. The headstone’s inscription gives little clue: You stand over a grave, but what is a grave if not a reminder of the preciousness of life?

Barbarian To Wizard In Pitch Darkness.name:
野蛮人到法师，在黑暗中
Barbarian To Wizard In Pitch Darkness

Text.text:
“我说，天才，你随时都可以弄点光出来。这样一来，才不会有哪个拎着巨剑的家伙一刀劈错人。”
“You know, genius, anytime now you could conjure up some light. That way, nobody with a really big sword will cut into the wrong body.”

I Cast Sleet Storm Using My Druidic Focu.name:
我以德鲁伊法器施展【冰雹风暴】
I Cast Sleet Storm Using My Druidic Focus

Text.text:
我高举象征自然伟力的信物，呼唤冬季无常的寒雾。我挥舞德鲁伊的法器划破空气，雾气随之凝聚成阴沉的云团，倾泻出一阵冰雨与霰的暴流。狂乱的降水击打四方，激起遮蔽视线的迷雾，并在地面铺就一层阴险的薄冰。
Bearing aloft my token of nature’s might, I call upon the intemperate mists of winter. I swirl my druidic implement in the air, and the mists coalesce into dismal clouds that release a torrent of sleet. The battering precipitation sends up an obscuring fog, and forms a layer of insidious ice upon the ground.

Dragon's Breath (Poison) Cast On Self.name:
龙息（毒素）对自身施放
Dragon's Breath (Poison) Cast On Self

Text.text:
一声咕噜作响的咆哮自你喉间渗出，周遭空气翻涌着剧毒的辉光。你双眼脉动着翠绿的光芒，猛地从顺手的腰袋里扯出一枚辣椒。扭动的唇间冒出苦涩的咒语，你用灼痛起泡的手掌狠狠拍在胸口，嘴巴张得不可思议地巨大。滚烫的口中骤然喷涌出一波嘶嘶作响的毒液浪潮。
A gurgling roar bleeds from your throat, the air about you seething with toxic effulgence. Your eyes pulse with viridian light as you yank a pepper from a handy pouch. Bitter words bubble from your writhing lips, and you smack a blistering hand upon your chest, your mouth opening impossibly wide. A wave of hissing venom bursts from your steaming mouth.

Cigar-chomping Liquor Store Clerk.name:
叼着雪茄的酒铺店员
Cigar-chomping Liquor Store Clerk

Text.text:
店员嘴里叼着的雪茄袅袅飘出刺鼻的烟雾，他们一边给你结账，一边听着身后收音机里传来的比赛战报，时不时挑起眉梢。褪色的保龄球衫松松垮垮地披在他们壮实的身躯上，一条沉甸甸的金项链垂在胸前，与他们指上那枚主权戒相映成辉。
Acrid smoke drifts from the cigar wedged in the clerk’s mouth as they ring you up, occasionally raising an eyebrow as they listen to the match report piping from the radio behind them. A faded bowling shirt drapes their robust form, and a heavy gold chain hangs around their neck, complementing the sovereign ring they are wearing.

Epic Tale Of Werewolf And Dragon-mounted.name:
狼人史诗与驭龙骑士传说
Epic Tale Of Werewolf And Dragon-mounted Knight

Text.text:
随即，狼人之刃的战吼在等待中低沉咆哮。年轻巨龙的脊背如翻滚浪涛，暗黑骑士勒紧缰绳，俯冲而下。双翼张开，龙裔直坠向那半狼战斗法师——他握着的刀刃颤动如被拴住的猎犬。忽然一阵轻爆，气浪骤涌，尘土自地面腾起，却不见狼人，也不见刀。他们已在空中现身于骑士侧畔；骑士坠向 Booming Blade，而狼人法师则以胜者的优雅落地。

~ 由 ThunderWolf Envisioned

Then did the battle-voice of the werewolf’s blade growl in wait. Saddled to the rolling wave of a young dragon’s back, the dark knight pulled on reins and dove. Wings spread, the wyrm plunged at the half-wolf battle-mage, who held the blade that shook like a leashed hound. Suddenly a puff, a burst of air, dust from the ground, but no werewolf and no blade. They appeared airborne beside the knight, who to Booming Blade did fall, and the werewolf mage landed with victorious grace.

~ Envisioned by ThunderWolf

Boarding An Enemy Vessel.name:
登上敌舰
Boarding An Enemy Vessel

Text.text:
倒计时——3，2，1，点火！——在逼仄的舱室里回荡。你的小型登舰艇被母舰侧向发射，猛然一颤，呼啸着穿越空间。你滑入虚空的刹那，四周陷入绝对的寂静。紧接着……一声震耳欲聋的撞击，震得你踉跄不稳。伙伴死死抓住扶手，你的艇首所装的激光钻机嗡鸣启动，咬进舰体外壳，硬生生钻穿数英尺厚的合金钢。你的气闸嘶嘶作响，开始泄压。
A countdown—3, 2, 1, ignition!—echoes in the claustrophobic chamber. Shot broadside from the ship, your small boarding vessel judders, hurtling through space. There is a moment of absolute silence as you slide through the void. Then… a thunderous impact that sends you staggering. Companions hold tight to handrails as the laser drill mounted to the front of your vessel whirs into action, boring into the hull, cutting through several feet of alloyed steel. Your airlock hisses, depressurizing.

I Cast Shield Of Faith Using Components.name:
我用施法材料施放【信仰护盾】
I Cast Shield Of Faith Using Components

Text.text:
我展开一卷磨得发亮的小羊皮卷，用清亮如钟的嗓音朗声诵读其上铭刻的文字。墨迹随即泛起金色光辉。同样发光的符文旋绕着我的盟友盘旋，渐渐凝聚成一层护盾般的气泡。
Unrolling a small scroll of well-worn parchment, I read the inscribed text in a clear, ringing voice. The ink begins to glow with a golden light. The same glowing glyphs swirl around my ally, coalescing into a shielding bubble.

这段代码化作一支箭矢，而非波纹。它以猩红的奔涌朝目标激射而去，追猎那名冒犯的黑客。箭矢会绕开非优先目标，把较弱的赛博空间住民推搡到一旁。它击中的一切上都会攀附起细小如爪的纺锤体，沿着敌人的代码缓缓渗落，绝望地搜寻他们在现实肉身中的所在。

~ 一位英雄所构想

This code takes the form of an arrow, not a wave. It shoots toward its target in a scarlet surge, seeking the offending hacker. The arrow bends around nonpriority targets, pushing aside lesser cyberspace denizens. Little clawlike spindles attach to whatever it hits, trickling down through the enemy’s code, searching desperately for where they are in meatspace.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Loot From A Hezrou.name:
从一只海兹洛身上搜出的战利品
Loot From A Hezrou

Text.text:
你找到两只赫兹鲁魔的利爪，每只价值约90枚金币。把它们凑在一起，就能折叠拼合成一把锻造的武器。
You find two hezrou claws, each worth about 90 gold pieces. Together, they are capable of being folded into a forged weapon.

Body Washed Up On The Beach.name:
尸体被海浪冲上了沙滩
Body Washed Up On The Beach

Text.text:
仿若一尊凄寂的雕像，一具躯体横卧在岸边——被遗忘的杰作，由潮汐的涨落雕琢而成。大自然的摧残将其血肉染上灰与红的色调，螃蟹在被海水漂白的躯肉上为残渣争夺撕扯。残存的衣物几乎不露端倪，只从这可怜人曾停靠的某座港口里，低声诉说着忧伤的旧事。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Like a forlorn sculpture, a body lies upon the shore—a forgotten masterpiece, sculpted by the ebb and flow of the tide. The ravages of nature have painted its flesh in hues gray and red, and crabs tussle for scraps across the sea-bleached flesh. What garb remains reveals little, only whispering tales of melancholy from whatever port this poor soul hailed.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Field Point Arrow.name:
野战定位箭
Field Point Arrow

Text.text:
长方形的布旗等距悬挂着，像晾衣绳上的衣物，在微风里轻轻飘动——任何寻常箭头一旦命中，都会把它们撕成碎布。这支箭却飞得笔直，落点干净利落，在旗面上穿出一个规整的小孔，清清楚楚便于计数，却绝非为实战而生。
Rectangular cloth flags hang, evenly spaced, like clothes on a line, waving in a light breeze—any normal arrowhead would shred them on a hit. This arrow flies true, strikes clean, and puts a neat, small hole through a flag, easy to count, but not exactly fit for a combat.

The Joker's Club Revealed.name:
小丑俱乐部现身
The Joker's Club Revealed

Text.text:
“有些人管他们叫‘牌组’。挺机灵的文字把戏。不是狼群那种‘群’，明白吧，是扑克牌。四个派系——梅花、黑桃、方块、红心——合起来就是小丑俱乐部。小丑高坐其首，不属任何花色，独一无二，其余人则按牌面阶序依次俯首。他们全是无赖：流氓、吟游诗人，还有各路两面下注的庄家。但凡有什么需要打听——一点流言、一句通往秘密行会的口令、一张指向应许宝藏的地图——小丑俱乐部都能告诉你。他们搜罗并守着知识，像巨龙把金币囤进巢里。没人真知道为什么。我反正不知道。恐怕只有小丑才明白这一切的真正目的——而他们就算对自己的指挥官：那些杰克、皇后与国王，说话也只以玩笑作答。”

~ 由 Argonath 所构想的 Envisioned

“They’re called the Pack, by some. Clever bit o’ wordplay there. Not like wolves, see, but playing cards. Four factions—the clubs, the spades, the diamonds, the hearts—make up the Joker’s Club. Joker’s at the head, suitless and peerless, while the rest fall in rank beneath. They are scoundrels, all. Rogues and bards and other double-dealers. But if there’s something needs knowin’—a bit o’ gossip, a password into a secret guild, a map to promised treasure—the Joker’s Club can tell ya. They seek and keep knowledge as a dragon hoards its gold. No one really knows why. I know I don’t. I suppose only the Joker knows the true aim of it all—and they only speak in jests, even to their commanders: their Jacks, Queens, and Kings.”

~ Envisioned by Argonath

Person Wrapped In Bandages.name:
缠满绷带的人
Person Wrapped In Bandages

Text.text:
那身影看着像人形，却很难辨出更多细节——他们被厚重斗篷与绷带层层裹住。污旧发白的纱布覆盖了此人每一寸肌肤，缠绕着脖颈、躯干与四肢——甚至连脸也不放过，只在破裂割开的缝隙处勉强让他们得以视物与呼吸。他们以一种诡异而不规则的步态前行，阴影遮蔽的目光在四周游移扫视。
The figure is humanoid, but it’s difficult to discern more about them, draped as they are in a heavy cloak and bandages. The dingy white gauze covers every inch of the individual, wrapped about their neck, torso, limbs—even their face, though torn and cut to allow them to see and breathe. They move with a strange and irregular gait, casting their shadowed gaze in all directions.

Ioun Stone Of Strength.name:
力量艾欧石
Ioun Stone Of Strength

Text.text:
你背脊、胸膛与四肢的肌肉猛然鼓胀，迸发出如绳索般的新生力量；那枚淡蓝色的石头呼啸着掠过你的面颊，擦着耳畔旋转飞过。
The muscles along your back, chest, and limbs swell with new, cord-like strength as the pale blue stone whirls past your face and over your ear.

Hershal, \"The Red Death\".name:
赫舍尔，“赤红死神”
Hershal, "The Red Death"

Text.text:
一道深深的疤——宛如冰川湖泊那种夺目、冷冽的蔚蓝——从战士脸上眼罩的边缘下蜿蜒而过。尽管岁月让他的身形略显松弛，这位前角斗士依旧英挺迫人，俊朗得让人难以移开视线。熊地精（特征）身材远高于寻常男子，粗硬的赤褐色毛发像厚毯般覆满全身，而那丰润的榛色皮肤之下，数不清的伤疤纵横交错。背上，战士背着一面古怪的盾牌，上面竟画着他自己的笑脸，正俏皮地眨着一只眼；一杆磨损沉重的火枪则随意地斜挂在肩头。他行走时，影子总会几乎难以察觉地慢半拍才追上来，仿佛只是照着他的身形临摹，却并不受其束缚。

~ 由一位英雄扮演

A deep scar—the striking, icy blue of a glacial lake—runs beneath an eye patch on the warrior’s face. Though his body has softened with age, the former gladiator still cuts an imposing and handsome figure. Standing well above the normal height of a man, the bugbear is covered in a thick carpet of coarse auburn fur, and innumerable scars mark the rich hazelnut skin beneath. At his back, the warrior wears a curious shield depicting his own smiling face winking coquettishly, and a worn, heavy musket is casually slung over his shoulder. As he moves, there is an almost imperceptible delay until his shadow catches up to him, as if it is merely copying his body, yet unbound by it.

~ Played by a Hero

Underground Fight Club For Battle Drones.name:
战斗无人机地下格斗俱乐部
Underground Fight Club For Battle Drones

Text.text:
一座由钢铁与铁网构成的笼子沉在擂场中央，四周看台层层环绕；空气黏腻，焦灼金属、廉价香水与烈酒的气味混在一起，几缕烟丝漂浮其间。在笼子两侧，驾驶员把触觉反馈战衣的线路接入无人机架——人形外骨骼——随后，他们那一台台装点着凶狠近战武器的格斗机器人从地面升起，踏入擂内。每个操控手摆出战斗架势，机器人也分毫不差地同步。低语、叫喊与欢呼在观众席间一波波荡开。忽然，一台无人机猛扑向前，旋转的锯刃尖啸着咬入目标的骨架。操控手随着这一击痛呼出声，仿佛伤落在自己身上。人群爆出雷鸣般的狂吼。

~ 由一位 Hero Envisioned

A cage of steel and mesh sits at the bottom of an arena ringed with bleachers; smells of burnt metal, cheap perfume, and liquor hang in the sticky air, along with wisps of smoke. At either side of the cage, pilots wire their haptic suits into drone rigs—humanoid-shaped exoskeletons—before their fighting robots, festooned with wicked melee weapons, rise into the ring. Each rigger takes a battle stance, moves the bots perfectly mimic. Murmuring, shouts, and cheers ripple through the audience. One drone leaps forward, driving a whirring saw into its target’s frame. The rigger cries out as the blow strikes his drone. The crowd roars.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Cave Grotto Village With Strange Mold.name:
长满诡异霉菌的洞穴石窟村
Cave Grotto Village With Strange Mold

Text.text:
由粗糙的植物残材搭起的小棚屋占据了这座阴暗、闷热的洞窟。黏滑的红色霉菌覆满地面与岩壁，像锈迹在一把老旧犁头上蔓延开来。由结实藤蔓编成的怪异生物彼此嘶嘶作响、咔哒相鸣，忙着各自的活计——对周遭空气中翻涌漂浮的浓密孢子云毫不在意。
Small huts—made of rough plant matter—dominate the dark, sweltering grotto. A slick, red mold covers the ground and walls, spreading like rust across an old plow. Strange creatures made of sinewy vines hiss and click to one another as they go about their business—unfazed by the thick clouds of spores drifting through the air around them.

Exiting The Burial Floor.name:
离开葬墓层
Exiting The Burial Floor

Text.text:
直到腐烂与败坏的恶臭开始散去，才真正看清它曾有多么强烈。那些原本为迎接来客而建的建筑，如今在残破中却将人拒之门外；曾经安宁之地，如今只在离去时才让人感到那份平静。
It’s not until the stench of rot and decay starts to fade that it’s truly clear how powerful it was. The structures, built to invite visitors, now—in their ruined state—push them away, and what was once a place of peace only provides those feelings upon departing.

一扇空荡的门洞通向主厅。蛛网沿着墙面铺陈，家具尽数埋在厚厚的尘埃之下。塔身两侧盘旋而上的是一道木质楼梯。许多台阶早已被时代侵蚀——或被潮湿的海风泡得发软，承重便沉沉下弯；或干脆裂成碎片，整段坠落无踪。登顶处是一方小小的平台，四周围着一圈锈蚀入骨的栏杆；中央则是一盏破碎的灯——如今成了鸟巢的窝——旁边那枚曾将光芒投射出去、为四周船只指引的透镜，也布满深深的裂纹。
An empty doorway leads into the main room. Cobwebs line the walls and the furniture is buried beneath a thick layer of dust. Spiraling around the sides of the tower is a wooden staircase. Many of the steps have fallen prey to the passage of time—either softened with the damp sea air, bending heavily under any weight, or splintered off and fallen completely. At the top, a small platform is surrounded by a deeply rusted rail and in the center sits a shattered light—now home to a bird nest—and a deeply cracked lens that once extended that light out to aid surrounding ships.

Cagey Gutterpunk Rocker.name:
谨慎多疑的沟渠朋克摇滚客
Cagey Gutterpunk Rocker

Text.text:
像被拨动的琴弦般颤抖着，这名邋遢的摇滚客目光鬼祟地在每一扇窗与门口间飞快游移，仿佛随时会有麻烦找上门。他们的话语以断奏般的节拍从发黄的牙齿间哒哒震出——其中几颗还镶着铬金属——整个人仿佛根本无法静止。
Shaking like a plucked string, the grungy rocker’s eyes dart furtively to every window and doorway, as if they expect trouble. The staccato rhythm of their speech rattles through yellowed teeth—some capped with chrome—and they seem incapable of stillness.

Sundries From A Shoosuva.name:
来自一头Shoosuva的杂货
Sundries From A Shoosuva

Text.text: 恶魔脖子上套着一圈由交织的舌头编成的项圈，下面坠着一枚被锤打成形的锡牌，上面写着：在你的大日子里，送给巴乌·裂爪。 The demon wears a collar made of woven tongues, on which hangs a tag of hammered tin that reads: To Baw Splitpaw on your big day.

Cloaked Stranger Sprouts Blades.name:
披风陌客抽刃而出
Cloaked Stranger Sprouts Blades

Text.text:
披篷人猛地以一种非人的方式抽搐，阴毒的嘶声从那被遮蔽的躯壳里蜿蜒逸出。以令人心惊的速度，两片剃刀般锋利的斧刃从陌生人的双臂轰然迸出，瞬间撕裂他的衣物。斧刃在归于静止时仍低鸣不止，那由诡异嵌合合金铸成的刃身，被其冷酷行径染上猩红。

~ 由 Discord 上的 Sahlonahl 构想

The cloaked figure jerks unnaturally as a sinister hiss slithers from their shrouded body. With alarming speed, two razor-sharp axe blades explode from the stranger's arms, tearing his clothing asunder. The blades hum as they come to rest, the strange chimeric alloy of their construction stained crimson by their grim work.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Discovery Of A Subterranean Treant.name:
地下树人现身
Discovery Of A Subterranean Treant

Text.text:
天然的地下隧道在此让位于一间砌有精修石墙的洞室。入口旁堆着一小堆松散的岩石，几截半掩在碎石下的类地精肢体散落在堆底。天花板上精准切出的孔洞倾泻下道道日光，拉成一条条明亮的光带，把石地照得斑驳如画。更多尸体——头颅被砸得塌陷、早已无声——横七竖八地倒在一棵矮壮苍白的小树周围，那树枝杈伸向温暖的光芒。你打量着这支地精队伍的残骸时，那棵树动了。两只油亮的黄色眼睛锁定了你，它迅捷地一转身，以防御姿态立起，盘曲的根须蜷成两条椭圆的腿。
The natural subterranean tunnel gives way to a chamber with finished stone walls. A loose pile of rocks lies near the entrance, a few partially buried goblinoid limbs splayed around its base. Long boxes of light illuminate the stone floor, painted by sunbeams streaming from precisely-cut openings in the ceiling. More bodies—lifeless with heads caved in—sprawl around a short and stout pale tree with boughs stretching toward the warming rays. As you survey the remains of this goblin party, the tree moves. Two glossy yellow eyes train on you, and it swivels with dispatch, taking a defensive stance on roots curled into two oblong legs.

这根坚韧干燥的木杖约有3英尺长。杖身一半被芦苇与碎布紧紧缠绕，其上干涸的油脂或蜡光泽隐现。火把周围弥漫着这燃料浓烈刺鼻的气味。
This rod of sturdy, dry wood is about 3 feet long. Rushes and rags, glistening with dried oil or wax, tightly wrap one half the rod. The odor of this fuel is strong around the torch.

Vampire's Manor: Grand Foyer.name:
吸血鬼（特征）的庄园：宏伟门厅
Vampire's Manor: Grand Foyer

Text.text:
宅邸的前厅以一片猩红地毯迎接来客——它或许曾经柔软温暖、绒密丰厚，如今却磨得见底，污秽与碎屑零落其上。前厅呈圆形，穹顶高拱，一道螺旋楼梯盘旋而上，通往宅邸二层。肮脏的墙面上挂着肖像与挂毯，描绘着昔日居于此处的人们：一幅里，年幼的孩子在庭院里同小狗嬉戏；另一幅里，一对气度雍容的贵族夫妻并肩而立，神情肃穆却不失温和；第三幅则绘着周遭乡野，绿丘起伏，河流闪光。可一切并非表面所见——当你环顾前厅，留意那些门扉与分岔的走廊时，画中的景象悄然变形、沉暗：孩子长大了，正埋葬那只狗；贵族夫妇凹陷憔悴的眼窝里渗出血丝；乡野化作灰烬般的废墟，灰白而无形，头顶则压着一片阴沉、令人窒息的黑天。
The manor's foyer welcomes visitors with crimson carpets that may have once been lush and warm, but now lie threadbare, scattered with filth and debris. The foyer is circular, domed at its top, with a spiraling staircase leading up to the manor's second floor. Portraits and tapestries adorn the filthy walls, depicting the manor's previous occupants. In one, a young child plays with a puppy in the courtyard; in another, a husband and wife of noble bearing stand shoulder-to-shoulder, their faces stoic but kind; and in a third, the surrounding countryside is depicted with its green, rolling hills and gleaming rivers. But all is not as it seems—as you cast your gaze around the foyer, noting its various doors and branching passageways, the portraits shift and darken. The child, older, now buries the dog; blood trickles from the gaunt, sunken eyes of the noble couple; and the countryside lies in ashen ruins, gray and featureless, while a dark and oppressive sky looms above.

Chapel In A Church.name:
教堂小礼拜堂
Chapel In A Church

Text.text:
这间由厚重石料砌成的小室里摆着六张长凳，一座矮墩墩却令人心生暖意的跪式祭坛由一整块明亮的洞石雕成。天花板上垂挂着一幅厚实的羊毛挂毯，其上绣满象征图案与勉励的字句。后墙几乎被一扇大窗占满，地上的地毯让室内安静而舒适。这里用于内省、冥想，并使灵魂在怜悯之前谦卑俯首。
The little chamber of heavy stone has six benches, and a squat but cheerful kneeling altar carved from a sunny travertine block. A large wool tapestry, embroidered with symbols and words of encouragement, hangs from the ceiling. One window takes up most of the back wall, and the rugs on the floor keep the room quiet and comfortable. This is a place for introspection, meditation, and the humbling of the soul toward mercy.

就是这里——越过所有结界与陷阱，穿过一切守卫之后——巫妖的终极圣所就在眼前，它那传奇的命匣必定藏于此处。只是……到底是哪一个？

这里堆着如龙之宝窟般的容器：箱子、匣柜、棺椁、木箱、各式容器、罐子与壶。你看见鼻烟盒、妆奁、卷轴筒、镶宝小匣、耍蛇人的篮子。甚至还有一个看起来像施舍箱的东西。

它也许就藏在某一堆下面，或在层层套盒里深埋六重。又或者——你此刻正直视着它。
This is it, past all the wards and traps, through all guardians—here is the final sanctum of the lich where its legendary phylactery must lie. Only… which is it? There’s a dragon-hoard of chests, coffers, coffins, crates, containers, jars, and jugs. You see snuffboxes, makeup cases, scroll cases, jeweled caskets, and snake charmers’ baskets. There’s even what looks like an alms box. It could be hidden under one of these piles, or six containers deep in a box-within-box. Or you might be looking right at it right now.

Receptionist With Accessibility Devices.name:
配备无障碍辅助设备的接待员
Receptionist With Accessibility Devices

Text.text:
前台那名赭黄肤色的外星人眨了眨爬行类的眼睛，深深吸了一大口气。她戴着的甲烷呼吸面罩发出清脆的提示音，耳机上的红灯随即跳闪成绿光。她的身躯显然经过尖端义体强化，能与任何物种无碍沟通，确保星际外交的交流如行云流水般顺畅无缺。
The ochre-skinned alien at reception blinks her reptilian eyes and takes a huge breath. The methane breathing-mask she wears chimes, and the red light on her headset flashes green. Her body appears augmented with advanced cybernetic enhancements, allowing communication with any species and ensuring a perfect flow of intergalactic diplomacy.

婴儿起初看上去与人类无异。然而，那略显棱角的五官与耳尖的弧度，却出卖了他们的精灵传承；当他们开始能独自站起、蹒跚行走时，你也察觉到他们举手投足间流露出的优雅与轻灵。
The infant appears human at first. The slightly angular features and point to their ears, however, betray their elven heritage, and as they come to stand and walk about on their own, you note the grace with which they move.

Tracks Disappear At Water’s Edge.name:
足迹消失于水岸
Tracks Disappear At Water’s Edge

Text.text:
方向很明确：水道的远岸就是目标。追踪者的成功取决于找出猎物是从哪里离开河道——以及需要沿上游或下游旅行多远。反过来，能否重新捕捉到离岸后的踪迹，将决定黑暗是否会成为新的障碍。
The direction is clear: the far bank of the waterway was the objective. The success of the tracker depends on locating where the quarry left the river—how far the travel either upstream or down. In turn, picking up the exit trail will determine whether or not darkness becomes the new obstacle.

在你面前隆起的断崖上，仿佛有一股松散的泥土洪流被猛然呕吐而出。那片冲积扇绵延数里，满覆松散的沉积物与碎石坡。它形成的斜面并非陡到无法攀越，但脚下尽是会滑动的岩块与残骸，光是穿行其上就足以让任何行进变得步步艰难、迟缓无比。
From the raised escarpment before you, a torrent of loose earth has been vomited forth. The alluvial fan is miles wide and covered in loose sediment and scree. The slope it forms is not impassably steep, but the sheer volume of shifting rocks and debris underfoot would make any traversal slow going.

Silver Raven Figurine Of Wondrous Power.name:
奇妙力银鸦雕像
Silver Raven Figurine Of Wondrous Power

Text.text:
这尊鸦形小雕像以足银铸成，恰好能安稳栖在你的掌心。小乌鸦的羽毛被精心雕琢出细密纹理，连它那长爪利钩的趾节棱脊也刻画得一丝不苟。尖喙微张，啼鸣定格在半声之间；喙内一截小小的银舌闪着冷光。
This corvid figurine is crafted of sterling silver and perches easily in the palm of your hand. The feathers of the little raven have been beautifully, painstakingly textured, as have the ridges of its long-clawed talons. Its pointed beak is open, frozen mid-caw. Its small silver tongue glints from within.

Foyer Continental Arbustum.name:
大陆门厅·灌木园
Foyer Continental Arbustum

Text.text:
在四周一排排真正的拱窗投下的尘光之中，地面被切割成拱形、分格的光池，繁茂的植株在其间簇拥成群。入口两侧的角落被塞得满满当当：棕榈、蕨类、多肉与热带花卉扎堆生长，皆植于肥沃的土壤盆中。瓷砖地面上绘着一朵新艺术风格的花，其纤维般的花茎自门槛处蜿蜒展开。
Among the arched and multi-paned pools of dusty light cast on the floor by the actual arched windows all around, plants cluster in abundance. The corners on either side of the entrance are stuffed with palms, ferns, succulents, and tropical flowers potted in rich soil. The fibrous stem of an art nouveau flower painted on the tile floor begins at the threshold.

Bridge Over Cave River.name:
洞河之桥
Bridge Over Cave River

Text.text:
这座宽阔的桥看似天成，却有人在石面上凿出阶梯，让桥身中央那道突兀的落差不至于难以通行。桥的大部分高悬在水面上方约三十英尺处，但中央一段会下沉六七英尺，随后又在对岸一侧骤然抬升。
This broad bridge seems natural, but someone has cut steps from the stone to make a sudden drop in its middle more manageable. Most of the bridge looms some thirty feet above the water, but the center portion of dips down half a dozen feet before abruptly ascending again on the opposite side.

Excerpt From It's All For Sport: How War.name:
摘自《一切皆为竞技：交战的巫师如何缔造现代游戏》
Excerpt From It's All For Sport: How Warring Wizards Created Modern Games

Text.text: [掩蔽] 这本褪成暗红的厚书封面上，标题以一种古怪的方式写就——一半是中世纪的花体笔迹，一半却像校队夹克上那种方方正正的粗体字。 [内容] 你翻动着起皱发脆、泛黄的书页，直到找到“附魔师马球”一节。你读到导言：附魔师马球是一种在坐骑上进行的野外团队比赛，由施法者分队骑乘参赛，通常骑的是斯特鲁蒂贡。它源自一种古老的战斗形式，原本用于平息交战施法者之间的土地纷争；因此，这项游戏成为魔法使用者中最古老、也最受欢迎的运动之一。规则与日常版本相似：双方队伍需引导球穿越场地，将其送入对方球门柱之间。然而，附魔师马球不用木球与槌，而是使用需要一定等级奥术技能才能娴熟驾驭的魔法装备。球是一枚玻璃球体，受附魔保护，能承受魔法与物理冲击。球槌由一种轻质金属制成，并经过调谐，能像魔法磁石般吸引球体。要让球体贴附在球槌上，需要持续而稳定的专注——这种专注可能被另一名玩家的意志打断……也可能被比赛中层出不穷的危险与干扰撕裂。附魔师马球的最后一项特色——赛季中会在不同场地上进行比赛——更令考验雪上加霜。标准场地包括：草地、海域、火山与风暴。每种场地都会对玩家及其坐骑提出独特挑战。比如，海域场地完全在一池水中进行；而火山场地则有火焰喷涌在比赛中随机爆发。 [Cover] Across the cover of this faded red tome, the title is written in an eccentric mix of medieval script and the blocky font of letterman’s jackets. [Content] You flip through the crinkling, yellowed pages until you find the “Enchanter’s Polo” section. You read the introduction: Enchanter's Polo is a field game played by teams of spellcasters astride mounts, typically Struttigons. Based on an ancient form of combat meant to settle land disputes between the warring spellcasters, this game is one of the oldest and most popular sports among magic-users. Similar to the quotidian game, teams must guide a ball across a field and through the opposing team's goal posts. However, instead of a wooden ball and mallets, Enchanter's Polo is played with magical equipment that requires a certain level of arcane skill to wield effectively. The ball is a glass orb, enchanted to withstand magical and physical forces. The mallets are made of a lightweight metal attuned to attract the orb, like a magical magnet. Keeping the orb attached to the mallet requires steady concentration that may be broken by another player’s will… or the general hazards and distractions that occur during the game. The final feature of Enchanter’s Polo—the game is played on different fields throughout the course of a season—adds to the trials. The standard array of fields is: Grass, Sea, Volcanic and Storm. Each field presents unique challenges to the players and their mounts. For example, the Sea Field is played entirely in a pool of water, while the Volcanic Field features spouts of flame that erupt randomly throughout the game.

看上去像是一个半兽人：身披皮革与黑曜石护甲，携带一柄弯刃大刀、一面盾牌，腰间还系着一圈匕首带——但这些细节隐约透露出，这副外形之下另有玄机。头盔的眼窝里并非黑暗，而是嵌着两颗如紫水晶般幽亮的光球。护甲的移动似乎在某种意义上独立于穿戴者，仿佛由一位智者与战士唤醒；他与自己的护甲之间的联系，早已超越寻常工艺所能解释的范畴。

~ Played by Orion Jaeger with

What appears to be the build of a half-orc wearing leather and obsidian armor—carrying a falchion, a shield, and a belt of daggers—gives some subtle hints that there is more to the form. Inside the helmet’s eye sockets are glowing orbs like amethysts. The movement of the armor seems to be independent in some way, as if awakened by a sage and fighter whose relationship to his armor is something more than common craftsmanship.

~ Played by Orion Jaeger with

Sundries From An Adult Black Dragon.name:
成年黑龙的杂物
Sundries From An Adult Black Dragon

Text.text:
酸性涎液自它大张的口中滴落，那头巨大的黑龙倒毙于地，死去时一切威严尽失。它的牙与爪大多已毁，鳞片亦然——不过或许仍能抢救出一两片。
Acidic drool leaking from its gaping mouth, the large black dragon lies defeated, all majesty lost in death. The teeth and claws are mostly ruined, likewise the scales—although one or two may be salvageable.

Ricta, The Assassin.name:
里克塔，刺客
Ricta, The Assassin

Text.text:
忽然间，一个人影出现在棺材里，神情里带着一种恶魔般的从容与傲气。浓艳的红丝绸将她衬得像一幅画：一名暗蓝皮肤的提夫林懒散地把肩膀抵在棺内铺着软枕的一侧。细如铁丝的尾巴从她身后蜿蜒探出，缓慢来回摆动，宛如一条正蓄势瞄准的眼镜蛇。她穿着朴素却做工考究的衣装——若她混入那群衣着华贵的宾客之中，也毫不突兀。她头上的角已经断裂，太阳穴上方的黑曜石色残桩在碎裂的边缘覆着一层灰白的钙化痕迹。她的眼睛是两汪深黑的潭水，中央只有一点针尖般的白光，在她打量你们队伍时灵动跳跃。

~ Found in the amazing TTRPG supplement The Vineyard

Suddenly, a person appears inside the coffin, expression laced with devilish aplomb. Framed by the luscious red silk, a tiefling of dark blue skin casually leans her shoulder into the pillowed side of the casket. A wire-like tail snakes out from behind her and waves slowly back and forth, like a cobra taking aim. She is dressed in plain, if finely made, garb—the kind of outfit to easily blend in if she joined the throng of richly attired guests. The horns on her head are broken, the obsidian nubs above her temples clouded with a gray-white calcification at the splintered edges. Her eyes are pools of black with a pinprick of white at their center, which dances around as she takes stock of your party.

~ Found in the amazing TTRPG supplement The Vineyard

Threat From A Fire Elemental.name:
来自火元素的威胁
Threat From A Fire Elemental

Text.text:
“你不属于这里。我能感觉到那股温温的污血支撑着你的躯壳站立。你的火焰不过是一点微弱的闪烁。它将被并入我的火中。”
“You do not belong here. I can feel the tepid ichor that keeps your body upright. Your blaze is barely a flicker. It will be added to my own.”

Hagan Con Wintertide.name:
哈甘·冬潮
Hagan Con Wintertide

Text.text:
尽管他举止精致，一旦精灵伸展身体，他的身形便像一只巨大的蓝眼蜥蜴——苍白、高挑而瘦削，嘴巴大张，双手如利爪般张开，头颈扭转盘旋。可在其他时候，甚至在休息时，他身上也总有股龙性：冰冷的凝视、傲慢的气势，以及那种近乎反社会、精于算计的处事方式。他的护甲雕琢着龙纹，细微到仿佛是他贵族长袍下皮肤的一部分。他腰间系着一条沉甸甸挂满钥匙的腰带，中央的扣环是一枚典狱官徽章。

~ Played by Moonie

As sophisticated as he is, when the elf stretches, his stature resembles a great blue-eyed lizard—pale, tall, and lean, mouth wide open, hands spreading like claws, his head and neck turning and twisting. At other times, even at rest, there is something draconic about him: a cold stare, the arrogance, and a sociopathic, calculating approach to things. His armor is worked in dragon patterns, so subtle it seems to be part of his skin under his noble robes. He wears a belt heavy with keys, with a warden’s badge buckle in the center.

~ Played by Moonie

Loot From A Redcap.name:
红帽妖的战利品
Loot From A Redcap

Text.text:
镰刀躺在从精类帽子里渗出的血泊中。那道邪恶的暗色金属弧刃，尺寸大得连更高大的类人生物也能挥舞。那生物的铁靴上结着泥浆与内脏的硬痂，大小足以让一名小型同伴穿上——只要他们扛得住铁的重量……以及这双靴子背后骇人的过往。
The sickle lies in the pool of blood seeping from the fey's hat. This wicked curve of dark metal is large enough for even a taller humanoid to wield. The creature’s iron boots, crusted with mud and viscera, are large enough to fit a small-sized companion—if they can bear the weight of the iron… and the footgear's gruesome history.

Loot From A Necromantic Flesh Mound.name:
死灵血肉丘的战利品
Loot From A Necromantic Flesh Mound

Text.text:
在一堆堆破烂衣料、发黑的硬币、断裂的刀刃与各式垃圾之下，你发现了一只走运未被动过的袋子——除去几处被蛆虫与其他害兽钻出的破洞外，几乎完好无损。袋中还残留着某顿早已腐烂成泥的饭食碎屑，但除此之外，你找到了一瓶封口完好的药水，瓶中液体仍泛着魔法的微光，以及一袋施法材料。你继续在杂物里翻找，又发现了约四只同样保存下来的小袋，仍沉甸甸地装满了硬币。
Under the piles of scraps of clothing, tarnished coin, broken blades, and other junk, you find a bag luckily untouched and not trifled with aside from a few holes from burrowing maggots and other vermin. Crumbs of some long-rotted meal do remain in the bag, but, besides that, you find a sealed bottle full of potion still shimmering with magic and a bag of spellcasting components. Digging through more of the clutter, you find about four pouches similarly preserved, still heavy with coin.

Guardian God Of Necropolis.name:
死城守护神
Guardian God Of Necropolis

Text.text:
入口上方，一尊庞大的十臂神祇巍然盘坐，交叠的双腿安放在巨掌的掌心之中。他神色安宁，目光越过近处，投向远方的沙海。奢丽的彩绘与鎏金仅有轻微磨损，愈发衬出他峻朗的面容；月与日的徽记点缀在他乌黑的发间。右侧三只手捧着生命的象征——石榴、海螺与火焰；左侧三只手托着变化的象征——一截白骨、一只蝴蝶与一只葬瓮。他的姿态、目光，以及那一身湛蓝肌肤，让人不由得想起无尽。
Looming over the entryway, a huge ten-armed deific figure sits, cross-legged, in the palms of massive hands. He gazes placidly into the distant sands. Lavish paint and gilding, only lightly worn, accentuate his features and symbols of the moon and sun adorn his dark hair. In three of his right hands, he holds symbols of life—pomegranates, conch shell, and fire. In three of his left hands, he holds symbols of change—a bone, a butterfly, and a funerary urn. His posture, gaze, and blue skin call infinity to mind.

Ioun Stone Of Absorption.name:
吸收艾奥恩石
Ioun Stone Of Absorption

Text.text:
如同环绕的月亮，这颗魔法石不停地在你身畔漂游，时不时掠过你的视线——仿佛一位愉快的邻居挥手问好。淡薰衣草色的宝石被精心打磨切割成光滑怡人的形态，两端柔和收尖，勾勒出完美的椭球。
Like an orbiting moon, the magical stone drifts ceaselessly around you, passing your gaze every so often—like a cheerful neighbor waving hello. The pale lavender gem is polished and cut into a smooth, pleasing shape that tapers gently at each end to form a perfect ellipsoid.

夕阳沉入天际，空气里尽是嗡嗡作响的虫鸣，这座湖畔的码头边依旧人头攒动。少数在此系泊的湖上商贩正指挥船员，急着把驳船装载妥当，好在拂晓第一缕光亮时就能启程。也有几个渔夫不是倔得不肯收线，就是懒得动弹，仍守在原地，盼着最后再咬上一口。湖水轻轻拍打岸边的安抚声响，抚平了你的紧绷神经。
The air is alive with buzzing insects as the sun sinks low in the sky, and people still crowd around the dock along this lake. What few lake traders tied off here direct their crew, wanting to pack their barges so that they might leave at first light. A few fishers too stubborn or too relaxed to pack up their lines remain, hoping for just one more bite. The calming sound of the water lapping at the shore soothes your nerves.

Sylviara The Half-elf Pyromancer.name:
西尔薇亚拉——半精灵炎术师
Sylviara The Half-elf Pyromancer

Text.text:
身姿丰盈的年轻女子以惊人的速度转身对上你，两条垂至膝间的辫子在你们之间卷起一道风，她那水晶般湛蓝的眼眸燃着恼怒的火光。她左手举起一根短杖，右掌心猛然迸出蓝色火焰。她披着的兜帽斗篷从头上滑落，露出一对尖耳——比纯血精灵的耳朵略短。显然，这位女士对捍卫自己免受威胁与冒犯——无论是事实还是她所认定的——都格外在意。

~ 由 Ardzone 扮演

The curvaceous young woman turns on you so quickly that her two knee-length braids whirl through the air between you, her crystal blue eyes burning with ill temper. Raising a short staff in her left hand, blue flames erupt from the palm of her right. The cowled cloak she wears has slipped from her head, revealing pointed ears somewhat shorter than a full-blooded elf. Clearly this lady has a vested interest in defending herself against threats and slights, perceived and real alike.

~ Played by Ardzone

Overheard Conversation About Ineffective.name:
偷听到的关于城镇卫队无能的对话
Overheard Conversation About Ineffective Town Watch

Text.text:
“——我是说，既然隔三差五就有怪物大摇大摆闯进我家地界、连个阻拦都没有，那还要镇卫干什么？前两天我有两头牛就被那些小蜥蜴似的玩意儿给叼走了。我跟你说，我非得弄到一本法术书不可——至少这样我就能保住我家人的安全。”
“—I’m saying, why even have a town watch if every other week some monster can just walk onto my property, unchallenged? I had two heads of cattle carried off by some tiny lizard things just the other day. I’m telling you, I got to get my hands on one of those spell books—at least I’d be able to keep my family safe.”

这是一只热气球，篮筐外巧妙地加装了一段自制的船形船壳。气囊的帆布面板褪色发脏，上面绘着俗艳的叶纹与山水风景，唯独有一块写着家族姓氏的黑色书法，墨迹淋漓下坠。船壳一扇舷窗里透出暖光，尾部螺旋桨大多时候平稳突突作响，只偶尔失火一顿，回喷出一股黑烟。前甲板上方拉着一根晾衣绳，衣物随风轻摆。
This is a hot air balloon with an ingeniously home-built boat hull constructed out from the basket. The fading, grubby canvas panels of the balloon are painted with gaudy leaf patterns and landscapes except for one, which bears drippy, black calligraphy of the family name. From one window of the hull comes a warm light, and the rear propeller chugs along smoothly except for the occasional miss and backfire of black smoke. Laundry hangs on a rope stretching across the forecastle.

Amulet With Jagged Symbol.name:
带锯齿符号的护身符
Amulet With Jagged Symbol

Text.text:
这枚圆形护身符呈暗淡的金色，深邃而原始的雕刻中嵌着红色镶边。其符号的线条参差尖裂，仿佛闪电，或一只破裂杯盏上蔓延的裂纹。
The round amulet is dull gold, with red piping in the deep and primitive engraving. The lines of its symbol are jagged, like lightning or the cracks you might find on a broken cup.

你紧攥着长石，掌心里一片沁凉，抬眼望向苍穹。一束银光闪烁的光柱如长枪般刺落，伴随着低柔而悦耳的嗡鸣。凡被光柱笼罩的生物立刻痛呼出声，月光化作幽白的鬼火灼烧其身。
You clutch the feldspar, cool in the palm of your hand, and turn your gaze skyward. A shimmering beam of silver light lances downward, accompanied by a quiet, pleasant hum. Creatures caught in the beam immediately cry out in pain as the moonlight sears with ghostly, white flames.

Young Lunar Sorcerer.name:
年轻的月之术士
Young Lunar Sorcerer

Text.text:
泪水在小女孩眼眶里打转，让她那双发光的眼睛愈发璀璨；空气开始嗡鸣，仿佛力量正在凝聚。她死死攥紧拳头，猛地一跺脚——一道涟漪在她脚下轰然炸开，现实随之被改写。环境像沉入水下般摇曳扭曲，岩石轻飘飘地漂浮掠过，仿佛失去了重量；她的发丝也在无形的暗流中摇摆。头顶的天空闪烁流光，月亮完全显现，洒下一束炫目的能量之光，直直笼罩在孩子身上。漆黑的虚无覆上她惊恐睁大的眼睛，随即她尖叫出声——能量的浪潮自她体内爆发，如混沌的潮汐汹涌喷涌而出。

~ Envisioned by DucereMortis on Discord

Tears well in the young girl's eyes, amplifying their luminescent brilliance as the air begins to hum with power. Clenching her fists tightly she stamps a foot, and a ripple explodes beneath her—altering reality. The environment swims as if underwater, and rocks float by with weightless ease, as her hair sways in an invisible current. The skies shimmer overhead and the moon becomes fully visible, casting a scintillating beam of energy onto the child. A black void washes over her wide, terrified eyes before she screams—and a wave of energy erupts from within her like a chaotic tide.

~ Envisioned by DucereMortis on Discord
