Thick Buttresses Supporting Stone Bridge.name:
支撑石桥的粗壮扶壁
Thick Buttresses Supporting Stone Bridge

Text.text:
支撑通往山间小径的石桥的单排扶壁厚重如山，密实得仿佛坚不可摧。唯有真正强大的魔法，或泰坦的震怒，才可能撼动这些令人敬畏的支柱。
The single row of buttresses supporting the stone bridge to the mountain path are so massive and dense that they appear almost indestructible. It would take truly powerful magic or the wrath of a titan to weaken these awesome supports.

Hydra Encounter: Dank Swamp.name:
九头蛇遭遇：阴湿沼泽
Hydra Encounter: Dank Swamp

Text.text:
沼泽回荡着陌生的叫声，以及无数昆虫永不停歇的合唱。夜间的空气与浓雾像耍弄人的把戏，让声音在你周遭反复折返，叫人难以判断它们的来处。就连一只袭来的蚊子那恼人的嗡鸣，也仿佛从四面八方一齐逼近——直到你看见那令人作呕的生物自阴影中浮沉而出，朝你飘荡而来。
The swamp echoes with unfamiliar calls and a constant chorus of countless insects. Some trick of the nighttime air and thick fog causes the sounds to bounce around you, making it difficult to judge their origins. Even the buzzing of an attacking mosquito seems to come from every which way until you spot the loathsome creature bobbing out of the shadows toward you.

Headstone: “Past” In Winter.name:
墓碑：“过去”在冬日里
Headstone: “Past” In Winter

Text.text: 这块墓碑向着面前的雪堆微微倾斜。你拂去碑面堆积的积雪，便能读到：忧虑尽抛，牵挂皆了，此身安歇，魂已不在。 This gravestone tilts away from the snowy mound before it. Brushing away the snow that’s collected on its face, you can read: Past all worry, beyond all care, my body rests, my soul not there.

Monk Victory Line.name:
武僧胜利台词
Monk Victory Line

Text.text:
“我第一击就杀了你；剩下的都只是练手。”
“My first strike killed you; the rest were just practice.”

Sultan's City In The Elemental Plane Of.name:
火元素位面中的苏丹之城
Sultan's City In The Elemental Plane Of Fire

Text.text:
这座城市的穹顶居所与高耸尖塔在头顶无休无止的烈日炙烤下灼然燃亮。整座大都会向四面八方绵延数里，尽披金、铜、青铜与黄铜的辉光——放眼所及尽是金属，滚烫地向外辐射热浪。街道上挤满了绯红肌肤的火巨灵，四处林立的铁匠铺里，锤与砧的回响此起彼伏。
The domed dwellings and soaring spires of the city blaze in the heat of the incessant suns high above. The entirety of the metropolis, sprawling for leagues in all directions, shines gold, copper, bronze, and brass—metal as far as the eye can see, radiating heat. The streets teem with crimson-skinned efreet, and numerous smithies ring with the sound of hammers and anvils.

在一堆白骨与半腐的残骸深处，一具魁梧的亡灵巨龙骸骨轰然抬起。破烂的皮翼倏然展开，巫妖巨龙踉跄着伸至全然骇人的高度，眼眶的空洞里，两点灼燃的光芒骤然点亮。干枯的残肉如褴褛碎布般挂在泛黄的骨架上；伴随一声嘶嘶的吸气，巫妖巨龙放出令人毛骨悚然的尖啸，气息里裹着浓烈的死亡恶臭。

~ 构想 by Trevar Fracchiolla and Chadmeister

From the depths of a pile of bones and half-rotted carcasses rises the hulking, skeletal form of an undead dragon. Ragged, leathery wings unfurl as the lich wyrm comes to its full, staggering height, and two pinpoints of burning light flare to life in the hollows of its eye sockets. Desiccated flesh hangs in tatters from the yellowed bones of the beast; a hissing inhalation and the lich wyrm looses an unnerving screech, fragrant with the stench of death.

~ Envisioned by Trevar Fracchiolla and Chadmeister

镜面的玻璃忽然如水般泛起涟漪，柔和的弦铃声轻轻荡开，细柔的光弧在表面游舞。镜框顶端三道符文随之点燃，在黑暗中泛着青蓝幽光。底座上还刻着更多符文，却仍沉眠不动——不禁令人发问：若将它们唤醒，又会发生什么？
The glass of the mirror suddenly ripples like water, emitting a soft chime-like sound as the soft arcs dance across the surface. Three runes alight from the top of the mirror’s frame, glowing teal in the dark. More runes are etched into the base, though these are dormant—begging the question what might happen if they are activated.

只消一眼便能看出，这艘船的船长那张饱经风霜的面孔——细密皱纹如纹路般缠绕，肤色被无数海上日子晒得黝黑——几乎见过这世界可能掷来的所有风浪。十亿滴海雾盐沫的斑痕点点，洒在他那件披在瘦长身躯上的、长而浸过焦油的海大衣的肩头、臂弯，以及更多地方。
One can tell from a glance that the careworn face of the master of this ship, festooned with fine wrinkles and tanned from countless days at sea, has seen virtually everything this world could possibly throw. The stains of a billion drops of sea spray dot the shoulders, arms, and quite a lot else of the long, tarred sea coat draped over the middle-aged man’s lanky frame.

阳光在这柄长柄武器的木柄上紧紧缠绕的精锤铁丝上闪烁——正好用来防备那些想砍断这件上等武器的斧手。戟的劈砍刃由暗沉的陨铁铸成，仿佛能吞饮四周的光线，这无疑是致命附魔的效果。
Sunlight glints off of the finely hammered iron wire wrapped tightly around the haft of this polearm—the better to ward off axemen looking to destroy this weapon of quality. The chopping head of the halberd is made of a dark, meteoric-iron that seems to drink in the surrounding light, no doubt the effect of a deadly enchantment.

一件棕色斗篷、粗糙的皮革与亚麻衣物裹着这名提夫林男子。他皮肤猩红，黑色犄角自额前向后掠去，藏在斗篷兜帽下，压住一头棕色卷发。他神情安宁，棕色眼眸失焦般望着前方，步履不停。右手握着一根虬结的木杖，背后斜挂木盾，宽阔的腰带上还别着数把匕首。空着的那只手牵着一头驴的缰绳——那驴披着皮制坐骑护甲。

~ Played by WxDan with

A brown cloak, rough leather, and linen clothing cover this tiefling man. He has scarlet skin, and black horns sweep back from his brow under his cloak’s hood, holding back brown curls. He has a peaceful look, his brown eyes unfocused as he walks. In his right hand, he carries a gnarled wooden staff, with a wooden shield slung on his back and several daggers tucked into his broad belt. His free hand holds the lead for a donkey arrayed in leather barding.

~ Played by WxDan with

Entering A Dark Mine In The Jungle.name:
踏入丛林中的黑暗矿井
Entering A Dark Mine In The Jungle

Text.text:
你踏入矿井时，气温骤降了好几度。清凉的空气让你从丛林令人窒息的酷热中得以喘息，微风裹着霉湿的泥土气息钻入鼻腔。身后的日光渐渐暗淡，仿佛你正一步步走进夜晚。一盏孤零零的提灯挂在支援横梁上，摇曳的光在岩壁间跳动，映亮蜿蜒的矿车轨道，伸向黑暗深处。
The temperature drops several degrees as you enter the mine. The cool air offers a welcome reprieve from the oppressive heat of the jungle, and a light wind brings a musty, earthen smell to your nostrils. As the daylight behind you fades, it’s almost as if you are walking into nighttime. A solitary lantern hangs from a support beam, casting a flickering light across the walls and reflecting off the mine cart track wending its way into the darkness.

一个矮小蹦跳的身影，满口挤满尖利獠牙——还顶着一对硕大尖耳——地精带着一股练就的戒备气息走近，怯意与凶狠的意图交织在一起。它的皮质护甲由阵亡同伴旧物的碎片东拼西凑而成，武器也在最走投无路的境地里被反复使用、修补得伤痕累累。在这个更强敌手遍地的危险世界中，地精是狡黠的幸存者……而有五个，就往往意味着有五十个。
A short, gamboling figure with a mouth overfull of pointed teeth—and enormous pointed ears—the goblin approaches with a practiced air of apprehension mixed with vicious intent. Its leather armor is cobbled together from scraps previously worn by its fallen fellows, and its weapons have seen heavy use and repair in the most desperate of conditions. In a dangerous world full of more powerful adversaries, the goblin is a cunning survivor… and where there are five, there are usually fifty.

这匹挽马的缎光皮毛下，庞大起伏的肌肉一阵阵滚动——它比城市里常见的骑乘马足足高出一整头。尽管体型惊人，这头役马却悠闲地嚼着一堆干草，间或甩动尾巴，驱走叮咬的马蝇。它这劳作之兽的鬃毛依旧浓密，却被草草修剪过，讲究的是速度而非细致或装饰。
Massive, heaving muscles shift under the satiny hide of the draft horse—a beast a full head taller than the riding horses usually seen in towns and cities. Despite its size, the workhorse munches idly at a pile of hay, occasionally swishing its tail to brush away horseflies. The mane of this beast of labor is full, but has been cut with an aim for speed rather than thoroughness or decoration.

你凝视着幽冥般的昏暗深渊，伸手撕扯那无形无质之物，在现实中扯开一道裂口。自墨黑虚空的深处，有什么在沉眠：一团未铸未形的力量，正静候降生。骇人的咆哮轰然灌满空气，一头爬行巨兽猛然破界而出——噩梦化为实形——双翼大张，挟雷霆之势撞入现实。
Peering into the umbral expanse, you rip and tug at the immaterial, tearing a hole in reality. From the depths of the inky void, something slumbers: an unmade, unformed mass of power, just waiting to be born. A horrifying roar fills the air as a reptilian bursts into being—a nightmare made manifest—thundering into reality with wings spread wide.

Evil Spellbook.name:
邪恶的法术书
Evil Spellbook

Text.text: [掩蔽] 深色、皱褶的粗硬皮肤片被缝合在一起，围着几块坚硬材质的板片，拼成这本巨著的外皮。两只人类手掌的骨骼被钉死在装订处，仿佛正捧着书本。它冰冷刺骨。 [内容] 一翻开，硫磺与铜腥味扑面而来。书页之中，亵渎的图阵与可怖的插画环绕着以某种恶魔文字写就的法术。所有内容都以猩红写成——墨水？ [Cover] Dark, wrinkled patches of rough skin have been sewn together around plates of some hard material to cover this tome. Bones from two human hands have been fastened to the binding as if cradling the book. It’s cold. [Content] When opened, it smells of brimstone and copper. Inside, profane diagrams and hideous illustrations accompany spells penned in some fiendish script. Everything is composed in crimson—ink?

Self-writing Quill And Inkwell.name:
自书羽毛笔与墨水瓶
Self-writing Quill And Inkwell

Text.text:
赤褐色的羽毛笔在羊皮纸上跳跃穿梭，蘸墨的笔尖滑移刮擦，在看不见任何手的操控下自行书写。一个巨大的墨水瓶——圆形的容器，饰纹繁复的青铜铸就，与这朴素的环境相比格外华丽——压着纸页，不让它卷起。
The tawny quill bounces across the parchment as its inked end scoots and scratches, writing without the aid of any visible hand. A large inkwell—a round vessel of embellished bronze, quite ornate compared to the plain surroundings—keeps the page from curling.

你面前这只古怪畸形的生物拥有放射对称的躯体；它的身架顶端张着一张布满利齿的巨口，巨口周围伸出三条长臂，其间点缀着三只眼睛。每条手臂末端都有三枚弯曲的利爪。它宽阔如岩石般的身躯，压在三条粗短的腿上。你心中的恐惧被错愕短暂压下，忍不住在心里自问：这他妈到底是什么东西？
The strange, misshapen creature before you has a radially symmetrical body, with a gaping, toothed maw atop its frame surrounded by three long arms interspersed with three eyes. Each arm ends in a trio of curving talons. Its wide, stone-like body rests upon three stumpy legs. Your fear is momentarily suppressed by bewilderment as you ask yourself: What the hell is this thing?

A Shadowy Dead Tree In The Moonlight.name:
月光下的阴森枯树
A Shadowy Dead Tree In The Moonlight

Text.text:
你面前的树枝在月光下投下不祥的阴影。它们像枯瘦的手臂与扭曲的手指般张开，铺满小径。忽然一阵风掠过，树身与影子随之挪移，伴着吱呀作响的呻吟，那些攫抓般的暗影仿佛在黑暗中不断向你触及，越逼越近。
The branches of the tree before you cast ominous shadows in the moonlight. Shapes like spindly arms and crooked fingers spread across the path. A gust of wind makes the tree and shadows shift, accompanied by a creaking groan, and the grasping shadows seem to reach ever closer in the dark.

起初，只是一声孤独而凄厉的长嗥掠过覆着薄雪的松林，很快便膨胀成狼群的交响，群狼对着头顶华美的月光齐声呼号。合唱不断蔓延，随着更多狼群加入呼唤，声浪愈发高涨，最终堆叠成回荡于原始森林深处的震颤高潮。
What begins as a solitary, keening howl across the snow-dusted pines, quickly grows into a lupine symphony as wolves cry out to the resplendent moon overhead. The chorus spreads, getting louder and louder as more packs join the call, building to a crescendo that resonates through the primal forest.

I Cast Temporal Divergence.name:
我施放「时序分歧」
I Cast Temporal Divergence

Text.text:
握住秘银的许愿骨，我吟诵咒文，眼前命运螺旋般的丝线徐徐展开。刹那间，未来清澈得如同俯瞰宁静海面的景致，我看见无数可能在我面前敞开——直到法术在一声清越的铃响中收束……而我必须选择自己的道路。
Holding the mithral wishbone, I chant the incantation and see the spiraling threads of fate unfold before me. For a moment, the future is as clear as the view over a tranquil sea, and I see the possibilities open to me, until the spell draws to a close with a chime… and I must choose my path.

High Elf Changing Appearance To Autumn.name:
高等精灵：外貌变作秋之姿
High Elf Changing Appearance To Autumn

Text.text:
秋之灵韵笼罩着这位精灵，他们的肌肤染上赭红与褐色交织的叶片质感。他们安宁得近乎冥想，愿意倾听，沉浸于炉火旁的恬静——那份从容映在慵懒的眼神与温柔的笑意里。

~ 由 Galvatron 构想

The aura of autumn envelops this elf, their skin taking on the leafy texture of russets and browns. They are peaceful nearly to the point of meditation, willing to listen, and given to the fireside calm—which shows in their languid eyes and gentle grin.

~ Envisioned by Galvatron

Adult Crystal Dragon.name:
成年水晶巨龙
Adult Crystal Dragon

Text.text:
在晨曦初绽的辉光里，一条巨龙立于突出的岩脊之巅，宛如幽影般的守望者，护持着水晶般的伟力，凝视着你的到来；它那独角熠熠生辉。半透明的鳞片折射阳光，孕出万花筒般的虹彩奇观。它的双眼如切割宝石，流溢奥秘的智慧，以不眨的强烈目光钉住你——钻石般的深处吞饮着你的一举一动。
In the brilliance of early morn, a dragon standing atop an outcrop of rock like a ghostly guardian of crystalline might, ponders your presence, its single horn glistening. Semi-transparent scales refract the sunlight, birthing a kaleidoscope of prismatic wonder. Eyes like faceted gems, radiating arcane wisdom, stare at you with unblinking intensity—their diamond depths drinking in your demeanor.

Vory V Zakone Punk.name:
法中贼朋克
Vory V Zakone Punk

Text.text: 她头顶炸着一撮凌乱的金发，其余的鬃发剃得只剩深色的短茬。耳机里不知在轰鸣什么曲子，她咬紧牙关，脑袋随着节拍疯狂点动。褪色的黑色牛仔马甲下，露出一条炽亮的热粉色抹胸；口袋边别针与锁链叮当垂挂，像勋章累累的老兵。马甲背后微微鼓起，像藏着什么。皮肤上有细若导线的压痕，从马甲后缘一路爬上颈侧，最终止于两侧太阳穴处闪烁的指示灯。她腹部纹着圣母玛利亚的画像，肚脐正落在圣母燃烧的心口。紧绷的黑色牛仔裤没入一双巨大的靴子里，每只靴侧都嚣张地露出一截匕首的灰色柄头。 A messy tuft of blond hair sprouts from the top of her head, the rest of her mane shaved down to dark stubble. She clenches her teeth as she bobs her head furiously to whatever music blares through her headphones. A hot-pink bandeau peeks out from under her faded black denim vest, pins and chains dangling from the pockets like the medals of a decorated soldier. Something makes her vest bulge slightly in the back. Wire-thin indents in her skin can be seen trailing from the back of the vest, up her neck, and ending at two blinking lights at her temples. An image of the Virgin Mary is tattooed over her stomach, her navel the site of the Madonna’s burning heart. Her skin-tight black jeans feed into massive boots, the gray hilts of daggers protruding brazenly from each one.

Artificer Attempting To Repair Dying Cyb.name:
奇械师正试图修复濒死的赛博格同伴
Artificer Attempting To Repair Dying Cyborg Companion

Text.text:
汗珠沿着工匠紧蹙的眉峰滚落，他们伏在受伤的义体同伴身旁忙碌不休。拳头猛地砸在工作台上，发明家却轻柔地托住朋友的头颅，让自己从那场为让义体存活而不断挣扎的鏖战里，偷得片刻喘息。两人的目光相触，你看见他们之间无需言说的对话——神情把言语说不尽的一切，都说了出来。

~ 由 EVERBOT 在 Discord 上 构想

Sweat beads across the artificer’s furrowed brow as they work, crouched over their injured cyborg companion. They slam their fist on the workbench, and the inventor gently cradles their friend’s head, allowing themselves a moment of respite from the constant struggle to keep the cyborg alive. Their eyes meet, and you watch the unspoken conversation between them, their expressions saying what words cannot.

~ Envisioned by EVERBOT on Discord

The Sanctuary: Stone Bridge Over Lazy Ri.name:
避难所：横跨缓流的石桥
The Sanctuary: Stone Bridge Over Lazy River

Text.text:
覆满青苔的石块自缓缓流淌的河流两岸突起，在水面上方相接，拱成一道优雅却饱经岁月磨洗的弧桥。两岸沿线长着一圈芦苇，渐渐过渡为时令草甸植物，将野花的甜香轻轻送入空气中。一小群红雀围聚在一片向日葵旁，啄食着葵籽。
Moss-covered stones rise from both banks of the lazily-flowing river, meeting above the water in a graceful but well-worn arch. The shores are lined with reeds, which transition into seasonal meadow plants that grace the air with the sweet fragrance of wildflowers. A small group of cardinals flock around a patch of sunflowers, harvesting the seeds.

漫长的步道铺着龟裂、覆满沙砾的地砖，其上刻绘着取材于古史的纹样。步道两侧排列着一连串小平台。内脏、随身之物、武器与宠物，皆交付给技艺娴熟的殓葬师之手；他们正为这具受敬的遗体做准备，好让它沿着冥界的暗流启程，漂向灵魂的休息。
The long walkway is set with cracked and sand-strewn tiles bearing historically inspired designs. It is bordered by a sequence of small platforms. Organs, possessions, weapons, and pets are each committed to the hands of skillful morticians preparing the honored body for its trip along the current of the underworld to its soul’s rest.

那片由泥土与岩石构成的利维坦般巨块高悬天际，从头顶掠过时遮蔽了太阳。漂浮的陆块上，一座设防城堡的城墙、雉堞与塔楼拔地而起，仿佛一座石砌要塞被人从地基上硬生生扯起，像从花园里拔出的杂草。浮空城堡的阴影在大地上缓缓滑行。

~ 由 Envisioned 受 MrRhexx 委托构想

The leviathan mass of earth and stone looms high above, eclipsing the sun as it passes overhead. The walls, parapets, and turrets of a fortified castle rise from the floating landmass, evoking the image of a stone fortress yanked from its foundations like a weed from a garden. The shadow of the floating castle travels across the landscape.

~ Envisioned by MrRhexx

I Cast Allergen Dissipation.name:
我施放《过敏原消散》
I Cast Allergen Dissipation

Text.text:
我猛地伸出双手，千丝万缕的银色微光骤然迸裂而出。那些光尘被无形的过敏源牵引着汇聚过去，抓住它们的瞬间便染上狡黠的猩红。随即，它们在一阵火花雨中消散为无。 我深吸一口气，空气仿佛轻了些，也更清透、更洁净。

~ 设想：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

I thrust out my hands and a thousand flecks of silvery light burst forth. The motes gravitate toward the unseeable allergens, turning a devilish red as they grab on to them. They dissipate to nothing in a shower of sparks. I breathe in, and the air feels lighter, cleaner.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Heavy Rain In The Forest With Awakened T.name:
在觉醒之树的森林里，暴雨如注
Heavy Rain In The Forest With Awakened Trees

Text.text:
雨水穿透林冠，顽强地一层层压下，滴落声汇成一曲激昂的交响。骤雨抵达下方的林地，在树根间汇成细小的溪流与水洼。倾盆大雨迫使各色生灵纷纷躲藏。啮齿动物与鸟类蜷缩在树洞里，皮毛与羽翼蓬起，抵御潮湿。狐狸尖叫着窜向洞穴。鹿群小心翼翼地挪动，长长的睫毛不停眨动，拂去水珠，一边啃食树皮与叶片。

有的生物藏匿不出，也有的在雨中苏醒。森林深处，一些树干开始颤动。它们从湿软的泥土中拔根而起，伸展着裹满泥浆的根须，树干上的瘤结像眼睑般张开，露出一双双鲜亮的翠绿眼眸。它们抖落叶片，弯下枝桠，让雨水淋遍它们的每一寸身躯。

There is a rousing symphony of drops as rain presses in tenacious sheets through the canopy. The shower reaches the forest floor below, creating little rivers and wells at the roots of trees. The downpour sends all manner of creatures into hiding. Rodents and birds huddle in the hollows of trees, fur and feathers puffed to stave off the dampness. Foxes scurry and yelp to their burrows. Deer move gingerly in their small herds, blinking away water with their long lashes as they nibble away at bark and leaves.

While some creatures hide away, others stir into life. Throughout the forest, some of the tree trunks shudder. They uproot from the dampened soil, stretching their soil-caked tendrils, the knots on their trunks opening as lids to reveal vibrant green eyes. They shake their leaves and bend their boughs, allowing the rain to shower every inch of them.

I Scale The Side Of A Building.name:
我沿着大楼外墙攀爬上去
I Scale The Side Of A Building

Text.text:
我把脚楔进三楼窗台，借力稳住，随即全身发力向阳台猛蹿而上。手指死死扣住栏杆，双臂在瞬间承受全身重量，疼痛猛地窜起；直到我终于把脚掌顶在外墙光滑的石面上，才得以稳住身形。
I wedge my foot against the third-floor windowsill, gaining purchase, and launch myself bodily upward towards the balcony. My fingers cling to a railing, and I feel a jolt of pain as my arms take my full weight for a moment before I can plant my feet against the smooth stone of the outer wall.

Werewolf Head Mounted On Wall.name:
狼人头颅被钉在墙上
Werewolf Head Mounted On Wall

Text.text:
一颗怪物般的狼头被钉挂在墙上，面孔被塑成骇人的狞笑。它的牙齿可怖至极——既有狼的獠牙，也杂着人的臼齿；浓密的眉弓沉沉压在玻璃眼上，灰色的虹膜死寂冰冷，像残酷寒冬清晨的霜光。  

“它不是真的。”猎人解释道，“但我喜欢把它摆在窗前。被嘲弄会让他们发怒。”  

他干巴巴地笑了两声，随后用粗糙的手拍了拍那颗填充好的头颅。锯末的灰尘飘散落下，沉到地板上。
A monstrous wolf’s head is mounted on the wall, face fashioned into a dreadful snarl. Its teeth are a horrid mix of wolfish fangs and human molars and its bushy brow hangs heavy over glass eyes, grey irises as dead and cold as a morning of a cruel winter. “It’s not real,” explains the hunter. “But I like to keep it in front of the window. Makes them angry to be mocked.” He chuckles dryly before patting the stuffed head with a rough hand. Sawdust clouds descend to the floor.

这只木盒里，放着一具钢与黄铜打造的六分仪、一对钢制卡钳，以及一根钢制量杆。布垫托着一枚磁石罗盘，外壳为黄铜与玻璃所制。旁边还有一支精细的铅笔尖、几支笔与墨水。器具下方压着地图与空白羊皮纸。
In this wooden case are a sextant of steel and brass, steel calipers, and a steel measuring rod. A cloth pads a lodestone compass housed in brass and glass. Beside it are a fine lead stylus, pens, and ink. Under the instruments are maps and blank parchment.

I Use My Bolas.name:
我抛出我的流星索
I Use My Bolas

Text.text:
我以稳定的节奏移动，将加重的流星锤在头顶旋转，借着惯性为投掷蓄势。我眯起眼，衡量与逃窜的目标之间的距离——把他们的速度也算进去——随即松手掷出。
Moving with a steady rhythm, I swing the weighted bolas above my head, gathering momentum for my throw. I narrow my eyes as I judge the distance to my fleeing target—accounting for their speed—and then release.

像这样的护甲，通常要用国王的赎金才能换来。那些量身定制并加以华饰的——比如君王身上的板甲——开出的价格，足以买回君主与其随从的自由。眼前这套护甲显得朴素得多。尽管打造它无疑耗时费工、代价高昂，但看起来并非为某个特定穿戴者而生，更像是制甲师按常规打造的成品。 A suit of armor such as this usually costs a king’s ransom. Those that are custom-made and decorated, like the plate armor worn by a king, can fetch a price that might buy the freedom of the monarch and their retinue. This armor looks more modest. Though no doubt time-consuming and expensive to make, it appears to be a suit that would have been produced without any particular wearer in mind.

Investigating Loot In A Shipyard.name:
在船坞调查战利品
Investigating Loot In A Shipyard

Text.text:
层层堆叠的木箱垒成参差不齐的墙面，外沿钉着锯切木板的饰条，铁钉泛着冷光。其间蹲着一只涂了油的柚木箱，像个迷路的阔绰游客，被一圈老练强悍的水手围在中间。箱内斜伸出一卷羊皮纸，颜色如风化的皮革。纸卷从盖下的缝隙里露出仅一指宽，卡住了扣锁，让它无法合上。也许那只是张货运清单，可它读起来却像是在邀请你伸手翻一翻……
Stacked crates form uneven walls with a fascia of sawn wood and iron nails. A trunk of oiled teak squats among them, a lost, rich tourist surrounded by toughened mariners. From it juts a rolled parchment the color of weathered hide. A finger’s width of it protrudes from the gap beneath the lid, keeping the latch from engaging. Perhaps it’s just a shipping manifest, but it reads like an invitation to poke around…

Secret Passage In A Dungeon.name:
地城中的密道
Secret Passage In A Dungeon

Text.text:
你的手指沿着墙面摸索，触到一串突起的小石子。你按下去时，它们发出轻微的咔哒声，墙上有一条狭窄的部分悄然滑开，露出一条窄小的通道。新出现的走廊被黑暗裹覆，里面飘来一股霉湿的陈腐气味。
As your fingers trace along the wall, you find a sequence of protruding pebbles. They click softly as you press down, and a slim portion of the wall slides away, revealing a narrow passage. This new corridor is swathed in darkness, with a musty smell wafting from within.

Lady Aurelei Gavrayn.name:
奥蕾蕾·加弗雷恩夫人
Lady Aurelei Gavrayn

Text.text:
加夫雷恩女士退到一旁，从容地以森林般的绿眸注视着周遭的行动。她将一缕波浪状的红发轻轻别到耳后，你注意到她的耳尖微微尖翘。她装备齐全：一身铆钉皮甲，一柄匕首与一把利刃。她装束中最夺目的，是一件由柔和的橙、红、黄交织而成的斗篷——仿佛以秋叶缝制而成。

~ Played by DocMysterio

The Lady Gavrayn stands out of the way, calmly watching the activity about her with forest-green eyes. She brushes a strand of her wavy red hair behind her ear, which you notice is slightly pointed. She is well-equipped with her suit of studded leathers, a dagger, and a blade. The most striking feature of her attire is a cloak of soft oranges, reds, and yellows: a cloak that seems to be made of autumn leaves.

~ Played by DocMysterio

Humanoid Spider Mage.name:
人形蛛魔法师
Humanoid Spider Mage

Text.text:
数只蛛形眼睛那黝黑而油亮的眼珠闪烁着奥术之力；法师以四只带爪的手编织法术，仿佛在掌间拉起一张纠缠的能量蛛网。獠牙咔嗒作响，满怀期待；披袍的身影用一种无法理解的语言开始吟诵，随着魔法层层堆叠，将那僵硬的猩红血肉映照出鲜明夺目的色彩。
The dark, glossy orbs of several arachnid eyes glimmer with arcane power as the mage weaves their spell like a tangled web of energy between their four clawed hands. Fangs clicking with anticipation, the robed figure begins to chant in an incomprehensible language as the magic builds, casting their rigid scarlet flesh in vivid hues.

Corporate Transport Drone In Hangar.name:
机库内的企业运输无人机
Corporate Transport Drone In Hangar

Text.text:
令人印象深刻的运输无人机停在机库里，像一只巨型甲虫。它流线型的机身与八个巨大的旋翼，昭示着敏捷与速度。复合推进系统让它既能执行远程任务，也能承担短途飞行。凭借庞大的货舱、先进的传感器与摄像头，以及GPS避障技术，它成了那些无力承担传送方案的企业的中流砥柱。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The impressive transport drone sits in the hanger like a gargantuan beetle. Its aerodynamic body and eight large rotors shout both agility and speed. The compound propulsion system allows for both long-distance missions and short-haul flights. With a massive hold, advanced sensors and cameras, and GPS obstacle avoidance tech, it's the mainstay of corporations unable to afford teleportation options.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

肌肉绷紧，目光交锁，拥挤的酒馆里仿佛能摸到的紧张感悄然攀升——喧嚣与笑闹忽然被一段令人窒息的停顿取代。年轻的矮人抬起那顶磨旧的三角帽帽檐——它用与他那身伤痕累累的护甲同样的皮革制成——在浓长的赤褐胡须下露出一抹笑意，这个动作牵动了他脸颊上的疤痕。只见他随意伸手，摸向身侧一把做工精绝的鲁特琴，开始调音。指尖轻轻拨动琴弦，他起身而立，人群的视线紧跟着他每一个细微的动作。“各位，晚上好。今晚咱们是用脚跳舞，还是用拳头？”

~ 扮演：隐士

Muscles tense, eyes lock, and a palpable tension builds in the crowded tavern as a pregnant pause replaces the general hubbub and merriment. Tipping up the brim of his worn tricorn hat—crafted from the same leather as his battered armor—the young dwarf smiles beneath his long auburn beard, the gesture tugging at the scar on his cheek. Casually reaching for an exceptionally crafted lute at his side, he begins to tune it. Softly plucking the strings, he stands, the crowd following his every move. “Good evenin’, everyone. Are we dancin’ with feet or fists tonight?”

~ Played by The Hermit

Gregarious Star-pilot.name:
善于交际的星际飞行员
Gregarious Star-pilot

Text.text:
“问候诸位！”一声欢快的高喊压过了船坞的喧嚣。声音来自一个头发狂乱、衣着昂贵的男人——整个人乱得很讲究，像是精心布置过的凌乱。“先生，您有没有碰巧见过我的飞船？一艘线条流畅的小家伙，绿金配色？我不太记得昨晚把它停在哪儿了。”他看向离自己最近的男人。那名路人对飞行员敞开的胸口毛投去一眼困惑的目光，随即摇摇头，匆匆离开。飞行员毫不在意，目光已在拥挤的人群中游弋，寻找下一个目标。
"Salutations!" The cheery shout overpowers the din of the ship bay. The source is a man with wild hair and expensive clothing in a state of tastefully arranged disarray. "Good sir, you haven't happened to see my ship, have you? Sleek little thing, green and gold? I can't remember where I docked it last night." He looks at the man closest to him. The passerby gives the pilot's exposed chest hair a look of general confusion before shaking his head and hurrying away. The pilot looks unperturbed, already scanning the crowd for his next target.

Hill Giant With Club.name:
持棒山丘巨人
Hill Giant With Club

Text.text:
这名巨人如同此地的泰坦，原始蛮力铸成的活山岳；它每一步踏过，都投下可触可感的威胁阴影。粗如树干的巨臂轻而易举地抡起一根巨大而伤痕累累的木棒。它那粗砺如岩的皮肤上刻满疤痕，双眼因旧伤之痛而蒙上一层灰白的浑浊——这名敌手绝不会轻易倒下。
This giant stands as a titan in the region, a living mountain of primal might casting a shadow of palpable threat where it strides. Enormous, tree-trunk limbs heft a massive, battered club easily. Its rugged, stone-like skin is emblazoned with scars, its eyes glazed with the pain of old wounds—this foe will not go down easily.

Forest Birds: Taking Flight.name:
森林鸟群：振翼起飞
Forest Birds: Taking Flight

Text.text:
狂风卷过，林木被吹得呻吟作响；一大群鸟掠过枝叶间仅剩的天光，所见之处皆为昏暗。你始终无法看清那些扑闪着羽翼的生灵，只听见它们的尖叫从四面八方触及你耳畔——喧嚣紧随数千微小身躯投下的破碎阴影，一路追逐不散。
Strong winds set the trees to groaning, and a huge flock of birds darkens what sky you can see through the branches. You never get a clear view of the flitting, feathery creatures, but their cries reach you from all around, the noise following the fractured shadow thrown by thousands of tiny bodies.

Loot From An Archangel.name:
来自大天使的战利品
Loot From An Archangel

Text.text:
大天使的圣武与它的尸身一同休息——致命的器具，却已对这位天界之灵毫无用处。一柄巨剑，八尺长的渐收钢刃，金色血槽流淌其间，护手如舒展的羽翼，映着太阳般的辉光。另一柄金色长柄刀沿杆身镌刻着神圣经文，刃口如一缕新月的银辉般闪烁。
The archangel’s holy weapons rest alongside its corpse—deadly instruments, but of no use to the celestial now. A greatsword, an eight-foot length of tapered steel with a golden fuller and a guard shaped like unfurled wings, gleams with solar radiance. A golden glaive is etched with sacred script along its length, the blade gleaming like a sliver of crescent moon.

I Wash In A River.name:
我在河里洗涤
I Wash In A River

Text.text:
我浸入清凉的河水里，脚下是被水磨得光滑的卵石。我在水下停留了很久，任由温柔的水流从身旁牵引而过。我用力搓洗，尽可能把身上的泥垢与污秽都洗去，直到不得不换一口气。终于我探出水面呼吸，河水从脸颊倾泻而下，清冽地拂过，像一记令人振奋的轻抚。
I dip into the cool river, feeling the smooth stones beneath my feet. I remain underwater for a long moment, allowing the gentle current to pull past me. I scrub away, removing as much of the dirt and grime from myself as I can before I need to take a breath. I finally come up for air, the water cascading down my face in a refreshing caress.

这柄双面矮人战锤粗壮的锤柄上，镶着一颗不知何种造型的威严锤首，由净化并祝圣过的花岗岩雕琢而成。尽管从未有法师之手触及，其精工之意仍一眼可见——打造时涂抹了特制的油膏，并施以祝福，使其获得如纯净精金般的坚韧与耐久。
An imposing head of some sort of cleaned and consecrated granite adorns the thick shaft of this double-faced dwarvish warhammer. Though no wizardly hands have touched it, it is obvious that great care was taken in its construction, with specific oils and blessings laid upon it to grant it the strength and durability of pure adamant.

Fire-breathing Statue Trap.name:
喷火雕像陷阱
Fire-breathing Statue Trap

Text.text:
[察觉]  一缕淡淡的焦烟味让你骤然止步，你下意识低头看向脚下——你的靴尖离一块疑似压板的机关仅差寸许。你环顾四周，捕捉到以往起火的痕迹：煤烟的黑痕与细灰。它们似乎都从那尊雕像方向蔓延而来。

[触发！]  你脚下的地面微微一沉，伴随着清晰可闻的咔哒一声。你只来得及眨眼闭上，下一瞬，火焰自雕像中喷薄而出，轰然咆哮着在你周身炸开。

[Perceived]  A faint smell of smoke stops you in your tracks, and you reflexively glance at your feet. They are inches away from what seems to be a pressure plate. Glancing around, you spy signs of previous fires: soot stains and ash. They seem to extend from the statue.

[Triggered!]  The floor shifts beneath your foot with an audible click. You only have enough time to blink your eyes closed as flames erupt from the statue, explosively roaring around you.

Amalae The Half-elf College Of Lore Bard.name:
阿玛莱——半精灵传说学院吟游诗人
Amalae The Half-elf College Of Lore Bard

Text.text:
半精灵灵巧的手指在鲁特琴弦上疾驰般跳动，娴熟地拨出一段简洁却悦耳的旋律，随即层层推进，攀升为一阵密集飞旋的和弦风暴。他们一边演奏一边移动，修长轻盈的身姿即便披着皮质护甲，也能定格出充满张力的动态姿态。高亢而婉转的歌声随之加入合鸣，自鲁特琴的旋律间绽放而出，宛如花开，抬升、交织、和声相拥。演奏间，一抹诡异的微光缠绕在半精灵周身，自震颤的琴弦向外流淌，直至笼罩整个阶段，继而覆上四周的观众。

~ Played by Tyler from RPGBOT.net

The half-elf's nimble fingers race deftly across the strings of the lute, plucking out a simple yet pleasant tune that crescendos into a flurry of chords. They move as they play, their lithe form striking a dynamic pose even in their leather armor. Their high, lilting voice joins the chorus, emerging from the lute's melody like a blooming flower, lifting and harmonizing. A strange glimmer surrounds the half-elf as they play, flowing outward from the vibrating lute strings until it encompasses the entirety of the stage, and then the surrounding audience.

~ Played by Tyler from RPGBOT.net

半身人哼了一声算作招呼。你看见他齿间叼着几根笔直的别针，绕着一具人体模特打着圈忙活；一匹布料被别在模特肩头，垂落成形。他腰带上别着一把锃亮、磨得锋利的钢剪。作坊的墙边还摆着其他模特，身上套着半成品的衣裳，做工参差不齐。
The halfling grunts a greeting, and you can see he is holding several straight pins between his teeth as he moves radially around a mannequin with a bolt of cloth pinned up over its shoulders. A shiny pair of well-sharpened steel scissors is tucked into his belt. Other mannequins rest along the walls of the workshop, dressed in half-finished garments of varying quality.

Quip By A Confused Half-orc.name:
困惑的半兽人插科打诨
Quip By A Confused Half-orc

Text.text:
“嗯，我爸总说要用你希望别人对待你的方式去对待别人。至于我妈……她肯定也说过点什么，只是隔着满口咆哮和羊肉味儿，很难听清，但我觉得意思也差不多。”
“Well, my dad always said to treat others like you want to be treated, and mom… She definitely said something, it was hard to tell through all the growling and mutton, but I think it was along the same lines.”

酒保瞪着你，哼了一声，把一大杯翻涌着泡沫的麦酒推到你面前。壁炉里的火焰轻轻噼啪作响，将他那张布满疤痕的脸映衬得轮廓分明；你的目光掠过他粗犷的五官，不由揣测那些愈合伤口背后藏着怎样的故事。他那黝黑的手臂粗壮如树干，筋肉虬结，在擦拭一只啤酒杯时隆起成绷紧的线条——而你也注意到吧台后方柜子里，陈列着几件令人好奇的战利品。
The bartender glowers at you as he pushes forth a mug of foaming ale with a grunt. The fire softly crackling in the hearth casts his scarred face in striking relief as your eyes roam over his rugged countenance, wondering at the story behind the healed wounds. Swarthy arms, thick as tree trunks, bulge with corded muscle as he sets to polishing a tankard—and you notice some curious trophies in the cabinet behind the bar.

Quip About Numbers By A Dumb Character.name:
一个笨角色的数字吐槽
Quip About Numbers By A Dumb Character

Text.text:
“聪明人总爱念叨数字。一天还剩多少数字，命还剩多少数字。我不想知道。谁都不该想知道。”
“Smart people always going on about numbers. How many numbers left in day, how many left in life. Don’t want to know. No one should want to know.”

Vial Of Perfume.name:
香水小瓶
Vial Of Perfume

Text.text:
这只精巧的小瓶由一滴泪珠般的半透明玻璃吹制而成，向下收束成短短的圆柱瓶颈。瓶口并不平齐，一侧特意削成便于精准倾注的弧沿。抛光锡环扣在瓶颈上，连着链条与软木塞相接。瓶中隐隐逸出一缕淡甜的香气。
A teardrop-shaped bulb of translucent glass tapers to a short cylindrical stem to form this fine vial. Its mouth is uneven, one side shaped for precise pouring. A loop of polished tin connects to a chained cork stopper. A faint sweet scent emanates from it.

Haunted House: Spare Bedroom.name:
闹鬼宅邸：备用卧室
Haunted House: Spare Bedroom

Text.text:
这间显然是空置的卧室，一面墙边摆着一张双人床，旁侧有一扇不大却够用的窗户，玻璃上覆着污垢与蛛网。室内陈设寥寥，除了门对面的一座壁炉几乎别无他物。然而，壁炉工具似乎曾被以骇人的力道——且令人不安的精准——掷向墙上的一面镀釉镜子。镜子已然碎裂，但那根拨火棍整整刺入墙体支撑四英寸，将其牢牢钉在原处。正当你开始怀疑你们之中是否连最强壮的人也无法把它拔出来时，它竟开始颤动、抖震，仿佛被一只怪物般的巨拳死死攥住。
This apparently spare bedroom has a double bed against one wall, near a small but serviceable window covered in grime and cobwebs. There are few amenities save for a fireplace opposite the door. However, it appears that the fireplace tools have been hurled with stunning force—and unnerving accuracy—into a glazed mirror on the wall. The mirror has shattered, but the poker, driven a full four inches into the wall’s brace, pins it in place. Just as you begin to wonder if even the strongest among you could pull the instrument free, it begins to shiver and shake, as if gripped by a monstrous fist.

Milliner Or Hatmaker Shop.name:
制帽师铺子
Milliner Or Hatmaker Shop

Text.text:
你踏入这间昏暗的店铺，立刻感到空气逼仄，鼻端尽是毡呢与皮革的气味。窗户被架子上的帽子半遮半掩，烛火吊灯垂在唯一留出的空处上方——地板中央的一块地毯，一张深色枫木柜台托着一面镜子。靠近账簿的针垫旁放着粉笔和量尺用的细绳。帽子从朴素的窄檐打蜡雨帽，到巨大、缀羽的华丽头饰一应俱全，价格贵得足以买下一栋小宅。
You can feel the close air, smell felt and leather, as you enter the dim shop. The windows are partly blocked by hats on stands and a chandelier of candles hangs over the only open place—the rug in the middle of the floor with a dark maple counter supporting a mirror. Chalk and string for measuring sit by a pin cushion near the ledger. The hats range from simple-brimmed waxed hats for keeping off the rain to giant, feathered fascinators the price of a small house.

Mayor's Speech About Successful City Def.name:
市长关于成功守城的演讲
Mayor's Speech About Successful City Defense

Text.text:
“我的朋友们，历经数日的恐怖与黑暗，我很荣幸地告诉诸位：我们已将噩梦从城墙边击退，它们的队伍如今横陈在地，血污遍身，支离破碎。为此，我欠下你们一笔永远偿还不起的债。你们展现出的胆识与勇气，远超任何将军或国王能向最凶悍的战士索求的极限……然而，我们的挣扎尚未结束。当你们选择我来引领这座城时，我曾寄望我的任期将是和平与繁荣，但命运并不允诺。相反，我必须提出那近乎不可思议的请求：再次整备，迎战。我们的城墙已裂，我们的家园被灼成焦黑，但这座城的心仍在跳动。我们必须重建，我们必须再度武装，我们必须为前方的苦战做好准备。可只要我们守住，只要我们再多战斗一阵子，我保证，我们孩子唯一的烦恼将是爱与安逸，而非堡垒与鲜血。”

~ Envisioned by Redfang

“My friends, after days of horror and darkness it is my privilege to tell you we have beaten back the nightmares from our walls and their number lies bloodied and broken. For this I owe you a debt I can never repay. You have shown courage and bravery far beyond what any general or king could ask from their fiercest warriors… Yet, our struggle is not over. When you chose me to lead this city, I had hoped my term would be one of peace and prosperity, but this was not to be. Instead, I must ask the unthinkable: to ready for battle once more. Our walls are cracked, our homes scorched, but the heart of this city remains. We must rebuild, we must re-arm, and we must prepare for the struggle that lies ahead. But if we hold, if we fight just a little longer, I promise that our children’s only concerns will be of love and comfort and not fortifications and blood.”

~ Envisioned by Redfang

Loot From A Green Dracolich.name:
来自绿龙巫妖的战利品
Loot From A Green Dracolich

Text.text:
在一座矮而宽的黑玉基座上，安放着两颗巨人的颅骨。其中一颗颅骨的左眼眶里，硬生生嵌着一枚硕大的缟玛瑙；另一颗的右眼眶中，则镶着同样夺目的翡翠。每颗宝石下方，都渗出一股浓稠而病态的幽绿液体。
On a short, broad pedestal of jet sit the skulls of two giants. Jammed into the left eye socket of one skull is a massive onyx. In the right eye socket of the other is an equally spectacular jade. A thick, sickly green liquid oozes from under each of the jewels.

Abandoned Lunatic Asylum: Haunted.name:
废弃疯人院：闹鬼
Abandoned Lunatic Asylum: Haunted

Text.text:
那声音又一次响起，清晰得仿佛她就在同一间屋里，可你无需回头也知道此处空无一人。那看不见的女人倾诉着对母亲的爱意，可字里行间还裹着恐惧与哀伤。你隐约感觉，她生前说出这些话时，根本无人倾听。
The voice comes again, as clearly as if she were in the same room, but you need not look to know no one is there. The unseen woman expresses love for her mother, but you hear fear and sadness too. You sense that when she spoke those words in life, they went unheard.

Fake Signet Ring.name:
伪造的印戒
Fake Signet Ring

Text.text:
印戒的戒面雕着一枚印章，远远看去几可乱真——却偏偏有个致命破绽。若将戒面按入热蜡，压出的印记会是反的。此印戒显然是拙劣而粗心的赝品。
The head of the signet ring is carved with a seal that, from a distance, looks genuine—save for one vital flaw. If the head were pressed into hot wax, the seal would be printed in reverse. This signet ring seems to be an obvious, careless forgery.

I Cast Armor Of Shadows.name:
我施放暗影护甲
I Cast Armor Of Shadows

Text.text:
我双腿大开站稳，双臂平举，掌心向前，向我的宗主祈求庇护。阴影如烟般蜷曲缠绕，绕着我盘旋；它们交织成覆在身上的暗幕与护甲般的甲片，完成使命便在一声轻不可闻的呢喃中隐去。唯有一阵低沉的嗡鸣仍在——几乎难以察觉，却是我魔法防护尚存的微弱证明。
In a wide-legged stance, arms held out with palms forward, I invoke my patron for protection. Shadows curl around me like smoke. They weave themselves into sheets and plates around my body, disappearing in a whisper when their work is done. A low hum remains—barely perceptible evidence of my magical defenses.

Mom-and-pop Mediterranean Bistro.name:
家庭式地中海小馆
Mom-and-pop Mediterranean Bistro

Text.text:
立式旋转烤架低低呻吟着，缓慢转动着一整块油光发亮的肉。肉汁沿着丰腴的层理滴落，滋滋作响，蒸腾出辛香馥郁的气味。店主——一名男人和他的儿子，顶着同样一团卷曲的黑发——几乎全程默不作声地忙碌。偶尔，男人会转头用不容置疑的语气对儿子说上几句，他们手下粗利地剁着洋葱、辣椒和番茄。一名带着暖意笑容、装着一只义体眼的女人在柜台前迎客；那矮小的台子与小馆里其他简朴的家具一样，都是那种薄而发响的金属做的。“要几份？”女人问道，她眨眼时，那只非人的眼睛发出轻微的嗡鸣，数字在她眼角外侧如流水般不断滚动，几乎被她长长的睫毛遮住。
The vertical rotisserie groans a bit as it slowly spins a slab of beautifully glistening meat. Juices drip down between succulent layers, sizzling and emitting a well-spiced aroma. The owners—a man and his son both with a similar mop of curling black hair—work in almost total silence. Every so often, the man turns to speak to his son in firm tones as they roughly chop onions, peppers, and tomatoes. A woman with a warm smile and one cybernetic eye greets customers at a short podium made of the same tinny metal as the rest of the simple furniture of this bistro. “How many?” asks the woman, her inhuman eye whirring as she blinks, numbers running in a constant stream near the outward corner of her eye, nearly hidden by her long lashes.

Arcane Academy District.name:
奥术学院区
Arcane Academy District

Text.text:
三座高塔以绝对的对称矗立，各据一方，围出一座三角形的庭院；地面是闪耀如镜的石材，光泽冷冽。空气中电光般的能量游走，你一走近，周身细汗毛便纷纷竖起。这里的魔法浓得几乎可见——哪怕从未涉足其秘的人，也会在第一瞬间心知肚明。每座塔的彩绘玻璃窗上，都描着披袍人影在不同姿态下施法，绚色之下掩藏着其中传授的奥术与诡秘真知。诡异的是，三座塔竟看不见任何入口——只有光滑、坚不可摧的石壁。忽然，一道门扉凭空出现，仿佛被无形刻刀从最右侧高塔的石面上镌刻出来；门户开启，一群披袍学生鱼贯而出，各自抱着成摞的皮革封面巨著，身旁还跟着形形色色的古怪魔宠。
A trio of towers stands in perfect symmetry, each occupying a point of a triangular courtyard of gleaming stone. The air is alight with energy, and the fine hairs on your body stand on end as you draw close. Magic is prevalent here—even those not practiced in its secrets know this immediately. The stained glass windows of each tower, depicting robed figures in various states of spellcasting, conceal the arcane and eldritch secrets taught within. Strangely, each tower appears devoid of any kind of entrance—only smooth, impenetrable stone. Suddenly, a gate appears, etching itself into the stone of the rightmost tower, and from the portal a series of robed students emerge, each carrying stacks of leather-bound tomes and accompanied by all manner of strange familiars.

你所熟悉、总与酒馆相伴的喧嚣呼喊与嘲笑，在这里竟无迹可寻。你踏入门内，担心他们已经打烊，但不——这屋里其实相当热闹。大多数桌子都坐满了人，一名酒保在酒馆里悄然游走——鞋底落地不发出半点声响——偶尔俯身，低声与某位客人说话，随即又回到吧台斟酒。壁炉被一面染色屏风遮住，坩埚里炖着的浓汤只逸出一缕淡淡的土豆与胡萝卜气息。所有人似乎都对这份安静、这片昏暗、以及近乎无香的空气感到心满意足。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The raucous shouts and jeers you’ve come to associate with taverns are nowhere to be heard here. You step inside, worried that they may be closed, but no—the room is actually quite lively. Most of the tables are occupied, and a barkeep slinks around the tavern—their shoes making not a sound—occasionally leaning down and speaking quietly with a patron before returning to the bar to pour drinks. The hearth is shielded by a tinted screen, and the stew cooking in the cauldron releases only a faint scent of potato and carrots. Everyone seems perfectly content with the quiet, the dimness, and the lack of fragrance.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

号角长达十三英尺，由云杉木分段拼接而成，自玩家唇边垂落，宛如大象的长鼻。弯曲的号口以一根小支架撑在地面上；在弧形木身的肘部，朝向天空处，绘着一枚家族纹章。这支号角吐出的，是山坡深处那低沉的嗓音。
The horn is thirteen feet in length and assembled in sections from the wood of a spruce, sloping down from the player’s lips like an elephant’s trunk. The curved bell rests on the ground on a little strut, and in the elbow of the curved wood, facing the sky, a family crest is painted. From this horn comes the deep voice of the mountainside.

Plain Iron Brooch.name:
朴素铁胸针
Plain Iron Brooch

Text.text:
这枚胸针以粗犷的火工锻造勾勒出一张狰狞巨面的轮廓，宛如宣告般彰显着阴暗的权势。那枚造型险恶的别针总爱从胸针的柄部摆荡而下，落到仿佛悬垂利刃般的位置。
Roughly fire-worked into the shape of a monstrous face, this brooch is a statement of dark power. The dangerously shaped pin has a tendency to swing from the brooch's handle into the position of a hanging blade.

Sundries From A Zombie Ogre.name:
丧尸食人魔的杂物
Sundries From A Zombie Ogre

Text.text:
魁梧的尸体轰然砸落在地，十几处伤口里猛地喷涌出腥臭恶毒的脓血。你瞥见一个几乎腐烂殆尽的挎包，绑在生物的腹部。你翻开一看，里面是食人魔上一顿残餐的朽烂骨头、几颗类人生物的头骨，以及一把铁钉和一只木槌。
The hulking corpse crashes to the ground, erupting vile, pungent ichor from a dozen wounds. You spot a satchel, almost rotted to oblivion, tied to the creature’s abdomen. Inside, you find the moldering bones of the ogre’s last meal, several humanoid skulls, and some iron nails with a wooden mallet.

God Of Knowledge.name:
知识之神
God Of Knowledge

Text.text:
这位神祇或化作抱着鲁特琴、唱着古老传说的歌者，或化作光头小丑，挥舞着铃铛法杖，肩挎一袋书卷，向深渊放声大笑。祂以欢快的曲调盛满智慧，公然嘲弄智识的忧郁。祂吟诵万古诗篇，用轻柔而令人信服的语调教导孩童。作为吟游诗人的曲库、史学家的记忆仓藏，祂列举事实，点名掷骰，将数学与其丈量的世界融为一体。当祂奏响理解之乐，低吟历史的词句后，便深深一鞠躬，摘下帽子，打趣道：“好揭开我的心思。”
Appearing as a singer with a lute and a song of lore, or a bald jester with a wand of bells and a satchel of books, this god laughs into the abyss. He defies the melancholy of wisdom by singing cheerful tunes brimming with it. He recites the poetry of the ages and teaches children in quiet, convincing tones. The repertory of bards, the store of memory for historians, the god lists facts, calls the roll, synthesizes math with the world it measures. After he plays the music of comprehension and croons the lyrics of history, he bows deeply and doffs his hat, “to reveal my mind,” he jokes.

Faerie Plane Overwhelms The Shadow Plane.name:
妖精位面压倒暗影位面
Faerie Plane Overwhelms The Shadow Plane

Text.text:
花朵在一颗破碎的颅骨空洞中绽放。鸟儿在新近复苏的树木繁茂绿叶间枝头跳跃，愉快地啁啾着，天穹也染上暮光般的柔辉。远处传来溪流潺潺，随着景色完成蜕变——这变化始于传送门，如今却已席卷整个影之位面。这里曾只有死亡、绝望与黑暗——而现在，新生在眨眼间破土而出，一片生机勃勃的森林取代了无尽的碎骨荒原与嶙峋怪石。
Flowers bloom in the hollows of a broken skull. Birds flit from bough to bough among the verdant leaves of newly resurrected trees, twittering pleasantly as the sky takes on the glow of twilight. A stream babbles in the distance as the landscape completes the transformation, which originated at the portal but has now overtaken the entirety of the shadow plane. Here there was only death, despair, and darkness—now new life springs forth in the blink of an eye, as a forest teeming with life replaces the endless wastes of shattered bone and jagged stone.

Chain Flail Trap.name:
链枷陷阱
Chain Flail Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 你敏锐的目光捕捉到前方道路上的异样：在满地残骸与碎屑之间，偏偏少了些该有的杂物。道路两侧有巨大的铁链夹击般垂落，却仿佛并不通向任何地方。

[发现] 前方路面上的绊线在微风里轻轻颤动。粗略搜查后，你发现头顶悬着沉重的铁链，致命的重量被系在绊线上的木楔勉强顶住。

[触发] 伴随一声扭曲的呻吟，悬在道路上方的铁链挣脱束缚。它们哗啦作响，宛如被诅咒之人的镣铐，一对巨链以骇人的速度朝你猛扑而来。

[Perceived] Your keen eyes notice something amiss on the path ahead, a subtle absence of debris among the detritus littering the ground. You see large chains flanking the path, yet they do not seem to lead anywhere.

[Discovered] A tripwire on the path ahead wobbles softly in the breeze. A cursory search reveals heavy chains suspended above you, their deadly weight held at bay by wooden blocks tied to the wire.

[Triggered] With a tortured groan, chains suspended above the path come free. Rattling like the shackles of the damned, a pair of enormous chains hurtles toward you at terrifying speed.

Barlgura's Cave.name:
巴尔古拉的洞窟
Barlgura's Cave

Text.text:
死亡与金属的恶臭在这座幽暗洞窟里黏腻滞留。扯离颈项的头颅一颗颗扣在每根石笋顶端，折断的钟乳如尖桩般刺入滴水的穹顶。碎石、断骨，以及更不堪入目的、泛着湿光的黏滑残渣，玷污着湿润而崎岖不平的地面。可怖的秽物又将洞窟后方倾斜处的一汪水池搅得污浊不堪。静止而腥腐的水面上方，在最远处的洞壁上，崩碎的岩石挤出一处王座般的凹龛，里面的小饰物、钱币与断裂的武器闪着寒光。

~ 构想：Nick

The reek of death and metal cloys inside this caliginous cavern. Heads torn from necks cap every stalagmite, and broken stalactites spike the dripping ceiling. Rubble, broken bones, and less savory glistening debris, defile the slick, uneven floor. Horrid detritus befouls a pool to the cave’s sloping rear. Above the still, fetid water, on the farthest wall, crushed stone forms a thronelike niche in which baubles, coins, and broken armaments glitter.

~ Envisioned by Nick

My Shield +1 Deflects A Claw.name:
我的+1盾牌格开了一记利爪
My Shield +1 Deflects A Claw

Text.text:
刺耳的刮擦声充斥四周，我的附魔盾牌将怪物的利爪硬生生弹开。尽管这一击带着原始的凶暴之力，我的壁垒依旧毫发无损、坚不可摧，随时准备再次为我挡下下一波攻势。
A terrible scraping sound fills the air as my enchanted shield deflects the monster’s claws. Despite the primal ferocity of the blow, my bulwark remains unblemished and strong, ready to defend me once more.

在它北侧一道肘形转角与南墙上一处天然拱门般的开口之间，这间宽阔的大厅正好沐在落日余晖的阴影里。五顶帐篷散落在木桶与箱笼之间，尽显久无人用的迹象。其中两顶帐篷的抛物线形篷檐在沙漠风里扑扇作响，边缘磨损开裂。火坑里堆着旧木，中央被烧得焦黑，却仍按一种井然的方式摆放，显出熟练的野外求生手艺。
Between an elbow turn to its north and a natural arch opening in its south wall, this large chamber is just feeling the shade of the setting sun. Five tents, all showing signs of disuse, are scattered among barrels and crates. The parabolic awnings of a couple of tents flap and fray in the desert wind. The firepit contains old wood, charred at the center, but in an arrangement demonstrating skillful survival craft.

微不足道的小事也能改写一生的轨迹——楼梯上的一次踏空，手中绳索的一瞬打滑，或匆忙间忽略的关键细节。借助这道法术，你希望避开这类愚行，甚至将好运握在自己手里，从命运的掌控中夺回方向。
Little things can alter the course of one’s life—a misstep on the stairs, the slip of a rope in the hand, or an important detail neglected in haste. With this spell you hope to avoid such folly, and perhaps take luck into your own hands to wrest control of fate.

Ravenous Drone Swarm.name:
饥噬无人机蜂群
Ravenous Drone Swarm

Text.text:
机械的嗡鸣与金属的铿锵撞击充斥在空气中，织成一层刺耳的声雾——甚至在那群蜂拥现身之前就已逼近。黑色无人机与同伴步调一致地滑行穿梭。可有些机体糊满泥垢，行动紊乱，彼此撞个正着，哐啷作响。整片机群被每一只猩红独眼的光芒映得通体发亮。
Mechanical buzzing and metal clanging fills the air with a sonic haze—even before the swarm comes into view. Black drones move in sync with their peers. But some, caked in dirt, move erratically and bounce off each other with a rattle. The entire array is aglow with light from each single red eye.

Ignus Al-farid.name:
伊格纳斯·阿尔-法里德
Ignus Al-farid

Text.text:
这个高大魁梧的男人，猩红的皮肤与眼睛本该最惹眼——若不是他的头发：像一束锥形火焰般跳动燃舞；下巴上的胡须则是更小一号的火焰倒影。灰色锁子甲外罩着一件黑色长外套，缀以红色点缀，外套下遮着一只挂在胯侧的玻璃瓶。肩带将一面圆盾固定在他背上；他双臂交叉而立，燃烧般的眉峰紧蹙，目光冷峻。右手上一枚红宝石戒指闪着微光。

~ 由 Connor S. 扮演

This tall, broad man’s crimson skin or eyes might’ve been his most striking feature were it not for his hair—which looks and dances like a cone of fire, the beard on his chin a smaller mirror image. A black overcoat with red accents tops his hauberk of gray chainmail and covers a glass bottle slung on his hip. A baldric keeps a round shield on his back, and he stands with arms crossed, his fiery brows drawn together and his eyes stern. A ruby ring glints from his right hand.

~ Played by Connor S.

Desert: Searing Hot Winds.name:
沙漠：灼烫热风
Desert: Searing Hot Winds

Text.text:
风势陡然变强，热浪也随之高涨。仿佛空气从沙地里攫取灼热，再狠狠抛向你。哪怕躲在高大沙丘的阴影里也毫无缓解，因为风在那儿同样凶猛。你愿意付出一切只求一缕凉风，或哪怕片刻的静止——只要不是这永不停歇、如熔炉喷吐般的灼风。
The wind has picked up strength, and heat with it. It’s as if the air snatches warmth from the sands and flings it at you. Even the shade of a high dune provides no relief because the wind blows just as strong. You’d give anything for a cool breeze, or just a stillness, anything but this relentless forge-blast.

Lorekeeper Durzo.name:
典籍守护者·杜尔佐
Lorekeeper Durzo

Text.text:
一双幽冥般的红眼从猩红长袍的深兜帽里探出，在空洞的眼眶中缓缓转动，暗暗发光。那身影似乎骨瘦如柴——也许吧，很难分辨。他的面容大半被黏附在凹陷轮廓上的阴影遮蔽。你避开那令人不安的凝视，凑近细看，才辨出那是个高龄精灵苍老而尖削的面相，可你从未见过如此惨白、如此枯槁的精灵。几缕稀薄的白发已长得很长，从兜帽两侧垂落，贴着锋利的下颌线探出。某种近似微笑的弧度开始在薄薄的黑唇上游走，露出那对犬齿——像是被锉过，或者……

~ 由 Leomoren Played

Haunting red eyes peer out from the deep hood of crimson robes and swivel in hollow sockets, glowing dimly. The figure is emaciated, perhaps. It’s hard to tell. Most of his face is obscured by the shadows clinging to his sunken features. Avoiding that unnerving glare, you peer closer and make out the aged, pinched looks of an elf of advanced age, though you have never seen one so pale and wasted before. A trickle of wispy white hair grown to length peeks out of the hood to each side of the sharp jawline. Something like a smile begins to play across thin, black lips, revealing canines that have either been filed, or . . .

~ Played by Leomoren

Tournament Melee Backstab.name:
锦标混战背刺
Tournament Melee Backstab

Text.text:
钢铁的喧嚣震耳欲聋。战场上挤满了挣扎的斗士，曾经鲜艳的罩袍如今破成缕缕碎布。交战者彼此猛击，钉头锤与战锤一下一下砸在头盔与盾牌上，火花与闷响齐作。一名披着朱红甲胄的骑士被一拳打得离地，铠片哗啦作响地摔落尘土。那张脸仿佛被淤青与狂怒铸成的面具，他踉跄爬起，抽出一柄看上去凶狠至极的匕首，猛地将其捅进毫无防备的对手背脊。
The cacophony of steel is deafening. The list is full of struggling fighters, once-colorful tabards hanging in shreds. Belligerents pummel each other, mace and hammer pounding helm and shield alike. A vermillion armored knight is punched from his feet, clattering to the ground. Face a bruised mask of fury, he clambers up, draws a vicious looking dagger, and plunges it into his unsuspecting adversary's back.

圈栏里等候的牲畜低着头、别开视线，嗅到死亡的气味，正如工人们也闻得到。女人们剖开四足尸身，男人们把剩下的部分分割剁解。两名工人拖着滴血的篮筐走向熏房，另一个则把牛排层层抹盐腌起。血浸透地面，浸透握着砍刀的手，浸透一颗颗牛头——尽头是失明般空洞的凝视。

~ 由 Joshakawa 构想

Livestock waiting in the pens look away and low, smelling death just as the workers smell it. Women gut four-legged corpses, and men butcher what is left. Two workers haul dripping baskets to the smokehouse, while another packs steaks in salt. Blood soaks the ground, soaks hands ending in cleavers, soaks cattle heads ending in blind stares.

~ Envisioned by Joshakawa

Sundries From An Unfathomable Aberration.name:
来自不可测异变之物的杂物
Sundries From An Unfathomable Aberration

Text.text:
伴随着一声灵能尖啸，你面前那团溃烂的眼与肉的聚合体猛然炸裂，浓稠黏腻的脓黑体液四下飞溅，将视野所及的一切尽数泼洒。你在胶质般的血肉残骸间拨弄翻找，最终发现一颗拳头大小的独眼，其惨白的瞳孔呈诡异的长方形。
With a psychic shriek the suppurating mass of eyes and flesh before you bursts, spattering everything in sight with thick, viscous ichor. Picking through the gelatinous carnage you find a single, fist sized eyeball with a pallid rectangular pupil.

Loot From A Ki-rin.name:
麒麟遗落之宝
Loot From A Ki-rin

Text.text:
七十七缕辉煌耀目的马鬃被打结缠在独角兽的鬃毛里。将其梳开，那结便化作一条辫索，随即绷紧成一根魔法弓弦。
Seventy-seven strands of magnificently glowing equine hairs are knotted together in the unicorn’s mane. Combed out, the knot becomes a braid that tightens into a magical bowstring.

Surprising Noise In The Woods.name:
林中惊异声响
Surprising Noise In The Woods

Text.text:
跋涉在覆着苔藓的灌木层间，你一步步更深入林子，雨水浸透的泥土气息浓烈得几乎灌满鼻腔。忽然，一声异响如刺客的利刃，劈开森林的静谧，穿透乡野安宁的薄纱。那是谁，或是什么？

~ 构想：Vohk 于 Discord

Trudging through the mossy undergrowth, you make your way further and further into the woods, the heady scent of rain-soaked soil filling your nostrils. A sudden noise cuts through the ambience of the forest like an assassin's knife piercing the veil of rural tranquility. Who, or what, was that?

~ Envisioned by Vohk on Discord

行星向阳的一侧，在未被各式云形遮蔽之处，地表呈现出布满沟槽的银亮质感。几何分割的绿色空间与棱角分明的水道切开整齐的城市蔓延图样。背阳的一侧，灯光同样勾勒出利落的线条与形状，显露出一带带城市化区域、被照亮的水面，以及主要交通走廊。这个覆盖整颗行星的城市里，几乎不剩多少黑暗。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The sunlit side of the planet has a grooved and silvery surface where the ground isn’t shrouded in varied cloud forms. Geometric green spaces and angular waterways break up orderly patterns of conurbation. On the dark side, lights form similarly clean-lined shapes, revealing bands of urbanization, illuminated waters, and major transport corridors. Little darkness endures in this planetwide city.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Cast Circle Of Power.name:
我施放「力量法环」
I Cast Circle Of Power

Text.text:
我高声吟诵多年前学会的词句——一段祈求神圣守护之力的祷文。随着我不断诵唱，一团朦胧而耀眼的金色光球在我周身骤然升起，继而迅速凝实，仿佛石砌堡垒般轰然落位。法术徒劳地溅撞在护罩上，奥术能量像火焰迸散的余烬般消散于空中。

~ Envisioned by Lazaeris

I speak aloud the words I learned long ago—a prayer of protective divine power. A vague, gleaming sphere of golden light springs up around me as I continue chanting, and it comes into full focus, slamming into place like a stone bulwark. Spells splash uselessly against the protective sphere, their arcane energies dissipating into the air like cinders from a flame.

~ Envisioned by Lazaeris

Entrancing Perfume Of Faerie Flowers.name:
妖精花卉的迷魂香氛
Entrancing Perfume Of Faerie Flowers

Text.text:
馥郁的花香在你鼻尖轻轻萦绕，温柔得像蝴蝶翅膀的扑动，又像恋人唇间一瞬即逝的触碰。当你再一次、更深地吸入时，那些你从未经历过的芬芳彻底将你的感官包裹。你感觉柔软的花瓣掠过你的脸颊——又一记记轻吻。你在舌尖尝到蜂蜜的甜。你在耳畔听见钻入土里的根须筋韧地沙沙皱响。头晕目眩、心也轻盈，你感到自己向后坠落，跌入这一床繁花之中；它们明亮的花颜早已准备好、欢欣地将你接住。
The floral aroma plays lightly about your nose, as gentle as the flutter of butterfly wings or the momentary trace of a lover’s lips. As you take another, deeper breath in, the scents—the likes of which you’ve never experienced before—totally envelop your senses. You feel the soft petals trace over your cheeks—more of those gentle kisses. You taste honey on your tongue. You hear the sinewy crinkle of earth-digging roots in your ear. Head swimming and heart light, you feel yourself falling backward into a bed of these blooms, their bright faces ready and glad to catch you.

Thick Electrician's Gloves.name:
厚实的电工手套
Thick Electrician's Gloves

Text.text:
这副厚实结实的手套由工业橡胶制成——闻起来也一股橡胶味。它们专为抗割裂与抗穿刺而设计，是每位电工不可或缺的关键装备。手套的状态极佳，显然一直保养得当。
These thick, robust gloves are made from industrial rubber—and they smell like it too. Designed to be cut and puncture resistant, these hardy gloves are vital equipment for every electrician. The gloves are in excellent condition and are clearly well-maintained.

Stone Bridge In Sweltering Heat.name:
酷热蒸腾中的石桥
Stone Bridge In Sweltering Heat

Text.text:
桥上的小径在热浪中仿佛微微摇曳，朦胧的光晕里，鹅卵石看起来像在起舞。石块中的矿物沉积在灿烈日光下闪闪发亮，折射出细碎的光点，宛如微小的钻石。灰泥间已裂开道道缝隙，枯死的草被烤焦，伏在地面上。
The path across the bridge seems to shimmer in the heat, and within the haze the cobbles appear to dance. Mineral deposits in the stone blocks sparkle in the brilliant sunshine, glinting like tiny diamonds. Cracks have formed in the mortar and dead grass lies scorched upon the ground.

Hard-drinking Card Shark.name:
嗜酒如命的赌局老千
Hard-drinking Card Shark

Text.text:
女人朝酒保亮出一把闪闪发光的信用点，随即滑进旁边的卡座，棱角分明的脸上挂着得意的坏笑。酒一上来，她在侍者错愕的目光中一口闷下。她一拳砸在木桌上又点了一杯，摇摇晃晃地站起身，宣称今晚全场她请客。喧闹的欢呼声轰然炸开，却没人看见那名诈赌高手把赌场腕带悄无声息地塞进皮下暗袋。
The woman flashes a gleaming handful of credits at the bartender, then slides into a nearby booth, a satisfied smirk on her angular face. She throws back her liquor in one gulp when it arrives—to the astonishment of the bemused waiter. Slamming her fist onto the wood she orders another and stands, somewhat shakily, to declare she’s buying for everyone in the bar. Raucous cheers erupt but no one sees the card shark slip her casino wristband into a sub-dermal pouch.

Tournament Merchant Intrigue.name:
锦标赛商贩阴谋
Tournament Merchant Intrigue

Text.text:
一座彩绘亭阁后头停着一辆篷车，车上货物用肮脏的油布胡乱盖着。一个披兜帽的人靠在车尾板上，正与一位衣着华贵的女子低声交谈，两人的脑袋几乎贴在一起。女子不耐烦地挥手示意，兜帽人便转过身，悄悄把手探到帆布底下去摸索什么。
Behind a colorful pavilion stands a wagon, its load covered with dirty tarps. A cowled figure leans against the tailgate chatting with an opulently dressed woman, their heads almost touching. The woman gestures impatiently, and the hooded individual turns, reaching surreptitiously under the canvas for something.

Inspiration About Facing The Impossible.name:
关于直面不可能的灵感
Inspiration About Facing The Impossible

Text.text:
“我看见你在绝望中颤抖。别躲开那种感觉——抓住它，去寻求复仇。惩罚这个把你带到世上的世界，惩罚它对你的冷漠与漫不经心，让它为此付出代价，让它不得不把目光投向你。”
“I see you quiver in despair. Don’t shy away from that feeling—take hold of it and seek revenge. Punish this world for bringing you into it, for its ambivalence toward you, and make it pay attention.”

Loot From A Leprechaun.name:
妖精盗宝记
Loot From A Leprechaun

Text.text:
战利品落在一处巧妙的陈列里，仿佛就摆在某户人家的门廊前。一根魔法橡木短杖斜倚在一套绿黄相间的衣服旁，那衣服挂在一株橡木雕成的立式衣架上，顶端还扣着一顶插着羽毛的帽子。那双小小的卷尖靴里塞满了金币。
The loot lands in a nifty arrangement, as if it were sitting at the front door of a home. A magical shillelagh is propped against a set of green and yellow clothing that hangs on a hall tree carved of oak and topped with a feathered cap. The little curl-toed boots are filled with gold pieces.

Abandoned Mage Hideout.name:
废弃法师藏身处
Abandoned Mage Hideout

Text.text:
这里有人施放过一道寒霜法术。你呼出的气在空中凝成白雾，刺骨的冷意刮过喉咙。闪耀的冰晶悬浮在空气里，几粒飘到你脸上，像冬日的亲吻般冰凉。地面覆着一层厚实的雪白绒毯，在你靴子的重量下悄然融化。你右侧有一扇敞开的门，通往一间宏伟的书房。书架直达天花板，一张长长的工作台静候着摆弄与修理。然而，这份气派被近来洗劫后的狼藉所黯淡。书本与纸张散落一地，与碎裂玻璃危险的寒光交织在一起。
A frost spell has been cast here. Your breath clouds in the air, the chill harsh in your throat. Glittering crystals hover in the air, a few floating into your face as wintry kisses. The floor is covered in a lush, white blanket that melts away under the weight of your boot. To your right, you see an open door leading to a grand study. Bookshelves reach the ceiling and a long worktable sits ready for tinkering. However, the grandeur is dimmed by the mess of a recent ransacking. Books and papers are strewn on the floor, mingling with dangerous glints of broken glass.

Impossibly High Cliff Face.name:
高得不可思议的峭壁崖面
Impossibly High Cliff Face

Text.text:
嶙峋的岩体建筑向上延展数英里，直至没入云层。看不见任何峰顶的迹象。你凝视这道古老峭壁的庞然——以及它顶端潜伏之物——一股深沉的不安悄然爬上你的全身。

~ 由 Dwayne 于 Discord 上 Envisioned

The rocky edifice stretches for miles upward, disappearing into the clouds. There is no sign of a summit. A profound sense of unease creeps through your body as you contemplate the enormity of the ancient cliff—and what lies at the top.

~ Envisioned by Dwayne on Discord

Exquisite Evil Spellbook.name:
精美的邪恶法术书
Exquisite Evil Spellbook

Text.text:
工艺精妙绝伦，仿佛整本书是由一整块硕大的红宝石雕琢而成。蜿蜒的金色纹线沿着封面铰链、外缘游走，并在四角以细密的金丝花纹盘结。尽管硬度惊人，它却无声开启，温顺得近乎柔软。书页间飘起一缕诱人的辛香；其上以暗红与深黑书写，底下则是几乎不可见的灰色恐怖插图。开膛破肚、食人、尸横遍野的原野——作为每一页魔法的背景，竟也显得格外美丽。
The workmanship is exquisite, as if the book were crafted from a single large ruby. Serpentine gold tracing crawls along the cover hinges, the outer edges, and in fine filigree at the corners. For all its hardness, it opens silently and with soft compliance. An appealing spice drifts up from its pages, which are scripted in dark red and deep black over barely visible gray illustrations of horror. Eviscerations, cannibalism, fields of corpses—all quite beautiful as the backdrop for each page’s magic.

I Cast Bane.name:
我施放：灾祸
I Cast Bane

Text.text:
只需一滴鲜血，再加几句低语。就足以削弱强者，击裂勇者。我直视那些袭击者——他们眼里满是胜利的希望——将血珠在指间挤碎。我抬手一指，随即朝他们做出驱逐般的手势。我能感觉到，他们的重心在偏移，专注在钝化……武器在掌中握得不再贴合，不再稳当。
Just a drop of blood and a few words. That’s all it takes to weaken the strong, to crack the brave. I look straight at them, these attackers full of the hope of victory, and squeeze the blood between my fingers. I point, then gesture against them. I can feel it, their balance shifting, their focus dulled… their weapons not quite right in the grip.

Inquisitor Anak Brand.name:
审判官 阿纳克·布兰德
Inquisitor Anak Brand

Text.text:
他所经之处，人人都不由得回头张望；他山岳般的身影投下阴影，盖过众人睁大的眼睛。那些张口结舌的神情，鲜明——甚至滑稽——地与他自己石刻般的面容形成对照：那是一张由纯粹决意铸成的凶厉表情。若不是脚步如雷，他那苍白的皮肤与银灰色的眼睛，你几乎会把他错认作一缕迷失在通往来世路上的幽魂。刺青的线条自眼角向下淌到下颌，墨色与他的板甲护甲同样漆黑如夜。他披着一袭红色斗篷，因体型而做得又长又沉，像挂毯般厚重；斗篷在风中鼓荡，仿佛一艘迎风破浪、驶向战争的船帆。

~ 由一位英雄Played

He turns the heads of everyone he passes by, the shadow of his mountainous form overtaking their wide eyes. Their slack-jawed expressions starkly—humorously—contrast his own stony visage, which is a fierce rendering of pure determination. If not for the thunder of his step, his pale skin, and his silver-gray eyes, you might mistake him for a specter lost on the way to the afterlife. Tattooed lines drip down from his eyes to his jawline, the ink the same pitch black as his plate armor. His red cloak, long and heavy as a tapestry to accommodate his size, billows like the sail of a windswept ship on a course to war.

~ Played by a Hero with

一名裹在棺材般飞行服里的生物端着战斗步枪掠空而过。它的下颚松垮下坠，沉重地摆荡着，滴落不死的污液。它用那条毫无生机的舌头品尝生命。腐烂的喉咙深处传来一声骇人的嚎叫，撕扯着你的专注。
A creature wrapped in a coffin-like flight suit swoops through the air wielding a combat rifle. Its jaw slackens, swinging low and ponderous, dripping undead fluids. It tastes life on its lifeless tongue. From deep in the rotting throat comes a dreadful howl that rips at your concentration.

Fresh Kill Rots Immediately.name:
新鲜猎物立刻腐烂
Fresh Kill Rots Immediately

Text.text:
你飞奔着去抓能抢到的战利品，枯萎的腐肉却在你掌心里一片片脱落。大团大团的肌肉与筋腱——散发着如同烈日下敞开的坟墓般的恶臭——以不自然的速度从霉烂的骨头上剥离滑落。你才刚在片刻前斩杀的野兽，就在你眼前迅速萎缩，坠入坏死的虚无。

~ Envisioned by Sahlonhal on Discord

Withering flesh comes away in your hands as you race to grab what loot you can from the rapidly decaying corpse. Huge gobbets of muscle and sinew—reeking like an open grave in the sun—slough from moldering bones with unnatural haste, as the beast you slew mere moments ago shrinks into necrotic oblivion before your eyes.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonhal on Discord

Temple To A God Of Dinosaurs.name:
恐龙之神的神殿
Temple To A God Of Dinosaurs

Text.text:
穿行在神殿的长廊间，恍若探入一座洞窟——石砌结构刻意粗砺，仿佛只用最原始的手段凿就。燃烧的壁灯将昏暗而张扬的光洒在壁画上：远古巨兽、天穹之火，以粗朴的赭黄与木炭色勾勒成形。内殿如同一座由岩石雕出的宏伟大教堂，化石般的远古恐龙被重构后安置在基座之上；它们凶相凝固，黯淡的骨骸在火炬光里泛出冷亮的微光。中央的基座则留给神祇的塑像：一名络腮胡的英雄壮汉，肌肉虬结鼓胀，手持石棒，身披兽皮。
Passing through the temple’s halls is like exploring a cave, the stone construction intentionally rough-hewn. Burning sconces cast dim, brazen light upon painted murals of ancient beasts and fires in the sky, composed in primitive ochers and charcoal. The inner sanctum is a great cathedral of stone, with fossilized ancient dinosaurs reconstructed on pedestals. They stand in frozen ferocity, their tarnished bones gleaming in the torchlight. The central pedestal is reserved for a likeness of the temple’s god, a bearded man of heroic build and bulging muscle, wielding a stone club and draped in hides.

Loot From A Beckoning Lich.name:
来自召唤巫妖的战利品
Loot From A Beckoning Lich

Text.text:
在一条由颗粒状腐烂与碎骨堆成的脊下——那或许曾是巫妖的手臂——躺着它那致命行当的工具：一根由削尖的尺骨制成的魔杖——圆钝的一端被雕成野兽般带角的骷髅——以及一本厚重的巨册，封面用鳞片般的绿色皮革装订，其上凸出一颗眼球。那只眼珠滚动、眨动，随后将目光牢牢钉在你身上。
Under a ridge of granulated rot and bone which might have once been the lich’s arm lie the tools of its deathly trade: a wand made from a sharpened ulna—the rounded end carved to resemble a beastly horned skull—and a thick tome bound in scaly green hide, with an eyeball projecting from the cover. The eye rolls and blinks before fixing its gaze on you.

Darkmantle Descends.name:
黑幕兽俯冲而下
Darkmantle Descends

Text.text:
在幽暗中，那东西悄无声息地降下，如坠落的枯叶般从天花板滑翔而来。它宽阔的下端延伸出触手般的附肢，每一条末端都生着狰狞的倒钩，彼此又以一层薄薄的、皮革般的膜相连。它圆柱形的顶部睁着一只血红的独眼，外形酷似周遭洞窟里的石笋与钟乳石。你还未来得及反应，黑暗便将你吞没——你只觉那东西的触手缠上了你的头颅、颈项与双肩。
In the dimness, the thing descends without a sound, gliding from the ceiling like a falling leaf. Its wide bottom ends in tentacle-like appendages, each tipped with a wicked barb, and connected by a thin, leathery membrane. A single, blood-red eye peers from the thing's cylindrical top, which resembles the stalagmites and stalactites of the surrounding cave. Before you can react, darkness envelops you—and you feel the thing's tentacles wrap around your head, neck, and shoulders.

Cloak Of The Bat.name:
蝙蝠斗篷
Cloak Of The Bat

Text.text:
这件带兜帽的披风看起来像是为化装舞会量身打造。斗篷外层漆黑，内衬紫色丝绸。黑色布料缝出的肋骨状筋条在肩头堆拢，向下延伸至披风的扇贝形边缘。再加上兜帽上方像巨大耳朵般竖起的褶皱，这一切都毫无疑问：这身衣装就是为了让穿戴者看起来像一只蝙蝠。
This hooded cape looks like something designed for a costume ball. The cloak is black with a purple silk interior. Stitched ribs of black fabric bunch up at the shoulders and run down to the scalloped edges of the cape. These things, along with the folds of fabric that jut up from the hood like big ears, leave no doubt that this garment was meant to make its wearer look like a bat.

Ethroe Clovase The Raven Shadowmancer.name:
埃斯洛·克洛瓦斯——渡鸦之影的影咒师
Ethroe Clovase The Raven Shadowmancer

Text.text:
你所见过最魁梧、最强壮的星光精灵就这样压在你面前，他的腰身与体型被缠附其上的缕缕阴影夸张放大，仿佛披着一件暗影斗篷。背心之下，他宽阔胸膛上精瘦的肌肉随着动作起伏翻涌——他将所选的武器的长柄搁在裸露的肩头：一柄巨大的黑曜石长镰。另一侧肩上停着一只乌鸦。他的装束简洁，仅以黑与红为主调；下方锃亮的黑靴与上方那一蓬骨白色的头发形成刺眼对照，而这名佣兵身上不见任何可供辨识的徽记。 “Clock！”他呼唤道，随即第二只更大的鸟——一只渡鸦——现身。在熔岩色的双眼之下，他嘴角两侧的白色纹线微微上挑，凝成一抹细小、冰冷、淡漠的笑意。

~ Played by Shangerla

The burliest, most strapping starlight elf you have ever seen looms before you, his girth and size exaggerated by the wisps of shadow clinging to him like a cloak. Beneath his vest, the lean muscles of his broad chest ripple as he brings the haft of his chosen weapon to rest against his exposed shoulder: an enormous obsidian scythe. On the other shoulder perches a crow. Clad simply in a black-and-red color scheme, the polished black boots below standing in stark contrast to a shock of bone-white hair above, the sellsword bears no identifying insignia. "Clock!" he calls, and a second, larger bird—a raven—appears. Beneath eyes the color of lava, the white lines at the sides of his mouth pull into a tiny, cold, benign smirk.

~ Played by Shangerla

显然是从上一场战争的残骸里打捞出来的，这支步枪带着曾经上阵的痕迹。它还能用，但击发机构很容易卡壳——往往偏偏在最不合时宜的时候——而当你把枪托抵上肩头时，枪身还会让人不舒服地晃动。总比赤手空拳强，可也绝非上等货。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Clearly salvaged from the remnants of the last war, this rifle bears the marks of active service. Though functional, the firing mechanism is prone to jamming—usually at inopportune moments—and the stock has an off-putting wobble when you shoulder the rifle. It’s better than nothing but it’s hardly top shelf.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Dwarven Mining Village.name:
矮人矿业村落
Dwarven Mining Village

Text.text:
喧闹的村镇上空铺着一层板岩灰的云幕，暴雨如槌狠砸人群；他们咬紧牙关，推着满身泥点的矿车，穿行在夯实的土路之间。铁匠的锤声叮当回荡，恍若雷鸣，敲碎天穹倾泻不止的雨幕，也为回旋在空气中的古老劳作歌谣打下激昂的节拍。纵使艰辛，矮人村民仍带着满足的笑意忙碌着——他们知道，日落时分，本地酒馆里有温暖的炉火与冰凉起泡的麦酒在等着。
The sky above the bustling hamlet is a blanket of slate-gray cloud, and rain hammers the populace as they heave mud-spattered mine carts through streets of packed earth. The ringing of a smith’s hammer resounds like thunder, punctuating the relentless deluge tumbling from the sky and the rousing bars of ancient working songs filling the air. Despite their hardship, the dwarven villagers go about their day with contented smiles, knowing a warm hearth and a cold, frothy ale awaits in the local tavern at day's end.

Kuo-toa Village On Dark Lake.name:
黑湖之上的库欧托亚村
Kuo-toa Village On Dark Lake

Text.text:
聚落那股腐臭的气味在村庄映入眼帘之前就先扑面而来。混杂的恶臭里，你捕捉到死水的腥闷、朽木的腐败与霉菌的阴湿，全都只是压过一切的鱼腥味下的底色。几拨零散的鱼人乞丐穿着破烂衣衫，鳃缝里污垢凝结成痂，一看见有访客靠近便抬起头来。越过他们走进村子深处，其余居民的境况也好不到哪去。即便是扛着钓竿和木料的人，那身朴素衣服上也缝着一块又一块补丁；许多街角处，两三名鱼人站在齐腰深的垃圾堆里翻找，扒拉着任何还算值钱的东西。

~ Dave Schmidt 构想

The putrid scent of the settlement hits you before the village comes into view. In the medley of stenches, you catch whiffs of still water, wood rot, and mold, all an undertone to the predominant smell of fish. A few scattered groups of pescanoid beggars in torn clothing, grime entrenched in their gills, perk up at the sight of incoming visitors. Past them and into the village proper, the rest of the residents don't look much better off. Even those toting fishing poles and lumber have numerous patches sewn into their modest clothing, and many street corners have a pair or trio of pescanoids up to their waists in heaps of refuse, scavenging for anything worthwhile.

~ Envisioned by Dave Schmidt

那人佝偻着跨坐在车辕上，戴着手套的手死死攥住缰绳，乍看更像一堆垃圾而非人形。兜帽压得极低，阴影深处有一双眯起的眼睛闪着冷光；披在弯曲身躯上的破布与兽皮，只让那本就破败的轮廓更加难辨。车夫用嘴发出清脆的催促声，赶着拉车的牲口继续向前。
The slouched form of the individual astride the wagon, reins clutched in gloved hands, evokes a pile of refuse before it does a humanoid figure. Narrowed eyes shine from the shadowed depths of a cowl pulled low over their head, while the rags and hides draping their bent frame do little to lend clarity to an already ragged shape. The driver clicks with their mouth, urging the beasts pulling the wagon forward.

Dry Well In Front Of Aged Cave Portico.name:
老旧洞窟门廊前的枯井
Dry Well In Front Of Aged Cave Portico

Text.text:
干涸的井口沉入庭院那被天气侵蚀的鹅卵石之间，虽原始却行之有效地将瀑流引向别处——无疑守护着地牢门廊下方的地基。如今，排水沟是否已成了水栖怪物的巢穴？
Sunk into the earth between the weather-beaten cobbles of the courtyard, the dry well is an effective if primitive means of diverting the waterfall—no doubt preserving the foundations beneath the dungeon’s portico. Do water-creatures now call the drainage ditch a home?

Adult Gold Dragon On The Wing.name:
展翼翱翔的成年金龙
Adult Gold Dragon On The Wing

Text.text:
沐浴在新一天的金色辉光之中，这条巨龙的鎏金鳞甲宛如锻造而成的阳光，炽然绽放出灿烂无比的荣光，振翼腾空，闯入视野。它是辉煌威仪的高贵典范；那双巨大龙眸深邃如古老的智慧，温和却不容置疑的威权在其中流转，俯瞰并巡视着它的疆域。它展开巨翼滑翔，恍若金辉泰坦——德行的化身，善之力的雄浑彰显。
Wreathed in the golden radiance of a new day, the gilt scales of this immense dragon—like forged sunlight—blaze with resplendent glory as it soars into view. A noble paragon of gleaming majesty, its vast eyes, deep with ancient wisdom, boast benign authority as it surveys its realm. On huge wings it glides like an aureate titan, an embodiment of virtue and the strength of good.

Overprotective Parent.name:
过度保护的家长
Overprotective Parent

Text.text:
她瘦得像把耙子，肤色斑驳，指甲啃到见肉。她举止拘谨，养尊处优得过头，可脸上却刻着忧惧的纹路。她对面坐着个耷拉着的少年——至少十七岁，一身黑衣——把腿交叠着，刻意朝外撇开。少年的母亲摆弄着他们的头发，告诫道：“今晚必须8:45整点回来！”
She’s a rake-thin woman of mottled complexion, nails bitten to the quick. She’s prim and over-pampered, and yet her face bears lines of worry. A slumped teenager—at least seventeen years old and dressed all in black—sits across from her, legs crossed away. The teen’s mother fiddles with the teenager’s hair, warning them to “be back by 8:45 tonight on the dot!”

Dungeon: Narrow Hall.name:
地城：狭窄走廊
Dungeon: Narrow Hall

Text.text:
地城的墙壁向内收拢，挤成一条逼仄的走廊，宽度几乎只够肩并肩通过。即便在黑暗里，你也能看出这是一条人工修筑的通道。墙面由石块砌成，平整光滑，拼接严丝合缝；地面则平坦干净，不见杂物。这里曾是用来秘密逃生的暗道，还是用于走私藏运的通路？
The walls of the dungeon narrow into a tight corridor, little more than shoulder-width apart. It's clear it's a constructed hall, even in the dark. The walls are made of stone, smooth and carefully placed, and the floor is level and clear. Could this have been a secret passage for escape, or maybe smuggling?

Loot From The Prince Of Wrath.name:
来自暴怒亲王的战利品
Loot From The Prince Of Wrath

Text.text:
从王子的手中，那件毁灭他的凶器哐啷落地：一柄由黑曜石与白骨铸成的战锤，体型与工艺都骇人至极。武器上镌刻的獠牙与颅骨纹路涌动着诡异力量，闷燃出一抹紫罗兰色的幽光。
From the prince's hands the instrument of his destruction clatters: a warhammer of obsidian and bone, monstrous in both size and make. The morbid etchings of teeth and skulls upon the weapon pulse with eldritch power, smoldering a violet glow.

走廊深处传来锁子甲的叮当轻响，一道高挑身影迈步而来。每一次修长的跨步都掀起罩在护甲之上的黑色战袍，如暗潮翻涌。你的目光随之上移，落在那张线条凌厉的面孔上——仿佛雕刻家以惨白大理石凿出的作品。  

他抬起头，直直盯住你，顺滑的棕发如帘般分开，露出一双缟玛瑙般的眼睛；墨色泪痕从眼角缓缓淌下，沿着苍白的面颊蜿蜒而落。
From down the corridor you hear the clinking of chain mail as a tall figure walks into view, each long stride billowing the black tabard which sits over his armor. Your gaze moves up toward a sharply cut face, as if chiseled by a sculptor in pale marble. As he lifts his head to stare at you, a curtain of smooth brown hair parts to reveal trails of inky tears slowly running down his pale cheeks from a pair of onyx eyes.

干枯扭曲的枝桠挂满腐烂果实，在曾经繁盛的苹果园里咔嚓一声断裂，随即沉闷地砸落在地。树木再也投不下半点阴影，树皮硬化龟裂，病变的树液从节疤孔中渗出，像伤口里挤出的脓。垂死之树结出的果子布满惨白斑点，恶臭扑鼻——那股令人作呕的腥酸气息，像堵塞的排水沟里溢出的腐败洪水。 Dried and twisted boughs, heavy with rotten fruit, crack and drop with a thump in the once-prosperous apple orchard. The trees provide no shade, their bark is hardened and cracked, and diseased sap oozes from knotholes, like pus from a wound. The fruits of these dying trees are riddled with white blotches, and reek—the sickly odor reminiscent of a clogged gutter brimming over with fetid floodwater.

Dungeon: Staircase Leading Up.name:
地城：通往上方的楼梯
Dungeon: Staircase Leading Up

Text.text:
一段漫长的阶梯自地面拔起，缓缓的斜坡引向地城更高的等级。很明显，阶梯尽头仍有通道延伸，但在顶端究竟有什么在等待，却没有任何立刻可见的迹象。
A long set of stairs rise from the floor, a gradual incline leading to a higher level of the dungeon. It's clear the passage continues at the end of the staircase, but there's no immediate indication of what waits at the peak.

Corrupted Avatar Of Lurue.name:
堕化的露露艾化身
Corrupted Avatar Of Lurue

Text.text:
独角兽人立而起，漆黑如无星之夜的皮毛紧绷在枯槁身躯上，肿瘤般的骨骼嶙峋凸起。拖曳的阴影化作这头野兽的鬃与尾。利齿在口中咬合作响，它发出的低吼更像疯狼而非马匹。血色的光从怪物的眼、鼻、口倾泻而出，在它参差锋利的蹄上跳动，又盘旋缠绕着那唯一的角——一根残酷而锯齿森然的尖刺。
The unicorn rears, with a coat the color of a starless night pulled taut over a wasted frame of tumorous bone. Trailing shadows form the beast’s mane and tail. Sharp teeth gnash in its mouth as it utters a growl more like a rabid wolf than a horse. Hematic light pours from the monster’s eyes, nose, and mouth, dancing on its jagged hooves and swirling around the cruel serrated spike that is its single horn.

Interrupted Ritual.name:
被打断的仪式
Interrupted Ritual

Text.text:
吟唱声在这扇门后最为震耳。木板的几道裂缝间迸出蓝色闪光。你猛然撞入，朽烂的木板哗啦作响四散飞落。浓烟从室内翻涌而出，沉甸甸地裹着蜡与血的腥甜气息。地上画着一圈白垩圆环，周围环绕着发光的符文，跳动着不自然的光芒。圆心站着一名年迈的地精，披挂着油腻的暗色羽毛礼装与粗切的宝石。他颤抖着手指指向你，尖声嘶嚎。角落里传来细弱的呼喊：“救救我！”一只更高大的地精从阴影中拖步而出，弓着身子，朝一只锈蚀的笼子低吼。一个小女孩被塞进一个几乎只够狗蜷缩的空间里，手脚被扭折成怪异的角度，像一具纠缠的木偶。她的手指从顶端的栅栏间伸出，正悬在看守者滴着涎水的獠口下方。她哭泣着，恳求的双眼在钴蓝的烛光里对你闪烁。

~ Envisioned by Derek E

The chanting is loudest beyond this door. Flashes of blue light show through several cracks in the wood. You burst through, sending the rotted planks clattering. Smoke billows out of the chamber, heavy with the scent of wax and blood. A chalk circle on the floor is surrounded with glowing runes, pulsing with unnatural light. At the center, an old goblin stands, adorned in regalia of greasy, dark feathers and rough-cut jewels. He points with a shaking finger and screeches. From the corner, you hear a small voice cry out: "Help me!" A taller goblin shambles out of the shadows, bending low and snarling into a rusted cage. A young girl has been stuffed into a space barely big enough for a dog, her arms and legs bent at odd angles like a tangled puppet. Her fingers stick out of the top bars, just under her captor’s dripping maw. She weeps, and her pleading eyes glimmer at you in the cobalt candlelight.

~ Envisioned by Derek E

Loot From A Harpy.name:
竖琴妖的战利品
Loot From A Harpy

Text.text:
鹰身女妖的皮挎包上缀满珠串与鸣禽羽毛。里面塞着几支烟斗——其中一支是象牙制的，定能卖个好价钱；另一支的斗钵由熔融宝石凝成，价值50枚金币。
The harpy's leather satchel is decorated in beads and songbird feathers. It is filled with pipes for smoking—one is ivory, sure to fetch a nice chunk of change, while another has a bowl made of fused gemstones, worth 50 gold pieces.

兜帽低垂，眼覆布带，宽大的长袍将她层层裹住，除了嘴唇之外几乎看不见她的任何面容。一只手自袍袖间探出，伸向近旁的香炉，轻轻扇动，将袅袅熏香的烟雾引向自己。随即另一只手也从袍中伸出，抛洒出一把碎裂的骨片，每一片上都刻着细小的符文。她将双手悬在散落的骨片上方，仿佛在触摸它们落下的形状与命运。
Hooded, blindfolded, and shrouded by voluminous robes, there’s little of this woman you can see besides her mouth. A hand appears from her robes, reaching out to a nearby censer to waft the smoke of its incense toward her. Then her other hand emerges and tosses out a scattering of broken bones, each marked with a tiny rune. She casts both hands out over the strewn objects as if feeling how they have fallen.

Plate Of Fugu.name:
河豚拼盘
Plate Of Fugu

Text.text:
河豚拼盘散发着危险的气息，精巧的摆盘将那或许致命的刺激暗藏其中。宛如一条美食的钢丝，半透明的河豚薄片徘徊在致命的边缘，让食客得以品尝这份经娴熟技能与极致谨慎方能成就的珍馐所带来的战栗。

~ 一位英雄所构想

The fugu plate emits an aura of peril, its artistic arrangement concealing the possibly deadly thrill within. Like a culinary tightrope, the translucent slices of pufferfish reside upon the precipice of lethality, allowing diners to taste the thrill of an adroitly prepared delicacy that demands both skill and exquisite caution.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Aarakocra Taking In Their Surroundings.name:
阿拉科克拉环顾四周
Aarakocra Taking In Their Surroundings

Text.text:
一对强健的羽翼自他们骄傲的肩头垂落，羽翎修长得几乎要让羽尖拂过地面。漆黑而锐利的眼睛来回游移，带着谨慎的警觉将四周尽收眼底。这个鸟民结实有力、肌肉分明的四肢昭示着不容小觑的威胁，但与那刀锋般锋利的喙相比，仍显得黯然失色。
Powerful wings, with feathers so long that the tips nearly brush the ground, hang from their proud shoulders. Sharp black eyes flick to and fro, taking in their surroundings with a sense of cautious awareness. The capable, well-muscled arms and legs of this birdfolk display the potential danger they could pose clearly, but they pale in comparison to the razor-sharp beak.

Canadian Hockey Player Piloting A ’57 Ch.name:
驾驶着一艘’57款雪佛兰时空飞船的加拿大冰球玩家
Canadian Hockey Player Piloting A ’57 Chevy Space-time Ship

Text.text:
这辆车宽阔雄壮，双前灯迸射出象征美式卓越的光芒，抛光的镀铬尾翼自车尾扬起，如刀翼般凌空。车舱内衬以精致的材料，纤尘不染，仿佛时间从未触碰；座位间却蜷着一具臃肿的身影，穿着全套冰球护具——面罩、球衣与护垫——胸前醒目印着加拿大的枫叶。这辆雪佛兰绝非标准款：引擎盖上嵌着一枚边角圆润、脉动着紫光的立方体；排气管被巨大的星舰引擎取代，内外更是密布不计其数的外星装置，闪烁、嗡鸣、飞旋不止。
The car is broad, twin headlights beaming American excellence, and polished chrome wings rising from the rear of the vehicle. The cabin is lined with fine materials, all immaculately preserved, and within is a bulky figure in full hockey regalia—mask, jersey, and pads—emblazoned with the maple leaf of Canada. This Chevy isn’t standard model: on the hood sits a pulsing purple cube with rounded edges, the exhausts have been replaced with humongous starship engines, and countless extraterrestrial gizmos flash and whir both inside and out.

A Plea From A Townsperson To Join.name:
一位镇民的恳求：请让我加入
A Plea From A Townsperson To Join

Text.text:
“我的家族在这片土地上扎根了整整两百年，可我就是做不到。每次看见夕阳沉落在我们的田野尽头，我脑子里只剩一个念头——那道地平线的另一边究竟有什么。求你，带我一起走吧。让我亲眼看看。”
“My family has stayed on this same stretch of land for two hundred years, but I just can’t. Every time I see the sunset over our fields all I can do is wonder what’s on the other side of that horizon. Please, take me with you. Let me see it.”

这只巨大的角鸮宛如自然的主权哨卫——双翼恢宏，眼眸如月光凝成的宝珠般熠熠生辉。傲然的角羽冠冕其首，短剑般的利爪攥紧，蓄势待发。它无声而警醒，兼具智慧与潜行的典范，以王者般的从容统御暮色之境。
This gigantic horned owl is nature's sovereign sentinel—boasting immense wings and eyes gleaming like orbs of moonlight. Imperious horns crown its head, and talons like shortswords clench in anticipation. Silent, watchful, a paragon of wisdom and stealth, it rules the twilight realm with regal grace.

I Cast Enhance Ability To Bestow Bull's.name:
我施放【强化能力】，赐予牛之力
I Cast Enhance Ability To Bestow Bull's Strength

Text.text:
我倔强地张开鼻翼，吟诵法术的咒词，呼唤公牛的力量。粗硬的牛毛在指间灼热发烫，魔能层层汇聚，灌注进肌肉，赋予它们骇人的伟力——赐下公牛之力。
My nostrils flare defiantly as I chant the words of the spell and call upon the strength of the Bull. The rough bovine hair grows hot between my fingers as the magical energy builds to instill muscles with incredible might—imparting the Bull’s Strength.

珠子漆黑如墨，光泽近似黑曜石。浑圆得无可挑剔，光滑得不见一丝瑕疵。你将它拾起的瞬间，便感到一股惊人的沉重——远远超出预期——可你又清楚，它不可能真的有那么重。是把戏——一定是。
The bead is black, almost obsidian in its shine. Perfectly spherical, perfectly smooth. As you pick it up, you feel the immense weight of it—much heavier than you expected—though you know it can't actually weigh as much as that. A trick—it must be.

Glassy-eyed Junkie Lurches Out Of Alley.name:
目光涣散的瘾君子踉跄着从小巷里冲出来
Glassy-eyed Junkie Lurches Out Of Alley

Text.text:
那男人如同丧尸般，从黑暗里踉跄扑出，喉间挤出一声窒息般的惨叫；褴褛的衣衫与空洞的目光，让他看上去像个不死之物。皮肤蜡黄、布满麻点，最后几缕稀薄的褐发黏在干裂脱屑的头皮上。他步伐癫狂而失序，摇摇晃晃地朝你逼近，同时抽出一把锈迹斑斑的刀刃。
Like a zombie, the man lurches out of the darkness with a strangled cry, his ragged clothing and vacant stare giving him a look of undeath. His skin is sallow and pockmarked, and the last vestiges of wispy brown hair cling to his dry, flaking scalp. His movements are erratic and wild as he staggers toward you, drawing a rusty blade.

Post-apocalyptic Flower Garden.name:
末世花园
Post-apocalyptic Flower Garden

Text.text:
生命似乎总能在逆境中找到繁盛的出路，而这座缤纷花园便是令人心头一酸的明证。它嵌在一只锈蚀的货运集装箱底座上，一排排野花间蜂群嗡鸣，行动喧嚣翻涌；头顶上，鸟儿从坍败的电话杆上轻轻啁啾。

~ MaesterAelix 于 Discord

It seems life always finds a way to flourish in the face of adversity, and this colorful garden is a poignant example. Set into the base of a rusted shipping container, the rows of wildflowers buzz with the tumultuous activity of bees as birds chirp delicately overhead from ruined telephone poles.

~ MaesterAelix on Discord

Otiluke's Freezing Sphere.name:
奥提鲁克的冰封法球
Otiluke's Freezing Sphere

Text.text:
你周身盘旋的魔法迅速凝聚、硬化，化作一颗完美的冰之球体，周围空气已然蒙起薄雾。你命令它疾射而出，它掠空尖啸，宛如骤然裂开的冬日池塘发出刺耳脆响。冰球坠地轰然爆裂，在已冻结的大地上迸出一片六十英尺宽的冰锥带，根根倒刺般向上猛刺。
The magic swirling around you coalesces and hardens into a perfect globe of ice, the air already misting around it. You command it to fly forth and it shrieks as it does, like a sudden crack rending a winter pond. The globe lands and bursts into a sixty-foot swathe of icicles stabbing upward from the now frozen ground.

Underground Dwarven Home.name:
地下矮人居所
Underground Dwarven Home

Text.text:
铁锤敲击铁砧的清脆回响在你钻进这座郊外住宅的精雕石拱门下时，渐渐淡去，化作沉闷的喧嚣。屋子体型不大，却有种令人安心的温暖与惬意——一座热烈诱人的壁炉在华美的扶手椅前噼啪作响。绚丽的地毯铺展在冰冷的石地上，墙面则用小巧圆润的挂钩陈列着一只只做工精妙的酒杯。

~ 由 Discord 上的 Daroneasa Envisioned 于 Discord

The ringing of hammer on anvil fades to a dull clamor as you duck beneath the worked stone archway of the suburban home. Though modest in size, the humble abode is reassuringly cozy—with a warm, inviting hearth crackling before a sumptuous arm chair. Colorful rugs spread across the cold stone floor and tankards of exquisite craftsmanship adorn the walls on small, rounded hooks.

~ Envisioned by Daroneasa on Discord

一汪圆润光滑的水池静静躺在周围岩石地貌投下的阴影里。它深得足以泡澡，却浅得不够游泳，毫无疑问也充当着附近生灵的饮水之所。一侧由岩壁遮蔽，带来几分私密；另一侧则开阔可望远景——再没有比这里更适合把脚趾探入水中小憩的地方了。
A round, smooth pool lies placidly in the shadow of surrounding rock formations. It looks deep enough to bathe in but too shallow to swim, and no doubt it serves as a watering hole for local creatures. With privacy on one side provided by walls of rock, and a view of the landscape out the other, you couldn’t ask for a better place to dip your toes.

Joust Combatant Wounded.name:
马上比武者负伤
Joust Combatant Wounded

Text.text:
人群以原始的嗜血狂吮般嘶吼着，披甲的巨人沿着赛道猛冲而下。钢铁包覆的重装怪物轰然相撞，冲击震得甲胄战栗。两支骑枪同时崩裂，碎片如雨自毁灭处迸射。战马仍在疾驰，其中一名骑士捂住胸口，一截一尺长的木刺从被洞穿的胸甲中突兀地戳出。
The crowd screams with primal bloodlust as the armored titans charge down the list. Crashing together, the juggernauts encased in steel shudder with the impact. Both lances rupture, a shower of splinters erupting from their destruction. The chargers gallop onward, one knight clutching their chest, a foot of wood jutting from their punctured breastplate.

一具幽影自浓雾中逼近。那是新近成就的不死之躯，交织着诸界的能量，魂灵由秘法之力凝聚而生。一阵恶心如潮涌过你——迷惘与疑虑、悲恸与失落。此处盘踞着破碎的心智与腐朽的灵魂。那人形如溪流回旋的涡动般颤抖，时而短暂凝实，又旋即褪回虚空墨黑的无底之无。
A specter looms out of the fog. A newly undead body of mingled planar energies, their spirit forming from mystic energies. A wave of nausea ripples through you—confusion and doubt, grief, and loss. Here sits a shattered mind and a decaying spirit. The humanoid form quivers like the eddy of a stream, becoming briefly solid then fading back into the inky nothing of the void.

Crying Angel Pendant.name:
哭泣天使吊坠
Crying Angel Pendant

Text.text:
你的手四下游移——搜寻着宝藏——一股超凡的能量牵引着它，向下探入污泥深处。你像渔夫般一拽，捞出一枚小小的坠饰，系在一条沾满污渍的丝绳上。它由整块雪花石膏雕成，你掌心的天使是令人心悸的天界绝美典范。她的双翼如沉睡的蝙蝠般收拢环抱着自己，头因疲惫而低垂，脸颊上被刻出一道道深深的沟痕：那是哭泣的双眼落下的泪痕。
Your hand roves—searching for treasure—and an otherworldly energy guides it, down into the muck. Like a fisher, you pull out a small pendant dangling from a cord of soiled silk. Carved from solid alabaster, the angel in your palm is a haunting paragon of celestial beauty. Her wings are folded around her like a sleeping bat, her head is bowed from exhaustion, and furrowed lines have been gouged down her cheeks: streaks of tears fallen from weeping eyes.

Asteroid Mining Facility.name:
小行星采矿设施
Asteroid Mining Facility

Text.text:
在群星的微光与星球的阴影之间，机器在嶙峋的岩面上无声运作。这里无气无生，它们凿掘钻进，扬起层层尘瀑，尘粒映着近处脉冲星的冷辉；那规律的闪烁为停靠平台投下明暗相间的光，照亮着炼制厂贴附在这天体庞大轮廓边缘的钢铁栈道。小行星静静悬在虚空，对设施势不可挡、直逼内核的推进毫无波澜。
Between the light of the stars and the shadows of planets, machines work silently upon the craggy rock surface.
