Airless and lifeless, they dig and drill, kicking up a cascade of dust which reflects the shine of the nearby pulsar, its regular flashes giving illumination to the docking platform of the refinery at the edge of the celestial body's massive form. The asteroid floats in the void unperturbed by the facility's inexorable advance to its core.

这柄野猪矛的矛刃仍染着来自遥远过往的强大生物之血；它平衡极佳，依旧保有如同在现代锻炉中淬炼过的武器般的坚韧力量。
Its blade still stained by the blood of a mighty creature from the distant past, this boar spear is very well balanced and still possesses the strength of a weapon tempered in a modern forge.

Stone-faced Demolitions Expert.name:
冷面爆破专家
Stone-faced Demolitions Expert

Text.text:
此人瘫坐在卡座里，把一根古怪的牙签——手雷的保险销——从满是疤痕的嘴角滚到另一边，穿着高筒军靴的双脚就这么搭在沾污的乙烯基桌面上。你读不出他们的意图：一副巨大的墨镜以镜面镜片遮住了眼神，而那副漫不经心的做派更是滴水不漏。
The individual rolls an odd toothpick—the pin of a grenade—from one corner of their scarred mouth to the other as they sit back in the booth, their jack-booted feet resting on the stained vinyl table. They are impossible to read, with their eyes hidden behind the reflective lenses of large sunglasses, and their casual demeanor gives nothing away.

这头鳞甲恶魔像一只巨大佝偻的爬行动物，斑驳的皮肤覆着黏滑的浆液，肩头、脊背与关节处刺出丛丛倒钩。它粗壮的双臂末端是一对阴狠的利爪。无唇的巨口大张，露出一排排骨白的尖牙；清澈而狡黠、满溢恶意的眼睛，从那张矮壮、如蟾蜍般的面孔里阴阴地窥视着你。
The scaly fiend resembles a massive hunched reptile, with slime-coated, mottled skin and barbs protruding from its shoulders, spine, and joints. Its powerful arms end in a set of wicked claws. A lipless maw gapes, revealing rows of bone-white teeth, and eyes, clear and cunning—filled with malice—peer out from a squat, toad-like face.

Speech About Good People.name:
关于好人的演讲
Speech About Good People

Text.text:
“有时候我会想，这世上还剩下好人吗？善良要如何在这般接踵而至的苦难狂潮中存活？也许他们早已全都离去，而留下来的尽是伪装者与骗子。”
“Sometimes I wonder if there are any good people left. How can good survive such a cavalcade of misery? Perhaps they are all gone, and all who remain are imitators and charlatans.”

I Use Quickened Spell.name:
我使用【快速施法】
I Use Quickened Spell

Text.text:
我迅速将魔力的洪流缚成一体。不再纠结于步骤，只专注于意念本身，我把生猛的奥术原力强行灌入施法之中，填补因仓促而在技巧上留下的每一道空隙。法术以远超应有的速度轰然成形。
I bind the magical forces together quickly. Focusing on intent rather than process, I pump raw arcane power into the casting to shore up any gap in my technique created by my haste. The spell goes off far faster than it should.

Anthro-roach Dumpster Diving.name:
拟人蟑螂翻垃圾箱
Anthro-roach Dumpster Diving

Text.text:
兴奋的吱喳回声在逼仄破败的小巷里回荡，灰暗肮脏的墙壁将声音一遍遍反弹。那只巨大的昆虫形生物在成堆垃圾间翻拣，众多手臂利落如风，迅速把值钱的东西从废渣里挑出来。滴答淌液的颚钳心不在焉地咔嗒作响，节奏游走散漫；那只蟑螂自顾自忙活着——仿佛在哼唱。

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

Enthused chittering echoes from the dingy walls of the cramped, decrepit alley as the large insectoid picks through piles of refuse, its many arms making short work of sorting the valuables from the chaff. Dripping mandibles click absentmindedly in a meandering rhythm as the roach goes about its business—as if it is humming.

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

这件武器不过是一截粗略削成的树枝，简陋得不能再简陋。木纹间的节疤与旋结天然隆起，形成棍身的凸缘，使其每一次挥落都凶狠沉重，威力骇人。
Little more than a roughly whittled branch, this weapon is truly rudimentary. Knots and whorls in the wood create natural flanges to the club, allowing it to strike with brutal, potent efficacy.

Dinesh Of The Yulni.name:
尤尔尼的迪内什
Dinesh Of The Yulni

Text.text:
他翻过部族营地上方的山脊时，猎人露出笑容；缺了一颗牙，让这笑意间显出一道醒目的空隙。太阳从云层后探出身来，把温暖的光线洒在他棕色的皮肤上，他将一缕缕黑发拨离脸颊，去感受那股热度。虽身形高挑精瘦，少年气仍柔和地停驻在他的眉眼间；他迈步如风，正无畏地踏入成人的年岁。一身做工精良的粗犷拼缀兽皮护甲、腰间的刀与手中的弓，便是他在荒野里活下去所需的一切；那双棕色眼眸闪着锐利的聪慧，像雄鹰般威严而清明。

~ Played by Walt M.

As he crests the ridge above his tribe’s camp the hunter smiles, a missing tooth leaving a pronounced gap in the gesture. The sun emerges from the clouds to cast warming rays on the man’s brown skin, and he pushes locks of black hair away from his face to feel the heat. Though tall and lean, the softness of youth still dominates his features as he strides boldly into adulthood. A well-made patchwork of rugged hide armor, a knife, and his bow provide him with everything he needs to survive in the wilds, and his brown eyes shine with a keen intelligence like a majestic eagle.

~ Played by Walt M.

I Peer Through My Eyes Of The Eagle.name:
我以鹰之眼窥视
I Peer Through My Eyes Of The Eagle

Text.text:
透过这副瞪大眼的护目镜那漆黑的镜片，我能清晰捕捉到数英里外哪怕最细微的动静。我左右微倾头颅，扫视地平线寻找我的目标，像一只猛禽锁定无助的田鼠般步步逼近。
Peering through the dark lenses of these wide-eyed goggles, I can clearly see even the faintest of movements miles away. I tilt my head to and fro, scanning the horizon for my target, like a bird of prey zoning in on a hapless vole.

恐惧在这高耸恶魔周身沸腾，灼烫着心智。黑色尖角如冠压在他头顶，双眼在其下以仇恨的余烬暗燃；其中两根更粗更长，向外、向前盘卷。参差獠牙从他牛般的口中突兀伸出，硬直的黑发覆满头颈、下颌与肩胛，也铺在前臂与双腿上，尾端还生着一撮。粗糙的暗红近黑的皮肤更像由无数伤疤织成的网，裹住他起伏鼓胀的筋肉。他咆哮着，双角间腾起火光，举起一柄残忍带倒刺的长戟蓄势待发。
Terror boils the air around the towering fiend, searing the mind. His eyes smolder with hate under a crown of black horns, two larger and longer, curling outward and forward. Snaggled fangs protrude from his bovine mouth, and wiry black hair covers his head, neck, jawline, and shoulders, along with his forearms, legs, and a tuft at the end of his tail. Rough, reddish-black skin, more a network of countless scars, wraps his rippling thews. He snarls, and fire kindles between his horns as he readies a cruel, barbed halberd.

The Tyrant Lord Of Discord.name:
纷争的暴君领主
The Tyrant Lord Of Discord

Text.text:
女子身形纤细，被飘逸长袍包裹，薄纱遮住了精致的五官。她的眼睛如两泓黑曜石的深潭，在布料上方微光闪烁，散发着超自然的魅惑。兜帽之下，细长的蠕动触须在丝绸下顶起起伏，扭结翻绞。她美得不似人间，气息摄人，目光被牵引过去，却让血液发冷。

~ Envisioned by Vhalaron

The woman’s slender form is sheathed in flowing robes, a veil masking delicate features. Her eyes, twin pools of obsidian, gleam above the fabric, glowing with a supernatural allure. Beneath her hood, long tendrils of coiling movement push at the silk, writhing. There’s an otherworldly beauty to her, a captivating aura that draws the eye but chills the blood.

~ Envisioned by Vhalaron

Fundamentalist Religious Zealot.name:
原教旨宗教狂热者
Fundamentalist Religious Zealot

Text.text:
这名雌雄莫辨的身影披着深红长袍，袍上绣着明亮的黄色火焰徽记，站在一段台阶的顶端；下方聚起一小群人，屏息凝神地听着。像个异乡的僧侣，他们在一片企业西装与“快乐小子”的机能潮服之间格外扎眼。那张脸绷成一副怪诞而极度专注的面具。他们高高举起一本陈旧破烂的书，整个人沉浸在宗教般的狂喜里，像是命悬一线般嘶声布道。也许确实如此。
Dressed in dark red robes stitched with a bright yellow flame symbol, this androgynous figure stands at the top of a set of steps, a small crowd gathered below in rapt attention. Like some foreign monk, they stand out among the corpo suits and joyboy techwear. Their face is a mask of grotesque concentration. They hold out an old and battered book, in the full swing of religious ecstasies, preaching like their life depends on it. Maybe it does.

Baron Jessbrand Of Mountavidor.name:
蒙塔维多尔的杰斯布兰德男爵
Baron Jessbrand Of Mountavidor

Text.text:
石头的气味——铜与壤土的气息——先于这名矮壮精悍的矮人现身。他的皮肤红润，像锻炉里烤出的青铜般发亮。腰带与斜挎带上挂着十来把斧子，形制各异、体型不一；每一把都是手工锻造的证据，诉说着他在铁砧前的技能。他那蓬乱的胡须如灼热铁色的浓郁赤褐，几乎垂到腰间，末梢被走失的火星燎得焦卷。他歪斜笑容里的戏谑被另一种敏捷压住——他的手总能在眨眼间摸上众多斧柄中的一根。
The smell of stone—of copper and loam—precedes the appearance of this stocky, well-built dwarf with ruddy, forge-bronzed skin. A dozen axes of myriad shape and size adorn belts and bandoliers, each a hand-forged testament to the dwarf’s skill at the anvil. His bushy beard, the rich auburn of scalding iron, hangs nearly to his belt, singed at its ends by errant embers. The playfulness of his crooked smile is tempered by the quickness with which his hand finds the haft of one of his many axes.

Tranquilizing Street Drug, Dopadrine.name:
镇静街头毒品：多巴德林
Tranquilizing Street Drug, Dopadrine

Text.text:
粉红色的气体在折叠的管内扩散开来，鼓胀成一串串气泡，被挤压着穿过塑料漏斗喷向空中。它抵达目标时，便将其整个吞没。躯体开始摇摇欲坠，韧带松弛，肌腱颤抖。他们像暴食般沉溺于兴奋剂的瘾君子一样，蜷缩着坍塌下去。

~ 由一位英雄所构想

A pink gas expands within a folded tube. It wells up into bubbles, pushed outward through a plastic funnel into the air. As it reaches the target, it envelops them. The body grows wobbly, ligaments loosening, tendons trembling. They collapse upon themselves, like a stim addict in the throes of a binge.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这支精灵打造的标枪，杆身以纤细却坚韧的山核桃木制成；枪头被磨砺得锋如剃刃，形貌宛如一枚被放大到夸张程度的箭镞，仿佛出自布码长箭的箭杆。
Mounted to a slender but tough shaft of hickory, the head of this elven-made javelin has been honed to a razor’s sharpness, resembling nothing so much as an overgrown arrowhead from a cloth-yard shaft.

Loot From A Necromancer's Blighted Wyrml.name:
从死灵法师的枯败幼龙身上搜刮的战利品
Loot From A Necromancer's Blighted Wyrmlings

Text.text:
枯槁的幼龙接连倒下，它们那在雾蒙蒙、黯淡失色的鳞片之间的纸薄皮膜再也不曾扑动。你跨过尸骸时，几缕微光倏然掠过眼角。你撕开蒙雾的鳞甲与条条皮片，竟发现——真是走运！——其下仍残留着幼龙曾经闪耀的鳞片碎痕。看来这场枯败终究没能接触到这些生物的每一处。
The withered wyrmlings fall, the papery skin between their foggily tarnished scales fluttering no more. As you step over the corpses, small glints catch your eye. You tear away fogged scales and strips of skin to find—what luck!—remnants of the wyrmlings’ shining scales underneath. It seems the blight did not touch every part of these creatures, after all.

那位俊雅的雄辩者溶入成年的猛虎——琥珀色皮毛上带着斑驳的条纹；幻影般的长袍褪去，取而代之的是一袭华美至极的托加长袍，辉煌得连神祇都愿为将它纳入衣橱而开战。它肩腿粗壮，腰胯与颈项却纤长，身形比大多数人类还高出整整一头。它俯视着你，灵猫般的眼睛游走其间，傲慢而暴烈。它探爪向前时你不由一颤——那带爪的指节竟以违逆骨骼的角度，从爪掌上诡异地向外弯折。低沉的呼噜在肌肉虬结的胸腔里层层荡开，眼中猛地一闪，饥渴的翠绿如浪涌起。
The comely orator dissolves into the streaked amber fur of an adult tiger, and its illusory robes are replaced by a toga of such magnificence that gods would war to add it to their wardrobe. Thick of shoulders and legs, yet slender through the hips and neck, it stands a head taller than most humans. It looks down on you, civet eyes roving with haughty violence. You twitch as it reaches forward, for its clawed fingers bend unnaturally away from its paw. A deep purr ripples through the muscled chest as a wave of ravenous green flashes in its eyes.

I Cast Sending.name:
我施放【传讯术】
I Cast Sending

Text.text:
我僵直地站着，将右臂笔直举过头顶。右手里捏着一段短短的铜丝细线。我在心中描摹收信之人的模样，随即说话，将讯息沿着手臂送出，穿过那根导线。它瞬息穿越以太，直抵目标的心智，意思无误。我静候他们的回音。
Standing rigid, I hold my right arm straight above my head. In my right hand is a short filament of copper. I picture my recipient and, speaking my message, I send it up my arm and through the wire. It travels instantly through the ether to my target’s mind, understanding ensured. I await their reply.

Ooze Domain: Fiendish Ooze.name:
软泥领域：邪魔软泥
Ooze Domain: Fiendish Ooze

Text.text:
一层油腻的薄膜从水面与墙壁上剥离翻起，堆叠成一股咕嘟冒泡的浪潮，猛然向你涌来。它的动作完全不像寻常液体，但即便如此，你的思绪仍要迟上一瞬，才认出那团在你面前昂然竖起的黏浆——竟是一种活物。
An oily slick peels up from the water and walls, building into a bubbling wave and surging toward you. It doesn’t move like normal liquid, but even so, it takes your mind a moment to recognize the ooze rearing up before you as a living thing.

I Cast Charm Person.name:
我施放「魅惑人类」
I Cast Charm Person

Text.text:
我知道他们总会从这种状态里醒来，但那一瞬的满足感值得。我温言细语，点头附和，双手暗中编织奥术，动作在我的目标眼里却显得格外顺眼。“你好，朋友，”我说，而他们以为自己认得我。“照做，”我说，而他们就照做。我最爱他们挥手的样子。
I know they always wake from this, but the momentary satisfaction is worth it. I speak kindly, nodding in agreement, my hands working the arcana in gestures my mark sees as agreeable. Hello, friend, I say, and they think they recognize me. Do this, I say, and they do it. I love it when they wave.

Sundries From A Nalfeshnee.name:
纳尔费什尼的杂货
Sundries From A Nalfeshnee

Text.text:
纳尔费什尼轰然倒成一团，它那躯体的恶臭仍在空气中盘桓，即便生命正从它怨毒的双眼里迅速褪去。你周围的巢穴遍布污秽之物，那些东西或许曾是值钱的器物。类人生物的骨头与骸骨无力地散落在桌上，旁边是沾着暗黑污渍的餐具与被砸碎的盘子。
The nalfeshnee falls in a heap, the stench of its body persisting even as life fades from its hateful eyes. The lair about you is riddled with filthy objects that may have once been things of worth. Humanoid bones and skeletons lie listlessly on tables next to darkly stained cutlery and smashed plates.

这片街区的西侧曾在很长一段时代里只是座果园，如今却被一排排砖石与灰泥的新楼取代，大半树影都已让位。街对面，一家新开的修车铺和杂货店，正对着几栋仍保留原样的锯木老屋——比如社团会馆，还有一家依旧开张的钉蹄铁匠铺。街区南端则有城中众多喷泉漫步公园之一，水声作伴，供人闲游。
The west side of this ward was for a long time only a fruit orchard, but new buildings of block and plaster replaced most of the trees. There’s a new mechanic and a grocery store across the street from some original sawn timber buildings, like the society hall and a farrier still in business. The south end of the ward has one of the city’s many fountain-centered strolling parks.

这支标枪做工朴素，不过是一根又长又细的木杆。一端装着棕色条纹的羽翎，另一端则削成阴狠尖利的刺。此等武器谈不上杰作，却足以让人领教它的厉害。
The javelin is plainly made, little more than a long, slender shaft of wood. It is fletched with brown striped feathers at one end and whittled down to a wicked spike at the other. This weapon is no masterpiece, but it is sure to get its point across.

Owlbear Tracks In A Forest.name:
森林中的枭熊足迹
Owlbear Tracks In A Forest

Text.text:
一条磨得发亮的兽径蜿蜒穿过这片森林，然而这里却静得反常——野生动物仿佛尽数消失，透着不祥。四周树干上布满深深的抓痕，像被巨力撕裂般。道路旁一串醒目的深爪足印沿途延伸，随后穿过被折弯的枝叶，转而没入周遭的荒野之中。
A well-worn game trail wends through this forest, yet it is unnaturally silent—the wildlife ominously missing. Deep gouges score the trunks of surrounding trees. And prominent, deep-clawed tracks line the path then lead off through bent foliage into the surrounding wilderness.

Slavers' Auction House.name:
奴隶拍卖行
Slavers' Auction House

Text.text:
一群垂头丧气的身影被押上粗陋的阶段，眼神黯淡而空洞，戴着镣铐拖着步子踉跄前行。在这里，有知觉的血肉被明码标价，活生生的生命被买卖、转手、交换，如同牲口般的货物。无论他们的新主人残忍还是仁慈，和善还是暴怒，他们都无法左右自己的命运这一事实都不会改变。他们别无选择，只能在被认定仍有用处的日子里，长久地活在奴役之中。
Dejected figures are marched out onto a rude stage, eyes dim and listless as they shuffle forward in their manacles. For here, sentient flesh is for sale, living beings bought, sold, and traded as chattel. Whether their new owners are cruel or merciful, friendly or wrathful, the fact that they have no say in their fate does not change. They have no choice but to live in servitude for so long as they are deemed useful.

I Lucid Dream To A Realm Of Fire.name:
我在清醒梦中坠入火焰之境
I Lucid Dream To A Realm Of Fire

Text.text:
在我的梦里，我面对一扇门。我选择以烈焰之境为目的地，迈步向前。门在我周身消融，我踏入一片荒漠。脚下的地面在足底化作细砾——是沙还是灰，我一时分不清。炽烈的天空翻滚着赤红云团。远处的群山在酷热中摇曳颤动，而梦中的我只感到那热度的一小部分。就像站在熔炉旁太近——灼烫，却尚能忍受。
In my dream, I face a door. I choose a realm of fire as my destination and walk forward. The door dissolves around me and I step into a desert. The floor turns to grit beneath my feet—sand or ash, I can’t quite tell. A fiery sky boils with red clouds. Distant mountains shimmer in the intense heat, which my dream self feels only fractionally. It feels like standing too close to a furnace—torrid, but tolerable.

Cyberpunk Pawn Shop.name:
赛博朋克典当行
Cyberpunk Pawn Shop

Text.text:
[外面] 这栋建筑阴沉可怖，显然曾是企业街区的一部分，如今却坠落至破败不堪；用不匹配的混凝土、钢筋和锈蚀铁皮东拼西补地勉强支撑。几张合成流行乐队的旧海报——褪色又被涂改——贴满了当铺无窗的外墙。入口旁蜷着个流浪汉，正抽着某种刺鼻、泛蓝的东西。闪烁不定的霓虹招牌写着 Central Exchange Hub。

[里面] 柜台后一个干瘦老妪戴着一双露指手套，搓着沾污的双手，面前散落堆着一摞摞信用点。店面宽而深，一排排玻璃展示柜仿佛望不到头，塞满了电子垃圾和各式小玩意儿。几名顾客沿着货架慢吞吞地晃着，翻拣物品，搜寻宝藏。昏低的橙色灯光让这里泛着浑浊的微光，空气里还隐约带着潮湿的气味。

[Outside] This is a grim construction, clearly once a corpo block before falling into disrepair, patched together with mismatched concrete, rebar, and rusted iron. Old posters of synthpop bands—faded and defaced—line the windowless exterior of the pawn shop. A bum lies next to the entrance, smoking something foul-smelling and blue. The flickering neon sign reads Central Exchange Hub.

[Inside] A wizened woman behind the counter rubs her grubby hands together in a pair of fingerless gloves over credits piled loose across the counter. The shop is broad and deep, with endless glass display counters full of tech junk and knickknacks. A few patrons mooch along the rows, picking through items, searching for treasure. Low orange lighting gives the place a murky glow, and there’s a faint smell of damp.

Dhampir Wizard.name:
吸血裔（特征）法师
Dhampir Wizard

Text.text:
女巫悄然逼近，流动的黑袍簌簌作响，仿佛坠落的乌鸦羽毛翻飞；她那不老的面容像是从大理石里冷冷雕琢出的伪美。她以棱角分明的目光打量着你，眼中闪烁着恶毒的智慧；她微微偏头，乌黑长发如墨瀑般倾泻在窄削的肩头，成串滑落，扰人心神。修长如钢琴家的手指攥住一根橡木法杖，木身被血河般的猩红浸染；她漆亮、锉尖的长指甲深深抠进木里，而她黑色的唇吐出幽暗的魔法。
The wizard stalks forward, flowing black robes swishing like falling crow feathers, her ageless face seemingly sculpted from marble in a cold attempt at beauty. She regards you with angular eyes that sparkle with malfeasant intelligence, tilting her head so her ebon hair cascades over her narrow shoulders in distracting rivulets. Long pianist fingers wrap around an oak staff stained scarlet by rivers of blood, her lacquered filed-tip nails gouging into the wood as her black lips voice her dark magic.

Swift Subterranean Stream.name:
迅疾的地下暗流
Swift Subterranean Stream

Text.text:
若非那急湍奔涌的轰鸣，你几乎会在黑暗中错过这条溪流。它自洞穴般的空间一侧涌出，又在另一侧隐没，沿着光滑湿润的岩石间一道深深的沟槽蜿蜒而行——在这漆黑的洞中，历经万古，它早已为自己凿出了一条归途。
Were it not for the roar of the swiftly-moving current, you might have missed the stream in the darkness. Emerging from one side of the cavernous space only to disappear into the other, the stream follows a deep groove through the smooth, slick stone, having eroded a path for itself over eons here in the black of the cave.

巨兽踏着轰雷般的蹄声前行，手中紧攥一杆长枪，枪上披挂着绚丽的旗幡。其下半身宛如一匹巨大的栗色骏马，上半身则像魁梧健壮、肌肉虬结的人形。它高举长枪，唇间迸出震天战吼，伴随着巨蹄如战鼓般的轰鸣，猛然冲锋。
The beast moves on thundering hooves, a spear draped with colorful banners clutched in their hand. Their lower half resembles a massive chestnut stallion, while the upper half evokes a burly, muscled humanoid. A mighty war cry escapes their lips as they hold aloft the spear and—with the mighty drum of colossal hooves—charge.

Recovering From Cybersurgery.name:
从赛博外科手术中恢复
Recovering From Cybersurgery

Text.text:
半昏半醒的厌恶一波波穿过你残破的躯体，你从手术中苏醒。干涩的、化学品般的苦味糊住口腔。那道起泡的裂口像烙印般标出某个位置——有什么至关重要的东西曾从你体内被硬生生撕走——失落与亵渎感在其中溃烂化脓。可留下来的，比失去的更可怕：不自然的铬色螺旋自伤口里攀出，刮擦着下方的骨头。你的思绪天旋地转，脑中某个原始的部分拼命想要逃离。然而无处可逃，因为那份恐怖如今已在你体内。

~ 一位英雄设想

Waves of semiconscious revulsion ripple through your mangled body as you wake from surgery. Dry, chemical bitterness coats your mouth. A feeling of loss and violation suppurates from the blistered rent marking the place where something vital was ripped from you. What was left behind is far worse. Unnatural chrome spirals up out of the wound, grating at the bone beneath. Your mind reels as some primal part of your brain seeks to flee. But there is nowhere to run, for the horror is inside you now.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

三枚巨龙獠牙如同骨化的王冠般压在这柄威严的武器顶端，每一根尖叉都是金属与骨质交织的僵硬尖塔。沿着柄身，一条龙形浮雕在焦黑的金属上狂暴奔突，它那风格化的躯体沿着三叉戟的全长延展。
A trio of dragon fangs top this imposing weapon like an ossified crown, each tine a rigid spire of metal and bone. Along the haft, a draconic form rampages over the blackened metal, its stylized body stretching the length of the trident.

巨大的斯芬克斯以天穹般的威严傲然伫立，冷峻而疏离，宛如一道不可逾越的壁垒，横亘在你与它守护的区域之间。它几乎免疫一切伤害，唯有最强横的打击方能撼动；更能随手驱使威力惊人的法术。这些传说中的狮身神兽，让它们所守护的宝藏坚不可摧，甚至比人们能想象出的最严密银行金库还要安全。
Standing proud and aloof in its celestial majesty, the sphinx serves as an impenetrable barrier between you and the area which it guards. Immune to all but the mightiest blows and with potent spells at its command, these leonine creatures of legend make the treasures they guard more secure than could the greatest bank vault ever conceived.

Erasto \"Pig Iron\" Teshin.name:
埃拉斯托“生铁”特辛
Erasto "Pig Iron" Teshin

Text.text:
这道魁梧的身影与其说是兽人，不如说更像机器。鼠尾草色的皮肤从金属补片与缠绕的电线间若隐若现。厚垫皮夹克和宽松牛仔裤上沾满油污，腰间的工具腰带陈列着他吃饭的家伙。一把手枪垂在胯侧，一支沉重的突击步枪背在身后——在大都会讨生活，这些都是必要的负重。他的头缓缓转向你。义体墨镜从眼前滑开，露出一双酸蚀般的绿色目光。他的神情更显凶悍——两根粗大的獠牙从口中突出。

~ 由一位英雄扮演

The hulking figure is more machine than orc. Hints of sage skin peek between patches of metal and lacings of wire. His padded leather jacket and baggy jeans are stained with grease, and the utility belt around his waist showcases the tools of his trade. A pistol hangs from his hip and a heavy assault rifle is strapped to his back—necessary burdens for a life in the metropolis. His head turns slowly toward you. Cybernetic shades slide back from his eyes, revealing an acidic, green stare. His look is made more fearsome by the two large tusks protruding from his mouth.

~ Played by a Hero

Orianna, Devotee Of The Moon Goddess And.name:
奥莉安娜，月之女神的虔诚信徒，圣廷宗教裁判所成员
Orianna, Devotee Of The Moon Goddess And Member Of The Holy Inquisition

Text.text:
尽管年纪尚轻，这位高挑、赤红肌肤的提夫林依旧夺目。她的步伐带着倦意，却不失优雅；而她把闪耀的板甲护甲与武器随意扛上肩头的姿态，又让人一眼看出那份沉稳的力量。她的皮肤泛着红光，双眼灼烈，头发如焰色翻卷——你本以为她会虔奉某种元素之力；可她外袍与盾牌上的纹记却昭示着，她是一名献身于月之女神的骑士。

~ Played by Eric Miller

Striking despite her youth, the tall, red-skinned tiefling moves with a weary grace, though her strength is evident in the nonchalant way she shoulders her gleaming plate armor and weapons. Between her red-tinged skin, her blazing eyes, and hair the color of flames, you would expect her to hold an Elemental Power in veneration, but the markings along her tabard and shield would indicate that she is a knight dedicated to the Goddess of the Moon.

~ Played by Eric Miller

Explosion In A City Square.name:
城市广场上的爆炸
Explosion In A City Square

Text.text:
广场猛然一震，人们还在忙着清晨的营生，橙色火光一闪，挟着一股向外狂涌的气浪横扫而出。光与轰鸣褪去，世界陷入刹那死寂。随即，惊恐的叫喊与痛苦的哀嚎骤然炸开，四面八方传来急促奔逃的脚步回声。焦黑的尸体与烧伤的受害者在燃起的碎屑间翻滚坠地。木柴燃烧的气味混着烤肉与焦发的恶臭。街道、摊位与店铺门面上，新点燃的火头吐出滚滚浓烟。

~ 一位英雄 Envisioned

A blast shakes the square as folk go about their morning business, the flash of orange fire sending forth a wave of outrushing air. As the light and roar fade, an instant of silence. Then panicked shouts and pained cries erupt, and the sound of running feet echoes from all directions. Blackened corpses and burned victims tumble to the ground amid ignited debris. Odors of woodfire mix with those of roasted meat and burning hair. Smoke rises from newly kindled fires in the streets, stalls, and storefronts.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Arrow Of Seelie Craftsmanship.name:
妖精匠艺之箭
Arrow Of Seelie Craftsmanship

Text.text:
这支箭由光滑的符文刻木雕琢而成，藤蔓缠绕着箭杆蜿蜒攀附，间或抽出点点翠绿新芽。箭羽处迸放出缤纷花束般的明艳花瓣，与箭头抛光的冷冽铁质形成鲜明对比。作为诸廷之间那场被遗忘的战争遗留之物，此箭对妖精生物而言致命无比。
Crafted from smooth, rune-carved wood, vines twist around the arrow’s shaft, sprouting small green buds. Bright petals of every hue erupt in a colorful bouquet from the fletching, contrasting the polished iron of the arrowhead. A remnant of a forgotten war between the Courts, this arrow is utterly deadly to fey creatures.

I Cast Magic Missile From My Robe Of Sta.name:
我从星辰长袍中施放魔法飞弹
I Cast Magic Missile From My Robe Of Stars

Text.text:
我蜷起手指，扣住袍领上缝着的六颗星之一，掌心里魔法随之绽放。三团能量在我握紧的拳中来回弹跳。法术的热度灼得发烫时，我猛地甩出刺痛的手掌，朝我的目标射出三枚嗡鸣作响的魔法飞矢。
I curl my fingers around one of the six stars sewn into the collar of my robe and feel the magic bloom in my palm. Three bursts of energy bounce around within my fist. As the heat of the spell becomes scorching, I fling out my stinging hand and send three humming, magical darts toward my target.

Equinoxian Apastra.name:
春分使徒阿帕斯特拉
Equinoxian Apastra

Text.text:
一尊由烈焰与黄色憎恨铸成的泰坦从黑暗中轰然迸出。四条手臂翻涌着一颗遥远垂死恒星的伟力——半似黑洞，半如炽阳。光子与引力子之浪在它强健的躯干中起伏奔涌，先化作漆黑，继而在不祥热潮的倾泻中燃成明亮橙红。那异界来客的恶魔面孔末端是一只伤痕累累、狰狞可怖的喙，啃噬着真实空间的空气。两处空洞的眼眶里回荡着一抹疯狂的寒光。
A titan of flame and yellow hate bursts forth from the darkness. Four arms ripple with the power of a distant, dying star—part black hole, part blazing sun. Waves of photons and gravitons undulate through its powerful torso, turning black, then bright orange in a cascade of ominous heat. The outsider’s demonic face ends in a scarred and nasty beak, gnawing at the air of realspace. A mad glint echoes in two empty eye sockets.

一对扭曲盘旋的巨角冠在这头高耸恶魔宽阔的头颅上。巨大的皮翼托举着这只生物凌空而立，它一只手握着一柄阴森的黑钢双叉干草叉。它露出狰狞的笑，黄牙成排森然可见；另一只手中凭空招来火焰——将稀薄空气凝成地狱之火。
A pair of gnarled, sweeping horns crest the broad head of this towering fiend. Massive, leathery wings hold the creature aloft, and in one hand it holds a wicked-looking two-pronged pitchfork of black steel. It smiles wickedly, displaying rows of yellow teeth, as it conjures flame in its other hand—coalescing hellfire from thin-air.

Library Of Arcana: The Restricted Sectio.name:
秘奥图书馆：禁书区
Library Of Arcana: The Restricted Section

Text.text:
每靠近这一片区域一步，都像纵身跃入群星之间无尽的黑暗。你知道自己仍能回头，别过脸去，退回到仅在寸前、片刻前你还站立过的那片更安全的岸边。你只需现在转身，在一切为时已晚之前。可在你前方，矗立着承载禁忌知识的书架，等待采撷，成熟得令人心悸。书页无声地躺着，等你伸手，渴望你的目光落在其上，读懂其中的意义。
Every step nearer to this section feels like a leap into the infinite dark between the stars. You know you can still go back, turn your face away, and retreat to the safer shores you stood upon just inches ago and moments before. You need only turn around now, before it’s too late. But ahead of you stand the shelves where forbidden knowledge waits, ripe for the plucking. The pages lie silent, waiting for your hand, yearning for your eyes to look upon them and understand.

A Conflict Of Elementals.name:
元素灵的冲突
A Conflict Of Elementals

Text.text:
一股火与冰交织的旋涡龙卷在下方大地上肆虐横行，游离的能量霹雳四处乱窜，把土地烙得伤痕累累。翻滚的元素熔炉里，扭曲变形的面孔凄厉尖啸；源自远古的词句被抛向空中，如雷云般轰鸣滚荡，诸般生灵在彼此嘲弄中叫嚣不休。

~ 由 Envisioned 的 DaveDaWanderer 于 Discord 构想

A swirling tornado of fire and ice runs rampant over the land below, scarring the earth with bolts of stray energy. Warped, distorted faces scream in the roiling elemental caldera, and words of ancient provenance are hurled through the air like thunderheads as the creatures taunt one another.

~ Envisioned by DaveDaWanderer on Discord

Staff Of The Woodlands.name:
林地法杖
Staff Of The Woodlands

Text.text:
一股馥郁而野性的芬芳自这根魅惑法杖纠结的年轮纹理间飘散而出，杖顶盘绕的枝杈宛如古树般抽生出葱郁翠绿的叶片。杖身接触时温热，脉动着自然那狂放、轻盈而沸腾的原始活力。
A fragrant, feral aroma drifts from the knotted whorls of the enchanting staff, and verdant green leaves sprout like an ancient tree from the twisting branches at its top. The rod is warm to the touch and pulses with the wild, effervescent energy of nature.

月亮悬在天际，像一只饱含期待、血色欲滴的眼。远处的嚎叫先是狼一般的长嗥，孤独而熟悉。很快，它们又与人类尖厉的狂笑交织在一起，那种肆意癫狂令人彻骨发寒。最终，所有声响都坍塌成怪物般的咆哮。月亮在上方幽幽沸腾，仿佛恐惧、饥饿与骇怖的坩埚。
The moon hangs in the sky like an expectant, sanguine eye. Howls in the distance begin wolfish, lonely and familiar. Soon they mingle with shrieking human laughter, chilling in their mad abandon. Eventually, all noise devolves into monstrous roars. The moon simmers above, a crucible of fear, hunger, and horror.

这只特定的巨鼠标本，和它那些较小的表亲一样恶毒。它龇出獠牙、嘶嘶作响，只要稍有机会便会凶狠地发动攻击——还会得到同类的支援。
This particular specimen of giant rat is as nasty as any of its lesser cousins. Baring its fangs and hissing, it will attack ferociously at the slightest opportunity—with the support of its brethren.

矮人雕塑家双手猛击黏土，将可塑的地貌奋力拱起，塑成群山与巨砾。他用粗短的手指在其间刻凿，捏出一条河流穿过山谷蜿蜒而下。他只退后片刻，抹去额头上的汗与泥，又立刻扑回去，这次换上刃具，在山脚刻出细密纹理，营造出松林铺展的幻象。  
“家。”他粗声说道，“或者说，我记忆里的家。你们找我有什么事？”
The dwarf sculptor attacks the clay with both hands, heaving the malleable landscape up to form mountains and boulders. He carves into it with his stout fingers, forming a river winding through a valley. He stands back only a moment to wipe sweat and clay from his brow before diving back in, using a bladed tool now to add texture to the base of the mountains, creating the illusion of a pine forest. "Home," he says gruffly. "Or what I remember of it. What can I do for you?"

Border Town Tournament.name:
边境小镇锦标赛
Border Town Tournament

Text.text:
在这片边境上，用来装点门面的资源和旗帜一样单薄。马上比武用的挡杆是粗凿的原木，未施涂彩，但铁匠与木匠手艺精熟，坐骑也强健而烈。看台上空着几排座位，许多观战的贵族仍穿着骑装。几名骑士与侍从脸上胡茬未刮，人人的成色都不高，正如奖品一般寒酸。然而，这些外巡骑手与游侠骑士之间有种安静的同袍情谊——从他们握手的力道里可见一斑，也藏在他们慢而长的饮酒节奏中。
On this frontier, the resources for beauty are as thin as the banners. The tilt bar is rough-hewn wood, unpainted, but the smith and carpenter are skilled, and the horses strong and spirited. The stands have some empty seats, and many of the nobles watching are wearing their riding clothes. Some knights and squires have unshaven faces, and the quality of them all is low, just like the prizes. There is a quiet camaraderie among these outriders and ranging knights, though, noticeable in their handshakes and the long, slow way they drink.

宛如天穹之上的希望灯塔般熠熠生辉，那枚化身光明的天界光球缓缓飘过你的行途。他们扇动着精雕细琢的金辉羽翼，翼展不逊于任何猫头鹰；一边发出清亮的颤鸣，兴奋地施展繁复的空中翻转与回旋，仿佛在催促你跟上。随即，他们从太阳般的核心迸射出一道揭示万象的光束，为你指明方向。你的灵魂仿佛汲取着那抹金色光辉而愈发充盈，你感到无可撼动，仿佛一切绝望都在它的热度中融化殆尽。
Shining like a heavenly beacon of hope, the celestial sphere of incarnate light drifts across your path. They flutter on intricately sculpted aureate wings as large as any owl’s. Performing complex aerobatic maneuvers while trilling their excitement, they seem to want you to follow them. They indicate a direction by unleashing a beam of revealing light from their solar core. Your very spirit seems to feed off that golden light, and you feel indomitable as if all despair has melted away in the heat of its presence.

一团覆鳞的血肉纠结着缓缓解开，松散出暗红与漆黑的长长丝缕，最终汇成一具修长蜿蜒、满覆条纹的蛇形躯体。眼镜蛇般的颈罩骤然张开，露出一圈以利爪为尖的骨质边缘，如光环般环绕着一张非人的面容。纯黑的眼睛从扁平的脸上冷冷逼视；那张脸只有一枚小鼻与一张宽阔的獠牙巨口，使这生物显得惊人聪慧，却毫无半分怜悯。
A tangle of scaled flesh unknots, loosening long strands of dark red and black, which resolve into one long, serpentine body covered in stripes. A cobra-like hood opens, revealing a talon-tipped flange that halos an inhuman visage. Utterly black eyes glare from a flat face that has a small nose and wide, fanged mouth, giving this creature the appearance of startling intelligence but no empathy.

满载待售货物的船只塞满了水道，胆子够大的人甚至可以从一条船踏到另一条船上。确有人这么做，为的是细挑货品、当面讨价还价；但更多人隔着船帮高声叫卖，货物与钱在人手间一递一接。尽管喧嚣混乱得像一锅沸水，这套门道却似乎真能让人各取所需。
Boats ladened with items for sale clog the waterway, making it possible—for those brave enough—to step from one to another. Some people are doing just that, in order to choose purchases and bargain directly, but most people engage in shouted bartering, with goods and money passing hand to hand. Despite the clamor and chaos of it all, the system seems to work for people.

Street Gang Haunt In Ruined Apartments.name:
废弃公寓里的街头帮派出没
Street Gang Haunt In Ruined Apartments

Text.text:
这栋老公寓楼若曾有过风光岁月，也早已被岁月啃噬殆尽。塌陷的屋顶豁开一道巨大的裂口，像一处骇人的头部重创，顶层因此敞露无遗，任鸽子栖落，也任夹着泥污的雨水浸透。可徘徊在此的并不只有斑秃羽毛的禽鸟与破碎的回忆。每层的阳台上都晃着一群隐在阴影里的身影。他们头上绑着发光的护目镜，沿着栏杆游荡时，恍若一群绿眼的幽魂；步枪的长影从他们身侧拖出，像从躯体里延伸出来的黑刺。某处破洞里传来一阵喧闹的哄笑，蓝色的电视光在洞口忽明忽暗地眨着。
If this old apartment building has ever seen better days, they are long gone. The caved-in roof gapes like a massive head wound, leaving the top floor open for pigeons to roost and for the muck-laden rain to soak. But it’s not only patchy-feathered fowl and shattered memories lingering here. Shadowed figures hang out on the balconies of each floor. The glowing goggles strapped to their heads make them seem like green-eyed specters floating along the railings, with long shadows of rifles extending out from their bodies. A raucous bout of shared laughter echoes out of a hole where the blue light of a TV screen winks in and out.

推开这处狭小壁龛的门，一团尘云猛地涌入寝室，呛得空气发紧。蜿蜒的薄雾在更开阔的空间里渐渐散开，视线与通路随之清晰，直通幽暗的走廊。再往里走出几步，便见一座直抵天花板的瓦砾堆横亘眼前，彻底封死了前路。
After pushing open the door to this small alcove, a cloud of dust billows out into the bedchamber, choking the air. The wending mist dissipates in the wider space, allowing sight and clear passage into the dark hall. A few steps in reaches a ceiling-high pile of rubble barring any way forward.

“来啊，都来啊！”马戏团领班豪迈地高喊，声浪足以让半英里内的人都听得清清楚楚。他们身披鲜艳的猩红外套，内衬一件紫罗兰色马甲，两者都缀满耀眼的金色纽扣与扣钉。一顶高礼帽端端正正压在头顶，勉强遮住一团蓬松卷曲的红发。他挥动手杖示意众人入帐，许诺糖果点心、甜蜜滋味，以及前所未见的奇景。为强调这番话，他又潇洒一抛手杖；接住的瞬间“啪”地一声，手杖竟变作一束繁花。他夸张地单膝致礼，将花递给路过的一家人。
"Come one, come all!" the ringmaster shouts boisterously, loud enough for all within a half-mile to hear. They wear a bright crimson coat over a violet vest, each studded with brilliant gold buttons and snaps. A top hat crests their head, barely concealing a mop of curly, red hair. They gesture with a cane, directing all to enter the tent, promising treats and sweets and sights yet unseen. To punctuate their point, they toss the cane with a flourish, and as they catch it, it shifts with a pop and becomes a bouquet of flowers, which they hand to a passing family with an exaggerated genuflection.

Blue Slaad Encounter.name:
蓝色斯拉德遭遇
Blue Slaad Encounter

Text.text:
生物魁梧的身躯宛如一座深蓝血肉的山岳，表面覆着两栖黏液般的湿滑。隆起的眉弓下，一对鼓胀的黄色眼睛幽幽窥视；它舔舐双唇，长舌一甩，带着迫不及待的饥渴。生物指节处刺出一枚枚削尖的骨质倒钩，锋利阴狠，钩身覆着一层不祥的毒光。
The creature’s hulking form is a mountain of deep-blue flesh, slick with amphibian slime. Bulbous yellow eyes peer out below a prominent brow as it flicks its tongue across its lips in anticipation. Wicked hooks of sharpened bone protrude from the creature’s knuckles, each one coated with a sinister sheen of poison.

Loot From A Red Dracolich Hoard.name:
红色龙巫妖宝库中的战利品
Loot From A Red Dracolich Hoard

Text.text:
一座宝藏堆在你面前延展开来，在这炽热山洞里，岩浆流淌的光辉映照其上，闪烁着猩红的光泽。你完全可以花上数小时在这片金币之海中细细翻找——那是这头藐视死亡的巨龙历经无数岁月囤积的财富。
A hoard stretches before you, glinting red in the light of the magma trails of this fiery mountain cave. You could spend hours combing through this sea of gold, harbored over the many lifetimes of the death-defying dragon.

I Mend A Sprain.name:
我为扭伤疗治
I Mend A Sprain

Text.text:
我咬紧牙关，从齿缝里倒抽一口气，小心翼翼地接触那处扭伤，掂量着伤势有多严重。我从背包里抓出绷带，开始将它紧紧缠绕。心里不由得惆怅地盼着能有一桶冰，或是一汪清凉的泉水好把伤处浸进去，可我也明白，这两样东西也许还远在天边。
I hiss through clenched teeth as I gingerly touch the sprain, judging its severity. I grab a bandage from my pack and begin to wrap it tightly. I wistfully wish for a bucket of ice or a cool spring to dip into, but know both of those things may still be far off yet.

Sundries From A Green Lich.name:
绿巫妖的杂货
Sundries From A Green Lich

Text.text:
以骇人的姿势摆放的柳条人偶、点缀着明快小花的叶片项链，以及数十根来自不同树种的细枝，被簇拥在由成千上万颗畸形卵石围成的圆环中央。石子铺成的线条约有一掌宽，圈出一个直径五英尺的圆。
Wicker dolls in frightening poses, leaf necklaces speckled with cheerful tiny flowers, and dozens of twigs from different tree species are clustered in the center of a ring created by thousands of deformed pebbles. The stones create a line about a handsbreadth thick, and a circle five feet across.

I Leap From A Carriage.name:
我从车厢上一跃而下
I Leap From A Carriage

Text.text:
马车轮在土路上哐啷作响，尘土与碎石被甩得四散飞溅，马匹撕扯着道路狂奔。声响混作一团——雷鸣般的蹄声、金属的吱呀与木料的呻吟交织成刺耳的噪潮。再也忍不了这颠簸的摇晃，我把视线投向脚下飞掠而过的地面，快得像一条奔流的河。我猛地从车上翻身跃下，拼命蜷起脊背，盼着落在夯实的硬土上时能护住脖颈与头颅。
The carriage wheels clatter over the earth, dirt and pebbles flying as the horses tear down the road. The sound is a cacophony of thundering hooves and creaking metal and wood. Unable to continue this rattling ride much longer, I look toward the ground which rushes below me as swift as a river. I toss myself off the carriage and attempt to round my back, hoping to protect my neck and head as I hit packed dirt.

I Use Voice Of The Chain Master.name:
我施展「锁链宗师之声」
I Use Voice Of The Chain Master

Text.text:
我闭上双眼。以意念沿着将我的魔宠与我相系的灵性锁链伸出触及。距离不再是阻碍，转瞬之间，我们的心神相连，我睁开了眼。世界披上一层幽暗而玻璃般的光泽。我如今能与我的魔宠交谈，也能借它之口发声。它的感官即是我的。
My eyes close. I reach out with my mind along the spiritual chains that bind my familiar to me. Distance is no factor, and in an instant, our minds connect and I open my eyes. The world has taken on a dark, glassy sheen. I can now speak to and through my familiar. Its senses are mine.

Tournament Moment Of Chivalry.name:
骑士精神的瞬间
Tournament Moment Of Chivalry

Text.text:
人群倒抽一口冷气，只见勇士的巨剑从她掌中飞旋而出。与她对峙的卓尔旋身避开，杏仁般的双眼闪着欢快的光。失了武器的勇士踉跄后退，眉间忧色尽显。可对手并未乘胜追击，而是俯身拾起长剑——双手捧起，剑柄朝前递还给她，低首垂颔，以示敬意。
The crowd gasps as the champion's greatsword spins from her grip. The drow facing her spins away, almond eyes gleeful. Unarmed, the champion steps back, face worried. But instead of pressing the advantage, her opponent stoops and picks up the sword—offering it back to her hilt first, head bowed in respect.

Shed On The Grounds Of A Manor.name:
洒落在庄园地面上
Shed On The Grounds Of A Manor

Text.text:
棚屋的结构简朴到近乎寒酸，却建得敦实牢靠。墙面的木板被日头晒得褪色，留着水渍斑痕；门上锈蚀的合页一动便发出刺耳的吱呀摩擦声。屋内只有一扇污浊的小窗透进些许光线，昏昏地照出数十件工具与容器的轮廓。一张行军床贴着一面墙放着，床旁的小桌上孤零零地搁着一本书。
The shed is a spartan structure, stout and sturdy in its construction. The wooden planks of its walls are sun-faded, stained with water, and the rusted hinges on the door creak with a grating whine. Inside, a single dingy window allows light in, dimly illuminating dozens of tools and containers. A single cot rests against one wall, a single book resting on the sidetable.

一座崩碎的拱门化作瓦砾，散落在通往墓园的小径上。你在碎石间瞥见几块雕工精致的石料。那道撕裂大地、贯穿墓园围墙的巨大裂隙，或许也正是它坍塌的元凶。
The rubble of a shattered arch lies strewn over the pathway leading into the graveyard. You spot pieces of artfully carved stone among the debris. Whatever caused the great cleft in the ground that cuts through the cemetery wall might also have caused its collapse.

Shadow Of Moil.name:
阴翳缠身
Shadow Of Moil

Text.text:
黑暗以翻涌的幽影之焰巨釜般将你吞没，世界随之黯淡。近处的阴影愈发深邃，化作张口欲噬的无尽长夜深渊，灯光在压迫性的黑暗面前战栗摇曳、明灭渐衰。
Darkness engulfs you in a roiling cauldron of umbral flames as the world dims. Nearby shadows deepen into yawning chasms of endless night as lights flicker and wane, cowed by the oppressive dark.

Werewolf Casting Thunderwave.name:
狼人施放【雷鸣波】
Werewolf Casting Thunderwave

Text.text:
法师以狼般后腿踏前一步，唇角翻起，露出凶狠的咆哮，直面甲板上那团无形、起伏蠕动的黏液巨块。紧咬的獠牙后，低沉的咆吼逐渐蓄起。利爪般的双手织出古老符号，让空气充满力量，静电噼啪作响，令毛发尽竖。就在黏液猛扑而来之际，法师以原始的暴怒怒吼，释放出震耳欲聋的冲击波，将那生物炸成滚烫的黏稠碎团，轰然掀出船舷——彻底湮灭。

~ 由 ThunderWolf 构想

The mage steps forward on lupine haunches, their lips curled back in a vicious snarl as they confront the formless mass of undulating slime on the ship’s deck. A guttural roar builds behind clenched fangs. Clawed hands weave ancient symbols, charging the air with power, causing hackles to rise in the static. As the ooze lunges forward, the mage roars with primal fury, unleashing a deafening shockwave that blasts the creature overboard in steaming gobbets of viscous goo—obliterating it entirely.

~ Envisioned by ThunderWolf

Divine Factory Of A God Of Machines.name:
机械之神的神圣工厂
Divine Factory Of A God Of Machines

Text.text:
喧嚣让这里无处可藏，轻易便能寻到。凡人的世界里，再没有比这更刺耳、更宏大的噪声：上千座磨坊、锻炉与钟表机关不仅同时运转，更以精密无瑕的协同彼此咬合。数以百万计的齿轮在轮盘上起伏旋转，连着摇臂，连着小齿轮，连着铁锤在砧上狂砸；金属入水的嘶嘶声上方，那节拍竟有一种动人之美——一曲巨兽般的交响。黑烟与硫磺塞满油腻的空气。石与青铜铸成的庞然壁垒之内，机器制造机器，头顶悬着一条弯曲的金色莫比乌斯环，像“无穷”本身的吊饰。最中央的厅室里安置着伟大齿轮，它为所有其他齿轮提供动力并加以调律；一切数学的秩序，都从它那里汲取恒定。

~ 一位英雄所想象

The noise makes this place easy to find. Nowhere in the world of mortals is there a cacophony like this: a thousand mills and forges and clockworks that run not only together, but also in coordinated perfection. There is a beautiful rhythm to the millions of cogs on wheels, connected to rocker arms, connected to pinions, connected to hammers pounding anvils over the hiss of metal in water—a symphony of gargantuan music. Black smoke and sulfur fill the oily air. Inside juggernaut walls of stone and bronze, machines build machines under the hanging bent-gold Möbius strip of infinity. In the centermost chamber is the Great Gear, which powers and regulates all the others, and from which every order of mathematics draws its constancy.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Nighttime Phase Monkey.name:
夜相灵猴
Nighttime Phase Monkey

Text.text:
这只生物浑身竖着光滑的灰色皮毛，沉重地朝你逼近；它那修长蜿蜒的手臂肌肉强健，皮毛上横向的条纹更将力量勾勒得分明。它高耸逼人，遮住渐盈月光投下的亮度，宽阔而异样的口器上缓缓绽开一抹掠食者般的笑。刹那间，它仿佛凭空消失，下一瞬却从营地另一侧的阴影里猛然窜出——扑向了某人的马。
Bristling with sleek gray fur, the creature lumbers toward you, the powerful muscles of its long, sinuous arms accentuated by the horizontal bands painting its fur. It looms over you, blocking the light from the waxing moon, and a slow, predatory smile spreads across its wide, alien mouth. In a flash, it disappears seemingly into thin air, before bursting out of the shadows on the other side of camp—and pouncing on someone’s horse.

Owlin Wizard In Private Library.name:
猫头鹰灵法师在私家藏书馆
Owlin Wizard In Private Library

Text.text:
巫师以缓慢而刻意的动作转过身，在你踏入他的书房时正面迎上你的目光。皮革与木材的土腥气息浸透空气，源自那些在抛光书架上安静陈列、被精心整理的卷册。年迈的鸮族学者以学者般老练的眼光打量着你，仿佛你是陌生文本里的一段难解之句。

~ 构想 by Sahlonahl on Discord

With slow, deliberate movements, the wizard turns to face you as you enter his study. The earthy scent of leather and wood saturates the air, emanating from the meticulously organized volumes resting quietly upon polished shelves. With a scholar's practiced eye, the venerable owlfolk appraises you like a passage in an unfamiliar text.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Elixir Of Bedouin Courage.name:
贝都因勇气灵药
Elixir Of Bedouin Courage

Text.text:
这种药水是一壶茶，浸入了米糟、豆蔻，以及鹰羽磨成的细尘。趁热饮下时，它会在旅行中赐予饮者对环境威胁所引发恐惧的抗力，例如闹鬼之地、危险的天气与气温、彻底的黑暗，或掠食者。冷饮则相反，会让饮者对同样的恐惧更加敏感。
This potion is a tea infused with rice mash, cardamom, and the dust from a hawk’s feather. Drunk hot, it grants resistance to fear of environmental threats during travel, such as haunts, dangerous weather and temperature, total darkness, or predators. Drunk cold, it makes the drinker more susceptible to those same fears.

Jack Of The Lanterns.name:
灯笼杰克
Jack Of The Lanterns

Text.text:
一条由缝合兽皮制成的围裙裹住那干瘪枯槁的可怖生物之躯——它顶着一颗南瓜头，面容凝固成恶意扭曲的狞笑。亵渎的咯咯狂笑自那蜡黄的橙色瓜瓤中迸出，内部熊熊燃烧的火焰透过凿刻在瓜皮上的孔洞倾泻出刺目的光。
An apron of stitched hide enrobes the withered form of a terrifying creature with the head of a pumpkin, its face frozen in a malevolent rictus grin. Unholy cackling emanates from the sallow orange gourd, and light from a fire blazing within pours out of the holes carved into its flesh.

Stromni Redbeard.name:
斯特罗姆尼·红胡子
Stromni Redbeard

Text.text:
骄傲地钉铆在长船船首，一名全身板甲的矮人稳稳抓着龙首雕饰，仿佛护甲的重量于他不过清风。他未戴头盔，狂野的赤红头发与胡须像癫狂火炬的焰舌，照亮他沟壑纵横、风霜刻写的面庞。船身逼近岸边时，他转身朝身后的划手们吼出命令，你这才注意到——他右耳尖少了一截。

~ Played by Vorag15

Proudly affixed at the bow of a longship, a dwarf in full plate steadily holds on to the dragonhead, unburdened by the weight of his armor. Helmless, his wild red hair and beard light his deeply lined, weatherworn face like the flames of a frenzied torch. As the ship approaches shore, he turns to shout orders to the rowers behind him, and you notice the tip of his right ear is missing.

~ Played by Vorag15

I Cast Sanctuary.name:
我施放庇护所
I Cast Sanctuary

Text.text:
结界显现为一只镜面方匣，自空中降落罩住我的目标，匣壁的映像向外折射。玻璃随即碎裂，化作无害的微光洒落地面，而我的目标则被一缕缕飘散的薄雾所笼罩。
The ward appears as a box of mirrors descending upon my target, its walls reflecting outward. The glass shatters into a harmless glitter on the ground and my target is left enveloped by a wisping haze.

Robot Who Wants To Be Human: Confused.name:
想成为人类的机器人：困惑
Robot Who Wants To Be Human: Confused

Text.text: “似乎问题只在于人类的优先级。我们掌握克隆、嫁接，而我精通一切被发明出来的打印语言、材料合成配方，以及CAD设计模板。二十三分钟九点三秒内，我就能造出一只活生生、会呼吸的老鼠，钻进别人的鞋里吃喝拉撒。Mus musculus，可供食肉动物食用。可我却无法被塑成血肉之躯，无法由那种瑕疵百出、仍在演化的神经系统所构成。无法计算。” “Human priorities alone seem to be the problem. We have cloning, grafting, and I am fluent in every printing language, material synthesis formula, and CAD design template invented. In twenty-three minutes, nine point three seconds I could produce a living, breathing mouse that eats and defecates in someone’s shoes. Mus musculus, edible to carnivores. Yet I cannot be made flesh and blood, composed of a flawed and evolving neurology. Does not compute.”

巨大的木桶塞满了这间位于舰船中央的方正舱室，每一只都装着供火炮使用的弹药。这里的空气温暖而干燥，像夏夜的余温；沉重的铁梁加固了墙壁与舱门，以防战斗中发生灾难性的爆裂。这里既是整艘船上最安全的地方——也是最危险的地方。
Huge barrels fill the boxy room at the ship’s centre, each packed with munitions for the guns. The air is warm and dry here, like a summer evening, and heavy iron beams reinforce the walls and door to prevent a catastrophic rupture in battle. This is both the safest—and most dangerous—place on the entire ship.

I Tinker With A Flying Board.name:
我捣鼓着一块会飞的滑板
I Tinker With A Flying Board

Text.text:
我把电路板横放在膝上，嘴里牢牢咬着烙铁，双手撬开许可面板。探头望去，只见板内密密麻麻的电路板与闪烁的指示灯交织成一张复杂的网。一颗熄灭的LED闯入我的视野，我移动间烙铁骤然亮起，开始——小心翼翼地——修复那段电路。
I set the board across my lap, a soldering iron grasped firmly between my teeth, and pry open the access panel with my hands. I peer into the complex web of circuit boards and blinking lights filling the board’s interior. A dead LED catches my eye and the soldering iron flares to life as I move to—carefully—repair the circuit.

这根巨大的棍棒完全由一株古树的心材制成，其上刻着精灵符文：“树”与“父”。棍身周缘钉入一圈木钉，宛如护手，守护持握者的双手。尽管负载惊人，这件笨重的武器却出奇地平衡，挥砸与向前突刺都轻松顺手。无论这致命武器流下过多少鲜血，它看起来仍如雕成之日一般崭新。
Fashioned entirely from the heartwood of an ancient tree, this massive club features the elvish runes: tree and father. Pegs have been hammered in around its circumference serving as a guard for the wielder’s hands. Despite its obvious bulk, the ungainly weapon proves to be perfectly balanced and surprisingly easy to swing or drive forward in a jabbing motion. Despite every drop of blood shed by this deadly weapon, it looks as new as the day it was carved.

Loot From A Young Brass Dragon.name:
来自一条年轻黄铜龙的战利品
Loot From A Young Brass Dragon

Text.text:
一只巨大的抛光黄铜钵置于厅室中央，满满盛着钱币与宝石，色泽温暖而明艳。其上方悬着一幅小挂毯，描绘一片宁静而丰饶、生机勃勃的森林。钵旁安放着一尊雕刻的桃花心木半身像：一位精灵面带揶揄的神情，雕琢出的眉峰微微挑起，仿佛难以置信。总体而言，这批宝藏约值5000枚金币。
A large bowl of polished brass sits in the center of the chamber, filled to the brim with coins and gemstones of warm and vibrant hues. A small tapestry hangs above it, depicting a serene and bountiful forest teeming with life. Next to the bowl rests a bust of carved mahogany, showing an elf with a bemused expression, their sculpted brow raised in an incredulous manner. Overall, the hoard is worth around 5000 gold pieces.

Guardian Of Faith.name:
信仰守卫
Guardian Of Faith

Text.text:
你向神祇祈求一丝恩典，随即便得到了回应——一尊巍然高耸的身影显现于前。那光辉灿烂的存在向你微微俯首，面容朦胧难辨，继而幽影般的双肩向后一展，举起长剑与盾牌，直面你的敌人。神圣守卫的身躯透明而缥缈、如雾如纱，但它那柄耀目的长剑却是一片纯白光芒构成的位面，而那面发光的盾牌上烙着你神祇的徽记，坚实如你的信仰。
You beseech your god for a little grace and are rewarded with the appearance of a towering figure. The radiant being bows an indistinct head to you, then rolls its ghostly shoulders back and lifts its sword and shield to face your enemies. While the divine guardian’s body is transparent and hazy, its brilliant sword is a plane of white light, and its glowing shield bears the symbol of your god as solid as your faith.

一个矮小的鳞皮身影借助重力支援脊柱贴地悬行。他们停了下来，一把复杂的模块化座椅在他们周身展开，使他们一气呵成地落座。他们身穿仿军装风格的衣物，上面零星贴满含糖饮料与玩家潮服的广告。鳞片般的皮肤结着硬痂，双眼因专注而眯起。厚重的耳机卡在头侧。一根棒棒糖从唇间探出，蛇一般的舌头不时弹出。难看的霓虹纹身挤满了他们的脖颈。
A short scaly figure hovers across the ground with the aid of a gravity-support spine. They come to rest, and a complex modular chair unfolds around them so that they take a seat in one fluid motion. They are dressed in pseudo-military clothing peppered with advertisements for sugary drinks and gamer clothing. Their scaled skin is crusted, their eyes narrowed with focus. Chunky headphones sit astride their head. A lollipop pokes out of their lips, from which a snakelike tongue flicks outward. Ugly neon tattoos crowd around their neck.

空间的织锦上新生出一道褶痕，宛如一线完美的光之裂隙伫立其间。裂隙旁，一名闪烁不定的精灵般存在执着一柄流光溢彩的长剑，下巴微扬，纹丝不动。它瓷白的肌肤上斑驳着午夜苍穹般的蓝黑。它在守着一道破口——可它究竟在防什么？这位俊美的妖精战士，又怎会畏惧什么？
A newly made fold in the fabric of space stands like a perfect slit of light. And next to it, a flickering elfin being wields a shimmering sword, chin raised, utterly unmoving. Its porcelain skin is mottled with the blue-black of a midnight sky. It is guarding a breach, but from what? What could this fair fey warrior possibly fear?

Plane Shift Misses.name:
位面转移失误
Plane Shift Misses

Text.text:
你掏出一支小巧的音叉，价值足抵鞋匠一整年的收入。只要敲响它那唯一的音，你便能旅行至另一个位面，甚至还能带人同行。可你偏偏把它当匕首般反握，低声呢喃晦深的秘奥咒文，猛然刺出。你心知只要一次接触，你仍会留在此地，而你的敌手将被放逐般流浪于另一个存在的位面。可你失手了——没有音色，没有回响，而你咒语中那磅礴的魔法，竟在刹那间化作你自身无声的破绽。
You draw out a small tuning fork worth a cobbler’s annual income. On its one note you could travel to another plane, even take others with you. You choose instead to hold it like a dagger, whisper some deep arcana, and strike. You know that on a touch you will still be here, but your foe will wander another plane of existence. Except you miss and there is no tone, and the powerful magic of your incantation suddenly becomes your own silent vulnerability.

Xey And His Doom Owl.name:
泽伊与他的末日枭
Xey And His Doom Owl

Text.text:
精灵飘然前行，兼具乌鸦的隐秘优雅与雄鹰凭战功换来的傲慢。他的铜色肌肤在深色鞣染的护甲皮革下闪着微光。一张木制面具覆住面孔，天然木纹扭结成令人不安的皱眉刻痕。他伸展的双手间延出两柄利刃：第一柄是深邃阴影的具象化，撕裂灵魂如同撕裂血肉般轻易；第二柄则更为寻常，却是一件噼啪作响、缠绕翠绿火焰的武器，随时准备爆燃。肩头栖着一只形似猫头鹰的阴森妖精之灵，斑驳羽色由梦魇与幻象凝结而成。它剃刀般的喙张开，取代任何有机声响的，是一声令人心底发寒的回响：“Doooom.”

~ Played by Mundin IronHand

The elf swishes forth, combining a raven’s subtle grace with an eagle’s earned arrogance. His copper skin glints beneath the dark-stained leather of his armor. A wooden mask covers his face, its natural grain forming an unnerving facsimile of frown lines. Two blades extend from his outstretched hands, the first a physical manifestation of deep shadows capable of rending the soul as easily as flesh, the second a more mundane weapon crackling with viridian flames, ready to erupt. On his shoulder roosts a macabre fey spirit in the shape of an owl, its dappled plumage coalesced from nightmares and phantasms. Its razor beak opens, and in place of any organic noise comes an unsettling echo of “Doooom.”

~ Played by Mundin IronHand

Aduro De Capria, The Emberwolf.name:
阿杜罗·德·卡普里亚，「余烬狼」
Aduro De Capria, The Emberwolf

Text.text:
尽管他穿得像个寻常水手，你眼前这名瘦削的焰血之人却燃着本源元素的暴怒；炭灰色的皮肤上，发光的赤红纹路灼目刺眼。然而他最反常之处在脸——那张面孔有一半像恐狼的口鼻与耳廓。额头上用银墨描出的纹身，描绘着世界之月的对位相合。胸甲下方斜束的彩色腰带里，塞着一柄未入鞘的冷铁长剑，在霜冷月光下闪烁寒芒；其刃口锐得不可思议，仿佛铁也被磨成了绝对的锋利。

~ 由一位英雄 Played 饰演，角色卡见

Though he is dressed as a common sailor, the slender fireblooded before you burns with the fury of his native element, his glowing red lines standing out from charcoal-gray skin. Yet his most unusual feature is that of his face, which halfway resembles the muzzle and ears of a dire wolf. A tattoo on his forehead, picked out in silver ink, features the world's moon in alignment. Tucked into the multicolored sash slung just under his breastplate, an unsheathed longsword of cold iron glints in the frosty moonlight, its edge hewn impossibly sharp for an iron blade.

~ Played by a Hero with

一堆高大的篝火在营地中央噼啪燃烧，四周的帐篷与篷车被精心排布，让商队里每个人都能彼此照应、互为耳目。营地一侧，挽畜与坐骑立着打盹，保养得当的缰具把它们系在拴马桩绳上。火光摇曳间，赶车人和守卫把酒瓶递来传去，众人趁着夜色尚暖，享受旅途的自由，直到睡意终于将他们一一吞没。
A sizable cook fire is at the center of this campground, surrounded by tents and wagons arranged in such a way that every person in the caravan is able to look out for one another. Off to one side, the draft animals and mounts sleep on their feet, bound to picket lines by their well-maintained halters. By the firelight, a bottle might be passed around by the teamsters and guards, the crew enjoying the freedom of the trail before slumber overtakes them for the evening.

Speech By A Healer About Disease.name:
治疗师关于疾病的演说
Speech By A Healer About Disease

Text.text:
“我选择治愈，因为当我放眼这片大地所遭受的一切苦难时，播下最深痛楚的并非刀剑的残暴，而是疾病那冷漠而凶狠的啃噬。哪怕我能止息百场战争，也远远比不上缓解一株痘毒带来的痛苦。”
“I choose to heal because when I look out at all the suffering plaguing this earth, it is not the brutality of the sword that sows the most misery, it is the indifferent viciousness of disease. I could stop a hundred wars and not be even close to alleviating the pain of a single strain of pox.”

Forgotten Island Spotted At Sea.name:
海上惊现遗忘之岛
Forgotten Island Spotted At Sea

Text.text:
病恹恹的薄雾翻卷退去，露出一座荒凉的孤岛；倦怠的浪涛浑浊黏稠，裹着浮渣，缓缓爬上碎页岩的海滩。万籁被压低，低垂的云层吞没了一切——只余海水慵懒的轻拍。此地不见生机，空气里弥漫着陈旧巫术的腥味，以及被遗忘魔法的灰烬般恶臭。

~ 构想：意志·赫特

Sickly mists roll back to reveal a bleak island and desultory waves thick with scum crawling up a shale beach. Sound is muted, the low cloud absorbing all—bar the languid lapping of the sea. Devoid of life, the air reeks of old sorcery and the ashen stink of forgotten magics.

~ Envisioned by Will Hurtt

Volcanic Crater Lake.name:
火山口湖
Volcanic Crater Lake

Text.text:
这座巨大的破火山口峭壁如削，围成一圈环形山脉，环抱着一汪蓝得惊心的湖水。岩石被炸裂、破碎的残貌，以及几乎不见的繁茂植被，无不诉说着其暴烈的火山渊源；然而那些久远的威胁，仍无法解除你望向水面时油然而生的宁静——湖面如镜，平滑得令人屏息。
The steep sides of this tremendous caldera create a circular mountain range surrounding a lake of startlingly blue water. The blasted, broken appearance of the stone, and lack of significant vegetation, speak to violent volcanic origins, but these old threats do little to dispel the sense of peace you get from looking across the mirror-like surface of the water.

血染的沙砾与漂白腐朽的枯骨铺满这座荒凉竞技场的地面。骷髅被残酷锈蚀的镣铐钉死在从地里突起的巨柱上，悬挂其间，宛如被遗忘亡者的墓碑。层层阶梯式长凳环绕斗坑排列——一座供嗜血看客观战的看台。
Blood-stained sands and bleached, rotten bones fill the floor of the desolate arena. Skeletons hang from the cruel, rusted manacles hammered into large pillars jutting from the earth, like tombstones of the forgotten dead. Stepped rows of benches line the fighting pit—a gallery for bloodthirsty spectators.

在幽冥深处的黑暗里，触须丛生、起伏蠕动的生灵群落渐渐成形。它们以情感点亮自身，多彩的光辉如极光般跃动，在黑暗中洒落到地下蘑菇与苔藓村落的上方。数个群落汇聚成一座属于自己的城市——一团球形的居住簇，在其中，所有胶质般的生灵都以心灵感应彼此交流。拥有强大灵能的存在会被奉为王族，受邀居住其间，并在流体般的迷宫建筑里，作为营养之源供养众生。

~ 一位英雄所构想

In the deep dark of the under realm, colonies of tentacled, undulating beings formed. They light themselves with their emotions, multi-colored lights dancing like an aurora through the darkness above an underground village of mushrooms and moss. Several colonies formed their own city, a spherical cluster of dwellings in which all the gelatinous beings communicate telepathically. Beings of great psionic power are invited to live as royalty and act as nutrition sources in a maze of fluid architectures.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Bard Performing A Spirit Session.name:
吟游诗人演绎一场通灵团期
Bard Performing A Spirit Session

Text.text:
所有人都把手按在圆圈中央的灵媒导体上。吟游诗人主持降灵仪式，向群灵招手呼唤，低声乞求它们指引。空气骤然变冷，氛围无端暗沉下去，唯有灵媒导体的光芒愈发炽亮。那同样的幽光从吟游诗人的眼、鼻与口中溢出闪烁。忽然，一段诵唱自他们唇间倾泻而出，众灵合声，层层叠叠，词句怪异尖厉，刺耳如啸。吟游诗人的头猛然向后仰去——伴随一道幽灵般的闪电迸发，诸灵倏然四散逃逸，仿佛从未存在过。
Everyone places a hand on the spiritual conduit that sits in the middle of the circle. The bard conducts the séance, beckoning to the spirits and begging for their guidance. The air turns cold. The atmosphere unaccountably darkens, while the spiritual conduit glows brighter and brighter. That same spectral luminance gleams from the bard’s eyes, nose, and mouth. Suddenly, a chant spills from their lips, polyphonic with the voices of many spirits, the words strange and shrieking. The bard’s head snaps back, and with a discharge of spectral lightning, the spirits flee, as though they had never been.

Shield Of Faith Cast By Follower Of Baph.name:
由巴风特信徒施放的信仰之盾
Shield Of Faith Cast By Follower Of Baphomet

Text.text:
一个身披闪耀护甲的孤影在危难之际高声呼求庇护。他将长枪猛然刺向苍穹——枪杆上刻满圣典的篇章。呼声回荡之时，铂金色的微光如星尘般洒落在他周身……直至他通体迸发出神圣的辉煌。
A lone figure in gleaming armor cries out for protection in his time of need. He thrusts his spear—its shaft covered in passages from his holy book—at the sky. As his call echoes, gleaming motes of platinum light fall around him… until he shines with holy brilliance.

那披甲之人挺立如松，威仪天成；肌肤似雪玉无瑕，发丝如月光流淌。那位女骑士腰间佩着一柄纹饰华美的长剑，臂弯夹着一顶生角的头盔，肩头则垂落一袭血红披风。她的眼眸金灿，几近发亮，盛着古老的智慧，却又显得青春正盛。她唇瓣微启，露出一丝几不可察的笑意，你却瞥见其间寒光一闪——尖锐的犬齿……
The armored figure stands tall and regal, with skin like alabaster and hair like moonlight. The knightly woman carries an ornate-looking sword at her hip and a horned helm tucked under her arm, while a blood-red cloak hangs from her shoulders. Her eyes, golden and nearly glowing, hold ancient wisdom, yet she appears young. As her lips part in the barest smile, you catch a glimpse of sharp canines . . .

City Raid By Red Dragon: Dragon Fire.name:
赤红巨龙突袭城市：龙焰
City Raid By Red Dragon: Dragon Fire

Text.text:
白昼的安宁在巨龙现身的那一刻被粉碎。如今，它在被龙息点燃的楼宇之间游弋徘徊，像猫戏老鼠般玩弄惊恐的人群。怪物在灰烬与浓烟中以惊人的速度穿梭——无论是在建筑间疾行，还是振翼掠过其上——只为撕裂与毁灭。
The peace of the day shattered when the dragon appeared. Now it stalks the streets amid buildings set ablaze by its breath, toying with terrified people like a cat with mice. The monster moves with startling speed through the ash and smoke—whether among the buildings or flapping above them—seeking to rend and ruin.

I Cast Command From My Staff Of Charming.name:
我用魅惑法杖施放《命令术》
I Cast Command From My Staff Of Charming

Text.text:
我吐出命令之词，感到一股魔法洪流贯穿法杖，将我的意志压向我的目标。法杖杖首迸发出一道无形的能量脉冲，魔法的奔涌令我视线刹那模糊；待那股激流退去——我的法术已然施放。
I speak the word of command and feel a rush of magic flow through the staff, bringing my will to bear against my target. An invisible pulse of energy erupts from the staff’s head, causing my vision to blur momentarily as the rush of magic subsides—and my spell is cast.

她身材异乎寻常地高大，面色红润，笑容随时可见，整个人像个豪爽的女巨人。她在朴素衣物外系着一条沾着啤酒湿气的围裙。那双因开瓶、搬运啤酒桶而磨出厚茧的手，却出奇灵巧，正细致地擦拭着一只纤薄的葡萄酒杯。
Unusually tall, and with a ruddy complexion and ready smile, this jovial giant of a woman wears an ale-damp apron over simple clothes. Calloused hands used to cracking open bottles and carrying beer casks work with surprising agility to polish a delicate wine glass.

Animated Armor Restricts Movement.name:
活化护甲限制移动
Animated Armor Restricts Movement

Text.text:
忽然间，你的手臂抬不起来了。接着，你一步也迈不出去。你的关节与肌肉仍在发力，却被你自己的护甲死死卡住——此刻它硬如磐石。你试着挪动，哪怕只有一寸，肌肉也在向你尖叫。你的防护已成你的牢笼。

~ 由 The Count Envisioned

Suddenly, your arm won’t lift. Then, you can’t take a step. Your joints and muscles are engaged, but they are stopped by your own armor, which is now as rigid as stone. Your muscles scream at you as you attempt to budge, even if only an inch. Your protection has become your prison.

~ Envisioned by The Count

I Put On My Dentures Of Translation.name:
我戴上了翻译的假牙
I Put On My Dentures Of Translation

Text.text:
眼看时机已到，需要细说一番，我打了个手势示意谈话的同伴们先稍候片刻。我从腰侧的皮囊里掏出假牙，一边咬紧一边将它们推入口中。魔法沿着牙龈奔涌，冲上头颅，继而漫过身体其余每一处。我露出笑容，让那一口光润的秘银牙尽数显现。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

As it seems the time has come to elaborate, I sign for my partners in conversation to wait a moment. I pull my dentures out of the leather pouch at my hip and bite down as I slide them into my mouth. The magic rushes through my gums, my head, and eventually the rest of my body. I smile, the glistening mithril teeth on full display.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

I Help Slay An Earth Elemental While Wea.name:
我戴着【土元素统御之戒】，协助众人斩杀了一头土元素。
I Help Slay An Earth Elemental While Wearing My Ring Of Earth Elemental Command

Text.text: 我的一击落在那生物宽阔的面孔上，伴随着令人痛快的咔嚓！戒指里猛然迸发出一股魔法洪流，将它震惊的表情轰塌成一座碎裂的坑洞。伤口间闪烁着那生物宝石匠般的内里光泽。它用僵硬而踉跄的腿连连后退，直到轰然倒下，碎作一堆瓦砾与宝石。破碎的尸身中升起一股土黄色的沙与魔法旋涡，扑面涌来，浸入我体内，将倒下敌人的力量灌注于我。 My strike lands against the creature’s broad face with a satisfying crack! A burst of magic surges from my ring, reducing its shocked expression to a crumbling crater. The wound reveals the glint of the creature's lapidarian interior. It stumbles back on stiff, unsteady legs until it topples into a pile of rubble and gems. A tan swirl of sand and magic rises from the shattered corpse and washes over me, imbuing me with the fallen foe’s energy.

Group Of Quaggoths.name:
夸戈斯群
Group Of Quaggoths

Text.text:
洞穴般的狭窄空间向你逼近——你不由得想象，上方难以计量的岩石与泥土正沉沉压下。野兽的嚎叫触及你的耳畔，在地下隧道间回荡；魁梧、佝偻的身影在光芒之外的黑暗中游弋。忽有一只自阴影里踏出——一头体格骇人的熊形生物，毛发纠结成毡，双眼燃着不加掩饰的饥渴。某种近似人形的巨熊扬起利爪向你逼来，獠牙寒光闪烁。

~ 一位英雄所构想

The cavernous confines close in around you—you cannot help but imagine the immeasurable stone and earth pressing in from above. The howls of beasts reach your ears, reverberating through the subterranean tunnels, and hulking, slouched shapes prowl the darkness just beyond your light. One emerges from the shadows, an ursine creature of immense stature, with matted fur and eyes that burn with an unbridled hunger. Something akin to a humanoid bear brandishes its claws as it steps toward you, teeth gleaming.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这座朴素的木屋里，一排排桌案整齐排列；每张桌上都摆着一套天平、放大镜，以及各式各样的药剂。每个工位前，淘金客都在与目光如刀的检验员为石块、宝石、矿石与古物的价值争得面红耳赤。空气里弥漫着泥土与汗味，夹着一丝金属的辛辣。一个手指沾满墨渍、系着领巾的登记员飞快地记下每次来访、估价与结算的条目。他身后，一座塞满账簿的书柜高耸而立，紧贴着交易所最深处的后墙。

~ Envisioned by Dungoket

The simple, wooden building holds rows of desks, each equipped with a set of scales, magnifying glasses, and various potions. At each station, prospectors quibble with sharp-eyed inspectors over the value of stones, jewels, ores, and artifacts. The air is thick with the smell of dirt and sweat, with a twinge of metal. A registrar with ink-stained fingers and ascot scribbles down notes on each visit, valuing, and payout. A ledger-stuffed bookcase towers behind him, pressed against the very back wall of the exchange.

~ Envisioned by Dungoket

Swordsman With Main-gauche.name:
持主手剑与左手短剑的剑士
Swordsman With Main-gauche

Text.text:
那名剑士手持一把左手匕与一柄军刀逼近，军刀的黄铜护手篮编织精巧，光泽冷冽。他身着绿色绗缝短袄，披着带兜帽的短斗篷，护甲零件杂而不乱地覆在身上；那张专注的面孔，是老练战士才有的沉稳与锐利。
The swordsman steps toward you with a main-gauche and a saber that has a well-crafted basket of brass. He wears a green quilted tunic, a hooded short cape, and pieces of various light armor, and has the focused face of an experienced fighter.

Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound.name:
魔邓肯的忠诚猎犬
Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound

Text.text:
你以一声尖厉的口哨自虚无中召来一只猎犬；这忠诚的野兽欢快地一跃而出，跃入现世，魅影（特征）的舌头惬意地垂在嘴边。它以吠声向你致意，那声音层层回荡，仿佛来自遥远的天际。
You summon a hound from the ether with a shrill whistle, and the faithful beast leaps into being with a joyful bound, phantom tongue lolling happily. The dog barks in greeting and the sound echoes, as if far in the distance.

这个小小的毡布袋里有个出奇圆的鼓包。你接触到它时，发现它微微发热。你带着几分忐忑往袋里一瞧，只见一团毛茸茸的球，像是蜷着睡着的小动物——可这团蓬松的“雪球”却看不出任何外形与器官。你细看之下，它还在轻轻起伏，仿佛在呼吸。待它满足地轻叹一声，你立刻将袋子的抽绳狠狠一拉，紧紧束死。
This small felt sack has a curiously round lump in it. You touch it and find it slightly warm. With some trepidation, you look into the bag and see a furry ball, like an animal curled up in sleep, but this snowball of fluff has no visible anatomy. As you examine it, you notice it pulsing gently, as if breathing. When it gives a contented sigh, you pull the drawstring of the bag tightly shut.

温泉洞窟里潮湿的空气中，弥漫着薰衣草、薄荷与洋甘菊的怡人香气。你一踏入其中，便看见不同残疾的客人正浸在天然温泉里，享受舒缓的浴池与淋浴。墙壁与地面皆由火山岩构成，尽管池水蒸腾、湿气氤氲，那岩面在接触时仍沁凉宜人。这里是宁静与复苏之所，唯一的扰动，是洞顶水滴落下，轻叩下方泉水的细响。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The humid air in the spa cave is laced with the pleasing aromas of lavender, peppermint, and chamomile. As you enter, you see patrons with various disabilities enjoying soothing baths and showers in the natural hot springs. The volcanic rock of the walls and floor are pleasantly cool to the touch despite the humidity and steam from the pools. This is a place of peace and rejuvenation, the only disturbance being the sound of water dripping from the cavern roof into the waters below.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Border Town Courier.name:
边境小镇信使
Border Town Courier

Text.text:
急促逼近的马蹄声先一步传来，一匹溅满泥点的阉马从清晨最后一缕薄雾中冲出。它小跑到拴马栏前，鼻息化作一团翻涌的白汽。一个满脸疤痕、裹着肮脏皮甲的女人从鞍上跃下，手里紧攥着一沓羊皮纸，目标明确地大步直奔镇长办公室。守卫试图拦住她，她却一言不发地硬闯而入。
The sound of a fast-approaching rider precedes the emergence of a mud-spattered gelding from the last of the early-morning mist. As it canters to a hitching rail, its breath is a cloud of billowing steam. A scar-faced woman clad in filthy leathers leaps from the saddle and strides purposefully toward the mayor’s office, a ream of parchment clutched tightly in her hand. The guards attempt to stop her but she barges past without a word.

The Sanctuary: Fissures To Northwest.name:
圣所：西北裂隙
The Sanctuary: Fissures To Northwest

Text.text:
你脚下干裂发黄的土地在爪边塌陷，露出一道道巨大的裂隙，如辫索般在大地上交织蔓延。你探身望向第一道峡谷的边缘，却怎么也看不清它的底部。附近某条裂缝里飘出淡淡的烟味与硫磺般的尘息，耳畔还隐约传来采掘时特有的金属撞击声。
The parched, yellow ground beneath your paws gives way to massive fissures that braid themselves across the landscape. You struggle to make out the bottom as you look over the edge of the first canyon. The faint aroma of smoke and sulfurous dust emanates from one of the nearby fractures, and the distinctive metallic clangs of mining can also be heard.

这道法术的最后几个音节像歌声般流淌而出，你将目光牢牢锁在眼前的野兽身上，仍低声哼着那段旋律。你以魔法与共情向前触及，盼望二者都能在这生物的心智中扎根。你们的心跳同频共振，仿佛你的法术就要奏效。
The last few syllables of this spell come out as a song, and you continue to hum the tune as you focus on the beast before you. You reach out with magic and empathy, hoping both find purchase in the creature’s mind. Your hearts beat simpatico, and it seems as though your spell will work.

若只有那骇人的体型便已足够——这巨人足有三层楼高。然而你仍不寒而栗：周遭空气仿佛滋滋作响，狂风如河流激涌的水势般拽扯着你，而那巨人挥舞着一柄闪电般的长剑，长如船桅。
If size were the only terrifying thing, that would be enough, for this giant stands three stories tall. But your hair stands on end as the air about you seems to sizzle, the wind pulls at you like a river’s current, and the giant wields a lightning-bolt-shaped sword as long as a ship’s mast.

Circus Music: Strange Puppet Show.name:
马戏团乐曲：诡异的木偶戏
Circus Music: Strange Puppet Show

Text.text:
一辆涂着糖果般艳丽色彩的巨型篷车高高耸立在撒满锯末的空地上。它庞大的车身上刻满木雕的荒诞喜剧：凝固着夸张笑容的阔面孔、无人识得的异兽，以及覆着金箔、神情邪气的孩童雕像。这样的外观掩盖了内部的机器——不知以何种方式驱动——它轰然运转，吐出诡异的乐声，伴随着固定在车壁上的木偶与木质面孔一同移动。
A vast wagon painted in candy colors looms tall over the sawdust-scattered field. Its bulk bears scenes of wild comedy carved in wood, broad faces with frozen grins, unknown beasts, and sculptures of wicked-looking children gilded in gold leaf. This façade disguises the machine within, which—driven by some unknown means—churns out strange music to accompany the movement of puppets and wooden faces attached to the wagon’s walls.

你面前隐现着一张轻若薄纱的分形巨网，由黏稠的丝线编织而成——每一根都粗如系泊缆绳。这张蛛网足以掩蔽整整一个街区，正因一头被缠住的河马疯狂的移动而嗡嗡震颤。一只巨大的蛛形怪从阴影里缓缓爬出，朝它的猎物逼近。它披着纤维般的毛皮——乌黑得像淤青——那对狼蛛般的长腿与其沉重的体躯极不相称地优雅游走。它一看见你，口器便咔嗒作响，声音大得足以把栖枝的鸟儿震得惊飞。
Before you looms a gossamer fractal, knit from sticky silk threads as thick as mooring lines. The web could cover a city block and thrums from the frantic movement of an ensnared hippo. An enormous arachnid creeps from the shadows toward its meal. Coated in fibrous fur—black as a bruise—the spider’s tarantula legs move with a grace incongruous to its weight. Its mandibles click when it sees you, and the sound is loud enough to shock birds from their perches.

你眼前的生物几乎无法用言语解释：她体型矮小，肤色是带着红晕的粉，洋红色的头发肆意铺散；身披一套仿佛会呼吸般起伏游移的护甲，像是由某种可塑的木材锻造而成。人们称她为“狼”。她头戴一顶头盔，形如仰天长嚎的狼首面具，明亮的紫红眼眸自野兽张开的巨口深处窥视而出。她也咧嘴露出獠牙——犬齿已不再是骨质，而是被打磨成锋锐的红宝石。

~ Played by a Hero with

The creature before you defies explanation: short of stature, with ruddy pink skin and magenta hair, clad in armor that seems to shift and move, forged from some sort of malleable wood. The Wolf, she is called. Upon her head she wears a helm in the shape of a howling, lupine visage, her bright fuchsia eyes peering from within the beast’s maw. She flashes her own teeth, revealing canines replaced by sharpened rubies.

~ Played by a Hero with

Noblewoman With One Arm.name:
独臂贵妇
Noblewoman With One Arm

Text.text:
她以无双的魅力穿过房间，边走边问候、称赞，顺手抛出机敏而俏皮的笑话。她的秀发精致得像艺术品，但真正最动人的，是她的聪慧。有人注意到她缺失的手臂时，她只需一眼便读懂对方的神色，随后要么简短解释，要么含笑相迎，直至再次与对方目光相接——既不尴尬，也不纠正。

~ 扮演者：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

She walks through the room with peerless charm, greeting, complimenting, and making quick and clever jokes. Her hair is exquisite, but her intelligence is her most appealing feature. When someone notices the missing arm, she assesses the look with a glance, then either explains briefly or smiles until there is eye contact again, with neither embarrassment nor correction.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

这块饱经摧残的木板几乎全靠硬撑着，板子的每一段看起来至少有百分之二十都是胶带缠出来的。可在主人眼里，每一道凹痕、每一处擦伤、每一条划痕、每一丝裂缝都在讲述一个故事——或是惊世的凯旋，或是折骨碎身的失败。
The battered piece of wood is barely holding together, and each section of the board seems to be at least twenty percent duct tape. To the owner, though, each dent, scrape, scratch, and crack tells a story, be it one of spectacular triumph or bone-breaking failure.

[察觉] 一股原始的本能在你脑后轻轻拉扯，逼得你停下脚步。前方墙上齐刷刷一排孔洞——对大多数人而言正好在胸口高度——牢牢攫住了你的目光。

[发现] 这里的地面高低不平——像是刻意为之——你试探着触碰一块压板时，察觉到些许抗力。你俯身窥向墙上钻出的孔洞，见里面寒光森然的矛尖正待发射，你的怀疑也随之坐实。

[触发] 压板被踩动，你的脚下一沉，肾上腺素瞬间冲上全身。以令人胆寒的速度，三支长矛从墙洞中暴射而出，直奔你而来——每一支都瞄准要害。

[Perceived] A primal instinct tugging at the back of your mind causes you to stop. Before you, a row of holes in the wall—at chest height for most—draws your attention.

[Discovered] The floor is uneven here—as if by design—and you notice some resistance as you test a pressure plate. Your suspicions become confirmed when you peer into the holes bored in the wall and see the spearheads waiting inside.

[Triggered] Your foot sinks as a pressure plate is triggered, and adrenaline floods your body. With terrifying speed, three spears are launched from holes in the wall toward you—each aimed at a vital organ.

Rod Arcane Focus.name:
法杖奥术法器
Rod Arcane Focus

Text.text:
这根短杖由某种异域巨兽的象牙长牙雕琢而成。杖身刻满脊纹与旋涡般的曲线，目光若执意沿着那些纹路追随下去，视野终会被搅得发花——逼得你不得不移开视线。只是图案过于繁复所致？还是这根短杖确实留存了持用者曾经贯注其中的一丝力量？
Carved from the ivory tusk of some exotic animal, this rod has had ridges and whorls carved into its shaft, such that trying to keep your eyes focused on its lines eventually makes your eyes blur—forcing you to look away. Is it simply the complex pattern? Or does the rod carry a fraction of the power channeled through it by its wielder?

这样巨大而可怖的东西，竟会被称作“可怜虫”，怎么想都不对。可它的身躯却呈淤伤般的青紫色。稀薄纠结的头发湿塌塌地贴在一张长脸上，嘴里戳着过多的断裂獠牙。修长而筋骨分明的四肢把它支撑成佝偻的姿势，仿佛正等着鞭子落下。怎么想都不对。直到你看见它的第三只眼睁开——额心正中一道竖裂，露出一颗黄色的眼球，瞳孔宛如沙漏。那不祥之眼渗出邪意，为它的躯体灌入非自然的蛮力。它的利爪收紧，死死握住一柄巨大的长柄刀。
It does not seem right that something so large and awful should be thought of as wretched. But its body is the color of bruises. Its thin and tangled hair lies lank against a long face bristling with too many broken fangs. Long sinewy limbs hold it in a hunched posture as if waiting for a whip to land. It does not seem right. And then you see its third eye open, a vertical slit in the middle of its forehead that reveals a yellow orb with an hourglass iris. That baleful eye exudes evil, suffusing its body with unnatural strength. Its clawed hands tighten around a great glaive.

Locust Swarm On Dead World.name:
死寂世界上的蝗群
Locust Swarm On Dead World

Text.text:
如果暴雨也能听起来干巴巴的，那它就该是这副声响。它们飞掠如百万张揉皱的纸片扫射大地。可大地却是龟裂的荒漠、枯脆的死草、以及连一点景天或石南都不肯生的岩壁。目之所及没有一片水域，没有一朵云。虫群饥饿地疾驰而过，零星几只坠向灼热的地表，在垂死挣扎中翻滚抽搐。
If a rainstorm could sound dry, this is how it would sound. They fly like a million crumpling papers strafing the earth. But the earth is cracked desert, dry and brittle dead grass, and rock faces without even stonecrop or heather. There is no body of water in sight, no cloud. The swarm races along, starving, a few at a time dropping to the hot surface and turning over in their death throes.

Adult Copper Dragon Encounter.name:
成年铜龙遭遇
Adult Copper Dragon Encounter

Text.text:
在落日赭红的余辉下，一条巨龙慵懒地盘踞在嶙峋的岩丘之巅，铜色的面容上挂着一抹顽皮的笑意。磨亮的鳞片仿佛一枚枚闪光的铜钱，在渐暗的光里点点跳动。它打了个哈欠，将一只古怪而灵动的眼睛落在你身上，像一只巨大的猫般咧嘴轻蔑一笑。双翼哗啦一声张开，向起伏不平的地面抛下锯齿般的阴影；它舒展盘绕的身躯，立起身来，尘土旋风般卷起。
Beneath the sunset's russet glow, a dragon lounges atop a rocky tor—a playful grin painted across its coppery visage. Burnished scales, like gleaming pennies, twinkle in the fading light. It yawns, and settles a whimsical eye upon you, smirking like an enormous cat. Wings clatter open, hurling jagged shadows across the uneven earth as it uncoils and stands amidst a cyclone of dust.

一阵叽喳声在大厅里回荡，听起来介于松鼠与小恶鬼之间。你的目光落在一道矮小的黑影上——它从墙边挪开，轮廓渐渐清晰，显出一只地精，眼里闪着顽皮的狡光。地精的嘴咧成歪斜而阴险的笑，满口参差的尖牙让你头皮发麻、寒毛直竖。
A chitter echoes across the hall, sounding halfway between a squirrel and an imp. Your eyes land on a short, dark figure, which steps away from the wall and resolves into a goblin with a mischievous glint in its eyes. The goblin’s mouth is split into a lopsided, devious grin, full of jagged teeth that make your hair stand on end.

在大地深处，传奇的山地矮人居所巍然矗立，披覆在永恒的黑暗之中——唯有聚落里永不熄灭的熔炉投下光亮，而这丝毫不让当地人显得更贫乏。没有昼夜更迭，铁匠们将同伴采出的矿石锤炼去杂的铿锵之声，昼夜不停地在岩壁间回荡。烘烤石面包的香气，与风箱喷吐出的炉烟所带的金属辛辣味恰到好处地交织在一起。每一个转角，都有神情冷峻的矮人哨兵肃立守望，随时准备集结，抵御那些从无光洞窟深处频繁涌现、千奇百怪的威胁。
Deep beneath the land’s surface, the fabled dwelling of the mountain dwarves stands resolute within a cloak of eternal darkness—lit only by the unceasing forges of the community, although the native people are no poorer for it. Without night and day, the sound of smiths hammering out impurities in the metals mined by their fellows rings out continuously. The smell of baking stonebread mixes perfectly with the metallic tang of the exhaust from the forges’ bellows. On every corner, stoic dwarf sentinels stand guard, ready to mobilize against the numerous and varied threats that regularly emerge from the depths of these lightless caverns.

Dragon-razed Farm.name:
被巨龙焚毁的农场
Dragon-razed Farm

Text.text:
曾经，这里是个能让人温暖避雨的家，壁炉里也曾有安适的火光；如今，龙焰把一切都夺走了。猪羊依旧像是在牧放，可只剩焦黑的骸骨——细瘦的骨头半碎半裂，围栏的边界化作一圈圈灰烬的线。黑色的焦土向外拖出条条痕迹，直到边缘处才渐渐褪淡，仿佛有把黑色的扫帚从这里扫过。裸露的地面旁，稀疏的野草新生，浅绿而纤细，零星地探出头来。

~ 由 LazerScythe构想

Where once a home kept folks warm and dry, and a hearth held a cozy fire, dragon-fire has taken all. Pigs and sheep are still pastured, but they are blackened skeletons of thin bones partly splintered, and the borders of their pens are lines of ash. The black ground streaks outward to its edges, where the char fades in places as if a black broom swept it. Sparse patches of wild grass stick up, new and light green, around the exposed land.

~ Envisioned by LazerScythe

Stained Glass Depicting Werewolves Being.name:
描绘狼人被歼灭的彩色玻璃窗
Stained Glass Depicting Werewolves Being Vanquished

Text.text:
冰冷的月光渗过彩绘玻璃的窗格，泼洒出片片猩红，落在地面上宛如飞溅的血。窗上描绘着一幕骇人的景象：左侧，黑衣猎人挥舞着镀银武器；右侧，类人的狼形怪物，利爪与獠牙上滴落着血。其上，月相铺展开来，银辉流淌；而在彩窗的核心，一名猎人与一头狼人短兵相接，将一柄银刃狠狠贯入野兽的心脏。
Cold moonlight bleeds through the panes of stained glass, throwing splashes of crimson across the floor like spattered blood. The window depicts a grisly scene: on the left, black-clad hunters wielding silvered weapons; on the right, humanoid wolves with blood dripping from claws and jaws. Above, the phases of the moon sprawl, glowing silver, while at the heart of the stained glass, a hunter clashes with a werewolf, driving a silver blade into the heart of the beast.

你把它误认成一座桥，但它一定另有用途。它比你张开双臂的宽度还要狭窄，由一层层叠起的石拱构成，从一侧山坡延伸，横跨山谷，连接到另一侧。它毫无缘由地跨越这道空隙。它看起来绝对平直，可你很快意识到，整段结构其实经过精密计算，沿着全长仅有几乎不可察觉的微微倾斜——因为这是一条渡槽。
You mistook it for a bridge, but it must be something else. Narrower than your outstretched arms, this structure of stone arches set atop one another runs from one hillside and across a valley to another. It crosses the gap for no apparent reason. It seems perfectly level, but you realize that it has been calculated to be very slightly inclined across its length, for this is an aqueduct.

Magical Meteor Shower.name:
魔法流星雨
Magical Meteor Shower

Text.text:
第一道划过天穹的光痕在你余光里猝然出现，令人措手不及。夜空随即恢复如常——明月与群星。紧接着，第二枚白色的流矢掠过一段无法丈量的距离。又从另一方向飞来第三道，随后是更多道接连出现。也许是神祇正匆匆穿梭于诸界之间，灼燃的尾迹乍现即逝；也许是伟力法师正在施放法术。
The first streak across the sky is a surprise in your periphery. The night sky returns to normal—moon and stars. Then another white missile crosses a distance that can’t be measured. From a different direction a third, then several more. Maybe gods are hurrying from one world to another, their burning trails disappearing as fast as they appear. Maybe spells are being cast by mages of great power.

Threat From An Ancient Lich.name:
来自远古巫妖的威胁
Threat From An Ancient Lich

Text.text:
“你们来此寻求知识。但这堵高墙之内的真理，远非你们这般迟钝乏想的头脑所能触及。我本可放你们离开，可我已经太久没有亲眼看着凡俗生灵的生命一点点流尽了。”
“You have come here seeking knowledge. But the truths that lie within these walls are far beyond the grasp of such dull and unimaginative minds. I would allow you to leave, but it’s been too long since I’ve observed the life drain from mortal creatures.”

这把战锄与其说倚赖尖端的锋利，不如说更仰仗那硕大的配重。它的锄头似乎由某种陨铁钢锻造而成——以惊人的密度闻名，却不以耐久见长。可锄身周遭却萦绕着一层魔法般的微光，想必是某种附魔，用以协助持用者驾驭这柄笨重却杀伤力骇人的武器。
Relying more on its massive counterweight than any particular attention paid to the sharpness of its point, this war pick’s head appears to have been fashioned from some sort of meteoric steel renowned for its density rather than its durability. Yet, a luster of magic hovers about the pick, doubtlessly some enchantment meant to aid the wielder in handling this cumbersome but devastatingly effective weapon.

Tavern Brawl: The Fight Expands.name:
酒馆斗殴：战火蔓延
Tavern Brawl: The Fight Expands

Text.text:
一记重拳落空却还是砸上了一张脸，一只掷出的酒杯砸碎了某人的酒盏，一把猛推让人踉跄着撞上旁人——转眼间，仿佛整间酒馆都卷入了斗殴。除了乐师们，当然。演出似乎必须继续——哪怕阶段正遭围攻。
A punch misses its mark but still strikes a face, a tossed tankard smashes someone’s glass, a shove sends someone stumbling into a bystander, and suddenly it seems the whole tavern has joined the brawl. Everyone but the musicians, that is. The show must go on, it seems—even when the stage is under siege.

Temple To A Dragon Goddess.name:
龙女神的神殿
Temple To A Dragon Goddess

Text.text:
石雕巨龙栖踞在神殿瓦檐边缘。形如蹲坐巨龙的立柱上，部分石鳞被明亮的金属或矿物鳞片替换，映出冷冽光泽。闪耀的铜门开启，通向一座中庭，其上覆着巨大的水晶穹顶；一尊镶嵌珐琅与黄金的神像，将龙之女神刻作披挂锋利嶙峋板甲的战士，头戴龙首盔。她身旁，另一尊龙像昂立，颈与尾蜷绕成护卫的环，严密地将她守在其中。它们是伙伴，还是同一存在的两种形态？
Dragons carved in stone perch at the edge of the temple’s shingled roof. Columns shaped like sitting dragons have some of their stone scales replaced with bright ones of metals or minerals. Shining copper doors open onto an atrium crowned with a great crystal dome, and a statue inlaid with enamel and gold depicts the dragon goddess as a warrior in full jagged plate, with a dragon-headed helmet. Beside her, another dragon statue stands with its neck and tail coiled protectively around her. Are they companions, or two forms of the same entity?

I Cast Counterspell.name:
我施放反制法术
I Cast Counterspell

Text.text:
我看着施法者吐出那道法术古老而繁复的词句，像鸟俯视蚁群般冷漠而笃定。我等他们念到倒数第二个音节——先戏弄他们一番——才终于出手。熟悉的麻木感悄然爬上我的手掌，我做出那记切割般的手势，斩断他们与所召来的能量之间的联系，让他们的法术瞬间失去生机。
I watch the caster as they speak the ancient, complex words of their spell like a bird might watch an ant. I wait for them to reach the penultimate syllable—toying with them—before I make my move. A familiar numbness creeps into my hand as I perform the cutting gesture to sever their connection to the energies they have summoned, rendering their spell inert.

在许多人眼中，野猪堪称野性凶蛮的化身；它不知收敛地撞开灌木丛，费力地哼哧作响。你知道，像这头一样的野猪对领地极其护短；若你不想与它那骇人的獠牙正面冲突，最好还是离它远些。
Regarded by many as the epitome of bestial savagery, the boar indiscreetly crashes through the underbrush, grunting in effort. You know that wild pigs such as this specimen are fiercely protective of their territory, and if you wish to avoid a clash with its fearsome tusks, it might be best to give it a wide berth.

Snow-covered Bridge.name:
积雪覆盖的桥
Snow-covered Bridge

Text.text:
轻盈潮湿的雪花在静止的空气中飘荡，坠落的雪片在背景里发出低低的嘶响。几英寸厚的白雪掩蔽了大多数表面，包括那座粗砺多石的桥，桥横跨裂谷，通向一片圆形而平坦的高地。几处雪堆上，灌木的无叶枝条刺出雪面。裂隙环绕着这片更高的区域，沟壑之中还突起其他锯齿般的尖峰，顶端覆着积雪。
Light, wet snow drifts in the still air, the falling flakes making a low background hiss. Several inches of the white stuff cover most surfaces, including the rough, rocky bridge that crosses a chasm onto a circular, flat expanse. Leafless branches of bushes poke from mounds of snow in various places. The crevasse surrounds the higher area, and other jagged and snow-capped pinnacles jut from the fissure.

Enercopter Pilot.name:
能量旋翼机驾驶员
Enercopter Pilot

Text.text:
一个身形瘦小却结实的蓝皮四臂外星人像老兵一样轻松驾驭着一架直升机，座舱里闪烁的指示灯密密麻麻，几乎化作一片光影。身上是飞行员惯常的道具：嗡鸣刃锯、皮革护具、工具腰带。座驾轻巧灵活，在被炮火撕碎的战场与天灾肆虐之地上空来回掠过。只需老练地轻推操纵杆，它便像被驯服的天穹猛兽般对他俯首听令。
A small and wiry alien with blue skin and four arms mans a helicopter with the ease of a veteran, the cockpit a blur of blinking lights. He’s decked out in the usual pilot gear: buzzblade, leathers, tool belt. His craft is light and mobile, skimming to and fro over blasted battlefields and natural disasters. With a practiced nudge of the controls, it responds to him like a trained skybeast.

Overheard Conversation About A Faerie Re.name:
关于妖精界宴会的偷听对话
Overheard Conversation About A Faerie Realm Party

Text.text:
“——我的耳朵里都长出蘑菇了，而且我相当肯定现在有人拥有我的灵魂，但妖精界下周还有一场派对，我觉得你应该跟我一起去。”
“—got mushrooms growing out of my ears, and I’m pretty sure someone owns my soul now, but there’s another party in the faerie realm next week and I think you should come with me.”

一团漂浮的触手聚合体——每根触手末端都顶着一颗珍珠般的圆珠，并环绕着同样质地的一颗巨大核心圆珠——这骇人的景象，像极了一只被恶毒实验强行赋予知性的头足类。每一颗圆珠都噼啪迸裂着能量，而那颗核心圆珠更以某种方式传达出令人胆寒的自我意识：一种异界心智，你绝不想在任何层面与之产生联系，然而你已能感到它污秽的接触正覆上你的思绪。你更仔细地透过这名异界存在扭动的触手间隙窥视，恶心得发现它竟长着一张圆形研磨般的口器，宛如七鳃鳗的嘴。

~ Played by R4v3nous_DM

A floating mass of tentacles—each ending in a pearl-like orb and surrounding one large, central orb of the same likeness—this horrific vision resembles nothing so much as a cephalopod given sentience through malevolent experimentation. Each orb crackles with power, while the central orb somehow communicates a terrifying sentience: an alien consciousness that you have no desire to connect with on any level, though you can already feel its vile touch upon your mind. Looking carefully between the writhing tentacles of this outsider, you are disgusted to see a circular, grinding mouth like that of a lamprey eel.

~ Played by R4v3nous_DM

他大步穿行在城市阴影的边缘——靴底在被遗忘、被遗弃的可怜虫哀嚎间低语——那是个面色苍白的男人，披着黑色的念头，也披着黑色的衣装。瞳孔漆黑如虚空，从一张由冷硬棱角雕凿出的脸上直直逼视。头发与胡须尽数剃净，只剩两道浓密的眉毛如檐般覆下，将他的怒容罩进阴影里。他的外套下穿着久经考验的护甲——镀铬尖刺从肩甲上突起，刺穿皮革，张扬地散发着威胁。他布满伤痕的双手在绣着火焰的袖口下不安地抽动，渴望在第一丝荒唐的苗头出现时，就放出灼燃的死亡。

~ Played by Tusker2zero with

Striding through the shadowed fringes of the city—boots whispering amid the wails of forgotten and forsaken wretches—is a pale man draped in black thoughts and black attire. Pupils, dark as the void, stare out from a face hewn from hard angles. His head and beard have been shaved, leaving two bushy eyebrows to canopy his glower in shadow. He wears well-tested armor beneath his overcoat—spikes of chrome jutting from the pauldrons to pierce the leather with ostentatious menace. His scarred hands twitch beneath the flame-embroidered cuffs of the jacket, eager to loose burning death at the first hint of nonsense.

~ Played by Tusker2zero with

Ghostly Sword Opens Portal To Another Re.name:
幽魂之剑开启通往异界的传送门
Ghostly Sword Opens Portal To Another Realm

Text.text:
刀锋在接触时冰凉，握持越久，越像把你体内的暖意一点点抽走。黑曜石般的微光覆上这柄武器，在金属上投下跳跃的影子，如癫狂般舞动，带着骇人的热烈。你照常演练剑术套路，挥斩之际，一股刺耳的能量猛然贯穿你的手臂——随之劈开你所在世界与虚无飘渺之间那层纤薄的帷幕。

~ 由 Andrew Sanguine 在 Discord 上 构想

The blade is cool to the touch and seems to sap warmth from your body the longer you wield it. An obsidian shimmer graces the weapon, casting dancing shadows across the metal in cavorting displays of macabre fervor. You run through your swordplay routine, and a jarring burst of energy rushes through your arm when you swing—and slice open the thin veil between your world and the ethereal.

~ Envisioned by Andrew Sanguine on Discord

Insult About Low Intelligence By Frustra.name:
被恼火的队友嘲讽智商低
Insult About Low Intelligence By Frustrated Party Member

Text.text:
“你知道要是没有你这种蠢货来搅局，能解决多少麻烦吗？当然不知道。这样吧，你只要点点头，说‘是’还是‘不’，然后让聪明人来收拾烂摊子——趁你还没把别的东西也搞砸之前。”
“Do you know how many problems would be fixed if idiots like you didn’t interfere? Of course, you don’t. Tell you what, just nod your head yes or no, then let the smart people solve this before you break anything else.”

Flint The Rune Knight.name:
燧石：符文骑士
Flint The Rune Knight

Text.text:
