一只小小的熔岩魅灵扑闪着飞到符文骑士面前，皱眉瞪视片刻，又耸耸肩。这个元素骑士——端庄而炽烈的孩子，已然高挑健壮——回以微笑。他几乎在字面意义上阴燃着：年轻骑士的皮肤由玄武岩构成，其上刻满符文；一个伸展便让岩壳龟裂，裂缝中显露出熔融的元素内里。燧石的头颅是一团火，情绪要么猛然喷发，要么低低闷燃。尽管那对深红的球形眼难以读懂，这位骑士的姿态却清晰流露出对物质位面的困惑与着迷。他可以化作巨人、化作尘暴，或化作一个衣着朴素、却怀着古老心智的尘世孩童。

~ Played by Knucklepop with

A little magma mephit flits to the rune knight and scowls, then shrugs. This elemental knight, a dignified and fiery child already tall and muscular, smiles back. Literally smoldering, the young knight’s skin is made of basalt, carved with runes, which cracks during a stretch to reveal a molten elemental interior. Flint’s head is a fire that emotionally erupts or simmers. Although their crimson orb-eyes are hard to read, the knight’s bearing expresses both confusion and fascination at the material plane. They can become a giant, a dust storm, or a simply-dressed child of the world with an ancient mind.

~ Played by Knucklepop with

Forced-labor Mine.name:
强迫劳役矿坑
Forced-labor Mine

Text.text:
兜帽监工们冷眼守望着一排排工人——身与命都被锁链拴在一起。工业的喧嚣被鞭梢锐利的炸响骤然撕裂，紧随其后的痛苦哀嚎回荡不绝，把尘土呛人的空气灌满一曲悲惨的交响。

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

Hooded taskmasters stand watch over lines of workers chained together in body and fate. The tumult of industry is interrupted by the keen crack of a whip and the agonized cry that follows, filling the dust-choked air with a symphony of misery.

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

Audience With Immortal God-king.name:
觐见不朽神王
Audience With Immortal God-king

Text.text:
庄严弥漫在这座奢华而古老的殿堂里，仿佛正从殿中央王座上的那名傲然男子身上渗出。他虽披着凡人的外相，双眼却闪烁着难以想象的力量与知识，仿佛现实不过是个概念，只要他愿意，随时都能改写。就在他右侧，一道修长的身影静立，五官尖削，肌肤如热带海洋般明艳湛蓝；他挑眉注视着你，唇边挂着洞悉一切的微笑。那生物的眼眸熠熠生辉，越过你的表象，直刺灵魂，将你的秘密尽数剥开。他们已经审判了你，而他们看起来毫不在意。

~ 由 Mitch Prince 构想

Solemnity permeates the lavish, ancient hall as if emanating from the imperious man on the throne at its center. Though he wears the guise of a mortal, his eyes shimmer with unimaginable power and knowledge, as if reality is merely a concept he can alter whenever he sees fit. At his right hand, a lithe figure with pointed features and skin the radiant blue of a tropical ocean watches you with a raised brow and a knowing smile. The creature’s sparkling eyes look beyond your appearance, penetrating your soul and laying your secrets bare. They have judged you, and they seem unimpressed.

~ Envisioned by Mitch Prince

你高声吟诵法术的咒词，将双掌按在地面。刹那间，伴随着钢铁般的嘶鸣，虚幻的刀刃自大地中暴起。这些刀刃由纯粹的魔法之力凝成，以无情的速度一次又一次向上刺穿，凡敢跨越界限者，尽皆被贯穿。
You speak aloud the words of the spell, and place your palms on the ground. Suddenly, with a hiss of steel, phantasmal blades erupt from the earth. Composed of pure magical force, the blades stab upward again and again with speed and ruthlessness, skewering any who dare cross the threshold.

长翅而邪恶的虫群化作狂乱的黑云遮蔽天空。它们俯冲而下，聒噪的嗡鸣淹没了所有声音。粗糙的身躯掠过，擦着你的皮肤滑过。几只甚至攀附在你身上，细腿沿着你的四肢、颈项与头颅爬行。
Insects winged and wicked darken the sky in a frenetic cloud. They descend, their vociferous hum drowning out all other sound. Rough bodies rush by, skidding against your skin. A few gain purchase upon you, their legs crawling along your limbs, neck, and head.

瀑布上奔涌的常态水流，如今被包裹的坚冰牢牢钳住，让你觉得自己所见的不只是寒冬的痕迹，而是一个在时代里凝固的瞬间。一阵微风自瀑顶拂过，卷起一缕闪烁的霜晶，提醒你：当这些水重获流动的自由时，必会有雾气自激流间升腾。
The normal rush of water over the falls is held in the grip of encasing ice, giving you the feeling that you look not just at the effects of a cold winter, but at a moment frozen in time. A breeze blows a curl of glittering frost from the top of the falls, reminding you of the mist that must rise from these waters when they have the freedom to flow.

Irony The Tiefling Paladin.name:
讽刺，那位提夫林圣武士
Irony The Tiefling Paladin

Text.text:
他步履坚定地穿过镇子时，你从那人斗篷下瞥见一角——他用缠满厚厚绷带的手，略一抬起深深的兜帽。陌生人的皮肤红得像刚刚泼洒的鲜血；斑驳骨质的犄角自他紧蹙的眉脊上方突起，威严地向后盘卷，贴向他光秃的头顶。你将这张与众不同的脸与——刻在其上的东西——一并细看，那神情仿佛要灼进你的记忆里。左脸颊上一道醒目的疤痕先是短暂攫住你的目光，随即你的视线又被他猩红皮肤上那幅壮丽的纹身牵引：一簇永不熄灭的火焰——以墨为书——自鼻梁处向外绽开，化作咆哮般的爆燃。腰带上挂着一条磨得发旧的马笼头——可他身边却没有马。

~ Played by Justinian

You catch a glimpse beneath the figure’s cloak as he strides purposefully through the town, adjusting his deep hood with a heavily bandaged hand. The stranger’s skin is as red as freshly spilt blood, and horns of mottled bone protrude above his furrowed brow, curling majestically towards the man’s bald crown. His countenance burns itself into your memory as you take in the details of his distinctive face—and the things etched upon it. A prominent scar across his left cheek draws your eye momentarily before your gaze is pulled to the magnificent tattoo marked on his crimson skin. A flame burns eternally upon his face—scribed in ink—blossoming outward from the bridge of his nose in a roaring burst. Upon his belt hangs a well-worn bridle—yet he has no horse with him.

~ Played by Justinian

Chain Mail Armor.name:
锁子甲护甲
Chain Mail Armor

Text.text:
这套沉甸甸的锁子甲由一件带兜帽的长锁子甲外衣组成，外披在同样及膝的厚实羊毛绗垫内衣之上。羊毛内衣没有兜帽，仿佛默认穿戴者会自备帽子。锁甲做工精良，而内衣只残留着前任主人极淡的气味。
This hefty suit of chain mail consists of a long and hooded coat of mail, worn over a similarly long coat of thickly padded wool. The undercoat of wool lacks a hood, perhaps supposing the wearer will provide their own hat. The mail seems well made and the undercoat has only a faint odor from its previous wearer.

Overheard Advertisement For An Inn.name:
旅店的耳边广告
Overheard Advertisement For An Inn

Text.text:
“我们的文明正当着我们的面崩塌。黑暗势力在这片土地上畅行无阻。这个世界已经不再讲理，但你知道还有什么依旧讲理吗？一块多汁的牛排、一大杯热乎的酒，还有一群好伙伴。来吧，走进安慰小酒馆，尽情放纵，用每一口咸香把混乱挡在门外。”
“Our civilization is crumbling before us. Dark powers move unimpeded through these lands. The world has stopped making sense, but you know what still does? A juicy steak, a warm flagon, and good company. Come on down to the Comfort Cantina, indulge, and shut out the chaos with each savory bite.”

Elf Woman Teaching Wyrmling To Hunt.name:
精灵女子教幼龙狩猎
Elf Woman Teaching Wyrmling To Hunt

Text.text:
精灵纤细的手指灵巧一甩，便在身侧召来一只乌鸦；同伴对那鸟儿的反应动作（）让她唇边漾起暖意的笑。那只小小的紫色巨龙像家猫在小屋花园里潜行般贴地伏低，将闪烁的身躯藏进高草之中，悄无声息地朝着羽毛覆身的对手逼近。笑声在空气里咕嘟咕嘟地冒出来，精灵终究没能按捺住乐意；她的欢欣随着柔软的夏日微风一路攀升。

~ 由 Ameria 在 Discord 上 构想

With a deft flick of her slender fingers, the elf conjures a raven to her side, her companion’s reaction to the bird bringing a warm smile to her face. Like a house cat stalking through a cottage garden, the small purple dragon gets low to the ground, concealing its shimmering body in the tall grass as it creeps toward its feathered foe. Laughter bubbles through the air as the elf fails to contain her amusement, her jubilation rising on the soft summer breeze.

~ Envisioned by Ameria on Discord

Tiefling At A Bar.name:
酒吧里的提夫林
Tiefling At A Bar

Text.text:
指甲有节奏地轻敲着木面，那提夫林疏离地坐着，手握酒杯。他一边慢慢品着酒，一边将两枚银币推过柜台；烛光里，他的黑角投下恶魔般的阴影，红皮肤泛着灼热的光泽。空灵的乐声飘荡，他随之轻轻摇晃，又灌下一大口，酒液沿着下巴淌成细线。
Nails tap rhythmically against wood as the tiefling sits aloof, tankard in hand. He pushes two silvers across the counter as he savors his drink, his black horns giving off a devilish shadow in the candlelight and his red skin bearing a fiery glow. He sways softly to the airy music as he takes another swig, a stream of liquor dripping down his chin.

Headstone: “The” Worn Smooth.name:
墓碑：“那块”被磨得光滑如新
Headstone: “The” Worn Smooth

Text.text: 这块界碑的顶端，以及最靠近小径的那一角，已被磨得圆滑发亮。也许人们的习俗是在攀登通往主神殿的台阶前先接触它；又或者在参加某场仪式时，人们总爱倚靠着它。其上刻着这样一句话：通往天堂的小径与通往救赎的大道，皆以牺牲铺就。 This marker’s top, and the corner nearest the path, have been worn smooth and shining. Perhaps it has been the custom of folk to touch it before climbing the stairs to the main shrine, or maybe people lean against it as they attend some ceremony. Its words read: The path to paradise and the road to redemption are both paved with sacrifice.

云层终于散去，让你得以目睹这座矮人工艺的奇迹。沿着陡峭得连山羊旅行都嫌勉强的山路攀行，你抵达一处略高于城池的观景点，眼前的城市如同雕刻般凿入山巅，以山势的斜坡作天然壁垒。就在这道屏障之内，田地与池塘如园林般清丽错落；数座塔楼据要而立，塔顶架着弩炮；而那座森严的要塞巍然耸立，扼守通往下方城邑的入口。
The clouds at last clear away and allow you to see this wonder of dwarven engineering. From the pitched pathways barely fit for a goat to travel, you arrived at a vantage slightly above the city, allowing you to see how it is dug into the top of the mountain, using mountain slopes as protective walls. Within this boundary lies a set of fields and ponds of garden-like beauty, strategically placed towers topped by ballistae, and the formidable keep that guards entry to the city below.

如灰烬般的孢子从那漂浮在你头顶的真菌巨怪身上簌簌落下，仿佛一轮腐臭的月亮。它那庞然躯体是一幅畸变的织锦：扭曲的血肉、幽光流淌的触须、盘结虬结的菌丝交错缠绕。它张口一啸，足以吞没城池的巨颚以血肉构成的X形豁然裂开，十字的每一道截面都由尖牙把守——那些獠牙又长又利，犹如高耸的尖塔。它的九只眼睛俯瞰而下，闪烁着跨越亿万纪元的智慧，几近全知的意味令人不寒而栗。那菌类之物仿佛具备行星般的引力，每一次吸气都将你从脚下扯离，拖拽着向它逼近。
Spores like ash fall from the fungal monstrosity that floats above you like some putrid moon. Its colossal body is an aberrant tapestry of twisted flesh, bioluminescent tendrils, and gnarled mycelium. Yawning wide, its city-swallowing maw opens in a fleshy X, each cross section guarded by teeth as long and sharp as spires. Its ennead eyes shine down with eon-spanning intelligence that hints at near omniscience. The fungoid seems to possess some planetary pull as every inhale draws you off your feet and toward it.

圆润的岩脊如石制阳台般探出地表，悬挂在峭壁之上，凌空而立。它或为长风或为长河在亿万年前雕琢而成，如今这处峭崖成了绝佳的瞭望点：极目远眺，遥远的地标、薄雾笼罩的遗迹、蜿蜒的河流与浓密的林海尽收眼底，尽皆伏于令人眩目的高空之下。
The rounded outcropping protrudes over the landscape like a stone balcony, hanging in the air above the cliffs. Carved eons ago by wind or river, the bluff provides a perfect vantage point: you see distant landmarks, shrouded ruins, winding rivers, and dense foliage, all beneath the staggering heights.

这座小洞窟宛如一口弥漫瘟疫的腐臭坩埚，光是望去便令人作呕。你踏入其中，腐烂的酸馊气息便汹涌灌满你的感官；脚下之路仅靠从一堆堆酸败秽物上滋生的磷光蘑菇投下的幽微光芒勉强照亮。
Like a fetid cauldron rife with pestilence, the small cave is repellent to behold. The sour tang of rot floods your senses as you venture in, your way lit dimly by the phosphorescent mushrooms growing from the heaps of rancid detritus.

Astral Dreadnought Encounter.name:
星界恐惧巨兽遭遇
Astral Dreadnought Encounter

Text.text:
起初，你并不确定自己看见了什么。那只是本该星海璀璨处的一团黑暗，正缓缓掠过你的视野——随即，一只巨大的黄色眼睛猛然睁开，一张口从黑暗中张开。你面前的巨喉庞大得骇人，足以将鲸鱼整只吞下；而成排如长剑般的獠牙更是确保，凡落入那咽喉的东西绝不会完整无损地滑下去。两只巨大的蟹钳与一条粗长如蛇的躯体，拼合出这头灰皮怪物的全貌，它正步步逼近你的所在。
At first, you aren’t sure what you’re seeing. It's simply a blackness in what is otherwise a sea of stars, moving slowly across your vision, but then one great yellow eye snaps open and a mouth opens out of the dark. The maw before you is massive, large enough to swallow whales whole, though there are rows of teeth as long as swords to ensure that whatever goes down that gullet would not do so in one piece. Two enormous crab-like pincers and a large serpentine-like body complete the gray-skinned monstrosity as it advances on your position.

Automatic Mortar And Pestle.name:
自动研钵与研杵
Automatic Mortar And Pestle

Text.text:
你面前的研钵与研杵看起来与寻常无异，唯独那两件器具正细微颤动、轻轻抖摇——仿佛有生命一般。而当你俯身望进研钵里，才发现底部沉着一层研磨得极细的粉末。钵身由坚韧的陶瓷制成，外壁覆着描绘研磨流程的纹饰，几乎像一套操作说明。只是——图上没有任何一笔提到需要由你来动手研磨……

~ 构想：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The mortar and pestle before you is just like any other, except the two pieces quiver and shake—they seem alive. And when you look inside the mortar, you notice finely ground powder at the bottom. The bowl is made of a tough ceramic covered in artwork that depicts the grinding process, almost like a set of instructions. Only, they don’t show anything about you needing to do the grinding…

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Divine Gardens Of A Goddess Of Fertility.name:
丰饶女神的神圣花园
Divine Gardens Of A Goddess Of Fertility

Text.text:
雌冬青扎根之处，深绿愈发浓密；旁侧便栽下一株雄株。如此，鲜亮的红色浆果便应声而来。蜜蜂在果树间轻掠穿梭，于虞美人与羽扇豆间嗡嗡作响，又在低垂的向日葵花盘上起伏点落，仿佛殖民者登陆金色的星球。花园中央是她的屋舍，披着美丽的外衣；河水的流淌与拂叶穿瓣的微风在其间歌唱，穿过棕榈的羽状叶、枝叶与花瓣。大地是她的身体；而在地底，我们看不见的地方，世界的行动正悄然进行，怀着大地的财富。
Where a female holly roots, growing deep green, a male is planted beside. This brings the bright red berries. Bees flit among the fruit trees, buzzing among the poppies and lupine, bobbing on the drooping heads of sunflowers like the colonizers of golden planets. In the center of the garden is her house, clothed in beauty and singing with river flow and breezes through frond, leaf, and petal. The ground is her body, and below the ground the activity of the world is found in what we don’t see, pregnant with the wealth of the earth.

这位身形修长的人仿佛由数个他人拼贴而成。蓝色鳞片从他的唇边一路延展，覆盖右侧头颅。右眼金黄、爬虫般冷冽，宛如巨龙之瞳；左眼则闪着精灵般的湛蓝。余下的头骨覆着不同色泽的人类皮肤，左侧长着一只尖耳。缝合线勾勒出不同皮肤拼接的边界；头顶的发色与质感各不相同，却都被齐齐剪短。温和的神情里带着一丝经久不散的忧伤，将这些不和谐的特征拢成一体。灰色绷带与同色大衣外披，配合黑色鳞甲、护胫与臂甲，构成浑然一体的装束。他将一把长度堪比长剑的砍刀搭在肩上，手持一面圆盾，盾面绘着一颗风格化的乌鸦头颅。

~ Played by Skittlebag with

This willowy person is a collage of several others. Blue scales stretch from his lip to across the right side of his head. The right eye is golden and reptilian, like that of a dragon, while the left shines an elvish blue. Humanlike skin in varied hues covers the rest of his skull, with a pointed ear on the left side. Sutures mark the borders between patches of different skin, and disparate colors and textures of hair on his head have all been cropped short. A gentle look with a hint of abiding sadness unites his dissonant features. Gray bandages and an overcoat of a similar shade combine with black scale mail, greaves, and vambraces in a cohesive outfit. He rests a cleaver the length of a longsword on his shoulder and wields a round shield emblazoned with a stylized raven’s head.

~ Played by Skittlebag with

箭矢仿佛诞生于远古世界，那是个蛮荒的时代，最原始的武器就能让一家人得以饱腹与自保，或凭借更精准的射术，以那些准头更差的人为代价扩张疆域。它的箭头锐利，边缘带着凿刻留下的锯齿。骨质呈现骷髅般的苍白奶色与污浊褐色——为了制造骷髅而生。
The arrow seems born of the ancient world, a primitive time when the most basic of weapons kept families fed and protected, or expanded territory at the expense of those with worse aims. Its point is sharp, its edges serrated from chisel work. The bone is the pale cream and dirty brown of a skeleton—made to create skeletons.

这座圣龛以纯金铸就，巴洛克式的繁复雕饰间嵌着青金石的镶片；若能觅得买家，本身便足以换来王侯般的赎金。可真正的宝藏，是其内所供奉之物——无疑是匠人信仰中的圣物遗珍。
Fashioned in a baroque style out of pure gold, and featuring lapis inlays, the reliquary itself would fetch a king’s ransom if one could find a buyer. But whatever item is housed inside—undoubtedly a sacred relic of the crafter’s faith—is the real treasure.

Sundries From An Ice Devil.name:
来自冰魔鬼的杂货
Sundries From An Ice Devil

Text.text:
恶魔那污秽的灵魂从它张开的颚口间裂隙般迸出，化作一缕冰冷的薄雾飞回它所属的位面。原地只留下它躯壳冻结后的蜕壳。
The devil’s foul soul departs to its plane by cracking out through its open mandibles and flying out as a cold mist. It leaves behind the frozen molt of its husk.

那美丽的人形生物缓缓降下，肌肤如银辉闪耀，发丝纯白无瑕，背后珠光流转的羽翼豁然展开。那天使般的身影不着护甲，健硕的体态毫无遮掩；他们手中紧握一柄金色钉头锤——那是大到凡人根本无法挥使的武器。燃着光焰的蓝眸牢牢锁定你，你在灵魂深处感到这异界存在那无可估量、无法衡量的全然伟力。你无法自已地颤抖起来，哪怕你并不愿意。
The beautiful humanoid with skin of gleaming silver and hair of pure white descends, pearlescent wings unfurled at their back. The angelic figure wears no armor, displaying a muscular figure, and in their hand they clutch a golden mace, too large a weapon to be wielded by mortals. Blue eyes ablaze with light focus on you, and you feel in your soul the full, unreckonable might of this otherworldly being. You cannot help but tremble, despite yourself.

Speech About The Pain Of Poverty.name:
关于贫困之痛的演说
Speech About The Pain Of Poverty

Text.text:
“你自称领袖，却对自己的人民一无所知。你可曾尝过贫穷的啃噬？可曾体会那种末日将临的感觉——它参差如锯的边缘一步步逼近？可曾有过无眠的长夜，死死盯着墙上的裂缝，看着赤贫与苦难把手伸进你的发间，贴着耳畔低语将至的恐怖？贫穷并非缺少奢华。它是一只缠身的恶魔，钻入你的一举一动、每一丝念头；而你却张开双臂，把这头野兽迎进了你的人民之中。”
“You claim yourself a leader, and yet you know nothing of your people. Have you ever felt the bite of poverty? That sense of impending doom as its jagged edges encroach ever closer? The sleepless nights spent staring at the cracks in your wall as destitution and misery run their hands through your hair, whispering of the horrors to come? To be poor is not a lack of luxury. It is a demon that haunts you, that worms its way into your every action and thought, and you have welcomed this beast among your people with open arms.”

Sundries From An Awakened Tree.name:
觉醒之树的杂货
Sundries From An Awakened Tree

Text.text:
随着那催发的魔法逸散，原本狂乱挣扎的树木渐渐平静，归于死寂。细看之下，无论树干还是枝桠间都寻不出什么值钱之物，但它的树皮与叶片或许能派上用场，供草药师取用。
With its quickening magic fled, the thrashing tree has grown calm and still. Closer scrutiny reveals nothing of value along its trunk or among its branches, but the bark and leaves might prove useful to an herbalist.

I Cast Shield To Avoid An Attack.name:
我施放护盾来躲避一次攻击
I Cast Shield To Avoid An Attack

Text.text:
我赤手迎向那毁灭性的攻击，眼角瞥见我的伙伴们纷纷皱紧眉头，仿佛下一瞬就要看我当场被斩倒。我低声吐出一个奥秘音节，手指依照既定的手势扭转成形，火星迸飞——那道攻击狠狠撞上我面前仅寸许之隔的一层无形力之位面。
Raising my bare hand against the devastating attack, I see my companions wince as they expect to see me cut down where I stand. Murmuring an arcane syllable while I twist my fingers into the prescribed shapes, sparks fly as the attack smashes into an invisible plane of force mere inches in front of me.

I Cast Darkvision.name:
我施放黑暗视觉
I Cast Darkvision

Text.text:
我在黑暗中摸索，努力把注意力集中在掌心里那小小一片正在休息的胡萝卜干上。双眼因这份专注而酸涩——但我成功了。念出咒语的最后一个音节，我将手指抵在太阳穴上——一道闪光掠过，黑暗随之退散，我终于能辨清这片单色的周遭景象。
I fumble in the darkness, trying to focus on the small piece of dried carrot resting in my palm. My eyes strain from the effort—but I succeed. Uttering the last syllable of the incantation, I rest my fingers against my temple—with a flash the darkness recedes and I can make out my monochromatic surroundings.

Border Town Guard.name:
边境小镇卫兵
Border Town Guard

Text.text:
巡逻队稍稍徘徊着，靠在建筑上，朝妇女与孩子点头致意，又对几名看上去更凶悍的男人低声咕哝着冷冷的威胁。通往主干道的大门处，守卫盯着是否有传令官、信使或补给入城。再远一些的边境关门，守卫眯眼打量着那片空旷的地平线，交谈寥寥。他们从木栅墙上走下来去休息，随即在军用铺位上迅速沉入睡眠。
The watch loiters a bit, leaning on buildings, nodding hellos to women and children, and muttering quiet threats to some of the harder-looking men. At the gate to the main road, the guards watch for incoming heralds, couriers, or supplies. Some distance away at the frontier gate, the guards squint at the expanse and keep their talk to a minimum. They step down from the palisade to rest, then quickly fall asleep on their military bunks.

I Put My Handy Haversack Inside An Extra.name:
我把便携次元背包塞进了一个异次元空间
I Put My Handy Haversack Inside An Extradimensional Space

Text.text:
我实在忍不住，于是照做了。我听见收纳空间深处传来一声沉闷的撞响。仿佛有浪潮逼近，轰鸣渐起。下一瞬，袋子向内塌折——连空气也一并折叠。袋子原先所在之处，浮现出一扇灰光之门，如风暴云团般翻涌。我只来得及吸一口气，怀揣一瞬的希冀。随即我被拽入门中，落在一座纤薄的桥上，四周尽是繁星。身后的门悄然消失。
I just can’t resist, so I do it. I hear a low thump deep inside the holding space. A sound like an approaching wave rises. Then, in an instant, the bag folds in on itself—and so does the air. Where the bag was, a gate of gray light like a storm cloud appears. I have time for one breath worth of hope. I am sucked into the gate and left standing on a thin bridge, surrounded by stars. The gate behind me disappears.

Small Unit Tactics: Crossfire.name:
小队战术：交叉火力
Small Unit Tactics: Crossfire

Text.text:
嗓音沙哑，你嘶声下令。“阿尔法小队，向右隐蔽前进；占据阵位。布拉沃，挖掩体；我们用交叉火力逮住他们！”阿尔法迅速分出，贴地潜行——沉默的掠食者，杀意凝成一线——直奔近处一段矮墙。你蹲伏着，藏在一辆仍在闷烧的装甲运兵车后方，布拉沃在你周围卧倒，武器上膛，沿着道路压低准星。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Voice hoarse, you hiss orders. “Alpha team, defilade right; take up positions. Bravo, dig in; we’ll catch them in a crossfire!” Alpha peels off, keeping low—silent predators full of intensity—making for a short wall nearby. You crouch, hidden behind a smoldering APC, Bravo going prone about you, weapons loaded, sighting down the road.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Strange Mural In Jungle Ruins.name:
丛林遗迹中的诡异壁画
Strange Mural In Jungle Ruins

Text.text:
数十年的潮湿与地下水侵蚀，让石灰岩几乎面目全非——却还差那么一点。你在壁画中依稀辨出：一名兜帽人影立于高台之上，俯瞰着一群如痴如醉的崇拜者。那陌生人似乎正在搭建某种东西……某种机械造物。

~ 由 Discord 上的 Sahlonahl 在 Envisioned 提出构想

Decades of humidity and groundwater have eroded the limestone almost beyond recognition—but not quite. In the mural you can make out a hooded figure on a raised platform above an adoring crowd. The stranger seems to be building something… something mechanical.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

矮人药剂师身披一件布满斑点、被酸液灼蚀的罩袍，松垮的腰间用一条宽腰带勒住；腰带上挂满药水瓶与散发香气的皮囊。那把未曾清洗的胡子被烧得一块块焦黑，却没人费心把它修整齐。因反复摆弄某种闻起来像硫磺的东西，他的手指染上了令人作呕的蜡黄。你细看他腰带上的瓶子，发现其中好几只装着从各类生物身上剖取的毒囊。
Clad in a spotted, acid-stained smock bound to his sagging waist with a wide belt of potion bottles and fragrant belt pouches, the dwarf apothecary’s unwashed beard has been burnt in patches without any effort made to even it out. His fingers are stained a putrid yellow from repeated handling of what smells like sulfur. Looking carefully at the bottles on his belt, you see that several of them contain venom sacs extracted from various creatures.

Forest Dragon Ambush.name:
森林巨龙伏击
Forest Dragon Ambush

Text.text:
一条森林巨龙栖在树冠之巅。叶片般的鳞片在风里微微颤动，色泽随之流转，悄然融入周遭的秋色。它俯视着猎物，随即抬起鳞片，吐出一缕几乎不可见的薄雾——落叶与河泥的气味遮住了它天生的麝香——就在河岸啃草的一只鹿忽然抬头，直直望向林中，鼻翼急促翕张的那一刻。

当那只鹿再次低下头，近旁的树干几乎被猛然折断，巨龙以不可能的速度扑射而出。它的利爪将一只鹿直接碾进泥里；苔绿的尖牙撕开另一只的喉咙；叶刃般的尾巴横扫一圈，削断第三只的腿，让它轰然栽倒。今夜，这条巨龙将大快朵颐。
A forest dragon perches in the treetops. Scales shaped like leaves quiver in the wind as their hue shifts to match the surrounding autumn palette. The dragon gazes down at its quarry, then lifts its scales to emit a barely visible mist—the scent of fallen leaves and river mud masking its natural musk—when one of the deer grazing at the riverbank lifts its head to stare into the forest, nostrils flaring. When the deer lowers its head once again, the tree snaps near in half as the dragon launches itself with impossible speed. One deer is crushed into the mud by its talons, moss-green teeth tear into the throat of another, and the leaf-blade tail swings around to cut the legs out from under the third. The dragon will dine well tonight.

无论装在吹箭筒中发射，还是徒手掷出，这件微小的武器在朝目标出击时，都会呈现一种古怪而难以解释的动量偏移，以一种足以令即便老练的投射武器使用者也为之错愕的速度疾掠而去。
Whether loaded in a blowgun or thrown by hand, this miniscule weapon exhibits a curious, inexplicable shift in momentum when launched toward a target, traveling at a velocity which can bewilder even practiced wielders of such missiles.

这装置看起来像一件铆钉密布的皮背心，背后捆着一大团帆布。胸甲上数十个搭扣纵横交错，配着精巧的皮绳，用来把两侧勒得紧紧的。一侧肩头安着一只巨大的黄铜把手，鲜红的绳索从把手处蜿蜒钻入背后的织物里。一个小补丁上缝着侏儒语与通用语的讯息：In case of emergencies, pull the brass handle and pray。 The device resembles a heavily riveted leather vest with a mass of canvas strapped to the back. Dozens of buckles crisscross the chest piece, with elaborate thongs to cinch the sides tight. Upon one shoulder sits a large brass handle, from which bright red ropes snake into the rear fabric. Stitched onto a small patch is a message in both gnomish and common: In case of emergencies, pull the brass handle and pray.

Small Magma Elemental.name:
小型熔岩元素
Small Magma Elemental

Text.text:
那生物蹲伏着，为了保持平衡，一只手按在双脚之间的地面上。它在熔融大地的极端炽热中不但毫发无伤——反而如鱼得水，愈发旺盛。它的双翼伴随一声震颤的爆裂猛然展开，岩浆尚未凝固，黏稠成丝地淌落。
The creature crouches, its hand pressed on the ground between its feet for balance. It is unaffected—rather, thriving—in the extreme heat of the molten earth. Its wings spread with a quaking crack, magma spilling in viscous strings, not yet hardened.

Breathtaking Beauty Of Fey Creature.name:
妖精生物的惊世绝美
Breathtaking Beauty Of Fey Creature

Text.text:
你不由自主地倒抽一口气，僵立在原地，目光被牢牢钉住。那存在几乎以华光自燃般耀眼。祂的肌肤迸发出摄魂的生命力，仿佛将“完美”化作了血肉。每一道弧线与衔接都恰到好处，每一条肢体都在宣告超凡的匠造。而那张脸……那张脸既明艳又神秘，却又令人情不自禁地想要靠近。那双眼温柔，却深不可测。如此绝美，甚至让移开视线的念头都成了一种难以承受的哀伤。
You gasp involuntarily as you stand transfixed. This being almost glows with splendor. Their skin radiates spellbinding vitality as if they are physical perfection personified. Every curve and transition is ideal, each limb a testament to supernal design. And the face… That face is luminous and mysterious, yet inviting. The eyes are gentle but inscrutable. Such loveliness makes the idea of looking away too great a sorrow.

Lightning Storm Over Tournament.name:
锦标赛上空的雷霆风暴
Lightning Storm Over Tournament

Text.text:
不祥的云团在原野上空越聚越厚，阴沉得发黑。雨水早已倾落在厮杀的人潮之上，众人挥舞橡木短棍与钝刃兵器，拼命想把对手打倒。观众们为取暖而挤作一团，脑袋在眼前的混战与头顶那片黑曜石般的天穹之间来回转动。

毫无预兆，一道炽白的异光自孕雷的天空弧闪而下，正正劈在骑士扭打的人堆中央。战士们齐声惨叫——皮肉被灼得滋滋作响，耳膜在轰鸣中炸裂——随即被大自然的怒意掀飞，横七竖八地摔向四周。

Ill-omened clouds grow darker as they gather above the field. Rain already falls upon the mass of combatants struggling to down their opponents with oaken clubs and blunted blades. Spectators, huddled together for warmth, swivel heads from the brawl before them to the obsidian sky above.

With no warning, a bolt of actinic light arcs from the pregnant sky, grounding in the very center of the brawling press of knights. In unison, the fighters scream—flesh cooking, eardrums bursting—as they are hurled aside by nature's wrath.

A Snare Is Magically Enchanted.name:
圈套被施加了魔法附魔
A Snare Is Magically Enchanted

Text.text:
你面前那卷绳索看起来足够无害——一件可用之物，仅此而已。你将它编成一个套索，再施法令它隐入灌木丛间，对大多数眼睛而言形同无物。那段柔软磨毛的绳头会在有什么东西踏入触及之际，像蛇首般微微一抬；紧密编织的绳身随即腾空而起，直扑向它的目标。绳索熟知自身的绳结之道，抽打、旋舞着缠住猎物，绕上四肢，一圈圈收紧。

~ master_builder75 构想

The coil of rope before you seems harmless enough, a thing of use, but nothing more. You work it into a snare, and then enchant it to hide itself in the underbrush, invisible to most eyes. The softly frayed end twitches up like a snake’s head when something walks into reach, and the braided body takes flight toward its target. The rope knows its own knots, and whips and twirls around the quarry, looping around limbs and tightening.

~ Envisioned by master_builder75

Wild Magic Surge: Peaceful Glade.name:
狂野魔法涌动：宁静林间空地
Wild Magic Surge: Peaceful Glade

Text.text:
施法余辉尚未散去，点点魔法微尘悬浮在你头顶。它们幻化成纤薄的粉色花瓣与翠绿的蝴蝶，轻轻振翅，在空气中安然飘舞、微微摇曳。
Motes of magic hover above your head in the afterglow of your casting. They morph into delicate pink flower petals and green butterflies, fluttering and wavering peacefully through the air.

那突出的下颚实在滑稽得很。还有那橙色的纽扣眼，像木偶似的；以及尾巴那种花里胡哨、痉挛般的乱甩乱扫。旁边又冒出一只小家伙，接着又来几只。鱼群开始成形。细小的牙齿在皮肉上轻轻一叮，只留下浅浅的一口，渗出一滴血。更多的食人鱼加入鱼群；再过些时候，湖底将只剩某个强壮又凶悍的生物的惨白骷髅（特征）在那儿休息。
That underbite is comical, really. So is the orange button eye like a puppet, or the colorful spastic swishing of the tail. There’s another little one, then a few more. A school forms. Tiny teeth deliver just a little nip on the flesh, a drop of blood. More quippers join the school, and later the white skeleton of some big, tough creature will rest on the lakebed.

Mausoleum Of A Powerful Wizard.name:
一位强大巫师的陵墓
Mausoleum Of A Powerful Wizard

Text.text:
披袍的女像威势逼人，冷眼俯瞰每一个踏上花岗岩台阶、走向这座奥秘陵寝的人，仿佛在挑衅他们胆敢越过门槛。入口周围，古老的雕文织成令人目眩的图案，那些符号一旦凝视便始终难以看清。
Robed statues of an imposing woman glare down at any who ascend the granite steps to this arcane mausoleum, daring them to cross the threshold. Archaic glyphs form a mesmerizing pattern around the entryway, the symbols never quite clear when looked upon.

护城河的恶臭从半掀的木板缝里涌上来，像船只的跳板下透出的腥气。但这不是船，木梁又宽又沉，以铁链拴在石壁上。吊桥如同一条巨大的橡木舌头，斜斜伸出，在护城河与堤道上投下尖锐的阴影。它以瓮城内的景象引诱你一窥；它又以这场致命的横渡冷然拒人。
The stink of the moat wafts up under the half-open planking, like the gangway of a ship. But this is no boat, and the timbers are built wide and heavy, held to the stone with chains. Like a great oaken tongue, the drawbridge casts an angled shadow over moat and causeway. It tempts with a view inside the barbican. It defies over a deadly crossing.

Defective Goblinoid Mangonel.name:
有缺陷的类地精投石机
Defective Goblinoid Mangonel

Text.text:
一只地精摇摇欲坠地攀在瘦长的石抛机顶端，试图修补断裂的投臂。这台粗制滥造的机器每挨一下锤击便吱呀作响——锈屑与污泥如雨般洒落，砸在下方等候的众人身上。忽然，这台临时拼凑的家伙开始剧烈颤抖，伴随着木头撕裂般的尖啸，轰然坍塌，扬起一团尘雾。
Teetering atop the lanky stone thrower, a goblin attempts to repair the broken arm. The ill-crafted machine creaks with every blow of the hammer—rust and muck raining down upon the crew waiting below. Suddenly the scratch-built machine begins to shudder, and, with a scream of splintering wood, collapses in a cloud of dust.

Threat About Choosing Words Carefully.name:
谨言慎辞的威胁
Threat About Choosing Words Carefully

Text.text:
“很明显，你从没经历过那种境地——一句话的分量足以在断头与开恩之间划出界线。但你现在就站在这里。我建议你把接下来的每个字都掂量清楚再说。”
“It’s clear you’ve never been in a situation where your words mean the difference between decapitation and mercy, but that’s where you find yourself now. I recommend choosing your next words very carefully.”

一双妖异猩红的眼在憎恨中眯起，带着捕食者般的恶意将你上下扫视，老练地锁定你防线中的破绽。那战士如扑击的蜘蛛般疾动，誓要在你尚未反应之前，以令人眩晕的致命凶猛一击得手。纤薄而优雅的弯刀如蓄势的獠牙般悬而待发，随即鞭挞般抽刺而出，每一点致命锋芒都带着精准的杀意直指要害。
Lurid red eyes narrowed in hatred roam across you with predatory malice, expertly identifying the weaknesses in your defenses. The warrior moves like a pouncing spider, intent on striking with stunning, lethal ferocity before you can react. Thin, elegant scimitars stand poised like readied fangs as they lash forward, each deadly point aimed with precise intention.

拱门旁的菱形铅条花窗映入眼帘，像在无声地迎接你。踏入其中，室内光线充盈，你看到的与其说是店铺，不如说是一间工坊——几乎分不清这里究竟卖什么。小锻炉与窑炉旁的墙上，既挂着匠人使用的工具，也挂着他亲手打造的工具。木工长凳边，一只装满斜接器与刨子的箱子半埋在锯末堆里。另一侧是皮革工桌与几只垃圾桶。地上摆着一排桶：各种溶液、干净与浑浊的水，还有灰烬。这里是用工具去造工具的地方，而主人对每一件工具的运作都了如指掌。
Diamond-patterned leaded glass windows beside an arched door greet you. Inside, full of light, you see a workshop rather than a store—hard to tell what’s for sale. On the wall by a small forge and kiln hang both the maker’s tools and the tools made. At a carpentry bench, a crate of miters and planes sits in a pile of sawdust. There is a leatherwork table and several trash bins. Buckets of solutions, clean and dirty water, and ash. This is a place of tools used to make tools, with a craftsman who knows how every one of them works.

Portable Ground-to-ship Radar Array.name:
便携式对舰雷达阵列
Portable Ground-to-ship Radar Array

Text.text:
这个小立方体毫不起眼，通体漆黑，六个面中只有一面嵌着一枚暗淡的绿色按钮。按下按钮，一根尖刺从上方面弹出，直指平流层。尖刺末端随即变形为一面巨大的球形雷达天线，发出柔和的嘀嘀声；立方体下侧也随之展开并校平，化作一座平坦的平台，用于支援整套雷达阵列。
The small cube is inconspicuous, black with only a single dull green button on one of the six faces. Depress the button and a spike emerges from the upper face, pointing toward the stratosphere. The end of the spike morphs into a vast spherical radar dish that emits a soft beeping noise and the undersides of the cube level out into a flat platform designed to support the radar array.

地平线上翻涌起一片赤褐色的云团。起初只是一道纤薄的痕迹，轻易就会被误认为热浪的幻影；很快，这场风暴便膨胀成不容小觑的威势。它发出凄厉而不祥的呼号，沿途吞没沙丘、植被与建筑。
A red-brown cloud billows on the horizon. At first a meager line easily mistaken for a heat mirage, the storm soon grows into a force to be reckoned with. It wails an ominous call as it swallows dunes, plants, and buildings in its path.

Tension Between Rivals Working Together.name:
宿敌并肩时的暗涌
Tension Between Rivals Working Together

Text.text:
贤者紧蹙眉头，注视着那些矮小的技工在构装体上忙碌。为什么他们总要没完没了地聒噪？若不是如此需要他们，他早就乐意把他们俩一并烧成灰烬——他冷笑着，沉溺在白日梦里。发明家试图点燃喷灯时那恼人的咔嗒声把他从遐想中拽回，他在心里记下一笔：若他们还能活着出来，就让他们统统付出代价……
The sage's brow furrows as he watches the diminutive mechanics at work on the construct. Why must they always chatter so relentlessly? If he didn't need them so badly, he would happily incinerate them both—he smirks, lost in his daydream. The irritating clicking of the inventor attempting to light his blowtorch draws him from his reverie and he makes a mental note to make them all pay… if they get out alive.

I Enchant My Pen To Write On Its Own.name:
我为我的笔附魔，让它自行书写
I Enchant My Pen To Write On Its Own

Text.text:
我用笔亲手写下一行字，然后轻轻把工具放在桌上。我用魔杖轻点它一下，又点了点那行字。笔在桌面上来回滚了两下，随即直挺挺立起，笔尖朝下戳在纸上。它带着一种仿佛兴致勃勃的弹跳感，把那行字重新誊写了一遍。写完后，它哗啦一声又倒回桌面。我再次用施法媒介轻点笔身，然后点了点自己的喉咙。我口述道：“蝾螈之眼，三叶草嫩芽。”笔又一次蹦起，行云流水般迅捷地把这句简短的话写了下来。
I write a line with my pen by hand, and then set the tool down gently on the table. I tap it with my wand and then tap the written line. The pen rolls back and forth a couple times before standing straight up on the desk, its point down on the paper. It rewrites the line with a bounciness that seems like enthusiasm. It clatters back down on the desk when finished. I tap the pen with my focus again and then tap my throat. I dictate, "Eye of newt, shamrock shoot." The pen hops up once more and writes down my simple phrase with swift fluidity.

Temple To A God Of Craftsmanship.name:
匠艺之神的神殿
Temple To A God Of Craftsmanship

Text.text:
这座神殿由教区信众亲手建起——他们几乎必定都是工匠。梁柱以木料精密起架，石材细致砌作，线条严丝合缝。殿内地面铺展开一片木箱、板条箱与帆布，层层堆叠着奉献之物：雕刻玩具、厨用器皿、蜡烛、烟斗、珠宝，以及其他艺术造物。仪式内容包含简短而启发性的讲道，讲授设计与材料；随后便是社交时光——吞云吐雾、合力解题、勾画蓝图。
Built by the parishioners, nearly all of which must have been artisans, the temple is exactingly framed in timber and worked with stone. Crates and boxes and canvases spread out on the floor of this place. They are piled with offerings of carved toys, kitchen utensils, candles, pipes, jewelry, and other objects of art. The ceremonies include short instructive sermons on design and materials, followed by social hours of smoking, problem solving, and drawing plans.

Caravan Operators' Station.name:
商队运营者驿站
Caravan Operators' Station

Text.text:
就在城镇之外，你望见一处有围墙的驿站——既不寒酸，也谈不上多么宏伟——专为赶着商队的人过夜歇脚、补给行装而设。此地不供餐食，却遍布可供烹煮的灶台；庭院中央的喷泉则随时提供清水，让疲惫的旅人解渴，也能把水槽重新灌满。空房很多，陈设简朴却干净，愿意数日来首次在屋檐下安睡的人，都有地方可躺。全年只有一栋建筑有人常住，里面住着看管此地的市政搬运工及其助手；他们自拂晓至黄昏维持秩序，确保安全。
Just outside the town, you espy a walled station—neither modest nor especially grand—that has been earmarked for those running caravans to spend the night and replenish their supplies. Though food is not provided in such places, cooking stations are plentiful, and the fountain in the center of the courtyard offers a ready source of water for a weary traveler to slake their thirst and to refill troughs. Many empty rooms, spare but clean, are available to those who care to sleep under a roof for the first time in days. There is only one building inhabited year-round, which houses the municipal porter who runs the place as well as their assistants, who help maintain order and security from dawn till dusk.

Giant Hit By Log Trap.name:
巨人被原木陷阱击中
Giant Hit By Log Trap

Text.text:
一声震耳欲聋的碎裂轰鸣撕碎了林间的宁静，紧随其后的是一声不屈的咆哮。那声音里既有躯体的剧痛，也有受伤的傲气。一个魁梧的巨人被摆荡的圆木陷阱死死压住——在那一瞬间——露出了破绽。
A thunderous crunch shatters the serenity of the woods, followed by a defiant roar. It is a sound of bodily pain and wounded pride. A burly giant, pinned by a swinging log trap, is—for a moment—vulnerable.

Censer Of Controlling Air Elementals.name:
操控气元素的香炉
Censer Of Controlling Air Elementals

Text.text:
这只精美绝伦的瓷制香炉上，刻着一圈圈令人联想到回旋狂风的诡异符号；炉盖饰纹繁复，外侧还系着一条便于提携的链子。靠近这器皿时，你会听见远处风的长啸，脸上始终拂过一阵微风——哪怕四周明明无风。香炉偶尔轻轻作响，几乎像在低语，催促着某个人——任何人——把它举起。
Strange symbols evoking swirling gusts of wind adorn this sublime porcelain censer with a decorated lid, affixed with a chain for carrying. When near the vessel, you hear the distant howl of wind, and feel a breeze always on your face, even when no wind is present. The censer rattles occasionally, whispering almost, urging someone—anyone—to lift it.

如同舰船的舱壁，这名保镖——身着考究西装、由血肉与金属铸成的冷酷屏障——横亘在你与他的雇主之间。些许细节泄露了他被强化的本质：伺服机构的嗡鸣，以及他扫视你——尤其是你的武器——时眼部一闪而过的微光。尽管他身上看不见任何武装，你仍怀疑他是一座行走的兵器库，只待将死亡倾泻给任何胆敢威胁其雇主的愚徒。 Like a ship’s bulkhead, the bodyguard—an implacable shield of meat and metal in a fine suit—stands between you and his employer. Subtle details give away the guard’s enhanced nature: a whirr of servos and a subtle ocular flash as he scans you, your weapons in particular. Though he has no visible armaments, you suspect he is a walking arsenal waiting to unleash death on anyone foolish enough to threaten his client.

一抹油滑的笑意在那顶低垂的黑色兜帽下蔓延开来，兜帽如丝绸般泛着幽光。男人的眼睛隐在阴影里看不真切，唯有牙齿如珍珠般一闪。 그는伸出一只手，神态和气。自腕至肘的简陋皮护臂上布满缺口与划痕。整套装束都朴素得很——除了腰带上点缀的搭扣与胸针。他的扣环以黄金或青铜铸成，打磨得一尘不染，正好攫住光线。
A smarmy grin spreads beneath a low-hanging black hood that shines like silk. The man’s eyes are obscured, but his teeth flash like pearls. He reaches a hand out, genial. The simple leather armguard that extends from his wrist to his elbow is nicked and slashed. His entire ensemble is basic—aside from the buckles and brooch decorating his belts. His clasps are made of gold or bronze, perfectly polished and catching the light.

I Play My Lute.name:
我弹奏鲁特琴
I Play My Lute

Text.text:
我的脚尖随着节拍轻点，双手在鲁特琴的弦上翩然起舞，拨出一支轻快俏皮的曲子。我沉醉于演奏的恍惚之中，与音乐融为一体，随着旋律的起落如潮汐般流转——惹得观众满心欢喜。
My foot taps along to the beat as my hands dance across the strings of my lute, picking out a jaunty tune. Lost in the reverie of my performance, I become one with the music, flowing with the melody as it rises and falls—much to the delight of my audience.

Industrial Mining Laser.name:
工业采矿激光器
Industrial Mining Laser

Text.text:
这台电动工具庞然如山——显然是为四名或更多工程师协同操作而设计——并安装在悬浮垫上。激光器的外壳是一块巨大的黑色长方体，表面无数细小灯点明灭闪烁。后部的燃料泵舱敞开着；前端则由长方体收束成一枚锋利的三叉银色三角，在三叉交汇的尖端嵌着一枚斑驳的黄色晶体：聚焦阵列。
This power tool is colossal—clearly designed to be operated by four or more engineers—and mounted on hover pads. The housing of the laser is a great black rectangle, and countless tiny lights flicker over its surface. At the rear, the fuel-pump lies open, while at the front the rectangle gives way to a sharp-looking three-pronged silver triangle, with a mottled yellow crystal nestled at the point of intersection: the focusing array.

类似通往东侧前厅的狭窄入口，这座砂岩石柱般的怪石在周围塑出一圈狭窄通道；从与之相连的每一间洞室出入，都得经过这些天然卡口。其南侧是一处小小的空旷袋状峡谷，里面有一口烟囱井；西北方则是一间空室。它与西岔瞭望岗洞室共用的半岛状岩壁上，有一道古怪的狭槽，看起来像是某种绞盘索具或装置的固定锚点。
Similar to the narrow entrance to the east vestibule, this hoodoo rock formation creates a set of narrow passages around it that make for choke points from each chamber adjoining it. To the south is a small empty pocket canyon containing a chimney well and to the northwest an empty chamber. On the peninsula wall it shares with the west fork watch post chamber is a strange slot. It appears to be an anchor point for some kind of rigging or device.

Spike Growth Affecting Player.name:
荆棘丛生影响玩家
Spike Growth Affecting Player

Text.text:
[未察觉] 上百道细小伤口的凶狠刺痛让你踉跄着停下脚步。你低头看见衣物被扯裂、浸着血的破口，这才发现罪魁祸首：你闯进了一大片荆棘纠结的丛网——坚硬、锋利，并且在周遭的地形之中伪装得天衣无缝。

[已察觉] 直觉与锐利的目光驱使你更仔细地审视前方的路。你辨出一根坚硬、尖锐的刺尖，正与周围的地形融为一体。你将视线铺开，随即发现脚下前方整片地面都被阴狠的尖刺密密铺满。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

[Undetected] The savage smart of a hundred tiny cuts makes you stagger to a halt. You gaze down at the bloodied rents in your garments, and only then do you spy the cause: you have stumbled into a vast tangle of thorns—hard, sharp, and perfectly camouflaged within the surrounding terrain.

[Detected] Intuition and a keen eye prompt you to peer more closely at the path ahead. You discern the point of a hard, sharp thorn, camouflaged against the surrounding terrain. You broaden your gaze, and discover a whole swath of wicked spikes carpeting the ground before you.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

带着咸味的海风轻轻拂过你。海湾碧绿的浪面上，几个黑影随波起伏。走近细看，那似乎是几艘小舢板，正载着人往岸边摆渡。其中一艘舢板上的乘客朝你挥手。更远处，你能看见几艘大帆船停泊在地平线上。
A salty breeze gently strokes you. Several dark bodies bob up and down on the turquoise surf of the cove. On closer inspection, they seem to be small prams ferrying people to the shore. One of the passengers on a pram waves to you. Further away, you can see several galleons anchored on the horizon.

Loot From A Mind Flayer.name:
夺心魔的战利品
Loot From A Mind Flayer

Text.text:
织入这生物幽暗长袍中的胸甲，由一种形似铁、轻若丝的金属打造而成。只需用利刃划上几下，这件护甲便可能轻易从其余衣袍上脱落。
The breastplate woven into the creature's tenebrous robes is crafted of a metal with the look of iron and weight of silk. With a few slashes of a blade the armor piece might easily come free from the rest of the garment.

First Encounter With Captain Shadowscale.name:
与影鳞船长的首次遭遇
First Encounter With Captain Shadowscale

Text.text:
“虽然我挺享受我们这段小小的交涉，但陪我聊天可不是免费的。”龙裔海盗咧嘴一笑，光芒掠过他那枚金色獠牙，紧绷的皮肤在剥落的乌黑鳞片边缘起了褶皱。他酸绿的眼睛迸出超自然的恶毒寒光，利爪般的手指刮过锯齿弯刀刀柄上的宝石。“我们收金币或鲜血。我建议你选金币——但血总是更有意思。”
“While I’ve enjoyed our little parlay, the pleasure of my company isn’t free.” The dragonborn pirate smiles, light catching his golden fang, as his taut skin creases around flaking ebon scales. His acid-green eyes flash with supernatural malevolence as he scrapes a clawed finger across the pommel gem of his serrated cutlass. “We accept gold or blood. I’d suggest you choose gold, but blood is always more fun.”

Quip About Party Of A Lifetime.name:
一生难忘的派对俏皮话
Quip About Party Of A Lifetime

Text.text:
“朋友们！我度过了此生难忘的一夜——笑声与翻腾的身躯化作一片迷蒙的洪流。我发誓，在那场放纵里我成了某个陌生又熟悉的自己，那是我离完美的自我最近的一次。真庆幸你们没被邀请。”
“Friends! I have had the evening of a lifetime—just a blur of laughter and bouncing bodies. I swear, whoever I became in that debauchery was the closest I have been to my perfect self. I’m glad you weren’t invited.”

当你念出这道法术的咒词时，你将手臂朝那片区域伸展开去，仿佛在播撒种子。随着魔法生效，一片全新的环境在此扎根，迅速生长成一座暗藏凶险的森林。
As you pronounce the words of this spell, you spread your arm out toward the area as if casting seeds. As the magic takes effect, a new environment takes root there, growing up into a forest of hidden danger.

Cheap, Mass-produced Modern Sword.name:
廉价量产的现代剑
Cheap, Mass-produced Modern Sword

Text.text:
剑身薄得惊人，每次挥砍都像在空气中颤晃。剑柄上嵌着廉价黑色塑料制成的俗气花纹。剑刃平面上压着醒目的企业徽标与序列号，几乎像是在为这把工厂流水线生产的武器自鸣得意。
The sword's blade is thin, practically wobbling through the air with every swing. The hilt is adorned with trite designs on cheap black plastic. A large corporate logo and serial number are stamped on the flat of the blade, almost conveying pride in the factory-produced weapon.

一团血肉与参差鳞片的狂怒猛然闯入视野。一具庞大的龙形躯体以两条利爪长腿向前一跃，蜥蜴般的头颅探出嗅闻空气。两片巨大的皮翼几乎遮住了它拖曳在后的尾巴。若因此忽略它，便是致命的错误——那尾端长着一根巨大的、如蝎般的毒刺。
A fury of flesh and jagged scales bursts into view. A great draconic body hops forward on two taloned legs while a reptilian head projects forward to sniff the air. Two tremendous, leathery wings nearly disguise the beast’s trailing tail. Missing it would be a deadly error, for it bears a huge scorpion-like stinger.

Manual Of Bodily Health.name:
强身健体之书
Manual Of Bodily Health

Text.text:
大书外封面没有任何文字能说明内容，唯有书脊上刻着一个矮人符文，意为“健康”。这本巨册在体型与厚度上与同类书籍并无二致，却不知为何给人一种沉甸甸的分量感。书页边缘包着一层箔片，但看起来更像青铜而非黄金。随手翻阅书页，能看到各式草药疗法，以及营养十足却可能令人作呕的混合饮剂与菜肴配方。
There is no writing on the outside to indicate the contents of the large book, aside from a single dwarven rune for health along the spine. The tome is not any different in size or volume as other books of its sort, yet somehow it has a significant feeling of weight to it. The page edges are lined with foil but look far more like bronze than gold. Leafing casually through the book’s pages reveals herbal remedies and recipes for nutritious but possibly disgusting concoctions and meals.

Shrine To A God Of Travel.name:
旅行之神圣龛
Shrine To A God Of Travel

Text.text:
一座小小的石质祭坛立在十字路口的边缘，朴素低调，不惹人注意。其表面绘着一个符号——罗盘玫瑰——而在坛座下方堆着一摞供品：一块备用燧石、一圈粗糙的麻绳，还有一只装着野牛肉干的小袋子。它们供任何疲惫且有需要的旅人免费取用，但人们也默认你会留下些什么作为回礼。
A small stone altar stands at the edge of the crossroads, simple and unassuming. A symbol is painted upon its surface, a compass rose, and an array of offerings is piled at its base: a spare flint stone, a coil of rough hempen rope, and a small pouch of bison jerky. They are free for any weary traveler in need, though it is expected to leave something in return.

I Have Land’s Stride.name:
我拥有「踏地如履」
I Have Land’s Stride

Text.text:
我凭着直觉般的优雅穿行其间，踏过盘根错节与嶙峋碎石，越过沼泽与瓦砾。草叶仿佛为我悄然分开。我从藤蔓与灌丛间滑身而过——连水也不例外。荆棘与尖刺在我的衣衫与肌肤上都寻不到落点。
I move with intuitive grace, over roots and stones, across bogs and rubble. The grasses seem to part for me. I slip through vines and thickets—water too. Thorns and prickles find no purchase on my clothing or skin.

你一边对生物开口，一边让双手不着痕迹地完成一连串玄奥的手势。你用意念轻拽生物的灵魂，将其引向你所希望的行动路线。生物眨了眨眼，随即点头。没错！它就该这么做。
You speak to the creature as your hands subtly complete the series of esoteric gestures. With your mind, you tug at the creature’s spirit, veering them toward a course of action. The creature blinks, then nods. Of course! That’s what they should do.

I Cast Sign Of Ill Omen.name:
我施放《凶兆之印》
I Cast Sign Of Ill Omen

Text.text:
我怒目瞪着我的敌人，宣告一段诅咒，专为他们而发，却要所有人都听见。我以长角之印指向他们——一次、两次、三次。我描绘我将降临在他们身上的毁灭。双眼圆睁，我以一口满怀恶意的气息朝他们吹去，作为终章。
Glowering at my enemy, I pronounce a malediction aimed at them but for all to hear. I point with the horned sign—once, twice, thrice. I describe the ruin I mean to visit on them. Eyes wide, I finish by blowing an ill-intended breath in their direction.

Fire Elemental: Forest Fire.name:
火元素：森林大火
Fire Elemental: Forest Fire

Text.text:
一阵空灵的轰鸣与一抹橙色的光辉提醒你：远处有一团火焰骤然迸发，猛地燃起。火焰凭空而来，仿佛由魔法唤起。你尚未闻到烟味，但随着那暴怒的亮光愈发刺眼，你意识到这场大火正疾速向你席卷而来。
An airy roar and an orange glow alert you to the flare of a distant fire bursting to life. The flames came out of nowhere, seemingly evoked by magic. You can’t yet smell their smoke, but as the angry light grows brighter, you realize the fire is racing toward you.

这个季节的美，在于它的静谧，像母亲铺床那样。雪一点一点地飘落，不急不缓，落地即融，只在最寒冷的角落里斑斑点点地堆积。也许你会为舌尖或睫毛上的一片雪花而暗自庆祝，也许你拉起兜帽，渴望夏日。可在你四周，窃语的冬天正把蕾丝般的雪挂上枝头与雨篷。
The beauty of the season is in its quietude, like a mother making a bed. A little at a time, the snow plies its way down, in no hurry, melting as it lands, accumulating in patches only in the coldest places. Maybe you celebrate a flake on the tongue or eyelash, maybe you raise your hood and want summer. But all around you the whispering winter hangs lace on branch and awning.

Motorcycle Repair Shop.name:
摩托车修理铺
Motorcycle Repair Shop

Text.text:
店铺的墙上贴满了各个摩托车品牌的海报广告，纸张翘起剥落；而几乎同样齐全的各色摩托车也一辆辆摆在店内，仿佛把海报里的阵容搬到了现实。每一辆旁边都守着一位面相粗硬的修车师傅，他们唯一始终如一的“制服”，只有那副被机油与油脂浸透的手套。
Peeling poster ads for every motorcycle brand cover the walls of the shop, with a motorcycle of nearly all the same brands physically present as well. Each one is tended by a gruff-looking mechanic whose only consistent uniform is a pair of gloves coated in oil and grease.

Hacker Bypasses Simple Firewall In The N.name:
黑客在网络中绕过简易防火墙
Hacker Bypasses Simple Firewall In The Net

Text.text:
手指在虚拟键盘上翻飞起舞，黑客通过控制台指令部署程序，宛如将军向待命的军队下达命令。转瞬之间，黑客便绕过了简陋的防火墙；他们的技艺远非基础软件所能招架，在这场猛攻之下，防线迅速崩解。
Fingers dancing across their virtual keyboard, the hacker deploys programs via console commands like a general issuing orders to their waiting troops. In moments, the hacker has bypassed the simple firewall, their skills proving too much for the basic software to handle as it crumbles beneath the assault.

Maledomini, The Seventh Circle Of Hell.name:
恶语之域，第七层地狱
Maledomini, The Seventh Circle Of Hell

Text.text:
唯有渴求冲突之人，方被准许入内。环形墙上的箍铁大门前，每个人都领到一页规条与一件武器。规条写道：
  • 提出合理论据，便得到合理反驳。
  • 啐一口，弃理不顾。
  • 攻击，并指责你的对手在攻击。
  • 无论你如何用力、如何精准挥击，你的武器都不会致死。
门开了。挚友与亲人，竟与贯穿你一生的死敌混立其间——一群持械暴民横在你面前，眼中淬着恶意。 Only those seeking conflict are admitted. At the banded door in the wall around the circle, each person receives a page of rules and a weapon. The page of rules reads:
  • Offer a reasonable argument and receive a reasonable rebuttal.
  • Spit and disregard reason.
  • Attack and blame your opponent for attacking.
  • Your weapon will not kill, no matter how hard or well you strike.
The door opens. Friends and family stand among the great enemies of your lifetime, an armed mob before you, malice in their eyes.

Chain Mail Armor +3.name:
锁子甲护甲 +3
Chain Mail Armor +3

Text.text:
这件耀眼的护甲由一串柔韧的金属链编织而成，轻若布料、灵活自如，却在无与伦比的防护中贴身紧致、坚固如铸。锁子甲的环片闪烁着诡异而诱人的光泽，是未知金属合金的交融，彼此几乎以共鸣般的嗡鸣相和。
The chain of this dazzling armor is a supple weave of metal, as light and flexible as cloth, yet snug and rigid in its unmatched protection. The rings of the mail shine with a strange and alluring gleam, a blend of unknown metal alloys that almost hum in harmony with one another.

I Save My Ally From Falling.name:
我从坠落中救下我的盟友
I Save My Ally From Falling

Text.text:
我看见同伴浑身发抖，脸上的紧绷既有竭力的用力，也有无法掩饰的恐惧。他们拼命想撑住，可我仍在那一瞬间的表情里捕捉到一丝认命的闪光。“不！”我大喊着伸手去抓，几乎就在他们手指脱力的刹那，我便攥住了他们。我们脚下的深渊大张着口，像迫不及待要把我们两人一并吞下，但我榨干每一分力气，将他们硬生生拽回安全处。我把他们紧紧抱住片刻，直到终于松开手。
I see my companion shake, the strained look in their face a mixture of exertion and terror. They try desperately to hang on, but I see a flash of resignation in their expression. “No!” I shout as I reach to grab them, and I take hold of them as soon as they lose their grip. The chasm yawns beneath us, eager to swallow us both, but I use every bit of my strength to hoist them back up to safety. I hold them for a moment in a tight embrace before finally letting go.

Warning From A Quest Giver About A Dange.name:
来自委托人对危险任务的警告
Warning From A Quest Giver About A Dangerous Mission

Text.text:
“我见过太多冒险者来来去去。像你一样，他们都急着帮我解决这点小麻烦——可到头来，回来的人不是满身伤痕，就是神志癫狂，甚至再也没能回来。这绝不是什么微不足道的差事，所以务必以它应得的郑重来对待。”
“I’ve seen many adventuring types come and go. Like you they were eager to help me with my little problem, but so far all of them have returned wounded, mad, or not all. This is not some paltry task, so please treat it with the seriousness it deserves.”

战争的功利残酷要求适应力——无论是士兵，还是他们手中的武器皆然。战镐是战场灵活性的巅峰，能在眨眼之间从穿刺突击切换为粉碎重击——而它履行这份职责时，冷酷得令人胆寒，效率却无可挑剔。
The utilitarian brutality of war calls for adaptability, from both soldiers and the weapons they wield. The war pick is the pinnacle of battlefield flexibility, able to switch from piercing strikes to crushing blows in the blink of an eye—a duty it performs with ruthless efficacy.

I Throw My Bronze Griffon Figurine Of Wo.name:
我掷出我的青铜狮鹫奇物塑像
I Throw My Bronze Griffon Figurine Of Wondrous Power

Text.text:
当小雕像坠地的一瞬，一声破碎的尖啸刺穿空气，随之爆起炽亮的金色闪光。镀金般的辉焰迅速褪去，模型原先的位置上，一头真正的狮鹫昂然立起。它狮般的尾巴左右狂甩，骇人的利爪焦躁地踏击地面，巨大的黑翼舒展又收拢，贴着它狮身的弧度伏定。那对闪烁的黄色鹰眼带着决绝的怒意钉在我身上，胸膛里传出低沉的呼噜声，仿佛从一片抛光青铜般的羽毛深处滚涌而出。
A ragged shriek pierces the air as the figurine hits the ground and flashes with bright golden light. The gilded flare fades and, in the model’s place, a true griffon rears. Its lion’s tail lashes back and forth, its fearsome paws tamp restless against the ground, and its great black wings stretch and settle against the leonine bend of its body. Its glinting, yellow eagle’s eyes fix on me with a determined fury, a rumbling purr emitting from its chest of burnished bronze feathers.

前一刻你还是一具有形有质的坚实体态的生物；下一刻，你如风一般，化作飘散的气态薄雾。你猛然腾跃而起，随即以难以置信的速度疾冲向前。
One moment you are a corporeal, solid creature; the next, you are as wind, becoming a gaseous mist. You spring upward, then rush forward at incredible speed.

Spacegoing Pleasure House: Control Cente.name:
太空行乐馆：控制中心
Spacegoing Pleasure House: Control Center

Text.text:
谨慎是这片银河里最值钱的现金，而这家场所富得流油。这里将客人的隐私奉为至高准则，常用化名、身份扰乱器——以及更为玄奥的手段——来守住这份特权。控制室陈设简朴却不失舒适，操作员也被照料得妥妥帖帖。主控台上一排灯光对应着建筑内无数房间，一旦内部任何警报被触发，便会立刻示警，提醒员工应对。
Discretion is the most valuable currency in the galaxy, and this establishment is wealthy indeed. The privacy of the clientele is of the utmost importance, and aliases, ID scramblers—and more esoteric methods—are frequently employed to maintain that privilege. The control room is simply furnished but comfortable, and the operators are well cared for. A bank of lights on the main console correspond to the myriad rooms of the structure, alerting the staff if any internal alarm has been triggered.

你面前站着一名高个男人，肩宽体阔，金发耀眼。尽管他面容仍带几分年轻气息，手中的钉头锤、板甲护甲与盾牌也依旧保养得当，但那双钴蓝色的眼睛里沉着的神色，却透出远超年岁的睿智。他迎着地平线而立，期待地伸出持盾的手臂，随后小心地转动盾面，露出前臂上绑着的一只皮质护臂。一只长着巨大角羽的猫头鹰俯冲而下，稳稳抓住护臂；你立刻看出他刻意护着盾牌上绘着的太阳徽记，不让鸟儿锋利的爪子划伤。猫头鹰的琥珀色眼眸，与年轻人发光钉头锤上流淌出的黄色光辉，色泽分毫不差。

~ Played by a Hero

Before you stands a tall man, broad-shouldered and blond. Though he has youthful features, and his mace, plate armor, and shield are still in good shape, the serious cast of his cobalt blue eyes suggests wisdom beyond his years. He faces the horizon and extends his shield arm expectantly, carefully pivoting the shield to reveal a leather bracer worn upon his forearm. As a large horned owl swoops down and grasps the bracer, you recognize his care in protecting the sun emblem painted on his shield from the bird’s sharp talons. The amber eyes of the owl perfectly match the shade of yellow light emitting from the young man’s glowing mace.

~ Played by a Hero

Masculine Windblooded.name:
雄性风裔血脉者
Masculine Windblooded

Text.text:
这名类人生物身形修长，体态轻盈矫健，举手投足间带着近乎超自然的优雅，脚步轻得仿佛要离地漂浮。天蓝色的肌肤被阳光轻吻，泛着近乎虹彩般的光泽。向后梳起的轻薄白发掖在略微修长的耳后，像被风随意撩拨。他开口时，声音宛如清风拂过，令草叶低伏。

~ JP Delofski 所构想

The humanoid is slim, lithely built, and moves with an almost supernatural grace, nearly floating off the ground he steps so lightly. His sky-blue skin, kissed by sunlight, shines with an almost iridescent quality. Swept-back, wispy white hair lies tucked behind slightly elongated ears, appearing teased by the wind. He speaks, and his voice is like a breeze bending grass.

~ Envisioned by JP Delofski

Young White Dragon Fight.name:
幼年白龙之战
Young White Dragon Fight

Text.text:
珍珠般的鳞片在阳光下闪耀，一条巨龙轰然砸进覆雪的废墟之中，碎石残骸四散飞溅。它仰天咆哮，双眼燃着憎恨的幽蓝。翼膜猛然一振，它昂身而起。一名魁梧身影披着层叠钢甲踏步上前，盾牌在前，战斧后引蓄势。一名披着棕与绿斗篷的弓手踏上冰冷瓦砾堆，稳稳张弓瞄准。华服鲁特琴师周身空气微微扭曲，弦音与歌声化作诡异的异界形态。一名披着暗色长袍的身影抱着巨大的古书低声吟诵，感召出一粒火焰珠光。还有一名战士，身形如孩童般矮小，却披斗篷、持剑执匕，狡黠地沿着战场边缘游走。巨龙深吸一口气，蓄势要将它新发现的猎物尽数湮灭。

~ 构想：Ivan

Pearly scales gleaming in the sun, a dragon smashes down amid the snowclad ruins, debris flying every which way. It roars, eyes smoldering blue with hatred. With a flap of its wings, it rears up. A stout figure clad in layered steel marches forward, shield ready, battleaxe drawn back. An archer mantled in brown and green strides atop a pile of icy rubble and takes aim. Air shimmers around a richly dressed lutist, melodies of strings and voice taking on eldritch forms. Bearing a great tome, a darkly robed figure incants, calling forth a bead of fire. Another warrior, childlike in stature yet cloaked and armed with sword and dagger, slyly skirts the battle’s edge. The dragon inhales and readies to annihilate its newfound prey.

~ Envisioned by Ivan

Gang Of Scavengers Leaves Empty-handed.name:
拾荒帮无功而返
Gang Of Scavengers Leaves Empty-handed

Text.text:
她立在一座灰烬沙丘之巅，目光在荒芜的地平线上来回搜寻残骸的痕迹。风势骤起，猛地扯拽着她那身装甲拾荒服。她叹了口气，把鼓鼓的头盔重新扣好，随即点亮肩部灯。突如其来的光束让围在她周围那群杂七杂八的地痞猛地一惊。她摇了摇头，朝下方的山谷一指，他们便开始了漫长的下行攀爬。
She stands atop an ash dune, scanning the desolate landscape for signs of wreckage. The wind picks up, yanking at her armored scav suit. Sighing she reattaches the bulbous helm then turns on her shoulder lamps. The sudden light causes the motley assortment of thugs surrounding her to jump. Shaking her head, she gestures to the valley below, and they begin the long climb down.

Brass Hunting Horn.name:
黄铜狩猎号角
Brass Hunting Horn

Text.text:
这支号角与水囊一道斜挎在腰侧，行走间恰到好处地轻轻晃荡。黄铜的弯卷在中央嵌着一枚完美的圆环，末端收束成狭窄的喇叭口。林中的猎物浑然不觉，仍按自己的路途游荡；围栏里的马匹却因恐惧与兴奋而嘶鸣不止。有人说，这号角是狩猎中最残酷的乐器——它能把一次偶然的目击，瞬间化作一队长矛与弓箭的集结号，呼唤着屠戮。
Slung to bounce comfortably at the hip with one’s waterskin, the brass curl of the horn, a perfect circle in its middle, opens to a narrow bell. One’s quarry in the forest wanders its course unaware, and the horses in the paddock nicker with fear and excitement. It could be said that the horn is the cruelest instrument of the hunt, turning a mere sighting into a company of spears and bows called to slaughter.

Quip By Injured Party Member About Diagn.name:
受伤成员对诊断结果的打趣
Quip By Injured Party Member About Diagnosis

Text.text:
“直说吧，医生……但别太直。也许就先讲眼前的问题。其实我也不介意偶尔来点惊喜——不如我们就当我体检一切正常，成交？”
“Give it to me straight, doc… but not too straight. Maybe just the immediate problems. Actually, I don’t mind the occasional surprise—how about we agree on a clean bill of health?”

Insult About A Brute.name:
侮辱蛮汉
Insult About A Brute

Text.text:
“你可真是一座大山！把时代都耗在挥舞兵刃上，却还是连句体面的对话都撑不起来。”
“Quite the mountain you are! All that time spent wielding weapons, yet still incapable of holding decent conversation.”

The City Of Turatt.name:
图拉特黄城
The City Of Turatt

Text.text:
这座城市的城墙坚固而保养得当，放眼所及不输你见过的任何一处；然而，本该映入眼帘的却不是闪耀要塞的尖顶，也不是高耸在天际线上的石质雉堞——你所见最宏大的建筑，竟只是一座礼拜堂。城内，风车磨坊、谷仓筒仓与牲畜圈栏并未像其他同等体型的聚居地那样被弃置在城外，而是被一并纳入图拉特的布局之中，你迎面听见的是此起彼伏的劳作声。事实上，城墙之外唯一称得上醒目的建筑，是一座阴沉的监狱，四周被瞭望的守卫塔牢牢环绕。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The walls around this city are as sturdy and well maintained as any you have seen, but where you might expect to see the peaks of shining citadels or a stone parapet looming over the cityscape, the largest building you see is a chapel. Within the city itself, structures such as mills, silos, and livestock pens have been integrated into Turatt’s design rather than left outside the walls, like in other settlements of this size, and you are greeted with the sounds of industry. Indeed, the only structure of note outside the city wall is a dour prison, surrounded by guard towers.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Guts, \"The Zealous Tongue\".name:
胆魄，“狂热之舌”
Guts, "The Zealous Tongue"

Text.text:
一抹笑意在一个男人如花岗岩般凿刻的面容上缓缓铺开——他弓身伏在咕嘟冒泡的炖锅前，身形庞大得让那口锅显得滑稽地小。他抬手一扬，潇洒地撒下调味料。墨色纹印覆在这名战士粗壮的双臂上，线条大胆而强劲；每添上一笔，都是他旅途上的一座里程碑。火光在他光洁的棕色头皮上跳舞，他低下头，先深深吸入锅中蒸腾的香雾，再试探性地尝上一口。暮色渐合、薄暮如霭之时，他的双眼亮得像天火的余烬——当烹饪的喜悦在胸中点燃，那光便燃得更盛。

~ Played by Vahlaron

A smile spreads across the chiseled granite countenance of a man hunched over a bubbling stew pot, his enormity making the vessel seem comically small as he adds seasoning with a flourish. Ink marks the warrior’s massive arms with bold, powerful patterns, each addition a milestone in his journey. The firelight dances across the smooth brown skin of his scalp as he bows his head to inhale the vapors of the pot and then take an exploratory taste. In the twilight hue of the gathering dusk, his eyes glow like embers of celestial fire, burning all the more brightly as culinary joy sparks within.

~ Played by Vahlaron

Aberrant Elder Ooze Reveals Itself.name:
畸变的古老黏液怪现出真形
Aberrant Elder Ooze Reveals Itself

Text.text:
女人的手臂垂到身侧，带着一种诡异湿腻的啪嗒声。液体从她的胳膊里渗出，浸入裙装。“你们的心思可真是好奇啊，”她说，声音颤抖，几乎掩不住那份狂喜。她另一条手臂也沉沉坠下，脚踝像是折断般一歪；双腿在她身下骤然发软。衣物、皮肤与头发一同融化成一团泛黄的黏块，双眼顺着那黏稠的形体两侧拖曳下滑，坠落时仍死死盯着你。这个生物散发的硫磺恶臭仿佛点燃你的鼻腔，带来可怖而刺痛的灼烧感。显露出的软泥怪一阵战栗，兴奋的惊叹从它的中心咕嘟咕嘟地冒起。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The woman’s arm goes limp to her side with a strangely wet slap. Fluid seeps from her arm into her dress. “Such inquisitive minds you have,” she says in a voice trembling with poorly masked elation. Her other arm sinks to her side and her ankles bend as if broken. Her legs buckle beneath her. Her clothes, skin and hair melt into a jaundiced blob, her eyes trailing down the sides of its viscous form, stlil fixed on you as they descend. The sulfurous odor of this creature sets your nostrils aflame with a horrible, stinging sensation. The revealed ooze shudders, an excited exclamation bubbling up from its center.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Savant: Living Longsword.name:
奇才：长生长剑
Savant: Living Longsword

Text.text: 这把单刃长剑带着极轻微的弧度，反倒衬得那镀金的十字护手更为醒目——其上仅有一道伤痕，撕开金色表皮，露出底下冷硬的钢。剑柄尾端系着一根黄色绳索，垂下一张红色、如同符箓般的纸片。你对一把剑竟挂着流苏般的坠饰暗自纳闷，但纸上覆满的黑墨很快攫住了你的视线。那些笔画像是孩童勉力写就，处处断裂、时隐时现。内容荒诞得毫无意义——字母被随意抛洒，既不管会拼成什么，也全然没有标点——然而在最底端，你看见一处仿佛署名的字样，笔锋凌厉而决绝：Savant。 This single edged longsword has a very slight curve to it, accentuating the gold plated crossguard with a single scar revealing the steel beneath. A red talisman-like piece of paper hangs from a yellow cord attached to the pommel. You wonder at a tassel on a sword, but the black ink covering the paper draws your attention. It forms words in what looks to be a childish attempt at writing, disappearing in places. The message is utter nonsense—letters thrown about without a care for what it might spell, completely lacking punctuation—but at the very bottom you see what looks to be a signature, the letters sharp and deliberate: Savant.

这柄竹制战矛顶着一缕长长的缨穗，矛尖如燧石般森寒锐利，与世间发给步兵的常见武器截然不同。精通此武器之人，无须向任何强横剑士屈膝，也不必在斧术宗师面前自矮三分。此矛之主手握足以掀翻巨龙与巨人、连同其仇敌一并倾覆的强大武器。
Topped with a long tassel and flintlike spearhead, this bamboo fighting spear is a far cry from the common weapon issued to foot soldiers the world over. A master of this weapon need not bend the knee to any puissant swordsman nor humble themselves before any master of the axe. The master of this spear holds a weapon mighty enough to topple dragons and giants as well as their foemen.

Cloak Of Protection.name:
防护斗篷
Cloak Of Protection

Text.text:
斗篷时而闪烁，在恰到好处的光线下，几乎呈现出金属般的质感。它是钢蓝色，镶着银边，肩部则以一层似乎由未知织物编成的纹理加固。颈前以一枚风筝盾形的扣针固定，使斗篷贴合佩戴者的颈侧。
The cloak gleams at times, and in the right light, is almost metallic in its quality. It is a steel blue in color, trimmed with silver, and reinforced at the shoulders with what appears to be a weave of unknown fabric. A clasp in the shape of a kite shield secures the garment about the wearer’s neck.

Ioun Stone Of Mastery.name:
精通艾欧恩石
Ioun Stone Of Mastery

Text.text:
棱镜迸发出淡淡的翠绿色光芒，从你掌心一跃而起，开始沿着你周身迂回盘旋。短短数息之间，百场战斗的历练与千次交往的体悟如洪流般灌入你的脑海，赐予你对这些经历的精通——即便那并非你亲身所历。
The prism, emitting a pale green light, leaps from your hand and begins its circuitous path around you. Within seconds, the experience of a hundred battles and a thousand interactions flow into your mind, bestowing upon you mastery of the experiences, even if they are not your experiences.

Plain Silver Brooch.name:
素银胸针
Plain Silver Brooch

Text.text:
银质表面黯淡无光，塑成扁平的螺旋形。背面因加工痕迹更为明显：胸针外侧弧线的一端伸出别针的卡扣；另一端则装在一根悬垂的横杆上，针尖越过钩子，长出一截小指般的距离。
The silver is dull and shaped in a flat spiral. On the underside, where the tooling is more obvious, the catch for the bar pin extends from one side of the brooch’s outer curve. On the other side, the pin is set on a hanging bar, its pointed end extending past the hook by a pinkie length.

在那牢不可破的黑色河岸上，等待的灵魂伫立不动；而在河中，遭定罪者漂白的躯体或沉浮、或徒然扑腾。他们的不受伤害在此被永恒地浪费。河面宽广而幽深，水势鼓胀翻搅——散发着千百纪元里不曾见过阳光、百合与鱼群的腐寂气息——托起那艘渡船，载着那些按规矩渡河的人：舌下压着一枚钱币。

~ 一位英雄所构想

At the black bank of invulnerability stand the waiting souls, while in the river float or flail the bleached bodies of the condemned. Their invulnerability is eternally wasted here. The river is broad and deep, and it swells and chops—reeking of the millennia it has spent without sunshine or lilies or fish—bearing up the ferry for those who cross properly, with a coin on the tongue.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Sundries From An Oni.name:
来自恶鬼（特征）的杂物
Sundries From An Oni

Text.text:
这只碧蓝食人魔的巢穴，正昭示着这位诡计家忙得不可开交：布片被撕得七零八落；一堆堆沾着褐色污渍的骨头与破碎玩具胡乱堆叠；一匹木马被劈裂成两半，木屑四溅；一个凹陷的皮球被丢在角落里；而一只布娃娃倒在肮脏的水洼中，柔软的编织面孔被浸得透湿。
The lair of this azure ogre shows just how busy the trickster has been: pieces of cloth are torn asunder; there are piles of brown-stained bones and broken toys; a wooden horse has been splintered in half; a dented kickball sits discarded in a corner; and a rag doll lies in a filthy puddle, her soft, woven face soaked through.

法师吟诵咒文，双手与指尖划出玄奥的手势。空气中鼓起一团灰雾泡，雾中闪烁的魔力汇聚成形，仿佛另一个微缩的法术在那里开始生效。巫师猛然攥紧一只拳头，将雾气压缩成一颗细小而明亮的光珠。它坠入另一只手心。

~ 由 Alex构想

The mage incants, moving their hands and fingers in esoteric gestures. A bubble of gray fog forms in the air, and inside, glittering magical forces coalesce. It’s as if another spell, in miniature, begins to take effect there. With a clench of one fist, the sorcerer condenses the fog into a tiny, luminous bead. It falls into their other hand.

~ Envisioned by Alex

Greeting From A Butterfly.name:
蝴蝶的问候
Greeting From A Butterfly

Text.text:
“别把嘴张得那么大，生物。你的口气腐臭难闻，我都能感觉到自己的翅膀在这股气息里萎靡下垂。现在，你想要什么？”
“Do not open your mouth so wide, creature. Your breath is rancid, I can feel my wings wilt in its presence. Now, what do you seek?”

Entrance To The Tomb Of Sand.name:
沙之墓入口
Entrance To The Tomb Of Sand

Text.text:
陵墓的地面在火炬照耀下，以细沙绘成的图案被精心而绚丽地铺陈开来。薄薄一层蜡将这些纹样牢牢定住——只要穿过那道门的人脚步轻、鞋底软，便不会惊扰分毫；而门楣之上，一轮太阳高冠其顶，仿佛颈间佩着一圈绿松石项圈。
The floor of the mausoleum is carefully and brilliantly decorated in sand paintings, lit by torches. A fine coating of wax holds the designs in place, provided only light and slippered feet walk through the gate, which is crested by a sun that seems to wear a turquoise collar.

Tournament Winner's Romantic Glance.name:
锦标赛冠军的含情一瞥
Tournament Winner's Romantic Glance

Text.text:
胜者昂然立于场中，胜利的气息未散，观众席却骤然一静，仿佛有一层无形的静默坠落在人群之上。就在那一刻，她的目光穿过攒动的身影，与看台上某个特别的人牢牢相扣。欢呼与掌声仍在翻涌，柔软的魔法却悄然绽放——一记含情的对视，像无声的歌，唱尽未说出口的爱意。眼神交汇之际，时代仿佛凝住不动，在锦标赛的盛典喧光里，他们的目光悄悄织出一段初绽的恋曲。
The victor stands victorious, a hush falling over the spectators. In that moment, her gaze locks with someone special in the crowd. Amid the cheers and applause, a tender moment of magic unfolds: a romantic glance that sings of unspoken love. Time stands still as their eyes meet, weaving a tale of a blooming romance within the pomp of the tournament.

Home Of A God Of Renewal.name:
焕新之神的圣所
Home Of A God Of Renewal

Text.text:
凡能抚慰疲惫身躯与灵魂的一切都在这里——从雨伞收拢插入伞架的那一刻起，到饱餐心头所爱后，窝在炉边扶手椅里小憩的那一刻止。前门旁，一只蜜蜂停落在玫瑰上。后窗是一整片玻璃，映出河畔农场的丰饶：果树累累，远处一泓湛蓝的湖水静卧。门与窗之间，是为旅人、挚爱家人与宠物备下的所有慰藉——安全而安宁的房间，铺着厚实柔软的深色亚麻大床。
Whatever restores the tired body and soul is here, from the moment the umbrella is sheathed in the stand, to the nap in the fireside chair after a favorite meal. A bee alights on a rose by the front door. The back window is an expanse of glass looking onto the bounty of a riverside farm with trees in full fruit and a distant blue lake. Between door and window are all comforts for the road guest, beloved family, and adored pets—rooms of safety and peace, furnished with generous beds of deep, soft linen.

Rer'wyn, Curator Of Osiris.name:
雷尔·温，奥西里斯的馆长
Rer'wyn, Curator Of Osiris

Text.text:
高个的年轻男子周身透着宁静的气息，被温暖的天界辉光所笼罩。他掀起祭司长袍的兜帽——长袍披在一件镶金边的白色皮甲上——用抹着黑色眼线的碧绿眼眸仰望星空。一手叉在腰间，他若有所思地抚弄自己修长尖细的胡须，指尖拨弄着胡梢那枚华丽的戒环，凝神辨认群星的连线。忧虑在他描画过的眉间织起细纹，他轻叹一声，抬手穿过乌鸦般漆黑的卷发。随后他俯身对着蜷伏在脚边的浣熊露出笑意；浣熊也仰头望着他，满眼期待。祭司低声祷告，指尖轻触身侧悬挂的钉头锤与背后的盾牌——盾面上绘着奥西里斯交叉的牧杖与连枷。

~ Played by a Hero

The tall young man has a peaceful air, glowing with a warm celestial light. He pulls back the hood of his priestly vestments, worn atop a jerkin of gold-trimmed white leather, and gazes up at the stars with green, kohl-lined eyes. One hand on his hip, he thoughtfully strokes his long, pointed beard, toying with the ornate ring on the end of it as he studies the constellations. Worry wrinkles his painted brow, and he sighs and runs a hand through his raven-black curls. He smiles down at the raccoon crouched by his feet, who, in turn, looks up at him expectantly. The priest murmurs a prayer as he touches the mace hanging at his side and the shield on his back, emblazoned with the crossed crook and flail of Osiris.

~ Played by a Hero

Reassurance After A Failed Mission.name:
失败任务后的安抚
Reassurance After A Failed Mission

Text.text:
“我知道今天过后大家都挺沮丧的，但说真的，我们得记住，这村子八成过不了几年也会被烧成一片焦土。你没看见他们把那么多干草和木料就那样随手堆着吗？整个地方就是个一点就着的火药桶。所以归根结底，这事也就只有一部分算我们的错。”
“I know we’re all feeling pretty low after today, but really, we should keep in mind that this village was probably going to burn to the ground in a few years anyway. Did you see how they left all that hay and wood just lying around? The place was a tinderbox. So, at the end of the day, it’s only partially our fault.”

Sundries From A Goblin Patrol In The For.name:
森林里一支地精巡逻队留下的杂物
Sundries From A Goblin Patrol In The Forest

Text.text:
火堆旁横七竖八地散落着粗糙削成的木棍、些许尖尖的小刺刃、几把断裂的刀——其中一把显然被锤子砸烂了——一堆不同颜色的甲虫，被关在小小的柳编笼里，还有一件湿漉漉的睡衣。睡衣上用矮人文字绣着姓名缩写，正冒着热气，一边烘干。
Lying around the fire are badly whittled sticks, little pointy shivs, some broken knives—one apparently smashed with a hammer—a bunch of beetles of different colors kept in little wicker cages, and a wet nightshirt. It is monogrammed in Dwarvish, drying and steaming.

Tracks Into Cave.name:
踏入洞窟的足迹
Tracks Into Cave

Text.text:
洞穴地面改变了足迹的走向，而愈发浓重的黑暗让它们更难辨清，于是追踪的差事变得越来越艰难。此处的赋礼是尘土。尘土勾勒出轮廓、爪痕，也带来围堵的可能——或是被你追寻的生物反过来逼入死角。
The cave floor changes the read of the tracks, and the increasing darkness obscures them all the more, so the project of following them becomes more and more difficult. The gift here is dust. Dust provides outlines, claws, and the possibility of cornering—or being cornered by—the creature you seek.

Breakview In Winter.name:
冬日断景
Breakview In Winter

Text.text: 这片混合用途的街区，远没能享受斯派尔威奇其他地段那般上流的照拂——人行道与街面被雪厚厚覆住，放眼不见一台铲雪车。住在这里的人们在工作地点与家之间来回奔忙，疲惫的眼睛却仍能在路过橱窗里的节日装饰时，亮起几分喜悦的光。甜甜圈店门口，OPEN 的灯牌虚弱地一闪一闪，窗上贴着招贴，吆喝着：肉桂卷 大得像你的脑袋！ 以及 热咖啡， 免费续杯！ The mixed use neighborhood doesn’t receive the same upper-class treatment as other parts of Spirewych—snow covers the sidewalks and streets without a snow plow in sight. The folk who live here hustle to and from their places of work, tired eyes still managing to shine with some jubilance as they pass holiday decorations in storefronts. The donut shop, OPEN sign flickering weakly, has posters hanging in its windows advertising: Cinnamon rolls as big as your head! and Hot Coffee, Free Refills!

Adult Black Dragon.name:
成年黑龙
Adult Black Dragon

Text.text:
那庞大的龙形生物，身躯如巨蛇般蜿蜒，缓缓朝你滑行而来。它的双眼锐利而狡黠，鳞片漆黑如黑曜石，鼻孔翕张，贪婪地嗅吸着你的气味。它咧开巨口，钩曲而凶狠的利齿寒光乍闪。涎液滴落，腐蚀般刺绿，嘶嘶作响。你终于真正意识到它的体型时，恐惧猛地攥紧了你。
The massive draconic creature, serpentine in appearance, slithers toward you. Its eyes are sharp and cunning, its scales black like obsidian, its nostrils flared as it breathes in your scent. Hooked, wicked teeth flash as its maw gapes. Saliva drips, caustic, green, and hissing. Fear grips you as you fully reckon its size.

Bulette Encounter: Facing The Bulette.name:
土龙遭遇：直面土龙
Bulette Encounter: Facing The Bulette

Text.text:
一块巨大的巨石如箭矢贯盾般猛然破土而出，紧接着岩石竟裂开一张布满獠牙的巨口，发出震耳欲聋的咆哮。细小而锐利的眼睛之后，强健的前肢拖拽着臃肿的身躯从地下钻出，隆起带鳍的脊背随之显露；粗壮的后腿肌肉虬结，利爪抓挠着松散崩塌的泥土，将它撑上地面。它再度咆哮，你立刻认出那是布莱特——人称“陆地鲨”。
A huge boulder bursts up through the earth like an arrow piercing a shield, but then the rock opens an enormous toothy maw and roars. Powerful legs pull a bulky body out of the ground after the beady-eyed head, revealing a humped and finned back with muscular rear legs that claw their way atop the crumbling dirt. It roars again, and you know it to be a bulette, what some call a land shark.

Catacombs Of Night.name:
夜之地下墓穴
Catacombs Of Night

Text.text:
地下墓穴如同流淌着纯粹阴影的血脉，在大地的肌理间蜿蜒穿行。这些令人发狂的隧道，其墙壁、地面与天顶皆是一片虚无，黑得几乎不可见，只在极少处以星屑般的微点反射光芒。你开始拿不准自己的落脚之处——头顶的究竟是天顶，还是脚下？你是在向前，还是在后退？不久，你连自我与时代的知觉都被侵蚀：你看不见自己的身体，也再无法判断自己在这无尽、无路可循的虚空中徘徊了多久。
The catacombs wind their way through the landscape like veins running with pure shadow. The walls, floor, and ceiling of these maddening tunnels are a void, so black as to be invisible, reflecting light only in star-like pinpoints. You find yourself unsure of your own footing—is the ceiling above you, or below? Are you moving forward, or back? Soon, you question your own sense of self and time, unable to see your own body and incapable of judging just how long you’ve wandered in this endless, trackless void.

Wine Shortage Causes Riot In Tavern.name:
葡萄酒短缺引发酒馆骚乱
Wine Shortage Causes Riot In Tavern

Text.text:
酒馆里顿时爆发出一片愤怒的合唱——吧台后方被挂上一块牌子：no wine left。胖墩墩的店主缩着脖子闪避，一瓶酒在他头顶炸裂；他踉跄窜回储藏间，反手锁上门。满腹牢骚很快化作赤裸裸的反叛，宣告一出，便引来无政府般的混乱，人群聚成暴民。酒馆首当其冲承受他们的怨火：窗户被砸碎，桌子被劈裂，门从合页上硬生生扯下。店主——蜷缩在食品间的黑暗里——对着能想起的每一位神明喃喃祈祷，只盼这场毁灭能快点转向别处。

~ thebigham on Discord

A chorus of outrage erupts across the tavern as a sign is placed behind the bar: no wine left. The portly innkeeper ducks when a bottle explodes over his head as he scuttles back to the storeroom and locks the door. Disgruntled mutterings turn to outright dissent as anarchy follows the proclamation and a mob is formed. The inn bears the brunt of their chagrin: windows are smashed, tables are shattered, and the door is ripped from its hinges. The innkeeper—cowering in the darkness of the larder—mutters prayers to any god he can think of, hoping the destruction will move on.

~ thebigham on Discord

Ancient Red Dragon Emerges From Erupting.name:
远古红龙自喷发的火山中破焰而出
Ancient Red Dragon Emerges From Erupting Volcano

Text.text:
熔岩以原始而不羁的狂怒喷涌而出，火山之巅在岩石与浓烟的暴雨中轰然爆裂。惊恐与警报的呼喊汇成一曲凄厉的哀号，人群在骇然中目睹某个大得不可思议的存在从暴走的火山口攀出——一条遮天蔽日的赤红巨龙。

~ 由 Clara C. Potter 在 Discord 上 Envisioned

Lava bursts forth with primal, untethered fury as the volcano's peak erupts in a shower of rocks and smoke. Cries of panic and alarm form a wailing chorus, and the people watch in horror as something impossibly huge climbs out of the raging caldera: a titanic red dragon.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

这把矮人掷锤结构轻巧、重心均衡，锤头上镶嵌的红宝石里刻着工匠之神的印记。每一次挥击与投掷，宝石都欢快地闪烁着光芒。
This dwarven throwing hammer, light and balanced in its construction, bears the mark of the God of Makers, inscribed in the ruby decorating the hammer’s head. The gem sparkles merrily with every swing and throw.

神龛内部右侧靠后角落里，摆着一只矮胖的陶碗，缩在背风处躲避恶劣天气。你看见一列蚂蚁忙碌地爬进碗里，另一列蚂蚁又攀爬着出来——每一只都扛着一粒沉甸甸的麦粒。无论这份供奉原本献给哪位精魂或何人，大自然似乎才是最终的受益者。
A squat clay bowl sits on the right side of the interior of the shrine, sheltered in the back corner from inclement weather. You see a line of ants industriously climbing up into the bowl and a second line of ants clambering out, each one heavily laden with a grain of wheat. Whatever spirit or person to whom this offering was dedicated, nature sems to be the ultimate beneficiary.

School Of Fish.name:
鱼群学派
School Of Fish

Text.text:
一群鱼在幽深海沟上方缓缓盘旋成一股慵懒的涡流，阳光下它们的身躯闪烁如新铸的钱币般耀眼。若有鲨鱼游弋得太近，这缓慢的旋转便会骤然化作惊惶的狂乱翻涌。
A school of fish swims in a languid vortex above a deep trench, their bodies glittering like newly minted coins in the sunlight. Their slow swirl turns to frantic undulation if nearby sharks drift too close.

The Sense Of A Defensive Ward.name:
防御结界的感知
The Sense Of A Defensive Ward

Text.text:
你感觉自己正挤压着某种东西前行，尽管眼前的空气明明空无一物。你试探性地抬起一只手，却遭遇到一股看不见的稠密阻力——你触及得越远，它就越发坚实。显然有某种魔法在此运作，而某种第六感也在警告你：别再往前逼得太深。
You feel like you are pressing through something even though the air stands empty. You raise a tentative hand, and encounter an unseen density that grows stronger the further you reach. Some magic is clearly at work here, and some sixth sense warns you against pushing ahead too far.

Pregnant Human Commoner.name:
怀孕的人类平民
Pregnant Human Commoner

Text.text:
一只手轻轻搭在她圆润的腹部，女人周身洋溢着幸福的光彩，仿佛满怀甜美的寄望城。一段边缘散着线头的黄色格纹布料——也许是毯子，或是一件尚未缝好的衣物——从她指间滑落。她深吸一口气让自己稳住，随后缓缓蹲下去捡起它，额头已沁出一层细密的汗光。
A hand resting on her rounded stomach, the woman glows with happy promise. A stringy-edged length of yellow gingham, perhaps a blanket or some piece of still-in-progress clothing, slips from her grasp. She takes a deep breath to brace herself before squatting low to retrieve it, a sheen of sweat forming on her brow.

一个巨大的球形生物翻滚着、前后颠倒地滚来滚去，隐约像是一只眼球。相似之处也仅止于此——它浑身覆满蜘蛛般的肢体，肢上长着粗硬却稀疏的毛。它借助那些附肢稳住身形，数量至少有二十条。生物体表脉动着梅紫色能量的丝缕，有那么一瞬间，重力骤然强到不可思议；它却仿佛对牛顿数值的变化毫无察觉。腿上的鬃毛在空气中绷直，如同在聆听某种动静。
A large spherical creature tumbles end over end, loosely resembling an eyeball. The similarity ends there, as it is covered in spidery limbs with thick, tenuous hairs. It steadies itself with the aid of its appendages, of which there are at least twenty. The creature pulses with strands of plum-colored energy, and for a moment, gravity intensifies to an impossible degree. It seems not to notice the change in newtons. Leg bristles stiffen against the air, as though listening for something.

Ruadethri Hlaeneldth.name:
鲁阿德斯里·赫莱内尔德斯
Ruadethri Hlaeneldth

Text.text:
仿佛从寒风中踏入壁炉前的温暖怀抱，这位健谈的陌生人闲庭信步般沿街走来，向每个人递上如星光般灿烂的笑容。他肤色红润、双颊绯红，一头赤褐色长发如火般流淌，为他的容貌添上一层暖意；一双闪亮的眼睛下，覆着一枚橙色的太阳纹身。华美的红袍以金色叶片与藤蔓点缀，披在他纤细的身形上；他手中托着一颗光辉四溢的宝珠，柔柔闪烁，仿佛将苍穹的威仪封存其内。他的盾牌更是一件最古怪的物品，上面绘着太阳与月亮——皆被赋予人形。一方的眼睛睁开、锐利逼人，而另一方则安然沉睡，休息着，直到属于它的醒时。他抬手挥了挥，袖口随之扬起，你这才看见他的皮肤上覆满精美纹身，宛如夜空群星的星座倒映其上。

~ Played by Jason Lasica with

Like the warm embrace of a hearth when stepping in from the cold, the gregarious stranger saunters down the street, offering everyone a smile that beams like starlight. His ruddy skin, rosy cheeks, and flowing auburn locks lend his appearance a sense of warmth, and his sparkling eyes rest beneath an orange tattoo of the sun. Exquisite red robes decorated with golden leaves and vines adorn his slender body, and he carries a radiant orb that twinkles softly, as if it carries the celestial majesty of the heavens within. His shield is a most curious item, bearing images of both the sun and the moon—anthropomorphized. The eyes of one are open and striking, while their counterpart slumbers peacefully, resting until their waking hours. He waves, causing his sleeve to rise, and you notice his skin is covered in beautiful tattoos that mirror the constellations above.

~ Played by Jason Lasica with

你在施放这道法术时掷起一枚硬币。它在空中翻飞旋转，每一回合都唤醒一种全新的感官，仿佛第三只眼骤然睁开。硬币啪地落在你掌心的瞬间，你先是感觉自己被猛地抛入一片喧嚷的人潮之中——你自己的思绪与他人的念头交织碰撞，在你周围轰然成一阵刺耳的嘈杂。若想从中得知任何信息，你必须让心神沉静下来，将注意力牢牢聚焦在某一个思考者身上。
You flip a coin as part of the casting of this spell, and as it tumbles through the air, each turn brings awareness of a new sense, like a third eye flicking open. When the coin slaps down on your palm, you at first feel plunged into a yammering crowd. Your own thoughts and those of others create a cacophony around you. To learn anything, you will have to quiet your mind and focus your attention on one thinker.

I Use Purity Of Body.name:
我施展「纯净之躯」
I Use Purity Of Body

Text.text:
我的气自由流转。污秽试图堵塞我体内更深处的经络时，我的气便涌入其中，裹住那玷污之物，将它逼迫向外。污染一路被推至皮肤表面，而在那里，我护体的气将渣滓灼烧殆尽，而不是任由它逃逸，去别处施展它那带毒的祸害。
My ki flows freely. As impurity tries to block channels deeper in my body, my ki moves in, envelops the defiling matter, and pushes it outward. The contamination reaches my skin, and there, my protective ki burns the dross away rather than allowing it to escape and do its tainted work elsewhere.

Frozen Puddle In A Cemetery.name:
墓园里的冰封水洼
Frozen Puddle In A Cemetery

Text.text:
[初次造访] 楼梯底部有一滩结冰的积水，冰面像是刚被什么东西弄裂过。冰旁有一条动物踩出的痕迹，可能是鹿——也许它曾踩破这滩冰的表面，然后继续前行。

[再次造访] 你记得这些台阶底部曾积着一汪水；因此尽管这片区域与墓园其余地方一样白得毫无瑕疵，你仍小心翼翼地下脚。你的谨慎很快得到回报——脚下传来一声细碎的裂响。积雪之下，藏着冰。

[First visit] A frozen puddle lies at the bottom of this stairway, its surface recently cracked by something. An animal trail, possibly a deer, passes near the ice—perhaps the animal broke through the icy surface of the puddle before moving on.

[Return visit] You recall a spot where water puddled at the base of these steps, so even though the area is as immaculately white as the rest of the graveyard, you step gingerly. Your caution is rewarded when you feel a crack beneath your foot. Ice hides under the snow.

City Of Cherry Blossoms.name:
樱花之城
City Of Cherry Blossoms

Text.text:
[白昼] 这座城市的石板街道洁净如新，两旁栽着令人惊艳的花树：深色树干如墨，与枝头一簇簇粉瓣繁花形成鲜明对照。微风拂过，树影摇曳如梦，花瓣坠落，飘飘荡荡落向地面，仿佛带羞的雪。即使站在城门前，也能望见城中心那座高耸的宝塔，像巨人般凌驾于密集的楼宇之上；红瓦塔檐在灰蒙天空下燃得炽烈。你看见人们步履匆匆，神情专注，各自忙着手头的事。 [夜晚] 纸灯笼把街巷与花枝染成落日的颜色：橙、黄与红。一天的劳作已毕，人们纷纷走向酒馆与食肆。小推车飘来温热咸香的气息，摊贩招呼疲惫的客人靠近——面条、蒸包、葱油饼，还有更多。杯盏与碗盘被添满时，倦容也随之亮起。关于白日见闻的闲谈织成愉悦的低鸣，混着贴着花树树干栖息的嗡嗡虫声，一并在夜里流淌。

~ 由 StarlighttheFox 在 Envisioned 构想

[Day] The clean, stone streets of this city are lined with strikingly beautiful trees: the dark wood of their trunks contrasts with a spray of pink-petaled flowers on their limbs. They sway dreamily in the breeze, petals falling and drifting down to the ground like blushing snow. A tall pagoda can be seen at the city center even from the front gate, rising above the tightly packed buildings like a titan. Its red-tile roofs are fiery against the grey sky. You see people are going about their business at a hurried, focused pace. [Night] Paper lanterns wash the streets and blossoms in colors of the sunset: orange, yellow and red. The workday is done, and people are making their way to bars and eateries. Warm, savory aromas waft from food carts, vendors inviting weary patrons over for noodles, steamed buns, scallion pancakes and more. Tired, drawn faces brighten as cups and bowls are filled. Chatter about the days’ activities creates a pleasant hum that mixes with the sound of the buzzing insects nestling against the trunks of the blossom trees.

~ Envisioned by StarlighttheFox

Moody Teenager.name:
喜怒无常的少年
Moody Teenager

Text.text:
他被荷尔蒙点燃般狂暴地把门一摔，头也不回地闷闷走向职业。宽大松垮的衣服上胡乱拼贴着各色乐队标志、褪色的补丁与衣物标签，带着一股不把规矩放在眼里的轻佻。格纹、单色棋盘格与黑色构成了他风格的主调，眼周晕开的妆容更衬出那双藏不住稚嫩生涩的眼睛。
Slamming the door with hormone-fueled ferocity, the young man does not look back as he sulks off to class. His baggy, oversized clothes are covered with an irreverent jumble of band logos, discolored patches, and clothing labels. Plaid, monochromatic checkers and black are the main elements of his style, accentuated by smudged makeup around eyes that betray his youthful inexperience.

Cultists Performing A Ritual.name:
邪教徒正在进行仪式
Cultists Performing A Ritual

Text.text:
空气里弥漫着燃烧兽脂的恶臭，又被一层甜腻得令人作呕的熏香瘴气衬得更为难闻。滴蜡的蜡烛挤在壁龛里、散在地上、摆在桌面——它们幽飘摇曳的火焰旁，抽搐的影子瑟缩退让。兜帽遮面的邪教徒围住刻在石地上的繁复圆阵，低声吟诵如无休止的噪潮回卷，震得人颅骨发麻，仿佛疯狂的前奏。空气愈发油腻沉重，异界的阴翳压得人喘不过气。某个邪教徒手中寒光一闪，匕首出鞘。很快，血腥的腥膻将与室内挥之不去的腐臭纠缠在一起。
The air reeks of burning tallow, made more abhorrent by a sickly sweet miasma of incense. Dribbling candles sit clustered in niches, on the floor, on tables—fitful shadows cower from their ghostly, wavering flames. Hooded cultists surround an elaborate circle scribed into the stone floor. Their low chanting is an incessant riptide of noise that reverberates in the skull like a prelude to madness. The air turns greasy and oppressive with otherworldly gloom. A knife flashes in the hand of one cultist. Soon, the pong of blood will mingle with the lingering fetor in the room.

Scribe's Shop.name:
抄写员的店铺
Scribe's Shop

Text.text:
你跨过那扇敞开的、饰纹繁复的彩绘玻璃门时，湿墨与积尘羊皮纸的迷人气息便搅动起你的感官。蜡烛的微光在店内点出一条小径，蜿蜒绕过层层堆叠的书册与散落的纸页。每张桌上都铺陈着一层又一层精巧构筑的墨作——为那些需要将语言缚住、封存于羊皮纸上的人，以羽管匠心细细织就。门店前方陈列着易于誊写的法术与雅致的世界史；而店主柜台后方，繁复的玻璃橱柜展示着更为珍奇的藏品：奇妙的巨册与笔意绝美的书页，珍贵得不容那些从喧闹街市踉跄闯入、满手油污的浪荡客用肮脏的掌心去触碰。
The charming smell of wet ink and dusty parchment stirs the senses as you step through the open, ornamented, stained-glass door. Wax candles light a pathway through the store, winding past stacked books and loose pages. On each table sits layer after layer of delicately constructed inkwork—masterfully quilled for those in need of language bound and sealed on parchment. Easily scribed spells and elegant world-histories line the front of shop, while intricate glass cabinetry behind the shopkeep's desk displays the more exquisite items: marvelous tomes and beautifully calligraphed pages too precious to be touched by the greasy palms of wayward patrons who might stumble in off the busy street.

Footprints In Dust.name:
尘埃中的足迹
Footprints In Dust

Text.text:
这些脚印几乎和留下它们的鞋子一样鲜明清晰。步伐谨慎到足以留下明晰的痕迹，却又漫不经心到让人轻易追随。尘土仿佛一座时钟，指示着每一道足迹是在多久之前踏下的。
The prints are almost as vivid and clear as the shoes that made them. The steps are careful enough to be clear, careless enough to be easily followed. The dust works like a clock, indicating how long ago each track was made.

你的心智竭力去容纳地平线上那条巨龙的泰坦般尺度，仿佛它从历史与神祇年代的残破书页间纵身跃出。云层在那生物身上翻卷盘旋，凝成朦胧的雾幕云垒，其间电光如裂纹般纵横；哪怕相隔如此之远，雷鸣仍清晰可闻。唯有传唱于史诗神话中的英雄，才可能与这尊巨像交战而生还。

~ Sahlonahl on Discord

Your mind struggles to take in the sheer titanic scale of the dragon on the horizon, as if it leaped from the crumbling pages of history and the age of gods.
