Clouds swirl across the creature, forming nebulous banks of fog streaked with lightning, and the thunder can be heard clearly even at this distance. Only the heroes of storied myth could battle this colossus and live.

~ Sahlonahl on Discord

Unsatisfying End To Transaction.name:
交易的败兴收场
Unsatisfying End To Transaction

Text.text:
货物仍如先前展示那般，摆在各自主人的身后，无人讨价还价。可商贩们却换了副模样。先前走来时还自信得意，如今却面红耳赤、汗流浃背，一边比划一边咒骂。一个在狭小的圈子里来回踱步。另一个坐着，缓缓摇头，目光死死盯着天空。
The goods remain as they were presented, behind their owners and without barter. The dealers, however, have changed. Confident and smug as they approached, they are now red-faced and sweating from gesturing and cursing. One paces in a tight circle. The other sits, head shaking slowly and eyes trained on the sky.

这头巨大的爬行生物以后肢踉跄前行，周身闪烁着令人目眩的紫罗兰、玫粉与青蓝光泽。它的头颅修长，顶端宛如扣着一朵硕大的粉色蘑菇；更小的蓝色蘑菇沿着它的背脊与腿部丛生。短小的前臂末端生着一对利爪，而一枚幽蓝发光的球体端端正正地嵌在它躯干的正中央。
Staggering forward on its hind legs, this large reptile shimmers a mesmerizing array of purples, pinks, and cyan blues. Its head is long, capped by what appears to be a large pink mushroom. Smaller blue mushrooms grow upon its back and legs, and its diminutive forearms end in twin claws. A glowing blue orb sits squarely in the center of its body.

Desert Nomad Camp: Night.name:
沙漠游牧营地：夜晚
Desert Nomad Camp: Night

Text.text:
狂风抽打着营地里寥寥几堆篝火的烟，将缕缕烟丝扯得细若游线，最终在浩瀚的繁星天幕下淡尽无踪。骆驼在寒冷的空气里低声呻吟、嘟囔着不满，它们隆起的驼峰在一顶顶紧闭御寒的帐篷起伏之间显得更矮更短，仿佛无数隆起里的一撮小疙瘩。
Wind whips the smoke of the camp’s few fires, drawing the threads thin to nothingness in the vastness of the starry sky. Camels groan and grumble at the chilliness of the air, their humped backs making shorter lumps amid the many humps of tents shut tight against the cold.

Elf Picking Lock.name:
精灵开锁
Elf Picking Lock

Text.text:
昏暗的房间里，一名精灵女子娴熟地摆弄着几根开锁工具。她的银发与翠绿的眼眸在微光中闪烁，她一边动手，一边倾听着每一丝细微的声响。随着最后一声轻得几乎听不见的“咔哒”，锁扣终于屈服。她的笑意渐深，为自己干得漂亮而暗自得意。
In a dim room, an elven woman skillfully manipulates some lockpicks. Her silver hair and emerald eyes glisten in the faint light as she works—attuned to every sound. With a final, quiet, click the lock surrenders. Her grin grows, as she congratulates herself on a job well done.

Loot From A Water Elemental.name:
来自水元素的战利品
Loot From A Water Elemental

Text.text:
元素体如巨浪拍击嶙峋岩岸般轰然爆裂，随即溶作一滩咕嘟冒泡的水灵生命精华。水洼中闪烁着几大块晶辉流转的蓝色宝石，价值至少100枚金币。
The elemental explodes like waves crashing against the rocky shore, then dissolves into a puddle of bubbling aqua vitae. Sparkling in the puddle are large chunks of a glittering blue gemstone worth at least 100 gold pieces.

Esvelia Bellerino.name:
埃斯维莉娅·贝莱里诺
Esvelia Bellerino

Text.text:
她纵身一跃，辫起的蔚蓝长发沿着她在空中流畅的弧线追随飘扬。她的双刃弯刀宛如熔融钢铁般流动，无需半点停顿，她手腕与手臂一折一转，将刀旋成一轮寒光闪烁的光环。满钉皮甲丝毫不妨碍她致命的舞步，缠绕在颈间与下颌的淡薰衣草色轻纱亦然。那薄如蝉翼的布料遮不住一抹坏笑，她空灵的精灵容颜染着少年般的无畏与轻狂。

~ 由一位英雄构想

She leaps, her braided cerulean hair following her fluid arc through the air. Her double-bladed scimitar flows like molten steel as she, without a hitch, bends her wrist and arm to twirl it in a glinting wheel. Her studded leather proves no hindrance to her deadly dance, nor does the light lavender scarf wrapped around her neck and chin. The delicate fabric fails to conceal a smirk, her ethereal elven beauty tinged with youthful temerity.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这套精致服装由技艺娴熟的裁缝亲手设计并缝制，正适合在你想出席华丽化装舞会、觐见君主的审理，或参加艺术品拍卖时穿着——既体面得当，又不至于招来过分苛刻的目光。衣料间隐约散出一缕辛香气息，像是在穿上之前，于衣领处轻轻喷洒过一点古龙水或香水。
Designed and sewn by a skilled tailor, this set of fine clothing is just the thing for when one wants to attend a fancy dress ball, a hearing conducted by a monarch, or an art auction without drawing undue critical attention. A faint scent of spice radiates from the clothing, a light spritz of cologne or perfume laid upon the collar before wearing.

Blue Dragon Lair.name:
蓝龙巢穴
Blue Dragon Lair

Text.text:
从地表倾泻而入这条隧道的沙坡，渐渐散落在一片被灼成灰白的玻璃地面上。沙堆底部有一块被磨得光滑发亮的区域，昭示着某个庞大而沉重之物曾无数次滑落，坠入这座幽暗的洞窟。隧道的墙壁与穹顶起伏着痛苦般的褶皱，皆由熔融并黏合的砂砾凝结而成。
The slope of sand that spills from the surface into this tunnel gradually scatters across a floor of blasted gray-white glass. A smoothed and shiny area at the base of the pile shows where something huge and heavy has frequently slid down into this dark cavern. The walls and ceiling of the tunnel ripple in tortured bumps of melted and melded sand.

Baroness Rilka Burrowholm.name:
里尔卡·巴罗霍尔姆女男爵
Baroness Rilka Burrowholm

Text.text:
女男爵钢铁般的目光直刺你心。她带着那种半身人特有的神情——早已从不止几次险境中全身而退。她一手搭在短柄斧的斧首上，斧柄因频繁使用而磨得斑驳起毛。她身旁一只獒犬端坐戒备，专注而静止，身披皮革鞍具，其上印着巴罗尼·洞丘领的徽记。

~ 由 Matt Shooter 扮演

The baroness’s steely gaze bores into you. She has the look of a halfling who has freed herself from more than a few scrapes. Her hand rests on the head of her hatchet, the handle weathered from regular use. A mastiff sits to attention next to her, focused and still, wearing a leather saddle that bears the insignia of Barony Burrowholm.

~ Played by Matt Shooter

Oasis On The Elemental Plane Of Air.name:
气元素位面上的绿洲
Oasis On The Elemental Plane Of Air

Text.text:
翻涌的云层短暂裂开，从旋转的狂乱中透出一线视野，得见彼岸的圣所。风暴之眼里，一处绿洲安然栖息，任凭凄厉狂风将它宁静而友善的边界层层包围，却丝毫不为所动。一道水流在岛屿中央蜿蜒成不间断的环，气泡翻腾如沸，落在漂浮乐土的铂金沙滩上，织就一场令人目眩的奇景。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The roiling clouds part briefly, offering a glimpse through the swirling tumult to the sanctuary beyond. An oasis rests calmly in the eye of the storm, unfazed by the howling winds encompassing its serene, welcoming borders. A stream of water, effervescent with bubbles, forms an unbroken loop at the center of the island, creating a mesmerizing display upon the platinum sands of the floating paradise.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

就算蒙着眼，你也能靠着鼻子找到这里——浓烈的鱼腥味显然也引来了好几只猫，外加一条狗。鱼贩们躲在柜台、木桶与筐篮后兜售货品，人人争抢你的注意力：拖着唱腔的吆喝、尖亮的口哨、夸张的手势此起彼伏。
You could find this place blindfolded, just by following your nose—the smell of fish has clearly attracted several cats as well as a dog. Fishmongers hawk their wares from behind counters, barrels, and baskets, each competing for attention with sing-song shouts, whistles, and gesticulations.

Cloak Of Distortion.name:
扭曲斗篷
Cloak Of Distortion

Text.text:
尽管墙上火炬熊熊燃烧，那件摊在桌上的斗篷周围的光线却仿佛被牵引般弯折、游走、编织成涟漪。你的目光一落在它身上，视野便开始发虚，刺耳的嗡鸣压过了听觉。你强忍着想要移开视线的冲动，咬紧牙关，逼迫自己稳住心神，直到那阵不适缓缓退去，感官重新归位。这斗篷显然带着魔法——而且非常实用。
The light seems to bend and weave around the cloak draped across the table—despite the blazing torches ensconced along the walls. As your gaze rests upon it you feel your vision begin to blur and a sharp ringing obscures your hearing. Fighting the overwhelming urge to look away, you grit your teeth and steel yourself until the feelings pass, and your senses return to you. This cloak is clearly magical—and very useful.

这把斧的乌黑钢柄之上，嵌着一枚闪耀的黑曜石刃首，如犬牙交错的险峰般峥嵘。那石质仿佛吞噬光线，使其呈现出令人不安的幽暗——宛如死亡亲手投下的阴影，伸向所有坠落在它之下的人。
A bladed head of gleaming obsidian crowns the blackened steel haft of this axe like a jagged peak. The stone swallows the light, lending it an unsettlingly dark appearance—like the shadow of Death’s own hand coming for those who fall below it.

Divine Tent Of A God Of Foreknowledge.name:
预知之神的神圣天幕
Divine Tent Of A God Of Foreknowledge

Text.text:
这不过是一顶简单的帆布帐篷，没有地板；它总会在帐篷最受渴望、或最不受欢迎之处现身——出现在那个迫切想冲进帐篷提问的人面前，或出现在那个连“答案”这一可能性都畏惧至死的人面前。也许他们是同一个人。帐篷的横杆上垂下一根线，线端悬着一面双面的镜子，摇晃着、缓缓打转；它的用途一眼可见，却又令人困惑。
It’s just a simple canvas tent with no floor, which shows up wherever the tent is either most, or least, desired—appearing to someone who wants desperately to charge into the tent and ask a question, or someone deathly afraid of even the prospect of an answer. Maybe they are the same person. From a crosspole of the tent, dangling and turning at the end of a line, hangs a two-sided mirror, its purpose both apparent and confounding.

Deserted House: Sensing A Presence.name:
废弃屋：感知到某个存在
Deserted House: Sensing A Presence

Text.text:
你几乎无法想象会有人住在这种地方，可你仍然能感觉到某种存在。有时你走进一间屋子，会生出一种错觉：仿佛有人刚刚离开——微微晃动的窗帘、空气里残留的温度、家具上若隐若现的身体印痕。你试图把这个念头赶出脑海，却发现自己不得不压住那股冲动：像个闯入者一样悄然潜行。
You cannot imagine someone living in this place, but nevertheless, you sense a presence. Sometimes when you enter a room, you get the impression that someone just left—a shifting curtain, a warmth in the air, the impression of a body on furniture. You try to put the thought out of your mind but find you must fight the urge to creep about like an intruder.

Ikeshti Brood-minder.name:
伊克什提育巢看护者
Ikeshti Brood-minder

Text.text:
一名孤身的蜥蜴状类人生物蹲伏着，神情沉思，凝望四周。它猩红的鳞片间夹杂着一道道断续的旧疤。分节的尾巴托起它结实的肌肉群，让身躯恰到好处地悬在地面之上。它迅速轻点绑在手腕上的电脑，眼前便投射出一幅闪烁的蛋的全息影像。它凝视着那影像，手指摩挲着腰间那把粗犷的刀。
A solitary lizard-like humanoid squats, peering out at its surroundings with a pensive expression. Its scarlet scales are split with intermittent scars. A segmented tail holds the creature’s substantial musculature perfectly poised above the ground. A quick tap at the wrist-strapped computer projects a blinking hologram of eggs in front of the creature. It studies the hologram, fingering the brutish knife at its belt.

Chieftains Embrace To End Feud.name:
酋长相拥，终结世仇
Chieftains Embrace To End Feud

Text.text:
一位酋长从椅子里起身，嶙峋的灰色面庞严峻却带着思量。另一位猛地站起，撞翻了椅子，俯视着他怒容满面。室内其余人都噤了声。老人抬眼望向她，轻轻点头，神色已然敞亮放松。她的眉间怒意在他将手按上她前臂时渐渐消退，脸也随之柔和下来。她用那双粗壮有力的臂膀将他一把揽住，甚至把他抱离地面，拥得紧紧的。他双脚悬空，也回抱住她。

~ Envisioned by Ethan

One chieftain rises from his chair, his craggy gray face stern but thoughtful. The other rushes to stand, knocking her chair over. She scowls down at him. Others in the room fall silent. Looking up at her, the older man nods, his face open now, relaxed. Her frown fades as he places a hand on her forearm. Her face softens, too. She takes him in her massive arms, picking him up to embrace him. Feet dangling, he returns the hug.

~ Envisioned by Ethan

一双黑色的眼睛因疲惫而黯淡，却以近乎临床的冷淡与务实审视着你。外科医生两鬓发际线渐稀，面庞刻着数十年忧虑与压力的沟壑。衣着素净实用，却依然质地上乘；身上几无饰物，唯有一枚金质怀表——他们总是细致地掀开确认时间。他们向路过的助手打了个手势，对方点头，随即无声地匆匆离开，去办一桩不便言明的差事。

~ 扮演者：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Dark eyes, weary with fatigue, regard you with clinical detachment and pragmatism. The surgeon’s hair is thinning at the temples, and their face is lined with decades of worry and stress. Their attire is plain and practical, though still of superior quality, and they bear few accoutrements save for a golden pocket watch, which they meticulously check. They sign to a passing assistant, who nods and quickly leaves on an unvoiced errand.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Prison Transport Ship: Laundry.name:
囚犯运输船：洗衣间
Prison Transport Ship: Laundry

Text.text:
亮橙色连身工作服在几台巨大的洗衣机前堆成一座座散发恶臭的衣山，机筒里早已塞满待洗的衣物。令人作呕的体味与积水的土腥气交织在一起，酿成一股家务荒废的污浊瘴气，刺鼻得叫人作呕。
Bright orange jumpsuits form stinking piles before enormous washing machines already packed with clothes. The repugnant stench of body odor mixes with the earthen tang of standing water, creating a truly unpleasant miasma of domestic neglect.

God Of Righteousness.name:
正义之神
God Of Righteousness

Text.text: 他赤裸的右手握着一柄灿然生辉的长剑，由同样卓绝的铁匠铸成，出自一个超越时代的时代。他左手戴着一只钢铁臂铠，内衬的红色天鹅绒只从边缘微微探出。他端坐在一条巨龙的背上——那是他所任命的诸多审判者之一——胯下的鞍具工艺恢宏，堪称史诗。他的面容冷峻而郑重；当他举起臂铠以示警告时，那张脸无声地抛出一个问题：你的诉求正当吗？ 长剑与巨龙静候回应。 His bare right hand holds a brilliant longsword forged by equally brilliant smiths from a time out of time. His left hand wears a steel gauntlet, its lining of red velvet just peeking out. He sits on the back of a dragon, one of his many appointed judges, in a saddle of epic workmanship. His face is stern, serious, and when he raises his gauntlet in warning, his countenance asks the silent question: Is your cause just? Sword and dragon await the reply.

这间东倒西歪的棚屋佝偻在山坡上，像一头巨大的枯骨野兽蜷缩着，想躲开风的撕扯。杂乱的木梁、覆着苔的茅草、粗糙的圆木与枝条拙劣地编进墙里，昭示着随着时代推移，人们在原本的结构上不断加建，硬生生添出一片如兽穴般的迷乱扩展。几根插进地里的木棍牵起一条绳子，勉强充作围栏；绳上垂挂着约莫上百具老鼠尸体，腐败程度各不相同，每一只都被一根穿过绳索的荆刺钉穿悬起。
The rambling shack slouches against the hillside, like the body of a great boney beast trying to take shelter from the wind. Various timbers, mossy thatch, rough logs, and sticks badly woven into walls suggest that over time a warren has been added on to the original structure. A rope strung from sticks jabbed in the ground serves as a fence, and from it dangle perhaps a hundred mouse corpses in varying states of decay, each impaled upon a thorn run through the cord.

Notorious Space Pirate.name:
臭名昭著的空间海盗
Notorious Space Pirate

Text.text:
海盗一瘸一拐地走着，整个人重重倚在一根量身定制的手杖上——杖头是一只风格化的海妖。膝盖以下，他们的左腿与一条异域义肢融为一体，义肢上覆着令人目眩的各色晶石；他们的大衣在身后夸张地翻涌摆荡，宛如太阳的波浪。尽管这场劫掠发生在星界，这名声名狼藉的亡命之徒仍带着所有航海同类的标记——额前还端端正正扣着一顶三角帽。
The pirate walks with a limp, leaning heavily on a bespoke cane crowned by a stylized kraken. Their left leg merges into an exotic prosthetic—covered in a dazzling variety of crystals—below the knee, and their greatcoat sways dramatically in their wake like a solar wave. Despite the astral nature of their piracy the notorious outlaw bears all the hallmarks of their sea-faring brethren—including a tricorn atop their brow.

Gala: Unplanned Excitement.name:
盛会：计划外的刺激
Gala: Unplanned Excitement

Text.text:
有什么东西炸开了，人们纷纷抱头俯身、四散扑逃，彼此撞作一团，掀翻桌子，杯盘碗盏砸落满地，连带着把人撞得东倒西歪。碎裂声与喊叫声交织其间，你听见愤怒的咆哮，也听见真正恐惧的尖叫。有人正在死去。鲜血在地面上铺成一层滑腻的薄膜。你意识到这一点的同时，周围的人也意识到了——而就在那一刻，恐慌才真正攫住了人群。
Something explodes and people duck and dive in different directions, slamming into one another, knocking tables and their contents to the floor, and sending one another sprawling. Amid the shattering and the shouts, you hear roars of anger and screams of true terror. Lives are being lost. Blood slicks the floor. As you realize this, so do others around you, and that’s when panic truly grips the crowd.

Smug Corporate Hacker.name:
自鸣得意的企业黑客
Smug Corporate Hacker

Text.text:
这位公司狗身上的每一件道具都代表着最尖端的水准——而他们最爱拿出来炫耀。那股无可救药的优越感像劣质古龙水般笼罩着黑客，被他们雕琢般的五官上那道永恒的冷笑愈发衬得刺眼。彻头彻尾的出卖者。
Every piece of gear the corpo has is state of the art—and they love to show it off. An irredeemable sense of superiority clouds the hacker like bad cologne, accentuated further by the permanent sneer painted across their sculpted features. The very definition of a sell-out.

Component Casting Of Awaken.name:
【唤醒】的成分施法
Component Casting Of Awaken

Text.text:
你将那枚珍贵的玛瑙伸在臂长之外，口中默诵神圣的音节，另一只手掠过宝石上方，直到它开始发光——不是奥术附魔那种刺目的冷亮，而是一种温暖的光，忽明忽暗地跳动，宛如心搏。随着最后一道命令落下，你转向灌木，将手猛地插入泥土，把玛瑙安放在它根团的正中央。霎时间，灌木的枝条仿佛自有意志般舒展延伸，向着太阳探去，姿态竟与类人生物醒来时伸展筋骨一模一样。

~ 由 bloodhadson 在 Envisioned 构想

Holding the precious agate at arm’s length, you mouth the sacred syllables and pass your other hand over the gem until it begins to glow—not a harsh glow like that of arcane enchantments, but a warm glow that pulses, not unlike a heartbeat. With a final command, you turn toward the shrub and plunge your hand into the earth, placing the agate in the center of its root ball. Immediately, the shrub’s branches extend under their own power, reaching toward the sun in exactly the same manner as a humanoid stretches upon waking.

~ Envisioned by bloodhadson

身姿灵动得不可思议，那道身影在拥挤的酒馆里穿梭如织，众人的目光不由自主被她超凡的自信与魅力牵引。短短的黑发勾勒出一张银质面具，面具以渡鸦为形精雕细琢，与她披肩的羽饰斗篷相映成辉；而一柄精致的长柄刀挂在背后的肩带上，刃身铭刻着corvidaen的潦草符文。那古怪的面具后，锐利而聪慧的眼睛静静窥视——一只如星光点缀的夜空，另一只则金灿得像初升的太阳。

~ 由一位HeroPlayed

Moving with incredible grace, the figure weaves through the crowded tavern, all eyes drawn to her supernatural confidence and charm. Short black hair frames a silver mask wrought in the likeness of a raven, complementing her feathered mantle and the exquisite glaive inscribed with corvidaen scrawl hanging from a sling at her back. Sharp, intelligent eyes peer out from the strange mask, one akin to a starlit night, the other as golden as the rising sun.

~ Played by a Hero

Belfry Full Of Bats.name:
蝙蝠塞满的钟楼
Belfry Full Of Bats

Text.text:
当你的头顶刚钻出梯子尽头的活板门，一阵刺耳的尖啸便如乱潮般扑面而来。蝙蝠——整整一群——把这座老钟楼当成了巢穴。带着薄膜的翅膀化作一团黑云，噼啪抽打着你的脸颊与脖颈，直到这些生物终于反应过来，纷纷振翼冲向外头的空旷夜风。你被撞得踉跄、被抓得生疼——四周尽是粪泥的汪洋，将你团团围住。
As your head breeches the trapdoor at the top of the ladder, a cacophony of screeches assaults you. Bats, an entire colony, have taken up residence in this old bell tower. A cloud of webbed wings slaps against your face and neck until the creatures gain enough sense to fly out into the open air. You are left buffeted and scratched—surrounded by a sea of guano.

你的命令在奥秘的回响中震荡，空气随之颤动，靠近你的人影周遭泛起涟漪般的扭曲与模糊。现实的织理被强行拧转，将他们拖入一片由空间裂口拼接而成的破碎拼布——他们的去处，尽在你一念之间。
Your command echoes with arcane feedback, causing the air to ripple and blur around the individuals near you. The fabric of reality twists, pulling those individuals into a patchwork of rents in space—their destinations entirely yours to direct.

她几乎悄无声息地、满怀笃定地穿行在浓密的林间。一名身形修长的年轻女子忽然停下，摘下那顶轻巧的冠冕——其上生着两支木质鹿角——抖散了她微卷的棕发。紧跟在她脚边的一只棕熊幼崽，在她骤然止步时一头撞上靴跟，引得德鲁伊低低一笑。小熊抬头嗅了嗅她，她便倏地在一截倒木上坐下，解下腰间的弯刀，将长杖靠在一旁。她从腰包里摸出一物，低声呢喃了几句，随即把一颗红莓丢入口中，又将另一颗轻放在林地的落叶间，留给小熊。

~ Played by Cowboy Wade

Walking almost silently and with complete confidence through the thick forest, a rangy young woman pauses to remove a light crown featuring two wooden antlers and shake out her wavy brown hair. Following close at her heels, a brown bear cub bumps into the heel of her boot at her sudden stop, eliciting a soft chuckle from the druid. The bear cub looks up and snuffles at her, and she abruptly sits atop a fallen log, removing her belted scimitar and leaning her quarterstaff next to it. She withdraws something from a belt pouch, murmurs a few words, and pops a red berry in her mouth, then lays one on the forest floor for the bear.

~ Played by Cowboy Wade

Medicinal Flower Guarded By Giant.name:
由巨人守护的药用花
Medicinal Flower Guarded By Giant

Text.text:
随着林木渐稀，你很快踏入一片宁静的林间空地，阳光穿叶成斑。鸟鸣在空中飘荡，带着夏日气息的凉风拂过，沙沙摇动枝叶。你目光一凝，只见一朵白花自一丘葱郁苔藓上悄然探出。可这林间的安宁骤然碎裂——一头庞大生物踏出雷霆般的脚步，从近旁一簇树丛中轰然冲出。芬芳的花香被刺鼻的体臭浊雾所取代；在你面前，一个披着污秽泥腻兽皮的巨影巍然耸立——一名山丘巨人横在你与那朵花之间。

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

As the trees become thinner, you soon find yourself in a tranquil, sun-dappled clearing. Birdsong drifts through the air and the scent of summer is upon the cool breeze that rustles the leaves. Your eyes alight upon a single white flower sprouting on a mound of verdant moss. The peace in the glade is shattered abruptly by the thunderous steps of an enormous creature as it explodes out of a copse of trees nearby. The delicate scent of blossoming flowers is replaced by a pungent miasma of body odor, and before you—wrapped in soiled, grimy hide—a towering hill giant stands between you and the flower.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Tsunami Escaped.name:
海啸中死里逃生
Tsunami Escaped

Text.text:
为触及更高处，你们一路狼狈奔逃，终于还是赶到了。几分钟前的地震掀翻了你们沿途经过的许多建筑。站在这里，你望见原本遥远的海岸线吞没沙滩，继续向内陆推进。无情的潮汐裹挟着残骸一路拖行：泥土、植被，以及那座海滨小镇的残存遗迹。
It was a miserable run to reach higher ground, but you finally made it. The earthquake from minutes before toppled many of the structures you passed on your way. From here, you watch as the once distant shoreline overtakes the beach and pushes further into land. Debris is dragged along with the unyielding tide: dirt, plants, and the remains of the seaside town.

亚麻色的发丝在无形的微风里轻轻漂荡，法师凝神聚力，猩红长袍的袍摆随之微颤，仿佛力量正于其中翻涌。他面容仍显年轻，却带着献身此道数百年的深邃智慧，那份积淀尽显于他的强大。伸出的手掌微微搏动，一声清越的铃音穿透空气——刺破浓稠的魔力噪响——而在他的掌心，一只眼睛缓缓睁开。
Flaxen hair drifts in an unseen breeze as the mage focuses his power, the hem of his crimson robes trembling as it builds. His face is youthful, yet he carries the wisdom of one who has devoted centuries to his craft, which is reflected in his prowess. His outstretched hand pulses as a chime rings through the air—piercing the heady atmosphere of magical static—and an eye opens in his palm.

一层闪烁的薄雾环绕着战士半透明的身形。它忽明忽暗，仿佛隔着一场梦才得以窥见。骑士神色冷峻、决意如铁，抽出一柄幽灵般的长刃，摆出战斗架势，随时准备在瞬息间出手。它以贵族特有的简短而正式的口吻，要求你说明来意。
A shimmering haze surrounds the warrior’s translucent form. It drifts in and out of focus as if glimpsed through a dream. With grim resolve, the knight draws a spectral blade and assumes a fighting stance, ready to act at a moment’s notice. It demands to know your intent in the clipped and formal tone one would expect of nobility.

这名半身人脸上的不对称笑容自然而然，仿佛天生就该如此。只见他轻轻一甩头，将一绺乱蓬蓬的栗褐色头发从湿苔般颜色的眼前扫开。他身披磨旧的皮质护甲，深色斗篷斜搭在一侧肩头；而那双灵巧的手，总是不离他那份令人叹服的武器家当：一柄细剑、几把匕首，甚至还有一把弩。他迈步带着自信的摇晃与张扬，表面的逞勇却掩不住他能在转瞬之间弹身而起、投入行动的迅捷。

~ Played by Tosari

A lopsided grin is clearly at home on this halfling’s face. With a flick of his head, he sweeps tousled chestnut-brown hair from eyes the hue of wet moss. He wears well-worn leather armor and a dark cloak swept over one shoulder, and dextrous fingers are never far from the halfling’s impressive repertoire of weaponry: a rapier, daggers, and even a crossbow. He walks with a confident swagger, the bravado belying the quickness with which he can spring into action.

~ Played by Tosari

这些器具以黄铜或钟铜精心锤制，再以自最早文明沿用至今的温和酸液加以处理；它们是行军军乐队的标点，是交响乐团里骤然迸出的呼喊。它们在阳光下闪耀，也能划破黑夜。
Hammered carefully from brass or bell bronze and treated with mild acids used since the earliest civilizations, these instruments are the punctuation of a marching army band, the sudden shout of an orchestra. They flash in the sunshine and cut through the night.

铁匠手法娴熟，动作迅捷，将坩埚中的熔融白银倾泻而出，注入模具，灌成箭镞、矛尖与匕首。那些阴狠的器具在你眼前逐一成形，在炉火摇曳的光里闪着冷亮。武器中有力量在低鸣，隐约却不容错认。“这些够用了，”铁匠说道。“嗯，这些可真是再合适不过。”
The smith works expertly, quickly, pouring molten silver from the crucible to fill molds for arrowheads, spearheads, and daggers. The wicked implements manifest before you, shining in the flickering light of the forge. Power thrums from the weapons, subtle but unmistakable. “These will do,” the smith says. “Aye, these will do nicely.”

I Swear An Oath With My Oathbow.name:
我以誓弓立下誓言
I Swear An Oath With My Oathbow

Text.text:
如今，我的宿敌就在那儿——至少接下来一周，或至少此刻。  
我搭上箭矢，听见箭身里涌出精灵语低语般的铿锵乐声：“愿我的敌人迅速败北。”  
我举弓，对着我的目标低声道：“愿你——这伤我之人——迅速败北。”  
半打黎明来结束这一切，半打落日作见证，除非我的目标的太阳先一步沉落。  
我发誓。
There now is my sworn enemy, my nemesis for the next week—or for now. I nock the arrow and hear the strong music of Elvish whisper from it, “Swift defeat to my enemies.” I raise the bow and whisper at my target, “Swift defeat to you who has wronged me.” Half a dozen dawns to finish this, half a dozen setting suns, unless my target’s sun sets first. I swear it.

Zombie Outbreak At A Research Outpost.name:
研究前哨站的丧尸（特征）爆发
Zombie Outbreak At A Research Outpost

Text.text:
即便有野外实验室，这座设施也无疑像一处前哨——加固的高塔、插满尖刺的路障——却不见巡逻队。没有鸟鸣。来访者研究的巨型恐龙，与其说是威胁，不如说那些微生物才致命。公司的人连同岛上的动物群，都被某种疾病击倒。随后，他们全都再次站了起来。

~ 由 Redsmoke 所构想

Even with its field laboratory the compound certainly looks like an outpost—buttressed tower, spiked barricades—but there are no patrols. No bird calls. The gargantuan dinosaurs the visitors studied proved to be less a threat than the microbes. The company, along with the island’s fauna, were felled by some sickness. Then they all rose again.

~ Envisioned by Redsmoke

一簇簇健康的绿叶沿着翻整过的田垄均匀分布。这里种下了相当可观的一片：结实的莴苣菜球、胡萝卜富有弹性的嫩叶尖，还有南瓜宽大的叶片，都清晰可辨。一个年轻的厨房帮工，脸颊红得像熟透的番茄，正用近乎失控的急促语气对园丁说着什么——似乎是主厨对上一茬收成质量的评价。老园丁嘴里叼着一根长草叶，双手叉腰，带着冷硬的责备目光打量着那年轻人。
Tufts of healthy green leaves are spaced evenly along rows of tilled soil. A substantial array has been planted here: heads of lettuce, the springy tops of carrots, and the wide leaves of squash are all identifiable. A young member of the kitchen staff, cheeks as red as ripe tomato, speaks to the groundskeeper in a frantic tone—something about the head cook’s opinion on the quality of the last yield. The old keeper, chewing on a long blade of grass and with hands on his hips, eyes the youngster with steely reproach.

Rune Smith’s Cabin.name:
符文铁匠的小屋
Rune Smith’s Cabin

Text.text:
你踏入这间狭小无窗的舱室，目光立刻被角落桌上铺开的发光羊皮纸吸引——每一张都描绘着怪异而棱角分明的符号，仿佛与船身各处镌刻的印记如出一辙。靠墙的床铺凌乱未理——像是匆忙间被丢下——床头的箱子盖子微微翘开。门旁的架子在几本巨大的皮装厚册重压下吱呀作响，每一本都带着被反复翻阅、过度使用的痕迹。
As you enter the small, windowless cabin your gaze is drawn to the glowing sheets of parchment spread across the desk in the corner, each depicting strange, angular symbols like those etched all over the ship. The bed set along the wall is unmade—as if left in a hurry—and the lid of the chest at its head stands slightly open. Beside the door, a shelf creaks beneath the weight of several huge, leather-bound tomes, each one bearing signs of excessive use.

Speech About A Good Life.name:
关于美好生活的演讲
Speech About A Good Life

Text.text:
“这一切结束之后，你想象过自己会成为什么样吗？我能想象一种好日子——至少，构成好日子的那些部分——可随后我又意识到，其中有一部分是我自己，而那就让这一切看起来根本不可能。”
“What do you picture for yourself after all this? I can imagine a good life—all the parts of one, anyway—but then I realize that one of those parts is me and it just doesn’t feel possible.”

Crew Member From Outlaw Ship.name:
亡命船上的船员
Crew Member From Outlaw Ship

Text.text:
那男人举止沉稳如钢，与你对视时目光锐利到毫不退让。一把硕大的手枪挂在他腰间磨损的枪套里——你怀疑他非常清楚该怎么用。廉价须后水的气味在他身边徘徊，如一缕若有若无的浊雾，黏在他那件旧风衣的布料上。
The man carries himself with nerves of steel, meeting your gaze with unflinching intensity. A large sidearm hangs in a battered holster on his belt—and you suspect he knows how to use it. The smell of cheap aftershave lingers around him, a subtle miasma clinging to the fabric of his worn duster coat.

Ancient Copper Dragon.name:
远古铜龙
Ancient Copper Dragon

Text.text:
修长的脖颈与更为修长的尾巴，如蛇般在它那轻灵的猫科身躯两端蜿蜒摆动。铜色鳞片构成护甲，有的细小如钱币，有的则大如圆盾。巨大的蝠翼紧贴着身体，它用力嗅闻空气，喷吐出一阵阵浓重的气息。
The long neck and even longer tail weave in a serpentine way at each end of its lithe feline body. Coppery scales provide armor, some as small as coins and others as big as bucklers. Tremendous batlike wings hug close to its body as it sniffs the air in great puffs.

Civilian Space Station: Roomy Control Ce.name:
民用空间站：宽敞的控制中心
Civilian Space Station: Roomy Control Center

Text.text:
盆栽植物摆满了这间宽敞房间的各个角落——在这样的船上堪称稀有度。控制中心的人员透过办公室的全景舷窗，得以饱览一片棱彩般的星云奇观，室内空气清爽宜人。每位操作员面前的巨幅监视器上，市民们照常忙碌于日常生活；空间站上一切看起来都安然无恙。
Potted plants fill the corners of the large room—a rarity aboard such a vessel. The staff in the control center are treated to a spectacular view of a prismatic nebula by the panoramic windows of the office, and the air inside is light and pleasant. Vast monitors before each operator show citizens going about their day, and all seems well aboard the station.

I Use My Rod Of Security To Transport To.name:
我举起【安稳之杖】，启动其力量，将众人从现实中抽离，转瞬传送到一座阳光炽烈、海风咸润的热带岛屿上。
I Use My Rod Of Security To Transport To A Tropical Island

Text.text:
我激活权杖时，空气里立刻灌满海洋咸涩的腥香，就在我们每个人瞬间自视野中闪灭之前。再睁眼，我们已站在温暖的金色细沙上，浪花轻柔地拍吻着这片恬静的海岸。远处海鸟呱鸣回荡，枝头压满斑斓果实的树木在我们头顶舒展摇曳，迎着惬意的午后微风。
The salty tang of the ocean fills the air when I activate the Rod, just before each of us blink out of existence. We find ourselves on warm golden sand as waves gently lap the idyllic shore. Sea birds caw distantly, and trees heaving with colorful fruits stretch above us, swaying in the pleasant afternoon breeze.

巨大的复眼宛如一对血色双月，高悬在这奇异生物狭长面孔上一条细长、肉质的口器之上。两根覆着羽绒的触角自额前傲然挺立，纤细的羽状绒枝轻轻颤动，随着生物审视着周遭环境。它的身形隐约呈类人轮廓，却如蛾般披覆着柔软的棉絮绒毛；一条灵活可卷的长尾划出优雅弧线。当它以令人不安的哺乳动物般后肢撑起身躯，探舌般去品尝空气的味道。
Huge compound eyes like twin blood moons sit atop a long, fleshy proboscis on the strange creature’s narrow face. Two feathered antennae rise proudly from its brow, their delicate fronds twitching as the creature observes its environment. Its body is vaguely humanoid in shape, yet it is covered in soft, cottony fuzz like a moth, and a long prehensile tail flicks in graceful arcs as it raises itself up on unsettlingly mammalian legs to taste the air.

一阵骨头的哗啦声攫住路人的目光，引人望向昏暗的街角：一名身影蜷伏在那里，披着破烂且恶臭的长袍。兜帽压得极低，遮住了面容——只露出一只布满血丝的眼睛，阴森森地斜睨着，眨也不眨。先知以不容置疑的腔调开口，嗓音沙哑，夹着痰音；而他那瘦骨嶙峋的手指，像潜伏蜘蛛的突节长足般诡异，捞起一把指骨，准备再一次将它们掷出。
A clatter of bones draws the eye of passerby to a shadowed street corner, where a figure hunches in tattered, foul-smelling robes. A cowl pulled low obscures their features—save a single, bloodshot eye leering, unblinking. The seer speaks with an implacable lilt, their voice throaty and phlegm-laced, as—with skeletal fingers that evoke the knobby legs of a lurking spider—they scoop up a fistful of knucklebones and prepare to cast them once more.

Demon Forms From Shadows.name:
恶魔自阴影中现形
Demon Forms From Shadows

Text.text:
令人窒息的阴影化作骇人的形态，恶魔自其中浮现，周身淌落漆黑如墨的黏稠细流，仿佛从焦油中诞生。旋涡般的黑暗里先裂开一张嘴——宽得过分——随后是一对妖异而聪慧的眼睛，深渊般的瞳孔自中央竖直劈开。低沉而阴森的笑声震得空气嗡鸣，待这魔物完全成形，便迫不及待要将它那难以揣测的阴谋诡计施加于世间。

~ Envisioned by Ameria on Discord

Choking shadow takes on horrifying form as the demon emerges, dripping with dark, inky rivulets as if it were birthed from tar. A mouth—far too wide—appears in the swirling darkness, followed by lurid, intelligent eyes split vertically by abyssal pupils. A deep, menacing laugh rattles the air as the fiend fully materializes, eager to enact its inscrutable machinations upon the world.

~ Envisioned by Ameria on Discord

The Opus Annabella.name:
《安娜贝拉大作》
The Opus Annabella

Text.text:
这并非一部以硬纸板与皮革装订的鸿篇巨著，而是一本小小的帆布日记，看上去脆弱、易燃、稍有不慎便会毁坏。薄如葱皮的纸页——一年三百六十五天，一天一页——轻得仿佛连笔尖的刮擦都承受不起。使用者翻到当天的那一页，写下一个问题。答案便会自行浮现：以纤细的字迹与插画蔓延至全部365页，铺陈这答案的来龙去脉，直至当下日期。读完这部作品的最后一页后，书册会以魔法重置，回到当天的那一页。
Rather than a great tome bound in board and leather, this is a small canvas journal that seems fragile, flammable, easily ruined. The onion-skin pages, one for every day of the year, feel too delicate to withstand the scratch of a pen. One finds the page for the current day and writes a question. The answer writes itself over all 365 pages in fine script and illustrations, covering the history of the answer up to the current date. After the opus’s last page is read, the book magically resets to the current day’s page.

那人形生物敦实臃肿，身高十英尺，肩背同样宽阔，迈着缓慢的步伐，像是一股未经驯服的蛮力在勉强运转。他们似乎还不习惯重力，被自身力量的重量拖拽着踉跄前行。腰带上挂着一整排令人咋舌的工具，每一件都刻着手工凿出的新月形缺口。
The humanoid—stocky, sedentary, ten feet tall and broad to match—moves with the slow gait of unpracticed power. They seem unused to the gravity, stumbling under the weight of their strength. An impressive array of tools hangs from their belt, each marked with a handmade notch in the shape of a crescent moon.

衣着考究的女地主坐在一张光滑如镜的乌木大桌后，那桌子宽敞得足以轻松容纳四五个人。她在这片领地里向各处佃户收取租金，过得极其安逸。多数时候，把佃户赶走比听他们抱怨、处理他们的诉求要便宜得多——贿赂和打手，本就是为此而生。
Sitting behind a smooth ebony desk that could easily accommodate four or five individuals, the well-dressed landowner makes a very comfortable living collecting rent from her tenants throughout the territory. Often it is much cheaper to evict a tenant than to address their complaints and concerns—that is what bribes and henchmen are for.

Alleana Of The Black Rose House.name:
黑蔷薇之屋的阿莱娜
Alleana Of The Black Rose House

Text.text:
她的性相令人一眼难忘：发光的灰色面庞，双耳穿着多处耳饰；一头凌乱的高马尾白发里，掺着淡蓝色的冷光。她既不完全是卓尔，也不算苍白的精灵——她的眼睛既非红宝石般猩红，也非黄水晶般金澄。她身披金色板甲，那是圣武士的护甲；胯下骑着一头黑色沼泽跃兽。可即便握着战锤与盾牌，她也不像彻头彻尾的圣武士——她的笑里有种术士般的妖异，有种邪气与睿智交织的锋芒。

~ Played by Captain Phule with

She has an unmistakable aspect: a luminous gray face and multiple piercings in her ears, under a messy high ponytail of white hair highlighted in pale blue. Neither fully drow nor pale elf, she has eyes neither ruby nor citrine. Her golden plate is the armor of a paladin, and she rides a black moorbounder. Despite her hammer and shield, she does not seem entirely a paladin—there is something sorcerous in her smile, something wicked and wise.

~ Played by Captain Phule with

Tournament Celebrating A Royal Birthday.name:
庆贺王室诞辰的比武大会
Tournament Celebrating A Royal Birthday

Text.text:
皇太子起身，脸庞被蛋糕上簇拥成列的蜡烛映得熠熠生辉。看台如雷般欢呼，他一口气吹灭烛火，随即举起那只戴满戒指的手。号角般清亮的喇叭声骤然响彻，一队队骑士列队从王家看台前行进而过，逐一躬身致礼；每人都从笑容灿烂的皇室手中领到一份小小的赋礼。
The crown prince rises, face aglow from the legion of candles adorning his cake. The stands thunder with cheers as he blows them out then raises his beringed hand. Clarion trumpets blare, and lines of knights file past the royal stand, bowing as each receives a small gift from the beaming royal.

Twisted Forest Floor.name:
扭曲的森林地表
Twisted Forest Floor

Text.text:
这里的一切都带着微妙的错位感，像是只偏了那么一线。叶片逆着风扭曲翻卷，盘结的枝条饥渴地向过路的旅人伸探，只要有人胆敢踏入它们的树冠之下。土壤呈暗沉的壤质深红，森地腐屑间，白骨以令人心惊的频率突兀地刺出。

~ 由 David 在 Discord 上 构想

Everything is slightly wrong here, just a touch off-kilter. The leaves twist and turn against the wind, and twisting branches reach hungrily for passing travelers that dare to tread beneath their boughs. The soil is a dark, loamy crimson, and bones protrude from the detritus of the forest floor with alarming regularity.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Harvey Public School.name:
哈维公立学校
Harvey Public School

Text.text: 这栋高耸的建筑正对着吟游诗人石广场，也正对着喷泉旁热闹的街市摊棚。它是一所合并学校，招收小学与中学阶段的学生。一层设有行政办公室与小学教室；二层则是图书馆与中学课程教室。正门上方有一块打磨得锃亮的小牌匾，上面写着：昔日为博学律政贵族会馆。 This tall building directly faces Bardstone Plaza, and the jubilance of the fountain’s bodega market. It is a combination school for students at primary and secondary levels. The first floor holds administrative offices and elementary classrooms. The second, the library and secondary level classes. A small polished placard above the front entrance reads: Formerly the Noble Lodge of Learned Barristers.

Heavy Combat Helicopter.name:
重型武装直升机
Heavy Combat Helicopter

Text.text:
直升机的机身由一连串相互咬合的金属板构成，厚重的护甲将整个机身严丝合缝地包覆起来。就连顶部旋转的桨叶也不是轻薄叶片，而是一块块坚固的金属板。它没有任何窗户，取而代之的是机内的数字成像系统，以换取更高的防护。火箭发射器与大口径武器的阵列嵌在机体骨架四周，弹药上膛，蓄势待发。
The body of the helicopter is a series of interlocking metal plates, covering the entire fuselage in thick armor. Even the spinning blades on top are slabs of sturdy metal. There are no windows, instead the vehicle opting for digital imaging inside for better protection. An array of rocket launchers and high-caliber weapons sit nested around the helicopter's frame, loaded and primed.

Outpost Along A Desert Crossing.name:
沙漠渡口前哨站
Outpost Along A Desert Crossing

Text.text:
作为两条商路交汇处的永久前哨而建，这片营地的核心是一顶巨大的指挥帐篷：粗壮木梁嵌入浇筑的地基，以金属桩深深钉进布满碎石的地表牢牢固定。帐篷周围散落着数顶较小的帐篷，还有一座马厩，为驮兽遮风避雨。前哨两端各立着一座可容两人值守的瞭望塔，塔上装有镜面，固定在原始却结实的旋转支架上，能将灯笼的反光聚焦投向黑暗深处。营地外围则以齐胸高的围栏环绕——打结的鸡网与风干木桩交织成一道屏障，用以阻挡夜行掠食者。
Built as a permanent outpost at the crossroads of two trade routes, the centerpiece of this compound is an enormous command tent, braced by timbers embedded in a cemented foundation, held with metal pegs driven deep into the stony surface. It is surrounded by various smaller tents as well as a stable to shelter beasts from the elements. A two-man watchtower is situated at each end of the outpost, each with mirrors on primitive but sturdy swivels for focusing reflected lantern light into the darkness. A chest-high fence of knotted chicken wire and dried wooden posts surrounds the compound to keep out nocturnal predators.

木料寻常，做工朴素却颇见功夫。皮革握把上方烙着一道匠人印记，便是这张弓唯一的装饰。筋弦绷得极紧，这张弓拉力比外表更为强劲，放弦时还会嗡然作响。
The wood is common, the workmanship plain but skillful. A maker’s mark, burned just above the leather grip, is the bow’s only decoration. Bent tight by a sinew string, the bow pulls stronger than it looks, and hums when it releases.

Corporate Smart Drug, Cereprax: Ingested.name:
企业级智能药物“脑睿派（Cereprax）”：口服
Corporate Smart Drug, Cereprax: Ingested

Text.text:
药片在你舌下数秒间便融化殆尽，留下一层粉笔般的干涩触感与苦味回荡其后。一阵刺痒的感觉从一侧太阳穴一路跳踏到另一侧，紧接着，你的视野里闪过细小如枝的锡灰色电光。你的心神在涌入的感官洪流中踉跄筛滤，思绪——与念头在时间的台风里凝结成形。你从潜意识的厚毯之下掘出被埋藏的细节，将此前游离无系、甚至从未得见的线头一一牵连成网。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

The tablet melts under your tongue in seconds, leaving a chalky texture and bitter taste in its wake. A tingling sensation tap-dances across your brow from temple to temple, then your vision flashes with tiny branches of pewter lightning. Your mind reels as it filters through sensory input, your thoughts—and ideas form in the temporal typhoon. You mine for details buried under the blanket of your subconscious, connect threads before now untethered, or entirely unseen.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

从浪涛中现身的那头泰坦般生物，正是人们对大洋墨黑深渊中潜伏之物的恐惧化身。四片覆鳞的鳍端生着锯齿般的尖刺，拖拽着这头生物的负载在水中疾驰，速度快到任何船只都无从逃脱；而它那如山峦般、布满尖棘的甲壳破浪前行，硬生生劈开层层波涛。自那甲壳前方悄然探出的，是两条蜿蜒的长颈；每条长颈尽头都顶着一颗蛇形头颅，以冰冷的蛇眸巡猎。它们在令人战栗的默契中齐齐张口，喷吐出双重海啸般的水柱，化作毁灭性的暴雨喷射而出。
The titanic creature that emerges from the waves embodies the fear of what lies deep in the ocean's inky depths. Four scaled fins tipped with serrated spines heave the creature's bulk through the water at a speed no vessel could escape, with a mountainous spiked shell cutting through the waves. Slinking from the front of that shell are two sinuous necks, each bearing a serpentine head that hunts with cold, ophidian eyes. In horrifying tandem, their jaws open to release twin tsunamis in jets of devastating spray.

如神祇般，游戏主持者的身影巍然压顶——一位晦奥的说书人，驾驭着秘传的想象力。披着自得的凌驾之姿，他们的目光怀抱无数界域的秘密。手执一支神秘羽笔，他们编织世界、拨弄命运，引领探险者穿行于其残酷造物的迷宫之中。
Godlike, the gamemaster looms large—an abstruse storyteller, a wielder of esoteric imagination. Clad in smug preeminence, their eyes cradle the secrets of countless realms. With a mystical quill, they craft worlds and manipulate fate, guiding explorers through the maze of their cruel invention.

Subterranean City Square.name:
地下城广场
Subterranean City Square

Text.text:
城市里的一切行动最终都会汇入这片道路交汇处——一座在大多数大城市都能见到的城市广场，但有一个根本不同之处：在这片回声无尽的所在，告示牌取代了街角的报信人和叫卖的推销汉。小吃摊与各色商贩沿着广场边缘密密排开；尽管这些货品在你这双久居地表的眼里怪异非常，他们喋喋不休的叫卖腔调却熟悉得令人发笑。
All of the activity of the city eventually flows to this confluence of roads, a city square like those to be found in most large cities, but with one principal difference: in this place of endless echoes, signs take the place of town criers and pitchmen on street corners. Food stalls and other vendors litter the circumference of the square, and while the goods are unusual to your surface-living eyes, the tone of their palaver is all too familiar.

Storm Breaks Over Tournament.name:
风暴倾覆斗技大会
Storm Breaks Over Tournament

Text.text:
看台上的观众齐声大笑：混战中一记钉头锤砸落的瞬间，恰好与天际滚来的惊雷一拍即合。青蓝色的云团迅速聚拢，沉沉压暗。细雨先是轻轻落下。几名商贩从摊位后探出头来，抬眼望天，随即把帆布一把拽下，收拢封摊。贵族们在混战一结束便立刻离场，赶回城堡寻求庇护；而场地与看台上的大多数人却被骤然开阔的天幕与斜斜泼下的雨幕兜头罩住，第一分钟内便被浇得透湿。
The spectators in the stands laugh as one when a mace strike in the melee falls at the same time as a clap of thunder from the sky. Blue clouds gather and darken. Light rain falls. Some of the merchants poke their heads from their stalls and look up at the sky, then pull their canvases down and close. The nobles leave immediately after the melee for the safety of the castle, but most of the field and stands are caught under the opening sky and the angled sheets of rain that drench them within the first minute.

那只修长的黑色盒子看上去毫不起眼，直到边框里弹出一根短天线。按下几枚按钮，内部的机械嗡鸣着苏醒。区域内所有电子设备立刻争相鸣叫示警——其中几台甚至直接报出，它们与各自服务器和已连接设备的链接已被切断。
The long black box looks innocuous enough, until a short antenna pops from the frame. With the press of a few buttons, the mechanics hum to life. All the electronics in the area start beeping for attention—a few even call out that their connection has been lost to their respective servers and connected devices.

矮人朝掌心啐了一口唾沫，随即闷哼一声，攥紧巨斧的斧柄，斧刃狠狠咬进高耸橡树的树干。他一斧接一斧地劈下去，随时调整角度，时而退后几步衡量成果。活计既沉稳又耗人，砍了十分钟后，矮人抹去额头的汗，连退几大步，扬声喊道：“倒树！”仿佛应声而动，树身啪地一响，先向一侧倾斜，又向另一侧摇摆，最终轰然倒下，撞出雷霆般的巨响。
The dwarf spits into the palm of their hand, then, with a grunt, grips the haft of the massive axe and bites the head into the trunk of the towering oak. They chop again and again, adjusting their angle as needed, standing back to gauge their efforts. The work is as deliberate as it is tiring, and after ten minutes of chopping, the dwarf mops sweat from their brow, takes a couple of long strides backward, and calls out “Timber!” As if on cue, with a snap, the tree leans one way, then the other, and finally topples with a thunderous crash.

Globe Of Invulnerability.name:
无敌法球
Globe Of Invulnerability

Text.text:
你将一颗水晶珠托在掌心，稳稳护在手中；一团微光自珠中鼓胀而出，化作一枚摇曳的光球。光芒在距你十英尺处倏然止步，斑斓闪烁的光点彼此交叠，如霜白指尖缠绕着玻璃般铺展。待其成形，那光球随即消隐无踪，但你知道，其中强大的防护魔法仍然留存。
You palm a crystal bead, keeping it safe in your hand as a shimmering sphere of light balloons out from it. The the light stops ten feet from you, scintillating in spots that overlap like fingers of frost entwining across glass. Once complete the globe vanishes, but you know its powerful abjuring magic remains.

曾经，人们一点点凿去这块巨岩的岩面，雕出一个壁龛，以及其中那尊立像。那时——新凿出的纹理还带着锋利——披袍的身躯会从周围岩石中明亮地突显出来，并且多年如一，甚至持续数十年。它当年无疑还有头颅，也有双臂。但如今，袍褶间覆着地衣，苔藓从它穿着凉鞋的脚趾间悄然滋长。
Once, people chipped away at the face of this boulder, carving out a niche and the standing figure within. Then—fresh cut—the robed body would have stood out brilliant from the surrounding rock, and it would have been so for many years, decades even. It no doubt had a head then, and both arms. But now the folds of its robes bear lichen, and moss grows in at the toes of its sandaled feet.

Medallion Of Thoughts.name:
思想徽章
Medallion Of Thoughts

Text.text:
这枚青铜徽章看起来并不值钱，但有人显然花了些心思：在其表面雕出了一对逼真得令人心惊的眼睛，而在它们上方，还以一枚澄澈的半宝石嵌出第三只眼。你在掌心里将它翻转过来时，一阵若有若无的刺麻感掠过头皮。
This bronze medallion does not appear to be of any great value, though some care has clearly been taken to shape two shockingly realistic eyes into its surface, above which a third eye has also been picked out with a clear semiprecious jewel. A faint tingling sensation plays over your scalp as you turn it over in your palm.

Clean Tavern Cups.name:
擦净酒馆杯子
Clean Tavern Cups

Text.text:
吧台尽头摆着三只饮具，个个一尘不染，整洁得像一队刚换上新军装的士兵。一只小巧的木杯、一只沉甸甸的金属啤酒杯，还有一只纤长的玻璃香槟杯——它们各具形制、各有所长，正如来往这家酒馆的冒险者队伍一样多样而专门。
Three drinking vessels stand at the end of the bar, each spotless, as spick-and-span as a group of soldiers in new uniforms. A small wooden cup, a hefty metal tankard, and a glass flute—vessels as diverse and specialized as the groups of adventurers that come by this tavern.

Temple To A God Of Art.name:
艺术之神的神殿
Temple To A God Of Art

Text.text:
这座神殿看起来更像画廊或博物馆，而非礼拜之所。侍奉的侍僧们身披长而朴素的袍子，上面溅满颜料与墨迹。有的充当向导，沿途解说各处展陈；有的则与来访的信众一同坐在展品之间，静静沉浸在四周的美感里。艺术品在风格与媒材上差异极大：有雕塑、绘画、织锦挂毯、彩绘玻璃。时不时地，受了启发的侍僧或信众会走近某件展品，添上一笔——或取走一部分。这个选择会被周围观众注视着，迎来困惑或赞许的低语——但无人会去推翻这项决定。主展区既是内殿圣所：一间独立的房室，垂着深蓝天鹅绒帷幕，金线绣纹在其上隐隐流光。门槛处排着一列表情各异的面具：宁静的面容、癫狂的咧笑、阴沉的怒容，甚至还有痛苦扭曲的脸孔。
The temple seems more a gallery or museum instead of a place of worship. The attending acolytes wear long, plain robes splattered with paint and ink. Some serve as guides explaining the various exhibits throughout while others sit among visiting worshippers to take in the beauty all around them. The various pieces of art differ greatly in style and in medium. There are sculptures, paintings, woven tapestries, and stained glass. Every so often, inspired, an acolyte or worshipper approaches an exhibit and adds something—or takes something away. The choice is observed by the surrounding audience and met with murmurs of confusion or appreciation—but no one reverses the decision. The main exhibit serves as the inner sanctum, a separate room curtained with dark blue velvet embroidered with golden thread. Masks of different expressions line the threshold: serene countenances, hysterical grins, grim scowls, and even visages twisted in agony.

Copper Dragon Wyrmling.name:
铜龙雏龙
Copper Dragon Wyrmling

Text.text:
褶边与犄角点缀着这只龙裔生物的蜥蜴般面孔，鳐鱼似的翼膜沿着它的身体一路伸展。它约莫一只大型犬的体型，用沉静而好奇的眼睛守夜般注视着你，嘴角微微扭起，像是在笑。它的铜色鳞片在阳光下闪耀，光泽内敛却依旧动人。它以一种诡异而迷人的优雅移动，始终保持距离，却又不放过对你的打量。
Frills and horns adorn the reptilian face of this draconic creature, and manta-like wings extend the length of its body. Roughly the size of a large dog, the creature watches you with eyes calm and curious, something akin to a smile twisting its mouth. Its copper scales shine, subdued but beautiful, in the sunlight. It moves with a strange and alluring grace, keeping its distance even as it studies you.

Blighted Forest Ambushes Travelers.name:
枯疫森林伏击旅人
Blighted Forest Ambushes Travelers

Text.text:
令人作呕的恶臭污染着森林里潮湿的空气，泥泞的地面如利爪般死死扯住你的靴子。四周树木低语哀鸣，仿佛在剧痛中扭动，阴影斑驳的树洞里亮起一双双绿眼，冷冷注视着你的一举一动。你踏入中央空地时，森林腐化的源头终于显露——这绝非自然病害。一个女性身影从一棵巨大、泣泪般滴落树汁的橡树里猛然挣脱出来，发出女妖般的尖啸。你周围的地面轰然炸开，勒喉般的藤蔓疯狂窜起，整片森林苏醒，只剩一个目的：杀戮。

~ Envisioned by MatthewMcHale on Discord

A sickening odor pollutes the humid air of the forest as the muddy ground claws at your boots. All around you, trees whisper and moan as if writhing in agony, and green eyes appear in shadowed hollows to watch your every move. As you enter the central clearing, the source of the forest's corruption becomes apparent—this is no natural malady. A feminine form wrenches itself free of a grand, weeping oak and shrieks like a banshee. The ground around you explodes with strangling vines as the forest comes alive with one purpose: to kill.

~ Envisioned by MatthewMcHale on Discord

Field Trip To Athens.name:
雅典实地考察
Field Trip To Athens

Text.text:
五年级的班级骑着扫帚编队飞行，跟随一位教授一路奔向地中海。隐形之中，他们降落在一处嶙峋的岩坡上，脚边是断裂的基座，旁侧则是柱廊残存的废墟。  

“菲迪亚斯就在这里雕刻了《雅典娜·普罗马科斯》。”教授一边说，一边凭空召出那尊雕像的影像。“三十英尺高，以黄金与象牙制成。”  

她手持长矛，目光越过海面。  

“她并非希腊人以为的女神。不。”教授的声音压低了些，“她是一位战斗法师。”
The fifth-year class flies their brooms in formation, following a professor to the Mediterranean. Invisible, they land on a rocky hillside, at the foot of a broken pedestal near a colonnaded ruin. “This is where Phidias sculpted Athena Promachos. Thirty feet tall, in gold and ivory,” the professor says as he conjures an image of the statue. It holds a spear and gazes out to sea. “She was not a goddess, as the Greeks thought. No. She was a battle mage.”

I Cast Animate Dead On A Skeleton As A W.name:
我以法师之姿，对一具骷髅（特征）施放了【死者复苏】。
I Cast Animate Dead On A Skeleton As A Wizard

Text.text:
我吟诵唤死之咒，用匕首割破手指，从伤口处剥下一片皮肉，将血与碎肉裹上骨粉揉成一团。我把这团东西抹在头骨上，随后绕着那堆骨骸缓步行走，低声咒诵。骨头彼此牵连、缝合，逐渐咔哒作响地拼接成形；最终，骷髅（特征）挺身而立，眼窝里幽光森然。
Chanting the call to the dead, I cut my finger with my dagger, peel skin from the wound, and roll the blood and flesh in bone dust. I smear the ball on the skull, then incant as I walk around the pile. The bones knit together, and finally, the skeleton stands, a sinister glow in its eye sockets.

一位自平民中长大的守护者，玛拉基最初在步兵队伍里起步，随后立下虔诚誓言。他以正直的仪态与一往无前的自信步步攀升，登上军旅生涯的巅峰。你能看得出来——从他斑白相间的头发与精心修整的胡须，到他那身华美的护甲与武备，无不昭示着这一切。他披挂由魔法石铸成的全身板甲，手持长剑与盾牌，盾上烙印着太阳神的徽记；一只由黄金与珠宝构成的活化臂铠点缀在他的右手，而他的左臂则是精金打造。再加上他那对辉煌的羽翼，为这一切画上冠冕。站在他身旁的，是狮鹫“正义”——他的坐骑，也是高贵的同伴。

~ Played by ImprisonedAgain

A Protector raised as a commoner, Malachi began in the infantry before taking the Devotion Oath. He ascended in righteous bearing and headstrong confidence to the height of soldiery. You can see it, from his salt and pepper hair and well-tended beard to the magnificence of his armor and arms. He wears full plate of magic stone and carries a longsword and shield emblazoned with the Sun God; an animated gauntlet of gold and jewels bedecks his right hand, his left arm is adamantine. All is topped by his glorious wings! Beside him stands the griffon, Justice, his steed and noble companion.

~ Played by ImprisonedAgain

Demonic Message Written On Flesh.name:
写在血肉上的恶魔讯息
Demonic Message Written On Flesh

Text.text: 皮肤上随机鼓起一道道风团，先是胀成猩红的泡，又像一只苍白青蛙的喉囊般瘪下去。这样由某种无形之力催生的伤痕浮现了片刻后，那起泡的血肉终于拼出一个词：我的。 Welts swell up from the skin in random pattern, ballooning red and then wilting like a pale frog’s throat. After a few moments of these wounds appearing by some invisible force, the bubbled flesh finally forms a word: MINE.

尽管这只是相对简单的一点魔法，你召唤出的那股无形之力却能充当你的随从，的确让生活轻松不少。危险与冒险在前方召唤，谁还有时代去叠衣服？
Though a relatively simple bit of magic, the unseen force you have conjured to act as your valet does make your life easier. Who has time to fold laundry while danger and adventure beckon?

甜腻的香皂与草药气息牵引着你，几乎是鼻尖先一步穿过门槛。屋内，身着宽松棉袍的客人慵懒地斜倚在绒软的椅子里，放松身心，等着被细致伺候。一名半精灵侍者重新点燃一碗新鲜的薰衣草熏香，随即递上一只托盘，盛着葡萄与清水。越过等候区域，你看见一个健谈的侏儒正把莹亮的红色漆油涂在一位年迈矮人的指甲上；一名瘦削的男子为俯卧低吟的半兽人揉按肩背；还有一个半身人踮在脚凳上，替一位贵妇修剪发梢。最深处，你注意到木门门框间正渗出缕缕蒸汽。
The sweet smell of scented soaps and herbs pulls you nose-first through the door. Inside, patrons in loose cotton robes recline in plush chairs, relaxing while they wait to be doted on. A half-elf attendant reignites a fresh bowl of lavender incense before offering a tray of grapes and water. Beyond the waiting area, you see a chatty gnome applying a lustrous red lacquer to the nails of an elderly dwarf; a slender man massaging a prone, murmuring half-orc; and, teetering on a foot stool, a halfling trimming the hair of a noblewoman. At the back, you notice steam seeping through the frame of a wooden door.

种子在暖阳中飘摇，一阵清凉微风轻抚稀干的稀树草原。高草起伏成浪，如同金色海洋，天地的和鸣交织在午后空气里。粗糙的褐色皮毛覆在强健的肌肉上，近处一片阴影笼罩的高地上，狮人族的族群伸展着身躯、慵懒倚卧，作为这片领地的主宰。

~ 构想 by mortojo

Seeds drift in the warm sun as a cool breeze caresses the dry grasslands of the savannah. The tall grass ripples in waves like a golden ocean, as the harmonious symphony of nature weaves through the afternoon air. Coarse brown fur stretches over powerful muscles as the pride of lionfolk stretch and recline on a shaded plateau nearby, rulers of their domain.

~ Envisioned by mortojo

坚韧原木制成的长柄通向一枚钢制枪头，起初宽如你的手掌，继而逐渐收束成一记精心磨出的锐利尖端。这把武器外形纤薄、流线无瑕——无论突刺还是投掷，都能以毁灭性的速度与精准贯穿目标。
The long shaft of robust wood leads to a steel head that begins as wide as your hand before it tapers to a meticulously sharpened point. The weapon is thin in profile and perfectly aerodynamic—ready to be thrust or thrown with devastating speed and accuracy.

Skeleton In Desert.name:
沙漠中的骷髅（特征）
Skeleton In Desert

Text.text:
在这片荒凉的废土上，一具骷髅（特征）半埋在流动的沙海之中。无休止的狂风将骨骼漂洗得惨白，仿佛被磨成了幽魂般的白色。空洞的眼眶直勾勾地望着一只被遗弃的水壶，里面的水早已被贪婪的沙漠夺走殆尽。
Here in this desolate wasteland, a skeleton lies half-buried in the shifting sands. Incessant winds have bleached the bones, scrubbing them a ghostly white. Empty eye sockets stare at a discarded water flask, its contents long since stolen by the greedy desert.

Persnickety Shopper Paws Through Produce.name:
挑剔的顾客在果蔬堆里翻翻拣拣
Persnickety Shopper Paws Through Produce

Text.text:
那女人鼻梁上架着一副细框眼镜，在成堆的农产品间挤来挤去，凑得近得骇人地嗅闻。她嫌恶地皱起眉头，用沉甸甸的爪子拨弄着堆起的瓜果蔬菜，怎么也挑不出一件能符合她苛刻标准的。
Thin glasses perch upon the nose of the woman as she shoves among the produce, taking a disturbingly close sniff. Her brow wrinkles in disgust as she flicks through the gathered fruits and vegetables with weighty paws, unable to find any to suit her exacting standards.

Cleric Casting Toll The Dead.name:
牧师施放「死亡丧钟」
Cleric Casting Toll The Dead

Text.text:
低沉而洪亮的挽歌充塞空气，牧师吟诵法术的词句——每一个音节都沉甸甸地压着死亡的重量。一口幽灵般的丧钟在他的目标上方凝结成形，每一次震耳欲聋的钟鸣都激荡出一圈圈脉动的坏死能量波纹。

~ 由一位英雄构想

A sonorous dirge fills the air as the cleric chants the spell’s words—each laden with the weight of mortality. A spectral bell forms above his target, and each thunderous chime sends out waves of pulsing necrotic energy.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Sundries From A Pursuant Minion Cleanser.name:
来自穷追不舍的仆从净除剂的杂项
Sundries From A Pursuant Minion Cleanser

Text.text:
搜遍男人的大衣与衣物口袋，也只翻出几张纸钱，半烧成灰，几乎看不出原样。
Searching the man's overcoat and clothes yields only a few slips of paper money, half-burned to oblivion.

Quip About Choosing A Party Leader.name:
关于挑选队长的俏皮话
Quip About Choosing A Party Leader

Text.text:
“虽然我也很享受我们努力达成共识的过程，但我想现在是时候选出一位领袖了。而既然是我最先攻、也最有自信把这个主意提出来，那我认为应该由我来担任。”
“While I’ve enjoyed our attempts at consensus, I think it is time we choose a leader. And seeing as I’m the one with the initiative and confidence to propose the idea, I think it should be me.”

Speech By A Vampire About People’s Purpo.name:
吸血鬼关于人类使命的演说
Speech By A Vampire About People’s Purpose

Text.text:
“我耗费了无尽岁月试图理解凡人。他们像火花般迸入夜色，嘶嘶作响，燃着残忍、爱与沉思，旋即又一次消散无踪。但到头来，他们不过是食物，而这些复杂不过是肉上的佐料。”
“I have spent eons trying to understand mortals. They burst like sparks into the night, sizzling with cruelty, love, and contemplation before vanishing once more. But in the end, they are simply food, and all these complexities seasoning on the meat.”

I Am Struck By A Bludgeon.name:
我被钝器击中
I Am Struck By A Bludgeon

Text.text:
我以为敌人都在我面前，可闷棍却从背后砸来——秘密在我脑海里化作刺耳的噪歌。钝响的震颤沿着骨头传开，随之翻涌的疼痛让我几乎难以移动，更难以集中精神。可我依然看见对手们模糊的脸庞——他们正因这场卑劣的暗算而得意微笑，稳稳占了上风。
I think my foes are before me, but the bludgeon arrives from behind, a secret becoming a dissonant song in my head. It sends a dull vibration through my bones, then the swell of pain makes it difficult to move or focus. I do see the blurry faces of my opponents, though, smiling at the skullduggery that has given them the upper hand.

Hidden Entrance In Spaceport.name:
太空港中的隐秘入口
Hidden Entrance In Spaceport

Text.text:
一股无菌的再循环空气微风掠过狭窄的房间，通风口低沉的嗡鸣为黑暗注入了令人不安的生机。昏暗中有什么攫住了你的目光：墙面出现了细微的起伏，仿佛布料在鼓荡。

~ 出自 PaizoConOnline 2029

A sterile breeze of recycled air drifts through the cramped room, the droning hum of the air vents adding an unsettling life to the darkness. Something catches your eye in the gloom: a subtle shift in the walls, like billowing fabric.

~ from PaizoConOnline 2029

在那些不谙奥术之道的人眼里，你似乎只是在白费口舌；但你心中暗自冷笑，因为你清楚自己已召出一道无形之壁，足以阻挡几乎任何攻击、闯入，或法术。
Though it may appear to those unschooled in the arcane arts that you are simply wasting your breath, you smirk inwardly in the knowledge that you have conjured forth an invisible wall capable of stopping virtually any attack, trespass, or spell.

Cautious Captain In A Tense Situation.name:
紧张局势下的谨慎队长
Cautious Captain In A Tense Situation

Text.text:
她端坐警觉，仿生、与舰船奴役相连的双眼死死锁定那艘刚跃入扫描射程的飞行器。她手稳如铁，在控制面板上输入代码，向船员下达指令；可一滴汗珠仍沿着她剃光的头皮滑落，她舔了舔纹身覆盖的嘴唇。每一秒流逝，舰桥上的紧绷都更深一分——她屏息等待着那艘外星飞船先出招。
She sits alert, her bionic ship-slaved eyes fixed on the craft that has just jumped into scanner range. With a steady hand she enters code into a control panel, issuing orders to the crew, but a bead of sweat trickles down her shaved head and she licks her tattooed lips. With each passing moment the tension on the bridge grows, as she waits for the alien ship to make a move.

噪声骇人至极，食人魔部落的咆哮撼动大地。在一座摇摇欲坠的栅栏营地内，营盘如同拼凑而成的混乱之毯铺展开来：肮脏的帐篷喷吐出披着碎片甲的住民，涌入泥泞的街道。魁梧的野蛮人操练、交合、斗殴、进食，对任何可能的攻击都嗤之以鼻。

~ 由 Juxtapozbliss 构想

The noise is horrific, the roars of the ogre horde shaking the very ground. Within a ramshackle stockade, the camp sprawls in a patchwork of chaos: filthy tents spewing scrap-armored inhabitants into muddy streets. Bulky savages drill, rut, fight, and eat, contemptuous of any potential attack.

~ Envisioned by Juxtapozbliss

I Endure Bludgeoning Damage.name:
我承受钝击伤害
I Endure Bludgeoning Damage

Text.text:
碾压般的剧痛如涟漪般扩散成冲击波——在它的震源处，我的软组织刺痒发麻，骨头嗡嗡震颤。呼吸在喉间猛地一滞，但我以意志逼迫自己站稳不倒。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The crushing pain is a rippling shockwave—at its epicenter, my soft tissues tingle and my bones vibrate. Breath catches in my throat, but I will myself to stand strong.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Teeming Life In The Swamps Of The Dark F.name:
黑暗妖精位面的沼泽中，生命汹涌滋生
Teeming Life In The Swamps Of The Dark Faerie Plane

Text.text:
苍白的树干从沼泽里拔起，乌黑如墨的叶片遮住了大半片天穹。树冠的裂隙间漏下星海——比你来此之前记忆中见过的任何一夜都要繁密。虫鸣嗡嗡充塞四周，没完没了，你感觉细小的足与翼掠过皮肤，痒意如潮。沼面一道道扭动的涟漪暗示着鱼、鳗，或水蛭的存在——那层绿浊之下究竟潜着什么，谁也说不准。忽然，一片水域咕嘟咕嘟冒起气泡，一颗粗砺的鳄首与脊背破水而出，覆着紫罗兰色的鳞片。它长长吐息，震动沿着淤泥扩散开去，惊散了翡翠色的蜻蜓与其他虫群，纷纷冲入闷热的空气中。
Pale trees rise up from the swamp, their jet-black leaves blocking out most of the sky. Cracks in the canopy show a sea of stars—more stars than you ever remember seeing before coming to this place. The hum of insects pervades, incessant, and you feel the tickle of tiny legs and wings brushing against your skin. Wriggles along the surface of the swamp suggest the presence of fish, eels, or leeches—it's unclear exactly what lurks beneath the green murk. A section of the water suddenly bubbles and the rugged head and back of an alligator with violet scales rises up. It exhales, sending vibrations out along the muck, scattering jade dragonflies and other bugs into the humid air.

山丘高高隆起，几乎像要吞没远处的群山。它的坡面绵长而舒展，铺出缓缓上升的弧度，勾勒出分明的圆锥轮廓。灌木与杂植紧贴山脚，沿着坡势向上蔓延；而山顶却尽是嶙峋岩石，冠端隐约可见覆雪。
The hill rises high, almost threatening to overtake the distant mountains. Its slopes are long and sweeping, creating a gradual ascent and forming a distinct conical shape. Shrubs and other plants hug the base of the hill and creep up its sides, but the top is rocky, snow visible at its crown.

Githyankis In Castle Dungeon.name:
城堡地牢中的吉斯洋基人
Githyankis In Castle Dungeon

Text.text:
这座漂浮在星界之海的城堡，拥有超越时代与空间的重力；可即便如此，它仍有一座地牢，沉重、潮湿、令人窒息。囚室里，星界苦行者无聊地等待着，比平日更显消瘦。他们的看守——星界战士——警觉得近乎冷酷，时刻监视，几乎不眨眼。看起来像是怪物在看守怪物，因为囚犯投来的目光疯狂而恶毒。

~ 由 Mori 构想

This castle in the astral sea possesses gravity out of time and space, but it nonetheless has a dungeon heavy, dank, and depressing. In the cells, astral ascetics wait, bored, even thinner than usual. Their guards, astral warriors, are vigilant, surveilling constantly and almost without blinking. Monsters guarding monsters, it seems, given the crazed and malevolent looks thrown at them by the prisoners.

~ Envisioned by Mori

Large Commoner's Feast.name:
盛大的平民盛宴
Large Commoner's Feast

Text.text:
庆典正酣。第二头猪正在火上炙烤，第一头早已被切上盘子、填进肚子，喜气洋洋的人们在广场上坐着、站着、跳着、笑着。风笛手吹奏的曲子你并不熟悉。这支歌似乎没有歌词，但狂欢者们显然都懂得配套的舞步。
The celebration is in full swing. A second pig roasts over a fire, the first already on the plates and in the bellies of the happy folk sitting, standing, and dancing around the square. You don’t know the music played by the pipers. The song doesn’t seem to have words, but the revelers appear to know the accompanying dance.

恶心的嗡鸣充塞空气，恶魔拍动闪烁的昆虫般翅翼俯冲而下；一阵令人作呕的倦怠攫住你，仿佛力量正从身体里被一点点抽走，昏沉几乎要将你吞没。那生物宛如被诅咒的半人马，双臂四足——落地时却迅捷翻转，倒挂在天花板上。它以复眼那冰冷的黑色球体凝视着你。
A sickening drone fills the air as the demon descends on flickering insectoid wings, and you feel strength leach from your body as a nauseating lethargy threatens to overcome you. Resembling a cursed centaur, the creature has two arms, and four legs—which move quickly as it lands upside down on the ceiling. It regards you with cold black orbs of compound eyes.

Quierk The Arcane Archer.name:
奎尔克：秘法弓手
Quierk The Arcane Archer

Text.text:
这名鸟人族的羽色带着猛禽般的棕与黑，渐渐褪成青铜与白；浅色主要铺在他的颈侧，以及那对宽阔而强健的翅膀上。与之相反，他的喙起初苍淡，越向前越沉，直到收束成黑色的钩尖。他身着猎人的装束——干净、上过油的深色皮甲，配有同色臂甲，护住前臂，免得他手中那张优雅长弓的弓弦失手时抽伤。可他的鳞皮利爪之足却毫无遮护。他仿佛随时都能动作或腾挪，锐利的褐色眼睛不断扫视四周。

~ Played by Vmaster1995 with

Raptorlike hues of brown and black fade to bronze and white on this birdfolk’s feathers, the lighter colors on his neck and broad, powerful wings. His beak, in contrast, starts pale and darkens to black as it tapers to its hooked point. He sports the garb of a hunter—clean, oiled dark leathers with matching bracers, which protect his forearms from any string mishap with the elegant longbow he carries. No such protection adorns his scaled, clawed feet. He seems always ready to act or move, his sharp brown eyes constantly searching the surroundings.

~ Played by Vmaster1995 with

Call Lightning Hitting Player.name:
闪电召来击中玩家
Call Lightning Hitting Player

Text.text:
空气嗡鸣震颤，一道纯粹能量的长枪自上方贯下，狠狠击中你。你的思绪猛然翻搅，耳膜爆裂般鼓胀，那骤然席卷而来的轰鸣早已超出听觉的痛楚——它像磨盘般碾压，把你的骨头都磨得咯咯作响。灼热的剧痛被强行泵入每一条血管，狂乱的折磨撕扯过每一根神经。刺鼻的焦灼气味——焦化的空气与血肉——灌满你的鼻腔；你在近乎兽性的惊骇中意识到：那是你的血肉。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

The air thrums as a lance of pure energy strikes you from above. Your mind bucks, your ears pop, and the sudden overwhelming rumble goes beyond mere auditory pain. It grinds your very bones together. Searing anguish is pumped through every vein as riotous torture rips through every nerve. The acrid stench of scorched air and flesh—your flesh, you realize in animal horror—fills your nostrils.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Tent City Under Bridge.name:
桥下帐篷城
Tent City Under Bridge

Text.text:
桥下广袤的空地被一簇簇光亮点亮，头顶车流轰鸣掠过，光影随之摇曳闪烁。各色各样、形状尺寸不一的帐篷在这片荒瘠之地上铺展开来，掩蔽着遍地垃圾与废弃物。这里如同上方城市的悲惨倒影，栖身其间的，尽是被它抛弃的人。
Pockets of light illuminate the vast expanse beneath the bridge, flickering as traffic thunders across overhead. Tents of all colors, shapes, and sizes cover the refuse-strewn tract of barren land here. It is a tragic mirror of the city above, populated by those it has discarded.

Sundries From A Griffon Nest.name:
狮鹫巢穴的杂物
Sundries From A Griffon Nest

Text.text:
鱼、禽与大型猎物的骨骸堆成一座小山，排列得近乎艺术品般讲究。巢穴外缘尘土泥地上遍布利爪划痕，其间散落着毫无价值的首饰与破损的营地道具。巢内还衬着一圈圈绳索，夹杂着几片破碎的衣物。
The bones of fish, fowl, and big game make a heap almost artistic in the arrangement. Worthless jewelry and broken camp gear lie among talon scratches in the dust and dirt around the outside of the nest. Coils of rope line the nest, along with scraps of clothing.

I Recognize The Signs Of A Dragon's Lair.name:
我认得出巨龙巢穴的征兆
I Recognize The Signs Of A Dragon's Lair

Text.text:
我对自己的发现毫不怀疑：这条痕迹始于一处降落点，地面仿佛被一对巨型扫帚扫过般干净，中央还留着两道巨大的弧形爪印。接着我注意到岩壁上被龙息灼过的变色斑痕，以及被折断、撕裂的树木——一条宽阔的破坏带一路清空，直到巢穴入口那堆昭然若揭的白骨。
I have no doubt about my discovery: the trail starts with a landing place and earth swept as if by a pair of giant brooms, with two massive arcs of claw prints in the center. Then I note the discolorations on rock faces hit by dragon breath and trees snapped and frayed—the wide swath cleared to the tell-tale bone pile at the entrance to the lair.

彼此相对的两个 F 形音孔，将曼陀林的身形与它的近亲鲁特琴区分开来；它更为娇贵，也通常用拨片而非手指来弹奏。眼前这把以枫木制成，染上层层不同的暖色调，黑色镶边勾勒轮廓；黑色琴颈上嵌着品丝，八根琴弦在其上绷紧如线。它是为世间的客厅与公共起居室而生的乐器。
The two F-shaped holes facing one another distinguish the body of the mandolin from its cousin, the lute, and it is more fragile and usually played with a pick rather than the fingers. This one is made of maple stained in different warm colors, with black trim and frets along a black neck under eight strings. It is an instrument made for the parlors and common rooms of the world.

Dwarf Forge Cleric.name:
矮人锻炉牧师
Dwarf Forge Cleric

Text.text:
锁子甲柔和而带金属质感的沙沙声宣告着这名祭司的每一次移动；他为战斗披挂上阵，每一枚细小的金属环扣都由他亲手以娴熟技艺锻造而成。他的头顶光秃，唯有两道浓密粗黑的眉毛；一条巨龙以大胆的黑色墨迹盘绕在他宽阔的头骨上。装饰性的圆环穿刺着他的下唇，承托着一束仪式用的锁子甲胡须——他每开口说话，那细密的链环便轻轻叮当作响。
The soft, metallic rustle of chain mail announces the priest’s every movement as he arms himself for battle, each tiny metal link forged by his own expert hand. His head is bald save for two thick, bushy eyebrows, and a dragon encircles his broad skull in bold, black ink. Decorative rings pierce his lower lip, playing host to a ceremonial beard of chain mail that jingles softly whenever he speaks.

Crystal Ball Of True Seeing.name:
洞见真视水晶球
Crystal Ball Of True Seeing

Text.text:
那枚晶莹的宝珠安放在一只朴素的黄铜支架上。水晶内部蜿蜒着奇异而闪烁的矿脉，在光线下微微流彩，折射出诱人的影像，仿佛就在球体深处游移。你凝视得越久，那些影子便越发清晰，逐渐凝聚成鲜明的画面。
The crystalline orb sits perched atop a simple stand of brass. The crystal is veined with strange glimmering minerals that seem to sparkle under the light, refracting and creating alluring silhouettes within the sphere itself. The longer you look, the stronger the images become, coalescing to create vivid scenes.

Itmi Vruh.name:
伊特米·弗鲁赫
Itmi Vruh

Text.text:
工装裤上别着一枚褪色的姓名牌。破旧的靴子。几绺瘦长的黑发黏在渐灰的头骨上。那双眼睛浑浊黯淡，失了焦点。很难分辨这具类人生物是否还活着。那张脸后藏着一股智性，却仿佛不习惯这副躯壳……就像它披着的这层皮是新的。令人不寒而栗，却又令人心酸。它低头看着掌心里那件陌生的科技造物，神情里满是惘然与眷恋。
A faded name tag on the overalls. Battered boots. Patches of lank black hair stuck to a graying skull. The eyes are glassy and faded, unfocused. It is hard to tell if this humanoid is alive. There’s an intelligence behind the face, but it looks unused to this body… as though the skin it wears is new. Unnerving, and yet sad. It looks down at the unfamiliar tech in its palm, a wistful expression on its face.

新生儿乍看之下或许与人类无异，唯独皮肤泛着血红的色泽，细软绒发的头顶拱出一对微小、山羊般的角。狡黠的笑意牵动着他们的唇角，你瞥见一对细如针尖的门牙已从牙龈间探出。
The newborn might appear at first to be human, save for the blood-red tinge of their skin and the tiny, goatlike horns cresting their head of downy-soft hair. A mischievous grin tugs at the corners of their lips, and you spy a pair of miniscule incisors already protruding from the gums.

护甲的铿锵作响，刀刃在鞘中的哐啷震颤，裸露钢铁的一闪寒光——战斗已然终结。那名人类战士轻轻一抖刀身，甩落血珠，踏在胜利之上俯视对手；对方的武器甚至只抽出到一半，仍卡在鞘口。战士仅以几不可见的一点头向倒下的敌手致意，随即跨过其身，将他们丢在尘土里。
The clatter of armor, the rattle of a blade in its scabbard, the flash of naked steel, and the fight is over. The human warrior flicks their blade to rid it of blood and stands victorious over their opponent, whose own weapon was only halfway free of its sheath. They acknowledge their fallen foe with the barest of nods before stepping over them and leaving them in the dirt.

I Activate My Ioun Stone Of Mastery.name:
我激活了我的精通艾欧石
I Activate My Ioun Stone Of Mastery

Text.text:
艾欧恩自那枚淡绿灵石旋舞的轨迹间向我低语，劝诫并指引我走向更好的自己。在我最为擅长之处，艾欧恩更让我凝神专注、心意相合、技艺愈发精湛。
Ioun whispers to me from the whirling flight of the pale green stone, advising and directing me toward betterment. Where I am most adept, Ioun makes me that much more focused, in tune, and skillful.

Druidic Menagerie.name:
德鲁伊的奇兽苑
Druidic Menagerie

Text.text:
穿过这座野生动物园的主路，更像一条深入荒野的步道。两侧巨树与嶙峋巨石隔断视线，仿佛一扇扇施了魔法的窗，将洁净而辽阔的栖息地呈现在眼前。阳光斑驳的草甸里，一只熊般的生物却长着猫头鹰的头颅，正打着盹；她的两只幼崽追逐着蝴蝶嬉闹。湖畔的沙滩上，一条鳞片泛着紫罗兰光泽的小龙与一位猩红色的伙伴翻腾嬉戏，彼此轮番俯冲入水。晶莹的地面铺设让人得以俯瞰地下世界：遍布生物荧光的菌类——以及一条巨大的绿虫，黑眼幽深，巨口周围环绕着触手。身着皮甲的看护者为访客指引方向，也照料这些野兽。

~ 一位英雄 构想

The main path through the wildlife park seems more like a trail through wilderness. On each side, massive trees and stones separate views, like magical windows, into pristine, expansive habitats. In a sun-dappled meadow, a bearlike creature with the head of an owl dozes as her two cubs chase butterflies. On a lakeside strand, a tiny, violet-scaled dragon frolics with a scarlet partner, each diving through the water. Crystalline flooring provides a view into a subterranean world full of bioluminescent fungi—and a great green worm with black eyes and a maw surrounded by tentacles. Leather-clad caretakers offer guidance to visitors and care for the beasts.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

地狱般的酷热已持续多日。微风拂过，却像残忍巨龙嘲弄般的吐息迎面拍来；井水渐涸，就连阴影里也闷得人喘不过气。长翼的食腐者飞上无云的天空——那是无情烈日的王座——盘旋搜寻着任何一个被节节攀升的高温击倒的倒霉鬼。
The hellish swelter has lasted for days. Breezes hit you like the mocking breath of a cruel dragon, wells are running dry, and even the shade is stifling. Winged scavengers take to the cloudless sky, the throne for the unrelenting sun, and circle in search for any who have succumbed to the rising temperature.

那位半精灵主妇般的妇人穿梭于厨房之间，举手投足都带着女王巡视疆域般的威仪；即便围裙上溅满油渍与酱汁，也只能稍稍削去她的端庄气势。数名次席厨师在各自的工位上埋头忙碌，跑堂与洗碗工来来往往、穿梭不停；要让一道道菜肴不失分毫地准时送到饥肠辘辘的食客面前，唯有冷静的头脑、精炼的味觉，以及能压住全场的号令之声。
The matronly half-elf moves throughout her kitchen with the lordly affect of a queen surveying her realm, her regal demeanor muted only little by her food-spattered smock. With several lesser cooks working diligently at their stations and many busboys and dishwashers moving hither and yon, it takes a cool head, refined palate, and commanding voice to keep food moving out to hungry patrons without delay.

Horas Redelav.name:
霍拉斯·雷德拉夫
Horas Redelav

Text.text:
几乎难以察觉地隐在阴影里，那名身形修长、灰肤的精灵沉默等待，以猎人的耐心注视着他的猎物。他褪色的紫眼被黑色飞翼状眼线衬得愈发锐利，白发在夜色凉风中微微竖起。一枚雕工精美的坠饰贴在他外衣内衬的软皮之上，随着他从暗处迈出、尾随标记而微微摇曳，在惨淡月光下泛着幽光。吊坠上装点着一只乌鸦的头颅——喙间紧紧衔着一颗钻石——而金属上更以大师级技能刻着一道纤细得几乎难以察觉的符号。他跟随那道标记一阵，才挑准完美时机，以迷人而张扬的风采亮出身形。

~ Played by a Hero with

Barely perceptible in the shadows, the slender, gray-skinned elf waits silently, watching his quarry with a hunter’s patience. His faded purple eyes are accentuated by the winged black eyeliner surrounding them, and his white hair bristles in the cool night breeze. A beautifully crafted pendant rests against the padded leather of his tunic, shimmering in the pallid moonlight as he emerges from the shadows to follow his mark. The head of a raven—a diamond held fast in its beak—adorns the swaying amulet, and a delicate, almost imperceptible symbol has been etched with masterful skill into the metal. He follows the mark for a time before choosing the perfect moment to reveal himself with a charismatic and flamboyant flourish.

~ Played by a Hero with

Intimidation Line About A Violent Life.name:
关于血腥人生的恐吓台词
Intimidation Line About A Violent Life

Text.text:
“你的人生一定充斥着血腥暴力——但我敢保证，我能拿出的折磨之法，连你都会大吃一惊。”
“You’ve led a very violent life, I’m sure, but I guarantee there are torments I can muster that will surprise even you.”

你的皮肤一阵刺痛，仿佛感应到逼近的威胁，直觉与肌肉记忆被瞬间点燃，催促你行动。它们让你在意识还来不及插手之前就猛然跃开危险。你的反应动作（）快如闪电。
Your skin tingles as you feel an incoming threat, kicking your instincts and muscle memory into action. They cause you to leap away from the danger before your conscious mind has time to get in the way. Your reaction seems lightning fast.

I Wild Shape Into A Deinonychus.name:
我野性变身为一只恐爪龙
I Wild Shape Into A Deinonychus

Text.text:
粗粝的喀喀啁鸣自我喉间挤出，魔法在我体内盘旋穿梭。我看着自己的鼻梁向前拉长成吻部，鼻孔被压扁成两道细窄如蛇的气孔。下颌扩张，弯曲的利齿刺破牙龈顶出。我弓身蹲伏，双腿涌起新生的肌肉，脊柱随着一连串噼啪声拉伸，塑出一条甩动的长尾。羽毛覆上全身，贴伏成一层流线的羽衣，黑、褐、白与灰杂糅交错。我用最粗壮的爪趾轻叩地面，趾甲如两柄竖起的象牙镰刀。

~ Envisioned by ProjectReap

The rasping chitter begins in my throat as magic winds through me. I watch my nose elongate to a snout, my nostrils flattening into thin serpentine vents. My jaw widens, curved teeth piercing through gums. I bend into a crouch as my legs burgeon with new muscle and as my spine stretches with a series of pops to create a swinging tail. Feathers cover my body in a sleek coat, a motley of black, brown, white, and gray. I tap at the ground with the largest of my taloned toes, the nails a pair of perked ivory sickles.

~ Envisioned by ProjectReap

牙齿在蓬乱纠结的胡须间死死咬合。眼睛像余烬般发亮，瞳孔彻底放大。那魁梧的战士野兽般低吼一声，随即隐入黑暗。他曾经所在之处，只剩两点猩红悬在阴影里，低语在空气中穿梭——起初是呜咽与细小的痛哭，诉说着疼痛与失去……旋即绽成破碎而嘶哑的狂怒尖叫。先是一声噗哧与短促惨呼，紧接着血雾猛然喷洒。又一次，刀刃剖开血肉的切割声响起，另一道血泉将空气染红。那些血滴、血线与血团仿佛被困在时间里，悬停不落。随后，这战士在阴影与阴影之间游移，身形化作幽魂般的残影，血也随他而行——融入早已在他身周盘旋漂浮、滴落飞舞的猩红触须，织成一层黏稠、扭动不休的血网帷幕。

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

Teeth grit together within the tangle of an unkempt beard. Eyes glow like embers, the pupils dilated fully. The hulking warrior snarls, bestially, before disappearing into darkness. Two red spots hang in the shadow where his eyes once were, and whispers weave through the air. They come as whimpers and small cries of pain, of loss… but then bloom into ragged screams of rage. A squelch and short cry are heard, quickly followed by a spray of blood. Again, the sound of a blade slicing through flesh, and another fountain of blood colors the air. These droplets, lines, and globules hang in the air as if caught in time. Then, as this warrior moves from shadow to shadow, his body a spectral blur, the blood follows him. It joins the dripping tendrils that already hover and fly about him, forming a veil of viscous, writhing webbing.

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

Eloquent Beggar's Request.name:
巧舌乞丐的请求
Eloquent Beggar's Request

Text.text:
“各位好心人，无论如何都别为自己的良心操心！哦，不必，神祇肯定会原谅你们对穷苦之人视而不见。我们这些只盼着能熬到明天的人倒想问——与其不小心把几枚铜子捐给坐垫或街面，嗯？为何不干脆把它们投进一只求助的手里呢？”
“Don’t under any circumstance worry about your conscience, good folk! Oh, no, your gods will certainly forgive you for ignoring the destitute. We wonder—we who hope only so much as to last to the morrow—why wouldn’t you drop a few coppers into a needy hand, rather than accidentally donate them to a cushion or a street, hm?”

施法者单膝跪地，以示臣服。低声呢喃一段短暂的祷词，随即唇角掠过一抹柔和的微笑。一个呈现为所祈唤神祇圣徽形状的光环环绕着目标。目标的眉心倏然浮现一粒光点，星辉闪烁，宛如尚未成形的半幅星座。
The caster takes to one knee in an act of obeisance. A brief whispered prayer, and then a soft smile passes over their lips. A ring in the shape of the invoked god’s holy symbol surrounds the target. A mote of light briefly appears on their brow, starry like a half-formed constellation.

一座坚固的石桥横跨河面，由两根粗壮的桥墩稳稳撑起。主拱将桥身中央高高托离水面，两侧各有较小的拱券贴着两岸承托。你沿着桥身打量时，一只鸽子从其中一处桥墩凿出的壁龛里扑棱棱飞起。那凹室看似毫无用处，但另一根桥墩上也对称开着一处同样的壁龛，倒让整座桥显得更有几分诗意。
A sturdy bridge of stone stands astride the river on two stout pillars. An arch raises its center high above the water, supported by smaller arches attached to each bank. As you examine its length, a pigeon flutters from its roost in a niche set into one of the bridge’s supports. The alcove seems to serve no purpose, but with a matching niche set into the other pillar, it makes the bridge more picturesque.

黑豹充满神秘气息。她既能攀爬也善游泳，既是奔行者也是守夜的幽灵（特征）；这生物是猫科的枢纽，是猫之气场的凝结。她的身躯如同魅惑编织而成的流畅锦缎，双眼则是通往异界的金色门扉。她守夜着你，打量着你，衡量你的分量。
The panther has mystique. A climber and swimmer, a runner and watcher ghost, this creature is a feline nexus, the aura of cat. Her body is the sleek tapestry of enchantment, and her eyes are the golden portals to other worlds. She watches you, sizing you up.

I Decline A Social Invitation After A Ha.name:
在疲惫不堪的一天后，我婉拒了一场社交邀约。
I Decline A Social Invitation After A Hard Day

Text.text:
随着白昼渐渐收束，忙碌的人们也把心思转向夜晚的消遣。一个个带着恶作剧意味的小邀请冒了出来，用义务的倒刺刺挑着我的耐性。我的设备一下一下震动，催促的警报声像海妖之歌般急切送达，可我能躲就躲，能点掉就点掉，能滑走就滑走，甚至大胆地拔掉电源。今晚属于我——我这样提醒自己——除非真正的紧急状况，否则什么也别想毁了它。
As the day draws to a close, busy folks turn their thoughts to nightly leisure. Devilish little invitations appear, pricking at my patience with their barbed prongs of obligation. My device pulses its siren song, delivered with urgency, but I tap, swipe, and unplug as much as I dare. Tonight is mine, I remind myself, and nothing short of an emergency shall spoil it.

宽阔的赤红肩头上垂挂着锤打成形的金属肩甲。一位灵体立于你面前，肌肤如石，沉重的心脏是一枚宝石。它足有十一英尺高，隐约呈人形的元素之躯在行走间扭曲着周身岩层，随心所欲地塑形石与土。最深邃的蓝宝石镶嵌在它棕黑色的额头上，而在一圈熔岩般的项圈之上——一道自满的神情挤压着它的面孔。
Broad red shoulders dangle pauldrons of beaten metal. A spirit stands before you, with stone for skin and a gemstone for its heavy heart. Eleven feet tall, the vaguely humanoid elemental warps the rock about itself as it walks, shaping stone and earth with a whim. A gem of deepest blue adorns its brown-black brow, and—above a collar of molten rock—a smug expression squeezes out across its face.

Sundries From An Orc.name:
来自兽人的杂货
Sundries From An Orc

Text.text:
你翻检它的行囊，摸到这名仍在肆虐的掠夺者随身携带的骇人器物。你拽出一串挂在铁钩上的耳朵，密密挤作一团，像一串葡萄；又掏出一袋牙齿，在掌心里哗啦作响——从人、野兽与怪物的咽喉利口里硬生生拔下来的；最后从兽人披毛的腰带上扯下一只猪膀胱水囊，提起时液体在里面晃荡作响。你拔开塞子，一股腐败的劣酒臭气直冲鼻腔，灼烧到深处，继而攥住你的喉头不放。
Rifling through its packs, you come across the grisly paraphernalia of this active marauder. You pull out a collection of ears on an iron hook, bunched together like grapes; a bag of teeth that rattles in your hand, pulled from the maws of people, beast, and monster alike; and a pig-bladder flask that sloshes as you pull it from the orc’s furred belt. Uncorking it, the odor of some fetid grog burns all the way through your nose and claws at your throat.

Encountering An Indifferent Creature.name:
遭遇一头冷漠的生物
Encountering An Indifferent Creature

Text.text:
这生物看你，最糟也只是淡淡的轻蔑，最好也不过随意的冷漠。队伍靠近时，它只抛来一眼短暂而审视的目光，却丝毫不打算挪动或自卫——事实上，它仿佛还放松了些。它的视线扫过整个区域，打量你就像巨龙看一只昆虫：满是绝对的优越与漠然。

~ Envisioned by Kazuma Bovino on Discord

The creature views you with mild contempt at worst and casual indifference at best. A brief, appraising glance is all it offers as your party draws near, yet it makes no effort to move or defend itself—in fact, it seems to relax. Sweeping its gaze over the area, it regards you like a dragon would an insect: with utter superiority and disinterest.

~ Envisioned by Kazuma Bovino on Discord

Witch Calls On Flesh Golem.name:
女巫召唤血肉魔像
Witch Calls On Flesh Golem

Text.text:
翻搅过的泥土深处，松软而隆起，像大地上的水泡般堆成一座椭圆土丘，一名鬼婆（特征）踉跄着从黑夜里爬出。她在墓前停下——那坟坑大得足以埋下一匹马——先露出一抹笑，随即伸出一根细长、弯曲的手指指去。一颗缝合扭曲的肉头从土里抬起，接着是肩膀与手臂。那坐起的身影站直，泥土成块从它身上坠落，随后猛地一晃，朝你踉跄扑来。

~ Envisioned by Vohk on Discord

From beyond the dirt churned soft, and swollen in an oblong pile like a blister on the earth, a hag shambles out of the night. She stops at the grave, which is big enough for a horse, and smiles before pointing a long, crooked finger. A fleshy head, stitched and warped, rises up, followed by shoulders and arms. The seated figure stands, earth dropping from it in clumps, then lurches toward you.

~ Envisioned by Vohk on Discord

Persona Non Grata.name:
不受欢迎的人
Persona Non Grata

Text.text:
以前也有人把事情搞砸过，但这一次的连带伤害深得惊人。昔日盟友在你面前局促不安，连陌生人都像迫不及待要绕开你。无名的愧疚与无面的指责成了你新的旅途伙伴，你递出的每一分社交礼数都被玷污——仿佛腐烂信天翁的恶臭萦身不散。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Folk have biffed it before, but the collateral damage here is profound. Old allies shift uncomfortably in your presence and even strangers seem eager to avoid you. Nameless guilt and faceless blame are your new traveling companions, and every social grace you extend is tainted—akin to the stink of rotten albatross.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Dilapidated Biofuel Camper Van.name:
破败的生物燃料露营车
Dilapidated Biofuel Camper Van

Text.text:
刺鼻到呛出泪的生物燃料酸味从破旧的老式露营车里渗出来，像刚撒下的粪肥般熏人，连带把油箱盖周围褪色的漆皮都一层层剥开。沉重的车身覆满起皮脱落的贴纸和陈旧的喷漆涂鸦，指向过去几十年里那些主要的环保组织与抗议运动。后视镜歪歪斜斜地挂着一串木制念珠，被长期摩挲得发亮、磨得发圆。
The eye-watering tang of biofuel leaks out of the battered old camper van like the stench of freshly spread manure, peeling the fading paint around the fuel cap in the process. The weighty vehicle is covered in flaking decals and old spray-painted designs referencing the major environmental organizations and protest movements of the last few decades. Wooden prayer beads hang from the poorly aligned rearview, worn down from extensive use.

猿猴的翅膀有节奏地拍动，缓缓将它推过空中。一群这样的翼猿在周遭扑棱盘旋，随着其中最强者的心意而游移。他们听命于首领——他一边狂吠着发号施令，一边用沾血的利爪四下指点。
The simian’s wings flap rhythmically, slowly pushing it through the air. A flock of these winged apes flutters about, moving on the whims of the strongest among them. They obey the orders of their leader, as he barks and points about with a bloodied claw.

Marlena The Halfling Glassblower.name:
半身人玻璃匠玛琳娜
Marlena The Halfling Glassblower

Text.text:
一名敦实的半身人女子穿着一条被灼痕遍布、在光下闪耀的皮围裙，在你踏入室内时转身迎上前来。她一动，耳畔那一串串玻璃耳坠便如乐音的微尘般在身后飘摇，风铃相互轻触，漾出细碎清脆的叮当声。
A stocky halfling woman, wearing a scorched leather apron that sparkles in the light, turns to greet you as you step inside. As she moves, her many glass earrings float behind her like motes of music, releasing small tinkles as the chimes brush together.

On Deck At Sea.name:
海上待命
On Deck At Sea

Text.text:
阳光在刚刷洗干净的甲板上闪烁，湛蓝天空里海鸥彼此呼唤。一阵顽皮的海风拂过你的脸颊与胸口，咸湿的海味在鼻尖与唇上清新可辨。船员里有人轻声哼着一段熟悉的曲调，很快便点燃了高亢而跳跃的船歌。其他人也跟着加入，歌声的节拍随着脚下海浪温柔的推与拉而起伏回荡。
The sunbeams glitter along the freshly swabbed deck as gulls call to each other in the blue sky above. A playful gust brushes your face and chest, the salt of the sea fresh on your nose and lips. A soft hum from a member of the crew, a familiar tune, soon inspires a loud and bouncing shanty. Others join in, the cadence of the song rising and falling with the gentle push and pull of the waves beneath you.

曾经构成坚固桥面的粗壮木梁，如今已被劈裂撕扯、断成残片，在自身重量下轰然坍塌。若要清理这座毁桥以便修复，需要一队伐木工人耗费数日艰苦劳作；而要重建或修补这片塌毁的残骸，还得再花上更多时日。
The mighty timbers that once formed a sturdy crossing have been split and rent apart, collapsed under their own weight. Clearing the ruined bridge so that it might be repaired would take a team of woodsmen many days of hard labor, then many more to reconstruct or repair the collapsed ruin.

店内噼啪作响的喇叭里飘出激昂的爱国乐曲——与柜台后方那面傲然占据整面墙的大旗相得益彰。各式枪械被锁在陈列柜里，宛如一座诡异的博物馆；你一踏进门，店主便警惕地盯着你。他们身着褪色的军用迷彩，发间银灰斑驳，姿态挺拔克制，像个曾经的士兵，始终无法放下过去。
Stirring patriotic music drifts from crackling speakers in the store—complementing the large flag proudly dominating the wall behind the counter. Firearms of all kinds are locked in cases, like a strange museum, and the owner eyes you warily as you enter. Clad in faded military fatigues, hair shot through with gray, they have the disciplined bearing of a former soldier unable to let go of the past.

Scale Mail Armor.name:
鳞甲护甲
Scale Mail Armor

Text.text:
这套护甲由一副臂铠、一对护腿、一件背心，以及两只可系带固定、便于穿在背心下方的袖套组成。薄皮革上铆着一片片长方形黄铜甲片，让它比看上去更沉，却也耀眼夺目。穿上它的人会如金龙般熠熠生辉。
This suit of armor consists of gauntlets, leggings, a vest, and two sleeves that can be laced on to fit under the vest. Rectangular sheets of brass attached to thin leather make it heavier than it appears, but it looks brilliant. Anyone wearing it would shine like a gold dragon.

I Untie Someone's Bonds.name:
我解开某人的束缚
I Untie Someone's Bonds

Text.text:
首先得让结扣松动，找到线头——调查占了大半功夫。我会找出结上最后绕上的那一圈，那往往最先松开。我还得看清那些小把戏：一旦解错了线，反而会把结越勒越紧。最后，第一个结终于解开，束缚随之松动，剩下的就只是时代问题了。
First the knots have to loosen, the ends found—investigation is most of the job. I find where the last loop to the knot is, the one most likely to free first. I spy tricks used to make untying the wrong line tighten its knot. Finally, the first knot falls, the bonds loosen, and the rest is just a matter of time.

霓虹酒馆里喧嚣的狂欢声浪翻涌，小舞台上的乐队仍奋力奏响，硬是压过那片嘈杂。纵情享乐的氛围为日复一日的劳顿带来难得的喘息，而这里早已人满为患，挤得远远超出承载极限。
The band on the small stage plays over the din of revelry in the neon cantina. Its hedonistic atmosphere provides a welcome relief from the drudgery of daily life, and the place is packed well over capacity.

这把独特武器的来历完全成谜，但每一次挥击时涌出的魔法力量都不容置疑。鞭子的材质并非牛皮或马皮，而是某种被猎杀的奇幻生物经鞣制后的皮革。其上密布如蜂巢般的祝福与赐福，既有神圣魔法也有奥术魔法的重重附魔；每当它横扫而过，空气中都会留下淡淡的蓝色残影，久久不散。
The provenance of this unique weapon is a complete mystery, but there is no denying the magic power flowing forth with every strike. The whip’s material is not cow or horse leather, but the cured hide of some felled fantastic creature. Heavily enchanted with a honeycomb of blessings and endowments of both divine and arcane magics, each sweep of its length leaves a faint blue afterimage lingering in the air.

Great Mine Cavern.name:
大矿坑洞窟
Great Mine Cavern

Text.text:
你所穿行的隧道豁然开阔，通向一座广袤的洞窟，穹顶高耸得超出你的视线。十余条隧道在此汇入，洞壁布满矿工剥刮殆尽的痕迹，宛如被利爪反复撕扯。木箱与桶罐——装着煤炭、铁锭，以及其他难以辨认的材料——零星散落在空间里，.
The tunnel through which you travel opens into an expansive cavern, the ceiling of which extends beyond your sight. A dozen tunnels empty into this room, and the walls are riddled with the work of the miners who stripped it bare. Crates and barrels—holding coal, iron ingots, and other unidentifiable materials—dot the space, .

Magical Street Drug, \"Bubbles\".name:
魔法街头毒品，“泡泡”
Magical Street Drug, "Bubbles"

Text.text:
源自奇术酵母，阴影里的化学师们缔造了这抹黄水晶般的奇迹。它是一种粉末，浸透了一丝以太的接触，是暧昧不明的赋礼。吞下这淡色化合物，便会得到一份难以捉摸的赋礼：来自星界变色龙的一吻。蒙福者得以悄然穿行，形迹无踪、毫不起眼——唯独使用者会接连发出几声粗俗的打嗝。

~ 由一位英雄Envisioned

From thaumaturgic yeast, shadowy chemists have created this citrine wonder. It is a powder infused with a touch of the ethereal, a gift of ambiguity. Ingestion of this pale compound bequeaths an elusive gift: a kiss from the astral chameleon. Those blessed may pass unseen, inconspicuous but for a series of vulgar belching from the user.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Cyborg Alien Resembling A Bipedal Bear.name:
形似双足巨熊的赛博外星人
Cyborg Alien Resembling A Bipedal Bear

Text.text:
笨拙而不协调的巨大灰熊摇摇晃晃地用后腿直立前行。巨兽的大口张得极开，仿佛要咆哮，然而那嘴却以不可能的角度继续裂开——颚骨向后翻折，露出一套复杂的金属传感阵列，其间生物荧光导管明灭脉动。尖锐的高频嗡鸣声戳破幻象：这头熊其实是一具结构精密的外星自动机械。
Awkward and ungainly, a gigantic grizzly bear staggers forward on hind legs. The great maw of the beast opens wide, as if to roar, but instead the mouth opens impossibly wide—hinging back to reveal a complex metallic sensor array, pulsing with bioluminescent tubes. A high-pitched whirring reveals the bear to be, in fact, a complex alien automaton.

有些树泛着柔和的祖母绿，树根处向外蓬开，像裙摆一样覆在地面松软的腐殖层上，为小兽与妖精提供庇护。有些枝头点缀着球果，时不时落下一枚。另一些树皮如谜般龟裂，褐灰相间的树干笔直如桅杆，枝条高挑而稀疏。在炽热的阳光下，或雨后不久，即便不靠眼睛也能认出这里。风掠过针叶的低语，以及树脂的气息，清晰得不容错认。
