Some of the trees are soft emerald, flaring out like skirts at the bottom over soft duff on the ground, offering shelter to small animals and the fae. Some are speckled with cones, dropping one now and then. Others are puzzle-barked, brown and gray trunks straight as masts, their branches high and sparse. In hot sunlight or just after rain, this place can be known without sight. The whisper of wind through needles and the smell of the sap is unmistakable.

沙砾、卵石般大小的碎石与巨砾铺满了你眼前的整个地貌，沉默地印证着过去某个年代里冰川奔涌的痕迹。行家里手的目光——细察这些堆积物的分布——能从中捕捉到冰川行进路线的些许线索。然而你仍不禁为那庞然冰体的浩瀚规模而惊叹：它必曾一路碾碎冲撞，沿着你如今踏行的这条路径硬生生闯过来。
Sand, pebble-sized chunks of gravel, and boulders make up the entirety of the landscape before you, mute evidence of a glacial flow in a past age. A knowledgeable eye—taking in the accumulation’s distribution—gains some indication of the path of the glacier. But one cannot help but marvel at the sheer scope of the massive ice form that must have smashed its way along the route you now follow.

法师之死那股非自然的恐怖令你脑海翻涌，你几乎无法将目光从这幕血腥惨状上移开。尽管遗骸仍披着奥术学者的长袍，却几乎再无任何能证明其曾是类人生物的痕迹。施法者的形体被生生拆解成一条条血肉飘带，仿佛有看不见的恶意像拽住一根松散的线头般扯住法师——并且一直扯下去。
Your mind reels at the unnatural horror of the wizard’s death, and you find it difficult to tear your gaze from the grisly scene. Though still wearing the robes of an arcane scholar, there is little else to identify the remains as a humanoid. The caster’s form has unraveled into ribbons of flesh, as if an unseen malevolence tugged at the wizard like a loose thread—and kept pulling.

这头庞然巨兽似在沉睡。覆鳞的侧腹缓缓起伏，一次又一次；带鳍的尾巴也轻轻抽动，像做梦的狗。它那四颗龙似的头颅发出粗重的鼾声，呼哧作响。然而其中一颗头却高高盘踞在其余之上，长颈如柱，亮黄的眼睛大睁着，警觉地扫视四周。
The enormous beast seems to slumber. Its scaled flank rises and falls in slow repetition, and its finned tail twitches, like that of a dreaming dog. Four of its dragon-like heads wuffle loud snores. But one head hovers, high over the others on a long neck, bright yellow eyes wide open and alert.

一团摇摇晃晃的柠檬绿胶质沿着无数细小触须黏滑前行，身形不断扭曲变换，挤过狭窄的缝隙。它的许多伪足在四周探挑拨弄，搜寻有知觉的血肉。黏液的后段鼓起一只巨大的囊泡，宛如被拉长的脑组织。囊内幽蓝的微光以令人目眩的节律忽明忽灭，照亮一张复杂的神经网络，贯穿其躯体的全长。
A wobbling mass of lime-green jelly slops along on countless little tendrils, shifting its shape to squeeze through tight spaces. Its many pseudopods tease out at the surroundings, searching for sentient matter. The rear of the slime is a great bulbous sac, like a stretched-out brain. Within, faint sparks of blue flash in dizzying patterns, illuminating a complex neural network that reaches the length of its body.

你轻轻从一只小巧的锁盒中取出那块华美的石头，指腹抚过它镶嵌宝石的表面，随即合上盒盖。你在渐冷的空气里描绘出繁复的齿轮状符文，将心神凝成一线，专注于嬗变，在意识中召来即将成形之物的轮廓。低沉的轰鸣与澎湃的奥能脉动撼动大地，尘雾翻涌成云。厚重的身影在旋转的尘心里逐渐凝结成形。
Gently taking the ornate stone from a small lockbox, you caress its gem-encrusted surface and close the lid. Tracing intricate cog-like symbols in the cooling air, you concentrate on the transmutation, mentally summoning an image of what will be. A deep rumble and a throb of arcane energy shake the ground as a dust cloud forms. A bulky figure takes shape in its swirling heart.

Ship Enters Atmosphere.name:
飞船冲入大气层
Ship Enters Atmosphere

Text.text:
失重的空间领域让位于再入时粗砺的压力，你的飞船冲入行星大气层，随着适应新的环境而微微颠簸。燃烧分子的炽亮光辉充盈你的视野，隔热盾吸收着大气摩擦带来的惊人热量。高速气流猛烈拍击着你的座驾，它向上层大气那翻涌的云海俯冲而去，穿透云层，仿佛撞进一团浓重的晨雾。随后，行星的陆地在你眼前铺展开来，壮丽得令人屏息。
The weightless realm of space gives way to the rugged pressure of re-entry as your ship enters the planet’s atmosphere, bucking slightly as it adjusts to the new conditions. The radiant glow of burning molecules suffuses your view as the heatshields absorb the tremendous heat from atmospheric friction. High-speed winds buffet your craft as it descends toward the rolling layer of clouds in the upper atmosphere, breaking through them like a dense morning mist. Then the planet’s landmass stretches before you in a spectacular vista.

Resthana Nan Vesta.name:
雷斯萨娜·南·维斯塔
Resthana Nan Vesta

Text.text:
年轻的白皙女子带着耐心而优雅的气息，沿着鹅卵石小巷缓缓踱行。她娇小的身形裹在朴素的土色里，白色罩衫映着日光的暖辉，披肩在夏日微风中沙沙作响。兜帽下金色卷发轻跳，带着一丝俏皮，也映在她那双蓝宝石般的眼眸里。她的步伐轻快、有力、洋溢着青春，但关节处却有种反常的僵硬，让她的步态被扭成了玩偶般的质感。她伸出的手里，一只没有铃舌的小手铃无声摇摆，听不见半点清响；然而在人耳不可及的深处，却有一缕神秘的共鸣低低嗡鸣，携着神圣的力量。

~ 由 Oscar Played

With an air of patient grace, the young, fair-skinned woman meanders down the cobbled lane. Her petite form is wrapped in earthy tones, a white blouse reflecting the sun's warm glow, and her shawl rustling in the summer breeze. Golden curls bounce beneath her bonnet, a hint of whimsy that is reflected in her sapphire eyes. Her steps are buoyant, energized, and youthful, but an uncharacteristic stiffness rests in her joints, warping her gait with a doll-like quality. There is a notable absence of sound from the clapper-less handbell swinging silently in her outstretched hand, but a mystical resonance below human hearing hums with divine power.

~ Played by Oscar

Nightmare Stalking You In A Forest.name:
噩梦在森林中尾随你
Nightmare Stalking You In A Forest

Text.text:
你喘得又急又短，狂奔穿过那片伸抓的树丛，昏暗里几乎被那些探向你小腿的树根绊倒。腐烂植被的浓烈气味熏得你头晕目眩，但你还是冒险回头一瞥——只见那生物正逼得更近。

~ 一位英雄所构想

Your breath is ragged and short as you sprint through the grasping trees, almost tripping on the roots reaching for your legs in the gloom. The heady scent of rotting vegetation makes your head swim, but you dare to look over your shoulder—and see the creature is getting closer.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Cast Longstrider.name:
我施放长足术
I Cast Longstrider

Text.text:
伴随着脚掌猛踏大地的声响——鹿在草木间腾跃、巨人哼哧着踉跄跨过宽阔裂谷——那震颤穿透我全身。我将手掌抵在同伴的背上。一股金色、狂躁的能量自我掌心噼啪迸散，涌入他们的血脉与肌肉。
With the sounds of feet pounding against the ground—of deer leaping through grass and tree, of a giant grunting as he lurches over a wide crevasse—vibrating through me, I press my hand into the back of my companion. A golden, frenetic energy fizzles out of my hand and floods their veins and muscles.

I Am Caught Stealing From A Dragon's Hoa.name:
我偷窃巨龙宝库时被当场逮住了
I Am Caught Stealing From A Dragon's Hoard

Text.text:
一声咆哮在洞窟深处轰然滚过，我只觉胃里猛地一沉；尾巴如鞭横扫而来，猛然缠上我的脚踝。我的手止不住发抖，宝藏从指间坠落；胃部翻绞成结，那尾巴越收越紧，勒住我的小腿、膝弯与腰身。
I feel my stomach drop as a roar rumbles through the cavern and a whip of a tail snaps around my feet. I drop the treasure from my trembling hands, my stomach curling into knots as the tail tightens about my calves, knees, and waist.

Psionic Warrior From The Astral Plane.name:
来自星界位面的灵能战士
Psionic Warrior From The Astral Plane

Text.text:
尽管注视着你的那个人形身影看起来像个瘦长、枯槁的人类，却毫无疑问，它与人类的距离，正如精灵之于矮人般遥远。尖长的耳朵、几乎只剩一丝轮廓的鼻梁、泛黄的皮肤——像某些地精部族那样——然而这生物仍以无比清晰的姿态传达出：它对你与你的同类只有轻蔑，而胆敢干预它的计划，只会换来它手下迅捷的死亡。它握着一柄银色巨剑，剑刃弧曲，如此形制你从未见过。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Though the humanoid watching you resembles a spindly, emaciated human, there is no doubt that it is as far removed from humanity as elves are from dwarves. With pointed ears, the barest hint of a nose, and yellow skin much like that of some goblin tribes, this creature is nonetheless communicating quite clearly that it has nothing but contempt for you and your kind, and that interference in its plans will bring only a quick death at its hands. It carries a silver greatsword with a curved blade, the likes of which you have never seen.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Young Brass Dragon.name:
幼年黄铜龙
Young Brass Dragon

Text.text:
大地震颤，你听见泥土里传来雷鸣般的刨抓声。一条鳞片如号角般鲜亮夺目的巨龙疾冲而来，猛地刹住，四肢分开站定，匕首般大小的利爪深深抠入地面。它的体型如马般庞大，筋骨如虎般紧绷，可那股活力四射的姿态，却更像一只嬉闹的小猫。
The ground shudders as you hear a thunderous scrabbling of the earth. A dragon with scales the color and brightness of a herald’s horn runs up and stops short, legs spread, with claws the size of daggers digging into the ground. It’s as big as a horse and as taut as a tiger, but it energetic posture reminds you more of a kitten at play.

Headstone: “Flames” In Winter.name:
墓碑：“冬日之焰”
Headstone: “Flames” In Winter

Text.text: 这块墓碑立在一条少有人走的小路旁，那小路自嵌入山坡的石阶蜿蜒而下。碑文写道：烈焰在那片无人应当渴望踏足的领域里永恒燃烧，然而仍有人在此生走上一条终将把他们引向那里的道路。 This headstone stands beside a little-used path down from the stairs built into the hill. It reads: Flames burn eternal in that realm where no soul should wish to tread, and yet some walk a path in life that leads them there.

一袭破烂的黑色长裙披在这名高挑瘦削的身影上，袖口垂坠飘荡，靛蓝色披肩如幕覆肩。她的头上绕着一圈黑色圆帽檐，发丝盘成繁复的发髻，发针外露。灰白轻纱的面纱自帽沿垂下，遮住并压暗她的面容，仿佛薄纱之下只剩一具森然裸颅。灰皮的长指骨节嶙峋，指甲如爪般尖锐，从宽大的袖中探出。她用那双手在虚空中编织出缕缕烟丝，同时低声呢喃咒文。
A tattered black gown with dangling sleeves and a mantle of indigo drape this tall, gaunt figure. Ringing her head is a black burlet, leaving hair done in an elaborate bun with pins exposed. A gray, gauzy veil hangs from the hat and obscures and darkens her face, giving the impression of a bare skull beneath. Long, bony fingers with gray skin and claw-like nails emerge from the gown’s baggy sleeves. With them, the figure weaves smoky strings out of thin air while whispering an incantation.

矮人监狱典狱长整理了整理制服，坐回自己办公室的书桌后，发出一声清晰可闻的叹息，眉眼之间尽是忧惧积累出的疲惫。他在抽屉里一阵翻找，拽出一只方形酒瓶和几只廉价的长饮杯，给自己倒了满满一杯烈酒，带着贪恋一口灌下。名义上他是这座庞大机构的掌舵者，可举手投足却像困在自己亲手设下的陷阱里——欠上级的债太深，根本抽不开身，只能在充斥贿赂与腐败的泥沼中越陷越深；那泥沼既纠缠着他的清醒，也同样侵入他的梦境。
The dwarf prison warden adjusts his uniform and seats himself behind the desk in his office with an audible sigh, the fatigue of worry evident in his every feature. Rummaging around in his desk, he pulls out a square liquor bottle and some cheap highball glasses, pours himself a stiff drink and downs it with relish. Though ostensibly the head of this sizable institution, he moves and acts as if caught in a trap of his own making, too far indebted to his superiors to remove himself from the world of graft and corruption that plagues his waking world and his dreams alike.

Vampire Sanctuary.name:
吸血鬼庇护所
Vampire Sanctuary

Text.text: [外部]  这座看似废弃的庄园矗立在夜色中，阴冷、黯淡、寂静无声；破碎的窗户被木板钉死，残破的窗帘在后方垂挂，将光线彻底吞没。门框上有个诡异的符号，像是被利爪生生刻出，狰狞地玷污着木纹。 [内部]  灰尘覆满每一寸表面，但这里有人出没的痕迹清晰可见。脚印与拖痕在尘埃里纵横交错，划出一道道脏污的路径。地板上散落着白骨，被獠牙啃噬得支离破碎；深色血迹斑斑点点，渗进曾经华美的地毯。沿着昏暗走廊深入，在一扇厚重的深色木门之后，六具华丽的棺椁静静安放，棺盖严密封死——唯有一具敞开着，里面空无一物。 [Outside]  The seemingly abandoned manor stands dark, cold, and silent; its shattered windows are boarded up and darkened with tattered curtains. A strange symbol mars the doorframe, carved by what looks like claws. [Inside]  Dust covers every surface, but the existence of occupants is clear. Prints lead this way and that, leaving trails through the dust. Bones litter the floor, gnawed by fangs, and splotches of dark blood stain the once resplendent carpets. Down the shadowed corridors, behind a heavy door of dark wood, six ornate coffins rest, their lids sealed shut—except one, which lies open and empty.

I Turn An Enchantment Spell Back On Its.name:
我用迷惑法杖将一道附魔法术反弹回它的施法者身上
I Turn An Enchantment Spell Back On Its Caster With My Staff Of Charming

Text.text:
我的法杖骤然迸发出明亮的棱彩闪光，将原本要蛊惑我的法术猛然格开。我死死攥紧杖杆，把怒意凝聚在那股魔法的源头，咬紧牙关、神情冷峻而坚定——准备将这道法术原封不动地反掷回施法者身上。
My staff flashes in a bright prismatic burst as it deflects the spell intended to enthrall me. Gripping the haft tightly I focus my ire on the source of the magic and set my jaw in stoic determination—as I prepare to turn the spell back on its caster.

I Cheat During A Card Game.name:
我在牌局中出老千
I Cheat During A Card Game

Text.text: 怀着我的手法能奏效的希望，我飞快地朝某位赌徒之神比了个手势，掌心暗扣起那张关键高牌，准备在发牌时用上。我把桌上的牌一把搂拢，趁着收牌的动作把那张牌顶到掌下藏住，直到洗牌时把它悄悄送到从牌顶数下来的第五张。我发牌，第一轮就知道落在我面前的会是什么——自信猛地涌上来。 [Successful] 我发出一张稍显野的牌，先把所有人的注意力带偏，再假装掠过、顺势一放，将掌扣的牌悄无声息地落下。我们收拢各自的手牌。我的牌摊开，像一个笑容——留给偶然的空间少得多。 [Unsuccessful] 那感觉糟透了，糟透了——你身旁的玩家那只手猛地扣住你的手腕。牌从我掌心弹出，还带着微微的弓起。它砸在桌面上，声响如同大钟鸣响。 With hope that my method will work and a quick gesture to some gambling god, I palm the high card on the pickup for my deal. Raking all the cards from the table, I pop the card up under my hand, concealing it until I shuffle it fifth from the top. I deal, knowing what lands before me on the first pass in a boost of confidence. [Successful] I deal a card a little wild, distracting everyone before the fake swipe and drop of my palmed card. We gather up our hands. Mine opens like a smile, with far less left to chance. [Unsuccessful] It’s a terrible, terrible feeling—that hand of the player next to you grabbing your wrist. The card pops from my palm, still a little bowed. It hits the table as loud as the toll of a great bell.

Murder Of Crows.name:
乌鸦谋杀团
Murder Of Crows

Text.text:
你一靠近，鸦群便猛然炸起腾空，乌黑的翅翼骤然拍击，声势突兀而震耳；那清晰的噼啪脆响在它们冲入空中时猛地惊了你一下。
Upon your approach, the flock of crows bursts suddenly into flight, the flap of their ebon wings so abrupt and loud that the audible snapping sound startles you as they take to the air.

Minotaur Mercenary Rampage.name:
牛头人佣兵暴走
Minotaur Mercenary Rampage

Text.text:
牛头人身披一身雇佣战士的道具——既无忠诚纹章，也无罩袍——冲着卫兵咆哮。怪物猛地从背后系带上一把战斧扯下，抡臂横扫。斧刃致命的弧线划破空气，刀口边缘布满崩缺却仍锋利无比，深深卡进第一名卫兵体内。牛头人一脚踏上尸体，硬生生把战斧拔出，侧身闪过第二名卫兵的劈砍，随即斩下那最后敌人的头颅。

~ 由 ProudBarbarian 构想

Wearing gear that marks a fighter for hire—without loyal sigil or tabard—the minotaur bellows at the guards. The monster yanks a battleaxe free from the tether on its back and swings. The deadly curve of the blade, nicked along an edge still sharp, lodges in the first guard. The minotaur puts its boot against the corpse and yanks free the battleaxe, dodges a strike by the second guard, then beheads its remaining opponent.

~ Envisioned by ProudBarbarian

House Of The Holy Dawn.name:
圣曦黎明之馆
House Of The Holy Dawn

Text.text:
踏入神庙的庭院，你迎面撞见一幕令人屏息的壮美：饰有纵向凹槽的高柱上遍布繁复精细的雕刻，直指无云的苍穹，在明亮的晨光下熠熠生辉；而绣着太阳徽记的垂挂旗幡与丝绸帷幔在微风中轻轻摇曳，于开阔的庭院里投下细腻流转的纹影。

~ 构想：Winters

Entering the temple grounds, you are met by a sight of awe-inspiring beauty: fluted columns emblazoned with intricate carvings stretch toward the cloudless sky, gleaming in the bright morning sunlight; and hanging banners and silken drapes emblazoned with the symbol of the sun dance gently in the breeze, casting delicate patterns across the open courtyard.

~ Envisioned by Winters

I Help Slay A Water Elemental While Wear.name:
我戴着【水元素支配之戒】，协助屠杀一只水元素
I Help Slay A Water Elemental While Wearing My Ring Of Water Elemental Command

Text.text:
我落下最后一击，刀锋如切果冻般劈开那水元素。它发出最后一声嘶嘶的哀鸣，身躯一分为二，随即化作细微的薄雾消散。蒸汽旋聚成云，缓缓下沉，罩向我。我嗅到新雨坠落后的清冽气息，身子不由一颤，仿佛坠落进冰冷而幽深的水中。
I land the final blow, slicing through the water elemental like a knife through jelly. It emits a last hissing wail as the two halves of its body dissipate into a fine mist. The vapors coalesce into a cloud that descends upon me. I smell the fresh scent of newly fallen rain, and my body shudders as I feel the sensation of falling into cold, deep water.

那名身形纤细的半精灵一身素灰，鼻梁上架着一副夹鼻眼镜。你在这间陈设冷峻却灯光明亮的画廊里端详着一件展品时，她悄无声息地走到你身侧，压低嗓音含蓄地问你是否需要她帮忙挑选一件你可能愿意购入的作品，并表示若你有任何疑问，她都愿意凭借自己的专业为你解答。
Dressed in muted gray and sporting a pair of pince-nez spectacles, the willowy half-elf comes up to your side as you examine one of the works displayed in the stark but well-lit art gallery. With a discreet whisper, she asks if she can assist you in finding a piece you might care to purchase, and offers her expertise should you have any questions.

Words Of Comfort From A Dying Paladin.name:
垂死圣武士的慰藉之言
Words Of Comfort From A Dying Paladin

Text.text:
“别为我哭泣。正如太阳滑入夜色的薄霭，我们终将如此。我们所能盼望的，只是此生之光曾照亮最需要它的人。”
“Do not weep for me. As the sun slips into the haze of night, so must we all. We can only hope that our life’s light has shone upon those who needed it most.”

Greeting From A Cleric’s Patron.name:
来自牧师守护神的问候
Greeting From A Cleric’s Patron

Text.text:
“感召之声多得数不清。无数虔诚的追随者以祈祷充盈我的领域，那嗡鸣宛如一座庞大蜂巢的震响。然而，你的声音却始终能刺破这片喧嚣。你身上有某种特别之处，我希望我们能一起将它寻出来。”
“There are so many calling out. So many devoted followers filling my realm with prayer like the buzzing of some great hive. And yet, your voice has always pierced the din. There is something special about you, I hope we can discover it together.”

Grick Attacks From Cave Ceiling.name:
格里克从洞穴天花板突袭
Grick Attacks From Cave Ceiling

Text.text:
生物以起伏的脉动蜿蜒抽动，从头顶的钟乳石上缓缓舒展开来；它那蛇一般的躯体不再与湿亮的岩壁融为一体。洞窟里陷入一阵意味深长的停顿，滴水声在寂静中回荡，仿佛雷鸣。随后，它出击！它从高处的制高点猛然跃下，以骇人的速度将自己抛向猎物；昏暗中，禽鸟般的喙饥渴地咔哒作响，触手狂乱甩动，环绕着那致命的几丁质剪刃。

~ Envisioned by Angie on Discord

With an undulating pulse the creature uncoils itself from the stalactite above, its serpentine body no longer camouflaged against the glistening rocks. A pregnant pause fills the cavern, and the sound of dripping water echoes like thunder in the silence. Then it strikes! Leaping from its aerial vantage, the creature propels itself onto its prey with terrifying speed, its avian beak clacking hungrily in the gloom as tentacles flail around its lethal chitinous shears.

~ Envisioned by Angie on Discord

Druid Threat About Prey.name:
德鲁伊对猎物的威胁
Druid Threat About Prey

Text.text:
“你见过被猎杀的啮齿小兽在掠过的鹰影下惊恐乱窜吗？如果你愿意，我可以让你切身感受自己在食物链中岌岌可危的位置。”
“Have you ever witnessed the terror of a hunted rodent as it darts away from a passing hawk? If you’d like, I can make you feel your precarious place in the food chain.”

Stone Age Jungle.name:
石器年代丛林
Stone Age Jungle

Text.text:
原始丛林是一场闷热潮湿的噩梦，遍布凶残猛兽。厚重的树冠层下，光线黯淡成令人窒息的昏翳，空气里充斥着丛林生灵觅食、厮杀、死去时持续不断、撕扯神经的声响，回荡在腐烂的落叶层与藤蔓缠绕的枝桠之间。
The primal jungle is a sweltering, humid nightmare filled with an abundance of ferocious creatures. Beneath the thick treetop canopy, the light fades to a claustrophobic gloaming, filled with the constant, nerve-shredding sounds of the jungle’s inhabitants as they forage, fight, and die among the rotting leaf litter and vine-covered branches.

一名巨大的兽人从阴影里蹒跚而出，随身带来酸败的血腥与腐陈内脏的恶臭。那生物仿佛由覆苔的花岗岩粗粗凿成，板岩般的肌肉覆着厚实、斑驳的暗绿皮肤。它那如濒死余烬般的细小眼珠冷冷打量着你，随即畸形的嘴猛然裂开，喷出一声低沉的咆哮，回声里带着祖灵般的蛮荒凶性。纵横交错的上百道苍白疤痕在这生物身上仿佛随动作起伏波动，而这头蛮兽却在下一瞬以惊人的速度骤然加速。冲锋途中，它抽出一柄怪异的匕首——护手篮的前方与两侧各伸出一片沉重的刀刃——竟还硬生生将三道刃锋一并对准了你。
An enormous orc shambles from the shadows, bringing with them the smell of soured blood and stale entrails. The creature looks crudely carved from mossy granite, their slab-like muscles covered in thick, mottled-green skin. Beady eyes the color of dying embers regard you before their mishappen mouth splits wide to release a guttural roar that echoes with ancestral savagery. The hundred pale scars that crisscross this creature seem to ripple as the brute moves with sudden speed. Mid-charge, they unsheathe an odd dagger with three heavy blades protruding from the front and sides of its basket hilt. They somehow manage to point all three in your direction.

Spectral Giant Forges Magical Sword Anew.name:
幽魂巨人再铸魔剑
Spectral Giant Forges Magical Sword Anew

Text.text:
巨人的幽灵（特征）巨槌——轻易便有一头公牛般的体型——挟着缥缈的clang砸落在你的武器上，他同时吟诵着束缚之词。低沉而洪亮的挽歌一路攀升至高潮，随着他落下最后一击，你的武器在火山般的暴怒中轰然绽放。幽灵以出人意料的速度行动，将熔融的武器深深刺入冰川寒冰，冷却时嘶嘶作响、火星迸溅。伴着一声满足的闷哼，他将它拔出。仍在冻结的空气中噼啪作响，你那乌黑的武器已被新符文点燃，熊熊燃烧着熔炉的怒火。

~ 由 Pepijn 设想

The giant's spectral hammer—easily the size of an ox—smashes down on your blade with an ethereal clang as he chants the words of binding. The low, sonorous dirge reaches a crescendo as he delivers the final strike, and your blade erupts in a bloom of volcanic fury. Moving with surprising speed, the ghost plunges the molten weapon deep into the glacial ice, causing it to hiss and spark as it cools. With a satisfied grunt he pulls it free. Still crackling in the frozen air, your ebon blade is alight with new runes, blazing with the fury of the forge.

~ Envisioned by Pepijn

Stimulant Street Drug, Nitro: Injected.name:
兴奋剂街头毒品「硝基」：注射
Stimulant Street Drug, Nitro: Injected

Text.text:
针尖冰冷的刺痛将一场力量的火风暴灌入你的躯体。你的肌肉翻涌，绷成捕食者般的筋索；每一次移动都像由战神亲自编排，你正攀升至宇宙级的狂暴。你的心智收束成完美的专注，每一种感官都被拧到超越凡人理解的极限。你是轰鸣的火山，迫不及待要喷发；你是古老的太阳，正向超新星屈服。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The needle’s chill bite unleashes a firestorm of power into your body. Your muscles ripple into predatory cords, each movement now choreographed by the god of war as you ascend to cosmic savagery. Your mind narrows into perfect focus as each sense is dialed beyond mortal comprehension. You are the rumbling volcano begging to erupt, the ancient sun surrendering to supernova.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Winter High-elf With Dying Wife.name:
冬境高等精灵与垂死的妻子
Winter High-elf With Dying Wife

Text.text:
随着最后一声颤抖的喘息，女人的眼神黯淡下去，身躯在丈夫苍白的臂弯里彻底软塌。房间里的暖意刹那消散——仿佛一支蜡烛被吹灭——霜花开始沿着墙面结起，噼啪作响，以不自然的速度蔓延开来。男人转向你，优雅的面容上凝着无法慰藉的悲恸与暴怒的泪痕，冰封其间，如今却扭曲成仇恨……一场风暴正在逼近。

~ 由Clara C. Potter 构想

With a last, rattling gasp the woman's eyes dim, and her body becomes limp in the pale arms of her husband. The warmth in the room instantly dissipates—as if a candle has been blown out—and frost begins to rime the walls, crackling as it spreads with unnatural speed. The man turns to you, tears of inconsolable grief and rage frozen on his elegant face, now twisted in hatred… a storm is coming.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter

Cybernetic Torso Augmentation +3.name:
义体躯干强化 +3
Cybernetic Torso Augmentation +3

Text.text:
这具躯体已化作一台永不停歇的意志引擎。核心深处是一座熔炉——一台燃烧的离心机，由超载的离子电池不断供能。躯干的每一寸都以超轻合金加固，在减重的同时将韧性推至极限。反黑入侵力场的低沉嗡鸣在无数军规级组件周围噼啪作响。增强体的负载之巨令人胆寒：一件活生生的武器。这些改造足以轻松承受为瘫痪载具而设计的高功率武器火力。

~ 一位英雄所设想

This body has become an engine of ceaseless will. At the heart lies the furnace, a burning centrifuge fed with supercharged ion batteries. Each inch of the torso has been reinforced with hyperlight alloys to reduce weight and increase resilience. The constant hum of an anti-hack field fizzles around the many military-grade components. The sheer bulk of the augmentations is daunting: a living weapon. These modifications could easily withstand high-powered weaponry designed to neutralize vehicles.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Warning From Tavern Maid To Patrons.name:
酒馆侍女对众人的警告
Warning From Tavern Maid To Patrons

Text.text:
“谁敢用一只手摸我屁股，桌上所有人就都得吞下一碗‘手炖汤’。”
“One hand touches me backside and everyone at the table eats a bowl of hand stew.”

Calysta Alpine.name:
卡莉丝塔·阿尔派恩
Calysta Alpine

Text.text:
矮人战士挺立在俯瞰下方小镇的峭坡上，伤痕累累的巨斧横搭在她宽阔结实的肩头。她的脸坚硬而饱经风霜，如同山岩；一条醒目的疤痕横贯她那被反复打断的鼻梁。厚重的皮革与毛皮裹身，她几乎未曾察觉刺骨寒风拨弄着她深色、纠结的辫发；她深深吸了一口清冽的高山空气，胸腔随之充盈，满足而踏实。由驯鹿骨雕刻而成的熊图腾悬在她粗壮的颈间，安稳地贴在披覆胸前的毛皮之中。

~ 由一位英雄Played，并附有

The dwarven warrior stands resolute on the bluff overlooking the town below, a battered greataxe resting across her broad, muscular shoulders. Her face is as hard and weathered as mountain stone, and she bears a prominent scar running across her repeatedly broken nose. Covered in thick leathers and furs, she barely notices the frigid breeze tousling her dark, matted braids as she takes a deep, satisfying lungful of the crisp alpine air. A totem of a bear—carved from caribou bone—hangs around her sturdy neck and nestles comfortably in the furs draped across her chest.

~ Played by a Hero with

Brooms Coaches At Practice.name:
扫帚马车训练中
Brooms Coaches At Practice

Text.text:
“好了，好了。能不翻就别翻。动作要省着用。保持速度。”

“对嘛。要翻也得有个穿着对面颜色的人让你翻进去！”

“亲爱的！”

“抱歉，宝贝。”

“Now, now. There’s no need to flip when you don’t have to flip. We want to economize our moves. Keep up the speed.”

“Yeah. You want to flip when there’s someone wearing opposite colors to flip into!”

“Dear!”

“Sorry, hon.”

Scale Mail Armor +3.name:
鳞甲护甲 +3
Scale Mail Armor +3

Text.text:
闪耀的鳞片层层叠叠，成百上千，构成了这套精致的锁子甲。鳞片柔韧顺滑，灵活贴身，轻若羽毛。这件护甲能轻易将钢刃拨开，提供远超寻常金属与皮革世俗极限的防护。
Gleaming scales, hundreds of them layered over the top of one another, make up this fine suit of mail. The scales are supple, flexible, and light as a feather. The armor is capable of turning steel aside without complication, providing protection beyond the mundane limitations of ordinary metal and leather.

Loot From A Sneaky Goblin.name:
狡猾地精的赃物
Loot From A Sneaky Goblin

Text.text:
地精的腰带上别着一把精致的雕纹匕首。你不禁猜想，究竟是哪位贵族倒霉撞上这怯懦的窃贼，才会被迫舍弃如此美丽的武器。
Tucked into the goblin’s belt is a fine, engraved dagger. You wonder what noble fell afoul of the craven thief to part with such a beautiful weapon.

Call And Response Of The Order Of Lightb.name:
光辉使团的呼应问答
Call And Response Of The Order Of Lightbringers

Text.text:
大圣骑士直面光耀使团——一支受祝福的战士连队。“我们是利剑！”

“决不折断！”骑士们齐声回应。

“我们是坚盾！”

“决不破碎！”

“我们是希望！”

“随黎明而至！”

“我们是光明！”

“在暮色中炽烈燃烧！”

大圣骑士高举长剑。“光耀使们，展现你们的光！”

The Grand Paladin faces the Order of the Lightbringers, a company of blessed warriors. "We are the sword!"

"THAT SHALL NOT BREAK!" respond the knights.

"We are the shield!"

"THAT SHALL NOT SHATTER!"

"We are the hope!"

"THAT COMES WITH THE DAWN!"

"We are the light!"

"THAT BURNS BRIGHT AT DUSK!"

The Grand Paladin raises his sword. "Lightbringers, present your light!"

Inside A Mountain Dwarfhold.name:
山中矮人要塞深处
Inside A Mountain Dwarfhold

Text.text:
巨大的穹顶般洞窟天花板压在一根根从原生岩体凿出的巍峨石柱之上。石柱中有珍贵矿脉如丝脉般闪烁，其上刻着古老矮人不断向更深处掘进的身影——繁复的纹刻被岁月磨得圆润光滑。圆顶建筑自地面隆起，居所、塔楼与工坊皆从山体核心凿出，窗内火把的光在其中忽明忽暗。矮人挤满这座地下都会的街道与巷弄，拖拽着金属与岩块，彼此吼叫呼喝。这座铺展无垠的石之城托举着头顶整座大山的沉重。
The immense, cavernous ceiling rests upon massive columns hewn from the raw stone. Veins of precious minerals glimmer within the columns, which depict ancient dwarves digging deeper and deeper—intricate etchings worn smooth by centuries. Domed structures rise from the floor, homes and towers and workshops chiseled from the heart of the mountain, their windows flickering with torchlight. Dwarves clog the streets and alleyways of the subterranean metropolis, hauling metal and rock, barking at one another. This sprawling city of stone holds aloft the immense weight of the mountain above.

刚踏入庄园宅邸的门口，你便站在一段宽阔楼梯的起点。楼梯向上延伸至一处开阔的楼台，四周陈列着十余幅镀金画框的古董油画。由此处再往上，两道巨大的螺旋楼梯如分岔的巨蛇般伸向庄园的上层房间与环廊。扶栏以深沉华贵的木材制成，在墙边长明的壁灯映照下泛出幽亮光泽；大厅穹顶下，一盏硕大的枝形吊灯以粗重铁链牢牢系住，垂落其间，将光影铺满整个空间。
Just inside the entrance to the manor house, you find yourself at the foot of a wide flight of stairs, which leads up to an expansive landing decorated with a dozen gilt-framed antique paintings. From there, two massive helical staircases branch out to the upper rooms and balconies of the manor. The rich, dark wood of the balustrade is highlighted by the lighted lamps along the walls, as well as the enormous chandelier bound by thick chains to the ceiling of the hall.

这块铁器在你掌心里轻若羽毛，你的指尖沿着每一道凹槽与弯折缓缓描过。它上面没有任何徽记或符号，金属却闪耀如同刚刚锻造。此钥将会寻得何处的锁孔，唯有时代能作答。
The piece of ironwork sits as light as a feather in your hand as your fingertips trace each groove and bend. It is bereft of insignia or symbols, and the metal shines as if newly wrought. Where this key will find its lock, only time will tell.

Elf’s Comradery.name:
精灵的战友情谊
Elf’s Comradery

Text.text:
“当你活得像我一样久，时代，以及被它束缚的人们，都会变成转瞬即逝的新奇玩意儿。可我与你们相处得越久，就越发现自己在追逐时代——想要攥紧我们共同经历的每一个细微瞬间。因为一旦它们消逝，我害怕自己再也找不到如此纤细而美丽的事物。”
“When you’ve lived as long as I have, time and the people bound to it become a passing novelty. Yet the longer I spend with all of you, the more I find myself grasping at time. Trying to hold on to each tiny moment we’ve shared. Because once they’re gone, I fear I will never find such delicate and beautiful things again.”

Cold-blooded Witch Curses A Home.name:
冷血女巫诅咒一户人家
Cold-blooded Witch Curses A Home

Text.text:
一名身着黑裙、披着兜帽斗篷的女子自风雪夜色中现身，朝那座铺着石板的建筑走去。她的身影有一半沉在阴影里。尽管一头白得刺目的长发，她却显得年轻而美丽：五官纤秀，肌肤光滑无瑕。可当她靠近一扇被炉火映得金灿灿的窗，另一半也随之暴露——半边脸皱起鳞片般的褶纹，锋利的牙齿从唇间森然探出。她凑近窗棂窥视，满眼恶意落在屋内熟睡的婴儿身上。她抬起手，仿佛要抚摸那孩子的脸影；可当指尖轻轻触上玻璃，白色霜纹便从她掌下噼啪迸裂蔓延。寒霜迅速吞没窗面，将整间屋子裹进一层刺骨的冰冷帷幕。
A woman in a black dress and hooded cloak emerges from the snowy night and approaches the stone-flagged building. Half of her form is cast in shadow. Despite her stark-white hair, she appears youthful and beautiful. Her features are delicate, her skin smooth and faultless. However, as she nears a window glowing golden with firelight, the other half of her is revealed. One side of her face is corrugated in scales, and sharp teeth protrude from between her lips. She peers into the window, eyes full of malice as they fall upon the infant sleeping within. She lifts her hand as if to caress the face of the image of the child, but when she gently places her fingertips on the windowpane, white lines of frost crackle out from her hand. The frost overtakes the glass, obscuring the entire room in a frigid veil.

Treasure Chest With Poison Needle Trap.name:
带毒针陷阱的宝藏箱
Treasure Chest With Poison Needle Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 这只箱子看起来平平无奇，由简陋的木板拼制，外以铁箍加固。木材显露出它的年代，发灰发旧，接触时还有些脆硬。你谨慎地向前触及，想掀开箱盖，却在刹那间猛然停住——后颈寒毛倒竖。你胃里一阵发紧的恐慌攥住了你，因为你看见了什么——就在箱锁左侧，有一抹干涸的血迹。

[触发] 一声嗡鸣般的咔哒轻响，你的思绪飞快转动，才来得及捕捉到掌心被刺穿的骤然剧痛。暗藏的针头几乎与刺出同样迅疾地“啪”一声回缩，只留下你手掌淌血。你痛苦地龇牙，突如其来的疲惫席卷而来。视野开始发飘。

[Perceived] The chest appears mundane, crafted of simple wooden planks and banded with iron. The wood shows its age, graying and somewhat brittle to the touch. You reach cautiously forward to lift the lid, but stop suddenly as the hairs on the back of your neck stand on end. Panic grips your gut as you notice something—dried blood just to the left of the chest’s lock.

[Triggered] There’s a whirring click, and your mind races to process the sudden pain that lances through the palm of your hand. As quickly as the hidden needle stabbed outward, it retracts with a snap, leaving your hand bloody. You grimace, and an abrupt fatigue overtakes you. Your vision begins to swim.

Brass Dragonfolk Fighting Dire Bear.name:
黄铜龙裔鏖战恐熊
Brass Dragonfolk Fighting Dire Bear

Text.text:
你还未看见战斗，便已先听见：钢铁铿锵，命令短促，濒死者的惨叫。一队龙裔披着斑驳的黄铜绿鳞，正与一头魁梧的凶暴巨熊对峙；他们攥紧长矛与盾牌，绕着猛兽缓缓游走。巨熊已夺走两条性命——尸身在死后化作石像，像倾倒的雕塑般在战场上崩裂风化。其间一名龙裔贴近，窥见破绽，长矛猛然送出，从野兽肋骨间贯入。巨熊怒吼如雷，挥起匕首般的利爪横扫；那龙裔徒劳举盾，仍被一爪掀飞，横穿战场，最终撞上树干当场毙命，瞬间化为岩石与尘土，向四面八方迸散。余下的龙裔交换着不安的目光，收紧阵型。

~ Envisioned by The1WiTheGun

You hear the battle before you see it: clamoring steel, barked orders, the screams of the dying. A troop of dragonfolk with mottled, brassy-green scales stand off against a hulking dire bear, clutching their spears and shields as they circle the beast. The bear has already claimed two victims, now turned to stone in death and crumbling upon the battlefield like toppled statues. One dragonfolk draws close, sees an opening, and strikes home with their spear, piercing between the beast’s ribs. It roars with fury and swipes with daggerlike claws, catching the dragonfolk as they try in futility to bring up their shield, only to hurtle across the battlefield and meet their end against the trunk of a tree, instantly becoming rock and dust that scatter in every direction. The remaining dragonfolk exchange worried glances and tighten their formation.

~ Envisioned by The1WiTheGun

Cone Of Cold Resisted.name:
寒冰锥被抵御
Cone Of Cold Resisted

Text.text:
你发现自己把一个锥形效果只丢向了一个敌手。话虽如此，那家伙看着就很难缠，斗志也依旧旺盛。你探手进材料袋，捻出一枚小小的水晶，随即开始一连串手势，最后定格在一只手旋腕成圈的疾旋，同时吐出咒言。被魔力冻结的寒气自你掌间喷薄而出，正中你的目标；他嘶吼着，顶着锥形寒流向你冲锋，浑身披霜。
You find yourself casting a cone effect on just one adversary. Granted, a tough-looking one, and still full of fight. You go to your component pouch and grab a small crystal, start the sequence of gestures that end in one hand whirling in a circle, and speak the words. Magically frozen air sprays outward from your hands and hits your target, who shouts and charges at you through the cone, rimed with frost.

I Cast Hold Person Using A Divine Focus.name:
我用一件神圣法器物品施放了“人类定身术”
I Cast Hold Person Using A Divine Focus Item

Text.text:
我以迅捷的祈祷唤起与神祇的联结，通过我的神圣法器引出法术的能量，感到魔力在体内层层聚聚、渐渐升腾。我张开手掌指向我的目标，随即猛然攥拳——以令人动弹不得的束缚之力将其禁锢。
Calling upon my connection to the gods with a swift prayer, I summon the spell’s energy through my divine focus and feel magical energy building within me. I gesture toward my target with an open palm, before clenching my fist—to bind them in immobilizing force.

Comradery In Filth.name:
污秽中的战友情谊
Comradery In Filth

Text.text:
“你满身污垢，你臭不可闻，你卑劣不堪——而我爱你。”
“You are dirty, you stink, you are vile—and I love you.”

Aeris The Dwarf.name:
矮人艾瑞斯
Aeris The Dwarf

Text.text:
他背着一只巨大的龟壳般背包，顶上横卧着一根看上去像攻城撞槌的重物；让这名矮人不至于一头栽倒的，仿佛只能是神祇的眷顾或某种魔法。然而他稳如山岳，步步踏实，节奏从容。身上尽是老练游侠的痕迹：脏金色头发，乱蓬蓬的连鬓胡子里夹着叶屑。晒得黝黄、布满风纹的脸，写满了长期曝晒于烈日之下的时光。他腰侧挂着一枚盘起的抓钩，一条魁梧的獒犬凑近嗅闻，顽皮地轻咬两下。你先听见金属铰链吱呀作响，接着看见一只机械鸟落在撞槌上，又给这矮人的背多添了一重负担。它的鸣叫带着电流般的噼啪杂音，镜孔般的双眼在柔和的嗡鸣里一闪一闪。

~ Played by James with

Equipped with a massive tortoise shell of a backpack and what looks to be a battering ram laid across its top, it seems an act of divinity or magic that keeps this dwarf from tipping over. But he’s steady as a mountain, each step sure and well-paced. He has the marks of a seasoned ranger, with dirty-blond hair and muttonchops that are wild and leaf-riddled. His tan, lined face suggests he’s spent plenty of time under the sun. A coiled grappling hook hangs at his hip, at which a broad mastiff sniffs and nips playfully. You hear the sound of metal hinges creaking and then see a mechanical bird land upon the battering ram, adding one more burden to this dwarf’s back. Its chirp crackles with static and its aperture eyes blink with soft whirs.

~ Played by James with

King In A Wheelchair.name:
轮椅上的国王
King In A Wheelchair

Text.text:
王座轮椅为舒适而非速度打造，金饰与绸缎层层点缀，机关运转几近无摩擦般顺滑。仆从相伴固然省力，可国王仍以结实修长的臂膀自行推行。与人握手时，他伸出手来，而非抬手向上。站着的人便俯身，或屈膝跪下；国王随即颔首，温和地抬手示意对方起身。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The chair is built for comfort rather than speed, adorned in gold and silks and its action kept nearly frictionless. Having servants is certainly a help, but the king pushes himself along with long, muscled arms. When he shakes hands, he reaches out rather than up. Someone standing bends, or kneels, and then the king nods and gently waves them up.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

毒液一进入你的身体，你立刻感到它骤然而凶狠的效力。疼痛从伤口向外扩散，钝重而炽烈，像火在血肉里灼烧，沿着四肢一路窜上头颅，最终直逼心脏。你的心跳骤然加速，把毒液泵送到全身，成了这毒物残酷行径的不幸帮凶。你踉跄着后退，双腿发软，膝盖一折几乎跪倒。你试着攥紧拳头，却发现手掌、指尖都使不上力。汗水从皮肤表面渗出，发热般的寒意却覆上全身。
As soon as the venom enters your body, you feel its sudden and severe effects. Pain radiates outward from the wound, dull and fiery, burning its way through your limbs, to your head, and then your heart. Your heartbeat races as it pumps the venom through your body, an unfortunate accomplice to the poison’s grisly work. You stagger, stumbling backward as your legs weaken and knees buckle. You try to make a fist and find you lack the strength in your hands, in your fingers. Sweat comes to the surface of your skin as a feverish chill comes over you.

Adult Silver Dragon Encounter.name:
成年银龙遭遇
Adult Silver Dragon Encounter

Text.text:
一名赤裸的精灵身影从被浮冰堵塞的湖中爬出——纤细的手指梳理着她银白的长发——对零下的严寒浑然不觉。细微声响乍起，她猛然抬头，身影倏然一晃：瞬间蜕变为一头巨龙，银鳞辉煌夺目，高贵的冠脊怒张，钴蓝色的眼眸牢牢钉在你身上。
A naked elven figure climbs from the frigid water of an ice-clogged lake—combing her silvery locks with slender fingers—oblivious to the sub-zero temperatures. At a slight noise, her head snaps up and she blurs: metamorphosing into a vast dragon, silver scales resplendent, noble crest rampant, and cobalt eyes fixed on you.

一只闪耀的玻璃罩内，红天鹅绒枕上安放着一支野兽之角，其年代与来历皆令人无法参透。它甚至比发现它的那古老文明还要更为久远；这支角几乎贯穿了世界历史的大半——也许，还不止于此。
Nestled on a red velvet pillow within a shining glass dome is a beast’s horn of incomprehensible age and provenance. Older than even the venerable civilization which discovered it, this horn has existed for most of the world’s history—and perhaps beyond.

你一踏进屋，鼻尖先被一股让人想起河水与淤泥的气味迎住；紧接着，皮肤又被一座巨大的砖窑散出的干燥热浪刺得发麻，它的烟囱一路穿过天花板向上延伸。门边的架子上陈列着陶匠的作品：一摞摞厚实的盘子与碗、各式炊具、陶罐、水壶、长嘴壶与杯子。大多数只是朴素好看又经用，但也有几件别出心裁，线条俏皮，色彩惊艳夺目。
A scent that reminds you of rivers and mud greets your nose as you step inside, while your skin prickles with the dry heat coming from a massive brick kiln with a chimney that runs up through the ceiling. The potter’s work stands on shelves near the door: stacks of thick plates and bowls, cookware, jugs, pitchers, and mugs. Most are simply pretty and functional, but a few show a creative flair with delightful twists and stunning colors.

Goddess Of Darkness.name:
黑暗女神
Goddess Of Darkness

Text.text:
一切都没有改变，改变的只有你感知万物的方式。她并非抵达，更像是在召唤你。就在你心脏漏跳的那一拍里，你与她独处——彻底的独处，却又同在一处。随即，所有存在才追赶上来，缓慢渗入，归位在你周围。可就在那一瞬间，你看见了她如她自知的模样：万物与世界之母——早于一切而存在，也将活着见证一切终结之人。正如每一道光都诞生于黑暗，它也将死于黑暗。她又怎能不是如此——如群星般美丽、遥远、冷漠？
Nothing changes except for how you perceive everything. She does not arrive so much as summon you. And for a beat that your heart misses, you are alone with her—so utterly alone, together. Then all existence catches up and leaks slowly into place around you. But for that instant you saw her as she knows herself: the mother to all life and the world—she who existed before all and who will live to see all end. Just as every light is born in darkness, it dies in darkness. How could she be anything other than this, as beautiful and as distant and uncaring as the stars?

Stairs Carved Into The Mountain Path.name:
凿刻进山道的石阶
Stairs Carved Into The Mountain Path

Text.text:
沿着山路向上跋涉因灰色岩石中凿出的石阶而稍稍轻松了些。原本几乎无法攀越的陡坡，如今被改造成一段尚算平缓的上行。看来在你之前也有许多人受益于这份便利——每一级台阶的踏面都被反复踩踏磨得发亮。
The trek up the mountain path is made slightly easier by a staircase carved into the gray stone. What would have been an unscalable slope has been turned into a reasonable ascent. It seems many before have appreciated this convenience as well—the surface of each step is worn from repeated use.

Warning About A Maze-like Dungeon.name:
关于迷宫般地城的警告
Warning About A Maze-like Dungeon

Text.text:
“此地道路万千，皆可踏上，却无一不需付出代价……有些代价，比起别的，更要从肉身上偿还。”
“There are many paths to follow in this place, but all come with a cost… some more bodily than others.”

一束苍白的日光从起雾的窗户斜射进来，照亮了空气中漂浮的尘埃微粒，像薄雾里缓缓旋转的星屑。屋内陈列的常备武器朴素却保养得当。可有些武器并未规整收好，而是松松垮垮地倚在武器架旁——这份随意与积尘一同诉说着：庄园里的人们已久享太平。几支长矛紧密地卡在向阳墙边的武器架上，一旁有带鞘的长剑与盾牌靠着架框。对面的墙则沉在阴影里：一只箭袋静静搁着，旁边是一柄战斧，以及一面绘着白蓝条纹的盾。
A beam of pale sunlight streams in through the fogged window, illuminating a haze of dust motes floating in the air. The standard array of weaponry in the room is simple but well-maintained. Some lean laxly against weapons racks instead of being put away, secure—this and the dust suggest peace has long been enjoyed by the people of the manor. A couple of spears sit snugly in a rack against a sunlit wall, a scabbarded sword and shield leaning against the frame. On the opposite wall, a quiver sits in shadow, as do a war axe and shield painted with stripes of white and blue.

这副牌组远在天边由一位巅峰匠人锻造而成，却伪装成一把暗色调的普通键盘。它比工厂标准略小一圈——轻轻松松就能藏进一只不起眼的公文包里。外壳线条柔和顺手，尚未被磕缺、也未见刮痕。要按全价买下这件美物，得省吃俭用、偷摸顺走多少东西？一辈子都未必够。但当你把这奇迹握在手中，尘土飞扬的街巷便不再是尽头，而是一道通往无穷平行世界的入口：网络。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

This deck was forged far away by an apex craftsperson, yet appears as a simple keyboard of dark hues. It’s a touch smaller than factory standard—easily concealed in a nondescript briefcase. The pleasant curves of the housing are not yet chipped or scratched. How much scrimping and thieving would it have taken to purchase this beauty full price? A lifetime. But with this marvel in hand, now dusty streets are nothing but a gateway to the infinite parallel world: the Net.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Jail Cell With Gore.name:
血腥牢房
Jail Cell With Gore

Text.text:
这间阴湿腐朽的囚室令人绝望，仿佛困在地狱里等死。墙壁被昔日囚徒的指甲一道道刮出沟痕，刻下他们临死前最后的灰暗念头。远处墙面与其下地面被苍蝇点点爬满的血肉飞溅污迹所覆盖，几条布满锈蚀、干涸血渍与碎肉的带刺铁链从上方垂落。
This wretched and dank chamber looks like a hellish place to be trapped. Its walls are scored by former prisoners’ nails, recording their last bleak thoughts before death. Spiked chains covered in rust, dried blood, and bits of flesh dangle over a fly-specked splatter of gore on the far wall and floor below.

被称为魔法中最古老也最荒诞的法术，它已从所有学院的法术书中抹除；唯有那种既无情又渴望散播死亡的法师，才会教授它。作为战斗法术，它并不实用——其构造会榨干施法者的灵魂。它臭名昭著，不仅因为它摧毁了无数目标，也因为它同样毁灭了施法者。
Called the oldest and most absurd spell in magic, erased from spell books at all the academies, it is only taught by a mage both heartless and in desire of spreading death. As a battle spell it is impractical, because in its design it is depleting to the soul of the caster, and it lives in infamy because of the casters, as well as the targets, it has destroyed.

Rumor Of A Runaway, Overheard At The Tav.name:
关于逃亡者的传闻，在酒馆里无意听见
Rumor Of A Runaway, Overheard At The Tavern

Text.text:
“领主说他的女儿失踪了。他声称是本地盗贼公会干的——可我听说，她是跟那公会的首领私奔了，就是人称‘影步’的那位。”
“The lord says his daughter’s gone missing. He claims it was the local thieves’ guild that’s done it—but I hear she’s run off with the leader of that guild, the one they call Shadowstep.”

Guarded Treasure Wagon.name:
戒备森严的宝藏车队
Guarded Treasure Wagon

Text.text:
这辆结实的宝藏货车以硬化橡木厚板打造，外覆铁箍加固，在珍贵货物的重压下吱呀作响。它由一队强健的战马拖曳，冷眼如铁的守卫严阵以待，随时向任何妄图打断他们旅程的人降下死亡。
Built of hardened oak planks and reinforced with bands of iron, the stout treasure wagon creaks under the weight of its precious cargo. It is pulled by a team of doughty horses and watched over by steely-eyed guards ready to deal out death to those who would seek to interrupt their journey.

Lelliana, Disciple Of Light.name:
莱莉安娜，光之门徒
Lelliana, Disciple Of Light

Text.text:
从她金发间夹杂的几缕年代灰白、以及笑容边缘细密的笑纹来看，这位女子已历经无数寒冬。她身着板甲，外覆一袭飘垂的罩袍，肩头披着天蓝色斗篷。腰侧悬着一柄发光的钉头锤，低低嗡鸣，鼓荡着魔法之力。背上斜挎着一面巨盾，盾心镶着一颗幽辉流转的红色宝石。不知缘由，她周身自有一层气场——投射出沉静、力量与蓬勃的生机。

~ 由 Alex Gray 扮演

This woman has seen her fair share of winters, judging from the grey streaks of age lining her golden hair and the laugh lines crinkling about her smile. She wears a suit of plate covered in a flowing tabard, and a sky-blue cloak is draped about her shoulders. At her hip hangs a glowing mace, thrumming with magical power. Across her back is slung a mighty shield with a luminescent red gemstone at its center. Though it isn’t clear how or why, there is an aura about her—one that projects calmness, strength, and vitality.

~ Played by Alex Gray

I'raithya Storm.name:
艾莱希娅·风暴
I'raithya Storm

Text.text:
女人在人群中格外醒目，惊艳的外貌仿佛磁石般牵引目光。她明显的半精灵族裔将纤细的精灵五官与人类运动员般的肌肉线条杂糅成一副奇异而和谐的轮廓。她的神情与举止处处透出圣武士的虔诚气质，对自身能力充满笃定的自信。她的肌肤苍白得近乎雪色，与那如暴风般炽烈的红发形成鲜明对比；红发翻涌成浪，沿着背脊倾泻而下。拱起的眉下，一双湛蓝的眼睛锐利而狡黠地闪烁，唇角却又随时像要绽开笑意。浅淡的疤痕在她脸上与刻满符文的板甲上游走跳跃。她的髋侧佩着一对长剑，弯曲的剑刃脉动着银色的幽辉。她修长的手指从不远离剑柄。

~ Played by Thya with

The woman stands out in the crowd, her striking appearance a lodestone. Obvious half-elven ancestry paints an eclectic mix of delicate elfin features, painted with the musculature of a human athlete. Her demeanor and manner reflect her paladin devotion, full of confidence in her own ability. Her skin is pallid, almost white, in stark contrast with the tempestuous red hair which flows in waves down her back. Beneath arched brows, her piercing blue eyes flash sharp and mischievous, though her lips seem quick to smile. Faint scars dance across her face and rune-etched plate. Sheathed at her hips are twin swords, their curved blades pulsing with silvery luminescence. Her slender fingers are never far from the hilts.

~ Played by Thya with

Gnomish Elder's Manor.name:
侏儒长老庄园
Gnomish Elder's Manor

Text.text:
你弯腰从齐胸高的门楣下钻过，跟随你那位光彩照人、身形娇小的女主人踏入她庄严的宅邸——眼前景象令你屏息。宅邸外观高耸巍然，威压而肃穆；而内里却装饰奢华，暖意融融，令人不由得放松。你沿着铺满柔软花纹地毯的雅致长廊前行，新出炉面包的香气与花朵的甜芬交织缭绕。壁灯里的烛火含蓄摇曳，墙上悬挂的画作中，身着古旧服饰、面带笑意的侏儒们以无畏的好奇目光注视着你。

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Ducking under the chest-high lintel of the doorframe, you follow your glamorous, diminutive host into her stately home—and it takes your breath away. From the outside, the towering edifice of the mansion is imposing and austere, but the interior is lavishly decorated, warm and inviting. The smell of freshly baked bread mingles with the sweet aroma of flowers as you walk along soft, patterned rugs lining an elegant hallway. Candles flicker demurely in sconces, and smiling gnomes in archaic dress regard you with intrepid curiosity from the paintings hanging on the walls.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Hungering Flame Blade.name:
饥渴炎刃
Hungering Flame Blade

Text.text:
你的战斗意志被点燃，一圈绚丽的灵光沿着你的武器刃缘倏然苏醒。你挥击之际，灼热的火舌舔上敌手，将他们品尝、吞噬，幽幽的橄榄石之焰如鬼魅花冠缠绕其身。饥饿仍未满足，魔法火焰乘风跃起，追逐最近的下一个目标，投以灼烧的拥抱。

~ 构想 by paradigmblue

Ignited by your fighting spirit, a colorful aura springs to life along the edge of your weapon. Fiery tongues lap at your foe as you strike, tasting and consuming them in a ghostly wreath of peridot fire. Their hunger not yet satisfied, the magical flames leap on the wind, seeking the next closest target for their burning embrace.

~ Envisioned by paradigmblue

Abyssal Gateway Opened By Alkilith.name:
由阿基利斯开启的深渊之门
Abyssal Gateway Opened By Alkilith

Text.text:
这扇窗的腐朽窗框裹满了油腻的绿污，一层闪烁的帷幕在其中扭曲现实，窗外的土地如海市蜃楼般变幻不定。随着幻象愈发令人不安，窗中映出的景象化作凡人难以理解的畸变大地，恶魔终于显形。窗框四周裂开数只鼓胀的猩红眼球——每一只都盛满了恶意的狂喜。
The decaying frame of this window is swathed in oily green matter, and a shimmering veil warps reality within it, the lands beyond shifting like a mirage. As the visions grow more unsettling, and the window offers scenes of a landscape twisted beyond mortal comprehension, the demon reveals itself. Several bulbous red eyes open around the frame—each one filled with malevolent glee.

I Frighten With My Pipes Of Haunting.name:
我用鬼魅哀管施加恐惧
I Frighten With My Pipes Of Haunting

Text.text:
我知道那些指法的组合，能带我潜入心与思最阴暗的角落——无人愿被带去之地。魔鬼的音程，绝望坠落的黑键——低音像喘息般的威胁被按下。我以忧惧、退缩，甚至刺耳的恐慌之乐，召来这可怖的世界。
I know the finger combinations that let me go to places in the heart and mind where no one wants to be taken. The devil’s interval, the black keys of hopeless falling—the low notes are played like a panting threat. I conjure this horrible world through the music of worry, retreat, even shrieking panic.

Call To Arms: Spellcasters In Battle.name:
战斗号召：施法者临阵
Call To Arms: Spellcasters In Battle

Text.text:
在你看见那抹色彩的闪光、或听见奥术噼啪炸裂之前，空气已先掠过一阵战栗。有人将一道法术横掷进混战之中；从那些被吼出的音节里判断，更多还在路上。战斗中施法或许司空见惯，但它掀起的混乱从来谈不上寻常。
You feel a frisson in the air before you see the flash of color or hear the arcane crackle. Someone slung a spell across the fray, and from the sound of shouted syllables, more are on the way. Spellcasting amid battle might be common, but there’s nothing routine about the chaos it creates.

外头那块彩绘招牌上画着一柄弯折的剑——这种事并不常见，却很适合作为店主营生的象征。店里四下堆着各式各样等待修复的破损物件：无头的斧柄、凹陷的护甲、断裂的相框，还有更多。看起来，这里掌柜的人痴迷于让万物重归可用、再度运转。
The painted sign outside showed a bent sword—an unlikely occurrence, but a good symbol for the work of the proprietor. All about the shop stand various broken objects in need of repair: hafts without heads, dented armor, broken picture frames, and much more. It seems the person who runs this place is obsessed with returning things to working order.

那位脾气乖戾的侏儒炼金术士在桌与桌之间迅速穿梭，先探了眼咕嘟冒泡的烧杯，又瞧了瞧快要溢出的细颈瓶。他搅动坩埚里的某种东西，顺手抹去旁边洒出的液体。在满屋小玩意儿与零碎杂物之间，他的速度与专注正如你所料——只是你没料到，竟有这么多勺子到处乱丢，散得满地都是。
The crotchety gnome alchemist moves quickly from table to table, checking first on a bubbling beaker, then an overflowing vial. He stirs something in a cauldron and wipes up a nearby spill. His speed and focus among all of the gewgaws and knick-knacks is much as you expected, though you were not expecting quite so many spoons strewn all over the place.

朴实而坚固，长剑是这片土地上铁匠们赖以立身的看家本领，而这把正是工艺精湛的典范。青铜护手托起一截闪耀的钢刃，握柄以红色细绳紧紧缠绕，为这件武器添上一抹色彩与一丝接触的温度。
Simple and sturdy, the longsword is the bread and butter of smiths throughout the land and this is a fine example of its craft. The bronze cross guard holds a gleaming steel blade, and red twine binds the handle, adding a touch of color to the weapon.

你步入墓室深处，厚厚的尘埃铺成层层堆积，在崩裂风化的石砌上留下刺目的痕迹。这里唯一可见的生机，是地衣紧贴着几幅苍白的湿壁画，其上裂缝蜿蜒纵横。你能感觉到死亡的存在从四面八方压来，仿佛一座献给短暂时光的纪念碑。在这里，在骨骸碎成粉末、腐朽以十年为刻度计数的所在，连太阳都很容易被彻底遗忘。
Thick layers of dust leave stark impressions along the crumbling stonework as you descend into the burial chamber. The only life apparent here is the lichen that clings to the cracks running through several pale frescoes. Here you can sense the presence of death all around you as a monument to the temporal. Here, it is easy to forget the sun altogether, in this place where bones crumble to meal and rot counts the decades.

Loot From A Homunculus Servant.name:
傀儡仆从身上的战利品
Loot From A Homunculus Servant

Text.text:
仆役随身带着一把小巧却结实的铁钥匙，看上去是为某种精密复杂的锁量身打造。锁匠一眼就能看出那把锁的体型与价值，而这往往也暗示着被守护战利品的身价。
The servant carries a small but strong iron key that appears to be designed for an intricate lock. A locksmith would know the size and value of the lock, which would likely indicate the value of the protected loot.

I Help Slay An Air Elemental While Weari.name:
我戴着【御风元素指环】协助斩杀一只风元素
I Help Slay An Air Elemental While Wearing My Ring Of Air Elemental Command

Text.text:
我拉近与元素之间的距离。它将那诡异的巨口朝我张开时，我咬紧牙关。“退散！”我用它那原初的语言喝道，随即倾尽全力劈下，戒指的力量如利刃般切开它的防御。生物在哀恸的尖啸中溃散成雾，异界之力涌入我的戒指。我感觉双脚离地，皮肤开始噼啪作响，电光在裂纹间窜动。
I close the gap between the elemental and myself. As it turns its eldritch gape toward me, I grit my teeth. “Begone!” I say in its primordial tongue, and I strike with all my might, the power of the ring cutting through its defenses. As the creature dissipates with a mournful wail, extraplanar power surges into my ring. I feel my feet lift off the ground as my skin begins to crackle with electricity.

这头体型庞大、覆满鳞甲的爬行生物以四条粗壮的腿支撑身躯。头顶生着一圈骨质冠冕，末端尖刺森然；额头与鼻梁处又探出弯曲的角。它锐利的目光在地形间游移，警惕捕食者的踪影，同时低头啃食近旁的植被。移动时，尾巴稳稳撑住它沉甸甸的躯体。
The massive, scaled reptile stands on four stout legs. A crown of bone crests its head, tipped with spikes, and from its forehead and nose, curved horns emerge. Its keen gaze roams the landscape, on the lookout for predators as it dips its head into the nearby vegetation. Its tail steadies its considerable weight as it moves.

Goblin Patrol In The Forest.name:
森林中的地精巡逻队
Goblin Patrol In The Forest

Text.text:
地精们身披柔韧的皮甲，手握阴狠的短刃与短弓，在灌木与低枝间迅疾而无声地穿行。他们一言不发，取而代之的是一套简洁而隐秘的手势暗语，用来协调彼此的行动。随着他们逼近目标，两名地精攀上树干以获得更好的视野，各自搭上一支箭，蓄势待发……
The goblins, garbed in supple leather and wielding wicked blades and shortbows, move through the underbrush quickly and quietly. They do not speak. Instead, they communicate with a simple, subtle series of hand gestures, to coordinate their movements. As they near their objective, a pair of goblins scale trees to gain a better vantage, and each nocks and arrow in preparation . . .

Interplanetary Bazaar With Diverse Offer.name:
星际集市，万象云集
Interplanetary Bazaar With Diverse Offerings

Text.text:
集市那一条条色彩斑斓的小巷里，琳琅摊位如繁星铺陈，任何心之所向都能觅得。来自银河各个角落的商贩摩肩接踵，吆喝兜售各自的货品，而在这套市井规矩里，彼此尊重至关重要。奇异的景象、声响与气味撩拨着感官，勾勒出充满可能与冒险的遥远异域幻景。
Anything one’s heart desires can be found in the colorful lanes of the bazaar’s myriad stalls. Vendors from every corner of the galaxy rub shoulders as they tout their wares, and mutual respect is paramount in the market code. Exotic sights, sounds, and smells tantalize the senses, conjuring visions of distant lands rife with possibility and adventure.

Pursuant Lieutenant Ambrosius Graaf.name:
追缉中尉安布罗修斯·格拉夫
Pursuant Lieutenant Ambrosius Graaf

Text.text: 他身上的长袍朴素粗织，却在边缘以昂贵的银线绣出繁复纹样。他手持宝珠与法杖，活像学院里的教授。他头发浓密，修得很短，雪白如同那把浓须与卷翘的胡子。他胸前佩着圣怨会的邪教徽章——Hierospite的圣怨会坠饰——同时还挂着一枚素朴的木制护身符，上面是学院纹章，却被涂上一道鲜红的X。 The robe he wears is simple and rough-spun but bordered in designs of pricey silver thread. He carries an orb and staff, as if he were a professor at the academy. His hair is thick, cut short, and white like his full beard and curled mustache. He wears the cult medallion of the Hierospite, along with a plain wooden amulet of the academy crest with a red X painted over it.

Mass Cure Wounds.name:
群体治疗伤口
Mass Cure Wounds

Text.text:
你完成咒文的刹那，声音如雷霆般轰鸣，一股脉动着的清凉能量自你体内迸发，向外扩散成浪。奥术之力拂过受伤者，缝合裂口，糅合血肉。随即，那股能量消散于空气之中。
Your voice booms as you complete the incantation, and a wave of pulsating, cooling energy emits outward from you in a wave. The arcane power washes over the injured, stitching wounds and fusing flesh. The energy then dissipates into the air.

Boots Of Levitation.name:
漂浮之靴
Boots Of Levitation

Text.text:
这双靴子乍看平平无奇。棕色皮革柔软而磨得发亮，黄铜扣环略显黯淡、带着岁月的锈痕。然而，每只靴子的鞋底都刻着一枚羽翼，纤羽分明，仿佛随时会振翅。你一接触靴子，骤然风起，几乎听不见的低鸣仿佛从靴子自身缓缓渗出。
The boots, at first glance, appear mundane. The brown leather is supple and well-worn, the brass buckles slightly tarnished. But etched into the sole of each boot is a single, feathered wing. When you touch the boots, a sudden wind kicks up, and an almost inaudible hum seems to emanate from the boots themselves.

虫鸣的嗡响迎面而来。酷热与潮湿主宰着你的感官，富含矿物的泥腥气与葱郁草木的清香交织在一起。藤蔓垂挂头顶，绿意纠结成结；虬曲的根须蜿蜒穿过覆着黏滑薄水的浅洼。蜥蜴与蛇类在灌木丛下游走——狩猎、觅食。
The drone of insects greets you. The heat and humidity dominate your senses, the smell of mineral-rich mud mingling with lush greenery. Vines hang overhead, a knotwork of green, and gnarled roots wind their way through the shallow pools of slimy water. Reptiles and serpents move through the underbrush—hunting, foraging.

这座军械库曾经堆满保养得当的武备，如今却沦为废墟——究竟是刻意为之，还是疏于照料，无从得知。年代让钢铁兵刃变得脆弱，锈蚀斑驳；每一处曾经打磨得发亮的表面，如今都被暗沉的锈晕所玷污。陈旧铁腥的气味渗透建筑的每一寸空间。它曾经井然有序——而今只剩被遗弃后的凌乱与荒凉。
This armory, once filled with well-maintained armament, has fallen into ruin, whether by design or simple neglect. Age has rendered the steel weapons brittle, pitted with rust, and every polished surface is now sullied with tarnish. The scent of aged iron pervades every inch of the structure. It was once orderly—now it is struck with the disorder of abandonment.

Magical Fever In Battlefield Med-tent.name:
战地医疗帐篷中的魔法热病
Magical Fever In Battlefield Med-tent

Text.text:
冰冷的寒热攫住隔离帐篷里受伤的士兵，鼓胀的帆布上覆着一层薄薄霜衣，像苔藓攀附墓碑般紧紧黏着。帐内不祥地死寂，唯有医者轻轻的脚步在病榻间穿梭，他们逐一审视每个病例。哀恸的风在营地上空嚎叫着宣判厄运，而众多伤亡者中的一人，终于抽出最后一口带着颤响的气息。

~ Envisioned by Dragonfly on Discord

Icy fever grips the wounded soldiers in the isolation tent, a thin rime of frost clinging to the billowing canvas like moss to a headstone. The interior is ominously silent, save for the gentle shuffle of healers making their way between the patients as they survey each case. A mournful wind howls doom across the camp as a final rattling breath is taken by one of the many casualties.

~ Envisioned by Dragonfly on Discord

Victor Glorian.name:
维克托·格洛里安
Victor Glorian

Text.text:
蓬乱的金色卷发随他的步伐轻摆，像被曙光拂过的麦浪；高大结实的身影外沿，隐约勾勒着一圈几不可察的微光光晕，细碎如鳞地闪烁。尽管他散发着力量与优雅，却以一种怯生生的姿态蜷着肩背，像一只对同伴生疏、时刻警惕的野兽；金色的眼眸低垂，刻意避开旁人的视线。秘银鳞片覆满全身，光线掠过时泛起耀目的波纹——更衬出其璀璨——而他背后背着一面朴素的木盾，风化的木板上除了一道用白色涂抹的古怪符号外，再无任何装饰。

~ Played by a Hero with

Tousled golden locks sway like dawn-touched wheat as the cleric moves, his tall, muscular figure outlined in an imperceptible halo of shimmering light. Though he exudes power and grace, he carries himself with the timid posture of a wary animal thoroughly unused to company, and his golden eyes are downcast to avoid the gaze of others. Mithral scales cover him, shimmering in a dazzling wave as the light plays across them—emphasizing their brilliance—and at his back rests a simple wooden shield, devoid of any embellishment save for a curious symbol daubed in white across the weathered planks.

~ Played by a Hero with

Create Undead.name:
创造不死生物
Create Undead

Text.text:
你已备齐一切——坟土、咸涩的浑水、玛瑙石——如今法术终告完成。当你低声吐出最后一个词，它自唇间逸出，宛如垂死之人最后一缕气息，一股非自然的寒意霎时攫住你；诡异的幽光自你身上蔓延开去，流向你面前陈列的尸体。尸体缓缓起身，却不再是它们原本的模样，而是如你所意：在魔法驱动下被唤起，俯首听命于你。
You have gathered the necessities—the grave dirt, the brackish water, the onyx stones—and now the spell is complete. As the whisper the last word leaves you, like the last breath of a dying man, an unnatural chill overtakes you, and a strange, ghostly light spreads from you to the corpses laid before you. The corpses rise, not as they were, but as you will them: animated by magic, and subservient to you.

I Cast Contact Other Plane.name:
我施放了【异界联络】
I Cast Contact Other Plane

Text.text:
接下来的一分钟危机四伏，赌上的甚至是我的神智。我必须吟诵的，是一段由诡异旋律编织而成的咒文，多音节的词句间，穿插着源自异界的声响。当我几乎觉得自己的心智就要崩裂时，那存在现身了——与我一样真实可触。掌握我所需知识的守秘者只吐出一个字：“问。”而我得到的回答，也几乎同样短促。
The next minute is a dangerous one, a risk of my very sanity. What I must chant is a composition of strange melodies, words of many syllables, punctuated with sounds native to another dimension. When it seems my mind could break, the being appears. As physical as I am, the keeper of the knowledge I require says one word: “Ask.” The answers to my questions are nearly as short.

此处安放的石棺似乎献给一位名为“梅茜”的人。其铭文写道：为梅茜祈祷。神祇在她生前并未善待她。祈祷或许能让她的来世更好过些。 The sarcophagus that lies here seems to be dedicated to someone named Mercy. Its inscription reads: Pray for Mercy. The gods were not kind to her in life. Prayers might make her afterlife easier.

Deserted House: Watching Crows.name:
废屋：鸦群窥视
Deserted House: Watching Crows

Text.text:
寒鸦在远处啼叫，光线染上一抹诡异的色泽。阴云密布的天空仿佛正将一层裹尸布缓缓拉过大地，迫使白昼过早谢幕。你身后，那座废弃的房子阴影森然地耸立着，冷峻而肃穆，宛如一块墓碑。
Rooks call in the distance as the light takes on a strange hue. The overcast sky seems to be drawing a shroud over the landscape, bringing the day to a premature end. Behind you the deserted house looms, as stark and solemn as a headstone.

Loot From A Lemure.name:
从劣魔身上搜刮的战利品
Loot From A Lemure

Text.text:
只要你搬得动，这里就有价值好几枚金币的异域油脂。其间堆着一座金字塔状的怪异粉尘；炼金术士愿意再多掏几枚金币把它买走。
If you can haul it, you have several gold pieces’ worth of exotic fat here. In the midst of it is a pyramidal pile of strange dust; an alchemist would be willing to part with a few more gold pieces for this.

I Cast Earth Elemental Planar Ally.name:
我召唤土元素位面盟友
I Cast Earth Elemental Planar Ally

Text.text:
我将双拳狠狠砸向大地。地面随我的法术一震，发出低沉的颤鸣。方正的砂岩块从土里缓缓抬升，彼此摩擦碰撞，震得我浑身骨头都在发响。每一块石头上都绘着一个符号，浓郁深沉的赭褐色在石面上如凝固的阴影。高耸的花岗岩碎片充作门扉，伴着刺耳的碾磨与沉重的闷响，它猛然向前倒下，一名土元素拖着沉步穿过——那是由不断错动的巨岩碎块拼成的生物，砂粒从充当双眼与口的裂缝里簌簌漏出。它对我开口，嗓音如闷雷滚动，震颤一路传到我的脚底。
I slam my fists down onto the earth. It shudders as my spell works. Square sandstones begin to rise from the ground, jostling every bone in my body. Each of the stones are marked with a symbol painted in richly dark umber. A tall shard of granite serves as the door, and with a grind and a thud, it falls forward and an earth elemental trudges through—a creature made of shifting chunks of boulder, sand dribbling out of the cracks that serve as its eyes and mouth. It speaks to me, its voice a rumble that vibrates down to my feet.

Sewer: Bubbling Junction.name:
下水道：咕嘟翻涌的交汇口
Sewer: Bubbling Junction

Text.text:
这处下水道隧道的交汇点中央，立着一座令人作呕的污秽喷泉。污水从浑浊的表面咕嘟翻涌，不时猛地迸射出一阵阵无常的飞溅，仿佛被某种看不见的力量从下方顶起——这股涌流必然源自其他隧道或灌满粪水的管道里更强的压力。你想到这里，强迫自己不去理会那股随之涌入脑海的溺毙幻象。
This junction of the sewer tunnels holds a disgusting fountain of effluence. It bubbles and spurts up from the surface in inconstant splashes, pushed up from below by unseen forces—the flow must be driven by greater pressures in other tunnels or pipes filled with sewage. As you consider that thought, you try to ignore the visions of drowning it puts in your head.

雷霆如鞭在头顶炸裂。电光一闪，云层被撕开一道缺口，长翼骏马踏空奔出，身躯亮若日芒，蹄跟与鬃毛被烈焰舔舐。它们的铁蹄在稀薄的空中翻腾起落，疾速牵引一辆珍珠车辇。车轮飞旋迸火，向天际洒出星尘。驾车者是一名天使，头戴翼盔，发丝在狂风中乱舞。
Thunder cracks like a whip overhead. In a flash of light a gap is torn open in the clouds and winged horses trample through, bodies bright as sunbeams, heels and manes licked with flame. Hooves bounding across the thin air, they swiftly draw a carriage of pearl. Its wheels spin and spark, spraying stardust into the sky. The driver is an angel wearing a winged helm, hair whipping wild in the wind.

I Activate My Ioun Stone Of Sustenance.name:
我激活了我的【维生艾恩石】
I Activate My Ioun Stone Of Sustenance

Text.text:
宝石的纯净——一枚朴素澄澈的玻璃纺锤——与它的力量正相称。它绕着我盘旋时，我仿佛刚享用过一顿丰盛的餐食。我的身体不再感到口渴。我对食物与饮品的欲望变得无关紧要，因为我已不再需要它们。只要这枚纺锤仍在空中循着轨迹飞行，我的生存所需便降低两级。
The purity of the stone, a simple and clear glass spindle, is right for its power. As it circles me I feel as if I have just finished a good meal. My body feels no thirst. My desire for food and drink is irrelevant for I have no need for them. My necessities of life are lowered by two, as long as the spindle follows its path in the air.

Myrill Caerdonal, Agent Of Shadows.name:
米里尔·凯尔多纳尔，暗影密探
Myrill Caerdonal, Agent Of Shadows

Text.text:
高等精灵步入你身边时，几乎是本能地用鼻尖俯视着你——既是他疏离姿态的证明，也是那惊人的身高所致。他略低于七英尺，堪称你见过、甚至听过的最高精灵；而那修长瘦削的体态更将其高度衬得愈发凌厉。银发与紫眸在雪白的肌肤上相互映衬，那肤色苍白得几乎谈不上不透明，只在颈侧留着一道褪色的伤痕——像是三道利爪曾经划过。腰间匕首上缠着阴影，仿佛活物般不肯散去。他那件深色皮护甲背心在腹部以三根象牙色的角扣束紧；颈间一条银链垂着三枚龙牙项坠，随着呼吸轻轻摇晃。
The high elf cannot help but look down his nose at you as he enters your vicinity, a tribute to both his aloof manner as well as his considerable height. At just a shade under seven feet tall, he is the tallest elf you have ever seen or even heard of—accentuated all the more by his lean build. His silver hair and violet eyes perfectly set off his alabaster skin, so pale that it barely qualifies as opaque, marred only by a faded scar three claws have left along the side of his neck. Shadows cling to the dagger at his belt as if they were a living thing. The vest of his dark leather armor is bound by three ivory horns along the belly, and a necklace sporting three dragon’s teeth dangles from a silver chain around his neck.

一个球形团块漂浮在空间中缓缓漂移。碎片、小行星或其他太空垃圾如影随形，仿佛一条大白鲨身旁跟着一群吸盘鱼。它苍白、布满坑洼的表面让它看起来像一轮月亮——一轮全新而陌生的月亮，如今正环绕着这颗行星运行。

~ 由 Doriana M. 构想

A spherical mass drifts through space. Debris, small asteroids or other bits of space junk trail along with it, like a great white shark accompanied by remora. Its pale, pockmarked surface lends it the semblance of a moon—a new and unfamiliar moon now orbiting the planet.

~ Envisioned by Doriana M.

Exobiologist Animal Wrangler.name:
异星生物学家／驯兽师
Exobiologist Animal Wrangler

Text.text: 生物学家对着自己看管的奇异生物柔声哄慰，仿佛它们是心爱的宠物般亲昵；她从卡其色马甲的一个口袋里摸出某种零嘴。那些生物兴奋得浑身颤动，蜂拥成群挤到科学家身边，迫不及待想要吃上一口。驯兽师严厉地抬起一只手，兽群立刻整齐划一地坐下，伴随着一声咚的闷响。女人满足地笑着，将几块零食抛向空中——霎时引爆混乱，群兽纷纷扑跃争抢那些美味的小块。 The biologist coos over the strange creatures in her charge as if they are beloved pets, and retrieves some sort of treat from one of the pouches on her khaki vest. The creatures vibrate with excitement as they crowd the scientist in a swarm, eager to get their snack. The animal wrangler holds up a stern hand and the pack sits in unison with a thump. Smiling contently, the woman throws several treats into the air—inciting chaos among the beasts as they dive for the tasty morsels.

Sundries From A Displacer Beast.name:
来自移位兽的杂物
Sundries From A Displacer Beast

Text.text:
闪烁豹的口鼻凝固在死后的永恒狞笑中。这头野兽在战斗里被摧残得太惨，已无法剥下那身油亮的黑皮；但它的獠牙或利爪在屠戮中依旧坚韧，或许能成为凶狠的战利品。
The blink panther’s muzzle is locked in a permanent postmortem snarl. The beast was too devastated in battle to be skinned for its glossy black hide, but its fangs or claws, resilient throughout the carnage, might prove fierce trophies.

I Load The Trebuchet.name:
我装填投石机
I Load The Trebuchet

Text.text:
我从弹药堆里抬起一块巨石，它粗糙畸形的外表让人很难把它搬到投石机旁。我把石头猛地掷进发射兜时，一道锋利的棱角刮住了手掌，一线鲜血渗出，混入碎石尘砾之中——这些残屑很快就会化作轰然的粉碎，撕裂敌人的阵线。
I lift a large stone from the ammunition pile, its rough and misshapen exterior making it difficult to carry to the trebuchet. A sharp edge catches my hand as I huck the stone into the launching pouch, a small line of my blood joining the rubble that will soon shatter the enemy line.

你脚下的大地在沉重的踏步声中震颤。某种酷似长须巨熊、通体如战场烟霭般灰暗的生物从阴影里直立而出；强健的后腿与宽大蓬松的尾巴一同发力，拖着它那笨重的身躯稳步逼近。它全身每一寸都绷着条条肌理，宽阔的颚口——缀着一圈青铜色的胡须——在饥渴的期待中一张一合。它的腹部还突兀地隆起着一具骷髅般的肋笼。
The ground beneath you shakes with heavy treads. Something akin to a bearded bear the color of battlefield smoke walks upright from the shadows, powerful legs working alongside a broad, bushy tail to keep its cumbersome body moving forward. Every inch of its frame is striated with muscle, and its broad jaws—bedecked with a bronze beard—open and close with hungry anticipation. A skeletal rib cage juts out from its midriff.

Loot From A Spirit's Lair.name:
灵巢遗珍
Loot From A Spirit's Lair

Text.text:
这里的空气逼仄得令人窒息。沉重而压抑，仿佛要将你压垮在这座宅邸上空如裹尸布般垂落的无边哀恸之下。寒风骤然掠过房间——尽管没有一扇窗户敞开——吹散冰冷壁炉里堆积的灰烬，露出一个小小的、被烧焦的盒子。
The air feels too close in this place. Heavy and oppressive, it bears down on you, attempting to crush you beneath the unfathomable weight of sorrow hanging over the house like a burial shroud. A chill breeze rushes through the room—though no windows stand open—blowing aside the mound of ash in the ice-cold fireplace and revealing a small, charred box.

Performance-enhancing Drug, Spirit Stren.name:
兴奋剂，灵魄之力
Performance-enhancing Drug, Spirit Strength

Text.text:
小瓶里那撮粗粝的土粉黝黑如一团蓄满新雨的云。细小的光点在其中不时闪烁，被玻璃折扭得摇曳变形。奥术符号如同护符的结界符文般装点着这只小药瓶，层层成环，沿着瓶身全长铺展。瓶内传出一阵低沉的轰鸣，仿佛被闷住的雷声，随之结界微微发光回应。

~ 一位英雄所构想

The coarse earthen powder in the vial is dark like a cloud laden with burgeoning rain. Motes of light flicker sporadically throughout, distorted by the glass. Arcane symbols decorate the small phial like warding runes, arranged in rings spanning the bottle’s length. A low rumble, like muffled thunder, emanates from within, causing the wards to glow in response.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Para Archery Competition In Stadium.name:
体育场残奥射箭比赛
Para Archery Competition In Stadium

Text.text:
体育场内的空气因竞赛的兴奋与不确定而微微颤动。射程尽头立起一排排涂彩的稻草目标，摊贩的喧闹叫卖声——连同货物的气味——在拥挤的看台间回荡。选手们各就各位时，欢呼骤然爆发；每个人都携带着独特的辅助装置，为残障运动员铺就同等的比赛等级。他们以体育精神的默契互相致意，随即号角响起，第一支箭离弦，比赛就此展开。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The atmosphere in the stadium trembles with the excitement and uncertainty of competition. Targets of painted straw have been erected down range, and the boisterous calls of vendors—and the smell of their wares—echoes among the packed stands. A cheer erupts as the competitors take their places, each toting a unique assistive device to create a level playing field for the disabled athletes. They greet each other with the camaraderie of sportsmanship, then a horn sounds and the competition gets underway as the first arrow is loosed.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Derion's Cemetery In Summer.name:
德里昂的夏日墓园
Derion's Cemetery In Summer

Text.text:
[初次造访] 一座低丘在溪流拐弯处隆起。丘侧立着高大的兜帽雕像，手中捧着火盆，火光燃烧不息。丘顶围着一圈低矮的干砌石墙，守护着这片墓园的核心——因为低丘四周立着一圈墓碑，如同环形列阵，碑面尽数朝向丘心。

[再度造访] 近来的雨水把通往德里昂墓前的小径泡成了烂泥。你每一步都“噗叽”作响，声势几乎盖过溪水的轻笑。一阵反常的寒风掠过空地，牵引你的目光沿着丘中的台阶向上——那几尊雕像的身影在风里愈发森然。它们掌中的火焰今日显得格外低弱，正如灰天之下，你心头挥之不去的阴郁。

[First visit] A low hill rises at the bend of a stream. Tall statues of hooded figures stand on one side of it, braziers burning in their hands. A low drystone wall rims the hilltop, guarding what must be the centerpiece of this cemetery, for all around the hill stand a ring of headstones, their faces turned inward.

[Return visit] Recent rains have made the trail to Derion’s grave muddy. The sound of your feet squelching as loud as the chuckle of the stream. An unseasonably chill wind blows across the clearing, drawing your gaze up the stairs in the hill to the looming figures of the statues. The flames they hold seem low today, matching your gloomy mood beneath the gray sky.

Werewolf On Hunt.name:
猎狼追踪
Werewolf On Hunt

Text.text:
那狼形人突然伏低到四肢着地，背脊的毛发根根竖起，鼻端在夜风里一嗅——血腥、汗味、恐惧尽数涌入。洁白如新的獠牙在月光下森然一闪，野兽放声长嗥，随即以令人胆寒的速度与凶性朝猎物疾驰扑去。
The lupine humanoid drops to all fours, fur bristling along its back as it sniffs the air—smelling blood, sweat, fear. Pristine white teeth gleam in the moonlight as the beast looses a howl before loping toward its prey with unnerving speed and ferocity.

火焰欢快的声音在石头被熏得焦黑的壁龛里噼啪作响、爆出火星，唱着一支关于晚餐、安宁与睡眠的歌。壁炉台上搁着一枝芬芳的松枝，火边则用皮带悬着一段黑色的生铁。
The cheerful voice of the fire, crackling and popping in the charred black alcove of the stone, sings a song of dinner, calm, and sleep. On the mantle is an aromatic pine bough, and hanging near the fire is a length of black pig iron on a leather strap.

Deaf Barbarian.name:
失聪的野蛮人
Deaf Barbarian

Text.text:
野蛮人的肉体力量与对房间的沉静专注锋利得像刀，直刺人心。他猛拍桌面。杯盏与酒杯一阵哐啷作响，震得倾倒溅洒，他随即举起拳头。他用简洁而通用的手势向酒馆老板示意——那种常年在喧嚣中讨生活的人一眼就能懂。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The barbarian’s physical power and calm focus on the room is sharp, penetrating. He thumps the table. Cups and mugs rattle and spill, and he raises his fist. He signs to the tavernkeeper in simple, universal gestures, understandable by those used to working in constant noise.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

这里远非僧侣们所住的那种赤贫而清苦的囚室。供神职人员起居的这套房间虽谈不上奢华，却也绝不刻薄。木制书桌前摆着一把略有软垫的椅子，崭新的羽毛笔与墨水备在一旁，旁边还整齐叠放着一沓沓羊皮纸。天花板垂下一条铁链，链上悬着一盏铁篓火盆，既照明又取暖，让居住于此的教士能在相对舒适的环境里研读典籍。房内的床铺虽窄小，却铺着一条由会众亲手缝制并捐赠给神殿的被子，盖在薄薄的褥面上，足以挡住夜色里的寒意。
Far from the bare and puritanical cells kept by monks, this set of rooms for the priesthood, while not especially lavish, are far from harsh. A lightly cushioned chair sits in front of a wooden writing desk, with fresh quill and ink ready alongside sheafs of parchment. Light and heat are provided by a cresset hanging from a chain from the ceiling, allowing the residing cleric to study their texts in relative comfort. Though the bunk in the room is small, a quilt, stitched together by a member of the congregation and donated to the temple, adorns its slight duvet to keep the night’s chill at bay.

Kilvar Helcral, Co-owner Of Helcral's Di.name:
基尔瓦·赫尔克拉尔，赫尔克拉尔酒坊合伙人
Kilvar Helcral, Co-owner Of Helcral's Distillery

Text.text:
矮人男子将一串黯淡失色的银珠编进赤褐色的胡须里，粗重的铁箍紧紧套在他的无名指上。头顶同样蓬松的卷发像鬃毛般铺开，及肩的发束翻涌盘旋，宛如滚动的火焰。红润带雀斑的脸颊在一双泛着铜色光泽的眼睛下鼓起弧度，那目光里藏着碎光，每当又有客人跨过酒馆门槛，便闪得更亮几分。  

他的穿着是穷人将就凑合的模样。上衣曾经浓郁的颜色褪成陈旧巧克力般的灰褐，肩头的缝线像是急着逃离布料，毛边的线头伸出一根根“手指”，抓向空荡的空气。他身上带着麦酒与黑麦的气息——衣服与头发里都浸满了那股味道，正如他整日把酒倒进那些缺口斑驳、裂纹蔓延的石杯里一样。
The dwarven man finishes weaving a row of tarnished silver beads into his auburn beard, with a heavy iron band bound around his ring finger. The same fluffy curls mane his head, the shoulder-length locks swirling like rolling flames. Ruddy, freckled cheeks round under copper eyes full of glimmer, a gaze that twinkles brighter every time another patron walks through the tavern’s threshold. His outfit is that of a poor man making do with what he has. The tunic’s once rich color has faded to the dusty brown of old chocolate, and the seams at his shoulders seem bent on running out of the garment, the fingers of frayed thread reaching for open air. He smells of ale and rye, his clothing and hair rife with the scent of the pours he makes into chipped and cracking stone mugs all day long.

Solert University Of Magic.name:
索勒特魔法大学
Solert University Of Magic

Text.text:
一头由起泡的清水凝成的公牛横冲直撞，掠过奢华的校园花园，最终伴着一声怒吼在远处的墙上轰然炸裂，惹得在芬芳空气中灵巧穿梭的皮克西们欢欣不已。身着飘逸学袍的学生们漫步在草地上，穿行于大学十二座巍峨高塔之间，漫不经心地闲聊着课程、恋情，以及青春里那些足以吞没一切的热门话题。走进一座高塔，两名学生驻足片刻，仰望那经魔法扩展后浩瀚得近乎不可能的塔内空间。

~ 构想：Duq

A bull made of foaming water charges across the lavish campus gardens and explodes with a bellow against the far wall, much to the delight of the pixies nimbly flitting through the fragrant air. Students in flowing academic robes stroll across the grass between the twelve imposing towers of the university, idly chatting about their classes, love lives, and the other all-consuming topics of youth. Entering a tower, two students take a moment to gaze up at the impossibly vast magnitude of the tower’s magically enhanced interior.

~ Envisioned by Duq

木槌与凿子敲击木料与皮革的声响充满这间朴素的小店。各式各样、大小不一的鞋履陈列在架上——从骑乘长靴到简单的凉鞋，应有尽有。一名双手布满老茧的矮人正将靴底钉牢，透过他那副沾满污渍的眼镜片细细检查，收工时朝你露出短暂的笑意。
The sound of hammers and chisels on wood and leather fills the humble shop. Shoes of all shapes and sizes, from riding boots to simple sandals, adorn shelves. A dwarf with calloused hands hammers the sole of a boot in place, inspects it through the dirty lenses of his spectacles, and offers you a brief smile as he finishes his task.

Removal Of An Arrow.name:
拔箭
Removal Of An Arrow

Text.text:
一个蓄着浓密胡须与八字胡的男人咬紧木制口衔，痛得闭上双眼。有人按住他，在靠近肩膀的箭伤入口处施压止血。另一个人小心握住箭杆，屏息蓄力，准备将箭矢拔出。
A man with a thick beard and mustache bites down on a wooden bit, closing his eyes in pain. Someone holds him down and puts pressure on the arrow’s entry point, near his shoulder. Someone else takes careful hold of the arrow’s shaft, preparing to pull.

你凝视着彼此套扣的银环，将它们举在身前，低声吟诵咒文，令你的意识横扫一切空间。刹那间，仿佛空间不过是幻象，你的心智便与所寻之人的心智相触，发现对方欣然应允，愿与你沟通。两道精神交汇相融，以思念之速交换意念与含义。
Focusing on the silver rings looped through one another, which you hold before you, you speak the incantation that unleashes your consciousness across all space. Instantly, as if space is but an illusion, your mind meets that of the one you seek, finding a willing partner in communication. Your two psyches mingle, sharing ideas and meaning at the speed of thought.

Concert Venue, Backstage.name:
音乐会场地，后台
Concert Venue, Backstage

Text.text:
低音——沉重得足以撼动骨骼——在场馆后台的区域里有节奏地脉动，将VIP们推入一场由药物助燃的纵欲狂潮。妖艳的洋红灯光以柔和、梦幻般的明暗起伏勾勒出这幕肉欲景象，让那些在电子烟雾与香水迷雾中沉溺、神志恍惚的参与者发出忘我的欢愉。
Bass—heavy enough to shake bones—pulses rhythmically through the backstage area of the venue, driving the VIPs into a hedonistic frenzy of drug-fueled excess. Sensuous magenta light casts the carnal scene in soft, dreamlike relief, much to the rapturous delight of the addled participants awash in the haze of vape smoke and perfumes.

一颗搏动的粉红大脑晃晃悠悠地飘入视野。大脑下方吊着一具躯体，软塌而萎缩，经历了亿万年无用的退化逆行。它似乎没有脸——至少不太像。若已登临心灵感应之力的巅峰，还需要一张脸吗？四条手臂在那残余的身躯两侧微微颤动，紧握着一把方位激光手枪。一阵温热的意念波自这漂浮的生物体内震颤扩散开来。
A pulsing pink brain bobs into view. Beneath the brain dangles a body, limp and atrophied with eons of useless de-evolution. There doesn’t seem to be a face, not really. Does one need a face once you have reached the apex of telepathic power? Four arms shiver at the side of the vestigial body, clasping an azimuth laser pistol. A warm wave of thought shudders out from the floating creature.

喷泉轻快地潺潺作响，水流倾入一方池塘，池中养着金鳞闪烁的鱼儿。空气里弥漫着浓烈的气息——既诱人又令人窒息——植物以葱郁的翠绿垂覆每一处表面。房间中央立着一张桌子，左右各有一把椅子。据说，先知就在这里将目光投向未知，窥见其形。
Fountains trickle pleasantly, emptying into a pond stocked with golden-scaled fish. The air is pungent—both alluring and overwhelming—and plants drape every surface with verdant greenery. At the center of the room stands a table with a chair on either side. Here, it's said, is where the prophet casts their sight into the unknown.

小壁炉旁的陶锅里飘出家常素食的气味，想必是一锅蔬菜粥。低低的炉火温暖着这间小屋，也昏昏照亮屋内的陈设：添柴用的木段、叠放的陶罐、悬挂的煎锅，以及一只餐边柜——上头挂着风干的香草，陶罐里插着各式炊具，一块砧板搁在一旁，仍散落着枯萎的胡萝卜叶梢。
The homely scent of plain cooking wafts from a clay pot by the small fireplace, no doubt some vegetable porridge. A low fire warms this small room and dimly illuminates its contents: logs for the fire, stacked pots, a hanging skillet, and a sideboard—where dried herbs hang, cooking utensils jut from a clay jar, and a cutting board sits, still littered with withered carrot tops.

从反应堆核心大步走出的，是一位由驯服的能量与核辐射凝成的妖精身影。祂看起来像一具充满阳刚生命力的人偶，仿佛由融化的翡翠塑成，在房间的昏暗光照中幽幽发亮；动作却轻灵得与那沉重的踏步形成强烈反差——每一次落脚都震得室内颤动，身后只留下凹陷的足印。成团的长橘发在一圈静电般的发丝光冠中翻涌扭动。放射性的热浪从祂汹涌的躯体上蒸腾而出，如白炽的瀑流倾泻，逼得你汗水涔涔，连身体也在本能的反应中绷紧。
Striding from the core of the reactor is a fey figure of harnessed energy and nuclear radiation. They appear as a virile mannequin, shaped from liquified emerald that glows in the room's dim light, and move with litheness at odds with their heavy footfalls—which shake the room and leave dented prints in their wake. A mass of long tangerine hair writhes in a corona of static strands. Radioactive heat wafts from their surging body in an incandescent cascade, causing you to sweat as you feel your body react.

I Break An Elemental Gem Of Red Corundum.name:
我捏碎一枚赤红刚玉的元素宝石：旋风
I Break An Elemental Gem Of Red Corundum: Twister

Text.text:
宝石轰然碎裂，数百片闪烁的碎晶倾泻坠地。碎片落地时迸出火花，嘶嘶的光芒骤然一闪，旋即绽放成咆哮的烈焰。一股火与烟的龙卷成形，燃烧的旋涡上撕开一张无定形的巨口与两只灼燃的眼睛。
The gem shatters, its hundreds of glittering shards cascading to the ground. The pieces spark as they land, the quick burst of hissing light then blooming into roaring fire. A twister of flame and smoke forms, the shapes of an amorphous mouth and two burning eyes stretching open along the flaming whirl.

Mad Scientist's Lab: Safety?.name:
疯狂科学家的实验室：安全？
Mad Scientist's Lab: Safety?

Text.text:
充斥着这间密室的怪异装置一动不动，旁侧盛满炼金液体的缸槽仍在无声地沸腾、咕嘟作响。潜伏的嗡鸣钻入耳中，伴随低沉的抽泵声。无论这些装备原本被设计用来进行何种黑暗行动，如今都已停歇——却并未真正结束。它像是在等待。
The strange devices that fill the chamber sit still, their accompanying vats of alchemical liquid continuing to quietly boil and bubble. A latent hum reaches your ears along with low pumping noises. Whatever dark activity this equipment was designer to do has ceased, but it doesn’t seem over. It feels like it waits.

Cluttered Dungeon Entrance.name:
杂乱的地城入口
Cluttered Dungeon Entrance

Text.text:
你跨过这处传奇之地的门槛，踏入第一间厅室——一条被杂物淹没的走廊。墙上的雕刻、塑像与盘根错节的烛台，全都被一堆堆陈旧破损的装备掩埋。被割裂的皮革、磨毛的绳索、凹陷的头盔、污渍斑斑的睡袋——也许是昔日冒险者弃置之物，或是为了更深处寻得的战利品而随手抛下。碎屑堆成的“龙之宝藏”中，有一条小径被踩踏出来，直通那扇将带你继续深入的门。你瞥见其中一座土丘里伸出一只骷髅手，指骨如蛛腿般朝那扇门探去，仿佛迫不及待要攫取可能遗落在里面的赃获。

~ Envisioned by ExoticSpoon

You pass the threshold of this storied place and find yourself in the first chamber—a hallway rampant with junk. Any carvings, statues, or gnarled sconces on the walls have been obscured by the considerable piles of old and broken equipment. Slashed leather, frayed rope, dented helmets, soiled bedrolls—discarded by adventurers past, perhaps dropped in favor of plunder found deeper within. A trail cuts through the dragon’s hoard of debris to the door that will lead you further in. You glimpse a skeletal hand hanging out of one of the mounds, fingers extending spider-like toward the door as if eager for spoils that might be left within.

~ Envisioned by ExoticSpoon

这柄标枪由一整块巨骨削凿而成，嵌入的符印上覆着某种闪烁的金属粉末，仿佛任何磨损都无法在其身上留下痕迹。其锋锐的枪尖足以贯穿最为坚固的板甲护甲。
Chipped from a single large bone and inlaid with sigils dusted with some sort of glittering metallic powder, this javelin appears to be impenetrable to wear of any kind. Its point is capable of piercing even the most durable plate armor.

Shipyard During Summer Drought.name:
夏季干旱期的造船厂
Shipyard During Summer Drought

Text.text:
船坞的干船台里，铁锤敲出参差不齐的节拍。即使在有遮阴的作业区，木匠们也会停下手，抬臂擦去额头的汗水。旱情让河水水位下降，岸边岩石上露出一层青绿的藻膜；未完工的船只肋骨般的框架横陈其间，仿佛巨型沙漠生物的骸骨——渴死于干涸。
Hammers beat an uneven rhythm within the shipyard dry docks. Even in their shaded work areas, carpenters pause to wipe sweat from their brows. A drought has lowered the water level in the river, exposing a layer of green algae on the rocks that line the shore, and the ribs of unfinished ships lie like the skeletons of gargantuan desert creatures—dead of thirst.

Wild Magic Surge: Beard Of Feathers.name:
狂野魔法涌动：羽毛胡须
Wild Magic Surge: Beard Of Feathers

Text.text:
奥秘也许没有一张脸，却自有幽默感。灼热的针刺感在你双颊上迸开，紧接着是一阵痒得发笑的搔动。下一瞬，白色羽毛闯入视野，一把长长的羽须将你的面孔遮掩得严严实实。你正要笑出声，却硬生生拧成一个喷嚏；这身滑稽的行头来得快去得也快——只留下你被一场羽毛雪团团围住。
Arcana may not have a face, but it has a sense of humor. Burning pinpricks erupt across your cheeks, immediately followed by a tickling sensation. An instant later, white plumage comes into view, disguising your face behind a long beard. You are about to laugh, but it twists into a sneeze, and the farcical costume ends as quickly as it began—leaving you surrounded by a snow of feathers.

Magical Detection Of A Fighter's Class.name:
对战士职业的魔法侦测
Magical Detection Of A Fighter's Class

Text.text:
在你与目标之间的半途中，侦测的薄雾——唯有你能看见——凝成了目标的轮廓。它模仿每一次移动，默然地无声描摹每一个字的口型，只持续短短数秒，旋即消散。
At the halfway point between you and your target, the mist of the detection—only visible to you—assumes your target’s shape. It mimics every movement, silently mouthing every word, only for a few seconds then disappears.

I Cast Black Tentacles Using A Squid Lim.name:
我用一截鱿鱼触腕施放了《黑色触手》
I Cast Black Tentacles Using A Squid Limb

Text.text:
鱿鱼般的肢体握在我掌心，触感又韧又粗糙。它从我紧握成拳的两指间探出，我用它尖锐的末端将法术对准地面。仿佛浓稠的油从大地里翻涌而出，触手破土而生，迅猛地扑向靴子，旋即缠上脚踝，层层盘绕。
The squid limb feels rubbery and rough in my hand. It sticks out between two fingers of my balled fist, and I use its pointed end to aim the spell at the ground. Like thick oil spilling up from the earth, the tentacles emerge, darting at boots and curling around ankles.

I Draw My Holy Avenger.name:
我拔出我的《圣复仇者》
I Draw My Holy Avenger

Text.text:
如同从沼泽中挣扎而出，迎上清冽的春日新风；又如从霉湿阴暗的地牢里爬行至盛夏的光里——当刀锋自鞘中滑出，而我将它的辉芒高高擎起、直指前方——我们便心胆俱壮。信心与康健为我们作壁垒，我们斩落那恶魔。借这柄钢铁裁决者的灿然光辉，我们将亵渎复生之物再度击回它们的影之国度。
Like emerging from a bog into fresh spring air, or crawling from a moldy dark dungeon into the summer light, when the blade slides from its scabbard—and I hold its radiance straight and high—we are emboldened. Shored up with confidence and good health, we strike down the fiend. We smite the profanely resurrected back to their land of shadow, by the brilliance of this steel arbiter.

Temple Of The Gods.name:
神祇圣殿
Temple Of The Gods

Text.text:
施法者以凯旋般的祈祷开场，俯身恳祈，一座巨大的法阵在空气中粼粼显现。宏伟的建筑随之完整成形：一处为祈祷与司祭祝福而建、可正常运作的院落群。殿群层层墙垣毫无瑕疵，仿佛出自神明之手的塑形。供奉主神的神像在内庭散发辉煌，光华四溢。神殿高踞于大地之上——信仰的昭示。
With a triumphant prayer, the caster bows in supplication, and a huge formation shimmers into existence. A magnificent structure, fully intact: a working complex built for prayer and priestly blessings. The many walls of the complex bear no flaw, as if the structure was modelled by the hands of the divine. An idol to the resident god radiates splendor across the inner court. The temple sits above the landscape—an affirmation of faith.

Shapeshifter Reveals Their True Form Aft.name:
变形者死后显露真身
Shapeshifter Reveals Their True Form After Death

Text.text:
随着生命一点点流逝，他们的面具也随之剥落。生物的面容在死亡中安详宁静，终于卸下欺瞒的重负，得以显露真实的自我。#REF!
As their life ebbs away, so too does their mask. The creature’s face is serene in death, free of their deceptive burden and finally able to reveal themselves for who they truly are.#REF!

这顶帽子以柔韧、熏黑的皮革精制而成，帽带上还别着一根精致的羽饰，乍一看几乎会让人误以为是哪位贵族的新潮奢玩——直到你凑近细看。帽带上以镀银丝线绣着几乎难以察觉的圣徽，而那根神气十足的羽毛里暗藏一枚银针，已不止一次在生死关头救过佩戴者的命。
Crafted from supple, darkened hide and topped with a fine feather in the band, one could mistake this hat for a noble’s latest fancy—until one looked closer. Almost imperceptible holy symbols, stitched in silvered thread, line the hat’s band, and the jaunty feather has saved the wearer’s life more than once with its hidden silver needle.

Giant Crystal Shard Emerging From The Gr.name:
巨大的水晶碎片破土而出
Giant Crystal Shard Emerging From The Ground

Text.text:
它并非嵌织在山腰的岩壁里，也不是深埋于洞窟之中；这枚碎片仿佛比周遭的岩石更为长寿。它斜斜向上伸展，通体呈半透明的翠绿，表面切面光滑，足有数码高。碎片底部四周，一簇簇晶体如花般绽生。
Instead of being woven into the rock of a mountainside or buried deep in a cave, this shard seems to have outlived the rock around it. It reaches upward at an angle, a translucent green in smooth facets and several yards high. A cluster of crystals grows like flowers around the base of the shard.

雨水穿过树枝倾泻而下，坠落成一片片连绵不断的水帘，将小径化作溪流，也把森林其余处变成泥泞的沼泽。万物都在滴水中闪着湿亮的光泽，连树干也不例外，没有哪条粗枝或细枝能提供像样的遮蔽。
The rain cascades through the branches of the trees, falling in continuous curtains that turn the trail into a stream and the rest of the forest into a muddy bog. Everything glistens with dripping water, even the trunks of the trees, with no bough or branch providing significant shelter.

Temple To A God Of Tyranny.name:
暴政之神的神殿
Temple To A God Of Tyranny

Text.text:
这座令人胆寒的建筑如同一块冷硬的无窗方盒，由巨大的石块垒成，外加铁箍紧紧束缚；厚重的黑色玄武岩大门嵌在轨道上，借此才能缓缓滑开。沿着神殿两侧分布着两类房间：亵渎者的囚室，以及审判厅——每间都只有寥寥几张座位、一张长案台和一把铁制法槌。中央祭坛是一座从另一间神殿掠来的干石喷泉，数处仍残留着血迹的暗斑。忏悔者们跪伏在圆形水盆周围礼拜，把祷词低低倾吐给这块死寂的石头——曾经那里流淌着水，如今只剩干涸与沉默。
