This intimidating building is a stark, windowless cube made of giant stone blocks and iron banding, with heavy doors of black basalt on tracks that help them slide open. Along the sides of the temple are two types of rooms: cells for blasphemers, and trial halls—each with a handful of seats, a bench, and an iron gavel. The central altar is a dry stone fountain taken from another temple, still stained with blood in several places. Penitents worship on their knees around the circular basin, praying into the dead stone where once there was water.

Barbarian Pre-battle Quip About Hatred.name:
野蛮人战前嘲讽：关于仇恨
Barbarian Pre-battle Quip About Hatred

Text.text:
“如此战斗，罕有其比。你要明白，当我以你的鲜血涂绘大地时，并非出于憎恨。我将敬奉那一抹汁液——那曾经是你身体的残影。”
“A battle like this is rare. Know that when I paint the earth with your blood, it will not be out of hatred. I will honor the smear of juices that used to be your body.”

Garret Valentine.name:
加勒特·瓦伦丁
Garret Valentine

Text.text:
他的双眼几乎让人忘了其余一切，甚至忘了加雷特那堪称典范的精灵相貌：一只祖母绿般碧绿，一只恶魔般猩红，正与他白色长袍的镶边同色。细密的金线以某种近乎数学的精确勾勒其上，沿着那看似闪粉般璀璨、却又反常——无疑也令人疼痛——金属化的皮肤流淌。他携带着黑暗魔法；那份冷冽的尊严与世代相传的高贵，在每一个手势、每一寸神情里都清晰可见。他的随身器具——一条卓尔触手鞭、几枚漂浮的球体、一本书、以及栖在他法杖上的小恶魔——都在诉说着那顶偶尔会在他头上闪现的恶魔王冠背后所隐藏的力量。

~ Played by a Hero

His eyes nearly make one forget the rest, even Garret’s quintessentially elvish look: one emerald green, one demon red and matching the trim of his white robes. Fine gold tracing, mathematical somehow, courses through skin that appears glittered but is unnaturally—no doubt painfully—metallic. He carries dark magic, and his cold dignity and generational nobility are apparent in every gesture, every expression. His accoutrements— a drow tentacle whip, floating orbs, a book, an imp perched on his staff—testify to the power behind the demon crown that sometimes flashes into view on his head.

~ Played by a Hero

Spell Component Emporium.name:
法术材料商店
Spell Component Emporium

Text.text:
即便你对这片地方全然陌生，也不难找到集市——百步之外，你就能闻到它的气味。这片由柜台与摊棚拼凑而成的市集，专营施法所需的各色杂项材料；这些组件在稀有度与来路上千差万别，以至于许多人甘愿为此支付溢价。一个守备森严、售卖珍贵宝石的摊位，正对着一名男人——他身旁的篮筐与陶罐里塞满了蜥蜴、蛇、贝类、昆虫，以及其他细小生物。笼中凤凰的尖啸几乎盖过了声音：一位年迈的提夫林正为一捆腥臊刺鼻的草药与人讨价还价，而旁边，一个精明的半身人正沿摊叫卖宗教护符，吆喝声此起彼伏。
It is not difficult to find the bazaar even if you are a stranger to this locale, as you can smell it from a hundred yards away. This gathering of counters and stalls specializes in the many sundry ingredients necessary for the casting of spells, components so varied in rarity and origin that many are willing to pay a premium price. A secure stall dealing in precious gemstones stands opposite a man near baskets and jars full of lizards, snakes, shellfish, insects, and other small creatures. The screeching of a phoenix in its cage nearly drowns out the sound of an old tiefling haggling over the price of a bundle of rank-smelling herbs with an enterprising halfling hawking religious amulets.

Sky Pirate Attack.name:
空盗攻击
Sky Pirate Attack

Text.text:
飞空艇瞭望台猛地传来一声尖叫，船上众人立刻警觉——舷侧的栏沿上，铁钩竟像被魔法召唤般接连冒出。伴随着一阵喷涌的蒸汽，一艘迅捷而重武装的海盗飞船自下方云层中拔升而起，贴着你们右舷船尾冲上来。大副扯开嗓子嘶吼下令，命船员击退登船者；与此同时，海盗飞空艇的第一轮炮火已经轰然开场。

~ 构想：Rogério da Costa Jr.

A sudden cry from the crow’s nest of the airship alerts everyone on board just as iron hooks begin to appear as if by magic along the ship’s gunwale. Accompanied by a burst of blowing steam, a fast, heavily armed pirate vessel ascends through the cloud cover below, coming up along your ship’s starboard stern. Shouting at the top of their lungs, the first mate bellows orders for the crew to repel boarders even as the first cannons from the pirate airship fire off their opening salvo.

~ Envisioned by Rogério da Costa Jr.

Fast Goblin That Cackles.name:
咯咯怪笑的迅捷地精
Fast Goblin That Cackles

Text.text:
你听见身后传来声响，转身时，一道墨绿身影疾掠而过，只在身后留下淡淡的臭气。它短暂停下，朝你发出咯咯怪笑，你的目光与那生物的眼睛相撞，你几乎来不及看清那地精的轮廓，它又再次拔腿逃去。
You hear a sound behind you and turn as a dark green figure dashes by, leaving nothing but a light stench in its wake. Your eyes meet the creature’s when it pauses briefly to cackle at you, and you barely register the goblin form before it’s on the run again.

Imperious High-class Orc.name:
傲慢的上等兽人
Imperious High-class Orc

Text.text:
一条蓝色领巾松松系在他肌肉虬结的粗壮脖颈上，这位兽人绅士既讲究又威势逼人。他的目光霸道凌人，尽管那只闪亮的黄色眼睛上还覆着一枚单片眼镜。稀疏的白色鬓须从他粗犷如凿的面庞旁飘散开来，顺着肩头垂落，宛如云霭轻柔地越过山脊、缓缓溢散。
Blue cravat tied loosely about his thickly muscled neck, the orcish gentleman is as imposing as he is posh. His gaze is domineering, even though one gleaming yellow eye is covered by a monocle. His wispy white sideburns flow away from his rough-hewn face and down his shoulders, like clouds breaking gently over mountain ridges.

弓箭手的长弓仍被尸体的手紧紧攥住。手指苍白，已被死亡冰冷的接触冻住，而她最后一刻的恐惧，深深刻在这名女子的脸上。不远处，箭袋倾倒在地，箭矢散落一旁。
The archer’s bow is still gripped tightly by the corpse’s hand. The fingers are pale, frozen by death’s icy touch, and the terror of her final moment is etched upon the woman’s face. A quiver lies spilled on the ground nearby.

它们最初只是一滩滩血迹，像被人甩在地上，隐约勾勒出赤足的轮廓。只走了几步，血痕便开始拖曳，越拖越长、越拖越慢，直到尽头抵达一扇紧闭的门。门把手上悬着的告示牌，再怎么写也不可能比门后等待着的东西更能说明一切。
They begin as splotches of blood slapped to the floor in the vague shape of bare feet. After only a few steps they drag, then drag longer and slower until reaching a closed door. A sign hanging from the doorknob couldn’t explain better what’s on the other side.

Ghosts In The Hall.name:
大厅里的幽魂
Ghosts In The Hall

Text.text:
幽魂在长廊里踱步，身着至少一百年前的华服。缕缕灵质在他们身后拖曳，如同蜗牛爬过留下的黏痕。尽管凝滞的空气像寒冰般咬噬着你，这些幽灵本身却不见半分恶意。忽有一位魅影（特征）从近旁的画中缓缓浮出，苍白的鬼面与肖像里的容颜分毫不差。她含笑颔首，唇形无声地开合，像是在致意，可传到你耳中的话语却被压得低哑破碎，难以辨明。
Ghosts mosey through the hall, dressed in finery of at least a hundred years past. Waves of ectoplasm follow them like snail trails. Though the still air bites at you like ice, the specters themselves suggest no malevolence. One phantom emerges from a painting nearby, the ghostly face matching the one in the portrait. She smiles and dips her head. She mouths something, perhaps a greeting, but her speech is muted and garbled to you.

Turok Three Eyes.name:
图洛克·三眼
Turok Three Eyes

Text.text:
灰绿而光滑的皮肤覆在他柔韧的肌肉上，那些肌理透过他身上那件又长又宽松的鹿皮大衣的开口若隐若现。这名精瘦男子的其余装束由宽大朴素的裤子、柔软的皮鞋与一条红木色腰带组成。深色纠结的发绺低垂，衬得他尖长的耳朵格外醒目，颈侧藤蔓般的刺青也因此更显清晰；嘴角还翘出两枚小小的白色獠牙。他的手是战士的手——粗砺结实、肌肉紧绷，指关节突起——可他的神情却很平静，眼色如深琥珀般暗沉，静静打量着四周。

~ Played by a Hero

Smooth, gray-green skin covers the supple muscles that show through openings in the long, loose doeskin coat this lean man wears. Baggy and plain pants, soft leather shoes, and a mahogany sash comprise his other attire. Dark, matted locks hang low enough to emphasize his pointed ears and the vinelike tattoos on his neck, and small white tusks jut from the corners of his mouth. His hands are that of a fighter—rough and muscular, with knobby knuckles—but he wears a calm expression, taking in his surroundings with eyes the color of dark amber.

~ Played by a Hero

当你念出召唤向导的咒言，薄雾在你脚边凝聚，涟漪般向外扩散，化作环绕你的云团。迷雾之中，一道兽性的轮廓扭曲翻卷，随即挺立成完整形体——它的血肉如宇宙般深邃流动。它贴着地面掠行而来，悄无声息地逼近。它幽灵般飘渺，却不阴森可怖；因为它的气息温暖而护持，宛如守卫的屏障。
When you speak the words to summon your guide fog coalesces around your feet, rippling out to form a cloud around you. From the mists, a bestial shape twists then rises into full form, its flesh cosmic and fluid. It approaches you, skimming across the floor. It is ghostly but not ghastly, for its aura is one of warmth and warding.

这生物大致呈人形，却依旧异质而可怖，叫人一眼便心底发寒。它灰白斑驳的皮肉紧绷在嶙峋扭结的骨架上，遍布阴狠的倒刺；接触之下粗粝扎手，仿佛能把皮肤刮破。每一条弯曲的肢体末端，都生着一簇向内弧起的利爪。它的角冠头颅上方，在一张塞满参差尖牙的狰狞小口之上，只有一只巨大、闪烁的独眼窥视着你。那眼睛仿佛滴落令人作呕的光芒——当它凝视你时，一股诡异而可怕的感觉猛然击中你的心神。
The creature, roughly humanoid, is nevertheless alien and horrific to behold. Its gray, mottled flesh, stretched taut across gnarled bones, is wickedly barbed and rough to the touch. Each crooked limb ends in a set of curving talons. Atop its horned head, above a nasty little mouth filled with jagged teeth, peers a single, great, glimmering eye. The eye seems to shed a sickening light, and as the creature gazes upon you, a strange and awful sensation hits you.

I Raft Down Rapids.name:
我乘筏冲下激流
I Raft Down Rapids

Text.text:
木筏猛然一震，撞上暗藏的礁石，冲击沿着木骨一路传到我全身；翻涌的水面上铺着蕾丝般的泡沫，底下的颠簸却无影无形。我死死抓紧，浑身肌肉绷到极限，只为不被甩离原位，任我们一路弹跳着冲下去。随着礁石的闷击稍稍缓和，我把桨重新插回河里，每一下都将上身压进划动里，去追上水势的狂烈。
Sudden jolts of the raft hitting hidden rocks reverberate through my body, the bumps invisible underneath the lacework of foam atop the sloshing water. I hold on, every muscle straining to keep me in place as we bounce along. I stick the paddle back into the river as the thudding of rocks calms slightly, leaning my torso into every stroke to match the water’s fervor.

Gold Dragon Lair.name:
金龙巢穴
Gold Dragon Lair

Text.text:
当你挤开这处偏僻之地周围诡异的五彩迷雾前行时，忽然脚步一滞——你意识到自己终于抵达了目的地。就在这团非人般的色旋之外，一道清澈到近乎晶莹的瀑布轰然倾泻，仿佛由雕琢的玻璃铸成，直落入一汪深蓝水潭。透过瀑布澄澈的水幕，你看见后方有一处洞穴——紧接着，两只巨大的眼睛倏然闪烁着睁开。金色的虹膜自庇护之所向外凝望，目光如钻，直刺入你灵魂的深处。
As you push your way through the strange multicolored mists surrounding this remote location, you stop in your tracks as you realize that you have found your destination. Just beyond this swirl of unearthly colors, a waterfall so clear and crystalline that it appears to be made from carved glass thunders down into a pool of deep-blue water. Behind the clear waters of the fall, you notice a cave—and then two enormous eyes flickering open. Golden irises peer out of their sanctuary and burrow deeply into the core of you.

Loot From A Green Dragon Wyrmling.name:
绿龙雏龙的战利品
Loot From A Green Dragon Wyrmling

Text.text:
整座宝藏堆满了黄与绿：金杯、珠宝与钱币，掺杂着祖母绿、翡翠、萤石与雾绿碧玺——有的镶在戒指与护身符上，有的散落其间。
The entire trove is composed of yellow and green: golden cups, jewelry, and coins mixed with emeralds, jade, fluorite, and misty-green tourmalines—set in rings and amulets as well as loose.

Valley Of Ice And Darkness.name:
冰与黑暗之谷
Valley Of Ice And Darkness

Text.text:
晶黑寒冰的山谷闪烁微光，锯齿般的冰晶拔地而起，宛如尖塔与凌空的群峰。每一座冻结的形体深处，你都能看见星辰的碎光、星云的缕缕薄雾、无数不可计量的世界光球——在漆黑、锋利如刃的冰锥之中，竟封存着无穷宇宙。夜色沉入其底，又被折射向外，如同一枚阴森的棱镜。你自身扭曲而被拉长的身影，在谷地阴影铺展的广袤里被无尽映照、层层复现。
The valley of crystalline black ice glimmers, rising in jagged formations that evoke spires and soaring mountains. In the depths of each frozen form, you see the sparkle of stars, the wisps of nebulae, the myriad orbs of worlds beyond counting—infinite universes within the dark, razor-edged icicles. The night is reflected in their depths, refracted outward like a sinister prism. Your own twisted form, elongated, is mirrored endlessly across the valley’s shadowed expanse.

洞窟诡异而阴森，奥术火炬幽幽燃烧，洒下斑斓的光，映在畸形的岩壁上；石面在摇曳的火焰里仿佛起伏蠕动。你沿着巨大的洞道前行，脚步放得极慢、极轻，心惊胆战；那令人不安的回声——嘶嘶声、吟唱、尖叫——愈来愈近，逼迫而来。你转过拐角，眼前豁然是一座球形巨窟，仿佛被远古魔法从岩石中生生凿出；洞窟中央立着一座黑石高坛，遍覆雕刻的盘蛇。人形身影围绕高坛，随着吟唱起伏摆动，你这才意识到那并非人类——鳞皮、獠牙、蛇一般的轮廓，将它们暴露为某种蛇人。其中一名头顶生着如眼镜蛇般的鳍冠，高高举起一柄弯曲而凶戾的匕首。

~ Envisioned by Spac3cowboyy

The cave is strange and sinister, lit by arcane torches that cast multi-colored light across the malformed surfaces of stone, which seem to undulate in the wavering flames. You move through the cavernous tunnels, slowly, cautiously, and the unnerving echoes—hissing, chanting, screaming—draw closer and closer. You round a corner and find yourself overlooking a spherical cavern, hewn from the stone by ancient magic, and at its center stands a raised dais of black stone covered with carved serpents. Humanoid figures surround the dais, moving with the chanting, and you realize these are not humans—the scaly skin, fangs, and serpentine features mark these creatures as a kind of snake-folk. One figure, their head crested with a cobra-like fin, holds aloft a curved, wicked-looking dagger.

~ Envisioned by Spac3cowboyy

[察觉] 这道栅门看起来过于单薄，于是你检查了它的边缘，发现它只向内侧铰开，随后会弹回原位。走廊由坚实的石材砌成，尽头是一扇假门。

[触发] 通往幽暗长廊的栅门轻易便被推开。你凑近墙面一看，才发现石壁被刻意修整成温馨暖意的模样，离尽头那对门约半程处的墙上还挂着两只壁灯。身后栅门悄然滑回，伴随一声咔嗒，决绝得诡异，像是落锁。石廊尽头的门是假的，而你已被困在其中。

[Perceived] The gate seems too flimsy, so you check its edges and notice that it only hinges inward and springs back into position. The hallway is solid stone, ending in a false door.

[Triggered] The gate to the dark hall opens easily, and when you get a closer look at the walls, you notice they have been worked to look homey and warm, with a couple of sconces on the walls about halfway to the doors at the end. The gate slips closed with a clack that sounds strangely final, like a lock. The door at the end of the stone hall is false, and you are trapped.

Underground Black Market.name:
地下黑市
Underground Black Market

Text.text:
尽管四周昏暗、热浪逼人，所有人都戴着深色墨镜或护目装备。空间里几乎每家店都只在一扇装着铁栅的窗口后做买卖，窗口嵌在有守卫、加固的门上；无论是门还是货品，都刻意不贴任何标识，显得格外刺眼。
Despite the dark and the press of heat, everybody is dressed with heavily tinted glasses or rigs. Almost every shop in the space is run out of the barred window of a guarded and reinforced door, and both the doors and merchandise are conspicuously unlabeled.

Twilight Prayer Of Vigilant Blessing.name:
警醒祝福的暮光祈祷
Twilight Prayer Of Vigilant Blessing

Text.text:
“以夜色的阴影为我披上斗篷，在他人退避与藏身之处，将一切纷扰尽数遮蔽。如你曾引导我那般，循着幽暗的虚空带我前行——因为光也会令人目眩、灼痛。在暮光的静谧里，我们守候，静待。”

~ 由 Tusker2zero Envisioned

“Cloak me in the nightly shade, where others shirk and shelter, to shutter all distractions. Guide me as you have before via the tenebrous void—for light can be blinding, searing. In the calm of twilight, we attend and await.”

~ Envisioned by Tusker2zero

Linguistical Calculator For An Interplan.name:
用于星际留声机的语言计算器
Linguistical Calculator For An Interplanetary Phonograph

Text.text: 当虫胶唱片在星际留声机上录下可沟通的极限，一位戴着白手套的译员便小心翼翼地将它捧到这台装置前。计算机同样像一架留声机，却立在一个木箱之上——那箱子有顶帽盒般的体型。它运转着一种算盘：黄铜圆筒在轨道上滑移、碰响，叮当作声。待它搭起所录语言的基本骨架，便从箱底的狭槽吐出一卷印着lingua franca的电报纸带。语言学家随后便可尝试译解其中材料。 After the shellac phonograph disc has recorded its limit of communication on the interplanetary phonograph, a translator wearing white gloves carries it gingerly to this device. The calculator looks like a phonograph as well, but it stands atop a wooden case the size of a hat box. It runs a kind of abacus of sliding and clinking brass cylinders. After it builds the fundamentals of the recorded language, it spits out a ticker tape of lingua franca through a slot in the box bottom. Linguists can then attempt to translate the material.

Blacksmith With Oligodactyly.name:
寡指铁匠
Blacksmith With Oligodactyly

Text.text:
他用一条粗壮前臂的手背抹去眼里的汗水，身旁的炉火噼啪作响，火星迸溅。他套上皮手套，依着他手掌的形状特制：一只只有两根手指，另一只则有三根。他抄起一把钳子，夹住火焰里的一块金属，将这柄灼亮的雏刃——熔融橙红、滚烫发光——拖到铁砧上。另一只手握起铁匠锤，把锤柄稳稳卡在那两根手指之间。重锤轰然落下，金铁交鸣，势大力沉，将金属一下一下敲弯塑形；而钳子与锤柄始终在他娴熟的掌控中纹丝不动。

~ 扮演：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

He wipes the sweat out of his eyes with the back of a burly forearm, the forge fires crackling and spurting beside him. He slides on his leather gloves, made to accommodate the shape of his hands, one with two fingers and the other with three. He grabs a pair of tongs to grip a piece of metal sitting within the flames and brings this glowing protoblade, molten and orange, over to his anvil. He grasps the smith’s hammer in his other hand, securing the handle between both fingers. The hammer swings down in powerful, clanging blows, bending the metal into shape, as the tongs and handle remain steady within his practiced grasp.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Fighter's Speech Of Self-deprecation.name:
战士的自嘲演说
Fighter's Speech Of Self-deprecation

Text.text:
“无论我训练得多刻苦、多拼命，都没用。我还没准备好。战局把我甩在身后，敌人强得离谱。我要投降吗？逃跑吗？不，我不会。我僵在原地，像被冻住一样。我得从某个地方找来信心，找来灵感……而且得立刻。”
“It doesn’t matter how much I train or how hard. I’m not ready. The fight’s gotten ahead of me, and my foe is too much. Do I surrender? Flee? No, I won’t. Frozen, I am. I need confidence from somewhere, some inspiration… and fast.”

层层交错的粗砺精金装甲板拼合成你面前这尊庞然魔像。它大致呈烧杯般的轮廓，下盘沉重如山，迈步间带着地震般的无可阻挡，大地在每一次落脚下都为之战栗。一个永恒的熔炉宛如巨大的熔融之眼，镶嵌在这生物尖齿般嶙峋的胸膛上，目光永不眨动。翻涌的炽热化作浓烟，从构成魔像头颅的狭缝盔面间喷吐而出。
Interlocking plates of abrasive adamantine form the massive golem standing before you. Roughly beaker-shaped, this bottom-heavy goliath moves with a seismic inexorability, the ground quaking beneath each step. An eternal forge, like a great molten eye, stares unblinking from the creature's cuspidated chest. Its roiling heat vents as smoke through the slitted helm that forms the golem’s head.

Divine Gambling Hall Of A Goddess Of Mis.name:
厄运女神的神圣赌馆
Divine Gambling Hall Of A Goddess Of Misfortune

Text.text:
从你踏入那片炽亮灯火、仙火光轮与斑斓旗幡的瞬间，你就笃定自己必将赢到最后。半裸的侍者端着酒壶与托盘穿梭其间，庞大乐团奏出的欢庆旋律灌满整座赌厅。食物、酒水与可能性汇成一场狂欢，让数小时像数秒般滑过——直到你把手伸进一个空口袋。你这才意识到，乐声掩盖了咒骂与啜泣的动静。一个守卫指着你。地面是滑腻的冰。正门上了锁，绝望却敞开着。
You feel certain you will win from the moment you enter under bright lights, wheels of faerie fire, and colorful banners. Half-naked servers move about with flagons and trays, and the festive music of an enormous orchestra fills the gambling hall. A carnival of food, drink, and possibility makes hours pass like seconds—until you reach into an empty pocket. You realize that the music covers the sounds of cursing and weeping. A guard points at you. The floor is slick ice. The front door is locked, the despair wide open.

Malfoy The Risen.name:
崛起的马尔福
Malfoy The Risen

Text.text:
蛇皮长靴随着这名黑暗精灵缓慢踱步而来，发出清脆的嗒嗒声。他用一只机械手的拇指缓缓挑起宽檐帽的帽沿，金属关节与“肌腱”在动作间吐出细碎的机括嗡鸣。深红的眼眸如红宝石般在自信的笑意上方闪烁，他的五官嵌在一片光滑的苍白肤色里，隐隐泛着淡蓝的冷调。掌心弩松松挂在髋侧，轻轻撞击着他那覆满翠绿鳞片的护腿。

~ Played by Khaolo with

Serpent-skin boots click in a slow saunter as this dark elf approaches. He slowly lifts the end of his wide-brimmed hat with the thumb of one of his robotic hands, the metallic joints and tendons emitting mechanical whirs as he moves. His carmine eyes glint like rubies above a confident smirk, and his features are set into a smooth swathe of pale skin with a light blue tint. A hand crossbow hangs loose on his hip, bouncing lightly against his verdant-scale cuisse.

~ Played by Khaolo with

Security Robot Malfunctions.name:
安保机器人故障
Security Robot Malfunctions

Text.text:
安保机器人尖啸着，火花从它厚重装甲包裹的头颅中迸裂四溅；紧接着警报器也加入这片喧嚣，臃肿的机器咆哮着发出警告，庞大的武器阵列开始依次预热、轮转。守在大门旁的人类同伙最先毙命，被高速弹雨撕成碎片。致命的自动机踏过他们支离破碎的尸体，开始了它的狂暴屠戮。
The security droid screams as sparks burst from its densely armored head; then claxons join the clamor as the bulky machine roars warnings and begins to cycle up its vast array of weaponry. Its human associates guarding the gate are the first to die, shredded by the bursts of high-velocity rounds. Stepping over their mutilated corpses, the deadly automaton begins its rampage.

庞大而凶残，这头巨型龙类生物蜿蜒逼近，双首起伏，如一场由翠绿血肉汇成的滑行雪崩。一颗头颅猛然昂起，巨颚张开，雾状酸液自咽喉爆裂喷涌，化作伞状倾泻而下，恶臭的酸雾直扑你的口鼻。另一颗头颅则猛地横甩，贴地如出击的毒蛇般袭来，沉重鳞甲拖曳犁开大地，嘴巴张得足以吞下一头猛犸。
Vast and vicious, the immense draconic creature slithers forward, its twin heads bobbing in a sinuous avalanche of viridian flesh. One head rears up, jaws opening as a plume of misty acid explodes from the maw to umbrella down toward you with its sickening fumes. The other head snaps sideways, coming toward you low as a striking viper, gouging the earth with the weight of its scales as it opens wide enough to swallow a mammoth.

My Shield +2 Deflects An Arrow.name:
我的+2盾牌弹开了一支箭
My Shield +2 Deflects An Arrow

Text.text:
我瞥见箭矢朝我疾射而来，立刻俯身躲到我的附魔盾牌后。金属在冲击力下嗡然作响，箭头撞上盾面，当场碎裂。盾面上镌刻的远古英雄纹章冷冷注视着一切，神情不可动摇、坚毅如铁，仿佛在挑衅那名袭击者：再来一次。
I spot the arrow flying toward me and duck behind my enchanted shield. The metal rings with the force of the impact as the arrow strikes it and shatters. The ancient hero emblazoned on the shield’s face looks on, implacable and with stoic determination, daring my attacker to strike again.

Burned-out Bureaucrat.name:
精疲力竭的官僚
Burned-out Bureaucrat

Text.text:
“这不是正确的档案，女士。”他慢慢地、谨慎地说道，对着那副缠在他日渐稀疏的头皮上的有线耳机，“我可以——要是您让我把话说完——”他忽然噤声，灰色的八字胡在阴沉的怒容上竖起。显示器的绿光照出他日复一日工作的代价：凹陷的脸颊、眼下深黑的眼窝、额头上刀刻般的褶皱。他双手发抖，悬在全息键盘上方，像随时要扣下扳机。“如果您需要帮助找到正确的档案，我——”他话到一半又被打断，骤然停住。他猛地把手砸进键位里，屏幕随之一闪，零零散散的窗口与警告接连弹出。

“通话结束。”一个冰冷、程序化的声音在他的格子间里响起。“检测到烦躁。行为变化已记录，待复核。”男人把拇指抵到牙间狠狠咬住，嘴唇无声地翕动，像在吐出一串恶毒的咒骂。

“This is not the right file, ma’am,” he says slowly, carefully, into the headset wired about his balding scalp. “I can— If you’d let me finish—” His gray mustache bristles over his scowl as he shuts up. The green glow of his monitor highlights the toll of his daily job: gaunt cheeks, dark basins under the eyes, and deep creases in the forehead. His hands shake as he holds them primed over his holo-keyboard. “If you need assistance finding the correct file, I—” He stops short, interrupted again. He slams his hands through the keys, causing his monitor to flash as a smattering of different windows and warnings open up.

“Call ended,” a sterile, computerized voice speaks into his cubicle. “Aggravation detected. Behavior shift recorded for review.” The man brings his thumb to his teeth and bites down, silently mouthing a nasty string of insults.

Sundries From A Werebear.name:
来自熊人狼的杂物
Sundries From A Werebear

Text.text:
在那狼人的随身物品中，你发现了一瓶清澈黏稠的蜂蜜和一把小小的锡勺。也许它嗜甜？
Amid the lycanthrope’s belongings, you find a bottle of clear, sticky honey and a small tin spoon. Perhaps they had a sweet tooth?

一股炽烈的喜悦感猛地攫住你——却并非你的喜悦。那是某种异质的情绪，自你面前伫立的精灵生物身上逸散而出。那类人形生物的皮肤色彩明艳，前臂上以优雅的花体字刻画着纹样。它含笑凝视，将它的情感投射进你体内，而你感觉自己的情绪正迅速枯萎。
A fervent sense of joy grips at you, but it is not your joy. It is something other, emanating from the elfin creature standing before you. The humanoid has brightly colored skin, marked at the forearms in elegant cursive script. It smiles, projecting its emotions into you, and you feel your own wither.

I Cast Detect Thoughts.name:
我施放【侦测思想】
I Cast Detect Thoughts

Text.text:
我在掌心将那枚铜币顺时针转动，低声念出法术的词句，将心神凝聚在我的目标上。我的意识向对方延伸而去，像幽灵隔着窗棂窥视，试图寻到一条侵入的缝隙。
I spin the copper piece clockwise in my palm as I mutter the words of the spell and focus my mind on my target. My consciousness reaches out to theirs, like a ghost looking through a window, trying to find a way in.

你把一颗小小的石珠举到眼前，用指尖轻轻一敲。细微的裂纹立刻浮现，一幅由碎裂构成的影像笼罩着你的目标，仿佛有一片小小的玻璃窗悬在他们周身，破碎成镶嵌般的纹路。目标四肢逸散出淡淡的热浪薄雾，飘入那些裂缝里，使其微微颤动。
You raise a small bead of stone to your eye, tapping it gently with a finger. Small cracks appear, and an image of these fractures surrounds your target as if a small pane of glass was hovering, broken, in a tessellated pattern around them. A faint heat haze drifts from the target's limbs and into the cracks, causing them to shake.

你念完咒语，刹那间，万籁俱寂。无声——连你的呼吸、你的心跳——都无法在你所造就的球形领域中逸出半点声响。
You complete the incantation, and in an instant, all sound immediately silences. No sound, not even your own breaths, your own heartbeat, emits within the sphere of your creation.

God Awakens To New Follower's Plea.name:
神明苏醒，回应新信徒的祈求
God Awakens To New Follower's Plea

Text.text:
自这位神明上一次苏醒以来，已过去了无数纪元；如今祂仍温顺沉眠，随宇宙之风在诸界之间漂流。一道细小而遥远的声音呼唤着祂——祂在请求援助。那存在发出低沉的轰鸣，意识缓缓回归，随着苏醒一点点浮上来。凝视祂的双眼，仿佛看见一个在时代本身诞生之前就已活过的生命——那被半遗忘的梦。#REF!
Eons have passed since this god last stirred, now drifting through the planes in docile slumber on cosmic winds. A voice, small and distant, calls to them—it asks for aid. The being rumbles, their consciousness returning slowly as they awaken. Gazing into their eyes feels like seeing a half-remembered dream of a life lived before time itself.#REF!

Draught Of Aegri Somnia.name:
阿格里·索姆尼亚之饮
Draught Of Aegri Somnia

Text.text:
这只深琥珀色小瓶以软木塞封口，轻易便能安放在掌心。瓶身贴着一张黑色标签，边缘毛糙起皱，褪成浅褐色，其上点点星纹如尘。Aegri Somnia以优雅而修长的字迹写就，笔画如清冽夜风拖曳的痕迹般流淌。透过软木塞，你能嗅到多种草药气息，其中最浓的是薰衣草。随手一晃，瓶中泛起幽深的蓝色微光，仿佛在暗示这瓶药剂受过附魔。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

This dark amber bottle, fitted with a cork, can easily be cradled in the palm of the hand. A black label, its frayed, worried edges fading to a tan color, is bespeckled with a starry pattern. Aegri Somnia is written in an elegant, elongated script, flowing like trails of a crisp night wind. Through the cork, you can smell various herbs, the strongest of which is lavender. A quick shake of the bottle elicits a dark blue shimmer, suggesting the potion is enchanted.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Sundries From A Psionic Warrior Of The A.name:
来自星界位面灵能战士的杂物
Sundries From A Psionic Warrior Of The Astral Plane

Text.text:
一片红色的爬行类鳞片，约有苹果般大小，系在倒下战士的腰带上，用皮绳捆着，像只祈福的兔脚随身垂挂。
A red reptilian scale about the size of an apple hangs from the fallen warrior's belt, tied to the leather like a lucky rabbit’s foot.

这是个老赌局。灵巧瘦小的那位，会赢过迟缓壮硕的那位吗？两名拳手，意志坚决、皮糙肉厚——一个盯着机会挥出沉重一击，另一个则像鱼一样溜入，蹭上一记惹人恼的小得分，然后又一记，再一记。如今他们深深喘息，身形微微摇晃。快的那位慢了些。壮的那位手垂得更低了些。时代仿佛被拉长，被疲惫拖拽着，走向一个不确定的终点。

~ Raetheriel所构想

It’s an old bet. Will the quick smaller one win over the slow brawny one? Two pugilists, determined and tough—one watching for a chance to land a heavy blow, the other slipping in for an annoying little score, then another and another. Now they breathe deep and waver a little. The fast one is a bit slower. The brawny one’s hands are a little lower. Time seems to stretch, to fatigue itself toward an uncertain end.

~ Envisioned by Raetheriel

Harness-mounted, Multi-barreled Minigun.name:
背负式多管旋转机枪
Harness-mounted, Multi-barreled Minigun

Text.text:
你面前的这把火器，堪称万般火器之祖。六根修长枪管安置在可旋转的座架上，座架连接着供弹器；其弹带粗大得无法收容其中，只得从一侧溢出垂落。整件武器沉重到骇人，使用者必须穿上内置的背带式挽具，才勉强能把它从地面抬起。
The firearm before you is the grandfather of all firearms. Six long barrels sit on a rotating mount attached to an ammo feeder, whose belts are too large to be contained within and instead spill out one side. The entire weapon is so weighty that it requires the user to wear a built-in harness to even hoist the thing off the ground.

Jormungand In The Net.name:
网中耶梦加得
Jormungand In The Net

Text.text:
宛如一条泰坦巨蛇，这尊浩瀚的数字典范在网络的腹地间蜿蜒翻涌，既是纷争的凶兆，也是熵增的先驱。它污秽的存在化作原初的黑暗，盘绕在网络的根系之上——一项渴求毁灭的禁忌。每一次碾磨般的撕咬，都会酝酿出灾变级的灭绝——直至万物终焉。

~ 一位英雄所构想

Akin to a titanic serpent, this vast digital paragon undulates through the bowels of the Net as a portent of discord and a harbinger of entropy. Its foul presence embodies primordial darkness, coiling about the network’s roots, an anathema seeking destruction. With each grinding bite, it ferments cataclysmic extinction—to the end of all.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Use An Elevator.name:
我乘坐电梯
I Use An Elevator

Text.text:
对我而言，旅行便是这般形态——一只机械悬浮的箱匣，取代了粗陋的楼梯。凭借道具与滑轮、杠杆与信号，我的行程由艰难化作轻松。让旁人去攀那不饶人的台阶吧。我们享用发明之利，我便乘之上下起落。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，来自 Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Travel takes this shape for me—a box of mechanical levitation that replaces the crude staircase. With gear and pulley, lever and signal, my journey transforms from challenge to ease. Let others toil up unforgiving steps. We have the use of invention, and on it I rise and descend.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Greatwych Island And The Wicklets.name:
大巫岛与维克列群岛
Greatwych Island And The Wicklets

Text.text:
威克河上的岛屿呈黄褐色，覆着稀草，看上去不过是些朴素的沙洲。然而“大威奇”却是一处古老的异教墓葬地，曾出土过古怪的小饰物与钱币；而“威克莱茨”则栖居着麝鼠、海狸，以及好几种不同品类的鸭子。
The islands of the Wick River are tawny, grassy affairs that look like simple sand bars. But Greatwych is an old pagan burial site where strange trinkets and coins have been found, and the Wicklets are home to muskrats, beavers, and several breeds of duck.

夜色的残酷胜过智慧。它们无声飞行。先以阴影般的纠缠猎住你，再骤然出击。它们的头颅旋得过分，双眼开阖间带着控诉者般令人心惊的裁断。它们吞食所杀之物，随后吐出一枚完美的骨球——一整套老鼠的骨骸，完整得像被装进了小盒。猫头鹰栖在僻静的高处，警觉凝视，静候，守望。
Nocturnal brutality is better than wisdom. They have silent flight. They haunt before they strike. Their head swivels too far, and their eyes close and open with the startling judgment of an accuser. They eat what they kill, then spit out the perfect ball of a mouse’s bones, intact like a kit. The owl is alert on its secluded perch, watching, waiting.

My Target Is Rammed By My Ring Of The Ra.name:
我的目标被我的公羊之戒猛撞而飞
My Target Is Rammed By My Ring Of The Ram

Text.text: 带着红尘般象牙色的烟雾自我的戒指中倾泻而出，噼啪作响，满溢能量——仿佛闪电被困在汇聚风暴的云团里。一颗公羊的头颅随之成形，粗壮的螺旋羊角盘绕其上。它低下额头，直冲 目标；对方的惊叫被这记幽影般的重击生生闷住，落下时带着砂砾般的 crack! Smoke the color of red-dusted ivory pours out of my ring, crackling with energy—like lightning caught in the clouds of a gathering storm. A ram’s head with thick spiraled horns forms. It lowers its forehead and rushes my target, whose yelp is smothered by the spectral blow that lands with a gritty crack!

冷峻的决意糊在青年汗湿的脸上。他们抬手整了整帽子，又摆弄着身上那件色彩斑斓的罩袍。握紧主人战马的缰绳，最后深深吸了一口气，他们牵着马背上的骑士穿过敞开的大门走进比武场，观众的喧嚣迎面砸来，令他们不由得一缩。
Grim determination plasters the youth’s sweating face. They adjust their hat and fuss with the colorful tabard they wear. Taking the reins of their master's destrier, and one last deep breath, they lead the mounted knight through the open gate to the list, flinching as the noise of the crowd hits them.

你的手触碰到那头野兽，你的心智如花瓣绽放般敞开，贪婪地汲取阳光。有一阵嗡鸣在你们两颗心灵之间共振，催促一股兽性的情绪洪流在你体内横冲直撞。你的感官膨胀起来，以承受这倾泻而下的奔涌，而你的灵魂发出长嚎，欢迎那头野兽——一种超越语言的理解将你们紧紧相连。
Your hand touches the beast, and your mind opens like petals blooming to soak in the sun. There’s a hum that resonates between your two minds, encouraging a rush of animalistic emotion to rampage through you. Your senses swell to accommodate the deluge, and your very soul howls a welcome to the beast as an understanding that transcends language connects you.

Aella, \"The Wind Of Terror\".name:
艾拉，“恐惧之风”
Aella, "The Wind Of Terror"

Text.text:
这位矮小女子外表青春，却掩不住那双翡翠绿眼眸里沉淀的冷硬智慧。眉头紧锁，唇线抿成一条薄刃般的直线，仿佛将周遭一切都判作不合格。她的头发同样是绿色，发梢微卷，恰在触及她所穿貂黑色高领长裙之前停住。那袭长衣衬得她白皙的肌肤几乎发光，却遮不住她朴素却相衬的鞋子，也遮不住那双纤细手指的长度——它们紧攥着一枚巨大的孔雀石宝石，宝石内部泛着柔和的幽光。

~ 由 Ararion 扮演

A youthful mien belies the hard wisdom in this small woman’s emerald eyes. Brows furrow, lips press into a thin line, as if she judges all around her as wanting. Her hair is also green, curling at the ends just before reaching the high collar of the sable-black dress she wears. The long garment makes her fair skin almost glow. It fails to cover her plain but matching shoes, or the length of the slender fingers clutching an enormous malachite jewel that glows with a soft inner light.

~ Played by Ararion

Ezria Eto.name:
埃兹莉娅·埃托
Ezria Eto

Text.text:
年轻的女士单膝跪在阳光里，低垂着头。她背上系着一面盾牌，盾徽正对着日光反射，耀得你几乎看不清纹样，只觉光芒直刺双眼。她双手握着一柄长剑，剑尖向下扎入身前草皮，低声呢喃着祈祷。祷毕，她起身转向你，将长剑收入朴素的剑鞘——剑鞘系在腰间，正好贴在同样朴实的胸甲下缘。她已不再跪在直射的日光中，可那份辉光仿佛仍黏附在她金色的肌肤与宝石般的红发上。

~ 扮演：EZ

The young lady kneels on one knee in the sunlight, her head bowed. A shield is strapped to her back, the emblem difficult to make out as it reflects the sun’s rays directly into your eyes. She holds a longsword, point down in the turf before her, as she murmurs her devotions. Once done, she stands and turns to face you, sheathing her sword in a plain scabbard strapped to her waist just below her equally practical breastplate. Though she is no longer kneeling in the direct sunlight, some radiance still seems to cling to her golden skin and ruby red hair.

~ Played by EZ

Shadowy Sports Bar.name:
阴影笼罩的体育酒吧
Shadowy Sports Bar

Text.text:
赌客们围在昏暗酒吧里几张摇摇欲坠的桌旁，每人都攥着下注单，仿佛屏幕上跳动的结果就攸关性命。悬在吧台上方的巨型等离子屏里，赛程冲线的一刻，喧嚣的欢呼与绝望的哀嚎搅作一团；人群随即蜂拥向前，有人冲去庆祝——也有人挤去哀叹。
Punters gather around flimsy tables in the shadowy bar, each clutching betting slips like their lives depend upon the results displayed on screen. A raucous cheer mingles with cries of despair as the race being shown on a huge plasma screen suspended above the bar finishes, and patrons rush forward to celebrate—or commiserate.

它最醒目的标志，是那条一百二十英尺长的船体两侧，各开着一排十六个桨口。帆布紧紧卷束在三根桅杆的横桁上。桨帆船吃水很浅，足以划进大多数港口装卸货物、上下船员。这艘船曾经风光更盛——在战火的磨砺下边缘崩缺、满身刮痕，但结构扎实，工艺可靠。重型武器舱口严严实实地扣着。浪花轻拍船舷，瞭望台上方的三角旗在天光里猎猎翻卷。
Its signature is the rank of sixteen oar ports on each side of a one-hundred-and-twenty-foot hull. Canvas sails furl tight along the arms of three masts. The galley’s draft is shallow enough to row into most ports for cargo and crew. This one has seen better days—chipped and scraped by the hardships of battle, but it is soundly crafted. Heavy weapons hatches are closed tight. Waves lap against the sides, and a pennant over the crow’s nest ripples against the sky.

Drunk's Slurred Request.name:
醉汉含糊的请求
Drunk's Slurred Request

Text.text:
“来点清淡带果香的，你懂的；可给我往里倒满、倒到溢出来那种我最爱、最爱喝的黑啤酒。”
“Summin’ light and fruitish, y’know, but drop it in losh and losh of thet black shtout y’know I love, love.”

街道由夯实的泥土铺就，颜色与所有建筑取材的砂岩别无二致。这是一座矗立在沙漠里的商铺沙堡，自佩特拉内的影门一路温柔下倾，通往苏丹那座古老的宫殿。黎明时分，西侧的石屋闪烁金辉，花园苏醒，泼洒出斑斓色彩。暮色降临，东侧的建筑被染成橙与赤，药草园也精神抖擞地活泛起来。头顶的天空带着魔意，如同被投映在巨洞穹顶的画幕——这座巨洞将柱廊藏匿起来，与凡常尘世隔绝。
The street is packed earth, the same color as the sandstone from which all the buildings are made. It’s a sandcastle of shops in the desert, reaching gently downhill from the shadow gate inside Petra to the sultan’s ancient palace. At dawn, the western stone buildings glitter gold, flower gardens awakening to splash them with color. Twilight turns the eastern buildings orange and red as their herb gardens perk to life. The sky above is magical, cast on the ceiling of the great cave in which the Colonnade is hidden from the quotidian world.

Dining Room Of A Manor.name:
庄园的餐厅
Dining Room Of A Manor

Text.text:
一张巨大的长桌主宰着这间狭长的厅室。瓷盘在眼前泛着莹光，银质餐具在几座枝形烛台的暖光中闪烁。长桌四周的高背椅上，各自刻着相似却独一无二的雕纹。桌上似乎尚未摆上食物，但一只盛着暗红液体的水晶瓶已被拔开瓶塞——也许是为醒酒而提前倒出的葡萄酒？
A great table dominates this long chamber. Porcelain plates gleam and sliver serving ware glitters in the warm light of several candelabras. The high-backed chairs around the table each bear a similar but unique carving. No food seems to be on the table as yet, but a crystal bottle containing a dark red liquid stands uncorked—perhaps wine left out to decant?

随着你脚步的震颤而有节奏地抽动，这只狼般大小的蛛形生物猛然转身，八只红宝石般的眼睛死死钉在你身上。它的外骨骼泛着失去光泽的银色幽辉，看起来同样坚不可摧。它以令人牙酸的窸窣声滑行前进，动作流畅得不似凡物，暗示着惊人的速度；螯肢尖端的毒牙咔哒作响，黏稠的毒液渗出，在它身前的地面上嘶嘶作响。四周缠绕着如巨型渔网般的丝线，将这只生物包围其中；你眼睁睁看着，它开始织起一张新网，准备朝你猛然喷射。
Twitching in rhythm to the tremors of your footsteps, the wolf-sized arachnid turns around, fixing eight ruby eyes on you. Its exoskeleton glimmers with the subdued luster of tarnished silver and seems just as strong. It moves with a chittering fluidity that hints at immense speed, and its fanged tips of its chelicera click, oozing unctuous venom that sizzles on the ground before it. Silky strands like large fishing nets surround this creature, and as you watch, it begins preparing a new web to launch toward you.

这台装置的外壳被做成一颗巨大的棉花糖，悬在高高的陆地上空。它在头顶的轨道上时不时猛地一晃。下方，常青林点缀着山谷，融雪覆在坚硬的花岗岩峰顶。地平线上，深蓝与淡紫在天幕下铺展开来。你坐的长椅软垫厚实、舒适，但这处境却让人隐隐觉得有些岌岌可危。
The casing of this contraption is shaped like a giant marshmallow, suspended high above the land. It lurches now and then on the track above it. Below, evergreen groves speckle the mountain valley, with melting snow covering the hard granite peaks. On the horizon, blues and lavenders stretch against the sky. Your bench seat is padded and comfortable, but the situation feels a little precarious.

名单上悬挂的旗幡华美夺目，旗上的传说与箴言在阳光下熠熠生辉。每位骑士的纹章骄傲地绘在盾面之上，昭示其血脉、功绩与胜利。鲜明的色彩与繁复的徽记更添这场比武大会的壮观，将这场盛事的仪典与恢弘衬托得淋漓尽致。
The banners adorning the list are stunning, and their legends and mottos sparkle in the sunlight. Each knight's coat of arms proudly graces their shield, boasting lineage, deeds, and triumphs. The vivid colors and intricate devices add to the spectacle of the tournament, highlighting the pageantry and grandeur of the illustrious event.

Half Plate Armor +1.name:
半身板甲 +1
Half Plate Armor +1

Text.text:
这件厚重的胸甲带着加固护领与钉饰肩甲。锁子甲进一步为甲片增添支撑，以皮带与黄铜扣具将各部牢牢束合。甲片的金属看似沉重笨拙，动作间却轻盈柔顺。再细看，那圈拢住护甲的凸起包边上，还刻着细密精致的符文。
The heavy cuirass features an armored collar and studded pauldrons. Chain mail further reinforces the plates, bound together with leather straps and brass buckles. The metal of the plates, appearing heavy and cumbersome, is light and supple in its movements. And upon closer inspection, you find finely-etched runes on the raised trim encasing the armor.

Cure Wounds To Stitch A Wound.name:
疗伤术：缝合伤口
Cure Wounds To Stitch A Wound

Text.text:
在你的接触下，一抹柔和的光芒被唤起，流淌向伤口，将其裹入温暖的辉光之中。转瞬之间，伤口便开始自行缝合，仿佛有一只无形之手在旁相助，又仿佛借由时代的流逝将其复原。
At your touch, a soft light is emitted and flows towards the wound, encasing it in its warm glow. Within a split second the wound begins to stitch itself back together, as if aided by an invisible hand and the passage of time.

Entrance Gate To Futuristic Desert City.name:
通往未来沙漠之城的入口大门
Entrance Gate To Futuristic Desert City

Text.text:
你尚未看见城，它的气息便先一步扑面而来：甜腻馥郁，像肉桂。越过沙丘的脊线，你瞥见城墙与那座巨门——一座巍然的砂岩雕刻拱门，沐在力场护盾的青蓝光辉里。护盾如海市蜃楼般，在荒漠的光热中轻轻荡漾。长长的悬浮运输车队缓慢爬行向前，而持械的人影只剩远处的黑色剪影，在门前巡弋。
The scent of the city hits you before you see it: sweet, like cinnamon. Beyond the crest of the dune, you glimpse the walls and the great gate—a colossal carved arch of sandstone glowing with the cyan light of a powershield. Like a mirage, the shield undulates in the desert light. Long convoys of hover-transports creep forward while armed figures, only distant black shadows, patrol the gate.

I Cast Hunter’s Mark.name:
我施放猎人印记
I Cast Hunter’s Mark

Text.text:
随着一声低语，我为猎物烙下印记。唯有我能看见的秘法符号，如炽烈的灯塔般在敌人身上浮现——而我感到了召唤。如今，他们再也无处可藏。
With a whispered word, I mark my quarry. A mystical symbol seen by my eyes alone appears on the body of my foe like a blazing beacon—and I feel the call. There is nowhere they can hide from me now.

你依照指示行事，在一条后巷里找到了公会大厅的入口——它藏在一段阴影笼罩的楼梯尽头。推门而入，你立刻想起自己去过的每一家荒僻小镇酒馆：刺鼻的气味、浓重的烟雾，以及喧闹的人声——有人放声唱歌，有人绘声绘色地编故事，也有人低吼着抛出威胁。这里的常客来自五湖四海，文化杂糅，既有近乡的熟面孔，也有异域的陌生风情。他们把武器当作随手之物，护甲穿得像日常衣装——每个人身上都带着冒险生涯留下的伤疤。最远的那面墙上，越过十几张桌子和沉重的橡木吧台，一块告示板上垂挂着密密麻麻的委托、悬赏与跑腿差事。
You follow the instructions provided, and find the guild hall's entrance in a back alley, at the bottom of a shadowed stairwell. Entering, you are immediately reminded of every backwater tavern you've ever visited—strong odors, heavy smoke, and raucous voices singing songs, spinning tales, and barking threats. The patrons are a mishmash of cultures hailing from places both near and distant, familiar and exotic. They carry weapons easily, wear armor comfortably—and each bears the scars of a life of adventuring. On the far wall, beyond a dozen tables and the heavy oaken bar, a bulletin board is draped with quest offers, bounties, and errands.

一袭优雅的灰袍垂落在这名女子纤细的身形上，衣摆缀着滚边，银线绣出若隐若现的符文。兜帽披肩之下，金色发丝环绕着她苍白的面庞；她凝视前方，容颜无瑕却冷峻如刻。她右手紧攥一根银色短杖，两端各嵌着一枚刻符的灵球。她低声呢喃，空着的那只手随之比划，空气因无形之力而嗡鸣，她的发梢也在光影中泛起变幻的色泽。

~ 由一位英雄 扮演

Elegant gray robes, adorned with hemming and subtle runes in silver thread, drape this woman’s slim frame. Blond tresses surround her pale face within the hooded mantle, and she stares out, face flawless but stern. In her right hand, she clutches a silvery rod with runed orbs at each end. As she whispers and gestures with her free hand, the air hums with unseen power and her hair ripples with various hues.

~ Played by a Hero with

冰冷的注视落在你身上，一种仿佛被拖入幽暗刺骨的寒水之下的感觉攫住了你。水面，就是你的自由意志。

[豁免失败] 你奋力挣扎，但另一股意志如黑水般淹没了你，你再也无法触及水面。你能感觉到自己在行动，却不再由你掌控。

[豁免成功] 你拒绝在那试图压制你意志的力量中溺亡，从搏斗中挣脱而出，仿佛终于吸到了久违的一口气。

Cold attention falls on you, and a feeling like being pulled under dark, frigid water takes hold. The surface is your free will.

[Failed Save] You struggle, but another will overwhelms yours like dark water in which you can’t reach the surface. You can sense yourself acting, but you’re no longer in control.

[Successful Save] You refuse to drown in the will striving to subdue yours, emerging from the struggle as if taking a long-needed breath.

他行动如踏地幽灵，脚底仿佛天生覆着软垫，落步无声。长满浓毛的双腿，小腿与大腿粗壮结实，托起一副肌肉虬结的躯干；胸前罩着一件不合身的胸甲，黑色熟皮煮制而成，硬挺而阴沉。过长的双臂向前伸展，利爪外张；樱红的眼珠以恶魔般的凝视锁定猎物。那颗木瓜般的头颅上竖着簇毛的耳朵，轻轻一颤；超乎常理的本能接管了身体，他一沉重心，快得像念头尚未成形，便已从背后的鞘中猛地抽出一柄长剑。
He moves like a specter on feet naturally padded for silent steps. Long furred legs, thick of calf and quad, lead to a muscled torso protected by an ill-fitting breastplate of black, boiled leather. His overlong arms are outstretched and claws extended as cherry eyes hold their quarry in a devil's gaze. The tufted ears that sprout from his papaya-shaped head twitch, and preternatural instinct takes over as he shifts his weight, moving faster than thought to pull a bastard sword from the scabbard at his back.

Stained Glass Depicting Vampires Being V.name:
描绘吸血鬼被诛灭的彩色玻璃窗
Stained Glass Depicting Vampires Being Vanquished

Text.text:
细碎的拼片与精密的铅条诉说着：这扇窗耗费了经年累月才得以完成。它覆满整面厅室墙壁——在深蓝色的玻璃夜空下，红与金交织成一幅发光的画面：一处战场。画中的吸血鬼尖啸着，抬起指端如刃的双手；身披金色护甲的骑士以木矛将他们贯穿，而笔直的长枪在原野上支撑着吸血鬼摇摇晃晃的尸身。窗子最远端的上角，一小块玻璃透出太阳的金光，穿过钢灰色的云层。
The small pieces and fine leading indicate that this window required years of work. It covers a wall of the chamber, a glowing tableau of reds and golds under a dark-blue sky of glass. A battlefield. The vampires depicted scream and raise sharp-fingered hands. Knights in gold armor skewer them with wooden spears, and upright pikes support the dangling bodies of vampires along the field. In the upper corner of the window’s far end, a small patch of glass shows the sun’s golden light through steel-gray clouds.

High Elf Community.name:
高等精灵社群
High Elf Community

Text.text: 闪耀的尖顶自皎白高塔之上拔地而起，在人类聚居地中无可匹敌——那是高等精灵一族所珍视的严谨之美与其妖精魔法的明证。街道与巷弄井然有序、洁净无瑕，哪怕最末等的贵族也会施展光亮咒术，使其泛着朦胧的珠光。不同于人类聚居地贸易广场上那种嗡鸣不止的喧嚣商气，这座高等精灵文化的堡垒由寂静所定义。即便在酒馆与会堂里，客人们也总以轻声、克制的语调交谈，不论情绪如何或醉意多深；每一次推搡、每一次挪动桌椅，都仿佛突兀得不合时宜。凡非高等精灵之身者，都会感到一双双目光如影随形，沉默地审视着所有被视作stranger之人。 Glittering spires of gleaming white towers are unmatched in human settlements—a testament to the precise beauty appreciated by the high elf people, and their fey magic. The streets and lanes are orderly and clean, glowing vaguely pearlescent thanks to the light-spells of even the least noble. Unlike the buzzing commerce associated with trade squares in human communities, this redoubt of high elf culture is defined by quiet. Even in taphouses and meeting halls patrons speak in quiet, measured tones, regardless of mood or inebriation, and every jostle or shift of furniture seems somehow out of place. Those who are not high elf in nature are followed by eyes silently judging all those deemed stranger.

Loot From A Winter Wolf.name:
冬狼的战利品
Loot From A Winter Wolf

Text.text:
在这名冰寒的狼族猎人颈间，你发现一圈粗糙的皮项圈，上面镶嵌着冰川般的宝石。皮革虽已磨损褪色，那些半透明的宝石合计仍值10枚金币。
Around the neck of the frigid lupine hunter, you find a crude leather collar embedded with glacial gems. Though the leather is worn and faded, the translucent gems are worth 10 gold pieces in total.

Cumulonimbus Cloud In The Sky.name:
天空中的积雨云
Cumulonimbus Cloud In The Sky

Text.text:
蘑菇状的云团中不时闪起电光，继而雷声炸裂，轰鸣作伴。你知道，一场短暂却倾盆的暴雨正迅速逼近。
Lightning flashes here and there within the mushroom-shaped clouds, punctuated by bursts of thunder. You know that a short but very heavy rainfall is well on its way.

野兽已扑到你面前，四肢着地猛冲而来。狰狞的利爪与寒光闪烁的獠牙在月色下掠过，它猛然一扑。你千钧一发侧身避开，那狼形生物擦地疾滑，骤然刹住，旋身便要再度攻击。月光下，你看清它骇人的面孔：带着讥笑的狼般长吻——双眼燃着不自然的狡黠。
The beast is upon you, charging in on all fours. Wicked claws and gleaming teeth flash in the moonlight as it lunges. You move aside just in time and the lupine creature skids to a halt, whirling to attack yet again. You behold its horrific visage in the moonlight: a sneering, wolf-like snout—eyes alight with an unnatural cunning.

把你一天里无视的弹窗警报数量拿来，乘以四十倍。几十个让人抓狂的动画角色一齐蹦出来，糖果般闪亮的媚眼女郎苦苦哀求着问：你寂寞吗？ 这就是你在目标的屏幕上埋下的雷区。除了不停把这些关掉之外，祝你还能干点别的，倒霉蛋。

~ 一位英雄所构想

Take the number of popup alerts you ignore in a day and multiply it fortyfold. Dozens of maddening animated characters appear, and pleading candy-eyed call girls ask Are you lonely? This is the minefield you make of your mark’s screen. Good luck doing anything besides closing these, sucker.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Courage’s Grave In Winter.name:
冬日的勇气之墓
Courage’s Grave In Winter

Text.text: 风吹散了墓碑铭文上的积雪，上面写着：勇气亲手铸就了自己的道路。纵然后来者无数追随他的脚印，也请记得——他会告诉你，走出你自己的路。毕竟，他的路最终把他带到了这里。 The wind has blown the snow from this grave’s epitaph, which reads: Courage forged his own path. Though many would follow in his footsteps, know that he would tell you to make your own way. After all, his path led him here.

Friendly Humanoid Lobster Says Hello.name:
友善的人形龙虾向你问好
Friendly Humanoid Lobster Says Hello

Text.text:
那生物从沼泽咸涩浑浊的水里升起，身上挂满藻类与水草，猛地将你惊住。它通体覆着赤褐色、分节的甲壳，两只鼓胀的黑眼从柔韧的眼柄上望向你。它挥舞着一只巨大的螯作招呼，像咕噜冒泡般用欢快的语调嘟囔着什么——听起来是在向你问好。

~ Envisioned by Angie on Discord

Rising from the brackish waters of the mire, covered in algae and weeds, the creature startles you. A ruddy, segmented shell covers its body, and two bulbous black eyes regard you from flexible stalks. Waving a huge claw in greeting, the lobster-like humanoid burbles something in a jovial tone. It seems to be saying hello.

~ Envisioned by Angie on Discord

这名矮人男子披着华美却不失实用的华服，金色胡须修剪得一丝不苟，细细洗净、打蜡，末端尖挺如针。每根手指都戴着戒指，镶着各不相同的宝石；你还闻到他身上飘来泥土与丁香交织的怡人香气。他露出一抹训练有素的笑，几颗银牙在唇间闪亮，随即伸出手向你致意。
The dwarf man, draped in fabulous but functional fineries, sports a closely trimmed golden beard, luxuriously washed and waxed to a fine point. Rings, each bearing a different gemstone, adorn his fingers, and you catch the pleasant scent of earth and lilac wafting from him. He cracks a practiced grin, revealing several silver teeth, and extends a hand in greeting.

这个盒子由粗糙的原木制成，以两道皮革与钢制的搭扣扣紧即可合拢。盒内放着一套石臼与杵，以及一把小巧的镰形刀。一只厚实的玻璃瓶占满其中一个凹槽，里面装着清澈的烈酒。其余格槽里则收纳着空小瓶、木制量勺、铁剪钳、小号钢锉，以及亚麻绷带与纱布。
Raw wood makes up this box, which can be held closed with two clasps of leather and steel. Inside is a stone mortar and pestle and a small sickle-shaped knife. A substantial glass bottle of clear spirits fills one slot. Others contain empty vials, wooden measuring spoons, iron clippers, a small steel file, and linen bandages and cheesecloth.

Loot From A Tyrannosaurus Rex.name:
暴龙身上的战利品
Loot From A Tyrannosaurus Rex

Text.text:
当这生物的内脏在它那起伏抽搐的爬行躯体周围汇成一滩，你在血肉残渣间瞥见一只腐烂的皮革挎包。翻开一看，里面是上一个不幸闯入这头野兽道路之人的遗物——260枚银币与120枚金币，是仅存还算完好的战利品。
As the creature’s innards pool on the ground around its heaving reptilian form, you notice a rotting leather satchel amid the offal. Inside you find the possessions of the last unfortunate to cross the beast’s path—260 silver pieces and 120 gold pieces are the only salvageable items.

Quip By A Cultist About Greater Purpose.name:
一名邪教徒讥诮道：凡人的悲欢不过尘埃——唯有更伟大的使命，才配你我献身。
Quip By A Cultist About Greater Purpose

Text.text:
“你替国王和平民跑些琐碎差事，而我们侍奉的才是真正的使命。这世界的命运正被推上棋局，有些博弈远非凡人所能计量；你竟妄想插手搅局，这份傲慢可笑至极。”
“You run mundane errands for kings and townsfolk, while we serve a true purpose. There are games being played for the fate of this world that are beyond mortal reckoning, and your arrogance in thinking you can disturb them is laughable.”

Aftermath Of Massacre.name:
大屠杀余波
Aftermath Of Massacre

Text.text:
这里发生过某种亵渎的惨剧。曾经宁静如画的小镇街道如今遍布尸骸，被野兽般的凶残撕裂、蹂躏。内脏涂抹在墙上，血淋淋的手印拖痕划过上了闩的门窗——你怀疑在这场屠杀中，没有任何人能在此找到庇护。

~ thebigham 构想

Something unholy happened here. The once idyllic streets of the town are littered with bodies, torn and ravaged with savage ferocity. Viscera paints the walls, and bloody handprints streak across barred doors and windows—you doubt anyone found refuge from the massacre here.

~ Envisioned by thebigham

High City Walls On A Snowy Night.name:
雪夜高城墙
High City Walls On A Snowy Night

Text.text:
一道坚固的木制壁障拔地而起，几乎与周围的树木一般高；许多树已被砍削清理，形成一圈便于防守的边界。你仰起脖颈，眯眼顶着坠落的雪片，瞥见墙头有移动的影子：三顶头盔在火把光里一闪。两颗脑袋迅速缩了回去，取而代之的是两张短弓，弓身一抖，便抖落两道沉积的雪线。“报上来意！”粗哑的喝问裹着纷飞的雪粉传来。

~ 一位英雄 Envisioned

A sturdy wooden barrier rises nearly as high as the surrounding trees, many of which have been cut back to create a defensible perimeter. Craning your neck and squinting against the falling flakes, you spy movement at the top of the wall: three helmets illuminated by torchlight. Two of the heads duck away. The two shortbows that take their places dislodge twin lines of settled snow. “State your business!” The gruff call is carried on the fluttering powder.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

狂风凶狠得如同嚎叫，穿过每一条走廊、每一条隧道，吵得你连自己的思绪都听不清。它以不歇的尖啸与呜咽灌满每一处空间，拍击的气流几乎要把你从脚下掀翻。
A wind so fierce and howling you cannot hear yourself think blows through every corridor, every tunnel. It fills every space with its incessant howling whine, the buffeting current threatening to take you off your feet.

这件大师杰作几乎不再像一副甲板，如今伪装成一方金属口袋巾。为把它改造成一件安全又便携的工具，投入了大量工艺：热纹验证解锁甲板，一块无与伦比的优雅伸缩键盘展开时浮现全息键帽。电池也被先进主板补强，泛着不祥的幽绿光芒。它没有任何导线——取而代之的是磁性牵引系统，让使用者可将甲板悬停在半空中，便于操作。头部结节的位置被语音指令所替代：一句口令便能唤醒纳米科技半面罩，将使用者送入网络。

~ 由一位英雄构想

This masterwork barely resembles a deck, now disguised as a pocket-square of metal. Much work has been done to convert it into a secure and portable tool. Heat-signature verification unlocks the deck and a peerlessly elegant extendable keyboard sports holographic keys. The battery has been supplemented with advanced motherboards, glowing a sinister green. No wires exist—instead, a magnetic leash system allows the user to hover the deck midair for easy operation. In place of head nodules, voice commands activate a nanotech half-mask to transport the user into the Net.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

法术从你唇间逸出之际，你感到舌尖一阵刺痛，露出的笑齿随之轻颤。尽管你无法确切理解自己说了什么，你却看见你的目标面容瞬间垮塌，彻底的绝望覆上眉眼，不安的水光漫涌进他们的眼底。你的魔法嘲弄一击中的。
As the spell leaves your lips, you feel a sting on the tip of your tongue, a vibration in your smiling teeth. Though you cannot comprehend exactly what you said, you see your target’s face fall into utter despair, a sheen of insecurity flooding their eyes. Your magical mockery has struck true.

Hexidor “Hex” Silverring.name:
海克西多尔“海克斯”·西尔弗林
Hexidor “Hex” Silverring

Text.text:
随着一记腾跃般的猛跳，这名凌厉的兔人族盗贼如陨星坠地般落入盗匪之中，将他们撞得四散翻滚，摔进泥浆。湛蓝如海的眼眸被深色、轮廓分明的花纹皮毛环绕，此刻锐光一闪，目标明确；他朝盗匪的猎物投去一个英雄式的笑容，随即爆裂般展开行动。钢刃成风，他在泥泞中缴械那些正挣扎起身的匪徒，让他们粗陋的武器在疾风般的轻巧下纷纷脱手、滚落。罪犯们仓皇逃窜之际，他向地上瑟瑟发抖的农夫伸出手，仁善的暖意掠过他那兔般的面容。

~ Played by Corey Reedy

With a bounding leap, the striking harefolk rogue lands amid the bandits like a meteor, scattering them into the mud. Blue-ocean eyes, encircled by dark, distinctively marked fur, flash with purpose as he offers a heroic smile to the bandits’ quarry before launching into explosive action. In a whirlwind of steel, he disarms the brigands rising from the muck, sending their crude weapons tumbling with tempestuous ease. As the criminals flee, he offers a hand to the terrified farmer on the ground, a benevolent warmth washing over his leporine features.

~ Played by Corey Reedy

Mercenary In Esoteric Armor.name:
秘甲佣兵
Mercenary In Esoteric Armor

Text.text:
这名鱼类佣兵满口针状利齿层层叠叠，沉重的火器在他们手中却轻若无物——鳞皮之下巨大的肌肉隆起如浪，力量呼之欲出——可护甲却出奇地缺席。取而代之的不是躯干护甲，而是一张由相连节点织成的精巧网格：每一枚都不过珍珠大小，闪烁着柔和的蓝光。也许这套古怪装置所蕴藏的力量，远超你的想象。
The piscine mercenary has rows upon rows of needle-like teeth and carries their weighty firearm with ease—huge muscles bulging beneath scaled skin—yet armor is curiously lacking. Instead of body armor they wear a delicate grid of connected nodes, each no larger than a pearl and twinkling with soft blue light. Perhaps this strange apparatus holds more power than you know.

所有天使兽都散发着高等存在的光辉，但这一位身上还带着几分游侠般的狡黠魅力。绿毛覆身、猫头鹰般的面孔，这生物身形修长，背生一对覆羽的翅膀，却不见手臂或护甲——至少表面看不出来。他们懒洋洋地后仰着，漫不经心，把一枚硬币随手抛向空中；那张猫头鹰似的脸上缓缓绽开一抹讨喜的笑容。腰间挂着一袋偷来的贵重物品，随着动作叮当作响。
All agathions radiate a glow of higher being, but this one also has an air of roguish charm about it. Green furred with an owlish face, the creature is slender, sporting a pair of feathered wings but no arms or armor—at least nothing obvious. They lean back, nonchalant, tossing a coin lazily up into the air as a winsome grin peels across the owl-like face. A bag of pilfered valuables clinks at their waist.

Token Gifted By Hag.name:
鬼婆（特征）赐予的衍体
Token Gifted By Hag

Text.text:
这件垂挂的小饰物由一堆零碎杂物胡乱拼凑而成，用盘绕的蛛丝和纠结的毛发草草串起。泛黄的牙齿、失去光泽的钱币、一枚倒刺鱼钩，以及其他难以辨认的物件一同堆叠，凝成一枚强大鬼婆的信物。
The dangling trinket comprises a mishmash of bits and bobbles, strung together haphazardly with coiled spider silk and matted hair. Yellowed teeth, tarnished coins, a barbed fishhook, and other indiscernible items all combine to form the token of a powerful hag.

Dingy Fast-food Franchise Restaurant.name:
昏暗肮脏的连锁快餐店
Dingy Fast-food Franchise Restaurant

Text.text:
这地方的烤盘上覆着一层层厚重的黄油垢；尘土、死虫与丢弃的残食散落在肮脏、久未清洗的地面上。一名不过十六岁的收银员满脸痘痘，神情冷漠，用手背把鼻涕一抹，伴着一声湿黏的“啪”。抹完后，他似乎也心满意足地不打算去洗手。
Thick yellow layers of grease coat the griddle in this place, while dust, dead insects, and discarded food litter the grimy, unwashed floor. A disinterested, acne-riddled cashier no more than sixteen wipes their nose against the back of their hand with a wet pop. They seem content to not wash afterward.

Obsidian Leader Of Demon Horde.name:
黑曜石恶魔大军统帅
Obsidian Leader Of Demon Horde

Text.text:
翻涌的邪恶洪流被硬生生分开，藏在其中的恶魔在那道黑曜石般皮肤的身影踏入时瑟缩退避。即便是高大、长角的怪物也不由得畏缩，让它们的主人逼近前行——那模糊不清的轮廓渗出令人作呕的恶意气息。紧随这名腐败的暴君之后，乌压压的群魔凝聚成满载敌意的方阵，獠牙大张，双眼燃起仇恨的烈焰。

~ 由 Rakio 构想

The churning mass of wickedness parts, the demons within cowering away from the obsidian-skinned figure striding through their midst. Even massive, horned monstrosities flinch away as their master stalks forward, an aura of visceral evil bleeding from its indistinct form. Behind this blighted tyrant, the horde coalesces into phalanxes of utter hostility, fanged mouths agape, their eyes blazing with hatred.

~ Envisioned by Rakio

Old Spirewych And Elderview Hall.name:
古老的尖塔巫居与远望厅
Old Spirewych And Elderview Hall

Text.text:
以埃德尔维尤大厅与城镇服务为中心，这座城市最古老的城区铺展着鹅卵石步行小径，一座刻纹若有若无、带着幽幽寒意的喷泉，以及经过精心规划、交织呈现的三段城市建筑年代。多数老屋早已歪斜不正，却被妥善加固并持续使用；而新式建筑则刻意融入旧城韵味——店门上方垂落的木瓦檐、镶嵌铅条的彩窗、以及以石质转角石勾勒轮廓的墙面。埃德尔维尤大厅之名，源自市长能清晰拥有通往学院高塔的视觉线。
With Elderview Hall and Town Services at its center, the oldest ward in the city is a place of cobbled pedestrian walks, a fountain of subtly haunting carvings, and a carefully planned mix of the city’s three ages of architecture. Most of the old buildings aren’t plumb, but they’re kept safe and in use, while modern buildings are designed with oldtown touches, such as shingles hanging over shop doors, leaded glass, and buildings with stone quoins. Elderview Hall is named for the mayor’s clear line of sight to the Academy tower.

那柄邪异的赤红利刃，刃身上纵贯着深邃漆黑的铭刻，闪烁着不自然的光芒。剑柄坚实，棱角冷硬，延伸至狭窄的握把，仿佛几乎要压不住这柄嗜血的刀锋。它似乎在低低嗡鸣，带着细微的震颤能量，每一次挥斩都更加强烈。若能一击臻于完美，又有什么不能被它一分为二？
The wicked red blade with deep, black engravings along its length glimmers with an unnatural light. The hilt is sturdy and shaped with harsh edges, leading to a narrow grip that looks barely able to hold back the thirsty blade. It seems to hum with a soft buzzing energy, which grows stronger with each sweep of the blade. With a perfect strike, what could it not cleave in two?

Keep Within A Castle.name:
困守城堡之内
Keep Within A Castle

Text.text:
要塞如山岳不屈的心脏般巍然屹立，守夜着城堡与其中的居民。旗帜在城垛顶端的旗杆上骄傲飞扬，警觉的哨兵在飘动的旌旗下巡行。
Standing strong like the unyielding heart of a mountain, the keep watches over the castle and its inhabitants. Flags fly proudly from poles atop the battlements, and watchful sentries patrol beneath the fluttering pennants.

Ally's Terrifying Transformation.name:
盟友的骇人蜕变
Ally's Terrifying Transformation

Text.text:
双眼翻白，你的同伴陷入骇人的恍惚，随即开始抽搐。他们的头发如枯秋落叶般簌簌脱落，骄傲的犄角向内缩退，没入颅骨；四肢以令人毛骨悚然的速度拉长、扭曲、变形。就在同伴战栗之际，他们的嘴以不可能的方式扩张——而站在你面前的，已不再是他们。

~ 由 Inbal 于 Discord 上 构想

Eyes rolling back, your companion falls into a disturbing stupor as they begin to shake. Their hair falls away like dry autumn leaves, and their proud horns shrink into their skull as limbs stretch and warp with horrifying speed. Their mouth expands in impossible ways as your companion shudders—and something else stands before you.

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

Elemental Bane: Cold.name:
元素祸害：寒冷
Elemental Bane: Cold

Text.text:
凛冽的能量在你体内翻涌盘旋，凝成一道闪烁如冰川寒光的灵光气晕。魔法之风灌满空气，携着冬日冰冷的恶意。你身形微微闪烁，在你与远处的宿敌之间开启一道通路，试图剥离他们的防护，削弱他们抵抗你所驾驭力量的能力。
Frigid energies swirl within you, creating a shimmering aura of glacial cold. Winds of magic fill the air, the icy spite of winter. Your form flickers as you open a channel between you and your distant foe, attempting to strip away their defenses and reduce their ability to resist the powers you command.

I Commune With An Eldritch Horror.name:
我与一头诡秘古怖灵性交感
I Commune With An Eldritch Horror

Text.text:
这些对我心灵幽暗殿堂的造访，总能让我浑身冷汗淋漓。我听见的语言陌生至极，可我却能将其含义分毫不差地理解。它像一只啮齿动物在我后脑墙壁里抓挠，又像战鼓的雷鸣在高耸洞窟的石壁间来回撞击。我听见它的训诫，以及对崇拜的索求。力量的触须如蛇般缠上我的身躯，我被迫服从。
These visits in the shadowed halls of my mind never fail to drench me in a cold sweat. The language I hear is unfamiliar, and yet I understand its meaning perfectly. It is like a rodent scratching in a wall behind my head, and also like the thunder of war drums bouncing off high cavern walls. I hear its instruction and the demand for adoration. Feeling tendrils of power snake around me, I am compelled to obey.

River In Cave.name:
洞中河流
River In Cave

Text.text:
河水清冽湍急，从桥下奔涌而过，掠过一处码头，几艘划艇随波轻轻起伏。船只的存在暗示这条河可供航行，但你看不出该往上游还是下游旅行的任何线索。河水自幽暗中来，又流入更深的阴影。
The water flows fast and clean, running under the bridge and past a quay where rowboats bob. The presence of the boats suggests the river is navigable, but you can see no hint of whether one should travel upstream or down. The river comes from the dark and flows into shadow.

Blind Human's Quip About Footsteps.name:
盲眼人类对脚步声的俏皮话
Blind Human's Quip About Footsteps

Text.text:
“从一个人走路的样子，你就能看出太多东西。比如你，走起路来咚咚作响，仿佛全世界的目光都理应追着你转。还有你——脚步轻飘又凌乱，像是随时都在憋尿。人们时时刻刻都在暴露真实的自己，你只需要用心去听。”

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，出自 Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

“You can tell so much about a person by the way they walk. You, for example, stomp around as if you deserve the whole world’s attention. And you—your steps are soft and irregular as if always needing to pee. People expose their true selves all the time. You simply have to listen.”

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Loot From An Adult Black Dragon.name:
成年黑龙的战利品
Loot From An Adult Black Dragon

Text.text:
在那头曾经不可一世的巨型黑龙残躯上搜寻时，你找到一件耐人寻味的头环——这条死去的巨龙竟将它当作耳饰佩戴。青金石镶边上爬满晦涩的秘文，其间点缀着细小的宝石，闪烁着未知力量的幽光。
Searching the once mighty corpse of the massive black dragon turns up an interesting circlet which the deceased wyrm used as an earring. Esoteric script crawls around the lapis lazuli edge, punctuated by small gemstones, glimmering with unknown power.

Victory And Revenge.name:
胜利与复仇
Victory And Revenge

Text.text:
战斗的喧嚣渐渐退去，随之而来的，是一种近乎不自然的死寂。空气里沉甸甸地挂着血与汗的腥味；你喘着粗气，武器上血肉淋漓地往下滴，随着肾上腺素退潮，伤口开始一阵阵发疼——你终于意识到自己站在胜者的位置上，却并非毫无代价。你的朋友与你的盟友倒在自己血泊之中，双眼圆睁，毫不眨动地望着天空。他们曾英勇无畏，曾奋不顾身，而如今却只能躺在这里。这份失去——是否毫无意义？你多少已讨回了些许血债——可这就够了吗？胜利的滋味，苦涩里带着甜。

~ Envisioned by Qualden

The din of battle fades, and with it comes an almost unnatural stillness. The smell of blood and sweat hangs heavy on the air, and as you catch your breath, gore dripping from your weapons, injuries aching as your adrenaline leaves you, you realize you stand victorious—but not without a cost. Your friend and ally lies in a pool of their own blood, eyes wide as they stare unblinking upward. They were valiant, brave, and yet here they lie. This loss—was it senseless? Some semblance of revenge has been doled out—is it enough? The taste of victory is bittersweet.

~ Envisioned by Qualden

这根狭窄的编织绳索呈乳白色，带着些微光泽与泥土般的气味。绳体由数十股细密的丝线拧绞而成，盘起一圈几乎不怎么压手。尽管长度可观，它所占的空间却远比植物纤维制成的绳索要少得多。
This narrow, braided cord is off-white with a slight sheen and an earthy odor. The rope itself is made of dozens of fine, twisted silk strings. The coil doesn’t weigh much. Despite its considerable length, it takes up far less space than rope made of plant fiber.

细小的酸橙绿幽絮在一汪黑水之上轻轻浮沉。有人靠近时，它们会瞬间熄灭，随即在扰动的另一处伴着清晰可闻的闪烁声重新出现。它们召来的光没有近旁火盆的暖意，反倒让周遭空气像一层冰冷帘幕垂落。水池边缘粗砺参差，显然不是这处建筑群原本规划的构造——更像是被什么东西硬生生掘出来的。三条褐色根须刺穿环绕水池的石砖，肆意弯折着探入那片蓝色深渊。紧贴水面正北，高耸的木柜堵死了视线，后方的一切都被遮蔽。它们摆放得杂乱无章——仿佛仓促拖来，勉强当作一道壁垒。水池里传来缓慢的咕嘟声。气泡自深处涌出，鼓胀与爆裂一秒比一秒更大。 Tiny, lime-green wisps bob above a pool of dark water. When approached, they wink out of existence for a moment before reappearing with an audible shimmer elsewhere in the disturbance. The light they conjure does not offer the warmth of the glowing braziers nearby, instead, the air about them is a chill curtain. The rugged edges around the pool suggest this was not a planned feature for this complex: rather it appears to have been burrowed. Three brown roots have pierced the stone tile surrounding the pool to bend wantonly into the blue abyss. Directly to the north of the water, tall wooden cabinets block sight of anything beyond. They are placed haphazardly—as if dragged in haste as a kind of bulwark. A slow burble comes from the pool. Bubbles emerge from the depths, the swelling and bursts growing larger by the second.

这把武器的枪头由某种巨型生物参差狰狞的獠牙打磨而成，枪杆则由珊瑚凿削、抛光，并缠以植物纤维制成的顺手握把。无论它的材质与来历如何，都没人会误判这柄怪异却久经沙场的三叉戟之坚实可靠。
The head of this weapon has been fashioned from the jagged tooth of some immense creature, and the shaft is chipped from coral and buffed with smooth grips of plant matter. Regardless of its construction and origin, none can mistake the soundness of this unusual but battle-tested trident.

I Clean My Gold-trim Glasses.name:
我擦拭那副镶金边的眼镜
I Clean My Gold-trim Glasses

Text.text:
我小心地朝镜片呼出一口气，让它们蒙上一层淡淡的雾气，同时伸手去取腰侧小盒里那块柔软的天鹅绒布。有人或许会说我这副眼镜的镀金镜框太过华丽、甚至多此一举，但既然风格与实用可以兼得，又何必为了实用牺牲品味？再说了——我也想看清自己戴上它们时有多好看。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

I breathe carefully on the lenses, fogging them slightly, as I reach for the soft velvet cloth in the small case at my hip. Some might say the gilded frames of my glasses are too opulent or unnecessary, but why sacrifice style for practicality when you can have both? Plus, I want to be able to see how good I look in them.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Maze Of Paths.name:
路径迷宫
Maze Of Paths

Text.text:
阴影笼罩的小径蜿蜒通向传送门，错综的路线与阶梯在黑暗中纵横交错，宛如令人发狂的迷宫。它们短暂相汇，旋即再度分岔，分支伸展后又一次在传送门的门槛前重新汇聚。
The shadowed paths wind their way up to the portal, a maddening maze of routes and stairs cutting through the darkness. They meet briefly before splitting off again, branching off before converging yet again at the threshold of the portal.

Nearby Grenade Renders Those Nearby Temp.name:
近处爆炸的手榴弹使周围的人暂时失聪
Nearby Grenade Renders Those Nearby Temporarily Deaf

Text.text:
你瞪大双眼，看着手雷在不远处停下，仍在旋转，随即以震耳欲聋的巨响轰然爆炸。可怕的嗡鸣灌满你的耳朵，抹去一切其他声音；你踉跄着远离爆心，爆炸的热浪灼得皮肤发红，你拼命寻找掩体，想要稳住呼吸，找回自己的感官。环顾四周，你看见同样被卷入爆炸的人们摇摇晃晃，双手死死捂住耳朵，身体笨拙地打着摆子，平衡感被彻底打乱。
Your eyes widen as the grenade comes to a rest nearby, still spinning as it detonates with a deafening boom. A terrible ringing fills your ears, eradicating all other sound as you stumble away from the blast, your skin flushed from the heat of the explosion as you desperately try to seek shelter and regain your senses. Looking around, you see others who were caught in the blast staggering as they clasp hands over their ears, teetering clumsily as their equilibrium shifts.

A Horse Wearing Horseshoes Of A Zephyr.name:
一匹钉着疾风马蹄铁的骏马
A Horse Wearing Horseshoes Of A Zephyr

Text.text:
越过原野，在低垂夕阳的斑斓映衬下，几乎成了剪影——一匹母马正全速疾驰。她鼻与口间喷出的团团白气拖曳在身后，掠过石南丛，穿过道路，直抵湖岸。随后她奔向湖面，在起伏粼粼的水上飞驰，迅疾而优美，笔直如轻舟，干爽如空气，蹄尖离那蔚蓝仅四寸，不起一丝涟漪，也不留半道尾波。
Across the fields and against the colors of a low sun, nearly in silhouette, there is a horse at full gallop. Puffs of breath trail from her nose and mouth as she races over the heather, crosses the road, and then reaches the lakeshore. Then she runs out onto the lake, fast and beautiful over the rippling water, straight as a skiff, dry as the air, hooves four inches above the blue and leaving no wake.

这名精灵男子肤色黝黑，头皮剃得干净，只在头顶留着一簇缠结的脏辫，像冠冕般利落堆起。脸与颈间的纹身刻意画成缝合线的模样：颈部正中一圈断续的“针脚”，嘴角两侧各有两道线向外延伸。他穿着一件淡蓝色短外套，金色纽扣一闪一闪；下身是宽松的黑裤，点缀着一抹旋涡般的蓝金线条。两条卷尺分别搭在他肩上，像祭司披垂的领带般垂落，他若有所思地用指尖沿着卷尺两侧缓缓抚过。你注意到他的手上也布满同样的“缝线”纹身。

~ 出自惊艳的 TTRPG 增补 The Vineyard

The elven man is dark-skinned, his head shaved except for a crop of dreaded locks piled stylishly on his crown. His face and neck are tattooed to resemble stitched seams: a line around the middle of his neck, two extending from each corner of his mouth. He wears a light blue jacket that winks with golden buttons and a pair of loose black pants decorated with a splash of swirling blue and gold lines. A length of measuring tape drapes over each shoulder like a priestly stole, and he drags his fingers down each side thoughtfully. You note his hands have more of those seam tattoos.

~ Found in the amazing TTRPG supplement The Vineyard

Loot From A Red Dragon Wyrmling Hoard.name:
红龙幼龙宝藏中的战利品
Loot From A Red Dragon Wyrmling Hoard

Text.text:
你穿行在雏龙的宝藏堆上，脚下踏着钱币打滑作响。一柄长枪横陈其间，蓝钢枪头、铁木枪杆，被雏龙的炽焰龙息熏得焦黑——却未被摧毁。另一条龙的头骨，或许是某个宿敌，被戏谑般地高高搁起，用来盛放一捧宝石，宛如一只阴森的糖果碗。
You find your feet slipping over coins as you traverse the wyrmling’s hoard. A pike, with a head of blue steel and shaft of ironwood, lies charred—but not destroyed—by the wyrmling’s flaming breath. The skull of another dragon, a rival perhaps, is perched mockingly to hold a collection of gemstones, like a macabre candy bowl.

这只背包的部分结构由抛光木板组成，木板上雕刻着神圣符号与卷草纹饰；条纹帆布则将其余部分连缀成形。背包底部牢牢固定着一个小木匣，开着两道狭窄的投入口，恰好够将钱币滑入其中。木匣旁以细链垂挂着一只青铜香炉，轻轻晃动。香的气息萦绕在袋边，久久不散。
Polished wooden panels carved with holy symbols and scrollwork make up parts of this backpack; striped canvas completes the structure. Fastened to the pack’s bottom is small wooden box with two narrow slots, just big enough to slide coins through. Dangling alongside the box from thin chains is a censer made of bronze. The scent of incense hangs around the bag.

Ancient Purple Dragon's Entrance.name:
远古紫龙的登场
Ancient Purple Dragon's Entrance

Text.text:
在电光噼啪作响的火山之巅，一头巨大的紫色巨龙盘踞其上，头顶竟插着一根蓝龙之角与一根红龙之角。它起身，张开双翼，俯冲而下，吐出一束狂暴的等离子洪流，将大地上一条漫长的地带熔融扭曲，宛如被犁开般深陷。巨龙重重落地，震得地面颤抖。它咆哮——可在你的脑海里，那轰鸣之声却化作清晰的言语。它宣告自己至高无上的权威，宣告自己必须将世界校准到应有的平衡——以秩序驯服混沌。

~ 由 Snakekeeper7 在 Envisioned 中构想

On a volcanic mountaintop crackling with electricity squats a massive purple dragon sporting on its head one blue dragon’s horn and one red dragon’s horn. It stands, spreads its wings, and swoops down, letting loose a blast of powerful plasma that melts and warps a long tract into the earth. The dragon lands heavily, shaking the ground. It roars, but in your mind, you understand the booming voice. It speaks of its absolute authority and its need to properly balance the world—to bring order to chaos.

~ Envisioned by Snakekeeper7

Town In A Tropical Paradise.name:
热带天堂中的小镇
Town In A Tropical Paradise

Text.text:
小镇紧贴着岛屿如画的海岸线，栖身于拍岸的碧绿浪涛之上。码头向海面伸展，各式可口佳肴、异域美酒与神秘奇珍皆由此抵达。小船在水面悠然起伏，渔夫撒网收线，捕回的收获将为终将到来的盛宴备下食粮。
The town hugs the idyllic coast of the island, perched over the lapping turquoise waves. Docks extend outward, by which all manner of delicious food, exotic drink, or mysterious curio arrives here. Boats bob lazily in the water while fishers cast their nets, bringing in food for an eventual feast.

Stirge Nest Inside.name:
吸血蚊巢穴内部
Stirge Nest Inside

Text.text:
黑暗中，你听见皮革般的翅膜扑簌振动。一个影子倏地掠过你的行进路线，转瞬没入阴影。空气里沉甸甸地悬着一股金属般刺鼻的腥臭。遍地散落着无数生物发黄的骨骸——有的类人，有的非类人。某种诡异而不祥的预感拽住你的思绪；当你后颈寒毛倒竖时，你才明白已经太迟。那些骇人的怪物——巨型蚊虫与蝙蝠畸形糅合的怪诞之物——自藏身处俯冲而下，只为你的血而来。
In the dark, you hear the fluttering of leathery wings. A shape darts across your path, disappearing into the shadows. A stench, metallic and acrid, hangs heavy in the air. Yellowed bones of myriad creatures—some humanoid, some otherwise—litter the ground. A strange, foreboding sensation tugs at your mind, and as the hairs stand on the back of your neck, you realize it's too late. The horrid beasts, a monstrous mingling of oversized mosquito and bat, descend from concealment—seeking only your blood.

Faerie Plane: Lair Of A Giant Toad.name:
妖精位面：巨型蟾蜍的巢穴
Faerie Plane: Lair Of A Giant Toad

Text.text: 你从洞窟深处听见一声低沉的咕噜，一堆泥浆随即蠕动，猛地拱起翻涌。泥淖被顶破，一张灰褐色的巨蟾脸钻了出来——宽得几乎能横跨一辆马车。它猛然放出一记雷鸣般的CROAK，回声在洞壁间来回撞击，震得地面都在发颤。一团分叉的舌尖从它沾满烂泥的嘴唇间探出。 You hear a single, deep gurgle from within the cave and a mound of mud wriggles before heaving upward. The wide, gray-brown face of a giant toad—as wide across as a horse cart—breaks through the muck. It lets loose a thunderous CROAK that bounces off the walls of the cavern and makes the ground shudder. A forked glob of a tongue peeks out from between its mud-caked lips.

Cure Wounds By Cauterizing.name:
灼烧止血疗伤
Cure Wounds By Cauterizing

Text.text:
以火净化，古老得与最初的熔炉同岁。这双手的按覆既不温柔，也不宽宥。循着医匠的仪式，皮肉被灼得合拢，终将愈合为一枚圣痕。我们留下印记，在神祇面前锻塑肉身的韧性。

~ 由 EZ构想

Purification by fire is as old as the original forge. This laying on of hands is not gentle, nor does it pardon. By the rite of the healer-smiths the flesh sears closed and will mend to a holy scar. We leave the mark and shape the body’s resilience before the gods.

~ Envisioned by EZ

Prince Of Dark Pleasures.name:
暗欲之王
Prince Of Dark Pleasures

Text.text:
老家伙和蔼的脸忽然剧烈地扭动起来，仿佛正被一场地震撕扯。可他既不因疼痛而尖叫，也不显出丝毫恐惧——相反，一抹讥笑在那蠕动的皮肉上蔓开，随后整张脸彻底裂开。皮肉、头发、衣物像浸透的面包一样一块块坠落在地。其间，另一个身影拔地而起：一个身形高大得压迫人的恶魔，皮肤紫得像淤青，头发与皮肤仍被伪装时的血污浸得油亮。他用分蹄一脚踢开老人的残余。黄猫般的獠牙在大笑中铺陈开来。“凡人。用一张慈眉善目的脸就能轻易把你们引上钩。”一柄黑曜石长剑在他那只长着利爪的六指手中凭空凝成。

~ 构想：Edward

The old fellow’s genial face suddenly wriggles violently, as if caught in a quake. But he does not cry out in pain nor look afraid—instead, a sneer spreads across his squirming flesh as his face fully splits. Flesh, hair, clothing drop to the floor like pieces of wet bread. From this, another figure rises: a demon of imposing height and skin as purple as a bruise, his hair and skin still slick from the gore of his disguise. He kicks away the remnants of the old man with cloven feet. Yellow cat’s teeth spread as he laughs. “Mortals. So easy to draw in with a kind face.” An obsidian sword materializes in his clawed, six-fingered hand.

~ Envisioned by Edward

Speech About A Hunger For Greatness.name:
关于对伟大的饥渴的演说
Speech About A Hunger For Greatness

Text.text:
“我不去追逐伟大——我索取它。每一次成功都会苦涩而空洞，直到我夺回与生俱来的权柄。记住我的话，我必将得到它……哪怕要从命运被肢解的尸骸上，生生撕下来。”
“I do not seek out greatness—I demand it. Every success will be bitter and empty until I achieve my birthright. And mark my words, I will achieve it… even if it means tearing it from fate’s butchered corpse.”

Glamorous Lounge Singer.name:
魅惑的酒廊歌手
Glamorous Lounge Singer

Text.text:
表演者以摇曳生姿的优雅游走于性别之间，缀满亮片的行头泛着磷光般的华彩，在举手投足间牢牢攫住观众的目光。穿过酒廊里烟雾与香水交织的薄霭，他们宛如摄人心魄的海妖——每一个音符都在引诱酒客更深地坠入他们的法术之中。
The performer walks the line between genders with sashaying grace, their sequined attire shimmering with phosphorescent elegance as they command the attention of the audience. Through the haze of smoke and perfume in the lounge, they appear as a captivating siren—each note tempting the patrons further under their spell.

某场浩劫吞没了这片滨水地带——也许是一场风暴——可你很难想象，得是怎样的巨浪才能把船只抛上街道、将码头的木板硬生生撕扯下来。不管那究竟是什么，这场灾害似乎迫使人们弃地而去。你眼下能见到的唯一“居民”，只有几只被你惊起的海鸟。
Some calamity claimed this waterfront—a storm, perhaps—although it’s hard to imagine the waves that could toss ships ashore onto streets and rip the planks from piers. Whatever it was, the disaster seems to have caused people to abandon the place. The only inhabitants you see are some seabirds startled by your presence.

一个瘦削、苍白的精灵站在那里，身着朴素长袍，外披一件上好的斗篷。他的皮肤泛着淡淡的蓝色，头发是一团褪色的灰，半束成半马尾。左耳尖缺了一截。脸部棱角分明却平淡无奇，唯有那片凌乱的锯齿状疤痕格外刺目——从喉间起始，仿佛一路向下延伸。他的动作带着一种不自然的静止感，像是世间的一切声响与景象对他而言都还陌生。沉暗的眼睛在厚重眼睑下左右急扫，警惕地搜寻着房间里的危险。

~ 由一位英雄 扮演

A gaunt, pale elf stands clad in simple robes and a nice cloak. His skin is faintly blue, his hair a shock of faded gray tied up into a half ponytail. The tip of his left ear is missing. His face is angular and unremarkable, apart from the mess of jagged scars that begin at his throat and seem to continue downwards. He moves with an unnatural stillness, as though all the sounds and sights of the world are new to him. Dark eyes with heavy lids dart back and forth, scanning the room for danger.

~ Played by a Hero

Hallucinogenic Street Drug, Eros.name:
致幻街头毒品：爱洛斯
Hallucinogenic Street Drug, Eros

Text.text:
这小瓶蓝色液体看起来无害得很，毕竟它的用途早已司空见惯。它是一剂梦境灵药，超越庸常世界，将清醒的意识与幻想交织。它的低语模仿着 Novacoke 的欣快气息，却又闪烁着近似清醒梦的细微幻觉。纳米化学的混合物松开抑制，如一场无声风暴裹住使用者，披上一层朦胧魅光，催旺魅力，膨胀自我。
The vial of blue liquid seems harmless enough, its use is widespread after all. A dream elixir, transcending the mundane world, weaving the conscious mind with fantasy. Its whispers ape Novacoke's euphoric vibe, yet shimmer with subtle hallucination akin to waking dreams. The nanochemical blend frees inhibition, like a quiet storm enfolding users in a nebulous glamor, enhancing charisma, bloating ego.

Quip About Exhaustion.name:
关于疲惫的俏皮话
Quip About Exhaustion

Text.text:
“折磨我的不只是肉体的疲惫。只要心智一旦脆弱，我所有内心的恶魔就会趁机出来作祟。”
“It’s not just the physical exhaustion I feel. When my mind is weakened, all my inner demons come out to play.”

Speak With Dead.name:
与亡者交谈
Speak With Dead

Text.text:
熏香辛辣刺鼻，气势逼人。烟雾缠绕着你——也缠绕着你面前的尸体。令人不安的声响打破寂静，像是颤抖、粗粝的呼吸。尸体猛地抽搐，四肢抬起，又倒吸一口断续的喘息。你知道它的时代所剩无几，但你有机会向亡者提出你的问题。
The incense is acrid, powerful. Its smoke coils around you—and the corpse before you. A disconcerting sound breaks the silence, something like a shuddering, rasping breath. The corpse seizes, lifting its limbs, taking in another gasping breath. You know its time is short, but you have the opportunity to ask your questions of the dead.

素净而泛白的亚麻帆布围绕中央木杆与布制杆帽，撑起一顶锥形帐篷。帆布绳环套在钉入地面的木桩上，将四壁绷得笔直。高高的入口帘可用数条皮革系带拉拢系紧。帐内弥漫着亚麻与蜂蜡的气息。
Plain and pale linen canvas forms a cone-shaped tent around a central wooden pole with a cloth cap. Canvas loops around spikes driven into the ground hold the sides taut. A tall entry flap can be drawn closed with several leather ties. The tent smells of linen and beeswax.

Ship Using Ftl Travel.name:
使用超光速旅行的飞船
Ship Using Ftl Travel

Text.text:
当飞船穿越屏障进入超光速旅行时，时代仿佛被放慢了；有那么一瞬，你悬在时刻与时刻之间——每一次跃迁前都会降临的、阈限般的黑暗。片刻之后抵达目的地时，你只觉胃里被猛地一拧，飞船再度闯入真实空间，像一颗坠落的流星般翻滚着跌入存在。
Time slows down as the ship crosses the barrier into FTL travel, and for a moment you hang in the space between moments, the liminal darkness that precedes every jump. When you arrive at your destination moments later you feel the wrenching lurch in your gut as the ship enters real space once more, tumbling into existence like a falling star.

Sundries From A Zombie With A Hint Of He.name:
带着些许生前痕迹的丧尸（特征）杂物
Sundries From A Zombie With A Hint Of Her Former Life

Text.text: 在这位溃烂贵妇人的口袋里，你找到一方绣有家纹的丝绸手帕，S.A. 以金线缀于其上。尽管布料已然毁坏——而且污秽不堪——其工艺之精良仍无可置疑。 In the pocket of the festering noblewoman, you find a monogrammed silk handkerchief with S.A. stitched in golden thread. Though the fabric is ruined—and thoroughly soiled—the quality of the craft is undeniable.

The Tyrant Lord Of Agony.name:
苦痛暴君领主
The Tyrant Lord Of Agony

Text.text:
覆满鳞片的人形生物披着腐朽的德鲁伊长袍，苔藓爬满其上，却也仅能勉强遮掩。他佝偻扭曲的身姿透出潜伏的力量，仿佛一棵树横向扎根在峭壁里，凭着顽强硬生生向外伸展。他脚边聚拢的阴影散而不清，却黑得过分，像是把周遭的微光都吞了进去。黑色的爬行类嘴唇裂开，发出嘶声——低了整整两个八度的回响在同一嗓音里阴森合唱——这龙裔存在召唤着扭动的蛇群与蜥蜴向他爬来。他分叉的舌尖一闪，品尝着恐惧……并将它放大。

~ 构想：Vahlaron

The scale-covered humanoid is thinly veiled by rotting druidic robes covered in mosses. His hunched and twisted posture evokes a latent strength, like a tree rooted sideways into a cliff and extending out of sheer doggedness. The shadows gathered at his feet are diffuse and too dark, as if they have swallowed the ambient light. Black reptilian lips part with a hiss—menacingly chorused in a voice two octaves lower—as the draconic being calls writhing serpents and lizards toward him. His forked tongue flicks out, tasting for fear… and amplifying it.

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

Sundries From The Prince Of Dark Pleasur.name:
黑暗欢愉之王的杂货
Sundries From The Prince Of Dark Pleasures

Text.text:
你搜遍尸身——尽管一位恶魔王子的尸体本身就足以称作战利品——却没有找到任何值钱之物。他只剩下冒着烟的血肉与破烂的皮革，如同一场美丽噩梦褪色后的残影。
You search the body and—though the corpse of a demon prince might be a trophy of itself—you find no items of value. He is naught but smoking flesh and tattered leathers, a shadow of a beautiful nightmare.

Meeko The Fairy Bard.name:
米可，妖精吟游诗人
Meeko The Fairy Bard

Text.text:
这位妖精讲故事时总爱顽皮地眨眼，指尖还会捻着那把修剪得体的漂亮胡须打转。一只松鼠魔宠舒舒服服地窝在他颈侧的凹处。他的皮肤与头发同为苔藓般的翠绿，头发向后束起，露出额上两只小角与一双祖母绿的眼睛。他手持的宝珠泄露了他术士的身份；在森林绿斗篷之下，他穿着铆钉皮甲与镶银边、土色调的贵族织物。斗篷垂落在一对红绿珠光的蜻蜓翅之间。

~ Played by Adam with

The fairy tells his stories with mischievous winks and twists of his well-shaped beard. A squirrel familiar makes itself comfortable in the crook of his neck. His skin and hair are both a mossy green, the hair pulled back to reveal small horns above his forehead and emerald eyes. The orb he carries reveals him as a warlock, and he wears studded leather and the silver-trimmed earth-toned fabrics of a noble under his forest green cloak. The cloak falls between a pair of red-and-green pearlescent dragonfly wings.

~ Played by Adam with

Road Through Grasslands.name:
穿越草原之路
Road Through Grasslands

Text.text:
这条朴素的土路被行人的脚步、马蹄与车轮磨得发亮，蜿蜒穿过乡野。黄绿相间的草地向四面八方铺展，间或被一小片树丛打断，直至辽阔的地平线外渐渐隐没。
The simple, dirt road—worn by foot traffic, hooves, and wagon wheels—winds it way through the countryside. Fields of yellow and green grass, broken only by the occasional copse of trees, sprawl in every direction and disappear over the vast horizon.

Accessible Dwarven Train Station.name:
无障碍矮人火车站
Accessible Dwarven Train Station

Text.text:
门扉开启，通向矮人城市的地下列车系统。一股独特的钢铁与电流气味充盈你的感官。忽然间，狂风卷起、雷鸣轰响，列车沿着闪耀的虹彩轨道呼啸而至。你看见几扇特别标记的车门，上面绘着蓝色符号——一名坐在轮椅上的人形。就在这些车门处，一条坡道向外伸出，跨过列车与站台之间的空隙。
The door opens to the underground train system in the dwarven city. A unique smell of steel and electricity fills your senses. Suddenly, with a rush of wind and thunder, the train arrives on the shining rainbow-colored track. You can see specially marked doors with a blue symbol depicting a humanoid in a wheelchair. At these doors, a ramp extends out across the gap between the train and platform.

Ring Mail Armor +2.name:
环甲护甲 +2
Ring Mail Armor +2

Text.text:
制作环甲的人通常是出于无奈。打造它比锁子甲耗费更少的时代和钱。然而这副护甲却宛如艺术品。每一枚金属环都像前一枚的完美孪生，以紧密而反复的纹样牢牢钉缀在坚硬的皮革衬底上。金属环本身泛着润泽的黑光，而下方的皮革则是夺目的猩红。
Those who make ring mail usually do so out of necessity. Crafting it takes less time and money than chain mail. But this armor looks like a work of art. Every ring seems to be a perfect twin of the last, affixed to the hard leather backing in a tight repeating pattern. The rings themselves gleam a lustrous black, while the leather beneath is a brilliant crimson.

一名直立行走的爬行类生物对着看不见的同伴啁啾作声。听到回应时，它那如鞭般的尾巴兴奋地抽甩——可那回应你却无从听见。它手臂与眉脊上的彩羽映出鲜艳法师长袍的斑斓色泽。它伸出细长的手指，唤出纤细、飘渺的魔法丝缕，渐渐凝聚成一团乳彩般的光球。
A reptilian biped chirps to an unseen partner. Its whiplike tail thrashes with obvious glee at the answer—an answer you cannot hear. Colored feathers at the arms and brow reflect the hues of a vivid mage’s robe. It extends its narrow fingers and conjures forth thin, wispy strands of magic that coalesce into an opalescent ball of light.

这个高大魁梧的男人身上散发着一丝淡淡的宁静。他赤裸上身，深褐色的皮肤上涂抹着原始的泥土纹样。铺在他宽阔肩头的绿叶沾着晨露，水珠拖出细长的泪痕，沿着他健壮的背肌一路滑落。他的面容被一张仪式面具遮得严严实实——木与骨拼制而成，涂成灰色，正中央耸着一根独角。面具深处，一双翠绿的眼睛幽幽闪光。
This tall, powerfully built man radiates a faint calm. He is stripped to the waist and daubed with primitive earthen markings upon his dark umber skin. Morning dew sits on the greenery laid atop his broad shoulders, streaking long tears down his muscular back. His face is hidden from view by a ritual mask built from wood and bone, painted gray and bearing a single central horn. Piercing green eyes glimmer from within the mask.

在宇宙震耳欲聋的寂静中，那颗恒星跨越无数千百万年的旅程，终于走到尽头。它的核心在漫长的纪元里维系着平衡，如同在神祇的熔炉中锻炼过的余烬般冷却；而在短短数秒之内，下一阶段便已开启。那天穹巨物像一座坍塌的高楼般向内塌陷，以骇人的速度与力量翻滚着吞没自身。随后，爆炸降临。恒星死去之时，宇宙创生般的炽白光辉向外迸发，将斑斓气体抛洒四方，在苍穹间旋卷成虹彩流转的云海。可它的死亡亦孕育新生——星云由此诞生。
In the deafening silence of the cosmos, the star’s journey of untold millennia finally reaches its end. In balance for eons, the star’s core has cooled, like a tempered ember in the forge of gods, and within seconds the next phase begins. The celestial giant implodes like a collapsing building, tumbling in on itself with terrifying speed and power. Then comes the explosion. The blinding light of universal creation explodes outward as the star dies, scattering colorful gases in swirling, prismatic clouds across the heavens. Yet from its death the star gives new life, and a nebula is born.

也许这可憎之物曾经是人类，但饥饿早已取代了人性。它干瘪的躯体仿佛只剩淤青般的皮肤绷在筋腱与骨头上，可那鼓胀的肚腹却高高凸出，行走时左右晃荡，仿佛腹中浊液在来回荡漾。污秽与血肉残渣染黑了它爪状的双手与枯槁的面孔。那双漆黑如沥青的眼睛淌出黏稠的焦油般液体，一条黑色舌头从獠牙密布的口中蜿蜒探出，舔去它龟裂唇边的污痕。
Perhaps this wretched thing was once human, but hunger has replaced humanity. Its withered body seems composed of little more than bruised skin stretched over sinew and bone, but its bulbous belly juts out and sloshes from side to side as it moves. Filth and gore stain its claw-like hands and wizened face. And eyes as black as pitch weep a tarry substance, which a black tongue—slithering from its fanged mouth—licks from its cracked lips.

Peaceful Temple: Shrine Of Purity.name:
宁静神殿：净澄圣龛
Peaceful Temple: Shrine Of Purity

Text.text:
炽热的余烬在石钵中噼啪作响，热浪将焚献的烟魂送上天际，空气里弥漫着草药与花朵浓郁醉人的芬芳。此处四壁环绕却又与天光相通，祭坛宁静安然；鸟鸣婉转，乐声轻扬，更将这份祥和衬得愈发深远。
Hot coals crackle in stone bowls, their heat sending the spirit of burnt offerings skyward and filling the air with the heady scents of herbs and flowers. Enclosed by walls but open to the air, this shrine feels peaceful, a sensation amplified by the song of birds and the playing of music.

Bard’s Silver Tongue.name:
吟游诗人的银舌
Bard’s Silver Tongue

Text.text:
吟游诗人织词如蛛吐丝。成品华美，却纠缠得骇人。吟游诗人雄辩的目标被绕得结结实实，明明眉间的沟壑愈发深刻，却仍不由自主地点头称是。
The bard weaves words like a spider weaves silk. The result is beautiful, but terribly tangled. The target of the bard’s rhetoric is left tied up in knots, nodding in agreement despite the groove that steadily deepens between their eyebrows.

当噩梦般的幻象逐渐成形，疑虑如潮水涌入你的心头。你曾见过这生物……它是在模仿你吗？还是你身边亲近之人？它像是某个人的记忆，被硬生生拉扯成食尸鬼般的畸形轮廓。那幽影咯咯发笑，用一只本不该属于它的鼻子嗅着空气。一阵令人胆寒的嗡鸣弥漫四周，它紧攥着一把如淬炼黑曜石般色泽的利刃。
Doubt fills your mind as a nightmarish vision takes form. You’ve seen this creature before… Is it meant to resemble yourself? One close to you? It seems a memory of a person, stretched out into ghoulish proportions. The apparition giggles, sniffing the air with a nose it should not own. A fearful hum fills the air as it clutches a blade the color of tempered obsidian.

City Boulevard.name:
城市林荫大道
City Boulevard

Text.text:
这条宽阔的城市大道两侧，树木与灌木定期浇灌修剪，枝叶葱茏得几乎能把整段路都罩进阴凉里——若不是车流不息，你几乎会以为自己置身公园。可这里终究还是城里：买卖的喧嚷、马蹄敲击鹅卵石的脆响、以及擦肩而过的零碎谈话声，几乎立刻就将那份幻景拽回现实。
The trees and bushes on either side of this expansive city avenue are watered and trimmed regularly, their lush greenery offering so much shade that, were it not for the traffic, you would think you were in a park.
