Yet this is still the city, and the sounds of commerce, hoofbeats on cobbles, and overheard conversation pull you out of that fantasy almost immediately.

Suspicious Stowaway.name:
可疑的偷渡客
Suspicious Stowaway

Text.text:
你一踏入船舱底层，那穷困潦倒的女人便扑到你面前，哀求你的怜悯。她的脚掌被污垢染得乌黑，地板上密布的藤壶刮破了皮肤，溃烂的伤口星星点点。她一边呛咳着抽泣，一边乞求你救她，说自己逃离了虐待她的丈夫，却在海上迷了路。恐惧与饥饿令她浑身发抖，蜡黄的皮肤下肋骨的轮廓清晰可见。她呼吸急促而破碎，咸涩的海水拍打着她受伤的脚，她痛得不由得一缩。

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

The destitute woman throws herself at your mercy as soon as she sees you enter the ship's hold. Her feet are black with grime and covered in lesions from the barnacles covering the floor. Through choking sobs, she begs you for help, claiming she ran away from her abusive husband and got lost. She quivers with fear and hunger, the outline of her ribs clearly visible beneath her sallow skin. Her breathing is fast and ragged, and she winces as the saltwater laps at her wounded feet.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Dungeoneer's Pack.name:
地城探险者套装
Dungeoneer's Pack

Text.text:
这只旅人背包以染成棕褐色的皮革制成，大袋背面缝着一只小巧的后袋。背包上寥寥几处挂环垂着一根铁撬棍和一把小号大锤。一侧绑着水囊，另一侧紧缚着一捆麻绳。
Made of stained brown leather, this traveler’s pack has a small rear pouch sewn onto the larger bag. Dangling from the pack’s few loops are an iron crowbar and a small sledgehammer. A waterskin is strapped to one side, a tight bundle of hempen rope to the other.

Sundries From A Werewolf.name:
来自狼人处的杂物
Sundries From A Werewolf

Text.text:
在一只破旧的挎包里——如今已被生物的血染透——狼人携带着几块生鲜的生肉，纹理各异。你只希望这些肉是来自动物……
In a ragged satchel—now stained with the creature’s blood—the werewolf carried several chunks of raw, fresh meat of varying textures. You hope the meat is from animals…

Beautiful Iron Buckle.name:
精美铁扣
Beautiful Iron Buckle

Text.text:
有人费心把这块沉重的金属锻造成水手结的形状，淬火定型，又在其上打上繁复的纹饰——令其价值远远超出材料本身。
Someone bothered to shape this heavy metal into a sailor’s knot, temper it, and stamp it with complicated designs—lifting the worth of its material considerably.

Approaching A Flooded Farming Valley.name:
逼近一片被洪水吞没的农耕谷地
Approaching A Flooded Farming Valley

Text.text:
你翻过山脊时，向导一眼望见下方景象，便像丧夫的寡妇般哀嚎起来。幽暗浑浊的水吞没了山谷翠绿牧场间那座原本恬静的村庄，把田园农地化作裹满淤泥的烂沼。那座如今沉没的村落只剩下谷仓筒仓与教堂尖塔，哀伤地刺出水面，宛如失落于时代长河的古老遗迹。

~ 构想：Discord 上的 A Hero

As you crest the ridge your guide wails like a grieving widow when they behold the scene below. Dark, murky waters have swallowed the idyllic village nestled in the verdant pastures of the valley, turning the pastoral farmlands to silt-filled muck. The only evidence of the now-drowned village is the silos and church spire, protruding mournfully from the surface of the water like ancient monuments lost to time.

~ Envisioned by A Hero on Discord

Offer Of Mercy From A Beholder.name:
来自眼魔的慈悲提议
Offer Of Mercy From A Beholder

Text.text:
“恶心的、阴险的害虫！你们竟敢用你们的臭气玷污我的住处？但我并非不讲道理。如此原始的生物，又怎会懂得分寸？我给你们这一次机会滚出去——也好让我免去清理你们残渣的恶心差事。”
“Disgusting, scheming vermin! You dare to pollute my home with your stink? But I am not unreasonable. How could such primitive creatures know any better? I shall give you this one chance to leave, if only to spare myself the nauseating task of cleaning up your remains.”

Advice From Hill Dwarf Using Keen Senses.name:
运用敏锐感官的丘陵矮人忠告
Advice From Hill Dwarf Using Keen Senses

Text.text:
“就在那儿。就在那道长石纹的左边。什么是长石？你傻了吗？那是一种石头！看。顺着那道黑色条纹走，然后就在大岩壁下那条裂缝旁边——不。不对。它……啊，算了算了！”
“It’s there. Just there to the left of that streak of feldspar. What’s feldspar? Are ya daft? It’s a kind of stone! Look. Follow that black streak there, then just next to the fissure under the big crag and… nope. Nope. It’s… Aww, never mind!”

Mountain In The Shape Of A Giant Turtle.name:
巨龟之形的山
Mountain In The Shape Of A Giant Turtle

Text.text:
它的乐声，是海浪拍碎的轰鸣与海鸥的尖啸，是岸边椰林的低语——在那儿，一座山自岛上拔起。巨大的头颅上，一只海龟张开的喙突兀伸出，俯瞰着大海。岩体的根基便是它的甲壳，常年被浪潮啃噬侵蚀。这块岩石并非雕凿之物，而是一具元素化石——曾经推动大地、引领群岛迁移的土之巨灵。如今，传言说，宝藏就藏在那张开的巨口深处的某个角落。

~ 由 Spac3cowboyy 在 Envisioned 中构想

Its music is the breaking of ocean waves and the shriek of gulls, the whispering palms along the shore, where a mountain rises from the island. The open beak of a turtle protrudes from its great head, overlooking the sea. The base of the rock is its shell, constantly eroded by waves. The rock is not a carving, but a fossilized elemental, an earth-mover that once steered islands. Now, rumor has it, treasure may be found somewhere in that open maw.

~ Envisioned by Spac3cowboyy

Approaching An Anxious Village.name:
逼近焦灼的村庄
Approaching An Anxious Village

Text.text:
几乎没有人待在屋里，可村里既没有活动，也没有宴会。仿佛连村庄的墙壁与街道都在绷紧，硬撑着不肯挪位。人们坐在椅子上也都前倾着身子，或是站得笔直不靠不倚，彼此对望，或沿着路来回张望。有些人把武器横放在膝上，或就搁在触手可及之处。村卫说着连他们自己都不信的打气话，直到最后也只剩习惯性地含糊嘟囔。
Almost no one is indoors, but there is no event, no party. The very walls and streets of the village seem to strain against their positions. The people sit forward on chairs or stand without leaning, as they look across at one another, or up and down the road. Some have weapons across their laps or near at hand. The village watch speaks encouragement they clearly don’t believe, until they finally just mumble it as a matter of habit.

将世界仅仅视作一连串变量与实验的代价，是人性被一点点磨损；这名科学家仿佛与周遭格格不入，冷眼旁观。他们把他人当作工具——可用则用、可操则控，等价值耗尽便随手弃置。挺括的白色实验袍与擦得锃亮、带着高管式镜框的眼镜，勾勒出一种洁净而冷峻的临床气质。
Viewing the world as little more than a series of variables and experiments takes its toll on one’s humanity, and the scientist seems detached from the world around them. They see others as tools to be used, manipulated—and discarded once their usefulness has run its course. A crisp white lab coat and polished glasses with executive frames give them a clean, clinical aesthetic.

Tinestone And Portgrade.name:
锡石镇与港阶城
Tinestone And Portgrade

Text.text:
三条鹅卵石步道在一处小圆场中央的石冢旁交汇。较窄的一条通向波特草地的避雨亭；沿锡石路可到金融区；而波特阶路则通往那道通向港口的下行阶梯。石冢上有些石块，曾用来纪念多年前在草地决斗中落败的人。如今，锡石路与波特阶路的石冢更常成了人们和平了结纷争的所在——他们把一枚枚小石子轻放其上，以此封存和解。
Three cobblestone walkways intersect at a cairn in a small circle. The narrower path leads to a shelter in Porter Green, while Tinestone takes you to the financial district and Portgrade is the walkway to the stair that leads down to the harbor. Some of the cairn stones memorialize the losers of duels on the green long ago. Now the Cairn of Tinestone and Portgrade is more often a place where people resolve their differences peacefully, laying small stones on the cairn to seal the peace.

I Move Up A Vertical Surface Wearing My.name:
我穿着蜘蛛攀爬拖鞋沿着垂直表面向上移动
I Move Up A Vertical Surface Wearing My Slippers Of Spider Climbing

Text.text:
当我稳稳踩住脚跟，迈出第一步违逆重力的步伐时，陌生的触感令我的感官本能地抗拒。我强迫自己专注于呼吸，心无旁骛地把一只脚踏到另一只脚上方，努力无视从这诡异角度俯瞰世界的景象。
My senses rebel against the unfamiliar sensation as I plant my feet and take my first gravity defying steps. Concentrating on my breathing, I focus solely on putting one foot above the other, trying to ignore the view of the world from this unfamiliar angle.

在数字空间最底层、最少有人涉足的深处，这片永恒黑暗的区域彻底与广告绝缘，没有建筑构造——甚至连其他化身也不见踪影。这里唯一的光，来自那些从更繁忙、更拥挤的城区泄露、截获、或以其他方式抽吸而来的原始数据流。在这样的所在，数字人格与AI聚集于此相互共鸣，在远离渺小人类的干扰与喧嚣之处交流。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Deep within the lowest and least explored areas of digital space, this zone of perpetual darkness is completely bereft of advertising, building constructs—even fellow avatars. Down here, the only light is given off by raw streams of data leaked, gleaned, and otherwise siphoned from the busier sections of more populated districts. In such a place, digital personalities and AIs gather to commune, free from the interferences and noise of mere humanity.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Rod Of Rulership.name:
统御权杖
Rod Of Rulership

Text.text:
这根沉重的短杖形如君王的权杖，通体镀金，镶嵌着抛磨至臻的名贵宝石，璀璨夺目。杖身底部塑出一道道棱脊，便于牢牢握持，仿佛它注定要被高举于空，手臂伸直，笔直向上。
Resembling the scepter of a monarch, this heavy rod has been plated with gold and encrusted with valuable gems polished to perfection. Ridges have been molded into the base of the rod for a firm grip, as if it is meant to be held upright, arm fully extended.

Staff Of Thunder And Lightning.name:
雷霆闪电法杖
Staff Of Thunder And Lightning

Text.text:
这根长杖触感如同实心铁铸而成，表面被精心雕刻：如闪电般的纹样沿着杖身一路缠绕直至杖顶。武器顶端周围可见粉笔般惨白的灼痕。你第一次拾起长杖时，微弱的静电“啪”地一声弹开，刺得皮肤一阵发麻。
Fashioned from what feels like solid iron, this staff has been carefully engraved: designs resembling lightning bolts wrap around the shaft all the way to the top. Chalk-white burn streaks can be seen around the top of the weapon. Picking up the staff for the first time, your skin is stung with a pop from a slight static charge.

The Sanctuary: Pancakaru.name:
圣所：潘卡卡鲁
The Sanctuary: Pancakaru

Text.text: 牌子上写着欢迎来到潘凯卡鲁——一处不许抱抱的避风港！，在通往这座热带台地之巅的繁华城市的城门口迎接来客。越过它，几十位形形色色的小动物各自忙碌，附近旅店飘来的烤杏仁与新鲜玉米面包香气勾得人直咽口水。众多商铺之中最夺目的是三座高耸建筑并立而起，每一座顶端都覆着一座彩绘繁丽的圆顶，向上收束成细致的尖峰。 The sign Welcome to Pancakaru – a Snuggles-Free Haven! greets visitors at the gates into the bustling city atop the tropical mesa. Beyond it, dozens of fellow critters of varying kinds go about their business, the smells of roasted almonds and fresh cornbread from a nearby inn making mouths water. Dominating the many shops is a trio of tall buildings, each of which is topped by an ornately painted dome that tapers to a fine point.

石阶间的凹缝里披着一层苔藓，细小的植物从灰浆中蜿蜒钻出。墙上挂着一幅蒙尘褪色的挂毯，其上仍可辨出公会的徽记。上方传来沉重而笨拙的靴声，咚咚回荡——一名公会成员正在城垛上来回踱步。
The stone stairs are dressed in moss between the nooks and little plants twisting through the mortar. The wall is adorned with a dusty, discolored tapestry bearing the guild’s emblem. Heavy, plunking boot-steps echo from above as a guild member paces on the battlements.

Sundries From A Weakened Prismatic Drago.name:
虚弱虹彩巨龙的杂物
Sundries From A Weakened Prismatic Dragon

Text.text:
你穿行在废墟上空迸溅的惊人色彩乱流中，朝那几乎隐形的巨龙摸索而去。荒瘠的地面上点点闪光——宛如天界海滩上散落的卵石。凑近细看，你才发现这些夺目的珠光竟是从那光辉巨龙鳞皮上脱落的鳞片。
Navigating the startling riot of color playing off the ruins, you make your way to the near-invisible dragon. Shining stones—like pebbles from a heavenly beach—dot the barren ground. Upon closer inspection, you find these dazzling baubles to be scales cast from the shimmering dragon’s hide.

他一身翠绿华服，满是装饰——从扣环到纽扣——皆以棕色皮革与金饰点缀；这小个子男人留着一把浓密的赤褐胡须。羽饰绿帽下，蓬乱的头发同样野性十足，朝四面八方翘起。唯有脚上的鞋子不见鲜亮颜色。姿态闲散，却一双眼睛明亮而警惕。他漫不经心地握着烟斗，偶尔抿上一口，却不见半缕烟雾逸出。
Richly dressed in green with adornments—from buckles to buttons—of brown leather and gold, this little man has a bushy auburn beard. Equally wild hair points in all directions from underneath his feathered green cap. Only his shoes lack bright color. He has a relaxed posture but bright, wary eyes. No smoke comes from the pipe he idly holds and occasionally puffs.

Soldiers Await The Dawn.name:
士兵静候黎明
Soldiers Await The Dawn

Text.text:
每一张脸都被忧虑拉长，带着宿命般的认命。汗与泪混在一起，难分彼此；营火低低闪烁，几近燃尽。火星划破黑暗——一名士兵将磨刀石贴着刀刃推过，迸出细碎的光。一个男人抬手捋过日渐稀薄的头发，湿漉漉的发缕贴在脸颊与额头；左耳上方的伤口缠着污渍斑斑的绷带，他的手擦得太近，便疼得一缩。营地里有人开始哼一支缓慢的曲子。他醇厚的嗓音渐渐拔高，直到双唇张开，化作强而无词的歌。其他人沉重地抬起头，悲恸的眼神带着几分熟悉望向他：是亲族与故土的歌吗？眼皮频频眨动，喉头上下滚动，他们把呜咽硬生生咽回去。更多声音加入，汇成有力而安抚人心的合唱。拳头砰砰敲在胸口，靴底咚咚踏向大地。倔强。纵使乌云遮住星光……而死亡在黎明里守候。

~ 由 Filos Sunbreaker 构想

Every face is drawn long with worry, with fateful resignation. Sweat and tears mingle together, inseparable, as the campfires flicker low, nearly spent. Sparks cut through the dark, flying from a blade as a soldier slides her whetstone across it. A man runs a hand through thinning hair, tendrils plastered against his cheeks and forehead; a wound over his left ear is wrapped in stained bandages and he winces as his hand swipes too close to it. Someone in the camp begins to hum a slow tune. His rich voice rises in pitch until his lips part into a powerful, wordless song. Others lift their heavy heads, mournful eyes turning toward him with some recognition: a song of kin and country, perhaps? Eyes blink and throats bounce as they hold back sobs. More voices join him in a powerful, reassuring chorus. Hands thump against chests and boots stamp against the ground. Defiant. Even as clouds shade the stars… and death waits with the dawn.

~ Envisioned by Filos Sunbreaker

I Cast Control Weather Using Components.name:
我用材料施放操控天气
I Cast Control Weather Using Components

Text.text:
这是一种由自然世界赐予的魔法：芳香的素材被点燃，木与土在一只小小的水碗里交融。那是一段低沉的吟唱，一次深处的恳求，求这颗星球改一改主意。我把整日交给无遮的天穹作伴，伸出手邀风共舞。我用手肘猛戳大地的肋骨，叫它去找人狠狠干一架。于是树木前后摇撼，云层滚滚压来，而我把敌人介绍给我那守护五英里的守卫。
This is magic given by the natural world, the aromatic elements burned, wood and earth mixed in a little bowl of water. It is a low chant, a deep request for the very planet to change its mind. I spend my day with the open sky as my companion, offering my hand to the wind for a dance. I jab an elbow into the ribs of the earth and tell it to go pick a fight. So the trees rock back and forth, the clouds roll in, and I introduce my enemies to my five-mile guardian.

Professor Of Astronomy.name:
天文学教授
Professor Of Astronomy

Text.text:
一个矮小的男人站在一连串台阶的顶端，台阶通向一架巨大的钢铁望远镜的目镜。他一只眼睛比另一只略大，也更明亮。天文台穹顶之下，微缩的星球、卫星与群星模型悬浮在他头顶。他一边讲解，一边用权杖拨弄这些天体——权杖顶端镶着一颗明亮的银色星辰。
A small man, one eye slightly larger and brighter than the other, stands atop a series of steps that lead to the eyepiece of a massive, steel telescope. Above his head, in the dome of the Observatory, float small models of planets, moons, and stars. He lectures, moving the celestial bodies about his scepter—atop which sits a bright silver star.

Razed Large Village.name:
被夷为平地的大村庄
Razed Large Village

Text.text:
曾经兴盛的村落——摊棚、简陋民宅与聚会之所——如今已不复存在；每一栋建筑都被劈砍得支离破碎，焚毁至地基。凡是在掠袭者第一轮扫荡中未被毁掉的东西，也被搜罗起来，统统抛进村庄广场的废墟里再烧一遍，成堆的灰烬被无拘无束的风携向远方。至于村民本身，四下看不见任何一眼就能察觉的迹象。
The once-thriving village of stalls, modest houses, and gathering places is gone—every structure hacked apart and burned down to its foundation. Anything not destroyed in the raiders’ first pass was gathered and thrown into the ruins of the village square and burned again, heaps of ash carried far by the carefree wind. Of the villagers themselves, there are no easily spotted signs.

Damp Fungi Cavern.name:
潮湿的菌菇洞窟
Damp Fungi Cavern

Text.text:
空气潮湿，阴影中的轮廓起初让人以为这里是一座塞满石笋与钟乳石的洞窟；然而，那些从地面刺起、从天花板垂落的尖锐与鼓胀之形，却证实是更柔软的东西。蘑菇——种类繁多得令人目眩——在脚下铺陈出一座仙境花园，而头顶则长成一片精灵也能穿行其间的蘑菇密林。
The dampness of the air and the shapes in the shadows at first give the impression of a cavern cluttered with stalagmites and stalactites, but the pointed and bulbous shapes projecting from the floor and dangling from the ceiling prove to be softer stuff. Mushrooms—a bewildering variety—create a fairy garden on the floor and a forest fit for sprites above it.

地砖的颜色加深，化作蒙尘的酒红，浓郁如醇酒。鲜红的线条织出玫瑰的纹样——楼梯的脚轻轻压入其间，像鞋尖滑进草甸般温柔。然而当你走近楼梯，你看见中央的图案截然不同：一道张狂的骷髅狞笑。你一步跨过它，胃里猛地一翻，仿佛正在坠落。
The tile darkens to a dusty burgundy, rich as wine. Bright red lines create a pattern of roses—with the foot of the staircase pressing into them as gently as a shoe slipping into a meadow. As you near the staircase, however, you see the design in the center is different: a brazen, skeletal grin. As you step over it, your gut pitches as if you were falling.

石匣在流逝万古的熵蚀接触下开始崩裂，露出其中的龙骨。古老的石灰岩上刻着锋利而弯曲的符文，骨龛之盖上方，则以一颗咆哮的龙首作冠——如今已缺了几枚獠牙。
The stone box has begun to crumble with the entropic touch of passing eons, revealing the draconic bones within. Text has been carved into the ancient limestone with sharp, curving runes, and a roaring dragon’s head—now missing several fangs—crowns the ossuary’s lid.

An Object Is Rammed By My Ring Of The Ra.name:
某个物体被我的公羊之戒猛力撞飞
An Object Is Rammed By My Ring Of The Ram

Text.text:
“别为这事儿折断腰，”我说着，将戴戒指的无名指朝那物体一勾。坚固的钢戒中倾泻出一颗空灵的公羊头，双眼已在搜寻目标。我喝令它冲向那物体；它那无形的鼻孔喷出一声烟雾般的喘息，随即那头颅笔直滚入其中。我们脚下的地面被撞得一颤。法术的烟雾渐渐散去，露出一堆碎片残骸，仍在那记魔力重击的余波里微微震动。
“Let’s not break our backs over this,” I say as I flex my ring finger toward the object. The ethereal ram’s head pours out of the sturdy steel ring, its eyes already searching for a target. I command it toward the object and, with a huff of smoke from its incorporeal nostrils, the head rolls straight into it. The ground beneath us shudders with the impact. The smoke of the spell dissipates, revealing a pile of debris that still vibrates from the force of the magical blow.

Screech Owl Familiar Gets Bossy.name:
尖啸猫头鹰魔宠变得颐指气使
Screech Owl Familiar Gets Bossy

Text.text:
“喂，别闹了。你还有三十一次 squidgious 要施放，还得附上分析笔记。把电影关了。关掉！”
“Hey, knock it off. You’ve got thirty-one castings of squidgious to go, with analytical notes. Turn off the movie. Turn it off!”

Swimming Pool In Manor.name:
庄园内的游泳池
Swimming Pool In Manor

Text.text:
诱人的缕缕蒸汽自宅邸地窖里精心设计的水池升腾而起——这般奢华景象，鲜有人曾亲眼目睹。水池由大地深处涌来的热力温养，既可用来锻炼，也可尽情嬉戏。灯光映在微微晃动的水面上，折射出一场愉悦的光影秀，在四壁间流转。
Inviting wafts of steam rise from the carefully designed pool of water in the manor’s basement—an extravagance few have ever witnessed. Heated by the warmth coming from the bowels of the earth, this pool is used for both exercise and frolic. The lamplight reflecting off the unsteady water’s surface casts a delightful light show over the walls.

I Cast Time Wrinkle.name:
我施放时代褶皱
I Cast Time Wrinkle

Text.text:
它微微扭曲心智的经纬，将一小片空间的时代倒拨回去。法术以专注与咒言开场，我从察觉里拧出时代的水分。尽管如此，我仍稳住身形，向前触及，两指画出一圈。我的目标沿着刹那倒退，逆转他们刚做的最后一件事。我深吸一口气，放下手。我的目标演出一个悖论：还是同样的动作，却得出了不同的结果。

~ Alex构想

It twists the mind’s fabric a bit, turning back the time of a small space. The spell begins with concentration and incantation, wringing the water of time out of my perception. Nevertheless, I remain steady, reach forward, and draw a circle with two fingers. My target moves backward through an instant, reversing the last thing they did. I take a deep breath and lower my hand. My target performs a paradox: the same action as before, but with a different result.

~ Envisioned by Alex

Prisoner Mining Strange Stone.name:
囚徒开采诡异矿石
Prisoner Mining Strange Stone

Text.text:
老人从佝偻中抬起头，眼里因用力而泛着光，一颗铁球用链子锁在他的脚踝上，把他拴在这里。他精瘦结实，显然被这活计磨炼出来，但当他让鹤嘴锄休息片刻时，手臂仍止不住发抖。他的锄头正落在一块奇异的石头正中——那石头像是熔岩被封在玻璃后头——随即迸裂成五彩斑斓、叮当作响的碎片。
The old man looks up from his slouch, eyes shining with effort, an iron ball chained to his ankle keeping him here. He is leanly muscled, clearly tempered by this work, but his arms shake as he lets his pick rest for a moment. He has landed the head in the center of a strange stone, which appears like magma trapped behind glass, and breaks off in colorful, clattering shards.

Snowy White Dragon Encounter.name:
雪白巨龙遭遇
Snowy White Dragon Encounter

Text.text:
暴风雪在你冻得发麻的耳畔咆哮掠过。它卷起雪幕，绕着你正逼近的小丘呼啸盘旋，余下的大地尽数被遮蔽无踪。脚下的土层在你周围低沉震颤，雪光的诡谲折影让那小丘仿佛正在缓缓蠕动。你靠得更近，终于看见丘脚处睁开一只冰蓝色的眼睛，转向你。巨大的翼展舒张开来，抖落压实的雪片，狂风骤起；此刻，两只寒冷而好奇的眼睛正直直盯着你。一条古老的白龙，正等你下一步动作。

~ 构想：sunnygcat

The blizzard roars past your frostbitten ears. It sweeps up and around the small hill you approach, the rest of the land obscured from view. The earth rumbles around you, and some trick of the snow makes it seem as if the hill is moving. You draw near enough to see an icy blue eye open near its base and turn toward you. Enormous wings stretch out, shaking packed flakes around in gusts, and now two cold, curious eyes stare at you. An ancient white dragon awaits your next move.

~ Envisioned by sunnygcat

Hostile Alien Soldier.name:
敌对异星士兵
Hostile Alien Soldier

Text.text:
一名士兵从一堆焦黑的瓦砾后跃出，挥舞着一把武器，厉声发出警告。外星人开口说话时，长在柔韧柄上的复眼来回转动，以苛刻的精准锁定你的每个动作。你不需要翻译也能读懂他们的意思：离开，否则就死。
Leaping from behind a pile of charred rubble, a soldier barks a warning while brandishing a weapon. Compound eyes move on flexible stalks as the alien speaks, tracking your movements with exacting precision. You don’t need a translator to decipher their message. Leave or die.

Dame Paige Of The Flatlands.name:
平原贵妇佩姬
Dame Paige Of The Flatlands

Text.text:
身披闪耀的钢制板甲，战士立于败敌之上，长剑高举，鸢盾随时待发。剑锋却并未落下。她缓缓放下武器，赤裸的剑身伴着一声钢鸣嘶响滑回剑鞘。

她抬手卸下头盔，露出一头鲜亮的铜色发丝、翡翠般的眼眸与饱满的唇——那份美丽本该出现在贵族舞会的灯影之间，可她却站在此处，披着骑士的甲胄，额前汗光微亮。

她吐出一口气。

“你败了。投降。”
The warrior, clad in gleaming steel plate, stands over their defeated foe, longsword raised and kite shield held at the ready. The sword does not fall. They lower the weapon, slowly, and return the naked blade to its scabbard with a hiss of steel. They reach up to remove the helm from their head, revealing hair of vibrant copper, emerald eyes, and full lips—a beauty, not out of place in a noble ballroom, yet here she stands in the raiment of a knight, sweat shining on her forehead. She releases a breath. “You are bested. Yield.”

Heavy Rain In The Hills With Galeb Duhrs.name:
丘陵暴雨，岩灵杜尔相伴
Heavy Rain In The Hills With Galeb Duhrs

Text.text:
雨幕洗刷着这片起伏的丘陵地带。水从矮小的峰顶涓涓流下，汇成细细的溪涧向下奔涌。高处的草地被雨水染得葱翠欲滴，低处的草却在积水里沉没；雨水在丘间浅谷里越聚越深，洼地成了水潭。大地传来一阵轻微的震颤，岩石巨魔翻滚着从山坡上滚落，砂砾般粗哑的嗓音哀叹着这场暴雨；它们一路滑行、溅水，跌跌撞撞地朝着避雨处挪去。
Rain showers the rolling land of this hill range. Water runs in small streams downward from the short peaks. The grasses higher up turn vibrant green while others drown in pools as the rain collects in the shallow valleys between. There is a slight tremor in the earth as rock trolls roll down the hills, their gravelly voices bemoaning the downpour as they slide and splash their way toward shelter.

Sundries From A Hell Hound.name:
来自地狱猎犬的杂物
Sundries From A Hell Hound

Text.text:
邪魔的尸身嘶嘶作响。它的皮肤成股剥落，化作灼燃的灰烬细流四散流淌，蔓延后渐渐冷却，直到那头猎犬只剩一堆刺鼻的硫磺灰。
The body of the fiend hisses. Its skin flakes off in rivulets of burning ash that spread and cool until the hound is a pile of sulfurous ash.

Grenade Thrown Toward Group Of Targets.name:
手榴弹掷向目标群
Grenade Thrown Toward Group Of Targets

Text.text:
手雷划破空气飞来，带着低低的尖啸直奔那群人而去。伴随着清晰的一声闷响，它落地后旋转着，停在队伍首领的脚边。众人瞳孔骤缩，本能接管了身体，转身就想逃——但已经来不及了。白炽的爆炸猛然绽放，炽烈的冲击瞬间将整支队伍彻底吞没。
The grenade sails through the air, whistling softly as it flies toward the group. With an audible thunk, it lands, spinning at the feet of the group's leader. Their eyes go wide and instinct takes over as they try to run—but it’s too late. A white-hot explosion erupts and the group is engulfed completely in the blast.

Towering Cliff Edge.name:
高耸的悬崖边缘
Towering Cliff Edge

Text.text:
从峭壁边缘俯瞰，下方广袤的景致仿佛出自某位勤勉的侏儒工匠之手，被精心雕琢成一座完美的立体沙盘。这里没有任何护栏或安全墙作阻隔，你几乎能想见某个愚蠢的家伙为求看得更清楚，伸长脖子探出陡直的崖沿，最终在眩晕中迎来悲剧的终章。
From the edge of the bluff, the vast landscape below looks as if it were crafted by some industrious gnome artisan as a perfect diorama. Unfettered by any manner of barrier or safety wall, you can well imagine some foolish soul craning their neck out over the edge of the sheer cliff for a better view, only to succumb to vertigo in their final, tragic moments.

忍者身形一晃，如行云流水般腾跃而起，攀住墙头，迅捷地将自己拉了上去。紧接着他们翻身越过，坠落到地面，轻得仿佛一片羽毛落地般悄无声息。他们停了片刻，目光如刀般扫过四周，随后继续朝着目标前行——如同猎食的雄狮。
With one fluid motion the ninja sprang and grasped the top of the wall, quickly pulling themself up. Then they were over and dropping to the ground with as much noise as a falling feather. They paused for a moment, scanning their surroundings before continuing toward the target—like a hunting lion.

脚印在覆雪的地面上交错纵横，每一座建筑都被厚实的白色雪堆层层掩埋。营地上空笼罩着一片格外沉重的寂静，偶尔才会被树枝在沉雪重压下断裂坠落的声响刺破。
Footsteps crisscross the snow-covered ground, every structure blanketed in dense white drifts. A pronounced silence hovers over the camp, punctuated now and then by tree limbs collapsing under the weight of the heavy precipitation.

巢穴很容易被忽略——它藏在陡峭、犬牙交错的峭壁上，一处岩石突起投下的阴影之下。巢由稻草、枝条、几块有趣的石头，甚至羽毛与骨片堆叠编织而成，彼此交错，构成一段半圆形的窝座；内里厚厚铺垫、严密隔温，足以抵御风雨侵袭。四周区域散落着被漂白、被啃噬的骨骸，体型显示它们来自牛、鹿及其他有蹄哺乳动物。还有几缕破烂染血的布片、生锈的护甲与断裂的武器，暗示狮鹫的食谱里也少不了更类人些的猎物。

~ Stefano Imperiale 构想

The nest is easy to miss, tucked away as it is beneath the shadow of a rocky outcropping on sheer, jagged cliffs. It is composed of straw, branches, bits of interesting stone, even feathers and bone—all woven together to form a semicircle padded and insulated against the elements. Bleached, gnawed-upon bones litter the surrounding area, their size indicating cattle, deer, and other hoofed mammals. Bits of tattered, bloodstained cloth, rusted armor, and sundered weapons hint at more humanoid fare in the griffon’s diet.

~ Envisioned by Stefano Imperiale

宁静的寂然如毯般覆住这片区域，你们小队在夜色里铺开行装，准备歇息。睡意在眼角徘徊，你却深吸一口冰冷的空气，让感官保持锋利。你沿着营地边缘巡查，脚步轻落在地面上，几乎不发出声响。离营地不到百尺，一阵寒意猛地贯穿胸口：被注视的感觉，仿佛有成千上万双饥饿的眼睛钉进你的后脑与脊背。你回头望去，只见阴影里潜伏着一些身影，矮小、贴地，正一点点逼近。你耳畔捕捉到一声动静——吱吱碎响？还是低沉的咆哮？

~ Envisioned by Cornifa

A tranquil quiet blankets the area as your party beds down for the evening. Though sleep toys at the corners of your eyes, you take a deep breath of the cold air to keep your senses sharp. You scout the perimeter, your footfalls soft against the ground. Not a hundred feet from the encampment, a chill shoots through your chest: a feeling of being watched, as if a thousand hungry eyes bore into your head and back. You look over your shoulder and see figures lurking in the shadows, small, creeping closer. Your ears catch a sound—a chitter? A snarl?

~ Envisioned by Cornifa

Overheard Announcement By Town Watch Abo.name:
镇卫队在街头贴出的告示与闲话：严禁行贿受贿
Overheard Announcement By Town Watch About Bribes

Text.text:
“我们的领主命我再次申明：在这座城里，袭击、盗窃、滋事闹事与行贿一概不容。尤其是贿赂，我们对它的容忍度低得不能再低。严禁行贿。把几枚钱币塞给你们附近的卫兵，好让我们买点漂亮玩意儿——绝对不行，半点都不行。”
“I have been asked by our lord to reiterate that assault, theft, hooliganism, and bribery will not be tolerated in this city. I cannot emphasize enough how little we tolerate bribery. No bribes allowed. Slipping a few coins to your local guardsmen so we can buy ourselves something pretty is not okay—at all.”

Cone Of Cold Resisted By Some.name:
部分人抵抗住了寒冰锥
Cone Of Cold Resisted By Some

Text.text:
这是一次漂亮而有力的施放，你手中的小玻璃锥体完美结晶，随即向外迸射，化作一束旋涡般、边缘如羽毛般翻卷的锥形寒流，将一群敌人吞没。你能看出其中一些已经完全承受了效果，可另一些却抬臂遮挡，或俯身迎着冲击低吼。冰冷的水汽从他们身上袅袅逸散，他们仍咬牙穿过你的魔法，继续向前。
It’s a good, strong cast, the little glass cone in your hand crystalizing perfectly and firing outward in a swirling, feather-edged cone that consumes a group of your foes. While you can tell the full effect has taken hold on some, others put up their arms or lean forward and growl into the blast. With cold water vapor wafting from them, they soldier on through your magic.

A Handy Haversack Is Placed Inside An Ex.name:
一个便携背包被放进了异次元空间之中
A Handy Haversack Is Placed Inside An Extradimensional Space

Text.text:
收纳空间深处传来一记沉闷的低响，震动穿透空气，紧随其后的是如潮水逼近般的轰鸣。刹那间，袋子向内塌折，连空气也一并折叠。袋子原本所在之处，浮现出一扇云雾般的灰色光门。光门攫住袋子的持有者，将其猛地吸入其中，随即消失无踪。
A low thump deep inside the holding space sends vibrations through the air, followed by a sound like an approaching wave. In an instant, the bag folds in on itself, and so does the air. Where the bag was, a gate of cloudy gray light appears. The gate grabs the holder of the bag and sucks them into it, then disappears.

Impaled By Construct Warrior.name:
被构装战士贯穿
Impaled By Construct Warrior

Text.text:
战士面甲的冷冽钢铁被染成猩红，你滚烫的鲜血喷洒在金属之上。它那冷酷而毫不动摇的神情纹丝不变，你在剧痛中翻滚挣扎——被它以巨刃代臂所挥舞的庞大刀锋贯穿。

~

The cold steel of the warrior's face is painted crimson as your hot blood sprays across the metal. Its stoic, unflinching expression remains unmoved as you writhe in agony, impaled on the huge blade it wields in place of an arm.

~

I Cast Planar Binding.name:
我施放「异界束缚」
I Cast Planar Binding

Text.text:
我手中的宝石骤然蜕变成一副镣铐，以一条由筋络与星辉交织的链条相连。一只铐环啪地扣上我的手腕，我将另一只猛掷向我的异界目标。镣铐啃噬着他们的形体，经历一番抗力后，终于咔哒一声锁定。我如释重负地长叹一口气，拽着链条将其拉向我，开口说道,: “来吧，还有活要干。”
The gem in my hands transmogrifies into a pair of shackles, linked together by a chain of sinew and stars. One cuff snaps to my wrist and I fling the other toward my extraplanar target. The shackle bites at their form until, after some resistance, it latches. I sigh with relief and pull the chain toward me, saying,: “Come, there is work to be done.”

Oceangoing Cargo Drone.name:
远洋货运无人机
Oceangoing Cargo Drone

Text.text:
码头上正装载的利维坦级远洋无人机，将附近停泊的所有船只都衬得渺小。它那巨大的货舱轻而易举地吞下将要运载的巨型游艇，牵引搬运机器人毫不费力地把这艘百米长的船推进那幽深如洞窟的巨口。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The leviathan oceangoing drone being loaded at the docks dwarfs all other vessels moored nearby. Its enormous cargo hold easily swallows the mega yacht it will transport, the haulage bots having no trouble in maneuvering the hundred-meter boat into the cavernous maw.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

你伸出手，一只由你手掌延展而出的手影随即浮现，虚幻透明，漂浮在空中。它轻轻上下浮动，离你而去；而你每一个念头掠过，它便依令而行。
You reach out, and an extension of your hand appears, spectral and floating. It bobs away from you, and with every thought, it follows your commands.

Strutting Gladiator.name:
趾高气扬的角斗士
Strutting Gladiator

Text.text:
一名角斗士——原始而不屈的力量化身，竞技场的冠军——披着伤痕累累的护甲，以娴熟到近乎漫不经心的姿态炫耀着武器。逼你将全部注意力都奉上。每一次动作都张扬着致命锋芒，体内燃着永不熄灭的战斗意志，他们迈着张力十足的步伐，昂然逼近。
A gladiator—a vision of raw, unyielding might, a champion of the arena—is sheathed in battered armor, flaunting their weapons with practiced ease. Demanding your undivided attention. Their every move boasting lethality, and possessing the relentless spirit of combat, they strut dynamically forward.

Menodora Neera-rinn Varis.name:
梅诺多拉·尼拉-琳·瓦里斯
Menodora Neera-rinn Varis

Text.text:
她的精灵肌肤泛着银色光泽，苍白如月，却不失温度。她将闪耀的白发松松地向后束起，勾勒出凌厉的五官与夺目的双眼——一只明亮的猩红，另一只深邃的翡翠。额头上有一道褪色的疤痕，形如月食，除非在特定光线下才勉强可见。她举止间带着克制的自信，坚毅尽显于紧绷的下颌线与如铁的肩背。黑色猎装外套与红色和服垂落在她修长、矫健而结实的身躯上，持剑的手臂裸露，露出另一轮月——肩头一枚赤色月纹刺青。她的双胯间悬着一柄华丽、仿佛被月光触碰过的弯刀，以及一把魔法锻造的镰刃。

~ 由 Axel Denar 扮演

Her elven skin glows with a silver luster, pale as the moon but lacking no warmth. She keeps her gleaming white hair pulled back loosely, framing sharp features and striking eyes—one a bright crimson, the other a deep emerald. A faded scar upon her forehead evokes the shape of a lunar eclipse, barely visible except in a particular light. She carries herself with a subdued confidence, her tenacity clear in the strong set of her jaw and the rigidity of her shoulders. A black hunter’s coat and red kimono drape her lithe, athletically muscled frame, her sword arm bare to reveal another moon—a red-hued tattoo upon her shoulder. Hanging upon her hips are an ornate, moon-touched scimitar and a sickle of magical make.

~ Played by Axel Denar

Conjure Woodland Beings.name:
召唤林地生灵
Conjure Woodland Beings

Text.text:
你将麾下原始之力灌入这声号令，妖精秘林的生灵自其领域中现身而出，纷纷奔赴而来，为你助阵。
Infusing your call to action with the primal power at your command, the creatures of the sylvan realm emerge from their domain and flock to your aid.

牧师迈步走进神殿，指节血肉模糊，长袍仿佛被泼洒过般染成猩红。朋友骇然发问他发生了什么。他回答说，祝福很成功。

“我还以为你是个牧师。”

“是的。复仇与暴力之神的牧师。”

~ 由 MaesterAelix 在 Discord 上Envisioned

The priest strides into the temple with bloodied knuckles, his robes painted crimson. Horrified, his friend asks him what happened. He replies that the blessing was successful.

"I thought you were a priest."

"Yes. Of the God of Vengeance and Violence."

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

Agile Target Under Heavy Fire Dives For.name:
在密集火力下，敏捷的目标飞身扑向掩蔽
Agile Target Under Heavy Fire Dives For Cover

Text.text:
目标简直像一道影子，在枪林弹雨中穿梭游走。一个枪手得意地高喊：“我逮到他们了！”随即朝着那处标记倾泻出一串子弹。然而，目标快得像蟑螂钻进冰箱底下般一闪而没，猛地扑入一条小巷——身后连一滴血都未曾留下。
The target might as well be a shadow, the way they weave through the gunfire. “I’ve got them!” a gunman cries out triumphantly as he looses a spray of bullets toward the mark. But, quick as a roach fleeing under a fridge, the target dives into an alley—leaving not even a drop of blood in their wake.

Animated Quartz Swarm.name:
灵动的石英蜂群
Animated Quartz Swarm

Text.text:
你面前是一场闪耀的枢纽风暴。每一枚晶体都是六角形圆盘，浸染着淡紫色的光泽，其表面潦草写满了晦奥的符文。六角晶体彼此交汇低语，随即卷成一股迸闪的光之洪流，折射四周，让你身周的空间都被迷离的色彩搅成一片眩目的幻景。失控的压电火花在晶体之间弹跳——噼啪作响，橙色、参差、如裂纹般的电弧划破空气。
Before you is a glittering nexus storm. Each crystal is a hexagonal disc suffused with a lilac tint. Esoteric runes are scribbled across their surfaces. As the hexagons confer, they swirl in a torrent of flashing light, refracting the surroundings, making the very space around you a mess of mesmerizing color. Wayward sparks of piezoelectricity bounce between the crystals—crackling, orange, jagged lines through the air.

表演者穿着一身灰暗肮脏的衣服，显然好几天没洗过澡，但至少还费了点心思把那团蓬乱如荒草的头发勉强捋顺，也把那身显然是睡出来的褶皱衣物稍稍抚平。“我最新的作品，”他们说着，翻开一本磨得发亮的旧皮革日志，书脊里还夹着一支刻写笔，“题为《巨龙前夜》。”
The performer wears dingy clothes, and though it’s clear they haven’t bathed in several days, they at least made some effort to tame their wild mane of unkempt hair and to smooth the clothes they’ve apparently been sleeping in. “My newest piece,” they say, opening a well-worn leather journal with a stylus tucked into the spine, “is entitled ‘Eve of the Dragon.’”

这座诡异死寂的小镇里，每一幢建筑都以这样或那样的方式显出破败的痕迹，而街上似乎根本无人去补救这点轻微的残败。事实上，镇上几乎每一扇窗户都已拉上百叶，或从屋内钉上木板封死。寂静之中，你能清晰分辨出每一块吱呀作响的地板、每一扇被推开又合上的室内门，以及那些将自己关在家中的住民所发出的每一次压低的移动声——他们在曾经熙攘的聚落里摸索穿行。
Every building in this eerily silent town shows signs of disrepair of one kind or another, and there is seemingly nobody on the street to remedy this slight ruination. Indeed, virtually every window in town has either been shuttered or boarded up from the inside. Through the quietude, you are able to pick out the sound of every creaking floorboard, every opened and shut interior door, and every hushed movement of the residents shut away in their own homes, all navigating their way through what was once a bustling settlement.

Humanoid Crocodile.name:
类人生物·鳄鱼
Humanoid Crocodile

Text.text:
湿咸的沼泽水面下，一具覆着滑腻爬鳞的躯体缓缓浮出，肌肉在鳞片下起伏鼓动；生物那双泛黄的眼睛死死锁住你，透出毫不掩饰的凶狠与压迫。它抡起沉重的铁矛，双足鳄形的身影在芦苇丛生的水道间从容迈步，将危机四伏的泥沼踏得仿佛铺石大道。
Muscles ripple beneath slick reptilian scales as the creature emerges from beneath the brackish water of the swamp, their yellow eyes fixing you with raw intensity. Hefting a weighty iron spear, the bipedal crocodilian strides gracefully through the reed-choked waters, navigating the treacherous bog as if it were a paved roadway.

Wild Magic Surge: Empowerment.name:
狂野魔法涌动：赋能
Wild Magic Surge: Empowerment

Text.text:
汹涌的力量洪流灌入你的体内，你的重心随之偏移。于这被强化的状态中，你所能驾驭的伤害之力震颤着澎湃威能。满溢的嗜血渴望必须锁定目标……并承诺带来令人震骇与战栗的震撼。
As a surging power floods into you, your center of gravity shifts. In your empowered state, the forces of harm at your disposal vibrate with potency. A brimming bloodlust demands to be targeted… and promises to shock and awe.

其形制奇异，整体近似三角，却在下缘舒展出优雅的翼缘；锻造时刻意留出细小的旋纹与针孔。金面上点缀着微雕的鸟影，并刻有匠人的印记。这是一枚用来“传话”的箭镞：不是缚在箭杆上的纸条那种，而是以自身价值开口——在尸体的密库里被人找到。
The shape is exotic, mostly triangular but with elegant flanges near the bottom, forged with little whorls and pinholes in them. Tiny engravings of birds adorn the gold, along with the maker’s mark. It is an arrowhead designed to send a message: not the kind tied to the shaft, but the kind that speaks through its value—found in the vault of a corpse.

随着天色渐暗，一道摇曳的光芒浮现。起初仿佛只是幻象，但不久便有更多光波与之相合。鲜明的绿、蓝、紫交织其间，又被缕缕金银丝线分隔——它们在头顶起伏荡漾，宛如平静海面上的层层波浪。那光辉洒落，将下方的世界映照在一种诡异的光晕之中。
As the sky darkens, a wavering light manifests. At first, it seems an illusion, but soon enough other waves of light join the first. Vibrant greens, blues, and purples, separated by strands of gold and silver—each undulating above like waves on a calm sea. The lights cast the world below in a strange glow.

一阵响亮而爽朗的大笑先行，随之而来的是个身形魁梧的男人，深色紧卷的头发贴着头皮，夹甲外套上的甲片熠熠生辉。腰间佩剑，背负圆盾，盾面刻着一位神祇的徽记。他扬手大幅比划，眼角因笑意挤出温和的细纹，豪迈地冲入一段惊险的冒险传奇。

~ Played by Salim Hakima

A loud, good-natured laugh precedes a powerfully built man with tightly curled, dark hair, the plates of his brigandine coat shining. He wears a sword on his hip and a shield on his back, the shield’s face bearing the sigil of a deity. A kind smile crinkles the laugh lines about his eyes as he gestures grandly, storming forth into an adventurous tale.

~ Played by Salim Hakima

Deserted House: Insect Swarm.name:
废弃宅邸：虫群
Deserted House: Insect Swarm

Text.text:
一团幽暗的躯体之云从墙里翻涌而出，点点黑影泛着黯淡的异色微光。它们在空中盘旋聚成旋涡般的密团，随即猛然四散，化作一片宽广、嗡鸣的云团在四周疾掠。苍蝇？蜜蜂？或许两者皆是——仿佛以某种方式纠缠在一场群蜂般的战争里。不管它们究竟是什么，都令人不祥。
A cloud of dark bodies, flecks of black gleaming with dull colors, boils out of the wall. They hover in a swirling mass before darting away to buzz in a broad, humming cloud. Flies? Bees? Perhaps both, somehow whirling through a swarming war. Whatever they are, they bode ill.

Crab For Dinner?.name:
螃蟹当晚餐？
Crab For Dinner?

Text.text:
这只甲壳生物从一侧疾速窜到另一侧，多节关节的足肢咬合精准，动作机械得像一具发条傀儡。尽管这只螃蟹体型相对小型（体型），你仍盯着它那荒诞得不成比例的巨螯，权衡着挨上一两下狠夹的风险，与收获那鲜美蟹肉的回报。
Scuttling from one side to the other, the crustacean resembles a clockwork automaton in the precise articulation of its multi-jointed legs. Despite the crab's relatively small size, you keep an eye on its absurdly disproportionate pincers and weigh the risks of enduring a pinch or two against the benefits of harvesting its tasty meat.

The Sanctuary: Spires.name:
圣域：尖塔
The Sanctuary: Spires

Text.text:
纤细的黄褐色石质尖塔自炽热的沙漠砂砾中直刺苍穹。虽有些已然断裂，但每一座完好的塔都一模一样——从仅有1英尺宽的塔基笔直拔起，垂直得近乎刻板。你用爪子沿着表面掠过，触到的光滑岩石却反常地冰凉。尖塔随之轻轻嗡鸣，回荡出一缕微弱而共振的音符。
Thin spires of tan stone soar skyward from the hot desert sand. While some have been broken, each intact tower is identical, standing perfectly vertical and rising from a 1-foot-wide base. As you run your paws across their surface, you find the smooth rock unnaturally cool. The spire rings with a faint resonant note.

Loot From A Hell Cat's Lair.name:
来自地狱猫巢穴的战利品
Loot From A Hell Cat's Lair

Text.text:
你发现一只小巧的机关麻雀，以铜铸成，银边镶饰，并用树胶封水。每到整点，这只鸟便蹦跳啁啾；它也会毫无征兆地振翅进行短促而费力的飞行——约四英尺远——落地后随即吹出一段轻快的短调。若卖出，其价值与金属相当——约7枚金币。
You find a small construct sparrow made of copper with silver trim and water-sealed with gum. The bird hops and chirps on the hour, and randomly takes short, laborious flights of about four feet before landing and whistling a quick tune. It is worth its metal if sold—about 7 gold pieces.

Portable Ram.name:
便携式破门锤
Portable Ram

Text.text:
这根结实的木梁以铁箍加固，末端连着一颗沉重的金属锤头。锤头宽阔而平整的击打面与木梁的水平性相齐平。木梁上装有两只铁制握把，握处缠着皮革。一只靠近锤头固定，另一只则在木梁的另一端附近。
This sturdy wooden beam, banded with iron, ends in a heavy metal head. The head’s broad and flat striking surface aligns with the beam’s horizontal aspect. Attached to the beam are two iron handles with leather-wrapped grips. One handle is affixed near the head, and the other is near the opposite end of the beam.

Medical Suture-bots.name:
医疗缝合机器人
Medical Suture-bots

Text.text:
一个沉重的八角形医疗包剧烈颤动、轰鸣作响。伴随一声气体的嘶嘶泄压，舱门弹开，放出一片翻涌的黑色海潮——像一群鸟低声呢喃着掠过。凑近细看，那些细小黑点竟都是结构精密的微型机器人：六条腿、六边形躯体，腹部还藏着一个微型传感器。每条腿的末端都是缝合针头，专为以骇人的速度编织伤口而生。
A heavy octagonal medpack shudders and rumbles. There’s a gaseous hiss as a compartment door opens to release a swarming sea of black, like a pack of birds, in a murmur. On closer inspection, each tiny dot is actually a complex robot: six legs and a hexagonal body with a microscopic sensor underneath. The legs each end in suture needles, designed to knit wounds with alarming speed.

Spell Scroll (Primal).name:
法术卷轴（原初）
Spell Scroll (Primal)

Text.text:
这卷轴是一片以传统工艺鞣制并妥善保存的兽皮——连那股相应的气味也一并留着。皮革上铺展开精美的野兽与山川图景，与每幅图旁的符文标记相互映衬。
The scroll is a patch of cured animal hide preserved by traditional methods—with the smell to match. Beautiful depictions of beasts and landscapes range across the leather, complementing the runic symbols next to each image.

那瘦长、灰皮的人形从阴影里踉跄而出，步伐迟滞而断续，像结巴般磕绊。它那深陷如暗坑的目光疯狂游移，搜寻着猎物。干涩、吃力的喘息从枯槁的肺里哐哐作响，它猛地朝你一扑，袍褴褛成碎，碎布间伸出不自然地修长的四肢，折断的爪子在空中胡乱抓挠。那生物浑身散发着泥土与腐败的气味、凋萎血肉与陈旧血迹的腥甜；当它空洞的眼睛锁定了你，那深窟般的眼眶里，缓缓亮起一缕病态的光。
The gangly, gray-skinned humanoid emerges from the shadows with halting, stuttered steps. Its dark-pitted gaze roams wildly, seeking prey. Dry, labored breaths rattle from desiccated lungs as the thing lurches toward you, unnaturally long limbs extending from the tatters of its robes, broken claws raking through the air. The creature smells of earth and rot, of withering flesh and old blood, and as its hollow eyes find you, a sickly light grows within those cavernous sockets

尽管佝偻而迟缓，他并不是靠着拐杖支撑自己，更像是用拐杖在前领路。他那灰斗篷与蓬乱的灰胡子透着不修边幅的衰老，脚上的裹足布诉说着一段困苦时代，但他身上却散发着一种古怪的自信。他的眼睛明亮而锋利，是年轻人的眼睛；他虽絮叨沉思，笑话却又快又巧。他讲起近来旅途的见闻。握在杖上的那只手讲着另一类故事——一枚刻着精灵文的银戒，还有一枚镶着红宝石的黄铜戒指。

~ Played by a Hero

Although hunched and slow, he doesn’t lean on his walking stick so much as lead with it. His gray cloak and ratty gray beard suggest an unkempt aging, his footwraps a time of hardship, but he emanates a strange confidence. His eyes are bright and sharp, a young man’s eyes, and though he rambles and ruminates, his jokes are quick and clever. He tells stories of recent travels. The hand on the staff tells other stories—in the form of a silver band engraved in elvish and a brass ring set with a ruby.

~ Played by a Hero

Sundries From A Steel Dragon.name:
钢铁巨龙的杂货
Sundries From A Steel Dragon

Text.text:
坚如淬钢的鳞片从那庞大的生物身上簌簌脱落，它轰然塌下，静卧不动，体内的烈焰迅速冷却。鳞片大如你的手掌，沉甸甸地压在掌心；你从焦灼的地面上拾起几片，入手冰冷而沉重。
Scales hard as tempered steel fall from the huge creature as it crumples and lies still, its internal fire rapidly cooling. As large as your palm, the scales weigh heavy in your hands as you gather a few of them from the scorched ground.

Undead Horde In A City.name:
城市中的亡灵大军
Undead Horde In A City

Text.text:
蹒跚的死者向城中倾泻而出，用腐烂的躯壳堵塞街道与巷弄。异界般的哀嚎充斥空气，它们朝着被困在街上的猎物汹涌扑去，彼此攀爬踩踏，只为触及那顿血肉盛宴。没过多久，这些污秽的怪物便开始砰砰拍打窗户与门扉，甚至攀上建筑本身，寻找许可。
The shambling dead spill outward into the city, clogging the streets and alleyways with their rotting forms. Otherworldly moans fill the air as they surge toward prey caught in the streets, clambering over one another to reach their meal. It's not long before the foul creatures begin banging on windows and doors, and even scaling the buildings themselves to find access.

Unseelie Queen.name:
邪魅妖精女王
Unseelie Queen

Text.text:
一股诡异的寒意先于她而至——那更像是一种压迫性的存在，而非纯粹的肉身。风与影凝聚成一具女性身形，高得令人错愕，既美得摄人，又怖得骇人。与你的目光相触时，你顿觉自己渺小得可怖，仿佛凡人立于亿万年古老的森林之前，那幽暗深处对你可怜的视线而言，深不可测、无从窥探。
An uncanny cold precedes her—an overwhelming presence, rather than a strictly physical form. Wind and shadow coalesce into a feminine figure, bafflingly tall, exuding beauty and terror in equal measure. Meeting her gaze, you feel frighteningly small, as a mortal standing before an eons-old forest, its shadowed depths impenetrable to your pitiful gaze.

Asian Fantasy Setting.name:
亚洲奇幻设定
Asian Fantasy Setting

Text.text:
紫罗兰色的巨峰巍然耸立，峰顶隐没在雾纱之中，怀抱着一片肥沃大地：繁茂的植被在频繁的雨水滋养下浓绿得发亮。大片沼泽与宽阔河流向远方铺展，起于那群阴影般的高山脚下，又终于其足边。农庄兴旺——漫灌的田地、层层梯田、长角耕牛在草间漫步——而魔法在这片土地的每一个角落安然栖息。祖先以兽灵之姿回到此位面；木与岩的细小生灵照拂自然；修长蜿蜒的巨龙穿行于山巅与古老河道之间，鳞片如月光般清亮，鬃毛或繁叶葱茏，或燃焰翻卷，或点缀银金碎辉。供奉这些秘奇的神龛随处可见：自湖心拔起，横跨江河，隐入丛林的层层帷幕，或嵌在峭壁之上，以木制坡道相连，穿梭于直接凿刻在岩石中的壁龛之间。

~ Envisioned by Numi

Violet titans, their peaks shrouded in mist, cradle a fertile land covered in luxuriant foliage, vibrantly green from the frequent rains. Swathes of swampland and wide rivers extend vast distances, beginning and ending at the feet of the looming mountains. Farms flourish—flooded fields, tiered paddies, and grazing oxen with long horns—and magic abides in every corner of the land. Ancestors return to this plane as animal spirits; diminutive beings of wood and rock tend to the natural world; long and winding dragons fly among mountain peaks and along ancient rivers, their scales lunar-bright and their manes lush with leaves, or flame, or with flecks of silver and gold. Shrines to these mysteries abound, rising from the centers of lakes, spanning over rivers, nestling within jungle shrouds, or inhabiting cliffsides with wooden ramps that run between alcoves carved directly into the stone.

~ Envisioned by Numi

宛如一条由地狱烈焰铸成的巨蛇，火海在荒野间蜿蜒穿行。火舌舔舐树木的枝桠，灼黑树皮，啃噬那柔嫩的树心。群鸟从头顶惊惶逃散，鹿群在脚下奔跃疾逃，眼中写满恐惧，拼命甩开毁灭的追赶。热浪压得人喘不过气——浓烟扼住空气，被炽热与夹着灰烬的狂风卷向高空。火星如萤火般漂浮，沿途点燃枯叶与灌丛，转瞬便将烈焰向四面八方疯狂蔓延。
Like a great serpent composed of hellfire, the blaze winds its way through the wilderness. The flames lick at the boughs of trees, scorching bark and eating into their tender hearts. Birds flee overhead, while deer bound away below, outrunning the destruction with panic in their eyes. The heat is overwhelming—smoke chokes the air, carried upward by heat and ash-laced wind. Embers float like fireflies, catching dried leaves and shrubs in their wake. They rapidly spread the blaze in all directions.

Warding Potion With Silver.name:
含银守护药剂
Warding Potion With Silver

Text.text:
细小的银色碎屑漂浮在瓶中钢蓝色的液体里。它不停地旋动——哪怕置之不理——碎屑在其中起舞、回旋。你拔开瓶塞，一股铁锈般的腥气灌满鼻腔；瓶内的液体此刻已然静止，几缕金属烟雾却从中轻柔缭绕而出。
Tiny fragments of silver float in the steely-blue liquid inside the bottle. It swirls constantly—even when left alone—the fragments dancing and twirling within. You uncork the stopper, and a ferrous tang fills your nostrils as wisps of metallic smoke curl gently from the, now still, liquid within.

I Drink My Potion Of Clairvoyance.name:
我喝下洞察灵药
I Drink My Potion Of Clairvoyance

Text.text:
这瓶染着淡黄色的药剂里，一颗眼球惶惶不安地乱窜，瞳孔以急促的节奏忽大忽小。我一边摇晃扭转软木塞，那眼球便死死盯住我。随着我“啵”地一声拔开塞子，瞳孔骤然扩张到极致，随即化作一缕影子消散进液体里。我迅速将它一饮而尽，药液刚溅入胃中，视野便猛地一糊，双眼刺痛。我眨了眨眼想把异样甩开——待视线重新清明时，只见那颗眼球正漂浮在我面前的空气里，轻轻弹跳着，仿佛迫不及待要开始它的差事。
The eyeball within this yellow-tinctured potion flits around nervously, its pupil dilating and contracting in rapid rhythm. As I wiggle and twist the cork, the eyeball fixates on me. Its pupil dilates fully as I remove the cork with a pop, and then it dissipates into the liquid. I drink it down quickly, and as soon as it splashes into my stomach, my vision blurs and my eyes sting. I blink to send these sensations away and, when my sight clears, I see the eyeball floating in the air before me, bouncing as if eager to begin its task.

Ring Mail Armor +1.name:
环甲护甲 +1
Ring Mail Armor +1

Text.text:
这套精工铸就的华美护甲由十余种不同金属的细密甲环编织而成，每一种都赋予其独特的色泽与光辉。整体效果夺目耀眼，银辉层叠成渐变，其间流转着明丽的紫芒与冰冷的蓝光。肩甲与胸前护板加固了肩部与胸膛的薄弱处，而内衬的皮革底衣则在提供额外防护的同时，也带来舒适与灵活。
A dozen different metals make up the finely forged rings of this sublime suit of armor, each lending a unique hue and shine. The overall effect is dazzling, creating a gradient of shining silvers, gleaming violets, and icy blues. Pauldrons and plates reinforce weak points in the shoulders and chest, while a leather undersuit provides additional protection as well as comfort and flexibility.

I Cast Plant Growth.name:
我施放《植物滋长》
I Cast Plant Growth

Text.text:
我用脚趾轻轻接触大地，草地便涌起鲜亮的绿意能量。叶片舒展、增厚，直到我的双足被一层繁茂健康的绿叶地毯吞没。法术的涟漪向外扩散，接触区域内的每一株植物。我看着它们回应我的魔法，肆意疯长——就连树木也不顾时令，骤然繁叶成荫，绽放花朵，结出果实。我的视野被法术所迷惑，让我得以看见万物生长之中生命的震颤：从根须到新芽，石灰绿的能量脉络蜿蜒流淌。我深吸一口气，此刻空气已清冽而洁净。
I touch a toe to the earth, and the grass surges with vibrant green energy. The leaves extend and thicken until my feet disappear in a blanket of healthy green foliage. The spell ripples out, touching every plant in the area. I watch them react to my magic, growing with wild abandon—even the trees burgeon with leaves, flowers, and fruit despite the season. My vision, enchanted by the spell, allows me to see the thrum of life within all that grows: veins of lime-green energy from root to sprig. I take a deep breath, for the air is now crisp and clean.

Wheelchair User's Quip About Steep Ramps.name:
轮椅使用者对陡坡的俏皮吐槽
Wheelchair User's Quip About Steep Ramps

Text.text:
“难道每一段坡道和斜坡都是登山家设计的吗？我去趟酒馆，凭什么每次都得像是在闯什么远古试炼！”

~ 构想 by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

“Was every ramp and slope designed by mountaineers? I shouldn’t have to feel like I’m passing some ancient trial every time I want to visit the pub!”

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Sundries From A Young Silver Dragon.name:
一头年轻银龙的杂物
Sundries From A Young Silver Dragon

Text.text:
这处寒气刺骨的山中巢穴里堆满了大量晦涩古怪的物件，乍看毫无价值：一只断裂的指南针、一本风化崩散、字迹难辨的日记、还有一只被年代褪色的孩童布偶——这些令人费解的“珍宝”只是那堆摇摇欲坠的杂物中的几样。
The frigid mountain den is filled with a large collection of esoteric items which seem to have no value. A broken compass, a crumbling, indecipherable diary, and a child's cloth doll—faded with age—are a few of the puzzling treasures amid the ramshackle pile.

Orc Shaman Casting Augury.name:
兽人萨满施展预兆占卜
Orc Shaman Casting Augury

Text.text:
兽人部族围拢在萨满身旁，环成一圈，将一堆巨大的篝火圈在中央；烟柱盘旋上升，直指繁星。萨满披着兽皮与骨饰，左眼空缺，踏前一步——部族立刻陷入死一般的寂静。萨满左右的兽人各捧出一只类人头骨与一柄雕饰华丽的钉头锤，萨满点头接过。他们高高举起头骨与战锤，让所有人都看清，随即把头骨置于篝火前的一块平石上。萨满猛力自上而下一击，将头骨轰然砸碎。紧接着，他们立刻单膝跪地，拨弄碎片，从断骨残渣间搜寻答案。

~ Requested by Dung Beetle

The orc tribe gathers around the shaman, encircling a large bonfire whose smoke spirals to the stars above. The shaman, garbed in hide and bone and missing their left eye, steps forward—the tribe falls deathly silent. Orcs to the shaman’s left and right produce a humanoid skull and an ornate mace, which the shaman accepts with a nod. They raise the skull and mace aloft for all to reckon, then sets the skull upon a flat stone before the bonfire. With a mighty overhead swing, the shaman shatters the skull. They immediately drop to one knee to sift through the fragments, searching for answers.

~ Requested by Dung Beetle

Child's Introductory Network Rig.name:
儿童入门级网络接入装置
Child's Introductory Network Rig

Text.text:
这套装置由色彩鲜艳的塑料制成，内衬柔软厚实，佩戴起来相当舒适，体型约为常见型号的一半。框架顶端一盏红灯不断闪烁着猩红的光，仿佛在催促你为它重新充能。
The rig is made of brightly colored plastic and is comfortably padded, measuring about half the size of a typical model. A red light at the top of the frame blinks red, asking for a fresh charge.

Gnome's Quip About Judgment.name:
侏儒对审判的俏皮话
Gnome's Quip About Judgment

Text.text:
“你把我当成低你一等的人吗？是因为我的聪明才智？还是因为我的身材？在我看来，你费尽心思把这个世界的图景编排成你高高在上的模样；也许那能让你觉得自己凌驾于人，但在我眼里，只显得你心虚不安。”
“Do you view me as lesser? Is it my intelligence? My stature? It seems to me that you have put a great deal of effort into orchestrating a view of the world that places you on top, and while that may make you feel superior, to me it just makes you seem insecure.”

你踏在这片开垦出来的沼泽地表面，每一步都软绵绵的，仿佛在提醒你：到了那个时代，这里终将回归成曾经的泥沼。可眼下，灌溉沟渠与排水暗槽重塑了这片土地——尽管潮湿阴冷，却已化作一方葱郁的农耕沃野，足以种出丰饶的收成，喂饱难以计数的肚腹。
Every step you take upon the surface of this reclaimed marshland feels spongy, reminding you that in time, this place will eventually be reverted to the swamp it once was. For now, however, irrigation ditches and drains have remade this landscape into a verdant agricultural bounty, dank though it is, able to be planted to feed an incredible number of bellies.

Staff Versus Orb Duel.name:
法杖对决宝珠
Staff Versus Orb Duel

Text.text:
决斗者各自踱步拉开距离，随后转身相对。执杖者微微下蹲，将长杖横于腰间，杖端直指对手。持珠者沉静如雕，端庄自持——一手背在身后，另一手抬至面前一尺处托着宝珠。起始口令一出，决斗几乎在开始的瞬间便告终：长杖破空飞出，正撞上宝珠，将其猛地弹回，砸在持珠者的额头上——她的咒语才念到第二个音节便戛然而止。她应声倒下，昏迷不醒。
The duelists pace off then turn to face one another. The staff wielder crouches slightly and holds the staff waist high, aiming the end toward her opponent. The orb wielder stands calm and still, dignified—one hand behind her back and the other a foot in front of her face, holding the orb. The start is called, and the duel ends almost as soon as it begins, with the staff flying into the orb and knocking it into the orbist’s forehead, two syllables into her incantation. She drops, unconscious.

灰烬与浓烟充斥着炽热灼人的空气，但即便没有这些，你也觉得自己仍能察觉到这生物的邪恶。它高大如风暴巨人，一只长着利爪的手握着一柄滋滋作响、噼啪迸射电光的长剑，另一只手中，一条燃烧的长鞭如蛇般扭动。它背后伸展出巨大的蝠翼，翼膜由炽烈火花与阴影交织而成，随着它转身而舒展收拢；它那不祥的眼睛扫视四周，恶狠狠地逼视着一切。
Ash and smoke fill the blazing hot air, but even without them you think you’d sense this creature’s evil. Standing as tall as a storm giant, in one clawed hand it wields a sword that sizzles and pops with electricity, and in the other a flaming whip writhes like a snake. Huge bat-like wings composed of fiery sparks and shadow extend from its back and flex as it turns baleful eyes to glare around.

Quip About Early Morning Banter.name:
关于清晨闲聊的俏皮话
Quip About Early Morning Banter

Text.text:
“抱歉，但在日出之前，我绝对拒绝接收任何新信息。你们要么配合这一点调整安排，要么我就去找一支更随和的冒险者队伍。”
“I’m sorry, but I absolutely refuse to take in any new information before sunrise. You can all work around that, or I can seek out a more relaxed group of adventurers.”

Perception Check In The Net: Augmented R.name:
网中察觉检定：增强现实
Perception Check In The Net: Augmented Reality

Text.text:
[检定成功] 眼前的世界一片乏味：花岗岩般的灰色建筑、载具与人群。忽然，一片光之星座在你视野中铺展开来。隐匿着繁复代码的小符号在你所见的科技设备周遭浮现，泄露出关于摄像头、引擎与电机的关键信息。向量刻度丈量着距离、温度与风速，以整齐的无衬线文字悬浮在半空中。

[检定失败] 眼前的世界一片乏味：花岗岩般的灰色建筑、载具与人群。短暂的一瞬，光芒在视野里炸裂，细小的光纺锤将眼前的科技与数据闪烁勾连起来——但仅此一瞬。增强信息在一阵猩红脉冲中消散，世界又回到那沉闷的灰。

~ 由一位英雄 设想

[Successful Check] The world before you is dull: granite-gray buildings, transports, and people. Then, a constellation of lights opens up. Small symbols hiding intricate code materialize around the technology you see, divulging crucial information about cameras, engines, and motors. Vectors measure distance, temperature, and windspeed, which are displayed in neat sans-serif text that floats in mid-air.

[Failed Check] The world before you is dull: granite-gray buildings, transports, and people. Briefly, a flicker of light erupts across your vision, small spindles of light linking the tech before you to flashes of data. But only briefly. The augmented information vanishes in a pulse of scarlet, and the dull gray of the world returns.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这看起来像结块的粉笔尘或干枯的地衣，但真相要可怕得多。霉层深处有一丝细微的移动——一阵阵起伏以轻颤穿行其间，仿佛只要最轻的接触，它就会把一蓬孢子抖落进空气里。
This appears to be clumpy chalk dust or desiccated lichen, but it is something far worse. A subtle movement, an undulation, works through the mold in little shivers, as if it were ready to send puffs of spores into the air at the lightest touch.

它掠过一泓死寂的湖岸，贴着水面飞行，擦过睡莲与成片的藻丛、池沼浮泥。它停落片刻，先栖在一根香蒲上，随即又落到你的脸侧、靠近耳廓处。这个微小的昆虫，是兽之神的一个化身——万亿化身中的一具。它踏着细如人发的高跷般小腿踱步，以神祇的嗓音低语：“我杀过的野兽，比世上所有野兽加起来还多。俯首自卑，否则流血染病。你还想从你妄图掌控的兽类世界里索求什么？”
It flies over the shore of a still lake, skimming the waterlilies and shoals of algae and pond scum. It alights for a moment, first on a cattail, and then on your face near your ear. This tiny insect is one avatar—one of trillions—of the God of Beasts. Walking on little stilt legs, each as fine as a human hair, it whispers in the voice of a god, “I have killed more beasts than all other beasts combined. Humble thyself, or bleed and sicken. What more would you ask from the animal world you seek to control?"

Loot From A Goblin Patrol In The Forest.name:
森林地精巡逻队的战利品
Loot From A Goblin Patrol In The Forest

Text.text:
在堆得整整齐齐、仿佛王冠珠宝般珍而重之的垃圾山间，你发现一只绣着精灵纹样的小袋子，缀着细小的玻璃珠饰，倚在一棵树旁。袋中有20枚铂金币。
Among heaps of trash gathered as neatly as if they were the crown jewels, you find a small pouch with elvish embroidery and tiny glass baubles leaning against a tree. In it are 20 platinum pieces.

Arne The Skillful Thief.name:
娴熟盗贼阿尔内
Arne The Skillful Thief

Text.text:
一个如岩石般灰白、如山岳般高大的男人从阴影中缓步现身。他手中的细刃被一圈暗紫色的光晕勾勒：那是魔法，沿着他苍白的手腕与结实的臂膀盘旋而上，最终在他巍峨的全身起伏流淌。碎石般的皮肤覆上他的颧骨与光秃的头顶。他沉重的眉骨像峭壁突岩般外凸，本应将双眼遮在阴影里——若不是那双眼在黑暗中如猫眼般泛光。

~ Played by Arne with

A man as gray as stone, mountain tall, stalks out of the shadows. The thin blade he carries is limned in a dark purple aura: a magic that winds up his pale wrist and muscled arm, eventually undulating over his entire towering form. Pebbled skin grows over his cheekbones and bald head. His heavy brow, protruding like a cliffside crag, would shade his eyes from view—if they did not glow like a cat’s eyes catching light in the dark.

~ Played by Arne with

Blake Mcalister.name:
布莱克·麦卡利斯特
Blake Mcalister

Text.text:
战士脸色苍白，肌肉结实，短发利落，下巴刮得干干净净。阳光里，一颗钻石在他一侧耳垂上闪了一下。他的长柄斧和弩看起来就没那么讨喜了。夹在两者之间的是他那副自负的笑容与警觉的眼神——碧绿、锐利，随时待发。仿佛每一道影子的变换、每一次持剑手臂的抽动，都逃不过他的察觉。那是个发号施令者的目光。

~ 由一位英雄扮演

The fighter is pale, muscled, short-haired, and clean-shaven. A diamond winks in the sunlight from one earlobe. His halberd and crossbow look less cheerful. Between them is his cocky grin and his watchful eyes, green and alert. Aware, it seems, of every change of a shadow or twitch of a sword arm. The eyes of a shot caller.

~ Played by a Hero

一只鱼状生物褐色的头颅从海滩灰白的沙里探出。它头顶那两只小眼睛每次眨动都会整颗缩回肉里，伴着黏腻的噗叽声。它用前鳍像桨一样划动，把自己从沙中彻底拖出，露出一条细长如鳗的躯体。它靠鳍在沙地上滑行，时不时急促停下，翻身侧卧，好让周围的烂泥重新糊满全身。凑近细看，你会发现它身上点缀着一串串电光般的蓝色斑点。
The brown head of a fishlike creature emerges from the gray sand of the beach. The two small eyes on the top of its head recede fully into its flesh each time it blinks, squelching as they do. Using its front fins as paddles, it pulls itself fully out of the sand, revealing a long, eel-like body. It slides itself across the sand with its fins, taking quick breaks to roll itself onto its side for a fresh coating of the surrounding muck. Upon a closer look, you notice electric-blue spots along its body.

Dilapidated Amphitheater.name:
破败的圆形剧场
Dilapidated Amphitheater

Text.text:
这座露天圆形剧场是逝去年代的遗物，早已荒废无人问津。涂鸦爬满了阶段，唯有被风吹来的垃圾与碎屑在角落和地面的凹陷处堆积，留下几块斑驳空白。层层看台的石座崩裂缺口，颜色褪成惨淡的灰。既然能在自家HUD的舒适里观看，又何必跑来坐这冰冷的石凳？
A relic from a bygone era, the amphitheater sits long abandoned. Graffiti covers the stage, except for where windblown trash and debris have collected in corners and divots in the surface. The tiered benches are chipped and faded. Why come sit on a stone bench when you can watch from the comfort of your own HUD?

Hunger Of Hadar.name:
哈达尔之饥
Hunger Of Hadar

Text.text:
现实在一声非人的尖啸中崩裂，你召来一道传送门，揭开群星之间的黑暗。冰冷的宇宙虚空里潜伏着可憎之物，你瞥见乳白色的触手越界探入你的领域，搜猎猎物——随即黑暗笼罩了一切。
Reality comes apart with an unearthly scream as you summon a portal to reveal the darkness between the stars. Hideous things lurk in the frozen cosmic void, and you catch a glimpse of milky white tentacles crossing into your realm, hunting for prey—before darkness shrouds the scene.

I Cast Polymorph On A Wheelchair User.name:
我对一名轮椅使用者施放了【变形术】
I Cast Polymorph On A Wheelchair User

Text.text:
我用指尖碾碎那枚保存完好的毛虫茧，口中吟诵最后的蜕变音节，抬手指向我的同伴。汹涌的转化魔法倾泻而出，将他们吞入一座虹彩熔炉般的盆地；鲜活的血肉、金属与皮革在其中交融，他们的轮椅也并入了新生的躯体。轮子解构为金属之翼，辐条被拉伸弯折塑成肢体——眨眼之间，蜕变已然完成。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，Forge Ahead: A Party To Access 呈献

Crushing the preserved caterpillar cocoon between my fingers, I intone the final transformative syllables and point toward my companion. A rush of transmutation magic engulfs them in a prismatic caldera, blending living flesh, metal, and hide as their wheelchair becomes part of their new body. Wheels unravel into metal wings, spokes stretch and bend to form limbs, and—in the blink of an eye—the transformation is complete.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Loot From A Solar.name:
来自“太阳”的战利品
Loot From A Solar

Text.text:
当那位光辉灿然的天界战士倒下时，他们松开了那柄巨刃；它无声飘落，轻若羽翎，缓缓贴向地面。你的手一合，握住剑柄，灼亮的温暖便涌入体内，银辉长剑随即为契合你的需求而变形，低低嗡鸣。
As the radiant angelic warrior falls, they drop their enormous blade, and it drifts silently to the ground like a feather. As your hand closes around the hilt, a radiant warmth flows through you and the argent sword changes form to suit your needs, humming softly.

Ediumere Van Jourgenstien.name:
埃迪乌梅尔·范·尤尔根斯坦
Ediumere Van Jourgenstien

Text.text:
那件剪裁精致的深蓝长外套与宽檐帽，看上去就像远行商贩的常见装束，或许也像个水手——直到你看见旅人左手：被一只厚重、镶满宝石的臂铠紧紧包覆。他抬起帽檐，而帽下并非双眼，只有两枚发光的镜片嵌在金属面孔上；那张脸几乎毫无五官，只被几道深深的凿痕撕裂。镜片与你对视，沉默而漫长，无需言语。随后，臂铠上的宝石骤然一闪，高挑的身影便在离地数寸处缓缓悬起。他把帽檐重新压下，遮住面容，悄无声息地从你身旁飘过，尘埃微粒在空中翻舞，标记着他法师般的行迹。

~ Played by Keegan Brown

The fine long navy coat and wide-brimmed hat resemble a typical ensemble for a traveling merchant, or perhaps a seaman—but then you see the traveler’s left hand, encased in a thick, bejeweled gauntlet. They push up the brim of the hat, and instead of eyes, you see two glowing lenses set in a metallic face, relatively featureless save for several deep gouges. The lenses meet your gaze for a long, wordless moment. Then the jewels upon the gauntlet flash, and the tall figure begins hovering several inches in the air. Replacing the brim of his hat to obscure his face, he soundlessly floats past, motes of dust marking his wizardly passage.

~ Played by Keegan Brown

Bloodstained Blackjack.name:
染血的二十一点
Bloodstained Blackjack

Text.text:
目光几乎会略过这把小小的武器；它的黑漆与污浊的沥青融为一体。但红色总会引人注目——这根短棒的末端在被丢弃在此之前，已被血迹溅得斑斑点点。
The eye almost skips over the small weapon, its black paint blending in with the dirty asphalt. But red tends to draw attention, and the end of the blackjack was splattered with blood before it was abandoned here.

Bard's Appeal To Mercenaries.name:
吟游诗人对佣兵的呼唤
Bard's Appeal To Mercenaries

Text.text:
尽管实力悬殊，聚集起来的村民仍挡住了当地领主队伍的推进。紧张气氛层层堆叠：雇佣兵们的手阴沉地悬在武器柄旁，迎面却是高举的干草叉，倔强地指向他们。一名高大、饱经风霜的男人把鲁特琴斜挂在背上，走进两拨人之间的空间里。“我主麾下的士兵们，我能感觉到你们心中暴力正升腾，也能感到责任压在你们肩头——可没有怜悯的责任，又有什么用？”他以富有魅力而克制的节奏对雇佣兵说道：“当你们看着这些朴素的人，你们看到的是敌人，是一团不忠、野蛮而无知的乌合之众；但我恳请你们再看近一些。看看他们的脸——那些因多年的笑声与欢聚而刻下的皱纹与褶痕。看看他们的护符与纪念物——由温柔、充满爱意的双手制成，只盼能护送主人平安归家。它们难道不像你们自己的吗？我们的挚爱究竟做错了什么，才该受我们缺席的惩罚？他们此刻都在等我们，在温暖、敞亮的家中，远离这条街上攫住每个人的仇恨。让我们回到他们身边——并且要知道，若我们选择和平之道，下次再相见，便可共饮一杯蜜酒。”

~ Envisioned by Walt M.

Though outmatched, the amassed villagers block the advance of the local lord’s contingent. Tension builds as the mercenaries, hands menacingly near their weapons’ hilts, are met with pitchforks raised in defiance. A tall, weather-beaten man, lute slung across his back, steps into the space between the two groups. “Soldiers of our liege, I can feel the rising violence in your hearts and the weight of duty on your shoulders, but what use is duty without compassion?” He addresses the mercenaries in a charismatic, measured cadence. “When you look at these humble people, you see an enemy, a disloyal mass of savagery and ignorance, but I urge you to look closer. To see their faces, wrinkled and creased from years of laughter and merriment. To see their talismans and keepsakes, crafted by gentle, loving hands, in the hope that they would see their owners safely home. Do they not match your own? What have our loved ones done to deserve our absence? They await all of us now, in homes warm and welcoming, free from the hatred that grips all on this street. Let us return to them—and know that if we choose the way of peace, the next time we see each other can be over a glass of mead.”

~ Envisioned by Walt M.

The Sense Of A Failing Ward.name:
崩坏结界的预感
The Sense Of A Failing Ward

Text.text:
你看不出也听不出任何异样，但记忆却召来一幕幕画面：帘幕悄然分开，气泡猝然破裂。一座由魔法构筑的架构——某道编入织纹的墙——已然松解崩散，剥落消逝。
You don’t see or hear anything different, but your memory summons the images of a curtain parting and a bubble bursting. An architecture of magic, some wall woven in the weave, has unraveled and fallen away.

Lambug Brightstriker.name:
兰布格·亮击者
Lambug Brightstriker

Text.text:
一具敦实的牛形身躯，覆着仿佛夜空般点点繁星的毛皮，与兽人女子厚实的躯干无缝相接。她深色的眼睛又大又灵动，追随着某个看不见的东西。她忽然扬身而起，甩了甩头，象牙色的辫子抽风似的掠过，将一只苍蝇从空中拍落。沉重的连枷也随之晃动，那颗陨铁枷头划出一道弧线，仿佛戏谑地重演它的星辰来历。她转了转结实的肩膀，又落回四只蹄子上，胸甲与下方的链裙相碰，叮当作响。她一边调整护住胸前的钢制胫裙甲，一边踢踏着向前迎你走来，带着母亲般的笑意，露出短短的獠牙。

~ Played by PufferNami

A stout bovine body, covered in fur speckled like the night sky, merges seamlessly into the thick torso of the orc woman. Her dark eyes—wide and expressive—track something unseen. She rears up suddenly and flicks her head, her ivory braid swatting a fly from the air. Her heavy flail jostles with the movement, its meteoric head arcing in a parody of its astral origin. She rolls her muscled shoulders and settles back on four hooves, cuirass clinking against the chain skirt beneath. Adjusting the steel faulds that protect her brisket, she clops forward to greet you, a motherly smile revealing her stubby tusks.

~ Played by PufferNami

Bard Assuming The Mantle Of Majesty.name:
吟游诗人：披上威仪之冕
Bard Assuming The Mantle Of Majesty

Text.text:
吟游诗人披上一层魅影，轻松得仿佛只是耸肩穿上舒适的外衣。眨眼之间，他们的形貌已然变了——又或者，他们一直就是这般模样？那副容颜惊艳到近乎不属于尘世，灿然夺目得令人难以移开目光。他们对被俘获的旁观者冷淡地下达要求，带着狡黠而精致的微笑旁观魅影施展其蛊惑的魔法。
The bard covers themselves in glamour with the ease of shrugging into a comfortable coat. Their form changes in a blink—or have they always looked this way? It’s an appearance so stunning, so otherworldly in its splendor, that it’s difficult to turn away. They make laconic demands of their captivated onlookers, and watch with a sly, exquisite smile as the glamour works its beguiling magic.

Loot From A Young Red Dragon.name:
幼年红龙的战利品
Loot From A Young Red Dragon

Text.text:
宽阔的火山洞窟里，金光在每一个角落闪烁。满溢财富的宝箱散落其间，钱币如河流般泼洒在玄武岩地面上。一只抛光金属碗置于石质基座顶端，碗中红宝石与耀眼的火蛋白石、石榴石交错辉映；黑化岩壁上凿出的壁龛里，数位统治者的大理石胸像冷峻地俯视着来者。后壁堆起焦黑的骨骸与熔化的武器，其间清晰可见数具类人生物的残骸，令这阴森的收藏更添寒意。这里的贵重物价值5000枚金币。
Gold glitters in every corner of the spacious volcanic cavern. Chests overflowing with riches scatter coins across the basalt floor like a river. Rubies mingle with gleaming fire opals and garnets in a polished metal bowl atop a stone pedestal, and the marble busts of several rulers peer sternly from alcoves carved in the blackened rock. Charred bones and melted weapons are piled high at the rear wall, with some humanoid remains clearly visible among the macabre collection. The valuables here are worth 5000 gold pieces.

Magic-nullifying Gas, Spell Stripper.name:
抑魔毒气，法术剥离者
Magic-nullifying Gas, Spell Stripper

Text.text:
玻璃管内翻涌的蒸汽呈现出一种令人却步的猩红色，裹挟着细小如尘的铅灰颗粒旋舞不止。此气体一旦与奥术能量接触，便会产生独特的腐蚀效果，将法术的镶嵌纹理一点点蚕食、崩解，宛如蛾幼虫钻穿织物。这种化学品通常用作一种——大多无害——的威慑手段，用来对付不受欢迎之地的法师与其技艺。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The roiling vapor inside the glass tube is a prohibitive red color, swirling with minute lead-gray particles. The gas has a uniquely corrosive effect when it comes in contact with arcane energy, deteriorating the tessellations of a spell like moth larvae through fabric. This chemical generally finds use as a—mostly harmless—deterrent against mages and their arts in places where they’re not wanted.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

没有熟悉的枪响，也没有那种令人满足的后坐力。取而代之的，只有那令人胆寒的哑火“咔哒”一声。那声响一出，你的心也随之沉了下去。击锤猛地一抽，发出别扭的嘎吱碎响，而扳机怎么也扣不动。哑火的武器上腾起一缕幽暗的雾气，盘旋缠绕，最终拧成一股残酷扭曲的黑烟。
No customary bang, no satisfying kick from the gun. Instead, there’s only the dreaded click of a misfire. Your heart sinks with the sound. The hammer jerks back with an awkward crunch, and the trigger will not pull. A dark coil of mist rises from the misfired weapon, curling into a cruel twist of smoke.

Faerie Fire, Revealing All.name:
妖精之火，尽显无遗
Faerie Fire, Revealing All

Text.text:
一道道绚丽的光痕自你掌心迸射而出，勾勒出区域内的一切，将万物尽数照见。光芒贴着他们的轮廓流淌，随着他们移动而紧随不舍，使其轻易成为目标。
Streaks of colorful light shoot from your palm, outlining everything within the area and revealing all. The light hugs their form, following them as they move and making them an easy target.

Halfling Living Room.name:
半身人客厅
Halfling Living Room

Text.text:
一座气势非凡的壁炉占据了客厅那面长墙，厚实的木柴在炉膛里噼啪作响，足够让火焰再燃上好几个小时。沙发从各个意义上都称得上“被好好爱过”——堆满靠枕与毯子，因多年宾客往来与聚会而微微塌陷，却仍旧蓬松柔软、坐上去格外舒适。色彩鲜艳的地毯与挂毯为这片空间添上明亮的光彩，而住客的兴趣痕迹也随处可见：鲁特琴与烟斗斜倚墙边，编织用具搁在沙发上，玩具从座椅底下探出一角。

~ ~ Guest Writer Sadie Lowry

An impressive fireplace dominates the long wall of the living room, crackling atop thick logs that will feed it for hours. The couches are well loved in every sense of the word—laden with pillows and throw blankets, sagging from years of guests and gatherings, yet somehow still plush and comfortable. Vividly colored rugs and tapestries brighten the space, and signs of the occupants’ hobbies lie littered about: lutes and pipes lean against the wall, knitting supplies sit on the couch, toys peek out from under a seat.

~ ~ Guest Writer Sadie Lowry

你低声哼出这道法术的音节，嘴唇以稳定的嗡鸣震颤着，想象着世界从昆虫的视角会是什么模样。刹那间，你看见一百个版本的自己，每一个都高如泰坦。然而，那些重重倒影随即缩小；当你眨眼想将视线拭清时，正在生长的昆虫猛然凝成庞然的实体。
You hum the syllables of this spell, vibrating your lips in a steady buzz as you consider what the world must look like from the perspective of an insect. For an instant, you see a hundred versions of yourself, each towering as high as a titan. But your many reflections shrink, and when you blink your eyes to clear them, the growing insects snap into massive solidity.

Herbalist's Yard In Winter.name:
冬日草药师的庭院
Herbalist's Yard In Winter

Text.text:
冬日的阳光把几处无雪的地块烘得微暖，鼠尾草与百里香、洋甘菊与安息日花束便在其中悄然滋长。草药师拄着木杖、挎着采集囊走了许久，带回收获后又埋下一枚球茎，只为早春抢先发芽。她用小鹤嘴锄轻轻凿开地面，直挖到幽黑的土层，将球茎安放其间，低声呢喃着鼓舞的咒语。她巡查篱笆，在炉火旁磨利工具，守夜看着白雪无声覆上这座古朴而强韧的庭院。
Snowless patches warmed by the winter sun grow sage and thyme, chamomile and sabbath posy. After a long walk with a stick and gathering satchel, the herbalist plants a bulb for early spring. She takes a small pick to the earth, down to the dark soil, places the bulb, and whispers encouraging incantations. She checks fences, sharpens tools by the fire, and watches the snow softly blanket the quaint and powerful yard.

Prisoner Found In Cellar.name:
地窖中发现囚徒
Prisoner Found In Cellar

Text.text:
敞开的门缝涌进光亮，瞬间灌满地窖，照出一个男人靠着木桶坐着，脑袋无力地垂在胸前。光线刺来，他猛地抬起双臂遮住眼睛。皮肤与衣物肮脏不堪，尽是暗红色的污渍。那堆被染污的麻袋在他身下散出一股浓烈的恶臭，扑面而来。他小心翼翼地睁开眼，偷瞥向你，嘴巴大张，难以置信地愣住了。
As the light from the open door fills the cellar, it illuminates a man sitting against a barrel with his head hanging low. He throws up his arms to shield his eyes as the light hits him. His skin and clothes are filthy, covered in ruddy stains. A ripe stench wafts from the stained sacks on which he sits. He opens his eyes gingerly to glimpse you, his mouth open in an incredulous gape.

尽管剥落的铁面上锈迹如花般蔓延，落闸门依旧坚如山岳——同样冷酷而不可撼动。它不过是一道简朴的金属网格，连着粗壮沉重的铁链；然而正是这道屏障，让城堡的居民世代得以安然无恙——有时，旧法子仍是最好的。
Though rust blooms across the flaking iron, the portcullis is sturdy as any mountain—and just as implacable. A simple metal grid attached to thick, heavy chains, this barrier has kept the residents of the castle safe for generations—sometimes the old ideas are still the best.

Smoking Room For Pipe Weed.name:
烟草烟室
Smoking Room For Pipe Weed

Text.text:
一座被烟灰熏染、恢弘得令人屏息的壁炉统御着这间木饰墙板的房间，宽阔的炉膛吐出安抚人心的暖光。奢华的厅室里弥漫着烟草的浊雾，舒适而磨旧的扶手椅为房中之人奉上柔软的歇息。雕花壁炉台上方，一幅冷峻的油画如守夜般俯视着一切，火光在它鎏金的画框上摇曳流转。
A soot-stained fireplace of immense grandeur dominates the wood-paneled room, offering a comforting glow from its ample hearth. A miasma of pipe weed saturates the air in the opulent chamber and comfortable, well-worn armchairs provide cushioned respite for the room’s occupants. An austere oil painting watches from above the carved mantel, the firelight shimmering across its gilded frame.

Giant Constrictor Snake.name:
巨型缠绕蟒
Giant Constrictor Snake

Text.text:
你面前这条巨蛇大得惊人，颚骨一旦脱臼张开，足以一口吞下一个成年类人生物。它那庞大的盘绕之躯蕴含着骇人的绞力，几乎不费吹灰之力便能将一头食人魔活活勒死。
The oversized serpent before you is so large that its jaws, once unhinged, would allow it to devour a fully-grown humanoid. Its enormous coils possess sufficient strength to squeeze an ogre to death with little ceremony.

I Read An Enchantment Spell Scroll I Und.name:
我读出一张我能理解的惑控法术卷轴
I Read An Enchantment Spell Scroll I Understand

Text.text:
卷轴上优雅的金色书写在纸面上闪烁流光，自行聚合成我能理解的法术词句。文字令人着迷，几近催眠，我发现自己竟难以将目光从那华美的书法上移开。
The elegant gold script of the scroll glitters on the page, forming itself into the words of a spell I can understand. The text is enthralling, almost hypnotic, and I find myself struggling to look away from the beautiful calligraphy.

Sundries From A Nightwalker.name:
夜行者的杂项
Sundries From A Nightwalker

Text.text:
高耸的亡灵轰然倒下，带角的头颅到分蹄的双足，尸身绵延三十余尺。它那不祥的气息虽在消散，却仍贪婪地啃噬着所能触及的一切，让附近的人尽数染上反胃与悲恸的阴霾。你俯身搜寻战利品——倘若能从一场噩梦的幻象里拾到什么。它的利爪与尖角不再闪耀，昆虫般的头颅里曾幽幽发着青绿鬼光的眼睛也已黯淡。你剖开它的腹部，迎面扑来一股冰冷的腐旧空气，带着死亡的腥臭，同时响起一声刺骨的尖啸。
The towering undead has fallen, the length of its body stretching over thirty feet from horned head to cloven feet. Its ill aura, though fading, still eats away at what it can, plaguing all those nearby with feelings of nausea and sorrow. You search the thing for spoils to be gathered—if anything could be gathered from a vision of nightmares. Its claws and horns do not gleam, and the eyes that glowed a spectral teal within its insectoid head have dimmed. Slicing into its belly, you are met with a cold rush of stale air smelling of death, and a chilling shriek.

Pile Of Bones In A Corner.name:
角落里的一堆白骨
Pile Of Bones In A Corner

Text.text:
大厅角落里一团惨白夺人眼目。各式大小的头骨与其他骨骸胡乱堆叠在墙边。好几块因粗暴对待而碎裂，这堆骇人的收藏也看不出任何整理归类的痕迹。
A mass of white in the corner of the hall draws the eye. Skulls and other bones of various sizes sit haphazardly stacked next to the wall. Several are broken from rough treatment, and there doesn’t seem to be any sort of organization to the macabre collection.

一张巨大的络腮胡面孔自岩壁中凝视而出，紧蹙的嘴唇化作通往山腹的门户。矮人头顶覆着城垛般的冠饰，使这座雕刻宛如一位阴郁的王者。那道巨石吊桥如同修长的下颚与下唇，几乎紧闭，仿佛这位矮人王正闹着别扭般噘着嘴。
An enormous bearded face stares out of the rock, its frowning mouth serving as gateway to the mountainside. A crenellation crowns the head of this dwarf, giving the carving the impression of a brooding king. The massive stone drawbridge serving as a long jaw and lower lip stands mostly closed, as if this dwarf king is pouting.

这座坟冢长得异常瘆人，仿佛埋在土丘下的人高得像个食人魔。墓碑上刻着的墓志铭写道：磐石或将化作尘埃，海洋或将干涸，但只要群星仍在闪耀，她便不会被遗忘。 The grave seems abnormally long, as if whoever was buried beneath the mound was as tall as an ogre. The epitaph engraved in in the tombstone reads: Stone might turn to dust, oceans might dry, but so long as stars shine, she will be remembered.

View Of An Elven Palace From Within The.name:
从都城之内眺望精灵宫殿
View Of An Elven Palace From Within The Capital

Text.text:
在基座之上，一尊大理石雕成的战阵统帅手持长矛，头戴羽饰头盔。它以坚定的凝视注视着集市的行动。这座城的精灵穿行其间，身着轻盈宽松的长袍，许多人将月桂叶编进乌黑的发丝里。正午阳光下，他们橄榄色的肌肤覆着一层薄汗，微微发亮。远处，王宫依山而建，建筑与大地完美交融——浑然天成。

~ 构想：Goblin Man

Upon its dais, the marble likeness of a war commander bears a long spear and plumed helmet. It observes the activity of the market with a determined stare. The elves of this city move about in airy, loose-fitting robes, and many of them have laurel leaves threaded through their dark hair. Their olive skin shines with a light sweat under the midday sun. In the distance, the palace is built into the side of a hill, its architecture melding beautifully—seamlessly—with the earth.

~ Envisioned by Goblin Man

Xanner Melaer, \"Vile Tongue\" Of House.name:
赞纳·梅莱尔，巴塔尔家族的“毒舌”
Xanner Melaer, "Vile Tongue" Of House Bartal

Text.text:
一袭流动的黑色斗篷披在一名瘦长的熊地精（特征）肩头。斗篷前角上绣着一幅鲜亮夺目的图案，在深色布料上格外刺眼：两颗龇牙咆哮的狼头，外圈被盛放的玫瑰组成的日芒般花环环绕。他一动，背后挂着的巨大瓶形葫芦里便传来沉重的晃荡水声。他狭长的脸庞被一圈狼鬃般的月白长发框住，发丝间夹着淡蓝的条纹，扎成八股发辫——每股末端都扣着一枚闪亮的银环——从头顶垂到背部中央。两颊的络腮胡上泛着玫瑰般的红晕。他嘴角一歪，露出顽皮的坏笑，舌尖顶着牙齿——仿佛下一秒就要抛出一句粗俗的笑话。

~ Played by christoffer with

The flowing black cloak that bedecks the shoulders of a slender bugbear displays a vibrant image on the front corner, striking against the dark fabric: two snarling wolf heads surrounded by a sunburst of roses in bloom. As he moves, a deep sloshing sound comes from a huge bottle-shaped gourd hanging on his back. His narrow face is framed in a lupine mane of moon-white hair, streaked with light blue and held in eight braids—each ending in a shining silver ring—which trail from his crown to the middle of his back. A rosy flush brims over his mutton chops. His mouth quirks into a mischievous grin, his tongue pressing against his teeth—as if he's about to tell a crude joke.

~ Played by christoffer with

Forge Of Spells.name:
法术熔炉
Forge Of Spells

Text.text:
穹顶房间的墙壁映照着柔和绿符文的稳定脉动，那些符文深深刻入如玻璃般的石材之中。铁砧、铁锤以及其他金工工具皆因长期使用而磨损，散落在房间边缘。空间中央，一座大理石基座托着银制火盆，空洞的绿色火焰舔舐着空气，停驻的时间比它们本该停留的更久。
The walls of the domed room reflect the steady pulse of soft green runes, etched deep into the glass-like stone. An anvil, a hammer, and other metal working tools, all worn from use, lay about the periphery of the room. In the centre of the space, a marble pedestal holds a silver brazier from which hollow green flames lick the air, lingering a moment longer than they should.

应召而来，小丑从人群中滑步而出，瘦削身形披着暗色缎衣，带着几分无赖的潇洒。他涂彩的脸忽地绽开一抹阴恻的笑，手法娴熟地从旁边一位贵妇头上顺走一顶高高的羽饰礼帽，轻巧地扣到自己头顶。“时尚之巅，”他高声叫道，戴着手套的双手把帽子一圈圈框出，“……显然已经飞上了鹰巢！”他学着鸟叫怪声一啼，随即把帽子猛地抛回那位贵妇的情郎怀里，对方顿时被一脸羽毛扑得狼狈。人群哄笑起来，紧张与取乐各占一半，小丑翻滚着朝下一个将被他奚落的倒霉蛋扑去。

~ Envisioned by GrantM

Summoned, the jester slips out from the crowd, his thin frame roguishly garbed in dark satin. His painted face breaks into a wicked smile as he smoothly steals a tall, feathered hat from a nearby noblewoman and perches it atop his own head. “The height of fashion,” he exclaims, framing the hat with his gloved hands, “...has apparently reached an eyrie!” He squawks and flings the hat back to the noblewoman’s beau, who receives a faceful of plumes. The crowd laughs, equal parts nervous and amused, as the jester tumbles toward the next victim of his jibes.

~ Envisioned by GrantM

镜子的华丽镜框斜倚在旁边的边桌上。镀金的花丝雕饰黯淡失色、斑驳氧化——尽管房间里其他家具都显示出对保存与光泽近乎苛刻的讲究。镜面的尘埃与碎片散落一地，如同带刃的雪粉纷纷扬扬。
The ornate frame of the mirror leans against a nearby side table. Its gilded filigree is dull and tarnished—although the other furniture in the room suggests a meticulous attention to preservation and sheen. The mirror’s dust and shards litter the floor like razored snowfall.

Newborn Half-orc.name:
新生的半兽人
Newborn Half-orc

Text.text:
这名新生儿乍看之下像个人类——唯有皮肤泛着淡淡的青绿，牙龈间还顶出两枚细小的白色獠牙。显然，兽人的血正奔流在他们的血脉之中。
The newborn might appear at first to be human, except for the greenish hue of their skin and the tiny white tusks jutting from their gums. It’s clear that orc blood courses through their veins.

My Shield +1 Deflects A Blade.name:
我的+1盾牌格开一记刀锋
My Shield +1 Deflects A Blade

Text.text:
我用盾牌将刀锋拨到一旁，随即稳住身形，双脚牢牢钉在地面上，准备迎接下一次攻击。换作寻常些的壁垒，早已在这一击的狂力下崩裂粉碎；而我这面附魔之盾仍旧岿然不屈，毫发无损。
I turn the blade aside with my shield then steady myself, planting my feet, to prepare for the next attack. A lesser bulwark would have been sundered by the force of the strike, yet my enchanted shield remains unbowed and unbroken.

Taunt From A Medusa About An Attractive.name:
“哎呀，真是可爱得让人心痒——你那张脸，简直像是专门为我的花园准备的雕像胚子。别躲，别眨眼，来，把你最得意的表情留住……我会让你美得一动不动，永远。”
Taunt From A Medusa About An Attractive Party Member

Text.text:
“哎呀，你可真是赏心悦目！我知道像你这般俊俏的人，绝不会把路过的一瞥施舍给我这种人，但很快我们就会有整整一个永恒来彼此熟悉。若你能在终结来临前摆个姿势，亮一亮那对闪着光的肱二头肌，我可就感激不尽了。”
“Well, aren’t you a sight to behold! I know one so handsome would never spare a passing glance to someone like me, but soon we’ll have a whole eternity to get to know each other. If you could strike a pose that shows off those glistening biceps just before the end, I would appreciate it.”

这根法杖看上去毫不起眼。乍一看，它不过是一截粗糙削成的树枝，杖首盘着一团打结的根须，宛如可供安放之座——仅此而已。可若再细看，便能从木纹上那些刻痕、蚀刻与伤口里，读出这根饱经风霜的杖所经历的岁月，以及它曾踏上的无数旅途。
There is nothing remarkable about this staff. It is a roughly carved branch with a seat of knotted roots at its head—at first glance. When one looks closer, they might see the marks, etchings, and wounds in the wood that tell the story of this timeworn stave and the many journeys it has been taken on.

One Day Of Travel By Foot Through Jungle.name:
徒步穿越丛林的一天旅行
One Day Of Travel By Foot Through Jungle

Text.text:
你拖着沉重的脚步穿行在丛林里，四周生命汹涌。馥郁的风掠过枝叶，树冠沙沙作响；你一靠近，灌木下的生灵便窸窣逃散。你沿着灌丛层住民踩出的小径旅行，耳畔是昆虫无休止的嗡鸣，远处传来吼猴低沉的啸叫。浓密树冠漏下的昏暗碎光勉强够你辨路；可即便在阴影里，闷热与潮湿仍让你汗水浸透全身。

~ 由 Spac3cowboyy Envisioned

You trudge through the jungle, teeming with life. A fragrant wind rustles the trees, and creatures flee through the underbrush at your approach. You travel by way of paths left by creatures dwelling in the shrub layer accompanied by the incessant buzzing of insects, while howler monkeys hoot in the distance. The dim, dappled light leaking through the dense canopy is enough to see by, but despite the shade you feel yourself soaked with sweat in the heat and humidity.

~ Envisioned by Spac3cowboyy

一座巨大的围栏环绕着前方的翠绿牧场。更矮的加固木墙将牧场分隔成四个象限，其间各色各样、大小不一的蜥蜴类生物低头啃食。它们的头骨上隆起尖角，脊背一路竖起棘刺，尾端还长着沉重的骨质棍槌。有的慵懒地晒着太阳，有的却在围栏里狂躁游走，四处寻找逃离这座坚固囚笼的机会。 一处圆形小栏里，两名驯兽人正与一只桀骜的爬行生物周旋，长鞭抽裂空气。那生物发出刺耳的尖啸咆哮，猛然以厚重的头骨撞向旁边驯兽人的腹部——那人当即被撞得凌空翻飞，越过栏墙重重摔出，蜷成一团，纹丝不动。

~ 由 Spac3cowboyy 构想

A massive pen encircles the green pasture beyond. Shorter walls of reinforced timbers separate the pasture into quadrants, and within saurian creatures of myriad shapes and sizes graze. Horns crest their skulls, spikes run along their spines, and their tails are tipped with heavy cudgels of bone. Some laze in the sun, while others roam wildly, searching for an escape from the fortified enclosure. In a circular pen a pair of beast-tamers work with an unruly reptilian creature, cracking the air with whips. The creature looses a screeching roar and slams its dense skull into the gut of a nearby tamer, who goes hurtling over the pen’s wall and lies, unmoving, in a heap.

~ Envisioned by Spac3cowboyy

Troglodyte Warlord's Intimidating Presen.name:
穴居人军阀的威吓气场
Troglodyte Warlord's Intimidating Presence

Text.text:
石制长杖上那颗熠熠生辉的蓝宝石杖首驱散了黑暗。一名穴居蜥蜴人把长着棘刺的脸颊倚在杖上，那里有一段弯下的石质结构，形成一枚如镰刀般的獠牙。即便他佝偻着身子、细长的脖颈前倾，你仍意识到这名生物恐怕足有八英尺高。而且他并不孤单。蜥蜴般的面孔如潮水般将你围住，恶臭从他们身上剥落般涌出——腐败、浓烈、无休无止。他们的鳞片颜色射程从灰褐到淤紫再到淡粉。为首者的皮鳞鲜橙夺目，点缀着黑色斑点。

“总算见到你了，”他嘶声道，分叉的舌头在空气中轻舔，收集你的气味。他湿润的黑眼里嵌着幽蓝发光的瞳孔，漫不经心地扫过你的脸，像路人欣赏一只微小却惹眼的昆虫。

The shining sapphire head of a stonework staff drives away the darkness. A troglodyte leans his spined cheek against the staff where a length of stone curves down to create a scythe-like tooth. Even stooped, his slender neck bent forward, you realize the creature must be about eight feet tall. And he is not alone. A sea of saurian faces surrounds you, the stench sloughing off them fetid, ripe, and relentless. Their scales range from brownish-gray to bruise purple to pale pink. This leader sports a hide of vibrant orange, speckled with black.

“Pleased to finally meet you,” he hisses, his forked tongue lapping at the air to gather your scent. His moist black eyes house glowing blue pupils that scan your face with a lax interest, like a passerby admiring a tiny, yet eye-catching, insect.

Quip About Indulging.name:
关于放纵享乐的俏皮话
Quip About Indulging

Text.text:
“你有没有试着稍微为自己活一回？熬个夜？吃一顿罪恶而奢靡的大餐？赤身裸体站在溪流里，让清水从你身上淌过？这世间有太多欢愉，沉溺其中，并非自私。”
“Have you ever tried living for yourself a little? Staying up late? Eating that sinfully decadent meal? Standing naked in a stream and letting the water wash over you? This world offers so many pleasures, and it is not selfishness to indulge in them.”

One Day Of Travel By Horse On Grassland.name:
草原上骑马旅行的一天
One Day Of Travel By Horse On Grassland

Text.text:
你在一片草海中旅行，草高得几乎拂过马腹；坐骑在丘陵间起伏、谷地里穿行，小心择路，循着辽阔平原上时隐时现的鹿径与熊道前进。你和坐骑在树荫下休息了两次，马儿也欢快地啃食青草。即便疲惫缠身，你仍咬牙继续。这样的旅行即使骑在马背上也令人乏累，但终于，当夕阳沉入远处的群丘之后，你触及了目标。
You travel through a sea of grass so tall it brushes your horse's belly as it picks a way over hills and through valleys, following deer trails and bear paths as they appear in the sprawling plains. You and your mount rest twice in the shade of a tree, and your horse grazes happily. You press on, despite your weariness. The travel is tiresome, even on horseback, but finally, as the sun dips behind the distant hills, you reach your objective.

飞镖线条流畅而优雅，暗示着这枚投射物在合适的人手中将展现致命的灵巧。寒光自这件武器锋利的尖端一闪，仿佛这件物体正露出一抹狡黠的笑。
The sleek, elegant lines of the dart hint at the projectile’s deadly grace—in the right hands. Light twinkles from the weapon’s piercing tip, as if the object is offering a roguish grin.

Prideful Restaurateur.name:
傲慢的餐馆老板
Prideful Restaurateur

Text.text:
