店主衣着考究，一身利落的蓝色西装，配着丝质领带与银质袖扣。只见他指尖一响，袖扣迸出火花，餐厅的灯光便由明转暗。他无瑕的肌肤呈焦糖般的色泽，在如今自每张餐桌摇曳的仿真烛光里微微发亮。那头齐肩的黑发打理得一丝不乱，间或贯穿着一道银色发丝——俊美得近乎刻意，显然并非天然。颈侧几枚几乎难以察觉、肉色的接口会不时喷出古龙水，气味是合成的香氛狂潮：薄荷、丁香、姜的气息层层翻涌。
The owner is dapperly costumed in a crisp blue suit, complete with a silken tie and silver cufflinks. With a snap of his fingers, the cufflinks spark and the lighting of the restaurant changes from bright to dim. His unblemished skin, caramel in hue, glows in the simulated candlelight now flickering from each table. His mane of shoulder-length black hair, neatly kept, has a streak of silver running through it—a handsome aesthetic, if clearly unnatural. His cologne spritzes out periodically from barely perceptible flesh-toned jacks on his neck, the smell a synthetic cavalcade of aromatics like mint, clove, and ginger.

Explanation From A Hungry Dragon.name:
来自饥饿巨龙的解释
Explanation From A Hungry Dragon

Text.text:
“很长一段时代里，我只是乐于旁观镇民日复一日的起居劳作；可当森林被砍伐殆尽、野生动物被猎到濒临灭绝，我就不得不另寻食物。填饱肚子总不算罪过吧？仅存的几只惊惶野兽既难寻也难捕，可镇民却像兔子一样繁殖，还偏偏有个坏习惯——总爱挤在同一个地方睡觉。”
“For a long time, I enjoyed merely watching the townsfolk in their day-to-day routines, but as the forests were cut and the wildlife hunted to the brink of extinction, I had to seek my food elsewhere. Surely feeding oneself is no crime? The few scared animals remaining are hard to find and catch, but the townsfolk breed like rabbits and have a terrible habit of all sleeping in the same place.”

Haunted Bathroom Stall.name:
闹鬼的厕所隔间
Haunted Bathroom Stall

Text.text: 你走近隔间。脚下的瓷砖在鞋底下咯咯作响，墙里的管道传来一连串响亮的砰响。隔间疯狂地震颤，生锈的铰链与螺丝吱呀摩擦、刺耳刮鸣。门上贴着些便条——多半是辱骂——还有人把涂鸦胡乱刻进木头里。你盯着看时，一幅新图像竟在眼前逐渐成形：一道道缺口接连出现，仿佛被一把细小的魅影（特征）匕首一刀刀划出。那是你自己的脸，粗陋的涂鸦把五官夸张扭曲，拼成一张丑陋的肖像。 You approach the stall. The ceramic tiles rattle beneath your shoes and you hear a series of loud bangs from the pipes in the wall. The stall shakes madly, rusting hinges and screws squeaking and grating. On the door, you see notes—mostly insults—and doodles scrawled into the wood. A new image develops as you watch, nicks appearing one-by-one as if made by a small phantom knife. It is a crude doodle of your own face, exaggerating your features into an ugly portrait.

Summons To The Seelie Court.name:
召至精灵仙廷
Summons To The Seelie Court

Text.text:
一股诡异却令人心安的暖意落在你身上。蝴蝶穿过斑驳的阳光飘然降下，绕着你的头轻快飞旋；它们纱雾般的薄翼拂过你的耳畔与面颊，带来细微的痒意。忽有一只停在你掌心，振翅摆触角，仿佛在跳一支无声的舞，你心中骤然涌起向前的冲动——更深地走入暮色笼罩的荒野。你被召唤了。
A strange yet comforting warmth falls upon you. Butterflies descend through dappled sunbeams to flit about your head, their gossamer wings tickling your ears and cheeks as they circle. One lands in your palm, dancing with its wings and antennae, and you feel a sudden urge to move forward, deeper into the twilit wilds. You have been summoned.

I Break An Elemental Gem Of Emerald: Sce.name:
我捏碎一颗翡翠元素宝石：气息
I Break An Elemental Gem Of Emerald: Scent

Text.text:
我捏碎宝石，召唤元素的瞬间，轰鸣的洪流倾泻而下，淹没脚下大地。清新的海风气息灌入鼻腔，裹着盐分的水雾拍打在皮肤上。那生物在我面前于翻滚的激流中凝成形体，静候我的指令。
A roaring deluge floods the ground as I break the gem and summon the elemental. The fresh scent of ocean air fills my nostrils and I feel the salt-laced spray against my skin. The creature forms before me in a roiling torrent, awaiting my instruction.

Vincent Riley Gallagher.name:
文森特·莱利·加拉格尔
Vincent Riley Gallagher

Text.text:
地狱犬的低吼在主人将一只冷静而带爪的铁手套按在它冒烟的头顶时戛然而止。那英俊的男人卷曲的黑发拂过猩红的眼眸——那颜色如火，却映出一个冰冷、精于算计的内心世界。他腰间的暗铁长剑也散发着同样的寒意。在他红黑长袍的背后，一对巨大的蝙蝠之翼阴影般耸立，翼展足有十二英尺。

~ 由 DaFrozenFury 扮演

The hellhound ceases its growling when its master rests a calm, clawed gauntlet upon its smoldering head. The handsome fellow’s curling black hair plays around his red eyes which, while fiery in their color, project a cold and calculating inner world. The dark iron sword at his hip gives off a similar chill. From the back of his red and black robes, a set of huge bat’s wings loom, twelve feet in span.

~ Played by DaFrozenFury

I Cast Thief Of Five Fates.name:
我施放「五命窃贼」
I Cast Thief Of Five Fates

Text.text:
我低声咕哝着一道恶毒的诅咒。他们不必听见，因为我已看见他们，并将咒骂加诸其身。我想象着命运暗藏的、如丝般柔滑的细线，逐一勾住，将其削弱。我以意志强行牵扯，让这些丝线不断散开，尽管它们仍试图重新缠合。好运归我撕裂——至少在一个时代里。
I mutter a vile hex. They need not hear, for I see and curse them. Envisioning hidden, silky threads of fate, I snag and weaken each one. I bend my will to keep the strands unraveling, though they seek to re-form. Luck is mine to fray, for a time.

E-waste Junkyard.name:
电子废料垃圾场
E-waste Junkyard

Text.text:
垃圾场唯一的防护是一圈矮矮的铁丝网围栏——就算大门真上了锁，也拦不住任何稍微认真点的贼。围栏里堆的尽是过时货色：要么是用上一年就注定散架的技术产物，要么早已被最新的进步甩在身后。
The only protection for the junkyard is a short chain link fence that wouldn't stop any half-serious thieves even if the gate had a lock. Inside there are only outdated goods, technology built to fall apart after a year's use or else already surpassed by the latest advancements.

Starship Debris Field In Orbit.name:
轨道上的星舰残骸带
Starship Debris Field In Orbit

Text.text:
濒临轨道衰退之际，这艘飞船的残骸像一则无声的警告，提醒平流层飞行员他们所直面的凶险。驾驶舱大体完好，以一顶歪帽般的角度打着转，仿佛以阴森的致意向人致敬。几套鼓胀的航天服里塞满冻结的骷髅，随飞行缓缓翻转，映着日光，像成千上万枚细小的月亮。偶尔，飞船的一块碎片飘入大气层，在一瞬间的炽热崩解中燃尽，迸出短促的光焰。
On the edge of orbital decay, the ship’s remains warn stratospheric pilots of the dangers they face. The cockpit is mostly intact and circles at the angle of a hat tipped in a macabre greeting. A few ballooning suits full of frozen skeletons turn as they fly, reflecting the sun like thousands of tiny moons. Now and then, a fragment of the ship drifts into the atmosphere and burns up in a momentary flare of disintegrating heat.

Hell: Tower Top.name:
地狱：塔顶
Hell: Tower Top

Text.text:
自这座高塔之巅俯瞰，地狱的景色如梦似幻，朦胧不清。你仿佛凌空立于离地数里之上；可一旦你凝神远眺某处地标——譬如一座疣瘤般的丘陵，或一道狰狞的陡崖——它便会令人眩晕地骤然拉近，清晰得刺眼。尽管你被抛掷到这般高远的青铜色天穹之下，空气却出奇地静止而温暖。
From atop this tower, the landscape of Hell appears dreamy and indistinct. You seem to stand miles above the ground, but when you focus on a distant landmark—such as a warty hill or a vicious escarpment—it zooms dizzyingly into focus. Despite being thrust so high into the bronze sky, the air feels remarkable still and warm.

一个男人姿态从容闲适，左手托开一本小小的随身日志，右手在其上书写——这个姿势让他宽松的袖口滑落，露出前臂上一大片布满疤痕的皮肉。他温暖的栗色眼睛专注地盯着纸面，落笔沉稳笃定，暗示着学者或教士的背景。他穿着朴素的旅行装束，轻便斗篷与宽檐帽用皮绳系着，垂挂在颈间。他唯一的护甲是一件锁子甲衫，在光里泛着天蓝色的冷辉。腰侧一条细腰带挂着一柄精致的细剑，剑刃是夺目的翠绿，其上镌着一道道优美的黑色雉堞纹路。

~ Played by Miles

A man with a calm and easy posture writes in a small journal held open with his left hand—the position allowing his loose sleeve to reveal a wide patch of scarred flesh on his forearm. His warm, chestnut eyes focus intently on his task, the sureness of his writing hand suggesting a scholarly or clerical background. He wears simple traveler’s clothes, complete with a lightweight cloak and wide-brimmed hat that hang from leather cords about his neck. His only armor is a chainmail shirt that glints sky-blue in the light. A fine rapier hangs from a thin belt at his hip, its blade a striking green emblazoned with lines of beautiful, black crenulations.

~ Played by Miles

阴冷的地底空气里悬着一股陈腐潮湿的霉味。厚重的石柱遍布整个墓室，墙边一排排石棺整齐嵌列，每一口都刻着一个名字。角落里蛛网垂挂，厚厚一层尘埃将它们——以及几乎所有东西——一并裹住。
A stale, dank smell hangs in the cool underground air. Thick stone pillars stand throughout the chamber, and the walls are lined with stone coffins, each inscribed with a name. Cobwebs hang from the corners, and a solid layer of dust envelopes them—and just about everything else.

在学院图书馆里，有一本小册子记着：创校者曾试图用一门共施法术来操控毕业典礼的天气，却把事情彻底搞砸。如今同样的事必定正在重演。逼近的暴风云以惊人的速度压来，云面竟生出一张年轻的面孔，嵌在风暴的灰与白之间。极其愤怒的少女额前，顶着一方由沉重乌黑云层凝成的平顶学位帽。她俯视地面上的人群与楼宇，猛地张开嘴。
In the academy library is a small tract about a communal spell that the founders botched while trying to control the weather for commencement. The same must be happening now. The storm cloud approaching at remarkable speed wears a youthful face, composed in the grays and whites of the storm. A mortarboard of flat, heavy black storm work perches on the forehead of an extremely angry girl. She looks down at the ground, the people and buildings there, and opens her mouth wide.

Energetic Martial Arts Student.name:
精力充沛的武术学徒
Energetic Martial Arts Student

Text.text: 身材矮健、金发寸头的武术学生浑身透着敏锐的少年锐气。他正练着套路，每一次转身与出拳都兴奋地高喊，任由路人讥笑也不为所动。他猛然踢出一记惊人的旋转后摆腿，却没能稳住落地，骂骂咧咧地摊倒在沥青地上。那身白色武道服背后绣着 红焰龙截拳道，下方还缀着一只生翼蜥蜴的图案。 Short and athletic with buzzed blond hair, this martial arts student wears a look of keen youthful energy. He is practicing his kata forms, yelling enthusiastically with each pivot and strike, ignoring the mockery of passersby. He launches an impressive spinning hook kick but fails to stick the landing, cursing as he sprawls on the asphalt. On the back of his white ki is Red Flame Dragon Jeet Kune Do, stitched with a winged lizard underneath.

Circle Of Death.name:
死亡之环
Circle Of Death

Text.text:
随着法术的最后一字落下，两扇巨大漆黑的门在你脑海中浮现。珍珠粉的最后一缕自指间簌簌滑落时，那两扇门轰然向内炸开——仿佛只有你才能听见这声巨响。门后黑暗张口，冰冷而可怖；一道阴影的浪潮自你所指之处扩散开来——死亡的寒意如同从那阴森之地被放出，猛然在世间爆裂。
With the final words of the spell, the image of two enormous, black doors appears in your mind. As the last of the pearl dust sifts through your fingers, the doors burst inward with a boom only you seem to hear. Utter darkness yawns beyond the doorway, cold and terrible, and a wave of shadow expands from the point you indicate—the chill of death exploding into the world as if unleashed from that grim place.

Sober University Professor.name:
清醒的大学教授
Sober University Professor

Text.text:
一名女子带着坚定而精准的步伐走进讲堂，在讲台后站定。她冷冷一瞥便压下满室喧哗，夺来所有人的注意；随即挑起一侧修得一丝不苟的眉梢，抬手抚平西装外套上的一道褶痕。她清了清嗓子，声音里满是威严，随即开始授课。
Moving with determined precision, a woman enters the lecture hall and takes her place behind the lectern. Silencing the hubbub of chatter with a glare and commanding the room’s attention, she arches a perfectly tweezed eyebrow before smoothing a crease from her blazer. She clears her throat authoritatively and begins the class.

Skeleton Carriage Driver.name:
骷髅马车夫
Skeleton Carriage Driver

Text.text:
马车吱呀一声，摇摇晃晃地停下。驾座上那名佝偻披兜帽的身影让缰绳在枯骨般的手中松垂。兜帽阴影里探出一张骷髅般的脸——眼眶的黑洞深处燃起幽绿火焰，扫视着四周。缰绳轻轻一抖，马车又一次疾驰而去。
The carriage rolls to a rickety stop. The hunched, hooded figure in the driver’s seat lets the reins go slack in skeletal hands. A skull-like face peers from the shadows of the hood—green flames burn from within the dark pits of their eye sockets as they perceive their surroundings. A flick of the reins and the carriage takes off once more.

Celebration Of The Vernal Equinox.name:
春分庆典
Celebration Of The Vernal Equinox

Text.text:
这座环形石阵古老沧桑，圆环多处早已倾颓，残存巨石披覆着厚厚的苔藓。阳光倾泻而下，仪式舞者在暖意中旋转起舞，围绕着那对头戴花冠、跪伏大地的伴侣盘旋扭动。两人相拥片刻，随即将种子抛向温润的空气，唇间吟唱着赞颂之歌。
The henge is ancient, much of the circle having fallen, stones swathed in moss. The sun beams down and ritual dancers twirl within its warmth, twisting about the flower-crowned couple kneeling upon the earth. The pair embrace, then hurl seeds into the balmy air, songs of praise upon their lips.

Meteor Impacts Crowded City Plaza.name:
陨石坠落，砸入拥挤的城市广场
Meteor Impacts Crowded City Plaza

Text.text:
警报声淹没在如潮的人声与脚步声里。广场一片喧嚣——交易、购物、叫卖、笑闹——直到一股逼近的热浪攀上皮肤。紧接着，头顶传来尖锐的呼啸，随后是一声震天巨响，绽开的多彩烈焰冲天喷涌；大地起伏战栗；楼宇摇晃、坍塌、坠落。广场瞬间化作耸立的炼狱火海。而当火势渐渐退去……只余一座冒着黑烟的巨坑，那里曾有成千上万条生命。
The alarms are lost in the crowd of voices and steps. The plaza is buzzing—trading, shopping, shouting, and giggling—until a sense of approaching heat is felt. Then a whistling sound from above is followed by a thunderous bang and eruptions of multicolored flame; rippling, shivering earth; shaking and falling buildings. The plaza is transformed into a towering inferno. And as the fire dies away… a smoking crater where thousands of lives had once been.

I Cast Sculptor Of Flesh.name:
我施放【血肉塑形师】
I Cast Sculptor Of Flesh

Text.text:
我在脑海中勾勒出一头野兽，模仿它的嘶鸣，效仿它的步态。起初，我的目标五官与轮廓开始扭曲变换，短暂地呈现出介于原本形态与即将化作的野兽之间的混血模样。转瞬之间，兽性夺身而出。躯体彻底蜕变，体型随之改换。他们已成为我眼中所见、心中所绘的那头野兽。
Envisioning a beast, I mimic its calls and imitate its movements. At first, my target’s features alter so they briefly seem to be a hybrid of their normal form and the beast they’re becoming. In a blink, the animal takes over. Their form transmutes and their size changes. They have become the beast I hold in my mind’s eye.

Tayanna Taxus, Founder Of House Badger.name:
塔雅娜·塔克苏斯，獾家族创始人
Tayanna Taxus, Founder Of House Badger

Text.text:
史上最凶悍的战斗法师之一，塔克苏斯教授曾被问到她最喜欢用什么方式结束一场战斗。“在它即将开始的时候，”她答道，“我建议先睡一觉。要是双方都同意，几乎总能善终。”她身披以草原细草精织而成的长袍，冬日里则衬着一层绒羽。她的头发蓬乱粗糙又厚重，漆黑间夹着白色丝缕；被日晒灼红的脸瘦削而逼人，叫人不敢直视。她热爱烘焙——也毫不意外地——热爱漫长的睡眠。在学院里，她的气质与战场上的凶相截然相反。
One of the fiercest battle mages in history, Professor Taxus was once asked her favorite method for ending a battle. “When it’s about to begin,” she answered, “I suggest a nap. If both sides agree, it almost always ends well.” She wore robes of finely woven prairie grasses, which, in the winter, were lined with down. Her hair was ratty and massive, black with white streaks, and her sunburned face was lean and intimidating. She loved baking and, surprising no one, long sleeps. Her demeanor in the academy was the opposite of her battle mien.

Joke About A Werewolf.name:
关于狼人开的玩笑
Joke About A Werewolf

Text.text:
“年轻时敢于尝试实在太重要了。就我而言，我曾有一晚与一头狼人共度。那经历令人脱胎换骨。”
“It’s so important to experiment in your youth. I, for one, once spent an evening with a werewolf. It was very transformative.”

Glynnis, Princess Of The Moon And Stars.name:
格琳妮丝，月与星之公主
Glynnis, Princess Of The Moon And Stars

Text.text:
一名精灵女子，眼中压着傲慢的审视，像是早已习惯评判眼前的一切。银色长发修整得一丝不乱，在肩上方利落地垂成刻薄的短波波头。剪裁精致的长袍满溢精灵风纹，自一件紧身皮质护甲的短上衣下流泻而下。胸前斜挎着一条纤细的弹带，上面只佩着一把匕首——银色柄端镶嵌华美宝石。她手中木杖顶端嵌着一颗宝石，闪烁着与她眼眸同样冰蓝的冷冽光泽。

~ Played by Amaera

An elven woman, eyes heavy with haughty regard, observes her surroundings as one who is accustomed to judging all before her. Silvery hair falls above her shoulders in a well-maintained, acerbic bob. Finely tailored robes, rich in elvish design, flow down from a jerkin of tight leather armor. A slim bandolier across her chest bears one dagger, its silver hilt ornately jeweled. Atop the wooden staff in her hand, a gem glistens with the same icy blue sheen as her eyes.

~ Played by Amaera

他那一头长发编成粗辫，纠缠着叶片与细枝；披着毛皮的德鲁伊凝视着一副钢制胸甲。脸上涂绘着醒目的蓝色纹样，此刻因痛苦般的专注而扭曲。他的目光一遍又一遍掠过那闪亮的护甲，紧锁的眉间仿佛正有一场无声的内战在厮杀。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，Treantmonk 呈现

如果德鲁伊穿上金属护甲，会发生什么？… 第一部分：德鲁伊，遭打断 第二部分：实验性德鲁伊护甲 第三部分：德鲁伊最后的拥抱 第四部分：灰归灰，尘归尘 His long, braided hair tangled with leaf and twig, the fur-garbed druid regards a steel breastplate. His face, painted with striking blue designs, contorts in a pained focus. His gaze passes over the gleaming armor again and again, some inner battle waging behind his creased brow.

~ Envisioned by Treantmonk

What happens if a druid wears metal armor?… Part I: Druid, Interrupted Part II: Experimental Druid Armor Part III: A Druid’s Last Embrace Part IV: Ashes to Ashes, Dust to Dust

Tournament Melee In Colorful Autumn.name:
缤纷秋色的比武大会乱斗
Tournament Melee In Colorful Autumn

Text.text:
近旁林地里层层叠叠的叶色斑斓，与比武场上来回厮杀者身披的五彩罩袍相映成辉。震耳欲聋的呐喊与痛苦的闷哼穿插其间，点破钢铁相击的铿锵、甲具的哐啷，以及断裂的盾牌迸碎之声。与下方鏖战者相互映照，观众席上的华饰亦如鸟群般闪烁流光。
The multitudinous colors of leaves filling the nearby woods easily match the many-hued surcoats adorning those battling to and fro across the list. Deafening cries and grunts of pain punctuate the clash of steel, rattle of harness, and fracturing of sundered shields. Mirroring those embroiled below, the finery of the spectators shimmers like a flock of birds.

艾米斯的举止里有种被压低的气息——既像好奇的麻雀，又像潜伏的狼——她以一种细微却挥之不去的存在感，停驻在你余光的边缘。纤细苍白的手指拂过她青绿发丝间繁复的编辫与点缀其上的鲜艳野花，她一边整理，一边调整那顶镶着莹亮月长石的金色额环。祖母绿般的眼眸闪着几乎按捺不住的好奇——那是一种想要踏足未知、想要发现真相的冲动。长弓在她背上轻轻颠动，腰侧则悬着一柄华丽弯刀，稳稳收入鞘中。她的衣着轻盈飘逸，在形制与实用之间恰到好处地平衡：既美丽，也被悉心打理得一尘不染。

~ Played by Alyss

There’s something subdued about the way Emmyyth carries herself—simultaneously curious sparrow and lurking wolf—a subtle yet persistent presence at the edge of one’s periphery. Delicate, pale fingers brush against the intricate braids and vibrant wildflowers strewn through her turquoise hair as she adjusts a golden circlet set with a gleaming moonstone. Her emerald eyes shine with barely contained curiosity—a drive to explore, to discover. A longbow bounces upon her back, paired with an ornate-looking scimitar sheathed at her hip. Her light and flowy clothes strike a perfect balance between form and function, both beautiful and well-maintained.

~ Played by Alyss

Multifunction Goggles.name:
多功能护目镜
Multifunction Goggles

Text.text:
不同色调的镜片像一叠叠扑克牌筹码般堆在护目镜上方，层层叠出一条令人沉醉的色谱。每一片镜片都校准着不同的功能，操作者只需一个念头便能切换视野，按需强化目力——无论是夜视、热成像、放大——甚至更为实验性的技术。
Lenses of varying hues sit atop the goggles like stacked poker chips, forming an enthralling spectrum of color. With each lens tuned to a different function, the operator is able to switch their view with a mental command, enhancing their vision in whichever way they see fit, be it night vision, thermal, magnification—or even more experimental tech.

Enigmatic High Elf's Introduction.name:
神秘高等精灵的登场介绍
Enigmatic High Elf's Introduction

Text.text:
房间里所有人的目光都转向那位陌生人——她以舞者般的轻盈步入室内。苍白的肌肤与一身黑衣形成鲜明对照，而她的仪态却从容不迫、带着与生俱来的高贵。她将一缕乌鸦般漆黑的发丝轻轻甩到肩后，眉梢微挑，清楚自己所攫取的注目，随即含笑开口，自报家门。

~ Inbal 于 Discord

Every eye in the room turns to the stranger as she steps into the room with a dancer's grace. Her pale skin stands in sharp contrast to her black attire, though her bearing is effortlessly poised and regal. Flicking a strand of raven-black hair over her shoulder, she arches an eyebrow, acutely aware of the attention she commands, and smiles as she introduces herself.

~ Inbal on Discord

I Dodge A Swipe From A Monster.name:
我闪身躲过怪物的一记横扫
I Dodge A Swipe From A Monster

Text.text:
我猛然后跃，躲开敌人怪物般的利爪，汗珠从额前四散飞溅。纵然闪避及时，其中一根尖刺的末端仍旧擦中目标，在我脸颊上刻出一道浅浅的血痕——一缕鲜血随之渗出，沿着面颊缓缓流下。
Sweat flies from my brow as I leap back to avoid the monstrous claws of my foe. Despite my evasion, the tip of one spur still finds its mark and carves a small furrow across my cheek—causing a trickle of blood to escape and flow down my face.

Dimensional Shackles.name:
次元镣铐群岛
Dimensional Shackles

Text.text:
这些沉重的铁镣铐上刻着古怪的符文，既环绕在镣环上，也镌在两端相连的链节之间。你将镣铐提起时，震惊地看见空气中有一缕微光拖曳在它们后方。每一道符文在静止时仿佛都在空中留下印记；而当你移动它们时，那黯淡的光芒便在身后短暂抹开。它让你想起不小心把墨迹蹭花的瞬间。
These heavy iron shackles bear strange runes, both around their manacles and on the links between them. When you lift the shackles, you’re shocked to see a glimmer in the air trailing after them. Each rune seems to make a mark in the air when still; then as you move them, a dim glow smears briefly behind. It reminds you of accidently smudging ink.

Carnal Pleasures Cyberpunk Club.name:
肉欲欢愉赛博朋克俱乐部
Carnal Pleasures Cyberpunk Club

Text.text:
沉闷的低频重击砰砰作响，把人引向那条肮脏的巷子深处；毒粉般诱人的霓虹光晕，如飞蛾扑火般牵引着他们向前。每当有新客推门而入，肉欲狂欢的声响——以及气味——便从厚重的门后撩人地飘出；待门再度合拢，又被重新闷住。俱乐部的每一寸都为挑逗感官而生，将狂欢者裹进纵欲的昏沉里。

~ 构想：Murmur（Discord）

The dull thump of pounding bass draws people down the seedy alleyway, the alluring hue of toxic pink lighting pulling them forth like moths to a flame. The sounds—and smells—of carnal ecstasy drift tantalizingly from the heavy doors whenever a new patron enters, only to be muffled once more when they close. Every inch of the club is designed to pique the senses, enveloping partiers in a hedonistic stupor.

~ Envisioned by Murmur on Discord

Loot From A Group Of Quaggoths.name:
一群夸戈斯的战利品
Loot From A Group Of Quaggoths

Text.text:
在一堆裂开的陶罐之间，放着几罐粗陋调和的颜料。它们的色泽与饱和度怪异得惊人，多半能值上一把金币。
Among the cracked clay pots are primitively mixed paints. They are in such strange colors and saturations, they are likely to be worth a handful of gold pieces.

Temple To A God Of Vengeance.name:
复仇之神的神殿
Temple To A God Of Vengeance

Text.text:
这座建筑像一块顽固的灰色巨碑，向上收束成锋利的尖端，仿佛矛头直刺天穹。入口不过是一道敞开的三角形门槛，外墙上看不见任何可辨的窗。你踏入主殿，一股灼热的气流迎面扑来；殿内被纯粹的赤红火焰照亮。这里没有座位，没有成群聚集的信众。金字塔中心的祭坛是一座方形石台，台顶竖着一柄以血红宝石雕成的匕首。僧侣们缩在角落与墙边，像无主的影子般游荡。他们的眼睛从暗沉松垮的眼袋上方警惕地窥视，随着你靠近，嘴唇绷紧成低吼般的狞笑。他们抬起双手，仿佛随时准备厮斗，指尖染着某种深色墨迹……或是脓血。
This staunch gray monolith of a building rises into a point like a spearhead. The entrance is no more than an open, triangular threshold, and there are no discernable windows. A draft of hot air hits you as you enter the main chamber, lit by entirely red flame. There is no seating, no great mass of gathered worshippers. The altar at the center of this pyramid is a square stone dais topped with a dagger carved out of blood-red gemstone. The monks stay in the corners and by the walls, haunting like shadows without hosts. Their eyes peer suspiciously over dark, baggy circles of flesh, and their lips crimp into snarls as you approach. They bring their hands up as if they expect a fight, their fingers stained with some dark ink… or ichor.

Sundries From An Animated Scarecrow.name:
来自活灵稻草人的杂货
Sundries From An Animated Scarecrow

Text.text:
稻草人瘫成一堆不相配的衣物与稻草，早已看不出半点人形。布料破损得太厉害，派不上任何用场。几朵小花与一颗迷你南瓜静静躺在从稻草人爆裂缝线中溢出的填充物间。
The scarecrow lies in a heap of mismatched clothing and straw, resembling nothing humanoid. The cloth is too damaged to be of any use. A few flowers and a miniature pumpkin rest among the stuffing that spills from the scarecrow’s burst seams.

Tome Of Clear Thought.name:
明晰思维之书
Tome Of Clear Thought

Text.text:
这本古老巨著的银色掩蔽上镌刻着各式奥秘符号、象形文字与经文，并以紫色宝石点缀其间。书内洁白无瑕的羊皮纸页上，尽是沉思的学者、颅骨解剖图，以及一套套细密严谨的思辨演练插图。
The silver cover of this ancient tome is inscribed with all manner of arcane symbols, hieroglyphs, and texts, complemented by purple gemstones. Images of pondering scholars, cranial diagrams, and detailed intellectual exercises fill the immaculate vellum pages within.

Weapon Of Firbolg Craftsmanship.name:
费波格工艺武器
Weapon Of Firbolg Craftsmanship

Text.text:
这把石制武器的体型之巨，唯有其惊人的沉重更胜一筹。水晶如脉络般贯穿石身，尖锐地突起，形成刀锋般的刃缘与刺穿用的尖点。尽管它笨重且材料粗陋，这件武器的构造却自有匠心——近乎完美的平衡与残酷的效率，便是明证。
The stone weapon’s sheer size is only outdone by its immense heft. Crystals vein the stone, protruding to form razor-sharp edges and puncture points. Despite its weight and crude materials, the weapon has an artistry in its construction, evident in its near-perfect balance and brutal effectiveness.

诞生于星辉与宇宙长风之中，这名元素生物上半身修长而精悍，披覆着宛如远方风暴般的飘拂织物。下半身则由一阵空灵的疾风构成，蓝灰色旋涡翻卷不息。它高达十号英尺，身形的透明度如呼吸般忽明忽暗，唇角挂着一抹玩味的笑。那张雕琢完美的面庞上，整齐的蓝色胡须被编成数缕，在几处结点上缀着异星工艺的古怪符坠。它准备开口时，风势随之抬升。
Born of starlight and cosmic winds, this elemental’s upper body is slim and muscular, wrapped in drapery reminiscent of a distant tempest. Its lower body is made of an ethereal gust, a swirl of blue gray. Ten feet tall, it oscillates its opacity with a whimsical grin. Its perfectly chiseled face bears a neat blue beard braided at several points with strange charms of alien make. The wind rises as it prepares to speak.

Pirates Ambush Merchant Freighter.name:
海盗伏击商用货轮
Pirates Ambush Merchant Freighter

Text.text:
货运船干净利落、保养得当，正沿着预设航线在空间中平稳滑行。第二艘船东拼西补，满身弹痕与武器灼痕，摇摇晃晃地扭转航向，像醉汉般把自己调整到与第一艘船相撞的轨道上。货运船猛地一震，仿佛从恍惚中惊醒，急忙转向躲避，却已来不及。海盗船发射了一枚看似鱼叉的东西，抛射体在飞行中裂成参差狰狞的倒钩，狠狠刺入货舱船体，将两艘船死死拴在一起。那艘来势汹汹的船沿着猎物的船身擦刮而过，金属尖鸣中对齐双方的装载舱口。
The freighter is clean, well-maintained, and gliding through space on a pre-set navigation. A second ship is patched, marred by weapon fire, and swerving drunkenly as it adjusts to put itself on a collision course with the first. The freighter jolts as if from a trance, turning away, but too late. The pirate ship fires what looks like a harpoon, and the projectile splits into jagged prongs that sink into the cargo ship and tie the two vessels together. The aggressive vessel scrapes along its prey as it lines up their loading bays.

施法者将他们的武器高高射向天空。随着一声咒令，飞弹划出弧线并分裂，相乘为无数致命的弹矢。它们带着令人满足的闷响坠入目标区域，把大地钉成一只刺猬。
The caster fires their weapon high into the air. With a word, the missile arcs and splits, multiplying into countless deadly shots. They fall in the target area with satisfying thuds, turning the ground into a pincushion.

High Priest Of The Sun God Of Justice.name:
正义太阳神大祭司
High Priest Of The Sun God Of Justice

Text.text:
祭司伫立在会众面前，身披金辉灿然的礼装，向人群宣讲。以其太阳神祇般炽烈的热忱 说话，祭司倾尽情感地布道，讲述善良的本质，以及所有门徒都有责任将光明的准则化为自身：仁慈、施舍与怜悯。尽管砂岩神庙的穹顶不停有尘沙 坠落，他们的白袍依旧洁净如新；额前以深色墨迹庄严点上一轮抽象的太阳，骄傲地昭示信仰。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The priest stands before the congregation, resplendent in their golden regalia as they address the crowd. Speaking with the fiery passion of their solar deity, the priest delivers an impassioned sermon on the nature of goodness, and the duty of all disciples to embody the principles of the light: kindness, charity, and mercy. Their white robes are pristine despite the dust falling from the sandstone temple’s ceiling, and a stylized sun is proudly daubed on their forehead with dark ink.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Speech By Vainglorious Character About S.name:
自我牺牲？哈。你们把它说得像一枚抛向天光的金币，叮当一响，便能换来掌声与救赎。

听清楚：我不是为了你们而燃烧。我燃烧，是因为这火本该属于我。

我走上前线，不是出于怜悯，而是出于选择；我挡下那一击，不是因为害怕失去你们，而是因为我拒绝让命运在我面前耀武扬威。若要有人流血，那也该由我来决定血落在何处。

你们会把我称作英雄，低声祈祷，眼里闪着感激的光。很好。让他们记住这一幕：在所有人退缩时，是我站着；在所有人求生时，是我把生路掷回给你们。你们的未来，将在我的背影里继续呼吸。

别误会，我并不渴求死亡。死亡太廉价，太轻飘。我要的是代价——那种沉甸甸的代价，让世界不得不承认：有些胜利，只有我能支付。

所以当我踏入黑暗，别哭。把你们的眼泪省下来，去照亮我留下的路。把你们的恐惧收好，去证明我这一场“牺牲”不是徒劳的戏剧，而是一枚钉进历史的钉子。

记住我——不是作为一个善人，而是作为一个不肯退让的人。你们能活下去，是因为我选择了不活得平凡。
Speech By Vainglorious Character About Self-sacrifice

Text.text:
“好了，朋友们，就到这儿了。我将独自面对那头野兽，用我的牺牲为你们争取逃命的时代。快走，去过好日子——但最重要的是，记住我：我的英勇，我的奉献，我那一头华美的秀发。把今天讲给你们的孩子听。告诉他们，有一种高洁的生命为了友情而戛然而止。现在就走！别想劝我改变主意；太迟了。太迟了……可万一你们逃跑途中遭遇一头更为可怖的怪物呢？嗯……也许我该在英勇地后退时为你们断后，确保你们安全通过？对，这才是更好的计划。”
“Well, friends, this is it. I will face the beast alone and buy you time to escape. Go forth and live the good life, but most of all, remember me—my heroism, my sacrifice, my gorgeous hair. Tell your children of this day. Tell them of a life of virtue cut short for the sake of friendship. Go now! Don’t try to convince me otherwise; it’s too late. Too late… but what if, in your flight, you encounter a beast even more monstrous? Hmm… Perhaps I will defend you as I heroically back up, ensuring your safe passage? Yes, this is a better plan.”

巨虫的头颅如同亵渎之花的花苞，自那布满黏液、疮痕累累的盘曲躯体中昂然升起；躯干缝合成节，层层分段。它像眼镜蛇般蓄势而立，口器张开成星形。星口中央——一圈利齿环绕的咽口——探出数条舌头，细长、粉红、尖削，蠕动不止，仿佛在试探空气，追寻某种非目可见、却能被感知的存在。
The head of the great worm, like the bud of a profane blossom, rises from a slimy, pock-encrusted coil of a seamed and sectioned body. Poised like a cobra, the mouth opens into a star shape. From the center—a tooth-ringed mouth—appear a set of tongues, long, pink, and tapered. They move as if testing the air for something sensed not seen.

Sundries From An Aberration's Lair.name:
异怪巢穴里的杂物
Sundries From An Aberration's Lair

Text.text:
畸变生物的巢穴里万物都覆着黏液，潮湿沉重的空气中塞满异界血肉那股有机的腥臭。几枚钱币夹在一簇簇腐败般的真菌与污秽的植被束之间，总值两枚金币。房间中央堆起一座小小的石冢，由明亮、打磨得极其光滑的石头垒成，漂亮，却多半一文不值。
Mucus covers everything in the aberration’s lair, and the organic stink of alien flesh fills the moisture-heavy air. Nestled among the fungal bundles of putrid-looking flora are a few coins amounting to two gold pieces in value. A small cairn of bright, highly polished stones has been erected in the center of the room, pretty but probably worthless.

Binary Star Sunrise.name:
双星日出
Binary Star Sunrise

Text.text:
你周围的夜晚是一片镶满碎钻的黑暗，忽然之间，群星尽数隐去。地平线上升起两团光球，将你的影子劈成两半，把它们拉得长长的拖在身后，宛如两道诡异的幽影。细小的生灵开始发出清晨的鸣响，双子太阳——一大一小——攀上天穹，宣告破晓时分的到来。
Around you the night is a rhinestone darkness, then suddenly the stars are no longer. From the horizon rise two spheres of light, splitting your shadow and casting it long behind you like two strange phantoms. Small creatures begin to make their morning noises as the twin suns—one large, one small—rise into the heavens, heralding the break of day.

眉头因专注而紧锁，这位半身人低声咕哝着读下去，指尖沿着页上的每一个词缓缓划过。她抬起头，吐出一声懊恼的长叹，将书放回膝上，身子向后靠去，任柔和的夏风拂面，享受阳光的暖意。那本厚实的巨著里，并非整齐划一的字迹，而是在磨损的羊皮纸页上布满细小、凸起的符号。奥术学徒——思绪已然归拢——重新开始她的研读，指尖再次顺着那些符号流淌，娴熟得仿佛早已练习千百遍。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To 许可

Brow creased with focus, the halfling mutters under her breath as she reads, her finger tracing each word across the page. She lifts her head and releases an exasperated sigh, lowering the book into her lap and leaning back, enjoying the gentle summer breeze and the warmth of the sun. In place of neat, uniform script, the robust tome contains small, raised symbols on the worn vellum pages. The arcane apprentice—her thoughts now collected—begins her studies anew, her finger flowing once more over the symbols with practiced ease.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

浑浊的水里翻涌着一团水蛭，仿佛活物。它们游来时扭摆起伏，如同风中飘舞的丝带。其中一只已与你的手亲密接触——在你毫无知觉的咬噬里牢牢吸附。它油亮的身躯随着每一次贪婪吞咽你的鲜血而一鼓一缩。
The murky water is alive with a clew of leeches. They undulate like ribbons on the wind as they swim toward you. One has already made close acquaintance with your hand, latched to you with a bite you didn’t feel. Its glistening body surges with each enthusiastic swallow of your blood.

Cheery, Plastic Jingles Fill The Fast Fo.name:
欢快的塑料叮当声回荡在快餐店里
Cheery, Plastic Jingles Fill The Fast Food Joint

Text.text:
一段没有灵魂的叮当小调在色彩刺眼的餐厅里回荡，让那些疲惫不堪的员工本就无休止的苦闷又添一层折磨。显然，总部只肯掏钱买两分钟的循环。足够把任何人逼疯。
A soulless jingle echoes through the brightly colored restaurant, adding to the perpetual misery of the beleaguered employees. Apparently, corporate only paid for a two-minute loop. It’s enough to drive anyone to madness.

Wild Magic Surge: Fog Cloud.name:
狂野魔法涌动：迷雾云
Wild Magic Surge: Fog Cloud

Text.text:
随着你的法术余波，残留的魔法在你周身轻轻一吐，化作一息银色薄雾。它迅速扩散、愈发浓稠，凝成一团遮蔽视线的云雾，将你与周遭一并吞没。
In the wake of your spell, residual magic whuffs out around you in a breath of silvery fog. It spreads and thickens into an obscuring cloud that engulfs you and your surroundings.

海水温柔地轻拍着沙滩，来回滑动，带着令人安心的恒定韵律。贝壳、浮木与碎石散落其间，让整片海岸透出一种晶莹的质感。再往内陆，丘陵起伏，直至与喧嚣的城市相接；然而在这片海边的岸线上，你听见的只有浪涛震耳欲聋的咆哮。
The sea laps pleasantly at the sand, sliding back and forth with a comforting, constant rhythm. Seashells, driftwood, and stones scatter the beach, giving it a crystalline quality. Farther inland, the hills rise to meet bustling cities, but here on the shores of the sea, you hear only the thunderous roar of the waves.

I Contest Control Over A Sphere Of Annih.name:
我夺取了湮灭之球的掌控权
I Contest Control Over A Sphere Of Annihilation

Text.text:
汗水沿着我的太阳穴淌下，我咬紧牙关，将意志强压在那颗球体之上，想把它从敌人手中硬生生夺过来。我能感觉到对方的意识与我缠斗，我们的心智轰然相撞，彼此都在竭力把对方从悬在我们之间那枚冰冷漆黑的球形之物旁逼退。我眼眶后方像被无形巨力挤压着，精神决斗的重压沉沉落下，时间在煎熬中被拉得漫长无比——直到胜者终于浮现。
Sweat runs down my temples as I strain to exert my will on the sphere and wrest it from my foe. I feel their consciousness dueling with my own as our minds clash, each trying to force the other away from the cold, black orb hovering between us. I feel the pressure of the mental duel behind my eyes, and the seconds pass agonizingly slowly—until a victor emerges.

Tournament Paddock.name:
锦标赛马厩区
Tournament Paddock

Text.text:
一道栅栏围起的院落圈住一小群马——归在场的骑士所有——然而每匹战马都有自己独立的围栏，它们烈火般的性情过于暴躁，根本容不得彼此混在一处。惴惴不安的侍从为这些威势逼人的坐骑添料梳洗，紧绷着神经躲闪踢来的铁蹄与咬来的利齿。
A fenced compound surrounds a small herd of horses—owned by the attending knights—although each destrier has its own enclosure, their fiery temperament too volatile to allow them to mingle. Apprehensive squires feed and groom the imposing steeds, tensely dodging hooves and teeth.

这批藏品的明珠，是一朵紧闭的花苞，体型惊人，沉甸甸得令人心惊。花心伸出数枝新芽，花瓣上点缀着眼眸般的纹路，仿佛正巡视着整座温室。喇叭藤蜷伏在沿着凸窗排列的精雕花槽里，Auld Garda 则挺立在坚韧粗壮的茎上，微微摇曳。
The jewel of the collection is a closed bloom of terrific size and weight. Shoots with eye-like markings on their petals branch from the flower, as if they are surveying the greenhouse. Trumpet vines nestle in the crafted planter that lines the bay window, and the Auld Garda sways slightly on its tough, thick stem.

Quip By A Mage About Access To Magic.name:
法师对魔法许可的俏皮话
Quip By A Mage About Access To Magic

Text.text:
“你能想象吗，如果人人都有许可使用魔法？如果平民也握有那种力量？你觉得他们会用它来挣脱枷锁吗？来帮助他们的社区吗？当然不会。不到一周，整个国家就会陷入火海。”
“Can you imagine if everyone had access to magic? If the common people held that power? Do you think they would use it to free themselves from their bonds? To help their communities? Of course not. The entire country would be on fire by week’s end.”

Fire Elemental: Elemental Rage.name:
火元素：元素之怒
Fire Elemental: Elemental Rage

Text.text:
烈焰在四周翻卷燃烧，黑烟灌满了空气。那元素生物每一步移动，雾霭便在其周身绽开猩红——它的躯体是一座不需燃料却渴求吞噬你血肉的炼狱。与它交战仿佛徒劳无功；挥击它，就像把手伸进铁匠的熔炉。可你别无选择，否则这饥饿的火焰必将把你吞没。
Flames burn all around, filling the air with black smoke. The haze blooms red wherever the elemental moves, its body an inferno that requires no fuel yet seeks to feast on your flesh. Fighting it feels futile. Striking it is like putting your hand into a smith’s furnace. But you have no choice or the hungry fire will surely devour you.

Beautiful Silver Buckle.name:
华美的银扣
Beautiful Silver Buckle

Text.text:
这枚扣环以精灵的手法扭转成形，外观宛如一片白杨叶，背面伸出一根带钩的扣针。其上嵌饰鲍鱼贝光泽，并以漆绘蕨叶点缀。
Turned in the elvish way and shaped like a poplar leaf, this buckle has a hooked prong on the back. It is inlaid with abalone and lacquered fern.

你以温柔的手贴上羽毛、皮毛或兽皮，便能触到一颗太古之心的搏动。它的脉动渐缓，而你的却加速，直至血潮同频奔涌。你低声将咒语对那野兽诉说，并记下太阳的位置。仅在行星自转一周的时间里，你将以鹰之眼看世界，以狼之鼻嗅万物，或以象那横扫般铺开的巨耳听尽四方汇聚的每一道声响。
With your gentle hand against feathers, fur, or hide, you can feel the beating of a primordial heart. Its pulse slows, and yours accelerates, until your blood courses in unison. You speak the words quietly to the beast and note the position of the sun. For a single rotation of the planet, you will see the world through the hawk’s eye, smell it through the wolf’s nose, or hear every sound gathered by the elephant’s sweeping ears.

幽暗的长厅里，影影绰绰的身形潜伏在昏黑之中。石墙的壁龛里立着一座座石像，每一尊约莫半身人那般高，安放在突出的基座上。它们似乎雕刻着城堡住民的英雄或祖先——有的披着长袍，有的穿着护甲，有的身着盛装；这些微缩的身躯居高临下，以冷漠而轻蔑的目光俯视着你。
Shadowy figures lurk in the gloom of this long hall. Stone statues, each one of perhaps halfling height, stand on plinths set in niches of the stone walls. They appear to represent heroes or ancestors of the castle’s residents. Dressed in robes, armor, or regalia, their miniature bodies gaze down with aloof disdain.

Eulogy For A Lost Comrade.name:
失落战友的悼词
Eulogy For A Lost Comrade

Text.text:
“我知道，我们都因失去挚友而痛彻心扉。但我们必须记住：死亡不是例外，而是常态。死亡始终与我们同行。我们的生命，不过是在它幽暗囚笼中迸出的短暂微光，宛如笑声刺破寂静。”
“I know we all feel great pain at the loss of our friend. But we must remember that death is not the exception, it is the rule. Death always walks with us. Our lives are but brief bursts of light from within its dark confines, like laughter piercing silence.”

Sundries In A White Dragon Wyrmling Lair.name:
白龙幼龙巢穴杂物
Sundries In A White Dragon Wyrmling Lair

Text.text:
幼龙那座冰封巢穴里，覆满了些诡异而玄奥的珍藏——都是它曾经视若珍宝之物。一头被开膛剖腹的鹿被冻在天花板里，半截身子嵌在冰中，另一半无力地垂落，任由寒冷洞窟的微风轻拂。猛犸与海象的象牙散落四处，像一片随意堆出的骨冢；而那些松脱的牙齿——锯齿般锋利，狰狞残酷——则满地都是，让这幅血腥陈列更添一层令人不寒而栗的肃杀。
The wyrmling’s frozen den is covered in strange, esoteric treasures the dragon once deemed valuable. An eviscerated deer is frozen halfway into the ceiling, its top half hanging limply in the chill cavern breeze. Ivory from mammoths and walrus is scattered all around like a haphazard boneyard, and loose teeth—serrated and cruel—litter the floor, adding to the grisly panoply.

这座线条流畅、格调优雅的空间站浸透着奢华、品位与排他性。一处带护盾的停泊舱由大型自动炮塔守卫——平日巧妙隐匿，待机而动。对这座私人太空港而言，观感至上；内部一尘不染，由一队身着利落时髦制服的工作人员悉心打理。
The sleek, elegant station oozes luxury, class, and exclusivity. A shielded docking bay is guarded by large, automated turrets—artfully concealed until needed. Aesthetic is paramount for this private spaceport, and the interior is immaculate, attended by a cadre of staff in crisp, stylish uniforms.

Overheard Preaching About Forgiveness.name:
无意间听到的宽恕布道
Overheard Preaching About Forgiveness

Text.text:
“我们祈求宽恕，但我们配得上这般慈悲吗？我们曾如圣者般活着的时代已然逝去，被淫欲与腐化所驱逐。我不赐予赦罪，也不提供逃避，唯有真理那灼亮的光芒——让你在神祇降临、洗涤这世界的污秽之时，能无惧地直面他们。”
“We ask forgiveness, but are we worthy of such mercy? The time when we lived as holy beings has passed, driven away by lechery and corruption. I do not offer absolution or escape, only the shining light of truth, so that when the gods come to wash this world of its filth, you may face them without fear.”

Vampire Duel With Pistols.name:
吸血鬼（特征）手枪决斗
Vampire Duel With Pistols

Text.text:
燧发枪冒着浓烟，两名决斗者各执一把。街道上回荡着急促的金属咔哒声，他们正疯狂地装填。其一如石像鬼般攀附在楼侧，把自己硬生生塞进建筑的棱角与缝隙里。她一条腿软软垂着，被霰弹打得千疮百孔。她的对手则伏在下方的阴影中，藏在街边一排常青树的其中一棵后面。他眉角的破洞干涸无血，然而那骇人的撕裂口却露出森白发亮的颅骨。武器就绪，他们尖声嘶叫，再次朝彼此猛扑而去，子弹乱飞。
Flintlocks smoke, one in the hand of each duelist. Frantic, metallic clicks echo in the street as they reload. One clings to the side of a building like a gargoyle, squeezing herself into the architecture. One of her legs hangs limp, riddled with scattershot holes. Her opponent keeps to the shadows below, behind one of the evergreen trees lining the street. The hole in the corner of his brow is dry, bloodless, yet the horrible rend reveals the shining white of his skull. Weapons ready, they shriek and launch at each other once more, bullets flying.

I Optimize My Hacker's Deck: Data Proces.name:
我优化黑客的甲板：数据处理
I Optimize My Hacker's Deck: Data Processing

Text.text:
也许我这儿的数据流多得能拼出一张底格里斯—幼发拉底河流域地图，但我也有足够的 AJAX 来给它们分流。我把框架稍微撑开一点——就像给船再加一只燃料舱——压缩一大堆文件夹，然后，瞧。再也不需要速度。

~ 一位英雄构想

Maybe I’ve got enough data streams to look like a map of the Tigris Euphrates, but I’ve also got plenty of AJAX to route them. I open the framework a little—like adding another fuel tank to a ship—compress a bunch of folders, and voilà. No more need for speed.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Amulet Holy Symbol.name:
护身符（圣徽）
Amulet Holy Symbol

Text.text:
这枚护身符以一条纤细的金链挂于颈间，经锻造、塑形、打磨，并受祝圣，只为敬奉其上所镌神祇圣徽的神祇。传说真正的牧师高举此徽记时，邪魔与亡灵也会在其圣力之下被迫退却。
This amulet is attached around one’s neck by a fine golden chain and was smithed, shaped, polished, and blessed to honor the deity whose symbol it bears. It is said that fiends and undead can be made to retreat from the holy power of a true cleric holding such a symbol aloft.

Pherios Kuril.name:
费里奥斯·库里尔
Pherios Kuril

Text.text:
他从阴影中现身——一抹压迫感十足的身影，黑得近乎吞光，竟让黑暗本身都显得苍白。身上的昂贵定制环片护甲被打磨得亮如镜面，光泽与乌檀色鳞皮无缝交融，几乎分不清何处是血肉、何处是护甲。然而这还不足以概括他令人难忘之处：他随身提着一柄巨大的长柄斧枪，缭绕着令人作呕的附魔气息，却轻松得像孩子拎着扫帚柄。头顶脊冠一路向后梳起的尖刺带着几分少年气，透出一种速度感；可那双狭长的裂瞳，却投出一个彻底不知怜悯为何物之人的冷酷气质。

~ Played by Kadenex with

Emerging from the shadows comes an imposing figure so black in color that he somehow makes the darkness itself look pale in comparison. The expensive, tailored banded armor he wears has been so highly polished that it is difficult to tell where his ebony-scaled flesh ends and his armor begins. Yet that is not the sum total of his memorable features, as he carries with him a mighty halberd, stinking of enchantment, as effortlessly as a child might carry a broom handle. The slicked-back spikes down the crest of his scalp lends a youthful air, conveying a sense of speed, but his slitted eyes somehow project the personality of a man utterly lacking in mercy.

~ Played by Kadenex with

Herd Of Hadrosaurs.name:
鸭嘴龙群
Herd Of Hadrosaurs

Text.text:
低沉而嘶哑的鸣叫——宛如射程尽头牛群的哞声——为这支在平原上蜿蜒前行的兽群定下声标；它们步态从容，毫不匆忙。各个年龄段的鸭嘴龙缓缓游走，幼崽在长辈的腿间嬉闹穿梭，四处寻觅一片新的草场啃食。
Low, braying calls—like cattle on the range—mark the herd meandering across the plains, unhurried in their movements. Hadrosaurs of all ages, with the younger members scampering playfully between the legs of their elders, search for a new patch to graze.

Verdant Plains Of The Faerie Plane.name:
妖精位面的葱茏原野
Verdant Plains Of The Faerie Plane

Text.text:
金色的草与野花掩蔽着这里起伏的丘陵，沉甸甸的种子穗与花朵在柔风中起伏荡漾，如水波般层层推开。空气里浮着花蜜与新割青草的甜香。巨大的熊蜂在花间嗡鸣穿梭，腿上挂满花粉；各色蝴蝶随风翻飞滑翔。洁白无瑕的蒲公英种子也随阵阵风起舞，与它们一同飘荡。
Golden grass and wildflowers cover the rolling hills here, the laden seed heads and blooms rippling like water in the soft breeze. The air carries the sweet scents of nectar and fresh grass. Giant bumblebees buzz among the flowers, their legs laden with pollen, and butterflies of every hue flutter and glide in the wind. Perfect dandelion seeds dance on the gusts with them.

Chivalrous Bullywug.name:
侠义的牛蛙人
Chivalrous Bullywug

Text.text: 皮肤绿得像盐渍橄榄般发亮的蛙裔战士，挺立如箭。护甲被擦拭得银光熠熠，胸甲隆起，特意为他们鼓胀的胸膛与咽喉留出弧度。一面小圆盾垂在臂侧，形如睡莲叶；一柄钉锤挂在胯边，锤头雕作莲花。你走近时，他们深深一鞠躬，头盔面甲叮当一声落下，遮住了双眼。起身时，他们对自己ribbit地笑出声，一边抬手把面甲拨正。那张阔口的笑容一路咧到雏菊般的黄眼睛边。 Skin as green and gleaming as brined olives, the frogkin warrior stands as straight as an arrow. Their armor is polished to a silver shine, the chest plate rounded to accommodate a ballooning chest and throat. A small buckler, shaped like a lily pad, dangles from their arm and a mace with a head shaped like a lotus flower hangs at their hip. As you approach, they bow low, the visor of their helmet clinking down over their eyes. They ribbit out a laugh at themself as they rise and adjust the visor. Their wide-mouthed smile reaches all the way up to their daisy-yellow eyes.

Quip About Getting To Know The Party.name:
关于逐渐熟悉队伍的俏皮话
Quip About Getting To Know The Party

Text.text:
“那么，你都对什么感兴趣？最喜欢的颜色？养宠物吗？说到这份上，我们都一起杀过东西了——而且我身上还沾过你不少血——所以我觉得，我们的关系怎么也该比酒馆里擦肩而过的点头之交更近一点吧。”
“So, what are some of your interests? Favorite color? Do you own any pets? At this point we’ve murdered things together—and I’ve had a significant amount of your blood on me—so I feel like we should be closer than passing tavern acquaintances.”

Sea Serpent Corpse.name:
海蛇尸骸
Sea Serpent Corpse

Text.text:
猩红浪涛拍击着那具庞大的蛇形尸骸，它在环绕岛屿、浸透血污的海水中漂荡；一群海鸟放肆尖啸，贪婪啄食着漂浮的残躯。翻搅的海中掠食者掀起血沫，溅洒在尸体上，腥红污泡成团迸裂，令人作呕——它们在狂乱的饕餮中撕扯下大块血肉。
Crimson waves buffet the massive serpentine corpse drifting through the gore-drenched waters around the island, and a flock of seabirds screech with wild abandon as they feast heartily on the floating remains. Thrashing marine predators cause bloody foam to spray across the body in sickening gouts as they tear off chunks in a feeding frenzy.

这把沉重的长柄武器顶端装着一片劈砍刃，锋缘仿佛能攫住每一缕散落的阳光。它的重心却调校得极佳，使得持用者无论徒步还是骑乘在坐骑之上，都能挥出几招出人意料的优雅斩击。
Topped with a chopping blade with an edge that seems to catch each stray beam of sunlight, this heavy polearm is balanced well enough that it is capable of some surprisingly elegant strokes whether the wielder is on foot or atop a mount.

Heavy Rain In The Grassland.name:
草原暴雨
Heavy Rain In The Grassland

Text.text:
在一片没有森林的土地上，大地与狂风怒号的苍穹之间毫无屏障。乌云在头顶翻涌，遮蔽了太阳。雨幕嘶嘶作响，成片砸向地面，灌满干裂泥土的缝隙，也抽打着被日晒得发亮的浅绿与淡黄草丛。牛、羚羊与马缓慢游走在紧密的兽群中，皮毛沉甸甸浸着雨水；有些在罕见的孤树下暂歇脚步，鸟儿也聚在那里，躲避倾盆而下的雨。
In a land without forests, there is no barrier between the earth and storming sky. Dark clouds billow overhead, blotting out the sun. Rain pounds the earth in hissing sheets, filling the parched fissures in the dirt and buffeting the sun-kissed grasses of pale green and yellow. Oxen, antelope, and horses wander slowly in packed herds, their coats heavy with water, some pausing their trek under a rare lone tree where birds also seek shelter from the downpour.

Sundries From A Pegasus.name:
飞马杂货
Sundries From A Pegasus

Text.text:
倒毙的巨兽双翼铺展，如两柄修长的扇形长幕，纵然死去依旧庄严耀亮。几根羽翎已然脱落，散落在地，仿佛一场天界鏖战后被弃置的绒羽之剑。它鬃毛间几缕铂金色的发丝被人编成细辫，此刻垂落在那张雪白的面庞上，媲美羽毛般动人，却多半不值当商贩摊位上的几个铜子。
The wings of the fallen beast spread out in two long fans, majestic and luminous even in death. Some of the feathers have fallen free, lying on the ground like downy swords discarded after some celestial battle. Some of the platinum strands of its mane have been braided and now hang over its snowy-white face, as beautiful as the feathers but most likely not worth much at a merchant’s stall.

Laughing Shadow Magus.name:
嬉笑暗影魔剑士
Laughing Shadow Magus

Text.text:
魔战士是金属与魔法的汇流，穿行于战场之上，步伐沉重，胫甲轰然作响，仿佛心脏临终的最后悸动。他们将手半剑扛在肩头，刃身平面贴着磨损的肩甲发出尖锐的啸鸣——也正因此得了bastard之名。十余个魔裔四散奔逃，朝各个方向溃散，每一个都祈祷自己不会成为被追逐的那一个，不会成为感受那道锋刃的那一个。

执念如铁，魔战士将剑自肩上滑下，懒散却精准地横掠一弧，竟在这个位面上撕开一道漆黑的虚无。他们下一步便踏过时代与空间，骤然再现于逃窜的魔裔面前。魔战士张口，令黑色以太中的魔法倾泻而出，灌入剑身。钢与法术的交响低语交织，化作噼啪炸裂的毁灭斩击，劈开空气与护甲，撕裂皮肉，捣碎骨髓，煮沸乌黑的血。第一只魔裔应声倒下，其余的因之更快地逃窜。又一次颤栗的踏步，又一道撕裂世界织纹的裂口，又一只魔裔直面湮灭——直到十余具尸体点缀战场。因为无人能跑得够快，无人能逃得够远，足以避开这位魔战士那超自然的触及。

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

The magus is a conflux of metal and magic as they move through the battlefield, their steps heavy, greaves thudding like a heart’s final palpitations. They carry their hand-and-a-half sword over their shoulder, the flat of the blade keening against the worn pauldron—earning the bastard in its name. A dozen fiends scatter, fleeing in all directions, each hoping they will not be the one pursued, the one to feel that sword’s edge.

Inexorable in their vocation, the magus slides the sword off their shoulder in a languid lateral arc that rips a black void through this plane. Their next step takes them through time and space to reappear in front of a fleeing fiend. The magus’s mouth opens, pouring magic from that black ether into their blade. Symphonic susurrations of steel and spell mingle into a crackling slash of devastation that scythes through air and armor to rend skin, pulp bone, and boil black blood. The first fiend is felled and the others fly all the faster for it. Another shuddering step, another tear in the fabric of our world, and another fiend faces annihilation, until a dozen corpses decorate the battlefield. For none could ever run fast enough, ever run far enough, to escape the preternatural reach of this magus.

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

Street Punk Jacket.name:
街头朋克夹克
Street Punk Jacket

Text.text:
这件夹克揉合新旧风格，渗出无政府的气息，衣面上醒目喷绘着反威权的口号。仿皮材质将护甲与街头腌臜范儿拧在一起——凯夫拉补丁让它硬到足以抵御大多数攻击，却仍点缀着尖钉、锁链与霓虹饰条。它是叛逆的象征，既反乌托邦政府，也反深层国家的压迫。
An amalgam of old and new, the jacket bleeds anarchy and is emblazoned with anti-authoritarian slogans. The faux leather combines armor with gutter style—Kevlar patches make it tough enough to resist most attacks while still being adorned with spikes, chains, and neon accents. It is a symbol of rebellion, against dystopian government and deep state oppression alike.

Austere Throne Room.name:
冷峻王座厅
Austere Throne Room

Text.text:
一扇巨大无比的木门缓缓荡开，露出一间宽阔的厅室；这里的温度只被勉强抬到足以让人不至于冻伤。厅室一侧那座朴素却实用的壁炉，偶尔把摇曳的阴影投在光秃的墙面上。几只老旧的火盆吐着呛人的烟，提供勉强够用的昏黄光亮，让人得以看清通往王座的墙上唯一的装饰：一幅尺寸夸张的王国地图——边界线条精确利落，却毫无炫饰。王座本身做工精湛，不施雕饰、不涂油彩，仿佛一年、十年，乃至百年之后仍会一成不变。王座上方悬着一幅相貌并不讨喜的祖先巨像，俯视整座厅堂，神情里似乎带着一丝淡淡的嫌恶。
A single, enormous wooden door swings open to reveal a sizable chamber that seems to have been heated only enough to prevent frostbite of those within. The homely but functional hearth on one side of the chamber also casts an occasional shadow against the bare walls. A few elderly braziers provide barely adequate, smoky, light to view the only decoration on the walls leading to the throne: an oversized map of the realm, borders drawn with precision but without flourish. The throne itself has been skillfully crafted without decoration or paint, and will likely look exactly the same a year, ten years, or even a hundred years hence. Above the throne, a large portrait of an unlovely ancestor peer out over the room, seemingly with an expression of faint distaste.

Dragon Turtle Attacking Ship.name:
龙龟袭船
Dragon Turtle Attacking Ship

Text.text:
一只巨如山岳的龙龟自深海猛然冲出，庞然身躯在轰然炸裂的水幕中拔地而起，凌驾于船只之上。它鼻孔喷吐滚烫蒸汽，巨大的喙猛地合拢，发出震耳欲聋的咔嚓巨响。海水倾泻般灌满这艘饱受摧残的船甲板，巨兽的负载压得翻涌巨浪将垂死的船只一口吞没。
A colossal dragon turtle surges from the depths, its immense form towering over the ship in a riot of crashing water. Steam issues from its nostrils as its enormous beak snaps shut with a deafening crunch. Water floods the beleaguered vessel’s decks, the bulk of the behemoth causing the heaving waves to swallow the dying ship.

Large Battle Between Humans And Orcs.name:
人类与兽人之间的大规模战役
Large Battle Between Humans And Orcs

Text.text:
兵刃相击之声传出数里，与撕裂喉咙的战吼、濒死者的呻吟搅作一团。浓烈的血腥味压倒一切，仿佛连空气都被染红。乌鸦与食腐兽已挤满战场边缘，啄食死者与将死者伤口里翻涌的血肉；那些人虚弱得连抗议都无力。可厮杀仍在继续：一阵阵箭雨撕开长空，最终钉进目标的躯体；刀刃带着嗜血的呼啸掠过；战马与座狼同样轰然倒地，抽搐着吐出最后一口气。已无法分辨这场冲突的两端——兽人与人类——究竟是谁更先坠入无知的野蛮；胜负几乎不相上下。
The clash of arms can be heard for miles, mixed with screamed battle cries and moans of the dying. The potent scent of spilled blood overwhelms all other smells. Crows and scavengers already crowd the outskirts of the battle, feasting on the gore from open wounds of both the dead and dying, too weak to protest. And yet, the struggle carries on: flights of arrows piercing the air to be concluded in the bodies of their targets, blades whistling in their bloody purpose, horses and worgs alike plummeting to earth and heaving last breaths. It is impossible to tell whether the orcs or the humans—opposing sides of the conflict—have descended further into mindless savagery, but it is a close competition.

自行车立在那里，像小丑夸张的一记眨眼：巨大的便士眼睁着，遥远的法新半阖。辐条如睫，几乎称不上能用的车架勉强把一切串在一起，中央的座椅脆得过分，仿佛根本承不住一个人。它驶过时宛如一座袖珍嘉年华——怪得像一撮扭曲的八字胡。
The bicycle stands like a clown’s dramatic wink, the large penny eye open and the farthing closed. With spokes like lashes, barely a functional rail holds it all together, and the seat in the middle seems far too brittle to hold a person. It travels like a miniature carnival—odd as a twisted mustache.

在蒸腾的熔岩原野上，过热的岩石咕嘟作响，蒸汽汇聚成一颗颗摇曳、浑浊而闪光的泡膜。它们浓稠黏滞，缓慢拉伸，随即“噗”的一声湿黏爆裂，伴着咕噜般的嘶鸣。又有一对泡膜鼓起，却不见赤红，只呈石灰般的冷灰；它们非但不继续膨胀，反而倏然翻开——竟是眼睑！一只皮厚如甲、满身疣瘤的蟾蜍从熔融的繁殖地里撑起身躯守卫，喉囊鼓胀，低沉而骇人的警戒呱鸣震得你胸腔发颤。它的喉囊再次膨起，这回鼓包里透出岩浆的辉光。蟾蜍将身形对准你，蓄势待发，准备喷出灼烈的驱逐之火。

~ Envisioned by TikiShades

In the steaming lava fields, superheated rock burbles as vapor collects in shimmering, opaque bubbles. Thick and viscous, they stretch slowly, then burst with a squelching pop and a gurgling hiss. A pair of such bubbles forms, not red-hot but stone-gray, and instead of swelling, they flick open—eyelids! A thick-hided, wart-covered toad rises to defend its molten breeding grounds, throat expanding as its deep, intimidating warning croak reverberates in your chest. Its throat swells again, this time with the glow of magma visible within the bulge. The toad aligns its body toward you, poised to release its fiery repellent.

~ Envisioned by TikiShades

I Push The Button On My Immovable Rod.name:
我按下不动杆的按钮
I Push The Button On My Immovable Rod

Text.text:
这根魔杖由黯淡而寻常的金属打造，表面斑驳、带着拉丝的纹理；每一处雕刻都方正敦厚，沉稳得像一块块切削过的铁。杖身刻着一匹挽马的肖像。兜帽状的杖首里嵌着一枚按钮。我将魔杖横持，按下按钮，随后把背包挂在其上，抻伸舒展——它仍旧牢牢钉在魔法与稀薄空气之中。
A dull and common metal, dappled and brushed, with a blocky stoutness to every carved component, this Rod features the likeness of a draft horse. Seated within a hooded pommel is a button. I hold the Rod horizontally and push the button, then hang my pack from it and stretch as it remains rooted in magic and thin air.

这位白化症外科医生神情冷漠，站姿警觉而镇定，制服一尘不染。冰蓝色的眼睛与她的手术服相互映衬——那是她雪白面容上唯一的颜色。她周身萦绕着一股冷峻的专业气息：没有温度，没有关怀，只有运作无误的卓越。她俯身在病人上方，调整着静脉输液管，对那些琐碎的提问置若罔闻。她那块洁净如新的名牌上写着 伊莎贝特·欧克莱尔医生。 This albino surgeon has an apathetic face, standing alert and unfazed, her uniform immaculate. Icy-blue eyes match her scrubs—the only color in her alabaster face. An air of cool professionalism surrounds her: no warmth, no care, only functional excellence. Leaning over a patient, she adjusts an IV tube, ignoring petty questions. Her pristine name tag reads Dr. Isabette Auclair.

I Cast Heroism.name:
我施放《英雄气概》
I Cast Heroism

Text.text:
我把手按在同伴身上，低声送出几句蕴含秘力的鼓励之言。一股温暖的明亮光照自我掌心弥漫开来，唤醒他们心中沉睡的英雄。
Placing my hand upon my companion, I offer them a few words of encouragement laden with mystical power. A warm, bright light suffuses my palm, awakening the hero within.

I Cast Dominate Person.name:
我施放【支配人类】
I Cast Dominate Person

Text.text:
我迎上目标的目光，开始这场精神决斗，誓要压过他们的意志。随着我吟诵咒文，我伸出一只手——那是我支配的象征——并缓缓握拢成拳。法术的力量层层堆叠，推至顶峰；当我吐出最后一个字，我的手猛然攥紧——仿佛将魔法一把攫住——随即施放法术。
I meet the gaze of my target and begin the mental duel to overcome their will. As I begin the incantation I reach out a hand—the symbol of my dominance—and slowly form a fist. The power of the spell builds to a crescendo, and when I speak the last word my hand closes tightly—as if catching the magic—and I cast the spell.

四条肌肉虬结的手臂在空间的深渊彼端抛接着一堆小饰物。生物那张牛脸阴沉地皱起，仿佛对手中之物颇感失望。它把物件悉数抛落。几秒后，一阵低沉的脉冲随一道闪光掠过，又有五件新物品凭空出现在生物身旁。它恼怒地长叹一声。
Four muscular arms juggle trinkets from across the gulf of space. The creature’s bovine face scowls, as though disappointed with what it holds. It drops the objects. Seconds later there is a low pulse and a flash, and five more items appear next to the creature. It sighs in exasperation.

The Fourth Bottle.name:
第四只瓶子
The Fourth Bottle

Text.text:
木桌上摆着几只瓶子，三只凑在一处，仿佛在开一场寻常的聚会。其中两只为厚重的绿玻璃瓶，一只还裹着打结的黄麻绳。第三只是不透光的陶壶，铜盖紧扣，沉甸甸地立着，像在央求有人往里灌满烈酒。唯独第四只与它们隔开。它小巧，贴着黑色标签，瓶塞却是一枚银铸的微型人类头骨。
Bottles sit on a wooden table, three of them in common congress. Two are of thick green glass, one of which is wrapped in knotted jute. The third is an opaque jug with a copper cap, solid and begging to be filled with grog. The fourth, however, sits apart from the others. It is small, black labeled, and its stopper is a tiny human skull cast in silver.

尖塔底部宽阔，向上延伸时依旧粗壮，却在高空骤然收束成锋利的尖端——仿佛专为犁开掠过的云层而生。它至少有一百英尺高，周遭一切在它面前都显得渺小。站在那上面，景色想必令人屏息。
Although wide at the base and thick as it rises, the spire tapers to a sharp point high above—as if intended to plow furrows into passing clouds. It stands at least a hundred feet tall, dwarfing all around it. The view from up there must be amazing.

Abandoned Lunatic Asylum: The End?.name:
废弃疯人院：终章？
Abandoned Lunatic Asylum: The End?

Text.text:
尖叫停了，乐声也终了，但有一个灵体仍留在此地。也许她永远都会在。你知道她依旧悲伤，却似乎不再恐惧。你希望自己的介入已终结邪恶——希望这座收容所如今能成为那些在废墟里安家落户的小小活物的栖居之所。然而，当你再次听见幽灵（特征）那忧郁的嗓音向你哭喊时，这希望却显得徒劳无益。
The screaming stopped, the music ended, but a spirit remains in this place. Perhaps she always will. You know she is still sad, but she no longer seems fearful. You hope that your intervention has ended the evil—that the asylum can now become the haunt of all the little living things that take up residence in ruins. But when you hear the ghost’s melancholy voice cry out to you again, it feels like a vain hope.

Investigating Loot In A Manor.name:
在庄园中调查战利品
Investigating Loot In A Manor

Text.text:
匆匆一瞥，便能看出这间书房的整面墙都嵌着一座抛光木制书柜——在这座陈设考究的庄园里，或许还不止这一座。中央那层的玻璃柜中，一抹无可错认的抛亮金属寒光攫住视线。究竟是黄金还是白金，仅凭这般距离难以分辨，凹槽灯光映在玻璃上，晃得人眼花。
A quick glance shows a wall-length bookcase of polished wood built into this study—perhaps one of several in the well-appointed manor. Within a glass case on the central shelf, the unmistakable gleam of polished metal draws the eye. Whether gold or platinum lies within can’t be made out at this distance, as there’s recessed lighting reflected on the glass.

蓝雾自峭壁下方的空洞间涌出，沿着笔直的岩壁缓缓倾泻，如同迟滞的瀑布，直到触及一线淡淡的银色符文。就在那儿，它骤然逆转，回卷缠绕，继而化作缕缕轻烟消散。更远处，月光照亮迷雾缭绕的山谷，并在下方遥远的河面上投下冷冽的反光。
Blue mist flows from the hollows below the cliff face, pouring down the sheer stone walls like a slow waterfall until it hits a line of faint, silvery glyphs. There, it reverses. It curls back on itself, then dissipates in wisps. Beyond, moonlight reveals a misty valley and reflects from a river far below.

Armored Destrier At Tournament.name:
披甲战驹·比武大会
Armored Destrier At Tournament

Text.text:
牵着高贵巨兽缰绳的侍从神色紧张：双眼圆睁，脸色煞白。战马高大，足有十六掌高，强健的后躯沉坠如铁，肌肉虬结；宽阔的胸膛披覆着镂花的坐骑护甲。它喷着粗气，猛地甩动雄壮的头颅，带刺的面甲在阳光下寒光闪烁。
The squire holding the noble beast's bridle looks nervous: eyes wide, face pale. The war horse is large, sixteen hands, its powerful hindquarters weighty with muscle, the huge chest encased in filigreed barding. It snorts and tosses its mighty head, spiked chanfron gleaming in the sunlight.

Lakeshore In High Wind.name:
湖岸疾风之中
Lakeshore In High Wind

Text.text:
狂风怒号拍打着岸边，苇草被抽得乱舞，翻搅成一片狂乱的旋涡。细碎的浪头在湖面上跳跃奔腾，凶猛的阵风催生出它们白沫翻飞的舞步。水花猛扑上岸，撞在岩石与倒伏的枯木上轰然炸裂。
A gale batters the shore, its fury whipping the reeds into a thrashing maelstrom. Miniature waves bound across the lake, savage gusts giving birth to their white-tipped dance. Spumes of water pounce onto shore, bursting against the rocks and fallen logs.

Satisfying End To Transaction.name:
交易的圆满收尾
Satisfying End To Transaction

Text.text:
每个讨价还价的人看起来都略显疲惫，彼此点头时带着心照不宣的认同，笑容却精明得像刀锋。每位贩子似乎都相信自己在这桩交易里占了上风，拿到了更好的货。他们又免费多换了几句——几句客套话里压着未来争吵的火药味，以及他们对那番前景的隐隐欣悦。
Each barterer looks a bit exhausted as they exchange contended nods and shrewd smiles. The dealers each seem to believe they have topped this trade, received the better goods. They exchange a little more, for free—some pleasantries heavy with the tone of future heated arguments, and their happiness with that prospect.

一条长长的、被反复刷平的行迹从庄园正前方那座宏大的种植园式宅邸延伸出来，引着访客走向马场。储放饲料的谷仓结实耐用，却不知为何透着几分摇摇欲坠的寒酸；从那里，一条有围栏的通道通往开阔的马厩场地。四周的围栏以刷白的粗劈木板钉合而成，木板边缘参差、纹理粗粝，牢牢插在深掘的桩洞里。围栏环绕马场一圈，尽头是一道同样由手工修整木料制成的栅门，推开便是起伏的牧草原野——马匹在完成训练后，就在这片牧场上放开四蹄奔跑。
A long, brushed trail leads visitors to the horse ranch from the large plantation-style house at the front of the property. From the sturdy but somehow ramshackle-looking barn where the fodder is stored, a fenced path leads to an expansive horse yard, bordered on all sides by whitewashed, roughly split planks of wood pegged together and set in deeply dug post holes. The fence loops around the yard and ends in a gate made of the same hand-tooled wood, opening up into the rolling pasturelands of the ranch where the horses are exercised after training.

Evil Crypt Central Cavern.name:
邪恶地穴·中央巨窟
Evil Crypt Central Cavern

Text.text:
你又拨开一蓬蛛网，走进一间霉味浓重的石室。尘土与腐朽的气息撩拨着你的感官，仿佛亡者的魂灵也随每一次呼吸被送入又带出。石墙上每隔一段便有安放火把的壁龛，可那些火把早已燃尽多年，地下墓穴尽数笼罩在黑暗之中。每迈出一步，你都能感觉到遗忘冰冷的接触擦过灵魂的边缘……亡者的幽灵不但躁动不安，更因你的闯入而怒意翻涌。
Parting yet another thatch of cobwebs, you find yourself in a musty chamber. The smell of dust and rot tickles your senses, and the spirits of the departed seem to be carried in and out with each breath. Though there are sconces for torches at regular intervals along the stone walls, any such torches have long since burned out and the catacombs are shrouded in darkness. With every step, you feel the cold touch of oblivion at the edges of your soul… the spirits of the dead are not only restless, but quite angry at your intrusion.

潮湿死沉的泥土在坑旁堆成一座土丘，洞中破裂的棺木里飘起腐朽与防腐油膏的气味。旁边立着一把锈迹斑斑的铁锹，一只乌鸦栖在柄头——目光灼灼地盯着你。寒意顺着脊背滑落，浓雾开始在墓地里缓缓爬行，向着那口敞开的坟墓逼近……
Stagnant, wet earth is heaped in a pile next to the hole, the smell of rot and embalming unguents rising from the broken coffin within. A rusty shovel stands nearby, a single raven perched atop the handle—watching you intently. A chill runs down your spine as a thick fog begins to creep slowly across the cemetery toward the open grave…

洞窟仿佛永无尽头，引着你一步步更深地坠入大地那令人窒息的怀抱。你穿过无尽深渊——那片幽冥之地，光无法渗入，植物无法生长，黑暗、古老、不可知的存在潜伏其间——却发现自己置身于高耸的巨穴之中，那里竟自成平原、森林、河流，甚至拥有属于自己的天空。奇异的真菌散发出异界般的微光。参天的巨蘑成林，支撑着地底的野生生灵。冰寒的河水咆哮奔涌，飞瀑般坠向更深处。而头顶上，闪烁的晶簇与发亮的矿脉如群星般辉映。远处，你瞥见几道仿佛城市尖塔的轮廓。
The caverns seem to go on forever, leading deeper and deeper into the oppressive confines of the earth. As you pass into the endless abyss—the underworld where no light penetrates, where no plants grow, where dark and ancient and unknowable beings dwell—you find yourself in soaring caves with plains, forests, rivers, even skies of their own. Strange fungus lends an otherworldly light. Forests of towering mushrooms support subterranean wildlife. A frigid river flows, roaring, cascading deeper into the earth. And above, glittering crystals and gleaming veins of minerals shine like stars. In the distance, you spy what looks like the spires of a city.

I Cast Fear From My Ring Of Animal Influ.name:
我从【动物影响之戒】中施放恐惧
I Cast Fear From My Ring Of Animal Influence

Text.text:
我抬起手，戒指如闪电般一闪。自我掌心涌出一团漆黑雾霭，翻卷盘旋，膨胀成一片暗云。云中凝出一张狰狞面孔，獠牙修长，目光残忍，冲着我的目标龇牙低吼。
I hold up my hand and my ring flashes like lightning. From my palm, a mass of dark mist swirls and grows into a dark cloud. A fearsome face with long fangs and cruel eyes forms within it, snarling at my target.

Primary Docking Platform In Winter.name:
冬日的主泊船平台
Primary Docking Platform In Winter

Text.text:
沿着斜坡攀上这座平台需要万分谨慎。随着你逼近那片冰冷的星界苍茫，你的四肢末梢已被寒意刺得发痛。你在这根巨柱表面踏出的每一步，都会沿着它的全长震起沉沉回响——那声音空洞而诡异，宛如一具庞然造物缓慢跳动的心脏。
Traversing the ramp up to this platform takes a great deal of care. Your extremities have begun to sting with the cold as you draw nearer to the icy, astral expanse. Each step along the face of this pillar sends a drumming echo down its length. It’s an eerie, hollow sound, like the slow heartbeat of a massive construct.

Unfinished Giant Construct.name:
未完成的巨型构装体
Unfinished Giant Construct

Text.text:
[]沉眠的构装体] 那高耸的身影静止地伫立在一处壁龛之中，壁龛的尺度正好容得下它骇人的体型。它隐没在阴影里，轮廓呈人形，约有山丘巨人的身高，四肢修长而舒展；沉重的钢铁骨架披覆着数十年的尘灰与蛛网。剪影像是一套巨大的板甲，然而钢壳之下隐约可见的精密机括，暗示这具构装体具备自行移动与行动的能力。 [Transformation] 微光在它的眼眶中闪烁。钢铁甲壳深处传来细碎的齿鸣与嗡旋，伴随刺耳的摩擦尖啸，驱动整台机器的齿轮与滑轮在沉睡数十年后第一次苏醒。尘埃与碎屑从构装体庞大的躯干上簌簌剥落，它缓缓挺直身躯，钢制颅骨刮擦着壁龛的石质顶棚。它向前迈步，起初踉跄，随即逐渐稳住，力量完全回涌时低沉的震颤随之扩散，宣告那惊人的强度——它开始搜寻闯入者。

~ Envisioned by codex

[]Dormant Construct] The towering figure stands dormant within an alcove suited to its immense size. Obscured by shadows, the figure is humanoid, standing roughly the height of a hill giant with long, sweeping limbs and a frame of heavy steel shrouded in decades of dust and cobwebs. The silhouette evokes a massive suit of plate armor, though intricate mechanisms beneath the steel hint at the construct’s ability to move and act on its own. [Transformation] Light flickers in the figure’s eyes. A chittering whir reverberates from deep within the steel carapace, and with a screeching grind, the gears and pulleys powering the machine wake for the first time in decades. Dust and debris slough from the construct’s massive frame as it brings itself upright, its steel skull scraping the stone ceiling of its alcove. It steps forward, shakily at first, then gains momentum as its power returns in full, a thrum that signals its immense strength as it begins searching for intruders.

~ Envisioned by codex

Kitchen Of A Creepy Manor.name:
阴森宅邸的厨房
Kitchen Of A Creepy Manor

Text.text:
你绕着宽敞的厨房踱步时，目光被一块巨大的砧板牢牢攫住——那木料厚重而陌生，表面布满深深的劈痕，像是被剁刀或其他沉重器具反复斩下留下的。砧板正上方悬着一排刀具，造型诡秘，显然是从遥远异乡特意订制而来。尤其有一把片刀，看上去与用来剥剐拷打受害者的那种刀别无二致。旁边一口散发恶臭的锅在微弱的火苗上咕嘟翻涌，匆匆一瞥你便认出里面煮着好几根骨头，正被熬成胶冻，好用在那些花哨的菜肴里。骨头究竟来自什么动物，已再也分辨不出。
As you circle the expansive kitchen, your eye is drawn to a large cutting board of thick, unidentifiable wood, sporting deep cuts from a cleaver or other heavy instrument. Just above the board, hangs a collection of knives, esoteric designs that must have been commissioned from distant lands. One filet knife in particular looks identical to a knife used to flay torture victims. A stinking pot boils over a low flame; you realize after a quick glance that it contains several bones being rendered into gelatin for use in fanciful dishes. One can no longer tell what sort of animal the bones came from.

Insult From A Barbarian About Dying Peac.name:
野蛮人对你“安详赴死”的讥讽
Insult From A Barbarian About Dying Peacefully

Text.text:
“我敢打赌，你会像个被娇惯的小婴儿一样，在床上安安静静地死去。你的死会和你的人生一样可悲。”
“I bet you’ll die nice and peaceful in bed like some coddled little baby. Your death will be just as pathetic as your life.”

City Dragged To Hell.name:
被拖入地狱的城市
City Dragged To Hell

Text.text:
天空已蜕变成一幅熔融画布：岩浆奔涌，恶臭的黑烟翻滚。空气灼烧着眼睛、舌头与喉咙，几乎要把肺叶烤得枯萎，化作焦黑的残块。你熟悉的城池在不可思议的热浪里起伏扭动。你听见崩塌楼宇深处传来遥远的哀号，夹杂着魔性的狞咆，猛地将它们惊得噤声。长角、带尾、利爪的怪物剪影游荡在街头，鹅卵石间缠绕着闷燃的脉络。整座城市仿佛正缓慢旋转，朝那成为新地平线的火焰深渊沉去；石块从民宅与商铺上剥落，如同被风轻易掠走的花瓣。

~ 构想：Klonik

The sky has transmogrified into a molten canvas of lava flows and stinking black smoke. The air burns the eyes, tongue and throat, and threatens to wilt the lungs into charred gobs. The city you know so well undulates in the waves of impossible heat. You hear distant wails within the crumbling buildings, punctuated by fiendish snarls that shock them to silence. Silhouettes of horned, tailed, clawed creatures roam the streets, the cobblestones laced with smoldering veins. The city seems to spin slowly toward the fiery abyss that is the new horizon, and pieces of stone slough off the homes and shops as easily as petals taken by the wind.

~ Envisioned by Klonik

半兽人猛击一位威仪凛然的身影：他们身披闪耀的板甲护甲，高举盾牌，紧握长剑。披覆全身的钢铁想必重达数十磅，可他们却以娴熟的优雅步伐腾挪，如同只披着轻柔丝绸。盾面拨开来袭利刃，圣武士高声吟唱着敬虔与正义的战吼，迎面冲锋。
The half-orc strikes a regal figure in gleaming plate armor, shield held high and longsword gripped tight. The steel draping them must weigh dozens of pounds, but they move with a practiced grace, as if wearing nothing but silks. The shield turns aside blades as the paladin charges forward, singing battle cries of reverence and justice.

Loot From A Rat Spectre Swarm’s Lair.name:
从鼠灵群巢穴中搜刮的战利品
Loot From A Rat Spectre Swarm’s Lair

Text.text:
那些虚幻害兽令人恼火的吱吱乱叫与窸窣疾窜声，渐渐消融在这处古怪却陈设考究的巢穴寂静之中：华贵织物包裹的家具安置在厚实丰茂的地毯上，地毯的纹样如迷宫般盘绕。你听见墙体深处传来喀哒作响的碰撞声。有那么一瞬，你几乎以为那些幽魂又要现身——可取而代之的，是钱币从沙发底下滚出、从衣柜与长沙发背后滚出、从地毯下面咕噜噜地滚了出来。
The infuriating squeaks and skitters of the ethereal vermin fade into the quiet of this strangely well-appointed lair: furnishings in rich fabric sit on a lush carpet with a labyrinthine decoration. You hear a clicking clatter in the walls. For a moment, it seems the ghosts might reappear—but instead, coins roll out from under the couch, from behind armoires and settees, from underneath the carpet.

I Cast Antimagic Field Using Components.name:
我用施法材料施放反魔法力场
I Cast Antimagic Field Using Components

Text.text:
我双掌相互摩挲，画着圆，掌间夹着铁屑的砂砾感沙沙作响，同时吐出扭曲的词句。法术的语言被倒置与反写，斜斜偏离了魔法诸界。那是破坏规则的词，没有人能看见在我周身成形的球形界域。他们只能看见它的效应——被召唤的灵体像蒲公英的绒絮般飘散远去，喊出的攻击法术却不曾射出，以及燃烧之剑黯然降温的钝响。
I rub my palms together in circles, the grit of iron filings between them, and speak in twisted words. The spell language is flipped and backwards, canted away from the realms of magic. They are rule-breaking words, and no one can see the sphere that forms around me. They see only its effects—the dandelion puff of a summoned spirit floating away, the shouted attack spell that does not fire, and the dull cooling of a flaming sword.

从一丛斑驳的绿白叶片间，抽出一根修长而优雅的花茎；花茎顶端迸放出一朵诡异而张扬的兰花。兰花有三片绿色花瓣，边缘晕着淡粉。两片花瓣如翼般向两侧舒展，点缀着深褐色斑点；第三片覆在上方的花瓣则带着条纹。花朵下方垂着一瓣深粉色的唇瓣，形状酷似一只拖鞋的鞋尖。
From a bed of mottled green-and-white leaves grows a long, elegant stem, and upon that stem erupts a strange and flamboyant orchid. The orchid has three petals, green, with blushes of pink around the edges. Two petals, stretched like wings to either side, are speckled dark brown, while the third overhanging petal is striped. The dark pink lip hanging from the bottom of the flower resembles the toe of a slipper.

Sundries From A Rat Spectre Swarm.name:
鼠灵群的杂物
Sundries From A Rat Spectre Swarm

Text.text:
虫群消散成一阵清凉的薄雾，那没完没了、层层回响的吱吱尖叫终于从你的脑海里褪去。曾经纠缠翻涌的幽魂大群所在之处，只剩下一抹灵质的拖痕。那发光的黏稠物浓厚得足以被刮起，装进小瓶留待日后研究——或当作一件阴森的纪念品。
The swarm dissipates into a cool mist, and the incessant, echoed squeaking finally fades from your mind. A smear of ectoplasm remains where the spectral horde once writhed en masse. The luminous stuff is viscous enough that it could be scraped up and put into a vial for later study—or as a ghoulish souvenir.

歌者那悦耳而富有阳刚之气的嗓音升起，清亮明澈地唱出旋律。他们的射程惊人得几乎令人难以置信，音线娴熟而无瑕地一路攀升，继而骤然回落，仿佛沿着螺旋楼梯的栏杆轻盈滑下。
The lovely, masculine voice of the singer rises, singing out clear and bright. Their range is staggering, almost unbelievable, as it masterfully, flawlessly continues to rise, and then drops like gliding down the banister of a spiraling staircase.

Halfling Rat King.name:
半身人鼠王
Halfling Rat King

Text.text:
那个秃顶的半身人坐在黑暗中，周围堆满了散发恶臭的污秽与垃圾；他悄悄咯咯笑着，低声对着在他身边疯狂窜动的老鼠呢喃。你们踏入时，他站起身来，深深一鞠躬。“欢迎来到我的王国，我的小宝贝们早就告诉我你们会来。”他的声音在这座空旷的下水道大厅里回荡——他把这里改造成了臭烂的、对王室宫廷拙劣而恶心的讽刺。
The balding halfling sits in darkness amongst piles of stinking filth and refuse, quietly giggling to himself and whispering to the rats frantically scurrying around him. He stands as you enter and bows deeply. “Welcome to my kingdom, my pets told me you’d be coming.” His voice echoes around the cavernous sewer chamber he has transformed into a foul mockery of a royal court.

Meteor-struck Ruins Full Of Monsters.name:
陨星坠击的怪物废墟
Meteor-struck Ruins Full Of Monsters

Text.text:
这座城市的废墟，几十年来一直在滋养藤蔓与杂草。靠近中心处，半埋着一道多孔、锯齿般的异界岩石弧影，足足有四分之三陷入地里——它身后拖出一条宽阔的彻底毁灭之痕。它降临时的冲击波，将曾在此繁盛的文明碾成细小碎片——如今取而代之的，是成群怪物在残骸间厮杀。兽群追猎那些狡黠的小恶鬼般恐怖之物，却又转瞬成了更为蛮横的掠食者的口粮；那些粗暴的旧城住民，正徘徊在破碎长廊的阴影里，等候着下一次撕咬。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The ruins of the city have been feeding vines and weeds for many decades now. Near its center is a porous, jagged curve of alien rock three-quarters embedded into the ground—a wide track of complete destruction behind it. The shock wave of its arrival made tiny fragments of the civilization that once lived here—replaced now by hordes of monsters fighting among the remains. Packs of beasts hunt small impish horrors, but are in turn preyed upon by the most brutish denizens of the old city’s broken halls.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

你的意识边缘骤然膨胀，灵能的浪潮在心海中汹涌奔腾，层层叠起，最终凝成坚不可摧的壁垒。深邃的敏锐如涓流渗入每一道思绪，护住每一条突触。
The edge of your consciousness swells, waves of psionic power surging in the ocean of your mind, cresting into impenetrability. A profound acuity trickles through every thought, shielding every synapse.

Avatar Of Death.name:
死亡化身
Avatar Of Death

Text.text:
一颗离体的骷髅头颅悬浮在你面前，空洞无魂的眼窝死死灼视着你。那阴森的凝望带着坟墓般的终局，你的脑海被一幅鲜明、刺骨的景象填满——你的墓碑：风化崩裂，荒草蔓生，终被遗忘。
A disembodied skull hovers before you, its hollow, soulless eyes burning into yours. Its morbid gaze carries the finality of the grave, and your mind is filled with a vivid, bone-chilling image of your headstone—crumbling, overgrown, and forgotten.

Fighter Swears A Paladin's Oath.name:
战士立下圣骑士的誓言
Fighter Swears A Paladin's Oath

Text.text:
“我伤过很多人。有些是好人……更多是坏人，至少我一直这么告诉自己。可当这颗心成了指引，我却迷了路。战斗太久，‘善良’就失了意义。人们只在乎自己想要什么、能拿到什么，以及为了拿到它需要伤害谁。我的心在被我塞满血肉与脏腑后，从胸腔里腐烂脱落——而我需要把它找回来。我知道我必须靠自己挣回它。我发誓，你派我去的每一个邪恶混账，我都会亲手劈倒，并以此敬奉你的名。求你做我的引路人，让这条血路，能被用来成就一点善。”

~ 一位英雄所Envisioned

“I’ve hurt a lot of people. Some good… Most bad, at least that’s what I tell myself. But with this heart as a guide, I’ve lost my way. When you’ve been fighting for so long, being good loses its meaning. It’s all about what people want, what they can get, and who they need to hurt to get it. My heart rotted out of my chest after I filled it with gore—and I need it back. I know I have to earn it. I swear I will venerate your name as I smite down every evil bastard you send me to. Please be my guide and let this life of blood be used for something good.”

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Swarm Of Insect Corpses.name:
虫尸群
Swarm Of Insect Corpses

Text.text:
几丁质的虫尸堆成隆起的丘脊，像微光闪烁的沙丘般掩蔽着地面。蜂群似乎并未遭受明显创伤，那数量不可计的万千躯体竟都完好无损。
Chitinous mounds of insect corpses cover the ground like shimmering dunes. No clear trauma seems to have befallen the swarm, the incalculably myriad bodies all intact.

Undead Horde In A Village.name:
村庄中的不死尸潮
Undead Horde In A Village

Text.text:
蹒跚的亡者蔓延到村庄的每个角落，嗅探着猎物。异界般的哀嚎充斥空气，它们朝着任何被困在街上的人汹涌扑去，彼此攀爬推挤，只为触及那顿“餐食”。不消片刻，这些污秽之物便开始砰砰敲打窗户与门板，把手伸进屋内，去抓住那些躲在里面的人。
The shambling dead spread to every corner of the village, sniffing out prey. Otherworldly moans fill the air as they surge toward anyone caught in the street, clambering over one another to reach the meal. It's not long before the foul creatures begin banging on windows and doors, reaching inside homes to grab those caught inside.

Ingestion Of Torpor.name:
麻木摄入
Ingestion Of Torpor

Text.text:
有什么味道不对。你刚意识到这一点，四肢便像被抽走了力气般软了下去。你昏沉地抬起头想开口，却发现嘴唇与舌头像不听使唤一般笨拙。你知道自己说出来的每个字都会含混不清，仿佛酩酊大醉。
Something doesn’t taste right. As you come to this realization you feel your limbs go limp. You dazedly raise your head and try to speak, but your lips and tongue feel clumsy. You know your words will be slurred as if you were deeply drunk.

狂怒扭曲了你敌人的五官，他们与你四目相对。无形的锁链将你们捆缚在一起，深处翻涌着灼热的强迫冲动。你的言语毫无意义——几乎是胡言乱语——可其中的含义却是暴力的化身。一股不可抗拒的战意在你体内搏动，世界收束得只剩下你与目标。
Rage twists your foe's features as they lock eyes with you. Unseen chains bind you together, with a deep compulsion simmering. Your words mean nothing—are almost gibberish—but their meaning is violence incarnate. An irresistible urge to fight pulses through you, the world narrowing to just you and your target.

半身人身姿优雅而精准地移动，朴素的衣衫随动作利落作响。他吟诵咒语时，周遭空气荡起层层涟漪，微风拂动他带着红褐色的发丝。颈间系着细绳的水晶泛起青蓝色的幽光。他的榛色眼眸骤然燃成明亮的蓝绿，铜色肌肤上同色的符印随之熠熠生辉。最终，他以一声尖锐的咒词与一记跺步收束，猛然将手向前一推。冲击波自那伸出的手臂轰然迸发，无声地滚涌着向远处席卷而去。#REF!
The halfling moves with grace and precision, his simple garments snapping as he does. Air around him ripples with his incantation, and his reddish hair moves in the breeze. A crystal on a string around his neck glows greenish blue. His hazel eyes flare to luminous teal, and sigils of the same hue shine on his coppery skin. With a final sharp word and a stomp, he thrusts a hand forward. A shockwave erupts from the outstretched arm, soundlessly rolling away from him.#REF!

Dantrox Creatrix, Aberrant Engineer.name:
丹特罗克斯·造物主，畸变工程师
Dantrox Creatrix, Aberrant Engineer

Text.text:
丹特罗克斯·克瑞特里克斯把护甲板直接钉附在自己最敏感的部位皮肤上，其余身体则用普通护甲保护。他将两根受损的眼柄替换为高效却黯淡的金属构装体版本。他的巢穴深藏在一座格外深邃、洞窟纵横的废弃矮人矿坑中。他那摇摆不定的理智扭曲了自己改造所捕获生物的天赋——把构装体的部件缝接到它们身上，并借此汲取奥术力量。

~ 由 Josh Green 构想

Dantrox Creatrix has attached armor plates to his skin in the most sensitive areas, but protects the rest of his body with normal armor. He has replaced two damaged eye stalks with efficient, dull metal construct versions. His home is deep in an especially cavernous abandoned dwarf mine. His fluctuating sanity twists his talent for altering the creatures he captures, attaching construct elements to them—from which he siphons arcane power.

~ Envisioned by Josh Green

Distant Fortress In An Autumn Forest.name:
秋林深处的远堡
Distant Fortress In An Autumn Forest

Text.text:
地面铺满落叶，如同一张厚毯；树木褪尽衣裳，枝杈似骷髅的臂膀伸向阴云密布的天空。曾经被遮蔽的堡垒如今显露出来，矮粗的塔楼不再藏在自然葱郁的披风之下。远处的城门依旧紧闭，包铁的窗户被栅栏封死；而一种超自然的寂静仿佛从那建筑深处向外渗出。恍惚间，你似乎看见有人——或某种东西——在城垛上行走……又或者，那只是秋雾在作祟？
The ground is a carpet of fallen leaves and the trees stand naked, branches like skeletal arms reaching up to the cloudy sky. A previously hidden bastion can now be seen, the squat towers no longer disguised by nature's verdant cloak. The distant gates remain closed, the iron-shod windows barred; and a supernatural quiet seems to emanate from the structure. For a moment it looks like someone, or something, walks the battlements—or is that some trick of the autumn mists?

Swinging Log Trap.name:
摆荡圆木陷阱
Swinging Log Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 一颗爱慕火把光的赝品欧泊，偎在碎屑里。欧泊牵出丝线，丝线引出细线，细线连成绳索，绳索通往隐蔽的凹槽。想把那样结实的东西藏在黑暗高处并不容易——把它悬在头顶、离地而起，专等毫无防备的人撞上。

[发现] 别去接触那颗在碎屑间对你眨眼的欧泊。那是玻璃，是诱饵。径直跨过去，然后抬头看那处凹槽：一圈惨白的圆盘，上面年轮般的纹路，正对着你，像靶心。

[触发] 在你把那根黏在碎屑里、闪着光的欧泊上的散丝扯开的这点时代里，所有好运尽数翻黑。丝线以快得离谱的速度滑回尘里，绳索沿着墙上的轨道疾速上收，而一阵呼啸——某种比人类躯干更庞大、更不讲理的东西——瞬间灌满了通道。

[Perceived] A false opal that loves torchlight nestles in some debris. Opal to thread, thread to line, line to rope to hidden recess. Tough to hide something that stout up there in the dark, to hang it above and away, aimed at the unwary.

[Discovered] Don’t touch that opal winking at you from among the debris. It’s glass, a lure. Step right over and then look up in that recess. A pale circle, the tree rings on it like a bullseye.

[Triggered] In the time it takes to unstick that stray thread from the opal glittering in the debris, all luck turns bad. The thread slips back into the dust far too fast, a rope slides up a track in the wall, and the woosh of something larger and less forgiving that a human torso fills the passage.

那名皱着眉的女人阖上双眼，无声地念了几句。随即她微微偏头，眉梢惊讶地扬起，又含糊地嘟囔了几句。她的神情重新沉回皱眉，点了点头。仿佛刚与自己完成了一场对话并心满意足，她从一侧口袋掏出一只塞着软木塞的墨水瓶，又从另一侧口袋摸出一本小册子，接着从耳后抽出一支羽毛笔，似乎要把什么记下来。
The frowning woman shuts her eyes and mouths a few words. Then she tilts her head, eyebrows shooting up in surprise, to mumble something else. She returns to the frowning face and nods. Satisfied with whatever conversation she just had with herself, she pulls a corked ink bottle from one pocket, a little book from another, and then draws a quill from behind her ear, apparently to write something down.

被污泥抹得发亮的地面在你脚下发出潮湿的咯吱声，你一边走一边躲开一堆堆烂泥般的垃圾和它们刺鼻的恶臭。幽暗尽头外，那些喧闹的店面把蓝光与紫光投进巷子，像是城市烟霾上方偶尔才挤得进来的阳光指缝。 一辆飞行摩托呼啸掠过，气流顺着巷道灌下，扑面而来的是一股带苦味的尿臊。几团黝黑的剪影——人影，或坐或睡——缩在阴影里，身上盖着防水布与成片玻璃纤维。一个穿兜帽雨衣的人正翻找一个巨大的蓝色垃圾箱，他肘弯里夹着的塑料袋在他把易拉罐和瓶子丢进去时沙沙作响、嘶嘶出气。
The sludge-slicked ground emits a moist crunch as you walk over it, avoiding the mushy piles of garbage and their rank stench. Blue and purple lights beam into the alley from the vibrant storefronts just beyond the gloom, reminiscent of the fingers of sunlight that rarely eke through the smog over the city. A flying motorbike zooms by, sending a draft of air down the alley to flood your face with the bitter smell of piss. A handful of dark silhouettes—people, sitting or sleeping—huddle in the shadows, blanketed in tarps and swathes of fiberglass. Someone in a hooded raincoat rifles through a large blue dumpster, the plastic bag in the crook of his elbow crinkling and hissing as he drops cans and bottles into it.

Mud Giant's Pit With Caves.name:
泥巨人的深坑与洞窟
Mud Giant's Pit With Caves

Text.text:
死亡与沼泽烂泥的气味萦绕在这座巨大的泥坑四周。由巨石垒成的坑沿向下延伸出嶙峋的岩坡，接着是覆满黏滑淤泥的土坡，最终沉入坑底的泥沼。你看见半埋的残骸、垃圾与白骨，还发现一串巨型类人生物的足迹，以及同样巨大的犬科脚印。坑底中央、最低处是一汪褐色水潭，散落着几块巨石，潭边还卡着一截早已枯死的橡树残干。坑壁上开着两条隧道：两足足迹通向较大的那条，四足足迹则钻入较小的那条。

~ 由一位英雄设想

The smell of death and swampy ground lingers around this colossal, muddy pit. From the boulders forming its rim, rocky inclines descend to slimy soil slopes, then a muddy mire at the bottom. You see half-buried debris, trash, and bones, along with the tracks of a huge humanoid and equally large canine. At the middle and lowest point is a brown pool, littered with boulders and the snag of a long-dead oak. Two tunnels open into the side of the pit, with the two-footed tracks leading into the larger and the four-footed tracks into the smaller.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Dare-do-well General Store.name:
亡命徒杂货铺
Dare-do-well General Store

Text.text: 这家杂货铺塞得满满当当，尽是冒险者可能用得上的零碎什物。连照亮店里更阴暗角落的灯笼上，都挂着写有 For the right price 的小牌子，花体字蜿蜒流转。店主是个半身人，皮肤像鞣过的皮革般黝亮，站在柜台后的凳子上。他穿得体面讲究——与这间杂乱的店铺形成鲜明对照：一件紫色紧身短上衣，扣子锃亮；深色皮裤利落地塞进一双皮靴里，靴子染成与裤子相近的色调。两名雇员正帮忙补货、整理货架：一位半精灵女子和一位人类男子，听着老板荤段子般的玩笑，只能讪讪地陪笑。后墙上挂着一张奇美拉的皮，麦金色的毛与病态的绿鳞混杂交错，那张丑恶的头颅与带刺的尾巴竟仍然连在皮上。 This general store is packed full of odds and ends that any adventurer might need. Even the lanterns that light the dimmer corners of the store are labeled with tags that read For the right price in a flowing script. The owner, a halfling with skin the color of tanned leather, stands atop a stool behind the counter. He is garbed in fine clothing—a stark contrast to his cluttered shop. He wears a purple jerkin fitted with gleaming buttons and dark leather pants that tuck neatly into a pair of hide boots, which are dyed to match the tone of his trousers. A couple of employees help restock and tidy shelves: a half-elf woman and a human man who smile sheepishly at their boss's bawdy jokes. The hide of a chimera, a mix of wheat-blonde fur and sickly green scales, adorns the back wall, its hideous head and spined tail still attached.

这头动物的一切仿佛都为切开血肉而生。他像鸟一样掠过珊瑚与海藻林上方滑行。背鳍、如巨型回旋镖般的尾巴、锐利的吻端——无不裁开海水。鲨鱼身体的下侧，圆而扁平的眼睛之下，一弯光滑的黑色新月裂开，边缘排满锋利的白牙。
Everything about this animal seems designed to cut flesh. He glides like a bird above the coral and kelp. His dorsal fins, a tail like a giant boomerang, the keen snout—all shear the water. Along the bottom of the shark’s body, beneath the round flat eyes, a smooth black crescent opens, lined with sharp white teeth.

Thorny Vines Hazard.name:
荆棘藤蔓危害
Thorny Vines Hazard

Text.text:
这片疯长的植被狡猾难缠——深绿如墨，垂挂着女巫胡须般的苔须，纠缠的常春藤绕在巨大的蕨类之间——但只要肯下力气，仍能找到或硬生生劈出一条路来。随着光线渐强——那是你快要闯到乱灌丛外缘的征兆——你忽然感到一阵刺痛般的拽扯。藤蔓像地毯般铺满地面，厚近一英尺；它们凶狠得像鲨齿的尖刺死死挂在坚韧的黄绿色茎蔓上，茎蔓彼此套缠，盘绕成团。
The overgrowth is tricky—deep green with hanging witch’s beard and tangled ivy around giant ferns—but it’s possible to find or force a path with some labor. As the light increases, a sign that the outer edge of the bushwhacking is approaching, you feel a stinging grab. Vines carpet the ground nearly a foot thick, their wicked, shark’s-tooth thorns stuck to tough, yellow-green stems that loop and curl around one another.

Loot From A Green Hag.name:
来自一位绿鬼婆的战利品
Loot From A Green Hag

Text.text: 一只又长又窄的木盒，盒底刻着七个凹槽：其中六个槽里依次摆着六只猫爪，按其腐坏程度由浅到深排列；正中那道凹陷里放着一颗猫牙。每只猫爪都有六个脚趾。盒盖内侧被胶牢牢粘着一张羊皮纸便签，上面写着：啃啃猫爪，破破法条。成功使用这件小饰物后，盒中物件会化作飞灰。便签随即自我改写，变成一张卷轴：cloak of chaos。 A long, thin wooden box with seven depressions carved in the bottom contains six cat paws, in order of their stages of decomposition, and one cat tooth in the center divot. Each paw has six toes. Glued to the inside of the box lid is a parchment note that reads: Gnaw the paws and break the laws. Successful use of the trinket disintegrates the items. The note rewrites itself into a scroll: cloak of chaos.

Oratory Of A Manor.name:
庄园演讲厅
Oratory Of A Manor

Text.text:
你踏入这座小礼拜堂的瞬间，心头被一阵宁静轻轻拂过——你这才意识到，这是一种源于建筑设计的微妙效果。深色木材在从祭坛附近彩绘玻璃窗洒入的柔和光线中泛着幽光，为前来寻求慰藉的人们带来热度与温暖，仿佛这处圣所本身也在安抚每一位踏入其间的灵魂。
The peace that washes over you as you enter this small chapel is, you realize, a subtle effect of the architectural design. The dark wood shines in the muted light coming through panes of stained glass near the chapel’s altar, lending both heat and warmth to those seeking succor within this consecrated place.

Enos Ii, The Chimpanzee.name:
伊诺斯二世，黑猩猩
Enos Ii, The Chimpanzee

Text.text:
他穿着皮质护甲，背上用绑带固定着一台喷气背包，在人类的环境里举止和其他黑猩猩并无二致：带着点忧郁，摆弄小玩意儿，偷看行人。直到你靠近为止。后脑勺底部有几道精确的粉色疤痕。他转过身，抬头用近乎理智的目光看着你，随即嗤笑。“哦，真好，”他说，“又一只长癣的退化猿盯着我的力量印记。你一定冻坏了吧。”一把古怪而巨大的手术刀仿佛自行在他手中显现，刀尖直指你。“我可不想耽误你去买鞋什么的，”他说。

~ 由 dr.dungeon 扮演

He wears leather armor strapped with a jetpack and behaves as any other chimp in a human environment: a little sad, tinkering and people-watching. That is, until you approach closely. Precise pink scars show at the base of his skull. He turns, looks up at you intelligently, then sneers. “Oh, good,” he says. “Another devolved ape with the mange staring at my power marks. You must be freezing.” A strange, large scalpel seems to manifest in his hand on its own, pointed at you. “I don’t want to keep you from your shoe shopping or anything,” he says.

~ Played by dr.dungeon

Speech From An Old Race About Mankind’s.name:
古老种族关于人类城市的演说
Speech From An Old Race About Mankind’s Cities

Text.text:
“人类是在这片土地上蔓延开来的伤疤。你们的城市像巨大的蛆虫堆般扭动溃烂，啃食着旧世界干枯的尸身。但我们尚未死去，我们将归来，把你们的污秽从此地洗净。”
