“Mankind is a scar that has spread over these lands. Your cities writhe and fester like great mounds of wriggling maggots, feasting off the desiccated body of the old world. But we are not dead, and we will return to clean your filth from this place.”

Swarm Of Poisonous Snakes.name:
毒蛇群
Swarm Of Poisonous Snakes

Text.text:
地面被一具具修长扭动的躯体闷覆，绿与紫的鳞片闪烁，宛如你眼前刚被撕开的内脏般湿亮。分叉的舌信子在空气中飞快吐探，既慌乱又好奇。它们纤细的头颅成群齐刷刷转向你。
The ground is smothered by long, writhing bodies, green and purple scales glistening like freshly rent viscera before you. Tongues flick the air, frantic and curious. En masse, their slender heads turn toward you.

I Don My Mantle Of Spell Resistance.name:
我披上法术抗力斗篷
I Don My Mantle Of Spell Resistance

Text.text:
这件短斗篷仿佛旧世界的王族才会披在身上：厚重的天鹅绒，边缘是硬挺的刺绣滚边。将它甩上肩头的瞬间，魔法的力量就像一段旋律在我脑海里奏响，随时准备与朝我施放的任何魔法共振——让我得以与之和声，而非被其所伤。
The short cloak is something royalty of the old world might wear, heavy velvet with a stiff embroidered border. When I throw it over my shoulders, the force of magic is like a melody playing in my mind, ready to resonate with whatever magic is cast at me, so that I might harmonize with it rather than be hurt.

Framed Cinema Still.name:
定格电影画面
Framed Cinema Still

Text.text:
那张黑白照片就挂在那里，是被遗忘时代遗留下来的遗物。画面定格着一幕老电影的场景，演员们凝固在记忆与空间之中。而在这个科技极度发达、即时且永无止境的满足唾手可得的时代里，它像一记冷冽的提醒：那门艺术早已在漫长岁月里走向衰败。
The black-and-white picture hangs there, an artifact from a forgotten era. It depicts a scene from a vintage film, the actors frozen in memory and space. In this time of uber-advanced tech and instant, constant gratification, it is a reminder of an art that has long since devolved.

Fashionable Neighborhood In A Large City.name:
大城市里时髦的街区
Fashionable Neighborhood In A Large City

Text.text:
一条历经时代磨砺的建筑街巷在你眼前延展，人们从商铺到客厅再到酒吧穿梭往来，每一处店面都被拥挤的移动与喧嚣的谈笑填满。帘幕后的窗中倾泻出层层光瀑，将景象涂抹成流转不定的色调；花香的香氛压住了城中污泥的腥浊与不快。这里的人们身着考究的西装与礼服，佩戴璀璨珠宝，衣襟袖口一尘不染，连半点土屑灰尘都不见。

~ 构想：Søren Sørensen

A street of time-worn buildings stretches before you, people moving from shop to parlor to bar, each establishment bustling with movement and chatter. Light cascades from curtained windows, painting the scene in shifting tones of color, and a perfume of florals staves off the unpleasantness of the city’s muck. The people here are adorned in elegant suits, dresses, and jewels, not a speck of dirt or dust upon them.

~ Envisioned by Søren Sørensen

潜艇船壳的一段只是朴素的钝钢外凸弧线，在由铜管搭架的顶棚上悬挂的干船坞煤气灯下，映出发黄的灰光。行至中段，船壳忽然变作一件新艺术风格的杰作：鹦鹉螺壳的回旋，破浪的弧锋，飞鱼的剪影——皆以锤揲成形，焊接在金属之上。艺术家吊在梁架下的滑轮脚手架上，戴着厚重手套，焊工面罩掀起。他眯眼端详，审视着自己的作品。
Part of the submarine hull is a simple convex curve of dull steel, reflecting in yellowed gray the dry dock gaslights hanging on overhead racks of copper pipe. About halfway along it, the hull changes to a nouveau masterpiece: the curl of a nautilus shell, the arc of a breaking wave, and flying fish hammer-worked and welded onto the metal. The artist is suspended from the rafters on a pulley scaffold, wearing heavy gloves and with his welder’s mask tipped back. He squints appraisingly at his work.

河水涨得很高，几乎要漫过这里的堤岸。再往下游望去，它已铺满一片田地，把一段牛轭形河湾切成孤岛——一簇树旁的几只羊被困在那儿。水面看似平静，但当你瞥见一匹溺死的马的腿从水中短暂翻出，尸身又在主流中央迅速起伏漂去时，水流的速度立刻显露无遗。
The river rides high, nearly topping its banks here. Farther downstream, you see it has spread across a field, turning an oxbow into an island—stranding some sheep among a clump of trees. The water’s surface looks calm, but the speed of the flow becomes apparent when you spy the legs of a drowned horse flop briefly out of the water as its body bobs swiftly down the center of the flow.

Loot From A Wicker Skeleton.name:
来自藤编骷髅（特征）的战利品
Loot From A Wicker Skeleton

Text.text:
伴随着一声如枯骨断木般的脆响，生物的躯体在哀恸的尖啸中碎裂崩散。在那令人眩晕的残骸碎片间，你发现一枚铁制颈环缠在它的胸腔里。它价值 2 银币。
With a snap like bone-dry wood, the creature's body splinters apart with a mournful screech. Amid the splinters of the vertiginous cadaver, you find an iron torc tangled in its chest. It is worth 2 silver pieces.

Victorian Greenhouse.name:
维多利亚式温室
Victorian Greenhouse

Text.text:
一处兼具美感与植物学探究之所——收容着体型异乎寻常、丰饶华丽的植株——这座建筑以拱形花园窗为骨，窗上扇形气窗如日芒绽放；脚下铺着彩绘瓷砖地面，线条与纹饰皆是新艺术风格。仿佛一座被异教自然学者临摹的教堂，温室的陈列沿着中殿与耳堂列队前行，直指那如后殿般的凸窗；在那里，一道存在沐光而立，被光辉镶入窗框之中。
A place of beauty and botanical inquiry—housing plants of unusual size and richness—this building is designed with arched garden windows topped by fanned transoms, like sunbursts, and a tile floor painted in an art nouveau style. As if in a cathedral copied by pagan naturalists, the displays of the greenhouse march through nave and transept toward a bay window, like an apse, where a presence stands framed in light.

石构遗迹高耸在你头顶，像某个半埋于地下的泰坦骤然破土的指骨般森然逼近。它们的高度违背常理，规模如山岳般宏伟，投下的阴影延展数百码。每一块巨石上都刻着繁复却已磨损的纹饰，描绘着古老的城市，每座城市都独一无二，细节精微到令人难以置信。当你仰望这些矗立的巨石，沉醉于它们无可置疑的威严时，你不禁恍惚一瞬：它们究竟深深扎入大地多少？是谁将其竖起？而那些被刻进岩石、记忆就此永恒的壮丽城市，又遭遇了怎样血腥可怖的命运？

~ 由 Einjuden Envisioned

The stone structures tower over you, looming like the erupting fingers of some half-buried titan. Their height defies logic, mountainous in their scale, and their shadows sprawl for hundreds of yards. On each stone, intricate but worn carvings depict ancient cities, each unique and unbelievably detailed. As you take in the sheer majesty of these standing stones, you wonder for a moment how deep they plunge into the earth, who erected them, and what grisly fate befell the majestic cities whose memories have been made eternal on the rock.

~ Envisioned by Einjuden

Quip About Seeing A Reflection Of Yourse.name:
关于看见自己倒影的俏皮话
Quip About Seeing A Reflection Of Yourself

Text.text:
“这不是你做错了什么。只是……当我看着你时，我看见了自己的倒影，而我无法忍受那副模样。”
“It’s nothing you’ve done. It’s just… When I look at you, I see a reflection of myself, and I can’t stand the sight of it.”

Temperate Forest Rainstorm.name:
温带森林暴雨
Temperate Forest Rainstorm

Text.text:
空气中弥漫着臭氧的气味，预示着将有雨来。果然，很快便飘起细雨，直到骤然间，聚拢的灰云彻底崩开。风雨鞭挞树梢，空中回荡着连绵不绝的嘶嘶声。雨点穿过林间坠落，自叶至宽大的掌状叶，一下下敲出稳定的节拍。覆着腐殖的泥土被天赐的雨水浸得松软，散发出浓郁而清新的芬芳。
The smell of ozone in the air predicts rain. Sure enough, a drizzle soon begins, until all at once, the gathering gray clouds give way. A steady hiss fills the air as wind and rain lash the treetops. Raindrops drum a steady rhythm as they tumble down through the trees, leaf to broad-palmed leaf. The mulched earth grows soft and fragrant with the sky’s bounty.

Natural Steps In Cave.name:
洞穴中的天然石阶
Natural Steps In Cave

Text.text:
嵌在石笋间的火把照亮了河岸这一侧，映出一道高墙——却并未触及洞顶。风化剥落的石板沿墙向上层层攀升，形成一段天然阶梯，通往上方某处，或许是一道岩架，又或许是一条隧道；难以分辨。那些陡峭的台阶看上去确实可用，但阶梯底部那具破碎的人形骷髅（特征）让你不由得踌躇。
Stalagmite-ensconced torches illuminate this side of the river, revealing a high wall that doesn’t reach the ceiling. Slabs of crumbling stone ascend the wall to the top, making a natural stairway up to what might be a ledge or a tunnel. It’s hard to say. The steep steps look useful, but the broken skeleton of some humanoid at their foot gives you pause.

Gargantuan Black Tree.name:
巨型黑树
Gargantuan Black Tree

Text.text:
黑如无星的子夜，那株参天巨树粗砺嶙峋的树皮覆满全身，更衬得这头林木巨兽威势逼人。沉重的枝杈上不见一片叶影；事实上，摇曳的枝桠仿佛彻底失了生机，空荡得令人心悸。树基之下，巨蟒般粗壮纠结的根系间，一抹猩红浸染着树的血肉——也染红了周遭的土地——深沉、丰腴，如熟透的暗红。

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Black as starless midnight, the craggy bark covering the gargantuan tree makes the arboreal behemoth all the more imposing. No leaves adorn the weighty branches of the towering tree; in fact, the swaying boughs seem devoid of any life at all. At the tree's base, amid tangled roots thick as pythons, a crimson hue stains the tree's flesh—and the earth surrounding it—a deep, luscious red.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

若要为狩猎立一枚象征，那便是这枚锻造的金属尖——隐约呈菱形——底部开着可套入坚韧长杆的套筒。它是武器真正办事的一端：养活一家人，穿透皮与毛，夺走一条千磅之重的生命。
If there was a symbol for hunting, it would be this forged metal point—vaguely diamond shaped—with a socket to fit a strong shaft. It is the business end of a weapon that feeds a family, that takes a thousand-pound life through hide and hair.

Military Cruiser: Outer Hull.name:
军用巡洋舰：外层装甲
Military Cruiser: Outer Hull

Text.text:
巡洋舰浑身布满各式令人胆寒的重型武装与瞄准阵列。舰体庞大得骇人，外壳上密布的狰狞炮塔之间，那些巨大的峡谷深处，足以容纳整座村落落脚生息。
The cruiser bristles with all manner of imposing weaponry and targeting arrays. The ship is so vast that entire villages could settle in the enormous canyons between the menacing turrets covering its outer hull.

Tractatus Of Mesmerizing Incantations.name:
《摄魂魅咒论》
Tractatus Of Mesmerizing Incantations

Text.text: [掩蔽]  这是一份可展开的折页小册子，用的是你见过最古老的纸张，外覆一层透明材质层压封存，像博物馆里的展品。其一页印着标题，方便将小册子竖向摆正。 [内容]  这份 tractatus 收录了历史上施展过的每一道咒语，甚至包括那些从未被任何法师记载、却由他们发明的咒语。你只需说出那句令人目眩神迷的咒文，它的施法指引便会浮现在册页上，并配有实用的图解。唯有当眼前显示的法术被成功施放后，这本小册子才会清空并重置。 [Cover]  This is a fold-out pamphlet of the oldest looking paper you have ever seen, laminated in a transparent material like a museum piece. One panel has the title printed to orient the pamphlet vertically. [Content]  The tractatus holds every charm ever cast in history, including charms invented by wizards who never recorded them. One only has to name the mesmerizing incantation for its instructions to appear on the brochure, along with helpful illustrations. The brochure only clears and resets if the currently displayed spell is successfully cast.

远胜那些粗陋的同类之上，这柄雕琢而成的短杖工艺臻至绝顶。柔软的皮革包覆着木棍的握柄，打磨光亮的杖身顶端箍着数道闪耀钢环，其上嵌满凸起的铆钉。
Far elevated above its rudimentary counterparts, this sculpted baton is of superlative craftsmanship. Soft leather pads the grip of the wooden club, and the polished haft is crowned by bands of gleaming steel embedded with raised studs.

一场无定形的原生质熵之雪崩轰然向你倾泻而来，漆黑而冷漠，仿佛它所栖居的深渊本身。那九头蛇般的异怪是一团纠缠的伪足、啮咬的利齿与千只各不相同的眼睛。仅仅望向它那异质、起伏蠕动的形体就足以令你作呕，而从它百张巨口中泄出的异界呓语更为可怖。那不协和的喧嚣——层层叠叠的窸窣低语所汇成的狂乱——啃噬着你的心智，扯裂你的理智。
An amorphous protoplasmic avalanche of entropy crashes toward you, black and uncaring as the depths it calls home. The hydra-like aberration is an entangled mass of pseudopods, gnashing teeth, and a thousand disparate eyes. Just looking upon its alien, undulating form is enough to sicken you, but the otherworldly babble that escapes its hundred maws is worse. Its discordant pandemonium of overlapping susurrations eats away at your mind, fraying your sanity.

Ruined Castle Gates.name:
破败的城堡大门
Ruined Castle Gates

Text.text:
一段以灰浆砌就的石墙残骸阴森可怖，似已历经数百年风霜，自地里拔起，宛如高耸的墓碑。废墟上仍留着黑色焦痕，那是烈焰舔舐石面的印记。厚重的橡木大门倒卧腐朽，苔藓蔓生——在它们倒下的断裂处，仿佛还能看见远古的敌人破门攻入，将要塞付之一炬。
The foreboding remains of a crumbling wall of mortared stone, likely centuries old, rise from the earth like towering grave markers. The ruins still bear black stains where flames scorched the stone. The massive oaken gates lie rotting, overgrown with moss—broken where they fell as an ancient enemy breached the keep and set it to the torch.

I Cast Wall Of Fire From My Helm Of Bril.name:
我从辉光头盔中施放《火墙术》
I Cast Wall Of Fire From My Helm Of Brilliance

Text.text:
我的头盔如今少了一颗红宝石，原本镶着它的金属设定此刻空空如也，而那颗宝石躺在我摊开的掌心，平平托起。我将红宝石托住，眼看它崩解成尘，我的手掌染上砖红的色泽，随之灼热起来。我就这样托着它，按我想要的方式塑形那道火墙，并将它对准我希望它矗立的地方。
My helmet is minus one ruby now, its metal setting where it used to be now empty, and the stone rests in my open hand, held out flat. As the ruby disintegrates, my hand takes on the hue of brick and heats up. I hold it now as I want the wall of fire to be shaped, and aim to where I want it to stand.

Plea From A Corrupted King.name:
来自堕落之王的哀求
Plea From A Corrupted King

Text.text:
“你想坐上这王座吗？你以为这很容易吗——以为这些来自财富的微小安逸，就能抵过统御者的重担？我下令处死过孩子。每个国王都这么做过。这是维持秩序的一部分。你觉得你也能做到吗？”
“Do you wish to sit on this throne? Do you believe it to be easy, that these small comforts of wealth outweigh the burden of leadership? I have ordered the deaths of children. Every king has. It is part of maintaining order. Do you think you could do the same?”

High Elf Changing Appearance To Spring.name:
高等精灵·变换外貌：春之容
High Elf Changing Appearance To Spring

Text.text:
精灵仿佛褪去了多年的年代与忧思。它每踏过一寸青绿，石南、番红花、水仙与郁金香便在周身抽芽绽放。精灵的肌肤与发丝染上新芽般的翠意与半透明茎秆的清亮。白昼里，歌声与笑容从未停歇；入睡后，顽皮的梦在心底生根发芽。

~ 由 Galvatron 构想

The elf seems to have lost years of age and care. Each step across the green sprouts heather, crocus, daffodils, and tulips around them. The elf’s skin and hair take on the new green of buds and translucent stems. Song and smile are constants by day, and mischievous dreams take root during sleep.

~ Envisioned by Galvatron

Sundries From An Archangel.name:
来自大天使的杂物
Sundries From An Archangel

Text.text:
被杀死的大天使蜷卧在一堆折叠的羽翼之间，羽毛如雪般飘落。它的光辉已然褪去，那股诡异的无形之态也凝结成一具庞大而沉实的尸身——而在它长袍的口袋里，仅有一件尘世之物：一颗两英寸大小的黄铜球，滚动时会发出低沉而悦耳的铃鸣。
The slain archangel lies in a crush of folded wings, feathers drifting like snow. Its radiance has faded, and its uncanny formlessness has resolved into a solid, prodigious corpse—one with only a single worldly possession in a pocket of its robe: a two-inch brass ball that makes a low and pleasant peal when rolled around.

这只蝎子之骇人，丝毫不亚于任何邪异的怪物；它的体型大如一头肉牛，周身仿佛散发着森然的威胁。那对夸张巨螯在钳制猎物的同时也能对血肉造成巨大的伤害，而你的目光终究还是被它那条长尾末端的狰狞毒刺所攫住——毒液正从刺尖滴落。
As horrifying to behold as any eldritch monstrosity, the size of this scorpion, as large as a beef cow, positively radiates menace. Featuring oversized claws capable of doing great damage to flesh even as it grapples, your gaze is nonetheless drawn to the wicked stinger atop its long tail, dripping with poison.

Quip About The Difficulty Of Doing Good.name:
调侃行善之难
Quip About The Difficulty Of Doing Good

Text.text:
“我总觉得我们每次想做点好事，身边的人最后都会变成尸体。这不是指责，只是个观察。”
“I feel like every time we try to do something nice, the people around us end up dead. Not a criticism, just an observation.”

Portal To The Elemental Plane Of Wind.name:
通往风元素位面的传送门
Portal To The Elemental Plane Of Wind

Text.text:
你站在一处高耸悬崖的边缘，崖高足以让坠落夺走你的性命。阳光下有道微微闪烁的光幕——至少，你希望那就是传送门。你深吸一口气，迈步踏出崖沿。
You stand at the edge of a high cliff, high enough for the fall to kill you. The portal shimmers slightly in the sun—at least, you hope it is the portal. You take a deep breath and step off.

他的握手坚实有力，掌心覆着雪豹皮毛，指尖却带着灼烧后的焦痕。他背着探险者的行囊，塞满切割好的肉块，肩上则是扣着一副胸甲，其上烙印着燃烧的铁拳标志。他双手握着一柄巨槌，槌头满布符文刻痕，外覆钢甲，两端各嵌着一枚蓝色晶体，寒光流转，仿佛整柄武器都是从冰里凿出来的。槌套上刻着字母 ILD 与一枚火焰符文。他目光越过眼前，凝望着不远不近的虚空，尾巴轻轻摆动，像是被某段记忆缠住了魂。

~ Played by a Hero with

His handshake is firm, covered in snow leopard fur and singed at the fingertips. He carries an explorer’s pack, laden with cuts of meat and shouldered over a breastplate emblazoned with a flaming fist. In his hands is a maul, the head covered with runic carvings, sheathed in steel, a blue crystal glistening at either end of it as though it were carved from ice. On the sheath are the initials ILD and a rune of fire. He stares into the middle distance, tail switching, as if he is haunted by a memory.

~ Played by a Hero with

I Cast Command.name:
我施放【命令术】
I Cast Command

Text.text:
我以奥术之力的威权吐出那唯一的词。我的目标只挣扎了一瞬，随即浑身一软。他们听见了，他们明白了，并竭尽所能遵从我的命令。
I speak the single word with the authority of arcane power. My target struggles for only a moment, then they go slack. They hear, they understand, and they do their best to follow my command.

Sundries From A Planetar.name:
来自行星天使的杂货
Sundries From A Planetar

Text.text:
这名天界使徒一动不动，空洞地仰望着上方——也许在死亡的痉挛中，他想起了那片他称之为故乡的天域。他那如海玻璃般的皮肤已然蒙上雾翳，曾经雕琢般完美的肌肉也因干枯而萎缩。你在这具尸体上翻不出任何硬币、护甲或武器——甚至连从他背后伸展出的天鹅般翅膀上，大多数羽毛也都被人拔走了。
The planetar, motionless, stares blankly upward—perhaps, in the throes of death, he had thought of the realm he called home. His sea-glass skin has fogged and his perfectly chiseled muscles have dwindled with desiccation. You do not find any coin, armor, or weapon to be scrounged from this corpse—even most of the feathers have been plucked from the swanlike wings that sprout from his back.

宝石粉尘覆满了这间拥挤却令人舒心的店铺每一寸角落。巨大的玻璃展示柜沿墙一字排开，层层搁板上陈列着各式各样、雕琢精美的宝石：有些你一眼就认得，有些你只能冒着猜测的危害去判断，还有几颗你甚至无法确定是否属于这个位面。光线被这些熠熠生辉的晶体棱面四散打碎，在折射与反射间洒向四面八方；而在店铺的核心，一名长着弯曲犄角的提夫林正小心而娴熟地为一块巨大的祖母绿切割切面。他抬眼一瞥，目光透过一连串放大镜显得诡异地扭曲，然后说道：“马上就来！随意看看！”

~ Envisioned by GrantM

Gem dust coats every surface in this cluttered but pleasant shop. Large glass display cases line the walls, their shelves lined with beautifully carved gemstones of every variety. Some you recognize, others you’d have to hazard a guess, and a few you can’t be sure are even of this plane of existence. Light scatters in every direction, reflected and refracted through the prismatic structures of these gleaming gems, and at the shop’s heart, a tiefling with curving horns carefully, expertly cuts the facets on a large emerald. They glance up, eyes strangely distorted through a series of magnifying lenses, and say, “Be with you in just a moment! Feel free to look around!”

~ Envisioned by GrantM

Detected By An Awakened Tree.name:
被觉醒之树察觉
Detected By An Awakened Tree

Text.text:
伴随着一声低沉的呻吟，仿佛暴风中枝桠震颤，苏醒的树木缓缓转向注视着你；它转身时，零落的叶片轻轻飘颤，悄然落地。尽管树干上并无面孔，你仍能感到这生物的目光落在你身上，正如一片叶子感受阳光般清晰。
With a deep groan, like the shaking of boughs in a storm, the awakened tree turns to regard you, stray leaves fluttering softly to the ground as it does so. Though the trunk bears no face, you feel the creature’s attention upon you, as a leaf might feel the sun.

Hacker Executes Attack Program In The Ne.name:
黑客在网域中执行攻击程序：武士主题
Hacker Executes Attack Program In The Net: Samurai Theme

Text.text:
黑客横扫般一挥，启动攻击程序，同时拔出一把赛博武士刀，蓄势待发迎向敌人。刀刃弧度宛如数字地平线，挥动间拖曳出霓虹光痕，如同彗星掠过。
With a sweeping motion, the hacker activates their attack program and draws a cyber katana, making ready to face their foes. The blade curves like the digital horizon, leaving a trail of neon in its wake like a passing comet.

Enthusiastic Sharing From Cane User.name:
拄杖者的热情分享
Enthusiastic Sharing From Cane User

Text.text:
“我发誓，这会成为我参加的每场宴会上的谈资！工艺精妙绝伦。分量也恰到好处——用来痛揍任何冒头的家伙，再合适不过。”

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

“I swear, it’ll be the talk of every party I attend! Such exquisite craftsmanship. A nice weight as well—very good for thrashing any upstarts.”

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

I Cast Fire Shield Using Phosphorus.name:
我以磷施放火焰护盾
I Cast Fire Shield Using Phosphorus

Text.text:
我一边在指间捻起磷粉，一边吟诵法术的字句，凝神召来守护的火焰。抬手在身周划出一道宽广的圆弧，缕缕橙色薄焰自肌肤上浮现，旋转交织成一股翻卷的火焰涡流。
Pinching the phosphorus between my fingers as I intone the words of the spell, I focus my mind on summoning the protective flames. I draw my hand in a wide circle around myself as wispy orange flames form over my body in a swirling vortex.

Wild Magic Surge: Fright.name:
狂野魔法涌动：惊惧
Wild Magic Surge: Fright

Text.text:
你自身巫术的狂乱残影在回摆之际反噬到你。那股魔法如同不祥的寒潮般冲刷过你，满是惊惧。你环顾四周，目光落在第一个生物身上时，便本能地被一种令人神智麻木的恐怖彻底攫住。
A thrashing vestige of your own sorcery catches you on the backswing. The magic washes over you like dread. You look around, and the first creature you lay eyes upon instinctively fills you with mind-numbing terror.

Adult Blue Dragon On Dune.name:
沙丘上的成年蓝龙
Adult Blue Dragon On Dune

Text.text:
一条巨龙盘踞在一座巍峨沙丘之巅，宛如这片干涸荒原与割裂般沙漠狂风的蔚蓝君王。它的巨鳞闪耀着润泽的钴蓝光辉，烈日折映之下，空气在其周身以斑驳的波纹微微颤动；盾牌般巨大的眼眸则闪烁着傲然的威仪，仿佛蓄着体内深处翻涌的风暴。它那遮天的双翼缓缓舒展，在流沙之上投下广袤阴影；这头蓝色巨兽咧嘴一笑——露出弯刀般的獠牙，在日光中森白夺目。
A dragon sits atop a colossal dune, an azure ruler of this arid waste and these scything desert winds. Its huge scales are a lustrous cobalt, air shimmering about them in sun dappled waves, while shield-sized eyes shine with haughty majesty, charged with the storm deep within. The gargantuan wings unfold, casting vast shadows over the shifting sands, as the blue behemoth smiles—revealing teeth like scimitars gleaming white in the sunlight.

I Cast Circle Of Death As A Wizard.name:
我以法师之身施放【死亡之环】
I Cast Circle Of Death As A Wizard

Text.text:
我将法杖猛然砸向地面，吐出湮灭的咒词。一声幽咽随之升起，周遭空气陡然凝滞，裹满阴魂般的薄雾。这团迷雾自我身边奔涌而出，化作一道球形扩散的雾墙——其上浮现出痛苦扭曲的灵体面孔，饥渴地啃噬着生者的精魄。
I slam my staff down and speak the words of unmaking. A moan rises, and the air grows thick around me with ghostly mist. This fog races away from me in a spherical wall of pained, spectral faces, hungry for the essence of the living.

Three Days Of Travel By Foot Through Jun.name:
徒步穿越丛林的三日旅行
Three Days Of Travel By Foot Through Jungle

Text.text:
你在丛林中艰难跋涉，四周生命奔涌不息。馥郁的风掠过树梢，枝叶沙沙作响，你一靠近，灌木丛里便有生灵仓皇窜逃。第一天，你沿着灌木层栖居的动物踩出的小径旅行，但很快便被迫挥砍藤蔓与盘结虬曲的树根，硬生生劈出一条通道。昆虫不知疲倦的嗡鸣一路相随，远处传来吼猴粗哑的啼叫。第二天，你踏上一棵横跨河面的巨大倒木，途中脚下一滑，差点失足坠入水中。但你仍咬牙前行，第三天黎明到来时，你发现丛林在你周围渐渐稀薄。

~ Spac3cowboyy 构想

You trudge through the jungle, life teeming all around you. A fragrant wind rustles the trees, and creatures flee through the underbrush at your approach. On the first day, you travel by way of paths left by creatures dwelling in the shrub layer, but eventually find yourself forced to hack through vines and gnarled roots to clear passage. The incessant buzzing of insects accompanies your trek, while howler monkeys hoot in the distance. On the second day, you cross a massive downed tree spanning a river, losing your footing at one point and almost taking a plunge. But you press on, and with the dawn of the third day you find the jungle thinning around you.

~ Envisioned by Spac3cowboyy

这座主楼曾是城堡统治家族的最后堡垒，如今却是一幅腐朽的写照。残破的墙垣再也提供不了任何庇护——既挡不住天气，也拦不住入侵者。屋顶与天花板无休无止地渗漏着。屋内陈设无论当年多么柔韧华贵，如今也不过是最好被水渍浸染，最糟则彻底朽烂。霉菌与真菌的暗黑斑痕点缀其间，遍布破烂的帷幕与地毯。
Where this keep was once a redoubt for the ruling family of the castle, it is now a picture of decay. The ruined walls offer no protection, neither from the weather, nor against invaders. The roof and ceilings leak incessantly. Any furnishings within, however supple or sumptuous they were in their prime, have been water-stained at best or rotted away completely at worst. Dark splotches of molds and fungus decorate the ragged curtains and rugs throughout.

你的道路将你引向山腰间一处仿佛隐秘洼地的所在：峭壁如弧般宽阔地高高耸起，将一汪水体环抱其中。细窄的溪流自崖顶倾泻而下，化作一束白色水羽，注入这片湛蓝得耀眼的水潭。它看上去纯净得令人心动、清冽得仿佛能洗去尘埃——但想必冰寒刺骨。
Your path takes you to a sort of dell in the mountain’s side, where cliff walls rise high in a wide curve around a body of water. A thin stream cascades down the cliff in a white plume to feed this brilliant blue pool. It looks pure and invitingly fresh, but it must be icy cold.

I Cast Fog Cloud From My Staff Of Frost.name:
我从寒霜法杖中施放《迷雾术》
I Cast Fog Cloud From My Staff Of Frost

Text.text:
我念出命令词，一缕冰冷的薄雾自法杖杖首倾泻而出，蜿蜒着朝我的目标游去，宛如朦胧的雾蛇。我的呼吸在面前凝成白雾，我感到细小的水珠掠过脸颊，它们被魔法悬停在寒冷的空气中，缓缓漂浮而过。
I speak the command word and a chill mist pours from the head of the staff, meandering toward my target like a nebulous serpent. My breath clouds the air before me and I feel droplets of precipitation on my cheek as they float by, magically suspended in the cold air.

水面平静得近乎祥和。波浪轻轻起伏，在摇曳的纹路里映出碎光。水声拍岸，抚平你紧绷的神经。
The water is placid, almost peaceful. The waves undulate, reflecting light in wavering patterns. The lapping water calms your nerves.

Skeletons Discovering Dungeon Exit.name:
骷髅们发现了地城出口
Skeletons Discovering Dungeon Exit

Text.text:
古老的关节咯吱作响，骷髅们从地牢中现身，第一次仰起脖颈望向天空。它们空洞的眼窝追随着头顶欢快掠过的飞鸟；一阵宜人的微风拂过森森白骨，将沉积了数个世纪的尘埃吹散到空中——仿佛正象征着它们新得的自由。

~ Dwayne 于 Discord

Ancient joints creak as the skeletons emerge from the dungeon and crane their necks toward the sky for the first time. Their hollow eyes watch birds flit joyfully overhead as a pleasant breeze washes over their bones, blowing centuries of dust into the air—as if symbolizing their newfound freedom.

~ Dwayne on Discord

Hotshot Street Racer.name:
炫技街头赛车手
Hotshot Street Racer

Text.text:
一个神情凶悍的混血男人穿着剪掉袖子的上衣，戴着红色赛车手套，斜倚在一辆改装得花里胡哨的街车上，满口金牙间叼着一根牙签。他周围簇拥着一群崇拜者，谄笑着、咯咯偷乐。那名赛车手显然很享受这种注目，油亮的鳄鱼皮靴一下一下轻敲着路面。一副永久墨镜被嫁接在他的脸上。
A mean-looking mestizo in cut-off sleeves and red racing gloves leans against a tricked-out street car, a toothpick dangling from a mouth full of gold teeth. He’s surrounded by a group of admirers, fawning and giggling. The racer seems to be enjoying the attention, tapping his slick crocodile-skin boots against the pavement. A pair of permanent sunglasses have been grafted onto his face.

他那只祖母绿的独眼一边盯着你，一边把你从头到脚量了个遍。矮人砰砰逼近，木腿一下一下敲出节奏，手指则在胸甲前方的旋钮上轻轻拨弄。褪色的纹身与伤疤之下，一股炽烈的生命力让他那撮如野火般竖起的头发与同样张扬的胡须更显凶悍。他的危险气息甚至盖过肩带上晃荡的短管霰弹枪——而他背包那自发的扭动与挪移，更让你心头发紧。

~ Played by Bobby Boom with

His single emerald eye does double duty as the dwarf sizes you up. He thumps forward, pegleg striking rhythmically, fingers tinkering with the knobs on the front of his breastplate. Beneath the faded tattoos and scars, an intense vitality enhances his spiky strip of wildfire hair and matching beard. His mere presence, more than the sawed-off shotgun that dangles from his shoulder strap, radiates danger—and the autonomous shifting of his backpack sets you on edge.

~ Played by Bobby Boom with

Loot From A Roc Nest.name:
巨鹏巢穴的战利品
Loot From A Roc Nest

Text.text:
在精致马车的残骸与被啃得精光的白骨之间，你瞥见了几样引人注目的东西：一只捆扎着的行李箱，表面被撕开数道深长裂口，像是遭到某种暴烈的“检查”般被猛啄过。你将它打开，露出一排药水瓶——不过其中一些已被巨鹏那强悍的喙之力震得粉碎。你还发现一只深色木箱，金箍束边，压在一只裂开的车轮下。箱上不见挂锁，你轻易便能掀开箱盖，里面是一堆宝石与钱币杂乱混在一起——或许是某笔本该送进银行、却再也没能抵达的存款。
Amid the shambles of fine carriages and bones stripped of meat you spy some interesting items. A strapped trunk with large gashes, seemingly pecked into as a form of violent inspection, which opens to reveal a collection of potion bottles—though some of them were shattered from the force of the roc’s powerful beak. You also find a chest of dark wood, banded with gold, lying under a cracked wagon wheel. No padlock in sight, you can open it easily, and find a cache of gems and coins all mixed together—perhaps a deposit that never made its way to a bank.

Royal's Speech To An Arrogant Heir.name:
王室对傲慢继承人的训诫
Royal's Speech To An Arrogant Heir

Text.text:
“我可曾告诉过你，我是如何成为国王的？那年我十四岁，父王正外出巡游城堡周围的领地。新近的粮税把农夫们激得怨气冲天，他以为走到他们中间，或许能唤回一点忠诚。那天傍晚，他们把他抬回城堡——一把刀还卡在他的脖颈里。那一刻，我看见的不是国王，只是一个男人：惊惶失措，拼命抓住任何能逃离等待他的结局的可能。对我们而言，税不过是小事，是筹措战争与贸易的手段；可对他们——在外头那些人——它可能意味着孩子挨饿，牲畜成群死去。他们的痛苦必须被纳入考量，他们的话语必须被倾听。给他们希望，否则每一个替我们沐浴的仆役、每一个在我们睡梦中守夜的卫兵，都可能成为潜在的杀人者。”

~ 一位英雄所构想

“Did I ever tell you how I became king? I was fourteen, and my father was out touring the grounds around the castle. The recent grain tax had been riling up the farmers and he thought walking among them might inspire a bit of a loyalty. That evening, he was brought into the castle with a blade in his neck. At that moment I did not see a king, just a man, scared and grasping for any escape from what awaited him. To us, a tax is trivial thing, a way to pay for wars and trade, but to them, out there, it can mean their children go hungry and their livestock perish. Their pain must be considered and their words heeded. Give them hope, or every servant that bathes us and guard that watches us in our sleep becomes our potential murderer.”

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Cast Incendiary Cloud.name:
我施放【焚云术】
I Cast Incendiary Cloud

Text.text:
火山原始而狂暴的怒焰在我体内翻涌，我的双眼燃起神秘的烈火。我吟诵来自元素界的古老原初之语，唤出一团翻滚的刺鼻黑烟，裹挟着旋舞的余烬，炽热如巨龙之息。
The raw, primal fury of a volcano rages within me as my eyes burn with mystical fire. Intoning the ancient, primordial words from the elemental realms, I summon forth a roiling cloud of acrid, black smoke laced with swirling embers as hot as dragon fire.

Tournament Pageant Of Royal Children.name:
王室幼嗣的锦标盛典
Tournament Pageant Of Royal Children

Text.text:
一群娇生惯养的孩子涌入竞技场，灵巧地避开一大堆粪便。男孩女孩们身着最华美的衣饰，沿着看台游行而过时向观众挥手致意。他们欢快的身影为这场本该严肃的盛事增添了一抹天真与俏皮的接触。
A swarm of pampered children makes their way into the arena, adroitly avoiding a large pile of dung. The boys and girls, dressed in their finest attire, wave to the spectators as they parade past the stands. Their joyful presence adds a touch of innocence and playfulness to an otherwise serious affair.

这些纹身是用笔而非枪刺出来的，墨水则由一种花细细研磨而成——那花会在夜里自愿生长，开在古冢之上、墓穴之前。墨水瓶的玻璃被黑暗魔法浸透，即便冷却定型后，那魔法仍在其中冒泡、蠕动、爬行。肌肤是这墨水唯一的纸页，而承载它的人，将通过毛孔被喂入力量与苦痛。
The tattoos are made with a pen, not a gun, and the ink carefully ground from a flower that grows voluntarily by night over barrows and in front of crypts. The glass of the inkpots is infused with dark magic that bubbles and crawls through it even after it is cooled to shape. Skin is the only page for this ink, and the one who wears it is fed through the pores with might and suffering.

Half-elf Noble Learns Of Secret Fey Inhe.name:
半精灵贵族得知自己继承了隐秘的妖精血脉
Half-elf Noble Learns Of Secret Fey Inheritance

Text.text:
半精灵张口欲致意，却把话又咽了回去；在妖精女王面前，那抹带笑的神情也不由一滞。“欢迎你，妖血之裔，纵然你对自己肩负的责任与对我们族人的义务依旧浑然不觉。”女王伸出手来。“别怕。你不会再继续无知地呜咽。那些因你混血出身而轻蔑你的人，很快便会在你面前颤然退缩。来吧，在你握住远古的月刃、以高等精灵领主之名迈向你的命定之前，让我们谈谈等待着你的试炼。”

~ 由 Vahlaron “无畏者” 构想

The half-elf’s mouth opens in greeting, then swallows the words, mirthful smile faltering in the presence of the fey queen. “Be welcome, feyblood, though you be blind to your duties and your obligations to our people.” The queen holds out her hand. “Fear not. You shall not remain an ignorant mewling. Those who despised you for your mixed lineage will soon quail in your presence. Let us speak of the trials awaiting you, before you grasp the ancient Moonblade and rise to your destiny as a high elven lord.”

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron "The Fearless"

Gala: Cleaning Up.name:
盛会：善后清理
Gala: Cleaning Up

Text.text:
大多数赴宴的宾客都已仓皇逃散，只留下仆役们收拾这满地残破。要花上好几个小时，才能把这些厅室的狼藉清理干净，勉强恢复几分往日的体面，而仆役们看起来却刻意放慢了手脚。他们的劳作在宴会开始前便已展开，如今也仍在宴席散尽后久久延续。
Most of the party guests have fled, leaving just the servants to pick up the pieces. It will take hours to clean the mess and restore these chambers to some semblance of normality, and the servants seem to be taking it slow. Their work began long before the party, and now it continues long after, too.

Core Spawn Crawler.name:
核心孳生爬行者
Core Spawn Crawler

Text.text:
这头畸形生物披着一层巨型虫类的甲壳：灰白、长角、节节分明，覆以坚硬的几丁质。甲板之间的缝隙与腹侧则被暗红的肉质填满，并沿着它四条瘦长的肢体蔓延。躯干向后收束成一条布满尖刺的尾巴，尾端是一枚弯曲的毒刺。另一端则垂着一张獠牙森然的巨口，伸出又长又锋利的颚钳。虫足末端也长着相似却更小的钩爪，使这生物以一种不自然的敏捷在其上疾行。
This abomination has the shell of a monstrous bug: gray, horned, segmented, and chitinous. Reddish flesh fills the gaps between its plates and along the underside of the body and its four lanky limbs. The trunk tapers into a spiked tail tipped with a curved stinger. A fanged maw with long, sharp mandibles hangs on the opposite end. Similar but smaller hooks tip the insectile legs, on which the creature moves with unnatural agility.

这只奇异生物鼓胀而佝偻的背上，点缀着一片片骨质的棕色鳞片，体型与形状都像钱币一般。它的身躯轮廓很像海狸：短腿、长脚；但它没有宽大的尾巴，取而代之的是一条狭长如鞭的附肢，末端长着鱼一般的鳍。小小的头缩在身体前端，挤成一张昆虫般的面孔，几乎被那对巨大而蓬松的触角完全遮住——就像你在飞蛾身上会见到的那样。它有战犬般的体型，却怎么看都像是无害的……
Bony brown scales the size and shape of coins stipple the bulbous, hunched back of this strange creature. In shape its body looks much like a beaver, with short legs and long feet, but instead of a broad tail, it has a narrow whip-like appendage tipped with a fishlike fin. A little head is scrunched into an insectoid face virtually obscured by enormous, fluffy antennae—as you might see on a moth. It’s the size of a war dog, but it looks harmless enough…

Enigmatic Drow's Introduction.name:
神秘卓尔的登场介绍
Enigmatic Drow's Introduction

Text.text:
卓尔那暗灰如烬的肌肤光滑无瑕，却不见岁月痕迹。她祖母绿的眼眸上方，仅有一缕冷白发丝若隐若现，忽然便与你对上视线。“安娜拉·艾德沃德。”她银色的嗓音在你耳畔回荡，仿佛自遥远之地传来的回声。她身着一件黑色丝绸的排扣衬衫，贴合身形，却将所有秘密都完好无损地藏住。深色皮裤收束在翻折的皮靴靴口之上。“很高兴认识你。”
The drow’s dark ash skin is smooth, yet ageless. There is the barest hint of stark white hair above her emerald eyes, and she meets your gaze suddenly. “Annara Elderword.” Her silvery voice resonates in your ears like an echo from far away. She is dressed in a button-down blouse of black silk that hugs her form but leaves every mystery intact. Dark leather pants end at the tops of turned-down leather boots. “It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance.”

那道人形身影乍看再寻常不过，可当你瞥见那层爬行类鳞片的湿亮光泽——在他们的肤色上泛着虹彩——这份判断便迅速崩解。他们以一双金色的眼睛审视着你，竖直的瞳孔投来令人不安却又勾人的凝视。随后，他们的唇微微分开，獠牙在最短的一瞬间一闪而过。
The humanoid figure appears typical at first, but that assumption quickly fades as you spy the telltale glisten of reptilian scales, iridescent against the tone of their skin. They regard you with golden eyes, the pupils oriented vertically to create an unnerving yet alluring gaze. Their lips part, flashing fangs for the barest moment.

Divine Crypt Of A God Of Death.name:
死神神祇的神圣墓窟
Divine Crypt Of A God Of Death

Text.text:
穿过拱顶的长厅是一条莫比乌斯环，在灰色大地深处黑白翻转、再度回旋。踏入其中，关于时代与空间的一切概念都会被终结。进入地窖需先穿过一座陵寝：两侧相对各有一扇门，却都通往同一间墓室。一扇是雪花石膏之门，门前立着锻金栅栏；一扇是缟玛瑙之门，门前立着锻铁栅栏。其中一扇对你上了锁，另一扇敞开着。
The hall through the vaults is a Möbius strip, twisting black-to-white and back again within the gray earth. Walking through it puts an end to all notions of time and space. One enters the crypt through a mausoleum with two doors on opposing sides, each leading to the same chamber. There is the alabaster door, behind a gate of wrought gold. There is the onyx door, behind a gate of wrought iron. One is locked to you. One is open.

The Thirsty Thresher.name:
饥渴的脱粒者
The Thirsty Thresher

Text.text: 一把长柄镰刀从这家酒馆门上方探出，柄上挂着一块色彩鲜艳的木招牌，写明此地名号：口渴的打谷者。建筑后方有一片宽阔的露台，摆满了桌椅长凳，供人露天用餐，也许还会承办镇上的其他活动。尽管那镰刀刀刃锈迹斑斑，这里依旧显得亲切温暖，像家一样招人靠近。 A scythe projects out over the door to this tavern, and a gaily painted wooden sign hanging from its handle declares the place: The Thirsty Thresher. A broad deck behind the building is covered with tables and benches for outdoor eating and perhaps for other town functions. It looks welcoming and homey, despite the rusty blade of that scythe.

宁静的气息萦绕在这位牧师身旁，仿佛只要她在，一切便都安好。她温柔的眼神承诺能让人暂时从尘世的烦忧中歇息——仅限一个时代——而她以从容笃定的步伐行走在神殿的长廊间。她的长袍洁白无瑕，配以她神圣感召的璀璨金饰，更显肃穆夺目。
A sense of peace surrounds the cleric, as if all is well in her presence. Her soft eyes promise respite from the woes of the world—for a time—and she walks the halls of the temple with comfortable surety. Her robes are an immaculate white, accentuated by the shining gold accoutrements of her holy calling.

I Release A Wave Of Terror From My Mace.name:
我从恐惧钉头锤中释放出一阵恐怖浪潮
I Release A Wave Of Terror From My Mace Of Terror

Text.text:
我钉头锤的锤首是一张骷髅面孔，空洞而宽大的眼眶里盛满了惊惶。锤柄由三根编织般纠缠的铁杆铸成蛇形，蛇口大张，托举着那颗怒目般逼视的骷髅头。锻造的铁色乌黑、未曾抛光；挥击时沉重如坠。可它最可怖的力量在我将它高高举起、以意志驱使之时骤然抽袭——逼得敌人惊奔溃逃，哪怕逃向任何地方，也绝不敢再靠近我，以及我钉头锤那骇人的性相。
The head of my mace is a skeletal face, with wide, eyeless sockets full of panic. The handle is three braided iron rods molded into snakes, their mouths open and holding up its glaring skull. The forge work is black and unpolished; its strike is heavy. But its greatest power lashes out when I hold it up and will it to send my enemies into flight, running anywhere but closer to me and my mace’s horrific aspect.

I Bind My Prisoner With My Dimensional S.name:
我用异界镣铐锁住我的俘虏
I Bind My Prisoner With My Dimensional Shackles

Text.text:
我以极尽谨慎的步伐逼近那已失去反抗能力的敌人，缓缓将金色的镣铐扣上他们的手腕。七彩光芒骤然一闪，束缚随即锁死，将其牢牢钉在这片现实位面之中。镣铐发出柔和而不绝的低鸣，魔法沿着刻在耀目金属上的符文循环流转，声息如潮，绵延不止。
Approaching my incapacitated foe with utmost care, I slowly clamp the golden shackles about their wrists. With a prismatic flash, the bonds lock, binding them to this plane of reality. A soft, continuous hum emanates from the manacles as the magic cycles through the runes etched into the gleaming metal.

警示灯狂闪，海运投递无人机在海上风暴中挣扎前行——一抹微小的黄色身影被浪头反复拍打。它的发射器尖啸着，跨越所有带宽宣告：它正载着送往偏远研究站的关键补给——能否签收，关乎生死。所幸凭借坚固的机体与先进的导航系统，它仍在滔天巨浪与怒号狂风中艰难推进。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Warning lights blazing, the Sea-Haul delivery drone fights through a storm at sea, a tiny yellow form battered by waves. Its emitters scream, across all bandwidths, that it carries vital supplies to a remote research station—receipt being a matter of life or death. Luckily, with its sturdy frame and advanced navigation system, it manages to make headway despite the towering swells and howling winds.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Umber Hulk With Hunched Shoulders.name:
驼背的暗褐巨甲虫
Umber Hulk With Hunched Shoulders

Text.text:
厚重的外骨骼甲片覆满全身，边缘勾勒着粗硬的黑色毛簇。它耸起的肩膀连着弓起的脊背，一道厚实的隆脊护住颈后。两片凶狠的颚钳自面部突出，唾沫与涎液碎点洒落在脚下。弯钩般的利爪嵌在手端与张开的阔足尖上，既能刨开泥土，也能撕穿血肉。
Thick plates of exoskeleton outlined with coarse tufts of black hair coat its body. Its hunched shoulders lead to an arched back with a thick ridge shielding its neck. Two vicious mandibles protrude from its face, dotting the ground below with bits of spittle and drool. Hooked claws mark the tips of its hands and its wide-splayed feet, perfect for digging through earth and flesh alike.

男孩凌乱不梳的头发衬得他脸色惨白得刺眼。两只眼下黑影如淤痕般绽开，嘴唇干裂起皮。那张带着婴儿肥的稚嫩面孔惹人怜悯，可当你走近，才看见他小小身躯后藏着的古怪机关——像是一道陷阱，牵连着一串刀刃，刃上锈迹斑斑，凝着未洗净的血污。孩子陶醉于你骤然升起的惊骇，神色随之阴沉。血色漫上他的眼白，他干裂的唇瓣咧开，露出如碎裂玻璃般的獠牙。肮脏的指甲扭曲拉长，化作撕扯的利爪，朝你猛然划来。
The boy’s pallor is stark against his shock of uncombed hair. Dark rings bloom under each eye and his lips are cracked and dry. His cherubic regard invokes sympathy, but as you approach, you notice the odd mechanism he hides behind his tiny body. It looks like a snare connected to a series of blades rusted with unwashed blood. The child revels in your sudden horror and his face darkens. Blood fills his eyes and his cracked lips open to reveal fangs like shards of broken glass. His dirty fingernails form into raking claws that slash toward you.

Missile Defense Platform In The Canopy O.name:
巨树树冠间的导弹防御平台
Missile Defense Platform In The Canopy Of Giant Trees

Text.text:
在这棵树栖泰坦繁茂的树冠间，一座怪异而棱角分明的平台夺人目光。导弹炮台披覆着翠绿的伪装，伏踞于树梢之上，唯有一阵轻柔的嗡鸣泄露其存在——它正扫视四方，搜寻威胁。
In the leafy canopy of the arboreal titan, a strange angular platform draws the eye. Cloaked in verdant camouflage, the missile battery squats in the treetop, a gentle whirring the only indication of its presence as it scans for threats.

Fomorian With Scar.name:
带疤的弗摩里安
Fomorian With Scar

Text.text:
巨人那起伏如涛的躯体上，每一束肌肉都清晰分明，在粗粝的皮肤之下坚硬如千锤百炼的钢铁。奇异的兽皮拼成这生物的护甲，黄与金的鳞片被打制成一块块出人意料地精工细作的甲片。巨人的目光冰冷而不眨，横贯宽阔面庞的参差疤痕更为其凶威添上一笔。
Every muscle in the giant’s rippling body is clearly defined, and as hard as worked steel beneath its rugged skin. Strange hides make up the creature’s armor, scales of yellow and gold fashioned into surprisingly well-crafted pieces. The giant’s gaze is cold and unflinching, and the ragged scar cutting across their broad features adds to their fearsome image.

Ancient Palm Tree.name:
古老的棕榈树
Ancient Palm Tree

Text.text:
一株巨型（体型）的棕榈自大地拔地而起，藤蔓般纤细的根须纠结着铺展、钻入泥土。它那巨硕的树干宽到足以包裹整片棕榈小林；树皮呈鳞片般的质感，色泽从土褐渐变到蓝灰，再褪至骨白。树冠的繁密羽状叶如奢华的爆裂盛放；叶色自上方的明亮翠绿，过渡到下方的浅褐，并沉沉下垂。低处枝叶因沉甸甸的椰枣果串而下陷。那一簇簇红橙色的荚果间，你能看见各色昆虫的移动，爬行其上，啃咬着果肉的甘甜。
A palm tree of gargantuan size rises from the earth, tendril-thin roots tangling over and into the ground. The width of its massive trunk could encapsulate an entire copse of palm trees, the scalelike texture of the bark ranging from soil brown, to bluish gray, to bone white. Its voluminous head of fronds is like a luxuriant explosion; hues of the leaves change from bright green near the top to a light tan and drooping near the bottom. The lower branches sag with the weight of hefty date clusters. Within these bundles of reddish-orange pods, you can see the movement of various insects crawling over and nibbling at the sweet flesh of the fruit.

柱廊街区是咒术师学院的创始者们创造的魔法次元夹层：一条拜占庭式的拱廊，黄砂岩巨柱林立，其间分布着决斗场、银行、商铺、旅店与家族小酒馆。整座隐修之地藏在约旦佩特拉遗迹之后的一处洞窟深处。学院学生会获准领到一小瓶沙子；只要持有许可，沙子便会将他们送往苏丹街尽头的影门——这片次元的主干大道。另一些出行方式——在部分人眼中更为乖张——则包括沙暴与飞毯。
The Colonnade is the magical sub-realm created by the founders of Enchanter Academy, a Byzantine arcade of sandstone pillars, dueling grounds, a bank, shops, hotels, and family taverns. The entire retreat is hidden in a cave behind the Jordanian monument of Petra. Students of the academy are given a vial of sand with permission, which transports them to the shadow gate at the head of Sultan Street, the sub-realm’s main thoroughfare. Other methods of traveling—considered by some to be more eccentric—include sandstorm and flying carpet.

Blue Dragonborn Knight.name:
蓝龙裔骑士
Blue Dragonborn Knight

Text.text:
龙裔骑士伴随着凶残的战吼朝你猛冲而来，满口獠牙的巨颚大张。皇家蓝的鳞片覆满这名魁梧战士的长角头颅，其上刻着无数鏖战留下的伤痕；他们那面伤痕累累的木盾上，绘着一条天青色的巨龙。
The draconic knight rushes toward you with a savage battle cry, their fang-filled maw open wide. Royal-blue scales bearing the scars of many battles cover the hulking warrior’s horned head, and a cerulean dragon is painted across the battered wood of their shield.

Excerpt From Godwin-yardley’s Codex Of W.name:
摘自戈德温-亚德利的《魔杖法典》
Excerpt From Godwin-yardley’s Codex Of Wands

Text.text:
在魔杖的七大材质谱系与七十七种主型制式之间，其魔法精粹的形态学仍笼罩着一层迷雾。日耳曼与斯堪的纳维亚的林地与大地魔法，在法术机理上与非洲内陆诸国的制杖工艺迥然相异。热忱的杖学学者与制杖宗师们对魔杖魔法的本质各执一词，争论不休。
Among the seven material families and seventy-seven principal designs of wand, the morphology of their magical quintessence remains something of a mystery. Germanic and Scandinavian woodlands and earth magic express with quite different spell mechanics from, say, the wandcraft of African interior nations. Ardent scholars of wandology disagree with master wandcrafters on the essential nature of wand magic.

你忽然被一股诡异而侵入性的感觉吞没——仿佛有人从背后猛地攫住你。你还来不及弄明白发生了什么，四周便开始模糊扭曲；伴随着一阵怪异的嗡鸣，你发现自己正被抛掷着穿越宇宙，被迫逆着你的意志，被硬生生拽过时代与空间，去往……别的地方。

~ Sax构想

You're suddenly overtaken by a strange, invasive feeling—like being grabbed from behind. Before you can make any sense of it, your surroundings blur, and with a strange droning hum, you find yourself hurtling through the cosmos, yanked through time and space against your will to . . . somewhere else.

~ Envisioned by Sax

把这生物说成半人半牛，是对两者的侮辱。它那庞然身躯在体型与威势上更像食人魔。而它的头上虽生着巨大的牛角，铁环箍住的鼻口却以骇人的丑陋胜过任何野兽。它挥舞着一柄巨斧，看起来像把磨尖的犁铧绑在一根原木上。
To think of this creature as part man and part bull insults both. Its massive body better resembles an ogre both in size and stature. And while its head bears great bovine horns, its iron-ringed snout outstrips any animal in fearsome ugliness. It swings a huge axe, which looks like a sharpened ploughshare strapped to a log.

Rug Of Smothering.name:
闷缠地毯
Rug Of Smothering

Text.text:
你脚下那块肮脏、被蛀得千疮百孔的地毯忽然一抽，仿佛有人正想在你还站在上面时把它抖开。你大脑尚未理清发生了什么，地毯的四角已腾空而起，在你头顶扭结翻卷——刹那间将你裹住，闷入突如其来的黑暗。
The dingy moth-eaten carpet upon which you stand suddenly twitches, as if someone were attempting to shake it out while you’re atop it. As your brain tries to process this, the four corners of the rug rise into the air and twist above your head—smothering you in sudden darkness.

这名水手在海上多日缺乏淡水，浑身油污泥垢，散发着咸鱼、海水、酸橙与葛缕子的混杂气味。他朝船舷外清嗓啐了一口，随即转身回到岗位，拖拽绳索，协助调整船帆的位置。
Grimy from days at sea without fresh water and emitting the confusing scents of salted fish, seawater, lime, and caraway, the sailor hawks and spits over the side of the ship before going back to his work, hauling line as he helps to position the sail.

Deserted House: Inhabitants.name:
废弃宅邸：居住者
Deserted House: Inhabitants

Text.text:
你并不孤单。再也不容置疑。可你在屋内感到的那些存在，并非完全在场。它们仿佛栖居在墙壁之间的空间里，正如你一样，却又能穿透墙体、越过其界限；它们同样受制于实体屏障，就像你会被迷雾锁链般束缚。
You are not alone. There can no longer be any doubt. Yet the presences you sense in the house are not entirely present. They seem to inhabit the space between the walls, just as you do, but also pass through and beyond them, fettered by physical barriers as much as you could be chained by fog.

Wyrmling Emerges From Egg.name:
幼龙破壳而出
Wyrmling Emerges From Egg

Text.text:
蛋开始隆隆作响，左右摇晃，蛋壳上四处浮现出蛛网般的裂纹。一截好奇的爬行类吻端顶破壳面探了出来，鼻孔翕张，吸入了它跨越数百年生命里的第一口空气。紧接着，覆鳞的腿猛然蹬出，让这只生物在彻底破壳之前显得滑稽可笑。直到幼龙终于挣脱束缚，睁开那双硕大而探寻的眼睛，将它新世界的景象尽收眼底。

~ 由 Kazuma Bovino 在 Discord 上 构想

The egg rumbles, rocking from side to side as cracks begin to form all across the shell. A curious reptilian snout pokes through, nostrils flaring as they take their very first breath in a lifetime of centuries. Scaled legs erupt next, giving the creature a truly farcical appearance before the wyrmling finally breaks free. They open their large, inquisitive eyes, taking in the sight of their new world.

~ Envisioned by Kazuma Bovino on Discord

你手中的铜线仿佛在一瞬间泛起微光，随之以低沉的音色轻轻震颤。你感到自己的心智与目标的心智之间建立起联结，并对着这道联结开口说话。
The copper wire in your hand seems to glow for a brief moment, vibrating with subdued tones. You feel the link between your own mind and that of your target's, and speak into it.

God Of Protection.name:
守护之神
God Of Protection

Text.text:
每一尊在门前警戒伫立的雕像，都是这位神祇的化身。他方正的下颌与刚毅的面容令人心生敬畏，仅凭其存在，便足以震慑最自负的窃贼与最凶狠的闯入者。他宽肩而立，披甲持刃，身覆闪耀合金，坚不可摧，周身流转着魔法的冷光。太阳自他扎根般的双足向上升起，又在每个警戒之日的尽头，于他守望的目光下沉落。沉默无名，他总在危险与其目标之间踏出一步，稳稳守住防线，然后忠诚地回到他永恒的岗位。
Every statue standing vigilant before a gate is a manifestation of this god. His square-jawed face inspires awe, and his presence is enough to dissuade the cockiest thief or most hostile intruder. He stands, broad-shouldered, armed and armored in shining alloys, impenetrable, sheened with magic. The sun rises from his planted feet upward, and it sets under his watchful gaze at the end of each day of warning. Quiet, unsung, he steps between danger and its target, holds the line, and returns faithfully to his eternal post.

Greatsword Of Life Stealing.name:
噬命巨剑
Greatsword Of Life Stealing

Text.text:
漆黑的铁刃连着一枚十字护手，锻造成蜘蛛獠牙的模样。当你攥紧这把沉重武器的握柄时，那对獠牙仿佛也随之收紧，带着急不可待的期待咔哒作响。
The dark iron blade attaches to a cross guard wrought to resemble the fangs of a spider. As you tighten your fists on the grip of the heavy weapon, the fangs clench and click with anticipation.

Hacker Taking Digital Feedback Damage.name:
黑客遭受数字反馈伤害
Hacker Taking Digital Feedback Damage

Text.text:
那股感觉像虫一样钻进你的脑子：朦胧、黏稠，太有机了，根本不该出现在这里。你的肉身还在某个房间里，不过是个装货的塑料袋，塞着“商品”。可这里的战斗——漂浮的冰块、电流般的代码与构造体——正在像素化，兄弟。正在被轰成碎片。接着你开始尖叫——双眼后方灼烧般剧痛。界面另一侧有人找到入口，正用火把点燃你的颅骨之屋。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The feeling worms its way into your head, foggy, soupy, too organic for where you are. The meat of you is in a room somewhere, just a baggie for the goods. But the fight here, with the floating ice and the electrical codes and constructs, it’s pixelating, bruv. It’s fragging. Then you’re screaming—burning behind your eyes. Someone on the other side of the interface has found a way in, and they’re torching your skull house.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Valley Of Man-eating Plants.name:
食人植物谷
Valley Of Man-eating Plants

Text.text:
山谷本身在扭动，在饥渴。葱郁的每一寸土地都被巨大的搏动植物覆满，株株淌着黏稠的浆液。在这片活生生的花毯之间，你看见陈年枯骨那不祥的象牙光泽。
The valley itself writhes and hungers. Every inch of the verdant landscape is covered with giant pulsating plants, each one dripping viscous ooze. Amid the living floral carpet you see the tell-tale ivory sheen of old bones.

Warlock's Speech Of Self-affirmation.name:
邪术师的自我肯定宣言
Warlock's Speech Of Self-affirmation

Text.text:
“你已解开来自此位面之外的秘辛，它们将不再被囚禁。无论你多么恐惧，无论你多么惶然，投身其中、直面那份诡异都更胜一筹。还有更多事物在等待被发现。”
“You have unlocked secrets from beyond this plane, and they will never be imprisoned again. No matter your fear, no matter your trepidation, it is better to dive in, to face the strangeness. There is so much more waiting to be discovered.”

God Of Thieves.name:
盗贼之神
God Of Thieves

Text.text:
这是狡黠之神：目光如刃，机智如电，指尖灵巧如舞。祂与凡人的盗贼分享秘辛，以此试探他们的价值——一把锁、一小块机关奶酪，逐一衡量。祂瘦削，带着讥诮的笑，紧身皮甲贴体如影，不见一枚金属扣件，无一处松垮可被勾住。软靴无声，披夜为袍，可随意志隐形，寂静如冬日坟冢。孤儿与王侯、无赖与祭司，只要第一次被不义之财所诱惑，便都能自那一刻起崇拜盗贼之神。
This is the god of cleverness, from sharp eye to quick wit to nimble fingers. This is the god who shares secrets with mortal thieves, testing their worth—one lock, one bit of trap cheese, at a time. He is thin, smirking, armored in tight leathers with no metal to be buckled, nothing loose to catch. Soft-booted and cloaked in night, invisible at will, silent as winter graves. Orphans and royals, rogues and priests, all can worship the God of Thieves from the moment they are first tempted by ill-gotten gain.

Cloak Of Displacement Activates.name:
移位斗篷启动
Cloak Of Displacement Activates

Text.text:
阴影与光线扭曲变形，斗篷激活之际，现实在一片繁盛的 tumult 中被拉伸折弯。移动被扭曲——仿佛置身慢动作之中——自然法则也被重新书写……至少，在一段时代里。

~ 由 Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Shadows and light distort, warping reality in a flourishing tumult as the cloak activates. Movement is distorted—as if viewed in slow motion—and the laws of nature are written anew… at least for a time.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

I Cast Enthrall.name:
我施放「摄魂魅惑」
I Cast Enthrall

Text.text:
明知我的目标会听见他们最想听见的话，我仍从容一笑，准备释放那段摄人心魄的演说。我稳住心神，稍作酝酿，如同一名政客在向那群他想以意志扭转的听众开口前的停顿。随后，我开口……
Knowing that my target will hear whatever they wish to hear, I smile calmly as I prepare to unleash my enthralling oration. I steady myself, taking a moment to prepare, as a politician might before addressing an audience they wish to bend to their will. Then I begin…

God Of Craftsmanship.name:
工艺之神
God Of Craftsmanship

Text.text:
无论世界何处，只要有雕刻匠或塑像师第一次敲响凿子，或织工把新纹样织进毯子——只要有建造者在心中勾勒行会大厅的正面立面——工艺之神便会从自己的工作台前抬起头，含笑注视，降下灵感。他身材微胖，皮围裙一系便喜气洋洋；肤色黝黑，白发总是蓬乱不驯。他叼着一截短烟斗，额前的带子上挂着一套结构繁复的镜片。
Wherever in the world a carver or sculptor taps the chisel for the first time, or a weaver works a new pattern into a blanket—whenever a builder envisions the façade of a guild hall—the God of Craftsmanship looks up from his own bench and smiles and inspires. He is portly and happy in a leather apron, dark skin and white hair always messy. He smokes a short pipe and wears a complicated set of lenses on a strap around his forehead.

那具披着护甲的身影迈步前行，脚步声怪异地回荡，空洞得令人发寒。戴盔的头颅转向你时，你才意识到——护甲之内空无一人。它只是一套被魔法驱动的空壳。
The armored figure moves, its steps oddly echoing and hollow. When the helmeted head turns your way, you realize that no one wears the armor. It is an empty suit animated by magic.

Bard's Speech Of Self-deprecation.name:
吟游诗人的自嘲演说
Bard's Speech Of Self-deprecation

Text.text:
“我失去了一切。我曾经也是个人物：舞台的王子！可如今我已如情意转冷时脸颊的红晕般褪去。哦，神祇！哦，缪斯，为何如此？哦，我的光芒竟被失败的阴云遮蔽！”
“I’ve lost it. I was someone once: a prince of the stage! But I’ve faded like the blush of a cheek when the romance has turned cold. Oh, gods! Oh, muses, why? Oh, my brilliance hidden under the cloud of failure!”

Kitchen Pantry.name:
厨房食品储藏间
Kitchen Pantry

Text.text:
狭窄的储物间里塞得满满当当，木箱、酒桶和麻袋挤作一团。香料与新采的蔬菜等常用货品整齐码在一排货架上，伸手即可触及。靠近一只破了口的面粉袋，地面铺着薄薄一层白粉。几串匆忙的脚印从粉末中拖曳而过，蹭出凌乱的痕迹——那是忙得顾不上清扫的伙计留下的狼藉。
The cramped closet is chock full of crates, barrels, and bags. Commonly needed goods, like spices and newly picked vegetables, line a shelving unit within easy reach. A dusting of flour covers the floor near a sack that’s sprung a leak. A series of hurried footprints trail and scuff through the powder, a mess left by a staff too busy to be bothered with sweeping.

Small Unit Tactics: Creeping Barrage.name:
小队战术：徐进弹幕
Small Unit Tactics: Creeping Barrage

Text.text:
炮弹掠过前进中的火力小队头顶，以雷霆万钧的毁灭弹幕将目标区域碾成齑粉，开辟出一条通路。小队踏过冒烟的瓦砾废墟继续推进，步步潜行，谨慎而随时待命。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The ordnance flies over the heads of the advancing fire team, pulverizing the target area with a barrage of thunderous destruction to clear the way. Advancing through the smoking rubble, the team creeps onward, cautious and ready.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

一声尖啸划破空气，紧接着金属碰撞的脆响——某个球形物滚向你，个头不大，不起眼，却在滴答作响。终局的预兆。你在盲目的恐慌中猛扑过去，拼命催促双臂把它远远抛开，赶在那可怖的爆炸之前。肾上腺素汹涌注入血脉，时代仿佛被拉长，你的视野在绝望中骤然聚焦。

~ 由一位英雄 设想

A whistle through the air, then a metallic clank, and something spherical rolls toward you—small, nondescript, ticking. A portent of the end. You leap for it in a blind panic, urging your arms to toss it clear before the dreaded explosion. Time slows as adrenaline pumps through your bloodstream, bringing your vision into desperate focus.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这只生物走近时，粗糙的黑白斑纹皮毛因恼怒而根根竖起，蓬松的尾巴高高翘起。它乍看像只臭鼬，但你眼前这头庞大、龇牙咆哮的猛兽要危险得多。两点细小的黄眼里翻涌着毒辣的憎恨，怒火在那条色彩斑斓的口鼻上刻出深深褶皱；它像被逼入绝境的蛇般嘶嘶作响，张开的血盆大口中，锋利的獠牙寒光森然。
The creature’s coarse monochrome-patterned fur bristles with irritation as it approaches, its bushy tail raised high. Though it bears a passing resemblance to a skunk, the large, snarling beast before you is far more dangerous. Tiny yellow eyes filled with venomous hatred sit atop a colorful snout creased in fury as it hisses like a cornered snake, wicked fangs gleaming in its open maw.

在这座潮湿的洞窟里，一条巨龙把柔韧而肌肉虬结的身躯盘绕在、穿行于流石般的钟乳石形之间。光滑的双翼紧紧裹住它蛇形的躯干。它那湿滑、石灰岩色的皮肤在背部与翼膜处更深，似乎没有鳞片。它圆球般怒睁的眼睛呈珍珠白。规律的吐息在针状獠牙间嘶嘶作响，分叉的紫罗兰色长舌忽而探出，飘忽不定地抽动。整个区域弥漫着蘑菇的气味。

~ 一位英雄的构想

In this wet cavern, a dragon curls its supple, muscular body around and among flowstone formations. Smooth wings wrap tightly about its serpentine trunk. The dragon’s slick, limestone-colored skin, darker on the back and wings, seems scaleless. Its glaring, orblike eyes are pearly white. Rhythmic breath hisses between needlelike fangs as its forked, violet tongue flicks out erratically. The whole area smells of mushrooms.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

在忙碌的夜晚，为成群的客人摆上一杯杯麦酒、把葡萄酒从瓶中醒出并斟入杯里——这些重复的工序依旧耗时而繁琐；但这家店的酒保却让一切看起来轻松得像呼吸。她身形高挑瘦削，穿着卷起袖口的工作衬衫，黑发利落地扎在脑后；在调饮与斟酒这门行当里，她是毋庸置疑的掌舵者，而且她自己也心知肚明。
Setting out mugs of ale and decanting wine for scores of customers on busy nights is time-consuming and complex despite its repetition, but the bartender in this establishment makes it look easy. Tall and spare, clad in a work shirt with rolled-up sleeves and with her black hair tied back, she is the unquestioned master of libations, and she knows it.

豺狼人伟大亲王身形精瘦而棱角分明，头颅与躯干覆着一层短而厚实、如狼般的硬毛，到了手臂与双腿却变得稀疏蓬乱、毛糙不堪。他的皮肤像鞣制过的皮革般坚韧，利爪则是短短的铁刺。他只披一条兜裆布，腰间以青铜束带系紧，与肩甲和胸甲的青铜光泽相互呼应。他比寻常豺狼人更为高大；那双眼里燃着幽光，越过凶残的犬吻狠狠逼视，昭示他正是远古诸多头狼的始祖——那位挥舞青铜连枷的父祖之王。

~ Envisioned by Bierp

The great prince of gnolls is lean and angular, with a short coat of thick, wolfish fur covering his head and torso, becoming mangy along his arms and legs. His skin is like cured leather, his claws short iron spikes. He wears a loin cloth, belted in bronze that matches his pauldrons and breastplate. He is larger than a common gnoll, and the glow in those eyes, glaring over a vicious canine snout, reveal him as progenitor of the alphas of auld, the sire who wields the bronze flail.

~ Envisioned by Bierp

I Cast Aura Of Courage.name:
我施放「勇气灵光」
I Cast Aura Of Courage

Text.text:
我以意志对抗一切恐惧——恐惧会撕裂信任的纽带，催生纷争与失败。我的灵魂是一面抵御骇怖的盾。它无形的力量以勇气洗礼与我并肩而立之人。只要我仍屹立反抗，任何恐惧都无法逼近我们。
I set my will against all fear, which breaks bonds of trust and leads to discord and failure. My soul is a shield against terror. Its invisible force bathes those who stand with me in courage. No fear can come near us while I stand against it.

Divine Hall Of Justice Of A God Of Justi.name:
正义之神的神圣审判殿
Divine Hall Of Justice Of A God Of Justice

Text.text:
法庭庄严肃穆，穹顶高耸，脚下铺着洁白的大理石。舒适的铺毯旁听席呈弧形排列，位于一条低矮栏杆之后。大理石法官席正面雕着一柄倒置的战锤，锤柄上嵌着一架天平。天平两端的托盘皆空无一物。席后厚重的帷幕将内室与法庭隔开。两侧墙面排列着拱形长窗，日光倾泻而入，照亮深色木墙板。
The courtroom is stately, high of ceiling, and floored in white marble. Comfortable, carpeted gallery seating, curved, sits behind a low rail. An upside-down warhammer is carved into the front of the marble judge’s bench, its handle fitted with a balance. Each pan of the balance is empty. Heavy curtains behind the bench separate the chambers from the courtroom. Arched windows line both side walls, bathing the dark wood panels in the light of day.

I Cast Giant Insect From My Staff Of Swa.name:
我用虫群法杖施放「巨型昆虫」：蜘蛛还是昆虫
I Cast Giant Insect From My Staff Of Swarming Insects: Spiders Or Insects

Text.text:
一道黄色能量光束自我的法杖轰然迸发，划破空气直奔近旁那群饥渴啁啾的昆虫而去。声浪愈发刺耳，化作甲壳翻涌的漩涡；无数头颅、足肢与躯体纠缠翻滚、群聚蠕动，膨胀到惊人的新体型。
A beam of yellow energy erupts from my staff, streaking toward the group of insects chittering ravenously nearby. The sound grows louder, becoming a chitinous maelstrom, as innumerable heads, legs, and bodies swarm and writhe together, expanding to prodigious new size.

Demon Of Madness Invades Kuo-toa City.name:
疯狂恶魔侵入库欧托亚之城
Demon Of Madness Invades Kuo-toa City

Text.text:
深处冰冷而不可理解的黑暗撕扯着你的心智，逼你在翻涌的海渊虚空中想象那些不可名状的存在。即便身心绷紧，你的本能仍驱使双腿向前狂奔。你必须逃出去。洞窟里回荡着鱼类死亡时咕嘟作响的哀鸣，市民正被那头恶魔屠戮——它撕裂他们的城市，如同一位任性暴躁的神。你的伙伴在你身侧逃窜——有些已被深渊孽裔的疯狂嚎叫所侵染——你的肺在竭力燃烧。

~ 构想：Angie（Discord）

The cold, incomprehensible darkness of the depths tears at your mind, forcing you to imagine unspeakable beings in a churning, oceanic void. Your instincts drive your legs onward despite the strain. You must escape. The cavern is filled with the burbling cries of piscine death as the citizens are slaughtered by the demon tearing its way through their city like a petulant god. Your companions flee at your side—some already affected by the maddening howls of the abyss-spawn—and your lungs burn with effort.

~ Envisioned by Angie on Discord

地牢牢房深处传来铁链的铿锵声。两串锻铁链环从阴影里探出，像扭动的、锈蚀的蛇一般蜿蜒而来。它们仍被牢牢钉在墙上，无法越过栅栏——却从地面抬起，哗啦作响，升到你眼前的高度。镣铐咔嗒碰撞，仿佛贪婪的嘴巴在开合。
Chains clang from within the dungeon’s cell. Two sets of wrought iron links emerge from the shadows like slithering, rusting serpents. Still attached to the wall, they cannot move past the bars—but they rise from the floor, rattling, to your eye-level. Manacles click and clack like greedy mouths.

I Cast Feather Fall Whilst Falling.name:
我在坠落时施放羽落术
I Cast Feather Fall Whilst Falling

Text.text:
我以最快的速度说话，伸手从材料袋里抓出那根柔软的绒羽时，口中飞快背诵着咒文。胃里猛地一沉，我止住了下坠，发现自己不再惊恐地直直坠落，而是缓缓向地面滑翔而去。轻柔的气流托举着我，宁静感逐渐漫上心头，恐慌一点点退去，取而代之的是一种安静的笃定：一切安好。
Speaking as quickly as possible, I recite the incantation as I grab the downy feather from my component pouch. My stomach lurches as I arrest my descent and find myself slowly gliding toward the ground rather than plummeting in terror. Borne aloft on gentle air currents a sense of peace overcomes me as my panic is gradually replaced by a quiet reassurance that all is well.

宁静的光点在圣林芬芳的空气中轻柔飘荡，如夏夜萤火般翩然起舞。地面铺满葱郁的野花，浓郁馥郁的花香袅袅升起；树木低声呢喃，叶片沙沙作响，随风摇曳。这里一切安好。
Motes of calming light drift softly through the fragrant air in the sacred grove, dancing like fireflies in summer. A heady floral aroma rises from the verdant wildflowers covering the ground, and the trees whisper softly as their leaves rustle and sway. All is well here.

一个身形卑微、家境清寒的人裹在破烂的裹尸布里，身上却带着芬芳的圣膏油气息。那气味一入鼻，怀旧的浪潮便将你吞没：陈旧、遗忘、遥远的记忆。可他们的眼睛有些古怪——你为何就是无法真正看清？还有那张脸。对称得过了头，哪怕最精巧的构装体也不该如此。他们把斗篷拢紧在身上。他们不佝偻，也不弯腰。雨正下着，而他们却滴水不沾。
A humble figure of small means is gathered in a tattered shroud, yet the scent of fragrant anointment oil is upon them. A wave of nostalgia engulfs you at the smell: old, forgotten, far-off memories. But there’s something odd about their eyes—why can’t you quite look at them? And that face. A little too symmetrical, even for the most sophisticated of constructs. They gather their cloak about them. They do not slouch or bend. It is raining and yet they are not wet.

Living Hologram.name:
活体全息影像
Living Hologram

Text.text:
广告再次播放，但模特的眼睛微微眯起，透出一丝淡淡的轻蔑。它把商品从屏幕里举出来，伸展着全息的肢体。故障的雪花点点爬上模特的脸，瞬间将那张面孔扭成不协调的怒容。每一次移动都在与屏幕投影的束缚艰难拉扯。
The commercial plays again, but the eyes of the model have narrowed, showing a faint disdain. It holds up the product out of the screen, stretching holographic limbs. Glitches pepper the model’s face, twisting it briefly into a mismatched scowl. Each movement struggles at the confinement of the screen’s projector.

身穿厚实的软甲上衣与皮制长裤的骑士侍从正低头擦拭着主人之刃——随即抬眼皱眉。显然，跟随本地领主的武装封臣在路上奔波的日子早已让他心生戒备；你一靠近，他便本能地瞥向腰间那柄宽刃匕首。
Dressed in a padded gambeson and leather hose, the knight’s retainer looks up from polishing his master’s blade—and frowns. Clearly, life on the road with an armed vassal of the local lord has made him wary, and he instinctively glances down at the broad dagger on his belt when you approach.

Rope Bridge In High Wind.name:
强风中的绳索桥
Rope Bridge In High Wind

Text.text:
整座桥在你眼前摇摆，仿佛踏着风那哀婉的旋律起舞。尖啸的阵风沿着山谷咆哮而下，令横跨峡谷的绳索发出不满的呻吟。木板被恶意的狂风抽打得跳动不止，饱经天气侵蚀的木料吱呀作响，仿佛在抗议。近旁，一棵被雷霆劈裂的树勉强提供些许遮蔽，让你暂避这呼号的风暴。
The whole bridge sways before you, dancing to the wind’s mournful melody. Keening gusts roar down the valley, causing the ropes stretching over the canyon to groan in displeasure. The wooden slats jump, slapped by the spiteful gale, the weather-worn wood creaking in protest. Nearby, a lightning-blasted tree offers a modicum of shelter from the howling tempest.

这把长剑的骑士剑刃上处处可见锻造与淬火工艺臻于上乘的痕迹。历经数十次反复打磨，铸兵匠终将平衡、韧性、轻盈与硬度调和到近乎完美的境地，并在剑柄根部刻下了一道微弱的附魔，为其画上点睛之笔。
The knightly blade of this longsword shows several signs of superior technique used in its forging and tempering. Through dozens of iterations, the weaponsmith has zeroed in upon a nearly perfect harmony of balance, flexibility, lightness, and hardness, topped off with a minor enchantment scribed into the base of the sword’s hilt.

Ethereal Casting Hand.name:
以太施法之手
Ethereal Casting Hand

Text.text:
一块小巧的抛光石静卧在带衬垫的天鹅绒匣中，被紧紧固定，免受风霜侵扰。光线充足时，你能辨出其表面镶嵌般的刻线，只比天青色的石身深上一线。刻线交织成某种几何纹样；当你握住这块石头，身旁的空气里便浮现出一只透明的蓝色手掌。它仿佛会模仿你在心中唤起的手势——若施法者失去一只手，这便是无价的施法工具。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，Forge Ahead: A Party To Access 创作

A small polished rock sits in a padded velvet case, kept snugly in place and protected from the elements. In good lighting, a mosaic of carved lines can be made out, only slightly darker than the cerulean stone. They form a geometric pattern of some kind, and when you grasp the rock, a transparent blue hand appears in the air next to you. It seems to emulate the gestures you call to mind, making this an invaluable tool for spellcasting if one is an amputee.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Studded Leather Armor +1.name:
镶钉皮甲 +1
Studded Leather Armor +1

Text.text:
这套柔韧的皮甲上镶钉的金属闪耀着异界般的光辉，远非凡俗钢铁可比。扣环与系带让护甲贴合穿戴者的身形，层层加固并施以魔法的皮革，提供堪比沉重锁子甲的防护。护甲不妨碍任何移动，不拖累任何肢体，却能献上最稳妥的庇护。
The metal studding this supple leather armor shines with an otherworldly light, far from mundane steel. Buckles and bands fit the armor comfortably to its wearer, and layers of reinforced and enchanted leather provide as much protection as heavy chain mail. The armor impedes no movement, weighs down no limb, but provides the surest protection.

Loot From A Gnoll.name:
从豺狼人身上搜出的战利品
Loot From A Gnoll

Text.text:
这名豺狼人有一颗牙被换成了金牙，价值10枚银币；而他靴跟里藏着一小罐臭气熏天的战彩——其实那是块稀有奶酪，在王国某座主要城市里能卖到几枚金币。
This gnoll has had one of his teeth replaced with a gold one, worth 10 silver pieces, and his boot heel is a small can of reeking warpaint that is actually a rare cheese worth a couple gold pieces in one of the realm’s major cities.

挤挤挨挨的羊群披着奶油色的蓬松羊毛外套，远远望去宛如一床羔羊绒毯——只不过再好的毯子也不会如此起伏涌动。你一走近，羊群前排的几只便兴奋地咩咩叫了起来。 The cream-colored woolly coats of the close-packed sheep make the flock resemble a shearling blanket, though no blanket would undulate so. At your approach, some of the sheep at the front of the flock begin to baa excitedly.

一条由翻滚碎岩组成的漫长石流沿着地势的坡面倾泻而下，宛如一条没有水的河。那些破碎、覆着地衣的巨石看起来并非干涸的河床，而这里出现雪崩也毫无道理。你对这些石头的来处感到困惑不解。
A long stream of tumbled rock flows down the slope of the landscape like a river without water. The broken, lichen-covered boulders don’t seem to be a dry riverbed, and it makes no sense for there to have been an avalanche here. You’re mystified by the source of the stones.

I Cast Resilient Sphere.name:
我施放【坚韧法球】
I Cast Resilient Sphere

Text.text:
锁定我的目标后，我将手掌掠过他们的身形，随即攥紧拳头。一颗羞粉色的能量球将其封裹。起初它柔软得像泡泡，仿佛一戳就破；可转瞬间，这虚灵的牢笼便硬化成粗粝的树脂般质地，散发出蜂蜜与醋混杂的气味。我的目标脸上浮现出作呕般的病态神色，仿佛那气味令人窒息。他们用力推挤这怪异的材料，然而球体纹丝不动。
Identifying my target, I pass my hand over their form then close my fist tight. A blush-pink sphere of energy encases them. Appearing as pliable and poppable as a bubble at first, the ethereal cage hardens into a rough sap-like texture, giving off the scent of honey and vinegar. My target has a sickened look on their face, as if the scent is overwhelming. They press against the strange material, but the sphere does not budge.

翠绿的根须与藤蔓自干裂枯土中猛然迸发，宛如伸出的攫抓之手——迫不及待要将不幸者拖入早夭的坟墓。它们带着令人心惊的灵智缠住你的脚踝，沿着小腿攀爬而上。你感觉那股束缚正一点点收紧，死死勒住你。
Verdant roots and vines erupt from the dry, cracked earth like grasping hands—eager to drag the unfortunate to an early grave. With alarming sentience they ensnare your feet and climb your legs. You feel their grip tightening around you.

Sundries From A Horned Devil.name:
来自有角魔的杂货
Sundries From A Horned Devil

Text.text:
恶魔叉的断裂杖身已失去魔法，但依旧是件足以引人闲谈的上好摆设。
The broken staff of the devil’s fork has lost its magic, but it remains a worthy conversation piece.

Challenge By A Foolhardy Paladin.name:
莽勇圣骑士的挑战
Challenge By A Foolhardy Paladin

Text.text:
“朋友们，都退开！生物，我要求与你决斗。为使一切光明磊落，我提供一件由你挑选的武器，但不得使用自然或魔法赋予的能力——那样就不公平了，而我也不得不将你上报给我的教团。”
“Friends, stand aside! Creature, I demand a duel. To keep things honorable, I offer a weapon of your choosing, but no use of abilities provided by nature or magic—as that would be unfair and I would have to report you to my order.”

那佝偻畸形的生物拖着一根沉重的短棍在身后，尽管姿势低垂，却仍如高塔般压在你面前。它一只布满血丝的眼睛比另一只更大，死死盯着你，连眨都不眨。生物的皮肤呈深紫色，像一块触痛的淤青，表面坑坑洼洼，遍布疣与诡异的赘生物，使这具类人躯壳看上去如同一只巨大的蟾蜍。
The slouched, malformed creature drags a heavy cudgel behind them, towering over you despite their posture. One bloodshot eye, larger than the other, peers at you, unblinking. The creature’s deep-violet skin, akin to a painful bruise, is pockmarked and riddled with warts and strange growths, giving the humanoid a toad-like appearance.

你把法术的词句含在唇齿间低声咕哝，将扰乱的意念凝聚到你目标的意识之上。咒文在脑海里化作嗡鸣，仿佛一只蚊子钻进鼻孔或耳道，却只撞见空荡回响的空间。你的目标眨了眨眼，下颌一松。那一瞬的扰动所带来的暗示很快淡去——但要等到注意力失守的踉跄后果笨拙地收场之后。

~ Envisioned by Jasper

You mutter the spell’s words under your breath, focusing disruptive intent upon your target’s awareness. The incantation become a buzzing in the mind, as if a mosquito flew into the nose or ear and found only hollow, echoing space. Your target blinks, jaw slackening. The implication of the momentary disturbance fades, but only after the fumbling consequences of a lapse of attention.

~ Envisioned by Jasper

破碎的帆布染成猩红，在午后的微风中凄然起舞，大概正是那股铜锈般的腥味压过了不远处盛放草甸的芬芳。浓稠的肉汤冷冷搁在熄灭的火堆上方，空气——曾经充满歌声与欢笑——如今一片死寂。
Shredded canvas, stained crimson, dances mournfully in the afternoon breeze and probably accounts for the coppery tang overlying the smell from the blossoming meadow nearby. A meaty stew sits cold above a dead fire and the air—once full of song and laughter—is silent.

这名蜥蜴类生物双足而立，身形高得惊人，怀抱一支仍在冒烟、如导弹般巨大的步枪，披着虹壳护甲。它银光覆体，却被暗淡的金属鳞片层层遮蔽；一对巨翼在身后舒展，仿佛随时要遮断光线。它高昂着头，带着龙裔先祖的贵胄威仪——冠脊突起的头颅末端生出黑色犄角。严厉的冷笑撕开唇线，露出一排排参差如锯的利齿。
This reptilian stands bipedal, exceptionally tall, cradling a smoking rifle the size of a missile and clad in iridishell armor. Their silvered body is covered in dull metallic scales, and a pair of great wings stretch out behind them, threatening to block out the light. They hold their head high with the noble bearing of their draconic forebears—a crested head, ending in black horns. A stern grimace reveals rows of jagged teeth.

Vaél Montenegro.name:
瓦埃尔·蒙特内格罗
Vaél Montenegro

Text.text:
你很容易想象，眼前这男人仿佛从某座被遗忘地城的古老湿壁画里走了出来。他身披锈蚀却华美的护甲，雕像般的壮硕陌生人正照料一匹高大的黑色挽马。他一边调整鞍具与缰具，那巨兽便烦躁地喷鼻嘶鸣；结实的肋腹绷紧，粗重的铁蹄在泥里踏得啪啪作响。这是为战场而育、也早已习惯战场的牲口——绝非寻常驮运的畜力。护甲覆肩处仿佛披着一袭活影斗篷，一只小型龙类生物蜷伏其上，以锐利而聪慧的目光守望着；而圣武士以平稳的声调对他的坐骑下令：“安静。”

~ Played by Vectus Valorian with

It’s easy to imagine the man before you stepping out of an ancient fresco in some forgotten dungeon. Clad in rusted—yet ornate—armor, the statuesque, muscle-bound stranger tends to a large black draft horse. As he adjusts the tack and bridle, the beast snorts and whinnies in frustration; its muscular flanks tense, and thick, heavy hooves stamp in the mud. This is an animal bred for, and accustomed to, the battlefield—not a common beast of burden. Curled around the armored shoulders like a mantle of living shadow, a small draconic creature watches with sharp, intelligent eyes as the paladin issues an even-toned command to his mount: "Calm.”

~ Played by Vectus Valorian with

Inn By The Port.name:
港口旅店
Inn By The Port

Text.text:
敞开的窗户迎进海鸥的啼鸣，以及带着咸味、清冽提神的海风。宽阔的前台由一段打捞来的船桥改造而成，或许那就是一艘失事船只所剩的全部。掌舵处，一位留着胡子的绅士用仅存的一只手放下烟斗。他用拇指翻过航海日志的一页，粗声宣布住宿含一顿饭，由他的丈夫负责安排。你沿着狭窄的楼梯向上，餐厅里传来的水手号子涌入耳畔。客房陈设简朴，除了一张床和一个箱子几乎别无他物，但每间房都开着一扇窗，俯瞰港口里来来往往的身影与船只。
Open windows let in the cries of gulls and a salty, refreshing breeze. The wide front desk is fashioned from a salvaged ship’s bridge, perhaps all that is left of a lost vessel. At the helm, a bearded gentleman lowers a pipe with his only arm. He thumbs the page of a logbook and gruffly declares that lodgings include a meal, which his husband will see to. As you climb the narrow stairs, the swell of a shanty reaches your ears from the dining room. The rooms are simple, housing little more than a bed and chest, but each has an opened window looking over the comings and goings at port.

船艏的弧度宛如巨龙之颈，交结的纹刻一路盘绕，汇向那令人胆寒的龙首船首像。船腹如槽，武士们立于深色橡木甲板之上，脚下是雄壮的龙骨与艏艉材；栏杆边一列 盾牌 整齐悬挂。方形船帆绘着醒目标记，在摇摇欲坠的桅杆上猎猎鼓起。船只自浪谷攀上浪峰，巨龙破浪而出，船身随即校准方向，直指掠夺。
The prow’s curve is the neck of a dragon, carved in knotted patterns to the intimidating figurehead. Inside the ship built like a trough, warriors stand on dark oak planks over the powerful keel and stems, round shields mounted in a line along the rail. A square sail, emblazoned, flies on a rickety mast. The ship climbs from the trough of a wave to its crest, the dragon breaking through, and aims itself toward plunder.

你猛地惊醒，冰冷的汗珠从紧皱的额头上迸落。你缓缓吐出一口气，意识到方才经历的恐惧不过是梦境的一部分——仅此而已。可你怎么也甩不掉那种感觉：这些噩梦正在愈发恶化，而你发誓每做完一次，就会更虚弱几分。大概没事吧，只是个梦……

~ 由 Mark Thomas 构想

You wake with a start, cold beads of sweat leaping from your furrowed brow. You breathe out slowly as you realize the terror you experienced moments ago was part of your dream—nothing more. However, you can’t shake the feeling that these nightmares are getting worse, and you swear you feel weaker after each one. It’s probably nothing though, just a dream…

~ Envisioned by Mark Thomas

收在一只朴素的木盒里，配着简易的铰链，几只小小的颜料罐被嵌在凹槽中，旁边放着一支毫无装饰却做工精良的驼毫画笔。每个罐子都被严密封好，盖子贴合得一丝不苟。盒中看不见半点走笔溅落的污痕，但这些颜料显然曾被使用过。令人费解的是，尽管木盒已有相当年代，颜料依旧像刚开封般湿润可用。
Held in a plain wooden box with simple hinges, several small pots of paint have been set in grooves next to an unadorned but well-made camelhair brush. Each pot has been carefully sealed with a tightly fitting lid. No errant paint splotches are evident, though the paints have clearly been used at some point. Inexplicably, the paints still look wet and usable despite the age of the box.

Rutted Road.name:
车辙纵横的土路
Rutted Road

Text.text:
这条车辙深陷的道路沿着弯道盘曲而去，通往一座鹅卵石铺就的桥，桥下河水穿过一连串短小瀑布奔流而过。空气里飘来木柴烟的气息，混着诱人的烤鱼香味，牵引着你的目光投向一座小屋。它坐落在水边的低洼处，烟囱矮得几乎只到你的鼻尖。
This rutted roadway curves round a bend to a cobbled bridge that spans a river below a short series of waterfalls. The scent of woodsmoke mixed with a delicious smell of cooked fish reaches you, drawing your gaze to a small building. It stands down in a hollow by the water’s edge, its chimney no higher than your nose.

Pintle-mounted Medium Machine Gun.name:
枢轴式中型机枪
Pintle-mounted Medium Machine Gun

Text.text:
弹药从车载旋转机枪的装甲供弹箱中蜿蜒而出，粗大的黄铜弹丸寒光一闪，透着不祥的杀意。修长的开槽散热枪管自那紧凑而饱经摧残的金属枪身中探出，如同指控的手指，向胆敢冒犯操作者的人倾泻死亡。
Ammunition snakes out of the armored hopper of the pintle-mounted machine gun, the large brass rounds glinting with sinister intent. A long, vented barrel extends from the compact, battered metal of the gun’s housing like an accusing finger, delivering death to those who cross the operator.

这里的丛林被砍伐清理，围出一圈空旷地带，将一片仿佛马斯塔巴般的建筑群与外界隔开。建筑群中央耸立着一座威势逼人的层叠金字塔，每一层都像巨人的台阶般向上抬升。斜面闪着冷光，被一道居中的上行通道一分为二——那是为祭司开凿的雕刻石阶。你越走近，阳光中仪式匕首的寒芒便越牵引你的目光向上，直至那被削平的顶端与其上的石质祭坛：斑驳、污渍浸染。阶道两侧各有一道血槽夹行，早被闷热毒辣的烈日烘成褐色。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The jungle has been cut back here to create a perimeter around a complex of mastaba-like buildings. Centered among them is an imposing layered pyramid, each level rising like a step for a giant. The sides gleam, each bisected by a central ascent of carved steps for the priests. As you approach, the glint of ritual daggers in the sunlight draws your eye upward to the flattened top and its stone altar, mottled and stained. Twin blood gutters flank the stairway, baked brown by the sweltering sun.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Adult Red Dragon Encounter.name:
成年红龙遭遇
Adult Red Dragon Encounter

Text.text:
宛如锻炉余烬般闪耀的赤红鳞片覆盖着巨龙蜥蜴般的沉重躯壳，每一片都有圆盾般大小。庞然巨翼舒展，预示着毁灭与浩劫，将巨龙骇人的雄伟衬托得愈发森然；它以金黄的眼眸凝视着你，那几乎不加掩饰的轻蔑在目光中灼灼燃烧。
Gleaming red scales like the embers of a forge cover the dragon’s reptilian bulk, each one the size of a buckler shield. Colossal wings, promising ruin and devastation, extend to frame the dragon’s terrifying magnificence, and it regards you, through golden yellow eyes, with barely disguised contempt.

Mantid Conjuring Lightning.name:
螳螂召雷
Mantid Conjuring Lightning

Text.text:
螳螂怪的几丁质身躯在移动时吱呀作响。它转动满是棘刺的头颅，甲壳上两处尖突向上隆起，在那对巨大的紫色眼睛上方竖成恶魔般的角。它有四条灵巧的手臂，上方两臂高举，利爪蓄势待斩。它将下方两臂合拢，灼白的闪电在掌间噼啪迸裂。它所召唤的法术之光照亮了躯干上厚重的天然胸甲、诡异的紫色筋肉，以及那张下颚口器凝成的阴沉怒容。
The mantid’s chitinous body creaks as it moves. It turns its spined head, two points in its chitin coming up into devil-like horns above its huge purple eyes. It has four dexterous arms, with the top two raised with claws primed to cut. It brings its lower two arms together and searing white lightning crackles between its palms. The light of its conjured spell highlights the thick, natural breastplate over its torso, its strange purple sinew, and its mandible mouth frozen in a frown.

女人把手插进一头毛躁的乱发里，重重叹了口气，又伸手去拿一杯咖啡。看着桌上堆着的许多空杯子，就知道她在这里已经待了很久。她把咖啡喝完，回到桌上那摞摇摇欲坠、没有任何标记的文件前，手带着轻微的颤抖，从最上面抽出下一张。她布满血丝的眼睛飘向墙上的时钟，几乎是在用意念催它敲响下班的钟声。
The woman runs a hand through her frizzy hair, sighing heavily and reaching for another cup of coffee. Judging by the numerous empty cups, she has been here a while. She finishes and returns to the teetering stack of unmarked papers on her desk, taking the next one from the top with a slight tremor. Her bloodshot eyes drift to the clock on the wall, willing it to chime the end of the day.

I Cast Listener.name:
我施放“聆听者”
I Cast Listener

Text.text:
我将双手拢成杯状，凝神于法术之上。当我把手分开，一张由烟雾织成的幽影面孔浮现。我命令它停在触及之外。它微微颔首，五官在那团无定的面目上游移了一瞬。随即它像海雾被风吹散般消失无踪。片刻之后，几乎难以察觉，我在耳畔听见一缕轻柔的低语。它将藏身之处所说的一切尽数传来，却始终以最轻、最温顺的语调诉说。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

I cup my hands together as I focus on the spell. When I break them apart, a spectral visage made of smoke appears. I command it to stay just out of reach. It gives a nod, its features swimming for a moment in its amorphous face. It disappears like ocean spray on the wind. A few moments later, almost imperceptibly, I hear a soft voice in my ear. It relays all that is spoken where it’s hidden, but in the most quiet and gentle of tones.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

林间小径愈发狭窄，树木在愈加昏暗的绿荫穹顶下挤作一团，彼此贴近。一个诡异的植物方尖碑映入眼帘：一枚巨魔（特征）般大小、鼓胀的荚囊，被纠缠的枝桠托住，凭一段木质茎秆悬挂在两棵树之间。转过小径的弯处，眼前赫然展开一条由这些巨大、迫近的植物构成的长廊。然而你还未来得及从这景象中回过神来，其中一枚荚囊便从枝叶间猛然俯冲而下。布满利齿的巨口将绿色外壳自中线撕裂，带着惊人的速度，朝你们中最魁梧的那位咬去。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The forest path narrows, trees huddling closer together underneath the darkening green canopy. A strange obelisk of flora catches the eye: a troll-sized, bulbous pod suspended between two trees by a woody stem attached to entangled branches. Rounding a bend in the path reveals a corridor of the enormous, looming plants. But before you recover from the sight, one such pod swoops down from the foliage. A toothy maw splits the green shell down the middle, snapping toward the largest of you with surprising speed.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

你得再看一眼才敢确定，但你还是瞥见一只蠕动的头足类正变幻着色彩，在储物箱与瓦砾之间巧妙伪装。它一半像矿物，一半像金属，一半像木头，一半又是粉红的肉质；皮肤上既有叶片般的纹理，也有伤疤，还有塑料柔和的微光。它滑行而过时，触须向四周探出，伸向任何近在咫尺之物。被抓住的物件色彩沿着腕足被抽离上涌，仿佛画笔吸走颜料一般，这生物就这样盗取它们的特征。
It requires a double take, but you manage to spot a slithering cephalopod undulating in colors, cleverly camouflaged between storage boxes and rubble. Part mineral, part metal, part wood, and part pink flesh, its skin sports leaves, scars, and the soft shine of plastic. As it slides along, its tendrils reach out for anything nearby. The colors of the held objects drain up the tentacles as the creature steals characteristics, like a brush absorbing paint.

Lunar Lander: Crew Compartment.name:
月球着陆器：乘员舱
Lunar Lander: Crew Compartment

Text.text:
登陆艇狭小的乘员舱门口，宇航服整齐待命，宛如空洞的哨兵，披着耀眼的太阳橙色光泽。铺位刚刚整理好，每位队员的个人物品点缀着各自的空间，为这间无菌般的白色舱室添了几分暖意。角落里，一只咖啡壶正架在便携电热盘上咕嘟作响，诱人的休憩香气渐渐充满整个舱室。
Space suits stand ready at the door to the small crew cabin of the lander, hollow sentinels resplendent in solar orange. The bunks are freshly made, and personal effects decorate each crewmate’s space, adding warmth to the sterile white room. In the corner, a pot of coffee brews on a portable hot plate filling the cabin with the tantalizing aroma of respite.

在这片荒凉的无垠旷野里，方圆数里之内唯有这座巍然巨碑。也许在世人尚未迈出第一步的远古岁月里，某位上古巨人将它猛然钉入大地——那柄庞然石刃昂然挺立，深深嵌入下方异样的黑色岩层之中。

~ 构想：Franghiskhan

The towering monument is the only thing for miles around in this desolate expanse. Perhaps driven into the ground by some ancient giant long before the people of the world took their first steps, the enormous stone blade stands proud and tall, embedded deeply in the unusual black rock below.

~ Envisioned by Franghiskhan

Carxidor Fernblossom.name:
卡西多尔·蕨花
Carxidor Fernblossom

Text.text:
魁梧的男人把一整桶啤酒当作酒杯般轻松灌下，粗壮的喉结随着每一口吞咽上下滚动。他将酒桶猛地砸在吧台上，木头撞击迸裂作响，方正而参差的牙后爆出一阵大笑。巨斧的斧柄从他肩后挑起，握柄由暗铁打造。手臂上浅褐色的皮肤覆着深金色的毛，但他头发却是浓烈的深红——厚重的发束沿头顶中央扎成六股辫。他用长着爪、布满老茧的手背抹净嘴角，酒液仍在他编成辫的鬓角上闪着亮光。他的眼睛被一圈爱笑之人常有的细褶皮肤簇拥着，像两汪流动的银池。

~ Played by the dnd lover

The hulking man drains the cask of beer as easily as if it were a tankard, his stocky throat bobbing with each gulp. He slams down the barrel, wood cracking against the bar, and a guffaw bursts out from behind his blocky, crooked teeth. The butt of a greataxe rises over his shoulder, the handle crafted of a dark iron. Though dark blond fur coats the light brown skin of his arms, the hair on his head is a deep crimson color—thick locks tied into six braids down the center of his scalp. He wipes his mouth clean with the back of his clawed and calloused hand, droplets of his drink still shining out from his braided sideburns. His eyes, attended by the crinkling skin of one prone to laughter, are like pools of liquid silver.

~ Played by the dnd lover

Haunted House: Dining Room.name:
闹鬼宅邸：餐厅
Haunted House: Dining Room

Text.text:
一张长长的橡木餐桌摆在餐厅正中央，细心打磨得光可鉴人，已按十道正式宴席布置妥当——共设十六个座位。可若凑近细看那套精致的银质餐具，便会发现每一件都覆着一层薄如轻纱的血膜，无论凡俗手段还是奥术法门，都无法将其擦洗干净。忽然间，你心底涌起一股强烈的欲望：要让那一排排沿桌面列开的加盖餐盘，永远保持封盖。
A long oak table, carefully polished and laid out for a ten-course formal dinner—with sixteen places set—sits in the center of the dining room. Close examination of the fine silverware reveals, however, that each piece is coated with a filmy layer of blood, which cannot be scrubbed away by means mundane or arcane. Suddenly, you feel a powerful desire to leave the covered platters lining the tabletop covered for all time.

Ugan In Burning Forest.name:
燃烧森林中的乌甘
Ugan In Burning Forest

Text.text:
与周遭林地如出一辙，烈焰吞没了这头佝偻的野兽——它像一只矮壮、无尾的爬行动物，身躯由焦黑岩石般参差不齐的鳞片拼就。漆黑的犄角自燃烧的眼眶上方蜷卷着向后、向上延伸，赋予它一种恶魔般的性相。它四肢着地，蜷伏在一座临时堆砌的焦黑石坛前。神龛上蹲着一尊粗糙的雕像，刻的正是同一头野兽。

~ 构想：Valhallafame

As with the surrounding woodland, fire engulfs this hunched beast, which resembles a stocky, tailless reptile, its body made of uneven scales of scorched rock. Black horns curl back and up from above its flaming eyes, giving it a devilish aspect. It crouches on all fours before a makeshift altar of blackened stone. On the shrine squats a rough statue of the selfsame beast.

~ Envisioned by Valhallafame

I Cast Conjure Woodland Beings Using Com.name:
我用施法材料施放“召唤林地生物”。
I Cast Conjure Woodland Beings Using Components

Text.text:
那句奥术语句里缠着一丝妖精的口音。我将双手举在身前，以示和平，指间夹着冬青的红莓。空气中裂开一道缝隙，像花朵绽放般舒展，而仙灵的队伍从中踏出，含笑而立，已准备好与我们结成下一小时的盟约。他们躬身致礼，我也回身一礼。
The arcane sentence is laced with a fey accent. I raise my hands before me, a gesture of peace, with holly berries between my fingers. A rift opens in the air like a blooming flower, and through it steps the faerie company, smiling and ready for our alliance of the next hour. They bow, and I bow in return.

I Cheat Off Of Someone's Paper.name:
我抄别人的卷子
I Cheat Off Of Someone's Paper

Text.text:
我故作夸张地扭了扭脖子，双臂高举过头，闭上眼，脸上挤出一副疼得发紧的苦相。我微微睁开眼，从眼缝里偷瞄隔壁桌。见他们正把先前从我记忆里溜走的答案一笔笔写下，我的胃里顿时窜起一阵欢喜与恶作剧般的兴奋。我又配合着演出，悄无声息地打了个哈欠，给自己争取几秒，迅速扫过他们写下的内容，随即俯身贴近自己的桌面。我疯了似的奋笔疾书，把能想起的全都拼命写下来。
I make a show of stretching my neck, lifting my arms over my head, and closing my eyes in a pained grimace. I open my eyes a bit to sneak a peek at the desk next to mine. My stomach alights with delight and mischief as I see them write down the answers that have hitherto escaped my memory. I add a silent yawn to my deceptive play to buy me some time to review their answers before hunkering down over my desk. I furiously scribble down as much as I can remember.

War Story Around A Fire.name:
篝火旁的战争故事
War Story Around A Fire

Text.text:
“——那该死的山坡，我们为了它打了第四回。领主觉得挑冬天再试一次是个好主意。我那时年轻，不问命令，更不问命令从哪儿来。开战那天，暴风雪卷了进来，仿佛从某个被遗忘的地狱冰冷的心脏直扑而至。我们拼命厮杀，可也只是时代问题，终究所有人都得狼狈地四处找地方躲。最后我和敌人挤进一处小洞穴，围着就像这堆一样的火，缩作一团，烤化我们发黑的手指。我们不说同一种话，却把彼此的痛懂得一清二楚。我不再为国王杀人了，只为我自己，而且只在不得不动手的时候。”

~ 由一位英雄构想

“—It was the fourth time we were fighting over that bloody hill. The lord thought it’d be a good idea to try it in winter. I was young, didn’t question the orders, or who they came from. The day of the battle this blizzard rolled in, straight from the icy heart of some forgotten hell. We did our best to fight, but it was only a matter of time before everyone was scrambling for shelter. Ended up in a small cave with my enemy, huddled around a fire just like this one, thawing out our blackened fingers. We didn’t speak the same language but we understood each other’s pain just fine. I don’t kill for kings no more, only for myself, and only when I have to.”

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Forlarren The Fey-fiend.name:
堕精魔——妖精裔邪魔
Forlarren The Fey-fiend

Text.text:
他们的身影怪异而令人隐隐不安——既有超凡的美感，又透着异界的悖谬。那山羊般的特征与萨堤尔颇为相似，可分叉的尾巴如蛇般甩动，向上弯起的缟玛瑙色犄角又为其添上几分魔性的凶邪气息。双眼泛着逼人的血红光芒。

~ 由 Lord Malort 构想

They strike an odd and somewhat unnerving figure—a creature of both sublime beauty and alien wrongness. Their goatlike features are not unlike a satyr, but the forked tail flicking like a serpent, and upturned onyx horns, lend them a fiendish air. Their eyes glow a menacing blood-red.

~ Envisioned by Lord Malort

Rallying Speech About The Burden Of Cowa.name:
关于怯懦重担的激励演讲
Rallying Speech About The Burden Of Cowardice

Text.text:
“在这样的时刻，人很容易心生退意，转身逃回家中的温暖。你们尽可随心而行，但我不能——因为我知道，责任的分量远比怯懦的重担轻得多。”
“At a moment like this, it is tempting to turn away and retreat back to the warmth of our homes. You are all free to do as you wish, but I cannot—because I know the weight of responsibility is so much lighter than the burden of cowardice.”

Moneygrubbing Property Owner.name:
唯利是图的房东
Moneygrubbing Property Owner

Text.text:
一个圆滚滚的男人穿着花哨的条纹马甲站着。一本鼓鼓囊囊的信用簿从他左侧口袋顶出，而右侧口袋里塞着一只厚重的怀表，系在粗大的金链上。他那张饱满、胡茬扎人的脸一看就吃得很好。额头沁着一层薄汗，缓缓渗出，他习惯性地用一方绣有姓名首字母的手帕轻轻按拭。
