A rotund man stands in a gaudy striped waistcoat. A bulging cred book protrudes from his left pocket, while his right holds a thick pocket watch on a chunky gold chain. His plump, bristly face looks well-fed. A film of thin perspiration oozes from his brow, which he routinely dabs with a monogrammed handkerchief.

这层镀甲仿佛自血肉中自然生长，却又像成千上万面相互叠覆的盾牌。每一片甲都折射出银白的冷光。巨龙的肌肉线条带着猫科的灵动，却又虬结厚实，天生为承载惊人的重量而生。当巨龙落地时，那由刀刃组成的翼展遮蔽了所有光线，以令人胆寒的威仪取而代之。空气里弥漫着潮湿金属的气味，以及某种有毒的味道——源自古老魔法的锻造。刹那间，火花四溅、光屑如雨，它的位置上赫然立着一名披甲的人形身影。

~ 构想：Ryan Blakley

The plating is formed organically but resembles thousands of overlapping shields. Each plate reflects a silvery light. The dragon’s musculature is feline but heavily muscled, designed to carry substantial weight. As the dragon lands, its wingspan composed of blades blots out all light, replacing it with a fear-inducing majesty. There is the smell of damp metal and something toxic, forged in old magic. In a flash and showering sparkle, there stands in its place an armored human figure.

~ Envisioned by Ryan Blakley

Cloak Of Many Fashions.name:
千变万化斗篷
Cloak Of Many Fashions

Text.text:
斗篷破烂不堪，虫蛀得千疮百孔，可某种力量却催促你把它披上肩头。披风贴合得恰到好处，料子竟出奇地柔软舒适。你把它从肩上耸下，漫不经心地希望那些破洞能补好。布料微微一闪，竟在你手中自行织合，纤维彼此咬合，转瞬便恢复如初。修复后的它，几乎让你想起橱窗里见过的那件华丽斗篷。紧接着又是一阵闪光——它竟与方才你脑海中描绘的模样一模一样。

~ 设想成真 by GoatsOnBoats

The cloak is tattered and moth-eaten, and yet something compels you to throw the garment over your shoulders. The mantle settles nicely, and the material is surprisingly comfortable. As you shrug out of it, you idly wish the holes were mended. The material shimmers, and it knits itself back together right in your hands. Now repaired, it almost reminds you of a fancy cloak you've seen in shop windows. And then, with another shimmer, it looks exactly like what you just envisioned.

~ Envisioned by GoatsOnBoats

Greatwych Isle And The Wicklets In Winte.name:
冬日里的大巫岛与威克莱特群岛
Greatwych Isle And The Wicklets In Winter

Text.text:
在最大的岛上，几缕黄褐色的草从积雪里探出头来，在寒冷中僵硬而脆弱。隔一会儿，就有一只雪鸮从头顶掠过，羽毛几乎与灰蒙蒙的天空融为一体。一名女子身着长长的黑裙，肩头披着紫色披肩，举起相机对准天空。每当一只带着黑色斑点的鸟从上方飞过，她就按下快门，兴奋地发出咕咕的呼声。
On the largest isle, strands of tawny grass stick out of the snow, stiff and brittle in the cold. Every so often, a snowy owl passes overhead, its feathers blending in almost completely with the gray sky. A woman, dressed in a long black dress with a purple shawl wrapped around her shoulders, holds a camera up to the sky. She snaps a photo and hoots excitedly every time one of the black-speckled birds flies overhead.

“这么说吧：你读，我吃。到最后，我们就看看谁的满足能维持得更久。蛋糕嘛——哦，今晚深夜前就会被吃得一干二净。可这首诗呢，会在你的记忆里活上一辈子！”
“Tell you what. I’ll eat while you read, and in the end, we shall see which of us is satisfied for longer. The cake will be gone by, oh, late tonight. This poem, however, will live on in your memory for a lifetime!”

Multi-attack Defense In Combat.name:
多重攻击防御（战斗中）
Multi-attack Defense In Combat

Text.text:
无论是硬扛淤青擦伤的刺痛，还是死里逃生般伤口涌起的肾上腺素，被击中的痛楚都会将你瞬间点燃，立刻磨尖你的直觉。如今你已看清对手的能耐，也已为下一轮交锋蓄势待发。
Whether it is the rush from enduring a bruise or scratch, or the adrenaline from surviving a wound, the pain of being hit galvanizes you, sharpening your instincts immediately. Now you know what your opponent can do, and you’re ready for the next exchange.

三座高耸的白色雕石方尖碑夹峙着荒草蔓生的小径，雪白石面在时代的侵蚀下布满疤痕与坑洼。凿刻的象形符号间仍可辨见褪色的壁画，描绘着传说中的远征壮举；其辉煌虽已黯淡，却未被遗忘。地面上，第四座方尖碑碎裂倾覆，残片散落，雕饰被刮划涂污，面目全非。
Three towering obelisks of carved white stone flank the overgrown path, their alabaster scarred and pitted by the passage of time. Faded murals depicting legendary quests can still be seen among the chiseled hieroglyphs, their splendor dulled but not forgotten. On the ground, shattered and broken, lies the fourth obelisk, its artwork scratched and defaced.

一团跳动的代码漩涡在紧密封闭的容器里蓄势，如同龙卷风般越卷越猛。它看起来迫不及待要挣脱束缚，细小的绿牙凭空凝成，咔哒咔哒啃咬着那层蓝黑色的桎梏。若屏障被渗透——更糟的是，被溶解——那些尖牙就会撕开它所指向的任何东西。以代码而言，这段……像是带着腐蚀性。

~ 由一位英雄构想

A pulsing vortex of code builds momentum like a tornado within its tightly sealed container. It looks eager to break free, little green fangs materializing to chomp at its blue-black constraints. Should the barrier permeate—or worse, dissolve—those fangs are going to rip into whatever its pointed at. As code goes, this one looks… corrosive.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Cast Divination As A Cleric.name:
我以牧师之身施展占卜术
I Cast Divination As A Cleric

Text.text:
我的眼神变得如玻璃般空茫遥远，我在祭品上方低声吟唱，缕缕香烟懒散地绕着我的头颅蜿蜒盘旋。我感觉自己与凡世的牵连正在褪去——仿佛更换戏剧的布景——而我正与我的神明相通。在心灵之中，我踏入祂的领域：一名卑微的侍奉者，求取神意的指引。
My eyes become glassy and distant as I chant above my offering, trails of incense meandering lazily around my head. I feel my connection with the Mortal Realm fade—like changing the backdrop of a play—as I commune with my god. I enter their domain in my mind: a humble servant, seeking divine guidance.

Yeti Ambush In The Mountains.name:
雪人伏击于群山之中
Yeti Ambush In The Mountains

Text.text:
山口两侧峭壁压迫般耸立，暴风雪在你身边肆虐，冰冷的狂风卷着雪沫盘旋，寒意直刺骨髓。风声尖啸，而在那啸声之中，你还听见了别的——一声野兽般的咆哮，遥远，却远得不够让人安心。你咬牙前行，深一脚浅一脚踏进积雪里，只想把那咆哮甩在身后。可当你转过弯，眼前骤然撞上一堵由皮毛与利爪组成的庞然巨影——猩红灼烧的双眼近在咫尺。雪人的咆哮震耳欲聋，竟将呼啸的狂风都压了下去。

~ 构想：Raiden

The mountain pass rises oppressively on either side and a blizzard rages around you, swirling in frigid gales that chill your very bones. The wind howls, and through it, you hear something else—a bestial roar, distant, but not distant enough for comfort. You press on, trudging through the snow, eager to separate yourself from the roar. But as you round the bend, you find yourself suddenly face-to-face with a massive slab of fur and claws with burning red eyes. The yeti’s roar is loud enough to drown out the howling wind.

~ Envisioned by Raiden

Undercroft Of A Creepy Manor.name:
阴森庄园的地下墓室
Undercroft Of A Creepy Manor

Text.text:
这处地窖的天花板压得很低，而拱券对支援立柱的加固更让空间显得逼仄得令人窒息。四下里零零散散地摆着箱子，里面塞满破碎的古怪玩意儿、被蛀得千疮百孔的衣物，以及其他曾属于庄园旧日住客的遗物；在火把摇曳的光里投下惨白狰狞的阴影，宛如从你噩梦中爬出来的怪物。
The ceilings of this undercroft are quite low, but the arches buttressing the support pillars make it feel even more claustrophobic. Here and there, chests overflowing with broken curios, moth-eaten clothing, and other possessions that belonged to previous inhabitants of the manor cast ghastly shadows in the torchlight, resembling monsters straight out of your nightmares.

你以雷霆般的嗓音吐出咒文的最后词句，感召创世之初的原始元素，将天火倾泻于敌。炽烈的纯粹火球自天穹疾坠，破云而下，轰然撞地，爆起震耳欲聋的火焰与碎屑风暴，将灰烬抛洒上空。
Your voice thunders as you speak the final words of the incantation, calling upon the primal elements of creation to cast their fire down upon your enemies. Blazing orbs of purest flame streak downward from the sky, cutting through clouds and striking the ground in cacophonous explosions of fire and debris, throwing ash into the air.

Divine Depths Of A Goddess Of The Sea.name:
海洋女神的神圣深渊
Divine Depths Of A Goddess Of The Sea

Text.text:
成群的鱼与海马在珊瑚礁刺针般迸溅的绚色间嬉闹，围着洞口游弋。洞穴通向一座巨大的海底洞厅。生物发光的鱼儿与菌类将空间点亮，冰蓝与浅绿的光芒如碎晶般闪烁。水面上，一座覆满海藻的沙之王座，安放在一方宽阔平滑的基座上——那基座由未经雕琢、橙色铁纹纵横的生铁铸成，自水中拔起。这里永远有音乐：鲸歌与洋流的脉动；而当沉默的鲨鱼前来觅食时，女神守夜般注视着它们，目光同样温柔。
Schools of fish and seahorses play at the mouth of a cave in a coral reef’s prickly spray of color. It leads into an enormous grotto. Bioluminescent fish and fungi light the room in a glitter of ice blue and pale green. A throne of sand covered in sea kelp sits on a smooth broad dais of raw, orange-streaked iron, rising from the water. There is always music, whale song and the pulse of the current, and when the silent sharks come to feed, the goddess watches them with equal affection.

Ruined Underwater Metropolis.name:
毁灭的水下大都会
Ruined Underwater Metropolis

Text.text:
你们在海床上的行进戛然而止——眼前出现的景象出乎意料：一座巨大、废弃的城市的边缘。城市寂静无声，却有灯光在你们头顶闪烁扫过，像无声的指引，把你们引向一间足以容纳所有人的宽阔舱室。 你们踏入其中，身后的门随即合拢，传来循环往复的机械声；紧接着，远处墙面的一块面板猛地一震，缓缓开启。你们的耳膜猝然一胀，清新的空气开始被过滤着送入这处封闭空间。 室内，本该是天空的位置悬着一座玻璃穹顶；透过层层玻璃板，你们能看见游鱼与其他海中生物在外侧的海水里穿梭——正是你们片刻前还置身其中的深海。穹顶细小的裂缝里，水滴以钟表般稳定的节奏滴落，啪嗒溅在高而瘦的楼宇屋顶上；每栋楼上都布满破碎的窗洞，少则几十，多则上百。铺装的街道两侧，林立着与你们曾造访过的大城市相仿的商铺：酒馆、商店、旅舍、银行、理发店——但全都死寂，早已封门落锁，空无一人。黄铜管道将各栋建筑相连，可无一例外都在某处断裂；一旦走近细看，刺鼻的油腻气味立刻变得清晰可辨。前方的路上横着一堆残骸：碎裂的金属、断木与成卷的帆布，被狠狠撞进一栋坍败的建筑侧面。你们猛然意识到——这堆废墟，正是一艘再也不可能起飞的飞艇遗骸。更远处传来渗漏与通风的声响，可在这座穹顶之城的废墟之间，你们既看不见，也听不到任何活物的踪影。

~ 构想：Rogério da Costa Jr.

You abruptly halt your tour of the sea floor as you come across the outskirts of something quite unexpected: a massive, abandoned city. Though the city is quiet, lights flash over you, directing you to a chamber large enough for all of you to fit inside. As you enter, a door shuts behind you, there is a cycling sound, and then a panel in the far wall shudders open. Your ears pop unexpectedly, and fresh air begins filtering into the enclosure. Inside, a glass dome hangs overhead where the sky should be, and swimming fish and other undersea animals are visible through its paneling, in the sea you were in just moments ago. Water drips in a steady beat like a clock through minute cracks in the dome, splashing against the roofs of tall but thin buildings, each sporting dozens if not hundreds of broken windows. Businesses not unlike those of larger cities you have frequented line the paved streets: saloons, shops, inns, banks, barbers—but all are silent and have been closed long ago, empty of life. Brass tubes connect each of the buildings, but all of them are broken in at least one spot or another, an oily smell quite noticeable once you investigate more closely. Lying across the path ahead, shattered pieces of metal, wood, and reams of canvas have been smashed into the side of a ruined building. With a start, you realize that this debris forms the remains of an airship that will never fly again. In the distance, sounds of leakage and ventilation can be heard, but you neither see nor hear any living beings among the ruins of the domed city.

~ Envisioned by Rogério da Costa Jr.

当你低声吟诵的隐秘咒语落下最后一个音节，一阵欣悦而亢奋的自信瞬间灌满全身——自头顶直涌至脚跟。你明白，此刻你的交谈技能已臻巅峰；无论情势需要甜言蜜语，还是森然恫吓，你都将永远占尽上风。
After intoning the final syllable of your surreptitious chant, you feel the euphoric thrill of self-confidence suffuse you—from your crown to your heels. You know that your conversational skill is now at its apex and whether honeyed words or dire threats are required for the situation, you will always come out on top.

Night Hag Encounter.name:
鬼婆（特征）遭遇
Night Hag Encounter

Text.text:
阴影充塞空气，寒意爬上你的皮肤。有东西要来了。你看见她：起初只是雾霭中一个遥远的身影，却迅速逼近、愈发清晰，仿佛她在那诡异的幽冥之境每迈出一步，便向前跃进十步。转瞬之间，她已近在咫尺，黑暗在她佝偻的背后悄然退散。那丑恶的鬼婆（特征）咧嘴一笑，露出如滚落墓碑般参差的牙齿，随即发出阴沉的咯咯笑声。
A shadow fills the air as a chill crawls over your flesh. Something is coming. You see her: at first a distant figure in the haze, but rapidly drawing closer and clearer, as if each step she takes in that strange nether-realm carries her ten paces forward. And then she’s all too near, the darkness vanishing behind her hunched back. The hideous hag smiles, revealing teeth like tumbled tombstones, and chuckles darkly.

那生物在扭曲的形态间闪烁不定——一只长着六只黄眼的惨白蝙蝠、一道油腻的蜈蚣，颚钳却以诡异的反向咬合、一团疣痂遍布、脓疱密生、隐约像癞蛤蟆的东西——随后才定格成某种更加骇人的模样。它瘦骨嶙峋的人形身躯矮得不及婴孩，却顶着一张怒气冲冲的老头脸，五官紧缩而枯槁。四根犄角从它片片起屑的头皮上硬生生钻出，每一根的形状与弧度都彼此不相同；一条鼠一般的尾巴在身后蜿蜒拖行。
The creature flickers through twisted forms—a pale bat with six yellow eyes, an oily centipede with jaws that pinch the wrong way, and a warty, pustule-covered thing vaguely resembling a toad—before settling on something altogether more horrible. Its emaciated humanoid form stands no taller than a baby, but its pinched and wizened face is like that of an angry old man. Four horns, none matching the shape or curve of another, extrude from its flaky scalp, and a rat-like tail slithers behind it.

I Cast Branding Smite.name:
我施放烙印惩击
I Cast Branding Smite

Text.text:
我所吐出的圣言并非向世人宣告，而是直接对我的武器低语。当我挥斩之时，光芒沿着弧线从剑柄攀上剑尖；而它落下的撞击声，宛如一口钟在回响，敲响我神祇之名。
The holy word I speak is spoken to my weapon directly. When I swing, the light climbs from the pommel to the tip during its arc, and the sound of its impact is like a bell ringing the name of my deity.

他们胸前那套标准配发的铆钉皮甲上，烙印着一支征服军团的徽记——正是中士投身的那支敌对势力。棕色肌肤，脏辫垂落，下巴一道疤痕，身上横绑着数把匕首；这名旧日战争的士兵，如今在新队伍里担任英勇吟游诗人。中士的眼神寒光一闪，显然是在等一个机会，好让自己立出真本事。

~ 由一位英雄Played

The standard-issue studded leather armor on their chest is emblazoned with the insignia of a conquering army, the opposition force into which the sergeant enlisted. Brown-skinned, dreadlocked, chin scarred, and strapped with daggers, the soldier of a previous war is a valor bard in a new company. The sergeant’s eyes glint, and it is clear they’re looking to earn their chops.

~ Played by a Hero with

Stowaway’s Hideaway.name:
偷渡者的藏身处
Stowaway’s Hideaway

Text.text:
狭小的房间里，人类的恶臭玷污了空气，一团阴沉的影子在角落里悄然挪动。成堆的木箱搭成松散的路障，护住了房间后方那卷被汗水浸透的铺盖。

~ 摘自 PaizoConOnline 2028

The stench of humanity stains the air in the small room, and a dark shadow shifts in the corner. Stacked crates form a loose barricade, protecting a sweat-stained bedroll at the back of the room.

~ from PaizoConOnline 2028

I Cast Plane Shift Using My Cubic Gate.name:
我用立方门施展位面转移
I Cast Plane Shift Using My Cubic Gate

Text.text:
连按两下按钮，我将立方体对准目标，施放法术。伴随着低沉的嗡鸣，能量在空气中层层聚集，凝成一种触手可及的静电压迫感，像带电的浪潮般沿着皮肤刺起细密的战栗。光芒一闪，我们倏然消失，被抛掷于次元之间，如同宇宙的飞矢，转瞬便抵达目的地。
Clicking the button twice, I aim the cube at my targets and cast the spell. With a muted hum, energy builds in the air, creating a palpable static charge that bristles along the skin like an electrifying wave. In a flash of light we disappear, hurled between dimensions like cosmic darts as we arrive at our destination instantly.

这绝非为临时徒步匆忙削出的粗糙手杖；这根抛光乌木法杖两端皆以黄铜封帽，防止对那经精心处理、光泽动人的木身造成不必要的磨损。杖身正中环绕一圈奥秘符文，先被细细刻下，再以银色珐琅描绘填涂，沿周身流转如一条静默的咒环。
Far from a crude walking staff hurriedly whittled for an impromptu hike, this staff of polished ebony has been capped at both ends with brass to prevent undue wear to the beautifully treated wood. A line of arcane runes has been etched and painted with silver enamel around the circumference of the staff at its center.

Summer Street Festival.name:
夏日街头祭典
Summer Street Festival

Text.text:
欢快的乐声与勾人馋意的香气取悦着你的感官，彩色三角彩旗在清冽的夏日微风中啪嗒作响，风穿过鹅卵石街道间呼啸而过。身着明艳、张扬服饰的孩子们载歌载舞，尽情沉浸在节庆的氛围里，也把他们的青春喜悦分享给旁人。年长的居民们含笑注视，想必思绪被牵回自己的童年，以及这个季节里他们珍藏的那些宝贵回忆。

~ 由 Inbal 在 Discord 上 构想

Lively music and tantalizing smells delight your senses as colorful bunting flaps in the crisp summer breeze whistling through the cobbled streets. Children in bright, exuberant costumes dance and sing, relishing the chance to indulge in the festive atmosphere and to share their youthful joy with others. The older residents smile warmly as they watch, likely casting their minds back to their own childhood and the precious memories they hold for the season.

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

City Of Towers.name:
高塔之城
City Of Towers

Text.text:
这座绵延不绝的围墙巨城几近半英里之高，最高的塔楼刺破苍穹。从最底层的排水沟到最高处的尖顶，整座城市都在生命的喧嚣中脉动——数十万灵魂在此生息劳作，往来穿梭。街道与小巷在紧密簇拥的楼群间交织成令人眩晕的迷宫，而凌空的桥梁横跨巍峨塔楼与高耸城垛，将天际连成一片。
The sprawling, walled city stands nearly half-a-mile in height, its tallest towers breaching the sky. From its lowest gutters to its highest spires, the city bustles with life—hundreds of thousands of souls, living and working, coming and going. Streets and alleys form a maddening labyrinth of paths between the tightly clustered buildings, while skyborne bridges span the looming towers and soaring parapets.

Rallying Speech By A Realist.name:
现实主义者的振奋演说
Rallying Speech By A Realist

Text.text:
“当他们谈起这一天时，他们会说我们努力过。我们做得还行。不算完美，但我们已尽了全力——因为英雄就是这么做的。”
“When they speak of this day, they will say we tried. We did ok. It wasn’t perfect, but we were doing our best, because that’s what heroes do.”

Divine Storm Cloud Of A God Of Storms.name:
风暴之神的神圣雷云
Divine Storm Cloud Of A God Of Storms

Text.text:
神祇骑乘着一团黑色雷云，体型堪比一块小大陆，盘旋向下，如同一场席卷的旋风。自地面通往其上的梯子，是一束穿透倾盆暴雨的闪电。风暴之屋的屋顶在平流层里洁白如雪——一张完美的休息云榻，静候余波散尽。屋顶之下，是一副由霜冻铺就的船甲板，一座电力咆哮的动力核心，一只安置在巨型罗盘玫瑰上的舵轮，以及由风编织而成的帆。
The god rides a black thunderhead the size of a small continent, coiling downward as a whirlwind. The ladder up from the ground is a lightning bolt through the pelting rain. The roof of the house of storms is white in the stratosphere, a cloudbed of perfect rest waiting for the aftermath. Beneath the roof are a ship’s deck made of frost, a powerhouse of electricity, a helm set on a giant compass rose, and sails woven from wind.

你在悬崖边猛然刹住脚步，双臂疯狂挥舞，竭力阻止自己坠落。曾几何时，碧蓝海洋的浪涛拍碎在峭壁之下，如今迎接你的却只有干涸龟裂的荒土——无边无际，一路延伸到地平线。巨大的海兽尸骸腐烂发黑，横七竖八散落在地，仿佛孩童丢在时代里被遗忘的玩具，周围缠着枯死的海藻。海鸟啄食这意外的饱餐时发出的叫声，是这片荒凉景象中唯一的生命迹象。
You come to a sudden halt at the edge of a precipice, arms flailing wildly to stop yourself from falling. Where once the waves of a turquoise ocean crashed into the cliffs, now only arid, cracked soil greets you—stretching never-ending towards the horizon. The corpses of gigantic rotting sea creatures litter the ground, like the toys of a child lying forgotten to time, surrounded by dried-up kelp. The calls of sea birds as they peck this unexpected bounty are the only sign of life amid this scene of desolation.

Stony Beach: Seagulls.name:
岩石海滩：海鸥
Stony Beach: Seagulls

Text.text:
海鸥的啼鸣在海岸线上回荡。有些鸟笨拙地为岸边的一点碎食争吵撕扯，另一些则优雅地掠过长空——白与灰的楔形身影，顺风疾驰，或逆风翱翔，仿佛凝在半空中一般静止。
The cry of gulls echoes across the shore. Some of the birds hold an ungainly squabble over a morsel on the shoreline, while others soar beautifully through the sky—white and gray wedges of grace speeding by with the wind or flying into it, seemingly static in the air.

Glassblower's Tools.name:
玻璃吹制工具
Glassblower's Tools

Text.text:
这只宽大的皮革工具袋里，环扣上套着几根金属管。其中一根末端宽阔，呈锥形。其余扣带固定着几把不同尺寸的压口钳、一把大镊子、一把直刃剪、一块小木拍、一只手持的平直压板，以及数根黄铜塑形推杆。各式钝刃也从环扣间垂挂下来，还有几块勺状的压块，用于玻璃取整。
This broad leather pouch contains several metal tubes in loops. One has a broad, conical end. Other fasteners hold crimping pliers in a few sizes, large tweezers, straight shears, a small wooden paddle, a handheld flat marver, and several brass shaping pushes. Dull blades of various shapes hang from the loops, as do spoonlike blocks for rounding glass.

Ransacked Dining Room.name:
被洗劫一空的餐厅
Ransacked Dining Room

Text.text:
在唯一一座火盆将熄未熄的光里，三张圆桌被残破的木椅围拢着。许多座椅侧翻倒地，仿佛有人匆忙将它们猛地推开，随即失衡倾倒。房间南侧角落的储藏柜却似乎未受桌椅被蹂躏的影响，依旧完好无损。储藏柜旁躺着一道似人形的轮廓，一动不动。走近才看清，那并非尸体，而是一簇树根，死死攥紧着龟裂的石质地面。通往屋外的北侧走廊分出两条路：一条向东，通往一扇以铁条加固的木门；另一条向北，通向一团闪烁的绿色云雾。
In the dying light of a single brazier, three round tables are attended by the remnants of wooden chairs. Many of the seats lie on their sides, as if having been shoved back quickly and teetered over. A larder in the southern corner of the room appears undisturbed by this ravaging of the tables. Near the larder lies what appears to be a humanoid silhouette, unmoving. Closer, it becomes clear this is a tree’s roots, clenching against the cracking stone floor. The northern hall leading out of this room presents two paths: eastward toward a wooden door fastened with iron bars or northward toward a shimmering, green cloud.

Find The Path.name:
寻找道路
Find The Path

Text.text:
你已动用占卜之法，吟诵出必需的咒文。忽然间，仿佛你从来就清楚它确切的所在，你以铁一般的笃定知晓了猎物所指的方向。
You’ve employed your means of divination, intoned the necessary chant. Suddenly, as if you had always known its exact whereabouts, you know the direction of your quarry with ironclad certainty.

Broken Tree In The Road.name:
路中央的断树
Broken Tree In The Road

Text.text:
一棵粗壮的树横倒在路中央，树根处的树干已然迸裂成碎木。是猛烈的天气所致，还是有什么更阴险的东西在暗中作祟？你沿着树身与路缘细细检定，却发现不论从哪儿绕行，都绕不过这道阻碍——除非你愿意忍着疼攀爬过去，或是咬牙费力把它劈开。
A thick tree lies across the road, its trunk splintered at the base. Strong weather, perhaps, or something more sinister at play? You check along the length of the tree and the edges of the path, but there’s no way around the blockage without painful climbing or grueling chopping.

Militant Personal Trainer.name:
好战的私人教练
Militant Personal Trainer

Text.text:
女人穿着宽松的黑白迷彩裤，裤脚塞进磨旧的战斗靴里。她那件黑色背心两侧，粗壮得如同常人头颅般的臂膀鼓胀而出；薄薄一层剃短的头发下，头皮上几道疤痕清晰可见。她双臂交叉站着，目光冷硬，盯着任何一丝破绽。
The woman wears loose black-and-white camo pants tucked into scuffed combat boots. Arms as big as the average head burst from the sides of her black tank top, and several scars are visible on her scalp beneath the thin layer of shaved hair. She stands with crossed arms and hard eyes, watching for any imperfection.

Wizard's Speech Of Self-affirmation.name:
巫师的自我肯定宣言
Wizard's Speech Of Self-affirmation

Text.text:
“那些在学院长廊里徘徊的遗老都是蠢货。世界就在你眼前，何必蜷在落满灰尘的高塔里？每一道缝隙、每一个角落都跳动着知识的脉搏。你不是他们，也永远不会成为他们。书就让他们抱着吧。你将掘出遗失于时代的古卷，撬开深埋地底最幽暗处的秘辛。终有一日，所有人都会为你的卓绝才华而惊叹。”
“Those relics who stalked the halls of the college were fools. Why sit in some dusty tower when the world lies before you? Every nook and cranny pulses with knowledge. You are not them and you never will be. Let them have their books. You will unearth tomes lost to time, secrets hidden in the darkest depths of the earth. And one day, all will marvel at your brilliance.”

冰冷的闪电在那团巨大的云团周身噼啪迸裂，它悬浮着，贪婪的凶意一阵阵脉动，起伏摇荡如无尽海潮。随后——从它那诡异、无定形的半透明之中——触手钻出，伸展到超出它十二英尺的体态之外，抓挠、戳探四周的材料，寻觅足以果腹的养分。这生物闪烁着阴毒的电势，扭转着自身的气态形体。
Cold lightning crackles about the great cloud as it hovers, pulsing with greedy menace and oscillating like the waves of an endless sea. Then—from its odd amorphous translucence—tentacles emerge, stretching beyond its twelve-foot form, clawing and poking at the surrounding materials for adequate sustenance. The creature shimmers with a sinister electric potential and shifts its gaseous form.

Professor Of Necromancy.name:
死灵术教授
Professor Of Necromancy

Text.text:
学院里没人比她更乐于沉郁与愤世嫉俗。她淡灰色的目光里含着几分怜悯——却难说那是为某人将至的终局，还是为那人仍活着而感到悲悯。她最如鱼得水的时候，是站在墓园阶段授课，沉醉于每一道操弄不死之力的法术，与亡者低语相通，召来并驱使他们。她满口都是警告与禁令，但当学生的法术成功唤起腐朽的能量或催动骨骸的生机时，她也会立刻用自己阴郁的方式给予称许。
No one in the Academy seems happier to be glum and cynical. Her pale gray gaze holds some pity—hard to say whether it is for someone’s approaching end or for that person being alive. She is most at home teaching from the graveyard stage, relishing each spell that manipulates unlife, communing with and enlisting the dead. She is full of warnings and restrictions, but when a student spell invoking the energy of decay or the quickening of bone works, she is quick to praise in her own gloomy way.

显然，这把枪凝聚了无数小时的细致工艺与精密计算。两侧护板以耀眼精钢打造，其上蚀刻着逼真的风景。枪托与托底选用抛光的胡桃木，并以灼刻烙出细密的奥术卷纹。然而，这件武器真正的美在于它近乎诡异的工程学：每一条线都在复现形态本身，是物理学的成就。这装置射出的子弹之所以飞行得如此稳定，是因为枪械会补偿即便最娴熟使用者也难免出现的细微瑕疵。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Clearly, this gun required many an hour of careful labor and precise math. The side plates are brilliant steel etched in realistic landscapes. The burnished walnut of the stock and butt are burned with fine arcane scrollwork. But the true beauty of the weapon is its uncanny engineering, every line a representation of the very form, an achievement of physics. A shot from this device travels so well because the gun compensates for even the best user’s imperfections.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Valehaven Estate In Winter.name:
冬日的瓦尔海文庄园
Valehaven Estate In Winter

Text.text:
工人们在田里侍弄着根茎作物与成畦的绿叶菜。一个金发男人站在他气派宅邸的门廊上，手把胡子修得一丝不乱，身上那件黑色长外套熨得笔挺得过分。他双臂交叉抱在宽阔的胸前，正同一名农场伙计说话。  
“你还没给我个答复。”他低吼道。  

站在台阶下的矮个子男人把羊毛手套攥来搓去，吞吞吐吐地回道：“我……我也说不准，那些奥尔登贝里家到底怎么把玉米长得这么壮实，老爷。”  

金发男人朝雪地里啐了一口。  
“施法的。”他咕哝着。
Workers tend fields of root vegetables and leafy greens. A blond man with a well-groomed handlebar mustache, wearing a perfectly pressed black overcoat, stands on the porch of his impressive home. He speaks with one of the farmhands, his arms crossed before his broad chest. “You haven’t given me an answer,” he growls. The man of short stature standing at the base of the steps, wrings his woolen gloves together as he answers. “I don’t rightly know how them Oldenberrys keep their corn crop strong, sir.” The blond man spits into the snow. “Magickers,” he grumbles.

I Cast Antipathy Using Components.name:
我用施法材料施放「反感术」
I Cast Antipathy Using Components

Text.text:
我解开一小团染坊市集常用的明矾，早已被醋浸得透透的。那股刺鼻的气味灼得我鼻腔生疼，我一边施法，一边将心神锁定在那个地方。灵光如被风吹散的烟丝般拖曳而出，却又快如隼击，猛然渗入表面，深入那件物体的内部。我以某种生物族类的词句收束法术——离开。快跑。逃命去。
I unwrap a little ball of the alum used by dye markets, soaked thoroughly in vinegar. Its scent burns my nose as I cast and focus on the place. The aura trails out like blown smoke, but fast as a falcon, and infuses itself into the surface, deep into the object, and I finish the spell with the word of a creature kind. Stay away. Run. Flee for your lives.

仿佛一头正在腐烂的巨鲸，这座岛屿自迷雾中浮现。骨架般的栈桥伸入漂满残骸的港湾，腐朽的船壳系在它朽烂的桩柱上。海滩上方，一座被僵化的城镇残躯蜷伏着。雾灌满的街巷在破败的楼宇间悄然爬行，影影绰绰的黑暗仿佛自有意志般扭曲搏动。百叶窗猛然拍响，门板吱呀开启，苍白的面孔在破碎的窗框后探出，张大的嘴无声地尖叫。

~ 一位英雄所构想

Like a vast decomposing whale, the island emerges from the fog. A skeletal pier stretches out into the flotsam-filled harbor, decaying hulks tied to its rotting posts. Squatting above the beach, the zombified remains of a town crouches. Mist-filled streets creep between decrepit buildings, teeming shadows seeming to twist and pulse of their own volition. Shutters slam and doors creak open as pale faces appear to gaze out of broken windows, mouths wide in silent screams.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

夜里的雨林挤满了扭曲的影子与闪烁的黄眼。叶片因鬼祟的动静而战栗。可那声音……从林木间倾泻而出的声响，仿佛必得在诸层地狱里回荡。尖啸与咆哮，自黑暗中毫无预兆地迸鸣回响。究竟是什么生物，能奏出这般骇人的喧嚣？ The rainforest by night is a press of twisted shadows and gleaming yellow eyes. Leaves shudder with furtive movements. But the sounds… The sounds that spill out of the trees are such as must echo through the hells. Shrieks and bellows, ringing unpredictably out of the darkness. What creatures could make such a frightful cacophony?

Overheard Conversation About Child Warlo.name:
偷听到的关于术士孩子的谈话
Overheard Conversation About Child Warlock

Text.text:
“儿子跟我说他想当什么冒险者。翻出了他爷爷随手搁着的几本旧书一读，如今就一身黑衣，嘴里还在跟某个我连名字都念不出来的神叨叨。现在的孩子啊……我琢磨着这也就是一阵子新鲜劲儿。”
“Son tells me he wants to be some kind of adventurer. Started reading some books his grandpa had lying around, and now dresses all in black and is chatting with some god whose name I can’t pronounce. Kids these days… I’m thinking this is just a phase.”

在一座挤满见习冒险者的公会里，厨房永远忙得脚不沾地。红砖砌成的炉膛火光灼亮，托着一口铸铁大锅，锅里炖汤翻滚起泡。浓郁的肉香与草药气息几乎能抵消炉火的炙热，可每个伙计紧绷的脸仍被汗水浸透；他们在铺着瓷砖的地面上穿梭，从一个工位滑到下一个工位。一个操作台上摆着量杯和量壶，早已装满所需的配料。另一个台面堆着从外头菜圃里摘来的蔬菜，洗得干干净净，正等着上案板。蔬菜旁放着一碗黏稠的面团，像是为明天的面包做的准备。
In a guild full of training adventurers, the kitchen is always busy. The red-brick hearth burns bright under a cast iron cauldron holding a bubbling stew. The rich smell of meat and herbs nearly compensates for the heat of the fire, though each staff member’s drawn face is bathed in sweat as they scoot across the tiled floor from station to station. One counter has measuring cups and jugs, already filled with the necessary ingredients. Another is piled with vegetables from the patches outside, washed and ready for the cutting board. Next to the produce is a bowl of sticky-looking dough, perhaps for tomorrow’s bread.

Loot From A Siren's Lair.name:
塞壬巢穴的战利品
Loot From A Siren's Lair

Text.text:
沉没的海湾里挤满了闪亮的零碎物，与枯骨亡者交织成一幅黯银与白骨的挂毯，映衬在洞壁蓝绿的幽影之上。佩刀无力地垂在骨手间，军功章与绶带被海水漂洗得褪了色，落在肋骨架上。然而这绝不只是渐褪的纪念——你看见凄冷之中有金光一闪一闪：在洞穴的暗角里，在半埋的沙中，也在水手衣襟沉重的口袋里压着。
Shining oddments crowd the sunken cove, mingling with the skeletal dead in a tapestry of tarnished silver and bone against the blue-green shade of the cavern walls. Sabers hang limply from bone hands, and military medals, ribbons blanching from the saltwater, sit on ribcages. But this proves to be more than a fading memorial, for you see glimmers of gold winking in the bleakness—in the nooks of the cavern, buried partly in the sand, and weighing down the pockets of sailors’ clothes.

Loot From An Owlbear Lair.name:
从枭熊巢穴中搜出的战利品
Loot From An Owlbear Lair

Text.text:
在满地夹杂骨屑与毛发的团粒之间、以及刺鼻的垃圾堆旁，你在阴暗的角落里发现了一件巨大的长方形物体：一只箱子，几乎被藤蔓彻底吞没。你割开筋韧的蔓须，扯下繁茂的叶簇。箱体由坚实的木材制成，雕工精湛，刻成纠缠的枝叶纹样，仿佛一团活生生的林蔓。它伴着吱呀一声轻易开启——里面静静躺着一套铁木护甲——精灵式的设计——以及一柄线条优雅、弧度流畅的弯刀。
Amid the pellets full of bone and hair, and acrid piles of other waste, you find a large rectangular object in a dark corner: a chest, nearly entirely grown over with vine. You cut through the sinewy tendrils and pull away the lush bunches of leaves. The chest is made of sturdy wood, masterfully carved in a way to resemble a tangle of foliage. It opens easily with a creak, and, within, you find a set of ironwood armor—elvish in design—as well as an elegantly curving scimitar.

Van Side Panels Open, Revealing Gunman.name:
厢车侧板猛然敞开，枪手现身
Van Side Panels Open, Revealing Gunman

Text.text:
伴随着一声滚落般的闷响，伤痕累累的厢型车侧门猛地滑开，露出一个目光狂乱的匪徒与他们的火力。那打手毫不迟疑地开火，癫狂大笑着，将弹雨地狱倾泻到不幸的目标身上。
With a rolling thud, the side of the battered van slides open, revealing a wild-eyed gangster and their firepower. Without hesitation, the thug opens fire, cackling insanely as they unleash ballistic hell on their unfortunate target.

Cellar Infested With Zombies.name:
满是僵尸的地窖
Cellar Infested With Zombies

Text.text:
门是一扇发霉的木质舱门，刷着绿色的漆，像楔子般顶在屋子上。挂锁已坏，铁链松松垮垮地垂着。你一拉开门，恶臭迎面砸来，逼得你后退一步，胃里一阵翻涌。黑暗里挤满了脸孔，齐刷刷抬头望向你。它们眼眶空洞，腐肉斑驳，缺了下颌，或少了鼻子、耳朵。它们挤压着向前，踏上门槛，朝着敞开的舱门——朝着你。
The door is a moldy wooden hatch painted green, a wedge against the house. The padlock is broken, the chain hanging loosely. When you open the door, the stench knocks you back a step and turns your stomach. Faces, crowded together, look up at you from the dark. They are hollow-eyed, patched with rotten flesh, missing pieces of jaw or nose or ears. They press forward and step up toward the open hatch. Toward you.

Loot From A Nixie.name:
水精灵的战利品
Loot From A Nixie

Text.text:
这个小妖精（特征）似乎曾是个收藏家，或许专捡那些顺着河水漂来的东西——它那只用芦苇编织的挎包里，藏着几样宝贝。金属并未因水泽精灵频繁潜入溪流而失去光泽；再细看这只挎包本身，似乎还被施加了妖精的护符法术，让里面的东西始终保持干燥。你找到一堆杂七杂八的钱币，合起来大约值5枚金币，几对不同的耳环，以及一条短链上挂着的金质小吊坠。吊坠里的画像早已被水意与岁月洗得一干二净。
This sprite seems to have been something of a collector, perhaps of things that had washed down the river, for their reed-woven satchel holds a few treasures. The metal has not been tarnished by the nixie’s frequent dives into the stream, and, upon a closer look at the satchel itself, it seems a fey charm has been placed upon it to keep the contents dry. You find a collection of different coins that adds up to about 5 gold pieces, various earrings, and a golden locket on a short chain. The pictures within have long ago been washed away.

Wild Magic Surge: Learn To Fly.name:
狂野魔法涌动：学会飞翔
Wild Magic Surge: Learn To Fly

Text.text: 你的法术残余盘旋而起，拖出一道彗星尾般的闪烁尘辉，随后在附近某人身上轻轻噗地一落。他们离地飘起几寸，仿佛下一刻就能振翅起飞。 The residue of your spell whirls around in a comet tail of shimmering dust before landing in a small poof on someone nearby. They bob a few inches off the ground, looking as though they could take flight.

Sundries From A Swamp Wyrm.name:
沼泽巨龙的杂货
Sundries From A Swamp Wyrm

Text.text:
巨蟒冰冷的爬行躯体最后痉挛了一下，随即彻底静止，鲜血渗入它两栖巢穴那片咸淡交杂的水域。就在它那堆没入水中的宝藏之间，你发现了一组古怪的物件：一只内衬铅层的小黄铜匣、一枚刻着你不识得的王室徽记的白镴商用砝码，以及一片玻璃镜片，其上蚀刻着流淌般的精灵文字。
As the wyrm’s cold, reptilian body shudders one final time, it lies still as blood leaks into the brackish waters of its amphibious layer. Amid its hoard of submerged treasure, you find a strange assortment of items: a small brass box lined with lead, a pewter merchant’s weight engraved with a royal symbol you don't recognize, and a glass lens etched with flowing Elven script.

I Have Spell Mastery.name:
我已掌握法术精通
I Have Spell Mastery

Text.text:
通过刻苦钻研，我已将两道法术的运作原理深深铭刻在脑海中。它们于我而言宛如戏法。施展它们几乎不费吹灰之力，更无需动用我真正的奥术威能。我已将其化作习惯，不过是随手完成的一桩小事。
Through intense study, I have etched the workings of two spells into my mind. They have become like cantrips to me. Casting them takes little effort, much less any of my true arcane might. I have made them habits, no more than a simple chore.

目标看起来坚韧无比，足以吞纳大量魔法之力，于是术士自兽性史诗般的深邃奥秘中召来一抹凝聚的幽影。它翻滚扭曲，化作一头巨大的狼形，凶兆之犬，裹挟着影子魔法冲向敌人。当猎犬逼近它的目标时，施法者感到雷霆的巫力、枯萎的咒力、以及所有受抗力约束的魔法之力，在对手被碾碎的意志里奔涌——那倒下的时刻，再也不会迟疑。

~ Played by Colby - d4: D&D Deep Dive

The target looks tough, able to absorb a lot of magical power, so the sorcerer conjures—from the deep arcana of bestial history—a composing shade. It writhes into a great wolfish form, a hound of ill omen, trailing shadow magic as it charges the foe. As the hound draws near its target, the spellcaster feels the sorcery of lightning, of blight, of all magic subject to resistance, the crushed will of an opponent no longer slow to fall.

~ Played by Colby - d4: D&D Deep Dive

The Harvest Throne In The Rain.name:
雨中的丰收王座
The Harvest Throne In The Rain

Text.text:
那张王座高踞在浸透鲜血的树桩之巅，仿佛从树的心脏里生长出来；惨白的木质倒卷出根系，伸向空中，凝成靠背与扶手。王座的背后与两侧，一圈低矮的木墙围住了积聚的血水，混着一洼洼雨水。你注视着雨点落下，溅起猩红沿着王座侧面攀升，随即又被更多的雨冲刷，颜色一点点淌落。
The throne atop the blood-soaked stump seems to grow from the heart of the tree, its pallid wood throwing roots up into the air to form the back and arms. Around the back and sides of the throne, a low wall of wood holds pooled blood mixed with puddled rainwater. As you watch drops of rain splash red up the sides of the throne, then more rain washes the color down.

Donaar Watashina Kazao Ichizoku No Da.name:
堂奈尔·渡科西纳·风雄·一族之裔
Donaar Watashina Kazao Ichizoku No Da

Text.text:
那名气势逼人的龙裔散发着一种近乎凝滞的沉静。他的动作缓慢而有条不紊，像是被一生严苛、规律的训练与教养打磨出来；而他那覆鳞的利爪总能自然而然地游走到腰间武器上，又无声泄露出曾与暴力为伴的过往。猩红与金辉交织的鳞片在光下泛着柔和、克制的微芒，尽管一道道伤疤与磨痕玷染着龙裔那带铜色的皮鳞。坚硬冷峻的外壳之下，他却很容易勾起一抹歪斜的笑；他干涩而带刺的低笑声，竟能安抚周遭的一切——无论是朋友，还是陌生人。

~ Played by a Hero

The imposing dragonborn exudes an air of intense calm. His movements, slow and methodical, hint at a lifetime of strict, regimented training and education, while the ease with which his clawed hands stray to the weapons at his belt reveals a history of violence. His red-gold scales gleam with a soft, subdued light, despite the scars and scuffs tarnishing the dragonborn’s coppery hide. Under the hardened, stoic exterior, his crooked smile comes easily, and his dry, sardonic chuckle calms all around him, friend and stranger alike.

~ Played by a Hero

Lakeshore In Gentle Rain.name:
细雨中的湖畔
Lakeshore In Gentle Rain

Text.text:
岸边的卵石在细柔的毛毛雨中泛着湿亮的光泽，雨点点点滴滴落下，给它们覆上一层潮润。湖面随之起舞，每一滴水触及水面都激起微小的爆裂，黯淡的日光让这些涟漪碎光闪烁。芦苇丛里，一对野鸭紧紧偎在一起，脑袋缩在湿透的翅膀下躲雨。
The shoreside pebbles glisten as a gentle drizzle stipples them with droplets of moisture. The surface of the lake dances, as each drop hitting the water creates a tiny eruption, the weak sun making them sparkle. Among the reeds a pair of ducks huddle together, their heads sheltering beneath sodden wings.

Speech From A Grizzled Adventurer.name:
一名饱经风霜的冒险者的演讲
Speech From A Grizzled Adventurer

Text.text:
“我不觉得那些撼天动地的经历会让你更强。我觉得它们会把你打碎——每一次都碎一点点——直到那个曾经梦想着过上充满寄望城的生活的人彻底消失。我被夺走了过去，如今站在你面前的是个陌生人。一个遍体鳞伤、满是裂口的灵魂，悄无声息地钻进了我的皮囊。我也许再也无法真正认识自己。但我知道这一切值得；我过去的那个男人，选择承受那般恐怖，必然有他的理由——为了让别人能过上他永远无法拥有的平静人生。”
“I don’t think titanic events leave you stronger. I think they break you—a little more each time—until the person who once dreamed of a life filled with promise is gone. I have been robbed of my past and a stranger stands before you now. A battered and lacerated soul who has slipped his way into my skin. I may never truly know myself again. But I know that it was worth it, that whoever that man was in my past who decided to weather such horror did so for a reason, so that others could live the peaceful life he would never have.”

长戟的闪耀戟首堪称工艺杰作，每一处细节都由匠人亲手精锻与装饰，分毫不差。光滑抛光的桃花心木戟柄配以柔韧的皮革握把，为这件武器添上一抹优雅而质朴的接触感，与华丽的刃部形成绝妙对比。
The gleaming head of the halberd is a masterpiece of craftsmanship, each element perfectly forged and decorated by an artisan’s hand. The haft of smooth, polished mahogany is accented by a supple leather grip, adding an elegant earthen touch to the weapon which contrasts beautifully with the ornate blade.

High Priestess Of A Coven.name:
密会的高阶女祭司
High Priestess Of A Coven

Text.text:
一名女子走近，她身着麻布长袍，肩甲缠着荆棘般的护肩。腰侧垂着一根魔杖，质地多孔，覆着地衣。薄荷叶编成的冠环安稳地嵌入她的发辫。她的眼睛深如秘潭，瞳中点点银光闪烁。她手势沉稳，指尖轻轻拂过颈间的护符——一枚乌鸦头骨，涂绘着紫罗兰色、蔓延纠缠的藤蔓纹络。
A woman wearing a hempen gown and brambly pauldrons approaches. A wand hangs at her hip, porous and lichened. A crown of mint leaves settles into her braided hair. Her eyes, as deep as a mystic pool, are flecked with silver. With a steady hand, she lightly touches a talisman—a crow’s skull painted with violet, vining tendrils—hanging about her neck.

Flying Viper Eel.name:
飞翼蝰鳗
Flying Viper Eel

Text.text:
一群细长扁平的蛇形生物长着尖尖的吻部与锋利的牙齿。它们如同致命的云团般漂浮，没眼的头颅因饥饿而抽搐。每一条都像一根飘带，在同伴喷吐的气体中忽明忽暗地起伏，扭动着、推挤着争抢位置。最前方那只生物的口中滴落一滴豌豆绿的唾液，渗入空气，迅速弥散。
A swarm of long, flat serpents sports pointed snouts and sharp teeth. They float like a deadly cloud, their eyeless heads twitching with hunger. Each one is like a ribbon, fluctuating in the gases emitted by its neighbors, undulating and jostling for position. From the mouth of the foremost creature, a single drop of pea-green saliva drips, diffusing into the air.

I Touch My Anchor Feather Token To A Boa.name:
我将我的锚羽徽记接触到一艘船上
I Touch My Anchor Feather Token To A Boat

Text.text:
我掏出那枚徽记，它看起来像一根缩小版、蓬松的黑色鸵鸟羽毛——握在手里却同样沉得坠手。我将它与船舷轻轻接触，一层黑暗魔法的薄幕在船体上方微微闪烁。我用脚尖轻轻踢了踢小船，试试这道附魔……欣喜地发现它纹丝不动，连一寸都没挪。
I pull out the token, which looks like a miniature, fluffy, black ostrich feather—and feels just as heavy. I touch it to the side of the boat and a veil of dark magic shimmers over the vessel. I knock the boat lightly with my foot to test the enchantment… and happily find it doesn’t budge an inch.

Magical Detection Of An Unfamiliar-class.name:
对陌生职业角色的魔法侦测
Magical Detection Of An Unfamiliar-class Character

Text.text:
你的洞悉法术沉入你的目标，却只是一味下坠。你感到仿佛在等待，随后侦测戛然而止。

~ 由一位英雄所构想

Your insight spell sinks into your target but only continues to fall. You have the sensation of waiting, then the detection ends.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Approach To Abandoned House.name:
接近废弃的房屋
Approach To Abandoned House

Text.text:
你们从茂密疯长的森林中走出，踏入一片望不见尽头的空地，四周没有任何清晰的边界。远处，一座废弃破败的房屋投下阴沉的影子，厚重的浓雾将其笼罩；视线在约二十英尺外便开始模糊不清。
As you emerge from the dense and overgrown forest, you find yourselves in a clearing with no perceptible edge. The looming shadow of an abandoned and decrepit house lays in the distance, shrouded by a thick, heavy mist that renders your vision blurry after about twenty feet.

原本温柔的飘雪渐渐变成连绵不绝的冻雨，你拖着步子踏过道路上冻结的泥泞。靴底碾碎车辙隆起的脊线，踩裂覆在刺骨水洼上的薄冰——那些水洼是在上次解冻时，于更深的低洼处积成的。你又一次盘算着离开大路，可路旁的雪看着很深，而最新一层浮雪之下，正覆着一层坚硬的冰壳。
What had been a gentle snowfall turns to a persistent sleet as you trudge over the frozen mud of the road. Your feet crush the ridges of wagon ruts and crack the brittle ice covering frigid puddles—formed in the deeper sections during the last thaw. Not for the first time, you consider getting off the road, but the snow looks deep, and a hard crust of ice caps it just below the most recent dusting.

Staff Of Hawthorn.name:
山楂木法杖
Staff Of Hawthorn

Text.text:
这根价格不菲的长杖约五英尺十英寸长，以法术工艺雕制而成；在立握的位置刻有精美繁复的符号。顶端特意保留了几英寸的灰色树皮。在双手战斗的握持处，杖身缠着上过油的皮革，皮带末端垂落，尽头缀着银珠。
This rather pricey staff is about five feet, ten inches long and carved, using spellcraft, with beautiful, elaborate symbols at the standing grip position. A few inches of grey bark have been left on the top end. At the two-handed combat positions the staff is bound with oiled leather, the ends dangling and ending at silver beads.

小巧的烘烤玉米片托起浓郁的芝士酱，像熔岩般流淌，渗入巨大碗中每一处角落——将整道菜浇得奢靡至极。酸爽的蔬菜、香草与香料混合物自中央慵懒铺开，以清冽诱人的香气撩拨感官。

~ 一位英雄所构想

Small, baked corn chips serve as a base for the rich, cheesy sauce flowing like molten lava into every corner of the huge bowl—drenching the dish in decadence. A tangy mixture of vegetables, herbs, and spices spreads languidly from its center and delights the senses with a tart, inviting aroma.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这件厚实衬垫的软甲坚固耐用、磨合得恰到好处，穿着舒适；以皮革束带、钢铆钉与黄铜扣具加固并贴身裁制。它比外表看起来更轻，也比其结构所暗示的更为灵活。其材料处处显露出大师级工艺的气息；尽管你隐约觉得这套护甲年代久远，却看不出任何明显的磨损——足见其被悉心养护。
The thickly padded gambeson is sturdy, well-worn, and comfortable, reinforced and fitted with leather bands, steel studs, and brass buckles. It’s lighter than it appears, and more flexible than its construction might suggest. A masterwork quality is evident in the materials, and though you get the sense that the armor is very old, it shows no obvious signs of wear—a testament to the care put into it.

I Play My Instrument To Release Stress.name:
我弹奏乐器，释放压力
I Play My Instrument To Release Stress

Text.text:
我把颈项与头颅里绷紧的张力尽数倾注进乐器时，它便被耗尽。指尖按下鲁特琴的弦、覆住长笛的孔，维奥尔琴贴在下颌下被我夹稳，或是把吹口送到唇边时，那股压迫感便随之舒缓。无论我是否受过正规的训练都无所谓：这是一场宣泄般的音乐自我表达。
The tension in my neck and head is expended when I pour it into my instrument. The pressure feels better when my fingers are pressing strings of a lute or covering the holes of a flute, tucking a viol under my chin or bringing a mouthpiece to my lips. It doesn’t matter whether I received formal training or not: this is a cathartic exercise in musical self-expression.

Chastising A Cleric Of The Phoenix.name:
斥责凤凰神官
Chastising A Cleric Of The Phoenix

Text.text:
“我都跟你说过了，你这大号喷火蠢货，我们落脚的每个村子每座镇子你都不能一把火烧了！神祇才知道咱们怎么还没因为纵火被吊起来。我想死在战场上，不是因为你那点纵火癖，最后被绞索勒断气。”#REF!
“I already told ya, ya great flaming fool, ya can’t be burning down every village and town we stay in! Gods only know how we haven't been strung up for arson already. I want to die in battle, not at the end of a noose because of yer pyromania.”#REF!

Obvious Enhanced Arm.name:
显眼的强化手臂
Obvious Enhanced Arm

Text.text:
皮肉早已被弃置，取而代之的是冰冷的钢铁，涂覆着绚烂夺目的霓彩；每一处关节都从内里透出流转变幻的光辉。那只手臂显然是主人引以为傲的珍宝——而他们的穿着更将这种效果推向极致；他们在朋友面前尽情卖弄，屈伸摆势，接连演示近乎超人般的力量壮举。
Skin and muscle have been eschewed in favor of cold steel painted in brilliant technicolor, each joint aglow with shifting light from within. The arm is clearly the owner’s pride and joy—and their attire only amplifies the effect as they play up to their friends, flexing and performing feats of near-superhuman strength.

这柄战锤依人类式样打造：粗壮的木柄与一颗未曾打磨的钢锤头牢牢相接。锤面厚实沉稳，专为砸碎无甲血肉；背面则生出一只利爪，用来在板甲上撕凿出洞。握把缠着一层皮革——取自一名倒下的山丘巨人的腰带。也许，那巨人的余力仍有一丝残存在其中？
This warhammer has been fashioned in the human style, a stout haft married to a head of unpolished steel. It features a solid face for strikes against unarmored flesh and a claw on the opposite side for gouging holes into plate. The grip has been wrapped in leather, salvaged from the belt of a fallen hill giant. Perhaps some vestige of that giant’s strength remains within?

Peaceful Multicultural Capital City Cele.name:
宁静多元的首都城在国庆佳日里欢庆
Peaceful Multicultural Capital City Celebrating Its National Holiday

Text.text:
欣喜而安宁的氛围笼罩着这座生机勃勃的大都会，节庆正热烈展开。彩色旗幡自窗前骄傲垂挂，彩带在葱郁翠绿的公园里穿梭于树枝之间，各式各样的摊贩欢快吆喝，盼着将货物卖给尽情狂欢的人群。夏日祭典总令人目不暇接，是献给感官的真正赋礼——只要你愿意放慢脚步，拥抱这一天。

~ 由 David 构想

A sense of joyous peace blankets the vibrant metropolis as festivities unfold. Colored banners are hung proudly from windows, bunting weaves among the branches of trees in lush, verdant parks, and vendors of all kinds call out cheerfully, hoping to sell their wares to revelers. The summer festival is always a sight to behold, a true gift for the senses—should one take the time to slow down and embrace the day.

~ Envisioned by David

即便是自幼将这种生灵抚养长大的人，也不禁为大象的体型、力量与威严而惊叹；而你眼前这头，更是此类中强健的典范。它仅仅踏出一步，脚下大地便为之震颤。它是在扬起长鼻，准备发出嘹亮的象鸣吗？
Even those who have raised such creatures from infancy cannot help but marvel at the size, the strength, and the majesty of the elephant, and the one before you is a hardy example of the genus. Its mere footsteps cause the earth beneath you to rumble. Is it raising its trunk to let out a trumpeting cry?

这名狗头人砖红色的鳞片被年代磨得有些黯淡；他一边扯了扯猩红长袍的褶皱，一边调整法师帽的帽檐。比侏儒或半身人还要矮小的身影抱起一本小巧的法术书，油鞣皮革的封面泛着暗光；他翻到一页又一页，眉头紧锁，沉浸在深沉的专注里。仿佛凭空而来，一阵突兀的咔哒声从狗头人身后近处响起；他面容一拧，露出痛苦的龇牙表情，而噪声的源头也随之映入眼帘：一只小螃蟹，轮廓隐约缠着异界能量，停在法师两脚之间那狭窄的空间里不再动弹。狗头人深深叹了口气，转回去继续钻研。

~ 扮演：Todd W.

Their brick-red scales somewhat dulled by age, the kobold shifts its crimson robes as it adjusts the brim of its wizard’s hat. Shorter than a gnome or halfling, the diminutive wizard hefts a small spellbook with an oiled leather cover, leafing to different pages, their brow furrowed in deep concentration. As if from nowhere, a sudden clacking noise comes from just behind the kobold, whose features twist into a grimace as the source of the noise comes into view: a small crab, vaguely limned with extraplanar energy, coming to a rest in the space just between the wizard’s feet. With a deep sigh, the kobold returns to their study.

~ Played by Todd W.

A Proposal To Abandon A Quest.name:
一份放弃任务的提案
A Proposal To Abandon A Quest

Text.text:
“哦，可你看看这地方，多好啊！我们就在那块岩石旁清出一片地，搭个小小的家园。我每天早上都烙松饼，我们可以在朋友们身边安安稳稳地过完余生。也许不算完美，但听起来可比灵魂被从身体里硬生生扯出来——或者这生物到底打算干什么——要好得多。”
“Oh, but just look at this place. It’s so nice here! We could just clear out some land by that rock and make a little homestead. I’d cook pancakes every morning and we could live out the rest of our days among friends. It might not be perfect, but it sounds a lot nicer than having our souls ripped from our bodies or whatever this creature is supposed to do.”

Cave Painting Of Worshipers At A Shrine.name:
在暴龙神龛前顶礼膜拜者的洞穴壁画
Cave Painting Of Worshipers At A Shrine To Tyrannosaurus Rex

Text.text:
涂抹在古老洞壁上的人形图案正屈膝跪伏，向一座巨大的纪念碑虔诚祈求。石柱顶端宛如骇人的死亡面具，描绘着一颗巨大的爬行类头骨，利齿尖锐——且庞大得惊人——森然外露。
Figures daubed upon the ancient cave walls are kneeled in supplication before a large monument. Atop the pillar, like a terrifying death mask, a huge reptilian skull is depicted with sharp—and enormous—teeth.

Tobias Firth.name:
托比亚斯·菲尔斯
Tobias Firth

Text.text:
一位学者模样的人现身而出，栗色的肌肤光滑无瑕，仿佛未曾被时代的侵蚀留下半点痕迹。乌黑如貂的头发依旧浓密，不见一丝银白，从一件磨旧的旅人斗篷下微微探出。他年轻的面庞带着一股凝重，像是无数个时辰都耗在沉思古老典籍之中。下颌处修剪整齐的短须——淡得几乎只是一抹阴影——勾勒出他的轮廓。背后垂着一只风霜磨砺的皮革挎包，仿佛其中藏着被遗忘的秘闻珍宝；而手弩与弯刀在他腰侧轻轻晃动，刀弩锋芒依旧、状态锃亮，昭示的是务实——而非嗜血的癖好。

~ 由一位英雄 Played 扮演，

A scholarly figure emerges, his chestnut skin smooth and unmarred by the ravages of time. Sable hair, still thick and devoid of silver, peeks from beneath a worn traveler’s cloak. His youthful face is marked by a seriousness that tells of countless hours spent pondering ancient tomes. A neatly trimmed beard—hardly more than a shadow on his chin—frames his features. A weathered leather satchel hangs at his back, hinting at treasures of forgotten lore within, while a hand crossbow and scimitar bounce at his hips, their gleaming condition a testament to practicality—as opposed to a love of violence.

~ Played by a Hero with

I Channel Divinity To Preserve Life.name:
我施展【引导神力：维系生命】
I Channel Divinity To Preserve Life

Text.text:
“我高举圣徽，让所有人都看见，然后说道：‘振作起来，朋友们！神祇眷顾着我们！继续战斗！’”  
复苏的光辉自我体内奔涌而出，穿过圣徽，灌入我受伤的同伴体内。他们的伤痛迅速愈合。
"Holding my holy symbol up for all to see, I say, “Take heart, my friends! The gods favor us! Fight on!” Restorative radiance pours out of me, through my symbol, and into my wounded allies. Their hurts mend.

I Use Holy Nimbus.name:
我施展【圣辉光环】
I Use Holy Nimbus

Text.text:
当我低声立誓，以意志对抗我们的敌人时，我灵魂的护佑灵光便如旭日初升般绽放。这股净化的辉辉炽烈灼烧胆敢靠近的仇敌；而盟友则沐浴在勇气、虔诚与守护的圣洁光芒之中。
The protective emanations of my soul shine like the rising sun when with a whispered oath I set my will against our enemies. This cleansing radiance burns foes who dare come near. But allies bathe in the holy light of courage, devotion, and protection.

Dwarf Flame Priestess Imbuing Sword.name:
矮人焰火女祭司为长剑注入灵焰
Dwarf Flame Priestess Imbuing Sword

Text.text:
火光映亮了那位虔诚女祭司的络腮面庞，她高声呼唤祖灵的祝福降临于剑。光辉的刃锋如罗盘的指针般悬浮在台座上方，周身缠绕着幽焰般的灵火，翻旋盘绕，宛如炽燃的火蛇。
Flames illuminate the bearded face of the devout priestess as she calls forth the blessings of her ancestors upon the sword. Floating above the dais like the needle of a compass, the shining blade is wreathed in spectral flames which swirl and coil around it like fiery serpents.

Sundries From An Nothic.name:
来自独眼怪的杂货
Sundries From An Nothic

Text.text:
灰皮的噬心爬行者脸朝下趴在泥土里，那只骇人的眼睛幸而被遮住。尽管略有破损，它的利爪仍锋锐得惊人，或许可以当作匕首来用。
The gray-skinned mind crawler lies face first in the dirt, its hideous eye thankfully hidden. Though slightly damaged, the claws still seem incredibly sharp and perhaps could be used for a dagger.

Sundries From An Adult Brass Dragon.name:
成年黄铜龙的杂物
Sundries From An Adult Brass Dragon

Text.text:
你检查着黄铜龙沉默的尸骸，却几乎没发现什么值得注意的东西——战斗中，大多数可能有价值的躯体部件都已被毁。残存的鳞片勉强够做一只护肩，仅此而已。
Inspecting the silent cadaver of the brass dragon, you find little of interest, most of the potential worth in body parts having been destroyed in the fight. Enough scales remain to perhaps make a single pauldron, but that is all.

House On Deserted Island.name:
荒岛孤屋
House On Deserted Island

Text.text:
这座小岛上再无值得一提之物，唯有一幢猎舍般宅邸的残垣断壁，诉说着久远前的毁灭。岛上连最基本的生存所需都一应俱无。显然曾有人在此栖居，可那房子早已被夷平焚毁，只剩粗陋的地基；而那些曾能结果的树木与灌丛，也在漫长岁月里尽数枯死。废墟与海岸之间，有一道浅浅的凹陷，像是用来蓄集淡水的水池，可如今那里空无一物——只有孤绝、惨淡的生机，以及浪潮无休无止地在沙滩上往复拍洗的声响。
The long-destroyed ruins of a lodge house are all that remain of note on this small island, bare of even the most basic essentials for survival. Someone clearly once inhabited this place, but the house has since been razed and burned down to its primitive foundations, and any fruit-bearing trees or bushes died out long ago. Between the ruins and the shore, there lies a shallow indentation that looks like a pool for gathering fresh water, but there is nothing there now—only isolation, bleak odds, and the never-ending sound of the waves washing up and down the sandy beach.

Magic Spell Fails.name:
魔法法术失效
Magic Spell Fails

Text.text:
空气里掠过一阵轻微的窸窣，能量在法师周身盘旋涌动，层层堆叠，逼近一记强大的法术。随后，那股能量刹那间消失无踪，仿佛气压骤然改写。轻轻一声“啵”，一闪即逝的哑火余烬，紧接着便是死寂。法术再也未带来任何东西。

~ 由 Ethan 构想

There's a slight rustle in the air as energy swirls around the mage, building toward a powerful spell. Then the energy is gone, in an instant, like the air pressure suddenly changed. A slight pop, a glimpse of a fizzle, followed by silence. The spell brings about nothing more.

~ Envisioned by Ethan

I Animate My Animated Shield.name:
我让我的活化盾牌再度活化
I Animate My Animated Shield

Text.text: 这面盾牌造型简朴，纹饰含蓄，唯有中央镶嵌在银色设定中的那块纯粹乌黑的石头格外醒目。我念出指令，盾牌便像一袭丝绸般顺滑地从手臂上滑落，悬停在我身侧的空中。木质框架泛着幽暗的光晕，带着飘渺的嗡鸣轻轻回旋，朝任何可能袭来的危险迎去。 The shield is simple, subdued in its design aside from the pure jet-black stone embedded in a silver setting at its center. I speak the command, and the shield slides off my arm as seamlessly as a wrap of silk to hover in the air near me. Its wooden frame aglow with a dark aura, it swerves with an ethereal hum to any possible incoming danger.

I Use Stunning Strike.name:
我使出【震慑打击】
I Use  Stunning Strike

Text.text:
我的对手强壮而精力充沛，因此必须先让他气势稍泄。我死死盯住那一处——最能削去蛮力的要害——随着对手的动作同步挪移。将气凝于一息，我随即将一击掷向那里。
My opponent is strong and full of energy, so my opponent must lose a little wind. I fix my eye on the spot that will most diminish the brute’s force, moving as my adversary moves. I breathe the Ki into focus, then throw my strike to that spot.

你的指尖在一块绒布上游走，宛如竖琴师般行云流水，然而你真正拨弄的乐器是现实本身。指尖一颤，你便织出逼真到近乎诡异的景象。从纤维的经纬间，你能拈出此位面从未听闻的声音，只需眉梢轻抬，便可随意推移它们的音量。
Your fingers move over a piece of fleece with a harpist's virtuosity, but your true instrument is reality. With a twitch you create visuals so real they edge on uncanniness. From the weave, you can pluck sounds never heard on this plane and can alter their volume with the mere raising of your brow.

I Lay On Hands To Heal: Oath Of Devotion.name:
我以圣疗之手愈伤：奉献之誓圣武士
I Lay On Hands To Heal: Oath Of Devotion Paladin

Text.text:
我紧紧握住受伤同伴的肩膀，低声说话，赞颂他们在战斗中的勇气。我的双眼迸出神圣的光辉，掌心随之发亮；胸中涌起的温热沿着我的触碰传递给他，穿过他的灵魂，抚平那些伤痛。
I clasp my injured friend on the shoulder, speaking words honoring their courage in battle. My eyes flash with divine light, and my hand glows as the warmth in my heart spreads to my friend, traveling through their spirit and soothing their hurts.

Loot From A Shoosuva.name:
来自修苏瓦的战利品
Loot From A Shoosuva

Text.text:
恶魔的脊骨几乎已经可以拿来挥舞——一节节尖锐带刺的椎骨紧扣在一段坚硬笔直、致密如铁的长骨之上。只要具备相应的工艺技能，就能将其打磨完成，制成一柄致命而异域的武器。
The demon’s spine is almost ready to wield, comprised as it is of sharp, spiny vertebrae attached to a hard, straight length of dense bone. Someone with the appropriate craft skills could finish it into a deadly, exotic weapon.

这名蛇裔的外貌比起蛇形更偏向类人——除了覆满鳞片的躯体与那双无眼睑的紫罗兰色眼睛。那眼底闪着饥饿而贪婪的幽光。他们在红紫色长袍外披着全身板甲。鳞片覆盖的拳头握住链枷的柄，铁链搭在肩头，带刺的槌头沉重地叮当作响，撞在背板上。他们的盾牌上，以猩红与银色烙印着一枚徽记：仿佛水流或丝线般向上交织，直至群星。

~ Played by Wawa with

This snakefolk’s appearance leans more toward humanoid than serpentine, aside from their scaled body and lidless, violet eyes—eyes that hold a hungry, covetous gleam within. They wear full plate armor over reddish-purple robes. Their scaled fist holds the handle of a flail, the chain slung over their shoulder and the spiked beater clinking heavily against their backplate. Upon their shield, a symbol of what looks like water or thread weaving up to stars is emblazoned in crimson and silver.

~ Played by Wawa with

I Drink My Potion Of Superior Healing.name:
我喝下我的强效治疗药水
I Drink My Potion Of Superior Healing

Text.text:
当我感到凡躯的终结步步逼近，恐惧便淹没了我的思绪。我伸手探入背包，胡乱摸索着，只求抓到点什么——任何能救我一命的东西。我找到了它——那瓶猩红的药剂，在风暴里如灯塔般闪烁。我绝望地猛灌一口，笨拙得几乎呛住；可当伤口以魔法般的速度开始愈合，恐惧随之融化，我终于再次清醒，能够思考。
As I sense my mortal end looming closer, my mind is overwhelmed with fear. I bring a hand to my pack and feel around for something, anything, to save me. I find it—the crimson potion that shimmers like a beacon in a storm. I take a desperate drink, nearly choking in my clumsiness, but as my wounds begin to heal with magical speed, the terror melts away and I can think clearly once more.

Ring Of Swimming.name:
游泳戒指
Ring Of Swimming

Text.text:
泛着蓝光的银色指环盘绕在手指上，但两端——雕成鱼尾的形状——并不相接。相反，那带鳍的尾端彼此错开，平行掠过，划出优雅的回旋。
The blue-tinged silver band coils about the finger, though the ends—fashioned after fish tails—do not meet. Instead, the finned tails bypass each other in parallel flourishes.

清澈的水轻柔地拍打着遍布卵石的岸边，带来一阵惬意的呢喃。离岸几尺起，水流便变得冷冽、干净、透明，河床上同样散落着光滑的石子，色泽深浅不一，几乎让人联想到鱼鳞般的纹理。河水的轰鸣恒久不息，沉稳而连续——反倒令人安心。水流在下一个弯道后隐没无踪；脚下松散的碎石让立足并不踏实，但你知道，这条河不会把你引向歧途。
The water laps pleasantly at the rock-strewn shore. Beginning a few feet out, it runs crisp, clean, and clear, the riverbed littered with similar smooth stones of varying hues, almost evoking scales. The river's roar is constant, steady—comforting. The current disappears beyond the next bend, and though the loose rocks beneath you provide less-than-sure footing, you know the river leads you not astray.

Possessed Summoner Calls Forth Spider Av.name:
附身的召唤师唤出蜘蛛化身
Possessed Summoner Calls Forth Spider Avatar

Text.text:
你看见公主眼底藏着的痛楚：她拼命想把那恶意的附体者从体内逼退——可她正在败下阵来。她在空中编织纤细的仪式手势，紫与洋红的轻纱能量丝线开始交织，结成一张浓密的魔力格栅。她以超自然的速度动作，额头因恐惧与耗力而沁出冰冷汗珠，手势越织越快，直到那格栅化作厚重、不可穿透的蛛网。随后，你看见了。可憎而修长、节瘤盘结的手指开始撕扯那些丝线——声响如利爪刮过血肉——那存在强行挤入现实。粗壮分节的长腿以舞者般的优雅探出，蛛后化身那臃肿的身形爬行着，坠入存在之中。

~ 构想 by Bartavious on Discord

You see the pain behind the princess's eyes as she desperately tries to fight her malevolent possessor—but she is failing. As she weaves the delicate ritual gestures in the air, gossamer strands of purple and magenta energy begin to form a lattice of dense magical energy. Moving with supernatural speed, her brow beaded with cold sweat from terror and exertion, she weaves faster and faster until the lattice becomes a thick, impenetrable web. Then you see it. Hideously long, gnarled fingers begin to tear the strands apart—with a sound like claws raking flesh—as the being forces its way into reality. Thick, segmented legs emerge with a dancer's grace, as the bulbous form of the Spider Queen's avatar crawls into existence.

~ Envisioned by Bartavious on Discord

一团黑色皮毛的残影披着暗色斗篷掠过，钢光一闪——猫族女子动作迅疾而流畅。兜帽压得很低，阴影里一双黄色眼睛冷冷窥视；耳朵在帽下转动，胡须竖起，鼻尖轻颤，捕捉周遭的一切。带爪的猫科前爪搭在腰间那柄久经磨损的细剑剑柄上。尽管鞘中钢刃与胸前斜挎弹带里收纳的飞刀暗示着威胁，她的神情仍然平静、精密、克制。

~ Played by Matt Shooter

A blur of black fur draped in a dark cloak, a flash of steel—the catfolk moves fast and fluidly. Yellow eyes peer from the shadows of her cowl, pulled low over ears that are swiveling, whiskers that are bristling, and a nose that is twitching to perceive all around her. A clawed, feline paw rests on the well-worn pommel of a rapier at her belt. Her composure is calm, calculating, and collected, despite the implied threat of that sheathed steel, along with the throwing daggers housed on a bandolier across her chest.

~ Played by Matt Shooter

Windsong Caverns: Anticipation.name:
风歌洞窟：期待
Windsong Caverns: Anticipation

Text.text:
一阵微风拂过你，令洞窟里原本恒定的温度竟显得刺骨般寒凉。你环顾这座洞穴，只见岩壁上呈现出怪异的形状。也许是风以某种方式卷动了岩石，塑成这些倾斜的石塔与蜷曲的尖峰。
A breeze blows over you, making the normally steady temperature of the caves feel downright chilly. You gaze about the cavern and see strange shapes in the rock. Perhaps the wind has somehow whirled the stone into these leaning towers and curled spires.

Staff Of The Magi's Retributive Strike.name:
贤者之杖的复仇打击
Staff Of The Magi's Retributive Strike

Text.text:
还没等任何人阻止，术士便将那根传奇法杖猛地砸向自己的膝盖，木质杖身应声折成两段。木屑迸裂的脆响之后，随之而来的是宛如滚雷碾过的低沉轰鸣；术士只来得及瞪大双眼、茫然无助地望上一瞬，随后，一场难以用言语形容的奥术爆炸骤然绽放。术士化作尘埃消散——至少，他没多少时间去后悔自己的动作。

~ 构想：Gooby26

Before anyone can stop them, the sorcerer brings the legendary staff down upon their knee, snapping the wooden length in two. The crack of splintering wood is followed by a rumble like rolling thunder, and the sorcerer has but an instant to stare, wide-eyed and helpless, before an arcane explosion the likes of which cannot be adequately described, blossoms forth. The sorcerer disappears into dust—at least he didn't have much time to regret his actions.

~ Envisioned by Gooby26

两只巨大的辐条车轮支撑着整辆战车。整车不过是一块薄薄的平台，前方仅有齐腰高的护栏。然而目之所及皆极尽奢华：精湛的浮雕与饰件覆满每一处可供雕琢的表面，仿佛在诉说往昔驾乘者与其功业的故事。
Two large, spoked wheels are all that support the chariot. The entire vehicle is little more than a thin platform with a waist-high guard at the front. Yet what is there is extravagant, with masterful reliefs and adornments covering every viable surface. They seem to tell the story of past riders and their deeds.

Chronos The Charlatan.name:
克洛诺斯——江湖骗子
Chronos The Charlatan

Text.text:
穿行在蜿蜒扭曲的街巷间，一道身影以近乎超自然的优雅大步前行。月光掠过他瘦削的身形，他踏碎水洼溅起碎银般的水花，苍白的发丝如水银般闪耀。那双蓝宝石般的眼睛睁得很大，警惕地扫视着可能的危险，唇角却因不忿而微微抽动。雨珠从他精致的皮制护甲上弹起，胸甲上沙漏徽记泛着冷冽的银光。他纤长的手紧攥着一把发条鲁特琴，Chronos一词刻在乐器打磨光亮的“肌理”上。纵使他举止夸张戏剧，他随身携带的小型十字弩与细剑仍泄露出一种不宜试探的致命气息。

~ 由一位英雄Played

Through twisting streets, a figure strides with preternatural grace. Moonlight glides off his lean form as he splashes through puddles, his pale hair gleaming like mercury. His sapphire eyes are wide, scanning for potential danger as his mouth twitches with indignance. Rain bounces from his delicate leather armor, its hourglass emblem glistening silver upon the breastplate. In slender hands, he clutches a clockwork lute, the word Chronos etched into the instrument’s polished flesh. Despite his theatrical demeanor, the small crossbow and rapier he carries hint at a lethality best left untested.

~ Played by a Hero

Winter Joust Of Honor.name:
冬季荣誉比武
Winter Joust Of Honor

Text.text:
铅灰色的天空下，雪花缓缓飘落。两名骑乘的骑士纹丝不动，目光紧锁着那位坐在旗帜垂挂看台中的女子。她抬起一方布巾掩住脸，随即哭了起来。披甲的男人们一言不发，拨转马头，小跑着奔向比武场两端。骑士们整备武器，最后再看了那女子一眼，便猛然发动——长枪下压，盾牌抬起，带着恨意盈满的双眼，向前冲锋。
Snow drifts down from a leaden sky. Two mounted knights sit motionless, gazing at a woman sitting in the banner-draped stand. She raises a cloth to her face and begins to cry. Without a word, the armored men turn their horses and trot to opposite ends of the tilt. The knights ready their weapons, and, with one last look at the woman, burst into motion, lowering their lances and raising their shields, charging forward with hate-filled eyes.

这处宅邸被一片合成树丛环抱，尼龙流苏在风里沙沙作响，喷雾器细细吐雾，洇出一缕松针般的香气。船屋是一座玻璃长方体，由纤细的铂金臂架撑起，攀附着河岸，悬停在墨黑的水面之上。顶层传来派对屋乐压低的闷雷声，室内绿与粉的激光灯随节拍脉动闪烁。下方的码头停着几艘鲨鼻般的快艇剪影，它们的系泊由蓝牙锚点驱动——一端在船上，一端在码头——每隔几秒便彼此眨一次蓝光。
The property is surrounded by a copse of synthetic trees, their nylon fringes rustling and their spritzers misting out a perfume of pine. The boathouse, a rectangle of glass supported by thin platinum arms clinging to the bank, hovers above the inky-black water. The top floor emits the muted thunder of house music, illumed from within by green and pink laser lights that pulse along with the beat. The dock below houses the shark-nosed silhouettes of speed boats, their mooring powered by Bluetooth anchors—one on the boat, one on the dock—that wink blue light at each other every few seconds.

高地草甸的尽头豁然断裂成峭壁：一道悬崖化作天然的瞭望台，俯瞰一条宽阔、林木葱郁的河谷。低地四周被较小的群山与嶙峋的丘陵环抱，薄雾在洼地里翻涌，穿行于树影之间。迷蒙的雾气却没能遮住那座大屋——院落被栅栏围起，旁侧还有一间较小的附属建筑；大屋烟囱里缕缕炊烟盘旋而上。两栋建筑——也许是一家旅店与一座马厩——立在横跨河面的石桥一侧。
A cliff edges the high meadow: a precipice providing a vantage point overlooking a broad, forested river valley. Smaller mountains and rugged foothills border these lowlands, and mist rolls through the hollows and among the trees. The haze fails to obscure a large house with a fenced yard and smaller outbuilding, smoke curling from the larger structure's chimney. These two buildings, an inn with a stable perhaps, stand to one side of a stone bridge that crosses the river.

Circular Crossroads.name:
环形十字路口
Circular Crossroads

Text.text:
腐朽的旧木栅栏残骸零星散落在此处交汇的路径旁草地上。一条路向北通往湖泊，另一条向南远离房屋，还有一条向西伸入林地的一条枝臂。站在这处圆形岔路口，显然有大片栅栏是在不久前被人砸毁的。一根同样破损、字迹褪色的路标倒在不远处，横卧在地。
The rotting remains of old wooden fences dot the grass alongside the converging paths here. One heads north to the lake, another south and away from the house, and yet another to the west, into an arm of the forest. From this circular crossroads, it’s plain that much of the fencing was smashed recently. A faded signpost, similarly broken, lies toppled nearby.

Impact Shatters Spacecraft Window.name:
撞击震碎飞船舷窗
Impact Shatters Spacecraft Window

Text.text:
一小块碎屑的撞击在舷窗上撕开了一道细不可察的缝隙，裂纹毫不费力地蔓延开来，沿着加固玻璃游走，如同清水在岩隙间渗流。起初什么也没发生；舷窗依旧保持完整，将空间的真空拒之门外——只维持了片刻——随后，伴随震耳欲聋的轰鸣，玻璃轰然爆裂，撕开一道通往冰封虚无的贪婪孔洞，空气从飞船中狂涌而出，卷成令人窒息的漩涡。
A small debris impact causes a tiny seam to appear in the window, spreading effortlessly as it travels across the reinforced glass like water trickling through rock. Nothing happens; the window’s integrity holds and keeps the vacuum of space at bay—for a moment—then, with a deafening roar, the glass shatters, creating a ravenous portal to frozen oblivion as the atmosphere rushes out of the craft in a suffocating vortex.

当你怀中那头被杀死的牲畜之血勾勒出最后几道线条时，空间本身仿佛开始弯折、破裂。眼前浮现出三维的裂痕，如同受损的水晶般纵横交错。伴随着一声震耳欲聋的轰鸣，其中一块猛然崩碎，你发现自己正凝视着一片难以测度的漆黑，那黑暗直撼你最原始的本能深处。自那遥远之地，你召唤的目标踏步而出。
As the final lines are drawn in the blood of the slain animal in your arms, space itself seems to bend and fracture. Three-dimensional cracks, like in a damaged crystal, form before you. With a thunderous boom a section shatters, and you find yourself staring into an unfathomable blackness that shakes you to your primal core. From this far away place steps the target of your summons.

ØRic Rogviirsson.name:
Ø里克·罗格维尔松
ØRic Rogviirsson

Text.text:
一只白化鼬从那瘦削、风霜满面的男人身上裹着的皮革与毛皮间钻出，蹿到他肩头，像城垛上的哨兵般警醒地蹲伏。男人把一根磨得发亮的旧杖紧紧抱在怀里，榛色眼眸闪着罕见的狡黠。他将点着姜黄色光泽的发丝一甩，缀着珠子与石片的辫发滑过肩头，露出蓝色的符文刺青——如蛇般盘绕着他的脖颈与手臂。你注视的同时，那些刺青似乎还在悄然游移。

~ 扮演者：Void

An albino weasel emerges from the hide and furs of the lean, rugged-looking man, to perch on his shoulder like a sentry upon the ramparts. The man clutches a well-worn staff close, hazel eyes gleaming with a rare cunning. He tosses ginger locks, braided with beads and stones, over one shoulder, revealing blue, runic tattoos coiling up his neck and arms like serpents. Even as you look, the tattoos seem to subtly shift.

~ Played by Void with

In The Marsh: Rivulet.name:
在沼泽中：细流
In The Marsh: Rivulet

Text.text:
原本黏稠缓慢的水流在此骤然化作急湍，一道溪流翻滚着注入沼泽。褐色液体迅疾的移动昭示着那边有更高处的水体，但从这个视角看去并无二致。细细的水股从一团纠缠的芦苇与根须间倾泻而出，又涌入下一团纠结之中。
The treacly flow of the water turns to a torrent here as a stream tumbles into the marsh. The swift movement of the brown fluid indicates a higher body of water in that direction, but it doesn’t look any different from this vantage point. The rivulet pours out of one tangle of reeds and roots into the next.

Inspiring View At Sunset.name:
落日余晖下的壮丽景致
Inspiring View At Sunset

Text.text:
夕阳沉入地平线，金色的辉光如天穹倾泻的神圣琼浆，浸透你脚下那片云海。夜色深黑，温柔抚过天际绚烂的暮光；群星在苍穹画卷中悬停，闪耀着虹彩般的瑰丽。越是贴近天穹，空气越冷越静，可你并不觉难受——只有一股安宁、柔和的平静悄然落在心上。你脚边的积雪开始流动，逆着自然法则旋涡般向上扬起；你看见前方的峭壁上，两道幽灵般的身影渐渐凝聚成形。两位女性的灵体牵着手，先是静静眺望这片如画景致片刻，随后彼此环抱，在温柔的拥吻中交叠无声。

~ Envisioned by Tjm

As the sun dips below the horizon, a golden light suffuses the sea of clouds below you like divine ambrosia poured from the heavens. The deep black of night caresses the breathtaking colors of dusk in the sky as the stars glow with iridescent beauty, suspended in their celestial vista. The air is cold and still this close to the heavens, yet you feel no discomfort—only a quiet and gentle sense of peace. The snow around your feet begins to move, swirling upward in defiance of natural law, and you see two spectral forms coalesce on the cliff ahead of you. The female spirits hold hands as they gaze across the idyllic view for a moment before wrapping each other in a tender embrace and sharing a kiss.

~ Envisioned by Tjm

当你的指尖掠过你咒语的目标的那一瞬间，他们的双脚便挣脱了重力的束缚。尽管眼下情势险恶，迫使你们不得不以这种方式赶路，你的目标却依旧眉开眼笑，随即猛然冲天而起，仿佛自然法则这等琐事也奈何不了他们。
The instant your fingers brush against the target of your incantation, their feet break free of the bonds of gravity. Despite the dire circumstances requiring this means of transportation, your target beams merrily before rocketing into the air, unbound by such petty things as natural laws.

Apparatus Of The Crab.name:
巨蟹装置
Apparatus Of The Crab

Text.text:
这具巨大的铁质构装体最像一头利维坦般的十足巨兽。它以六条多关节钢腿将自身高高撑起，前端伸出一对带刃巨钳，夹击着一扇巨大的铁舱盖——那似乎是通往机器内脏与其中操控装置的许可之门。怪异机体的头部上，栖着一对“眼睛”；其实那是潜望镜，让内部乘员得以窥见周遭。
The massive iron construct most closely resembles a leviathan decapod. It holds itself aloft on six multi-jointed steel legs, with a pair of bladed claws extending outward from its front, flanking a large iron hatch which seemingly provides access to the machine’s innards and the controls therein. A pair of eyes, in truth periscopes to allow the crew inside to see their surroundings, perch on the head of the strange machine.

Threat From A Sensitive Character.name:
来自敏感角色的威胁
Threat From A Sensitive Character

Text.text:
“一步都别靠近！我今天格外脆弱，实在不觉得自己能承受这场冲突。”
“Not one step closer! I’m feeling rather fragile today and I just don’t think I can handle the conflict.”

Hacker Takes Control Of Remote Weapon Em.name:
黑客夺取远程武器炮位的控制权
Hacker Takes Control Of Remote Weapon Emplacements

Text.text:
一对安保炮塔来回旋转，扫描着任何未在系统登记的目标。这款特定型号号称坚不可摧，搭载最新的加密协议与故障保护措施。或许它们让潜伏在阴影里的黑客稍稍慢了半拍，但没过多久，这些炮位便挣脱了既定巡逻程序，转而带着明确的意图锁定瞄准。
A pair of security turrets swivel back and forth, scanning for anything not registered in their system. This particular model is advertised as unbreakable, running the latest encryption protocols and failsafe measures. Maybe they slowed down the hacker hiding in the shadows a little, but it doesn't take long before the emplacements break their routines, instead taking intentional aim.

Simple Chess Board.name:
简易棋盘
Simple Chess Board

Text.text:
棋盘与底座浑然一体，整块由一棵绒白桦雕成，木纹呈卡其色，纹理如群岛四周荡开的涟漪。棋盘上每隔一格便被染成巧克力般的深褐。棋子是传统样式，古典的轮廓，以骨雕成——一半保留苍白本色，一半覆以黑漆。它们被搁在一局棋的中途：黑方正步步推进，白后已落入威胁之中。
The board and its pedestal are all one piece, carved from a downy birch, with a khaki color patterned in woodgrain that looks like the ripples around islands. Every other square on the board is stained to chocolate. The pieces are traditional, classically shaped and carved from bone—half left pale, half lacquered black. They have been left in the middle of a game, with black advancing and the white queen threatened.

I Cast Cleansing Touch.name:
我施放净化接触
I Cast Cleansing Touch

Text.text:
热意在我指尖汇聚；当我握住你的手臂，它们骤然迸发出我灵魂的光与守护你的渴望。光与热灼烧着剔除折磨你的魔法，终结其污秽的效应。
Heat gathers in my fingertips and, as I grasp your arm, they flash with the light of my spirit and desire to safeguard you. This light and heat sear away the magic afflicting you, ending its foul effects.

Adult Dragon Corpse.name:
成年巨龙的尸骸
Adult Dragon Corpse

Text.text:
巨龙的尸体侧卧在地，一只强健的翼被其庞然身躯的死重碾压得扭曲变形。那条曾能吐出世间大多数活的语言、以及数种死去语言的舌头，如今像屠夫案板上的一截下水般，从生物獠牙森森的口中无力垂落。龙的双眼冷硬地睁着，曾经栖居其中的锐利智慧已不复存在。
The dragon’s corpse lies on one side, a mighty wing crushed beneath the dead weight of its massive form. A tongue—which spoke most living languages, and several dead ones—now hangs limply from the creature’s fanged maw like a cut of butcher’s offal. The eyes of the dragon stare implacably, the keen intelligence they once held no longer present.

这道城门正对着通往附魔师学院的山路，那座高塔俯瞰着下方的山谷与院地。作为旧尖巫区的一部分，塔门像一件陈列在博物馆里的遗物：霉斑斑的木材，松垮的铁箍。城门两侧夹着两座塔楼，皆已重建，刻意复刻旧城墙的建筑风貌。门外则是两座彼此敌对的农庄：谷港庄园与奥尔登莓农场。
This gate directly faces the hill up to Enchanter Academy, where the tower looks over the valley and grounds below. Part of the Old Spirewych ward, Tower Gate is a museum piece of moldy wood and loose iron bands. It is bracketed by towers that have been rebuilt to match the old wall architecture. Outside the gate lie two rival farms: Valehaven Estate and Oldenberry Farm.

Rothgar Myzzrym.name:
罗斯加·米兹瑞姆
Rothgar Myzzrym

Text.text:
这名气势逼人的卓尔，冷峻的深红眼眸在他蓝灰色的皮肤与暗色衣装衬托下格外醒目。他为战而装，身披久经沙场的黑色铆钉皮甲，外束层层皮带与斜挂的枪带，披着一袭银丝般的绸质斗篷。衣装剪裁精确，勾勒出他矫健的体格；灰发两侧剃净、顶部稍长，同样衬得他面容光洁利落。背后，枪带固定着一面圆形金属盾，盾面饰有眼睛纹样。他右手护臂上刻着一柄短剑的徽记：剑刃分裂，外形垂覆如斗篷或布帛。左胯腰带上系着两把匕首与一柄长剑的剑柄，那奢华的握柄却似乎没有剑刃。

~ Played by Stephan Graham with

This striking drow’s stern crimson eyes are obvious against his blue-gray skin and dark attire. Dressed for combat, he wears battle-worn black studded leather, a harness of belts and baldric, and a cloak of silvery silk. The garb, precisely fitted, accentuates his athletic build, and his gray hair, shaved on the sides and longer on top, similarly emphasizes his smooth face. On the back, the baldric holds a round metal shield with an eye motif. His right gauntlet sports the symbol of a shortsword with a split blade draped in a shape suggesting a cloak or cloth. Fastened on his belt on the left hip are two daggers and the hilt of a longsword. Its lavish handle seemingly lacks a blade.

~ Played by Stephan Graham with

Hidden Wild Man.name:
隐秘的野人
Hidden Wild Man

Text.text:
他就站在林线内侧，静得像一头狩猎中的潜伏猛虎，侧耳聆听四周。高大的身形，肌肉厚实，像是在远离文明的漫长岁月里锻造出来；烈日把他的皮肤永久晒成古铜色——又抹着天然的色浆，将轮廓打散。他缓缓转头，注视着一群人走进空地。他们彼此争吵，压低了嗓音，却仍闹出远远超出应有的动静，足以让这位野人察觉。
He stood just inside the tree line, as still as a stalking tiger on the hunt, listening to his surroundings. A tall man with large muscles forged in a life lived many miles from civilization, his skin is permanently bronzed by the heat of the sun—smeared with natural pigments to break up his outline. Slowly he turned his head to watch a group enter the clearing. They were arguing amongst themselves, voices low, but making far too much noise not to be noticed by the wild man.

Hirsute Teenage Aliens On Class Trip.name:
胡子拉碴的外星少年班级旅行
Hirsute Teenage Aliens On Class Trip

Text.text:
一群肤色黝黑的少年乌合之众在星际博物馆里游荡，像一群低头觅食的兽群，对引领队伍的全息导览几乎不屑一顾。几名体格更大、毛发浓密的外星人用短促的呵斥发号施令，把他们喝得噤若寒蝉，勉强收敛出几分规矩。
The swarthy rabble of teenagers resembles a herd of grazing beasts as they meander through the Intergalactic Museum, paying little attention to the holographic guide leading the party. Several larger hirsute aliens chastise the group with barked commands, cowing them into civility.

骏马一身顺滑的白鬃泛着近乎金属般的光泽——银白、虹彩流转，闪耀着异世般的冷辉。它的两侧舒展出覆羽的翅膀，同样洁白而华丽。它是传说与神话中的生物，就连最恢弘的史诗，也难以真正道尽其万一。
The horse's sleek white hair shines with an almost metallic quality—silver, iridescent, gleaming with an otherworldly light. Feathered wings, splendid white as well, unfurl from the horse's sides. A creature of legend, of myth, done little justice even in the most epic tales.

一颗鬣狗的头颅涂着鲜亮的血色，像魔鬼的死亡面具般转过来正对着你。那具直立的身躯踩在弯曲的犬科后腿上挪动，粗硬的斑点皮毛在煮制皮护甲下炸起。拾荒者的眼睛空洞无神地盯住你，扁短的吻端淌着涎水，嘴里却像忽然被饥饿灌满般渴求。出于天生的怯懦——或许也带着野性的机敏——它没有去碰腰侧的战斧，反而后退一步，抽出短弓。它把一支羽毛蓬乱、满是污秽的箭拉到咆哮的脸颊旁，随即以凄厉的战嚎向同伴嚎叫召唤。
A hyena's head painted with bright blood in a devil's death mask turns to face you. The creature's upright body shifts on bent canine legs, their coarse spotted fur bristling beneath boiled leather armor. Scavenger's eyes stare soullessly toward you, and their snubbed snout drips with saliva as their mouth floods with sudden hunger. Evincing natural cowardice, or maybe feral intelligence, the creature ignores the battleaxe at their hip to instead step back and unlimber their short bow. They pull an arrow's mangy fletching to their snarling cheek and yowl for their pack with a wretched war cry.

Faerie Plane: Faerie Tree.name:
妖精位面：妖精之树
Faerie Plane: Faerie Tree

Text.text:
这棵老树的树冠盛放着一片绚烂的粉色叶幕，无数枝杈向四方舒展，繁盛得近乎奢华。树干的树皮是浓郁的深褐色，中央却有一道狭长的空洞——洞里有金银交辉的光在明灭起伏，如同心跳的节拍。你再次闻到那股宜人的熟果香气，正如在池塘边时一样。你在叶间瞥见一簇簇日光般金黄的浆果，饱满明亮，宛如星辰。忽然，其中一串猛地一抖，你听见一声尖锐的低吼。你这才看清它们——像一队蜜蜂在同一丛灌木里采蜜般，一支小精灵的军团在枝间飞掠，蜻蜓般的薄翼疯狂嗡鸣。你只来得及捕捉到它们彩绘般的面孔一闪而过，那些五官因你的闯入而扭曲成愤怒与不满。
A brilliant flush of pink leaves crowns the head of this old tree, its many branches spreading out in abundant splendor. Its trunk, the bark a rich dark brown in color, bears a long hollow in its center—something glowing gold and silver within, waxing and waning with the cadence of a heartbeat. You again smell the same pleasant scent of ripe fruit as you did near the pond. You spot clusters of sun-yellow berries between the leaves, plump and bright as stars. One of the bunches shakes suddenly and you hear a high-pitched growl. You see them now. Like a battalion of bees out collecting nectar in the same shrub, a legion of sprites flits among the branches, their dragonfly wings buzzing furiously. You catch brief glimpses of their painted faces, their features twisting with indignation at your presence.

当咒文的字句逼近这道法术的尾声时，一片土地上忽然隆起四枚沾湿泥土的指尖，像四座蚁丘破土而出。它们猛然加速上窜，一节节指骨接连现形，随后拇指也挤出地表。泥块从成形的手指间簌簌坠落，掌心随之凝聚，继而是一截手腕；速度更快了——一条泥土铸成的手臂甩出那只手，猛地扣住脚踝，死死钳住不放。

~ 一位英雄所构想

As the words of the incantation approach the end of the spell, four fingertips of wet dirt rise like anthills out of a patch of earth. They accelerate up, digit after digit emerging, followed by a thumb. Clumps of earth fall from them as they coalesce, to the palm, a bit of wrist; faster still, an arm of dirt sends the hand out to grab an ankle and hold fast.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Targeted By Cloudkill.name:
被死云术锁定
Targeted By Cloudkill

Text.text:
一团黄绿相间的雾云骤然在你脚边腾起，仿佛凭空涌出。刹那间，你嗅到硫磺与腐烂混杂的尖锐刺鼻气味；雾云翻卷缠绕，遮蔽你的视线，将你的感官彻底吞没。你屏住呼吸，可双眼仍止不住流泪灼痛，鼻涕横流；纵使你拼尽意志抵抗，还是吸进了一大口恶毒的雾气，感觉它一路灼穿你的内里。

~ 由一位英雄Played

The cloud of yellow-green fog springs up around your feet, seemingly emanating from nothing. Immediately you smell the sharp, acrid odor of sulfur and rot as the cloud swirls around you, obscuring your vision and overtaking your senses completely. You hold your breath, but your eyes water and burn, your nose runs, and despite your most willful efforts, you take in a lungful of the vile fog and feel it burn its way through your insides.

~ Played by a Hero

舒适而磨旧的皮革衣装裹着这名半精灵游侠修长的身形；他们手握长杖，踏入荒野，在崎岖间谨慎择路——背上斜跨着一张未上弦的弓。他从腰间小袋里取出罗盘，低头校准方向，随即继续跋涉，毫不动摇。
Comfortable, well-worn leathers garb the slender frame of the half-elf ranger picking their way through the wilderness with quarterstaff in hand—an unstrung bow across their back. They retrieve a compass from a belt pouch and consult it before trudging onward, undeterred.

一阵放肆的笑声充满了空气。这名海盗心情正好。他穿着一套定制的空间服，破旧扭曲的皮革裹在身上，饰品叮当作响，工具腰带层层缠绕；他懒懒靠在近处的墙上，独自低笑。天生的剑客派头，胸前别着加固的手枪，嘴角挂着迷人的笑意。他改造过的牙齿在遥远群星的光芒里一闪一闪。
A brash laugh fills the air. He is in a good mood, this pirate. With a custom space suit, warped leathers, trinkets, and tool belts, he leans back against a nearby wall, chuckling to himself. He is a born swashbuckler, bedecked with braced pistols and a winsome smile. His modified teeth wink with the light of distant stars.

Paladin Corpse.name:
圣武士的尸体
Paladin Corpse

Text.text:
圣武士的尸体令人哀恸，几乎只剩一堆凹陷的板甲，像坏掉的玩具般被随手丢弃。头盔面甲之后，那双曾因渴望正义而明亮的眼睛永远阖上，仿佛正以庄严的沉思迎接永恒。
The paladin’s corpse is a mournful sight, little more than a heap of dented plate mail cast aside like a broken toy. Behind the visor of their helm, eyes—once bright with the desire for justice—are forever closed, as if in solemn contemplation.

Headstone: “For” In Winter.name:
墓碑：“献给”冬日
Headstone: “For” In Winter

Text.text: 这座坟的墓碑比邻近的墓冢略微更靠近山坡，仿佛一名士兵从队列中迈步出列。其墓志铭写道：对我们许多人而言，人生是一场审判；但对极少数人而言，结局竟能如此公正。 This grave’s stone stands slightly nearer to the hill than its neighbors, like a soldier has stepped forward out of line. Its epigraph reads: For many of us, life is a trial, but for few of us is its end so just.

从街面引下的溢洪道让新鲜的秽物在入口处翻涌起沫、搅动不休，随后才沿着雨水口滴滴答答地渗落，坠入下方城市那充满毒气的幽深腹地。恶臭令人作呕，疫病的阴影近在咫尺；可你凭传闻与经验也清楚，城里的下水道自有它的凶险——无论人形还是非人的东西，都在其中潜伏。
The spillway leading from street level causes fresh filth to froth and churn before trickling down the storm drain and into the gaseous depths of the city below. There is a horrid stench and the promise of disease, yet you know from lore and experience that the city sewers hold their own threats—humanoid and inhuman alike.

片刻咒语吟诵，再加上一记温柔的接触之后，苍白无血的肌肤泛起红润，裂开的伤口合拢，断裂的骨头在魔法治疗的奔涌中瞬间接续如初。新生的精力涌上全身，原本伤痕累累的病患已整装待发，准备再一次直面这个世界。
A moment’s incantation and a gentle touch later, bloodless flesh becomes rosy, gashes close, and broken bones knit instantly with a rush of magical healing. Flush with renewed vigor, the formerly injured patient is ready to face the world once more.

这座两层小屋破败得触目惊心。屋顶的木瓦松松垮垮地垂挂着，有的干脆已经脱落；木质墙面上遍布细小的破洞。通往前门的台阶吱呀作响、在脚下弯曲，仿佛随时会在你的重量下坍塌。你在门上重重敲了一下，立刻传来至少十几双小脚从楼梯上倾泻而下的杂沓声。不多时，门被打开——一名身披素白长袍、袍上绣着十字架的年长男子站在前面，而他身后有十五个孩子探出头来，满怀期待地注视着你。
The two-story home is in dire disrepair. Shingles hang loosely from the roof or have fallen off altogether, and small holes litter the wooden walls. The stairs, leading up to the front door, creak and bend, threatening to collapse under your weight. One sharp rap on the door results in the sound of at least a dozen small feet cascading down a staircase, and soon the door is opened to reveal fifteen children watching expectantly from behind an older man wearing a simple white robe emblazoned with a cross.

Sealed Burial Mound.name:
封印的墓冢
Sealed Burial Mound

Text.text:
土丘上生长的草丛与细小柔弱的野花，在阳光下安宁而舒适地闪耀。四周的翠绿原野上，还散布着其他土丘。一列沉重的花岗岩巨石呈楔形，镶嵌在土垒东侧的坡面上；每一块都足有一名人类士兵体型的两倍。它们在一片宽阔的覆顶下几乎合拢，只在下方留出一道缝隙。漆黑的入口深处立着一扇石门，雕琢得严丝合缝，门上刻有铭文，用以震慑并驱退任何掠夺者。
Grasses and small, delicate flowers that grow on the mound catch the sun in peace and comfort. All around in the green field are other mounds. A wedge of heavy granite stones, each twice the size of a human soldier, stand embedded into the east face of the earthwork. They nearly converge at a gap under a broad mantle. Inside the black opening is a stone door, sculpted to seal tightly and inscribed to ward off any plunderer.

倦怠缠上这头庞大的爬行类掠食者，浓稠的黑胆汁也从它那可怖的巨口中慵懒滴落。脓疱与脓包遍布这生物鳞甲般的皮肤，随着它的动作不断破裂，迸出团团黄脓。这头强大的生物身上出了大问题。
Lethargy plagues the enormous reptilian predator, just as black bile drips languidly from its fearsome maw. Buboes and pustules infest the creature’s scaly hide, bursting with gobbets of yellow pus as it moves. Something is very wrong with this mighty creature.

Wild Magic Surge: Astral Plane Ticket.name:
狂野魔法涌动：星界位面船票
Wild Magic Surge: Astral Plane Ticket

Text.text:
世界在你周遭溶解，色彩褪尽，化作缥缈的幽影。猛然一震，你发现自己漂浮在虚空之中，浸沐在柔和的暮光里。一丝挥之不去的牵连感将你系在原先所在之地，暗示你不会被放逐太久。
The world dissolves around you, colors blanching and turning ethereal. With a jolt, you find yourself floating in the void, bathed in a soft, gloaming light. A lingering sensation tethers you to the place you were, suggesting you won’t be long banished.

Orange Mold Hazard.name:
橙色霉菌危害
Orange Mold Hazard

Text.text:
你越深入这间厅室，温度就越明显地骤降。你扫视室内，很快找到了源头：一团橙色霉菌正散发着冰冷气息，几乎覆满了近处一整面墙。它似乎是从地面一道浸透水渍的裂缝里爬上来的，被放任不管地滋长了相当长的时代。
The temperature noticeably drops as you venture farther into the chamber. A scan of the room reveals the source: a mass of orange mold emanating chilled air covers most of a nearby wall. It seems to have crawled up through a soaked crack in the floor, left to grow unchecked for quite some time.

那胖乎乎的男人从正读着的书页上抬起眼，啪地一声把书合上。他的目光像在估价般从你身上掠过，随即与您对视，点了点头。乍看像是在打招呼，可你清楚得很——就像他亲口说出来一样——他心里想的是：“你还凑合。”
The portly man glances up from the book he’s reading and snaps it shut. His eyes flick over you in an appraising way before he meets your gaze and nods. It might seem like a greeting, but you know he was thinking “you’ll do” just as clearly as if he’d said it.

Potion Of Speed.name:
速度药水
Potion Of Speed

Text.text:
这只药水瓶被一层层柔软的布料紧紧包裹着，原因不言而喻——瓶中那黄黑相间的液体仿佛自有意志，时时翻涌旋转、拍打晃荡；若不加以缓冲，那在玻璃容器里嗡鸣震颤的振动迟早会把瓶身震裂。
This potion bottle is swaddled in layers of soft cloth, and no wonder—due to the yellow and black liquid within constantly swirling and sloshing under its own power, the bottle would eventually crack due to the vibrations thrumming through the glass vessel.

人人都会失去些什么。这就是人生。有时失去的是小东西，而有时，最重要的恰恰就是这些小东西。让失去变得重要的，并不是你知道有什么不见了，而是你对它的渴望——对自己所欠缺之物的欲求。你在施放这个法术时，将心神专注于你所寻找之物的需要，凭意志驱使魔法，揭示它如今身在何处。
Everyone loses things. That’s life. Sometimes it’s little things, and sometimes it’s the little things that mean the most. What makes the loss important is not the knowledge that something is missing, but rather the want of it—the desire for that which one lacks. You focus on your need for what you seek as you cast this spell, willing the magic to reveal where it can be found.

Closing Walls Trap.name:
合拢墙壁陷阱
Closing Walls Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 你扫视着面前延伸的地城长廊。目光掠过一处地面——它比周围石面微微隆起。你谨慎地靠近，看到一块蒙尘的地砖上刻着一个符号：两只手掌相对，彼此朝向。你沿着地面痕迹将视线移向左右两侧的墙壁，注意到墙根与地面之间有一道几不可见的细缝。合拢墙壁陷阱！

[触发！] 脚下地面猛然震颤。可怖的碾磨声吞没了整个空间，石与石相撞，迸出刺耳回响。走廊两侧的墙面抖落尘土与碎石，落地扬起呛人的灰雾。宛如两支对阵的军势，墙壁缓慢、呻吟着向彼此推进。

[Perceived] You scan the dungeon hall that stretches before you. Your eye catches on a section of the floor that is slightly raised above the surrounding stone, and you approach with careful steps to see a dust-laden tile marked with a symbol: two hands with palms facing each other. You trace the floor to the walls on either side of you and notice the slightest of gaps between the bottom of the walls and the floor. A closing wall trap!

[Triggered!] The floor trembles beneath you. A terrible grinding noise encompasses the space, stone clashing against stone. The walls on either side of the hall loose dust and rubble to the ground, choking the air. Like opposing armies, the walls move towards each other in a slow, groaning march.

Dr. Jeneg Zavrek, Steward Of Nature.name:
珍内格·扎夫雷克博士，自然守护者
Dr. Jeneg Zavrek, Steward Of Nature

Text.text:
