杰内格·扎夫雷克博士似乎始终谨慎而好奇地汲取周遭的一切，以一双探究的祖母绿眼眸洞察万物。他或许显得冷淡、疏离——但更准确地说，是“沉浸在思绪中”。这位高挑清瘦的鱼人身着剪裁得体的长袍，身影古怪却令人心动。虹彩鳞片微微闪烁，鱼鳍沿着他的前臂与小腿竖起。头顶一片硕大的冠鳍舒展，颜色在藻绿与天蓝之间轻颤游移。
Dr. Jeneg Zavrek seems at all times to carefully and curiously absorb his surroundings, perceiving all with inquisitive, emerald eyes. Aloof, standoffish, maybe—but “lost in thought” is more accurate. The tall, lean merfolk strikes a strange but alluring figure in his tailored robes. Iridescent scales shimmer, and fins crest his forearms and calves. A large crown fin crests his head, dithering from algae green to sky blue.

Hacker Enters A Hackers-only Virtual Han.name:
黑客潜入“仅限黑客”的网域虚拟据点
Hacker Enters A Hackers-only Virtual Hangout In The Net

Text.text:
手指在键盘上飞舞，沿着网络一路搜寻，追逐那扇难以捉摸的入口。忽然，其中一台终端发出低沉的哔声。屏幕上闪过一幅粗糙的骷髅与交叉骨标记，紧接着是一串倾泻而下的代码。暗色剪影随之脉动，虚拟据点在他们眼前凝结成形。这里狂野而无序，墙面被霓虹涂鸦胡乱划满，看不见的音箱里轰鸣着节拍强劲的音乐。各路黑客或懒散地窝在虚拟沙发里，或倚着虚拟墙壁，交换技巧、倒腾传闻、讲述故事。这里是尖端技术与禁忌软件的集散地——用来交易，也用来试炼。
Fingers fly across the keyboard as they scour the network, searching for an elusive portal. Suddenly, a low beep sounds from one of the terminals. A crude image of a skull and crossbones flashes on the screen, followed by a stream of code. Dark silhouettes pulse and the virtual hangout materializes before them. It's a wild, anarchic place, with neon graffiti scrawled across the walls and pulsing music blaring from unseen speakers. Hackers of all kinds lounge on virtual couches or lean against virtual walls, trading tips and swapping stories. This is a place of cutting-edge technology and forbidden software, to be traded and tested.

来自十数个遥远国度的异域鸟儿在树梢筑巢。百种色泽的花朵灿然盛放，空气里满是它们独特而交织的芬芳。四面八方皆有清水潺潺，令人心神舒畅；而花园的中心矗立着一座层层叠起的喷泉，顶端立着栩栩如生的雕像。泉水清澈如晶，鸟儿与睡莲叶懒懒漂浮其上。
Exotic birds nest in trees from a dozen distant lands. Flowers of a hundred shades bloom radiantly, and the air is laden with their unique, mingling perfume. Water trickles pleasantly from every direction, and at the garden's heart there stands a multi-tiered fountain topped with lifelike statues; birds and lily pads float lazily in its crystal-clear waters.

Earth Elemental: Beast In Wilderness.name:
土元素：荒野巨兽
Earth Elemental: Beast In Wilderness

Text.text:
你在听见之前就先感觉到了。大地震颤，抖得脚边的碎石咔啦作响。紧接着，一阵隆隆低鸣或怒吼——也许两者皆是，甚至根本就是同一种声音——在山坡间回荡。雪崩绝不可能发出这样的动静。外头有什么野兽——而且是个大家伙——听起来正怒火中烧。你伸手去拿武器时，又察觉到一丝古怪：鸟儿似乎对这场骚动毫不在意。
You feel it before you hear it. The ground shakes, rattling pebbles at your feet. Then a rumble or roar—perhaps both, maybe the same—echoes across the hillside. No avalanche would make such sounds. A beast of some sort—a large one—is out there, and it sounds angry. As you reach for your weapons, you note something odd: the birds seem to pay this disturbance no mind.

你的双掌以完美的对称舞动，手腕翻转间，掌心之间的空间不断扩张，世界的元素丝线随之松解。一个翻涌的粉彩光球荡起涟漪，如梦似幻地凝现。你的指尖像拨动竖琴弦般轻拈色彩，抽离出各自的元素，再如调和油彩般将它们混融，直到你准备将其化作毁灭性的弧光，朝你的目标轰然掷出。
Your palms dance in perfect symmetry, the space between them growing as your wrists twist and the elemental threads of the world unravel. An orb of roiling pastel hues ripples into a dreamlike existence. Your fingers pluck at the colors like harp strings, drawing out the individual elements and mixing them like oil paints until you are ready to launch it in a devastating arc toward your target.

Lord Eric Von Mansford.name:
埃里克·冯·曼斯福德爵士
Lord Eric Von Mansford

Text.text:
狂乱的犬吠先声夺人，一群猎犬自黑暗中小跑而出；紧随其后，是它们的主人，骑着一匹炭色骏马，鬃毛如烈焰翻腾。男人伤痕累累的面容冰冷而残忍，猩红的目光与猎犬那一双双血红的眼相互映照——像跃起的火星般闪烁。主人身披夜黑护甲，胸甲嵌着一枚银色圆盘，手中紧攥盘绕的长鞭。他挺拔的身姿或许曾有过德行——如今，那宽阔的肩膀只被专横的残酷撑得更直。

~ 由 Paul 扮演

Frenzied baying precedes a pack of hounds as they lope out of the darkness, followed by their master on a charcoal steed with a fiery mane. The man’s scarred countenance is cold and callous, his ruby glare echoed by the glint of the blood-red eyes—like leaping sparks—of his hounds. The master is clad in night-black armor, his breastplate inlaid with a silver disk, and he clutches a coiled whip. There might once have been virtue in his upright bearing—now, his broad shoulders are squared by imperious cruelty.

~ Played by Paul

I Cast Major Image.name:
我施放了高等幻影
I Cast Major Image

Text.text:
我的双手汇聚起靛蓝的魔法，丝线般的光从指间滴落，缠绕上我的手臂。我猛地将双手向前一推，魔法便汹涌喷薄而出，坠落成我脑海中那幅画面的剪影。转瞬之间，我的幻象便以逼真的色彩、声音与气味自我补全。“十分钟。”我叹了口气。“别把这事搞砸。”
My hands pool with indigo magic, strings dripping through my fingers and twining about my arms. I throw my hands forward and the magic gushes forth, falling into a silhouette of the image in my head. In a moment, my illusion completes itself with realistic color, sound, and smell. “Ten minutes.” I sigh. “Let’s not screw this up.”

Blood Skull During Winter.name:
冬季血颅
Blood Skull During Winter

Text.text:
浸透着血浆的三角形切口刻在巨大的山羊头骨上，尖端直指地面。一道蠕动般的凝血沿着鼻梁的裂缝滴落，末端结成细小的血色冰锥，悬挂在骨面一处巨大的凹坑边缘。先前祭品的头骨散落在这座邪秽纪念碑的底部四周。
The gore-soaked triangle cut into the huge goat skull points toward the ground. A wriggling line of coagulating blood drips down a crack in the nose, ending in tiny blood icicles which hang from a large divot in the bone. Skulls of previous sacrifices lie scattered about the base of this vile monument.

一连串刺耳的呱噪在你头顶炸响。一个漆黑的影子从你面前疾掠而过，紧接着第二个、第三个接连掠来。转瞬之间，这些短促的冲刺膨胀成一场由羽毛与利爪卷起的旋风，蓝黑发亮，寒光闪烁。尖叫声吞没了空气，你能感觉到翼缘掠过你的身躯。鸟喙像飞弹般从你耳畔呼啸而过，张得大大，迫不及待地要一口夺走。
A series of abrasive caws peal above you. A dark shape shoots by your face, then another, then a third. In a matter of seconds, these short bursts expand into a whirlwind of feathers and talons, blue-black and shining. The sound of their cries overtake the air and you feel the edges of wings flick against your body. Beaks whistle by your ears like missiles, gaping open and eager to snatch.

Bhavani’s Medical Center In Winter.name:
冬日的巴瓦妮医疗中心
Bhavani’s Medical Center In Winter

Text.text:
覆雪的医疗所窗内灯火通明，医生正俯身照看着一张行军床上的病人。一个提夫林踮着蹄子，小心翼翼沿路潜近那栋建筑。雪花落在他的角、鼻尖与尾巴上，嘶嘶作响，转眼化作热汽。他怀里抱着一只棕色点心盒，底角有一小块油渍，用朴素的麻绳随意一扎。

走到门廊前，他缓缓把盒子放在门前，随即一阵狂敲，转身就想逃走，尾巴在身后兴奋地乱甩。可惜脚下一滑，冰面把他整个人掀翻，结结实实摔了个屁股墩儿——恰在此时，门被推开，医生站在门口，脸上是恼火与担忧搅作一团的神色。提夫林先用炼狱语咒骂了一句，随即缩着脖子露出尴尬的笑，耳朵耷拉着，对医生怯怯地赔笑。
The snow-topped medical center’s windows are alight, the doctor tending to a patient in a cot. A tiefling steps his hooves gingerly down the road, stealing toward the building. Snowflakes hiss to steam as they land on his horns, nose, and tail. He carries a brown pastry box with a small grease stain at one of its lower corners, tied with simple twine. At the porch, he slowly places the box in front of the door, knocks furiously, and then attempts to run away, his tail wagging wildly behind him. Unfortunately, he slips on the icy road and falls right onto his backside just as a doctor opens the door with a look of annoyance muddled with concern. The tiefling curses in Infernal before smiling sheepishly at the doctor with downturned ears.

Beast Shield Master.name:
兽盾宗师
Beast Shield Master

Text.text:
她横冲直撞地杀来：一名巨大的类人身影，灰色皮肤如皮革般粗硬，耳朵又大又扁，短短獠牙外露。她用修长的鼻子把一名披甲战士像破布娃娃般拖行。怒火让她双眼暴突，接着举盾撞上第二个对手。轰然一声，重击把她的目标掀翻进泥土里，她随即将他死死压住。第一个敌人被她的长鼻缠住，挣扎着想挺起长矛，她却用一条布满尖刺的长尾一扫，将那无力的刺击抽开，随后把他狠狠掷倒在地。紧接着，她用宽大扁平的脚掌踏下，把他钉在原地。她胜利地长鸣，挥动那满刺的肢体，抽打两名倒地的战士。

~ Played by Colby Poulson, d4: D&D Deep Dive

Barreling forward, a massive humanoid with leathery gray skin, large and flat ears, and short tusks uses her long snout to drag a mail-clad warrior like a ragdoll. Her eyes bulge in fury as she smashes into a second adversary with her shield. The blow resounds, tossing her target to the dirt, where she pins him. The first foe, wrapped in her trunk, tries to bring a spear to bear, but she whips the weak thrust aside—with a long tail covered in spines—before hurling him to the ground. Then she stomps down with a broad, flat foot to hold him in place. Trumpeting in triumph, she lashes both fallen fighters with her spiky appendage.

~ Played by Colby Poulson, d4: D&D Deep Dive

这把弯刀被锻造成一只风格化巨龙之翼的形态，显然出自工艺大师之手。护手中央嵌着一枚镶黑曜石的闪耀黄玉，宛如爬行生物的眼睛；刀柄末端则以一只带爪的足爪作收。刀身上刻着陌生而棱角分明的文字——以脉动的微光柔和发亮。
Forged in the likeness of a stylized dragon’s wing, this scimitar is clearly the work of a master artisan. A gleaming topaz inlaid with obsidian forms a reptilian eye at the center of the crossguard, and a clawed foot caps the pommel. Strange, angular text—which glows softly with a pulsing light—has been engraved along the blade.

Cloud, The Windblooded Monk.name:
云，风血武僧
Cloud, The Windblooded Monk

Text.text:
陌生人闪过一抹笑意，迷人却又危险，仿佛远处酝酿的风暴；他轮廓分明、俊朗锋利的五官，让每个擦肩而过的人都忍不住回头再看一眼。他身形高挑修长，一头白发在柔和的微风里不断翻涌，如同夏日天空中慵懒漂移的云。只见他从贴身的武者长袍褶缝间优雅一扬，变出一朵精致的花，随即微微躬身，将花递给面前的年轻女子——她的双颊顿时因喜悦而染上深红。

~ Played by Max_Slacker with

The stranger flashes a smile as captivating and perilous as a distant storm, his sharp, handsome features pulling second glances from all who pass by. He is tall and slender, his white hair constantly billowing in a soft breeze like clouds drifting lazily across a summer sky. Producing a delicate flower from the folds of his fitted, martial robes with a flourish, he offers it to the young woman before him with a low bow, causing her cheeks to flush crimson with delight.

~ Played by Max_Slacker with

Three Town Guards.name:
三名镇卫
Three Town Guards

Text.text:
三名守卫在泥泞的街道上轻松巡逻，彼此闲聊着不时发出低笑，将长矛斜靠在肩头。他们身上穿着磨得发旧、并不合身的皮甲，多半是从镇上先前的守卫手里传下来的。尽管神情松散，他们仍以锐利而谨慎的目光扫视四周，向路过的人点头致意，同时将视线牢牢钉在新来者身上。
The three guards patrol the muddy streets with a casual ease, talking and chuckling between one another, cradling their spears against their shoulders. They wear well-worn, ill-fitting leathers, likely passed to them from previous guards in the town's employ. Despite their laidback attitude, they scan their surroundings with keen, careful eyes, nodding to passersby and keeping their gazes locked on newcomers.

高大的半兽人如铁柱般挺立，身披钢制板甲，宛如行走的要塞。他的双臂与桶状胸膛鼓胀着千锤百炼的肌肉，沉沉隆起，仿佛将那柄巨大战锤的重量也一并吞入血肉——而那战锤，他常常只用一只手便能挥舞自如。遭人抛来玩笑时，他会立刻绷紧那突出的下颌；面对致命强敌时，他同样毫不犹豫地猛冲向前。尽管仪态如王者、气势如武人，他榛色的眼中却燃着一簇被压低的火——那是被束缚却从未熄灭的怒焰。

~ Played by Miggs3030

The towering half-orc stands rigid, a walking fortress in steel plate armor. His arms and barrel chest swell with honed musculature, swollen with the weight of the mighty warhammer he often wields with just one hand. He sets his jutting jaw when confronted with a joke just as readily as he charges forward when faced with a deadly foe. Despite his regal, martial bearing, a subdued fire alights in his hazel eyes, a flame of rage contained but never extinguished.

~ Played by Miggs3030

Rats Bursting From Corpse.name:
尸体中爆涌而出的鼠群
Rats Bursting From Corpse

Text.text:
你越走近，矮人的尸身便从内部诡异地被撑长、扭曲。忽然间，伴随着一声令人作呕的撕裂声，宛如羊皮纸被猛然扯开，一群浑身糊满血肉、圆眼发亮的老鼠从尸体的腹腔里爆涌而出。它们在恶臭的内脏间四散奔窜，随即逃入黑暗。
The dwarf’s body stretches grotesquely from within as you get closer. Suddenly, with a sickening rip like tearing parchment, a swarm of gore-covered, beady-eyed rats bursts from the belly of the corpse. They scatter among the stinking offal and flee into the darkness.

Witch Weapon Charms.name:
女巫武器护符
Witch Weapon Charms

Text.text:
这些由骨片与麻绳缠结而成的微型构装体，刻着棱角分明的力量符文，正是女巫传说中的护符——因其在战斗中的骇人威能而名扬四方。护符低鸣着被束缚的魔法，除非感官与奥术与秘法同频，否则几乎无人能察觉。

~ 构想：Bangalulu

These tiny constructs of bone and twine etched with angular runes of power are the fabled charms of witches—and are known far and wide for their potency in battle. The talismans hum with restrained magic, barely perceptible to all but those whose senses are attuned to the arcane and mystical.

~ Envisioned by Bangalulu

God Of Records.name:
记录之神
God Of Records

Text.text:
一切都在他脑中：可被丈量的宇宙，每一页都在那里。他开始时就已年迈——那究竟是哪一年，没人记得。他记下了最初发生的那件事——不管那是什么。他白发如霜，高而瘦，披着羊毛长袍，鼻梁上架着一副小小的夹鼻眼镜，手里握着鹅羽笔。我们看见他任由一张张小纸条飘落，不是因为他装不下这一切，而是因为我们需要他看起来像这样——否则，凡人根本无从理解他；当他们试图抓住这位神所记录的浩瀚历史时，只会被那无边的重量压得失语。
It’s all in his head: every page of the measurable universe. He was old when he began, whenever that was. No one can remember. He recorded the first thing that happened, whatever that was. He is white-haired, tall and thin, wearing a woolen robe and a little pince nez, holding a goose-feather quill. We see him dropping little slips of paper, not because he cannot hold it all, but because we need him to look that way—otherwise, mortals could not hope to make sense of him, as they grapple with the immensity of the history the god has recorded.

长弓的弓弦瘫在折断的弓身旁，曾经引以为傲的张力与力量，如今只剩遥远的回忆。木材已开始腐朽——在这件断裂的武器内部，霉斑与菌丝初绽，汲取着腐败而滋长。
The longbow’s string lies beside its broken body, the tension and strength it once proudly held now a distant memory. The wood has begun to rot—the first blooms of mold and fungus visible within the sundered weapon, nourished by the decay.

I Swing Through Trees.name:
我在林间穿梭荡行
I Swing Through Trees

Text.text:
我的四肢筋络分明、柔韧如枝，仿佛与身旁弯拢的树杈同一脉搏。我在枝与枝之间荡跃，带着灵长般的轻松本能。林木气息的炼金术——花、藤、叶、皮——汹涌灌入我的感官，我鞭甩般掠过空气。我的老茧掌心在移动间既不裂也不破，撞击的震颤一路攀上我强健的肩头。
My limbs as sinewed and pliant as the boughs bending around me, I swing myself from branch to branch with simple simian ease. The alchemy of arboreal aromas—flower, vine, leaf, bark—flood my senses as I whip through the air. My calloused hands do not split or break as I move and the vibration of impact rattles up to my strong shoulders.

Inotion Negomi.name:
伊诺申·涅戈米
Inotion Negomi

Text.text:
女术士将手臂蜷向胸前——五指绷紧成爪，缭绕着漆黑如墨的能量——与此同时，一只小瓶从她颈间垂落的细绳上轻巧起舞。雪白的长发披过肩头，被编成一条修长的辫子。她的衣袍随与生俱来的力量起伏荡漾，尤以那件深紫染就的披风最为醒目，在背后分裂成两道尾摆垂落。点缀华饰的金属护甲覆住她的颈项与上胸，泛着蓝灰色泽，宛如暴风阴影下的海面。其下，她穿着一袭黑色和服，腰间以束带系紧，同时固定着一条及膝的裙摆，颜色与披风相呼应。

~ Played by Alex with

The sorceress curls her arm toward her chest—hand tensed into a claw, swirling with jet-black energy—as a vial dances from a length of cord about her neck. Snow-white hair drapes over her shoulder in a long braid. Her clothes undulate with her innate power, most notably her cape, dyed dark purple, which splits into two tails down her back. Embellished metal armor covers her neck and upper chest, tinted a blue-gray color reminiscent of a sea that sits in the shadow of a storm. Under this she wears a black kimono cinched at the waist by a belt that also secures a knee-length skirt dyed to match her cape.

~ Played by Alex with

Ruined Village Square.name:
毁坏的村庄广场
Ruined Village Square

Text.text:
这片废墟激起的凄惨荒凉之感，在这里尤为萦魂不散——曾几何时，这座村庄必定生机勃勃。草从鹅卵石间的裂缝里钻出，成了这片被残破建筑围拢的宽阔广场上唯一的活物。广场中央立着一口坍圮的井，井棚几乎全靠几根倾斜的木梁勉强支撑着。
The feeling of wretched desolation provoked by the ruins feels particularly haunting here, where once the village must have felt so vibrant. Grass grows in cracks between the cobbles, the only sign of life in a broad square bounded by broken buildings. A crumbling well stands at the center, its roof barely held aloft by leaning timbers.

Gnoll God Charges.name:
豺狼人神祇冲锋
Gnoll God Charges

Text.text:
一头怪物从现实翻涌的裂创中轰然冲出，形貌宛如恶魔与豺狼人交杂的畸种。他兽性的面孔挂着残忍的狞笑，双眼如两汪魔性的饥渴之池，迸射深渊般的狂怒。沾满无数受害者血迹的利爪攥着一柄骇人的三头连枷，三颗枷头皆在滴落腥红。随着这头巨兽踏步逼近，空气因凄厉的痛嚎而震颤，被屠戮者的恶臭先一步扑面而来，仿佛为他不息的冲锋开道。
Barreling from a seething wound in reality comes a monstrous entity, appearing like a cross between a demon and a gnoll. His bestial visage bears a savage grin, and his eyes—pools of diabolic hunger—radiate abyssal rage. Claws stained with the blood of countless victims grasp a horrific flail with three heads, all dripping gore. The air throbs with screams of agony as the behemoth strides forward, the stench of the slaughtered preceding his relentless charge.

Elven Village In Summer.name:
夏日精灵村
Elven Village In Summer

Text.text:
在这座精灵村落之中，盛夏以温柔的暖意统治着一切。孩童清亮的欢歌在空气里流淌，沐阳的枝叶随风摇曳，仿佛踏着同一段韵律。魔法花园以万花筒般的绚烂盛放，整座村子都因季节蓬勃的生机而沸腾。在这片如梦的乐土里，精灵们安然兴盛，沐浴着暖光，庆祝自然赐予的一切。
Here amid this elven village, summer reigns with a balmy embrace. The melodic joy of children fills the air as sun-kissed branches sway in rhythm. Magical gardens bloom with kaleidoscopic splendor, and the whole village seethes with the flourishing energy of the season. In this idyllic haven, the elves thrive, basking in the warmth and celebrating the gifts of nature.

黑色岩石凝固在熔岩奔流最后的痉挛之中，铺满原野直抵天际。褶皱起伏的地貌陌生得像异星之物，宛如布满疣与脓疱的血肉。它以浑浊的滑润反射光线，可一旦擦身触到那石面，便会被割出火辣刺痛的伤痕。
Black rock, frozen in the last spasms of the lava’s flow, fills the field to the horizon. The wrinkled landscape looks alien, like warty, pustuled flesh. It reflects light with a muddy smoothness, but brushing against the stone causes painful scrapes.

I Press The Second Button On My Rod Of L.name:
我按下我那根君王之威权杖上的第二个按钮（+3 战斧）
I Press The Second Button On My Rod Of Lordly Might (+3 Battle Axe)

Text.text:
当我按下第二枚按钮时，斧头那对繁复的刃片如两片致命的翼翅骤然弹出，自杖柄中跃现，伴随着一声清脆的金属铿鸣。斧刃被强大的魔法柔和映亮，低沉的嗡鸣如挽歌般回荡，静待啜饮鲜血。
Springing forth like a pair of deadly wings, the elaborate blades of the axe leap from the Rod’s haft with a metallic clang when I press the second button. Glowing softly with powerful magic the axe blades hum a low dirge, waiting to taste blood.

Short Travel Across The Elemental Plane.name:
穿越风元素位面的短途旅行
Short Travel Across The Elemental Plane Of Wind

Text.text:
你踏上旅程时并不确定会遇见什么，旅行穿越漂浮的群岛——那些随风飘移的陆块。风从四面八方不歇地呼啸而来，鞭打着你。你以所敢及的最快速度前行，终于，你看见了目的地。
You embark on your journey unsure of what you might find, traveling across floating islands—landmasses adrift on the breeze. The wind is incessant, whipping at you from all directions. You travel as quickly as you dare, and finally, you see your destination.

I Cast Chronal Chrysalis.name:
我施放《时茧》
I Cast Chronal Chrysalis

Text.text:
我在脑海里听见钟摆稳定的滴答声，双手在空气中划过，召唤我的法术。钟摆忽然一颤，time 的流动被打断，我将那股精粹汇聚进掌心。我把魔法像蛛网的丝线般抛向我的目标，丝缕闪烁着金、银与紫的光。魔法缠上他们，每一根丝线一旦钉住，便将一条肢体冻结。钟摆声越来越慢，越来越慢，直到最终以一声click戛然而止——我的目标被定格在原地。

~ 由 Alex 在 Envisioned

I hear the steady beat of a pendulum in my head as I roll my hands through the air, conjuring my spell. The pendulum stutters, the flow of time interrupted as I gather its essence into my grasp. I fling the magic like lines of spiderweb toward my target, the threads glittering gold, silver, and purple. The magic wraps around them, each thread freezing a limb as it makes purchase. I hear the pendulum become slower, slower, until finally it stops with a click and my target is frozen in place.

~ Envisioned by Alex

Temple To A Goddess Of Unicorns.name:
独角兽女神的神殿
Temple To A Goddess Of Unicorns

Text.text:
神殿如梦似幻，美得不似凡间。墙壁与廊柱由一种白色大理石砌成，石中流淌着虹彩般的纹理；其上雕刻着繁复精致的独角兽浮雕——成群奔腾、腾跃、昂首嘶鸣，镀金的蹄子踏出耀目光泽，独角般的角如珍珠般莹亮。越过殿墙，神殿的庭院是一片向天空敞开的青草原野。草地中央，一泓澄澈如晶的泉水自大地涌出，泉旁立着女神的大理石雕像，身着朴素的长衫。一只独角兽将头安静地枕在她的膝上。
The temple is a structure of ethereal beauty. The walls and columns—constructed of a type of white marble with veins of iridescence—are carved with exquisitely detailed depictions of unicorns: herds of them racing, leaping, or rearing on gilded hooves, horns gleaming like pearls. Beyond the walls, the temple’s courtyard is a field of green grass, open to the sky. At the center of the meadow, a spring of sparkling clear water wells up from the earth, and beside it sits a marble statue of the goddess, dressed in a simple shift. A unicorn rests its head in her lap.

你最先映入眼帘的是一片片空白画布般的船帆——后桅帆、主帆与前帆——以及在主桅瞭望台上方猎猎飞扬的长旌。数十位匠人合力打造了这艘船，从制绳与制帆师到造船匠与木工。船首探出一尊傲然的船首像，迎着大海的凶险不屈前指。艉楼甲板与船舱的设计精巧得胜过大多数宅邸。当钟声响起，船员呼喊应和、奔赴各自岗位时，连风浪与盐雾都仿佛被兴奋与冒险点燃。
The first things you can see are the blank canvas sails—mizzen, main, and fore—and the long banner flying over the main crow’s nest. Dozens of artists constructed this, from rope- and sailmakers to shipwrights and carpenters. A figurehead juts out arrogantly from the prow, against the sea’s perils. The quarterdeck and cabins are designed better than most houses. When the bell rings and the crew calls out and takes stations, the very elements are charged with excitement and adventure.

它那扭曲的入口藏在环绕的浅珊瑚礁间，礁群如卫士般护住此地，不让舰队的船只靠近。穿过其间，这处海蚀洞豁然通向一座巨大的洞厅，变幻的水面映出非尘世的幽光，沿着洞壁流转闪烁。洞内搭起了一座临时小镇——粗陋却可栖的避风港，收容着那些悬挂骷髅交叉旗的船只与人手。
Its twisting entrance hidden among the shallow reefs of coral that guard it against the ships of the fleet, this sea cave opens into a massive chamber, with unearthly light reflected along the surface of the shifting waters. Inside, a makeshift town has been constructed, a rude sanctuary for the ships and personnel of those who fly the skull-and-crossbones.

I Use Flurry Of Blows.name:
我使出【连环拳】
I Use Flurry Of Blows

Text.text:
我的每一次出击，都只是余韵。怀着明确的意志，我只动一次；顺乎本能，我便连击两次。不是狂乱，也不是不假思索，而是凭着清明——我知道自己身在何处，我的目标在何方，也知道训练早已教会我的手与脚该如何动作。待我回到中正，一切已化作一体：三件事，在同一瞬间完成。
They are afterthoughts, my strikes. With purpose, I move once, and by nature I strike twice. Not wildly or thoughtlessly, but with the clarity of knowing where I am, where my target is, and what my training has already taught my hands and feet to do. When I return to center, three things have been accomplished as one.

Summer Tournament Crowd.name:
夏季锦标赛人潮
Summer Tournament Crowd

Text.text:
看台上挤满了欢庆的人群，挥舞着鲜艳的旗帜，热烈的吼声此起彼伏。每当一位新的骑士被唱名，欢呼便层层叠高直至沸腾，回荡在整个场地，而策马的挑战者则绕场一周，接受这荣耀的巡礼。沫白的啤酒杯被高高举起，人们举杯痛饮，为诸位冠军的安康与荣光祝酒。
The stands are full of festive folk waving bright flags and roaring enthusiastically. As each new knight is announced the cheers rise to a crescendo, echoing about the list while the mounted contender does a lap of honor. Tankards of foamy beer are raised and the health of champions toasted.

Tide Pools At Low Tide.name:
低潮时的潮池
Tide Pools At Low Tide

Text.text:
形态各异、大小不一的水洼散落在岩石遍布的海滩上，没有一处深过你的膝盖，许多甚至浅得只没过一只手。粗糙的海星与肉质的海葵以斑斓的色块紧贴在水池的侧壁与底部，细小的鱼群在其中穿梭游动，四处寻觅逃生之路。
Puddles of all shapes and sizes lie scattered across the rocky beach, none deeper than your knees with many as shallow as a hand. Rough starfish and fleshy anemones cling in colorful splotches to the sides and bases of the pools while tiny fish swim about, seeking escape.

Hyper-reality Of Faerie Plane.name:
妖精位面的超现实
Hyper-reality Of Faerie Plane

Text.text: 从那道缠绕着光辉、悬浮于空的通往彼界的门扉，到此界之乐——以毫无道德可言的迷魅为弦——在这里亲身所经历的一切，都足以把心神拧入情绪与迷惘的乱结。就连色彩的光谱本身，也既是谜语，又像一篇言之凿凿的辩词，证明这个世界不过是一场幻觉。然而其效应仍在，触手可及的妖精也会造访其他位面，于是关于认知与真相的诘问便永无止息。去那一座座城堡与林间空地走一遭，望见有知之树，目睹仙灵诸廷的乖戾与恣意——若连这都不是幻象，那么物质世界究竟有多真实？ From the wreathed and levitating portal to the realm’s music with its amoral enchantments, everything physically experienced here can send the mind into twists of emotion and confusion. The very color spectrum is both a riddle and a convincing argument for this world being a hallucination. But the effects remain, and the palpable fey visit other planes, so the epistemological questions never stop. A visit to the castles and glades, the sentient trees, the caprices of the faerie courts—if this isn’t an illusion, then how real is the material world?

Hazel The Uncertain.name:
黑泽尔·未决者
Hazel The Uncertain

Text.text:
这位年迈的矮人面庞红润，深深的笑纹刻满脸颊；一双柔和的蓝眼睛让人不由自主地放下戒心。他对每一个擦肩而过的人都报以温暖、真诚的笑意——几乎被那壮丽的白胡子遮住：胡须编成辫子，收拢后塞进腰带里。而他总愿意与陌生人掰开面包、同桌分食。绑在他背上的那面饱经摧残的盾牌，倒是一件最惹人好奇的物品。盾面上密密覆满各式宗教圣徽，这面朴素的木盾见证了黑泽尔为寻得真正信仰而走过的动荡旅程；然而他曾侍奉过的每一位神祇，都以仁善与施舍为名。

~ Played by David from dScryb

The old dwarf has a ruddy face creased with deep laugh lines and soft, blue eyes that invite trust. He offers a warm and welcoming smile—almost hidden by the magnificent white beard, braided and tucked into his belt—to all who cross his path. And he is always willing to break bread with a stranger. The battered shield strapped to his back is a most curious item. Covered in all manner of religious icons, the simple wooden shield stands testament to Hazel’s tumultuous journey to find his true faith, though each god he has served is one of benevolence and charity.

~ Played by David from dScryb

村外不远处立着一处简易的遮蔽所，供过路人歇脚，也让他们的牲畜在旅行途中得以避风并休息。饲料台、用来挡风雨的简陋棚顶、拴马桩与饮水槽——看起来并不起眼，但这种粗陋的安置，足以让驯养的负重牲畜撑过一夜。
A simple shelter stands just outside the village, for wayfarers to shelter and rest their animals as they travel through. A platform for fodder, a simple roof to keep the elements at bay, a hitching post, and a water trough may not seem like much, but such rude accommodations would allow a domesticated beast of burden to survive the night.

Threat About The Musing Of Dead Men.name:
亡者低语之威
Threat About The Musing Of Dead Men

Text.text:
“我倒是很想继续聊下去，但我可没兴趣听死人絮叨。”
“I would love to keep talking but I don’t entertain the musings of dead men.”

伟大的橡树高耸挺立，百折不挠——数百年来一直如此。火焚、疫病与迷途雷击留下的疤痕遍布它厚实而饱经风霜的树皮，每一道都在诉说它的坚韧不屈。这位古老的巨人守望着由子嗣组成的森林，纵使岁月沉沉，古老的枝桠间仍结出新鲜翠绿的橡实。
The great oak stands tall and unbowed—as it has for centuries. The scars of fire, disease, and errant lightning strikes cover the thick, weathered bark of the tree, each one a testament to its resilience. The venerable giant watches over its forest of offspring, even as fresh green acorns form among its ancient boughs.

Barbarian Quip About Balance.name:
野蛮人关于平衡的俏皮话
Barbarian Quip About Balance

Text.text:
“人生讲究的就是平衡。比如我，有时候早上一睁眼，心里就只剩怒火。到了晚上该睡了，我还是一肚子火。平衡，懂吧？”
“Life is all about balance. Like, me, sometimes I wake up in the mornings and all I feel is rage. Then, when night comes and I go to sleep, I’m still in a rage. Balance, see?”

Barbarian's Speech Of Self-deprecation.name:
野蛮人的自嘲演说
Barbarian's Speech Of Self-deprecation

Text.text:
“软。瞧瞧你，你……你软，软乎乎的，松垮垮的，软，虚弱的小婴儿。对。你打人跟婴儿一样。大地的神祇都在笑你，你这软弱无力的小婴儿。”
“Soft. Look at you, you… you soft, softie, flabby, soft, weak baby. Yeah. You hit like a baby. The earth gods laugh at you, you soft, weakling baby.”

Marcus \"Murmur\" Saleb.name:
马库斯“低语”·萨勒布
Marcus "Murmur" Saleb

Text.text:
一个身形瘦削的男人穿着邋遢的衣服和一件长长的雨衣，掏出了手机。屏幕的蓝光照亮了他困倦的棕色眼睛，也照出他宽阔的鼻梁——鲜血正滴落进他的胡子和络腮胡里。设备上的光色忽然转为绿色，一串串怪异的符号映在他的脸上。他抽了抽鼻子，随即意识到什么，抬手捂住渗血的鼻孔。他喃喃自语，耸起肩膀几乎贴到耳边，把自己缩进衣领里，继续沿路前行。

~ 由一位英雄 扮演

A thin man dressed in unkempt clothes and a long raincoat takes out his phone. The blue light from the screen reveals bleary brown eyes, as well as a broad nose dripping blood into his mustache and beard. The color from his device suddenly changes to green, and strings of strange symbols are reflected onto his face. He sniffs and, realizing, holds a hand up to his leaking nostrils. He mumbles to himself, hiking his shoulders up to his ears and retreating into his collar as he continues on his way.

~ Played by a Hero

Flamboyant Street Promoter.name:
张扬的街头宣传员
Flamboyant Street Promoter

Text.text: 一个男人顶着脏辫，亮蓝、深紫与本色黑交织成瀑，从戴着手套的双手间投射出一块招牌。细薄的光丝从指尖延伸，像蜘蛛网的纤线般牵扯在空气里。招牌内容似乎与一场即将到来的活动有关，日期与时代在电蓝色的数字投影中燃得最亮。 “来嘛，别装忙了，”那名宣传员说道，笑容讨喜得不容拒绝。几乎每个路过的人都被他勾得回头，嘴角带着忍俊不禁的弧度回以一笑。 “你会想把这个写进日程表的，相信我！” 他与你对上视线，你这才注意到他额头上缠绕着某种金属工艺的纹饰，汇聚在眉心正中一枚钢蓝色的尖点。你忽然对他要说的话产生了强烈的兴趣。 A man with dreadlocks of bright blue, deep violet, and natural black projects a sign from his gloved hands, thin wisps of light extending from his fingertips like strands of spiders’ web. The signage has something to do with an upcoming event, the date and time burning brightest in the electric-blue digital projection. “Come on, now, stop pretending to be busy,” says the promoter, his smile so winning it’s undeniable. He turns the heads of almost every passerby, who return his grin with a bemused quirk at the corner of their mouths. “You want to make room for this on the calendar, trust me!” He catches your eye and you notice some kind of metalwork weaving about his forehead that coalesces at a steel-blue point in the center of his brow. You suddenly feel very interested in what he has to say.

Beautiful Iron Brooch.name:
美丽的铁胸针
Beautiful Iron Brooch

Text.text:
这枚胸针被精心打造成一条旗鱼的形状，铁质在部分位置发蓝，鳞片纹理清晰可辨。旗鱼正跃出水面，背脊弓起成一道漂亮的弧线。铰链安在它张开的嘴上方，因此当胸针完全打开时，别针便化作旗鱼修长的吻剑。针杆接触起来光滑，却又刻满繁复的水纹图案，与那冷灰的铁色形成出人意料的鲜明对照。
This brooch is carefully worked into the shape of a swordfish, the iron blued in places, the scales detailed. The fish is mid-jump, arching its back. The hinge sits just above its open mouth so that, when fully open, the pin becomes the swordfish's long bill. The pin shaft is smooth to the touch but elaborately engraved with water images, a surprising counterargument to the cold gray iron.

Green Ring Gas: In Use.name:
绿环毒气：使用中
Green Ring Gas: In Use

Text.text: 钢制罐体叮叮当当地砸在地上，发出一连串空洞的叮啷声，最终停住不动。随即“啵”的一声，紧跟着一阵凶狠的嘶嘶喷响。鲜艳的绿烟从手雷中喷涌而出，盘旋翻滚，迅速膨胀，充满整个区域。烟雾里隐约凝出一圈环状轮廓，像一条病态的套索，随时要收紧，勒住所有被困其中之人的喉咙。 The steel canister clatters against the floor with a series of hollow plinks before settling to a stop. A pop is followed by an aggressive hiss. Vibrant green smoke plumes from the grenade, circling and billowing to fill the area. The semblance of a ring forms in the smoke, like a sickly lasso ready to tighten about the necks of all those trapped within.

这座矮矮的圆形住处覆着一层防水外皮，两根木桩之间垂着一片厚实兽皮作门帘。毡房内，兽皮铺满地面以添舒适，一堆闷燃的篝火让温热的空气里带着辛辣的木烟味。烟雾从屋顶的小孔里轻柔逸出，木制格栅为帐篷厚重的皮革墙面提供支援。
The squat, round dwelling is covered with a waterproof outer layer and has a flap of thick hide to serve as a door between two wooden posts. Inside the yurt, animal furs have been laid across the ground for comfort, and a smoldering campfire adds a tang of woodsmoke to the warm air. Smoke gently drifts out of a small hole in the dwelling’s roof, and a wooden lattice provides support for the heavy leather walls of the tent.

在宇宙诸多畸变之物间，潜伏着一头合成怪物——以非法基因拼接孕育而成的禁忌造物。它以筋腱虬结、杂糅拼合的肢体高高矗立，丑恶的形态将掠食猛兽的残酷特征与造物者噩梦般的想象熔为一体。苍白而病态的皮肤上，从各处刺出细小的螺旋酶倒刺，仿佛纺锤般外张；那皮肤似乎在最轻微的创口处也会自行编织愈合。
Among the various abominations of the universe lurks a synthetic monster, a forbidden creation born of illicit gene-splicing. Standing tall on sinewy, chimeric limbs, the creature’s grotesque form melds elements of predatory beasts with the nightmarish imagination of its creators. Small, helicase barbs spindle out from points on its pale and sickly skin, skin that seems to knit itself back together at the slightest wound.

Pantry Of A Creepy Manor.name:
阴森宅邸的储藏间
Pantry Of A Creepy Manor

Text.text:
尽管通往储藏间的厚重门扇大敞着，你仍不由得觉得阴影黏附在此处——也许是那结实的锁具，竟能从外面把门反锁？或许只是你的想象，但你怎么也甩不掉那种感觉：一段哀伤的记忆栖居其中，而这间小屋曾同等地见证过泪水与怒火。某种难以辨认的腐败气味若有若无，始终躲开你的探查；你几乎无法判断它究竟从何处飘来。
Though the heavy door to the pantry is wide open, you cannot help but feel that shadows cling to this place—perhaps it is the sturdy locks that allow one to lock it from the outside? Maybe it’s just your imagination, but you cannot shake the feeling that a memory of sorrow dwells within, and that this small room has seen both tears and anger in equal measure. An unidentifiable odor of rot, barely there, evades your investigations; you cannot quite tell from where it originates.

这只大而方正的篮筐以厚实的芦苇紧密编织而成，顶端作人字形屋脊，一根坚韧的木杆构成脊梁。弧形的柳条提梁固定在这根木杆上；木杆同时还穿起两侧两扇平盖的芦苇铰链。篮内衬着素净的亚麻布。
Made from tightly woven thick reeds, this big, square basket has a gabled top with a rod of sturdy wood forming the apex. An arched handle of wickerwork attaches to this rod, which also holds the reed hinges of two flat lids to either side of it. Plain linen cloth lines the basket’s interior.

A Tenday Of Travel By Horse On Road.name:
沿路骑马旅行十日
A Tenday Of Travel By Horse On Road

Text.text:
你骑马旅行，每天天刚破晓便启程，沿着道路蜿蜒的脉络前行。最初几日平平无事；每到夜里，你就把这匹坐骑拴在路旁的树上休息。第四天，你的坐骑蹄铁脱落，只得匆匆修补。次日，又有一名旅人带着你听不出的口音前来问路，口中还提到一条巨龙。你并未把这些话放在心上，强打精神继续赶路，尽管疲惫已压在肩头。终于到了第十天，夕阳沉入远处的群丘之后，你的目标赫然出现在眼前。
You travel by horse, setting out at dawn each day and following the road's winding path. The first few days pass uneventfully, and each night you rope the steed to a tree by the roadside to rest. On the fourth day, your mount slips a shoe, and you're forced to make quick repairs. The next day, another traveler asks for directions in an accent you don't recognize, and speaks of a dragon. You pay their words little mind and press on, despite your weariness. Finally, on the tenth day, as the sun dips behind the distant hills, your objective appears before you.

Prehistoric Dinosaur Keepers.name:
史前恐龙饲养者
Prehistoric Dinosaur Keepers

Text.text:
驯养员们在村中巡行，身旁跟着各式各样、大小不一的恐龙。成群的巨型草食兽踏得大地震颤，被数名驯养员赶往牧场；每位驯养员都用一连串清脆的咔哒声、尖利的口哨与短促的喝令，指挥这些庞然巨物转向、止步、前行。村子的另一头，几只身形矫健的食肉恐龙披着斑驳的橙色皮甲，在族长警惕的目光下，被引导着穿越障碍训练场。
Keepers roam the village, accompanied by dinosaurs of all shapes and sizes. Colossal herbivores shake the ground as they are herded out to pasture by several individuals, each keeper utilizing a series of clicks, whistles, and barked commands to maneuver the beasts. Across the village, several lithe carnivorous dinosaurs with mottled orange hides are being guided through an obstacle course under the watchful eye of the chief.

Selkie Watch Gate In Winter.name:
冬日海豹精看守门
Selkie Watch Gate In Winter

Text.text:
塞尔基门顶上的卫兵守着夜与风的哨，冒着热气的保温壶紧贴在他们发抖的脸旁。几个人穿着厚重的棕色大衣，从河岸一路踩雪爬上来。

“都平安吗？”收费亭里的卫兵喊道。他饶有兴味地打量着他们，眼神里甚至带着几分疑心。

那一行人看起来像是一家子：同样深色的眼睛，棕色的浓密卷发从毛皮帽檐下探出来。大衣的臃肿之下，他们身形都相当瘦削，身上河水的腥冷气息也格外浓重。

一个看上去像父亲的男人朝卫兵点点头，咧嘴一笑，露出突出的下颌。“都平安，长官。带孩子们见识见识冬天怎么钓鱼。”男人的嗓音却出乎意料地尖细。

那声音惹得卫兵几乎忍不住笑出来。他挥挥手，放这家人过去。
The guards atop Selkie Gate keep their vigil, holding steaming thermoses close to their jittering faces. A group of people in heavy brown coats hike up from the riverbank. “All well?” calls the guard from the tollbooth. He eyes them with interest, even suspicion. The group appears to be a family, with matching dark eyes and thick curls of brown hair peeking out from under fur caps. They are all quite slender under the bulk of their coats, and the smell of river water is strong upon them. A man who appears to be the father nods at the guard and grins, revealing his underbite. “All well, sir. Showing the young ones how to fish in winter,” says the man in an unexpectedly squeaky voice. The sound of it elicits a barely concealed chuckle from the guard. He waves the family through.

Sundries From A Guardian Naga.name:
守护娜迦的杂货
Sundries From A Guardian Naga

Text.text:
你发现了啮齿动物的骨头和浸了毒的绷带。再仔细一看，你又翻出几张被侵蚀、被灼烧的笔记：字迹工整得宛如魔法之手亲书，却在其间充斥着狂乱而晦涩的胡言乱语，喋喋不休地谈论着蜕壳不朽者与水栖（特征）个体发育。
You find rodent bones and poisoned bandages. Another look and you uncover eroded and burned notes in the perfect penmanship of a magical hand, with wild, cryptic ramblings about the molting eternal and aquatic ontogeny.

Studded Belt Of Stone Giant Strength.name:
石巨人之力铆钉腰带
Studded Belt Of Stone Giant Strength

Text.text:
这条腰带以黝黑的鳞纹皮革制成，缀以蓝灰色金属束带。铆钉环绕腰带一圈，汇至正面，扣环端坐其上，形如锤首。扣环中央嵌着一张更为纯净的钢铁铸成的瘦削无毛面孔：深陷的眼眶里目光狭窄，鼻梁略尖，薄唇紧抿，下巴尖锐而带着酒窝般的凹陷。
The belt is made of dark scaly leather with bands of blue-gray metal. Studs surround the belt before coming to the front where a buckle sets, shaped like the head of a hammer. In the center of the buckle is a thin, hairless face made of purer steel, with narrowed sunken eyes, a somewhat-pointed nose, thin lips, and a dimpled, sharp chin.

Mausoleum Of A Wealthy Merchant.name:
富商陵寝
Mausoleum Of A Wealthy Merchant

Text.text:
陵墓外墙被浮夸的财富与地位陈设所掩蔽，宛如粗俗的珠宝——那种专为肆意炫耀成功而打造的饰物。尽管整座建筑仍遍布金箔，但在漫长的时代里，大片已剥落，露出下方灰暗的石材。巨大的铜制穹顶曾被打磨得如镜面般明亮，如今却染上了陈旧的青绿色泽。
Gaudy displays of wealth and status cover the mausoleum’s exterior like vulgar jewelry, the sort designed to gratuitously flaunt success. Though the gold leaf is still prolific across the structure, much of it has peeled away over time to reveal the drab stone beneath. The great copper dome, once polished to a mirror shine, has adopted an aged viridian hue.

埃德尔维尤庭院的喷泉曾被来自世界各地的学者研究——却无一例外地因喷泉边缘雕刻的符号与面孔而困惑离去。那些刻痕浅得几乎难以察觉，但喷泉与庭院的石材皆由一种珍珠般莹润的大理石制成，这种石料在本地区周边从未发现。水流几乎无声地落下，暮春时分，水面会浮起睡莲叶。鸟儿与孩子会在喷泉的下层池里嬉戏，然而许多成年人却会与之保持距离。
The fountain of Elderview Court has been studied by many scholars from around the world—all of whom left perplexed by the symbols and faces carved around its edges. The carvings are so shallow as to be barely noticeable, but the fountain and the stones of the court are made of a pearly marble not found anywhere near this region. The water falls almost silently, and lily pads appear on it in late spring. Birds and children will play in the bottom tier of the fountain, but many adults keep their distance.

Cursed: Disadvantage On Ability Checks A.name:
诅咒：所有与魅力相关的能力检定与豁免检定均带有劣势
Cursed: Disadvantage On Ability Checks And Saving Throws Tied To Charisma

Text.text:
怎么回事？你明明如此迷人又风趣，为什么他们不凑过来，不被你的机智逗得前仰后合，不在你眨眼时就融化？所有人都该竖起耳朵，立刻跟着你的节奏走，对吧。你才是发号施令的人！他们为什么不听？！
What’s the problem, when you’re obviously so charming and witty? Why aren’t they leaning in, laughing at your cleverness, melting when you wink? Everyone needs to listen and march to your drum, right now. You’re in charge! Why aren’t they listening?!

Animated Cemetery Statues.name:
灵动的墓园雕像
Animated Cemetery Statues

Text.text:
墓园里四处林立的石像开始移动，石屑簌簌落下。点缀喷泉的小天使、墓碑上方怒目而视的石像鬼、守护坟茔的天使——全都活了过来。它们张开僵硬的下颌，眨动眼睛，脸上浮现出真正的、活生生的表情：多半是如释重负与惊讶。它们转动肩膀，舒展手掌，花岗岩彼此摩擦，发出刺耳的碾磨声。渐渐地——因为躯体仍旧僵硬笨重——它们咔嚓作响地蹲下身，从底座上倾倒而下。落地时震得泥土颤鸣，随即抬头四顾，开始打量周遭。
Dust falls from the stony figures all about the cemetery as they begin to move. Cherubs adorning fountains, gargoyles glowering above tombs, and angels safeguarding graves—they all come to life. They stretch their jaws and blink their eyes into true, living expressions: mostly relief and surprise. They roll their shoulders and stretch their hands, the granite grinding against itself. Gradually, for their bodies are still stiff and unwieldy, they crunch down into crouches to tip off their pedestals. They land onto the earth in a shaking rumble and begin to survey their surroundings.

伴随布料撕裂般的声响，藤蔓自冲击点轰然爆出。缀满撕裂尖刺的植物绳索翻涌着覆上你的目标，将其牢牢钉在原地。藤蔓开始收紧……
With the sound of ripping fabric, vines explode from the point of impact. Vegetal ropes studded with shredding thorns roil over your target, locking them in place. The vines begin to constrict…

God Of Art.name:
艺术之神
God Of Art

Text.text:
在一座神殿里，你对着头顶那幅神性彩绘失声痛哭。你站在图书馆中，从一本书里读到自己的未来——又或者未来就躺在走廊的地毯上。喷泉的水声与你的愿望和鸣。他刻下那枚棋子，你便在心里将它想象成活物。她捏出一只陶碗，让你梦见失去挚爱那双手的温度。人们聚在博物馆里，争论谁才是艺术之神。他们耗尽一生去寻找——就像你现在这样——却忘了自己早已看见、嗅到、听见、触到那份神圣。艺术之神：就在这里，也在那里，无处不在。
In a temple, you wept at the divinity painted above. You stood in a library and read your future in a book, or perhaps lying upon the hallway rug. A fountain’s waters harmonized with your wish. He carved the game piece, and you imagined it into life. She shaped an earthenware bowl, and made you dream the hands of a lost love. People gather at museums, arguing over who is the God of Art. They spend their lives searching, as you are now, instead of realizing they have already seen, smelled, heard, touched the divine. The God of Art: there, and over there, and everywhere.

Young Black Dragon.name:
幼年黑龙
Young Black Dragon

Text.text:
它大如战马，矫健似猛虎，可你的思绪却将万兽尽数抛诸脑后，只剩一个名字：巨龙。乌黑发亮的鳞片坚如钢铁，为那肌肉虬结的身躯披上一层护甲；两支可怖的长角如镰自头颅斜斩而出，投下阴影，遮住深陷的双眼——那眼底闪烁着恶毒而聪慧的光。
It’s as big as a warhorse and as lithe as a tiger, but your mind discards thoughts of all other beasts but one: dragon. Glossy black scales, as tough as steel, armor its muscular form, and two terrible horns scythe from its head, shadowing deep-set eyes that glimmer with malevolent intelligence.

Kava Norixius.name:
卡瓦·诺里克修斯
Kava Norixius

Text.text:
一名年轻女子在舞台上恣意嬉舞，绚烂得近乎炫目。她被阳光吻过的双颊上，淡淡的绿鳞闪烁；亮丽裙摆一旋，露出同样泛着鳞光的双足。奇幻的形状环绕着她生角的头颅盘旋，星子般闪耀——是幻象，还是召唤？观众沉醉得无暇察觉，她描着黑色眼线的眸后，正有阴郁的怨恨暗暗灼烧，如同引火的枯柴，只待一点火星。

~ Played by TheKaiser

A young woman cavorts on stage, a spectacle of flamboyant color. Faint green scales glitter on her sun-kissed cheeks, and a swirl of her bright skirt reveals a shimmer of scaled feet. Fanciful shapes orbit her horned head and twinkle like stars—illusions, or conjurations? The crowd is too enthralled to notice the dark resentment smoldering behind her kohl-lined eyes, like tinder awaiting an inciting spark.

~ Played by TheKaiser

Patiently Addressing A Screaming Child.name:
耐心安抚尖叫的孩子
Patiently Addressing A Screaming Child

Text.text:
“哇，等等，先别动。嘿，我有个主意。你试试看倒着朝我走三步，然后原地转三圈。很好！还有，不许再尖叫了。”
“Whoa, there, hold on. Hey, I have an idea. Let’s see if you can walk backward to me three steps and then spin around three times. Good! And no more screaming.”

Fake Hat Of Disguise.name:
伪装帽（赝品）
Fake Hat Of Disguise

Text.text:
你把这顶奇妙的帽子戴到头上，凝神想象自己要投射出的幻象外表。你低头一看，却发现你……依旧是你自己。你摘下帽子，仔细端详。帽檐下竟藏着一层带饰的面纱，上面配着一副厚重眼镜和一撮蓬乱浓密的假胡子。
You place the wondrous hat upon your head and focus on the illusory appearance you wish to project. You look down and discover that you are… still yourself. You remove the hat and examine it. An accessorized veil is hidden under the brim, featuring a pair of thick spectacles and a fake, bushy mustache.

Sundries From A Roper.name:
来自潜伏怪的杂货
Sundries From A Roper

Text.text:
针刺般的利齿淌着涎液，咕嘟作响的胃酸把它喉后灼出斑驳疤痕，还有那些仍在扭动的丝状触手……这具死去的畸形怪物是炼金术士的美梦，却是其他所有人的梦魇。就连它那只独眼也依旧大睁着，鲁莽的猩红光泽闪烁不灭，或许也值得从眼眶里剜出，作为一份战利品。
Needle-like teeth dripping with saliva, gurgling stomach acids scarring the back of its throat, and those still writhing filamented tentacles… this dead monstrosity is an alchemist’s dream and everyone else’s nightmare. Even its single eye, still open wide and gleaming its rash-red color, might be a prize worth extracting from the socket.

Loot From A Young Copper Dragon.name:
来自幼年铜龙的战利品
Loot From A Young Copper Dragon

Text.text:
一小堆擦得锃亮的金属堆主宰着这处生物的巢穴。温暖而带着赤红的青铜与黄铜色泽，被古旧的黄金点亮，让整套藏品的色盘显得丰厚而悦目。房间里零星摆着几只陶土罐，罐中各色宝石熠熠生辉，诱人的光泽闪动着，仿佛在招手引你上前。光滑的岩壁上垂挂着数幅巨大的挂毯，每一幅都描绘着一则知名传奇中的一个篇章，毯边更缀以打磨过的彩色石子，勾勒出亮丽的边框。总体而言，这批藏品价值 5000 金币。
A small pile of burnished metal dominates the creature’s den. The warm, ruddy hues of bronze and brass are highlighted by antique gold, giving a pleasing richness to the collection’s palette. In terracotta pots dotted around the room, gleaming gemstones of every color shimmer with tantalizing luster, beckoning you forward. The smooth, rocky walls are covered by several large tapestries, each depicting a chapter in the saga of a well-known legend and each threaded with polished, colorful stones at the border. Overall, the collection is worth 5000 gold pieces.

Balcony Of Faerie Ballroom.name:
妖精舞厅的露台
Balcony Of Faerie Ballroom

Text.text:
巍峨的阶梯之巅，一座形似祭坛的陈设高踞其上，俯瞰着宏伟的宴会大厅：一张华美的木桌，细密的木纹在柔和的金色光里泛着温润的光泽。桌面上静卧着一株明耀盛放的植株，花瓣色彩从金黄流转至翡翠，再沉入深紫，同时不断释出发光的孢子，点点飘散如微尘星火。阳台左右两端尽头，各立着一扇巨大的木门。
Atop the majestic staircase, dominating the balcony overlooking the grand ballroom, is an altar of sorts—a gorgeous wooden table, the intricacies of the grain glowing in the soft, golden light. A luminous, blooming plant rests atop the table, releasing glowing spores as the colors of its petals shift from gold to emerald to deep violet. To the left and right the balcony ends at large wooden doors.

木料被敲击时回声空洞，却并不脆弱；整体结构结实稳固，试用时拐杖既不吱呀作响，也不弯折。它们由某种特殊树木精心雕成，刻痕里满是被珍爱过的耐心。握住拐杖上段的把手时，一道半圆弧稳稳托住你的手臂；你向前倾身，立刻察觉体重被均匀分摊在两支拐杖上，连手腕都不再隐隐作痛。那份触感向你灌注一种笃定：更可能折断的，是你自己，而不是这木头。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The wood sounds hollow when knocked, but the construction is solid and the crutches do not creak or bend when tested. These were lovingly carved out of a special kind of tree. They instill you with a confidence that you’re more likely to break than the wood. A semicircle stabilizes your arms when you grip the handholds on the upper quadrant of the crutches and, as you lean forward, you notice that your weight distributes evenly across both crutches and that your wrists don’t ache.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Emperor's Parade On The Royal Mile.name:
皇帝巡游于皇家一英里
Emperor's Parade On The Royal Mile

Text.text:
旗幡翻飞作响，帝国的仪仗队伍踏着整齐的步伐穿过城市拥挤的街巷。人们爬上街道两旁歪斜的屋顶、攀上倾斜的瓦面，只为抢得一处视野，目睹那闪耀夺目的军威游行。乐师奏起沉重有力的军歌，旋律掠过欢呼的人潮，点燃更炽烈的爱国狂热。参与者沐浴在聚集而来的万众喝彩之中。队伍中央——骑在披甲战马之上——皇帝威仪凛然，华服珠饰加身，身边簇拥着最亲近的卫士与顾问随侍左右。

~ 由 Dunchan 构想

Pennants flutter and snap as the imperial procession marches through the crowded streets of the city, and people clamber over the slanted roofs of the crooked dwellings lining the street, seeking any vantage to see the glittering parade of military might. Musicians play a thumping martial anthem, their melodies drifting across the cheering crowd and inspiring them to even greater patriotic fervor. The participants bask in the adulation of the assembled masses. At the center of the procession—atop his armored steed—the Emperor cuts a regal figure, bedecked in finery and surrounded by a retinue of his closest guards and advisors.

~ Envisioned by Dunchan

Loot From A Zombie Horde.name:
来自丧尸（特征）尸潮的战利品
Loot From A Zombie Horde

Text.text:
那团扭动翻涌、溃烂流脓的血肉丘已被击倒，它那噩梦般的浪潮终于被遏止。在恶臭扑鼻、腐烂的尸堆之间，你找到一枚镶宝石的戒指，价值20枚金币；一只被魔法封印的金质坠盒；以及足够多的钱币，让你的钱袋沉了整整50枚金币的分量。
The mound of writhing, suppurating flesh has been laid low, its nightmarish tide finally stemmed. Among the stinking, rotted corpses, you find a jeweled ring worth 20 gold pieces, a magically sealed golden locket, and enough coins to make your pouch 50 gold pieces heavier.

粗如战士挥剑臂膀的绷紧巨绳，被棘轮一点点绞到位，固定在一枚庞大的弩矢之后，矛头般森然指向下方吊桥的来路。尽管这架弩炮乍看像一把放大的简陋弩弓，你却确信，这件战争武器足以掀起令人毛骨悚然的毁灭。
Taut ropes, thick as a warrior's sword arm, have been ratcheted into position behind an enormous bolt, pointed menacingly at the approach to the drawbridge below. Though the ballista resembles a simple crossbow, you are certain this weapon of war is capable of truly horrifying devastation.

Tired Restaurant Server.name:
疲惫的餐馆服务员
Tired Restaurant Server

Text.text:
磨破的白色高跟鞋裹着肿胀的脚来回踱步，带着不容喘息的狠劲把食物从厨房一趟趟送出。疲惫的眼下挂着深深的眼袋，因那勉强撑起的笑而泛着泪光；他们的肌肉在用力中灼痛、颤抖。你最好多给点小费。
Swollen feet in scuffed white pumps pace back and forth, ferrying food from the kitchen with relentless intensity. Bags droop beneath exhausted eyes watering from the strained smile on the server’s face, and their muscles burn and quiver with exertion. You’d better tip well.

Gnome Riding Raccoon.name:
侏儒骑乘浣熊
Gnome Riding Raccoon

Text.text:
她将大腿深深陷入坐骑那厚密的灰色皮毛中，侏儒猛然冲锋向前，长矛被她指节发白的手紧紧攥住。骑在浣熊背上，她不受地形阻碍；而她那戴面具的伙伴也轻快地向前窜行，以灵巧的从容穿过重重障碍。生物兴奋地吱吱作响，驮着朋友一路疾奔，迫不及待想在她的冒险之后分得一份战利品。
Sinking her thighs into the thick, gray fur of her mount, the gnome charges forward, a spear clutched in her white-knuckled hand. Atop the raccoon she is unhindered by the terrain, and her masked friend scampers effortlessly forward, navigating obstacles with dexterous ease. Chittering excitedly, the creature bears his friend onward, eager to claim his share of the spoils after her adventure.

Grippli Warrior.name:
格里普利战士
Grippli Warrior

Text.text:
小小的战士自水中升起，显露出矫健的身形；斑驳的绿皮覆着两栖生物般的湿亮光泽。尽管身量不比半身人更大，这生物的双腿却肌肉虬结、青筋鼓胀。哨兵以惊人的优雅与力量腾空跃起，落在你面前。那陌生人青蛙般的面孔上浮起一丝近似微笑的神情，并抬起一只格外类人的手向你致意。
Rising from the water, the small warrior reveals a lithe physique, their mottled green skin covered with an amphibious sheen. Though no larger than a halfling, the creature’s legs are corded with bulging muscle, and the sentry launches themselves into the air with incredible grace and strength to land before you. Something akin to a smile spreads across the stranger’s frog-like countenance, and they wave a strikingly humanoid hand in greeting.

Underground Dweller Quip About Darkness.name:
地下居民关于黑暗的俏皮话
Underground Dweller Quip About Darkness

Text.text:
“你们都无法理解的是，光是一场谎言，是一层虚假的安全涂层，粉饰着现实。唯有把它从自己身上剥离，你才能发现真正的自己是谁。”
“What you all can’t understand is that the light is a lie, a false safety glossing over reality. Only when you rid yourself of it can you discover who you really are.”

Gyras Wuldhall.name:
吉拉斯·伍德霍尔
Gyras Wuldhall

Text.text:
他长着山羊般蓬茸的腿与分趾蹄——像个萨堤尔——双眼却幽幽泛着绿光；但这瘦削男子偏偏没有那些狂野妖精常见的角。相反，他的轮廓纤细而锋利，连耳朵都尖得像刃。嵌宝的额环箍住他凌乱的乌黑卷发，让发丝垂至铆钉皮甲的肩铠处，不至于遮住面容。他站得局促不安，神色阴郁，目光谨慎地来回扫视。两只拇指始终卡在腰带里，挨着几只华丽的皮囊与几把入鞘的利刃。

~ Played by Matthew Love with

He has the furry legs and cloven hooves of a goat—like a satyr—and his eyes glow green, but this lean man lacks the horns common to those wild fey. Instead, his features are slim and sharp, including his pointed ears. A jeweled circlet holds his tousled ebony curls, which hang to the pauldrons of his harness of riveted leather, out of his face. He stands ill at ease, brooding, watching carefully. He keeps his thumbs tucked into his belt near several ornate pouches and a few blades in scabbards.

~ Played by Matthew Love with

Night Market: Row Of Stalls.name:
夜市：摊位长排
Night Market: Row Of Stalls

Text.text: 一串串灯笼悬在潮湿发亮的街面上方，投下金、红、粉与紫的浑圆光斑，在地面上滚动成片。摊位一字排开，面貌大同小异——折叠桌、直白的招牌、摊主们阴郁的夜猫子眼神——可卖的东西却各不相同。面摊的炒锅冒着热汽，油与洋葱的咸香浓郁，隔着两摊都能勾人肚腹。一对母女在卖用废金属做的首饰：易拉罐拉环、被戳穿的便士、还有弯成戒指的钉子。一个自称女巫的人，雌雄莫辨的脸上布满穿孔与点状纹身，漫不经心地挥手拂过一叠写着手抄咒语的卡片：Love Incantation、Ensorcell Your Enemy、Hex to Hack。大多数摊主手腕上都戴着笨重的收银手环，黑色屏幕用绿色像素跳出简短指令与表情符号。 Strings of lanterns hang over the damp-slickened street, casting globular reflections of gold, red, pink, and purple. The row of stalls is characterized by similar aspects—folding tables, straightforward signs, and vendors with gloomy night-owl eyes—but the wares vary. The wok of a noodle stall steams, the savory smells of oil and onion enticing even from two stalls away. A mother and daughter sell jewelry made from discarded metal: soda can tabs, punctured pennies, and nails curled into rings. A self-proclaimed witch, their androgynous face pierced and tattooed in dotted patterns, waves a hand casually over their collection of cards with hand-written spells: Love Incantation, Ensorcell Your Enemy, Hex to Hack. Most vendors wear a bulky point-of-sale bracelet on their wrists, the black screen creating simple commands and emoticons via green pixels.

Flying Cleric Strikes Down Demon Lord.name:
飞天牧师一击斩落魔王
Flying Cleric Strikes Down Demon Lord

Text.text:
她驾驭高贵的飞马，周身燃起灿金的圣怒，宛如一颗携罚而来的神圣彗星。她向恶魔领主轰出一束灼烈的圣辉，光芒命中之刻，那卑劣暴君的血肉滋滋作响、焦灼燃烧，污秽的形体在刺目的光中枯萎湮灭，被逐回孕育其诞生的诅咒暮影界。
Ablaze with radiant fury atop her noble pegasus, the cleric is a divine comet of retribution as she unleashes a searing bolt of holy energy toward the demon lord. The wretched tyrant's flesh sizzles and burns when the light strikes them, their pestilent form shriveling into oblivion as they are cast back to the cursed gloaming realm which spawned them.

Goblinoid Battering Ram.name:
地精类攻城撞槌
Goblinoid Battering Ram

Text.text:
污垢与血痂覆满这根巨大的攻城槌。被铁链锁在粗巨圆木上的地精们因期待而尖叫；粪水与脏水被哗啦泼洒在覆皮的顶棚上——寄望以此作护符，抵御即将降临的烈焰。一个臃肿的食人魔拍着那根刻满恶魔面孔的尖桩，满怀憎恨地龇牙咆哮。
Grime and blood encrust the length of this great ram. The goblins chained to the huge log scream in anticipation as dung and water are slopped across the hide-covered roof—hopeful wards against imminent fire. A corpulent ogre pats the spike carved with faces of demons, snarling with hate.

虬结的树木自沼泽湾咸苦的水面上拔起，根须与藤蔓纠缠成一团。水的气味不对——死滞而腐闷——厚厚的藻类笼罩其上；偶尔有涟漪掠过那看似平静的水面，水下的鱼正追逐虫子觅食。成千上万的昆虫在沼地里爬行游弋，振翅与啮鸣塞满了空气。
Gnarled trees rise from a tangle of roots and vines in the brackish water of the bayou. The water smells off—stagnant—and is shrouded in algae, ripples occasionally playing across its placid surface as fish below hunt for bugs. Thousands of insects prowl the swamp and fill the air with chittering.

I Attempt To Control A Sphere Of Annihil.name:
我试图掌控一颗湮灭之球
I Attempt To Control A Sphere Of Annihilation

Text.text:
群星之间黑暗的冰冷与无情的虚无在我试图操控那悬浮的黑色球体时触及我的心神。我凝视着深渊，一阵恶心的浪潮席卷而来，我必须强迫自己集中精神，才不至于当场干呕。
The cold, unfeeling emptiness of the darkness between the stars touches my mind as I attempt to control the hovering black sphere. A wave of nausea washes over me as I gaze into the void, and I must concentrate to stop myself from retching.

Acrobatic Dwarven Circus.name:
矮人杂技马戏团
Acrobatic Dwarven Circus

Text.text:
矮人矮壮、宽厚、沉重如山石，本不该让人指望他们擅长杂技表演——可他们偏偏做到了。矮人杂技演员以惊人的灵巧与从容腾跃、翻滚、旋转，在空中穿梭，结成复杂到近乎不可能的活体金字塔。压轴更是令人屏息：你目不转睛地看着九名杂技演员搭出一架摇摇欲坠的“人梯”……第十名自顶端纵身俯冲，扎进一桶翻涌起泡的麦酒里，引来雷鸣般的掌声。

~ 由DaveDaWanderer在Discord上构想

As squat, wide, and heavy as mountain stone, one wouldn't expect dwarves to excel in acrobatic displays—yet here they are. With incredible dexterity and poise, the dwarven acrobats leap, tumble, and spin through the air as they form living pyramids of impossible complexity. The finale is truly breathtaking, and you watch transfixed as nine acrobats form a teetering ladder… and the tenth dives from its apex into a barrel of foaming ale to rapturous applause.

~ Envisioned by DaveDaWanderer on Discord

Manual Of Quickness Of Action.name:
迅捷行动之书
Manual Of Quickness Of Action

Text.text:
这本书以染成乌黑如墨的皮革装订，正面封面仅有一处装饰——一道闪电的雕刻。翻开书页，你看见一些图示：例如一名男子手握带重的木条，走在绷紧的钢索之上。你还瞥见几段用以磨砺身手灵敏的练习描述，比如要快到足以在火舌灼伤你之前，迅速掐灭烛焰。
This book has been bound in dyed jet-black leather, a single engraving of a bolt of lightning on the front cover its only decoration. Within its pages, you see diagrams of figures such as a man walking across a tightrope holding a weighted billet. You also glance at descriptions of exercises to sharpen one’s nimbleness, such as snuffing a candle’s flame quickly enough to avoid the flame’s burn.

这块墓碑上深深刻着一圈环形文字：生命的故事是一场无尽的悲伤轮回，因为人们并未意识到——句末的“到”又引回开头的“生”，让这段墓志铭成了一个阴森的玩笑。 This tombstone bears the deep inscription of a circle of words: The story of life is an endless cycle of sorrow because people don’t realize that—the end of the sentence “that” leading back to the word “The” makes the epitaph a grim joke.

Aspect Of Tiamat.name:
提亚马特的性相
Aspect Of Tiamat

Text.text:
她自恶魔般的幽冥阴影中现身：一条庞然巨龙，身躯与利爪四肢覆满干涸血色的鳞片，周身缠绕着猩红炼狱般的烈焰。火海随她巨大的蝠翼展开而渐息——那双翅膀如破碎的暗影般铺张。五条颈项自双翼之前探出，居中的那条最为粗壮，披着深红鳞甲，耳缘生褶，头顶两支象牙巨角向后弯掠。红色头颅的猩红背脊冠一路延伸贯穿全身，直抵尾端那带蝎刺倒钩的尖梢。红首左侧并列两颗龙首：一颗湛蓝，耳缘流苏般外翻，鼻梁竖着一支白色角；另一颗雪白，长角沿头顶向后斜伏。另一侧同样升起一对龙首——其一披覆翠绿甲鳞，脊冠如带刺的帆；其二以黑曜石般的鳞甲武装，面貌如骷髅般森然，角尖前指。她自每一张犬牙嶙峋的口中齐声咆哮，声若雷霆，裹挟着刻骨的憎恨与狂怒。
She emerges from fiendish gloom: a colossal dragon, her body and clawed limbs covered in scales the hue of dried blood, and wreathed in a crimson inferno. The conflagration abates as her enormous, batlike wings spread like tattered shadows. Five necks sprout to the fore of these extremities, the central and largest sporting crimson scales, frilled ears, and great, backswept ivory horns. The scarlet dorsal crest of this red head runs down the length of her body, to her scorpion-barbed tail tip. To the red head’s left are a blue head, with fringed ears and a white nasal horn, and a white one with its horn angled backward along the crown. On the opposite side, another duo of draconic heads rises—the first plated in green with a crest like a spined sail, the second armored in obsidian-hued scales, skull-like in visage, and with forward-pointing horns. She roars from every crooked-fanged maw, the thunder of it bearing hatred and wrath.

仪态庄严，这名比例完美的人形身披熠熠生辉的金色圣衣，与他们银白的肌肤形成鲜明对照，却又与那一绺绺长卷发相映成辉。其体量与身姿赋予其阳刚的性相，但轮廓间又隐约透出几分阴柔。他们神情慈悲，双眼泛着柔和的蓝光。光耀的羽翼自肩胛舒展而出，然而那对覆羽的肢体究竟是否与躯体相连，却难以辨明。
Stately in bearing, this perfectly proportioned humanoid wears gleaming golden vestments that contrast with their silvery skin but match their long curls. Their mass and stature grant a masculine aspect, but their form hints at femininity. They wear a compassionate expression, eyes glowing soft blue. Shining wings extend from their shoulders, although it’s unclear whether the feathered appendages connect to the body.

它连同猎获的猎物也不过两英尺高、三磅重，是一种极难获得的魔宠。它是猫头鹰中最为独立的一类，不情愿负重，也不爱交换情报。此刻这只披着斑驳的灰、黑与橡果褐的羽色。它的目光牢牢钉住你，仿佛在衡量你的价值，而你却无法看出它的裁决为何。
Two feet tall and three pounds heavy with its hunted prey, this is a difficult familiar to gain. These are the most independent of owls, reluctant to bear burdens and trade information. This one is brindled gray, black, and acorn brown. With a riveting gaze, the owl seems to judge your worth, and you cannot tell what the verdict is.

Flooded Cavern: Ominous.name:
被淹没的洞窟：不祥
Flooded Cavern: Ominous

Text.text:
这座洞穴里的空气让你觉得不对劲。这里没有一丝微风，可在回响的滴答与扑通声背后，你仿佛听见一阵绵延不绝的呻吟，像是有人久久地吸着一口气。你屏息凝神，努力分辨并确认那声音的来源，又察觉到更多异样动静：溅起的水花大得绝非滴水可比，紧接着传来一声低沉的咆哮或呻吟。那肯定不是自然现象！
Something about the air in this cave feels different. There’s no breeze, but behind the echoing drips and splashes, you think you can hear a continuous moan, like a long intake of breath. Straining to hear and place the sound, you notice other unusual noises: splashes too big to be water dripping, followed by a kind of growl or groan. Surely that wasn’t natural!

污渍与臭味把这瘦长的少年标记成一名马厩小工。他穿着朴素的亚麻短袍，以绳索作腰带束紧。染成铁锈红的亚麻长裤护着双腿，柔软皮革制的鞋子包住双脚。他那蓬乱的棕发像是许久之前照着碗沿剪过一圈。他躲避他人的目光。然而那双绿眼睛却明亮得很，神情坦然，带着好奇。

~ Played by Ace Wheelie with

Stains and stench mark this gangly lad as a stable boy. He wears a plain linen tunic with a rope belt. Linen pants dyed rust red protect his legs, and shoes of soft leather cover his feet. His mop of brown hair looks to have been sheared some time ago along the lip of a bowl. He avoids the gaze of others. His green eyes are bright, though, and his expression is open and curious.

~ Played by Ace Wheelie with

Undermountain Kraken.name:
地脉山渊的海妖巨魇
Undermountain Kraken

Text.text:
你面前那潭死水忽然炸裂翻涌。一团触手猛然冲天而起，蜿蜒的长肢遍布疤痕与锯齿般的倒钩，纠结成一片。浪头轰然拍下，将你兜头浇透；那巢穴般蠕动的臂肢伸展探来，阴沉的恶意塞满了腐臭的空气。

~ Envisioned by Adonis

The pool of stagnant water before you suddenly erupts. A mass of tentacles bursts upward, their sinuous lengths a mess of scars and serrated hooks. A wave crashes over you as the nest of writhing arms reaches out, their dark malignance filling the stinking air.

~ Envisioned by Adonis

Fey Spring Concert.name:
妖精之春演奏会
Fey Spring Concert

Text.text:
导演以毫无拘束的喜悦指挥着这场流光溢彩的芭蕾盛宴；他丝绸般的长发在身周翻涌成一片斑斓狂潮，随着他与舞者一同挥手、旋舞而起。新绽花朵的芬芳为空气染上一抹怡人的甜意，回荡在木质露天剧场里的旋律清澈明亮，宛如凛冽而澄净的春晨。

~ Inbal 于 Discord

The director conducts the flowing prismatic ballet with unrestrained joy, his silken hair flowing about him in a riot of colors as he gestures and dances with the performers. The scent of fresh blossoms tinges the air with a delightful sweetness, and the melodies ringing through the wooden amphitheater are clear and bright like a crisp spring morning.

~ Inbal on Discord

前方吹来一阵凉风，裹着腐肉败烂的恶臭。巫妖绕着房间踱步，骷髅般的脚掌刮擦地面，发出刺耳的摩擦声——那张可怖的面孔却平静得近乎冷漠，甚至带着几分耐心。碎裂的骨片从生物腐朽的皮肤中刺出，火焰般的双眼散发不祥的幽光，在它枯槁的脸颊与金色王冠上投下诡异阴影。它身披的长长丝袍几乎掩不住那具早已死去的躯壳真相——由恶意与魔法同等缝合、勉强维系。
A cool breeze from ahead brings with it the stench of decomposing flesh. Skeletal feet grate against the ground as the lich circles the room—its ghastly features calm, even patient. Chipped shards of bone pierce the creature's rotten skin, causing the ominous glow from its fiery eyes to cast eerie shadows along its emaciated face and golden crown. The long silk robes it wears do little to hide the truth of its expired form—held together by malice and magic in equal parts.

Arrival Of The Faerie Carnival.name:
妖精嘉年华的到来
Arrival Of The Faerie Carnival

Text.text:
在城外的一片旷野上，人群聚拢而来，穿着应季的衣裳。有人提着空篮子，有人攥着票券。蓝黑色的旋涡一卷，云层与原野之间裂开一道异界的门扉。狂欢节的篷车从中缓缓降下，或由马匹牵引，或由狐狸、兔子拉行——它们背生蝶翼，振翅如梦。最后一辆篷车随之现身，由狂欢节的主人亲自驾驭。他们贴地掠过，向人群轻触帽檐，笑意一闪而过。篷车一辆接一辆落地，围成一圈巨大的圆环；随之，粼粼的雾光从车厢间翻涌而出，灌满中央，将即将搭建的狂欢场地笼罩在朦胧帷幕之下。

~ Envisioned by Zevram

In a field outside the city a crowd gathers, wearing clothes of the season. A few hold empty baskets, and a few hold tickets. With a swirl of blue-black a dimensional portal opens between the clouds and the field. Carnival wagons descend through it, drawn by horses, foxes, or rabbits with butterfly wings. The last wagon emerges, driven by the Carnival's owners. They fly low to tip hats and flash smiles at the crowd. As the wagons land one by one, creating a great circle, a shimmering fog billows from them to fill the center, shrouding where the carnival grounds will be assembled.

~ Envisioned by Zevram

I Paralyze With My Rod Of Lordly Might.name:
我以威严权杖施以麻痹
I Paralyze With My Rod Of Lordly Might

Text.text:
当我挥动那根魔法法杖猛然一击，震耳欲聋的雷鸣在我周遭轰然炸裂，令敌人仿佛骤然石化般僵在原地。他们全身绷紧，双眼惊恐地左右乱窜，却无力阻止魔法将其彻底吞没。躯体瞬间锁死，随即像被推倒的雕像般轰然倒地。
As I strike with the magical Rod, a cacophonous boom of thunder erupts all around me, causing my foe to freeze as if suddenly petrified. They stiffen as their eyes dart back and forth in panic, unable to halt the magic overcoming them. Their body locks in place, and they fall to the ground like a toppled statue.

Iris Volkova.name:
伊里斯·沃尔科娃
Iris Volkova

Text.text:
温和而阅尽世事的眼睛，仿佛雾霭天空的色泽，在这名女子的面庞上闪着微光。她把笔直、修长的银金色长发披散着。然而她的身躯却坚硬结实、充满力量，皮肤上布满细小的伤疤。她的左臂套着一截由层叠皮甲片组成的护袖，上覆一枚肩甲护住臂膀；其系带横跨过一条斜挂的剑带，剑带同侧在她腰间挂着一柄入鞘的长剑。皮革与毛皮缠裹着她的胸口，并垂覆在她的髋部与大腿上；她的靴子也由相似的材料制成。一只羽色灰淡的小鸟停在她的头顶，灵巧的黑眼睛机警地打量着一切。

~ 由Zach 扮演

Kind, world-wise eyes, the hue of a misty sky, shine in this woman’s face. She wears her straight, long, and silvery-blond hair loose. Her body, however, is hard, athletic, and covered in small scars. A sleeve of layered leather plates topped with a pauldron protects her left arm. Its strap crosses a baldric that holds a longsword sheathed at her waistline on the same side. Leather and fur wrap her chest and drape over her hips and thighs. Similar materials comprise her boots. A tiny, gray-feathered bird observes, with clever black eyes, from its perch on her head.

~ Played by Zach

Bronze Dragon Lair.name:
青铜巨龙巢穴
Bronze Dragon Lair

Text.text:
唯一一处不靠翅膀也能进入的洞口藏在咆哮的浪涛之下，隐没于一片海藻森林之后。隧道一路向上，最终在一座临海洞窟中露出出口。湿滑的绿色藻膜覆满每一寸表面，空气里浓重的咸味刺入鼻腔。分岔如迷宫的通道继续向上延伸，足有数百尺。拍岸浪声的低鸣渐渐退去，被沉重的寂静取代。随后，你听见有什么在动——有什么庞然之物拖着自身的重量在地面摩擦前行。巨龙就在近处。
The only cave entrance accessible without wings lies beneath the roaring waves, concealed behind a forest of kelp. The tunnel leads upward, emerging in a seaside cave. Slick, green algae covers every surface, and salt heavily tinges the air. The branching, labyrinthine tunnels lead upward, hundreds of feet. The drone of crashing waves gives way to heavy silence. Then, you hear something move—something massive dragging its weight across the floor. The dragon is close.

Cleric Victory Line.name:
牧师胜利台词
Cleric Victory Line

Text.text:
“我本不该沉溺于卑劣的快感，但看着你走向毁灭，确实令我心底生出一丝微薄的愉悦。”
“I am not supposed to indulge in base gratifications, but watching your demise does bring me a small measure of joy.”

Abandoned Base In Moon Orbit.name:
月轨废弃基地
Abandoned Base In Moon Orbit

Text.text:
这座废弃基地如幽灵般悬垂在空间里，绕着一颗小而隐秘的卫星缓缓轨道运行。三座独立的机库舱与中央主体相连，顶部耸立着两座塔：一座安置着精密的武器阵列，另一座则是雷达信标。靠近时，基地看起来完好无损，却沉睡不醒——没有着陆灯，没有牵引光束扫过的锥形光柱，通讯频道里也毫无嗡鸣。唯一的生命迹象，是雷达塔底部一盏孤零零的灯在规律闪烁。
Dangling in space like a ghostly apparition, the abandoned base orbits a small, secluded moon. Three separate hangar bays are attached to a central complex topped with two towers: one housing a sophisticated weapons array, the other a radar beacon. On approach the base appears intact but dormant—no landing lights, no sweeping cone of a tractor beam, no buzz on the comm channels. The only sign of life is a single blinking light at the base of the radar tower.

贵族英俊的五官因讥诮的冷笑而扭曲，化作映照他对你蔑视的残酷倒影。比你所拥有的一切都更华美的衣饰披覆在他高挑、修饰得一丝不苟的身形上，耀目的翠绿与莹亮的金黄交织，宛如一袭孔雀翎羽般的华丽披风自他背后层层倾泻而下。
A sneer of derision creases the noble’s handsome features into a cruel reflection of his contempt for you. Clothes, finer than anything you own, drape his tall, manicured form in stunning greens and lustrous yellows, mimicking a resplendent cloak of peacock feathers cascading down his back.

红橙相间的虎毛下是如铁般隆起的肌肉，他对一切都保持警觉——那双蓝眼像冰冷的宝石，永远在搜猎。开口时，他粗粝张扬的嗓音自信十足，辅音咬得铿锵有力，常拿来点评他人的特质与动作。他所属的变形者教团古老而务农，由像他这样的战士守护。战锤“铸日者”沉沉卧在他爪间，背后一面有灵性的盾牌不安分地轻晃，他那身红色鳞片护甲隐隐透着恶魔般的气息。作为一头大猫，他能用存在感填满整间屋子……也能悄然淡入阴影。

~ 由 Prettzellecchia Played

Heavily muscled under his red-orange tiger fur, he is alert to everything—blue eyes, like cold gems, always hunting. When he speaks, his brash voice is full of confidence and punctuated consonants, often in commentary on the traits and actions of others. His shapeshifter order is ancient, agricultural, and protected by warriors like him. Sunforger, his warhammer, sits powerful in his paws, an animated shield fidgets on his back, and his red scale armor appears vaguely demonic. As a big cat, he can fill a room with his presence… or fade into shadow.

~ Played by Prettzellecchia

这只柔软的鹿皮钱袋被分成数个隔层与侧袋，并配有皮革扣环用以固定小瓶。它散发着辛辣而带金属味的气息。袋侧垂着几条细薄的钢链，每条链上都连着数枚圆环，便于系挂护符、法器与钥匙。更大的钢环则可将钱袋悬挂在腰带或背带上。翻盖以一枚朴素的钩扣固定。
This soft doeskin purse is divided into several compartments and side pockets, and it has leather loops for holding vials. It smells pungent and metallic. Thin steel chains hang from the side, each with rings for fastening charms, focuses, and keys. Larger steel rings allow the bag to be hung from a belt or strap. The flap closure has a simple hook fastener.

Speech About Drained Happiness.name:
关于被抽干的幸福的演说
Speech About Drained Happiness

Text.text:
“有时我觉得自己把所有幸福的源泉都榨得干干净净，贪婪痛饮，直到连滋味都被喝没了。可在你这里，那口泉却仿佛永不枯竭。”
“Sometimes I feel as though I’ve drained every source of happiness dry, guzzling it down until it loses all flavor. Yet, it seems with you that well springs eternal.”

只需一番接触，再低声念出几句咒语，那只精致的宝箱便在你眼前悄然褪去，化作虚无，被送往以太位面——在那里，凡俗的窃贼绝不可能夺走你所置入其中的任何东西。
With but a touch and a few words, the exquisite chest fades into nothingness before your very eyes, sent to the Ethereal Plane where no mere thief could possibly take that which you have placed inside.

螳螂人身披太空陆战队的护甲，手持两柄灵能匕首。他的甲壳以深绿伪装，触角短促，复眼如切面的黑曜石般幽暗，却足够传神，显出他沉静而坚定的意志。背上挂着一只次元袋，上面别着一枚崭新的校徽。

~ Played by Dunec with

The mantid wears the armor of a space marine and carries two daggers of psionic energy. His carapace is camouflaged in dark greens, his antennae are short, and his eyes are a faceted black, expressive enough to demonstrate his quiet determination. On his back is a bag of holding, sporting a fresh, new school badge pinned to it.

~ Played by Dunec with

Fine Dining Establishment.name:
高级餐饮场所
Fine Dining Establishment

Text.text:
当你走近这家餐饮店的入口时，映入眼帘的是那扇上好硬木制成、打磨得油亮的门，以及其上抛光如镜的黄铜饰件；门外还立着一名侍者，身着一尘不染的制服，戴着雪白手套——看上去唯一的职责，就是为来客开门。你一边走近，一边在心里默默检查自己的衣着与体面，心知只要在这里吃上一顿，便足以让你的私房钱大出血……但听人说，这样的一餐，会让人多年之后仍记忆犹新。
As you approach the entrance of this dining establishment, you note the polished brass fittings of its finished hardwood door and the attendant standing outside—in a spotless uniform and snow-white gloves—apparently for the sole purpose of opening the door for patrons. You mentally check over your clothing and hygiene as you approach, knowing that any meal you purchase within would put a significant dent in your personal funds . . . but, from what you have heard, such a meal would be remembered for years to come.

Open Dungeon Door.name:
打开地城大门
Open Dungeon Door

Text.text:
伴随着一声痛苦的呻吟，门在锈蚀的铰链上吱呀作响地开启，露出门外那片幽暗而未卜的世界。斑驳破碎的门面刻满爪痕与武器的重击痕迹，那是无数次血腥冲突留下的伤疤。它越张越开，一股腐臭的空气猛地逸出，裹挟着血腥与腐肉的气味。
With a painful groan, the door creaks open on rusted hinges, exposing a world of dark uncertainty beyond. Its chipped surface is etched with claw marks and weapon blows, the scars of countless violent encounters. As it yawns wider, a gust of fetid air escapes, carrying with it the scent of blood and rotting flesh.

Weary Police Force Lieutenant.name:
疲惫的警队副队长
Weary Police Force Lieutenant

Text.text:
宽阔的肩膀仿佛扛着整座城市的重量，那位疲惫的警督瘫坐在办公桌前，面前摊开一堆令人费解的文书，像小山般堆叠。官僚体系、罪案横行、公众的轻蔑——这一切都在无情啃噬着这个人在倾向无序的世界里苦苦维系法度的意志。
Broad shoulders sag with the weight of a city as the weary police lieutenant sits at their desk, a mound of baffling paperwork splayed out before them. The bureaucracy, the crime, the public contempt—it all takes a toll on this person struggling to uphold law in a world prone to anarchy.

I Craft An Arrow Of Petrification.name:
我制作一支石化箭
I Craft An Arrow Of Petrification

Text.text:
我把那只装着软化溶液的小瓶子一直搁在工具旁，以防万一——虽然我已经有一阵子没出过岔子了。戴着手套，我将抹了沥青的石质箭镞牢牢嵌进细长箭杆末端的凹槽里。我用刀把沥青一点点抹匀，谨慎得很，生怕刮到石头。那道魔法就藏在石心——一层若隐若现的银色粉尘——随着我的动作微微闪烁，像个顽皮的眨眼，提醒我务必小心。
I keep the small bottle of softening solution next to my tools, just in case, though I haven’t had an accident in a while. With gloved hands, I affix the pitch-daubed stone arrowhead into the notch at the end of the thin shaft. I smooth out the pitch with my knife, taking care to not scrape the stone. The magic, visible as a subtle spackle of silver dust at the center of the stone, glimmers as I work—a mischievous wink, reminding me to take care.

你能从商人的脸上看出来：谈判的每一步都像在泥泞的山坡上滑落，手指死死抠住想要触及坡顶，却终究还是一路向下。解释与辩解都已结束后，一个冷淡而失望的点头便是最终的结算。两人离开时，一方带着更多的欢喜，也带着更多的财富；另一方则不然。
You can see it in the trader’s face, the sense that each step of the negotiation is like slipping down the side of a muddy hill, clawing to reach the top but sliding downward all the same. After the explanations and defenses have concluded, a curt and disappointed nod is the final account. One leaves with greater happiness, and greater wealth, than the other.

Well-known Professional Reporter.name:
知名职业记者
Well-known Professional Reporter

Text.text:
透过一段颗粒粗糙、满是雪花杂讯的影像传输，这位英勇的记者伫立在战斗残骸之间，手握一支古旧的麦克风，将最新战况播报给整个银河。她的眼眸在敬畏与恐惧间闪烁，讲述着对立外星势力所掀起的毁灭与荒芜。
Through a grainy, static-laden pict feed, the heroic reporter stands amid the debris of battle, archaic microphone in hand, delivering the latest news to the galaxy. Her eyes shine with both awe and terror as she recounts the devastation wrought by the opposing alien forces.

战士在同伴重新集结时厉声下令，催促他们整队，准备迎接下一波冲锋。汗珠在她泛红的橙色皮肤上闪闪发亮，她一边审视局势，一边以惊人的速度推演所有可能的结局。她在脑海中勾勒出战场——从高处俯瞰，交战者如同棋盘上的棋子——獠牙森然的嘴角悄然浮起一抹笑意。她攀上路障顶端，在烟雾弥漫的空气里编织奥术手势，身形灵动却分毫不差。闪烁的洋红能量如薄纱般落在同伴身上，灌注他们超自然的速度与技能。她满意地点头，随即拉开长弓，搭箭在弦，静候敌人踏入她的陷阱。

~ Played by Colby - d4: D&D Deep Dive

The warrior barks commands at her allies as they regroup, preparing for the next assault. Sweat glistens on her ruddy orange skin as she assesses the situation, her brilliant mind extrapolating all potential outcomes with incredible speed. She pictures the scene—viewing combatants from above like pieces on a board—and a smile creeps across her fanged maw. Climbing atop the barricade she weaves arcane gestures in the smoke-filled air, her movements lithe yet precise. Glittering magenta energy settles over her allies, imbuing them with supernatural speed and skill. Satisfied, she draws her longbow, nocks an arrow and waits for the enemy to spring her trap.

~ Played by Colby - d4: D&D Deep Dive

Vial Of Airway Relief.name:
气道舒缓小瓶
Vial Of Airway Relief

Text.text:
起初是胸口一阵发紧，伴随着一丝朦胧感官般的瘙痒；接着你的喉头轻微收缩，细微到几乎察觉不到，直到呼吸变得费力，喘息才骤然开始。用力会让情况更糟，你甚至开始害怕任何突如其来的英雄壮举——怕自己会像离水的鱼一样在地上徒劳扑腾。饮下这瓶小瓶中黏稠的褐色液体时，魔法随之渗入气道，在流过的瞬间强迫它张开，让氧气再次轻松涌入肺中。这些说明被人贴心地潦草写在一块粘上的纸莎草纸补丁上，歪歪斜斜地挂在玻璃小瓶外。

~ 构想自 Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

First there’s a tightness in the chest, a vague sense of itching, then your throat constricts so slightly that you don’t notice, until breathing becomes a labor and the gasping starts. Exertion makes it worse, and you fear sudden heroics that could leave you flopping on the ground like a fish out of water. As one drinks the viscous brown fluid in this vial, the magic seeps into the airway as it passes, forcing it to open and allowing the easy flow of oxygen into the lungs once more. This information is helpfully scribbled on a glued patch of papyrus that hangs haphazardly on the glass vial.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

枪杆以紫杉木雕琢而成，缠着皮革握带；而两端却是匠心独运的金属工艺，宛如艺术品。枪刃是一颗银铸的天使头颅，戴着带翼头盔，翼尖延展成锋利的锯齿刃端。承口与枪杆的连接处嵌着一颗硕大的珍珠；枪尾则以银与珍珠簇成，形似一枚巨大的卵。仅仅目睹这柄武器，亡灵便会心生恐惧。僵尸在它的突刺下迅速干枯，随即倒地。
The shaft is a carved yew wood with leather grips, but the ends are expertly metal-worked pieces of art. The blade is a silver angel’s head in a winged helm, the wingtips forming the sharp serrated tip of the blade. A great pearl occupies the connecting point of the socket to the shaft, and the butt of the spear is a cluster of silver and pearls the shape of a large egg. Just the sight of this weapon frightens the undead. Zombies desiccate and fall to its thrust.

这块细长的石灰岩板一侧装着把手与固定带，像一面风筝盾。但它看上去更像一块风化崩裂的墓碑——裂痕纵横，苔痕斑驳。盾面以古老而残损的文字刻满姓名，像潮湿岁月里仍不肯沉默的名单。 [Activated] 你唤起亡者庇护自身。一名幽灵（特征）从石盾上的某个名字里猛然迸出，挡下迎面而来的重击。随即，那名字从盾面上消失无踪。 [Creature Dies Nearby] 一缕尖啸的灵体从新鲜的尸身里被撕扯而出，无法抗拒地被拖入盾中。它的名字随之浮现在墓碑般的盾面上，仿佛有一只看不见的手正冷冷刻下。 [Wielder Dies] 黑暗降临片刻后，你感到一股不可抗拒的牵引。你从躯壳中飞出，直奔那面墓碑盾而去。你眼睁睁看着自己的名字出现在它的表面，随后坠入那冰冷、无光的深处。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

This long slab of limestone has a handle and bracing strap on one side, like a kite shield. But it looks like a crumbling tombstone, complete with cracks and moss. Names engraved in a weathered, ancient script adorn the stone shield’s face. [Activated] You invoke the dead to protect you. A ghost bursts from a name on the stone to block the incoming blow. Then that name disappears. [Creature Dies Nearby] A screeching spirit tears from the fresh corpse, pulled inexorably into the shield. Its name appears on the tombstone’s face, engraved by an invisible hand. [Wielder Dies] After a moment of darkness, you feel an irresistible pull. You fly from your body toward the tombstone shield. As you watch your name appear on its surface, you sink into its cold, lightless depths.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

斯派尔威奇的金融区大多是翻新过的楼宇，线条利落，工业质感冷硬。人们提着钱袋、攥着钞票在街上穿梭，脸上不是沉重就是恍惚，尽被一天的生意牵着走。可在这片商业中心的一角，却有个地方格格不入：一座高耸的老塔，乡舍风格。斑驳的屋顶压在摇摇欲坠的砖墙之上，砖块风化开裂，像随时会剥落。门上方的招牌褪色缺口，仍能辨出中世纪字体写着：Exchange。而这建筑最后、也许最怪的一点，是屋顶上永远栖着一只乌鸦——谁要在塔门前逗留得太近、太久，它便扯开嗓子厉声聒噪。 The financial district of Spirewych mostly features modernized buildings, sleek and industrial in design. Folk mill about with purses and bank notes in hand, expressions heavy or distracted with the business of the day. One corner of this commercial center, however, sticks out like a sore thumb: a tall, old tower built in cottage style. The patchy roof is stacked atop walls of crumbling brick. A sign above the door, faded and chipped, reads: Exchange in medieval script. The final and perhaps strangest feature of this structure is an ever-present crow that roosts on the roof. It squawks loudly at anyone who lingers too near or too long at the tower door.

他足有七英尺高，体魄雄健，圆润的肌肉足以扛起板甲的重量，背上还斜绑着一柄巨剑。沉默而巍然，这名战士既令人敬畏，又令人叹服。他身上没有任何家族或派系的徽记，衣着风格也难以辨认。骨白色的半面具遮住了他面部上半部——再加上一条布质面罩覆住口鼻、下颌与颈项——他行走于世，彻底隐于无名。面具上的眼孔被割得极窄，甚至连他眼睛的颜色都无从分辨。

~ 由 Thordak 扮演

He stands at seven feet tall, robust with rounded muscles to carry the weight of plate armor and a greatsword strapped to his back. Silent and towering, the warrior is as imposing as he is impressive. He bears no emblem of a house or faction, and his style of dress is indiscernible. With a bone-white half mask obscuring the top of his face—and a cloth gaiter veiling his mouth, chin, and neck—he walks in complete anonymity. The eye holes in the mask have been cut so narrow, you cannot even discern the color of his eyes.

~ Played by Thordak

女主人那奢华的笑声倏然一转，化作阴森的轻笑，她抬起一只手，像利爪般撕扯着空气。你对她的印象被猛地扯裂——如同一袭彩烟披风般蒸散消失——显露出一具魁梧的黑毛巨躯，狮般的面孔狰狞逼人。长须掩映的唇角咧开，露出满口锋利獠牙与修长巨牙，轻笑随之沉坠，化为低沉的咆哮。
Your host’s luxurious laugh transforms into a sinister chuckle as she reaches a hand up to claw the air. Your image of her rips away—evaporating like a cloak of colored smoke—to reveal a hulking form of black fur with a leonine face. Whiskered lips curl in a broad smile of sharp fangs and long tusks as the chuckle becomes a low growl.

Gust Of Wind.name:
狂风之息
Gust Of Wind

Text.text:
你将掌心的一粒豆子吹起，随即握紧成拳。狂风从指缝间骤然爆发，化作连绵不绝的疾风向外奔涌。你一边死死攥住拳头，一边专注于法术，引导风暴的怒意倾泻而出。
You blow across a bean in the palm of your hand and make a fist. Wind erupts from between your fingers, rushing outward in an ongoing gale. You struggle to keep your grip as you concentrate on the spell and direct the wind’s fury.

一阵冷风拽动着高处的枝桠；一棵树孤零零地矗立在这座古塔入口前，宛如独守的哨兵。它曾经或许有四层之高，但很久以前，塔顶女墙被什么猛然削断，碎石轰然坠落，掏空了塔身，在内外堆成一片倾塌的石丘。门洞在眯起的箭孔下方大张着，像一张巨脸正试图绕过树干窥视。
A cold breeze pulls at the high boughs of a tree standing as lone sentinel in front of the entrance to this ancient tower. Once it was perhaps four stories tall, but something sheared off the parapet long ago, sending rubble down to gut the tower and form a tumbled heap of stone inside and out. Its doorway gapes open beneath squinting arrow slits, like a great face trying to see around the trunk of the tree.

Mallet And Orb For Enchanter's Polo.name:
附魔师马球用槌与球
Mallet And Orb For Enchanter's Polo

Text.text:
木槌由一种轻盈的蔚蓝金属打造，槌头大得有些夸张，仿佛漫画里才会出现。挥动时，内部传来清脆的叮当轻响，像是塞满了细小的铃铛。那枚圆球似乎由薄玻璃制成，脆弱得令人心惊。圆球靠近木槌的槌面时，会“以魔力相连”。它悬在木槌前方的空间中，疯狂旋转，仿佛夹在磁石的推拉之间。即使不用于游戏，这枚圆球也会散发出活泼灵动的气息。
The mallet is crafted from a lightweight, azure metal and its head seems cartoonishly large for its purpose. When swung, a light tinkling sound comes from within, as if it’s full of tiny bells. The orb seems to be made of thin glass, terribly fragile. When the orb is near the mallet’s face, it “connects with magical force.” The orb hangs in space before the mallet, spinning wildly, as if between the push and pull of magnets. Even when not in play, the orb radiates a lively aura.

Ferrys, \"The All'seeing One\".name:
费里斯，“全视之眼”
Ferrys, "The All'seeing One"

Text.text:
一枚浅绿的棱柱绕着这位气度不凡的精灵头颅盘旋，幽辉流转，把他一头金色长发染上一层冷色的光晕。他那双蓝绿异色的眼眸凝视着掌间的秘奥古书，修长的手指紧扣书脊；眉心深锁，连同两眉之间那只繁复的眼形印记一并皱起。敞开的长袍披在他纤瘦的身形上，衣襟裁开处露出胸前一幅跃动的纹身——星群在夜空中游走、漫延。叹息一声，他将沉甸甸的书塞进一只精致的袋子里，书的负载竟不知为何能穿过那狭小的袋口。

~ 由 Ararion Played

A pale-green prism orbits the head of this impressive-looking elf, its lambent glow staining his long blond locks. With mismatched blue-green eyes, he ponders the content of the esoteric tome clutched between his slender hands, his furrowed brow creasing the intricate eye emblazoned between them. An open robe adorns his slender frame, its cut revealing an animated tattoo capering across his chest, a constellation of stars meandering across the night sky. Sighing, he thrusts the weighty book into an exquisite bag, its bulk somehow fitting into the container’s small opening.

~ Played by Ararion

Loot From A Stirge.name:
一只吸血蚊蝠的战利品
Loot From A Stirge

Text.text:
当你解决掉最后一只可憎的刺针蚊，它的尸体从空中坠落时，你注意到不远处泥淖里有一堆白骨。你草草搜了搜尸体，发现一对沉甸甸的金属骰子，凹槽里嵌着金色墨迹——落到识货的人手里，必定价值不菲。
As you dispatch the last horrid stirge and its body falls from the air, you notice a pile of bones in the muck nearby. A cursory search of the body reveals a pair of weighty metal dice inlaid with golden ink—surely valuable to the right person.

Mountain Pass: Wildlife.name:
山口：野生动物
Mountain Pass: Wildlife

Text.text:
一只鹰从你所在的山腰掠过，从上方俯视它的身影让人感到异样。你注视着它，它越飞越高；而当你的目光追随着它攀升时，视线掠过坡面上一团毛茸茸的身影，正笨拙地踉跄前行。距离太远，难以看清那是什么生物，但风势不知怎地把它烦躁的哼哧声与恼怒的咆哮一并送到你耳边，还夹杂着某些更小生物的嘶嘶声——它们显然正在纠缠追逐它。
An eagle soars past your place on the mountainside, and it feels strange to see it from above. As you watch, it rises higher; and as you follow it with your eyes, your gaze passes over a furry form trundling across the slope. The distance makes it difficult to tell what the creature is, but some trick of the wind brings its grumpy grunts and annoyed roars to your ears along with the sound of hissing from some smaller creatures that must be harrying it.

当你穿行在一片片广阔的乡间农田之间时，一处铺展开的聚居地在接近之际骤然显露。它从路上并不容易被看见——这里的人并不住在木屋或砖房里，而是栖居在山坡上星罗棋布的地穴洞居中，俯瞰着一条支流，为他们的菜园送去水源。每一处可钻可躲的家都用一扇门牢牢封住：样式各不相同、手工打制，镶着上釉的窥视小窗，尺寸也并非为人类准备，而是为半身人量身打造。每户人家的炉灶——展现出别出心裁的巧思——都连着一根烟道，通往山丘背面探出的烟囱。村子中心确有几幢小建筑：店铺、酒馆，甚至还有一间招待旅客的旅店；而那些并未全身心投入买卖或交游的人，则窝在自家洞里，享受他们珍视的生物舒适，如这些矮小的族人向来所爱。
Nestled between sizable acreages of rural farmland, a sprawling settlement is suddenly revealed as you approach. It is not easily seen from the road, as the people of the settlement do not live in houses of wood or brick, but in burrow-holes dotting a hillside and overlooking a tributary providing water to their gardens. Every bolt-hole home is secured with a door, each idiosyncratic and hand-tooled, fitted with glazed peek-windows, and sized not for humans but for halflings. The stove of each home—in a demonstration of ingenuity—connects to one of the smokestacks peeking out of the far side of the hill. While there are small buildings in the center of the village itself, shops and taverns and even an inn for visitors, those who are not fully engaged in trade or camaraderie are in their homes, enjoying their creature comforts as the bantam people are wont to do.

Sundries From An Ochre Jelly.name:
赭色黏怪的杂货
Sundries From An Ochre Jelly

Text.text:
蠕动的软泥渐渐溶散成一滩泛黄的液洼，几根骨头哗啦啦坠落在地。一个类人生物的颅骨滚到你脚边，软泥意外的保存让它那阴森的笑容未见腐朽。散落的骸骨杂物间，你还发现了一顶带角头盔，像是头部挨了数记重击而弯折，另有几把斧头，刃口锈蚀斑驳。
As the wriggling ooze dissolves into a yellow-tinged puddle, a number of bones clatter against the ground. A humanoid skull rolls toward your foot, its macabre grin free of decay thanks to the ooze’s unintended preservation. Among the skeletal sundries, you also find a horned helmet, bent as if from several blows to the head, and a few axes with rusted blades.

Intimidation By A Cleric.name:
牧师的威吓
Intimidation By A Cleric

Text.text:
“拜托，别害怕。我的誓言绝不允许我在有人需要照料时袖手旁观。所以，要是我这位朋友最后把你杀了，我也会守在你身边，一次又一次把你带回来，直到你交出我们想要的情报。”
“Please, do not be afraid. My oaths would never allow me to stand by and do nothing when somebody is in need of care. So, if my friend here ends up killing you, I will be right by your side to bring you back again and again until you provide the information we seek.”

一名看上去百无聊赖的官僚在数据板上轻敲着手指，娴熟地在劳工与数据分析员的名单间飞快滑动。他们的人形外表毫不起眼：灰暗的衣着，阴沉而饱经风霜的五官。你说不清他们是三十岁，还是三百岁。他们从数据板上抬起头，用那对细小、纯黑的眼睛望向外面的人群。一抹训练有素的笑容像抹开的黄油般，在他们脸上缓缓铺开。
A bored-looking bureaucrat taps at a datapad, scrolling expertly through lists of laborers and data analysts. Their humanoid form is entirely nondescript: drab clothing, grim and weathered features. They could be thirty or three hundred. They look up with beady, pure-black eyes from their datapad and at the people beyond. A practiced smile spreads like butter across their face.

Velkan \"Armkiller\" Solistarian.name:
维尔坎「断臂者」索利斯塔瑞安
Velkan "Armkiller" Solistarian

Text.text:
一名男子仿佛从古老史诗中被拽入现实，手持一顶带角头盔，与一柄杂种剑相对而立。他宽阔的面庞——曾经苍白，如今因长日曝晒而呈古铜色——显得和善；那双锐利棱角分明的眼睛里，跃动着青年特有的蓬勃神采。他俯身致意，一缕凌乱的黑发从束发的缎带下逃出，落在脸侧。待他直起身，袍服微微错动，露出一副华丽的钴蓝钢胸甲，其上浮雕着一张狰狞恶魔的面孔。

~ Played by Ian McCullough

A man, seemingly plucked from an ancient epic, holds a horned helmet opposite a bastard sword. His broad face—once pale, now bronzed from long days in the sun—seems kind, his sharp angular eyes bright with the exuberance of youth. He bows in greeting, and a strand of messy black hair falls across his face, escaping the ribbon tying it back. As he straightens, his robes shift to reveal an ornate breastplate of cobalt steel emblazoned with the face of a gruesome fiend.

~ Played by Ian McCullough

你低声咕哝咒词，做出细微的手势，让自己将心神收束在这道法术的意图上。你的目标不是塑造魔法，而是敞开自身，去感受它在你周遭空间中被扭曲的轨迹。其他附魔会以昭然若揭的方式折叠魔法的织理，泄露它们的用途——很快，你就会看见它们在何处、又如何运作。
You murmur the words and make the small motions that help you concentrate on the purpose of this spell. Your goal is not to mold magic but instead to open yourself to the way that it warps in the space around you. Other enchantments fold the fabric of magic in telltale ways, which hint at their purposes, and soon you’ll see where and how.

Loot From An Astral Dreadnought.name:
来自星界恐怖巨兽的战利品
Loot From An Astral Dreadnought

Text.text:
这头无畏巨兽似乎刚刚与一艘穿行星界的船只发生过一次遭遇。缆绳与帆布纠结成团，死死缠在那掠食者庞大头颅上方的一根巨角周围。再凑近细看那起伏蠕动的堆叠物，便会发现：一只上了锁、镶着黄铜箍带的桃花心木蒸汽旅行箱，被牢牢绑在一截碎裂的桅杆横木上。
