This dreadnought seems to have had a recent encounter with an astral-faring vessel. A tangle of ropes and sail is snarled around one of the horns crowning the predator’s massive head. Inspecting the undulating heap more closely reveals a locked, brass-banded mahogany steamer trunk lashed to a splintered length of spar.

Old General At War Council.name:
老将军的战时军议
Old General At War Council

Text.text:
老将军专注地听着议会争吵不休，众人始终无法就计划达成一致。战室里那张沉重的橡木长桌上，铺满了插着木制标记的地图，桌面凌乱不堪；头顶的枝形吊灯由粗铁链悬着，烛火几乎燃尽。夕阳透过将军座椅后的彩绘玻璃沉落，他霍然起身，一拳砸在桌上。寂静瞬间席卷全场，所有目光都钉在这条老战犬身上。只听他压低声音、如咆哮般威严地下达战斗计划，挑衅般地等着谁敢反对。

~ Sahlonahl 于 Discord

The old general listens intently as the council bickers, unable to agree on a plan. Maps covered in wooden tokens are strewn across the heavy oak table in the war room, and a chandelier—its candles almost burned down—hangs from thick iron chains overhead. As the sun sets through the stained glass behind the general's chair, he rises and slams his fist on the table. Silence rushes through the assembled and every eye is on the old war dog. In a low, commanding growl, he lays out the battleplan, daring someone to disagree with him.

~ Sahlonahl on Discord

孩子们咕嘟咕嘟冒泡般的欢笑声此起彼伏——他们沉醉在一座游乐场的奇妙里：这里把无拘无束的想象力与魔法装备融为一体。旋转木马在旋转时卷起一片闪烁的色雾，旁边排成一列的连环传送门让捉迷藏的每一局都从不轻松。细小的元素精灵帮着年幼的伙伴在沙坑里堆出异想天开的造物，而被施了咒的地面也会乖巧地托住每一次绊倒与跌落

~ 由 David 在 Discord 上构想

The bubbling, joyous laughter of children rings out as they delight in the wonders of a playground that blends unencumbered imagination with magical equipment. Roundabouts twirl in a haze of shimmering colors as they spin, and linked portals arranged nearby ensure no game of tag is ever easy. Tiny elementals help their young friends build whimsical creations in the sand pit, and the enchanted floor obligingly cushions any trips or falls

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Waterfall With Dangling Rope.name:
垂挂绳索的瀑布
Waterfall With Dangling Rope

Text.text:
一道白色水羽沿着高耸断崖的嶙峋岩壁翻卷而下，随即坠入一汪令人惊艳的蔚蓝水潭，四周尽是葱郁繁茂的植被。潭水又从一处较小的瀑口逸出——这道水流拍击巨石飞溅而下，汇成一条潺潺溪涧。一条打结的绳索从水潭上方约30英尺处的岩沿垂落，或许只是供跃下之人攀爬回去。
A white plume of water tumbles down the rocky face of a high escarpment before plunging into a startlingly blue pool of water surrounded by lush vegetation. The water escapes through a smaller waterfall—this one splashing over boulders and down to form a stream. A knotted rope dangles from a ledge about 30 feet above the pool, perhaps just for jumpers to climb.

在喧闹市集的热浪里，一名香料商人以斑斓的身影攫住了你的目光。她披着层层飘逸的亮色布料，仿佛将货物的色泽穿在身上；背后藤编箱篓紧紧束着各式香料。乌黑卷发如瀑倾泻，映着日晒后的暖意，勾勒出她的面容。她的双手沾染着浓郁的赭黄与深红，粗糙起茧却依旧灵巧优雅，指节与掌纹间留着手艺带来的细小伤痕与斑渍。
Amid the heat of the bustling market, a spice trader catches your eye with her colorful appearance. Adorned in a vibrant ensemble of flowing fabrics, she embodies the hues of her wares, which are secured to her back in a wicker case. Her ebony curls cascade like a waterfall, framing her face with sun-kissed warmth. Her hands are stained with rich ochres and reds, calloused yet graceful, bearing the blemishes of her craft.

The Labyrinth And The Orb & Tower.name:
迷宫、宝珠与高塔
The Labyrinth And The Orb & Tower

Text.text:
葡萄园与旅店归一对学院第四代校友夫妇所有，他们酿制一系列价格不菲的附魔葡萄酒。「宝珠与高塔」典雅而宽敞，弥漫着一股诡异的魔法气息，令不少市民对它的餐馆与赋礼商店敬而远之。每逢假日与庆典，身披长袍、头戴秘法尖帽的怪人便会出入旅店——大多和善——尤以春分秋分与冬至夏至之日最为热闹。那座迷宫在镇上被称作「迷城」，是神秘学家与求道者趋之若鹜的景点。
The vineyard and inn belong to a couple of fourth-generation Academy alumni who produce an expensive selection of enchanted wines. The Orb and Tower is elegant, spacious, and filled with a strange aura of magic that keeps many of the citizens away from its restaurant and gift shop. Strange folk—most of them friendly—in robes and arcane hats frequent the inn at holidays and festivals, especially equinox and solstice days. The labyrinth, known as The Maze in town, is an attraction for mystics and seekers.

一座大都会安卧于这片海底幽谷中，四周是随波摇曳的海带田野，荧光水母洒下柔和的光。城市呈环形布局，中央有一座高塔拔地而起。建筑杂糅着圆形与方形的棚屋，其上方投下阴影的是那些宽檐屋顶的巨构——它们由饰满符文与象形图的雄伟立柱高高托起。褐、绿、黄相间的珊瑚加固着城市的石灰岩地基，使其呈现斑驳而多孔的质感。人鱼在海带、棚屋与立柱间自如穿梭。身着虹彩短袍的卫兵在上方巡游，手持三叉戟，珊瑚甲覆身，身旁还跟着巨大的鲟鱼——胡须般的吻端轻颤，时刻保持高度警觉。

~ Envisioned by Giuseppe

A metropolis rests in this undersea vale, surrounded by fields of swaying kelp and lit by luminescent jellyfish. The city is shaped in a circle with one tower rising at its center. The buildings are a mix of round and square hovels, shadowed by wide-roofed structures held aloft by mighty columns decorated with runes and pictographs. Corals of brown, green, and yellow reinforce the city’s limestone foundations, giving it a mottled and porous appearance. Merfolk swim fluidly through kelp, hovel and column. Guards in iridescent tunics swim above, armed with tridents, armored in coral, and accompanied by great sturgeons whose whiskered snouts twitch on high alert.

~ Envisioned by Giuseppe

这只微小的红陶圆罐一侧带着粗糙的环形把手，便于握持与倾倒。哪怕塞着软木塞，仍散发出刺鼻的焦油味。红褐陶壁上蜿蜒的暗色油痕，昭示着曾有油液从瓶身溢洒。
This tiny round jar of red clay has a rough loop handle on one side to facilitate holding and pouring. It reeks of tar, even through its cork seal. Dark rivulets on the clay flask mark where oil has been spilled.

Goddess Of Pleasure.name:
欢愉女神
Goddess Of Pleasure

Text.text:
欢愉女神：人们说她的姐姐——痛苦女神——爱热闹，可从欢愉那臻于完美的永恒人生里，你绝不会看出半点阴影。有时她为正经活计把头发束起，马尾般甩动；有时她又将长发放下，任由轻松的快感自然而来。女神将一切拿捏得恰到好处：明亮的笑、柔和的舞步，凝神专注的片刻，带着疑问的好奇探究。欢愉不是放纵：她只允许自己微微发福，继而再微微清瘦。她懂得疲惫，也懂得甜美的休息。她那双顽皮的眼里闪着光，像在招手，满腹盘算。
The Goddess of Pleasure: they say her sister, the Goddess of Pain, loves company, but you would never know from the perfection of Pleasure’s eternal life. Sometimes she bundles her hair back for her good work, swinging like the tail of a horse, and other times she lets her hair down for the effortless pleasures. The goddess balances it all, bright grins and pleasant dances, moments of concentration, quizzical curiosities. Pleasure is not excess: she only lets herself get a little heavy, then a little thin. She knows exhaustion and sweet rest. The glow in her naughty eyes beckons, full of plans.

I Cast Seeming.name:
我施展「易容幻景」
I Cast Seeming

Text.text:
我缓缓环顾四周，挑选目标，并对每一个人摊开平直的掌心。对每个目标，我都在脑海中勾勒他们焕然一新的模样。随后我召来一场由色彩、光芒与阴影织成的雨。那些虚幻的雨滴落下时，我以随心改写的现实为我的对象覆上一层新漆。每一个人都披上幻象的外衣，如我所想般呈现出全新的面貌。
I look around slowly, picking my targets and presenting a flat palm to each one. For each, I visualize their new appearance. Then I call forth a rain of color, light, and shadow. As these illusory drops fall, I cover my subjects with a reality repainted according to my wishes. Each one, cloaked in illusion, now looks as I envisioned.

Ghost, Elf Necromancer.name:
幽灵（特征），精灵死灵法师
Ghost, Elf Necromancer

Text.text:
尽管这名高等精灵正凝望月光，宽阔的皮革腰带上却沉甸甸地挂着一本法术书，他身上却并未披着法师长袍。取而代之的是一身剪裁精致的皮制护甲，染成乌黑如墨，与他苍白的肤色和长及背脊的雪白长发形成刺眼对比。右手里，他紧握一柄镰刀，刀身由某种暗哑的灰色金属铸成，诡异地仿佛拒绝光线——无论柄或刃，都不映出半点月辉。左臂朝向月亮伸出，肘部微曲；起初你并不明白这姿势的缘由，直到一阵振翼声掠过耳畔——一只巨大的黑色渡鸦俯冲而下，利落地停在他伸出的前臂上。魔宠回到身侧，他这才转过身来。冰蓝色的眼睛从你与伙伴们身上一扫而过，锐利得令人难忘，却仍不及那眼下深陷的浓重黑影更醒目。

~ Played by Kevril N

Though the high elf staring out into the moonlight has a hefty spellbook attached to his wide leather girdle, he does not wear the robes of a wizard. Rather, he is adorned in fine leather armor, dyed jet black in stark contrast to his pale complexion and long, snow-white hair. In his right hand he grasps a scythe of some dull gray metal that curiously seems to eschew the light, providing no reflection along the shaft or blade. His left arm is extended toward the moon and crooked at the elbow. The reason for this position is unclear at first until you hear a flapping of wings—a large black raven swoops down and perches neatly on his extended forearm. His familiar returned to his side, he finally turns. Ice-blue eyes sweep across you and your companions, and they are striking indeed, but not as noticeable as the deep dark circles underneath.

~ Played by Kevril N

Countryside: Nighttime In The Country.name:
乡野：乡间夜色
Countryside: Nighttime In The Country

Text.text:
成千上万只看不见的虫子奏起夜的交响，断续间或有一只猫头鹰独自亮嗓，加入这支合唱。漂浮的萤火虫仿佛也为它们起舞；可当一阵冷冽的微风轻轻拂乱你的发丝，它们细小的光点便落入沾满露珠的草间，今夜的舞步就此收场。云层裂开，露出明月灿然的面容；短短片刻，午夜的田野在你四周铺展开来，宛如一片由蓝色阴影翻涌而成的浩瀚海洋。
Thousands of unseen insects sing a symphony of nocturnal calls, joined in their chorus by the occasional soloist owl. Drifting fireflies seem to dance for them, but as a chill breeze gently tousles your hair, their little lights settle into the dew-kissed grass, dancing done for the night. Clouds part, revealing the brilliant face of the moon, and for a few moments the midnight landscape of fields sprawls out around you like a great ocean of blue shadows.

Elven Vale: Warm Day.name:
精灵谷：暖日
Elven Vale: Warm Day

Text.text:
阳光仿佛缓缓飘落，轻柔地停在你肩头，又透过头顶密密匝匝挤在一起的叶与枝织成的格影，在葱郁的林下铺洒出虹彩般的斑驳暗影。温暖的泥土上升起一层薄雾——唯有拉开些距离才看得见——被滞留、堆叠的日光染成金色。鸟儿与虫子在其中穿梭，宛如流星。
Sunlight seems to drift down, settling gently upon your shoulders and dappling the verdant undergrowth with prismatic shadows cast by the lattices of leaves and branches that crowd overhead. A thin fog rises from the warm earth—visible only with distance—painted gold by the caught and accumulated sunshine. Birds and bugs flit through it like shooting stars.

Three Days By Horse On Road.name:
骑马在路上三天
Three Days By Horse On Road

Text.text:
你骑马旅行，每天破晓出发，沿着道路蜿蜒的轨迹前行。第一天一路平安无事，夜里你把马用绳拴在路边的树上休息。第二天，你遇见一名同样疲惫的旅人，便提出载他们一程到目的地；他们感激地接受了。你与他们共进一餐，随后各自上路。你强打精神继续赶路，到了第三天——当夕阳沉入远处的群丘之后——你触及了目标。
You travel by horse, setting out at dawn each day and following the road's winding path. On the first day, the journey passes uneventfully, and you rope the horse to a tree by the roadside to rest that night. The next day, you pass a fellow weary traveler, and offer them a short ride to their destination, which they accept gratefully. You share a meal with them then part ways. You press on, despite your weariness, and on the third day—as the sun dips behind the distant hills—you reach your objective.

Goddess Of Joy.name:
欢愉女神
Goddess Of Joy

Text.text:
她年纪很大，却显得年轻——胸怀饱满，快乐得会传染——以至于她的皱纹与白发仿佛自出生起便与她相伴。她披着节日的颜色：前一刻还在烘焙，下一刻就喝酒掷飞镖，转眼又高举双臂祈祷。因为欢乐女神也向欢乐祈祷。没有仇恨，没有痛苦强大到让她笑不出来，她总能含笑宣告：“该你退场了。大人们来了——现在轮到他们当孩子。”
She is old but seems young—her heart so full and contagiously happy—that her wrinkles and white hair may as well have been with her since birth. She wears the colors of a holiday: one minute baking, the next drinking and throwing darts, then raising her arms in prayer. For the Goddess of Joy prays to Joy. There is no hatred, no pain too strong for her to smile through and pronounce, “Time for you to go. The grownups are here to be children now.”

这把短弓散发出强烈到惊人的魔法气息，任何以法师的感官端详它的人都必然会被其吸引。它的尺寸远不足以由远古巨龙制成；你怀疑用于打造它的那截角，取自一头被击败的奇美拉。
The shortbow radiates magic in such potency that it is sure to attract the attention of any who examine it with wizardly senses. Far too small to have been fashioned from an elder dragon, you suspect the horn it was crafted with was taken from a vanquished chimera.

Shadowy Housing Project.name:
阴影笼罩的住宅区项目
Shadowy Housing Project

Text.text:
兜帽人影在昏暗、堆满垃圾的巷弄里交换货物，目光游移，四下窥探。警车悄然滑过，来者不善；惊惶的住户为了躲开麻烦，急忙把门窗砰然关紧。
Hooded figures cast furtive glances all around as they exchange goods in dimly lit alleyways choked with garbage. A police vehicle glides past, its presence entirely unwelcome as doors and windows are slammed shut by frightened residents desperate to avoid trouble.

Barbarian: I Dodge A Melee Attack.name:
野蛮人：我闪避一次近战攻击
Barbarian: I Dodge A Melee Attack

Text.text:
我侧身躲开那笨拙挥来的重击，恼火得咬紧牙关，耐心等待出手的破绽。属于我终结敌人的时代即将到来。
I duck the clumsy swing as it comes in and grit my teeth with frustration as I wait for an opportunity to strike. My time for vanquishing my foe is soon to come.

一名怪异的战士自死水般的水面中浮现，几乎悄无声息。那层玫瑰色、半透明的皮肤下，你能看见纤细的血管网脉动着，与胸甲般编织的芦苇之下所隐藏的心跳同频。粉色的羽状叶饰点缀在那些怪异的突起上，簇拥成冠，宛如一顶闪烁的头饰，为这名爬行类战士加冕。
From the stagnant waters a strange warrior emerges, almost silently. Beneath rosy, translucent skin you see thin webs of veins pulsing in time with a heart hidden beneath a breastplate of woven reeds. Pink fronds adorn the strange protrusions that crown the reptilian warrior like a scintillating headdress.

Celestial Bow And Arrows.name:
天界弓与箭
Celestial Bow And Arrows

Text.text:
一种超凡脱俗、带着蛋白石般虹彩的材料构成了这把反曲弓优雅的弧度。银白金属勾勒着握把边缘、瞄准窗与两臂末端。末端的凹槽里并无弓弦，取而代之的是一线细若游丝的白色辉光，几乎难以察觉。随弓附带的三支箭则是同样材料制成的朴素直杆。箭一旦上弦，便迸出明亮的光羽，箭镞也随之亮起，锋利如剃。
An otherworldly, opalescent material makes up the graceful bends in this recurve bow. Silvery metal accents the grip edges, the sight window, and the end of each arm. Grooves in those ends hold no bowstring. Instead, there is a fine line of white radiance, barely visible. The three arrows accompanying the bow are simple straight shafts of similar materials. When nocked, an arrow flares with luminous feathers and a glowing, razored head.

Soveliss Siannodel.name:
索维利斯·西安诺德
Soveliss Siannodel

Text.text:
凛冽的极地寒风撕扯着翻飞的书页，法师用冻得发紫的手指死死压住。那双勤学的绿眼里点缀着金色碎光，他一边踱步一边以惊人的专注扫过字句，仿佛对恶劣天候浑然不觉——又或只是执意要学。尽管身裹层层厚重布料，他的湛蓝皮肤在严寒中愈发深沉；落在银白发丝上的薄雪几乎融入那片冷光之中，难以察觉。他把那条修长而轻飘的胡须塞回外袍，继续前行，脚下踏碎覆着霜衣的草叶，发出清脆的咯吱声。

~ Played by Ethan

Biting arctic winds tear at flapping pages as the wizard holds them down with frost-bitten fingers. Studious green eyes flecked with gold scan the words with incredible focus as he meanders, seemingly oblivious to the conditions—or simply very determined to learn. Despite wearing layers of thick, heavy cloth, his azure skin has deepened its hue in the frigid temperatures, and the snow dusting his silvery hair is almost imperceptible amid the argent strands. Tucking a long, wispy beard back into his tunic he marches on, crunching frost-rimed grass underfoot.

~ Played by Ethan

巨大的白猿背对着你坐着，低垂着头，用两只手啃食一片叶簇。紧接着，又一只左手从那对手的下方探出，扯下更多叶簇。他转过身看向你，野猪般的獠牙一闪而过，眼神里满是不耐。他站起身来，足有八尺高，四臂粗壮、双腿敦厚，猛地剧烈甩头，喉间发出一声低沉的哼咕。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The great white ape sits with his back to you, head down, using two hands to eat a frond of leaves. Then another left hand reaches out from below the pair to pull more fronds from the plant. He turns to look at you, flashing the tusks of a boar and a look of irritation. He stands, eight feet tall, four-armed and thick-legged, shakes his head hard, and grunts.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Subterranean Lava Lake.name:
地下熔岩湖
Subterranean Lava Lake

Text.text:
湖面映着赤橙的光芒，不时咕嘟作响，熔融的岩浆鼓起一团团泡沫，伴着黏稠的滋滋声四处飞溅，随即又被那片熔岩之湖吞回。湖中散出的热浪压得人喘不过气，仿佛要把肺里的空气都夺走；你徒劳地大汗淋漓，只为让身体稍稍降温。
The red-orange glow of the lake’s surface burbles now and again, globules of molten magma splattering with an oozy sound before being reabsorbed into the lake of lava. The heat radiating off the lake is oppressive, stealing the breath from your lungs and making you sweat in a vain effort to cool your body.

立方体握在手里又大又沉。它由一种陌生而光滑的石料凿成，镶嵌着奇妙的金属与宝石；六个对称的面上各刻着一个奥秘符号，柔和的散射光在其上幽幽流转。
The cube is large and heavy in the hand. Hewn from a strange, sleek stone and set with wondrous metals and gemstones, the cube’s six symmetrical sides each display an arcane symbol, glowing softly with a diffused light.

Possessed Sheep.name:
被附身的绵羊
Possessed Sheep

Text.text:
那畜生踉跄前行，步履虚浮，走出一条摇摇晃晃、毫无章法的路线。一只羊，痛苦地咩叫着，凄惨又可怜。忽然它停住了，死一般僵直，随即转过头来，鼻吻翕张。那双眼睛如黑色针尖般幽暗，却骤然迸出骇人的残忍；一声异界般的咆哮自它泡沫翻涌的獠口中迸裂而出。
The animal stumbles, walking an unsteady, haphazard path. A sheep, pathetic in its pained bleating. Suddenly it stops, deathly still, before turning its head, snout flared. The eyes, dark pinpoints, flash with a startling cruelty as an otherworldly roar escapes the beast’s frothing maw.

Experimental Druid Armor.name:
实验性德鲁伊护甲
Experimental Druid Armor

Text.text:
说到底，不过是一副胸甲。再配些零件，还有一顶头盔。铁是从大地里炼出来的，对吧？皮革束带——那来自动物。甲片上压铸着一只鹿——麋鹿？——某种有蹄有角的东西。内衬是羊毛。对。来自绵羊。这套护甲看起来并不怎么吓人，然而哪怕只是在脑海里想象一只手被卡在那副铁护手里，都足以让一只眼角狠狠抽搐。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，Treantmonk 呈现

如果一名 德鲁伊穿上金属护甲，会发生什么？…… Part I: 德鲁伊，被打断 Part II: 实验性的德鲁伊护甲 Part III: 德鲁伊最后的拥抱 Part IV: 尘归尘，土归土 It's just a breastplate, really. And some other pieces, and a helmet. Iron is made from the earth, right? The leather straps—those are from animals. The plate is embossed with a deer—Elk?—something with hooves and antlers. Wool lining. Yes. From sheep. This armor doesn't look so intimidating, although even imagining a hand trapped in one of those gauntlets puts a mean twitch in one eye.

~ Envisioned by Treantmonk

What happens if a druid wears metal armor?… Part I: Druid, Interrupted Part II: Experimental Druid Armor Part III: A Druid’s Last Embrace Part IV: Ashes to Ashes, Dust to Dust

撕裂世界现实的，是一位永劫者那不可思议的形体。这位无面无相的宇宙造物主如巨神般巍然矗立，披着一袭午夜般的斗篷，斗篷在星界的幻景中微光流转，映出群星系在空间里盘旋涡动。它像杂耍者开场般将两枚球体高高托起：一枚是虚空的彻底漆黑、无可填补的空白；另一枚则是翻卷星尘的瘴雾——构成我们维度存在的关键原质。
Tearing through the world's reality is the unfathomable form of an aeon. This featureless cosmic architect stands tall as a giant, swathed in a midnight cloak that shimmers in an astral mirage depicting galaxies that swirl through space. It holds two spheres aloft like a juggler beginning their act. One orb is the utter black blankness of the void. The other is a miasma of swirling stardust, the essential ingredient of our very dimensional existence.

Boss Of A Slaver Crew.name:
奴隶贩子团伙的头目
Boss Of A Slaver Crew

Text.text:
一个敦实的男人站在场地中央，头上扎着头巾，身披一件不合身的长风衣，衣上溅满干涸的血迹。显然一切尽在掌控，这名凶徒冷漠地啐了一口，随即捏响指节。每根肮脏的手指上都套着一枚银戒或金戒。他把污垢蹭在袖子上，目光缓缓扫过自己的同伙与那些被他们奴役的人——像屠夫打量一群待宰的山羊。
A stocky male wearing a bandanna and an ill-fitting duster spattered with dried blood stands in the midst of the scene. Clearly in control, the brute spits dispassionately and cracks his knuckles. Each dirty finger bears a ring of silver or gold. As he wipes the grime on his sleeve, his gaze travels across his crew and the people they have enslaved, much like a butcher might view a herd of goats.

Villian's Frustrating Interrogation.name:
反派令人抓狂的审讯
Villian's Frustrating Interrogation

Text.text:
当你质问对手时，对方咧嘴冷笑——那副令人作呕、令人火大的表情正挑衅着你的克制。你每抛出一个问题，他们就回敬一个，把对话织成一座令人晕眩的心智迷宫，话语层层盘绕，永无止境地向内扭曲。#REF!
Your adversary smirks as you question them, a sickening, infuriating expression that tests your restraint. For every question you ask, they have one of their own, creating a mental labyrinth of befuddling dialogue, twisting eternally inward.#REF!

Cyberpunk Fantasy Metropolis: Working-cl.name:
赛博朋克奇幻巨型都市：工人阶层“C”区
Cyberpunk Fantasy Metropolis: Working-class 'C' Neighborhood

Text.text:
这里是城里劳工阶层熙攘奔忙的核心。朴素的居所、最低限度的安保措施与简陋的生活设施，让这片区域成了勤恳住民既实惠又务实的选择——只是他们为谋生计，仍得穿行于并不安全的街巷之间。
Here sits the bustling focus for the city's labor force. Modest dwellings, minimal security measures, and modest amenities make this location an affordable and practical option for its diligent residents, who have to navigate the less-than-safe streets to make a living.

Temple To A God Of Resilience.name:
坚韧之神的神殿
Temple To A God Of Resilience

Text.text:
所有献给这位神祇的神殿，都建在难以触及之处。这一座也最为典型：坐落在山巅之上，休息在临近峰顶前的山鞍处。通往神殿的嶙峋石径一路延伸，越过正门——门前是北地风格的深檐，以粗粝沉重的原木压出一片阴影。朝圣者按规矩须先跋涉而过食物、水与栖身之所，登上峰顶，再沿原路折返，方可进入神殿；在那里，坚固的守护之门开启，迎面便是温暖炉火的款待。
All temples to this god were built in places hard to reach. This one, in a most typical fashion, is on a mountaintop, resting on the saddle of the mountain just before the summit. The rocky path to it goes beyond the front door and its deep overhang of raw, heavy timbers in the northern style. The pilgrim is expected to first trek past food and water and shelter, to the summit, and then double back along the same path to enter the temple, where the strong doors of protection open to a hearth of welcome.

嘴巴快得像每小时一百万英里般飞速开合，这头巨大的有知觉的熊焦躁地来回踱步，对着头顶盘旋的无数漂浮摄像机疯狂比划。它的毛皮大半被染成绿、蓝、红的斑斓色块。某台摄像机里传来捐款提示那一声反复的叮，主播随即以一种古怪的敬礼回应。它身上套着一身令人眼花缭乱的彩衣拼贴，随后用爪子握着的某台控制台啪地拨下一个开关。几枚半透明的小表情从它头顶噗地炸开，俏皮地以夸张的风格飘散。 Mouth moving at a million miles an hour, the gigantic sentient bear moves frantically to and fro, gesticulating wildly for the many floating cameras that hover above them. Much of their fur is dyed greens, blues, and reds. The repetitive ding of a donation alert sounds off from one of the cameras, to which the streamer responds with a strange salute. Clad in a dizzying mishmash of colorful clothing, the streamer flicks a switch on one of their paw-held consoles. Little translucent emotes burst forth over their head in stylized whimsy.

Sundries From A Balor.name:
来自巴洛炎魔的杂物
Sundries From A Balor

Text.text:
你小心翼翼地逼近那场爆炸式毁灭的中心，俯身检查巴洛魔的残骸。一只腰带小袋里装着一枚铅币，币面图案磨损得几乎辨认不出；还有一件玄武岩雕成的骷髅。巴洛魔那串令人作呕的项链上，穿着真实的头骨：有大有小，有的长角，有的生獠牙。
Warily approaching the epicenter of its explosive demise, you examine the balor’s remains. A belt pouch contains a lead coin printed with an image too worn to recognize, and a basalt carving of a skull. The balor’s gruesome necklace is strung with real skulls: large and small, some with horns, some with tusks.

Concealable Bulletproof Vest.name:
可隐藏式防弹背心
Concealable Bulletproof Vest

Text.text:
针织防弹背心紧贴在衣物之下，流畅的轮廓几乎难以察觉。为了不让这份优势露出破绽，你小心翼翼地调整步伐，将身上多出的重量藏得天衣无缝。
The knitted bulletproof vest fits snugly beneath your clothes, and the sleek outline is almost imperceptible. Careful to conceal your advantage, you adjust your gait to hide the extra weight you're carrying.

吱呀作响地承受着沉重载荷，这辆涂抹过油脂的货车缓缓驶过，车轮所至之处皆留下深深的辙痕。它绝非拙匠草草捆扎成的简陋手推车；这辆车经过巧妙的倾斜设计与精工打造，即便车轮受损也能轻易更换。如此载具穿行荒野时乘坐起来分外舒适，也能让驮兽搬运远超其平常极限的重载。
Creaking under its heavy load, the oil-rubbed wagon rolls by, leaving deep impressions from its wheels everywhere it goes. A far cry from a simple cart lashed together by unskilled hands, this wagon has been expertly tilted and built so that wheels might be easily replaced in case of damage. Such a conveyance makes for a relaxing ride through the wilderness, and allows beasts of burden to move loads far in excess of their normal capacity.

Village Of Wizards.name:
巫师之村
Village Of Wizards

Text.text:
村庄伫立在巍峨山峰的阴影下，紧贴着覆着薄雪的山麓。它看起来安稳而朴素——鹅卵石铺就的道路，矮敦敦的砖砌房屋，镇子中心是一座宽阔的中央广场。可当你走近些，便会发现几分异样。披袍戴斗篷的身影交错穿行，施展魔法修复一段倒塌的篱笆；两名披甲战士以兵刃对练，武器上流淌着炽亮的光辉；一位医者将手覆在受伤的农夫身上，轻声一句，便将折断的腿骨重新归位。

~ 由 Jason 构想

The village stands in the shadow of a towering peak, tucked against foothills dusted with snow. It appears comfortable, modest—cobblestone roads, squat buildings of brick, a large central plaza at the town’s heart. Drawing closer, one finds some peculiarities. Robed and cloaked figures weave magic to repair a toppled fence; a pair of armored warriors spar with weapons glowing with a radiant light; a healer lays hands on an injured farmer and sets the broken leg with a word.

~ Envisioned by Jason

Cania, The Eighth Circle Of Hell.name:
卡尼亚，地狱第八层
Cania, The Eighth Circle Of Hell

Text.text:
冰之宫殿的地面灼烫得起泡。墙壁滚烫，空气像烈焰般折磨着你的呼吸，可这座冰宫依旧湿润闪耀，泛着苍白的蓝光。集结于此的宫廷众人齐齐转向你，露出微笑。你原以为认得他们——直到他们开口，你才惊觉这里没有一个人如其所见。伪装套着伪装，把身体捏成谎言，用别的脸覆住真正的面孔。无论你怎么尝试，你们的每一次交涉都会朝着你最不想要的方向收场，永无止尽。
The floor of the palace of ice is blistering hot. The walls are scalding, the air a burning torment to breathe, and yet the ice palace glistens damp and pale blue. The court assembled turns toward you and smiles. You recognize them until they speak, and then you realize that no one here is who they seem to be. Disguises upon disguises shape bodies into lies and mask faces with other faces. Your exchanges end the opposite way you want them to, no matter what you try, forever.

Green Dragon Wyrmling.name:
绿龙幼龙
Green Dragon Wyrmling

Text.text:
那头龙裔生物收拢双翼，紧贴着蜥蜴般的躯干，悄然游走。它的体型约莫一只大型犬大小，目光锐利而狡黠，鳞片呈夺目的祖母绿。它鼻孔翕张，嗅吸着你的气味，从远处审视你。弯曲而凶险的利齿在一抹讥笑般的神情中闪着寒光，一缕古怪而腐臭的气体从它喉间嘶嘶逸出。
The draconic creature, wings tucked tight against its reptilian frame, prowls. Roughly the size of a large dog, the beast's eyes are sharp and cunning, and its scales are a stunning emerald green. Its nostrils flare as it breathes you in, inspecting you from a distance. Its teeth, curved and wicked, flash in a kind of sneer, and a hiss of strange, putrid gas escapes the beast's throat.

在这座拱顶洞窟的核心，沉毅的矮人们在他们雄伟的熔炉前劳作。巨大的炉膛灼热空气，铁匠们一丝不苟地敲击、塑形，将通红的锭块锻造成华丽的武器与精巧的珠宝。他们双手布满疤痕，脸上汗水淋漓，打造着经久不衰的珍宝，铁砧与铁锤的回响在锻炉间铿锵作响，尽显勤勉。
In the heart of this vaulted cavern, stoic dwarves labor at their mighty forge. A huge furnace heats the air as the smiths meticulously hammer and shape glowing ingots into ornate weapons and intricate jewelry. With scarred hands and faces sheathed with sweat, they craft enduring treasures, the forge ringing with their diligence.

无数尖锐的构造物直刺入这座巨型洞窟的幽暗深处——宛如黑暗中的匕首——它们闪亮的侧面映照着下方街道里绿、红、蓝交织的光，因而显形。你辨不出这些光的源头，因为一张遮蔽网挡住了大半视野。过了片刻你才意识到：那如同巨大马戏帐篷般覆在城市上方的东西，竟是一层蛛网织成的天幕。
A host of sharp structures project high into the gloom of the vast cavern—like daggers in the dark—made visible by their shining sides reflecting the green, red, and blue light in the streets below. You can’t discern the sources of the illumination because a screening net hides much from view. It takes a moment to recognize that the stuff draping the city like a vast circus tent is in fact a blanket of webs.

旋转、回身——这些死去已久的狂欢者对周遭浑然不觉，也不曾意识到自己幽灵般的存在。他们在无尽的华尔兹中穿墙而过，身形掠空冲撞，阴森的笑声在厅室里回荡不休。他们骷髅般的面容永远凝固在狂喜的表情之中。
Spinning, wheeling—the long-dead revelers take no notice of their surroundings, nor to their spectral existence. They phase through the walls in their endless waltz, careening through the air as their haunting laughter echoes through the chamber. Their skull-like visages are locked eternally in expressions of exultation.

A Hoard Of Fool's Gold.name:
一堆愚人金
A Hoard Of Fool's Gold

Text.text:
一片金色钱币的海洋环绕着你，宝藏的浪潮翻滚，在火把光里粼粼闪耀。你把手探进那堆宝藏，让金属从掌心、手腕间倾泻而下——冰凉得像阴影里奔涌的河水。你捧起满满一把举到眼前，每一枚钱币上都印着一位古老国王的威严肖像，冷冷地回望着你。可……那浓郁的金色开始褪去，裂开、崩碎成雾，露出一层令人心惊的黯淡劣金。几枚钱币从你指缝间滴落，叮当作响地归入堆里，像是在嘲笑你。钱币表面融化、旋转，又重新凝成形。有些仍是国王的肖像，只是他如今挂着狼一般的狞笑，舌头从齿间伸出；另一些则变成圆滚滚的屁股，对着你“亮月”，带着锈斑点点的臀肉。

~ Envisioned by Tyler from RPGBOT.net

A sea of gold coins surrounds you, rolling waves of treasure glimmering in the torchlight. You dip your hands into the hoard and let the metal run over your hands and wrists—cool as the rush of a shaded river. You bring a heaping handful to your face, and a regal portrait of an ancient king stares back at you, sternly, from each coin. But… the rich golden hue begins to fade, cracking and crumbling into mist, and revealing a terribly tarnished metal. A few of the coins drip between your fingers, rejoining the pile in a mocking clatter. The surfaces of the coins melt and swirl, reforming. Some still show the portrait of the king, though he now sports a wolfish sneer, his tongue sticking out between his teeth. Others show a rounded bum, mooning you with tarnish-bespeckled cheeks.

~ Envisioned by Tyler from RPGBOT.net

踉跄的身影浮现出来，伸手将兜帽往后一扯。褴褛的碎布随之滑落。饥渴的恶疾早已将他们的形体啃噬殆尽，皮肤扭曲变形，肉身皱缩起伏，渗泪的疮口遍布其上。周遭之人既作呕又怜悯——这副怪诞的模样，是大自然残酷报复的刺目警示。
The shuffling figure emerges and tugs back their hood. The rags fall away. A ravenous malady has ravaged their form, morphing skin and puckering flesh with weeping sores. They elicit both revulsion and pity from those around them, a grotesque reminder of the vindictiveness of nature.

Kuo-toa Boarding A Ship.name:
库欧托亚登船劫掠
Kuo-toa Boarding A Ship

Text.text:
腥臭在它啪嗒一声瘫上甲板之前就先一步出卖了这只生物——一团精瘦的肌肉与鳞片堆成的湿滑肉块。腐烂海藻与死鱼的恶臭黏在这怪异的鱼形生物身上；当它黏腻的鳃张开，盐水与黏液滴滴答答淌落，那气味便愈发浓烈。它那对玻璃般鼓胀的眼睛——几乎大得塞不进眼眶——猛地转向你；生物抬起一柄由废弃航海残骸拼成的三叉戟，直指你的方向。

~ 由 Allura 构想

The smell gives the creature away, even before it flops onto the deck in a heap of lean muscles and scales. The stench of rotting seaweed and dead fish clings to the strange piscine creature, becoming more powerful as its slimy gills open, dripping with saltwater and mucus. Glassy, bulbous eyes—nearly too big to fit in their sockets—swivel in your direction as the creature raises a trident made of discarded nautical debris toward you.

~ Envisioned by Allura

如此之多的残骸与废料涌上这颗星球的地表，以至于连土地本身都几乎无从得见。这里远不止一座寻常的垃圾场：一代又一代的飞船拆解工把退役舰船的废弃船体——从私人小飞梭到沉重披甲的货运巨舰——胡乱倾倒在大地各处，直到再也无处安放，只能把新残骸堆在旧残骸之上，最终垒起层层叠叠、摇摇欲坠的船体群山，密实得近乎伸入这颗星球的对流层。这里唯一的居民，是拾荒者与拾荒者的后裔；他们勉力维生，挥刀切开这些死去的船只，只为搜寻裸露的电线、零件、燃料储备，以及被遗忘的私人物件与珍藏。

~ Envisioned by Quark83

So much debris and junk has found its way to the surface of this planet that the ground itself can scarcely be seen. It is far more than a simple landfill, for generations of spaceship breakers have dumped the disused hulls of decommissioned ships—from personal flitters to heavy, armored freighters—willy-nilly across the landscape, until there was nowhere left to put the wrecks but atop other wrecks, resulting in dense, multi-layered mountains of unstable hulls stretching almost into the planet's troposphere. The only people living here are scavengers and descendants of scavengers, eking out meager livings by hacking open these dead ships in search of raw wire, components, fuel stores, and personal treasures.

~ Envisioned by Quark83

Azalea Rush, 2nd Year House Raven.name:
杜鹃疾驰，乌鸦学院二年级
Azalea Rush, 2nd Year House Raven

Text.text:
以一种哥特式的邪美动人，阿泽莉娅看上去比实际年纪更成熟，并把这一点化作优势。她喜欢让别人替她跑腿办事——要么眨动长睫卖弄风情，要么更直接：一把揪住某个学生的衣领，贴着耳畔低语命令。她的手纤秀、骨节分明，每只手指上都套着几枚廉价戒指。她随身带着一颗黑玻璃宝珠，和她本人一样，美得夺目，也危险得令人不寒而栗。
Pretty in a gothic, wicked way, Azalea looks older than she is and uses that to her advantage. She likes to get others to do her bidding, and either flashes her lashes or takes a more direct approach by grabbing the collar of a student and whispering a command. Her hands are elegant and fine-boned, with a couple of cheap rings on each. She uses a black glass orb that is as beautiful and dangerous-looking as she is.

那生物发出带着猪鼻子哼哧的窃笑，躲藏起来，深信自己在谍报之道上天纵英才。它浑身覆着浓厚的疣皮，颜色像放了一周的炖汤；令人意外的是，那具身体却异常结实有力，肩头与腹部还结成一簇簇绒毛。粗糙的皮背心和长裤早已风光不再——而那股味道，至少可以说，令人终生难忘。

~ Envisioned by DaveDaWanderer on Discord

Snickering with a porcine snuffle the creature hides, convinced of its own brilliance in espionage. Thick, warty skin the color of week-old stew covers its surprisingly muscular body, and patches of downy fur clump around its shoulders and abdomen. The rough leather jerkin and trousers have seen better days—and the smell is memorable to say the least.

~ Envisioned by DaveDaWanderer on Discord

Faerie Plane: Circle Of Stones.name:
妖精位面：石环
Faerie Plane: Circle Of Stones

Text.text:
你发现自己站在坚实的地面上——一片泥土，被一圈石头环绕。这些竖立的花岗岩“面孔”闪烁着缕缕绿色魔法的微光。你脚边传来清脆的叮当声，几乎像小恶魔的窃笑，金色的魔法微尘沿着地面轻轻起伏、漂游。四周，一片葱茏的世界在暮色粉红的天空下静候着你。湍急的水声牵引着你的目光：一道瀑布倾泻而下，注入一汪蓝绿相间的池水。石圈外不远处有条小径分岔，通向那边。
You find yourself on solid ground, a patch of dirt surrounded by the circle of stones. These standing granite faces wink with wisps of green magic. You hear a tinkling near your feet, a sound nearly like an impish giggle, as golden motes of magic bob along the ground. All around you, a verdant world awaits under the pink shade of a twilit sky. The rushing of water draws your attention to a waterfall cascading into a teal-blue pond. A path leading toward it branches off just outside the stones.

那佝偻臃肿、形似蟾蜍的生物拄着一根虬结的手杖，杖身挂满骨头与其他阴森的护符。它那橡胶般的皮肤布满疣粒，在一层腐臭的绿光里湿亮发黏，像鼻涕或下水道的污流。臃胖的生物发出一声湿哑、破碎的吸气，朝手心啐了一口，随即用那只手开始施放法术。
The stooped, bulbous, toad-like creature leans on a gnarled staff draped with bones and other grim totems. Its rubbery, wart-riddled skin glistens a putrid shade of green, reminiscent of snot or sewer runoff. The corpulent creature takes in a wet, ragged breath and spits into its hand before proceeding to cast a spell with it.

Fallstreak Hole In The Sky.name:
天空的坠迹裂洞
Fallstreak Hole In The Sky

Text.text:
天空中的洞——厚重云层掩蔽里一个近乎圆形的缺口——是种奇景，或许你此生再也见不到第二次。你几乎能想象：一位暴怒的云巨人挥拳穿透云幕，才打出这道空洞——一场怒意的爆发，被放大到铺天盖地。
The hole in the sky—a roundish gap in the thick cloud cover—is a curiosity you may never see again. One might imagine an angry cloud giant punching their fist through the clouds in its creation, a fit of pique writ large.

Necklace Of Prayer Beads.name:
祈祷珠项链
Necklace Of Prayer Beads

Text.text:
这是一条很长的项链，粗麻链上在不同位置串着珠子。那些光滑的珠子似乎由各色石料打磨而成：蜜色琥珀、层纹黄水晶，以及雪白的缟玛瑙珠。最引人注目的，是其中三颗雾霭般的海蓝宝珠，泛着幽冷的蓝光。
This is a long necklace with beads at various sections of the hempen chain. The smooth beads seem to have been crafted of various stones: honey amber, layered citrine, and alabaster pearls. The most eye-catching of the array are three misty-blue beads of aquamarine.

Adventurer's Last Sunset.name:
冒险者的最后余晖
Adventurer's Last Sunset

Text.text:
尽管生命正一点点流逝，这名负伤的冒险者仍咬牙拖着疲惫的四肢，攀上悬崖顶端最后几级台阶。她皱着眉坐回那块熟悉的岩石上，望向海面：夕阳沉入地平线，把水面染成一整片温暖而耀眼的青铜。她虚弱地一笑，随着凡俗最后的残余从她体内悄然抽离，乘着海风飘散而去。

~ Slip on Discord

Though her life is ebbing away, the wounded adventurer manages to carry her weary limbs up the last few steps to the top of the cliff. With a grimace, she sits on a familiar rock and gazes out across the sea as the sun dips behind the horizon, turning the water into a sheet of warm, radiant bronze. She smiles weakly as the last vestiges of mortality leave her and drift away on the ocean breeze.

~ Slip on Discord

Spring Carnival In The Evening.name:
夜幕下的春日嘉年华
Spring Carnival In The Evening

Text.text:
欢快的乐曲与笑声充盈在空气里，与春日嘉年华上炸物、甜点等诱人的香气交织缠绕。夕阳渐渐低垂，将天穹染成翻涌的品红薄雾；影子在火把摇曳的光里跳跃嬉闹，掠过一顶顶绚丽帐篷，映得通体生辉。中央主棚里，一个半身人站在结实的木箱顶端，向门口兴致勃勃的赌客招手，滔滔不绝地夸赞里面的种种妙趣。

~ 构想：Clara C. Potter，发布于 Discord

Jovial music and laughter fill the air, mingling with the tantalizing scent of fried foods, sweet treats, and more at the spring carnival. The sun is bowing low, casting the sky in a swirling magenta haze, as shadows dance and cavort across colorful tents aglow in the flickering torchlight. A halfling standing atop a robust crate in the central pavilion beckons eager punters through the gates, espousing the delights found within.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

水面闪过一阵移动，仿佛浪头翻卷，却不闻半点声响。然而，一只生物翻搅着现身——它的身影像人的上半身，身后拖着一条巨大的鳗鱼般长尾。两只漆黑的眼睛各有母鸡蛋般大小，从一张布满鲨鱼般尖牙的口器上方警惕地窥视着你。
The water flashes with movement, like a wave turning over, but you hear nothing. Yet a creature has roiled into view, the shadow of its shape a humanlike torso that trails a great eel-like tail behind it. Two black eyes, each as big as a hen’s egg, peer suspiciously from above a mouth filled with shark-like teeth.

Ancient Lumocantha.name:
远古辉光棘兰
Ancient Lumocantha

Text.text:
从一根巨柱般的中央花蕊中，黄色的棘刺拔地而起，贪婪啜饮着白昼温柔的光。此植巍然如神，见证过无数次黎明。花瓣渗出的染液滴落下来，落在林地上滋滋作响，溅起灼热的水花。黄色棘刺微微颤动，来回摆荡，探寻着附近的养分。
From a colossal central stamen, yellow spines rise up to drink in the day’s loving light. This plant is a titanic thing and has seen countless dawns. Seeping dye drips from petals and lands with sizzling splashes on the forest floor. The yellow spines quiver, oscillating in search of nearby nutrients.

Tournament Celebrating The Marriage Of A.name:
庆祝王室与平民联姻的比武大会
Tournament Celebrating The Marriage Of A Royal And A Commoner

Text.text:
新婚夫妇一踏入比武场，平民人潮中顿时爆发出震天欢呼。看台上的贵族却一片死寂，个个面色阴沉。国王与他出身卑微的王后沿着赛道栅栏缓步前行——挥手致意，笑容明朗——刻意无视王室包厢里那些冷眼相向的轻蔑面孔。
A huge cheer erupts from the mass of commoners as the newlyweds arrive at the tourney. The nobles sitting in the stands remain silent, their faces grim. The king and his low-born queen walk along the list— waving and smiling—pointedly ignoring the scornful faces in the royal box.

Lemuel The Bounty Hunter.name:
莱缪尔——赏金猎人
Lemuel The Bounty Hunter

Text.text:
一名逃犯猛地刹住脚步，滑行着停在死胡同前。身后，追捕者吹着轻快的小调，踏入一汪火把的光晕里——黑色锁子甲与斗篷裹身，如同活着的影子。他紧闭的左眼上横亘着一道参差的疤痕，直抵发际；一缕黑发被白丝穿过，像被霜咬过的痕迹。赏金猎人抽出长剑，对被逼到墙角的猎物露出一抹忧郁的冷笑。

~ Played by BlckHeart

A fugitive skids to a halt before a dead end. Behind them, their pursuer whistles a jaunty tune as he steps into a pool of torchlight, a living shadow in his dark mail and cloak. A ragged scar runs over his shuttered left eye and up to his hairline, where a lock of his black hair is threaded through with white. The bounty hunter gives his cornered quarry a melancholy smirk as he draws his longsword.

~ Played by BlckHeart

Cyber Fantasy Metropolis.name:
赛博奇幻大都会
Cyber Fantasy Metropolis

Text.text:
霓虹粉的招牌与LED全息影像在湿漉漉的漆黑街面上滚动掠过，像蒸汽波的彩虹般流淌。大都会以灰色的轮廓压在自然的落日之前，那落日与广场上商业与暗影闪烁不定的人工嘉年华相互冲撞。夕阳前方，一条孤独的巨龙掠空而行——少数足以与这座被制造出来的世界分庭抗礼的存在之一。屋顶的合成器派对上，精灵、亚人、混血者与被工程改造的生物停下舞步，齐声为那有翼的生物欢呼。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Neon pink signs and LED holographs scroll over wet, black streets in a vaporwave rainbow. The metropolis looms gray against a natural sunset that clashes with the artificial carnival of biz and shadows flickering in the square. Against the sunset flies a solitary dragon, one of the few beings powerful enough to rival the manufactured world. From a rooftop synth party, elves, metahumans, hybrids, and the engineered stop their dance to cheer for the winged creature.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Opulent Reception Room Of A Merchant Tra.name:
商旅巨贾的奢华会客厅
Opulent Reception Room Of A Merchant Trader

Text.text:
当你踏入这间奢华装点的房间，异域的景象、气味与声响瞬间充盈你的感官。目之所及，富丽毫不掩饰地铺陈开来：黄金锻成的雕花烛台，畸变异兽的头颅沿墙陈列，带着陌生而恢宏的异界威仪；而各色华美丝绸慵懒披覆在匠心独具的家具之上。显然，这个房间就是为了在来访者心中留下深刻印象而打造的。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Exotic sights, smells, and sounds fill your senses as you enter the lavishly decorated room. Everywhere you look, opulence presents itself unashamedly: sculpted candelabras wrought in gold, aberrant beast heads lining the walls in all their alien grandeur, and exquisite silks of every color draped languidly over artisanal furniture. This room is clearly designed to make an impression on visitors.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Road Leading To Ruined Tower.name:
通往废墟高塔的道路
Road Leading To Ruined Tower

Text.text:
这条简陋的土路上散落着碎石，沿着山坡绕行，向上通往那座残破的高塔。你环顾四周，只见倾覆建筑的残骸四散其间，早已被荒草与藤蔓吞没。古代匠人凿刻的痕迹仍清晰可见，那是镌在石上的遗产。
The simple dirt road, strewn with rocks, leads around the hill and up toward the ruined tower. Around you, you see the remnants of the toppled structure, now scattered and overgrown. The chisel marks from ancient craftspeople still remain, a legacy carved in stone.

你将法术当作武器般挥起——如同一把上弦待发的弩。你一声怒喝，咒文随之完成；当你将一束纯粹的光之长枪掷向敌人时，他们的皮肤上开始腾起缕缕蒸汽。
You brandish the spell like a weapon—like a crossbow loaded and ready to fire. With a shout, you complete the incantation, and as you hurl a lance of pure light toward your foe, steam begins to rise from their skin.

Insult About Immortality.name:
关于不朽的侮辱
Insult About Immortality

Text.text:
“有着无尽广袤的时代供你反思、精进自身，可你仍和我们其余人一样无知卑劣。”
“The infinite vastness of time to reflect on and better yourself, but you’re still just as ignorant and vile as the rest of us.”

Defrex Juvenile.name:
德弗雷克幼体
Defrex Juvenile

Text.text:
一头近似长须巨熊的野兽，毛色如战场硝烟般灰暗，从阴影里四肢着地踱出；强壮的后腿驱动着那笨重的躯体向前挪动。它仍带幼兽的骨架却修长精悍，肌肉紧绷，宽阔的颚骨一开一合，饥渴的期待在其中蠢动。凹陷的肚腹轰隆作响，如雷滚过。
Something akin to a bearded bear the color of battlefield smokes walks out of the shadows on all fours, powerful legs working its cumbersome body forward. Its juvenile frame is slender and muscular, and its broad jaws open and close with hungry anticipation. A concave gut rumbles like thunder.

两分钟过去，你滴下几滴略带异味的药膏，又迅速低声连缀一串奥术音节；你的法术受术者随即猛地倒抽一口气，声音清晰可闻。此刻，他们的双眼泛起微光，魔法视界锋锐得足以刺穿幻象，并令他们得以窥见以太界。
Two minute drops of the slightly smelly ointment and a fast series of murmured arcane syllables later, and the recipient of your spell gasps audibly. Their eyes now glimmer with magical sight so sharp that it penetrates illusion and lets them see into the ethereal realm.

乌鸦在这座庞大城市垃圾场的界内，啄食着堆叠如丘的废物；直到脚步声逼近它们恶臭的领域，才在刺耳的聒噪中振翅散去。此城的遗弃之物规模骇人，堆积成山，正是城中居民挥霍无度的铁证。然而你仍会隐隐觉得：若有人愿意花些时代在这片腐臭的边界里翻找，几乎什么都可能从中寻得。
Crows pick over the mounds of rubbish piled up within the bounds of the sprawling city dump, only departing with loud cries as footsteps approach their stinking domains. The leavings of this city are monumental in their volume, a true testament to the wastefulness of the city's inhabitants. And yet, one has the sense that if a person chose to spend time searching through such a place, they might find almost anything within its reeking boundaries.

Loot From An Awakened Shrub.name:
来自一丛觉醒灌木的战利品
Loot From An Awakened Shrub

Text.text:
被连根拔起的灌木倒卧不动，四周落叶零落。你在枝叶间摸索，找回一支以暗红近黑的木材削制而成的箭，尾羽是黑白相间的条纹羽。箭头上刻着一道锯齿般的符印。
The uprooted shrub lies motionless in a scattering of leaves. Feeling among the branches, you recover an arrow hewn from reddish-black wood, fletched with black-and-white striped feathers. A jagged sigil is carved into the arrowhead.

这里岩石间的风声愈发丰沛而和谐，仿佛有管乐从阴影的裂隙里应和着加入。悦耳的叮当声点缀其间。下方还不时透出一抹抹金色光辉。那会是阳光能触及到的地方吗？
Sounds of the wind grow rich and concordant among the rocks here. The tones give the impression of wind instruments joining in from the shaded crevices. Pleasant chiming punctuates the music. Glimpses of golden light also come from below. Could sunlight reach down there?

Act One Of Pierced By Moonlight Begins.name:
《月光穿刺》第一幕开始
Act One Of Pierced By Moonlight Begins

Text.text:
房间里的每一盏灯都黯了下去，观众席间随之落下一片静默。厚重的帷幕像两只巨翼般向两侧分开，向后舒展，仿佛正为下一拍蓄势。舞台中央，一束追光亮起，将一名女子罩在冷冽的蓝色光晕里。她身着一袭淡紫的薄裙，紧贴身形，眉眼间写满不安。忽然，黑暗中传来一阵窸窣声。又一束追光落在一棵道具树上——枝桠苍白，像骷髅的利爪多过寻常的树木。一名身形矫健的男子伏在那枯骨般的掌心里，黑色丝质短上衣贴着身躯。他的妆容与她如出一辙：惨白的底妆、眼下赭色的阴影、深蓝的唇。她转向他，他咧开嘴露出獠牙。她也回以微笑，尖尖的门齿在假月光里一闪。舞台左侧的小小伴奏组敲响了俏皮的风铃般叮咚。

~ 出自惊艳的 TTRPG 增补 The Vineyard

Every light in the room dims and a hush falls over the audience. The heavy curtains part like two massive wings stretching back, readying for a beat. A spotlight appears at the center of the stage, cloaking a woman in a cool blue tone. A thin lavender dress clings to her body and she wears a worried look. Suddenly, a rustling is heard from the darkness. Another spotlight appears over a prop tree with pale branches—more skeletal claw than an everyday arbor. A lithe man in a black silken jerkin perches in its bony palm. His makeup matches hers: pale foundation, ochre circles under their eyes, dark blue lips. She turns to him and he smiles wide, fangs showing. She smiles back, her own pointed incisors glinting in the faux moonlight. Whimsical chimes play from the small group of musical accompanists on stage left.

~ Found in the amazing TTRPG supplement The Vineyard

那苍白的生物比大多数人类高出一头，宽阔而强健的躯干披覆着带刺的钢铁锁链。数条锁链自生物的手臂垂落，末端坠着阴毒的钩爪。一对血红的眼睛在层叠锁链的纠结之中幽然闪烁。
The pale creature stands a head taller than most humans, with a broad and muscular frame draped in barbed, steel chains. Several dangle from the creature's arms, ending in wicked hooks. A pair of blood-red eyes gleam from within the mass of chains.

海浪拍击着长船，它如长矛般破水疾进，轻而易举地在翻涌的泡沫乱潮中切开一条航道。雄浑大鼓的节律如心跳般轰鸣，稳稳将划手的动作扣在同一拍点上，桨叶一次次斩入水中。长船两侧，色彩斑斓的盾牌连成一道墙，上面绘着船长与其先祖的纹章。
Waves batter the longship as it plows onward through the water like a spear, cutting a path through the foaming tumult with ease. The rhythmic heartbeat of a mighty drum keeps the rowers in time as their oars slice into the water. Colorful shields form a wall along each side of the longship, decorated in the heraldry of the captain and their ancestors.

Homeless Youth.name:
无家可归的少年
Homeless Youth

Text.text:
污垢在那少年憔悴的脸上拖出一道道脏痕，他们的衣服几乎只剩破烂的碎布条。那双眼睛游移不定，满是戒备；从他们紧绷的身形里，你看得出他们随时准备在一瞬间要么拼命一搏，要么转身逃窜。
Grime streaks the gaunt face of the youth, whose clothes are little more than tattered rags. Their eyes are roaming, suspicious, and you see in the tension of their frame that they stand prepared to fight or flee at a moment’s notice.

Streets Of A Lower Ward Market.name:
下城区集市街道
Streets Of A Lower Ward Market

Text.text:
潮湿的空气裹挟着一股令人窒息的气味与声响洪流：小贩摊上刺舌的香料与焦化黄油的热香，商人货架间花香与菌香交织的芬芳，以及十几种截然不同的语言里急促的讨价还价。人潮翻涌，被街道与小巷引导、挤压——他们是血液，奔流在这座本身就活着、会呼吸的城市的静脉与动脉之中：一头有心跳的利维坦，筋腱是钢铁与木梁，血肉是石砌。城市向上延展，远远超出你的视野，没入都市的迷雾之中。

~ 由 Bh3lliom 构想

The humid air carries an overwhelming blend of scents and sounds: biting spice and browning butter from food vendors, fragrances both floral and fungal from traders, harried bartering in a dozen distinct languages. The crowds churn, channeled through the streets and alleyways—they are the blood running through the veins and arteries of a city that is itself a living, breathing thing: a leviathan with a heartbeat, its sinew steel and timber, its flesh stone. The city stretches upward, far beyond your vision, disappearing into the metropolitan haze.

~ Envisioned by Bh3lliom

Scorching Ray Cast From Three Fingers.name:
三指迸射的灼热射线
Scorching Ray Cast From Three Fingers

Text.text:
你吐出嘶嘶作响的音节，扭动手腕，将掌心舒展开来，伸出三根手指指向前方。回应你的法术，三道纤细的火线——每一道不过指宽——猛然刺出，呼啸着撕裂空气，笔直而精准地依你心意疾射而去。
You utter sibilant syllables and twist your wrist to unfurl your hand and point three fingers. In answer to your spell, three thin lines of flame, each barely wider than a finger, lance outward and roar through the air, straight and true, as you direct them.

你将自己接入电脑系统，一道纤细得转瞬即逝的绿色光线从你的额头划入屏幕。指尖在键盘上噼啪敲出指令，屏幕随你的操作接连弹出一串窗口。凭借这些更新后的算法，以及你自身硬件带来的增幅，你只需短短几秒便能强化。

~ 由一位英雄构想

You jack yourself into the computer system, a thin, blink-and-you-miss-it line of green light tracing from your forehead into the screen. Your fingers clatter away commands onto the keyboard, the screen opening up a series of windows as you work. With these updated algorithms and the boost from your own hardware, you are able to enhance in just a few seconds.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Adventurer's Surprise Birthday Party.name:
冒险者的惊喜生日派对
Adventurer's Surprise Birthday Party

Text.text:
惊呼声猛地吓了英雄一跳——朋友们从酒馆的暗处一拥而出，差点就挨上一记本能的回击。待明白过来，英雄的神色顿时柔和，豁然张开双臂，豪爽地放声大笑。麦酒如水般倾流，歌声唱到喉咙沙哑，肚皮塞满庆祝的美食；欢宴一直持续到天明，翌日清晨的第一缕晨光轻吻着疲惫不堪的狂欢者。

~ 构想：Inbal（Discord）

Shouts of surprise startle the hero as their friends leap from concealment in the tavern, almost catching a reflexive strike for their trouble. The hero's face softens as understanding dawns on them, and they spread their arms wide with a gregarious cheer. Ale flows like water, songs are sung until throats become hoarse, and bellies fill with celebratory treats as the festivities continue until dawn kisses the beleaguered partygoers the next morning.

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

Elven Vale: Cleansing Rain.name:
精灵谷：净雨
Elven Vale: Cleansing Rain

Text.text:
细密而绵长的雨丝从树冠与枝桠间滴落、蜿蜒而下，渗入林地柔软的腐叶与泥土。雨意清凉，却不刺骨。按理你会寻找遮蔽，可此刻那敲打在你头顶与肩上的点点雨声，反倒像一场恩赐。
A steady drizzle drips and trickles its way through the boughs and branches, settling into the softness of the forest floor. The rain feels cool, but not cold. Though you’d normally seek shelter, the drops that patter over your head and shoulders feel like a blessing.

探险者背包里叮当作响，宣告着他们的到来——地图筒、成捆的麻绳、铺盖卷，以及一大堆辨不清来历的工具与补给。他们将单筒望远镜举到眼前，随即把所见与掌心的罗盘相互印证，满意地点了点头，继续前行。
The clatter of the explorer’s pack announces their presence—map cases, bundles of hempen rope, a bedroll, and a multitude of other indiscernible tools and supplies. They bring a spyglass to their eye, compare their findings with a compass in their palm, and nod in satisfaction before continuing on.

房间左侧的桌子上堆满了封口覆蜡的信封，都是寄往各个地址的外发信件。门正前方的书桌上摞着一叠新纸、墨水瓶与羽毛笔，还有几封已写完的信平铺着，让新墨慢慢风干。书桌椅旁触及可及的位置，摆着一小层架子，放满了多种语言的词典与同义词词典。
The table at the left side of the room is stacked with wax-sealed envelopes, all outgoing to various addresses. The desk straight ahead of the door has a stack of fresh paper, ink bottles and quills, and some finished letters set out to allow the fresh ink to dry. Within easy reach of the desk chair sits a small shelf of dictionaries and thesauruses in various languages.

Ry'keth Stilmyst.name:
莱凯斯·史提尔迷雾
Ry'keth Stilmyst

Text.text:
你首先注意到这位苍白的骑乘战士的，是他所携带的非凡武器：一柄双刃长矛，长度恰好足以在马背上施展，金属枪身带着一丝微妙的弧度。每片刃的后缘都饰以带刺的倒钩。影精灵举止沉着而高贵，背脊笔直如箭，骑姿稳健，仿佛生来就属于鞍上。他的暗色护甲与斗篷如夜空云影般将他笼罩，而那双锐利的绿眼在微光下闪烁着一线银辉。一枚闪耀的坠饰贴在胸甲磨损的护甲表面，上面刻着一只振翅飞翔的乌鸦，双翼舒展而骄傲；其后镶着一颗淡乳光的宝石，如同一轮惨白渐盈的月亮作为衬底。

~ 扮演者 Jij

The first thing you notice about the pale, mounted warrior is the remarkable weapon he carries: a double-bladed spear, long enough to be used from horseback, and with a slight curvature of the metal. Spiked hooks adorn the rear of each blade. The shadow fey carries himself with a stoic and noble bearing, his back straight as an arrow, and riding like he was born in the saddle. His dark armor and cloak shroud him like clouds in the night sky, and his piercing green eyes glimmer with just a hint of silver. A shining pendant rests against the scuffed armor of his breastplate, depicting a raven in flight, its wings spread wide and proud against the pale opalescent gemstone set behind it like a pallid, waxing moon.

~ Played by Jij

当你目睹这来自深渊幽底的粗鄙实体时，一股预言般的末日感便沉沉压上心头。它的形貌是扭曲肢体与尸鬼般附肢拼凑而成的畸形杂糅体，渗出森然恶意。朦胧的空气随之悸动，泛起超自然的共鸣；这生物辛烈如毒的存在低声诉说着原初的智慧，凌驾于凡人的理解之外。
When seeing this vulgar entity from the abyssal depths, a sense of prophetic doom settles upon you. Its shape, a grotesque amalgam of twisted limbs and ghoulish appendages, bleeds malignance. The hazy air throbs with a preternatural resonance as the creature’s vitriolic presence whispers of primordial intellect, transcending the ken of mortals.

附魔师马球的龙族坐骑有几分像鸵鸟：长腿修劲，颈项如天鹅般优雅，鼻口却短而敦实。它没有翅膀，小小的前臂舒适地交叠扣在隆起的胸前。那双硕大的眼睛碧绿如玉，点缀着金色碎斑，以顽皮的兴致打量着往来行人。它张口发出带着呼噜的低吼时，锋利齿缝间迸出细小火花，鼻孔里卷出缕缕烟气。
The draconic mount of Enchanter's Polo somewhat resembles an ostrich, with long legs, swan-like neck, and squat snout. Wingless, its small forearms rest comfortably clasped in front of its protruding chest. Large eyes, green and flecked with gold, regard passersby with playful interest. As it opens its mouth to emit a purring growl, small sparks escape from between its sharp teeth, and smoke furls out of its nostrils.

Very Rough Seas.name:
汹涌狂涛
Very Rough Seas

Text.text:
咆哮的巨浪在被风暴撕裂的天际前如山峙立。电光乍裂，雷声滚滚。海面怒涌起白色泡沫，旋即再度轰然砸落，将裹着盐味的水雾冲上高空。漆黑翻搅的海洋暗藏无数凶险，而那巍然如岳的浪墙，反倒只是其中最不足道的一种。
The roaring waves rise like mountains against the storm-wracked horizon. Lightning flashes and thunder rolls. The sea foams white in a rage before crashing down again, sending salt-laced spray skyward. The dark, roiling sea hides many dangers, the least of which are its monumental waves.

厚重的钉刺甲片构成了这身护甲的大部分。它乍看像抛光钢铁，却在表面看不见一丝反光，昭示其材质全然异于寻常。夸张的肩甲与爪尖护手也让它区别于标准板甲，但最独特的，莫过于头盔两侧伸出的那对蜷曲公羊角。角尖染着深沉的暗红——是骇人的装饰，还是其用途的血证。
Heavy plates adorned with spikes make up the bulk of the armor. While it appears to be made of polished steel, complete lack of reflection on the surface reveals that the material is something different entirely. Oversized pauldrons and claw-tipped gauntlets also set it apart from standard plate mail, but most unique are the two curled rams horns protruding from the sides of the helm. The points of the horns are stained a deep red—a gruesome design choice, or evidence of their purpose.

Prosthetic Hand Of Burning.name:
燃烧义肢手
Prosthetic Hand Of Burning

Text.text:
这只义手由一种微微发光的金属铸成，接触时带着温热；皮革前臂护套上有六条束带，将它牢牢固定。手指看起来并不柔韧，指尖直直指向前方。凑近细看，手背上铺展开一片近乎分形的符文纹路。你将义手翻过来：一条清晰的红线自掌心中央延伸，继而分岔通往中间三根手指。那些线条仿佛随着你的心跳一同脉动。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To 许可

This prosthetic hand is formed of a metal that glows faintly and is warm to the touch, with a half-dozen straps on a leather forearm sleeve to hold it in place. The fingers don’t seem pliant, the tips pointing straight ahead. A closer look reveals an almost fractal pattern of runes sprawled across the back of the hand. You flip over the prosthetic; a clear red line travels from the center of the palm, then splits to the three middle fingers. The lines seem to pulse in time with your heartbeat.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Retired Dwarven Man.name:
隐居的矮人男子
Retired Dwarven Man

Text.text:
一名老矮人佝偻着背坐着，双眼浑浊发灰，乱蓬蓬的头发灰得像正在聚拢的暴风云。他的胡子蓬松如烟，一路拖到肚脐，既不编辫也不缀珠。他若有所思地拽着胡子，从牙齿间的缺口里吹出一声带哨的叹息——而那几颗缺牙，只是他缺失的牙齿里相当一部分。他穿着一件陈旧的无袖衫，胳膊伸出的袖窿被多年把粗壮手臂硬挤进去撑得松垮变形。如今他的肌肉已然萎缩，皮肤微微下垂，双臂上点缀的伤疤与纹身也褪成了苍白的残影，只剩往昔的回声。

~ 一位英雄 Envisioned

An old dwarf sits with a bent back, his eyes foggy and his wild hair as gray as gathering storm clouds. His beard puffs out like smoke and trails down to his navel, unbraided and unbeaded. He tugs at it thoughtfully, whistling a sigh through a gap in his teeth—of which a fair few are missing. He wears an old sleeveless shirt, the holes where his arms slip through loose from years of squeezing burly arms through them. His muscles dwindle now, skin sagging a bit, and the scars and tattoos decorating either arm are faded to pale echoes of what they once were.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Quip About A Miserable Place.name:
关于一个凄惨地方的俏皮话
Quip About A Miserable Place

Text.text:
“唉，我讨厌这里。但若命中注定要落到这般凄惨的地方，那我想，至少能与你们在一起，我也算庆幸。”
“Well, I hate it here. But if I was destined to end up in such a miserable place, I suppose I’m glad it’s with all of you.”

一棵大树——被近来的风暴连根拔起——顺着坡地轰然倒下，撕扯着周围的林中巨木，在树冠间硬生生撕开一道窗口，将四周的地貌暴露无遗。放眼望去，浓艳的翠绿如瀑般自高耸的山峰与嶙峋的山脊倾泻而下，成片丛林层层坠落。远处一座山丘上传来野兽尖厉的啸叫，不多时，你右侧林间也响起了相似的回声。
A tree—uprooted by a recent storm—has fallen down the slope and torn at the surrounding forest giants, opening a window through the canopy and revealing the surrounding landscape. All around you, vibrant green cascades of jungle tumble down from high peaks and ridges. A shrill cry from a beast comes from a distant hill, and soon it is echoed by similar calls from the trees to your right.

你一路闯过的凄冷黑暗，终于被前方一抹柔和而诡异的光打破。小舟随暗流漂近时，你看见这条地下河里，半没入水中的石笋顶端簇簇生出发光的蘑菇。它们也一路攀上洞壁，铺过穹顶，几乎像一条指向远方瀑布的宝藏轨迹——那瀑布正为洞窟的水系注入源源不绝的水流。有翼的昆虫在菌盖间轻巧穿梭，也有几只慢悠悠地飘向你。你看见它们斑点状的甲壳，正泛着与真菌同样的光色。

~ Snepai 构想

The bleak darkness you’ve ventured through is finally broken by a soft, eerie light ahead. As your boat drifts closer, you see clusters of luminescent mushrooms sprouted atop the partially submerged stalagmites in this subterranean river. They have also grown up the walls and across the ceiling, acting almost as a treasure trail to a distant waterfall that’s feeding the cave’s water system. Winged insects flit from one cap to another, while some float lazily over to you. You see their spotted carapaces aglow in the same color as the fungi.

~ Envisioned by Snepai

Half-red Dragon Veteran Encounter.name:
半红龙老兵遭遇
Half-red Dragon Veteran Encounter

Text.text:
你很难判断自己该如何看待眼前这道潇洒身影。他身披闪耀的板甲，显然是为他的身形量身打造；戴着护手的双手自信地搭在入鞘长剑的剑首上。他们说美不过皮囊，要看穿一个人的外表——可从没人告诉过你，该如何看待那猩红的鳞片与漆黑的龙角：他似乎有一部分，是龙。
You find it hard to know how to feel about the dashing figure standing before you. He wears gleaming plate armor, clearly custom-crafted to fit his figure, and confidently rests gauntleted hands on the pommels of sheathed swords. They say beauty is skin deep, and to look past a person’s outward appearance, but they never said anything about the crimson scales and black horns of someone who seems to be part dragon.

Emblem Of The Sun On The Temple Dais.name:
神庙祭坛台座上的太阳徽记
Emblem Of The Sun On The Temple Dais

Text.text:
当你踏上那段半没于水的阶梯尽头的高台时，便瞥见平台中央、两道向上延伸的楼梯之间，有一枚徽记：颜料早已褪色，边缘斑驳剥落。徽记将永恒的太阳拟人化呈现；尽管这座神殿显然奉献给天界羽蛇神，但对苍穹之王依旧奉以应有的敬意。两侧楼梯之外，各立着三尊较低位阶神祇的陶土雕像，只是右侧中间那一尊，似乎在漫长岁月里的某个时刻被毁坏，或被人移走了。
As you emerge onto the dais at the top of the partially submerged stairs, you spy an emblem with fading and chipped paint in the center of the platform between two ascending staircases. The emblem is an anthropomorphized representation of the eternal Sun, and though this temple is clearly dedicated to the celestial couatls, proper respect has been shown to the king of the heavens. Past the staircases on either side sit three clay statues of lesser deities, though the center statue on the right appears to have been destroyed or removed at some point over the centuries.

Cybernetic Cranial Augmentation +1.name:
赛博义体颅脑强化 +1
Cybernetic Cranial Augmentation +1

Text.text:
三根钢筋加固的管子连接着脊柱顶端与颞叶，管内导线搏动着闪烁的翠绿液体。每次转头，颈部肌群里的小型马达便嗡嗡作响。左侧太阳穴上突兀地探出两枚粗壮的金属螺栓，电线自其间蜿蜒而下，钻入眼后的一枚光学植入体。那只眼睛在红、绿、黑之间闪烁变换——增强体将更高阶的认知经由视神经转译传递。颅骨周围萦绕着一阵低沉的嗡鸣。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Three steel-reinforced tubes link the top of the spine and the temporal lobe, their wires pulsing a sparkling green fluid. With each turn of the head, small motors in the neck muscles buzz. Two chunky metal bolts protrude from the left temple, from which wires snake down into an optical implant behind the eye. This eye flickers colors—red, green, black—as the aug relays advanced cognitions through the optic nerve. There is a low hum about the cranium.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Subterranean Dwarfhold.name:
地下矮人堡垒
Subterranean Dwarfhold

Text.text:
头顶的石砌城垛，只泄露了大地之下那片庞然所在的冰山一角。你跨过门槛，感到矮人哨兵的目光如钉般落在身上，随即向山腹深处走去。身后的光亮很快黯淡，取而代之的是火把与火盆投下的猩红光晕。由岩体本身凿刻而成的下行通道一路延伸，将你引入矮人要塞。那里，另一道门关如巨影般矗立，封锁着入口——厚重的石门上镶嵌着贵金属与宝石。
The stone battlements above provide only a hint of what sprawls beneath the earth. You cross the threshold, feeling the eyes of the dwarf sentinels upon you, and descend into the depths of the mountain. The light at your back soon dims, replaced by the red glow of torches and braziers. The descent, carved from the rock itself, leads into the dwarfhold. There, another gate looms, barring the entrance—stone doors inlaid with precious metals and gemstones.

Deaf Druidess.name:
失聪的德鲁伊女祭司
Deaf Druidess

Text.text:
德鲁伊每天清晨醒来，迎接自然的美与威胁。她蹲身追踪，双手优雅地忙碌，目光常以缓慢而横扫的弧线环视四周。她凭借轻柔的接触与嗅觉调制药水与膏剂。能听见的凡人世界钟爱鸟鸣，理应如此。德鲁伊召来这些鸟儿，仿佛识得它们，也真心在意。树木与动物通过所有感官诉说，而不止是声音——这位德鲁伊便是明证。

~ 由 Played 的 Forge Ahead: A Party To Access 扮演

The druid wakes to the beauty and threat of nature every morning. She crouches to track, hands gracefully working, and often looks around in slow, sweeping arcs. She brews potions and poultices with a light touch and her sense of smell. The hearing world of the common folk loves birdsong, and so it should. The druid summons these birds and seems to know them and to care. Trees and animals speak through all the senses, not just sound, and this druid proves it.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

各族生灵汇聚在神殿台阶上。人们一个接一个进入，去见那位牧师——他端坐其间，指尖轻触圣典书页，专注倾听他们的祈求。殿内陈设极简，只有几丛绿植与木制风铃点缀其间。祈求者的声音里，交织着共同的渴望：祝福与治疗。在盲眼先知的神话根源中，作为通往神祇的桥梁，牧师倾听，也在倾听中学习。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Beings of all species gather on the temple steps. One at a time, they enter to meet the cleric, seated with fingertips on pages of holy text and listening carefully to their petitions. The temple is sparsely decorated with plants and wooden chimes. In the petitioners’ voices are their common need for blessing and healing. In the mythic tradition of blind seers, as bridges to the gods, the cleric listens and learns.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Devil's Sight In Darkness.name:
恶魔之视：黑暗之中
Devil's Sight In Darkness

Text.text:
你召来一场人造的夜，将敌人困得狼狈不堪，失明般踉跄，瞳孔徒劳地放大。黑暗对拥有你这般天赋的人毫无阻碍；你悄然逼近，细细品味他们的脆弱。他们警惕地转动脑袋。更近些，蓄势待发你的奇袭攻击。他们的目光与你相触——短暂一瞬，却毫无识别。你啜饮他们的恐惧。在这墨色幻象的虚无里，你那恶魔之视无形却可感的存在，必定令人魂飞魄散。

~ 构想：Spac3cowboyy

A conjured night has left your foe floundering, blind, pupils uselessly dilating. Darkness presents no problem for someone with your gifts, and you stalk toward them, savoring their vulnerability. Their head swivels warily. Closer, readying your surprise attack. Their eyes meet yours—fleetingly, without recognition. You drink their fear. In the nothingness of the inky illusion, the invisibly-felt presence of your devil’s sight must be harrowing.

~ Envisioned by Spac3cowboyy

一只毛茸茸的蝙蝠，棕色皮毛、耷拉着耳朵，倒挂在地牢天花板伸出的一根铁杆上：一段旧管子改成的栖杆。哪怕最细微的声响——一声压低的耳语或座位上的轻轻挪动——都会让蝙蝠那豆粒般的眼睛猛地睁开；他抗议似地啾叫着，扑腾起薄膜般的翅膀。再多刺激一点，他细小的毛胸便会鼓起一阵起伏，随即爆出刺破耳膜的尖啸。
A woolly bat, brown-furred and floppy-eared, hangs from an iron bar sticking out of the dungeon ceiling: an old pipe turned perch. The smallest sound—a hushed whisper or a shift in a seat—causes the bat’s beady eyes to peel open; he chirps and flaps his membranous wings in protest. Further provocation elicits a swell in his tiny, furry chest followed by an ear-piercing screech.

Genial Construction Worker.name:
能工巧匠的建筑工人
Genial Construction Worker

Text.text:
他用脚跟把那把磨损的铁锹猛地踩进泥土里，一个穿着荧光黄连体工作服的胖男人愉快地吹着口哨，抬起安全帽向路过的一家人致意。挖了几分钟后，他用戴着手套的手抹去额头沁出的汗珠，露出满足的笑容，仿佛一切都干得漂亮。他抿了一口保温壶里的饮料，又热情地朝一辆驶过的校车挥手——司机轻按喇叭回应，引得车内学生一片欢呼。
Driving his worn shovel into the dirt with his heel, a portly man in a neon-yellow jumpsuit whistles cheerfully, tipping his hard hat to a passing family. After several minutes of digging, he wipes the sweat beading his brow with a gloved hand and smiles, satisfied with a job well done. He takes a sip of his thermos and waves enthusiastically to a passing school bus as the driver pips the horn—much to the delight of the students inside.

人群嗡嗡作响，零碎的道听途说四处飞散：有传商旅遭人劫掠；有个黑暗骑士，手中低语的利刃令人不寒而栗；还有平民与贵族私会的流言，玷污了当地领主的名声。所幸，这些不堪入耳的闲话里，并未提到你。
The crowd buzzes with snippets of hearsay: rumors of merchants being robbed, a dark knight with a whispering blade, a tryst between commoner and noble besmirching the local lord’s name. Thankfully, there is no mention of you in such scandalous chatter.

Welcome From The Bookstore Owner.name:
来自书店老板的欢迎
Welcome From The Bookstore Owner

Text.text:
“欢迎！你知道的，我父母以前说文学学位是浪费时代……直到我找到了那本恰到好处的书，彻底改变了他们的想法——永远。”
“Welcome! You know, my parents said that a degree in literature was a waste of time… until I found just the right book to change their minds—permanently.”

Electrum Buckle For A Narrow Belt.name:
窄腰带用琥珀金搭扣
Electrum Buckle For A Narrow Belt

Text.text:
在扣爪本应接触之处镶着一颗欧泊，这枚扣环在闪耀的框架下刻着专属的爱慕之词。
Set with an opal where the prong would touch, the buckle is personalized with an engraved adoration under its sparkling frame.

Earthbonded Desert Wizard.name:
缚地沙漠巫师
Earthbonded Desert Wizard

Text.text:
披袍之人抬手将头饰向后一推，露出一张陶土般的脸。他那圆睁的双眼噼啪迸响着电蓝色能量，仿佛两颗钻石各自封存着一缕闪电的火花。他把磨损的凉鞋深深踩进金色沙地，举起弯月般的镰形剑（khopesh）指向无云的天空。周围的沙粒开始流动——像湖水温柔拍岸般轻缓起伏——丝缕沙雾腾起，绕着他盘旋，如同一阵尘旋在宁静中缓慢成形。雾霭之中，你看见这个人分裂出不同的影像：一个挥刃劈落，一个在说话，一个在施展法术，一个转身欲逃。它们在你刚看懂的瞬间便溶散，坠落到地上，或重新并入那旋舞的沙柱之中。

~ Played by TheOriginalGrape

The robed figure pushes back his headdress, revealing a face the color of terracotta. His round eyes crackle with electric blue energy, like two diamonds each holding a spark of lightning. He digs his worn sandals into the golden sand and lifts the curved blade of his khopesh to the cloudless sky. The sand around him begins to shift—like the gentle lapping of a lake against a shore—wisps lifting and swirling about him, like a dust devil forming at a calm, gentle pace. Within the mist, you see different images of this person forming: one slashing down with his blade, one speaking, one casting a spell, one turning to run. They dissolve as soon as you make sense of them, falling to the ground or rejoining the swirling twister.

~ Played by TheOriginalGrape

Wizard’s Workshop With Unfinished Golem.name:
巫师的工坊与未完成的魔像
Wizard’s Workshop With Unfinished Golem

Text.text:
一排排玻璃与水晶烧瓶盛着闪烁的液体，色泽各异，沿着数十层落满灰尘的架子铺陈开来。靠墙立着一张巨大的橡木书桌；桌上散落的卷轴与羊皮纸描绘着各式配方与几何草图，既有凡俗工艺，也有魔法构想。黄铜与红铜制成的奇异工具与器具占据了每一处可用的台面，表面刻满符文，在奥术火光中仿佛自带微芒。房间中央矗立着一具高耸的石质身影，轮廓粗略近似人形——一尊魔像，尚未苏醒，却已接近完工。
Flasks of glass and crystal, filled with glimmering liquid of varied hues, line dozens of dusty shelves. A massive oaken desk sits against one wall; the scrolls and parchment spilled across it depict a variety of formulas and geometric drafts both mundane and magical. Strange tools and implements of brass and copper rest on every available surface, each etched with runes that seem to shine in the arcane firelight. A towering figure of stone dominates the center of the room, roughly humanoid in shape—a golem, unawakened, but nearing completion.

I Charm With My Eyes Of Charming.name:
我以魅惑之眼施展魅惑
I Charm With My Eyes Of Charming

Text.text:
我微微偏头，朝我的目标露出笑意；眼镜那玫瑰色的镜片把整个世界都染成甜腻的粉红。我看着他们眉心紧皱的困惑一点点融化，化作轻松、慵懒的满足。他们朝我走来，像一匹被缰绳温柔牵引的马。
I tilt my head and smile at my mark, the rose-tinted lenses of my glasses casting the world in a sugary pink hue. I watch as their look of brow-crinkling confusion melts into an easy, dozy contentment. They walk toward me, like a horse gently pulled by its lead.

你吐出一个阴暗的词——在舌上留下令人作呕的余味——同时想象你的敌人双眼被针刺穿。你感到魔法的织理随之荡起涟漪，仿佛你的仇敌不过是你织成蛛网上的一只苍蝇。
You spit a dark word—which leaves a foul taste on your tongue—while imagining your enemy’s eyes pierced by pins. You feel the fabric of magic ripple in response, as if your foe were a fly on a web you’ve spun.

Elixir Of Nutrients.name:
营养灵药
Elixir Of Nutrients

Text.text:
一只光滑的玻璃小瓶闪着微光，瓶中的紫色液体点缀着大小不一的颗粒。软木塞也挡不住气味渗出：一抹金属般的辛涩，却又带着草本的浓郁丰盛。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，Forge Ahead: A Party To Access 创作

A flask of smooth glass glimmers, the purple fluid within dotted with granules varying in size. A smell comes through the cork stopper: a metallic tang, yet also an herbaceous lushness.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

寒风已将这片湖面的积雪尽数刮走，露出一面蓝黑色的镜子，纵横交错着一道道细长的白色裂痕。你瞥见几串像是鹿蹄印的痕迹，逼近湖岸后便消失在广阔的冰面上，想必是踏冰穿行，去往对岸那片被雪覆盖的森林。
Wind has swept the snow from the surface of this lake, revealing a blue-black mirror crisscrossed with long cracks of white. You spy what might be deer tracks approaching the edge then disappearing on the expanse, probably crossing the ice to get to the snow-blanketed forest on the other side.

Abandoned Lunatic Asylum: Spirit Prisone.name:
废弃疯人院：幽魂囚徒
Abandoned Lunatic Asylum: Spirit Prisoners

Text.text:
无论那来自彼岸的声音是谁，它都不知为何被困在此处。生前被关进这座疯人院，死后灵魂仍是它的囚徒。那敲击声也许是她在试图逃脱——寻求救援或一条出路——但奏响音乐的并不是同一个灵魂。这些走廊里游荡的幽灵（特征）不止一个。
Whoever speaks to you from beyond is somehow trapped here. Locked away in this asylum in life, the spirit remains its prisoner in death. The rapping might be her trying to escape—seeking rescue or a way out—but it is not the same spirit that plays the music. More than one ghost haunts these halls.

Duergar Transforms Into Devil.name:
灰矮人蜕变为恶魔
Duergar Transforms Into Devil

Text.text:
那矮壮、紫皮的矮人猛地弓身蜷缩，战栗撕扯着他的躯体；浓稠刺鼻的黑烟从他的眼眶与口中汩汩涌出，将他裹进一团地狱般的瘴雾。翻滚的屏障之内，你看见烈焰以炼狱般的凶暴轰然爆裂，他的真形随之显露：漆黑如缟玛瑙的骸骨凝聚成一具高大的有角骷髅（特征），披覆着诅咒的森严装束，眼中燃着点点炽烈的地狱火星。它发出癫狂大笑，朝你逼近。

~ 由 Pepijn 在 Discord 上 Envisioned

The squat, violet-skinned dwarf doubles over as tremors wrack his body and thick, acrid smoke begins to pour from his eyes and mouth to envelop him in a hellish miasma. Within the roiling barrier you see flames erupt with infernal ferocity as his true form is revealed: bones—black as onyx—coalesce to form a large horned skeleton wreathed in the panoply of damnation, eyes alight with motes of blazing hellfire. Laughing maniacally, it advances toward you.

~ Envisioned by Pepijn on Discord

它的身形矮壮如矮人，却绝不会有人把它当作凡间的矮人。它的皮肤泛着橙红光芒，宛如刚从熔炉里夹出的炽热金属；头发则像纠结成团的熔融热丝。它躯体散出的高温令空气泛起阵阵涟漪，而它握在手中的战锤也借来的火焰般灼灼发亮。
While dwarf-like in stature, no one would mistake it for a mortal dwarf. Its skin glows orange and red, like metal pulled from the forge, and its hair looks like tangled strands of molten-hot wire. The heat from its body causes ripples in the air, and the warhammer it holds glows with borrowed fire.

Greeting From A Bee.name:
蜜蜂的问候
Greeting From A Bee

Text.text:
“我们追寻大地温柔的甘甜，只为回到我们的挚爱身边。为何那棵血肉之树要打断我们？”
“We seek the tender sweetness of the land and to return to our love. Why does the fleshy tree interrupt us?”

Sensation Of Memory Loss.name:
失忆感
Sensation Of Memory Loss

Text.text:
世界感觉残缺不全。你的世界。尽管那些念头像雾中的幽灵般飘忽不定，你仍知道自己失去了……某样东西。你的一部分清楚有什么被夺走了，可你永远想不起那究竟是什么。日子在这种令人恼火的循环里流逝，你感觉自己正一步步漂向更深的遗忘——仿佛溺水的流亡者缓缓沉入浪下，头顶摇曳的光也渐渐褪去，最终只剩墨一般的漆黑与虚无。

~ 由 Sahlohnal 在 Discord 上 构想

The world feels incomplete. Your world. Though the thoughts elude you like wraiths in the fog, you know you have lost… something. Part of you knows something has been taken, but you can never remember what it is. As the days pass in this infuriating pattern you feel yourself drifting further and further into oblivion, like a drowning castaway slowly descending beneath the waves until the dancing light from above fades to inky black nothingness.

~ Envisioned by Sahlohnal on Discord

战马以近乎庄严的耐心站定，任由马夫一片一片为它系上坐骑护甲。光是金属就足有七十磅，披甲的骑手甚至还未现身。马鬃已被修剪得齐整，那覆于其上的折叠颈甲如手风琴般层层展开；紧随其后的是沙弗龙面甲，空洞的眼孔后，目光仿佛仍睁得极大。随后，尾部护板与缰绳一并就位。为了护住它的躯干——一圈巨大的钢裙垂落包裹。最后，马夫将鞍具推上战马英武的脊背，这头庞然大物低低叹了一口气。
With magnificent patience, the warhorse stands for its barding, being strapped on by the groom, piece by piece. Seventy pounds of metal before the rider in armor even arrives. The accordion crinet over the horse’s clipped mane is followed by the mask of the shaffron, its eyes staring wide through the holes. Then, the tail guard and reins. To protect its body—an enormous steel skirt. Finally, the groom pushes the saddle up over the horse’s heroic back, and the great beast sighs.

Delivery Of Wyvern Poison.name:
飞龙毒液的交付
Delivery Of Wyvern Poison

Text.text:
你清晰地感到这次攻击带来的痛楚，紧接着是一阵滋滋作响的异样触感，仿佛血液里充满了气泡。剧烈的战栗席卷全身，层层攀升至撕裂般的痛峰，随后化作更细小的余震，一阵阵回荡，最终渐渐消散。
You feel the pain of the attack closely followed by a fizzing sensation, as if your blood is filled with bubbles. A wracking shudder overtakes you, rising to painful peak followed by smaller echoes that gradually fade.

Fernando Lamas.name:
费尔南多·拉马斯
Fernando Lamas

Text.text:
一名男子行走在广场上，五官混合了人类与卓尔的特征，却带着绅士般的风度，沿途向行人献上迷人的问候。他衣着优雅、剪裁考究，可当他用灵巧的手指整理袖口时，便露出袖边竟破旧蒙尘。疲于奔波的气息仿佛缠在他身上，也缠在他的影子上——那影子比此刻阳光的斜度所该投下的更长一截，并且似乎扭曲成某些古怪的形状。

~ Played by Walt M. with

A man with the blended features of human and drow, and the bearing of a gentleman, walks through the square offering charming greetings to passersby. His elegant clothes are finely made, but when he adjusts his sleeves with nimble fingers, his cuffs are revealed to be ragged and dusty. A road-weary air seems to follow him, as does his shadow, which is a bit too long for the cant of the sun—and seems to twist in peculiar shapes.

~ Played by Walt M. with

Loot In The Den Of A Pack Of Werewolves.name:
一群狼人巢穴中的战利品
Loot In The Den Of A Pack Of Werewolves

Text.text:
看起来这群家伙在这儿盘踞已久，因为你在巢穴深处发现了一处丰盛的粮仓。几只啤酒桶仍散发着明亮的酒花清香，旁边还有一只小巧、未启封的葡萄酒桶。土豆、洋葱这类耐放的蔬菜装在柳条篮里，蒜串则从墙上垂挂下来。你从一个方形木箱上扯下一角米色篷布，箱盖木板上刻着三道斜痕。你撬开木箱，里面竟藏着一大批宝物：银与金的首饰，以及一罐罐满溢的钱币。
It seems the pack had been holding up here for a while, for you find a generous larder tucked deep into the den. There are a couple barrels of ale still giving off a bright and hoppy scent, as well as a small, unopened cask of wine. Hardy vegetables like potatoes and onions sit in wicker baskets and garlic hangs from the walls. You pull a bit of beige tarp from atop a square crate, the top boards marked with three slashes. Prying the crate open, you find a bountiful cache within: silver and gold jewelry and jars brimming with coins.

Riverside Border Town In Autumn.name:
秋日河畔边境镇
Riverside Border Town In Autumn

Text.text:
你涉水过河进镇，双腿溅满泥点。雨丝开始坠落，周遭的人们咒骂着，朝镇广场上那座压迫感十足、统治般耸立的教堂指指点点。穿着黯淡制服的卫兵四人一组巡行，逮住任何喧闹过头的人盘问呵斥。仿佛一切颜色都从这处聚落里被抽走了——建筑、衣着、面孔尽是灰阶——唯独那座教堂例外。它血红的墙壁阴沉地高悬在你头顶。
Your legs are spattered in mud from crossing the river to enter the town. Rain begins to fall and folk around you curse and gesture at the imposing church dominating the town square. Guards in dull uniforms walk in groups of four, accosting anyone too raucous. All color seems to have been leached from the settlement—buildings, garb, and faces all shades of gray—except the church. Its blood-red walls loom grimly above you.

一个身形瘦削的男人推了推眼镜，目光紧紧锁在他的发现上，手里捏着一支细小的刷子。空气中浮着零星尘埃，惹得人时不时打个喷嚏。他伸手去拿笔记本，你这才发现他身边尽是工具——连一件武器的影子都没有。显然，他是更亲近书卷、而非刀剑的人。
A thin-framed man adjusts his spectacles as he focuses on his discovery, small brush in hand. Bits of dust linger in the air, causing occasional sneezes. He reaches for his notebook, and you realize he is surrounded by tools—not a weapon in sight. Definitely a man more of the book and less of the sword.

Sleeping Hadrosaur.name:
沉睡的鸭嘴龙
Sleeping Hadrosaur

Text.text:
起伏的胁侧、翕张的鼻孔与放缓的吐息，昭示着鸭嘴龙已沉入睡梦；它在族群间心满意足地休息，无数星辰如璀璨的天穹画布般铺陈于头顶。高草在夜风中摇曳，夜行生灵的啼鸣回荡在葱郁翠绿的平原上空。
A heaving flank, flaring nostrils, and slowed breath denote the hadrosaur’s slumber, resting contentedly among the herd as innumerable stars paint the sky above like a brilliant celestial canvas. Tall grasses sway in the night breeze, and the calls of nocturnal creatures echo across the lush verdant plains.

Spaceport Vagrant.name:
太空港流浪者
Spaceport Vagrant

Text.text:
在喧嚣的空间港里，一个孤零零的流浪汉蜷缩在墙根，祈祷自己别被执法者盯上。他穿着破烂的连体工装，脏兮兮的帽檐下，一双被阴影纠缠的眼睛睁得发亮；他守夜般望着各式各样的飞船从装甲玻璃窗外掠过——它们流线的船体，与他虫蛀般破败的身影形成刺眼对比。他是被遗忘的灵魂，独自漂在无尽的空间里。
In the bustling spaceport, a lone tramp sits huddled against a wall hoping not to be seen by enforcers. Dressed in a tattered jumpsuit, haunted eyes wide beneath his dirty cap, he watches as ships of all shapes and sizes cruise past the armored glass windows—their sleek hulls a sharp contrast to his moth-eaten appearance. He is a forgotten soul, alone in the endless expanse of space.

你的声音逐渐低沉，化作单调的嗡鸣，你一边吟诵，一边俯视那圈盘起的绳索。你感到它在变形，眼见它几近隐形，陷阱随之就位；你又感知到，那道命令如同咒文般被刻写进绞索的每一根纤维之中。
Your voice deepens to a drone as you chant above a coil of rope. You feel it transforming, see it turn nearly invisible as the trap is set, and sense the command writ like script into each fiber of the snare.

主看台的阴影里伏着一名披斗篷的身影，一手紧攥着赛事手册。他们神色焦躁，目光不停在人群间游移，兜帽下的眼睛警觉而锐利。忽然间，他们闯到一位衣着考究的女子面前——猛地撞了她一下——随即大步钻入人潮，双手已然空空。
In the shadow of the main stand rests a cloaked figure, a tournament program clutched in one hand. They seem agitated, constantly scanning the crowd, hooded eyes alert. Abruptly they step into the path of a well-dressed woman—barging into her—before striding off into the crowd, hands now empty.

Command Cast Against A Struggling Foe.name:
命令施法对抗挣扎中的敌人
Command Cast Against A Struggling Foe

Text.text:
话语从你口中逸出，如热刀般刺入目标体内。他们的挣扎清晰地写在脸上，在与你的意志角力时拼命抵抗，只为死死守住对自身的掌控。
The words leave your mouth and penetrate the target like a hot knife. Their struggle is painted clearly on their face as they wrestle against your will, desperate to stay in control.

Surprise Fanfare Upon Heroic Return.name:
英雄凯旋时的惊喜号角
Surprise Fanfare Upon Heroic Return

Text.text:
你一靠近，号角便以惊人的嘹亮礼号骤然爆发，迎接你的是一片笑脸的浪潮与王者般的盛装仪仗。你的手本能地一颤，摸向武器，面对这场庆贺式的伏击，你不得不强压下拔出的冲动。所幸你按捺住武人的血性，没有让流血为这场盛事留下污点。

~ 由 Kazuma Bovino 在 Discord 上 构想

Trumpets erupt with startling fanfare as you approach, greeted by a swath of smiling faces and regal panoply. Your hand flinches to your weapon by instinct, and you have to suppress the desire to draw it in the face of the celebratory ambush. Luckily, you restrain your martial urges and avoid blemishing the occasion with bloodshed.

~ Envisioned by Kazuma Bovino on Discord

Herald The Retired.name:
退隐的传令官
Herald The Retired

Text.text:
纵横交错在老人手臂、脖颈与脸上的伤疤和齿痕，讲述着一个不仅活到了暮年、还几乎是拼命熬到今日才看见这把年纪的男人的故事。你不由得猜想，他究竟熬过了多少代护甲的更迭，才披上如今这套由皮革与金属板拼凑而成的补丁甲。尽管他背脊佝偻，每当他不耐烦地用手指敲击那本皮封日记时，前臂肌肉随之绷起的劲道却让你想起一株经年不倒的巨橡。腰侧悬着一柄保养得当、也用得极勤的长剑，剑鞘护板上一块暗哑的锈迹，仿佛是上百次仓促拔剑留下的证据。察觉到你的打量，他咧嘴一笑，随即夸张地哼了一声——humph。他把注意力从你身上移开，抬手将一缕灰白的波浪前发拢到耳后，左手则护着剑柄不放。

~ 由 Rogério da Costa Jr. 扮演

The scars and bitemarks that crisscross the old man’s arms, neck, and face tell the story of a man that not only lived into his old age, but barely survived to see it. You wonder how many generations of armor he outlived before donning the patchwork suit of leather and metal plate he wears today. Though his posture is stooped, the muscles in his forearms that flex with each impatient tap of a finger against a leatherbound journal remind you of the enduring strength of a mighty oak. A well-kept and well-used longsword hangs at his hip, a patch of tarnish over the plate evidence of a hundred hurried draws. Sensing your appraisal, he flashes a grin before vocalizing an exaggerated humph. Shifting his attention away from you, he brushes back a wavy forelock of gray hair behind an ear, his left hand protectively over the hilt of his sword.

~ Played by Rogério da Costa Jr.

Divine Territory Of A God Of Barbarians.name:
蛮族之神的神圣领地
Divine Territory Of A God Of Barbarians

Text.text:
在辽阔的草原上，北方白色群山耸立，南方丛林如潮涌动，神的领地随时可能显现。空气里危险带电般翻涌，感官骤然锐利；一场酝酿中的狩猎或战斗在风中低语着逼近。摇曳的草浪忽然凝止，鸟鸣戛然而止，群兽围拢在巨大的空地四周。两堆巨型营火轰然喷薄——平原两端各燃起一处——而一座石质祭坛自原野中央拔地而起。所有在场者都能感到野性的力量接管了世界：当那位神自山麓迈步而下，走向祭坛，随即释放出震天的战吼。
On the open steppe, white mountains to the north and jungle to the south, the god’s territory may appear. The air charges with danger, the senses sharpen, and a brewing hunt or battle whispers its approach on the wind. The blowing grasses still, bird calls cease, and animals surround the great clearing. Two great campfires erupt, one on each side of the plain, and a stone altar rises at the field’s center. All present feel the power of the wild take over the world when the god strides down from the foothills to the altar and unleashes his warcry.

Decorated Kuo-toa.name:
装饰华丽的库奥托亚
Decorated Kuo-toa

Text.text:
薄而革质的皮肤覆在敦实的人形躯干上，其间点缀着一块块闪烁的鳞片。鼓胀的鱼眼分立在头骨两侧，一道带刺的背鳍自背脊一路延伸。下身披着垂落的长袍，上面绣满繁复的符号与符文；上身则赤裸，仅佩一串精致的金色护符项链。这只双足生物单手握着一根长杖，杖顶镶着一尊发光的造像。
Thin leathery skin, dotted with patches of gleaming scales, covers a stout humanoid body. Bulbous fisheyes stand on either side of their skull and a spiny fin runs down their back. Robes decorated with ornate symbols and runes hang from their lower body. The upper body is bare, save for a necklace of fine golden talismans. The bipedal creature holds a long staff topped with a glowing figure in one hand.

尽管你自己很清楚此人犯下的种种暴行与罪恶，但当他们以一种令人无法理解的随意笃定开口时，你竟几乎要相信他们的谎言。仿佛这个目光清明、魅力逼人的家伙生来就没有良知……甚至连质疑或悔恨都不懂。只要给他们机会，他们什么都做得出来；而陌生人往往也很难拒绝他们那轻飘飘的做派，直到危险逼近得太晚，才会察觉。
Though you yourself are well aware of the villainy and evil this person has perpetrated, you find yourself almost believing their lies as they speak with a casual conviction that is impossible to understand. It is almost as if this clear-eyed, charismatic individual was born without a conscience . . . and does not even know enough to question or regret it. This is a person who will do anything when allowed, and there is little that a stranger will not allow them to do in their airy manner, never suspecting the danger until it is far too late.

Tome Of Radiant Light.name:
辉光之书
Tome Of Radiant Light

Text.text:
你敢说自己见过第二本这样的书吗——至少，在物质位面上没有。它的掩蔽与书脊由一种闪耀的金属构成，色泽如日光本身，其上镶嵌着羽纹般的乳彩之翼与银色花丝，纤细得仿佛一缕丝线。卷册无题无署名；书页既非纸也非金属，而是介于两者之间：一张张柔韧的薄金，被灼亮的文字蚀刻其上，并绘有栩栩如生的神祇与强大英雄的形象。书本在打开时似乎会轻轻嗡鸣，散发出温暖的辉光。
You can’t say you’ve ever seen another book like it—at least, not on the Material Plane. A gleaming metal, the shade of sunlight, makes up the cover and spine, inlaid with feathered, opalescent wings and silver filigree so fine it appears as thread. No title adorns the tome, nor author, and the pages within are neither paper nor metal, but something in between: thin sheets of pliable gold etched with gleaming script and lifelike depictions of gods and mighty heroes. The book itself seems to hum with a warm radiance while open.

Junky Amateur Hacking Rig.name:
破烂业余黑客设备
Junky Amateur Hacking Rig

Text.text:
这套装置不过是个塑料块，用几根裸露的电线草草绑在一副耳机上。从技术上说，这已经足够接入网络，但这玩意儿看起来随时会散架、把使用者电得一哆嗦，或者两者同时发生。
The rig is little more than a block of plastic tied to some headphones with exposed wire. Technically, that's all one would need to connect to the network, but this setup looks ready to fall apart, electrocute the user, or both at once.

I Pilot A Car Enchanted To Fly.name:
我驾驶一辆被施了飞行魔法的汽车
I Pilot A Car Enchanted To Fly

Text.text:
我大概懂手动挡的棍式换挡杆，但从没想过它还能变出个Z轴来。于是我索性试一把。它像普通车那样启动，我庆幸自己没一脚蹿出去。接着我发现挡杆有八个档位，全都没标。  
我松开刹车，把挡杆推到一个刁钻的位置。车子猛地悬浮起来，飞快上升，直到我再次踩下刹车。  
我转动方向盘，车也随之转向——透过挡风玻璃，我正对上一间咒法职业教室三楼的窗户。
I understand a stick shift, kind of, but not how you get a Z axis from one. So I just give it a go. It starts like normal, and I’m glad I don’t just take off. Then I notice eight positions to the stick, none of them marked. I let off the brake and shift to a tricky spot. The car levitates, fast, until I brake again. I turn the wheel, the car turns, and I’m looking through the windshield into the third-floor window of a conjuration class.

Sundries From A Purple Worm.name:
紫虫杂货
Sundries From A Purple Worm

Text.text:
你强忍那张巨口里弥漫不散的腥臭吐息，探身望向通往食道深处的幽暗咽喉，仿佛一条空洞而无尽的隧道。涎丝从牙间垂落，层层叠叠的锯齿般尖牙如林而立；其间卡着一具矮小的骷髅（特征）——看起来像是侏儒，或矮人。
Braving the stinking breath hanging in its gaping mouth, you peer into the cavernous stretch of throat leading to the gullet. Strings of spit hang down from the teeth, rows upon rows of jagged points, and you see a short skeleton—a gnome or dwarf—caught among them.

Goblins Beat A Trapped Dragon Wyrmling.name:
地精痛打受困的幼龙
Goblins Beat A Trapped Dragon Wyrmling

Text.text:
这些瘦长的小家伙长着珠红般的眼睛、刀刃似的耳朵和尖利的牙齿，一边咯咯怪笑、哼哧低吼、尖声欢叫，一边对着一团罩在网里的隆起物又踢又戳又抽打。几只生物攥着网绳牵引，其余的则在旁边蹦跳乱窜，煽动着这股恶意。它们终于挪开些许，露出网里抓住的，是一只瑟瑟发抖的爬行类生物——生着翅膀，覆着鳞片，闪耀着灿烂的铜色。它呜咽、抽泣、嘶喊，却怎么也躲不开那些残忍的殴打。

~ Envisioned by Jimbo

Rangy little folk with beady red eyes, knifelike ears, and sharp teeth giggle, grunt, and whoop as they kick, poke, and swat a netted mound. A few of these beings hold leads to the net while others caper about, encouraging the nastiness. They eventually move enough to reveal they’ve caught a shivering reptilian creature with wings and scales of brilliant copper. It whimpers, sobs, and shouts, unable to avoid the cruel blows.

~ Envisioned by Jimbo

这件护甲的皮革柔韧却坚韧，每一次移动都会发出悦耳的吱呀声。鲸骨加固了上身胸腹，偶尔闪过的金属寒光暗示着更深一层的防护。符文低调却清晰，在恰当的光线下便会浮现，沿着护甲的领口一圈环绕。
The leather of this armor is supple yet sturdy, and it creaks pleasantly with every movement. Whalebone reinforces the upper torso, and a metallic flash hints at further protection. Runes, subtle but visible in the right light, ring the collar of the armor.

魔法让重力任你摆布。你做出手势，手腕一甩，便将重力的牵引倒转。呼的一声，周遭的一切——物体、生物，乃至覆在表面的尘埃——都猛然腾空而起。
Magic makes gravity your plaything. You gesture, and with a flick of your hand you reverse the pull of gravity. With a whoosh, everything in the vicinity—objects, creatures, even the dust littering surfaces—vaults upward.

Caravan Of True Course In Winter.name:
寒冬正途商队
Caravan Of True Course In Winter

Text.text:
一辆篷布上绘着红色符文的篷车覆着薄雪。两头长毛麝牛紧挨着站着，粗壮的身躯间蒸汽袅袅升起。一名兽人女子开口对另外两名战士说话：她蓝色长发编成辫子束在脑后，腰间别着两把手斧；对面是一名肤色黝黑的女子，背负长矛与长弓，旁边则是一名披袍的矮人男子，手握铁制权杖。“阿尔乔姆一回来，我们就出发。”她说道，“愿我们的航向无误。”她坚定地点了点头，另外两人也随之复诵她的誓言。
A caravan with a red rune painted on its canvas is dusted with snow. Two long-haired musk oxen stand close together, steam rising from their bulky frames. An orcish woman, blue hair tied back in a braid and two handaxes at her belt, addresses two other warriors, a dark-skinned woman equipped with a pike and longbow and a robed dwarven man holding an iron scepter. “As soon as Artyom returns, we set out,” she says. “May our Course be true.” She nods once, firmly, and the others echo her oath.

I Create A Pact Weapon.name:
我召唤一把契约武器
I Create A Pact Weapon

Text.text:
我伸出惯用手臂，张开掌心。一点猩红的光在掌中浮现，伴随着嗡鸣般的细语，漆黑的尘屑在我张开的指间上下，沿着一道圆柱形的轨迹翻舞。粒子开始汇聚。随着钢刃出鞘般的声响，它们在我合拢的拳中凝成一柄武器。
