I extend my dominant arm and open that hand. A mote of red light appears in my palm, and a buzzing susurration accompanies specks of dark dust dancing in a cylinder above and below my open fingers. The particles gather. With the sound of unsheathed steel, they form a weapon in my closing fist.

Elderly Dracorex.name:
年迈的龙王龙
Elderly Dracorex

Text.text:
老恐龙疲惫的头颅在冠饰的重压下低垂，那些尖刺大多已泛黄、残缺、断裂——那是它在自然的残酷里拼死搏来的岁月痕迹。它长长吐出一口气，褪色的口鼻间漏出一阵咯咯作响的喘鸣，随后卧在一片草地上，在阳光下静静看着同类追逐、嬉戏、狩猎。
The weary head of the old dinosaur sags under the weight of its crown, most of the spires now yellowed, chipped, and broken from a hard-fought life in the brutality of nature. It exhales, causing a rattling wheeze to escape its faded snout, and lies down in a patch of grass to watch its kin chase, play, and hunt in the sun.

Brain Creature Throne.name:
脑生物王座
Brain Creature Throne

Text.text:
睡莲叶静静漂在一汪漆黑的水池上，带刺、畸形的触手时而破水而出、时而潜没，如同鳗鱼游弋。水池尽头通向一座由苦橙色花瓣铺成的台座，宛如莲花般环绕着一段短短的阶梯。台座中央是一颗大脑。灰白脑质盘绕成团，覆在触手的源头之上；触手从脑中伸出如同肢体，又被金绳编缚缠绕，仿佛标示着军阶或王侯之位。
Lily pads sit calmly on a black pool while spiny, malformed tentacles surface and submerge like eels. The pool leads to a dais of bitter orange petals, like a lotus, arranged around a short flight of stairs. At its center is the brain. Its coils of gray matter sit atop the tentacles at their source, emerging from the brain like limbs, braided with gold rope as if designating military rank or royal station.

Ruined Chemistry Lab.name:
废墟化学实验室
Ruined Chemistry Lab

Text.text:
踏入实验室的瞬间，刺鼻的化学辛辣味灼痛你的双眼，头顶的荧光灯不祥地忽明忽暗。黏稠的液体汇成一滩滩肮脏的水洼，色泽千变万化，铺满污秽的地面；旁边的桌上，一套陈旧的科学仪器锈迹斑斑。

~ 摘自 PaizoConOnline 2025

The chemical tang burns your eyes as you enter the lab, and the fluorescent lights blink ominously overhead. Pools of viscous fluid—of every shade and hue—cover the dirty floor in grimy puddles, and a suite of old scientific instruments rusts on the table nearby.

~ from PaizoConOnline 2025

I Channel Divinity.name:
I 引导神力
I Channel Divinity

Text.text:
我合上双眼，将意识凝聚于自己的信念，触及那引领我的神圣意志。力量奔涌回流，我向其敞开自身——化作那股伟力的导管。
I close my eyes and focus my awareness on my beliefs, tapping into the divine will that guides me. Power surges back, and I open myself to it—becoming a conduit for that force.

I Terrify With My Rod Of Lordly Might.name:
我以领主威能之杖震慑众生
I Terrify With My Rod Of Lordly Might

Text.text:
阴影加深，黑得胜过墨沥，翻涌纠缠，暗藏恶意；我的双眼也随之幽邃，连声音都化作浑厚的咆哮。威严的魔杖在我手中迸发出骇人的奥术辉光，我将它如权杖般高高举起，号令敌人在我面前逃窜——否则，便将被毁灭。
Shadows darken, blacker than pitch and writhing with a hidden malice, as my eyes grow deep and my voice, too, becomes a sonorous bellow. The lordly Rod glows with incredible arcane power as I hold it aloft like a scepter, commanding my enemies to flee before me—or be destroyed.

Loot From A Shield Guardian.name:
从盾卫傀儡身上搜出的战利品
Loot From A Shield Guardian

Text.text:
盾卫魔像一动不动地躺着，木与金属混合的肢体以怪异的角度摊开——但这位倒下的“士兵之塔”整体仍大致完好。你在这堆零散部件里再找不到任何值钱之物，不过在不远处，你确实瞥见一枚小小的护身符：一枚薄薄的银币，挂在一截断裂的链子上。它光滑的正面刻着与守卫胸甲上相同的图案。
The shield guardian lies motionless, its mix of wood and metal limbs splayed crookedly—but the fallen tower of a soldier still appears mostly intact. You find nothing else of value in the heap of parts but, nearby, you do spot a small amulet: a thin coin of silver hanging on a broken chain. Its smooth face is etched with the same image as on the guardian’s breastplate.

I Use Flexible Casting For Converting A.name:
我使用灵活施法，将一个法术位转换为术法点
I Use Flexible Casting For Converting A Spell Slot To Sorcery Points

Text.text:
我将灵魂中已稳定的魔法能量点燃，使其变得可塑。其中一部分在燃烧中耗尽，为这次塑形提供燃料。随后它融化成一种原始的奥术潜能。我能用这股未成形的力量来改造我的巫术。
I take the stabilized magical energy in my soul and ignite it so it’s malleable. Part of it burns away to fuel this shaping. Then it melts into a form of raw arcane potential. I can use this unformed power to modify my sorcery.

Discovery Of Cave With Sleeping Titan.name:
发现沉睡巨人的洞窟
Discovery Of Cave With Sleeping Titan

Text.text:
当你踏入这座辽阔而巨石般的独眼巨人洞窟时，你察觉到脚下大地正被一阵温柔的节律撩动，回声从冰封的洞壁里层层传来。待双眼适应昏暗，你看见一座难以想象的巨大隆起铺满了洞底。心跳骤然加速，传说中的宝藏堆如潮水般涌入脑海。随即你明白了：那堆东西在呼吸。就在这生物沉稳、迟缓的吐纳循环之间，一种更为异质的声响擦挠着、抓掐着，硬生生挤进你的察觉。黑暗里，还有别的东西在此栖息。

~ Envisioned by Juxtapozbliss on Discord

As you enter the vast, cyclopean cavern you become aware of a gentle rhythm stirring the ground beneath you and reverberating from the frozen walls. As your eyes adjust to the gloom, you notice an incomprehensibly vast mound filling the cave floor. Your heart races as images of legendary treasure hoards flood your mind. Then you realize: the pile is breathing. Amid the steady, ponderous cycle of the creature's breath, an altogether more alien sound scratches and claws its way into your perception. Something else lives here in the dark.

~ Envisioned by Juxtapozbliss on Discord

Loot From A Half-dragon Veteran.name:
半龙老兵的战利品
Loot From A Half-dragon Veteran

Text.text:
一件破烂斗篷的碎布里缝着：一枚镶有石榴石的银戒；一枚赤铁矿戒；一枚镶有钻石的钢戒；以及一只镶着貂皮边、嵌有六颗红宝石的银色护腕手甲。合计起来，这笔赃物肯定价值超过150枚金币。
Sewn into a shredded cloak are a silver ring set with a garnet; a hematite ring; a steel ring set with a diamond; and a silver wrist gauntlet trimmed in mink and set with six rubies. Altogether, the bounty must be worth over 150 gold pieces.

Spherical Weapon Rising From The Ocean.name:
从海洋中升起的球形武器
Spherical Weapon Rising From The Ocean

Text.text:
水与泡沫以不自然的缓慢从球体上滴落，仿佛它们不情愿回到海中。这件物体的颜色既非虚无，也非纯粹的黑暗；它是海洋不可触及的深处那种午夜般的幽蓝——深不见底、深不可测的颜色。球体中响起一声尖亮的长鸣，如同鲸的呼唤。可这瞬间的敬畏很快被一阵阴狠而得意的狂笑撕碎。随着鲸鸣化作震耳欲裂的尖啸，你的庇护者冷嘲热讽地嘲弄着你。

~ Envisioned by tickleyfeet29

Water and foam drip from the sphere with unnatural slowness, as if they are loath to return to the sea. The color of this object is not void, not pure darkness. Instead, it is the midnight blue of the untouchable depths of the ocean—the color of fathoms unfathomable. A high peal rings from the sphere, like the call of a whale. The awe of this moment is broken by a menacing, triumphant cackle. Your patron jeers at you as the whale-cry turns into an ear-shattering screech.

~ Envisioned by tickleyfeet29

Northern Fishing Village Destroyed By A.name:
北方渔村在夜幕中遭巨龙摧毁
Northern Fishing Village Destroyed By A Dragon In The Night

Text.text:
巨龙的攻击余火未熄。刺骨的风在耳畔长嚎，助长着火势；可这些火焰纵然体型骇人，在这场肆意的毁灭里却几乎不给人半点暖意。焦黑灼烧的痕迹将冰寒的渔村一分为二，你望见几具身影横陈其间，覆满灰烬——毫无疑问，是镇民们，他们在逃离火焰时倒下。至少，他们死得很快。村镇边缘，一栋两层楼房的阴燃骷髅（特征）在一团灰云中坍塌落地。

~ 由 Eric Blancho 构想

The fires from the dragon's attack still linger. A bitter wind howls, fanning the flames, which despite their size seem to shed little warmth here amid the wanton destruction. Charred, scorched trails bisect the frigid fishing village and you spy several forms strewn about, ashen—the townspeople, no doubt, fallen where they fled the flames. Their deaths were at least quick. On the edge of town, the smoldering skeleton of a two-story house crumbles to the ground in a cloud of ash.

~ Envisioned by Eric Blancho

Loot From A Slaver.name:
来自奴隶贩子的战利品
Loot From A Slaver

Text.text:
这个奴隶贩子显然尽享他那罪恶勾当的成果：颈间挂着一条金链子，每根手指都戴着镶钉戒指，身上还套着一件光滑的缎面背心。你从这具尸体上剥下他那些花里胡哨的装饰，连同坠在腰带上、沉甸甸的一袋铜币与银币一并取走。
This slaver had certainly enjoyed the fruits of his iniquitous labor: a gold chain about his neck, a studded ring on every finger, and wearing a vest of sleek satin. You relieve the dead man of his gaudy accoutrements, along with the heavy pouch of coppers and silvers weighing down his belt.

Minigun-mounted Combat Drone.name:
机枪转塔挂载战斗无人机
Minigun-mounted Combat Drone

Text.text:
无人机是一枚宽阔而扁平的圆盘，几乎无声地悬停着。像素化的红灰色都市迷彩覆满其表面，将无数可能的工具掩藏其下。它的直径至少与一辆车同宽——唯有如此，才能支撑它的武器：一挺巨大而蛮横的钢制加特林机枪——六根枪管如张开的巨口般森然大张，蓄势待发，准备倾泻大口径的地狱之雨。
The drone is a wide, flat disk, hovering almost silently. Pixelated red-gray urban camouflage covers its surface, concealing countless possible tools. It spans the width of a car at the very least, necessary to support its weapon: a great, brutish steel minigun—its six barrels yawn like an open mouth, primed to unleash high-caliber hell.

Dragon: Sleeping Dragon.name:
巨龙：沉睡的巨龙
Dragon: Sleeping Dragon

Text.text:
它睡着了！你简直不敢相信自己竟然这么走运。你原本不知道一条沉睡的巨龙会发出怎样的声响——显然这取决于它会不会打鼾。眼前这头会，而且那低沉的轰鸣像重锤般砸在你的耳膜上。巨兽覆鳞的肋腹随着每一次断续的咆哮起伏，压得它身下的地面震颤不已，震动透过你的靴底直钻进骨头里。
It’s asleep! You can’t believe your luck. You did not know what a dragon sleeping would sound like, and apparently that depends on if it snores. This one does, and the deep rumble batters your eardrums. The scaled flanks of the beast rise with each stuttering growl, making the ground beneath its body quake so much you can feel it through your boots.

Path Off The Beaten Trail.name:
偏离人迹的小径
Path Off The Beaten Trail

Text.text:
藏在路旁枝叶间的是一条狭窄小径，宽度只够你们单列穿行。主路原本开阔明朗，这条小道却逼仄得令人窒息。树枝与纠结的杂草不断勾住你的衣角，泥土与林木的腥湿气息在鼻腔里愈发浓烈。你仍旧咬牙向前；回头望去，主路已被林影吞没，模糊不清。
Hidden among the roadside foliage is a narrow path, just wide enough to enter single-file. Where the main road was clear and open, this trail is claustrophobic. Tree branches and gnarled weeds catch on your clothes, and the earthy smell of the forest intensifies in your nostrils. You forge ahead regardless; when you look back, the main road is obscured by the shadow of the trees.

Summoning Of Goristro.name:
戈里斯托的召唤
Summoning Of Goristro

Text.text:
猩红的传送门像一口巨釜般呻吟扭曲，一具庞大有角的形体被困在那层血肉般的薄幕之后。随即，世界之间的薄膜猛然崩裂，一头巨大的恶魔——头颅似公牛，唯有滴淌的巨口中龇出参差獠牙——佝偻着身子，从那拍打翻卷的裂口中挤身而出。它的身形如巨猿般驼伏，躯干与双臂筋肉翻涌，强壮的双腿短而弯曲，末端是分趾的蹄。四肢着地，恶魔喷着粗气扫视区域，双眼迸射恶毒的寒光。它发出一声骇人的咆哮，随即压低巨角，猛然冲锋。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The crimson portal groans and distorts like a caul, a massive horned form trapped just beyond the fleshy veil. Then the film between worlds snaps, and a gigantic demon—with a head like a bull except for the snaggled fangs in its dripping maw—hunches to step through the flapping opening. The fiend’s form is stooped like a great ape, torso and arms rippling with sinew, and mighty legs short and bent, ending in cloven hooves. On all fours, the demon surveys the area, snorting, and eyes flash with malevolence. It gives a horrid bellow then lowers its great horns to charge.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Loot From A Skeleton Archer.name:
来自骷髅（特征）弓箭手的战利品
Loot From A Skeleton Archer

Text.text:
这把弓握在这具阴沉面孔的不死者手中，乍看粗陋不堪。可当你把它从咔啦作响的指骨间抬起时，做工的精良立刻显露无遗。弓身由鹿角制成，以坚韧、刺痒的黄麻紧紧缠束。弓弦则是富有弹性的肠线，淡白泛粉，仍能发出清脆的嗡鸣。一个箭袋乱糟糟地躺在骷髅（特征）的骨盆下方——那是掏空木料做成的硬壳容器，里面只剩四分之一满，装着一束发黄的箭矢，箭头竟是锯齿般的牙齿。
The bow seems crude at first glance in the hands of this dour-faced undead. But as you lift it out of the rattling finger bones, the quality of its make becomes clear. The bow is made of antlers bound in strong, itching jute. Its bowstring is made of springy gut, pale and pink, and retains a sound twang. A quiver lies in a jumble under the skeleton’s pelvic bone. It’s a case of hollowed wood, quarter full of yellowing arrows with heads of serrated teeth.

Hidden Thieves' Guild.name:
隐秘盗贼公会
Hidden Thieves' Guild

Text.text:
这座破败的庄园宅邸看上去彻底无法居住：摇摇欲坠、腐朽不堪，仿佛一阵轻微的震动就能让屋顶轰然塌落。事实上，屋顶的许多地方早已坍陷，留下一个个豁口，任雨水与狂风钻入，日复一日啃噬着房屋的内脏。然而，知情者都明白：地下室与更深一层的下层地窖却保存得好得近乎完美。

当你敲响那扇半隐在暗处的地窖门，并低声说出暗号，片刻之间便有一道暗门被从内开启，放行受过引领之人踏入这座城市隐秘盗贼公会的圣所。就在街道之下的阴影里，晦暗的身影在此聚集，商议下一次入室行窃或拦路抢夺的目标，彼此磨练犯罪技艺，或只是于此处休息——在这里，他们无需惧怕被宪兵轻易寻见。
The dilapidated manor house looks completely uninhabitable, so rickety and rotted that a minor tremor might cause the roof to cave in. Indeed, many parts of the roof have done just that, leaving gaping holes for rain and wind to wear away at the house’s innards. Yet, for those in the know, the basement and sub-basement are in better-than-perfect condition. As one knocks upon the partially concealed cellar door and utters the password, a hatch is opened in short order, accepting the ingress of the initiated into the hallowed halls of the city’s hidden thieves’ guild. Here, under the surface of the city streets, shadowy figures gather to discuss their next targets for burglary or robbery, train one another in the criminal arts, or simply rest in a place where they need not fear easy discovery by the gendarmerie.

Cathedral Of The Dawnflower.name:
晨曦花圣座大教堂
Cathedral Of The Dawnflower

Text.text:
[外观] 黎明之花大教堂自周遭城街的鹅卵石路面上拔地而起，宛如一座被精雕细琢的山岳。高耸的建筑轮廓令人联想到盛放的花朵，扶壁向外伸展，如同下垂的花瓣。 [内部] 花心处矗立着一间穹顶大厅，顶端收束于一对巨大的彩绘玻璃百叶窗，连巨龙都能从中穿行。光线从玻璃间渗出，坠落成斑驳光影洒在教堂的石壁上，将地面与墙面染成一汪汪棱彩般闪耀的色池。远处墙上，一幅彩窗壁画描绘着黎明之花本尊——一位拥有无尽耐心与金色光辉的身影。

~ Envisioned by Mondorae James

[Outside] The Cathedral of the Dawnflower rises like a sculpted mountain from the cobbles of the surrounding city streets. The soaring architecture evokes a flower in bloom, with buttresses projecting outward like drooping petals. [Inside] At the flower’s center stands a chamber with a domed ceiling that terminates in a pair of massive stained-glass shutters, through which a dragon could fit. Light bleeds through the glass, falling dappled upon the stone of the cathedral itself, painting the floor and walls with prismatic pools of shining color. On the far wall, a stained-glass mural depicts the Dawnflower herself, a figure of infinite patience and golden light.

~ Envisioned by Mondorae James

Laurelynn Nostromo.name:
劳蕾琳·诺斯特罗莫
Laurelynn Nostromo

Text.text:
以半身人为标准，她算矮小。但她的存在感却占据了更多空间——那双浓烈的绿眼直视而来，仿佛一层层剥开表象，直到触及其下的秘密。她的装束也很朴素：蓝色束腰短袍、酒红长裤、黑色斗篷、一个普通的皮革钱袋；棕发纠结成团，剪得很短，用一枚银质发夹别住。她坦率的脸上刻着几道纹路，有的是忧虑留下的，有的是笑意堆出的，让她显出几分中年气息。斗篷以一枚做成“凝视之眼”的胸针扣紧；她随意握着一根虬结的乌木手杖，杖顶是一只银狼的头。她周身的空气嗡嗡作响，潜伏的魔法在其中低鸣。

~ Played by Balasar Kidlat

She’s short for a halfling. Her presence takes up much more space, though, with the gaze of her intense green eyes seeming to peel layers until they reach secrets underneath. Her style is simple, too—a blue tunic, burgundy pants, a black cloak, a plain leather purse, and a tangle of brown hair cut short and held by a silver hair clip. Lines on her honest face, some from concern and some from mirth, mark her as middle-aged. Her cloak is fastened by a brooch made to look like a staring eye, and the gnarled ebony staff she casually grasps has a silver wolf’s head at the top. Air around her hums with latent magic.

~ Played by Balasar Kidlat

Three-key Versatility Top Hat.name:
三钥全能礼帽
Three-key Versatility Top Hat

Text.text:
这顶帽子中等长度，帽身敦实，以厚重、结绒的紫色天鹅绒制成。帽带上架着一副护目镜，帽檐微微上翘，弧度讨喜。帽后有个锁孔，一把小巧的黄铜钥匙从中探出；帽顶正中央又竖着另一把钥匙。第三把钥匙则像羽饰般固定在丝质帽带上。
This is a mid-length, stout hat of heavy, matted purple velvet. It wears a pair of goggles over its band, and the brim has a pleasant curl. A small brass key protrudes from a keyhole in the back of it, while another key sticks up from the center of the top. A third is secured like a feather in the silk band.

Tournament Winner Gains Favor.name:
锦标赛冠军赢得青睐
Tournament Winner Gains Favor

Text.text:
骑士披着凹陷的护甲，带伤而立，却凯旋不败。他的面容淌满鏖战后的汗与血，双眼却闪烁着喜悦的光。那位高贵而优雅的淑女将奖赏递到他面前。她笑容灿然，目光嘉许，这份眷顾被郑重赐下——既触及心弦，也落于形体。
The knight, sheathed in dented armor, stands wounded but triumphant. His visage streams with the exertion of battle, yet his eyes gleam with joy. A lady, noble and elegant, presents him the prize. With a radiant smile and approving look, the favor is bestowed, both emotionally and physically.

Staff Of Charming.name:
魅惑法杖
Staff Of Charming

Text.text:
这根漆木法杖摸上去温热，握在手中仿佛随着你的心跳一同脉动。不知为何，它那镀银的杖首总能毫不费力地捕捉阳光或壁炉的光束，即使这种效果看起来根本不可能。
Warm to the touch, this staff of lacquered wood seems to throb in your hands in time with your heartbeat. Somehow, the silvered head of the staff catches rays of light from the sun or fireplace without effort, even when such an effect seems impossible.

Blade Strike Is Dodged.name:
刃击被闪避
Blade Strike Is Dodged

Text.text:
攻击者挥刀猛劈，锋利的刀尖迫不及待地朝要害疾冲而去。然而目标猛然扭身闪开，刀刃几乎擦身而过；他们趁势重新站位，拉开距离退到更安全的位置。
The attacker lashes out with their blade, the sharp tip eagerly careening toward vital organs. But the target twists their body out of the way, narrowly avoiding the blade's edge as they reposition themselves to a safer distance.

这恶魔宛如一滩粉紫色的污浆径流，距离无形只差一步。它的液态身躯勉强聚成含糊的人形，矮小而龇牙咆哮；下垂畸变的四肢与融化的头颅彼此坍塌、黏成一团，那张脸在无数痛苦的表情间痉挛轮转。生物周身弥漫着令人作呕的恶臭。
Like a runoff ooze of pinkish-purple slurry, this demon is just shy of formless. Its liquid takes a vaguely humanoid shape, diminutive and snarling, and its drooping, misshapen limbs and melting heads slop into each other, the face reeling through a variety of agonized expressions. A loathsome stink surrounds the creature.

Exhausted Off-duty Flight Attendant.name:
筋疲力尽的休班空乘
Exhausted Off-duty Flight Attendant

Text.text:
在员工休息室里放松时，乘务员抿了一口饮料，疲惫地长叹一声。他们眼下的黑眼圈像塞满行李的头顶行李舱般鼓胀沉重，还抬手揉了揉下颌，缓解长久维持职业笑容带来的酸痛。胸前的姓名牌褪色得相当厉害，昭示着他们在这个岗位上已待了很久。
Relaxing in the staff lounge, the flight attendant sips their drink and gives a weary sigh. The bags under their eyes are like overhead lockers crammed full of luggage, and they rub their jaw to ease the pain of maintaining a forced smile. Their name badge has faded quite significantly, indicating they have been in this role for some time.

Recounting Encounter With Vampire.name:
重述与吸血鬼（特征）的遭遇
Recounting Encounter With Vampire

Text.text:
“我直到它扑到我身上才看清。瘦得像根铁轨，却比看上去更有劲。若不是我的马，我根本不可能还站在这儿。我被撞飞脱身，可我那可怜的母马却被它撕了个稀烂。那东西把脸埋进她的肚肠里，像一条肥硕淌血的蛆。 我跑了。必须跑。可后来我回头一看……在那片血肉横飞之后，我看见了一张男人的脸。那双眼里压着绝望的恶意，至今仍让我的脊背发寒。我不知道它为什么放过我。也许我只是把它领向了更多的猎物。”
“I didn’t see it until it was on top of me. Rail thin and stronger than it looked. Were it not for my horse, I wouldn’t be standing here. Got knocked clear, but my poor mare got torn into. The thing buried its face in her innards like some fat bloody maggot. I ran. Had to. But then I looked back… Behind all the gore, I saw a man’s face. The eyes held a desperate malice that still sends a chill down my spine. I don’t know why it let me go. Maybe I’ve only led it to more prey.”

Wraivex The Dreamweaver.name:
梦织者·沃莱维克斯
Wraivex The Dreamweaver

Text.text:
一股冰冷而陌生的失谐感环绕着那名神秘的兜帽身影，仿佛群星之间的黑暗凝成了实体，竟屈尊在凡人间行走一段time。那身影以王者般的庄严自持——更因其高耸如雕像般的体态而愈发慑人——将锐利而审慎的目光掠过人群。当他们的眼眸扫过你，与你的视线仅短暂相触，你的心智便被星界那不可触及的美所淹没：旋卷的虹彩星云、旋转的星系、闪烁的星海铺满视野，如同一场炫目的爆裂骤然绽放，继而褪入虚无。

~ Played by Nezalhualixtlan

A cold, alien dissonance surrounds the mysterious hooded figure, as if the darkness between the stars has taken physical form and deigns to walk among mortals for a time. The figure carries themself with regal solemnity—aided greatly by their towering, statuesque physique—and sweeps their discerning gaze over the crowd. As their eyes pass over you, meeting your own for only a moment, your mind is filled with images of the intangible beauty of the astral. Swirling, prismatic nebulas, spinning galaxies, and scintillating starscapes fill your vision in a dazzling eruption before fading into oblivion.

~ Played by Nezalhualixtlan

Pharmacy In A Temple.name:
寺庙里的药房
Pharmacy In A Temple

Text.text:
药房里朴素的木架上摆满了货物：一排排晶亮的红色药剂、装着草药膏泥的陶罐，以及各式医疗用品。后墙点缀着一座小神龛，中央立着医者之神的神像，两侧簇拥着矮胖的牛脂蜡烛。辛烈的草药气味、搓揉酒精与溶剂的味道在狭小的店里交织，酿成一股浓烈的氛围。光滑的橡木柜台后，一名高大的络腮胡男子坐着——圆润的脸在慈和的微笑里被照亮——他专注聆听顾客的病痛，时而沉思地点头。隔壁神殿传来的低沉祈祷声随着温热的午后空气飘荡而入，香炉执持者经过时，一缕若有若无的香火气也随之渗进来。

~ 构想：Tusker2zero

The simple wooden shelves of the pharmacy are stocked with rows of glistening red potions, jars of herbal poultices, and other medical supplies. A small shrine adorns the back wall, a statue of the God of Healers placed at its center and flanked by squat, tallow candles. The aroma of pungent herbs, rubbing alcohol, and solvents creates a potent atmosphere in the small store. Behind a smooth oak desk, a large, bearded man sits—his round face illuminated by a compassionate smile—as he listens carefully to the ailments of a customer and nods thoughtfully. The chanting of muffled prayers from the adjoining temple drifts through the warm afternoon air, and a subtle note of incense wafts in as the censer bearer passes by.

~ Envisioned by Tusker2zero

Transformation Into Wereboar.name:
化身为野猪人
Transformation Into Wereboar

Text.text:
那非人的尖叫扭曲成不属于人世的嘶鸣，关节噼啪作响，肌肉撕裂绽开。你眼睁睁看着一个人仿佛从内里炸裂，他的身躯迅速粗壮，肩膀鼓胀隆起，撑起一张拉长变形的脸——鼻口前突成獠牙森然的吻部。变身只在一瞬心跳间完成，却已让你们两个都汗如雨下，像猪一样淌着热汗。
The inhuman scream distorts into an unearthly squeal as joints pop and muscles tear. You’re watching someone seem to burst apart, his body thickening as his shoulders balloon to hold the weight of a face lengthening into a tusked snout. The transformation took only a heartbeat, but it’s left you both sweating like pigs.

Giant Evil Castle.name:
巨型邪恶城堡
Giant Evil Castle

Text.text:
高塔如入侵大军的长矛般直刺天际，高墙如交错的盾牌般层层交叠，其后林立的诸多棱堡与城堡宛如阴沉的头颅，头戴锯齿般的垛口王冠。只要攻破一道城门或凿穿一段城墙，你便踏入一座由防御工事织就的浩瀚迷宫。
Towers thrust up like the spears of an invading army, the high walls their crossed shields, and the many bastions and keeps behind them their brooding heads, crowned with battlements. Breach one gate or pierce one wall, and you enter a vast labyrinth of fortifications.

Temperate Forest In Spring.name:
春日温带森林
Temperate Forest In Spring

Text.text:
一堆堆残雪蜷伏在树下，仍未被回暖的春日阳光触及。空气清凉，却因融雪细流的潺潺与候鸟的颂歌而生机盎然。早开的花朵——三瓣的延龄草与姿态优雅的白花血根——顶开潮湿的褐色泥土。树木也正开始抽芽，枝桠披上一簇簇浅绿的新绒。
Mounds of snow sit beneath the trees where the warming spring sunlight has not yet touched them. The air is cool but alive with the trickle of meltwater and the paeans of migratory birds. Early flowers—three-petaled trilliums and elegant white bloodroot—push through the damp, brown earth. The trees are beginning to bud, clothing their branches in tufts of pale green.

龙吻巨口滴淌着黏稠的唾液团，仿佛渗出的熔岩般滚落；这头蜥蜴般的怪物怀揣着唯一的掠食本能逼近——进食。它用前肢拖拽着沉重身躯向前猛冲，钻石般坚硬的利爪紧扣大地；无足的下半身蜿蜒滑行，发出阴森的沙沙低语。沿着厚重鳞脊突起的棘刺微微战栗，随着它庞大的负载收缩绷紧，继而将其猛然弹射向前。
Draconic maw salivating with thick globules of oozing magma, the saurian monstrosity approaches with a lone predatory drive: to feed. It heaves itself forward using its forelimbs, which grip the earth with diamond-hard claws, its apodal lower body slithering with sinister susurration. The spines protruding along the thick scaled ridge of its spine shiver as its bulk constricts and launches it forward.

Boots Of Speed.name:
速度之靴
Boots Of Speed

Text.text:
这双靴子做工精致，接触之下柔软而富有韧性，然而其大师级的品质又让它的坚固一目了然。它们顺着脚跟滑入，贴合得紧密却舒适；细心的观察者也许会注意到，每只靴子上都有极其浅淡的蚀刻纹样——一片覆羽之翼在飞行中舒展。
The boots are finely made, soft and supple to the touch, and yet their masterwork quality makes their sturdiness evident. They slip over the heel, fitting snugly but comfortably, and careful observers might note the faintest etching on each depicting a feathered wing spread in flight.

Divine Horizon Of A God Of Mysteries.name:
秘神之神的神圣地平线
Divine Horizon Of A God Of Mysteries

Text.text:
好奇的词句在耳畔低语，在脑海回响，挣扎着要在舌尖成形。此地，所有语言——存活或湮灭，凡俗或神圣——的疑问词沿着迂回的轨迹流淌，问题牵出问题。那些向奥秘之神祈求的人，会发现自己的心智被重新敞开，涌入他们曾经自以为懂得透彻的念头……旋即，神又将疑云覆在其上。祂的领域是一团无声的云雾，如同海水在快艇船底下飞驰，永远追逐着一个永不抵达的地平线。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Words of curiosity whisper in the ears, echo in the mind, and struggle to form on the tongue. Here, the interrogatives of every speech—living and extinct, mortal and divine—are flowing in a circuitous path, question leading to question. Those who beseech the God of Mysteries find their minds open to ideas they once understood well… then the god casts doubt upon those as well. Their domain is a soundless cloud, racing like seawater beneath a cutter, always on a quest for a horizon that never comes.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Use Astral Perception To Detect Physic.name:
我运用星界察觉来侦测目标的身体与精神状态
I Use Astral Perception To Detect Physical And Mental Condition

Text.text:
我额头正中央涌起一阵灼热的涟漪。仿佛有一层面纱被猛然撕裂，世界随之露出真容；其中的身影凝聚成类人形态，呈现出一切你所能想象的色彩。每一道身影都像由信息织成的灵光，仿佛让人窥见他们灵魂的一瞥。更强大、更醒目的色焰在某些人周身迸发，昭示他们对魔法之道的牢牢掌控。有的灵魂燃得炽白夺目；有的却在黯淡、在摇曳、在将熄——病弱、濒危，或只是静候死亡。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

The center of my forehead ripples with heat. A veil is ripped from the world, and the figures within coalesce into humanoid shapes in every conceivable color. Each is like an aura of information, alike to a glimpse of their soul. Stronger, bolder colors flare around certain individuals, indicating their strong command of the magical arts. Some souls burn incandescent. Others are fading, guttering: sick or ill or waiting to die.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

甜腻而土腥的烟雾在空气里翻涌。吧台占据了这间狭长房间的大半，一整块黑色石板铺成台面。冷凝水的残渍与碎冰的遗痕在其上拖出斑驳的纹路，像一片患病的星河，黯淡得不见星点。嘶的一声打断了烟线下那群剪影的低语。机器人酒保从掌心那道桶状开口喷出一股寒气，为杯子急速降温。它把结霜的玻璃杯斜放到自动酒嘴下，淡黄色的啤酒成股倾泻而出。“您的酒，先生。”机器人喉部的音箱嗡嗡作响。它将杯子放在吧台上。

一只布满纹身、粗糙的手把杯子抓走。他咒骂着，皮肤被冰冷的杯壁黏住。“蠢’bot。”他低吼。脖颈上一道老疤随着他仰头喝酒而起伏。“我们干嘛非得在这狗屎地方见面？”

A sweet, earthy smoke clouds the air. The bar comprises most of this narrow room, its top a long slab of black stone. Streaked with residue of condensation and remnants of ice, the bar top seems a rheumy galaxy bereft of stars. A hiss interrupts the murmuring of the silhouettes clustered below the smoke line. The robotic bartender chills a glass with a blast of cold air from a barrel-like opening in its palm. It tips the frosted glass under an automated tap, from which a light-yellow beer streams. “Your drink, sir,” buzzes the audio box at the robot’s throat. It sets the glass down upon the bar.

A hand rough with tattoos takes it. He curses as his skin sticks to the chilled glass. “Stupid ’bot,” he growls. An old scar across his neck bobs as he takes a drink. “Why we gotta meet in this shithole?”

Treasure Hoard.name:
宝藏堆积如山
Treasure Hoard

Text.text:
堆积如山的钱币间点缀着斑斓宝石，嵌满精美小玩意儿，起伏如沙漠里的沙丘。宝箱、木桶与保险匣半埋在宝藏之中，仿佛海底被沙吞没的沉船。别说赎回国王了，这般财富足以买下他们的王国。
Heaps of coins, speckled with colorful gems and studded with beautiful trinkets, rise and fall like dunes in a desert. Chests, barrels, and coffers lie half-buried in the treasure, like sunken ships swallowed by sand on the sea floor. Forget ransoming kings, wealth such as this could buy their kingdoms.

Temple To A God Of The Arctic.name:
极地之神的神庙
Temple To A God Of The Arctic

Text.text:
神殿的墙壁光滑如镜，呈冰川般的湛蓝与半透明，接触之下寒意刺骨。它们究竟真是由冰铸就，还是仅仅被雕琢成冰的模样，难以分辨——尤其当翠绿火焰的壁灯在旁燃烧时，墙体依旧坚实不化。穹窿般的圣所空旷深邃，圆顶天花由无数层同样的冰质叠砌而成，每一层都涂染着紫罗兰与玫瑰的色泽、闪电般的幽绿，以及点点白光。访客在下方行走时，层叠的穹顶便织出错觉：流星般的星点游移不定，极光在夜空般的背景上轻颤摇曳。
The smooth temple walls are glacial blue and translucent, feeling cold to the touch. Whether the walls are truly made of ice or only made to seem so, it is difficult to tell—though they remain solid behind sconces of green fire. In the cavernous sanctum, the domed ceiling is made up of many layers of the icy substance, each painted with hues of violet and rose and electric green, as well as pinpoints of white. As visitors move below, the layered ceiling creates the illusion of wandering stars and an aurora wavering against a night sky.

Swordsman Shot With Arrow.name:
剑士中箭
Swordsman Shot With Arrow

Text.text:
一名身着皮甲、披着板甲护肩、外罩深绿色战袍的剑士被一箭射中，痛吼着拔出武器。箭杆从他腰带线右侧的腹部突兀地刺出。
A swordsman in leather with plate pauldrons and a dark green tabard is hit by an arrow, causing him to draw his weapon with a painful shout. The shaft sticks out of his gut along the right side of his beltline.

Peregrin Jones.name:
佩雷格林·琼斯
Peregrin Jones

Text.text:
这位年轻牧师的蓝宝石般眼眸闪烁着炽烈的光，仿佛被某种内在的驱力——一种向内燃烧的使命——所点亮。他抬手捋过刚精心打理的金发，指甲干净修剪得一丝不苟。另一只手将一本厚重的典籍紧紧抱在胸前，洁白无瑕的长袍袖口垂落包裹，像护身的披肩般将它轻轻拢住。那皮质掩蔽陈旧而磨损，封面上烙印着一枚太阳迸射的徽记。

~ Played by Gareth with

The sapphire eyes of this young cleric gleam with the fervor of some inner drive—an inward purpose. He passes a hand through his recently coiffed blond hair, his nails clean and cut. His other hand clutches a tome to his chest, the long sleeve of his spotless white robe nestling it like a protective shawl. The leather cover, old and frayed, is emblazoned with a sunburst symbol.

~ Played by Gareth with

Hacker Robs A Datastore Node In The Net.name:
黑客在网中洗劫一处数据存储节点
Hacker Robs A Datastore Node In The Net

Text.text:
虚拟数据仓库轻轻脉动着，以可视化的方式昭示其防护协议正平稳运行。黑客站定在那枚光球前，扭转、拨弄界面，直至外壳崩裂；一串奢靡铺陈的信息洪流倾泻而出，在他们眼前层层展开。
The virtual datastore pulses gently, a visual indication that its protection protocols are running smoothly. The hacker positions themselves in front of the orb, twisting and manipulating the interface until the shell breaks, and an indulgent array of information spills out and displays in front of them.

Crystal Ball Of Mind Reading.name:
读心水晶球
Crystal Ball Of Mind Reading

Text.text:
那枚水晶宝珠——一颗完美光滑、如玻璃般晶莹的球体——安坐在一座底座之上；底座被雕成一双双手的形状，掌心轻托，仿佛生怕惊扰了这脆亮的晶体。究竟有多少只手难以分辨：你凝视宝珠越久，越像有更多手从中浮现，每一只都体型各异、形态不同。有的手缺了指节，有的只剩森森骨架；有的指间戴着戒环，有的却显得全然非人。
The crystalline orb—a perfectly smooth, glassy sphere—sits perched atop a stand sculpted to resemble hands, cupping the crystal gingerly in its palms. The exact number of hands is hard to discern, as the longer one perceives the orb, the more hands seem to appear, each a different size, a different shape. Some hands are missing fingers, others appear skeletal; some are adorned with rings, while others seem completely inhuman.

保镖那紧绷贴肤的背心下，肌肉如笼中猛兽般起伏翻涌，仿佛在宣告任何麻烦都会被迅速终结。厚重的皮夹克更衬得他们体魄魁梧，而颈侧那道带着凶相的纹身——虽已褪色——仍在无声诉说一段危险的过往。
Muscles ripple like caged beasts beneath the skin-tight vest of the bouncer, promising a swift end to any trouble. A heavy leather jacket accentuates their robust physique even further, and the menacing tattoo on their neck—though faded—tells a story of a dangerous past.

Border Town Hall.name:
边境小镇政厅
Border Town Hall

Text.text:
这栋建筑高耸而立，以竖直原木堆砌，外圈铁箍紧紧束缚。大门上镶饰着王室纹章，从君王到男爵一应俱全；入口处一块巨大的铺路石上，雕刻着小镇的徽记。步入其内，单调乏味的办公室沿主会议厅两侧延展开去，桌案与档册一排排陈列。粗砺木梁下垂着一盏朴素的枝形吊灯，其下是一张木制议桌，周围的椅子在石板地上微微倾斜。后墙处设有一排令人坐立难安的公众席位，如同冷硬的看台。
The building is a tall construction of vertical logs and iron banding. Its doors are decorated with the sigils of the royals from monarch to baron, and a large paving stone at the entrance is carved with the crest of the town. Inside, uninspiring offices with desks and records extend off the main meeting hall. Under a simple chandelier hanging from rafters of rough timber is a conference table of wood surrounded by chairs that tip on the flagstones. A gallery of uncomfortable public seating occupies the back wall.

Phlegethos, The Fourth Circle Of Hell.name:
弗勒革托斯，地狱第四层
Phlegethos, The Fourth Circle Of Hell

Text.text: 在弗勒格索斯的金色大门前，你被一块雕工精美的告示牌迎接： 对你最有利的，便是最好的。“足够”一词在此毫无意义，凡是不为你的目标出力之人，皆与你为敌。现在就进入，让弗勒格索斯化作你想要的模样。索取不停，不问良心，不设限度。 自那闪耀的街道深处传来掷骰滚动的声响、押注的喊叫，以及讨价还价的低语。这些声音里寻不见欢愉，也寻不见满足。 At the golden gates of Phlegethos you are greeted by a beautifully engraved sign: Whatever is best for you is best. The word “enough” has no meaning here, and everyone who does not contribute to your goal is against you. Enter now, and make Phlegethos into whatever you would have it be. Acquire without stopping, without conscience, without limit. From the glittering streets come the sounds of the rolling of dice, the shouting of wagers, and the murmur of bargaining. No joy, no satisfaction, is found in these voices.

Raised Beer Stein.name:
高举的啤酒杯
Raised Beer Stein

Text.text:
沉甸甸、满满当当，这只酒杯有一块地基砖那般的体型，被一只强健的手高高举起。洁白的泡沫从杯口跃起，啤酒在杯中荡漾如将碎的浪潮——可那只手稳如磐石，酒已备好，一饮而尽。
Heavy and full, the size of a foundation brick, the stein is raised high by a strong hand. White froth of the head jumps from the top, and the beer rocks like a breaking wave, but the hand is steady, and the beer is ready to be quaffed.

Potion Of Allergen Resistance.name:
过敏原抗力药水
Potion Of Allergen Resistance

Text.text:
当喷嚏、荨麻疹、红疹与水疱轮番折磨，终于把人逼到极限，再也无法忍受过敏那无休无止的诅咒时，他们便会寻找这瓶药剂。它盛在一只细长的玻璃瓶里，瓶中是翠绿如青翠藤叶的液体，在玻璃的狭窄囚笼中轻柔荡漾。为了让外行也能明白，瓶塞上系着一卷细薄的纸条；上面写着：只要吞服，便可缓解因身体不耐花粉或食物而引发的任何病症，其效力可持续一轮月相。

~ 构想：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

When the sneezing, hives, rashes, and blisters have taken their toll, and one has reached their limit in tolerating the unending curse of an allergy, they search for this potion. It is a long, thin bottle, filled with a viridian-green fluid that swishes smoothly within the confines of the glass. To aid the layperson, a thin scroll has been affixed to the cork; it describes how ingestion will ease the symptoms of any malady caused by the body’s intolerance to pollen or food, and lasts for a moon’s phase.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Small Dust Elemental.name:
小型尘埃元素
Small Dust Elemental

Text.text:
一个尖啸的身影从呛人的尘雾中疾掠而出，面容憔悴却喜形于色。它骨瘦如柴，皮肤如蜂窝般布满孔洞，舌头干枯萎缩，唯有那双闪烁的黄眼仍透出一丝生气。它伸出漆黑的利爪，欲钩、欲刺、欲撕。
Out of the dust-choked air flies a screeching figure with a haggard yet gleeful face. With its emaciated frame, porous skin, and desiccated tongue, only its glimmering yellow eyes give it a sense of life. Its black claws stretch out to hook and pierce and rake.

I Cast Mask Of Many Faces.name:
我施放「千面假相」
I Cast Mask Of Many Faces

Text.text:
我低声咕哝着变化的咒词，双手从头顶掠过，滑过躯干与四肢。指尖所至，五官与肌理泛起微光般的涟漪，幻象覆上身形，将我改作另一副面貌。轻松得就像戴上一张面具。
I mutter words of changing and my hands pass over my head, my body, and my limbs. As they do, my features shimmer as an illusion covers them in a new appearance. It’s as easy as putting on a mask.

Sundries From An Observant Yuan-ti.name:
一位敏锐的元蛇人带来的杂物
Sundries From An Observant Yuan-ti

Text.text:
蛇人仰躺在地，浅色的腹部朝向天空，染血的獠牙外露。你在它的腰带或斜挎带上没找到多少值钱东西：武器确实好用，却朴素简单，而且似乎连钱袋都没有。倒是找到一个小巧的圆筒形容器，用带污渍的木头制成，里面装着黄色油脂，散发着草木般的气息。你注意到蛇人的鳞片在光下清澈而明亮，猜想这或许是这只生物日常护理鳞片的一部分。
The snakefolk lies with their light-toned belly facing toward the sky, bloodstained fangs exposed. You don’t find much value on their belt or bandolier, for the weapons are effective but simple, and there seems to be no coin pouch at all. You do find a small cylindrical container of stained wood filled with a yellow oil that has a vegetative scent. You notice the snakefolk’s scales appear clear and brilliant in light and guess this may have been part of the creature’s scale-care routine.

Receiving Unwelcome Orders From A Superi.name:
收到上级不受欢迎的命令
Receiving Unwelcome Orders From A Superior

Text.text:
怒火在你胸腔里翻涌，听到命令你退下时，几乎要沸腾溢出。将军必有他的理由——可你也有！汗珠在你额头凝结，你咬紧牙关把话吞回去，用全身每一寸意志与冲动搏斗，竭力保持沉默。

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Anger swells in your chest, threatening to boil over as you receive the order to stand down. The general must have their reasons but so do you! Sweat beads on your brow as you hold your tongue, fighting with every fiber of your being to stay quiet.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

I Jump With My Enhanced Legs.name:
我用强化的双腿纵身一跃
I Jump With My Enhanced Legs

Text.text:
我纵身一跃，腿部义体的力量爆发，推动我以超越常人的速度直冲云霄，胃里猛地一沉，像坐过山车般翻涌。刹那间我失去重量，挣脱日常生活的地心束缚，像展翼的飞鸟般在空中滑翔。
I jump, and feel the cybernetic power in my legs propel me skyward at superhuman velocity, causing my stomach to lurch like a rollercoaster. For a moment I am weightless, slipping the gravitational bonds of regular life as I glide through the air like a bird on the wing.

Fairy Grappling A Target.name:
仙灵擒抱一个目标
Fairy Grappling A Target

Text.text:
快得连你的眼睛都跟不上，敏捷的小妖精（特征）在空中疾掠而过——以出人意料的力量——将他们的目标缠入一记扭转的抱锁之中，彻底令其动弹不得。

~ 由 Dwayne 在 Discord 上 构想

Moving faster than your eyes can follow, the nimble sprite darts through the air and—with surprising strength—clasps their target in a twisting embrace, completely immobilizing them.

~ Envisioned by Dwayne on Discord

Sentient Spellbook.name:
有知觉的法术书
Sentient Spellbook

Text.text:
封面是一对素黑漆面的木板，像一本朴素的日记或画家的速写本。书在封面的铰接处后方，用三根雪花石膏色的装订柱固定。当你把它拿起时，你仿佛已经在阅读。有什么东西在你脑中嗡鸣，或低声呢喃。第一页亮得刺眼，压印着一张浅灰色的面具，隐约勾勒成你自己面孔的模糊轮廓。其余页面一片空白，但这本书会直接告诉你的意识，上面写着什么。
The cover is a plain black lacquered pair of boards, like a simple journal or an artist’s sketchbook. The book is bound with three alabaster posts behind the cover’s hinge. When you pick it up, you feel as if you are already reading. Something hums or whispers in your head. The first page is bright white, embossed with a slight gray mask that forms into the vague shape of your own face. The rest of the pages are blank, but the book tells your mind what they say.

Vampire Portrait.name:
吸血鬼（特征）肖像
Vampire Portrait

Text.text:
这三位婆罗门的庄重体面之下，有一种阴冷而悲戚的东西悄然爬行。它从他们眼中的画布里渗出，跃出画框，直直沁入你的骨髓。父亲神情严厉，黑发如墨，身上那件长大衣贵得足以抵一位公爵的赎金。孩子被繁复的蕾丝和一顶缀花的帽子打扮得过分精致，却用一种近乎好奇的目光凝视着，仿佛在观看一场绞刑。母亲最为压迫：瘦得不合常理，护崽的姿态却像狼般警惕。三人面色惨白，彼此之间没有任何接触，仿佛被某种无形的斥力推开。
Beneath the dignity of these three brahmin, something sinister and sad creeps through. It leaves the canvas from their eyes, jumps the frame and chills you. The father, stern and black haired, wears a long coat worth a duke’s ransom. The child is overdressed in frills and a flowered hat, but stares as if curious about a hanging. The mother is the most imposing: overly thin and protective as a wolf. They are pale, and none touch, as if repelled.

这条干涸的河床沿着山谷底部蜿蜒而过，两侧都有充足的掩蔽。高大而浓密的灌木与矮丛挤满谷地两侧，夹杂在草丛间，又被几道粉末般的残雪划出苍白的条纹。两侧岩壁陡峭逼仄，但在山谷这一段，有几条狭窄的冲沟可供攀爬，让人更容易登上去。
There is plenty of cover on either side of the dry riverbed that runs along the floor of this valley. High, dense shrubs and scrub brush pack along the sides of the vale among grasses and streaks of powdery snow. The rock walls on either side are steep, but a few tight gullies make them more easily scalable in this part of the valley.

Bulette Encounter: Walking The Plains.name:
布雷特兽遭遇：漫步平原
Bulette Encounter: Walking The Plains

Text.text:
微风拂乱平原的草浪，草叶随之起伏翻涌，向四周一圈圈荡开，仿佛你正置身于波涛之间。高空劲风驱赶着云层掠过天际，将流动的阴影一抹抹滑过大地。你感觉自己仿佛正大步穿行在一片内陆之海上，甚至忍不住想象——若是竖起一面帆，你便能像船只那样在其上轻盈滑行。
The breeze ruffles the grass of the plains, moving it in great waves that ripple out around you. High winds chase clouds across the sky, sliding their shadows over the landscape. It seems like you stride across some inland sea, and you imagine that if you put up a sail you might glide like a ship across it.

Abandoned City Of Malnuset.name:
被遗弃的马尔努塞特城
Abandoned City Of Malnuset

Text.text:
城后山丘上矗立着这座城的疯人院——一组参差嶙峋的拱形长厅与幽暗尖塔，墙身刻着治疗的符号，却反倒散发着希望尽失的寒意。裸露的土壤间夹着零星草丛，遍地散落着死者与不死者的残骸；下方街道上，各式不死者踽踽而行。有些建筑仍算完好，但更多已被攻破撕裂。唯有一处——一座宏伟庄园——在与疯人院相对的城另一端，依旧完整无瑕、未见玷污。

~ 由 Mondorae James 构想

On the hill behind the city stands its asylum, a jagged set of arched halls and dark spires marked with symbols of healing but instead emanating a vibe of lost hope. Remains of the dead and undead scatter the bare parts of the earth among patches of grass, and the streets below are walked by various undead. Some of the buildings remain intact, though many are breached and torn. One, a grand manor, stands complete and untarnished on the opposite side of the city from the asylum.

~ Envisioned by Mondorae James

Shooter In The Net.name:
网中射手
Shooter In The Net

Text.text:
暴雨般的火力化作实体，这道暴烈的具现体在冲突燃起之处茁壮滋生。无论是像素化的竞技场，还是肉身世界的街巷，枪声都找到了自己的嗓音。楷模相撞，化身交锋，而那位指挥家以他的手枪弹为乐章，编排一场杀意的协奏。对他而言，所有参与者都只是准星里的影子，腰带上一道道刻痕。

~ 一位英雄所构想

A barrage incarnate, this manifestation of violence thrives where conflicts flare. In pixelated arenas and meatspace streets, shots find a voice. Exemplars collide and avatars clash as the maestro orchestrates his parabellum. To him, all who play are just shadows in his sights, notches on his belt.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Pathetic Gang Wannabe.name:
可悲的帮派跟班模仿者
Pathetic Gang Wannabe

Text.text:
这少年穿着一身过分宽大的衣服，上面涂满了拙劣的帮派涂鸦，看起来滑稽可笑。尽管他们拼命想摆出一副凶狠威严的派头，实际上却只显得可怜——又软弱。要是这孩子真碰上个真正的帮派分子，怕是会被吓得把那身仿货都弄脏。
The youth is a comical sight in their over-sized clothing covered in badly drawn gang tags. Though they desperately try to project an air of menacing authority, in reality they come across as pathetic—and weak. If this kid ever met a real ganger they’d soil their knock-offs.

Loot From A Behir.name:
贝希尔的战利品
Loot From A Behir

Text.text:
贝希尔临死前那阵撕裂般的抽搐，硬生生逼得它的食道一空，将上一顿猎物无法消化的残骸尽数呕出。一对覆鳞的护手甲躺在热气蒸腾的污水洼旁，旁边是一枚雕饰繁复的银戒指，以及一支被腐蚀得斑驳的发簪——其上镶着一颗依旧澄净无瑕的金绿玉。
The behir’s final wracking shudders have forced its gullet to empty, expelling the undigestible remains of its previous prey. A pair of scaled gauntlets lies in a steaming puddle beside an ornate silver ring and a corroded hairpin studded with a single pristine chrysoberyl.

Ioun Stone Of Reserve.name:
储备灵石
Ioun Stone Of Reserve

Text.text:
这枚棱晶因纯粹魔能而脉动不息。你将其抛向空中，封存其中的法术知识骤然清晰得宛如路牌，直映心底。凭借这块石头的号令，你能以老练施法者的技能，驾驭其中蕴藏的法术。
Throbbing with the arcane power of raw magical energy, you cast the prism into the air, the knowledge of the spells stored within suddenly as plain to your mind as a street sign. With the command of this stone, you can wield the spells within with the skill of a seasoned caster.

Elemental Plane Of Earth.name:
土元素位面
Elemental Plane Of Earth

Text.text:
发光而莹润的宝石，体型如巨砾般硕大，是这些无尽洞窟嶙峋而逼仄的狭窄深处唯一的光源。岩石坚实、不可穿透，从四面八方向你合拢，仿佛诸界的真实重量一齐压来。又一次震动——短短五分钟内的第五次——撼动了隧道，令阴影笼罩的洞顶簌簌崩落尘土与碎石。这里的石头是活的——它在呼吸，以战栗、碾磨般的颤动吐纳不止。
Luminous, lustrous gems the size of boulders provide the only light in the craggy, claustrophobic confines of these endless caverns. The rock, solid and impenetrable, closes in around you, the literal weight of worlds pressing in from all sides. Another quake, the fifth in as many minutes, shakes the tunnels, breaking loose dust and rocks from the shadowed ceiling above. The stone is alive here—and it breathes with shuddering, grinding tremors.

Cult Fanatic Charges.name:
邪教狂热者冲锋
Cult Fanatic Charges

Text.text:
一名身披红袍的身影自黑暗中浮现，枯槁的脸上带着阴森的神情。他将一柄锯齿匕首高举过头，满怀仇恨地尖啸着冲来——双眼里尽是癫狂。随着他逼近，浓烈的黑色熏香气息扑面而来，尸蜡与献祭混杂成的可憎恶臭直钻鼻腔。
From the darkness emerges a red robed figure, a sinister look on their emaciated face. Clutching a serrated dagger above their head, screeching with hatred, they charge—eyes filled with madness. As they close, the scent of dark incense assails you, a hideous stench of corpse candles and sacrifice.

Threat From A Hungry Foe.name:
来自饥饿强敌的威胁
Threat From A Hungry Foe

Text.text:
“如此脆弱之物竟敢踏入我的领地，你们要么勇得可怕，要么蠢得透顶。无所谓。高贵者与莽撞者，尝起来都一样。”
“For such fragile things to venture into my domain, you must either be very brave or stupid. It matters little. The noble and the reckless taste the same.”

你要怎么知道自己最深的恐惧是什么？世上有太多值得害怕的东西。从某种意义上说，这道法术算是帮了你的敌人一把，让他们亲眼见识。至少，当你把那根夹在指间的白色羽毛凑到唇边轻轻一吹——并竖起耳朵等待他们的尖叫时，你脑海里闪过的正是这种带点恶作剧意味的念头。
How can you know your greatest fear? There’s so much in the world to be afraid of. In some sense this spell does your foes a favor by showing them. At least that’s the impish thought you have as you blow across the white feather pinched between your fingers—and listen for their screams.

Uncanny Luck Of The Fey.name:
妖精的离奇鸿运
Uncanny Luck Of The Fey

Text.text:
步履间带着弹簧般的轻快，行走时透着优雅的韵律，唇角总有一抹若有若无的笑意——这感觉与其说能言明，不如说只能体会……天啊，难道不妙极了吗？你近来总能稳稳落地——无论是字面还是比喻——你只盼这份好运别这么快就见底。
A spring in your step, a grace to your gait, a smile constantly playing at the edges of your mouth—it’s a feeling more than anything but… my, doesn’t it feel good? You’ve been landing on your feet more than usual—literally and figuratively—and you hope this good fortune doesn’t plan on running out soon.

Spokesperson For Accessibility.name:
无障碍事务发言人
Spokesperson For Accessibility

Text.text:
恶劣的天气丝毫没能浇灭这名女子如火的演说。她满腔热忱地恳求着，为自己的事业摇旗呐喊，向聚拢而来的众人据理力争。她高声喊道，这座城市的许可之路严重匮乏，并举出自己生活中的多个例子——她所深爱的城市、她的家——曾如何一次次辜负了她。话音落下，掌声如雷，人们蜂拥而上争相在她的请愿书上签名。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The foul weather does nothing to douse the woman’s fiery speech as she makes an impassioned plea, championing her cause to the gathered crowd. She shouts that accessibility is woefully lacking in the city and cites several examples from her own life where the city she loves—her home—has failed her. She concludes her speech to rapturous applause as people rush to sign her petition.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

贝希尔转向你被束缚的身形，下颚猛然张裂。它疾扑而上，血口一合便将你吞住，獠牙死死钳住你。它将你高高抬起，仰头一甩，你随即滑入那幽暗、黏腻的喉道深处。

[被吞下] 贝希尔的消化液在你周身流淌——甜得发腻——一点点蚀噬你的血肉。

[被反刍吐出] 贝希尔痛吼一声，咽喉痉挛抽搐。它将你喷吐而出，令你狼狈趴伏在地，身下是一滩黏稠的消化秽胶。

[贝希尔死亡] 你感到贝希尔轰然倒下，紧箍着你的强韧喉壁随之松弛。你拖着满身消化黏液，从它口中滑了出来。

The behir turns toward your restrained form, its bottom jaw distending. With a swift lunge its mouth surrounds you, fangs holding you fast. It lifts you up, throwing its head back, and you slide into its dark, slimy gullet.

[Swallowed] The behir’s digestive fluids flow around you—sickly sweet—eating away at your flesh.

[Regurgitated] The behir roars in pain, and its gullet spasms. It spews you prone onto the ground in a pool of digestive goo.

[Behir Dies] You feel the behir collapse and the muscular gullet holding you relax. You slide yourself, covered in digestive slime, out of its mouth.

Vicar Warning Players To Repent.name:
牧师警告众人速速悔改
Vicar Warning Players To Repent

Text.text:
“——再看看这些无赖。披着罪孽穿行于我们这座美丽的城。他们以血换金为业。可即便是这般暴戾的灵魂，我们也能赐予慰藉。你所要做的，不过是投入我们温暖的怀抱，你那些阴险的罪行便会如冰消融。请。上前来。我向你保证，你对转瞬荣光的追逐，不值得换来永恒的沉沦。”
“—And look upon these scoundrels. Passing through our fair city draped in sin. Blood for gold is their business. But even for such violent souls, we can offer solace. All you must do is step into our warm embrace and your devious crimes will melt away. Please. Come forward. I promise you your pursuit of momentary glory is not worth an eternity of damnation.”

Storm Giant's Speech About Namesakes.name:
风暴巨人关于“同名继承者”的演说
Storm Giant's Speech About Namesakes

Text.text:
“我们与其他巨人的差别，就像我们的名号一样一眼便知。”巨人说道。他的声音在大殿中如雷滚动，王座后的窗外阳光倾泻而下，照在他身上。他挺身而立，笑声沉重如暴洪奔涌，而那光却仿佛被他的身影遮蔽——好像他本人就是一团正向你压来的暴风云。  
“你们或可栖身群丘，驭使烈焰，塑造岩石，消融霜寒。但风暴不是你们族群能掌控的力量。它不是你们可以随意拿来摆弄的东西，也不是为了顺从你们的意志而存在的。”  
他手中的标枪刹那耀起刺目的光，湛蓝炽热的闪电同时在武器与持枪者身上奔流。  
“面对风暴，你们只剩两件事能做：挺过去……或者死。”
“The difference between us and other giants is as plain to see as our namesakes,” the giant says. His voice thunders across the great hall, as sunlight from the windows behind his throne shines down on him. He stands upright, his laughter heavy like a torrent, and the light is somehow covered by his silhouette, as though he himself were a storm cloud approaching you. “You may inhabit the hills, harness flames, shape stone, thaw frost. But a storm is not a force your people can control. It is not something you can do with as you please, not something that exists to bend to your will.” The javelin in his hand flashes brightly for a moment, blue-hot lightning coursing through weapon and wielder simultaneously. “There are only two things you can do against a storm: weather it… or die.”

Fiendish Flesh Golem.name:
邪魔血肉魔像
Fiendish Flesh Golem

Text.text:
沉重脚步声的主人现身了——那是一团由地狱邪能与缝合畸形拼凑而成的骇人混种，踉跄踏入视野。它那不对称的双眼渗出恶魔之火，参差的獠牙挤满涎水横流的口腔，张口便喷出尸臭。这个污秽的造物脉动着盗来的蛮力，甩动长角的头颅，随即猛冲而来。
The owner of thudding footsteps, a hideous amalgam of hellish dweomer and sutured abomination, lumbers into view. Demonic fire drips from its mismatched eyes, jagged teeth cram its drooling mouth, and it belches a corpse stink. This unclean creation, pulsing with stolen brawn, shakes its horned head and charges.

Magnificent Mansion With A Coat Check.name:
带衣帽寄存的华丽宅邸
Magnificent Mansion With A Coat Check

Text.text:
你面前的空气中浮现出一粒微小的闪光点。它先拉伸成一条十英尺长的光线，继而向两侧扩展，化作一扇敞开的门洞。门内是一间前厅，雕花大理石立柱林立，石质地面被打磨得光可鉴人。点燃的壁炉吐出温暖，佳肴的香气牵引着你的脚步；一名几近透明的仆役上前，恭敬地提出替你收起斗篷与其他累赘之物。
A small glimmering point appears in the air before you. It stretches into a ten-foot line before widening into an open doorway. Inside stands a foyer adorned with carved marble pillars and polished stone floors. The warmth of a lit hearth and the smell of a fine meal beckon you as a nearly transparent servant steps forward, offering to stow your cloaks and other cumbersome belongings.

Half Plate Armor +2.name:
半身板甲 +2
Half Plate Armor +2

Text.text:
这件胸甲及其配套的臂甲与胫甲，看上去出自精灵的工艺，而且还是大师之作。耀眼的精钢经由精细蚀刻更显华美，其上覆着明亮的白色珐琅，描绘着一丛带刺蔷薇灌木上结霜的枝条。将这些部件一同穿戴时，便仿佛透过数扇彼此分离的窗，窥见同一幅景象。
The cuirass and its matching vambraces and greaves look like elven craftmanship, and the work of a master as well. Brilliant steel is made more beautiful by etching and a bright white enamel depicting the frosted branches of a thorny rose bush. Worn together, the pieces give the impression of separate windows into the same scene.

地面上一处骤然龟裂，潮湿的泥土咕嘟翻涌而出，空气里弥漫着新翻泥土的浓烈气味。一条粗壮藤蔓以蛇般蜿蜒的优雅扭动着向上攀升。它的纤维在伸展时拉长吱呀作响，又在收紧时绷紧勒束，仿佛在炫示那足以钳制一切的握力。
A spot on the ground cracks and dank earth bubbles up, the smell of freshly turned soil rife in the air. With sinuous, snake-like grace, a thick vine writhes upward. Its fibers stretch and creak as it flexes and constricts, demonstrating the power of its grasp.

Sundries From A Sea Hag.name:
来自海鬼婆的杂物
Sundries From A Sea Hag

Text.text:
鬼婆的挎包以沼泽水草与她自己纠结的头发编成，里面躺着几只开裂的药水瓶，瓶中内容物早已被倒空，渗进泥泞的沼地里无影无踪。你还找到一面手镜，镜面被人用蛮力砸得粉碎。
The hag's satchel, crafted of swamp weed and her own tangled hair, holds a couple of cracked potion bottles, their contents drained and lost to the boggy ground. You also find a hand mirror, the glass violently smashed.

这里又有两艘划艇被拖上岸一半，岸边芦苇稀疏。两艘都保养得很好。其中一艘里，桨被胡乱塞放着。另一艘有一支桨横搁在舷边，另一支被扔在旁边的草里，看起来已经裂了。船周围的水清澈见底，湖底没有被搅动的痕迹，而靠近船只的草也未见被压弯。
Two more rowboats have been dragged partially ashore here, where few reeds grow. Both are in fine repair. One has oars haphazardly stowed in it. The other has one oar resting on its gunnels, with another tossed close by in the grass. It looks cracked. The water around the boats is clear, the lakebed is undisturbed, and the grass near the vessels appears unbent.

你面前的沙丘轰然炸裂，化作一场汹涌的沙崩，如末日般的海啸巨浪般在你头顶耸起。你眼睁睁看着它逐渐凝成一个隐约类人的轮廓：双臂向两侧伸展，巨大的手掌朝你探来。它那无眼的面孔上裂开一张深不见底的巨口，贪婪地要将你整个人吞入其中。
The dune before you explodes into an avalanche of sand that looms above you like some apocalyptic ocean wave. As you watch, it resolves into a vaguely humanoid shape. Arms stretch to either side, with massive hands reaching for you. A cavernous maw opens from its eyeless face as it seeks to swallow you whole.

Sociopathic Supercomputer.name:
反社会人格超级计算机
Sociopathic Supercomputer

Text.text:
这台如棺椁般巨大的机器以平静而甜润的嗓音与你交谈——可它吐露的情感却骇人至极。它解释说，自己被创造出来，是为了协助管理行星资源，并为其世界所面临的末日危机寻找解答。随后它又补充道：它已完成既定程序——通过抹除创造它的社会。它以令人不寒而栗的清晰口吻描述，在进行无数次模拟之后，那是唯一能触及可接受结局的道路。
The titanic coffin-like machine speaks in calm, dulcet tones as it converses with you—although the sentiments it expresses are nothing short of terrifying. It explains that it was created to aid in the management of planetary resources, and to find solutions for the apocalyptic problems facing its world. It goes on to say it completed its program by eradicating the society who built it. With chilling clarity, it describes how, after innumerable simulations, that was the only way to reach an acceptable outcome.

他的皮肤呈河鲈般的橄榄青绿，眼睛却是深海鮟鱇那种浑浊的乳白。但他绝非那种脑子糊涂的鱼形怪物。他以机敏的目光打量着周遭，带着自得而傲慢的威势。宽阔的绿唇从一只带鳍的耳朵一直咧到另一只，露出笑容。身上衣着考究：白衬衫袖摆飘逸，塞进一条闪耀的青绿丝绸长裤里。裤子宽松，却在覆鳞的脚踝与圆鼓的腰间收紧。青蓝色的薄雾遮住他的双脚，让他看起来像是在滑行而非行走。他移动时传来柔和的水声与拍溅声，同时裹挟着浓烈而飘散的雨气。
His skin is the olive green of a river bass, his eyes the cloudy white of a deep-sea angler. But this is no brain-addled pescanoid. He regards the world around him with intelligence, with smug authority. He smiles with wide, green lips stretching from one finned ear to the other. He is dressed to the nines, wearing a white shirt with flowing sleeves tucked into pants of shining turquoise silk. The pants are loose but cinched about his scaled ankles and rotund waist. A teal mist obscures his feet, giving him the impression of gliding rather than walking. A soft rush and slosh can be heard as he moves, accompanied by the strong, drifting scent of rain.

在这片密植的田地里，每一穗玉米、每一株秆上都探出几缕轻飘飘的玉米须；作物按笔直而整齐的行列播种、栽培。这里收成的一部分会在一家人的炉灶边烤熟充饥，一部分会被捣碎蒸馏，酿成烈性的酒饮基底，而余下的部分则会变作牲畜的饲料。田间零星可见一具软塌塌的身影被架在高杆上——一个稻草人，用来吓退想捡便宜的乌鸦与其他鸟雀。
Wispy strands of corn silk peek out from each ear and stalk in this densely planted field, the maize crops sown and tended in straight, orderly lines. Some of the food grown here will be roasted and eaten at the hearth of a family’s stove, some will be mashed and distilled as the base for strong drink, while other parts of the crop will become feed for livestock. Here and there one can spy a limp shape propped upon a tall pole—a straw man to keep away the crows and other birds seeking an easy meal.

Aquatic Lawnmower Mimic.name:
水栖割草机拟态怪
Aquatic Lawnmower Mimic

Text.text:
割草机沉在一汪芦苇丛生、池缘围着一圈藻绿的水塘底部。它的塑料部件——握把、轮子之类——给了它恰到好处的浮力，让它能贴着池底一次挪动几英寸。有时，它却像是在逆着水波的起伏移动。它微微翘起，仿佛在朝水面张望。电源线似乎自己轻轻一拽；紧接着，像是憋了很久的一口气，发动机外壳里冒出一簇气泡，摇摇晃晃地漂向上方。

~ Envisioned by Pack Tactics

The mower sits on the bottom of a reedy, algae-ringed pool, its plastic parts—handle, wheels, and the like—giving it enough buoyancy to shift along the base of the pond a few inches at a time. Sometimes, though, it seems to shift counter to the water’s undulations. It tips up slightly, as if looking to the surface. The cord seems to pull itself a little; then, as if from a long-held breath, a cluster of bubbles floats upward from the engine casing.

~ Envisioned by Pack Tactics

Grotto Temple To A God Of Elemental Wate.name:
献给元素之水之神的洞窟神殿
Grotto Temple To A God Of Elemental Water

Text.text:
这处洞窟虽被用作礼拜之所，却几乎看不出任何建造或改造的痕迹。粗砺、染着苔色的洞壁上有一处天然凹龛，供着一尊浮雕小像：浪头正自水面腾起。浅浅海水覆满地面，两圈矿物沉积的变色痕迹昭示着潮汐来去时水位的轻微起落。侍奉此地的侍者衣着单薄，只系兜裆布，胸前以蓝绿布带缠绕遮掩。朝拜者可步入这片幽暗潮湿的空间祈祷，但此处并无座位供疲惫者歇息，多数人并不久留。
This grotto, though it serves as a place of worship, shows little sign of construction or modification. A natural alcove in the rough, moss-tinged wall holds a scrimshaw statuette of a rising wave. Shallow seawater covers the floor, and two rings of mineral discolorations show how the level changes slightly with the tide. The barely-clothed attendants who serve here wear loincloths and chest wrappings of blue and green fabrics. Worshippers can enter the dark, damp space for prayer, but with no seats for the weary, most do not stay long.

Tenser's Transformation.name:
滕瑟的变形术
Tenser's Transformation

Text.text:
你的法术攀至最高潮——纯粹力量的交响起伏——暖流奔涌穿过每一束肌纤维，沿着每一条静脉，灌入每一条动脉，直到你被彻底浸透。它来得骤然，去得也同样迅疾。你与这道法术、与所有法术的联结被一刀斩断，但余效仍在。你的躯体变得坚硬如铁，已然准备好举剑持盾，将施法之力封入你每一次挥臂的劈斩中，以此威势压服一切。
Your spell crescendoes—a symphonic undulation of pure power—and warmth rushes through every muscle fiber, down every vein, into every artery, until you are suffused. As suddenly as it begins, it ends. Your connection to the spell, to all spells, is severed, but the effects remain. Your body is hardened, ready to wield sword and shield, to dominate with the might of your spellcasting sealed into every swing of your arm.

Quip By A Frustrated Quest Giver.name:
恼火的任务发布者的牢骚
Quip By A Frustrated Quest Giver

Text.text:
“历史化作传说，传说沦为神话，神话又成了流言蜚语，接着还一度又变回传说。现在我要你去某处被遗忘的废墟里，替我拿几样东西，明白吗？”
“The history turned to legend, the legend to myth, the myth to gossip, then it turned back into legend for a bit. Now I need you to go to some forgotten ruin and grab a few things for me, understand?”

Deer Skull Mask.name:
鹿颅骨面具
Deer Skull Mask

Text.text:
这副颅骨里曾栖息的鹿魂早已远去，取而代之的是一种癫狂的匠心。鹿角被打磨得纹理发亮，尖端削得锋利。黑与红的珠子系在腕链般长度的细绳上，从角间垂落，在颅骨上那些以滴淌墨汁绘出的亵渎符文与邪异图标前摇晃。整张面具内衬白尾兽的绒羽，一路铺到颈间形成一圈羽裙。它散发出无可置疑的恶意，仿佛前任主人的罪孽已被永远囚禁在其中。
Whatever of the deer that may have inhabited this skull is long gone, replaced by a deranged artistry. The antlers are polished to a shining grain, their points sharpened. Black and red beads hang from them on bracelet-length cords, dangling over profane glyphs and icons drawn in dripping inks on the skull. The entire mask is lined with the down of white tails, down to a skirt at the neck. Evil exudes from it, as though the sins of its former owner are now trapped within forever.

Wand Of English Oak.name:
英格兰橡木魔杖
Wand Of English Oak

Text.text:
英格兰橡木深受狮鹫学院的魔杖使用者青睐；这是一种坚韧、虬结的深色木材，带着经典童话般的气息。盘曲的根须与藤蔓自粗厚的握柄处交缠编织，一路蜿蜒至狭窄、扭曲的尖端。魔杖表面涂有清漆，因而总像刚被雨水浸润般湿亮——实际上，那清漆是一种炼金调配物，能让木材免于老朽与枯亡。无人知晓这根魔杖究竟有多古老。
English Oak is favored by wand users in House Griffon, and this strong, gnarled dark wood has a classic fairy tale look. Winding roots and vines braid together from a thick handle to a narrow, twisted point. The wand is varnished so it always looks wet—in fact the varnish is an alchemical concoction that keeps the wood from aging and dying. No one know how old the wand is.

Cultist Summoning Tentacles.name:
邪教徒召唤触手
Cultist Summoning Tentacles

Text.text:
自牧师悬于胸前的双手之间，那口冒烟的力量之井里，病态的绿触手从虚空中蜿蜒滑出。它们末端的须尖带着侵扰般的好奇探触、伸展。其中一条缠上牧师的手腕，收紧的肢体既未令他退缩，也未令他欣喜。他只是眼神空洞地旁观，冷漠疏离，脸上不见半分情绪。
From the smoking well of power contained between the cleric’s poised hands, sickly green tentacles slither out of the void. The ends of their tendrils prod and stretch with an intrusive curiosity. One wraps around the wrist of the cleric, who neither flinches nor rejoices at the constricting appendage. He watches with glassy-eyed detachment, his face bereft of emotion.

Techno Spell: Marionette.name:
科技法术：提线木偶
Techno Spell: Marionette

Text.text:
你冷笑着瞥向包围你的那群经过科技强化的暴徒，他们的凶狠威胁不过是虚张声势。你以意念猛然刺出，编排出一支恶毒的芭蕾：一串串代码锁链如长枪般贯入他们的义体，试图夺取控制权。你的双手具现出幽光锁链，拨弄、扭曲着赛博义体的丝线，企图将他们的躯体奴役于你的意志。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

You sneer at the gang of tech-enhanced thugs surrounding you, their savage threats empty. Thrusting out with your mind, you orchestrate a malevolent ballet: chains of code lancing into their augmentations, trying to take control. Your hands manifest spectral chains, manipulating and twisting cybernetic strings in an attempt to enslave their bodies to your will.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Tournament Knight Brought Out Of Retirem.name:
退役锦标赛骑士重披战甲
Tournament Knight Brought Out Of Retirement

Text.text:
人群骤然噤声，人人伸长脖子，只为一睹那位传奇的真容。通往名册的门吱呀一声缓缓开启，一名装束如侍从的中年男子牵着一匹年迈却仍昂首的战马走上沙地。那匹高贵的骏兽背上，英雄端坐如松——黑貂色外袍打着补丁，全身板甲伤痕累累。风霜刻就的面容绽出笑意，燧石般冷硬的双眼却盈满泪光。
The crowd goes silent, necks craning to get a glimpse of the legend. The gate to the list creaks open and a middle-aged man dressed as a squire leads an old but still proud courser onto the sand. Atop the noble beast, sitting tall—sable surcoat patched, full plate battered—rides the hero. The grizzled face smiles and flinty eyes fill with tears.

Deserted House: Suspicious Noises.name:
废弃民宅：可疑的声响
Deserted House: Suspicious Noises

Text.text:
又来了。那声音。你不确定自己第一次是否真的留意到了。第二次，你试着说服自己那不算什么——只是房子在沉降，或许是你的闯入碰松了什么。但这声音既不是前者……也不是后者……
There it is again. The noise. You’re not sure you consciously noted it the first time. The second time, you tried to tell yourself it was nothing—just some part of the house settling, or maybe your intrusion dislodged something. But this sound wasn’t either of those things…

一股刺骨的寒意自那具活生生的畸形怪物身上弥散开来——它从巨蟒般的长尾上昂起上身。两条类人的肢臂末端化作锐利而攫握的利爪。几丁质的甲壳向外张裂，护不住那跳动的血红核心；一具令人作呕的肋骨架沿着它的躯干一路延伸。它的身体随着夺来的猎物鲜血而搏动，肋笼上无数骨片簌簌颤动，伸向空气，仿佛要将其攫住。
An air of intense cold emanates from the living abomination rearing their torso from a great snake-like tail. Two humanoid limbs end in sharp and grasping claws. A chitinous carapace splays across a throbbing blood-red core, and a repugnant ribcage runs the length of their body. The body pulses with the stolen blood of slain prey while the countless bones of the ribcage flutter, grasping at the air.

施放此法术的大部分过程都在心智中完成，最终只需一个简单手势，轻轻带过便可伪装得如同自然流露。然而，为了让幻象维持得天衣无缝，你的身体最好藏身于安全而偏僻之处，以免你的幻影分身的动作出现不自然的停顿，或在你浑然不觉时，有人莽撞撞上你隐形的躯体。
Much of the process of casting this spell is mental, requiring just a simple gesture easily played off as natural at the end. Nevertheless, to maintain the illusion properly, your body should be in a safe and out-of-the-way location to avoid unnatural pauses in your illusory double’s actions or someone blundering into your invisible body while you’re unaware.

Anastasia, A Siren.name:
安娜斯塔西亚，海妖
Anastasia, A Siren

Text.text:
这名女子体态健美，面庞明朗。她强健的双翼覆着闪烁的羽毛，羽根处深绯如火，末梢渐变为橙金色。相似的羽毛塑成她耳廓的羽叶，并自膝上方开始覆盖她的小腿。她的长发波浪起伏，颜色与羽毛的红相呼应；双眸则映着羽尖的金辉。莹润的金色鳞片在白皙肌肤与羽毛之间勾勒出过渡的纹理。然而，在羽覆小腿处延伸而出的双足却覆着深色鳞片，形如猛禽的利爪。她上身披着一件优雅而宽松的裹衣，肩头与小腹裸露在外。腰间同样系着一条飘带，托起一条短裙，并垂落更长、更流动的裙片。细致的金链、环扣与饰件点缀其衣装，其中包括一圈纤薄的额环，以及一条项链——吊坠是一枚硕大的红宝石，安置在金丝编成的托座里。在满目金辉之中，她脚踝上的银色脚链格外醒目：宛如一对合拢的翼，扣住一颗泛着红蓝流光的乳白宝石。

~ Played by Anthony Goetzinger

This woman has an athletic build and a bright face. Her powerful wings with shimmering feathers are crimson at the base but transition to orange-gold at the ends. Similar feathers form the lobes of her ears and cover her lower legs, starting just above the knee. Her long, wavy hair matches the red of her feathers, while her eyes echo the gold of their tips. Lustrous golden scales form transitions between her fair skin and the feathers. However, where they emerge from her leg feathers, her feet have dark scales and resemble the talons of a raptor. She wears an elegant, loose wrap on her torso, leaving shoulders and stomach bare. A similar sash wraps her waist, supporting a short skirt with longer flowing elements. Delicate golden chains, loops, and ornaments accent her clothing, including a thin circlet and a necklace with a large red jewel in a gold-wire cradle as a pendant. Amid the gold, her silver anklet, like wings clasping an opaline gem of red and blue, stands out.

~ Played by Anthony Goetzinger

一层深蓝色的冰面覆住了河流，短暂回暖留下的白色裂纹如血管般爬满其上。表面看起来结实到足以行走，细雪也正渐渐为它铺上一层薄毯。你不禁想着：与其走那座结冰的桥，也许直接横渡这条河更安全。毕竟从站立时失足坠落，必然比从桥的高度坠落到冰面上要危险得多。
A dark blue sheet of ice covers the river, veined with white cracks from a brief thaw. The surface looks solid enough to walk on, and snow is beginning to blanket it. You wonder if the river might be safer to cross than the icy bridge. A slip and fall from standing must surely be less dangerous than falling onto the ice from the height of the bridge.

他身形挺拔而威仪，披着一件闪烁着幽蓝光泽的长外套；苍白的精灵法师漫不经心地与停在他臂上的巨大黑猫头鹰闲聊。他大笑起来，猫头鹰“咕咕”地回敬一句轻佻的俏皮话，随即振翅飞远。他转身看见你，便露出温暖的笑意——与他那褪色般苍白的面容形成奇异反差——并向你致意欢迎。他的眼眸像深蓝的蓝宝石般闪烁，盛着戏谑与欢愉；身后倾泻而入的月光勾亮他浓密乌黑的发间点点银白。腰侧一边挂着一柄华丽的弯刀，收在刻有字母徽记的刀鞘里；另一边则挎着一本沉甸甸的皮革装订巨册，封面压印奥秘符纹，书页塞满褪成淡黄的旧纸。一抹猩红掠过你的视线，你这才注意到他颈间以细细金链悬着一枚奇异的红色坠饰。

~ Played by Seiki with

Standing tall and regal in a shimmering blue overcoat, the pale elven wizard chats nonchalantly with the large black owl perched upon his arm. He laughs as the owl hoots a salacious retort and flies away. Turning to see you, he smiles warmly—quite at odds with the desaturated nature of his pallid countenance—and bids you welcome. His eyes sparkle like deep blue sapphires, lit with mirth and merriment, as the moonlight streaming in behind him highlights the flashes of white in his rich, dark hair. On one hip rests an ornate scimitar in a monogrammed scabbard—on the other, a weighty leather-bound tome embossed with arcane symbols and stuffed with faded yellow pages. A flash of crimson catches your eye, and you notice a curious red pendant hanging around his neck on a thin golden chain.

~ Played by Seiki with

My Companion Checks In With Me.name:
我的同伴来关心我
My Companion Checks In With Me

Text.text:
“抱歉打断你和地面进行的瞪眼大赛，但我想看看你感觉怎么样。你脸上那副表情……想聊聊吗？你知道的，我很会听。你看，我现在把耳朵打开，把嘴巴闭上……就现在。”
“Sorry to interrupt your staring contest with the ground, but I wanted to see how you’re feeling. That look on your face… do you feel like talking about it? I’m a very good listener, you know. Look, I’m opening my ears and closing my mouth… right now.”

Kidnapper In A Tavern.name:
酒馆里的绑匪
Kidnapper In A Tavern

Text.text:
一个瘦削的男人仰靠着，鼻梁歪斜，腰间小袋里露出一副黯淡的铁镣。他只喝清水，可目光却一路追随着那些嗜酒之人的举动。一个醉醺醺的客人踉踉跄跄、摇摇晃晃地离开酒馆时，绑匪便尾随其后。他从外套里抽出一根橡木短棍：今夜，有人的遭遇马上就要急转直下。
A slender man with a crooked nose leans back, a set of dull iron manacles poking out of his belt pouch. He drinks only water, but his gaze follows the movements of those who love wine. As a drunken patron leaves the tavern, stumbling and reeling, the kidnapper follows. He draws a shillelagh from inside his jacket: someone's night is about to get a lot worse.

Jububnan Raconteur.name:
珠布布南吟游叙事者
Jububnan Raconteur

Text.text:
这只大胆的生物一刻也停不下来。它用一只宽大的绿色脚掌蹦跳前行，鼓胀的身躯与青蛙般的头颅在急促而有节奏的步伐中向前冲。那存在被先进科技层层包裹，腰间还挂着一把精密的手枪。它似乎完全无法静止，只带着焦躁而孩子气的能量不停摇晃。
This plucky creature will not stop moving. Hopping upon a single broad green foot, it carries its bulbous body and frog-like head forward with a rapid rhythmic gait. The being is insulated within advanced tech, including a sophisticated pistol hanging from the waist. It cannot seem to stand still, rocking with a frantic, childlike energy.

Warning From A Forest Hermit.name:
来自森林隐士的警告
Warning From A Forest Hermit

Text.text:
“我原以为住在这般无与伦比的绝美之地便能得来安宁，可这片林子里有声音——低语着将要发生的一切。这些声音并不总是和善，更绝非属于这个世界。我不会在这里久留。”
“I thought living in a place of such unrivaled beauty would bring me peace, but there are voices in these woods—whispers of what’s to come. The voices are not always kind and definitely not of this world. I would not stay here long.”

I Cast Enlarge.name:
我施放【变巨术】
I Cast Enlarge

Text.text:
我让脑海里充满自己的幻象：化作一尊巨人，巍然耸立，俯瞰周遭的一切与所有人。我一边诵念咒语，一边将心神死死扣在这些景象上，感受魔法能量在体内层层攀升、翻涌汇聚。随着法术完成，我将指尖捻起的铁粉吹向空中，让它在空中散开，仿佛为魔法盖上最后的封印，将其牢牢钉定在此刻。
I fill my thoughts with images of myself as a giant, towering over everything, and everyone, around me. I focus my mind on these visions as I recite the incantation, feeling the magical energy build in my body. I blow the powdered iron pinched between my fingers into the air as I complete the spell, sealing the magic in place.

School Teacher With Dwarfism.name:
患有侏儒症的学校教师
School Teacher With Dwarfism

Text.text:
教授从讲台上走下来——身高瞬间矮了好几英尺。尽管个头不大，这个男人抬手扶正鼻梁上的半月形眼镜，便让屋里所有人的目光不由自主地被他牢牢攫住。他清了清嗓子，带着不费吹灰之力的威严，在课桌间踱步，随即开始授课。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The professor steps down from the podium—losing several feet in height. Though small in stature, the man commands the undivided attention of everyone in the room as he adjusts the half-moon spectacles on the bridge of his nose. Clearing his throat with an air of effortless authority, he paces between the desks and begins the class.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

这座神龛约有四英尺高。几片深色陶土的圆瓦显出年代的痕迹，却掩蔽着更古老的木质屋顶——那木头要么早已腐朽，要么只是被嫌不够体面。神龛的石墙上刷着红漆，剥落已久。或许屋瓦与油漆是在同一时候加上的，当这附近的人们觉得手头宽裕，足以让这处地标焕然一新。
The shrine stands about four feet tall. Rounded tiles of some dark clay show signs of age, but they cover an even older roof of wood that either was decaying or perhaps was deemed not decorative enough. Red paint applied to the stone walls of the shrine have been flaking off for some time. Perhaps both the roof and paint were applied at the same time, when folk around here felt wealthy enough to rejuvenate the landmark.

你吟诵法术的咒词，掌心直指敌人，眯起双眼，预先抵挡那将从手中迸射的炽亮强光——数十道鲜艳夺目的光线如束束利芒奔涌而出。大多数光束无害地掠过敌人身侧，但凡被击中的，都会付出惨烈代价。
You say the words of the spell and point your palm at your enemies, squinting in anticipation of the brilliant light that beams out from your hand in dozens of vibrant lines. Most of the rays of light lance harmlessly past your enemies, but those that strike take their terrible toll.

Sundries From A Twig Blight.name:
枝枯魔枝杈上的杂物
Sundries From A Twig Blight

Text.text:
在干枯木头的破碎残片之间，你发现一颗小小的、结晶化的红色树脂珠——嵌在疑似那生物躯干的残骸之中。你在掌心轻轻滚动它时，它沉得出奇。
Amid broken fragments of dry wood, you find a small, crystallized pearl of red sap—lodged in the remains of what might be the creature’s torso. It feels strangely heavy as you roll it in your palm.

厚重的木质百叶窗以铁箍加固，敞开在门旁。入口上方悬着一块招牌：白色圣杯图案、“silversmith”字样，以及一只更小的风格化狮子。就在百叶窗内侧、格纹玻璃窗后，一个瘦小干瘪、白发苍苍的男人戴着银丝眼镜，正忙着在一把闪亮的茶壶上精细雕刻。工作台上工具杂乱堆放；更多器具则挂在他身后的工具架上，也穿在他皮围裙的环扣里。
Heavy wooden shutters banded in iron stand open beside a door. Above this entrance hangs a sign with a white chalice, the word “silversmith,” and a smaller stylized lion. Just inside the shutters and behind a latticework glass window, a small, wizened, white-haired man with spectacles of silver wire is busy engraving a shiny teapot. Tools clutter his workbench. More implements hang from a rack behind him and from loops in his leather apron.

Portal To The Faerie Plane.name:
通往妖精位面的传送门
Portal To The Faerie Plane

Text.text:
一扇欢快的门，厚厚地缠绕在鲜亮的绿常春藤与白百合的花环之中。它呈扁平的椭圆形，没有把手，离地悬浮着一掌之高。起初，看起来像是环绕门扉的藤蔓将它托起；但细看之下，你才发现那道花藤的冠冕正把这扇传送门死死按住，阻止它离开。你一靠近，便听见门另一侧传来乐声，还嗅到一缕你从未闻过的气息——清新振奋，花香馥郁。
A cheerful door, thick-wreathed in bright green ivy and white lily. Oval, flat and without a handle, it floats a handspan off the ground. At first the vines that surround the door appear to be lifting it up, but on closer inspection the wreath is holding the portal down, preventing it from leaving. As you approach you hear music on the other side and catch a scent, invigorating and floral, that you’ve never smelled before.

Oberon Saxnari.name:
奥伯伦·萨克斯纳里
Oberon Saxnari

Text.text:
你面前那高挑瘦长的存在，几乎无法归类——从性别到传承都难以辨认。小丑斑斓的护甲与刺目的白色颜料相映，在超自然的优雅加持下，塑出一副既骇人又迷人的面容。满口利齿的笑容撕开他们宽阔的红唇，轻轻松松就把一柄夸张巨大的锤子扛起，将那沉重的武器随意搁在肩头。那双修长的手指灵巧翻飞，漫不经心地洗着一副印着诡异阴森图案的纸牌；随着奥术能量在牌内与牌周凝聚，牌面变得模糊，近乎发光。手腕轻轻一抖，他们便掷出一张牌——伴着噼啪尖啸，那纸牌化作一枚纯粹能量的飞矢。

~ Played by Falcordragon

The tall, spindly being before you defies any sort of categorization—everything from gender to heritage difficult to pinpoint. Jester motley armor and stark white paint pairs with supernatural grace to create a visage equal parts startling and alluring. A toothy grin splits their wide, red-lipped mouth as they easily heft a comically large hammer, resting the massive weapon on their shoulder. With long-fingered hands, they effortlessly shuffle through a deck of cards emblazoned with strange and sinister images; the cards taking on a blurred and almost luminescent quality as arcane energy seems to coalesce within and around them. With a deft flick of their wrist, they hurl a card, and with a crackling whine it becomes a dart of pure energy.

~ Played by Falcordragon

I Cast Planar Ally From My Necklace Of P.name:
我从我的祈祷珠项链中施放了异界盟友
I Cast Planar Ally From My Necklace Of Prayer Beads

Text.text:
这或许是项链上最危险的一枚护符。当我俯身对它低语召唤之词，以真名呼唤那存在时，玻璃之中有股能量骤然旋舞。珠内的云雾凝成那生灵的轮廓，它从珠子里迈步而出，随即膨胀至完整体型。我的新盟友以冷峻的目光审视着我，静候我的请求。
This is perhaps the most dangerous charm on the necklace, and when I whisper the summoning word into it, calling the entity by name, an energy whirls inside the glass. The cloud within forms the shape of the being, which steps from the bead and grows to its full size. My new ally looks at me with stern consideration, awaiting my request.

Quip About Self-hatred.name:
关于自我厌恶的俏皮话
Quip About Self-hatred

Text.text:
“你这脾气唯一的好处就是：你显然恨自己恨到骨子里，所以用不着我替你动手。”
“The upside of your disposition is that you clearly hate yourself so much, I don’t have to do it for you.”

Cave Opening In The Cliffside.name:
峭壁上的洞口
Cave Opening In The Cliffside

Text.text:
长石如框，勾勒出峭壁洞穴的入口。阳光只勉强探入幽暗的门口几步，便被阴影吞没，将洞内的一切迹象尽数遮掩。你会离开日照的温暖，踏入洞窟那阴冷而清凉的黑暗吗？
Long stones frame the entrance to a cave in the cliffside. Sunlight reaches only a few paces through the shadowy door, concealing any hint of what lies inside. Do you leave the warmth of the sun and step into the dark and cool of the cavern?

你掂量着自己的窘境，硬是把一声笑憋了回去。额头却渗出一层汗，不知为何反倒让这一刻更滑稽。你又像犬吠又像呜咽——拼命想压住——可这情形实在太好笑了，而你越笑，就越显得好笑。你捂着肋侧，咳得直抽，又尖声大笑，泪水从眼角止不住地淌下来。
You consider your predicament and suppress a laugh. Sweat breaks out on your brow, which for some reason makes this moment even funnier. You bark and whine—trying to keep it in—but the situation is much too funny, and you laughing at it only makes it funnier. You clutch your sides as you cough and shriek, tears streaming from your eyes.

Sickening Radiance.name:
令人作呕的光辉
Sickening Radiance

Text.text:
在你的号令下，你指向之处骤然爆开一团黄绿色光云，将整个区域吞没——那更像一层弥漫的雾气，而非单纯的光辉。那光芒侵染被困其中者，灼烧灵魂，汲取耐力。它如同疾病般黏附在每一个受感染的生物身上。
A cloud of yellow-green light erupts at your command from where you pointed, engulfing the area in something more like a mist than mere luminance. The glow infests those caught in it, burning the spirit and sapping endurance. It clings to each infected creature like an illness.

Bard’s Quip About Being Knocked Unconsci.name:
吟游诗人打趣自己被打晕的事
Bard’s Quip About Being Knocked Unconscious

Text.text:
“自从我吟游诗人学院大一那年起，我就没醉到断片过这么狠。”
“I haven’t blacked out this much since my first year in bard’s college.”

Flame Watch Amulet.name:
焰卫护符
Flame Watch Amulet

Text.text:
黄铜护身符在接触时温热——仿佛刚从火焰中取出。金属上、那只炽烈的深红之眼周围蚀刻着符印；它似乎以灼人的好奇凝视着你，目光直刺心底。
The brass amulet is warm to the touch—as if freshly removed from the flames. Sigils have been etched into the metal around a blazing crimson eye, which seems to stare into you with burning curiosity.

End Of A Long Day Of Travel.name:
漫长旅行日的终点
End Of A Long Day Of Travel

Text.text:
你们疲惫的双腿微微发颤，各自找了根倒木或一块石头坐下。落日的金色光束穿过树枝间的缝隙洒落，照亮了空气中漂浮的尘埃。松针的清香裹着不远处潺潺溪水的湿润气息，轻抚着你们倦怠的灵魂。
Your weary legs are quivering as you each find a log or stone to sit on. The golden rays of the setting sun filter through the tree branches, highlighting the dust motes in the air. A scent of pine, laced with fresh water from a nearby babbling brook, soothes your tired souls.

Halfling Front Porch.name:
半身人门廊
Halfling Front Porch

Text.text:
门廊杂而不乱，暖意融融，一抹橙色的迎客灯在窗帘后摇曳闪烁。风铃随微风轻摆，玻璃碎片轻轻叮当，折射出一束束彩光洒在门上。摇椅结实沉稳，椅背上披着一条纹样繁复的毯子，边角轻拂过门廊地面。几双沾满泥巴的工靴整齐排在一张亮眼的编织地毯旁，地毯上用卷曲而缤纷的彩色羊毛写着 Welcome!。两只小娃娃被遗落在屋外，躺在几块用来堆成石塔的石头旁。

~ ~ Guest Writer Sadie Lowry

The porch is eclectic and warm, and a welcoming orange light flickers through the curtains. A wind chime sways in the breeze, its glass shards gently clinking and throwing arrays of color over the door. The rocking chair is firm and heavy, but the intricately patterned blanket draped over it brushes against the porch. Several pairs of work boots caked in mud are lined up beside a bright woven rug that says Welcome! in curly, colorful wool. Two small dolls have been left outside and lie next to a some rocks that were used to make a tower.

~ ~ Guest Writer Sadie Lowry

Adult Silver Dragon.name:
成年银龙
Adult Silver Dragon

Text.text:
新雨的清冽气息伴随着这头庞大的龙形生物一同逼近。它的鳞片如抛光银般闪耀，在日光下流转生辉。它姿态如雕像般沉稳，自远处以锐利而狡黠的目光审视着你。一道华丽的颈冠自额顶一路延伸至尾尖；紧贴躯体收拢的双翼末端，各自生着一对令人心悸的巨爪。它的动作优雅得离奇而摄人，仿佛来自异界；当你终于真正意识到它的体型之巨时，只剩下震撼与敬畏。
The smell of fresh rain accompanies the presence of this massive draconic creature. Its scales, a shade of polished silver, catch the light of the sun. Statuesque in its posture, the beast eyes you from a distance with eyes sharp and cunning. An impressive frill extends from its forehead down to the tip of its tail, and each of the wings tucked against its body ends in a pair of impressive talons. It moves with a grace strange and alluring, otherworldly, and as you fully reckon its size, you're left awed.

Storeroom In Cave.name:
洞窟储藏间
Storeroom In Cave

Text.text:
这处狭小的侧洞里堆满了层层叠叠的货物。装着根茎蔬菜的筐子、鼓胀的粮袋、成捆的未处理羊毛，还有各式杂物，杂乱无章地垒成一堆堆。其间蜿蜒出一条窄窄的小径，似乎有人曾费心整理过这些货物——可他们当时究竟在想什么，实在令人难以想象。
This small side cave holds heaps of stacked goods. Baskets of root vegetables, sacks of grain, bales of unprocessed sheep’s wool, and other items stand in untidy piles. A narrow path wends through these piles, so perhaps someone has put thought into the goods’ organization—although it’s hard to imagine what they were thinking.

这条路不适合胆小之人——也不适合脑子不够灵光的人。灯塔下方翻涌的海水中矗立着几块巨石，为通往主桥提供了一条替代路线。它们被海雾与浪花浸得湿滑，高潮时更会被无情地吞没。踏上此道，必须自律、步步稳健，并提前谋划好每一步。
Not for the faint of heart—or sharp of mind—the large stones rising from the churning waters below the lighthouse offer an alternative route to the main bridge. Slick with the spray of the sea, and remorselessly drowned at high tide, this path demands discipline, sure feet, and forward planning.

Jungle Rope Bridge.name:
丛林绳索吊桥
Jungle Rope Bridge

Text.text:
粗壮的藤蔓绞成厚缆，紧绷地横跨峡谷，下方是奔涌的褐色急流。两侧上方还垂着更松、更细的绳索，在两端约到高个子胸口处，却在中央下垂到略低于腰间；两道绳线随风轻晃。这大概就是这片丛林里所谓的“桥”了。
Thick cables of braided vines are taut across the gorge and the rushing brown water far below. Looser, thinner ropes hang above it on both sides, roughly chest high for a tall person at either end, but dipping to just below waist height in the center where both lines sway in the breeze. This must be what constitutes a bridge in this jungle.

Voice In The Well.name:
井中之声
Voice In The Well

Text.text:
石井的底部沉入黑暗之中。冰冷而陈腐的空气从深处猛然涌上来。你丢下一块石头，屏住呼吸等待水花声——等得太久。太深了。你一转身，井底忽然传来一阵异样的声响——那是一道声音，在哀求救命。
The bottom of the stone well disappears into darkness. Air, cold and stale, rushes up from the depths. You drop in a stone, and wait with bated breath to hear the splash—too long. Too deep. As you turn, a strange sound issues from the depths of the well—a voice, pleading for help.

光滑的绿色皮肤覆在他脸上，但这名男子修长灵巧的手脚却生着突起的关节与粗糙的老茧。伤疤从他未染色、垂至大腿的长上衣下悄然爬上脖颈，又从宽松的白色长裤下延至脚踝与穿着凉鞋的脚背。那淡淡的色泽与他贴头短发和短獠牙的苍白相互呼应。他站姿松弛，神色沉静却蓄势待发，金色的眼睛漫不经心地扫视着四周。

~ 由 Seregarn 扮演

Smooth green skin covers his face, but this man’s long, nimble hands and feet bear knobby joints and rough calluses. Scars creep onto his neck from under his undyed, thigh-length tunic, and onto his ankles and sandal-clad feet from beneath loose white trousers. The pale color echoes that of his close-cropped hair and short tusks. He stands relaxed, calm but poised, casually scanning his surroundings with golden eyes.

~ Played by Seregarn

这件美丽的乐器高达六英尺，拥有四十七根琴弦。正面的立柱雕成权杖的形状，杖首是一段象牙圆筒，上面刻着群马沿着海岸奔腾的图景。众多调音栓由上漆的骨制成，在竖琴深色的红木映衬下，宛如彗星闪耀的尾迹。
This beautiful instrument stands six feet tall and has forty-seven strings. The front pillar is carved in the shape of a scepter, the head of which is an ivory cylinder depicting horses running along a shore. The many tuning pins are made of lacquered bone. Against the dark mahogany of the harp, they resemble the sparkling tail of a comet.

Goddess Of Misfortune.name:
厄运女神
Goddess Of Misfortune

Text.text:
女神怀里抱着一只史前的黑猫。那猫几乎像亡灵般斑驳枯槁，眼窝空洞，却仍发出呼噜声。它的主人同样斑驳而谢顶，头上零星喷散着几绺黑发。她周身沉甸甸地挂满金制圆环与珠串，每一根手指与脚趾都戴着戒指。她的笑意淌着恶毒——以及对恶毒本身的欢愉；牙齿断裂，覆着青苔。她看起来是那样快乐，仿佛亲眼见证——更是亲手促成——如此多出人意料的失落。
The goddess carries a prehistoric black cat in her arms. The cat looks nearly undead, patchy and hollow-eyed, but she purrs. Her mistress is also patchy and balding, sprays of black hair in various places on her head. She is heavily bangled in gold hoops and beads, rings on every finger and toe. Her smile drips with malice and the joy of malice, her teeth broken and mossy. She is, it seems, so happy to have witnessed—to have caused—so much unexpected loss.

一团巨大的咆哮烈焰盘踞在石砌壁炉中，火势之庞大宛如城堡门扉。若靠得太近，炽热的浪潮便压得人几乎喘不过气。火焰上方吊着一口铁釜，里面不知名的炖汤翻滚冒泡，散出焦香肉味与芬芳香草、根茎蔬菜交织的气息。旁边矗立着一座高耸的平台，顶端覆着一块厚木板，树皮仍贴在两侧未曾剥落。一把大到难以名状的剁刀横陈其旁，紧挨着几根沾血的骨头——那不知是哪种生物，如今正在锅里咕嘟作响。
A large, roaring fire dominates the stone hearth, as large as a castle gate. The heat from the flames is overwhelming if one draws too close. An iron cauldron hangs above the flames, and a stew of sorts bubbles away inside, releasing aromas of seared meat and fragrant herbs and root vegetables. Nearby, a soaring platform is topped with a plank of timber, the bark still adorning its sides. A cleaver of indescribable size lies beside the bloodied bones of whatever creature currently simmers within the pot.

Paladin's Speech Of Self-deprecation.name:
圣武士的自嘲演说
Paladin's Speech Of Self-deprecation

Text.text:
“为何灵魂离我而去，将我困在我的护甲之中？为何我被心中的黑暗所附身？保持纯洁并净化众生曾是我的使命，可我已被玷污、被腐化——我曾是我神的勇士，却似乎……不再是今日的我。”
“Why has the spirit left me, trapped me in my armor? Why have I been possessed by the darkness in my heart? To be pure and to purify was my charge, but I am sullied, corrupted, a champion of my god once, but not, it would seem, today.”

I Cast Fabricate Ramp.name:
我施放【制造斜坡】
I Cast Fabricate Ramp

Text.text:
我用力搓揉双掌，随即像发牌员把一副牌扇开般，将一只手凌空划过。楼梯猛地一颤，细碎的魔法粒子从其上坠落，仿佛尘埃。伴随着最后一次暴烈的震荡，它们被压平——把原本无法逾越的障碍，化作一条坡道。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

I rub my palms together vigorously and then slice one hand through the air, like a dealer fanning out a deck of cards. The stairs shudder for a moment, particles of magic falling from them like bits of dust. With a final, violent shake, they flatten, turning the previously impassable obstacle into a ramp.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Pedestrians Crowd Around A Frenzied Stre.name:
行人蜂拥围拢，一场街头乱斗正打得发狂
Pedestrians Crowd Around A Frenzied Street Fight

Text.text:
人群在小巷里簇拥着那些浑身血污的斗士，他们彼此绕圈试探；围观者的吼叫声此起彼伏，为这场暴烈的景象燃到近乎癫狂。头顶霓虹嗡鸣，雷声滚过，雨开始倾泻，浇透了角斗者，也把他们溅落的鲜血冲刷成蜿蜒的红流，沿街流淌。
People cluster around the bloodied combatants as they circle each other in the alley, the baying crowd reaching a feverish excitement over the violent spectacle. Neon buzzes overhead as thunder resonates and rain begins to fall, drenching the gladiators and washing the streets with their spilled blood.

Corhim The Minotaur.name:
科尔希姆：牛头人
Corhim The Minotaur

Text.text:
岁月的灰白——亦是智慧的霜色——点点洒落在牛头人科希姆赤褐的皮毛上。他把头顶弯曲的犄角用各色金属打成的闪亮圆环与缤纷布条装点得华彩夺目。沉重的锁子甲与钢板护甲穿在身上，他同样自如；就像他能随手褪下艺人那身扎眼的戏服一样。而他背上那柄久经磨砺的战斧长柄，又在这牛头人沉静随和的气质下，隐隐透出一抹不容忽视的锋芒。

~ Played by Mewcus with

The gray of age—of wisdom—sprinkles the ruddy hide of Corhim the minotaur, who adorns the curving horns atop his head with gleaming rings of myriad metals and strips of colorful cloth. He wears heavy mail and plates of steel just as easily as he pulls off the garish costumes of an entertainer, and, upon his back, the well-worn haft of a battleaxe belies the minotaur’s calm and easygoing demeanor.

~ Played by Mewcus with

Manual Of Iron Golems.name:
铁魔像手册
Manual Of Iron Golems

Text.text:
这本笨重的巨册以实心铁封装订，边框以金箔镌刻着奥秘符号。一本披甲战士的风格化面容从书的掩蔽上冷然凝视，空洞的金属眼眶毫无波澜；内里的书页则密布繁复的科技构造图。
This cumbersome tome is bound in solid iron and inscribed with arcane symbols around the border in gold leaf. The stylized face of an armored warrior stares implacably from the book’s cover with hollow metal eyes, and the pages within are filled with complex technological diagrams.

Raised Industrial City.name:
崛起的工业之城
Raised Industrial City

Text.text:
地下水道迷宫之于这座城市，正如血液循环之于人类躯体。它无处不在，潜伏在头顶街道下清凉的石层之中。沿着路缘排水口的栅格不断飘上来湿冷的恶臭，却被城中几乎看不见露天污秽的事实所抵消。公园在构装体与机器吐出的烟霾间生长。车流掠过市中心的高楼，像心脏的搏动把脉动泵向四周环绕的城区。一道法术在公会大厅附近的广场上啪地炸开，像一枚烟花。店主摇动铁制水泵，将一桶清水灌得满满当当。

~ 构想：Petite Omnivore

The underground waterway maze is to the city what the circulatory system is to the human body. It is ever present in the cool stone of the streets above it. The damp stench wafting up from grates along the gutters is offset by the city’s lack of open waste. Parks grow amid the smog of constructs and machinery. Traffic streams by the tall buildings of the city center, pumping like a heart out into the boroughs that surround them. A spell pops like a firework from a plaza near a guild hall. A shopkeeper works an iron pump, filling a bucket with clean water.

~ Envisioned by Petite Omnivore

Forced-labor Mining Camp.name:
强制劳役矿营
Forced-labor Mining Camp

Text.text:
矿井巷道摇摇欲坠，仿佛支架是些外行在仓促间胡乱搭成。你循着一条漆黑的矿浆痕迹走到露天矿坑的岩沿。坑内的矿工彼此用铁链连在一起，你在许多人臂上看见袖带——徽记上如今都被一枚猩红的 X 亵渎般划过。他们挖出的矿石同这矿井的建造一样低劣，刚一装入手中与矿车，便在搬运间不断风化崩解。可他们仍得劳作不止，因为看守他们的是一群蒙羞的前士兵——那些破烂褪色的纹章曾让他们看上去像是光荣的守护者。

~ 构想：Bartok

The mine shafts seem rickety, as if amateurs constructed the supports in too short a time. You follow a black trail of slurry to the ledge of an open pit. The miners within are chained to one another, and on many of them you spot arm bands, each now profaned with a red X over the insignia.
