The ore they excavate is as inferior as the mine’s construction, degrading in their hands and carts even as they load it. Toil on they must, for they are kept under guard by disgraced former soldiers whose own tattered heraldry once marked them as honorable protectors.

~ Envisioned by Bartok

泥土与岩石的基座勾勒出一抹如同蘑菇般的剪影：细瘦的尖塔托举着臃肿的顶部。乍看之下，这形态显得不自然，近乎人工造就；然而真正的匠人却是天气——风、雨、日光——在无数个万古长岁里，一点一滴地雕琢大地。
The pedestal of earth and rock forms a toadstool-like silhouette, with a spindly spire holding aloft a bulbous top. The form seems unnatural at first glance, almost manufactured, but the craftsperson was weather—wind, rain, sun—carving into the earth little by little over many eons.

Bandolier Of Fragmentation Grenades.name:
破片手雷弹带
Bandolier Of Fragmentation Grenades

Text.text:
这条斜挎的尼龙腰带上挂着一串看起来像蔫绿苹果的东西——破片手雷。拉环处的指示灯泛着红光，保险销牢牢插在原位。
This crossbody nylon belt runs with what looks like dingy green apples—frag grenades. Lights on their tabs glow red, their safety pins securely in place.

I Clean My Flute.name:
我擦拭长笛
I Clean My Flute

Text.text:
旅行的尘土、酒馆里烟与烈酒混杂的气味、还有我自己陈年的唾渍。真够恶心的——至少在活儿干完之前是这样。来点纯烈酒，几把上好的瓶刷，再把指孔和吹口的边缘一圈圈细细抠干净，它看起来几乎和它的声音一样漂亮。
The dust of travel, the smoke-and-booze smell of a tavern, my own old spittle. Nasty, really, until the job is done. A little straight alcohol, a few fine bottle brushes, and some careful detail work around all the edges of finger holes and mouthpiece, and it looks almost as good as it sounds.

Sundries From A Black Dragon's Lair.name:
黑龙巢穴里的杂物
Sundries From A Black Dragon's Lair

Text.text:
曾盘踞此地的黑龙，对阴森怪诞的艺术别有癖好。一支骷髅（特征）军团——被木制支架撑得笔直——在一幕嘲弄般的行军赴战立体景里列阵。你在骷髅（特征）的行头中清点出五顶锈蚀头盔、三副黯淡胸甲，以及一打霉朽的皮靴。有一具既可悲又滑稽的骷髅（特征），正踩在一座头骨堆成的“山”顶端，摆出君王般的姿势。
The black dragon that lived here had a flair for art of a macabre sort. An army of skeletons—propped upright on wooden armatures—stands in a mocking diorama of a march to war. You count five rusted helmets, three tarnished breastplates, and a dozen moldering leather boots among the skeletons’ accoutrements. One tragically ludicrous skeleton strikes a kingly pose atop a mountain of skulls.

Greeting From A Tree Spirit.name:
来自树精的问候
Greeting From A Tree Spirit

Text.text:
“你不像那些践踏过这片神圣林地的家伙。也许你可以留下，品尝我们的果实，沉浸在我们的树荫里——但要记住，这些都是供人享用的馈赠，不是任人掠夺的战利品。”
“You don’t seem like the others who have trampled through these sacred woods. Perhaps you can stay, partake in our fruits, and indulge in our shade, but know that these things are gifts to be enjoyed and not plunder to be taken.”

Sundries From A Hell Cat's Lair.name:
地狱猫巢穴的杂物
Sundries From A Hell Cat's Lair

Text.text:
被利爪撕碎的衣布条带散落一地，末端被唾液浸得潮湿。裙装上的小饰物与珠串滚在角落里，或沿着墙边零星排开。一只廉价的破旧怀表外壳躺在旁边，正落在一张破烂地毯的中央。
Ribbons of clothing, shredded by claws, are damp at the ends with spit. Baubles and beads from dresses are in corners or along wall edges. A cheap, broken pocket watch casing lies nearby in the center of a tattered rug.

船坞里一片行动喧嚣，工人们彼此配合，建造与修补各式船只——从私人的纵帆船到远行的贸易帆船。某处船坞内，五名木匠正将一根根精心削出的肋骨拼装到新船的龙骨上，船体的骷髅（特征）在他们的手下逐渐显形。外头，两人一组挥动打磨得一丝不苟的锯子，将巨木锯切成木板、肋材与桅桁。船场的一座干船坞正缓缓注水，好让一艘新近完工的船只浮起出坞，驶向大海，交付给自豪的新主人。
The shipyard bustles with activity as laborers collaborate to build and repair boats—from personal schooners to trading galleons. In one bay, five carpenters assemble carefully shaped ribs of a new ship’s keel, the skeleton of a hull gradually becoming visible through their work. Outside, two-man teams use meticulously filed saws to cut enormous timbers into planks, ribs, and spars. One of the yard’s drydocks is gradually being flooded to allow a newly-completed vessel to float out to sea, and delivered to its proud new owners.

Target Shot By Hidden Sniper.name:
被潜伏狙击手射中的目标
Target Shot By Hidden Sniper

Text.text:
男人倒下——纸片般薄的通讯器从他仍紧攥的手里飞出——他那套上流社会的几何剪裁西装在撞上人行道的一瞬间皱塌变形。头颅正中央的弹孔冒着缕缕青烟，一道细细的血线从鼻下淌落，随即一折，蜿蜒向其中一只眼。人群尖叫着俯身躲入掩蔽，可匆匆一瞥四周楼宇，却找不出枪声的来源：只有一幅龟裂玻璃与油布帘幕交织的挂毯，视野里不见细长的枪管，也不见任何瞄准激光。
The man falls—paper-thin cell flying from his still-clenched hand—and the geometric cut of his high-society suit crumples as he hits the pavement. A bullet hole smokes in the center of his head, a thin line of blood streams down his nose, then bends toward one of his eyes. People scream and duck for cover, though a quick glance to the surrounding buildings betrays no source for the shot: only a tapestry of cracking glass and tarpaulin curtains without a slender gun barrel or scoping laser in sight.

脚印玷污了那张曾经华丽的地毯，如今铺在阴沉办公室的地面上。房间一角挤着一张污渍斑斑的沙发和几把椅子，褪色的坐垫因疏于照料而开裂、撕破。陈腐的空气里，体味与廉价须后水的气息刺鼻得几乎能触摸到，彻底压过了墙上神龛里那支小小香薰蜡烛的微弱挣扎。对面的墙边摆着一张沉重的书桌——宽得像船的舷侧——上方挂着一幅褪色的油画：一个矮壮、衣着考究的男人，面孔如崩裂的花岗岩般冷硬。
Footprints stain the once opulent rug covering the floor of the dismal office. A soiled couch and some chairs fill one corner of the room, their faded cushions split and torn through neglect. The scent of body odor and cheap aftershave is palpable in the stale air, completely overwhelming the feeble attempts of the tiny, scented candle burning in the shrine on the wall. A heavy desk—like the broadside of a ship—occupies the far wall, sitting beneath a faded oil painting of a stocky, well-dressed man with a face like chipped granite.

这里的昏暗光照只会更凸显那些诡异、近乎骷髅般的轮廓：堆放的木箱、陶罐与瓮，以及披着布的雕像。你踏在摇摇欲坠的木地板上，脚步吱呀作响，与四周建筑的呻吟声交织在一起。有什么东西在你视野边缘一闪而过：是光影的把戏吗？是某种害兽仓皇逃向掩蔽？还是别的什么？你怎么也甩不掉那种感觉——你并不孤单。
The dim light up here serves only to accentuate the strange, almost skeletal, silhouettes of storage crates, clay pots and urns, and statuary draped with cloth. The creak of your footsteps on the rickety floorboards mingles with the groans of the building around you. Something moves in your periphery: Was it a trick of the light? Some vermin fleeing for cover? Or something else? You cannot shake the feeling that you are not alone.

I Use Frenzy.name:
我发动狂暴
I Use Frenzy

Text.text:
我挥动手中的武器横扫四方，宛如愤怒的旋风。我挥砍，再挥砍。我将每一分力气都灌注进双手，让它们完成这血淋淋的活计。若我还能活着，我才会休息。
I sweep about me with my weapon, a whirlwind of wrath. I strike, and I strike again. I put every ounce of effort into my hands doing their bloody work. I’ll rest if I live.

Phanrim Marsh-singer.name:
潘瑞姆·沼泽歌者
Phanrim Marsh-singer

Text.text:
雪白的母虎缓缓眨动那双月银般发亮的眼眸，猫科的面容挂着宁静的微笑，圆润的耳朵也放松地伏着。她喉间与胸腔深处滚出低沉而稳定的呼噜声，令颈间悬挂的翡翠徽章微微颤动。她的皮毛外披一袭橄榄绿长袍，肩上覆着金色披肩。一只覆着利爪的手握着一根红褐色木杖，杖首雕成兜帽眼镜蛇的模样，吐信欲出。

~ Played by the dnd lover

The snow-white tigress blinks her luminous moon-silver eyes slowly, with a serene smile on her feline face and relaxed rounded ears. A low, steady purr rumbles from within her throat and chest, causing the emerald medallion hanging about her neck to tremble. She wears a long, olive-green robe over her fur and a golden mantle about her shoulders. In one of her clawed hands, she holds a staff of reddish-brown wood, its head carved to resemble a hooded cobra flicking its tongue.

~ Played by the dnd lover

你眼底燃着一抹顽皮的幽光。面前的火焰攫住了你的目光。你的双手模仿着扭动的火舌，与那噼啪作响、灼烫空气的舞者同频共舞，交织出共生的律动。你神情紧绷、专注如弦，将烈焰揉捏进你的意志，助长它的狂怒，并逼它俯首听令。
A mischievous glow burns within your eyes. The fire before you holds your gaze. Your hands mimic the writhing flames, weaving in symbiotic motion with the crackling dancers that scorch the air. Features taut in concentration, you mold the blaze to your will, fanning its fury and demanding its obedience.

I Become Exhausted.name:
我陷入力竭
I Become Exhausted

Text.text:
一阵倦怠如潮水般席卷而来，像最阴毒的毒素般渗入我的四肢。精神与体力被抽空，我双膝一软跪倒在地——额头沁出冰冷的汗珠——身躯沉重如石，思绪也随之浑浊不清。
A wave of lethargy washes over me, seeping into my limbs like a most insidious poison. Drained of spirit and stamina, I sink to my knees—a cold sweat beading my brow—as my body grows as heavy as stone and my thoughts become muddied and unclear.

God Of Mysteries.name:
诡秘之主
God Of Mysteries

Text.text:
神秘本身的化身，这位神祇唯一恒常不变的，只是祂乐于将答案拒之门外。祂的幽光长袍闪烁流离，铺满整片夜空，点缀着星云与银河。神性的躯体轮廓无时无刻不在起伏变幻。这个无性、无别、流动不定的存在没有面容；唯有两只眼睛，如遥远星辰一般，悬在一顶空荡兜帽之中——那兜帽宽广如同宇宙本身。曾凝望过这位神祇“面容”的哲人都已发狂——而如今问题来了：你凭什么认为自己会有所不同？

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The embodiment of an enigma, the god’s only constant is their delight in withholding answers. Their spectral robe shimmers, occupying the entirety of the night sky, flecked with nebulae and galaxies. The contours of the divine body fluctuate without ceasing. The sexless, genderless, fluid being possesses no face, though two eyes, like distant stars, sit within an empty hood as wide as the cosmos. Philosophers who have looked into this god’s visage have gone mad—and now comes the question: what makes you think you will be any different?

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Mortimer Maxwell Carton.name:
莫蒂默·麦克斯韦·卡顿
Mortimer Maxwell Carton

Text.text:
男人兴奋地絮絮叨叨，指向手中那本翻得起毛的旧书，修长的手指正点在一段至关重要的文字上。尽管年代已高，这位学者的眼眸却被青春般的炽烈点亮——他倾泻而出的信息如狂潮般汹涌，讲述间手势凌乱却不失迫切。仿佛一座披着卡其布外衣的行走图书馆，这位银发绅士身上几乎不带别的，只有书——而每一本，他都至少读过十二遍。

~ 由一位英雄 扮演

Chattering excitedly, the man points to the well-worn book in his hand, his slender finger highlighting a paragraph of vital importance. Despite his age, the scholar’s eyes come alive with the vibrant passion of youth as he divulges information in a raging torrent of knowledge, gesturing erratically as he does so. Akin to a walking library garbed in khaki, the silver-haired gentleman appears to carry little except books—each one of which he has read a dozen times.

~ Played by a Hero

Hearth With Sleeping Dog.name:
有睡狗的壁炉
Hearth With Sleeping Dog

Text.text:
那条狗几乎与火炉同长，侧卧在地，一只耳朵软塌塌地摊开，四条腿两两交叠。他抬起头，先盯着火光看了片刻，又转而确认自己的主人们都安好。打了个响亮的哈欠后，他缓缓陷入昏沉。后腿忽地抽动一下，头也跟着偏转。随后梦境散去，狗又安稳地蜷回温暖而令人安心的睡眠里。
Stretched nearly the length of the firebox, the dog lies on his side, one ear flopping open and each pair of legs crossed. He tips up his head to watch the fire for a moment, then to check on his people. After a loud yawn, he drifts off slowly. One back leg twitches and his head turns. Then the dream ends, and the dog settles back into a warm and comforting sleep.

在尖塔顶端的原野上，有几处绿意无法生长的斑驳地带，蔚蓝的薄雾便在那儿一阵阵从地底卷起。偶尔，这些蒸汽会嘶嘶作响，或发出低沉的哀鸣，响得足以盖过风声。有时，雾气会隐约凝成某个人或野兽的轮廓，仿佛在与看不见的袭击者厮斗，或仓皇奔逃。
Where greenery fails to grow in several patches on the spire-top field, blue mist curls from the ground in fits. Occasionally, the vapors hiss or moan loudly enough to be heard over the wind. Sometimes, the fog takes the faint shape of a person or beast, fighting or fleeing invisible attackers.

你拾起这把武器，在空中挥舞几下，试探它的重量与平衡。它在你手中感觉怪异地不稳，可当你停下来细看时，武器的分量却又恰到好处。你又做了几次试探性的动作，终于察觉：这把武器总会不由自主地牵引你回到防御姿态。
You pick up the weapon and swing it about, testing it for weight and balance. It feels oddly unstable in your hand, yet when you pause to consider it, the heft of the weapon seems perfect. You try a few more experimental movements and realize that the weapon drags toward defensive postures.

Quip About Assisting A Weaker Party Memb.name:
调侃自己在协助较弱的队友
Quip About Assisting A Weaker Party Member

Text.text:
“别担心。我不惧死亡，但我知道你害怕，所以想你或许需要人搭把手。”
“Worry not. I don’t fear death, but I know you do, so I thought you might need a hand.”

尽管他的脊背因年代而佝偻、满头发丝已尽数化作银白，这位马鞍匠铁一般的握力仍清晰可见：他塑形、锤打，裁去一层又一层的衬垫皮革，逐步将其雕琢成一副上等的骑乘马鞍。作坊的墙面挂满各式马鞍与挽具——从战马所用的军用马鞍，到役畜身上那套朴素的挽具。
Though his back is bent and his hair completely silver with age, the saddlemaker’s iron grip is still evident as he shapes and hammers, trimming layer upon layer of padded leather, gradually sculpting them in to a high-quality riding saddle. The walls of his workshop are covered with various types of saddles and harnesses, from a military saddle for a warhorse to a simple harness for a draft animal.

你轻轻向哨子吹出一口气，完成法术；当一头幽灵猎犬从虚无中踱步而出，坐到你身旁时，你便知道它的呼唤已得到回应。它那无形的头颅垂着舌头，你甚至能透过那条魅影般的舌尖看见虚空；但那双刺人的蓝白眼睛却真实得令人心悸，正望向你，等待你的命令。
You blow lightly on the whistle to complete the spell, and know its call is answered when a ghostly hound lopes out of thin air to sit near you. You can see through its phantom tongue as it lolls from an intangible head, but its piercing blue-white eyes seem wholly real as they look to you for a command.

Cave Passage Bending Right.name:
洞穴通道向右弯曲
Cave Passage Bending Right

Text.text:
理智上你知道，当洞穴向右蜿蜒时把脖子多探出几英寸，在实质上根本帮不上什么忙；可就是多看那短短几寸，仍让你心里踏实些。沿着这条曲折洞穴前行，几乎没有任何东西能让你感到安全或安稳——你只得瞪大眼睛，警惕搜寻是否有不受欢迎的住客留下的踪迹。
Logically you know that craning your neck out a few inches as the cave wends to the right doesn't really help in any meaningful way, but peering just a couple of inches further makes you feel better. Precious little about this winding cave makes you feel safe or secure, as you keep your eyes peeled to detect tracks of any unwelcoming inhabitants.

Introduction By An Assassin.name:
刺客的开场白
Introduction By An Assassin

Text.text:
“我有许多名号，但在大多数人眼里，我是冰冷的死神、寒彻的长眠、危险的打盹；而当我寒光一闪、匕首出鞘，人们便分不清该为我倾倒，还是该惊恐逃命。”
“I go by many names, but to most I am the cold death, the chilly sleep, the dangerous snooze, and when I flash my daggers, people can’t decide if they should swoon or flee in terror.”

I Cast Protection From Energy.name:
我施放「能量防护」
I Cast Protection From Energy

Text.text:
我的皮肤战栗着变得像液态钢铁：冰冷而坚韧。我接触我的目标，一圈银蓝色能量的光冠笼罩着他们的身形。“不算完美，”我说，声音带着金属般的嘶哑，“但他们现在没法那么快杀死你了。”
My skin shudders into what feels like liquid steel: Cold and resilient. I touch my target, and a corona of silver-blue energy surrounds their form. “It’s not perfect,” I say, my voice tinny, “but they can’t kill you as quickly now.”

这枚光泽莹润、棕粉交织的贝壳两端皆尖。一端冠着螺旋，向壳体最宽处舒展成带刺的圆锥；尖刺色泽更浅，沟槽则更深。与主锥体相对的一侧，有一道沟槽沿边起伏，波浪般的外缘勾勒其侧，表面愈发平滑、愈发粉润，并向外唇边缘逐渐褪淡。通向壳内的管道一路延伸，最终在另一端尖点收束——那是一枚微微起皱的圆锥。

~ 由一位英雄构想

This lustrous, brownish-pink shell comes to a point at both ends. One tops a spiral that expands in a spiky cone toward the widest part of the shell. Its spikes are lighter in color, while the grooves are darker. An undulated lip lines the side of a channel opposite the main, conical body, the surface becoming smoother and pinker, paling toward the edges of the outer lip. The canal into the shell’s interior ends at the other point tip—a slightly rippled cone.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Mage With A Green Hood.name:
绿兜帽法师
Mage With A Green Hood

Text.text:
镶着金边的绿色兜帽向后一落，露出一名肤色浅褐的小个子法师。他栗色的头发编成一条辫子垂在肩头，几缕不听话的发丝散落出来，泄露了它只是为了不挡住视线而随手匆匆束起的事实。那双钢灰色的眼睛里透出的神情，让你隐约觉得，这位法师所见所历远比他那清澈无瑕的皮肤所能暗示的更多。
The green hood with gold trim falls back to reveal a small mage with tan skin. Their chestnut-colored hair falls in a braid over their shoulder, wayward strands betraying that it was haphazardly pulled together to stay out of their face. The look in their steel-gray eyes gives you the feeling that this mage has seen and lived through more than their clear, unblemished skin would otherwise make it seem.

Nothari The Frost Mage.name:
诺萨里·霜寒法师
Nothari The Frost Mage

Text.text:
死亡冰冷的接触萦绕着精灵法师，她的发丝在虚幻的微风中轻轻翻涌。尽管四周气候温和，她吐息却凝成平静的雾团；每一次克制而均匀的呼气，都在她带疤却纤细的唇上铺开一层霜色薄膜，如冰纹般蜿蜒。宝石般的蓝眼闪烁着智性光芒——那智慧被她磨砺到锋锐之极，并被她娴熟地用来追逐自己的欲望。一枚细长的冰蓝水晶冠冕悬浮在她眉间上方，为她那种不费吹灰之力的王者雍容再添一笔——她把它像上等香氛般披在身上。战斗一启，凛冽的狂寒将精灵抱紧，骷髅之翼在她身后骤然迸裂展开，将她裹入令人战栗的恐惧之中。

~ Played by schnoodle

The chilling touch of death surrounds the elven mage, her hair billowing softly in a phantasmal breeze. Despite the temperate surroundings, her breath mists in placid clouds, a patina of frost marbling her scarred, delicate lips with every measured exhalation. Sapphire-blue eyes sparkle with intelligence, which she has honed to a keen edge and expertly wielded in pursuit of her desires. A slender diadem of ice-blue crystal hovers above her brow, adding to the air of effortless regal grace the woman wears like fine perfume. As battle begins, an icy furor embraces the elf and skeletal wings erupt behind her, cloaking her in terror.

~ Played by schnoodle

First Year Fellowship Ritual.name:
第一年同盟仪式
First Year Fellowship Ritual

Text.text:
一年级新生被分入各自的学院后，会被召集到入口大门内侧不远处集合。夕阳西沉时，他们齐声吟诵一道法术，提醒自己彼此相系的不止是学院，更是他们的职业。仪式进行期间，每位学生都会记住同班同学的名字。法术结束时，每个人的前臂上——手腕上方一点——都会烙上一枚小小的纹身：深棕色墨迹绘成的学院徽记，以及他们的入学年份。
After the first-year students have been placed in their houses, they are gathered together just inside the entrance gate. As the sun sets, they chant a spell that reminds them they are bound together by their class, not just by their house. During the ritual, each student learns their classmates’ names. The spell ends with a small tattoo—in dark brown ink—emblazoned on each forearm, just above the wrist, showing the academy sigil and their year of admission.

I Rage With Sorrow.name:
我以悲恸为怒
I Rage With Sorrow

Text.text:
万古的哀歌自我口中倾泻而出，祖灵的召唤化作怒火灌满胸腔。泪水沿着我布满伤痕的脸颊奔流，而我的双眼渗出翡翠色的雾。我要向先祖嘶喊，恳求他们庇护我的朋友。他们回应了——那些枯槁的幽影唯有我能看见——他们拥住我的敌人，将其引向我张开的臂弯。

~ 由 Rexx 构想

The dirge of ages spills from my mouth, the rage filling me with the call of my ancestors. Tears stream down my scarred cheeks as my eyes bleed emerald mist. I scream to my forebears, beseeching them to protect my friends. They answer, their gaunt shades visible only to me, and they embrace my foe and guide them to my waiting arms.

~ Envisioned by Rexx

店铺柜台前空无一人，但更深处不时传来零星的行动声响。透过后门窥去，可见一间宽阔的工坊，木料堆成小丘，四周散落着各式塑形工具。一名匠人独自立在空间中央附近的工作台前，全神贯注地在一条木板上量取并划出整齐一致的刻痕。他用手指沿着刻痕数了一遍、两遍，随后锯下木板末端的一截，任其哐当一声落到地上。
Nobody stands at the shop's counter, but sporadic sounds of activity emanate from deeper within. Peering through a back door reveals an extensive workshop dotted with piles of lumber and an assortment of tools to shape it. A single craftsman stands at a workbench near the center of the space, intently focused on measuring out uniform marks on a strip of wood. With their finger, they count the marks out once, twice, before they saw a chunk off the end of the plank and let it clatter to the floor.

中士厉声下令，脸涨得通红，嗓门大到仿佛只有巨人和巨龙才能发出那般震天的音量。他们的制服笔挺无瑕，却遮不住那副魁梧结实的肌肉身躯——他们不仅能狠狠干上一顿，看起来也同样扛得住。
The sergeant barks orders, face red as their voice reaches a volume previously only achievable by giants and dragons. Their uniform, crisp and perfect, does little to hide the bulky, muscled frame—they can dish it out, and from the looks of it, they can take it too.

尽管这只背包的做工无可挑剔，但唯有在细细端详之后，它真正非凡的一面才会显露出来。精巧的装饰纹样之中暗藏玄机，奥秘的符号与蜿蜒流动的字迹交织其间，隐隐昭示着这只魔法背包所具备的超常力量。
Though this bag is certainly a fine quality, its truly remarkable nature is only revealed upon closer inspection. Cleverly concealed in the decorative designs, arcane symbols and flowing lines of script hint at the extraordinary properties of this magical backpack.

这把手弩的打造毫不吝惜成本，显然出自大师级匠人之手。从弩弦无可挑剔的缠绕与上弦，到弩臂近乎完美的对称，再到弩身枪管般笔直的校正工艺——这件刺客的武器尽管体型小巧、易于藏匿，却蕴含着骇人的穿透力。
No expense has been spared in the construction of this hand crossbow, clearly the work of an expert craftsperson. From the flawless winding of the string to the perfect symmetry of the limbs to the impeccable straightening of the barrel, this assassin’s weapon packs an incredible punch despite its size and concealability.

Gnome Arguing With An Awakened Plant.name:
与一株觉醒植物争辩的侏儒
Gnome Arguing With An Awakened Plant

Text.text:
一幕怪诞的景象在你眼前上演：一个侏儒——头发和他的脾气一样狂乱——正对着一盆盆栽怒气冲冲地争辩，而那盆植物也沙沙作响，仿佛在回嘴。这个矮小的男人语速飞快，夸张的手势像烟火般点燃每一句论点；他的花卉同伴则把身子倾得更近，叶片与枝条交叉抱起，满是毫不掩饰的讥诮。

~ 构想：CpnTaintKick（Discord）

A strange scene plays out before you as a gnome—with hair as wild as his demeanor—argues vehemently with a potted plant that is rustling back at him. The diminutive man speaks quickly, emphasizing his points with flamboyant gesticulation, while his floral companion leans closer, their leaves and branches crossed in obvious derision.

~ Envisioned by CpnTaintKick on Discord

Druid Quip About Aging.name:
德鲁伊对衰老的俏皮话
Druid Quip About Aging

Text.text:
“我额头上的每一道皱纹，都如同山峦更迭般生成——阅历与爱意被岁月侵蚀，又被生命之河携走，去成全某个新的用处。唯独这几道鱼尾纹例外。这是你无能造成的。”
“Every wrinkle on my brow has formed like the changing of a mountain, experiences and loves eroded away and carried down the river of life to fulfill some new purpose. Except for these crow’s feet. These are from your incompetence.”

Ruined World With Mystic Blue River.name:
与神秘湛蓝之河共存的残破世界
Ruined World With Mystic Blue River

Text.text:
目光所及，尽是彻底的湮灭。不是战争留下的血腥与残骸，而是更深、更彻底的抹除：这世界被一层无缝衔接的珠光浓雾闷覆其下。在窒息的臭氧之下，一切都被完全抹平——声音、气味、视野与生命——唯有一处例外，仿佛在一幅杰作般的风景画上被撕开了一道裂口。它逼迫你移不开视线。一条蜿蜒的河流以灿然光晕将两侧迷雾推退，蓝色光波层层荡开，排斥着雾幕。那是这世界的绝唱，向必然的命运发起反叛。

~ 由盖加的最后之光 构想

Everywhere you look, you see complete annihilation. Not the gore and wreckage of war, but an erasure more profound, more complete: this world has been smothered beneath a seamless blanket of pearlescent fog. All is utterly erased under suffocating ozone—sound, smell, sight, and life—except for one place, like a rip through a masterwork landscape. It demands your gaze. A meandering river pushes back the fog on either side with a radiant aura, repelling with waves of blue light. The swan song of this world, rebelling against inevitability.

~ Envisioned by The Last Light of Geiga

干旱肆虐的平原上，尘土旋风翻卷游走，把天空裹进灰褐色的迷雾。你脚下的焦土干脆而脆裂，每迈出一步都崩开细纹，扬起一缕缕微小的尘烟。窒息般的干燥空气里，你的皮肤、你的口腔，甚至你的眼睛都像被抽走了水分。这里没有任何绿意能够繁茂生长。
The drought-stricken plains swirl with cyclones of dust, shrouding the sky with a gray-brown haze. The arid earth beneath you is brittle, cracking with each step and stirring up little plumes of dirt. Your skin, your mouth, even your eyes feel dry  in the choking air. Nothing green flourishes here.

Druidic Grove On A Hilltop.name:
山巅德鲁伊圣林
Druidic Grove On A Hilltop

Text.text:
你沿着城外丘陵的缓坡向上攀登，靴底陷入柔软可塑的青草。登顶后，你驻足片刻，仰望点缀在丘顶冠冕般的远古巨石，随后踏入其间的石环，朝中心那株正盛放的杜松树走去。你跨过界限，一阵清凉怡人的微风拂面而来，灌注进你心底，带来难以言喻的安宁与康泰。你回头看向你的伙伴，却不见踪影。薄雾在石环四周悄然垂落，将外面的世界尽数遮蔽。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

You ascend the gentle slope of the hill outside the town, your boots sinking into the soft, malleable grass. Upon reaching the summit, you take a moment to admire the ancient megaliths adorning the hill's crown before stepping into the circle within, making your way toward the blossoming juniper tree at its center. You cross the threshold and a cool, refreshing breeze washes over you, instilling an unfathomable sense of peace and wellbeing. You look back to your companions, but they are nowhere to be seen. A delicate mist has descended around the circle, obscuring the world beyond.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The Sanctuary: Ruined Humanoid-sized Out.name:
圣所：荒废的人形尺度前哨站
The Sanctuary: Ruined Humanoid-sized Outpost

Text.text:
一座巨大的六角高塔废墟自解冻的泥土中拔起；黑色石砌结构的大段已然坍塌剥落。仅存的几扇窗如无眼的空洞般俯瞰南方苔原，寒风穿梭其间，发出幽咽的哀鸣。
The ruins of a humongous hexagonal tower rise from the thawing soil; large portions of the dark stone structure have crumbled away. The few windows that remain look out over the southern tundra like eyeless sockets, and the wind blows through them with a haunting wail.

[察觉] 你的直觉与敏锐的感官占了上风！你看见前方道路上，一根细线绷得笔直，横在你脚踝高度的位置。你的视线顺着细线追去，这才发现它连在支撑天花板的立柱上。

[触发！] 有什么轻轻擦过你的脚踝。你低头一看，那根线随着一声 TWANG！应声绷断！原本支撑天花板的立柱开始错位摇晃，塌陷就在你眼前发生。

[Perceived] Your gut and keen senses prevail! You see a thin wire that stretches tautly across the way ahead of you at about the height of your ankles. You follow the wire with your gaze, realizing it’s connected to the columns supporting the ceiling.

[Triggered!] You feel something light against your ankle. You look down to see a wire snap with a TWANG! The columns that were holding the ceiling up begin to shift and wobble, their collapse happening before your very eyes.

Galactic Commerce Exchange Floor.name:
星际商业交易大厅
Galactic Commerce Exchange Floor

Text.text:
数据板与无线交易交织其间，夹杂着目光的交锋、手势暗号，以及异域汗味与香水若有若无的气息。各个种族成群结队，穿着配色与剪裁相近的商务装，或占据仿照其原生环境的浴池与包厢。这就是银河经济生死起落之处。几米高空的行情滚动条在地面上方滑过，天花板上的有机玻璃隔间里，形迹暧昧的身影俯视着场内的一切。
Datapads and wireless transactions mix with eye contact, hand signs, and the faint smell of exotic perspiration and colognes. Clusters of races wear similar colors and cuts of business wear, or occupy baths or booths that mimic their environments. This is where the state of the galactic economy lives and dies. As the ticker scrolls several meters above the floor, shadowy figures in the plexiglass boxes above look down on the action.

Ring Of Free Action.name:
自由动作之戒
Ring Of Free Action

Text.text:
一圈由链状金属组成的戒环，每一节链节都粗厚带棱，扣合成环，顶端镶着一枚巨大的方形切割宝石。近乎澄澈的晶体深处，点点冰蓝碎屑仿佛凝在其中。如此坚固的饰物，戴上却出奇地轻盈。
A band of chained metal, each link bulky and ridged, forms a ring with a large square-cut gemstone at the head. Flecks of icy blue suspend within the mostly clear jewel. For such a sturdy piece of jewelry, it is surprisingly light when worn.

Speech About An Opportunity For Greed.name:
一场关于贪婪机会的演说
Speech About An Opportunity For Greed

Text.text: “我的朋友们，就是现在：我们获得自由的时刻。这样的机会，恐怕再也不会降临。所以请让我们给予它应得的慎重。我们不是一次又一次做了正确的事吗？为了他人的安宁，我们忍受折磨、付出惨痛的代价；而如今，命运也回赠了我们一些东西。也许把掉进我们怀里的东西据为己有，并不光彩。但若仅此一次，我们让那道催促我们行善的小声音沉默，我向你们保证，我们将再也不必为它牵肠挂肚。” “My friends, this is it: our moment to be free. And it will likely never come again. So please, let us give it the consideration it deserves. Have we not done the right thing time and time again? We’ve suffered and lost so much in the pursuit of others’ well-being and now the fates have given us something back. Perhaps it is not honorable to take what has been dropped in our laps. But if, just this once, we silence the little voice telling us to do good, I promise you we will never have to concern ourselves with it again.”

别把那癫狂的咯咯笑当成愚蠢的证据。这种豺狼人猎犬会数数，能从笼式陷阱里脱身，还能结成规模逾百的氏族。鬣狗运用巧妙的猎杀战术，扩张欲强，游猎疆域辽阔无边；它们在夜里发出的嚎叫令人骨寒战栗——而那骨头，正是它们强悍的颚力能轻易咬碎的。
Don’t mistake the insane giggle for stupidity. This gnollish dog can count, escape from cage traps, and organize into clans of over one-hundred. Hyenas employ ingenious hunting tactics. They are expansionist, ranging over enormous territories, and their calls shiver the bones at night—bones their powerful jaws can crack.

那只虹彩甲虫从阴影里窜出，肿胀的甲壳散出腐臭般的光，仿佛透过泛黄的玻璃被折射得支离破碎。它有獒犬般长，却又矮壮沉密，外形几乎像只乌龟，却以昆虫的速度疾掠而行。它的颚足粗长，像兽人的手指般结实，随着它抬头，咔嗒作响、猛然合拢，异质的眼睛冷冷打量着你。

[驯化] 它似乎在等待什么。随后你注意到它胸部上绕着一圈皮质牵绳。是在等某个人，那么。

The iridescent beetle skitters from the shadows, its turgid carapace emitting putrid light that seems refracted through jaundiced glass. As long as a mastiff yet squat and dense, the beetle appears almost tortoise-like but moves with insectoid speed. Its mandibles, thick and long as an orc's fingers, snap and click as its head tilts up to regard you with alien eyes.

[Domesticated] It seems to be waiting for something. Then you notice the leather leash looped around its thorax. Waiting for someone, then.

Aeorian Absorber.name:
艾奥里安吸收者
Aeorian Absorber

Text.text:
一头野兽如黑豹般自阴影中潜行而出，獠牙密布的巨口深处滚出低沉而回响的咆哮。腥臭的涎丝从匕首般的利齿间滴落，拖出一串黏稠唾沫的痕迹；猩红尾端顶着的浑圆独眼探入幽暗，微微抽动——搜寻着猎物。它猛然一跃，一步便跳上巨岩，伏在那里嘶嘶作声，猫科般的头颅微偏，竖耳聆听闯入者的动静。
Like a panther, a beast prowls from the shadows, resonant growls issuing from deep within its fang-lined maw. Strings of stinking saliva drip from the dagger-like teeth, leaving a trail of sputum in its wake, and the globular eye crowning its crimson tail peers into the gloom, twitching—seeking prey. Abruptly it leaps atop a large rock in one bound, and crouches there hissing, feline head cocked, listening for intruders.

刻在刃身上的符文骤然明亮，内蕴的魔法正逐步显现。镀银的刃缘映住月光，古老的军刀发出轻柔的嗡鸣。你试着挥了几下，它的分量恰到好处，你随即意识到这是一把为唯一目的而铸的武器：屠戮怪物。 Runes carved into the blade shine brightly as the magic within begins to manifest. Its silvered edge catches the moonlight and a soft hum emanates from the ancient saber. It has a pleasing weight as you try a few practice swings and realize this is a weapon forged for a single purpose: to slay monsters.

Civilian Trading Vessel: Disorderly Crew.name:
民用贸易船：混乱的船员舱室
Civilian Trading Vessel: Disorderly Crew Quarters

Text.text:
生活那种杂乱而不合常理的无序，在这艘船混乱的舱室里展露无遗。每一张铺位都带着住客的怪癖，被五彩的自豪张扬出来，而船上的纪律涣散更是一眼可见。霉味扑鼻的衣物堆、空空的食物包装袋，以及各式各样的私人物件，被肆意地抛散四处，凌乱得近乎放纵。
The disordered impracticality of life is evident in the chaotic quarters of this vessel. Each bunk shows the idiosyncrasies of its occupant with colorful pride, and the lack of discipline aboard is evident. Musty heaps of clothing, empty food packets, and a myriad of personal effects are strewn around with wild abandon.

这座桥横跨一道不大却很深的沟渠。有人劈开树干，将原木横铺在缺口上，给过路人搭起一条相对平坦的通道。它宽到足以让一辆马车通过，但两侧若能各再添一根原木，会更稳妥。
The bridge spans a small but deep ditch. Someone split trees and laid them across the gap, providing a relatively level platform for travelers to cross. It’s wide enough for a wagon, but it could do with one more log on either side.

魔法不只依赖咒词、狂野的手势或古怪的物件，更依赖施法者的心境。就像你在脑海中握着的法术是一道拼图，而其他构成要素只是补上缺失的碎片。对这个法术而言，那些缺口所对应的拼图框会在你心中不断变换大小，直到你将其拼合完整。即便法术未能奏效，能把它从脑中甩脱，也令人如释重负。
Magic relies not just on words, wild gesticulations, or weird objects, but on the mindset of the spellcaster. It’s like the spell held in thought is a puzzle, and the other components provide missing pieces. For this spell, the puzzle those missing bits fit into constantly shifts sizes in your mind until you complete it. Even if the spell doesn’t work, it’s a relief to be rid of it.

有人用曾经是一头枭熊的厚实皮毛，打造出这套沉重的护甲。棕灰相间的条纹羽毛在肩颈处织成一圈装饰流苏，而枭熊巨大的利爪则被制成钩扣与搭扣，用来将护甲牢牢固定。
Someone crafted this hefty suit of armor from the thick pelt of what was once an owlbear. Its striped brown and gray feathers form a decorative fringe around the shoulders and neck, while the owlbear’s massive claws have been used as hooks and buckles to secure the armor.

它的躯体是一团圆滚滚的木瘤，密密匝匝的藤蔓从中摇曳伸出，末端全都绽着黄粉相间的小花。木结纠缠的核心嵌着一只巨大的绿眼，带着令人胆寒的漠然凝视着一切。绿眼下方，一条细长的青绿色、宛如青蛙的舌头啪地弹出又缩回，在充作牙齿的一排排尖刺间疾速游走。那些小花忽然眨了眨眼，随即猛然张开，露出更多空洞、呆滞的眼睛。

~ Envisioned by Steve Adamski

The body is a round burl of wood with many vines swaying and reaching from it, all tipped with yellow and pink flowers. A great green eye embedded in its knotty center stares with horrific indifference. Below the eye, a longish, green, frog-like tongue snaps and darts around the rows of thorns serving as its teeth. The little flowers suddenly blink, then open wide to reveal more empty, staring eyes.

~ Envisioned by Steve Adamski

Cultists' Basement.name:
邪教徒的地下室
Cultists' Basement

Text.text:
石砌的地下室乍看平平无奇：碎石与杂物散落成堆，层层污垢黏在其上。唯有一扇狭窄的小窗透进昏黄的光，尘埃在光柱里缓缓漂浮，将这逼仄的空间照得更显阴沉。可在阴影浓重的角落里，一座祭坛兀然矗立，覆着凝融滴落的蜡痕。墙上布满符文，深深刻入石面。祭坛台面上有三样物件被恭敬地摆放着：一把银质小刀、一个铸铁盆，以及一截看似风干成木乃伊的人类手指。
The stone basement at first appears mundane: littered with debris and piled clutter layered with grime. Dust floats in the dingy light from a single, narrow window, illuminating the cramped space. But in a shadowed corner an altar stands, draped in melted wax. Runes adorn the wall, carved deep into the stone. Three items have been placed reverently atop the altar's surface: a silver knife, a cast-iron basin, and what appears to be a mummified human finger.

Speech By A Watchman About Adventuring.name:
守望者关于冒险者的一段训话
Speech By A Watchman About Adventuring

Text.text:
“我也曾想当个冒险者。背上行囊闯进荒野，去寻宝，去救美人。夜里睡在林子里，头顶只有星光替我遮风挡露。如今想来倒有几分浪漫，可没过几天我就快被折磨疯了。我又臭又湿，浑身透透的，脚趾缝里还长出了某种该死的怪菌。那一刻我才明白——家乡也有的是美人等着救。也许我是个懦夫。但至少，我他妈是个过得舒服的懦夫。”
“I tried to be an adventurer once. Set out into the wilderness in search of treasures to uncover and damsels to save. Slept out in the woods with nothing but the stars to give me shelter. Sounds almost romantic now, but after a few days I was a nervous wreck. I stank, I was soaked through, and growing some kind of ungodly fungus between my toes. It was then I realized there were plenty of damsels back home. Maybe I’m a coward. But I’m a damn comfortable one at least.”

I Craft Cherry Bombs.name:
我制作樱桃炸弹
I Craft Cherry Bombs

Text.text:
我一边把粉末塞进那些微小的黏土圆球里，一边压着嗓子窃笑，眼前已经浮现出它们将掀起的欢快混乱。毫无疑问，这只是个无伤大雅的恶作剧——可落在我这样的高手手里？这些小爆竹足以把任何场合搅得一塌糊涂。
I chuckle gleefully under my breath as I pack the tiny clay spheres with powder, already picturing the delightful chaos they will sow. A harmless prank, to be sure, but in the hands of a master like myself? These little bangers could ruin any occasion.

Bejeweled Goblin Chief.name:
珠宝缀饰的地精酋长
Bejeweled Goblin Chief

Text.text:
地精那革质的绿皮每一寸都覆满宝石与珠玉，镶嵌在各式俗艳浮夸的小玩意儿上，耀得人眼花。它扬起修长尖锐的鼻子俯视着你，嘴角挂着讥诮的轻蔑；那位鎏金的酋长以穿透般的冷光打量你，清清楚楚记下你身上缺乏张扬华饰的寒酸。

~ 由 David 在 Discord 上构想

Every inch of the goblin's leathery green skin is covered in precious stones and jewels embedded in all manner of gaudy trinkets. Looking down its long, pointed nose at you with sneering contempt, the gilded chief appraises you with a piercing glare, noting your lack of audacious finery.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Fake Deck Of Illusions.name:
赝品幻象牌组
Fake Deck Of Illusions

Text.text: 粗略检查这副牌，你发现了古怪之处：你翻开的每一张牌上都写着 哥布林拉米牌戏规则。你把其中一张扔到地上，牌落之处，幻象浮现——一只哥布林正骑着某种两轮载具。 A cursory inspection of the deck reveals something strange: each card you turn over reads Rules for Goblin Rummy. You toss one on the ground, and where it lands, the illusion of a goblin riding some sort of two-wheeled conveyance appears.

当至日或分点之夜，月光点亮学院塔楼的钟面，它便在地面投下一个圆环般的倒影，仿佛浸在水里的银灰微光。那倒影随即化作一方小小的黑色池塘，池中盛满闪烁的白色星点。任何人的肌肤只要触及池水，要么便能彻夜不眠而毫无疲惫，要么就会立刻在池畔沉沉睡去。
When the academy tower clockface is lit by moonlight during a solstice or equinox, it reflects its circle on the ground in a watery, silver-gray light. That reflection becomes a small black pond full of twinkling white stars. Anyone whose skin touches the pond will either be able to stay up all night without any exhaustion or will immediately fall asleep on the pond’s bank.

I Wield My Mace Of Smiting Against A Con.name:
我挥舞惩戒钉头锤，迎击构装体
I Wield My Mace Of Smiting Against A Construct

Text.text:
这把铁制武器透着一股原始而粗粝的土腥气。钉头锤的锤首由几块粗锻的铁片拼拢而成，攒在一截简陋的柄端。唯有其中魔法的炽烈强度昭示着它的力量——直到它砸中目标。那机械结构，那由某种觉醒之物雕琢出的造物机巧，承受不住我砸下的一击：或是轰然压垮，或是直接贯穿它那无生之躯。很快，它就会再次沦为不过是一堆原料。
There is a primitive, earthy feel to this iron weapon. The head of the mace is smithed in basic plates gathered together at the top of a rudimentary handle. Only the intensity of its magic marks its power, until it connects. The machinery, the fashioned artifice of some awakened thing, cannot withstand what I deliver upon, or completely through, its unliving form. Soon it will again be no more than raw material.

Bane Cast With A Drop Of Blood.name:
以一滴鲜血施下的灾厄咒
Bane Cast With A Drop Of Blood

Text.text:
你在袋中摸到一根玫瑰刺，将它夹在拇指与食指之间用力一压。尖锐的痛楚瞬间窜过手掌，刺尖刺破皮肉。你握紧拳头，拇指朝下伸出，让一滴鲜血坠落。血珠触地的一刻，你看见猩红爬上敌人的眼眸。
You finger a rose thorn in your pouch, then press it between your thumb and forefinger. A sharp pain shoots through your hand as the thorn pierces your flesh. You hold out a fist and point your thumb down, allowing a single drop of blood to fall. As it touches the ground, you see crimson in the eyes of your foes.

你与一名身着贵族服饰的男子那双天青色的目光相撞；他穿着银亮缎面的短上衣，英气逼人，与他深蓝色的肌肤相得益彰。沿着他的袖口与剪裁利落的长裤，你能看见若隐若现的云纹暗线。他微微颔首，带着温文的笑意，周身的暖意与坦率一眼便知。一只毛茸茸的白色野兔端端正正地蹲在他麂皮靴旁，眼睛与主人同样湛蓝。它竖起的耳朵被顺滑的羽饰拉得更显修长，羽尖点着墨黑般的色泽。

~ Played by Lycerious with

You catch the sky-blue gaze of a man in noble’s attire, his silvery satin jerkin a dashing compliment to his deep blue skin. Along his sleeves and crisply tailored pants, you see subtle tracings of cloud-like patterns. He nods his head to you with a genteel grin, a warmth and openness immediately apparent. A fluffy, white hare sits primly by his suede boots, its eyes the same blue as its master. Its perked ears are elongated by sleek feathers tipped with an inky-black color.

~ Played by Lycerious with

这些古老的石阶早已被磨得光滑如玉，每一位朝圣者的跋涉都让它们再被岁月啃噬一分。山羊安然立在近旁的岩石上凝望，灰色蓬乱的毛皮在凛冽的山风中鼓胀翻涌。每一处台地都以天然泉眼的复苏之水赐予喘息——热气蒸腾的池沼向疲惫的旅人招手，邀他们浸入其中，休息酸痛的筋骨。
These ancient steps are worn smooth, each pilgrim’s journey eroding them a little further. Goats watch placidly from nearby rocks, their gray, shaggy coats billowing in the stiff mountain breeze. Each plateau offers respite in the rejuvenating waters of the natural springs—steaming pools beckoning weary travelers to rest their aching bones.

Gloating Victory Line.name:
得意的胜利台词
Gloating Victory Line

Text.text:
“不，不必鼓掌。 我也只是个和你一样的普通市民——只不过更强壮，也更好看。”
“No, please, hold your applause. I’m just a normal citizen like you—only stronger and better looking.”

Rickety Canyon Bridge.name:
摇摇欲坠的峡谷桥
Rickety Canyon Bridge

Text.text:
一座由悬吊木板拼成的桥在横向微风中轻轻摇摆，系缆处吱呀作响。它跨越的深邃峡谷里涌起一股上升气流，将细砂尘粒薄薄地扑洒在桥面上。老旧的木梁布满节疤孔洞，无疑是这趟本就险象环生的穿越中又一处脆弱的破绽。
A bridge of suspended planks swings gently in the cross breeze, creaking against its anchor points. An updraft from the yawning canyon it spans, paints the surface with a dusting of grit. The old timbers are riddled with knotholes, no doubt weak points in the already dicey crossing.

箭矢像豪猪的尖刺般密密麻麻地钉满地精的尸体，每一根箭杆都从那革质的绿色皮肉里戳出，周围鼓起一圈血淤。生物的嘴大张着，露出发黄的獠牙与一条肿胀的紫色舌头。
Arrows riddle the goblin’s corpse like the spines of a hedgehog, each shaft protruding from leathery green flesh in a welt of blood. The creature’s mouth hangs open, revealing yellowed fangs and a bulbous purple tongue.

Belgrim Redbeard.name:
贝尔格里姆·红胡子
Belgrim Redbeard

Text.text:
矮人站得稳如磐石，肩宽背阔，胸膛如桶，拳头似铁锤。头发赤红如炉心之火，顶部修剪得短而利落；胡须却一直垂到腰际。一道银色的纹路宛如珍贵矿脉，自胡须正中劈开而下。他披着厚重甲胄：黑色胸甲与护肩，铜制臂铠与护胫。矮人扛起一柄巨大的战锤，锤身仿佛散发出熔炉般摇曳的灼热光辉。

~ 由 Trevor E. 扮演

The dwarf stands stout and sturdy, with broad shoulders, a barrel chest, and fists like hammers. His hair, red as the heart of a forge, is kept short and tidy on top, while his beard hangs to his belt. A streak of silver, like a vein of precious metal, splits his beard down its center. Heavily armored with a black breastplate and pauldrons, gauntlets, and greaves of copper, the dwarf hefts a massive warhammer that seems to radiate with the shimmering heat of a forge.

~ Played by Trevor E.

你周遭的世界被一种陌异的、超凡脱俗的美所统御。河流在阳光下闪烁发亮。群山如尖塔般拔地而起，刺破上方的云层。井然有序的建筑与农田零星点缀在这片大地上。河水从这块浮空陆块的边缘倾泻而下，化作飞散的水雾，消散在风里。
The world around you is dominated by a strange, otherworldly beauty. Rivers gleam in the light of the sun. Mountains rise, spire-like, piercing the clouds above. Orderly structures and farmlands dot the landscape here and there. The rivers cascade over the side of this floating landmass, dissipating into the wind.

Dungeon: Cold Air.name:
地城：寒气逼人
Dungeon: Cold Air

Text.text:
一阵刺骨寒气沿着甬道翻涌而来。裸露的皮肤在低温中发麻，呼出的气息化作一团团可见的白雾。越往走廊深处，地面与墙壁的潮湿石面越发湿滑，霜花与冰锥在地底的寒意中逐渐凝结成形。
A burst of frigid air rolls through the passage. Any exposed skin prickles in the low temperature and exhalations become visible puffs of breath. The damp stone of the floor and walls grows slick deeper into the corridor, with frost and icicles forming in the subterranean cold.

Opening The Bones Of The Earth.name:
开启大地之骨
Opening The Bones Of The Earth

Text.text:
你将手掌掠过地面，一道巨大的断层随之显现。大地震颤，轰然裂开，露出下方参差嶙峋的沉积层与基岩。六根石柱应你号令自新生的裂隙中拔地而起。
You draw your hand across the ground and a great fault line appears. The earth quakes and splits open, exposing the jagged sediment and bedrock beneath. Six pillars appear at your command, rising from the newly formed fissure.

支离破碎、残缺不全的尸身横陈在泥泞战场那堆腐肉般的浆泥之中，每一具都诉说着一段被硬生生截断的生命。那些曾懂得年少的爱恋、心碎的痛楚、冰凉麦酒与母亲拥抱的面孔，此刻从淤泥里无神地仰望着你，在污浊的泥浆中一点点冷却。
Broken, mutilated bodies lie among the charnel slurry of the muddy battlefield, each one a life cut short. Faces which once knew young love, broken hearts, cold ale, and a mother’s embrace gaze lifelessly up at you from the mire as they grow cold in the muck.

数十只鹿聚成一群。它们踱步啃食，优雅的长颈时而伸展，警惕地巡视四周，硕大的耳朵不时一颤。鹿群中，一头雄鹿昂然挺立，掌状鹿角自他威严的头顶分叉伸展。
Dozens of deer have formed a herd. They pace and graze, stretching their graceful necks to surveil their surroundings, and twitching their large ears. A buck stands proud among them, with palmate antlers branching from his regal head.

Approaching The Temple Of The Fallen In.name:
白昼逼近堕落神殿
Approaching The Temple Of The Fallen In Daylight

Text.text:
一座由白色石块堆砌、正逐渐崩塌的建筑，在冲积沙丘与热浪扭曲的空气中格外醒目。带着橙色光晕的沙粒在四周聚拢，却尚未将其掩蔽，也未堵住残破墙体间的缝隙。北面，一尊巨大的、与沙同色的蛇像探出头颅，高高越过建筑，目光朝南凝望着一抹水光……那真是水，还是海市蜃楼？
A crumbling structure of white stones stands out among the alluvial dunes and heat shimmers. Orange-tinged sand gathers around the place but has yet to cover it or choke the gaps in the broken walls. To the north, the head of an enormous, sand-colored serpent statue rises over the building. It gazes southward at a glimmer of water… or is it a mirage?

这尊眼镜蛇神像的兜帽蛇首高高昂起，远远凌驾于墙垣与立柱之上。底部巨大的盘绕蛇身支援着整座雕像。它那蛇类的面孔透出凶戾，獠牙森然的口大张着，长舌外吐。然而那空洞的眼眶——或许曾镶嵌着巨大的宝石——却削弱了这位被遗忘神祇的威势。
The hooded head of this cobra idol rears well above the walls and standing pillars. Huge coils support the statue at the base. Fierceness emanates from its ophidian face, with its fanged mouth open and tongue extended. But the hollow eye sockets, once home to great jewels, perhaps, diminish the menace of this forgotten god.

Pentacle Sacrifice Chamber.name:
五芒星献祭密室
Pentacle Sacrifice Chamber

Text.text:
房间中央的五芒星，是以浸透鲜血的研磨碎骨绘成。图案周围立着几支半融的蜡烛，蜡质怪异，香气浓烈得刺鼻；它们不久前才被点燃，尽管这些走廊早在一段时代之前就已被清空，连陈设都不剩。但最令人不寒而栗的，是一条巨大的猩红血痕——从五芒星的中心一路拖曳，横贯房间，穿过一扇紧闭的铁栅门；那铁栅门上三分之一处已被血浸透，死死封住了东侧走廊。
The pentacle in the room’s center is composed of ground bone soaked in blood. Half-melted candles of a strange and heavily scented wax stand around the design; they have been recently lit, even though the halls were cleared of furnishings some time ago. But the most chilling sight is a massive streak of red that travels from the pentacle’s center across the room and through a closed portcullis, which is soaked in blood a third of the way up and blocks the eastern corridor.

The Banking Borough In Winter.name:
冬日的银行区
The Banking Borough In Winter

Text.text:
自治市的银行与金融中心都披上了最喜庆的盛装——花环、枝圈、窗上手绘的字符。更讲究的场所里，大堂摆着直抵天花板的高树。交易所高塔以歪斜的身形压迫般耸立，屋顶上栖着那只永远警觉的乌鸦。从街上很难看清它的模样，但它似乎在脖子上围着一条针织围巾。高塔的门上，没有松枝花环，取而代之的是一条编辫面包：点点嵌着干果，表面刷着糖釉，泛着亮光。
The banks and financial centers of the borough are covered in their festive best—garlands, wreaths, hand-drawn characters painted on windows. Ceiling-high trees can be seen in the lobbies of fancier establishments. The Exchange Tower looms with its crooked form, the ever-vigilant crow perched atop its roof. From the street, it is hard to get a clear sight of the bird, but it seems to be wearing a knitted scarf around its neck. On the door of the Tower, a loaf of braided bread, pockmarked with pieces of dried fruit and shining with a glaze, hangs instead of a pine wreath.

Sundries From A Nycaloth.name:
来自尼卡洛斯的杂物
Sundries From A Nycaloth

Text.text:
在这头畸形生物臃肿的尸骸上，你找到一块蓝色的腿肉、一对由刻骨打磨成的骰子，以及一本小巧的皮革装订日记，密密记着两百年前那场战斗的始末。
On the hulking corpse of the grotesque creature, you find a haunch of blue meat, a pair of dice made from carved bones, and a small, leather-bound diary listing the events of a battle two hundred years ago.

这些在职律师的事务所里摆着朴素却做工精良的硬木家具；然而真正令人震撼的，是沿着每面墙壁层层书架上塞满的巨册——数量之多、分量之沉，几乎压得空气都发紧。因为每一卷书页之间都藏着无尽的法理：邻近矮人王国的刑律典章；由一位声名赫赫、早已死去的暴君所传下的人类古法；关于刑罚正当性的道德论述；以及没完没了、没完没了的庭审记录史，为援引法律先例而存在。
Decked out in simple but well-crafted hardwood furniture, the offices of these practicing solicitors are nonetheless impressive for the sheer number and weight of tomes filling the shelves along each wall. For within each volume, boundless legal knowledge can be found: criminal codes of a nearby dwarven kingdom; ancient laws of man handed down from a famous, long-dead despot; treatises on the morality of punishment; and endless, endless histories of courtroom proceedings for citing legal precedence.

投石索这种简朴而古老的技术，带来一种令人安心的可靠感。它不过是陈旧的皮革与一只承托弹丸的索兜，但在娴熟之人的手中，这件武器依旧致命。
The simple, ancient technology of the sling provides a comforting reliability. Little more than aged leather and a munitions cradle, the weapon is still lethal in skilled hands.

Waterfall In Dark Crevasse Of Cave.name:
洞穴幽暗裂隙中的瀑布
Waterfall In Dark Crevasse Of Cave

Text.text:
这里的地面在此处断裂成层层突出的岩台，构成一道巨大而幽深的裂谷峭壁，一座石桥横跨其上。水从其中一处岩台倾泻而下，坠入昏暗深处时由溪流碎裂成漫天水雾。瀑布所在的岩台周围峭壁上粘着几簇蜘蛛卵囊，虽然它们遮挡了视线，你仍看见水正从一个狭小的洞道里涌出。
The floor here breaks up into ledges creating the wall of a vast and deep crevasse spanned by a stone bridge. Water pours from one of the ledges, turning from stream to spray as it falls away into the gloom. A few clusters of spider eggs cling to the cliff around the waterfall’s ledge, but despite them impeding your view, you see that there is a small tunnel out of which the water flows.

Meddlesome Pixies.name:
爱管闲事的皮克西
Meddlesome Pixies

Text.text:
附近的树篱里抖出一阵尖细的咯咯笑，像高音合唱，紧接着是翅翼嗡嗡旋转的震鸣。紧密叠压的叶片间探出一张尖刻的脸，神情阴损，肤色如海沫般发青。另一张脸从灌木顶端蹦出，正啃咬着一只蝴蝶。他们指向一个毫无防备的路人，用压低却刺人的声音彼此说话。随即他们从藏身处猛扑出来，昆虫般的翅膀在空气中掀起粗陋的震颤。他们疾冲向目标，引得旁观者尖叫四起，也有人发疯般手忙脚乱去抓魔杖与法杖。
A treble chorus of giggles shakes out from nearby hedges, followed by a whirring buzz of wings. A pinched face, pestiferous in expression and the color of seafoam, peeks out between the tightly packed leaves. A second pops out of the top of the bush, gnawing on a butterfly. They point at an unwitting passerby, speaking to one another in hushed, needling voices. They fling themselves out of their hiding place, their insectoid wings sending crude vibrations through the air. They zoom to their target, eliciting screams from onlookers, as well as mad scrambling for wands and staves.

I Cast Animal Messenger.name:
我施放《动物信使》
I Cast Animal Messenger

Text.text:
我吟唱这道法术：这里有一口你喜欢的美味，这里也有个忙想请你相助。前方有一天，也有个人要去寻，我会把他描述给你听，好让你知道该落在何处。用我的声音说出这些话，然后回来领赏吧，我的好朋友。
I sing the spell: Here is a morsel of something you like, and here is a favor I ask you to lend. Ahead is the day and a person to find, described for you so you know where to land. Speak these words in my voice, then return for a treat, my good friend.

银丝交织成网，贯穿这件黑色武装衬衣。部分银线织成繁复的符文构图，在视野里蠕动游移，令人目眩心乏。夹袄上的绳索与环扣暗示它们生来便是彼此捆缚相连，而非用来系上护甲。内置兜帽垂着遮眼的面纱；其上以皮带与搭扣牢牢固定着一枚口具，意在封住双唇，令舌头归于沉默。
Threads of silver form a mesh through this black arming shirt. Some of the threads form elaborate runic schematics that crawl in the vision and make the mind weary. Cords and loops in the gambeson suggest they’re made to be bound together rather than to pieces of armor. A built-in hood has a shroud for the eyes. Fastened to it via leathers straps and buckles is a mouthpiece meant to seal lips and still the tongue.

I Cast Comprehend Languages On Writing.name:
我对文字施放了「通晓语言」
I Cast Comprehend Languages On Writing

Text.text:
指尖沾着烟灰与盐粒，我以接触触碰那满页我无法理解的文字。我开口吟诵；当法术收尾之际，符号化作字母，继而连成词句，最终含义在我眼前豁然清晰。
With soot and salt on my fingers, I touch a page full of writing I cannot understand. I speak, and as I finish the spell, the symbols become letters that then become words, and finally the meaning clarifies before my very eyes.

Samina Saydalia's Apothecary.name:
萨米娜·赛达莉娅的药剂铺
Samina Saydalia's Apothecary

Text.text:
萨米娜深焦糖色的肌肤平日里总泛着一层魔法般的护光，像无形的护甲贴在身上。正因如此，她在熬制药剂、试验那些暴烈易燃的粉末时，胆子也更大几分。她个子出奇地高，身形瘦削，光头利落，眼睛是比肤色更浅的一抹淡色。她做实验时穿着朋克靴、演唱会T恤和工装背带裤，把实验室当成自己的舞台。

你在她的药剂店里见到她正帮一位顾客挑选药品；她那迷人又圆润的口音、松弛得会传染的态度一并落在你眼里。她一边示范一边讲解，医药词汇信手拈来，仿佛每个药名都被她说得有了重量与温度。
Samina’s deep-caramel skin usually glows with a magical sheen of protection. In this way, she can be more bold brewing potions and experimenting with volatile powders. She is impressively tall, thin, and bald, and her eyes are a lighter shade of her skin. She conducts her lab work in punk boots, concert T-shirts, and overalls. You find her helping a customer in her apothecary shop, and you note her charming, smooth accent and contagiously relaxed manner as she demonstrates a remarkable vocabulary in medicines.

Green Githyanki.name:
绿色吉斯洋基
Green Githyanki

Text.text:
那名绿皮女子的五官锋利如她所携的邪刃；当你迎上她冷冽、异质而疏离的目光时，一阵寒意顺着脊背直窜上来。她行动间带着冠军般笃定的自信，每一步都大胆而果决，步步踏出明确的意图。
The green woman’s features are as sharp as the wicked blade she carries, and the cold, alien, detachment in her eyes causes a shiver to run up your spine when you meet her implacable gaze. She moves with the self-assured confidence of a champion, every step bold and filled with purpose.

人们说，最伟大的军阀与最嗜血的士兵在死后都会投入地狱军团的行列。你眼前的战士仿佛正是这句话的铁证。她的板甲上布满细小的刮痕与凹痕，像是从千场胜战里一点点刻出来的；而她手中的武器跃跃欲试，活像一条迫不及待要扑咬的战犬，在无形的牵绳下狠命挣扎。
They say that the greatest warlords and most bloodthirsty soldiers serve in the ranks of Hell’s armies after death. The warrior before you seems proof of that claim. Her plate armor bears small scratches and dents from a thousand battles won, and the weapon in her hand leaps about like an eager attack dog tugging at its leash.

在昏暗中，闪烁的烟雾勾勒出一只巨型猫科的轮廓——足有九英尺长——却生着狮子的鬃毛与尾巴。倒刺般的尖刺从它鬃间的脊背上突出，也刺在尾端的毛簇里。它悄无声息地踱步向前。每迈出一步，喉间便滚出低沉的咆哮，双眼随之点燃幽灵般的火焰。
In the gloom, shimmering smoke defines the form of a massive cat—nine feet long—with the mane and tail of a lion. Barbed spikes project from the spine in its mane and the tuft of its tail. It pads forward. As it does, it growls low and its eyes light with spectral fire.

Castle Covered Parapet Walk.name:
城堡覆顶女儿墙巡道
Castle Covered Parapet Walk

Text.text:
暴雨如锤猛砸屋顶，你行走在封闭走廊里那段有顶的城垛下，震耳欲聋的回响在耳畔轰鸣。透过外墙狭窄的射孔，你看见水幕翻涌，狂乱倾泻，狠狠砸向下方的土地。
Rain hammers the roof, causing deafening echoes as you walk beneath the covered parapet along the enclosed corridor. Through the narrow slits in the outer wall, you can see the watery tumult crashing down on the lands below.

I Cast Locate Creature.name:
我施放“定位生物”
I Cast Locate Creature

Text.text:
无数道魔法丝线自我体内延展而出，如同帆船索具的绳缆。我念出所寻生物的名字，几缕丝线便开始颤动。我将双手覆在丝线上，烙下我的意志……没错！有一根丝线比其余的更为欢跃地震鸣。我能沿着那根丝线听见目标的声音，穿越这座朦胧的桥梁，以轻柔的耳语飘然而至。
Multitudinous threads of magic extend out from me like the ropes of a ship’s rigging. I speak the name of my queried creature and a few of the threads begin to tremble. I place my hands over the threads and impress my will… and yes! One thread thrums more lively than the rest. I can hear the voice of my target along the thread, arriving across this nebulous bridge in soft whispers.

Skeleton Crucified On Tree.name:
被钉死在树上的骷髅（特征）
Skeleton Crucified On Tree

Text.text:
你走近一幅惨淡的景象：一具骷髅被钉在一棵虬结的树上，宛如受难的十字架。它四肢大张，仿佛永陷无尽折磨。食腐者与天气早已剥尽血肉与脏器，只剩一座粗砺而沉默的纪念碑，铭刻着酷刑与死亡的冷酷真相。
You approach a bleak tableau: a skeleton crucified upon a gnarled tree. Its limbs are spread wide, as if in perpetual torment. Scavengers and weather have shorn away any flesh or organs, leaving only a blunt memorial to torture and mortality.

Night Blade Encounter.name:
夜刃遭遇
Night Blade Encounter

Text.text:
你兜帽遮面的袭击者血丝密布的双眼里燃着杀意，他们的剥皮刀每一次突刺都由嗜血欲望驱动。浓烈的血腥恶臭如死亡瘴气般裹住那身阴影重重的衣袍，凝固的血痂在龟裂发黄的指甲下结成硬壳。
Murder burns in the bloodshot eyes of your hooded assailant, each thrust of their flensing knives fueled by bloodlust. The stench of gore coats their shadowy clothing like a miasma of death, and congealed blood crusts beneath cracked, yellow nails.

女人把头歪向一侧，蛇一般的发丝因恼怒而扭动翻卷。爬行类的眼眸——泛着惨白的巫光——死死锁住老矮人的目光；他一步步逼近，颈间的圣徽撞在饱经摧残的板甲护甲上，哐啷作响。“你那肮脏的法术对我没用，女巫。”他的声音如雷霆般在屋内滚过。“反正我也看不见你有多丑！”

~ 扮演者：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The woman’s head tilts to one side, her serpentine hair writhing in frustration. Reptilian eyes—aglow with pallid witch light—hold the old dwarf’s gaze as he advances towards her, the holy symbol around his neck clattering noisily against battered plate armor. “Yer foul magics won’t work on me, witch.” His voice rolls across the room like thunder. “I can’t see how ugly ye are!”

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

这里的堤岸被凿出一段陡峭的石阶，自道路一路向下，通往河畔一处开阔的洼地。厚实木桩深深钉入泥土，牢牢固定着木板铺就的步道，免得小径在雨水里化作一条泥泞的滑坡。
A steep set of stairs has been cut into the embankment here, descending from the road to a broad hollow beside the river. Planks of wood, held in place by stout posts driven into the earth, keep the pathway from becoming a muddy slide.

Sundries From A Young Green Dragon.name:
来自一条年轻绿龙的杂物
Sundries From A Young Green Dragon

Text.text:
森林洞窟的天花板上垂挂着一件件陶器，爬行的绿藤在其间交织成格；每一件都被精心摆放，悉心打理，宛如匠心陈列。
Pottery latticed with creeping green vines hangs from the ceiling in the forest cave, each piece carefully arranged and artfully maintained.

I Cast Magic Circle.name:
我施放魔法法阵
I Cast Magic Circle

Text.text:
随着一阵迅疾翻涌的移动，魔法弯折回旋，在地面上方织出一段短促的能量循环。转瞬之间，那团缥缈的云雾倏然消散，取而代之的是地面上浮现的符文，勾勒出一个圆的周界。符号柔和地闪烁着，宛如尘埃下金银碎屑轻轻眨眼。
In a swift, billowing movement, the magic bends and curves to create a short cycle of energy over the ground. In a blink, the ethereal cloud dissipates and runes appear on the ground in its place, creating the circumference of a circle. The symbols glitter gently, like bits of gold and silver winking under dust.

这道法术源自久远的时代，强大——也极易失手施放。你花费时间做好准备，确认各项材料与构件都已就位。你缓缓吐出一口气，将全部心神凝聚在眼前的生物身上。仪式漫长而繁复；当你终于塑成雪与冰的形骸，并将一缕拟真的生命气息灌注其中时，一个完美的复制体已立在你面前。
The spell is an ancient one, powerful—and easy to cast incorrectly. You take time to prepare, ensuring the components are in place. You ease out a breath and focus your attention on the creature before you. The ritual is lengthy and involved, but as you finish sculpting the snow and ice, and as you imbue it with a facsimile of life, a perfect double stands before you.

Walking The Line Between Life And Death.name:
行走于生死之间
Walking The Line Between Life And Death

Text.text:
如潮汐般，你的生命起落消长；随着日复一日的流逝，愈发漂向远方，被时代之沙一点点拖拽而去。你已在这条界线上行走多日，在诸界之间浮沉，暮光般的存续里，你的本质渐渐衰弱。死亡似乎注意到了你的旅程，一面打磨得光亮的镜子出现在你面前。迎接你的，并非你的倒影。

~ 由 Discord 上的 Inbal Envisioned

Like a tide, your life ebbs and flows, drifting further and further out with each passing day as the sands of time drag it away. You have walked this line for many days, floating between realms as your essence weakens in this twilight existence. Death, it seems, has taken notice of your journey, and a polished mirror appears before you. It is not your reflection that greets you.

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

Victorian Pub In Cybercity.name:
赛博城里的维多利亚酒馆
Victorian Pub In Cybercity

Text.text:
这间古怪的小酒吧藏在大学附近，城里那刺目的霓虹光在这里荡然无存。你推门而入，真实皮革的泥土气息迎面扑来；城市生活里无处不在的科技低鸣，被一种震耳欲聋的寂静所取代。吧台后，一名留着小胡子、戴着高礼帽的男人在抛光木质吧台后向你致意，像杂耍歌舞剧的主持人般，热情欢迎你来到这里。

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

The neon glare of the city is absent from this curious little bar tucked away near the university. As you step inside, the earthy scent of real leather greets you, and the ambient hum of technology—omnipresent in city life—is replaced by a deafening stillness. A mustachioed man with a top hat greets you from behind a polished wooden bar, welcoming you to the establishment like a vaudeville showman.

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

教室像月亮般绕着高塔尖顶缓缓环行，透明的墙壁将庭院与四周乡野尽收眼底。穹顶天花板拱覆在众人上方，宛如一只黑猫弓起脊背，肚腹缀满星光，铺陈出一片浩瀚星海与无数星座。女教授举起法杖，让整间教室的转动戛然而止，好指给学生们看某个特定的星群纹样。

~ 一位英雄所构想

The classroom orbits like a moon around the tower spire, its transparent walls offering full view of the grounds and surrounding countryside. Its domed ceiling arches above the class like a black cat with a star-spangled belly, presenting a sea of constellations. The professor raises her staff to pause the motion of the room so that she may point out a particular pattern of stars to the students.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Approaching A Haunted Hillside Tomb.name:
靠近闹鬼的山坡墓冢
Approaching A Haunted Hillside Tomb

Text.text:
荆棘丛像利爪般攀上这座奇特的平顶小丘；它足有六十英尺高，却因矮胖方正的轮廓而显得没那么巍峨。沿着山丘边缘侦察时，你发现几处灰沙地面，上面有前人抓挠出的骷髅头轮廓；其中一些沙坑里还堆着碎石，排成眼窝与牙齿的形状。掠过这阴森的陈列，你瞥见一处摇摇欲坠的石质壁架，半被带刺灌木遮蔽；它从山丘北侧的阴影凹陷处探出，悬在其上。这里散落着被丢弃、断裂的长柄武器，而在其间，有三处一眼可辨的挖掘口，深浅不一，正被流动的砂砾缓慢回填。隧道向下蜿蜒，钻入黑暗。

~ 构想：Thundyrcat

Bramble patches claw their way up a curious, flat-topped hill, its sixty-foot height diminished by its squat, boxy shape. Scouting its perimeter, you find patches of gray sand in which previous visitors have scratched the outline of a death’s-head. Gravel piles arranged in some of them suggest eyes and teeth. Passing this grim gallery, you spy a precarious stone ledge partly obscured by thorny shrubs. It juts out over a shadowed depression in the hill’s north face. Here, amid discarded and splintered polearms, are three unmistakable excavations in various stages of being slowly refilled by the shifting aggregate. Downward the tunnels wind, into the dark.

~ Envisioned by Thundyrcat

I Cast Heat Metal Using Components.name:
我以材料成分施放【炽热金属】
I Cast Heat Metal Using Components

Text.text:
话语急促而怒火翻涌，仿佛专为重新点燃熔炉的狂暴而铸。我看着掌中的铁在火焰里发黑，继而炽白如同被直插进铁匠的煤炭深处，却没有灼伤我。那白炽的怒意在我的目标身上显形——它开始闷燃，散发出深沉而灼烈的橙红光芒，随着魔法攫住它而愈发炽亮。
The words are fast and full of anger, designed to reignite the fury of the forge. I watch as the iron in my hand blackens in the flame, growing white hot as if plunged into the blacksmith’s coal, yet it does not burn me. Its incandescent rage manifests in my target, which begins to smolder and glow a deep, burning orange as the magic takes hold.

Divine Vessel Of A God Of Sailors.name:
水手之神的神圣容器
Divine Vessel Of A God Of Sailors

Text.text:
每一根桅杆都垂直如尺，每一面帆都收放得恰到好处。索具用的是细绳，却有铁一般的劲道；舵轮转向正点，迎风改向或顺风换舷，都干净利落。为这艘神圣之舟效力，回报是荣耀：不论是商人还是洗手上岸的海盗，船员都能睡在洁净的吊床里，餐桌上吃得饱，杯中喝得到好朗姆。货舱入港时必定满载，所有货物毫发无损。船艏像刻着船长的面容——水手眼中的神明。它让岸上的孩子心生向往，投身大海，敢闯深渊，去探索这整个世界。
Every mast is plumb, every sail trimmed fit. The rigging is fine rope with iron strength, and the wheel spins to the right point, tacking or jibing. Working on the divine vessel is rewarded with honor: whether merchants or former pirates, the crew will sleep well in clean hammocks, eat well at the board, and drink good rum. The holds will come to harbor full, all cargo unspoiled. The figurehead is a likeness of the captain, a god among sailors. It inspires a child ashore to take to the sea, brave the depths, and explore the world.

I Draw A Javelin From My Efficient Quive.name:
我从高效箭袋中抽出一支标枪
I Draw A Javelin From My Efficient Quiver

Text.text:
我以一气呵成的移动从箭袋中抽出一支标枪，将其高举待击；下一支已在那奥术配饰中循位而上，接替其空缺。仿佛训练有素的士兵，新标枪毫不迟疑地填补前任留下的缺口。
In one fluid movement, I draw a javelin from my quiver, raising it to strike before the next takes its place in the arcane accessory. Like a well-drilled soldier, the new javelin fills the gap left by its predecessor without hesitation.

A Respite Tavern.name:
小憩酒馆
A Respite Tavern

Text.text:
当你从寒冷中踏入室内，壁炉那令人沉醉的暖意便融化了你酸痛的骨头；你关上门，挡住刺骨的冷风，大片雪花在你脚边打着旋儿。一个欢快的曲调迎面而来——尽管是由一名半兽人村中少年用中提琴摇摇晃晃地拉出来的——仍将你更深地牵引进这间温馨的小店。烤肉与蔬菜的香气令你不由得口舌生津，你穿过人群，朝房间角落那张空桌走去。你落座后环顾这间热闹的酒馆，心中感谢神祇，让你在这段漫长而艰辛的旅途中得享片刻喘息。
The blissful warmth of the hearth defrosts your aching bones as you come in from the cold, with large snowflakes whirling at your feet as you close the door from the chilly wind. A jolly tune—if somewhat wobblingly played on the viola by a half-orc village youth—greets you, pulling you further into the cozy establishment. You salivate at the scent of roasted meat and vegetables as you find your way toward an empty table at the corner of the room. Taking a seat, you look around at the busy tavern, thanking the gods for this respite from your long, arduous journey.

Cone Of Cold Resisted By All.name:
寒冰锥被全员抵抗
Cone Of Cold Resisted By All

Text.text:
你的法术材料化作迅速消融的冰块；你一边比划一边吟诵，指缝间的寒意愈发刺骨。你从双手轰然射出寒潮，瞬间将整间厅室灌满。你听见解冻时噼啪作响、嘶嘶作声，嗅到冰冷的霜气——可随即你沮丧地意识到，这道法术太弱了。尽管你的对手都被冻得一颤，他们却纷纷化解了你的攻势，依旧岿然不动。
Your spell component transforms to quickly melting ice, and as you gesture and speak you can feel it growing cold between your fingers. You fire the blast from your hands, filling the chamber with it. You hear the crackle and hiss of thawing and smell the cold frost, but then realize with dismay that the spell is weak. Although your opponents are chilled, they have all countered your efforts and continue to stand firm.

Sea Devil Scout.name:
海魔斥候
Sea Devil Scout

Text.text: 你瞥见一抹翠绿鳞光与猩红眼眸一闪而过——突出的下颚间，歪斜的尖牙森然发亮。那蜥蜴般的战士以两足疾奔，利爪紧握长矛直指前方，修长的蹼尾在身后舒展，以老练的平衡稳住身形。它朝你猛冲而来时，你的脑海里骤然响起一道陌生的声音，像回声般下达命令，嘶哑而原始：战斗！ You see a flash of green scales and red eyes—crooked teeth shining from a prognathic jaw. The reptilian warrior runs on two legs, spear outstretched in clawed hands and long webbed tail extended behind them in practiced balance. As they rush toward you, you feel a foreign voice in your mind, an echoed command, raspy and primitive: Fight!

Foreboding Dawn Sky.name:
不祥的黎明天空
Foreboding Dawn Sky

Text.text:
本该在旭日的暖意里得到慰藉，今日的光却呈现霉腐般的蓝绿，夹杂着焦虑的灰色条纹。仿佛黑夜拒不松手，硬生生把黎明撕扯开来。太阳苍白黯淡地铺在地平线上，低声呢喃着冰冷的警告。
Where there should be comfort in the warmth of a rising sun, today the light is the blue-green of mold and rot and streaked with the gray of angst. It’s as if the night refuses to let go, pulling apart the dawn. The sun, pale and washed across the horizon, whispers a cold warning.

一声尖锐的嗖响宣告飞镖的存在——它以惊人的速度自雕像口中激射而出。陷阱虽明显古老破败，却依旧运作得分毫不差——只可惜，倒霉的是你。 A sharp thwip announces the presence of the dart as it flies from the statue’s mouth with incredible speed. Though clearly ancient, the dilapidated trap functions perfectly—unfortunately for you.

高大、肤色黝黑、肌肉结实，带着士兵那种硬朗的锻造感，却又在眼神里有着圣武士般的慈悲。他伫立在旧都遗迹之上。残骸铺展到天际，像一片久已焚尽的焦黑森林。他抬手抚过寸短的头发，锁子甲在云隙间接住几缕黯淡的光。胸甲上烙着他失落故国的帝国纹章。长剑仍在鞘中，盾牌依旧扣在背上。王权战乱的年代已被他抛在身后。

~ Played by Walt M. with

Tall, dark, and muscled in the hard way of the soldier yet kind in the eyes like a paladin, the man stands over the relics of his capital. Spread against the horizon, its remains resemble a forest long ago burned. He runs a hand over his close-cropped hair, and his chain mail catches some dull light between the clouds. The imperial crest of his fallen home is emblazoned on the chestpiece. His sword is sheathed, and a shield remains strapped to his back. The age of royal war is behind him.

~ Played by Walt M. with

Crystalline Floor.name:
水晶般的地面
Crystalline Floor

Text.text:
这间舞厅的地面与你以往所见截然不同，仿佛一整片大理石般的祖母绿，晶莹、平滑。光线渗入其中，如墨洇上羊皮纸般漫开，使那些水晶般的结构泛起异世的幽辉。地面本身铺展开横贯全室的纹样，描绘着盛放的藤蔓，最终汇入一圈巨大的繁茂植被。
The floor of this ballroom is unlike anything you’ve seen before, a kind of marbled emerald, crystalline and smooth. Light penetrates it, bleeding through like ink on parchment, setting the crystal formations aglow with an otherworldly light. Room-spanning designs in the floor itself depict flowering vines, terminating in a large circle of vegetation.

Xulgath Skulker.name:
地蜥人潜行者
Xulgath Skulker

Text.text:
干燥鳞片在地面上窸窣滑行的低语，是你唯一的警告——那惨黄的生物已如疾影般朝你扑来，枯槁的手臂举着匕首。它狭长的脸侧鼓起赭黄的眼球，眼中漆黑的细缝骤然放大。你眼睁睁看着，它下颌两侧带蹼的嘴角被扯得极开，弯曲的獠牙间喷出嘶嘶声。珠母般的鳞片短暂闪烁，旋即融入颜色，贴合环境。紧接着，那东西的恶臭像重锤般狠狠砸来，翻涌的恶心随之纠缠不散。
The whisper of dry scales slinking across the ground is your only warning as the sallow creature streaks toward you, daggers raised by emaciated arms. The creature’s black slits dilate inside the ocher orbs bulging from the sides of its narrow face. As you watch, the webbed corners of its jaw stretch wide as it hisses through curved fangs. Nacreous scales glimmer momentarily before blending to match the environment. Then the stench of the thing hits you as hard as a hammer blow, and the ensuing nausea plagues you.

Loot From A Vampire Child.name:
来自吸血鬼孩童的战利品
Loot From A Vampire Child

Text.text:
一枚做工精美的金质别针，价值30枚金币，隐在那阴险生物如乌鸦巢般纠结的发丛深处。别针上刻着一只蜂鸟正从盛放的花朵中啜饮花蜜；这件饰物如同冰冷的警示，残酷地提醒着人们这孩子真正的本性。
An exquisitely wrought golden clasp worth 30 gold pieces is nestled in the raven thicket of the insidious creature’s hair. Depicting a hummingbird sipping nectar from a blooming flower, this ornament serves as a grim reminder of the child’s true nature.

Sewer Junction.name:
下水道交汇处
Sewer Junction

Text.text:
半打管道与水渠在此汇聚，通向这片庞大下水道系统的核心枢纽。污浊的咸臭积水在渠中流淌，于此汇成一汪又迅速倾泻，打着旋儿向下坠去，没入更深处某个未知的排口。狭窄的栈道纵横交错，有些是用废木与碎石拼搭而成。你不由得猜想是谁修的，旋即又打消念头——有些画面，还是别太急着在脑中成形。
A half-dozen pipes and channels lead here, to a junction at the heart of the expansive sewer system. The foul, brackish water flowing through the channels pools and empties here, spiraling downward to some unknown drain deeper within the complex. Narrow walkways criss-cross, some constructed of scrap wood and stone. You wonder who constructed them, then think better of imagining too readily.

Snake-themed Sacrificial Chamber.name:
蛇之祭献密室
Snake-themed Sacrificial Chamber

Text.text:
巨大的拱顶厅堂里，一座深坑吞吐着炼狱般的猩红光芒，两侧蛇形雕像如卫兵般伫立。滞涩的空气里弥漫着浓烈的铜腥味，你看见石面上被凿出锯齿般的细沟，条条将鲜血引向那张饥渴的裂口。张开的深渊之口上方，一座平台由饰纹铁链悬吊其上，承载着一座骇人的祭坛，台面覆满献祭的血污。

~ Envisioned by LORD_BUMBLE

Serpentine statues flank a pit glowing with infernal red light in the large, vaulted chamber. The stagnant air is laced with the potent scent of copper, and you notice jagged rivulets carved into the stone, each channeling blood toward the ravenous aperture. Suspended above the yawning maw on decorated iron chains, a platform carries a macabre altar that is covered in sacrificial gore.

~ Envisioned by LORD_BUMBLE

覆着诡异符文纹身的炭黑皮肤包裹着那道向你阔步逼近的巍峨身影。她的步伐快得不可思议，直到你意识到这巨人至少有三层楼高，跨过大多数建筑就像你迈过酒馆长凳一样轻松。她提着一杆如树身般修长的长矛，身上穿着足够一整群牲畜剥下来的皮革护甲。她冲锋时猛地把巨石般的头颅一甩，猩红的发辫如闪电般分叉飞扬，獠牙森然的巨口随之爆出一声霹雳般的怒吼。
Charcoal skin tattooed in eldritch runes covers the towering figure striding toward you. Her pace seems impossible, until you realize the giant is at least three stories tall and could step over most buildings as you would a tavern bench. She carries a tree-length spear and wears an entire herd's worth of leather armor. As she charges, she flicks her boulder head back, her carmine braids forking like lightning bolts as her tusked maw releases a roar like a thunderclap.

Dwarven City Square Harvestbrew Festival.name:
矮人城邦广场·丰酿节
Dwarven City Square Harvestbrew Festival

Text.text:
在这座城市肃穆而宏伟的背景下，节庆徐徐铺展。空气里弥漫着令人沉醉的香气——新收的谷粒与麦芽化的大麦——其间穿插着商贩高声吆喝、夸赞自家货品的喊声。大啤酒杯里盛满浓郁翻涌的泡沫麦酒，每一杯都倾注了匠人的爱与心血。放声大笑与欢快的打趣此起彼伏，亲友与家人相聚一处，细品千般滋味，庆贺这场流淌的丰收。
Amid the stern grandeur of the city, the festival unfolds. The air is full of intoxicating scents—fresh grain and malted barley—punctuated by the cries of traders lauding their wares. Steins overflow with rich, foaming ales, each crafted with loving care. Guffaws and jovial banter can be heard as friends and families gather, savoring the myriad tastes and celebrating the liquid harvest.

Subterranean Ancient City.name:
地下古城
Subterranean Ancient City

Text.text:
这座建在巨型洞窟中的城市，规模不逊于你在地表见过的任何城邦。它的建筑风格混杂交错，源于数个世纪缓慢却不曾停歇的扩建与生长。然而，尽管城市的年代久远，它却大体完好无损；这里的人们——甚至比地表的居民更甚——深知放任失修的代价：一处建筑的坍塌，便可能引发塌方，危及整座城市。
The city constructed within this colossal cavern is as large as any you’ve seen on the surface. The architecture is a mélange of styles from slow but constant growth through the centuries. Yet, for all of the city’s age, it is more or less intact; the people here—even more than those dwelling on the surface—are well aware of the consequences surrounding willful neglect, where a collapsing structure might endanger the entire city by causing a cave-in.

Cursed Doll Wielding Needle.name:
诅咒人偶·执针
Cursed Doll Wielding Needle

Text.text:
一个肮脏的玩偶披着破烂、溅满血迹的贵族服饰，从破败的家具底下用指甲抓挠着爬了出来。它的瓷脸裂开了一角，露出令人心悸的空洞；半边头发已然脱落，剩下的也被烧焦成参差不齐、纠结成团的长短。它右手握着一根细长的针，像佩剑般锋利。它无声地试了试针尖的锐度，满意地点了点头，随即踉跄着扑上前来。

~ 由Ashe构想

A dirty doll in tattered, blood-splashed aristocratic clothing claws its way out from under the dilapidated furniture. Part of its porcelain face has cracked away, revealing a haunting hollow, and its hair is missing from half its head, the remainder charred to varied, tangled lengths. In its right hand, it wields a long needle like a rapier. Silently, it tests the point’s sharpness and, with a satisfied nod, lurches forward.

~ Envisioned by Ashe

Gondola At Dock.name:
码头缆车
Gondola At Dock

Text.text:
黑漆船身以金色卷纹与执照徽牌装点，船尾飘着一面小红旗。它的fèrro轻轻撞上码头的护舷。船上的长凳铺着装饰靠垫，横跨中央的一块木板上放着一个小野餐篮，以及一只浸在冰桶里的葡萄酒。
The black lacquered hull is decorated with golden scrolls and license badges, with a small red flag flying on the stern. Its fèrro bumps softly against the fenders of the dock. The boat’s benches are fit with decorative cushions, and a plank across the center holds a small picnic basket and a bottle of wine in an ice bucket.

I Cast Maze.name:
我施放【迷宫术】
I Cast Maze

Text.text:
丝线在我的心眼里拉长、交错，宛如蛛网。我像指挥家般牵引它们，双手抓握、拉扯、扭绞这些线弦，直到编织出一座繁复而广袤的迷宫。我拇指向下一点，我的目标便坠入这座异界迷阵之中。
Threads stretch and crisscross like a spider’s web in my mind’s eye. I direct them like a conductor, my hands grasping, pulling, and twisting the strings until I’ve formed a labyrinth both complex and vast. I point my thumb downward and my target falls into my otherworldly maze.

许多惑控法术会强迫目标——像提线木偶般操弄他们——也有些则以魅惑与诱引为能事。而像这样的法术却极为罕见：它并非逼迫，而是说服。施法之际，你对受害者开口，将你的想法措辞得仿佛出自他们自身。随着法术生效，你看见他们神色悄然变化，继而频频点头，表示赞同。
Many enchantments compel their targets—manipulating them like puppets on strings—while others bewitch and entice. It’s the rare spell such as this that persuades. As part of the casting you speak to its victims, wording your idea so that it seems like their own. As the spell takes effect, you see expressions change and heads nod in agreement.

由一段段原木垒起、再以铁链捆扎加固的城墙看似无人把守。你不禁短暂地怀疑，他们是不是把这堵墙一路拖着带来的。尽管不见守卫，可对灰矮人而言，表象向来不可信。也许整整一个排正悄无声息地站岗，而你却浑然不觉。大门只开启了片刻便又合拢，似乎无人进出。这变化令人不安，却也让你趁机看清了几座掩体般的建筑，以及里面几个隐约可见的灰矮人。
The walls, erected in sections of logs lashed together by chains, seem unguarded. You wonder briefly if they carried the walls with them. Although you see no guards, with duergar, appearances are invariably deceiving. There could be a whole platoon standing silently on watch, and you’d never know. The gates open for a minute and close again, with no one seeming to enter or exit. This is a worrying development, but it gave you the chance to see several bunker-like structures and a few visible duergar inside.

I Have A Stroke Of Luck: Ranged Attack.name:
我鸿运当头：远程攻击
I Have A Stroke Of Luck: Ranged Attack

Text.text:
我的攻击故意打偏——当然，这正是我想要的。我勾起一抹冷笑。就在敌人放松警惕的瞬间，那一击从他们身后某处弹射折返，竟以出人意料的角度命中要害。
My attack goes wide—but of course, I meant it to. I smirk. Just as my foe relaxes, the shot ricochets off something behind them. And the attack hits home from a surprising angle.

Plasmoid Space Colony.name:
类变形体空间殖民地
Plasmoid Space Colony

Text.text:
数颗小行星被粘稠的胶质死死黏合，汇成一座庞大得骇人的群团，漂浮在虚空中，却又以出人意料的灵巧穿梭于周遭的小行星带。其表面崎岖嶙峋，灰烬般的岩壳上散布着各式建筑，点点灯火织成一张光网。你能辨出人影来来往往，在港口的各处码头、商店与打捞场之间穿行。更令人费解的是，这里似乎聚集了大量具备智慧的软泥怪，其中不少还身居商贸与市政要职。

~ Envisioned by SibunaIV

Held together by viscous goo, several asteroids float through the void in a gargantuan cluster, drifting through the surrounding asteroid field with surprising dexterity. On its surface, various structures can be seen dotting the craggy landscape, forming a network of lights on the ashen rock. You can make out the forms of people going to and fro as they make their way between the various docks, stores, and salvage yards of the port. Curiously, there seems to be a large number of sapient oozes here, many in positions of mercantile and civic authority.

~ Envisioned by SibunaIV

Green Giant Returning Home.name:
归家的绿巨人
Green Giant Returning Home

Text.text:
当他拐过这条掩蔽小径的最后一个弯角，巨人望见阳光斑驳的山丘上那座家园，脸上顿时绽开灿烂的笑容。他那翠绿的长腿每迈出一记如雷的步伐，便跨过十步之遥；漫长旅途将尽，他吹着一支旅人的小调，朝终点渐近。

~ Envisioned by DaveDaWanderer on Discord

When he turns the final corner of the sheltered path, the giant's face breaks into a beaming smile as he sees his home on a sun-dappled hill. His viridian legs cover ten strides with each thunderous step, and he whistles a traveling tune as he nears the end of his long journey.

~ Envisioned by DaveDaWanderer on Discord

Lizardfolk In Butcher's Apron.name:
围裙染血的蜥蜴人
Lizardfolk In Butcher's Apron

Text.text:
巨大的眼球从蜥蜴人的狭长面孔两侧鼓胀而出，每只眼的虹膜各自朝不同方向游移。一只戴着单片眼镜，毫不羞怯地以赤裸的好奇打量着你；另一只则死死盯着脚边一摊血淋淋的肉堆——那曾是什么动物，已难以辨认。他们的利爪间握着一把小巧的弯刀，刀尖滴落着脓血般的污液。他们将刀刃在薄薄的皮围裙上抹净，又漫不经心地用刀背贴着腹部划过，仿佛在擦拭一件日常器具。牙缝后探出一截细长的蓝舌，轻轻一甩，去尝空气——去尝你。他们微微歪着长角的头颅，骨质突起如冠冕般排布。吻部鳞片呈李子般的紫色，色泽向后渐次褪去——转为紫罗兰、淡紫、蓝与青绿——一路延伸到后脑与脊背。

~ Played by Nachodelamancha

Huge eyes bulge out from either side of the lizardfolk’s narrow face, the iris of each swerving in separate directions. One eye, monocled, regards you with open curiosity, free of shame, while the other fixates downward toward a bloody heap of some indiscernible animal. In their clawed hand, a small, curved knife drips with ichor. They wipe the blade clean against their thin leather apron, drawing the flat of the knife casually across their belly. A thin blue tongue flicks out from behind their teeth to taste the air—to taste you. They tilt their horned head, the bony protrusions arranged in a crownlike pattern. The scales of their snout are a plum purple, and the coloration fades gradually—to violet, lavender, blue, and teal—toward the back of their head and down their spine.

~ Played by Nachodelamancha

Sunrise Over Peaceful-seeming Village.name:
宁静村落之上的朝阳
Sunrise Over Peaceful-seeming Village

Text.text:
太阳缓缓越过地平线，晨光铺开，照亮前方丘陵上一格一格的犁耕田畴；低矮的树篱将每一块田地都细细围出边界。几块田里已有嫩苗点点，其余田垄则翻着肥沃的黑土，静待播种。近处草甸上，羔羊蹦跳嬉闹，羊群从棚里放出，涌向新绿的草地啃食；它们的羊毛外衣刚被剪过，显得轻薄而清爽。牧场与耕地之间，茅草屋顶的小屋零星散落，烟囱里升起几缕细白的炊烟，笔直地向空中延伸。你几乎难以相信，这样宁静的村庄竟会遭遇任何祸患。
As the sun slowly rises over the horizon, its light reveals a checkerboard of plowed fields on the hills ahead, low-growing hedges framing each individual one. Small plants grow in several of the fields, while in others the fertile soil awaits to be seeded. In nearby meadows, lambs bound and frolic about as herds of sheep are let out of sheds to graze on the fresh green grass, their woolen coats recently shorn. Thin white columns of smoke rise from the chimneys of the thatched roof cottages that sit in between the pastures and the cropland. You find it hard to believe that this serene village could possibly be beset by anything.

在公共厅的中央，一只火盆里燃着煤与草药，洒在北方松林般的熏香之上，獾之灵自其中浮现。它是灰色烟雾凝成的形体。你的朋友自幼从幼崽被抚养长大，此刻深深吸入那灵烟，又将其余的烟雾挥过头顶，拂过黑白相间的皮毛。獾抬头望向你。你们在心中彼此致意：情感与魔法相系，相互束缚。
At the center of the common room, from a brazier of coal and herbs sprinkled over the incense of a northern pine forest, the spirit of the badger emerges. It is shaped gray smoke. Your friend, raised from a cub, breathes the spirit-smoke deeply, waving the rest over head and through black and white fur. The badger looks up at you. In thought you greet one another: emotionally and magically bound.

Bottle Of Arsenic.name:
一瓶砒霜
Bottle Of Arsenic

Text.text:
这只小瓶子不起眼，小巧玲珑，极易被忽略——正合其意。瓶身几乎没有任何标记，但瓶盖上贴着一枚小贴纸，上面印着 As-33。打开容器，露出一层细腻的粉末，不带任何阴影、色泽或气味。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

The bottle is small, unassuming, and easy to miss—as intended. Though largely unmarked, the bottle has a small sticker on the lid printed with As-33. Opening the container reveals a fine powder, devoid of shade, hue, or scent.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

尽管它的形体与一条肌肉虬结的猎犬相仿，但这只妖精生物与獒犬的相似程度，就如同精灵与人类之间的差别一般。它那一色的眼睛会在毫无预兆的瞬间微微眯起；下一刻，闪现犬便无声消失，又在不远处重新出现，仿佛毫不费力。
Though its form is similar to that of a muscular hunting dog, this creature of the fey bears as much resemblance to a mastiff as an elf does to a human. Its monocolored eyes squint briefly and without warning, the blink dog simply disappears and reappears a short distance away, seemingly without effort.

Divine Archives Of A God Of Records.name:
司录之神的神圣档案馆
Divine Archives Of A God Of Records

Text.text:
档案馆没有墙，只有记录：一排排书架与上锁的匣子，必须用秘语才能开启。它是一座微缩的宇宙，是诸界信息的疆域：每一个新生儿，每一具曾埋在教堂墓园里的尸体，吃掉了多少牲畜，打过多少战争，沙粒有几粒，雨滴落了多少，记录着有多少条记录的记录，以及那些秘密记录——它们揭示其中有多少是真实无误的。存在之物皆被写下，而阅读即为知晓，因此档案馆也许是整个时代里最危险的所在。
There are no walls to the archives, just records, rows of shelves and locked boxes requiring secret words. It is a microcosm, a realm of the information from other realms: every little baby, every corpse ever in a churchyard, how many animals eaten, wars fought, grains of sand, drops of rain, records of how many records there are, secret records that show how many of them are accurate. What exists is written, and reading is knowing, so the Archives is perhaps the most dangerous place anywhere in time.

这柄巨斧以远胜寻常武器钢的合金锻成，配以铁木斧柄，由矮人为一场如今已被遗忘、对抗其世仇的战争而打造。尽管历经年代，它的工艺之精依旧不朽。
Forged from an alloy far stronger than ordinary weaponsteel and married to an ironwood haft, this greataxe was fashioned by dwarves for a now-forgotten war against their ancestral enemies. Despite its age, the quality of its craftsmanship is timeless.

投索是一种矛盾的化身：它最像古老而强大的泰坦在战斗中使用的投索，却又仿佛为你的手量身打造，尺寸恰到好处。这怎么可能？不管怎样，这样的谜团多半不会妨碍你在战斗中将这把被重度附魔的武器发挥到极致。
The sling is an exercise in contradictions: Though it most closely resembles the slings used by ancient, powerful titans in combat, it seems perfectly sized to your hand. How is such a thing possible? Regardless, such a conundrum is unlikely to keep you from using this heavily enchanted weapon to its fullest capacity during battle.

Inspiration About Your Worst Day.name:
关于你最糟糕的一天的灵感
Inspiration About Your Worst Day

Text.text:
“争斗了一辈子，到了这一刻你却动摇？这还不是你最糟的一天。你最糟的一天还在后头——而到那时，你会像此刻一样屹立不倒。”
“A lifetime of strife, and in this moment you falter? This is not your worst day. Your worst day is yet to come and you will stand strong then as you will now.”

Shocking Grasp Effect.name:
电爪 效果
Shocking Grasp Effect

Text.text:
你用仿佛墓碑相互碾磨般的嗓音，结束了最后一句奥术咒言，同时以一根手指按在你目标的眉心。空气里飘过一丝臭氧的气味，他们的头发根根竖起；电光在体内炸裂成弧，沿着每一根骨骼与肌腱狂奔，抽走肌肉里的力气，又在他们身上任何金属被瞬间灼热到发红时，把皮肉烫得焦灼刺痛。
In a voice akin to a grinding tombstone, you finish uttering the arcane words while placing a single finger upon the brow of your target. A hint of ozone wafts through the air, and their hair stands on end, as lighting arcs through their body, coursing through every bone and tendon, sapping strength from their muscles, and burning flesh when it superheats any metal on their person.

Barbarian Battle Cry.name:
野蛮人战吼
Barbarian Battle Cry

Text.text:
她双拳紧扣在武器上，宽阔的肩膀猛然一沉，摆出迎战的姿态。她的眼神翻涌着愤怒的风暴，像标枪刺入血肉般直钉进敌人的心口。她从胸腔深处迸出一声非人的咆哮，森白的牙齿间唾丝飞溅。

~ Envisioned by Aiine

She clenches her fists over her weapon and squares her broad shoulders. Her eyes, stormy with indignation, bore into her enemy like javelins sinking into flesh. From deep within her chest, she emits an inhuman roar, strings of saliva flying from her bared teeth.

~ Envisioned by Aiine

Beleth Vice.name:
贝莱斯的罪恶副面
Beleth Vice

Text.text:
城卫的徽记在她的罩袍上清晰闪耀，映着她燃烧般的橙色眼眸所投出的光。她的睫毛漆黑如墨，却在每一根末端亮起明黄，像一截发光的引信尾端。两只深红的山羊角粗粝而盘旋，从她冬霜般的灰色额头蜿蜒卷出。她一臂挂着一面绘有燃烧之眼的盾牌，腰间别着战斧。背后斜挂着一把巨大的鲁特琴，以深色天鹅绒的装饰绶带背负，其琴面刻着蛛网般的纹饰。

~ Played by master_builder75 with

The emblem of the city watch shines clearly on her tabard, reflecting the light of her burning, orange eyes. Her lashes are black but each end is bright yellow, like the glowing end of a fuse. Two crimson goats' horns, rough and spiraling, curl from her wintry-gray brow. A shield emblazoned with a flaming eye hangs from one arm and a battle axe is at her belt. A large lute, slung across her back via a decorative sash of dark velvet, is etched with spiders' web designs on its face.

~ Played by master_builder75 with

这是学期的第一天，夏末的阳光明亮炽热。你们学院的门房递给你一卷卷轴，缚以丝带，封蜡上印着学院的颜色。你的寝室编号以卷曲的花体沿着边缘书写。你站在自己的起居处门前，展开卷轴阅读，想象你的房间会是什么模样——现代还是古旧，线条利落还是杂物堆叠。羊皮纸在指间寸寸崩解，你的房间随之显现。
It’s the first day of the term, sunny and hot with the end of summer. The porter of your house gives you a scroll, bound and sealed with house colors. Your chamber number is written in curling script along the edge. Standing before your living quarters, you read the scroll and imagine how your chamber will look—modern or antiquated, clean-lined or cluttered. As the parchment disintegrates, your room appears.

你的四肢拼命摆动，肌肉与肺腑在灼烧般的用力中抽痛。那些怪物臃肿巨大的身躯重重砸向地面，轻而易举地撞开障碍，与你之间的距离迅速被抹平。你听见黏湿的低吼与急不可耐的笑声交织在一起。眼角余光里，你看见其中一只已经追上来。它的笑容以阴森的快意咧开，龟裂的嘴唇向后翻起，露出一排覆着褐黄污垢的獠牙般的颌骨。
Your arms and legs pump, muscles and lungs burning with effort. The creatures’ overly large bodies pound against the ground and through obstacles with ease, closing the gap between you. You hear wet snarls mingle with eager laughter. Out of the corner of your eye, you see one has caught up with you. Its grin spreads in ghoulish pleasure, cracked lips pulling back from a set of jaws caked with brown and yellow.

Landing At Stairway End In Dark Cave.name:
在漆黑洞窟的阶梯尽头着陆
Landing At Stairway End In Dark Cave

Text.text:
从这处平台出发，一条幽暗的隧道没入峭壁之中，洞口垂挂着一张巨大的蛛网，如帘遮挡。几片木屑碎片散落在地，依稀证明这里曾放过木箱或木桶。台阶似乎还从平台向下延伸——穿过一团纠结的蛛网，网间沉甸甸挂满蛛卵。然而阶梯在一道陡然断崖前戛然而止。也许它们曾经还能继续向下，只是岩石后来崩塌了。真让人不寒而栗……
From this landing a dark tunnel vanishes into the cliff wall, its opening curtained by a large web. A few shards of wood attest to a crate or barrel once placed here. The steps seem to continue down from the landing—past a tangle of webs heavy with eggs. But the stairway ends at precipitous drop. Perhaps they continued down further once, but the stone gave way. Not a pleasant thought…

那苍白的幽影低声啜泣，身周弥漫着几乎触手可及的哀伤气息。她的脸被一绺绺飘忽的幽发遮住，在无形的微风里轻轻拂动。褴褛的裙装裹着这生物枯槁的躯体；当你靠近时，她缓缓抬起头，与你四目相接——那凶戾的目光锋利而残忍，宛如匕首。
An aura of palpable sorrow radiates from the pale apparition weeping softly, face hidden by locks of phantasmal hair that flutter in an unfelt breeze. A ragged dress envelops the creature’s withered frame, and as you approach, she raises her head and locks eyes with you, her baleful gaze as sharp and cruel as a dagger.

Mad Ranger Defending His Sanctum.name:
疯狂游侠守卫他的圣所
Mad Ranger Defending His Sanctum

Text.text:
箭矢呼啸掠过，连珠般倾泻而来——快得绝不可能出自一名射手之手；可偏偏，他们就站在高耸的尖塔之巅，朝四周灌木丛不断放箭。狂乱扭曲了游侠的面容，双眼圆睁，每一次拉弓都伴着恶毒的诅咒咆哮：“自然的亵渎者！你们休想踏入这片圣地！”尖塔底部的藤蔓翻搅扭动，在游侠召唤下纠缠蔓延，静候他们一声令下。连生灵也纷纷响应——从松鼠到麻雀，再到潜行的狼群——仿佛都听见了游侠的召唤，聚拢集结，要为这片神圣的土地筑起防线。

~ Envisioned by Walt M.

Arrows whistle past, volleyed much too quickly to have come from a single shooter—and yet there they stand atop a towering spire, loosing arrows into the surrounding brush. A madness contorts the ranger’s features, their eyes wide as they shout curses with every draw of their bow. “Despoilers of nature! You shall not enter this sacred place!” Vines writhe at the base of the spire, summoned by the ranger and awaiting their bidding. Creatures too—from squirrels to sparrows to prowling wolves—seem to answer the ranger’s call, mustering themselves to help defend this hallowed land.

~ Envisioned by Walt M.

Burnt Pyre.name:
焦黑火葬柴堆
Burnt Pyre

Text.text:
柴堆的余烬在风中发着微光，仿佛一串倾泻的星辰般四散飞扬；它们在微风里旋舞，飘飘然朝着天穹升去。柔软的灰白色灰烬堆成小丘，将逝者焦黑的遗骨掩埋其下，让他们在最后的休息中仍保有庄严的体面。
The glowing embers of the pyre scatter in the wind like a cascade of stars, swirling in the breeze as they drift toward the heavens. A heap of soft, gray ash buries the charred bones of the deceased, affording them solemn dignity in their final rest.

Irina Von Mansford (\"Irina The Cruel\").name:
伊琳娜·冯·曼斯福德（“残酷的伊琳娜”）
Irina Von Mansford ("Irina The Cruel")

Text.text:
她衣饰如帝王般庄严，神情更是居高临下、傲然无匹。那双祖母绿的眼睛闪着光，仿佛遥远的妖精鬼火之灯。瓷白无瑕的肌肤上，唯有眉间几道浅浅的蹙痕，像不耐烦被刻进了骨相里。她的发是黑的，衣亦是黑的：暗色蕾丝沿着身形蜿蜒攀爬，如蛛网缠缚；长袍在她周身浮游，仿佛凭空唤来的雾气悬在空气里。那空气冰冷刺骨——一种带着死意的寒。或许这与她身后踉跄而行的行尸有关：枯瘦腐败，手里攥着各式锈蚀兵刃。阴影里的女士轻轻一抖长鞭，每具尸体便整齐划一地迈出一步。她收拢的手指上，戴着一枚印戒。

~ 扮演：Paul，使用

Imperial in her dress and utterly superior in her expression, the dark and haughty woman’s emerald-green eyes glint like far distant lamps of fae fire. Her flawless porcelain skin is marked only by slight, furrowed frown-lines about the eyebrows. Black is her hair, and black her raiment: dark lace crawls up her form like a spiderweb, while the robes float about her as if a conjured fog hangs in the air. That air is freezing: a deathly chill.
