It could have something to do with the walking corpses traipsing in the woman’s wake: gaunt with decay and wielding an assortment of rusted weaponry. The shadowed lady twitches a whip, and each dead body takes a step in perfect unison. On her furled finger sits a signet ring.

~ Played by Paul with

Blink Dog Encounter.name:
闪烁犬遭遇
Blink Dog Encounter

Text.text:
巨大的蝙蝠般耳朵勾勒出这条狗夸张的犬类面孔，一道骨脊沿着它的背部隆起，宛如连绵山脉。锋利的刃片从猎犬的膝关节处刺出，涎水横流的巨口里挤满了多得过分的獠牙。然而它并不攻击。相反，它的眼眸闪烁着顽皮的兴奋神采，仿佛一只备受宠爱的家庭爱宠。
Large, bat-like ears frame the dog’s exaggerated canine face, and a ridge of bone traces its spine like a mountain range. Sharp blades protrude from the hound’s knees, and its slavering maw is filled with a surplus of fangs. Yet it does not attack. In fact, its eyes shimmer with the playful exuberance one might expect from a beloved family pet.

咸涩刺鼻的海水气味弥漫在这片河口的四周，潮流从不远处的海洋直灌而入。水流被回旋的涡流充分搅拌，裹挟着丰饶的沉积物，沿着河口沙滩一线拍荡前行时，水温竟也颇为温和。
The acrid smell of salt water pervades all surrounding this estuary as the flow comes in directly from the nearby sea. Well-mixed by swirling eddies and full of enriching sediments, the water is actually quite temperate as it sloshes along the length of the estuary's beaches.

学院主塔这座炮塔的墙壁被施了魔法，染成夜空般的午夜蓝，凭空召来的群星在其上闪烁。几道仿制彗星的尾焰灼灼划过石面，有些甚至从墙里迸出火花，掠过学生头顶，直射向空中。一道螺旋的黄铜楼梯盘旋而上，直抵高塔之巅，通往天文台。
The walls of this turret on the Academy's main tower has been charmed to the midnight blue of the night sky, conjured stars twinkling. Tails of faux-comets sear across the stone, while some spark from the wall and shoot through the air over students’ heads. A spiral, brass staircase swirls up to the top of this tall tower, leading to the Observatory.

一道饱满的赤红光芒自雕像张开的口中涌出，暗示着敞开的桥那端有温暖在等待。旅人们必须在一尊巨大的石质守卫阴郁的凝视下穿越这片空旷，承受那如山般沉重的审判倾轧而来。
A hearty red glow emanates from the statue’s open mouth, hinting at the warmth beyond the open bridge. Travelers must make their way across the expanse under the dour glare of an enormous stone guardian, weathering the crushing judgment cast upon them.

在刺骨狂风与恶劣天气的抗争中，一间小屋孤零零地立在冰寒山巅。这里谈不上舒适，却仍因能为饱受风霜、筋疲力尽的攀登者遮蔽风雪而令人心怀感激。小屋搭得粗陋，修修补补不知多少回。几堆散乱的毛皮铺在四周，既可当座垫也可作铺盖，围着一处火坑——火坑上方的天花板开着一口排烟孔，不用时便用鞣制兽皮盖住。
Built in defiance of the harsh wind and weather, a hut stands at the summit of the wintry peak. It is a place of meager comfort, but welcome nonetheless for the shelter it offers to wind-beaten, weary climbers. The hut is crude in its construction and has been repaired countless times. Scattered piles of furs offer seating and bedding around a firepit that rests below a smoke hole cut in the ceiling—covered by a tanned hide when not in use.

Rhogar The Dragonsong.name:
罗伽尔·龙歌
Rhogar The Dragonsong

Text.text:
排箫吹出如鸟鸣般的颤音，在空气中轻快起舞。这段摄人心魄的旋律牵引着众人的目光落在玩家身上：一名身形瘦长、鳞片如水晶般剔透的龙裔。他以近乎孩童的惊奇打量四周。他那宝石般的面容，从鼻尖起呈天蓝色，沿着线条分明的头脊一路渐深，最终在后脑与头顶沉入浓郁的紫水晶色。他一身戏班艺人的装束：袖摆飘逸而雅致，收腿长裤缀着绣纹，半披风随着他俏皮的昂然步伐一跳一跳——然而，铆钉皮背心与细剑又昭示着：他既是娴熟的斗士，也是出色的表演者。

~ 由 Neofite Played 并附

The bird-like trill of a panflute dances through the air. The enchanting melody draws attention to the player: a lanky dragonborn with crystalline scales. He observes the surroundings with a wonder almost childlike. His gem-like face begins sky-blue at the tip of his snout and gradually darkens into a rich amethyst color at the back and top of his ridged head. He is dressed as a showman: elegantly flowing sleeves, tapered pants adorned with embroidery, a half-cape that bounces along with his jaunty swagger—but a studded leather jerkin and rapier suggest he is as consummate a fighter as he is an entertainer.

~ Played by Neofite with

一只沉重的橡木舵轮嵌着闪亮的黄铜铆钉，自船尾楼甲板的高台上昂然矗立。轮辐以刻满符文的钢箍加固，六根握柄皆雕作龙首之形。新上蜡的木香化作怡人的薄雾般缭绕，即便夜风拂过也久久不散。
A heavy oak wheel set with shining brass studs rises from the aft castle of the deck on a raised dais. The spokes are reinforced with bands of rune-carved steel, and each of the six handles is carved to resemble a dragon’s head. The scent of fresh polish drifts from the wood in a pleasing miasma that lingers despite the night breeze.

Wild Magic Surge: Fiery Touch.name:
狂野魔法涌动：炽焰接触
Wild Magic Surge: Fiery Touch

Text.text:
狂野魔法的逆焰猛然撞上你，感觉就像站在锻炉旁。你的皮肤泛红，你周身透出灼燃的热光。你和你的随身物品毫发无伤，但凡是你所@接触的可燃之物，十有八九会腾地起火。
The backdraft of wild magic that slams into you feels like standing next to a forge. Your skin flushes, and you glow with a burning heat. You and your belongings remain unharmed, but anything flammable you touch is likely to go up in flames.

Magical Detection Of A Bard's Class.name:
吟游诗人职业的魔法侦测
Magical Detection Of A Bard's Class

Text.text:
你在脑海里听见音乐：鲁特琴的琶音，短笛吹奏着舞曲。伴随着它，你也听见在你目标那充满创造力的心灵深处，一段旋律正低声哼鸣，最终落入一个和弦，戛然而止。
You hear music in your mind: a lute arpeggio, a fife playing a dance. Along with it, you hear the humming of a tune inside your target’s own creative mind, which resolves in a chord and finishes.

Rod Of Alertness.name:
警觉之杖
Rod Of Alertness

Text.text:
这根结实的长杆顶端装有几片凸缘，造型别致得几乎与壁灯托架上沿那一排叉齿如出一辙。长杆的另一端，从握柄处斜斜突出一根带倒刺的尖钉，却并不适合用来刺击。也许只是你眼花，但你总会不时发誓，长杆顶端正隐隐泛着微光。
The flanges atop this sturdy rod have been styled in such a way that they greatly resemble the tines along the top of a wall sconce. At the other end of the rod, a barbed spike, not suitable for any sort of stabbing, juts out from the haft. It may be your eyes playing tricks on you, but now and again, you would swear that the top of the rod glows faintly.

I Track Small Game.name:
我追踪小型猎物
I Track Small Game

Text.text:
我单膝跪地，把手掌贴近足迹作比对。是头小兽，但这不代表更容易逮住。搜寻时我得又快又静。  
我起身，目光扫过整个区域，寻找粪便的痕迹或其他路过留下的迹象。
I kneel to the ground, placing my hand near the tracks for scale. It’s a small beast, but that does not mean they’ll be easier to catch. I’ll have to be swift and quiet in my search. I stand, scanning the area for traces of scat or other signs of passing through.

Crater Mining Site.name:
陨坑采矿场
Crater Mining Site

Text.text:
你扫视这片采矿作业区，空气里嗡嗡作响，尽是钻探的轰鸣。这座巨大的采石场建在一处陨坑之中，宽逾三公里。无数台机器机身上都印着公司的标志，狠狠捶击大地，震得你脚下发颤。一名工头吼了句什么，十来个工人便匆匆奔走，忙着照办。尘埃呛得你喉咙发紧——它堆在桶里，裹在撇渣艇与重型运输车上——你仍在其间瞥见珍贵晶体清澈的幽光。
The air is abuzz with drilling as you scan the mining operation. This gigantic quarry, over three kilometers wide, has been built in a crater. Countless machines, each emblazoned with a company logo, pound the earth, shaking it beneath your feet. A foreman shouts something and a dozen workers scurry to obey. Here and there, through dust that clogs your throat—heaped in buckets, skimmer-craft, and heavy transports—you spy the lucent glow of precious crystals.

Ash And Dust Covered Sky.name:
灰烬与尘埃遮蔽的天空
Ash And Dust Covered Sky

Text.text:
每迈出一步，你都愈发不安地察觉到灰烬与尘埃扼住了天空，将四周笼罩在一片半明半暗之中，太阳几乎被彻底遮蔽。砂砾开始在你眼角堆积，被泪水的湿意黏在睫毛上。你几乎立刻就口干舌燥，每一次呼吸都吸入细碎的灰烬颗粒。
With each successive step, you become uncomfortably aware of the ash and dust choking the sky, casting your surroundings in a state of semi-darkness, the sun all but blocked out. The grit begins to gather in the corners of your eyes, glued to your lashes by the moisture of your tears. You become parched almost instantly, particles of ash inhaled with every breath.

在云层遮蔽与雨雾之下，以松杉深绿作背景，你眼前图腾的底部是一圈熊族女子：她们面朝外站立，爪掌托举着中段。四位氏族首领端坐其上，与天地万象议事，各自朝向一个方位。再往上是一枚圆盘，半为月、半为日；圆盘之上便是图腾的顶端：来自各个种族与部族的孩子们嬉闹游戏，最上面的孩子被众人托起，放声大笑。
Under cloud cover and rainy mist, against the deep-green backdrop of pine and fir, the bottom section of the totem before you is a circle of bear women who stand facing outward, their paws holding up the middle piece. Four clan chiefs sit in conference with the world, each facing a cardinal direction. Above them is a disc, half moon and half sun, and on that disc stands the top section of the totem: children of all races and tribes playing a game, with the topmost child held up by the rest and laughing.

Unusual Fungi Forest On Arboreal World.name:
树栖世界上的奇异菌林
Unusual Fungi Forest On Arboreal World

Text.text:
这些菌簇由粉褐色的球茎构成，铺满一片开阔的地带。它们的大小从婴儿的拳头到食人魔的拳头不等，疣状的肿块般蜷聚着，彼此相隔几尺。忽然，其中一枚球茎开始颤动，整簇随之战栗。它鼓胀起来，恶臭四溢，紧接着——又一枚球茎从它体内弹出，湿漉漉的，崭新而鲜活。放眼其他菌簇，同样的过程也在发生——快得过于突兀。
The clusters are composed of pinkish-brown bulbs covering a wide field. They range from baby fists to ogre fists, and huddle in warty lumps a few feet apart. One of the bulbs begins to shake, the rest of the cluster quivering around it. It swells, stinks, and then another bulb springs out of it, wet and new. Among other clusters, the same process happens—far too suddenly.

Loot From A Stinking Zombie.name:
从一具臭气熏天的丧尸（特征）身上搜出的战利品
Loot From A Stinking Zombie

Text.text:
挂在这具恶臭丧尸（特征）磨损的腰带上，你发现了一只叮当作响的钱币袋。也许这位不幸的人原本正赶去集市，却在途中撞上了某个死灵法师。
Hanging from the fraying belt of the stinking zombie, you find a pouch of jingling coins. Perhaps this unfortunate person was on their way to the market when they ran afoul of a necromancer.

Threat From A Curious Necromancer.name:
来自好奇的死灵法师的威胁
Threat From A Curious Necromancer

Text.text:
“那你又是什么？我从未见过你这种族。如此独特的形态结构……我想我会把你一条条拆开，每一条都能揭出一个新的小秘密。这样我接下来几天应该就不愁无聊了。”
“And what are you? I haven’t seen your kind before. Such unique morphology… I think I will take you apart in strips, each one revealing a new little secret. That should provide me some amusement for the next few days.”

Spiders In The Transformation Classroom.name:
变形术教室里的蜘蛛
Spiders In The Transformation Classroom

Text.text:
某个夜晚，几十只蜘蛛——从小小的狼蛛到体型硕大的绿园蛛，它们拖着修长的黑腿——悄悄潜入变形术教室，藏在下一堂课要用的靶标附近。第二天上课时，它们突然跃到咒语前方，把法术硬生生扭曲了：本该被变成蝴蝶的饮水杯仍留在桌上，可一只体型如饮水杯的飞蜘蛛却凭空出现；一朵花端端正正地顶在一把八足伞的伞面上。蜘蛛们究竟是怎么策划出这一切的？
One night, dozens of spiders—from small wolf spiders to big green garden spiders with long black legs—hid themselves in the transformation classroom, near targets for the next lesson. In class the next day they suddenly jump in front of the spells and warp them. A drinking cup set to become a butterfly remains on the table, but now a flying spider the size of a drinking cup appears. A flower sits atop an eight-legged umbrella. How did the spiders plan this?

Fountain Room: Vaulted Chamber.name:
喷泉厅：穹顶大厅
Fountain Room: Vaulted Chamber

Text.text:
空气闻起来清新，贴在皮肤上既潮湿又沁凉。高耸的厅室之内，水流穿梭，汩汩作响，时而溅起水花，沿着错综复杂的水道与水池网络循环流转。空气中的寒意不仅来自水，更来自一缕轻微而恒定的微风，仿佛深处穹窖在持续吸气，将你一点点牵引向更幽邃的腹地。
The air smells fresh, feeling both damp and cool on your skin. Within these high-ceilinged chambers, water flows, burbles, and splashes, circulating through a complex network of channels and pools. The chill in the air comes not just from the water but from a slight and steady breeze, as if from a constant inhalation deeper into the vaults.

Nothic's Psychic Probe.name:
诺西克的心灵探针
Nothic's Psychic Probe

Text.text:
两座并行的桥梁横跨张口欲噬的深渊，将洞窟一分为二；刺骨寒风自其幽深处喷涌而出。你凝视阴影，确信方才有东西在其中一闪而过。眩晕骤然缠上你，乏味的臂膀将你紧紧裹住，怪诞的记忆随之汹涌灌入脑海。扭曲的念头、卑劣的幻象，化作你过往所为之事的噩梦般讽刺仿影。

~ 一位英雄所构想

Twin bridges stretch across the yawning chasm splitting the cavern, a frigid breeze belching from its depths. You peer into the shadows, certain you saw something move. Vertigo abruptly wraps its insipid arms about you, and bizarre memories flood your mind. Twisted thoughts, debased visions, appear as nightmare parodies of things you have done in the past.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Turn Invisible While Wearing My Ring O.name:
我戴上隐形戒指，身形随即隐去无踪
I Turn Invisible While Wearing My Ring Of Invisibility

Text.text:
我摆弄着指间的戒指，它的材质清澈得像抛光的玻璃。屏住呼吸，我感觉魔法如同一袭细密的丝绸长袍覆在我身上。我低头看向自己的脚，却已不见踪影；我挥动手臂，扭动脚趾，确认这道附魔牢牢贴合。待它稳稳生效，我便继续前行，轻若幽灵，悄无声息。
I fiddle with the ring on my finger, its material as clear as polished glass. Holding my breath, I feel the magic drape over me like a robe of fine silk. I look down to my feet and do not see them; I wave my arms and wiggle my toes to ensure the enchantment sticks. When it does, I continue on, as subtle as a spirit.

数十处水潭星罗棋布在地貌之上，体型与深浅差异极大。每一潭都盈满色泽诡异却令人沉醉的水——此处翡翠般的碧绿，彼处深邃的紫罗兰。水潭上蒸汽袅袅升腾，空气中弥漫着芬芳而微咸的湿润气息。
Dozens of pools, varying widely in size and depth, litter the landscape. Each brims with water of strange and alluring hues—jade green there, deep violet here. Steam rises from the pools. The air is fragrant and pleasantly brackish.

一阵顽皮的咯咯怪笑隆隆回荡，仿佛气泡从鬼婆的坩埚里咕嘟咕嘟冒起，一道形体开始在空气中成形。鼠尾草般的青绿烟雾翻涌凝聚，化作一条小小的无足幼龙；它那轻薄如雾的爬鳞面容被一抹乖戾的咧笑撕开。小妖精绕着你盘旋，像一团好奇的云——随后，它吸入一口大得令人不安的气息。

~ Envisioned by Joanne

A mischievous cackle rumbles, like bubbles rising from a hag's cauldron, as a shape begins to form in the air. Coalescing in a cloud of sage-green smoke is a small, legless dragon with a cantankerous grin splitting its wispy reptilian features. The sprite circles you like a curious cloud—before drawing in a worryingly large breath.

~ Envisioned by Joanne

Wild Magic Surge: Sudden Stealth.name:
狂野魔法涌动：骤然潜行
Wild Magic Surge: Sudden Stealth

Text.text:
奥术余烬落在你脚边，轰然迸散成一团烟羽。你挥手驱散烟雾，才发现自己的手竟半透明。周围的人朝你的方向投来目光，却仿佛视线直接穿透了你。你嘶声想引起他们注意——他们似乎也听不见你。
Arcane embers fall to your feet and erupt in a plume of smoke. You wave the smoke away and notice that your hand appears translucent. Individuals around you peer in your direction, but they seem to look right through you. You hiss to catch their attention—they can’t seem to hear you, either.

Drizzle Of Rain.name:
细雨蒙蒙
Drizzle Of Rain

Text.text:
远称不上什么像样的大雨，一层细细的雨丝如薄雾般缓缓笼罩着这片区域。可不知为何，凡是选择冲进这层轻雾的人，都会莫名其妙地从头到脚被浇得透湿。
Far from a downpour of any significant size, a faint haze of drizzling rain settles slowly over the area. Despite all reason, any who choose to dash through this fine mist end up inexplicably drenched from head to toe.

这个带皮扣的松木箱打开后，分成一深一浅两侧。较深的区域里放着两只塞着软木塞的陶罐、一口小铜锅，以及一套研钵与杵。另一侧则收着涂蜡的皮革小袋、几支小瓶、几把勺子、一把小镰刀、一支注射虹吸器，还有燧石与打火钢。箱内另嵌着一个更小的盒子，里面装着新鲜的软木塞。皮带与皮环将这些器具牢牢固定在各自的位置上。打开的一瞬间，松脂与皮革的气味扑面而来，夹着一丝铜腥与酵母的微甜。
This pine case with a leather closure opens into one deep side and one shallow. The deeper area has two corked ceramic jugs, a small copper pot, and a mortar and pestle. The other contains waxed leather pouches, a few vials, spoons, a small sickle, a syringe siphon, and flint and steel. A smaller box inside holds fresh corks. Leather belts and loops fasten these implements in place. The scent of pine and leather wafts from within, mixing with a hint of copper and yeast.

一股像陈年沼泽般的恶臭。嘴唇与舌尖沾着湿腐泥土的腥涩味。她的咯咯怪笑，像鞭梢炸裂的脆响。一名鬼婆立在她的屋前，目光死死钉在你身上。她的一只眼——纯白无瞳——像一轮死月，嵌在她憔悴拉扯的惨白面皮里。一阵微风掠过，窗边悬着的风铃轻轻作响——用暗线串起的一串串细小骨头。相似的饰物也挂在她颈间与耳畔。她那枯瘤盘结的手紧握着一柄长齿叉。

~ Played by Spac3cowboyy

A stench like an old bog. The taste of dank earth on lips and tongue. A cackle like the crack of a whip. A hag stands in front of her home, her gaze fixed on you. One eye—pure white—sits like a dead moon in the pale flesh of her drawn face. A small breeze rattles the wind chimes hanging about her windows, collections of small bones strung together with dark thread. Similar adornments hang about her neck and from her ears. In her gnarled hand, she grips a long-tined fork.

~ Played by Spac3cowboyy

Werewolf-vampire Hybrid.name:
狼人-吸血鬼（特征）混血
Werewolf-vampire Hybrid

Text.text:
这名肌肉虬结的类人生物带着狼的轮廓，但皮毛短而黝黑。它的耳朵大得不成比例，光秃无毛，内侧布满隆起的褶脊。瘦长的手指与脚趾拉得过分修长，末端是弯钩般的利爪。獠牙从颌间突兀伸出——上犬齿与正中的两枚门牙长得骇人。生物漆黑如珠的眼眶里燃着血色光焰。
This muscular humanoid has features of a wolf, but its fur is short and dark. The ears are overlarge, furless, and ridged on the inside. Its skinny fingers and toes are overlong, tipped with hooked claws. Fangs jut from its jaws, the upper canines and two central incisors monstrously long. The creature’s black, orblike eyes blaze with blood-colored light.

I Cast Prayer Of Healing.name:
我施放治疗祷言
I Cast Prayer Of Healing

Text.text:
我低声呢喃祈祷时，能清晰感到神祇的临在萦绕身侧——神圣的披衣沉沉压在肩头，却又令人振奋、充满力量。我的声音挟着坚定的信念轰然回荡，层层能量波自我体内向外辐射。红与白交替的光环自我身形鼓胀扩散，裹住我的伙伴，将安抚人心的治疗魔法温柔覆上。
I feel the presence of my deity around me as I murmur a prayer—a godly mantle heavy upon my shoulders, but also invigorating and empowering. Voice booming with conviction, waves of energy radiate from me. Alternating coronas of red and white light balloon out from my form, wrapping my companions in soothing healing magic.

Wand Of Binding.name:
束缚魔杖
Wand Of Binding

Text.text:
这件器具由一段黑铁锻成，你的目光立刻被它末端吸引——那里被精心打造为一只镣铐的形状。
Fashioned from a length of black iron, your eye is immediately drawn to the end of the instrument, which has been meticulously fashioned into the shape of a manacle.

Deverash Neverdash.name:
德维拉什·永不疾奔
Deverash Neverdash

Text.text:
从那支长柄烟斗里吐出一团馥郁浓稠的香烟后，侏儒倚在树桩上，短腿在温暖的午后阳光里惬意地晃荡。他胸前那枚擦得锃亮的圣徽贴着深色皮肤，因他身上那件潇洒束腰上衣深开的领口而清晰可见。树桩底部，依偎在主人一堆冒险道具之间，一头巨大的爬行类野兽满足地打着鼾；它每次呼气后，鼻孔都会随之鼓起，迸出一阵静电般的噼啪微响。

~ 由 Max_Slacker 扮演，并附

Blowing out a cloud of rich, perfumed smoke from his long-stemmed pipe, the gnome leans back on the stump, short legs swinging blissfully in the warm afternoon sun. A polished holy symbol rests against the dark skin of his chest, exposed by the plunging neckline of the dashing tunic he wears. At the stump’s base, settled amongst its master’s adventuring gear, a large reptilian beast snores contentedly, its nostrils flaring with a static crackle after each exhalation.

~ Played by Max_Slacker with

Exorcist's Bag.name:
驱魔师的布袋
Exorcist's Bag

Text.text:
这只由皮革与天鹅绒制成的挎包，上面压印着神圣的徽记；它之于灵魂，正如医师的器械之于肉身，或学者的笔记之于心智。包内装着构成一生的诸物——薄饼与酒、香烟与圣带、爱与对死亡的笃定。里面还有一本能令恶魔受苦并仓皇遁逃的书，以此世与彼界的语言书写。
This shoulder bag of leather and velvet, embossed with a holy symbol, is to the soul what a physician’s instruments are to the body or the scholar’s notes are to the mind. Inside are the things that make a life—wafer and wine, smoke and stole, love and the assurance of death. There is also a book to make demons suffer and flee, written in the languages of this world and theirs.

Overheard Conversation About Evil Plan.name:
偷听到的关于邪恶计划的对话
Overheard Conversation About Evil Plan

Text.text:
“——主人们老爱念叨他们那套宏大的邪恶计划，可你知道他们从不提什么吗？牙科保险。我老婆现在连亲都不肯亲我了。她说就像有人把一颗发霉的卷心菜硬塞进她嘴里。”
“—masters always going on about their big evil plan but you know what they never talk about? Dental plans. My wife won’t even kiss me no more. Says it’s like getting a moldy cabbage shoved in her mouth.”

Mercantile Council Chambers.name:
商贸议会厅
Mercantile Council Chambers

Text.text:
这座拱顶大厅开着高窗，气质宛如一座神殿——而且确实，诸多神祇在此并立。商人们似乎并不挑剔。只要你的神祇可能对旅行、手艺、天气，或只是好运稍有兴趣，那么在柱、墙与天花板的深色木料之间，在那丰饶的工艺雕刻与晦涩的行会象征层层交叠之处，多半就藏着一座不起眼的小神龛。
High windows on this vaulted hall make it feel like a temple, and indeed, many gods are present. The merchants don’t seem choosy. If your god might have some interest in travel, craft, the weather, or just luck, there’s liable to be some small shrine hidden among the bountiful carvings of crafts and obtuse guild symbolism among the dark wood of the pillars, walls, and ceiling.

Worn Subvocal Communicator.name:
磨损的次声语音通信器
Worn Subvocal Communicator

Text.text:
等离子体伤害在通讯器的黑盒外壳上烙下焦痕——它曾经是件线条流畅、低调内敛的科技设备。如今看起来已饱经磨损。最后佩戴它的人似乎喉部遭受了沉重的伤害。多种颜色的静脉式导线从盒体上垂落，那是一套合成矩阵，用于与使用者的声带植入体进行接口连接。
Plasma damage scars the black box of the communicator, once a sleek and subtle piece of tech. It seems like it’s taken some wear and tear. Whoever was last wearing this took some heavy damage to the throat. Intravenous wires hang in multiple colors from the box, a synth matrix meant to interface with the user’s vocal implants.

My Spell Fails.name:
我的法术失败了
My Spell Fails

Text.text:
我高高举起双臂，等待奥术能量的洪流冲入血脉，灌注我的法术。然而，魔法始终没有降临。我僵立了一瞬，随即放下手臂，更加凶狠地重复动作，催逼那股神秘能量的流动——可魔法之井似乎早已干涸。
I raise my arms high, waiting for the surge of arcane energy to rush through my veins and empower my spell. But the magic never comes. I stand frozen for a second, before lowering my arms to repeat the motion with more aggression, urging the flow of mystical energies. But the well of magic seems to have run dry.

异样的光芒在巨蛛的八只眼睛上闪烁，它那惊人的体型令其看起来阴森而狰狞。它巨大到你甚至能看清其触肢上每一根细毛，自然也无需再去捕捉昆虫来充作扭动的餐食。
An alien light glitters across the eight eyes of the giant spider, its size making it look sinister and monstrous. So enormous that you can make out the individual hairs on its pedipalps, it has no need to resort to insects for its wriggling meals.

粗短褶皱的象腿之上，水牛般的躯干伏着，像一辆披着生皮的坦克——可紧接着……那荒诞的脖子。没长到长颈鹿那般夸张，却也绝不算短到合理；那上面的肌肉想必如钢箍般紧绷。脖颈尽头，仿佛随手补上的，是一颗疣猪的脑袋。到底是谁造出了这东西？你也就明白，为何人们说这些怪物是女巫用自己的奶水养大的。

~ 一位英雄 构想

On squat, wrinkled elephantine legs a buffalo body rests like a hide-covered tank, but then… that preposterous neck. Not quite so long as a giraffe’s but not short enough to be reasonable—the muscles of it must be like steel bands. On the end of the neck, almost an afterthought, is the head of a warthog. Who did this thing? You can see why it is said that hags raised these monsters on their own milk.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

完美的多面体巨构如同世界般悬挂在无尽虚空中，每一面金属表皮都在诡异、摇曳的光里闪烁发亮。你脚下的大地像铁一样——粗粝、磨损，却又近乎完美地平整，向四面八方无边铺展。奇异的铁甲群山以绝对几何的姿态成簇从这方立方世界的表面拔起。军队在其上不断行进、永无休止地交战，行军靴踏在金属上发出的震颤沿着地面传开，仿佛整片世界都在回响。
The world-sized, perfect polyhedral shapes hang in an infinite void, the metallic surface of each shining in the strange, wavering light. The ground beneath your feet feels like iron—rough, worn, but almost perfectly flat, sprawling in all directions. Strange, iron-shod mountains, perfectly geometric, rise in clusters from the surface of the cube-world. Armies move across the surface in a constant war, their marching boots reverberating through the metal.

I Map The Region.name:
我绘制这片区域的地图
I Map The Region

Text.text:
我眯起眼，盯着桌前摊开的那张巨大羊皮纸——一片等待我落笔的空白。回溯着旅途的点滴，我提起画笔，先勾出河流的脉络，再描绘丘陵起伏的圆润弧线，继而点上群山的峻锐尖峰，以及环抱其间的浓密林海。意识渐入半醒的恍惚之境，心与身步调一致，只为尽可能精准地将这片地域呈现在纸上。
I narrow my eyes at the large sheet of parchment spread over the table before me: a blank canvas for my work. Recounting the journey in my mind, I take my brush and begin to trace the flow of the river, then the rolling mounds of the hills, the sharp points of mountains and the thick woodlands surrounding them. I enter a semi-lucid trance as mind and body work in tandem to depict the region as accurately as possible.

这支吹箭筒由某种大型鸟类生物的中空骨骼制成，笔直的筒身经由极其细微的削凿与校正，确保从筒口吹出的飞镖能如持有者的准星般笔直命中。
Fashioned from the hollow bone of some great avian creature, the straight shaft of this blowgun has been minutely chipped and adjusted to ensure that a dart blown from its aperture flies as true as its wielder’s aim.

为完成这道法术，你将手在空中如蛇般向前探出，除一指外其余手指尽数蜷起，攥成紧握的拳。一束狭窄、病态的绿光自那根伸出的指尖刺射而出——快过箭矢。它的轨迹割裂空气，在周遭撕开一圈虚空，滋滋作响，满溢毁灭。
To finish the spell, you snake your hand forward through the air and curl all but one of your fingers into a tight fist. A narrow beam of sickly green light lances out from the extended digit—faster than an arrow. Its path cuts through the air, opening a void around it that sizzles with destruction.

几具可怖扭曲的恶魔孩童缝合体被绑在漂浮的操控台上——一团苍白的身影扑在它们的“游戏”上，机械护手胡乱抓挠着无数拉杆。恶魔们戴着VR头显，咯咯笑得欢畅，仿佛一间疯子的教室。现实在虚假的影像里噼啪作响，你眼前的世界翻卷成令人作呕的颤晕。电玩般的图像猛然跃出、凝成实体，招手邀你加入这场地狱的嬉戏时光。
Several horrible, twisted amalgams of demonic children sit strapped to floating consoles—a pallid clutch of figures scrabbling at their game, mechanical gauntlets pawing at myriad levers. The demons giggle with glee beneath their VR headsets: it is something akin to a madman’s classroom. Reality crackles with false imagery and the world before you swirls in a nauseous shimmer. Vidgame graphics leap out and take form, inviting you to join their hellish playtime.

Speech By A Pragmatic Devil.name:
务实恶魔的演说
Speech By A Pragmatic Devil

Text.text:
“给穷人带来财富，给孤独的人送上陪伴，这真的算邪恶吗？据我所知，你做那些英雄壮举，也是指望回报与掠夺。我提供的是同样的服务，只是条款更清楚，流血更少。”
“Is it truly evil to provide a poor person with wealth, or a lonely person with companionship? As I understand it, you perform your deeds of heroism with an expectation of reward and plunder. I provide the same service, only with clearer terms and less bloodshed.”

Subterranean Purple Worm Tracks.name:
地下紫虫的踪迹
Subterranean Purple Worm Tracks

Text.text:
你面前那条光滑的通道闪烁着未被掘出的石英微光：一道钻凿得完美的孔洞，向着混乱的方向蜿蜒延伸，通往不知何处。因为这绝非矮人开凿、亦非为采矿而设计的坑道，而是一条由巨型紫虫的酸性唾液与可怖的、如七鳃鳗般的颚口生生蚀刻出来的巨大甬道。
The smooth path before you glitters with the sparkle of unearthed quartz: a perfectly bored hole leading in chaotic directions to who-knows-where. For this is no hole dug by dwarves, or engineered for mining, but an enormous passage created by the acidic spittle and fearsome lamprey-like jaws of an immense purple worm.

Bo Of The Southern Water Tribe.name:
南方水族长杖
Bo Of The Southern Water Tribe

Text.text:
一个矮个男子转过身，用一双格外醒目的榛色眼睛打量着你。他神情沉思，面容仍显年轻，却被一道从左颊贯下的疤痕破坏了——像一滴早已干涸的长泪留下的痕迹。他穿着一件朴素的无袖短袍，露出右臂上覆盖整条手臂的繁复刺青：一只乌贼用粗壮的触手绞碎船只——海沫飞溅、木屑迸裂，细致得仿佛下一刻就要动起来。典型水手的纹身，而这年轻人站姿里也带着海上长大的人特有的浪荡自信。他朝你点了点头，笑意爬上脸庞，随即微微躬身向你致意。

~ Played by Matado Defense

A short man with a broad face turns to regard you with striking hazel eyes. His expression is thoughtful and his face youthful, though marred by a scar running down his left cheek like the streak of a long-shed tear. He wears a simple sleeveless tunic that shows off an intricate tattoo spanning his entire right arm. It depicts a squid crushing a ship in its thick tentacles—ocean spray, and wood splinters rendered in such detail they seem almost to move. A sailor’s tattoo, and the young man holds himself with the swagger of one raised at sea. He nods toward you, a smile cresting his face as he greets you with a slight bow.

~ Played by Matado Defense

I Drink My Potion Of Mind Reading.name:
我饮下心灵读取药水
I Drink My Potion Of Mind Reading

Text.text:
喝下这黏稠的药剂，简直像要一口吞下酸奶或布丁。随着魔法开始生效，周围众人头顶浮现出淡粉色的光环。细微的声音在我脑海里低语，像演出前乐团正轻轻校音。我只需在心中向某个特定的目标触及，就能更清晰地听见他们的思绪。
Quaffing this viscous potion is akin to trying to drink yogurt or pudding in one gulp. As the magic takes effect, pink halos appear around the heads of those around me. Quiet voices murmur in my mind like an orchestra tuning their instruments before a show. I only need to mentally reach out to a particular target to hear their thoughts more clearly.

Loot From A Blue Dragon's Lair.name:
蓝龙巢穴的战利品
Loot From A Blue Dragon's Lair

Text.text:
蓝龙巢穴的地面上有一堆沙丘，像是刚被翻动过。往下挖去，露出龙藏匿的一处暗袋：一柄纤薄弯曲的长剑，收在以鎏金錾纹珐琅打造的剑鞘中；一只塞着瓶塞的金瓶，镶嵌青金石，隐隐散发出奢华香水的淡香；以及一只皮袋，内装1000枚金币。
A mound of sand appears recently disturbed on the floor of the blue dragon’s lair. Digging down reveals a hidden pocket of the dragon’s hoard: a slim, curved sword in a scabbard of gold-chased enamel; a stoppered gold bottle inlaid with lapis lazuli, exuding a faint scent of sumptuous perfume; and a leather bag containing 1000 gold pieces.

The Dive Bomber.name:
俯冲轰炸机
The Dive Bomber

Text.text:
一团赤褐羽影如掷出的匕首钢刃般寒光一闪，那鸟形人坠落而下——双翼紧贴纤韧的身躯，喙首前探，像标枪的尖端。尖啸伴随俯冲，狂风从身侧撕掠而过。鸟民伸出弯曲的利爪，就在触地前的刹那猛然回旋上拉，攫住猎物，以一阵疾风般的移动将其拽离地面，直带上空。猎物的惨叫在升高、再升高的途中渐渐消散，最终没入无尽天穹的虚空之中——随后，那俯冲轰炸者松开爪子——大地呼啸着迎向那不幸的受害者。

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

A blur of auburn feathers gleams like the steel of a throwing dagger as the avian humanoid plummets—wings tucked against their lithe frame, beaked head leading like the point of a javelin. A whistle accompanies the dive, wind whipping past. The birdfolk reaches out with curved talons, and, in the instant before they hit the ground, they wheel upward, clutching their prey and hauling them into the air with a flurry of movement. The prey's screams fade as they're carried aloft, higher and higher, disappearing into the endless void of the sky, before the dive bomber lets go—and the earth rushes to meet the unfortunate victim.

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

尽管她戴着一顶羽饰夸张的高帽，身披看似华贵的长袍，这名女子的姿态却毫无威严可言。她一手托腮，肘部支在面前的小桌上；另一只手漫不经心地在桌面上涂画，以陶杯里的酒为颜料。看起来她画出了一个愤怒的猫脸，正继续勾勒它的身体。
Though she wears a pompously feathered hat and rich-looking robes, the woman’s posture does not convey authority. She rests her cheek in one hand, elbow on the little table before her. With her other hand she idly draws on the table’s surface, using wine from a clay cup as her medium. It looks like she’s created an angry cat face and she’s working on the body.

一片片坚实的灰色皮甲彼此叠覆，层层折起，在他的胸肌、腹部与手臂上形成粗糙的盾牌。他的嘴扯成一抹狞笑，牙齿融合成上下两道喙。鼻梁上的角短而粗壮，尖端却锋利得像针。厚重、嶙峋的眉骨投下阴影，将他的双眼压在暗处。
Staunch plates of gray skin fold over each other, creating rough shields over his pectorals, abdomen, and arms. His mouth splits into a grimace, his teeth fused together into an upper and lower beak. The horn on his nose is short and stout, but pointed sharp at its tip. His eyes are shadowed by heavy, bumpy brows.

Loot From Orcus, Prince Of Undeath.name:
来自不死之主奥库斯的战利品
Loot From Orcus, Prince Of Undeath

Text.text:
从恶魔亲王那只长着利爪、冒着黑烟的手中，一根骨制魔杖滚落而出。杖身如同一段脊柱的长度，扭曲得令人不适，末端嵌着一颗裂口大张的骷髅头。那张死亡般的面容永远定格在嚎叫之中，仍缭绕着一缕缕绿与紫的魔法幽光。魔杖的椎节咔嗒作响，起伏蠕动着，仿佛在自我伸缩重塑——最终缩小到恰好能被离它最近的人握持的尺寸。
Out of the demon prince’s clawed, smoking hand, a wand of bone rolls free. The shaft resembles the length of a spine, twisting uncomfortably, and has a gaping skull at its end. The deathly visage, in a perpetual howl, still glows with wisps of green and purple magic. The wand's vertebrae rattle, undulating as the wand resizes itself—becoming small enough to be wielded by the person standing nearest to it.

每当我踏入一个区域，我都会在心里默记那些能提供隐蔽的地点。于是，关键时刻来临，我无需思考——不必犹豫——我会直扑最近的掩蔽处，身形倏然隐没。随后，在无人察觉的移动中，我还能从出其不意的角度再度发动攻击。
Whenever I enter an area, I mentally note the places that offer concealment. So, when the time comes, I don’t need to think—I don’t hesitate—I rush for the nearest cover and disappear. Then, moving unseen, I can attack again from an unexpected angle.

景色向四面八方绵延数十里，血红的沙海上，唯有幽深陡坠的裂隙与崩塌的尖峰打破单调。地平线处电光乍裂，乌云翻涌，化作一场永不停歇、只为毁灭而生的风暴。这里的空气如砂纸般刮磨，足以把那些胆敢不加防护穿行这片被魔法摧残的荒原之人，生生削去血肉。远处，一声巨大的嘶鸣撕开夜幕，你瞥见风暴前方，一头庞然迟缓的太古巨物投下的剪影。

~ 设想：Zoe

The landscape sprawls for leagues in every direction, the blood-red sands broken only by dark, plunging crevasses and crumbling peaks. Lightning flashes in the horizon, the dark clouds roiling in a perpetual, destructive storm. The air here scours the flesh from those foolish enough to traverse these magic-wracked wastes without proper protection. In the distance, a great cry splits the night, and you catch sight of some great, lumbering primordial silhouetted against the storm.

~ Envisioned by Zoe

Ogre Archer On The Hunt.name:
正在狩猎的食人魔弓箭手
Ogre Archer On The Hunt

Text.text:
一名脸色蜡黄的身影——一头身形矫健的食人魔——从蕨叶间现身。他手持一张芦苇般细长的弓，弦上已搭好一支箭。橙色的眼睛沉静地钉在前方，带着老练猎手、掠食者的冷定。肩头披着一张白狼皮——与其说是御寒的衣物，不如说是战利品——那硕大的狼头仍然连着，獠牙死死咬住食人魔的肩甲。
A sallow figure, a lithely built ogre, emerges from the fronds. He holds an arrow nocked in a reedy bow. Orange eyes are affixed ahead with the calm of a practiced hunter, a predator. A white wolf pelt—more a trophy than a practical garment—adorns his shoulders, its great head still attached and biting onto the ogre’s pauldron.

Loot From A Horned Devil.name:
来自角魔的战利品
Loot From A Horned Devil

Text.text:
这只魔鬼想必在其地狱主君的军势中颇有地位。它腰间系着一条镶嵌白金甲片的腰带，价值20枚白金币。
This devil must have been of some rank in its infernal master’s army. It wears a belt of platinum plates worth 20 platinum pieces.

Razor-sharp Curved Knife.name:
剃刀般锋利的弯刀
Razor-sharp Curved Knife

Text.text:
这把弧刃刀以耐用的碳纤维与钛合金打造。握柄覆着深色哑光涂层，压印着一枚猩红骷髅，底部嵌有金属环以便快速许可。握柄内部还藏着一支高功率微型手电，专为夜间行动而生。刀刃本体是一道残酷的弧线，由金色合金铸成，部分带锯齿。它看上去阴狠、凶厉，仿佛无可阻挡。
The curved knife is made of durable carbon fiber with titanium alloy. The handle features a dark matte finish embossed with a red skull, and a metal ring at the base for quick access. Embedded within the handle is a high-powered microflashlight for nighttime operations. The blade itself is a cruel curve of gold-colored alloy and partly serrated. It looks wicked and utterly unstoppable.

Intense Psychic Injury.name:
剧烈的精神创伤
Intense Psychic Injury

Text.text:
世上再无别的世界，唯有那从你颅骨内部将你撕裂的痛楚。你觉得自己的眼睛一定在流血。几乎不可能听见任何声音，除了血液在耳膜里轰鸣的搏动，以及神经元放电时那超越物质的尖啸。电流在突触间跳跃，灼烧着你的意识。
There is no other world but the one ripping your head apart from the inside. You think you must be bleeding from your eyes. It’s almost impossible to hear anything but the thrumming of your own blood and the metaphysical howling of neurons firing. The electricity burns as it arcs through your synapses.

通道的墙壁上凿出一处拱形壁龛，细微的修饰悄然勾住视线，引人探头窥入。碎屑零星散落，陈旧的饰件与展示架的残骸交错其间——那是早已不在的宝藏曾经的陈列。废墟并未立刻透露这壁龛昔日究竟供奉着什么。
An arched alcove is carved into the wall of the passage, its subtle flair drawing the eye to peer inside. Bits of debris are scattered, old adornments and the remnants of a showcase for long-gone treasure. The ruins give no immediate indication as to what the alcove used to feature.

Businesslike Enhanced Mercenary.name:
商务作风·强化雇佣兵
Businesslike Enhanced Mercenary

Text.text:
一身如格斗刀般锋利的西装裹住佣兵经过强化的躯体，他们堵在门口，身影压迫而来；冲锋枪的轮廓为这次登场添上一层阴森的肃穆。他们的脸是一张毫无表情的面具，镜面墨镜后那双眼冷硬不可撼动；他们以军人般的纪律迈步，沉稳地占据阵位。
A suit as sharp as a combat knife covers the mercenary’s enhanced frame as they loom in the doorway, the silhouette of a submachine gun adding morbid gravitas to their entrance. Their face is an expressionless mask, their eyes implacable behind mirrored shades as they move with military discipline to take position.

一座久已荒弃的城堡，半掩在攀援藤蔓与纠缠荆棘之下，孤零零地坐落在森林边缘。越过门楼——吊桥歪斜地挂在锈蚀的铁链上——满是尘屑的光束斑驳洒落在草地上，那曾是城堡的外院。残砖碎石散落在城墙附近，令人窒息的藤蔓像孩子手里的黏土般把墙体揉碎成渣。主楼高踞其上，被一层扭曲的荆棘披风笼罩，紧紧攀咬着石壁，如同时代对遗忘史诗的索取与占有。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

A long-abandoned castle, half-hidden by climbing vines and tangled briars, sits at the edge of the forest. Past the gatehouse, where the drawbridge lies askew on rusted chains, shafts of mote-filled light dapple the meadow that was once a bailey. Rubble lies strewn near the walls, where choking vines have crumbled them like clay in a child’s hands. The keep looms over all, shrouded in a mantle of twisted briars that grip the stone like time’s claim on a forgotten history.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Targeted By Circle Of Death.name:
被死亡之环锁定
Targeted By Circle Of Death

Text.text:
施法者念完咒语，抬起一根沾满黑色晶尘的手指，指向你——将你定为他们的目标。你只来得及抽入一口急促而颤抖的气息，病态、飘忽的能量便已环绕周身。视野随之模糊，那股力量伸出攫握、扭动的触须般丝缕，渗入你的体内；寂静以突兀而令人不安的速度压了下来。你感到一阵恶心，反胃在腹中盘旋收紧，坏死的能量开始向你索取代价。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The caster completes the incantation and points a finger coated in black crystalline dust, indicating you as their target. You have only a moment to take in a gasping, shuddering breath as the sickly, wavering energy encircles you. Your vision blurs as the energy leaches into you with grasping, writhing tendrils, and silence overcomes you with a sudden and unnerving quickness. You feel ill, nausea coiling in your gut, as the necrotic energies begin to exact their toll.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这套沉重的护甲甲片泛着异界般的幽光，折射光线时几近晶质般璀璨。细若尘埃的符文刻痕沿着甲片隆起的镶边蜿蜒流淌。尽管它的重量与刚硬看似束缚人身，却能贴合穿戴者的身形，稳妥而舒适，以行家般的平衡将轮廓轻柔地覆起。
The plates of this heavy suit of armor gleam with an otherworldly light, almost crystalline in their refraction of the light. Infinitesimal runic etchings run along the raised trim of the plates. Though the weight and rigidity of the armor seems constricting, it fits its wearer snugly and comfortably, draping their form with expert balance.

Ring Of Evasion.name:
闪避之戒
Ring Of Evasion

Text.text:
一只宝石蜂鸟作这枚金戒的戒首，羽翎如凝露般滴落着翡翠与海蓝宝的光泽。双翼直立，这只仿真的鸟形被定格在时代之中，停驻于振翅飞行的刹那。
A jeweled hummingbird serves as the head of this golden ring, its feathers dewdrops of jade and aquamarine. Wings upright, the avian simulacrum is caught in time midflight.

青铜甲片拼成这头雄伟的雄鹿——从宽阔、多叉的鹿角，到分裂的蹄爪，无一不由金属铸就。较大的面板刻纹如毛，构成躯干；更小的甲片勾勒出精致的细部：优雅而渐尖的头部、微微抽动的耳朵，以及短小如叶的尾巴。最细小的甲片则如厚实尖挺的毛簇，层层竖在它的颈项上。唯有它的双眼违逆了这具金属躯体的统一——那眼眸燃作熔金般的圆珠，吐出铁匠炉的热浪与焦灼的气息。
Bronze plates make up this magnificent stag, from its wide and multipronged antlers to its cloven hooves. Larger panels, graven to resemble hair, comprise its body, while smaller plates form finer features—elegant, tapered head with twitching ears, and short, leaf-shaped tail. The smallest of all lie like thick, pointed trusses of fur on its neck. Only its eyes defy the metallic unity of the body: they burn like orbs of molten metal, giving off the heat and scent of the forge.

Psi Warrior Shifter.name:
灵能战士·变形者
Psi Warrior Shifter

Text.text:
一名野性战士裹在长着鹿角的护甲中，荧光般的能量冲击波自她带爪的足底奔涌而出，将她猛然弹射至下方战场风暴之上。跃至顶点时，她灵猫般的眼睛锁定了她的目标——一头怪物正高举利刃，欲斩向她昏迷的盟友。她发出祖灵般的嚎叫，怒意翻涌，随即倾斜盾牌，雕刻着自己的下坠轨迹；又从腰带上猛地扯下一柄战锤，朝那生物掷去。轰然一击将它震得倒飞近十英尺，胸口被砸出一处凹陷的深坑。她下落之际，用虹彩般的灵能为盟友撑起一座穹顶，将其笼罩其中。落入敌群时，她把余下的对手溅得满身尸腥烂泥；随后，她微笑着伸手去摸下一柄战锤。

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

A bestial warrior encased in antlered armor channels shockwaves of fluorescent energy through her clawed feet, launching herself above the maelstrom of the battle below. At the apex of the jump, her civet eyes find her target—an abomination raising a blade over her unconscious ally. Yowling with ancestral rage, she angles her shield, sculpting her descent, then tears a hammer from her belt and hurls it at the creature. The impact sends it flying back almost a dozen feet, and leaves a crater in its chest. As she falls, the warrior blankets her ally in an opalescent dome of psionic energy. She spatters her remaining foes in charnel muck as she lands in their midst, then smiles as she reaches for another hammer.

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

Githzerai Monk.name:
吉斯泽莱武僧
Githzerai Monk

Text.text:
此人高挑瘦长，五官近似人类，却更为凌厉——尤其是一对尖耳。黄绿色的皮肤下肌肉起伏如浪。身上零星的褐色斑驳，与他的眉色相同，也与自下巴正中垂落的细长稀疏胡须同色。金色的眼眸沉静无波，面容深不可测。站姿从容而开阔，一腿一臂前探，重心尽压在后腿之上。他穿着灰色长裤、棕色外套与朴素腰带，皆剪裁贴身，便于移动。黯淡却洁净的亚麻布缠住他的双手、脚踝与双足，唯独让带爪的指节裸露在外。他缓缓攥紧了拳头。
This tall, slender person has humanlike features—only sharper, including pointed ears. Muscles ripple under his yellow-green skin. Brown mottling here and there matches the color of his eyebrows and the long, wispy beard extending from the middle of his chin. His golden eyes are calm, his face inscrutable. He has an easy, wide stance, one leg and arm forward, with all his weight on the rear leg. The gray pants, brown overcoat, and simple belt he wears are all fitted for easy movement. Drab, clean linen wraps his hands, ankles, and feet, leaving his clawed digits exposed. His fists close.

你从未见过艺术、建筑与品味的边界被如此残酷地拷打。汹涌的色彩在这座躁动的城市上泼洒横流，即便是白昼也被照得发亮。魔法灯光铺陈在整面墙都被涂绘过的楼宇之上，幻象在半空嬉闹翻腾，把自己的动作一遍遍循环重演。看上去像是互相叫阵的无数狂欢节打起了一场千路混战——可这不过是广告。从鱼贩摊位到街角小店，再到 Curses, Cheap and Effective，无不施展法术，只为把你勾进去。 Never have you seen the boundaries of art, architecture, and taste so sorely tested. A riot of color splashes across this tumultuous city, brightening it even in daytime. Magic lights splay over buildings whose whole sides have been painted, and illusions gambol in midair, repeating their actions in endless loops. It looks like a thousand-way war between competing carnivals, but it’s just advertising. Everything from fishmongers, to corner shops, to Curses, Cheap and Effective use spells to draw you in.

King Percivil The Humble.name:
谦卑的珀西维尔王
King Percivil The Humble

Text.text:
他的姿态谦卑得近乎低首，却仍难掩王者的骨相与威仪。他的尊贵里带着书卷气的修养，与平民交谈时又透出街头磨炼出的机敏与通达。脸型清瘦，颌骨方正，一头浅金近白的发既像天使般圣洁，又像野心般锋利。头戴一顶十尖王冠，冠带上环嵌十四枚宝石，光芒冷冽。身披红色加冕礼袍，肩头与臂侧以紫色绳穗装饰，层层缠绕如誓言。腰间一柄长剑松松垂着，仿佛随时可被抽出。年轻君主最异样之处，是他的左手——半兽人的手——其上戴着王室印戒。金色麻雀绕着他飞旋，掠过王冠与袍角，像一抹不肯落地的晨光。

~ Played by Leonidas-Nerevar

His posture is full of humility despite his regal bearing. There is something learned in his royalty, a street savvy in his relations with the common folk. His face is slender, his jaw square, and his pale blond hair is something at once both angelic and ambitious. On his head is a ten-pointed crown, wreathed in fourteen gems around its band. He wears red coronation robes, decorated in purple cord over the shoulder and around the arm. A longsword hangs loosely on his belt. Most unusual about the young monarch is his left hand—the hand of a half-orc—on which he wears his royal signet ring. Flying about him is a golden sparrow.

~ Played by Leonidas-Nerevar

Frozen Cliff Under Midnight Sun.name:
午夜太阳下的冰封峭崖
Frozen Cliff Under Midnight Sun

Text.text:
你伫立在冰封极地的峭壁之巅，凝望旧日最后的时辰，也凝望新日最初的时辰——可太阳从未离去。它沿着天穹缓缓下弯，贴近地平线——却从不坠落——将天空浸染成猩红。太阳像是绝望地挣扎着，要从下方冰冷的海洋里饮尽最后一口光；就在此刻，一阵狂风卷起，寒意刺骨，带着要把你从崖边掀下去的威胁——仿佛那正是太阳垂死时的吐息。

~ 构想：Bangalulu

You stand on a cliff at the icy pole to watch both the final hours of the old day, and first hours of the new, but the sun never leaves. It curves down to the horizon—never below it—washing the sky in red. As the sun desperately fights to drink from the cold ocean below it, a wind whirls up, chilling and threatening to blow you from the cliff—as if it were the sun’s dying breath.

~ Envisioned by Bangalulu

Wizards' Guildhall.name:
巫师公会会馆
Wizards' Guildhall

Text.text:
起初，这座建筑庄严如陵墓，仿佛与时代同岁。藤蔓攀覆在黝黑的石质立面上，高耸的彩绘玻璃窗诉说着往昔法师的故事。然而，当你进一步深入这片校园，便会发现岁月里东拼西凑的增建层层叠叠——它们像不驯的蘑菇从主楼上突兀冒出。一座塔楼扭曲得像拧干的抹布，一座玻璃穹顶里漂浮着点点游光，还有一栋矮胖的建筑，每当你眨眼，它似乎就换了个位置。

~ 由 Hero N. 构想

At first, the structure is as solemn as a tomb and seems as old as time itself. Vines stretch themselves over the dark stone facade, and tall stained-glass windows tell the stories of mages past. However, as you explore further into this campus, you see that a mishmash of additions have been constructed over time. They pop out like unruly toadstools from the main building. There is a tower twisted like a wrung rag, a glass dome filled with floating lights, and a squat structure that seems to be in a different place every time you blink.

~ Envisioned by Hero N.

锤击与锯切的声响在这座建筑敞开的拱廊间回荡，逼得里面干活的人不得不提高嗓门才能彼此听见。砖石结构沿着滨水一带最高耸立，而带顶的区域也向海滩敞开——让造船匠能把他们的造物直接拖入海湾。
The sound of hammers and saws echo around the open vaults of this building, causing those working within to shout to be heard. The brick and stone structure is the tallest along the waterfront, and the roofed area is also open to the beach—allowing the shipwrights to haul their creations directly out into the bay.

Goblimatic Weather Control System.name:
哥布林气象控制系统
Goblimatic Weather Control System

Text.text:
一团纠结的木料与扭曲的金属自一处粗陋的地基上蜿蜒而起，表面糊满粗鄙的标语与青绿色的涂料。塔身如一根弯曲的手指戳向苍穹，塔顶飘扬着一面旗帜，其上是一张讥笑的绿色面孔狞然窥视。病态的能量电弧沿着结构噼啪攀升，汇聚在顶端一只凹痕斑驳的金属坩埚里。你越靠近高塔，空气便越发黏稠潮湿。

~ 构想：ElusiveGenie

A snarl of wood and twisted metal curves up from a ramshackle foundation, plastered with rude slogans and green paint. The tower rises like a crooked finger to the sky, flying a flag upon which a sneering green face leers. Bolts of sickly energy crackle up the length of the structure, gathering in a dented metal crucible at the apex. The air grows dense and wet as you near the tower.

~ Envisioned by ElusiveGenie

Speech About The Futility Of Heroics.name:
论英雄壮举之徒劳
Speech About The Futility Of Heroics

Text.text:
“我们非得帮这些人吗？那些一次又一次把家安在某头巨兽的巢穴旁、或受诅咒的遗迹边的人？那些明知故犯、屡屡招惹灾祸却始终不肯改弦更张的人？我们非得吗？”
“Must we help these people? The people who time and time again build their homes next to some great beast’s den or cursed ruin? Who continue to court catastrophe without changing course? Must we?”

Home Of A God Of Elemental Water.name:
元素水之神的居所
Home Of A God Of Elemental Water

Text.text: 大地兄弟栖身于陆地——那无疑是广袤的家园，令人叹服的家园。然而，构成世界大半的却是海洋；海洋才是水神的元素故乡。他乘着浪涛，与群鱼嬉游，或俯身潜入，探访栖居于最深黑暗之中的生灵。远离类人生物的喧嚣，他居于奇异珊瑚织就的幽邃海窟，或沿着鲸群之路般绵延千里的洋流漂行；在无事时安然自得——直到需求降临，而后他便随之而起。 Brother Earth lives in the land—an expansive home, no doubt. An impressive home. But these are the seas which make up most of the world, and they are the elemental home of the Water God, who rides the waves to play among the fish or plunges to visit the creatures who live in deepest darkness. Far away from the humanoids he lives, in grottos of fascinating coral or on the thousand-mile currents of whale roads, happy until the need arises—and then he arises.

Protection From Evil And Good.name:
防护邪恶与善良
Protection From Evil And Good

Text.text:
你低声诵念那些词句——古老的束缚与庇护之语——同时将圣水洒向目标。忽然，一股无形的压迫感自目标体内迸发，向外推涌，随即又沉降下来，仿佛一块布单被抛掷在某个物体之上。
You recite the words, ancient phrases of binding and protection, while sprinkling the target with holy water. A sudden pressure seems to emanate from the target, pushing outward before settling like a sheet thrown over an object.

这盏灯由薄而打孔的铁皮制成，形如一截圆筒，顶部收成锥形。锥顶处、悬挂用的环扣上方，横接着一根木质提柄。灯身分作四面——两面为穿孔铁皮，两面敞开，可直视内部与灯芯。外侧还附着一只同样风格的副圆筒，可旋转以合拢灯身敞开的两面。靠近底部设有油槽的盖帽，以及一枚用于升降灯芯的旋钮。
Made of thin, perforated iron, this lantern is a tube with a conical top. Attached there, above a loop for hanging, is a horizontal wooden handle. The lantern has four sides—two of perforated iron and two open into the interior and the wick. Attached to the outside is a secondary cylinder in the same style, which can be rotated to close the open sides of the lantern. Near the bottom is a cap to the oil font and a knob for raising the wick.

一道筋骨分明的身影伏身而蹲，仿佛披着一袭由虹彩鳞片织就的鲜艳锦缎。那双鼓突的眼睛闪烁着不容置疑的机敏，而灵巧的四肢与能缠握的尾巴则暗示着他们具备以惊人速度穿梭的能力。一支专为鳄形口吻精雕的吹箭筒，从格纹兜裆布的皮革系带上斜斜探出；一条挂满浸毒飞镖的弹带横跨肩头。
A sinewy figure crouches, sheathed in a vibrant tapestry of iridescent scales. Their bulging eyes shine with obvious intelligence, and their dextrous limbs and prehensile tail hint at an ability to move at great speeds. A blowgun specially carved to fit their crocodilian mouth juts from the leather thong of a tartan loincloth, while a bandolier of poison-drenched darts crosses over their shoulder.

I Cast Light.name:
我施放光亮
I Cast Light

Text.text: 我的指尖泛起光辉，按在我法术的物体上。随着我施放魔法，响起一声滋滋作响，仿佛热锅里落下一滴水——随即，物品迸发出明亮光照。 The tips of my fingers glow with light as I press them against the object of my spell. There’s a sizzle like a drop of water in a hot pan as I cast my magic—then the item illuminates with bright light.

一枚光滑如镜的玻璃球体，内部亮起一张朦胧的分叉能量之网——仿佛把一场迷你雷暴封进了不过雪球般大小的水晶球里。它以狂躁的力量嗡鸣，像被囚的灵体随时要冲出牢笼，用噼啪作响的死亡裹住整间屋子。只是看着它就令人反胃。它被设计用来扰乱感官、搅乱心智，甚至连将其停用本身都是一场令人目眩的奇观。怎么会有东西如此明亮、如此充满光，却能把这样的黑暗带进世间？
A smooth glassy sphere glows with a nebulous web of forking energy—a miniature lightning storm in little more than a snow globe. It hums with manic power, like a trapped spirit ready to rush out and wrap the entire room in crackling death. It makes you queasy to look at. Designed to disorient and discombobulate, even inactivate it is a stunning spectacle. How can something so bright, so full of light, bring such darkness into the world?

Abandoned Castle In A Crater Lake.name:
陨坑湖中的废弃城堡
Abandoned Castle In A Crater Lake

Text.text:
当你翻过陨坑的脊线——脚下惨白的地衣被踩得咯吱作响——你看见一座远古城堡的残骸，正休息在坑内那片广阔幽暗湖泊的中央岛上。狭窄的窗洞里闪烁着幽灵般的光，塔楼上方垂挂的破碎幻旗在非人的寒风中噼啪抽响。一座饱经风雨的长石桥横跨湖面，像暴露的脊骨，将城堡与岸边焦黑沙滩上的残破门楼连接起来。咆哮的营火把它们映成剪影，海滩上巡逻着魁梧健壮、挥舞战争兵刃的庞大身影。

~ 构想：Puff

As you crest the ridge of the crater—pallid lichen crunching underfoot—you see the remains of an ancient castle resting on the central island of the vast, dark lake within. Spectral lights flicker in the narrow windows and ragged, phantasmal banners hanging from the towers above snap in an unearthly breeze. A long bridge of weathered stone stretches across the lake, like an exposed spine, connecting the castle to a ruined gatehouse on the blackened sands of the shore. Silhouetted by roaring camp fires, hulking, muscular figures wielding weapons of war patrol the beach.

~ Envisioned by Puff

The Retired Adventurer.name:
退休的冒险者
The Retired Adventurer

Text.text:
“当你想象踏上一次冒险时，你不会去描绘那些宁静的片刻——一顿顿饭、无聊的时光、与你的伙伴并肩长行时的沉默。但作为一个把一生都用来追逐荣光的人，让我告诉你：力量终会消退，英雄事迹也会滑入史书的页间；而那些在无言中共同度过的时光，才是你最铭记的。”
“When you imagine going on an adventure, you don’t picture the moments of quiet—the meals, the boredom, the silences of long walks with your companions. But as someone who spent their life seeking glory, let me tell you this: strength fades and heroic deeds slip into the history books, but the times shared in silence are what you will remember most.”

Cyber Street Drug, Bitcrush: Injected.name:
赛博街头毒品“比特碾碎”：注射剂
Cyber Street Drug, Bitcrush: Injected

Text.text:
注射器将原始的生物代码泵入你的细胞。痛楚尖锐到你的身体竟误以为那是快感——万亿次亚原子级爆炸撕碎你DNA的每一股螺旋，只为将它们重新卷回，织成全新的形态。你在一瞬间闪烁，部分的你被从存在中生生剜去，旋即又完美复原。你那僵硬扭曲的面具被一张对称得近乎神性的幼神之颜取代，伤口与疤痕在无瑕肌肤下消隐无踪；而你新生的意识如宇宙般扩张，将旧日经验尽数吞没。然而在这完美状态里，你能感到时代之沙本身，低声流逝，滴答倒数，直指那一刻——你将再度腐坏，退回那具恶心的空壳，那具困了你太久的牢笼。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The injector pumps raw bio-code into your cells. There is pain so acute your body mistakes it for pleasure, as trillions of sub-atomic explosions shred each strand of your DNA—only to re-spool them in a new shape. You flicker for a second, parts of you ripped out of existence only to reform perfectly. Your rictus mask is replaced by the symmetrical face of a godling, your cuts and scars disappear beneath flawless skin, and your new consciousness expands like a cosmos to subsume your old experience. But in this perfect state you can feel the very sands of time, whispering away, counting down to that moment when you degrade back into the disgusting shell that has trapped you for so long.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这只黑漆木匣配着铁制铰链与搭扣。匣内以皮革衬里，放着几支羽毛笔、墨水、一袋吸墨干燥粉、一本小记事本，以及数张羊皮纸。匣盖内侧用皮带固定着卡尺、直尺、绘图圆规、天然磁石罗盘与十字测杆。大多数器具皆为朴素钢制，唯独十字测杆以抛光的木与金属打造。
This black-lacquered wooden case has iron hinges and latches. Inside, its leather interior contains a few quills, ink, a bag of drying powder, a small notebook, and leaves of parchment. Strapped onto the lid bottom are calipers, a ruler, a drawing compass, a lodestone compass, and a cross-staff. Most of the implements are made of plain steel, but the cross-staff is polished wood and metal.

Divine Treetop Of A God Of Wilderness.name:
荒野神祇的神圣树冠
Divine Treetop Of A God Of Wilderness

Text.text:
也许你本想把这里建成一座漂亮的树屋，但荒野之神并不需要这些。那株古老的橡树本身就是家。它默许神明在仪式般的攀爬中没入树荫，他们一同呼吸旧世界未受污染的空气。他坐在粗壮枝桠的分岔处，嚼一颗橡实，或用口哨吹出鸟鸣。神明短暂地睡去片刻，做一个不受打扰、无需忧心那些前来砍伐焚烧之人的梦——直到他必须醒来，展开他暴烈的双翼，俯冲而下，站出来对抗文明。
Perhaps you wanted this to be a beautiful treehouse, but the god of wilderness has no need for that. The ancient oak is itself home. It agrees to the god’s ritual climb into shade, where they breathe the unpolluted air of the old world together. He sits in the crook of broad branches to eat an acorn or whistle birdsong. The god sleeps for a brief moment to dream without bother or worry over those who come to cut and burn, until he must wake, unfurl his violent wings, and fly down to stand against civilization.

Wild Magic Surge: Action Surge.name:
狂野魔法涌动：动作激发
Wild Magic Surge: Action Surge

Text.text:
随着你的法术余波，狂野的魔法如肾上腺素般在你体内奔涌。时代仿佛在刹那间放慢——恰好足以让你再做一个动作。
In the wake of your spell, raw magic surges through you like a rush of adrenaline. Time seems to slow for an instant—just long enough to perform one more action.

沐浴在午后温暖的阳光里，这头沉睡的爬行掠食者看起来就像一块巨大而扁平的岩石。生物的四肢深深埋在环绕它的渐凉泥沼中，宛如擎天巨柱，随时准备在需要时将这座由利齿与鳞甲构成的堡垒托举而起。粗壮的尾巴覆着锯齿般的鳞片，慵懒地漂在水里，柔和的水流像托着倒木般承载着这条沉重的肢体。
Basking in the warm afternoon sun, the sleeping reptilian predator resembles a large, flat rock. The creature’s legs are buried deep in the cooling mud that surrounds it, like mighty pillars ready to raise this fortress of teeth and scales aloft when needed. A thick tail covered in serrated scales drifts languidly in the water, the gentle current carrying the weighty appendage like a fallen log.

头顶传来一声沙哑刺耳的嘶嘶声。声源是一只强壮的鸟，蹲伏在峭岩之上。它的身躯像一块由褪色黑羽拼成的补丁布，大多数羽毛不是沾满污泥，就是被撕扯得破破烂烂。唯独它的头颅光秃秃的，结满痂皮，顶着一只弯得凶狠的钩喙。
A rasping hiss comes from above, the source a brawny bird perched on a crag. Its body is a patchwork of faded black feathers, most of which are spotted with dirt or torn and tattered in some way. The head, however, is completely bald, covered in scabs, and bears a wickedly curved beak.

Techno Divination Drug, Spectralize.name:
科技占卜药剂：幽灵显形
Techno Divination Drug, Spectralize

Text.text:
这是一只纤薄的黑色匣子，素净无饰，唯有一枚小小的螺旋纹以嵌银勾勒。匣内安放着三枚三角形胶囊，每一枚都刻着一只眼睛的符号。匣盖开启时，它们从柔软的泡棉巢座中缓缓升起，像在招手，催你取走、催你注射——催你与它融为一体。

~ 一位英雄构想

This is a thin black case, unadorned except for a small spiral that is made of inlaid silver. Within the case lie three triangular capsules, each engraved with the symbol of an eye. They rise out of their plush foam housing as the case is opened, beckoning to be taken, to be injected—to become one with you.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

伴随着一声饱受折磨的呻吟，这棵树猛然自地里拔起，腐臭的泥土在它周围迸裂翻涌，释放出令人作呕的恶臭。那笨重的生物缓缓转身，腐烂的树皮如同死皮般片片剥落，露出树干上一张哀恸的面孔。它尖啸着张开一道骇人的巨口，里面獠牙森立；你在它空洞的眼窝中，看见冰冷而饥渴的恶意。

~ Envisioned by RandomHero

With a tortured groan, the tree uproots itself and fetid earth erupts around it, unleashing a revolting stench. The lumbering creature turns, pieces of rotting bark flaking away like dead skin to reveal a mournful face in the trunk. With a shriek, it opens a gaping maw full of bristling fangs, and you see cold hungry malice in its hollow eyes.

~ Envisioned by RandomHero

Weapons Shop In Town.name:
镇上武器铺
Weapons Shop In Town

Text.text:
一栋矮壮的单层建筑坐落在街道尽头，由厚重的原木、卵石与砂浆梁垒砌而成。黑烟一股股从粗大的石烟囱里翻涌而出，烟囱从瓦片屋顶的远侧拔起。几级台阶通向一扇沉重的门，门上方的招牌直白地写着“护甲”，字样上方还粗糙地刷着一面盾牌。屋内透过窗子传来叮叮当当的金属回响——铁锤敲击钢铁的尖亮声在街上回荡。

踏入门内，处理过的皮革那股带着泥土气的味道立刻钻入鼻腔。狭小而朴素的房间里摆着几十个架子，每个架子都挂着不同种类的防护道具。一面墙边整齐放着线条利落的皮护甲，有些还钉着粗厚的铁铆钉；另一面墙旁则立着一套套板甲，沉稳而威风。隔壁房间里持续的敲击声在门关上的瞬间戛然而止，紧接着店主走了出来，身上系着厚实的皮围裙，边缘沾着油污。
A stout, one-story building made of heavy wood logs, cobble, and mortar beams sits at the end of the street. Plumes of black smoke billow from a thick stone chimney rising from the far side of the shingled roof. Steps lead up to a heavy-set door, where overhead a sign plainly reads, “Armor,” above a crudely painted shield. The tinny sound of a hammer rapping on steel echoes through a window from inside.
 
 Stepping inside, the earthy smell of worked hide greets your nose. The small, simple room houses dozens of racks, each holding a different kind of protective gear. Along one wall rest sets of sleek leather armor, some reinforced with thick iron studs, while along another stand proud plate mail suits. Hammering from an adjoining room stops at the sound of the door closing behind you and out walks the shopkeeper dressed in a hefty leather apron smudged with oil.

曾经，这里只是野灌丛间一条尘土飞扬、被无数脚步踩踏出来的小径；如今，道面上或多或少均匀地铺散着采石场碾碎的岩屑。碎石路对那些更精致的鞋底而言相当磨人，却比雨季里被踩得稀烂、泥泞纠缠的跋涉要好上太多。
Spread out over the surface of what was once a dusty, foot-beaten path in the untamed brush, this road has now been more or less evenly scattered with pulverized rock from a quarry. The gravel trail, though quite punishing on the soles of more delicate footwear, is a vast improvement over a mired trip over mud churned up during the rainy seasons.

这只乌龟的体型和孩童差不多，举止却更像猴子而非两栖动物。这生物吱吱喳喳地叫着，用机敏的眼睛打量四周，还会直立行走。它粗硬的毛发剃成僧侣般的地中海发式，头顶中央却凹着一处小小的圆形水洼。你一注意到这一点，这生物便显得警惕、戒备，甚至有些恼怒。它蜷伏下身，将自己收拢在满是尖刺的甲壳之下。
This turtle is the size of a child and behaves more like a monkey than an amphibian. The creature chatters, stares through intelligent eyes, and walks upright. Its coarse hair is styled in a tonsure, like a monk, and there is a small circular pool of water in the center. When you notice this, the creature seems wary, defensive, even a little angry. It hunkers down, gathering itself under its spiky shell.

Angry Willow Treant.name:
暴怒的垂柳树人
Angry Willow Treant

Text.text: 树人沉重地踏上小丘，脚步轰隆砰响；它双腿缠绕的根须如筋腱般弯折柔韧。它猛然挥动枝桠般的臂膀，爪状的双手抛洒出木刺，落地时发出轻轻的噗嗒声，扎进蓬松的草丛与泥土里。它稀疏的叶须簌簌颤抖，胸腔空洞处传出低沉的咆哮；它龇着锋利的牙，扭曲成狞笑，牙齿随那声响咔哒作响、碰撞连连。 The treant trumps up the knoll with heavy, thumping footfalls, the twined roots of its legs bending and pliant like sinew. Moving its bough-arms in abrupt thrusts, its clawed hands fling splinters out to land with soft plunks in the earth, piercing the tufted grass. Its wispy tendrils of leaves shiver as a growl thrums from the hollow of its chest, and its sharp teeth, bared in a grimace, clatter and click with the sound.

Tortle Necromancer.name:
龟人死灵法师
Tortle Necromancer

Text.text:
他令倒下的战友再度起身，他们的躯体支离破碎、伤痕累累，如今只被法术驱使。再来一次。在最后冲锋前的短暂静默里，在确信己方必将覆灭的那一刻，他疲惫不堪，外壳龟裂，灵魂也被榨干了最后一丝魔力。那些他未能救下的人、以及即将再次死去的人，让他的心沉重如铅。死亡，那不可避免的盟约。

~ 构想：TK DiBiase

He raises his fallen comrades, their bodies broken and scarred, compelled now only by the spell. One more time. In the lull before the final charge, in the certainty his side will fall, he is weary, his shell cracked, and his soul depleted of its last magicks. His heart is heavy with the loss of those he could not save and those about to die again. Death, the inevitable alliance.

~ Envisioned by TK DiBiase

The Pine In The Clearing.name:
林间空地的松树
The Pine In The Clearing

Text.text:
高大的扭叶松伫立在林间空地上，在秋日寒意里显得格外温暖。它的紫杉根系如斑驳的手指般紧扣着下方的泥土。阳光束与肥沃的土壤在这株孤松四周铺展开来，清晨的露珠挂在松针上，在光里闪烁微芒。
The great lodgepole stands in a clearing, a warm sight in the autumn chill. Its yew roots clasp the earth below like mottled fingers. Sunbeams and fertile soil stretch forth around this single pine, the morning dew on its needles glimmering in the light.

Desert: Trekking Across The Sand.name:
沙漠：跋涉穿越沙海
Desert: Trekking Across The Sand

Text.text:
风势终于弱到足以让你听见自己踩在沙地上的脚步声。偶尔仍有灼热的小微风触及你的皮肤，但你听到的风声必定在高空呼啸，将天上寥寥无几的云层撕成碎絮，赶在它们投下任何解渴的阴影或带来雨水之前，就把它们卷得无影无踪。
The wind has died down enough to allow you to hear your own footsteps in the sand. Hot little zephyrs reach you now and then, but the wind you hear must be high, shredding the few clouds in the sky and sending them flying away before they provide any relief-giving shade or rain.

Desert Nomad Camp: Day.name:
沙漠游牧营地：白昼
Desert Nomad Camp: Day

Text.text:
营地的色彩与喧嚣让这里带上了嘉年华般的气息，尽管四周景色依旧荒凉。低矮的尖顶帐篷在沙地上绵延铺开，临时拼成一座村落，中央广场上铺满了地毯。几顶帐篷将侧帘卷起，露出里面的椅子、箱子与坐垫——旅途中能打包带走的全部便携奢华。
The colors and noise of the camp lend it a carnival atmosphere, despite the bleak surroundings. Low tents with peaked roofs spawl out across the sand, creating an impromptu village complete with a rug-strewn central square. Some tents have their sides rolled up, revealing chairs, chests, and cushions—all the portable luxuries that could be packed for the journey.

Someone’s Spot.name:
某人的藏身处
Someone’s Spot

Text.text:
一块巨石将此处从路上半遮半掩；石旁一片夯实的土地被剥得寸草不生。这里似乎是某人最爱来抽一口的地方——地上散落着断裂的陶烟斗，点点烟灰斑驳其间。
Partially hidden from the road by a large boulder, a patch of packed earth has been denuded of grass. This appears to be someone’s favorite spot to come for a smoke, as the ground is littered with broken clay pipes and spots of ash.

Ray Of Sickness.name:
疫病射线
Ray Of Sickness

Text.text:
法术裹着恶毒的憎恨被狠狠啐出，于是魔法凝结成形——病态的绿，带着腐蚀的尖厉——一线黏稠的毒液朝着目标疾射而去。这道法术的恶臭毒雾让周遭植物迅速萎蔫，仿佛连它们的生命都被硬生生抽走。
The spell is spat in vicious hate, and so the magic forms—sickly green and caustic—a line of sticky poison shooting toward the target. The noxious fumes of this spell cause nearby plants to wilt, as though the very life has been sucked out of them.

尽管它形似火焰，你伸出的手中迸射出那道耀眼的神圣能量洪流却不带丝毫热度——那是你信仰所召来的威能，为的就是将敌人轰然击倒。
Though it resembles flame, no heat emerges from the raw blast of coruscating divine energy flying from your outstretched hand—the might of your faith conjured to lay low your enemy.

这家伙身高体型都很普通——相貌也平平无奇，模糊到几乎记不住。他戴着一顶你今天至少在十来个人头上见过的帽子，身上穿的也是随处可见的常见衣服。这些特征显然正合他那行当的需要：你看着他撞上另一名行人，连声道歉，随即从这场毫不起眼的遭遇中抽身离开，手里却多了个钱袋，并迅速将其悄无声息地藏了起来。
The fellow is of average height and build—and of middling, indistinct appearance. He wears a hat you must have seen on a dozen other people today, and he’s dressed in commonly seen clothes. These factors must help in his evident profession, for you watch him bump into another pedestrian and apologize, breaking off from the forgettable encounter with a coin purse in his hand, which he swiftly secrets away.

Drow With Vitiligo.name:
患白癜风的卓尔
Drow With Vitiligo

Text.text:
如同抽象的纹身一般，颜料拼出的谜题格外醒目。它看起来像一段秘密码，是身体用来确认自身身份的宣言。卓尔那头白发因靛蓝底色上以淡蓝弧线描绘的分段纹彩而更显凌厉夺目。

~ 由 Played 发表，Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Like an abstract tattoo, the puzzle of pigments is distinguishing. It looks like a secret code, an expression of the body to identify itself. The drow’s white hair is made all the more striking by the segments painted in pale blue curves on an indigo field.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Fast Goblin With Cloak.name:
披斗篷的疾行地精
Fast Goblin With Cloak

Text.text:
地精嗖地从你身旁掠过，近得你甚至能感觉到它斗篷的边缘擦过你的手臂。你伸手去抓那块布，却只抓了个空。地精早已跑出好几步远。
The goblin zips past you, close enough for you to feel the edge of its cloak against your arm. You reach out to grab the cloth, but come away empty handed. The goblin is already paces away.

Skyship Bow Gun.name:
飞空艇舰艏炮
Skyship Bow Gun

Text.text: 观星者引以为傲的杰作，令人叹为观止。船艏嵌着一门毁灭性的符文加农炮，由四根炮管组成——每根足有一英尺粗——其上刻着发光的符印。你靠近这头庞然巨物时，牙根隐隐发痒，眼后传来沉沉的压迫感；魔法的气息强烈到几乎让空气都变得粘稠沉重，饱含神秘力量——只待释放，倾泻奥术的毁灭。 The pride and joy of the Stargazer is an awe-inspiring sight. Four barrels—each a foot wide—marked with glowing sigils make up the devastating Rune Cannon set in the bow of the ship. Your teeth itch and you feel a pressure behind your eyes as you near the behemoth, the aura of magic so strong that the very air feels heavy and laden with mystical power—waiting to be unleashed and deliver arcane devastation

这头熊地精巨兽般的身躯，配上松垮的水手衣装与踏浪般的摇摆步伐，除了海盗不作他想。他魁梧的骨架上覆着一层厚白毛，部分地方炸起卷曲——主要在头顶、肩膀与前臂——像一团团云絮般蓬松，显然是长年受咸湿海风吹拂的结果。他的眼白呈灰烬色，唯有猩红的虹膜以静止而烟雾般的沉着打量世界。干裂的嘴唇后露出尖牙，其中下颌两枚最粗大的獠牙如獠牙般向上挑出，几乎像野猪的长牙。与他眼中血色裂缝同色的绶带绕在腰间，衬得他圆鼓的肚腹更显醒目。肩头那一圈圈厚实的肌肉告诉你，他能轻松把背上的巨型巨剑抽出。剑刃带弧，弯势宛如一记力量惊人的下沉海浪。他胸前的衬衫敞开着，白毛之间垂着一枚徽章，上面刻着一道闪电的符号。

~ Played by Khao Lo with

This behemoth of a bugbear could be nothing else but a pirate, with his loose seafarer’s clothes and sea-leg swagger. A thick coat of white fur all over his burly frame frizzes in some places—his head, shoulders, and forearms mainly—a cloudlike effect undoubtedly from constant exposure to salty sea air. His eyes are ashen-colored aside from crimson irises that observe the world with a still and smoky calm. Sharp teeth poke out from behind his chapped lips, the two largest fangs from his lower jaw extending far upward like tusks. A sash, the same color as the sanguine slits in his eyes, wraps around his middle, highlighting his rotund belly. The thick bands of muscle in his shoulders suggest he can pull the massive greatsword from his back with ease. The blade curves, its bend reminiscent of a powerful, descending ocean wave. His shirt lies open at the chest, and against the white fur you see a medallion hanging, bearing the symbol of a lightning bolt.

~ Played by Khao Lo with

Subterranean Fungi Forest.name:
地下菌蕈森林
Subterranean Fungi Forest

Text.text:
在这片非人间的地下生态群系中，你正穿行于一片枝叶密织的区域。然而，它并非阳光之地的森林：这里没有参天乔木，取而代之的是巨大的蘑菇；林地也不见青苔与灌木，只有成团的地衣与霉菌铺满地面。潮湿腐烂的气味浸透空气，一层淡淡的孢子薄雾如落尘般笼罩着整个区域。
Here, in this unearthly subterranean biome, you find yourself traveling through a thickly forested area. However, unlike the forests of sunlit lands, this one is replete with enormous mushrooms instead of trees, and clumps of lichen and mold blanket the forest floor instead of moss and shrubbery. The smell of wet rot permeates the air, and there is a faint haze of spore fallout blanketing the entire area.

Fire Giant's Volcanic Forge.name:
火巨人的火山熔炉
Fire Giant's Volcanic Forge

Text.text:
铁锤的鸣响如神祇的钟声，一遍又一遍——每一次沉重落下之间，都夹着一记轻点——你踏入一间巨大的房间，几乎完全由一座天然熔炉构成：参差嶙峋的支挡墙由乌亮如镜的黑岩垒起，墙体内涌动着熔岩。你面前，一个巨人背阔如墙地立着，一手握锤，另一手攥着一柄未完成的武器柄。那魁伟的铸匠停下手中活计，最后一声锤鸣在室内回荡，它随即转身看向你。抵在炉火上的粗胚武器白红炽亮，却已凝实到足以握持。

~ 构想：Nachreld

A hammer rings like a god’s bell, again and again—a light tap between each heavy fall—as you enter a large room made almost entirely of a natural forge: a jagged retaining wall of shining black rock filled with lava. Standing broad-backed to you is a giant, hammer in one fist, handle of an unfinished weapon in the other. The massive smith stops its work, the last ring of the hammer echoing, and turns toward you. The rough weapon held to the forge glows white and red, yet solid enough to wield.

~ Envisioned by Nachreld

Rhuinen Greymantle.name:
鲁伊嫩·灰披风
Rhuinen Greymantle

Text.text:
尽管身形敦实，这名矮人对同族而言却算得上高大，肩头几乎与仍在外游荡的少数人类齐平。他环顾四周，机敏的蓝眼在渐浓的黑暗里仍将每一处细节尽收眼底。浓须下掠过一丝沉思，他漫不经心地抓了抓手背上那道繁复的纹身。他在一枚踩踏痕旁跪下，泥地被那脚印割出一道伤口。拂开钴蓝色长袍，他从一只蔚蓝护腕里取出一支小巧的单筒望远镜，俯身细细察看那痕迹。确认无误后，他起身，小心跨过脚印，低声呢喃了些什么。

~ 扮演：Roony

Despite his girth the dwarf is tall for his race, shoulder height to the few humans still abroad. He surveys his surroundings, clever blue eyes taking in every detail despite the growing dark. A thoughtful look crosses his bearded face and he scratches absently at the intricate tattoo adorning his hand. He kneels beside a footprint scarring the mud. Brushing aside his cobalt robes, he removes a tiny spyglass from one cerulean bracer and uses it to examine the mark. Satisfied, he rises, steps carefully over the print and whispers something.

~ Played by Roony

Mountain Pass: Old Wooden Bridge.name:
山口：古老木桥
Mountain Pass: Old Wooden Bridge

Text.text:
横跨深渊的桥在风中摇晃，随着你踩上去的重量发出吱呀呻吟。粗厚而饱经风雨的木板看上去结实可靠，紧紧捆扎其上的绳索也不见半点磨损的毛边；可即便如此，脚下是如此漫长的坠落距离，每迈出一步都令人心惊胆战。
The bridge crossing the chasm sways in the wind and creaks with your weight. The thick, weathered planks look sturdy, and the ropes binding it tightly together show no sign of fraying, but even so, with such a long way to fall, each step feels treacherous.

尽管这处庭院为露天格局，高大阴森的宅邸围墙仍为其提供了部分庇护，使庄园的住民得以在此暂歇。精雕细琢的大理石雕像矗立在修剪齐整的花园中，那些穿园而过的平整石径四角等距对峙。几张石凳沿着小径安置，恰好适合人们在此静静沉思——也许手边还摊着一本被翻得起了毛边的旧书。
Despite its open-air layout, this courtyard is partially protected by the tall, forbidding walls of the property, allowing a place of respite for the estate’s inhabitants. Finely crafted marble statues have been erected at equidistant corners of the smooth stone paths cut through the manicured gardens. Several stone benches have been placed along these walkways, conducive to moments of quiet reflection, perhaps with a well-thumbed book.

只需指尖轻轻一触，那物体便猛然迸发出魔法火焰。火焰毫无热度，却以摇曳闪烁的光芒，成为令人欣然的照明来源。
With a mere touch from the tip of your finger, the object bursts into magical flame. Though it emits no heat, the flame is a welcome source of flickering light.

Private Spacecraft Repair Bay.name:
私人航天器维修舱
Private Spacecraft Repair Bay

Text.text:
你所见过最令人难以置信的舰船，正奢靡地停卧在这座私人船坞唯一的泊位里。干船坞中的舰体被一小支工作人员队伍团团照料，在一名阴沉工头冷峻的注视下，他们细致入微地修补着这艘船——那工头戴着一顶硬挺的尖檐帽。每个入口都布置了身穿黑色护甲的武装守卫，而自动炮塔低沉的机械嗡鸣声，则泄露出更深一层防御的存在。
The most incredible ship you have ever seen lounges decadently in the private shipyard’s only bay. A small army of staff attends the dry-docked vessel, meticulously repairing the craft under the watchful gaze of a dour foreman in a stiff, peaked cap. Armed guards in black body-armor have been stationed at every point of entry, and the mechanical whirring of automated turrets betrays the presence of further defenses.

My White Robe Of The Archmagi Gives Me A.name:
我的大法师白袍让我在对抗一个法术时获得优势
My White Robe Of The Archmagi Gives Me An Advantage Against A Spell

Text.text:
敌人的法术朝我飞射而来，我迅速抬臂交叉于胸前，结成防御的十字。长袍雪白的袖口鼓荡着与生俱来的力量，兜帽猛地跃起罩住我的头颅，在那股敌意的魔法触及之际将我护住。被施了魔法的布料深处猛然一震、奋力一掀，我清晰地感觉到长袍把法术的全部冲击硬生生推开。想到我的伙伴们也许来不及躲开这次攻击最可怕的部分，我的心猛地一跳。我立刻放下兜帽，去确认他们的情况。
As the enemy spell flies at me, I bring up my arms into a defensive cross. The snow-white sleeves of my robe billow with innate power, and my hood leaps over my head to protect me as the hostile magic makes contact. With a great heave within the enchanted fabric, I feel the robe shove away the full brunt of the spell. My heart leaps at the thought of my companions being unable to avoid the worst of the attack. I immediately lower my hood to check on them.

Bhavani’s Medical Center.name:
巴瓦妮医疗中心
Bhavani’s Medical Center

Text.text: 这幢石砌建筑几乎毫无装饰，唯有一块简朴的木牌挂在前门上，潦草的字迹匆匆写着 医疗中心。透过正面的窗户，你能看见医生的身影——她的笔尖狂乱地在一张羊皮纸上疾书，沙沙作响。屋里最向阳的角落摆着两张折叠床，空着，却刚刚铺好，整齐得发亮。她无声地对护士咬着口型交代几句——那是一名提夫林，短而尖的角从额上探出，皮肤上紫红相间的斑驳像淤痕般铺开。她把纸递给他，随即从地上拎起一只皮革包。她利落地一把推开前门，身子挤出去，任门在身后自行合拢。她沿着道路走去，神情绷得笔直，专注得近乎冷硬。护士则显得有些不安，手指穿过那团乱翘的黑发，猩红的眼睛飞快扫过她留下的笔记。 The stone building is bereft of decoration aside from a simple wooden sign, simply reading Medical Center in hurried script, hanging on the front door. The doctor can be seen through the front window, her pen furiously scribbling down notes on a piece of parchment. Two cots lay empty but freshly made in the sunniest spot in the room. She mouths some instructions to her nurse, a tiefling with short, pointed horns and skin mottled purple and red. She hands him the paper and picks up a leather bag from the floor. She presses through the front door with an efficient shove, letting it shut behind her. She makes her way down the road with a rigidly focused expression. The nurse, looking a tad fretful, runs his hand through his shock of black hair as his red eyes scan over her notes.

Manacled And Marked Undead Dwarf.name:
被魔缚并烙印的亡灵矮人
Manacled And Marked Undead Dwarf

Text.text:
矮人的手腕上戴着镣铐，锁链叮当作响；它挥动双臂，笨拙地胡乱抓挠。苍白的皮肉上刻满符文，被成片剥下的厚厚皮条垂落，露出底下红肿发炎的血肉。它仅存的一只眼睛蒙着乳白色的浑浊薄膜，却仿佛死死盯着你。它踉跄向前，双腿在雕凿般的肌肉之下依旧不稳；它低声呻吟，粘稠的黏液与唾液拉成丝网，横亘在那张大张的嘴间。
Chains jingle from manacles about the dwarf’s wrists as it swings its arms in clumsy swipes. Runes are carved into its pallid flesh, flayed away in thick strands to reveal inflamed flesh underneath. Its one remaining eye, though fogged with a milky-white veil, seems fixed upon you. It shambles forward, legs unsteady despite their chiseled musculature, moaning through the strings of mucus and saliva webbing across its gaping mouth.

Loot From A Grimlock.name:
来自灰锁魔的战利品
Loot From A Grimlock

Text.text:
灰矮魔身上一无所获，但它的一名受害者却在那只被它攥紧的腐烂残手里，留着5枚铜币、一把锁（钥匙还插在锁孔里），以及一只信号哨。
No loot is found on the grimlock, but one of its victims has 5 copper pieces, a lock with the key in it, and a signal whistle in the putrid remains of their clutched hand.

The Front Lines Of A Mythic Battle.name:
神话战役的最前线
The Front Lines Of A Mythic Battle

Text.text:
爬行类坐骑驮着骑手冲入军阵——骑手身披黑金长袍，迎面撞上穿红色束腰短衣的士兵队列；那红，是主教袍般的猩红，随咬合的獠牙与闪烁的枪尖觅到血肉，迅速黯成陈酒的色泽。战场的尘霾忽然短暂散开，被俯冲而下的狮鹫宽阔黑翼狠狠拍散；披甲骑士骑在它们狮般的背上，压向爬行骑兵。一名骑士驭手抬手，魔法的激流飞掠而出，能量波如重锤砸穿阵线，黑金军势顿时四散。红衣士兵的阵线爆出欢呼，但狂喜来得太早。硫磺般的刺鼻气味灼烧空气，对方阵中一枚火焰之球呼啸而来，轰然炸入队列，连几只腾空的狮鹫也被点燃。罪魁祸首——一台巨大的有轮暗金属机器，像烟囱般喷吐黑烟，炮管深处仍有一抹橙红余烬在闷烧。战场被浓烟、烈焰与魔法的微光堵得几乎窒息，尖叫与骇人的剪影搅成一团迷乱的云雾，更多身影正涌入绞杀之中。

~ Envisioned by SorcererMemeSupreme

Reptilian mounts, their riders garbed in robes of black and gold, crash into lines of soldiers in tunics of red—a cardinal red that darkens to the color of old wine as gnashing teeth and glinting spearheads find flesh. The dusty haze of battle clears for a moment, buffeted away by wide, black wings of griffons descending upon the reptilian cavalry, bearing knights upon their leonine backs. A surge of magic flies forth from a knight-rider, and the black-and-gold army scatters as a wave of energy pummels their line. A cheer rises from the line of red soldiers, but the revelry is premature. A sulfurous smell singes the air as an orb of fire blazes from the opposing force, exploding into the soldiers and setting some airborne griffons ablaze. The culprit: a huge wheeled machine of dark metal, smoking like a chimney, a smoldering orange within the barrel of its gun. The battlefield, choked with smoke, fire, and the shimmer of magic, is a confounding cloud of shrieks and ghastly silhouettes as more forms move into the fray.

~ Envisioned by SorcererMemeSupreme

Bulky, Hard-wired Mercenary.name:
笨重的硬接线佣兵
Bulky, Hard-wired Mercenary

Text.text:
她那件绿色军衬衫的袖子被硬生生撕掉，露出臂膀上隆起的厚实肌肉，以及一圈圈赛博义体电缆如花环般缠绕而下，沿着手臂一路蜿蜒到手腕。她抬手拨过自己的假莫霍克发型，霓虹在夜城里跳跃，映在她飞行员墨镜那漆黑如镜的镜片上。那副护目镜紧紧压在她脸上，镜框包住耳廓，接口延伸进听觉增强器里。步枪的枪口从她肩后探出一截，而她腰侧还挂着一把笨重的爆能手枪。
The sleeves of her green army shirt have been torn free, making way for the sizable muscles of her arms as well as the garland of cybernetic cables winding down to her wrists. She passes her fingers through her fauxhawk, the neon lights of the city dancing on the black mirror of her aviators. The specs press tightly against her face, its frames wrapping around her ears and feeding into auditory enhancers. The nose of a rifle peeks over her shoulder, and she carries a bulky blaster pistol at her hip.

Delivery Of Drow Poison.name:
卓尔毒药的交付
Delivery Of Drow Poison

Text.text:
一股寒意从伤口处窜入你体内，向外蔓延。寒意所过之处，你只觉身体一点点僵硬。你本能地想要挣扎抗拒，可那冰冷却猛地冲上你的头顶。你唇间再也挤不出半个字，只剩一声低低的喘鸣——你就这样原地冻结。
A chill runs through you, radiating out from the injury. Where it passes, you feel your body stiffen. You instinctively protest, but the chill rushes over your head. Nothing escapes your lips but a quiet wheeze as you freeze in place.

Orbital Military Checkpoint With Skeleto.name:
配备骷髅（特征）班底的轨道军事检查站
Orbital Military Checkpoint With Skeleton Crew

Text.text:
尽管这座环轨检查站理所当然地令人心生畏惧，却不知为何——空荡得可怕。憔悴的士兵守着这艘庞大的舰船，铅一般沉重的双手操弄着控制台，被疲惫压得几乎抬不起。天知道有多少走私禁品从这支形同骷髅的班底眼皮底下溜了过去。
Though the orbiting checkpoint is rightfully intimidating, it feels somehow—empty. Haggard soldiers man the large vessel, operating the controls with leaden hands, weighed down by fatigue. Who knows how much contraband has slipped past this skeletal crew.

各种材料陈列在你面前——红陶土、灰烬，以及研磨成粉的曼德拉草根。你一手高举镶满宝石的匕首，另一手则开始调配那些繁复的配料。你口中吐出的词句古老得近乎陌生，其真正含义早已湮没无闻。但它们的效果无可置疑——当你割开自己引出鲜血，生命便在你眼前凝聚。陶土、灰烬、草根与你的血交融搅合，开始自行塑形，逐渐塑出那被称作人造人的生物。

~ 由 OntarioDad 构想

The components lie before you—red clay, gray ash, and ground mandrake root. With one hand, you hold aloft the jewel-encrusted dagger, and with the other, prepare the intricate ingredients. The words you speak are ancient, their true meaning forgotten. But their effect is undeniable, and as you cut yourself to draw blood, life coalesces before you. The clay, the ash, the root, and your own blood mingle and begin to take shape, forming the creature known as a homunculus.

~ Envisioned by OntarioDad

Mcgregor’s Cottage.name:
麦格雷戈的小屋
Mcgregor’s Cottage

Text.text:
一名兔族男子坐在门廊上吱呀作响的摇椅里轻轻晃着，褐色的长耳与口鼻边缘泛着一圈白霜似的浅色。他穿着褪了色的背带裤和蓝色法兰绒衬衫，细长的脚没穿鞋，沾满泥污而发黑。靠在椅中，他把脸迎向日光取暖，嘴里慢慢嚼着一小段甜草。宅地上的两块菜园里蔬菜长势喜人，个个品相惊人：有卷心菜宽得像车轮，还有巨大番茄，红绿相间的条纹在皮上蜿蜒。
A rabbitfolk man rocks in a squeaking chair on his porch, his brown-furred ears and snout turning white at the edges. He’s dressed in faded overalls and a blue flannel shirt, his long feet shoeless and darkened with mud. As he rests in his seat, warming his face in the sun, he chews on a bit of sweet grass. The two gardens on his property are full of healthy vegetables with impressive qualities. You spot cabbages as wide as wagon wheels and enormous tomatoes striped both red and green.

金褐色的毛皮下，粗壮的肌肉索条起伏绷紧——那名高耸的狮族战士踏着沉稳步伐巡行于要塞城垛之上。他举手投足间尽是天生军人的武者骄傲与纪律；他那一尘不染的装备在夕阳沉入海湾时，映出温暖的橙金光泽。右侧披着一袭飘动的斗篷，其上印着他神祇的徽记；一面盾牌——绘着风格化的太阳——与他手中那柄令人胆寒的长矛相互映衬。温柔的海风掠过他飘扬的鬃毛。他合上黄玉般的眼眸，短暂沉浸于这份触感，而后重新睁眼，继续守望。

~ Played by Vmaster1995 with

Thick cords of muscle flex beneath the golden-brown fur of the towering lionfolk warrior as he marches across the fortress battlements. The man carries himself with the martial pride and discipline of a natural soldier, and his immaculate equipment catches the rays of the sun in a warm orange hue as it sets over the bay. A flowing cloak bearing the symbol of his god is draped over his right side, and a shield—emblazoned with a stylized sun—complements the formidable spear he carries. A gentle sea breeze caresses his flowing mane. Closing his topaz eyes, he enjoys the sensation for a moment before resuming his watch.

~ Played by Vmaster1995 with

你面前的男人堪称惊艳。抛光钢铁般的肌肤，与条纹虎木的嵌片交错相融，仿佛在复刻自然的解剖结构，奇妙得令人屏息。然而，这绝非区区自动人偶。他那机械的笑容里透着一种爽朗的暖意，反衬出造物本该有的冰冷机能；而那双深棕色的眼睛里又藏着难以言说的忧伤，沉沉承载着悲剧过往的重量。随着一声清晰可闻的click，他从左前臂的一道槽口中伸出一面小巧而精美的盾牌，盾面上镌刻的青铜齿轮徽记在阳光下熠熠生辉。

~ 由 ABrokenTardis 扮演，并使用

The man before you is quite magnificent. Skin of polished steel blends with pockets of banded tigerwood in a facsimile of natural anatomy that is truly wondrous to behold. But this is far from a mere automaton. There is a jovial warmth in his mechanical smile, which belies the cold functionality of his creation, and a sadness in eyes of deepest brown that carry the weight of a tragic past. With an audible click he extends a small, beautifully crafted shield from a slot along his left forearm, the bronze cogwheel emblazoned upon it shining resplendent in the sun.

~ Played by ABrokenTardis with

I Unfold A Portable Hole.name:
我展开一个便携洞
I Unfold A Portable Hole

Text.text:
我从口袋里掏出那团圆润的丝绸，轻轻一抖。它倏然展开成直径六英尺的圆盘，落地之处，陷坑随之显现。接下来只剩下诱饵与等待。我的对手很快就会出现——等他们坠入其中，我便能将那片异次元空间的黑暗像布一样合拢包起，像取出时一样轻松地塞回口袋，然后扬长而去。
From my pocket, I pull the rounded silk and give it a shake. It opens to a circle six feet in diameter, and where it lands, the pit appears. Just a question of baiting and waiting now. My opponents will be along, and when they drop in, I can just fold up the blackness of extradimensional space around them, tuck it with the same ease into my pocket as when I took it out, and be on my merry way.

你从远处看到的空气扭曲，原来是急速奔流的熔岩溪流蒸腾出的热浪。它穿过大地上一道幽深的裂隙——这裂隙仿佛将整片墓园一劈为二，并向两端延伸至视野尽头，像是世界被硬生生撬开了一道口子。这是否预示着某种强大的施法，或是被释放到世间的元素之力？
The wavering in the air you saw from a distance turns out to be the heat from a stream of swift-flowing lava. It flows through a deep cleft in the earth that has riven this graveyard in two and stretches into the distance in both directions, as if the world cracked open. Does this portend some powerful spellcasting or elemental energy unleashed into the world?

I Hide In The Rafters.name:
我藏在椽梁之上
I Hide In The Rafters

Text.text:
我像蜘蛛般悄无声息地潜行，沿着椽梁一点点挪动，手脚并用紧抓木梁。我的身形藏在阴影里，火把、月光与星光都无法触及我。我凝视着，等待着——此刻，耐心与寂静才是关键。
Slinking as stealthily as a spider, I inch along the rafters, with both hands and feet grasping the wood beams. My form is hidden in the shadows, the light of torches, moon, and stars unable to reach me. I watch and wait, patience and silence now key.

随着咒语与手势的完成，你不复存在。这滋味确实诡异。你伫立在缥缈的虚无之中，只能感知现实那模糊的灰色轮廓与被闷住的声响。此处没有任何东西能伤害你，然而你知道自己必须归返，否则便会永远迷失。
With the completion of the words and movements, you cease to be. A strange sensation, to be sure. You stand amid ethereal nothingness, perceiving only the vague, gray shapes and muffled sounds of reality. Nothing can harm you here, and yet you know you must return to avoid losing yourself forever.

Charismatic Pirate Captain.name:
魅力非凡的海盗船长
Charismatic Pirate Captain

Text.text:
船长大步踏上甲板，船员间顿时鸦雀无声，随即又被震惊的低语取代。她举手投足宛如女神，浑然天成的魅力以肉眼可感的气势倾泻而出。乌鸦般的黑发精心梳起，衬得那对盘旋的犄角愈发醒目，其上点缀着各式各样的闪耀饰物。宝石般的红色肌肤鲜润得像一颗清脆成熟的苹果，而她那双金色眼眸在一瞬间便将整支船员尽收眼底。

~ Clara C. Potter on Discord

The captain strides onto the deck as a hush falls over the crew, replaced by stunned murmuring. The woman carries herself like a goddess, exuding effortless charisma in palpable magnitude. Her raven-black hair is styled to accentuate her spiraling horns which are festooned with all manner of glittering accessories. Her ruby-red skin is the luscious hue of a crisp, ripe apple, and her golden eyes gain the measure of her crew in an instant.

~ Clara C. Potter on Discord

它潜伏在阴影里，多枚摄像镜头锁定那位光彩夺目的名流，碎裂的代码灼烧着侵入式监视的残渣。最新科技以吞噬光线的涂料包覆它棱角分明的骨架，唯一的移动来自它眼中细小的电机，正不断调校角度与景深。
It lurks in the shadows, multiple camera lenses trained on the glittering celebrity, scrap code burning off intrusive surveillance. The latest tech coats its angular frame with light-eating pigment, and the only movement is the tiny motors within its eyes, adjusting angle and depth.

面包师围着厨房忙得团团转，围裙前襟沾满面粉，时而查看发酵程度，时而把一盘盘面包与点心在砖砌烤炉里调换转位。他伸手指蘸了点果酱浓缩汁尝了尝，撒上一撮盐，又尝了一口，满意地点点头，随即转身投入下一项工序。
Flour stains the front of the baker's apron as they bustle around the kitchen, checking proofs and rotating breads and pastries in the brick ovens. They dip a finger into a fruit reduction, taste it, add a pinch of salt, taste it again, nod, and move on to the next task.

Justice's Grave In Winter.name:
冬日的正义之墓
Justice's Grave In Winter

Text.text: 在积雪之下，这具石棺刻着铭文：此间长眠者为正义，德里昂强而有力的右臂。愿二者在旅途之中永不分离，无论此世或来世。 Beneath the snow this sarcophagus bears the inscription: Herein lies Justice, strong right hand of Derion. Let the two never be parted in their journeys, whether in this world or the next.

Loot From An Oni.name:
恶鬼的战利品（特征）
Loot From An Oni

Text.text:
野兽在吞噬受害者后，似乎把一些魔法物品据为己有。宝藏上覆着一件破烂的斗篷，或许曾属于某个倒霉的施法者：几支装着不同液体的小瓶仍稳稳卡在弹带上，一枚护符，一把弯刃匕首，以及一袋材料。
The beast seems to have hoarded some magic items for itself after devouring its victims. A tattered cloak that may have belonged to a hapless spellcaster covers the treasure: a few vials of different liquids still nestled safely in a bandolier, a talisman, a dagger with a curved blade, and a pouch of components.

Hidden Opening In The Floor Leading To S.name:
宅邸地板上隐藏的暗门，通往秘密通道
Hidden Opening In The Floor Leading To Secret Passage In A Manor

Text.text:
掀开这间房里的地毯，露出地板上一处凹陷，乍看只是天然的瑕疵；可你细细查看，发现其中一块地板竟能滑开，下面嵌着一只铁环。你与铁环短暂角力，暗门随即弹开：一架短梯向下通往一条干净、干燥的通道——里面一片漆黑，但墙上钉着几处火把环。它似乎是一条通往宅邸另一处的秘密路线……又或者，直通宅邸之外？
Pulling back the rug in this room reveals a divot in the flooring that appears to be a natural imperfection, but after examining it more closely, you find that part of the floor can be slid aside to expose an iron ring embedded within. After a brief wrestle with the ring, a trapdoor opens on a short ladder leading down to a clean and dry passage—dark but with several torch rings mounted on the wall. It seems to be a secret route to another part of the manor… or perhaps leading out of the manor?

汗珠顺着护士布满褶皱的额头滑落。她步伐坚定，穿行在医院灰色的走廊里，头顶的长条灯忽明忽暗地闪烁。无数琐事一瞬间争抢她的注意力——病人呼喊，装备发出警报，堆得满满当当的护士站里，那些未填完的表格也仿佛在向她招手。她的咖啡——早已冰凉——孤零零地搁在桌上，杯身印着连锁店的吉祥物，带着令人火大的幸灾乐祸注视着她的困境，而她只能强迫自己把这片喧嚣当作背景噪音。
Sweat drips down the nurse’s creased brow. She walks with purpose down the gray corridor of the hospital beneath the flickering strip lights. A million things vie for her attention all at once—patients call out, equipment sounds off, and incomplete paperwork calls to her from the overloaded nurses’ station. Her coffee—now stone cold—sits idly on the desk, the franchise mascot emblazoned on the cup and watching her plight with rage-inducing mirth as she tries to tune out the cacophony.

Halfling Kitchen And Dining Area.name:
半身人厨房与用餐区域
Halfling Kitchen And Dining Area

Text.text:
这座宅子里没有任何空间称得上真正宽敞；每个房间都像把无数物件硬塞进巧思百出的收纳里。然而厨房与用餐区域却格外令人赞叹。墙上串挂的新鲜香草，把香气揉进刚出炉面包的暖甜味里；锅碗瓢盆只要有空间就被挂起或叠放。缠着彩色麻绳、盖着布料的玻璃罐里，盛着干果、香料、小麦面粉、糖、种子、干蘑菇与坚果。用餐空间里摆着一张大得过分的桌子，周围围着数量惊人的椅子——那是无数次合食共餐留下的遗迹。粗砍的木面满是喧闹孩童与家庭争执留下的“战痕”，却又铺着一条色泽浓郁的桌旗，旁边还点缀着几只插满鲜花的花瓶。

~ ~ Guest Writer Sadie Lowry

No space in this home is truly large, as each room is a collection of items stuffed into creative storage solutions, but the kitchen and the dining area are impressive. Fresh herbs strung along the wall lend aromatic touches to the smell of freshly baked bread, and pots and pans are hung or stacked wherever there is space. Jars decorated with colorful twine and cloth hold dried fruits, spices, wheat flour, sugar, seeds, dried mushrooms, and nuts. In the dining space is a table that is too big, surrounded by an unwieldy number of chairs—a remnant of many communal meals. The rough-hewn wood bears battle scars from rowdy children and family disagreements but is topped with a richly colored table runner and several vases of fresh flowers.
