~ ~ Guest Writer Sadie Lowry

Sundries From A Griffon.name:
狮鹫杂货铺
Sundries From A Griffon

Text.text:
野兽无声地伏卧着，脖颈与左肩上还挂着那次试图给它套上缰绳却已磨烂的残余。它一只脚踝上还松松缠着一截已无可挽回的绳股，像手环般勉强打着结。
The beast lies silent, the frayed remains of an attempt at haltering it hanging about its neck and left shoulder. An unsalvageable strand of rope around one ankle, like a bracelet, remains barely tied.

Will‐o’-wisp In The Dark.name:
黑暗中的鬼火
Will‐o’-wisp In The Dark

Text.text:
在黑暗的映衬下，一枚细小、轻轻浮动的纯净亮蓝光球仿佛自阴影中浮现。光球缓缓靠近，你隐约听见从中传来一阵轻微的嗡鸣，几乎带着孩童般的稚气。
Against the dark, a tiny bobbing sphere of pure, bright blue light seems to emerge from the shadows. The sphere draws closer, and you perceive a slight, almost childlike hum emanating from it.

I Cast Dominate Monster From My Ring Of.name:
我从大地元素指挥之戒中施放了支配怪物
I Cast Dominate Monster From My Ring Of Earth Elemental Command

Text.text:
我在那魁梧的元素巨灵脸前抬手划过空气。它那深陷的宝石般双眼追随着我的动作，随即发出一声足以撼动大地的咆哮……可那吼声里却带着迟疑——困惑。它肩膀一松，发出仿佛砂砾刮擦般的粗哑声响，随后目不转睛地望向我，屏息凝神，等待我下令。
I wave my hand through the air in front of the hulking elemental’s face. Its deeply set gemstone eyes follow my movements and it emits a roar strong enough to shake the earth… but its tone is hesitant—befuddled. It relaxes its shoulders with a sound like a gravelly scrape, and it looks to me with rapt attention, ready for command.

一双锐利的湛蓝眼睛与你对视，随即一闪而过，你便感到某种草率的裁断已然落下。那男人透过半副眼镜向下瞥着手中卷轴，墨渍斑斑的手指捏着纸页，故意给你片刻，让你也作出自己的判断。他衣着考究，却仍显得邋遢：几缕油腻的细发横梳过光秃的头顶，鼓胀的肚腹把纽扣顶得崩开了一颗。
Eyes of piercing blue lock with yours, and you feel some summary judgement has been made when they flick away. The man looks down through half spectacles at a scroll in his ink-stained fingers, giving you a moment to make a judgement of your own. He wears fine clothes, but still manages to look disheveled, with thin strands of greasy hair combed across a bald pate and a button popped over his prodigious belly.

醒来，便揭晓他今日将戴上四张面孔中的哪一张。他梦见沉睡的元素——直到其中一个与他同时睁眼。它的色彩染上他的发与眸，可他的心智仍归他自己；他知道自己既走运，又锋利。哦，而且无论今天是哪种元素诅咒着他，他依旧英俊得过分。牌能翻出什么，是他皮革里暗藏的刀也补救不了的？几乎没有。自从他在街头流浪、成了孤儿，又经历那些实验——夺走他带金屑的黑色皮肤，把它献给天界牌组——他还能有什么极限可言？

~ 由 Coach Sean 在 Envisioned 中构想

Waking reveals which of the four faces he will wear. He dreams of sleeping elements until one opens its eyes as he does. His hair and eyes wear its colors, but his mind’s his own, and he knows he’s both lucky and sharp. Oh, and handsome despite whatever element curses him today. What will the cards produce that the knives hidden in his leather can’t fix? Little if anything. After his street days, orphaned, and the experiments that took his gold-flecked black skin and gave it over to the Deck Celestial, what could his limits possibly be?

~ Envisioned by Coach Sean

一只盘旋乌鸦的尖厉聒噪骤然打断了你的思绪，也正是在这时，你注意到一条由碎裂下陷的石块铺就、崎岖不平的小径，从一间小棚屋蜿蜒伸向你。那建筑由四面脆裂的石砖墙和一顶纠结凌乱的茅草屋顶拼凑而成。窗户都被木板钉死，但烟囱里仍有一缕细细的青烟逸出，门缝下也透出柔和的光，说明这里尚未被遗弃。
The shrill caw of a circling crow interrupts your thoughts, and it is then that you notice the uneven path of cracked and sunken stones that winds from a small shack towards you. Four walls of brittle stone brick and a tangled thatched roof make up the structure. The windows are boarded, but the thin trickle of smoke escaping the chimney and the soft glow below the door suggest that it is not yet forsaken.

坠落般并入队形，你端起自动武器，齐声向前方横扫倾泻一轮集火齐射。抛出的弹壳如雨落在脚边，蜂拥的子弹织成一道不间断的火力屏障。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

Falling into formation, you shoulder your automatic and launch a collective salvo in a sweep ahead of you. Spent cartridges rain down to your feet as your swarming bullets form a barrier of nonstop gunfire.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Sir Milo The Magnificent.name:
伟大的米洛爵士
Sir Milo The Magnificent

Text.text:
高耸的骑士身披闪耀的板甲，长剑亦熠熠生辉，仿佛燃着神圣之力，与他那憔悴、邋遢的外表形成刺眼反差。头盔阴影下，他的双眼泛着黄光；脏乱打结的头发与污秽的脸被盔沿遮去大半，那张脸因无数次斗殴而扭曲变形。除却正义之刃与辉煌盾牌，这名古怪骑士的腰带上还挂着一只被烧焦的泰迪熊，少了一只纽扣眼，他却亲昵地称它为“Squire”。

~ Played by Joseph Stewart

The towering knight’s shining plate and longsword, alight with divine power, belie his otherwise haggard, unkempt appearance. Eyes glow yellow from the shadow of his helm, which obscures dirty, matted hair and a filthy face misshapen from too many brawls. Along with his righteous blade and gleaming shield, the odd knight carries on his belt a scorched teddy bear missing one button eye, whom he affectionately calls Squire.

~ Played by Joseph Stewart

高桅大船与渔舟沿着伸入海湾的栈桥一字排开；一条为抵御最凶猛浪涛而修筑的防波堤将港湾护在臂弯。码头工人与水手、商贩摩肩接踵，空气里回荡着买卖的喧嚣，混着鱼腥的咸味。城池拥挤着向水边挤压而来——仓库、办事处、旅店与公寓楼，离水线不过几步之遥。
Tall ships and fishing boats line piers projecting out into a bay sheltered by a quay constructed to keep the worst of the waves from battering the harbor. Dockworkers rub shoulders with sailors and merchants, and the air is filled with the sounds of commerce and the scent of fish. The city crowds down to the water—warehouses, offices, inns, and tenements just steps away from the water’s edge.

Spacegoing Vessel: Well-kept Galley.name:
远航飞船：整洁如新的船上厨房
Spacegoing Vessel: Well-kept Galley

Text.text:
厨房一尘不染。这个厨房里每样东西都各归其位，工作人员确保绝不会遗漏任何物品。空气里隐约刺着消毒剂的气味，每一处闪亮的镀铬表面都洁净无瑕。
The galley is immaculate. Everything has its place in this kitchen, and the staff ensure nothing is ever left out. The air bristles with the subtle hint of disinfectant, and every shining chrome surface is spotless.

你不禁揣测，堡垒内这数不清的尸骸是否皆为守护此物而倒下：一座巨大的石制台座，安置在抬高的平台之上。祭坛毫无装饰，刻纹早被时代磨蚀殆尽，但即便隔着一段距离，你仍能感到那沉重石体深处传来的力量震颤——与周遭的气息截然不同，仿佛是从遥远异乡辗转运来。
You wonder if the countless dead here inside the keep fell defending this: a massive stone dais set upon a raised platform. The altar is unadorned, its etchings worn away by time, but even from a distance, you sense the thrum of power within its heavy stone—which differs from that of the surroundings, perhaps transported here from a distant land.

Summoning The Night.name:
召唤夜幕
Summoning The Night

Text.text:
一声惊雷轰然炸响，淹没了喧嚣街市的声浪。随之而来的是倒吸凉气、低语窃窃，还有一匹受惊马儿的嘶鸣——与此同时，天空中浮现出一道锯齿般、墨黑的裂痕。阴翳自裂口不均匀地蔓延开来，追逐并驱散白昼的湛蓝，仿佛将太阳一并熄灭。气温随着阴影骤降。转瞬之间，非自然的黑夜降临，唯有群星洒下微光。

~ 由 EndAllUsers Envisioned

A crash of thunder drowns the sounds of bustling streets. Gasps, murmurs, and the scream of a startled horse follow, along with the appearance of a jagged, inky line in the sky. Gloom spreads unevenly from this crack. It chases away the blues of daytime and puts out the sun. The temperature drops with the shadows. In moments, unnatural night has fallen, stars providing the only light.

~ Envisioned by EndAllUsers

Magic Staff And Wand Shop.name:
魔法法杖与魔杖店
Magic Staff And Wand Shop

Text.text:
店里弥漫着令人愉悦的木屑与丁香香气。魔法法杖与手杖——或是雕琢精雅的木作，或是锻造而成、缠绕繁复卷纹的金工——成束插在木桶里，错落立于架上，或用托架悬挂在墙面。铺着毛毡内衬的长桌上陈列着骨质或水晶的魔杖，折射出诡异的虹彩流光。一道透明的墙以微弱的闪烁勾勒出轮廓，将陈列区与店内一处空角隔开；那角落里，一具焦黑的训练假人安静地伫立，仿佛在耐心等候。
The shop smells pleasantly of sawdust and cloves. Magical staves and walking sticks—elegantly wood-carved or smith-forged with intricate scrollwork—are clustered in buckets, perched on racks, or hang bracketed on the walls. Felt-lined tables display wands of bone or crystal that make strange rainbows of the light. A transparent wall, discernible by a faint shimmer, separates the showroom from one empty corner of the shop, where a scorched training dummy patiently stands.

Professor Of Transmutation And Staves.name:
嬗变与法杖学教授
Professor Of Transmutation And Staves

Text.text:
这位教授本身就是“健身”二字的写照：肌肉线条轻而紧致，浑身散发着极具感染力的旺盛精力。从额头斜贯到面颊、横过她左眼的那道疤，与其说是毁容，不如说是一枚勋章——那是她还是学院学生时，在一场史诗般的巫术大战中留下的印记。事实上，那是一道诅咒，也是她如今留在这里任教的原因。因为无论她变成什么模样，或把哪个目标变形，那道疤都会随之出现、烙在其上。她的战斗长杖也使得出神入化，因此成了全校最受欢迎的教授之一。
This professor is a study in fitness: lightly muscled and radiating a contagious high energy. The scar that crosses her left eye from forehead to cheek is more a badge than a disfigurement, received in an epic battle of wizardry during her own time as an Academy student. In fact, it is a curse, and the reason she teaches now. Because whatever form she takes, or target she transforms, wears her scar. She is also superior with a battle staff, making her one of the most popular professors in the school.

Word Of Recall.name:
回返真言
Word Of Recall

Text.text:
你稳住心神，眼前的世界如同水光荡漾般颤动，随即在你眼中消散无踪，立刻被熟悉的景象所取代。你和你的伙伴被召回了你所选择的庇护所，这让你如释重负。
You brace yourself as the world around you shimmers and disappears before your eyes, replaced immediately by familiar environs. You and your companions have been recalled to your chosen sanctuary, to your great relief.

整个房间都在滴落某种半透明的绿色黏蜜——又像病症的鼻涕。它从椽梁、椅臂、桌沿与灯罩上垂挂下来，起伏成一层层波浪。它在地面汇成一滩，哪怕一滴落入其中，那滩也几乎不泛涟漪。一团从天花板坠到你身上，沿着肩头滚落，拉丝般顺着你的胸口往下坠。
The room is dripping with something like translucent green honey, or the snot of an illness. It hangs in undulating waves from the rafters and chair arms, the table edges and lampshade. It pools on the floor, and when a droplet falls into it, the pool barely moves. A blob from the ceiling falls on you and rolls off your shoulder, stretching down your chest.

群山那张紧蹙的巨脸张开了一道深不见底的巨口。拱形洞窟如同大教堂般的空间豁然展开，但你很快看见它向内收束、下沉，化作一条没入岩石的黑暗咽喉。你无法判断它究竟通向多深处，却很难不生出一种感觉——大地正等着把你一口吞下。
The great frowning face of the mountain holds open an enormous yawning maw. The arched cavern opens as a cathedral-like space, but you can see that it soon narrows and lowers to a dark throat that runs into the stone. You can’t tell how deep it goes, but it’s hard not to have the impression that the earth will swallow you up.

Wand Of Paralysis.name:
麻痹魔杖
Wand Of Paralysis

Text.text:
无数缕纤细冰冷的金属丝交织在一起，编成一支魔杖的形状。它们彼此咬合、盘绕，看似杂乱无章，却又令人目眩神迷。金属杖身顶端嵌着一块象牙，雕成甲虫的模样，只是本该是颚部的地方，换成了一团扭动不止的金色触须。
Countless strands of thin cold metal are woven together to form the shape of a wand. They interlock and wind about each other in a seemingly random yet mesmerizing manner. Atop the metal shaft sits a piece of ivory carved into the likeness of a beetle, but with the usual mandibles replaced by a mass of writhing golden tentacles.

Enchanter Academy Headmistress And Porte.name:
魔法师学院女校长与门房
Enchanter Academy Headmistress And Porter

Text.text:
“我需要一份清单：过去二十年里，所有曾经领用过猫之魔杖的学生。你觉得整理出来会不会太难？”

“办妥。给您，夫人。”

“I’m going to need a list of all the students who were ever issued the Cat Wand, covering the last twenty years. Do you think that would be too difficult to produce?”

“Done. Here ’tis, Marm.”

Light Combat Helicopter.name:
轻型武装直升机
Light Combat Helicopter

Text.text:
一挺小巧却致命的迷你机枪装在这架轻装甲直升机的机腹下方。它的弹药箱一眼就能从那道黄色的危害条纹中辨认出来。这架直升机挨不了几下，但速度快、机动灵活——最适合发动迅捷而凶狠的突击。
A small but deadly minigun is attached to the underside of the lightly armored helicopter. Its ammo hopper can be picked out by its yellow hazard stripes. This chopper can't take many hits, but it is fast and nimble—perfect for quick, hard-hitting attacks.

你猛然停下脚步。前方通道的石面被密密麻麻的刻痕覆盖——地面、天花板与两侧墙壁都布满细小的划刻，沿着狭窄的行列一排排延伸。乍看之下，那些符号陌生至极：它并非你所知的任何一种文字。
You stop in your tracks. The stone of the passage ahead has been covered in carvings. Floor, ceiling, and walls all bear tiny marks scratched into them in narrow rows and columns. At first glance they seem unfamiliar: it’s not written in any language you know.

此地的真诚，藏在朴素却结实的做工里。两间屋，一大一小，以坚固的材料搭建，足以抵御天气侵袭。教堂除门上方的圣徽与一座刻满献给神祇铭文的祭坛外，再无多余装饰。
The sincerity of this place can be found in its simple yet sturdy workmanship. Two rooms, one large, one small, are crafted from strong materials built against the weather. The church is without ornamentation beyond the holy symbol above the door and an altar carved with inscriptions to the divine.

Quip About Mage’s Friendly Fire.name:
调侃法师的误伤友军
Quip About Mage’s Friendly Fire

Text.text:
“听着，我知道你就爱把东西炸上天，我也绝不会剥夺你这点乐趣，但要是你能换个地方炸，别偏偏就冲着我脚下这块儿来，那就不会显得这么针对我了。”
“Listen, I know you love blowing things up, and I would never take that away from you, but if you could do it somewhere other than directly where I’m standing, it would stop feeling so personal.”

莫林米尔湖的水波轻轻拍打着小港里安然起伏的小船，午后的阳光洒在狼穴镇的集市日上。空气中，新鲜鱼货的辛辣腥香与春日花开的清甜交织，商贩们向过客高声叫卖——兜售毛皮、本地葡萄酒，以及今日刚上岸的渔获。远处的山丘上，一座废弃要塞的阴影俯压着小镇，提醒着人们这里曾有过的前人。

~ 构想：Ford Stonebreaker

The waters of Lake Morinmere lap against boats bobbing peacefully in the small harbor, and the afternoon sun shines down on market day in Wolfdenn. The pungent aroma of fresh fish mingles with the scent of spring blossoms in the air, as merchants tout their wares to passers-by—hawking furs, local wines, and the catch of the day. On a distant hill, the shadow of an abandoned keep looms over the town, a reminder of those who came before.

~ Envisioned by Ford Stonebreaker

Investiture Of Flame.name:
烈焰灌注
Investiture Of Flame

Text.text:
最初一阵火星迸裂、噼啪作响后，你的身体骤然点燃，化作一团盛大而耀眼的烈焰。你既不感到疼痛，甚至几乎察觉不到热量——只有一丝若有若无的暖意，刚刚逼得你额头渗出薄汗——可你全身已披上一件火焰战袍，炽焰如燃烧的河流般绕体奔涌。
After an initial spark and crackle, your body combusts into a full and brilliant blaze. You feel no pain, nor even much heat—only a subtle warmth that just begins to bring forth sweat on your brow—but you are wreathed in a tabard of flame that runs in fiery rivers around you.

Wick River In Winter.name:
冬日的烛河
Wick River In Winter

Text.text:
渔民们把他们的道具拖到覆雪的威克河岸边，有些人甚至冒险踏上河沿那层薄冰——这条河从不会彻底封冻。他们一边抛下挂着活饵、不断扭动的鱼线，一边彼此高声打趣，带着友善的较劲意味。
Fishermen haul their gear down to the snow covered banks of the Wick, some braving the thin ice at the edges of the river—which never completely freezes over. They shout good-natured words of competition to one another as they cast lines fitted with live, wriggling bait.

越过渐起的坡面，一道裂口豁然张开，裸露的山巅上铺开一处宽阔的碗状洼地。令人窒息的寂静弥漫其间。碎石残砾散落在苍白的岩土上。几根带红色的圆柱形石柱零星从地里突起，每一根在底部都不均匀地向外膨大。类似的形体如柱般横陈，断裂、倾覆。它们外表像粗糙的红橙色树皮；而越向中心，色泽越黯、越深红，层层纹理宛如被锯开的树干年轮。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Over the rising slope, a cleft opens into a wide bowl across the naked mountaintop. Breathless silence pervades. Rubble litters the pale, rocky soil. Reddish cylindrical stones jut from the earth here and there, each widening unevenly at the bottom. Similar forms lie like pillars, broken and toppled. On the outer surface, these rocks resemble rough, red-orange bark. Their color dulls and reddens toward the center, forming patterns that look quite like the rings of a cut tree.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Ruined Throne Room.name:
残破的王座厅
Ruined Throne Room

Text.text:
曾经鲜红夺目的挂毯，如今褪色破败，垂挂在墙。王座厅两侧的火盆冰冷空荡。穹顶高耸，由一道道舒展的拱券支撑；拱上雕满极尽精细的浮雕——历史事件与著名战役、昔日的国王与王后、辉煌的凯旋与更惨烈的灾厄。曾供贵族与来访显贵就坐的长椅，如今碎成一堆堆残片。地毯与石面上污渍斑驳——血、烟灰，或别的什么。王座位于这间长方形大厅尽头：一张沉重、垒得很高的石座，像阴影般压迫而立，却被某记可怖的重击或扭曲的魔法干净利落地劈成两半。
Tapestries, once vibrant red, hang faded and tattered. Braziers lining the throne room sit cold and empty. The ceiling soars, supported by sweeping arches carved with incredibly detailed reliefs of historical events and famous battles, of kings and queens past, of great triumphs and greater calamities. The benches where once sat nobles and visiting dignitaries lie in shattered piles. Old stains mar the carpets and stone—blood, soot, or something else. The throne, a heavy and high-packed stone seat, looms at the far end of the rectangular chamber, split cleanly asunder by some mighty blow or twisted magic.

The Courtyard Of Enchantment.name:
魅惑庭院
The Courtyard Of Enchantment

Text.text:
庭院在塔内，却仿佛置身户外：繁花满庭，一座闺阁般的阳台探出，玫瑰沿着格栅攀援而上。啊，诱人倾心、或窥读心念的危险沉醉。夏日的石板与绣球花之间，爱情有时会施展自己的法术；但若有一座魔法花园为施法添势，那就更妙了——它确实能让一切推进得更快些。庭院里那座小小石泉的细水潺潺，仿佛在低语：“相信。”
The courtyard is inside the tower but feels outside, full of flowers, with a boudoir balcony and roses climbing a lattice to it. Ah, the perilous intoxication of charming someone, or reading a mind. Among the flagstones and hydrangeas of summer, sometimes love casts its own spell, but it's nice to have a magical garden enhancing one's casting—it does move things along a little faster. The trickling of the little stone fountain in the courtyard seems to say, “Believe.”

作为雄马与雌驴交配所生、无法繁衍的后代，骡子被培育来在狭窄山径上驮运沉重货物。它温顺、善良，正安静地嚼着一根胡萝卜，身上套着一副小小的绳制挽具。它的日子便是在烈日下被人拽着往前走、背上压满货物、被呼来喝去，最后又被拴在木桩上。它的力量不只在脊背，它的平衡也不只在四蹄。
The sterile offspring of a male horse and a female donkey, the mule is bred to carry heavy loads on narrow trails. Docile, kind, and quietly chewing on a carrot, this one wears a small rope harness. He spends his day being yanked forward, loaded up, ordered around, and tied off to a post in the hot sun. His strength is in more than his back, and his balance in more than his legs.

Dungeon: Moldy Corridor.name:
地城：霉腐长廊
Dungeon: Moldy Corridor

Text.text:
前方走廊里弥漫着潮湿霉烂的气味。病态的青绿色仿佛从地面与墙壁的裂缝中渗出、淌落。当你看见几滩死水般的积水时，罪魁祸首便昭然若揭。水汽悬在空气里，黏在衣物与肌肤上，令人浑身不适。
The corridor ahead is ripe with the smell of damp mold. Sheets of sickly green seem to ooze from cracks in the floor and walls. The cause is made clear when you spot puddles of stagnant water. Moisture hangs in the air and sticks to one’s clothing and skin.

Highland Games, Hammer Throw.name:
高地运动会：掷铁锤
Highland Games, Hammer Throw

Text.text:
那男人看起来更像一头披着苏格兰裙的熊，站在一堆铁链旁，链上顶着一颗光滑圆润的铁球。他朝手心啐了一口，把双手猛地一拍，随即抄起铁链的一端。铁链蜿蜒滑过地面，哗啦作响，忽然绷得笔直——铁球稳稳压在链尾的地上。他转身画起圆来，双手抡动铁球，先在腰际掠过，再到肩头高度，继而以更快的速度沿着斜斜的弧线甩动，肌肉绷紧如钢。“走你！”他大吼一声，铁球拖着长链呼啸着掠过场地飞了出去。
The man, who looks more like a bear in a kilt, stands by a pile of chain with a smooth round iron ball on top. He spits into his hands, smacks them together, then lifts the end of the chain. It slinks and rattles, then snaps taught, the ball sitting at on the ground at the chain’s end. He turns in a circle, using both hands to swing the ball, first at waist height, then shoulder height, then faster in an angled arc, muscles straining. "Let's go!" he shouts as the ball flies over the field, trailing its chain.

Quip About Overkill.name:
关于用力过猛的俏皮话
Quip About Overkill

Text.text:
“老天爷！我们只要打败敌人——又不是要把他们熬成一锅汤。”
“Good lord! We only need to defeat our enemies—not turn them into soup.”

Goblin Quip About A Meaningful Life.name:
地精对有意义人生的俏皮话
Goblin Quip About A Meaningful Life

Text.text:
“我们也许活不长，但这只意味着要把仅有的那几天塞满刺激……而这也是我们活不长的原因之一。”
“We may not live long, but that just means we pack what few days we have with excitement… which is part of the reason why we don’t live long.”

Intimidation By A Person Connected To Na.name:
来自与自然相连之人的威吓
Intimidation By A Person Connected To Nature

Text.text:
“我听见你脚下大地的呼唤，也听见你呼吸的空气在耳畔低语。我能断定，它们想要伤害你。”
“I hear the calls of the earth you stand on and the whispers of the air you breathe. I can tell that they wish you harm.”

Festival Of The Ancestors.name:
祖灵祭典
Festival Of The Ancestors

Text.text:
庆典正酣，节日喧腾攀至巅峰。食摊上热气蒸腾，辛辣与甜香交织：油炸面团滋滋作响，炙烤果肉泛着焦香，蓬松的糖丝云絮轻飘飘地涨起。孩子们在街上起舞，手中彩带飞扬，旋转、蹦跳间划出一道道流光。大人们为他们鼓掌大笑，笑声里尽是欢愉，眼角却也涌起泪光。大多数人身着白袍，面上扑着淡淡的粉。每一扇门口都悬着灯笼，染色纸壳里透出斑斓的光晕：金、红、粉、橙——如落日般暖人心房的色彩。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The festival is at the height of its celebrations. Food stalls steam with scents spicy and sweet: fried dough, grilled fruit, airy billows of candied fluff. Children dance in the street, ribbons streaming from their hands as they twirl and bounce. Adults clap and laugh at their performance, voices full of mirth even as tears well in their eyes. Most wear robes of white and pale powder on their faces. Lanterns hover above each doorway, their coronas of light glowing multicolored from within their dyed paper shells: gold, red, pink, and orange—the heartwarming hues of sunset.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Bandit Camp Just Off The Trail.name:
小径旁的强盗营地
Bandit Camp Just Off The Trail

Text.text:
一缕灶火的炊烟，是这处粗陋却有人气的营地最先露出的迹象：几座粗糙的棚屋与破窝子拼凑而成，却又荒诞地挂满了从毫无防备的旅人身上劫来的华贵饰物，像把脏污的兽皮披上了锦缎。这里是匪徒的巢穴；若这些野性未驯的掠夺者嗅到你们的踪影，必定会竭尽所能让你们永远闭嘴。因为此地必须守口如瓶，才能让他们的脖颈远离执法者的绞索。
The smoke of a cooking fire is the first sign of the rough but lived-in camp made up of crude huts and hovels, incongruously festooned with fineries raided from unsuspecting travelers. Brigands make this place their home, and if these feral robbers caught wind of your presence, they would certainly do what they could to silence you. For this is a place that must remain secret, to keep their necks out of the nooses of lawmen.

尽管整体轮廓近似人类，这个存在却比高个子人类还要高出一尺多。乍看之下他的皮肤只是苍白，但仔细端详便会发现：这生物周身覆盖着斑驳的白蓝色外骨骼，其上生着短而细的绒毛。环绕在獠牙密布的口器周围的螯肢让他显得相当凶恶，可那八只纯黑的眼睛周围细密的褶皱，却让你相信他正被你对他外貌的反应逗得暗自发笑。身着为融入阴影而裁制的深色衣物，这名蜘蛛般的男子将一张长弓斜背在肩上，腰间还佩着一柄入鞘的细剑。

~ 构想：BalarRachi

Though humanlike in his overall shape, this being is more than a foot taller than a tall human. His skin looks merely pale at first glance, but a more careful appraisal reveals that the creature is covered with a mottled white and blue exoskeleton sporting short, fine hairs. The mandibles surrounding his fang-filled mouth makes him look rather menacing, but the crinkling around his eight solid-black eyes lead you to believe that he is quite amused at your reaction to his appearance. Dressed in dark clothes designed to blend into shadows, the spiderlike man carries a longbow across his shoulders, and a rapier sheathed at his belt.

~ Envisioned by BalarRachi

沙海在你周身铺展开来，浪涌般隆起，又坠入幽深的沙谷。微风将细碎的尘粉吹上你的面颊，你眯起眼，望见从沙峰上逸散而去的闪烁尘云。久而久之，这里的风甚至能搬动群山。所幸此刻空气还算平静。
A sea of sand stretches out around you. It rises in great swells and falls into deep valleys. A breeze blows a fine dust into your face, and you squint to see the sparkling clouds that blow off the peaks. Over time, winds can move mountains here. Thankfully, the air seems relatively calm at the moment.

I Cast A Water-breathing Spell In An Aqu.name:
我在水栖之境施放了一个水下呼吸法术
I Cast A Water-breathing Spell In An Aquatic Realm

Text.text:
水下的暗流把我来回抛打，直至我分不清哪边才是上方。我将胡乱挣扎的动作化作施法手势，咕噜咕噜的咒语从喉间翻涌而出，嘴里喷出一股泡沫泉。凉意沿着气管一路滑下。我猛地倒吸一口气——随即呼出，竟像呼吸清新空气般，开始在水中呼吸。
The underwater currents batter me to and fro until I can’t tell which way is up. I turn my flailing into magical gestures, and a fountain of bubbles erupts from my mouth as I gargle an incantation. A cool sensation travels down my windpipe. I gasp—and exhale, breathing water like it’s fresh air.

你小心翼翼地结出你守护者的秘印，低声背诵那道诅咒；前后摇晃着一遍又一遍地重复、呼唤，直到一股漆黑的邪法在你脑海中凝成形。随后，它在你掌心里蜷曲盘绕。你知道你的目标将被削弱，变得脆弱可乘；你对着双手合拢成的杯状空隙轻声呢喃，将双手抬起，随着咒语最后一个收束的字，将它送出。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

You carefully form the secret sign of your Patron, reciting the malediction; rock back and forth repeating it, calling it, until a dark enchantment takes shape in your mind. Then it curls in your hands. You know that your target will be weakened, susceptible, and you whisper into the cup of your hands, lift them, and with the closing word of the hex, send it.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

那位退休女演员把剧院以自己之名命名，简直就是“浮华张扬”一词的化身。她的礼服受魔法驱动，能随身形贴合、熠熠生辉、衣袂流转，以最衬人的方式展现风采；她那蓬松富有层次的长发间织入一整套繁复的咒饰，足以左右除最强大施法者之外、凡与她相遇之人的情绪。她还常常毫无征兆地即兴切换，突然演起她数十年来在舞台上塑造过的数百个角色中的某一幕。
The retired actress who named her theatre after herself defines the word flamboyant. Her gowns are magically animated to fit, sparkle, and flow in the most complimentary ways, and her long, textured hair is woven with a set of complicated charms that influence the emotions of everyone but the most powerful spellcasters who meet her. She is prone to spontaneously breaking into a scene from one of the hundreds of characters she’s played on the stage for decades.

Witch Queen Of The Fey.name:
妖精女巫女王
Witch Queen Of The Fey

Text.text:
她丰润而骨相精致，神态傲然冷冽；无论是王廷的殿堂还是市井的地面，她都能从容行过，柔韧的黑色皮裙拖曳在后——姿态与步伐同样摄人心魄。她引诱、蛊惑，周身散出奥秘魔法与辛香香水交织的催眠气息。然而一旦有人令她觉得受了轻慢，她便骤然化作谢顶的老妪，嘶声回嘴，伸出弯曲的手指指点。还未等旁人察觉，那里又已伫立着那位年轻的妖精美人，唇边挂着机敏的笑意。
Luscious and fine-boned, arch and cold, she can walk the floor of court or common, trailing her supple black leather dress—enchanting in both posture and stride. Enticing, seducing, she emanates the hypnotic scent of arcane magic and spiced perfume. But should she feel slighted by someone, she transforms into a balding crone, hissing a retort and pointing a crooked finger. Before anyone else notices, there stands again the youthful beauty and clever smile of the fey.

这间厅室的墙壁仿佛由一块块巨大的弧形玻璃拼接而成，嵌在同样弯曲的珊瑚支柱之间。玻璃墙外，小小的海生物照常忙碌，对室内那股分明可辨的香薰海藻蜡烛气息与灯盏碗中多彩荧光藻类的柔和光晕浑然不觉。相较于内部那几乎令人喘不过气的压迫效果，玻璃墙带来了一丝难得的开阔——毕竟，室内几乎完全被海量书架所占据，迎面便是成千上万本书。成排书架之间仅以狭窄通道相隔，书架由窑干的沙子制成，镶饰着各式各样、大小不一的贝壳。
The walls of this chamber seem to be made of massive, curved glass sections fixed within similarly curving stanchions of coral. Outside, small sea creatures go about their existences, oblivious to the unmistakable aroma of scented seaweed candles and the soft glow of multicolored fluorescent algae in lamp bowls. The glass walls provide a welcome contrast to the almost claustrophobic effect provided by the sheer volume of shelving that dominates the interior, confronting you with thousands of books. The rows of shelves—separated by narrow walkways—are crafted from kiln-dried sand and adorned with seashells of all shapes and sizes.

Nibor \"Nibs\" Sparkles.name:
尼博尔“尼布斯”·斯帕克尔斯
Nibor "Nibs" Sparkles

Text.text:
侏儒骑在一头金属坐骑上猛然行动起来：那是一只长腿的鸟形自动机，鸟喙竟是斧刃。它沉重的钢爪叮当作响，刹停在地面上。金属双翼轰然展开，翼上刀剑般的羽片列阵般铺开。骑手仰起一头红发放声大笑，笑声与他的登场一样粗豪张扬。板甲护胸罩住他的躯干，皮裤则让他在这机械奇迹背上移动自如。他一臂夹着骑枪，另一臂绑着圆盾。“好了，”他从腰带上解下一只小号角说道，“让他们见识见识我们是什么做的！”他吹响冲锋号音，坐骑应声发出刺耳尖啸，镜片般的眼中黄光急闪。他们猛冲而出，骑枪稳如钉桩，斧头般的鸟喙向前突刺。

~ Played by PCZ with

The gnome bursts into action astride a metallic mount: a long-legged bird automaton with an axe-head for a beak. Its heavy talons clamor against the ground as it comes to a stop. It spreads its metal wings wide in an array of saber-like feathers. The rider guffaws, throwing back his head of red hair, the laugh as blustery as his entrance. A plate chest piece covers his torso, while his leather pants allow for ease of movement atop the mechanical marvel. He holds a lance under one arm and a buckler strapped around the other. “All right,” he says, unhooking a small horn from his belt. “Let’s show them what we’re made of!” He blares a charging note and the mount gives an ear-piercing shriek in answer, the yellow lights in its lensed eyes flashing. They surge forth, the lance held steady, the axe-head beak jutting forward.

~ Played by PCZ with

这座地下城宽阔大道两侧铺就的石材并非你熟悉的卵石，而是取自深层岩石；然而城中的喧嚣与繁忙却一如往昔。尽管在城中心上空那轮由魔法召唤、悬停不动的“人造太阳”洒下的昏暗光照里，你异乡而突兀的模样偶尔会引来几道目光，居民们仍旧各行其事，照常忙碌。
The stones lining the broad roads of this underground city are made from deep rock rather than the cobblestones to which you’re accustomed, but the bustling city life remains the same. Though your outlandish appearance draws the occasional look under the dim light of an artificial sun hovering above the city center—summoned by sorcery—the inhabitants continue about their business.

黑色的皮肤——鳞片斑驳、腐烂不堪，紧绷在白骨之上——随着那不死的憎恶自它那片巨大、死寂的水潭中升起，如同一条可怖的海蛇般簌簌剥落。空洞的眼眶燃着恶意的绿火，它咧嘴一笑——那笑意令人作呕——湿腻的咔裂声中，肌肉与筋腱被撕扯开来，黏稠的酸液从它腥腐的巨口滴入恶臭的潭水。古老的骨骼吱呀作响、摩擦碾磨，巨龙张开残破的双翼，翼膜只剩零星的皮革碎片，更将空气里铺天盖地的腐败恶臭推向窒息。它以亵渎的狂怒咆哮。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Black skin—scaly, rotting, pulled taut against bone—flakes away as the undead abomination rises from its large, stagnant pool like a terrible sea serpent. Hollow eyes burn with malevolent green fire as it smiles—a gesture that turns your stomach—causing muscle and sinew to split with a wet crack as viscous acid drips from its fetid maw into the stinking waters. Ancient bones creak and grind as the dragon spreads decimated wings covered in scraps of leathery tissue, adding to the overwhelming stink of decay in the air. It roars with unholy fury.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Hearing Everyone's Thoughts.name:
聆听所有人的心声
Hearing Everyone's Thoughts

Text.text:
思绪在你脑海里漂浮，如过眼云烟；无定的形状在意识中滑行，仿佛风中落叶。然而有些形状陌生得刺眼——事实上，这些念头大多并不属于你。你的目光掠过擦肩而过的人群，每一次停留都在心底唤起一幅新的画面。不久，你的脑袋仿佛成了拥挤的集市，悄无声息的喧哗塞满颅内；而你所站立的街道，却依旧安宁平静。

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Thoughts drift through your mind like passing clouds, amorphous shapes sailing through your consciousness like leaves in the wind. Yet some of the shapes are unfamiliar; in fact, most of these thoughts are not your own. Your gaze drifts over people as they pass, and each glance conjures a new image in your mind. Soon it begins to feel like a crowded market, as your head fills with inaudible chatter, despite the serene nature of the street on which you stand.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Grave Of A Teacher.name:
一位老师的坟墓
Grave Of A Teacher

Text.text: 一枚石雕苹果安放在墓碑脚下，昭示着这座被细心照料的坟茔；那果实的纹理与形貌刻得栩栩如生，几可乱真。铭文写道：菲奥娜·梅里韦瑟，你教会我们的远比你所知更多。谢谢你。 A stone apple rests at the foot of the headstone marking this well-tended grave, the fruit depicted in remarkably lifelike detail. The inscription reads: Fiona Merryweather, you taught us more than you can ever know. Thank you.

Warrior Of Sunlight.name:
阳光战士
Warrior Of Sunlight

Text.text:
如同他光辉的庇护者一般，这名战士身披太阳的盛装，熠熠生辉，将真实与光明的美德化作血肉与呼吸。护甲的造型仿佛泥塑般贴合他的身形，即使有护板覆体，那紧实盘结的肌理依旧清晰可见。没有头盔遮掩他的面容，他的笑容温暖，宛如黎明初照的第一缕曙光。

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Like his radiant patron, the warrior is resplendent in his solar regalia, embodying the virtues of truth and light. The armor’s design is molded like clay to his form, and his corded physique is clearly visible despite the protective plates. No helmet hides his countenance, and his smile is warm like the first rays of dawn.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Winter Tournament Under Gray Skies.name:
灰天之下的冬季比武大会
Winter Tournament Under Gray Skies

Text.text:
彩绘斑斓的帐篷在刺骨寒风中猎猎作响，冰封的地面上覆着一层薄雪。管事们聚作一团，仰望头顶灰沉沉的云层，连连摇头，神色阴郁。赛场两侧的看台挤满了臃肿的人影，层层华服把他们衬得膨胀笨重。平民们穿着粗布衣裳排成一列列，瑟瑟发抖，双脚陷在冰冷的灰泥里。侍从吃力地扛着沉重的长枪，脸与手都冻得发青。骑士们跨坐在不甚情愿的战马上，彼此低声交谈，面甲缝隙间吐出的白雾翻涌，身上的护甲覆着霜花，寒意直透骨髓。
Colorful tents flap in the chill wind, and a dusting of snow gathers on the frozen ground. Stewards gather, looking up into the gray clouds above, shaking their heads and looking grim. The pavilions on either side of the tilt fill with bulky figures, bloated by layers of rich garb. The commoners stand shivering in homespun ranks, feet encased in cold gray mud. Squires struggle to carry heavy lances, their faces and hands blue with cold. Knights sit atop their less-than-happy chargers, whispering to each other, breath steaming from visors, shivering within armor coated in frost.

倒刺般的棘刺与皮革般的鳍片沿着这头庞大、蟾蜍般的生物的脊背一路竖起。它那橡胶般的皮肤呈尸体般斑驳的灰色，遍布疣瘤，湿漉漉地闪着冷光。镰刀似的利爪从它瘦长的四肢向外弯曲伸展；在宽阔下斜的额头下，漆黑的眼睛凶光毕露。它是同类中的顶点。
Barbed spines and leathery fins run up the back of this enormous, toad-like creature. Its rubbery skin is the mottled gray of a corpse, riddled with warts and glistening wetly. Scythe-like claws curve outward from its gangly limbs, and beneath a broad, sloped forehead, black eyes gleam menacingly. It is the apex of its kind.

Hot Summer Cemetery.name:
炎夏墓园
Hot Summer Cemetery

Text.text:
炽烈的太阳烘烤着坟冢，墓碑投下拉长的阴影，如同从彼岸伸来的黑色指爪。时令花朵在热浪中萎蔫，一只慵懒的蜜蜂在颤动的空气里漫游，最终落在一座被遗忘的墓旁阴影里。
The blazing sun beats down upon the graves, the headstones casting elongated shadows like dark fingers reaching out from beyond. Seasonal blooms wilt in the heat, and a lazy bee meanders its way through the shimmering air, finally landing in the shade of a neglected tomb.

Hacker Bypasses Challenging Firewall In.name:
黑客在网域中绕过棘手防火墙
Hacker Bypasses Challenging Firewall In The Net

Text.text:
一条由二进制代码构成的巨龙在黑客头顶阴影般逼近，它伫立在服务器许可入口之前。伴随着骇人的数字化咆哮，它巨口大张，火焰洪流奔涌而出。黑客以闪电般的反射神经猛然前扑——翻滚着从烈焰下方穿过——在守卫者的双腿间穿梭，直逼其腹部。召唤出一柄闪烁不定的代码之剑，他们将其狠狠刺入巨兽体内，巨兽随即在刺耳的反馈爆鸣中炸裂成四散的数据。
A dragon made of binary code looms over the hacker as it stands before the server access point. With a terrifying digitized roar, its maw opens wide and torrents of fire rush forth. The hacker dives forward with lightning reflexes—rolling under the flames—and weaves between the guardian’s legs to reach its belly. Summoning a sword of flickering code, they plunge it into the beast, which explodes into data with a burst of screeching feedback.

I Resist Becoming Charmed.name:
我抗拒被魅惑
I Resist Becoming Charmed

Text.text:
那道魔法如同轻吻我眉心般轻柔又撩人，几乎将我攫住。我嗅到鲜花的清甜、新出炉面包的香气与其他令人沉醉的芬芳，眼皮也随之沉重起来——可转瞬间，它们在我鼻腔里尽数变酸。我伸手按上我的武器，竭力辨明那道险些得逞、几乎控制住我的魅惑法术究竟来自何处。
The enchantment, as delicate and ticklish as a light kiss upon my brow, nearly seizes me. My eyelids grow heavy as I take in the enticing smell of fresh flowers, of newly baked bread, and other mesmerizing aromas—but they quickly all turn sour in my nose. My hand goes to my weapon as I try to determine the source of the charm spell that almost succeeded in taking hold of me.

从容不迫地，一名精灵女子迈步向前，头颅微微倾斜。披覆在她身上的华丽丝绸随步摇曳，最长的一缕在她脚踝间飘浮时，轻轻掠过高筒靴柔韧的皮革。那布料的傲气，几乎与穿着它的女人不相上下。

~ 由 jhwulfven 构想

Unhurried, an elven woman steps forward, her head inclined slightly. The lavish silks which drape her body sway with her, and the longest of these kisses the supple leather of her high boots as it floats about her ankles. The material seems as haughty as the woman wearing it.

~ Envisioned by jhwulfven

The Sanctuary: Wholu Village.name:
圣所：沃鲁村
The Sanctuary: Wholu Village

Text.text: 甜润的木香弥漫在一片怪异的树林间：树干虬结，紫橙色的树皮如同绚烂的晚霞。相近色调的木板上，用白色字母写着：欢迎来到沃卢村。前方，一处小小的木屋聚落依偎在树根之间。刺猬们几乎个个爪子都染着那抹鲜艳的晚霞色，步履匆匆、各司其事；而泥土深处传来的窸窣移动声，却暗示着下方还有更庞大的族群。 The smell of sweet wood fills a grove of strange trees gnarled with purple-orange bark resembling a vibrant sunset. A sign in white lettering on a similarly colored plank reads: Welcome to Wholu Village. Ahead, nestled in the roots of the trees, is a small community of wooden homes. Hedgehogs, almost all with paws stained the vibrant sunset hue, move with purpose, but the sound of movement in the ground hints at a larger community below.

Ancient Battlefield With Cairns In Cold.name:
寒冷天气下的远古战场，遍布石冢
Ancient Battlefield With Cairns In Cold Weather

Text.text:
板岩灰的天幕预告着雨水，或更糟的灾厄。刺骨寒风拽扯着尸树上垂挂的骨片与护符；那惨白的树皮上刻满古老的警示符文，沟痕累累。石冢周遭的土地被撕裂翻开——肋骨与头骨从冻泥里探出——其间散落着失去光泽的项圈，皆为献给亡者的供品，乞求他们继续沉睡，莫来惊扰活人。唯有一柄长剑被直插入地；它不染锈蚀，乌铁剑刃血迹斑斑，剑柄上还绑着一只无头乌鸦的尸身。
The slate-gray sky promises rain or worse. A frigid wind tugs at the bones and fetishes hanging from the corpse tree, its pallid bark scarred by ancient runes of warning. The ground is broken and split about the cairns—rib cages and skulls peeking from the frozen mud—and littered with tarnished torcs, offerings to the dead, begging them to sleep on and trouble not the living. A single sword has been thrust into the ground; it is untouched by rust, black iron blade stained with blood and the body of a headless crow tied to its hilt.

Chakroun’s Coffee Cup In Winter.name:
冬日里查克伦的咖啡杯
Chakroun’s Coffee Cup In Winter

Text.text:
人群挤进这间本就狭窄的咖啡馆里，庆幸终于躲开寒意；有些人甚至挨着门口缩成一团，站着等空桌出现。墙上镶饰的花纹瓷砖、别具一格的桌椅与地毯，让人恍惚间仿佛被送到了另一种更干燥的气候里。店主查克鲁恩被困在柜台后动弹不得，只得借助客人的帮忙——他彬彬有礼地请他们把一盘盘咖啡壶与杯盏递送到对应的桌上。那些造型精美的铜器里飘出的香气温暖馥郁，带着令人愉悦的烘焙焦香。
People have jammed into this already cramped coffee house, grateful to be out of the cold, some even standing in a huddle by the door as they wait for a table to become available. The decorative tile adorning the walls and the uniquely styled furniture and rugs give the sense that you’ve been transported to a different, more arid climate. The owner, Chakroun, has found himself stuck behind the counter. He employs the assistance of patrons, asking them in a genteel manner to pass along his trays of coffee pots and cups to the correct table. The smell from these elegantly designed copper vessels is delightfully warm and roasty.

Arrival To The Elemental Plane Of Wind.name:
抵达风之元素位面
Arrival To The Elemental Plane Of Wind

Text.text:
你从峭壁踏出一步，脚下竟落在云上——一张被耀眼日光照得发白的柔软云床。前方微风拂开一条轻纱般的裂隙，直通下方如地图般铺展的世界。远处漂浮着几座多孔的陆块浮岛，而无数带着各自性情的风在你周身盘旋——有的轻柔呢喃，有的迎面相抗。在这第三维度、这条额外的轴线上，伴随眩晕与恶心、兴奋与力量，你可以说服这些风，载你去往你想去的地方。
The step from the cliff lands you on a cloud, a bright sunlit bed of white. In front of you, a breeze opens a wispy chasm down to the map of the world. There are some distant floating islands of porous land, and many personalities of winds whirl around you—some softly, some in opposition. In this third dimension, the other axis, through vertigo and nausea, thrill and power, you can convince the winds to take you where you wish to go.

一扇明亮的枫木门高达十二英尺，其上雕刻着一列历史人物——她们自称为女孩与女人——推开后，映入眼帘的是一座闪烁如宝石的殿堂：长榻与阅读椅以便于交谈的方式围摆，半透明的磨砂玻璃窗披着垂落的轻纱。穹顶向上拔起，汇入一片缎带般的繁复结构——那些编织的谱面卷曲回环，乐音在铺砖墙面间轻轻回荡。每一间隔间都隐蔽无踪；洗手台朝内围成一圈，对着环形的镜墙，而中央立着一座高挑的喷泉。室内唯一的气味只是若有若无的花香。
A bright maple door, twelve feet tall and carved with historical figures identifying as girls and women, opens to a glittering palace of divans, reading chairs in conversational arrangements, and draped translucent windows of frosted glass. The ceiling rises to a mass of ribbons, compositions that scroll and loop while their music echoes quietly off the tiled walls. Every stall is hidden, the sinks are arranged to face inward around a circle of mirrors with a tall fountain at the center, and the only scents in the room are vaguely floral.

Chain Shirt Armor +3.name:
锁子衫护甲 +3
Chain Shirt Armor +3

Text.text:
这副护甲由彼此咬合的金属圆环编织而成，闪烁着近乎月光般的清辉。那金属与你所见的任何材质都不相同，你却能猜到它绝非凡品——它以一种超脱尘世的方式攫住光芒，将其向四面八方折散。锁子甲片彼此滑合又分离，精妙得近乎神迹，重量却轻若无物。链环贴身却不紧迫，稳稳地拥住身形，让穿戴者的移动毫无阻滞。
The interlocking metallic rings comprising this armor shine with an almost moonlike quality. The metal is unlike any you've seen, though you'd guess it's far from mundane, catching the light in an otherworldly way and scattering it in all directions. The mail slides together and separates with sublime precision, weighing almost nothing. The chain fits snugly but comfortably, allowing for complete ease of movement for the wearer.

Faerie Court Chambers.name:
妖精宫廷议事厅
Faerie Court Chambers

Text.text:
树木环绕着空地，枝桠交织，筑成一道天然的木栅。圈内，堆满丝绸软垫的椅子与躺榻仿佛从地里生长出来——树干被雕琢成家具，其上端坐着妖精的宫廷。他们奢华、迷人，笑声几乎不曾停歇；这些异界存在从永远盈满的高脚杯中啜饮美酒，谈论着既世俗又神秘的诸般议题。恒久的暮光将这些妖精半神笼在柔和的金色辉光里。

~ 由 Ryan Blakley 构想

Trees ring the clearing, their branches intertwining to create a natural palisade. Within the circle, chairs and lounge seating piled with silken cushions seem to grow from the ground—trees, sculpted to form furniture, upon which sit the fey court. Lavish, lovely, and laughing almost incessantly, these otherworldly beings sip wine from ever-brimming chalices and speak on matters both mundane and magical. The persistent twilight wraps these fey demigods in a soft, golden glow.

~ Envisioned by Ryan Blakley

The Sense Of An Absence Of The Weave.name:
对魔网缺席的感知
The Sense Of An Absence Of The Weave

Text.text:
你意识到一种诡异的静止与某种奇特的缺席感。仿佛整片森林在你周围无缘无故地噤声，又像你不看就伸手去拿一件物品，却只抓住一把空荡的空气。那感觉虽空，却沉甸甸地压在身上。你每一次呼吸，都像在把这份负担一点点加重。
You become conscious of a curious stillness and a kind of queer absence. It feels like having a forest fall silent around you for no reason you can discern, or like reaching for an item without looking only to have your hand grasp empty air. Despite the emptiness of the feeling, it carries with it a weight. Each breath you take seems to add to your burden.

Ghost Ship In Cosmic Storm.name:
宇宙风暴中的幽灵船
Ghost Ship In Cosmic Storm

Text.text:
宇宙风暴咆哮肆虐，一道暴烈的彩虹色在空间中翻卷奔涌。目光在这片炽烈的光潮里捕捉到一抹苍白的阴影——一艘腐朽残破的飞船剪影，时隐时现地在风暴的闪光中掠过。它几乎像在宁静地滑行，穿过这场狂怒的风暴。然而只要视线稍一凝聚，它便悄然漂离，遁入无形。
A violent rainbow of colors swirls out in space as the cosmic storm rages. The eye catches on a pale shadow amid the vibrant display, a silhouette of a decrepit ship flashing against the lights of the tempest. It glides almost peacefully through the raging storm. As soon as any focus is put on it, though, it drifts out of sight.

Tournament Stands Full Of People.name:
擂台看台上人山人海
Tournament Stands Full Of People

Text.text:
空气因吟诵而震颤，那翻涌人潮的共生之声在每一次凯旋、每一次失利时齐声呼喊。欢愉的尖叫、绝望的哀号交织成浪；无论老少贫富，人人都被眼前这场比武大会的戏剧性裹挟其中。
The air throbs with chanting, the symbiotic voice of the seething mass shouting in harmony at every triumph, every loss. Screams of joy, wails of dismay, folk—old and young, rich and poor—are caught up in the theatrics of the tourney before them.

这把弩以传说中——亦令人胆寒——的卓尔精灵工艺铸成，历经数十道秘法淬炼，确保无论白昼曝晒，还是长夜幽暗，都能维持不衰的锋芒与威能。它的弩臂呈反曲之形，更常见于长弓之上。这把轻弩所迸发的力道，以及那仿佛能让箭矢自行寻敌的精准附魔，不亲眼目睹，绝难置信。
Crafted in the fabled—and feared—drow elf style, this crossbow has undergone several dozen treatments to ensure its continued potency in the light of day as well as the dark of night. Its prod follows a recurve shape more commonly attributed to longbows. The power of this light crossbow as well as its enchantments toward accuracy must be seen to be believed.

Green Space Elf.name:
绿色空间精灵
Green Space Elf

Text.text:
他身形矫健而强韧，紧绷的肌腱如绳索般缠绕在那对鲜亮的翠绿臂膀上；这名异族高逾七尺，俯视众人。那张俊雅的面庞覆着更深的绿色肌肤，在唇角与眼角、以及尖耳的末梢处渐次晦暗，斑驳成近乎墨色的绿黑。暗哑的银色长袍在他精灵般的身形周围飘拂，仿佛被风撕裂的残片。他完美的额头上点抹着一串串红泥小点。
Lithe and strong, tense sinews of muscle cording his bright green arms, this alien stands over seven feet tall. The skin of his elegant face is a deeper green, darkening to mottled green-black at the corners of his lips and eyes, and at the tips of his pointed ears. A dull silver robe flutters about his elfin form like a fractured cut of wind. His perfect brow is daubed with dots of red clay.

I Cast Suspend Sorcery.name:
我施放「魔法悬停」
I Cast Suspend Sorcery

Text.text:
当我吐出束缚与悬停的咒词，双手在空中编织出一张虚幻的晶格。它悬在我面前，如一团灰色的球形薄雾。随后，我又施放另一道法术，最后的字句与手势将涌来的诡秘能量牢牢扣进我搭建的牢笼。随着指尖一捏，我把那陷阱压缩成一枚发光的珠滴，从空气里摘下，留待日后启用。

~ 由 Alex 构想

As I speak the words of containment and suspension, my hands form an ethereal lattice. It hangs like a gray spherical mist before me. Then, I cast another spell, and my final words and gestures latch the incoming eldritch energy to the cage I built. With a pinching motion, I squeeze that trap into a glowing globule I pluck from the air, keeping it ready for later.

~ Envisioned by Alex

Trio Of Sentient Swords.name:
三柄有灵之剑
Trio Of Sentient Swords

Text.text:
这些剑如同一个时髦毁灭的三头同盟：三柄华饰长刃彼此无异，唯有剑柄头嵌着的宝石各不相同。它们像梳羽自矜的鸟儿般闪耀，却透着一股孤注一掷的急切，仿佛在恳求被看见、被赞美，并且比自己的同伴更加引人注目。

~ 构想由Discord上的Sahlonahl在Discord提出

The swords are a triumvirate of stylish destruction, each of the ornate blades identical to its neighbor save for the gemstone embedded in the pommel. Like preening birds, each weapon gleams with desperation, begging to be noticed and admired more than its siblings.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

I Pour Water From My Decanter Of Endless.name:
我从无尽之水醒酒器中倒出水流（涓流）
I Pour Water From My Decanter Of Endless Water (Stream)

Text.text:
起初只是细细一线，但很快水流便加快，化作一股稳定的、咕嘟冒泡的液流。水量以欺人的速度不断堆积，必须小心看管，否则这只水壶的无尽供给就会给持有者惹出麻烦。
At first, it's only a trickle, but the flow picks up quickly into a steady stream of bubbling liquid. The volume of water accumulates with deceptive speed, demanding careful attention lest the decanter's endless supply begin to cause trouble for its wielder.

Sundries From A Skeletal Rider.name:
骸骨骑手的杂物
Sundries From A Skeletal Rider

Text.text:
佝偻的骑手头颅无力地垂在坐骑的脊椎上方，骨瘦如柴的双腿与这头骨质野兽桶状的肋笼纠缠在一起。生物似乎仅携带两样东西：一件披在肩头的破旧罩袍，上面绣着一枚褪色的纹章；以及一只泪滴形瓶子的半截碎残，悬在一条开裂皮革系带上，随风轻晃。
The stooped rider’s head hangs listless over the vertebrae of its steed, its bony legs tangled with the osseous beast’s barreled rib cage. The only items the creature seemed to be carrying were the ratty tabard about its shoulders, decorated with a fading sigil, and the partially shattered remains of a teardrop-shaped bottle dangling from a cracked-leather lanyard.

Anhew Fothisev.name:
安休·福西塞夫
Anhew Fothisev

Text.text:
那矮小的身影纤瘦得离奇，既不像半身人，甚至也不像地精；可他们显然早有准备，用一件罩帽的绿色斗篷披在肩上，刻意遮蔽自身轮廓。你看不见他们的右臂——被斗篷严严实实地藏住了——可当你瞥见他们的左臂时，仍不免一怔：臂端竟是一只带爪的手，紧紧攥着一根龙骨法杖，或是足以乱真的仿制品。你的好奇被瞬间点燃，却只来得及捕捉到他们面容的一闪而过——那覆着鳞片的脸在你匆匆扫过的刹那，竟有三点似眼的光芒在其中一闪，让你心头发紧。还是说，最上面的那只“眼”，其实是一颗宝石？

~ Played by Jenzelta

The diminutive figure is far too slender to be a halfling or even a goblin, though they have clearly taken steps to obscure their appearance with the cowled green cloak draped across their shoulders. You cannot see their right arm, concealed as it is by the cloak, but you are momentarily surprised to see their left arm ending in a clawed hand, clutching a dragonbone staff or a reasonable facsimile of such. Your curiosity roused, you are only able to catch a fleeting glance at their face—and you are alarmed to see the sparkle of what looks like three eyes in the quick scan of their scaly visage. Or was the top eye a gem?

~ Played by Jenzelta

Revitalizing Warmth And Light In A Realm.name:
在精灵宫廷的国度里重燃温暖与光明
Revitalizing Warmth And Light In A Realm Of The Seelie

Text.text:
你从那低低悬浮的传送门踏出，步入一座色彩斑斓的花园：光线柔软，香气安神。细细的水脉在脚边潺潺流过，它们是远山巨瀑的静默孩子，如今悄悄穿行于你所立之处。草地在足下舒适柔韧，像加了软垫的躺榻。繁花与藤蔓的错落编织以美抚慰心神，而你从它们间吸入的气息，仿佛一杯恰到好处的热茶。你听见清亮的笑声在悠扬的竖琴背景中闪烁回荡。
From the low-floating portal, you step into a colorful garden of soft light and a calming scent. Rivulets trickle by, the quiet children of great waterfalls in the distant mountains, now sneaking through the garden where you stand. The grass is comfortable beneath you, padded like a daybed. Arrangements of flowers and vines heal the mind with beauty, and what you breathe from them feels like a good cup of tea. You hear sparkling laughter over a melodious harp in the background.

Dagger With Hidden Compartment.name:
带暗格的匕首
Dagger With Hidden Compartment

Text.text:
这把武器的刀刃锋利得足以符合刺客的标准，而握柄也藏着一个秘密：剑柄内部嵌有一处暗格，只要取下柄头便可开启。它的大小足以收纳细小的宝石、一把备用开锁器，甚至是一点你想藏起来的毒药。
While this weapon’s blade is sharpened to an assassin’s standard, the grip also holds a secret: a hidden compartment built into the hilt that can be accessed by removing the pommel. It is large enough to store small gems, a spare lockpick, or even a bit of poison you want to hide.

Helm Of Brilliance.name:
辉煌头盔
Helm Of Brilliance

Text.text:
这顶精工镶宝的头盔浸透着粼粼的威仪，嵌入了多到令人目眩的精雕宝石。钻石、欧泊与红宝石以摄人心魄的辉焰闪烁，仿佛每一颗都是头盔的匠人自苍穹摘下的星辰。
The fine bejeweled helm is steeped in shimmering majesty, inlaid with a dizzying number of exquisitely cut gems. Diamonds, opals, and rubies sparkle with mesmerizing incandescence, as if each is a star plucked from the heavens by the helm’s creator.

植物般的阴影逐渐成形，扭动的藤蔓在空气中起伏摆荡，像爬行动物的舌头探寻猎物的气息。幽紫的孢子如萤火般在这株植物阴影周身闪烁，短暂照亮它盘绕蜷曲的藤蔓。恍惚一瞬，这抹阴翳从虚相渗入现实，呈现出摄魂的性相。你一吸气，便觉昏沉袭来，头晕目眩。
Plant-like shadows take form, writhing vines oscillating in the air, like a reptile’s tongue tasting for prey. Glowing purple spores shimmer like fireflies about the plant-shadow, briefly illuminating its coiling vines. For a moment the shade phases into realspace and takes a haunting aspect. Inhaling, you feel drowsy, almost dizzy.

你紧握手中的木杖，吐出古老的咒词。伴随着一声低沉的吱呀呻吟，木杖骤然变得如磐石般坚硬不可撼动。敌人逼近时，你将它当作棍棒挥舞迎击。
You grip the wooden staff in your hand and speak the ancient words. With a sudden, groaning creak, the staff becomes as unyielding as stone. You wield it like a club as your enemies approach.

Approaching Coastal Town Docks By Boat.name:
乘船驶近海滨小镇的码头
Approaching Coastal Town Docks By Boat

Text.text:
正午的烈日炙烤着你们船上的木板，船只滑入港口。柚木码头之外，粉刷雪白的建筑拔地而起，日光灼亮的陶瓦屋顶层层叠叠，依偎在果实累累的热带树木之间。你们耳畔捕捉到街头艺人拨弄弦乐的叮咚声，孩子们在码头边追逐打闹，咯咯笑声清脆如铃。缆绳摩擦的刺响之上，又抬起商贩的叫卖声。海鸥在头顶盘旋，讨食的鸣叫引得你们想起自己饥肠辘辘的肚子；而一股新气味穿透海风的陈腥——那是新鲜面包的香气。

~ 一位英雄构想

The noonday sun bakes the planks of your ship as the vessel glides to port. Beyond the teak docks rise whitewashed buildings, with sun-drenched terracotta roofs, nestled between tropical trees heavy with fruit. Your ears catch the sound of a busker twanging a stringed instrument as children chase each other around the wharf, their giggling chiming like bells. Above the sawing of ship lines rises the sounds of hawking of merchants. Gulls circle above, their calls for food drawing your attention to your own hungry stomachs, as a new smell permeates the stale scent of the sea—that of fresh bread.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Ghost In Chains.name:
锁链缠身的幽灵（特征）
Ghost In Chains

Text.text:
赤红的锁链如闷燃的巨蟒般收紧，缠绕在幽影颤抖的肩头与孱弱的腰际。凡是锁链触及之处，绿色的灵质浆球便渗涌而出，滴落在地，拖出一道幽光流淌的痕迹。它的脸只有一张嘴——无牙而大张——从中迸出痛楚、抽噎般颤抖的哀嚎。
Red chains constrict like smoldering boas around the shade’s trembling shoulders and frail waist. Green globules of ectoplasm seep out wherever chains make contact, dripping onto the floor in a glowing trail. Its face consists of only a mouth—gaping and toothless—that emits pained, shuddering wails.

[空置] 公会的锻炉不大，却颇为齐全。工作台上放着一把锤头厚重、做工精良的锤子和一副大钳子，末端都被熏得焦黑。旁边的桌上摆着一些锻造尝试——多半是失败品——其中有一把弯刀，若比例得当，本可以成为一柄弯刀。新近上过清漆的铁砧立在炽亮的炉膛前，炉火映得金红。

[使用中] 一连串叮当声在院子里回响，一名年轻学徒正试着在铁砧上弯折一条金属。一个身形宽阔、绿鳞覆体的龙裔抱臂守夜，灰蓝的眼睛警觉地追着每一步进展。还有几名成员也在旁观，脸上肌肉绷扭，也许是在为自己轮到铁砧的回合而紧张。龙裔抬起带爪的手，接过少年手中的锤子与钳子；那孩子的脸色苍白，却因热浪与用力红得像熟透的番茄。铁匠示范正确的手法，几记沉稳的敲击之后，金属终于开始显出形状。

[Vacant] The guild’s forge is modest but relatively well-equipped. A workbench features a fine, heavy-headed hammer and large pliers, both charred at the ends. A table set to the side features smithing attempts—mostly failures—including a curved sword that could have been a scimitar if the proportions were right. The anvil, freshly varnished, sits in front of the glowing hearth.

[In Use] A series of clangs ring through the yard as a young apprentice attempts to bend a strip of metal on an anvil. A broadly built, green-scaled dragonborn watches the progress, arms folded, slate eyes alert. A couple of other members watch with twisted faces, perhaps nervous for their turn at the anvil. The dragonborn holds up a clawed hand and takes the hammer and pliers from the youth, whose pale face is as red as a tomato from the heat and exertion. The smith demonstrates the proper technique and, with a few sound hits, the metal begins to take shape.

它在你脑后啃噬：一种力量，一道存在，一股你几乎抓不住却触手可及的能量——而它并不回避你。你攫住这团扭动、蠕行之物，将它驱使起来。无需吐出只言片语，也不必做出任何手势。你以纯粹思念般的冲决将它的能量向外导出，空气仿佛奉命般裂开。法术所过之处，连地形都开始扭曲异变，肉质触须般的延展物膨胀滋长，纠缠着从现实中挣脱。裂口张开，齿环森然，地面与墙壁彻底变作另一种存在。那团扭动、蠕行的存在——那你尚未真正理解却又无比熟稔之物——在你面前化作一片令人癫狂的、涟漪般起伏的薄雾。

~ Envisioned by Pockets

It gnaws at the back of your mind: a power, a presence, a tangible energy you cannot quite grasp—yet it does not shy away from you. You seize this writhing, wriggling thing and set it to work. No words need be spoken, nor somatics observed. You direct its energy outward like an expulsion of pure thought, and the air parts as if commanded. In the spell’s wake, the terrain itself warps and mutates, expanding in fleshy tendrils that twist free of reality. Mouths yawn open, ringed with teeth, as the floor and walls become something else entirely. That writhing, wriggling presence—that thing you don’t quite understand yet know intimately—manifests before you in a maddening, rippling haze.

~ Envisioned by Pockets

I Parry A Strike From My Foe.name:
我招架住了敌人的一记斩击
I Parry A Strike From My Foe

Text.text:
在我们交错的攻防之间，在兵刃相击的震响里，在粗重的喘息声中，我看见了——下一击的弱点。它沿着我预料的轨迹而来，我顺势拨开这次攻击。但这不是格挡，这是对对手刀刃的攻击。破绽已现，敌手门户大开，暴露在我的反击之下。
Between our exchanges, the impact of our weapons, and our labored breathing, I see it—the weakness of the next strike. It follows the path I expect, and I sweep aside the attack. But this is not a block, it’s an attack on my opponent’s blade. There is now an opening and my foe exposed, open to my counterstrike.

这名犬科人形生物像一只金毛寻回犬——却与你所熟悉的完全不同。那一身浓郁的金色皮毛与棱角分明的下颚依旧令人一眼认出其血统，可眼前的生物却直立行走——还穿着衣服。它们不再有前爪，而是进化出覆着粗硬毛发的人形双手。你一靠近，那双如液态巧克力深潭般的褐色大眼便睁得更圆；蓬松、扫帚般的大尾巴也兴奋地摇摆起来，仿佛在为结识新朋友的可能而雀跃。
The canid humanoid resembles a golden retriever—though not as you know it. The rich, golden fur and chiseled jaw of the breed are recognizable, but the creature before you walks upright—and wears clothes. In place of forepaws this species has developed humanoid hands covered in coarse fur. Large brown eyes like pools of liquid chocolate widen as you approach, and a bushy, sweeping tail begins to wag excitedly at the possibility of making a new friend.

Traveler On A Flooded Road.name:
洪水漫过的旅路行者
Traveler On A Flooded Road

Text.text:
无休无止的暴雨灌满了这条被遗弃小径的每一道缝隙，将曾经车队与朝圣者络绎不绝的繁忙商道，变作一片令人绝望的泥沼。一个孤独的旅人艰难跋涉在泥泞的堤道上，他手推车的车轮吱呀作响、卡滞抽搐，让本就艰辛的旅程愈发难捱。
The incessant deluge has flooded every crevice of this forsaken path, turning what was once a busy trade route full of caravans and pilgrims into a quagmire of despair. A lone traveler trudges through the muddy causeway. The squeaky wheels of his pushcart seize and stutter, making an already difficult journey that much harder.

Frozen Skeleton.name:
冰封骷髅（特征）
Frozen Skeleton

Text.text:
一具骷髅张着嘴，仿佛发出无声的尖叫，被坚硬如石、毫不退让的冰层封葬其中。裸露在外的骨骸因年代久远而泛黄剥落，可在冰层之下，这具骷髅却被完美地保存着。这里究竟发生了什么？
A skeleton, mouth open in a silent scream, is entombed in unyielding ice as hard as stone. The exposed bones are yellow and flaking with age, but beneath the ice the skeleton has been perfectly preserved. What happened here?

Cultists' Hideout.name:
邪教徒的藏身处
Cultists' Hideout

Text.text:
这间狭窄而棱角分明的房间填满了空间与空间之间的夹缝——一处隐秘的密室，身处周围房间时你几乎无法想象它的存在。有人费心把一张破旧的沙发硬塞了进来，又摆了几把不成套的椅子，以及一只桶，桶盖上堆着几只未塞软木塞的陶罐与瓶子。这里显然被当作会面之所，而原因似乎就钉在墙上的那座小神龛上。镜背的搁架被环绕着黑色小雕像的融烛滴蜡浸得黏腻，蜡泪顺着边缘缓缓垂落。
The narrow, angular room fills this space between spaces, a hidden chamber you’d be hard-pressed to imagine when in the surrounding rooms. Someone took the trouble to cram a battered couch in the room, along with some mismatched chairs and a barrel topped with various uncorked jugs and bottles. It's clearly used as a meeting place, the reason appearing to be the shrine attached to the wall. The mirror-backed shelf drips wax from the melted candles that surround a black statuette.

柔软的卷发如环般垂落，勾勒出一张俊美得令人分神的面容；但你随即注意到，那人的发间竟探出一对公羊角，而同样的绒毛也盘绕在他赤裸的胸膛上，沿着他显而易见的健壮身躯一路蜿蜒而下，延伸向……一双强健有力的山羊腿，覆着与之相同色泽的毛发。
Ringlets of soft hair frame a distractingly handsome face, but you notice the ram’s horns that protrude from the man’s locks, and similar hair that coils across his bare chest and down his obviously athletic body, trailing toward… a pair of powerful goat legs, furred in similar color.

Ioun Stone Of Greater Absorption.name:
强效吸收艾奥恩石
Ioun Stone Of Greater Absorption

Text.text:
这块大理石般的薰衣草色石头宛如一枚异界之卵，其间贯穿着闪烁的翠绿矿脉。那奇异的椭圆体嗡鸣着奥术之力，你也察觉到它周围的空气正微微闪光。你的手一靠近，便感到这物体那触手可及的空洞——以及饥渴。
This marbled lavender stone looks like an otherworldly egg, shot through with veins of glimmering green ore. The curious oval thrums with arcane power, and you notice a shimmer in the air around it. As your hand draws near, you feel the object’s palpable emptiness—and hunger.

The Barbarian's Intelligence.name:
野蛮人的智力
The Barbarian's Intelligence

Text.text:
“别把我当成蠢货。我胸口那份空洞，和你感受到的一模一样。我只是选择用放纵与暴力去填满它，而不是用学习。”
“Don’t think me simple. I feel that hollowness in my chest just as you do. I just choose to satisfy it with debauchery and violence instead of study.”

Klikharp Hatchling.name:
咔哩竖琴幼雏
Klikharp Hatchling

Text.text:
一曲仿佛合成器般的旋律在空气中回荡，如同涟漪掠过昏暗的池面。声音来自一只小小的蓝色虫子，它几乎像雕像般端坐着，两条后腿轻轻震颤。一阵宁静的波涛拍上你的心灵，嗡鸣着彻底的安适。这只蟋蟀般的生物歪了歪头，带着天真的好奇望着你。
A synth-like song echoes into the air, like a ripple across a darkened pool. It comes from a small blue bug, which sits almost statuesque, its two hind legs softly vibrating. A wave of calm meets your mind, a thrum of utter comfort. The cricket-like creature cocks its head with a look of naïve curiosity.

Sundries From A Minotaur.name:
来自牛头人的杂货
Sundries From A Minotaur

Text.text:
牛头人的尸身上能找到的只有这些：一只小小的腰带袋，里面塞着几段松散的十号英尺长线头；一圈磨损却仍可使用的三十号英尺长绳索；以及一条宽腰带——已经断裂。
A tiny belt pouch of several loose ten-foot lengths of thread, a frayed and usable thirty-foot coil of rope, and a wide belt, broken, are all that can be found on the minotaur’s body.

Instant Fortress, Ready For Battle.name:
瞬息要塞，整军待战
Instant Fortress, Ready For Battle

Text.text:
三十英尺高的精金高塔周遭的空间里，散落着因金属立方体骤然膨胀而被挤开、翻卷的碎屑与植被。如今它已完全成形，塔身布满箭孔，巍然矗立，随时迎战。
The space around the thirty-foot tall adamantine tower is strewn with debris and flora displaced by the sudden expansion of the metal cube. Now fully grown and lined with arrow slits, it stands ready for battle.

一层遮蔽视线、异界般的薄雾笼罩着幽暗的山谷，四面尽是浓密荒野与难以逾越的丘陵。头顶的月亮洒下银辉落在谷地之上，却几乎无法穿透这无处不在的迷雾。村落零零散散地蜷伏其间，不过是些与世隔绝的小村庄，在黑暗中如针尖般点点微光。远处，一座哥特式城堡高耸森严，像沉默的哨兵般俯瞰着整片山谷。
An obscuring, otherworldly mist shrouds the shadowed vale, surrounded on all sides by dense wilderness and impassable hills. The moon above casts its silver light upon the valley, doing little to penetrate the ever-present fog. Villages huddle here and there, little more than isolated hamlets, pinpoints of light amongst the darkness. In the distance, a gothic castle stands tall and imposing, looming over the vale like a silent sentinel.

Dueling Bards In A Tavern.name:
酒馆里的吟游诗人决斗
Dueling Bards In A Tavern

Text.text:
旋律在这间阴浊的酒馆里回荡，引得一大群人——而且醉得不轻——欢呼不止。一名龙裔女子以炉火纯青的灵巧拨动鲁特琴弦，从这件饱经旅行风霜的乐器中诱出摄人心魄的曲调。她的对手咧嘴一笑，牵动了脸上的疤痕，随即以同样的姿态回敬；只不过他的音乐反击，是从一支以象牙木雕琢、刻纹精致的短笛中迸发而出。二人在观众喧闹的喝彩声中斗得难分难解，两个吟游诗人谁也不肯认输——更不肯把聚光灯拱手让人。

~ DaveDaWanderer on Discord

Melodies ring out across the seedy tavern to the delight of a large—and rather intoxicated—crowd. A dragonborn plucks the strings of her lute with masterful dexterity, coaxing enchanting tunes from the travel-worn instrument. Her opponent smirks, which tugs at the scar on his face, and he replies in kind, though his musical rebuttal rings out from a delicately inscribed fife crafted from ivory wood. The pair battle over the raucous cheers of the crowd, neither bard willing to admit defeat—or give up the spotlight.

~ DaveDaWanderer on Discord

雄伟的砂岩桥横跨阿萨提河运河，贯穿蟹井镇的心脏——这本身就是一项工程专长——然而视线却总会不由自主地被桥身两侧排列的砂岩塑像所牵引。六尊古老雕像各自呈现人形身影，衣着与姿态各异：一名战士高举盾与矛；一名猎人挽弓在手；一名奥术师将华丽的法杖高高托起。这些人物的名字早已湮没于时代——身份与意义在数百年前便被遗忘——可即便面容风化、即便在此守望了漫长的岁月，他们依旧伫立不动，诡异的眼神注视着每一个踏上桥面的人。
The mighty sandstone bridge spans the Asatti River Canal running through the heart of Crabwell—a feat of engineering in and of itself—yet one’s eye finds itself inexorably drawn to the sandstone figures lining the bridge itself. These ancient statues, six in all, depict humanoid figures in a variety of garb and poses: a warrior brandishing shield and spear, a hunter with bow in hand, an arcanist holding aloft an ornate stave. The names of these figures are lost to time—identities and significance forgotten centuries ago—and yet, despite their weathered visages, despite the eons they’ve stood guard here, they remain, uncanny eyes watching all who cross the bridge.

Decapitated Owlbear.name:
被斩首的枭熊
Decapitated Owlbear

Text.text:
这头魁梧巨兽庞大的覆羽身躯匍匐在一滩浓稠黏腻、正逐渐凝结的血泊中，侧腹裂开一道狰狞的豁口，内脏从中倾泻而出。你走近才看清：要了这生物性命的并不是那道伤口。它的头不见了。熊般宽阔的双肩之间，只剩下一截骇人的肌肉与软骨残桩，破碎的组织条缕无力垂落，其间还可见湿亮的椎骨闪着寒光。

~ David 构想，发布于 Discord

The large, feathered body of the hulking beast lies prostrate in a thick, viscous pool of congealing blood, its organs spilling from a gaping wound in its flank. As you draw closer, it becomes apparent this wound did not kill the creature. Its head is missing. Ragged strands of tissue hang limply from a grisly stump of muscle and cartilage between the bear's shoulders, and glistening vertebrae can be seen within.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

烤肉与油渣煎脂的腻香扑面而来，浓稠得几乎黏在喉间，却又丰美诱人。人群挤作一团，或站或坐，围着长桌与矮凳大口吃喝、闲谈喧哗。看起来人人都端着同样朴素的一餐——肉、肉汁与面包——再配上麦酒；可有这么多食客捧场，想必滋味不差。
The greasy smell of roast meats and fried lard greets you, an unctuous but sumptuous scent. A crowd of people eats and chats, standing or seated around long tables with low benches. It looks like everyone has the same simple meal—meat, gravy, and bread—and ale, but it must be good with so many patrons.

Sundries From An Undead Shadow Giant.name:
来自不死幽影巨人的杂物
Sundries From An Undead Shadow Giant

Text.text:
异界的尖啸撕裂长空，那独眼的梦魇轰然倒下，猛地炸成一团团脓黑的血浆碎块。残骸被盘旋的阴影缠绕，宛如拂晓时分在草尖起舞的晨雾，而你不禁思索：是否有一种安全的方法，能采集那些黏稠的血珠。
An otherworldly shriek shatters the air as the cyclopean nightmare falls, bursting into gobbets of ichor. The remains are wreathed in swirling shadow, like morning mist dancing on the grass in the dawn, and you wonder if there is a safe way to harvest the viscous globules.

那名少年双臂抱胸，摆出挑衅的姿态，用一双狭长的红眼打量着你。他苍白的皮肤与银色的头发，在血红皮革护甲的映衬下格外醒目。他身后有一道诡异的光芒忽明忽暗，在他头顶勾勒出一圈电蓝色的光晕。一颗脱离躯体的头骨漂浮在他肩侧，钴蓝火焰般的眼眶死死盯着你。

~ 由一位英雄扮演

The adolescent, arms crossed in a defiant manner, appraises you with a narrow, red-eyed gaze. His pale skin and silver hair are striking against his armor of blood-red leather. An eerie glow flickers from behind him, casting an electric-blue halo around his head. A skull, free of a body, floats over his shoulder, its flaming cobalt eyes fixed on you.

~ Played by a Hero

这把陌生的镰刀那弯曲的斩切刃，形状无疑与您见过无数次的农具如出一辙；但这件武器似乎并非铁或钢所铸，而是由崩裂的黑曜石打制而成。它的握柄十分简陋，只是在根部一层又一层缠绕着布条。然而您毫不怀疑，这刃口与您腰间的匕首一样锋利，甚至更胜一筹，并足以撕开骇人的创口。
The curved chopping blade of this unfamiliar sickle is certainly shaped like the farming implement you have seen so many times, but this particular weapon appears to have been made from chipped obsidian rather than iron or steel. Its grip is simply fashioned from layer upon layer of cloth wrapped around the base. Yet you do not doubt that this blade is as sharp or even sharper than the dagger at your belt, and capable of inflicting hideous wounds.

Cloud Of Daggers.name:
匕首之云
Cloud Of Daggers

Text.text:
匕首在一瞬间凝现，令空间充斥着一团翻涌旋舞、闪烁不定的奥术能量云。你感到心神被无形重压挤压——你的意念竭力维系着那缕脆弱的丝线，将造物勉强拴系在物质位面。匕首在致命的漩涡中盘旋翻卷，混乱激荡间，刀锋相击的细微铿鸣自乱流深处回响不绝。
The daggers materialize in an instant, filling the space with a whirling cloud of shimmering arcane energy. You feel pressure on your psyche as your mental efforts maintain the tenuous thread binding your creation to the material plane. The daggers swirl in a deadly maelstrom, the faint sound of clashing blades echoing from the tumult.

Rune Of Paralysis.name:
麻痹符文
Rune Of Paralysis

Text.text:
[察觉] 你踏入房间时，本能警告你避开雕像探寻般的凝视。一阵寒意顺着脊背爬升。有些地方不对劲。

[发现] 雕像后脑勺上刻着一道繁复的奥术符文。它以淡淡的橙光柔和发亮，几乎难以察觉的能量脉动自符号中一波波逸散。

[触发] 当你迎上雕像冷酷无情的目光，四肢瞬间僵住，仿佛被石头攫住。你无法移开视线，只能以僵硬、不屈的姿势轰然倒地。

[Perceived] Instinct warns you to avoid the statue’s probing gaze as you enter the room. A shiver runs up your spine. Something is amiss.

[Discovered] Carved into the back of the statue’s head is a complex arcane rune. It glows softly with a faint orange light as almost imperceptible pulses of energy emanate from the symbol.

[Triggered] As you meet the statue’s implacable gaze, your limbs freeze, as if held by stone. You cannot look away as you topple to the ground in a rigid, unyielding posture.

一个精瘦的男人皮肤呈黄褐色，松松垮垮的红衬衫外套着一件多功能背心——每个口袋都塞得鼓鼓囊囊。沾满泥巴的靴子和染着草渍的裤子暗示他已经旅行了好几天，可他看起来更像个书卷气十足的人，而非热衷冒险的家伙。他抬手抓挠着下巴那层浅浅的胡茬，厚厚污迹的眼镜后，双眼沉入思索。他一手捧着摊开的日记本，翻过那些磨损起毛的纸页，掠过一行行似乎是手写的笔记。
A lean man of tawny skin wears a utility vest—each pocket brimming—over his loose red shirt. Mud-caked boots and grass-stained pants suggest days of travel, though he seems more bookish than adventurous. He scratches at the shallow scruff of his chin, eyes deep in thought behind his thoroughly smudged glasses. He holds an open journal in one hand and flips through its frayed pages, passing what looks like hand-written notes.

Red Eye Grimoire.name:
赤瞳秘典
Red Eye Grimoire

Text.text:
一册巨著静卧在桌上，光线只照亮了它精工细作的封面一半——靛蓝染色的皮革上铺陈着金色饰纹，几枚徽章般的符文嵌在封面之上。可黑暗揭示得更多。封面中央镶嵌的宝石在光下只是昏灰，却在黑暗里化作一只炽燃的赤红之眼。阴影中，其余徽章褪去金泽，在符文刻痕里浮现出灼人的猩红描边。
A tome lies upon the table, light revealing only half its finely crafted cover, which is made of indigo-dyed leather and covered in golden embellishments. Medallion runes are set into its face. Yet, the darkness reveals more. The gem set into the middle of the cover is dusky gray in the light, but a blazing red eye in the dark. In the shadow, the rest of the medallions lose their golden sheen and gain searing red outlines in the runic etchings.

Oppenscotch Orchard.name:
奥彭斯科奇果园
Oppenscotch Orchard

Text.text:
奥维尔·奥彭斯科奇的名声比不上维尔黑文家或奥尔登贝里家，但他自豪地拥有斯派尔威奇唯一的苹果园。哪怕还在通往这处农庄的路上，人们就能看见一排排果树上垂着的苹果——像巨大的红黄宝石般闪耀；奇迹般地一年四季都挂在枝头。其余田地则随季节更迭：夏季多种满野蔷薇莓，秋季则换成南瓜。白天，奥彭斯科奇庄园向公众开放，奥维尔与家人会在此售卖各式果酱蜜饯与新鲜压榨的苹果酒。
Orvil Oppenscotch does not boast the same reputation as a Valehaven or an Oldenberry, but he does proudly own the only apple orchard in Spirewych. Even from the road near this farmstead, the apples can be seen hanging like huge red and yellow gemstones from the rows of trees—miraculously all year round. The rest of the fields change with the seasons, commonly filled with bramble berries in the summer and pumpkins in the fall. The Oppenscotch manse is open to the public during the day, where Orvil and his family sell various preserves and freshly pressed cider.

Hammer Of Thunderbolts.name:
雷霆之锤
Hammer Of Thunderbolts

Text.text:
这柄巨锤的锤头雕着一对胡须浓密的面孔，五官扭曲成狂怒的狰狞。武器每一寸刻纹都喷薄着毁灭之力与对弱者的蔑视。这是一件传奇武器，唯有最强大的英雄才配将其挥舞。
The head of this gigantic hammer depicts a pair of bearded faces, their features twisted into furious grimaces. Every sculpted inch of this weapon exudes destructive power and contempt for the weak. This is a weapon of legend, fit for only the mightiest heroes to wield.

Wand Versus Wand Duel.name:
魔杖对决
Wand Versus Wand Duel

Text.text:
在一场经典的法师决斗中，两名四年级生身着紧身短上衣，身姿挺拔如枪，魔杖竖直举在面前，正对脸庞。他们鞠躬时目光仍死死相扣，下颌绷紧。纯黑乌木的杖，对上雪白如玉、镶着珍珠的杖。第一轮咒术在擂台中央附近轰然相撞，一道弹飞，擦过彩绘玻璃窗。另一道则化作模糊的疾影，形似群鸦翻涌，呼啸着扑向对面的法师。
In a classic mage’s duel, two fourth-years stand straight and tall in their doublets, wands held vertically before their faces. They bow without breaking eye contact, jaws set. A wand of pure ebony against a wand of alabaster and pearl. The first spells collide near the center of the ring, and one carroms off a stained glass window. The other becomes a blurry streak shaped like a murder of crows, soaring at the opposing mage.

A Plea For A Peaceful Resolution.name:
恳请以和平方式解决
A Plea For A Peaceful Resolution

Text.text:
“暴力自有一股势头；一旦开端，便再也无法收手。所以，在我们动手之前，必须先问问自己：这样的凶兽，是否值得放出笼来。因为它对缘由与正义毫不在乎，终将同样玷污胜者与败者的灵魂。”
“There is a momentum to violence; once begun it becomes impossible to stop. So, before we do this, we must ask ourselves if such a beast is worth unleashing. For it cares little about causes or justice, and will taint the souls of victor and vanquished alike.”

High Elf Warlord.name:
高等精灵军阀
High Elf Warlord

Text.text:
长发坠落在肩甲上，这位饱经风霜的领主垂首沉思。那张脸或许曾经俊美，如今却消瘦憔悴，被哀伤拉扯得干枯紧绷。一道惨白的疤痕横贯他的脖颈，一只尖耳被齐根削短，断口处血肉鼓起，青筋盘结。灼烈的月光下，他的军刀与胸甲泛着虹彩般的光泽，宛如甲虫的硬壳。
Long hair falling over pauldrons, the world-weary lord casts his face down in thought. While once it may have been beautiful, that face is now gaunt and drawn in sorrow. A pale scar runs across his neck, and one of his pointed ears has been shorn short, flesh wadded and veined at the site of the cut. His saber and breastplate shine iridescent, like beetles' shells, in the searing light of the moon.

这把板岩色战斧的长柄几乎会在你每一次劈砍与横斩时，随着一串串黄色字符微微发亮。尽管这些符记清晰可辨，其语言却不属于尘世任何广为人知的族裔。然而，这把武器斩入之深远胜多数——或许这正是一桩你能与之共存的谜。
The long haft of this slate-colored axe practically glows with yellow characters with every chop and slash you make. Though the sigils are perfectly legible, the language is not that of any well-known worldly ancestry. However, since the weapon cuts more deeply than most, this is perhaps a mystery with which you can live.

Forested Base Of Mountain.name:
山麓密林
Forested Base Of Mountain

Text.text:
苍翠的针叶林在清冽的空气中摇曳，枝桠吱呀作响，鸟儿在枝间跳跃穿梭。林外的群山巍然耸立。你望见一条小径沿着山势蜿蜒盘绕，细若钢丝，通向那被云冠遮掩的峰顶。
Lush conifer trees sway in the crisp air, limbs creaking, while birds bounce among the branches. The mountain beyond this wood looms high. You see a path winding around it, thin as a wire, leading to a peak hidden in a crown of clouds.

Dragon Bone Catacombs.name:
龙骨墓窟
Dragon Bone Catacombs

Text.text:
薄雾在一具巨大龙颅风化的吻端分开；它张着巨口，通向黑暗。那是一道高得连霜巨人都能迈步穿过的门槛。你看出这建筑的尺度惊人：久已死去的龙族泰坦遗骸，与矮人建筑冷峻的石质几何彼此咬合。平直的石拱框住骷髅（特征）的头颅，像牢狱的项圈般将这具无肉的巨兽锁住。骸骨之翼自两侧铺展，紧贴嶙峋的地形，爪尖深深抠进碎石与泥土，稀疏的山草在其间疯长。它像是神殿或陵墓，却没有任何侍从可供询问——没有邪教徒，也没有祭司。这里只有吞噬之龙的幽影之口，以及前方更深的阴影。

~ 一位英雄所构想

The mists part at the weathered snout of a huge dragon skull, its maw open and leading to darkness. It’s a threshold tall enough for even a frost giant to step through. You notice the wide breadth of the structure, a meshing of a long-dead draconic titan and the stark stone geometry of dwarven architecture. A flat arch of the stone frames the head of the skeleton, shackling the fleshless beast like a prison collar. Skeletal wings expand out from either side, hugging the stony terrain, claws digging into rubble and earth overgrown with sparse mountain grass. It seems to be a temple or a tomb, but there are no attendants here you can ask about this place—no cultists or priests. There is only the spectral mouth of a devouring dragon and the shadows ahead.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Feytouched Wishing Well.name:
妖精之触许愿井
Feytouched Wishing Well

Text.text:
离小径稍偏处，一口不起眼的井藏在开得疯长的常春藤里，井上方是一座繁花织就的花廊。一个孩子笑着跑过，随手抛下一枚硬币；硬币在井沿上轻轻一跳，便落入藤蔓之间。某种厌恶金属的力量牵引着人前来，邀请你许愿。它要你说出一个钱买不到的渴望，一样远在触及之外的东西。它的声音像风的歌，在耳畔低语：“许愿。”
Just a bit off the path, an unassuming well covered in overgrown ivy sits under a floral arbor. A child runs past, laughing, and tosses a coin, which bounces off the rim and lands among the vines. Some energy that dislikes metal compels a visit, invites a wish. It asks for you to name a desire that can’t be bought, something far out of reach. Its voice is a song of the wind, and it whispers: “Wish.”

Chapel To A Goddess Of Winter.name:
冬之女神礼拜堂
Chapel To A Goddess Of Winter

Text.text: [外部] 冲破无尽雪堆的汪洋，一座建筑如魅影般拔地而起；每一扇彩绘玻璃窗都是一只晶蓝之眼，闪烁着幽微的光。屋顶最高处立着一尊石雕女子，披着缀满流苏的披肩，头颈与肩头堆满了积雪。 [内部] 小礼拜堂里静得出奇，唯有外头冬风的远啸隐隐传来。地面由白、灰、蓝三色瓷砖拼成马赛克，如闪耀雪花的涡流在主厅中央汇聚；那里燃着一座蓝焰火盆。火焰散出的暖意并不如其体型所示那般强烈，但它的光却让马赛克的艺术纹饰与晶莹的窗格都活了起来。一位女祭司浑身裹着白色披肩，披肩边缘垂着黑色流苏，从侧室踱步向你走来，双臂托着一只托盘，上面摆着热气腾腾的茶杯。 [Outside] Breaking the sea of endless snowdrifts, a structure rises up like a phantom, each of its stained glass windows a crystal-blue eye flickering with light. The stone figure of a woman draped in a tasseled shawl stands at the highest point of the roof, her head and shoulders piled with snow. [Inside] The chapel is quiet aside from the distant howl of the wintry wind outside. The floor is a mosaic of white, gray, and blue tiles, eddies of glittering snowflakes that converge at the heart of the main chamber. There, a brazier of blue flame burns. The fire does not emit as much warmth as its size might suggest, though its light livens the artistic flourishes of the mosaic as well as the crystalline windows. A priestess, garbed entirely in white shawls with black tassels, shuffles from a side chamber toward you, arms laden with a tray of steaming teacups.

Quip By A Criminal In A Corrupt City.name:
在腐败之城里，罪犯的俏皮话
Quip By A Criminal In A Corrupt City

Text.text:
“那又怎样，我偶尔割个喉咙怎么了？我干活卖力，税也照交。你见过这座城吗？整座地方从眼眶里往外渗着谋杀和淫靡。你走到哪儿，每家店铺、每处宅院背后都藏着某种骇人的罪行。要是你真想肃清邪恶，就得把这座城烧成灰——而我不觉得你下得了这个手。”
“So what if I cut the occasional throat? I work hard. I pay my taxes. Have you seen this city? Whole place has murder and debauchery leaking out its eyeballs. There’s some kind of heinous crime behind every store and homestead you come across. If you’re here to purge evil, you’re going to have to burn this city to the ground—and I don’t think you have it in you.”

I Cast Beacon Of Hope.name:
我施放《希望信标》
I Cast Beacon Of Hope

Text.text:
我高声吟诵希望的圣咏，一手按在胸口，以此彰显我的虔诚。近旁的空气随我的声音微微震颤，凡是听见我、或感受到那回响的同伴，皆为之振奋。
I raise my voice in a chant of hope, my hand on my heart as a symbol of my devotion. The air nearby vibrates with my voice, heartening friends who hear me or feel the reverberation.

I Cast Control Water Using Components.name:
我用施法材料施展【操控水流】
I Cast Control Water Using Components

Text.text:
一只手掌托着一滴清水，另一只手的指缝间捻着一撮尘土；我以轰鸣如海啸的咒音高声呼喝。面前的水听令而起，自原处升腾，铺成百尺见方，蓄势待发，唯我驱使。漩涡或洪潮，分开的湖面或改道的溪流，尽在我掌控之中。
In one palm sits a drop of water, and between the fingers of the other hand I hold a pinch of dust, as I shout the booming tones of oceanic force. The water before me hears and rises from its place, a hundred feet square, ready to obey. Whirlpool or flood, parted lake or diverted creek, are mine to command.

原本还算平缓的河流，随着地势陡然下陷，顿时换了一副面孔。河水冲过成片礁石与突兀落差，激起白沫翻涌，搅动飞溅。空气里尽是急流的咆哮声，它们在地貌间横冲直撞，肆虐奔腾。
The relatively calm river takes on an entirely different countenance as the landscape dips steeply. As it rushes over clusters of stones and sudden drops, the river froths, churning and splashing. The air is filled with the roar of these rushing currents as they rampage across the landscape.

这件锁子衫由细若发丝、轻若无物的环扣织成，任何身经百战的战士乍看之下都会立刻把它当作徒有其表的摆设——不过是某个贵族花花公子装模作样扮演战争时的戏服。然而一旦以刀刃或钝击试之，哪怕是沉猛的重击，也只会在那被施了魔法的编织上留下些许浅浅擦痕。
This shirt of chain is made up of rings so fine and light that any experienced warrior would immediately discount it as a mere showpiece, little more than a costume for some noble popinjay playing at war. Yet if tested with blade or bludgeon, even strong blows leave little more than a scratch upon its enchanted weave.

Crack Sprite.name:
裂纹小妖精（特征）
Crack Sprite

Text.text:
你的小妖精（特征）只偶尔显现为一道眨眼般的电流脉冲，像电缆迸出的火花。它沿着矩阵的一条矢量线无声滑行，在其上抖落闪烁的补丁代码与恶意软件，就在游弋的入侵反制方块下方掠过。小妖精（特征）伴着一声白色的脆响，重新出现在你肩头。
Your sprite only appears as an occasional wink of electric pulse, like a cable spark. It makes no sound while slipping along a vector line of the matrix, dusting it with flickering patch codes and malware, right under roving cubes of intrusion countermeasures. The sprite reappears at your shoulder with a white snap.

Adult Green Dragon Encounter.name:
成年绿龙遭遇
Adult Green Dragon Encounter

Text.text:
一股阴森的压迫感攫住这片林地。源头盘踞在一棵畸形橡树上——一条庞大的玉绿色巨龙正酣睡其间，涎口滴落，毒雾如羽状袅袅翻卷。它那布满獠牙痕迹的吻端周围，草色枯黄死寂，昭示着这头怪异蜥龙体内腐蚀般的毒性。它慵懒地睁开一只满含恶意的眼睛时，邪祟的气息更是陡然浓烈起来。
A sinister feeling grips these woods. The source is curled about a misshapen oak: an immense jade-green dragon slumbering amid the plumes of toxic mist curling from its drooling maw. The grass about its fang-dappled snout is brown in death, evidence of the vitriolic nature of this monstrous saurian. The aura of malignance grows even stronger as it languidly opens one spite-filled eye.

Fallen Cyclops.name:
堕落独眼巨人
Fallen Cyclops

Text.text:
要塞最后一批守卫者的白骨散落在一具独眼巨人那庞大的骷髅（特征）周围；它的尸骸被数十支长矛与箭矢贯穿。太多人在此倒下，为了守住要塞，甘愿将性命献给那头怪物般的生物。那唯一、空洞大张的眼眶，永远向上凝视。
The bones of the keep’s last defenders lie scattered around the massive skeleton of a cycloptic giant, its corpse pierced with dozens of spears and arrows. So many fell here, giving their lives to defend the keep from the monstrous creature. The single, gaping eye socket stares forever upward.

City Slums In Snow.name:
雪中贫民窟
City Slums In Snow

Text.text:
厚重的积雪堵塞了贫民区狭窄而未铺设的街巷，也沉沉压在破败棚屋的屋顶上。纵有寒风呼啸，腐烂食物与木柴烟气的恶臭仍扑鼻而来，令人窒息。凄惶的居民们挤作一团，呵出的白气在冷空气中清晰可见，只盼着春天早日到来。
Deep snow chokes the cramped, unpaved streets of the poor quarter, and weighs heavy on the roofs of the dilapidated huts. Despite the wind, the smell of rotting food and wood smoke is overpowering. Forlorn inhabitants huddle together, their breath visible, longing for the coming of spring.

Windy Autumn Tournament.name:
多风的秋季比武大会
Windy Autumn Tournament

Text.text:
倒地的骑士被侍从们拖走时，在泥地上犁出一道浑浊的沟痕。将他挑落马下的那位女骑士缓缓策马前行，去领取她辛苦赢来的奖赏。风势渐起——将树上最后的叶片尽数剥落——人们把斗篷裹得更紧。名单两端，各有一群未上马的骑士聚拢，他们的罩袍在潮湿的空气里浸得沉甸甸的。
The downed knight leaves a muddy furrow as the squires drag him away. She who unhorsed him slowly rides to receive her hard-earned prize. The wind picks up—stripping the last leaves from the trees—and folk clutch cloaks more tightly about them. At each end of the list groups of unmounted knights gather, their surcoats sodden in the damp air.

Temple To A Dawn Goddess Of The Drow.name:
卓尔黎明女神的神殿
Temple To A Dawn Goddess Of The Drow

Text.text: [外观] 除了石制入口拱门外，整座神殿皆以细瘦的灰白桦木长杆搭建，杆端削尖，分段捆扎成束。墙顶、小塔尖顶与窗拱边缘全都如锉过的齿刃般参差锯裂。黑色三角旗自女儿墙上垂垂飘荡。 [内部] 穿过拱门，你迎面看见女神的条纹大理石雕像，立于一张圆形紫罗兰色地毯之上。八角石凳环绕其侧，弧形坐垫在水晶吊灯下整齐摆放。 [Outside] Except for the stone entrance arch, the entire temple is constructed of spindly grey birchwood poles, sharp-pointed and bound together in sections. The tops of walls, spires of the small towers, and window arches are all serrated like filed teeth. Black pennants dangle from the parapets. [Inside] Passing through the arch, you are met by an elegant, striated-marble statue of the goddess on a round violet rug. Octagonal stone benches surround it, and curved cushions are arranged under crystal chandeliers.

Hacker Enters A Virtual Speed Dating Eve.name:
黑客潜入网络中的虚拟极速相亲活动
Hacker Enters A Virtual Speed Dating Event In The Net

Text.text:
这片虚拟空间被廉价地堆砌了些现实世界的装饰物，散发出的气息更像情人旅馆，而非任何精致考究的活动。活动的其他参与者早已在封闭网络里占好了房间；每一间都被一扇防火墙之门隔开，门上挂着头像，旁边还有一行滴答作响的倒计时。
The virtual space has been cheaply decorated with real-world trappings that evoke more feelings of a love hotel than any kind of sophisticated event. Other participants in the event have already claimed rooms in the closed network, each blocked by a firewall door adorned with a profile picture and a ticking time limit.

闪亮、粼粼生辉的钢片如鳞般覆在一套钉铁皮甲之上。坎肩、胫甲与护手与内衬甲一并齐全，而那内衬甲本身还镶嵌着某种波纹起伏的合金。金属上不见凹痕与刮擦，亦无锈迹侵蚀其外观或效用。它看起来沉重，却像睡衫般贴合舒适——而浓重的魔法嗡鸣萦绕其间，挥之不去。
Splints of shining, shimmering steel overlay a fine suit of iron-studded leather. Pauldrons, greaves, and gauntlets accompany the gambeson, which itself is inlaid with some kind of rippled alloy. No dents or scrapes mar the metal, no rust degrades its appearance or effectiveness. It looks heavy, but fits as comfortably as a nightshirt—and the thrum of magic hangs heavy around it.

I Begin A Lucid Dream.name:
我开始做一场清醒梦
I Begin A Lucid Dream

Text.text:
我周遭的世界似曾相识——却又不尽然。我认得这里的一段路，那里的一栋楼；都是我见过的地方，却被改了模样，或与别的地标交融在一起。我把手贴上墙，指腹摩挲着粗粝的表面——然后向前一推。不可思议地，我穿过坚实的石壁，飘然从另一侧现身。意识骤然凝结：我在做梦。
The world around me is familiar—almost. I recognize a road here, a building there. Places I've seen before, but changed, or blended with other landmarks. I press my hand against a wall, feeling its rough surface—and I push forward. Impossibly, I drift through the solid stone and emerge on the other side. My awareness crystallizes: I am dreaming.

Ship's Deck At Sea.name:
海上甲板
Ship's Deck At Sea

Text.text:
船身在海浪的左右摇摆中发出吱呀作响的木鸣，与浪声相互应和；帆布船帆在风中拍打鼓胀，推着船只向前破浪。每一次呼吸都浸满咸涩的海盐味，刚擦洗过的甲板还散着潮湿气息——深色木板吸饱了水分，胀得严密不漏。

~ 由 Andrew Sanguine 构想

Timbers creak in counterpoint to the waves rocking the ship from side to side, and canvas sails flap and billow as the wind drives the ship forward. The taste of salt permeates every breath, while a damp smell wafts from the freshly swabbed deck—dark wood swollen and watertight.

~ Envisioned by Andrew Sanguine

Ships In Combat Encounter Whirlpool.name:
战斗中的船只 遭遇 漩涡
Ships In Combat Encounter Whirlpool

Text.text:
木屑飞溅，炮弹撞裂每艘船的舷侧；炮口的爆焰如暴风中的闪电，将浓雾一次次撕亮。船员的呼喊在血腥、火药与潮雾的迷障里回荡。甲板上脚步打滑吱响，众人奔忙着去装填火炮；沉重的铁炮弹随着每一步都像要从指间滑脱。忽然，一座瞭望台上传来三记钟鸣，硬生生刺破这片喧嚣。“漩涡！” 当、当、当！ “漩涡！”前方雾幕骤然裂开——若不是海面正凝出那吞噬一切的旋涡，这本该是仁慈。海水翻搅旋转，泡沫如缎带般勾勒出通往深渊的轨迹。两船的呼声再度升起，沙哑而尖利，人们在甲板上仓皇乱窜，恐惧逼疯了他们。

~ Envisioned by Ekiins

Wood splinters as cannonballs crack against the sides of each ship, the explosions from the cannons lighting up the fog like lightning in a storm. The voices of the crews echo through the haze of blood, gunpowder, and mist. Feet skid and squeak as the crews move to reload their cannons, the heavy iron cannonballs threatening to slip through their fingers with each step. Suddenly, three clangs of a bell can be heard from one of the crow’s nests, the sound breaking through the cacophony. “Maelstrom!” Clang, clang, clang! “Maelstrom!” The fog breaks ahead, a would-be mercy if not for the vortex forming in the sea. The waters swirl, ribbons of foam lining the path down to the abyss. The voices of each crew rise again, haggard and piercing as they scramble, mad with fear.

~ Envisioned by Ekiins

Insult About A Villain's Beliefs.name:
嘲讽反派信仰的辱骂
Insult About A Villain's Beliefs

Text.text:
“在终结到来之前，你将回望那些支撑你一生的扭曲信条，恍然明白：你筑起的不是帝国，而是一座囚笼。”
“Before the end, you will look back on the twisted beliefs you built your life upon and realize you were not building an empire. You were building a prison.”

I Cast Phantom Steed.name:
我施放「魅影坐骑」
I Cast Phantom Steed

Text.text:
我在空荡的空气中挥舞雷霆长鞭，硬生生撕开一扇通往另一重现实的窗口。我的坐骑疾驰而出，鬃毛翻涌着蔚蓝的火焰，身形由烟雾与阴影交织而成。它小跑到我身侧，一如既往地忠诚。蹄子刨着地面，它迫不及待地等待我的指令。
I swing a whip of lightning through the empty air, tearing open a window to another reality. My steed gallops forth, mane frothing azure flame, its form a mix of smoke and shadow. It canters up to my side, faithful as ever. Hooves pawing at the ground, it eagerly awaits my instruction.

在那座政府建筑前，一群心怀不满的市民松散地聚成一团，集结起来抗议某桩滔天不公。他们齐声高喊，嗓音汇成汹涌的声浪，震得人耳膜发麻。尽管这场抗议大体上仍算和平，一队城镇守卫却坚定地横在群众与建筑之间，寸步不让。空气里潜伏着一股电光般的紧绷感，沿着每一次呼吸悄然窜动。
Standing in a loose group in front of the government structure, a group of discontented citizens have rallied to protest some great injustice, chanting in unison, voices raised to a powerful volume. Though the protest seems peaceful for the most part, a detachment of town watch stands resolute between the crowd and the building. An undercurrent of tension runs electric through the air.

Hunter On The Interplanetary Savannah.name:
星际大草原上的猎手
Hunter On The Interplanetary Savannah

Text.text:
他那浓密的金色八字胡引人注目，丝毫不亚于那把黄铜镶边、折开枪膛搭在他弯曲臂弯里的霰弹枪，枪身在光里闪得耀眼。他穿着束带外套，长裤塞进擦得锃亮的靴筒里。头上扣着一顶灌木帽，一侧帽檐翻起扣住，替他挡住炽烈的双日，可他那副小圆眼镜仍被光线撩得跳跃不止。他露出一口马似的白牙大笑着，两枚幽蓝发光的弹壳夹在指节之间，利落地往枪里装填。地平线上，一头此世原生的野兽蓦然抬起长着七支角的脑袋，嗅了嗅空气。
His thick blond mustachios are as noticeable as the sparkling brass-trimmed shotgun broken open over his bent arm. He wears a belted coat and trousers bloused into polished boots. A bush hat with one brim side folded up and snapped protects his head from the suns, but his little round glasses still dance with light. He laughs through horsey white teeth, holding two glowing blue shells between his knuckles and loading the gun. On the horizon is an animal native to this world, which suddenly raises its seven-horned head and sniffs the air.

大蒜与乌头花的辛烈香气，沉沉压在角落那张桌旁的人身上——硬生生盖过了笼罩这间小酒馆的陈旧烟斗味。两个精灵、一个矮人和一个半身人组成了这支古怪的队伍；每个人都披着结实的皮护甲，携着镀银武器，只为一个致命的目的：猎杀怪物。他们以追猎的刺激为生，渴望尚未流出的鲜血，胸中翻涌着追踪并宰杀猎物的强烈冲动。也许，他们与自己追猎的那些东西……并没有那么不同。
The aroma of garlic and wolfsbane hangs heavy around the individuals sitting at the table in the corner—overpowering the stale pipe smoke blanketing the small tavern. Two elves, a dwarf and a halfling make up the strange group, each one equipped with tough leather armor and silvered weapons for a deadly purpose: hunting monsters. They live for the thrill of the hunt, of blood yet to be spilled and the overwhelming desire to track and kill their prey. Perhaps they are not so different from those they hunt…

Elvara Celthoth.name:
埃尔瓦拉·塞尔索斯
Elvara Celthoth

Text.text:
好奇在德鲁伊的眼底深处闪烁，宛如深翠碧潭底部的宝石。醒目的纹身点缀着她小麦色的肌肤，透过皮护甲上若隐若现的开口，能窥见那纹路延展的范围。她一头光泽的赤褐长发带着秋日的色彩，被打理得利落实用，一侧剃短，露出更多部族墨纹盘踞于皮肤之上。她用一声短促的口哨唤来一只身形轻捷的剑齿猫；它贴近她的脚跟时，她抬手亲昵地拍了拍。她对这生物露出熟稔的微笑，身躯在猛兽的陪伴里放松得彻底。

~ Played by a Hero with

Curiosity sparkles in the depths of the druid’s eyes, like gemstones at the bottom of deep veridian pools. Striking tattoos decorate her tan flesh and glimpses of their extent can be seen through the revealing gaps in her leather armor. Lustrous auburn hair, embodying the hues of autumn, is styled in a practical fashion and shaved down one side to reveal yet more tribal ink upon her skin.
