With a curt whistle she summons a lithe, sabertoothed cat and pats it affectionately as it reaches her heel. She offers the creature a familiar smile, her body completely at ease in the beast’s presence.

~ Played by a Hero with

方格纹油毡铺着这家路边小餐馆肮脏的地面，大窗户被外头源源不断的污染物熏得一道道脏痕纵横，玻璃也浑浊发白。一个身材魁梧的女人戴着一顶破旧的纸帽，熟练地翻着汉堡肉饼；一名染着毒蓝色头发的年轻男子在喧闹的餐桌间匆匆穿梭，累得满头大汗，拼命追赶着所有人的点单。
Checkered linoleum covers the dirty floor of the roadside diner, its large windows streaked and clouded by the constant stream of pollutants outside. A broad woman in a bedraggled paper hat flips burgers with practiced ease as a young man with toxic-blue hair hurries between the bustling tables, sweating with exertion as he tries to keep up with everyone’s orders.

Herd Of Triceratops.name:
三角龙兽群
Herd Of Triceratops

Text.text:
一群巨兽如同方阵般隆隆碾过。每头生物硕大的头颅都戴着骨质颈盾的王冠，其上刻满醒目的纹样，三支骇人的巨角装点其间，在落日余晖里泛着珍珠般的冷光。它们厚皮动物般的身躯覆着粗糙、颗粒嶙峋的硬皮，连最锋利的利爪都难以划开。空气被它们喷鼻与嗅探交织的喧嚣震得发颤，它们踏步而过，腿如花岗岩的树桩般沉重砸落。
A herd of behemoths trundles past like a phalanx. Each creature’s massive head is crowned with a bony frill, etched in striking patterns and adorned with three fearsome horns that gleam like pearls in the setting sun. Their pachyderm bodies are covered in rough, pebbly skin that even the sharpest claws would struggle to slice. The air vibrates with their snorting, snuffling cacophony as they thud by on legs like stumps of granite.

若你留心，便能在树干周遭那圈亵渎的光晕里感到它的灵：地上散落着形状与色泽都不洁的弃叶。盘结而病态的枝条下，空气愈发沉重、腥腐。再靠近树干，传来叶与水的低语，却也夹杂着年轮与髓心深处某种东西的呢喃。树皮臭得令人作呕。树干上一团巨大的瘤结忽然转动、张开，露出一只盛满血色思绪的眼睛。
The spirit can be felt in the halo of defilement around the trunk, the discarded leaves of unholy shapes and colors, if one is paying attention. Under the knotty, sick branches, the air grows heavy and rank. Closer to the trunk comes a whisper of leaf and water, but also of something within the rings and pith. The bark is foul enough to make one retch. A great burl on the trunk suddenly turns and opens, exposing an eye full of bloody thoughts.

Furred Goblinoid.name:
毛茸茸的地精类生物
Furred Goblinoid

Text.text:
除了几绺浓密黝黑的粗毛外，它几乎赤裸；这头肌肉虬结的生物在荒芜的岩地上目标明确地大步前行，猩红的眼睛扫过每一道裂隙与缝缝角角，搜寻猎物。宽阔的下颚上，黄牙向上戳出，形成醒目的地包天；破损的黑色利爪在岩石上刻出深痕，仿佛那只是羊皮纸。
Naked save for patches of thick, swarthy fur, the muscular creature strides purposefully across the barren rocks, its red eyes scanning every crack and crevice for prey. Yellow fangs jut upward from a wide jaw to form a prominent underbite, and ragged black claws gouge the rock as if it were parchment.

Sundries From A Sea Serpent.name:
海蛇杂货
Sundries From A Sea Serpent

Text.text:
死蛇的腹部翻卷向上，朝着天空，在海浪间浮沉起伏。它巨口大张，半浸在水里，用不了多久，这头怪物就会沉入海底。它针般的利齿仍覆着一层寒霜，那是冰息留下的冷光。现在正是采集鳞片、牙齿，以及充盈元素之力的喉腺样本的时代。
The belly of the dead serpent rolls upward to face the sky, bobbing in the waves of the sea. With its maw hanging agape in the water, there’s only a short time before the beast sinks to the bottom of the ocean. Its needling teeth are still coated in a sheen of frost from its icy breath. The time to collect samples of scales, teeth, and elementally-charged throat glands is now.

那身影佝偻的骨架上背着沉重与疲惫，与其年纪极不相称。过早泛白的头发无力地垂在脸侧，被低垂的兜帽压出一片阴影。TA手中握着一根怪异的浅色木杖——但细看才知，那并非木头，而是雕刻成形的骨头。腰间系着一条缀满小袋的腰带，袋口隐隐逸出辛辣苦涩的刺鼻气味。此人身上有着浓烈的腐殖土与新翻泥土的味道，除此之外还夹着另一种气息——腐败那股甜腻得令人作呕的香。
The figure carries upon their crooked frame a weight and a weariness that belies their youth. Their hair, prematurely white, hangs limply about their face, shadowed by a low cowl. They carry a gnarled staff of some strange pale wood—though closer inspection reveals it to be carved bone. They keep about their waist a belt ringed with pouches, which emanate an acrid and bitter odor. The figure smells sharply of loam and fresh earth, and something else too—the sickly sweet aroma of decay.

这座旋转书架以额外的巧妙工程打造，借由滑轮便能令层板升降自如。层板可容纳任何体型，而旋转机构本身还能上锁，使其中一层能滑出更远，便于许可取用。精密部件虽为铁制，层板却选用上等桃花心木，并以奢华的紫色清漆重重封护，光泽深沉。边缘衬着绿色毛毡，防止机器转得过于兴起时，物件被猛然甩落。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

This rotating shelf was built with extra engineering that allows the shelves to lower and raise by the use of a pulley. The shelves can accommodate any size, and the rotator itself can be locked to allow one shelf to slide out further for easier access. Although the intricate bits are iron, the shelves are made of exquisite mahogany and further sealed with a luxuriant purple varnish. Green felt lines the edges to prevent items from being slung off during a too-spirited rotation of the machine.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Precipitous Berth In Winter.name:
冬日险峻泊位
Precipitous Berth In Winter

Text.text:
沿着坡道攀上最高的巨柱，寒意骤然尖锐到极致，仿佛连空气的雾息都要在你身侧碎裂。前方的辽阔承载着无数天体的重量，周身缠绕着湛蓝能量。在这片冰封的栈台上只要一步踏错，便会被直接抛入虚空——化作无数旋转碎屑中的一粒尘点，绕着那擎天般的巨型星球与群星永无止境地轨行。
Ascending the ramp to the tallest pillar, the frigidity becomes so intense it feels as though the very vapors of the air might shatter around you. The expanse ahead bears the weight of many astral bodies, wreathed in azure energy. A single misstep on this frozen berth teases to pitch you directly into the void—transforming you into one of the many specks of spinning debris orbiting the titanic planets and stars.

Casia Belliger.name:
卡西亚·贝利杰尔
Casia Belliger

Text.text:
一名女子带着沉重的叹息，调整着皮背心的系带与贴合度，褐色眼眸里闷燃着傲气。满意之后，她又细致地抻正领口与袖口，让衬衫更讨巧地贴在她的护甲周围。她脸色苍白，因数日旅行而晒伤起皮的双颊紧绷，扭成一抹酸涩的皱褶。她转身与同伴低声拌嘴——那是个高大宽肩的男人，棱角分明。他的头发是一团俊逸而野性的亮泽赤褐乱鬃，举止仪态却如王者般尊贵。

~ Played by Walt M. with

A woman adjusts the ties and fit of her leather jerkin with a burdened sigh, haughtiness smoldering in her brown eyes. Once satisfied, she takes care to adjust her collar and sleeves so that the shirt lies appealingly about her armor. Her pale face, her cheeks burnt and flaking from days of travel, is twisted into a sour puck. She turns to bicker quietly with a companion, a tall and broad-shouldered man with angular features. His hair is a handsomely wild mop of shining auburn hair and his bearing is as regal as a king’s.

~ Played by Walt M. with

这面细长狭窄的风筝盾显然出自精灵之手，原本为骑乘作战的武者打造，但你徒步携带也乐在其中。它本身就是一件艺术品。盾牌外侧绘着一幅繁复的森林图景；镶压的银色兽影在其间或匍匐、或瑟缩、或纵跃穿行。前景中央，一头独角兽昂然伫立，骄傲而醒目。
This long and narrow kite shield was clearly made by elves for a warrior on horseback, but you’d be happy to carry it on foot. It is a work of art. The shield’s outward face bears an elaborate painting of a forest scene. Embossed silver animals crouch, cower or leap through this scene. A single unicorn stands proudly and prominently centered in the foreground.

I Cast Lesser Restoration From My Neckla.name:
我从祈祷念珠项链中施放了次级复原术
I Cast Lesser Restoration From My Necklace Of Prayer Beads

Text.text:
这状态绝非什么小小的划伤或淤青，而是足以让人垮下去的重创。我必须用拳头攥紧那颗珠子，另一只手按在受术者的额头上。逆转只需短短几秒——珠子渐渐发热，将诅咒、体内的腐坏一并吸纳并净化，随后光泽黯淡下去，魔法耗尽。
The condition isn’t some mere cut or bruise, but something debilitating. I have to clench my fist around the bead and put my other hand to the forehead of my subject. The reversal takes only a few seconds as the bead grows warm, absorbing and purging the curse, the rot within, and then growing dim, its magic spent.

一名身披羽饰长袍、通体发光的女子在祭坛后现身。她提起一条毒蛇，长度几乎与她等高，捏住蛇头后方的颈部，将其盘入鎏金钵中。她抄起一柄刀刃，剖开蛇身，任由内脏倾泻进盆里。幻影随即消散，但血腥味仍在空气中萦绕。
A luminous woman in feathered robes appears behind the altar. She lifts a viper, almost as long as she is tall, by the neck just behind the head and coils it in the gilded bowl. Taking a blade in hand, she splits the serpent and allows its entrails to spill in the basin. The apparition disappears, but the scent of blood remains.

战士啐出一口血，身子一弓，摆出徒手斗殴的架势。他们的凶性按捺着，静候时机；敌人猛扑上来，却一击落空。他们骤然爆发，侧身一晃——步法妙到毫巅——一记雷霆般的重拳轰进袭击者的下腰。嶙峋的指节撞上的瞬间，劲力如锤贯入，狠狠砸中对方的肾；撕心裂肺的惨叫中，那人当场瘫软垮塌。

~ 由一位英雄Envisioned

The warrior spits blood and hunches—a fist-fighter stance. Their aggression waits for its chance as their foe lunges, misses. They erupt into action, jigging to the side—footwork sublime—and send a thundering punch into the lower back of their assailant. As the gnarled knuckles impact, the kinetic force hammers the foe’s kidney, the screaming agony causing them to crumble.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

那女人的裙装露得比遮得还多：短裙开着高衩，腰胯与肩头周围又挖出大片空白。她一边走一边拨弄蓬松的长发，顺手检视淡雅的妆容；哪怕神思不属，她的举手投足仍不由分说地牵引视线落在那双腿上。
The woman's dress reveals more skin than it hides, with a slit in the short skirt and swaths cut out around the hips and shoulders. She rearranges her voluminous hair and checks her subtle makeup as she walks, her movements drawing the eye to her legs even when she's distracted.

Jeweler Transforms Emerald Into The Shap.name:
珠宝匠将祖母绿雕琢成水之女神的形态
Jeweler Transforms Emerald Into The Shape Of A Water Goddess

Text.text:
匠人灵巧的双手飞快而娴熟地游走，他轻轻雕琢着那枚苍白的绿宝石，将其塑成一件令人屏息的艺术杰作。他低声哼着一支古老的歌谣，在杂乱无章的工坊里，借着摇曳的烛光继续手作——太阳的光辉早已远去，投入夜色的怀抱。待在祖母绿的表面刻下最后几道细若游丝的纹路，他温和地一笑，随即垂首致敬那其上所描绘的水之女神。

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

The crafter's nimble hands work quickly and expertly as he gently sculpts the pallid green gemstone into a breathtaking work of art. Humming an ancient song under his breath, he works by flickering candlelight in his chaotic workshop, the sun's light long since passed into the embrace of night. He smiles warmly as he makes the final, delicate etchings upon the emerald-green surface and then bows his head in reverence to its depiction of a water goddess.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

毒蕈散落满地，绚烂的虹彩令人目眩。菌类覆满洞壁，将闪烁的孢子抖落进空气里，如同发光的尘埃。空气里弥漫着腐闷与霉味；尽管洞窟毫无外界光源，主宰这片空间的真菌却散发出自带的诡异幽光，勉强照亮前方，让你看清眼前几步。
Toadstools litter the ground in a dizzying rainbow of vibrant colors. Fungi coat the walls, loosing glimmering spores into the air like luminescent dust. The air smells of must and mildew, and though the cavern is devoid of outside light, the fungi dominating the space give off their own eerie glow, lighting the space just enough to see in front of you.

一道耀眼的亮黄光芒攫住视线，逼人仰望这座城里最离奇的建筑：一座砂岩高塔，无窗无门，塔顶却盘踞着一团巨大的黄铜号角。号角的管身如戈尔贡扭动的头颅般彼此缠绕，喇叭口大张，宛如咆哮的巨口。每面塔墙都饰以象形图案——图像刻入石中，并镶嵌着与上方号角同样的黄铜金属。它们看起来与城墙上装点的象形图案如出一辙。
A glare of brilliant yellow draws the eye skyward to the strangest structure in the city: a sandstone tower, windowless and doorless, crowned in a tangle of massive brass horns. Like the writhing head of a gorgon, the horns' pipes twist about each other, their flares gaped wide like roaring maws. Pictograms ornament each wall, images etched into the stone and inlaid with the same brassy metal as the horns above. They appear similar to the pictograms decorating the city walls.

Sundries From A Wicker Zombie.name:
柳条丧尸（特征）的杂物
Sundries From A Wicker Zombie

Text.text:
孕育出这具丧尸（特征）的烈焰高温，将这不幸之人随身携带的钱币熔成一团凝固的铜块，其间还染着被烧焦的银与金的暗痕。看来那些鬼婆对受害者的钱毫无兴趣。
The intense heat of the fire that birthed this zombie melted the coins this unfortunate soul was carrying into a lump of solid copper, tinged with charred silver and gold. It seems the hags had no use for their victim’s money.

I Cast Misty Step.name:
我施放【迷踪步】
I Cast Misty Step

Text.text:
银色薄雾在我脚边蒸腾，宛如龙息，旋绕而上，没至小腿。气息清凉而鲜润，像海面吹来的柔软水雾。我感觉自己漂浮起来，身形轻若身周翻涌的云絮，而在我选定的位置，一团云雾悄然生长。我迈出一步，瞬间传送至那里。
Silver mist steams like dragon’s breath around my feet, swirling up to my calves. It smells cool and fresh, like a soft spray from the ocean. I feel myself levitate, my form as light as the billows about me, and a cloud grows in my chosen location. I take my step and teleport to that spot.

阳光晒成古铜色的肌肤、靛蓝色的长发，以及闪烁如虹的爬行鳞片上，仿佛有一层光辉向外逸散——这具异样却令人心动的人形身躯因此更显夺目。她显然出自多重血脉的后裔：外貌交织着人类、猫科与龙裔的痕迹，三者的力量与特质彼此熔铸，凝成一个远胜于各部分相加的存在。她那保养良好却极简的护甲，毫不遮掩肌肉紧实、灵活矫健的身形与宽阔的肩背。粗厚的格斗手套间探出带爪的手指，因频繁——且凶猛——的使用而磨损斑驳。一抹狡黠的笑意，轻易便攀上她的唇角。

~ 扮演：Kyro，

A radiance emanates off the sun-browned skin, indigo hair, and shimmering reptilian scales of this strange yet alluring humanoid. Clearly a descendant of multiple bloodlines, her appearance is a mingling of human, feline, and draconic, with the strengths and characteristics of all three amalgamating to create a being greater than the sum of her parts. Her well-maintained but minimal armor reveals her muscled, lithe frame and broad shoulders. Clawed fingers emerge from heavy brawling gloves, worn from frequent—and ferocious—use. A wry smile comes easily to her lips.

~ Played by Kyro with

Embellished Story About A Vampire.name:
一则华丽润色的吸血鬼（特征）故事
Embellished Story About A Vampire

Text.text:
“——然后我就看见了它：比雪还要惨白，唯有一缕猩红从它的血盆大口里淌出来。它朝我扑来。我还以为自己死定了，可就在那一刻，我想起腰带上的灵药。我猛地将药液泼向那生物，只消一口黑蒜与圣油的辛烈气息，它便瑟缩在我面前。我告诉那畜生，它的狩猎日子到头了。它哀求饶命，可我当场便将这污秽生物放逐。万幸的是，我从不离家不带我那独家专利的护身灵药！”
“—and then I see it: Paler than snow, except for a line of crimson dribbling out of its gob. It came at me. I was sure I was done for, but then I remembered the tonic on my belt. I dashed it on the creature, and with a single whiff of the black garlic and holy oils, it was cowering before me. I told the beast its hunting days were over. It begged for its life, but I banished the foul creature on the spot. Luckily, I never leave the house without my patented warding tonic!”

Kobold Siege Engineer Enters War Council.name:
狗头人攻城工匠步入战争议会
Kobold Siege Engineer Enters War Council

Text.text:
鼓鼓囊囊的工具腰带在工程师奔向作战室时叮当乱响，双臂抱着多到快要滑落的卷轴。议会众人望着那名红皮肤的狗头人走向占据房间中心的规划桌，嘲弄的低语与憋笑的抽气声在席间蔓延——却很快戛然而止。工程师以近乎癫狂的热情扑入讲解，手舞足蹈地指点地图——还恰到好处地配上了音效。

~ 由 Clara C. Potter 在 Discord 上 构想

A brimming tool belt clatters noisily as the engineer rushes to the war room, arms laden with too many scrolls. Murmurs of derision and stifled chuckles spread through the council as they watch the red-skinned kobold approach the planning table dominating the room, but they are soon silenced. The engineer launches into their plans with frenetic vigor, gesturing enthusiastically at their maps—and providing appropriate sound effects.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

一座圆形山谷向两端延展，绵延数里，宛如一只缓缓倾斜的巨碗。河流沿着谷壁蜿蜒下泄，汇入凹陷深处，在中央那座自谷底隆起的山丘周围汇成湖泊与池塘。你不禁猜想，这片诡异而辽阔的深坑究竟因何而生——或许很久以前，有什么东西自天外坠落。如今又过了漫长的纪元，大地在那次撞击周围移位、滋长，悄然重塑了伤痕。究竟从天而降的是什么，又在此留下了什么？
A circular valley spans leagues in either direction, resembling a gently sloping bowl. Rivers wind down the sides into the depths of the indentation, pooling in lakes and ponds around the hill rising from its center. You wonder what formed the strange and sprawling pit—something fell from the sky long ago, you imagine. And now, eons later, the land has shifted and grown around that impact. What fell from above, and what did it leave behind?

I Cast Branding Smite From My Necklace O.name:
我从祈祷念珠项链中施放烙印惩击
I Cast Branding Smite From My Necklace Of Prayer Beads

Text.text:
这串项链的大半都用于治疗，但神圣之力有时也必须用来对抗邪恶势力。那颗水晶珠散发着淡淡的光，我将它高高举起，注视着光芒渐盛、力量增长。光从珠子里蜿蜒流出，如同一股细流，缠绕成一道道光带，紧紧裹住我的武器。当我挥击时，敌人不仅被照得无所遁形，也将受其惩戒。
So much of this necklace is devoted to healing, but holy power sometimes needs to be delivered against the forces of evil. The crystal bead radiates a pale light, and I hold it aloft, watching the light increase and its power grow. The light curls from the bead as a stream and wraps itself in bands around my weapon. When I strike, my foe is illuminated as well as chastised.

Insult About Corrupted Heart.name:
关于腐化之心的羞辱
Insult About Corrupted Heart

Text.text:
“你一开口，我就忍不住想抬手遮住脸，生怕你心里那口胆汁粪坑下一刻就从嘴里喷涌而出。”
“Whenever you speak, I feel the urge to shield my face in case the cesspit of bile in your heart comes spewing out of your mouth.”

V, The Artificer's Armor.name:
V，巧匠的护甲
V, The Artificer's Armor

Text.text:
一具工艺独特的构装体高高矗立在你面前。暗木根须在它强健的躯架上扭结翻卷，几道寒光闪烁的钢箍将其束缚，却被旅人装束拙劣地遮掩着。它像哨兵般警觉伫立，姿态兼具力量与诡异的监视感。它的双手令人不安地近似人类，五指齐全，指节微微抽动，仿佛正凭记忆操弄某种秘奥之术。眼眶里嵌着深紫色的碎片——宛如濒死恒星被囚禁的残光——闪烁着异界的智能，扫视四周。它一手攥着漆黑如沥的长棍，腰侧垂着一柄随时可拔的匕首。宽阔的背上还斜挂着一张短弓，几乎像是随手一带的念头。它像好奇的鸟儿般歪了歪头，那些紫色碎片随之点亮在你身上，空气里悬着无声的疑问，如同耳畔一缕低语。

~ 由一位英雄 Played

A construct of unique artistry looms before you. Darkwood roots twist and writhe about their powerful frame, bound by gleaming steel bands poorly obscured by traveler’s garb. They stand watchful like a sentinel, their stance a juxtaposition of might and eerie surveillance. Their hands, disturbingly humanlike with five fingers, twitch subtly, as if manipulating something esoteric from memory. Shards of deep purple—like captured fragments of a dying star—glint with otherworldly intelligence in their eye sockets as they scan their surroundings. A quarterstaff as dark as pitch is clutched in one hand, with a dagger hanging ready at their side. The martial look is completed by a shortbow slung across their broad back, almost like an afterthought. Tilting their head like an inquisitive bird, the purple shards alight upon you, a silent question hanging in the air like a whisper.

~ Played by a Hero with

Goodberry, A Little Harvest.name:
神莓，小小的收获
Goodberry, A Little Harvest

Text.text:
施放 goodberry 法术总让人心满意足。一点小点心，既能缝合伤口，又能填饱肚子。由槲寄生化作的想象之果。眼下有九颗。再留下一颗，以备从现在到明日那场小小收成之间的不时之需。
The goodberry spell is so satisfying to cast. A little snack to close a cut and fill a belly. A fruit of imagination transmuted from mistletoe. Nine for now. One berry saved to meet a need between now and tomorrow’s little harvest.

Performance-enhancing Drug, Rhino.name:
增强兴奋剂：犀牛
Performance-enhancing Drug, Rhino

Text.text:
金属扁壶在你手中晃动时咔啦作响，仿佛里面装满了珠子或粗盐。壶盖用两套独立的机关牢牢卡死，侧面浅浅蚀刻着一个粗陋的警示符号。扁壶底部贴着一张贴纸，上面是卡通风格的犀牛：一只眼睛眨着，苍白的舌头伸得老长。

~ 一位英雄 构想

The metal flask rattles as you move it about, as if it were full of beads or coarse salt. The cap is clamped shut with two separate mechanisms, and a rudimentary caution symbol is etched shallowly on the side. On the bottom of the flask, you see a sticker bearing the cartoonish image of a rhinoceros winking and sticking out its pale tongue.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

各色帆布拼接缝成一只朴素的背包，底部的系绳固定着一卷彩色的铺盖。背后绑着一只抛光木匣，匣面沾着颜料或妆粉的斑痕。匣盖上雕着一位女子捧卷阅读的身影——一位缪斯。背包侧边唯一的挂环上吊着一个水囊。
Canvas panels in various hues have been sewn into a simple backpack, and strings on the bottom hold a colorful bedroll. Paint or makeup stains a polished wooden case strapped to the back. Carved on the case’s lid is the image of a woman reading a scroll, a muse. The pack’s one loop holds a waterskin.

I Fidget With My Stone Of Good Luck.name:
我摆弄着我的幸运石
I Fidget With My Stone Of Good Luck

Text.text:
我把手伸进腰包，指尖捻住我的幸运石，在指间翻转。感受着它冰凉而光滑的触感，我回想它或许曾在多少次险境里把我从命运边缘拽回来。拇指与食指轻轻摩挲，我在心里默念一声谢意。随后，我让它安安稳稳地落回原处。
I reach into my pouch and turn my luckstone over in my fingers. Feeling its cool smoothness, I consider the times it might have saved me before. With my thumb and forefinger, I give it a little rub and a thought of thanks. Then I let it settle back into place.

Tree House On The Grounds Of A Manor.name:
庄园庭院中的树屋
Tree House On The Grounds Of A Manor

Text.text:
巨大的橡树高耸于四周地面之上，被任其恣意繁茂生长，枝桠直探苍穹。繁枝间栖着一座木造结构——一间树屋，却绝非寻常之作。门扉、窗棂、梯子、台阶、绳桥、摇曳的藤蔓——无一不是匠心大师的杰作。
The massive oak towers over the surrounding grounds, allowed to flourish and grow to its whims, with branches reaching for the sky. Perched within the boughs, a structure of wood sits—a treehouse, but not one of common make. The doors, windows, ladders, stairs, rope bridges, swinging vines—all crafted by masters.

Pixies Goading Tree To Attack Adventurer.name:
小精灵挑唆树木攻击冒险者
Pixies Goading Tree To Attack Adventurers

Text.text:
“蠢货，蠢货，一群蠢货，”一个尖细得像吱吱叫的小嗓音呵斥着你，你和你的伙伴正蜷伏在一株阴暗扭曲的橡树里。“你们全都要被砸烂啦，嘿嘿嘿。”你身下的地面开始隆隆震颤，藏身处周围的树根被硬生生扯裂拔起。粗壮的枝臂暴戾地朝你们劈落，而那株枯疫树拔地而起，挺起它全部的高度。
"Stupid, stupid, stupids," a squeaky, tiny voice berates you as you and your companions lay low within a dark and twisted oak. "Yous all going to be smashed now, hehehe." The ground beneath you begins to rumble as roots are torn free from your hiding spot. Limbs from the tree swipe down at you violently, and the tree blight rises to its full height.

Conducting Searches In A Courtyard.name:
在庭院中搜查
Conducting Searches In A Courtyard

Text.text:
踏进城门，并不代表你就得到了这座城的青睐。高墙环抱的一处庭院里挤满了人——商贾与过客被编成一个个小队。每队各有一名守卫看管，逐个搜身。搜查并不粗暴，却依然把态度摆得明明白白——正如墙头上那些荷枪实弹、俯视众人的卫兵一样。

~ Envisioned by Noah

Inside the gates does not mean in the good graces of the city. A courtyard, surrounded by a high wall, holds people—organized into small groups of merchants and passersby. A guard assigned to each group searches one person at a time. The searches aren’t rough, but they make a clear point nonetheless, as do the armed guards looking down from atop the wall.

~ Envisioned by Noah

狂风如龙卷般在你身周抽打盘旋，凄厉的嚎叫淹没了一切声响。旋卷的风暴之外，环境只剩朦胧的暗影轮廓——在结界彼端遥远而无力。
The wind whips around you like a twister, the ghastly howl drowning out all other sound. The environment beyond the whirling gale becomes shadowed shapes—distant and impotent on the other side of the ward.

一名男子端坐在一张奢华得近乎夸张的巨大书桌前。他身形瘦削，裹在华贵的天鹅绒长袍里，染着无星之夜般摄魂的深蓝。布料在他弯腰伏案时，柔软地堆在腰际与肩头。他手中天鹅羽毛笔那明亮雪白的羽翎微微发颤，笔尖却飞快掠过纸面。蓬乱的头发像一团乱草垂在他沉重、过分严肃的额前。你一进门，他便抬起头，眉心拧出恼怒的褶皱；刻薄的眼神扫过你的脸、衣着与道具，嘴角连同那撮小胡子一并下坠，拉出一抹不以为然的冷笑。他抚平长袍起伏的褶皱，起身而立，一条长长的金项链随之垂落到胸口中央。其上悬着三枚坠饰：一颗参差的尖牙、一支小巧的望远镜、一片羽翼。坠饰闪烁着某种不止于贵金属光泽的异样辉芒。

~ Played by a Hero

A man sits at a luxuriously large writing desk. His thin frame is wrapped in rich velvet robes, dyed the bewitching blue of a starless night. The fabric bunches cozily about his waist and shoulders as he hunches over the table. The brilliant white vanes of his swan-feather quill tremble as he writes swiftly across the page. An unkempt mop of hair hangs over his heavy, over-serious brow. He looks up as you enter, his forehead furrowing into irked wrinkles. His acerbic eyes scan your face, clothes, and gear until his mouth and small mustache droop in an unimpressed grimace. He smooths down his robes and stands, a long necklace of gold unfurling to the center of his chest. From it, three charms dangle: a jagged tooth, a spyglass, a wing. The charms glisten with something more than the luster of precious metal.

~ Played by a Hero

Elven Vale: Pleasant Fall Of Rain.name:
精灵幽谷：宜人的秋雨
Elven Vale: Pleasant Fall Of Rain

Text.text:
林间的金色光辉渐渐褪去，取而代之的是幽暗的蓝意与一抹令人舒畅的青绿，仿佛你每一次呼吸都将它吸入胸腔。正当你心念一动：也许要下雨了——便听见水滴轻轻拍打树冠的细碎声响。几分钟后，雨丝穿过层层枝叶落到你身上，化作零星的滴点，带来沁凉的清爽与澄澈。
The golden light in the forest fades, replaced gradually by dim blues and a pleasant greenness that you seem to inhale with every breath. Just as it occurs to you that it might rain, you hear the gentle patter of water dropping on the treetops. A few minutes later, the rain filters down to you, landing in scattered drops of refreshing coolness and clarity.

Jingle Jangle The Faithful.name:
叮当作响的虔信者
Jingle Jangle The Faithful

Text.text:
这匹体格壮硕的夸特马披着一身闪亮的浅黄色皮毛，到了鼻端渐渐加深为金棕色——巧黠而幽默的巧克力色眼睛在那儿闪烁生辉。细软的姜红色长毛构成它的鬃与尾，一条金色头巾垂挂在马的肩隆与肩部之间。它的臀后还饰着一道银色的土星符文。

~ 由一位英雄Played

This powerfully built quarter horse has a shiny coat of light yellow, darkening to golden brown at the nose—where chocolate-colored eyes sparkle with cleverness and humor. Fine ginger hair makes up its long mane and tail, and a golden bandana hangs around the horse’s withers and shoulders. A silvery rune of Saturn adorns its hindquarters.

~ Played by a Hero

这片冰原向四面八方延展，绵延数里未有半点扰动，却骤然在眼前以刺耳的暴裂撕开。尖锐的冰柱向裂缝彼岸的同类伸出触及，仿佛竭力想再度合拢。裂口一路向下、向下，深得远超你的视线所及，被遥远的距离与黑暗吞没。
The sheet of ice, undisturbed for miles in each direction, comes to a sudden, harsh rupture. Sharp pillars of ice reach towards their brethren on the other side, as if straining to be rejoined. The fissure goes down, down, far beyond what you can see, obscured by distance and darkness.

Chandler's Shop.name:
钱德勒的杂货铺
Chandler's Shop

Text.text:
各色灯火摇曳闪烁，仿佛狡黠的鬼火般勾人，将顾客一一引入。陈列的蜡烛色泽、尺寸与香气千姿百态；有些还以花草点缀：薰衣草花瓣、薄荷叶、柑橘皮，诸如此类。店主在书桌前收尾一笔交易。你听见他干巴巴地笑了一声，抬手掐灭胡子末梢那一段暗红的余烬。“隔壁以前有个做古地图生意的制图师。我想我把他弄得有点紧张。”
Flickering lights of various colors abound, drawing in patrons like beguiling will-o'-wisps. The candles on display showcase a multitude of shades, sizes, and scents. Some are decorated with flora: lavender petals, peppermint leaves, citrus rinds, and more. The owner is finishing a transaction at his desk. You hear him chuckle dryly as he extinguishes a smoldering end of his mustache. "Used to be a cartographer next door that dealt in antique maps. I think I made him nervous."

Weddi-torrey Fields.name:
韦迪-托雷田野
Weddi-torrey Fields

Text.text:
这座农庄的田地里种满了啤酒花与大麦。宅邸前的院子里码着一摞摞木箱，箱身用醒目的粗字标着：Guzman Gulp Brewing Company。古兹曼家的家主兼农场主人阿莱格拉·古兹曼性情亲切，见访客自大路走近，便热情迎上前来。尽管他们的住家不对外开放，阿莱格拉和已成年的子女仍在屋外搭起木长凳、桌子与帐篷，供人落座，品尝最新酿出的酒液。
The fields of this farmstead are full of hops and barley. Crates stacked in front of the house on the property are labeled with bold text: Guzman Gulp Brewing Company. Allegra Guzman, the head of the family and the farm, is a friendly soul and eager to greet visitors as they approach from the main road. While their home is closed to the public, Allegra and her adult children have set up wooden benches, tables, and tents where people can sit and try out the latest brews.

你不禁想：究竟是谁建起了这样的结构——又有谁能攀至这般令人眩晕的高度，施展如此登峰造极的工艺？高耸入云的柱群、巍峨的拱门、以及恢宏得令人失语的长廊，让人仿佛看见神祇般的存在徒手凿刻洞窟。柱身与拱券上深深镌刻的符文，用以驱逐擅闯者与心怀恶意之人；另一些则诉说着巨人们曾立下的赫赫伟业。
You wonder who built such a structure—who could achieve such dizzying heights and masterful craftwork? The soaring pillars, immense archways, and massive corridors evoke images of godlike beings carving the caverns by hand. Runes etched deep into the pillars and archways ward against trespassers and those with ill intent; others speak of the great deeds of giants.

Celebration Of The Winter Solstice.name:
冬至庆典
Celebration Of The Winter Solstice

Text.text:
杜松、松树与雪松编成的冠饰点缀在巨石粗粝尖峭的顶端。石环中央，一根巨大的原木直立而起，通体剥去树皮的木身刻满盘旋的符印，祈求守护与财富。人群围拢，将沥青与油脂厚厚涂抹在它的根部，齐声高唱咒语。持炬者缓步逼近，面覆面具，赤足踏着灰烬。
Crowns of juniper, pine, and cedar adorn the menhirs' jagged tips. In the center of the stone circle, a huge log stands upright, its barkless length carved with swirling sigils of warding and wealth. A crowd of folk coat its base with pitch and fat, chanting loudly. The torch bearer approaches, her face masked, ash covered feet bare.

Ioun Stone Of Fortitude.name:
坚毅艾欧石
Ioun Stone Of Fortitude

Text.text:
你只需片刻便抽出并掷出那枚打磨光亮的石子——粉红色，被雕成一种离经叛道、棱角分明的怪异形状。随着石中魔法发动，它以完美的轨迹绕着你的头颅旋转不息，你感到一股强烈的健康与活力自体内扩散开来。疲惫迅速褪去，肌肉与关节的酸痛也从你身上流走，仿佛烈日下的积雪悄然消融。
It takes but a moment to draw and toss the polished stone, pink and carved into an unorthodox, angular shape. As the magic of the stone begins to move the stone in perfect revolutions around your head, you feel a powerful sense of health and wellness radiate through your body. Your fatigue fades away and the soreness of your muscles and joints bleeds away from you like snow melting in the hot sun.

Sundries From A Kuo-toa.name:
来自库欧托人的杂货
Sundries From A Kuo-toa

Text.text:
翻找这具佩斯卡诺伊德的尸体时，你短暂窥见了这只生物曾经的日常。松散捆起的一束水草无精打采地垂在他用绳子扎成的腰带上——你猜那是零嘴，因为草梢上压着细小的啃咬痕迹。你还找到一袋河卵石，形状大都相仿。靠近袋口的几颗仍带着潮湿。
Searching the pescanoid’s corpse, you are given a brief window into what was once this creature’s daily life. A loose bundle of waterweed hangs listless in his rope belt—a snack, you guess, for their ends are impressed with small bite marks. You also find a bag of river stones all generally the same shape. A few near the top are still damp.

Hamlet Home To Mages.name:
法师的哈姆雷特家园
Hamlet Home To Mages

Text.text:
村子很小——小到几乎称不上是个聚落。几栋石屋紧紧簇在村中央的水井周围，附近的牧场里牲畜悠闲啃草。远远望去，这里不过是一座寻常农庄小村——几户人家并肩耕作，同守一片土地。可当你走近，便觉出一切并不如表面那般简单。你经过时，一个稻草人竟抬手扶帽向你致意，随即又继续照料菜圃。一个古怪的机械身影从修剪羊毛的活计中抬眼瞥了你一下。还有一把扫帚悬空自立，替你把路上的尘土扫开。你似乎误闯进了一处奥术飞地……
The village is small—barely large enough to be considered a settlement. A tight cluster of stone buildings huddle around a well at their center, and animals graze in nearby pastures. From a distance, it appears to be a simple farming hamlet—a few families working the land alongside one another. But as you draw closer, you notice things are not quite as they seem. A scarecrow tips its hat as you pass by, then resumes tending the gardens. A strange, mechanical figure glances up from its work shearing sheep. A broom holding itself aloft sweeps dirt from the path before you. You seem to have stumbled upon an arcane enclave . . .

一条庞大到骇人的分节巨虫从火山地形中轰然炸出。它十字形的颚部疯狂旋转，随着巨躯起伏翻涌，卷起一股由锯齿般利牙构成的飓风——专为撕裂大地、吞噬这世界的基岩而生。那种非人的湮灭感深深钻入你的灵魂，而这环节怪物以无眼的凝视锁定了你。
A gargantuan segmented worm explodes from the volcanic terrain. Its cruciform jaw gyrates as the beast undulates, creating a cyclone of sawing teeth designed to rip through earth and devour the very bedrock of this world. An inhuman sense of annihilation burrows deep into your soul as the annelid aims its eyeless gaze upon you.

这间八角形的厅室里摆着巨型家具，皆由沉重原木粗犷却精到地雕凿而成。一张大床盘踞着整面墙，堆满猛犸皮毛与手工缝制的枕垫。墙上悬着几幅古怪而褪色的挂毯，边缘缀满符文，画面描绘着远古大事——巨人之城的奠基、巨人与巨龙之间的战争、与人类的初次相遇——虽被时代磨损，却仍勉强保持着可观的体面。床的对面是一张巨大的扶手椅，大得让人类攀爬时如同登上一座小丘，却恰好贴合巨人的身形。
The octagonal chamber features gargantuan furniture carved roughly but expertly from heavy timber. A bed dominates one wall, piled with mammoth furs and hand-stitched pillows. Strange, faded tapestries lined with runes and depicting ancient events—the founding of a giant city, a war between giants and dragons, the first meeting with humans—hang on the walls, worn with time but kept in passable condition. Opposite the bed, a massive arm chair sits, large enough for a human to scale like a hill, but perfectly suited to the frame of a giant.

Fortune Teller’s Tent.name:
占卜师的帐篷
Fortune Teller’s Tent

Text.text:
皇家紫的布幔缀着金边，先声夺人；然而更攫住你目光的，是敞口处那枚镴质龙爪扣，将你的注意力生生拽向幽暗深处。帐内飘出辛辣而馥郁的气息——异域香草被抛入两座火盆，甜腻的烟雾袅袅升起，火光柔和地微亮，勾勒出一名坐在蒙纱桌后之人的剪影。银线绣就的桌布上，描绘着来自各式学派的符文与印记，而桌布之上有着移动：一双手正洗弄着一副夸张巨大的卡牌。
The royal-purple cloth accentuated with golden trim attracts the eye, but it’s the pewter dragon-claw clasp over the open entrance that really wrestles your attention toward the shadowy depths. A spicy potpourri of smells emanates from within—sweet smoke from exotic herbs tossed onto the two braziers that glow softly and trace out the silhouette of a person sitting behind a shrouded table. Movement above the tablecloth embroidered with silvery thread, depicting runes and sigils from various disciplines, comes from a pair of hands shuffling a deck of oversized cards.

这里几乎闻不到大多数肉铺里那股令人作呕的腥臊味，苍蝇也寥寥无几。他们的营生想必打理得相当干净。门前立着一块木牌，上面用颇为讲究的方式陈列着今日供应的牲畜断头：一只鸡、一只鹅、一只鸭、一头猪、一只羔羊，还有一颗小得可怜的脑袋——想来必是只鸽子。
The rank smell that wafts from most butcher shops is less apparent here, and there are few flies. They must run a fairly clean operation. A board out front shows the animals on offer today with an artful arrangement of severed heads: a chicken, a goose, a duck, a pig, a lamb, and the tiny head of what must be a pigeon.

Aarakocra Alchemist's Welcome.name:
阿拉科克拉炼金术师的欢迎词
Aarakocra Alchemist's Welcome

Text.text:
“哎呀，近来可好？欢迎光临我这间寒舍小店，勇敢的冒险者们！我这儿有一大堆新奇的调配品等你们尝尝。看看有没有哪样合你们心意。”炼金术士笑着，抖了抖羽毛，随即递上一只小瓶，里头是闪着微光的湛蓝液体。“这可是我最喜欢的之一：你需要什么，它就给什么——骨头冷了就暖进去，额头热了就凉下来！泡进茉莉花茶里也妙得很。要不要来一杯？”#REF!
“Well, how do you do? Welcome to my humble store, brave adventurers! I got lotsa nifty concoctions for you to try. See if any take your fancy.” The alchemist smiles, ruffling their feathers before offering up a phial of shimmering blue liquid. “This here is one of my personal favorites: It warms cold bones and cools hot brows depending on what you need at the time! It’s also wonderful in jasmine tea. Would you like a cup?”#REF!

你感知到那生物的痛苦——有股卑劣的魔法在折磨它。你推断那是一道诅咒，怀着恶意施下。你伸出意念，去解开诅咒的丝线，用心神将其抽拨。起初它们顽强抗拒，但你谨慎而精准地推进，最终只需猛地一扯，便将诅咒的织纹彻底拆散，把它从受害者身上硬生生拽出。
You sense the creature’s suffering—the vile magic plaguing it. A curse, you surmise, cast with ill intent. You reach out to untangle the threads of the curse, pulling at them with your mind. They resist at first, but you move carefully and precisely, then with a single tug you unravel the curse’s weave and yank it from the afflicted.

此地无日可照。唯一的光源自地表本身——一层漫散的、似余烬般的微光，仿佛在暗示这个位面那黑暗扭结的核心深处，正有熔融的中心在翻涌。令人不适的热浪从龟裂的土地里蒸腾而起，风里却裹挟着超凡的寒意。硫磺般刺鼻的酸臭浓重地悬在空气中，铁链的叮当作响无处不在。这个位面的每一处细节——从阴沉压顶的黑天到焦土荒原那不可能的地形——都让人本能地感到错位而悖谬。

~ 由 Grant 构想

No sun shines here. The only light emanates from the ground itself—a diffused, ember-like glow that seems to suggest a molten center to this plane’s dark and gnarled heart. An uncomfortable heat rises from the cracked earth, while the wind carries an otherworldly chill. A sulfuric, acrid odor hangs thick on the air, and the rattle of chains is omnipresent. Every facet of this plane, from its dark and looming skies to the impossible geography of its blasted landscape, feels inherently wrong.

~ Envisioned by Grant

Taproom And Gambling Hall Of Boat.name:
船上酒馆与赌厅
Taproom And Gambling Hall Of Boat

Text.text:
飞船恢宏的外观不过是内里景象的一点前菜。轻快而利落的乐声将你引入其中。高耸的穹顶由彩绘玻璃铺陈，悬着一盏巨大的水晶枝形吊灯，周身缭绕着芬芳的烟斗烟雾。阳台环抱整个空间，散落着一张张小而隐蔽的桌子，成对的生物俯身贴近，低声私语。长阶向下延伸，三排层层堆叠的酒桶俯瞰着一座放浪的赌厅。侍者在人群间穿梭，托盘上满载各式饮品与来自世界各地的精致佳肴。客人们在覆着毛毡的桌面上掷骰、发牌，也把嘲讽与骂声一并甩了出去。
The ship's grand exterior offers only a taste of what lies within. Music, jaunty but crisp, lures you in. A high, domed ceiling of stained glass houses a massive crystal chandelier shrouded in fragrant pipe smoke. A balcony encircles the space, littered with small, secluded tables where pairs of creatures lean in for private conversation. A long stairway leads below, where three rows of stacked kegs overlook a bawdy gambling hall. Servers wind their way through the crowd, carrying trays laden with drinks of all varieties and fine delicacies from across the world. The patrons sling dice, cards, and insults across felt-lined tables.

Geomancer Fungus Of The Plains.name:
平原地卜菌
Geomancer Fungus Of The Plains

Text.text:
菌类类人生物那顶像毒蘑菇般的头颅随着他们挪动脚下泥土而上下轻晃，双手划出繁复而精准的手势，召来泥浆与碎石——一条青绿的蛇盘在他们臂上，频频吐信，嗅着空气中的气味。类人身着蓝色工装连体服，磨旧不堪，满是泥渍，背后一袭斗篷在风中猎猎翻飞。蔚蓝的眼眸里点燃着古老的智慧，嘴角却只微微一勾，带着含蓄的笑意。

~ 由一位英雄扮演

The toadstool-esque head of the fungal humanoid bobs as they shift the earth around them, waving their hands in intricate gestures to conjure mud and stone—a green serpent coiled about their arm smelling the air with rapid flicks of its tongue. The humanoid wears blue coveralls, well-worn and stained with dirt, while a cape flutters at their back. An ancient wisdom lights their azure eyes, and a subtle smile tugs at the corners of their mouth.

~ Played by a Hero

巨大的棍棒握柄缠绕着一圈圈皮革条，棒身被打磨抛光，以免木刺飞溅。握柄末端还烙上了一枚德鲁伊符印，嵌着石英粉末，微微闪烁。如此精湛的工艺，干净利落地打消了一个尴尬的可能——它的主人只不过是把一截树干当作私人的武器到处扛着。
The enormous club’s grip has been wrapped with strips of leather, its body sanded and polished to prevent splintering. And a Druidic sigil has been burned into the end of the grip, sparkling with quartz powder. This impressive workmanship neatly eliminates the possibility that its wielder might simply carry around a tree trunk as their personal arms.

I Take Cover In A Forest.name:
我在森林中寻找掩蔽
I Take Cover In A Forest

Text.text:
我猛地撞上树干，惊起一群鸟儿乱作一团。羽毛与树叶簌簌落在我身旁，它们扑腾着冲上林冠之上。敌人的投射物贴着我的脸呼啸掠过，叮叮当当地钉进我掩蔽外不远的树干。我抽出武器，咬紧牙关稳住心神，等这阵乱雨一停，便准备在下一回合转身迎击来犯者。
I throw myself against a tree trunk, sending a flock of birds into a fluttering fit. Feathers and leaves fall about me as they scramble and fly above the canopy. I feel the rush of the enemy’s projectiles whizz past my face, landing onto trunks just beyond my cover. I take out my weapon and steel my nerves, ready to turn out and face the attackers once the flurry subsides.

Drunk Bartender.name:
醉醺醺的酒保
Drunk Bartender

Text.text:
酒保因为偷尝自家酒水而面红耳热、脚步虚浮；他端着酒，竭力绷紧精神，才勉强不把那座杯子金字塔撞得东倒西歪，好把饮料送到寥寥无几仍留在店里的客人手中。
Flushed and sloppy from sampling his own wares, the bartender has to concentrate deeply just to avoid knocking over the pyramid of mugs as he strains to deliver drinks to what customers remain.

Tavern In Hell.name:
地狱酒馆
Tavern In Hell

Text.text:
就地狱里的酒馆而言，这地方竟算得上整洁利落、打理得体。装潢杂糅而张扬：暗紫色的石材、樱木与乌木色的木料、覆着碳黑的铁件——偏偏对倒钩与骇人的战利品过分执着——再配上各式软垫皮座。烤肉、深焙咖啡与烈酒的气味几乎掩住了硫磺与无名秽物的丝丝臭息。客人同样“杂糅”二字最贴切：带翼的恶魔与诸般怪物在此饮酒、饕餮、起舞；形形色色的人形生物也加入狂欢，只是那些更不走运的家伙，往往成了邪恶取乐的玩物。

~ 由 Kingsler34 构想

For a joint in Hell, this place is tidy and well maintained. The eclectic décor includes dark-violet stone, cherry- and ebony-colored wood, carbon-coated iron—with an overemphasis on barbed hooks and gruesome trophies—and various seats of padded leather. The smell of cooked meat, dark coffee, and strong alcohol almost hides whiffs of brimstone and nameless filth. Eclectic is the word for the clientele, too. Winged fiends and other monsters drink, feast, and dance. A variety of humanoids join in the merriment, although the less fortunate provide wicked amusements.

~ Envisioned by Kingsler34

River Delta In Fog.name:
雾锁河口三角洲
River Delta In Fog

Text.text:
浓雾密布，遮蔽了大地，树影与河岸仿佛被淡绿与灰色的笔触涂抹成一幅褪色画卷。雾气里的空气清冷而凝滞，却始终浸透着流水不息的低语——河水在此分流又回旋，织成一座座林木小岛，岸沿如鳞片般层叠起伏。鸽群哀婉的啼鸣在这份不确定的寂静里显得格外诡异。
A dense fog obscures the landscape, the trees and riverbanks rendered in faded brushstrokes of green and gray. The misty air is cool and still but suffused with the constant murmur of running water where the river splits and bends to form islands of trees with shingled shores. The plaintive cries of doves are eerie in the uncertain calm.

A Dagger Is Thrown.name:
匕首掷出
A Dagger Is Thrown

Text.text:
匕首翻滚着破空飞去，凄厉的尖啸充斥空气，速度快得肉眼几乎追不上。带着一种阴沉的终局感，它“噗嗤”一声湿响钉入目标，刀柄微微一颤，随即静止不动。

~ Casey Boyd 构想

A keening whine fills the air as the dagger flies, end over end, moving faster than the eye can follow. With a grim sense of finality, it hits the target with a wet thud, the hilt juddering slightly as it comes to a rest.

~ Envisioned by Casey Boyd

Half-sunk Boat In Swamp.name:
沼泽中半沉的船
Half-sunk Boat In Swamp

Text.text:
一艘小划艇板条碎裂，半沉在沼泽的黏液与污秽之中。腐蚀性的水贪婪地拍打着船身，而淤泥在岁月流逝间一点点将它拖得更深——那咸涩的巨口吞噬着最后的痕迹：一个迷途的傻瓜把船划得太远，闯入沼泽阴影深处后留下的残余。
A rowboat, its planks splintered, lies half-submerged in the slime and the filth of the fens. Caustic water laps hungrily at the wood while the mud pulls it deeper with each passing year—a brackish maw devouring the last vestige of a wayward fool who rowed too far into the shadows of the fens.

Major Trade Road Through Arctic Tundra.name:
穿越北极苔原的主要商道
Major Trade Road Through Arctic Tundra

Text.text:
风掠过这片荒芜的大地，流动的积雪吞没了一切路痕；于是这片死寂之地的商队与旅人便堆起石堆作路标。你正走在通往下一个路标的半途，脚下一绊，撞上了一小堆乱石，踢得雪沫四散。看起来，旅人们惯例会往石堆上添几块石头，让它们长成新的路标。
Wind across this barren landscape buries any pathway with shifting snow, so the merchants and other travelers of this desolate land have piled up stones as way markers. You’re halfway to the next marker when you stumble over a small pile of rocks, kicking off the snow. It looks like it's customary for travelers to add stones to piles and make new markers.

那把骇人的巨弩稳稳嵌在一堵低矮的沙袋墙后。木制弩身以发黑的钢条加固，弓臂与支撑杆绷得死紧，压抑的暴烈仿佛随时要迸出——急不可耐地要将怀中紧扣的沉重铁矢猛然射出。它吱呀作响，像是活物般喘息；扭力弹簧焦躁不安，躁动难耐。绞盘昂然矗立，微微颤抖，蓄着未发的劲道，只等主人之手来解放。
The monstrous crossbow sits ensconced behind a low wall of sandbags. Its wooden frame is reinforced with darkened steel, and its arms and struts are taut with suppressed violence, eager to launch the heavy iron bolt held within its tight embrace. The thing creaks as if alive, the torsion springs impatient, restless. Standing proud, the winch quivers with suppressed energy, waiting for its master's hand.

你的舌头在嘴里显得过于肿胀。每次试着吞咽，都被喉咙里胀痛的灼痒提醒着。尖锐的痛楚像刀子般刺穿你的头骨。只要你一动脑袋，阵阵搏动便让视野在眩晕的旋涡中天旋地转。透过一团昏沉的倦怠，你终于意识到自己必须喝点水——而且得马上。
Your tongue feels too big for your mouth. Each attempt to swallow reminds you of the swollen ache in your throat. Sharp pains knife through your skull. Whenever you move your head, a throb sends your vision spinning in a whirlwind of vertigo. Through a cloud of lethargy, you determine that you need to drink some water—and soon.

你显得出奇地随意，摆弄着一把勺子和几块石片，低声吟诵不过短短一分钟；小小的仪式在你优雅地摊开双手时戛然而止。凭空之间，一座宏伟的建筑赫然出现在你面前——奢华的宅邸，足以匹配一位强大领主的尊荣；其美感与结构分毫不差，正如你想象中所构筑的一切。
You seem strangely casual, fiddling with a spoon and some stone pieces and a minute’s worth of recitation, your small ritual abruptly ending with a graceful spreading of your hands. From out of nowhere a massive building appears just in front of you, a rich abode worthy of a powerful lord, the beauty and construction of the dwelling exactly as your imagination conceived.

Haggling With A Tavernkeeper.name:
与酒馆老板讨价还价
Haggling With A Tavernkeeper

Text.text:
“善良的先生，我光顾过许多店家，却从未见过如此迷人的乐土，满是欢愉与舒适。毫无疑问，我会把您这般圣洁的款待传得人尽皆知……只要您肯在账单上少收几枚钱币。”
“My good sir, I have frequented many establishments, and I have never come across such a charming venue of joy and comfort. Surely, I will speak far and wide of your saintly hospitality… if only you would knock a few coins off the bill.”

Dragons Locked In Mortal Combat.name:
巨龙在殊死搏杀中纠缠厮杀
Dragons Locked In Mortal Combat

Text.text:
宛如传说中的一幕，两条巨龙在高空彼此盘旋，缤纷鳞甲化作炫目的旋风。兽性的咆哮撼动苍穹，它们猛然撞上，利爪与獠牙互相撕凿，巨大的龙血喷泉倾泻而下，化作血雨洒落大地。战局喧嚣之中，银辉火矛与剧毒气云交锋，巨龙倾尽最凶狠的杀招——以可怕的价格为代价。它们如坠落的群山般直坠地面，携着撼地碎天之势从天而落——可谁也不肯承认败北。

~ Envisioned by Gibler

Like a scene from legend, the dragons circle each other in the skies above, a dazzling whirlwind of colorful scales. Bestial roars shake the heavens as they clash, gouging into each other with claw and fang as great fountains of draconic blood rain down on the land below. Amid the tumult of combat, lances of argent fire battle with noxious plumes of gas as the dragons unleash their most potent attacks—at a terrible price. Plummeting to the ground like falling mountains, the duelists fall from the sky with earth-shattering force—but neither is willing to admit defeat yet.

~ Envisioned by Gibler

一只土元素石像鬼用紧绷的翅膀艰难地扑腾着，勉强悬在齐膝高度，在你身旁踉跄盘旋。它身上厚薄不均地覆着尘土与污垢，这生物看起来更像一座失败的雕塑，而不像活物。它花了一分钟才消化你的存在，随后便下沉，结结实实地落在它偏爱的地形上，发出一声尖啸，仿佛土拨鼠求偶的叫声。它那玩偶般的脑袋上，覆土裂开一道细缝，像是在盘算下一步的移动。

[Fight] 这只小恶魔突然鼓胀起来，腹部随着吸气而撑起——准备在下一瞬喷出令人眩晕的爆裂冲击。

[Hide] 这只小恶魔骤然停止一切移动，屏住呼吸，显然希望你把它当成一尊毫无价值的石像。

A gargoyle of elemental earth struggles to fly on strained wings, barely remaining above knee height as it flounders around you. Unevenly coated in layers of dust and grime, this creature looks more like a failed sculpture than a living thing. After a minute of processing your presence, the creature descends and lands solidly on its favored terrain, unleashing a shriek like a groundhog's mating call. A crack appears in the dirt coating its doll-like head as it thinks about its next move.

[Fight] The mephit swells suddenly, its stomach distending as it draws in air—ready to release it in a sudden stunning blast.

[Hide] The mephit suddenly stops all movement, holding its breath, presumably hoping you mistake it for a statue of no material value.

Loot From A Troglodyte.name:
穴居蜥蜴人的战利品
Loot From A Troglodyte

Text.text:
在穴居人的恶臭窝棚里，你在那粪污涂抹的墙壁间几乎找不到任何值钱的东西。然而，角落里却躺着一只背包，侧面被狂乱地撕开，里面那点可怜的家当被随手抛散在地——只因它的携带者成了那顿不幸的口粮。你找回一个小袋子，里面有10枚银币，以及一个指南针。
In the troglodyte’s stinking hovel, you find little of value within the dung-smeared walls. A pack lies in the corner, however, its side torn open in a frenzy and its meager contents cast aside in favor of the unfortunate meal who was carrying it. You recover a small pouch of 10 silver pieces and a compass.

I Scout From A Treetop.name:
我从树梢侦察
I Scout From A Treetop

Text.text:
我像抱住一位老友般紧紧拥着这棵树，一条手臂搭在纤细的树干上，双脚在最顶端的枝杈间稳稳踩住以保持平衡。我腾出一只手，既用来稳住身形，也用来在这般高度遮挡刺眼的阳光。眼前的景色一路铺展开去，仿佛一张活生生的动态地图，将我们周遭的一切尽收眼底。
I hug the tree close like an old friend, one arm slung around the thin trunk as I balance my feet within its topmost branches. I keep one hand free to balance and also to block the harsh light from the sun at this height. The landscape stretches out before me, a veritable animated map of our surroundings.

雾气中走出一名兜帽身影，眼眸泛着幽焰般的微光。强盗头目从瑟缩的精灵身旁转过身，冷笑道：“滚开，陌生人，这不关你的事！”他朝自己的伙伴一摆手，他们逼近上前，刀刃蓄势待发。来者轻轻一掀斗篷，同时抽出一把造型诡异的手弩。时代仿佛凝滞。陌生人开始吟唱，幽魂般的丝缕在他骤然跃动的身形周围凝聚。最近的强盗轰然倒下，一支弩矢在她胸口炸裂贯出。外来者在疯狂劈砍的匪徒之间踏步旋舞，猛然探出一只手，声音攀至高峰，诡秘能量自指尖喷涌。袭击者扭身欲避，躯体却被撕开，痛苦中惨死。仍被无形的幻影缠绕着，那名咒弩手冷静装填，举起武器，漫不经心地一箭将张口欲吼的强盗头目射穿心口。

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

From the mist strides a cowled figure, their eyes a lambent glow. The bandit leader turns from a cowering elf and sneers. “Walk away stranger, this ain't your fight!” He gestures to his companions, who move forward, blades ready. The newcomer flicks aside their cloak while simultaneously drawing an esoteric-looking handbow. Time seems to stop. The stranger begins to sing and ghostlike tendrils coalesce about their suddenly moving form. The nearest bandit collapses, a crossbow bolt exploding through her chest. Dancing around desperately slashing brigands, the outsider thrusts out a hand, voice a crescendo, eldritch energies erupting from their fingers. Attackers twist away, bodies torn open, dying in agony. Still wreathed in intangible phantoms, the spellbow calmly reloads, raises their weapon, and nonchalantly shoots the gaping bandit leader through the heart.

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

Cave With Small Creatures.name:
栖息着小型生物的洞窟
Cave With Small Creatures

Text.text:
嘶嘶的低语在这座潮湿洞窟的阴影里游走，细长的音节像蛇信般吐出。声音大多从膝盖高的地方传来，尖细而刺耳。不管那是什么，它们不想被看见——至少现在还不想。但你听得一清二楚，这说明它们并非因恐惧而躲藏。
Hissing voices whisper sibilant syllables in the shadows of this damp cave. The speech comes mostly from knee height, its pitch high. Whatever they are, they don’t want to be seen—at least not yet. But since you can clearly hear them, it seems they are not hiding out of fear.

尽管他指节因反复敲击鞣制过的皮革而青紫，掌心也因长期接触用于鞣制的防腐药剂而粗糙，这位精灵鞋匠的双手在精打细算的动作里仍保有一份优雅。就在你眨两次眼的工夫，他从唇间叼下了一枚钉子，分毫不差地立在鞋底上，随即以近乎苛刻的精准将它一锤钉牢。见你走近，他把剩下的鞋钉哗啦一声倒进皮围裙的口袋里，朝你露出一个欢迎的笑容；半月形眼镜下，他的眼神轻快跳动。
Despite the bruising on his knuckles from rapping them against tanned hides and the roughness of his palms from handling preserving chemicals for curing, the elf cobbler’s hands still retain their grace in their economical motion. In the time it takes you to blink twice, a nail is taken from between his lips, set perfectly in the sole, and hammered home with exquisite precision. As he sees you approach, he dumps the remaining hobnails into a pocket of his leather apron and favors you with a welcoming smile, his eyes dancing under his half-moon spectacles.

Deaf Pianist.name:
失聪的钢琴家
Deaf Pianist

Text.text:
这件乐器力量的明证在于：当那位失聪的钢琴家演奏时，没人察觉他们听不见。键盘前只有一名音乐家，身着正式的黑色礼服，脚踏体面的好鞋。钢琴家盯着某些指法片刻，随即抬眼望向观众，神情自信而沉思。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The evidence of the instrument’s power is that when the deaf pianist plays, no one knows they cannot hear it. There is only a musician at the keyboard, dressed in formal black and good shoes. The pianist looks at certain fingerings and then up at the audience with a confident and contemplative air.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Police Force Cruiser Pulls Over A Speedi.name:
警用巡逻车逼停一辆超速疾驰的汽车
Police Force Cruiser Pulls Over A Speeding Car

Text.text:
一辆流线型巡逻车贴着疾驰的汽车悄然逼近，警灯闪烁，四周目光尽数被牵引而来。刺耳的金属合成嗓音随即响起，命令司机靠边停车。司机没有闹出任何风波，顺从照办；巡逻车的车门向上滑开。一名身披防弹背心、护目镜泛着幽光的警官走近超速车辆，抬手敲了敲车窗。
An aerodynamic cruiser glides up behind the speeding car, its flashing lights garnering attention from all around. A grating metallic voice rings out, ordering the driver to pull over. The driver complies without incident, and the police cruiser door slides upward. An officer clad in a flak jacket and glowing visor approaches the speeding car and knocks on the window.

Stone Of Good Luck (Luckstone).name:
好运石（幸运石）
Stone Of Good Luck (Luckstone)

Text.text:
这块古怪的石头被雕成一头野兽的模样，用多面切割、泛着乳白虹彩的眼睛凝视着你。护符握在手里分量恰好，令人心生踏实；一旦攥紧，便有一股奇异的自信涌上心头。
Carved to resemble a wild beast, this curious stone peers at you through faceted, opalescent eyes. The charm has a pleasing weight to it, and, when held, fills you with a strange sense of confidence.

Monk Quip About Metaphor.name:
僧侣对隐喻的俏皮话
Monk Quip About Metaphor

Text.text:
“就像我把水织在你的攻势周围，再用我的拳头把你砸得七荤八素……像海浪……在水里。听着，我受的是格斗训练，不是修辞课。”
“Like the water I have weaved around your strikes and then battered you with my fists… like waves… in the water. Look, I was trained in combat not metaphor.”

Tournament Royal Pavilion Of Scarlet Sil.name:
绯红绸缎皇家竞技亭
Tournament Royal Pavilion Of Scarlet Silk

Text.text:
一圈全副披甲的士兵将那座猩红丝绸铺就的宏阔华帐围得水泄不通。帐内，战士女王端坐受朝，举起镶宝的高脚杯，向跪伏在她脚边的骑士祝酒。侍女们在她身旁轻盈穿梭，她却不耐地挥手将她们赶开，显然厌烦她们的殷勤摆弄。帐篷内悬挂着一幅幅描绘王国往昔胜利的挂毯，脚下铺陈着异域华毯——皆是从遥远国度夺来的战利品。
A perimeter of heavily armored soldiers surrounds the voluminous pavilion of scarlet silk. Within, the warrior queen holds court, lifting a jeweled goblet to toast the knight kneeling at her feet. Ladies-in-waiting flit about her, but she waves them away, clearly displeased by their fussing. The tent is hung with tapestries depicting the realm's past victories, and upon the ground lie exotic carpets—trophies from faraway lands.

Elven Vale: Elven Flautist.name:
精灵谷：精灵长笛手
Elven Vale: Elven Flautist

Text.text:
一声低吟般的呢喃穿过林间，颤抖着绵延成一曲强烈却难以言喻的情绪。某处，有人在吹奏长笛；笛声在树下回荡，仿佛峡谷里层层叠叠的回声与人声。
A moaning, whispering note calls out through the forest, warbling into a song of intense but mysterious emotion. Somewhere, someone plays the flute, and its music echoes under the trees like voices in a canyon.

Flames Rocket Out Of Nearby Manhole.name:
附近的下水道井盖猛然喷射出火焰
Flames Rocket Out Of Nearby Manhole

Text.text:
火焰从附近的窨井里轰然爆裂，宛如暴怒巨龙喷出的灼息，吓得行人魂飞魄散，车流也为躲避这场喷发而猛然急转、剧烈偏航。沉重的铁制掩蔽被像纸盘般掀飞，伴着碎玻璃与金属的暴雨砸落，生生碾碎了旁边一辆街头小吃推车。
Flames explode out of the nearby manhole like the breath of an irate dragon, terrifying nearby pedestrians and causing traffic to swerve violently to avoid the eruption. The solid iron cover is tossed aside like a paper plate, crushing a nearby street food cart in a hail of broken glass and metal.

雨起初只是细细的毛毛雨，像一层薄雾，用冰冷的雨点润湿你的衣物与裸露的肌肤。很快它愈发猛烈，厚重的雨幕砸在石板路上噼啪作响；黑暗渐深，寒意逼人的雾气缠绕着你的脚踝。
The rain is a light drizzle at first, a mist that dews your garments and exposed skin with frigid drops. It intensifies, pummeling the cobbled streets with heavy sheets, and a chilling mist coils about your feet as the darkness deepens.

Kindly Mom-and-pop Storekeeper.name:
亲切的夫妻小店掌柜
Kindly Mom-and-pop Storekeeper

Text.text:
灰金色蓬松的发云在一张慈祥的脸庞两侧炸开，笑纹与鱼尾纹将那份温和刻得更深。她身穿灯芯绒衬衫、系着格子围裙，这位上了年纪的妇人忙前忙后，朝熟客高声招呼，在一阵阵爽朗的大笑间抽空回答问题。她的双手糊满食物，指尖还带着些微焦痕。
Ash-blond puffy clouds of hair burst on either side of a kindly face, creased with smile lines and crow’s feet. Wearing a corduroy shirt and a gingham apron, this elderly woman bustles to and fro, shouting greetings to the regulars and taking questions between loud peals of laughter. Her hands are caked with food and slightly singed.

Orchard Of Unfamiliar Fruit Trees.name:
陌果林
Orchard Of Unfamiliar Fruit Trees

Text.text:
这枚古怪的球茎状果实与你所见过的任何东西都截然不同。果肉浆质半透明，纤维般的网状脉络在果实内部交错纵横，织出令人目眩神迷的纹路。果园里，一排又一排怪异的果树伫立着，每一株都沉甸甸地挂满了更多这份离奇的异界馈赠。
The strange, bulbous fruit is unlike anything you have seen before. The pulpy flesh is translucent with veins of fibrous webbing crisscrossing the fruit’s interior in mesmerizing patterns. Rows upon rows of the strange fruit trees stand in the orchard, each one laden with more of the curious alien bounty.

Sun-scorched Wasteland.name:
烈日灼烧的荒原
Sun-scorched Wasteland

Text.text:
这片干旱的土地仿佛正以你的痛苦为乐，让你本就艰难的跋涉雪上加霜。烈日以无情的窒闷酷热炙烤着你龟裂的皮肤；猩红的大地上，唯有枯败的藤蔓零星横亘，其上尖刺如参差獠牙，静候刺穿你焦黑的脚底。
Seeming to relish your torment, the arid land compounds your arduous journey. The sun bakes your cracked skin with relentlessly oppressive heat, and all that breaks up the red ground are ragged vines with thorns like jagged fangs, waiting to puncture your blackened soles.

Children’s Rhyme About Petty Royalty.name:
关于小气王族的童谣
Children’s Rhyme About Petty Royalty

Text.text:
她立在梳妆镜前，刁蛮的小公主叹了口气。
“我的裙子是粉的，瞧着太寡淡！”于是她的裁缝——
把裙子染成皇家蓝；为此公主说道：
“你的蓝染料把浴桶都染脏了，现在我也要染脏你的床单——”
“派对准备好了？”王后前来问询。
公主只阴沉着脸瞪她，把她推进了——
“把所有面包师都开除！”他们听见国王咆哮。
面包硬得离谱，弯了他的刀，还捅进了他的——
“立刻处理！”君主对一位领主下令。
贵族听得够多了，吞下了自己的——
城堡回廊里满是龌龊流言，
我宁可睡在墙外，也不想睡在城堡里面！

Standing at her looking glass, the petty princess sighs.
"My dress is pink, I find it drab!" And now her tailor—
Dyes her dress a royal blue; for this the princess said:
"Your blue dye stained the tub and now I’ll stain your bedclothes—"
“Ready for the party?” The queen came to inquire.
The princess only scowled at her and shoved her in the—
“Fire all the bakers!” they heard the king demand.
The bread was hard, it bent his knife and stabbed him in the—
“Handle this at once!” declared the monarch to a lord.
The noble had heard quite enough and swallowed his own—
Sordid are the rumors that fill the castle halls,
I think I’d rather sleep outside than inside castle walls!

Arcane Mezzoloth.name:
奥术梅佐洛斯
Arcane Mezzoloth

Text.text:
一副半月形眼镜搁在那只怪异、双足豺狼的吻端。它身披华美的深靛色天鹅绒长袍，金边滚饰熠熠生辉；那双眼以探究而好奇的智慧凝视着你——仿佛在衡量你的价值。它肩上斜挎着一只朴素的皮袋，里面塞着一摞摞边缘磨损的泛黄卷轴，以银线缚起；当它以令人惊诧的雄辩开口时，一抹凶险的笑意悄然爬上那张狞笑的面孔。

~ Envisioned by MadCar

A pair of half-moon spectacles rests on the snout of the strange, bipedal jackal. Dressed in sumptuous velvet robes of deep indigo trimmed with gold, the being regards you with a probing, curious intelligence—as if assessing your value. A simple leather bag slung over its shoulder holds an assortment of fraying yellow scrolls bound in silver thread, and a menacing smile creeps across its leering face as it addresses you with startling eloquence.

~ Envisioned by MadCar

熔岩般的纹路沿着这柄华丽长枪的枪杆蜿蜒流淌，仿佛它是从大地熔融的核心中锻造而成。武器的形制浑然一体，枪杆与枪头之间毫无接缝，宛如一整块被烈焰抚过、雕琢成形的岩石。
Seams of lava run through the haft of this magnificent pike, as if it had been wrought from the molten core of the earth. The weapon’s form is solid, with no separation between haft and head. It is like one large piece of sculpted, flame-touched rock.

一道由粗壮原木搭成的结实桥梁横跨裂缝，将原本被熔岩河撕开的墓园小径重新连成一线。空气里飘着柴火烟的气味，让你心里微微发紧，但这些原木足够粗大；作为仓促拼凑的权宜之计，它看起来还算管用。
A stout bridge of logs has been constructed across the crevasse, reconnecting a path through the cemetery that was split by the lava river. The smell of woodsmoke makes you a little nervous, but the logs are thick and for a hasty solution is seems to work well enough.

Testimony Of Priest Of The Sun God Of Ju.name:
正义太阳神祭司的证词
Testimony Of Priest Of The Sun God Of Justice

Text.text:
“在一些人眼里，我们主人的试炼或许不近人情——甚至残酷。但若非我亲身走过，我绝不会要求你们去做。 我曾直面沙漠烈日无休止的灼烧；我曾尝到干渴最原始的啃噬，理智尖叫着要我回头。我的一生曾是没有方向的苦难，为卑微的凡俗利益日复一日地劳作。我在九者面前倒下，神志恍惚，半死不活。索拉斯向我显现，他燃烧的掌中托着一杯温茶，静静休息着。我贪婪地饮下，随后抬头望向立于我前的神明。没有眼睛回望——只有火焰。就在那一刻，在索拉斯面前，我被洗净旧日人生，重获新生，被送上正义之途。愿你们终有一日，也能踏上这条道路。”

~ 一位英雄构想

“To some, our lord’s trials may seem unreasonable—even cruel. But I would not ask you to perform such a task had I not done it myself. I have faced the relentless burn of the desert sun. I have felt the primal gnaw of thirst, my mind screaming at me to turn back. My life had been one of directionless misery, toiling away for petty, mortal gains. I collapsed before the nine, delirious and half dead. Solas showed himself to me, a simple cup of tea resting in his burning grasp. Greedily, I drank, before looking up at the god that stood before me. No eyes looked back—only flame. It was there, before Solas, that I was cleansed of my old life, born anew and sent along the path of righteousness. A path that I hope all of you may, one day, follow.”

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Tournament On A Beautiful Day.name:
美好日子的比武大会
Tournament On A Beautiful Day

Text.text:
银号吹响每一场比武的召唤，旗帜与繁花在轻拂的微风里织成一幅粼粼闪耀的画面。今日的冠军雍容威严，当之无愧，长枪上系着一位淑女的信物。日光与云影相映，明亮却不刺目；食物、香水、马匹与湖水的气息在庭院与赛场间缓缓飘散，贵族们与平民一同登上看台，尽情观赏骑士的盛会与技能的较量。
Silver trumpets sound the call to each tilt, and the banners and flowers create a shimmering tableau in the light breeze. The day’s champion is regal and well deserving, carrying a lady’s favor on his lance. The sun and clouds give light without glare, and the smells of food, perfumes, horses, and lake water drift across court and field as the nobles take the stands among commoners to enjoy the events of chivalry and skill.

Bardic Inspiration.name:
吟游诗人激励
Bardic Inspiration

Text.text:
友与敌在他面前交锋，矮人将框鼓紧紧抱在胸前，慌乱的心脏急切地寻找节拍。他深吸一口气，轻叩绷紧的生皮，单一的音符让他的思绪归于正中。他又试探着敲了几下，直至搅起一段炽烈的旋律，足以配得上这场拼杀。歌声点燃了附近伙伴的心，将决心烧得滚烫。
As friend and foe clash before him, the dwarf clutches his frame drum to his chest, his frantic heart searching for rhythm. He takes a deep breath and taps the taut rawhide, the single note centering his mind. He prods a few more times until he stirs up a fervid melody worthy of their struggle. The song sets nearby companions’ hearts aflame with determination.

I Become Charmed.name:
我陷入魅惑状态
I Become Charmed

Text.text:
我感觉鼻腔与喉咙深处渐渐泛起一阵诡异的刺痒，视野边缘变得柔软模糊，一股甜美到令人沉醉的欣快感将我彻底淹没。我松开紧咬的下颌，让双臂垂落在身侧，脸上绽开一个——宽得离谱——的笑容。这里没有什么可害怕的——这里只有朋友。
I feel a strange tingling build in my nose and throat as the corners of my vision soften and a feeling of blissful euphoria overcomes me. I unclench my jaw and let my arms fall to my sides, and a smile—acres wide—spreads across my face. There is nothing to fear here—there are only friends.

Quip About Betraying Party.name:
关于背叛队伍的俏皮话
Quip About Betraying Party

Text.text:
“我承认，我曾在某个时候背叛过我大多数的伙伴——但要是对你们下手，我肯定会良心不安。”
“I will admit, I have betrayed most of my companions at one point or another, but with all of you I will definitely feel bad about it.”

Dragon And Demon Locked In Combat.name:
巨龙与恶魔缠斗厮杀
Dragon And Demon Locked In Combat

Text.text:
传送门的边缘点缀着术士的工艺，世代雕琢而成。它扩张的视野里，浮现出一处恶魔位面，而在那漆黑的核心，一点金芒闪烁。随着传送门开启，那金点膨胀成带翼的轮廓，像硬币上压印的纹章。它旋即化作一条高贵的金龙——正是数百年前为守护这个位面而自我牺牲的那一位。它双翼尽展，利爪向前，与一头由焦油与浓烟凝成的恶魔厮杀。那污秽的怪物尖啸着，撞向这条英勇的巨龙——自远古以来，正是它将其死死压在门的那一侧。

~ 构想：D. G. Speirs

The portal’s edge is adorned with warlock artistry, crafted over generations. In its widening field appears a demonic plane, and in its black center, a speck of gold. The speck grows into a winged shape like the imprint on a coin as the portal opens. It turns into a noble gold dragon, the same one who had sacrificed themselves centuries ago to protect this plane. Their wings are out, talons forward, as they fight a demon of tar and smoke. The foul beast shrieks against the heroic dragon that has held it on that side of the gate since ages past.

~ Envisioned by D. G. Speirs

Quip About Thinking Through A Problem.name:
关于把问题想透的俏皮话
Quip About Thinking Through A Problem

Text.text:
“只要一次愉快的散步就能把你带到终点，就永远别急着下结论。”
“One should never jump to conclusions when a delightful walk will get you there just fine.”

Blandalf The Younger.name:
小布兰达夫
Blandalf The Younger

Text.text:
很难说，究竟是哪一样更容易攫住阳光的流辉：是你面前那位少年精灵的金发，还是他被日晒成蜜色的金黄肌肤。他穿着长裤与剪裁合身的衬衫，外罩一件黑色无尾礼服外套，目光不由自主便被它牵引——两条黄铜巨龙以细密丝线绣出，缠绕在丝质袖面上，仿佛随呼吸微微游动。一条蝎尾狮皮革腰带将低垂的枪套束在他纤细的胯侧，顶端探出一根魔杖，握柄弧度古怪，像某种不肯示人的爪钩。少年精灵摆出一副睁大眼的无辜神情，可当你听见他开口的那一刻，便立刻认出那套措辞——那是更为古老的存在才会使用的词汇。

~ Played by Shackleford

It is impossible to say which catches the sun’s rays more readily: the blonde locks of the adolescent elf standing before you, or his tanned, golden skin. Dressed in slacks and a tailored shirt, his black smoking jacket truly draws the eyes, as twin brass dragons, picked out in fine thread, twist around the silken sleeves. A manticore leather belt straps a low-slung holster across his slender hips; a wand with a curiously curved grip juts from the top. Though the young elf projects a look of wide-eyed innocence, the moment you hear him speak, you recognize the vocabulary as one that a far older being might employ.

~ Played by Shackleford

Greenhouse On The Grounds Of A Manor.name:
庄园庭院中的温室
Greenhouse On The Grounds Of A Manor

Text.text:
温室离庄园的露台只需走一小段路——那是一座由玻璃与钢铁构成的庞然巨物，内里植物的生命力几乎要冲破其间。踏入其中，暖湿的空气裹挟着泥土的气息，墙面在阳光下仿佛渗出细密的汗珠。上百种植物在此四季繁盛，有些是本地品种，有些则来自世界的另一端。它们被精心修剪，悉心照料。
The greenhouse stands a short walk from the manor's terrace—a massive structure of glass and steel, bursting from inside with plantlife. Inside, the air is warm and humid and tinged with loam, and the walls perspire with sunlight. A hundred varieties of plant, some local, others from the other side of the world, flourish here year round. They are carefully trimmed and cared for.

I Drink My Potion Of Animal Friendship.name:
我喝下我的动物友谊药水
I Drink My Potion Of Animal Friendship

Text.text:
容器里装着的，是孩子可能用泥土与清水胡乱捏出的东西；其中还夹着一抹像是玩耍时无意舀进来的意外之物——一小片动物的残屑，或许是羽毛、鳞片，或是一缕毛，紧贴在玻璃边缘。友谊的价格，就是我咽下的这口泥水，连同那块粗糙的小碎片，一起滑入喉咙。
In the container is something a child might assemble from earth and water, along with what looks like an accidental inclusion, scooped during play, of a little scrap of fauna—a bit of feather perhaps, or scale, or fur—up against the glass. The price of friendship is this mud I drink, carrying that little rough piece with it down my throat.

Busy Parking Enforcement Officer.name:
忙碌的停车执法员
Busy Parking Enforcement Officer

Text.text:
女警骑着悬浮滑板车沿人行道飞掠而过，明明是尖端科技，她却硬是骑出了十足的土气。她在一辆车前刹住，滑板车悬在半空轻轻起伏。她在嵌入袖口的数据板上敲下车牌号。附近一家店里传来愤怒的吼声。“喂！喂，我才在这儿不到一小时！喂！”女警迅速在徽章上点了两下，随即抓住车把，嗖地窜向下一辆违规停放的车。

她的制服外沿骤然缠起噼啪作响的电火花，头盔里响起自动播报。一道男性的机械声毫无起伏地宣告：“袭击停车执法人员将导致额外罚款。请保持距离，直至停车执法人员完成检查。”

The officer zooms along the sidewalk on her hoverscooter, managing to look as dorky as possible on a piece of cutting-edge tech. She stops in front of a car, the hoverscooter bobbing midair. She types down the license plate number on the datapad embedded into her sleeve. An angry shout comes out of a nearby business. “Hey! Hey, I’ve been here less than an hour! Hey!” The officer quickly taps on her badge before grabbing the scooter’s handle and zipping to the next ill-parked vehicle.

Her uniform becomes wreathed in electrical sparks and an automated message sounds out of her helmet. A male, robotic voice calls out monotonously: “Assaulting a parking enforcement officer will result in additional fines. Please keep your distance as the parking enforcement officer completes their inspection.”

Vampire's Manor: Coffin Sanctuary.name:
吸血鬼（特征）庄园：棺椁圣所
Vampire's Manor: Coffin Sanctuary

Text.text:
巨大的石棺统治着这片空旷的空间，体量远大到绝不可能只为容纳一具人类尸体。粗重的钢链封锁着棺椁——每一环都粗得如矮人的腿；其石面上刻蚀的诡异符文至今仍清晰可辨。四根石柱支撑着空间的高顶，每根柱上都嵌着一支未点燃的火把，插在锈蚀的铁制火把座里。你在房间里移动时，脚步搅起积了数百年的尘埃与碎屑，火把却骤然自行燃起，将阴森的血红光芒泼洒在整个房间。
The massive, stone sarcophagus dominates the cavernous space, much too large to contain a human corpse. Heavy steel chains, the diameter of a dwarf’s leg, seal the coffin—strange runes etched into its stone surface still discernible. Four pillars support the high ceiling of the space, each housing an unlit torch set into a rusted, iron sconce. As you move about the room, your feet disturbing centuries of dust and debris, the torches suddenly flare to life, casting an eerie, blood-red light across the room.

Sundries From A Green Slaad.name:
来自绿斯拉德的杂货
Sundries From A Green Slaad

Text.text:
蟾蜍的巢穴里散落着几支微型望远镜、几副眼镜，以及一副伸缩式护目镜——全都碎裂不堪。旁边堆着一组画在小羊毛袋上的靶子，每一个都被黏滑的唾液糊成一团，仿佛被长舌舔过。
The toad’s abode has several tiny spyglasses, pairs of spectacles, and one pair of telescopic goggles—all broken. With them is a group of targets painted on small woolen sacks. Each is clotted with slimy spittle, as from a tongue.

Wraith And Wight At Campfire.name:
篝火旁的缚灵与尸妖
Wraith And Wight At Campfire

Text.text:
冰冷阴郁的洞窟里，墙面被一抹诡异的色彩涂染：两名骇人的存在在一堆巨大的篝火旁休息。伴着如同受伤士兵临终吐息般的蛇嘶声，缚灵（特征）以意志压迫火焰，使其骤然迸裂成钴蓝之色，飞舞的火星直扑洞顶。枯槁双眼微微眯起，火堆另一侧的尸妖（特征）在寒冽空气中编织强横法术，漠然一笑——火焰却转而燃作鲜亮的翠绿，将跳动的碧影投向冰封的石壁。

~ Gostteam on Discord

A curious blend of color paints the walls of the icy, dismal cave as two ghastly beings rest beside a large bonfire. With a serpentine hiss like the final breath of a wounded soldier, the wraith exerts its will on the flames, causing them to erupt in a cobalt hue, sending dancing sparks to the cavern roof. Narrowing their withered eyes, the wight on the other side of the pyre weaves potent magics in the frigid air and smiles dispassionately as the flames instead burn a vibrant green, casting dancing veridian shadows across the frozen walls.

~ Gostteam on Discord

Mystic Reading Book.name:
神秘占读书
Mystic Reading Book

Text.text:
神秘学者将书高高举起，身着华丽的长袍，目光扫过字句，食指沿着竖排的行文缓缓下移。他以自身为灯照明——躯体满溢明亮的湛蓝火焰，双眼也燃着同样璀璨的蓝光。
Holding the book up, the sumptuously garbed mystic scans the text, his pointer finger moving down the vertical lines. He provides his own light to read by, as his body brims with bright blue flame, and his eyes glow this same brilliant blue.

Seduction Of A Dragon.name:
巨龙的诱惑
Seduction Of A Dragon

Text.text:
“我宁可被像你这般华美而强大的生物烧成灰烬，也不愿得到世上所有其他平凡而可怜的生物的爱。”
“I would rather be burnt to cinders by a creature as resplendent and powerful as you than be loved by every other plain and pitiable creature on this earth.”

Cult Of The Dark Blade.name:
暗刃邪教
Cult Of The Dark Blade

Text.text:
一大群人缓慢行进，汇聚在巍峨山壁的脚下。三道向下的斜劈在岩面上撕开一道嶙峋的裂口，仿佛某头巨兽的利爪将石头整齐贯穿。吟诵的人群鱼贯进入狭窄洞穴，摇摆的香炉将他们裹进一团团熏香的烟雾。气味令人想起滚烫的辛香、焦灼的木炭，以及渴盼雨水的干土。众人披着层层长袍，腰间以沉重的皮带束紧；每人都佩着一柄剑：剑柄为暗铁，剑刃弯曲如一枚修长的钩爪。

~ Vahlaron 构想

A host of people gathers in a slow march at the base of a mighty mountainside. Three downward slashes create a craggy opening into the rock, as if claws of a colossal beast had torn clean through the stone. The chanting host enters the narrow cave, their swinging censers surrounding them in a cloud of incense smoke. The scent recalls hot spice, scorched wood, and the dry earth longing for rain. The people are draped in layers of robes cinched at the waist with heavy leather belts, each bearing a sword: hilt of dark iron, blade curved like a long talon.

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

一条鞭影般的巨龙割裂云海与天穹，从三瓣裂开的巨口中尖啸着冲出。死亡的盘卷把世界的光一并绞断，它在半空回旋折返，伸展带翼的鳍膜，老练得像久经沙场的猎手。它的音波尖啸震耳欲聋，而从它口中倾泻的另一股喷吐同样骇人：毒雾弥漫，辛辣呛喉、烟尘滚滚，伴着嘶嘶作响与噼啪炸裂的异质化学反应。
A whiplike dragon cuts through cloud and sky, screeching out from a tripartite maw. The light is cut from the world in a coil of death that rolls back on itself, flexing winged fins with the practiced flight of a veteran hunter. Its sonic scream is deafening, but so too is the other emission pouring from its mouths: noxious gas, acrid and smoky, hissing and fizzling with alien chemistry.

Computer Repair Shop.name:
电脑维修店
Computer Repair Shop

Text.text:
小小的修理铺里，工作台上铺满了电路板、电线，以及更为玄奥的零件；烙铁炽白发亮、蓄势待发，坐在台前的身影已俯身投入作业。架子上塞满了电脑装备，多数都被主人反复修修补补，或干脆改装成了独一份的样子。顾客一踏进店门，便会触发一只芯片音色的门铃，叮当奏出一段朗朗上口的小调。
Circuit boards, wires, and more esoteric components cover the workbench in the small repair shop; the soldering iron is white hot and ready for action as the figure seated at the bench sets to work. Computer equipment fills the shelves, most having been heavily repaired or customized by the owners. Customers entering the store trigger a chip-tune doorbell playing a catchy jingle.

办公室的墙边排满书架，书籍、活页夹与账簿层层堆叠。蒙着蛛网的卷轴搁在架顶，你的鼻尖被那层积尘刺得发痒。桌上铺满记录数字与日期的纸页，忙得焦头烂额的公会司库正伏案其间：一名女侏儒，厚重眼镜后目光飘忽而遥远。她一写完一份文书，便立刻起身走向书架，把它塞进活页夹里，低声嘟囔：“空间乱，脑子也乱。”她的指尖染着墨色，心不在焉地咬着一片沾污的指甲，又顺手把嘴角抹得一片乌黑。
The office’s walls are lined with shelves of books, binders, and ledgers. Cobwebbed scrolls sit atop the shelves, and your nose itches from the layer of dust. A desk, bestrewed with papers logging numbers and dates, is occupied by the harried guild bursar: a female gnome with a far-off look behind thick spectacles. Once finished with a document, she immediately moves to a shelf and adds it to a binder, muttering under her breath, “cluttered space, cluttered mind.” Her fingers are pigmented with ink. She smudges the corner of her mouth as she absently chews on a besmirched nail.

你尚未看见高草中的尸体，灼热的霉菌恶臭便先一步扑面而来。野兽般的残虐撕咬将这倒霉的灵魂剁成一堆几乎辨认不出的烂肉，但在这片尸骸般的废墟里，你仍能辨出几处身份线索。一条手臂——肘部被齐齐斩断——上刻着环带状的符文刺青；而一枚染血的叶形别针钉住了被撕成碎片的羊毛斗篷残余。
The hot, fungal stench reaches you before you see the body in the tall grass. Wounds of bestial savagery have carved this unfortunate soul into a barely recognizable heap of flesh, but you can still make out a few identifying features in the charnel ruin. An arm—severed at the elbow—bears banded runic tattoos, and a bloody pin fashioned in the shape of a leaf secures the remains of a shredded woolen cloak.

你掌心里攥着的尘土与水滴，被突如其来的微风一卷，刹那升起，转瞬无影无踪。空气立刻冷了下来，随之而来的是裹着冰碴的凛冽寒风。区域内的地面迅速冻结，骤降的寒意让冰层噼啪作响。
The dust clutched in your hand, along with the droplets of water, rises with the sudden breeze and disappears in a flash. The air chills instantly, accompanied by a frigid, ice-laced wind. The ground freezes in the area, the ice crackling with the sudden coldsnap.

华丽的马车在头顶一块吱呀作响的木牌下缓缓停住，牌上写着 PICK UP。车夫——一位笑容灿烂的矮人——拉动身旁的拉杆，车门随即向两侧摆开，一道宽阔的机械坡道伴着金属般的咔哒声降下。马车内部与其体型全然不符地辽阔，空间足以容纳十余名乘客安心舒适地旅行，无论他们有何种身体需求都能从容安置。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，Forge Ahead: A Party To Access 制作

The ornate carriage pulls to a stop beneath a creaking wooden sign overhead that reads PICK UP. The driver—a beaming dwarf—pulls a lever at his side, causing the doors to swing open and a wide mechanical ramp to descend with a metallic click. The inside of the carriage is impossibly vast given its size and holds space for well over a dozen occupants to travel in safety and comfort no matter their physical needs.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

那披着斗篷的身影几乎与你迎面相撞，却并非真正奔跑，而是以急促的快步疾行，仿佛身负紧迫差事——或正逃离某个现场。你转头追随着他们掠过的轨迹，瞥见一张苍白消瘦的面孔上，嵌着一副奇异而雌雄难辨的五官。他们那双玻璃般空茫的眼睛眨了眨，你几乎要惊得下巴脱臼——当他们再度睁眼时，那目光竟与你的视线一模一样，如同镜中倒映！察觉到你的震骇，身影猛地一转，再次匆匆遁去。

~ Played by Chase Derringer

The cloaked figure that nearly collides with you does not precisely run, rather walking in double time as if they had some urgent errand—or a scene to flee. You turn your head to track their passage, and catch a glimpse of curiously androgynous features set in a pale, gaunt visage. They blink their glassy eyes, and you just manage to keep your jaw from dropping as their eyes reopen, now a mirror image of your own gaze! Sensing your shock, the figure turns and rushes off again.

~ Played by Chase Derringer

Dungeon Depths: Walking Into The Unknown.name:
地城深处：步入未知
Dungeon Depths: Walking Into The Unknown

Text.text:
你越是深入地城，就越觉得自己正一步步走进自己的坟墓。因为死亡确实在这些长廊间潜行。毕竟，是你把死亡带进了黑暗之中。正因如此，你才会携带武器，无论是魔法还是金属。你原本打算让这些隧道成为别人的葬身之地。若你死在这里，你的尸身也会像他们一样：被老鼠和蛆虫啃食——或更惨。
The deeper into the dungeon you delve, the more it feels like walking into your own grave. For surely Death stalks these halls. After all, you brought death with you into the dark. That’s why you carry weapons, be they magic or metal. You intended to make these tunnels someone else’s tomb. If you die here, your body will end up just like theirs: eaten by rats and worms—or worse.

City Split By Chasm.name:
被深渊裂谷一分为二的城市
City Split By Chasm

Text.text:
这座城市分立在一道巨大的裂谷两侧——大地本身被劈开的深痕。裂谷底部堆着成吨的瓦砾：多年前地面猝然张口，吞没了整座城——房屋与高塔的尸骸，尽数掩埋。可城市仍顽强延续，死死抓住生存不放；如今，人们用那些残存的石骨架起一座座桥梁横跨深渊，让城市此岸得以许可通往彼岸。
The city stands on two sides of a massive chasm, a cleft in the earth itself. Tons of rubble lies at the bottom of the chasm where the earth opened years ago to swallow the city—the corpses of homes and towers, buried. Yet the city persists, dogged in its survival, and now bridges constructed from those stone-remains span the chasm, allowing one side of the city to access the other.

施法者只吐出一个字，坚定而洪亮，随即一道雷霆炸响，震得天地俱颤，三百尺内四面八方皆能感到其余波。施法者消失无踪。在轰鸣渐息、近处众人尚未回过神之际——有些人再也没能站起——施法者又在毁灭中心之外相当远的地方现身，掸去尘土，转身离去。
The spellcaster speaks but one word, firm and resonant, and there is a clap of thunder that shakes the earth and sky, felt three hundred feet out in every direction. The caster is gone. During the fading of the boom and the recovery of those near it—some do not rise—the caster reappears a fair distance from the center of destruction, dusts off, and walks away.

I Cast Chain Lightning Using Components.name:
我施放连锁闪电，使用施法材料
I Cast Chain Lightning Using Components

Text.text:
细小的银针与一团琥珀球，被裹在一小片毛皮里——这是携带法术的古老方法。我把这小包托在掌心，对它低语，然后抬眼望向我的目标，完成咒语。每一枚针都在充能，力量节节攀升，最终化作一道道强劲的闪电霹雳，从我手中这套简朴器具里跃然迸发。
The tiny silver pins and ball of amber are wrapped in a small patch of fur—an old method for carrying a spell. Holding this little package in my palm, I speak to it, and then look up to my target and finish the incantation. Each pin charges and grows in might, each becoming a powerful bolt of lightning that jumps from this simple kit in my hand.

Sundries From A Gray Slaad.name:
灰色史莱德的杂货
Sundries From A Gray Slaad

Text.text:
你发现几堆分开的睡衫与睡帽、羊毛长袜以及毯子。它们上面覆着一层黏滑的胆汁，仿佛是被人呕吐出来的。
You find separate piles of nightshirts and nightcaps, wool stockings, and blankets. They are slick with bile, as if they have been vomited up.

Construct Knight Arrives To Battle.name:
构装骑士奔赴战场
Construct Knight Arrives To Battle

Text.text:
一个巍峨的身影大步穿过围城的烟霭，发光的长剑前指，钢包边的漂白木制熨斗盾稳稳端起，随时迎击。他身披一件破裂污渍的白色罩袍，以武器腰带束紧，罩在覆体的暗色甲片之上；甲片上刻蚀的符文在剑光里映出金灿的回辉。相似的甲片勾勒出他的面容，组成双眼的圆球迸射出金辉般的光芒。一只犬形构装体贴身随行，身覆与主人同样刻符的护甲，低伏小跑在他身侧。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

A towering figure strides through the siege smoke, his glowing longsword held forward, his heater shield of steel-rimmed bleached wood held ready. He wears a torn and stained white tabard, cinched with a weapon belt, over the dark plates covering his body, the runes etched in them reflecting gold in the light of the sword. Similar plates make up his face, and the orbs that form his eyes shine with aureate radiance. A canine construct, covered in runed armor like its master, lopes at his side.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Divine Lair Of A Dragon Goddess.name:
龙女神的神圣巢穴
Divine Lair Of A Dragon Goddess

Text.text:
灰白如大理石的山壁蜿蜒成墙，峥嵘锋利，威势逼人。正中央的门洞上悬着一张山羊皮，掀开便通往一座如大教堂般宏阔的巢室。巢室深藏在一处巨大的庇护洞穴里，由粗凿的原木搭成，地上铺着用无数匹织金布编成的巨毡。洞壁上插着一盏盏壁灯，每一盏都值一艘船的价格，燃着熏香，吐出幽低而温润的光。峭壁上凿开的窗洞俯瞰双生山湖：一池是熔岩，一池被坚冰堵塞封死。
The mountain face, grey and marbled, forms a curving wall of jagged majesty. At its center, a goat hide hangs in a doorway that leads into an aerie as large as a cathedral. Within a giant sheltering cave, the aerie is formed of rough-hewn logs and a mat woven from many bolts of cloth-of-gold. Sconces, each worth the price of a ship, burn incense and emit a low, glowing light. Windows cut into the cliff look out over twin mountain lakes: one of lava, one choked with ice.

一只双足迅猛龙以强健的双腿阔步行走，足端利爪森然。它身形修长精悍，光滑的羽毛覆在身上，极简的护甲之下护着柔软的腹部与灵活的颈项。它的爪中托着一枚紫色圆球，靛蓝光纹如波涛般荡漾。令人诧异的是，这样先进的存在却不见任何科技痕迹。取而代之的，是一层魔法灵光环绕着这生物，并从那双靛黄相间的眼眸中奔涌而出。
A bipedal raptor strides about on powerful legs that end in claws. The being’s long lean body is covered in sleek feathers beneath the minimalist armor protecting a soft underbody and flexible neck. In its claws nestles a purple orb, rippling with indigo light. Curiously, this advanced being bears no sign of technology. Instead, a magical aura surrounds the creature, surging through indigo-yellow eyes.

Sundries From A Silver Dragon Wyrmling.name:
银龙雏龙的杂物
Sundries From A Silver Dragon Wyrmling

Text.text:
死去的幼龙鳞片在游移的灰与蓝之间闪烁，胸口中央正滋生出一抹淡淡的黄锈。若将其皮剥下，可制成一件坚韧的鳞甲外衣，既夺目又实用。
The dead wyrmling’s scales gleam in shifting shades of gray and blue, with just a hint of yellow tarnish burgeoning at the center of its chest. Its hide might be shorn to create a resilient coat of scales both eye-catching and effective.

Goblin With A Bow.name:
持弓的地精
Goblin With A Bow

Text.text:
最先映入眼帘的，只有猩红的眼珠与咧开的、满是尖牙的狞笑小嘴——那只矮小的地精猛冲而来，在离你30英尺处骤然刹住。它发出一声刺耳的尖啸，令你分神片刻；等你猛然回过神，才发现它已娴熟地抽出一张摇摇欲坠的弓，搭上一支石尖箭，直指你的方向。那一连串老练的动作，与这把武器粗陋单薄的做工形成了刺目的反差。
Red eyes and a snarling, sharp-toothed mouth are all you see at first as the small goblin hurtles toward you, stopping 30 feet away. The high-pitched shriek distracts you momentarily and when your attention snaps back you notice that the goblin has expertly drawn a rickety bow and nocked a stone-tipped arrow in your direction, the practice of its movements undercutting the flimsiness of the weapon’s make.

Vampire Lord In Disguise.name:
伪装中的吸血鬼领主
Vampire Lord In Disguise

Text.text:
头顶电光炸裂，男人转身面向你，素日的温暖被冰冷而掠食者般的恶意取代。他嘴角扯出一抹毫无笑意的弧度，随手甩开那件破烂斗篷，露出古老的贵族衣饰。他以王者般的仪态立定，五官随之扭转重塑，线条愈发分明俊美，笑容越咧越开——露出森然獠牙。暗黑而翻涌的天幕下，他的身影被闪电勾勒成令人敬畏又毛骨悚然的剪影。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

Lightning flashes overhead as the man turns to you, cold predatory malice replacing his usual warmth. His lips curl into a mirthless smile as he casts aside his tattered cloak to reveal archaic noble clothing. He stands with regal bearing while his features shift and morph, becoming more defined and handsome as his smile widens—exposing wicked fangs. The man strikes an impressive and terrifying figure silhouetted against the dark and tumultuous sky.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这名黑发身影身披铆钉皮甲，鬓角已添了大把灰白，左手紧攥着手杖，把整个人的重量都压在上头；然而那双绿眼睛却亮得惊人，几乎要在他枯槁的面庞上发出幽光。他修剪得体的胡须与淡淡胡茬间，仍能看见两道细小的旧日穿刺伤疤，像被岁月轻轻藏起的印记。一把磨旧却依然趁手的长剑垂挂在他腰侧。虽看上去已是中年，你仍能从他起伏滚动的步态里看出：他依旧保有少年时的健康与力量。

~ 由 GenX_Jedi 扮演

Though the black-haired figure in studded leather has a generous amount of gray at his temples and leans heavily upon a cane clutched in his left hand, his green eyes sparkle so brightly that they practically glow in his cadaverous face. Two tiny scars from old puncture wounds are visible, though they are partially concealed by the man’s well-trimmed beard and light stubble. A worn but serviceable longsword hangs at his hip. Though he appears middle-aged, you can see from his rolling gait that he still retains the health and strength of his youth.

~ Played by GenX_Jedi

一个瘦长的人形生物几乎有八英尺高，身穿飞行员皮装。一把结实的求生刀绑在一侧大腿上，另一侧胯部则挂着一把滋滋作响的电弧手枪。它们动作轻盈流畅，在那副被拉长的躯体边界里显得无比自在。它们的脸——三只眼睛与两张竖向的嘴——令人有些不安，始终毫无表情。尽管它们并未真正看向你，你却生出一种毛骨悚然的感觉：你正被注视着。
A slender humanoid stands almost eight feet tall, clad in pilot leathers. A rugged survival knife is strapped to one thigh, while a static arc pistol hangs from their other hip. They move with lithe fluidity, totally comfortable in the bounds of their extended body. Their face—with three eyes and two vertical mouths—is a little disconcerting, and remains without expression. Although they aren’t quite looking at you, you get the unnerving feeling you are being seen.

那簇怪异的岩石自周围丘陵间拔地而起，宛如一座要塞。确实，从远处望去，这片岩体的轮廓像是一座塔楼或城垣，嵌在山脊之上，俯瞰四周的地形。岩石在岁月中被磨得圆滑，彼此摇摇欲坠地叠靠着，每一块都有巨石般大小。你不禁怀疑——这究竟是自然造物，还是某个巨人将这些巨石一块块垒上去的？
The strange cluster of stone rises like a fortress from the surrounding hills. Indeed, from a distance, the silhouette of the formation resembles that of a tower or rampart, built into the ridge and overlooking the surrounding terrain. The stones, worn smooth over time, sit precariously upon one another, each the size of a boulder. You wonder—is the structure natural, or did a giant stack these boulders atop one another?

Magical Detection Of A Warlock's Class.name:
术士职业的魔法侦测
Magical Detection Of A Warlock's Class

Text.text:
侦测呈现为一对只有你能看见的臂铠，扣在你目标的手臂上。臂铠仿佛由一叠叠完全相同的羊皮纸叠成，通篇覆着同样的字迹，并各自以同样的蜡封封缄。每当你的目标抬臂动作，臂铠便随之消失。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The detection takes the form of bracers only you can see, attached to your target’s arms. The bracers seem to be made of identical sheets of parchment, covered in the same writing, and each bound with the same wax seal. When your target’s arms move, the bracers disappear.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Human Soldiers' Mess Hall.name:
人类士兵食堂
Human Soldiers' Mess Hall

Text.text:
食堂里喧闹不休，笑声与拌嘴声此起彼伏，几乎与诱人的香气一样浓烈。人类士兵们为摆在磨旧木桌上的新鲜面包、香料鹿肉与其他精致佳肴相互推搡。一个士兵灵巧地把自己的酒杯挪开，恰在一滴蜡从铁制枝形吊灯里固定的蜡烛上坠落之际。烛光摇曳，在墙上陈列的无数战利与狩猎奖杯间游移闪动。

~ 由 Battersby 构想

The mess hall is filled with noise, laughter, and bickering as much as it is with delicious aromas. Human soldiers jostle one another for the fresh bread, spiced venison, and other fine fare laid out on worn wooden tables. One soldier deftly moves their tankard out of the way as a drop of wax falls from a candle ensconced in an iron chandelier. The candles cast flickering light over the many battle and hunting trophies adorning the walls.

~ Envisioned by Battersby

River Journey: Dock.name:
河道旅程：码头
River Journey: Dock

Text.text:
一条由裂开的木板拼成的狭长栈桥，从泥泞的河岸蜿蜒伸出，探入更深的水域。沿着栈桥，几艘小船随波轻轻起伏，还有一艘挂着单帆的较大型河船。河流在此处拐弯，水势放缓，形成一片更为宁静的湾汊。毫无疑问，良好的泊位正是人们将附近村落选址于此的原因之一。
A narrow pier of split boards snakes from the muddy bank and out into deeper water. Along it a few boats bob, as well as a larger river ship with a single sail. The river’s flow runs slower because of the bend here, creating a calmer bay. No doubt the good mooring is part of the reason folk chose this location for the nearby village.

Heavily Enhanced Doctor.name:
高度强化医生
Heavily Enhanced Doctor

Text.text:
医生俯身靠近，右手姿态精准得无可挑剔。本该握着一件器械的拳中却空无一物。伴随一连串悦耳的咔嗒声，触觉传感器嗡鸣启动，将医生的前臂分裂成五件各自独立的多功能工具——每一件都通过一系列复杂的机械植入体与骨骼相连。再细看，这个人体早已大幅强化：一只鼓胀的蓝色眼球用于生物科技分析，口周嵌着内置的外科防护盾——甚至连颅骨也被尖端医疗植入体优化到了极致。
The doctor leans in with a perfectly poised right hand. There should be an implement in their fist, but there isn’t. With a series of pleasing clicks, haptic sensors whirr and split the doctor’s forearm into five separate multi-tools, each connected to the bone by a series of complex mechanical implants. Looking closer, much of this individual is enhanced: a bulging blue eye for biotech analysis, a built-in surgical shield around the mouth—even the cranium has been optimized with cutting-edge medical implants.

Quip About Cosmic Connection.name:
关于宇宙联结的俏皮话
Quip About Cosmic Connection

Text.text:
“像你这样头脑简单的人永远不会明白：我们彼此相连。最卑微、满身泥污的蠢货，与最强大的国王，同属一个宇宙计划的一部分。很恶心，不是吗？”
“What a simple mind like yours will never understand, is that we’re all connected. The lowliest mud-covered fool and the mightiest king are all part of the same cosmic plan. It’s disgusting, isn’t it?”

Destroyed Colossal Statue.name:
崩毁的巨像雕像
Destroyed Colossal Statue

Text.text:
一尊巨大战神的雕像倒卧在古老竞技场的残骸间；若在完好之时，想必高如风暴巨人。那巨像的碎块散落得如此之远，光看这抛散的距离便知，它定是被某次无比骇人的猛击生生震碎。
An incredibly large statue of a warrior-god, probably as tall as a storm giant in its intact state, has been strewn about the remains of the ancient arena. Judging from how far apart the pieces of the colossus have been scattered, it must have been broken apart by a mighty impact indeed.

羽毛沿着巨蛇的身躯根根竖起，它蜿蜒前行，感官捕捉到猎物时鼻孔猛然翕张。无论这是自然的怪癖，还是某场失控的奥秘实验所致，这头野兽都堪称奇观。鳞片与羽毛被涂染成世间能想象的一切色彩，它游动之际便绽放出刺目而狂乱的斑斓光谱——先以眩彩将猎物迷得神志恍惚，再倏然扑击。
Feathers bristle along the serpent’s body as it slithers forward, nostrils flaring when it senses prey. Whether a quirk of nature, or some arcane experiment gone awry, the beast is truly a sight to behold. Scales and feathers alike are painted in every hue imaginable, creating a scintillating display of riotous color as it moves—dazzling its prey into a stupor before it strikes.

Tomb Of A Hedge Wizard.name:
树篱巫师之墓
Tomb Of A Hedge Wizard

Text.text:
一尊身披飘逸长袍、面带微笑的隐士雕像伸出手来，仿佛在招呼你走进这座古老的陵墓；当你跨过门槛，一股宁静的暖流随之漫过全身。墓室中央，一具覆满怪异深奥符文的石棺巍然占据视线；数枚奥术光球在空中轻轻浮沉，柔和的辉光流转不息，色彩不断变幻。
A statue of a smiling hermit in flowing robes beckons you inside the ancient tomb with an outstretched hand, and a sense of peace washes over you as you cross the threshold.
