A stone coffin covered in strange, esoteric symbols dominates the chamber, and globes of arcane light bob gently in the air, their colors constantly shifting with a soft, radiant glow.

陆地环抱着海面，伸出两道分明的臂弯，仿佛一张张大欲噬海的巨口。船只在海湾里拖网巡弋，中央点缀着一簇簇小岛。
The land embraces the sea, forming two distinct arms that evoke the image of a gaping maw around the sea itself. Boats trawl the bay, and a cluster of small islands dot the center.

这处岩角如一枚参差的獠牙般突兀拔起。几道石缝里顽草与灌木死死攀附，但灰色岩面大多裸露。朝向草甸的一侧，被岁月磨出大片攀爬的凹槽，宛如刻在石上的登梯；这些凹痕足以让数名攀登者同时上攀——然而峰顶几乎无处立足。另一侧则是直坠下方山谷的绝壁。
This point of rock rises like a ragged tooth. Tough grass and bushes cling to a few crannies, but the gray stone is mostly bare. The side facing the meadow has worn climbing grooves carved into much of it. These indentations could allow several climbers to ascend at once—but the pinnacle offers little room to stand. On its other side is a sheer drop to the valley below.

一只古灵精怪的生物凭着任性与奇趣，在风中御空而行——纤薄的翼膜自它伸展的双臂延展。它在反复无常的圆圈里嬉闹翻飞，身后不断排出一股缥缈雾气的旋涡。察觉到你，mephti 发出一声惊叫，回响宛如绿头鸭的求偶鸣声。它那带着地精气息的面容扭曲了一瞬，竟像是在掂量“战”与“逃”的轻重。

[Fight] 不再犹豫，mephti 俯冲而下——利爪尖牙尽出，裹挟着癫狂翻涌的元素之力。

[Flight] 选择逃走的 m ephti 重重哼了一声。它恼怒之下夸张地喷出一团元素能量，随即振翅飞远，消失在天风里。

An impish creature of whim and whimsy rides the winds on thin wings that extend from its outstretched arms. As it cavorts in capricious circles, it excretes a steady eddy of nebulous vapor. Noticing you, the mephit utters a cry of surprise that echoes a mallard's mating call. There's a moment when its goblinoid features twist, and it literally weighs fight versus flight.

[Fight] Considering no longer, the mephit dives—claws and teeth extended in a maniacal frenzy of elemental energy.

[Flight] Choosing to flee, the mephit huffs. A puff of elemental energy accompanies its annoyance in an ostentatious display as it flies on and away.

A Request For Kindness From A Dying Frie.name:
来自垂死挚友的一份慈悲请求
A Request For Kindness From A Dying Friend

Text.text:
“看着我——这很重要。很快，我就会离开，真正地离开，但别让这击垮你。让我在你的行事之中延续。让你对我仍存的所有爱意触及你身边的人，因为我已经用不上它了。”
“Look at me—this is important. Soon, I will be gone, truly gone, but do not let it break you. Let me live on in your deeds. Let whatever love you hold for me reach those around you, for I have no use for it anymore.”

Insult About Silence.name:
关于沉默的侮辱
Insult About Silence

Text.text:
“我得掘开哪座坟？我得读懂哪些奥秘符文？我得膜拜哪位神祇，才能让你哪怕就闭嘴片刻？”
“What tomb must I unearth? What arcane runes must I read? What deity must I worship to get you to shut up for just a moment?”

Creepy Campsite In Forest.name:
森林中的阴森营地
Creepy Campsite In Forest

Text.text:
一棵被暴风掀倒的大树将纠结扭曲的树根与泥土一并扯上半空，成了怪异棚屋的一面墙——这棚屋就搭在沉重倒伏的树干下。临时搭起的结构四周——树根上、斜靠木杆的端头上、以及插进泥里的齐胸木桩上——都悬着小小的人形偶，皆由细枝、苔藓与蕨叶扎成。
A tree torn down by a storm splays a tangle of twisted roots and dirt into the air, forming one wall of a strange lean-to built under the fallen bulk of the tree’s trunk. All around this makeshift structure—on roots, on the ends of lean-to logs, and on chest-high sticks driven into the dirt—hang little humanoid figures made from twigs, moss, and ferns.

Speech About Living Fully.name:
关于尽情活着的演说
Speech About Living Fully

Text.text:
“想想有些人一生只尝到自己能感受到的情绪里的一小部分。抑郁的宁静，悲伤的释然，恐惧的迫近。我的人生唯一的盼望，就是在所有体验里纵情饕餮——不论好坏。”
“To think that some people experience only a fraction of the emotions available to them. The serenity of depression, the release of sadness, the immediacy of fear. My only hope in life is to be gluttonous with all my experiences, good and bad.”

Gorgon Preparing To Charge.name:
戈耳工蓄势待冲
Gorgon Preparing To Charge

Text.text:
钢铁摩擦钢铁的尖啸在林间空地回荡，它每迈出一步都如同利刃般刺入你的耳膜。闪亮的黑色甲板覆盖着这头公牛般的生物全身，向前延伸成一对锋锐得足以撕裂一切的巨角。它重重踏下金属蹄，清脆的铿锵声暴露了它的意图；绿色烟雾从鼻孔翻涌而出，它随即压低头颅，蓄势待发，准备冲撞。
The screech of steel on steel reverberates through the clearing, assailing your ears with each step it takes. Glistening black plates cover the bull-like creature’s body, leading to a pair of devastatingly sharp horns. It stamps its metallic hoof, the sharp clang revealing its intention as green smoke billows from its nostrils, and lowers its head, preparing to charge.

Half-elf Biomancer.name:
半精灵生体塑法师
Half-elf Biomancer

Text.text:
那男人身形与半精灵一般高挑，却生着病态的蜡黄皮肤，覆着蜥蜴般的细鳞。沉重的眼睑耷拉着，仍遮不住他眼中刺目的亮光；鼻翼翕张，如同追猎中的猛兽。尽管他的躯体带着鱼类的特征——拖着一条尾巴，双手生着蹼——血脉里那份精灵的传承依旧清晰得无可辩驳。一件朴素的皮背心随意披在他诡异的肤色上，他身佩弯刀，肩挎一只鼓胀得令人不适的挎包，里面塞满了形形色色的怪异小瓶。
The man stands as tall as a half-elf, but his skin is a sickly yellow and scaled like a lizard’s. His eyes are bright despite the heavy lids that droop over them, and his nostrils flare like a beast on the hunt. Although his body is piscine, with a tail and webbed hands, the elven lineage in his blood remains clear and inarguable. A simple leather vest is draped over his unusual complexion, and he carries a scimitar and a satchel that bulges uncomfortably with strange vials.

I Use My Helm Of Comprehending Languages.name:
我启用我的通晓语言头盔
I Use My Helm Of Comprehending Languages

Text.text:
镜片怪异，造型却格外讨好那些更……嗯，带着水栖（特征）气息的家伙。但无需施放便能让法术恒常相伴，这无疑是一大恩赐。姓名、词汇、变位一一自我归位，而我也由此成为这世界真正的公民。
The lenses are strange and the design appealing to someone more, well, aquatic. But the constant presence of the spell without the labor of casting it is certainly a boon. Names, vocabulary, and conjugations all sort themselves out, and I am made a true citizen of the world.

I Cast Hold Person Using An Arcane Focus.name:
我用一件奥术法器物品施放【定身术】
I Cast Hold Person Using An Arcane Focus Item

Text.text:
我将奥术之力引入我的施法媒介，全部心神牢牢钉在目标之上。低声咕哝一句咒言，伴随一个华丽的手势，我施放法术；心眼之中，目标已然僵直麻痹，任人宰割。
I channel arcane power through my focus, my attention fixed entirely upon the target. With a muttered word and a flourishing gesture I cast the spell, my mind’s eye envisioning the target paralyzed and helpless.

A Tenday Of Travel By Horse Through A Ch.name:
骑马旅行十日，穿越由夏入秋的更迭
A Tenday Of Travel By Horse Through A Change To Fall

Text.text:
信任坐骑的直觉，你在这条失修的路上旅行时放开缰绳，任它自行选择脚步。你把斗篷拢得更紧，一边警惕地扫视着地平线。夏天正向这片土地告别。树叶已开始变色；到了第二天，一阵清冽的风起，便把叶片从枝头一片片剥落。第四天，天空被迁徙的鸟群填满，你为夜晚寻了更结实的栖身处。次日，你的休息被一只想偷走口粮的狐狸搅扰，但你掷出一块石头，便把它赶走。第十天下午，当你抵达旅程的尽头时，你只盼着一间温暖的酒馆厅堂和一顿像样的饭食。
Trusting your mount's instincts, you give it free rein as you travel along the ill-maintained road. You tug your cloak tighter about you as you scan the horizon. Summer is bidding the land farewell. Already the leaves are turning, and by the second day a crisp wind begins to strip them from the trees. Day four sees the skies fill with migrating birds, and you seek more robust shelter for the night. The following day your rest is disturbed by a fox attempting to steal your rations, but a hurled stone sends it on its way. By the afternoon of the tenth day, when you reach the end of your journey, you are hoping for a warm taproom and some decent food.

一座由讥笑与空洞张口的颅骨垒成的纪念碑，许多头盖骨上刻着交融般的裂痕。堆叠之中混杂着各色种族：人类、长角的提夫林、矮小的半身人，以及咧嘴狞笑的地精类。怪物也点缀着这座骇人的神龛：牛头人的黑角自其牛颅向下卷曲，巨魔与巨人的巨大头颅充作堆垒的基座，而一头利齿森然的蜥蜴类则作为冠顶。
A monument of sneering and gaping skulls, with many of the craniums etched with amalgam cracks. Various races make up the stack: humans, horned tieflings, diminutive halflings, and leering goblinoids. Monsters, too, decorate the grisly shrine: the black horns of a minotaur curl down from its bovine skull, huge heads of a troll and a giant serve as the foundation of the pile, and a sharp-toothed saurian acts as the crown.

Set Of Reinforced High-end Clothing.name:
一套加固的高档服装
Set Of Reinforced High-end Clothing

Text.text:
这套精致的三件套西装比想象中更沉，展开时也比寻常布料更僵硬。旁边的牌子上写着这身行头可防小口径枪械子弹，还画着一幅漫画：穿西装的商人一边挥手一边微笑，身后一个脏兮兮的劫匪朝他背上开枪，却只落得徒劳无功。
The fine three-piece suit is heavier than one would expect, and stiffer than normal cloth to unfold. A sign nearby advertises the outfit as bulletproof against small-caliber firearms, with a cartoon of a suited businessman waving and smiling as a grubby mugger fires uselessly at his back.

[首次造访] 一只乌鸦蹲在一把从旁边泥土堆里斜插出来的铁锹顶上，冲你聒噪地叫着。地上一个泥泞的坑边，坟墓被掘开，墓碑歪倒在草丛里。挖开这座坟的人必定走得匆忙——你又瞥见另一把铁锹丢在土堆旁。坟里像个光秃秃的土洞；既看不见骨头，也不见棺木腐烂的木屑。要么他们挖得不够深，要么这里从来就没埋过任何东西。

[再次造访] 附近树上的乌鸦此起彼伏地鸣叫，彼此示警，仿佛你闯入了它们的领地。坟旁的土堆变小了些，却又冒出草叶与杂草。土堆变小，或许是风雨侵蚀所致，也可能有人费心把坟回填了几铲。无论如何，一部分泥土已经回到了坑里。

[First visit] A crow squawks at you from its perch atop a shovel jutting from the pile of dirt beside a muddy hole in the ground. A grave lies open, its marker toppled in the grass. Whoever dug up this grave must have left in a hurry because you spot another shovel lying by the pile of dirt. The grave looks like a bare earth hole. You see neither bones nor the rotting wood of a coffin. Either those digging here did not dig deep enough, or nothing was ever buried here.

[Return visit] Crows call from the nearby trees, alerting one another to your intrusion in what they seem to think is their territory. The pile of dirt beside the grave has shrunk while simultaneously sprouting blades of grass and weeds. The pile of dirt might be smaller because of weathering or because someone made an effort to fill in the grave. Either way, some of the dirt has returned to the hole.

那身影的轮廓毫无类人的曲线，一条破烂、褐渍斑斑的床单裹在它嶙峋的肩头。床单下摆探出一双利爪般的脚，鳞片覆着的趾头粉灰相间，像秃鹫的脚趾。若那也算一张脸，它便从床单的阴影里窥出：两只眼睛燃着炽热熔炉的光——一只金黄，一只猩红。其余面容被一层浓密、炸立的棕灰毛皮遮住，宛如远古恐狼厚重的皮袄。它在正中裂开“脸”开口说话时，你看见一排排锋利的犬齿，唾涎成丝，黏亮地垂落。
The figure’s silhouette is devoid of humanoid curvature, a ratty, brown-stained bedsheet wrapped around its bony shoulders. Taloned feet stick out from under the hem, the scaly toes pink and gray like a vulture’s. A face, if you can call it that, peers out from the sheet, its two eyes burning with the colors of a fervid forge—one yellow and one red. The rest of the visage is hidden by a dense coat of bristling brown and gray fur, like the coat of an ancient direwolf. Indeed, as its face splits in the center to speak, you see rows of sharp, canine teeth stringy with slaver.

Starship Lands On Jungle Planet.name:
星舰降落在丛林星球上
Starship Lands On Jungle Planet

Text.text:
微小的异星小动物四散奔逃，巨大的黑色物体自天穹坠落。着陆火箭轰然点燃，减缓飞船下沉的势头，同时引燃缠绕在高得不可思议的树木之间的干枯藤蔓。空气的湿热陡然加剧。飞船触地之际，树木成片倾倒、崩裂，亿万年的生长被碾作齑粉。待引擎终于熄火，一圈焦灼的黑色枯死植物环绕着落地的星舰。
Small alien fauna scatter as the colossal black object drops from the heavens. Landing rockets ignite, slowing the ship’s descent and setting fire to dry vines looped between trees of impossible height. The humid heat of the air intensifies. Trees topple and splinter as the vessel lands, crushing eons of growth. By the time the engines are switched off, a scorched ring of dead black plant life surrounds the landed starship.

Guildmaster's Meeting Room.name:
公会会长会议室
Guildmaster's Meeting Room

Text.text:
你将食堂与厨房的喧闹抛在身后，踏入一间私密的小室。屋内只摆着一张仅够几人围坐的餐桌——也许是公会会长与其最亲近的核心圈子所用。一个水壶与几只杯子搁在一只合拢的柜子上方，你轻拽把手，立刻感觉到它被某种机关或魔法严丝合缝地封死。
Leaving the commotion of the mess hall and kitchens behind, you step into a private room with a dining table large enough for only a few people—perhaps the guildmaster and their closest circle. A pitcher of water and cups sit atop a closed cupboard, and a tug at its handles tells you it is sealed tight by either mechanism or magic.

Abandoned Jungle Temple.name:
废弃的丛林神庙
Abandoned Jungle Temple

Text.text:
一座神秘的石造神殿，古老而荒弃，匍匐在这片丛林汗湿的心脏深处。纵使历经万古，它依旧诡异地洁净如新，毫无风蚀之痕——仿佛在搏动着超自然的寒意，扭曲的象形刻画脉动着不朽的仇恨。违背一切理智，你却感到一种引诱，驱使你踏入那自内部招手的预言阴翳之中。

~ Envisioned by Titanulas

An enigmatic stone temple, ancient and abandoned, squats deep within the sweating heart of this jungle. Despite the eons, it stands eerily pristine, devoid of erosion—seeming to throb with supernatural dread, twisted pictographs pulsating with an ageless enmity. Against all reason, you feel an allure, compelling you to step within the prophetic umbra beckoning from within.

~ Envisioned by Titanulas

Goddess Of The Moon.name:
月之女神
Goddess Of The Moon

Text.text:
她不费吹灰之力便能摄人心魄，将周遭每一处光源都映作魅影（特征）般的银辉，含着神秘的微笑，仿佛夜色的主宰。她的长发如铂金倾泻，覆在一袭淡蓝色锦缎长袍之上。她那双灰色的眼睛与行止之间的气息让你明白：善变的不止是她的性情。她能随光而变，移形换貌——先化作掌潮弄汐的力量，或造就一头狼人；继而又成了群星间一弯纤薄的白色新月缪斯。
She charms without effort, reflecting in a phantom silver every light source nearby, smiling with mystery and command of the night. Her long hair is platinum, draped over a robe of pale blue samite. Something about her gray eyes and the way she moves tells you that more than her personality is mercurial. She can change with the light, shifting form—first a power that controls the tides or creates a werewolf, then a thin white crescent muse among the stars.

Nightmare About Sinking.name:
关于沉没的噩梦
Nightmare About Sinking

Text.text:
你蹚入翻涌的水域，浪头狠狠拍打胸前，一波波令人恼火地横扫而来。灰黑的云层如同哀悼者的裹尸布般压在头顶。远处有个人影的轮廓，正像你一样与浪搏斗。他朝你抬起手臂——在招唤你。你咬牙前行，每一步都比上一刻更艰难。抬脚、摆臂都变得异常费力。你的猎物在远方渐渐缩小。你用尽最后一丝力气向前扑去，害怕会失去他的踪迹——却迎面撞上了一片开阔的深水。你瞬间下沉，四肢沉如铅块，身体里唯一的移动只剩心脏急促狂跳。上方世界那点微薄的光亮逐渐淡去，你被冰冷的海水吞没。你徒劳地吐出一声带着气泡的尖叫，寒意让肺叶迅速萎缩。

~ BigMacDaddy 构想

You wade through the roiling waters, waves slapping against your front in galling sweeps. Gray-black clouds loom like a mourner's pall above. There’s the shade of a person’s shape in the distance, battling through the waves as you are. They raise their arm toward you—a beckoning. You press on, each step more arduous than the last. It’s so difficult to lift your feet, to pump your arms. Your quarry grows smaller in the distance. You use the last ounce of your strength to pitch yourself forward, fearing you’ll lose them—and meet open water. You sink in an instant, limbs leaden, the only movement in your body the rapid racing of your heart. The meager light of the world above fades as you are swallowed by the freezing sea. You loose a futile bubbling scream that wilts your lungs.

~ Envisioned by BigMacDaddy

Psychic Voices Build In Intensity.name:
灵能低语愈发强烈
Psychic Voices Build In Intensity

Text.text:
如同坠落的雪轻轻敲打般，声音起初只是耳语，在你穿行冰封岛屿时，被刺骨寒风吞没。可它们开始抓挠你的心智，愈发高亢，愈发喧嚣，仿佛哀嚎的亡者合唱团；你拼命想将其拒之门外，却只能听见乞求与哀告的杂音在颅骨里轰然爆裂。

~ 由 Clara C. Potter 在 Discord 上构想

Like the soft pattering of falling snow, the voices begin as whispers, lost on the biting winds as you traverse the frozen island. The voices start to claw at your mind, growing louder and louder like a choir of the wailing damned as you desperately try to shut out the begging, pleading cacophony bursting inside your skull.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

I Parry A Strike Using My Shield.name:
我用盾牌格挡一次打击
I Parry A Strike Using My Shield

Text.text:
我把对手的武器引向一个又大又显眼的目标。但那面盾牌却化作武器，斜斜擎起，让打击擦过偏转、歪斜甩开，而不是被弹回到持盾者惯常的握持线上。当我为自己的武器让开盾面时，前方再无阻碍。
I give my opponent’s weapons a nice, big target. But the shield turns to a weapon, held at an angle to make the blow glance and careen away rather than back to the wielder’s natural grip. When I clear the shield for my own weapon, nothing is in its way.

Earth Elemental: Ruined City.name:
土元素：废墟之城
Earth Elemental: Ruined City

Text.text:
风掠过这座曾经繁华的城市，呜咽作响，拨弄着枯叶。透过早已不复存在的墙垣遗址望去，满目尽是杂草噎塞的瓦砾残堆，你心头涌起一种凄凉的感觉——就像偶尔走进墓园时那般沉重。这座城沦陷时死了多少人？又有谁的白骨，正躺在断壁残垣的阴影里？
Wind whistles over a once-vibrant city, toying with dry leaves. Looking through where walls once stood and gazing over weed-choked rubble, you have the same forlorn sense you sometimes get when walking through a graveyard. How many died when this city fell? Whose bones lie in the shadows of its ruined walls?

Pursuant Minion Dunker.name:
追随的奴仆扣将
Pursuant Minion Dunker

Text.text:
一名女子身穿漂得发白、浆得笔挺的白衬衫，胸前挂着一枚闪烁的金属徽章，裤腿卷起，站在水中，水没到她的膝盖。她身旁是个赤脚的孩子，穿着白色长袍，浑身湿到腰际。她低声呢喃一段只有他们听得见的祷辞，每念到一个停顿，便猛地将孩子用力按入水中，又一把将他拽起。她在诵词间反复这样做了十号。孩子每次露出水面都剧烈地吐水、呛咳，直到第十次。随后，他露出微笑，自行沉入水下，而她守夜般凝视着某种东西在水底自她身边疾驰而去。
A woman in a bleached- and starched-white shirt, wearing a flashing metal medallion, stands with her trousers rolled up, submerged to her knees. Beside her is a barefoot child in a white gown, soaked to the waist. She whispers a speech only they can hear, which she punctuates by pushing the child into the water with considerable force and yanking him back up. She does this ten times through her recitation. The child spits and chokes at each emergence until the tenth. He then smiles, submerges himself, and she watches something race away from her underwater.

一阵喀喀作响、嘈杂刺耳的啃噬声宣告了这只甲壳蜈蚣的巅峰之躯。它覆鳞而修长的身形两侧，密布着如弯刀般的千足，带着令人胆寒的速度窸窣疾掠。它的躯体末端生着三颗巨大的虫首，每一颗都嵌着复眼，冰冷地凝视着原始而饥渴的杀意。三张巨口布满穿刺般的獠牙，而更骇人的是，下方的螯钳正滴落着一股元素能量。
A chittering cacophony announces this chitinous apex of chilopods. Its scaled, elongated body is flanked by a thousand legs like scimitars that skitter with an appalling speed. Its body ends in three giant insectile heads, each set with multifaceted eyes that stare with cold, primal hunger. The three maws are riddled with piercing fangs, and as if that weren't enough, the pincers below drip with an elemental energy.

High Seas: Sheltering Down Below.name:
公海：在甲板之下避风藏身
High Seas: Sheltering Down Below

Text.text:
风暴在外头咆哮肆虐，你庆幸自己躲开了那撕扯一切的狂风——可雨水还是追上了你。地板上已有一寸深的积水四处荡漾，祈祷这只是从敞开的舱口涌入，或沿着木板缝隙一滴滴渗落下来的。
The storm rages outside, and you count yourself lucky to be out of its wind—but its rain has found its way to you. An inch of water sluices about the floor, hopefully coming from open hatches or dripping down from cracks in the boards.

Flightless Sprites Riding Insects.name:
乘虫而行的无翼小精灵
Flightless Sprites Riding Insects

Text.text:
这些小妖精（特征）堪称奇妙的生灵。大多数同族凭借自身的翅膀飞行，而这一群里的每一只小妖精（特征）似乎都缺了一只翅膀，或因其他缘故无法使用翅膀。取而代之，它们骑乘被魔法放大的昆虫腾空而起，那些昆虫有足够的力量将它们托举在空中。有些甚至配有专门的挽具，便于轻推昆虫，令其朝正确的方向飞去。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

These sprites are remarkable creatures. Whereas most of the species fly using their own wings, every sprite in this group appears to be missing a wing or is otherwise unable to use them. Instead, they take to the sky on magically enlarged insects capable of holding them aloft. Some even have dedicated harnesses to aid in nudging the insects in the right direction.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Viking Village With Temple.name:
带神庙的维京村落
Viking Village With Temple

Text.text:
浓雾挤满这座静谧的海湾小村街巷，遮没泥泞灰暗的地貌，也让刺骨寒意浸透空气。建筑多为长屋，交叉的山墙彼此咬合。一座烟囱吐着黑烟，气味像蔬菜或菌菇般的土腥，却很快被烤肉的咸香压过。有一处建筑在高度与风格上都鹤立鸡群：一座三层神殿，墙体由竖立木板拼筑，山墙顶端以锻铁饰件加冕。
Fog crowds the streets of this quiet, bayside hamlet, obscuring the muddy, gray landscape and suffusing the air with bitter cold. The buildings are longhouses with crossed gables. A chimney puffs with black smoke, the scent of it vegetal or fungal—an aroma quickly overwhelmed by the savory smell of roasting meat. One structure stands out from the rest in both height and architecture: a three-story temple built with walls of upright planks and gables crowned with wrought-iron ornaments.

斑驳的泥褐色几丁质在这昆虫状生物全身铺成坚固的外骨骼，使它迅疾的动作带着令人作呕的性相。猩红的复眼下方，骇人的大颚间滴落黏稠的绿色脓液；当野兽将其咔哒咔哒地合拢、迫不及待想要品尝新鲜猎物时，刺耳的吱喳声也随之愈发高涨。
Mottled, mud-brown chitin forms a sturdy exoskeleton across the insectoid creature’s body, lending a sickening aspect to its rapid movements. Viscous green ichor drips from the fearsome mandibles set beneath red compound eyes, and a hideous chittering builds as the beast clacks the former together in anticipation of tasting fresh prey.

Haunted House: Master Suite.name:
鬼宅：主卧套房
Haunted House: Master Suite

Text.text: 伴随着一声拖长的吱呀，双开门缓缓开启，露出主卧套间前厅昔日华美的陈设。门对面的壁炉幽暗冰冷，但当你走近时，一股刺骨寒风——夹杂着清晰可闻的哀号——猛地抽打在你的脸与胸口。你方才从这猝不及防的冲击中缓过神来，通往卧室的门便自行摆开，而墙上壁灯架里的灯盏虽未点燃，却骤然一盏盏亮起。 With a protracted creak, the double-doors open to reveal the once splendid furnishings of the foyer of the master suite. The fireplace opposite the doors is dark and cold, but as you approach a blast of freezing air—accompanied by an audible wail—lashes across your face and chest. Just as you recover from that unexpected buffeting, the doors leading to the bedroom swing open of their own accord, and unlit lamps set in sconces along the walls suddenly come alight.

Android Intelligence Laboratory.name:
安卓智能实验室
Android Intelligence Laboratory

Text.text:
技术员们拿着手持终端走进无尘室，把套着鞋套的鞋底从黏腻的除尘地垫上缓缓撕开，同时核查空气中的颗粒物洁净度。那台安卓此刻仍只是一团冰冷的机械骨架，没有任何人性化的修饰，悬挂在一座小型脚手架上。它的颅顶盖敞开着，在导电凝胶的包裹中，一枚由纤维与硅构成的玻璃质舱体漂浮其内。技术员们将装满二进制与语言翻译模块的设备接入主机，通过细密的缆线束一路牵引，直连那颗“脑”。
The technicians take their handhelds into the clean room, peeling their covered shoes from the sticky doormat and checking the particulate quality of the air. The android, still a mass of robotics at this point and without humanizing touches, hangs on a small scaffold. Its skull cap is open, and inside a conductive gel floats a glassy pod of fiber and silicon. The techs interface their devices, full of binary and language translators, through the mainframe and the fine ropes of cable to the brain.

Private Supper Club.name:
私密晚宴会所
Private Supper Club

Text.text:
在那扇极不起眼的门前报上口令后，你被引入室内：一间雅致的厅堂，尽是奢靡而颓艳的华贵。角落的厨房门缝里飘出异域香料的馥郁气息，厅内只摆着寥寥几张桌子。背景乐恰到好处地流淌，刚好撩动谈兴却不喧宾夺主；身着熨得笔挺制服的侍者们殷勤周到，目光与动作都细致得无可挑剔。
Upon giving the password at the very discreet door, you are led inside to a stylish room filled with decadent luxury. The enchanting scent of exotic spices drifts from the kitchen door in the corner, and there are only a few tables. Ambient music fills the room at the perfect level to stimulate conversation but not detract from it, and staff in neatly pressed uniforms attend to you with utmost diligence.

I Unfold My Folding Boat: Ship.name:
我展开折叠船：船只
I Unfold My Folding Boat: Ship

Text.text:
我猛地一掷，将箱子抛入水中，心知这点魔法得留出宽阔的回旋余地。我念出口令，箱子一阵战栗，木板与钉子彼此震颤作响。伴随着一阵高亢起伏的鞭啸声，宛如船帆猛然舒展，箱子裂开。船壳……桅杆……船桨……一艘完整的船迅速成形，仿佛每一部分都由苍白的帆布织就。然而它在水面上起伏得如同真正的船般稳当，只待一位船长与一群船员登船。
With a great heave, I fling the box into the water, knowing this bit of magic will need a wide berth. I speak the command and the box shudders, wood and nail rattling against each other. With a loud undulating whipping sound, like sails unfurling, the box splits open. Hull… mast… oars… a full ship forms, each part seemingly made from pale canvas. But it bobs on the water with the same steadiness as a true ship, in need only of a captain and crew.

Goblin’s Plea For Mercy.name:
地精的求饶
Goblin’s Plea For Mercy

Text.text:
“拜托别杀我。我还有一窝孩子。三十个小崽子都离不开我。好吧，对不起，那是骗你的。但要是你饶我一命，说不定我以后真能有一窝——也许还会用英俊的冒险者们来给它们取名？”
“Please do not kill. I has brood. Thirty little broodlings needs me. Okay, sorry, that’s lie. But if you spare, maybe I get to have brood—maybe name after handsome adventurers?”

Zealot On A Pilgrimage.name:
朝圣途中的狂信者
Zealot On A Pilgrimage

Text.text:
身披污秽褴褛——那曾是俗世之人的礼服——这名乱发蓬散的流浪者死死攥着一枚失去光泽的圣徽，像是抓住最后的信念。磨穿的凉鞋在脚底露出破口，诉说着一段漫长的旅途，而这趟路仍远未走到尽头。
Dressed in filthy rags that were once a lay person’s vestments, the wild-haired vagrant clutches fervently at a tarnished holy symbol. Their sandals, worn through in parts, tell the tale of a long trip that is nowhere near finished.

起初你只看见一团藤蔓，蔫蔫地纠缠在一起，突兀得像被遗落在此。几缕轻快的翠绿能量在藤间飘曳，叶片微微战栗，抖落出如同柔和而绵密细雨般的沙沙声。藤蔓随即变形，向上抬升，塑成类人的轮廓：垂落的手臂与双腿结构松散，以便自由移动；而躯干则被紧紧束缚，编结成护甲。

~ 构想：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

At first you only see a mass of vines, listless and out-of-place. Wisps of sprightly green energy flutter amidst the vines, and the leaves shiver to produce a sound akin to soft and steady rain. The vines morph, shifting upward into a form for a humanoid: the hanging arms and legs are loose in structure to allow for free movement, while the torso is tightly bound into armor.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Loot From A Young Blue Dragon.name:
幼年蓝龙的战利品
Loot From A Young Blue Dragon

Text.text:
幼龙的宝藏陈列得惊人地协调——无论是色彩还是主题都浑然一体。在从上方倾泻而下的光束汇成一汪汪光池的照明下，你看到精心布置的展柜：一摞摞码放齐整的钱币；蓝、绿、紫的宝石被排列在一座抛光石质基座上；以及一幅描绘沙漠绿洲的巨画，嵌在华丽的巴洛克风木雕画框之中。总体而言，这批收藏约值 5000 枚金币。
The young dragon’s hoard is remarkably coordinated—both in color and theme. In artfully curated displays lit by pools of light from above, you find neatly stacked piles of coins; blue, green, and purple gemstones arranged on a polished stone plinth; and a large painting of a desert oasis set in a baroque wooden frame. Overall, the collection is worth around 5000 gold pieces.

Half-orc Innkeeper.name:
半兽人旅店老板
Half-orc Innkeeper

Text.text:
旅店老板娘侧身一歪，滚动着脖颈，长长地叹了口气，显然是在想把那股别劲儿揉开。她把宽阔的身形重新稳住，闭着眼缓缓抬起头，让你得以细看她那棱角分明的面容。兽人传承赋予她坚实的下颌、细小的獠牙，以及高而硬的颧骨。这是一张毫不妥协的脸；当她睁开眼打量你时，你在那目光里几乎看不见半点暖意。
The innkeeper leans to one side and heaves a sigh as she rolls her neck, clearly trying to work out a kink. She centers her broad frame and slowly raises her head with eyes shut, giving you a chance to examine her blocky features. Orc heritage has given her a strong jaw, small tusks, and high, hard cheekbones. It’s an uncompromising face, and when she opens her eyes to regard you, you see little warmth in them.

纤细矫健的身影以放松的姿态倚在近处的柱子上，白发垂落，暂时遮住了她的脸。她感官捕捉到你的接近，便抬眼望向你，双手随意地搭上匕首的柄端——那种对佣兵来说再自然不过的习惯动作。你一时愣住：她的眼睛毫无特征，乳白得像浑浊的瓷，眼眶周围却深深一圈暗影。她的皮肤苍白得近乎泛着珍珠般的虹彩，与那身保养得极好的黑色皮装形成鲜明对比。

~ Played by Kendalatrix

The lithe figure stands in a relaxed pose leaning against a nearby post, her white hair obscuring her face from you for the moment. As she senses your approach, she looks up at you, her hands moving to her dagger hilts in a manner casual to those of the mercenary set. You are momentarily taken aback by her featureless, milky-white eyes, ringed as they are with dark circles. Her skin, so pale as to be considered opalescent, stands in stark contrast to her set of well-maintained black leathers.

~ Played by Kendalatrix

Wizard's Insult To A Sorcerer.name:
法师对术士的羞辱
Wizard's Insult To A Sorcerer

Text.text:
“和你那一类不同，巫师的魔法是挣来的。你的却是场闹剧；蹦蹦跳跳，手指乱晃，看会冒出什么。我不知道是哪股奥术力量觉得该把这份威能塞给你，但我向你保证——那是个笑话，而非赋礼。”

~ 由 LJBlakey 构想

“Unlike your ilk, wizards earn their magic. Yours is a travesty; jumping around, waggling your fingers and seeing what comes out. I don’t know which forces of the arcane saw fit to grant you this power, but I assure you it was a joke and not a gift.”

~ Envisioned by LJBlakey

Fake Helm Of Telepathy.name:
伪造心灵感应头盔
Fake Helm Of Telepathy

Text.text:
你将头盔稳稳扣在头上，猫头鹰般的面罩覆住你的双眼与鼻梁。你透过头盔左侧眼窝那枚紫色镜片凝视着你的目标，试图将注意力钉入对方的思绪，在脑海中捕捉任何一丝心灵独白的微光……却一无所获。要么你的目标脑中空无一念，要么这顶头盔是个赝品。
You fit the helm snugly over your head, the owl-like visor covering your eyes and nose. You gaze through the purple lens in the helm’s left eye socket at your target, focusing on their thoughts, listening in your mind for any glimmer of telepathic monologue… and receive nothing. Either your target’s head is devoid of thought, or the helm is a fake.

A City Afflicted By A Time Curse.name:
一座饱受时代诅咒侵蚀的城市
A City Afflicted By A Time Curse

Text.text:
当你走近这座你几天前才离开的城市时，你发现它如今已显得破败不堪、风雨飘摇。你离开时还算完好的建筑，现在墙体崩裂、窗户被木板钉死。这里看不出战斗或火灾的痕迹——仿佛只有时代在此留下了沉重的磨损。
As you approach the city you had only left a few days prior, you see that it now appears worn down and dilapidated. Buildings that were in fair condition when you left now have crumbling walls and boarded-up windows. There are no signs of battle nor fire—it seems only time has taken its toll here.

Detect Poison And Disease.name:
侦测毒素与疾病
Detect Poison And Disease

Text.text:
如同一处你怎么也挠不到的痒意，在你的法术加持下，你能感知到近在咫尺的剧毒与疾病的存在。无论是装在小袋里、等着倒进毫无防备受害者餐食中的一小瓶毒液，还是通向某个生物毒牙咬噬的毒囊，甚至哪怕是一名村民正悄然滋长的鼻塞轻症，都逃不过你的察觉。
Like an itch you cannot scratch, you are able, thanks to your spell, to feel the presence of noxious poisons and diseases in the immediate vicinity. Whether a vial carried in a pouch to be emptied into an unsuspecting victim’s meal, a venom sac feeding into a creature’s poison bite, or even a villager’s burgeoning case of the sniffles, none are beneath your notice.

Primary Docking Platform.name:
主泊靠平台
Primary Docking Platform

Text.text:
穿过连接两根立柱的桥下，你踏着草地朝最高的柱体走去。一道斜坡盘绕着它的黄铜躯干向上延伸，通往停泊平台的第一层架台。你触及顶端时，一层刺骨寒气如薄纱掠过肌肤——空间的真空已近在咫尺。这里的几何纹样描绘着一组与下方地面不同的行星天体；而你周围的每一根立柱上，都有各自独一无二的细线、圆环与其他形状的布局。前方不远处，第二道斜坡通向真正的系泊处，这根黄铜柱发出的呻吟比其他柱体更尖更高，金属在每一道轰鸣的能量波中都清晰可见地颤抖。
Passing under a bridge connecting two columns, you move through the grass toward the tallest pillar. A ramp wraps around its brass body and leads up to the first shelf of the docking platform. A veil of frigid air passes over you as you reach the top, the vacuum of space now much closer. The geometric patterns here depict a set of planetary bodies different from those on the floor below—and on the pillars around you, each of which has a unique layout of thin lines, circles and other shapes. Just ahead, a second ramp leads up to the actual mooring place, and this column of brass groans in a higher pitch than the others, the metal visibly shaking with each rumbling wave of energy.

Mini Mart Robbed At Gunpoint.name:
迷你便利店遭持枪抢劫
Mini Mart Robbed At Gunpoint

Text.text:
当劫匪们冲进门时，轻快的叮当声弹跳般响起，他们的脸藏在骇人的橡胶面具后。几把霰弹枪对准一脸茫然的店员，他们索要钱，还朝天花板轰出一发，炸开一个洞来强调自己的“道理”。忽然，其中一个歹徒猛地向后倒飞，撞穿了杂志架，浑身糊满血肉与碎屑。第二名员工站在库房门口，颤抖的双手握着一把冒烟的枪。剩下的贼扑向掩蔽处，而店员再次开火。
A bouncy chime sounds as the robbers rush through the door, their faces hidden by terrifying rubber masks. Leveling shotguns at the bemused clerk, they demand money and blow a hole in the ceiling with a shell to emphasize their point. Suddenly, one of the criminals flies backwards, crashing through a magazine stand, now covered in gore. A second employee stands in the stockroom doorway, their trembling hands holding a smoking gun. The remaining thieves dive for cover as the clerk opens fire again.

Quip By Small Folk About Childhood.name:
小个子们的童年俏皮话
Quip By Small Folk About Childhood

Text.text:
“我的童年和大多数人一样——时刻笼罩在对每一只大型猛禽和过分凶悍的啮齿动物的恐惧之中。但我挺了过来，如今站在你们面前，稍微没那么害怕了。”
“My childhood was like most—filled with a constant terror of every large bird of prey and overly aggressive rodent. But I persevered, and I stand before you now, slightly less terrified.”

龙裔比同族更为高大，一具冷峻的生物：黯淡的金色鳞片失了光泽，身披缟黑如缟玛瑙的长袍。他们倚着一根虬结法杖，杖身宛如盘绕的巨蛇；蛇口大张，衔着一枚乳白虹彩的圆球，散发着克制而诡异的微光。相似的光芒在他们眼眸深处的猩红里翻涌旋转。蒸汽自这生物獠牙森然的口中逸出，他们迈步向前，带着施法者那种不受束缚的自信——仿佛握有无法估量的力量，只在平静表面之下幽幽沸腾。

~ 设想 by GMroyaljeff

The dragonfolk stands taller than their brethren, an austere creature with tarnished golden scales and shrouded in onyx-black robes. They lean on a gnarled staff evoking a coiled serpent, its mouth agape and clutching an opalescent sphere that shimmers with a subdued, uncanny light. A similar light swirls in the crimson depths of their eyes. Steam issues from the creature’s fanged maw as they stride forward with the unfettered confidence of a spellcaster wielding untold power, just simmering beneath the placid surface.

~ Envisioned by GMroyaljeff

Loot From A Vampire Shade.name:
来自吸血鬼阴影的战利品
Loot From A Vampire Shade

Text.text:
在棺木上方潮湿霉烂的泥土里，你发现了一小把金币。共计 10 枚，被人撒入墓穴，作为逝者下葬前最后的献礼。看来曾有人怜惜并在乎长眠于此的受难灵魂。
In the wet, musty earth scattered over the coffin you find a small amount of gold. Each of the 10 pieces cast into the grave was the final tribute to the departed before burial. It seems someone cared for the tortured soul that lay here.

Floating Castle In Winter Sky.name:
冬日天空中的浮空城堡
Floating Castle In Winter Sky

Text.text:
高空之上，一道阴影逼近；在雪云之中，悬着一座不可能之物——一座城堡，一座要塞——高塔刺破雨层云的厚幕。高悬的旌旗被冬风拽得猎猎作响，窗棂玻璃冻得发白，城垛上缀满獠牙般的冰锥。
High in the sky a shadow looms, within the snow clouds an impossibility—a citadel, a fortress—tall towers tearing at the nimbostratus mass. Lofty pennants are tugged by winter winds, the glass of its windows is frozen and its battlements are festooned with fang-like ice.

Loot From A Green Lich.name:
绿巫妖的战利品
Loot From A Green Lich

Text.text: 巫妖丢下一本小书，封面如树皮般粗糙，书脊以芦苇编织而成。你一打开，它便皱缩扭曲，发出噼啪断裂的脆响，随即自行折叠塑形，化作一枚护符，形似一朵粗砺的木花。其上刻着一段只能诵读一次的咒文，用于巫妖的绽放接触能力。 The lich drops a small book with a cover of bark, the spine woven by reeds. When you open it, the book crumples and twists, makes snapping noises, then forms itself into a fetish that looks like a rough wooden flower. Carved into it is a single-use recitation for the lich's blossoming touch ability.

这家旅店让人想起人类聚居地里常见的那种客栈，只是有几处显眼的不同。既然这里招待的是龙裔，哪怕最纤细的高脚凳也被加宽加固，以承受龙血之躯那沉密的分量。店里没有卡座，只有零散的桌子与矮椅，所有椅背都被塑成能容纳翅膀的弧形。当壁炉里的火势渐弱时，一名伙计便从吧台后走出，往里添上燃料，随后从口中喷出一束烈焰，将火苗重新点燃。
This inn is reminiscent of those found in human settlements, with a few noticeable differences. Since this inn caters to the dragonborn, even the most slender stool has been broadly reinforced to accommodate the density of dragon-blooded bodies. There are no booths, just scattered tables with low chairs, the back of every chair shaped to accommodate wings. When the fire in the hearth dies down, an employee comes out from behind the bar and throws on fuel, reigniting it with a plume of flame expelled from their jaws.

Hidden Entrance To A Clockwork Dungeon.name:
通往发条地城的隐秘入口
Hidden Entrance To A Clockwork Dungeon

Text.text:
一块花岗岩巨板堵住去路，宛如坚不可摧的实心石墙。它沉重得远非人力所能撼动，但细细察看后，你发现地面上有一道深深的槽痕，使巨板得以相对轻松地滑动。其后，一场工程奇迹正等待着——黄铜、铜与白银闪烁生辉，繁复的钟表机括在抛光下熠熠生光。齿轮、滑轮与绞盘细小而精巧——然而这扇钟表之门看上去牢不可破、纹丝不动。每一处零件与构件边缘，都镌着细密到几乎难以察觉的符文，环绕门扉本身，并向内螺旋汇聚至锁闭机关。一阵微妙的嗡鸣自门与其后的通道中传来——那是魔法的暗示，纵使最迟钝的人也无法忽视。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

A granite slab blocks the path, an impenetrable wall of solid stone. Its weight is far too immense to move by hand, but after inspecting the slab closely, you find a deep rut in the ground allowing for the slab to slide with relative ease. Beyond, a marvel of engineering awaits—brass, copper, and silver gleam, and complex clockwork mechanisms shine with polish. The gears, pulleys, and winches are minute, delicate—and yet the clockwork door appears unbreakable, immovable. Fine, almost imperceptible runes line each piece and part, ringing the door itself and spiraling inward toward the locking mechanism. A subtle thrum emanates from the door and the passage beyond—a hint of magic that even the least perceptive among you cannot ignore.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Delusional, Overly Optimistic Big Tech E.name:
妄想成性、过度乐观的大型科技公司高管
Delusional, Overly Optimistic Big Tech Executive

Text.text:
“要我说，这主意值十亿美元！”男人大喊，丰厚的肚腩随着爽朗的笑声一阵阵抖动，他热情地拍了拍同伴的后背。他穿着与那些刻板印象里冷漠油滑的公司同僚如出一辙的西装，可那双明亮的眼睛与宽大的笑容里，却没有半点应有的犬儒。“真不敢相信以前居然没人想过自动出租车，”他接着说，就在几辆正好印着“自动出租车”的有轨车从旁悠然驶过时更显得讽刺。“你需要多少？”

~ 由一位英雄 构想

“That's a billion-dollar idea if I've ever heard one!” the man shouts, his substantial gut rippling as he laughs genially and slaps his companion on the back. He wears the suit to match his stereotypical jaded corpo colleagues, but his bright eyes and broad smile lack the expected cynicism. “I can't believe nobody’s ever thought of automated taxis before,” he continues, as several streetcars branded as exactly that cruise by. “How much do you need?”

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Inspiration About Writing A Song.name:
关于写一首歌的灵感
Inspiration About Writing A Song

Text.text:
“我要为你的人生写一首歌。就在此刻，你可以决定它会是一首悲伤的打油诗，还是一曲高飞的叙事长歌。”
“I’m going to write a song about your life. In this moment, you may decide if it will be a sad limerick or a soaring ballad.”

Crushed Under Claw.name:
爪下碾碎
Crushed Under Claw

Text.text:
利爪深深抠进你身周的泥土，你感到一股难以想象的重压狠狠压在胸口。肺叶骤然收紧，气息被硬生生挤出；紧接着，一连串突兀而刺痛的断裂声炸响，你清晰地感觉到肋骨一根接一根地崩裂塌陷。你拼命踢打那些利爪，用尽每一分力气向上挣起，可周遭的世界仍在迅速沉黑。你竭力想吸进一口气，血沫与空气搅在一起，你呛住，剧烈地咳嗽、窒息。

~ Ardzone 构想的 Envisioned

The claws dig into the earth around you, and you feel an immense weight press on your chest. Your lungs constrict as the breath leaves you, then with sudden, painful cracks, you feel your ribs give way one by one. You kick and strike against the claws, heave upward with every ounce of strength, but the world darkens around you. You struggle to take a breath, blood mingles with air, and you choke and cough.

~ Envisioned by Ardzone

Dovecote Of A Creepy Manor.name:
阴森宅邸的鸽舍
Dovecote Of A Creepy Manor

Text.text:
鸽舍里满是粪便，脏得令人作呕；风裹挟着一股腐臭而邪恶的气味，直扑你抽动的鼻翼。理智催促你立刻忘掉这里，可你的耳朵却捕捉到里面传来的移动声；你飞快一瞥，发现十多只鸽子正低头啄食那骇人的地面上的什么东西。它们起伏、咕咕作响的身躯下，压着的究竟是什么形状？
The dovecote is absolutely filthy with droppings, the wind carrying a foul, evil smell to your twitching nostrils. Despite common sense telling you to forget this place, your ears detect movement from within, and a quick glance reveals more than a dozen pigeons pecking at something on the ghastly floor. What is that shape beneath their heaving, cooing bodies?

Room Of Gruesome Trophies.name:
骇人战利品陈列室
Room Of Gruesome Trophies

Text.text:
一盏油灯从天花板垂挂下来，散出病态的惨白光，照亮一面陈列着骇人战利品的墙：有的战利品挂在铁钩上，有的摆在架子上。这里收集的大多是器官与肢体碎块，浸在腌渍罐里漂浮沉浮。一只青铜香炉安放在其中一层架上，焚着辛辣而甜腻的熏香，用以压住卤水的腥咸气味。这个阴森陈列最令人不寒而栗的中心，是一整张人形皮囊——皮革般发硬、泛着绿色，腋下被铁钩挑起悬挂。它那纸薄的手臂右侧的架子上，一颗被保存下来的女性头颅凝固在痛苦的尖叫里，眼睑深深凹陷。再往上一层的另一只罐中，两只爬行类的眼睛漂浮着，末端拖着粉色的触须状尾丝。
An oil lamp hung from the ceiling casts its sickly pale light on a wall of gruesome trophies: some prizes hanging from hooks, others displayed on shelves. Most of the items collected here are organs and other body parts floating in pickling jars. A bronze pot of spicy, sweet incense burns on one of the shelves to stave off the smell of brine. The unsettling centerpiece of this grim collection is a full humanoid skin, leathery and green, its armpits hanging on iron hooks. On a shelf to the right of its papery arm, a preserved feminine head is frozen in an agonized scream, her eyelids sunken in. In another jar, on the shelf above, two reptilian eyes with pink tendril tails float.

Beleaguered Convenience Store Cashier.name:
焦头烂额的便利店收银员
Beleaguered Convenience Store Cashier

Text.text:
倦怠像瘟疫般缠上收银员。他忧郁地望着墙上那只裂纹遍布的钟，暗自催促时辰快些溜走。他的制服又旧又脏，十几处污渍来自店里早已不再售卖的东西。一枚褪色的胸牌曾经友好地写着他的编号与姓名——那样的日子早已远去。
Lethargy plagues the cashier as he gazes forlornly at the cracked clock on the wall, willing the hours to speed by. His uniform is old, stained in a dozen places by things the store doesn’t even sell anymore. A faded badge once depicted his ID and name with a friendly greeting—those days are long gone.

卫兵们轮班进出这栋建筑。一名卫兵坐在门廊的摇椅上，目光沉稳不移，双手随时握紧一把上弦的弩。透过前窗，你看见一名颇有头领气势的卫兵叼着烟斗，俯身细读摊在桌上的巨大地图。她的手指在羊皮纸上指向不同区域，唇形无声地下达命令，脸庞被烟斗吐出的浓烟层层吞没。
Guards move in and out of the building in shifts. One sits in a rocking chair on the porch, gaze steady, his hands readily armed with a crossbow. Through the front window, one guard with the look of a leader smokes a pipe, poring over a large map laid upon a table. She points to different areas on parchment, mouthing orders as her face is smothered in a cloud of pipe smoke.

I Cast Chill Touch.name:
我施放「寒冷接触」
I Cast Chill Touch

Text.text:
一道迅捷省事的法术，总能在我需要援手时如约而至。只消片刻令人胆寒的言语，冰冷而脆硬的词句落下，那只手便出现在我敌人身侧。它的接触起初温柔——轻拍肩头，托起面颊——而后骤然收紧，死死缠住，拒不松开。
A quick and easy spell that delivers when I need a helping hand. It takes a moment of harrowing speech, cold and brittle words, but the hand appears next to my foe. Its touch is gentle, a tap on the shoulder, the cupping of a cheek—and then it constricts, refusing to let go.

低等元素生物或许可凭几个手势与咒语便能召来，但你所追求的，是更为强大的存在。为此，召唤之地与仪式材料必须与元素相合：以同类唤同类，以同质引同质。你所吟诵的词句亦将随之改变，取自原初语的不同支脉，编织出一段只属于你将召来的那位存在的迎辞。
Lesser elementals might be conjured with mere gestures and words, but you seek to summon a more powerful being. For that, the summoning place and components must align with the element: like with like with like. The words you chant change as well, drawing from different parts of the Primordial tongue to craft a welcome unique to the being you summon.

Arrival To The Elemental Plane Of Earth.name:
抵达土元素位面
Arrival To The Elemental Plane Of Earth

Text.text:
越过石门，眼前的大地看起来与离开时别无二致。随后，你听见泥与石被低声唤出的名字，岩层的絮语，流沙的嘶嘶声，火山的低吼，以及万物之下那永不停歇的碾磨。你能感到原初的板块移动，感到震颤。这才是大地真正的面貌。
Beyond the stone gate, the earth looks just the same as from where you left. Then you hear the whispered names of muds and stones, the voices of rock formations, the hiss of quicksand, the growl of a volcano, and the grinding under everything. You can feel the primeval tectonic movement, the quake. This is the earth’s true self.

尽管狗头人生来带着爬行类的生理特征，他们的地下巢穴却像一座被放大无数倍的鼠穴迷宫。空气里腐烂的气味浓得化不开——那是他们众所周知培育可食用蘑菇留下的痕迹。隧道又窄又矮，逼得你们大多数人只能手脚并用在地上爬行；它们在黑暗中分叉、扭曲，延伸成数不清的岔路与暗道。你屏息竖耳，试图捕捉陷阱或伏击的蛛丝马迹——你心知肚明，没有哪个狗头人会心甘情愿与敌人来一场公平的对决。
Although kobolds have reptilian biology, their subterranean lair resembles a rat warren writ large. The smell of rot is rich in the air, an artifact of their well-known cultivation of edible mushrooms. The tunnels are narrow and squat—forcing most of you to crawl on your hands and knees—branching and twisting into innumerable passages in the dark. You strain to hear signs of traps or ambush, knowing that no kobold willingly meets their opponent in a fair fight.

层层叠叠的多彩兽皮与毛皮拼合成一套朴素却极其可靠的护甲，内里厚实衬垫，足以将除最精准打击之外的攻击尽数偏斜。所用皮革并非寻常野兽之物——或许来自凶暴兽、天裔生物，乃至怪物般的猛兽。护甲上还点缀着獠牙与利爪，贴身而舒适，穿戴者移动自如，毫无滞碍。
Layers upon layers of multicolored hide and fur comprise a simple but effective suit of armor, padded to turn aside all but the most precise of blows. The hides used aren't those of mundane beasts—dire animals, planetouched creatures, or monstrous beasts perhaps. The armor, adorned also with fangs and claws, fits snugly and comfortably, allowing for complete ease of movement.

[察觉] 起初你以为那是一张古怪得过分的反光地毯，表面涂着旋涡与飞溅的色彩；可它其实是一滩积液。你试探着一碰，它像蜂蜜般被拉起一缕细丝，随即又弹回去凝固——胶水。

[触发] 地上的地毯呈圆形，涂满旋涡与飞溅的色彩，踩上去柔软无声，于是你借它来消减鞋声。走了两步，后脚却猛地被黏住。地毯纹丝不动，你这才意识到：你的双脚被牢牢粘在地板上了。

[Perceived] What at first appears to be a strangely reflective floor rug, painted in swirls and splashes of color, is a puddle. You test it to find that it pulls up from the floor in a strand like honey, then springs back and solidifies. Glue.

[Triggered] The rug on the floor, round and painted in swirls and splashes of color, will be soft and quiet under your feet, so you use it to muffle your shoes. Two steps and then your back foot sticks. The rug doesn’t budge, and you realize that your feet are glued to the floor.

Hall Of Rebirth.name:
重生之厅
Hall Of Rebirth

Text.text:
穿过未上锁的双扇门，是一间又长又空的房间。墙上绘着人们的图像——也许正是葬在此处的人——以及他们通往来世的旅程。亡者与蛇形生灵交谈，有些仅半身为蛇。旅程尽头，众人皆俯首于一条巨大的罩颈眼镜蛇之前：紫罗兰色鳞片，黄澄澄的眼睛。那蛇神吞噬亡者，而他们在其中重生，化作蜿蜒的蛇之形。
Past the unlocked double door is a long empty room. The walls bear images of people, maybe those buried here, and their journey to the afterlife. The dead speak with ophidian beings, some only part snake. In the end, everyone bows before a great, hooded cobra with violet scales and yellow eyes. The cobra-god consumes the dead, and they are reborn in snakelike forms.

Boudoir Of A Creepy Manor.name:
一座阴森宅邸的闺房
Boudoir Of A Creepy Manor

Text.text:
你踏入庄园女主人的闺房，口中立刻一阵发干。你细细查验室内，令人不安的细节渐渐浮出水面：地板上有十道浅浅的指甲抓痕，整整延伸了十六英寸之长，虽有人铺了地毯试图遮掩；而你几乎可以发誓，靠墙小几边缘那若隐若现的压痕，只可能是人类牙齿留下的——尽管有人费力用砂纸把凹陷磨淡了。
Your mouth goes dry as you enter the boudoir of the lady of the manor. As you inspect the room closely, worrisome details emerge: ten shallow gouges from fingernails stretch a full sixteen inches along the floorboards, though a rug has been placed in an attempt to conceal them, and you'd swear that the impressions barely visible on the edge of an end table could only have been made by human teeth, although some effort has been made to sand out the divot.

Betty's Boudoir, A Pirate Shop.name:
贝蒂闺房，海盗商店
Betty's Boudoir, A Pirate Shop

Text.text:
这艘不寻常的船在主甲板上固定着旋转纺轮与织机。每台器具旁，都有一名半兽人女裁缝——看起来更像举重选手——在缝制战斗服。另一些人调配染料，把一桶桶颜料抬到艏楼的染缸里。甲板下，更多半兽人挥动绳结般的肌肉臂膀当铁匠使唤。船长将法术编进船员手中织出的羊毛与锁链之中。等他们抵港，女人们把桌子抬出来，摆上货物，冲着行人吆喝报价。

~ Pirate King 所构想

This unusual ship is equipped with spinning wheels and looms anchored to the main deck. At each device, a half-orc seamstress who looks more like a weightlifter creates battle clothing. Others mix dye and carry buckets to a vat on the forecastle. Below deck, more half-orcs with arms of corded muscle work as smiths. The captain weaves spells into the wool and chain of the crew’s workmanship. When they reach the port, the women haul out tables and set them with the goods, barking out prices.

~ Envisioned by Pirate King

Sensible Family Station Wagon.name:
靠谱的家庭旅行车
Sensible Family Station Wagon

Text.text:
这辆车平平无奇到几乎让人忽略，仿佛小偷和劫车者的视线里根本不会为它停留。四门车的漆面虽有磨损，却干净整洁、被细心打理过，轮胎看起来是最近才换的。透过车窗能看到几件孩子的玩具和一些空零食包装纸。
The car is so unremarkable, it seems likely thieves and carjackers don’t even register it in their vision. The paint of the four-door is worn but clean and cared for, and the tires look recently replaced. A few children's toys and empty snack wrappers are visible through the windows.

Awakened In A Dream By A Dark Power.name:
在黑暗力量的梦中苏醒
Awakened In A Dream By A Dark Power

Text.text:
你眨了眨眼，发现自己置身于几乎彻底的黑暗之中。恐慌翻涌而起，你用意志将它压下，缓缓吐出一口稳定心神的气息。你刚才是在睡觉？还是被打昏了？你努力回想，却只抓到一团朦胧——记忆如流光般一闪即逝，迅速褪去。双眼逐渐适应这压迫的阴影，你开始辨出些细节：四壁、头顶的天花板、几件家具模糊的轮廓。你踉跄着站起，发现四肢怪异而飘忽，仿佛与你脱节；身体像是与意识断了线。就在这时，你忽然察觉房间里还有别的东西。不是人——而是一种存在。

~ Envisioned by Dan

You blink, finding yourself in almost utter darkness. Panic rises, and you will it down, easing out a steadying breath. Were you asleep? Knocked unconscious? You struggle to remember, but the memories are hazy—fleeting and fading quickly. Your eyes adjust to the oppressive shadows surrounding you, and you begin to make out details: walls, a ceiling above you, the vague silhouettes of furniture. You rise shakily, finding that your limbs feel odd and detached, that your body feels disconnected from your mind, and suddenly become aware of something else in the room with you. Not a person—a presence.

~ Envisioned by Dan

Adult Green Dragon.name:
成年绿龙
Adult Green Dragon

Text.text:
那头庞大的龙形生物将双翼紧紧收拢在蜥蜴般的躯干旁，悄然游弋。高耸的巨兽目光锐利而狡黠，鳞片呈惊艳的祖母绿。它鼻翼翕张，仿佛将你的气息一口吸入，从远处审视着你。它那弯曲而阴狠的利齿在近似冷笑的表情中一闪而过，喉间逸出一声嘶嘶低鸣，伴随一缕诡异、腐臭的毒气。你终于真正看清它的体型，那股异界般的压迫感瞬间攫住了你的恐惧。
The massive draconic creature, wings tucked tight against its reptilian frame, prowls. The towering beast's eyes are sharp and cunning, and its scales are a stunning emerald green. Its nostrils flare as it breathes you in, inspecting you from a distance. Its teeth, curved and wicked, flash in a kind of sneer, and a hiss of strange, putrid gas escapes the beast's throat. Fear grips you as fully reckon its size, its otherworldly presence.

The Sanctuary: Swamp.name:
圣所：沼泽
The Sanctuary: Swamp

Text.text:
薄雾贴着浑浊的绿水漂浮，半遮半掩着那些畸形的树木；它们的根须如枯槁扭曲的手指，伸进沼泽深处。苍蝇与蚊蚋的嗡鸣塞满空气。在一块较干的地面上，整齐摆着一排裂开的骨头，涂成猩红——这是“红祸”的标记，一群鼠人蛮族的象征。
Mists cling to the surface of murky green water, partially obscuring the misshapen trees whose roots extend like gnarled fingers into the swamp. The buzz of flies and mosquitoes fill the air. On a patch of drier land is a row of cracked bones painted red—a marker for the Red Scourge, a group of rat barbarians.

The Horror In The Shattered Mirror.name:
破碎镜中的恐怖
The Horror In The Shattered Mirror

Text.text:
镜面的碎片在月光下闪烁，镀金镜框上起舞的精灵生物咧嘴狞笑，恶意满溢，你踌躇着向前踏出一步。你猛地低头去看那些碎片，想确认先前见到的骇人景象是否仍在其中。你僵住了。映回来的不再是两只空洞的黑玛瑙眼睛——每一片碎镜里，都各自映出一双属于你自己的眼睛。破裂的玻璃开始渗出黑色液体——被困在镜中的东西，如今已被赐予自由。
The shards of the mirror sparkle in the moonlight, the dancing fey creatures on the gilded frame grinning at you malevolently as you take a hesitant step forward. You dart your head down to look into the shards, trying to see whether the horrific image you saw earlier is still there. You freeze. Instead of two soulless onyx eyes, each shard reflects its own pair right back at you. The broken glass begins to ooze with black liquid—whatever was trapped inside the mirror has now been bestowed its freedom.

Unlicensed Broadcast Tower.name:
无证广播塔
Unlicensed Broadcast Tower

Text.text:
岗哨布满建筑的入口与走廊。每一件播报装备——连改装的短天线也不例外——都装着轮子，只要一有风吹草动，立刻就能推走撤离。
Lookouts dot the entrances and hallways of the building. Every piece of broadcasting equipment—down to the modified short antenna—has wheels, ready to be rolled out at the first sign of trouble.

大到无法靠港，这艘船只能在海湾里抛锚等候。它侧舷对着岸线，炮列森然，尽是为击碎他船而生的巨炮；舷侧栏杆砌成垛口，便于火枪架稳射击。加固的船体沉重如铁，因此桅杆上加挂了更多帆布，繁复的索具交织成网。船身所饰的徽记与旗帜宣示着国家与传承——货舱与舱室则简陋利落，务求效率。它只有一个目的：赢下一场战斗。
Too massive to dock, the ship waits anchored in the bay. It sits broadside to the shore, displaying its strength with cannons designed to break other ships and crenellated rails for stabilizing firearms. Its reinforced hull is heavy, so the masts are fitted with extra sails, webbed with complicated rigging. The sigils and flags that adorn it are of nation and legacy—the hold and cabins sparse and efficient. It is a vessel of singular purpose: to win a fight.

Acid Rain On Toxic World.name:
毒雾世界的酸雨
Acid Rain On Toxic World

Text.text:
这个世界看上去像一张颗粒粗糙的旧照片：废弃的汽车、空洞的楼群、枯萎下垂的树木，以及覆着孱弱雪冠、稀稀拉拉往下渗流的群山。崩解显然已持续了多年。没有一处表面是平整的，一切都布满麻坑，塌陷下垂。若仍有人类存活，也必然已躲进某处避难，因为这颗星球正被自天空渗落的死亡所淹没。
The world appears as if in a grainy photograph of abandoned cars and hollow buildings, wilting trees, and mountains of weak, trickling snowcaps. The dissolution has obviously been going on for years. Not a surface is smooth, everything pockmarked and slumped. If there is human life, it has taken refuge somewhere, as the planet is awash in death seeping from the skies.

Abrash Delmirev The Dragonborn Oath Of D.name:
阿布拉什·德尔米列夫——龙裔·奉献誓言圣武士
Abrash Delmirev The Dragonborn Oath Of Devotion Paladin

Text.text:
映入眼帘的，是阳光在这位龙裔的乌黑如墨鳞片上流转的光影。他站在你面前的姿态极具压迫感：身形高大厚重；战锤与锁子甲上布满刮痕与擦伤，昭示着不久前才经历过战斗。然而，他那双爬行类般的绿色竖瞳，似乎完全容不下半分恶意——这一点又被他擦得锃亮的盾牌上、醒目展示的圣徽进一步印证。

~ 由 RPGBOT.net 的 Tyler 扮演

The play of sunlight over the dragonborn’s jet-black scales is the first thing you notice about the paladin standing before you, imposing in his height and heft, as well as the scrapes and scuffs on his warhammer and chain mail, signs of recent combat. Yet his eyes, a reptilian, slitted green, seem entirely incapable of embracing malice, an observation that is reinforced by the holy emblem displayed prominently on his burnished shield.

~ Played by Tyler from RPGBOT.net

这地方的陶器与餐具、桌布与亚麻、搅拌与调和的工具备货之齐全，连采买都得从门外开始。门旁悬着一块喜气洋洋的招牌，下面歪歪斜斜的编织篮子一摞摞叠成小塔，旁边是铁制烤炉，长凳上堆满了勺子与盘子。走进店内凉爽的阴影里，天花板仿佛也活了起来，锅具成串垂挂，铜锅与铁煎锅摇晃轻响；一张张白松木长桌上，则整齐陈列着成套的陶器与玻璃器皿。就在这满屋器物的中心，店主带着愉快的疲惫迎上前来。
The place is so well stocked with crockery and tableware, linens and mixing tools, that shopping begins outdoors. Under the cheerful shingle hanging beside the door, crooked stacks of woven baskets stand in little towers alongside iron baking ovens and benches piled with spoons and plates. In the cool shade inside the shop, the ceiling is alive with hanging pans, copper and iron skillets, and long white pine tables carry sets of pottery and glassware. In the midst of it all, the proprietor meets you with a happy exhaustion.

这片冰寒世界的蓝色峰峦以流畅的弧线直冲天穹，宛如巨大的海浪被零下严寒瞬间凝固。嶙峋山脉之间铺展着无垠的白：薄雪覆在纹丝不动的坚冰之上，荒寂的平原被刺骨狂风鞭挞，卷起雪粒，打成幽灵般的旋涡。在如此酷烈的环境里，能活下来的生灵寥寥无几，但无论野兽还是人类，都在天然洞窟中寻得栖身之所——那是通往冰川群山腹地的湿滑陡降。

~ 由 Tate 构想

The blue peaks of this frigid world swerve up into the sky in fluid arcs, like gargantuan ocean waves frozen by subzero temperatures. Between these jagged ranges are vast fields of white: thin layers of snow covering immovable ice, barren stretches stricken by biting winds that send the snow into ghostly whorls. Few creatures can survive such harsh conditions, but beasts and people alike find shelter in natural caves—slippery descents into the heart of the glacial mountains.

~ Envisioned by Tate

Desert Nomads' Tent.name:
沙漠游牧民的帐篷
Desert Nomads' Tent

Text.text:
这顶遮阳棚由结实的长杆、层层叠覆的地毯与精心鞣制的布料搭建而成；它看起来像一顶简朴的四人帐篷，正如三层高的旅店看起来像一间低矮的乡间小屋。它兼具实用与美感：地毯纹样绚丽，却也能在突如其来的沙暴中用绳索一拉便合拢封紧。几名成年人可在它阴翳的檐下安然就寝，床铺由长长的软垫铺成，舒适妥帖；每张床边都摆着一张木桌，供人用餐与掷骰消遣。
Constructed from stout poles, overlapping rugs, and carefully treated cloths, this shady canopy resembles a simple four-person tent in the way a three-story inn resembles a humble country cottage. This tent is built for both function and beauty, the rugs colorful in design but also able to be pulled shut with ropes in case of sudden sandstorm. Several adults may sleep comfortably within its shadowed eaves on comfortable beds made up of long cushions, with wooden tables at each bedside for meals and gaming purposes.

Hot Weather Coastline.name:
炎热天气的海岸线
Hot Weather Coastline

Text.text:
浪涛轻柔地掷上沙滩，悠扬的涛声与眼前的宁静景致相互应和。万里无云的钴蓝天空下，烈日炙烤。洁白无瑕的海滩上，半裸的渔夫们忙着讨生活：或抛撒渔网，或手持鱼叉潜入碧绿的深处。一位美人鱼倚在礁石上晒着太阳，梳理长发，尾鳍在浅滩里拍打，溅起细碎水花。
Waves roll gently up the beach, their melodic song matching the serene view. The sun beats down from a cobalt sky devoid of clouds. From the pure white beach half-naked fishers ply their trade: casting out their nets or diving down into the turquoise depths, harpoon in hand. A mermaid combs her hair, basking on a rock in the sun, her tail splashing in the shallows.

一座庞大的死者之城在你眼前铺展开来，破碎的城墙为遍地瓦砾的道路投下阴影。某处坍塌的建筑间忽然惊起一群鸽子，盘旋着升入高空，又在这迷宫般的废墟另一处落下。有些高塔仍然屹立——像蛋糕上的蜡烛——你还看见几座庞然大物，或许曾是神殿或行会大厅；但时代早已磨碎了它们的诸多特征，把一切漂洗成同一种石色。
A vast necropolis sprawls before you, its shattered walls shadowing rubble-strewn roads. A flock of pigeons rises from somewhere amid the tumbled structures and circles high in the air before settling elsewhere in the labyrinth. Some towers still stand—like candles in a cake—and you see large structures that might have once been temples or guildhalls, but time has crumbled many identifying features and bleached everything into a uniform color of stone.

那名类人生物身形纤细、线条轻灵，举手投足带着近乎超自然的优雅，脚步轻得仿佛将要离地飘起。她的天蓝色肌肤沐着日光，泛出几近虹彩的微光。及肩的薄雾般白发掖在略微修长的耳后，像被风轻轻拨弄。她开口说话，声音宛如风穿林梢，簌簌作响。

~ 构想：JP Delofski

The humanoid is slim, lithely built, and moves with an almost supernatural grace, nearly floating off the ground she steps so lightly. Her sky-blue skin, kissed by sunlight, shines with an almost iridescent quality. Shoulder-length, wispy white hair lies tucked behind slightly elongated ears, appearing teased by the wind. She speaks, and her voice is like wind rustling trees.

~ Envisioned by JP Delofski

翠绿的田野环抱着河流的一处弯道，弯道之外立着一个小村庄。牛、羊和山羊全都放在外头：有的卧在草间，有的安然啃食，还有的嬉闹蹦跳。它们个个神态欢畅、膘肥毛亮。奇怪的是，放牧人和看家犬的身影却一个也不见。
Green fields surround a bend in a river, beyond which stands a small village. Cows, sheep, and goats are all out, some lying in the grass, some munching peaceably upon it, and others gamboling in play. The animals all look happy and healthy. Oddly, no shepherd or watchdogs are in sight.

墙上别无装饰，只有法术的示意图，以及魔杖、法珠或法杖的施法动作轨迹。屋顶低矮，粗重的暗色横梁压在头顶，其下整齐排着一列列深而方正的书桌。每张桌面都能掀开，学生们将引动异界效应的法术投进其中施放。教室前端立着一座石制小亭，教授或某位学有所成的学生可在此演示法术。本职业课堂的核心争论，是塑能与咒法之间那几乎无法分辨的界线——这一难题已令学者困惑了数代。
Nothing adorns the walls but diagrams of spells and the action patterns of wand, orb, or staff. The roof is low, with heavy dark beams, under which are ranks of deep and boxy desks. Each desktop opens, and student spells evoking effects from other realms are cast into them. At the head of the class is a stone booth, where the professor or a successful student may demonstrate a spell. The principal point of discussion in this class is the indistinguishable nature between evocation and conjuration that has perplexed scholars for generations.

你从未见过一处地方被宗教热忱吞没到这种程度。神祇与其他神圣灵体仿佛既深嵌于日常起居，又被郑重其事地奉为庆典。每间店铺都有神龛，每个街角都有雕像，四面八方尽是庙宇。若日日皆为圣日，又有谁还能把活儿干完？
Never have you seen a place so consumed with religious fervor. Gods and other divine spirits seem both embedded in daily life and specially celebrated. Every shop has a shrine, every corner a statue, and you see temples in every direction. When every day is a holy day, how does anyone get any work done?

一群风格迥异、令人过目难忘的人物正等着你投去目光，其中几位的奥术天赋几乎写在脸上。一名身形修长的精灵女子，裹着半透的深红衣衫，站在一位法师身旁——那法师身高不过两英尺，袖珍的手掌里托着一团火球。她旁边是一名健壮的红发矮人，结实的肚腩藏在磨旧的皮围裙下，围裙上还沾着几缕从他那把壮丽胡须间落下的散毛。矮人左侧站着一名披着破损护甲的兽人，铁一般的肌肉在绿色皮肤下起伏，他双臂交叉，带着不信任的目光死死盯着你。
A disparate crew of striking individuals awaits your notice, some with obvious arcane talents. A willowy elven woman in sheer crimson clothing stands beside a mage—no more than two feet high—with a fireball in her diminutive hand. Beside her stands a hardy red-haired dwarf, his robust belly hidden beneath a scuffed leather apron dusted with stray hairs fallen from his magnificent beard. To his left stands an orc in battered armor, iron-hard muscles rippling beneath green skin as he crosses his arms and stares at you with distrust.

Victory Line About Dying Quickly.name:
关于迅速死去的胜利台词
Victory Line About Dying Quickly

Text.text: “你这就要死了？可我才刚开始觉得有意思呢。” “Are you dying already? Because I just started having fun.”

Underwater Skeleton Army.name:
水下骷髅军团
Underwater Skeleton Army

Text.text:
你凝望着水中自己的倒影，浑浊的水里渐渐浮现出形状。视野随之黯淡，翠绿的云雾旋卷而生，将水池化作一面阴森的镜子，镜中满载阴影。随后，他们来了。不安息的亡者踏步而出，身披诅咒者的破烂褴褛与锈蚀的护甲，塞满了颤动的水面——他们被漂白、崩裂的骨骸在非自然的魔法中再度获得了生命。
Shapes form in the murky water as you gaze at your reflection. The vision darkens as green clouds swirl into being, transforming the pool into a foreboding mirror laden with shadow. Then they come. The unquiet dead, marching in the tattered rags and rusting armor of the damned, fill the trembling waters—their bleached, crumbling bones given new life by unnatural magics.

Furred Alien Restaurateur.name:
毛绒外星餐馆老板
Furred Alien Restaurateur

Text.text:
那女人自信与老练几乎要从身上炸开来，她轻盈地落座在吧台的高脚凳上，朝柜台后的男人微微点头致意。名牌套装贴服地披在她优雅、修长的灰色皮毛身躯上，举手投足尽是财富与地位的派头。她含笑接过饮品，随后如烟般飘向餐厅后方用绳索隔开的楼梯，拾级而上，径直走向办公室。
Bristling with confidence and sophistication the woman alights delicately on a stool at the bar, tipping a nod to the man behind the counter. A designer suit drapes her elegant, sleek, gray-furred body and she bears all the trappings of wealth and status. After accepting her drink with a smile she drifts toward the roped-off staircase at the back of the restaurant and makes her way to the office.

Forest Crossroads.name:
森林十字路口
Forest Crossroads

Text.text:
道路自十字路口向外分岔：铺石的大道与走得发亮的小径，泥泞的车辙与若有若无的岔路。没有任何路标指向它们的终点。
Paths branch out from the crossroads: cobbled roads and well-worn trails, muddy tracks and faint byways. No signs mark their destinations.

在你周遭的岩壁中撕裂穿行的，是二十尺长的蠕形恐怖。它覆鳞的蛇躯以阴鸷的优雅起伏游动，带刺的尾巴在你面前刮擦地面，像是在熟悉这片新开的杀戮场。它以无眼的凝视钉住你，巨口骤然张开，露出一座噩梦般的深窟，内壁层层排布着匕首般锋利的尖齿。它开始以婴孩般的渴求吮吸空气，你体内的恶心随之膨胀翻涌。下颚突出的獠牙颤动着，带着镰刃般的迫切杀意。
Ripping through the rock around you is twenty feet of vermiform dread. Its scaled, serpentine body undulates with sinister grace, a spiked tail raking across the ground before you as it familiarizes itself with the new killing field. It fixes you with its eyeless gaze as its maw gapes wide, revealing a nightmare cavern lined with rows of dagger-sharp teeth. Sickness swells in you as it begins to suckle at the air with infantile need. The jutting tusks of its lower mandible quiver in scything anticipation.

White Rose Dripping Blood.name:
白玫瑰滴落鲜血
White Rose Dripping Blood

Text.text:
一朵白玫瑰在月光下妖艳夺目，像一位淑女倚在贵妃榻上般，静静躺在门廊。花瓣分毫不乱，仿佛这枚信物是被人以极尽轻柔的心思郑重摆放。若不是带刺的花茎上正淌落一滴滴浓稠的鲜血，它本会是一份令人惊艳的赋礼。
A white rose, lurid under the moonlight, lies on the porch like a lady upon a chaise. With no petal out of place, it seems this token has been placed with delicate care. It might have been a stunning gift—if not for the thick droplets of blood that fall from its thorny stem.

Vampire's Manor: Chapel.name:
吸血鬼的庄园：礼拜堂
Vampire's Manor: Chapel

Text.text:
木质长椅沿着这座巨型礼拜堂的纵深一排排延伸，大多已碎裂成残片。高耸的窗框曾镶着彩绘玻璃，如今却敞开着，任凭风霜侵入，一股刺骨寒风在空间中呼啸穿行。血红的地毯一路铺向台阶与升起的讲台。尘土覆满每一寸表面，而在成堆的垃圾与残骸间，你捕捉到几道淡淡的足迹，朝着讲台上的石质祭坛后方延伸。
Wooden pews, most of them shattered, line the length of the massive chapel. The towering windows, once set with stained glass, now stand open to the elements, allowing a frigid wind to race through the space. A blood-red carpet leads to stairs and a raised dais. Dust covers every surface, and in the piles of refuse, you detect faint tracks heading behind the stone altar on the dais.

它斜倚在一张打磨得光亮、颜色几乎与它肌肤无异的桌上——曲线与长颈构成的杰作，优雅而慵懒，缀着闪烁如露的丝弦。它会向弓弦歌唱，能催人入眠或将人唤醒，能轻挠心弦或阴魂不散；能在篝火旁狂舞旋转，也能以摄魂夺魄的美，将天鹅绒般的大厅灌满。
It reclines on a polished table nearly the same color as its skin, this masterpiece of curves and a long neck, elegant, languid, dressed in glistening strings. It sings to the bow and can lull or awaken, tickle or haunt, dance wildly around a fire or fill a velvet hall with captivating beauty.

Neuroimaging Cap.name:
神经影像头帽
Neuroimaging Cap

Text.text:
这顶帽子由紧致的紫罗兰色毡布制成，内部交织着一张金属丝网，并用皮革绑带固定在头上，绑带在下巴下扣紧。数束导线汇聚，连向一个扁平的木盒；木盒四角包着黄铜，侧面装有发电机道具曲柄。盒盖嵌着一扇玻璃窗，上面蚀刻着大脑各个地区的地图，透过玻璃能看到下方一排排裸露的导线端头。帽子戴稳后，操作者转动曲柄，导线随即逐一亮起，显现佩戴者在不同刺激下产生的电信号反应。
The cap is a tight felt of violet, woven through with a wire webbing that is held against the head by leather straps buckled under the chin. A cluster of wires leads to a flat wooden box cornered in brass and with a generator gear crank on the side. The top has a glass window, etched with a map of the brain’s regions, that reveals an arrangement of exposed wire ends beneath it. When the cap is set, the reader turns the crank, and the wires light up to reveal the wearer’s electrical signals in response to various stimuli.

Speech About Fear By An Old Criminal.name:
老罪犯的恐惧演讲
Speech About Fear By An Old Criminal

Text.text:
“让人害怕的感觉真爽。我干这事干了很久。想要什么就拿什么，看他们吓得尿湿裤子、浑身发抖，我就觉得刺激。可那时我不明白，他们泪痕斑驳的眼睛后面并不是屈服，而是一个寄望。寄望有一天能战胜那个夺走他们力量的怪物。让它也明白什么叫恐惧。如今这怪物老了，病了。我害怕，那笔账就要来讨了。”
“Feels good, making people scared. Did it for a long time. Took what I wanted and got a kick out of watching them tremble in their own piss. But what I didn’t understand then was that it wasn’t submission behind their tear-stained eyes, it was a promise. To one day overcome that monster that had robbed them of their power. To make it understand their fear. And now this monster is old and sick. I’m afraid that bill is coming due.”

Temple Of Healing.name:
治疗神殿
Temple Of Healing

Text.text:
一小群人排在这座朴素的小礼拜堂外，队伍蜿蜒成线。一个上了年纪的男人沉沉倚着一个男孩，明显把重心从左脚上挪开；旁边是三名醉醺醺的士兵，嘴唇裂开、眼眶乌青。一个女人高声喊道：“让开！”队伍便窸窣挪动，给一位女祭司和两名侍祭让出通道——他们抬着一名昏迷不醒的男人，他的头部正汩汩淌血。
A small group of people form a line outside this humble chapel. There’s an older man leaning heavily on a boy, clearly keeping weight off his left foot, and a trio of inebriated soldiers, split-lipped and black-eyed. A woman shouts, “Make way!” And the line shuffles aside to allow the passage of a priestess and two acolytes carrying an unconscious man bleeding freely from his head.

Dragon Scale Mail.name:
龙鳞锁子甲
Dragon Scale Mail

Text.text:
这套精制护甲在光下熠熠生辉，完美展现出鳞甲的精工之美。鳞片层层叠覆，前后相扣，织成近乎不可穿透的护网。虽呈金属光泽，鳞片却轻盈柔韧，灵活贴体，却又在最致命的打击前显出分明的刚硬。肩甲、护手与胫甲上嵌饰着犄角与獠牙，尽皆向上弯起，为抵御利刃提供额外支援——整套护甲勾勒出一条庞大巨龙昂首欲喷吐龙息的剪影。
The masterwork armor gleams beneath the light, a demonstration of perfectly worked scale mail. The scales overlap, one after the other, creating a nigh-impenetrable weave. Though metallic in appearance, the scales are light and supple, perfectly flexible, and yet clearly rigid against even the most deadly blow. Horns and teeth adorn the suit’s pauldrons, gauntlets, and greaves, all curving upward and providing additional support against blades—the suit evokes the silhouette of a massive dragon, rearing to unleash their breath.

公主如鸟般栖在王家看台上，背脊挺直，颈项端凝，贵胄风范尽显。她所坐的大椅几乎将她衬得渺小，她身上的礼服亦然——天鹅绒与珍珠堆叠成一团张扬华丽的云瀑。众人无不钦慕她的优雅与风姿，她守夜般凝望着骑士们为荣耀与荣誉而冲锋比武。
The princess perches in the royal stand like a bird, back straight, head poised, a picture of nobility. The large chair she sits upon dwarfs her, as does the regal gown she wears—a flamboyant mass of velvet and pearls. Her elegance and grace are admired by all, as she watches the knights joust for glory and honor.

你发现自己被一片葱郁繁盛的荒野包围。树木高大得惊人，足有物质位面所见的两倍之巨，巍然压顶，浓密延展的树冠在头顶交织，令林间沉入重重阴影。森林仿佛在你周身扭动，随着居民的出没而呼吸起伏——各式各样的野兽在其间穿行，每一只都比上一只更狡黠。
You find yourself surrounded by a lush, teeming wilderness. Trees, half-again as large as those you might find on the Material Plane, loom overhead, shadowing the forest with their dense, reaching canopies. The forest writhes around you, breathing and undulating with the coming and going of its denizens—beasts of all shapes and sizes, each more cunning than the last.

Rocket Launcher Fired.name:
火箭筒开火
Rocket Launcher Fired

Text.text:
你扣下触发，火箭弹从发射器的炮管里飞窜而出，咆哮如脱缰的地狱猎犬，尖啸着撕裂长空。尾焰废气刺得你双眼生痛，随即那股瘴雾在旋涡般的云团中渐渐散去。
You depress the trigger and the rocket flies from the launcher’s barrel, roaring like an unleashed hellhound as it screams through the air. The exhaust fumes sting your eyes before the miasma dissipates in a swirling cloud.

Bandit Winter Camp.name:
强盗冬季营地
Bandit Winter Camp

Text.text:
狂风在林间空地里呼啸，宛如受伤的女妖哀嚎；刺痛的冰雹噼啪砸落，在下方粗陋的棚屋上乱响。从你的高处望去，大多数强盗都躲在屋里，只有一个孤零零的哨兵——裹在一团毛皮里，几乎看不清人形——蜷缩在一堆可怜的火苗旁。木箱与板条箱堆在建筑边，遮雨油布在狂烈的风势中抽打翻飞。
The wind howls through the glade like a wounded banshee, the stinging hail clattering on the crude huts below. From your vantage point you can see that most of the bandits are inside, but a solitary guard—obscured in a mass of furs—huddles near a pitiful fire. Crates and boxes are stacked near the buildings, their protective tarps flapping in the fury of the gale.

Crym Delimber.name:
克莱姆·德林伯姆
Crym Delimber

Text.text:
这男人走路带着一股张扬的派头，目光扫视四周，眼眸是异世般的银色，嘴角随时挂着一抹得意的坏笑。完美的金色发丝垂落，围住他无瑕的古铜面庞。他的双手指节修长，肌理光滑，打理得一丝不苟。合身而精致的衣装与一件压纹皮革双排扣上衣，勾勒出他精瘦的身形。他两侧胯间各佩一把剑，右侧那把更短。较长剑旁挂着一只绣纹小袋，内装一支珐琅排箫，他的左手总是不自觉地掠过它。

~ 扮演者：一位英雄，

This man moves with swagger, gazing around with otherworldly silver eyes and a ready smirk. Perfect golden locks surround his unblemished bronze face. His hands are long-fingered, smooth, and kept meticulously tidy. Equally fine and fitted clothing and a doublet of embossed leather accent his lean frame. He carries a sword on each hip, the shorter blade to his right. An embroidered pouch alongside the longer blade holds an enameled pan flute, which his left hand persistently brushes against.

~ Played by a Hero with

你踏入店铺时，店主正忙着在光洁的木质柜台后为几层货架补货。他抬头向你露出温暖的笑容，抬手示意你进来，眼角那几道愉快的笑纹立刻让你放松下来。你不仅被欢迎进入他的店里，更真切地感觉到——你的到来让他这一天都亮了起来。
The shopkeeper is busily stocking some shelves behind the polished wooden counter as you enter his place of business. He smiles warmly as he gestures you inside, the pleasant laugh lines at his eyes setting you immediately at ease. Not only are you welcome inside his establishment, you genuinely feel you have made his day.

风暴如一尊黑貂巨神骤然爆发，乌黑云涛在地平线上翻涌，宣告它盛怒的降临。空气仿佛一支暴怒的乐团，电光将至的躁动在其中脉动，一曲狂烈交响与迫近的混乱同声共振。咆哮的狂风成形，抽打、撕扯着沿途的一切。轰然的雨点重锤般砸向树冠，将大地改写成自然暴怒的洪流。
The storm erupts like a sable titan, ebon clouds billowing across the horizon, proclaiming its wrathful arrival. Like an orchestra of rage, the air throbs with voltaic anticipation, a raging symphony harmonizing with imminent chaos. Howling winds form, thrashing and clawing at everything in their path. The thunderous raindrops batter the trees, transforming the landscape into a flood of natural fury.

一条由扁平石块铺成的小径通向一口低矮井墙的圆形石井。它想必已为旅人服务了数十年。你不禁猜想是谁挖了它——也许曾有人在此经营过一座农场？井的木质掩蔽斜倚在井边，桶与绳索还系在上面。
A little path of flat stones leads up to the low walls of a round stone well. The well must have served travelers for decades. You wonder who dug it. Perhaps someone had a farm here once? A wooden cover for the well leans against it, with a bucket and rope attached.

Cave Painting Of Pterosaurs Flying.name:
翼龙翱翔的洞穴壁画
Cave Painting Of Pterosaurs Flying

Text.text:
洞壁上以红色黏土绘着巨大的有翼生物——体型远比旁边描绘的鸟类庞大得多。它们头部的锥形轮廓尤为怪异，与你此前所见的任何生物都截然不同。它们仿佛正掠过一片浩瀚海洋，下方以起伏的蓝色波纹线条加以描绘。
Huge winged creatures—far larger than the birds drawn beside them—are painted on the cave walls in red clay. The conical shape of their heads is most curious and unlike anything you have seen before. They appear to be flying over a vast ocean, depicted in wavy blue lines below.

Bloody Vampiric Skull.name:
血腥吸血鬼骷髅头
Bloody Vampiric Skull

Text.text:
一束光斜斜切过一抹獠牙森然的狞笑，掠过一侧瘦削颧骨——那儿早已无皮可覆；黑暗中的骷髅，正与卑劣行径同谋。空气里残留着一丝铁锈般的血腥味。阴影笼罩的眼窝骤然迸燃，幽暗随之溃散，深沉的猩红光芒迅速吞没一切。
A shaft of light cuts across a fanged grin, a gaunt cheekbone bereft of skin—a skull in the dark, party to foul deeds. A tang of iron lingers in the air. The shadowed eye sockets suddenly flare, the gloom dissolving as a deep crimson glow takes over.

Thomas Liadon.name:
托马斯·利亚登
Thomas Liadon

Text.text:
那男人在拥挤的人群间旋舞穿梭，宛如一阵洋溢欢愉的旋风；他的手指拨弄鲁特琴，轻快的旋律一下一下勾住脚尖，而他又扬起那蛊惑人心的嗓音放声歌唱。金色卷发随着步伐弹跳，绿眸里笑意粼粼，他以耀眼的光彩令众人目眩，用毫不费力的魅力将他们牢牢攫住。尽管一件铆钉皮护甲挂在他纤瘦的身形上，他的动作仍旧柔韧敏捷；你隐约觉得——若有需要——他腰间那柄细剑也会在他手中同样娴熟。

~ Played by Ethan

The man dances through the crowd like a whirlwind of effervescent joy, as his hands coax jaunty, foot-tapping melodies from a lute and he raises his bewitching voice in song. With bouncing golden locks and green eyes sparkling with mirth he dazzles the crowd, captivating them with effortless charm. His movements are lithe and agile despite the studded leather armor hanging from his slender frame, and you get the sense that—if needed—he would be just as skilled with the rapier at his hip.

~ Played by Ethan

Fallow Fields From The Summer Crop.name:
夏收之后的休耕田
Fallow Fields From The Summer Crop

Text.text:
村里几座农舍周围的田地如今已有好几块撂了荒——早春播种，夏末收割。你闭上眼便能轻易勾勒出那幅景象：勤劳的农人弓着腰埋头劳作，趁着秋天天气变脸之前，匆匆把庄稼抢收入仓。
Several of the fields around the farmhouses of the village are now fallow, having been planted in the early spring and harvested in the late summer. In your mind’s eye it is easy to imagine the hardworking farm folk bent over their labors, rushing to bring in the crops before the autumn weather turns.

Mountain Approach During Winter.name:
冬日山道逼近
Mountain Approach During Winter

Text.text:
一阵寒意窜过脊背，却与冷风无关。此地的怨恨一定浓得化不开，连山都不愿触碰它——岩体在它四周层层崩离，退成一圈圈断裂的边缘，留下中央一方裸露的石台，其上陈列着一幅令人作呕的骇人景象。

一条小径穿过积雪，在一列列弯曲的石柱间蜿蜒；那些柱子像折断的肋骨，森然指向夜空。小径通向祭坛的台阶，火把亮得刺眼，将石阶照得惨白。再往前——最可怖、也最令人迷惑的——一具如山岳般巨大的山羊形骸骨矗立着，鼻端深深抵入地面，弯曲的角被抛向灰色天穹。

还有更多可看之处，但此刻你的目光被它空洞眼眶之间的一道三角切口牢牢攫住。那痕迹像是不久前才用鲜血涂抹过。
A chill runs through you that has nothing to do with the cold. This place must be so hateful even the mountain avoids touching it, breaking away in rings around it and leaving a table of rock upon which stands a ghastly tableau. A path treads through the snow between a series of curved pillars shaped like broken ribs. It leads up the steps of an altar, illuminated by powerfully lit torches. And beyond that, most horrible and bewildering of all, a titanic goat-like skull stands, its nose pressed into the ground and curved horns thrown to the gray sky. There’s more to behold, but for the moment your attention is drawn to a triangle cut between the skull’s empty eye sockets. It looks like it has recently been painted with blood.

Loot From A Triceratops.name:
三角龙的战利品
Loot From A Triceratops

Text.text:
在这具生物静止不动的躯体上，你注意到它的角与前腿上缠着色彩斑斓的饰带。鲜艳的染料浸透布料，被织成令人目眩的几何纹样，布面还镶缀着宝石。若是卖给识货的买家，这些能值150枚金币。
On the creature’s still form, you notice that colorful bands adorn its horns and forelegs. Brightly colored dyes saturate the cloth, worked into mesmerizing geometric patterns, and the fabric is adorned with precious stones. These would be worth 150 gold pieces to the right buyer.

一道巨浪汹涌而至，先是拔地而起，继而轰然砸落，咆哮震耳。水流向四面八方奔涌，顷刻间灌满每一处可容纳的空间。随即，就在它砸落般突兀的瞬间，它又再度升起，令人费解。

这一次，浪潮高高耸立，诡异而反常的扭动将它推至极致的高度。一个轮廓渐渐成形——人形，四肢向外伸展，一张模糊的面孔自上而下怒视。伴着雷鸣般的咆哮，宛如浪涛撞击礁石，那元素之躯再度猛然出击。
A wave surges, rising then crashing down with a roar. The water rushes in all directions, filling every available space in an instant. And then, as suddenly as it crashed down, it rises up once more, inexplicably. This time, the wave looms upward, and strange, unnatural movements bring it to its full height. A shape forms, humanoid, limbs stretching outward, and a vague face glaring downward. With a roar like thunder, like waves crashing against rocks, the elemental form strikes once more.

Quip About Following Through On A Plan.name:
关于贯彻执行计划的俏皮话
Quip About Following Through On A Plan

Text.text:
“要不就这一次，我们先简短聊聊，定个大概的计划，然后真照着做？我知道外头一热闹就让人热血上头，但我保证，就算不把一切点成火海，我们照样能干出惊天动地的大事。”
“What if, just this once, we have a quick chat beforehand, come up with some sort of plan, and actually stick to it? I know things get very exciting out there, but I promise we can still accomplish incredible things without lighting everything on fire.”

Wild Magic Surge: Resistance.name:
狂野魔法涌动：抗力
Wild Magic Surge: Resistance

Text.text:
回应你的咒术，狂野的魔法在你周身凝结成形，化作一套幽影般的护甲，闪耀如虹彩甲虫的甲壳。披上它，你仿佛足以抵御迎面而来的任何攻击。
In answer to your sorcery, raw magic crystallizes around you to form a spectral suit of armor, gleaming like the chitin of an iridescent beetle. With it, you feel like you could weather any attack that comes your way.

Overheard Troll Conversation About Prepa.name:
无意间听到的巨魔闲聊：关于备餐
Overheard Troll Conversation About Preparing A Meal

Text.text:
“我知道这味儿冲得要命，但肉真香。你得先把那层壳——它们老披着的那些布片——给剥掉，然后把它前面那块撕开。最肥最汁的都在那儿。”
“I know it stinks, but it’s good eating. You just got to get rid of that shell—the pieces of cloth they’re always wearing—then rip its front part open. That’s where the juiciest bits are.”

I Cast Ice Storm From My Staff Of Frost.name:
我举起寒霜法杖，施放【冰风暴】
I Cast Ice Storm From My Staff Of Frost

Text.text:
法杖在我唤起暴风雪的怒威时，猛然炸开一团刺骨的魔法寒爆。点点冰蓝光尘自杖首激射升空，凝成旋卷朦胧的云雾，其间穿梭着脉动的极地寒光。我将法杖猛然砸下，仿佛重击大地——云团随即在震耳欲聋的轰鸣中轰然引爆，巨大的冰雹如陨石般倾泻坠地。
The staff erupts in a blast of freezing magic as I call forth the wrath of a blizzard. Motes of ice-blue light shoot from the staff’s head into the air, forming swirling, nebulous clouds threaded with pulsing arctic lights. I bring the staff down, as if striking the ground, and the clouds detonate in a cacophonous boom as immense hailstones fall to the earth.

Signs Of Destruction In A Town Square.name:
城镇广场上的毁灭征兆
Signs Of Destruction In A Town Square

Text.text:
广场上的鹅卵石堆成一摞摞，地面布满巨大的坑洞，仿佛一场草率的施工半途而废，骤然停工。摊位碎裂成一地残骸，彩色篷布如今被撕扯得破破烂烂，肮脏而皱缩。附近建筑的立面也显出受损痕迹，却仍勉强屹立。你看见碎裂的窗户、弯折的壁灯托架、被刮擦得斑驳的门板，仿佛一辆马车——或是更庞然的东西——曾狠狠撞上这里。

~ 构想：Steve Adamski

The cobblestones of the square lie in piles, and wide holes riddle the ground, as if a haphazard construction effort had been paused halfway through its progress. Stalls lie in splintered shambles, colored tarps now torn, filthy, and crumpled. The façades of nearby buildings show signs of damage, though they still stand. You see shattered windows, bent sconces, and scraped doors, as if a horse-drawn cart—or something even larger—has smashed against them.

~ Envisioned by Steve Adamski

Gnarg The Half-orc Berserker.name:
格纳格——半兽人狂战士
Gnarg The Half-orc Berserker

Text.text:
他宽阔的肩背肌肉线条分明，只是随手将磨刀石沿着巨斧刃口一抹，筋肉便如波纹般起伏。他身上不着护甲——这习惯让他遍体伤疤，想必是数十场战斗留下的印记。他从手上的活计里抬起头，微微偏转，露出獠牙外突的嘴与沉重的眉骨。那半兽人知道你在看。

~ 由 RPGBOT.net 的 Tyler 扮演

The pronounced muscles of his broad shoulders and back ripple with the simple action of brushing a whetstone along the blade of his greataxe. He wears no armor, a practice that has resulted in many scars from what must have been dozens of battles. He lifts his head from his task, turning it slightly to reveal a tusked mouth and heavy brow. The half-orc knows you’re looking.

~ Played by Tyler from RPGBOT.net

Deal With The Devil.name:
与恶魔交易
Deal With The Devil

Text.text:
端坐在一座由黑暗铸成的王座上的是一道长角的身影，猩红的皮肤被两点猩红幽光投下的阴森影子所笼罩。他以蹄足立起，踏入光中，余下的面容随之显露。黑色山羊胡勾勒出的嘴角扭成狡黠的笑，露出一口过于锋利、耀目惨白的利齿。那压迫感十足的身躯高高俯视着你，身披上等丝绸与亚麻。右手修长的手指紧紧攥着权杖——夜色般漆黑，杖头镶着一枚切割出666个切面的红宝石，在光里凶狠闪烁；每一道折射都把受尽折磨的灵魂影像投在四周的表面上。他以天鹅绒般的嗓音问道：“我们开始吧？”
Seated at a throne cast in darkness is a horned form, crimson skin cast with sinister shadows from two glowing red points of light. He stands on hoofed feet and steps into the light, revealing the rest of his face. His mouth, framed by a dark goatee, is curled in a devious grin, revealing a mouth full of too-sharp scintillatingly white teeth. His imposing figure towers over you, garbed in high-quality silks and linen. The long thin fingers of his right hand, each ending in a pitch-black pointed claw, firmly grasp his staff—night-black, topped with a ruby cut with 666 facets that glimmer menacingly in the light, each refraction projecting images of tortured souls onto the surrounding surfaces. He asks in a velvet tone, " Shall we begin?"

A Tripwire Triggers A Spray Of Acid.name:
绊线一触即发，酸液四溅
A Tripwire Triggers A Spray Of Acid

Text.text:
那根被巧妙藏匿的钢丝猛然绷紧，墙体深处传来一阵阴森的气动嘶鸣，像毒蛇贴地滑行。刺鼻的黑色液体从暗处喷薄而出，溅洒四周，裹满附近的一切——包括你。
The wire—expertly hidden—pulls taut and a sinister pneumatic hiss slithers from the walls. Pungent, black liquid sprays from a hidden source coating everything nearby—including you.

宛如暴怒的恶魔，这名披甲矮人猛然冲入战阵；沉重的连枷燃作复仇的彗星，在他焚灭敌人时划出炽烈轨迹。漆黑如煤的双眼在挥击间闷燃着元素之火的狂怒；他的战吼点燃同伴心中的希望，如黑暗中的高贵火炬。鲜亮的橙色发辫——以传统矮人式样编织——构成他的头发与胡须，战斗时层层垂落，仿佛火焰光环环绕周身。一只鼻子——矮壮宽阔，像经久耐用的铁砧——压住一张粗砺如其族人栖居群山之下的面庞。

~ 由 Tuhs 扮演

Like a raging demon, the armored dwarf hurtles through the battle, weighted flail ablaze like a vengeful comet as he immolates his foes. Coal-black eyes smolder with the fury of elemental fire as he attacks, his battle-cry igniting hope in the hearts of allies, like a noble flame in the darkness. Vibrant orange locks—braided in traditional dwarven style—make up his hair and beard, cascading around him like a halo of fire as he fights. A nose—squat and broad like a hardy anvil—dominates a face as rugged as the mountains his people dwell beneath.

~ Played by Tuhs

Entangle Evaded By Player.name:
玩家躲开了纠缠
Entangle Evaded By Player

Text.text:
你脚下的地面猛然迸发生机，无数藤蔓与攫握的杂草破土而出，以纤维般的卷须缠住你的四肢，将你牢牢束缚。随着植物越勒越紧，一股绝望的怒意如熔岩般在你体内翻涌；你怒吼一声，硬生生撕裂纠缠，挣脱而出。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The ground around you explodes into life as innumerable vines and grasping weeds burst forth to ensnare your limbs in their fibrous tendrils. As you feel the plants tighten their grip, a surge of desperate rage flows through you like molten lava and, with a roar, you tear yourself free.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Zombie Apocalypse Setting.name:
丧尸末日设定
Zombie Apocalypse Setting

Text.text:
守墓人早已习惯寂静的夜晚。附近小镇那些迷信的乡民白天都很少踏进墓地，更别提在夜晚的黑暗里。这样也好——在太阳底下挖坟干上一整天是苦活，而这些年墓园越来越满，连日常的修整都开始一点点榨干他疲惫的骨头。他还能奢求什么？无非是安宁、寂静，以及炉火上咕嘟作响的一壶水。

门上突然传来抓挠声，把他从出神里拽了出来。多半是田野里跑来的什么小畜生。它们通常挠两下就会放弃。他继续照看炉火，可那沙沙—沙沙—沙沙却怎么也不停。守墓人叹了口气，费力撑起身子，抄起铲子准备把害兽赶走。门闩才一抬，一只人手就从门缝里硬生生挤了进来。紧接着又伸进两只……

但不对劲。指端的肉已经腐烂，剥落的皮下露出白森森的骨头。守墓人尖叫着向后跌去，活尸们猛地撞进他的小屋。浑黄的牙齿在呆滞乳白的眼睛下大张着口。那些东西拖着身子扑上前，将他压倒，撕扯下一块块血肉，直到痛叫声戛然而止。随后，刚刚被转化的守墓人也站了起来，加入同伴的怪物行列。它们步调一致，穿过田野，朝镇子移动。

The gravekeeper is accustomed to quiet nights. The superstitious folk of the nearby town hardly venture to the cemetery during the day, let alone in the darkness of night. Just as well—a day spent out in the sun digging graves is hard work, and with how full the graveyard has become over the years, even the general maintenance is starting to take its toll on his weary bones. What more could he ask for than peace, quiet, and a kettle over the fire?

A scratching at the door draws him out of his reverie. Some critter from the fields, no doubt. They tend to give up after a few moments. He focuses on tending the fire, but the scritch-scritch-scritch doesn't cease. With a sigh, he heaves himself up, and grabs his shovel to chase away the pest. As soon as he lifts the latch, a human hand pushes through the opening. Then two more…

But something’s wrong. The flesh on the extremities is rotten, and bits of bone show through the peeling skin. The gravekeeper falls back with a scream as the living corpses burst into his hut. Mouths of yellow teeth gape open below milky, unfocused eyes. The creatures drag themselves forward and fall on the man, ripping chunks of flesh until the sounds of pain stop. Then the gravekeeper, freshly turned, rises with his fellow monsters. They move as one toward the town across the fields.

Professor Of Astrology.name:
占星学教授
Professor Of Astrology

Text.text:
教授身着一袭午夜蓝长袍，内衬金色几何纹样；她透过一副六边形眼镜凝视前方，冷铁镜框透着寒意。腰侧一支黄铜单筒望远镜随步伐轻晃，外舱周缘嵌着一圈符文。她背着一个形如巨型箭袋的背包，里面收纳着一卷卷长长的羊皮纸。学生们看着她轻快地蹦跳，卷轴也随之咚咚撞响，她一边走一边讲述自己刚刚完成的星图。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Garbed in a midnight-blue kaftan lined with golden geometric patterns, the professor peers through a pair of hexagonal glasses set in a cold-iron frame. A brass spyglass swings at her hip, with runes inlaid around the outer chamber. She bears a backpack, shaped like an enormous quiver, which holds a collection of long scrolls. Her students watch her bounce buoyantly, scrolls bumping along with her, as she describes the star charts she’s just finished.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

几乎无人敢在这场暴雨倾盆中出门——雨点如重锤擂下，巨雷炸裂，毁灭性的闪电一再劈落。毫无预兆地，你被一股冲击掀翻在地，耳中嗡鸣不止。离你约十五英尺处，地面被炭黑的灼痕撕出一道疤——一道闪电险些贴身命中。你挣扎着撑起身，忽觉脚下的泥土在蠕动、在位移。紧接着，一根藤蔓像蛇一样从土里探出，猛然拔高、鼓胀，生长之迅疾让你几乎来不及理解眼前所见。短短几分钟，一头扭动的植物生物硬生生从地底挤出身躯，满身叶质触手在雨幕中胡乱抓攫，急切寻找能塞进那张可憎之口的食物。碎裂原木的尖端参差嵌在它的口缘，宛如锯齿般的牙；而当你看见它身体上端缓缓睁开两只巨大的黄眼——黑与红的血丝贯穿其中——一股寒意瞬间攫住了你的心。

~ Envisioned by Miggs3030

Few others are out in this deluge, a pounding rain punctuated by massive thunderclaps and devastating bolts of lightning. Without warning, you are blown off your feet, your ears ringing. A charred burn mark mars the ground perhaps fifteen feet from you—a lightning bolt that struck dangerously close. As you pull yourself to your feet, you notice the ground shifting. Then a vine pokes forth from the soil, like a serpent, growing in height and swelling so quickly that you barely have time to process what you are seeing. In minutes, a writhing plant-creature has shoved itself out of the ground, leafy tentacles grasping for food to cram into its hideous excuse for a mouth. Jagged ends of smashed logs line the maw like teeth, and you are horrified when you see two monstrous yellow eyes—shot through with black and red veins—open near the top of its body.

~ Envisioned by Miggs3030

Villain's Opulent Quarters.name:
反派的奢华寝宫
Villain's Opulent Quarters

Text.text:
这间圆形房间里弥漫着令人窒息的紫丁香气息，熏香的烟雾在空间中盘旋缭绕，浓郁而芬芳。角落里一张厚重的橡木书桌占据了视线，桌后立着一把高背椅，天鹅绒靠垫深陷其间。桌旁放着一只盛着深色烈酒的玻璃杯，尚未饮尽，旁边摊着一张本地区地图，上面标注着难以理解的符号。装框的画作倚靠墙边，尚未挂起；有些描绘着著名战役或传奇将领的巅峰英姿，另一些则题材更为抽象，令人心底发毛。
The circular room smells oppressively of lilac, and incense fills the space with swirling, fragrant smoke. A heavy oaken desk, behind which stands a high-backed chair with velvet cushions, dominates one corner. A tumbler of dark liquor sits unfinished beside a map of the region, marked with incomprehensible symbols. Framed paintings lean against the walls, undisplayed. Some depict famous battles or legendary generals in their prime, while others are more abstract and unsettling in their subjects.

Vivace The Half-dragon.name:
活跃者·半龙
Vivace The Half-dragon

Text.text:
一位威仪凛然的身影——半龙半人——盘坐成近乎禅定的姿态。她身形矮小却令人肃然起敬，纤瘦的负载覆着黄铜色鳞片，层层叠成灵活柔韧的线条，其下隐约可见珍珠般光泽的黑色缝脉。她头顶红发如惊雷般炸起，龙鳞与人类的五官轮廓交融无间。她的双眼如红宝石般闪烁，中央却被椭圆的蜥蜴瞳孔刺穿。下背处一条长尾左右甩动，尾尖轻轻拂过地面。一对略显偏小的翅膀向后展开，涟漪般的肌肉起伏间轻轻收放。她衣着简洁——折叠的黑色裙摆配白色上衣，镶着金边——粗糙起茧的拳中紧握一根金属齐眉棍。

~ Played by Komaru with

A stately figure—half dragon, half human—settles into a zen-like posture. Short and impressive, her slender bulk of brass-colored scales layers into lithe and supple lines, underlain by seams of nacreous black. A shock of red hair erupts from her head, though draconic scales blend with human facial features. Her eyes gleam like rubies, punctured by oval lizard pupils.
