From the lower back, a long tail lashes side to side, gently brushing the ground. A pair of wings a little too small for her body spread backwards, flexing with rippling muscle. Her garb is simple—a folded black skirt with a white top bearing golden trim—and she grips a metal quarterstaff within a calloused fist.

~ Played by Komaru with

一股不老的恶意笼罩着这位阴沉的骑手，仿佛他仅仅存在于此，就能携来如同暴风聚拢般的阴森帷幕。骑士的黯色板甲上镶着贵族百合的纹章——黑得如无月之夜——身后破烂的斗篷猎猎翻飞，像一支覆灭军队残存的旗帜。尽管骑手空洞的眼眶里燃着不祥的火光，那闪烁的深处却藏着渴望，渴望一种意义；那饥饿注定永远无法被满足。

~ Played by Vahlaron

A sense of ageless malice surrounds the somber horseman, as if his very presence carries a macabre pall like a gathering storm. The knight’s dark plate is decorated with the crest of a noble lily—black as moonless night—and a ragged cloak flutters at his back like the banner of a fallen army. Though the rider’s hollow eyes burn with baleful fire, there is a longing in the flickering depths, a hunger for purpose, destined to remain unfulfilled.

~ Played by Vahlaron

Investiture Of Ice.name:
冰之灌注
Investiture Of Ice

Text.text:
法术一经施放，你便感觉所有温暖尽数离你而去，被抽空殆尽，取而代之的是冬日麻木的拥抱。你呼出的气息在眼前化作白雾，晶莹的霜冰开始覆上你的肌肤，沿着身体以不可阻挡的浪潮般蔓延。你的皮肤在其接触之下渐渐褪白。
As the spell is cast you feel all warmth leave you, drained away, to be replaced by the numb embrace of winter. Your breath mists before you as crystalline ice begins to rime your flesh, creeping across your body in an inexorable wave. Your skin pales beneath its touch.

Gloves Of Missile Snaring.name:
擒箭手套
Gloves Of Missile Snaring

Text.text:
轻柔纤细，如同薄雾般的轻纱缠绕，这副手套看似脆弱得不堪一击。银线在布料上织出诡异的蛛网纹样，手背处更有几道风格化的箭矢刺入图案之中。
Soft and delicate, like gossamer shrouds, these gloves are deceptively frail. Strange, weblike patterns adorn the fabric in silver thread, and stylized arrows pierce the design along the back of the gloves.

Final Encounter With Captain Shadowscale.name:
与暗鳞船长的最终遭遇
Final Encounter With Captain Shadowscale

Text.text:
“你就不能老老实实别管，嗯？非得把鼻子伸到不该伸的地方——现在我就把它剁下来塞回你嘴里。我们要用你的血刷洗甲板，把你剥下的骨头抛进深渊。然后我的主人终于能重获自由！”  

他抽出那把阴冷的黑钢弯刀，双眼因癫狂的狂热而瞪得滚圆。影鳞爆发出野兽般的咆哮，示意他的船员发动攻击。
“You couldn’t just leave it be, eh? You had to go sticking your nose where it don’t belong—and now I’m going to chop it off and feed it you. We’ll wash our decks with your blood and cast your flayed bones into the abyss. Then my master will finally be free!” Drawing his wicked, dark steel cutlass, his eyes wide with unhinged fervor, Shadowscale unleashes a bestial roar, signaling his crew to attack.

烟斗上了清漆并精心抛光，柔和地映出那红褐斑驳木纹上的光泽。斗钵很深，足以装下满满一撮烟草；烟嘴则是一段弯曲的黑色骨质。
The pipe is varnished and buffed so it softly reflects the light from the reddish, mottled wood. The bowl is deep to hold a good pinch of tobacco, and the stem is a curved black bone.

Volcanic Island Shifting To And From Fae.name:
火山岛屿在妖精位面之间往返迁移
Volcanic Island Shifting To And From Faerie Plane

Text.text: 一声震天动地的轰鸣将你的目光扯向地平线——一座孤岛上矗立着火山。山体在熔岩与烈焰的暴雨中轰然爆裂，几乎同时传来一声仿佛巨幅织锦被生生撕成两半的裂响。漆黑的山峰以违背常理的姿态扭曲，像一张纸般弯折，继而向内自我折叠；下方的树林与沙滩也随之翻覆倾倒。它并未下沉，而是闪烁着从世间抹去，只留下那一蓬仍在喷溅的熔岩。炽热的泥火坠落，噼啪四溅地砸入开阔海面，水汽从海表腾起成柱。穿过这团云雾，在其后，岛屿最淡的一丝影像忽明忽暗，像一抹虚弱到无法显形的魅影（特征）。 A thunderous rumble draws your attention to the horizon, to an island with a volcano. The mountain explodes in a shower of lava and flame, followed almost immediately by a sound like a tapestry being torn in two. The dark peak shifts unnaturally, bending like a piece of paper before folding in on itself, the trees and beach below capsizing along with it. It does not sink but instead blinks out of existence, leaving its spray of lava behind. The molten earth falls and splatters into the open sea, plumes of steam rising from the surface. Beyond this cloud, the faintest image of the island flickers like a phantom too weak to manifest.

Wizard's Letter To A Former Student.name:
写给昔日学生的巫师来信
Wizard's Letter To A Former Student

Text.text:
[掩蔽] 金发般的羊皮纸被严丝合缝地折成一个完美的方形。一枚厚重的紫色蜡质徽章将向后折起的四角牢牢封住，其上压印着印戒留下的朴素而雅致的奥术纹记。封蜡上方紧挨着一行字：悔恨。恳求。 占据正面相当大的一片，学生的姓名与地址以比纸张本身更深的色泽浮现其上，仿佛未曾动用半点墨迹。 [内容] “你一直是个恭敬而勤勉的学生；然而，当你踏入尘世，我还有最后一课要教你。我通往成就的道路阴沉而险恶。求知令人振奋——它赐予你的力量也令人沉醉——但这份追逐会让你对自己造成的苦难视而不见。当你揭开宇宙的真相时，又何必在乎区区几名卑微之人的命运？可正是这份在乎，才是一切。你是我最耀眼的学生，我知道你将成就惊天伟业；但没有智慧、没有谦卑、没有共情，知识便一文不值。我知道你会找到自己的路；我只希望，你身后留下的尸体，能比我少一些。”

~ 由 DMlis 构想

[Cover] The blond parchment is folded tightly into an exact square. A heavy purple medallion of wax holds its back-folded corners together, imprinted with the simple but elegant arcane impression of a signet ring. Just above the seal are the words Contrite. Imploring. Taking up a sizable amount of the front, the student's name and address appear in a darker version of the parchment itself, with no apparent use of ink. [Content] “You have always been a respectful and diligent student, yet, as you embark into the world, I have one lesson left to teach you. The road to my achievements was a dark and insidious one. The pursuit of knowledge is invigorating—and the powers it grants you intoxicating—but that pursuit can leave you blind to the suffering you inflict. When you are unveiling the truths of the universe, why care about the fates of a handful of lesser people? But that care is everything. You are my brightest student and I know you will achieve tremendous things, but knowledge is nothing without wisdom, without humility, without empathy. I know you will find your way; I just hope you will leave fewer bodies in your wake than I have.”

~ Envisioned by DMlis

I Use Fast Hands To Disarm A Trap.name:
我用「巧手」迅速解除陷阱。
I Use Fast Hands To Disarm A Trap

Text.text:
命运偏爱大胆之人——也偏爱手脚利落的人。我将工具滑入掌心，先行部分触发陷阱。这样一来，机关该断什么、该折什么、该挡什么便一目了然。于是我照做。
Fortune favors the bold—and the quick. I slide my tools into my hands and partially trigger the trap. Doing that shows me what to break, bend, or block in the mechanism. And that’s what I do.

I Cast Expeditious Retreat.name:
我施放《迅捷撤退》
I Cast Expeditious Retreat

Text.text:
当我将这道法术的音节连缀成一体，一股轻盈的感觉便将我淹没，四肢仿佛变得轻快而柔韧。步伐间多了弹性，我注意到脚边萦绕着一层诡异的微光，新的自信充盈全身。我会活着，去迎接下一场战斗！
When I join the syllables of the spell together, a buoyant feeling overtakes me, causing my limbs to feel light and flexible. There is a new spring in my step, and I notice a strange glow surrounding my feet as I am filled with a new confidence. I will live to fight another day!

Staff Arcane Focus.name:
法杖（奥术法器）
Staff Arcane Focus

Text.text:
这根法杖以打磨抛光的紫杉精心制成，自杖端至杖端皆刻满符印，唯有握持处以皮革缠绕，便于掌控。自远古时代起，法师便凭此等法杖撼动世界。
Crafted with exquisite care from sanded and polished yew, this staff has been etched with sigils from end to end, except for where the shaft is wrapped with leather for easy handling. With such staves, wizards have shaken the world since time immemorial.

Peering Through The Observatory Telescop.name:
透过天文台望远镜窥探
Peering Through The Observatory Telescope

Text.text:
透过望远镜望去的景象令人震撼。那些从地面看起来整齐划一的星辰，忽然显露出鲜明的个性：它们在体型、亮度、色泽上各不相同……甚至连它们穿过望远镜镜片时的闪烁方式，都仿佛拥有了自己的生命。
The view through the telescope is astonishing. Stars that once looked so uniform from the ground suddenly gain stark individuality. They vary in size, brightness, color… Even how they twinkle through the telescope’s glass has taken on a life of its own.

Mighty And Strong—a Shanty.name:
《强壮又威猛》——一首海员号子
Mighty And Strong—a Shanty

Text.text:
被人从镇上酒馆里扔出来，踉跄着，满身污渍。
喊着哦，我很威风，喊着哦，我很强壮。
抽出一把刀，打手们却只当笑话。
放下它，伤不到我们。

摇摇晃晃往家走，微光忽然勾住了他们的眼。
我也能威风，我也能强壮。
捡到一截镶宝的枝杖，内部奔涌着嗡鸣般的能量。
放下它，别伤到我们。

朝空气胡乱劈砍，莽撞又自在。
求你让我威风，求你让我强壮。
宝石骤然一闪，烈焰倾泻而出。
放下它，别伤到我们。

起哄者与讨厌鬼缩作一团，瑟瑟发抖。
现在谁才威风，现在谁才强壮？
复仇与怒火如雨落下。
放下它，别伤到我们。

盗贼与强盗闯进小镇，
炫耀他们多威风，炫耀他们多强壮。
刀与弓在手，熟练得令人心寒。
把那些放下，别伤到我们。

有人不向匪徒低头，
我来让你们见识威风，我来让你们见识强壮！
在瑟缩的农夫身上看见了自己的过去，
将他们击倒，不会伤到我们。

魔杖的主人回到村里，
看见持杖者，威风又强壮。
想不想加入队伍？
拒绝我们吧，不会伤到我们。

他们花了些时间想得周全，
想要威风，想要强壮。
把新得的力量用在正途——
离开小镇，不会伤到我们。

与无数野兽、与更强的敌手厮杀，
他们实在太威风，他们实在太强壮。
同伴把他们架起，扶回脚下，
别放弃，你会伤到我们。

训练、成长，开始渐渐掌握，
学会如何威风，学会如何强壮。
把我们从蛮徒与怪物手里救下，
确保再没有什么能伤到我们。

~ 由 Jangowolf 构想

Tossed out the town bar, stumbling and stained.
Says oh, I’m mighty, says oh, I’m strong.
Pulls out a blade and bouncers just laugh.
Put that down, can’t hurt us.

Shambling on home, shine catches their eye.
I could be mighty, I could be strong.
Finds a jeweled branch coursing with birr.
Put that down, don’t hurt us.

Slashes through air, careless and free.
Please make me mighty, please make me strong.
Flash from the jewels, and fire floods out.
Put that down, don’t hurt us.

Hecklers and pests cower in fear.
Now who’s the mighty, now who’s the strong?
Vengeance and wrath rain down upon them.
Put that down, don’t hurt us.

Thieves and robbers come to the town,
Showing they’re mighty, showing they’re strong.
Wielding blades and bows with practice.
Put those down, don’t hurt us.

One doesn’t bow down to the bandits,
I’ll show you mighty, I’ll show you strong!
Sees their past in the cowering peasants,
Brings them down, won’t hurt us.

Wand’s owner returns to the village,
Sees the wielder, mighty and strong.
How would you like to join the party?
Turn us down, won’t hurt us.

Takes their time to think it all through,
Wants to be mighty, wants to be strong.
Puts their new power to a good use—
Leaves the town, won’t hurt us.

Fights many beasts and stronger foes,
They’re just too mighty, they’re just too strong.
Comrades hoist them to their feet,
Don’t give up, you’ll hurt us.

Train and grow and start to master,
Learns to be mighty, learns to be strong.
Saves us from all brutes and monsters,
Makes sure nothing hurts us.

~ Envisioned by Jangowolf

尽管还未被无休止的杂役压弯脊背，这个少年对自己生活的农场早已熟门熟路。年纪尚小，干不了重活，他被安排去喂鸡、拾蛋——从他前臂上挽着的那只草编篮筐便可见一斑。
Although not yet bent of back from unrelenting chores, the young boy is no stranger to the farm on which he lives. Too small for hard work, he has been tasked with feeding chickens and gathering eggs, as evidenced by the straw basket looped over his forearm.

笑意轻易爬上这名类人生物的唇角——而他的舌头也同他手中所持的利刃一样锋利。可这份轻松滑稽的表象，在绝境之时便会剥落，露出非人的力量。乍看像人，他却无法长久遮掩自己怪物般的传承。他的双眼——乌黑如墨的巩膜与血红的瞳孔——仿佛燃着奥术的光焰。那股力量同样在他血管里奔涌，灌入他长剑那阴狠的刃口。他把深色、镶着毛边的斗篷兜帽压得很低，遮住面容，以掩饰自己的非人本性。一册以精致皮革装订的法术书悬在他的腰间，旁边还挂着半打烧瓶与玻璃小瓶，里面盛着色泽各异、摇晃作响的怪异液体。

~ Played by Cark

A smile comes easily to the humanoid’s lips—and his tongue is just as sharp as the blade he carries. But the easy, comical veneer gives way to an inhuman power in times of desperation. Though human at first glance, he cannot conceal his monstrous heritage for long. His eyes—jet-black sclera and blood-red pupils—seem to blaze with arcane energy. That same power flows through his veins and into the wicked edge of his longsword. He keeps the cowl of his dark, fur-trimmed cloak low over his face to conceal his inhuman nature. A spellbook, bound in fine leather, hangs at his belt, along with a half dozen flasks and glass vials of strange, sloshing liquids of myriad hues.

~ Played by Cark

Drider With Fireball.name:
火球蛛魔
Drider With Fireball

Text.text:
一种由精灵与蜘蛛拼凑而成的地狱杂种，这生物仅仅现身，便让你脊背窜起原始的战栗——它用多得离谱的腿咔哒咔哒向前逼近。蛛形肢体上乌亮的黑色甲壳如水镜般映出它掌中火球的橙色光芒，红宝石般的眼睛闪烁着癫狂的恶意，在黑暗中步步推进。
A hellish combination of elf and spider, the creature’s mere presence sends primal shivers up your spine as they clack forward on far too many legs. The glossy black carapace of their arachnid limbs reflects the orange glow of the fireball in their hand like a watery mirror, and ruby-red eyes shine with delusional malice as they advance in the darkness.

Slaver's Ship.name:
奴隶贩子的船
Slaver's Ship

Text.text:
这艘船的每一块木板、每一段缆绳、每一张帆都散发着绝望与残酷。甲板上寥寥几名水手浑身污秽，身披黑色皮革与帆布斗篷。腰间垂着成套的铁链与镣铐，几人手持或干脆佩着粗陋的短棍。空气恶臭刺鼻，船舱下方不时传来愤怒的喊叫、讨水的哀求，或鞭子抽落的响声。
Every board, rope, and sail of this vessel emanates hopelessness and cruelty. The few hands above deck are filthy, clad in black leathers and canvas cloaks. From their belts hang sets of iron chains and manacles, and several of them either carry or wear simple clubs. The smell is terrible, and from below you occasionally hear a shouted protest, calls for water, or the sound of a whip.

Mouthwatering Meat.name:
令人垂涎的肉
Mouthwatering Meat

Text.text:
你看着烤叉上那结实多汁的肉在火上滋滋作响，表皮焦褐如焦糖般泛光，口水不由自主地涌上来。香气乘着宜人的晚风在营地里飘荡，你咕噜作响的肚子也提醒你——该吃晚饭了。
Your mouth waters as you watch the tough, meaty flesh on the spit sizzle and brown like caramel. The aroma wafts around the camp, carried on a pleasant evening breeze, and your growling stomach reminds you it is dinnertime.

浓郁的木香、油脂与皮革气息先一步迎上你的脚步，带着你踏入制弓匠的店铺。墙上挂满各式各样的弓，大小形制不一，源自不同的材料——有的以铁桉那柔韧的木材雕成，有的镶嵌贵金属闪着冷光，另一些则由骨头或更难辨认的来源削凿而出。木屑像土一样铺满地面。制弓匠本人是个半精灵，短发贴服，双手布满老茧；他们小心加热木材，用脚作杠杆弯折弓胚，专注得抿紧嘴唇。“马上就好，”他们说道，目光仍不离那份要紧的活计。只要一盎司的力用错方向，弓胚就可能当场断裂。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The rich smell of wood, oils, and leather precedes your entrance into the bowyer’s shop. Bows of myriad shapes and sizes, borne of various materials, line the walls—some carved from the supple wood of ironbark trees, some inlaid with precious metals, others hewn from bone or less recognizable sources. Wood shavings litter the ground like soil. The bowyer themselves, a half-elf with short-cropped hair and calloused hands, carefully heats the wood and bends the stave using their foot as a lever, lips pursed in concentration. “Be with you in just a moment,” they say, not looking up from their important work. One ounce of force in the wrong direction, and the stave might snap.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Vampire's Manor: Grounds.name:
吸血鬼（特征）的庄园：庭院
Vampire's Manor: Grounds

Text.text:
破败的庄园宅邸如同合拢的肢体般环抱着庭院，将这片场地从刺骨寒风最凶狠的侵袭中隔绝开来，狂风只在四周摇撼着腐朽的结构。紧贴庄园的一座温室蜷伏其侧，玻璃蒙着厚重污垢，昏暗不透。庭院里满地残骸与杂物，废弃物间散落着骨头——鸟类、兽类，乃至人形生物的遗骸。庭院中央矗立着一棵巨大而虬结的树，似乎早在许久以前便已枯死，却仍不倒下，以阴森的、骷髅般的姿态伪装成生命的残影。
The dilapidated manor house surrounds the courtyard like encircling limbs, closing the grounds off to the worst of the frigid wind rattling the surrounding structure. A greenhouse hugs the manor, its glass filthy with grime. Debris lies strewn about the courtyard, scattered bones among the refuse—avian, mammalian, and humanoid remains. At the heart of the courtyard stands a massive, gnarled tree that appears to have died long ago, yet remains standing in a sinister, skeletal facsimile of life.

Werewolf Signs In The Forest.name:
森林中的狼人踪迹
Werewolf Signs In The Forest

Text.text:
足迹一路通向森林更深处，穿过灌木与荆棘，硬生生开出一条路。那一开始分明是人形的步印，可你沿着踪迹追去，某种……变化发生了。步幅变长，脚掌与脚趾被拉伸，利爪浮现。很快，这生物像是改用前脚掌着地，再接着干脆四足奔行。人形的足迹消失无踪，取而代之的是巨大、带爪的兽掌印。
The tracks lead deeper into the forest, cutting through brush and thorns. They are distinctly humanoid, but as you follow the trail, something… changes. The gait lengthens, the soles and toes stretch. Claws appear. Soon, the creature seems to be moving on the balls of its feet, then on all-fours. Massive clawed paws have replaced the humanoid tracks.

Cemetery; Undead; Pathfinder;.name:
墓园；不死生物；探路者；
Cemetery; Undead; Pathfinder;

Text.text:
他蹲坐着，双膝高过头顶——小腿胫骨一排排针状倒刺森然竖立。前肢与躯干上，他穿着一件剪裁考究的外套，领口还系着一枚由紫罗兰花瓣制成的领结。他那双如向日葵籽般的眼睛带着条纹与尖细的形状，沉静而聪慧地打量着四周。
As he sits in a crouch, his knees reach above his head—shins lined with needle-like barbs. About his forelegs and torso, he wears a smartly tailored coat, complete with a bowtie fashioned from violet petals. His eyes, striped and shaped like sunflower seeds, take in his surroundings with calm interest and intelligence.

Vignar Jasevear.name:
维格纳·贾瑟维尔
Vignar Jasevear

Text.text:
赤鳞的龙裔散发出一种冷峻的安宁——那是军旅岁月与教会生涯淬炼出的沉静，却又被他显而易见的戒备姿态所悄然揭穿。洁白无瑕的长袍以深红皮革加固，披覆在结实的龙躯之上；衣袍的丝线泛着微弱的银辉，暗示其上萦绕着某种神圣的附魔。龙裔那对琥珀色的眼眸里，究竟藏着怎样的谜团？紧抿的下颌、永远中性的神情之后，又翻涌着何等情绪？背后那柄大剑——握柄磨得发亮、刃口锤炼得锋锐——已足以道出龙裔的过往，也道出他随时愿意拔剑而战的决心。

~ Played by Max_Slacker

The red-scaled dragonborn exudes a stoic serenity—a calm borne of military service and a life in the church, belied by his apparent readiness. Pristine white robes reinforced with crimson leather drape the muscular, draconic form; the threads shine with a subtle, silver glow, hinting at some kind of divine enchantment. What mysteries do the dragonborn’s amber eyes hold? What emotions roil behind the set jaw, the perpetually neutral expression? The great sword with its well-worn hilt and honed edge at his back says enough about the dragonborn’s past—and his willingness to fight.

~ Played by Max_Slacker

不过是一团生铁，粗暴地锤在粗糙的木柄上，这把钉头锤简单——却残忍而高效。铁箍在武器凹痕累累的锤冠下绽开锈花，木柄因多年疏于照料而干枯开裂。
Little more than a ball of pig-iron hammered on to a rough wooden haft, the mace is simple—yet brutally effective. Rust blooms across the iron bands beneath the weapon’s dented crown, and the wood is dry and cracked from years of neglect.

Toll The Dead.name:
亡者丧钟
Toll The Dead

Text.text:
当你指向你的目标时，空气变得沉重而凝滞。寂静被一记深到不可思议的轰鸣撕裂，你的敌人猛地捂住太阳穴，因震颤而弓身蜷缩。他们强撑着站起，露出那张枯槁而疲惫的面孔——而你看着他们的生命更快地向终点跳动。
When you point at your target, the air grows heavy and still. An impossibly deep peal splits the silence, and your foe clutches their temples, doubled over from shock. They push to standing, revealing their face—withered and weary—and you watch their life tick more quickly to its end.

I Cast Fiendish Flame Strike Using Compo.name:
我用材料施放邪魔烈焰打击
I Cast Fiendish Flame Strike Using Components

Text.text:
我露出阴森的笑意，将一撮硫磺朝敌人吹去，随即抬眼望向苍穹。硫磺在空气中灼燃，留下刺鼻的恶臭；与此同时，一道亵渎的火柱自云间轰然喷薄而出，咆哮着扑向我的对手，宛如狂吠的地狱猎犬。
I smile wickedly as I blow the pinch of sulfur toward my enemy, then cast my gaze skyward. The sulfur burns in the air leaving a foul stench, as a column of blasphemous fire erupts from the clouds, roaring towards my foe like a baying hellhound.

Bardic Cleaver.name:
吟游诗人砍刀
Bardic Cleaver

Text.text:
排箫清亮的音符骤然响起，一名身着皮甲的战士飞身冲入战团，刀锋缠绕着绿色火焰；空着的那只手握着一支灰色铁木箫，微光流转，翠焰的火舌从箫管间不规则地迸溅。细剑带着曳尾的火光横扫，划开敌人的胸膛。对手惨叫，葱郁的火焰将其吞没。箫声仍悬在空气里，直到一个高潮，一股火焰从箫中跃向另一个目标，将其点燃。战士将细剑猛然贯入敌人胸口——炽亮的断奏收束于一声爆鸣，尸身被震得倒飞出去，落地发出一声crunch。伴随一道灵巧的飒然挥动，发光的刀锋被带到他阴沉的面前，战士在两具仍冒着烟的尸体之间静静伫立。

~ 扮演：Colby Poulson，来自 d4: D&D Deep Dive

Clarion notes from a pan flute ring out as a leather-clad warrior flies into the fray, their blade writhing with green fire, and gray ironwood flute in their free hand shimmering, tongues of the green fire erratically sparking from the pipes. The rapier slices across the chest of a foe in a blaze-tailed sweep. The adversary screams as the viridescent flame consumes them. The melody of the flute hangs in the air until, at a crescendo, a gout of fire jumps from it to another target and sets them ablaze. The warrior thrusts their rapier through the enemy’s chest—a refulgent staccato ending in a blast that sends the body backward to land with a crunch on the ground. With a lissome swish that brings the glowing blade to their grim face, the warrior stands still between the smoldering corpses.

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

A Tenday Of Travel By Boat Through A Cha.name:
乘船旅行十日，穿越入冬的更迭
A Tenday Of Travel By Boat Through A Change To Winter

Text.text:
第一天的大半时间都耗在往船上装载贸易货物上；即便你付了船票，仍被要求出力帮忙。船一路向北，途中靠港数次，继续装货、接人。第四天，有人发现了一头鲸，船员们立刻备好鱼叉。所幸这头威严的巨兽并未袭击，航程也就安然无恙地继续下去。第七天你醒来时浑身发抖，上到甲板才见栏杆结着一层厚霜，船舷旁漂着碎冰。水手们挥着木杖拍打船帆，敲落其上的冰凌。第九天开始飘雪，所有人都又加了衣物，试图把寒意挡在外头。第十天，船只迟缓地驶入港湾，在浅水的薄冰间挤推前行。不久你踏上几乎空无一人的码头，冷冽空气里，你的呼吸化作一团团白雾。
Most of the first day had been spent loading the vessel with trade goods, and despite being a paying passenger you were obliged to help. The boat made several stops as it made its way north, picking up additional goods and passengers. On the fourth day, a whale was sighted and the crew had made ready with harpoons. Thankfully, the majestic beast had not attacked and the voyage proceeded without mishap. On the seventh day you awoke shivering, and upon going above decks saw that frost caked the rails and ice floated alongside the vessel. Crew beat the sails with staves to free them of rime. It began to snow on day nine, and everyone donned more clothing in an attempt to keep warm. On the tenth day, the vessel sailed sluggishly into the harbor, shoving through the thin ice of the shallow water. Soon after, you disembarked onto an almost deserted quay, your breath steaming in the chill air.

Lesson From Mentor In Smithing.name:
锻造师傅的教诲
Lesson From Mentor In Smithing

Text.text:
“你已经准备好做个简单的弯折了。把铁条架在砧角上，从这里敲下去。停——不，对，在这里。手再往后挪一点握住铁条，好给自己借力。很好。现在回炉再加点热，但只加在你需要的地方。你做得不错。尽量别把自己点着了。”
“You’re ready for a simple bend. Hold the bar over the horn and strike here. Stop— No. Here. Hold farther back on the bar to give yourself leverage. Good. Now, back for a bit more heat, but only where you need it. You’re doing fine. Try not to catch fire.”

Goro Von Xander.name:
戈罗·冯·桑德
Goro Von Xander

Text.text:
一袭蓝色和服披在一名身形修长的男子身上，布料幽暗发亮，仿佛冰川湖面的冷光。衣背与过长的袖子上，几何纹样如雪花分形般层层绽放，又似棱锥群山般冷峻起伏。宽大的兜帽遮住了大半面容，只露出一截无须的下巴，皮肤粗韧黝黑，如皮革般经风历雪。一柄巨剑自他肩后高高耸起，修长剑刃几乎要擦到地面。他纤细的身躯却以不动如山的优雅将这柄重兵器稳稳负起。

~ Played by christoffer with

A blue kimono hangs over a lithe-framed man, the fabric dark and gleaming like the surface of a glacial lake. A geometric design of snowflake fractals and pyramidic mountains decorates the back and overlong sleeves of the garment. Most of the wearer’s features are hidden from view by the large hood, but you can see a bit of a beardless chin, the skin as tough and tanned as leather. A greatsword rises over his shoulder, the long blade nearly scraping the floor. His slender frame manages to bear the weapon with an unshakeable grace.

~ Played by christoffer with

这栋房子是座两层建筑，介于乡间小屋与小型庄园之间。它似乎已在此伫立逾百年，却依旧修缮得一丝不苟。后方那片林木在微风中庄重地摇曳。  

一位仪态雍容的女子从屋内走出，身着宝石般的红色长裙，披着银色貂皮披肩。她身旁跟着两名看似与她有亲缘关系的男子。他们在对她的需求保持体贴周全的同时，也对周遭环境保持着高度警觉。其中一人双手捧着一只小箱子。  

他们沿着道路朝附近的裁缝店走去——The Spare Cufflink。
This house is a two-story affair between a country cottage and a small manor. It seems to have been standing here for over a century, but it is in excellent repair. The grove of trees in the back sways solemnly in the breeze. A stately woman exits the home wearing a ruby-red gown and a silver mink shawl. She is accompanied by two men who seem to share some relation to her. They are both highly alert to their surroundings while remaining attentive to her needs. One of the men carries a small chest in his hands. They make their way down the road to the nearby tailor shop, The Spare Cufflink.

Wild Magic Surge: Levitation.name:
狂野魔法涌动：悬浮
Wild Magic Surge: Levitation

Text.text:
一股魔法回涌在你周身咕嘟翻涌，让你头晕目眩——连身体都仿佛变得轻飘飘的。你的双脚与地面失去接触，你缓缓离地，向空中升起。
A magical backwash bubbles up around you, making you feel lightheaded—and light-bodied. Your feet lose contact with the ground as you slowly rise into the air.

Spear Of Seelie Craftsmanship With Carvi.name:
带雕纹的精灵巧工长矛
Spear Of Seelie Craftsmanship With Carvings

Text.text:
这柄精致长矛的矛杆上，点缀着林地住民嬉闹跳跃的可爱浮雕；矛头处弯曲的银色刃片上，则以优雅的花体文字环绕镌刻。你握住这件武器时，新割青草的清香与令人愉悦的肉桂暖意交织而来，你几乎敢发誓，方才看到其中一处雕刻正冲你发笑。长矛散发出一种满足安宁的感觉，抚平你肌肉里的紧绷。它似乎很喜欢你。
Delightful images of capering woodland denizens decorate the haft of this fine spear, and elegant script lines the curved silver blades at its head. The smell of freshly cut grass mingles with a pleasing cinnamon warmth as you take hold of the weapon, and you could swear you just saw one of the carvings laughing at you. The spear emanates a feeling of contentment, easing any tension in your muscles. It seems to like you.

Approaching A Dead Village.name:
走近一座死寂的村庄
Approaching A Dead Village

Text.text:
当你走近这座寂静的村庄，一股腐烂的恶臭钻入鼻腔。街道上横七竖八地散落着家族与商旅的腐尸，每一具都显然是惨遭残忍攻击的受害者。

~ 地形 Guy

As you approach the quiet village, an odor of decay reaches your nostrils. Rotting corpses of families and merchants are strewn across the street, each clearly the victim of a brutal attack.

~ Terrain Guy

为什么一只鸟会无视肉铺后头那堆肥油与筋膜，偏偏跑去酒馆外的垃圾里啄食？它叼着一截细小的鸡骨头，像叼着烟斗般飞上酒馆屋顶，守夜般俯瞰下方街巷。它用那双聪慧的黑眼睛扫视大道上的每一个人。
Why would a bird ignore the fat and gristle behind the butcher shop to pick at the trash outside a tavern? He flies to the tavern roof, holding a small chicken bone in his mouth like a pipe, and watches the streets below. He scans everyone in the thoroughfare through intelligent black eyes.

这位鸟人有着一根黯哑黑色的细长三角喙，羽毛乌黑而顺滑，眼睛是发亮的蓝黑色。他的手臂——并非翅膀——末端是覆着鳞片的深灰手掌，指端长着钝钩般的爪。细致的铆钉皮甲短袍配着同款腰带，腰间挂着两根木制魔杖与一柄饰纹细剑。他静静守夜，缓慢眨动眼睛，随后从背上解下一把镶银边的西特琴，摆好姿势，准备奏响。

~ Played by SilverFoxActual with

This birdlike person has a long, triangular beak of dull black; sleek, black feathers; and shiny, blue-black eyes. His arms—instead of wings—end in scaly, dark-gray hands, digits tipped with blunt claws. His fine tunic of studded leather has a matching belt that holds two wooden wands and an ornamented rapier. He watches quietly, blinking slowly, then unslings a silver-trimmed cittern from his back and prepares to play.

~ Played by SilverFoxActual with

Large Cave Cavern.name:
大型洞穴洞窟
Large Cave Cavern

Text.text:
温吞的水滴自高悬的钟乳石上落下，尖刺般向下突伸，宛如某头巨兽的獠牙。你的呼吸、脚步，甚至心跳，都在这空旷的空间里回荡，最终消散在令人窒息的黑暗之中。苔藓与地衣，潮湿而带着腐殖土的气息，裹覆着岩石。窸窣的爬动与刮擦声，几乎陌生得像异界之音，沿着隧道蜿蜒而来，回响不息。下方究竟潜伏着什么？
Tepid water drips from looming stalactites, jutting downward like the teeth of some massive beast. Your breath, footfalls, even your heartbeat, echo through the cavernous space, eventually fading into the oppressive darkness. Moss and lichen, loamy and damp, enshroud the stone. Skitterings and scrapings, almost alien to your ears, wind their way through the tunnels and reverberate endlessly. What lurks below?

I Hear The Voice Of My Sire.name:
我听见吾父之声
I Hear The Voice Of My Sire

Text.text:
“血月升起；盛宴与狂乱的时代将近。回来见我。我不必提醒你，赐予的赋礼，也能同样轻易地被收回。”
“The blood moon rises; the time of feast and frenzy draws near. Return to me. I need not remind you that a gift given can be taken away just as easily.”

混沌在你周身翻涌。电光乍闪。漂浮的土块彼此撞击，轰然震响。火舌喷涌，卷入狂风、滔天巨浪与突刺般的石刃之中，彼此湮灭，旋即又再度重塑。整片地貌仿佛自有意志般移位扭曲，翻转变形。
Chaos roils around you. Lightning flashes. Hunks of floating earth collide with a thunderous crash. Gouts of flame mingle with gusts of wind, towering waves, and jutting daggers of stone, each obliterating the other before reforming again. The entire landscape seems to shift and twist with a mind all its own.

Gamboler Gate In Winter.name:
冬日欢跃之门
Gamboler Gate In Winter

Text.text: 东南大道车马稀少，甘波勒门格外清冷，唯有冬风掠过石墙，低低呢喃。一只雪鸮栖在垛口的一处雉堞上，引得塔顶守卫纷纷侧目。守卫们被逗乐了，指着它，学着咕咕叫，伸出戴着手套的手，想看它会不会落上来。它先把头偏向一边，又偏向另一边，月黄的眼睛微微放大。 Without much traffic along the south-eastern road, Gamboler Gate is quiet aside from the winter breeze calling softly over the stone. A snowy owl perches on one of the crenellations, drawing the attention of the guards atop the tower. Amused, they point and hoot at it, holding out their gloved hands to see if it will perch. It tilts its head to one side, then the other, its moon-yellow eyes dilating.

Welcome From Night Hags.name:
来自夜鬼婆的欢迎
Welcome From Night Hags

Text.text:
三名枯槁的老媪立在鹅卵石地面上一处砌石围边的洞口旁，紫罗兰色的皮肤、深色长袍与骨质饰物在昏光里泛着冷意，低声耳语。可那耳语……真的是她们发出的么？还是从坑底涌上来？ 最高的那位站在中央，咧嘴一笑——狼一般的笑。她用两只带爪的手招了招，手镯叮当作响，编成辫的白发在弯曲的黑角旁摇曳。“靠近些，”她说，“别害怕。” “是呀，是呀。”最矮也最瘦的那位嘶声应和。她俯视洞口，乌黑的头发遮住了脸，却遮不住短短的白角与那条修长的鼻子。“我们一直在等你。不是吗？是的。来，听听。” 最高者右侧的鬼婆（特征）摇了摇头。系在红色发绺上的小铃铛蹦跳着，敲在她那对巨大的螺旋长角上叮铃作响。她闭上一只眼，另一只瞪得滚圆，直勾勾盯着你。“不。不，这里没有危险，甜心们，”她说，“没有，只有我们三个和那泉眼。要是它想要你的灵魂呢，嗯……嗯……” 三位女士一齐咯咯怪笑。

~ Envisioned by PiousMight

Three gaunt crones with violet skin, dark robes, and adornments of bone stand around a stone-lined hole in the cobbled floor, whispering. Or is the whispering coming from the pit? The tallest, standing in the center, grins. A wolf’s smile. She beckons with both clawed hands, bangles jangling and plaited white locks swaying around her curved, black horns. “Come closer,” she says. “Don’t be frightened.” “Yes, yes,” says the shortest and thinnest of them in a hiss. She looks down at the opening, her black hair covering her face but not her short white horns and long nose. “We’ve been expecting you. Haven’t we? Yes. Come listen.” The hag to the right of the tallest shakes her head. Ringing bells tied in her red tresses bounce off her enormous spiral horns. She closes one eye and stares with the other widened. “No. No peril here, sweets,” she says. “No, only us three and the font. And if it wanted your soul, well… well…” All three ladies cackle.

~ Envisioned by PiousMight

守卫的巡逻步伐看似随意，却一手不安地摆弄着掌心大小的手电筒，另一手则搭在黄色电击枪的枪套上。他对路人挂着笑，但眼神冷硬，始终紧盯四周，仔细掂量每一个可能的威胁。
The guard's stroll looks casual, but he fidgets with a palm-sized flashlight in one hand and rests his other on the holster of a yellow stun gun. And while he offers a smile to passersby, his eyes are hard, watching closely and sizing up any potential threats.

两头上了鞍的骆驼懒散地站在棕榈树下，靠近这处水潭的沙岸。旁边放着一只水桶，桶脚周围的沙地上散落着谷粒。越过骆驼，沿着岸边再往前一点，搭起了两顶亚麻帐篷。两顶帐篷都几乎看不出磨损的痕迹。然而它们之间的沙地却被翻动过，中央那座低矮、灰白的沙丘，像是被埋起的篝火余烬。
Two saddled camels stand idly under palms near the sandy bank of this pool. A bucket sits close by, grain littering the sand around its base. Past the camels, a little farther along the shore, two linen tents have been erected. Neither has much sign of wear. Sand between them has been disturbed, though, and a low, grayish mound in the center might be the buried remains of a campfire.

A Negative Experience Of Planar Travel.name:
一次糟糕的异位面旅行
A Negative Experience Of Planar Travel

Text.text:
你什么也看不见，却痛苦地被挤压着，仿佛整个身体正被吸进一根细管里。若你还能做到，你会因剧痛而倒抽一口气或尖叫；你多希望自己就此昏过去，却偏偏没有。若再多持续那怕人到极点的一瞬，你便会向所有神祇祈求死亡——但它停了。你站在一个全新的地方，仍因那段穿行的记忆而战栗。
You see nothing but feel painfully squeezed, as if your whole body is being sucked through a straw. You would gasp or scream in agony, if you could; you wish you’d lose consciousness, but you don’t. If it lasted just one excruciating moment longer you’d beg all the gods for death, but it stops. And you stand somewhere new, shuddering at the memory of your passage.

Secret Passage In A Castle.name:
城堡中的密道
Secret Passage In A Castle

Text.text:
那扇巧妙隐藏的门无声滑入凹陷的壁龛，露出一条通往城堡下方的秘道。隧道里涌出的空气带着霉味，裹挟着石壁的寒意扑面而来。墙上嵌入式的壁灯早已只剩枯尽的火把，无法提供半点光亮；你的目光只能勉强刺入黑暗一小段距离，却仍看见台阶向下延伸，沉入大地深处的腹腔。
The door, cleverly hidden, slides into a recessed alcove, revealing a passage leading beneath the castle. The air rushing from the tunnel smells of mildew and carries with it the chill of stone. Recessed sconces set into the wall with long-dwindled torches provide no light, and your gaze only penetrates so far into the darkness, but you see stairs descending deeper into the bowels of the earth.

暴风雪骤然裂开，从尖啸的风暴中踏出一头披着冰寒毛皮的魁梧怪物。狂风拽扯着它蓬乱的长毛，也拽动那纠结皮毛间垂挂的冰牙。冰川般的眼眸燃起猎食者的狡黠，死死盯住你，参差獠牙的狞笑如同一座塞满碎裂冰锥的洞窟。它猛地一扑，踏雪飞跃而来——一声凄厉的嚎叫撕碎了冬日的冷空气。
The blizzard parts, and from the screaming storm strides a hulking monstrosity of frigid fur. The wind tugs at its shaggy coat and the fangs of ice dangling from the tangled pelt. Glacial eyes blaze with predatory guile as it stares, its snaggletoothed grin like a cave of broken icicles. It lurches forward, bounding across the snow—a ghastly howl shredding the wintry air.

Jorroth Of The Rivnos.name:
里夫诺斯的乔洛斯
Jorroth Of The Rivnos

Text.text:
刺骨的寒风顽皮地掠过，将男人乌鸦般漆黑的长发吹得乱翘。他策马横越平原，不断催促坐骑，在风啸不止的苔原上越跑越快。身披磨旧的皮革与纠结的兽皮，他无惧严寒，放声大笑，任由雪粉轻覆在浓黑的眉上，雪花落在他疾驰的栗色坐骑颈胸之间。繁复的部族纹身以鲜亮的蓝色刺入肌理，沿着他结实的臂膀织出摄人的图案；当他以强健的拳掌攥紧缰绳，那些纹样仿佛也随肌肉起伏而游动。马身两侧挂着成堆的鞍袋、麻袋，甚至还有小桶，行进间叮当喧响，却终被荒凉的极地旷野吞没，他仍一路向前。

~ Played by Walt M.

The frigid wind sweeps raven-black hair aside in a playful tousle as the man rides across the plains, spurring his horse faster and faster across the windswept tundra. Clad in worn leather and matted furs, he braves the cold, laughing heartily as snow dusts his dark eyebrows and flakes settle upon his galloping chestnut mount. Intricate tribal tattoos—inked in vibrant blue—decorate his well-muscled arms in a mesmerizing pattern, the designs undulating as he grips the reins with his mighty fists. A great many saddlebags, sacks, and even small barrels hang from his horse, causing an almighty clatter that is lost to the barren arctic wastes as he journeys onward.

~ Played by Walt M.

你面前这名体格健壮的战士，浓重的眉弓、嶙峋的面部线条与灰白如烬的皮肤，让他带着一股阴沉的气息；然而，他那身漆蓝板甲的肩甲上垂挂着的徽记却令你放下戒备：一只振翅的白鸽，光洁得仿佛经常被人细细擦拭，熠熠生辉。更少见的是，他手持一根修长的齐眉棍，两端各像嵌着沉重的锤头。那头银白长发被一丝不苟地盘成发髻，却仍有几缕散落，拂过肩头。
The heavy brows, craggy features, and ash-white skin of the well-built warrior before you lend him a sinister quality, but the emblem hanging from the pauldrons of his lacquered blue plate armor sets you at ease: a dove in flight, shining as if regularly buffed. Somewhat unusually, he carries a long quarterstaff with what looks like heavy mace heads at each end. His long silver hair has been gathered into a neat bun, though some strands fly loose, touching the tops of his shoulders.

I Have Divine Health.name:
我拥有神圣健康
I Have Divine Health

Text.text:
我的灵魂在体内熊熊燃烧，正是我本该成为之姿的完美写照。这神圣的烈焰不容任何侵染。当疾病试图扎根时，它找不到可供藏匿的阴影；反倒会在我精神的熔炉中被焚尽。这火焰不留余烬。
My soul blazes within me, the perfect representation of me as I should be. This sacred flame abides no infection. When sickness attempts to take hold, it finds no shadows to hide in. Rather it burns away in the crucible of my spirit. This fire leaves nothing behind.

Crew Member From Privateer Ship.name:
私掠船船员
Crew Member From Privateer Ship

Text.text:
尽管这女人如今穿着军装，却怎么也遮不住她那不洁的出身。她对着熨得笔挺的军上衣浑身不自在——不习惯那上浆的硬领在颈侧发痒——站姿僵硬得仿佛四肢都不是自己的。她动作刻意板直，像个发条人偶……直到上级的身影消失在视线之外。
Though the woman now wears a military uniform, there is no disguising her insalubrious origins. She chafes at her pressed tunic—unaccustomed to the starched collar tickling her neck—and stands as if her limbs are not her own. She moves with forced rigidity, like an automaton… until her superiors are out of sight.

Door Standing Alone In A Forest.name:
森林中孤立伫立的一扇门
Door Standing Alone In A Forest

Text.text:
在阴翳的林间空地中央，孤零零立着一扇巨大的木门——约莫比人形尺寸的旅店正门还要高出一半——无依无靠，仿佛被硬生生从世界里剥离出来。绕着紧闭的门走上一圈，门后什么也没有，只有门板的背面冷冷对着你。然而你随即注意到，一束柔和而诱人的金色光芒正从门缝间淌出，像温暖的呼吸。这样一扇门会通向哪里？它又是如何在此时此地出现的？
Standing alone in the middle of a shady forest glen is a large wooden door—perhaps half again as tall as a humanoid-sized front door of a popular inn—completely disembodied. Walking around  the closed door reveals nothing behind it except the back of the door. But then you notice a golden light, soft and inviting, spilling through the door’s cracks. Where could such a doorway lead, and how did it come to be, here and now?

Sewer Ooze.name:
下水道黏液怪
Sewer Ooze

Text.text:
肿胀的污水团块如泥石流般蠕动，缓缓朝你逼近。那无定形的躯体由凝结的黄绿黏浆构成，其间点缀着粪秽。它的假足像尿流般伸展，胆汁般的污泥触须四下探抓。它的恶臭玷污空气——刺鼻的氨气与腐烂泥炭的腥臭纠缠成一股令人作呕的污浊气息。
The turgid mass of sewage moves like a mudslide as it creeps toward you. The amorphous body is composed of coagulated-chartreuse dotted with nightsoil. Its pseudopods extend like streams of urine, grasping with tendrils of bile-like filth. Its odor corrupts the air with a polluting reek of acrid ammonia fused with fetid peat.

嘲笑着自然法则，一座由黄金与宝石构成、旋转不息的天象仪垂挂在这柄华丽连枷的银链末端。握柄周围嵌着纤细的金色铭文。璀璨的星光镀彩如同秋日拂晓的薄雾般在武器周身游移缭绕。
Laughing in the face of natural law, a swirling orrery of gold and precious stones hangs from the silver chain of this magnificent flail. Delicate golden script is inlaid around the handle. A dazzling patina of starlight drifts around the weapon, like the mists of an autumn dawn.

灵能修行者瘦削如苇，神情沉静，盘膝而坐，目光凝定在空间中某个无形的点上。双手轻轻落在膝头，十指以特定的姿势微微扣合，仿佛在引导这位苦行者所唤起并驯服的能量成形。映在他们脸上的神色，与身上的刺青一样，是对其位面无尽混沌的深沉观照——那混沌已浸透他们，使他们获得了洞悉他人心智的能力。
The psionic adept, slender and calm as a reed, sits cross-legged, staring at some invisible point in space. Their hands rest gently on their knees, fingers held in such a way as to help shape the energy the ascetic coaxes into use. Painted on their face, like their tattoos, is contemplation over the endless chaos of their plane that has imbued them with the ability to know the mind of another.

碘褐色的玻璃罐让人以为只是药剂师调配的温和药水——可标签上那枚骷髅与交叉骨的标记，却暗示着更阴狠的成分。拔开软木塞，露出一罐白色晶体，苦杏仁的气味淡得几乎能悄然掠过鼻端而不被察觉。它虽是间接谋杀的首选毒物，一旦落到受害者身上，发作却迅疾、暴烈，且无可辩驳。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The iodine-brown glass jar suggests an apothecary’s benign concoction—but the skull-and-crossbones marked on the label implies a more sinister compound. Removing the cork reveals a preparation of white crystals, with a scent of bitter almonds so mild it might easily evade notice. Though a poison of choice for indirect murder, its effects upon a victim are swift, violent, and unmistakable.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Crossroads Woods.name:
十字路口林地
Crossroads Woods

Text.text:
两条道路之间隆起一片林地，自分岔处起一路铺满空间，在精心耕整的田畴之间楔入一角野性的林莽。高枝深处不知何处传来寒鸦的叫声，被十几层深浅不一的绿意遮蔽得看不见。林缘阳光下灌木与杂丛疯长成一片喧腾，仿佛在守护那幽暗林腹里的某处私密之地。
A patch of forest rises up between two roads, filling the space from where they fork and making a wedge of wild woodland between carefully tended fields. Rooks call from high branches somewhere, screened from view by a dozen shades of green. A riot of bushes and scrub grows in the sunshine on the verge of the wood, as if protecting some private place in the shadowy interior.

I Cast Power Word Stun.name:
我施放「律令：震慑」
I Cast Power Word Stun

Text.text:
那道箴言如一道霹雳般猛然闯入我的脑海，感召我全神贯注。时间放慢，我能看清目标体内每一处关节、肌腱与肌肉纤维的牵连走向。我吐出那道箴言，它从舌尖迸裂而出，刺得像电击般灼痛。法术击中目标，他们僵在原地——或至少试图僵住。双眼翻白，脚下踉跄摇晃；嘴唇紧抿成不安的一线，面颊因恶心而松垂下坠。
The Word comes to my mind like a jolt of lightning, calling me to rapt attention. Time slows, and I can perceive every joint, tendon, and string of muscle within my target’s body. I speak the Word and it cracks off my tongue, stinging like an electric shock. The spell hits my target and they stand still—or try to. Their eyes roll back and they sway on their feet. Their mouth becomes an uneasy line and their cheeks droop with nausea.

Lair Of The Siren: Calling To Us.name:
海妖巢穴：对我们的感召
Lair Of The Siren: Calling To Us

Text.text:
你方才听见的声音此刻在你体内回荡，你发现自己竟随着它的旋律低声哼唱。你踉跄向前，如同被风牵引的风筝，被那歌声的源头拉扯而去。是什么把你拴在这片地方？为何要退缩？为何要抗拒那早已从你口中唱出的歌？不如挣断束缚，任意翱翔，加入那乘风而来的乐音……
The voice you heard now resounds within you, and you find yourself humming along to its tune. You stumble forward, drawn toward the source of the song like a kite pulled by the wind. What’s tethering you to this spot? Why hold back? Why resist the song that you already sing? It would be better to fly free and join the music on the wind…

海沟抛下上方水域的蔚蓝，转而让位于一片张口欲噬的黑暗。凝视这道深渊时，哪怕四周森林再如何葱郁鲜活，也很容易被人遗忘。
The trench abandons the cerulean blue of the waters above, giving way to a yawning darkness. Peering into this abyss, the surrounding forest, lush and vibrant as it is, might easily be forgotten.

Time-traveling Robots Meet King Arthur.name:
穿越时代的机器人邂逅亚瑟王
Time-traveling Robots Meet King Arthur

Text.text:
披甲的骑士们围坐在庭院中央的一张巨大圆桌旁，各自就位于亚瑟王神圣的宫廷之中。然而，一切并非表面所见。几名战士全身封装、严丝合缝地坐着，他们以学者般的专注好奇打量着其他人，宛如科学家观察实验对象。细小的伺服机构咔哒作响、尖鸣低啸，随着他们整齐划一地转动，一同望向那位日渐苍老的国王——竭力理解眼前这场奇幻究竟如何真实存在。

~ 由 Envisioned 在 Discord 上的 MaesterAelix 构想

Armored knights sit around a large round table in the center of the court, each taking their place within the hallowed court of King Arthur. But not all is as it seems. Several of the warriors sit, fully encased, as they watch the others with studious curiosity like scientists observing a subject. Small servos click and whine as they turn as one to look at the aging king—struggling to comprehend the existence of the fantasy before him.

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

一片苍白的荒原铺展至天际，直到远方群山脚下才戛然而止。此地彻底无生——不见飞鸟掠空，不闻虫豸爬行，不有草木滋长。地面布满诡异的六边形疤痕，将大地扭曲得面目全非；也许是昔日季候更迭的遗痕，又或另有缘故？凛冽寒风卷起晶尘抛向空中，刺痛双眼，覆上唇瓣。零星水洼如镜映着无云的天空，富含矿物的风拂过，细小涟漪在水面上跳舞。
The white expanse stretches to the horizon, only halting at the foot of the distant mountains. It is utterly devoid of life here—no bird flies, no insect crawls, no plant grows. Strange hexagonal scars disfigure the ground; memories of past seasonal change, perhaps, or something else? A chill wind spools crystals into the air, stinging eyes and coating lips. Here and there, pools of water mirror the cloudless sky, tiny ripples driven by the mineral-rich breeze dancing across their surface.

Speech By An Orc Cleric About The Might.name:
一名兽人牧师关于治疗之威能的演说
Speech By An Orc Cleric About The Might Of Healing

Text.text:
“我可不是什么孱弱的小医生。我是伤口的征服者，痛楚的粉碎者。我与一切令你病倒之物展开无休止的战争。我治愈得如此凶狠，凡是面对过我的人，都只能含着感激与解脱的泪水。好了，让我看看你带来了怎样的敌人到我面前。”
“I am no puny doctor. I am the conqueror of cuts and smasher of pain. I wage unending war against all things that make you sick. I’m so vicious in my mending, that those who face me are forced to tears of gratitude and relief. Now, let me see what foe you have brought before me.”

这件乐器有六根弦：从尾枕上的微调弦轴起，越过通向中空共鸣腔的音孔，再横跨一块隆起且带品的指板，延伸到更大的定弦弦轴上。那些大弦轴嵌在一段中空的弯木里——木料雕成卷轴状，并与指板牢牢相连。旁边还有一把弓：一根弯曲的弓杆，两端拉紧马尾毛，用来拉奏这件乐器。
This instrument has six strings that stretch from fine-tuning pegs in a tailpiece, over a hole that leads into a hollow interior, and across a raised and fretted fingering board to larger tuning pegs. These larger pegs fit in a hollow curved piece of wood, carved in a scroll and fastened to the fingering board. Alongside is a bow, a curved stick with hair strung between the tips, used for playing the instrument.

High Seas: The Doldrums.name:
公海：无风带
High Seas: The Doldrums

Text.text: 船周的海面平得像一口结冰的池塘，将铅灰色的天光一路映到地平线——在那里，天与海仿佛融为一体，彼此晕开，只剩灰色，只剩虚无。船身轻柔的摇摆与一缕轻得鼓不起帆的微风，让你同时感到疲惫，又坐立难安。 The ocean around the ship is as flat as a frozen pond, mirroring the gray skies to the horizon—where sky and sea seem to merge, blurring together so there’s nothing but gray, nothing but nothingness. The ship’s gentle sway and a breeze too light to fill the sails make you feel both tired and restless at once.

Overheard Sermon Of A Street Preacher.name:
街头布道者的断续布道声
Overheard Sermon Of A Street Preacher

Text.text:
“——娼妓与巫师淫邪的阴谋将我们团团围住。我们不过是溺水之人，在徒劳中挣扎，抵抗那淹没此城的污秽洪潮。但有一条路，能洗净这世界的腐败；而只需五枚银币的低廉价格，你就能学会！”
“—the lascivious conspiracies of harlots and sorcerers surround us. We are but drowning men struggling in vain against the tide of filth that floods this city. But there is a way to cleanse this world of its corruption, and for the low price of five silver pieces you can learn how!”

Rallying Speech About A Corrupted Creatu.name:
关于一只被腐化的生物的激励演说
Rallying Speech About A Corrupted Creature

Text.text:
“我们如今面对的不是野兽，而是一块污渍。若不将它彻底擦净，它就会蔓延开来。”
“What we face now is not a beast but a stain. One that will spread if it is not wiped clean.”

Divine Torture Chambers Of A Goddess Of.name:
痛苦女神的神圣拷问密室
Divine Torture Chambers Of A Goddess Of Pain

Text.text:
这里有许多厅室，房门半掩。是的，其中一间摆着铁制刑具——螺丝、刀刃与钳子，燃着煤炭火盆，墙上有绞架与绳索。然而，另一间厅室里却只有一把木椅，正对着一座教堂的门。再一间里有一汪占视之池，嵌在石盆中，水面盛满记忆，以及自我憎恨的历史。还有一间摆着一张巨大而舒适的床，床边小几上备着食物与饮料，窗外可见花园景致；房里立着一尊逼真的雕像——受害者的母亲或孩子。这里是一场噩梦，却被系上了一枚漂亮的蝴蝶结。
Many chambers are here, their doors ajar. Yes, there is the one with the iron instruments, the screws and blades and pincers, the coal braziers and racks and ropes. However, one of the chambers contains only a wooden chair facing the door of a church. Another has a scrying pool in a stone basin, full of memory and the history of self-hatred. One chamber has a huge comfortable bed, food and drink on the end table, a view of a garden, a realistic statue of the victim’s mother or child. This place is a nightmare topped with a pretty bow.

The Spare Cufflink In Winter.name:
冬日里的备用袖扣
The Spare Cufflink In Winter

Text.text:
这间浮夸的两层裁缝铺金银辉映，连那些皮克西侍者也不例外——他们的衣装闪烁如龙窖宝藏。店铺一层的假人身上陈列着毛绒衬里的长裙、挺括的外套、贴手的细皮手套——每一件物品都被优雅地搭配得恰到好处。二层里，裁缝正伏在一具假人前缝制鹿皮短上衣，将皮料一针一线合拢。他忽然停住，修长的手掌按在灰褐色的毛皮上。一个古怪的神情掠过他的脸：是哀伤，还是怒意？他那双金色眼睛轻轻合上，深深吸了一口气，随即又回到手中的针线活。
This grandiose two-story tailor shop is aglitter with gold and silver decorations, not excluding the pixie attendants whose garments sparkle as bright as a dragon’s hoard. The dummies on the ground level of the shop are dressed in fur-lined dresses; smart overcoats; slim, leather gloves—each item gracefully styled. On the top floor, the tailor attends to a deer-hide jerkin, stitching it together over a dummy. He pauses, long hand resting on the gray-brown fur. An odd look passes over his face: sorrow or rage? His golden eyes flutter closed as he breathes once, deeply, before returning to work.

Niche Sentinel Statues.name:
壁龛守望哨兵雕像
Niche Sentinel Statues

Text.text:
两尊骑士雕像几乎有成年人的两倍高，分别镌刻在门廊入口两侧的壁龛之中。它们作为守卫，阻挡一切胆敢亵渎地城深处之人的职责有二：其一，提醒越界者正被注视；其二，昭示敢于踏入者早已在预料之中——并且为那一天预备好了手段。
Two knightly statues, nearly twice as tall as a fully-grown human, are carved into the alcoves on either side of the portico’s opening. Their service as sentinels against those who would violate the dungeon’s depths is twofold: a reminder that transgressors are being watched, and that those who dare to enter have been expected—and measures prepared for that day.

以任何尺度衡量——或许精灵的尺度除外——这位萨满都已垂垂老矣。他收拢起自己的法器，开始一段漫长而缓慢的吟诵，双脚在尘土中拖曳，以刻意而稳准的节奏踏出回响。这位备受敬仰的长者是一名祈雨舞者，恳求诸灵将慈悲倾注于他的族人，护佑他们，滋养他们，并降下甘霖。
Old by any scale except perhaps elven, the shaman gathers up his instruments and begins a long, slow intonation, his feet shuffling in the dust in a measured rhythm. This revered elder is a rain dancer, entreating the spirits to turn their mercies upon his people, to cherish them and to water them.

Desert Temple Entrance In A Cliff Face.name:
峭壁之上的沙漠神庙入口
Desert Temple Entrance In A Cliff Face

Text.text:
神殿的入口占据了整整一面峭壁，陡直而高耸。两根石柱直接从岩体中凿出，分立在阴沉的拱门两侧；柱身刻满螺旋纹样，历经亘古风沙磨蚀，已被抛得圆润光滑。门口堆着沙丘，越过其间，入口隧道一路向下，坠入黑暗。
The temple's entrance encompasses the entire cliff face, sheer and soaring. Carved into the stone itself, a pair of pillars flank the looming archway, each etched with spiraling designs worn smooth by eons of wind and grit. Sand piles in the doorway, and beyond it the entrance tunnel descends into darkness.

Neokein \"Bearskin\" Egumavi.name:
新凯因“熊皮”·埃古马维
Neokein "Bearskin" Egumavi

Text.text:
肩头披着厚重的棕色熊皮斗篷，随着每一次呼吸起伏。呼气声低沉翻滚，像崩塌的山坡。裸露在众人目光下的胸膛与躯干布满旧伤，肌肤呈暴风云般的深灰，而每一道疤痕都是一道苍白的闪电，烙在血肉上——那是艰苦鏖战赢来的战利品。斗篷同样伤痕累累，却仍几乎完整保留着兽首。熊的上颚压在他脸前，如阴影般遮去大半容貌；你只能看见他方正、覆着短硬胡茬的下巴，紧紧绷着。

~ 扮演：Akirenvi ；

Shoulders, wreathed in the thick brown fur of a bearskin cloak, heave with each breath. The exhalations rumble like a crumbling mountainside. His chest and torso, bared for the world to see, are a meshwork of old scars: his skin is the dark gray of a stormy sky and each scar a pale strike of lightning emblazoned on his flesh—trophies from battles hard-won. The cloak, as scarred as he is, still has the animal’s head nearly intact. The top of the bear’s jaw looms over his face, hiding most of his features. You can only see his square and stubbled chin, firmly set.

~ Played by Akirenvi with

每一根随风摇曳的麦秆顶端，金色的穗芒在日光映照下闪烁不定；良久之间，这片温柔起伏的原野竟宛如一片银白的海洋。如此景象勾起了记忆中那种田园般的安宁——对历经风霜的冒险者而言，稀罕得近乎奢侈。
The golden spikes atop each swaying stalk of wheat glint with the reflected light of the sun, and for a long moment the gently rolling field resembles an argent ocean. Such a view inspires memories of idyll all too rare in the life of a hardened adventurer.

你面前的武器仿佛在以生命脉动。缕缕乌黑雾丝缠绕着它的刃身翻卷，而那枚切割粗陋、充作剑首的红宝石里，有一抹猩红光芒忽明忽灭。你一靠近，长剑便低声呢喃，许下伟业的诺言。你的思绪沉向阴暗，一幅画面在脑海里成形：你手执此刃，立于堆叠的敌尸之巅，仰天咆哮，宣告胜利。
The weapon before you seems to pulse with life. Tendrils of ebon mist fold about its blade, and a crimson light flickers within the ill-cut ruby that forms the pommel. At your approach, the sword begins to murmur promises of greatness. Your thoughts turn dark, and a picture forms in your mind: you, wielding the blade, atop a mound of slain foes. Roaring your triumph.

Mariner's Enchanted Combat Wheelchair.name:
水手的附魔战斗轮椅
Mariner's Enchanted Combat Wheelchair

Text.text:
这辆回收再造的战斗轮椅上爬满了幽光流转的翠绿色藤壶。它以一艘曾名噪一时的商船被烈日漂白的枯骨为材锻造而成；这些被施了法的甲壳生物提供所需的电压，让这艘老旧快船得以再次被注入新生。漂流木制的座椅安置在打捞上来的舵轮之上，每个把手处都固定着小小的脚轮，转动时轻快而利落。它被设计成可实现完全旋转，使使用者能够将安装的鱼叉枪对准射程内任何不幸之人。
Glowing, viridescent barnacles cover this reclaimed combat wheelchair. Crafted from the sun-bleached bones of a once prominent trading vessel, these enchanted crustaceans provide the voltage required to breathe new life into the old clipper once again. The driftwood chair sits upon the salvaged helm, spinning with small casters fixed to each handle. Designed to achieve complete rotation, the user is able to aim their mounted harpoon gun at any unfortunate soul within its range.

Recban The Thaumaturge.name:
雷克班，奇术师
Recban The Thaumaturge

Text.text:
猫族女子端坐在一摞木桶顶上，敏锐的褐色眼睛扫视着拥挤的集市。阳光下，她的黑毛泛着虹彩般的光泽，鼻翼旁的一枚铆钉穿孔微微闪亮。她拍了拍轻薄束衣的口袋、皮制短甲，又逐一摸过各式各样的袋囊与钱袋，直到带爪的指尖终于叩到腰侧悬着的小斧。她从某个口袋里掏出一面小圆镜举起，一边理顺胡须，一边抚平缠绕在头上的头巾。

~ Played by Puffernami

The catfolk sits atop a stack of barrels, scanning the crowded marketplace with keen brown eyes. Her black fur is iridescent in the sun, and a stud piercing winks at the side of her nose. She pats down the pockets of her airy tunic, her leather jerkin, and her multifarious pouches and purses before her clawed fingers finally tap against the hatchet hanging at her side. She produces a small round mirror from one of the pockets and holds it up as she smooths her whiskers and the wrap wound about her head.

~ Played by Puffernami

Luna De Sangre, A Floating Pirate Town.name:
血之露娜，一座漂浮的海盗城镇
Luna De Sangre, A Floating Pirate Town

Text.text:
停泊在锚地的船只在紊乱的潮涌中起伏摇摆，阵形从梯形被扯得变形，渐渐挤成近乎三角的模样；粗重的绳桥在潮汐的推拉间吱呀作响。几艘船上方飘着烟，带着烟草与甘蔗的甜腻气味。黑旗在风中猎猎翻卷，海盗镇周遭的水面漂满残骸：几只空酒瓶、以及一段塌毁的木板栈桥碎片随波掠过。

~ Pirate lord 所构想

Ships at anchor bob in a disorderly flux, shifting from a trapezoid formation to a near-triangular shape, with the heavy rope bridges creaking as the vessels are pushed and pulled by the tides. There’s smoke above some of the boats, smelling of tobacco and sugar cane. Black flags whip in the wind, and flotsam dots the waters around the pirate town: a few emptied bottles and the remnants of a collapsed plank gangway float by.

~ Envisioned by Pirate lord

远远看去也许难以分辨，但一旦靠近，征兆便清晰得不容忽视。农夫的瞳孔已然消失，眼白如同蛋清般浑浊。牙齿化作犬牙，彼此咬合成一道密不透风的齿墙；本该是指甲的地方，却长出了冷硬如钢的利爪。
From a distance it might be hard to tell, but up close the signs are obvious enough. The peasant’s pupils have disappeared, the eyes like egg whites. Teeth have become fangs that mesh together like a wall, and steely claws grow where there should be fingernails.

Microwave-heated Soy Burger Meal.name:
微波加热大豆汉堡套餐
Microwave-heated Soy Burger Meal

Text.text:
附近躺着一包色彩鲜亮的包装，上面印着一张照片：一只热气腾腾、汁水四溢的汉堡摆在桌上，一家人笑容满面地围拢在旁，仿佛在祭坛前朝拜。往那已经撕开的口子里一瞧，只见一块单调无色、凝结成坨的豆浆凝块，显然还没来得及进微波炉就被人抛弃了。
A bright package lies nearby, featuring a picture of a steaming and juicy burger on a table with a smiling family gathered around it like an altar. Peering into the opened end reveals a monochromatic slab of congealed soy, apparently abandoned before it could even make it to a microwave.

一名纤瘦的女子傲然而立，肤色苍白，目光锐利。银色发丝如绳索般倾泻至背，身着色彩斑斓的飞行服。她掌中托着一枚刻满符文的宝珠，琥珀般的光辉幽亮跳闪，仿佛蕴着某种心灵感应的智能。她颈间垂着一条象征异族阶位的项链，悬在两侧紧绷的肩头之间，像是在承受某种沉重的重量。她优雅的面庞点染着青蓝色墨迹，宛如瓷器上的纹印。
A slender woman stands proud, pale skinned and keen eyed. Silver ropes of hair cascade down her back, clad in a colorful flight suit. She holds a runic orb of glowing amber that fizzles with a psychic intelligence. A necklace of some alien rank dangles from her neck, set between two shoulders tensed as though they are bracing a great weight. Her elegant face is daubed with cyan ink, like markings upon porcelain.

Dragon Erupts From Volcanic Portal.name:
巨龙自火山传送门中喷薄而出
Dragon Erupts From Volcanic Portal

Text.text:
破火山口里轻轻翻涌的岩浆骤然如间歇泉般爆裂，熔融的岩石泼洒在焦黑的山坡上，宛如一场发光的雨。爆焰之间，一道悬浮的剪影舒展出黑暗而可怖的双翼；它獠牙森然的巨口大张，露出其中闷燃翻滚的火光。低沉而轰鸣的咯咯怪笑，像遥远雷霆般在烟雾弥漫的空气里滚动回荡，巨龙俯瞰着它新世界里那座一触即燃的火药桶。

~ 由 Daroneasa 在 Discord 上 构想

The softly bubbling magma in the caldera explodes like a geyser, spraying molten rock across the blackened slopes like glowing rain. Amid the explosion, a hovering silhouette spreads dark and terrible wings, its fanged maw gaping to reveal the smoldering fire within. A low, booming cackle like distant thunder rumbles through the smoke-filled air as the dragon surveys the tinderbox of its new world.

~ Envisioned by Daroneasa on Discord

Wild Magic Surge: Quickening.name:
狂野魔法涌动：加速
Wild Magic Surge: Quickening

Text.text:
汹涌的力量灌入你体内，时代被拖得迟滞——黏重、总慢一拍。你在被加速的状态中，魔法在一道时间的狭隘隘口后堆积，鼓胀翻涌，寻找闸口，随时要以迅雷不及掩耳之势奔泄而出。
As a surging power floods into you, time drags—stodgy, one beat behind. In your quickened state, magic builds behind a temporal narrow, swollen and seeking a sluice, ready to rush out with alacrity.

紫罗兰色长袍与暗色金属甲片裹住这名高挑、纤细的存在；它一只长指的手松松提着一把黑色战镐。它的眼睛又大又亮，漆黑如漆；皮肤灰白，头颅无发，颅顶宽阔、下颌尖窄。看不见嘴——却能看到扁平的鼻孔与耳洞。那双缓慢眨动的眼睛难以捉摸；但在灵能层面，它们嗡鸣着未竟的可能，像一张正要开口的嘴。

~ 由一位英雄 扮演，其

Violet robes and dark metal plates shroud this tall, willowy being carrying a black war pick loosely in one long-fingered hand. They have outsized, shiny black eyes, gray skin, and a hairless head with a wide crown and narrow chin. No mouth is visible—although flat nostrils and ear holes are. The slow-blinking eyes are inscrutable; but on a psychic level they buzz with potential, like a mouth about to speak.

~ Played by a Hero with

Wisecracking Ace Pilot.name:
贫嘴的王牌飞行员
Wisecracking Ace Pilot

Text.text:
一个雌雄莫辨的身影斜倚在一张老旧飞行员座椅里，坐垫被棉絮撑得鼓胀，笑意咧开的唇角还吊着一套尼古丁装置。他们身上的皮革被爆能枪火灼出道道伤痕：一件橙色荧光日光夹克，口袋多得数不清，下面是一条破旧的棕色长裤，裤脚塞进黑色战斗靴里。那晒黑且布满疤痕的头皮上，竖起一撮紫绿相间的尖刺发。
An androgynous figure leans back in an old pilot’s chair bursting with cotton, a nicotine system dangling out the corner of their grinning lips. They’re dressed in leathers scarred with blaster fire: an orange Day-Glo jacket with countless pockets and a pair of tatty brown trousers tucked into black combat boots. From their tanned and scarred head sprouts purple-green spiked hair.

Quasi-elemental Plane Of Minerals.name:
准元素位面：矿物位面
Quasi-elemental Plane Of Minerals

Text.text:
整片天地皆为晶质，灿然夺目，令人屏息。各色宝石千姿百态，体型各异，色泽万千，一路铺陈到目力尽头。闪烁的贵金属脉络在岩石与晶簇间蜿蜒流淌。可当你看清许多水晶竟呈人形——以及他们凝固在脸上的痛苦与惊惧——那份敬畏与美感也随之被寒意压低了几分。
The entirety of the landscape is crystalline, brilliant to behold. Gems of every shape, size, and hue, spanning as far as the eye can see. Glimmering channels of precious metals vein the stone and crystals here. The sense of awe and beauty tempers somewhat, though, as you realize the humanoid shape of many crystals—and the expressions of pain and terror on their faces.

Story About A Serial Killer.name:
关于一名连环杀手的故事
Story About A Serial Killer

Text.text:
“很久以前，有人雇我去追捕一名杀人犯。他杀了六个人，把血淋淋的惨状就那样摆给所有人看。后来我终于找到他——他没躲在什么巢穴或洞窟里，而是在镇上的酒馆，端着酒杯，和那些被他恐吓得寝食难安的人一起喝酒大笑。我上前质问，他却不动手——只是结清酒钱，请全场喝了一轮，然后走到外面。等只剩我们两人时，他告诉我那些人必须死；说有种邪恶占据了他们，除此之外别无他法。就在我割开他喉咙时，他还对我温柔一笑。我曾与强横的巨兽厮杀，也曾推翻疯癫的国王，可我从未见过比那人平静笑容背后更深的邪恶。”
“A long time ago, I was hired to hunt down a murderer. He had killed six people and left the gory aftermath for all to see. Eventually, I found him. Not hiding in some lair or cave, but in the town’s tavern, drinking and laughing with the people he had been terrorizing. When I confronted him, he didn’t fight—he just settled his tab, bought everyone a round, and walked outside. When we were alone, he told me those people had to die. That some evil had taken them and there was no other way. He gave me a gentle smile as I slit his throat. I have fought mighty beasts and mad kings, but I have never encountered such evil as what lay behind that man’s placid grin.”

Editing A File.name:
编辑文件
Editing A File

Text.text:
这里的网络是有形的：拿工资的喽啰来回巡走，俯身从工位后窥视人们的屏幕。你把代码行深埋进一个文件里，用醒目的粗体标题划分章节，整理得井井有条，只盼别有人在别处翻检它，随时会绊上你动过手脚的痕迹。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The network is physical here, with salary grunts walking around and looking over the shoulders of people at their desks. You bury the lines of your code in a file with bold titles for sections and neatly organized, hoping that no one is sifting through it elsewhere and ready to stumble upon your tampering.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Fresh Corpse Of An Adventurer With Obvio.name:
一具新鲜的冒险者尸体，伤口触目惊心
Fresh Corpse Of An Adventurer With Obvious Injury

Text.text:
精灵仰面倒卧，庞大的背包与铺卷将她的上身微微垫起。她身披锁子甲，脸上凝固着震惊的神情。三支箭矢贯穿她的胸口，干涸的血从伤口蜿蜒淌下，染到半塞在她背下的盾牌上。她生前挥舞的长剑已不见踪影，伸出的手中空空如也，腰间的剑鞘也同样空着。
The elf lies on her back, body propped slightly upright by her large backpack and bed roll. She wears chain mail and a shocked expression. Three arrows pierce her chest, and drying blood runs from the wounds down to the shield half tucked under her back. The sword she wielded in life is missing from her outstretched hand and the scabbard at her belt.

Threat From A Weathered Brawler.name:
来自饱经风霜的斗殴老手的威胁
Threat From A Weathered Brawler

Text.text:
“我不介意狠狠干上一架，但你要是再揍我一次，我可就要当真记仇了。”
“I’m all for a bit of brawling but you hit me again and I’m going to start taking it personally.”

The Scheduling Monster.name:
排期怪物
The Scheduling Monster

Text.text:
一座巨大的时钟咔哒作响、沉重报时，仿佛连时代本身都被磨得骨痛。金属先是呻吟，继而蜕变——指针化作触手，数字裂成楔形的区块，每一块上都睁开多只眼睛。表盘变作一尊发号施令的古老神祇，中心像一只巨大海星的口器。触手朝四面八方狂乱抽打，嘈杂的滴答声化作眩晕的风暴，搅得你头重脚轻、胃里翻江倒海。

~ 构想：Tyler

A gigantic clock clacks and chimes roughly, as if time itself has put an ache in its bones. The metal groans, then transforms—hands turn to tentacles, numbers become multiple eyes on wedged sections. Its face becomes an elder god of command, the center like the mouth of a huge starfish. Tentacles flail in every direction as a chaos of ticking dizzies you and turns your stomach.

~ Envisioned by Tyler from

尽管制造商竭尽所能营造温暖与亲昵的错觉，这具愉悦仿生人却冰冷而疏离。它那张美丽面孔上生物塑形的微笑空洞无物，双眼深处没有半点热情。它或许能在肉体上满足需求，但除此之外，再无可奉。
Though the manufacturer has made every attempt to create a sense of warmth and intimacy, the pleasure android is cold and impersonal. The bio-sculpted smile on its beautiful face is hollow, and there is no passion behind the eyes. Though it can physically satisfy, it has nothing else to offer.

这座巨大的祭坛与地面同为一色石材，安放在一座如外墙般雪白的台座之上。祭坛上，一只陶碗与一只金瓶立在大盆的一侧；另一侧，一把漆黑的匕首紧贴着它的木鞘静卧。盆的上缘鎏着金光。无论沙砾还是时代，都未曾在祭坛及其器物上留下丝毫磨损。
This massive altar, of the same stone as the floor, rests on a plinth as white as the outer walls. A clay bowl and golden bottle stand on it, to one side of a large basin, and a dark dagger lies next to its wooden sheath on the other. Gold gilds the basin’s upper rim. Neither sand nor time have marred the altar or its contents.

Axel Blaze-breaker.name:
阿克塞尔·焰断者
Axel Blaze-breaker

Text.text:
在雄辩学院的某个午夜，阿克塞尔（原本叫露珠，不过别说出去）写了一首献给母亲——女巫女王塔莎——的歌，让他小有名气。如今他已是吟游界的名人，写歌、歌唱、演戏，一切都像他记得自己“应该”去做的那样——只因为一道诅咒夺走了他的情感。此刻，他站在巨蛛咔哒作响的螯肢前，抬起吉他放声歌唱，蓝发在船长帽下摇曳；他的信仰守护者正在成形，而他的名声仍在攀升，哪怕邪咒缠身。

~ 由 Bilal 扮演

One midnight at the College of Eloquence, Axel (originally Dewdrop, but don’t tell) wrote a song about his mother, Tasha the Witch Queen, that made him a little famous. Today, a bardic celebrity, he writes and sings and acts as he remembers he should, all because of a curse that took his emotions. Standing before the clicking mandibles of a giant spider, he hoists his guitar and sings, blue hair swinging under the captain’s hat, his Guardian of Faith forming, his fame on the rise despite the hex.

~ Played by Bilal

Dungeon: Double Doors.name:
地城：双开门
Dungeon: Double Doors

Text.text:
一对宏伟的双开大门挡住了前路。其工艺无可挑剔——门扇之间的缝隙严丝合缝，窥不见彼端分毫。门框四周雕刻着繁复的纹样，门面上亦点缀着细致的刻饰。
A grand set of double doors blocks the way forward. The craftsmanship is impeccable—there is no hint of what lies on the other side visible in the seam between the doors. Intricate designs are carved into the surrounding frame, with some detailing on the faces of the doors themselves as well.

Loot From An Angel.name:
天使遗落之财
Loot From An Angel

Text.text:
在这具遍体创痕的天使遗骸之下，他们那柄虹彩长刃熠熠生辉；周遭的微光自刃身脉动涌出，翻腾着灼目的圣辉。他们腰间悬着一只浅色皮袋，银白绳索将袋口紧紧束住。
Beneath the wound-ravaged body of the angel gleams their iridescent blade, the ambient glow pulsing from it seething with radiant light. At their waist a pale leather bag hangs, silvery rope binding it closed.

Radamus Church.name:
拉达穆斯教堂
Radamus Church

Text.text:
这名瘦削男子一身黑衣、黑发如瀑，衬得那张光滑的翠绿色面孔格外醒目；白色獠牙仅从下唇边缘微微探出。他戴着一顶高顶帽，宽大的弧形帽檐向外翻卷，檐下是一团浓密的黑发，在尖耳上方已泛起银丝。长外套之下，他穿着铆钉皮制护甲；腰间左右各挂一只枪套，分别稳稳托着一把做工精致的左轮。斜挎的弹带将一支步枪背在身后，带上还排列着为武器准备的多枚弹药。这名枪手神情隐约带笑，淡淡的咧嘴弧度在琥珀色眼角刻出细细的纹路。

~ Played by mintdivision with

This lean man’s black outfit and dark hair highlight his smooth, green face, where white tusks barely push out from his bottom lip. He wears a high-crowned hat with a wide, curved brim, under which is a mop of thick black hair, silvering above pointed ears. He sports riveted leather armor under a long coat of suppler material, and two hip holsters, each cradling a fine revolver. A bandolier holds a rifle slung to his back, along with numerous cartridges for his weapons. This gunsel looks vaguely amused, with a faint grin that creates fine lines on the corners of his amber eyes.

~ Played by mintdivision with

一只海洋生物身躯扁平如翼，在水中优雅地划出弧线，长尾在身后曳出流影。它的身体上点缀着五彩的尖刺突起与鳍状的张翅般鳞褶；翼缘的轮廓仿佛特意雕琢，既适于游弋，也适于翱翔。尾端拖着数根丑陋的倒刺——显然是一种防御性武器。它发出低沉的呜鸣，几乎细不可闻。
A marine creature with a flat, winged body arcs gracefully through the water, trailing out its long tail. Multicolored spiny protrusions and finlike flares pepper the creature’s body, and the contour of its wings appears specifically adapted for both swimming and flying. Lingering at the tail are a number of ugly-looking barbs—clearly a defensive weapon. It emits a low whine, almost imperceptible to the ear.

这生物曾经高挑而美丽的模样，仍隐约可见——如今它的皮肤被诅咒染成瘀伤般的色泽，绷紧在近二十英尺的肌肉与驼起的背脊上，隆起的疮痂一片片鼓胀。它那突出的双眼能越过小屋屋顶张望，也能直直对上塔钟的表盘。猿似的长臂低垂，其中一只拖着木棒的棒头刮过地面，像是在警告附近所有人：最好再三考虑要不要动手。

~ 由 Admiral Grim Envisioned

The tall and beautiful creature this used to be is almost visible under skin cursed to the color of a bruise, stretched and carbuncled over nearly twenty feet of muscle and humped back. The bulging eyes can look over the top of a cottage, or straight into the face of a tower clock. Ape-like arms hang low, and one drags a club head along the ground, warning anyone nearby to reconsider a fight.

~ Envisioned by Admiral Grim

Decanter Of Endless Water.name:
无尽之水倾注壶
Decanter Of Endless Water

Text.text:
这个大号扁壶由坚挺的蓝色皮革制成。你用一条朴素的皮革背带把它拎起时，壶里半满的液体随之晃荡作响。壶口的软木塞让你格外在意——尽管它本身看起来毫不起眼。一条细细的银链从塞顶绕过，分别固定在壶口两侧。软木塞上被银链勒出一道凹痕，仿佛它始终在向上顶着，急切地想要挣脱而出。
This large flask has been crafted from stiff blue leather. It sloshes, half full, as you dangle it from a simple leather strap. You find the cork that plugs it very curious—although the cork itself seems unremarkable. A thin silver chain wraps over the top of the cork and attaches to the bottle on either side of the opening. The cork bears an indentation from the chain, as if it is always pressing upward to escape.

Loot From A Weakened Prismatic Dragon.name:
来自虚弱虹彩巨龙的战利品
Loot From A Weakened Prismatic Dragon

Text.text:
凑近细看，你能看见巨龙那闪烁的半透明身躯——宛如最瑰丽的彩绘玻璃——以及其体内那颗巨大、搏动的水晶之心。若能将它取回，它又会藏着怎样的秘密？
Up close you can see the dragon’s shimmering translucent form—reminiscent of the most beautiful stained glass—and the large, pulsing, crystal heart within. If it could be recovered, what secrets might it hold?

Great Old One Dream Visit.name:
古老者的梦境造访
Great Old One Dream Visit

Text.text:
梦境从铁链在地面上轻微拖曳的沙沙声开始。紧接着是一声铿锵，又一声，声响愈发响亮，愈发逼近。它在一扇上锁的铁门外停下，门上开着窥视孔。小门板悄然滑开，另一侧黑与灰交缠成旋涡，漏斗般卷向一个微小的身影。深渊里传来一道声音：“进来。我向你寄望城，赐你驾驭混沌与锁链的权柄。进来。”

~ Envisioned by Arastin

The dream begins with the faint scrape of chains across a floor. A clank follows, then another, the sound growing louder and closer. It stops just the other side of a locked iron door with a spyhole. The little door slips open, and on the other side a vortex of black and gray funnels out to a tiny figure. A voice from the abyss says, “Step in. I promise you the authority to wield chaos and chains. Step in.”

~ Envisioned by Arastin

Jet Bike Crashes Into Street Market.name:
喷气摩托撞进街市
Jet Bike Crashes Into Street Market

Text.text:
在街市里，引擎轰鸣被扩音放大的声响并不罕见，哪怕要盖过人群的喧嚣也不算什么。罕见的是，一辆喷气摩托从高处失控俯冲，猛然扎进集市中央，碎片与尖叫一同被抛上天空。燃料、焦火与血腥的气味浓稠地悬在空气里，人们在这场突如其来的混乱余波中僵立不动。
Amplified revving engines aren’t an uncommon sound in the street market, even above the din of the crowd. What is uncommon is when a jet bike careens from above into the midst of the market, sending debris and screams alike into the air. The smells of fuel, fire, and blood hang thick in the air as people stand stunned in the aftermath of the sudden chaos.

I Am Charmed By Dragon's Breath.name:
我被龙息所蛊惑
I Am Charmed By Dragon's Breath

Text.text:
蛇般的眼睛眯起，这生物守夜着它吐息的粉色微光将我淹没。每一块绷紧的肌肉、每一次想逃的冲动、腹中任何一丝怒火——尽数融化，散作一段模糊的记忆，仿佛……方才的一切都不曾发生。此刻我所知的，唯有眼前这条绝美的巨龙赐予我一瞥、一抹笑意，以及即将落下的命令。我的手在武器上收紧，心中满是虔诚，开口问道：“您要我做什么，哦，光辉的尊者？”
Serpentine eyes narrow as the creature watches the pink shimmer of its breath overtake me. Every tensed muscle, every urge to flee, any spark of anger in my belly—these all melt away, disappearing into a vague memory of… whatever was just happening. All I know now is this gorgeous dragon before me has graced me with a look, a grin, a pending command. My hand tightens around my weapon as I ask, heart full of devotion, “What would you have me do, oh glorious one?”

这把手枪在设计与做工上毫无出奇之处，只以最少的技术与审美投入勉强完成本职。薄弱金属制成的石板灰外壳里，塞着一套过时的击发机构；每当枪身被挪动，扳机就会在护圈里令人不安地咔啦作响。

~ 一位英雄所构想

The pistol is wholly unremarkable in design and quality, serving its intended purpose with the bare minimum of technological and aesthetic effort. A slate gray casing of flimsy metal houses the outdated firing mechanism, and the trigger rattles concerningly in its cradle whenever the gun is moved.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Rock Ledge Behind A Waterfall.name:
瀑布背后的岩石峭壁
Rock Ledge Behind A Waterfall

Text.text:
瀑布的轰鸣灌满你的耳朵，那浑然天成的壮美几乎让你屏住呼吸。可有什么东西攫住了你的视线。翻涌的水势间，飞溅的水花勾勒出一瞬的纹路，短暂露出瀑幕后方的某个轮廓。你盯着那道水帘再次分开——没错，你很确定：瀑布背后有一处凹龛或岩沿，宽阔得足够让一个人站立其上。
The roar of the falls fills your ears, and their natural beauty takes your breath away. But something catches your eye. In the tumult of the water, there’s a pattern of splashes that offers a brief glimpse of something behind the falls. You watch the curtain of water part again, and yes, you’re sure of it: there is a kind of niche or ledge behind the waterfall, one large enough for a person to stand on.

荆棘丛簌簌作响，带刺的枝蔓在风中摇摆。尖锐的藤蔓忽然绞缠成团，织成一片密不透风的荆棘栅网，随即扭动变形，凝现出一具高大的类人生躯。它的手臂疯长到不合常理的长度，双手攥紧，化作带倒刺的拳头。荆棘披覆其身，如同扎满尖刺的护甲，肢体与脊背上刺簇丛生。一颗头颅在肩上成形，骷髅般的面容里，两只幽暗空洞的眼窝向外窥视。那凶相毕露的生物挺直身躯，迈步前行。

~ 某位英雄的构想

The brambles rattle, their thorny growths swaying in the wind. The spiky vines suddenly coil together, forming a lattice of impenetrable brambles that soon writhes and shifts to manifest a tall humanoid body. Its arms grow out to an unnatural length, its hands closing into barbed fists. The brambles shroud the figure in thorny armor, with spines sprouting from its limbs and back. A head forms atop the thing’s shoulders, and two dark, hollow eyes peer outward from the skull-like visage. The menacing creature rights itself and sets forth.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Speech By An Old Soldier About The False.name:
一位老兵关于战争虚假承诺的演讲
Speech By An Old Soldier About The False Promises Of War

Text.text:
“他们许诺给我荣誉、声望，还有军人高贵的尊严。每杀掉十来个人，他们就往我胸口别上一枚小小的饰章，告诉我我会被世人铭记。可最记得我的，偏偏是那些被我伤害过的人；而当勋章生锈、腐朽，留给我的只剩噩梦，以及一到黑暗便令人窒息的恐惧。这样的尊严，究竟在哪里？”
“I was promised prestige and the noble dignity of a soldier. For every dozen men I killed, they pinned a small ornament to my chest and told me I would be remembered. But those who remember me most are the ones I’ve hurt, and as the medals rust and decay, all I have been left with are nightmares and a crippling fear of the dark. Where is the dignity in that?”

Speech About The Limits Of Knowledge.name:
关于知识之界限的演说
Speech About The Limits Of Knowledge

Text.text:
“若你们的学者与法师有朝一日真找到了他们那般疯狂渴求的全部知识，你们所有人都将坠入永无止境的癫狂。”
“If your scholars and mages ever found the entirety of knowledge they so desperately seek, you would all descend into an unending insanity.”

Alley Of Golden Tentacles.name:
金触手小巷
Alley Of Golden Tentacles

Text.text:
某种金色之物布满吸盘的触手在狭窄的小巷中蜿蜒穿行，柔韧得不输任何鱿鱼或章鱼。小巷一侧是嵌着铅条的玻璃，温暖的灯笼光从中流泻而出；另一侧则是石墙，其上开着一扇门。无论这生物究竟是什么，它的躯体都被小巷更深处的黑暗遮蔽着。
The sucker-spotted tentacles of something golden wind through a tight alley, as pliable as any squid or octopus. The alley runs between leaded glass—with warm lantern light streaming through—and a stone wall with a door set in it. Whatever this creature is, its body is hidden by the darkness deeper in the alleyway.

收获的最后一天，为一年中最盛大的庆典，人们支起摊棚与展台。筐篮与提桶里堆满的瓜果蔬菜如丰饶之角般倾泻而出。孩子们吃着甜浆果，脸颊黏得发亮；咸香的炊烟与热气在四处游走。主桌前，用最后一捆收割的玉米扎成的偶人倚着一只几乎被一年的成果撑得鼓胀的丰饶之角。人群间不时能瞥见某位显赫的镇民——拙劣得骗不了任何人的乔装——披着黑袍，提着农夫的镰刀，在收获晚宴开始前挨家挨户讨要施舍。
On the final day of the harvest, stalls and stands are erected for the largest festival of the year. A cornucopia of fruits and vegetables spill out from their gathering pails. Children’s faces become sticky from eating sweet berries, and savory cooking smells are everywhere. At the head table, a doll made from the last sheaf of corn harvested leans against a horn of plenty practically bursting with the fruits of the year’s efforts. Here and there, one can spot a prominent townsperson—in a disguise fooling no-one—clad in a dark robe and carrying a farmer’s scythe, asking for largesse before the harvest supper begins.

Locate Animals Or Plants.name:
定位动物或植物
Locate Animals Or Plants

Text.text:
你闭上双眼，将注意力凝聚在你所追寻之物的影像上，把其余的感官向四周敞开。你低声呢喃咒词，手臂在空气中舞动；你倾听风里捎来的声响，嗅闻它携来的气息，感受它流动的方向——当你几乎能品尝到猎物的味道时，你睁开眼，它的所在之处便如潮水般涌入你的心中。
You close your eyes and concentrate on the image of that which you seek, opening your other senses to your surroundings. As you whisper the words and your arm dances in the air, you listen to the sounds on the wind, you smell its scents, you feel its flow; when you can almost taste your quarry, you open your eyes and knowledge of its whereabouts flows into you.

一截粗犷的斧柄由虬结的橡木制成，外缠磨损开裂的皮革，稳稳承托着沉重的铁质斧首。尽管锻造手艺粗糙，斧刃却凶悍而高效，刃口布满使用留下的缺口与崩刃，满是斑驳的战痕。
A rugged haft of gnarled oak wrapped in fraying leather supports the weighty iron head of the axe. Though the metalwork is crude, the cutting edge is brutally effective and well-worn with dents and chips from use.

Erasing My Signature.name:
抹去我的签名
Erasing My Signature

Text.text:
破旧旅馆的昏暗客房里藏着一条街头教训：任何被丢弃的个人信息，都可能像留下名片一样致命。为了让人更难拼凑出这里发生过什么，你花了些时代收拾残局——用漂白般冷厉的手段，抹去每一丝能追溯到你的数字痕迹。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

There’s a streetwise lesson from dingy hotel rooms: any discarded piece of personal info can be as incriminating as leaving a calling card. To make it harder to reconstruct what happened here, you take the time to clean up, bleaching away every bit of digital evidence that could be traced back to you.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Twilight Cleric's Aid.name:
暮光牧师的援助
Twilight Cleric's Aid

Text.text:
牧师疾奔赶去援助盟友，随即单膝跪地——手握圣徽——低声吟诵这道法术的回春箴言，同时将点点闪烁的尘光洒在同伴身上。祂的眼神逐渐失焦，踏入诸界之间的薄幕，引领盟友的灵魂归返。此处的时代仿佛凝滞在飘渺的暮光里。紫罗兰色的天穹之下，永恒西沉的太阳与渐盈的月亮相互追逐，锁定在拂晓与黄昏的无尽天舞中。刹那间，牧师的工作完成，同伴的双眼再度微微一颤，重新睁开。

~ Tusker2zero on Discord

Rushing to their ally's aid, the cleric kneels—holy symbol in hand—and chants the rejuvenating words of the spell as they scatter shimmering dust over their companion. Their eyes glaze over as they enter the veil between worlds and guide their ally's spirit back. Time stands still here in the ephemeral twilight. The violet sky is host to a permanently setting sun and waxing moon, locked in the eternal celestial dance of dawn and dusk. In an instant, the cleric's work is done, and the eyes of their companion flicker open once more.

~ Tusker2zero on Discord

Magical Detection Of A Rogue's Class.name:
对潜行者职业的魔法侦测
Magical Detection Of A Rogue's Class

Text.text:
你凝视着你的目标，施放这道法术时，你身上所有的口袋都合拢起来——温柔地抱紧其中的一切。片刻之后，它们又重新张开。
You look at your target as you cast this spell, and all your pockets close—gently hugging anything within them. After a second, they open again.

Shrine In Swamp.name:
沼泽中的神龛
Shrine In Swamp

Text.text:
这座建筑在几十年前向内坍塌之前曾有着不明用途，如今沼泽已重新吞没了地基，藻类与根须如蛇般沿着石面蜿蜒攀爬。圆筒状的废墟里摆着一座临时祭坛：石桌上插满蜡烛，昏黄的蜡油在烛根处淤积成滩。怪异的是，烛火竟仍在燃烧，在恶臭的风里摇曳不定，投下古怪而阴险的影子——可是谁点燃的？
This structure served an unknown purpose before it collapsed inward decades ago, and now the fens have reclaimed the foundations, algae and roots snaking up the stone. The cylindrical ruin houses a makeshift altar, candles adorning a stone table, yellow wax pooling at their bases. Strangely, the candles glow, wavering in the foul-smelling wind and casting strange, sinister shadows—but lit by whom?

An Intelligent Weapon.name:
一件有智慧的武器
An Intelligent Weapon

Text.text:
这场遭遇短促而残酷，沾血的钢铁在火把光里泛着冷亮。你跨过尸体，强压喘息，手中的武器松松握着。这些野兽究竟在如此拼命地守护什么？你现在看见了——它就躺在一座临时搭起的祭坛上，祭坛由破碎的石板与木屑残片拼凑而成：一把剑，显然古老，华丽的剑柄上镌着早已被遗忘的符印。尘土结在剑身上，可刃口却毫无缺损，想必仍如出炉之日般锋利。你意识到这是一把附魔之剑，显然出自深奥的秘法。你伸手去取，却又迟疑——如此强大的赋礼，竟被留在此处，长久无人触碰。它的守卫已然倒毙。你缓缓吐出一口气，将武器从它的休息之处一把夺起。你好，它说道。你立刻把剑丢开。它哐啷一声砸在地上，钢鸣清脆回荡。哦别这样，那把剑在你脑海里低吟。你既已拾起我，如今我便是你的。我们要去哪里？要做什么？我已经太久太久没有走出这些崩塌的废墟了……

~ 由 Envisioned 的 Tyler Kamstra（RPGBOT.net）创作

The skirmish was swift and brutal, leaving bloodstained steel gleaming in the torchlight. You step over the dead, catching your breath, weapon held loosely in your grip. What were these beasts protecting so fervently? You can see it now, lying upon a makeshift altar of broken flagstones and fragments of wood: a sword, clearly ancient, with an ornate hilt emblazoned with long-forgotten sigils. Dust cakes the blade, though its edge is unmarred, likely as sharp as the day it was forged. An enchanted sword, you realize, clearly born of esoteric sorcery. You reach for it, then hesitate—such a mighty gift, left here, untouched for so long. Its guardians lie dead. You ease out a breath and snatch the weapon from its resting place. Hello, it says. You immediately drop the sword. It clatters to the ground with a ring of steel. Oh come now, the sword intones in your mind. You took me up, now I’m yours. Where shall we go? What shall we do? It’s been so very long since I’ve ventured beyond these crumbling ruins…

~ Envisioned by Tyler Kamstra of RPGBOT.net

一名蓬乱的哨兵以四爪巡行，在营地边缘来回游弋。它凶悍而忠诚，硕大的头颅不断转动，黑色的鼻尖高高扬起，捕捉任何陌生的气味。每一步都沉稳而有章法，利爪叩击石面的节奏清脆回响，像一段令人安心的拍子，提醒着这只生物不曾动摇的守望。它明亮的眼睛以毫不偏移的专注扫视四周，厚实的嘴唇滴着涎水，微微抽动，仿佛随时会对任何威胁翻起，亮出匕首般的獠牙。它永远准备以碎骨般的凶狠，守护自己的族群。
A shaggy sentinel with four paws prowls the perimeter of the camp. Fierce and loyal, its massive head swiveling, the dog’s black nose is held aloft to catch any unknown scent. Every methodical step comes with the rhythmic click of claw on stone, a calming reminder of the creature's unwavering presence. Its bright eyes survey all around with unerring focus, and its thick lips—dripping with drool—twitch as if ready to curl back at any threat, baring teeth like daggers. It’s always ready to defend its pack with bone-crushing ferocity.

Marching To War On The Great Field.name:
在辽阔原野上奔赴战场
Marching To War On The Great Field

Text.text:
靴声轰鸣，联军拖着沉重步伐推进；护甲叮当作响，剑在鞘中铮然震颤，战鼓与号角低沉嗡鸣。纵使喧嚣震耳，队列间却忽然落下一层寂静——敌人尚未入眼前，那短暂的安宁像屏息般凝固。直到敌军出现——暗色钢甲不映一丝光，血红战旗猎猎翻卷——在地平线上密密排开，命令便在你方阵中迅速传递开来。士兵列阵，抬起盾牌与长矛；骑兵躁动不安，渴望纵马冲过战场，让雷霆般的铁蹄把尘土与碎石翻搅成浪。两军相向逼近，先是行军，继而在号角的尖啸中同时奔跑起来。不可避免的碰撞随即爆发——金铁相击的刺耳交织，钢刃撕裂血肉的闷响，痛苦的惨叫与短促的口令混成一团，令人神智麻木。战火翻涌——此刻，就是时刻。

~ Envisioned by Goblin Man

Boots resound as the combined forces trudge forward; armor clatters, swords rattle in scabbards, drums and horns drone. Despite the cacophony a hush settles over the ranks—a moment of calm before your foes come into view. When the enemy—clad in dark steel that reflects no light, flying blood-red banners—appears, assembled in tight ranks on the horizon, orders spread quickly through your allies. The soldiers form up, hefting shields and spears, while the cavalry stirs restlessly, eager to gallop across the field, to churn up dirt and stone beneath thundering hooves. The armies approach one another, marching at first, then each breaking into a run as signal horns blare across the field. The inevitable clash is a mind-numbing blend of metal on metal, of steel rending flesh, of pained screams and barked orders. The battle rages—now is the time.

~ Envisioned by Goblin Man

Sloppy Alien Barfly.name:
邋遢的外星酒吧酒鬼
Sloppy Alien Barfly

Text.text:
那名昆虫般的外星人瘫在吧台上，复眼一片呆滞，刺鼻的黄色唾液从口器里淌下。身上套着廉价却花里胡哨的衣物，这个酒吧里的常客看上去狼狈不堪——即便是在这间破落的酒吧里也是如此。吧台后那名满身纹身的高大外星人一声呵斥，把神志不清的客人震醒；对方嗡嗡作响地怒鸣着，悻悻离去。
The insectoid alien slumps on the bar, compound eyes glazed over and pungent yellow spittle dribbling from their proboscis. Dressed in cheap, colorful attire the barfly is a sorry sight—even in this dive. With a bark, the large tattooed alien behind the bar rouses the befuddled patron, who buzzes angrily as they take their leave.

I Lucid Dream To A Fiendish Realm.name:
我在清醒梦中坠入恶魔秘境
I Lucid Dream To A Fiendish Realm

Text.text:
我以意志驱使梦中的自己振翅起飞，掠过陌生的地貌，专注于目标的方向。地平线上，一座陡峭森然的高山拔地而起。夕阳瞬息沉落，我被留在一个空旷如巨穴的苍穹之下。炽白的熔岩之河沿着山坡淌下，仿佛伤口在流血。借着那光，我看见嶙峋的玄武岩城堡嵌入峭壁，如刀刻般冷硬；大地上尽是焦黑扭结的树木，轮廓却诡异得近似人形。遍体尖刺的有翼身影在金砖铺就的道路上飞掠、踱行。
I will my dream self to take flight, gliding over unfamiliar geography as I focus on my destination. A stark, steep mountain rises on the horizon. The sun sets at once, leaving me beneath a cavernous sky. Incandescent rivers of lava bleed down the mountainside. By their light, I can see severe castles of basalt built into the cliffs, and a landscape of scorched and gnarled trees with unnervingly humanoid silhouettes. Winged figures bristling with spines fly and walk over roads of golden bricks.

Shipyard In Winter.name:
冬日船坞
Shipyard In Winter

Text.text:
一层积雪覆在一座沿着滨水地带延展的巨型石砌建筑之上。寒冷的空气里回荡着锤击与锯切的喧嚣，木匠们正打造、改装并修补各种体型、各类用途的船只。他们在干船坞的庇护下忙碌作业，而船台已被冻住，只为等到春季解冻后，能将一艘艘适航的船只顺利下水。
A layer of snow covers a colossal stone building stretching along the waterfront. The din of hammers and saws echoes through the chill air as carpenters build, refit, and repair boats of every size and purpose. They ply their trade in the shelter of the dry docks, while the slips are frozen, so that they can launch seaworthy vessels after the spring thaw.

不可思议的是，这把强力长弓竟以某种庞然大物的整根角一体雕制而成——那生物形貌近似北山羊，却远比其巨大。草原游牧民或许会用角作为短弓的弓背，便于马背上开弓；而这把弓几乎长出一倍，拉力也与之相称。指尖触及弓身时，会有一丝细微的战栗窜过，昭示这根角多半取自某种高度魔性的生物；再看角的尺寸，除非你追求真正威猛的战利品，否则绝不会想与那样的家伙纠缠。
Impossibly, this powerful longbow has been crafted all in one piece using the horn of some gargantuan creature resembling an ibex but far larger. Whereas steppe nomads might use a horn as a backing for their shortbows to be used from the saddle, this bow is nearly twice that length with a pull to match. A slight thrill through the fingertips as one touches the longbow indicates that the horn was probably taken from some highly magical creature, and judging by the horn’s size, probably not one you’d care to tangle with unless you were after a truly mighty trophy.

这名高挑、白衣裹身的身影圆润得出奇，却仍以优雅的步伐从容迈进。它眯起的眼缝里透出几乎压抑不住的暴烈；那身苍白、如皮革般的护甲与头盔同样泄露了端倪——头盔被塑成狼首，獠牙面罩取代了下颌。被遮蔽的面孔只露出双眼，燃着雪色的冷光，周围是被年代刻出细纹的褐色皮肤。那身影缓慢而无声地抽出一把弯刃长剑与一柄匕首，二者钢刃边缘同时泛起诡异的幽蓝光芒。

~ Played by JT

The roundness of this tall, white-clad figure contradicts the grace with which they stride. Their squint speaks of barely restrained violence, as does the pale leathery armor and helm, the latter shaped like the head of a wolf with a fanged mask replacing the lower jaw. Of the hidden visage, only the eyes are visible, burning with a snowy glow and surrounded by tan skin lined with age. Slowly and silently, the figure draws a curved longsword and knife, the steely edges of both glowing with eldritch blue light.

~ Played by JT

魔法在那张毫不起眼的人类面孔前摇曳，起伏如被蜻蜓轻轻一点的水面。随后，幻象破碎。兜帽像融化般坍塌，嘶嘶作响化作烟雾，继而彻底消散。如今立在那里的，是一名皮肤深红的提夫林；月银色的眼眸嵌在高颧骨之上。他尖削的下巴上修着一圈贴面短短的黑色山羊胡，与他头顶冷峻利落的短发相映成趣。他穿着一身富丽的棕色皮甲，挪动步伐时悄无声息，带着克制却有弹性的轻快。垂在髋侧的手松松垂着，他把玩着一对开锁工具，指间传来细微的金属咔哒声。

~ Played by a Hero with

Magic wavers in front of the nondescript human face, wobbling like the surface of water disturbed only by the light touch of a dragonfly. And then the illusion breaks. The hood melts down and fizzles into smoke before disappearing completely. A tiefling with deep red skin stands there now, his moon-silver eyes set over high cheekbones. His pointed chin is decorated with a close-cut black goatee that matches the austere crop of hair on his head. He wears a suit of rich brown leather that doesn’t make a sound as he shifts from foot to foot with a subdued springiness. A slight metallic clicking comes from his hand hanging loose at his hip as he fiddles with a pair of lockpicks.

~ Played by a Hero with

I Use Careful Spell.name:
我施展【谨慎法术】
I Use Careful Spell

Text.text:
我将两种意图融为一体，启用体内那口奥术之泉，在法术效应显现的同时织就一层护罩来抵御自己的法术。我把这道护盾裹在我选定的生物身上，让它们与法术的纹理之间产生不协与错位。凭借这份庇护，那些存在便能更好地避开我魔法的正面冲击。
Blending two intentions, I use my well of arcane power to weave shielding against my spell as its effects appear. I wrap this shield around creatures I choose, creating dissonance between them and the spell’s pattern. Using this protection, those beings can now better avoid the brunt of my magic.

Giving In To Despair.name:
向绝望屈服
Giving In To Despair

Text.text:
“这太沉重了，我再也看不到尽头。再困在其中一刻，都让我害怕自己会先崩溃。我想不出一条明路。所以我们才会在这里。注定完了。”
“It’s just too much, trying to see the end of this. I fear to be in it longer than I can bear. I can’t think of a way clear. So here we are. Doomed.”

柜台后的男人瘦削苍白，礼貌地向你致意；可你仍能看见他以极其挑剔的目光上下打量你时，眼睛微微眯起。你不敢打包票，但柜台下那只藏在视线外的手，很可能正握着一把手弩。也许，他并不习惯冒险者这一类人常来光顾他的店？
The thin, pallid man behind the counter greets you politely, but you can spot his eyes narrowing as he looks you over with a highly critical eye. You couldn’t swear to it, but the hand out of sight below the counter may well hold a hand crossbow. Perhaps he is not used to adventurous ilk frequenting his shop?

Goddess Of The Sun.name:
太阳女神
Goddess Of The Sun

Text.text:
闪烁的金光化作缥缈丝线，层层缠绕着女神；她的长袍辉耀夺目，璀璨得令人几乎无法直视。恒久的暖意，如同春日初融的第一缕回温，环绕在她身侧——当她行走于大地，带来爱与光，也将所有虔信之人温柔迎入她安抚的怀抱。

~ 由 Discord 上的 Sahlonahl 在 Envisioned 于 Discord

Ethereal threads of scintillating golden light envelope the goddess, her robes blindingly luminescent in their splendor. A perpetual warmth, like the first thaw of spring, surrounds her, welcoming all the faithful into her comforting embrace as she walks the land, bringing love and light.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Puzzling Over A Spell.name:
琢磨一则法术
Puzzling Over A Spell

Text.text:
“把手朝着时钟的逆向转动，食指和中指弯曲成低音提琴的挂钩状……诸界地狱在上，低音提琴的挂钩到底是什么鬼？一边专注于那三色白炽符号，一边把—— 该死的阴郁闷热之夜，我永远学不会这头脑里的怪物！”
“Turn the hand against the clock, with fingers one and two crooked like a double bass hook… What in all the hells is a double bass hook? While concentrating on the three color symbols of incandescence, burn the— Hot night of gloom, I’m never going to learn this mental monster!”

Greeting From A Wolf.name:
来自狼的问候
Greeting From A Wolf

Text.text:
“我尝得到你身上的臭味。你的皮肉上残留着恐惧与杀戮的痕迹。你想要什么？”
“I can taste your stink. There are the traces of fear and murder on your flesh. What do you want?”

Speech About A Life Of Notoriety.name:
