一段关于臭名昭著生涯的演说
Speech About A Life Of Notoriety

Text.text:
“为了出名，我愿意做许多伟大而可怖的事。有人说谦卑即美德，但那些人都是失败者。沐浴在他人的崇拜与嫉妒之中，才让人生值得一活；而说服自己不是这样，不过是试图抚平你自身的失败。”
“There are many great and horrible things I would do to be known. Some say to be humble is to be virtuous, but those people are losers. To bask in the adoration and envy of others is what makes life worth living, and convincing yourself otherwise is only an attempt to soothe your own failure.”

Magic Jar Cast With A Disembodied Sensat.name:
以游离的感官施放魔法之壶
Magic Jar Cast With A Disembodied Sensation

Text.text:
华美的容器静卧在你掌心——你猜，这是一只为活人准备的骨灰瓮。你凝神注视那只罐子，逐渐感到自己脱离了躯壳，灵魂在这临时的栖身之所里凝聚成形，仿佛寄居蟹换了一副新壳。一分钟过去——却漫长得像一个世纪——你的意识苏醒，眼前是一具身体歪倒在一侧，却仍在呼吸……
The ornate container rests in your hands; an urn for the living, you suppose. You focus on the jar and begin to feel disembodied as your soul coalesces into this temporary abode, like a hermit crab changing shells. A minute passes—though it feels like a century—and your mind awakens to see a body slumped to one side, but still breathing . . .

Seduction Quip About True Companionship.name:
关于真正陪伴的撩人俏皮话
Seduction Quip About True Companionship

Text.text:
“亲爱的，你误会我了。我并不想要那种可怜兮兮、只图一晚欲念的邂逅。我想和你真正相识相知。我想让你看见我睡得糟糕后阴沉暴躁、面目可憎的样子。我想在你愤怒、刻薄、被失败折磨得满心挫败的时候陪在你身边。我想和你为无关紧要的蠢事争得面红耳赤。我想要的是真爱，你明白吗——一种长久的爱，能跨过生活里所有细碎的龌龊与乏味，依旧屹立不倒。而我想，我能在你身上找到它。”
“My dear, you misunderstand me. I am not looking for some paltry evening of lust. I wish for us to know each other. I want you to see me grouchy and ugly after a bad sleep. I want to be there when you’re angry, petty, and frustrated by failure. I want to have inane arguments over useless things. I want true love, you see. A lasting love that triumphs over all of life’s little indecencies and boredoms. And I think I could find it with you.”

你拨开那两片被蛀得千疮百孔、权当门用的帘子挤进这间摇摇欲坠的小屋，鼻腔立刻被一股刺鼻的浓烈消毒药酿呛得发痛。屋内地面铺着刷白的石板，像是经过数月甚至数年的一丝不苟地擦洗，洁净得发亮；三面墙都排着架子。每层架上摆满药剂、酊剂与药膏——全都锁在透明玻璃后。房间中央是一张巨大的木制诊疗台，占据了视线的中心，台子一端堆着一叠折好的床单。
As you push past the moth-eaten curtains serving as a door to this tumbledown cabin your nostrils sting from a whiff of strong antiseptic brew. The floor inside is whitewashed flagstones, well-scrubbed from months if not years of fastidious cleaning, and shelves line three of the walls. Each shelf has potions, tinctures, and balms—all locked behind clear glass. A large wooden examination table dominates the center of the room, a set of folded sheets piled on one end.

半身人周身缠绕着一股诡异而超凡的气息。他们紧握一根虬结的法杖，从腰间的袋子里掏出一团漆黑蠕动之物——一只蜘蛛。以古老而无人知晓的言语说话，术士在掌心捏碎蜘蛛，任由黏稠的内脏从指缝间滴落。回应这般召唤的……是某种越过这存在位面的帷幕之物，正缓缓应声而来……
An uncanny, otherworldly air accompanies the halfling. They grip a gnarled staff as they produce from a pouch at their belt something black and wriggling—a spider. Speaking words ancient and unknown, the warlock crushes the spider in their hand and lets the viscera trickle from between their fingers. In response, something beyond the veil of this plane of existence answers their call . . .

这辆推车样式朴素，由陈旧木板与锈蚀钉子勉强拼凑成形，仿佛随时都会散架。后方两只车轮早已变形，前端的挂杆也因反复使用而满是擦痕与磨损。再细看一眼，能发现许多修补与加固的痕迹——显然曾有老练的匠人费心整治过。
The cart is of humble design, composed of old wood and rusted nails that struggle to hold the vessel together. The two wheels in the back are misshapen, and the mounting bars at the front are scuffed and worn from repeated use. A second look reveals numerous patches and fixes implemented by an experienced workman in the past.

Hatching A Dragon Egg With Lightning.name:
以雷霆孵化龙蛋
Hatching A Dragon Egg With Lightning

Text.text:
远处雷声滚滚。天空迅速暗沉。龙蛋静默如死，冰冷无温。它旁边，那件价值连城的遗物泛起一抹幽微光晕，同时一阵刺耳的嗡鸣逐渐抬升。风起，裹着咸味的寒意扑面而来。你将手按在蛋那虹彩流转的表面上，感到那里正滋生出温度——一种脉动的回响，宛如心跳。光芒也将龙蛋吞没，天穹翻涌，风暴在短短片刻间成形。阳光被浓重乌云彻底遮断，一道闪电在你脚边数尺处轰然劈落。此刻的光已灼烈——炽白如熔。你强忍着抽回手的冲动，不去躲避那热度、那力量。龙蛋颤动着，光辉将那件附魔物品撕碎瓦解，碎片在风中化作虚无；暴雨如瀑，成片鞭打而下。狂风重重撞击你，逼你后退，但你仍咬牙坚持，紧握龙蛋，感受它的热，它的生。又一道闪电骤然炸亮……龙蛋裂开了。

~ 由 Matthew Swaney Envisioned

Thunder rumbles in the distance. The sky darkens. The dragon egg sits silent, cold. Beside it, a priceless artifact takes on a subtle glow, while a discordant hum rises. Wind stirs, carrying with it a salt-laced chill. You place a hand upon the iridescent surface of the egg and feel warmth growing there—a pulsing reverberation not unlike a heartbeat. The glow engulfs the egg, too, as the sky roils, a storm manifesting in a matter of moments. The sun’s light disappears, shrouded by dark clouds, and lighting crashes mere feet from you. The glow is searing now—white-hot. You resist the temptation to remove your hand, to shirk from the heat, the power. The egg trembles as the glow disintegrates the enchanted item, its fragments dissolving into the wind as rain lashes in torrential sheets. The wind buffets you, forcing you back, but you persist, gripping the egg and feeling its heat, its life. Lightning flashes again… and the egg cracks.

~ Envisioned by Matthew Swaney

战神身上笼罩着一种出人意料的宁静。他那不可摧毁的猩红护甲，是其无畏的化身。周围架子与挂钩上陈列的各式武器与军备，几乎都成了陪衬——真正的威势来自那双巨大的手，紧紧攥住战争营帐座椅的扶臂。他头戴的头盔令人胆寒——那是来自时代之前的某种野兽头骨——它守护着这位神之军械库中最重要的武器：他兼具战略与战术的心智。
An unexpected calm characterizes the God of War. His indestructible crimson armor is the incarnation of his fearlessness. The array of armaments on racks and pegs around him are almost secondary to the might in the massive hands that grip the arms of his warcamp chair. The helmet he wears is terrifying—the skull of an animal from before time—and it protects the most important weapon in the god’s war chest: his strategic and tactical mind.

这名蛙裔那对硕大、玻璃般幽亮的黑眼睛里，藏着深邃的智慧——一种庄重的通达，映衬得他那纤细而不起眼的身形愈发不合常理。冰蓝色的战纹与蛙类光滑的红皮形成刺目的对比；红色肌肤只在简陋的毛皮与兽皮下偶尔露出。由兽骨拼成的图腾从他身上垂挂下来，随着每一次移动轻轻碰撞作响；他倚着一根虬结的树枝，树枝上也披挂着同样的图腾。一只老鼠从那面斜靠在蛙裔背上的、雕纹繁复的木盾后探出身来，敏捷地爬到他肩头坐定，接过一粒碎屑，慢慢啃咬。

~ 扮演：Mike Hersh

There’s a deep wisdom in this frogfolk’s big, glassy, black eyes—a solemn sageness that belies his slight and unassuming form. Ice-blue warpaint contrasts starkly with the frog’s slick, red skin, where it’s visible beneath simple furs and hides. Totems composed of animal bones dangle from him, clattering softly with each movement, and he leans on a gnarled branch draped with similar totems. A rat emerges from behind the ornately carved wooden shield resting against the frogfolk’s back, moving to sit on his shoulder and accepting a crumb to nibble.

~ Played by Mike Hersh with

这条搏动着的赤橙色蛞蝓散发出一股生石油般的腐臭。它的身躯涌动着动能，灼热的波纹自头至尾旅行而过；当蛞蝓的唾液与空气接触时，剧烈的咕嘟冒泡声里回荡着一记尖锐的共鸣。四根眼柄在一张竖裂的口器上方抽搐，那口器内侧排列着剃刀般锋利的獠牙。
This throbbing red-orange slug gives off a putrid reek of raw petroleum. Its body undulates with kinetic energy as ripples of heat travel from head to tail, a sharp sound resonating with volatile bubbling as the saliva of the slug makes contact with the air. Four eyestalks twitch above a vertical mouth lined with razor-sharp teeth.

I Cast Chains Of Carceri.name:
我施放卡瑟里铁狱之链
I Cast Chains Of Carceri

Text.text:
我面对眼前的超自然存在，吐出三句束缚之言。每吐出一个字，地面便爆裂般窜出一条噼啪作响、如锁链般的冰覆藤蔓，瞬间缠上那生物。第一句，我缚住它的行动。第二句，我缚住它的移动。最后一句，我缚住它的说话。三句尽出，藤蔓随即消失，但那束缚仍旧牢牢留在它身上。
To the supernatural entity before me, I utter the three words of binding. At each word, a crackling, chainlike vine covered in ice erupts from the ground and entwines the creature. First, I bind it from action. Second, I bind it from moving. Finally, I bind it from speaking. All three words spoken, the vines disappear, but their binding remains.

Satyr Corpse.name:
萨堤尔的尸体
Satyr Corpse

Text.text:
酒液从萨堤尔的鼻孔与口中缓缓淌下，浓稠的红色涎液黏成一片，打结在他们胸前的毛皮上。曾经因欢闹与恶作剧而闪烁的双眼，如今黯淡无神，像一只空酒杯般死寂。
Wine trickles slowly from the satyr’s nose and mouth, matting the fur of their chest with thick red drool. Eyes once alight with merriment and mischief are now as dull and listless as an empty glass.

City In The Jungle.name:
丛林之城
City In The Jungle

Text.text:
光线刺破浓密的林冠。丛林并未止步——只是渐渐稀薄，被收束成两侧列树的运河与树荫笼罩的长街。城市的石质建筑映照着森林的丰饶：几乎每一扇窗都簇拥着花朵，而更高楼宇阶梯般的层台上，则整齐排列着一畦畦生长的作物。
Light pierces the thick forest canopy. The jungle doesn’t end—rather it thins, curtailed into tree-lined canals and arbor-shrouded avenues. The city’s stone structures reflect the forest’s fertility, as every window seems to sport flowers and the stair-like tiers of taller buildings host ordered rows of growing produce.

Horn Of Blasting.name:
爆裂号角
Horn Of Blasting

Text.text:
号角顶端覆着一颗咆哮狮首，巨口大张，正是这件乐器的喇叭口。号角各处无一相同：主体如同一场斑斓的狂欢，纷繁图案层层叠叠，每一道都标记着它漫长历史中的一个时代。彩带、珠串与流苏沿着号身点缀铺陈，将这些格格不入的纹饰衬得愈发醒目。
A roaring lion’s head caps the horn, its open maw serving as the bell of the instrument. No two parts of the horn are alike: the body is a riot of colorful designs, each marking a time in the horn’s substantial history. Bands, beads, and tassels decorate its length, accentuating the incongruous designs.

这一只巨蛙纵身一跃，竟不逊于它那小巧表亲的惊人弹跳；它的后腿鼓胀如缆，肌肉虬结。这样的生物完全能一跳越过一栋家宅。而它那张巨口也足以将那户人家的宠物一并吞下。
With a leap fully as impressive as that of its tiny cousin, the legs of this giant frog bulge with corded muscle. Such a creature would be more than capable of leaping over a family home. And its great maw is also large enough to swallow that family’s pets.

移开冰冷的金属栅盖，一道狭窄的石砌竖井赫然显露：足有十五英尺深，窄到寻常人连坐下都不可能。四周房间渗下的潮气与碎屑在井底汇成一滩恶臭的浊汤。浊汤之中，一只骷髅手孤零零地探出，朝你伸来。
Removing a cold metal grate reveals a narrow stone shaft fifteen feet deep and so narrow that sitting would be impossible for the average human. Moisture and debris from the surrounding room has pooled into a fetid soup at the base of the shaft. Out of it, a single skeletal hand reaches toward you.

Flooded Cavern: Rowing Across Underdark.name:
被淹没的洞窟：划船穿越幽暗地域的黑暗
Flooded Cavern: Rowing Across Underdark Darkness

Text.text:
划过一片死寂的水面时，你不由得觉得自己闹出的动静大得离谱。要是这片水域里还有什么东西、什么人，他们必定能在好几里外听见你摇桨时沉闷的撞击与飞溅的水声。可在黑暗中停下，让小船无声漂流在不可测的深渊之上，又莫名更令人胆寒。如今除了继续前行，别无他法。
Rowing across the still water, you can’t help but feel you’re making far too much noise. If anything or anyone else is out there, they must be able to hear the thud and splash of your sculling from leagues away. But stopping in the darkness to drift in silence above unknowable depths somehow seems worse. There’s nothing to do but keep going now.

Naval Trooper In Body Armor.name:
穿着护甲的海军步兵
Naval Trooper In Body Armor

Text.text:
这名海军步兵从头到脚都包裹在一套抛光锃亮的全身护甲中——唯一能辨认身份的标记，是他们沉重肩甲上那枚军衔徽章。尽管装备累赘，他们的动作却出奇地流畅；而那几不可闻的伺服嗡鸣，泄露了护甲内部电机正在暗中出力。
The naval trooper is encased from head to toe in a suit of polished body armor—the only identifying feature being a rank insignia on their weighty pauldron. They move with surprisingly fluid motions given their equipment, and the subtle whirr of servos betrays the presence of internal motors aiding in the endeavor.

Wild Magic Surge: Mood Music.name:
狂野魔法涌动：氛围乐章
Wild Magic Surge: Mood Music

Text.text:
你的法术回声在空气中回荡，继而凝成柔和的乐音：弦乐滑奏如水流淌，晶莹的钟铃清澈叮咚，无形的合唱将你轻轻包裹，化作一曲宁静而空灵的交响。
An echo of your spell reverberates through the air, and resolves into soft music: a glissando of strings, crystalline bells, and a chorus of disembodied voices enfold you in a peaceful, atmospheric symphony.

地面隆起，一层厚重的金白色甲壳破土而出。那昆虫状生物猛地撕开土层冲向天空，粗壮的前臂上点缀着圆柱形尖刺。四条后腿托举着发光的胸节。它的头颅硕大，三只橙色眼睛来回疾扫，眼下是一对巨大的颚钳，锯齿般锋利，宛如两把巨刀。热浪自它体内翻涌而出，几乎令人难以忍受。它抖落身上仍在滴淌的熔融岩浆残渣。
From the ground emerges a thick gold-white carapace. The insectoid creature tears itself skyward, sporting brutish forearms dotted with cylindrical spikes. Four hind legs support a glowing thorax. The head is large, bearing a great pair of mandibles serrated like massive knives below triple orange eyes darting to-and-fro. A wave of heat emanates from the creature, almost unbearable. It shakes off the remnants of liquified rock from its body.

一个矮小的蓝色类人生物站在你面前，只有三尺半高。他们四条手臂中的三条在空中不停比划，像是在强调某个细腻而真诚的观点。两根倒生的角从他们脸侧突起，边缘闪烁着一缕银色微光。话语以惊人的速度从这生物口中倾泻而出，你不由得屏息细听。第四条手臂无力地垂在身侧，手指一阵阵抽动。
A diminutive blue humanoid stands before you, three and a half feet tall. Three of their four arms gesticulate in the air, making a point that seems delicate and sincere. Two inverted horns protrude from the side of their face, glittering with a trace of silver light. Words pour out of the creature’s mouth at an alarming rate, and you find yourself listening closely. A fourth arm sits limply at the creature’s side, fingers twitching.

Elf Scout Targets Raiders.name:
精灵斥候锁定劫掠者
Elf Scout Targets Raiders

Text.text:
紧绷如弦的肌肉牵动着精灵的身形，她向后拉弓，目光死死锁定那群流着涎水、正猛扑她伙伴的乌合之众。她从掠夺者中挑出一名作为她的目标，随即放箭离弦；她脚下的树枝被这股力道带得剧烈摇晃，她把脚跟狠狠钉进剥落碎裂的树皮里，稳住身形。

~ 由 Ameria 在 Discord 上 Envisioned

Tension cords her muscles as the elf draws back, her gaze fixed to the slavering horde assailing her companions. Selecting one of the raiders as her target, she lets the shot fly, causing the branch beneath her to sway dramatically as she drives her heels into the crumbling bark to steady herself.

~ Envisioned by Ameria on Discord

一个由暗钢铸成的男人——机体被切割成爬虫鳞片般的纹路——体内纵横的能量脉络迸出亮蓝光芒，将他映得通体冷艳。几乎每一寸金属骨架都带着伤：鳞片边缘崩缺；刮痕被拙劣地打磨得发钝；四肢在多处用铆钉粗暴固定，仿佛他曾在某个时刻被轰得四分五裂。两枚嵌入面部的圆形镜片——他的眼睛——同样涌动着蓝色能量，那灼目的辉光与他冷若冰霜的气质形成刺眼反差。一门小型火炮悬浮在他身侧，借着魔法的上升气流稳稳托起，炮口噼啪跳着迫不及待的电火花。

~ Played by a Hero

A man of dark steel—his chassis cut into the pattern of reptilian scales—is cast in bright blue light by the lines of energy veining through his body. Nearly every inch of his metal frame is marred in some way: the edges of the scales are chipped; scratches are buffed down poorly; and his limbs are riveted in various places as if, at one point, he had been blasted apart. Two circular lenses set into his face, his eyes, surge with blue energy as well—an effulgence contradictory to the coldness of his demeanor. A small cannon floats next to him on an updraft of magic, the barrel crackling with anticipatory sparks.

~ Played by a Hero

Site Of A Recent Rockslide.name:
近期落石滑坡现场
Site Of A Recent Rockslide

Text.text:
小径在潮湿的泥土与近期山崩滚落的碎石下消失无踪。其上，山坡像围着一条泥与残骸的围兜：断裂的树干、被冲刷得光秃湿滑的地表。滑坡尽头的堆积物下方，仍有浑浊的细流淅淅沥沥渗出。新翻泥土般清新的土腥气扑面而来，仿佛犁过的田地，预告着春天嫩芽即将破土。然而此刻，石块的噼啪坠落与水花的溅响提醒你，滑坡余烬仍摇摇欲坠。

~ 设想：Einjuden

The trail vanishes under the wet earth and tumbled stones of a recent rockslide. Above it, the hill wears a bib of mud and debris, shattered tree trunks, and scrubbed, wet earth. Muddy rivulets still trickle from under the heap at the slide’s end. A fresh smell of soil, like a plowed field, promises the budding of new spring shoots. For now, though, a clatter and splash of stones tells you that the remains of the slide are still precarious.

~ Envisioned by Einjuden

Grimy Waterfront Bar.name:
肮脏的海滨酒吧
Grimy Waterfront Bar

Text.text: 门外那块刺眼的招牌在乐观的蓝色光晕里宣告着 WITH A VIEW。你透过酒吧侧面一排脏兮兮的窗户往里瞧，又看见那道熟悉的、被油污抹开的地平线：一轮昏沉的红日，以及黑暗、恶臭的水面。不过算了——墙上的全息菜单显示酒水便宜，而酒保下手很重。她站在黏腻的吧台后朝你冷冷点头致意。她的机械臂一边冒着蒸汽、迸着火星，一边抖动着摇酒壶。她把一杯泛绿的鸡尾酒倒进一只雾蒙蒙的玻璃杯里，顺着吧台滑过去，正好送到一个仍穿着油腻工装的井架工人面前。 The glaring sign out front advertises WITH A VIEW in an optimistic blue glow. You peer through the grimy windows lining the side of the bar and see that familiar smudgy horizon of a bleary red sun and dark, stinking water. But hey—the holographic menu on the wall shows the drinks are cheap, and the bartender pours with a heavy hand. She gives you a cool nod from behind the sticky bar top. Her mechanical arm steams and sparks as it judders a drink shaker. She pours a greenish cocktail into a foggy glass and slides it down to a rig worker still dressed in his oily coveralls.

Torchlight Playing Over Ancient Arena.name:
火把光影掠过古老的竞技场
Torchlight Playing Over Ancient Arena

Text.text:
摇曳的火把光在古老竞技场的废墟上投下阴森的微光。角斗坑边缘四周拉长的影子，仿佛在暗示这些坍塌的墙垣曾目睹过无数场厮杀。还是说，那不过是你的想象？
The flickering torchlight casts an eerie glow over the ruins of the ancient arena. The shadows cast around the periphery of the gladiatorial pits are suggestive of the many fights these crumbled walls have witnessed. Or is that simply your imagination?

Approaching A Starving Village.name:
逼近一座饥荒中的村庄
Approaching A Starving Village

Text.text:
没有垃圾堆燃起的火，没有马厩里可喂的饲料，连一丝腐烂蔬菜的臭味都闻不到。也听不见人声，除了偶尔传来婴儿的哭嚎。你看不到狗或猫，只有一匹母马，肋骨在皮下隆起如脊，蜷着腿伏在马厩里。屋舍里仍有炊烟升起；你嗅到饥饿的病气，把那令人胆寒的倦怠吸进肺里，仿佛它就悬在空气中。
There are no trash fires, no feed in the stalls, not a single smell of rotting vegetables. And not one sound of human voice save the occasional baby’s wail. You see no dogs or cats, although a horse, ribs ridging her sides, lies with legs tucked under in a stable. Smoke comes from the houses, and you smell the sickness of hunger and breathe its terrifying fatigue in the air.

如今，你已透过伟业之窗，眺望终极权能。小小的城市与地区都知晓你的名号。王族与霸主主动寻你而来，异界的住民也借由传说与歌谣注视着你。无论是为誓言，还是为安宁，你都追逐那些需要强大魔法的挑战。你的武器或许拥有名字，其威权不止于锋刃与分量。你的护甲或披风，你的帽子或靴子——你如今拥有的许多东西，都不再轻易能被替换。你召来风暴，直面军阵，与英雄（或恶徒）同席分食。你向着世人纷纷逃离之处，踏步进军。
Now you look through the window of greatness and toward ultimate power. Small cities and regions know your name. Royals and overlords seek you out, and the dwellers in other realms watch you through tale and song. Whether for your vows or for your comfort, you pursue challenges requiring powerful magicks. Your weapons might have names, authority beyond only their edge or heft. Your armor or cloak, your cap or boots--much of what you have now cannot be easily replaced. You call storms, face armies, break bread with heroes (or villains). You march toward whatever most of the world flees.

向下走了十来级台阶，你就感觉气温骤降。再往下走十来级，上方的声响渐渐远去，取而代之的是一股清冽洁净的气息在鼻腔里愈发浓郁。水淹没了最底层的台阶，仿佛它们自此坠入无尽深处，消失不见。你低下头，望向那间被水淹没的寂静大厅。
A dozen steps down, and you feel the temperature drop. As you descend a dozen more, sounds from above diminish, but a fresh, clean scent grows in your nose. Water submerges the bottommost stairs, so that they seem to fall away into the depths unendingly. You duck your head to look over the silent chamber flooded with water.

Temple Of Death.name:
死亡神殿
Temple Of Death

Text.text:
这座神庙几乎令人难以置信。它栖立在一座大湖的岸边，庞大而诡异的结构让人联想到一辆没有车轮的利维坦战车：高墙拔地而起，又向下倾斜收束。内部由三层阶梯式结构分隔开来，中央一根冲天的黑色尖塔前，矗立着一尊巍然的青铜巨像。其间，信众的颂唱在石壁之间回荡不息。
The temple defies belief. Perched on the shores of a great lake, the  massive and strange structure evokes images of a leviathan chariot devoid of wheels, with walls rising high and sloping downward. A series of three tiers divide the inner structure, with a towering bronze statue standing before a soaring black spire at its center. Within, the chants of worshipers reverberate off stone.

Sundries From A Unicorn.name:
来自独角兽的杂货
Sundries From A Unicorn

Text.text:
在独角兽的林间幽地里，你发现一根高挑的手杖，由光滑柔韧的桦木制成，杖身镌刻着华美繁复的符号。杖顶雕着一颗独角兽的头颅，浮雕细节璀璨夺目，栩栩如生。
In the unicorn’s glade you find a tall walking stick crafted of smooth, supple birch and engraved with beautiful, elaborate symbols. Carved atop the cane is a unicorn’s head, resplendently detailed in stunning relief.

在这片石柱耸立的峡谷中，外头尚能察觉的暖风一踏入便消散无踪，取而代之的是清冷的寂静。东侧有一根石柱的角落已然崩塌，参差锋利的碎片散落在沙地上。破损的柱身周遭空气如脉动般起伏，将一阵阵温热的气流推向小径尽头那扇幽暗的门洞。这些扑来的气息仿佛把尘土吹拢，覆在前方的地砖之上。
Within the pillared canyon, the warm breeze apparent outside fades to cool stillness. On the east side, one of the pillars has crumbled on a corner, and jagged shards have fallen to the sand. The air pulses around this broken column, sending warm gusts toward the shadowy doorway at the pathway’s end. These puffs seem to have pushed dust onto the tiles ahead.

Sundries From A Pixie.name:
妖精的杂货
Sundries From A Pixie

Text.text:
翅膀低垂蜷曲，如同将死的叶片，小精灵的皮肤原本的翠绿也染上了阴冷的死灰。尽管他的呼吸与微光显然都已耗尽，他的装束仍为那曾经鲜活的生命留下一抹颜色：一圈满天星花冠覆在头顶，像被困在时代里的薄雪粉尘；而他的束腰外衣——由勿忘我编织成的一束——呈现出暮色般的紫蓝。
Wings drooped and curled like dying leaves, the green hue of the pixie’s skin is tinged with a deathly gray. And though his breath and sparkle have clearly both been spent, his outfit gives color to his once vibrant life: a wreath of baby’s breath crowns his head like a powder of snow caught in time, and his tunic—a woven bunch of forget-me-nots—is the purpling blue of twilight.

Terrace Of A Manor.name:
庄园露台
Terrace Of A Manor

Text.text:
宽阔的露台俯瞰着庄园辽阔的花园。露台上铺设着繁复的石砖，交织出令人目眩的纹样，勾勒出通往各处的小径：一处有顶的休憩座位区、一座下沉式的露天火炉，甚至还有一处抬高的水嘴，方便人们在真正踏入庄园前先把靴子上的泥浆冲洗干净。精雕细琢的石质栏杆将露台与花园分隔开来；花园内动植物繁盛多样，从本地盛开的花卉到声名远扬的葡萄藤，再到羽色如棱彩般流光溢彩的异域鸟儿。
The large terrace overlooks the manor's expansive gardens. Elaborate stone tiles create a dizzying pattern upon the terrace, creating paths leading to a covered sitting area, a sunken outdoor hearth, even a raised spigot for washing the mud from one's boots before entering the manor proper. A worked stone banister separates the terrace from the gardens, which boast a wide variety of flora and fauna, from local blooms to famed grapevines to exotic birds with prismatic feathers.

Speak With Animals.name:
与动物交谈
Speak With Animals

Text.text:
你年少时常常揣测动物在想什么。如今，你只需开口问它们便可。动物往往会因你能与它们交谈而惊愕，而它们天性诚实。然而，你必须保持警惕。动物越聪明，或与你越熟悉，它就越可能为了占到便宜而施展欺瞒。你绝不该照单全收动物说的每一句话——即便那真的是从马嘴里说出来的。
When you were young, you often wondered what animals were thinking. Now you can simply ask them. Animals tend to be astonished that you can speak to them, and they are innately truthful. But you must be cautious. The smarter the animal or the more familiar it becomes, the more likely it uses deception to gain advantage. You should never take what an animal says at face value, even when it literally comes from the horse's mouth.

Battle Line Forming.name:
战线成形
Battle Line Forming

Text.text:
在铂色天幕之下，连队士兵身披洁净的板甲，色泽几乎与周遭的雾霭无异。持矛兵列于前排，旗手亦并肩而立。猩红与鎏金的罩袍与旗上的雄狮纹章相互辉映，那面旗帜垂覆其上，俯视着正就位的士兵。
Under a platinum sky, soldiers of the company wear clean plate armor nearly the color of the fog around them. Spearmen take the front rank, along with the pennant bearer. Tabards of crimson and gold match the lion sigil on the flag, which hangs over the soldiers now taking position.

Potion Of Diminution.name:
缩小药水
Potion Of Diminution

Text.text:
这份魔法调制物里淡粉色的液体每隔几秒便会收缩成一颗樱桃红的小珠。每当如此，软木塞便轻轻蠕动一下，玻璃也随之传来一阵细微的颤鸣。
This magical concoction’s faint-pink liquid contracts into a tiny cherry-red bead every few seconds. The cork wriggles each time this happens, and a slight tremble thrums through the glass.

Deep City Of Spiders.name:
蜘蛛深城
Deep City Of Spiders

Text.text:
城市在高门大族的山巅别墅与其华丽雕琢的垛墙之下熠熠生辉。洞窟地面那一根根巨大的石笋被镂刻出繁复的格栅与尖塔，紫、品红与蓝交织其上。纤细的魔法纹路以银色点缀整座城市，如同镶丝细作的护甲。街道在乌木壁灯下喧嚣涌动，灯盏托着一团白焰，宛如未戴兜帽者的发丝。无数尖顶建筑上布满黑色门洞——暗中交易的门洞，也是蜘蛛潜伏的门洞。

~ Envisioned by DM Robert of @GamerEssentials

The city sparkles below the wall of the high family villa and its ornately carved crenellations. Elaborate latticework and spires in purple, magenta, and blue are cut into giant stalagmites on the cave floor. Fine lines of magic decorate the city in silver like filigreed armor. The streets bustle under ebony sconces that hold a white fire resembling the hair of the unhooded. Its many spired buildings are pocked with black doorways—doorways of clandestine deals, and doorways where the spiders hide.

~ Envisioned by DM Robert of @GamerEssentials

I Use Subtle Spell.name:
我施展【精妙法术】
I Use Subtle Spell

Text.text:
我施法，用正常的时间凝聚意志、塑造法术。但我始终沉默不动。我不做正确的奥术手势，也不吟诵咒文，而是点燃体内尚未成形的奥术潜能。它代替缺失的施法成分，仍旧将法术硬生生逼入现实。
I cast, taking the normal time to focus my will and form the spell. But I remain silent and still. Instead of making the proper arcane gestures and incantations, I burn the unformed arcane potential within me. It takes the place of the missing components, forcing the spell into being anyway.

Werewolf Bursts From The Trees.name:
狼人从林间骤然冲出
Werewolf Bursts From The Trees

Text.text:
一连串沉重的脚步声撞碎远处的灌木丛，闷响由远及近，愈发逼人。忽然枝叶四溅，一头魁梧的生物伴着粗哑的咆哮猛然冲出。它的面容在人与兽之间扭曲交战：类人的额头与鼻梁挤作一团，像犬类龇牙的口吻；狼似的耳朵高竖；类人的口中却探出长长的獠牙。它足有七英尺高，身躯由岩石般坚硬的肌肉雕刻而成。纠结的粗毛厚厚覆住它的手臂、头颅与胸膛，类人手指的末端却生出利爪。它赤红的眼睛寒光闪烁，带着狂怒的目的，拖拽着身躯穿行在林间。
A series of thudding footfalls crashes through the distant brush. The sound grows louder until, in a shower of twig and leaf, a hulking creature bursts forth with a guttural roar. The features of its face war between human and beast: humanoid brow and nose scrunched together like a dog’s snarling snout, wolfish ears, long fangs sticking out from a humanoid mouth. It stands at a height of seven feet, its body cut with rock-hard muscle. Matted hair thickly coats the creature’s arms, head, and chest, and claws sprout from the ends of its humanoid fingers. Red eyes gleaming, it hauls itself through the woods with rageful purpose.

Spell Scroll Case (Arcane).name:
法术卷轴匣（奥术）
Spell Scroll Case (Arcane)

Text.text:
这只卷轴匣上布满令人目眩神迷的符号，闪耀的金色符文在其间游走，仿佛在光线中起舞变幻。两端以抛光的淡紫色宝石封口，宝石之间系着一条细致的皮革带，通过闪亮的搭扣牢牢固定。
Mind-bending symbols cover this scroll case in shimmering golden runes which seem to dance and shift in the light. Polished lavender gems cap the tube at each end, and a fine leather strap is strung between them on gleaming buckles.

Grocery-getter Scooter.name:
买菜代步小踏板
Grocery-getter Scooter

Text.text:
这辆杂货代步车早已风光不再。金属篮筐上好几根栅条弯折或缺失，小小轮胎的胎纹被磨得光秃，车架上的油漆褪色斑驳、剥落缺口。可不知怎么的，在这支狭小又乱糟糟的车队里，它竟然还算最体面的一辆。
This grocery scooter has seen better days. Several of the strands in the metal basket are bent or missing, the tread on its tiny tires are worn bald, and the paint on the frame is faded and chipped. Somehow, it's the best-looking option in the small, disorderly fleet.

Paladin’s Suit Of Plate Armor.name:
圣武士的板甲套装
Paladin’s Suit Of Plate Armor

Text.text:
承载着这副护甲的简朴木制支架，仿佛化作一座圣龛。每一处细节都为惩戒成群的不死军团而铸。阴沉的头盔如审判的面容；胸甲的大部分是一枚巨大的圣徽，其所侍奉的神明被涂油的金属紧紧抵在心口；而那覆盖每一条肢体与关节的繁复而克制的甲片，则是铁匠们庄严的祈祷。护甲所守护的不止是其中的血肉。它守护一切生命与律法。
The simple wooden stand bearing this armor becomes a shrine. Every piece is crafted to chastise armies of the undead. The grim helmet is the countenance of judgment; most of the breastplate is a great holy symbol, its god held against the heart by oiled metal; and the complicated, deliberate plates that cover every limb and joint are the solemn prayers of smiths. The armor protects more than the flesh inside. It protects all life and law.

Pool Of Blessings.name:
祝福之池
Pool Of Blessings

Text.text:
丰美的睡莲叶静静漂浮在这片美丽水池的澄蓝水面上，虹彩般的微光精灵在上空欢快穿梭。水池的守护者——一尊古老而仁慈的雕像——在池心捧着一只供奉碗，它谦和的微笑让你心头涌起温暖的安宁与满足。
Sumptuous lily pads float peacefully on the calm blue waters of this beautiful pool, as iridescent sprites flit happily through the air above. The pool’s guardian—an ancient and benevolent statue—holds an offering bowl at the pool’s center, their humble smile filling you with a warm sense of peace and contentment.

I Sculpt Spells.name:
我塑形法术
I Sculpt Spells

Text.text:
巫术关乎精确。我唤起力量环绕我的敌人，却又以分毫不差的手法，将它们避开我不愿伤害之人，严密编织其间。于是，安全的空隙便随之成形。在这些口袋般的避风之处，被我从魔法锋芒中排除的人，无需畏惧它的余波。
Wizardry is about exactness. I evoke the forces about my enemies, but I precisely weave them around those I wish no harm to. Safe spaces form. In these pockets, those I exclude from the brunt of my magic need not fear its effects.

Loot From A Snakeblooded Humanoid.name:
蛇血类人身上的战利品
Loot From A Snakeblooded Humanoid

Text.text:
在那瘦削的身躯外裹着衣物与护甲之间，你发现他们腰带上挂着一个沉甸甸的钱袋，背包里还藏着一个小巧的皮革携行盒。盒中是一套伪装工具，配有各类配件：一只夸张的人形鼻子、肉色妆粉，以及一副深色眼镜。看起来他们或许曾用这套工具强化人类的特征，同时把自己那蛇一般的一面藏进阴影里。
Amid clothes and armor wrapped around the thin-framed body, you find a hefty coin purse on their belt and a small leather carrying case in their pack. The case is a disguise kit with accessories, such as a pronounced humanoid nose, flesh-toned makeup, and a pair of shaded glasses. It seems they may have used the kit to highlight human features while obscuring their serpentine side.

旅店褪色的油漆成片剥落，像破布般垂挂着，被裹着盐味的海风从木板上生生撕扯下来。门上方用吱呀作响的铁链吊着一块被水浸透的木招牌，上面画着一只海鸥正从倒扣的啤酒杯里痛饮解渴。它紧挨码头，门口永远是醉意各异的水手进进出出的人潮，屋里飘出海员号子的轻快旋律。昏暗的空间里，形形色色的海上讨生活的人挤在桌旁，端着堆满油腻炸鱼的锡盘大快朵颐，再一口口从各自的酒杯里猛灌下去。
The inn's faded paint hangs in peeling tatters, flayed from the structure by the salt-laced wind. Hanging above the door on creaking chains is a waterlogged wooden sign depicting a seagull drinking its fill from an upturned tankard. Situated near the docks, the doorway is a constant stream of sailors coming and going in various states of inebriation, and the lilting notes of sea shanties waft from inside. The dim space hosts all manner of sea-folk huddled around tables, enjoying tin plates piled with greasy fried fish and washing them down with gulps from their tankards.

Leoril Jade-lazuli Puffington.name:
利奥里尔·翡翠青金·帕芬顿
Leoril Jade-lazuli Puffington

Text.text:
这名游荡的奇械师肤色如杏仁酱般温润，却因巨人之血的侵染而变得粗糙坚硬。他们体内仿佛有齿轮在咔哒作响、低鸣嗡振——身形修长挺拔，举止间带着高等精灵的清冷与矜贵，站姿如领主般从容。姜黄色的头发两侧剃短，余下编成一条辫子垂落背脊。那双绿眼睛灵动迅捷，像被上紧的弹簧，尤其在谈及构装体与小器械时更是灼灼发亮。他们随时备战，细剑、左轮与盾牌皆在手。

~ 由一位英雄扮演

This rogue artificer has skin the color of almond butter, yet giant's blood has turned it rough. They tick and hum, standing tall and thin, and bear an air of the high-elven with the posture of a lord. Ginger hair, shaved on the sides, falls in a braid down their back. Their green eyes are active and quick, as if wound on tight springs, especially during conversation about constructs and gadgetry. They stand ready with rapier, revolver, and shield.

~ Played by a Hero

Headstone: “That” In Winter.name:
墓碑：“那个”在冬日中
Headstone: “That” In Winter

Text.text: 尽管积雪柔化了断口的棱角，这块墓碑仍缺失了一大截——不知何故从顶部断裂，被抛走或搬走。石板正面刻着一行阴郁的铭文：生命竟如此短暂，似乎残酷；但生命本就残酷，那么或许这便是仁慈。 Although snow softens the edges of the break, a chunk of this tombstone has gone missing, somehow broken from its top and tossed or carried away. The face of the slab bears a grim engraving: That a life should be so short seems cruel, but life is cruel, so perhaps this was mercy.

这只铁壶 snugly tucked into 一只磨旧的皮革小袋里，壶身有些地方的抛光早被磨去，可那枚黄铜塞子却亮得刺眼，仿佛昨天才刚锤打成形。你感到一股诡异的暖意从中渗出。它在微微发抖吗？你刚在心里问出这句话，它就立刻停了。也许只是你的错觉？当你听见——或以为听见——某种低沉的咆哮从极远处传来时，寒意顺着皮肤爬开，逼得你不由得回头张望。
Snugly tucked into a worn leather pouch, the polish has rubbed off on some parts of this iron flask, but its brass stopper shines as if it were hammered into shape yesterday. You feel a strange warmth emanating from it. Is it shaking slightly? As soon as you ask yourself that question, it stops. Perhaps you only imagined it? Your skin crawls as you hear—or imagine—something growl as if from a long way off, enough to make you look over your shoulder.

无声无息，卓尔将匕首直送要害，几乎像外科手术般精准地从目标肋骨间滑入，干净利落地了结性命。尸体尚未触地，盗贼已融回阴影之中，身影在掩蔽与掩蔽间掠动，攀上排水槽悄然遁去，不留半点痕迹。
Unseen, unheard, the drow drives their dagger home, slipping it almost surgically between their target’s ribs for a clean, quick kill. Before the corpse hits the ground, the rogue melts back into the shadows, flitting from cover to cover and scaling a gutter to escape notice.

Jacob Nikolaus.name:
雅各布·尼古劳斯
Jacob Nikolaus

Text.text:
褐色的长发从这名苍白男子宽檐黑帽下四下翘出，像被风随意拨乱。他披着同色的长外套，遮住臃肿的身形。身上是深色、实用的旅装，可衣领边仍露出几枚神秘符号的纹身。左手紧攥一根虬结的橡木手杖；右手松松捏着一支卷好的粗烟。
他把烟叼到嘴边，深深吸了一口，挑起一侧眉梢，冷眼打量眼前的景象。卷烟末端的红光勾出他鼻梁上的疤痕轮廓，也照亮了那双带着轻蔑的蓝眼。

~ Played by Ararion

Long strands of brown hair poke out in several directions from under this pale man’s wide-brimmed black hat. His matching overcoat cloaks his portly form. He sports dark, practical traveler’s garb, but tattoos of mystic symbols still peek from his collar line. In his left hand, he clutches a gnarled oak staff; in his right, he loosely holds a rolled stogy. Bringing the cig to his mouth, he takes a long drag, observing the scene with one eyebrow raised. The rollup’s glowing tip casts the scar across his nose in relief, and illuminates his scornful blue eyes.

~ Played by Ararion

Threat From A Mind Flayer About Dreams.name:
来自夺心魔的梦魇威胁
Threat From A Mind Flayer About Dreams

Text.text:
“得做多么瑰丽的梦，才敢把自己当成英雄。我几乎等不及要一口口品尝它们——当它们从你的颅骨缝隙里渗出来时。”
“It must take such wondrous dreams to believe yourself a hero. I can barely wait to taste them, one by one, as they leak from your skull.”

Pair Of Newlyweds.name:
一对新婚夫妻
Pair Of Newlyweds

Text.text:
这对情侣肩并肩紧挨着走着，各自抬起一只手，与对方十指相扣，高举的手臂上缠绕着一串花链。两人穿着想必是最体面的盛装，像是刚从某场仪式上径直赶来。他们也分明知道要去哪里，因为他们连看都不看路——眼里只剩彼此。
The couple walks close together, each with a hand raised and clasped to the other’s, their raised arms wrapped with a chain of flowers. They wear what must be their finest clothes, and it seems they must have come directly from a ceremony. They also know where they are going because they aren’t looking. They only have eyes for each other.

I Cast Alter Self: Aquatic Adaptation.name:
我施放【变身术：水栖适应】
I Cast Alter Self: Aquatic Adaptation

Text.text:
我深吸一口气，对自己说话。那道附魔听起来像是在说话时打嗝，吐出的字句圆滚滚、黏腻得令人作呕。随之而来的是不适，仿佛有人正从我脖颈上撕剥结痂。手指与脚趾又黏又软，像橡胶般发胀扭伤——旋即一切恢复如常，唯独空气吸进肺里变得古怪，而水在低声呼唤。
After a deep breath I talk to myself. The enchantment sounds like belching while speaking, the words round and grossly liquid. Then the discomfort, as if someone is peeling scabs from my neck. My fingers and toes feel sticky, rubbery, and sprained—then all is normal, except the air feels strange to breathe, and the water calls.

Leather Knee Brace.name:
皮革护膝
Leather Knee Brace

Text.text:
这副护膝绝非等闲之作——它不只是轻轻松松包住膝盖而已。尽管皮面压花与冲孔精美得令人屏息，但它的设计者显然不只是皮匠。自护盖处延伸出的皮带与扣具以出人意料的角度分岔伸展；而多重束带的组合调节，让膝部能因不同用途获得支援——下坡时的配置、侧向支撑的配置，以及另一种专为承受冲击的配置。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

This brace is no simple accomplishment—it does more than simply wrap a knee with ease. Its designer must have been more than a leather artist despite the gorgeous stamping and punchwork. Straps and buckles extend from the cap cover at unexpected angles, and the combined adjustments of the straps give the knee support for different uses—a downhill configuration, one for lateral support, and yet another for impact.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

这片荒原粗粝的壮美掩盖了它的凶险。尖塔般的石柱、孤立的台地与幽深的峡谷在视野中铺陈出令人惊叹的色彩涟漪：一层层赤红与橙色的色带，被细细的灰、黑，或淡得近乎发白的黄线骤然割断。然而这片恶地里几乎寸草不生——这意味着水将是无比珍贵之物。
The landscape’s rugged beauty belies its danger. The spires, buttes, and deep gorges ripple with an astonishing array of color: bands of reds and oranges interrupted by thin lines of gray, black, or a yellow so pale it almost looks white. But little grows in these badlands, which means water will be a precious thing.

Cleric's Speech Of Self-deprecation.name:
牧师的自嘲之辞
Cleric's Speech Of Self-deprecation

Text.text:
“当我灵魂的安宁被诱惑搅得翻涌，被抛进疑虑与失信的烈火里，那又该如何？当圣典喋喋不休，翻来覆去都是那些陈词滥调、磨损的箴言，我又该如何知道该怎么做？我太过凡俗……太过属于这个世界。”
“When the peace of my soul has been roiled by temptation, cast to the fires of doubt and lost faith, what then? When the holy books prattle on with the same clichés, the shopworn wisdom, how am I to know what to do? I am too mortal… too much of this world.”

茅草屋顶下的木骨架间以编枝抹泥填实，构成这座小谷仓的墙体。一段木板台阶沿着外墙攀上干草阁楼。底层敞开的门洞里透出幽暗的内景：几间马厩隔栏，其中一间更宽大，像是专供母马临盆之用。门楣上残留的锈迹与日晒的暗影暗示着——直到不久前，这里还钉着一只马蹄铁。
Wattle and daub fill the timber frame beneath the thatched roof of this small barn. A set of wood plank steps climb the outside of the building to a hayloft. The open doorway on the ground floor reveals a shadowy interior: a few stalls for horses with one larger stall for where a mare might give birth. A rust stain and a sun shadow on the lintel of the doorway hint that a horseshoe was nailed there until quite recently.

Vornsten's Hearth And Home Hostels In Wi.name:
沃恩斯滕的炉火与归家：冬日旅舍
Vornsten's Hearth And Home Hostels In Winter

Text.text:
三家旅舍里都嗡嗡作响，行动如潮。每一家都塞满了旅人，其中不少来自不同的队伍。他们饱经风霜的脸上泛着如释重负的红光，忙着脱下湿透的靴子，把孩子们排好送进温暖的床铺——厚重的被褥上织着矮人几何纹样，规整而沉稳。  

在柜台办公室门口，一名矮人女子正对一群披着长袍的旅人说话，他们脖颈间垂着圣徽，随着呼吸轻轻晃动。“很抱歉要把你们挡在门外，亲爱的，”矮人女子说道，“可这里实在挤得转不开身。我倒是可以告诉你们去试试古斯拉姆的……但你们山上的神殿并不收留朝圣者。”  

其中一名长袍人气得鼓起胸膛，疲惫的眼里却盈着泪光。这时，一个与那女子相貌相似的矮人男子迈到她身旁，缠着绷带的手紧绷地扣在那把朴素的修补匠小锤柄上。
The three hostels are thrumming with activity. Each of them is chock-full of travelers, some from different parties. Their weather-beaten faces seem flush with relief as they take off their wet boots and line up their children into the cozy beds, the heavy quilts designed in geometric dwarvish patterns. At the office door, a dwarven woman speaks to a group of robed travelers, holy symbols dangling from their necks. “I’m sorry to turn you away, my dears,” says the dwarven woman. “But we’re absolutely crammed, I fear. I can tell you to try Guthram’s… but your temple on the mountain doesn’t take in pilgrims.” As one of the robed figures puffs up in anger, his tired eyes brimming with tears, a male dwarf bearing a resemblance to the woman steps to her side, bandaged hand tense over the handle of his simple tinkerer’s hammer.

这道城门因常有农民在遭受攻击时，得从田野里狂奔穿过它逃回安全处而得名。关于昔日袭击的传说并非军队来犯，而是巨魔与其他尘世怪物，或是流窜的术士、死灵法师及其爪牙。每座塔楼里都悬着一口大钟，以防某座塔楼无人驻守，也为了向农庄发出最紧迫的警报。钟声已许多十年未曾响起。
This gate is named because often peasants had to run through it from the fields to safety during an attack. The legends of past attacks are not about armies, but about trolls and other earthly monsters, or about rogue sorcerers, necromancers, and their minions. In each tower hangs a large bell, in case one tower should be empty and the warning to the farms of great urgency. The bells have not rung in many decades.

你听见细小翅膀在四处扑棱作响，却误以为那只是栖居在这片森林生态里的蝴蝶或其他有翅昆虫。可你仍忍不住回想起林中行人的传闻——他们声称自己曾成为顽皮的妖精恶作剧者的受害者：对方为粗心者布下虚假的小径，或仅为取乐施下无害却恼人的小把戏。你向来觉得这种蠢故事荒诞得难以置信……直到你瞥见一只长着翅膀的微型妖精生物，体型不过两英尺，正蹲在树枝间，笑得停不下来。

~ Envisioned by dima0024

You hear the flutter of tiny wings hither and yon, but incorrectly attribute the sounds to butterflies or other winged insects living in this forest biome. Yet you find yourself wondering at the tales of passersby in this forest, claiming that they have been the victims of mischievous fey pranksters laying false paths for the unwary, or laying harmless but annoying enchantments for nothing more than their amusement. Such foolish stories are quite unbelievable to you . . . until you spy a tiny winged fey creature, no more than two feet in size, perched in the limbs of a tree, giggling uncontrollably.

~ Envisioned by dima0024

I Cast Heroes’ Feast.name:
我施放“英雄盛宴”
I Cast Heroes’ Feast

Text.text:
我面前那只华丽的钵盂在魔法汇聚、法术开始生效时，唱出一声高亢而闪耀的清音。随着我最后一次念完咒文，钵盂上镶嵌的宝石便开始嗡鸣，奏出动人和声。声浪层层堆叠，直至轰然高潮，钵盂在一道闪光中消失——而盛宴随之显现。
The lavish bowl before me sings a high, shimmering note as the magic builds and the spell begins to take hold. As I finish the incantation for the last time, the gems across the bowl begin to hum in beautiful harmony. It builds to a crescendo, and the bowl vanishes in a flash of light—and the feast appears.

Ancient Door With Staircase Beyond.name:
古老的门扉，门后延伸着阶梯
Ancient Door With Staircase Beyond

Text.text:
伴随着仿佛源自无生命的漫长世纪的沉闷呻吟，门缓缓滑开，尘埃从头顶古老的门楣簌簌飘落。阴影笼罩的走廊深处迎面涌来一股陈腐的空气——而一座螺旋楼梯还在继续向下，坠入更深的黑暗。你会继续前行吗？

~ 由 Discord 上的 Sahlonahl 构想

With a groaning born of inanimate centuries the door slides open, dust drifting down from the ancient lintel overhead. A rush of stale air greets you in the shadowy corridor beyond—and a spiral staircase descends further into darkness. Will you venture further?

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Family-owned Hardware Store.name:
家族经营的五金店
Family-owned Hardware Store

Text.text:
这家店不大，却被塞得满满当当：电动工具、建筑材料、螺母、螺栓，以及更多杂七杂八的物品。每样物品都在它该在的位置上，整整齐齐地摆放在一张手写标签下面。一个头顶渐秃的男人在后方柜台后喊道：“要是你需要帮忙找什么，尽管跟我说！这地方我闭着眼都摸得清，跟自己的手背一样熟。”
The store is small but filled to the brim with power tools, building materials, nuts, bolts, and more. Every item is in its proper place, carefully arranged beneath a handwritten label. "Just let me know if you need help finding anything!" a balding man calls out from behind a counter in the back. "I know this place like the back of my hand."

这名半兽人把夹着银丝的头发随意挽成一个凌乱的发髻。细金属丝边眼镜架在鼻尖上，怀里抱着一摞皮革封脊的厚书，他们在书架间穿梭翻找，将书籍、卷轴与法典一一归位，放回各自编目在册的位置。
The half-orc keeps their silver-streaked hair tied back in a messy bun. With wire-frame spectacles perched on the end of their nose, and an armload of leather-backed tomes, they search through the shelves, placing books, scrolls, and codices in their proper, catalogued places.

汗水滴进你的眼睛，你却仍继续吟诵，强压住伸手去擦的冲动。此刻哪怕一个瑕疵的手势，都会让你此前的精心努力付诸东流，更可能害你损失一份价值连城、足抵王侯赎金的稀有材料。你闻到一股气味——烧焦的毛发混着培根的油香——随即短暂失去知觉。你醒来时，仍在吟诵最后的词句，带着近乎贪恋的快意做出最后一个手势；你知道，尽管还需漫长时日等待，但这道法术已然完成。
Sweat drips into your eyes but you continue chanting, resisting the urge to wipe it away. A flawed gesture now will waste much careful effort and likely rob you of a rare component worth a king’s ransom. You smell a scent that is a mix of burnt hair and bacon, then briefly lose consciousness. You come to, still chanting the last words, and make the final gesture with relish, knowing that while many days must pass, the spell is complete.

Silvester The Astral Traveler.name:
西尔维斯特，星界旅人
Silvester The Astral Traveler

Text.text:
逼近的星界船只的船长尽管座舰明显受了损，仍在舵轮后摆出一副威严的姿态。此人外貌如猫，猫人顶着一头凌乱的锈红色头发，一只金色眼睛上横贯着一道伤疤。他咬紧下颌，沉稳而娴熟地操舵，意志坚定。闪耀的长袍在身后猎猎翻飞，衣摆掀起，露出他内里所穿的钢制护甲。

~ 由 Dung Beetle 扮演

The captain of the approaching astral vessel strikes a commanding pose behind the helm despite the apparent damage to his ship. Feline in appearance, the catfolk sports unkempt rust-colored hair and a scar across one golden eye. With a set jaw, he steers the ship expertly and with determination. His glittering robe flutters behind him and exposes the steel armor he wears underneath.

~ Played by Dung Beetle

Sword Dancer's Flourish.name:
剑舞者的华丽回旋
Sword Dancer's Flourish

Text.text:
舞者头戴缀珠头巾，腰系珠带，胸衣上密钉细小钱币与亮片，薄纱灯笼裤轻盈飘拂，脚踝的饰环垂着钱币，叮当作响如指钹。每一次绕圈提身、挺胸、抬胯，双弯刀都在光里一闪。随后——她旋身骤坠，钱币欢快作响——刀锋倏然弹出，直指她的敌人。

~ 构想：OscarMike

The dancer wears a beaded headscarf and belt, a brassiere studded with small coins and sequins, gauzy pantaloons, and anklets adorned with coins like finger cymbals. Two scimitars flash in the light with each circle lift, chest lift, and hip lift. Then—as she performs a twirling drop and the coins jingle cheerfully—the blades flick out at her enemy.

~ Envisioned by OscarMike

Axe Beak Encounter.name:
斧喙鸟遭遇
Axe Beak Encounter

Text.text:
这只鸟类生物豆粒般的红眼满是疑心，追随着你的一举一动——并加以审视。一对覆鳞的腿托着它披羽的身躯，而一块可怖的楔形骨质构成了那标志性的喙。它修长的脖颈深处滚出低沉的啭鸣，警告你退后。
The avian’s beady red eyes are full of suspicion, tracking your every movement—and judging. A pair of scaled legs carry the creature’s feathered body, and a formidable wedge of bone forms the titular beak. A low warble rumbles in the depths of its long neck, warning you to stay back.

Atlantean King's Skeleton On Throne.name:
王座上的亚特兰蒂斯国王骷髅（特征）
Atlantean King's Skeleton On Throne

Text.text:
亚特兰蒂斯护甲一眼就能认出：金色金属覆在被海风盐雾侵蚀的青绿色皮革之上。然而，尸身却辨不真切。一具骷髅端坐在砂岩王座上，披着那显眼的护甲，用森白的骨手支起一柄双手斧。
The Atlantean armor is easy to recognize: gold metal over sea-bitten green leather. The body, however, is not. A skeleton sits on the sandstone throne, wearing the telltale armor and propping up a two-handed axe with a bony hand.

Ancient Lava Tube Leading Into Planet’s.name:
通往行星内部的古老熔岩隧道
Ancient Lava Tube Leading Into Planet’s Interior

Text.text:
曾经在这条巨型管道中奔涌的岩浆，将岩壁磨得光滑而冰凉，宛如融化后凝固的蜡。巨大的洞穴隧道沿着陡峭的斜坡向下倾泻，张口如泰坦般的巨颚，仿佛要将你整个人一口吞没。
The magma that once flowed through this gigantic tube has left the rock smooth and cool like melted wax. The cavernous tunnel descends at a steep incline, yawning wide like a titanic maw intent on swallowing you whole.

当你念出那句祷词——你知道它能将你直接连上某位神祇的心智——一股难以遏制的焦虑便攀上心头。向神祇祈求垂怜、接受赐予是一回事；真正与其中一位开口交谈、并被其回应，又是另一回事。你一边祈祷，一边在心底反复演练要问的问题，生怕自己出丑，或让请求显得含糊不清。
You can’t help but feel anxious as you utter the prayer that you know connects you directly with a divine mind. It’s one thing to beseech the gods for their favor and receive their gifts, it’s quite another to speak with one and be spoken to. As you pray, you mentally rehearse your questions, not wanting to embarrass yourself or be unclear in your request.

I Spot Cheating During A Card Game.name:
我在牌局中撞见有人作弊
I Spot Cheating During A Card Game

Text.text:
桌面上，一只手多余地抽动了一下。眼神轻轻一移，几乎难以察觉，朝那位惊艳的同伴投去——她恰到好处地分散了全桌的注意力。同伴绕着桌子走动，从我身后经过。我看不见她向对面作弊者打出的暗号，只看见那些暗号被接收时的反应。
The extra twitch of a hand across the table. A shifting of the eyes, almost imperceptible, up to the stunning partner who distracts the table just enough. The partner walks around the table, behind me. I do not see the signals given to the cheater across the table, only the way they are received.

I Cast Animate Objects.name:
我施放【活化物件】
I Cast Animate Objects

Text.text:
我只有短短几秒，得在这距离上对几乎看不清的物体完成计算。雕像体型巨大，旁边的桌面上散落着无数细小的可能性。指尖急促抽动，我在空气中疾书向量与重量，随即敲定武器的数量与体型。我的目标现身。那些物体骤然苏醒，齐齐转向它们的标记，静候我的号令。
I only have a matter of seconds in which to do the math on objects I can barely see from this distance. The statue is large, the tables nearby are strewn with tiny possibilities. Within the rapid twitching of my fingers, scribing vectors and weights against the air, I decide on the number and size of my weapons. My target appears. The objects jump to life, turn to face their mark, and await my command.

死气沉沉的眼睛一眨不眨，从架子上人偶的视角凝视着黑暗；它的头歪向一侧，仿佛被一条看不见的绞索吊着。瓷白的皮肤——冷得像尸肉般惨白——被涂成一张细致的面具：胭脂与深红交叠，在那歪斜的微笑嘴角处，像新鲜血迹正慢慢洇开。你只把视线移开一瞬，窸窣声便攫住了你的注意。那人偶……一直有这么近吗？

~ 设想：Bale “Old Pops” Ridgeback

Lifeless eyes stare, unblinking, into the darkness from the doll’s vantage point on the shelf, its head lolling to one side as if hung by an invisible noose. Porcelain skin—cold and white as corpse-flesh—is painted in a delicate mask of rouge and crimson, giving the impression of fresh blood at the corners of a crooked, smiling mouth. You turn away for a second, but a rustling catches your attention. Was the doll always that close?

~ Envisioned by Bale "Old Pops" Ridgeback

I Draw A Spear From My Efficient Quiver.name:
我从高效箭袋中抽出一支长矛
I Draw A Spear From My Efficient Quiver

Text.text:
我一把攥住箭袋里长矛的矛柄，手腕一抖将它利落抽出，另一支随即顶上空位。武器向前一跃，迫不及待要投身战斗。
Grabbing the haft of the spear in my quiver, I pull it free with one swift motion as another rises to take its place. The weapon springs forward, eager to join the battle.

Intimidation By A Mage Of A Non-mage.name:
一名法师对非施法者的恐吓
Intimidation By A Mage Of A Non-mage

Text.text:
“我掌控着宇宙的能量，而你看起来只是挥舞着一块绑在木棍上的金属，所以也许打起来并不符合你的利益。”
“I wield the energies of the universe and you appear to be wielding a piece of metal tied to a stick, so perhaps fighting isn’t in your best interest.”

Faerie Plane: Waterfall.name:
妖精位面：瀑布
Faerie Plane: Waterfall

Text.text:
一缕魔法的微光在风中流转，宛如排箫上最轻柔的一声。瀑布最上层的水幕如帷幕般分开，露出一道由红褐色陶砖砌成的拱形门槛。你看不清其后，那入口被神秘的阴影彻底笼罩。蘑菇精灵们蹦跳的身影吱吱叫得更急切了——它们脸上的神情交织着兴奋、惊奇与戏谑。
A shimmer of magic plays on the wind, like the softest note on a pan flute. The topmost tier of the waterfall parts like a curtain to reveal an arched threshold of reddish clay brick. You cannot see beyond the mysterious shade totally shrouding the entryway. The jumping bodies of the mushroom-spirits squeak more fervently—the looks on their faces a mixture of excitement, wonder, and amusement.

Insult About Sins.name:
关于罪孽的侮辱
Insult About Sins

Text.text:
“真没想到你犯下那么多罪孽，背脊竟还没被压断。”
“I’m surprised your back hasn’t broken under the weight of all the sins you’ve committed.”

螳螂般的掠食前爪垂在身侧，宛如带锯齿的弯刀。它三角形的头颅呈春叶般的翠绿，以不自然的角度旋转着打量你；复眼之上，触角高高扬起，仿佛啜饮般将你的存在尽数纳入。即便它以昆虫般的腿佝偻着——弯曲如祈祷中合拢的双手——这螳螂仍有一棵树那么高。它猛然一跃，撕裂树冠；胸部两侧的鞘中弹出薄如轻纱的翅翼，振鸣如飓风般咆哮，生物随之扑向你。
The mantid’s raptorial claws hang like serrated scimitars. Its triangular head, the green of spring leaves, swivels at an unnatural angle to regard you, as antennae rising above its compound eyes drink in your presence. Even stooped on insectoid legs—bent like hands in prayer—the mantid is the height of a tree. With a leap that rips open the canopy, the creature launches itself; gossamer wings spring from sheaths along the thorax and buzz like a hurricane.

Drazhan Vantchev.name:
德拉赞·万切夫
Drazhan Vantchev

Text.text:
他像自己必定攀登并征服过的群山一般不可撼动，酋长的凝视冷冽而湛蓝，宛如冰川湖水。肌肤与雪冠融为一体，蓬乱的狼皮披挂其身，其间透出的钢灰色，与他那曾经乌黑、如今已见灰痕的鬃发如出一辙。仅凭存在感，他就显得比实际更魁伟：在本该只有精瘦、虬结肌肉的地方堆叠出负载般的厚重，为并不出众的身高添上魅影般的几寸虚高。

~ 扮演：Walt M.

Implacable as the mountains he has surely climbed and conquered, the chieftain’s stare is as cold and blue as a glacial lake. His skin blends with the snowcaps, and his shaggy wolf pelts are shot through with the same steel gray that streaks his once-black mane. His presence makes him seem bigger than he is, packing on bulk where there is only lean, corded muscle, adding phantom inches to his lacking height.

~ Played by Walt M.

I Meet A Legendary Villain.name:
我遇见了一位传奇反派
I Meet A Legendary Villain

Text.text:
“我不相信邪恶。邪恶不过是对复杂问题的廉价答案，是一种让我们与他人的残忍行径拉开距离、免于反思自身道德责任的借口。它没有实体，也没有形貌。可当我看着你犯下的那些暴行……我再也找不到别的解释。”
“I don’t believe in evil. Evil is just a simple answer to a complex question, a way to distance ourselves from the cruel acts of others and free us from reflecting on our own moral accountability. It has no substance and no form. Yet when I look upon the atrocities you have committed… I can find no other explanation.”

Emotionless Vor V Zakone Brigadier.name:
冷面“法中盗”准将
Emotionless Vor V Zakone Brigadier

Text.text:
那身影几乎只是一套护甲，浑身上下武装到牙齿，枪械与刀刃绑满全身，随时应对任何场合。唯一能说明它并非某种自动机的迹象，是那顶盔下的人头——可即便如此，这名准将的面孔也一片空白，冷峻如石，纹丝不动。
The figure is little more than a suit of armor, strapped to the teeth with guns and knives for every occasion. The only indication it's not some kind of automaton is a helmeted head, and even then, the brigadier's face is blank—stoic and unmoving.

High Seas Battle: Cannons And Bows.name:
公海之战：火炮与弓箭
High Seas Battle: Cannons And Bows

Text.text:
一支颤抖的箭仿佛从你脸旁的木头里生长出来，紧接着又有十几支箭在你周围坠落。你的敌人不只有火炮，还有弓箭手。你环顾四周寻找可以掩蔽的地方，但几乎没有什么能保护你免受从天而降的箭雨。
A quivering arrow seems to sprout from the wood near your face as a dozen more fall around you. Your foes have archers as well as cannons. You look for someplace to take cover, but there’s little to protect you from arrows falling out of the sky.

Alchemist's Gratitude For Blood Sample.name:
炼金术士对血样的谢意
Alchemist's Gratitude For Blood Sample

Text.text:
炼金术士凝视着眼前那团猩红的混合液，稍作停顿，向那位为他的研究献出鲜血的勇者默然致谢。
The alchemist studies the sanguine mixture before him, taking a moment to give thanks for the brave soul who donated their blood for his research.

Harpy Jasmine.name:
鹰身女妖·茉莉
Harpy Jasmine

Text.text:
一丛巨大的灌木在星界的微风中摇曳，仿佛踏着无声的韵律起舞。粉与橙的獠牙花朵微微闪烁，从灌木般的核心中探出。你注视之际，跃动的光点落在这生物周遭，折射成异界动植物的影像。这些影像逸散出幽灵般的声响，却总有哪里不对……像是卡顿失真的影像播报。
A large shrub sways in the astral breeze, as if to a silent rhythm. Fanged flowers of pink and orange, shimmering faintly, protrude from the bush-like core. As you watch, dancing lights settle about the creature, refracting into images of alien flora and fauna. Ghostly sounds emit from these images, although they don’t seem quite right… like a glitching vidcast.

Entering Through A Malfunctioning Airloc.name:
通过故障的气闸进入
Entering Through A Malfunctioning Airlock

Text.text:
你踏入故障的气闸舱后，身后的外部舱门伴随着一阵颤抖般的卡顿滑合。狭小的舱室里回荡着令人不安的、忽快忽慢的嘶嘶声，舱内系统正试图平衡气压并排出污染物——但其成功程度无人知晓。
The external doors slide shut with a juddering motion behind you after you step into the malfunctioning airlock. A concerningly erratic hiss fills the small chamber as the cabin attempts to equalize the pressure and expunge contaminants—with an unknown level of success.

I Cast Awaken On A Plant.name:
我对一株植物施放“觉醒术”
I Cast Awaken On A Plant

Text.text: 我追随魔法的脉络，而非妄想能将它们凭空绘出。它们属于花的纪元，是跨越岁月的藤蔓，向着时光彼端伸出触及。玛瑙在我掌中崩解，被奔涌于我体内的魔法夺走——以植物的言语，以大地的语言，我将咒文吟入花瓣与叶片，茎与根须。就在施法末尾的最后几个字里，有那么一瞬，植物回望我的眼睛，忽然知晓。 I follow the pathways of magic rather than imagine I can draw them. They are part of the floral epoch, vines that reach across the ages. The agate disintegrates in my hand, taken by the magic coursing through me in plantspeak, in earth language I chant into petal and leaf, stem and root. There is a moment in the last words of my casting when the plant looks back into my eyes and suddenly knows.

这里的空气贴在皮肤上，灼热而潮湿，混杂着陌生而诡异的香气。奥术火炬投下摇曳不定的光，在突兀嶙峋的石柱间游移；而在这座球形洞窟的中心，一簇巨大、椭长的卵静静休息在成堆的枯草与被啃噬的骸骨之间。数个类人生物围着卵忙碌，它们的皮肤泛着虹彩，覆着鳞片，小心地翻转、挪动这些卵——甚至跪下，轻抚它们，低声呢喃。

~ 构想 by Spac3cowboyy

The air here settles on your skin, hot and humid, fragrant with strange and unknown smells. Arcane torches shed wavering light across the jutting stone formations, and at the center of the spherical cavern, a cluster of large, oblong eggs rest amid heaps of dried grass and gnawed bones. Several humanoid figures, their skin iridescent and scaled, tend to the eggs, rotating and shifting them—even kneeling to caress and speak to them.

~ Envisioned by Spac3cowboyy

Billiard Room Of A Manor.name:
庄园台球室
Billiard Room Of A Manor

Text.text:
你在这座庄园里已见过不少奢华的迹象，但这间屋子却被一张台球桌彻底占据——这种物件罕见到几乎只有异国王族的宫廷里才见得到。象牙般的灰白球静卧在猩红的台呢上，仿佛随时会被架在房间一侧的球杆架上那些抛光木杆击出，沿着桌面轰然撞散。对面的墙边摆着一张餐边柜，水晶醒酒瓶里盛着上等白兰地，旁边几只水晶杯倒扣着，折出冷冽的光。
You have seen some signs of great luxury in this manor house, but this room is dominated by a billiards table—rarely found outside the palaces of foreign royalty. Off-white ivory balls sit atop a crimson felt, ready to be cannoned around the table’s surface with the polished wooden sticks sitting in a rack to one side of the room. Along the opposite wall, a sideboard contains fine brandy in a crystal decanter and several crystal tumblers sitting upside down.

Divine Cemetery Of A God Of Necromancy.name:
死灵术神祇的神圣墓园
Divine Cemetery Of A God Of Necromancy

Text.text:
有些树开花，有些却光秃枯立，如石化般僵硬。有些陵寝以鲜花与肃穆的敬刻铭记逝者；另一些则歪斜下沉，坠入腐朽的壤土之中。神不住在墓园里。他住在入口门楼的两座塔中——有时在象征生的右塔，有时在象征死的左塔。无论从哪扇窗，他都读着悼词，目光穿过石块向下凝望，向每一具骷髅（特征）点头——它们双手交叠，覆在那曾经囚着一颗跳动之心的胸笼之上。
Some trees bloom and some stand leafless and petrified. Some mausoleums honor with flowers and somber carvings of respect, while others sink crooked into the loam of decomposition. The god does not live in the cemetery. He lives in the two towers of the entrance gate—sometimes in the dexter tower of life, sometimes in the sinister tower of death. From either window he reads the memorials, gazes down through the stones, nods to each skeleton with its hands folded over the cage in which there once was a beating heart.

彩虹般的烟雾从这间迷人小屋歪斜的烟囱里轻柔升起，色泽每隔片刻便悄然变换。一个朴素的菜园被篱笆圈起，立着一块牌子，上书 不要喂萝卜！——这警告颇有先见之明，毕竟它们天性凶残。你沿着蜿蜒的鹅卵石小径走向那扇箍铁的橡木门时，菜蔬对你低吼，叶片窸窣作响；门框上刻满令人目眩的奥术符印，繁复得近乎眩晕。黄铜门环朝你咧嘴一笑，笑容是一张狞笑的恶魔面孔——紧接着，它开口说话了。 Prismatic smoke rises gently from the crooked chimney of this charming cottage, its hue shifting every few moments. A modest vegetable garden has been fenced off with a sign reading Do not feed the radishes! A prescient warning, given their predatory nature. The vegetables growl at you, rustling their leaves as you walk up the winding cobblestone path to the banded oak door, its frame inscribed with arcane sigils of dizzying complexity. The brass knocker grins at you with the face of a leering demon—and then it speaks.

Charity’s Grave In Winter.name:
冬日里的慈善之墓
Charity’s Grave In Winter

Text.text: 你拂去石棺上的积雪，露出其上铭文：此为德里昂的侍从慈善之墓。纵然此墓空空如也，那些爱过她的人心中仍满溢着自豪。 You brush snow from the sarcophagus that states: This is the grave of Charity, Derion’s footman. Though this grave lies empty, pride fills the hearts of those who loved her.

Village Council Chambers.name:
村议会厅
Village Council Chambers

Text.text:
村子近中心处矗立着一栋建筑，模样像是被放大了的谷仓。宽大的畜栏门敞开着，露出骨架结构——识货的人一眼就能看出那是旧式手工立架的工法；屋顶还开了两扇舱口式天窗，只需用长杆一顶，便能轻松开合。素净却被细细打磨的木地板虽已被仔细清扫，空气里仍隐约飘着一丝干草的气味。几段截下的圆木被摆成座位，上面铺着朴素却舒服的坐垫——大约四分之一被锯得更矮些，想来是给半身人或其他身形矮小的村民用的。这里没有阶段，但尽头立着一只讲台，一把朴木小槌静静搁在其上。讲台周围又添了几张给乡绅的座位，半圆形排开，使得不同的会议几乎不必怎么挪动就能迅速布置妥当。
Near the center of a village stands a building that resembles an oversized barn. The large stock doors stand open, revealing framing that an educated eye would recognize as hand-raised in the old style and two hatch-style skylights cut into the roof that are easily opened or shut with the aid of long poles. Despite the care with which the plain but meticulously sanded wooden floor has been swept, a faint scent of hay is still detectable. Cut sections of logs topped with simple but comfortable cushions have been arranged as seats—about one-quarter have been cut shorter, presumably for halflings or other diminutive villagers. There is no stage, but a lectern stands at one end, a plain wooden gavel resting on top. Several more seats for the selectmen have been placed in a semicircle around the lectern, allowing for different meetings with a minimum of rearranging.

Speech By A Regretful Adventurer.name:
一名悔恨冒险者的演说
Speech By A Regretful Adventurer

Text.text:
“我在一座恬静的小镇长大，小镇依着一条清澈见底的河。那儿的人从不操心自家院落与街坊之外的世界。他们日复一日地劳作，直到老得干不动了，便在尘土飞扬的街道上踱来踱去，直至死去。那是一种我无法忍受的简单生活。我自认比那地方更出众，理应享尽世间所有的欢愉与传奇。于是我拾起长剑踏上旅途，也确实得到了属于我的那一份：财富、歌谣、情人。可随着年岁渐长，我却常常出神，梦回那座小镇与那些朴素友善的人。最终我回去了，可剩下的只有焦黑的木板与腐烂的尸体。世界终究找到了我的家。或许若我当初留下，一切会不一样。”
“I grew up in a quaint town set up on the banks of a crystal-clear river. The people there didn’t concern themselves with the world beyond their homesteads and neighbors. They toiled away until they were too old to work, then puttered about the dusty streets until their deaths. It was a simple life that I could not bear. I was better than that place, deserving of all the pleasures and stories the world had to offer. So, I picked up a sword and set out, and I got my piece: riches, ballads, lovers. But as I grew older, I found myself daydreaming of that quaint little town and its simple, friendly people. I eventually returned, but all that remained were charred planks and rotting bodies. The world had found my home. Perhaps if I had stayed, it would have been different.”

A Ploy By A Corrupt Official.name:
腐败官员的阴谋
A Ploy By A Corrupt Official

Text.text:
“我真想帮你们那场小小的宝藏寻觅，真的想。神祇作证，这把老骨头的脑壳里还咣当着一堆要紧的细节，可我就是怎么也抓不住。眼下我正面临选举，为了我那座小村庄的困境，我压得喘不过气，愣是蠢得像头骡子。但你们知道吗？我打赌，你们这群膀大腰圆的精明干练之人，准能替我卸下几分压力。说不定到那时，我的脑子就能更灵光些。”
“I’d love to assist in your little treasure hunt, really, I would. By the gods, there are all sorts of pertinent details rattling around in this old skull of mine, but I just can’t seem to grasp them. I’m facing an election and the enormous stress I feel for the plight of my little hamlet has rendered me dumb as a mule. But you know what? I bet a group of strapping entrepreneurs like yourself could get rid of a few of those stresses. Maybe then my mind will be a bit sharper.”

Sundries From A Gremlin's Home.name:
来自小魔怪（特征）家中的杂物
Sundries From A Gremlin's Home

Text.text:
三英尺长的绳段整整齐齐排成一小列，大多被打成各式各样古怪的结。旁边的地上堆着几只大木箱，里面装满城堡大门用的锁具机构与铰链。生锈的金属上被刻出一个个小小的笑脸，笑意阴森，带着几分邪气。
Three-foot lengths of rope, most tied in various and strange knots, are lined in a neat little row. On the floor nearby are large crates containing lock mechanisms and hinges for castle doors. Tiny smiley faces, wicked looking, are scratched into the rusting metal.

Arrival To The Elemental Plane Of Fire.name:
抵达火元素位面
Arrival To The Elemental Plane Of Fire

Text.text:
这片燃烧冒烟的位面在各处随机窜起烈焰，仿佛一连串失控的暴怒。熔融的池沼咕嘟翻涌又复归平静，沸腾又渐渐冷却，如同凤凰卧巢，死生轮回。灼热永恒地以威胁之姿裹住你，却并不将你吞噬。
This burning, smoking plane flares up in random locations, a chaos of tantrums. A molten pool bubbles and calms, boils and cools, like a phoenix in its nest. Heat, eternally threatening, envelops but does not consume you.

I Recognize The Signs Of Goblin Activity.name:
我认出了哥布林行动的迹象
I Recognize The Signs Of Goblin Activity

Text.text: 哦，这烂摊子。内脏新鲜得出奇——我几乎能听见那尖细的咯咯笑声、下流的咒骂，以及歪斜武器相互磕碰的刺响。三只翻倒的木桶正渗出淡绿色劣酒的残液。某个可怜生物的肠子被拖拽着铺满地面，仿佛是被当作某种骇人的游戏道具，四处抛掷过。 Oh, the mess. The offal is so fresh—I can almost hear the high-pitched giggling, the raunchy curses, and the clash of crooked weapons. A trio of overturned casks leak the remnants of a pale green grog. Entrails of some poor creature are stretched across the ground, perhaps thrown about as part of some gruesome game.

Mind Flayer In A Thieves' Guild Hideout.name:
盗贼公会藏身处里的夺心魔
Mind Flayer In A Thieves' Guild Hideout

Text.text:
与守卫的厮杀让你付出了代价，但你仍咬牙前行，毫不退缩。你沿着走廊谨慎推进，武器在手，一股诡异的感觉忽然笼罩全身。起初几乎难以察觉，可当你深入这处藏身地时，颅内的压迫感愈发沉重。眼后骤然绽开的尖锐头痛随之而来，紧接着，是仿佛有手指沿着你思维的沟壑缓缓描摹的触感。那股存在必定来自下一扇门之后。你就是知道……于是踉跄着闯了过去，急切地想让脑中的不适停下，却只看见一具化作实体的恐怖：类人形，皮肤湿滑，呈淤青般的色泽；本该是嘴的位置，却是一簇蠕动翻卷的触须。那生物的目光落在你身上时，你头中的痛楚攀至顶点，几乎令你失明。

~ 由 Ramon 为 Envisioned 构想

The fight with the guards took its toll, but you press on, undeterred. As you move cautiously down the corridor, weapons drawn, a strange sensation overtakes you. It's nearly imperceptible at first, but as you move deeper into the hideout, the pressure inside your skull grows. A headache, sudden and sharp, blossoms behind your eyes, followed by the feeling of fingers tracing the crevices of your mind. The presence must emanate from beyond the next door. You just know... and stagger through, eager to cease the disquieting sensations in your head, only to find yourself facing down a horror made flesh: humanoid, with slick skin the color of a bruise, and in place of a mouth, a cluster of writhing tentacles. As the creature's gaze falls upon you, the pain in your head reaches a zenith, nearly blinding you.

~ Envisioned by Ramon

Statuesque Enforcer.name:
雕塑般的执法者
Statuesque Enforcer

Text.text:
男人雕像般的躯体上布满参差丑陋的疤痕——脸与肩头都被深深剜开。那双如花岗岩卵石般细小的灰眼带着轻蔑打量着你，他上下扫视一遍，脸随即扭成厌恶的冷笑。
Ragged, ugly scars mar the man’s statuesque physique—deep gouges across both face and shoulder. Small, gray eyes, like granite pebbles, regard you with contempt, and his face twists into a disgusted sneer as he looks you up and down.

Pangs Of Vampire Thirst.name:
吸血鬼渴血之痛
Pangs Of Vampire Thirst

Text.text:
你的胃发出一阵咕噜声，随之袭来的绞痛前所未有。饥饿像一片巨大的虚空，将你吞没。与此同时，一种感觉攀上来，仿佛灰烬灌满口腔，干渴灼烧着喉咙。在这些吞噬般的感官之中，一股渴望抬头。它为你迫切想要终结这份馋欲的绝望需求，献上唯一的答案：鲜血。
Your stomach growls, bringing with it a pang like none you’ve yet experienced. The hunger is a vast void. With it comes a sensation, as if ash fills your mouth and thirst scorches your throat. A desire rises through these consuming sensations. It offers one answer to your desperate need for an end to this craving: Blood.

这里的目录全息影像里陈列着一排排义体，人工痕迹毫不遮掩。金属与玻璃纤维面板构成肢体的骨架，柔韧的部分则由塑料或金属纤维编织而成。有些组件的线缆与管路干脆裸露，穿过内部或贴着表面蜿蜒而行。光纤与微型LED让少数部位幽幽发亮——有时只是为了好看，但更多时候是廉价工艺不得已的妥协。

~ 一位英雄构想

Obvious artificial parts form the cyberware shelved and shown in the catalog holograms here. Metal and fiberglass panels comprise limb frames, while fibers of plastic or metal make up flexing parts. Wires and tubing run unhidden through or on the surface of some elements. Optical fibers and micro-LEDs cause a few bits to glow, sometimes as an aesthetic choice but otherwise part of cheaper engineering.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Port Town: Shipyards.name:
港口城：造船厂
Port Town: Shipyards

Text.text:
沿着水边排列的宽阔石造建筑皆覆以高耸屋顶，屋内形成幽深如洞窟的阴影空间：大船停在斜坡滑道上，小艇则由粗壮缆索悬吊半空。造船匠们敲击、锯切、涂漆、忙个不停，工作区也因此得以避开最恶劣的天气。
The broad stone structures that line the water’s edge have high roofs, creating cavernous, shaded spaces within which ships sit atop ramps, while smaller boats hang suspended from thick cables. The shipbuilders hammer, saw, paint, and more, their work protected from the worst of the weather.

Vial Of Torpor.name:
迟滞小瓶
Vial Of Torpor

Text.text: [察觉] 这是一只短矮粗胖的玻璃小瓶，里面装着看起来像深色、浓稠啤酒的液体。瓶塞是一截结实厚硬的软木，死死楔在瓶口。 [分析] 你对这种毒药的了解，让你只要听到有人对某种烈酒或补剂说“务必一滴不剩地喝完”，就会立刻起疑。饮下者的面孔会逐渐肿厚，凝成呆滞的痴望；双手蜷缩收紧，双脚僵冷失去平衡，最后猛然坍倒，像被捻皱的虫子般抽缩成一团，彻底失去行动能力。 [Perceived] This is a short, squat glass vial of what looks like dark, heavy beer. The stopper is a stout cut of cork wedged in tight. [Analyzed] What you know of this poison makes you suspicious any time someone says “Be sure to drink all of it” about a liquor or tonic. The drinker’s face will thicken into a dumb stare, hands contracting, feet freezing against balance, then collapsing like an insect crumpled into incapacitation.

Wilhelm Von Lightless.name:
威廉·冯·无光
Wilhelm Von Lightless

Text.text:
尽管这男人只度过了寥寥几个寒冬，头发却白得如瓷般冷亮，钴蓝的眼眸深处久久盘踞着一抹沉沉的哀意。他黝黑的手指紧扣着一柄华丽战锤的长柄，携着那把可怖的武器仿佛轻若无物。圣徽烙印在他的盾上，清晰地映在那面如镜的壁垒之上，向敌人直白宣告：我的神与我同在。你也能这么说吗？

~ 由 Thundyrcat 在 Played 扮演，角色卡见

Though the man has weathered few winters, his hair is as white as porcelain, and a deep sadness lingers in his cobalt eyes. His dark fingers grip the haft of a magnificent warhammer, carrying the formidable weapon as if it weighed nothing. A holy symbol marks his shield, printed upon the mirrored surface of the bulwark as a clear message to his foes: My god is with me. Can you say the same?

~ Played by Thundyrcat with

Guardian Of Nature.name:
自然守护者
Guardian Of Nature

Text.text:
空气因树木般的灵能而噼啪作响，你汲取着自然狂野的伟力。翠绿的能流藤蔓在你周身翻卷缠绕，绽放成一场令人屏息的蜕变。随着这副新形态成型，一股原初的威势随之弥散：一名原始的哨卫被召唤而出，用以抵御步步逼近的危险。
The air crackles with arboreal energy as you siphon the wild powers of nature. Vines of emerald effluence writhe about you, blooming into a breathtaking transformation. A sense of primordial might emanates from this new form as it comes into being: a primal sentinel conjured to defend against the encroaching danger.

这名男子背后伸展着宽阔的猩红羽翼，勾勒出近乎天使般的剪影。他体格健壮，五官端正；黑发如波浪般垂落，环绕着他光洁的面庞。他身着考究衣装，胸口束得紧实，腿部却宽松飘垂，然而整体气质冷峻逼人。红色的眼睛带着审判般的挑剔，唇线与穿孔的眉梢一并向下压出不悦。他双手始终扣在腰间匕首的握柄上。一个长着蜻蜓翅膀的小人绕着他飞掠盘旋，神情与他同样不以为然。

~ Played by Nathan

The broad, scarlet-feathered wings extending from this man’s back give him an angelic silhouette. He has a strong build and well-formed features, with dark hair that hangs in waves around his smooth face. His fine clothing is tight at the chest and loose around the legs, but his look is severe. His red eyes are judgmental, his lips and pierced eyebrows angled down. He keeps his hands on the grips of daggers at his waist. A little person with dragonfly wings flits about him with a look as disapproving as his.

~ Played by Nathan

Surge Of Bubbling Magma.name:
翻涌的气泡熔浆
Surge Of Bubbling Magma

Text.text:
一阵持续不断的低沉轰鸣环绕着你，熔融岩石如溪流般奔涌，沿着火山那已硬化的表层刻出蜿蜒的通道。偶尔它艰难地挤过那些早已冷却的岩块，猛地鼓起一团巨大的岩浆气泡，随即炸裂迸响，声音仿佛有人从一只巨大的麦酒桶里狠狠拔出了木塞。
A constant low roar surrounds you as the molten rock flows in streams and carves its way through the hardened surface of the volcano. Every now and then as it struggles to clear a path through pieces of rock that have already cooled, a large bubble of magma bursts and pops with a sound like an enormous cork being yanked out of an ale barrel.

Stone Age Valley.name:
石器年代山谷
Stone Age Valley

Text.text:
浓雾在覆满葱郁密林的起伏丘陵间汇聚成潭。旭日刚越过地平线，谷底仍被雾纱笼罩，阳光渐渐灼穿那层遮蔽的云霭。鸟鸣合唱骤然爆发，旋即与自然和声交织，山谷的居民苏醒，开始新的一天，置身于那原始、未被触碰的乐土之中。
A thick mist pools between sloping hills covered in dense, verdant forests. The floor of the valley lies shrouded in fog as the sun crests the horizon and begins to burn away the obfuscating cloud. A chorus of birdsong erupts, soon joined by the harmonious music of nature as the inhabitants of the valley wake and begin another day in their primal, untouched paradise.

Primal Casting Of Light.name:
原初之光的施放
Primal Casting Of Light

Text.text:
你手握一块石头，从四周的草木间唤来一只萤火虫，对它低声呢喃。它点亮腹部，绕着石头悬停片刻。石头随即脉动起柔和的黄绿色微光，很快愈发明亮并恒定下来，仿佛成群萤火在同辉。那只乐于助人的小虫无声振翼，悄然飘远。
Holding a rock in hand, you call a firefly out of the surrounding flora, whispering to it. It lights its belly, hovering around the stone for a moment. The rock pulses with soft, yellow-green light, and soon becomes brighter and constant, like that of scores of fireflies. The helpful insect drifts away on silent wings.

Goblin Shaman With Staff.name:
持杖的地精萨满
Goblin Shaman With Staff

Text.text:
地精萨满周身散发着一股超自然的灵光——一团恶意的邪能烟霾，连空气都被玷污。他们破烂、污渍斑斑的长袍仿佛吞噬着周围的光，而他们紧攥的法杖却吐出不祥的幽辉。随着他们逼近，四周的氛围沉重得几近凝固，充满阴毒的意图，仿佛连这世界本身都在畏缩，躲避他们所操使的黑暗妖术。
The goblin shaman radiates a preternatural aura, a smog of malevolent dweomer that sullies the very air. Their tattered, stained robes seem to absorb the light around them, but the staff they clutch emits a baleful aura. In their presence, the ambience thickens with a sinister intent, as though the world itself recoils from the dark devilry they wield.

狂怒的海洋仿佛执意要毁灭一切，连头顶的天空也被它撕咬着。浪涌如山，峭壁般的浪谷裂开——船只便沿着其中一道深坠而下。艏斜桅像长矛般刺入浪壁，咸涩海水轰然拍下，将水手与道具一并吞没。紧接着，它又如追逐湮灭之星的火箭般猛然昂起，那颗星隐在死黑的云幕后方。

~ 一位英雄 Envisioned

The angry ocean seems intent upon destruction, attacking the very sky above it. Swells like mountains, with steep-sided valleys—down one of which the ship falls. The bowsprit drives like a spear into the wave, salt water crashing over sailor and gear alike. Then it pitches upward like a rocket seeking the star of oblivion that hides behind death-black clouds.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Potion Of Joint Fortitude.name:
协同坚韧药剂
Potion Of Joint Fortitude

Text.text:
这只小瓶上的标签磨损斑驳、边缘翘起，画着一名风格化的人影蜷身忍痛，关节处闪烁着一圈圈猩红光晕。你轻轻转动瓶身，标签竟随之变形：那人影挺直站起，猩红褪去，化作鲜亮而安抚的蔚蓝。瓶中起泡的粉色液体看着并不讨喜，但或许能在一段时间里缓解你的酸痛与折磨。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The worn, peeling label on this small bottle depicts a stylized figure hunched over in pain, a crimson hue flashing around their joints. As you shift the bottle, the label morphs. Now the figure stands upright, the crimson replaced by a vibrant, soothing blue. The effervescent pink liquid within doesn’t look appealing, but it may ease your aches and pains for a while.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

这副甲板机宛如一块黑色石碑。加固外壳上垂着一条改装过的背带，红色视网膜锁严禁启动；一旦验证通过，甲板机便啪地展开，两块流线型键盘弹出，人体工学卡扣让它能牢牢扣在附近任何表面上。幽暗机壳压印着反光的蓝色纹路；而背面，一块巨型电池被泵循环的冷却液压着降温，流体翻涌，像一枚庞大冰裂的碎片。无数电线被嫁接般贯穿整台甲板机。键盘两侧，细小的金属结节里藏着颅线，供使用者插入自己的头插口。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

This deck is shaped like a black stone tablet. A tricked-out strap hangs loose from its reinforced case, with red retina locks prohibiting activation; once verified, the deck swings open two sleek keyboards with ergonomic latches enabling attachment to any nearby surface. The dark housing is embossed with reflective blue and, on the reverse, a huge battery is cooled with a pump pushing through fluid like a colossal shard of ice. A bevy of wires are grafted throughout the deck. On either side of the keyboards, small metal nodules house cranium wires for the user to plug into their headjack.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这项游戏使用一颗软木与毛毡制成的球，以及细长的木质球拍，在室内球场上进行；两面墙沿线排着观众看台，像战壕般凹入墙体。四名穿着随意、宽松的羊毛白衣或灰衣的选手隔网对击，把球打向彼此，任其在墙面或看台顶棚上弹跳反射。计分规则繁复，像是专为贵族准备的算术。某个社交俱乐部的成员们半醉上场，落后时偶尔会把凶狠的抽击当作武器，专挑彼此为目标。
The game is played with a ball of cork and felt, and skinny wooden rackets, on an indoor court; spectator galleries like dugouts line two walls. Four players dressed in casual, loose wool whites or grays hit the ball over the net at one another, bouncing it off walls or the roofs of the galleries. The scoring is complicated, an arithmetic for aristocrats. Members of a social club, half drunk, sometimes target one another with vicious strikes when they fall behind.

Tournament In Rain.name:
雨中锦标赛
Tournament In Rain

Text.text:
天空逐渐阴沉。忽然，大雨猛击着看台上方撑起的篷布。坐在篷下的人们只是短暂抬头一瞥，却更热衷于下方的景象。两名手持长柄武器的骑士围绕着一头巨大的食人魔游走，不断刺击那头被铁链束缚、挥舞着流血双臂的野兽。天穹倾泻而下时，这头庞然生物将目光投向天空。代价立刻显现——两名骑士同时突进，长戟深深贯入怪物的身躯。
The sky grows dark. Suddenly, rain begins to batter the canopy stretched over the stand. Those seated beneath it glance up briefly but are far more interested in the spectacle below. Two polearm-wielding knights circle an enormous ogre, jabbing at the chained beast that flails with bleeding arms. As the heavens open, the massive creature swings its gaze skyward. This proves costly, as both knights lunge forward, thrusting their halberds deep into the monster’s body.

剥去血肉后，这名士兵只剩白骨与残酷的目的。仿佛这名兵卒的五脏六腑都被抽空了——不只是皮肉，连灵魂也一并被吸走。然而，在它冰冷眼眶里那抹狡黠的幽光之外……似乎还藏着一丝柔软的哀伤？一声低沉的呻吟把你拉回这生物的现实：它握着一柄宽刃决斗剑，配着一把流线型半自动手枪。它高大而压迫，身披如传统士兵般的甲胄。它骷髅般的右手上，套着一串厚重的戒环。
Stripped of flesh, this soldier is nothing but bone and brutal purpose. It is as though the very innards of the trooper have been sucked out—not merely the flesh but the soul too. Yet beyond the cunning light in its cold eye sockets… a soft sadness, perhaps? A low moan brings you back to the realities of the creature and its broad dueling sword and sleek semi-auto pistol. Tall and imposing, it is armored like a traditional soldier. A set of chunky rings sit on its skeletal right hand.

Welcome From The Blacksmith.name:
铁匠铺的欢迎词
Welcome From The Blacksmith

Text.text:
“欢迎。每次我打造一把武器，我都会想象它将如何剖开肌肉、撕裂肢体、唤起成加仑喷涌的鲜血——而这……这让我为自己是个仍在劳作的艺术家而自豪。”
“Welcome. Each time I craft a weapon, I imagine how it will carve through muscle, rend limbs, call forth gallons of gushing blood, and it just… it makes me proud to be a working artist.”

Elven Noble Betrayed By Lover.name:
被恋人背叛的精灵贵族
Elven Noble Betrayed By Lover

Text.text:
精致的五官因正义的愤怒而泛起猩红——背叛之火在其中助燃——灼热的泪珠自她低垂的眼中坠落。精灵的双拳紧攥，指节痛得发白，指甲如匕首般深深刺入掌心柔软的血肉。情绪在她体内翻涌，宛如被囚的巨龙；怒火与令人作呕的醒悟相互厮杀，而她曾经熟悉的世界正在周遭崩塌……取而代之的，是孤立无援的冰冷漠然。

~ 由Ameria在Discord上构想

Delicate features flush crimson with righteous indignation—fueled by the fires of betrayal—as burning tears fall from downcast eyes. The elf’s fists bunch tightly, knuckles whitening painfully as nails dig into the soft flesh of her palms like daggers. Emotions roil within her like captured dragons, the rage dueling with the nauseating realization as the world she once knew crumbles around her… replaced by the cold indifference of isolation.

~ Envisioned by Ameria on Discord

Tomb Of Sand.name:
沙之陵墓
Tomb Of Sand

Text.text:
华美的陵寝与其修长的平台两侧，排列着一处处壁龛，用以为亡者整备行装，踏上通往冥界的旅途。漫长的行列通道——亦即 dromos——尽头通向一座小小的码头，幽暗的地下水在砌石墙脚轻轻拍击。
The beautiful mausoleum and its long platform are bordered by niches for preparing the dead for their journey into the underworld. The long processional, or dromos, leads to a small port where dark subterranean waters lap against its block wall.

Asteroid Defense System.name:
小行星防御系统
Asteroid Defense System

Text.text:
轨道设施悬挂在热层之中，配备一整套尖端武器系统；每一处节点都足以抵御多次小行星入侵。无论是密集的激光炮阵，还是核弹发射装置，这些系统彼此协同运作，守护星球免遭毁灭性的撞击。从地表望去，它们如同一列闪耀的钻石，致命而美丽，将锋芒献给守护星球的未来。
Orbital installations hang in the thermosphere, boasting an array of cutting-edge weaponry, each node capable of defending against multiple asteroid incursions. Including both dense laser batteries and nuke installations, these systems work symbiotically, safeguarding the planet from catastrophic impact. From the ground they appear like an array of sparkling diamonds, deadly beauty dedicated to protecting the planet’s future.

Ring Of Jumping.name:
跳跃戒指
Ring Of Jumping

Text.text:
这枚纤薄的玫瑰金戒指顶端并非镶着宝石，而是在戒圈上弯出一道小小的弧线，宛如地平线上初升的太阳。它有种令人毛骨悚然的倾向：若不牢牢戴在手指上，就会从你手中滑脱。一旦掉落，它便会轻快地弹跳不止，直到被人一把抓住。
Rather than a precious stone at its head, this thin rose-gold ring has a bend in its band, a small arc like a horizon sun. The small accessory has the uncanny propensity to fall out of your hands if not secured upon a finger. If it does, it bounces buoyantly until snatched.

I Use Empowered Evocation.name:
我施展【强化塑能】
I Use Empowered Evocation

Text.text:
我凝神专注，将魔法的丝线一缕缕牵拢，在我所感知到的弱点处细细裁剪效果。这道法术是一份锋锐的赋礼。我短暂窥探了敌人的脆弱之处，便能让每一次伤害都更深一分。
I concentrate as I pull the threads of magic together, tailoring the effect to the weaknesses I sense. This spell is a pointed gift. My brief study of my foe’s frailties allows me to hurt them just a little more.

Armored Ghoulish Warrior With Sword.name:
持剑的披甲食尸鬼战士
Armored Ghoulish Warrior With Sword

Text.text:
一个令人不安的披甲身影从前方门口涌出的病态幽光中浮现。它迈步逼近，凶相毕露。它的皮肤呈惨白的青绿色，紧贴在筋骨嶙峋的四肢上，每一块肌肉都绷紧得像要爆裂，满溢着暴烈的杀意。它利爪般的握持中，一柄不祥的刀刃摇摆晃动，随时准备斩落头颅、劈开血肉。
A disturbing armored figure emerges from the sickly glow emanating from the doorway ahead. It strides forward menacingly. Its skin, a pallid green, clings to its sinewy limbs, every muscle taut with violent intent. In its clawlike grip, an ill-favored blade swings, ready to lop heads and cleave flesh.

Sewer: Ankle Deep In Effluent.name:
下水道：污秽没踝
Sewer: Ankle Deep In Effluent

Text.text:
渗进你鞋里的液体冰冷刺骨，与拂过你面颊的空气形成鲜明对比——那空气被你自己的呼吸烘得又稠又热，还混杂着从上方街道与建筑里渗下来的污水恶臭。低矮的天花板不断滴落湿意，或是凝结的水珠，或是液体沿着砖墙缝隙一路渗漏而下。
The liquid seeping through your footwear feels cold, in stark contrast to the air about your face, which feels thick and hot with your own breath and the noisome stink of effluent from the streets and buildings above. The low ceiling drips with moisture, from condensation or perhaps liquid seeping down through the brickwork.

Grand Temple Of Victory.name:
胜利大圣殿
Grand Temple Of Victory

Text.text:
当你跨过古老神殿的门槛，一曲辉煌的号角宣告你的到来。自远古时代起，各个文化都流传着这座英雄殿堂的传奇，但再多故事也难以道尽它的真实。金色光辉自巨大的彩绘玻璃倾泻而下，温柔地浸透整座神殿；窗上以惊人的细节描绘着传说般的凯旋。拱顶甬道两侧矗立着一尊尊英雄雕像，通向宏伟祭坛——那里立着一位女子，身披灿然华美的护甲。她高举长剑，示意你上前；你发现自己竟无法抗拒她的召唤。你迈步向前，狂喜的掌声充盈空气；花瓣在你脚前一簇簇炸开，仿佛有人抛洒——可此处空无一人。你来到祭坛脚下，目光不由自主被基座顶端那位雕塑般的战士牵引。她正俯视着你，嘴角含笑。

~ Tuttlepants 于 Discord

A glorious fanfare announces your arrival as you cross the threshold of the ancient temple. Every culture has told tales of the famed hall of heroes since time immemorial, but none of the stories do it justice. Golden light bathes the temple in gentle radiance from titanic stained-glass windows depicting legendary triumphs in astonishing detail. Heroic statues line the vaulted causeway leading to the grand altar, where a woman stands in resplendent armor. Raising her sword, she beckons you to approach and you find yourself unable to resist her summons. The sound of rapturous applause fills the air as you walk forward, and petals scatter in bursts before you as if thrown—but there is no one here. You reach the foot of the altar and find your gaze drawn to the statuesque warrior atop the plinth. She is smiling down at you.

~ Tuttlepants on Discord

这些丘陵或许曾是群山，如今却已崩毁成废墟——碎裂的岩堆与嶙峋的石林，尽被常春藤与苔藓所笼罩。地形几近难以通行，尖锐突出的岩角四处耸立，险峻的裂隙暗藏杀机。
The hills may have once been mountains, but now they lie in ruin, heaps of broken rock and craggy formations shrouded in ivy and moss. The terrain is almost impassable, with sharp, jutting points and perilous crevices.

你攥紧手中一条白布，抬手在空中描摹符号，口中念出咒词。白布在一道闪光中倏然消失。温热自你胸口涌起，沿着四肢奔流，最终在指尖化作光辉。你感知到身边的盟友，随最后一句咒语，将那份温暖与光明延伸至他们的心间。
A strip of white cloth clutched in your hands, you trace the symbols in the air and speak the words. The cloth vanishes in a flash of light. Warmth originates in your chest and flows into your limbs, becoming light at your fingertips. You perceive your allies around you, and with a final word extend that warmth and light to their hearts.

Manual Of Flesh Golems.name:
血肉魔像制作手册
Manual Of Flesh Golems

Text.text:
[掩蔽] 这本骇人的巨册触感令人不安，带着皮革般的黏腻韧度，似乎由深浅不一的皮片拼缝而成。


[内容] 书页光滑得不像羊皮纸，有些甚至像是……长着雀斑？腥冷的解剖图谱塞满了整部阴森的文本，散发出浓烈的防腐药液气味。

[Cover] This hideous tome has an unsettling, leathery texture and appears sewn together in patches of varying hue.


[Content] The pages within are too smooth to be parchment, and some appear to have… freckles? Visceral anatomical diagrams fill the pages of the macabre text, which smell pungently of preservative fluids.

通道在一面墙前戛然而止，墙体裂开，左右各延伸出一条新的岔路。两边都幽暗无光，看不出尽头通向何处。哪一边看起来保存得更完好？那阵诡异的声响，是从左侧传来，还是右侧？
The passage comes to a blunt end at a wall, splitting with two new passages in either direction. Both are dark, with no hint at what may lie at the end of their paths. Does one seem to be in better repair? Did that strange sound come from the left, or the right?

在暗影行动中，这里的装置堪称完美。这台微型步行无人机是科技的奇迹，专为侦察任务打造。它的多足结构让它能像蚱蜢般攀上墙面；先进的传感器与摄像头则能实时回传高分辨率图像与视频。近乎无声的运转确保隐秘任务得以在不被察觉的情况下完成。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

For shadow ops, the device here is perfect. This micro walker drone is a marvel of technology, designed for reconnaissance missions. Its multi-legged design allows it to scale walls like a grasshopper, with advanced sensors and cameras providing high-resolution images and videos in real time. Its silent operation ensures covert missions can be carried out without detection.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Doctors Complaining About Magical Healin.name:
医生们抱怨魔法治疗
Doctors Complaining About Magical Healing

Text.text:
“那些该死的奥术师，跑来这里，抢我们的饭碗！想当年，我们被病人淹没，淹没，我跟你说！排队等治疗的名单要好几周才能清完，好几周！现在呢，病人一来，噗！好了！就这么一下！而我们这边的治疗室空着落灰，金库也在见底。”

“这不只是收入的事。这是尊严。我们的手艺会留下自然治疗的痕迹，是给未来诊断用的路线图。那些奥术师却让病人身上什么证据都不剩——看不出手上练就的技能，看不出治疗时那份细微的取舍。他们躲在他们的魔法后面。懦夫！”

“Them darn arcanists, coming here, stealing our jobs! Once upon a time, we were swamped in patients, swamped, I tell you! Waiting lists for treatments took weeks to clear, weeks! Now, patients come along and POOF! Cured! Just like that! Meanwhile, our treatment rooms are standing vacant and our coffers are dwindling.”

“It's not just about income. It's about pride. Our work leaves traces of natural healing, a roadmap for future diagnoses. These arcanists leave their patients with no evidence of the practiced skill of the hand, the nuanced decision of treatment. They hide behind their magic. Cowards!”

Decision To Walk Away From A Fight.name:
决定从战斗中抽身离去
Decision To Walk Away From A Fight

Text.text:
肾上腺素在你体内狂飙，激素的潮汐不肯退去，你离开战场时仍被它裹挟。视野翻涌，思绪彼此撕咬，像饥饿的野兽。你做对了吗？

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Adrenaline surges through your body, the hormonal tide refusing to abate as you walk away from the fight. Your vision swims, and your thoughts wrestle with each other like starving beasts. Did you do the right thing?

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

I Cast Remove Curse.name:
我施放【解除诅咒】
I Cast Remove Curse

Text.text:
当我施展守护时，脑海里回荡着诅咒那恶毒的低语。随着我的法术积蓄力量，它们变得愈发喧嚣、愈发狰狞。“退散！”我喝道，一圈炫目的紫色能量王冠在我头顶绽现。那些声音随即褪去，只剩无力的白噪音。我将手按在我的目标身上，感到那股恶意的能量正缓缓退潮。
I hear the malignant voices of the curse in my head as I conjure my ward. They grow louder and nastier as my spell builds power. "Begone!" I say, as a crown of dazzling purple energy appears around my head. The voices fade to impotent white noise. I place my hand on my target and feel the malicious energy recede.

Dead Planetoid's Approach.name:
死寂小行星的逼近
Dead Planetoid's Approach

Text.text:
数周以来，大地一直笼罩在令人作呕的阴影之下：连绵阴天如铅云压顶，赤红夜色却又亮得刺眼。植物蜷缩自缠，迅速干枯成骨架般的残枝瘦影，继而一碰即碎，化作尘土。动物拖着迟缓的步子挪动，叫声因疲惫而微弱，眼中噙着泪光。人类也并未好到哪里去。焦虑已毒化心智，酿成恐惧：猜忌与偏执成了常态。掌权者铁腕统治，凶兆般的预言从礼拜堂与阴暗街角轰然传出。末日的声音异口同声，指向同一个祸首——数周前出现在天幕上的那颗天体：一颗灰色行星，其表面燃着血红的斑块。那些熔融的坑洞密密麻麻，宛如一张死相的脸：嘴巴大张，眼窝深陷。每过去一天，那行星似乎就更逼近一步。

~ 由 Stefano Imperiale 构想

For weeks, the land has been cast in a sickening shadow; a pall of overcast days and gleaming red nights. Plants curl in on themselves, drying to skeletal waifs before crumbling to dust. Animals move at a sluggish pace, their cries weak with weariness and eyes shining with tears. People do not fare any better. Anxiety has poisoned minds to fear: mistrust and paranoia are now the norm. Those in power rule with iron fists, and foreboding prophecies thunder from houses of worship and dark street corners. The apocalyptic voices all call out the same malefactor—the celestial body that appeared in the sky weeks ago. A gray planet with blood-red, burning patches. These molten craters pockmarking its surface resemble a face in death, mouth agape and eyes sunken. With each passing day, the planet seems to grow closer.

~ Envisioned by Stefano Imperiale

Harken Conservatory In Winter.name:
冬日的哈肯音乐学院
Harken Conservatory In Winter

Text.text: 一株巨杉高耸入云，甚至能越过围拢温室庭院的高墙，远远便能望见。树上挂满了节庆装饰：串串红莓花环与刷成金色的橡果，在常青针叶间明亮夺目。主楼门厅内，墙上悬着一面巨幅横幅，上书 霜潮传说。这场展览阴森的标题，与门厅接待员叮当作响的铃铛耳坠与手镯形成鲜明反差——她低头在纸上书写，头与手臂随着动作微微闪烁。 A titanic pine rises high enough to be seen over walls that surround the conservatory’s courtyard.
