Festive decorations adorn the tree: garlands of red berries and acorns painted gold stand out bright from the evergreen needles. Within the lobby of the main building, one large banner hangs on the walls reading The Legend of the Frost Tide. This ominous title of the exhibit is juxtaposed by the jingle-bell earrings and bangles of the lobby receptionist, whose head and arms twinkle as she writes on a piece of paper.

Silver Bullet & Pistol.name:
银弹与手枪
Silver Bullet & Pistol

Text.text: 老猎人将那把沉甸甸的手枪搁在桌上，发出一声厚重的砰响。它既是武器，也是艺术品：枪管上繁复的雕纹与镀金铭牌，以令人屏息的细致刻画着早已作古的英雄斩杀凶残野兽的场景。矮人把一个小小的、圆形的物体递到你手里，上面浸透了乌头草辛辣刺鼻的气味。“只有银弹才能把它们彻底放倒——这就是咱们最后一发了，别浪费。” The old hunter places the solid pistol on the table with a weighty thud. As much a work of art as a weapon, the intricate carvings and gilded plaques along the barrel depict, in astonishing detail, long dead heroes slaying savage beasts. The dwarf hands you a small, round object steeped in the pungent aroma of wolfsbane. “Silver bullet’s the only way to put ‘em down proper—that’s our last so make it count.”

I Debuff My Enemy's Hacking Attributes.name:
我削弱敌人的黑客属性
I Debuff My Enemy's Hacking Attributes

Text.text:
只需一个专注的手势。我靠坐着，注视数据流——敌手在代码里精算般的修订与指令开始放缓。行文变得混乱而潦草。技能依旧在，但要从中挑出弱点、将其作为我反制手段的目标，已经容易得多。

~ 一位英雄所构想

All it takes is a focused gesture. I sit back to watch the stream of data, the series of my foe's calculated revisions and commands in the code slowing. The lines turn scrambled and sloppy. The skill is still there, but it's much easier to pick out the weak points to target in my own countermeasures.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Wagon Journey: Music Around The Campfire.name:
马车旅途：篝火旁的乐声
Wagon Journey: Music Around The Campfire

Text.text:
柔和的乐声正合你此刻的心绪。你在繁星点点的夜空下依偎着篝火取暖。一天的跋涉已然结束，明日又将启程。谁又知道它会把你带往何方？但这些忧虑尽可留待日出之后。今夜，你可以怀揣一曲在心，任自己渐渐沉入梦乡。
Gentle music suits your mood as you huddle close to the fire beneath a starry sky. The day’s journey is done, and tomorrow another begins. Who knows where it may take you? But such concerns can wait for the sun to rise. Tonight, you can drift to sleep with a song in your heart.

Witch Double-crosses Hobgoblin.name:
女巫背刺大地精
Witch Double-crosses Hobgoblin

Text.text:
一名大地精仰躺在桌上，没有束缚，神志清醒，神态松弛。他壮硕的身躯裸露在外，蒸腾的热气里沉甸甸地悬着草本的气味。一个披着棕色亚麻长袍的老妇人绕着桌子走动，用一根裹着白色树皮的木棒，把油亮的药剂抹在他身上。她把罐子和短杖放到一旁，一手按住他的头，另一手覆在他的心口。他猛地倒抽一口气，脊背弓起，随即在她用力朝他脸上吹出一口气时僵住不动。女术士像断线般瘫倒在地。寂静降临。忽然，大地精发出嘶哑的喘鸣，坐起身来。带着一抹咧开的笑，他环顾密室……用的却是那位老妇人的眼睛。

~ 由一位英雄构想

A hobgoblin lies on the table, unrestrained, conscious, and at ease. His brawny body is uncovered, and an herbaceous scent hangs heavy in the steamy air. Making her way around the table, an elderly woman in robes of brown linen applies an oily concoction to him, using a stick covered in white bark. She sets aside the jar and wand and puts one hand on his head and the other on his heart. He gasps, arches his back, and then stills as she blows hard into his face. The sorceress crumples to the ground. Silence falls. Suddenly, the hobgoblin wheezes and sits up. With a grin, he gazes about the chamber… with the old lady’s eyes.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

覆着裹尸布的形体横陈在这间幽暗厅室内，两排狭窄的石床沿着房间纵向一字排开。尸身一动不动，毫无呼吸，但盖在其上的布料却被血迹与其他体液浸染成斑驳污痕。仿佛这些尸体的景象与腥甜腐败的气味仍不足以警示你，石刻装饰更以死亡的象征布满四周：耳生蝠翼的骷髅、披斗篷挥舞长镰的身影，以及被刻入石面的沙漏图纹，无不刺入你的视线。
Sheeted forms lie on two rows of narrow stone beds running the length of this dark chamber. The bodies lie still and unbreathing, but blood and other fluids stain the cloths draped over them. As if the sight and smell of the bodies were not warning enough, stone carvings decorate the chamber with symbols of death. Skulls with bat wings for ears, cloaked figures wielding scythes, and engravings of hourglasses catch your eye.

I Cast Dominate Beast.name:
我施放「支配野兽」
I Cast Dominate Beast

Text.text:
我与那野兽四目相对，低声起咒，以我不可抗拒的意志强行支配它的心智。我将张开的手掌向它触及，召来它存在的拟像，在掌心凝成——随即猛然合拢五指，将那幻影死死攥住，并施放法术。
I lock eyes with the beast and begin the incantation to dominate its mind with the force of my inexorable will. I reach my open hand toward it, summoning a simulacrum of its being in my palm—before I clamp my hand shut around the illusion and cast the spell.

Tournament To Choose A Knight Of The Cou.name:
遴选宫廷骑士的比武大会
Tournament To Choose A Knight Of The Court

Text.text:
战士们在比武场上列队游行，护甲素净无饰，尚未配得上骑士的纹章色彩。人群嗡嗡议论，流言四起；赌注被收下，预言被抛出。自王家看台上，司仪高声宣告对这些志愿者的期许——他们必须展现何等品格，方能获封骑士。
Fighters parade about the list, their armor bare, knightly colors as yet unearned. The crowds buzz with gossip, while bets are taken, predictions made. From the royal stand, the master of ceremonies loudly declares what is expected of the aspirants, what qualities they must display to become a knight.

Cybernetic Arm Augmentation +3.name:
义体手臂强化 +3
Cybernetic Arm Augmentation +3

Text.text:
加固导管将脑干连接到一只最尖端的聚合物肩部关节窝，幽蓝光芒脉动其间：那是一台微观纳米机器人制造器，源源不断地编织出细小的昆虫状机械体。每一枚纳米机器人都经过升级，具备有限的飞行能力，让使用者拥有更远的射程与更自由的创意。如今，整条手臂都能化作有生命的聚合体——一团会呼吸的虫群，孕育无尽可能。随着使用者动作，来自脑干神经网络的信号塑形整臂，将其雕刻成一片黑色液态云雾。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Reinforced tubing connects the brain stem to a cutting-edge polymer shoulder socket pulsing with blue light: a microscopic nanobot fabricator, crafting endless tiny insectoid robots. Each nanobot has been upgraded with limited flight capacities, allowing the user greater range and creativity. Now the entire arm can become a living mass, a breathing swarm of possibility. As the user moves, signals from the brain stem’s neural net sculpts the arm into a black liquid cloud.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

你从负能量位面的混沌织构中汲取力量，将法术的能量塑成一场苦难，直击那不幸闯入你路途之人的根本属性，把他们硬生生拖入一种无助到近乎灾厄的境地。你注视着他们，眼中的火焰逐渐熄灭。
Drawing forth from the chaotic weavings of the negative plane, you shape the energies of your spell into an affliction attacking the very attributes of the unlucky soul who has crossed your path, forcing them into a hapless state that is nothing short of calamitous. As you watch, you see the fire in their eyes go out.

Footprints In The Snow.name:
雪中足迹
Footprints In The Snow

Text.text:
脚印在原本无瑕的雪毯上压出凹痕，凹槽里幽蓝的深处正一点点被新落的雪花填满。虽难以断定，但它们似乎从大路偏离，朝河边延去。你沿着足迹的走向与四周的景色望去，心底只剩一个谜团：留下这些印记的人，到底去了哪里？
Footprints dent the otherwise pristine sheet of snow, the blue depths of their wells gradually filling with new flakes. It’s difficult to tell, but it seems like they head away from the road toward the river. As you gaze along the length of the path and the surrounding landscape, you’re left with a mystery: where did whoever made the prints go?

Deep Dragon's Mushroom Plantation.name:
深渊巨龙的蘑菇种植园
Deep Dragon's Mushroom Plantation

Text.text:
洞窟幽冥如渊，地下苔藓是唯一的光源。残缺的工人——仿佛失明且沉默——在贫瘠发白的蘑菇周遭翻耕泥土，蘑菇成排高高摇曳，其上有灰皮矮人监看。大多数阴森的建筑都配有黑暗精灵哨兵，华丽的弩随手可取；但有一座低矮黝黑的建筑格外醒目，一条紫鳞巨龙盘绕在其基座上。

~ 构想：Bangalulu

The cavern is stygian, hypogeal moss providing the only light. Mutilated workers—seemingly blind and silent—till the soil around anemic mushrooms swaying in lofty ranks, watched over by gray-skinned dwarves. Most of the sinister buildings sport dark elf sentries, ornate crossbows close to hand, but one dark squat structure has a purple scaled dragon coiled about its base.

~ Envisioned by Bangalulu

Dying Of Exhaustion.name:
力竭而亡
Dying Of Exhaustion

Text.text:
熬过头两天的不眠，渴望便变成了需求。你的视野时而漂浮发晕，双手也止不住颤抖。你躺在那里，头重脚轻，却怎么也沉不下去。第三天悄然滑进第四天，幻觉相伴，纯粹的疲惫终于猛然踢门而入。你正在发疯。世界被精神病性的滤镜与疼痛的白日梦筛过一遍又一遍。终于，你感觉到有某种东西——不是睡眠——正沿着骨头缝悄悄爬进来。万物褪色，缩成一条赤裸的意识隧道，直到它终于合拢。

~ 一位英雄 设想

After the first two days without sleep, the desire turns to need. Your vision swims sometimes, and your hands shake. You lie there, woozy but unable to drift off. The third day slips into the fourth with hallucinations, and the sheer exhaustion kicks in. You are going insane. The world is filtered through psychosis and painful daydreaming. Finally, you feel something other than sleep creeping in through your bones. Everything fades into a tunnel of bare consciousness that finally closes up.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Open The Stopper Of My Efreeti Bottle.name:
我拔开了我那只伊弗利特之瓶的塞子
I Open The Stopper Of My Efreeti Bottle

Text.text:
我拔下黄铜塞子，只见一团浓稠、闪烁着微光的烟云从瓶口涌出，在地面盘旋堆积成翻卷的瘴雾。随着一道炽白的闪光，火焰吞没了烟雾，一个皮肤如灼热煤炭般赤红的大型存在站在我面前。
Pulling the brass stopper free, I watch as a cloud of thick, glittering smoke flows out of the bottle and pools on the ground in a swirling miasma. With an incandescent flash, fire consumes the smoke, and a large being with skin the color of hot coals stands before me.

一位年迈的绅士带着盛气凌人的威仪，斜倚在一张天鹅绒软垫椅上——椅子两侧装着两只狭窄的轮子。他抓住两只轮圈，一推一拉，便利落地转了个弯，好将更多领地尽收眼底。他的脖颈想必不太灵便，只微微一偏，便立刻转动轮子，让座椅朝另一侧扭转过去。
An elderly gentleman with an imperious air reclines in a velvet padded-chair attached to two narrow wheels. By grabbing both wheels and pushing one while pulling the other, he executes a neat turn to survey more of his domain. He must have some difficulty turning his neck, as he tilts it only slightly before turning the wheels to twist his chair the other way.

Dwarven City Entrance.name:
矮人城入口
Dwarven City Entrance

Text.text:
伟大、阴沉、蓄须的面孔在你上方逼近，俯瞰着那条由平整石板铺就、笔直延伸于陡峭石壁之间的道路。每一颗矮人头颅都宛如一座城堡塔楼，鬈曲的头发与胡须掩住了箭孔。你看见戴盔的脑袋从这些诡异建筑张开的眼眶里探出，向下窥视；而那一张张嘴仿佛带铰链的石门，随时可能敞开倾泻出一场攻击。你仰望这些面孔，忍不住猜想：它们那深邃的鼻孔会释放出何种武器。
Great, grim, bearded faces loom over the level road of flat stones running between sheer walls. Each dwarf head serves as a castle tower, with curls of hair and beard hiding arrow loops. You see helmeted heads peering down at you from the open eyes of these strange structures, while the mouths appear to be hinged doors of stone that could disgorge an attack. Looking up at the faces, you can’t help but wonder what weapon their cavernous nostrils unleash.

老妇人的皮肤被数十年的日晒烤得黝褐起皱，嘴角扭出一抹小小的笑。她的头巾陈旧却补丁密实，工装背带裤的口袋里塞满各式工具，还揣着一把碎裂的玉米粒喂鸡。她身后停着一辆小独轮车，满满装着从她地头前段果树上摘下的李子。
The old woman’s skin is wrinkled and burned brown by decades of sun, her mouth twisted in a small smile. Her kerchief is old but well-patched, the pockets of her overalls filled with different tools, as well as a handful of cracked corn for the chickens. Behind her, a small wheelbarrow sits, full of plums picked from the trees in the front part of her land.

天际线上浮现出几片帆影，破烂不堪，漆黑如墨。随着那艘船愈发逼近，一股不祥的预感攫住你，寒意沿着脊背直窜而上。你看清了它那幽魂般的轮廓，墨黑的烟雾触须盘绕其身——以及甲板上那群骷髅般的船员。
Sails appear on the horizon, tattered and black. A sense of foreboding comes over you and a shiver runs up your spine as the ship draws closer. You notice the spectral shape, the tendrils of inky, black smoke coiling about it—and the skeletal crew upon its decks.

你以低沉嘶哑的腔调吟诵，夸张地伸展你平日的移动，将你的投射物放出。低语与闪光轰然化作怒吼——与它成双的飞弹自你的一击分裂而生，塞满空中，狂飙远去，仿佛你已将它们尽数释放。它们的轨迹不断扩散，越来越多的影子凭空浮现，执行致命的工作，宛如巨龙喷吐出一场弹药的冰雹。
With a guttural intonation and an exaggeration of your normal movement you loose your projectile. Whispers and flashes become a roar, as missiles, twinned from yours, fill the air and rush away, as if you released them all. Their path widens, and more and more appear to do their lethal work, like a dragon had breathed forth a hail of ammunition.

道路的石砌铺面历经万古荒废仍完好无损，蜿蜒穿行于疯长的植被与风蚀的丘岗之间。交汇处立着一尊雕像，隐约是类人形态，却已五官磨灭；它一臂伸出，指向一处阴影笼罩的废墟——一座铺展开来的巨城，秘辛尽失于时代，塔楼倾颓。那座古老城市的核心，究竟藏着什么？
The worked stone of the path remains intact, even after eons of disuse. It winds its way through overgrowth and eroded hillocks. A statue stands at an intersection, depicting a vaguely humanoid figure, though its features are worn away. One arm points in the direction of a shadowed ruin: a sprawling city, its secrets lost to time, its towers toppled. What lies at the heart of this ancient city?

Blacksmith: Busy Smithy.name:
铁匠：忙碌的锻造坊
Blacksmith: Busy Smithy

Text.text:
仿佛每一座铁砧、每一块砧座旁都有人挥锤敲击。他们以惊人的速度与从容运作，几乎成品在短短片刻便一件接一件地流出。火星在铁匠们的腿间四散飞溅，甚至还没落地就已冷却成灰。
It seems every anvil and block has someone striking it. They work with startling speed and ease, turning out nearly finished products in rapid succession. Sparks scatter among the legs of the smiths, cooling to ashes before they even hit the floor.

唯有真正蒙受生命和谐之福者，才敢尝试这等强大的死灵术。长达一小时的吟诵既令人精疲力竭，又要求献上一枚价值连城的宝石；然而当遗体自停尸台上起身——毫发无损、完好如初，宛如生命盛年般——双眼眨动，短暂地流露出茫然不解时，你再也无法否认眼前所见的铁证。
Only one truly blessed with the harmony of life should even attempt this powerful necromancy. The hour-long intonation is both draining and requires the sacrifice of a priceless gem, but there is no denying the evidence of your eyes as the body rises from its bier—unwounded and whole—as it was in the prime of life, eyes blinking in momentary incomprehension.

Calm Meadow On Pristine World.name:
原始世界的静谧草甸
Calm Meadow On Pristine World

Text.text:
阳光与树荫在浓密的翠绿草毯上缓缓起舞。十二种鸟儿或晒着日头，或在高高的谷穗与灌木间穿梭，盘桓于草甸远端的边缘。微风低柔而干爽，一条天色般澄蓝的小溪自青翠山丘间潺潺流下，吟唱着安歇的曲调；四周的树木仿佛在田园般的恍惚催眠里，成了困倦的观众。
Sun and shade dance slowly across the thick green grass. Twelve species of bird sun themselves or flit about the tall grains and bushes along the meadow’s far edge. The breeze is low and dry, the trickle of a brook the color of the sky sings a restful song down from the green hills, and the surrounding trees seem to be a sleepy audience under an idyllic trance.

Grimm (Elry Shadowfoot).name:
格里姆（埃尔瑞·影足）
Grimm (Elry Shadowfoot)

Text.text:
在祖父母的照料下长得高大健壮，这位邪术师以坚定的目光眺望世界。他被阳光晒得黝黑，脸颊上一道伤疤，正是他与大个子们并肩冒险、对抗各类怪物与险境的见证。他的护甲布满尖刺，轻弩凶狠凌厉；可即便如此，他依旧温和友善，内心深处仍是研习奥术的学者。生日时他总会送出很棒的礼物；无论对过往多么讳莫如深，他仍是那个与朋友围坐盛宴的半身人。

~ Played by Batsassin with

Grown tall and strong under the care of his grandparents, the warlock looks out at the world with determination. He is tanned by the sun and bears a scar on his cheek, a testament to adventures with the big folk against monsters and hazards of all kinds. His armor is spiked, his light crossbow vicious, but for all that he is still kind, friendly, a scholar of the arcane at heart. He gives good presents on his birthdays, and he is still a halfling who feasts among friends, however secretive he may be about his past.

~ Played by Batsassin with

Plane Of Ice.name:
冰之位面
Plane Of Ice

Text.text:
这里连空气仿佛都被冻结了。你脚下是一整片坚实的蓝白色冰面，若不是危险得要命，几乎称得上美丽。你艰难地想要站稳，可你越是用力，肺里越像被灼烧一般——这是此地那种不自然、非尘世的寒意。你看见地平线上有由冰构成的群山拔地而起，直冲天际，没入上方灰色云层之中。你意识到这里不会下雪——冷到连雪都无法形成。
The air itself seems to freeze here. The ground beneath you is solid, blue-white ice, almost beautiful were it not so hazardous. You struggle to find footing, but the harder you try, the more your lungs burn with the unnatural, otherworldly cold of this place. You see mountains composed of ice rising to the sky on the horizon, disappearing into the gray clouds above. It won't snow, you realize—it's too cold for snow.

Necromancer Raising A Mass Of Undead.name:
死灵法师唤起成群亡者
Necromancer Raising A Mass Of Undead

Text.text:
惨绿的光从死灵法师空洞的眼眶里泻出，他施展法术时，干枯的唇间挤出一声嘶哑、被掐断般的笑。那股能量像蛆虫般在雾罩墓园里钻行，纤薄的触须一路探入坟冢深处——唤醒其中的亡者。伴随着低沉而痛苦的呻吟，受诅的尸体用折断的指甲抓挠着腐殖泥土，硬生生爬出地面，直到苍白月光抚过他们霉烂的血肉。

~ DaveDaWanderer on Discord

Sickening green light spills from the necromancer's hollow eyes as he casts the spell, and a wheezing, throttled laugh escapes his desiccated lips. The energy worms its way through the fog-shrouded cemetery, sending wispy tendrils deep into the graves—and animating the dead within. With low, tortured moans, the blighted cadavers claw their way through the loamy earth with broken fingernails until the pallid moonlight caresses their moldering flesh.

~ DaveDaWanderer on Discord

这只可展开的帆布工具袋里，整齐收着几把大小不一的凿子、锤子、刷子与抹子，另有一把钢制直尺与角尺。袋内还放着一枚铅锤等级，以及用于标记与测量的墨线。内侧的细小夹套与环扣将工具稳稳固定在袋壁上。
This fold-out canvas pouch contains a few chisels, hammers, brushes, and trowels of assorted sizes, as well as a steel straightedge and square. It also holds a plumb bob level, along with marking and measuring twine. Small sleeves and loops hold the tools to the pouch walls.

I Eat Spicy Food: Not Enjoying It.name:
我吃辣：并不享受
I Eat Spicy Food: Not Enjoying It

Text.text:
第一口还挺香——可紧接着，辣意便如野火般掠过我的舌面，猛然翻涌。灼热烧得我满口刺痛，连味蕾都被麻得失了灵，食物只剩一股冲鼻的苦涩。泪水涌得视线发花，鼻涕顺着上唇淌下。我听见胃里一阵抽搐般的咕噜声，这才明白：这顿饭带来的折磨，绝不会到此为止。
The first bite tastes pretty good—but then the spiciness crests over my tongue like a wildfire. The heat burns my mouth and numbs my tastebuds, leaving the food with only a pungent, bitter flavor. Tears blur my eyesight as snot dribbles over my lip. I hear a cramping gurgle from my stomach, and I realize my suffering isn’t going to end with this meal.

Suddenly Vulnerable Town Attacked By Dra.name:
突然失陷的城镇遭巨龙袭击
Suddenly Vulnerable Town Attacked By Dragon

Text.text:
翼蜥在空中懒洋洋地侧身盘旋，温暖的上升气流拍打着那对苍老的鳞翼。城墙之外的城镇边缘已被灼成一片焦黑，尽数沦为它喷吐出的炽亮赤红火浪的牺牲品。城镇本身却在一团温热的防护魔法泡罩下微微摇晃，将巨龙的猛攻一一抖落。就在它开始绕回时，空气里忽然迸起噼啪的电响。护盾嘶嘶作响，明灭闪烁，继而一阵颤抖——彻底崩溃。镇民们已开始尖叫，在即将降临的恐怖前，惊惧得几乎窒息。

~ 由一位英雄 Played

The winged lizard banks lazily in the air, warm drafts buffeting old, scaled wings. The outskirts of the town beyond the walls are scorched black, fallen victim to bright gouts of belched red fire. The town itself wobbles beneath a warm bubble of protective magic, shrugging off the dragon’s assaults. As it begins to circle back around, a crackle fills the air. The shield fizzles, flickering, then stutters and fails. Townspeople begin to shriek in terrified anticipation of what’s to come.

~ Played by a Hero

Virus-bombed City Ruins.name:
遭病毒炸弹轰炸的城市废墟
Virus-bombed City Ruins

Text.text:
一缕缕酸橙绿的气体从弹坑深处与麻点般的混凝土缝隙间袅袅逸出。你嘴里泛起一丝杏仁般的微涩气味，混凝土似乎也染上了淡淡的青绿，而所有木料都已腐朽。许多建筑结构仍然完好——这里没有遭受常规意义上的破坏——但这是一座幽灵城，死一般寂静，没有移动，没有笑声。河床裸露，亦无鸟鸣。生命早在很久以前就被从这里驱逐殆尽。
Wisps of lime-green gas waft from the bowels of craters and pockmarked concrete. There is a slight almond tang in your mouth and there appears to be a greenish hue to the concrete, while all the wood is rotten. Much structure remains intact—there has been no conventional destruction here—but it is a ghost town, utterly silent, without movement, and without laughter. The river is bare, and no birds are singing. Life was driven from this place long ago.

那名战士身披全套板甲，却能以漫不经心的娴熟挥舞巨剑，显然既经受过严苛的训练，也在真正的战场上见过太多生死。骑士将戴着头盔的面甲微微转向你，随即略一躬身；可这份致意究竟是问候还是挑衅，你一时难以分辨。
The warrior’s casual finesse with a greatsword while garbed in full plate armor clearly stems from both rigorous training and plenty of real battle experience. The knight inclines a helmeted face in your direction then bows slightly, though whether this acknowledgment is greeting or challenge you are not sure.

一个腿上打着夹板的男人单手拄着一根拐杖，另一只手捏着一小截木炭，在贴在墙上的纸上写写画画。你上前一步，他挪了挪身子，让你看清了他的“杰作”——他正给一张通缉令上的画像添上一撮夸张的小胡子。

他察觉到你的目光时猛地一惊，木炭脱手而落，拐杖也滑了出去。他踉跄着撞向墙壁，手忙脚乱地想站稳，结果把那张通缉令连同旁边几张告示一并扯落，纸张哗啦啦散了一地。他急急转身，终于在坠落前稳住了身形。

他抬手把额前乱发拨开，伸出一只沾满炭灰的手，笑着向你打招呼——全然没意识到自己刚才顺手在脸上抹出了几道黑色的污痕。
A man with his leg in a splint leans on one crutch while he uses a bit of charcoal to write or draw on a paper attached to the wall. He moves, giving you a better look at his work, and you see that he is drawing a mustache on the picture of someone on a wanted poster. He startles when he notices you watching, drops the charcoal, loses his crutch, and tumbles against the wall, tearing down the poster and several others as he scrambles to keep his footing. He spins and manages to stop himself from falling. Brushing his hair out of his eyes, he holds out a charcoal-stained hand and smiles in greeting, not realizing that he’s wiped streaks of black across his face.

Spaceship Crash Landing Site.name:
宇宙飞船坠毁迫降点
Spaceship Crash Landing Site

Text.text:
曾经那艘流线优雅、精密考究的飞船，如今已碎成千片残骸，四散的碎片在绵延数里的地表砸出一个个小小的陨坑。主撞击点又深又宽，吞着飞船伤痕累累的尾部——它仍大体完好。巨大的紫色火焰舔舐着残存的船体外壳，却因燃料匮乏而被迫收敛。
What was once a single sleek and sophisticated craft is now a thousand shattered pieces, the debris making little craters for miles around. The site of the main impact is deep and wide, and holds the scarred rear of the ship, still largely intact. Great purple flames lick at what is left of the hull, limited by the lack of fuel.

Runaway Child.name:
离家出走的孩子
Runaway Child

Text.text:
孩子的眼睛慌乱地四处游移，把周遭尽收眼底，双臂死死抱紧一只填充猫头熊玩偶。他们独自旅行，至少看起来如此。路上的泥点溅满他们破旧的靴子与裤腿，脚步虚浮踉跄，像是好几天没进过食。
The kid’s eyes roam wildly about, taking in their surroundings as they clutch a stuffed owlbear close. They travel alone, or at least it seems that way. Mud from the road flecks their shabby boots and trousers, and they have the unsteady gait of someone who hasn’t eaten in days.

她将纸张牢牢固定好，便合上搁在膝上的石板。那是一件奇特的折叠器具：一侧排列着一行行大小一致的长方形格位，另一侧则布满细小的圆形凹窝。她感觉到卡扣咔哒一声扣紧，不由得含笑，随即从腰间小袋里取出一件优雅的尖头工具——形似书写用的羽毛笔。接着，她以惊人的速度与精准度开始书写：在那些长方形格位中，用点状压痕在纸上留下凸起，编织出可触摸的密语。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Securing her paper in place, the dark elf closes the slate resting in her lap. It is a curious folding apparatus with rows of identical rectangular spaces on one side, and small round depressions on the other. She smiles as she feels the clasps lock into place and produces an elegant, pointed tool—much like a writing quill—from a pouch on her belt. Then, with remarkable speed and accuracy, she begins to write by indenting the paper with dots inside the rectangular spaces, forming a tactile code.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Wetland Temple Ruins.name:
湿地神庙遗迹
Wetland Temple Ruins

Text.text:
在沼泽浑浊蔓延的湿地深处，神庙遗迹如被遗忘的神祇般矗立。风蚀的石柱曾经庄严巍峨，如今却倒伏在地，披覆着浸满露水的苔藓。倾颓的柱身上刻着古老符文，诉说着早已被时代迷雾吞没的仪式传说。自然已夺回这片圣土，崇拜者的歌声不再，只余青蛙的呱鸣回荡。
Within the murky sprawl of the marsh, temple ruins rise like forgotten gods. Weathered stone columns, once proud and grand, now lie sheathed in dew-soaked moss. Ancient runes carved into tumbled pillars tell tales of rituals long lost to the mists of time. Nature has reclaimed this sacred ground, the songs of worshippers gone and replaced by croaking frogs.

Downcast Panhandler.name:
落魄的乞讨者
Downcast Panhandler

Text.text:
乞丐一边抚摸身旁那条癞皮狗，一边勉强挤出一抹湿润的笑。人群如流水般从他面前掠过——或浑然不觉，或心不在焉，或干脆冷眼旁观。他疲惫地叹了口气，低头望向面前那只被磕得凹瘪的杯子，清点今天寥寥无几的施舍——又暗自盘算，今夜该在哪儿落脚。
Patting the mangy dog by their side, the panhandler manages a watery smile as people stream by, oblivious, distracted, or actively disinterested. They sigh wearily as they look in the battered cup before them to count the meager donations from today—and wonder where they will spend the night.

Tadapiye Nima'a.name:
塔达皮耶·尼玛阿
Tadapiye Nima'a

Text.text:
三名骑手身披轻便长袍与兜帽斗篷，风吹日晒的挎带横过胸前，挂着水罐与行囊，看上去足以在炽热沙海中连续旅行数日。领头者骑着一匹灰白相间的马，抬起拳头示意停下队伍的疾驰。他动作利落地从坐骑上翻身落地，火焰般的红色辫发从兜帽下滑出，背后鞘中的长矛随之碰撞作响。他深褐色的皮肤上点缀着雀斑，大多聚在那摄人目光的下方。那双浅棕色眼睛闪着爽朗的笑意——但其中一只眼的巩膜却彻底化作金色，泛起某种超自然的微光。

~ Played by TheOlamicSource

Garbed in light robes and hooded cloaks, and with water jugs and packs slung across their torsos in weatherworn bandoliers, the three riders appear equipped for days of travel over blazing sands. The leader, a man astride a gray and white horse, holds up a fist to halt the gallop of his group. He swings down from his mount with ease, his flaming red braids slipping out from his hood, his spear clattering in the sheath on his back. His dark brown skin is dappled with freckles that congregate mostly under his arresting gaze. His eyes are light brown and shining with good cheer—but one sclera is completely golden and shimmers with something supernatural.

~ Played by TheOlamicSource

Boast With Magical Jargon.name:
用魔法术语夸耀
Boast With Magical Jargon

Text.text:
“哦，这其实很简单。人智学派每天都在用灵听。只是他们缺了那种一梦的视界，无法用神印来放大杖占术的冲击。”

那疯癫的老巫师对着自己咯咯发笑，又补上一句：“午饭前就能收工，不然我就不配这‘大诺斯替’的头衔！”

“Oh, it is simple, really. Anthroposophists use clairaudience every day. They just lack the oneiral vision to use a sigillum dei to amplify the rhabdomantic impact.”

The mad old wizard chuckles to themself and adds, “We'll be done in time for lunch, or I don't deserve the title of greater gnostic!”

你推开正门踏入的瞬间，喧嚣轰然炸开。湿漉漉的皮毛味、粪臭与干草气息直冲鼻腔，你把咳嗽闷在臂弯里。动物们——有些奇异罕见，但更多是常见的——在狭小的笼舍与水槽里踱步、蜿蜒、游弋。你经过时，一只亮蓝羽毛的长尾小鹦鹉尖声厉叫，癫狂地喊着：“顾客——”
A cacophony erupts as you make your way through the front door. The smell of wet fur, scat, and hay fills your nostrils, and you stifle a cough in your elbow. Animals—some exotic, but many familiar—pace, slither, and swim in small enclosures and tanks. A parakeet with bright blue feathers shrieks loudly as you pass, screaming, “Customer,” maniacally.

Wild Magic Surge: Sheep Shape.name:
狂野魔法涌动：绵羊形态
Wild Magic Surge: Sheep Shape

Text.text:
当魔法顺从你的意志弯折时，一股回应般的涌流也以自身的意志反压于你。

[豁免成功]  它扭曲你的现实，试图改变你的肉体形态；但你以精神之力一推，拒斥它的意志，仍旧毫无变化。

[豁免失败]  它扭曲你的现实，改变你的肉体形态。你四肢着地倒了下去，厚厚一层卷曲羊毛让你骤然感到温热，朝同伴发出凄切的“咩——！”

As the magic bends to your will, an answering surge exerts its own will upon you.

[Successful Save]  It twists your reality, attempting to alter your physical shape, but with a mental push, you reject its will and remain unchanged.

[Failed Save]  It twists your reality, altering your physical shape. You fall down on all fours, suddenly warm under a thick coat of curly wool, calling out to your allies with a woeful “Baaa!”

Overheard Story About An Encounter With.name:
偷听来的故事：与巨人的一次遭遇
Overheard Story About An Encounter With A Giant

Text.text:
“——一跺脚就地动山摇的大家伙。瞧着有点像个人形。至少打呼噜跟人一个样。起先我们还以为他迷路了，直到凑近才看清那畜生的体型——像两栋房子一上一下摞起来那么高。马儿被吓得乱蹬，闹出震天动静，把它给惊醒了。它把一棵树连根拔起当棍子抡，冲我们吼了句什么。也不知道吼的啥，我们可没傻到留下来听完，但我敢打包票，那玩意儿还在外头拖着步子到处晃。”
“—stomping great thing. Looked like a man, sort of. Snored like one, anyway. We thought he might be lost until we got closer and saw the size of the bastard, like two houses stacked on top of each other. Horses kicked up an awful racket and it started to wake. Pulled a tree out by the roots like a club and yelled something at us. Don’t know what it was, didn’t wait around to find out, but I’m sure it’s still lumbering around out there.”

Tournament Libations Booth.name:
锦标赛酒水摊
Tournament Libations Booth

Text.text:
一大群人围在藤蔓垂坠的帐篷与那位身形矮小的牧师周围。负责赐福的萨堤尔已然酩酊大醉，口齿含混，圆鼓鼓的鼻头红得像红宝石。祭司微笑着举起金色圣杯，倾出一小点奠酒，感召神祇的恩眷。随后他一口将剩余的酒吞尽——并爆出一声震耳欲聋的酒嗝。
A large crowd is gathered around the vine-draped tent and its diminutive cleric. The satyr providing the blessings is drunk, his speech slurred, and his bulbous nose ruby red. The priest smiles and raises his golden chalice to pour out a tiny libation, calling upon the favor of the gods. Then in one gulp he downs the remaining wine—and belches thunderously.

你周遭的世界一片灰白，黯淡、无形、毫无特征。天空没有星光点亮，也没有月色洒下辉辉。荒原般的延展仿佛无穷无尽，在它的凄冷荒寂中压得人喘不过气。
The world around you is gray, muted, featureless. No stars light the sky, no moon casts its glow. The sprawl is seemingly endless, and oppressive in its bleakness.

透过被撕成碎片的祭衣，你看见神父的皮肉上满是利爪撕裂与灼烧的痕迹。他一只手还在疯狂扯裂自己的衣物，另一只手却胡乱挥扫着空气，仿佛在拍打一团看不见的虫云。胸口正中央，挂在颈间的圣徽下方，隆起一团血泡般的瘤块。痛苦的尖哼从他紧咬的齿缝里渗出来。他把牙关越咬越紧，直到伴着一声令人作呕的咔嚓，牙齿碎裂。他扑通跪倒，嘴角松垂。无数种不同而无法辨识的声音，如同军团般从他的喉咙里倾泻而出。 Through vestments torn to shreds, you can see the priest’s flesh has been clawed and burned. One of his hands continues to tear at his clothes while the other swipes at the air, as if batting away a cloud of insects. In the middle of his chest, a mound of blood blisters sits under the holy symbol hanging around his neck. A squeal of pain seeps from between his clenched teeth. He grits them until, with an repugnant crunch they splinter. He falls to his knees, and his mouth goes slack. A legion of different, unintelligible, voices pour out of his throat.

Funeral Vault Of A Sorcerer.name:
术士的葬仪秘库
Funeral Vault Of A Sorcerer

Text.text:
火焰在术士的葬墓金库那闪耀的黄铜表面勾勒出跳跃的纹样，将灼热的残影烙进你的视野。秘奥符印点缀着石棺，沿着匣体边缘一圈圈压印，宛如哨兵般守护着他们的主人，直至死亡彼岸。棺盖上烙印着居者的肖像：一名术士身披华贵长袍，安卧如眠，将法杖紧紧抱在胸前。
Flames limn the shining brass of the sorcerer’s funeral vault in dancing patterns which sear the image into your vision. Arcane sigils decorate the sarcophagus, stamped around the perimeter of the box like sentries guarding their master beyond death. The occupant’s likeness has been emblazoned onto the lid of the vault, depicting a sorcerer clad in opulent robes, a staff clutched to their chest in repose.

Post Resurrection Quip.name:
复活后的打趣
Post Resurrection Quip

Text.text:
“我看见了——我看见了我的母亲和父亲；我走近时，他们张开双臂迎向我，接着我就在这里醒来。谢谢你。一想到要与他们共度永恒，我几乎承受不住。”
“I saw—I saw my mother and father; they opened their arms as I approached, then I woke up here. Thank you. The thought of spending an eternity with them was almost too much to bear.”

Reinforced Wooden Nunchaku.name:
加固木制双节棍
Reinforced Wooden Nunchaku

Text.text:
一条相扣的钢链将两截双节棍连接在一起；每一截都是短小的木棍，外侧又以布满凹痕的金属板加固。那古老设计的朴素雅致一眼可见，而落入行家之手，这件武器便能爆发出摧枯拉朽的杀伤力。
A linked steel chain joins two nunchaku, each short wooden pole reinforced with battered metal plates. The simple elegance of the ancient design is evident, and in the right hands, this weapon is devastatingly effective.

The Invisible Knight.name:
隐形骑士
The Invisible Knight

Text.text:
战士身披闪耀的板甲，甲面镶饰着天使般的纹章；一顶巨盔遮住了他们的面容，盔上点缀着风格化的羽翼。右肩甲上，一只长着蝴蝶翅膀的小小类人——小妖精（特征）——正停栖其上；左手则擎着一面镀金的风筝盾。战斗伊始，他们任由带着翼状棱刃的狼牙棒斜挂一旁，反而以戴着铁手套的拳头紧攥那枚苍穹吊坠。他们用沙哑的男中音开口，小妖精（特征）随即振翅飞起。下一瞬，那名披甲骑士在一阵炫目的粒子闪光中消失无踪。

~ 扮演者：Colby Poulson，来自 d4: D&D Deep Dive

The warrior wears gleaming plate armor adorned with angelic motifs, their face hidden by a great helm decorated with stylized feathered wings. On their right pauldron, a little humanoid with butterfly wings—a sprite—perches, and the knight carries a gilded kite shield on the left. They leave their mace, with winglike flanges, slung as battle begins, instead grasping their empyreal pendant in a gauntleted fist. They speak in a raspy baritone and the sprite takes flight. Then the armored knight vanishes in a flash of dazzling particles.

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

Threat By A King About Talking Too Much.name:
国王因你话太多而发出的威胁
Threat By A King About Talking Too Much

Text.text:
“我敢肯定，你那三寸不烂之舌曾把不少酒馆常客哄上过你的床，但在这里，它只会把你哄进坟墓。”
“While I’m sure your silver tongue has gotten you into the beds of many a bar patron, here it will only lead you into the grave.”

Swat Surround A Hostage Situation.name:
特警包围：人质危机
Swat Surround A Hostage Situation

Text.text:
头盔覆面、身披碳纤护甲的SWAT小队涌入一栋阴冷肮脏的公寓楼走廊。众人缩着脖子、枪口随时待发，话语经由变声系统过滤，听起来像机械般的碎语。离公寓门最近的警员双手举着爆破盾牌。

“他把客厅的监控摄像头毁了，扫描器也没在他或人质身上检测到神经芯片。”

“那就用老办法来。我先开始谈判。狙击手就位了吗？”

“鹰眼，回报。”警员面罩上的叠加界面由绿色转为黯淡的黄。

“鹰眼已就位。”她的头盔里传来低沉的男中音噼啪作响，音频在警员面罩角落里以起伏的频谱图呈现。

Helmeted and vested in carbon armor, a SWAT team floods the hallway of a dingy apartment building. Heads are hunched into their shoulders and firearms at the ready, their speech a mechanic chatter through the voice-modulating systems. The officer closest to the apartment door holds a blasting shield with both hands.

“He’s destroyed the surveillance camera in the living room and scanners haven't detected a neural chip in him or the hostage.”

“So we do this the old-fashioned way. I’ll begin negotiations. Snipers at the ready?”

“Eagle-Eye, report in.” The overlay on the officer’s visor changes from green to dim yellow.

“Eagle-Eye in position.” A baritone voice crackles through her helmet, the audio portrayed in a fluctuating spectrogram in the corner of the officer’s visor.

School For Spellcasters Setting.name:
施法者学院设定
School For Spellcasters Setting

Text.text:
空气中弥漫着一丝独特的魔法余韵。高耸的墙边排满书架，书本在格间微微战栗，像焦躁的鸟儿等着振翅而起。翻检纸页的沙沙声自每一间书房窸窣传来。此处既是港湾、是歇息之所，也是熔炉——魔法使用者能在此与精通各派魔法学识的导师磨砺技艺，甚至包括那些古怪而冷僻的门类。学生的面孔从眼睛发亮、笑意盈盈的新生，到目光阴沉、风暴未息的高年级皆有。书被召唤时，便从书匣中倏然飞出又归位。闪烁的云团载着导师与学徒在楼层间穿梭，他们踏上心之所向的回廊，脚步与法杖的回音一路攀上高高的穹顶。光团如露珠般悬浮，随时准备引领学生穿过迷宫般的通道，去往拱形窗光线触及不到的幽暗处。这些哥特式长廊里，又藏着怎样的秘密，等待好奇者……或不可救药之人去揭开？
The unique tinge of magic laces the air. Bookcases line the looming walls, and books shudder within their confines like anxious birds waiting to take flight. The susurrus of paper being rifled through rustles from every study. This school is the harbor, the respite, the crucible where magic users may hone their skills with masters of every magical discipline—even the odd and the obscure. The faces of the students range from bright-eyed, beaming newcomers to stormy-eyed seniors. Books fly in and out of their cases when summoned. Glittering clouds carry masters and pupils from one floor to the next, the sound of footfall and staff echoing up to the lofty ceilings as they step onto their desired landing. Globules of light hover, ready to guide students through labyrinthine pathways, where the light of the arched windows cannot reach. What secrets might these gothic halls hold for the curious… or the incorrigible?

Obvious Enhanced Leg.name:
显眼的强化腿
Obvious Enhanced Leg

Text.text:
有些义体增强追求隐蔽，力图看起来浑然天成。但设计这条腿的人显然走了彻底相反的路数。脚部是个圆环，中心伸出数根突起用来维持平衡。粗大的铆钉与焊接痕迹沿着整条肢体一路延伸，靠近胫骨的一段甚至是透明的，让人能直接窥见内部盘绕的电线与电子元件。
Some cybernetic enhancements aim for subtlety, a natural look. Whoever designed this leg went in the absolute opposite direction. The foot is a circle, with several extrusions for balance jutting from the center. Obvious rivets and welding marks run the length of the limb, and a section near the shin is even transparent, offering a look at the wires and electronics inside.

Brass Dragon Wyrmling.name:
黄铜幼龙
Brass Dragon Wyrmling

Text.text:
覆着薄膜的鳍翼自这头龙类生物的颈侧舒展开来，赤红的黄铜鳞片在阳光下熠熠生辉。它的体型约莫一只大型犬那么大，这头爬行兽以一种诡异而摄人的优雅游移，从远处以狡黠又好奇的目光打量着你。它翼膜沿着尾部一路垂落，仿佛披着长袍的人影。
Webbed fins unfurl from the neck of the draconic creature whose ruddy brass scales catch the light of the sun brilliantly. Roughly the size of a large dog, the reptilian beast moves with a strange and alluring grace, watching you from a distance with eyes cunning and curious. The membrane of its wings extends down the length of its tail, giving the appearance of a robed figure.

Quip About Ignoring Fear.name:
对无视恐惧的俏皮话
Quip About Ignoring Fear

Text.text:
“我或许害怕明天会带来什么，但我也怕小鱼、巨响，以及长得像我母亲的人，所以也许恐惧并不是一种值得追随的可靠情绪。”
“I may be terrified of what tomorrow will bring, but I’m also afraid of small fish, loud noises, and people who look like my mother, so perhaps fear is not a reliable emotion to follow.”

Sorcerer's Refuge.name:
术士的庇护所
Sorcerer's Refuge

Text.text:
空间的石质地面上刻着一道深深的符文圆阵。各色晶体自地面、墙壁与天花板破土而出，散发出诡异而超现实的光辉，为这间原本昏暗的密室披上一层异样的亮色。这里处处留着一位尚未完全掌控自身魔法之人的痕迹：焦黑的灼痕撕裂墙面，部分石材像蜡般融化流淌。
A deep runic circle is etched in the stone floor of the space. Crystals of every luminous shade emerge from the floor, walls, and ceiling, providing a strange and surreal light to the otherwise dim chamber. The room carries the markings of one not quite in control of their magic: scorch marks mar the walls and portions of the stone appear melted like wax.

你从指尖轻弹而出的圣水四散飞溅，化作点点闪光，逆着风飘向你所守护的人。你赐下的祝福如金色斗篷般落在他们肩头，随即悄然消隐。
The holy water you flick from your fingers scatters into sparkling light that drifts against the wind toward those you protect. The blessing you grant settles about their shoulders like golden cloaks before vanishing.

I Shave With A Knife.name:
我用刀刮胡子
I Shave With A Knife

Text.text:
冰冷的钢刃贴着我的脸颊刮过，我娴熟地引导刀锋在脸上游走。嘴角掠过一丝幽灵（特征）般的笑意，我看见我的伙伴屏息凝神，目不转睛地盯着我的每一个动作，等着我露出破绽。只要一步走错，我就可能失去一只眼，或把喉咙划开——但这正是乐趣所在。
The cold steel scrapes against my cheek as I expertly guide the blade across my face. The ghost of a smile passes my lips as I see my companions watching my every move with bated breath, waiting for me to make a mistake. One wrong move and I could lose an eye or open my throat—but that’s the fun part.

Stone Bridge In Freezing Weather.name:
严寒天气中的石桥
Stone Bridge In Freezing Weather

Text.text:
霜雪覆满整座结构，桥身由粗凿石块垒成，在微弱的日光下泛着冷亮的光泽。桥面铺石看上去险恶无比，卵石般圆润的形状被一层冰壳紧紧裹住。几缕草叶从灰浆的裂缝里倔强钻出，在冬日的箍握中几乎凝成晶体。
Frost coats the whole structure, and the rough-cut blocks forming the bridge glisten in the feeble sunlight. The cobbles of the walkway look treacherous, their egg-like forms sheathed in ice. Strands of grass push through cracks in the mortar, almost crystalline in winter's grasp.

Sundries From A Night Hag.name:
鬼婆（特征）的杂物
Sundries From A Night Hag

Text.text:
那恐怖之物终于倒下，死了，沉默了，可她那刺耳的狂笑尖啸仍在你耳畔回荡。你凝视着尸体：纠结成团的脏乱头发，裹着污秽的袍子。她腰带上的头骨，眼窝里曾燃着某种邪秽能量，如今又褪成一汪汪黑暗。它们在接触下脆弱不堪，被接触时空洞作响，下颌骨松垮垂着，仿佛也在以它们自己的方式发出讥诮的笑。她脖颈上挂着一串人类指甲，贴着胸前摇晃。每一枚指甲下方，她那结痂的胸口都凹着细小的印痕，仿佛这些污秽的护符曾试图抓挠她，惩她作恶。
The horror falls, finally dead and silent, though the piercing shriek of her cackle still rings in your ears. You observe the body, a tangle of matted hair and filthy robes. The skulls on her belt, eye sockets once alight with some foul energy, have faded to pools of darkness once more. They are fragile to the touch and rattle empty as they are touched, jawbones lolling in their own kind of scornful laughter. Around her neck, a necklace of human fingernails hangs against her chest. Small indentations lie underneath each nail on her scabbed-over chest, as if these foul charms had sought to claw at her for her evil deeds.

Inhalation Of Burnt Othur Fumes.name:
吸入烧焦的奥瑟烟雾
Inhalation Of Burnt Othur Fumes

Text.text:
一层褐色的薄雾猛扑向你的感官，像尖锐之物般刮过喉咙深处，逼得你眼眶泛泪。你尽量屏住呼吸，却仍在空气里尝到了它——苦涩、灼烧的滋味。接着是那股气味……像臭鼬一样鲜明刺鼻，同样独一无二。
A brown haze assaults your senses, striking the back of your throat like something sharp and making your eyes water. You taste it on the air even as you try not to breathe—a bitter and burning flavor. Then the smell… as distinctive and repellant as a skunk, and just as unique.

Dirindi Fabulist.name:
狄林迪寓言家
Dirindi Fabulist

Text.text:
一个敦实的三眼类人生物低低地咯咯发笑，像是在自娱自乐。橡胶般的灰色皮肤覆满全身，偶尔随着电流的噼啪窜动而微微震颤。它穿着一套黄色飞行服，背上装着喷气背包，懒散地向后倚在近旁的墙上，仰头为某个陈旧、半记半忘的笑话放声大笑。三根手指的手掌兴奋地拍打着自己的胸口。
A stout humanoid with three eyes chuckles lowly to themself. Rubbery gray skin covers their entire body, occasionally vibrating with the zap of electricity. Dressed in a yellow flight suit outfitted with a jetpack, they slouch backwards against a nearby wall, throwing their head back with a raucous laugh at some old half-remembered joke. Three-fingered hands beat against their chest enthusiastically.

Druidic Grove With Banquet For Heroes.name:
为英雄设宴的德鲁伊圣林
Druidic Grove With Banquet For Heroes

Text.text:
当你走近林间小径里的公园时，一道树篱先是微微战栗，继而簌簌抖动，随后从中央分开，露出一片林地：空气里甜润得发腻，玫瑰、薰衣草、绣球与百合的香气层层叠叠。藤蔓在树冠间懒洋洋地摇摆，柔和的绿光如萤般在空中漂浮游弋。一棵粗壮的大树竟自行移动，先把几人吓了一跳，随即伸出一根困惑般灰白相间的枝桠，示意替他们接过外套或行囊。另有三棵树在这宏伟的天然广场上踱步，献上花朵、提供协助与饮品——那些木杯显然被德鲁伊的魔法塑形，有的扭曲成莲花般的姿态。再往厅室深处，一张桌子伫立其间，仿佛是树木自行生长、硬生生长成了那样的形状。

~ Envisioned by Crimson Coffin

As you approach the park in the grove, a hedgerow quivers, then shakes, then parts in the middle, revealing a forest sweet with the scent of roses, lavender, hydrangea, and lilies. Vines swing lazily among the treetops, and soft green lights drift about the air. A strong tree moves, startling a few before offering a branch of puzzled gray and white to take their coat or bags. Three other trees walk about this grand natural plaza, offering flowers, assistance, and beverages in cups of wood obviously shaped by druidic magic, some twisted like lotus flowers. Further into the chamber stands a table that looks as if a tree grew itself into that shape.

~ Envisioned by Crimson Coffin

Permanent Iv Implant.name:
永久性静脉植入物
Permanent Iv Implant

Text.text:
静脉输注植入体从此人肘窝处的皮肤里凸出，外覆金属套壳。它被改装成可快速注入生理盐水的型号，在植入体与皮肤交界处装了一个小型真空装置。多面式接入插口可扩张，以适配不同型号的医疗包静脉管。看起来装得相当草率——手术部位周围布满厚重的疤痕。
The IV implant protrudes from the person’s skin in metallic casing at the crook of the elbow. It’s been modified for rapid saline insertion, a small vacuum installed at the point where the implant meets the skin. A multifaceted entry jack allows for widening to fit different models of medpack IV. It looks like it’s been installed without care; there’s heavy scarring all around the surgical site.

High Seas Battle: Boarding.name:
公海战斗：登船接舷战
High Seas Battle: Boarding

Text.text:
船只并肩在水面上狂飙，时而颠簸得近到水手敢于纵身一跃跳到对面。有人抓着绳索荡过去，有人踏着搭在险恶缝隙上的跳板冲过。浓烟与尖叫充塞空中，双方船员终于短兵相接。
The ships race through the water together, pitching close enough at times for sailors to attempt a leap across. Others swing on ropes or run over gangplanks laid across the perilous gap. Smoke and screaming fill the air as the crews come to grips.

Sundries From An Owlbear.name:
来自枭熊的杂货
Sundries From An Owlbear

Text.text:
这头巨大的生物张着黄色的喙，黏稠的涎水与鲜血拉成一缕缕往下滴落，在地上汇成一滩胶黏的污池。它的皮毛布满孔洞与深深的斩痕，血肉横飞，把羽毛糊得一塌糊涂。为放倒这般凶残强敌所付出的艰苦鏖战痕迹尽显无遗，却也不幸抹去了这场冒险本可榨取的所有价值。
The massive creature’s yellow beak hangs open, strings of drool and blood dripping from it and collecting in a sticky pool on the ground. Their pelt is riddled with holes and slashes, gore making a mess of the feathers. The signs of the arduous battle necessary to take down such a fearsome foe also unfortunately take away any value that may have been reaped from the endeavor.

Highway Express Hauler.name:
公路极速货运车
Highway Express Hauler

Text.text:
这台骇人的重载无人运输车如同利维坦般盘踞在交通大动脉上。引擎咆哮，宛若远古巨兽的怒吼；它以不可阻挡之势前行，巨大的车轮轻易吞噬岩砼公路，逼得周围的小型载具纷纷急避让道。它那臃肿的货舱足以运载整座居住区模块、军用载具，或以超吨计的关键物资与资源，并将其送抵行星最遥远的边陲。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The monstrous haulage drone is a leviathan dominating the arterial express. Engines roaring like a titanic beast, it is an unstoppable force as enormous wheels eat up the rockcrete highway with ease—causing smaller vehicles to dodge out of the way. Its bloated cargo holds are capable of transporting entire hab blocks, military vehicles, or ultra-tons of essential supplies and resources, and delivering them to far-flung corners of the planet.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Investigate Strange Mushrooms.name:
我调查诡异的蘑菇
I Investigate Strange Mushrooms

Text.text:
蘑菇能长成的奇形妙状，似乎永无止境。然而这些标本，仍是我所见过最为离奇的一类。粗壮的白色菌柄顶着皱褶的菌盖，颜色像糖果般铺陈开来——黄、绿、紫、蓝。那些褶纹带着一层霜白的质感，仿佛裹着细砂糖。正当我俯身细看，一股宛如黄油与香草的怡人香气悄然拂过鼻尖。
There seems to be no limit to the odd and wonderful forms mushrooms may take. These specimens, though, are one of the strangest I’ve encountered. Stout, white stalks bear wrinkled caps in an array of candy-like colors—yellow, green, purple, blue. The folds have a frosted texture, like they’re covered in sugar. As I inspect them, a pleasant aroma like butter and vanilla wafts under my nose.

I Cast Tattletale.name:
我施放“告密者”
I Cast Tattletale

Text.text:
这股嗡鸣一定就像拳台上的裁判贴身挤进两名拳手之间时的那种感觉。我正把两个系统硬生生对撞在一起。一个是蓝莹莹的数字妖精少女，用阴毒又细小的嗓音撒着娇；另一个则是现场安保系统——马上就要明白，我那可怜、毫不知情的目标，已经成了全民公敌numero uno！把她逗得去指向那段ID代码补丁，仿佛我的目标就站在那儿，替人背锅，实在太好玩了。然后被“画像”。

~ 由一位英雄 设想

This buzz must be like what a referee in the ring feels, getting right between two fighters. I’m pitting two systems against each other. One is the blue digital rizzy of a girl whining in a wicked little voice, and the other is the onsite security system about to learn that my poor, unwitting target is public enemy numero uno! It’s fun making her point at the patch of ID code, as if my target were standing right there, getting blamed. And then profiled.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Hermetic Mage And Wiccan Witch Discuss M.name:
赫密斯秘法师与威卡女巫探讨魔法
Hermetic Mage And Wiccan Witch Discuss Magic

Text.text:
“魔法不过是一道方程，是对物质本质的编序。世界是一把锁，只要配对正确的词句与方法，一切皆有可能。”

“我们所栖身的世界，表象之下确实深藏万物，可我不懂你怎能如此冷眼旁观。你用尽一生，单调地拼凑最粗浅的仪式；而真正的魔法之力，正如洪流般在你狭窄视野之外奔涌。去感受大地的心跳，并将其据为己有——这不只是傲慢，更是危险。”

“不，我这没洗干净的朋友，‘危险’是你把毒蘑菇塞得满嘴，醉醺醺地在林子里乱跑，还宣称那就是个法术。”

“好吧，也许你真试一次，就没那么乏味了。我不敢说懂得宇宙所有秘密，但至少我知道怎么尽兴。”

~ 由一位英雄构想

“Magic is nothing more than an equation, an ordering of the material essence. The world is a lock, and with the right combination of phrases and methods everything becomes possible.”

“This world we live in does hold much beneath its surface, but I don’t understand how you can view it so coldly. You spend your whole life monotonously piecing together the most rudimentary rituals, while the forces of true magic stream in torrents just outside your narrow view. To feel the heartbeat of the earth and claim it as your own isn’t just arrogant, it’s dangerous.”

“No, my unwashed friend, ‘dangerous’ is gorging yourself on poisonous mushrooms, running around the woods in a stupor, and claiming it’s a spell.”

“Well, perhaps if you tried it, you’d be less dull. I don’t claim to know all the secrets of the universe but at least I know how to have a good time.”

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Ritual Summoning Of A Dark Power.name:
黑暗力量召唤仪式
Ritual Summoning Of A Dark Power

Text.text:
亵渎的字句带着犹疑从你唇间滑落。蛛网般的咒语在你周围回响，化作上百道不同的声音——其中只有一部分属于凡人。你身边的阴影愈发浓重；蜡烛与火把先是摇曳、噼啪作响，随即在一阵冰冷、恶臭的风掠过后尽数熄灭。片刻间，一切凝滞无声、死寂如坟。随后，一道刺耳的尖啸从静默中升起，音量不断攀升，最终化作高亢而尖厉的惨叫。你面前浮现出一团闪烁的微光，血红与墨黑交织，逐渐凝聚成一枚椭圆的球体，继而膨胀，吞没整个区域，最终定形为一道门扉，边缘镶着发光的亵渎符文。裂隙内的黑暗中，有些形影在蠕动翻卷。

~ 由 John Requested

The unholy words leave your lips with hesitance. The spidery incantation echoes around you in a hundred different voices—only some of them mortal. The shadows deepen around you; the candles and torches flicker, sputter, then die in the wake of a frigid, foul-smelling wind. For a moment, all lies still, silent. Then, a piercing whine rises amid the quiet, growing in volume until it becomes a scream, high and shrill. A flickering glow, blood-red and inky black, appears before you, coalescing into an oblong sphere and then growing to encompass the entirety of the area, finally forming a doorway ringed with glowing, profane runes. Shapes writhe in the darkness within this rift.

~ Requested by John

I Cast Clairvoyance For Hearing.name:
我施放【千里眼】（听觉）
I Cast Clairvoyance For Hearing

Text.text:
或许有人以为我半聋——因为我肩上斜挂着一支镶宝石的听音号角，像件古怪的乐器。我对着它的号口低声说出某个地方的名字，再说出那地方里我的法术将替我倾听的具体位置。我能看见它，能感到它就在远方：一颗小小的蓝色光球黯然发亮，从遥远处贴着我的耳畔轻声呢喃。
Perhaps some think me partly deaf because of the jeweled hearing horn I wear slung like a strange instrument. I speak into its bell the name of a place, the spot in that place where my spell will listen for me. I can picture it, feel it out there, a small blue orb glowing dully and whispering into my ear from far away.

Athena Promechos Speaks.name:
雅典娜·普罗玛科斯开口说话
Athena Promechos Speaks

Text.text:
由星尘微粒凝成的化身——一位由无数细小燃烧星辰铸就的女神——缓缓屈膝跪下，震颤自废墟深处回荡开来，顺着地面爬上你的脚底，激得你一阵战栗。一道如雷霆般的嗓音自她的面容倾泻而出，用希腊语说话。随着每一个轰鸣的音节，她的五官愈发清晰、愈发逼近现实；一条分叉的舌头从虚渺的齿间蜿蜒探出。而那双严厉而狂野的猫头鹰之眼在你面前燃起太阳般的金黄。
The avatar made of motes—a goddess made of tiny burning stars—kneels down, sending a reverberation through the ruin that sends shivers through your feet. A thunderous voice, speaking in Greek, pours from her visage. The features of her face become more prominent with each rumbling syllable. A forked tongue slithers out from between ethereal teeth. And her stern, wild owl’s eyes blaze sun-yellow before you.

锯开的木材散发出干燥的气息涌入鼻腔，取代了路旁那股不太悦人的味道。你在外头听见的声响此刻充满耳畔：锤击、锯割、敲打。整座建筑里，年轻的学徒们正忙于各自的木工作业。你环顾四周寻找他们的师傅，却不见其人，仿佛并不在场。
The dry scent of sawn wood fills your nose, replacing the less pleasant odor of the roadway. The noises you heard from outside fill your ears: hammering, sawing, and pounding. All about this building, young apprentices work on woodworking projects. You look about for their master, but he or she is not readily apparent.

Quip About Adventuring For The Wrong Rea.name:
因动机不纯而踏上冒险的俏皮话
Quip About Adventuring For The Wrong Reasons

Text.text:
“神祇、恶魔、怪物……说实话，我只是想混点名声，再多赚些金币，好在酒馆里花个痛快。不过看来想要一样，就躲不开另一样。”
“Gods, demons, monsters… Truthfully, I just got into this for a bit of fame and some extra gold to spend at the taverns. I suppose I won’t get one without the other, though.”

Loot From Black Flies' Prey.name:
黑蝇猎物的战利品
Loot From Black Flies' Prey

Text.text:
黑蝇正围着一具人形尸体嗡嗡盘旋，但它已被贪婪啃食的虫群糟蹋得不成样子——嚼烂的血肉翻卷剥落，白骨与鲜红的内脏裸露在外。死者的随身物品却分毫未动：一只镂丝精美的银质香炉，配着四炷线香；还有一只钱袋，叮当作响，里面装着二十枚金币。
The black flies had been swarming a carcass, humanoid in shape, though badly disfigured by the feasting insects—bone and bright red viscera exposed by masticated flesh. The victim’s effects remain untouched: a beautifully filigreed silver censer with four sticks of incense, and a purse jangling with twenty gold pieces.

这间狭长、霉味缭绕的办公室背面挑高甚高，容得下高窗一排。凿刻成形的木柱撑起拱起的石质穹顶，其间垂着一盏铁制枝形吊灯。花岗岩墙面一圈皆是塞满书籍的书架。高窗前方稍前处，一座抬高的平台上摆着一张雕工繁复的书桌与一把高背椅。平台两侧各立着一把小椅子，坐垫磨得见了线头。这里的木头——从地板到家具——全都亟待重新打磨上漆。

~ 构想：Steve Adamski

A high ceiling accommodates tall windows at the back of this narrow, musty office. Chiseled wooden pillars hold up the vaulted stone ceiling, an iron chandelier dangling amid them. Book-filled shelves line the granite walls. An elaborately carved desk and high-backed chair sit on a raised platform just in front of the windows. To the sides of the platform stand two small chairs, their cushions threadbare. All the wood here, floorboards to furniture, needs refinishing.

~ Envisioned by Steve Adamski

一条漆黑的猎犬昂首而立，耳朵竖起，警惕地捕捉着四周的声响。它肩高约三英尺，体格魁梧，血统显得格外出众。若非它在现实空间中忽明忽暗、时隐时现，几乎会被误认为名贵纯种。深色皮毛之下，幽蓝的能量噼啪翻涌，脉动与嗡鸣宛如体内引擎。它偏了偏头，短短一瞬后，便在几英尺外重新现身。
A dark hunting dog stands proud, its ears pricked to scan the surrounding noise. Standing around three feet tall, it seems an impressive breed. It could be mistaken for a pedigree, were it not flickering in and out of realspace. Beneath the dark fur, a blue fizz of energy pulses and whirs, akin to an internal engine. It turns its head and, a brief moment later, reappears a few feet away.

Historical Archives And Vestibule.name:
历史档案室与前厅
Historical Archives And Vestibule

Text.text:
与大多数学院不同，这所学院最容易获得许可进入的房间是它的档案馆。前厅是一个蛋形空间，像一座壁炉般向上张开，穹顶高达一百英尺，紧挨着主入口以西那座巨大的圆形门厅。凡想从档案馆调取材料的人，都会踏入一间密室：其中一面弧形墙上，层层架子摆满成千上万枚小小的球体。其余墙面则完全由石制书架构成，配有梯子与栈道，顺着多层楼面蜿蜒而上。
Unlike most schools, the Academy’s most accessible room is its archives. The vestibule is an egg-shaped space that resembles a fireplace with a hundred-foot ceiling, right off the gigantic circular foyer west of the main entrance. Here, anyone wishing to access materials from the archives steps into a chamber with one curved wall of thousands of small orbs on shelves. The rest of the walls are entirely made of stone bookshelves, fit with ladders and walkways for its many floors.

Winter Tournament Crowd.name:
冬季锦标赛人群
Winter Tournament Crowd

Text.text:
尽管寒意刺骨，呼出的气息在冰冷空气中化作一团团白雾，裹着皮毛的人群仍朝着在点点积雪的沙地上厮杀的斗士高声呐喊助威。钢铁的铿锵也许被压得沉闷，热烈的掌声也因连指手套或手套而略显含糊，看台或许只坐了半数，但人群依旧坚守——对那让耳朵麻木的寒风嗤之以鼻。
Despite the cold, and breath white in the frigid air, the fur-wrapped masses shout encouragement to the combatants battling across snow-dappled sands. The ringing of the steel may be muted, the energetic applause slightly muffled by mittens or gloves, and the stands may be half empty, but the crowd endures—contemptuous of the wind numbing their ears.

Goddess Of Magic.name:
魔法女神
Goddess Of Magic

Text.text:
她黑发如夜，肤色白皙，五官却难以界定——像人类，像精灵，甚至像亡灵。她的眼眸盛着深邃的智慧，可她的年代却让你无法捉摸；长袍以法术缝织而成，布料如导体般引流万般魔法的脉冲。她不携任何物品或武器，也无法术材料袋与钱囊。她周身萦绕着纯粹的惑魅气息，开口便能吐出奥秘诸学派的全部词典与咒语之语。
She is dark haired and fair skinned, with features difficult to define. Perhaps human, elvish, even undead. Her eyes are full of wisdom although her age eludes you, and her robes are spell-sewn fabrics that conduct the current of all magics. She carries no items or weapons, no spell component pouches or purses. Hers is an aura of pure enchantment, and she speaks the lexicons of every school of the arcana.

暴风雨毫不留情。闪电乍现，将自身的余影烙进你的眼底；紧随其后，是一声炸裂的雷鸣。倾盆大雨把街道灌成河流，冷酷的狂风骤雨抽打着建筑，震得它们哀鸣不止。
The storm is relentless. Lightning flashes, embossing echoes of itself in your eyes. A crash of thunder follows. Streets turn to rivers in the downpour, and buildings are battered by the unforgiving squalls.

这块巨大的巨石如岩石哨兵般高高矗立在周遭区域之上，气势逼人。岁月与风霜的侵蚀在它的表面刻下独一无二的风化纹理，仿佛自有一段只属于它的故事。
Towering over the surrounding area like a rocky sentinel, this large boulder is an imposing sight. Time and exposure to the elements have left it with a uniquely weathered surface telling a story all its own.

在城市的河港与威肯桥之间，是一座宽阔而秀丽的公园：修剪整齐的草坪一望无际，设有掷马蹄铁沙坑、地滚球场地，以及供人野餐的遮蔽棚。到了夜里，波特绿地的南段会显得有些混乱：沿河讨生活的跑船人和酒吧常客——往往醉醺醺的——闲得发慌。通常顶多也就是打上一场群架，而尖塔巫河的河卫队也同样是一群硬茬。
Between the city’s river harbor and the Wickenbridge is a large and pretty park of mown grass containing horseshoe pits, bocce courts, and a shelter for picnics. At night the south part of Porter Green can get a bit rough, with river-runners and barflies—often drunk—who have time on their hands. A brawl is usually as bad as things get, and the Spirewych Riverguard are a tough bunch themselves.

Divine Manor Of A God Of Treachery.name:
诡诈之神的神圣庄园
Divine Manor Of A God Of Treachery

Text.text:
宅邸大门洞开，通向一座恢弘的前厅：黑白棋盘格地面延展其间，两侧侍立着笑容可掬的仆役。精美绝伦的石作、修长而雅致的高窗，以及一片崭新的翡翠瓦屋顶静候来客。正门前的花园修剪得一丝不苟，繁花灌木盛放，浓荫乔木成行，花卉点缀其间，明艳夺目。可一踏入室内，每个房间都空无一物。每一道楼梯不是踏碎塌断，便是触发机关陷阱。宅邸后方的庭园却枯槁凋败，枯死的树上兀鹫栖伏，蛛网间蜘蛛潜行。每一株鲜艳的植株底下，都蜷伏着一条剧毒蛇。
The manor doors stand open to a grand foyer with a checkerboard floor flanked with welcoming servants. Remarkable stonework, tall and elegant windows, and a new roof of jade tile await. The front garden is brilliantly manicured with blooming bushes, shade trees, and flowers. Inside, every room is empty. Every stair either breaks or sets off a trap. The garden behind the manor is withered, with vultures perched in dead trees, spiders in webs. Under every colorful plant hides a poisonous snake.

A Tenday Of Travel By Foot On Road Throu.name:
沿着道路徒步旅行十日，时节转入寒冬
A Tenday Of Travel By Foot On Road Through A Change To Winter

Text.text:
你的呼吸在潮湿的空气里凝成白雾，你凝视着前方的路。大地已然天翻地覆：曾经色彩浓烈的秋林，正褪成一片荒寒的广袤原野，向远处延展数里。你越是旅行，越能看见季节刺骨的寒意如何一点点夺走这片土地——新落的积雪更让脚下变得险滑难行。最初的三天里，天气一日比一日凶狠；一场狂暴的暴风雪逼得你钻进一处小洞穴躲避，蜷缩在一簇孱弱的火光旁熬过整整一天，只为让自己不被冻透。风暴终于退去，你再度上路，硬着头皮踏回那条冰冷的道路，途中还曾为躲避雾中某个庞然大物的沉重步伐而匆匆藏身。尽管环境严酷，数日之后，你却被霜雪大地那份细腻的巧工所触动，竟开始懂得欣赏这一季的冷冽之美。第十天的傍晚，你拖着疲惫的步子下到一段陡坡，每一步都把你带向坡下那座小村落里令人心安的暖光。
Your breath mists in the damp air as you survey the path ahead. The landscape has undergone a dramatic change: the vivid autumnal forests transforming into a bleak vastness stretching onward for leagues. The further you travel, the more of the region the biting cold of the season claims—with the fresh snowfall making the going treacherous. Over the first three days, the weather grew steadily more severe, a fierce blizzard forcing you to seek refuge in a small cave and spend a day huddled beside a weak fire in an attempt to keep yourself warm. When the storm finally abates you push on, braving the road again, once taking shelter from something huge striding through the fog. Despite the harsh conditions, several days later you find yourself inspired by the delicate artistry of the frosty landscape and begin to appreciate the beauty of the season. The evening of the tenth day you trudge down a steep hill, each step bringing you closer to the welcome glow of a hamlet below.

一排排被墨渍染黑的书桌整齐列队，面向讲台；讲台后方立着一块巨大的石板，架在支座上充作黑板。有人用颤抖不稳的手把字母表涂写在石板上，呈下坠的弧线，仿佛每写一个字母就更沉重几分。每张书桌上或旁边都散落着小石板和粉笔碎屑，有些石板上歪歪扭扭地写着几行字母。
Ink-stained desks stand in tidy rows facing a lectern, behind which a large piece of slate in a stand serves as chalkboard. An unsteady hand has scrawled the alphabet across the slate in a descending arc, as if each letter got heavier. Slates and chips of chalk lie on or near each desk, some with poorly written letters on them.

I Cast Eldritch Blast.name:
我施放【魔能爆】
I Cast Eldritch Blast

Text.text:
诡异的异界能量弧在我指尖间噼啪跃动，我呼唤着我的宗主赐下的力量。四肢上的汗毛根根竖起，嗡鸣的静电充塞空气——耳中随之涌起越来越沉的压迫感。待其攀至顶点，我死死锁定我的目标，轰然释放这道冲击。
Arcs of eldritch energy crackle between my fingers as I call forth the power of my Patron. The hairs on my limbs stand up, and buzzing static fills the air—causing pressure to build in my ears. At its apex I lock my gaze onto my target and unleash the blast.

对所有身处你法术效果区域内的人而言，你手掌一挥便成了他们所见的最后景象，随即便被完美的黑暗彻底吞没。
For those within your spell’s area of effect, a wave of your hand is the last thing they see before they are covered in perfect darkness.

Healer's Kit.name:
治疗者工具包
Healer's Kit

Text.text:
这只盒状皮包以硬皮制成，可折开展开。内里排布着环扣与分隔，整齐收纳着各式工具与补给。一组小袋里装着酒精小瓶与药膏；另一处更大的隔层则塞着压紧的亚麻绷带团和一卷缝合线。刀具、镊子与小钳各归其位，另有数枚针固定在另一面上。
Made of hard leather, this boxlike bag folds open. Within are loops and compartments holding a variety of tools and supplies. One set of pouches holds vials of alcohol and salves. Another larger section holds a compressed wad of linen bandages and a coil of sutures. Knives, tweezers, and small pliers all have homes, and several needles are fastened to another surface.

翼兔堪称隐秘界域的真正生物，是兔与蝶诡异而新奇的混合体。虹彩双翼自碧蓝绒毛间舒展而出，宛如炫目光瀑；它在移动时色泽仿佛随之流转，蓝、紫、绿的万千层次尽收其身。可一旦它开始在近旁花朵上取食，便立刻不再讨喜——原本该是舌头的位置，竟会舒展开一根细长的口器。
Truly a creature of the hidden realm, the winged rabbit is a curious mixture of bunny and butterfly. Iridescent wings sprout from turquoise fur in a dazzling display, and the creature’s color seems to shift as it moves, encapsulating every shade of blue, purple, and green imaginable. It becomes decidedly less charming when it feeds from a nearby flower however—a long proboscis unfurls in place of a tongue.

Pain Inflicted On Fey Creatures With The.name:
以铁之接触施加于妖精生物的痛楚
Pain Inflicted On Fey Creatures With The Touch Of Iron

Text.text:
那妖精生物在你的武器接触下猛然后退——血肉在触点处嘶嘶作响，鼓起骇人的水泡。它脖颈的血管暴突，发出夹杂痛楚与狂怒的尖啸。它的脸阴沉得如同幽灵，死死盯住你，彻底漆黑的双眼里翻涌着嗜血的杀意。
The fey creature recoils at the touch of your weapon—flesh hissing and blistering at the point of contact. The veins in their neck protrude as they scream in pain and fury. Their face, grim as a ghost, locks onto you, bloodlust simmering in now totally black eyes.

Holy Pirate City.name:
圣盗之城
Holy Pirate City

Text.text:
虔信者怀抱着溢满金灿金子、珠宝与无价珍藏的宝箱，朝着城心那艘倒扣的船只行去。这处盗贼与杀手的巢穴以罗盘之轮般环列排布；凡踏上骷髅骨路者皆奉其为圣地，在此不得见血。海盗女神立于翻覆船舰的船首，俯瞰追随者；凡以供品取悦她者，皆得她降下祝福。

~ 构想：Dom Perignome

Carrying chests overflowing with gold, jewels, and priceless treasures, the faithful make their way to the inverted ship at the center of the city. Arranged in a compass wheel, this den of thieves and cutthroats is held sacred by all who walk the path of crossbones, and no blood may be shed here. The goddess of piracy looks upon her followers from the bow of the overturned vessel, granting blessings to those who please her with their offering.

~ Envisioned by Dom Perignome

Old Person Meditating.name:
冥想中的老人
Old Person Meditating

Text.text:
老人站着，脑袋后仰、双眼紧闭，姿态松弛得让你以为他可能站着就睡着了。可紧接着他抬起双臂，双手在空气中缓缓游移。依旧不睁眼，他从喉间发出低沉而绵长的嗡鸣声，动作也随之继续，慢慢地比划着。
The old man stands with head lolled back and eyes closed in such a relaxed posture that you think he may have fallen asleep standing up. But then he lifts his arms, and his hands drift through the air. Still without opening his eyes, he utters a deep and continuous hum as he continues slowly gesticulating.

Haggling Line About Abominations.name:
关于憎恶之物的讨价还价台词
Haggling Line About Abominations

Text.text:
“我曾直面那些光是看上一眼就足以让你恶心作呕、发狂失智的憎恶之物，可我从未见过比这些价钱更骇人听闻的东西。”
“I’ve faced abominations whose mere sight would drive you into fits of nausea and madness, but I have never encountered anything as atrocious as these prices.”

Short Descriptions Of Five Tavern Patron.name:
五名酒馆常客的简短描写
Short Descriptions Of Five Tavern Patrons

Text.text:
一名披着毛皮的蜥蜴人啜饮着一杯热气腾腾、气味浓烈的茶，爬行动物般的眼睛在其他客人间来回扫视。一名戴着宽檐紫帽的矮人调着小提琴，准备一开口就唱起来。一名人类一只手戴着古怪的黑色护臂，独自坐着，却不断瞥向门口，像是在等什么人。一对精灵挨得很近，正俯视着面前摊开的巨大古籍，彼此用自己的语言低声说话。一个披袍的人走进来，放下兜帽，深吸一口带香的空气，露出微笑。其身后跟着一个古怪的、孩子般的构造体，似由石头构成却出奇地神情丰富，踏入屋内时谨慎地环顾四周，投来戒备的目光。
A lizardfolk garbed in furs sips a steaming cup of a strong-smelling tea, their reptilian eyes scanning the other patrons. A dwarf with a wide-brimmed purple hat tunes a fiddle and prepares to break into song. A human with a strange black gauntlet on one hand is alone but keeps glancing toward the door, as if expecting someone. A pair of elves sit close, both looking over a massive tome laid open before them, speaking quietly in their own tongue. A robed figure enters and lowers their cowl, taking a deep breath of the fragrant air and smiling. Behind them follows a strange, childlike construct, seemingly made of stone but surprisingly expressive as it enters and casts a wary gaze about.

Sundries From A Hill Giant.name:
来自山丘巨人的杂物
Sundries From A Hill Giant

Text.text:
一面兽人战锣，青铜铸就却已裂开，正躺在一只粗糙皮袋的残骸里；旁边还塞着一个硕大——所幸空空如也——的马蜂巢。
An orcish gong, bronze and cracked, sits in the remains of a rough hide bag, along with a large—and fortunately empty—hornet’s nest.

空气沁冷，你查看储藏室时，呼吸在面前轻轻凝成薄雾。干燥的香草与腌熏好的肉条悬挂在宽敞房间上方，俯瞰着一片箱子、木桶与板条箱的海洋。这里简直是一座食物与美酒的巨龙宝藏——食材虽朴素，可若落在手艺精湛的厨师手里？便能化作数不清的珍馐美味。
The air is chilled and your breath mists gently before you as you inspect the pantry. Dried herbs and cured cuts of meat hang over a sea of boxes, barrels, and crates in the large room. A veritable dragon’s hoard of food and drink—simple ingredients, but in the hands of a skilled chef? Innumerable delicacies.

Create Or Destroy Water.name:
造水或毁水
Create Or Destroy Water

Text.text:
你低声咕哝着法术的词句，轻轻吐出那些黏涎的太初音节——借用水元素精魂所说的语言。唾沫从你唇边飞溅，悬停在你面前的空气中，等待最后一个手势来命令它坠落、四散喷开，或倒卷回你的口中——这微缩的一瞬，将由魔法在更宏大的尺度上投映到世界里。
You mutter the words of the spell, quietly spitting the slobbery Primordial syllables that draw upon the language water elementals speak. Spittle flecks from your lips and hovers in the air before your face, awaiting the final gesture that will tell it to fall, spray apart, or draw back into your mouth—an action in miniature that magic will reflect in the world on a grander scale.

Archivist Of The Net.name:
网之档案官
Archivist Of The Net

Text.text:
自以太的阴影中，一道以奉献受洗的身影浮现：档案管理员——专注本身的化身。这位炽烈的策展者以使命为盾，守护着在网络中翻涌不息的无尽数据碎片。从非法的巨型企业审计，到最寻常不过的程序，没有任何事物能逃过他警醒的目光。作为数字的神化之形，他将信息编织成牢不可破的纹理。凭借坚定的意志，他如勤勉的哨兵般守望无垠，永远忠于自己的职责。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

From etheric shadow, a figure baptized in dedication emerges: the archivist—single-mindedness incarnate. This fervent curator’s purpose is an aegis, safeguarding the infinite fragments of data seething through the Net. From illicit megacorp audits to the most prosaic of programs, nothing escapes his vigilant gaze. An apotheosis of the digital, he knits an unbreakable weave of information. With resolute will, he stands guard as a diligent sentinel of the endless, eternally committed to his task.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Anareliltallë, The Desert Druid Matriarc.name:
安娜瑞莉塔莱，沙漠德鲁伊族母
Anareliltallë, The Desert Druid Matriarch

Text.text:
当黎明的光越过嶙峋的沙漠峭壁，一抹微光倏然映入眼帘。一个身影正朝你走来，衣袍的染色精确得不可思议，与这片富含矿物的地形中紫、蓝、橙、红的层层色泽浑然相融。那人抬手拨开遮掩，一圈紧密的金色卷发如光晕般显露，与光滑的铜色肌肤形成鲜明对照。友善的微笑向你致意，可那双眼睛——宛如深邃绿洲的水潭——却诉说着亘古的睿智，以及不容轻慢的力量。
As the light of dawn crests the craggy desert cliffs, a shimmer catches your eye. A figure is walking toward you, clothing perfectly dyed to match the purple, blue, orange and red hues of the mineral-rich terrain. A hand reaches up to uncover a halo of tight golden curls juxtaposed to smooth copper skin. While a friendly smile greets you, the eyes—like deep oasis pools—speak of an ancient wisdom, and power not to be trifled with.

Sundries From A Sneaky Goblin.name:
狡黠地精的小杂货
Sundries From A Sneaky Goblin

Text.text:
你割开地精腰间那只沾满污垢的皮袋，里面有几枚钱币、一块小巧的贵金属压纹锭，还有一只空药瓶，褪成淡黄的标签依稀可见。
Slicing open the grimy leather pouch on the goblin’s belt, you find some coins, a small, embossed ingot of precious metal, and an empty vial with a faded yellow label.

你头顶上方的野生槲寄生由丰饶翠绿的枝茎构成，点缀着厚实圆润的叶片。细小的白色浆果悬在绿意之间，如同闪亮的珍珠，衬得那繁盛的叶丛愈发华美。
Rich, verdant stalks—replete with thick, rounded leaves—form the body of the wild mistletoe above you. Small white berries hang like shining pearls betwixt the greenery, punctuating the sumptuous foliage.

Fioree Le'astier.name:
菲欧蕾·勒阿斯捷尔
Fioree Le'astier

Text.text:
她将长戟从死去的恶魔体内猛地抽出，黑色污泥如喷涌般迸溅开来；随即，她转向你，金色的眼眸锐利而审慎。她气势逼人，立于倒下的敌人之上，宛如新雪的白发自长角的头颅后柔雅翻涌。她拥有神话英雄般高贵的雪花石膏面容，却被一道从脸颊贯至喉间的醒目疤痕所划破——也因此更显凌厉。她那华丽的金色护甲仿佛被玷污——甚至近乎腐化——暗色的黑血黏附在曾经炽亮的甲片上。的确，当你的目光停驻得更久，便会察觉她周身萦绕着一层淡淡的阴影气息，在无形的微风里悄无声息地翻卷。

~ 扮演：Roxanne Sergeant

Pulling her halberd free from the dead fiend in a gout of black sludge, the woman turns to you with discerning golden eyes. She strikes an imposing figure, standing over her foe with hair like freshly fallen snow billowing gracefully from her horned head. She bears the noble alabaster features of a mythic hero, marred and emphasized by the prominent scar running from cheek to throat. Her ornate golden armor seems somehow tainted—perhaps even corrupted—by patches of dark ichor clinging to once-ardent plates. Indeed, as your gaze lingers you notice a faint aura of shadow around her, roiling silently in some invisible breeze.

~ Played by Roxanne Sergeant with

这道怪异而蜿蜒的脊岭沿着坡面盘旋而上，两侧尖峭如削，仿佛羊皮纸上起伏的褶痕般耸立，遮蔽了左右的视线。沿脊岭前行恐怕并不轻松：碎石松散堆积，地形又时不时骤然下陷，让人猝不及防。
The strange, meandering ridge winds up the slope, its sharply steepled sides rising like folds in parchment, obscuring sight on either side. Navigating the ridge might prove difficult, as rubble lies loose and the terrain dips unexpectedly.

Yuan-ti With A Longsword.name:
持长剑的蛇人
Yuan-ti With A Longsword

Text.text:
一条苍白的长绿蛇尾，粗如成年男子的腰腹，松松盘在树根旁，向上无缝融入一个过于人类的躯干。绿鳞在头顶枝叶漏下的斑驳日光里微光流转，将令人目眩的纹影映在那双修长优雅的手臂上——臂上仍零星点缀着鳞片——而他们却以从容与技能挥舞着那柄修长锋利的剑。面容由凌厉的棱角勾勒而成，锐利的绿眼、竖裂的瞳孔，带着几分无聊又不失警惕地扫视着四周。
A long, pale-green serpent’s tail, the thickness of a man’s midsection, is loosely coiled at the foot of a tree, blending into an all-too-human torso. The green scales shimmer from the spots of sun that have penetrated the foliage above, reflecting mesmerizing patterns on long, elegant arms, still speckled with occasional scales, that wield their long, sharp sword with poise and skill. Angular features dominate their face. Sharp green eyes with slitted pupils watch their surroundings with a mixture of boredom and cautious observance.

Desert Valley Pond.name:
沙漠谷池塘
Desert Valley Pond

Text.text:
乍看之下不过是一滩更大的水洼，但当你走近这座干涸山谷中央那片闪烁的池水时，才发现它深深楔入大地，池沿几乎盈满了湛蓝而清冽的地下水，水源来自地表之下更深处某个无人知晓的所在。你看见有生物栖居在池水阴影笼罩的深处，得以躲开烈日与风鞭般抽打的飞沙。你不由得疑惑：为何没有动物聚到这里饮水与休息——这池水幽暗的深处，是否潜藏着什么可怖之物？
Though little more than a large puddle at first glance, as you draw nearer the pond gleaming at the heart of this arid valley you see it thrusts deep into the earth, filled to its brim with blue, crisp groundwater, fed by an unknown source far below the surface. You see creatures dwelling in the pond’s shadowed depths, spared the heat of the sun and the wind-whipped sand. You wonder for a moment why animals don’t gather here to drink and rest—is there something to fear in the dark depths of this pond?

Adult Amethyst Dragon.name:
成年紫水晶巨龙
Adult Amethyst Dragon

Text.text:
在你头顶，一道晶莹优雅的伟岸显化腾空掠过，炽然辉煌。鳞片——一枚枚紫水晶的小棱镜——将光线折射得如同万面镜阵。多重犄角以王者般的从容弯曲，双眼闪耀着预言般的智慧。它落地时，竟像淋湿的狗那样猛地一抖。龙的背棘悬浮在颈侧，叮铃作响，仿佛风穿过水晶吊灯。
Above you, a majestic manifestation of crystalline grace soars with incandescent majesty. Scales—small prisms of amethyst—refract light like a host of mirrors. Multipart horns curve with regal elegance, and eyes shine with prophetic wisdom. As it lands, it shakes itself like a wet dog. The dragon’s spines hover at its neck, tinkling like wind through a chandelier.

你用指尖轻轻在手中紧握的武器上掠过，呼唤原初之力。咒词如号令般，将你所寻的元素召至身旁。你柔和地一推，便把那股滋滋作响、噼啪迸裂的力量与武器融为一体。施法结束时，仍在目标之中回荡的魔法微光，昭示着法术的成功。
Running a light touch across the weapon in your grasp, you call to the primordial forces. The words summon the element you seek into your presence. With a gentle push, you merge that power—sizzling and crackling—with the weapon. As the casting ends, the magical glow that remains within your target speaks of the spell’s success.

Insult About A Warlord.name:
关于军阀的辱骂
Insult About A Warlord

Text.text:
“你确实集结了一支强大的军队。但我在想……当我们将你击倒时，会有多少人会为你的死而哀悼？”
“You have, indeed, mustered a mighty host of soldiers. But I wonder… When we strike you down, how many will mourn your death?”

一股麝香般的气味弥漫在这间屋里，那是许多人挤在同一空间里留下的、再明显不过的气息。大多数床铺的床单都被揉皱，枕头与被褥东歪西斜——仿佛有人在匆忙而潦草的清晨例行中随手收拾。靠近高窗的远角，一只花瓶里插着鲜艳的亮粉色花朵，为这杂乱的空间添上一抹明亮。
A musky smell pervades this room, the telltale scent of many people in a shared space. Most of the beds’ sheets are mussed, pillows and covers askew—signs of a rushed and haphazard morning routine. In the far corner near the tall window, a vase of bright pink flowers brightens up the cluttered space.

High Seas Battle: Aftermath.name:
公海之战：余波
High Seas Battle: Aftermath

Text.text:
你挺过了这场战斗，但代价是什么？船只残骸正在下沉，而尚未沉没的部分也已烈焰缠身。很快，大海将把它彻底吞没；凡是还能漂浮的东西都会化作海上残骸，随波逐流，散落到天涯海角。
You’ve survived the battle, but at what cost? What’s left of the ship is sinking, and what hasn’t yet sunk is on fire. Soon the sea will claim it, and whatever contents can float will become flotsam and jetsam, scattered to the four winds.

Border Town Fire.name:
边境小镇之火
Border Town Fire

Text.text:
天空染上一层猩红的光，浓烟滚滚涌入空中——就在宁静的小镇骤然炸裂成混乱的前一瞬。马匹惊恐嘶鸣，人们难以置信地怒吼。一个士兵把一只空桶猛塞进你手里，含混不清地吼了几句，随即拔腿狂奔而去。街道上挤满四散奔逃的人群，各式各样的东西被他们死死抱在怀里。几条街外一栋建筑轰然坍塌，伴着火焰的死亡，一声怒吼般的火花与烈焰冲天而起。更多士兵提着哗啦作响的水桶、扛着斧头和铁锹冲向火海。热浪扑面而来，带着烧焦的头发与稻草的恶臭，逃命的人朝你嘶喊：“做点什么！什么都行！”
The sky takes on a reddish glow, and dense smoke is billowed into the air, moments before the peaceful town erupts into chaos. Horses scream in fear and people roar in disbelief. A soldier thrusts an empty bucket into your hands and shouts incoherently before sprinting away. The streets fill with running people, all manner of things clasped in their arms. A building collapses several streets away, and an explosion of sparks and flame roars upward from its fiery demise. More soldiers run toward the blaze, laden with sloshing buckets, axes, and spades. Heat washes over your face, stinking of burning hair and straw as escaping folk shout at you, “Do something! Anything!”

Beached Living Whale.name:
搁浅的活鲸
Beached Living Whale

Text.text:
覆着沙砾与海藻，这头搁浅的庞然巨物已不复浪涛之下那份优雅威严；可它那双大而含情的眼睛，却在你心底搅动起某种难以言明的悸动。低沉哀婉的歌声掠过海滩，鲸以此悼叹自己的命运，发出感召，呼唤援助——而它的同族已无力给予。
Coated in sand and kelp, the stranded behemoth lacks the graceful majesty it commands beneath the waves, yet its large, soulful eyes stir something within you. A low, mournful song drifts across the beach as the whale laments its fate, calling for aid its brethren cannot provide.

一只矮小的生物一瘸一拐地朝你挪来，身体的重量压在一把黯淡、折断的短剑上——那短剑被再利用成了拐杖；它的脚用肮脏的破布胡乱缠着。灰皮地精龇开满口尖锐参差的利齿，你却分不清这动作究竟是在欢迎，还是在警告。
A small creature hobbles towards you, its weight supported on what looks like a dull, broken shortsword that has been recycled into a crutch, its foot bandaged with dirty rags. The grey-skinned goblin bares a mouth full of sharp, jagged teeth, and you’re not sure if the gesture is meant to be a welcome or a warning.

太迟了。等你看见它时，它也已经看见了你：那个光点在一张张代码网格间弹跳，像一条踱步的狗。那缕赛博幽絮起初无辜地发光，仿佛遥远的星辰，直到火舌骤然燃成耀眼的金色，继而转为死一般的猩红。你的头骨猛击般震颤，像是一千个刺耳警报同时炸响。你感觉这一千个汽笛的“眼睛”一齐转向你，伸手般探向你闪烁的核心，如同穿甲子弹穿透防弹护甲。

~ 由一位英雄构想

It’s too late. By the time you see it, it sees you: the blip that bounces from one lattice of code to another like a pacing dog. The cyber wisp glows as innocently as a distant star until its fires flame a bright gold and then deathly crimson. Your skull pounds with what sounds like a thousand blaring alarms going off at once. You feel the eyes of these thousand klaxons turn on you at once, reaching to your flickering core like armor-piercing bullets through ballistic armor.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Several Small Fey Inhabiting A Fairy Mou.name:
栖居于仙灵冢中的数名小型妖精
Several Small Fey Inhabiting A Fairy Mound

Text.text:
一棵巨大的橡树伸展枝桠，为这座圆润的土丘投下浓荫。土丘周围，几簇长草与几块异常光滑的石头散落其间；在阳光更能触及地面的地方，它们显得格外醒目。细小的人形生物探头探脑，像缩小版的精灵孩童，时而从岩石后、草丛里，或繁叶垂落的枝间窥视。它们身上的衣物少得可怜，却色彩鲜亮，由天然材料制成。
A massive oak’s branches shade this rounded mound. Tufts of long grass and oddly smooth stones surround the hill, where more sunlight reaches the ground. Tiny humanoids, with the appearance of miniature elven children, peer from behind the rocks, the grass, or leafy branches. Their scant clothing is colorful and made of natural materials.

一段墙体已然坍塌，碎裂的石块堆成一座瓦砾丘，向内倾覆，仿佛某头巨兽撕开城垣、从缺口处狂奔而入。腐朽风化的守军遗骸仍埋在废墟之下，锈蚀的锁子甲裹着森森白骨，被那本为守护他们而筑起的城墙生生碾碎。
A section of wall lies in a heap of crushed and cracked stone, fallen inward as if some massive beast sundered the rampart and charged through the breach. The moldering, skeletal remains of ancient defenders still lie beneath the ruins in rusting chain mail, crushed beneath the very wall erected to defend them.

I Cast Dragonlord's Bond.name:
我施放《龙领主之契》
I Cast Dragonlord's Bond

Text.text:
蛋就在我面前，冰冷而沉默。它那珠光般闪耀的表面，在云层聚拢时洒落的斑驳光影里熠熠生辉。远处雷声隆隆，天色愈发阴沉。一阵刺耳的嗡鸣渐渐升起。我将手——因期待而微微颤抖——覆在蛋壳上，指尖触到一股脉动的回响，宛如心跳。它也变得温热了，光芒从我的指缝间渗出。有什么东西在里面蠢动。头顶天穹翻涌，闪电乍裂，蛋壳沿着中央开裂，向两侧分开。我向后跌倒，抬臂遮住面庞，白炽的光焰猛然喷涌，雷声渐远，耳中嗡鸣不止，云层随之散去。就在我面前，一条青铜幼龙蛇一般的身形，端坐在蛋壳之上，宛如君王踞于王座。它缓缓舒展身躯，以幽暗的眼眸注视着我。

~ 由 Matthew Swaney 在 Envisioned 构想

The egg sits before me, cold and silent. Its pearlescent, gleaming surface catches the dappled light as clouds gather. Thunder rumbles in the distance as the sky darkens. A discordant hum rises. I place my hand—trembling with anticipation—upon the egg, and feel a pulsing reverberation not unlike a heartbeat. It’s warm now too, and a glow bleeds through my fingers. Something stirs within. The sky roils above, lightning flashes, and the egg cracks, splitting down its center. I fall backward, shielding my face from the white-hot glow that erupts, ears ringing as the thunder fades and the clouds disperse. Before me, seated upon the egg like a monarch upon their throne, is the serpentine form of a bronze wyrmling. It uncoils itself and perceives me with dark eyes.

~ Envisioned by Matthew Swaney

半身人身上带着浓烈的啤酒花与酵母气味，指甲因长时间搅动冒着热气的酿造大桶而微微泛黄。皮围裙的口袋里塞满长柄勺、舀子和量匙，随着这位酿酒师在咕嘟翻滚的锅灶与发酵桶间忙碌穿梭，叮当作响，听来格外悦耳。他们从铜制龙头接满一大杯——最新一批的酒——啜了一口，在口中轻轻晃荡品味，随即满意地点了点头。
The halfling smells strongly of hops and yeast, their fingernails yellowed from hours spent stirring the steaming vats. Ladles, scoops, and measuring spoons fill the pockets of their leather apron, clattering pleasantly as the brewmaster bustles between simmering cookpots and fermentation barrels. They fill a tankard from a copper spigot—their latest brew—take a sip and slosh it about their mouth before nodding in approval.

Expending The Last Of Your Magic.name:
耗尽你最后的魔法
Expending The Last Of Your Magic

Text.text:
你吟诵出最后那些诡异的字句，随之它们的一切记忆从你脑海中悄然滑落。取而代之的，是一片空白。那道法术已然消逝，如同梦境的逻辑一般无从追索。
You intone the final strange words, and all memory of them slips from your mind. In their place, nothing. The spell has vanished like the logic of a dream.

尽管从外面看，它不过又是一栋不起眼的灰色建筑，但里面却铺陈着一座繁茂奢华、弥漫肉桂香气的大堂。它们是在往通风里打兴奋剂吗？每一件家具都是艺术品——椅子以不可能的角度向后自我折返。万物都浸在柔和温暖的橙色光里，而你很快意识到，这光源自色相晶体——本星域最稀有的矿物之一——接待台后方，一道绿松石色的水瀑沿着大理石墙倾泻而下。一名仿生人飘然而至，转瞬间，你手里已多了一杯紫色、嘶嘶起泡的液体。
Though from outside it seemed to be another unremarkable gray building, the inside boasts a lush and luxurious lobby smelling of cinnamon. Are they pumping stims into the airflow? Each piece of furniture is an artwork—the chairs bending back on themselves at impossible angles. Everything is glowing with soft warm orange light, which, you realize, comes from chroma crystal—one of the rarest minerals in the sector—and turquoise water cascades down a marble wall behind the reception desk. An android floats over and suddenly you are holding a glass of purple fizzing liquid.

Stony Beach: Storm Overhead.name:
岩石海滩：风暴压顶
Stony Beach: Storm Overhead

Text.text:
狂风把雨水连同浪涛一并驱向岸边。云层触及陆地时，漆黑的结团便分裂开来——宛如水手从小船里倾泻而出上岸放假——雷光在它们阴沉的躯体高处一闪而过，随即倾下冰冷而绵密、稳定不歇的滂沱大雨。
The wind drives the rain against the shore along with the waves. As the clouds reach land, dark knots separate—like sailors spilling out of a boat for shore leave—and lightning flashes high in their shadowy bodies, before unleashing a cold and steady drenching rain.

Bard Reciting Romantic Poem With Charm.name:
吟游诗人以魅惑之声朗诵浪漫诗篇
Bard Reciting Romantic Poem With Charm

Text.text:
吟游诗人的诗句不但雕琢得精妙绝伦、浪漫得足以融化人心，他们的吟诵也同样炽烈而真挚。目光灼灼似燃，嗓音满溢情绪——既温柔又狂烈，在渴望中颤抖不定。“纵然浪涛悲号着分离，终会在遥远彼岸重逢。若爱如海般无垠，我便永不与你分离。”
Not only is the bard’s poetry exquisitely crafted and heart-meltingly romantic, but their recital is also passionate and sincere. Their eyes smolder, and their voice brims with emotion—tender and tempestuous, wavering with longing. “Though waves might part with anguished roars, they meet again on distant shores. If love be boundless as the sea, then never shall I part from thee.”

从神出鬼没的河豚中浸出之河豚毒素，散发着危险的气息。致命却迷人，它如一名强悍的刺客潜伏暗处，诱惑着那些追逐烹饪险境刺激的人。啜饮这一滴经由千般谨慎掌控的毒液，仿佛在狂喜的刀尖上旋转起舞——一场令人沉醉、与禁忌相约的会面。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Tetrodotoxin, leached from the elusive fugu, emits an aura of danger. Deadly yet intriguing, it lurks as a robust assassin, tempting those who seek the thrill of culinary menace. A sip of this poison, painstakingly handled, pirouettes on the tip of exhilaration, an intoxicating appointment with the taboo.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Emblem Holy Symbol.name:
徽记圣徽
Emblem Holy Symbol

Text.text:
这枚铜质徽章上铸着牧师或圣武士所虔奉神祇的圣徽。只要紧握在掌中、佩在颈间，或镶装于盾面之上，他们便会被信仰的力量所充盈，踏上神圣使命时不由得更加笃定而昂扬。
This copper medallion is emblazoned with the symbol of a cleric or paladin’s venerated deity.  When clutched in their hand, worn around their neck, or mounted on a shield, they cannot help but feel empowered by their faith as they go forth in their divine work.

Showdown At High Noon.name:
正午对决
Showdown At High Noon

Text.text:
烈日高悬，你站在镇子广场中央，手悬在腰侧枪套上方。只有你和另一个牛仔——他也做着同样的动作。是时候了结这一切。你凶狠地盯着他，可刺眼的阳光让视线微微发花。钟声敲响正午。电光火石间，两把左轮同时出鞘、两声扳机同一刻扣下。随即，天地一片惨白……
The sun is high in the sky as you stand in the middle of the town square, your hand hovering above the holster at your hip. It’s just you and the other cowboy—who’s doing the same. It's time to settle this. You eye them menacingly, though the glare of the sun blurs your vision. The clock strikes noon. In a flash both pistols are unholstered, both triggers pulled at the same time. And everything goes white…

这根竹制战斗长棍覆着厚重的朱红漆，棍身盘绕着一条黑金相间的东方巨龙，蜿蜒缠绕其上。龙眼处嵌着一枚小小的玉片。奇妙的是，当你的手掠过龙的眼睛时，你能感觉到自己的动作骤然加快，肌肉随之鼓胀涌起力量，长棍在你一式式武艺套路间游走得愈发凌厉。
Coated in thick red lacquer, this bamboo fighting staff features the sinuous form of a black-and-gold Eastern dragon wrapped around its length. A single chip of jade has been embedded for its eye. Curiously, when your hand passes over the eye of the dragon, you feel your actions quicken and your muscles swell with power as you move the staff through your fighting forms.

Fountain Room: Fountains.name:
喷泉室：喷泉
Fountain Room: Fountains

Text.text:
清泉自喷泉中奔涌而出，划出弧线穿过空中，哗然坠入水盆，满溢后又注入更大的水池。幽蓝的魔法火焰在深处闪烁，也在雕刻纹饰上跳动，照亮翻涌的波涛与飞溅的水幕。这引人入胜的景致背后支撑着精巧的机关工艺：喷泉依循某种规律轮替，交错更换喷射的出水口。
Water gushes from fountains, arcing through air and splashing down into basins that overflow into larger pools. Magical blue flames glimmer in the depths and flicker on carvings, illuminating the waves and showers. Some complex engineering undergirds the engaging vista, as the fountains follow a pattern, alternating the spouts from which they spray.

I Cast Memory Recall.name:
我施放「记忆回溯」
I Cast Memory Recall

Text.text:
当我思索自己的物品究竟溜到哪里去了时，我低声呢喃咒语，在指尖间搓揉一撮金属粉尘。粉尘噼啪迸出火花，蓝色烟雾升起，悬在我面前——随即顺风飘去，引我找到那件被我遗落之物。我的记忆也许会失灵，但我的魔法绝不会。

~ 构想：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

As I ponder where my item has absconded to, I mutter an incantation under my breath and rub a pinch of metal dust between my fingers. The dust sparks and blue smoke rises to hang in front of me—then floats on the wind, leading me to what I misplaced. My memory might fail me, but my magic never will.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Lem Cinderspire.name:
莱姆·烬火尖塔
Lem Cinderspire

Text.text:
他的脸上布满伤疤、风霜刻痕，仿佛身上的锁子甲与实用衣装一样久经磨砺。这名高大魁梧的男人以冷淡的沉静打量四周，黑眸目光坚硬得不肯退让。乌黑长发间夹着几缕灰意，纠结成粗绳般的发束，垂覆头颈与肩头。起茧而有力的双手自然地搭在长剑剑柄上——两侧胯间各有一柄入鞘长剑。每把剑旁，一柄手斧从皮革套环上垂挂。双斧也像其主人一般满是缺口与伤痕，木柄被长期握持磨得光滑。

~ Played by Zerodragoon

His face as scarred and weathered as the chain hauberk and practical clothing he wears, this tall, brawny man observes his surroundings with quiet indifference. His dark-eyed gaze is unyielding. Long black hair with hints of gray forms a ropey mass about his head and shoulders. Callused, powerful hands rest easily on the pommels of longswords, one sheathed on each hip. Alongside each blade, a handaxe hangs from a leather loop. Both axes bear nicks and scars like their owner, their wooden hafts worn smooth with use.

~ Played by Zerodragoon

Corp-run Private Police Precinct.name:
企业运营的私人警察分局
Corp-run Private Police Precinct

Text.text:
这可不是什么拿国家预算撑起来的警局。都市蔓延的钢筋森林里，一座线条利落的高塔拔地而起，骄傲地昭示着它的企业主人。隔着防弹玻璃，你窥见一个光鲜的大厅：高端家具一丝不苟，前台则是一位前沿的机器人接待员。再往上，四座停机坪如王冠般压在塔顶。分局里一群警员匆匆穿梭，身上清一色披着军规级防弹护甲。几乎没人闲聊，空气里只有令人窒息的“出成果”的自觉。分局后方写着标语 Protect and Serve，有人在后面又喷了一句 and Profit!。

~ 一位英雄所 Envisioned

This is no state-funded cop shop. A sleek tower rises from the urban sprawl, proudly proclaiming its corporate owners. Through bulletproof glass, you spy a suave lobby with high-end furniture and a cutting-edge robot receptionist. Above, four helipads crown the tower. A bevy of policemen scurry around the precinct, decked out in military-grade body armor. There is little chitchat and a stifling awareness of results. At the rear of the precinct reads the slogan Protect and Serve. Someone has graffitied and Profit! afterward.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

巨大的白色大理石板嵌入赤红岩壁，组成一面切削精准、严丝合缝的墙与门洞。每一块石板——墙面、立柱或过梁——皆为整料一体。过梁处点缀着蓝色瓷砖，宛如那条小径上的砖块；小径穿过门洞，却在前方一堵粗糙的砌石墙前戛然而止。前路看上去已被封死。
Massive slabs of white marble set into the red rock make up a precisely cut and fitted wall and doorway. Each slab—wall, column, or lintel—is one piece. Blue tiles accent the lintel. They’re like the tiles in the path, which crosses through the doorway to end abruptly at a rough masonry wall. The way forward looks sealed.

Dying Words Of Dagne, Bride Of Ruin.name:
达格涅——毁灭新娘的遗言
Dying Words Of Dagne, Bride Of Ruin

Text.text:
“你们为什么要这么做，小孤儿们？从今往后，你们将孑然一身，被困在这崩坏的死亡与虚无循环里。我只希望你们能变得完整。很抱歉我没能让你们明白……但终有一天，你们会的。”

达格涅双腿一软，整个人塌了下去。长袍落地摊平的瞬间，仿佛有成千上万只虫子从布料里窜出，窸窣疾行，逃向最近的缝隙与暗角；还有一些干脆一头扎进深坑。那层丝质面纱如蒲公英般在风里骤然炸散，轻飘飘地在厅室中漂浮——而此刻，整个空间开始震颤。碎石从天花板上簌簌坠落。
“Why have you done this, little orphans? You will be alone now, trapped in this crumbling cycle of death and emptiness. I only wished for you to be whole. I am sorry I couldn’t make you see… but someday you will.” Dagne’s legs crumble beneath her. As her robe hits the floor and flattens, what looks like a thousand bugs skitter out from the fabric. They flee to the nearest nooks and crannies, and some pitch themselves into the pit. The silken veil bursts like a dandelion in the wind and floats about the chamber, which now begins to shake. Pieces of stone tumble down from the ceiling.

Loot From A Pixie.name:
从小精灵身上搜刮到的战利品
Loot From A Pixie

Text.text:
小精灵才刚死去不久，身上仍闪烁着她尘粉的魔法微光。尘粉落在她的脸颊上，如同钻石粉末般的雀斑，又紧紧依附在她翅膀的脉络上。若你能以温柔的谨慎与裁缝般的灵巧下手，你觉得或许可以收集到一些尘粉，供你自用与研究。
The pixie, only recently deceased, still shimmers with the magic of her dust. It settles on her cheeks like diamond-dust freckles and clings dearly to the veins of her wings. With gentle care and a seamstress’s dexterity, you think you might be able to collect some of the dust for your own use and study.

绞刑架在空地前傲然矗立。粗壮的橡木梁托着一圈粗麻绳套索，随风轻轻摇晃。它空着——暂时如此。
