The stage stands proud before the clearing. Thick oak beams hold up a coarse rope noose that sways lightly in the wind. It is empty—for now.

Semi-autonomous Surveillance Drone.name:
半自主监视无人机
Semi-autonomous Surveillance Drone

Text.text:
保安人员在他平板电脑那笨重的键盘上飞快敲入一串代码，无人机随即嗡鸣苏醒，喷口迸射，将它从地面托起。镜头嵌在无人机流线型白色罩壳之中，正中央一盏跳动的红光——仿佛对“视线”的不安拙劣戏仿——伴着低沉嗡鸣亮起。它以一串串二进制代码的短促鸣叫作答，漂浮着远去，用扫掠的激光网格扫描着它的巡逻路线。
The security officer punches a code into the bulky keypad of his tablet, and the drone whirs to life as jets lift it from the ground. A pulsing red light—an unsettling parody of vision—hums to life in the center of a lens set into the drone’s sleek white canopy. It chirps in bursts of binary code as it floats away, scanning its patrol route with a sweeping laser grid.

Dragon Dance Of The Claw Style: Folha Se.name:
爪式龙舞：枯叶直升机
Dragon Dance Of The Claw Style: Folha Seca Helicóptero

Text.text:
这记翻腾在激战中几乎不可能完成：单脚猛然弹起，身躯一拧，四肢如镰般贴地平行掠过，旋即仍以同一只脚稳稳落地。龙之舞在你体内苏醒，腾空与奇袭的劲流奔涌，你将防御与攻击融为一体。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The flip seems impossible in mid-combat. A pop off of one foot, a twist and whirl of limbs like scythes parallel to the ground, and then landing on the same foot. The dance of the dragon is alive in you, the energy of flight and surprise as you combine defense and attack.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Cast Prismatic Spray.name:
我施放棱彩喷射
I Cast Prismatic Spray

Text.text:
我举起双手，十指各自绽放出彩虹般不同的光芒。空气里悬着雨后的清新气息，我瞄准着自己的射击角度。 我稳住身形，暗自祈祷这道法术无论选中哪一种颜色，都能把目标的一天彻底毁掉。 我释放魔法，绚烂的喷涌迸射而出，声响宛如瀑布奔流。
I raise my hands, each of my fingers glowing a different color of the rainbow. The scent of rain hangs in the air as I line up my shot. I brace myself, hoping whichever color the spell chooses absolutely ruins my target's day. I release the magic and, as the vibrant spray spews forth, it sounds like the rush of a waterfall.

微风轻拂，撩动巨人如瀑般流淌的银发；她俯身照料着一片色彩浓烈的药草园，低声呢喃，仿佛在与草叶私语。她像一座由雕刻般肌肉与灰烬色肌肤堆砌而成的山岳，起身时身影直压过花圃；她拍了拍那双如铲般巨大的手，尘土落在一条磨得发白的围裙上。她的目光落到你身上，眼中一闪而过的不是怒意，而是好奇，随后她用一口流利的通用语向你致意。

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

A subtle breeze plays about the giant’s flowing, silver hair as she tends to a garden of vividly colorful herbs, murmuring softly under her breath. She is a mountain of sculpted muscle and ashen flesh, towering above the garden as she gets to her feet, dusting hands the size of shovels upon a well-worn apron. As her gaze falls upon you, her eyes flash, not with anger, but curiosity, and she offers a greeting in fluent common.

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

Auction Hall For Magical Artifacts.name:
魔法遗物拍卖厅
Auction Hall For Magical Artifacts

Text.text: 喧闹的人群吵作一团，在震耳欲聋的嘈杂中仍能喊出清晰的出价。观众由无数生物拼成一片汹涌的海，而拍卖师的形象既诡异又迷人——来历不明的人形体，五官与特征都陌生得令人移不开眼。他们俯身靠在讲台上，噼里啪啦地报出价格与物品，音节如洪流般倾泻而出，夹杂着十几种语言：第一件，一把滴着酸液的剑，归那位戴眼罩的半兽人！ 第二件，来历不明、用途未晓的远古球体，卖给那位来自未知时代与异地的无定形存在！ 而这根仍在抽动生长的枝条——来自托举苍穹的天树？卖给乘星界之船抵达此处的公主！ 每一次竞价刚起便立刻收束落槌，物品随即被人抬走，送往幕后。 The raucous crowd is rowdy, shouting intelligible bids over the din. Myriad creatures make up the audience, and the auctioneer strikes a strange and alluring image, a humanoid of unknown origin with unfamiliar features. Leaning over their podium, they rattle off prices and items, a rush of syllables in a dozen languages: First up, a sword dripping with acid, goes to the half-orc with the eyepatch! Second item up for bid, an ancient sphere of unknown purpose, sold to the amorphous being from an unknown time and place! And this still-living branch of the tree that holds the celestial heavens aloft? Sold to the princess who arrived here in an astral ship! Just as soon as each bid begins, it ends, and the items are carried backstage.

Break In The Hedgerows.name:
闯入树篱间
Break In The Hedgerows

Text.text:
田地边界处那一片纠结疯长、被人勉强修整过的灌木丛，像城堡的墙一样竖起一道屏障；但在这里，你瞥见了一处隐蔽的侧门。一条从大路旁踩踏出的小径穿过草丛，通向篱墙间一段宛如隧道的通道。也许最初是獾类工兵的突袭开出的缺口，但后来被闯入的鹿群不断拓宽，如今人也能弓着身、匍匐着爬过去。
The tangled riot of growth tended into a boundary of the fields stands as a barrier like the wall of a castle, but here you spy a sallyport. A trail beaten through the grass from the roadway leads to a kind of tunnel through the hedgerow. Perhaps it was first the foray of badger sappers, but the path has since been widened by invading deer so that a person might hunch and crawl through.

Snowy Beekeeping Town.name:
雪落蜂乡
Snowy Beekeeping Town

Text.text:
这座看似不起眼的小村，紧贴着一片霜意缠身、辽阔如海的松林。几条深深车辙犁出的土路向北、向南与西南蜿蜒而去。松木削成的木墙环绕聚落，墙外田地与农舍散落铺陈，四面八方延绵数里不绝。尽管寒气刺骨，空气却仿佛因无处不在的肥腹蜜蜂而嗡鸣不息——它们成群结队，在松林与村内蜂箱之间往返穿梭；那些蜂箱在镇中排成网格，足有数十只。养蜂人戴着厚手套与面罩，手持松烟不歇，忙着收取一片片蜜脾。空气里压着一股勾人的气味，酸里带甜，甜中微涩，醉人得像要把人拉进梦里——那是本地蜂蜜酒坊飘出的香，显然正借着这取之不尽的蜜源酿造。整座村落透着一股超自然的暖意，与外头的冰冻气温形成诡异的反差。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The seemingly unremarkable hamlet sits tucked against a mighty sprawl of frost-tinged pine forest, with deeply rutted dirt roads leading north, south, and southwest. A wall of pine timbers encircles the settlement, with fields and farmhouses dotting the surrounding landscape for many leagues in all directions. Despite the wintry chill, the air seems to buzz with the constant presence of fat-bottomed honeybees flitting around, traveling in droves between the pine forest and the hive boxes situated in a grid of dozens within the town itself. Beekeepers work tirelessly with heavy gloves, masks, and pine smoke, collecting combs of honey. An alluring smell hangs heavy in the air, sour and sweet and intoxicating, wafting from the local meaderies which undoubtedly utilize the abundant honey. The hamlet exudes a supernatural warmth, which belies the freezing temperatures.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

起初，新多瓦的首领给人的印象极为迫人：她身披深色钢制板甲，甲面镌刻着巨龙纹饰。护甲在关键处刻意留出空隙，露出古铜色肌肤下绷紧的肌理之索，让她即便负重也能保持流畅而致命的移动。可她与人相见时却带着欢快的笑意与专注的目光——左眼闪着银辉，右眼流转金芒。

~ Played by P.O.

At first, the leader of the New Dovah is an imposing figure with her suit of dark steel plate marked with dragon motifs. Strategic gaps in the armor, revealing cords of muscle under bronze skin, allow for fluid and deadly movement despite the weight. However, she meets folk with a merry smile and attentive gaze, her left eye gleaming silver and the right sparkling gold.

~ Played by P.O.

Warning From A Fighter To A Guardsperson.name:
一名战士对守卫的警告
Warning From A Fighter To A Guardsperson

Text.text:
“我不怀疑你对你城邦律法的信念，但你剑鞘上的锈迹告诉我——你根本没什么手段去执行它们。”
“While I don’t doubt your conviction for your city’s laws, the rust on your scabbard tells me you have little means of enforcing them.”

Peaceful Temple: Pool Of Contemplation.name:
宁静寺庙：沉思之池
Peaceful Temple: Pool Of Contemplation

Text.text:
一股溪流从岩石间咕噜咕噜地涌出，翻滚着注入一汪宽阔的水池，或许源自天然泉眼，又或是借助巧妙的工艺从城墙外的湖泊引来。池水在十来处溢出，水珠沿着石板间的缝隙细细淌成小股水线，随即又被精心引走。水仿佛凭空而来，又同样神秘地消失无踪。
A stream burbles out from the rock and tumbles into a broad pool, perhaps fed by a natural spring or conveyed through clever engineering from a lake outside the walls. The pool itself spills over in a dozen places, the water trickling into tiny streams between the flagstones before being cleverly carried away. The water seems to come from nowhere and vanish just as mysteriously.

Planetar Encounter.name:
天界行者遭遇
Planetar Encounter

Text.text:
那尊雕像般的身影足有十多尺高。宽阔而俊美的面庞仰望苍穹，可你却感到自己被注视着，仿佛祂正直直盯着你。祂的身躯流光溢彩，像由珍珠凝成；但凑近细看，你才发现那是金色的肌肤，上面潦草刻写着细小的乳白符文，泛着虹彩。这个强大存在的双手都搭在巨剑的剑首上，那把大剑的长度轻易就有常人用剑的两倍。祂一动不动，连一丝肌肉都未颤动，可背后那对巨大白翼的羽毛却在你感受不到的微风里轻轻拂乱。
The statuesque figure stands a dozen feet tall. Their broad and handsome face gazes heavenward, but you feel as seen as if they were staring at you. Their body looks iridescent, like it’s made of pearl, but on closer examination you see that they have golden skin scrawled with tiny opalescent runes. Both of this mighty being’s hands rest on the pommel of a greatsword easily twice the length of most human's. Not a muscle moves, but the white feathers of their two great wings ruffle in a breeze you do not feel.

Misty Tendrils Investigate Skeleton.name:
迷雾触须 调查 骷髅（特征）
Misty Tendrils Investigate Skeleton

Text.text:
它以绝望的姿势半埋在冰里，骷髅（特征）双手高举，仿佛正试图阻止一场迫近的攻击。薄雾在开裂的冰面上翻卷，向那堆陈旧的骨骸逼近。起初，这不过像大自然一段迷人却寻常的循环；可随即，雾丝化作的触须开始在冰上爬行、掠飞，如同章鱼灵巧的肢体。雾生的触手戳弄着骷髅（特征）：一条缠上它颈部的椎骨，另一条探入那张被掰开的空洞下颌，仿佛在搜寻残存的脸颊与舌头。
Its desperate pose half-buried in ice, the skeleton’s hands are raised up as if trying to halt an impending attack. Mist furls over the cracking ice, closing in on the old bones. At first this seems a mesmerizing but normal routine of nature, but the tendrils begin to crawl and fly across the ice like the dexterous limbs of an octopus. The mist-born tentacles poke at the skeleton: while one curls about the vertebrae of its neck, another prods into the swung-open hollow jaw as if searching for remnants of cheek and tongue.

Loot From A Violet Fungus.name:
来自紫色真菌的战利品
Loot From A Violet Fungus

Text.text:
干枯龟裂的骸骨散落在洞窟地面上，拼成一幅阴森可怖的死亡拼布。骨头表面布满坑蚀与伤痕——仿佛被酸液啃噬过——但其中藏着的几样东西仍引起你的注意：一只褪色的皮革钱袋，里头装着几枚钱币，总计十四枚银币；还有一枚指南针——依然运转如常——都是难得的收获。
Dry, cracked bones litter the cavern floor in a macabre patchwork of death. The bones are pitted and scarred—as if by acid—but a couple of objects hidden among them catch your eye. A faded leather purse, containing a few coins totaling fourteen silver pieces, and a compass—still in working order—prove to be valuable finds.

Disused Cathedral And Plaza.name:
废弃的大教堂与广场
Disused Cathedral And Plaza

Text.text:
大教堂塔楼传来一声刺耳的钟鸣，宣告时辰。這座古老建筑瘦削而阴沉，远离机车人潮与街头叫卖的喧嚣，孤零零地矗立着。曾经香火鼎盛，如今遗址周围的辽阔广场却空无一人——只剩枯死的树与乌鸦作证。淡紫色的光里，大教堂在你头顶高耸：巨大的彩绘玻璃花轮、尖塔与扶壁层层叠起。一股久远的庄严威势扑面而来。
A clangorous bell sounds from the cathedral tower, calling the hour. This ancient building, gaunt and foreboding, stands clear of the bustle of motor crowds and street hagglers. Once a busy place of worship, the vast plaza around the site is empty—only dead trees and ravens left to bear witness. Lilac in the light, the cathedral towers above you: great wheels of stained glass, towers, and buttresses. A sense of ancient majesty sweeps over you.

Spilled Ink In Wizard’s Study.name:
巫师书房里洒落的墨迹
Spilled Ink In Wizard’s Study

Text.text:
这间巫师的书房向来像活着一般：一支魔法羽毛笔沙沙作响，将法术誊写进法术书；炼金调配物咕嘟冒泡，翻滚酝酿。如今却诡异得死寂无声。墨迹泼洒在地板上。长凳后方，你看见一只血淋淋的手攥着一本书被撕下的书页。
This wizard's study has always felt alive: a magic quill scratching as it transcribed spells into a spellbook, alchemical concoctions burbling and brewing. Now it is eerily silent. Ink spatters the floor. Behind the bench you can see a bloody hand holding the torn page of a book.

Victoria Tremaine.name:
维多利亚·特雷梅恩
Victoria Tremaine

Text.text:
巨龙优雅如蛇，轰然落地，震响如雷。他一身缟黑鳞甲泛起幽光，在光线下犹如黑曜石般冷冽闪耀。巨龙的骑手随之下了坐骑，身披与坐骑同样的黑鳞战甲，周身却带着超脱尘世的美感。她的靛蓝眼眸闪着狡黠的戏谑，铂金色的金发在方才狂风撕扯之后仍凌乱得恰到好处。女人手中紧握一条盘卷的长鞭，鞭身由纺成的铂金与晶莹寒冰编就。

~ Played by Cornelia

The dragon, beautiful and serpentine, touches down with a thunderous report. His onyx-black scales gleam, shining like obsidian in the light. The dragon’s rider descends, armored in the same black scales protecting her mount, and carrying with her an otherworldly beauty. Her indigo eyes shine with a playful cunning, and her platinum-blond hair hangs perfectly tousled, despite the wind ripping through it just moments ago. The woman grips a coiled whip of spun platinum and crystalline ice.

~ Played by Cornelia

风向一转，雾中浮现出一个身影，安静的咔哒声也随之露出源头。一根杆子顶着公牛的头骨，下面垂挂着各式骨头，用细皮条绑着，在微风里彼此轻轻磕碰，发出低低的骨响。原来这像是一块路标——地上散落着大小不一、种类繁杂的骨骸。此地规模之骇人令人窒息。想必一代又一代的人都把亡者的遗体送来这里，任其被啃噬剔净。
A figure resolves out of the fog as the wind shifts, revealing the source of a quiet clacking noise. A bull’s skull tops a pole, from which hang bones of various types, tied by thin leather strips, quietly clattering against one another in the slight breeze. This turns out to be a signpost of sorts, for bones of diverse types and sizes litter the ground. The scale of the site is staggering. Generations must have brought the bodies of the dead here to be picked clean.

Weaselly Android Stoolie.name:
鬼祟的安卓走狗
Weaselly Android Stoolie

Text.text:
从他神经质的举止判断，你几乎可以肯定，这个瘦削苍白的仿生人要是能出汗，早就汗如雨下了。不知怎的，在巷子昏暗光照里，他那合成的头发竟显得油腻发亮；他惴惴不安地搓着双手。发声器独有的共鸣为他的嗓音染上一层金属般的回响，他把你要的信息一股脑吐露出来——随即又急忙开口，求你给他一个你会保护他的保证。
You suspect the gaunt, pale android would be pouring sweat if he were able, judging by his jittery demeanor. Somehow his synthetic hair looks greasy in the dim light of the alleyway, and he wrings his hands with trepidation. The unmistakable resonance of a vocal emitter colors his speech as he divulges the information you seek—before quickly asking for the reassurance of your protection.

I Cover My Trail In A Forest.name:
我在森林中抹去行踪
I Cover My Trail In A Forest

Text.text:
我从旁边一棵树上生生扳下一根细枝，特意挑那种被茂密叶丛簇拥着的，好让再尖的眼也难看出少了它。我用枝条贴着地面横扫，把自己的脚印和营地留下的一切痕迹都抹平。接着从背包里抽出一段绳索，缠到腰间打紧结，把那根枝条塞在身后，像拖着一条葱绿的尾巴。枝条一路在身后拖曳，我小心翼翼地穿行在灌木丛里，鼻尖与耳朵都绷紧，捕捉任何急水的声息——得找条河趟过去，好把追踪者彻底甩开。
I wrench a thin branch from a nearby tree, taking care to choose one surrounded by its leafy brethren that would not be noticed as missing by sharp eyes. I sweep the branch across the ground to wipe away my footprints and any evidence of the camp. I uncoil a length of rope from my pack and tie it about my waist, fitting the branch behind me like a verdant tail. The branch drags behind me as I make my careful way through the thicket, my nose and ears piqued for any sign of rushing water—a river to pass through, to further evade any trackers.

Grand Emporium Of The Arcane.name:
奥术大商会
Grand Emporium Of The Arcane

Text.text:
[Inside] 这座八边形建筑以白色石料砌面，四角各立一座塔楼，每座塔都覆着圆锥形屋顶，瓦片色泽彼此不同。每处尖顶上方都漂浮着一枚与之同色的发光球体；塔楼之间升起一座金色穹顶，中央开有一道槽沟，里面嵌着一枚由巨大齿轮托举的水晶透镜。朝东的巨门由白木制成，并以秘银箍束，其旁夹击着两枚白光光球。环绕此处的白石铺地广场上，空气的微光凝成野兽与人形的轮廓，或许正解释了为何看不见其他守卫。即使隔着一段距离，空气也在嗡鸣，带着刺麻的能量颤动。 [Outside] 巨大的外门通向一条宽阔的入口通道，地面铺着闪亮石砖。由金属排列而成的魔法法阵边缘立着一座讲台，俯瞰通往下层的阶梯；下方一层摆满桌案、书桌、凳子与椅子——其上方漂浮着小小的光球。环柱拱廊环绕着这一层，墙边排满书架，堆放典籍、卷轴、石板与各类容器。其上的三层皆与此布局相仿，只是每层的阳台都更向穹顶大厅内伸出。穹顶高处悬浮着一盏巨大的水晶吊灯，晶辉流转，将大厅浸在温暖的光里。身披不同色泽长袍的人影在室内穿行，忙于奥术事务；其中一些操作伴随刺眼的闪光与刺耳的异响。同时，蜥蜴般的小狗头人匆匆来往，收集材料协助法师。

~ Gingerbeard 构想

[Inside] This octagonal building, faced in white stone, has a tower on every corner, each one’s conical roof covered in tiles of a differing hue. A luminous ball of matching color floats over every pinnacle, and between the towers rises a golden dome with a trench in the center that holds a crystal lens on great gears. Huge doors of white wood banded in mithral face east, with globes of white light flanking them. In the white-paved plaza around the place, shimmers in the air take bestial and humanoid shapes, perhaps explaining why no other guards are visible. The air thrums with tingling energy even at a distance. [Outside] The huge outer doors open into a broad entryway tiled in shiny stone. At the edge of a magic circle arrayed in metal stands a podium overlooking steps leading down to a lower floor filled with tables and desks, stools and chairs—with small orbs of light floating above them. A pillared arcade surrounds this level, and shelves with tomes, scrolls, tablets, and containers line the walls. The three floors above mirror this arrangement, although each one’s balconies project farther into the domed room. A great chandelier of glimmering crystal floats in the vaulted ceiling’s uppermost reaches, bathing the hall in a warm glow. Figures in robes of varied hues move about the room, undertaking arcane tasks; flashes of light and dissonant noises accompany some of this work. Meanwhile, small lizardlike kobolds hurry about collecting materials to assist the mages.

~ Envisioned by Gingerbeard

骨头与石质小饰物彼此碰撞，叮当作响，随着披在女祭司身上的毛皮与兽皮一同摇曳——她的身形微微佝偻，却又像舞者般灵动。黑色颜料在她四肢与躯干上勾出虎纹，又在眼眶周围抹成深黑的圆环；那张脸因此如同骷髅，凹陷阴森。她手执一根缀满骨饰的法杖，杖身雕刻成一对盘绕的蛇，彼此吞噬，纠缠不休。她周身仿佛时时逸散着黑暗而辛辣的烟雾，翻涌成不祥的形状，伴随她施展那卑劣的魔法。

~ Envisioned by Puckley

Bones and stone trinkets clatter against one another as they dangle from the furs and hides draping the priestess’s slouched yet danceresque form. Black paint creates tiger stripes across her limbs and torso, and dark circles around her eyes—the visage is skull-like, sunken. She carries a staff adorned with bones, carved to evoke a pair of coiled serpents consuming each other. Dark, acrid smoke seems to waft from her at all times, swirling into sinister shapes as she works her vile magic.

~ Envisioned by Puckley

Mask Of Epi.name:
埃庇之面具
Mask Of Epi

Text.text:
你原本误以为是蜘蛛网的东西，其实是一种极薄的织物。你将这片丝滑的材质拈起，它自然垂落成一副面具的形状，恰好覆住人脸的下半部。它并非用来伪装——几乎完全透明。面具里隐隐传出一阵轻微的嗡颤，你指间的系带也微微摇摆，仿佛焦躁不安，迫不及待想做点什么。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

What you originally mistake as a spider’s cobweb is actually a thin fabric of some kind. You lift the silky material, which forms the shape of a mask that covers the lower half of one’s face. It is not intended to disguise, as it’s almost entirely see-through. A slight thrum emanates from it, and its straps sway slightly in your grip—as though restless and eager to do something.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Disinterested Computer Technician.name:
冷漠的计算机技师
Disinterested Computer Technician

Text.text:
他对着眼前一排排主板沉沉地叹了口气，增广眼镜上通知、警报与公式接连迸亮，冷冰冰的电子兴奋感悬在他惺忪的眼底。他抬手挠了挠胸口，褪色乐队T恤上的图案随着动作微微晃动，随后抓起他的测试工具。
He heaves a heavy sigh as he regards the motherboards before him, his augmented glasses flaring with notifications, alerts, and formulas. A computerized enthusiasm hovers over his bleary eyes. He scratches his chest, the image on his faded band T-shirt rocking with the motion, before picking up his tester tool.

Skeleton In An Underground Pool.name:
地下水池中的骷髅（特征）
Skeleton In An Underground Pool

Text.text:
一具孤零零的骷髅（特征）半浸在这处地下水池污浊的水里。那钙化的残骸诡异地显得很开心，头骨上凝固着一道永不褪去的咧笑。水面泛起一丝微弱的荧光反射，洒下黯淡的光辉，笼罩着那斜卧的身影。
A solitary skeleton lies half-submerged in the squalid waters of this subterranean pool. The calcified remains seem eerily cheerful, a permanent grin fixed upon its skull. A faint gleam of luminescence reflects from the pool’s surface, casting a dim glow over the reclining figure.

I Use Wild Shape: Wolf.name:
我施展【荒野变形】：狼
I Use Wild Shape: Wolf

Text.text:
我踱着步，嗅闻空气。头发猛地拉长，贴着皮肤噼啪作响，化作暗褐的皮毛。我向前扑倒；双手触地的刹那，指骨缩短重塑，变成宽阔的爪子。面部与牙齿向外延伸拉长，脊椎末端猛然抽出一条蓬松的尾巴。
I pace and sniff the air. My hair lengthens, and it crackles across my skin as it becomes dusky fur. I fall forward; as my hands hit the ground, they shorten and reshape into broad paws. My face and teeth stretch, and a bushy tail sprouts from the base of my spine.

在某种黑暗而扭曲的力量驱动下，一堆残肢断体抽搐着、猛然一抖。它像是被某种邪恶的意志强行焊接成的一团肉堆：不可能存在的血肉聚合体，肢体与头颅胡乱地朝各个方向伸指，爪挠着地面寻找支撑。可怖的缝合线宛如融化的塑料，将肢体连在一起——这些肢体尺寸与肤色各不相同。生物所过之处飘散着腐败物质的恶臭。
Animated by some dark and twisted force, a collection of body parts spasms and jerks. It looks like a pile of meat welded together by some fell will: an impossible mass of flesh, limbs and heads pointing haphazardly in every direction, pawing at the ground for purchase. Horrible sutures, like melted plastic, connect the limbs, which are of myriad different sizes and colors. A foul stench of rotten matter wafts from the creature’s wake.

Dizabold Vennaut.name:
迪扎博尔德·文诺特
Dizabold Vennaut

Text.text:
年迈的龙裔闲庭信步地走来，手杖清脆地敲击地面，带着几分俏皮的节奏；他那蓝绿的目光明亮又顽皮，仿佛海浪飞沫般闪耀。上唇胡须与山羊胡的末梢已显毛糙，染着灰白，他那爽朗的嗓音里也带着一丝沙哑。疤痕在他的唇边与下颌交织成网。鳞片是浓郁的林木深绿，到了肘部、棘刺与其他粗硬的棱角处，则渐变为昏沉的青铜色。他走路微驼的姿态让肚腹更显圆鼓，也将那件厚实的围裙顶得向外鼓起——口袋里插满木工工具，整件围裙又以鳞甲片加固。腰侧处，你瞥见一把燧发手枪，金属光泽与他眼里的精气同样跳脱。

~ 由一位英雄扮演

The old dragonborn saunters up, cane clacking jauntily against the ground, his blue-green gaze as bright and playful as ocean spray. The whiskers of his mustache and goatee are frayed and tinged with gray, and there is a rasp to his jolly voice. Scars create a lattice across his lips and jaw. His scales are a rich forest-green color that turn to a dusky bronze at his elbows, spines, and other rough edges. The hunch to his walk rounds his pot-belly and pushes out his heavy-duty apron, its pockets lined with carpentry tools and the whole of it reinforced with scale plates. At his hip, you spy a flintlock pistol with the same spirited sheen as his eyes.

~ Played by a Hero

乍一看，这座建筑像一座设防的瞭望塔。然而它虽立于山丘之上，高大的树木却紧贴着塔身；那些看似箭孔的狭缝又宽得反常，更像是为了比例而非防护；屋顶的雉堞也显得偏向装饰。最离奇的是，底层竟是一座敞开的亭廊，露出一段螺旋楼梯，必定能通往上方的诸多房间。
At first glance the structure looks like a fortified watchtower. But although it stands on a hill, tall trees crowd close to it; what look like arrow loops seem too wide, placed more for proportion than protection; and the roof crenellations appear decorative. Strangest of all, the bottom floor is an open pavilion revealing a spiral staircase that must allow access to the chambers above.

Ancient Copper Spellbook.name:
古老的铜制法术书
Ancient Copper Spellbook

Text.text:
两道青铜环穿过厚重铜板上的孔洞蜿蜒盘绕。封面上刻满符文般的标记，以及诸神般的身影施展奇迹的场景。其中一位存在伸出的舌头化作一枚铜夹，将书牢牢扣合。即便如此，也能看出书页竟是更薄的铜片，被压得平整服帖。铜绿斑驳了封面，也侵蚀了部分书页的边缘。
Two rings of bronze coil through holes in plates of thick, heavy copper. Etched on these covers are runic symbols, and deific figures performing miraculous acts. The tongue of one such being forms a copper clip that holds the book closed. Even so, it’s apparent the pages within are thinner sheets of copper, pressed flat. Verdigris has marred the covers and some page edges.

Agent Of The Night Blade Casting Spell O.name:
夜刃特工正对着一扇门施放法术
Agent Of The Night Blade Casting Spell On A Door

Text.text:
一个气息晦秘的身影回头侧望，火把的光映亮了他脸上一线轮廓。颈间一枚青铜胸针扣住兜帽。他的长袍朴素却做工精良，厚重的深红布料既遮蔽身形，也以压迫感逼人。那人将双手举到紧闭的门前，掌心迸发出明亮光照。
A figure with a cryptic air peers over his shoulder, a sliver of his face becoming illuminated in the torchlight. A bronze brooch at his neck secures his hood. His robe is simple but well-made. It is a heavy, dark red fabric that intimidates as much as it obscures. The figure holds his hands up to a closed door, and bright light flashes from his palms.

破烂的褐色布条披在乞丐身上，替他们挡住风雨。一顶兜帽压得很低，阴影遮住了那张瘦削憔悴的脸。他们一手托着锡盘，向过路人收拢零散的铜币；另一手紧攥着一根虬结的拐杖，沿着鹅卵石路小心挪步。每当一枚硬币叮当落入盘中，乞丐便微微点头致谢，神情庄重，却满怀感激。
Ratty brown rags drape the beggar's form, shielding them from the elements. A cowl pulled low shadows their gaunt face. In one hand, they hold a tin plate, collecting coppers from passersby; the other hand clutches a gnarled walking stick as they pick their way down the cobbled road. With each clink of a coin into the pan, the beggar nods their thanks, solemn but grateful.

High Seas: Thunder And Lightning.name:
公海：雷霆与闪电
High Seas: Thunder And Lightning

Text.text:
海鸥为躲避风暴栖在船上，以一种超然的冷漠俯视甲板上的行动。雷声滚滚，闪电一瞬将云层染成紫色，雨势更猛，终于与海雾般的浪花飞沫分得清楚。船体木料在海的攫握中颤抖尖鸣，风暴撕扯着整艘船。你不确定这艘船还能承受多少折磨，但那些海鸥显然认为这里比开阔海面更像避风的巢穴。而你也不得不同意。
Gulls have taken shelter from the storm aboard the ship, observing the activity on deck with detached disinterest. Thunder rolls, the lightning briefly turning clouds purple, and the rain falls harder, becoming distinct from sea spray. The timbers shudder and squeal in the grip of the sea as the storm tears at the ship. You’re not certain how much more punishment the ship can withstand, but the seagulls seem to think it a better shelter than the open water. And you must agree.

Haunted House: Main Hall.name:
闹鬼宅邸：主厅
Haunted House: Main Hall

Text.text:
大厅中央垂挂着一盏巨大的木制枝形吊灯，粗重的铁链上它轻轻摇晃；可它摇曳的灯火投下的阴影却仿佛以闪电般的速度窜动，在你视野的边缘扭曲翻滚。华丽的鎏金画框里装着十余幅画作——既有肖像，也有景致——然而在这光线下，每一幅都被照得阴森诡异。画中每一个人、每一只动物的眼睛都分明在追随着你——楼梯宽阔的栏杆尽头，那些咧嘴狞笑的石像鬼头颅同样如此。
The massive wooden chandelier hanging over the center of the great hall swings gently on its thick iron chain, but the shadows cast by its flickering lamplight appear to move at lightning speeds, twisting at the periphery of your vision. Ornate gilded frames contain more than a dozen paintings—both portraits and features—though the light casts a sinister bent on each depiction. And the eyes of each person and animal within the paintings are definitely following you—as are those of the grinning gargoyle heads that cap each bannister of the large staircase.

Sundries From A Barghest Rider.name:
来自巴格斯特骑手的杂货
Sundries From A Barghest Rider

Text.text: 这头狼被套上了骑乘用具，但皮带、金属环与扣具都破败不堪。死去的骑手本人还带着一根又长又细的棍子，侧面刻着地精语单词 beatzies 。 The wolf is fitted with rider’s tack, its straps, rings, and buckles in bad shape. The dead rider themself carries a long, thin stick with the goblin word beatzies carved into the side.

The January In Winter.name:
冬日一月
The January In Winter

Text.text:
迎曙年节的筹备已经开始——你在当地人的闲聊里一再听到这个名字。人们把日光般明黄的缎带与挂毯披挂在城门的雉堞与周围城垣上，像给石壁点燃了一圈暖色的火。  

“游行队伍要从门洞里走过，所以我们得摆上路锥，把车都挡在外面，”一名女子说道，语气里透着不容顶嘴的强硬。她胸前斜挂着一条长春花蓝的绶带，上面用亮黄色大字写着：委员会主席。  

“去跟城门的守卫谈谈，看能怎么处理。快点去！”
Preparation has begun for the Year Dawning Festival—you keep hearing the name in local chatter. Folk drape sun-yellow ribbons and tapestry from the gate’s crenellations and surrounding battlements. “The procession will be walking through the gate, so we’ll need cones up to keep out the cars,” says a woman in a tone that suggests no tolerance for back-talk. Across her torso she wears a periwinkle sash with bright yellow letters that read: Committee Chair. “Speak with the guards at the gate to see what can be done. Hop to it!”

Dragonborn Phantom Rogue.name:
龙裔魅影（特征）游荡者
Dragonborn Phantom Rogue

Text.text:
许多龙裔以威仪与强悍闻名，而这位却是夜色里的潜行者。这个盗贼身上的龙性更偏爬行般的冷峻——迅捷、机敏、狡黠，与其说是火焰本身，不如说更像火焰投下的影子。自影中，魅影猛兽现身，出击如电，旋即遁回黑暗。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

While many dragonborn are known for their presence and prowess, this one is a skulker of the night. The draconic in this rogue is reptilian, quick and clever, kin to the shadow of a flame more than to the flame itself. From the shadow comes the phantom beast, who strikes and slips back into the dark.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Speech About Fate In The Stars.name:
群星中的命运演说
Speech About Fate In The Stars

Text.text:
“有时我真希望我的命运写在群星之中。那些零散的光点能指引我，仿佛我只是某场宇宙棋局里的一枚棋子。但当我抬头望向天空，我看到的只有它们之间无垠的黑暗深渊——而我所感到的，唯有孤独。”
“Sometimes I wish my fate was written in the stars. That these random points of light directed me as though I were a piece in some cosmic game. But when I look up into the sky, I see only the vast gulfs of darkness between them—and all I feel is loneliness.”

Crowded Night Market With Entertainers.name:
热闹夜市与街头艺人
Crowded Night Market With Entertainers

Text.text:
活力四射的表演者与古怪的摊贩在熙攘的市集里争夺目光。的确，随着你前行，你的每一处感官都被喂以令人目眩的新奇体验。空气中翻涌着令人垂涎的馥郁香气交织成一曲交响，乐师奏起轻快的旋律；杂技演员、翻腾者与喷火人轮番登场，逗得聚拢的人群欢呼连连。你隐约觉得，在这片缤纷的帐篷与摊位之间，任何东西都能找到——只要你知道该往哪儿看。
Vivacious performers and eccentric vendors compete for attention in the bustling market. Indeed, each of your senses is treated to dazzling new sensations as you progress. A symphony of mouth-watering aromas fills the air, and musicians play jaunty melodies as acrobats, tumblers, and fire breathers delight the gathered crowds. You suspect one could find anything among the colorful tents and stalls—if one knew where to look.

Threat From The Evil Necromancer.name:
来自邪恶死灵法师的威胁
Threat From The Evil Necromancer

Text.text:
“你的骨头将被折弯，你的脏腑将被拧绞，而我会把你的身体塑成更有用的东西。”
“Your bones will be bent, your entrails will be twisted and I will mold your body into something more useful.”

Intimidation Of A Town Guard.name:
镇卫的威吓
Intimidation Of A Town Guard

Text.text:
“我们在这里做的事，早已超出你那份律法章程的管辖。要是你还继续妨碍我们的任务，我保证你要操心的，可不止几桩微不足道的轻罪。”
“What we are doing here is beyond your charter of laws. If you continue impeding our mission, I guarantee you will have a lot more to worry about than a few petty misdemeanors.”

Loot From A Nabassu.name:
来自纳巴苏的战利品
Loot From A Nabassu

Text.text:
在恶魔受害者干枯的残骸间散落着，你发现了几件耐人寻味的小玩意：一封用蓝色蜡封口却不见印记的信，一条银质护符手链，以及一枚被掰成两半的木制圣徽。
Scattered among the desiccated husks of the demon’s victims, you find some interesting curios: a letter sealed with blue wax but no signet, a silver charm bracelet, and a wooden holy symbol broken in half.

Abandoned House In Snow.name:
雪中废宅
Abandoned House In Snow

Text.text:
空洞的窗与无门的门框不透一丝光，仿佛没有瞳孔的黑眼；屋顶的茅草被天气折磨得软塌塌、湿漉漉地耷拉着。它立在惨白的雪地里，整座房子毫无生气，唯一的声响来自头顶掠过的雁群。
The empty windows and doorless frame emit no light, like black eyes with no pupils, and the thatch of the roof looks weather-limp and bedraggled. In the bleak snow on which it stands, the house shows no life, and the only sound comes from geese flying overhead.

Temple To A God Of Justice.name:
正义之神的圣殿
Temple To A God Of Justice

Text.text:
这里的许多武僧都是龙裔。不是龙裔的那些人，为了敬奉那位龙族神祇，也都在手臂、腿部与胸膛上忍受了鳞片纹身的烙刻。祭坛之上，正义之槌——以柚木打造，体型如战锤般巨大——安放在一对黄铜龙爪之中。紫罗兰色的帷幕后方燃着熏香，颜色与侍者的长袍如出一辙；缕缕细烟蜿蜒升起，带着蜂蜜般的甜香。
Many of the monks here are dragonborn. Those who are not have endured tattoos of scales on their arms, legs and chests in honor of the draconic deity. Atop the altar, the gavel of Justice—crafted of teakwood and the size of a warhammer—rests upon a pair of brass dragon claws. Incense burns from beyond a violet curtain, the same color as the attendant's robes, with the thin smoke trails smelling of honey.

Mage Hand Cast By A Wizened Wizard.name:
由一位老成的法师施放的法师之手
Mage Hand Cast By A Wizened Wizard

Text.text:
弯曲的脊背与年代的摧残刻在身上，这位干瘦的施法者低低呢喃出一个音节，毫无预兆，旁边书架上的一册巨著便轻轻浮起，落入她早已伸出的双手。

~ 构想：Shackleford

Bent of back and the ravages of age, the wizened spellcaster murmurs a single syllable and, without preamble, a tome from a nearby bookcase floats into her waiting hands.

~ Envisioned by Shackleford

Underground Temple To A God Of Elemental.name:
献给元素之土之神的地下神殿
Underground Temple To A God Of Elemental Earth

Text.text:
你向大地深处下行。狭窄蜿蜒的通道在前方分岔成无数支路。祭司们仿佛对这些路径了如指掌，即便不借助火把也能从容穿行。他们多是习惯地下生存的族群：白眼的精灵、肤色蜡黄的矮人、长着触须的鼹民。

你触及一座高耸的洞窟，若非洞壁几处关键位置点着寥寥火把，这里本会彻底沉入黑暗。岩壁上以泥土颜料绘着浓烈的橙、棕与黑，图像似在讲述一个循环：秩序、毁灭、重塑。群山骤然燃起烈火，崩裂倾泻，化作火雨砸向大地。新的生命——植物、怪物、人们——从焦黑的残骸中滋长而出。

每一幅壁画前，都有一尊泥塑成形的守卫者伫立。你走过时，能看见他们矮壮的头颅里，宝石般的眼睛微微转动，追随着你的身影。
You descend into the earth. The narrow, winding paths branch in various directions. Priests seem to navigate these with ease and without the aid of torchlight. Many of them are of races accustomed to under-earth living: white-eyed elves, sallow-skinned dwarves, and whiskered molefolk. You reach a tall cavern that would be cast entirely in darkness if not for the spare few torches burning at key points of the cavern's walls. You see scenes painted in earthen pigments of rich orange, brown, and black upon the stone. The images appear to convey a cycle: order, destruction, reformation. Mountains burst into flame and rain down upon the land. New life—plants, monsters, people—grow from charred remains. At each mural, a clay-formed figure stands guard. You see their gemstone eyes shifting in their squat heads as you pass by.

Charles The Knight.name:
查尔斯·骑士
Charles The Knight

Text.text:
查尔斯身形高大，肌肉如能号令战场的骑士般雄健；绿眸、黑发与黑胡子又为他添上一股粗犷异乡的魅力。他左眼下方横着一道疤，更衬得他气势逼人。他始终把胡子修整得一丝不乱——那是他的尊严与骄傲，也是他严峻外表下那颗善良之心的映照。当他披上锁子甲、握起战镐，双眼战意翻涌时，这位斗士已全然不像那个朴实的商人之子。

~ Played by duckyonfire

With the tall musculature of a knight that can command the field, the green eyes, black hair and beard give Charles a wild outland charisma. He sports a scar under his left eye, making him all the more impressive. He keeps the beard groomed neatly, part of his dignity and pride, and reflective of the kind heart under his stern manner. When he dons chain mail and war pick, his eyes full of battle, this champion is unrecognizable as the modest son of a merchant.

~ Played by duckyonfire

Soup Kitchen Volunteer.name:
施粥所志愿者
Soup Kitchen Volunteer

Text.text:
厨房的窗口柜台后，两口巨大的汤缸腾起滚滚热汽。机械臂在缸上方嗡鸣旋转，将切成细小方丁的食材一把把撒入其中。粗大的真空管抽吸着那股棕米色的汤液，将内容物导向分装台，碗与保温壶在那儿被一一灌满。队伍很长，挤满了瘦削发抖的人们。柜台后，一名四十多岁的女人系着斑驳染污的围裙，神情温柔而疲惫。她在剃得极短的头上裹着一条红色头巾，在这般机械化的环境里显得朴拙又暖和。她向队伍里走近的人打招呼时，许多人也用熟稔的热意回以问候。
Two large vats of soup steam behind the window counter of the kitchen. Robotic arms whir over the vats, adding ingredients that have been diced into tiny cubes. Large vac tubes suck up the brownish-beige liquid and funnel the contents over to a dispensing table where bowls and thermoses are filled. The line is long and full of people who are thin and shivering. Behind the counter, a woman in her mid-forties wears a splotchy, stained apron and a gentle, tired expression. She dons a red bandana over her buzzed head, a quaint and cozy choice in such a robotic environment. As she greets those in line as they approach, many of them greet her with warm familiarity.

I Cast Alter Timeline.name:
我施放《改写时间线》
I Cast Alter Timeline

Text.text:
现实凝固，我将自己从时代的洪流中抽离，漂游于无尽的可能之海。我的星灵之躯穿行于数百条潜在的未来，每一条都以纤毫毕现的细节被我完整经历，直到我找到对同伴最为有利的一线。我以纯粹的意志之力探手触及，攫住命运的丝缕，将它们拽入当下，改写时间线。

~ 构想 by Alex

Reality freezes as I detach myself from the flow of time, drifting through the infinite expanse of possibility. My astral body journeys through hundreds of potential futures, fully experiencing each in vivid detail, until I find one that is most favorable to my party. I reach out with sheer force of will and grasp the strands of fate, pulling them into the present moment and altering the timeline.

~ Envisioned by Alex

I Drink My Potion Of Radiant Resistance.name:
我喝下我的光耀抗力药水
I Drink My Potion Of Radiant Resistance

Text.text:
这瓶浑浊的药剂泛着金色的光。里面漂浮着看似小宝石的东西：黄水晶的碎片、红宝石的细屑、蓝宝石的丝缕。当我一饮而尽，入口顺滑轻盈，宛如春水。滋味甜美而醇厚——仿佛神明赐下的甘露。
The cloudy potion glows with golden light. Items that look like small gems bob within: fragments of citrine, flecks of ruby, filaments of sapphire. When I quaff the mixture, it's as smooth and light as spring water. The taste is sweet and rich—a divine treat.

Sandir Argenvostholt.name:
桑迪尔·阿尔根沃斯特霍尔特
Sandir Argenvostholt

Text.text:
一位夺目的精灵少年，碧绿的眼眸如晨阳下沾露的叶片般闪烁，任由人群将他推挤着穿过繁忙的城市街道。他瘦削的身形在步伐间微微摇晃——怀里护着一本沉重的巨著，肩上还斜挂着一只鼓胀的厚袋。袋侧起伏不止，直到扣带松开一线，一只圆滚滚的鼬鼠悄然钻出，继而扒拉着一路爬上精灵的肩头。精灵的头发——后方金长如瀑，双侧却剃得只剩短茬——几乎遮不住那瑟缩的魔宠，于是这对搭档一路招来古怪的目光。察觉到那些注视，精灵苍白的脸瞬间泛起醇酒般的红；他低下头，咬着牙继续前行。

~ Played by Ethan Scott

A striking elven youth, with viridian eyes that sparkle like dewy leaves in the morning sun, lets the crowd push him through the busy city streets. His narrow frame sways with the weight of a heavy tome he holds protectively against his chest and the bulky bag he has draped over his shoulder. The sides of the bag bulge with movement until the clasp loosens enough for a portly weasel to sidle out then claw his way to the elf's shoulders. The elf's hair—long and golden in the back but shaved to stubble on the sides—does a poor job of obscuring the cowering familiar and the pair earn odd looks. Noticing the stares, the elf's pale face blooms the color of good wine; he lowers his head and presses on.

~ Played by Ethan Scott

一尊行动迟缓、胸膛如木桶般厚实的魔像高耸在你面前，光滑的双腿呈现出柔韧的曲线。绷覆其全身骨架的薄膜既像纸，又像人皮。那层覆盖在构装体面部的皮膜微微起伏，面容几乎成形——仿佛正从黏土中被一点点雕刻出来。 A lumbering barrel-chested golem towers over you on smooth legs shaped in supple curves. The membrane stretched across the entirety of its frame is a little like paper, a little like human skin. The covering ripples across the face of the construct, which is almost defined—like it is being carved out of clay.

粗绳一股股绞拧缠绕，结成一张宽阔的大网。网缘镶着一颗颗粗糙的熟铁小球作坠，使其抛掷更顺手，也能在致命的缠缚中牢牢困住猎物。
The lengths of coarse rope, wound together, form a wide net. Small, rough balls of wrought iron line the sides, weighting it to allow for easy casting and lethal ensnarement.

Desperate Beggar's Request.name:
绝望乞丐的请求
Desperate Beggar's Request

Text.text:
“求求你，求求你帮帮我。我又冷又累又饿。只要你肯分我一点点，我就感激不尽。求求你！”
“Please, oh please help me. I’m so cold and tired and hungry. If you would just part with a little, I would be so grateful. Oh please!”

毒素顽固而不屈，死死缠着你。它一波波袭来，先用剧痛与恶心狠狠抽打你，随后又再度沉寂，赐下仿佛解脱的假象。疼痛侵袭你的全身，自胃部向外蔓延，分叉窜向指尖尽头，带来电击般的刺麻与灼痛。每一次发作，你都被迫蜷成一团，喘得像要窒息，视野翻涌失焦，耳中嗡鸣不止，呕出胃里所剩无几的一切。待它退去，你勉强找回呼吸，却只觉冷汗淋漓，额头冰凉，困倦得只想沉沉睡去。这一切究竟何时才会结束？
The poison is persistent, unyielding. It comes in waves, lashing out with pain and nausea before quieting once again, giving the illusion of relief. The pain affects your entire body, radiating outward from your stomach and forking to the very tips of your fingers with shocking, tingling agony. Each time it comes, you find yourself doubled over, gasping for breath as your vision swims and your ears ring, vomiting up whatever your stomach has left. As it passes, you catch your breath and feel sweaty, cold on your brow, eager to sleep. When will this end?

I Use A Mask Of Epi.name:
我戴上伊庇的面具
I Use A Mask Of Epi

Text.text:
哦不。我感觉喉咙猛然收缩，像被某个幽影攥住般越勒越紧。我来不及去想饭里混了什么——只知道脸正在肿胀，胃里翻江倒海，像泥里打滚的猪般搅得人发昏。我伸手去抓面具，指尖一碰，绑带缝线周围骤然闪出一圈刺目的白光。我把它啪地拍在脸上，霎时一股汹涌得近乎压倒性的肾上腺素冲上来，心脏狂跳，血管灼烧。可不过几秒，喉头便松开了，脸上的皮肤也不再那样痛得一跳一跳。我深深吸进一口清冷的空气，又一口。心跳终于缓回了熟悉的节奏。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Oh no. I feel my throat contract, closing in on itself as if within some specter's grip. I don’t have time to think about what was in the meal—I only know my face is swelling and my stomach is turning over like a pig in mud. I grab for my mask, the seams around the straps flashing white as I touch it. I slap it onto my face and feel a rush of an overwhelming surge of adrenaline, heart throbbing and veins aflame. But in a matter of seconds, my throat loosens and the skin on my face ceases its painful throbbing. I catch one good breath of cool air, and then another. My heartbeat slows to its normal patter.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

消防站的前半部分被打理得一丝不苟——防火夹克、头盔、软管以及各式工具整齐地挂在墙上，触手可及。消防车尽可能贴近车库门停放，擦得锃亮，在任何一刻接到通知都能立刻出动。建筑的后半部分则松散得多，地板上散落着各种私人物品，还有一张全息扑克桌。
The front of the fire station is meticulously organized—fireproof jackets, helmets, hoses, and all kinds of tools hang on the wall in easy reach. The trucks rest as close as possible to the garage door, polished to a shine and ready to roll out at a moment's notice. The back half of the building gets more lax, with various personal items strewn about on the floor and a holographic poker table.

Volcanic Elemental Destroys A Fort.name:
火山元素摧毁一座要塞
Volcanic Elemental Destroys A Fort

Text.text:
村民们一边逃命一边频频回头尖叫，主街尽头的强盗堡垒正被赤红滚烫的熔岩巨岩狂轰滥炸。每一枚“飞弹”都拖着一道浓厚的黑烟弧线坠落，落地时发出沉闷的碾压巨响，伴随一口尖锐的火息。屋顶横梁与墙角立柱被点燃，继而崩塌。空气里弥漫着燃木、焦肉的臭味，以及那名元素袭击者自身躯体所散出的、浓稠而带土腥的焦油气息。镇民与强盗仓促集结。箭矢击中那团燃烧、发光的召唤造物，随即化作灰烬；元素生物则抽身退去，身后留下一串熔岩脚印。

~ 由 Elijah 构想

As villagers on the run look over their shoulders and scream, the bandit fort at the end of the main street is pummeled by red-hot lava rock. Each missile trails an arc of thick black smoke and lands with crushing sounds and the sharp breath of fire. Roof beams and corner posts ignite and collapse. The air smells of burning wood, flesh, and the thick earthy tar of the elemental attacker’s own body. The town and its bandits organize hastily. Arrows strike the burning, glowing conjuration before turning into cinder, and the elemental retreats, leaving lava footsteps in its wake.

~ Envisioned by Elijah

尽管这柄大槌的体型惊人，却自有一种在同类武器中罕见的雅致。它以黑色大理石铸就，辅以纯金温润的色泽点缀，构造夺目；这柄战锤令人屏息，即便是毫无经验的目光，也能一眼看出其卓绝的品质。
Though the maul is of tremendous size, it holds a certain elegance uncommon among weapons of its ilk. A striking construction of black marble accented with the warm tones of pure gold, the hammer is a breathtaking sight, its superior quality evident to even the untrained eye.

干燥草药、菌菇与咕嘟冒泡的液体散发出万千气味，交织成一股令人眩晕的混香——辛辣、刺鼻，却并不讨厌。积尘的架子沿墙排开，每一层都堆满以软木塞封口的玻璃瓶。瓶身标签虽已褪色，仍能辨出成分与用法——从消毒药水、止血凝粉，到缓解疖肿、灼伤与瘀伤的药膏，应有尽有。
The myriad fragrances of dried herbs, fungi, and bubbling liquids create an overwhelming mingling of scents, sharp and acrid, though not unpleasant. Dusty shelves line the walls, each laden with glass bottles stoppered with corks. The labels on the bottles, though faded, include the ingredients and instructions for use—everything from antiseptic liquid to clotting powder to creams to relieve boils, burns, and bruises.

I Cast Stinking Cloud Using Skunk Cabbag.name:
我用臭鼬白菜施放恶臭云
I Cast Stinking Cloud Using Skunk Cabbage

Text.text:
我低声咕哝着咒文，间或用粗鲁地噗噗噘唇作点缀。手里攥着一把硕大的心形叶片，我猛地一拧，逼出它们的恶臭。腐肉的腥烂气味直冲鼻腔，随之而来的魔法蒸汽猛然喷涌，在敌人头顶炸开一团令人作呕的昏黄毒云。从他们呛咳干呕的样子看，那边的味道肯定更要命。
I mutter an incantation, punctuated by a rude flapping of my lips. Clutching a handful of large heart-shaped leaves, I give them a twist to release their stench. The odor of rotting meat assails my nostrils as an answering puff of magical vapor erupts in a noxious yellow cloud over my enemies. Judging by their choking and gagging, the smell over there must be a lot worse.

Threat From A Spurned Black Dragon Vampi.name:
来自被轻蔑拒绝的黑龙吸血鬼（特征）的威胁
Threat From A Spurned Black Dragon Vampire

Text.text:
她披着黑暗精灵的伪装，如同一袭奢华的斗篷。由无数细小、层层叠叠的黑曜石碎片织成的长裙倾泻至足踝，闪烁的波纹如浪潮般流动。她双臂僵直垂在身侧，指节紧扣，怒意几乎要从指缝间溢出；下巴高扬，傲慢的愤慨写在每一道线条里。“想不到我竟把永恒里的一滴，浪费在你这种忘恩负义的生物身上。你以为你有资格伤我？像虫子钻进面包一样在我脑子里爬行？哦不，亲爱的，就算要花上一千年，你will学会敬畏。你会以我应得的爱与恐惧仰望我！”她的双眼燃着刻毒的怨火，讥笑扭曲了那饱满血红的唇，露出森然獠牙。“然后……我会把你当作你那不值一提的空壳一样丢弃。”

~ Envisioned by Rakio

She wears the guise of a dark elf like a luxurious mantle. A gown of tiny overlapping spalls of obsidian cascades to her feet in shimmering waves. Her arms are rigid at her sides, fingers crimped with barely contained wrath, chin lifted in haughty outrage. “To think I wasted a drop of my eternity on such an ungrateful creature. You think you have the right to wound me? To move through my mind like a worm through bread? Oh no, my darling, even if it takes a thousand years, you will learn respect. You will look upon me with the love and terror I am owed!" Her eyes burn with scathing venom, and a sneer twists her full, blood-red lips, baring wicked fangs. "And then… I will discard you like the worthless husk you are.”

~ Envisioned by Rakio

Giant Centipedes Unleashed On Arena.name:
巨型蜈蚣被放入竞技场
Giant Centipedes Unleashed On Arena

Text.text:
自黑暗中，你听见远超想象的无数足肢窸窣爬动。令人作呕的洪流猛然喷涌而出，巨型蜈蚣破闸般涌入竞技场，咔哒作响的颚钳滴落黏稠的绿毒。它们如甲壳浪潮般向你扑来，迫不及待要尝一口温热的血肉。

~ 由 Inbal 在 Discord 上 Envisioned

From the darkness, you hear the skittering rustle of far too many legs. Bursting forth in a repulsive torrent, the giant centipedes erupt into the arena, their snapping mandibles dripping with viscous green poison. They lunge toward you in a chitinous tide, eager to taste warm flesh.

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

一声干涩刺耳的呻吟在空间里回荡，像枯风般割裂寂静。拖沓的脚步声从四面八方同时逼近，仿佛无处不在。那腐朽的生物踉跄步入视野，你看清它佝偻畸形的躯壳。烂布裹满它腐败的身体每一寸，还像斗篷般在身后拖曳。它又呻吟了一声——无唇的口几乎要挤出词句——而在那深陷的漆黑眼眶里，有幽光缓缓渗出。
A dry, rasping moan reverberates through the space, cutting the silence like an arid wind. Footsteps, dragging, seem to approach from all directions at once. As the moldering creature steps into view, you take in its slouched, misshapen form. Rotting cloth wraps every inch of its decaying body, and drags behind it like a cloak. It moans again—almost forming words with its lipless mouth—and from its sunken, dark eye sockets, a glow emanates.

你将双拳伸直举在身前，随着你低声呢喃那些不可理解的词句，拳头开始嘶嘶作响、嗡嗡震颤。你把双拳缓缓拉开，在掌间扯出一根狂乱能量凝成的细杆，像一支标枪——更小，却更致命。当你收臂蓄势准备掷出时，那道瞬息万变的矢光尚未决定自己要成为什么；而在你松手的刹那，它的抉择已然落定。

~ 格鲁姆·伍尔夫斯坦

Holding your fists outstretched in front of you, they start to fizz and vibrate as you mutter words beyond understanding. You pull your fists apart, creating a thin rod of frenzied energy not unlike a javelin—smaller, but more deadly. As you pull back your arm to launch it, the ever-changing bolt does not yet know what it wants to be, but as you release, its decision is made.

~ Grum Wulfstan

Vial Of Oil Of Taggit.name:
塔吉特昏睡油小瓶
Vial Of Oil Of Taggit

Text.text: [察觉] 小瓶呈暗哑黄铜色，瓶塞为琥珀色树脂，内嵌软木封口。沿着塞缘萦绕着一丝淡淡的、甚至称得上怡人的某种类人麝香气息。 [解析] 塔吉特对皮肤了如指掌，这一点毋庸置疑。戴着手套的指尖蘸上一点，便能描过女子的耳廓，或按上男子赤裸的手掌；接下来只需等他们失去意识时扶住身体——或者在你漫不经心地撤离时，听见他们倒地的声响。 [Perceived] The vial is dull brass, the stopper an amber resin with a cork seal. Around the stopper’s edge is the mild, even pleasant, aroma of some humanoid musk. [Analyzed] Taggit knew skin, that much is certain. A gloved finger dipped in this can trace a woman’s ear or press a man’s bare hand, and all that’s left is to catch the body when they lose consciousness—or hear them fall during one’s casual escape.

Enchanting A Heavily-processed Item.name:
为一件深度加工的物品附魔
Enchanting A Heavily-processed Item

Text.text:
你的双手悬在那件寻常的物品上方，蓄势待发，准备以一泻千里的奥术洪流灌注魔法能量。你压低声音咏诵字句，空气里弥漫开那股明显的臭氧气息——这是魔法共鸣逐渐堆叠的征兆。

[失败] 当最后的词句离开你的唇边，你将凝聚出的能量倾泻进物品，竭力把自己的力量烙进其中——却徒劳无功。物品早已偏离其天然本态太远，无法接纳这份魔法。

[成功] 魔法在四周嗡鸣震荡，你将法术的力量释放进物品，欣喜地看着它将能量尽数纳入。尽管它已被加工成形，这件物品仍保留了足够的自然质地，得以承载魔法。

~ 由一位英雄 设想

Your hands hover over the mundane item, ready to bestow magical energies in a flood of arcane power. As you recite the words under your breath, the tell-tale scent of ozone permeates the air around you—a sign of the magical resonance building.

[Failure] As the last words leave your lips, you unleash the conjured energy into the item, straining to implant it with your power—to no avail. The item is simply too far removed from its natural state to accept the magic.

[Success] Magic thrums all around as you unleash the spell’s power into the item, and watch in delight as it accepts the energies. Despite its processed nature, the item has retained enough of its natural qualities to host the magic.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

托座、拱心石、楼梯扶手柱、过梁，以及其他常带装饰性的建筑构件倚靠着墙壁，在这座开阔、谷仓般的建筑里整齐成排地立着。你原以为它们是学徒的练习品，或是工地上被淘汰的次品，可每一件看起来都做工精良。大厅尽头，一名男子站在一圈悬挂的灯笼之间，正对着一块石料敲敲打打，沉浸在手头的活计里，对周遭浑然不觉。
Corbels, keystones, newels, lintels, and other often decorative architectural elements lean against the walls and stand in tidy rows throughout this open, barn-like structure. You assume them to be practice pieces by apprentices, or perhaps rejects from on-site work, but all look like fine craftsmanship. At the far end of the halls a man stands among a ring of hanging lanterns, pinging and pounding at a block of stone, distracted by his work.

Data Storm Resisted By Player.name:
数据风暴被玩家抵御
Data Storm Resisted By Player

Text.text:
他们向你举起双手，敌手的掌心骤然炸裂成数据触手，猛地跃起，直扑你的化身。你一眼认出这次攻击是强制上传，随即启动整套防御工具应对。你的通知在刹那间变成血红，随后杀毒程序将攻击硬生生踢出你的设备——只留下深沉的抽痛——但至少，你的反应速度仍然正常。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Raising their hands to you, your adversary’s palms suddenly explode into tentacles of data, which leap toward your persona. You recognize the attack as a forced upload, and you execute your suite of defense utilities in response. Your notifications go red for a split second before your antivirus kicks the attack back out of your rig—leaving a deep throb of pain—but at least your response time is normal.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Sundries From A Nest Of Aberrant Rats.name:
畸变鼠巢的杂物
Sundries From A Nest Of Aberrant Rats

Text.text:
你仍能听见逃窜鼠群远去时的吱吱尖叫与窸窣疾爬声——它们暂且退却。你一脚踢开被你宰杀的鼠尸，裸露的脑浆从颅骨里滚落出来；那颅骨上曾经阴毒的幽绿光芒，如今也已消散。它们那狭小、恶臭的巢穴里并没多少值得一提的东西：几缕破布用来垫窝，几片沾满下水道污垢的金属碎片；更不堪入目的，是一截类人生物的指骨，上面还黏着些许血肉，颜色发黑，干枯皴裂。
You can still hear the squeaking and skittering of the fleeing swarm, retreating for now. You kick away the corpses of the rats you’ve slain, their exposed brains rolling out of their skulls, which are now free from that insidious green glow. You do not find much in their small, stinking lair: torn bits of cloth to build up their nest, pieces of sewer-grimed metal, and, even less savory, a humanoid finger bone with bits of flesh still clinging to it, dark and desiccated.

Rogue Technomancer.name:
游荡的科技术士
Rogue Technomancer

Text.text:
在加密矿工的安防网络办公室里，那张五边形的监控桌前，这种稀有品种的夜行特工站在一团紫色数据流的云雾中——从他的镜片里投射出来，仿佛未经雕琢的原始魔力。数据流在他周身盘旋翻涌，偶尔迸出微型电磁脉冲的火花。他不触发任何警报，不被任何摄像头捕捉。戴着VR手套的双手穿过数据流，像法师的手势般精准，向目标的哈希流中施放一道数字扰乱法术。虚拟钱。

~ 一位英雄 构想

At the pentagonal desk of monitors in a crypto-miner's security network office, this rare breed of noc stands in a cloud of purple datastreams—projected like raw mana from his lenses. They whirl around him, occasionally sparking with micro-EMPs. He triggers no alarms, registers on no cams. His VR gloves move through the datastream like a wizard's hands, casting a digital diversion spell into his target's Hashing stream. Virtual money.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Summoning A Digital Spirit.name:
召唤数字灵体
Summoning A Digital Spirit

Text.text:
零星的代码——从非法U盘里拼凑、从企业金库中一块块偷拓出来——既不成其义，也不属于任何系统可识别的语言。它需要一名技法师。凭借自制的转译器与校验器，那些横跨诸界的桥梁，他把手探入被遗忘的、混沌翻涌的赛博深渊。与此同时，他又将意识伸向另一端：从卷轴与残破羊皮纸上死记硬背的古老奥术。随后，他一边吟唱一边编写代码，绷紧心神，呼唤一位数字盟友。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The smatterings of code—collected from illicit flash drives, lifted in patches from corporate vaults—don’t make sense, and are not a language recognized by any system. It needs a technomancer. Using his own transpilers and checkers, bridges between worlds, he reaches into the forgotten chaotic depths of cyberspace. Simultaneously he reaches in another direction, toward spells memorized off scrolls and parchment scraps of old arcana. Then he chants and codes at the same time, while straining his mind to call for a digital ally.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The Misery Curse.name:
苦厄诅咒
The Misery Curse

Text.text:
这个法术没有任何施法材料，只有你耳中血液擂鼓般的轰鸣，以及你对良知的决绝摒弃。你的目标在痛苦中挣扎——而你正是始作俑者——随着你一步步把那个尚可被原谅的自己剥离殆尽，法术便生效，继续运转，越钻越深。
There are no components to this spell but the pounding of your own blood in your ears and the rejection of your conscience. Your target is in pain—you are the cause—and the spell works, drives deeper, as you become less and less of a forgivable self.

Caravan Attacked By Hostage-taking Bandi.name:
商队遭到挟持人质的土匪袭击
Caravan Attacked By Hostage-taking Bandits

Text.text:
商队在密林中颠簸前行，乘客们忽然察觉到一种令人不安的声响——寂静。转瞬之间，树线轰然炸开，土匪自灌木丛中猛冲而出，箭矢在空中尖啸穿行。伤者的惨叫与厮杀的喧嚣交织一处，护卫们竭力护住车队，在泥泞的混乱中尽可能结阵抵挡。一只麻袋被猛地套上某位精灵男子的头，他被拽倒在地，随即被那群无赖拖走，悄无声息地消失在林中。

~ 由 Ameria 在 Discord 上 构想

As the caravan trundles through the dense forest, the passengers notice an unsettling sound—silence. Moments later the tree line erupts as bandits charge from the undergrowth and arrows sing through the air. Cries of the wounded mingle with the uproar of battle as guards attempt to protect the wagons, forming up as best they can in the muddy tumult. A sack is thrown over the head of an elven man, who is dragged to the ground and spirited away into the forest by the ruffians.

~ Envisioned by Ameria on Discord

I Turn The Unholy: Oath Of Devotion Pala.name:
I 驱散邪祟：奉献之誓圣武士
I Turn The Unholy: Oath Of Devotion Paladin

Text.text:
我将剑尖指向地面，举起剑柄末端的圣徽，高声说道：“在我面前退散吧，你们这些不洁的畜生！”随即，剑柄末端迸射出神圣的光辉，空气也随着我的信念震颤。

[成功] 恶魔与亡灵在我的神圣敕令下瑟缩退避。有些家伙……照做了。

Pointing my sword at the ground, I present the holy symbol on its pommel, saying, “Flee before me, you unclean beasts!” In response, the pommel flashes with divine light and the air pulses with my conviction.

[Success] Fiends and undead wince at my divine command. Some of them obey…

这头生物魁梧强悍、皮实而顽固，踏着粗壮的肌肉长腿踉跄逼近。它身披厚重的部族皮毛，以皮革与怪异的外星织物捆扎缝合成片。颈间垂着一枚洁白通透的石质坠饰，系在绳上，其上刻着猩红的铭文。它的身躯仿佛自带甲胄，覆着硬化矿物的板甲般层层护住，令它神情肃杀，满是军武气息。那岩质甲板在末端收束成凶狠的利爪，从双手每一处指节上狰狞生长而出。
Hulking, hearty, and tenacious, this creature stumbles forward on muscular legs. They’re clad in heavy tribal furs banded together with leather and odd alien fabrics. A pendant of clear white stone hangs on a string from their neck, engraved with a scarlet inscription. Their very body seems armored, plated with hardened minerals, giving them a serious and militaristic expression. The rocky plating ends in vicious claws that grow from the knuckles of each hand.

Space Pirate Flagship: Disorderly Bridge.name:
太空海盗旗舰：混乱的舰桥
Space Pirate Flagship: Disorderly Bridge

Text.text:
旗舰宽敞的舰桥上毫无统一规格可言，每一件装备都明显是从别的船只上掠夺来、再胡乱改装拼上的。杂糅的技术拼贴更衬得这间舱室凌乱而割裂：形形色色、大小不一、各个种族的海盗各司其职，听命于船长——她斜倚在那张张扬奢华的座椅上，活像披着不羁的王座。
Nothing is standardized aboard the flagship’s ample bridge, with every piece of equipment clearly looted and retrofitted from other vessels. The collage of technology adds to the disparate nature of the room as pirates of all shapes, sizes, and species go about their business, obeying the orders of the captain draped roguishly in her ostentatious chair.

Children’s Rhyme About Royal Deaths.name:
关于王族之死的童谣
Children’s Rhyme About Royal Deaths

Text.text:
公主在花园里漫步了约莫一小时。
她撞见一条紫藤，攀着她的高塔往上爬。
她双手攥住，使出浑身力气猛拽。
那竟是一条紫色毒蛇，獠牙含毒一咬就要命！

小王子爱马成痴，待他稍长能跑能跳，
便扮作农家少年，悄悄溜进马厩。
他翻身上马，自以为像模像样，
那匹种马却把王子掀翻，砸在沉重的马车底下！

国王在寝宫里，炉火轰鸣如兽，
饮下一杯葡萄酒，好让自己安然入睡。
他绊住华贵的王袍，错过了床沿，
一头跌进壁炉里，如今已然断气！

王后立于阳台，要宣读她的演说；
风把讲稿卷走，顷刻令她哑口无言。
她纵身去抓那几页纸——可王后也不会飞，
于是如今阳台再不建得那般高！

~ 构想：Girlhead

The princess walked the gardens for about an hour.
She came upon a purple vine that climbed her tower.
She took it in her hands and pulled with all her might.
It was a purple snake with poison in its bite!

The little prince loved horses and when he was able,
He dressed as a farm boy and snuck out to the stable.
He climbed onto a horse and though he looked the part,
The stallion threw the prince beneath a heavy cart!

The king was in his chambers with a roaring fire
And drank a glass of wine to help him to retire.
He tripped upon his royal robes and missed his bed,
Fell right into the fireplace and now he’s dead!

The queen was at the balcony to read her speeches;
The wind carried her notes away and left her speechless.
She leapt to catch the pages though a queen can't fly,
So now they don’t build balconies to be so high!

~ Envisioned by Girlhead

Firbolg Ritual With Fox.name:
与狐共行的菲尔博格仪式
Firbolg Ritual With Fox

Text.text:
合上那双硕大、带着牛般温顺的眼睛，女人在圣洁的供品前屈膝跪下，将长长的绯红辫发甩到肩后。她那宽松、磨旧的衣衫披着春祭艺人般欢快的色彩，可在此处，她举止却收敛成一股精致的优雅与庄重，确保她开口吟诵的每一个音节都准确而清晰。她身侧，一只小狐狸——眼中闪烁着锐利而探究的聪慧——守夜般兴致盎然地注视着这一幕。

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

Closing large, bovine eyes, the woman tosses long crimson braids over her shoulders as she kneels before the sacred offering. Though her loose, well-worn clothing bears the joyous colors of a performer at a spring festival, she conducts herself with refined grace and dignity here, ensuring each word of the chant she begins is precise and clear. At her side, a small fox—its eyes alight with keen, probing intelligence—watches the scene with great interest.

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

Volcanic Island In A Boiling Underground.name:
沸腾地下湖中的火山岛
Volcanic Island In A Boiling Underground Lake

Text.text:
蒸汽自广袤的地下蓄水湖那咸涩浑浊的水面袅袅升起；湖水被深处的地热喷口永恒地灼成沸腾。湖心那座孤悬于小小岩岛上的巍峨火山，峰顶翻涌着黑烟；丝丝缕缕的烟羽探向洞窟穹顶——仿佛在寻找通往外界的出口。一次地震般的震颤撼动了这座独眼巨人般的巨窟，滚烫的白炽岩浆从火山翻腾的破火山口喷薄而出，刹那间以炽烈的橙红火光将洞内照亮。

~ Sahlonahl 于 Discord

Steam rises from the brackish surface of the vast underground reservoir, its waters permanently heated to boiling by thermal vents in the depths below. Black smoke billows from the summit of an imposing volcano marooned on the small rocky island at the lake's center, wispy tendrils probing the cavern roof—trying to find an exit to the world beyond. A seismic tremor rocks the cyclopean cavern and torrents of white-hot magma spew from the volcano's bubbling caldera, briefly illuminating the cave in hues of fiery orange.

~ Sahlonahl on Discord

在万籁俱寂的深夜，月轮高悬天穹正中，午夜钟声敲响——随之而来的，是毒性发作。你的脸颊骤然潮红，滚烫得猝不及防，眩晕翻涌而上，令你一阵发虚。腹中像被拧成死结，你痛得弯下腰，剧痛来得又急又狠，尖锐得让视野都被搅得模糊。耳畔嗡鸣不止，你颤抖着抬手触及面颊——指尖收回时，已染上血色。
In the dead of night, as the moon is at its zenith in the sky, midnight strikes—and with it comes the effects of the poison. Your face flushes, hot and sudden, and you feel faint as dizziness overtakes you. Your guts tie themselves in knots and you double over in pain, the agony so sudden and piercing that it blurs your vision. Your ears ring, and with a shaking hand, you reach up. Your fingers come away stained with blood.

Tournament Paramour.name:
比武场上的情人
Tournament Paramour

Text.text:
一位勾人的女子优雅地走在一名退役骑士身旁，身上那件略显惊世骇俗的礼服是耀眼的猩红。她未束的长发随意披落背后——如同倾泻而下的午夜墨潭——颈间戴着一串珍珠项链。但再无其他饰物能与她的美丽争辉。她娴雅动人的笑意与闪烁的眸光引来无数倾慕的目光。
An alluring woman walks elegantly beside a retired knight, her somewhat scandalous dress a vibrant scarlet. Her unbound hair flows loosely down her back—like a pool of cascading midnight—and she wears a necklace of pearls. But no other jewelry competes with her beauty. Her winsome smile and glinting eyes attract many admirers.

Glitzy Synth-guitar.name:
华丽的合成器吉他
Glitzy Synth-guitar

Text.text:
这是一把绚烂夺目的合成器吉他。两条带键的指板自五彩斑斓的琴身中昂起，而琴底部则被重度改装：各式电线与旋钮纵横交错，只为制造出最响、最刺耳、几乎要撕裂鼓膜的音乐。一条饰有舌头图案的背带松垂着。要驾驭这件乐器，看起来所需的技能几乎不亚于操纵一架战斗无人机。
This is a synth-guitar of dazzling colors. Two fretboards lined with keys rise from a multicolored housing, and the base of the guitar has been heavily modified with all manner of wires and knobs, all intended to produce the loudest, most ear-splitting music possible. A carry strap detailed with a tongue hangs loose. Operating this instrument looks like it would take as much skill as piloting a combat drone.

I Stand Against The Tide.name:
我逆潮而立
I Stand Against The Tide

Text.text:
我佯装站得四平八稳，把自己摆成一个诱人的目标，让人轻易误判。敌人一旦上钩，我便朝另一名敌人方向后撤，迫使攻击者用力过猛、破绽大开。就在最后一瞬，我侧身闪开。惯性便把袭击者的这一击带偏，狠狠砸向另一个敌人。
I pretend to stand flat-footed, making myself a tempting target, easily misjudged. When my enemy takes the bait, I retreat toward another foe. I force my attacker to overextend. At the last instant, I dodge. And momentum carries my assailant’s strike into the other enemy.

Beautiful Silver Brooch.name:
精美的银胸针
Beautiful Silver Brooch

Text.text:
如同蕾丝一般，它繁复的花丝纹样是无数小时精细劳作的结晶。纤细的银丝被塑成蝴蝶的形态，别针与扣环为这枚胸针的脆弱赋予坚实的平衡，直到它落在斗篷或围巾之上。
Like lace, its complicated filigree is the product of many hours of careful toil. The fine wire of silver is shaped like a butterfly, and the pin and catch give a strong balance to the fragility of the brooch until it lands on a cloak or scarf.

Ring Of Animal Influence.name:
动物支配之戒
Ring Of Animal Influence

Text.text:
这是一圈木制箍环，其上刻蚀着各式动物的图纹。刻痕从狼与熊龇牙咆哮的侧影，延展到啮齿小兽的剪影——狡黠的尖鼻微翘，耳朵竖立。
This is a band of wood etched with the images of various animals. The etchings range from the snarling profiles of wolves and bears to the silhouettes of rodents with their impish snouts and perked ears.

Speech About Hidden Dragons.name:
关于潜龙的演说
Speech About Hidden Dragons

Text.text:
“我听说有些龙能伪装自己，混在我们中间行走。也许要是我们把彼此都当成潜伏的秘密巨龙来对待，世界会变得更好。至少，我们都会更有礼貌。”
“I heard that some dragons can disguise themselves and walk among us. Maybe if we all treated each other like secret dragons, the world would be a better place. Least, we’d all be more polite.”

The Cape Of Archambault.name:
阿尔尚博披风
The Cape Of Archambault

Text.text:
这件斗篷以阿尔尚博传奇坐骑——亦是他最亲密的挚友——的翼膜施法织就；那头飞龙因年迈逝去后，它的遗骸被化作此物。斗篷呈心血般的深红色。自下摆至兜帽足有八英尺长，筋骨分明、皮革般坚韧，却出奇轻盈；系绳则由纺成的黄金拧成。它能抵御任何天气的侵袭，而胸前以一种来自更残酷时代的魔法文字刻着：凡逆我而飞者，必坠。
Spell-crafted from the wings of Archambault’s legendary mount—and closest friend—after the wyvern passed away from old age, the cape is the deep red of heart’s blood. Eight feet in length from hem to hood, ribbed and leathery, yet light, the cape has a drawstring of spun gold. It is impervious to any weather, and across the chest in a magical script from a more brutal time are the words: He who flies against me, falls.

The Sanctuary: Mine Entrance.name:
圣所：矿井入口
The Sanctuary: Mine Entrance

Text.text:
一辆空荡荡的木制矿车停在轨道上，在潮湿的微风里轻轻晃动，发出吱呀的呻吟。轨道很快没入山脚一道黑黢黢的洞口，仿佛被硬生生凿进岩壁。凑近矿车细看，车身两侧被巨大的爪痕撕出一道道深沟。
An empty wooden minecart sits on tracks, squeaking as it rolls slightly in the humid breeze. The tracks quickly disappear into a dark opening carved into the base of the mountain. A closer at the cart reveals large claw marks gouged into its sides.

I Draw An Arrow From My Efficient Quiver.name:
我从高效箭囊中抽出一支箭
I Draw An Arrow From My Efficient Quiver

Text.text: 当我从箭袋里抽出一支箭时，先响起一声轻柔的咔嗒，随即又像被什么填补般归于沉寂。抽出时有一丝抗力，仿佛我正把箭杆从某种禁锢中拽离。就好像那片空间深处仍想紧紧攥住它。 A soft click precedes its replacement as I draw an arrow from my quiver. There is a slight resistance, as if I’m pulling the shaft free of entrapment. It’s as though the space within wants to hold on.

一滴水在你的指尖颤动。你低声呢喃出命令，任那水珠坠落——它倏然爆裂，化作巍然高墙——随你手腕一抖，巨浪便以不可阻挡的咆哮轰然向前推进。
A single drop of water trembles on your fingertip. Murmuring a command, you let the droplet fall—as it erupts into a towering wall—and, with a flick of your wrist, you send the wave surging forward with an implacable roar.

Trex The Barbarian.name:
特雷克斯，野蛮人
Trex The Barbarian

Text.text:
猫族人咧开尖利的牙齿，露出一抹顽皮的笑，胡须微微翘起，橙色的眼睛扫视着区域。他左耳缺了一大块，切口利落得像是被迅捷的刀刃一削而过。他穿着朴素的衣物——里面甚至没有轻甲衫或皮背心——一把长剑用褪色的腰带束在背上，腰带上布满与他一样多的凿痕、割口与粗糙磨损。他把布条一圈圈勒紧在拳头上，几处黑色皮毛缺失，伤疤深得把毛都刮走了。

~ Played by Jo H

The catfolk bares pointed teeth in a cheeky grin, his whiskers perking as his orange eyes scan the area. A chunk of his left ear is gone, cut cleanly as if sliced through by a swift blade. He wears plain clothes—not even a shirt of light mail or leather jerkin underneath—and a longsword strapped to his back by a faded belt riddled with as many gouges, cuts and rough patches as him. He tightens cloth wraps around his fists, patches of black fur missing where scars run too deep.

~ Played by Jo H

Phantom Steed With Radiating Eyes.name:
散发光芒的魅影战马之眼
Phantom Steed With Radiating Eyes

Text.text:
随着最后一句咒言落下，你的召唤已然完成。那匹马的双眼如炽热煤炭般灼亮，将它的额头映入一片深沉阴影。缰绳垂挂在它修长而强健的颈项上，尾巴一甩，迫不及待要踏上旅程。
With the final words spoken, your summoning is complete. The horse’s eyes, radiating like hot coals, paint its brow in a deep shadow. Reins drape over its long, powerful neck and its tail flicks, impatient to begin the journey.

Quip By Low Intelligence Party Member Ab.name:
一个脑子不太灵光的队友对着带陷阱的箱子嘀咕：“瞧吧，它肯定只是想抱抱我们。”
Quip By Low Intelligence Party Member About A Trapped Chest

Text.text:
“各位，能不能谁再帮我看看这个？我看不懂，但总觉得里面有什么东西能要了我的命。”
“Hey everyone, could someone else look at this? I don’t understand it but I’m getting the feeling something in it could kill me.”

Nursery In A Manor.name:
庄园里的育婴室
Nursery In A Manor

Text.text:
这里的光线昏柔而宜人，透过半透明的帘幕摇曳流淌；帘子在微风里轻轻扑动。屋外花园的馥郁香气被送进来，悄然沉落成一缕淡淡却勾人的香氛。靠墙的一侧是一张巨大的橡木婴儿床，占据了整面墙的视线；床垫羽绒般柔软，却又结实到足以支撑一个熟睡的孩子。床垫上躺着一只毛绒玩具，像是熊的身子，却顶着猫头鹰的脑袋。对面的墙上排着一层又一层的搁架——装得高过小手够得到的高度，却又低到大人伸手便能触及上头的书与玩具。房间一角摆着一把摇椅，想必已有数十年光景；它似乎由一整块木头雕成，纹饰繁复，静静守着这间屋子的安宁。
The light here is dim and pleasant, wavering through the transluscent curtains that flutter in the breeze. The fragrant smells from the gardens outside waft in, settling into a faint but alluring poutpourri. A large, oaken crib dominates one wall, the mattress inside downy soft, but firm enough to support a child sleeping inside. A stuffed toy, something resembling a bear with the head of an owl, lies on the mattress. Shelves upon shelves line the opposite wall, mounted high enough to avoid little hands, but low enough for an adult to reach the books and toys atop them. A rocking chair, likely decades old, carved elaborately from what appears to be a single piece of wood, sits in one corner of the room.

Unexpected Archaeological Discovery.name:
意外的考古发现
Unexpected Archaeological Discovery

Text.text:
拂去千年的尘埃，求知若渴的学者双眼骤然睁大——沙下并非他们预想中布满坑洼的砂岩，而是一抹幽蓝如天的金属冷光，正微微闪烁。他们的手因期待而颤抖，却仍稳稳地继续清理，想揭开更多被掩埋的物体。队员们在旁守夜，低声耳语着诅咒与来自群星彼岸的访客。
Brushing the ancient dust aside, the inquisitive academic's eyes widen as they discover shimmering cerulean metal in place of the pockmarked sandstone they expected beneath the sands. Their hands tremble with anticipation as they work steadily to uncover more of the buried object. Their crew watches on, whispering of curses and visitors from beyond the stars.

Enchanter Academy Winter Sunrise.name:
附魔师学院：冬日曙光
Enchanter Academy Winter Sunrise

Text.text:
清冷的苍白在清晨鼓励的注视下，像湖冰般咔嚓裂开。金色的光把塔楼的灰石烘暖，那塔仿佛如缠绕的藤蔓般苏醒、扭动。随着黎明灌满宅邸的公共厅与寝室，学生们先把自己缩在被窝里，攒足勇气，才施放一天里的第一道法术。暖热地板。拨旺炉火。召来热茶。
The pale cold cracks like lake ice under the encouraging eye of morning. Golden light warms the gray stone of the tower, which seems to wake like a twisting vine. As the house common rooms and bedchambers fill with the dawn, students hunker under their covers before screwing up their courage to cast the day’s first spells. Warm the floor. Stoke the fire. Summon tea.

Sundries From A Seelie Queen.name:
仙灵女王的杂物
Sundries From A Seelie Queen

Text.text:
布满瘿结、狂放生长的木质手镯，天鹅绒般的苔藓半披风，月桂冠——这些曾浸满仙灵魅惑的饰物，如今尽失光华。没有光泽也没有色彩，它们与那倒下的女王一样死寂无声。
Bangles of wood wild with burls, a half-cape of velvet moss, a crown of laurel—these adornments once suffused with faerie allure have lost their luster. Without sheen or color, they are as lifeless as the fallen queen.

Civilian Trading Vessel: Chilled Cargo H.name:
民用商船：冷藏货舱
Civilian Trading Vessel: Chilled Cargo Hold

Text.text:
木箱与桶子塞满了这艘商船的货舱，仿佛一群挤作一团的人潮，在狭窄的船腹里彼此推搡着争夺空间。天花板通风口送来的气流冰冷而陈旧，你看见自己的呼吸在空气中凝成白雾。霜花沿着货物边缘结起，像一层细薄的雪粉。
Crates and barrels fill the hold of the trading vessel like a gathered crowd, each one jostling for space in the confines of the ship. The air humming through the vents in the ceiling is cool and stale, and you notice your breath misting. Frost rimes the cargo like delicate snow.

Vampire's Manor: Attic.name:
吸血鬼（特征）的庄园：阁楼
Vampire's Manor: Attic

Text.text:
阁楼门吱呀一声被推开，一架缺了几根横档的梯子滑落下来，给予你进入的许可。你的脑海不由得勾勒出扭曲畸形的剪影，潜伏在视线之外的咫尺之处。你攀上摇摇欲坠的梯子，当你踏入阁楼空间时，霉烂的恶臭瞬间将你淹没。堆叠的箱笼与成堆的杂物在你周围投下怪诞而阴森的影子，而远墙上那扇被木板封死的圆窗，仅有一丝天光渗入。你左侧有什么东西动了，贴着覆满尘埃的地板窜行而过。
The attic door creaks open, and a ladder missing rungs slides downward to allow access. Your mind conjures images of misshapen silhouettes, lurking just beyond your sight. You climb the rickety ladder and as you step up into the attic space, the stench of mildew overwhelms you. Stacked crates and piles of debris create strange and sinister shadows all around you, while the barest hint of daylight seeps through the circular, boarded-up window set into the far wall. Something moves to your left, skittering across the dust-shrouded floorboards.

Skiing In Summer.name:
盛夏滑雪
Skiing In Summer

Text.text:
在深冬玻璃球里，雪一年到头都在下。一个闷热的傍晚将尽，讲座与实验室课程散场后，几十名学生结伴走下台阶，踏入寒意。他们围上围巾，戴好手套，穿起越野滑雪靴，拉低针织帽檐。他们笑着惊叹魔法生活的奇妙——靴底咔哒一声扣进固定器，然后一同出发，在塔下那枚巨大的雪景玻璃球之中，穿行于冬之谷地深厚松雪的漫长雪道。
In Deep Winter Globe, the snow falls all year, and on a sweltering late afternoon, after lectures and labs, dozens of students walk together down the stairs and into the cold. They put on scarves, gloves, cross-country boots, and knit hats. They laugh at the wonder of a magical life, at snapping their boots into bindings for a long ski together through the deep powder of a winter valley inside a giant snow globe beneath the tower.

Spacegoing Slaver's Vessel: Cargo Hold.name:
星际奴贩船：货舱
Spacegoing Slaver's Vessel: Cargo Hold

Text.text:
悲恸与苦难玷污了这片洞窟般宽阔的舱底污浊空气，与汗臭与秽物流出的恶臭交织在一起。一排排奴隶被锁链拴在粗糙的金属长凳上，双脚磨得血肉模糊，发黑结痂。除了最新被押来的那一批，所有人的眼中都已不见希望。
Sorrow and misery taint the foul air in the cavernous hold, mingling with the stench of body odor and effluence. Rows of slaves sit chained to rough metal benches, their feet raw and blackened. Hope has left the eyes of all but the newest arrivals.

盗贼脸上挂着一抹潇洒的笑——尽管那笑意沾着血点；他们神色安然，仿佛早就知道结局会是如此。一只僵硬的手紧攥着一只喝空的酒杯，像是在为一段不虚此生举杯致意。
A dashing smile—albeit one flecked with blood—is painted across the rogue’s face; they seem at ease, like they always knew it would end this way. A drained tankard is clutched in one rigid hand, as if toasting a life well lived.

幽暗潮湿的隧道在压迫性的岩壁间蜿蜒延伸，石面沁着水光，湿滑黏腻。粘稠纠结的蛛网横贯其间，覆在地面、顶壁与四周岩壁上，如同阴森的帷幕层层垂落。你越往深处走，越能看见散落的白骨与干瘪的尸骸——野兽与类人皆有——被丝网裹成茧，生命早已被抽空。你后颈寒毛倒竖，洞窟深处传来细碎的啮啮声与移动的窸窣。黑色多毛的蜘蛛在纤维般的蛛网间爬行，在这阴湿的黑暗里显得格外庞大。有什么巨物在蛛网帘幕之后蠕动——你瞥见多节的长腿，以及一具如牛车般大小的躯体。
The dark, dank tunnels wind their way through the oppressive stone, slick with moisture. Webbing, sticky and tangled, spans the tunnels, coating the floor, ceiling, and walls, draping like ghastly curtains. As you delve deeper into the tunnels, you find scattered bones and emaciated corpses—beasts and humanoids alike—cocooned in the silken webbing and drained of life. The hairs rise on the back of your neck as you detect chittering and movement deeper in the cave. The spiders, black and hairy, crawling amongst the fibrous webs, seem larger here in the dark and the dank. Something massive moves beyond a curtain of webbing—you catch a glimpse of multi-jointed legs and a body the size of an oxcart.

Boone Calhoun.name:
布恩·卡尔霍恩
Boone Calhoun

Text.text:
一名矮壮的侏儒跨坐在一只骑乘犬背上；他留着金色的马蹄形胡子，几乎垂到鞍边。尖尖的耳朵上冒出几撮沙色细毛，但一顶夸张的棕色十加仑牛仔帽把他头顶的头发遮得严严实实。他身上穿着外套、长裤、皮套裤和靴子，皆由不同皮革拼凑而成。鞍的一侧挂着一把长柄战锤，另一侧则悬着一面圆盾。他嘴里嚼着一根草茎，神情满足，唇边带着淡淡的笑意，翡翠色的眼眸里闪着光。那只骑乘犬毛色浅褐，胸口却洁白；短腿、长而蓬松的尾巴、三角形的耳朵，以及明亮的棕色眼睛——它张着嘴，一脸快乐的神情。

~ Played by Kiirasha

A stocky gnome, with a blond horseshoe mustache that dangles nearly to the saddle, sits astride a riding dog. Tufts of sandy hair sprout from the gnome’s pointed ears, but an oversized brown ten-gallon hat covers any hair on his head. He also wears a coat, pants, chaps, and boots of varied leathers. A long-hafted hammer hangs from one side of the saddle, and a round shield from the other. Chewing on a stem of grass, the rider projects a feeling of contentment, with a slight grin on his lips and a gleam in his emerald eyes. The riding dog has tan fur but a white chest, with short legs, a long bushy tail, triangular ears, and bright brown eyes—and a happy open-mouthed expression.

~ Played by Kiirasha

Ring Of Three Wishes.name:
三愿戒指
Ring Of Three Wishes

Text.text:
这枚戒指的设定颇为异样：三颗硕大的钻石以完全相同的切割风格与精准一致的体型镶嵌，构成一个完美的三角形。即便在这样的光线下，每一颗钻石的闪耀也远比你预想的更加夺目。
The setting of this ring is unusual in that it features three large diamonds cut to the same style and exact size of its fellows, set in a perfect triangle. Each diamond glimmers far more brightly than you would expect in this light.

Glitzy Corporate Pr Executive.name:
浮华的企业公关高管
Glitzy Corporate Pr Executive

Text.text:
这女人身着登峰造极的高级时装，高挑而优雅——奢华却不张扬。一件贵族气息浓郁的栗红色长外套在她身侧翻卷如波。外套之下，是一套利落的灰色裤装，精致得连广告里的模特都相形见绌。她高跟鞋的叩击声格外清脆响亮，说话语速飞快。手里端着一杯山羊奶拿铁，她对着通讯植入体笑个不停，聊着“赫斯提亚–格拉德韦尔合并案”，又八卦StoneCross会不会在“秘书那起事件”之后把他们的CEO开掉。
Clothed in the highest of high fashion, this woman is tall and elegant—opulent, without being showy. An aristocratic maroon overcoat swirls about her. Beneath, she wears a chic gray pantsuit even better than the models in the ads. The click of her heels is loud, and she talks rapidly. Goat milk latte in hand, she laughs into her comm implant about the “Hestia–Gradwell Merger” and whether or not StoneCross is firing their CEO after “the incident with the secretary.”

Gary, A Mimic.name:
加里，一只拟态怪
Gary, A Mimic

Text.text:
一只老鼠抖了抖她黑白相间的皮毛，抬头盯着卓尔巴拉克拉瓦垂下的绳头——那绳头一跳一颤，活像她细小的胡须。男人靛蓝色的皮肤与雪白的头发让他看上去凶悍可怖，可当你意识到他身上隐约有股蔬菜味时，这份威吓便顿时打了折扣。她端坐在他绘好的羊皮纸草图上：一幢小巧而温暖的建筑，顶部的字样装饰得颇为讲究：Gary’s Food and Rest。他穿着剪裁得体的外套与一尘不染的衬衫，伸了个懒腰，随后拾起鲁特琴，紫色的眼眸含着暖意，对着他的啮齿小伙伴微微一笑。

~ 由一位英雄出演

A rat shakes her black-and-white fur and looks up at the dangling cord of a drow’s balaclava, twitching just like her little whiskers. His indigo skin and white hair make him look menacing, but the intimidation falls short when you realize he smells vaguely of vegetables. She sits on a parchment sketch he has made of a small, cozy building, lettering adorning the top: Gary’s Food and Rest. He stretches in his well-made coat and spotless shirt, then picks up his lute, his purple eyes smiling warmly at his rodent companion.

~ Played by a Hero

Magical Stone Circle: Climbing The Mount.name:
魔法石阵：攀登山峰
Magical Stone Circle: Climbing The Mountain

Text.text:
攀上这座山的路途，已将你带离尘世。俯瞰而下，低地被一层薄雾铺盖，如同将你托成天际孤岛。风在你身旁回旋低语，仿佛要把你再向上牵引。
The climb up the mountain has taken you away from the world. Looking down, you see a sheet of mist has drawn over the lowlands, putting you on an island in the sky. The wind whirls and whispers about you, seeming to pull you higher.

肩宽膀阔、肌肉虬结，头顶微秃、五官粗犷——若在酒馆里撞见此人，你多半会把他当成本地的地痞狠角色。可他此刻却跪在地上，双手以一种古怪的方式交叠，低垂着头，口中喃喃着某种祷词。身上只披着朴素的羊毛长袍，双掌之间夹着的，想必是一枚圣徽。
Broad-shouldered and muscular with a balding head and rough features, if you saw this man in a tavern, you’d take him for the local tough. But he kneels on the ground, hands folded in a peculiar manner, his head bowed as he mutters some kind of prayer. Dressed in simple woolen robes, he holds what must be a holy symbol between his hands.

Rare Spell Paper.name:
稀有法术纸张
Rare Spell Paper

Text.text: 几张信笺静静躺在奥术师的陈列柜里，隔着玻璃泛着冷光。纸面压印精致，细密墨线以直角交织，勾出一圈悦目的边框。你一走近展示，最上面那张纸的四角便浮现出奥术符文，像切割水晶般微微闪烁——迷人的符号在色泽间流转，随即又彻底隐去。纸旁一张小卡写着 稀有物品：法术纸。店主满怀期待地抬眼看向你。 A few sheets of stationery sit beneath glass in the arcanist’s case. Embossed and finely-inked lines are set at right angles to form a pleasing border. When you step toward the display arcane characters appear in the corners of the top page, shimmering like cut crystal—captivating symbols that shift in color before disappearing entirely. A small card beside the sheets reads rare item: spell paper. The shopkeeper looks up at you hopefully.

Hungry Blue Slaad.name:
饥饿的蓝色斯拉德
Hungry Blue Slaad

Text.text: 一连串刺耳的呱鸣与低吼在空地间回荡——起初毫无意义，却很快被反复传来的心灵讯息翻译出来：“饿。”这只生物以缓慢而刻意的步伐从水中潜行而出，巨大的双叉巨钳拖在身后，刮擦着石面。它那蛙状面孔上深陷的、锐利的黄眼扫视着整个区域。怪物咂了咂嘴，露出一排参差不齐、弯曲发黄的尖牙。它魁梧的躯体里绷着结实而强悍的肌肉，背脊与四肢布满尖刺与角刺，仿佛被粗暴磨砺过一般。 A series of harsh croaks and grunts resounds through the clearing—meaningless at first, but soon telepathically translated by the repeating message: “Hungry.” The creature slinks out of the water with slow deliberate steps, its enormous two-pronged claws dragging on the stones behind it. Piercing yellow eyes, sunken in its toad-like face, scan the area. The monster smacks its lips, displaying a row of uneven, crooked yellow fangs. Its mighty frame is filled with taut, powerful muscles and scoured with spines and horns.

I Use Supreme Healing.name:
我使用至高治疗
I Use Supreme Healing

Text.text:
我低声吟诵一段修补的祈祷。由我眼中赐生之光映出的微芒，在一切反光的表面上闪烁，昭示着我的治疗魔法正在运作。那光的细屑飘入伤者体内，以我对生命的虔诚进一步加固他们的生机。
I intone a prayer of mending. Flickers on reflective surfaces, from the life-giving light in my eyes, indicates my healing magic at work. Motes of this light drift into the wounded, further fortifying them with my devotion to life.

Catoblepas In Swamp.name:
沼泽中的卡托布莱帕斯
Catoblepas In Swamp

Text.text:
野猪般的头颅低低前探，怪物搅得脚下沼泽水翻涌不止。它的皮毛凌乱，浸透污浊的水渍；身后泥淖深处，一截恐龙般的尾巴从浑浊中刺出。
The warthog head juts forward and low as the monster roils the swampy water beneath it. Its fur is straggly and soaked with dirty water, and its dinosaur tail pokes up from the murk behind it.

Temperate Forest Lichen.name:
温带森林地衣
Temperate Forest Lichen

Text.text:
地衣在整片森林里成片生长：攀附在树干上、树枝上、岩石上。种类繁多，质地与颜色各不相同。有的柔软如海绵，呈明亮的黄色或粉尘般的白色；有的薄片剥落，泛着淡淡的浅绿；还有些边缘卷褶起伏，像周遭那片葱郁的绿叶植被一般。
Lichen grows in patches throughout the forest: on tree trunks, tree branches, rocks. There are many different kinds, with distinct textures and colors. Some are spongy yellow or dusty white, others are flaky pale green, while others still have a frilled appearance like the surrounding leafy-green vegetation.

Apartment Of A Creepy Manor.name:
阴森庄园的公寓
Apartment Of A Creepy Manor

Text.text:
公寓的起居室里挂着一面镀银不完美的镜子——你找不到任何一个角度能不让它把你的五官扭曲成怪诞的讽刺画。你强迫自己移开视线，注意到卧室门缝处被人小心翼翼地塞进一条折好的毛巾；尽管有人焚过熏香、喷过香水，它依旧没能彻底挡住那股令人反胃的气味。那不是腐烂的臭，也不是血的腥，而是一种既原始又令人厌恶、同样难以名状的味道。
The sitting room of the apartment features a mirror that has been imperfectly glazed—you cannot find an angle that fails to distort your features into a grotesque caricature. Tearing your eyes away, you note a folded towel placed carefully along the crack of the bedroom door, which fails to completely block the stomach-turning smell despite some efforts made with burned incense and perfumes. It is not the odor of rot nor the scent of blood, but something as primeval and off-putting as it is unidentifiable.

Helm Of Telepathy.name:
心灵感应头盔
Helm Of Telepathy

Text.text:
乍一看，这顶风格化的头盔像一顶工艺精湛的青铜颅顶盔；但再细看，便会发现装饰细节刻意做成了残缺人类头骨间有大脑探出的模样。尽管骇人，将其戴在头上的人却会沿着头皮感到一阵奇异的刺痒，仿佛这头盔正以某种方式审视着他们最深处的念头。
At first glance this stylized helmet looks like a well-crafted bronze skullcap helm, but a closer look reveals a detail of decoration meant to resemble a brain peeking out of an incomplete human skull. Grisly though it is, those who place this helm atop their head feel a curious prickly sensation all along their scalp, as if the helm were somehow examining their very thoughts.

Dungeon: A Distant Cry For Help.name:
地城：遥远的呼救声
Dungeon: A Distant Cry For Help

Text.text:
呼喊声从走廊深处隐约传来，但那一个词却清晰无比：“救命！”它又响起，再一声、两声，随后一切归于寂静。地城的墙壁将呼声层层回荡，搅乱了你对其来源方向与远近的判断。
The cry comes faintly from down the corridor, yet the word is clear: "Help!" It comes again, once, twice, and then all is quiet. The walls of the dungeon make the cry echo, muddling both the direction and distance of its source.

Small Unit Tactics: Slicing The Pie.name:
小队战术：切分扇区
Small Unit Tactics: Slicing The Pie

Text.text:
短促的倒数后，队长张口爆发出一声战吼，震得人心发紧。小队成员齐齐举起武器，向敌人倾泻出整齐划一的弹幕，逼得他们狼狈冲向掩蔽。那些被压得抬不起头的守军浑然不觉，其中一人趁乱俯身贴地，悄然绕出战线，寻找合适的夹击位置。

~ 由一位英雄构想

A short countdown, then a warlike yell bellows from the mouth of the team leader. Each member of the team raises their weapon, letting forth a coordinated salvo of bullets at the enemy, driving them to dash into cover. Unbeknownst to the cowed defenders, one member of the team uses the confusion to duck low and circle out to locate a suitable flanking position.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Tiefling Apprentice Mage.name:
提夫林见习法师
Tiefling Apprentice Mage

Text.text:
那女人怀揣着按捺不住的期待，急匆匆地迈出门槛，却又在离去前停下脚步，迅速扫视四周。两支修长纤细的角自发间向外弯曲，宛如新落的白雪，衬出一张年轻的脸——满是希望与惊奇。蔚蓝如天的肌肤与她利落时髦的学院长袍相得益彰，而她束紧的皮包鼓鼓囊囊，塞满了奥术典籍。

~ Envisioned by Ameria on Discord

The woman positively bristles with anticipation as she hurries out of the door, pausing to survey her surroundings before she departs. Long, slender horns curve away from the hair like freshly fallen snow framing a youthful face full of hope and wonder. Skin of azure blue complements her stylish academy robes, and her cinched leather bag bulges with arcane tomes.

~ Envisioned by Ameria on Discord

你周遭的世界仍如你所知，却被扭曲、被阴影笼罩——宛如主物质位面的一面黑暗倒影。既熟悉又令人不安，这个世界的阴影仿佛在吞饮四周的光，空气中飘荡着灰烬。这里很冷，冷得不自然。寒意钻过你的斗篷，渗入你的血肉，你甚至能在骨髓里感到它的冰凉。每一点声响、每一道从环境中挣脱出来的影子，都让你不由自主地一颤。
The world around you is as you know it, but twisted, shadowed—a dark reflection of the Prime Material. Familiar and unsettling in equal measure, the shadows of this world seem to drink in the light around them, and ash wafts on the air. It’s cold here, unnaturally so. The cold seeps past your cloak, into your flesh, and you feel the chill in your very bones. You cannot help but flinch at every sound, at each shadow that dislodges itself from your surroundings.

I Cast Imprisonment Using A Fine Chain.name:
我以一条精致的锁链施展禁锢术
I Cast Imprisonment Using A Fine Chain

Text.text:
我将一条纤巧的锁链绕在那幅描绘之上，猛然绷紧，随着魔法层层堆叠，锁链嘶鸣着爆裂而出，以哀嚎般的铿锵声将我的敌人囚禁。

[豁免失败{/i>] 束缚如同被附体的毒蛇般腾跃，猛地收紧缠住我的猎物；每一节链环都燃着强劲的奥术能量光芒，将四肢吞没进铁之茧中。

Wrapping a delicate chain around the depiction, I pull it taut as the magic builds and chains burst forth to imprison my foe with a wailing rattle.

[Failed Save{/i>] Leaping like possessed serpents, the bonds constrict around my quarry, each link aglow with potent arcane energy as they engulf limbs in cocoons of iron.

I Cast Lay On Hands To Cure Disease.name:
我施放「圣疗之触」以祛除疾病
I Cast Lay On Hands To Cure Disease

Text.text:
我以指尖轻触你滚烫的额头，将神圣而净化的光芒自心口直送而出。光沿着我的手掌流淌，继而从你的头顶一路推进至脚尖，所过之处如烈焰焚尽病灶，将那份病痛在前行中彻底烧灼殆尽。
Touching your fevered forehead, I send forth divine, cleansing light directly from my heart. It travels out of my hand, then from your head to your toes, burning out the sickness as it advances.

你手中的玛瑙若交给珠宝匠镶嵌，足以买下一座村庄。可你却把掌纹一笔笔刻进它的表面：掌心的线条蜿蜒交错，其间又细细蚀出你所有的希冀与恐惧——那些一旦要把一个孩子带到世上，便会时时牵动你心神的念头。如今它作为首饰已不再值钱，但在这漫长的仪式时光里，它对你的分量却愈发沉重。现在只剩最后一步：将这块石头与那生物接触，这最珍贵的宝石便会就此消失。然而这个念头并未扰乱你。它所承载的一切，仍会与你同在。
The agate in your hands could have bought a village if given to a jeweler to set. Instead, you scratched into its surface the lines of your palms. Between these lines, you etched tiny images of your hopes and fears—all the things that would concern you if you were bringing a child into the world. Although worth much less now as jewelry, its value to you has increased over the hours of the ritual. All that’s left now is to touch the stone to the creature, and this most precious gem will vanish. But this thought does not disturb you. All that it represents will still be with you.

鳞甲与骨骼堆叠成一座蹒跚的山岳，仅仅目睹一头甲龙，便足以让除最莽撞或最能干的冒险者之外的人都停下脚步。尽管这生物那双硕大而有灵的眼睛里并无恶意，但它那条粗壮尾巴末端覆着沉重骨槌——再加上镶嵌于铁硬甲壳边缘的锯齿尖刺——已足以劝退大多数胆敢向它出手的东西。
A lumbering mountain of scale and bone, the sight of an ankylosaurus is enough to give all but the most foolhardy or capable adventurer pause. Though no malice lurks within the large, soulful eyes of the creature, the weighty club of bone capping its prodigious tail—alongside the jagged spikes hemming its iron-hard shell—are enough to dissuade most things from attacking it.

Ruins Of Atlantis.name:
亚特兰蒂斯遗墟
Ruins Of Atlantis

Text.text:
生命在这座沉没之城里蓬勃滋长。你惊叹地望着：庞大的鱼群从巨大的、风化崩裂的大理石雕像旁俯冲而过；鲨鱼在宏伟的奥利哈钢神殿高耸的立柱间穿梭盘旋。珊瑚以千般色泽与质感，在建筑的古老石面上恣意绽放；阳光碎金般洒落，点亮集市广场那繁复精致的马赛克地面。水中回荡着一阵若有若无的低鸣，仿佛这座城市仍有一丝力量在悄然运转。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Life flourishes in the sunken city, and you watch in awe as enormous schools of fish dive past huge, crumbling marble statues while sharks weave between the towering columns of a grand orichalcum temple. Coral of every hue and texture blooms into exuberant life across the ancient stone of the buildings, and sun dapples the intricate mosaic floor of the market square. A subtle hum reverberates through the water, as if a modicum of the city’s power remains active.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Old Treasure Map.name:
古老的宝藏地图
Old Treasure Map

Text.text:
陈旧而被遗忘，一张泛黄的羊皮纸方方正正地躺着，半埋在桌上散落的霉味书册与纸张之间。其上仍依稀可辨淡淡的图像与批注：一枚奢丽繁复的罗盘玫瑰，以及一个醒目的红色 X。
Old and forgotten, a square of yellowed parchment lies half-buried among the musty books and papers strewn across the table. Faint images and annotations can still be discerned, including a lavishly detailed compass rose and a distinctive red X.

Fire Elemental: Happy Campfire.name:
火元素：欢快的篝火
Fire Elemental: Happy Campfire

Text.text:
火焰噼啪作响，欢快地跳跃着，迫不及待要烤熟肉食，或把茶水温热。缭绕的烟香勾起你无数个舒适的瞬间——你曾长久凝望火光，而它总在寒夜里化作温暖而受欢迎的同伴。
The fire cracks and pops merrily, eager to roast meat or warm water for tea. The scent of its smoke reminds you of countless cozy moments spent staring into flames, always a warm and welcome companion on a cold night.

Quip About Odd Hobbies.name:
关于古怪爱好的俏皮话
Quip About Odd Hobbies

Text.text:
“你知道吗，按理说我这会儿应该正嘲笑你。但我一直在努力变得更积极些——要是这份愚蠢的迷恋能给你带来一点快乐，那我又有什么资格评头论足呢？”
“You know, normally I’d be mocking you right now. But I’ve been working on being more positive and if this inane fascination brings you some joy then who am I to judge?”

The Sanctuary: Transitional Conifer Fore.name:
圣所：过渡性针叶林
The Sanctuary: Transitional Conifer Forest

Text.text:
这片冰封森林既瑰丽又令人心悸。诡异的寂静里，唯有高大的针叶树在风中摇摆，发出吱呀作响的呻吟。你踏过林缘，爪下冻结的松针被碾得咯吱作响。寒风裹着微甜的树脂气息，也捎来更冷夜色逼近的预兆。
The icy forest is as beautiful as it is foreboding. Its eerie silence is broken only by the creaking of the large conifer trees swaying in the wind.
