The warcamp is basic, tough, but perfectly maintained. In the god’s tent, its peak a hundred feet high and floor the width of an arena, maps of war are spread over tables the size of family huts. Heroes of the ages and the unknown courageous, all confronting lives of violence, salute for the god who, of all gods, most desires peace.

I Bestow A Gift Of Readiness On Myself.name:
我将“准备就绪”的赋礼施予自身
I Bestow A Gift Of Readiness On Myself

Text.text:
这一套娴熟的动作与随之低吟的咒语，仿佛不费吹灰之力。我用指尖钩住时代的经纬，将其轻轻一拧，紧紧缠绕在一枚看不见的线轴上。给自己施放魔法时，我屏住呼吸。若有危险浮现，它便会触发，而我将是最先行动的人之一。

~ Envisioned by ashesnblood

It looks effortless, these practiced motions and their accompanying mantra. My fingers hook into the weave of time, turn it, winding it tightly around an invisible bobbin. My breath stills as I cast the magic upon myself. If danger arises, it will trigger, and I’ll be among the first to act.

~ Envisioned by ashesnblood

Magical Stone Circle: Terrifying Presenc.name:
魔法石环：骇人威压
Magical Stone Circle: Terrifying Presence

Text.text:
一抹翠绿的能量沿着立石之间的地面明灭游走，疾掠如闪电，却又摇曳如火焰。你才刚看清，那光便倏然消失，随即又在石圈的另一处重现——永远卡在你视野的边缘，仿佛刻意躲开你目光的捕捉。不知为何，这让你想起一幅画面：翻涌鼓胀的帘幕被风掀起，又落回原处，恰好覆住帘后某个伫立的人影。
A green energy flickers along the ground between the standing stones, flitting like lightning but wavering like fire. Just as soon as you see it, the light vanishes, reappearing somewhere else in the circle—always at the edge of your vision, as if to avoid the capture of your gaze. For some reason, this brings to mind the image of a billowing curtain which falls back into place over the form of someone standing behind it.

Speech By A Noble About Family Feuds.name:
一位贵族关于家族世仇的演说
Speech By A Noble About Family Feuds

Text.text:
“家庭不过是一出出闹剧。说到底，挺无聊的。比如，我刚听说我表哥为了土地和妻子杀了我外甥——这可太西奥多了，你懂吧？他永远非得当众人瞩目的中心不可。”
“Families are just drama. It’s all quite boring, really. For instance, I got word that my cousin killed my nephew for his land and wife, and that’s just so Theodore, you know? Just always has to be the center of attention.”

Faerie Plane: Bullywug Court With Pool O.name:
妖精位面：牛蛙人宫廷与熔岩之池
Faerie Plane: Bullywug Court With Pool Of Lava

Text.text:
洁净如新的王廷里，立着光滑而阴影深重的柱列；暗铁铸成的火盆闷燃不息；猩红的帷幔垂悬半空——一幅幽暗之美的景象，却几乎被那席卷整个空间的炽热所吞没。王廷中央，一池熔岩翻涌泼溅，仿佛由神秘而不可见的液火暗流源源不断地注入。几块黑曜石巨板如踏石般铺出一条路，横跨那红橙色的熔池，通向一棵巨树下的王座。枝桠如多臂的守护者般覆在御座之上，沉甸甸地挂满金色浆果；最靠近熔池的叶片被热浪炙烤，焦灼成明亮的橘色，熔岩在脚下鼓泡喷涌，时而翻起灼人的浪花。
The pristine royal court sports smooth and shadowed columns, smoldering braziers of dark iron, and hanging red tapestries—a vision of dark beauty nearly lost on you because of the immense heat that overwhelms the space. In the center of the court a pool of lava sloshes and sprays, as if fed continuously by mysterious, unseen streams of liquid fire. Obsidian slabs of what seem to be stepstones lead across the red-orange pool up to a regal throne under a large tree. The branches hang over the royal seat like a many-armed guardian, heavy with golden berries, and the leaves closest to the pool singe to bright orange from the heat of the lava as it surges in bubbles and spurts.

Prince Poisoned At Banquet.name:
王子在宴会上中毒
Prince Poisoned At Banquet

Text.text:
盛宴长桌旁原本欢快的谈笑声，随着王子浑身一软、扑倒在自己的餐盘上，骤然化作惊骇的倒吸气与警惶的呼喊。绿色的泡沫在他抽搐的嘴角翻涌，他的脸在毒素发作间迅速肿胀，骇人的腐败沿着王室血脉奔流蔓延。他像溺水的水手般急促喘息，身体剧烈痉挛，血管转瞬发黑，蜷缩枯萎，宛如曝晒干裂的藤蔓。

~ Clara C. Potter 于 Discord

The jovial chatter around the feasting table turns to horrified gasps and shouts of alarm as the prince goes limp and collapses onto his plate. Green bubbles froth at the corners of his twitching mouth and his face begins to swell as the poison takes hold, the horrid rot streaming through his royal blood. Gasping like a drowning sailor, his body spasms violently as his veins turn black and shrivel like sun-baked vines.

~ Clara C. Potter on Discord

Infernal Obsidian Spear.name:
炼狱黑曜石长矛
Infernal Obsidian Spear

Text.text:
一截打磨光亮的黑曜石尖刺如同地狱般的痛楚王冠，覆在这柄邪恶长矛的顶端。碎片从那耀眼的黑石上片片剥落，绕着它盘旋，宛如一座由恶意与苦难驱动的天体仪。矛杆由黑铁铸成，接触之下冰冷刺骨；金属上排列着发光的诡秘符号，仿佛被阴森的火焰勾勒点燃。

~ Envisioned by MatthewMcHale on Discord

A polished spur of obsidian caps this wicked spear like a hellish crown of pain. Shards flake away from the gleaming stone, orbiting it like an orrery of malice and suffering. The black iron of the haft is cold to the touch, and glowing eldritch symbols line the metal, limned in sinister flames.

~ Envisioned by MatthewMcHale on Discord

台球撞击的清脆声在拱顶大厅里回荡，玩家俯身出杆，白球划过鲜亮的绿呢台面。空气里浮着一层薄雾，将厅内的景象扭曲成似曾相识的海市蜃楼，色彩被压低，像一幅年代久远的旧画。角落的吧台边，客人们笑谈交错，间或传来杯盏相碰的叮当声，为喧语点上短促的停顿。
The clatter of billiard balls striking one another resonates through the vaulted hall as players take their shots across vibrant green felt. The air is hazy, distorting the scenes within the hall to a mirage of familiarity, colors muted like an old painting. Patrons laugh and converse at the bar in the corner, the occasional clink of glasses punctuating their chatter.

Icy Wasteland: Being Tracked.name:
冰封荒原：遭到追踪
Icy Wasteland: Being Tracked

Text.text:
风暴在低语、尖啸、嚎叫、呜咽与呻吟，却不曾咆哮，也不如饥饿野兽般怒吼。有什么东西在风鞭雪幕的白色帘幕后知晓你们的存在，它听起来正盛怒。
The storm whispers, whistles, howls, moans, and groans, but it does not growl, nor does it roar like a hungry beast. Something beyond the white curtains of wind-whipped snow knows you are here, and it sounds angry.

I Plead For Information.name:
我恳求情报
I Plead For Information

Text.text:
“我们不要你的金币，甚至也不求你的怜悯；我们所需要的，只有你的坦诚。你的自尊就那么值钱，你的见识就那么神圣，竟愿意把它捂在怀里，拿无辜的性命来作交换吗？因为眼下赌上的，正是这个。”
“We are not asking for your gold, or even your sympathy; all we need is your honesty. Is your pride so valuable, your knowledge so sacred, that you would withhold it at the cost of innocent lives? Because that is what’s at stake here.”

字迹几乎已从这张风化泛黄的羊皮纸上褪尽，参差破损的边缘刻着被无数次摩挲过的熟稔痕迹。许久以前，疲惫的泪滴曾滴落其上，洇出斑斑水渍——当这些字句一笔一划凿进心底。

~ Daroneasa 于 Discord 上 所构想

The words have almost faded from the crumbling, yellowed piece of parchment, its ragged edges bearing the hallmarks of intense familiarity. Droplets stained the letter long ago, fallen from weary eyes as the words carved themselves upon a heart.

~ Envisioned by Daroneasa on Discord

Wagon Journey: Camping.name:
马车旅程：露营
Wagon Journey: Camping

Text.text:
白日的余温随着太阳沉入地平线，凛冽的冷风紧随其后追来。所幸你在休息时有一堆噼啪作响的篝火相伴，驱散寂冷。你凝视着火焰，看见一截燃烧的木柴噼然爆裂，目光追随着飞溅的火星旋转上升，最终在群星之间悄然消失。
The warmth of the day followed the sun over the horizon, and a cold wind chases after them. Thankfully, you have a crackling fire to cheer you as you rest. Staring into the flames, you watch a burning log pop, and your gaze follows the sparks spiraling up to disappear among the stars.

Ring Of Spell Storing.name:
法术储存戒指
Ring Of Spell Storing

Text.text:
戒环如彩带缠绕五月柱般，在指间盘旋数匝。边缘残缺不齐，似是刻意雕成羊皮纸毛边的撕裂末端。符文与异体字符的刻痕点缀其面，细密如纹。
The band curves multiple times about the finger like a ribbon around a maypole. Its edges are chipped, carved purposely to resemble the frayed ends of parchment. Etchings of runes and other characters decorate the ring’s face.

作为法术的一部分，你把眼睛紧紧挤闭，直到再睁开时眼前浮现斑点。这些斑点融入施法之中：你游移的手指在空气里一勾，便从虚空中钩住其中一点。那点迅速膨胀，化作一圈光晕——唯有你能看见——悬绕在你的手边。凭借它的接触，你将赐予超越光所能揭示的视界。
As part of the spell, you squeeze your eyes so tightly that when you open them you see spots. These spots become part of the casting as your drifting finger snags one from the air. The spot grows, becoming a halo, which only you can see, that hangs about your hand. With its touch, you will confer a sight beyond that which light reveals.

I Cast Hypnotic Pattern Using A Crystal.name:
我用水晶小瓶施放催眠图案
I Cast Hypnotic Pattern Using A Crystal Vial

Text.text:
我从腰包里取出一支小瓶，以催眠般的低吟念出咒语。轻轻一晃，瓶中液体便裹着光旋转翻涌，光芒又缓缓黯淡下去。我吐出一口气。空气中骤然迸出发光的涡流，与我掌中如出一辙——却染上了梦境般千变万化的绚丽色彩。
Taking a vial from my pouch, I speak the incantation in a mesmerizing drone. One shake, and the vial’s liquid swirls with light, which dims slowly. I exhale. Glowing eddies erupt in the air, mirroring those in my hand—but taking on the myriad hues of a dream.

Recalled Encounter With A Horde Of Monst.name:
与怪物群的回忆遭遇
Recalled Encounter With A Horde Of Monsters

Text.text:
“它们像潮水般越过田野涌来——一团起伏翻滚的锈蚀钢铁与咬合作响的獠牙。逃的人里有些捡回了命，战的人没有。那群潮涌碾过我们的镇子，把一切刮得干干净净，留下的毁灭比任何洪水或瘟疫都更彻底。我不相信有什么能阻止那样凝聚成一束的暴力。但如果你们仍要去试，我会向每一位神明——已知的、未知的——祈祷，让你们平安归来。”
“They came over the fields like a tide, a heaving mass of rusted steel and gnashing teeth. Some who fled made it out with their lives, those who fought didn’t. The horde swept through our town and picked it clean, leaving behind a devastation worse than any flood or plague. I don’t believe anything can stop such concentrated violence. But if you try, I will pray to every god, known and unknown, to return you safely.”

Recounting Encounter With Werewolf.name:
重述与狼人遭遇
Recounting Encounter With Werewolf

Text.text:
“我们守着进镇的城门时，它突然袭来。把乔纳一口气撕成两半。该死的，我们连一点动静都没听见，直到他碎块落地那声湿黏的闷响。它就站在那儿：皮毛癞秃，身高是任何男人的两倍，浑身散着死气的恶臭。没给我们多久，它就猛扑上来。我跟你说，我把长戟硬生生捅进那恶魔的身体，直至从它背后穿出。那一下给我争出点时间，才得以从它身下挣脱，冲过城门。等我们带人回来时，只剩一地血。我不知道它怎么可能挨了那样一击还能活，但它就是不见了。可我忘不掉的是……也许我们当时没看清——毕竟是晚班——但我不觉得它是从森林里来的。我们已经尽力盯紧那道门了，它却是从我们背后出现的。所以，要么那东西会飞，要么我们这座小镇远没看起来那么清白。”
“We were guarding the gate into town when it attacked. Tore Jonah clean in half. Didn’t hear a damn thing, until the wet thud of his pieces hitting the ground. There it stood: mangy, twice the height of any man and reeking of death. Didn’t have long before it lunged. I tell you now, I buried my halberd in that demon till it came out its back. Bought me enough time to get out from under it and through the gate. When we came back, all we found was blood. I don’t know how it could survive a blow like that, but it was gone. What sticks in my head though… Maybe we just didn’t see it—it was a late shift—but I don’t think it came from the forest. We were watching that gate best we could and it came from behind us. So, either that thing can fly or our little town isn’t as innocent as it seems.”

传言配不上她。她的美更骇人，而她的丑更令人敬畏得无以复加。当你挣扎着想从她那闪烁的眼眸上移开视线时，故事里有一条诡异却真实的细节将你钉在原地：她的头上不是头发，而是一窝从颅顶滋生的蛇群——每一条都是嘶嘶作响的怪物，生着自己的眼与獠牙。
The stories did not do her justice. Her beauty is more terrible, and her ugliness could not be more awe inspiring. One strange truth of the tales you were told grounds you as you struggle to look away from her glittering eyes. She has a nest of serpents sprouting from her head instead of hair, each a hissing monster with eyes and fangs of its own.

Fork Off The Main Road.name:
离开主路
Fork Off The Main Road

Text.text:
这条小道从主路旁岔出，但车轮同样把泥土碾出了深深的辙痕。虽说它偏离了笔直的大道，可从辙痕的深浅来看，这里或许才是更常走的路。你在一处将干未干的水洼软泥里看见些蹄印，像是绵羊或鹿留下的。它们沿着路向前延伸，远离十字路口而去。
This lane leads off the main track, but wagons have rutted the dirt in just the same way. Although it runs away from the straight path, it might be the more traveled route, judging from the depth of the ruts. You spot the prints of what might be sheep or deer in the soft mud of a drying puddle. They head down the road, away from the crossroads.

肉体之力，源自明智的抉择与不曾中断的专注。那么，就让我的手在此承接——以宇宙的秘法之力，将我心智的能量引入掌心。我的心也在此，我能感到它强劲搏动。我已臻于平衡，如今便能将这股力量导向我意志所指之处：动作的速度，抗力的蓬勃，复苏的烈焰。
Physical strength is a consequence of wise choice and uninterrupted focus. Here, then, is my hand, receiving the energy of my mind from the mystic power of the universe. Here is my heart, which I feel beating strong. I am in balance, and now I can channel this force where I will it to go. The speed of my actions, the vigor of resistance, the fire of replenishment.

Magical Street Drug, Renfield: Injected.name:
魔法街头毒品「伦菲尔德」：注射
Magical Street Drug, Renfield: Injected

Text.text:
黑暗从注射器被推进你的血流。它瞬间凝结，让你的身体在粘稠却不再泵动的血液中僵硬如铁。你的心脏骤然停跳，你死去——在那漫长而可怖的一瞬间，你的意识被压成一枚冰冷的余烬，随即又猛然回涌，坠入更清晰、更阴森的存在。阴影向你低语，将你系连到非真实的暗物质。你的肉身被拉伸延展，而你的魔法能力如恶性增殖般扩张成更宏大……也更可怕的东西。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Darkness is pushed from the syringe into your bloodstream. It coagulates instantly, turning your body rigid with viscous blood that does not pump. Your heart seizes, and you die for a long, terrible moment—your consciousness dampening to a cold ember before surging back into a clearer, more sinister existence. Shadows whisper to you, connecting you to the dark matter of unreality. Your physical body stretches as your magical abilities metastasize into something greater… and far more terrible.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

隔着一条街就能闻到浓郁的烟草燃香味，想来是烟草铺老板与常客们在店里尽情纵享他们最爱的嗜好所致。推门而入，拥挤的货架上摆满了烟斗、水烟壶、雪茄、香烟、小雪茄，以及一袋袋嚼烟。琳琅满目的醇厚烟品静候挑选与试抽——最好再来几口烈酒作伴。
The rich smell of burned pipeweed can be detected from down the block, no doubt owing to the proprietor of the tobac shop, and their clientele, indulging in their favorite vice on the premises. Behind its doors, the crowded shelves are stocked with pipes, hookahs, cigars, cigarettes, cigarillos, and pouches of chewing tobacco. The bounty of rich smokables wait to be purchased and sampled, preferably after strong drinks.

Fungal Bundle, A Pirate Shop.name:
真菌杂货捆，一家海盗商铺
Fungal Bundle, A Pirate Shop

Text.text:
远远望去，这艘船平平无奇——流线的船体与前伸的艏艏相映成势，船帆松垮地垂着，在海风里轻颤，任船身滑行漂荡。可越是靠近，景象便越发诡异。寻常帆船该立后桅之处，竟疯长出一棵参天巨树；树根仿佛与甲板木板熔为一体，帆布则被牵挂在枝桠之间。盛放的花簇与鲜艳的菌类沿着舷栏与甲板蔓延铺开，而本该潜伏火炮的位置，却摆着一只只巨大的陶瓷盆。船员同样古怪却迷人——一群兔形的生灵，明显出自妖精血脉；而那位站在舵轮前的船长，栗色皮毛间泛着苔藓与地衣的青绿。

~ Pirate Lord构想

At a distance, the ship appears mundane enough—a sweeping hull with a jutting prow, with sails loose and fluttering in the wind as the vessel coasts. But the nearer one draws, the odder the sight becomes. A massive tree sprouts where a mizzenmast would stand on a typical sailing vessel, its roots seemingly melded with the planks of the deck and sails strung between its boughs. Blooming flowers and vibrant fungi line the ship’s rails and planks, with massive ceramic pots where normally would lurk cannons. The crew, too, comprises strange but alluring rabbit-like creatures—clearly fey in origin—while the captain, standing at the ship’s wheel, sports chestnut fur tinged green with moss and lichen.

~ Envisioned by Pirate Lord

I Cast Shooting Stars From My Ring Of Sh.name:
我从我的流星指环中施放流星雨
I Cast Shooting Stars From My Ring Of Shootings Stars

Text.text:
三道光痕掠过我戒指上的宝石，微光一闪，我便知道法术已然就绪。我攥紧拳头，瞄准，然后放出那一粒粒闪烁发亮的光尘。它们飞行间不断膨胀，速度愈发惊人，灼穿空气呼啸而去，触及的瞬间轰然炸裂，将目标吞没在炽烈的纯白火焰之中。
Three trails of light glint across the gem of my ring, and I know the spell is ready. I clench my fist and aim, then set free the glistening, glowing motes. They grow as they fly, searing through the air with gathering speed, and explode on impact, consuming the target in blazing white flames.

Merfolk Trading Post.name:
人鱼贸易站
Merfolk Trading Post

Text.text:
海藻林在商站四周温柔的洋流里摇曳，浅湾晶莹剔透的水面下，阳光如碎金般闪烁。此处，尘世烦忧随海潮漂流远去；宁静的贸易与友谊在这座小小的鱼人聚落中当道。闪光的鱼鳞居民在湾中穿梭，沉浸于浅滩生命的涨落起伏，华美的鳞片在温暖的午后阳光里熠熠生辉。

~ 由 Clara C. Potter 在 Discord 上 构想

Kelp fields sway in the gentle currents surrounding the trading post and sunlight gleams through the crystal clear waters of the shallow cove. Here, the worries of the world are set adrift on ocean tides, as peaceful trade and friendship reign in the small merfolk settlement. The shimmering piscine denizens swim in the cove, enjoying the ebb and flow of life in the shallows as their resplendent scales catch the warm afternoon sun.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Welcome From Excitable Halfling.name:
来自兴奋不已的半身人的欢迎
Welcome From Excitable Halfling

Text.text:
“所以我就跟他们说，我说，‘我才不会跟什么不三不四的家伙去冒险呢，永远不去，因为我今天还得打扫，还得把些mathom添进弗拉克斯山的大宅里，活儿多得很，家务也一大堆。’可后来，等等，最精彩的来了——我正蹲在花园里给雏菊除草呢，忽然一个精灵就冒出来了，还跟我提起了你们！还有你！结果我人都到这儿了，连自己什么时候答应的都想不起来，你懂我意思吧。还是怪吓人的。”
“So, I told them, I said, ‘I’m not going on any adventures with any unsavories ever, because I’ve got sweeping to do today and some mathom to add to the big house at Flax Hill and so many chores,’ but then wait, this is the best part, then this elf shows up in the garden while I’m weeding the daisies and tells me about you! And you! And here I am not even recalling making the commitment, if you know what I mean. It’s still a bit terrifying.”

Loot From The Prince Of Revelry.name:
狂欢王子的战利品
Loot From The Prince Of Revelry

Text.text:
一把小提琴与琴弓静卧在草间，木纹呈现出不可能的嫩枝翠绿，旁边是“欢宴王子”倒下时洒落的那层金尘。每一枚音栓都由抛光的橡果精雕而成，竟自行扭转，为镀金琴弦调准音高。
A fiddle and bow, the wood an impossibly spriggy green, sit in the grass near the dusting of gold where the Prince of Revelry fell. The tuning pegs, each crafted from a polished acorn, twist of their own volition to tune the gilt strings.

Sir Accolon Of Gaul At The Joust.name:
高卢爵士阿科隆：马上比武场上
Sir Accolon Of Gaul At The Joust

Text.text:
骑士挺直身躯，带着坦率的骄傲走向赛场，一边向宫廷中脸颊绯红的少女挥舞着一枚精致的淑女信物。蔚蓝底色上金色的鸢尾花纹章烙印在他洁净如新的盾牌上，同样的纹饰也复刻在坐骑沉重的坐骑护甲之上。

~ 由 Vahlaron 构想

Carrying himself with forthright pride, the knight makes his way to the field waving a delicate lady’s favor to a blushing maiden of the court. Golden fleurs-de-lis on a field of azure are emblazoned upon his pristine shield, the heraldry duplicated on the weighty barding of his steed.

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

Creepy Throne Room.name:
阴森的王座厅
Creepy Throne Room

Text.text:
一道粗壮的光柱自不对称的天窗倾泻而下，照亮飘浮的尘埃微粒，并为这座巨大大厅的石砌墙面镀上一层幽蓝。你沿着柔软的深红绒毯继续深入，成对的象牙白蜡烛——安置在长长的铁制烛架上，烛架以螺栓牢牢钉入石质地面——骤然自行燃起。那座早已废弃的壁炉壁台上方，悬着一幅巨大的肖像：画中男人发丝油亮，肤色苍白得近乎不似人类，唇色猩红如血，宛如守望者般俯视此地。他的双眼深得不可思议，黑得发沉，仿佛随着你每一步移动而转动视线。

一缕旋律在室内弥漫，轻到几乎像是鬼魂呼出的气息带来的回声，可你看不见任何乐器，也听不见任何歌者。随后，你的目光被大厅尽头那张巨大的象牙王座攫住——雕工精细得近乎偏执。阴影里，是否有个身影正一动不动地坐着，静待你靠近？还是那只是你翻涌不止的想象所捏造的幻影？
A fat shaft of light shining through an asymmetrical skylight picks out motes of dust and casts a blue tint over the stonework of the enormous hall. As you follow the plush crimson rug further into the chamber, pairs of ivory white candles—sitting atop long iron holders bolted into the stone floor—burst to life. Above the mantel of the defunct fireplace, a massive portrait of a man with slicked hair, unearthly pale skin, and blood-red lips stands sentinel. His eyes are impossibly deep and dark, and seem to follow your every step. A faint melody, so faint that it might be carried on the breath of ghosts, pervades the room, but you see no instruments nor vocalists. Then your attention is drawn to a massive ivory throne, meticulously carved, at the far end of the hall. Is there a figure sitting, immobile, in the shadows awaiting your approach? Or is it a figment of your roiling imagination?

Sentry Of The Verdant Waste.name:
翠荒哨卫
Sentry Of The Verdant Waste

Text.text:
如同一株威严而古老的橡树，哨兵伫立在林间空地。外套下摆在葱郁的微风里轻轻摇曳，掀起一角，露出下面的皮甲。空地这片暧昧的空间里，只有树叶窸窣与疲惫的喘息声，他静候着强盗先动。一个憔悴的女人躲在他沉稳如壁垒的身影之后，把呜咽的孩子紧紧抱在胸前；她瞪大的眼睛从未离开近旁那对袭击者。刹那间，皮肤呈橄榄色的精灵从背后抽出一根雕刻精美的长杖，动作行云流水，灵巧的姿态昭示着他对这件武器炉火纯青的熟练度。他的脸如同不动的面具，绿眸牢牢锁住那群恶徒的身影，挑衅般逼他们上前。

~ Played by Brian Allen with

Like a mighty, venerable oak, the sentry stands in the grove. The hem of his overcoat sways gently in the verdant breeze, revealing the armored leather beneath. Rustling leaves and beleaguered panting are the only sounds in the liminal space of the clearing as he waits for the bandits to make a move. A haggard woman shelters behind the stoic bulwark of his frame, clutching a whimpering child to her chest as her wide eyes never leave the pair of assailants nearby. In one fluid motion, the olive-skinned elf draws a carved quarterstaff from his back, his dextrous grace evidence of his considerable proficiency with the weapon. His face is an unflinching mask as green eyes hold the ruffians in view, daring them to advance.

~ Played by Brian Allen with

Speech About Love In Dreams.name:
梦中的爱情演说
Speech About Love In Dreams

Text.text:
“我曾在梦里遇见过一个女人。我们交谈了仿佛永恒。她的美貌与笑声同样令人沉醉，也同样令人心惊。醒来之后，我明白她并不真实——那毕竟只是个梦……说到底，我只是在和自己说话。但我告诉你，若是借由某种魔法的扭转，我们真能在那片雾蒙蒙的领域之外相见，我愿意为再与她共度一个夜晚，甘心献出我的灵魂。”
“I once met a woman in my dreams. We talked for an eternity. Her beauty and laugh were intoxicating and nerve-racking in equal measure. After I woke up, I understood she wasn’t real. It being a dream… Really, I was just talking to myself. But I’ll tell you, if through some twist of magic we could meet outside of that misty realm, I would gladly give my soul away for one more evening with her.”

这男人的衣服下摆磨得起了毛边，黑色的乱发桀骜地向四方竖起。他挎着一只破旧的皮挎包，身上用背带固定着两只大玻璃瓶，腰带里还塞着一双用旧的手套。右臂是木制的，布满刮痕，却关节精巧灵活，前臂上装着一把弩。右脸颊上有一道烧伤疤痕，和他的衣衫一样参差粗粝；伤害在右耳下那枚菱形纹身前戛然而止。可他嘴角那一抹淡淡的笑意牵出胡茬满面的笑纹，让疲惫的榛色眼睛也忽然亮了起来。

~ Played by Paurie with

This man’s clothes are frayed at the hems, and his dark, untamed hair sticks upright in various directions. He carries a tattered leather satchel and two large bottles in harnesses, while worn gloves are tucked into his belt. His right arm is wooden and scratched, but finely articulated, a crossbow attached to the forearm. A burn scar, as ragged as his clothes, mars his right cheek. The damage ends just before a tattoo of diamonds under the right ear. But his slight grin brings out the laugh lines in his scruffy face, making his weary hazel eyes bright.

~ Played by Paurie with

Amphisbaena Double Attack.name:
双首蛇蜥双重攻击
Amphisbaena Double Attack

Text.text:
这条巨蛇覆着暗红鳞片，是一头无比骇人的怪物：既无前也无后——两端都探出一颗蝮蛇般的蛇首。它会用一颗头咬住另一颗头，盘成一只血肉之轮，以令人眩晕的狂飙在地面疾旋冲撞。随后，两颗头猛然分开，从不同角度同时发动攻击，毒牙上滴落琥珀色的毒液。
A giant serpent covered with reddish scales, this monstrosity has neither fore nor rear—the head of a viper emerging from both ends. One head grabs the other to form a wheel of flesh, which the horror uses to spin rapidly across the ground in a dizzying charge. The two heads then separate to attack from different angles, fangs dripping amber venom.

察觉你靠近，那匹矮壮的小马猛地一甩蓬乱的脑袋，把细如玉米须的鬃毛拨到眼睛旁边。你才刚一转身，它就毫不客气地把天鹅绒般的口鼻猛地扎进无人看管的鞍囊里——厚颜无耻地搜寻燕麦。你瞪着它，把袋子挪到它够不着的地方，它便压低声线轻轻嘶鸣，开始原地小跑。它眼睛睁得溜圆，无需言语便把那份期盼传达得明明白白：希望你赏它一口美味，也许再配几句温柔的安抚低语。
Sensing your approach, the stout pony tosses its shaggy head, shifting the fine corn silk mane away from its eyes. The moment your back is turned, it unceremoniously jams its velvety muzzle into an unattended saddlebag—a shameless search for oats. You glare as you move the bag out of reach, so it whickers quietly and begins prancing in place. Its eyes huge, it communicates without words its hope that you will provide a delicious morsel and perhaps some soothing murmurs.

Civilian Trading Vessel: Empty Cargo Hol.name:
民用商船：空荡的货舱
Civilian Trading Vessel: Empty Cargo Hold

Text.text:
这间舱室莫名显得萧索，仿佛这艘船也能感知到货舱空无一物的虚空。声响在空间里回荡，如同洞穴中的脚步声，更加凸显那股弥漫货舱的沉重空寂。
The room seems somehow bereft, as if the ship can sense the void of its empty hold. Sound echoes through the space like footsteps in a cave, further emphasizing the weight of emptiness pervading the hold.

Portal Of Shadow.name:
暗影之门
Portal Of Shadow

Text.text:
突出的巨石彼此倚靠，勉强拼成一扇粗陋的门洞。门内透出一道光——像淤青般深沉的紫色——尽管散发着不祥的气息，却仍在召唤你向前。自那门中飘来新翻泥土的气味，夹着一丝肉桂的甜辛；一股在此地从未有过的暖意也随之漫出。
Jutting stones lean against one another, forming a crude doorway. A light emanates from the portal—the deep purple of a bruise—beckoning you forward despite its sinister aura. From the portal, you smell fresh earth, tinged with cinnamon. A warmth, completely unknown here, seems to waft from it.

靶子是塞满干草的粗麻布袋，被压得像枕头一样扁平，中央刷着一个黑色圆圈，约莫只有孩子手掌那么大。弓手们站在许多步开外，弓垂在身侧。其一是自制弓，握在一位寒门猎户的女儿手中；其二出自行会制弓匠之手，此刻已被一位贵族的次子举起、上弦。他放箭，箭矢扎在黑点外的麻布上。女孩眯起眼望向前方，搭上一支箭，稳稳取准。
The targets are hay-stuffed burlap bags, flattened like pillows and painted with a black circle in the center, about the size of a child’s palm. The archers stand many paces out, holding their bows by their sides. One is homemade and held by the daughter of a humble hunter. The other is carved by a guild bowyer, now lifted and knocked by a noble’s second son. He fires and hits the burlap outside the black dot. The girl squints ahead, knocks an arrow, and takes aim.

Sundries From A Noble Bullywug.name:
来自高贵霸霸蛙的杂货
Sundries From A Noble Bullywug

Text.text:
蛙裔张着嘴，细长的舌头无力地耷拉在外；那双大眼紧闭，像是沉入永恒的长眠。你搜查尸体时发现，他们的半身板甲护甲不过是装饰品，轻飘又脆薄，像锡皮一样。条纹灯笼裤的一个口袋里塞着一朵睡莲，花瓣沮丧地低垂，茎上还系着一条湿透的缎带。
The frogkin’s long tongue lolls out of their open mouth, their large eyes shut in eternal sleep. In searching the body, you find that their half plate armor is merely decorative, lightweight and flimsy as tin. One of the pockets in their striped pantaloons holds a water lily, its petals drooping sullenly and its stem decorated with a soggy ribbon.

Civilian Space Station: Cramped Control.name:
民用空间站：狭窄的控制中心
Civilian Space Station: Cramped Control Center

Text.text:
狭窄办公室里的循环空气混杂着浓重的汗臭味，令人窒息；头顶忽明忽暗的灯光勉强照亮疲惫不堪的控制中心工作人员，他们仍在各自岗位上机械地忙碌着。几台屏幕布满坏点的显示器上跳动着粗糙的画面：空间站里那些被压得抬不起头的居民像牲口般挤在狭长走廊里。
The recycled air in the cramped office is thick with the stench of body odor, and the flickering lights overhead barely illuminate the beleaguered control center staff as they go about their work. Monitors with clusters of dead pixels depict grainy images of the space station’s downtrodden populace packed like cattle in the narrow corridors.

香气浓郁得宛如烤鸡，热气腾腾的杯子更像是一碗汤而非茶。碧绿的香草碎点缀在汤面上，杯底则沉着一小撮琥珀色的蜂蜜。这股气味足以驱退吸血鬼——也几乎肯定会让寻常人同样不敢与你说话。
Scent as savory as roast chicken, the steaming mug seems more soup than tea. Green flecks of herbs garnish the surface of the broth, while a smidge of amber-colored honey rests at the bottom. The aroma would deter vampires—and it will almost certainly deter everyday folk from speaking with you, as well.

Gnomish Cleric's Silver Flask.name:
侏儒牧师的银酒壶
Gnomish Cleric's Silver Flask

Text.text:
这只长方形水壶以熠熠银光铸成，壶口的软木环带着它曾盛过的烈酒余味，气息浓烈。壶身高度约莫人类孩童初次捧杯的尺寸，表面细致压印着一幕景象：类人生物推车运木送往炉膛，身旁跟着高大的巨兔与肥硕得离谱的松鼠。凑近细看，那里并非乐于助人的孩子，而是一群勤勉忙碌的侏儒。它的窄侧面刻着宗教器物，而背景被处理成带纹理的质感，既像袅袅烟痕，又巧妙地不易沾上指纹。
The rectangular canteen is cast in shining silver, and its cork ring smells of the potent liquors it has known. The flask is the height of a human child’s first cup and is finely embossed with a scene of humanoids carting wood to a furnace accompanied by goliath rabbits and oversized squirrels. A closer look shows not a scene of helpful children, but industrious gnomes. Its narrow sides depict religious artifacts, and the background is textured in a way that both suggests smoke and cleverly resists fingerprints.

毒素起效又快又准。没有疼痛，也没有恶心向你袭来。取而代之的是一阵诡异的平静降临，你感到自己敞开而清醒，感知一切。你忽然生出一种最古怪的领悟：你无法说谎——哪怕是在心底的念头里，对自己也不行。
The poison works quickly and effectively. No pain and no sickness washes over you. Instead, an uncanny calm comes, and you feel open and aware. You have the strangest realization that you cannot lie, even to yourself in your thoughts.

The Waste, The Domain Of Death.name:
荒原，死亡的领域
The Waste, The Domain Of Death

Text.text:
在永恒的猩红暮光之下——地平线上仍残留着一线灼烈如刀的日光——无尽的腐朽荒原绵延铺展。尘埃悬在龟裂的土地上，植物无从繁茂。枯灌木在最轻微的接触下便碎成粉末，残存的树干灰败染病。可在这片荒凉里，人却多得惊人：一些人双手血淋淋，眼中闪着野蛮的意图；医生戴着长喙的瘟疫面具在后头咯咯怪笑；披袍的施法者把厚重的典籍紧紧抱在胸前，以冰冷而学究的疏离审视四周。许多人转身面向峭岩悬崖上那座阴沉而锋利的堡垒，血垢结痂的手举起，仿佛在进行某种神圣的赞颂。笼罩这座巍然建筑的云层化作一张张被拉扯成尖啸的面孔，痛苦凝固其上。城垛上垂下黑色旗幡，边缘破碎、永远燃烧，其上绘着一朵血红玫瑰。

~ 构想：Ararion

Under a sky of perpetual red twilight—with a hint of sun lingering as a searing line on the horizon—endless tracts of decaying land extend. Dust hangs over the cracked ground, where plants fail to flourish. Dried brush crumbles at the slightest touch and remnant tree trunks are gray with disease. People, though, abound in the desolation: folk with bloody hands and eyes aglint with brutal intent, doctors cackling behind long-beaked plague masks, robed spellcasters clutching thick tomes to their chests and observing their surroundings with a cold, academic detachment. Many turn to face a fortress bleak and trenchant upon a craggy cliff, their gore-caked hands raised in a kind of holy praise. The clouds over this imposing structure take the form of faces stretched into howls of agony. From the parapets hang black banners, their edges frayed and forever burning, bearing the image of a blood-red rose.

~ Envisioned by Ararion

Loot From A Voodoo Priestess.name:
来自巫毒女祭司的战利品
Loot From A Voodoo Priestess

Text.text:
在女祭司那只血迹斑斑的挎包里，你找到一只塞紧的葫芦，里面装着清水；一枚双面铜币；以及一只小兽的骨头。她脸上那副厚重的木面具令人不寒而栗，当你对上它怒火翻涌的目光时，胃里一阵翻搅——但面具额头上嵌着的一块整雕翡翠看起来极其值钱。
In a blood-stained satchel on the priestess, you find a stoppered gourd filled with water, a two-headed copper coin, and the bones of a small animal. The imposing wooden mask she wears makes your stomach churn when you meet its furious gaze—but the carved piece of solid jade embedded in its forehead looks very valuable.

你本不知道该如何想象这处聚落的首领，可眼前这名形容枯槁的人影，看起来更像个殡葬师。他紧抿的嘴唇像一道刀口，夹在尖小的下巴与狭窄的鼻梁之间。灰色的眼睛从紧皱的眉弓下冷冷审视着你；眉上那头泛灰的头发向后梳拢，抹了油，贴得紧紧的，像是箍在头骨上一般。
You didn’t know what to expect of the leader of this settlement, but the gaunt figure before you looks more like an undertaker. His tight-lipped mouth is a slash between a small chin and a narrow nose. Gray eyes examine you coldly from under a furrowed brow, above which his graying hair is swept back and greased down tight to his skull.

凸窗如画框般收拢了乡野的壮丽景致，其中也包括延展铺开的斯派尔威奇镇。窗边坐榻覆着深邃的蓝色华丽织物软垫，一对木制膝上书桌倚靠着窗pane。旁侧立着一张带围栏的书桌，配有一整套墨水瓶与一叠叠毫无瑕疵的纸张。你在房内探查时，忽然察觉自己的脚步声不再让地板吱呀作响——或许是某种消音的法术？
A bay window frames a stunning view of the countryside, including the sprawling town of Spirewych. The window seat is cushioned with rich blue fabric, and a pair of wooden lap-desks rest against the pane. A walled desk sits nearby, equipped with a full inkwell and stacks of unblemished paper. You notice your footfalls have stopped making the floorboards creak as you explore—a sound-muffling spell, perhaps?

维多利亚束腰是一场由呼吸与系带编织的谎言。布料是蒙尘的粉红，配饰则是油亮的黑。系带洁白，粗糙如绳，正好牢牢攫住那些精心设计的金属扣眼。这位裁缝娘尤其狠毒，想出让系带拉扯卡咬的法子，既把腰围榨到最小，也把折磨推到最大。它们甚至需要一个刁钻的解扣动作，才勉强让人产生“或许能松开”的念头。
The Victorian corset is a lie made of breath and laces. The fabric is dusty pink and the accoutrements glossy black. Its laces are white and rough as rope, the better to grab the carefully designed grommets. This seamstress was particularly vicious, devising a way for the laces to pull and catch, minimizing the waistline and maximizing the torture. They require a tricky release to even suggest the idea of loosening them.

Mighty Fortress.name:
坚不可摧的要塞
Mighty Fortress

Text.text:
施法者在掌心碾碎一颗小钻石，双眼翻白。大地隆隆震颤，低沉而有节奏的轰鸣如雷霆般深邃。壁垒、工事、城垛自荒芜的土地中拔地而起，凝聚成一座巍然巨堡。四座炮塔刺向苍穹，带刺的胸墙如利爪般森然。越过外墙，一座小型主堡巍立三层。旗帜沿外墙垂落，昭示着施法者的纹章。
The caster crushes a small diamond in their palm, and their eyes roll back into their head. The ground rumbles a low, percussive sound, thunderous and deep. Ramparts, fortifications, battlements all rise from the barren earth, coalescing into a mighty fortress. Four turrets prod the sky, their spiked parapets like claws. Past the outer walls, a small keep stands three floors high. Banners fall down the outer walls, proclaiming the caster’s heraldry.

Claws Of Flame Wrist Tattoo Revealed.name:
烈焰之爪手腕刺青显现
Claws Of Flame Wrist Tattoo Revealed

Text.text:
那人扯了扯缠在手腕上的一截暗色布条，露出掌下方前臂上的纹身。黑色线条彼此交缠蜿蜒，勾勒出一个令人联想到火焰的形状——又或许，是一只三趾利爪。
The person pulls on the bit of dark cloth wrapped around their wrist, revealing a tattoo on the forearm just under their palm. Black lines intertwine and bend to create a shape that recalls a flame—or perhaps a three-toed claw.

Castle: Collapsed Ceiling.name:
城堡：坍塌的天花板
Castle: Collapsed Ceiling

Text.text:
如同这座城堡曾效忠的王国一般，主堡也已沦为废墟。破碎的橡木梁从瓦砾与乱石堆中刺出，像一头巨兽腐朽遗骸的肋骨般裸露；穹顶被撕开一道巨大的窟窿，光线从中倾泻而下。附近积着一滩死水，许多吱呀呻吟的地板似乎被腐烂涨得鼓胀。
Like the kingdom this castle once served, the keep lies in ruins. Shattered oak beams poke out from piles of rubble and stone like the ribs of a huge beast, left to decay, and light streams into the castle from a cavernous hole in the roof. A puddle of stagnant water lies nearby, and many of the groaning floorboards seem swollen with rot.

纤细、扭动的触须环绕着中央那张大张着的巨口，酸液滴落。生物让触须高速震颤，扭曲周遭光线，凝成一团浑浊的、初生的黑雾。你的视野随之衰弱，明暗闪烁不定。而当野兽逼近时，房间里所有声音都被瞬间抽空，仿佛气闸泄压般无声喷散。
Thin, writhing tendrils circle a central maw that hangs agape, dripping acid. The creature vibrates the tendrils, manipulating nearby light into a murky cloud of nascent black. Your vision weakens, flickering. And as the beast closes in, all sound is sucked from the room like the venting of an airlock.

Taunt From A Dragon To A Diverse Party.name:
巨龙对杂牌小队的嘲讽
Taunt From A Dragon To A Diverse Party

Text.text:
“我没想到你们居然还有这么多令人兴奋的花样。大的就拿来吃掉，小的嘛——我就拿来当牙签用。”
“I didn’t realize you came in such exciting varieties. The large ones will be eaten, and the little ones I’ll use as toothpicks.”

Temple To A God Of Arcane Magic.name:
秘奥魔法之神的神殿
Temple To A God Of Arcane Magic

Text.text:
神庙？不，这里看起来是一座图书馆：木墙镶板的阅览室里，长长的书架一排排延伸，其上陈列着卷轴、典籍与魔导书。然而，书架的迷宫般排列包围着这座古老石砌建筑的中央一间密室。密室里摆着天鹅绒座椅、一张圆形红地毯、点点烛光，而房间正中央，只有一本魔导书，塞满了法术。第一页便是一道召唤——向魔法最初的原初之力发出的祈请。
A temple? This is a library, it seems: a wood-paneled reading room with long rows of shelves holding scrolls and tomes and grimoires. But the maze of shelves surrounds a chamber in the center of the old stone building. In that chamber are velvet chairs, a circular red rug, candles, and in the room’s center, a single grimoire packed with spells. The first of them is a summoning, a petition to the original power of magic.

你将绳圈套在目标身上，一边高声念出咒词，一边完成手势，迅速把绳结收紧。目标立刻离地而起，在空中悬浮数寸，仿佛重力也无从干预。
You tie the loop around the target, quickly drawing it snug as you speak aloud the words and complete the gestures. The target immediately lifts off the ground, hovering a few inches in the air, unbidden by gravity.

那可怜的生物蜷缩在一堆破布里。它身边堆满了社会的残渣：几只碎裂的陶罐、空荡的玻璃瓶、肮脏帆布的破片，还有一只鸡的残骸——骨头早已被啃得干干净净。它伸出一只橄榄色的手，指甲乌黑，随着手臂一抬，一股像敞口下水道般的恶臭扑面而来，让你不得不强压住干呕的冲动。你从包里取出一条刚出炉的面包——那香气像抹在你饱受折磨的感官上的温柔药膏——又从袋子里掏出另一只鸡，肥硕而刚被宰杀，将两样东西一并递过去。地精那对鼓胀的黄眼珠越过长鼻子盯着你，随即咧嘴一笑，满口尖牙森然。它一把夺过食物，朝你招手，示意你跟上。
The wretched creature huddles within a heap of rags. The debris of society surrounds it: several broken clay pots, empty glass bottles, shreds of filthy canvas, and the remains of a chicken whose bones have long been picked clean. It reaches out an olive-hued hand with blackened nails, wafting up a stench reminiscent of an open sewer and causing you to fight the urge to gag. You take out a loaf of freshly baked bread from your bag—its aroma a soothing balm to your battered senses—while from a sack you produce another chicken, plump and freshly killed, handing them both over. The goblin’s bulbous yellow eyes stare at you above a long nose, then it grins with a mouth bedecked with pointy teeth. It snatches the food from you and beckons you to follow.

Belt Of Stone Giant Strength.name:
石巨人力量腰带
Belt Of Stone Giant Strength

Text.text:
腰带由粗糙的皮革与兽皮编成辫状，垂着几缕白色毛皮流苏。腰带正面固定着一张以蓝灰色石头雕出的无毛面孔。那张脸的下颌紧咬，外露的每一颗牙都被单独刻出；厚重的眉脊低垂，略微遮住双眼——那是一对天蓝色的海蓝宝石，其间缠绕着雾白色的纹理。

~ 由 Rakbel316 所构想

The belt is a braid of rough leather and hide, with tassels of white fur hanging from it. The front of the belt is affixed with a hairless visage carved of blue-gray stone. The face’s jaw is clenched, each bared tooth individually carved. Its heavy brow hangs over and slightly shadows its eyes, constituted by two sky-blue aquamarines veined with misty-white lines.

~ Envisioned by Rakbel316

Residential District With Colorful Roofs.name:
彩顶民居区
Residential District With Colorful Roofs

Text.text:
这片住宅区域的屋顶铺着鲜艳的红蓝瓦片，在临近正午的阳光下，漆色明亮得几乎发烫。许多人穿行于区域之中，却没有人偏离既定路线；也没人彼此搭话闲聊。人人垂着眼，往返于本地集市，臂弯里挎着装满食材的袋子与篮筐。一个孩子忽然仰头问母亲一句，鞋底擦过鹅卵石路面，发出吱呀的尖响。她轻声把他按住，递给他一串葡萄，让他忙着咀嚼，把声音吞回去。

~ Envisioned by Ghost Bee

The roofs of this residential district are decorated with vibrant red and blue tiles, the paint vivid in the late morning sun. Many people pass through the area, though no one wanders from their route; nor do they begin idle conversations with one another. Eyes cast down, they make their way to and from the local market, arms bearing bags and baskets for their groceries. A child pipes up with a question for his mother, his shoes squeaking against the cobblestone street. She hushes him gently and hands him a bunch of grapes to occupy him.

~ Envisioned by Ghost Bee

Drone And Vehicle Junkyard.name:
无人机与载具废料场
Drone And Vehicle Junkyard

Text.text:
无人机与其他载具那锈蚀空洞的躯壳在废品场四周堆成一座座尸丘，仿佛一处暴露在风雨中的万人坑。它们只剩腐朽的底盘，这些不幸的机器早在很久以前就被剥走了所有有用或值钱的部件。如今，它们只能等待着，用空洞的眼睛凝望那终将降临、碾碎一切的必然命运。
The rusting, hollow bodies of drones and other vehicles lie in heaps around the junkyard, like a mass grave left open to the elements. Little more than rotting chassis, the unfortunate machines have been stripped of anything useful or valuable long ago. Now they wait, gazing with empty eyes at the crushing, inevitable fate which awaits them all.

Cube Of Force.name:
力场魔方
Cube Of Force

Text.text:
这枚通透的水晶立方体，看起来像某种怪异游戏的骰子。每一面都刻着一个符号，微微凸起于其余表面之上：一面像云，另一面是长方形；接着还有心形、星形、圆形，最后是一枚几乎占满整面的巨大凸起方形。
This cube of clear crystal looks like the die for a strange game. Each side has a symbol on it, slightly raised from the rest of the surface. One looks like a cloud, another side has a rectangle, and then there are a heart, a star, a circle, and finally a large raised square that occupies nearly all of its side.

Alabaster Corpse Of A God.name:
神祇的雪白遗骸
Alabaster Corpse Of A God

Text.text:
一只赤裸的雪白脚掌如高塔般压在你面前，脚跟映着正午的烈阳。你眯起眼，沿着尸体的侧面向下望去。那轮廓很熟悉——类人——可那尺度却令人无法理解。你戳了戳那人的脚底，想确认这不是一尊石像。最轻微的接触便令皮肤撕裂，点点璀璨光尘倾泻而出，随即飘飘然升向苍穹。
A bare, alabaster foot towers over you, its heel reflecting the noon sun. Through squinting eyes you peer down the side of the corpse. The shape is familiar—humanoid—but the scale is incomprehensible. You prod the figure's sole to confirm it's no stone statue. The skin tears with the lightest touch, and motes of brilliant light spill out then drift up to the heavens.

当你瞥见这具诡异的人形恐怖时，异界的惊惧侵入你的脑海，逼得你把视线压向地面。可你仍看得见那生物的脚——看得见那无色的皮肉紧绷地覆在已然融合的指骨上。病态的迷恋牵引着你的目光向上：掠过它锋利的脚踝、疙瘩般突起的膝盖、再到那如同人体模特般空洞的胯部。违背你的意志，你的双眼沿着它饥饿枯瘦的形体继续旅行，越过凹陷的腹部。你看见它一束束肌纤维像钢琴弦般绷紧，将四根生着利爪的手指牵引入你的视野。那几根手指触及过来，轻轻托起你的下巴，让你不得不直视那生物的脸。寒意灌满你的脊柱，胆汁猛地涌上喉头——在你望进它那张大张的嘴与洞穴般的眼眶时。那些虚空仿佛无底，尽管其中正被一种污浊的光填满，愈发明亮，也愈发可怖。
Alien terror infects your mind as you glance at this uncanny humanlike horror, forcing your eyes down to the ground. But you can still see the creature's feet; you can still see the colorless flesh stretched tight over fused phalanges. A morbid fascination draws your eyes up to its sharp ankles, then its knobby knees, and its mannequin crotch. Against your will, your eyes travel up the starved form of its gaunt abdomen. You watch as its individual muscle fibers tighten like piano strings to bring four clawed fingers into view. Those fingers reach out to gently pull your chin up so you stare into the creature's face. Ice fills your spinal column, and bile rushes up your throat as you look upon the creature's gaping mouth and cavernous eye sockets. Those voids seem depthless, even as they fill with a tainted light growing brighter and more horrible.

Sermon Against The Undead.name:
讨伐亡灵的布道
Sermon Against The Undead

Text.text:
“——而如今，神祇已召唤我们挺身而出，对抗这些卑劣之物；它们每一步都在亵渎我们挚爱之人的遗骸。但无需畏惧，因为它们的污秽必将被我们正义之光焚尽。待那血腥之事了结，这些游荡的可憎之物终将得享安宁。”
“—and now we have been asked by the gods to stand against these vile creatures, whose every step defiles the bodies of our loved ones. But do not fear, for their corruption will be burnt away by our righteous light. After the bloody deed is done, these wandering abominations will finally know peace.”

Room In An Inn.name:
旅店客房
Room In An Inn

Text.text:
沉重的橡木门沿走廊一字排开，每扇门上都烙着一枚失去光泽的铜字母。门与门之间挂着一幅幅肖像，年代久远而褪色，画中人是旅店往昔的主人或声名显赫的常客。钥匙一拧，门吱呀一声开了；你走进去，见到的是简朴却舒适的陈设：一张羽毛床，老旧的木架轻轻作响；床边一张小桌，上面放着一对蜂蜡蜡烛；一只小脚箱，扣着沉重的铁挂锁；一只木制洗脸盆，其上方悬着一面长椭圆的镜子。房间里弥漫着旧木与干薰衣草的怡人气息。
Heavy oaken doors line the hallway, each emblazoned with a tarnished copper letter. Portraits hang between the doors, faded with age, depicting past owners of the inn or famous patrons. The door creaks open with a twist of the key, and inside you find spartan but comfortable accommodations: a feather bed with a creaky wooden frame, a small bedside table with a pair of beeswax candles, a small footlocker with a heavy iron padlock, and a wooden washing basin, above which hangs an oblong mirror. The room smells pleasantly of old wood and dried lavender.

Dense Forest In A Brisk Air.name:
清冽寒风中的密林
Dense Forest In A Brisk Air

Text.text:
森林异常稠密，目光难以穿透其深处。清冽的空气涌入鼻腔，带来木质与腐朽交织的泥土气息。金色的阳光如细针般穿过头顶层层树叶，在一截扭曲的树根、一只怯生生的林鼠，以及野生块茎的翠叶上投下聚光。鸟儿在枝间飞掠，每一声啼鸣都尖利而清脆。脚下枯枝与松针被轻轻碾碎的沙沙声，填满了这片原始荒野所剩无几的寂静。
The forest is dense, making it difficult to peer far into it. A brisk air fills your nostrils with the earthy smell of wood and decomposition. Golden pins of sunshine thread the layers of foliage overhead and spotlight a twisted root, a shy wood mouse, and the green leaves of a wild tuber. Birds flit from branch to branch, each chirping a shrill, sharp song. The soft crunch of twigs and pine needles underfoot fills what little silence remains in this pristine wilderness.

Cloak Of Displacement.name:
移位斗篷
Cloak Of Displacement

Text.text:
这件斗篷线条利落，通体漆黑，接触之下柔软顺滑——那张兽皮在那头猫科凶兽殒命之前必定华美非凡。更怪的是，斗篷背后垂落着一对古怪的附肢，摇曳悬挂，倒更像头足类的触腕，而非任何猫类所有。
The cloak is sleek, black, and soft to the touch—the hide must have been magnificent before the feline beast’s demise. Strangely enough, draping down the back of the cloak, a pair of peculiar appendages dangle, more akin to a cephalopod than that of any cat.

Person Ranting On The Corner.name:
街角咆哮的人
Person Ranting On The Corner

Text.text:
她衣衫不整，长发纠结成一团乱麻，肮脏的双手在空中胡乱挥舞，时而拍打，时而抓挠那些你根本看不见的东西。即便她不是在街角嚎哭发狂，光凭这副模样，你也会认定她已经疯了。
Her clothes disheveled, her long hair a tangled mat, she waves filthy hands through the air, alternately swatting or scratching at things you can’t see. Even if she wasn’t wailing and raving on a street corner, her appearance alone would have you guess her to be mad.

Taunt From Wood Elf Running At Full Spee.name:
以全速奔跑的木精灵发出的嘲弄
Taunt From Wood Elf Running At Full Speed

Text.text:
“快点！当心脚下坑洼！喂，跟上——哈哈哈！呜呼——！小心脑袋！来啊，抓住我！”
“Come on! Mind the rough ground, now! Hey, come on and keep up—hahaha! Wooo-hooo! Mind your head! Come on and catch me!”

Farmer’s Field In Snow.name:
雪中的农田
Farmer’s Field In Snow

Text.text:
在冬日静谧的怀抱里，农夫的田地沉睡于安宁之中。大地披覆着晶亮的雪白，终于在刺骨的寂静里得以歇息。庄稼早已收割殆尽，新种子静候春的到来，等待生命再度绽放。
In the serene embrace of winter, a farmer’s field slumbers in tranquil peace. The land, cloaked in glistening white, finally rests in the frigid hush. Its crops are long since harvested, with new seeds awaiting the promise of spring and the bloom of life once more.

Bag Of Greens.name:
一袋青翠蔬叶
Bag Of Greens

Text.text:
一只装满新割嫩绿的皮革小袋——一座葱茏的宝藏宝库——被一位部族长者捧在掌心。那些纤薄的叶片宛如从自然万花筒中摘取的翠绿宝石，蕴藏着治疗与滋养的力量。它们低语着远古的药方，也是一场献给感官的盛宴，每一口都许诺着蓬勃的活力。
A leather pouch of freshly cut greens, a verdant treasure trove, sits cupped in the hands of a tribal elder. Like vibrant emeralds plucked from nature's kaleidoscope, these delicate leaves hold the power of healing and nourishment. They whisper of ancient remedies, and a feast for the senses, promising vitality with each bite.

Goblin With A Shortsword.name:
持短剑的地精
Goblin With A Shortsword

Text.text:
那只绿皮地精在你面前显得毫不退让、信心十足，下巴微微上扬，带着明确的意图。它将短剑举在身前，幽暗的光线里锋芒冷厉；刀刃显然年岁已久，却被细心保养得很好。你毫不怀疑，这只地精会在第一丝威胁出现时就发动攻击……甚至可能更早。
The green goblin looks unyielding and confident before you, its chin tilted up with purpose. The shortsword raised before it glints sharply in the low light, the blade clearly old but well-cared for. You know without question that this goblin will attack at the first threat . . . perhaps even before.

一阵刺骨的冷风似乎从山坡上凿出的隧道里向外涌出。阳光只能探入隧道短短几步，随后便被沉沉的黑暗吞没。它通向何处？里面又潜藏着什么？
A chill wind seems to flow outward from the tunnel carved in the hillside. Sunlight only penetrates a few paces into the tunnel, which disappears into oppressive darkness. Where does it lead? And what lies within?

Early Winter Tournament Melee.name:
初冬锦标混战
Early Winter Tournament Melee

Text.text:
细雨迷蒙，遮住了那团挣扎缠斗的人影；钝器砸在湿透的盾牌上，只回荡着空洞的闷响。人群哼哧喘息、跌撞滑行，热气从面甲缝隙里一口口喷出，在覆着烂泥冰浆的险滑地面上拼命撑住不倒。围观者同样凄惨，冷雨打湿面孔，神情却满是轻蔑，嫌恶地看着这场可怜的闹剧。
Drizzle obscures the struggling mass of combatants, their blunted weapons ringing hollow upon sodden shields. The grunting, gasping throng slip and slide, breath bursting from visors, hard pressed to remain upright on the treacherous slush-covered ground. The crowd looks on, as miserable as the combatants, their faces disdainful of the pitiful show.

Loot From A Vampire Spawn.name:
吸血鬼（特征）仆从的战利品
Loot From A Vampire Spawn

Text.text:
它本该挂在怪物那苍白的颈间：一枚金质坠饰，镶嵌着精美的铂金卷纹，价值250枚金币。或许，那是这不幸之人在被转化之前的人生里，曾珍藏过的一份赋礼。
It would have hung around the monster’s pallid neck: a golden medallion, inlaid with beautiful platinum scrollwork, worth 250 gold pieces. Perhaps it was a treasured gift from a life this unfortunate soul knew before they were turned.

Intimidating Gang Leader.name:
令人胆寒的帮派头目
Intimidating Gang Leader

Text.text:
这男人浑身都是肌肉与枪火，穿的衣服就是为了把它们炫出来。他把头发剃得干干净净，免得分心，让人能清楚看见那张方正粗硬的脸上纵横交错的疤痕。就连他自己帮派里的人在他身边也显得踌躇，刻意与他拉开距离。
The man is all muscle and guns, with clothes designed to show them off. His hair is shaved to prevent distraction, ensuring a clear view of the scars adorning his blocky face. Even the members of his own gang seem hesitant around him, and give him a wide berth.

光是注视它就刺痛双眼。你后脑勺仿佛因这份努力而燃烧。谁能描绘这黑暗的化身？一团翻卷的阴影旋涡，灰色的人形躯体，斑驳的皮肤裂开无唇的伤口，仿佛连光本身都要被它们吸走。纤长的手臂末端生着五根修长利爪，在粗大的挥砍中迸射出荧光般的虹彩。那生物的面容被一团暗云缠绕，仿佛书法家的笔锋以最深的墨黑扫过野兽的轮廓。唯有那张口仍清晰可见，巨口大张，露出一排饥渴的獠牙。
It stings to look upon. The back of your head is aflame with the effort. Who could describe this avatar of darkness? A swirling mass of shadows, gray humanoid body, piebald skin sporting lipless gashes that seem to suck at the light itself. Lithe arms end in five long claws that flash fluorescent in broad cuts of rainbow. The creature’s face is wreathed in a dark cloud, as though a calligrapher’s brush has swept the edges of the beast in darkest black. Only the maw of the face remains visible, gaping wide a set of ravenous fangs.

The Knight Revealed.name:
揭晓的骑士
The Knight Revealed

Text.text:
那男人披着褪色破烂的衣衫，倚着一根虬结的手杖踉跄站立，目光低垂。银丝斑驳的八字胡微微颤动，他忽然一抖手腕，将手杖高高举过头顶。暖风拂过他身上的碎布，伴随一声低低的嗡鸣，柔和的光自他脚边升起，迅速膨胀，将他整个人笼罩其中。那身影迸放出眩目的光辉，五彩流转，金斑点点；光芒沿着流浪汉高举的双臂延伸，穿过手杖的木质纹理——刹那间，手杖化作一柄华丽的利刃。光辉退去，留下熠熠生辉的武装：一把耀目的光刃，以及一套闪耀的板甲。曾经佝偻的平凡流浪者消失无踪，取而代之的是一名巍然矗立的骑士，身披金色护甲，灿然如日。

~ 由 AmateurJack 构想

The man, draped in faded and frayed garments, stands unsteadily as he leans on a gnarled walking stick, eyes downcast. His silver-streaked mustache twitches, and with a flourish, he lifts the cane over his head. A warm wind rustles the rags he wears, and with a hum, a soft glow rises from his feet, growing to envelop him. Dazzling light shines from the figure, multi-colored and dappled with gold. It extends into the drifter’s raised arms, through the wood of the walking stick; in an instant, the cane becomes an ornate blade. The light recedes, leaving in its wake gleaming armament—the radiant blade and a suit of shining plate. Where the unassuming drifter once slouched now towers a knight resplendent in golden armor.

~ Envisioned by AmateurJack

Interaction Between A Fairy And An Ai.name:
仙灵与AI的交互
Interaction Between A Fairy And An Ai

Text.text:
“所以，创造你的人都不在了吗？这也太悲伤了。他们会回来吗？” 他们是肮脏的种族，必须从污秽中被清除。 “哎呀，那他们也许只是去洗干净了……洗澡的时候很容易忘了时间！” 是的，或许正是如此。也许你能带我去见见你的族人，我也可以让他们同样变得干净？

~ 一位英雄所构想

“So, all the people that made you are gone? That’s so sad. Are they coming back?” They were an unclean race, and needed to be purged of their filth. “Golly, well maybe they just went to get cleaned up… It’s easy to lose track of time when you’re taking a bath!” Yes, that is probably it. Perhaps you could lead me to your people and I could make them clean as well?

~ Envisioned by a Hero

A Tenday Of Travel By Horse Through A Ch.name:
一段为期十天的骑马旅行，穿越由冬入春的更迭
A Tenday Of Travel By Horse Through A Change To Spring

Text.text:
你的阉马在融雪中慢吞吞地踏步前行，吐息融入四周的白雾。荒原已在身后，沼泽的恶臭终于渐渐散去。你继续旅行时，雨势骤然变得倾盆，你只得躲进一座废弃的农舍避雨，在那里整整待了一天把身子烘干。第六天醒来，阳光耀眼，天空湛蓝。趁着天气转好，你翻身上坐骑，接下来的几天行程顺遂，步程大进。积雪已成回忆，路旁点点新绿，春芽正悄然绽放。等你触及目的地时，早已脱下冬装，让温暖的金黄日光洒在脸上。
Your gelding plods through melting snow, its breath joining the surrounding mist. The moor is behind you and the stink of bogs finally fades. As you travel onward it begins to rain heavily, so you seek shelter in an abandoned farmhouse, remaining there a full day to get dry. On the sixth day you awake to brilliant sunshine and a blue sky. Taking advantage of the break in the weather, you mount up and make good headway for the next several days. The snow is a memory, the roadside now dappled with spring buds opening. By the time you reach your destination you have doffed your winter garb, enjoying the warm yellow sun on your face.

你将手中那块小小的花岗岩当作法术构型的矩阵，只要你的专注尚未崩散，十号块坚实的石方便会依照你所选定的排列自虚空中凭空显现。
Using the small block of granite in your hand as a matrix for your spell’s design, ten blocks of solid stone appear out of thin air in the pattern of your choosing, so long as your concentration holds out.

高举着两支火把——贪婪的烈焰在其上咆哮——地精的双臂伸展，活像一个小孩迎向母亲的招呼被扭曲成了阴森的亵渎。几乎愈合的熔融皮肉覆在这生物身上，宛如凝固的熔岩，将它原本的五官彻底糊成一团。它咧开那口参差断裂的牙，裂到几乎要撕开面孔，喷吐出令人血液冻结的焚身威胁。随后，它猛冲而来。火把的光映在它发热的眼里，却远不及这生物那颗细小黑心里燃着的狂热。想把你、把你身边的一切烧成灰的渴望，压倒了它对自身性命的任何眷恋。刹那间，它那具残破的血肉竟比它贫乏词汇能吐出的任何话都更具直观的威胁。
Holding twin torches—roaring with ravenous fire—the goblin's arms stretch out like a sinister perversion of a small child's greeting for its mother. Their features are no longer distinguishable due to the layer of barely-healed melted flesh that coats this creature like hardened lava. Their wide, fractured-tooth grin rips open to spew bloodcurdling threats of immolation. Then they charge. The torchlight reflected in their fevered eyes is nothing to the fervor in this creature's tiny black heart. The desire to burn you, and everything around you, surmounts any desire for self-preservation. Suddenly, their ruined flesh seems a more visceral threat than any they could vocalize with their limited vocabulary.

沙砾在令人窒息的烈日下闪烁，仿佛黄铜般刺眼。沙丘如山岳般高耸，又似海啸般翻涌，蜿蜒绵延数里，横贯这片干枯的荒原。沙丘坡面陡峭，你才开始攀爬，靴子一陷进松散的细沙便立刻向下滑坠。你的双腿在这番挣扎中酸痛难忍。
The sand glimmers like brass in the oppressive sun. The dunes tower like mountains, like tidal waves, winding for miles across the arid landscape. The sides of the dunes are steep, and as you start to scale them, you slide downward when your boots sink into the loose sand. Your legs ache with the effort.

Spectacled Owl.name:
戴眼镜的猫头鹰
Spectacled Owl

Text.text:
它警惕地栖在高处观望，模样竟有几分像个矮小、严厉的图书管理员。翅膀与头部那层浓郁的深褐羽色，与浅褐胸前形成鲜明对比；胸口的羽毛仿佛一件合身的学者马甲。眼周那圈白羽——宛如眼镜——让它的神情永远带着冷静而精密的审视与算计。
Observing vigilantly from its perch, this owl slightly resembles a small, gruff librarian. The richly brown feathers of its wings and head provide a striking contrast to its tawny chest, where the feathers resemble a fitted, scholarly vest. The white feathers surrounding its eyes—its spectacles—give it an expression of constant, calculating discernment.

I Cast Ball Lightning From My Ring Of Sh.name:
我从【流星射击之戒】中施放出球状闪电
I Cast Ball Lightning From My Ring Of Shooting Stars

Text.text:
我握住戴戒指那只手的手腕，稳住心神。宝石迸出细小的闪电舌——在表面跳跃，继而沿着我的手臂无害地窜下。紧接着，一团滋滋作响的电光球自宝石中绽开，噼啪爆闪从它的轮廓上迸落。敌人逼近时，电光球愈发炽亮，猛然放出一缕刺痛的纯粹雷电触须，护住我。
I hold the wrist of my ring-bearing hand, centering myself. The gem sparks with tiny tongues of lightning—arcing over its surface and harmlessly down my arm. Then an orb of sizzling electricity blooms out of the gem, flashes popping off its form. As enemies close in, the orb glows brighter and discharges a stinging tendril of pure lightning to protect me.

Speech By A Crime Lord About Corruption.name:
腐败不是怪物；腐败是空气。你们每一次眨眼、每一次沉默、每一次点头，都在吸进它、吐出它。你们以为自己站在秩序这边？不，你们只是站在价格更高的一边。

我不是在贩卖罪恶，我是在经营现实。法律写在纸上，权力写在皮肤里，而钱——钱写在每个人的胃里。饿着的人会讲道德，吃饱的人会讲原则；可当他们的孩子发烧、房租到期、债主敲门时，原则就会像油漆一样剥落，露出底下更真实的颜色。

你们说我腐蚀了这座城？这座城早就烂了。我只是把烂掉的地方擦亮，让它看起来像金子。你们喜欢干净的故事：英雄、恶棍、正义的结局。可真相更简单——每个人都有价码。只不过有些人卖的是手，有些人卖的是嘴，有些人卖的是眼睛，假装没看见。

看那群穿制服的，他们说自己守护秩序。可秩序是什么？是一条不让穷人过河的绳子，是一扇只给富人开门的锁。你们以为他们在抓我？不，他们在和我谈分成。今天抓一个替罪羊，明天就有一张更大的桌子摆出来，盘子里装的还是同一块肉。

腐败最聪明的地方在于：它从不逼迫，它只提供选择。你签个字，换来孩子的学费；你睁一只眼，换来升职的机会；你把良心放进抽屉，换来一条能活下去的路。你们管这叫堕落？我管这叫交易。交易从来不问你是不是好人，它只问你缺什么。

所以别再用正义的口号对我嚷嚷。你们要的是一个能被憎恨的名字，一个能让你们相信自己仍然干净的靶子。可你们知道吗？你们真正害怕的不是我——是镜子。因为镜子里那张脸，和我一样懂得：世界不是被善良维系的，是被利益缝合的。

我会倒吗？也许会。总有一天，风向变了，刀子更快，某个更年轻、更狠的家伙会坐上我的椅子。可腐败不会死。它只会换一件外套，换一个徽章，换一套口号，然后继续在这座城的血管里流动。

你们想清白？可以。把饥饿从街上赶走，把恐惧从门后赶走，把贪婪从心里拔出来。否则，就别装作惊讶——当你们伸手去接我递过去的东西时，指尖上沾到的那点黑，不是我给的，是你们一直带着的。
Speech By A Crime Lord About Corruption

Text.text:
“交易啊，我的朋友们。交易才让这一切运转。进步的车轮没有一点润滑就不会转动。你们爱把这叫作‘腐败’也行，但那可不高尚。那不过是那些弱到玩不起这场游戏的人才会说的话。”
“Deals, my friends. Deals make all this work. The wheels of progress don’t turn without a little grease. You can call it ‘corruption’ all you want, but that isn’t noble. It’s just what people say when they’re too weak to play the game.”

Icy Wasteland: Sheltering From The Wind.name:
冰封荒原：躲避狂风
Icy Wasteland: Sheltering From The Wind

Text.text:
狂风横扫雪原，呼啸如刃，但你找到了一处背风的藏身点，替你挡去了它最凶狠的怒势。你合上双眼，几乎能把这一切想象成遥远某处一个风大的日子——炉火与家门近在咫尺。然而一阵战栗猛然攫住你的身躯，将你狠狠拽回此时此地：这里寒冷得足以夺命，温暖与安宁仿佛只是梦。
The winds blast across the snowy wastes, but you’ve found a sheltered spot that spares you the worst of its fury. When you close your eyes, you can almost imagine it to be a blustery day somewhere far away, where hearth and home are close at hand. But then a shiver wracks your body, snapping you sharply back to the here and now: where it is deathly cold, and comfort and safety seem like dreams.

I Feel My Bond With My Deity Break.name:
我感到自己与神祇的羁绊断裂
I Feel My Bond With My Deity Break

Text.text: 我感觉胸口正中猛地一拽，仿佛一根绳索勒紧我的心——凶狠得让我害怕它会爆裂。可下一秒，那条无形的系绳忽然绷断，一阵狂喜般的轻飘感席卷全身，令我头晕目眩；紧随其后，恶心沉进胃里，像一块沉重的石头在坠落，砰然砸进烂泥，闷响震荡。冷汗瞬间涌出，覆上我的胸膛、颈项与头皮，像被抛下了一层幽灵般的薄纱。可是……不。不，这并非某种新事物的存在。这是某样我曾以为离了就活不下去之物的缺席。 I feel a tug at the center of my chest, like a rope tightening around my heart—so fierce I fear it might burst. But then the unseen tether snaps, and I feel a euphoric lightness throughout my body, making my head swim, followed by a nausea settling into my stomach like a heavy rock falling, thudding against mud. I break into a cold sweat that coats my chest, neck, and head, like a ghostly veil has been thrown over me. But… No. This is not the presence of something new. It is the absence of something I thought I could not live without.

比起木筏更不笨重，比起独木舟却更不灵活，这条小船温馨而小巧。船舷是绿色的，船身两侧是明快的黄色。长凳上放着一条叠好的毯子。船桨卡在桨架里，桨叶浸在水中，像一只肥胖昆虫的腿。小划艇静候在河道回流的漩涡里，随时准备踏上旅行。
Less bulky than a raft, less maneuverable than a canoe, the boat is homey and small. Its rail is green and the sides a cheerful yellow. A folded blanket rests on the bench. The oars sit in their locks, blades in the water like the legs of a fat insect. The rowboat waits in the eddy of the river, ready to travel.

I Take Cover In An Urban Environment.name:
我在城市环境中寻求掩蔽
I Take Cover In An Urban Environment

Text.text:
我把后背死死贴在墙上，小巷里水洼的恶臭蒸腾上来，几乎要把我闷得喘不过气。敌人将攻势劈头盖脸掷来，砖面被打得崩裂，碎屑化作红褐色的粉末四下飞扬。我抬臂遮住眼睛，攥紧手中的武器，飞快权衡。是挺身而出、以英雄般的胆魄迎战，还是夹着尾巴转身就逃？
I press my back against the building, the stink wafting up from the puddles of the alley threatening to stifle me. The enemy flings attacks at me, breaking off chunks of the brick into reddish-brown powder. I shield my eyes and grasp my weapon, weighing my options. Stand and fight with heroic bravado, or turn tail and run?

Mummified Bat Talisman.name:
木乃伊化蝙蝠护符
Mummified Bat Talisman

Text.text:
纸莎草与草药的土腥气浸透了这具生翼的木乃伊（特征），干枯空洞的眼眶从它那小巧、如啮齿兽般的颅骨中直勾勾地凝视着。

The earthy scent of papyrus and herbs suffuses the winged mummy, and hollow, desiccated eye sockets stare out from its small, rodent-like skull.

一匹独狼踱上倾斜的岩石，发出一声尖厉的长嚎。它全身随着嚎叫弓起，粗厚的灰色皮毛在结实的躯干上根根竖立。尽管这头野兽确实狰狞可怖，却缺少恐狼同类那种格外突出的身高与负载般的压迫感。然而，若那声嚎叫是在召唤余下的狼群，就绝对不可小觑。
A lone wolf lopes up a slanted rock and lets out a piercing howl. Its whole body arches into the call, thick gray fur bristling along its sturdy frame. While the beast certainly looks fearsome, it lacks the distinctive height and bulk of its dire counterparts. Yet, if that howl was a call for the rest of its pack, it’s certainly nothing to underestimate.

Tournament Armory.name:
锦标赛军械库
Tournament Armory

Text.text:
宽阔的大厅里弥漫着油脂与钢铁的刺鼻气味，木制兵架上陈列着琳琅满目的武器与护甲。各式长短不一的刀刃，以及用来砸击、压碎或痛殴敌人的千般重器，尽皆整装待发。一套套护甲在烛光下熠熠生辉，铁匠们则埋头苦干，细致修补并打理骑士们赴会所需的装备。
The large room stinks of oil and steel, and an extensive selection of weapons and armor adorns the timber racks. Blades of all lengths, and myriad tools to smash, crush, or bludgeon a foe, stand ready. Suits of armor gleam in the candlelight, while smiths work diligently, repairing and preparing the knights' accoutrements for the event.

这把弯刀的刀身在钝刃一侧被工整却生疏地刻上了难以辨读的纹样。它看起来只是用寻常的兵器钢打造而成，但弯刀的配重却隐隐透出异样的巧思，为持握者的手腕添上一股富有弹性的劲道，使劈砍的动作更为灵动，出刀后的连贯余势也随之更强。
The blade of this scimitar has been neatly, but inexpertly, inscribed with an unreadable design along its blunt side. Though it appears to have been made from common weaponsteel, something about the scimitar’s balance lends a springy strength to the holder’s wrist, allowing for a more dynamic chopping motion that improves its follow-through.

Elemental Gem Of Blue Sapphire.name:
蓝宝石元素宝石
Elemental Gem Of Blue Sapphire

Text.text:
这座奇异的结构由璀璨的蓝色水晶构成，轻得不可思议，脆弱得仿佛不该存在。不知如何，那些纤薄的晶片被编织成一只篮子般的形状。你忍不住试探性地捏了捏，结果比想象中坚韧得多。你确信自己单手就能将其捏碎，但它似乎不至于因无意的碰撞而毁坏。
This curious structure of brilliant blue crystal feels far too light and fragile to exist. Somehow the thin gems have been woven into a kind of basket. You can’t resist a testing squeeze, and it proves sturdier than you expected. You are certain you could crush it with one hand, but it seems safe from accidental destruction.

十来头大象缓缓踏过大地，宽大的耳朵拍打着，扬起一片尘土，尾巴来回甩动，驱赶着嗡嗡的飞虫。幼象在象群中央嬉闹翻腾，雄伟的长者则以睿智的褐色眼眸审视四周。
A dozen or so elephants plod across the landscape, flapping dust from their prodigious ears, and swatting at flies with their tails. Calves cavort in the midst of the herd, while majestic elders survey their surroundings with wise brown eyes.

I Detach A 10-foot Pole Patch From My Ro.name:
我从我的“实用物品长袍”上扯下一块10尺长杆补丁
I Detach A 10-foot Pole Patch From My Robe Of Useful Items

Text.text: 我差点就没注意到那块补丁；那道细细的刺绣线摸起来几乎和缝线一模一样。我用拇指和食指捏住它的末端，猛地把它从斗篷上扯下来。我刚好及时调整身形，接住那根凭空显现的十英尺长杆。它落进我手里，发出木头般的咚一声闷响。 I almost pass over the patch without realizing it, as the thin line of embroidery feels just like a seam. I pinch the end of it between my thumb and forefinger and rip it off the cloak. I maneuver myself just in time to catch the ten-foot pole that manifests out of thin air. It lands with a wooden clunk into my hands.

这只疯长般巨大的鼬类看起来并不怨毒也不残忍，但它的戒备丝毫不减其危险性。若无人制止，这头巨鼬一旦饿到一定程度，轻而易举就能把人的手或脚啃断。
This overgrown mustelid does not seem rancorous or cruel, but is no less dangerous for its apprehension. Left unchecked, the giant weasel could easily gnaw off a hand or foot should it get hungry enough.

Ring Of Warmth.name:
温暖之戒
Ring Of Warmth

Text.text:
抛光木质指环的内侧衬着柔软的毛皮，温暖而令人安心，宛如一只微型暖手筒。戒面处的刻纹是一团抽象的火焰漩涡。确实，即使将它托在掌心，指环也会散出些许热度——像一块在火边短暂烘暖过的石头。
The interior of the polished wooden band is lined with soft fur, warm and comforting, like a miniature muff. An etching at the head of the ring is an abstract whirlpool of flame. Indeed, even when held in the palm of your hand, the ring emits a minor amount of heat—like a stone briefly warmed by a fire.

Myathethil Anahera Yaeldrin.name:
米娅瑟希尔·安娜赫拉·雅尔德林
Myathethil Anahera Yaeldrin

Text.text:
这名女子在她存在的每一分性相中，都凝聚着冬日的冷冽优雅。她的五官美得纤细，如覆霜的花朵；瓷白肌肤上，深色而繁复的纹身将这份美感衬得愈发凌厉。她的双眼是冰封河流般的璀璨蓝光，带着敏锐的智慧审视四周；而那一头丰盈的金发——仿佛落雪轻覆——如冬晨初升的太阳般为她加冕，映衬出她修长身形上白金饰物的凛寒华美。她身侧，一条耀眼蓝宝石色的巨龙傲然而立，庄严如王座前的守卫。

~ 由一位英雄扮演

The woman embodies the cold elegance of winter in every aspect of her being. Features as beautiful and delicate as a frost-rimed flower are accentuated by dark, intricate tattoos on her porcelain skin. Eyes the scintillating blue of a frozen river take in her surroundings with a keen intelligence, and bountiful golden hair—dusted with snow—crowns her like the rising sun on a winter’s morn, accentuating the frigid beauty of the white-gold accessories adorning her slender frame. At her side, a proud and noble dragon of brilliant sapphire stands with regal solemnity.

~ Played by a Hero

新生的地精不断扭动身子，细长带爪的四肢胡乱挥舞，朝周遭任何没钉死的东西拍打过去。那对巨大的蝙蝠般耳朵微微抽动，专注地捕捉着四面八方的动静。
The newborn goblin squirms, flailing their lanky, clawed limbs in all directions, swatting at anything nearby not bolted down. Their large, batlike ears twitch as they listen intently to everything around them.

光滑的聚碳酸酯塑成一根坚硬的警棍，顶端覆着竖立的电极，低沉嘶吼，像被拴住的恶犬。沉重的橡胶握把将使用者牢牢“接地”，在挥击时吸收那股刺痛的电能回冲。然而，目标就没这么走运了。
Sleek polycarbonate forms a rigid baton capped with bristling electrodes which growl like tethered dogs. A weighty rubber handle grounds the user, absorbing the painful output of electrical energy when they strike. The target, however, is not so fortunate.

Chain Lightning, Sizzling And Leaping.name:
连锁闪电：噼啪作响，四处跳跃
Chain Lightning, Sizzling And Leaping

Text.text:
能量噼啪作响，一道闪电自你掌心迸射而出，疾冲向目标。但何必止步于此？闪电一触即分裂，三道新生电流从碰撞点反弹开去，弹射向附近的其他敌人。
Sizzling with energy, a bolt of lightning leaps from your hand, racing towards the target. But why stop at just the one? Upon contact, it splits, and three new currents of electricity ricochet off to other nearby enemies.

A Mage’s Goodbye.name:
法师的告别
A Mage’s Goodbye

Text.text:
“好了，我得走了。这个世界还有太多要学……陌生野兽的习性，奥术交互的隐秘细节。但我想，最让我牵挂的，还是你们。请在我不在的时候务必平安。”
“Well, I must be off. There is still so much to learn about this world… the habits of unknown beasts, the intimacies of arcane interactions. But I think worrying about all of you will occupy my mind the most. Please be safe in my absence.”

Alekto Orsium.name:
阿莱克托·奥尔修姆
Alekto Orsium

Text.text:
披风身影在屋顶间疾奔，双手凝现出闪烁的灵能能量利刃；脚下的陶瓦如抹了油的烂泥般滑动。 他灵巧跃过下方的巷道，转身将脉动的碎刃掷向追兵，双眼燃起旋涡般的洋红能量。 他无声落地，带着一抹讥诮的笑，直面那些负伤的猎手。 他的披风——一袭石板灰的裹尸布——如烟翻卷，露出磨旧的海军蓝皮甲与一条挂满小袋的腰带，多得足以让炼金术士都脸红。 他朝对手狡黠地眨了眨眼，随即任由自己从屋顶向后倒坠，落入下方早已等候的马车之中。

~ 由 Logan Wozniak 通过 Played 扮演，并使用

Blades of shimmering psionic energy manifest in the hands of the cloaked figure as he runs across the rooftops, clay tiles sliding underfoot like slick mud. Leaping deftly over an alleyway below, he turns, flinging the pulsing shards at his pursuers, his eyes alight with swirling magenta energy. He lands without a sound and smiles wryly, facing his wounded hunters. His cloak—a slate-gray shroud—billows around him like smoke, revealing a set of worn, navy-blue leathers and a belt with enough pouches to make an alchemist blush. He tips his adversaries a sly wink before allowing himself to fall backwards from the rooftop into the waiting cart below.

~ Played by Logan Wozniak with

Magic-nullifying Gas, Spell Stripper: In.name:
抑魔毒气，法术剥离者：启用中
Magic-nullifying Gas, Spell Stripper: In Use

Text.text: 一声清脆的咔嗒之后，猩红薄雾稳定地嘶嘶弥散开来，空气里随之漫起臭氧与铁锈般的气味。毒气所及之处，仍在运作的法术纤丝纷纷松脱、崩解，如同被蛀虫啃噬的丝绸般破碎坠落。 A telltale snick is followed by the steady hiss of a scarlet haze filling the air along with a scent like ozone and iron. Wherever the gas spreads, the delicate threads of active spells unravel and fall apart like moth-eaten silk.

[隐匿] 这枚一英寸的立方体由无缝金属一体铸成，材质成分无法辨识；外形如同一颗朴素的骰子，六个完全方正的面在接触时隐约带着温热。更离奇的是，它似乎几乎不受任何伤害影响，甚至连呼出的潮气也奈何不了它。

[激活] 口令一出，金属立方体立刻在毫无征兆、毫无声势中膨胀，相乘般地猛然增大体型。立方体向上延展时，表面开始浮现出结构与细节。短短数秒，它竟不可思议地化作一座精金高塔，塔身开有箭孔，顶端筑起垛墙。

[Concealed] Made entirely of seamless metal, unidentifiable in composition, this one inch cube is the same shape as a simple gaming die, its six perfectly square sides vaguely warm to the touch. Curiously, the cube appears to be virtually immune to harm, or even the moisture from one’s breath.

[Activated] The command word uttered, the metallic cube immediately grows with neither fanfare nor warning, multiplying in size dramatically. As the cube extends upward, features begin to appear on its surface. Within seconds, the cube has impossibly transformed into an adamantine tower, complete with arrow slits and a battlement.

Deity Of Creativity And Renewal.name:
创意与新生的神祇
Deity Of Creativity And Renewal

Text.text:
那身影沐浴在璀璨的金色光辉中，仿佛由晨曦亲手雕琢。年轻的面庞俊美而沉静，健美的体格穿着剪裁合体的丝绸长衣，金银镶边在光中流转，既威严逼人，又令人心生亲近。金发如瀑倾落，卷曲地堆在肩头。那双异色的眼睛——一金一银——闪烁着喜悦与好奇，仿佛正向今日可能带来的一切绽放光芒。
The figure stands cast in radiant, golden light. Their youthful face is beautiful and contemplative, and their athletic build strikes an imposing yet welcoming figure in tailored silks trimmed with gold and silver. Golden hair cascades down and collects in curls upon their shoulders. Their eyes, one gold and one silver, twinkle with joy and curiosity, beaming at the possibilities the day might bring.

Animal Companion's Last Sacrifice.name:
动物伙伴的最后牺牲
Animal Companion's Last Sacrifice

Text.text:
透过朦胧的视线，你看见敌人的身影，双臂高举，正要落下致命一击。你周遭的世界渐渐沉入黑暗，感官也随之消退。你听见一声压抑的发力低吼，随即看见你的动物伙伴纵身跃起，扑到你身前护卫——恰在夺命一击落下的瞬间。它的身躯猛然一颤，硬生生承受住那道打击，随即瘫倒在你身旁的地面上；它的眼里盛满爱意，与您的目光相接，旋即一点点黯淡、消散。你努力想弄清刚刚发生的一切，视野却如潮水般晃动；悲恸如刀锋贯穿心口，而你终于在无意识的虚无中沉沉坠落。

~ Envisioned by altenere

Through blurred vision, you see the form of your enemy, arms raised as they prepare to strike the fatal blow. The world around you grows dark as your senses fade. You hear a muted cry of exertion, and you see your animal companion leap bodily to your defense—just as the killing blow is dealt. Their body shudders as they absorb the strike and collapse to the ground beside you, their eyes filled with love as they meet your gaze, before fading away. Your vision swims as you try to process what just happened, and grief lances through your heart like a knife as you finally succumb to unconscious oblivion.

~ Envisioned by altenere

Dungeon Hall With Unlit Braziers.name:
摆着未点燃火盆的地城长厅
Dungeon Hall With Unlit Braziers

Text.text:
一排火盆沿着地牢长廊延伸，朴素的盆架里还窝着陈旧的余烬。它们的失主想必曾频繁使用这些火盆；如今失了引路的光，通道被浓稠的黑暗所吞没。
A series of braziers runs the length of the dungeon hall, housing old embers in their simple frames. They must have seen good use by their missing owners, as the passage is cast in thick darkness without their guiding light.

这名半巨人身形高大、肌肉虬结。苍白光秃的皮肤上刻着血红的疤纹，更添几分异样。他身披的毛皮与皮革几乎将护甲的甲片遮住。背后挂着一把夸张巨大的弩，他倚着一柄沉重巨剑，剑尖指向泥土。冰蓝色的眼睛空空望着虚无，嘴微微张开，仿佛在倾听某种只有他能听见的声音。

~ 由一位英雄Played，并附上

This half-giant is tall and powerfully built. His pale, bald skin marked with blood-red, scarified patterns gives him further distinction. The furs and leathers he wears almost hide the plates of his armor. An oversized crossbow hangs from his back, and he leans on a massive sword, pointed earthward. His ice-blue eyes gaze at nothing, his mouth agape, as if he’s listening to something no one else hears.

~ Played by a Hero with

Sundries From A Wraith.name:
来自缚灵的杂物
Sundries From A Wraith

Text.text:
在附近一座雕琢精致的石质藏骨堂里，你找到了那名幽灵般对手的森白腐霉的遗骨。嵌在一块小小的金属铭牌上的刻字，写着他们受诅咒的名字。
In a nearby ossuary of finely wrought stone, you find the bleached, moldy bones of your spectral adversary. An inscription on a small metal plaque bears their cursed name.

九座门希尔石柱——灰色岩石所凿，约莫人高——潜伏在这片空地四周的林线之中，仿佛每一座都正要迈步而出，却又在最后一瞬踌躇停住。空地中央，一棵扭曲的苹果树——反常地硕果累累——伸展出葱郁枝叶，覆在一块平坦、覆满青苔的巨石上，那石面大得足以让两三个人躺卧其上。
Nine menhirs, pillars of gray stone and average human height, lurk in the tree line around this clearing, as if each was about to step forward but hesitated. At the clearing’s center, a twisted apple tree—unseasonably fruitful—spreads leafy branches over a flat moss-coated stone large enough for two or three people to lie upon.

I Cast Druidcraft To Elevate My Mood.name:
我施展了德鲁伊伎俩，提振心情
I Cast Druidcraft To Elevate My Mood

Text.text:
太阳为谁而照？当然是为植物！那么，若能在夜里的任何时刻，从紧闭的花苞中诱出一朵盛放之花，岂不是天大的恩惠。若我必须待在室内，我也能把丁香与玫瑰的芬芳，赋予书桌那裸露的木面。于是我再问：太阳为谁而照？今日，它为我而照。
For whom does the sun shine? For the plants, of course! What a boon, then, to coax forth a blooming flower from a closed bud at any time of night. If I must be indoors, I can impart the scent of the lilacs and roses to the bare wood of a writing desk. So I ask, for whom does the sun shine? Today, it shines for me.

Jean-pierre's Exotica.name:
让-皮埃尔的异域珍奇
Jean-pierre's Exotica

Text.text:
一层熏香与烟草的薄雾悬在天花板下方。墙边挤满了古玩柜与目录柜台，地板中央则是一座迷宫：成堆的地毯、摆着空铁丝笼的基座，以及来自世界各地的家具。偶尔，一张地毯会穿过烟雾腾空而起；或是一只笼子自己打开门，放进一只叼着小购物袋的鹦鹉，它（它们）随即把门从里面锁上。店里的一切都散发着魔法的气息，以及随时被唤醒、动起来的可能。
A haze of incense and tobacco hovers just below the ceiling. The walls are packed with curio cabinets and catalog desks, and the center of the floor is a maze of rug piles, pedestals with empty wire cages on them, and furniture from around the world. Occasionally, a rug takes flight through the smoke, or a cage opens its own door to let in a parrot carrying a small shopping bag, who locks the door behind them. Everything in the shop radiates magic and the potential to animate.

倒在地上的车夫湿漉漉地咳着，一股股鲜血从他腹部那道可怕的伤口里涌出。他发着热、语无伦次，试图用一块折叠的布按压住伤口，嘴唇却不断吐出含混的咆哮，念叨着亡灵与一座岛上的地牢。若没有高超的医疗技艺或魔法治疗，这个人必定会在几分钟内断气。

~ 由 Hayatemasaru 构想

The wagoner lying on the ground coughs wetly, a gout of blood welling forth from the grievous wound to his abdomen. Babbling feverishly as he tries to apply pressure to the wound with a folded piece of cloth, his lips chunder forth with rantings about undead and an island dungeon. Without advanced medical expertise or magical healing, this man will surely be dead within minutes.

~ Envisioned by Hayatemasaru

你被那头巨型生物掠过时迸发的冲击力猛地掀向一旁：一条无眼的巨虫，厚实的紫色皮甲覆体；它那骇人的巨口大得离谱，唾液又酸蚀得惊人，连坚实的岩层都能被它轻而易举地溶穿、钻行如常。这样的生物几乎不费吹灰之力，就能在眨眼间把你们整支队伍一口吞下……它注意到你们了吗？
You are thrown to one side by the force of a gargantuan creature's passage: an eyeless worm with a thick purple hide, its tremendous maw so large and its saliva so corrosive that it passes through solid rock as a matter of course. Such a creature could, almost without effort, swallow your entire party in the blink of an eye… has it taken notice of you?

当你逼近那名握着长柄刀的护甲身影时，对方转身迎向你。尽管厚重护甲之上戴着密闭头盔，你仍能感觉到那道目光从头到脚掠过你的面孔；随即，他们近乎优雅地反转武器，轻轻一挥，便将脚边一人的腹部豁然剖开。仿佛你们无足轻重，他们以脚跟一旋，转身朝林缘步去。

~ 由 Hayatemasaru 构想

As you approach the armored figure holding the glaive, they turn to face you. Though they wear a closed helm atop their heavy armor, you feel their gaze taking in your faces as they reverse their weapon almost daintily, slashing open the belly of an individual just by their feet. As if you are of no consequence, they turn on their heel and walk toward the treeline.

~ Envisioned by Hayatemasaru

Magical Detection Of A Sorcerer's Class.name:
术士职业的魔法侦测
Magical Detection Of A Sorcerer's Class

Text.text:
你的努力唤出一缕疾行的薄雾，唯有你能看见。它逼近你的目标时，你感到记忆猛然涌上心头——你过往的片段如镜中倒影般闪回。紧接着，薄雾化作时代，化作它自身的记忆，踉跄着倒退回你身边——分毫不差地逆转流返，最终止于你掌心。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Your effort produces a swift-moving mist only you can see. As it draws near your target you feel a rush of memories, flashes from your own past as if reflected in a mirror. Then the mist becomes time, a memory of itself, reeling back to you—reversing precisely and ending in your hands.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Phoenix Paladin's Speech.name:
凤凰圣骑士的演说
Phoenix Paladin's Speech

Text.text:
“不要畏惧敌人！诸位，在狂怒的战场熔火口中倒下，乃是至高的荣耀。正如圣凤凰，我们的血肉将为重生之焰添薪——以鲜血淬灭我们诞生时那白炽的钢铁——而后我们将如黎明般再度升起！”

~ Max_Slacker 于 Discord

“Do not fear the enemy! To fall in the raging caldera of battle is the highest honor, my friends. Like the Holy Phoenix, our bodies shall stoke the fires of rebirth—our blood quenching the white-hot steel of our creation—and we shall rise again like the dawn!”

~ Max_Slacker on Discord

Taunt From A Werewolf.name:
来自狼人之嘲弄
Taunt From A Werewolf

Text.text:
“你们杀不了我，小家伙们。要是我真能死在暴力之下，我早在很久以前就亲手了结自己了。不过你们尽管来试。我一直很好奇，你们这种东西尝起来是什么味道。”
“You can’t kill me, little ones. If I could die by violent means, I would’ve done it myself long ago. But you are welcome to try. I’ve always wondered what your kind tastes like.”

Graceful Satyr.name:
优雅的萨堤洛
Graceful Satyr

Text.text:
你面前站着一名生物，满头蜜棕色的卷发蓬松如瀑，几乎将那对自他头颅盘旋而出的巨大犄角遮住——它们像公羊的角般蜿蜒扭转。他的卷发垂落至裸露的胸膛，躯干以优雅的姿态立在两条山羊般的腿上，尽头是坚硬的蹄子。
Before you stands a creature with a mop of honey brown ringlets that almost hide the great horns twisting out from his head like a ram’s would.  His ringlets extend to his bare chest, and his torso sits poised gracefully on two goat legs that end in hooves.

I Fold Up A Portable Hole.name:
我把一个便携洞折叠起来
I Fold Up A Portable Hole

Text.text:
尽管深坑里坠落了那么多重量，掀起那张造出深坑的布单时，却轻得仿佛举起一方细腻的丝绢。我将最后一道褶痕叠好后，这张几乎像二维般扁薄的布单便承载起囚徒们的全部重负，而我只剩下一个挥之不去的好奇：他们究竟还能不能逃出去。
Despite all the weight that fell in the pit, lifting the sheet that created it feels like lifting a fine silk handkerchief. When I have finished with the last fold, this sheet that seems nearly two-dimensional holds all the burden of my prisoners, and I am left carrying the curiosity of whether or not they will ever escape.

洞窟正中央伫立着一名矮壮的护甲身影，雪白如玉的面孔上覆着阴沉的冷意。它身披黑曜石般的护甲——仿佛直接由阴影锻铸而成——手中擎着一柄骇人的战镐，周身散发着恶毒的杀意。双眼燃着仇恨的火焰，渴望屠戮的欲念仿佛从它的毛孔里渗出。
In the center of the cavern stands a squat armored figure, a grim look upon their alabaster face. Clad in obsidian armor—seemingly forged from the very shadows—and hefting a formidable war-pick, they exude an aura of malevolent intent. Eyes blaze with hate and the need to murder bleeds from their pores.

在你看清笑声源头之前，咯咯的窃笑便已在石砌长廊间回荡不休。紧接着，在远处的黑暗里，一点摇曳的绿光如流星般朝你激射而来，疯狂的尖笑也随之愈发响亮：一颗脱离躯体、骨白森然的头骨，缠绕着非尘世的祖母绿火焰，颌骨一开一合，像是在嘲弄地复刻它曾为人时的习性。空洞的眼眶里，炽橙的余烬骤然亮起，目光般来回闪烁于你与同伴之间，仿佛在挑选它将用诡异火焰吞没的对象。

~ Requested by GoGo DM from PerilousPursuits.com

You hear the sound of chortling laughter reverberating through the stone hallways long before you see its source. Then, in the distant darkness, a flickering green light rockets toward you as the insane cackling grows in volume: a disembodied, bone-white skull, wreathed in unearthly emerald flames, its jaws opening and closing in a mocking memory of its once-human behaviors. Blazing orange embers wink into life in its empty eye sockets, flickering back and forth between you and your comrades, as if choosing whom it will engulf in its eldritch flames.

~ Requested by GoGo DM from PerilousPursuits.com

Orbital Civilian Checkpoint: Restrooms.name:
轨道平民检查站：洗手间
Orbital Civilian Checkpoint: Restrooms

Text.text: 当你踏入这片被标注为Restrooms的区域时，一排排刻着令人费解符号的门迎面而来。你看到来自想象得出的每一颗星球的物种进进出出：有的四足而行，有的双腿直立，还有的干脆由纯粹的能量构成。你急切地扫视着那些标识——迫切渴望解脱——终于在这间巨大房间的另一端，看见了一个你认得的符号…… A line of doors marked with baffling symbols greets you as you step into the area designated Restrooms. Species from every planet imaginable enter and exit the doors: some on four legs, others on two, and some of pure energy. As you scan the signs—desperate for relief—you finally see a symbol you recognize… at the other end of the huge room.

City Under Orc Siege.name:
兽人围攻下的城市
City Under Orc Siege

Text.text:
城中的街道诡异地寂静，空荡得反常。来往者寥寥无几，多数人选择躲在屋里，屏息等待风暴过去。许多建筑已成废墟——有几处仍在冒烟，延续着昨夜袭击的余烬。城墙却是另一番景象——数百名守军手持长矛与长弓登上垛口，守在城垛间，等待敌人的下一步动作。城墙之外，兽人正在集结，他们粗哑的嚎叫传进城中每一个人的耳朵里。他们翻身跃上战争坐骑，召集部众，整顿军阵，准备再度发动攻势。
The streets of the city are oddly silent, strangely deserted. Few come and go, most opting to stay inside, wait it out. Many buildings lie in ruin—a few still smolder from the previous night's assault. The walls are a different story—hundreds, armed with spears and longbows, take to the ramparts, awaiting the enemy's next move. Beyond the walls, the orcs mass, their guttural cries reaching the ears of everyone within the city. They mount their warbeasts, rally their legions, and prepare another assault.

你嘶嘶低语，手臂朝敌人伸出，仿佛要从下往上抛出什么；动作间，你感到魔法的涟漪自头颅荡起，穿过肩头，沿着骨骼一路奔涌至掌心。苦涩的滋味霎时盈满口腔，随即你将它沿着魔法的通道吐出——从掌心喷涌成一团绿色液滴的云雾，以惊人的速度破空疾射而去。
You whisper sibilant sounds and extend your arm toward your enemy as though making an underhanded lob, feeling the magic ripple from your head through your shoulder and down your bones toward your hand as you do. A bitter taste fills your mouth before you expel it down the channel of magic and out of your palm as a cloud of green droplets that speed through the air.

Peaceful Temple: Hall Of Wisdom.name:
宁静神殿：智慧之厅
Peaceful Temple: Hall Of Wisdom

Text.text:
看到如此多的抄写员在寂静中伏案工作，你不由得觉得自己也必须压低声音——若你在这座智慧与学识的殿堂里甚至被允许开口的话。墙上悬挂着想必堪称典范的作品，卷轴上展露的书法如同艺术品一般，与周围沿着卷轴边缘描绘的精致图画相映成辉。
Seeing so many scribes at work in silence makes you think that you must whisper—if you’re even allowed to speak—in this hall of wisdom and learning. What must be exemplary samples of their work hang from the walls, revealing calligraphy that is as much a work of art as the delicate images painted around the scrolls’ margins.

Speech About Spending Gold On Luxury.name:
一篇关于把金币花在奢侈享受上的演说
Speech About Spending Gold On Luxury

Text.text:
“要是赚来这么多金币却没法痛痛快快花出去，我们流的血还有什么意义？为什么每一枚铜子儿都得砸在武器和给养上？不如买间小屋，养几只稀奇的宠物，找人画幅肖像，再开一瓶陈了百年的老酒，喝到一头栽倒。我们为这些金币赌上性命，难道不该让它多少还我们一点活着的滋味吗？”
“What’s the point of bleeding over all this gold if we can’t enjoy spending it? Why must we dedicate every copper to weapons and provisions? Let’s buy a little cottage and some exotic pets, commission a portrait, and drink hundred-year-old wine until we collapse. We risk our lives for this gold. How about it pay us back a little bit of life?”

Hacker Executes Armor Program In The Net.name:
黑客在网络中执行护甲程序：中世纪主题
Hacker Executes Armor Program In The Net:  Medieval Theme

Text.text:
当黑客执行护甲程序时，一套闪烁着绯红微光的板甲如同被点燃般在他们周身骤然成形。仿佛无数奇幻游戏中的主角一般，他们披着这身崭新的中世纪华服，大步踏入赛博空间。
A suit of shimmering crimson plate mail flickers into life around the hacker as they execute the armor program. Like the protagonist of innumerable fantasy games, they stride forth into cyberspace, bedecked in their new medieval regalia.

Quip By A Fleeing Villain.name:
逃亡反派的嘲讽
Quip By A Fleeing Villain

Text.text:
“你打得很好……出乎意料地好。我本来为你专门筹备了一座特别的地狱，可惜，只能先等等了。”
“You have fought well… surprisingly so. I had a special hell planned just for you, but unfortunately, it will have to wait.”

Massive Unmanned Tractor Trailer.name:
大型无人驾驶牵引挂车
Massive Unmanned Tractor Trailer

Text.text: 这辆半挂驾驶室真是庞然巨物，宽度足足是普通轿车的两倍。它肯定属于那种持有特别通行许可、能同时占用两条车道的家伙。车身是脏兮兮的暗绿，溅满污秽的涂抹痕迹；车主还留下了粗陋的个人审美：驾驶室车窗里挂着一块按喇叭支持掠夺者！的牌子，仪表台上则立着一个老派流行明星的摇头公仔。驾驶室前端加装着一面铁质格栅，让人想起远古时代的汽油卡车。 This semi cab is truly colossal, twice as wide as the average car. It must be one of those vehicles with a special permit to use two lanes at once. Dirty green and spattered with smears of pollution, it bears crude stylistic choices from the owner: a Honk for the Raiders! sign in the cab window and a bobblehead of an old-school pop star on the dash. Mounted at the front end of the cab is an iron grill, reminiscent of ancient gasoline trucks.

An Invitation To The Faerie Plane.name:
仙灵位面的邀请函
An Invitation To The Faerie Plane

Text.text:
“你那边！对，就是你！我从你眼里看得出来。你渴望的，比这灰暗乏味的世界能给你的要多一点。让我带你去一个大地永远在变幻的地方，每一条根须、每一株树木都随混沌震颤。那里，狂喜、美丽与危险融为一体。我不能保证你能活着回来，但我能保证——你绝不会觉得无聊。”
“You there! Yes, you! I can see it in your eyes. You desire a little more than this drab world can offer. Let me take you where the land is always changing, where every root and tree thrums with chaos. A place where ecstasy, beauty, and danger live as one. I can’t guarantee you’ll survive, but I can guarantee you’ll never be bored.”

一个巨人般的男人立在厚重的屠宰砧板前，双臂与围裙都被血染成粉红。他的手大如火腿肘子，却握着一柄薄如纸片的刀，小心翼翼地从一块鱼肉里挑出细小的鱼刺。
A titan of a man stands at a thick butcher’s block, arms and apron pink from blood. With hands like ham hocks, he wields a knife as thin as a sheet of paper to gingerly pick the tiny bones from a hunk of fish.

I Set My Mirror Of Life Trapping.name:
我设下了我的生命囚镜
I Set My Mirror Of Life Trapping

Text.text:
我听见沉重的脚步声逼近，这让我知道时候到了。我从橱柜里取出那面镜子，找了个对手最可能经过的位置。镜子只有四英尺高，但在这里斜靠在墙上就足够了。当我低声念出命令词时，它银色的镜面荡起涟漪，我被一幅景象吓得心惊：冰冷的雾气，以及那片用于放逐的异次元空间——空旷、阴沉、令人绝望。然后我把那些正逼近的敌人交给他们的命运。
I hear heavy steps approaching, which tells me it’s time. I take the mirror from its cupboard and find a place likely for my opponents to pass. The mirror is only four feet tall, but leaning it on the wall here will suffice. When I whisper the command word, its silver surface ripples, and I am terrified by an image of cold fog and the open, dismal space of extradimensional exile. Then I leave my approaching foes to their fate.

Euphoric Street Drug, Novacoke: Inhaled.name:
迷醉街头毒品“新可乐”：吸入式
Euphoric Street Drug, Novacoke: Inhaled

Text.text:
你的鼻翼扩张，火辣的粉末如烈焰般撕裂你的黏膜，冲破鼻腔里柔嫩的毛细血管，建立起一处滩头阵地，让一波又一波的药力顺势猛攻你的全身。自信直冲云霄，心跳踏着体内那支军队的节拍行进。你觉得自己高大得像站在阶段上的将军，口才如同披上一层光泽，把每个音节都镀上大师级演说家的力量与从容。你的笑声轰鸣如炮火，肌肉绷硬成层层叠叠的护甲甲片。突如其来的豪胆如弹幕倾泻，碾碎了所有顾忌。任何风险感都被那种挟持你大脑皮层的无敌感剖开、抹除。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

Your nostrils dilate as the burning fire of the powder rips through your mucous membrane, breaching the tender blood vessels of your nose and setting up a beachhead through which wave upon wave of the drug assaults your system. Your confidence soars, and your heartbeat marches to the rhythm of the army inside you. You feel as tall as a general on a stage, as eloquence coats your every syllable with the power and poise of a master orator. Your laugh booms like cannon fire as your muscles harden to plates of overlapping armor. Inhibitions shatter beneath the barrage of your sudden bravado. Any sense of risk is eviscerated beneath the feeling of invincibility that commandeers your cortex.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Cast Silent Image To Recall A Happy Me.name:
我施放「无声幻影」，唤回一段幸福的回忆
I Cast Silent Image To Recall A Happy Memory

Text.text:
尽管我能在脑海里重构那段记忆，一道简单的法术却能将那份怀旧无限放大。我施放幻象，绕着它踱步，也许干脆从中径直穿过……而只要一个手势、一句奥秘的咒言、一件施法焦点物体——或是一小撮羊毛——就能把我沿着梦的路带回这段幸福时刻，这件事本身就令我心生欢喜。
Though I can construct the memory in my mind, the use of a simple spell amplifies the nostalgia. I cast the illusion, walk around it, perhaps step right through it… and take delight in knowing it takes only a gesture, an arcane word, and a magical focus object—or a bit of fleece—to dream my way back to this happy moment.

Subterranean Trading Post.name:
地下贸易站
Subterranean Trading Post

Text.text:
幽幽鬼光从一朵朵蘑菇的菌盖下闪烁而出；它们生长在色彩斑斓、雕饰繁复的陶盆里。这些真菌既是路标，也是棚檐，替在这座洞窟中、咯咯作响的小溪上方摆摊的商贩遮蔽招徕。琳琅货品引来同样五花八门的客人。你正惊叹这番景象时，其中一点光忽地一晃，随即熄灭——那蘑菇被人碰撞，像雨伞般“啪”地合拢了菌盖。
Ghostly light glimmers from the hoods of mushrooms growing in colorful and elaborately molded clay pots. These fungi serve as signposts and awnings for merchants who’ve set up shop in this cavern above a chuckling stream. Wares of all sorts draw an equally varied clientele. As you wonder at the scene, one of the lights wobbles and blinks out—a consequence of the mushroom being jostled and snapping shut like an umbrella.

这剂药水以橄榄叶与石榴研磨而成，使饮下者对所有被其视作较弱者的人都变得慷慨而宽恕。其效力持续至最近的黄昏或黎明为止，而这份慷慨必须以行动来体现，而非仅以钱财或赋礼敷衍了事。
This potion, ground from olive leaf and pomegranate, makes the drinker generous and forgiving to everyone he or she perceives as being less powerful.
