The effects last until either twilight or dawn, whichever is closest, and the generosity must be expressed through action, not simply through coin or gift.

Tropical Jungle: Down By The River With.name:
热带丛林：河畔乐声缭绕
Tropical Jungle: Down By The River With Music

Text.text:
湍急的河水穿过丛林，诱人地抛出一个机会，开辟出一条新的道路。若你能顺流而下，也许乘着激流漂行，而非在纠结的岸边艰难跋涉，便能在短短几分钟内做到原本需要数小时才能完成的事。当然，这份寄望城也伴随着天生的危险——没人知道下一个拐弯处潜伏着什么。
The river rushing through the jungle offers an enticing opportunity, opening a new path. If you can follow its flow, perhaps floating atop its rapids rather than struggling along its tangled banks, you might achieve in minutes what otherwise could take hours. Of course, the promise brings with it an inherent danger. There’s no way of knowing what lies around the next bend.

一团由恐惧与憎恨纠结而成的雾团在空气中翻涌起泡，勉强凝出朦胧的形状。你看不见它，却几乎能感知到它，仿佛活在视野边缘的余光里。若目光无法捕捉，也许你的直觉能引你寻到它；若仍无从把握，这头以情绪为食的猎手便要扑涌而上，直噬你的灵魂。
A cluster of fear and hatred takes vague form, bubbling in the air. It is not seen but almost sensed, living in the peripheries of your eyes. If it cannot be seen, perhaps instead your intuition can guide you to it. If not, this predator of emotions threatens to swarm your very soul.

Belt Of Cloud Giant Strength.name:
云巨人力量腰带
Belt Of Cloud Giant Strength

Text.text:
厚实的皮腰带上镶嵌着坚硬、深色的钢条，勾勒成流动气流的纹路。皮革因年代与行动而显得风化起皱，却依旧泛着精心保养的皮面光泽。两侧一排铁铆钉覆着一层霜壳，延伸至一枚沉重的带扣——其上浮雕着翻涌的风暴云。
The thick leather belt is ringed with hard, dark steel inlays shaped in the form of flowing air currents. The leather appears weathered and creased by age and activity, but still holds the sheen of a well-maintained hide. Iron studs, crusted with a layer of frost, line the sides leading to a hefty buckle depicting a storm cloud.

Backworld Gutterpunk With Plasma Shiv.name:
带等离子短刃的后世界阴沟朋克
Backworld Gutterpunk With Plasma Shiv

Text.text:
少年的喧嚣傲气写在这名朋克讥诮的笑容与横冲直撞的姿态里。一排色彩鲜艳、参差如锯的头发占据了他们原本剃光的头顶，而那身钉刺外套上缝着足够好几只生物分量的皮革。握在他们手中——指节发白、死死攥紧的——是一把嗡鸣作响的等离子短刃。尽管朋克表面自信张扬，眼底却有一抹绝望，泄露了他们的恐惧。
The boisterous arrogance of youth is evident in the punk’s smirking face and swaggering demeanor. A vibrantly colored jagged row of hair dominates their otherwise shaved head, and their spiked attire contains several creatures’ worth of leather. In their hands—in a white-knuckle grip—is a humming plasma shiv. Despite the punk’s outward confidence there is a desperation in their eyes that betrays their fear.

I Use Reliable Talent.name:
我发动【可靠天赋】
I Use Reliable Talent

Text.text:
这种事我做得多到数不清，所以我里里外外都清楚自己在干什么。反复练习带来的是稳定性——就算称不上完美。没必要把成败押在运气上。你要说我傲慢也行——但我就是有这么强。
I’ve done this more times than I can count, so I know what I’m doing in and out. Practice makes for consistency, if not perfection. No need to rely on chance. Call it arrogant—if you like—but I’m that good at what I do.

Fake Adamantine Armor.name:
伪精金护甲
Fake Adamantine Armor

Text.text:
当敌人以灵巧一击命中你时，你自信自己的精金护甲足以将其弹开。然而，这份自信转瞬便崩塌——你的护甲也是如此；它没能挡住这一击全部的凶猛威势。
When the enemy lands a deft strike against you, you feel confident that your adamantine armor will deflect it. However, your confidence quickly crumples—and so does your armor, as it fails to check the full ferocity of the blow.

你周遭的世界闪耀着刺目的白光，晶莹剔透，被数尺厚的松脆积雪所笼罩。若不是那股穿透骨髓的寒意紧贴着你的脸颊与衣襟，这景象本该美得令人屏息。你打了个寒颤，脑海里不由浮现出仍在暗红闷烧的壁炉、咕嘟翻滚的炖汤，以及铺满毛皮的温暖床榻。可道路此刻在呼唤，催促你继续向前。积雪在靴底咯吱作响，你的呼吸在眼前化作团团白雾，你拖着步子，继续跋涉。
The world around you shines bright white, crystalline, shrouded by feet of crisp snow. It would be beautiful if not for the penetrating chill that clings to your face and garments. You shiver, thinking fondly of smoldering hearths, simmering stew, and of a warm bed piled with furs. But the road calls now, urging you forward. The snow crunches beneath your boots, your breath plumes before you, and you trudge on.

沙与火焰在术士周身盘旋翻涌，只听从其原始而与生俱来的力量。沿着晒成古铜色肌肤蜿蜒的纹身仿佛被异界之光点亮。赤红长袍猎猎作响，那名人类离地悬浮数寸，沙暴愈发狂烈，而他们摊开的双掌间，火焰跳跃着凭空燃起。
Sand and flame swirl about the sorcerer, answering solely to their raw, innate power. Tattoos lining sun-browned skin seem to glow with an otherworldly light. Red robes fluttering, the human levitates a few inches off the ground as the storm of sand grows in ferocity, and in their outstretched palms, flames flicker to life.

这副面具勾勒出一张瘦削如骷髅的面容，诡异地近似人类，却又无可置疑地带着兽性。任何望向这张脸的人都会被一阵不安攫住——尤其当那双眼眶的幽暗空洞仿佛正钻进他们的心底时。认为这张面孔属于某种恶魔生物的念头，并非毫无根据。
The mask evokes a gaunt, skeletal face, uncannily human yet unmistakably bestial. A sense of unease comes over any who look upon the visage—or who find the dark hollows of the eyes boring into them. The notion of this face belonging to some demonic creature is not unfounded.

City Port In Winter.name:
冬日城港
City Port In Winter

Text.text:
港口深陷于凛冬的掌控之中：唯一的一艘船裹在蜡黄的薄雾里，冰渣污染的迟缓浪声拍击着岸边，打破了萎靡的寂静。码头与仓库空空如也，磨损的建筑在近旁街道上拖出长长的阴影。刺骨的寒风裹挟着盐味与腐朽的气息；阴郁的氛围唤起被遗弃与忧伤的感觉，铅灰色的天空下，雪无声飘落。
The port is deep in winter’s grasp: the single ship shrouded in sallow mist and the sound of sluggish waves, polluted with ice, breaking the listless silence. Docks and warehouses stand empty, their worn architecture casting long shadows over the nearby streets. The biting wind lugs with it the scent of salt and decay, and the cheerless atmosphere evokes a sense of abandonment and melancholy as snow falls from the leaden sky.

你用力吼出一个短促的音节，同时抬指一指，被你点名的那个人骤然绷紧，僵硬得纹丝不动，仿佛你掌心紧攥的那块铁一般。
With a single, barked syllable, and a pointed finger, the person you denote suddenly tenses, as stiff and immobile as the iron piece you are clutching in your palm.

这座坟墓的墓志铭写道：勇气铸就了他自己的道路。纵然许多人将追随他的足迹，也请记住，他会告诉你要走出自己的路。毕竟，他的路最终将他带到了这里。 This grave’s epitaph reads: Courage forged his own path. Though many would follow in his footsteps, know that he would tell you to make your own way. After all, his path led him here.

I Cast Burning Hands From My Staff Of Fi.name:
我从火焰法杖中施放【燃烧之手】
I Cast Burning Hands From My Staff Of Fire

Text.text:
我吐出命令词，将法杖的焚炎之怒倾泻向敌人。杖身随魔法的蓄积而逐渐发烫，片刻之后，烈焰自杖首喷薄而出，化作宽阔的锥形火潮；噼啪作响的火星铺满空气，辛辣刺鼻的焦烟味翻涌而来。
I speak the command word to unleash the incendiary fury of my staff upon my enemies. The haft grows warm as the magic builds and a few moments later flames leap from the staff’s head in a wide cone, filling the air with crackling cinders and the smell of acrid smoke.

Battle Between Shadowy Forces In Dark Di.name:
黑暗维度中影影绰绰的势力交锋
Battle Between Shadowy Forces In Dark Dimension

Text.text:
黑暗的存在在阴影笼罩的位面中碰撞交锋，厚重而令人窒息的浓雾在他们周身翻卷，将刀刃相击的铿锵声闷住。鲜血——有的滚烫新鲜，有的陈旧如昔——染红了空气；战士在两边接连倒下，尽成暮光山谷里这场野蛮混战的牺牲品。

~ Envisioned by Andrew Sanguine on Discord

Beings of darkness clash in the shadowed plane, the ringing of their blades muffled by the thick, oppressive fog swirling around them. Blood—some fresh, some ancient—paints the air as warriors fall on both sides, victims of the savage melee churning in the twilight valley.

~ Envisioned by Andrew Sanguine on Discord

Mountainside Tower Of Pipperindil.name:
皮佩林迪尔的山腰高塔
Mountainside Tower Of Pipperindil

Text.text:
巍然耸立的高塔本身就是一项令人难以置信的专长级魔法造物，仿佛从群山永恒的岩体中一气呵成地雕琢而出。塔身看不出任何砌筑或加工的痕迹，然而那光滑的表面却镶嵌着数百个几乎难以察觉的符号——用于守护的结界。推开沉重的橡木门，你踏入一位学者混乱而随意的起居空间：每一处平面都堆满涂写凌乱的纸张，厚重的典籍摊开着，页边密密麻麻写满批注。数十只杯子——其中的饮品早已冰冷——散落在书桌、桌子与椅子上；几块墨绿近黑的黑板上，复杂的图示纵横铺展，符文与古老的深渊印记交缠其间。蜡烛忽明忽暗，黑色蜡泪滴落，堆成一座座小丘。地面上刻着螺旋的圆环——不同的符号与结界——每一道都被木炭擦抹得模糊不清。刺鼻的硫磺气味很淡，却无可错认。

~ Envisioned by weaselarmor

The looming tower itself is a feat of incredible magic, carved seamlessly from the eternal stone of the mountain. It displays no signs of masonry or manufacture, though its smooth surface is inlaid with hundreds of barely perceptible symbols—wards of protection. Stepping through the heavy oaken door, you find yourself in the chaotic, haphazard living space of a scholar, every surface piled with scribbled-upon papers, and tomes lying open with notes in their margins. Dozens of mugs, their contents long gone cold, litter desks and tables and chairs, while upon several green-black chalkboards, extensive diagrams sprawl with runic symbols and ancient, abyssal sigils. Candles flicker, dripping black wax into mounding piles. Spiraling circles etch the floors—different symbols and wards—each smudged with charcoal. The pungent smell of sulfur is subtle but unmistakable.

~ Envisioned by weaselarmor

六十个迷失的灵魂——饥饿、挨打，为了活下去彼此撕咬——这些该死的可怜虫，如今都被丢进臭名昭著的石颚监狱。温吞的细流从看不见的蓄水处悠悠渗出，像是在用触手可及却永远得不到的自由嘲弄囚徒。囚犯们踩在血与秽物之上争吵扭打，在黑暗里互掷辱骂，用页岩碎片磨出粗陋的匕首。笑声很快被疑惧取代，镣铐磨到皮开肉绽，拷问者撕裂血肉，鲜血渗进石缝。少有人能活到洗清罪名，更少有人能回到家仍不被摧折。
Threescore lost souls—starved and beaten, fighting to survive—these are the damnable wretches who find themselves in the infamous Stonemaw Prison. Tepid streams trickle leisurely from unseen reservoirs, seeming to mock the inmates with unattainable freedom. Prisoners squabble atop blood and filth, exchanging insults in the dark and grinding shivs out of shale fragments. Laughter gives way to paranoia, manacles rub until the skin is raw, torturers rend flesh, and blood seeps into stone. Few inmates survive long enough to acquit their crimes, and even fewer return home unbroken.

这头熊的皮毛油亮得发光，黑得深沉，阳光一照几乎泛出幽蓝。它为寻找食物而不断踱行，步伐沉重却不迟缓；尽管身形魁梧，熊躯移动起来却带着令人意外的速度。
The glossy coat of the bear is so black that it looks almost blue in sunlight. Lumbering about in its constant search for food, the ursine form moves with surprising speed, given its bulky frame.

一截扭曲盘结的树干托起一株泰坦般的巨植。古老的茎干在顶端汇成一张巨大的掠食之口，森然大张，滴淌着黏糊糊的植物浆质。它高逾四十英尺，翻搅扭动，饥渴得像野兽般异乎寻常。根部周围隆起的发光瘤状增生有节律地搏动，仍残留着幽邃的灵能余波。
A twisted and knotted trunk supports a titanic plant. The ancient stem culminates in a huge predatory maw that yawns wide, leaking goopy plant matter. Over forty feet tall, it writhes with an unusually animal hunger. Bulbous, luminous growths about the roots pulsate with residual psychic power.

巫妖四爪着地，头颅前探，警觉搜寻，双翼向后收拢。但那颗头几乎只剩一副暗灰色的骨颅，腐烂的、柔软的青绿色鳞片成片垂挂在吻端与额头。双眼只是眼窝深处的一点微光——某种有知觉的存在，若还能更糟，甚至比活龙的凝视更令人胆寒。皮与鳞松松垮垮地披在骷髅（特征）上，双翼也只剩当年厚皮革般筋膜的碎裂残痕。其余皆是枯骨，被一缕困住的灵魂驱动。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

The lich stands on all four claws, head thrust forward and searching, wings back. But the head is mostly a skull of dull gray bone with patches of rotten, soft green scales hanging on its snout and forehead. The eyes are only a dim glow from deep in their sockets—something sentient and, if possible, worse than a living dragon’s own gaze. Skin and scale drape from the skeleton and the wings are shredded remnants of the heavy leather they once were. The rest is bone animated by a trapped soul.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Spell Scroll Case (Primal).name:
法术卷轴匣（原初）
Spell Scroll Case (Primal)

Text.text:
这根雕刻的骨质管上，沿着管身缠绕着皮革系带——其间缀满羽饰护符——而发黄变色的表面则被刮刻出参差尖锐的符文。粗糙的皮革背带上点缀着艳丽的珠串，骨管两端各以一枚雕木塞封口，木塞上刻着兽首的形貌。
This carved bone tube has thongs of leather—replete with feathered charms—wrapped around its length and jagged runes scratched into the discolored surface. Colorful beads decorate a rough leather strap, and each end of the tube is capped with a carved wooden stopper depicting the head of a beast.

Gaping Hole In City Wall.name:
城墙上的巨大破口
Gaping Hole In City Wall

Text.text:
一阵突如其来的疾风猛地拍打在你身上，牵引着你的目光投向城墙上一处巨大的破洞——那里正由镇上的守卫严加看守。究竟是什么在城防上撕开了如此骇人的豁口？一记强大的法术？一头横冲直撞的巨人发狂的暴怒？还是敌对攻城器械的一次攻击？工人们在张口般的破洞底部来回穿梭，搭建起修补裂口所需的脚手架，用以支援修复工程。
A gust of wind unexpectedly buffets you and draws your gaze to a massive hole in the city’s wall, under guard by the town’s watch. What could have left such a great gouge in the city’s defenses? A powerful spell? The mad tantrum of a rampaging giant? An attack from a hostile siege engine? Workers move around the base of the gaping hole, constructing the scaffolding necessary to support the breach’s repair.

Arcane Weapon Firebolt.name:
奥术武器：火焰箭
Arcane Weapon Firebolt

Text.text:
随着一句咒令，工匠术士手中举平的魔杖骤然迸燃。杖尖浮现一粒旋舞的火焰微光。炽烈的光照亮幽暗的林木，将沿着杖身刻出的串串奥术符号映衬得分外清晰。又一句咒令，那团灼亮的火星从魔杖上疾射而出，蓝白炽核外拖曳着橙色焰尾。

~ 构想 by Jaum

With a word, the wand leveled in the artificer’s hands flares. A mote of swirling flame appears on the tip. Fiery light illuminates the dark wood, emphasizing strings of arcane symbols carved along the wand’s length. Another word, and the blazing speck streaks away from the wand, orange flame trailing from a blue-hot core.

~ Envisioned by Jaum

I Cast Flesh To Stone Using Components.name:
我用材料施展【血肉化石】
I Cast Flesh To Stone Using Components

Text.text:
我将目光牢牢钉在我的目标身上，把石灰、水与泥土在掌心揉合，专注于那触感——混合物迅速在皮肤上硬化、紧贴成壳。我低声吟诵的词句仿佛重若千钧；我能感觉到被我唤来的能量，像一件内衬铅片的斗篷沉沉压在肩头。
Fixing my gaze on my target I mix lime, water, and earth in my palm, concentrating on the sensation as the mixture rapidly hardens against my skin. My chanted words bear incredible weight as I feel the energy I have summoned, like a cloak lined with lead on my shoulders.

Dispel Good Misses.name:
解除善良未命中
Dispel Good Misses

Text.text:
这些烦人精、规矩看守、帮手——都该滚回它们来的地方去。你尖锐地并拢手指一拧，将防护法术扭转为一道命令。你瞄准其中一个兴高采烈的小花采摘者，厉声喊出驱逐的咒言。而你的对手仿佛毫无察觉，只是挑起一边眉毛，像是在打量一个在店里磨蹭游荡的闲人，而不是面对一份可怖的威胁。
These annoyances, the rule keepers, the helpers—they need to go back to where they came from. You angle your fingers sharply to shift the protection spell into a command. You aim at one of these cheerful little flower pickers and shout the words of dismissal. And your opponent, seeming not to have noticed at all, raises an eyebrow as if you were a dawdling loiterer in a shop instead of a mighty threat.

I Hex A Beverage To Overflow.name:
我对一杯饮料下咒，让它漫溢而出
I Hex A Beverage To Overflow

Text.text:
我手腕轻轻一抖，便将我的意志强加在杯中。饮料底部开始冒出细密气泡。法术在数秒之间从微弱的起泡迅速升级为翻涌的泡沫，白色泡花绽开，像一杯倒砸了的啤酒。饮品发出怪诞的咕嘟声，随即猛然喷涌成柱，把周遭的一切与所有人都淋上一层黏腻的泡沫飞沫。
With a fine flick of my wrist, I impose my will upon the cup. Bubbles begin to form near the bottom of the beverage. The spell escalates from a mild carbonation to full foam in a matter of seconds, blooming with white froth like a badly poured beer. The drink burbles grotesquely and then geysers, covering anything and anyone nearby with foamy spray.

你拔出长剑时，霜华沿着那柄闪耀的剑刃迅速蔓延，空气里也交织起凛冬般的寒意。剑柄仿佛将你的手一并冻结，麻木顺着皮肤爬上来，血色被一点点抽走；你举起剑锋，蓄势待发，准备将这刺骨的冷冽尽数放逐到敌人身上。
Frost rimes the glittering blade as you draw the sword, and the air becomes laced with winter’s chill. The sword’s hilt seems to freeze your hand, numbing the skin and draining its color as you raise the blade, ready to turn the biting chill loose on your enemies.

元素之力凝聚成一张咯咯怪笑的巨口，其间透出一抹小鬼般的狞笑。它有着带翼的身躯，双翼振拍着支撑那滑稽硕大的脑袋，而那脑袋又托起那令人抓狂的笑容。它身高三尺，浑身淌落纯粹的混沌能量，懒洋洋地划出一道弧线盘旋而过，带着肆无忌惮的狂喜，把附近的物件从台面上撞得七零八落。
Elemental forces take shape into a cackling maw, an impish grin shining through. The body is winged, and the wings flap to support the comically large head, which in turn supports that infuriating smile. Three feet tall and dripping pure chaotic energy, it wheels in a lazy arc, knocking nearby objects off surfaces with reckless glee.

这座栈桥的旧木板在脚下吱呀作响，但看上去依然稳固。一艘小划艇随河水的流动轻轻漂荡，被系在一根粗壮的桩上——那桩深深钉入河床，用以支撑栈桥。码头尽头，一根无人看守的钓竿斜靠在一根木棍上，钓线垂落，直入河心。
The weathered boards of this jetty creak underfoot, but it looks stable. A rowboat drifts in the river’s flow, tethered to one of the stout posts driven into the riverbed to support the jetty. An unattended fishing pole dangling a line into the middle of the river leans against a stick at the end of the pier.

双手以空灵的优雅舞动，术士编织着他们的法术。奥秘能量在灵巧的指尖周遭层层汇聚，他们引导着无形世界的力量，专注如磐。尽管当魔法在身旁盘旋时，他们所能感知的不过是几缕色彩的闪烁，他们依旧笃定自己的能力——信任多年磨炼的技艺，以及体内回荡的魔法共鸣。

~ 扮演：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Hands moving with ethereal grace, the sorcerer weaves their spell. Arcane energies build around dexterous fingers as they channel the power of the unseen world, their focus unwavering. Though they can perceive little more than flashes of color as the magic swirls around them, they are confident in their abilities, trusting their years of practice and the feeling of magical resonance within their being.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Sundries From A Barbed Devil.name:
倒钩魔的杂物
Sundries From A Barbed Devil

Text.text:
在这只倒钩魔与你展开致命遭遇之前，它曾佩戴着闪亮的饰物。然而当你检查尸体时，你判断它那两只凹陷的铁手镯，以及一枚缺了口的红玻璃耳坠，几乎不值一提。
Before the barbed devil’s fatal encounter with you, it had been adorned with shiny baubles. When you examine the corpse, however, you deem its two dented iron bracelets and its chipped earring of red glass to be worth little.

Dream Visit From Archfey Patron.name:
来自至高妖精宗主的梦中造访
Dream Visit From Archfey Patron

Text.text:
一幕景象如舞台剧般在你眼前铺陈，你心眼所见的黑色帷幕微光流转，缓缓分开，露出树木幽暗的剪影。枝桠在风穿梭其间时吱呀作响。你明知自己必是在做梦，却仍能感到夜风冰凉的轻吻掠过脸颊。你闻到泥土的潮腥，以及树脂与花朵的甜香。你向前迈步，身子轻得如同风本身，走入一片开阔的林间空地。满月高悬，洒下带着蓝晕的月光，将空地点亮。你忽然察觉到另一道存在——安静，却强大。你认出那是你的守护者，穿过真实与虚幻的薄幕，来到你身边。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

A scene unfolds like a stage play before you, the shimmering black curtains of your mind’s eye parting to reveal the dark silhouettes of trees. Their limbs creak as the wind weaves through them. Though you surely must be dreaming, you can feel the cool kiss of night air on your face. You smell the dankness of the earth and sweetness of sap and flowers. You step forward, your body light as the wind itself, into an open glade. The full moon hangs overhead, alighting the glade in its blue blush. You suddenly become aware of another presence, one quiet and powerful. You recognize it as your patron, come to you through the veil of real and unreal.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Fallen High Elf Kingdom.name:
堕落的高等精灵王国
Fallen High Elf Kingdom

Text.text:
苔藓与地衣攀爬在一座高耸的纯白石王座之上，沿着台阶倾泻而下，向外蔓延成一片柔软、葱郁的绿毯。树根盘旋着缠上曾支撑起巍峨穹顶的立柱，而那穹顶如今已半塌——一株巨大的橡树破壁而出，撑裂了它的边界。斑驳的光影落在被岁月与天气磨蚀的表面上，这座曾经辉煌的王座厅静默无声；你不由想象，昔日是否曾有数百人汇聚于此，只为聆听一位精灵母主的言辞。
Moss and lichen crawl over a towering throne of pristine white stone, cascading down the steps and sprawling outward to form a carpet of soft, verdant green. Roots spiral up pillars that once held aloft a soaring dome, now half-collapsed with a massive oak breaching its confines. Dappled light falls upon the weather-worn surfaces of a once great throne room, and you imagine the crowds that might have assembled here, hundreds strong, to heed the words of an elf matriarch.

Hacker Accidentally Falling Into The Dig.name:
黑客意外坠落进数字协约
Hacker Accidentally Falling Into The Digital Concordance

Text.text:
眼袋深重却还想再肝一把的甲板操手漫不经心地敲下上传口令，随即往后一靠，任意识在坚实的数字地面上安稳着陆，舒服得像回到熟悉的巢穴。可黑客忽然捕捉到一段坏代码的抽搐——像耳后细微的痒。紧接着，那只耳朵里爆出一声尖叫，代码被撕开一道口子，恶心的眩晕随之袭来：你正坠入陌生的虚拟构造之中，既无清晰的制高点，也没有可度量的物理尺度。

~ 一位英雄所构想

Baggy-eyed but ready to grind some more, the deck jockey casually hits the upload passcode, then sits back to relax into the mind’s happy landing on solid digital ground. But the hacker feels a jump of bad code, just an itch behind the ear. Then a scream in that ear, and a tear in the code, followed by the sick nausea of plummeting into alien virtual structures without clear vantage points or scalable physics.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

作为这道法术最后的华丽收势，你将那把微小的白金剑在空中精巧地一甩，随后塞回同样微小的剑鞘。霎时间，一道半透明的轮廓在你面前浮现——那是材料成分的幽影化身。它看起来几乎不真实，但你清楚这件武器究竟有多致命。只需一个念头，它便飘然而进，替你贯彻那份致死的意图。
For the last flourish of the spell you elaborately swish the tiny platinum sword through the air, then tuck it away in a tiny sheath. Instantly, a semi-transparent shape appears before you, a shadowy version of the material component. It hardly seems real, but you know just how deadly this weapon really is. With a thought, it drifts forward to fulfill your deadly intent.

Loot From A Stone Giant.name:
石巨人的战利品
Loot From A Stone Giant

Text.text:
在巨人如花岗岩般的耳廓深处，你注意到几枚巨大而尖利的水晶被硬生生钉穿了血肉。它们在阳光下流转着虹彩般的光泽，闪烁出棱镜般的共鸣。
In the granite lobes of the giant’s ears, you notice that large, pointed crystals have been driven through the flesh. Iridescent in the sun's light, they shimmer with prismatic resonance.

The Armor Of Kendi.name:
肯迪的护甲
The Armor Of Kendi

Text.text:
最伟大的沙漠法师与学者遵照稀树草原上最强狮群的十三头雄狮所授的法门，打造了这套护甲。它色彩明艳，以绿、红、金、黑的几何图形绗缝拼接；宽阔的腰带束紧身形，条纹裙甲上缀着鸵鸟羽毛摇曳。尖塔状头盔由藤编与钢铁构成，颈后垂落锁子链护颈，如披帛般覆盖后颈。传说此护甲从未被箭矢或刀刃贯穿；它更赐予穿戴者一声魔法般的咆哮。
The greatest of the desert mages and scholars crafted this armor, following the instructions of thirteen lions from the strongest prides of the savannah. It is brightly-colored, quilted in geometric shapes of green, red, gold, and black, with a broad belt and a striped skirt decorated in ostrich feathers. The spire helm, wicker and steel, has an apron of chain for the back of the neck. The legend is that the armor has been penetrated by neither arrow nor blade. It endows its wearer with a magical roar.

这名四臂人形披着华丽奢贵的装束。头颅光滑而修长，灰色皮肤绷紧在锥形的颅骨上。身形虽精瘦，四肢纠结的筋肉里却分明蕴着力量。他微微偏头，将一副熏黑护目镜拉下，遮住斑驳的黑色眼眸。精致的空间服上，一整套尖端科技在暗处闪烁着冷光。
The four-armed humanoid is draped in opulent finery. Their head is smooth and elongated, gray skin pulled tight to a cone-like skull. Although lean, strength clearly lies within the knotted fibers of their limbs. They cock their head and pull a set of darkened goggles over dappled black eyes. A panoply of advanced technology glints along their sophisticated space suit.

魅力非凡之人，总更容易攀上极致暴力的巅峰。地狱七座城市的精英地狱骑士所拥有的，是对“精通”本身的精通。他们自称“伊尔里格”，这些黑暗精灵的突击兵——施展繁复而强大的法术，足以驾驭恶魔、舒展军势、在时空长河间穿行，让地狱之焰一路蔓延。正如圣武士散发神圣、鼓舞人心的灵光，伊尔里格拉札赫则以邪恶的魅惑施咒，引来最不堪、最可怖的怪物。

~ 由 Merovaeus 扮演

The charismatic find it easier to ascend to ultimate violence. The mastery possessed by the elite Knights of Hell’s Seven Cities is mastery itself. They call themselves “Illriggers,” these dark elf shock troops—casting spells intricate and powerful enough to steer demons, unfurl armies, navigate the infernal across the timescape spreading infernal flame. As the paladin radiates the inspiring aura of the divine, Razzakh the Illrigger enchants with the allure of the malevolent, attracting the very worst of monsters.

~ Played by Merovaeus

Paladin's Speech Of Self-affirmation.name:
圣武士的自我肯定宣言
Paladin's Speech Of Self-affirmation

Text.text: “不要憎恨那潜伏并盘踞在我们每个人心中的黑暗。它如同癌变的赘生物，以失落与恐惧为食——而就像任何肿瘤一样，它也能被切除。你可以豁免他们……你将豁免他们。不是靠痛苦与威胁，而是靠怜悯与慈悲。伸出的手，能比紧握的拳更有力量。” “Do not hate the darkness that lurks and lingers in all our hearts. It is a cancerous growth, fed by loss and fear—and like any tumor, it can be removed. You can save them… You will save them. Not through pain and threats, but through compassion. The outstretched hand can be stronger than the clenched fist.”

I Draw A Card At Random From My Deck Of.name:
我从“万象无穷牌”中随意抽出一张牌
I Draw A Card At Random From My Deck Of Many Things

Text.text:
这副牌散发出的力量令人瞠目。牌背上雕刻的华美纹样繁复得近乎催眠，我一边小心洗牌，一边不由自主地被它吸引。牌面在接触时顺滑得令人愉悦——更证明了它们的上乘品质——还带着一丝微温，仿佛刚被人握过。我深吸一口气，强迫自己稳住心神……然后抽牌。
The power emanating from this deck of cards is staggering. The beautiful designs etched into the card backs are hypnotically intricate, and I find myself drawn in as I carefully shuffle the deck. The cards are pleasingly smooth to the touch—yet more evidence of their superior quality—and they hold a slight warmth, as if recently held. Taking a deep breath, I steel myself… and draw.

Wand Arcane Focus.name:
魔杖（奥术法器）
Wand Arcane Focus

Text.text:
这根细长的魔杖由柳树富有弹性的枝条削成，显然历经使用。杖身上有一处磨损痕迹，正好位于施法时做出挥转动作、拇指与食指和中指交叉的位置。杖尖附近隐隐带着些许烟灰般的气味——火焰与雷电法术一次又一次从那里迸溅嘶鸣而出。
Carved from the springy branch of a willow tree, this thin wand has seen use. A worn spot is visible where the thumb crosses with the second and third fingers when making a flourish during spellcasting. The wood has a slight sooty odor near the tip, where spells of fire and lightning have sizzled forth time and again.

Royal Tomb Of A King And Queen.name:
国王与王后的皇家陵寝
Royal Tomb Of A King And Queen

Text.text:
王家地穴里霉湿逼仄的通道终究让位于一间殿室：肃穆得近乎寂静，却依旧以相称于长眠者身分的华饰点缀其间。这里是王国一对国王与王后的最终休息之所——他们不仅生前结为连理，死后亦并肩相系。天花板的饰边上雕着细小的基路伯与炽天使，如今已在年代侵蚀下渐渐剥落，仿佛仍在引领这对陨落的王者走向来世。
The musty confines of the royal crypt eventually give way to a chamber, quiet in its solemnity, but still decorative as befits the station of those who rest within. This is the final resting place of a king and queen of the realm, bound in matrimony not only in life but in death as well. Tiny cherubim and seraphim, now crumbling with age, have been carved into the trim of the ceiling as if guiding the fallen royals to the afterlife.

Posh Country Club.name:
豪奢乡村俱乐部
Posh Country Club

Text.text: 乡村俱乐部里那股理所当然的优越感几乎触手可及，却又被巧妙藏起——埋在上了清漆的笑容与夹枪带棒的恭维之下。穿白色Polo衫的员工穿梭伺候着阔绰的客人；那些人不耐烦地啧声、弹指催促，却始终不与人对视。高尔夫球杆开球时那声标志性的啪响，像节拍一样敲打着会所里充斥的无聊闲谈。 The air of entitlement in the country club is palpable but hidden—beneath veneered smiles and back-handed compliments. Staff in white polo shirts attend to affluent clientele who tut and snap their fingers impatiently without making eye contact. The tell-tale thwack of golf clubs teeing off punctuates the inane chatter filling the clubhouse.

Sundries From A River Nymph.name:
河宁芙的杂物
Sundries From A River Nymph

Text.text:
她的身体融化成一滩蓝绿色的暗河水、浮萍与水生草木——仿佛她的躯体曾收集过各式各样的水栖草药。若有人具备草药师的见识与技能，或许能从这位宁芙（特征）吐出的残余里，抢救出最有用的标本。
Her body melts into a blue-green puddle of dark river water, lily pads, and flora—as if her body collected a variety of aquatic herbs. Someone with the knowledge and skill of a herbalist might be able to salvage the most useful specimens the nymph expelled.

当你经过一捆直立的麦秆时，一个细节抓住了你的目光。缠绕在它周围的麦秆被编成了辫子。把一捆麦垛裹得这么讲究，未免过于刻意。你凑近细看，发现辫子后面塞着一个小小的稻草人偶，像水手被捆在船桅上一般。你环顾四周，又看见其他麦垛上也绑着同样的小人偶。
As you pass one of the standing sheafs of wheat, a detail catches your eye. The stalks twisted around it have been braided. It’s a peculiar amount of care to take in wrapping a stook. On closer examination, you see that a little straw doll has been tucked behind the braid, like a sailor lashed to a ship’s mast. Looking around, you spy other little dolls tied to the other stooks.

Julius Renard.name:
朱利叶斯·勒纳尔
Julius Renard

Text.text:
光芒自这名高挑、五官俊朗的男子头顶散发，照亮他垂至肩头的雪白长发，以及发间那道细致的额环。他澄澈的蓝眼在柔光里闪烁，面庞上淡淡的纹路诉说着智慧、笑意与忧怀。他举止沉稳从容。然而，他那打磨光亮的锁子甲上满是战斗与艰苦旅行留下的磨损；同样，他那伤痕累累的鸢盾也不例外，盾面绘着一条蛇盘绕着太阳。左胯处，一柄长剑悬在磨得斑驳的剑鞘中。

~ Played by a Hero with

Light radiates from this tall, fine-featured man’s head, illuminating his white, shoulder-length hair and the circlet upon it. His limpid blue eyes sparkle in the soft glow, while slight lines on his face speak of wisdom, laughter, and concern. His manner is calm. But his polished mail shows the wear of battle and harsh travel, as does his scarred kite shield adorned with a serpent coiled around the sun. A longsword hangs in a battered scabbard on his left hip.

~ Played by a Hero with

Speech During A Desperate Siege.name:
绝望围城中的演说
Speech During A Desperate Siege

Text.text:
“我们苦战良久，血汗交织，但还远未结束。唯有当城墙龟裂，敌人那被腐化的血腥悬在空气中，我们才算告终。唯有当我们支离破碎、横尸于他们的死者之间，方能说我们真正活过。”
“We have fought long and hard, but we are not done yet. Only when the walls crack and the corrupted blood of our enemies hangs in the air can we say we are finished. Only when we lie broken and dead amongst their slain can we say we’ve truly lived.”

这地方显然出自那种“一次就把活干对”的人之手——而且他痴迷天然的光。每一面干砌石墙上都开着两道巨大的拱形窗洞，厚重的木质百叶窗向外掀开。板岩瓦屋顶与粗壮木梁之下，是一座宽阔的壁炉，足够升起火焰、炖上一锅浓汤。壁炉前摆着一把巨大的椅子，堆满坐垫与毯子，像是随时要接住一具疲惫的身躯。壁炉台上方交叉悬着两把鹤嘴镐，像退下来的导师，沉默守望。
This place was obviously built by someone who does a job right the first time—and who craves natural light. In each wall of dry-stacked stone are two large arches serving as windows. Their heavy wooden shutters open outward. Under the slate tile roof and timber beams is a broad hearth for a fire and a pot of stew. A massive chair sits before it, piled with cushions and blankets, ready to welcome a tired body. Crossed pickaxes, like retired mentors, hang above the mantle.

Enormous Mechanized Wizard.name:
巨型机械巫师
Enormous Mechanized Wizard

Text.text:
远处雷声隆隆。你愣了片刻，才带着一阵刺骨的恐惧意识到，那雷声绵延不绝、一次次重复——根本不是雷。是脚步声。沉重到令人窒息的巨步声。你挤开人群，爬上高处，而眼前的景象彻底颠覆常理：一名高达90英尺的机械化法师，以铁铸成，迈着轰鸣的步伐朝城墙逼近。 一阵喧嚣把你的视线扯向下方的城门。你看见守卫正与铁质构装体厮杀——那些东西抓起守卫，像扔破布般将他们抛出去，尖叫声划破空气，身体重重撞上城墙。与此同时，机械化法师仍在逼近，越来越近。

~ Sax 构想

Thunder rumbles in the distance. It takes a moment to realize with a pang of terror that the thunder is persistent, repeating—not thunder at all. Footsteps. Massive footsteps. You find higher ground, shoving through the crowd, and what you see defies explanation: a 90-foot mechanized wizard, forged of iron, striding toward the walls of the city. A clamor draws your attention to the city gate below, and you see the guards clashing with iron constructs, who pick up the guards and hurl them screaming against the walls of the city. All the while, the mechanized wizard draws closer.

~ Envisioned by Sax

I Calm An Upset Struttigon Mount.name:
我安抚一头受惊的斯特鲁蒂冈坐骑
I Calm An Upset Struttigon Mount

Text.text:
我用手轻轻顺着结构鸡龙的脖颈抚下，它的鳞片在惊惶不安中被激发出的潜伏魔法映照下微微闪烁。它张开的鼻孔里噗噗溅出细小的火星，双眼狂乱，瞳孔彻底放大。然而，真正的威胁并非魔法与火焰——而是它强劲的后腿猛踢，以及那条骨质尾巴鞭子般的抽甩。我低声安抚，一只手仍温柔按在它的颈侧，另一只手却收紧缰绳，握得死牢。紧绷的片刻后，它不再用带爪的脚狠狠跺地，尾巴也终于停止来回抽动，仿佛在寻找一截脖子去折断。
I trace a gentle hand down the struttigon’s neck, its scales glimmering with latent magic conjured in its state of upset. Small sputters of flame flicker out of its flared nostrils, and its eyes are wild, in full dilation. But its magic and fire are not the true threats—instead it is the powerful kicks of its legs and the whips of its bony tail. I speak softly while keeping a gentle hand on its neck but the other tightened in a firm grip on its reins. In a few tense moments, it ceases stomping its taloned feet into the ground and its tail stops whipping to and fro as if seeking a neck to snap.

Modular Sprite.name:
模块化小妖精（特征）
Modular Sprite

Text.text:
轻按一下按钮，小妖精（特征）便融入现实空间。它不定一形，而是如暴烈浪潮的回涡般扭曲翻卷。它将诸多工具具现出来，形体不断变换成插头、线缆与高科技破译器具。它并非类人，却也难以与其他小妖精（特征）相提并论。温吞的空气里，它短暂闪烁，脉动着由绿转蓝，再变作一种病态的黄。这个小妖精（特征）似乎厌恶维持任何一种形状。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

With the touch of a button, the sprite melts into realspace. It does not take a single form, instead twisting like the eddies of a violent wave. It materializes its many tools, shifting shape into plugs and wires and high-tech cracking implements. It is not humanoid but it is hard to compare it to other sprites. It glimmers for a moment in the tepid air, pulsing green, then blue, then a sickly shade of yellow. This sprite seems to dislike holding one shape.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

小径消失了，被一场湿土与滚石的雪崩般塌方深深掩埋。山坡迎面一侧被近来的雨水浸透，整片剥裂崩落，将途经之物尽数吞没。浑浊的泥水细流从巨大的堆积物间涓涓渗出，而一阵哗啦的碎响与溅水声告诉你，泥石流的某个部分仍在缓缓蠕动。
The trail vanishes, buried under an avalanche of wet earth and tumbled stones. The face of a hillside, soaked by recent rain, sheared away and collapsed, burying all in its path. Rivulets of muddy water trickle from the massive heap, and a clatter and splash tells you some part of the mud slide is still moving.

那男人摘下宽檐帽，用袖口抹过汗湿的额头。尽管戴着帽子——不如说正因如此——他被晒得通红的脸上，额顶沿着发际线留着一道苍白的帽檐印。他用长满老茧的双手从身上一路掸下，抖落旅途扬起的尘土，随后挺直腰背伸了个懒腰，骨节清脆作响。
The man takes off a broad-brimmed hat and wipes his sleeve across a sweaty brow. Despite the hat—really, because of it—his sunburnt face has a pale band at the top of his forehead. He brushes calloused hands down his body to dust off the dirt of the road and then stretches his back with audible cracks.

每根软铁岩钉都带着宽大的钉头，末端渐收却依旧钝圆，侧面则如刀刃般扁平，呈现出平整的性相。与扁平面垂直的位置，钉头上铸有一道环扣。这个穿眼宽阔到足以穿过粗绳。
Each of these soft iron spikes has a broad head, a tapered but blunt point, and a flat aspect like a blade. Perpendicular to the flat side, as part of each piton’s head, is a loop. This eye is big enough for thick rope to be threaded through.

Carnivorous Plant In Field.name:
田野里的食肉植物
Carnivorous Plant In Field

Text.text:
这株格格不入的植物从田野葱茏的沃土中扭曲钻出，宛如繁花间的一根尖刺；它锯齿般的棘刺形态与周遭的温柔景致形成刺眼对照。一只小鸟缓缓飘近想看得更清楚，探身钻入那从粗壮茎秆上垂下的、鼓胀滴液的囊袋。啪的一声，植物猛然合拢，牢牢钳住小鸟；它拼命挣扎——却徒劳无功。

~ DaveDaWanderer 于 Discord 所构想

The incongruous plant twists from the verdant earth of the field like a thorn among blossoms, its jagged, prickling form at odds with the gentle surroundings. A small bird drifts near to have a closer look, edging inside a bulbous, dripping sac hanging from the thick stalks. With a snap the plant closes, steadfastly holding the bird as it struggles—in vain—to free itself.

~ Envisioned by DaveDaWanderer on Discord

Soldier With Greatsword.name:
巨剑士兵
Soldier With Greatsword

Text.text:
这名士兵身披花哨夺目的装束，却能从容挥舞一柄骇人的巨剑，举重若轻。每一次劈砍都透着习惯成自然的严整纪律，刀锋破空，嘶嘶作歌。他步步逼近，神情晦暗难测，钢铁划出的弧光在身侧旋成夺命的风车，宣告终结。
This soldier, clad in flamboyant garb, brandishes an imposing greatsword with consummate ease. Every swing is a display of customary discipline, the blade splitting air with a sibilant song. Enigmatic, he steps forward, the arc of steel about him a windmill of deadly finality.

Nystul's Magic Aura.name:
涅斯图尔的魔法灵光
Nystul's Magic Aura

Text.text:
吟诵充盈你的口舌，手指在空中起舞；当你凝视你的目标时，魔法如洪流灌入你的心智。你重新编织它内在本质的丝缕。肉眼看来，它依旧分毫未变；然而若以魔法手段审视，它新形态中被改写的混沌将遮蔽真相。
Chanting fills your mouth, your fingers dance through the air, and magic floods your mind as you regard your target. You reweave the strands of its inner essence. To the naked eye, it remains exactly the same. But if examined through magical means, the altered chaos of its new form will obfuscate the truth.

Eager Kid.name:
急不可耐的孩子
Eager Kid

Text.text:
孩子的眼睛闪着纯真与惊奇——在如今这世道里已是稀罕之物——他们抬头望着你，兴奋几乎要从紧绷的神情里溢出来。把手探进兜里，他们迫不及待地炫耀自己最珍贵的物品，一边急切地从你脸上寻找认可的迹象，一边像决堤般滔滔不绝地把关于这件物品的种种信息倾倒而出。
The kid’s eyes shine with innocence and wonder—a rare thing these days—and they look up at you with barely contained excitement. Reaching into their pocket they eagerly show off their most prized possession, searching your face for signs of approval as a torrent of information about the item tumbles out.

Emmer Wheat Field.name:
埃默尔小麦田
Emmer Wheat Field

Text.text:
起伏连绵的麦浪铺天盖地，在正午阳光下金灿夺目、熠熠生辉。麦田几乎铺满整座山谷，边缘地带还能见到几头大型食草兽悠然自得地咀嚼着连根拔起的麦秆。田畔有一条狭窄的河流与麦田并行流淌，想必正是它供给的水源，让这片土地化作肥沃丰饶的良田。
The vast swathe of undulating wheat is golden and resplendent in the midday sun. The field stretches across most of the valley, and there are several large herbivores contentedly chewing uprooted stalks on the fringes of its perimeter. A narrow river runs parallel to the wheat, no doubt supplying the water which turns the ground into rich, fertile soil.

这里一尘不染：干净的稻草、上好的干草，金属水槽里盛着新鲜的清水。新兵与毛头兵被派去清理马厩的粪污、为战马刷洗皮毛。骑兵们带着胡萝卜前来，压低声音，轻柔地与坐骑絮语。每个栏位里都充满起伏的肌肉与无畏——这些野兽早已与恐怖相识，却仍在它们的营房中温顺地轻嘶、咀嚼。
The place is immaculate, clean straw, good hay, fresh water in the metal troughs. Recruits and green soldiers are assigned the mucking of the stables and brushing down of the horses. The cavalry riders visit with carrots and low, soft talk to their mounts. Rippling muscle and bravery are the stuff of every horse in each stall, beasts acquainted with horror yet gently nickering and chewing in their barracks.

这名精瘦男子的定制西装与他垂至肩头的炭黑长发同色，发间一道白色挑染格外醒目。外套之下，他的衬衫只比外衣深了几分色调。他那双锐利的眼睛几乎黑得发亮。棱角分明的五官极具辨识度，右颊一道疤痕更将其锋利感衬得愈发凌厉。双脚稳稳分开立在身下，他以放松的战斗姿态站着，右手握着一把线条流畅的乌木手弩。左手自然垂着，掌心微张，松弛却随时可动。

~ 由 Jake 在 Played 中扮演

The color of this lean man’s tailored suit matches his shoulder-length charcoal hair, which has a streak of white through it. Under his coat, his shirt is only a few shades darker than his outerwear. His piercing eyes are nearly as black. He has distinctive angular features, accentuated further by a scar on his right cheek. Feet squared under him, he stands in a relaxed combat pose and holds a sleek ebony hand crossbow in his right hand. The left hangs open, relaxed but ready.

~ Played by Jake with

Grimlock With Club.name:
持棍的格里姆洛克
Grimlock With Club

Text.text:
这生物像人类之于蝙蝠像鸟：部件一应俱全，却仿佛来自不同的模具，比例也全然失衡。它斑驳的皮肤宛如灰色大理石。硕大的耳朵在头顶各自抽动，夹着一张尖瘦的脸——细小的眼睛，取代鼻子的则是张开的鼻孔。它用夸长前臂末端的巨掌攥着一根凶相毕露的棍棒。
This creature resembles a human in the way a bat resembles a bird. All the parts are there, but from different models, and out of proportion. Its mottled skin looks like gray marble. Huge ears twitch independently on its head, framing a pinched face with tiny eyes and gaping nostrils instead of a nose. It holds a vicious-looking club in large hands at the ends of overly long forearms.

一艘经抛光的樱桃木船体傲然悬停在天空船坞上方，风鼓起帆布般的船帆，帆腹饱满隆起。你听见它复杂的内部机械发出吱呀与铿锵的声响，船员们彼此呼喊，兴致勃勃地讲述着他们最新一段航程。
A hull of polished cherrywood hovers proudly above the sky dock, the canvas bellies of the ship’s sails swelling with the wind. You hear the creak and clang of its complex internal mechanisms, and members of the crew shout to one another, heartily recounting their latest voyage.

I Cast Hold Monster Using My Divine Focu.name:
我用神圣圣徽物品施放了“定身怪物”
I Cast Hold Monster Using My Divine Focus Item

Text.text:
我引动灵性的权威、圣战的威能与随之而来的和平祝福，瞄准我的敌人。

[成功豁免] 怪物迎上前来，它的力量与我的力量相互角力。神圣的权威随即消退，仿佛认定此刻并非天命所许，怪物不会停下推进的脚步。

[失败豁免] 怪物迎上前来，它的力量与我的力量相互角力，但我在命令中感到神意，我的对手亦然。它放缓，它驻足，此刻它无法对抗束缚它的正义威能。确切地说，它根本无法移动分毫。

I channel spiritual authority, the might of holy war and the blessing of peace to follow, and take aim on my foe.

[Successful Save] The monster engages, its power struggling against my own. The divine authority fades, determining that this moment is not to be, and the monster will not pause its advance.

[Failed Save] The monster engages, its power struggling against my own, but I feel the divine in the command, and so does my opponent. It slows, it stays, and now it cannot act against the righteous might that holds it. Indeed, it cannot move at all.

Gem Temple With Goat Guardians.name:
山羊守卫的宝石神殿
Gem Temple With Goat Guardians

Text.text:
在一座本该寂静无声的神殿台阶上，一个光头巫师身披猩红长袍，双臂疯狂挥舞；他头皮上刺着惑控的徽记。四只巨羊与他厮杀，咩叫与蹄声轰鸣，和法术的奥术喝令诡异地绞在一起。神殿四周繁茂的叶影间，霉斑遍布的石块上刻着反复出现的纹样：一颗较大的宝石，周围簇拥着一圈更小的宝石。每只山羊的长毛上都点缀着闪亮的宝石碎片，仿佛它们正在皮毛里生长。

~ 设想：Elijah Richard

On the steps of an otherwise silent temple is a bald wizard in crimson robes flailing his arms, his head tattooed with the symbol of enchantment. He battles four giant goats, whose bleating and clomping of hooves mix unnervingly with the arcane shouts of spells. Through the lush foliage around the temple, carved into the moldy stone blocks, is a repeated pattern: a group of smaller gemstones surrounding a larger one. The long fur of each goat is dotted with sparkling gem fragments, as if they were being grown.

~ Envisioned by Elijah Richard

Thessaly Cord, The Daredevil.name:
色萨利绳索，“亡命飞胆”
Thessaly Cord, The Daredevil

Text.text:
“来这儿，小家伙，”伴随着一连串哄诱般的咂嘴声，从河岸边一处小空地传来。一个男人蹲着，穿着一件皮背心，兜袋密密麻麻，走动间叮当作响；他递出一条风干肉干，招呼一只误闯营地的狗。那犬科生物一点点靠近，他眼里顿时亮起光，可那狗却猛地咬走半截零嘴，转身就跑。“是头发的问题吗？”男人直起身，低声嘟囔。他抬手梳过自己狂野纠结的乱发，把那半截被啃过的肉干挂到腰带的钩子上，旁边已经挂着另外两条。

~ Envisioned by Charlotte

"Here, boy," followed by a series of cajoling clicks, emanates from a small clearing by the river's edge. A man with a leather vest covered in jingling pockets squats down, offering a strip of jerky to a dog that's wandered into camp. His eyes light up as the canine inches closer, only for the dog to bite off half the treat and run. "Is it the hair?" the man mumbles to himself as he straightens. He runs a hand through his wild locks as he hangs the half-eaten jerky next to two other strips hooked on his belt.

~ Envisioned by Charlotte

Captains Club Guide.name:
船长俱乐部指南
Captains Club Guide

Text.text:
一头快活的熊仰头灌下一小杯深色液体，拇指勾在腰带的环扣里。它足有十英尺高，身披旧日海军准将般的华丽行头，朝空中吼出一声浓重的熊式大笑，震得那顶缀满羽翎与长羽的帽子往后一滑，差点从头顶掉下。胸前那些被倒着钉上的勋章随着移动叮当作响。
A jovial bear knocks back a shot of dark liquid, their thumb tucked into a loop at their belt. Ten feet tall and decked in the finery of a commodore of old, they bark a thick ursine laugh into the air, sending their plumed and feathered hat sliding back off their head. The medals stapled upside down to their chest jangle with the movement.

Tall Tale About A Flying Monk.name:
关于一位会飞的僧人的奇谈
Tall Tale About A Flying Monk

Text.text:
……咔嚓！九头蛇又一副巨颚在武僧脚下咬了个空。咔嚓！这一次，咬合声从他脑后炸响。他轻巧地从一条长颈飘到另一条长颈，戏弄着这头怪物。沿着峡谷峭壁，他引它向上、再向上，越攀越高。仿佛乘着一缕清风，他在自己最后一个回合结束时悠然飘开，静候九头蛇的诸首把那宿命的结打成。七张乱咬的巨口咔哒作响，像一群受惊的鸡，困惑又被自家脖颈勒得喘不过气；它的脚在峡谷边缘徒劳地抓挠，拼命寻找落点。武僧朝这摇摇欲坠的九头蛇吹出决断的一阵劲风，它便翻栽进深渊。因为他是……清风修士。
…Snap! Another set of the hydra's jaws closes on air beneath the monk's feet. SNAP! This time behind his head. He flutters with ease from one neck to the next, mocking the beast. Up the canyon wall he leads, higher and higher. As if on a breeze, he floats out of his final turn and waits for the hydra's heads to tie the fateful knot. The seven snapping jaws clack like chickens, confused and strangled, and its feet fight for purchase at the canyon's edge. The monk blows a conclusive gust of air at the unbalanced hydra and it falls into the chasm. For he is… the Air Friar.

I Use Wild Shape: Crocodile.name:
我使用荒野形态：鳄鱼
I Use Wild Shape: Crocodile

Text.text:
我扑倒在地，腹部贴着地面蠕动，身躯随之拉长，皮肤泛起粗糙的青绿色光泽。四肢在关节噼啪作响中缩短，脊椎却一路延展，化作一条强健有力的尾巴。我发出嘶声。头骨扁平、变宽、拉长；五官在压扁与抹平间变得光滑，我感觉双眼缓缓移到头顶。参差不齐的獠牙冒了出来，从细长的口吻间这里一根、那里一根地向外突刺。
Dropping to my belly, I wriggle as my body stretches and takes on a rough, green cast. My limbs shrink with a popping of joints as my backbone lengthens into a muscular tail. I hiss. My head flattens, widens, and elongates. As features flatten and smooth I feel my eyes move to the top of my head. Irregular fangs appear, jutting here and there from my long maw.

Modest Tenement.name:
简陋的廉租公寓
Modest Tenement

Text.text:
一间间房屋与公寓连绵铺展开来，门廊上方的遮篷与中央花园为这里添了几分明快。许多住户在门框上挂起迎客的标牌，或在自家门阶上摆放鲜花。主干道的街角处，一名街头艺人与一位吟游诗人合奏同乐；除去偶尔漏雨的屋顶、破裂的窗户，或醉醺醺的小毛贼，这片公寓区看起来仍算是个适合安身的地方。
The sprawl of rooms and apartments is made cheery by awnings over the doorways and a central garden. Many of the residents have hung a sign of greeting on their door frame or set flowers on the stoop to their home. A busker and a bard play together on the corner at the main road, and but for an occasional leaky roof, broken window, or drunken petty thief, the tenement seems a reasonable place to live.

你的手在手枪冰冷的握把上收紧。它是低温工程的奇迹，枪管的金属光滑得像融化的冰。弹匣的位置跳动着一枚钴蓝能量电池，为这把武器的超冷腔室供能。枪口呼哧逸出的雾气噼啪作响，裹着刺骨的寒能。扣下扳机时，那团雾气被瞬间压缩成刀锋般的冰刃碎片，随即以惊人的速度膨胀，被致命的力量与精准从枪管中迸射而出。
Your hand tightens around the cold grip of the pistol. A marvel of cryo-engineering, the barrel's metal is as sleek as melted ice. In place of a magazine pulses a cobalt cell, which powers this weapon's supercooled chamber. The vapor that wheezes out of the barrel's tip crackles with icy energy. Pulling the trigger compresses that vapor into razor-edged shards of ice that expand so quickly they're ejected from the barrel with deadly force and precision.

Alarm From Merchant Captain As Pirates B.name:
商队船长惊呼示警，海盗正登船来袭
Alarm From Merchant Captain As Pirates Board The Vessel

Text.text:
“上楼梯，快点！退后，上楼梯！所以才叫它艏楼，你们这群骑士！保卫你们的船，你们这些勇士。保卫她！”
“Up the stairs, and sharpish! Back and up the stairs. That’s why they call it a forecastle, you knights! Defend your ship, you champions. Defend her!”

Creepy Campsite Off The Trail.name:
偏离小径的阴森营地
Creepy Campsite Off The Trail

Text.text:
空地里散落着几顶被遗弃的帐篷，帆布久经风雨，处处磨损破裂。中央是一处小小的火坑，早已熄灭，一口巨大的铜锅悬在上方，孤零零地晃着。地面被撕开数道深深的沟痕，像是某辆货车或马车在骤然的蛮力下被拖拽挪动——曾栖身于此的人必定是仓皇离去，猝不及防。营地里弥漫着令人毛骨悚然的寂静，让每一步落地都仿佛回声四起，砸碎这脆弱的安宁。
The clearing holds several abandoned tents, their canvases weathered and torn in places. In the center, a small firepit sits extinguished and a large copper pot hangs abandoned above it. Deep gashes line the ground where a wagon or carriage was moved with sudden force—those who resided here must have left quickly and unexpectedly. An eerie silence resides within the camp, making each footfall seem to echo and shatter the fragile stillness.

Elven Throne Room.name:
精灵王座厅
Elven Throne Room

Text.text:
不同于人类、甚至矮人国度那种依赖物质堆砌的恢宏，精灵君主的御座厅散发着一种不容置疑的威势——由自水晶般的玻璃中倾泻而入的缥缈光辉所加持。宽阔的台座与高背王座，皆由一株古老到无法估量其年代的巨树盘曲枝干生长、塑形而成。事实上，若非见多识广，你几乎会以为那些晶莹窗扉也是这样“长”出来的……一想到要实现这般奇迹，得动用何等强大的精灵 魔法，便不禁脊背发凉。
Unlike the material grandeur of human or even dwarven realms, the throne room of the elven monarch exudes a feeling of power—bolstered by ethereal light pouring in through crystalline glass. The broad dais and tall-backed throne both grown and shaped from twisted boughs of a tree so ancient that its age is inestimable. As a matter of fact, if you didn’t know better, you’d think the crystalline windows were somehow also grown that way . . . and it makes you shiver to consider what powerful fey magic would be required to pull off that marvel.

Metal-stamping Submachine Gun.name:
金属冲压冲锋枪
Metal-stamping Submachine Gun

Text.text:
要把这把沉甸甸的冲锋枪抬起来得费一番劲。握把用金属加固，并配有额外支撑，用来削减后坐力，避免没有强化的使用者手腕被震断。枪管固定着一套附加装置，能将加长弹匣里的金属冲压弹丸强力推出。
It takes an effort to hoist the meaty submachine gun. The grip is reinforced with metal and comes with additional supports to dampen recoil and stop a non-enhanced wielder’s wrist from breaking. The barrel is fixed with an attachment to propel metal-stamping rounds from the extended magazine.

这道法术完成之际，一股刺鼻的气味随之弥漫；雾气倾泻而出，你的指尖也随之冰冷。雾霭渐聚之时，你发誓听见风中传来一声遥远而痛苦的尖叫。黄绿色的浓雾里，你瞥见几张空洞的面孔向外窥视——也许是这道法术过去的受害者？
An acrid odor accompanies the completion of this spell, and your fingers grow cold as the fog pours forth; as it gathers you swear you hear a distant, pained scream on the wind.  Within the yellow-green fog you see the hint of hollow faces peering outward—past victims of the spell, perhaps?

Villain's Austere Quarters.name:
反派的清冷居所
Villain's Austere Quarters

Text.text:
对这样一位掌握滔天权势的人而言，她的寝室却几乎看不出半点排场。简陋的床架把低矮的床铺稍稍抬离地面，毯子只是灰色羊毛。床脚处摆着一只包铁的箱子。角落里立着一张小小的书写桌，仿佛修道院里的抄写员才会用的那种。屋内唯一交付于虚荣的物体，是墙上挂着的一面小镜子。
For someone with so much power, her bedchamber does little to show it. A simple frame holds a low bed off the floor, the blankets just gray wool. At its foot sits an iron-bound chest. In a corner stands a small writing desk, as a scribe in a monastery might use. The only object given over to vanity is a small mirror hung on the wall.

Temple To A Halfling Goddess.name:
半身人女神的神殿
Temple To A Halfling Goddess

Text.text:
这处空间朴素克制，简洁却不失舒适。空气清新，带着湿润的土腥气，隐隐混着隔夜的香火余韵；摇曳的烛光洒下温暖的色泽，令人不由得放松。地上铺陈着无数坐垫，足够容纳前来礼拜的人群；而在神殿的核心，一座圆形台座隆起，显然为仪式而设，其上摆着丰盛而亲切的供奉：各色果蔬、谷物，以及紫罗兰色的葡萄酒与金色的蜂蜜酒。飘动的帷幔两侧，齐半身人身高的窗子向外开着，映入眼帘的是起伏的翠绿田野；一阵清凉却令人心安的微风掠过，沿途把烛火吹得噼啪轻颤。
The space is spartan, simple, but comfortable. The air smells fresh, loamy, tinged with day-old incense, and the flickering candles lend a warm, inviting light. Myriad cushions arranged on the floor provide ample seating for worshipers, and at the temple’s heart rises a circular dais arranged for a service, with a welcoming cornucopia of produce, grains, and bottles of violet wine and golden mead. Flanked by fluttering curtains, halfling-height windows look out onto rolling green fields, and a cool but comforting breeze licks past, sputtering the candles as it goes.

Sundries From A Group Of Skeleton Archer.name:
一群骷髅弓箭手的杂物
Sundries From A Group Of Skeleton Archers

Text.text:
成块的人形骨骸与碎布、破皮散落满地。断裂的箭杆、碎裂的燧石或弯曲的铜制箭头，混杂在这片血腥狼藉之中，四处零落。
Chunks of humanoid bone litter the floor along with scraps of cloth and leather. Broken arrows and cracked flint or bent copper arrowheads are scattered among all the carnage.

I Survey The Aftermath Of A Shoot-out.name:
我勘察枪战后的余波
I Survey The Aftermath Of A Shoot-out

Text.text:
我以冷静到近乎算计的疏离，审视枪战后血淋淋的残局，把刚才发生的一切在脑海里像全息影像一样反复回放。那是一次伏击，但算不上成功：双方死伤惨重，而从混凝土上密密麻麻的弹孔来看，他们没一个枪法像样。
I survey the bloody aftermath of the shootout with calculated detachment, replaying the events in my mind like a holo-vid. It was an ambush, but not a very successful one: lots of casualties on both sides, and judging by the number of bullet holes in the concrete, none of them were a good shot.

矮人举手投足间带着学者般的谨慎与克制，拄着法杖前行，时不时拍一拍系在身侧的厚重巨册，仿佛那是安身的依靠。然而在这苍老的表皮之下，蛮横无羁的力量正潜伏涌动。法师吐出古老而晦涩的言辞，法杖顶端的水晶绽放出异界般的光辉。咒语收束的刹那，烈火迸发，比创世之初的原初之焰更为灼热。
The dwarf carries themselves with the caution and care of a scholar, leaning on a staff and patting a heavy tome tied to their side for comfort. But beneath the wizened veneer, unbridled power resides. The wizard speaks words ancient and archaic, and the crystal atop their staff glows with an otherworldly light. As they complete their incantation, fire springs forth, hotter than the primal flame of creation.

Official Document Affirming Special Righ.name:
确认特殊权利的正式文件
Official Document Affirming Special Rights

Text.text:
这卷亚麻卷轴展开后约有半码长。标题行以古老字体书就，装饰繁复得几乎难以辨认；而细密的正文分段罗列着特权与权柄，其间点缀着一枚枚盖印的徽记。文字下方嵌着三枚巨大的蜡封，等距排列，牢牢缀入亚麻纹理之中。背面以金扣固定的红色系带自下缘垂落。
This linen scroll opens to a half-yard in length. The title lines are in an old script, so heavily ornamented as to be barely legible, while the blocks of fine writing that delineate privileges and authorities are peppered with stamped symbols. Below the writing are three massive wax seals, evenly spaced and knitted into the linen. The red binding ribbon, attached to the back by golden clasp, hangs from the bottom edge.

White Stone Mesa.name:
白石台地
White Stone Mesa

Text.text:
宛如雕刻家案上静候凿刀落下的石坯，这座巨大的台地匍匐在平原之间，数里之外仍压住天际线。粗粝的雪白石质在渐暖的阳光中泛着光泽——被翻涌的云影点点斑驳——令这处地标披上一层灿然的色彩。

~ 构想：David（Discord）

Like a sculptor's block awaiting a chisel, the enormous mesa squats amid the plains, dominating the horizon for miles around. The rough, alabaster stone shines in the warming rays of the sun—dappled by the rolling clouds—which gives the landmark a resplendent hue.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Loot From A Troll.name:
巨魔身上的战利品
Loot From A Troll

Text.text:
那魁梧的生物轰然倒地毙命，咕嘟冒泡的绿色血肉再也无法再生。巨魔（特征）的腰间挂着一只巨大的皮革袋，用绳索紧紧捆住。你打开一看——在各式肉块之间——发现190枚银币、60枚金币，以及一把碎裂长剑的残片。
The hulking creature falls over dead, its bubbling green flesh no longer capable of regeneration. About the troll’s waist hangs a large leather pouch bound with rope. Inside—among various chunks of meat—you find 190 silver pieces, 60 gold pieces, and the fragments of a shattered sword.

Hilltop Ritual Site.name:
山顶仪式场
Hilltop Ritual Site

Text.text:
你攀着山坡一路爬上山脊，眼前豁然出现一片人工开辟的空地。灌木被清理得一干二净，只剩土与岩裸露，在此形成一个巨大的圆形。粗陋的石制三联碑被竖立起来，满覆符号，环绕着一座巨石祭坛；祭坛被无数献祭的鲜血染成褐色。你试图追索这些三联碑与祭坛之间的排列规律，却让你的感官愈发迷乱，仿佛它们拒绝被理解。
You clamber up the side of the hill to its crest to find a man-made clearing. The brush is swept away down to the dirt and rock in an enormous circle. Crude stone triptychs have been erected and covered with symbols, surrounding a great stone altar stained brown with the blood of countless sacrifices. Trying to follow the pattern of the triptychs as they relate to the altar disorients your senses, as though they refuse understanding.

Juvenile Atlapak.name:
幼年亚特拉帕克
Juvenile Atlapak

Text.text:
如同其史前的水栖祖先之一，这只甲壳类生物以八对足横行疾走，游动姿势笨拙而粗陋。它身长五英尺，钴蓝如钢，生着一只巨硕无朋的钳爪，开合间咔哒作响，声震耳膜；另一只则较小，却长着阴狠尖利的小钩爪，专为撕裂血肉而生。猩红羽状饰毛在尾端与头部怒张翻卷，分节的甲壳在光下闪烁发亮。
Like one of their prehistoric aquatic ancestors, this crustacean scuttles along on eight pairs of legs, a crude swimming motion. Five feet long and cobalt blue, it sports a humongous pincer that clacks open and shut with a deafening sound, while a second is smaller and boasts nasty little claws designed to tear flesh. Scarlet feathers flare at the tail and head, and the banded shell of its carapace glitters in the light.

你跨过这家古怪旅店的门槛时，左侧便传来一阵无实体的低沉嗓音隆隆作响，问你是否愿意把外套或斗篷交给它照看。你刚一脱下外衣，它们就被一股看不见的力量从你手中轻巧夺走，倏然送往旁边的衣帽间——那扇门仿佛也会自行开启。走进公共区域，你看见壁炉里燃着幽蓝的火焰，明亮得不似人间。盛着饮品与点心的托盘无声漂浮在房间里，灵巧地绕开宾客、避开碰撞，把东西稳稳送到等候的客人面前。空气中回荡着一支轻快的曲子，可放眼望去，既无乐器，也无演奏者。
As you cross the threshold of this unusual inn, a disembodied bass voice rumbles from your left, asking if you would like your coats or cloaks taken. As soon as you divest your outer garments, they are plucked out of your hands by an unseen force and spirited off to a nearby cloakroom, the door of which appears to open of its own accord. Heading into the common area, you find hearth with a fire that glows bright blue. Trays of drinks and edibles float soundlessly throughout the room, maneuvering around the guests and avoiding collisions as they are delivered to waiting patrons. A jaunty tune fills the air, but there are no instruments nor performers to be seen.

Sundries From A Sandsea Aboleth.name:
砂海底栖魔的杂物
Sundries From A Sandsea Aboleth

Text.text:
它的皮革般外皮如砂纸一般，粗糙得一接触便能感到刺涩；然而同时还渗出深褐色黏液的滴珠。那黏稠、带着植物腥味的液体一路拖曳，身后留下团团湿沙的凝结。它额头上层叠的三只眼——被一层蓝色膜质眼睑不透明地覆住——若能小心拆解，或许可以将其取出。
Its hide is like sandpaper, rough to the touch, and yet also excretes droplets of a dark brown mucus. The viscous, vegetal-smelling fluid has left globs of wet sand in its wake. The three eyes stacked on its brow—opaquely covered by a blue membranous eyelid—might be extracted with some careful tinkering.

熊地精（特征）的尸体是一团纠缠的长长毛臂毛腿，彼此堆叠，像火堆里的木柴。生物松垮张开的下颌从这片肢体的混乱中探出，一把斧头深深劈进它的头骨。
The bugbear’s corpse is a tangle of long, furry limbs heaped atop one another like logs in a fire. The creature’s slack-jawed face pokes out from the anatomical chaos, an axe buried deep in its skull.

这片环形山谷向两端延展数里。高耸而陡峭的崖壁沿着周缘竖起一道天然城墙，而雨水则在洼地中心汇聚成湖泊与水塘。你不禁猜测，这个诡异而广阔的深坑究竟因何而生；随即抬头望向天空——或许很久以前有什么自天而坠，在此留下了撞击的疤痕。坠落的是什么？它又留下些什么？
The circular valley spans leagues in either direction. Its high, steep sides form a natural wall around the circumference, though rainfall collects in lakes and ponds near the center of the depression. You wonder what formed the strange and sprawling pit, then look skyward—maybe something fell from the sky long ago, leaving this impact crater in its wake. What fell, and what did it leave behind?

Obvious Ocular Weapon Implant.name:
显眼的眼部武器植入物
Obvious Ocular Weapon Implant

Text.text:
哪怕只是匆匆一瞥，也能看出这名特工的义眼经过了升级，那枚幽红发光的虹膜宛如毁灭的信标。它散发着激光式武器系统的味道，塞满了目标捕捉与追踪功能：落在行家手里，就是一件致命的武器。
Even at a quick glance it is obvious the operative has an upgraded ocular, the glowing red iris a beacon of destructiveness. It smacks of a laser-based weapon system, chock full of target acquisition and tracking features: a deadly weapon in the hands of a pro.

Quiet City Port.name:
静谧之城港口
Quiet City Port

Text.text:
退潮的海水把十来艘小船搁在码头岸边——桅杆歪斜，船身倾侧——仿佛巨人把玩具随手丢进泥里。更大的船只则停泊在更深的水域，静候潮水回返。眼下栈桥上还算安静，水手们或修补渔网，或分拣待运的货物，或干脆打着盹。
The retreating sea has stranded over a dozen small boats along the quay—masts tilted and hulls canted—like toys tossed in the mud by a giant. Larger vessels have moored farther out in the deep water, awaiting the returning tide. For now, the pier is relatively quiet with sailors repairing nets, sorting goods for transport, or taking naps.

那头狼形怪物四肢着地疾奔而来，粗硬的炭灰色毛皮化作一抹残影。猎犬低吼咆哮，诡异的骷髅般面容扭曲成令人毛骨悚然的冷笑，燃烧的双眼闪烁着近乎人类的智慧。宽阔而前突的下颚上，弯曲的獠牙向上倒刺般顶出——狼与地精般的邪异混种，古怪得令人不寒而栗。
The lupine beast moves on all fours, a blur of coarse, charcoal-gray fur. The hound snarls, its strange, skeletal visage twisting into an uncanny sneer, burning eyes alight with a human-like intelligence. Curving fangs jut upward from its broad, underslung jaw—a strange and unnerving mingling of wolf and goblinoid.

渡鸦是鸟类中最聪慧的种族之一。它的喙如黑色的铁砧，嗓音低沉沙哑。那一双眼各自如幽黑深井，盛满预言的秘闻，巡视着它的领地。
The raven is among the smartest of birds. Its beak is like a black anvil, its voice deep and gravelly. The black well of each eye brims with prophetic lore as it surveys its territory.

Loot From An Unseelie Queen.name:
来自一位不祥妖精女王的战利品
Loot From An Unseelie Queen

Text.text:
在女王的寝宫里，一切都出自史上——乃至更遥远之地——最精湛的工匠之手。宏伟奢华的厅室四周壁龛中，镶嵌着打磨光润宝石的大理石底座上安放着无价的艺术珍品。由蛛丝纺成的床罩轻拂着一张奢靡得近乎过分的巨床，床上方垂着一顶绣工绝美的华盖；而在床尾，一只巨大的木箱静静停放，其上刻满玫瑰与藤蔓的纹饰。每一件物品都必定价值一笔小小的财富。
In the queen’s chambers everything has been crafted by the finest artisans of history—and beyond. Priceless works of art rest atop marble pedestals inlaid with polished gemstones in the alcoves around the grandiose room. Covers spun from spider’s silk caress a decadently large bed overlooked by a beautifully embroidered canopy, and at the foot of the bed rests a large wooden chest engraved with roses and vines. Each item must be worth a small fortune.

I Put On My Gold-trim Glasses.name:
我戴上镶金边的眼镜
I Put On My Gold-trim Glasses

Text.text:
我小心翼翼地展开眼镜纤薄而光滑的镜腿，轻柔地将它们抬起，稳稳戴到脸上。镜框周围的金色镶边在鼻梁与耳畔优雅地映着光，让我的视野澄澈无比。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，Forge Ahead: A Party To Access 创作

I carefully unfold the thin, polished arms of my glasses and gently lift them into position on my face. The gold trim around the frames catches the light elegantly atop my nose and ears, allowing me to see with perfect clarity.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Advice From A Master About Talent.name:
大师谈天赋的忠告
Advice From A Master About Talent

Text.text:
“天赋不是赋礼；它是一枚种子。它必须被呵护、被照料，否则就会枯死。有天赋的人常常因为自认特殊而放弃训练，但真正的大师，是那些跨越自身阻碍、并在时代中超越天赋者的人。”
“Talent is not a gift; it is a seed. It must be cared for and tended to or it will die. Those with talent often forgo training because they believe they are special, but the true masters are those who overcame their impediments and surpassed the talented with time.”

Short Travel Across The Divine Realm.name:
穿越神域的短途旅行
Short Travel Across The Divine Realm

Text.text:
你踏上旅程，心中并不确定会发现什么。空气闪耀着灿烂的金色光辉，永恒的白昼里，云层泛着银光，把万物浸在无所不包的辉耀之中。地平线上，洁白发亮的高耸建筑拔地而起，而群山更是巍峨至极。你小心翼翼地穿行在这片辉光位面上；终于，你看见了你的目的地。
You embark on your journey unsure of what you might find. The air gleams with a radiant, golden light, and the clouds shine silver in the perpetual daylight, suffusing everything in an all-encompassing glow. Soaring architecture, gleaming white, stands on the horizon, and mountains stand even taller. You move carefully across the radiant plane; finally, you see your destination.

I Commune With Animals.name:
我与群兽通感
I Commune With Animals

Text.text:
我在冥想中，以心智与灵魂向外触及。我感知到近处的动物，以及它们心脏的搏动——如眨动的星光。我察觉它们原初的智慧。它们传递各自的挣扎与得意：觅食、哺育幼崽、悼念逝去者。我与这些生灵交换原始的思绪与情感，因为同一种永恒的本质在我们每一个体内流淌，正如生命之血一般确凿。
Meditating, I reach out with my mind and spirit. I perceive nearby animals and the beating of their hearts like winking stars. I sense their primeval intelligence. They communicate their struggles and successes: finding food, caring for young, mourning the lost. I exchange primal thoughts and feelings with these creatures, for the same eternal essence flows through each of us, as surely as our life’s blood.

它们如燃烧的箭矢般刺破长空，化作耀眼的火雨群，身后拖曳着闷燃的烟痕。流星自天穹倾泻而下，绽放出惊心动魄的天象之美，宛如行过的灯笼，将夜幕映得通明。
They appear as flaming arrows lancing through the sky in a dazzling swarm, leaving smoldering trails in their wake. The meteors cascade across the heavens in a spectacular display of celestial beauty, illuminating the night sky like passing lanterns.

一尊雕像刻画着一名年轻女子正从大理石贵妃榻上半起身，仿佛你闯入了她私密的闺房。她的石躯以撩人的弧度蜷曲成诱惑的姿态，微微俯首与您的目光相接。她双眼镶嵌的璀璨宝石闪烁着勾人的光芒，精细凿刻的唇线似乎藏着一抹秘而不宣的笑意。雕刻者想必与超自然之力立下契约，才得以如此妖娆地捕捉欲望的神韵。
A statue depicts a young woman in mid-rise from a marble divan, as though you have intruded upon her private boudoir. Her stone body is curved in a seductive pose and her head is bent to meet your gaze. The glittering gems of her eyes gleam alluringly, and her delicately chiseled lips hint at a secret smile. The sculptor must have made a supernatural pact to have so sensually captured the spirit of desire.

五彩缤纷的旗幡垂挂在车身上，马车渐近时，你听见车厢内传出乐声。它缓缓停下，随即猛然扭动变形，仿佛凭借魔法自我拆解重组。一侧展开成一座阶段，篷顶随之升起罩在其上。烟囱喷吐出十几种颜色的烟雾，把空气染得斑斓，同时飘散出陌生而异域的气味。车门砰然炸开，一群虹彩鸟儿冲天而出，羽毛在阶段上方流淌的光辉里熠熠生辉。乐声此刻轰然向外奔涌——号角刺耳齐鸣，钹声轰响迸裂，鼓点如雷滚滚。
Colorful banners drape the wagon and, as it approaches, you hear music emanating from within. It rolls to a stop and instantly shifts, transforming and reshaping seemingly with magic. A stage unfolds from one side, with a canopy rising above it. The chimney spouts smoke of a dozen colors, tingeing the air with strange and exotic smells. The door bursts open, releasing a flock of rainbow-colored birds whose feathers shine in the light glowing over the stage. The music now booms outward—blaring horns, crashing cymbals, and thunderous drums.

Loot From A Tarrasque.name:
从泰拉斯奎身上剥下的战利品
Loot From A Tarrasque

Text.text:
泰坦巨大的双眼渐渐失去神采，生命从它那庞然身躯里流逝，伴随着成股涌出的刺鼻黏稠血浆。它如洞窟般的巨口大张着，浓稠涎丝自大得不可思议的獠牙间垂落，宛如洞中垂挂的藤蔓——而后你看见了，那从怪物腹腔深处透出的、无可错认的宝藏微光。
The titan’s enormous eyes glaze over as life ebbs from its gargantuan body in torrents of pungent, viscous blood. Its cavernous maw hangs agape, thick strands of drool hanging from impossibly large fangs like vines over a cavern—and then you see it, the unmistakable glimmer of treasure from deep within the beast’s innards.

灾厄越过地平线。一个行走的泰坦映入眼帘，身高堪比数栋楼宇，周身披覆由装甲板构成的外骨骼。它的面孔仿佛进化中一切野蛮冲动的终极结晶：半是狼，半是蜥蜴，满口龇裂的獠牙。它冠冕般的犄角与利爪仿佛足以夷平摩天大楼；而在装甲板的缝隙间，舌状的附肢蠕动着伸出，触及近旁的残骸，品尝着空气。
Calamity crests the horizon. A walking titan comes into view, several buildings high and covered in an exoskeleton built of armored plates. Its face is the culmination of evolution’s every savage impulse: part wolf, part lizard, all snarling fangs. While its crowned horns and claws look to be able to level skyscrapers, between the armored plates wriggle tonguelike appendages that reach out toward nearby debris, tasting the air.

Sneak Attack From Supine Position Agains.name:
卧姿对敌偷袭攻击
Sneak Attack From Supine Position Against Opponent

Text.text:
你仰面躺倒时，小心别泄露自己仍有意识，竭力模仿倒下战士那种空洞、无神且不眨眼的凝视。敌人从你身旁掠过，转而去与一名同伴交战之际，你骤然向侧一滚，抽出匕首，随即自下而上猛然捅入对方大腿内侧，意图以致命一击割断其股动脉，使其迅速失能。
Careful not to give away your conscious state as you lie supine, you mimic the blank, unblinking stare of a felled combatant. As the enemy moves past you to engage one of your allies, you suddenly roll to one side, drawing and then plunging your dagger upward toward the inside of their thigh, seeking a debilitating severing of your opponent’s femoral artery.

Cosmic Dragon On Mountaintop.name:
山巅之上的宇宙巨龙
Cosmic Dragon On Mountaintop

Text.text:
六只难以捉摸的黄色眼睛——每一只都有车轮般大小——以不可测的好奇注视着你。缕缕飘渺的以太薄雾在巨龙庞大的头颅周围盘旋——如同被夏日微风拂起的发丝——顺着一股你无法感知的暗流流淌。光芒以催眠般的节律在这威严的生物全身脉动，掠过它鳞片上漂移的流体星海——宛若苍穹中的彗星般起舞。
Six inscrutable yellow eyes—each the size of a wagon wheel—regard you with unfathomable curiosity. Wisps of etheric mist swirl around the dragon’s enormous head—like hair caught by a summer breeze—flowing in a current you cannot feel. Lights pulse in a hypnotic pattern throughout the majestic creature’s body, dancing across the fluid star-scape that drifts over its scales like comets in the firmament.

寺中某处传来一声悠长的锣响，或许是在宁静的庭园里宣告一场禅修的开始。身披明亮橙袍的僧侣们神情安然，飘然穿行于这片圣地，从不比必要时走得更快。相较于粉刷墙外那片无边蔓延的都市，这座寺院宛如一处令人心安的绿洲，是现代生活重压之下的一方避难所。
A gong sounds somewhere in the temple, perhaps marking the start of a meditation in the tranquil gardens. Serene monks in bright orange robes drift around the hallowed grounds, never moving faster than they need to. This temple is a welcome oasis amid the urban sprawl of the city beyond its plastered walls, a refuge from the stress of modern life.

一名吟游诗人披着绚丽多彩的衣裳，坐在热闹的街角，指尖拨弄着乐器，奏出一支甜美的旋律。来往行人心生赞赏，纷纷将钱币投进诗人脚边那顶倒扣的帽子里。其间一位施主再度经过，竟未认出这位演奏者，只是随手又丢下一枚钱币。吟游诗人目送着他远去，唇角扬起一抹含蓄的微笑，手上却不停歇，依旧奏着那令人沉醉的迷人曲调。
A bard draped in colorful clothing sits on a busy street corner, playing a sweet tune on their instrument. Appreciative passersby drop coins in the upturned hat at the bard’s feet. One such patron passes by again, regards the performer without recognition, and drops another coin in the hat. The bard follows them with their eyes and a subtle smile, still playing their enchanting tune.

Mountain Pass: Ogres Nearby.name:
山口险隘：食人魔出没
Mountain Pass: Ogres Nearby

Text.text:
风从你的衣衫缝隙里钻入，寒意沿着脊背一路滑下。片刻之后，仿佛你的身体早已预感到一般，你听见远处战号低沉的咆哮。吹响那道阴郁音符的人必定肺活量惊人——即便算上回声，那号声仍拖得又长又响，久久不散。
The wind slips through your clothes and sends a chill down your spine. A moment later, as if your body somehow foresaw it, you hear the deep bellow of a distant war horn. Whoever blew that dark note was capable of a deep breath, for even accounting for an echo, it sang out long and loud.

I Press The Fourth Button On My Rod Of L.name:
我按下我的王者权杖上的第四个按钮（梯子）
I Press The Fourth Button On My Rod Of Lordly Might (Ladder)

Text.text:
当我按下第四个按钮时，长杖以不可思议的方式延伸，随心而长，恰好满足我的需求。两端弹出固定用的尖刺，杖身又伸出横杆，化作一架梯子。我把手搭在第一根横档上试了试，感受那令人安心的坚实触感，不由得露出微笑。
When I press the fourth button, the Rod extends impossibly, growing to meet my needs. Anchoring spikes pop out from each end and bars emerge from the haft to serve as a ladder. I place my hand on the first rung and test it, smiling as I feel the reassuring solidity.

Ring Of Fire Elemental Command.name:
火元素统御之戒
Ring Of Fire Elemental Command

Text.text:
这枚黄铜戒指的中央贯穿着一条深灰色金属纹脉，光线掠过时，纹脉中迸出点点红色火星般的闪辉。
This brass ring has a vein of dark gray metal running through its center, which glitters with red sparks as it catches the light.

Arrival To The Ethereal Plane.name:
抵达以太位面
Arrival To The Ethereal Plane

Text.text:
你几乎没有重量，悬浮在一种微微半透明的介质中，介于水栖与空中之间。若有位艺术家能用烟斗吐出的烟雾与橄榄油，把万物都复制一遍，再给多元宇宙狠狠来上一巴掌，把那份复制品从原件上拍得弹开、就这么让它漂在原地——哦，再把这份复制品变得透明——那位艺术家便创造了以太位面。
You are nearly weightless, hovering in a medium slightly translucent, between aquatic and airborne. If an artist could make a copy of everything out of pipe smoke and olive oil, then give the multiverse a smack hard enough to pop the copy off the original and just float it there—oh, and then turn the copy transparent—that artist would have created the ethereal plane.

篝火在夜色中如灯塔般熊熊燃烧，缕缕黑烟与飞舞的火星盘旋着直冲天穹。燃木噼啪作响的急促节拍充斥四周，吸引着那些渴望火焰温暖与光亮的人们聚拢而来。
The bonfire blazes like a beacon in the night, wisps of dark smoke and dancing embers swirling toward the heavens. The staccato crackle of burning wood fills the air, drawing in those who crave the warmth and light of a fire.

Babar The Cleric.name:
巴巴尔·牧师
Babar The Cleric

Text.text:
身披深绿长袍、额戴金色头箍的这名象人笨拙却戒备地立着。两根象牙平举，灰色长鼻高高扬起，他举起一面圆形金属盾，盾面铸成盛放莲花的模样。与之相对，他右手紧握一柄金色钉头锤，锤头像一朵含苞未放的莲。粉色花瓣不时从锤头簌簌飘落。他回头瞥了一眼，低声呢喃，令一只酷似迷你蓝莓灌木的生物从他腿侧探出头来。

~ 由 Nathan 扮演

Dressed in deep green robes and donning a gold circlet, this elephantfolk stands awkwardly at the ready. His two tusks leveled and gray trunk raised, he holds up a round metal shield fashioned to look like a blooming lotus. In contrast, he clutches a golden mace with a head like a closed lotus in his right hand. Pink flower petals sporadically drop from the weapon’s head. He glances behind him and whispers, causing a creature that resembles a tiny blueberry bush to peek around his leg.

~ Played by Nathan

I Cast Scrying Using A Focus Object.name:
我以一件焦点物体施放探知术
I Cast Scrying Using A Focus Object

Text.text:
我凝视着——穿透——我的焦点，缓缓沉入冥想的境地。心眼里骤然涌现出一片人潮：他们全都是影子。我尽可能轻柔地穿行于这群幽影之间。耳畔是他们的思绪，纠缠成一团低语；除非我刻意锁定某个人，否则全都毫无意义。我的魔法是一缕银线，在人群中穿梭编织，引我走向目标。那人的剪影被银线松松垮垮地披着，像一团拙劣缠绕的线轴。我将心念触及向他们的心念。
As I look into—and beyond—my focus, I descend into a meditative state. My mind’s eye floods with a crowd of people: all of them shadows. I press through this throng of shades as gently as possible. I hear their thoughts as a tangle of whispers, nonsensical unless I choose to focus on someone. My magic is a silver thread weaving through the crowd, guiding me to my mark. Their silhouette is draped loosely with the thread like a poorly wrapped spool. I reach my mind out to theirs.

I Cast Entangle.name:
我施放「纠缠术」
I Cast Entangle

Text.text:
潮湿泥土的气息灌满我的鼻腔，我与周遭植物的脉动相连，意念催动埋藏的根须与藤蔓自大地中爆裂而出，缠缚我的敌人。我高声呼唤古老的德鲁伊咒语来施展这道法术，并指向我的目标，释放自然的伟力。
The smell of damp soil fills my nostrils as I connect with the plants around me, willing the buried roots and vines to erupt from the earth and ensnare my foe. I call out the ancient druidic phrase to cast the spell, and point at my target, unleashing the power of nature.

Faerie-blooded Infant.name:
仙灵血脉的婴儿
Faerie-blooded Infant

Text.text:
一位母亲将婴儿揽在臂弯里，孩子裹在池水般湛蓝的毯子中。婴儿把脸从母亲鼠尾草绿长袍那令人安心的褶皱间转开，露出令人不安的面容：一双硕大的紫色眼睛直勾勾地、不眨一下地望向母亲的脸，扩张的瞳孔仿佛要把光都吞进去。头顶一撮绒发色泽与质地宛如玉米须，空气里飘起甜甜的、带着蔬青味的气息。孩子的眼睑仍被生生撑开，开始咿呀作声——从喉间溢出的不止是幼婴应有的轻柔咕哝与呜咽，还有吐沫四溅的猫般断续嘶嘶声，以及昆虫翅翼疾掠般的嗡鸣音色。
A mother cradles an infant in her arm, the babe wrapped in a pond-blue blanket. The child turns their face away from the comforting folds of their mother’s sage-green robe to reveal unsettling features. Large, purple eyes stare, unblinking, up at their mother’s face, and their dilated pupils seem to drink in the light. The tuft of hair on their head has the color and texture of corn silk, and a sweet, vegetal scent wafts in the air. The child, eyelids still pried open, begins to coo. The voice that emerges is not only made up of the delicate burbles and whimpers expected of a baby so young, but also the staccato hisses of spitting cats and the swift, buzzing timber of insect wings.

Military Spacecraft Hangar.name:
军用航天器机库
Military Spacecraft Hangar

Text.text:
全副武装的卫兵如同严苛的自动机般在这片区域巡逻，动作精确到每一秒。探照灯照亮的机库湾里塞满了火力强悍、种类繁多得令人咋舌的军用飞行器。有些骄傲地披着自家涂装，将团旗般的军团色彩大喇喇铺陈在机身上，几乎不屑于掩饰；另一些则刷上几何迷彩，专为高空隐去轮廓而生；还有的更进一步——你看见一阵粼粼微光掠过一处空荡的机位，随即显形出一架流线锋利的黑色飞行器，宛如完美的空中掠食者。
Armed guards patrol this area like rigorous automatons, their actions precise to the second. The floodlit bay is brimming with potent military craft of staggering variety. Some bear their livery proudly, displaying the regimental colors across their fuselage with little thought to subterfuge. Others have been painted with geometric camouflage, designed to obscure their silhouette at high altitudes. Some go further still. You watch a shimmer ripple across a large empty bay to reveal a sleek, black craft—the perfect aerial predator.

I Cast Disinformation.name:
我散布假情报
I Cast Disinformation

Text.text:
从网中拈起丝线，我织出一张谎言之网。指尖化作残影，倾注成股的伪造新闻、虚假流言与扭曲真相，直到现实随我心意而变形。失真信息乘着被污染的代码浪潮渗出，我看着自己的非现实在赛博空间里一圈圈荡开。虚拟人生轨迹战栗，幻象怒放。我是混沌的无形指挥，手中指挥棒却是一柄钝槌，逐字节敲打着存在的战场。

~ 一位英雄Envisioned

Plucking threads from the net, I weave a web of lies. My fingers blur, injecting streams of forged news, false rumors, and twisted truths until reality warps around my whim. Disinformation seeps out on a surge of corrupted code, and I watch my unreality ripple through cyberspace. Virtual lifepaths shudder, illusions bloom. I'm the unseen conductor of chaos, my baton a bludgeon that beats the battlefield of existence byte by byte.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

一名皮肤晒成古铜色的半精灵一边嚼着苹果，一边穿过镇子。衣服明显磨旧了，外套上还打着几块补丁，颜色格外扎眼。他们脸上带着一种幸福的无知——仿佛并不知道这世上潜伏着何等真正的恐怖——但他们懂得如何劈柴，而这点本事已足以让他们心满意足。
A tanned half-elf chews an apple as they walk through the township. Their clothes are visibly worn, with some patches on the coat being distinctly different colors. They have a look of blissful ignorance—of not knowing the true terrors that lurk in this world—but they know how to chop firewood, and that has served them well enough to be content.

暴民由卑微的镇民组成：一个握着锄头的农夫，一个拿着面包刀的面包师，一个攥着铁锤的铁匠。还有人举着伐木斧、铁锹、长柄镰。然而，他们将这些本用于创造的工具反作他用，挥舞成武器；人群在肾上腺素点燃的躁动中移动、涌动、不断变形。

~ Played by Justin M

The mob is made up of humble residents: a farmer with a hoe, a baker with a breadknife, a blacksmith with a hammer. Others hold lumber axes, shovels, scythes. Yet they wield these tools of creation in their opposite purpose, brandishing them as weapons as the crowd moves and shifts in adrenaline-fueled agitation.

~ Played by Justin M

这些词语温柔抚慰，在每一个音节里都蕴藏着几乎能治愈任何病痛的力量。你掌中的钻石尘粗砺而刺手，但当你将它抛向空中时，它便闪烁生辉；每一粒微不可见的碎屑都被奥术浸染。随着你完成咒文，一抹幽冷的蓝光自你身上流溢而出。
The words are soothing, and carry within their syllables the power to heal almost any malady. The diamond dust in your hand is rough, coarse, but it glimmers as you cast it into the air, each infintesimal fragment imbued with the arcane. A glow, blue and cool, emanates from you as you complete the incantation.

脑猎犬看上去活脱脱像一颗被放大到怪异尺寸的大脑，四条粗壮的带爪腿支撑着它，悄无声息地贴近它那念动力的吞噬者主人，迫不及待要替它们执行卑劣的差事。它既无眼，也无耳，更无鼻，却似乎毫不费力便能在周遭寻路游走。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Resembling nothing so much as an oversized brain with four thick, clawed legs, the brainhound sidles close to its psionic devourer masters, eager to do their heinous bidding. Though it has no eyes, nor ears, nor nose, it seems to find its way around with no appreciable difficulty.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Highland Games, Caber Toss.name:
高地运动会：掷木柱
Highland Games, Caber Toss

Text.text:
一根比房子还高的巨木横卧在赛场上。一个巨人般的女人走近，深吸几口气，随后把它推到竖直。她双手捧住木端，将抛杆抱起，贴着身躯稳稳抵住。她迈步前行——拼命稳住脚下与掌中的重量——继而小跑起来，被木杆的惯性拽着向前冲，最后用尽全身力气猛地一掷，让巨木翻转向前，另一端轰然触地。它缓缓地，几乎慢得令人窒息地立起，又坠落……向前。胜利。
A post taller than a house rests on the game field. A giant of a woman approaches it, takes a few deep breaths, then pushes it to a standing position. She cups the end in her hands and lifts the caber, balancing it against her body. She walks—struggling to keep her footing and her hold—breaks into a jog, pulled forward by the caber’s momentum, then heaves the post up as hard as she can so that it flips forward to land on its other end. Slowly, almost too slowly, it stands up then falls… forward. For the win.

Beautiful Copper Buckle.name:
精美的铜扣
Beautiful Copper Buckle

Text.text:
年代，以及缝隙间点缀的水绿铜锈，诉说着世代累积的财富。爪尖镶着一颗朴素而罕见的碧玺，框架一角下方那枚名匠印记则昭示其卓绝品质与令人咋舌的价值。
The age, and the touches of aqua green verdigris in the seams, speak of generational wealth. A simple and rare tourmaline adorns the tip of the prong, and a famed maker’s mark under one corner of the frame declares its superlative quality and shocking value.

Selkie Watch Gate.name:
塞尔基守望之门
Selkie Watch Gate

Text.text:
斯派尔威奇的西南城门通向一条乡间土路，沿着古德威克河并行延伸。门石上雕着半人形的生物：水獭般的尾巴与脚掌，姿态神情都透着顽皮的戏谑。  

“留神点儿，”一名守卫一边挥手示意一辆卡车穿门而过，一边说道，“要是看见了塞尔基却没夸它毛皮的光泽，可要倒大霉。”他冲副驾驶座上的男孩眨眨眼。男孩立刻转头望向车窗外的河面，眼睛睁得滚圆，急切地搜寻着。  

男孩的父亲叹了口气，礼貌地点头致意，随即驾车离去——而他的儿子已经开始连珠炮似的追问起塞尔基的事来。
The southwestern gate of Spirewych leads to a country road that runs parallel to the Good Wick river. Images of half-human creatures with otter-like tails and feet are carved into the gate's stones, their postures and expressions playful. “Keep an eye out,” says a guard as he waves a truck through the gate. “Bad luck if you see a selkie and don’t compliment the shine of its fur.” He winks at the boy in the passenger’s seat, who turns to look out his window at the river, wide eyes searching. His father sighs, and gives the guard a polite nod, before driving off—as his son begins to ask a stream of questions about selkies.

Vampire Lord Zombie.name:
吸血鬼领主丧尸（特征）
Vampire Lord Zombie

Text.text:
褴褛的破布与坏疽的腐肉紧紧裹住这具蹒跚行尸的躯壳。它一动，关节便摇摇欲坠、错位脱臼。凹陷的眼窝里泛着冰冷的幽光。它的脸缺了鼻子与嘴唇，只剩一张凝固在死亡里的狞笑。那尸骸之物拖着步子执拗前行，带着饥饿的意志伸出手指，长而参差的指甲探向早已失落的生命。
Clinging rags and gangrenous flesh wrap the frame of this shambling cadaver. Its movements reveal joints that dangle and dislocate. Cold light glows in its sunken eyes. Its face is missing its nose and lips, locked in a deathly grimace. The corpse thing trudges on with hungry purpose, fingers reaching with long, ragged nails for life long lost.

这间小酒吧被四面墙上屏幕投下的冷蓝光照得发寒。后巷酒馆里，客人们瘫在破旧剥落的皮椅里，对周遭肮脏的环境浑然不觉，插入接口便一头栽进网络深处，身影随之消失。每个人的意识都已被赛博空间彻底吞没。
The small bar is illuminated by the cold blue light of screens on every wall. Reclining in battered, flaking leather chairs, the patrons of the back-alley saloon seem oblivious to their grungy surroundings as they jack in and disappear into the net. Each one’s consciousness has been utterly consumed by cyberspace.

幼小的恐龙腿脚还不稳，踉踉跄跄地伸长脖子去够一根低垂的树枝，以及枝头那一簇簇汁水饱满的翠绿叶片。它那双又大又圆的眼睛之间，一道小小的冠脊格外醒目；斑驳的鳞片覆满它的爬行动物身躯。它发出一声惊惶的嘶鸣，脚下一滑便栽倒在地，喉间随即涌起低低的、带着奶气的呜咽。警觉的母亲小跑着赶来安抚，用轻柔的一顶把它扶起。
Teetering on unsteady legs, the young dinosaur reaches for a low-hanging branch and the juicy green leaves it holds. A small crest dominates the youngling’s face between its large, round eyes, and mottled scales cover its reptilian body. With a honk of alarm, the baby topples to the ground as it loses its footing, and a low, mewling cry begins to build in its throat. Its watchful mother lopes over to offer comfort and helps it up with a delicate nudge.

高架引水渠凌空横跨大地，石砌的渠身由一根根巍然耸立的巨柱托举。水流在渠槽里轻快潺潺，不时拍击溅出渠沿，滴落到下方的土地。引水渠将这份恩泽一路送往远方的田野。
The aqueduct soars over the landscape, a stone structure supported by towering pillars. Water trickles pleasantly down the channel, occasionally sloshing over the side and dripping to the ground below. The aqueduct carries its bounty to the fields in the distance.

Visually Discernable Artificial Planet.name:
视觉可辨的人工行星
Visually Discernable Artificial Planet

Text.text:
这颗行星哪怕从远处望去都显得不寻常。陆地与水域的分布过于几何、过于完美。这里的一切显然经过规划与优化，而当你准备降落时，这点更是无可置疑。各区域的过渡——从森林到草甸、从草甸到城市，乃至更多——都沿着笔直、修整得一丝不苟的界线进行。
The planet just looks unusual, even from a distance. The arrangement of land and water is too geometrical, too perfect. This planet was planned out and optimized, which is only made more obvious when preparing to land. Transitions—from forest to meadow, meadow to city, and more—are perfect, well-maintained straight lines.

Elf Noble Sorcerer.name:
精灵贵族术士
Elf Noble Sorcerer

Text.text:
黑发夹杂银丝，被轻轻拂开并掖在优雅尖长的耳后，勾勒出一张冷冽而傲慢的面容。她的皮草大衣是柔软的橙色，点缀着深褐色斑纹，却仿佛被阴影缠织其中。唯有她十指交扣的双手可见，方形切割的宝石点缀其上。她其余的身形似乎都消失在黑暗里。

~ Envisioned by jhwulfven

Black hair streaked with silver is swept aside and tucked behind gracefully pointed ears, framing a cold and condescending visage. Her fur coat, a soft orange with deep brown spots, seems somehow laced with shadow. Only her interlaced fingers adorned with square-cut stones are visible. The rest of her form seems to disappear into darkness.

~ Envisioned by jhwulfven

Nest Of Aberrant Rats.name:
畸变鼠巢
Nest Of Aberrant Rats

Text.text:
你在这座天花板低矮的洞窟里越走越深，空气中始终悬着巢居害兽的腥腐恶臭。你很快就找到了气味的源头：老鼠从你前方的路径上窜来窜去，往返于石壁上的洞口。它们的尾巴拖过昏黑的水洼与黏腻的污垢。它们察觉到你的存在时，有几只受惊一跳、匆匆加快脚步——却并没有如你预想般四散逃开。它们仍旧不断从你面前穿行，仿佛被困在永无止境的踱步操练里。直到其中一只停下脚步，抬头死死盯住你，你才看清：在它两只圆耳之间，有一小团大脑裸露在外，泛着风化铜绿般的幽光。那只老鼠吱叫一声，声音含混回荡——仿佛有两只老鼠同时在发声。其余害兽也都刷地停住，鼻尖抽动，眼神浑浊。等待着。领头老鼠的脑组织搏动一下、两下——随即鼠群齐齐转向你，在狭窄洞窟里挤成一团的痛苦与暴怒尖啸轰然炸响，刺耳成灾。

~ Gammarayz 构想

As you make your way deeper into this low-ceilinged cavern, the rank stench of nesting vermin hangs in the air. You see the source of the smell: rats scurry across the path in front of you, to and from holes in the stone. Their tails trail through the dark puddles and grime. As they sense your presence, some jump in surprise and hurry along their paths—but they do not scatter as you might expect. They continue passing in front of you, as if stuck in an endless pacing drill. It's not until one of the creatures stops and stares you down that you see it: a small brain, exposed between its two rounded ears and glowing the green of weathered copper. This rat squeaks, and its voice is garbled and echoing—as if two rats are vocalizing at the same time. The rest of the vermin skitter to a stop, noses twitching and eyes dull. Waiting. The brain of the commanding rat throbs once, twice—then the horde turns toward you, their pained, enraged cries cacophonous in the cramped cavern.

~ Envisioned by Gammarayz

Vampire's Manor: Balcony.name:
吸血鬼（特征）的庄园：阳台
Vampire's Manor: Balcony

Text.text:
阳台在你脚下发出吱呀呻吟，你一步踏上，松散的碎屑随之簌簌滑动。它俯瞰着庭院，如今一片灰败空寂，唯有那株虬曲如骸的枯树立在正中央。停栖在它攫握般枝桠上的乌鸦几乎带着人类般的疑忌打量着你。
The balcony creaks beneath your weight, debris shifting loose as you step on it. It overlooks the courtyard, now gray and empty save the gnarled, skeletal tree that stands at its heart. The crows perched upon its grasping branches eye you with almost human-like suspicion.

The Kemblehatt Kid.name:
肯布勒哈特小子
The Kemblehatt Kid

Text.text:
在尖巫剧院群其中一座剧院的后台入口处，你瞥见一名年轻学徒正伸长脖子，满眼热切地朝舞台深处张望，只为一睹新剧演员的身影。你看见三个粗野的地痞逼近他，来者不善。一个盯上少年袍上盘踞的巨龙纹章；另一个则死死盯着那根打磨得光可鉴人的长杖——杖头还镶着黄金。少年察觉到异样，深吸一口气，低声咕哝着什么，手在背后悄然比划，掌心捏着一枚铜币。还是铜币？此刻它却像忽然泛起金色光泽。
At the stage entrance behind one of the Spirewych theaters, you spot a young student staring eagerly down the stage for a sight of one of the cast members of the latest play. You watch as three roughnecks approach him, obviously looking to make trouble. One eyes the boy’s dragon-emblazoned school robe. Another stares at the beautifully polished staff capped in gold. The youth notices and takes a deep breath, muttering under his breath and gesturing behind his back, copper coin in hand. Or is it copper? It looks rather gold now.

Loot From A Zombie Ogre.name:
丧尸食人魔的战利品
Loot From A Zombie Ogre

Text.text:
在这只臃肿的丧尸（特征）食人魔那条磨损开裂的腰带旁，你找到一只钱袋，里面装着10枚金币。钱袋用斑驳的蓝色皮革制成，这种材质你从未见过——它究竟来自何处？
Around the fraying belt of the bloated zombie ogre, you find a coin purse with 10 gold pieces inside. The mottled blue leather of the pouch is not a material you have seen before—where could it have come from?

当你走近那具令人作呕、蜷缩成一团的爬行者尸体时，你不由得注意到伙伴们脸上的神色。你也承认，自己几乎要从它的腹部退开——那些细如毛发的小腿，像车轮辐条般簇在一起，构成了一幅说不清缘由却令人极度反胃的景象。可最终，你还是举起了那只装着新鲜爬行者黏液的瓶子——它是从怪物的呼吸囊里放出来的。这样的东西再恶心不过，却是一等一的毒药，既能在危急时刻救你一命，也能卖出个好价格。
You could not help but notice the looks on your companions’ faces of as you approached the loathsome, curled-up corpse of the crawler, and you admit to yourself that you nearly shied away from its belly as the tiny, hairlike legs—gathered like spokes of a wheel—made for an inexplicably grotesque sight. Still, at the end you hold up the flask of fresh crawler mucus, drained from the breathing sacs of the monster. For this substance, disgusting though it is, makes a first-class poison, and could get you out of a jam—or sell for a good price.

Forest Birds: Flocking.name:
森林鸟群：结队飞行
Forest Birds: Flocking

Text.text:
翻涌尖啸的鸟群如同一头骇人的无定形巨兽般移动。由成千上万漆黑身影汇成的巨爪上一刻猛然探出，下一刻便倏然蒸散。你在这庞大的鸟潮中感受不到任何心智或躯体的存在，然而其中依旧有着一种意志。每一只鸟或许只是追随同伴，但它们合在一起，却不知何故能如同一个整体般行动。
The shifting, screaming mass of birds moves as a monstrous amorphous beast. A huge claw of thousands of dark bodies reaches forth one moment, only to evaporate in the next. You don’t sense any mind or body in the massive flock, but there nevertheless exists a will. Each bird might only be following its fellows, but together they somehow act as one.

毛皮衬里的丝绸以黄金与白金镶边，垂落在这位贵族雕像般的身姿上；他微微上扬的下巴、倨傲的目光，以及戴满戒指的指节，无不昭示着他身居高位、出身王族。金色头箍点缀着他的额头，修剪得一丝不苟的胡须衬得本就锋利的下颌更显凌厉，而那微微隆起的小腹则暗示着他享用丰盛餐食的频率之高。
Fur-lined silks trimmed with gold and platinum drape the statuesque form of this noble, whose upturned chin, haughty gaze, and ring-laden knuckles mark him as a man of rank and royalty. A golden circlet adorns his forehead, and a perfectly manicured beard accentuates an already sharp jaw, while his slight gut hints at the frequency with which he enjoys ample meals.

Flooded Cavern: Beautiful.name:
被水淹没的洞窟：美丽
Flooded Cavern: Beautiful

Text.text:
一座寂静的石之大教堂以拱顶覆罩着一片澄澈而冰冷的水域；它的沉默与清冽的凝止，只偶尔被粗壮钟乳垂落的滴水声打破——每一根都自成奇景。远处传来一声轻微的溅水，你不由得想到有鱼从池中跃起。俯身窥向深处，你看见细小的影子来回穿梭——成群的鱼苍白得几近透明。
A cathedral of quiet stone arcs over an expanse of clear, cold water, its silence and cool stillness interrupted only by the occasional drip from fat stalactites, each a unique wonder of its own. You hear a small splash somewhere in the distance and think of a fish leaping out of a pond. Peering into the depths you see tiny shapes flit about—schools of fish so pale as to be nearly transparent.

Quip By A Selfish Adventurer About Backs.name:
一个自私的冒险者对自己身世的俏皮话
Quip By A Selfish Adventurer About Backstory

Text.text:
“哦，拜托，别拿你是怎么来到这儿的细节来烦我。我敢肯定那一定很悲惨——比如你的父母被种族主义的地精掳走之类——但说实话，我来这儿不是为了听别人的故事。只是为了让自己的故事更丰厚。”
