“Oh, please, spare me the details of what brought you here. I’m sure it was tragic—your parents being carried off by racist goblins or whatever—but truthfully, I didn’t come here to listen to other people’s stories. Only to enrich my own.”

Kursik Uldin Teinithra.name:
库尔西克·乌尔丁·泰尼丝拉
Kursik Uldin Teinithra

Text.text:
这名骑乘战士的一切都在诉说他一生的武艺修行与技能。从高贵的狮鹫背上，他以战术家的精明目光俯瞰战场，迅速找出敌军阵形的薄弱之处。太阳的光芒在他胸甲上那枚新月饰纹上闪烁，他转身与自己信赖的半精灵侍从交谈，手中那柄修长华丽的长柄战斧微微抬起，斧身流淌着奥术符文的幽光。他的五官如同手中利刃般锋利，晒成古铜的脸颊一侧刻着荣耀的印记——也同样横陈着数道醒目的伤疤。

~ Played by Jij

Everything about the mounted warrior speaks to his life of martial discipline and skill. From atop his noble griffon, he watches the battlefield with a tactician’s shrewd eye, identifying weaknesses in the enemy formations. The sun glints off the crescent moon decorating his breastplate as he turns to speak with his trusted half-elf retainer, gesturing with a long, ornate poleaxe aglow with arcane runes. His features are as sharp as the blade he wields, and marks of honor line one side of his tanned face—along with several prominent scars.

~ Played by Jij

Fineian Wildheart.name:
菲尼安·狂野之心
Fineian Wildheart

Text.text:
半身人的昂扬步态昭示着这人自信十足，也显然早已习惯了摇晃不定的海面。尽管是个硬朗的水手，他却衣着考究，举手投足尽是富商的派头。他那件深红皮马甲与丝绸衬衫、宽檐大帽相得益彰；帽顶插着一根奶油粉相间的羽毛，像宝石般熠熠生辉。他随意将一只手搭在腰间细剑的剑柄上，感官对周遭任何风险都保持着敏锐。淡淡的伤疤自下颌线一路延至左眼，而当他绽开明亮又随和的笑容时，那道旧伤便在眼角化作细纹。

~ Played by Ron Adkins

The halfling's swagger denotes a man with confidence, as well as one accustomed to the swaying seas. Despite being a hardy sailor, he’s sharply dressed and has all the makings of a wealthy merchant. His crimson leather vest pairs well with his silken shirt and large hat, atop which sits a cream-and-pink feather that glistens like a jewel. He rests one arm casually on the hilt of the rapier at his hip, senses keen to any risks nearby. A light scar runs from jawline to his left eye, and the old wound diminishes into crinkles whenever he flashes his bright, easy smile.

~ Played by Ron Adkins

Hearth With Sleeping Dogs.name:
睡犬环炉
Hearth With Sleeping Dogs

Text.text:
壁炉前的地毯上每一寸都被狗铺满，几条尾巴从纠缠的毛团与结块里伸出来。它们的脑袋缩进一座座圆润的毛丘中。时不时传来一声哈欠、一阵鼾响，或一个响屁；而当其中一只扭动着找个更舒服的姿势时，所有狗都会跟着一起挪。随后这一团又重新安静下来，紧紧依偎着再次筑起温暖的巢。
Every inch of the rug before the hearth is covered in dog, with several tails sticking out of twists and clumps. Their heads are tucked into the rounded mounds of fur. Now and then there is a yawn, a snore, or a fart, and when one wiggles into a better position, they all do. Then the cluster of them settles down and nests together again.

Games Room Of A Manor.name:
庄园的游戏室
Games Room Of A Manor

Text.text:
一张巨大的橡木桌占据了房间中央，桌面内凹。桌面铺着磨旧的皮革，染成深栗红，最适合掷骰与推牌。桌角各有凹槽可放饮品，每把高背椅的扶手上也都嵌着同样的杯槽。靠墙的一侧是吧台，陈列着各式烈酒。桌子正中央，一对六面骨骰静静休息，等待被掷出。
A large, oaken table with a recessed surface dominates the center of the room. The table's surface is a worn leather dyed a deep maroon, ideal for rolling dice and sliding cards. Recesses ideal for drinks adorn each corner of the table, and in the arms of each high-backed chair. A bar along one wall features a variety of liqours. At the center of the table, a pair of six-sided bone dice rest, waiting to be rolled.

Fake Javelin Of Lightning.name:
赝品雷霆标枪
Fake Javelin Of Lightning

Text.text:
这柄强悍的标枪——两端尖锐参差，宛如风暴神降下的惩戒雷霆——在你掌中嗡鸣震颤，仿佛迫不及待要被掷出。你念出指令词，想将这件武器化作一枚闪耀的、裹挟天光的大气辉光飞弹……却只觉一阵静电刺痛。标枪依旧是标枪，而且还是一柄相当普通的那种。
This mighty javelin—with fiercely jagged ends like the smiting bolt of a storm god—hums in your grip, as though eager to be loosed. You utter the word of command to transform the weapon into a scintillating missile of atmospheric radiance… and feel the sting of a static shock. The javelin remains a javelin, and a rather ordinary one at that.

这位和善的法师在一切意义上都是一盏明灯，周身散发的温暖与光辉如同引路的灯塔。蓬松的卷发从宽檐草帽下丰沛地倾泻而出，落在始终松弛的肩头。他们的肌肤带着阳光亲吻过的光泽，点点雀斑如星座般铺陈，描绘出那份近乎天赐的温柔性情。

~ 由 David 在 Discord 上构想

A luminary in every sense, the kindly wizard radiates warmth and light like a guiding beacon. Curly hair tumbles bountifully from beneath a wide-brimmed straw-hat and lands upon perpetually relaxed shoulders. Their skin bears a certain sun-kissed glow, and constellations of freckles chart the course of their heavenly disposition.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Tasha's Caustic Brew.name:
塔莎的蚀酸酿汁
Tasha's Caustic Brew

Text.text:
你的胃猛地一翻，你弯下腰，先因痛苦呻吟，继而低声吟诵咒语。魔法在你体内奔涌，带来一阵狂暴的干呕。胆汁沿着喉咙渗上来，你的祈唤变得嘶哑粗粝；正当你确信这道法术会把你灼成虚无之际，你猛然挺直身子，呕出一波酸液。
Your stomach flips as you double over, moaning first in pain then in incantation. There is a violent heaving as the magic courses through you. Your invocation roughens as bile seeps up your throat; and just as you are sure the spell will burn you to nothing, you straighten and vomit forth a wave of acid.

I Cast Mind Blank.name:
我施放“心灵屏障”
I Cast Mind Blank

Text.text:
白噪的嗡鸣在我耳畔回响，我的双手被一层诡异的灰色薄雾所笼罩。我将一只手轻轻覆在我的目标身上，随即听见宛如玻璃碎裂的清响。看着他们的面容沉入安然的恬静之中，我知道我的工作已然完成。
White noise buzzes in my ears and my hands become cloaked in a strange, gray mist. I place one hand lightly upon my target and I hear a sound like glass shattering. As I watch their face fall into a blissful repose, I know my work is done.

Dungeon: Large Room With Pillars.name:
地城：立柱林立的大房间
Dungeon: Large Room With Pillars

Text.text:
这间房的天花板高耸在你头顶，比你迄今在地城里穿行过的任何房间都要高。成排的柱子装点着这片宽阔的大厅，奢华的建筑陈设如同一场炫耀，却依旧壮丽得令人屏息。脚步声在厅中怪异地回荡，每一次都以不同的方式撞上柱身，回音层层叠叠，久久不散。
The room's ceiling towers above you, higher than any other room traversed so far in the dungeon. Rows of pillars adorn the expansive hall, a showcase of extravagant architecture that remains a majestic sight to behold. Footfalls echo oddly through the chamber, each resounding off the columns in a new way.

Grinning Bandit.name:
咧嘴坏笑的强盗
Grinning Bandit

Text.text:
强盗咧开一抹阴毒的笑，露出几颗黑黄残缺的断牙。无论是出于选择还是形势所迫，此人早已堕落成掠食者，谋杀与劫掠就是他们的看家本领。他手中那把满是缺口的弯刀，早已尝过信任者、疏忽者、无助者与倒霉鬼的鲜血——而若厄运降临，它也会尝到你的。
The bandit flashes an evil grin, revealing several black and broken teeth. Whether by choice or circumstance, this person has devolved into a predator for whom murder and theft are their stock-in-trade. The notched scimitar in their grip has tasted the blood of the trusting, the unwary, the helpless, and the unlucky—and if misfortune should strike, it will taste yours as well.

The Sanctuary: Caves.name:
圣所：洞窟
The Sanctuary: Caves

Text.text:
一对石质小丘从干旱的沙海中突兀隆起，与这片沙漠景致格格不入。你走近最近的一座，发现一个狭小的洞口。那拱形轮廓过于匀称，怎么看都不像天然形成。洞内，洞穴地面迅速向下倾斜，没入黑暗之中。里面涌出一股浓重的霉腐气味，耳畔还隐约传来水声的回响。
A pair of stone hillocks rise from the arid sand, out of place in the desert landscape. As you approach the nearest one, you see a small cave entrance. Its arched appearance seems too uniform to be natural. Inside, the cavern floor quickly descends into darkness. A strong musty smell comes from within, and the faint echo of water reaches your ears.

I Lockpick A Locked Chest.name:
我撬开一只上锁的箱子
I Lockpick A Locked Chest

Text.text:
这是钥匙孔机关——一切实用锁具里最容易的一种。一个皮革小匣收着我的细钩与耙针，也装着我的扭力扳手。我把它摊开，平平整整，像旅店老板摆好一张桌面。耳朵微侧贴近锁身，指尖夹着的微型“魔杖”正各司其职。金属轻轻一滑，机关深处传来一声咔哒。锁芯转动，直到门闩回缩，而箱盖与箱体之间那道细线，便令人愉悦地渐渐张开。

~ 一位英雄构想

It is a keyhole mechanism—the easiest of any practical lock. A leather case holds my little hooks and rakes, as well as my tension wrenches. I open it flat, like an innkeeper setting a table. My ear is tipped toward the lock, with the miniature wands between my fingertips doing their work. There is a slip of metal and a click from deep in the mechanism. The cylinder turns until the latch pulls back, and that fine line between the lid and the chest widens pleasingly.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Alter Self: Natural Weapons.name:
改变自身：天然武器
Alter Self: Natural Weapons

Text.text:
当重塑的骨头顶破皮肤时，痛楚随之窜起——你将体内的骨质储备淬炼成天生的武器，锋利如剃刃，致命无情。
There is some pain as reshaped bone pushes through your skin, forming natural weapons from your own body’s reserves, razor sharp and deadly.

Plea For Help From A Cursed Town.name:
来自诅咒之镇的求救呼号
Plea For Help From A Cursed Town

Text.text:
“我们阻止不了这里正在发生的一切。无论我们用多少圣徽将自己团团围住，只要灯火一灭，它就在那里。它就在我们所有人身边，在黑暗里低声耳语。我不知道我们做了什么才招来这种惩罚，但求你了，你们一定要帮帮我们。我们能承受的也就这么多，再这样下去，总会有人开始去听它到底在说什么。”
“We can’t stop what’s happening here. No matter what holy symbols we surround ourselves with, when the lights are extinguished, it is there. It is there for all of us, whispering in the dark. I don’t know what we did to deserve this, but please, you must help us. We can only take so much before some of us start to listen to what it has to say.”

即使以精灵的标准衡量，他也古老得惊人。法师那一头又长又乱的头发与未经梳理的胡须同样灰白纠结，正好映衬他那身磨损、打着补丁的礼袍。然而当他小心翼翼翻阅古老典籍、搜寻隐秘的知识时，即便指尖留着灼痕，双手依旧纤细灵巧。他一边阅读一边对自己嘟囔——听起来仿佛正在与人对话——偶尔因一时兴起而放声咯咯大笑。

~ 由 Shackleford 扮演

He is ancient even by elvish standards. The wizard’s long, unkempt hair and uncombed beard are both gray and matted, a perfect match for his worn and patched dress robes. Yet his hands are still delicate and dexterous regardless of the burn marks on his fingertips as he leafs carefully through the pages of ancient tomes in search of hidden knowledge. As he reads, he mumbles to himself—sounding like he’s in a conversation—occasionally cackling loudly in a moment of amusement.

~ Played by Shackleford

Insult About Cold Words.name:
关于冷言冷语的辱骂
Insult About Cold Words

Text.text:
“你的话冷得毫无温度，我都惊讶你说出口时牙齿竟然没被冻得碎裂。”
“Your words are so bereft of warmth, I’m surprised your teeth don’t shatter from uttering them.”

这座要塞虽已古老，却仍旧坚固如初。岁月既未夺走它那令人望而生畏的城墙，也未削弱它在防御上的可怕价值。苔藓在石砌之间零星滋生，给墙面添了几分湿滑，但真正开裂的地方寥寥无几。就连木材也依然结实，干燥无腐。某个早已覆灭的贵族家族的旗帜仍悬挂在墙上，色彩褪尽、边缘略显破损，却依旧能辨认出其纹章。
The keep is aged, but structurally sound. The years have not robbed this place of its forbidding walls, nor have they lessened its formidable value in defense. Though moss grows here and there, adding a slippery feel to the stonework, very few surfaces have actually cracked. Even the wood has remained sound, dry and without rot. The banners of a long-defunct noble house still hang upon the walls, faded in color and somewhat frayed, but still discernible.

战士深吸一口气，让思绪沉入专注，聆听并捕捉周遭世界。尽管他们的世界一片黑暗，却在脑海中凭借其他感官勾勒出战场的地图而鲜活起来。严苛训练与淬炼本能在战斗中交织，武者在出手时感知敌人的每一次挪动——并以同样致命的效率回敬。摆脱视觉分心的束缚，战士在混战中如舞者般穿梭，他们的武器不过是那被放大到极致的意识之延伸。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The fighter takes in a deep, focusing breath and tunes into the world around them. Though their world is dark, it comes alive as their mind forms a map of the battlefield using their other senses. Rigorous training and honed instincts combine as the warrior fights, sensing the movements of their foes as they strike—and responding in kind with deadly efficacy. Unburdened by the distraction of sight, the fighter dances through the melee, their weapon merely an extension of their heightened consciousness.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

干燥的风掠过一望无际的农田——小麦、玉米，以及数不清的作物在田垄间翻涌。田野中央立着一道人影，孤零零地支在一根木梁上。它的手脚在风里扑簌摆动，脸是一张拙劣而骇人的仿生面具，空洞地凝望前方。那双空眼明明毫无生气，却仿佛仍能“看见”你，一阵寒意顺着脊背爬升。右侧有什么东西一闪而动——可那里什么也没有。你把视线收回稻草人，血液却瞬间冰冷——它已不再挂在木梁上。
A dry wind blows across the sprawling farm fields—wheat, corn, and countless other crops. A lone, solitary figure stands within, propped atop a wooden timber. Its arms and legs flutter in the breeze, and its face, a macabre facsimile of life, stares vacantly ahead. The hollow eyes, despite their lifelessness, seem to perceive you, and a shudder runs up your spine. Something moves to your right—but there's nothing. As you return your gaze to the scarecrow, your blood runs cold—it no longer hangs from the timber.

Ethical Paleontologist.name:
伦理古生物学家
Ethical Paleontologist

Text.text:
古生物学家几乎以宗教般的虔敬，小心翼翼地用沉稳而不容动摇的双手，将泥土从出土的骨骼上轻轻刷去。化石采集者身着卡其色工装裤，布料上沾满沙漠赭黄的尘粉，头戴一顶宽檐遮阳帽。随着他们的动作，每一份样本都被掘出、编目，并以一丝不苟的谨慎妥善封存。
With almost religious reverence, the paleontologist carefully brushes the earth away from the excavated bones with steady and implacable hands. The fossilist is clad in khaki overalls stained with the ochre dust of the desert and wears a wide-brimmed sun hat. As they work, each sample is exhumed, catalogued, and stored with meticulous care.

Sundries From A High Elf Warlord.name:
高等精灵军阀的杂货
Sundries From A High Elf Warlord

Text.text:
在军阀的尸体上，你找到两份用叶片包裹的精灵食物，每份都足够抵作野蛮人一周的口粮；此外还有几缕被撕碎的丝绸条带，也许手艺高明的裁缝还能将其修补。
On the warlord’s corpse, you find two pieces of elvish food in leaf wrappers, each good for a week of barbarian’s rations, along with a few shredded lengths of silk that a tailor might be able to repair.

City Under Siege.name:
围城之都
City Under Siege

Text.text:
城里的街道异样寂静，冷清得反常。行人寥寥无几，更多人选择紧闭门户，躲在屋里苦等风暴过去。许多建筑已成断壁残垣——其中几处仍在冒烟，残火未熄，那是昨夜袭击留下的余烬。可城墙却是另一番景象——成百上千的人手持长矛与长弓登上垛口，守在城垣之上，屏息以待敌人的下一步动作。城墙之外，敌军结阵聚拢，阳光在他们的刀刃与护甲上跳动，冷光刺目。攻城器械吱呀作响，工兵小队忙着装填那一台台毁灭性的机械。战马不安地嘶鸣、刨地躁动，仿佛也嗅到了即将到来的冲击。
The streets of the city are oddly silent, strangely deserted. Few come and go, most opting to stay inside, wait it out. Many buildings lie in ruin—a few still smolder from the previous night's assault. The walls are a different story—hundreds, armed with spears and longbows, take to the ramparts, awaiting the enemy's next move. Beyond the walls, the enemy masses, the sun glinting off the steel of their blades and armor. Siege engines creak as teams load the destructive machinery. Horses whinny and stir restlessly, sensing the coming assault.

Loot From An Ogre.name:
食人魔的战利品
Loot From An Ogre

Text.text:
在血淋淋的骨堆间——那是食人魔过往餐食的残骸——你发现了几堆被丢弃的杂物：一堆是衣物与护甲胡乱搅在一起，另一堆则是金属物件垒成的小丘。所谓“整理”，看起来不过是食人魔饱餐之后拿来消遣的小游戏。你翻开那堆金属，摸到几把钱币，甚至还有几件首饰——当然，全都沾满了内脏与污秽。好好洗一洗之后，你将收获一大笔宝藏。
Amid the bloodied bones—remnants of the ogre’s past meals—you find piles of discarded items: clothing and armor muddled together in one pile, and a mound of metallic objects in the other. The organization appears to have been no more than a simple game for the ogre to play after its meal. Digging through the metal pile, you find a couple handfuls of coins and even jewelry pieces—all besmirched with viscera, of course. After a good wash, you’ll be left with a good deal of treasure.

一团紫色真菌以冰川般缓慢的速度黏糊糊地蠕动向前。它起伏着稠腻的孢子，向空气中喷吐出品红色的气体。淡紫的表皮之下，电光闪烁，标记着能量在神经网络间的传递。空气里弥漫着苦涩的铁腥味，菌落在彼此间交流，将信息素与菌质搅拌成一体。
A purple mass of fungus slops forth at glacial speeds. It undulates its gloopy spores, puffing magenta-hued gas into the air. Beneath the lilac skin, flashes of lightning mark the transfer of energy through neuron networks. A scent of bitter iron fills the air as the colony communicates between itself, mixing pheromones with fungal matter.

Archer Firing With Malice.name:
怀着恶意的弓手射击
Archer Firing With Malice

Text.text:
一名弓箭手蓄势待发，箭已搭在弓弦上。他留着络腮胡与八字胡，头发剪得短而粗硬。乍看像是穿着猎人的装束，可他脸上的神情却暗示：除非他憎恨猎物，否则他从不狩猎。此刻，他正面对这样的猎物；他眯起一只眼，松弦放箭，直指自己的目标。
An archer stands ready, arrow nocked on his bow. He wears a beard and mustache and a short rough haircut. Although he could be wearing huntsman’s clothes, the look on his face implies that unless he hates his prey, he does not hunt. He faces such prey now; he shuts an eye and looses the arrow toward his quarry.

油腻的黑烟从女人的口与眼中汩汩涌出，她的脸在刺骨的尖啸中溶解成一场噩梦的漩涡。转瞬之间，她的身躯退化为翻卷的阴影龙卷，四肢解开、蜿蜒成攫抓的触须——她终于显露真形：一缚一虐的灵魂，向虚空发出凄厉的哀号。

~ 构想：Tuts

Oily black smoke pours from the woman’s mouth and eyes as her face dissolves into a maelstrom of nightmares with a bone-chilling screech. In seconds, her body has degenerated into a swirling tornado of shadows as limbs uncoil into grasping tendrils, and she reveals her true form: a bound and tortured soul wailing into the void.

~ Envisioned by Tuts

一截暗色金属管从吹箭筒尖端那枚小巧、抛光的骷髅张开的口中突兀伸出，仿佛骷髅正咯咯怪笑着，啐出死亡。仿若从死神亲自的军械库中夺来，这件武器通体布满阴森骇人的细节，宛如一根冷峻的送葬之杖。
A dark metal barrel juts from the open mouth of a small, polished skull at the blowgun’s tip, like the skeleton is cackling as it spits death. As if plucked from the reaper’s own armory, the weapon is replete with macabre details along its length like a grim funeral rod.

矮人铁匠在熔炉腹地里如同一座令人望而生畏的巨块，敦实的身躯尽是筋肉。布满老茧的双手在咆哮的火焰上不知疲倦地忙碌，锻出华美的兵刃与锁甲。他的技能声名远播，铁锤与金属相击的铿锵之歌，吟唱着他对这门手艺毫无保留的奉献。
The dwarven blacksmith is a daunting mass in the belly of the forge, his thickset frame all brawn. With calloused hands, he works tirelessly over the roaring flames, forging splendid weapons and mail. His skill is renowned, the song of hammer against metal singing of his utter dedication to the craft.

Approach To Astral Dock In Winter.name:
冬日驶近星界船坞
Approach To Astral Dock In Winter

Text.text:
越过那道崩塌的屏障墙，几根金属立柱列队而立，高矮不一，霜寒阴沉地攀附在它们黄铜色的金属躯干上。来自寒冷而不算遥远的天幕帘幕的黯淡蓝光，抹去了这些壮观金属构造物任何可能的光泽。穿过墙体，离开那层清脆咯吱的雪毯，你的脚下立刻变得不稳。尽管通道上无雪——露出繁复的几何纹样——但光滑的地面会在你穿行其上时露出致命的险意。
Beyond the crumbling barrier wall a squadron of metal pillars stand, varying in height, with frost clinging grimly to their brassy metal bodies. A dull blue light, from the cold and not-so-distant celestial curtain, nullifies any chance these impressive metal structures might have to gleam. Stepping through the wall, off the blanket of crisp and crunching snow, you find uneasy footing. Though the pathway is clear of snow—revealing an intricate geometric design—the slick ground will prove treacherous as you make your way across it.

精钢经巧匠锻造，化作一段约一尺长、环环相扣浑然无缝的链节，焊接在一对银质端帽上。端帽衔接着两根乌亮漆面的短棍，材质为致密的柚木。其工艺之精，昭示着匠人与武者对战争之艺同样的执着与虔诚。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Steel forged expertly into a chain of seamless links about a foot long is welded to a couple of silver caps. The caps connect two glossy lacquered batons of dense teak. The craftsmanship indicates a dedication to the art of war in both maker and warrior.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Temple During Spring Bloom.name:
春华绽放时的神殿
Temple During Spring Bloom

Text.text:
神殿安然坐落在花园深处，春装正盛，色彩奔涌如潮：紫色福禄考铺成地毯，金黄的凌霄花如缨络般垂挂在圣柱之上，果园里的果树则缀满纤细的白花，繁茂而清透。自然万物的圣洁感，与其环抱的神殿不相上下。春日花开，比任何染色丝绸更明艳，比任何熏香更甜润。
The temple sits nestled within gardens that are a riot of color in their spring vestments: purple phlox carpets the ground, yellow trumpet vines festoon sacred pillars, and delicate white blossoms flourish on fruit trees in the orchards. The natural world feels as holy as the temple it surrounds. The spring blooms are brighter than any dyed silk and sweeter than any incense.

Fletcher House In Winter.name:
冬日的弗莱彻宅邸
Fletcher House In Winter

Text.text:
这座两层宅邸里欢宴正酣，屋内那户活力四射的人家身着华服，节庆般的红、银、蓝交相辉映。众人的目光大多都被壁炉台上方的一件装饰牵住：一颗巨大的灰色雄鹿头颅，鹿角繁复而宽阔，枝杈纠缠、恣意蔓延，仿佛这头野兽从未褪过角。鹿吻周围的毛色白得像屋外的积雪，灰毛间又点缀着炭黑斑块。一位红发女子身着深红长裙，肩头披着一张同色兽皮。她温柔地抚摸着它，面颊潮红，红得与衣裙无异。
Revelry abounds in this two-story manse, the vivacious family within adorned in elegant clothes of festive reds, silvers, and blues. Much of their attention is centered on a decoration above the mantelpiece: a large gray stag’s head with complex, broad antlers, so chaotic and expansive it seems as if the animal had never shed them. The fur around the stag’s snout is white as the outside snow and the gray is dappled with charcoal patches. A red-haired woman in a dark red gown wears a similarly colored hide across her shoulders. She pets it lovingly, cheeks flushed as red as her garment.

God Of Machines.name:
机械之神
God Of Machines

Text.text:
在这由管道与传送装置的神经节般脉络间，在风箱与熔炉之间，在一座忙碌蜂巢般的齿轮与皮带中——它们贴着布满仪表与工具的巨大墙面咬合轰鸣——屹立着唯一且至高的心智，秩序机械位面的统治者；那是一个数学与机械臻于完美的国度。伴随祂的神圣仆从——秩序的构装体——祂施行自己公式化发明所铸就的律法，连最混沌的魔法也不得例外。祂的法则，正是物质自然那不可违逆的铁律。

~ 一位英雄 Envisioned

Here among the ganglia of pipes and conveyances, among the bellows and smelters, among a busy hive of gears and belts grinding against enormous walls pegged with gauges and tools, there stands the One and Supreme Mind, ruler of the mechanical Plane of Order, a realm of mathematical and mechanical perfection. With his divine servants, constructs of order, he enforces the laws of his formulaic invention, which apply to even the most chaotically magical. His are the inexorable laws of physical nature.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这生物修长而结实的躯体覆着乌黑如无月之夜的皮肤，黄色的蛇瞳里闪烁着捕食者般的残酷冷意。它像舞者般游走，每一步都精准、算计周全、目的明确，绕着你缓缓盘旋。修长的手指间探出尖锐而凶狠的利爪，带着迫不及待的期待收放伸展；它带着骗子般的微笑开口，以令人惊讶的文采对你娓娓道来。
The creature’s lithe, muscular body is covered in jet-black skin like a moonless night, and a predatory cruelty shines in its yellow serpentine eyes. The being moves like a dancer, each step precise, calculated and brimming with purpose as it circles you. Sharp, brutal claws extend from long fingers, flexing with anticipation as the creature addresses you with startlingly eloquent prose and a trickster’s smile.

I Have A Stroke Of Luck: Ability Check.name:
我鸿运当头：能力检定
I Have A Stroke Of Luck: Ability Check

Text.text:
我迟疑了片刻。这不是犹豫不决，也不是力有未逮，而是一段戏剧性的停顿。这种时机必须拿捏得恰到好处。随后，无论是凭借纯粹的技能还是好运垂青，我都行云流水地完成得无可挑剔。
I hesitate for a moment. It isn’t indecision or inability, but a dramatic pause. One must time these things just so. Then, whether by pure skill or good fortune, I execute flawlessly.

Korred In Cave.name:
洞穴中的科雷德
Korred In Cave

Text.text:
一小撮乌黑乱发贴着洞壁蹭着前行。你先听见一声带喘的嗅闻，随后是满足的咯咯轻笑。那生物猛地一弹，又旋身一转，露出一张砂砾般灰沉的脸，几乎被浓密的眉丛与长长的胡须吞没。他的分蹄在地面上敲出欢快的节拍，手掌一路拖过岩壁——仿佛在抚摸心爱骏马的颈项。他蹦跳着更深入洞窟，蹄声始终清脆如歌，将旋律一路带向黑暗深处。
A short stack of dark hair shuffles along the cave wall. You hear a wheezy sniff followed by a pleased chortle. The creature bounces, then twirls, revealing his gravel-gray face nearly overtaken by bushy brows and a long beard. His cloven feet tap a lively rhythm on the floor as he drags his hand along the wall—like petting the neck of a beloved horse. He skips deeper into the cavern, his hooves maintaining a clear melody all the way.

这枚实心玻璃球对普通人来说稍显过大，单手握持并不舒适，而且比它看上去更沉。球体光滑得令人屏息，形制完美对称，内部毫无气泡或其他瑕疵。你端详它的短短一瞬间，仿佛有一道阴影掠过，遮住了球内扭曲映出的外界景象。你将圆球从不同角度微微倾斜，试图重现那一幕，却怎么也做不到。怪了。
This sphere of solid glass proves a little too big for an average person to comfortably hold in one hand, and it is heavier than it appears. The glass ball is stunningly smooth, symmetrical, and utterly free of any air bubble or other imperfection. For a brief moment as you examine it, a shadow seems to obscure the warped image of the world beyond. You tilt the orb in various angles, trying to replicate the effect, but you cannot. Odd.

Home Of A God Of Elemental Fire.name:
元素火焰之神的居所
Home Of A God Of Elemental Fire

Text.text:
在永恒而无处不在的烈焰国度里，赤红的天空吞噬了大半空气。它将湿气蒸腾成雾，将下方大地灼烧、淬炼。此处，其他诸质皆为燃烧之元素役使，复生只为再度被吞噬。毁灭的中心，一根燃烧的巨柱直冲天穹——核心白炽，边缘幽蓝。其根基是一座由煤与木堆成的焦黑金字塔。其内，栖居着不死鸟与火蜥蜴之神，火焰与烟尘、狂怒与重生之主。
In the realm of eternal and omnipresent flame, the red sky swallows most of the air. It vaporizes moisture into steam, and scorches and tempers the earth below. Here, the other essences all serve the burning element, replenishing only to be consumed. At the center of destruction, a burning pillar shoots upward—white hot at the core, blue at the edges. Its base is a charred pyramid of coal and wood. Inside is the home of the god of phoenix and salamander, flame and smoke, rage and rebirth.

Loot From A Basilisk's Lair.name:
从蛇怪巢穴中搜刮的战利品
Loot From A Basilisk's Lair

Text.text:
尽管蛇发鸡蜥那毫无生气的庞大躯壳本身榨不出半点价值，你仍在它石化的猎物间瞥见一抹金属寒光。似乎其中一名受害者曾戴着一顶做工精湛的头盔，竟未被化作石头。
Though the lifeless bulk of the basilisk itself yields nothing of value, a glint of metal catches your eye among its petrified prey. It seems one of the victims wore a finely crafted helmet that was not transformed into stone.

Faith’s Grave In Winter.name:
冬日信仰之墓
Faith’s Grave In Winter

Text.text: 这口坟的墓盖在约莫胸口的高度凹陷出一块长方形的凹槽。你拂开积雪，露出刻在石上的字句：菲丝，曾是德里昂忠诚的持盾侍女。她安息之处，皆为圣土。 The lid on this grave has a rectangular depression at about chest height. You clear the snow to reveal the carved words: Faith, who served as Derion’s loyal shield-maiden. Wherever she rests is hallowed ground.

Temple To A God Of Righteousness.name:
正义之神的神殿
Temple To A God Of Righteousness

Text.text:
巍峨的巨柱自金色的爪足底座直上，触及并支援着绘满壁画的穹顶。壁画中，一条伟岸巨龙以吐息倾泻而下，将一群黑暗的乌合之众淹没；火焰如日光般灼亮。亚麻色的挂毯自墙面垂落，散发着浓烈的香料混合气息。其中一匹耀眼的锦布披在高台上的王座之上；那便是神殿的祭坛。侍从们——许多是龙裔——在鳞片与肌肤上点抹了闪烁的金粉。那些龙族血脉的侍者挂着格外凯旋而炽热的笑容。
Towering columns reach from a golden clawfoot base to support a muraled ceiling. The mural depicts a mighty dragon flooding a rabble of darkness with its breath, flames the color of sunbeams. Flaxen tapestries hang from the walls, scented with a powerful blend of spices. One gleaming cloth is draped across a throne sitting atop a dais; the temple’s altar. The attendants, many of them dragonborn, have flecked their scales and skin with glittering gold paint. These dragonkin sport especially triumphant, fervid smiles.

I Cast Cure Wounds From My Necklace Of P.name:
我从祈祷珠项链中施放《治疗伤口》
I Cast Cure Wounds From My Necklace Of Prayer Beads

Text.text:
这枚被赋能的小小玻璃雕饰，功效堪比医学的应用之道。它所储备的治疗之力，源自一位超越存在的神圣真言。当我亲眼见证受试者的躯体复原之后，我便感到这颗珠子在当天余下的时间里悄然滑入再生的流转。
This empowered little sculpture of glass works as well as the applied science of medicine. Its supply of healing uses the holy word of a transcendent being. After I witness the restoration of my subject’s body, I feel the bead slip into rejuvenation for the remainder of the day.

Norse Warriors Fighting.name:
诺斯战士激战
Norse Warriors Fighting

Text.text:
钢铁相击，怒吼如雷，两名北地战士在死亡的边缘起舞。长矛如蛇般迅疾而精准地刺出，划开持斧敌手的肩头。鲜血奔涌，殷红成流；受伤的战士举起战斧，猛然砸落向前，以牙还牙。
With a clash of steel and thunderous shouts, two Norse warriors dance with death. A spear strikes with swift precision like a snake, slicing the shoulder of its wielder’s foe. Blood flows, a crimson stream, as the wounded warrior’s axe rises and hammers forward to return the favor.

Cosmic Summoning With Fatal Results.name:
致命后果的宇宙召唤
Cosmic Summoning With Fatal Results

Text.text:
当你怀中被宰杀的牲畜之血勾勒出最后的线条时，空间本身仿佛开始弯折、碎裂。立体的裂缝如同受损的水晶般在你眼前绽开。你还未来得及反应，一道裂口便骤然成形，将你的身躯从腰间一分为二。你感到虚无的牵引，你的灵魂被从这片现实中硬生生撕扯出去，送回它来时的那片黑暗。
As the final lines are drawn in the blood of the slain animal in your arms, space itself seems to bend and fracture. Three-dimensional cracks, like in a damaged crystal, form before you. Before you can react, a crack forms, separating your body at the waist. You feel the pull from the void as your soul is ripped from this reality and returned to the blackness from whence it came.

这只磨旧的皮革袋看起来平平无奇——鼓鼓囊囊，内衬缝着一排排口袋，点缀着纽扣与搭扣，被里面的重物坠得下垂。你把手探进去，立刻察觉到一个浩瀚的空间，远比这袋子的体型所能容纳的更庞大。你的指尖抓住了什么——你迫切需要的那件物品，从异次元空间递送到你的掌心。

~ Requested by Cowboy Wade

The worn leather bag appears mundane—a bulging bag lined with pockets, buttons, and buckles, sagging with the weight of its contents. You reach inside, and sense an immense space, far larger than the size of the bag would suggest. Your hand grasps something—the item you desperately need, delivered to your hand from extra-dimensional space.

~ Requested by Cowboy Wade

Liam Oakcrusher.name:
利亚姆·橡木粉碎者
Liam Oakcrusher

Text.text:
你细看院子里那名“矮人”的训练，猛地一惊：这人根本不是矮人，而是个半身人——穿着矮人斧圣侍学徒的款式，一身蓝色训练服却偏宽松。更古怪的是，仿佛与他朴素的穿着风格相互矛盾，这个“矮人似的”半身人还披着一条亮黄色斗篷，多数人都会把它当作纠缠的危害；但也许其中自有门道，旁观者一时看不出来。他那一头修长飘逸的金发在疾挥猛刺间被甩得翻飞，长棍化作一片迅疾残影，连绵快击砸向木制训练假人——尽管假人的四肢缠着好几层粗麻布衬垫，撞击声仍然闷沉而响亮。

~ Played by Trevar Fracchiolla

Upon close inspection of the dwarf training in the yard, you realize with a start that this individual is not a dwarf at all, but a halfling clothed in the style of a dwarven axe-saint acolyte in a blue training uniform that is on the roomier side. Curiously, and in seeming contradiction to his simplistic style of dress, the dwarf-like halfling also wears a bright yellow cape most would consider a grappling hazard, but perhaps there is some method that escapes the casual bystander. His long, flowing blond hair whips around as he swings and thrusts his quarterstaff in a blur of quick blows, striking a wooden training dummy with loud impacts despite the multiple layers of burlap padding wrapped around its limbs.

~ Played by Trevar Fracchiolla

瀑布旁的河岸上裂开一个黑洞，像是在暗示里面通着一条隧道——又或许不过是大地里天然的空腔。几块狭长的岩石把那片幽暗的空间框成一道粗陋的门洞。洞口周围的冰呈更深的蓝色，仿佛有些黑暗从中渗出、被抽走似的。它让你想起通往冥界的门扉，但你立刻把这荒唐念头甩开。只是河岸上的一个洞而已。仅此而已。
A dark hole in the bank beside the falls hints at a tunnel, or perhaps just a natural hollow in the earth. Long rocks frame the shadowy space like a crude doorway. The ice around it is a deeper blue, as if some of its darkness has leached out. It makes you think of a doorway to the underworld, but you shake that silly notion from your head. It’s just a hole in the bank. That’s all it is.

乌黑的马尾向后束起，露出她机敏的脸——那是一张扑克脸，冷得让你不敢冒险去猜她的意图。吟游诗人那半精灵的皮肤上遍布明亮的水蓝色纹身。她身着黑、灰、褐相间的短袍与皮革护具——旅行者的装束，被打理得一丝不苟，正如她精心经营的讨价还价策略；此刻她在店主面前将这套手腕尽数摊开，为了货物寸寸压价。

~ 扮演：MasterLionsDen，使用

A black ponytail is pulled back from her clever face—a poker face, too cool for you to hazard a guess at her intent. All over the rest of the bard’s half-elven skin are bright aqua tattoos. She wears a tunic and leathers of black, gray, and brown—traveler’s clothes as carefully tended as her bargaining strategies, now on display with a shopkeeper as she haggles over goods.

~ Played by MasterLionsDen with

身影伫立在小巷的阴影里，低声说话。两人都披着兜帽斗篷，帽檐压得很低，身形微微佝偻，好把自己藏得更深，避开窥探的目光。其中一人从斗篷褶皱间抽出某样东西，以一记几乎难以察觉的移动递给了另一人。
The figures stand in the shadows of the alleyway, speaking in hushed tones. Both wear cloaks with hoods drawn, their postures hunched to further conceal themselves from prying eyes. One figure draws something from the folds of their cloak, passing it to the other with a flash of subtle movement.

I Throw My Ebony Fly Figurine Of Wondrou.name:
我掷出我的乌木苍蝇奇物雕像
I Throw My Ebony Fly Figurine Of Wondrous Power

Text.text:
我把小雕像一掷，黑灰色的尘雾便从中咕涌而出。它在空中飞掠时迅速膨胀，身后拖出一串悬浮的纸薄翅片与细小而歪曲的几丁碎壳。尘雾汇聚翻卷，凝成一只如马般巨大的苍蝇，双翼振起令人作呕、轰鸣刺耳的嗡响。它那红色、鼓胀的复眼由千百枚闪烁的晶亮小镜组成，沉沉压在卷曲的口器之上。口器末端伸出一条触须般的细端，带着好奇般探来，轻轻一戳，在我手臂上留下了一点湿痕。
A cloud of black and gray dust bubbles out of the figurine once I throw it. The cloud grows as it sails through the air, leaving a trail of hovering paper-thin wings and tiny crooked chitin in its wake. It collects and billows into the shape of a fly as big as a horse, its wings creating an abominably sonorous buzz. Its red, bulging eyes, made of a thousand glittering lenses, sit heavily over its curling proboscis. The tendril extends out toward me, a curious prod that leaves a wet spot on my arm.

Three City Guards.name:
三名城卫
Three City Guards

Text.text:
锁子甲叮当作响，三名卫兵穿行在城中街道，长剑在剑鞘里磕碰作声。他们佩着城邦的徽记，背脊挺直如铁，把律法沉沉扛在肩头。行过人群时，他们目光扫掠而过——认得的便点头致意，不认得的则投去冷厉而多疑的凝视。
Chain mail clatters as three guards move through the city streets, longswords rattling in their scabbards. They bear the sigil of the city, and with straight-backed rigidity, carry the law on their shoulders. They scan the crowd as they pass, offering nods to those they recognize and suspicious glares to those they don't.

暴雨鞭挞而下。它若无法以击打裸露的肌肤来刺痛你，便以毫不留情的狂怒重重砸落。仅仅冲过一条街就足以让你浑身湿透，而若站在这般倾盆之中，你几乎等同于在水里游泳。即便戴着宽檐帽或兜帽，也最好抬手护住双眼，挡开雨帘，才能看清前路。
The rain lashes down. Where it cannot sting by striking bare flesh, it pounds with unrelenting fury. Simply dashing across a street would get you soaked, but standing out in this downpour you might as well be swimming. Even with a wide-brimmed hat or hood, it pays to shield your eyes against the rain so you can see.

无论这条地下通道是由有智生物开凿而成，还是被远古熔岩洪流切割出形状——又在反复踩踏中磨成勉强可行的羊肠小径——都能一眼看出这里往来频繁。脚印、车辙、蹄痕，以及你辨不出的其他生物遗留的痕迹，纵横交错地从路面两侧向两端延伸。
Whether this underground road was constructed through the efforts of sentient beings or carved by an ancient lava flow—worn down to a passable footpath from repeated use—one can easily see it has heavy traffic. Footprints, wheel tracks, hoofprints, and the leavings of other creatures you cannot identify crisscross the road in both directions.

Short Travel Across The Elemental Plane.name:
穿越水元素位面的短途旅行
Short Travel Across The Elemental Plane Of Water

Text.text:
你踏上旅程时，心中没有把握将会遇见什么。你在海上旅行——四面八方仿佛无边无际——却屡屡撞见诡异的漂浮岛屿、晶莹的冰晶构造，甚至一座自海床升起的城市。你以所敢及的速度旅行；终于，你望见了目的地。
You embark on your journey unsure of what you might find. You travel across a sea—seemingly endless in all directions—but often find strange floating islands, crystalline ice structures, even a city emerging from the seafloor. You travel as quickly as you dare; finally, you see your destination.

Overheard Conversation About A Young Hal.name:
偷听到的关于一名年轻半兽人的谈话
Overheard Conversation About A Young Half-orc

Text.text:
“——我让我的半兽人儿子做他自己，结果邻居家的狗已经失踪两周了……这大概只是巧合吧？”
“—told my half-orc son to be himself and now the neighbor’s dog has been missing for two weeks . . .  It’s probably unrelated right?”

侏儒的动作诡异得不似常人，四肢运转几乎带着异界般的怪诞。他身披舒适垂坠的针织衣，颜色艳俗刺眼、彼此冲撞，忽然间一阵混乱爆发般踉跄扑倒，脸朝下砸在地上，手脚乱挥。可他落地才一眨眼——人群的惊呼还悬在空中——便一个腾跃翻身的筋斗弹起，满脸尴尬地咧嘴傻笑。人群随即爆出欢呼——却正好赶上一根横梁从上方坠下，轰然一声如雷霆掌掴，狠狠拍在他头骨上。
The gnome moves unnaturally, his limbs operating in an almost alien fashion. Garbed in comfortable, draping knits with garish, clashing colors, the gnome stumbles and falls flat on his face with a sudden flurry of chaos, limbs flailing. But just as quickly as he dropped—the crowd’s gasp still hanging in the air—he rises with a vaulting somersault, grinning sheepishly from ear to ear. The crowd breaks into cheers—just in time for a beam to drop from above, smashing him across the skull with a thunderous slap.

一只华丽的玻璃瓶里盛满了黏稠的乳白液体；哪怕瓶塞紧紧封住，四周仍萦绕着烈酒般浓重的气息，久久不散。瓶塞下方固定着某种涂抹器，而一张褪色变黄的标签上，以优美流畅的花体字写着早已淡去的文字。
A viscous, milky liquid fills the ornate glass bottle, and a lingering scent of potent alcohol surrounds it—despite the stopper being firmly in place. An applicator of some sort is affixed to the underside of the cork, and a discolored label bears faded text in beautiful flowing script.

I Break An Elemental Gem Of Yellow Diamo.name:
我捏碎一枚黄钻元素宝石：爆炸
I Break An Elemental Gem Of Yellow Diamond: Explosion

Text.text:
我捏碎宝石，召唤元素的刹那，大地轰然炸裂，泥土与碎石如暴雨般四散飞溅。那生物以砂石磨砺般刺耳的嗓音宣告降临，发出震耳欲聋的咆哮，静候我的指令。
The ground explodes in a shower of dirt and gravel as I break the gem and summon the elemental. With a voice like grating stone, the creature announces its arrival with a cacophonous bellow, awaiting my instruction.

Warning From A Grizzled Space Merchant A.name:
一位老练的空间商人对虚空疯狂的警告
Warning From A Grizzled Space Merchant About The Madness Of The Void

Text.text:
“虚空里有太多怪异。起初它看上去什么都没有——摸上去也什么都没有——可你在那儿漂得够久，就会开始听见它。空旷无垠的心跳，牵扯着你的思绪。它一开始很轻，可你在外头待得越久，它就越响。有东西在那片黑暗里守夜。它不想我们在那里。”
“There’s a lot of strangeness out in the void. It looks like nothing—feels like nothing at first—but you drift for long enough and you’ll start to hear it. The heartbeat of the empty expanse tugging at your mind. It’ll start quiet, but the longer you’re out there, the louder it gets. Something watches from that blackness. And it doesn’t want us there.”

Plane Of Faerie.name:
妖精位面
Plane Of Faerie

Rogue Quip About Stand-up Fights.name:
关于即兴打斗的盗贼俏皮话
Rogue Quip About Stand-up Fights

Text.text:
“我想我从没真打过一场架。至少不算真正的那种。我当然杀过一大堆人，但通常只是黑暗里某个倒霉蛋喊着，‘你在哪儿？’然后我噗嗤噗嗤几刀，事情就结束了。也许哪天我会来场真正的较量……他们不会往你脸上招呼吧？”
“I don’t think I’ve ever actually been in a fight. Not a real one, anyway. I’ve killed loads of people, sure, but it’s usually just some hapless fool in the dark yelling, ‘Where are you?’ then stab-stab-stab and it’s over. Maybe I’ll get in a real bout one of these days… They don’t hit you in the face, do they?”

Belt Of Fire Giant Strength.name:
火巨人力量腰带
Belt Of Fire Giant Strength

Text.text:
这条腰带由十三块方形铜板拼接而成，铜板上铸有符文与风格化的图画文字，描绘着怪物与巨人。它接触起来带着温热。其间有一块带扣钩的铜板，刻着一张巨人咆哮的棱角面孔——他火焰般的头发与胡须翻卷燃烧；长长的胡须垂下，收束成锐利的尖端，向前斜斜刺出。
Thirteen square plates of copper, cast with runes and stylized pictograms of monsters and giants, make up this belt. It feels warm to the touch. One plate, which has fastening hooks, depicts the shouting, angular face of a giant with hair and beard of fire. His beard is long, forming a sharp, forward-angled point.

Grimoire Of A High Priest Or Priestess.name:
高阶祭司（或女祭司）的魔法书
Grimoire Of A High Priest Or Priestess

Text.text:
这本巨著以柔软的皮革装订，染着幽紫色泽，书口被一枚甲壳质的搭扣紧紧扣合。封面朴素无奇，唯有一道浅浅蚀刻的符文；此刻，它对你而言毫无意义。书中数百页并不规整——有些较大的纸张从其余页边探出，有些则由不同的材料制成。尤其刺眼的是其中一页，竟像是用粗硬的毛皮织成。
The tome is bound in soft leather tinted purple, ends snapped tightly together by a buckle of chitin. The cover is nondescript aside from a lightly etched rune that, for the moment, means nothing to you. The hundreds of pages are not uniform—some larger pieces stick out from the rest and some are made of different materials. Particularly jarring is a page that appears woven from coarse fur.

Giant Scorpion Nest In Desert.name:
沙漠巨蝎巢穴
Giant Scorpion Nest In Desert

Text.text:
沙砾在干燥的赤红峡谷岩间翻滚，荒风撼动上方沙丘，砂流便沿着断崖边缘窸窣倾泻而下。深壑四周回荡着咔啦作响的嘶嘶声，几只蝎子——有的体型竟与马一般大——从地下洞穴里钻出，粗阔的足肢张开，迅疾横掠而行。

~ 构想：Dwayne（Discord）

Sand tumbles amid the dry, red rocks of the ravine, skittering down escarpments as the arid wind displaces the dunes above. A rattling hiss echoes around the chasm, and several scorpions—some the size of a horse—emerge from their underground burrows on wide, scuttling legs.

~ Envisioned by Dwayne on Discord

Corporate Smart Drug, Cereprax.name:
企业智能药物：脑普拉克斯
Corporate Smart Drug, Cereprax

Text.text:
巴掌大的金属小盒顶盖滑开，伴随着刀刃回缩般的咔嚓声。里面堆着的药片乍看无害，像薄荷糖一样，只是泛着暗沉的灰色，还点缀着毛茸茸的白斑——仿佛水果上的霉点。

~ 一位英雄设想

The top of the palm-sized metal tin slides open with the sound of a retracting blade. The tablets piled inside look as innocuous as mints, except for their dull gray hue and furry speckles of white—like mold on fruit.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Overheard Conversation About Ruins.name:
关于遗迹的窃听对话
Overheard Conversation About Ruins

Text.text:
“——自从我和家人搬到这儿，一切就都不对劲了。我们在其上筑家的这些废墟里，回荡着某种回声；它随着年代流逝，只变得愈发冰冷、愈发疯狂。”
“—and ever since me and my family moved here things have just been wrong. These ruins we build our homes on hold an echo of something that has only grown colder and more insane with age.”

黑暗能量自你掌心奔涌而出，注入倒下者的残骸；在你周遭众人惊骇欲绝的注视下，死者的躯壳踉跄着站起身来，不知疲倦，且彻底受你驱使。
Dark energy flows from your hands to the remains of the fallen, and—to the horror of those in your presence—the form of the deceased shambles to its feet, tireless and completely in your thrall.

在这道法术漫长的施放过程中，你一直试图在脑海中勾勒出自己理想的坐骑。为了得到正确的结果，你所想象的每一处细节都必须分毫不差——从睫毛到尾尖。你的努力终于得到了回报：空气开始凝结，染上色彩。
Throughout the long casting of this spell, you have been attempting to envision your ideal steed. To achieve the proper result, every imagined detail must be correct, from eyelash to tail tip. Your efforts are rewarded as the air begins to solidify and take color.

Subterranean Ruined Settlement.name:
地下废墟聚落
Subterranean Ruined Settlement

Text.text:
曾经，在某个遥远的年代，这座洞窟必定曾因日常生活的奔忙与喧嚣而兴盛；但那个时代早已远去。如今，聚落的建筑破败不堪，残损程度各异，有些甚至已坍塌到只剩地基。即便看似大体完好者也危险至极——支撑梁早已腐朽断裂，在水蚀与长期无人修缮中被一点点啃噬殆尽。动物——以及怪物——成了此地仅存的住民。
Once, in some distant age, this cavern must have thrived with the scramble and haste of everyday life; but that time is long over. Now, the settlement buildings are in various states of disrepair, some crumbled to their foundation. Even those that appear largely intact are infinitely dangerous, with the support beams rotted through, eroded by water and lack of maintenance. Animals—and monsters—are the only inhabitants now.

Threat From A Hag.name:
来自鬼婆（特征）的威胁
Threat From A Hag

Text.text:
“真不可思议，像你们这般几口小点心，竟会自愿走进我们的家门。你们当然是最受欢迎的。事实上，只要我们喜欢，你们想住多久都行。”
“Incredible that a few morsels like yourselves would walk willingly into our home. You are most welcome, of course. In fact, you can stay as long as we like.”

Charging Barghest Rider.name:
冲锋的巴盖斯特骑手
Charging Barghest Rider

Text.text:
一只咆哮的利齿恶狼背上骑着一名地精——野性而混乱的祸害，身披拼凑而成的护甲，挥舞着粗陋却致命、沾满血污的武器。它们目光狂乱，笑容狰狞；野兽与骑手合为一体，化作一股可怖的威胁：不知疲倦的屠夫，几乎毫无悔意。它们周身散发出浓烈的杀戮气息。
Perched atop a snarling, razor-toothed wolf is a goblin—a feral, chaotic menace clad in patchwork armor, brandishing crude but effective weapons stained with gore. With wild eyes and savage grins, together, the beast and rider form a potent threat: relentless killers with little or no remorse. They give off an aura of murder.

Small Tabaxi Wizard.name:
小型塔巴希法师
Small Tabaxi Wizard

Text.text:
一条粗糙的粉色舌头从这位小猫科法师的嘴边垂落，她吃力地把那本沉重的法术书——体型几乎有她的一半——搬上桌。漆黑如午夜的毛色，与她身上那堪称世间最缤纷、最欢快的衣装形成强烈对比：色彩炸裂，图案错落，令人目眩。她头戴一顶巨大、尖顶锋利的帽子，特意在帽身上剪出两个洞，让两只尖耳朵穿出。

~ Sahlonahl 于 Discord

A rough pink tongue hangs from the small feline wizard's mouth as she hefts the weighty spell book—easily half her size—onto the table. Fur black as midnight is contrasted by clothes of the most colorful and joyous hues imaginable, all in a startling array of patterns. A large, sharp-tipped hat rests upon her head with holes cut for two pointed ears.

~ Sahlonahl on Discord

Detect Magic Sensation.name:
侦测魔法的感应
Detect Magic Sensation

Text.text:
你的头发与衣袍翻动，仿佛被来自异世界的风所吹拂。每一种感官都在偏移，像一条鱼第一次察觉自己正被水包围。你感受到维系万物的能量那自然而然的流动——也感受到那股能量被挪移、被改变、或被截断之处。
Your hair and clothing move as though blown by wind from a different world. Every sense shifts, like a fish aware of the water around them for the first time. You feel the natural flow of the energy that sustains everything—and where that energy has been moved, changed, or interrupted.

密不透风的丛林树冠遮蔽了夜空。你小心翼翼地穿行在盘结纠缠的藤蔓、树根与蕨类之间，四周尽是蓬勃兽群的动静。仿佛成百上千只夜行昆虫的啁啾与颤鸣织成一片不息的嗡响，悬在空气里。头顶上，你听见生物窜跃于枝桠之间的窸窣声，从一枝跳到另一枝。你缓慢前行之际，忽然撞见一道紫意幽光刺破沉沉阴翳——以及一棵倒下的巨木，盘根仍裹着湿润黝黑的泥土。树冠在此处裂开一道口子，让你得以窥见夜空：群星如锦，托出两轮月亮。一轮带着蓝色冷意的白，柔光轻洒；另一轮却像灼红的太阳正贴着地平线燃起。

~ Envisioned by Nick

The impenetrable canopy of the jungle trees obscures the night sky. You make your way carefully through the twisting mass of vines, roots, and ferns, hearing the sounds of thriving animal life all around you. The chirps and trills of what sounds like hundreds of nocturnal insects create a constant buzz in the air. Above, you can hear the rustling of creatures as they jump from branch to branch. As you make your slow progress, you come upon a shaft of purplish light cutting through the pall of shadow—and a fallen tree, its roots still covered in moist, dark soil. This break in the canopy allows a glimpse of the night sky: a tapestry of stars framing two moons. One, blue-tinged white with a soft glow. The other, like a searing-red sun meeting the horizon.

~ Envisioned by Nick

阴冷、潮湿而令人窒息的黑暗中，卵石铺就的地面与墙壁向四周各延伸十英尺。门边放着一盏小小的油灯，静待点燃。结实的木梁横贯天花板，支撑着上方的地板。部分墙面靠着搁架，摆满瓶罐与一捆捆腌藏之物；另一些墙上则吊着风干的肉排。最深处的角落堆着一袋袋土豆、根茎菜与面粉，另一处角落安放着几只巨大的麦酒与葡萄酒桶——足够维持好一段时间的口粮。
Cool, damp, and oppressively dark, the cobbled floor and walls stretch out ten feet on each side. A small oil lamp sits by the door, waiting to be lit. Strong wooden planks run along the ceiling, supporting the floor above. Some of the walls are lined with shelves, holding bottles and bundles of preserves, while others have hanging joints of cured meats. The back most corner is dedicated to sacks of potatoes, root vegetables, and flour, while another corner houses several large barrels of ale and wine. That would be sufficient sustenance for some time.

斑驳的日光穿透头顶的浪涛洒落下来，照亮珊瑚礁那道令人目眩的虹彩。坚硬的珊瑚虫石质息肉一簇簇挤在一起，每一株都比上一株更明亮、更鲜艳，堆叠成起伏的珊瑚丘。鱼群在礁间游弋，寻觅唾手可得的猎物。
Dappled daylight coming through the waves above illuminates the dazzling rainbow that is the reef. Stony polyps, each a brighter and more vibrant shade than the last, cluster together to form hills of coral. Fish roam the reef in search of easy meals.

Loot From A River Nymph Cove.name:
河中宁芙隐湾的战利品
Loot From A River Nymph Cove

Text.text:
你发现这名宁芙（特征）攒下了相当可观的一批收藏，多半是从过路旅人身上顺手牵来的。成堆失去光泽的首饰纠缠在一起，像一簇簇水草般蔓生。那件缀满繁复蕾丝的浅色长裙在温柔的水流中漂荡，领口与肩部被河石压住，像被钉在水里。渔网裹着一批造型各异的玻璃瓶——里面装着各式药剂，晃荡着、咕噜作响。
You find the nymph has amassed quite the collection, most likely nicking these treasures from travelers. Piles of tarnished jewelry tangle together like clusters of weeds. A pale dress of intricate lace drifts in the gentle current, anchored by river rocks at its neck and shoulders. A fisherman’s net wraps around a collection of uniquely shaped glass bottles—potions of various kinds sloshing within.

这里的森林已然消失，取而代之的是倒伏的树木与被砍得参差不齐的树桩。一个将雨水挡在外的篷布棚旁，奄奄将熄的炊火正吐出缕缕青烟。一座以层叠原木搭建的长屋嵌在山坡里，想必是营地伐木工们共用的宿舍与集会之所。
The forest has vanished here, replaced by felled trees and chipped stumps. Smoke curls from a dying cookfire near an awning erected to keep the rain at bay. A long lodge constructed of layered timbers is nestled into the hillside and must serve as the common house for the loggers who work at the camp.

One Day Of Travel By Foot On Grassland.name:
草原上徒步旅行的一天
One Day Of Travel By Foot On Grassland

Text.text:
当你踏上广袤无垠的平原——穿行在一片及腰深的草海之中——你在起伏的丘陵间谨慎择路，逢鹿径循鹿径，遇熊道走熊道。你在树荫下休息了两次，勉强咽下几口行军口粮。尽管疲惫缠身，你仍咬牙前行。旅行艰难，但终于，当夕阳沉入远方的群丘之后，你找到了你的目标。
As you travel over the sprawling plains—through a sea of hip-deep grass—you pick your way over the hills, following deer trails and bear paths as you find them. You rest twice in the shade of a tree and enjoy a meager meal of trail rations. You press on, despite your weariness. The travel is hard, but finally, as the sun dips behind the distant hills, you find your objective.

I Hack Into A Computer.name:
我黑进一台电脑
I Hack Into A Computer

Text.text: 我带着沉静的自信迅速入侵电脑，视线在数据流与安全措施之间飞掠，屏幕上它们像大道霓虹招牌般铺陈闪烁。忽然一切陷入黑暗，惊惶如潮灌满全身，我拼命回溯想锁定自己的失误。就在这时，一个边缘泛着绿光的方框弹出：许可已授予。 With quiet confidence I work quickly to hack the computer, my eyes darting across the streams of data and security measures filling the screen like neon billboards on the strip. Suddenly everything goes dark and a rush of panic floods my body as I try to pinpoint my mistake. Then a single box appears, limned in green: Access Granted.

Sundries From A Toymaker Hag.name:
来自玩具匠鬼婆的杂货
Sundries From A Toymaker Hag

Text.text:
在那丑恶老妪的尸身上，你找到一个小小的玉米皮娃娃，上面仅钉着一根针，旁边还有一袋指甲。你不寒而栗，不敢去想这恶毒的女巫究竟打算用它们来行什么阴险勾当。
On the corpse of the hideous crone, you find a small corn husk doll pierced with a single pin and a bag of fingernails. You shudder to think what nefarious purpose the vile witch had for these.

Disability-friendly Guitar.name:
适合身心障碍者使用的吉他
Disability-friendly Guitar

Text.text:
这件乐器堪称机械奇迹。它依旧有琴弦，但吉他的琴身被压缩得只有寻常的一半体型，而且没有可供握持的琴颈。取而代之的是，背面装有一条可调式系带，将吉他紧贴在佩戴者胸前。光滑木料上精雕细刻的纹路之间，潦草写就的符文蜿蜒其内，既作装饰，也作魔法灌注。琴弦比标准吉他更易拨响，而更小的体型也意味着只能用一只手演奏——再借一点点魔法的帮助。

~ 构想：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The instrument is a mechanical marvel. There are strings, but the body of the guitar has been condensed to about half the size of an ordinary one, and there is no neck to grasp onto. Instead, the back is equipped with an adjustable tether, which holds the guitar close to the wearer’s front. Glyphs have been scrawled within an intricate carving in the smooth wood, serving as both decoration and magical imbuement. The strings pluck more easily than a standard guitar, and the smaller size means only one hand can be used to play—with the aid of a little magic.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

这声尖啸过于响亮、过于阴森，绝不该出自凡人之口；然而那凄厉哀嚎既非女妖所发，也不是恶魔的咆哮。它来自一名缚灵（特征）般的女子——她奔跑着，双手各舞一柄染血战斧，斧影旋转如风。你猛然屏住呼吸，脚步钉在原地，被这幅景象摄住：怒火与暴烈化作实体，凝在一具肌肉贲张的躯体上；其上狂野刺青仿佛自有生命般跃动、翻涌。
The shriek seems too loud, too eerie, to have come from a mortal, but the wailing issues from neither a banshee, nor a demon. It comes from a wraith-like woman, running while whirling bloody axes in each hand. Your breath halts as you stop, mesmerized by this vision of wrath and violence embodied in a muscular form emblazoned with wild tattoos that leap with a life of their own.

当你的双手在空气中穿梭翻飞，火焰便随你心意跃动闪烁。你宛如一位指挥家，挥洒着唯有你——以及烈焰——才能听见的旋律。
As you weave your hands through the air, fire jumps and flickers at your whim. You are a maestro, conducting a melody only you—and the flames—can hear.

海带在被遗忘的海底王国的缝隙间繁茂绽放，随洋流起舞，宛如夏日微风里摇曳的草浪。沉没的深处藏着平和而宁静的安定，让人不难想象，这些被海潮收回的街道曾熙熙攘攘，满是久远年代里早已被遗忘的市民。

~ Clara C. Potter 于 Discord

Kelp blossoms in the crevices of the forgotten underwater kingdom, dancing in the ocean currents like grass in a summer breeze. The sunken depths hold a placid, serene calm, and it is easy to imagine these reclaimed streets brimming with citizens of times long forgotten.

~ Clara C. Potter on Discord

Wand Of The War Mage +2.name:
战争法师魔杖 +2
Wand Of The War Mage +2

Text.text:
虬结的树枝盘绕自身，打出数十道精巧紧密的死结，凝成一根坚实的魔杖。杖身底部缠着结实的皮革握把，其上嵌着点点金色镶饰；杖尖托着一枚坚硬的宝石，隐隐泛着淡蓝的微光。
The gnarled tree branch wraps around itself in dozens of intricate and tight knots to form a solid wand. Its base is wrapped in a solid leather grip studded with golden inlays, and the tip holds a rigid gem that glows a faint blue hue.

那男人漫不经心地倚在餐馆门口，刺青的巨龙缠绕在他粗壮得惊人的手臂上。他深吸一口烟，斜挎在肩上的冲锋枪随之一阵抖动，发出令人不寒而栗的金属颤响。看那把被撞得伤痕累累的枪托上刻着的道道划痕，他显然早已习惯黑帮火并里无处不在的暴力与死亡。他抬手抹过剃得极短的黑发，用中文朝餐馆店员吼了句什么，随即迈步出去巡逻。
The man leans nonchalantly in the doorway of the restaurant, tattooed dragons coiling around his huge, muscular arms. He takes a drag on his cigarette, causing the submachine gun slung over his shoulder to rattle menacingly. Judging by the etched scoring on the battered headstock, he is no stranger to the ever-present violence and death of gang warfare. He runs a hand over his shaved, black hair and shouts something in Mandarin to the restaurant clerk before setting out on patrol.

Animated Street Food Vendor.name:
会动的街头小吃摊贩
Animated Street Food Vendor

Text.text:
双手以不可思议的速度翻飞，一个瘦高的少年把鸡肉和牛肉塞进法士达里，朝着喧闹的街道高声吆喝着价目。他低沉的嗓音向外迸射，盖过头顶喇叭里尖薄的音乐。刺眼的日光橙连体工装把他从头到脚裹得严严实实。头上戴着一顶蓝色发网，死死压住那团爆炸般的非洲卷发。他站在一辆破旧的金属推车后，车身锈迹斑斑，边缘挂着忽明忽暗的霓虹灯。小小的燃气炉吐出温暖的光，把他油腻、汗渍斑斑的脸照得发亮。
Hands moving at incredible speed, a gangly youth fills fajitas with chicken and beef, yelling prices into the busy street. His deep voice projects outward, drowning tinny music from overhead speakers. A Day-Glo–orange jumpsuit covers him fully. On his head is a blue hairnet, crushing down his Afro. He stands behind a battered metal cart, covered in rust and adorned with flickering neon lights. A small gas stove casts a warm glow on his greasy, sweat-stained face.

I Transform Into A Wererat.name:
我变身为鼠狼人
I Transform Into A Wererat

Text.text: 一阵刺痛贯穿我门牙，我本能地伸手去接触它们。牙齿如今锋利得像细高跟鞋的尖刃，我一缩，指尖竟被割破。来了。 鼻梁痛得发紧，随之被拉长，鼻端变得湿滑而抽动。叉状的胡须刺破口鼻两侧钻出，灰扑扑的细绒毛从我每一寸皮肤上疯长。我的背部痉挛般抽搐，先挺直又弓起，脊柱在爆裂的脆响中让肌肉鼓胀隆起。可怖变形的高潮里，一条骨质尾巴猛地破肤而出，坠落到地上，像蛇一样盘成一堆。 A stab of pain shoots through my front teeth, and I instinctively reach out to touch them. I wince as I cut into my fingertips with my now stiletto-sharp teeth. Here we go. My nose pinches painfully as it elongates, the end of it becoming slick and twitching. Pronglike whiskers pierce through my snout and a peach fuzz of grayish fur sprouts from every inch of me. My back spasms, straightening and then curling over, and my muscles swell as my spine cracks. A bony tail bursts out from my skin in the climax of my horrid transformation, falling to the floor in a snakelike heap.

Brawl In The Tavern.name:
酒馆斗殴
Brawl In The Tavern

Text.text:
“打起来！”这声吼几乎才刚从某个大嗓门嘴里蹦出，一记拳头就擦着你的脸飞过。那一下险险落空，却砸在另一个酒客的脑袋上，对方当场软倒在地。椅子刺耳地刮响，酒杯翻滚四溅，人们纷纷起身，手臂高举，蓄势待发。指节裂开，牙齿崩碎，腹部在拳肘膝撞的连环痛击下抽搐塌陷。酒保惊怒大喊，盘子、碗和杯子转眼成了人群投掷的暗器。混乱喧嚣中，不知哪里有个吟游诗人喘着粗气，吐出不合时宜、走调刺耳的嘲讽，煽得乌合之众愈发狂躁。
“FIGHT!” The cry is barely free of some loud-mouth’s lips before a fist flies by your face. The narrow miss lands on the head of another patron, who crumples to the floor. Chairs screech and tankards tumble as folk stand, arms raised and ready. Knuckles split, teeth crack, and bellies wilt under pummels of hand and knee. The barman shouts in dismay as plate, bowl, and cup become missiles of the mob. Somewhere in the hubbub, a bard wheezes out untimely, discordant jibes, spurring the rabble on.

你伸出你的秘法感官，感知周遭的大地：那细若游丝的震颤，以及深埋其中的微观生命。你分辨出它的地势与纹理，熟稔得如同自己的手背——而此刻，你握紧又松开这只手，将大地揉捏于你的意志之下，仿佛陶艺大师掌中一团黏土。
You reach out with your occult senses and perceive the earth around you: its minute rumblings, and the microcosmic life buried within it. You discern its topography and textures, coming to know them like the back of your own hand—a hand you now clench and release to knead the earth to your will, like a master potter with a lump of clay.

Mysterious Magical Muffin.name:
神秘的魔法松饼
Mysterious Magical Muffin

Text.text:
你踏入这家别致的小烘焙坊，香草、肉桂与覆盆子的气息饱满地浸透空气，甜香馋人得令人不由吞咽。柜台上、玻璃后方，摆着一只奢华松软的玛芬，轻轻冒着热气，仿佛才刚离开烤箱。金灿灿的蛋糕体如丝绒般细腻，鲜亮晶莹的甜品酱以纤细的缎带斜淋其上，蜿蜒掠过雪白的糖霜。

~ 设想：NinjaVahn

The smell of vanilla, cinnamon, and raspberry saturates the air with a mouth-watering scent as you enter the quaint little bakery. On the counter, behind some glass, sits a sumptuously fluffy muffin, gently steaming as if it has just left the oven. The luxurious golden sponge is drizzled in a vibrant, glistening dessert sauce in delicate ribbons across the snow-white icing.

~ Envisioned by NinjaVahn

Hydra Encounter: Meeting The Hydra.name:
九头蛇遭遇：与九头蛇相逢
Hydra Encounter: Meeting The Hydra

Text.text:
水面轰然炸开，你猛然发现自己已被团团围住。蜿蜒而强健的长颈——大概有六条——在你身旁疾速穿梭，每一条都顶着一颗蛇形头颅，颌骨咔嚓作响，利齿如刀般森寒。你这才看清，那些长颈竟全都连在同一具覆满鳞片的躯体上，正潜游于沼泽之中。
The water explodes and suddenly you find yourself surrounded. Sinuous, muscled necks—perhaps a half-dozen of them—dart around you, each bringing to bear a serpentine head with snapping jaws and razor-sharp teeth. You realize that the long necks all attach to the same scaly body swimming in the swamp.

Water In The Depths.name:
深渊之水
Water In The Depths

Text.text:
湍急水流的轰鸣自石桥下方的裂隙深处传来。仿佛初雨洗净大地般清新的气息自下方升腾。尽管阴影笼罩，白昼的光仍在深处的溪流上反射，向陡直的岩壁投下粼粼摇曳的碎光。那声音暗示着，下面某处还有一道瀑布。
The roar of flowing water comes from deep within the fissure under the stone bridge. A smell like fresh rain rises from below. Despite the shadows, daylight reflects off the stream in the depths, throwing shimmering light on the sheer walls. The sound suggests a waterfall somewhere down there.

附近的一件物体咯咯作响，旋转起来，随即猛然长出手臂与双腿。它小心翼翼地站起身，仿佛还不确定该如何面对这崭新的生命——有点怯生生的，有点脆弱。它挺直身子立正站好，像个玩具士兵般，转过头凝望着它的造物主。
A nearby object rattles, rotates, then abruptly sprouts arms and legs. It rises gingerly to its feet, perhaps unsure of what to do with its new life—a little timid, a little fragile. It stands at attention, not unlike a toy soldier, and turns to gaze at its creator.

Corporate-owned Mass Transportation.name:
企业所属的大众交通运输
Corporate-owned Mass Transportation

Text.text:
运输机巍然如山——一台庞大的步行无人机，像史前雷龙般穿行于整座市政区。它粗壮的巨腿从容迈步，轻松跨越重重障碍；尖端科技确保即使最沉重的货物也能安全高效送达——凭借它的速度与力量，它是连接巨型企业与消费者的配送网络中至关重要的一环。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The transporter is colossal, a gigantic walker drone that traverses the municipality like a prehistoric brontosaur. Its massive legs stride smoothly over obstacles, its advanced tech ensuring safe and efficient delivery of even the heaviest cargo—with its speed and power, it is a crucial part of the delivery network connecting mega-corps and consumers.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The Excitable Cleric.name:
兴奋过头的牧师
The Excitable Cleric

Text.text:
“我们的使命或许正服务于神明宏大的天意，但天哪，我就是兴奋得不得了，能来到这里！”
“Our purpose probably serves the grand providence of the divine, but golly, I’m just so darn excited to be here!”

Pirate Lord's Plunder.name:
海盗领主的掠宝
Pirate Lord's Plunder

Text.text:
宝藏在洞穴摇曳的光影里妖娆闪烁，堆积如一座名副其实的巨龙掠夺之巢——船长就踏立其上。伴随一声振奋的欢呼，这位久经风浪的老海狗高声赞颂船员们的战利品，举起一只镶宝酒杯，与众人共饮，敬这公海上一生的冒险。

~ 由 Sahlonahl 在 Discord 上 设想

Treasures glimmer seductively in the wavering light of the cave, amassed like a veritable dragon's hoard of plunder—which the captain stands astride. With a rousing cheer, the veteran sea-dog lauds his crew for the spoils, and raises a jeweled goblet as they toast a lifetime of adventure on the high seas.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Police Force Patrolman.name:
警察巡警
Police Force Patrolman

Text.text:
巡警头盔的护目镜上闪烁着红色线条与文字，不断向他输送情报；车流与人影从身旁呼啸而过，拉成模糊的残影，街上霓虹招牌的光把色彩一层层洗过。防弹背心之下，他的制服依旧笔挺。护膝与护肘各自闪着某种强化装置的微光。护目镜下那抹自鸣得意的笑，以及他微微前倾的胯部姿态，都在说明他很享受自己此刻的样子。厚重的黑色背心上方投射出朦胧的蓝光警徽，还浮着他的名字。
The visor on the patrolman’s helmet flickers red lines and text, feeding him information as cars and people whiz by in blurs, colors shifting with the neon signage above the street. His uniform is crisp underneath the bulletproof vest. Knee and elbow pads each blink with some kind of enhancement. By the smug smile underneath the visor and how his hips lean forward, you can tell he likes the way he looks. His police badge is projected over the bulky black vest in hazy blue light, along with his name.

教堂长椅上，教区信徒默默端坐，礼拜之日身着或许仅次于最体面的那套衣装。神父布道的韵律只被近旁婴儿的一声啼哭打断，惹来一抹隐约的愠色。圣日之上，任何人都不该质疑或打断神职人员——哪怕只是个小孩子。
Sitting silently in a temple pew, the parishioner is dressed in perhaps their second-finest garb on the day of worship. The rhythm of the priest’s homily is disrupted only by the cry of a nearby baby, which evokes a subtle scowl. None should question or interrupt the clergy on a holy day, not even a small child.

这间廉价窝棚像是一条无穷无尽的走廊，两侧挤满狭小逼仄的隔间；肮脏的窗户堵住了本就稀薄的天光。墙皮在腐朽中层层剥落，有些地方甚至破出洞来。每个房间里都摆着一张光秃秃的金属床架，配着一条污渍斑斑的床垫。有一间的天花板上还留着一块可疑的褐色污痕。佝偻而惶惧的身影在你靠近时瑟缩着退开。这里潮湿阴冷，空气却又闷得发紧——那股味道让人几乎喘不过气。远处传来争吵声，嗓门高亢而暴怒。
The flophouse seems to be one infinite corridor full of poky little rooms, their grubby windows obstructing the natural light. The walls peel with decay, and in some places there are holes. Each room houses a bed with a bare metal frame and a dirty mattress. In one room there is a suspect brown stain on the ceiling. Hunched and fearful figures cringe away at your approach. It is damp and cold, yet the air is very close—it’s hard to breathe with the smell. In the distance you can hear voices, raised and furious.

I Cast Imprisonment Using A Transparent.name:
我用一枚透明宝石施展“禁锢术”
I Cast Imprisonment Using A Transparent Gemstone

Text.text:
宝石闪烁着光芒，魔法能量以频闪般的波浪掠过它抛光的表面。我对目标的描绘被其上方的水晶扭曲并放大，随着法术临近完成，闪电开始在物体之间噼啪作响、迸裂成弧。

[豁免失败{/i>] 我吟出最后的力量之词，完成法术，惊叹地看着我的敌手被拽向那座神秘的囚笼。

The gemstone glitters as magical energy flashes across its polished surface in strobing waves. My depiction of the target is warped and magnified by the crystal atop it, and lightning begins to crackle and arc between the objects as the spell nears completion.

[Failed Save{/i>] Invoking the final words of power, I complete the spell and watch in amazement as my foe is pulled toward the mystical prison.

I Breathe Underwater With My Necklace Of.name:
我戴着适应项链，在水下自在呼吸
I Breathe Underwater With My Necklace Of Adaptation

Text.text:
我猛地扎入水面之下，激流在耳畔轰鸣。颈间传来一阵暖意，金色项链熠熠生辉。那光芒刺破浑浊的水色。一团气泡在我头边膨胀开来，我猛吸一口气，肺里灌满清澈可呼吸的空气。气泡微微摇晃，果冻般的质感时不时弹回到我的头侧，我一边稳住呼吸，一边打量四周。
I plunge beneath the surface, the rush of water roaring in my ears. I feel a warmth at my neck, the golden necklace aglow. Its light breaks through the murk. A bubble of air balloons about my head and I take a gasping breath, my lungs filling with clear, breathable air. The bubble wobbles, its jellylike texture occasionally bouncing against my head as I take in my surroundings.

Air Elemental Bearing Down.name:
迫近的风元素
Air Elemental Bearing Down

Text.text:
一张尖啸的面孔在狂暴旋风中扭曲延展，超越了自然所能承受的极限，随着那股撕裂般的怒吼朝你扑来。狂风如饥饿的猛兽般撕扯着你，那高耸的风暴之躯挟着元素的狂怒轰然压下，凶厉的长嚎充塞了你的整个世界。
A shrieking face, distorted beyond natural limits, stretches across the violent whirlwind screaming toward you. Wind tears at you like a ravenous beast as the towering mass bears down with elemental fury, and a furious howl fills your world.

一圈低矮的栅栏围住了这片菜园，立柱与粗大的枝条间还夹杂着几根修长的骨头。围栏外侧丢着一把铁锹，半掩的栅门挂在锈蚀的铰链上微微下垂。菜畦里长着成熟的胡萝卜、卷心菜与各色青叶菜，几株显然刚被采收。翻起的新土与潮润的腐殖气息，亦暗示着不久前才除过草、精心打理过。泥土里还能看见细碎的骨片与牙齿。
A low fence made of posts and large sticks—and some long bones—surrounds this garden. A shovel lies just outside the enclosure, and the half-open fence gate hangs on rusty hinges. Mature carrots, cabbages, and greens grow in the vegetable patch. Several have been harvested recently. Turned earth, and the loamy smell of it, also suggest fresh weeding and careful tending. Bone fragments and teeth are visible in the soil.

这支箭看起来像是有人用整块黄金精心打造而成，却轻得与寻常箭矢无异。你本能地用指甲去刮它的表面，但那材质的坚实程度，甚至比黄金本身还要更胜一筹。
This arrow looks like someone crafted it from solid gold, but it weighs no more than an ordinary arrow. Instinctively you try to scratch it with a fingernail, but its substance is more solid than even gold would be.

Icy Wasteland: Braving The Wind.name:
冰封荒原：迎风而行
Icy Wasteland: Braving The Wind

Text.text:
风的嚎叫与尖啸仿佛有了生命，推搡着、拍打着你，穿透最厚的织物，钻进衣物的缝隙，伸手般探入，寒意如针如刃，刺穿、戳进你的肌肤。你紧紧抱住双臂，试图凭借意志强迫自己暖起来，可身体背叛了你——牙关开始不受控制地打颤。
The howl and whistle of the wind seem like a living thing, pushing and buffeting you, blowing through the thickest fabric, reaching through the gaps in your clothes to pierce and stab you with cold. You clutch your arms close and try to warm yourself by force of will, but your body betrays you as your teeth begin to chatter.

Supply Convoy Crashes In Urban Area.name:
补给车队在城区区域内失事
Supply Convoy Crashes In Urban Area

Text.text:
由五辆卡车组成的车队正飞速穿行在拥挤的城市街道上，忽然领头车的车轮剧烈摇晃，重型卡车随即垮塌失控。后方卡车来不及刹停，人群看出撞击迫在眉睫，尖叫着四散奔逃。一辆倾覆的卡车像失控的巨兽直冲一栋低层公寓楼，翻滚腾跃，将致命的金属碎片抛洒到街面上。撞上公寓楼的瞬间，热浪般的爆炸轰然炸开——火焰冲天而起，地面猛然震颤，空气里弥漫着烧焦橡胶的刺鼻气味。
The five trucks making up the convoy are moving fast, through crowded city streets, when the lead vehicle’s wheel wobbles and the HGV collapses. The trucks behind cannot stop in time, and the crowds scatter as they see the impending crash. A toppling truck barrels toward a low-rise apartment, somersaulting and throwing deadly scrap into the street. As it hits the apartment block, it explodes in a wave of heat. A plume of fire bursts skyward, the ground shudders, and the smell of burning rubber fills the air.

Planet Made Of Diamond.name:
钻石之星
Planet Made Of Diamond

Text.text:
碳与硅在星光下闪烁，这颗星球仿佛月亮般自生反光。它几近完美的球体，仅因需要两极才略显扁圆；地表洁净而银亮——仿佛这颗星球生来就是为刮洗其他星球。钻石从地表一路延伸至核心，数百万平方英里的财富。
The carbon and silica shimmer under starlight, the planet generating its own reflective glow like a moon. It is a near-perfect orb, obloid only out of its need for poles, its ground clean and silvery—as if the planet were made to scour other planets. The diamonds trace their way from surface to core, millions of square miles of wealth.

Grandparents With A Grandchild.name:
带着孙辈的祖父母
Grandparents With A Grandchild

Text.text:
两位年迈的老人一左一右牵着一个小女孩，各自握着她的一只手。尽管显然被这番折腾累得够呛，他们仍兴致勃勃地每走四步就把孩子荡到空中一次，口中齐声念着：“一、二、三——嘿呀！”而每一次，女孩都尖声大笑起来。
Two elderly folk walk with a young girl between them, each holding one of her hands. Though clearly exhausted by the effort, they gamely swing the child up into the air every fourth step, chanting, “One, two, three, oop-a-day!” And each time the girl shrieks with laughter.

这些树的枝叶如同浓密的穹顶，厚到足以在它们所立的水面上投下清凉的阴影；可真正有性格的，是那盘根错节的根系。它们让人觉得这些树像是被从泥土里硬生生拔起，又被放回水中，靠着上百只褐色、虬结的爪子勉强平衡。有的仿佛正攫住水面那层平静的薄膜，有的则像用上千条瘦长的腿，缓慢地在水里踱行。
While the leafy canopy of these trees is so dense it provides cool shade over the water in which they stand, the roots have their own character. They make it look as if the trees were pulled from the ground, then set down to balance on a hundred brown, knotty claws. Some look as if they are grabbing the water’s calm surface, others as if they are walking slowly through it on a thousand skinny legs.

Magnificent Caravel Sets Sail.name:
壮丽的卡拉维尔帆船启航
Magnificent Caravel Sets Sail

Text.text:
雪白的船帆在清冽、带咸味的海风里鼓起又拍响，船员们正为航行做最后的准备。码头上挤满了围观者，兴奋夹杂着惴惴不安的气息悬在空气中；他们迫不及待想亲眼见证这场历史性远征的启程。海鸥尖叫着穿梭于高耸的桅杆之间，掠过索具上自豪飘扬的旗旌。忽然，钟声一记长鸣，人群爆发出欢呼，船只解缆离岸——命运的旅程由此展开。

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Crisp white sails billow and snap in the fresh, salty breeze as the crew finishes preparations for their voyage. A sense of excited trepidation hangs in the air as a crowd of onlookers gathers on the quay, eager to witness the start of the historic expedition. Gulls screech as they soar between the towering masts of the ship, taking wing above the pennants fluttering proudly from the rigging. A cheer erupts from the crowd as a bell peals and the vessel casts off—beginning their fateful journey.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

骸骨身影——成百上千，甚至可能上万——以森严队列列阵而立，披挂着随葬的武装与护甲。它们这些不死战士不需食物，不需清水，不需休息；它们步履不息，冲锋陷阵也毫不退缩。正当它们肩并肩站成整齐行列时，一名骸骨骑士策着一匹嶙峋坐骑驰来，那坐骑的眼眶燃着猩红火焰。哗啦一声，将军从鞍上落地，护甲与剑鞘相互碰撞作响，沿着无尽兵列踱步巡视，检阅这支军团，搜寻任何一丝弱点的迹象。

~ Envisioned by Rogério da Costa Jr.

Skeletal figures—hundreds, if not thousands of them—stand in regimented formation, armed and armored in their burial garb. These undead warriors require no food, no water, no rest; they march unceasingly and charge into combat unflinchingly. As they stand in rank-and-file, a skeletal figure rides up on a gaunt steed with burning red eyes. With a clatter, the general drops from the saddle, armor and scabbard rattling, to walk the endless lines of troops, inspecting the legion for any sign of weakness.

~ Envisioned by Rogério da Costa Jr.

Ioun Stone Of Leadership.name:
领导灵光石
Ioun Stone Of Leadership

Text.text:
周遭所有人的目光都被你牵引而来，仿佛你的言辞与姿态自带引力，将他们一寸寸拽入。真正注意到那枚粉绿纹理交错、绕着你头顶旋转的球体的人寥寥无几——可即便他们看见了，也丝毫不会削减你对众人目光的掌控。
The gazes of all surrounding you gravitate to your form, your words and posture drawing them in. Only a very few of those beholding you place much importance on the pink and green marbled sphere whirling around your head—not that you command their attention any less for their observation.

Great Seaside Metropolis.name:
海滨巨都
Great Seaside Metropolis

Text.text:
海鸥在头顶盘旋，咸湿的海风里回荡着它们尖利的鸣叫；地平线处，帆影翻飞，迎风猎猎的旗帜如波浪般起伏。码头上行动喧腾——船只靠岸与离泊，粗壮臂膀的水手将木箱与酒桶装卸搬运，船长的喝令声一声声劈开嘈杂。城里同样在行动的嗡鸣中运转：水手涌向集市与酒馆，而来自四面八方的商人正把货物整束打包，准备装船启运。
Gulls circle overhead, their calls shrill on the salt-laced air, and the horizon is a flutter of sails and windswept flags. The docks bustle with activity—ships arriving and disembarking, crates and barrels loaded and unloaded by thick-armed deckhands, and barked orders from captains. The city itself hums with activity as sailors take to the markets and taverns, and as merchants hailing from near and far prepare their goods for shipment.

漩涡混沌能量的化身——一具蔚蓝的鳗形躯体顶着鲶鱼般的头颅，振动明焰般的双翼，穿行于这世界的熵流之中。它修长蜿蜒的鳗身半透明，内脏清晰可见，漂浮其间，体型与形态不断变换；无眼的面孔上伸出须状触须，轻触并品尝着周遭的能量。被凡人生涯的纷乱所吸引，它轻快地向你飘来，随性而好奇。
The embodiment of the Maelstrom's chaotic energy, an azure anguilliform body with a catfish head soars through the entropy of this world on wings of bright flame. Its long sinuous eel body is translucent, its organs visible as they float around, changing size and shape, and whisker-like antennae extend from its eyeless face, tasting the energy around it. Drawn to the chaos of mortal lives, it flutters toward you, casual and curious.

Overheard Conversation About Looming Des.name:
偷听到的关于迫近毁灭的对话
Overheard Conversation About Looming Destruction

Text.text:
“——我当然知道，总有些什么地狱般的生物或古老的预言要降临，把一切化为焦土。但我还得睡觉、照顾孩子、干我的活儿，又不能一路尖叫着过日子，所以我尽量不去想它。”
“—’course I know there’s always some infernal creature or ancient prophecy coming to lay waste to everything. But I’ve got to sleep, take care of my kids, and do my job without screaming, so I try not to think about it.”

Dragon Turtle Encounter.name:
龙龟遭遇
Dragon Turtle Encounter

Text.text:
你俯视水下那片令你一直忧心的嶙峋暗礁，却骇然发现它那庞大的轮廓竟在缓慢挪动。你张口正要示警，水面却猛然炸裂，浪头直冲而起，兜头拍下，几乎将你掀翻。一颗爬虫般的头颅——巨大而可怖——破水升起，怒目周围水流成股淌落。原来那片暗礁，是这头巨龟般怪物的甲壳。
As you view a rocky shoal beneath the water that has been worrying you, you’re stunned to see its great bulk slowly shift. You open your mouth to raise the alarm, but the water explodes upward, washing over you in a wave that nearly knocks you down. A reptilian head, huge and terrible, rises from the surface, rivulets of water dripping down around angry eyes. The rocky shoal was the shell of this enormous turtlelike monster.

毒素迅速而血腥地发作。你的视野一阵摇晃，收束成针尖般的一点，四周的声音也随之闷沉下去。你双膝一软，力气在瞬间被抽空，你在栽倒之际勉强撑住自己。口中泛起污秽刺鼻的苦涩酸味——恶心在喉咙深处盘旋纠结。你的心跳慢得像停滞一般，开始艰难地将血液泵送到全身。
The poison does quick, grisly work. Your vision swims, narrowing to a pinpoint as all sound becomes muffled around you. Your knees buckle as every ounce of strength leaves you in an instant and you catch yourself as you topple. Your mouth tastes foul, acrid, bitter—nausea coils at the back of your throat. Your heartbeat slows to a crawl as it begins to struggle at pumping blood through your body.

Corrupted Dryad's Tree.name:
堕化树妖之树
Corrupted Dryad's Tree

Text.text:
风穿林而过，枝叶喀啦作响，像一口为这片阴魂不散的林地敲响的丧钟，回声绵延至幽暗深处。薄雾在树干间缠绕，也缠上你的双腿，遮蔽地面，使你难以在带刺、灼痛的荆棘灌丛中辨路。忽然，脚下的泥土变得坚硬，你再也感受不到脚边的杂草纠缠。你发现自己站在一棵树前——焦黑、断裂，仿佛曾被一道霹雳正中劈开。真菌从它的根与树皮间渗出，酸腐的气味从中散开。你再靠近些，便看见树上的蘑菇开始扭动、颤抖，菌盖转动——朝着你伸去。

~ 一位英雄 Envisioned

The wind rattles through the trees, the sound a death knell that spans the reaches of this haunting wood. Mists weave around the trees and your legs, obscuring the ground and making it difficult to navigate through the brambly, stinging foliage. Suddenly, the earth feels harder and you don’t sense underbrush any longer. You find yourself standing before a tree, charred and broken, as if once struck by a bolt of lightning. Fungal growths seep out of its roots and bark, and a sour smell radiates from it. As you move closer, you see the mushrooms on the tree start to wiggle and tremble, their heads turning—reaching toward you.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

有人倾注心血打造了这支箭。箭头呈纤长的羽叶形：尖锐如针，却又略微不对称，中央脊更为厚实。尾羽与箭头的轮廓相似，但用的是真正的银白羽毛，来自一种你从未见过的鸟。箭杆的深色木质上环绕着细小的刻纹，像是一群燕子盘旋起舞。它看起来更像一件艺术品，而非战场上的武器。
Someone took great care in crafting this arrow. Its head is a slim feather shape: sharply pointed but slightly asymmetrical with a thicker central core. The fletching looks similar to the arrowhead, but made of real, silvery feathers from a bird you’ve never seen. Tiny etchings of what might be swallows swirl around the dark wood of the shaft. It seems to be more of a work of art than a weapon of war.

Boreal Forest Pine Grove.name:
北境针叶林松林
Boreal Forest Pine Grove

Text.text:
高挑纤细的松树排成一道天然的柱廊，清冽的松绿气息充盈在空气里。林地铺满飘落的松针与地衣，仿佛被镀上一层金色。腐朽的泥土间，娇艳的粉色杜鹃盛放。抬头望去，松林织出一层蓬乱的树冠，深绿枝叶的缝隙间仍可窥见一抹星云般的天空。
The tall, slender pine trees form a natural colonnade, with a sharp, green scent filling the air. The forest floor is gilded with fallen needles and lichen. From the moldering soil grow beautiful pink azaleas. Above, the pine trees form a shaggy canopy, though a nebula of sky is visible through the gaps between the deep green branches.

祭司的吟诵在神殿中回荡。你能在胸腔里感到那股震颤，低沉的嗡鸣仿佛从地面沿着双脚向上爬升。你的呼吸渐渐放缓，眼皮沉得发坠。在众信徒之间坐下，加入他们昏昏欲睡的圣歌之中，竟显得再自然不过。
The priests’ chanting reverberates about the temple. You can feel the thrum of it in your chest, and its hum seems to run up through your feet from the floor. Your breathing slows, and your eyelids feel heavy. It feels perfectly natural to sit down among the following and join them in their somnolent song.

在你看见它之前，你就先在空气里嗅到了变化。洞穴里那股麝香般的泥与菌的气味散去，鼻腔与肺里都变得轻盈起来。当那片岩石岸边映入眼帘时，最令人震惊的——除了它的体型——是那份寂静与凝止。清澈如玻璃、平坦如镜面的水面向外延展，没入一座辽阔而低矮的洞窟；从你所在的角度，根本无法判断它究竟延伸到何处、深到几许。
Before you see it, you smell the difference on the air. The musky mud-and-fungus scent of the caves clears, becoming light in the nose and on the lungs. When you get its rocky shore in sight, what’s most astonishing—besides its size—is the silence and stillness. Water clear as glass and flat as a mirror extends outward into a vast, low cavern, its extent and depth unknowable from your vantage point.

Loot From A Illithilich.name:
夺自夺心巫妖的战利品
Loot From A Illithilich

Text.text:
巫妖腐臭的血肉渐渐消散，只余下一堆恶臭熏人的长袍。袍布间雾气缭绕，你发现一个金属盒，形似贝壳，扣得严严实实。你一接触它，冰冷刺骨，但里面有什么在蠕动。你能感觉到它在轻轻敲击……
The rancid flesh of the lich dissipates, leaving a pile of foul-smelling robes behind. Amid the misting cloth you find a metallic box shaped like a clam shell, clasped shut. It is ice-cold to the touch, but something writhes within. You can feel it tapping…

从碎裂的冰中诞生，在你面前拔地而起的龙形怪物，正是冰冷死亡的化身。冰川般的鳞片在稀薄的光里闪着寒芒，琥珀色的眼睛紧盯着你每一次细微的颤动。它用巨大的利爪前肢拖拽着蜥蜴般的身躯向前逼近，爪尖深深凿入冰面。生物张开血盆大口，露出冰锥般的利齿，吐息如冻结的狂风般咆哮，向你发出挑战。
Birthed from broken ice, the draconic monstrosity that rises before you is the epitome of cold death. Glacial scales glint in the scant light, and its amber eyes track your every twitching move. It pulls its lizard body forward on massive, clawed arms that gouge into the ice. The creature opens its maw, revealing icicle teeth as it roars its challenge on breath like a freezing gale.

Rescue From The River Of Time.name:
从时代之河中救援
Rescue From The River Of Time

Text.text:
冰寒的河流停滞在洞窟的漆黑里，像一颗不再跳动的心脏。这个过分死寂的所在，唯有河岸边那名乌黑精灵带来声音与动静。他以一种古怪的划水姿势切开水面——过于精准，过于完美。他并未被水流拽回，却也毫无进展，离岸永远差那一寸。他双眼圆睁，哀求的瞳孔因疲惫而松散无力。嘴巴大张，却只吐出一声无声的尖叫。

~ 由 JoeyVeritas 构想

The gelid river sits stagnant in the black of the cavern, like an unbeating heart. The only sound and movement in this too-still place comes from the ebon elf at the river’s edge. He cuts through the water with an odd stroke—too precise, too perfect. He isn’t pulled back, but he makes no progress, never gaining an inch toward the bank. His eyes are wide, his pleading pupils slack with exhaustion. His mouth gapes, but only a silent scream comes forth.

~ Envisioned by JoeyVeritas

Telescoping Self-defense Staff.name:
伸缩式自卫棍
Telescoping Self-defense Staff

Text.text:
你手腕轻轻一抖，那根线条利落的炭黑钢警棍便顺势滑入掌中，稳稳到位。一个流畅的动作间，这把武器倏然伸展至全长，伸缩节节层层弹出，“咔哒”一声脆响，牢牢锁定。
The sleek charcoal steel of the baton slides effortlessly into position with a flick of your wrist. In one smooth motion, the weapon extends to its full length, the telescoping segments locking firmly into position with a click.

Dust-choked Highway.name:
尘沙呛喉的公路
Dust-choked Highway

Text.text:
一层褐色的烟尘笼罩在多车道高速公路上，将车流闪烁的红色尾灯都映得昏暗。透过这团尘云所能看清的部分来看，这条路似乎根本不需要外力就会自行崩坏。坑洼无处可避，坑与坑之间的沥青裂缝纵横交错，整段路面在通勤人潮的重压下吱呀作响、呻吟不止。
A haze of brown hangs over the multi-lane highway, dimming the flashing red lights of traffic. From what's visible through the cloud of dust, it looks like the road doesn't need any help deteriorating. Potholes seem unavoidable, with cracks in the asphalt running between them, and the entire structure creaks and groans from the weight of the commuters.

Radiant Crystal Heart Of A Flying City.name:
飞城的辉耀水晶之心
Radiant Crystal Heart Of A Flying City

Text.text:
水晶之中闪过一道凌厉的冷光——那是一枚体型宏伟、奇美得近乎不真实的巨型球体。它高耸于周围建筑之上，安置在五只金色利爪之中；每一爪都如刀刃般锋锐，其上压印着放射状的纹路。球壳半透明，正中央燃着炽烈的源火。它如星辰般闪烁，当粉与白的火焰骤然迸发，虹彩的纹样便如潮水般掠过球体表面。一道人影朝水晶走近，抬手遮眼，试图挡住那刺目灼人的辉光。

~ Envisioned by Curran

A glare flickers from within the crystal, a massive orb wondrous in its size and beauty. It towers above the surrounding buildings and is set upon a quintet of golden claws, each bladelike and embossed with raylike patterns. The orb’s shell is translucent, with a burning source at its center. It glitters like a star and, as pink and white fires flare, patterns of rainbow color wash over the orb’s surface. A figure approaches the crystal, his hand held up to shield his eyes from its brilliant sear.

~ Envisioned by Curran

Gam Of Sharks.name:
鲨群猎宴
Gam Of Sharks

Text.text:
一只海鸟在海面起伏的落脚处啼鸣。骤然奔涌的水声逼得它怒振双翼冲天而起，一张巨口自水下破浪浮现。海鸟以亡命的狂烈掠空而逃，堪堪在那张嘴合拢前躲过死劫。袭击者是一条鲨鱼，灰色的皮肤上点缀着更深的斑点，它恼怒地翻搅四周海水，搅得浪沫如沸。错失的猎物此刻已只是天边一粒微尘。更多尖锐的灰色背鳍破出水面，在水中拖出幽灵般的箭头轨迹——它们正搜寻下一顿猎食。
A seabird cries from its wavering seat upon the sea. The sound of rushing water sends it furiously flapping into the air as a monstrous set of jaws emerges from under the surface. The bird flies with death-defying fury, escaping its fate just before the mouth can close. The assailant, a shark with skin gray and peppered with darker spots, angrily thrashes the surrounding waters into a boil. Its missed catch is now no more than a speck in the sky. More sharp gray fins rise from the surface, trailing through the water like ghostly arrowheads—on the hunt for another meal.

Greeting From A Seductive Club Owner.name:
来自妖冶夜店老板的问候
Greeting From A Seductive Club Owner

Text.text:
“欢迎光临我这间寒舍——一处品味与放松并存之地。这里的陈设出自少数匠师之手，我们的侍者身着最奢华的织物，而我们多数酒桶比我年纪还大……价钱更是翻了两倍。”
“Welcome to my humble establishment—a place of taste and relaxation. Our décor has been crafted by a select few artisans, our company is clothed in the most luxurious fabrics, and most of our casks are older than I am… and twice as expensive.”

装卸码头上，集装箱堆叠成盘根错节的迷宫巢穴，货运起重机在头顶挥臂摆荡，宛如钢铁巨兽。商业与工业的喧嚣震耳欲聋：在冰冷的金属地面与箱体间回荡震颤，汇成一片翻涌不息的贸易狂响。
Shipping containers form twisting labyrinthine warrens on the loading dock as cargo cranes swing overhead like mechanical behemoths. The sounds of commerce and industry are deafening: reverberating from the cold metal of the floor and crates to form a tumultuous cacophony of trade.

那个半身人抬头看着你，把你从头到脚打量了好几秒，随后从背心里掏出一本磨旧的记事本。你隐约觉得自己像被点名一样尴尬——他先是飞快地把想法潦草记下，接着清了清嗓子，这才屈尊开口同你说话。哪怕你见惯了形形色色的怪物与恶徒，这种感觉仍让你觉得——就像一只鸟停在树枝上，而猎人正拉弓瞄准你。
The halfling looks up at you, taking you all in for a few seconds, and pulls a worn notepad out from his vest. You feel somewhat put on the spot as he scribbles his thoughts down before clearing his throat and deigning to speak with you. Despite your experience with monsters and villains of all stripes, it is a feeling, you imagine, much like being a bird perched on a branch while a hunter sights in on you with their bow.

Lake Troll Emerges From Water.name:
湖中巨魔破水而出
Lake Troll Emerges From Water

Text.text:
一件黏滑的水草披风黏在生物病态的蓝色皮肉上，它从湖中缓缓现身。刺鼻的鱼腥味在空气里飘荡，宛如正午阳光下的码头鱼市；而巨魔（特征）黏吸般沉重的脚步拖过岸边，在泥泞的堤岸上犁出一道道深深的沟壑。

~ Envisioned by Dwayne on Discord

A sallow cloak of slimy weeds clings to sickly blue flesh as the creature emerges from the lake. The pungent smell of fish wafts through the air like a dockside market in the noon sun, and the sucking plod of the troll's footsteps leaves great gouges in the muddy bank.

~ Envisioned by Dwayne on Discord

Speech By A Retiring Friend.name:
一位即将退休的朋友的致辞
Speech By A Retiring Friend

Text.text:
“当我来到你们身边时，心里满是盛大冒险的念头。无辜者被锁在高塔里，喷火的巨龙，咯咯怪笑的女巫。而我们一路同行的旅程……怎么说都算得上不同寻常，却比任何童话都更让我珍惜。只是，当我想到自己原本可能过上的人生——安静、简单——我便不由得发抖。我爱你们所有人，可我犯了个错，也对自己撒了太久的谎。我要离开了，去追寻一种新的冒险。我不知道能否找到我在找的东西，但我希望，在你们一次次闯荡之间，我还能再见到你们。”
“When I came to you all, I was filled with thoughts of grand adventure. Innocents locked in towers, fiery dragons, cackling witches. And while the journeys we’ve had together have been… different, to say the least, they have meant more to me than any fairy tale. Yet, when I think about what my life could’ve been, quiet and simple, I tremble. I love you all, but I have made a mistake, and I’ve been lying to myself for too long. I’m leaving for a new kind of adventure. I don’t know if I’ll find what I’m looking for, but I hope, between all your escapades, I will get to see you again.”

Laemlis Caerdonal, Crusader Of Conquest.name:
莱姆利斯·凯尔多纳尔，征服十字军
Laemlis Caerdonal, Crusader Of Conquest

Text.text:
有人认得他傲慢而冷酷，是米瑞尔那自负的孪生兄弟，被对权势的意志驱策。也有人凭他护手上摇曳的香炉与自其中涌出的威能认出他——那力量根植于他对神圣秩序与誓约的奉献。他的家族则称他为冠军：野心勃勃却忠诚如铁，挺立其上守望不眠，将自己与他们、与他们的名号一并奉上。他是这一切，是阴影与光明的缟玛瑙与大理石白，披着攫取之金铸成的甲胄。

~ 由一位英雄 Played

Some know him as arrogant and ruthless, the pompous twin to Myrill driven by his will to power. Some know him by the censer that dangles from his gauntlet and the power emanating from it, a power rooted in his dedication to holy order and oath. His family knows him as a champion, ambitious but fiercely loyal, standing tall over them in vigil, devoted to them and their name. He is all of these, all the onyx and marble white of shadow and light, armored in the gold of acquisition.

~ Played by a Hero

山谷仿佛无尽延展。构成两侧的群山呈现出纹理与秩序，像被精心雕绘过一般，景象诡谲而超现实。它们的石质山脚深深扎入大地，山巅却接触到一层闪烁的位面，仿佛天空是流动的水银。山谷间，一尊泰坦奔行其上，咆哮震天，狂乱挥击，在绝望而孤独的暴怒中横冲直撞，摧毁一切他所能接触之物，并为解脱而哀号。

~ 由一位英雄Envisioned

The valley seems to extend infinitely. The mountains that form its sides are patterned, designed, and the landscape surreal. Their stone feet are rooted in earth, but their peaks touch a shimmering plane, as if the sky is mercury. Through the valley runs a Titan, roaring, swinging wildly in a desperate, lonely rage, destroying what he can touch and wailing for release.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

你抬手一指，吐出那些词——低沉刺耳的喉音，搅得你腹中翻涌欲呕。一团腐臭的雾气在你面前凭空盘旋而生，随即迅速膨胀，充满整个空间，遮蔽一切视线；随之而来的恶臭令人发狂——像是烈日曝晒的垃圾、腐烂的肉与粪便混杂在一起。
You point and speak the words—guttural, harsh words that stir nausea in your gut. A putrid mist swirls into existence before you, immediately expanding to fill the space and obscure all vision, bringing with it a heinous smell—something akin to sun-baked refuse, rotting flesh, and feces.

Williame Of The Sea.name:
海之威廉姆
Williame Of The Sea

Text.text:
他走过之处，空气里都带着刺人的盐味。他高大敦实，常年曝晒在海风卷来的烈日下，皮肤成了焦赭色；这位浪里讨生活的老兵遍体疤痕，步子沉得像踩着船板，仿佛随时等着脚下的大地也跟着晃起来。贴头短发灰白相间，像岩石上紧攀的地衣；最明亮的蓝眼从被盐蚀的面庞里凿出锐利的光。虽然他的锁子护甲因细心保养而闪着光，但衣物几乎都被那夺走他苍白肤色的太阳漂得褪了色。一枚华丽的徽记挂在三重打结的腰带上，他粗壮的拳头里攥着一柄结实的大长矛，造得足以叉穿鲸鱼……或任何挡他路的东西。

~ Played by poisonokie with

Salt stings the air in his wake. Tall, stocky, burnt umber from so many days under the harsh sea-swung sun, this scarred veteran of the waves seems heavy in his feet, as if expecting the very ground to wobble beneath him. A close crop of salt-and-pepper hair grips his skull like lichen on rock, and eyes of brightest blue bore out from his salt-bitten face. Though his chain armor gleams from obvious care, almost all his clothing has been bleached by the same sun that robbed him of his pale complexion. An ornate symbol hangs from a thrice-knotted belt, and in his hefty fist sits a large pike well built to harpoon whales… or anything else that gets in his way.

~ Played by poisonokie with

起初它与一棵倒伏的原始古树毫无二致，你却猛然惊觉：这位老家伙盘结的根与虬曲的枝，正组成一头庞大树人的双足与双手。你凝望着，惊叹于这腐朽生物不可思议的年代——就在此时，细小的光点正四下聚拢而来——那是森林的灵魄，正忙着收回这具沉睡意识的化身。

~ 一位英雄所构想

At first indistinguishable from a fallen old-growth tree, you realize with a start that the root and branch of this old fellow form the feet and hands of an enormous treant. Even as you watch, marveling at the incredible age of this decaying creature, you see tiny motes of light gathering around—the spirits of the forest working to reclaim this incarnation of its dormant consciousness.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Eniri Of The Fenriir.name:
芬里尔之伊妮莉
Eniri Of The Fenriir

Text.text:
她站得像她本就是的族长那般——威严而笃定，足以点燃战士们的斗志。她高挑清瘦，披着熊皮斗篷，外罩部族以兽皮与毛皮制成的护甲；手中战斧由矿中采得、锻炉铸成、再细细磨刃，正合一位在战场上强悍而可怖的领袖之用。和平时，她热情友善，褐发不束于头盔之下，自由垂落；她的玩笑同任何芬里尔人一样粗犷张扬。

~ Played by Walt M.

She stands like the chieftain she is, regal and sure, an inspiration to her warriors. Tall and lean, she wears a bearskin cloak over her tribe’s armor of hide and fur and carries a battle-axe mined, forged, and sharpened to suit a leader who is strong and fearsome in war. In times of peace, she is welcoming and kind, her brown hair free of a helm, her humor as brash as any Fenriir.

~ Played by Walt M.

Sundries From A Hezrou.name:
来自赫兹洛的杂物
Sundries From A Hezrou

Text.text:
巨大的鳞片与碎屑散落一地，夹杂着些许带黏的蜕皮，还有一滩滩小小的黏液积在尸身下方。那股恶臭几乎浓烈到让你无法呼吸。
Large flakes and scales, some snotty molt, and little puddles of ooze lie on the floor under the body. The mess reeks almost beyond your ability to breathe.

Abandoned Lunatic Asylum: Deaths Uncount.name:
废弃疯人院：死者无数
Abandoned Lunatic Asylum: Deaths Uncounted

Text.text:
