你踏入了一座鬼魅的巢穴。你听见亡者的说话声多得不可思议，仿佛这里曾同时住过的人也比不上。那些幽魂一定是在数十年的死亡里层层堆积起来的，就像一座墓园，坟坑越挖越深，只为埋下不断垒高的尸身。你正这么想着，耳边便响起苍蝇的嗡鸣，仿佛所有坟墓都敞着口。
You have entered a hive of haunts. You hear more dead speaking than could ever have lived here at one time. The ghosts must have built up over decades of deaths, like a cemetery with graves dug deeper to bury growing stacks of bodies. As you think this, you hear the buzz of flies, as if all the graves lie open.

一名类昆虫身影倚着一根雅致的手杖，姿态如同贵胄般威严。祂身披加固长袍，其上烙印着紫色星辰的徽记；兜帽向后掀起，露出一颗歪斜的几丁质头颅，上面刻满仪式性的疤纹。一侧颚钳被一道深裂的伤口撕破，触目惊心。祂仿佛陷入狂喜，双眼上翻没入眼眶，一只利爪伸向头顶的天穹。这是一场令人难以移开视线的表演，狂热与虔诚扑面而来。祂口中吐出的言辞……似乎潜藏着某种遥远的力量。
An insectoid figure leans upon an elegant cane, giving them a lordly bearing. Dressed in reinforced robes emblazoned with the mark of a purple star, their hood is thrown back to reveal a crooked chitinous head scarred with ritualistic patterns. A deep wound mars one of their mandibles. They seem as though in a rapture, their eyes rolling back into their head, one claw stretched to the sky above. It is a captivating performance full of zeal. The words they speak… there is a distant power in them, perhaps.

峡谷两侧峭壁高耸，沿着溪流在岩石谷底蜿蜒的路径一路延伸。岸边植被稀少，仿佛在暗示这片谷地常被奔涌的洪水反复淹没。高悬在崖顶之上的灰色天幕预告着雨势将至，你只盼河水的上涨只是季节性的。
The walls of the gorge rise high on either side, following the stream’s path through the rocky bottom. The shores have little vegetation, hinting that regular rushing flows flood the vale. Gray skies high above the clifftops predict rain, and you hope the rise of the river is seasonal.

身形修长、腿长而利落，蔚蓝色皮肤下绷着一束束修长的肌肉；红唇微启，露出令人卸防的笑意——这位提夫林女子的惊艳与威势一并压来，逼得你无法移开视线。她披着一袭猩红斗篷，斗篷上绣着无睑之眼，步履从容而优雅；手边始终不离一根纤秀的魔杖，杖顶镶着一枚白色宝石。

~ 由 Jessica 扮演

Lean and leggy, with long, corded muscles beneath azure skin and red lips that part in a disarming smile—the tiefling woman’s striking, commanding presence demands your attention. She moves with an easy grace in a scarlet cloak emblazoned with lidless eyes, and keeps close at hand an elegant wand topped with a white gemstone.

~ Played by Jessica

Sindyl Erlshade.name:
辛迪尔·厄尔影荫
Sindyl Erlshade

Text.text:
这名弓手步履轻盈而笃定，走到哪儿都带着笑。她的长裤与束腰外衣实用得体——皮背心、靴子与射箭手套亦然——但布料用双道线密密缝牢，色彩明快；皮革上压印着繁复纹样作点缀。她被日光晒成蜜色的肌肤光滑，五官优雅利落；细致的发辫与上过清漆的发簪将她坚果棕的头发固定在一旁，不让它遮住那双锐利的海蓝绿眼睛。这样的装束也露出了她耳尖那一点微微的尖翘。她背上的挽具稳稳托着漆面长弓与配套箭袋，旁边还挂着一把擦得锃亮、雕工精巧的竖琴。

~ 由一位英雄 扮演

This archer moves with grace and confidence, grinning as she goes. Her pants and tunic are practical—as are her leather gilet, boots, and archery gloves—but the cloth is double-stitched and colorful, and the leather embellished with stamped patterns. Her suntanned skin is smooth, her features elegant, and precise braids and varnished pins hold her nut-brown hair away from her sharp aquamarine eyes. The style reveals the slight point on her ears. A harness holds her lacquered bow and matching quiver on her back, along with a polished, delicately carved lyre.

~ Played by a Hero

Loot From An Orc Shaman.name:
兽人萨满的战利品
Loot From An Orc Shaman

Text.text:
萨满蜷作一团倒在地上，披着狼皮披肩的肩头耸起；那一长条细密毛皮在夺走其性命的冲突中竟毫发无损。一枚坠饰——一只铁铸之眼，周围环绕着锈蚀的尖刺——由一条黑铁链垂落，正落在其染血的胸口中央。热意从那只眼中央的红宝石里隐隐散出，宝石般的瞳孔闪烁着灼亮的光，仿佛在燃烧。
The shaman lies in a heap, shoulders hunched under their wolf-skin shawl, a fine length of fur undamaged by the skirmish that claimed their life. A medallion—an iron eye wreathed in rusting spikes—hangs from a black iron chain in the center of their bloodstained chest. Heat emanates from the ruby in the center of the eye, a gemstone pupil gleaming and burning.

Insult About Warping Words.name:
关于歪曲言辞的侮辱
Insult About Warping Words

Text.text:
“我并不怀疑你说的是真话，但你话里藏着的意图让我不寒而栗。”
“While I don’t doubt that your words are true, the intent behind them disturbs me.”

God Of Elemental Water.name:
元素之水之神
God Of Elemental Water

Text.text:
他现身了：一个蓝绿相间、覆鳞生鳍的男人，正调塑着自己的形貌，好让陆居者在对上他那只毫无表情的眼睛时，能稍微舒服一些。他带着异界的气味：青绿海藻与咸盐，还有对陆居者——对那位夺取者而言——他同族的腥臭，鱼群与人鱼的味道。他巨大的蹼足在水洼里张开，随即咧开宽阔的嘴，用海豚之歌般的咔嗒与尖啸开口说话。
He appears now, a blue-green man of scales and fins, shaping himself to make the land-dwellers more comfortable as they stare into one of his expressionless eyes. He smells of the alien world: green kelp, salt, and what to the land-dweller—the taker—is the reek of his kin, the fishes and merfolk. His enormous webbed feet splay before him in a puddle, and he opens his broad mouth to speaks in the clicks and squeals of dolphin song.

Story About A Cursed Flame.name:
关于诅咒之焰的故事
Story About A Cursed Flame

Text.text:
“很久很久以前的某个夜晚，我床边的壁炉对我开口说话。我常常坐起身，任由它跳动的光照在脸上，一坐就是好几个小时。它讲述黑暗之地，讲述痛苦与失去的所在，可我仍旧凝视着，像饥饿的人吞噬幻景般贪婪。后来，那座家园在一场大火中化为乌有。也许是我喂给火焰的太多——也许不过是命运的一次扭转。然而我总觉得，那团火的灵已经烙进了我身上，那一夜我所受的每一道灼伤与疤痕，都是它的印记。也许终有一天，它会回到我身边，带我去往那火焰之外的彼岸之地。”
“One night, a long time ago, my bedside hearth spoke to me. I would sit up for hours basking in its flickering light. It spoke of dark places, places of pain and loss, but still I watched, hungrily devouring its visions. Eventually, that home was lost to a fire. Perhaps I had fed the flames too much—or perhaps it was simply a twist of fate. Yet, I feel as though the spirit of that fire was imprinted on me in every burn and scar I suffered that night. Maybe someday it will return to me and take me to that place beyond the flame.”

Military Cruiser: Orderly Crew Quarters.name:
军用巡洋舰：井然有序的船员舱房
Military Cruiser: Orderly Crew Quarters

Text.text:
一排排铺位沿着这间巨大的房间延伸，看不到任何个人痕迹。床铺如同严整的方阵般一丝不苟地排列着，每个床位都被收拾得干净利落，床尾还放着一只硕大的脚柜。空气里弥漫着几乎令人窒息的上光剂气味，乙烯基地面把头顶灯光映得纤毫毕现，亮得刺眼。
Bunks line the huge room bereft of any form of personal expression. The beds stand in rigid phalanx, each berth meticulously clean and ordered with a large footlocker at one end. The smell of polish is almost overpowering and the vinyl floor reflects the lights above with startling clarity.

Solitary Roadhouse On An Otherwise Barre.name:
荒凉小行星上唯一的路边酒馆
Solitary Roadhouse On An Otherwise Barren Asteroid

Text.text:
当那颗小行星几乎要从你的余光中滑走时，你才终于瞥见了目的地：一幢孤零零的破棚建筑，顽固地趴在荒瘠的岩面上，像是在这片死寂的荒原里公然插下旗帜，宣示主权。附近只停着寥寥几艘货运船，它们的船体被酒馆歪斜门楣上方忽明忽暗的霓虹招牌洒下的光染亮。
The asteroid has almost left your peripheral vision when you spot the place. A single ramshackle building squatting obstinately on the barren rock, defiantly staking its claim to the desolate landscape. A small number of cargo vessels have landed nearby, their chassis bathed in the light of the flickering neon sign above the tavern’s lopsided door.

这是一头由未加雕琢的原始肌肉堆砌而成的魁伟巨兽，宛如半神般高耸，俯视着绝大多数存在。生物的面孔被一只巨大的独眼所占据；它那庞然躯体几乎不着寸缕，唯有一条鞣制皮革的缠腰布勉强遮身，边缘缝着沾满尘泥的粗硬兽毛。独眼巨人将一根大得骇人的木棒随手抡起，仿佛只是一截细枝；木头里楔入的碎石锋片上，抹着早已干涸发黑的血污。
A hulking behemoth of raw, un-sculpted muscle, this being towers above most others like a demi-god. A large, singular eye dominates the creature’s face, and little covers its massive body save a loincloth of cured leather hemmed with dirt-encrusted fur. The cyclops hefts a wooden club of prodigious size as if it were a twig, and the stone shards driven through the wood are smeared with dried gore.

I Have Second Wind.name:
我有「第二次呼吸」
I Have Second Wind

Text.text:
我被那记重击打得踉跄后退。但我还是停下片刻，阖上双眼，深深吸气；随即嘴角一挑，带着一抹坏笑，再次将我的武器对准敌人。
I stagger from that last hit. But I take a moment, close my eyes, breathe deep, then with a smirk I level my weapon at my enemy again.

Alchemical Vial Of True Air.name:
真空炼金小瓶
Alchemical Vial Of True Air

Text.text:
一只矮小的玻璃小瓶里，狂怒的西风在其中翻涌旋舞。瓶中四方之风争夺主宰，细碎的雨点、尘土与残屑溅洒在瓶壁上。小瓶底部，一团黑云以珠光般的褶皱聚拢，间歇迸发噼啪雷鸣。
A short vial swirls with the force of raging zephyrs. Within, four winds compete for dominance, spattering the glass with miniature rain, dust, and debris. At the base of the vial, a dark cloud gathers in pearly folds, crackling with intermittent thunder.

Drunken Partygoer.name:
醉醺醺的宴会客
Drunken Partygoer

Text.text:
醉醺醺的狂欢者怀里像抱着珍宝般搂着一罐起泡的黄色液体，踉踉跄跄地晃了过去，软绵绵地抬手致意。他们脸上浮着一抹困惑又好笑的笑意，仿佛沉在只属于自己的梦里；行动却像被拙劣操纵的木偶，抽动、摇摆，步伐凌乱不稳。
Cradling a can of foaming, yellow liquid like a prized possession, the drunken reveler staggers by, waving a limp hand in greeting. A bemused smile softens their face as if they are lost in a private dream, and they move like a poorly operated puppet, with jerking, unsteady motions.

Loot From An Annis Hag.name:
安妮斯鬼婆的战利品
Loot From An Annis Hag

Text.text:
尽管战斗凶猛，这名山地鬼婆围裙却似乎毫发无损——围裙由琥珀色、略带油光的皮革制成。一把巨大的剁肉刀插在前襟口袋里，未被陈血染污之处，锋刃寒光逼人。两枚黑铁钱币串在链子上，挂在那粗壮的脖颈间。
Despite the ferocity of the battle, the mountain hag’s apron, made from an amber-hued and slightly oily leather, seems undamaged. An enormous meat cleaver sits in the front pocket, keen edge shining where it is not stained with old blood. Two black iron coins are strung on a chain around the burly neck.

Aasimar Standing With Greatsword.name:
持巨剑而立的天裔
Aasimar Standing With Greatsword

Text.text:
天裔的双眼在一头乌黑长发下闪着金辉，恰如哨兵的护甲与罩袍般冷冽而庄严。左肩覆着一枚巨大的青铜肩甲，边缘沿着三角肌向上翘起成锋利的弧线。天裔的披风以一枚璀璨的金别针固定。戴着皮手套的双手安然搭在一柄锻造得耀眼夺目的巨剑上。
The eyes of the celestialkin are as gold under a head of long black hair as the sentinel’s armor and tabard. On the left shoulder is a giant bronze pauldron, its lip curved upward along the deltoid. The celestialkin’s cape is held on with a brilliant gold pin. Their leather-gloved hands rest on a brilliantly smithed greatsword.

这架竖琴被剔除得只剩最必要的部件，轻巧到足以舒适地固定在竖琴师的轮椅上。琴足经过特别改造，变成宽阔平坦的位面，更好地分散乐器重量，让雕刻木制琴身得以优雅挺立，升至完整高度。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，出自 Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Stripped of all but the most necessary elements, this harp is light enough to be affixed comfortably to the harpist’s wheelchair. The foot has been specially altered into a wide, flat plane able to better distribute the instrument’s weight, allowing the carved wooden body to rise gracefully to its full height.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

战士如其生般死去——倒在刀刃之下。尸体的面容凝固在临终那一声怒吼里，双眼仍圆睁，燃着狂怒与憎恨。无头的躯干横陈在血浸的地面上，动脉喷溅的血迹勾勒出头颅飞离时的轨迹。
The warrior died as they lived—by the edge of a blade. The corpse’s face is frozen in the bellow of rage that marked their final moment, eyes still wide with fury and hatred. The decapitated body lies on the blood-soaked ground, with arterial spray marking the trajectory of the head as it flew.

伴随着一声震天的吱呀巨响，片刻前还像树木的东西猛然踉跄着向前逼近。缕缕光芒从它树皮般的外壳裂缝里艰难渗出。它的躯体由枝杈与藤蔓纠缠成团，像肌肉般穿梭绞结。每当它那修长的手臂猛力一扯，或躯干一拧，构成它头颅与面孔的结节群便挤出阵阵嘶哑的呻吟。 With a massive creak, what looked like a tree moments ago lurches forward. Streaks of light eke through the cracks in its arboreal rind. Its body is a tangle of twig and vine threading like muscle. With each wrench of its long arms or twist of its torso, groans wheeze out from the collection of knots that form its head and face.

Expertly Crafted Optical Scope.name:
匠心打造的光学瞄准镜
Expertly Crafted Optical Scope

Text.text:
这台漆黑如墨的装置堪称科学奇迹，是一件精密到极致、力量绝对的工具。只需按下开关，它便融入一套远程瞄准系统；先进的传感器与数字显示屏让使用者将目标尽收眼底。
The jet-black device is a scientific marvel, a tool of utter precision and absolute power. By depressing a switch, it melds into a long-range targeting system, with advanced sensors and a digital display giving the user a clear view of the target.

Ioun Stone Of Regeneration.name:
再生灵石
Ioun Stone Of Regeneration

Text.text:
那枚白色纺锤体一开始绕着你的头颅盘旋，你的皮肤便泛起一阵温热而舒适的麻痒感。短短几分钟内，你就看见手掌与手臂上那些细小的割伤与创口已然自行愈合，露出一层新生的鲜嫩肌肤。
The instant the white spindle begins circumnavigating your head, your skin begins to tingle with a warm, comfortable sensation. Within minutes, you see that minor cuts and wounds along your hands and arms have already healed over, revealing fresh new skin.

Professor Cornelius Knoxx.name:
科尼利厄斯·诺克斯教授
Professor Cornelius Knoxx

Text.text:
你注意到一位老者正对着自己嘀咕，埋首于几本厚重的巨册之间。他身形瘦长，披着起褶的长袍，鼓胀的袖口沾满墨渍。粗框眼镜放大了他锐利的蓝眼睛，那目光倏然抬起，只一瞬便游走着审视你。男人蜡黄的面皮与灯芯般的胡须又长又老，他的脑袋以完美的节拍扭动着，仿佛与肩上那只古怪的猫头鹰同频。他停下呢喃，含住一支长长的木烟斗吸了一口——带着祖父般的笑意，示意你开口。

~ Played by Ressie

You notice an elderly man muttering to himself as he pores over several heavy tomes. His slender frame is draped in creased robes, their billowing cuffs stained with ink. Thick-rimmed glasses magnify his sharp blue eyes, which snap up to scrutinize you in a single roving moment. The man’s waxy face and wicklike beard are long and aged, and his head twists in perfect rhythm with the odd owl perched on his shoulder. He ceases his muttering to suck on a long wooden pipe and—with a grandfatherly smile—invites you to speak.

~ Played by Ressie

I Cast Lightning Bolt From My Staff Of P.name:
我从权杖法杖中施放闪电束
I Cast Lightning Bolt From My Staff Of Power

Text.text:
我的双眼渐渐阴沉，如同风暴将至。我从法杖中召唤出毁灭性的魔法，凝视着噼啪作响的蓝色能量在杖身上跳跃迸散。电光化作混乱扭动的雷矢迸射而出，拖着撕裂长空的光痕直扑敌人，宛如暴怒神祇的天罚。
My eyes grow dark just like the coming storm. I summon the destructive magic from my staff and watch small shocks of crackling blue energy leap along the haft. Lightning arcs out in a chaotic, writhing bolt, streaking towards my foes like the wrath of an angry god.

Ostentatious Galleon Airship.name:
浮夸的盖伦飞空舰
Ostentatious Galleon Airship

Text.text:
最显眼、最张扬的奢靡财富宣言，这艘船看起来像一只舞会高跟鞋——却有板球场般的长度，仿佛出自疯子之手。十来片鳍翼从船身两侧向外触及，船体的肋骨与梁架几乎通体由黄铜与黄金构成。抛光硬木甲板上，既摆着覆白布、配水晶餐具的餐桌，也沿着栏杆环列着黑铁火炮。船尾一簇烟囱向下探出，在引擎之下向后卷曲；而那引擎却出奇地安静。
The most conspicuous statement of exorbitant wealth, this ship looks like a ballroom heel, but with the length of a cricket pitch and designed by the demented. A dozen fins reach out from the ship’s sides, the ribbing and beamwork of the ship almost entirely brass and gold. Polished hardwood decks hold both white cloth dining tables with crystal settings and black iron guns around the railings. In the stern a cluster of smokestacks sticks down and curls backward under the engines, which are surprisingly quiet.

Quip About Bad Plans.name:
对馊主意的吐槽
Quip About Bad Plans

Text.text:
“好吧，这听起来也许挺冒险——我知道我以前也做过几次糟糕的决定——但我希望你们都记住：计划在成功之前，看起来都很蠢。”
“Ok, this may sound risky—and I know I’ve made a few bad calls in the past—but I want you all to remember that a plan is only stupid until it works.”

Abandoned Goblin City.name:
废弃的地精之城
Abandoned Goblin City

Text.text:
地精城市的街道与小巷毫无规律可循——彼此以令人抓狂的角度交错穿插——两侧林立的建筑简陋、随意，却异常结实。再仔细一看，你才发现这些屋舍竟是由巨型昆虫的几丁质外骨骼拼接而成：先将其掏空，再彼此嵌合，便形成了棚屋、储藏间，甚至还有一处位于镇中心、覆顶遮蔽的公共区域。
The streets and alleyways of the goblin city follow no discernible pattern—criss-crossing one another at maddening angles—and the structures lining them are simple, haphazard but sturdy. On closer inspection you realize the buildings are composed of the chitinous exoskeletons of massive insects, hollowed-out and fitted together to form hovels, storerooms, even a covered common area at the center of town.

Swimming Pool In Creepy Manor.name:
阴森庄园里的游泳池
Swimming Pool In Creepy Manor

Text.text:
你踏入这间厅室，热浪如重压般扑面而来，蒸汽黏腻得几乎令人窒息。屋基被掏出一座方形的室内泳池，深陷于建筑的地基之中；你暗自祈祷池水源自天然温泉。然而此处却有一股与温度无关的寒意，你的面容倒映在水面上，被扭曲成怪诞的形状。池子的尽头——池底那团阴暗的轮廓，是一具尸体……还是某种截然不同的东西？
The heat is oppressive, the steam cloying, as you enter this chamber. A square pool for indoor swimming is sunk into the building’s foundation, its waters, you hope, derived from a natural hot spring. Yet there is a chill in this place unrelated to temperature, the reflection of your face twisted into grotesque shapes. And at the far end of the pool—is that dark shape on the bottom a body… or something else entirely?

Signs That An Army Passed Through.name:
军队曾经途经的迹象
Signs That An Army Passed Through

Text.text:
无数双脚把这片原野踩成了一片烂泥沼泽。你不时能看见蹄印与车辙，但它们的痕迹被朝同一方向涌去的人潮反复践踏得模糊不清。你凝神细看，发现泥浆里夹着被遗弃又被踩进烂泥的杂物碎片：一截苹果核、一面碎裂的盾牌、一件染血的衬衣。
Countless feet have churned the field into a morass of mud. Here and there you spot hoofprints and cart tracks, but their trails are trammeled by a huge number of people heading the same direction. Looking carefully, you spot bits of trash left behind and pressed into the muck: an apple core, a shattered shield, a bloody shirt.

当你穿过这片昏暗的区域时，墙上的某道阴影骤然从石面脱离——径直扑向你！它的轮廓隐约呈人形，黑影猛然前冲，试图以那亡灵般汲取生机的死亡灵光将你彻底吞没。
As you move through the dimly lit area, one of the shadows suddenly leaps off the wall—and directly at you! Vaguely humanoid in shape, the shadow's form lunges, seeking to envelop you within its life-draining aura of undeath.

Taunt After A Near Miss.name:
擦肩而过后的嘲弄
Taunt After A Near Miss

Text.text:
“抱歉，这是在跟我说吗？还是你跟那面墙有什么我不知道的陈年旧怨？”
“Sorry, was that meant for me? Or do you have some long-running dispute with the wall I’m unaware of?”

Crowded Sidewalk.name:
拥挤的人行道
Crowded Sidewalk

Text.text:
形形色色的人挤满了这条宽阔的人行道——肩挨肩的躯体、喧嚣的交谈声、头顶盘旋的无人机——下层企业人的闪亮套装与街头朋克阴狠的纹身、下水道垃圾般的褴褛身影、以及美貌模特过分完美的光泽交织在一起，他们的假脸闪闪发亮。只有在这里，你才会看到这样的混杂。前方的人群忽然被粗暴推开，争吵声随之响起。一个高大的男人身穿红色细条纹西装，整个人被一层青绿的个人空间泡罩包裹，昂首阔步穿过人海。
All manner of folk crowd this wide sidewalk—packed bodies, voices chattering, drones hovering above—the flash suits of lower-rung corpos mix with the grim tattoos of street punks, the ragged shapes of gutter trash, and the too-perfect sheen of beauty models, their fake faces sparkling. Only here would you see such a mix. Up ahead, people are abruptly pushed aside, and there is the sound of arguing. A large man wearing a red pinstripe suit and encased in a turquoise personal-space bubble strides through the crowd.

皱缩的血肉像一颗腐败的葡萄，紧紧黏附在这……生物枯槁的躯壳上。它的构造彻底陌异，这诡异的存在以一种你难以理解的方式搅得你胃里翻涌。这不只是厌恶，而是一种源自本能深处的反感。它顶端那跳动的孔口飘出腐鱼的恶臭，孔内带倒刺的触须在你靠近时疯狂抽搐——仿佛嗅到了新鲜的肉。
Puckered flesh, like a rancid grape, clings to the withered form of this… creature. Utterly alien in its composition, the strange being turns your stomach in ways you don’t fully understand. More than mere disgust, this is revulsion on a primal level. The smell of rotting fish drifts from the pulsating orifice at its apex, and the barbed tentacles within thrash wildly as you approach—perhaps sensing fresh meat.

Haunted Crypt: Inside The Crypt.name:
闹鬼地穴：地穴内部
Haunted Crypt: Inside The Crypt

Text.text:
在地窖拱顶的黑暗中，天花板仍让人感到逼仄，墙壁——沉坠着死亡、被霉斑染得乌黑——仿佛正向内挤压。你清楚自己正踏在死者的足迹上：那些久远之前建造此地的人，以及把他人埋进这里的人——如今也许同样长眠于此。这里不是活人该踏足的地方。
In the vaulted darkness of the crypt, the ceiling still feels close, and the walls—weighted with death and black with mold—seem to press inward. You’re conscious that you walk in the footsteps of the dead: those who built this place long ago and those who buried people in it—now perhaps entombed here as well. This is no place for the living to tread.

焦糖烧焦般的卷发垂落在她高而苍白的额头上，从那层轻若蛛丝、优雅缠绕头顶的薄纱下倾泻而下。她有着洋娃娃般精致的五官。她的眼睛又大又银，缀着血丝般的红，从涂得蛛网似的睫毛膏拉长的睫下空洞地凝视着。她的嘴像一朵俏生生的花，紧张咬唇时口红总会蹭到牙齿上。她的双手一刻不停，两根细如匕首的编织针在指间闪着冷光，挑着粉、白、红的线穿梭起落——在她轻纱长裙的胸前织出一片古怪的拼缀。那图案一瞬像一束端丽的花，下一瞬又像一堆脏器，被用鲜明的细节一针一线缝得栩栩如生。

~ 摘自精彩的TTRPG补充资料 The Vineyard

Ringlets the color of burnt caramel spill over her tall, pale brow, descending from a gossamer veil wrapped daintily about her head. She has the delicate features of a doll. Her eyes, large, silver, and laced with red, stare blankly from under long lashes spidery with mascara. Her mouth is a pert blossom, the lipstick scraping onto her teeth each time she nervously bites her lip. Her hands are in constant motion, a pair of stiletto-thin knitting needles glinting as her fingers maneuver them through pink, white, red thread—creating a strange patchwork over the chest of her gauzy gown. The design at one moment resembles an elegant bouquet of flowers and, in the next, a pile of viscera sewn in vivid detail.

~ Found in the amazing TTRPG supplement The Vineyard

Shark Bites Through Ship's Guardrail.name:
鲨鱼一口咬穿船舷护栏
Shark Bites Through Ship's Guardrail

Text.text:
伴随着一阵筋肉抽搐，那头流线型的海洋掠食者如离弦之箭般自浪间破水而出，巨口大张。锯齿般的牙列泛着象牙般的冷光，在你拼命后仰、试图逃离时愈逼愈近。只听一声仿佛骨裂般的脆响，利颌狠狠撞碎了船舷的护栏，撕毁了骇人规模的结构。那生物再度坠回浪涛的庇护之中时，顺势一翻身——将它修长而强健的肌体全貌尽数展露。

~ 由 Clara C. Potter 在 Discord 上为 Envisioned 构想

With a spasm of sinewy muscle the sleek ocean predator launches itself from the waves like an arrow, jaws agape. The ivory sheen of serrated teeth draws ever closer as you hurl yourself backward, desperate to escape. With a crunch like splintering bone the jaws smash through the ship's guard rail, destroying a terrifying amount of the construction. As the creature plummets back to the safety of the waves once more, it flips—displaying the full length of its lithe, muscular body.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

God Of The Wind.name:
风之神
God Of The Wind

Text.text:
他们本为一体，却生着四颗头颅，无性无别，如一簇云铸的面孔，沿着磁罗盘的方位缓缓旋转。各自当令之季，便压过其余，权势更盛：北方的玻瑞阿斯，冬须如霜；南方的诺图斯，盛夏长发；西方的泽菲罗斯，花开正盛；东方的欧鲁斯，叶色赤褐。他们今日可化作风暴，明日又成轻风。他们或为世界授粉，或将树木连根撕离；他们的交谈同样险恶而强大，恰如我们的心绪，随天气而变。
They are one, but four-headed, without gender or sex, a cluster of cloud-faces revolving toward magnetic compass points. Each gains power over the others during its season. Winter-bearded Boreas of the north, Notus of the summer-haired south, Western blooming Zephyros, and Eurus of the russet eastern leaves. They are a tempest one day, a breeze the next. They pollinate the world or rip trees from it, and their conversation is as treacherous and mighty as our own moods that change with the weather.

飞船穿过明亮的冬日晴空逼近，起初你根本无法判断它的确切体型。螺旋桨的嗡鸣先一步传来，暗示着要让这艘巨大的飞船升空需要何等澎湃的动力。它越靠越近，你也许只是被凛冽的空气呛得下意识倒吸一口气。流线的外形、宏阔的风帆，以及船艏精雕细琢的纹饰，无不昭示着它的华美与威势。

~ 由 Arlekin 构想

The ship approaches through a bright winter sky, and it’s impossible to determine its exact size at first. The hum of its propellors reaches you, hinting at how much power is required to fly the great dirigible. Then it comes closer, and maybe it’s just the crisp air that makes you instinctively gasp. Its sleek design, great sails, and exquisite carvings in the bow all stand testimony to its splendor and might.

~ Envisioned by Arlekin

Wicker Skeleton.name:
柳条骷髅（特征）
Wicker Skeleton

Text.text:
一个瘦长的身影拨开芦苇挤了出来，踉跄的四肢像被提线操纵般抽动。你看见一具人形的骷髅（特征），却不是由骨头构成——它的身躯完全以细密编织的柳条打造。一个矮胖篮筐般的头颅在脖颈上猛地旋转整整一圈，空洞的眼窝四下搜寻，额心绘着一道符号。每一次移动，它的形体都会发出空空的吱嘎声，像濒死树木的枯枝在风中摩擦。

~ 由 SpaceVulture 构想

A thin figure pushes through the reeds, its faltering limbs moving as if pulled by a puppeteer’s strings. You see a humanoid skeleton, but not one of bones—its body is entirely crafted of finely woven wicker. A head shaped like a squat basket swivels all the way around upon its neck, empty eyes searching, a painted symbol in the middle of its forehead. With each movement, its form emits a hollow creak like the branches of a dying tree.

~ Envisioned by SpaceVulture

Staff Of The Magi.name:
魔法师之杖
Staff Of The Magi

Text.text:
这根长杖由难以辨认的金属锻造而成，杖首盘结着一簇交织的枝条，分开、再分裂、再度分开。杖身深深刻着神秘的符文——以淡蓝色的微光缓缓脉动。尽管造型相当朴素，这根法杖却仿佛嗡鸣着一股浩瀚的存在感。
The long staff, forged from unidentifiable metal, is topped with a set of weaving branches which part and split and part again. Mysterious runes—pulsing slowly with a pale-blue light—are carved deep into the shaft. Despite its rather simple design, the staff seems to buzz with an immense presence.

Cybernetic Torso Augmentation +1.name:
义体躯干强化 +1
Cybernetic Torso Augmentation +1

Text.text:
心脏是最先被改造的部位——以导线束缚的离子电流强行增压，让人得以手动掌控自己的心率。右肩关节被替换成一颗钨制球体，实现完整的360度移动。胸腔与中背的大部分区域则以高密度材料加固，外观宛如不可思议的肌肉隆起，并使使用者足以硬抗轻武器火力。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The heart has been the first thing to change, supercharged with wired ionic electricity permitting manual control of one’s heart rate. The right shoulder joint has been replaced with a tungsten ball for full 360-degree movement. Much of the chest and middle back have been reinforced with high-density materials, giving the impression of incredible musculature and allowing the user to weather small arms fire.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

学生们在此，在草药学教授的指导下学习打理学院的土地：四周铺展开来的是一片片种植圃、成行的田畦与林地——那是学院仍为中世纪要塞时遗留下的风貌。他们的园艺课程一年比一年严苛，从各组负责地块的繁茂与否，便能看出哪支队伍技艺最精。看守者也常在这里开设动物学课程。
Students study here, under the tutelage of the Herbology professor, to tend the academy grounds: an apron in all directions of plots, crop tracts, and woodlands from its days of being a medieval keep. Their horticultural studies progress in intensity each year, and one can tell from the health of the plots they manage which teams are the most skilled. The Keeper often holds zoology classes here, as well.

你只需说出一句短语，敌人便会被彩色火焰清晰勾勒出轮廓。那些幻象之焰不会灼烧，却足以让受影响者一目了然——也更容易成为目标。
With a single spoken phrase, your enemies are clearly limned in colored flames. The illusory flames don’t burn, but they certainly make those affected easy to see—and to target.

Flow Of Time In The Faerie Plane.name:
妖精位面的时代流动
Flow Of Time In The Faerie Plane

Text.text:
你所熟知的时代，是一条线性的洪流，是你无法逆行的水势。分钟紧随分钟，日子接着日子，太阳升起又落下——但在此地，正如荒野会搅乱逻辑、悖逆现实一般，时代的流动并非如河，而如潮：同样用力地推来又拽回，退去时留下万古遗痕。在这里的一天，或许只相当于故乡的几分钟；又或你不过稍作停留，外界却已流逝一年。这里没有白昼与黑夜，只有永不消退的恒久暮光。
You know time as a linear stream, a current against which you cannot fight. Minutes follow minutes, days follow days, and the sun rises and sets—but here, just as the wilds confound logic and defy reality, time flows not as a river, but as a tide, pushing and pulling in equal measure, leaving behind remnants of eons past. A day here might comprise only minutes back home, or a year might pass while you tarry only a moment. There exists no day or night, instead only a perpetual twilight that never abates.

I Am Possessed By A Ghost.name:
我被幽灵（特征）附身了
I Am Possessed By A Ghost

Text.text:
我的皮肤瞬间起满鸡皮疙瘩，仿佛其中的暖意被硬生生抽走。寒意直坠血脉，渗入骨髓；连我的灵魂都仿佛被冻得发寒。随后我感觉到了——一种存在：一股绝望而执拗的意志。四肢麻木得厉害，我甚至来不及察觉自己已失去对它们的掌控，一切便已太迟。我成了自己躯壳里的旁观者，只能在意识的角落里无助地颤抖。
My skin erupts in gooseflesh as the warmth is siphoned out of it. The chill plunges through my bloodstream, my bones; my very soul feels cold. Then I feel it, a presence: a desperate, adamant will. My limbs are so numb, I don’t notice that I’ve lost control of them until it’s too late. I’m a spectator in my own body, shivering helplessly in a corner of my mind.

Council Of Changelings.name:
易形者议会
Council Of Changelings

Text.text:
议员们一个接一个地变换，形体如水中倒影般流转不定。肌肤逐渐蜡黄，面容扭曲重塑，汇成一张若有若无的脸——那是画布，换生灵将他们的艺术呈献于世的所在。

~ Envisioned by Daroneasa on Discord

One by one the councilors change, their forms shifting like reflections in water. Skin becomes sallow as faces contort to form a subtle countenance—the canvas on which the changelings present their art to the world.

~ Envisioned by Daroneasa on Discord

你低声吟诵这道法术抑扬顿挫的咒词，半阖着眼望向目标，默默催逼他们感到倦意，期盼这股魔法将他们轻轻摇入梦乡。作为施放法术的最后一步，你将一只手的手指相互摩挲，仿佛掸落指间的细沙，再揉揉一只眼，打了个哈欠。
You whisper the singsong words of this spell and look at the targets with eyes half-lidded, willing them to feel tired, hoping its magic lulls them into slumber. As the last component of the spell’s casting, you rub the fingers of one hand together as if dusting off sand, rub one eye, and yawn.

蔚蓝的光芒从受损的罗盘中轰然炸裂——如缎带般的光束划破夜色，照亮船只上方的天穹。它们以令人目眩的速度翻涌旋转，逐渐凝聚成一枚罗盘玫瑰，指针疯狂疾转，始终无法在宇宙以太中找到立足的方向。毫无预兆地，指针骤然停住，一阵刺耳的轧鸣充满咸湿的空气——船身不再摇晃，反而向着天际缓缓升起。被奥术的暗流托举着，这艘船遁入幽影般的投影之中——只在下方翻涌的泡沫浪花里，不留一丝存在的痕迹。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Cerulean light explodes out of the damaged compass—streaking ribbons illuminating the night sky above the ship. Swirling with dizzying speed, they coalescence to form a compass rose, needle spinning frantically, unable to ground itself in the cosmic ether. Without warning the needle stills and a grinding hum fills the salty air as the ship ceases its rocking and floats heavenward. Borne aloft on arcane currents, the vessel disappears into the spectral projection—leaving no trace of its existence in the foaming waves below.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Run-down Sports Venue.name:
破败的体育场馆
Run-down Sports Venue

Text.text:
体育场的骷髅（特征）在空荡荡的停车场中阴森矗立，曾经球员奔跑穿过的地下通道里，如今蜷着无家可归者沉睡。忽明忽暗的泛光灯把荒草丛生的场地涂成一片昏黄，像一道扭曲的雷击；有人从破败的看台上扯下几排残旧座椅，在满地肮脏垃圾的球场边点起一堆火。往昔明星球员的海报褪色破损，其中一张被涂上帮派涂鸦——一枚惨白的骷髅（特征）与交叉骨。
The skeleton of the stadium stands ominous amid an empty car park, and homeless people sleep in the underpass where players once ran through. Flickering floodlights wash the overgrown field in yellow light, like a twisted lightning strike, and someone has torn out several dilapidated seats and built a fire beside the pitch littered with dirty trash. Posters of famous players from bygone years are faded and in disrepair, one bearing gang graffiti—a bleached skull and crossbones.

你下沉进一片频闪的地下冥界——一处感官纵欲的悸动乐园。搏动的VR茧舱许诺沉浸式的冒险，使用者扭曲的面容在其中闪烁摇曳。全息地板被人潮挤满，畸形的身躯随着迷幻舞曲翻搅扭动，双眼紧闭，汗雾在空气里弥散。阴影的角落里，赌客们围拢在兜帽人身旁，银色的魔法科技薄片在手中交接，霓虹蓝的药液被人以近乎癫狂的放纵一口口灌下。

~ Envisioned by Geekstress

You descend into a strobing underworld, a throbbing haven of sensory vice. Pulsing VR cocoons promise immersive adventure, the distorted faces of users shimmering within. The holo-floor is packed by a crowd of twisted bodies writhing to psytrance, their eyes closed and sweat misting the air. In a shadowy corner, punters huddle around hooded figures, with silver wafers of magitech changing hands and vials of neon blue being quaffed with frantic abandon.

~ Envisioned by Geekstress

Fake Berserker Axe.name:
伪·狂战士战斧
Fake Berserker Axe

Text.text:
当你与这把附魔武器建立调谐，一股宁和之感在你体内缓缓弥漫。你变得平静，厌恶让这柄双刃巨斧——做工完美无瑕——去沾染战斗的血腥屠戮。你最强烈的渴望只是将它紧紧留在身边，使其始终完好如新，永不与它分离。
As you attune with the enchanted weapon, a feeling of peace percolates throughout your being. You feel calm, averse to subjecting the double-bladed axe—with its flawless craftsmanship—to the bloody carnage of battle. Your greatest desire is simply to keep the axe close, in perfect condition, and never part with it.

Quip About Different Forms Of Courage.name:
关于不同形式的勇气的俏皮话
Quip About Different Forms Of Courage

Text.text:
“我也许没打过多少仗，但我曾向陌生人敞开心扉。我曾赤身起舞，任雨浇淋，醉意汹涌。我与形形色色的存在同枕共眠，并在他们每一个身上都寻到真挚的温柔。真正地活着，本身就需要另一种勇气。”
“I may not have fought many battles, but I’ve opened myself up to strangers. I’ve danced naked and drunk in the rain. I’ve slept with all manner of beings and found an honest tenderness within each of them. To truly live takes its own form of courage.”

参天巨树的猩红根须缠绕着分岔的石径，自树干向外蔓延，宛如利维坦蜿蜒的肢体。阳光穿透头顶浓密的树冠，温暖着你脚下的石面，而四周洋红色的叶片永不停歇地倾泻飘落。前方，一段阶梯向上延伸，通往某道附魔门扉摇曳不定的微光。
The crimson roots of the towering tree wrap around the branching stone paths, spreading outward from the tree’s trunk like the snaking limbs of a leviathan. Sunlight filters through the dense canopy above, warming the stone beneath your feet, while all around you magenta leaves fall in a perpetual cascade. Ahead, a set of stairs lead up, toward the wavering glow of some enchanted doorway.

词语仿佛你在空气中刻下的纹印；它们的奥秘音节沿着你的手勾勒出形状。你向前踏出一步：不是远离混战，而是迎向它。你并非不朽，却有护佑在身。敌人的尖锋撞上你的护障时被迟滞、被削弱。在你面前——一位战斗法师——致命一击擦身而过，偏斜而去。
The words feel like the sigil you write on the air, their arcane sound creating the shape through your hand, and you step forward: not away from the melee, but toward it. Not invincible, but protected. An enemy's sharp point is slowed as it hits your ward. Before you, a battle mage, the death blow glances away.

一股寒意从四面八方同时渗出。霜花沿着一切表面悄然蔓延，你的呼吸在刺骨的空气中化作团团白雾。风声里夹着一阵低吟，痛苦而遥远，随风升起；在你眼角余光中，你看见一个身影从阴影里剥离出来，飘然滑向你——无重无形，不死之物。
A chill emanates from everywhere at once. Rime creeps across surfaces, and your breath plumes before you in the frigid air. A moan, pained and distant, rises with the wind, and in your peripheral vision, you see a figure detach itself from the shadows and glide toward you—weightless, formless, undead.

Crane Control Cab.name:
起重机控制驾驶舱
Crane Control Cab

Text.text:
夜里，起重机的控制舱像一处孤零零的栖身之所。操作员啜饮着一杯冒着热气的饮品，面容憔悴；他戴着手套抹过满是污渍的窗玻璃。指挥面板上，他熟练地一转操纵杆，那些铁铸巨兽便猛然苏醒，在堤道的轨道上以惊人的齿轮轰鸣碾行；他将它们稳稳调度到货物上方，缓缓挪入位置。
The control cab at of the crane at night is a lonely perch. The operator looks haggard as he sips from a steaming cup and wipes the grimy windows with a gloved hand. With a deft turn of the levers on the command panel, the iron behemoths lurch into life, their titanic gears grinding along the tracks in the causeway as he maneuvers into position above the cargo.

阳台被一顶色彩鲜艳的布质遮篷护在其下，两只小火盆将光滑如镜的抛光石面浸染成温暖的橙色光辉。栏杆旁摆着槽状花箱，插满新鲜花朵，甜润芬芳的花粉弥漫在空气中。
The balcony is sheltered beneath a brightly colored cloth awning, and two small braziers bathe the smooth, polished stone in a warm orange glow. Fresh flowers are placed in troughlike boxes along the balcony’s rails, filling the air with sweet, fragrant pollen.

Insult About An Unwelcome Party Member.name:
关于不受欢迎的队员的羞辱
Insult About An Unwelcome Party Member

Text.text:
“理论上，我明白你有什么用——但我们为什么还没把你丢在最近的森林里不管，这一点我至今想不通。”
“Theoretically, I understand how you’re useful, but why we haven’t just abandoned you in the nearest forest is still beyond me.”

你以宛如滚滚雷鸣般的嗓音吟诵咒文，同时挥动你的奥术法器。闪电自你身上跃出，劈向你的目标，在你们之间以滋滋作响的弧线狂舞。你凝神维持，那道电光便牢牢不散，持续带来令人战栗的电击效果。
Incanting in a voice that recalls rolling thunder, you gesture with your arcane implement. Lightning jumps from you to your target, dancing between you in a sizzling curve. As you focus, the bolt holds, with continued shocking results.

野生冬青灌木上，尖刺般的倒角叶片层层簇拥着一串串诱人的红色浆果。叶缘锋利如战士长矛，这株植物坚韧的防御足以吓退除最执拗——或最愚蠢——的啃食者之外的一切来犯。
Spiked, beveled leaves surround clusters of tantalizing red berries on the wild holly bush. Sharp as a warrior’s spear, the plant’s hardy defenses see off all but the most determined—or foolish—grazers.

这名女子肩、背、臂与大腿处，一卷卷线条完美的厚实肌肉高高隆起；即便这身戏服是为她量身打造，此刻也被撑得紧绷作响。她朝人群灿然一笑，先做了几组拉伸热身，随后才开始表演。她真打算把那头家畜像举起普通哑铃一样，高高举过头顶吗？
Thick rolls of perfectly toned muscle bulge at this woman’s shoulders, back, arms, and thighs, her costume stretching and straining despite being sized specifically for her. She beams at the crowd, limbering up with some stretches, before beginning her act. Does she actually plan on lifting that livestock over her head as if it were just another free weight?

Possessed Child.name:
被附身的孩子
Possessed Child

Text.text:
还有什么比纯真被剥夺、更被扭成地狱般的智慧更骇人的吗？曾经前途无量的幼童，如今却成了一具瘦小脆弱的躯壳，像一只精瘦的猎犬般站立着，急促喘息，用捕食者般好奇的目光死死盯着你。还有那张小脸，那对脸颊——当它们看见你时，竟在一抹亵渎般可怖的笑意里凹出酒窝。
Could anything be more horrifying than innocence robbed, converted instead to an infernal intelligence? What was once a promising young child is now a small and fragile body standing like a lean hound, breathing rapidly and gazing with predatory, inquisitive eyes. And that little face, those cheeks—they dimple in a terrible violation of a smile when they spot you.

Questioning A Lawful Character’s Values.name:
质问一位守序角色的价值观
Questioning A Lawful Character’s Values

Text.text:
“你自以为高贵？自以为是在为所有人的正义而战？那我倒要问问，你说的究竟是哪一些人。‘所有人’里，显然不包括那些被你用剑血洗的掠夺者与盗贼。你不是英雄，你是一根棍棒，被有势者握在手里，用来碾碎无势者。我也许不会把每一条法律都奉为圭臬，但若我杀人，那是因为我自己选择如此，而不是因为某套僵硬的原则命令我这么做。”
“You believe yourself noble? That you fight for the justice of all people? I would ask which people you mean. Surely ‘all’ does not include the marauders and thieves you bloody your sword with. You are not a hero, you are a bludgeon, used by those with means to crush those without. I may not follow every law to the letter, but if I kill, it is because I decide to do so, not because some rigid set of principles told me to.”

穿过田野的小径古怪而令人不安——它在庄稼间蜿蜒迂回，仿佛被利落地从作物中切割出来，形成一座曲折的迷宫。起初那些转折与弯道毫无章法，但对细心之人而言，很快便能看出规律：圆环。符文。记号。道路并非随意，也绝非自然生成——它们构成一圈圈同心圆，外缘镶刻着符文。难道这是某个巨大法术的组成部分？还是另有其物？
The path through the fields is odd, unnerving—it winds here and there, seemingly carved cleanly through the crops themselves to form a meandering labyrinth. The turns and bends at first make little sense, but a pattern becomes clear to those paying attention. Circles. Runes. Symbols. The paths are not random, nor are they natural—they form concentric circles, ringed with runes. Could it be a component of a massive spell? Or something else?

Festival Ruined, Patron Abducted By Drag.name:
庆典崩毁，赞助人遭巨龙掳走
Festival Ruined, Patron Abducted By Dragon

Text.text:
你注视着巨龙的身影渐渐缩成天际的一点，它那宽阔的苔绿巨翼每一次拍击，都把你的庇护者带得更远、更远。她的尖叫声一点点消散，最终归于虚无，被绑架者那刺耳的咆哮所吞没。你环顾被摧毁的城镇广场，诡异地寂静；一张张惊惶的脸从瓦砾中站起，茫然四顾。那股令人作呕的恶臭毒素从巨龙喉间喷吐而出，化作剧毒的雾霭，如今已在地面低洼处沉积成一滩滩毒池。尸体躺在翻涌起泡的液体里，肿胀发紫——非死即垂死。颤抖的镇民失魂落魄地捡起摊位残骸——撕裂的缎带、断裂的木板、污浊的旗幡——而更勇敢的那一批，则试图触及那些在毒雾中扭动挣扎的人。恐惧与痛楚的哀嚎开始从人群里层层涌起，骤然击碎了这片死寂。

~ 一位英雄构想

You watch the image of the dragon dwindle, each flap of its wide moss-green wings taking your patron further and further away. Her screams fade to nothing, muted by the shrieking roar of her captor. You survey the wrecked town square, eerily quiet as shocked faces stand up from the rubble. The foul-smelling poison, spewed from the dragon’s throat as a noxious mist, has settled into pools along the ground. Bodies lie in the bubbling liquid, bloated and purple—dead or dying. Trembling townsfolk absently pick up the remnants of stalls—lengths of torn ribbon, planks of wood, soiled pennants—while the braver of the lot attempt to reach those writhing amid the poison. Wails of horror and pain begin to swell up from the crowd, shattering the silence.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Cast Cone Of Cold From My Staff Of Pow.name:
我将权杖之力对准前方，施放「寒冰锥」
I Cast Cone Of Cold From My Staff Of Power

Text.text:
冰冷的蓝光自我法杖上大师级雕琢的符文间迸涌而出，寒意随之在我周身落下。静止的空气里，我的吐息凝成白雾。随着我召唤一股刺骨的魔法冲击，将敌人彻底冻成冰雕，法杖的金属杖身也覆上了一层淡淡的霜华。
Cold blue light emanates from the masterfully carved runes along my staff, and a chill falls around me. My breath mists in the still air. A light frost rimes the staff’s metal haft as I summon a blast of frigid magic to freeze my foe solid.

Novice Busker.name:
新手街头艺人
Novice Busker

Text.text:
街头艺人凝视着鲁特琴的琴弦，神情专注得近乎凝固，艰难地用指尖死死按弦，想把音色压到正确的位置——却只得了部分成功。曲调虽不完美，他颤抖的演奏里却透出真切情感，足以让偶尔路过的行人停步，在他脚边丢下几枚铜币。
The busker stares at the strings of his lute in deep concentration, struggling to press down on the strings hard enough to make the sound come out right—with only partial success. Though the tune is not perfect, his emotion rings out through his shaky performance, enough to make occasional passers-by drop copper bits at his feet.

Great Hall Of A Manor.name:
庄园大礼堂
Great Hall Of A Manor

Text.text:
这座大礼堂里那座巨大的壁炉燃烧得正旺，跃动的火舌将原本冻得人牙关打颤的寒意驱散，只剩下令人不适的冷。厅内地面上一道道痕迹，昭示着此处曾经无数次聚会的盛况——从贵族的宴席到盛大的庆典、婚礼仪式与洗礼。礼堂后墙一侧，廊台在栏杆后方高高架起，吟游诗人可立于其上，借着拱形穹顶的回音，让浑厚的乐声充满整座大厅。
The enormous hearth of this great hall blazes with leaping flames, reducing the cold of the great hall from a tooth-chattering chill to merely uncomfortable. The markings along the floor of the hall are evidence of countless gatherings within its walls, from noble’s meals to times of great celebration, wedding ceremonies and baptisms. Along the rear wall of the hall, a gallery stands above behind a rail, for minstrels to fill the hall with sonorous sounds aided by the acoustics of its vaulted ceiling.

这道身影足有食人魔般的体型，像一堵墙般压在你面前：一身剪裁极讲究的军装，光是缝制就得用上好几码羊毛。上衣边缘虽已磨损，但每一处破洞与擦痕都被一丝不苟地补好、缝牢。无数枚擦得锃亮的勋章铺满战士那宽阔得惊人的胸膛。一支人类根本无法挥动的巨型火绳喇叭枪斜挎在肩上，又被那只硕大的爪子轻松拎着。可真正让路人移不开眼的，还是这位存在本身——凡是远道而来的旅者，都会发誓：这敦实的家伙简直像一头河马穿上军装、直立行走。你忽然意识到，这大概不是该当着他们面说出口的比喻。

~ Played by Spencer Wilson

Fully the size of an ogre, the figure looming before you is decked out in a well-tailored military uniform that must have taken several yards of wool to create. Though the tunic is somewhat worn around the edges, every hole and scuff has been patched or mended with meticulous care. And numerous polished medals cover the warrior’s massive chest. Strapped over one shoulder, and carried with ease in one enormous paw, is a blunderbuss far too large for a human to wield. Yet it is the being themself who invites the most awe-inspired stares from passersby. For those who have traveled far would swear that this stout individual resembles nothing so much as a hippopotamus who has taken to wearing military clothing and balancing on two legs. It occurs to you that this is probably not a comparison to be made out loud in their presence.

~ Played by Spencer Wilson

Overheard Conversation About Alimony.name:
关于赡养费的窃听对话
Overheard Conversation About Alimony

Text.text:
“——丈夫甩给我四百年的赡养费，你敢信？千万别去精灵法庭走一遭。”
“—husband slapped me with four hundred years of alimony, can you believe that? Never go through elf-courts.”

Orb Of Eyeglass.name:
眼镜宝珠
Orb Of Eyeglass

Text.text:
这颗透明的玻璃球直径约八码英寸，轻若鸿羽。其表面遍布霜白圆环的刻纹，光影在玻璃中相互折返，让那些圆环仿佛立体悬浮。它会在一名魔法学徒的掌心上方无声漂浮，并能复制自身。每复制一次，所有球体的体型便减半，最小可分至八颗、每颗仅一英寸。缩至最小后，且由足够强大的持有者操控时，每一颗都能化作一只漂浮之眼，拥有二十尺的察觉射程。
This clear glass orb is about eight inches in diameter and feather light. Frosty circles are etched all over its surface, reflecting around the glass so they seem three dimensional. While it levitates above the hand of a student of magic, the orb can duplicate itself. Each duplication halves the size of the orbs, down to eight orbs of one inch each. At their smallest, and under the control of a sufficiently powerful wielder, each orb works as a floating eye with a perception range of twenty feet.

Intergalactic Mail Delivery.name:
星际邮件投递
Intergalactic Mail Delivery

Text.text:
带着疲惫而认命的一声叹息，星际邮递飞行员按下仪表盘上那枚巨大的红色按钮，按钮标着 BLAST SHIELDS。伴随嗡鸣般的旋转低响，一道炫目的蓝色力场瞬间笼罩这艘小小的邮运飞船——就在同一刻，前方的星海骤然爆裂成狂暴而令人屏息的景象。流星如雷，砸在盾牌上，像冰雹敲击铁皮屋顶般密集作响，又被弹开，飞散回苍穹；盾牌发生器在连绵轰击下发出沉重的呻吟。飞行员额头渗出汗珠，盯着仪表台上的读数飞速跳动，快得连眼睛都追不上。盾牌还能撑住吗？

~ DaveDaWanderer on Discord

Sighing with weary resignation, the intergalactic mail delivery pilot presses the large red button marked BLAST SHIELDS on the dashboard. With a whirring hum, a scintillating blue force field engulfs the small postal craft just as the starscape before it bursts into violent, breathtaking life. Meteors thunder onto the shield like hail on a tin roof, bouncing away into the firmament as the shield generator groans under the onslaught. Sweat beads the pilot's brow as they watch the display on the dash hurtle through numbers faster than their eyes can follow. Will the shield hold?

~ DaveDaWanderer on Discord

Nightmare About A Horde Of Rats.name:
关于鼠群的噩梦
Nightmare About A Horde Of Rats

Text.text:
恶臭的甬道在火把的光里微微摇晃，唯一的声响只有火焰噼啪将熄与液体滴落。一个小小的身躯擦过你的脚踝。又一个。再一个。细碎的脚步声先在断续的吱鸣间隐约可闻，继而汇成轰鸣。一股湿漉漉、毛茸茸的潮水猛然将你撞翻，你翻滚着跌进隧道的污泥里，火把嗤的一声熄灭。利爪撕扯，尖牙啃噬你的血肉，老鼠像污秽的水一样蠕动钻行，往你身上每一道缝隙里灌入。

~ 由 BigMacDaddy 构想

The reeking passage wavers in the torchlight, the only sounds that of guttering flame and dripping fluid. A tiny body brushes your ankle. Another. Then another. The patter of tiny feet first becomes audible amid intermittent squeaks, then it becomes a roar. A tide of wet, furry forms bowls you over, and you tumble into the tunnel’s muck, the torch going out with a hiss. Claws tear and teeth gnash at your flesh as the rats worm their way, like vile water, into every gap.

~ Envisioned by BigMacDaddy

The Sanctuary: Ice Spire Cave.name:
圣所：冰尖石窟
The Sanctuary: Ice Spire Cave

Text.text:
冰冷的晶体尖塔从高原上突兀刺出，在你头顶交错相接，宛如一位被掩埋的巨人合拢的尖拱双手。杂乱无章的排列勾勒出一张黑暗而巨大的洞口，像洞穴张开的深渊之口。这里寒风刺骨——但这股冷冽的气流，是从那幽深的洞窟入口里吹出来的。
Icy crystalline spires jut out from the plateau, intersecting above you like the steepled hands of a buried giant. The haphazard pattern creates a yawning, dark mouth to a cave. There is a cold wind here—but this breeze is coming out of the cavernous opening.

恐狼——银色皮毛在淡淡的青蓝辉光中闪耀——直扑巨龙。一名金发及肩的男子骑乘其上，身披熠熠生辉的秘银板甲，绿色披风翻卷如浪。炽烈而通红的火焰骤然迸发，环绕他的身形盘旋，将异界般的光辉映在他那锐利的银色双眼中；他放声战吼，高高举起一柄巨大的战斧。巨龙轰然倾倒，战斧正中要害。

~ 扮演：Dung Beetle

The direwolf—silver-fur gleaming with a faint teal glow—charges the dragon. A man with shoulder-length blond hair sits astride the wolf, clad in shining mithral plate and a billowing green cloak. Flames, radiant and red-hot, spring forth and encircle the man’s form, lending an otherworldly light to his piercing silver eyes as he lets loose a battle cry and hefts a massive waraxe over his head. The dragon topples as the axe finds its mark.

~ Played by Dung Beetle

I Parley With The Marauder Leader.name:
我与掠袭者首领交涉
I Parley With The Marauder Leader

Text.text:
“我想像你这样的人，多半会在理智面前选择拔剑。到目前为止，我敢说这招一直相当管用。但我保证，若你今天选择用剑，你就活不到明天。我们只求片刻交谈——放下暴力与逞强。若你不喜欢我们要说的话，那也罢；我们就一起踏上通往地狱的路。”
“I imagine someone like you often chooses your sword over reason. So far, I’m sure it’s worked quite well. But I promise if you choose your sword today, you will not live to see tomorrow. We only ask for a moment to converse, free from violence and bravado. If you don’t like what we have to say then so be it, we shall all make the journey to hell together.”

Loot From A Rug Of Smothering.name:
窒息魔毯的战利品
Loot From A Rug Of Smothering

Text.text:
当你将那张失去活力的地毯一线一线地拆开时，小小的金属碎片从织物里簌簌落下。有些圆得像常见的钱币，有些则被雕成方形、菱形与三角形。每一块碎片的正面都刻着一道符文。无论你能否判断这些符文是否带有魔法性质，你都能猜到，这些零散的金银碎片能以不错的价格卖出去。
As you disassemble the de-animated rug—thread by thread—small metal pieces fall out of it. Some are round like common coins, others carved into squares, diamonds, and triangles. A rune is carved into the face of each piece. Whether you can determine the runes are of a magical nature or not, you can guess these bits of gold and silver can be sold at a decent price.

Bottle Of Shrew-tongue.name:
鼩舌之瓶
Bottle Of Shrew-tongue

Text.text:
这只黑色玻璃圆筒轻易便能收进掌心。瓶身没有贴任何标签，但你确实在紧紧塞入瓶口的老旧棕色软木塞末端，发现一个被灼烙其上的符号：一只长吻、生着龇露的啮齿尖牙的生物剪影。

~ 出自精彩的TRPG补充资料 The Vineyard

The cylinder of dark glass fits easily in your palm. No label is glued to the bottle, but you do find a symbol burned onto the end of the old brown cork firmly fitted into the mouth: a silhouette of a creature with a long snout and snarling rodential teeth.

~ Found in the amazing TTRPG supplement The Vineyard

Teaching A Spell.name:
教授一项法术
Teaching A Spell

Text.text:
女术士眯起眼，盯着导师又一张晦涩难解的图式，随即恼火地把它揉成一团。她朝营火一指，啐出一个字，短暂召来一阵疾风，将那团皱巴巴的课业卷进火焰里。法师看着，随后用夸张的动作比划出她那道法术的体势成分。她撅起嘴，觉得自己成了笑柄：他的姿态刻意得过分，可半点风都没起。

接着，法师挺直身躯，再次施展那道定向传讯法术，贴着掌心低语，然后抬指一点。“告诉我，但要用你自己的声音——别学我。编织之网必须听见你的声音，听从你的命令。”

年轻女人耷拉着肩，抿紧嘴唇，开始那套熟悉却屡屡失败的施法。她换了只手。她不再模仿老师。她把讯息送了出去。

“嗯，是的，我当然可以。”法师说道。他的错愕融化成带笑的神情。“只是没想到你第一次成功的传讯，会用上那么……缤纷的措辞。”

年轻的女术士猛地跳起——双眼圆睁，嘴巴大张——一把抱住她那位德高望重的导师。
The sorceress squints at another of her mentor’s incomprehensible diagrams, then crumples it in frustration. She gestures to the campfire and spits out a word, briefly conjuring a gust that lifts her wadded lesson into the flames. The wizard watches, then mimes the somatic component of her spell. She pouts, thinking herself the butt of a jape: his form is exaggerated, and no gust appears.

Then the wizard stands tall and performs the targeted communication spell once more, whispering into his palm and pointing. “Tell me, but as yourself—not in imitation. The Weave must hear your voice, heed your command.”

The young woman slouches, purses her lips, and begins the familiar, much-failed, casting. She switches hands. She does not mimic her teacher. And she sends her message.

“Well, yes, I can be,” says the wizard. His consternation gives way to a mirthful smile. “And I wouldn’t have expected your first successful sending to use such… colorful language.”

The young sorceress springs up—eyes wide, mouth agape—and throws her arms around her venerable mentor.

这把武器远谈不上精致——不过是一截粗劈的树枝，外面用粗糙的铁箍胡乱缠束。想把这样的棍棒抬离地面都得有惊人的力气，更别说在战斗中将它挥舞得得心应手。
This weapon is far from refined, being only a roughly hewn tree branch ringed with crudely banded iron. To even lift such a club takes immense strength, let alone to wield it effectively in battle.

你吐出缥缈流淌的咒词，墨黑的阴影缠绕在你的双手。你伸出手去接触附近的一名生物。刹那间，你从他们的躯体中汲取生命力，感到它如冰冷奔涌的激流般灌入你的体内。
You speak the wispy, flowing words, and inky black shadows wreathe your hands. You reach out to touch a nearby creature. In an instant you leech vitality from their body and feel it flow like cold, rushing water into yours.

一只软体生物背负着珠光闪烁、虹彩流转的螺旋壳，体型如挽马般巨大，靠着那条粗壮如巨虫的足缓缓滑行。它皱褶的苍白躯肉泛着湿亮的光泽，皮肤在头顶处渐变为天青色；那头颅被生物从地面抬起。蓝色在它的四根触手末端逐渐加深，其中上方两根的尽头嵌着细小的黑眼。更短的下方触手之下，一张如吸盘般的口器微微收放，这只蜗牛一边蠕动，一边审视着周遭。
Carrying a pearly and iridescent spiral shell on its back, a mollusk the size of a draft horse slides along on its giant, wormlike foot. Its wrinkled, pale flesh glistens, and its skin transitions to cerulean at the top of the head, which the creature raises from the ground. The blue darkens toward the end of the creature’s four tentacles, the top two of which end in tiny black eyes. Below the smaller, lower tentacles, a sucker-like mouth flexes while the snail surveys its surroundings.

一名仪态端方的女子步履匆匆，昂首挺胸，身姿笔直。她携着想必沉重的负担，但你猜它们彼此抵消了重量。一只手上，一摞用麻绳捆扎的高高书堆垂挂着；另一只手则提着一串黄铜碗，借由那用来夹紧它们的提柄，垒成一座小塔。阵阵辛辣的蒸汽从碗堆间袅袅飘来，钻入你的鼻端。
A prim-looking woman walks swiftly, her head held high and her posture erect. She carries what must be heavy burdens, but you suppose they balance each other out. A tall stack of books tied with twine dangles from one hand, while with her other she carries a tower of brass bowls by the handle that serves to clamp them together. A waft of spicy steam drifts to you from the stack of bowls.

Monk's Meditation Chamber.name:
武僧的冥想静修室
Monk's Meditation Chamber

Text.text:
这间圆形房室陈设极简，中央只摆着一只坐垫，四壁垂挂着织毯。此处的寂静几乎令人窒息，静到能听见自己的心跳。然而这份沉默也能安宁无比，仿佛终于能听清脑海里每一个念头。那只磨损已久的坐垫唤起虔诚者的身影——他们沉静端坐，潜心冥思。
The circular room is adorned simply, with a single cushion at its center and tapestries draping the walls. The silence here is almost overwhelming, quiet enough to hear one's own heart beating. But that silence can be serene, and for once you hear every thought your mind has to offer. The well-worn cushion conjures images of the devoted, quiet in their contemplation.

这块朴素的锭料却闪耀着明亮光泽，让人一眼便知它只可能出自某一种金属。能锻造它的铁匠必定拥有登峰造极的技能，而若将这般坚韧又轻盈的材料浪费掉，那份羞愧必会令人难以承受。它引人遐想它将化作何物——利剑或护甲；也许是一顶领袖之盔，在战场上将光芒向四面八方反射。
The bright gleam to this simple ingot tells anyone it could only be one kind of metal. The smith who works it must be of the greatest skill, and the shame of wasting something this strong and light would be overwhelming. The ingot prompts the imagination of what it could become, sword or armor—perhaps the helm of leadership reflecting light in all directions on a battlefield.

Bartus Notesworth.name:
巴图斯·诺茨沃斯
Bartus Notesworth

Text.text:
这个矮壮却结实的人类格外惹眼：乌黑的头发一丝不苟地梳得服帖，深褐色的眼睛从晒成小麦色的俊朗面庞上望来。然而看得越久，那层体面就越像薄漆般剥落，露出一个有些年代、疲惫而磨损的男人——脸上厚厚的妆粉勉强遮住被天气摧残的痕迹与细密皱纹。可他举手投足依旧带着力量与速度，腰间那柄精金细剑更像是他身体的一部分，熟稔得令人不寒而栗。

~ 由Joorrekiin在 Played 扮演，角色卡见

The stout yet sturdy human cuts a striking figure, dark hair coiffed immaculately, deep brown eyes peering out from a tanned, handsome face. But the longer one looks, the more the facade falls away, revealing a worn and weary man of a certain age, face plastered with makeup to hide weather damage and wrinkles. He moves with strength and speed, however, and appears all too comfortable with the adamantine rapier at his belt.

~ Played by Joorrekiin with

士兵们合力把一只酒桶抬上桌面。一人用黑色粉笔画下三道同心圆。他们一边饮酒大笑，一边从战后收集来的折断兵器里挑拣矛镞——连着约四英寸长的短杆。第一个用力掷出。矛镞当啷一声撞在酒桶上，滚落下来。又一个把金属尖端稳稳钉进第二圈内侧。能听见的只有尖端入木的咚声，令人心安。 The soldiers hoist a wine cask onto a table. One draws three concentric circles in black chalk. They drink and laugh as they choose spearheads—with shafts about four inches long—from the broken weapons collected after the battle. The first throws, hard. The spearhead clanks off the cask and falls. Another sticks the metal point just inside the second ring. It is comforting to hear only the thunk of the point in wood.

Great Dwarfhold With Humans.name:
人类共筑的伟大矮人堡垒
Great Dwarfhold With Humans

Text.text:
这座城市嵌在孤峰之中、环其四周并覆其顶端，远远望去宛如一座被围困的城塞。由矮人精雕细琢的巨石建筑巍然矗立，外围却被杂乱蔓生的木屋区层层包围。然而街道上矮人与人类摩肩接踵，买卖喧嚣不断。从他们的珠宝与衣着来看，矮人占据着更富裕、统治的阶层。
This city built into, around, and atop a butte gives the impression of a besieged citadel. Its grand structures of dwarf-carved stone are surrounded by a messy sprawl of timber buildings. But dwarves and humans crowd the streets with commerce. Judging by their jewelry and dress, the dwarves make up most of the wealthier, ruling class.

Small Cave Cavern.name:
小洞穴岩窟
Small Cave Cavern

Text.text:
石壁上一道裂隙显露出一段短短的通道，尽头豁然开入一间大致呈圆形的石室，直径不过数码。地面中央散落着一堆凌乱的碎石，仿佛在暗示上方岩层曾经崩塌，早已沉寂多时。
A fissure in the stone reveals a short passage that opens into a roughly circular chamber just a few yards in diameter. An untidy tumble of stones in the center of the floor hints at an old collapse of rock from above.

Syr Zarryl Galarina Of Sendria.name:
森德里亚的西尔·扎里尔·加拉里娜
Syr Zarryl Galarina Of Sendria

Text.text:
这名精灵男子身形高大宽阔，健硕的躯体披覆在层层精工打造、如水波起伏的钢甲之下。缠着荆棘藤蔓的鹿角冠在他头顶，自金发间探出，宛如雄鹿之角。他神情严峻——棱角分明的下颌紧绷如铁——可那双祖母绿般的眼睛却并非全无温度。腰侧佩着一柄弯刃，刃缘刻满符文；背上则悬着一面塔盾，嵌着一颗绿色宝石，仿佛在低低嗡鸣，蕴着被压抑的力量。

~ Played by Snakekeeper7

The elven man stands tall and broad, his muscular frame shrouded in intricate plates of rippled steel. Antlers coiled with thorny vines crest his head, emerging from his blond hair like those of a great stag. His face is stern—pronounced jaw set tight—yet his emerald-green eyes are not devoid of warmth. He carries a curved blade at his hip, its edge scored with runes, and across his back hangs a tower-shield set with a green gemstone that seems to hum with subdued power.

~ Played by Snakekeeper7

Silent Asteroid With Corpses Of Miners.name:
寂静的小行星，遍布矿工尸骸
Silent Asteroid With Corpses Of Miners

Text.text:
无声的屠戮在小行星深处迎接着你。多孔的岩壁被鲜血涂抹成画，矿工们被开膛破肚的残躯像有机彩屑般四散铺陈。你环顾这片惨状，胃里像压进一块吸铁石般沉坠的恐惧缓缓落定；目光掠过覆着霜花的尸体，你愣在原地难以置信，身体也在适应大气变化的刺痛中发紧。一阵可怕的碾磨声将你的注意力拽向附近的一条隧道——那是脚步声吗？

~ Envisioned by Juxtapozbliss on Discord

Silent carnage greets you in the depths of the asteroid. The porous rock has been painted with blood, and the eviscerated bodies of the miners are strewn around like organic confetti. Dread settles like a lodestone in your gut as you survey the scene, your eyes sweeping the frost-rimed corpses in stunned disbelief as your body adjusts to the change in atmosphere. A terrible grinding sound draws your attention to one of the nearby tunnels—are those footsteps?

~ Envisioned by Juxtapozbliss on Discord

Captain Shadowscale's Dying Words.name:
影鳞队长的临终遗言
Captain Shadowscale's Dying Words

Text.text: 影鳞一手死死捂住伤口，悲恸地望着你。“所以，这就是我的结局？直到现在我才明白；为了几件小玩意儿，竟要付出这么多痛苦与死亡……”船长痛楚的脸抽搐着，竟凝成一抹残忍的笑。“每一滴血都值了。趁你还能享受我的战利品就好好享受吧——等你踏过那道界线，我和船员们会在那里等着。” 影鳞发出刺耳的狂笑，身体被令人作呕、几乎要折断骨头的痉挛撕扯，粘稠的黑色脓液块从他大张的口中四处飞溅。他的声音变得诡异而低沉，带着喉音般的回响，仿佛有什么东西正借他之口说话。“这袋血肉与骨头失败了，但有许多在等着取而代之，因为我的意志永恒。”船长猛地一颤，用死去的、受诅咒的方言吐出污秽的词句——随后僵硬不动，肿胀的舌头无力地垂在脱臼般张开的下颌外。 Shadowscale looks mournfully at you while gripping his wound. “So, this is my end? And only now does it become clear; all that suffering and death over a few trinkets…” The captain's pained face resolves into a cruel smile. “It was worth every drop of blood. Enjoy my plunder while you can, ’cause when you cross over, me and the crew will be waiting.” Shadowscale cackles as his body is wracked by abhorrent, bone-breaking convulsions, gobbets of thick ichor flying from his gaping maw. His voice takes on a strange, guttural resonance, as if something is speaking through him. “This sack of meat and bones has failed, but many wait to take its place, for my will is eternal.” The captain shudders, speaking foul words in a dead, cursed dialect—before falling still, his swollen tongue hanging limply from his unhinged jaw.

A Free Derro.name:
自由的德罗
A Free Derro

Text.text:
这家伙像是被锯短了的矮人，尖瘦锋利，活像一堆摇摇晃晃的破烂臭布条堆出来的东西，满是鼠咬般的褴褛与馊臭。一只结节分明、黯淡蓝灰色的手扯开破碎的兜帽，露出一双惨白的眼睛，贴在皱成一团的脸上恶狠狠地斜睨着。它蓄着一撮凌乱的白胡子，顶着一头白发，两者都随手胡乱编成辫子。“乌贼脸把我从妈妈身边抢走了！”它尖叫道。“拿她的脑子做实验！”这古怪的生物倏地掠入黑暗，留下霉窖般的陈腐气味，随即与阴影融为一体。那声音在远处淡淡回荡：“可现在我有——嗯嗯——魔法！”

~ Envisioned by Josh

This seems to be a sawed-off dwarf, sharp, skinny, and resembling a shambling pile of ratty, foul-smelling rags. A knotty hand of muted blue-gray pulls back a tattered cowl, revealing white eyes that leer on a squinched-up face. They have a scraggle of white beard and a head of white hair, both haphazardly braided. “Squid faces took me from Mother!” they shriek. “Experimented on her mind!” The strange creature flits into the darkness, leaving a musty smell, and melds with the shadows. The voice echoes faintly, “But now I have mmm-MAGIC!”

~ Envisioned by Josh

Rapier Of Life Stealing.name:
噬命细剑
Rapier Of Life Stealing

Text.text:
黑曜石般的细剑在你掌中平衡得恰到好处，剑柄工艺精湛。剑身不见半点划痕与磨损，然而金属在光下却不闪不亮——若说有什么变化，倒像是剑刃周遭的空气愈发晦暗。你隐约觉得，它正伏着不动，静候时机。
The obsidian-colored rapier is perfectly balanced in your hand, its hilt expertly crafted. The rapier shows no scratches or wear, yet the metal does not glint in the light—if anything, the air seems darker around the blade. You get the sense that it is lying in wait.

I Press The Sixth Button On My Rod Of Lo.name:
我按下威严之杖的第六颗按钮（罗盘）
I Press The Sixth Button On My Rod Of Lordly Might (Compass)

Text.text:
当我按下魔杖上的第六个按钮时，它猛地从我手中跃出，悬浮在我面前。它一边旋转一边发出一声清脆的鸣响，最终指向磁北。随后，一个平静的声音回荡开来，用不容置疑的口吻告诉我——我此刻离地面之上或之下有多远。
When I press the sixth button on the Rod, it leaps from my hands and hovers before me. A chime sounds as it rotates to point toward magnetic north. A placid voice rings out, telling me—in an imperious manner—how far I am above or below ground.

Obelisk In A Snow Field.name:
雪原方尖碑
Obelisk In A Snow Field

Text.text:
石柱自苍白的原野中拔地而起，尖顶覆着积雪。风霜试图将这座纪念碑彻底掩蔽，冰霜在凹槽的纹路里与柱基处结成厚块。然而，它仍顽强地拒绝被完全吞没。上半部刻蚀的符文清晰可见，深深镌入石中，凌厉而醒目。
The stone pillar rises out of the white landscape, its pointed head covered in snow. The elements seek to cover the monument completely, with ice clumping in the grooved lines and at its base. However, it resists being overtaken completely. Runes etched on its upper half are clearly visible, boldly engraved into the stone.

Unusual Glowing Asteroid Fragment.name:
不寻常的发光小行星碎片
Unusual Glowing Asteroid Fragment

Text.text:
这块碎片脉动着异样的温热，是一枚多孔岩石构成的小小锯齿三角。它在空中轻轻起伏，仿佛遍布的孔洞让它比空气还要轻盈。它身上有种格外陌生的气息——不自然、未被触碰，像有什么存在潜伏其内。那是……一张脸的轮廓？还是仅仅撞击留下的疤痕？几处孔洞里渗出一种惹眼的酸橙绿黏液。
Pulsing with a strange warmth, this fragment is a small, jagged triangle of porous rock. It bobs lightly in the air, as though its many holes make it less dense than the atmosphere. There’s something distinctly foreign about it, unnatural, untouched, like a presence lurks within. Is that… the outline of a face? Or merely impact scarring? A curious lime-green ooze leaks from some of the holes.

Ogre Warrior Charges Through Foliage.name:
食人魔战士冲破枝叶猛扑而出
Ogre Warrior Charges Through Foliage

Text.text:
食人魔伴随着一片震耳欲聋的杂响从灌木丛中猛然冲出：折裂的枝条、簌簌震落的叶片、他巨大脚掌踏地如雷的轰鸣。他满口獠牙的巨口裂开成咆哮，粗壮的手臂肌肉绷紧，死死攥住巨斧的长柄。另一条手臂则抬起护住要害，手掌与手腕套着一只布满尖刺的护手铁拳套，正适合一击砸穿树枝，也砸碎头骨。
The ogre bursts from the brush with a cacophony of sound: rending branches, shaken leaves, the thunder of his huge feet. His toothy maw splits into a roar and the huge muscles of his arms tense as he grips the haft of his greataxe. He holds up his other arm in defense, his hand and wrist fitted with a spiked gauntlet perfect for smashing through both branch and skull.

你面前这只覆着几丁质的节肢生物，肥硕得像一只大公猫。它那珊瑚色的甲壳与巨大的前螯酷似龙虾，但那条布满棘刺的长尾却粗壮如鳗，天生就是为了缠住猎物。生物的鲶鱼般巨口里塞满獠牙，两侧还有节状颚肢，摆动起来宛如蝎尾。它为迅捷游泳而生，在陆地上却只能拖着身子迟缓蠕行。
The chitin-coated arthropod before you is as fat as a large tomcat. Its coral carapace and large foreclaws resemble a lobster but its long spined tail is thick and eel-like, designed for wrapping around prey. The creature's catfish maw is filled with fangs and flanked by articulated mandibles that move like scorpion tails. Adapted for swift swimming, this creature slithers sluggishly on land.

在这座城堡居所的外层垛口与坚固城墙之后，矗立着一座你所见过最为坚实的建筑。这里便是主堡——当灾祸临头，城堡的统治者在此做出最后的防守。大门上一道沉重的铁闸门将主堡与城堡其余部分隔开；沿着墙垣，你很容易看见那些支架，重型弩炮与滚沸的燃油锅便会架设其上。每一处可能的墙段——凡未被更沉重的武备占据之处——都摆着做过防水处理的木桶，里面满满装着成捆成捆的弩箭。
Behind the outer battlements and sturdy walls of this castle dwelling, there sits as sturdy a structure as you've ever seen. It is in this place, the keep, that the rulers of the castle make their final defense in times of trouble. A heavy iron portcullis in its gate separates the keep from the rest of the castle proper, and one can easily spot along its walls the brackets upon which heavy ballistae and steaming pots of burning oil would be mounted. Waterproofed barrels containing legions of crossbow bolts sit at each likely spot along the wall not covered by heavier fare.

Sundries From A Wight.name:
来自尸妖的杂物
Sundries From A Wight

Text.text:
不死战士枯槁的脖颈上挂着一件骇人的战利品：一串由纤细的木乃伊手指串成的项链。其中几根几乎腐烂殆尽，在灰暗下垂的皮肉下露出被漂白的森森白骨。
A grisly trophy adorns the withered neck of the undead warrior: a necklace of slender, mummified fingers. Some have rotted almost entirely to reveal the bleached bone underneath the gray, sagging flesh.

Flesh To Stone.name:
血肉化石
Flesh To Stone

Text.text:
你将泥土在掌心捏碎，湿润的土屑从指缝间簌簌落下。腐殖土的气息扑面而来，将你彻底淹没。你的口中发干，指节僵硬。你指向你的目标时，感到这世界的岩石回应你的呼唤。
You crush the earth in your hand, and the moist dirt falls between your fingers. The smell of loam overtakes you. Your mouth goes dry, your fingers stiffen. You feel the stone of the world answer your call as you point toward your target.

这生物的凝视比覆满它每一寸骇人躯体的冰壳甲皮更为冷冽。倒刺密布在它四条分节的腿与两只手臂上。身后一枚肿胀的腺体生出尾须，拖曳着摇摆不定，带着威胁的气息。冰裂之声骤然撕碎你的注意力——巨口两侧突出的颚钳间，獠牙如爆裂般疯长并咔哒相击。它在冲锋中向你发起挑战，挥舞长矛，熟稔得如同旗手般从容。
The creature’s glare is colder than the ice-crusted carapace that covers every inch of its horrifying body. Barbs riddle its four articulated legs and two arms. A swollen gland sprouting cerci extends behind the creature and sways menacingly. The sound of breaking ice rips your attention back to mandibles jutting from either side of a maw exploding with fangs, which click together. It challenges you as it charges, wielding a spear with a banneret’s ease.

黑色烟雾在这只矮胖瓶子半透明的瓶身里翻涌盘旋，瓶口以铅塞封住。烟雾贴着玻璃急切地打着旋儿，仿佛迫不及待要逃逸出去，你还看见最细微的一缕缕从瓶唇处渗漏而出。
Dark smoke swirls within the translucent confines of this squat bottle, which is topped with a lead stopper. The smoke spirals against the glass, eager to escape, and you see the barest wisps leaking from the lip.

在阴郁、苍白的云幕下，水面铺展无垠——一条海的绿色臂膀刺入陆地。自那粗砺、覆满苔垢的岸边望去，你看见一幕异常诡谲的景象。每隔几分钟，就有一条孤零零的黑色触须破水而出——一会儿在这处，一会儿在那处——探伸扭动，仿佛在搜寻什么，随后又以丝绸般的旋转悄然没入水下。你听见一阵低沉的嗡鸣，像大提琴拉出的悠长单音，并感到太阳穴处隐隐发胀

~ 由 Adam Mindwolf

Under dreary, pallid clouds, the waters stretch—a green arm of the sea breaching the land. From the rough, moss-grimed shore, you see something quite strange. Every few minutes, a single, dark tendril breaches the surface—in one spot, then another—reaching and writhing, as if searching, before sinking beneath the surface in a silken twirl. You hear a low thrum, like a prolonged note from a cello, and feel a pressure in your temples

~ Envisioned by Adam Mindwolf

它看起来和任何其他港口城镇没什么两样——大体如此。水手以给自己纹身的习俗闻名，可其中有几个人身上的纹身之多，甚至超过你在任何地方一次见过的总和。码头向来是四方来客汇聚的地方，但看见大批 hobgoblins 和 half-orcs 混在人群里谈笑周旋，仍让你隐约觉得不太对劲。
It looks like any other port town—mostly. Sailors are known for their custom of tattooing themselves, although a few of them have more tattoos than you’ve seen at once anywhere else. And piers are often cosmopolitan places with visiting people from all over, but the sight of hobgoblins and half-orcs hobnobbing among the crowds strikes you as somewhat suspicious.

Heavy-duty Air Ferry.name:
重型空中渡船
Heavy-duty Air Ferry

Text.text:
这台庞然巨械公然蔑视物理法则——臃肿如山的巨兽却是工程学的奇迹，以其体型而言，速度快得几近不可能。机身由先进的轻量化材料铸就，令人屏息的旋翼结构托举着这头空中巨人稳稳悬停。它还能运载以百万吨计的重载，比如沉重的工业机械与建筑材料。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

This vast machine defies the laws of physics—the bulky behemoth is a miracle of engineering with an almost impossible speed for a craft of its size. Its body is made from advanced lightweight materials, with an awe-inspiring rotor design able to keep this giant of the skies airborne. The drone is capable of ferrying mega tonnage loads, such as heavy machinery and building materials.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Dungeon: Partially Submerged Corridor.name:
地城：半淹没的走廊
Dungeon: Partially Submerged Corridor

Text.text:
滴答与哗啦的水声清晰可辨，走廊尚未映入眼帘，你便已知它半没在水中。地面陡然让位于一片荡漾的黑暗水面，水下的一切都被浑浊的漆黑所遮蔽。
The distinct sound of dripping and sloshing water informs you of the partially submerged corridor before it even comes into view. The floor gives way to a rippling surface of darkness, everything beneath the water’s surface concealed by murky black.

前方的阴影仿佛在疯狂抽动、痉挛——好似被某个神秘的奥术傀儡师赋予了生命——散发出刺鼻的腐朽酸臭，灼烧着你的鼻腔。一团漆黑的身影浮现，贴着闪烁的沙粒蜿蜒滑行；浑浊的缕缕暗雾扭曲变形，化作巨大、破烂、如皮革般的翅翼，无力地耷拉在枯槁的蛇形躯体两侧。那生物的龙首左右摇摆，下一瞬却猛地攀上粗大的利爪巨足，朝你狂冲而来！
The shadows ahead seem to thrash and convulse—as if given life by some mysterious arcane puppeteer—emitting a caustic stench of decay that burns at your nostrils. A dark shape emerges, slithering over the glittering sand, and murky wisps morph into large, tattered, leathery wings that hang limply off a gaunt serpentine body. The creature's draconic head gyrates from side to side before it suddenly clambers onto large clawed feet and charges toward you!

Orderly Streets In The Enclave Of A Tyra.name:
暴政政权飞地中井然有序的街道
Orderly Streets In The Enclave Of A Tyrannical Regime

Text.text:
洁净无瑕的街道上，没有任何东西显得格格不入。看不见破坏、腐败——也看不见生命。你穿行于聚落之间，唯有恐惧相伴，脊背一阵刺痒，仿佛寒意沿着脊柱爬行。你很清楚：有人在盯着你。
Nothing is out of place in the immaculate streets. There is no sign of vandalism, degradation—or life. Fear is your only companion as you make your way through the settlement, keenly aware of a prickling sensation in your spine. You are being watched.

I Seek To Make Amends.name:
我愿赎罪
I Seek To Make Amends

Text.text:
我深深吸了一口气，让呼吸沉稳下来，为即将袭来的情绪风暴做好准备。我昂首阔步向前。与朋友目光相接的瞬间，罪疚的刺痛如刀般在腹中翻搅；而我——几乎用尽全身力气——张开嘴，说出那些但愿能修补我们羁绊的话。
Drawing in a deep, steadying breath, I steel myself for the emotional turmoil ahead. I boldly step forward, head held high. The pang of guilt twists in my gut like a knife as I meet the gaze of my friend, and—with herculean effort—I open my mouth to speak the words that will hopefully repair our bond.

Crossroads Shrine In Heavy Rain.name:
暴雨中的十字路口神龛
Crossroads Shrine In Heavy Rain

Text.text:
你发现自己置身于十字路口的神龛前，雨幕如天穹的泪水倾泻而下，敲击出有节律的鼓点，仿佛一场精心编排的复苏交响。被雨浸透的神龛如同漂泊灵魂的避难所——这场暴雨是一种原始的洗礼，冲刷疑虑，乃来自天上的祝福。
You find yourself at a crossroads shrine, rain sheeting down like celestial tears, sounding like a rhythmic drumbeat, an orchestrated symphony of replenishment. The soaked shrine stands as a sanctuary for souls adrift—the downpour a primitive baptism, washing away doubts, a blessing from the heavens.

Stone Age Honey Gathering.name:
石器年代采蜜
Stone Age Honey Gathering

Text.text:
在辽阔荒野的深处，风拽着他们以兽骨编织的发辫，部族之人娴熟地投身于采蜜之艺。他们手持粗陋的工具，怀揣无尽的胆魄，穿行于险恶的地形之中，追寻难觅的蜂巢，时刻警惕那些拳头大小的巨蜂。循着祖灵的教诲，他们采撷自然的金色甘露——既是赖以生存的粮，也是辛劳不息后甜美丰厚的奖赏。
Amid a sprawling wilderness, with winds tugging at bone-woven hair, tribals adeptly engage in the art of gathering honey. With primitive tools and boundless courage, they navigate the treacherous terrain, seeking out elusive beehives, ever watchful for the fist-sized bees. Guided by ancestral teachings, they harvest nature's golden nectar, their sustenance and luscious reward for their tireless efforts.

Hurmfar Thalorn.name:
赫姆法尔·萨洛恩
Hurmfar Thalorn

Text.text:
这名费尔博格在红色皮毛下肤色苍白，体型敦实而坚韧；那双棕色眼睛仿佛见过天涯海角。他身上有一处将潘神奉为神祇的纹身——神面如他偶尔的脾气般冷硬而锋利——那是他与矮人们为伍时留下的印记，从他的话语腔调里也能听出几分。粗砺的外壳裹着一颗温柔的心。他穿着荒野行者的衣物与护甲：树皮与苔藓被雕刻、编织成形；一手狼牙棒，一手盾牌。

~ 由一位英雄扮演，其

The firbolg, pale skinned under red fur, is stocky and tough, and his brown eyes say they have seen the world. He bears a tattoo deifying Pan—the face on the god as curt and sharp as he can be sometimes—picked up from time spent among dwarves, one might hear in his expressions. A gruffness worn over a gentle soul. He wears the clothes and armor of an Outlander, bark and moss, carved and woven, fitted with mace and shield.

~ Played by a Hero with

你第一次敲门，门便向内荡开了约一英尺。你闻到一股绝不会认错的气味：血腥混着人汗的酸咸。你踏入屋内无人应答，直到你看见那片曾是卧室的战场。枕头的羽毛、被单的碎屑与玻璃的尖片散落满地，而在地板上——一滩苦涩的红褐色积液之中——横着一具尸体。

~ 构想：Inbal

At your first knock the door swings open about a foot. You smell the unmistakable odor of blood mixed with human sweat. Your entrance receives no reply, but then you see the battleground that was once a bedroom. Pillow feathers, shreds of linen, and shards of glass litter the room, and on the floor—in a pool of bitter reddish brown—lies a body.

~ Envisioned by Inbal

你将手掌拢起，仿佛探入一袋谷粒之中，灼热的火星颗粒在掌心逐一点亮。随即你猛然一挥，将炽燃的光点掷向你的目标——它们在飞行途中体型与烈度不断膨胀，以非人的精准速度直扑而去。
Cupping your hand as if delving into a sack of grain, fiery particles begin to light your palm. With a sudden flourish, you hurl the blazing motes at your target, their size and intensity growing as they speed toward it with unearthly accuracy.

Cyberpunk Gas Station.name:
赛博朋克加油站
Cyberpunk Gas Station

Text.text:
这里仅剩一名人类店员。她站在收银台后，神情麻木而冷淡。涂满涂鸦的低端机器人在这间狭小的便利店里四处清扫。门外，生物燃料的气味刺得鼻腔发痛。一个欢乐仔靠在改装过的街车车头上，嘴里叼着牙签。一群年轻的崇拜者围着他打转，央求他载他们兜风。一伙毛发浓密、满身纹身的摩托帮呼啸而过，增幅墨镜在阳光下闪着冷光。头顶上，企业标志高高悬挂，骄傲宣告着对这里的所有权。

~ 一位英雄设想

There is only one human worker left here. She stands at the till with an expression of blank apathy. Low-end robots covered in graffiti clean around the small convenience store. Outside, the smell of biofuel stings the nostrils. A joyboy with a tricked-out streetcar leans against the hood, toothpick in his mouth. A gaggle of young admirers swarms him, begging for a ride. A gang of hairy, tattooed bikers rolls by, their augmented sunglasses flashing in the sun. Above, a corp logo proclaims proud ownership.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Vampire Duel With Fisticuffs And Fangs.name:
吸血鬼（特征）的拳牙决斗
Vampire Duel With Fisticuffs And Fangs

Text.text:
战斗者嘶嘶作响，像掠食者般压低身形匍匐着，随即獠牙毕露地猛扑向彼此。他们在半空中轰然相撞，用獠牙与利爪撕咬抓挠，扯裂苍白的皮肉，泼洒出黝黑黏稠的血液。他们再次跃入空中，依旧纠缠不休，宛如巷口为一口残食厮斗的野猫，战势不止，口中迸出非人的咆哮。
The combatants hiss, crouching low like predators, before springing toward each other with fangs bared. They collide in mid-air, tearing into each other with fangs and claws, rending pale flesh and spilling dark, viscous blood. They leap into the air, still entangled like alley cats fighting over a scrap of food, loosing inhuman roars as their battle continues.

Female Sign Language Interpreter In A Th.name:
剧院里的女性手语翻译员
Female Sign Language Interpreter In A Theater

Text.text:
她坐在阶段边缘，面朝前排最后几张椅子，正与雇她来协助的聋人观众用手语轻声交谈。厅灯渐暗时，她从口袋里掏出一小片磷光苔藓，在掌心捏碎，轻触座椅，便绽出一团柔和温暖的微光，恰好照亮她的手势，让表演得以被清晰译出。仿佛独角戏一般，她以夸张而精确的面部神情呼应台上演员，双臂舒展，长而流畅的手势如水般连绵，将演员每一丝情绪都一一传递。
Seated along the stage and facing the last chairs of the front row, a sign language interpreter is chatting with the Deaf theater-goers she was hired to assist. As the house lights go down, she pulls a piece of phosphorescent moss from her pocket, crushes it in her palm, and touches her chair, creating a soft, warm light enough to make her movements visible for interpreting the performance. A one-woman show, she mirrors the performers’ dramatic facial expressions accompanied with long, flowing gestures to convey every emotion felt by the actors.

Welcome From A Tavern Keeper About Cooks.name:
来自酒馆老板的欢迎词：关于厨子
Welcome From A Tavern Keeper About Cooks

Text.text:
“欢迎光临我们这间寒舍。要说吃的，整片王国都找不出比这更香的；麦酒更是管够，灌得一条巨龙都得趴窝。只不过……少管闲事，赏钱给足——后厨那帮人，先学会割喉，才学会切菜。”
“Welcome to our humble establishment. We got the best grub in the realm and enough mead to ground a dragon. Just… mind your business and tip well—the cooks used to cut throats before they cut vegetables.”

A Plea To A King About An Apocalyptic Th.name:
向王者陈情：末日威胁迫在眉睫
A Plea To A King About An Apocalyptic Threat

Text.text:
“我们面对的力量不是来征税，也不是来宣示什么主权！他们是来焚毁、来吞噬，直到世上再无一物可剩。胜利的时代已经过去。旧世界已死——只是它还没意识到罢了。如今我们必须打一场注定要输的战争。我们必须把手中所有的一切都投进这场混战，只盼在一切结束时，还能剩下足够的东西去重建。”
“The force we face is not here to levy a tax or stake some claim! They are here to burn and consume until there is nothing left. The time for victory has passed. The old world is dead—it just hasn’t realized it yet. Now we must fight a losing war. We must throw everything we have into the fray in the slim hope there will be enough left to rebuild when it is all over.”

Dream Of Glory.name:
荣耀之梦
Dream Of Glory

Text.text:
深色颜料覆在这尊巨大的眼镜蛇神像上，苍白的宝石在它冰冷的眼中闪耀，几乎令人恍惚入迷。然而漆面龟裂、簌簌作响，成片剥落。一只镶宝的眼睛随远雷般的轰鸣碎裂，另一只则悄然消失。迷醉渐退，只剩下一条傲然却褪色的巨蛇，昔日荣光尽失。
Dark pigment covers this titanic cobra idol, and pale jewels sparkle in its cold eyes, almost hypnotizing. But the paint cracks, rustles, and peels. One jeweled eye shatters with the sound of distant thunder, while the other disappears. The reverie wanes, leaving behind an imperious but faded serpent, bereft of former glory.

Pilfering A Noble House's Treasure Room.name:
洗劫贵族宅邸的宝藏库
Pilfering A Noble House's Treasure Room

Text.text:
你设法绕过守卫，沿着楼梯向上，推开左手边的门。映入眼帘的是一间堆满毛皮与兽皮的房间，还有一把华丽的长剑——虽非魔法之物，却毫无疑问价值不菲。墙上还挂着几面盾牌，展示着这家族的纹章；其下方摆着金银打造的箱子，里面藏着什么宝物无人知晓。
You make your way past the guards and up the stairs, then open the door on the left. You are presented with a room full of furs, animal pelts, and a fancy sword that—though not magical—undoubtedly has a high retail value. There are also shields on the wall displaying the house's coat of arms, and below them, chests made of gold and silver holding who knows what treasures.

Taric Black.name:
塔里克·布莱克
Taric Black

Text.text:
那一击落下时，男人几乎纹丝不动，伤口却猛地喷涌出猩红的焦油般血液。他缓缓抬起头，与袭击者对上视线——一抹赤红、刺骨的目光——对方这才意识到自己犯了错，死一般的惨白悄然爬上皮肤。历经数百年战火磨出的耐心，让他只是等待下一次挥击，才终于动身。他格开那软弱无力的攻击，顺势拨开刀刃，随即将战镐猛然贯入敌人的颅骨，伴着湿黏的碎裂声。俯身去拔出嵌入的武器时，他的夹棉甲袖口被带得上滑——露出那冰冷、灰白的皮肉。

~ Played by Max_Slacker

The man barely moves when the blow connects and causes sanguine tar to erupt from the wound. Lifting his head slowly, he makes eye contact with his aggressor—a red, piercing gaze—causing a deathly pallor to creep across their skin as they realize their mistake. With the patience born of centuries at war, he waits for the next strike before making his move. Blocking the feeble attack, he turns the blade aside before driving his war pick through his enemy’s skull with a wet crunch. Reaching down to free the embedded weapon causes the sleeve of his gambeson to ride up—exposing his cold, gray flesh.

~ Played by Max_Slacker

Cookie-cutter Coffee And Donuts Franchis.name:
千篇一律的咖啡甜甜圈连锁店
Cookie-cutter Coffee And Donuts Franchise

Text.text:
这家方方正正、亮粉色的店铺里，从每一道缝隙到每个角落，都是经由加工的企业造物，连墙上那些平庸的装饰画也不例外。如今城里几乎每个街角都该有这么一家了，缓慢扩张，以不可逆的笃定一步步吞没周遭——像寄生虫一寸一寸殖入宿主体内。
Every nook and cranny of the boxy, bright-pink store is a processed corporate fabrication, right down to the mediocre art on the walls. There must be one of these places on every corner of the city by now, slowly expanding, taking over with inexorable certainty—like a parasite colonizing the host’s body inch by inch.

一根粗壮的方木桩立在此处，底部被几块半埋入土中的石板围住。木桩上固定着镣铐，靠一道厚重的铁箍钉入坚硬的木心——这木料想必曾是棵巨树的躯干。木头看起来还算新鲜，镣铐虽为铁制，却几乎不见按理说在这风吹雨打的地方应有的锈迹。显然有人定期更换两者。把囚犯一路押到这儿已经够令人望而生畏——还要搬运这样一根沉重木梁，简直像是发疯。可随即，一个阴冷的念头钻入脑海：也许，是囚犯被迫自己把这根木桩背上来的。
A stout piece of squared-off timber stands here, its base surrounded by slabs of stone sunk into the earth. Manacles attach to the post, pinned to it by a thick hoop nailed into the hard heartwood of what must once have been a huge tree. The wood seems relatively fresh, and the manacles, though made of iron, show little sign of rust like you would expect up here, exposed as they are to the elements. Someone must replace both regularly. The idea of transporting a prisoner all the way up here is daunting enough—bringing up a heavy beam of wood seems mad. But then a dark thought occurs to you: maybe the prisoner was forced to carry the post.

Sundries From A Young Red Dragon.name:
幼年红龙的杂物
Sundries From A Young Red Dragon

Text.text:
闷燃的火山岩——散发着触手可及的炽热红光——散落在巨龙那令人窒息的灼热洞窟四周。滚烫的碎石铺成一道令人疼痛难忍的灼烧长廊，专门迎接任何妄图偷盗或闯入的窃贼与入侵者。
Smoldering volcanic rocks—aglow with palpable heat—are scattered around the dragon’s stiflingly hot cave. The searing pebbles form a painful gauntlet for any would-be thieves and intruders.

她有一双硕大而炽烈的深红眼睛，神情严肃；身形纤细，个头不比人类孩童高。她的皮肤呈暗褐色，隐隐透着紫罗兰的影子。几枚漆黑发亮的尖簪将她乌鸦般光泽的卷发从脸侧别开，盘成繁复的发髻。这样的发式让她尖而过长的耳朵完全露出——那是侏儒的耳朵，不是精灵。她穿着决斗者的装束：皮质长外套、靴子与手套，配以宽松的长裤和一件淡色丝质束腰上衣。她的胯侧挂着一只华丽的剑鞘，里面安放着一柄带篮形护手的细剑。

~ Played by John Carney

She has large, intense crimson eyes and a serious look, this slender woman no taller than a human child. Her skin is dusky with hints of violet. Sharp pins, lacquered black, hold her glossy, raven-colored curls back from her face in an elaborate updo. The style allows her pointed, overlong ears to show entirely—the ears of a gnome, not an elf. She wears the clothes of a duelist: leather coat, boots, and gloves, along with blousy pants and a tunic of pale silk. On her hip hangs a fancy scabbard holding a basket-hilted rapier.

~ Played by John Carney

Peaceful Temple: Chamber Of Meditation.name:
宁静寺院：冥想室
Peaceful Temple: Chamber Of Meditation

Text.text:
浓郁的香火气息沉甸甸地压在空气里，缕缕袅娜的烟雾懒散地在殿内蜿蜒盘旋。这些阴燃供香的猩红火点与一支缓慢燃烧的孤烛火焰，构成了此地唯一的光源。地面上零散铺着席垫，供寺中信众俯身叩伏其上，加入那低回的禅诵。
The perfume of incense hangs heavy in the air, while lines of wafting smoke curl lazily through the chamber. The red tips of these smoldering offerings and the flame of a single slow-burning candle provide the only illumination. Mats lie strewn across the floor for adherents of the temple to prostrate themselves upon and join in the meditative chant.

你吐出一个阴暗的词，舌尖立刻泛起一股令人作呕的余味，同时想象敌人的耳朵被针刺穿。你感到魔法的织物随之起伏荡漾，仿佛你的仇敌只是你织就之网上的一只苍蝇。
You spit a dark word that leaves a foul taste on your tongue while imagining your enemy’s ears pierced by pins. You feel the fabric of magic ripple in response, as if your foe were a fly on a web you’ve spun.

板岩色的板甲覆在身上，肩头披着厚实的银白长袍，一名战士稳稳摆出迎战姿态。他手执长柄刀严阵以待，银色的弯刃蓄势待发，足以对敌人送出迅疾而凌厉的横扫斩切。他咬紧牙关，浓密的赤褐胡须在滚烫的喘息中微微颤动。忽然，他灰色的双眼一闪，化作灼燃的金色，护甲与武器上的明亮符文同时亮起。他张开下颌，爆发出一声怒吼，威势之大，足以撼动群山的根脉。

~ Played by Nachreld with

Plate armor the color of slate, shoulders draped in a thick, argentine robe, a fighter braces himself in a fighting stance. He holds a glaive at the ready, its silver, curved blade positioned to deliver quick, cutting sweeps against his foes. He bares clenched teeth, his full auburn beard quivering with the force of his seething breath. Then his gray eyes suddenly flash, becoming a burning gold, and bright runes on his armor and weapon light in tandem. His jaw drops as he emits a shout mighty enough to shake the roots of mountains.

~ Played by Nachreld with

炉火蒸腾，热浪让空气微微扭曲；锤击铁砧的喧嚣几乎震耳欲聋。铁匠铺不过是一道斜斜的屋顶罩在作坊上，用来遮风挡雨。墙上挂着锤子、钳子与凿子，旁边则陈列着刀剑、斧钺、长矛，以及更寻常的农具铁件与马蹄铁。铁匠提着一柄刃口红橙、仍似熔融的长剑走向木桶，将武器浸入油中淬火。祂向助手点了点头，助手便开始拉动风箱，为下一次回火做准备。
The air shimmers with heat from the forge, and the clamor of hammer upon anvil is nearly deafening. The smithy is little more than an angled roof set over a workshop to keep out the elements. Hammers, tongs, and chisels adorn the wall beside blades, axes, spears, and the more mundane metal of farming implements and horseshoes. The blacksmith carries a sword with a red-orange molten edge to a barrel and quenches the weapon in oil. They nod to their assistant, who begins working the billows in preparation for another temper.

State-of-the-art, Corporate-owned Hospit.name:
最先进的企业控股医院
State-of-the-art, Corporate-owned Hospital

Text.text:
即便是医院，这里的氛围也冷得过分，临床得像手术器械般没有温度，仿佛所有员工都以某种方式与世隔绝。配备了令人不安的强大火力的保安在惨白的走廊里巡逻，一切都是钱能买到的最顶级配置——包括医生与护理人员。你隐约感觉，只要季度薪资出了点岔子，其中一些人会连眉头都不皱一下，转身就走。
Even for a hospital, things feel too clinical here, as if the staff are all detached in some way. Security guards with a worrying amount of firepower patrol the stark-white corridors and everything is the best money can buy—including the clinicians. You get the sense that if there was a problem with quarterly pay, some of these people would walk out without a second thought.

Avi The Elven Wizard.name:
艾薇——精灵法师
Avi The Elven Wizard

Text.text:
一名年轻的精灵穿着磨破的旅行装，蜷坐在小巷口，埋首翻阅一本破旧的厚书。她尖尖的耳朵与紫色长发在人潮中格外扎眼，行人匆匆掠过。停在她肩头的乌鸦扯了扯她的马尾，像在发出警告。她从书页上方偷偷一瞥街对面那个可疑的扒手——对方正打量着她，估摸着下手的机会。她紧张地咧出一个笑，手指微微一抽——随即消失无踪。扒手对着一片空荡的空气目瞪口呆。

~ 扮演：Walt M.，使用

A young elf in threadbare traveling garb sits in the mouth of an alley, poring over a worn tome. Her pointed ears and purple hair stand out among the crowd beetling past. The raven sitting on her shoulder gives her ponytail a warning tug. She peeks over her tome at a likely cutpurse across the street sizing her up. She gives him a nervous grin, twitches her fingers—and vanishes. The cutpurse gapes at the empty air.

~ Played by Walt M. with

Weapon Of Gnome Craftsmanship.name:
侏儒匠造武器
Weapon Of Gnome Craftsmanship

Text.text:
这把古怪而摄人的武器仿佛拒绝被归类。它更像工具而非刀刃，可你目光一落，其锻造中的匠心便立刻昭然若揭。它由无数材料拼合而成，每一种都为整体赋予独特（特征）；诸般金属彼此交融，织就一层起伏流纹的铜色光泽。
This odd, alluring weapon seems to defy categorization. It is more tool than blade, and yet the artistry in its construction is evident the moment you set eyes upon it. Composed of myriad materials, each lending a unique trait to its overall composition, the metals mingle to create a rippled, coppery hue.

Mysterious Trader At Market.name:
集市上的神秘商人
Mysterious Trader At Market

Text.text:
市集中，一个神秘身影攫住了你的目光。一名兜帽女商人自她的摊位后凝视着你。她身披暗色丝绸，狐般的面庞上浮着难以捉摸的神情，兜售来自遥远国度的奇珍异货与盛满异域之物的华丽瓶盏。她的眼眸如幽深的异界潭水，暗示着未曾言明的隐秘，将好奇的灵魂牵引进她那片秘密的领域。
Amid the market, a mysterious figure grabs your attention. A hooded trader gazes at you from her stall. Clad in swarthy silk, with an enigmatic look upon her vulpine face, she offers wares from distant lands and ornate bottles filled with the exotic. Her eyes, deep pools of otherworldliness, hint at something untold, drawing curious souls into her realm of secrets.

这件武器所雕琢而成的橡木漆黑而古老，几乎像是在吞饮光线。蜿蜒的力量符文穿行于打磨光亮的木纹之间，化作闪烁的威能脉络，宛如大地深处搏动的地脉。锤打成形的黄铜包覆着它饱经征战的尖端——一张伤痕累累、阴郁沉默的狮面，正等待将下一个被它击中的东西撕裂。
So dark and so ancient is the oak from which the weapon is carved, it almost seems to drink the light. Sinuous glyphs of power weave through its polished grain, shimmering veins of might, like ley lines pulsing through the earth. Beaten brass sheathes its war-hardened tip, the scarred face of a brooding lion, waiting to sunder the next thing it strikes.

Treatise On Verdianite.name:
《维尔迪安石论》
Treatise On Verdianite

Text.text:
[掩蔽] 这卷卷轴被妥帖收在一只无瑕的黄铜筒中，并套在同材质的金属杆上；边缘鎏金，纸面洁白，厚度异乎寻常。标题宣告它是一部论述维尔迪安石的专著，细致列明这种合金的精确构成——既有魔法之材，亦有凡俗之料。

[内容] 文中详述合金化的流程，包括对热度、空气、时代与巫术干预等熔炼条件的严苛规定。成品金属还必须以其易爆般的性情自证：在撞击他物时，会腐蚀接触到的材料。随后是锻造警告：铁匠须防护自身，免受这种汞合物般混金散出的刺咬蒸气侵害，并要预料凡非维尔迪安石所制的工具都会朽坏。最终成品是一种光润、绿纹游走的金属，不仅赋予武器超自然的平衡与锋锐，还能制造伤口，仿佛刀刃涂满酸液。

~ 由 Sardan Scribes Wizard 等级 12 Envisioned

[Cover] Furled in an untarnished tube of brass, and on a rod of the same metal, this scroll has gilded edges, a white surface, and unusual thickness. The title proclaims it a treatise on verdianite, which details the precise components of the alloy—magical and mundane.

[Content] The alloying process is described, including specific smelting conditions of heat, air, time, and sorcerous intervention. The finished metal then must prove its volatile nature by corroding other materials when hitting them. Next are warnings on forging: that the smith must be protected from the amalgam’s biting vapors, and to expect tools not made of verdianite to decay. The final product is a lustrous, green-veined metal that not only imparts supernatural balance and keenness, but also creates wounds as if the blade were coated in acid.

~ Envisioned by Sardan Scribes Wizard Level 12

Sundries From A Young Blue Dragon.name:
一条年幼蓝龙的杂物
