Sundries From A Young Blue Dragon

Text.text:
在巨龙尸骸周围干燥的沙丘间，你发现了几根由结晶砂砾凝成的细长中空管——正是那生物的闪电吐息轰击地面后留下的痕迹。它们会成为你这场战斗的绝佳纪念！
Among the arid dunes surrounding the dragon’s corpse, you find several long hollow tubes of crystallized sand where the creature’s lightning breath had struck the ground. They would make a fine memento of your battle!

Ancient Dragon Corpse.name:
远古巨龙遗骸
Ancient Dragon Corpse

Text.text:
言语几乎无法描绘眼前这头生物的惊世威仪。即便死去，这头远古巨龙仍令人屏息：鳞甲与肌肉堆叠如山，周身勾勒着璀璨的魔法能量，像水面浮油般流光游移。无论这头生物生前功过如何，它的死亡都带着一种沉重，连凡世都能清晰感受到。
Words can hardly convey the stunning majesty of the creature that lies before you. Even in death the ancient dragon is breathtaking: a mountain of scale and muscle limned with scintillating magical energy that dances like oil on water. No matter the creature’s deeds in life, its death carries a weight felt in the mortal world.

回廊内狭窄逼仄，若非空气里萦绕着怡人的熏香，壁炉散发着暖意，角落里还堆着一小摞适合跪拜的祈祷软垫，这里几乎要让人心生窒息。一对蜡烛投下微弱却令人宽慰的光，照亮了小木祭坛上摊开的厚重典籍；祭坛上描绘着一位神祇显露其真实而宏伟的形貌。同样的圣徽也烙印在典籍封面上，亦点缀着其旁休息着的圣遗物。这片空间里弥漫着纯粹而彻底的虔敬。
The close confines of the cloister might evoke feelings of claustrophobia were it not for the pleasant odor of incense, the warmth of the hearth, and the small pile of prayer pillows suited for kneeling. A pair of candles provide meager but welcome light for the tome open upon a small wooden altar depicting a deity in their true, grand form. That same symbol adorns the tome itself, as well as the holy relic resting beside it. The space carries the feel of utter devotion.

Loot From A White Dracolich.name:
白龙巫妖的战利品
Loot From A White Dracolich

Text.text:
那不死的憎恶之物如同咆哮的暴风雪般怒吼着轰然坠地，冰川般的碎冰四散飞溅，将宝藏抛向四面八方。它虽已静止不动，那双空洞的眼眶——如今不再燃着巫焰——仍令你心生战栗，仿佛那噩梦般的暴君仍在注视着你，任你掠夺它那银辉灿灿的宝库。你找到一笔惊人的财富：成堆的银与铂金钱币、澄澈闪耀的宝石，以及古老的征服遗物，总价值相当于324,000枚金币。
The undead abomination bellows with the fury of a howling blizzard as it crashes to the ground, scattering treasures in every direction with a spray of glacial ice. Though it lies still, its hollow eyes—now devoid of witch light—fill you with trepidation, as if the nightmarish tyrant watches you still as you plunder its argent hoard. You find a fortune in silver and platinum coins, clear sparkling gems, and ancient artifacts of conquest worth 324,000 gold pieces.

从墨一般的黑暗中，两点微光逐渐炽亮，直至化作一双燃着奥术之火的眼睛。那光芒勾勒出生物面孔枯槁如骸的轮廓；当它逼近时，你猛然惊觉，心头一阵骇然——那张恶毒讥笑的脸根本不属于活物。一颗人形的头骨，离体无身，在空中浮沉；两枚多棱切面的宝石占据着空洞的眼眶。
From the inky darkness, two pinpoints of light grow in radiance until they appear as a pair of eyes ablaze with arcane fire. Their glow reveals the gaunt, skeletal traits of the creature’s visage, and as it looms closer, you realize with a pang of horror that the vile, sneering face is no living thing. A humanoid skull, disembodied, bobs in the air—a pair of faceted gemstones occupying the hollows of its eye sockets.

Eagle On Perch.name:
栖枝雄鹰
Eagle On Perch

Text.text:
一只雄鹰静静栖在最高的枝梢间，俯瞰下方的地形，以无与伦比的锐利目光搜寻一口鲜嫩的猎物。
Perched silently among the highest branches, an eagle surveys the terrain below, bringing its peerless eyesight to bear in search of a tender morsel.

Disjunction Chamber: Infusion Chamber.name:
解离之室：灌注之室
Disjunction Chamber: Infusion Chamber

Text.text:
闪电跳跃迸溅，沿着墙壁与地板里的缆线噼啪游走，又在一台奥术机器锋利的叉齿间嗡鸣跳动。整间屋子以力量低吟，震得你牙根发麻，头发根根竖起。无论这座密室意欲何为，它都像是在逆着自然行事——仿佛连空气本身都在反抗那装置的掌控。
Lightning leaps and sparks, crackling along cords in the walls and floors, and buzzing between the sharp tines of an arcane machine. The room hums with power. It vibrates your teeth and sets your hair on end. Whatever the purpose of this chamber, it seems to go against nature, for it feels as if the air itself rebels against the contraption’s control.

Alien Drug Dealer.name:
异星毒贩
Alien Drug Dealer

Text.text: 外星人熟练地抛出一套早已排练过的说辞，猛地敞开他那件宽大的长外套，里面一排排小玻璃瓶赫然在目，瓶中挤满了棱彩般的晶体，流光溢彩。你瞥见他腰间的手枪，他却压低声音，用密谋般的口吻耳语，夸耀他那沙子的力量与品质。他阴森地低笑，向你保证这将是毕生难忘的一趟旅程……还说你很快就会回来要更多。 Launching into a practiced spiel, the alien opens his large coat to reveal rows of small glass vials teeming with prismatic crystals. You note the sidearm at his hip as he whispers in conspiratorial tones, espousing the strength and quality of his sand. With a sinister chuckle he promises you the trip of a lifetime… and says you’ll soon be back for more.

I Study My Manual Of Gainful Exercise.name:
我研读《增益锻炼手册》
I Study My Manual Of Gainful Exercise

Text.text:
是时候窝进一把舒服的椅子里，吃饱喝足、精神清醒，把进度尽可能往前推进了。当我掀开掩蔽，我感觉它的时钟开始走动，震得我骨子里发响。研读起初还算怡人，但到了时代推移，我的肌肉开始酸痛，我需要休息，也饿得像要把一切吞下去。书页仿佛越来越沉，而在这些天里与它们相伴，我的肌肉也一寸寸长了出来。
Time to settle into a comfortable chair, well fed and awake, to make as much progress as possible. When I open the cover, I feel the clock of it begin, deep in my bones. The study is pleasant for a while, but in time, my muscles ache, I need rest, and I’m ravenously hungry. The book’s pages seem to gain weight, and over the days spent on these pages, I gain muscle.

Werewolf Wizard Fighting Minotaurs With.name:
狼人巫师挥舞雷霆，与牛头怪鏖战
Werewolf Wizard Fighting Minotaurs With Lightning

Text.text:
那狼形巫师四足疾奔，身影起伏如风，直冲向魁梧的牛头战士；火花自他爪间迸裂飞溅。轰然撞上去，仿佛暴怒神祇掷下的雷霆，他以超自然的蛮力猛扑，将牛头怪像咆哮的破布娃娃般高高抛向空中。

~ ThunderWolf 构想

Loping forward on all fours, the lupine wizard barrels toward the hulking bovine warriors as sparks erupt from the wizard’s paws. Crashing with the fury of a thunderbolt hurled by an angry god, he charges them with supernatural force, flinging the minotaurs high into the air like bellowing rag dolls.

~ Envisioned by ThunderWolf

Peace Officers Mercilessly Beat A Prone.name:
治安官冷酷无情地痛殴倒地的嫌犯
Peace Officers Mercilessly Beat A Prone Suspect

Text.text:
雨点般的拳脚倾泻在那名蜷缩着自卫的抗议者身上——治安官对这名俘虏毫不留情地殴打。人群挤压着全副武装的执法者，近身混战骤然爆发；愤怒与惊惧交织成一触即燃的烈性混合物。抗议者如狂潮般蜂拥而上，如此赤裸的暴行令他们再也无法忍受。
Blows rain down on the protester—their body curled up in defense—as the peace officers mercilessly beat their captive. A melee erupts as the crowd presses in on the armored enforcers, their frustration and horror proving to be a volatile mixture. The protesters rush them in a frenzied tide, the sight of such blatant injustice too much for them to bear.

峭壁拔地而起，高逾百尺，岩面起伏如揉皱的帷幕般层层荡开。石带沿着崖面向上铺陈出斑驳的色彩，其间更深的岩脊——想必是更坚硬的岩层——比周遭更为凸出，棱线分明。
The cliff rises more than a hundred feet, rippling in and out like a crinkled curtain. Bands of stone carry color up the face, with darker ridges of what must be harder stone projecting more than the others.

这头年迈的生物斑驳的蓝色皮肉，在浪涛之下沉埋多年后早已失去大半光泽，随时代褪到近乎灰白。阳光穿透水面，在这头恐龙的皮肤上洒下碎金般的斑点；刹那间，它仿佛重拾青春的辉煌，再次显现出昔日那般矫健而可怖的掠食者姿态。
The aged creature’s mottled blue flesh has lost much of its luster after many years beneath the waves, fading to near gray with time. Sun dapples the dinosaur’s hide through the water’s surface and, just for a moment, it recaptures the splendor of its youth and appears as the lithe, formidable predator it once was.

Montgomery \"Monty\" Mercer.name:
蒙哥马利“蒙蒂”·默瑟
Montgomery "Monty" Mercer

Text.text:
棕色绒耳微微竖起，他用犬科般的目光扫读着书页，眼睛绿得发亮，像新鲜青柠一般清透。他一边读，四条蓬松的尾巴便以起伏的节律轻轻摆荡，另一边又心不在焉地挠着素黑衬衫的领口。棕色无指手套为他修长的利爪留出了空间，他便用那爪尖小心翼翼地翻动纸页。额前、尖耳之前，架着一副皮带固定的护目镜，金色缝线闪烁着微光，将各处零件牢牢缀合。他低低地发出一声轻响，尾巴也随之停住。他的嗓音介于哼鸣与低吼之间——或许是读到了引人注意的段落，但那张狐科面孔依旧严肃如初，毫无波澜。

~ Played by Relu

Brown-furred ears perk as he scans a book with canine eyes, their color as bright and green as fresh limes. His four bushy tails waver in an undulating pattern as he reads, and he scratches absently at the collar of his plain black shirt. Fingerless brown gloves give room for his long claws, which he uses to gingerly flip through the pages. A pair of leather-strapped goggles sits on his brow just before his pointed ears, their shimmering gold stitching holding the pieces together. He lets out a quiet sound, his tails pausing. His voice is a cross between a hum and growl—perhaps he’s reached a passage of interest, though his vulpine face remains altogether serious and unmoved.

~ Played by Relu

Sputtering Firepit.name:
噼啪作响的火坑
Sputtering Firepit

Text.text:
一小堆营火把灰烬送上夜空，仿佛无畏的士兵在注定失败的战争里，对抗着坠落的雪之大军。围着火堆摆成一轮、充作长凳的木头上，能看出曾被拂去积雪以供人落座的痕迹，但如今又覆上一层新白，显然那并非不久前的事。
A small campfire sends ashes floating into the air, like brave soldiers fighting a doomed war against the army of falling snow. The logs set round the fire to serve as benches show signs of having been brushed off for people to sit, but the new coating of white shows it wasn’t very recent.

Dungeon: Dead Wizard.name:
地城：死巫师
Dungeon: Dead Wizard

Text.text:
一具静止的身躯瘫靠在墙边，毫无生机迹象。此人身着精致长袍与轻便靴子，而那顶滑落遮住面庞的帽子更是让人毫不怀疑——这曾是位法师。双手仍紧紧攥着一截碎裂的木杖，腰侧的挎包敞开着，零碎杂物散落一地。
A still form lies slumped against the wall with no indication of life. The figure is dressed in fine robes and light boots, though the hat that's fallen over their face is what removes all doubt that this individual was a wizard. Their hands are still clasped around a shaft of splintered wood, and odds and ends spill out of a satchel near their waist.

I Cast Foresight.name:
我施放「预见」
I Cast Foresight

Text.text:
我深吸一口气，胸膛随之鼓胀，汲取我储备的魔法力量；将奥术的影响力探入时代的织锦，探入那不受时代束缚的智慧深井。引导这股秘力时，我的双眼泛起光芒，世界在我眼中如同建筑师的蓝图展开——敌人的内在布局一览无遗：下一步、下一次挥击、下一声呼喝。我轻拍同伴的肩头。刹那间，我们的目光化作彼此呼应的白焰之池，随后魔法自我心智奔涌而出，灌入他们的意识。
My chest swells with my breath as I tap into my magical reserves, reaching my arcane influence into the tapestry of time, into the timeless wells of wisdom. My eyes glow while I channel this mystical power, and I read the world as an architect’s draft, understanding the internal plans of the enemy—each next step, swing, and shout. I tap the shoulder of my comrade. Our eyes are matching pools of white flame for a moment before the magic rushes from my mind into theirs.

I Cast Animate Dead.name:
我施放《死者复苏》
I Cast Animate Dead

Text.text:
这是一小剂阴森的酿物。像个好奇的孩子戳弄尸骸一般，我把指尖一滴血与骨粉混作一团。我将那糊状物捅进一片恶臭的肉屑里，然后把这团污秽如同圣礼般举到眼前，照着我的魔典挥动。于是你出现了，归来一日，腐败溃烂，几乎没有心智。我的仆从。我的亡者守卫。
Here is a macabre little brew. Like a curious child poking a carcass, I mix a drop of blood on the end of my finger with bone dust. I prod the paste into a stinking sliver of flesh, and lift the filth before me in sacrament, waving it according to my grimoire. And there you are, back for a day, putrescent and all but mindless. My servant. My dead protector.

Insult From Mortally Wounded Soldier.name:
来自濒死士兵的辱骂
Insult From Mortally Wounded Soldier

Text.text:
“哎呀瞧瞧，你竟然把我杀了。没想到真能办到。至少我用不着再忍受你那股恶臭多久了。”
“Well look at that, you’ve killed me. Didn’t think it could be done. At least I won’t have to suffer your stench for much longer.”

Brittle's Potions And Alchemical Supplie.name:
脆裂的药剂与炼金补给品
Brittle's Potions And Alchemical Supplies

Text.text:
[外部] 面向城镇广场、夹在两家店铺之间的是一栋狭窄的两层小楼。外立面由风化的砖墙与深色木构框架组成，拱形门廊的两侧各嵌着一扇巨大的锻铁窗。门上方悬着一块浅绿色招牌，金色字样写着布里特尔的药水与炼金用品。

[内部] 你踏入店内，浓烈草药的气味——混杂着油脂与药剂的花香——几乎迎面砸在鼻腔里。你一边努力从冲突的香臭中分辨出层次，一边打量货架上陈列的灵药、滋补剂与酊剂。店主并未立刻现身，但柜台后方门口垂着的帘子里传来臼与杵持续研磨的圆润声响。

[Outside] Facing the town square and lodged between two other storefronts stands a narrow two-story building. Its facade is made of weathered brick and dark timber framing, with a great wrought-iron window on each side of its arched entryway. A pale green sign with gold lettering reads Brittle’s Potions and Alchemical Supplies over the door.

[Inside] As you enter the shop, the smell of potent herbs—combined with the flowery scents of oils and potions—is an assault on your nose. You try to sift through the contrasting odors as you view the elixirs, tonics, and tinctures on the shelves. The proprietor isn’t immediately obvious, but the circular grinding sound of a mortar and pestle comes through a curtain that hangs in the doorway behind the counter.

Sundries From A Vicious Slaver.name:
恶奴贩子的零碎杂货
Sundries From A Vicious Slaver

Text.text:
肿胀的舌头垂在腐烂的牙齿间，那男人仰面摊在一滩血泊里。你在他的腰带上翻找，镣铐与绳索之间藏着一件古怪的物体：一只小小的笼子。这座空荡、微不足道的迷你牢狱由暗淡的灰色金属铸成，但有个细节格外刺眼——每一根栏杆上，都刻着同一个名字。
Bloated tongue hanging betwixt rotten teeth, the man lies sprawled in a pool of blood. On his belt, hidden among the shackles and ropes, you find a strange object: a tiny cage. The empty, miniscule prison is made of a dull, gray metal but one detail in particular catches your eye—a name is engraved once on every bar.

I Swing My Staff Of Striking With Force.name:
我奋力挥舞我的重击法杖
I Swing My Staff Of Striking With Force

Text.text:
我挥杖猛击的同时高声喊出命令词，冲击点瞬间迸发出一团力场爆裂。伴随这一挥落，浑厚的轰鸣声震荡四周，空气中充斥着突如其来的、强劲而磅礴的魔法能量激荡。
I shout the command word as I strike with my staff, causing a blast of force to erupt against the point of impact. A sonorous boom accompanies the swing as the air fills with the sudden discharge of potent, powerful magical energy.

Towering, Ancient Tree.name:
参天古树
Towering, Ancient Tree

Text.text:
这里矗立着森林的心脏——一尊洪荒巨灵，根须向四面八方延展，绵延数里。它比任何堡垒更宽、更高、更雄伟，粗壮的枝杈铺天盖地，连日光都被它的荫影吞没。苔藓与藤蔓蜿蜒攀上树干，又从令人眩晕的高处垂落。十余种鸟类在它的树冠间筑巢。你被这景象的无上庄严所震慑，也被它那沉重如山的引力效果压得几乎喘不过气来。你仿佛正站在一位神明面前。
Here stands the heart of the forest—a primordial titan whose roots extend leagues in every direction. It towers wider, taller, and mightier than any fortress, with boughs and branches that shadow the sun itself. Moss and vines snake up the trunk and dangle from its dizzying heights. Birds, a dozen varieties, nest in its canopy. You are struck by the sheer majesty of this sight and the effect of its immense gravity upon you. You may as well stand before a god.

I Lather Myself In Mud.name:
我把自己全身涂满泥浆
I Lather Myself In Mud

Text.text:
我把泥浆抹满四肢，那种怡人的清凉与土腥气立刻让我的肌肉与感官安定下来。我用手大把大把地抹，把更多泥浆涂在胸口、背脊和颈后，最后再点些在脸上作收尾。它的气味明亮而繁复，肥沃得仿佛孕育着葱茏的可能。我闭上眼放松下来，期待那层可塑的泥壳干透的时刻——到时我就能像一只生物长大、蜕去甲壳般，将它整片剥落。
I smear mud over my limbs, and the pleasant coolness and earthen scent immediately cause my muscles and senses to calm. With generous swipes of my hands, I smear more mud over my chest, back, and neck, then as the final touch I dab bits onto my face. Its aroma is bright and complex, fertile with verdant possibility. I close my eyes and relax, anticipating the moment when my fictile shell dries out and I can slough it off like a creature outgrowing its carapace.

Spell Scroll Case (Divine).name:
法术卷轴匣（神圣）
Spell Scroll Case (Divine)

Text.text:
这根闪耀的银色圆筒上，抛光的外壁以细腻刻工镌刻着宗教圣像与神圣经文。祈祷念珠紧紧缠绕其上，宛如拥抱；两端各以一枚华美的金色圣徽封顶。
This gleaming silver tube has religious iconography and passages of holy scripture engraved delicately into its polished exterior. Prayer beads wrap the tube in a tight embrace, and a decorative, golden holy symbol caps each end.

蝙蝠死死攀在栖木上，瘦骨嶙峋的手臂裹着焦黑的翼膜。额前两根角如猪尾般卷曲，皮肤油亮而覆着细绒，像蜘蛛的腹部。它急促喘息，每一次嘶鸣喉间的光都更炽亮。宝石般的猩红双眼紧锁着你，它张开嘴，露出一条翻涌灼烧的咽喉，热得如同熔炉。
The bat grips onto its perch, its skinny, skeletal arms cloaked in charred wings. Two horns curve like pigs’ tails from its brow, its skin shining and fuzzy like a spider’s abdomen. It breathes rapidly, its throat glowing brighter with each wheeze. Ruby-red eyes lock upon you and its mouth opens, revealing a seething throat as hot as a forge.

Druid's Starscape.name:
德鲁伊的星幕
Druid's Starscape

Text.text:
你面前的球体内蕴一方宇宙，只需片刻凝神，你便能刺破帷幕，迈入那片太阳系的仿影——血肉凡胎只能从坚实地表遥遥仰望的所在。浩瀚星海环绕着你渺小得近乎毁灭的身形，星座开始在黑暗中勾勒成形。你微启双唇欲言，声浪却化作震耳雷鸣，横贯虚空。星座随之闪烁，像被点燃的生命；你这才意识到，它们蕴藏着敏锐而不可知的心智。它们漂浮着，蓄势待发，准备回应。

~ 由 Stefano Imperiale Envisioned

The globe in front of you holds a universe within, and it takes only a moment of concentration for you to pierce the veil and step into a copy of the solar system fleshy mortals have only been able to see from solid ground. In the vast starscape that surrounds your devastatingly small form, constellations begin to take shape. Your lips part to speak, and from them sounds a thunderous boom across the void. The constellations flicker with life, and you realize they hold a keen, unknowable sentience. They float, ready to respond.

~ Envisioned by Stefano Imperiale

Karalaq Quori.name:
卡拉拉克·夸里
Karalaq Quori

Text.text:
在你面前伫立着一只源自最深沉噩梦深处的生物：一道阴影般的身形，仿佛螳螂与巨蛇扭曲交织而成。它周身环绕着成群恶意浮游的眼球，似乎回荡着受害者痛苦的哀号——那些人也许再也不会醒来。也许你正疑惑，当你盯着那张邪恶的面孔、看它将目光钉死在你的同伴身上时，自己是否很快也会迎来同样的结局。又或者，将遭受远远、远远更可怕的下场……
Before you stands a creature borne from the recesses of one's darkest nightmares: a shadowy figure that seems to be a twisted cross between a mantis and a serpent. It is surrounded by a multitude of malicious floating eyes, which seem to echo with the agonized voices of its victims—who may never wake again. Perhaps you wonder, as you stare at the wicked visage transfixed upon your comrades, if you will soon meet the same fate. Or possibly suffer much, much worse…

Severed Humanoid Head.name:
被斩下的人形头颅
Severed Humanoid Head

Text.text:
一个类地精生物的腰带上垂着一颗类人生物的头颅，被鲜血与结痂的脑浆糊得面目全非，已无法辨认。这种伤害出自毫无良知、毫无愧意的存在——那人以夺取并炫耀这份战利品为乐。

~ 由一位英雄在 Envisioned

From the belt of a goblinoid hangs the head of a humanoid, unrecognizable beneath the blood and crusted brain matter. This damage is the kind done by a being without conscience or qualm, someone who reveled in scoring this trophy.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Seduction Of A Vampire.name:
吸血鬼的诱惑
Seduction Of A Vampire

Text.text:
“也许有人会说这很鲁莽，甚至疯狂，但爱情从不理会这样的警告。我从未见过像你这般强大又迷人的生物。当你用那双饥渴的眼睛看着我时，我的脊背便窜起一阵战栗——唯有我胯下翻涌的那股颤意，才能与之匹敌。”
“Some may call it reckless or insane, but love does not heed such warnings. I’ve never met as powerful or fascinating a creature as you. When you look at me with those hungry eyes, it sends a shiver down my spine that is only matched by the one in my loins.”

Tropical Jungle: Down By The River.name:
热带雨林：河畔之下
Tropical Jungle: Down By The River

Text.text:
河流像一把锯齿利刃劈开丛林，撕出一道崎岖的裂口，让阳光得以漏下，催生出河岸上你在别处从未见过的繁盛植物。即便如此，两侧的植被仍向水面倾身探出，仿佛拼命想重新合拢。河水在明暗交错间奔涌不息，撞过乱石，入深处便盘旋回卷——频繁的雨水与无数支流不断为它注入新生。
The river cuts a jagged line through the jungle, allowing sunlight to filter in and causing the growth along its banks of a profusion of plants you’ve not seen elsewhere. Even so, vegetation on either side leans out over the water, as if straining to rejoin. The river tumbles ever on through sunlight and shadow, rushing over rocks and swirling in deeper sections—fed by frequent rains and innumerable streams.

尽管他额头上有一道显眼的皱褶，眼角也刻着深深的鱼尾纹，这位半身人的眼睛仍闪烁着戏谑的笑意。他一边整理那件俊朗的蓝色外套袖口，动作利落而从容。上臂袖处绣着三道金菊色的环纹，醒目却不张扬，像低声的徽记，提醒着旁人这位矮小男子在宫廷与律法之道上的正规造诣与老练掌控。
Despite a noticeable crease in his forehead and pronounced crow’s feet at the corners of his eyes, the halfling’s eyes still twinkle with mirth as he adjusts the sleeves of his handsome blue jacket. Three goldenrod rings have been embroidered into the upper sleeves, noticeable but understated reminders of the diminutive man’s formal mastery of the courts and their laws.

Hag Feast: Hag Forest.name:
鬼婆盛宴：鬼婆森林
Hag Feast: Hag Forest

Text.text:
这片荒凉的森林里，嶙峋扭曲的树木在头顶佝偻成拱，树干并非被风朝同一个方向压弯，而是向四面八方歪斜——如今背负着年代与苦楚。偶尔传来乌鸦啼声的回响，或野兽远处的低沉咆哮，提醒着你：除此之外，森林寂静得近乎死寂，毫无生机。
Gnarled and twisted trees hunch overhead in this forlorn forest, their trunks bent not in one direction by wind but every which way—now burdened by age and misery. The occasional echo of a raven’s call or a beast’s distant rumble serves to remind you how, otherwise, the forest stands silent and lifeless.

这名地精刺客是黑暗中无声的幽影，潜行的威胁裹挟着致命的危险。脚步被压得几不可闻，锋利而阴毒的刀刃寒光闪烁，他们怀揣杀意，悄然逼近自己的目标。作为死亡的先兆，他们从阴影中剥离而出，迫不及待要将又一缕灵魂献给他们的主人。
This goblin assassin is a silent specter in the dark, a creeping threat wreathed in danger. With muffled steps and sharp, wicked blades, they steal toward their target with lethal intent. A harbinger of death, they peel from the shadows, eager to send another soul to their master.

Antiquities Shop In Academic Borough.name:
学术区古董店
Antiquities Shop In Academic Borough

Text.text:
[外部] 学院区一条鹅卵石小巷旁，立着一栋狭窄的半木结构楼，左右两侧的联排民居像肩膀般夹着它，使其挺直不歪。门上悬着一块雕刻招牌：墙洞。门的体型并不如人所料，比寻常矮了一截。它悄无声息地开启，通向一间拱梁高挑、地面铺着地毯的店铺：古董与杂物塞得满满当当，标价随意，或上架、或搁置、或堆叠，杂乱却诱人。对面墙上有一扇圆形橡木制的半身人小门。

[内部] 穿过店门，你来到一家人的起居处。这里温暖舒适——主要由一扇巨大的圆窗照亮，窗外是一条覆满常春藤的窄巷——陈设也尽是店里最上乘的货色。两幅画挂在精美的旧银雕画框中。其中一幅里，一对半身人男女带着两个十二岁左右的孩子，坐着微笑。女人下方刻着Clara，而在更近些时候又添刻了RIP。另一幅画中站着一位笑容爽朗的半身人，Lillian，眉眼与Clara惊人相似。

~ 由Daredevildad 构想

[Outside] Off a cobbled lane in the academic borough stands a narrow half-timbered building, kept straight by flanking townhouses. Over the door hangs a carved sign: Hole in the Wall. The door isn’t quite the size one would expect, being shorter than the norm. It opens quietly into a shop of arched beams and rug-covered floors, packed with antiquities and bric-a-brac haphazardly priced, shelved, and piled. On the opposite wall is a round oaken halfling door.

[Inside] Through the shop door, you find the family residence. It is comfortable—lit mostly by a huge round window that looks out on an ivy-covered alley—and decorated with the best of the shop’s wares. Two paintings hang in beautiful old silver-engraved frames. In one, a halfling man and woman sit smiling with two children, twelvish. Under the woman is engraved Clara, and, more recently, RIP. In the other painting stands a jovial-looking halfling, Lillian, who looks remarkably similar to Clara.

~ Envisioned by Daredevildad

Githzerai Disciple.name:
吉斯泽莱门徒
Githzerai Disciple

Text.text:
清明与笃定的使命感统御着弟子存在的每一处性相，使其得以将秩序带入他们所感知的翻涌混沌之中。带纹的蛙状皮肤紧绷覆在铁硬的肌肉上，长而尖的耳朵自剃光的头颅向上弯起。肃峻的面容上，一抹鼻梁的轮廓伏在猩黄的眼睛下方；他们的衣着朴素黯淡，毫无任何装饰。
Clarity and surety of purpose govern every aspect of the disciple’s being, allowing them to bring order to the roiling chaos they perceive around them. Patterned, frog-like skin stretches taut over iron-hard muscles, and long sharp ears curve upward from a shaven head. A suggestion of a nose sits beneath lurid yellow eyes in their stern countenance, and their clothing is simple, drab, and without adornment of any kind.

Warrior's Advice About Mastery.name:
战士的精通箴言
Warrior's Advice About Mastery

Text.text:
“人生其实很简单。无非是重复与磨炼——学会走路，学会战斗，学会去爱。在这一生里，你只有时代去精通寥寥几件事；务必谨慎选择。”
“Life is quite simple, really. It’s just repetition and training—learning to walk, learning to fight, learning to love. You have time to master only a handful of things in this life; choose wisely.”

Thunderstorm: After The Storm.name:
雷暴：风雨之后
Thunderstorm: After The Storm

Text.text:
暴风投下的浓重阴影已然散去，云层偶尔裂开一道缝隙，让一束束光柱坠落在大地上，照亮仍在坠落的雨丝与蜿蜒的水流。四周鸟鸣此起彼伏，仿佛在为危机的终结而欢呼。
The thick shadows cast by the storm have passed, with the clouds occasionally parting to let columns of light fall across the landscape, illuminating streams of still-falling rain. All around you, birds call out to each other, seeming to celebrate the end of the danger.

Lightning Striking A Ship's Mast.name:
闪电劈中船桅
Lightning Striking A Ship's Mast

Text.text:
一道闪电撕裂头顶的云幕，紧随其后雷声轰然砸落。电光击中船桅，木料迸出火星、炸裂四散。碎片飞射，噼啪砸在甲板上，船员们慌忙寻找掩蔽。横桁仍在闷闷冒烟，附近的绳索被烧得焦黑，开裂崩断。

~ 由 Sahlonahl 构想

A beam of lightning tears through the canopy of clouds above, a roll of thunder crashing down directly after it. The bolt hits the mast of the ship, wood sparking and splintering. Shards fly, pelting the deck, the crew scrambling for cover. The spar is left smoldering, the nearby ropes charred and splitting.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl

Threatening Enhanced Criminal Enforcer.name:
威吓型强化罪犯执法者
Threatening Enhanced Criminal Enforcer

Text.text:
女人身上的义体并不显眼，但在她魁梧的躯干上仍能捕捉到足够多的蛛丝马迹。黑暗里，她的眼睛泛着微光——不算强，却比应有的更亮。皮肉与金属的接缝藏在西装袖口与裤脚的边缘之外，只有当她略微挪动重心时才会一闪而过。她举止间那份从容与松弛的警觉，比任何一堵金属高墙都更令人胆寒。
The cybernetics on the woman aren't obvious, but there are enough hints on her hulking frame. Her eyes shine in the dark, not much, but more than they should. Seams between flesh and metal lie just beyond the sleeves of her suit and cuffs of her pants, only offering a glimpse when she adjusts her weight. The poise and relaxed alertness she carries herself with is much more intimidating than a wall of metal could ever be.

Approaching The Harvest Throne.name:
走近丰收王座
Approaching The Harvest Throne

Text.text:
成垛的谷束在月光下的田野里如同聚拢的人群般伫立，但一抹温暖的光芒越过禾捆牵引着你的目光，投向那片阴暗、枯叶尽褪的林地树线。灌木丛边缘，纠结的枝桠之后，有针尖般的微光忽明忽灭。看起来像是有人点燃了数十支蜡烛，把它们摆在纠结枝蔓中心的一张宽大长桌四周。
Stooked grain stands like a gathered crowd in the moonlit field, but a warm glow draws your eyes beyond the sheafs to the tree line of a dark and leafless wood. Pinpricks of light flicker behind a tangle of tree boughs at the edge of the thicket. It looks like someone has lit a few dozen candles and set them around a broad table at the tangle’s center.

怪异的异星之光从灯塔高耸的彩绘玻璃窗间倾泻而出，引诱船只驶向锯齿般的礁岩。水手们远远绕开这座岛屿，坚信它被某个邪恶的异界存在所诅咒，正引诱不幸的灵魂走向覆灭。围绕这座宏伟建筑疯长的巨型惑心真菌，随着迷人的虹彩脉动，低低吟出催眠般的挽歌。
Strange alien light pours from the towering stained-glass windows of the lighthouse, drawing ships to the jagged rocks. Sailors give the island a wide berth, believing it to be cursed by a fell otherworldly entity luring unfortunate souls to their doom. The enormous mind-bending fungi growing around this magnificent edifice emit a low, hypnotic dirge as they pulse with alluring, prismatic hues.

Axel Tipstep.name:
阿克塞尔·踮步
Axel Tipstep

Text.text:
绷带与朴素破旧的衣物几乎遮住了这位身形修长的年轻人全身。几枚由骨片、珠子与半宝石串成的彩色护符从他的装束上垂坠摇晃，一只钢制酒壶挂在他帆布腰带旁。唯有他晒成古铜色的脸庞与一蓬深棕卷发仍裸露在外。缠绕在颈间的布条止于颈侧时，波纹般起伏的疤痕从边缘探出一角。纵然这些痕迹暗示着过往的苦难，他那双蓝眼仍明亮，笑意爽朗。

~ Played by Hells Fury

Bandages and simple, shabby clothes cover most of this willowy young man’s body. Several colorful talismans of bone, bead, and semiprecious stone dangle from his outfit, and a steel hip-flask hangs on his canvas belt. Only his tan face and mop of dark-brown curls remain uncovered. Where the wrappings end at his neck, rippled scars peek out. Despite these hints of past suffering, his blue-eyed look is bright and jovial.

~ Played by Hells Fury

Chasme Attack.name:
恰斯魔的攻击
Chasme Attack

Text.text:
那如雷霆般的嗡鸣在虫形巨兽降临前先一步袭来，重重敲打着你的耳膜——刺耳、粗粝的震颤，让你牙关不住打战。一只黑色、臃肿的苍蝇从地底裂隙中升起。它巨大而可怖，比一匹小马还要庞然；那对多面复眼在黑暗里锁定了你。倒刺般的长腿从鼓胀的躯体下垂，象鼻似的口器饥渴地向前探觅。它透明的翅膜一阵颤抖，下一瞬便猛然朝你俯冲而来。

~ Envisioned by DMJoe

The thunderous drone that precedes the insectoid beast’s arrival drums in your ears, a discordant, raw hum that sets your teeth chattering. A black, bloated fly rises from the subterranean chasm. It’s a massive and terrible thing, larger than a pony, and its multifaceted eyes find you in the darkness. Barbed legs dangle from its bulbous form, while an elephantine proboscis probes hungrily forward. It hurtles suddenly toward you with a quivering of its pellucid wings.

~ Envisioned by DMJoe

这片森林绵延数英里，细长的枝桠在头顶高处交织成团，纠缠成网，将天空尽数遮蔽。红杉高耸，远远凌驾于其荫蔽下的一切草木之上；从每一根巨大的树干旁经过，都仿佛踉跄走过泰坦的双腿之间。松鼠拌嘴般的吱喳声在林间回荡，一只啄木鸟在其中一位巨人身上凿洞的断续节拍也同样清晰可闻。
This forest extends for miles, its spindly branches high overhead creating a tangle to block out the sky. The redwoods dwarf all other plant life growing in their wake, and passing by each massive trunk is akin to traipsing past the legs of titans. The bickering chirps of squirrels echo, as does the staccato rhythm of a woodpecker boring holes into one of these giants.

Ebony Fly Figurine Of Wondrous Power.name:
乌木飞蝇奇物强能雕像
Ebony Fly Figurine Of Wondrous Power

Text.text:
这尊纯黑檀木小雕像仿佛一片被捕捉并凝固的阴影，定格成一只马蝇的形象。它的翅膀是纤薄的带状结构，中间留出数道空隙，仿照真实昆虫翅膜的半透明与脉络。握在手里略显不适——细长的足肢与盘绕的口器突兀地顶进你的掌心。
The pure ebony statuette is like a piece of shadow captured and frozen into the image of a horsefly. The wings are thin bands separated by several gaps, mimicking the translucency and veins of true insect wings. It is a bit uncomfortable to hold, as the spindly legs and twirling proboscis jut into your palm.

Mountain Stream Cuts Through Forest.name:
山涧穿林而过
Mountain Stream Cuts Through Forest

Text.text:
一如既往，那条溪流咕噜作响，化作奔涌的急流切开森林，将自然的丰饶裹挟着送往四周的土地。远处，水源之所在如巨神般巍然耸立——一座高耸入云、峰顶覆雪的山岳。
As it has always done, the stream cuts through the forest in a burbling torrent, carrying the bounty of nature to the surrounding lands. In the distance the source of the water looms like a titan—a towering, snow-capped mountain.

在这里，城堡守军最脆弱的所在，反倒成了进攻者最致命的险地。看那一片以螺栓铆接成网格的铁桩阵，专为抵御冲车或攻城器械而设，底端锤打成尖刺。瓮城两座塔楼之间，伴着绞盘与铁链的铿锵声，这位守护门道与吊桥的卫士，或张开铁口以礼相迎，或低吼着猛然咬合，将敌人死死咬住。
Here, the most vulnerable place for a castle's defenders becomes the most dangerous to its attackers. Look at the grid of iron posts bolted together against ram or engine, hammered to spikes at the bottom. Between the towers of the barbican, to the sound of winch and chain, the protector of doorway and drawbridge either opens its iron mouth in hospitality or growls and bites down against the foe.

空气里弥漫着烤肠与野味在炊火上滋滋作响的香气，还有铁匠炉火那股带着铁锈般锐利的金属味——一如既往。但取暖篝火烧得更旺，木烟更浓。铁匠的锤声在寂静的场地里回荡，像冰冷的钟声一下一下敲过。积雪吞没了别的声响，连倾斜栏旁奔马如雷的蹄声也被压低。商贩依旧吆喝买卖，人们仍挤在看台上抱团取暖，杯口蒸汽袅袅升起——可这场比武更为简朴；在冰冷泥泞的赛场上，阴沉的荣誉与钱压过了所有排场。
The air smells of sausages and wild game over cooking fires, and the iron bite of the forge, just as it always does. But there is more woodsmoke from warming bonfires. The smith’s hammer sounds toll like an icy bell through the quiet grounds. The snow muffles other sounds, even the thundering of hooves along the tilt rail. Merchants still sell, and people still huddle in the stands, steam floating from mugs, but this tournament is more spartan—grim honor and money prevail over pageantry on the cold, muddy field.

Goddess Of The Sea.name:
海洋女神
Goddess Of The Sea

Text.text:
她开口时，话语里带着古老的知见与神裔传承的威权——那几乎就是整个世界。月之母赐她潮汐与洪洪的力量。她的肌肤是盐，是蓝绿的卤水。她的发如海的化身，在她壮丽而骇人的面容与强健、覆鳞的身躯旁翻涌盘旋。她有时是鱼，或半身为鱼；但此刻她是属于自身水栖族群的女人，是水手与采珠者、渔夫与美人鱼的守护者，亦或毁灭者。
She speaks with old knowledge and the authority of her divine inheritance, which is most of the world. Mother Moon gives her the power of the tides and floods. Her skin is salt and blue-green brine. Her hair is an expression of the oceans, roiling around her magnificent and terrifying face and powerful, scaly body. Sometimes she is a fish, or half of her is, but for now she is a woman of her own aquatic race, protector or destroyer of sailors and pearl divers, fishermen and mermaids.

Civilian Trading Vessel: Improvised Sick.name:
民用商船：临时医务舱
Civilian Trading Vessel: Improvised Sick Bay

Text.text:
这艘船上的船员已尽力把这间逼仄的办公室布置得尽可能让病人舒服些，但仍差强人意。一袋点滴无力地悬在一根临时拼凑的支架上，病床也不过是一张可折叠的行军床，垫着几只扁平的枕头勉强充当慰藉。那张磨旧的病榻布面上还能看见几处可疑的污渍，而桌上的小急救包更是显得急需补给。
The crew on this vessel have done their best to make the cramped office as comfortable as possible for the patient, but it leaves a lot to be desired. An IV hangs limply from a jury-rigged stand, and the bed is little more than a fold-out cot with some flat pillows for comfort. A few questionable stains can be seen on the worn fabric of the sickbed and the small first aid kit on the desk looks in dire need of resupply.

生物张开巨口，发出狮吼般的咆哮，但与任何寻常野兽的相似之处也仅止于此。它的牙齿如鲨——足足三排——全身覆着细长尖刺，一旦穿透你的防御，必将带来刺骨剧痛。它振翼升空，臃肿的身躯遮蔽了部分光线，随即猛甩尾巴向前抽去，从尾尖抛射出尖刺，直指要夺你性命。
The creature's maw opens in a leonine roar, but the resemblance to any mundane creature ends there. Its teeth are those of a shark—three rows deep—and its body is covered in long spines that promise to be painful if they pass your defenses. It takes wing, its bulky form blocking out some light, and whips its tail forward, slinging spikes from its tip and aiming to end your life.

Mercenary Council Chambers.name:
雇佣兵议会厅
Mercenary Council Chambers

Text.text:
营地里牲畜粪便、灶火与久未洗净的士兵所混杂的气味，一踏入那顶巨大的圆形帐篷门帘内便渐渐淡去，取而代之的是悬挂香炉里燃起的浓烈熏香，沉沉弥漫。这里尽是适合随旅行而行的奢华之物：华美地毯、皮毛毯子，以及小巧却做工精致的椅子。一只敞开的箱匣里放着几卷收拢的羊皮卷，看起来像是地图。
The camp scents of animal dung, cookfires, and unwashed soldiers diminishes inside the flap of the large circular tent, covered by the heady scent of incense burning in hanging braziers. Here the luxuries that travel well are on full display: fine rugs, fur blankets, and small but beautifully made chairs. An open coffer holds several rolled scrolls that appear to be maps.

Divine Home Of A Goddess Of Harvest.name:
丰收女神的神圣居所
Divine Home Of A Goddess Of Harvest

Text.text:
她有许多屋舍，每一处都能暂作归家——每一处都有一户务农的人家，细心照看着这片土地。对泥土的眷恋、农历与物候的知识、那双能把万物养活的巧手：正是这些引她来到需要她最后祝福的地方，去为仍然挺立的秆茎、繁茂的灌丛、以及挂满果实的树木一一加持。这里就是其中一处屋舍。她栖身于此，对着细雨微笑，为干旱叹息，祝福地窖里的根茎与覆盖严实的陶瓮。去找她吧——她就站在金色的田野里，张开双臂，对着乌鸦大笑。
She has many houses, and each becomes home for a while—each with its family of farmers, caring for the land. Love for the soil, almanac knowledge, the green thumb: these are what attract her to a place that needs her final blessing over all the standing stalks, teeming bushes, and trees in full fruit. This is one of those houses. She abides here, smiling at a light rain, lamenting drought, blessing the root cellar and the covered urn. Look for her standing in the golden field, arms out, laughing at crows.

Quip About Cursed Blade.name:
关于诅咒之刃的俏皮话
Quip About Cursed Blade

Text.text:
“每次我用这东西把野兽劈倒，都仿佛它体内有什么在微笑。我不知道那是胜利的喜悦还是嗜血的渴望，但它出手狠准、永不餍足——对我来说，这就够了。”
“Every time I strike a beast down with this thing it’s as if something within it smiles. Whether it’s from victory or bloodlust I don’t know, but it strikes true and insatiably, so that’s good enough for me.”

Public Park In Disrepair.name:
年久失修的公共公园
Public Park In Disrepair

Text.text:
公园是一片广袤的荒败草坪，曾经葱茏生机，如今只剩枯死的树与稀疏的草——一块被摩天大楼包围的孤寂长方形。入口处那扇老旧的铁门在开启时吱呀作响。向东，是游乐设施的残骸，唯独一架秋千在风里轻轻摇晃，枯叶绕着滑梯翻飞起舞。向西，是一座干涸的湖，如今腐朽成肮脏的混凝土盆地，墙面点缀着色彩斑斓的涂鸦。
The park is a vast expanse of decrepit lawns, once lush with life. Now it is covered with little more than dead trees and sparse grass—a lonely rectangle surrounded by skyscrapers. The entrance, an old iron gate, creaks at its opening. Eastward is the remnant of a play structure, the only swing gently swaying in the wind, dead leaves dancing around the slide. To the west is a drained lake, now decayed into a grimy concrete basin adorned with colorful graffiti.

Alien Antiques Dealer Of The Forbidden.name:
禁忌异宝古董商
Alien Antiques Dealer Of The Forbidden

Text.text:
这名披着黑袍的异族周身散发着阴冷而优雅的气息，燧石般的目光仿佛能刺穿你的灵魂。他的笑容如锯齿般锋利，没有一丝温度，嗓音却过分丝滑，暗示着那无懈可击的伪装之下潜藏着黑暗。随着他一个手势，价值连城的古董全息影像闪烁成形，柔和的光将房间染成翡翠色。那些明显被禁的藏品与异域珍物，都与它们的主人如出一辙。
The dark-robed alien exudes an air of sinister elegance, with a flinty gaze that seems to pierce your soul. His serrated smile holds no warmth and his tone is too silky, hinting at a darkness beneath his impeccable facade. At a gesture, holos of priceless antiques flicker into being, the soft light painting the room jade. Both the obviously forbidden pieces and the exotic items mirror their owner exactly.

这只帆布包内分隔出数个夹层、袋囊与套环。袋囊以别针扣合，便于迅速开启。套环中紧紧束着一根暗铁撬棍、一把羊角锤、一盏罩灯与一只水袋，旁侧还留有空环可挂其他工具。包侧一条更宽的束带固定着一卷麻绳。
This canvas pack has several compartments, pouches, and loops. The pouches have pin closures for easy opening. Bound tightly in the pack’s loops are a crowbar of dark iron, a claw hammer, a hooded lantern, and a waterskin, with empty rings for other tools. A larger strap on the pack’s side holds a coil of hempen rope.

Quip By A Healer About An Accident-prone.name:
治疗师对一位老出事故的同伴的调侃
Quip By A Healer About An Accident-prone Companion

Text.text:
“你知道的，有那么个时刻，你会开始觉得所谓的治疗，不过是在阻止你学到一堂该学的教训。”
“You know, there’s a point where it begins to feel like healing is just stopping you from learning a good lesson.”

Dorian \"Lostsong\" Lavellan.name:
多里安“失落之歌”拉维兰
Dorian "Lostsong" Lavellan

Text.text:
他龇着牙，发出坚毅的低吼，将一柄发光的长剑横在身前——剑身如午夜般幽暗，其间银色纹理脉络纵横。淡银色的纹身如藤蔓般爬过他精瘦手臂的古铜肌肤，呼应着武器上蜿蜒的银线。长长的灰发束成发髻，紫罗兰色的眼睛以精灵特有的冷冽利落审视着威胁。他身上的朴素昏色亚麻衣料一闪而逝，随即化作护甲：锐利的铆钉在深色皮革的底面上如星光般闪烁。胸前，一只陶笛用布绳悬挂着，随着他猛然突进而危险地摇晃，他以迅雷之势挥出一记迅捷斩击。

~ Played by Caio Cordeiro

Teeth bared in a stalwart snarl, he holds before him a glowing sword—a dramatic, midnight-hued blade veined with silver. Pale silver tattoos vine over the tanned skin of his lean arms, mirroring the tendril lines along his weapon. Long gray hair is tied back in a bun and his violet eyes survey the threat with keen elven efficiency. The simple dusky linens he wears shimmer and disappear to reveal armor: sharp studs glinting like stars over a canvas of dark leather. On his chest, an ocarina hanging from fabric cord dances precariously as he surges forward in a swift strike.

~ Played by Caio Cordeiro

Used Cyberware.name:
已使用的义体
Used Cyberware

Text.text:
货架上陈列着义肢、器官、眼球——各式各样的赛博机件——其上方的全息标牌写着 翻新 与 大幅折扣。许多货品表面布满划痕、磕碰与褪色的斑驳。另一些商品则是零件拼凑，彼此不甚匹配。有几件还以古怪的接口连着一缸缸组织培养液，从脑质碎块到心肌纤维都有。旁边的告示提醒你：这些肉不包含在硬件里，但在安装前必须依靠它维持运转。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The rack holds limbs, organs, eyes—all sorts of cyber mechanisms—under holos that read Refurbished and Big Discounts. Scratches, dings, and discolorations mar much of the ware. Other merchandise has mismatched parts. A few have odd connections to vats of tissue, from brain matter to heart muscle. A notice informs you that the meat doesn’t come with the hardware but is required to keep it functional prior to installation.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Cherubic Squire.name:
天使般的侍从
Cherubic Squire

Text.text:
一枚华丽的球形外壳——宛如抛光过的化石——悬浮在空中。机器上嵌着几枚与孩童眼睛一般大的目镜摄像头凝视着四方，却看不见任何武装。外壳的分片缝隙间渗出微弱的光，苍白而纯净，携着肉桂与薰衣草的气息弥漫在空气里。一阵遥远的宁静感掠过你的心头。
An ornate spherical shell—something like a polished fossil—hovers in the air. Ocular cameras as wide as a child’s eyes stare out from the machine, which has no visible weapons. Faint light, pale and pure, leaks out from segments of the shell, permeating the air with the smell of cinnamon and lavender. A sense of distant calm sweeps across you.

Church Nave Infested With Zombies.name:
满是僵尸的教堂中殿
Church Nave Infested With Zombies

Text.text:
食尸鬼般腐朽的剪影伫立摇晃，宛如一片枯死的林木。它们耷拉的头颅朝向从彩绘玻璃窗倾泻而入的月光。长椅在石地上刺耳地刮鸣——其中一个踉跄撞了上去。那只食尸鬼低声呻吟，愤懑地咕噜作响，双臂无力地拍打着木头。其余的乌合之众应和着它的嚎叫，声音一齐攀升，汇成一曲阴森而不谐的怪诞合唱。
Ghoulish, decaying silhouettes stand and sway like a forest of dead trees. Their lolling heads face the moonlight beaming in through the stained glass windows. A pew screeches against the stone floor as one of them blunders into it. The ghoul groans, gurgling in frustration, and smacks its arms listlessly against the wood. The rest of the mob echoes its howl, voices rising together in a macabre, discordant chorus.

Tenser's Floating Disk.name:
滕瑟浮空碟
Tenser's Floating Disk

Text.text:
你一遍又一遍吟诵着那有节奏的咒文，如同车轮不停旋转。你宛如陶匠捏弄湿润的陶土般，温柔塑形着魔法的原初质料，将其铺展开来，扩成一个圆。待你大功告成，便端详起成果：一枚完美的圆盘，其上隐约的同心纹脊将虹彩抛洒在银白的表面上。
You chant the rhythmic incantation over and over, like the spinning of a wagon wheel. Akin to a potter with wet clay, you gently shape the raw stuff of magic, spreading it wide into a circle. Your work complete, you admire the result: a perfect disk, with faint concentric ridges that throw iridescence across the silvery surface.

一间私密的小屋，里头只有一座朴素的木制马桶。空气里飘着清新的柠檬香，木质座圈被擦得锃亮，既没有刺鼻的污渍，也不见半点难堪的痕迹。有人——真该祝福他们——把这里收拾得一尘不染。
A private room with a simple, wooden toilet. The fresh scent of lemon hangs in the air and the wooden seat is both polished and free of unpleasant stains. Someone, bless them, keeps this place spic and span.

Undead Gunslinger At Sunset.name:
落日下的亡灵枪手
Undead Gunslinger At Sunset

Text.text:
猩红的光如泼洒的鲜血浸透大地，把尘土飞扬的峡谷染成一片血色的岩石与黄土。孤身枪手发出一声问询，灰色烟云翻卷缠绕，吞没了他那已然干枯、刻满风霜的面容；他以示敬意，向对手索要姓名。

~ 构想：Amerin（Discord）

Crimson light bathes the ground like spilled blood, turning the dusty canyon into a sanguine expanse of rock and dirt. A question rings out from the lone gunslinger, a cloud of swirling gray smoke engulfing their drawn, withered features as they ask for the name of their opponent in a show of respect.

~ Envisioned by Amerin on Discord

这间高拱的厅室里，雕刻天花板上绘着各式纹章异兽的面孔，俯视着下方。房间尽头，一座石砌台座上摆着两张高背软椅，椅身同样雕满了这些生物。
The painted faces of various heraldic beasts peer down from the carved ceiling of this high-vaulted chamber. At the room’s far end two plush and high-backed chairs stand atop a stone dais, both carved with more of the same creatures.

这个小小的女人——也许只有两英尺高——拄着一根手杖，身着做工精致、色调自然的衣物。一顶内衬毛皮的尖帽兜从头肩覆下，长长垂到腰际。尖尖的耳朵和乌黑的卷发从兜帽边缘探出。她明亮的紫罗兰色眼睛闪闪发光，咧嘴笑得灿烂，伸手去摸她随身携带的小袋子和小锤子。
This tiny woman—maybe two feet tall—leaning on a walking stick wears finely crafted clothing in natural colors. A fur-lined liripipe covers her head and shoulders, hanging to her waist. Pointed ears and black curls poke out of the hood. Her bright violet eyes sparkle as she gives a broad smile and reaches for the little pouch and hammer she carries.

Hacker Remains Oblivious During Life-thr.name:
黑客在致命危机中浑然不觉
Hacker Remains Oblivious During Life-threatening Event

Text.text:
对周遭的屠戮浑然不觉，黑客将全部心神精准无误地钉在手头的任务上，对逼近的危险一无所知。随着他们埋首操作，世界褪成低沉的雪花噪点，意识被这场精密而脆弱的行动彻底吞没。
Oblivious to the carnage around them, the hacker is unerringly focused on their task, ignorant of the danger. The world fades away to muted static as they work, their consciousness consumed by the delicate nature of their operation.

你眨了眨眼，视野在一阵诡异、摇曳的光里倏然黯下。瞳孔猛然放大、扭曲变形，化作烙印在眼中的奥秘符文。你又眨了一次，目光穿透现实的帷幕，窥见潜伏在近处的黑暗、游移的轮廓——那些隐形匿迹的存在。
You blink, and your vision darkens in a flash of strange, wavering light. Your pupils dilate, shift, becoming arcane runes within your eyes. You blink once more and see beyond the veil of reality to spy the dark and shifting shapes of those who lurk nearby, invisible.

Coven Plotting In A Glade.name:
林间空地的密谋
Coven Plotting In A Glade

Text.text:
“领主又染上了什么毛病，准是又去他那些老地方鬼混了；可我担心，用不了多久，他就会把自己的倒霉怪到我们头上。也许是时候给那小畜生安排一场‘病’，让这片土地换个新主子了。”
“The lord’s caught something again, no doubt frequenting his usual establishments, but I fear it won’t be long before he begins to blame us for his misfortunes. Perhaps it’s time we arrange our own ailment for that little wretch and give these lands some new leadership.”

这头巨兽那小巧的蛇形头颅上，仿佛竖着数十枚锋利尖牙；其修长的颈部蜿蜒伸展，连向鲸鱼般的庞大躯体。四片强劲的鳍肢推动它破水前行，而短小的尾巴如舵般扭转摆动，助它在水中转向。
What seems like dozens of sharp teeth bristle in the small serpentine head of this great beast, atop a long neck that snakes away from a whale-like body. Four powerful fins propel it through the water, guided in part by the twisting of a short tail acting as rudder.

Base Of Skull Hill.name:
颅骨丘陵基地
Base Of Skull Hill

Text.text:
死亡的能量像一袭窒息的裹尸布般笼罩着此地。太多人在这里死去，孤身一人，被遗忘，在冷漠的苍穹下嘶吼着最后的字句；他们的生命在亵渎的仪式中被夺走。无数年屠戮流下的鲜血将岩石染成深沉而浓郁的猩红，让凿刻在石中的骷髅呈现出真正魔性的狰狞——那不死的空洞眼眶，正注视着你向上攀登。

~ 由 Envisioned 创作，Leif 来自 Devs & Dice

诅咒之丘 第一部分：骷髅丘之底 第二部分：骷髅丘的坡面 第三部分：一对身披红甲的战士 第四部分：骷髅丘之巅 第五部分：跳动水晶下的巫妖 The energy of death smothers this place like a suffocating burial shroud. So many have died here, alone, forgotten, screaming their last words to an uncaring sky as their life was taken in blasphemous ritual. Blood from countless years of slaughter has stained the rocks a deep, rich crimson, giving the skulls carved into the stone a truly fiendish appearance—as their deathless eyes watch your ascent.

~ Envisioned by Leif from Devs & Dice

Cursed Hill Part I: Base of Skull Hill Part II: Slopes of Skull Hill Part III: Pair of Red, Armored Warriors Part IV: Summit of Skull Hill Part V: Lich Beneath a Pulsing Crystal

Brass Dragon Lair.name:
黄铜龙巢穴
Brass Dragon Lair

Text.text:
狂风掠过洞窟上方的荒漠，卷起的沙旋顺着天顶孔洞射入的一束束阳光飘舞而下。风向一变，它低吟的音色也随之转调，洞穴回响起如笛般的幽声。你在阴影间凝神搜寻，试图捕捉巨龙的踪迹，却见一群色彩斑斓的鸟儿仿佛凭空振翅而起，穿出洞顶而去；它们掠过时无声无息，恍若梦境。
Wind blows through the desert above this cave, causing swirls of sand to dance down shafts of sunlight coming through holes in the ceiling. As the wind shifts, the tone of its moan changes, and the cavern reverberates with a flute-like sound. As you peer through the shadows, seeking sight of a dragon, a flock of brilliantly colored birds flutters up from nowhere and out of the roof, their passage completely soundless and dreamlike.

音色比单簧管更高、比长笛更凌厉——这件乐器能催眠蛇群，也能从它的喇叭口里卷出梦境。演奏它的玩家必须低头沿着那细长的黑色管身望去，双唇紧抿，肺叶奋力鼓动，将那勾魂的旋律吹入大地。
Higher than a clarinet, more cutting than a flute, this is the instrument that hypnotizes snakes and curls dreams out of its bell. Its player must look down along the thin black body, lips pursed, lungs working hard as they play their alluring tune into the earth.

在你观想象征性魔法的矩阵，并用指尖搓揉那团滑腻的油脂后，一层油光在附近地面上迅速铺开，滑得足以让任何人脚下一空、当场失足。
After envisioning the matrix of representational magic and rubbing the slippery bit of oily fat between your fingertips, a greasy sheen coats the surface of the nearby floor, slick enough to make anyone lose their footing.

Cloister Of Flumphs.name:
福朗普隐修院
Cloister Of Flumphs

Text.text:
一阵古怪却又略带安抚的声音从那团蜷缩着、悬浮在空中的生物群里传出——像是轻柔、有节奏的咕咕低鸣。每一只水母般的生物都漂浮着，仿佛在水下轻轻起伏。身后拖曳的触须稳住它们的悬停身形，而它们则用一对对慵懒扭动的眼柄朝四面八方探看。
A strange, somewhat soothing sound emanates from the huddled mass of levitating creatures—a kind of soft, rhythmic cooing. Each jellyfish-like creature floats as if bobbing underwater. Trailing tendrils stabilize their hovering forms as they peer about in all directions with pairs of lazily writhing eyestalks.

I Cast Private Sanctum.name:
我施放了【私密圣域】
I Cast Private Sanctum

Text.text: 魔法的波涛在我周围的空气中闪烁，铜色与钴蓝交替流转。我摇曳着身形——双手揉捏着空气——一座结构开始成形。金属扭曲的尖鸣与砖石坠裂的轰响接连响起，随即一声空洞的clang回荡，圣所彻底凝固。刺喉的盐腥与灰烬气息渗入四周，浓雾沉沉落下，将其中的一切尽数遮蔽。 Waves of magic shimmer in the air about me in varying hues of copper and cobalt. I sway—molding the air with my hands—as a structure begins to form. The sounds of metal bending and bricks crashing can be heard, followed by a hollow clang as the sanctum solidifies. The choking scents of salt and ash infuse the air, and a dense fog descends, obscuring all that is within.

耀眼的祖母绿鳞片如同羽毛般外翻，覆盖着这条凶残巨蛇修长如蛇影般的躯体。它巨口大张，露出弯如匕首的毒牙，粗大的注毒管里不断喷溅出毒液。它的双眼收束成陌生的细缝，毫不眨动地凝视着，分叉的舌信在空气中嗅出恐惧的气味。它开始盘绕——不是为了防御，而是让全身蓄势待发，只要第一名温血威胁踏入它的触及范围，便会以雷霆般的迅疾猛然出击。
Flared emerald scales, almost featherlike, coat the long ophidian body of this vicious serpent. Its mouth gapes wide, exposing fangs like curved daggers that sputter poison from enormous injection tubes. Its eyes, narrowed to alien slits, stare unblinking as its forked tongue smells the air for fear. It begins to coil, not for defense, but to ready its body to strike with lightning alacrity at the first warm-blooded threat to enter its reach.

一条修长的藤蔓蜿蜒探出，显然具备某种知觉，面对光、热与声响都会抽搐作出反应动作（）。藤蔓的数个节结处绽放着白色喇叭状花朵。植株的源头无从得见；这条藤蔓已远远蔓延而去。藤蔓尖端聚起噼啪作响的蓝白电弧，嗡鸣声不断攀升，直至化作震耳欲聋的狂乱高潮。
A lengthy vine snakes forth with obvious sentience, twitching in reaction to light and heat and sound. White trumpet-like flowers bloom at various nodes. The source of the plant cannot be seen; the vine has ventured far. Crackling volts of blue-white electricity build at the plant’s very tip, a hum that reaches a cacophonous crescendo.

这位瘦削而年迈的女人专注地在一本厚重的皮革装订大书上奋笔疾书。羽毛笔急促的沙沙声只在蘸取墨水时稍作停顿，或偶尔被一台由木齿轮与木杆构成的算筹器哐啷作响所打断。她朝你这边瞥了一眼，短暂地竖起一根手指——显然，她要你等着。
This slight and elderly woman concentrates on scribbling in a large, leatherbound book. The rapid scratching of her quill pauses only to dip for ink, or the occasional clatter of a counting tabulator made of wooden cogs on rods. She glances your way and briefly holds up one finger. Apparently, she wants you to wait.

Deeply-offended Shopkeeper.name:
深受冒犯的店主
Deeply-offended Shopkeeper

Text.text:
你从未像这次一样，把任何人冒犯得如此惨烈——尤其是这位店主。你慌乱地想弥补过错，嘴里却只是不停地胡言乱语，词句像结块的稀粥一样噗噗往外溢；可无论你怎么挣扎，都无济于事。摊主的脸因怒火而涨得通红，瞳孔缩成针尖大小，随即以神祇般的威势咆哮着命令你立刻滚出店门。他爆出的脏话之下流，足以让最粗鄙的水手都羞得脸红。

~ 构想：GentlemanJimGM，发表于 Discord

You've never offended anyone so heinously as you have this shopkeeper. Words spill out of your jabbering mouth like lumpy porridge as you desperately try to fix your mistake—to no avail. The vendor's face flushes with rage and their pupils shrink to pinpricks as they bellow with the might of a god for you to get out of their shop. Their use of profanity would make the most uncouth sailor blush.

~ Envisioned by GentlemanJimGM on Discord

Loot From A Balor.name:
夺自巴洛炎魔的战利品
Loot From A Balor

Text.text:
巴洛魔静卧在一圈焦黑的地面中央，一动不动。你小心翼翼地翻动那具仍在冒着热气的尸体，发现恶魔的双角上套着三道金箍，其中一枚镶嵌着一颗硕大的红宝石。一根雕饰华丽的短杖挂在巴洛魔的腰带上，而其旁，一只由环甲编成的小袋里装着一副沉甸甸的骨骰和一小瓶紫色液体。
The balor lies at the center of a ring of scorched ground, motionless. Handling the steaming corpse with care, you discover three bands of gold around the demon’s horns, one of which is studded with a large ruby. An ornate rod hangs from the balor’s belt, and, next to it, a pouch made of ring mail contains a set of heavy bone dice and a vial of purple liquid.

Sundries From A Succubus Or Incubus.name:
魅魔或梦魔的杂货
Sundries From A Succubus Or Incubus

Text.text:
伴随着充满暴怒与狂怨的凄厉嚎叫，那恶魔在被拖回老巢时于一团烈焰中骤然消失。它只留下了一朵红玫瑰，被施了魔法，能取悦所有凝视它之人的感官。
Emitting a wail of rage and fury, the fiend vanishes in a burst of flame as it is dragged back to its home. It leaves behind a single red rose, enchanted to delight the senses of all who behold it.

一段轻盈婉转的旋律越过翻涌的浪尖飘来——像夏日微风般毫不费力。你四下寻觅声源，终于看见一名美得惊心的女子栖坐在礁岩突起处。落日为这幅壮丽景象更添光辉，你不禁疑惑：更摄人心魄的究竟是那海妖，还是她的歌声？
A lilting melody carries over the cresting waves—effortless as a summer breeze. You look around for the source and see a woman of stunning beauty perched upon a rocky outcrop. The setting sun adds to the magnificent image and you wonder which is more striking: the siren or her song?

Hill Dwarf Village.name:
丘陵矮人村庄
Hill Dwarf Village

Text.text:
这座小丘从周围的高地间拔起，紧贴着一面巍然耸立的山墙。石砌建筑点缀在坡上，像船壳上的藤壶般密密附着。那些小屋仿佛从地里鼓起的水疱，半埋于土，粗壮烟囱里烟雾盘旋而上。你越走越近，城镇的轮廓逐渐清晰——一团紧凑的屋舍，被岩石围成的壁垒环抱。矮人聚落的声与味触及你：铁砧的铿锵、粗豪的笑声、带着香气的灶火烟、砂砾与腐殖土的气息。镇门前的守卫披着锁子长衫，见你走近，神情冷峻而沉稳。

~ Envisioned by Cartonis

The hillock rises above the surrounding highlands, tucked against a soaring wall of mountains. Stone structures dot the rise like barnacles on the hull of a ship. These huts emerge from the earth like blisters, half-buried, with smoke swirling from stout chimneys. The town comes into focus as you draw nearer, a tight cluster of structures surrounded by a wall of rock. The sounds and smells of the dwarf settlement reach you: ringing anvils, raucous laughter, fragrant cookfire smoke, gravel, and loam. The guards at the town’s gate, shrouded in chain hauberks, regard you stoically as you approach.

~ Envisioned by Cartonis

Inspiration About A Demanding World.name:
关于一个苛求的世界的灵感
Inspiration About A Demanding World

Text.text:
“这看起来很难吗？那也没办法。世界不会停下来等你鼓起勇气，却仍然要你拿出勇气来。”
“Does this seem difficult? Well, too bad. The world does not wait for courage, but demands it nonetheless.”

Crown Of Stars.name:
星辰王冠
Crown Of Stars

Text.text:
七个词逐一出口，你手势上扬，每念一词，头顶便诞生一粒与之呼应的星辉尘火。每一轮微小的太阳现身，你身上散发的温暖白光便愈发明亮。咒文终了，那些小星辰开始环绕你的头顶盘旋成冠。只消一瞥、一念与一挥手，你便可将其中一颗专属星辰掷出，轰击敌手。
Each of seven words, said with an upward gesture, births a matching mote of starlight above you. As each tiny sun appears, the warm, white luminance you shed brightens. The incantation done, the little stars move to orbit the crown of your head. With but a glance, a thought, and a gesture, you launch one of your personal stars to smite a foe.

Ten Mugs Of Ale—a Drinking Song.name:
十号麦酒大杯——饮酒歌
Ten Mugs Of Ale—a Drinking Song

Text.text:
伙计们，噢，我们最爱听故事！
伙计们，噢，我们最爱倒麦酒！
伙计们，噢，我们最爱寻个姑娘！
快给那姑娘斟上一杯葡萄酒。

麦酒一杯杯下肚，喝得太急，
再喝两杯，敬那些已逝的朋友，
三杯下去，噢，我们为安康而饮，
四杯下去，噢，我们为财富而饮。
五杯下去，噢，我们为城镇而饮，
六杯下去，敬我们自个儿的名声，
七杯下去，我们便要证明力量，
八杯进肚，胃里开始发酸！
九杯进肚，就要去惹是生非，
十号杯下肚，眼前就要重影翻飞。
老板！把我们掷骰似的滚出门去
先前那姑娘呢，我们不是见过？

姑娘，你不想听听我的故事？
姑娘，你不想给我倒杯麦酒？
姑娘，这一切都是神祇的安排：
姑娘们，噢！一个也寻不着！

Lads, O we love to hear a tale!
Lads, O we love to pour an ale!
Lads, O we love a lass to find!
Get that lass a mug of wine.

Mugs of ale that we drink too fast,
Drink two mugs for our friends who’ve passed,
Drink three mugs, O we drink to health,
Drink four mugs, O we drink to wealth.
Drink five mugs, O we drink to town,
Drink six mugs to our own renown,
Seven mugs, and we prove our power,
Eight mugs in, and our stomachs sour!
Nine mugs in, we’ll be seeking trouble,
Ten mugs in, we’ll be seeing double.
Barkeep! Roll us out the door
Where’s that lass that we saw before?

Lass, don’ yeh want to hear my tale?
Lass, don’ yeh want to pour my ale?
Lass, it was all in the gods’ design:
Lasses, O! There are none to find!

Iron Bands Of Binding.name:
束缚铁环
Iron Bands Of Binding

Text.text: [球形] 若非你见多识广、阅历深厚，你几乎会把这枚锈迹斑斑的铁球当成毫无价值的小玩意儿，甚至像是孩子的玩具。然而当你亲手把玩过它，你便察觉到，有一缕缕力量的丝线正攀附在这朴素的外形之上。 [变形] 你将这枚一磅重的铁球掷出，同时说话念出命令词，铁质束带便会解散抽离、向你的目标延展而去。几乎快得不可思议，那些束带转瞬便缠绕合拢，把你的受害者封进一座由金属与魔法构成的牢狱。 [Ball form] Were it not for your experience and knowledge, you might mistake the rusty iron ball as a worthless trinket, perhaps a child’s toy. Yet after handling the ball, you are aware of the threads of power clinging to its simple form. [Transformation] Hurling the one-pound ball while speaking the command word causes bands of iron to unravel and extend toward your target. With unbelievable alacrity, the bands move to encase your victim in a prison of metal and magic.

Abandoned Mine Shaft.name:
废弃矿井竖井
Abandoned Mine Shaft

Text.text:
矿井口四周散落着被遗弃的木箱、矿车与工具。井口上方立着一台绞盘，滑轮与绳索向大地深处延伸数千英尺，没入下方的黑暗之中。当你蹑手蹑脚靠近井缘，一块松动的石子坠入黑暗，转瞬无影——你听不见它落地的回响。
Crates, carts, and tools lie abandoned around the mine shaft. A winch stands over it, pulleys and ropes extending thousands of feet into the earth, disappearing into the blackness below. As you creep closer to the shaft's edge, a dislodged stone drops into the darkness and disappears—you do not hear it land.

Low-light Binoculars.name:
微光双筒望远镜
Low-light Binoculars

Text.text:
加大的镜片泛着一种古怪的绿色色调，仿佛二进制数据屏幕。看似不起眼的双筒望远镜外壳之下，藏着一整套精密硬件，让使用者在微光环境中也能看得一清二楚。粗重的背带将它稳稳固定在颈间。
The oversized lenses have a peculiar green tint to them, like a binary data screen. The unassuming housing of these binoculars conceals a wealth of sophisticated hardware which enables the user to see perfectly in low-light conditions. A heavy strap keeps them secure around the neck.

Sangromancer's Squadron.name:
血咒唤尸师中队
Sangromancer's Squadron

Text.text:
一名吸血鬼（特征）法师向前踏出，披袍加身，威严非凡，自信满满。血咒师将目光投向战场上流淌的鲜血，嘴角骤然扯出一抹凌厉的笑，随即将四名饥渴的吸血鬼（特征）仆从驱入战阵。

~ Envisioned by ArielleVB

A vampire mage steps forward, robed, majestic, and confident. The sangromancer looks to the blood of the battlefield and breaks into a sharp grin before sending four eager vampire spawn into the fray.

~ Envisioned by ArielleVB

这骆驼的脾气几乎和它的臭味一样令人不快；你一走近，它便停下咀嚼，抬眼打量你。尽管态度欠佳，这样的坐骑在穿越险恶地形时却无比珍贵，速度与耐力都胜过大多数马匹。
The camel’s demeanor is nearly as unpleasant as its smell, and it pauses from its chewing to eye you upon your approach. Despite its questionable attitude, such mounts are invaluable for trekking across forbidding terrains, with a speed and stamina exceeding that of most horses.

Animated Jack-o’-lantern.name:
会动的南瓜灯
Animated Jack-o’-lantern

Text.text:
南瓜那圆滚滚的橙色身躯里，藤蔓般的肢体盘卷而出；雕刻出的面孔僵在一抹痉挛般的狞笑上。它咯咯怪笑，满怀恶作剧的快意——这只具备意识的葫芦猛地从桌上跃下，以惊人的速度冲出门外。它迈着轻快却歪斜的步伐，窜入夜色之中，借着体内那支蜡烛的微光为自己照路。

~ David on Discord

Vinelike limbs curl out from the plump orange body of the pumpkin, its carved face frozen in a rictus grin. Cackling with mischievous glee, the sentient gourd leaps from the table and careens out of the door with alarming speed. With a jaunty, lopsided gait, it scampers into the night, using the light of the candle within to light its way.

~ David on Discord

驱散魔法让一切看上去像是凭空消失，仿佛你的法术撕裂了他人编织出的魔法构造。然而，每一次施放这道法术，都会提醒你真正发生了什么。最后的手势像是把某样东西翻转过来，你能在掌心感到它的重量，宛如倒转一只沙漏。借由这道防护系法术，你告诉那道法术它的时代已尽，于是，它便自行松散，层层解开。
Dispelling magic makes it seem like it disappears, as if your spell rips apart the construct of magic created by another. Yet every casting this spell reminds you of what really happens. The last gesture is of flipping something over, and you feel the weight of it in your hand, like turning an hourglass. Through this abjuration you tell the spell its time is up, and thus, it unravels itself.

I Cast Fire Storm (Elemental).name:
我施放【火焰风暴（元素）】
I Cast Fire Storm (Elemental)

Text.text:
我将元素的狂怒牵引到身侧，开始施展法术，在翻涌的空气中编织古老的奥秘手势。咒文那繁复的词句与渐起的雷鸣震颤交织，魔力层层堆积。我的双手随之泛起炽光，灼烧着狂野而毁灭的力量；我指向敌人，倾泻出炽烈的怒焰。
Drawing the rage of the Elements to my side, I begin the spell, weaving ancient arcane gestures in the tumultuous air. The complex words of my incantation mingle with the rising tremor of thunder as the magical energy builds. My hands begin to glow, burning with wild destructive power as I point toward my foe and unleash my fiery wrath.

箭头的箭镞看起来像一座微型鸟屋，或像精灵孩童的哨子。松木雕成，削斜的顶端嵌着一个小孔；它会像一只怪鸟般鸣叫，仿佛只会说一件事——一声又高又尖的音符。这道声音既可充作野外行军部队的警报，也能把猎物从藏身处惊得四散奔逃。
The arrowhead looks like a tiny birdhouse, or an elf-child’s whistle. Pine carved with a hole set into a beveled top, it calls like a strange bird with only one thing to say—a note high and sharp. The voice can serve as an alarm to troops in the field, or can frighten game from their havens.

I Unfold My Folding Boat: Canoe.name:
我展开我的折叠船：独木舟
I Unfold My Folding Boat: Canoe

Text.text: 伴随着树枝弯折般的声响，木箱的板条向外撑开，仿佛船舱里的乘客正挪动身子寻找舒适。随后，一声刺耳的啪响，箱体两侧坠落，一卷看似厚重帆布的东西开始舒展。它彻底展开后鼓胀起来，向上隆起，化作一艘修长的独木舟。我将手沿着船身抚过，描摹其上绘着的波浪纹样。波涛在我的接触下微微游移，缓慢地起伏升降。 With a sound like a branch bending, the panels of the wooden box stretch, like passengers in a hold trying to get comfortable. Then, with a piercing snap, the sides of the box fall and a roll of what looks like thick canvas begins to unfurl. It unfolds completely then swells, rising into the form of a long canoe. I pass my hand along the side of it, tracing the wave-like pattern painted there. The waves shift under my touch, slowly rising and falling.

一声炸雷是唯一的预警，随即暴雨如瀑，穿透林冠倾盆砸落。雨声化作不绝的嘶嘶低鸣。雨滴抽打蕨叶，猛击潮湿的泥土，敲出急促密集的鼓点。透过晃眼的白色雨幕，还能看见其他植物以特化的叶片与花朵汇拢雨水，趁着这残酷——却又令人欣慰——的恩赐大快朵颐。
A crack of thunder is the only warning before a torrent of rain pelts down through the canopy. The noise of rainfall is a constant hiss. Raindrops buffet fern fronds and batter the damp earth in a rapid tattoo. Through the blinding white sheet of rain, other plants can be seen funneling rainwater with specially adapted leaves and flowers, taking advantage of the brutal—but welcome—bounty.

I Cast Enhance Ability.name:
我施放「强化能力」
I Cast Enhance Ability

Text.text:
我在脑海中描摹自己想要强化的能力所对应的动物形态，将全部意念毫无保留地凝聚其上。我深深而克制地吸入一口气，伸出的手掌周围魔法不断汇聚，我一边诵念咒文一边专注引导。能量凝成生机，在指缝间盘旋流转，逐渐披上我所引导之兽的性相。
I picture the animal shape of the ability I wish to enhance and focus my intent completely upon it. I draw in a deep, measured breath, focusing on the magic building around my outstretched hand as I recite the incantation. Energy coalesces into life, swirling between my fingers and taking on the aspect of the beast I have channeled.

Dueling Evangeline Maples.name:
决斗者伊万杰琳·梅普尔斯
Dueling Evangeline Maples

Text.text:
伊万杰琳咬紧牙关。紧张的汗珠黏住她额前与太阳穴的卷发；她一边抹开汗水，一边从掩蔽后举起魔杖。她手腕一抖，快如蝎尾毒刺，一束炽燃的橙色能量光束轰然朝你激射而来。
Evangeline grits her teeth. Beads of nervous sweat stick her curls to her forehead and temples; she swipes them away as she raises her wand from behind cover. With a flick of her hand, quick as a scorpion’s stinger, a beam of burning orange energy blasts toward you.

Corporate Aircar Flies Low Overhead.name:
企业空车低空掠过头顶
Corporate Aircar Flies Low Overhead

Text.text:
线条流畅的黑色轿车从头顶掠过，近得几乎能伸手接触到，横冲直撞，丝毫不在乎挡路的是谁。深色车窗将车内遮得严严实实，但你太熟悉这种调调了：某个爱炫的企业高管，带着保镖，正火急火燎地赶去他们自以为至关重要的地方——比如午餐。
The sleek black car is almost close enough to touch as it flies overhead, caring little for anyone in the way. Tinted windows obscure the interior, but you know the type. Some flashy corpo executive and their bodyguards are rushing somewhere they deem vitally important—like lunch.

I Cast Fireball From My Staff Of Fire.name:
我从火焰法杖中施放火球术
I Cast Fireball From My Staff Of Fire

Text.text:
我将法杖指向我的目标，吐出那句命令词，只觉杖身在掌中骤然发烫。一点温暖的橙色光芒凝聚成形，像萤火虫般轻轻浮动——旋即如离弦之箭般冲向我的敌人，尖啸如烟火破空，挟带着炽燃的火焰负载。
Pointing my staff toward my target, I speak the command word and feel the staff grow hot in my hands. A mote of warm orange light forms, bobbing gently like a firefly—before racing toward my foes, shrieking like a firework, carrying its incendiary payload.

Towering Cliff Bottom.name:
高耸峭壁之底
Towering Cliff Bottom

Text.text:
从崖底仰望上去，视角令人头晕目眩，仿佛那巨大的峭壁正擦着天穹而立。自此可见层层岩面，像被一柄巨型鹤嘴锄凿削而成；一片片石层在漫长岁月里缓缓堆叠，叠出沉甸甸的年轮。
Looking up from the bottom of the cliff, the perspective is dizzying, as if the massive bluff were brushing up against the sky itself. From here you can see layers of rock seemingly carved out with a gigantic mattock, every sheet of stone gradually piled on over the ages.

House Raven Commons (The Repertory).name:
渡鸦公馆共享区（剧目库）
House Raven Commons (The Repertory)

Text.text:
陈列室的外墙几乎全由一扇扇法式落地门构成，顺着楼上弧形的轮廓排开，推门便通向一片开阔的长廊式露台，立柱与栏杆密密延伸。其余三面墙几乎尽是书架，塞满书籍、乐谱长卷，以及夹着羊皮纸碎片的活页夹——碎片上满是数学公式的密集笔划。门楣上悬着黑灰相间的彩旗缎带，宅邸配色的毛衣与围巾则挂在雪花石膏的衣帽树和墙钩上。地面铺着白色大理石，华贵的阅读扶手椅与沙发之间，簇着一圈黑骨制的乐谱架。
The Repertory outer wall is mostly sets of French doors, following the curve of the upper-floor and opening to a sweeping deck of many posts and rails. The other three walls are almost entirely shelves, stuffed with books, musical scrolls, and binders of parchment scraps covered in mathematical formulae. Bunting of black and gray stripes decorates the tops of the doors, and sweaters and scarves of the house colors hang on alabaster hall trees and wall pegs. The floor is white marble, and among the posh reading chairs and sofas is a cluster of black bone music stands.

I Check My Cyberpsychosis Implant.name:
我检定我的赛博精神病植入体
I Check My Cyberpsychosis Implant

Text.text:
我把手腕抬到眼前，那里绑着一只像手表一样的监测器。低调的表带下，几根导线蜿蜒钻入我的血液。笨重的方形屏幕角落里，一枚鲜红的感叹号警示标记闪烁，坐实了我躁动不安的恐惧。我点了点警告，屏幕瞬间被一大段红字挤得满满当当。

WARNING: Our monitor has reviewed your levels and determined you are HIGH RISK today. DO NOT employ cybernetics until further notice.

接下来是一串例行的安抚建议清单：冥想。阅读。去自然里散步……我望向被烟霾浸透的城市天际线，胸口的焦虑像虫群乱爬，却还是忍不住咳出一声干笑。

I bring my wrist to my face, where I have the watch-like monitor strapped. Wires underneath the unassuming band snake into my bloodstream. A warning sign of a red exclamation point flashes in the corner of the clunky square display, confirming my agitated fears. I tap on the warning and a block of red text crowds the screen.

WARNING: Our monitor has reviewed your levels and determined you are HIGH RISK today. DO NOT employ cybernetics until further notice.

What follows is a list of the routine suggestions for calming activities: Meditation. Reading. Walking in nature… I look out into the smog-soaked cityscape and cough out a laugh despite the anxiety riddling my chest.

一层火焰薄纱瞬间遮住这具构装体的身影，他们高高举起钉锤。烈焰在其头顶咆哮翻卷，随后在身后凝聚成一柄锻造锤的形状。那缥缈的光辉为其钢与青铜的躯体镀上一圈炽热的光环。锁子甲自双肩垂落，宛如祭司披肩；链环贴合在身上，光滑得如同龙鳞。他的形态显然仿照一名魁梧的人形士兵打造。面容看似冷峻——一整块没有五官起伏的钢铁平面——可很快你便注意到，眼周柔和流淌的青铜线条，以及脸颊上两枚圆形金属板，竟让这构装体显出一种温和而好奇的神情。

~ Played by Alister with

A veil of flame obscures the construct for a moment as they raise their mace high. Fire roars over their head, coalescing behind them into the shape of a smithing hammer. The ethereal light casts their steel and bronze body in a fiery halo. Chainmail drapes from both shoulders like the stole of a priest, the chain melding against their body as sleek as dragon scales. Their form is clearly modeled after a burly humanoid soldier. Their face also seems a stoic, steel slab of bare features, although you soon notice the soft flow of the bronze lines around their eyes and the two round plates on their cheeks that manage to give this construct a kind, inquisitive expression.

~ Played by Alister with

你一踏进门，头顶的铃铛便叮当作响，但店主仍专注于在一叠亮黄色布料上裁出笔直的线，连眼皮都未抬。几具木制人台上展示着各式衣装，有的仍密密插着别针，正处在赶工缝制的途中。
A bell rings above your head as you enter, but the shopkeeper does not look up from concentrating on cutting a straight line through a ream of bright yellow cloth. Several wooden forms display outfits, some still bristling with pins and in the midst of construction.

Looted Stone Coffin.name:
被洗劫的石棺
Looted Stone Coffin

Text.text:
棺盖未曾封死，歪斜地搁在石棺其余部分之上。稍远处地面上散落着一具遗骸——也许正是葬在此处之人——像是被人漫不经心地随手抛开。探头向棺内望去，除了一层尘土与泥垢外，再无他物。
The lid of the coffin sits unsealed and askew atop the rest of the stone casket. The remains that lie splayed out on the ground a little ways away—possibly whoever was buried here—have been cast aside with hardly a thought. Peering into the coffin reveals nothing aside from dust and dirt.

一段陡峭而险恶的攀登把你带到了这岌岌可危的境地。你立在一条狭窄的山脊之巅，下方是两道深谷。山脊向两侧蜿蜒起伏延伸，但目之所及，它的两侧要么是险象环生的攀爬，要么是致命的坠落。
A steep and dangerous climb has led to this precarious position. You stand atop a narrow ridge high above two valleys. The ridge rambles up and down in both directions, but for as far as you can see, its sides offer only treacherous climbs or deadly falls.

Subterranean Stairs Leading Up.name:
通往上方的地下阶梯
Subterranean Stairs Leading Up

Text.text:
从上方一处裂口渗下的微弱光线，与这片地底国度无尽的昏暗相比，几乎刺眼得如同烈日。它照出了一级巨大的石阶，覆着霉斑与阴湿黏滑的水汽，湿滑如涎，向上延伸——通往地表的世界。攀爬既令人望而生畏，又危机四伏。
The minute amount of light leaking down from an opening is almost as stark as bright sunlight when compared to the endless gloom of this underground realm. It reveals an enormous stone staircase, slippery and slimy with mold and dank moisture, that leads upward—into the world above. A daunting climb, and dangerous.

Quip About Resting Longer.name:
关于更久休息的打趣话
Quip About Resting Longer

Text.text:
“哦，拜托，我们能不能再多休息一会儿？就连这条破破烂烂的铺盖卷，比起今天要走进的那份恐怖计划，都像是枕在天使的怀里休息。”
“Oh please, can we just rest a little longer? Even this ratty bedroll feels like resting on an angel’s bosom when compared to walking into whatever horror we had planned for today.”

离小屋的墙角只几英尺远，立着一截矮墩墩的劈柴墩：一段圆橡木，树皮仍未剥落。一把木柄黑铁斧深深楔在木墩里。斧刃上沾着某种暗色污渍，柄上与木墩上也溅着相似的斑点。风吹日晒的柴薪在屋旁堆成一座粗糙的柴垛；再往里，一摞晒透的木柴整齐码在屋檐下。
Just a few feet from the cabin’s corner, there stands a squat chopping block of round oak with the bark still on. Driven into the block is an axe of wood and black iron. Something dark stains the axe head. Similar spatters mark the handle and the wooden block. Weathered firewood forms a rough heap near the house. Beyond it, a pile of seasoned wood is stacked neatly under the eaves.

双肩后展、下颌前探，这名沉思的身影对周遭的一切无一遗漏。他们脸上带着一种近乎凶狂的神色，像被追捕的逃犯。他们在审视一张张面孔——每一张面孔——又以近乎鲁莽的狂热在袖珍电脑上敲下笔记。他们红白相间的旋动衣袍垂至沾泥的鞋面。
Shoulders back and chin forward, the contemplative figure ignores absolutely nothing. A wild look is in their face, like a hunted criminal. They are studying faces—every single face—typing notes with reckless fervor into a pocket computer. Their swirling red-white raiment ends at dirty shoes.

Caravan Of True Course.name:
真途商队
Caravan Of True Course

Text.text:
一群旅人正在此扎营；他们那辆巨大的篷布大车此刻已从两头魁梧的麝牛身上解下套具。麝牛面颊两侧的长毛被编成细辫，缀着棕、黑、红三色珠子。车篷素白的帆布上，描着一道血红的符文。约十来人的队伍显然来自别处——他们的衣着与口音都与城里大多数人不同。众人穿着便于跋涉的行装与轻捷的护甲，染成泥土般的朴实色调。大约有三名成人身形敦实，携着各式武器：长剑、弩、投斧与长矛。另有两人背负圆筒形背包，里面塞着又长又毛边的卷轴，像是地图。大人们神情冷峻，与之形成鲜明对比的，是一群兴高采烈的孩子在营地间奔跑，玩着追逐游戏。
A group of travelers has set up camp here, their large covered wagon currently unhitched from two bulky muskoxen with brown, black, and red beads braided into their long fur around their faces. The plain canvas of the wagon’s bonnet is painted with a blood-red rune. The group of about ten people seem to come from a different region, for their dress and accents differ from most of the city. Their clothes are practical traveling garb and lithe armor, dyed with earthy colors. About three of the adults are of sturdy build, outfitted with a variety of weapons: swords, crossbows, throwing axes, and spears. Two others carry a cylinder pack on their backs that hold long, fraying scrolls that might be maps. The grim-faced adults are contrasted by the exuberant group of children that run about the camp, playing a game of tag.

Tattered Spellbook.name:
破烂的法术书
Tattered Spellbook

Text.text:
这本掩蔽的亚麻封皮透着一股古朴的村落气息。书角柔软得像黄油，书沿缀着细细的游丝般线头。内页由不同的布料或皮革制成，并按魔法学派分组：占卜用棉布，死灵用羊皮纸，此外还有更多。文字大多以清晰可辨的奥术书写，每道法术都被工整题写、以纤细的笔触详加说明——但这些页面并不牢靠。许多已经脱落，有些被撕去一角，或在久远岁月里被无数拇指磨得边角残缺。
There is a quaint, village feel to the linen of the cover. The corners are soft as butter, and the edges are lined with dangling fine threads. The pages are of different cloths or hides, grouped by magical school. Cotton for divination, vellum for necromancy, and more beyond. The script is mostly in legible arcane, with each spell neatly titled and explained in a fine hand, but the pages are loose. Many are detached, and some have pieces torn off or their corners worn away by thumbs ages past.

Barbed Devil Encounter.name:
倒钩魔遭遇
Barbed Devil Encounter

Text.text:
凶残的尖刺与倒钩遍布这邪恶生物斑驳的绿色皮肉，宛如一只地狱豪猪。那对充满贪欲的猩红眼睛以掠食般的饥渴死盯着你，魔鬼那条筋肉虬结的尾巴兴奋地来回抽动。分叉的舌头像蛇一般掠过一排排泛黄的獠牙，它向你露出一抹滴着恶意的笑容。
Vicious spines and barbed hooks cover the mottled green flesh of the wicked creature, like an infernal porcupine. Leering red eyes saturated with greed peer at you with rapacious hunger, as the devil’s sinewy tail flicks back and forth excitedly. A forked tongue snakes across rows of yellow fangs as it offers you a smile dripping with malice.

灼热干燥的风像刀子般撕扯着你的脸，你拖着沉重的步伐穿过龟裂而荒芜的废土。自从那场爆炸之后，这里再也长不出任何东西；在炙烤的烈日下，唯一的喘息之处，只有零星点缀四周的残破废墟。高速公路那半融化的沥青横亘沙海，宛如一具巨蛇的尸骸，正缓缓被辐射的沙砾吞没，逐渐没入无尽黄沙之中。
Hot, arid wind tears at your face as you trudge across the cracked, desolate wasteland. Nothing grows here now, not since the blast, and the only respite from the baking sun is the gutted ruins dotted around the place. The partially melted asphalt of a highway cuts across the desert like the corpse of a titanic serpent, slowly disappearing beneath the irradiated sands.

你扬起脸庞与双臂向天召唤，天空以谄媚的低语俯首应允。气流在你周身盘旋，托举你离地而起。此刻，深吸一口气便能令身前空气凝滞；吐出一息便可唤来狂风；抬手便能调度上升气流；而一拳砸下，则可命令空气向下方大地低头俯伏。
You raise your face and arms to the sky in summons, and it acquiesces with an obsequious whisper. Air swirls around you, lifting you off the ground. In this moment, holding a deep breath would still the air before you, exhaling a single breath would summon a gale, lifting a hand would marshal an updraft, and slamming a fist would demand the air bow to the ground below.

Wolf In The Snow.name:
雪中之狼
Wolf In The Snow

Text.text:
不久前，你曾在冰封的寒风里听见那声长嚎。此刻，在一条覆满白雪的山脊线上，深绿的松树零星点缀，细碎的粉雪随风盘旋；一头母狼低垂着头伫立，金色的眼睛越过深谷凝望。她灰、白、黑交杂的厚毛在风中竖起。刚才的声音是她发出的么？她是孤身一狼么？母狼身后那片森林里，一道合唱般的回应随之响起。
You heard the howl on the frozen wind not long ago. Now, on a white ridgeline scattered with deep green pines and whirls of powder, a wolf stands with her head lowered, golden eyes staring over the ravine. Her thick fur of gray, white, and black bristles in the wind. Was that her voice earlier? Is she alone? From the forest behind the wolf, a chorus answers.

他的呼吸在巴布特头盔前凝成一团，像闹鬼清晨的薄雾；他的眼睛在雾中闪亮，仿佛月光穿过云层。巨剑的刃锋寒光一闪，凶险如刽子手的斧刃，被他单手稳稳搭在肩头。他抬起覆甲的手套，冷冽得近乎残忍，空着的那只手指向他的敌手。纤薄如纱的苍白魔法丝线在目标周围交织缠绕。寂静骤然碎裂，他铠甲铿锵、猛然一冲。双手握住剑柄，他抡起那柄巨大的武器，狠狠劈向猎物。他一击命中，幽影般的丝线在目标四周颤鸣，随即膨胀成耀目的光晕。守望者发出一声非人的尖啸——苍穹随之回应。一束光柱直贯而下，轰然命中目标，光晕爆裂，音爆震荡，回响穿透空气与大地。

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

His breath hangs before his barbute helm like the fog of a haunted morning, his eyes shining through the mist like moonlight through clouds. The blade of a greatsword—glinting and wicked as an executioner's axe—is balanced on his shoulder with one hand holding it steady. He raises his gauntlet with deadly calm, pointing his free hand toward his foe. Diaphanous threads of pale magic weave about his target. The quiet shatters as he surges forward in a clanking lurch. Hilt in both hands, he heaves the massive weapon to bring it down upon his quarry. He strikes true, the spectral threads warbling about the target before expanding into a luminous aura. The warden cries out an unearthly yell—and the heavens answer. A ray of light beams down upon the target and the aura explodes, sending a sonic boom resounding through air and earth.

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

Fake Royal Sigil.name:
伪造的王室印玺
Fake Royal Sigil

Text.text:
乍一看，这枚纹章符记刻画精准，处处都透着真品的气息。然而，目光敏锐者会察觉它与真正的王室纹章有一处不符：其中一枚徽记侧面示人，却朝向了错误的方向。
At first glance, the sigil appears to be accurately scribed and possesses all the marks of authenticity. However, a keen eye detects an inconsistency with the true royal sigil: one of the charges, depicted from the side, faces the wrong direction.

Mountain With Lone Figure.name:
孤影立山巅
Mountain With Lone Figure

Text.text:
群峰巍峨之间，一道孤影阔步前行，在大自然的宏伟面前不过一粒微尘。他踏过嶙峋险径，宛如山羊凌空踏壁，藐视死神的召唤。生命与山川融为一体，他以不羁之魂穿越高处，与荒野同在。
Among towering peaks, a lone figure strides, a mere mote against nature’s grandeur. They navigate the rugged path, like a mountain goat defying death’s call. A merging of life and landscape, they traverse the heights as an untamed spirit, one with the wilderness.

当你念完咒文，一股热浪自体内升起。你感到火焰在胸腔中不断堆积，随即一声怒喝，将其尽数释放。掌中的磷质燃至赤红灼亮，旋即在一记闪光中消失无踪；同一瞬间，一道冲天而起的猩红火墙轰然喷涌而出。
A heat rises within you as you complete the incantation. You feel the fire building, and with a shout, release it. The phosphorous in your hands burns red-hot, then vanishes in a flash, and in the same instant, a soaring wall of crimson flame erupts forth.

Ship Frozen In Ice.name:
冰封之船
Ship Frozen In Ice

Text.text:
光芒透过厚重的半透明冰层照亮眼前，你几乎不敢相信自己的眼睛：一项被遗忘的奇迹——一艘被冰封住的船。谁知道这艘船被困在这片刺骨的牢笼里已有多久？
You can scarcely believe your eyes as the light reveals, through thick translucent layers, a forgotten marvel—a ship frozen in the ice. Who knows how long this vessel has been stuck in its frigid confines?

一头庞然巨兽从黑暗的深坑中攀爬而出。她的五颗头颅高高俯视着你，每一颗都呈现出她那恶毒子嗣的颜色，每一颗都喷吐着元素的狂怒。巨龙般的恶意自她泰坦般的身躯中爆裂，空气因她骇人的憎恨而翻涌沸腾。提亚马特——彩色龙之后——怒吼，獠牙密布的巨口中迸发出刺耳尖啸的混乱合鸣。
A gargantuan beast clambers from the pit of darkness. Her five heads loom above you, each one the color of her malevolent offspring, each one belching elemental fury. Draconic malice erupts from her titanic form, the air seething with her horrific hatred. Tiamat, the chromatic queen of dragons, roars—a cacophony of screams bursting from her fang-filled mouths.

她身形挺拔——一个苍白而纤弱的女人，昂着下巴，乌黑的长杖被她伸臂紧握，像在刻意与人保持距离。她的黑发齐颈而短，蓬乱得与那身灰扑扑的衣着无异；外披的斗篷也破旧寒酸。她那双深色眼睛从鼻梁上方冷冷俯视，鼻梁到额头之间被涂上一道灰白的线；她抿着嘴唇，挂着一丝轻微却带着讥诮的阴沉皱眉，静静打量四周。一个骷髅面具用磨旧的皮绳挂在她颈间，随呼吸轻轻摇晃。

~ Played by Walt M. with

She stands tall, this pale and waifish woman, with her chin held high and her ebony staff clutched at arm’s length. Cropped to neck length, her sable hair is as tousled as her drab clothing and mantle are shabby. Her dark eyes gaze down her nose, which bears an ashen line painted from its bridge to her forehead, and she observes her surroundings with her lips pressed into a slight but sneering frown. A death’s-head mask dangles from a wan leather cord around her neck.

~ Played by Walt M. with

River Green In Winter.name:
冬日的河流绿影
River Green In Winter

Text.text:
一名护士牵着一只三条腿的狗穿过公园。“你能行的，霍桑！”护士一边鼓励，一边看着它踏着积雪往雪坡上爬。它终于翻上坡顶，舌头耷拉着，尾巴摇得欢，三条腿稳稳撑住身体，平衡得近乎完美。

透过自然中心的窗户，能看见一只雕鸮躺在手术台上，一侧翅膀几乎被拔得光秃。兽医神色紧绷地检查着。就在这时，猫头鹰伸出利爪，轻轻覆在兽医的手背上。
A nurse walks a three-legged dog through the park. “You can do it, Hawthorn!” The nurse encourages him as he tramps up a snow hill. He crests the top, tongue lolling and tail wagging, balancing on his three legs perfectly. Through the window the nature center, a great horned owl can be seen on an operating table, one of its wings nearly bare of feathers. A veterinarian inspects it with a tense look on her face. As she does, the owl reaches out with a talon and gently rests it on the vet’s hand.

We Are Not Alone.name:
我们并不孤单
We Are Not Alone

Text.text:
你身后有什么东西动了一下。你冒险回头一瞥，却什么也没看见，只有巷子里堆叠的木箱与桶子杂乱地堵着去路。石板路上传来一声刮擦，你再次转身；在你视野边缘，一团轮廓从愈发浓稠的阴影里挣脱出来，粗重地喘息着。你并不孤单。
Something shifts behind you. You hazard a glance and find nothing, save the stacked crates and barrels cluttering the alley. The sound of a scrape across the cobblestones turns you again, and from your periphery a shape dislodges itself from the deepening shadows, breathing heavily. You are not alone.

Pantry Of A Manor.name:
庄园储藏间
Pantry Of A Manor

Text.text:
通往厨房的木门吱呀一声荡开，露出一间储藏室：存货充盈，架架堆到满溢，既有烹饪的常备食材，也有精心腌制的蜜饯与罐藏。四壁之间，足以为你们这般体型的队伍备下百场盛宴的家当。
The wooden door from the kitchen swings open to reveal a well-stocked larder, every shelf filled to the brim with the staples for food preparation as well as carefully prepared preserves. These walls hold the makings of a hundred feasts for a party of your size.

I Take Time To Enjoy My Hobby.name:
我会抽出时代来享受我的爱好
I Take Time To Enjoy My Hobby

Text.text:
训练很重要……维护装备也同样重要……阅读、钻研、筹划也一样；而这些我都会去做。但在那之前，我要先停下来，享受一项最爱的消遣。既然我喜欢做，那它就一定值得去做：让精神焕然一新，让双手与思绪都舒展开来，为接下来的一切做好准备。
Training is important… and so is maintaining equipment… but so is reading, studying, planning; and I’ll do all of those things. But first, I will pause and enjoy a favorite pastime. If I like doing it, then it must be worth doing: refreshing the spirit, limbering up the hands and the mind for what comes next.

獾那相对硕大的头部几乎占了它矮壮紧凑身躯的三分之一。它看起来似乎并不怎么危险，然而关于它们在保卫洞穴时的凶悍、野蛮的噬咬，以及那对掘土利爪一旦不再抓向泥土而是撕进血肉所展现的力量，传闻始终不绝。
The badger's relatively large head makes up fully one-third of its squat, compact length. It looks as if it would not pose much of a threat, and yet tales persist of their ferocity when defending their dens, their savage bite, and the power of their digging claws when applied to flesh rather than soil.

Oscar Of Amn.name:
安姆的奥斯卡
Oscar Of Amn

Text.text:
男人大摇大摆地走近，明明身上缺了几块，却仍一副趾高气扬的架势。左眼覆着眼罩。右手握着一把手弩，食指暂时被上弦的弩矢尖端顶替。那抹坏笑卷成近乎狞笑的弧度，露出笑里一颗金色门牙冷冷一闪。看他脖颈、脸庞与手臂上纵横交错、清晰可见的疤痕，便知此人早已与死亡反复擦肩——死神化作撕裂的利爪、啃咬的獠牙，以及鞭挞般抽来的长尾。

~ Played by Haydn Neese

The man walks up with an approach that’s all swagger, even though pieces of him are missing. An eye patch covers his left eye. He holds a hand crossbow in his right hand, his index finger replaced for the moment by the point of a bolt loaded into the weapon. His smirk curls like a grimace, revealing a golden incisor glinting in his smile. By the array of visible scars on his neck, face, and arms, it is obvious this is someone who’s faced death many times in the form of slashing claws, gnashing teeth, and whipping tails.

~ Played by Haydn Neese

Group Of Caravaniri.name:
商队行旅团
Group Of Caravaniri

Text.text:
一辆宛如夜间庙会般的篷车前门口，站着两个男人、三个女人、一个瘦小男孩、一个少女、一条杂种狗和一只鸭子。其一的女人瘦削而多疑，像那条狗。其一的男人圆润柔软，像那只鸭。那少女既撩人又危险。她们在纹着刺青的脚踝、手腕与手臂上，披挂着一场集市般的珠宝与编织皮革——手指上堆满戒指——多数人还用好几条围巾层层叠叠，罩在鲜艳拼布的衣服之上。男孩戴着一顶歪斜的高顶帽，竟是用被褥拼布缝成。

~ Envisioned by Shangerla

Before the door of a wagon that resembles a town fair at night stand two men, three women, a tiny boy, a teenage girl, a mongrel dog, and a duck. One of the women is thin and suspicious, like the dog. One of the men is round and soft, like the duck. The girl seems tantalizing and dangerous. They wear a bazaar of jewels and braided leather on tattooed ankles, wrists, and arms—their fingers encrusted with rings—and most wear multiple scarves over layers of bright patchwork clothes. The boy sports a crooked top hat made from a quilt.

~ Envisioned by Shangerla

你抬头望向瞭望台，抬手遮住刺眼的晨光。一名龙裔在万里无云的天空下鳞片熠熠生辉，正朝你挥手。她利落地顺着粗麻绳梯下到甲板，随后以有些外八的步态朝你走来。她咧开友善的笑容，几枚獠牙已经崩裂或折断。
You look up to the crow’s nest, shading your eyes from the bright morning sun. A dragonborn, scales glistening under the cloudless sky, waves to you. She descends the hempen ladder to the deck with swift ease, then approaches you with a bandy gait. She sports a friendly grin, some of her fangs chipped or broken.

你看见雨势逼近。它在一箭之遥外如起伏的雨幕倾泻而下，顺着高空云流的指引横铺在大地之上。雨点噼啪敲打着泥土，那诡异的纹理席卷而来，将你裹入倾盆大雨之中。
You see the rain coming. It falls in waving curtains a bowshot away, dropped across the landscape as dictated by the flow of clouds high in the sky. Droplets patter over the earth as the mysterious pattern overtakes you, enveloping you in a downpour.

Disgusting Motel Room.name:
令人作呕的汽车旅馆客房
Disgusting Motel Room

Text.text:
汽旅房间里弥漫着一股刺鼻的恶臭，沉沉压在空气里。霉味与人类排泄物的气息在这团混杂中最为浓烈。柜台上脏兮兮的玻璃杯、塌陷床垫上破烂的床单，到底是清洁人员视而不见，还是他们能拿出的最好家当，都已难以分辨。你甚至能听见隔壁住客冲马桶的声音，仿佛就发生在同一间房里。
A pungent smell hangs heavy in the air of the motel room. Mold and human waste are the strongest among the mix. It's unclear whether the dirty glasses on the counter and tattered sheets on the sagging mattress were ignored by housekeeping or just the best they had available. You can hear the patron next door flush their toilet as if it happened right in the same room.

Commoner And Newsboard.name:
平民与告示板
Commoner And Newsboard

Text.text:
一块木制告示板上钉着风吹雨打、褪色斑驳的告示，却被一个坐在木桶上的身影半遮半掩。对方目光游移不定，小麦金的发丝从绿色兜帽下倾泻而出。那人穿着与告示板一样黯淡朴素的衣物，仿佛此人正是为了坐在它旁边而被特意打造出来的。
A wooden newsboard bearing weatherworn notices is partially blocked by a figure seated on a barrel. Their eyes dart around, wheat-gold hair spilling out of their green hood. They wear clothes as dull and plain as the newsboard itself, as if the person were crafted to purposefully sit beside it.

Quip About Lunch.name:
关于午餐的打趣
Quip About Lunch

Text.text:
“我也说不准，胃里那股往下坠的空洞感到底是饥饿，还是存在性的恐惧；但我想停下来吃点零嘴，看看答案是哪一个。”
“I’m not sure if the pit in my stomach is hunger or existential dread, but I’d like to stop for a snack and find out.”

全场观众屏息凝神，只见一枚烟花拖着光痕直冲夜空；尖细的嘶鸣成了人群间唯一的声响。它飞得太远，连声音也渐渐听不见了，短暂的寂静被拉得漫长，直到那小小的火箭猛然炸开，化作缤纷的火焰与光雨。人群立刻爆发出震天欢呼，欢呼声淹没了又一打新烟花升空的啸响，它们接连跃入天际，与这场庆典的盛放汇成一片。
The entire audience holds their breath as a single firework streams into the sky, its high-pitched whine the only sound amid the crowd. It gets too far to hear, and the moment of silence drags on, until the little rocket bursts into a shower of multicolored fire and light. The crowd immediately erupts into cheers, drowning out the sound of a dozen new fireworks launching into the sky to join the celebratory display.

Mutant Half-elf On The Hunt.name:
追猎中的突变（特征）半精灵
Mutant Half-elf On The Hunt

Text.text:
半精灵压低身形，贴近地面扫视林间的落叶与泥土。他那双猫一般的眼睛——两枚泛着幽光的黄宝石，突兀地嵌在人的面孔上——终于捕捉到踪迹：足印藏在枯死与将死的叶片之间，松软的黑土里压出一道单一而狰狞的巨爪印。他直起身，停了一瞬，缓缓伸展颈间绷紧的力道，半身板甲护甲的重量沉沉压在肩头。他更深地走入幽暗的林木，长剑背负在身后。靴底几乎不发出任何声响。

~ 由 Vmaster1995 Envisioned

The half-elf crouches low to scan the forest floor. His catlike eyes—the glowing yellow orbs out of place on his human face—finally find the spoor, their tracks hidden among the dead and dying leaves, the soft earth impressed with a single monstrous claw print. He stands and takes a moment to stretch the tension out of his neck, the weight of his half plate armor bearing down on his shoulders. He walks deeper into the dark wood, sword at his back. His boots barely make a sound.

~ Envisioned by Vmaster1995

道路的接触感黏附在这件磨旧的风衣上，外套本身就诉说着一段独属于它的故事。饱经摧残的护甲板——由各式材料与品牌拼成的独特混搭——沿着这件长大衣铺陈成起伏的盾幕，为穿戴者挡下致命的重创。弹孔与匆匆缝补的补丁覆在新换的护甲板之上，暗示这件衣物所需维护的频率——以及它骇人的效能。
The touch of the road clings to this worn duster, and the coat tells a story all its own. Battered armor plates—a unique mix of materials and brands—line the long overcoat in a rippling shield, protecting the wearer from grievous harm. Bullet holes and hastily sewn patches over new armor plates hint at the frequency of maintenance required for this garment—and its formidable efficacy.

一道微弱的光影闪烁，勾勒出这具魁梧的身形。随之而来的，是令人作呕的腐败恶臭，仿佛一艘未用防腐剂的船上厨房。那臃肿的人形从头到脚裹在不合身的护甲里，脸上还扣着工业级面甲。肩头与膝盖处刻着鲜亮的绿色生化危害标识。它的脚不但覆有护甲，还被暗淡的蓝布层层缠裹，其上溅着几乎淡不可察的褐色污痕。
A faint flicker of light illuminates this hulking figure. It brings with it a stench of decay, like a ship’s galley lacking preservatives.
