The bulky humanoid form is dressed from head to toe in ill-fitting armor, including an industrial-grade face plate. Bright green biohazard symbols are engraved at the shoulders and knees. The feet are not only armored but shrouded with wraps of drab blue cloth, splattered with the faintest hint of brown.

你本能地抬手捂住鼻子抵御那股恶臭，尽管几乎无济于事。房间向地下掘入，以厚石砌成，好让墓室保持阴凉，可这些防范仍挡不住大自然无休止的进程。陈列在一排排石制停尸台上的死者并不会久留便会下葬，但那段时间已足够让尸身变色，散出死亡的腥臭。
You instinctively raise a hand to your nose against the stink, although it does little good. The room is dug into the ground and built of thick stone to keep the chambers cool, but these precautions do little to stop the relentless process of nature. The dead laid out on the rows of stone biers do not stay long before burial, but it seems long enough for bodies to discolor and give off the stench of death.

Breaking Of Spell Of Petrification.name:
石化法术的破除
Breaking Of Spell Of Petrification

Text.text:
魔法的脉络在石中穿行。雕像的双眼开始以能量沸腾，火花如明亮的泪滴般倾泻而下。每一道发光的纹理都迸射出光束，石体在一声震耳欲聋的CRACK中崩裂。其内的活物不再石化，战栗着抖落这具石牢。岩屑每一次崩散，地面便随之震颤。

~ 由暴虐的Grim Envisioned

Veins of magic thread through the stone. The eyes of the statue begin to simmer with energy, sparks cascading down like bright tears. Each glowing vein emits beams of light as the stone breaks open with a resounding CRACK. The living being within, no longer petrified, shivers as they shed their stony prison. The ground shakes with each fragment of crumbling rock.

~ Envisioned by Grim the Tyrannical

在灌木丛与岩石之间，点点金色光珠轻盈扑动、明灭脉动，悬停半空，或停驻在表面上休息。有些在飘移或起伏时发出细微的铃音。一个忽然熄灭，另一个又在近旁瞬间出现，以一声清脆叮响与骤然一闪攫住目光。看起来，这些光芒正注视着草甸及其周遭。
In the brush and among the rocks, little orbs of golden light flutter and pulse, hover and rest on surfaces. Some make slight ringing sounds as they move or fluctuate. One winks out, another instantly appears nearby, drawing attention with a chime and sudden flash. It appears these lights are watching the meadow and its surroundings.

有一只眼睛的眼皮松松垮垮，睫毛还在；它偶尔会缓慢地开合一下，像是在慢吞吞地眨眼。玩偶里塞满填充物，穿着一条花卉图案的裙子。它的鞋是一圈圈皮革绑带，外头又缝上金色扣环，凄惨地想把它伪装得不那么像刺客的靴子。无论你把它怎样放下，最后总会发现它以一种古怪的姿势坐着，仿佛正伸手去够什么东西。
One eye has a loose eyelid with lashes. It opens and closes sometimes in a slow wink. The doll is stuffed, fit with a floral dress. Its shoes are sets of leather straps, with gold buckles sewn over them in a pitiful attempt to make them look less like an assassin’s boots. No matter how it is left, the doll is always found sitting in a strange posture, as if it were reaching for something.

Finger Of Death.name:
死亡之指
Finger Of Death

Text.text:
一股诡异而超脱尘世的寒意自你腹中升起——紧随而来的是撕扯般的恶心。你感觉那股冷意蔓延进四肢，悄然爬上你的指尖。你伸出一根手指，指向那生物；一瞬间，翻涌的毒烟乍现，那股感觉从你体内抽离，将纯粹的坏死能量灌入目标。就在你眼前，那生物开始枯萎。
A strange and otherworldly cold rises in your gut—a clawing nausea follows. You feel the chill extend into your limbs, creeping into your fingertips. You extend a finger, pointing to the creature, and in a flash of virulent smoke, the sensation leaves you, imbuing the target with pure necrotic energy. Before your eyes, the creature begins to wither.

两道布满利齿的金属弧片合拢成这道陷阱的颚口；两侧的弹簧臂如同开启的杠杆。紧闭的颚口下方是触发盘，旁边还卡着设定销或止扣。触发盘之下是一块金属底座，底座连着一条锁链与一根金属桩。
Two arches of toothed metal form the jaws of this trap; spring arms serve as opening levers on either side. Under the closed jaws is a trigger pan, along with the setting pin or dog. Beneath the trigger pan is a metal base, to which a chain and metal stake are attached.

Man In Worker Clothing Arrives Through P.name:
身着工装的男人穿过传送门而至
Man In Worker Clothing Arrives Through Portal

Text.text:
一道在空间-时代中荡漾的裂口骤然张开——嘶嘶作响，裹着辛香的气味——在传送门翻涌的黑烟间，一个来自不同年代的男人迈步而出。他穿着荧光橙色的长衫、灯芯绒长裤、防化手套、钢头靴，戴着军用头盔，脸上写满困惑。嘴唇被撕裂出一道口子。他来回转动脑袋，像是在寻找某个特定的目标。
A rippling gash in space-time opens—fizzling with the scent of spice—and through the billowing black smoke of the portal steps a man from a different age. He wears a Day-Glo orange tunic, corduroy trousers, hazmat gloves, steel-toed boots, a military helmet, and a puzzled look. His lip has been split. He swivels his head back and forth as though looking for something specific.

Gunshot Deals Debilitating Wound.name:
枪声造成致残重创
Gunshot Deals Debilitating Wound

Text.text:
枪声之后，伴随着一声痛呼与一记轻闷的坠地声，受伤的目标轰然倒下。他们虚弱地挣扎着想站起来，却终究力不从心，只能按住枪伤处，试图压住伤口，遏止鲜血汹涌外流。
The shot is punctuated with a cry of pain and a soft thud as the injured target collapses. They make a feeble attempt to stand but can't manage it, instead opting to apply pressure to the gunshot in hopes of stemming the tide of blood.

Cyberpunk Fantasy Metropolis: Downtown.name:
赛博朋克奇幻大都会：市中心
Cyberpunk Fantasy Metropolis: Downtown

Text.text:
无尽的拱城挤满了市中心的空间，仿佛一锅沸腾的火锅，翻滚着彼此倾轧的企业集团。流线型的塔楼自潮湿阴腐的城市蔓延中拔地而起，一尊庞大的企业之灵沿着主街阔步前行，电光在它无形的面孔周围簌簌飞舞。豪奢的办公室里，身着价值连城西装的冷酷高管们彼此暗下毒手，他们晦暗的星界能量化作相互争夺的光之绞索，盘旋攀缠于拱城之间。天空中，一张红獠牙的灵体面孔翻飞——锯齿般的边缘、细小的眼珠、抽打的长舌——那是企业贪婪的巨大徽记，将恶意的阴影投覆整座城市。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Endless arcologies crowd the downtown space, a thriving hotpot of rival corps. Sleek tower blocks rise from dank urban sprawl, and a colossal corporate spirit strides along the main street, lightning fluttering about its formless face. In plush offices, ruthless corp executives in priceless suits seek to stab each other in the back, their dark astral energies manifesting as competing strands of light twisting up and around the arcologies. The red-fanged face of a spirit flutters in the sky—jagged edges, beady eyes, and a lashing tongue—a great emblem of corporate greed casting its malignant shadow across the city.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Divine Fairgrounds Of A Goddess Of Joy.name:
欢愉女神的圣域游乐场
Divine Fairgrounds Of A Goddess Of Joy

Text.text:
当你在门口出示门票时，一幅粗厚的帆布从票面上舒展而出，像活物般延展，最终与摊贩的帐篷融为一体。灯火悬在游乐道上方摇曳。你穿行在各式消遣之间，自己的年代悄然褪去——用一份善意换来一块蛋糕，用一杯酒换来一场飘雪。一个孩子把冰淇淋倒进地上的狗碗里，指着那边喊叫着，笑得前仰后合。欢喜响起时，人人都听得见；苦难降临时，游乐场里的每个人也都会向它致谢，感谢它扮演的那一份角色。巨大的烤坑里最后一缕烟，终于散入傍晚的天穹。
When you present your ticket at the gate, a sailcloth of canvas unfurls from it, becoming one with the vendors' tents. Lights hang over the midway. You walk among the diversions, your age disappearing, trading a kindness for a cake, trading wine for a snowfall. A child puts her ice cream in a dog dish on the ground, and calls out, pointing and laughing. When there is joy everyone hears it, and when there is suffering, everyone in the fairgrounds thanks the suffering for the part it plays. The last of the smoke from the great roasting-pits disappears into the evening sky.

Loot From A Gold Dragon Wyrmling.name:
金龙幼雏的战利品
Loot From A Gold Dragon Wyrmling

Text.text:
这只幼龙竟然在脖子上用一根编绳挂着一瓶强效治疗药水，另外还带着一个小袋子，里面塞满了各式各样的钱币。
The wyrmling, oddly, wears a greater healing potion on a braided cord around its neck, as well as a pouch filled with an assortment of coins.

Self-repairing Armor.name:
自我修复护甲
Self-repairing Armor

Text.text:
两只半截的鳞甲桶以皮革在两侧相连。它的背甲上绑着一对青铜罐，中间垫着一层橡胶缓冲垫：一罐盛着熔融金属，另一罐装着冷却剂。细小而狭长的金属管从罐体引出，沿着鳞片之间的沟槽蜿蜒铺开。左手的锁甲手套上装有一枚开关。护甲受损时，开关会先放出炽热金属，紧接着喷出一股冷却剂，将破损处以丑陋粗糙的补丁强行填补替换。
Two half barrels of scale mail are connected at the sides by leather. Strapped to its back plate, with a rubber cushion between them, is a pair of bronze canisters, one of molten metal and one of coolant. Tiny, narrow metal tubes run from them to the grooves between the scales. The left mail glove is fitted with a switch. When the armor is damaged, the switch releases hot metal followed by a shot of coolant, which replaces the compromised section with ugly, rough patches.

[外部] 市政厅庄严恢宏、帝王般矗立，堪称市政成就的巅峰。仿希腊的立柱沿着入口排开；奢华的大理石台阶层层向上，通往一扇巨大的木门。立柱间支起高耸的竖屏，循环播放市长的公益宣传。主入口前有一道柔和的绿色力场闪烁不定。这里安保森严：全副武装的卫兵星罗棋布，黑色面罩屏上跳动着红色感叹号。要是听说屋顶有狙击手，你也不会意外。下方广场停着一列列深色豪华车辆，车窗玻璃一律深色贴膜。

[内部] 穿过安检屏障，迎面是奢华与实用并存的建筑：舒适，却依旧冷冽高效。厚绒地毯与水晶吊灯交织其间，高速扶梯与重力电梯穿插往来。西装革履的官员来回阔步，身后跟着神色焦灼的助理，怀里紧抱厚重文件。你可以确信，自己正被多台摄像头记录着。整洁的极简指示牌指向各个部门——税务咨询、 紧急服务、 刑事起诉，以及更多。

[Outside] Stately and imperial, City Hall stands as the apex of civil achievement. The faux Greek columns, lining an entrance of extravagant marble steps leading to a great wooden door, support long vertical screens displaying mayoral PSAs. A soft green forcefield flickers over the main entrance. Security is tight here: well-armored guards dot the place, their black visor-screens flashing red exclamation marks. You wouldn’t be surprised to learn there were snipers on the roof. In the plaza below sit lines of dark luxury vehicles with tinted glass.

[Inside] Past the security screen is a building of opulence and utility, comfortable yet still coldly efficient. Plush carpeted floors and chandeliers mix with high-speed escalators and gravity elevators. Suited officials strut back and forth, followed by harried-looking assistants clutching heavy papers. You can assume that you’re being recorded by several cameras. Neat minimalist signs point the way to departments—Tax Enquiries, Emergency Services, Criminal Prosecution, and many more.

越过一道摇摇欲坠的拱门，豁然开启一间石室；矮短的笼子沿着每一面墙排开。空气中盘旋着一股腐腥的恶臭，像肮脏又湿透的狗身味，黏在喉头不散。黑铁栅格将一间间囚笼分隔开来，粗陋的挂锁至今仍把笼门锁得死死的。门口附近，一把钥匙挂在钩子上。泥土地的空地上散落着陶碗，有的开裂，有的碎成片。十数个囚笼之中，犬类的骨骸横七竖八地摊着——它们被遗弃在此，终至枯白。

~ LazerScythe构想

Beyond a crumbling arch opens a chamber with short cages lining every wall. A fetid smell, like dirty, wet dog, hangs in the air. Black iron grids divide cells from one another, and simple padlocks still hold doors closed. Near the doorway, a key hangs on a hook. Clay bowls, some cracked or shattered, litter the open part of the dirt floor. Within the dozen or more cages sprawl the bones of canines left abandoned.

~ Envisioned by LazerScythe

Speech By An Armorer About The Rewards O.name:
铠甲匠谈自己手艺的奖励之词
Speech By An Armorer About The Rewards Of Their Work

Text.text:
“在有些人眼里，我的活儿很简单。可它有时既累断脊梁又枯燥单调，但我知道，我在让护甲更坚固一点——或让它更贴合舒适一点——上多花的每一个时辰，都可能为某个人争来逃出生天所需的那一秒，而这就足以让一切都值得。”
“My work is simple to some. It can be backbreaking and monotonous at times, but I know that every extra hour I put into making the armor a little stronger—or the fit a little more comfortable—might grant someone that extra second they need to escape, and that makes it all worthwhile.”

Guthram’s Abbey In Winter.name:
古斯拉姆修道院·冬日
Guthram’s Abbey In Winter

Text.text:
修道院狭窄的窗内传出杂乱的低语与喧嚣，许多声音在其中隆隆回荡。灰色石墙在苍白的雪幕前显得冰冷而肃峻。那些声音夹杂着疲惫与懊恼，忽然一把粗哑的嗓音压过嘈杂：“炖菜、面包，还有一处过夜的空间，会提供给所有需要的人。但你必须等到你的回合。”

正门外，一名侍从站着，戴着连指手套的双手捧着一只金属施舍箱。他们一边对路人微笑，一边牙齿打颤。他们用颤抖的声音说道：“给饥饿与受冻的人。只要一点点，够我们——他们——熬过这个冬天。”

The sound of many voices rumbles out from the abbey’s narrow windows, its gray stone walls cold and austere against the pale backdrop of snow. The voices are a mix of weariness and frustration, and then a gruff voice carries over the clamor, “Stew, bread, and a space to sleep will be provided to all who need it. But you must wait your turn.”

Outside the front door, an acolyte stands and holds a metal alms box with mittened hands. Their teeth chatter as they smile at passersby. They say in a tremulous voice, “For the hungry and cold. Just enough to get us—them—through the winter.”

平民在你向他们搭话时露出微笑，频频点头附和。你这才发现，他们的目光并不落在你的眼睛上，而是牢牢盯着你的嘴，随着你说话读着你的唇形。他们再次肯定地点头，随即以同样的方式回应，谨慎而清晰地说话。
The commoner smiles as you address them, nodding along. You realize their gaze is locked not on your eyes, but your mouth, reading your lips as you speak. They nod along in affirmation, then respond in kind, speaking carefully.

Futuristic Arms Dealer.name:
未来军火商
Futuristic Arms Dealer

Text.text:
尽管她的身躯金属多过血肉，这名军火商的笑容却仍带着有机的温度：几分阴鸷，几分迷人。她身着战斗制服，像一块会呼吸的广告牌；身形轻捷流畅，但她每一步挪动，你都能听见机械肢体细小的嗡鸣。她随意而从容地握着一只线条利落的金属公文箱。她是否正注视着你，你无从得知：她的眼睛藏在镜面般的镜片之后。
Though she is more metal than flesh, the dealer’s smile is organic: slightly sinister, slightly charming. Clothed in combat fatigues like a living advertisement, she is lithe and fluid, but you hear the small whirring of mechanized limbs as she moves. She holds a sleek metal briefcase in a loose and easy grip. Whether she’s looking at you, you don’t know: her eyes are hidden behind mirrored lenses.

Man Absorbing Dark Essence.name:
吸纳黑暗精粹的男子
Man Absorbing Dark Essence

Text.text:
男人的面孔因癫狂的膜拜而扭曲，他用饥渴的双手在冒烟的符文上来回抚过，贪婪品味着那股未被触及的力量在体内奔流的触感。悖逆一切自然法则，符文开始变化——在被朗读出声的同时，它们的形态也随之移转。墨黑如油的雾丝从男人的眼中盘旋逸出，他仍在继续。也许那是他焦黑灵魂吐出的污霾。
The man’s face contorts in deranged adulation as he runs ravenous hands across the smoking runes, relishing the sensation of untapped power flowing through him. Defying all natural laws, the runes begin to change, their forms shifting as they are read aloud. Tendrils of inky-black mist swirl from the man’s eyes as he continues. Perhaps it is smog from his blackened soul.

Loot From A Red Slaad's Lair.name:
红色斯拉德巢穴中的战利品
Loot From A Red Slaad's Lair

Text.text:
尸体铺满地面，肩挨着肩，像一群人在逼仄的旅舍里挤着打地铺。遗体上在不同部位张着血肉模糊的巨大空洞，多集中在腹部与胸口。然而，布置出这幅骇人景象的人似乎对受害者的随身物毫无兴趣——于是，你们踩着死者跨过去翻找一番，仍能找到装着钱币的荷包，以及几瓶药水。
Corpses line the floor, shoulder to shoulder like people bedding down in a cramped hostel. The bodies have gaping, gory cavities at various points, mostly near their stomachs and chest. However, whoever composed this gruesome scene had no interest in the victims’ belongings, so—stepping over the dead and searching—you are able to find coin purses and some potions.

Insult About A Pretty Face.name:
漂亮脸蛋的讥讽
Insult About A Pretty Face

Text.text:
“别想太多——会把你那张漂亮脸蛋都皱坏的；没了它，你还能剩下什么？”
“Don’t think too hard—you’ll wrinkle that pretty face, and without that, what else would you have?”

铺石小径两旁点缀着喷泉与雕像，蜿蜒穿过郁郁葱葱的花圃，盛放的繁花与青翠的灌木挤满其间。园子被精心打理得近乎苛刻，呈现出一幅田园如画的景致，连一根草叶都不曾错位。鸟儿聚集在树梢，清脆鸣啭，又俯冲到散布在区域各处的石制水盆中嬉戏啄饮。一方池塘以平整石片细致围砌，水里游着几尾体型硕大的金鳞鱼，它们以近乎人类般狡黠的目光打量着过往行人。
Cobbled paths lined with fountains and statuary wind their way through lush garden beds brimming with blooming flowers and verdant shrubbery. Painstakingly maintained, the gardens present an idllyic image with not a blade of grass out of place. Birds gather in the trees, whistling pleasantly and diving into stone water basins strewn throughout the area. A pond, meticulously lined with flat stones, contains several large, golden-scaled fish, which eye passersby with an almost human-like cunning.

一棵孤树枯骨嶙峋、衰败不堪，自废墟之心刺出，宛如长矛贯穿伤口。根须蜿蜒钻入崩碎的石块，紧紧攫住，将其拉入自身——纠缠得如同相拥而亡的恋人，死在彼此的臂弯里。
A lone tree, skeletal and wasting, rises from the heart of the ruins like a spear through a wound. The roots wind their way through the crumbling stone, clutching them to itself—entwined like lovers dead in each other’s arms.

Negative Energy Plane.name:
负能量位面
Negative Energy Plane

Text.text:
黑暗包围着你——深邃而漆黑，仿佛将一切光都吞饮殆尽。虚空无边无际、毫无空气、彻底无貌无形。这里既不冷，也不暖——事实上，连“温度”这一概念都在此遗失了，与重力一同消散。四周仿佛伸出利爪撕扯你，使你疲惫，抽走你的力气——此地无法维系生命，只会以生命为食。
Darkness surrounds you—so deep and black it seems to drink in any light. The void is endless, airless, and utterly featureless. It's not cold, nor is it warm—in fact, the very notion of temperature seems lost here, along with gravity. The surroundings seem to claw at you, fatiguing you, drawing out energy—this place cannot sustain life. It only feeds on it.

I Drink My Potion Of Cold Resistance.name:
我喝下我的抗寒药水
I Drink My Potion Of Cold Resistance

Text.text:
我痛饮下这瓶药剂一大口，感觉就像啜着一杯热气腾腾的茶。温暖而舒缓的能量在我体内点燃，我的肌肤噼啪作响，迸溅出缥缈的余烬。
I drink a deep draught of this potion, the sensation much like sipping a steaming cup of tea. My body alights with warm, soothing energy, and my skin crackles with ethereal embers.

Insult About Incompetence.name:
关于无能的侮辱
Insult About Incompetence

Text.text:
“哇，干得漂亮。也许那畜生会被吓得逃之夭夭，怕你的无能会传染。”
“Wow, well done. Perhaps the beast will flee, for fear your incompetence is contagious.”

Doubtful Maimed Warrior.name:
疑惧的残废战士
Doubtful Maimed Warrior

Text.text:
战士依旧双手紧握长剑。锈迹与血渍斑斑的板甲护肩与护喉覆在下方轻便的锁子甲与皮甲之上，可他的头颅却赤裸无护。一只眼睛已经没了，鲜血汩汩涌出。他脸上带着犹疑的神色——一种阴沉的、不祥的动摇。
The fighter still holds a sword with both hands. Plated pauldrons and a gorget, spotted with rust and blood, cover a light chain and leather suit beneath, but the warrior’s head is bare. And one eye is gone, bleeding profusely. There is a tentative expression on the warrior’s face, a grim doubt.

这名存在的眼中燃烧着对领袖教诲的狂热。他们对教团的虔诚贯穿每一句话、每一次移动、每一个行动。谁若不幸与之为敌，必将遭殃。
This being’s zeal for their leader’s teachings burns in their eyes. Their devotion to the cult comes through in every word, every movement, every action. Woe betide anyone unfortunate enough to cross them.

Ferrofluid Ooze.name:
铁磁流体黏浆
Ferrofluid Ooze

Text.text:
一滩银色液体以轻快的迅疾感从周遭渗流而过。它直径八码，暗沉的躯体仿佛充塞整个空间，短暂地带上磁性，伴随尖细的嗡鸣。各式金属器具从这生物体内刺出——半被消化，半被同化。它像慵懒的浪潮般拱起，细小触须探寻新的金属碎料以供吞食。
A pool of silver liquid oozes past its surroundings with an easy quickness. Eight feet in diameter, its dark body seems to fill the space, briefly magnetizing with a high-pitched whine. All manner of metallic implements poke out of the creature—half digested, half absorbed. It arcs up like a lazy wave, small tendrils seeking out new scrap for consumption.

Bladesinger Using Green Flame Blade.name:
刃歌者施展绿焰之刃
Bladesinger Using Green Flame Blade

Text.text:
半精灵大步逼近她的仇敌，每一步都像踏着狂风骤雨的节拍起舞。她丰润的身形与饱满的脸颊近乎天使般稚气，却遮不住那份久经磨炼的优雅。离敌人仅两步，她抽出一对沾满烟灰的短剑，手腕翻飞，剑影以令人目眩的连环花式疾旋，直至空气震颤，仿佛被奥术之歌拨响。喧响之下，一股可感的压迫感攀升，散出异界般的灼热。

她如执棒的指挥家般雕琢这曲秘奥交响，直至那热浪骤然爆裂成祖母绿的火焰，沿着剑刃起舞。随即她猛然抽击，将一切倾注于一道炽烈的横斩。光与声在巅峰处点燃：层层绿焰浪潮吞没她的敌人，又翻涌回卷向她。她迎接那饥渴的火——任其掠过自己的身体——将最凶烈的灼痛与怒意虹吸进副手之刃，再挥出紧随其后的攻击，怒焰无声，却带着垂死恒星般的毁灭。

~ 由 Colby Poulson 在 Played 中演绎，出自 d4: D&D Deep Dive

The half-elf strides toward her foe, each step like a dance set to a tempestuous tempo. Her plump body and full cheeks are almost cherubic, belying her practiced grace. Two paces from her enemy she draws a pair of soot-stained shortswords, flourishing them in a dizzying sequence until the air thrums with an arcane song. Beneath the noise a palpable pressure rises, radiating otherworldly heat.

Like a conductor with their baton, the half-elf sculpts the esoteric symphony until that heat bursts into emerald flames that dance along her blade. Then she lashes out, channeling everything into a blazing horizontal slash. It ignites in a crescendo of light and sound: waves of green fire inundate her enemy before roiling back at her. She welcomes those ravenous flames—lets them graze across her body—siphoning the worst of their blistering ire into the off-hand blade, which she swings in a follow-up attack that rages with the silent devastation of a dying star.

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

King With Greatsword.name:
巨剑之王
King With Greatsword

Text.text:
国王屹立如松，沉毅而强大。他身披华丽的护甲，手中稳握着威猛的巨剑。那武器刃缘泛起蔚蓝的辉光，宛如神秘伟力与武威权柄的象征。君王既令人敬畏又令人胆寒，力量与统御的气场在他周身脉动不息。
The king stands stoic and strong. He’s clad in ornate armor, his mighty greatsword steady in his grip. The weapon, its edge glowing cerulean, shines as a symbol of mystical power and martial authority. The monarch commands both respect and fear, an aura of strength and leadership pulsing about him.

I Fall While Wearing My Ring Of Soft Lan.name:
我戴着我的「柔落之戒」仍然坠落
I Fall While Wearing My Ring Of Soft Landing

Text.text:
脚下的地面骤然塌陷，我的胃猛地一抽。身体在失重中向下翻坠。出于本能的恐惧，我一把抓住手指上的翼形戒环，几乎用过分的力道攥紧金属。魔法早已起效：冰凉的气流从腋下疾涌而过，拖住我下坠的速度，将我托正。随后我轻松地滑翔着降落，像乘着微风的鸟。心跳渐渐平复，迫在眉睫的死亡感随之消散。最后，我的双脚轻轻点地，落下时只发出一声轻响。
My stomach lurches as the ground beneath my feet gives way. My body pitches downward in freefall. In instinctive fear, I grab at the winged ring on my finger, clutching the metal with undue force. The magic is already at work: cool air rushes under my arms, slowing my descent and lifting me upright. I float down in an easy glide, like a bird riding a breeze. My heart rate calms as the sense of imminent death fades. I land with a light tap of my feet against the ground.

I Cast Find Familiar: Sprite.name:
我施放“寻获魔宠”：小妖精（特征）
I Cast Find Familiar: Sprite

Text.text:
我把干燥的紫杉木与蘸过油、扭结的芦苇放进一只华丽的银碗里。低声呢喃着林语中象征友谊与结合的词句，我又添入蜂蜜茉莉的香。接着我讲述善良族的故事，整整一小时。期间，我焚起晒干的接骨木莓、忍冬、马鞭草与西洋蓍草。甜腻的烟雾一缕缕钻入鼻腔，我频频深吸，直到头脑发飘。眼皮合拢。忽然，一阵振翅的轻响提醒我——我新的小妖精（特征）同伴已然到来。
I set dry yew wood and oil-dipped twisted reeds in an ornate silver bowl. Murmuring Sylvan words of friendship and union, I add incense of honey jasmine. I tell stories of the good folk for an hour. As I do, I burn dried elderberries, honeysuckle, verbena, and yarrow. I take whiffs of the sweet smoke until I feel lightheaded. My eyes close. A fluttering of wings alerts me to the arrival of my new sprite companion.

Beautiful Platinum Brooch.name:
华美的白金胸针
Beautiful Platinum Brooch

Text.text:
正如人们所说的那般顶尖货色，唯有最显赫的商贾或深受恩宠的贵族才负担得起。这枚胸针被打造成一串葡萄的形状，上覆叶片，暗示这年份珍稀难得，值得珍藏。
The top of the line, as they say, only affordable by the most prominent merchant or favored noble. This brooch is worked as a cluster of grapes, topped by leaves, implying the vintage is rare and worth keeping.

这艘海盗船张满帆布，牢牢咬住海风；火炮更是专为横扫一艘臃肿商贸大帆船的船腹而布置，宛如在满是海盗猎物的海面上游弋的狡黠掠食者。只要某艘倒霉船上的瞭望员瞥见主桅上傲然飘扬的骷髅旗，他们的船长便明白：今日最可能的结局，只有投降或死亡两条路。
With plenty of sail for holding the wind and cannons specifically positioned to best rake the hull of a fat trading galleon, this pirate ship is a sleek predator in a sea chock-full of the buccaneer’s prey. For when a lookout on such a hapless vessel spies the Jolly Roger flying proudly from this mainmast, their captain knows that surrender or death are the two most likely outcomes for the day.

A Greeting After Death.name:
死后问候
A Greeting After Death

Text.text:
一阵冰凉的细沫洒遍你的全身，像依附大地的云层覆在你身上，化作一条温柔的薄雾毯，轻轻喷洒。你睁开眼，眼前是一片灰白的无垠，唯有雾气可见。你像尘埃般漂浮其中，被轻柔却坚定地牵引着向前。 “何等奇异的能量。”一道如雷的嗓音震撼天地。 昏暗里，一组石块仿佛自虚空中凝出，漂浮着朝你靠近。它们逐渐拼合成眼、口、鼻与耳，组成一张悬空的面孔。潮湿的雾光在其上闪烁，线条与棱角光滑得不似凡人之手可雕。它的花岗岩下颌随每个词摩擦碾动，发出刺耳的刮磨声。 “你的灵魂像钩尖上的虫子般扭曲挣扎。听着——深渊并非无所系之魂唯一能走的路。”

~ 构想：JD

You feel a cool spray all over your body, like earthbound clouds laying over you in a gentle, misting blanket. You open your eyes to a gray expanse, the mist the only thing to be seen. You float like a mote of dust through it, being gently but steadily pulled along. “Such curious energy.” A voice like thunder shakes the world. Out of the gloom, a set of stones floats toward you, as if out of thin air. They take shape into eyes, a mouth, a nose, and ears, forming a hovering face. It glistens in the damp, with lines and edges so smooth it could not have been carved by mortal hands. Its granite jaw grates and grinds with each word. “Your spirit twists like a worm on the edge of a hook. Hark—the abyss is not the only path the unmoored soul may take.”

~ Envisioned by JD

Nystul’s Magic Aura: False Aura.name:
奈斯图尔的魔法灵光：虚假灵光
Nystul’s Magic Aura: False Aura

Text.text: 你的双眼蒙上一层异界之力的雾光，目光穿透目标。你撕碎其形而上织构的丝线，又将它们依照你渴望的形象重新编织。目标的灵光随你意志扭曲，化作一则新的谎言，用以欺骗奥术之眼。 Your eyes mist with otherworldy power as they look through your target. You shred the threads of its metaphysical fabric, reweaving them into your desired image. Your target's aura warps to your whim, a new lie to trick the arcane eye.

I Cast Locate Animals Or Plants.name:
我施放《定位动物或植物》
I Cast Locate Animals Or Plants

Text.text:
我将疑问朗声说出，声音随风而去。我合上双眼，自然的声响层层放大——盖过伙伴的低语，盖过脚步挪动的沙沙，盖过护甲与兵刃相击的铿锵。我听见鸟儿在巢中彼此啁啾，听见掘洞的生物烦躁地哼哧着，把泥土从鼻孔里喷出；听见枝芽与叶片舒展的细响，而后……我的目标。它的影与声，以及它周遭气息的味道。我找到它了。
I state my query aloud and hear my voice taken by the wind. I close my eyes and the sounds of nature augment—over the chatter of my companions, over the shifting of feet, over the clank of armor and weaponry. I hear birds twitter to each other in their nests, a burrowing creature’s frustrated huffs as it blows dirt out of its nose, the stretching of sprig and leaf, and then… my target. The sight and sound of it, and the scent of its surroundings. I’ve found it.

Magical Detection Of A Wizard's Class.name:
侦测法师的职业的魔法手段
Magical Detection Of A Wizard's Class

Text.text:
你的法术如一层唯有你能看见的纯粹奥能薄膜，覆上你的目标——泛着紫意，带着学院长廊与厚重知识巨著的陈旧书卷气。它缓缓剥落——一团团、一圈圈烟雾短暂漂浮，旋即消散。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Your spell washes over your target in a film of pure arcana only you can see, purplish and tinged with the musty smell of academic halls and heavy tomes of knowledge. It peels away slowly—puffs and rings of smoke that float for an instant then disappear.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Optimize My Hacker's Deck: Sleaze.name:
我为黑客改装牌组：潜行
I Optimize My Hacker's Deck: Sleaze

Text.text:
这是贴身内衣式的活儿。一次只剥一层薄纱，绝不碰会炸响的东西。我从边缘的窗口偷瞄，轻扯防御者代码的渔网，啪地解开嵌入式算法的吊带扣。前戏很多，满是哎呀，没事没事，这里什么都没有。可只要一句低语说错，我就会变成另一颗碎心。

~ 由一位英雄构想

This is lingerie-ware. One thin layer at a time, and nothing that goes boom. I peek through the peripheral windows, I tug on the fishnet of defender code, unsnap the garter of an embedded algorithm. Lots of foreplay, lots of oopsie, nothing to see here. One wrong whisper, though, and I’m just another broken heart.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

我双眼血红，死死瞪着我们的敌人。我咬住斧柄，重踏一步，耸肩抖身，喉间低吼，龇牙咆哮。关节噼啪作响，我的力量暴涨——肌肉翻涌起伏。狂怒席卷而来，我发出一声怒吼，抡起战斧，蓄势待发。
Wild-eyed, I glare at our foes. I bite the haft of my axe, stomp, and roll my shoulders, growling and gnashing. My joints pop as I swell with might—flesh rippling. The fury overtakes me, and I ready my axe with a roar.

Open Pit Prison.name:
露天坑牢
Open Pit Prison

Text.text:
庭院里那口幽深的洞穴不断传出低沉而痛苦的呻吟，囚徒们在其中哀叹自身的命运。陡峭的岩壁上渗着腥臭的水珠，岩石被凿成一间间带栅的牢室，关押着数百名骨瘦如柴的囚犯。进出此地的唯一通道，是一座摇摇欲坠的木制升降台——而它始终处在严密的重兵看守之下。
A low, tortured moan constantly emanates from the cavernous hole in the courtyard as the prisoners within lament their fate. Sheer rock walls—dripping with fetid water—house hundreds of emaciated prisoners in barred cells dug from the stone. The only way in or out is a rickety wooden lift—which is constantly under heavy guard.

Ghost Vandals Of The Old Academy.name:
旧学院的幽灵破坏者
Ghost Vandals Of The Old Academy

Text.text:
学院墙上一块石头闪着微光，随即开始变化。一张面孔浮现出来，仿佛作为纪念被凿刻在石中。那是某个古老破坏者的脸——当年袭击原始建筑的部族之一；后来，奠基的法师将那座建筑改造成了学院高塔。那张脸向前顶出，化作半透明的灰色形体，身躯紧随其后。幽灵从浮雕中踏出，开始行军……
A stone in the academy’s wall glistens and changes. A face reveals itself, as if it were carved into the stone as a memorial. It is the face of an ancient vandal, one of the tribes that attacked the original structure the founding mages turned into the academy tower. The face pushes forward, emerges in a translucent gray form, and the body follows. The ghost steps from the frieze and begins its march…

Divine Workshop Of A Gnomish God.name:
侏儒神祇的神圣工坊
Divine Workshop Of A Gnomish God

Text.text: 皮革与陶土、金属与木料、玻璃与珠宝的作坊被硬生生揉作一处，成了乱中有序的一团：工具架、木桶、锻炉、窑炉与木箱挤挤挨挨，却全都缩小到平日的三分之一。风箱只有香水瓶般大；锤子看起来更适合敲核桃，或许也能用来敲响风铃。然而这里依旧行动如潮，轰然作响。进行中的工程多得难以计数。锤子的叮响、玻璃出水时滋滋作响的噗嘶、凿子咔咔咔的连击声，以及神祇的助手们——数以百计——齐声唱出的和谐歌声，充满了整座工坊。 Workshops for leather and clay, metal and wood, glass and jewelry, are mashed together into one chaotic collection of tool racks, tubs, forges, kilns, and crates, all reduced in scale to a third of their usual size. A bellows is the size of a perfume bottle. A hammer looks suitable for walnuts, or perhaps for hitting chimes. The place is booming with activity, however. More projects are underway than can easily be counted. The ping of the hammers, the sizzling pshh of glass pulled from water, the chick-chick-chick of chisels, and the harmonious songs of the god’s assistants, hundreds of them, fill the workshop.

Quip By An Elf About Foolhardiness.name:
精灵对莽撞之举的俏皮话
Quip By An Elf About Foolhardiness

Text.text:
“你们竟然还活着，真让我刮目相看。我原以为你们这个种族的逞勇好胜早该把自己送进灭绝的深渊了——毕竟只要觉得能捞到一点荣耀，你们看起来连火山口都敢往里跳。”
“I am just so impressed you’re all still around. I was sure your race’s bravado would’ve driven you to extinction long ago since you seem ready to jump into a volcano if you think there’ll be some glory in it.”

I Transform A Magic Weapon Into My Pact.name:
我将一把魔法武器转化为我的契约武器
I Transform A Magic Weapon Into My Pact Weapon

Text.text:
我单膝跪地，双手按在武器的握柄上，打击端朝下，静静抵在地面。我以低沉的咒语呼唤我的宗主与我们之间的羁绊。我将力量灌入武器，用无形的魔力之索将它与我紧紧捆缚。一个小时后，我在心中观想宗主的领域。我遣散武器，它随即消失，遁入我与那片领域之间的异次元空间。
I kneel with my hands on the weapon’s grip, the striking end pointed at and resting on the ground. Using a low incantation, I invoke my patron and our bond. I push power into the weapon, binding it to me with cords of invisible magical force. After an hour, I visualize my patron’s realm. I dismiss the weapon, and it disappears into an extradimensional space between me and that realm.

他们的鼻尖不停抽动，目光追逐着每一丝细微的移动，整个人像一根蓄势待发的弹簧。凭借强健有力的后腿直立而起，他们完全有能力在愿意时一跃而出，跨越令人惊叹的距离。作为情绪极为外露的生物，他们的长耳朵常常映照心境：欢欣时竖起轻颤，阴郁时便无力下垂。
Their nose constantly a-twitch and gaze flicking over every slight movement, they are a coil ready to spring. Upright on their powerful hind legs, they certainly have the capability to launch themselves to impressive distances if they so wish. Highly expressive creatures, their long ears tend to reflect their mood, perking with glee or drooping in gloom.

Rock Bridge During Winter.name:
冬日石桥
Rock Bridge During Winter

Text.text:
尽管你暴露在高高的山坡上，空气却出奇地平静，你甚至能听见雪花坠落，轻轻敲在周围积雪上的细响。可当你走近那道横跨深渊的巨石桥时，一切便变了。桥两侧的裂隙里猛地卷起一阵呜咽般的尖啸狂风，裹挟着刺骨的冰晶扑面而来。想必是地形的某种怪异之处，将下方的气流硬生生抽上来。你小心翼翼地打量这座桥，警惕脚下的落点，发现桥缘处竟有细小的冰锥朝上竖起。
Though you stand exposed high on the mountainside, the air feels calm, allowing you to hear the fall of flakes as they strike the surrounding snow. That changes as you approach the bridge of boulders that crosses the abyss. A whistling moan whips up from the crevasse on either side of the bridge, carrying with it biting crystals of ice. Some quirk of the topography must draw air from below. As you examine the bridge, wary of your footing, you note that along its edges, tiny icicles point up.

Jungle Water Lily.name:
丛林睡莲
Jungle Water Lily

Text.text:
一片静止的水面上挤满了睡莲叶。每一片叶子都是巨大的翠绿圆盘，边缘微微隆起成唇。叶柄根部开着一道三角形缺口，细长的茎拖曳入水，将叶片与近旁的同伴相连。在这层层拥簇之间，一朵睡莲花漂浮其上——硕大的花朵由数十片洁白花瓣层层叠起。它优雅地停驻着，悬在如镜的倒影之上。
Lily pads crowd a stretch of still water. Each pad is a great green disk with a raised lip. A triangular notch is at the base of the stem, which trails down into the water, connecting the pad with its neighbors. Among the crowd floats a water lily flower, a large bloom layered with dozens of white petals. The lily sits, poised elegantly, over its mirror reflection.

Healing Nanobots Enter The Body.name:
治疗纳米机器人进入体内
Healing Nanobots Enter The Body

Text.text:
你正开始怀疑这些纳米机器人的效力，忽然间意识到：疼痛已经消失了。治疗悄然无声，如同一剂温柔的万能灵药，在你休息时于背景中静静运转，让那些微观机器从容不迫地施展本领。你心中涌起一阵谨慎的乐观，细细品味着这份被重新点燃的健旺。
You’re beginning to doubt the nanobots’ efficacy when you suddenly realize: the pain has gone. The healing was subtle, a gentle panacea that worked quietly away in the background while you rested, allowing the microscopic machines to do their work with aplomb. A cautious sense of optimism swells within you as you relish your invigorated health.

老法师拄着一根虬结的手杖，身子沉沉压在上头，独自咯咯怪笑。黯黑破烂的长袍披在佝偻的身形上，缝着无数补丁，颜色各异，材料也不尽相同。他的双眼落在你身上——一只睁得极大，游移不定；另一只半眯着，狡黠阴冷——一股说不清的诡异感沿着你的脊背悄然爬升。这个巫师哪里不对劲，几乎像是异界来客；就在那股感觉涌上来的同时，你也闻到一阵混杂着十几种草药与油脂的气味，紧跟着又是扑面而来的、无可错认的汗臭——好几天没洗的那种。
The old mage cackles to themselves as they lean heavily on a gnarled staff. Dark, ragged robes drape their slouched form, stitched with numerous patches of varying colors and materials. Both eyes, one wide open and roaming, the other narrowed and cunning, fall upon you, and an uncanny sensation creeps up your spine. There’s something off about this wizard, something almost otherworldly, and the stench of a dozen different herbs and oils reaches your nose at about the same time as the unmistakable stench of unwashed sweat.

这支舞很古老——经由数百年演化得愈发繁复——对话亦然。每一句都缠着暧昧的暗示，每一次回应不是狡黠的纵容，便是带着哈欠般的厌倦。白发与阴鸷的眼，柔美的肌肤相连，乌亮如鸦羽浸油；舞者有时竟像一具四肢错生的怪异生物。潮起潮落，鞠躬与屈膝礼。手掌接触，脸颊接触，对话的色泽愈发放浪，终至大胆无忌。舞终之时，手上的事却才刚刚开始。
The dance is old—grown complicated over the centuries—as is the conversation. Each phrase is laced with innuendo, each response either a sly encouragement or a huffing expression of boredom. White hair and sinister eyes, the connection of beautiful skin like crow oil, the dancers sometimes seeming like one strange-limbed being. Ebb and flow, bow and curtsy. Hands touch, cheeks touch, and the conversation grows in shades more risqué, and finally quite bold. When the dance ends, the hands have only begun.

一个孩子怯生生地站在一旁，让开了路。蓝色的血管沿着她瘦骨嶙峋的腿上下蜿蜒。她的肤色苍白得吓人，透着病气；面颊凹陷，头发细软得像蒲公英的种子。尽管脸上没有泪痕，她的眼皮却红肿浮胀。她心不在焉地吮着一根像鸡骨头的东西，目光像鸟儿盯着地上爬行的虫子那样，好奇地打量着四周。
A child stands sheepishly out of the way. Blue veins trail up and down her skinny legs. Her pallor suggests she is sickly, as do her gaunt cheeks, and her hair seems as delicate as dandelion seed. Though there are no tears on her cheeks, her eyelids are red and puffy. She sucks absently on what looks like a chicken bone, observing her surroundings with the interest of a bird watching bugs crawl along the ground.

Plain Steel Brooch.name:
朴素钢胸针
Plain Steel Brooch

Text.text:
如果它很可能会被那件斗篷抢去风头，那么它的朴拙反倒会衬得斗篷愈发华美。卫兵与仆役们偏爱这件谦卑的饰品——这才配得上他们的身份。
If this is likely to be ignored in favor of the cloak, then the cloak will be all the more beautiful for its being dull. Guards and servants like this humble piece of jewelry, as it befits their station.

Claustrophobic Interplanetary Shuttle.name:
令人窒息的星际穿梭艇
Claustrophobic Interplanetary Shuttle

Text.text:
穿梭机的座椅狭窄、天花板低矮，就算没有挤满往返于行星之间的乘客，也会让人觉得逼仄难耐。那些没走运抢到一张破损塑料硬座的人，在穿梭机猛然起飞时踉跄失衡；船体在令人不安的频率下剧烈震颤，飞船吃力地拖着沉重载荷冲出大气层。
The narrow seats and low ceiling of the shuttle would feel cramped even if it wasn’t packed full of passengers heading from one planet to another. Those who weren’t lucky enough to find an uncomfortable chipped-plastic seat stagger as the shuttle blasts off, the hull rattling at a concerning frequency as the ship struggles to propel its heavy load out of the atmosphere.

结实的麻绳盘成一堆，约有五十英尺长。纤维光滑，被岁月与无数双手磨得温顺发亮。这根绳子曾把人送入怎样险恶的深渊，又曾抵达过怎样的绝境？
The sturdy, hempen rope lies in a coiled pile, some fifty feet in length. The fibers are smooth, worn from years of use and dozens of hands. What dangerous depths have been reached by the end of this rope’s length?

Epokasite Runner.name:
艾波卡寄生体奔行者
Epokasite Runner

Text.text:
这名类人生物外星人约五英尺高，双腿矫健轻灵，带着分外的雀跃一跃而出。他们身着一套朴素的技工连体服，上面挂满各式各样的科技小玩意与奇巧装置。连体服呈偏黄的浅褐色，而他们的下半张脸同样泛黄，鳞皮粗糙、仿佛剥落般向后绷起，露出一抹兴高采烈的咧笑。上半张脸则明显带着爬行类的气息，甚至有几分类地精的味道——歪斜而鼓起的鼻子、绿色的皮肤，以及一撮黑色尖刺般的乱发。他们发出一阵尖细刺耳的咯咯怪笑。
Five feet tall and spry on their legs, this humanoid alien bounds forth with a distinct glee. They’re clad in a simple mechanic’s suit, bedecked with all manner of technological trinkets and gizmos. The suit is a yellowish tan, and yellow too is their lower face, scaly and peeled back in a gleeful grin. Their upper face is distinctly reptilian, almost goblinoid, sporting a crooked and bulbous nose, green skin, and a shock of dark spiky hair. They let out a high-pitched cackle.

Drawmij's Instant Summons.name:
德劳米吉的瞬间召唤
Drawmij's Instant Summons

Text.text:
你吟诵束缚之词，触碰那件你希望能跨越空间与时代回应你召唤的物体。你以轻柔却笃定的握持，托着一枚桌面切割的蓝宝石，平整的顶面朝上。你绕着法术的对象缓步环行，始终与其保持接触，并为它命名。宝石迸出噼啪作响的裂鸣，物体的名字随即浮现在它那平整的表面上。召唤已就绪。
You chant words of binding, touching the object you wish to heed your call across space and time. In your light grasp, you hold a table-cut sapphire, its flat top upward. As you circle the spell’s subject, keeping in contact with it, you name it. A crackling sound issues from the jewel as the name of the object appears on its flat face. The summons is ready.

它以从容而沉稳的步伐绕着房间踱行。骨与骨相叩的轻响——咔、咔、咔——在室内回荡，它不紧不慢地敲着自己的腕骨，仿佛只是在等待。它周身散出一种超越时光的静滞感，像是已用这种姿态等了千年万载，也会为了那完美的一刻永远等下去。一袭深翠绿的斗篷拖曳在地，扫起铺了无数年的尘埃。它缓缓张开的嘴里逸出一声悠长的嘶嘶，露出无牙龈包裹的牙齿。下一瞬，它猛地一拧转向你——燃烧的双眼泼洒出残忍的光，掠过它粗糙腐烂的面孔与裸露的骨骼，将一切都染成令人作呕的病绿。 With calm, poised strides it circles the room. The soft clack, clack, clack of bone-on-bone echoes through the room, as it taps its wrist, seemingly waiting. A sense of timelessness emanates around it, as if it had been waiting this way for millennia and would wait forever for the perfect moment. A cloak of deep emerald drags on the floor behind it, disturbing dust that had lined the floor for countless years. A long slow hiss escapes its slowly parting mouth, revealing gumless teeth. With a sharp jerk it turns towards you, its flaming eyes wash a cruel light over its rough, decomposing face and exposed bone, painting it a sickly green.

这座剧院像一枚带齿的轮盘，排练室与授课室以精确的间距从轮缘上突起。事实上，演出时，观众席会绕着坚硬的木质舞台缓缓旋转。遇上晴好——或经魔法改造的——天气，剧院便显露为塔楼的屋顶，像舱盖般向天空开启，化作一座露天圆形剧场。
The theater is like a wheel with cogs, the practice and teaching rooms sticking off of it at precise intervals. In fact, during performances the seating slowly revolves around the hardwood stage. In fine—or magically altered—weather, the theater appears to be the tower roof and opens like a hatch to the sky, becoming an amphitheater.

它们疏离地伫立着，常常单脚踩在细长如杖的腿上，火烈鸟的浮华风姿盈满了整片泻湖。它们抖动羽毛，明艳的粉色张扬宣告着这些生灵被喂养得何等健壮丰腴。鸣叫声喧闹刺耳，彼此呼唤，或是驱退来犯的对手。仿佛同为一体，鸟群优雅地将滑稽的脑袋齐齐探入浅水，水面被贪婪的喙搅得翻涌，只为寻觅虾群。片刻之后，它们抬起头来，再度傲慢而自得地挺立着。
Standing aloof, oft atop a single spindly leg, the flamboyance of flamingos fills the lagoon. They rustle their plumage, the vibrant shade of pink declaring how robustly well-fed these creatures are. Their cries are raucous, calling to each other or warning off a rival. Seemingly as one, the flock elegantly thrust their comical heads into the shallow water, which churns with greedy beaks seeking shrimp. Moments later, they rise, standing disdainfully proud once more.

Abandoned Space Station: Control Center.name:
废弃空间站：控制中心被擅自占据者接管
Abandoned Space Station: Control Center Taken Over By Squatters

Text.text:
肮脏的床垫和垃圾散落在这座昔日控制中心狭窄的空间里，居住的痕迹已蔓延至整艘废弃的船只——占屋者们在此划地为营。衣物挂在头顶栈桥之间的临时晾衣绳上，烹煮食物的气味为循环的空气添上辛辣的底色。
Dirty mattresses and refuse litter the cramped space of the former control center, the trappings of habitation having spread through the abandoned vessel as squatters staked their claims. Clothes hang on makeshift washing lines between the overhead gantries, and the smell of cooking food seasons the recycled air.

I Cast Plane Shift.name:
我施放了【位面转移】
I Cast Plane Shift

Text.text:
双手紧紧相扣，我清晰而自信地宣告自己的目的地。视野上掠过一阵微光，仿佛热浪翻涌；随即空间顺从我的意志扭曲折叠，如同书页两端合拢，覆住我的视界。黑暗中，我的胃猛地一沉，身体被拽得上下翻转、左右甩荡——直到一道明亮光照从目的地朦胧的剪影后迸射而出。法术将我猛地抛向那光，我只能祈愿神祇垂怜，把我丢到一处安全而坚实的落点。
Hands clasped tightly, I announce my destination with clarity and confidence. A shimmer passes over my sight, like a wave of heat, then space bends to my will, closing like the two covers of a book over my field of vision. In the darkness, my stomach lurches as I am wrenched downward, upward, left and right—until a bright light shines out from behind the vague silhouette of my destination. The spell flings me toward it, and I hope the gods see fit to plop me somewhere safe and solid.

一声低沉的咆哮撕裂你的喉间，你周遭的空气因嬗变能量而翻涌沸腾。你双眼燃起憎恨的火光，将一枚辣椒高举过头顶。你扭曲的唇间倾泻出号令般的咒言，随即以发光的手掌猛拍胸口。你的嘴巴不可能地张得极开，口中凝聚起一道元素般的辉光。
A guttural roar rips from your throat, the air about you seething with transmuting energies. Your eyes flare with hate as you raise a pepper above your head. Commanding words spill from your twisting lips and you slap a glowing hand upon your chest. Your mouth yawns impossibly wide, an elemental glow forming within.

Pterosaurs In Flight.name:
翼龙凌空飞翔
Pterosaurs In Flight

Text.text:
在炽烈的太阳映衬下，它们的身影化作剪影，双翼大张，翼龙散发出一种原始的威严，几乎无人能望其项背。一声刺耳长啸宣告俯冲的开始——它们如坠星般扑向悬崖下起伏的海浪，锐利的目光穿透水面，以毫厘不差的精准锁定水下游鱼。
Silhouetted against the blazing sun, wings spread wide, the pterosaurs evoke a primal majesty few can hope to match. A piercing cry signals their descent, plummeting toward the undulating waves below the cliff as keen eyes pick out a fish beneath the surface with unerring accuracy.

台阶向下通往一间昏暗潮湿的石室，霉味与泥土气息扑鼻而来。墓室呈T字形：一条中央走廊被两处宽阔的壁龛横向截断，壁龛两侧墙面嵌着一具具棺椁，整齐排布。走廊旁立着几尊雕像，曾经天使般的轮廓如今已被年代磨蚀，面容扭曲得近乎狰狞。你几乎来不及让视线适应，便听见拖拽脚步的刮擦声，瞥见一道影子从墙面剥离——一具人形的身影。你绷紧神经，一声低沉的呻吟在黑暗中回荡。
The stairs lead down into a dim, dank stone chamber that smells of mildew and earth. The crypt is t-shaped, with a central corridor bisected by two wide alcoves, each lined with coffins set into the walls. Statues, once angelic in appearance, flank the corridor, their faces worn with age and made monstrous. You barely have a moment for your eyes to adjust before you hear the scrape of a dragging foot, and catch sight of a shadow separating from the wall—a humanoid figure. You tense as a groan reverberates through the darkness.

七个人围坐在一张与之相配的圆桌旁，桌子大小恰好容得下所有人，人人坐在雕工繁复的木凳上。桌心立着三支白蜡烛，成为唯一的光源。众人围成一圈，闭着眼，手与手相握。一位年长的女子向幽灵低语，邀请它们加入这场集会。她的咒语声起，烛焰猛然窜高。
Seven people sit on richly carved stools around a matching circular table just big enough for them all. Three white candles stand at the table’s center, providing the only light. Around it, the participants hold hands with their eyes closed. An older woman speaks to the spirits, asking them to join the gathering. As she intones, the candles flare.

Alien Crop Harvest.name:
异星作物收割
Alien Crop Harvest

Text.text:
一台巨型联合收割机在无垠的淡蓝作物田里轰隆前行，机身上装着宛如断头台般的刀刃。它一边收割一边发出刺耳的尖啸，吐出一条条厚实的植被长带，弹跳翻滚，质感像抖动的橡胶碎块。
A massive combine with blades like guillotines chugs along the vast field of pale blue crops. The heavy-duty machine squeals as it harvests, producing thick strips of vegetation that bounce, their texture like jiggling bits of rubber.

Headstone: “Stone” In Winter.name:
墓碑：「冬之石」
Headstone: “Stone” In Winter

Text.text: 即便隔着积雪的掩蔽，这座坟也显得异乎寻常地狭长，仿佛埋在土丘下的人高如食人魔。墓碑上镌刻的墓志铭写道：磐石或成尘，沧海或干涸，但只要群星仍在闪耀，她便不会被遗忘。 Even through the snow cover this grave seems abnormally long, as if whoever was buried beneath the mound was as tall as an ogre. The epitaph engraved in in the tombstone reads: Stone might turn to dust, oceans might dry, but so long as stars shine, she will be remembered.

Dragon's Breath (Fire) Cast On Ally.name:
龙息（火焰）施放于盟友
Dragon's Breath (Fire) Cast On Ally

Text.text:
你嘶嘶吐出龙语的齿音，随即一口咬下那枚火辣的辣椒。它的外皮与籽在你唇上灼烧翻腾时，你抬手重重拍在盟友背上，将那股热辣的魔法回响一并传了过去。盟友挺直身子，深吸一口气，试探性地鼓起腮帮，喷出一缕炽灼如刀的烈焰。

~ Played by Donnie

You hiss draconic sibilants, then bite into the hot pepper. As its skin and seeds burn against your lips, you clap your ally on the back, transferring a magical echo of that heat. Your ally draws themselves upright, takes a breath, and puffs out an experimental flash of searing flame.

~ Played by Donnie

Mountain Pass: A Chill Wind.name:
山口隘道：寒风凛冽
Mountain Pass: A Chill Wind

Text.text:
你没有察觉到天气的变化，也许是因为你攀得更高了；但此刻狂风撕扯着你的衣袍，在你耳畔尖啸。风势主要从你前方扑来，却又有阵阵气流从不同方向轮番撞击——几乎像是这高处的空气正竭力把你逼回山下。
You didn’t notice the weather change, so perhaps it is because you gained elevation, but the wind now rips at your clothes and whistles in your ears. It comes largely from ahead of you, but breezes buffet you in different directions—almost as if the air up here is trying to force you back down the mountain.

Speech About Dreams.name:
关于梦的演讲
Speech About Dreams

Text.text:
“我常常想就此滑入永恒的长眠。清醒之时，渺小无足轻重的幽影压在我头顶。我被这世界不可计量的运转与算计所纠缠，也被自己在其中短暂时代的无力所折磨。可在梦里，我所见的一切皆由我亲手构筑——而这不知为何，竟更令人胆寒。”
“I have often considered slipping into an eternal sleep. In my waking hours, the specter of insignificance looms over me. I’m haunted by the immeasurable machinations of the world and the impotence of my short time in it. But in my dreams, every piece of what I see is of my own construction, and that is somehow even more terrifying.”

这台巨型投石机以巨人的骨骸、猛犸的长牙，以及无数敌人的血肉与筋腱精心拼铸，巍然矗立在山丘之上，宛如一尊有机的泰坦。兽人炮手们小心翼翼地拉拽、敲击、拖拽——为让他们的神祇再度开火而忙碌——汗水淋漓的肌肤泛着油亮，狂热的双眼在迷狂的快感中熊熊燃烧。
Crafted from giant bones, mammoth tusks, and the flesh and sinew of myriad foes, the colossal trebuchet stands upon the hill like an organic titan. Orcish artillerists tenderly tug, hammer, and haul—preparing their god to fire again—laboring with sweat-slick skin, fanatical eyes blazing with ecstasy.

I Cast Instant Summons.name:
我施放「瞬间召唤」
I Cast Instant Summons

Text.text:
凝视着眼前璀璨的蓝宝石，我吟诵咒文，将物体与宝石紧紧缚在一起。我双手起舞，如奥术的繁复步法般严谨专注，凝聚那回响的魔法；我看见仪式材料上文字短暂燃起光芒——旋即如将熄的余烬般黯然消散，归于虚无。
Gazing into the brilliant sapphire before me, I recite the incantation to bind the object and the gem together. I wave my hands in a complex dance of arcane discipline and focus the resonant magic, watching as words briefly flare to life on the ritual components—and fade to nothing like dying embers.

本应宽敞得令人心生余裕的空间，如今却像一座陵寝：一排又一排的病床无穷无尽，紧挨着挤在一起。每张床上的病人都被皮革束带牢牢捆住，静得可怕，让人几乎分不清他们究竟还活着，还是仅是徒具形貌的假人。他们的皮肤薄得近乎透明，脆弱的血管清晰可见，更衬得他们像大理石雕像般冰冷僵硬。玻璃瓶悬浮在空中，里面粘稠的液体缓慢流动，经由蜿蜒的管子一路向下，如同一张繁复的网，深入到下方那些瘫痪的躯体之中。
What would have been a generously roomy space instead feels like a mausoleum, with row upon endless row of beds pressed close together. Restrained by leather straps, the patients in each bed are so still it is hard to ascertain whether they are alive or mere effigies. Their skin is so thin, the frail veins reinforce their likeness to marble statues. Glass bottles hover in the air, the viscous liquid within flowing slowly through tubes that snake their way down in an intricate web into the paralyzed bodies below.

护甲那沉重的甲片每一次挪动都仿佛在低吟，金属以完美的共鸣回响叮当。深色金属——近乎黑色的林地墨绿——构成了护甲的主体，皮革系带与黄铜搭扣将其牢牢束缚，钢铆钉进一步加固。金属以一种古怪而摇曳的方式捕住光线，虹彩在其表面跃动，宛如阳光穿过薄雾细雨。你意识到：这是精金——世上最坚硬、最耐久的物质，被锻造成一套不可摧毁的护甲。
The armor seems to hum with each shift of its heavy plates, the metal ringing with perfect resonance. Dark metal, a forest green bordering on black, makes up the bulk of the armor, lashed with leather straps and brass buckles, and reinforced with steel rivets. The metal catches the light in an odd, wavering way, a rainbow dancing across its surface like sunlight through a misty rain. It’s adamantine, you realize—the hardest, most resilient substance in existence, forged into a suit of indestructible armor.

单独一声呱叫并不会对你造成任何实质影响，但附近那支青蛙大军无休无止的合唱却足以把你逼到抓狂。仿佛察觉到你的烦躁，几只青蛙扑通扑进水里——不过它们更可能是在搜寻一顿不慎掠过的飞虫大餐。
A single croak would not affect you in any meaningful way, but the endless chorus of croaking coming from the army of frogs nearby drives you to distraction. As if sensing your annoyance, several splash into the water, though they are more probably in search of an unwary meal on the wing.

光芒在海洋摇曳的洋流中掠过海龟金灿灿的甲壳，闪烁流转。它如彗星般划破海湾碧蓝的水域，在起伏摇荡的海藻间穿梭，展开一场轻盈而华美的舞蹈。

~ David 于 Discord

The light shimmers across the turtle's golden shell in the swaying currents of the ocean. It streaks like a comet through the aquamarine waters of the bay, weaving between undulating strands of kelp in a weightless, resplendent dance.

~ David on Discord

Skyship Main Mast.name:
飞空艇主桅
Skyship Main Mast

Text.text:
一块沉重的铁板以粗大的螺栓牢牢压住，支撑着巨桅高高耸立，凌驾于船体之上。此刻巨大的帆布仍被收拢，它们投下的阴影却已如沉睡的巨龙般笼罩甲板，静候再次舒展雄浑的翼幕，乘风腾起。你将手按在那深色、打磨得发亮的木材上，试探其坚韧，只觉它的沉稳与厚实令人安心。
A heavy iron plate, held down by thick bolts, keeps the enormous mast upright as it towers over the ship. The shadows of huge canvas sails, currently packed, loom over the deck like sleeping dragons, waiting to unfurl their mighty wings and take flight once more. The dark, polished wood has a reassuring solidity as you place a hand upon it, testing its strength.

High Seas Battle: Ship Ahoy!.name:
公海之战：船只来袭！
High Seas Battle: Ship Ahoy!

Text.text:
上方传来一声呼喊，你顺着指示的方向望去，理所当然还什么都看不见。桅顶瞭望台上的水手能越过你的地平线先一步看见。但仅仅片刻之后，你也捕捉到了：在天海相接之处，有一小点颜色的污迹。那轮廓渐渐凝实成船与帆——是另一艘船，而且正向你们逼近。
A call comes from above, and you look in the direction indicated, but of course see nothing yet. The sailor in the crow’s nest can see over your horizon. But in just a few moments you spot it: a tiny blot of color where the sky meets the sea. The shape gradually materializes into ship and sails. It’s another vessel, and it’s closing in.

Alarion Windrider.name:
阿拉里昂·风驰者
Alarion Windrider

Text.text:
翅翼在肆虐狂风的尖厉啸声中嗡鸣，一道身影在空中疾掠而过，随即落地，却出奇地轻柔，落势只扬起一缕无声的尘烟。他天蓝色的皮肤与如云般翻涌拖曳的长发，昭示着他是风裔之血。他身形精悍，是名战士，披着褪色的铆钉皮甲，腰侧悬着两柄纤长的短剑。他那冷峻的暴风灰眼眸周围刻着细纹，诉说着他的年代——无数战斗的目睹与胜利。待他收拢翅翼，你才看清那翅薄如蕾丝、半透明，宛如蜻蜓之翼。光里，它们的色泽流转：从与他肤色相映的清冷湛蓝，渐至暮色紫罗兰，再到无云之夜月光般炽亮的银白。

~ Played by Max_Slacker

Wings whirring with the shrill whistle of a rampant wind, a figure zips through the air then lands with unexpected softness, his impact a whisper of rising dust. His sky-blue skin and billowing train of cloudlike hair mark him as wind-blooded. He is a warrior of lithe build, wearing faded studded leathers and bearing two slender shortswords at his sides. Lines around his stoic, storm-gray eyes tell a story of his age, of many battles seen and won. His wings still, and you see they are lacy and translucent, like a dragonfly’s. In the light, they shift in color from a blue that matches the cool hue of his skin, to a twilight purple, to the blazing silver of the moon on a cloudless night.

~ Played by Max_Slacker

Loot From A Banshee.name:
女妖的战利品
Loot From A Banshee

Text.text:
被斩杀的女妖只剩下一堆虚无缥缈的尘埃，以及一个金线锦囊。你解开锦囊的抽绳，将手触及囊内，发现一尊小巧的玉雕精灵女子像，以及一枚金质坠饰，里面嵌着一幅俊美精灵男子的肖像。
Of the slain banshee, only a pile of ethereal dust and a cloth-of-gold pouch remain. Unknotting the drawstrings of the pouch, you reach inside and discover a small jade statuette of an elven woman, and a gold locket containing the portrait of a handsome elven man.

这位瘦削的半精灵穿着最新款的时装，显然迫不及待想回到他们最爱流连的沙龙里闲坐；而他们对自己钟爱的谈资也毫不掩饰。话才出口不到二十来个字，他们就已经提起谁和谁上了床、宫廷里正流传着哪些丑闻、又是谁家的生意在走下坡路。每当打听到几条劲爆的内幕，他们便忍不住抬手掩口，咯咯窃笑。
Dressed in the latest fashions and no doubt itching to return to the salons they prefer to lounge about in, the waifish half-elf makes no bones about their favorite subjects. Scarcely two dozen words out of their mouth and they have already brought up who is sleeping with who, what sorts of scandal are being discussed in court, and whose businesses are failing. Upon finding out some juicy tidbits, they cannot help but titter behind their raised hand.

Gas-fired Injector System.name:
燃气喷射注入系统
Gas-fired Injector System

Text.text:
这件纤细的金属装置握在手里几乎没有重量，末端是一枚锋利而精准的尖端，专为精细的刺入而生。外壳上嵌着一只可再填充的气体钢瓶——显然，这根针借由加压气体的推力，旨在穿透硬化的皮肤。针身旁一束微型目标激光使这件工具得以以无与伦比的精度扫描并解析其目标。
This slender metallic device, feeling almost weightless in the hand, has a sharp and precise tip intended for delicate insertion. The housing bears a gas cylinder that can be refilled—clearly, this needle, with the added pressure of gas, is designed to bypass hardened skin. A small targeting laser beside the needle allows the tool to scan and analyze its target with unparalleled accuracy.

Loot From A Pursuant Minion Cleanser.name:
追随者爪牙清道夫的战利品
Loot From A Pursuant Minion Cleanser

Text.text:
枪在他的尸身旁幽光闪烁，一长串子弹以斜挎弹带的方式紧束在他胸前。无论这把武器看上去多么凶戾沉重，你都可以将它据为己有——为你的魔法火力再添几分猛劲。
The gun gleams beside his corpse, and a ream of bullets is strapped across his chest in a bandolier style. As menacing and weighty as the weapon might be, you may claim it—and add a bit of firepower to your magical artillery.

Barkeep Reading.name:
酒馆老板的察言观色
Barkeep Reading

Text.text:
趁着擦拭吧台的间隙——身旁还放着一大壶烈酒——这位欢快的酒保一手捧书，一手攥着湿抹布，在酒馆昏暗的光线里眯起眼细读。
During a lull from wiping down the bar—and with a jug of alcohol next to him—the happy barkeep holds a book in one hand and a wet rag in the other. He squints to read in the bar’s low light.

Targeted By Greater Restoration.name:
被高等复原术指定为目标
Targeted By Greater Restoration

Text.text:
她取来一只盛着闪烁粉尘的小碗，放在你身旁，随即将双手探入其中。她捧起一把粉尘贴近唇边，低声呢喃柔和而安抚的字句。她在你头顶上方张开双手，任由钻石粉尘如瀑倾落，空气中微光流转——触感却像一阵冰冷的细雨。
She retrieves a small bowl of glittering dust and places it beside you, then dips her hands into it. Pulling the handful of dust close to her lips, she whispers soft, soothing words. She opens her hands above your head and allows the diamond dust to cascade down, a glimmer in the air—that feels like a cold drizzle.

它们起初悄无声息——沉甸甸的小身躯、扭动的尾巴在洞穴地面上窸窣乱蹭。随即一群聚拢成团，短暂撕扯翻搅。又一群结成团。地面中央，数团鼠群汇聚，互相啃咬厮斗——尖叫着、蹦跳着——接着彼此压叠成堆。更多鼠群涌来，堆砌出一座诡异的金字塔，高得令人心里发虚。某种像是由老鼠拼合而成的踉跄独体，翻滚着无数小眼与尾巴，缓缓爬向前方。
They start quietly, heavy little bodies and squirming tails scuffling around on the cave floor. Then a pack forms and wrangles for a moment. Another pack forms. In the center of the floor several packs converge, nip and fight—squealing and jumping—then pile onto each other. More packs join, forming a bizarre pyramid, dubiously high. Something like a shambling singular being made of rats, roiling with little eyes and tails, crawls forward.

第一阵整齐划一的靴声踏上大道，广场上的人群立刻自发散开，贴到两侧排成长龙。街面尚未彻底清出，第一声号角便已炸响——黄铜般的嘹亮穿透空气，像利斧劈入松软的白松木，干脆而锐利。展开的旗帜由步卒高举，鼓胀翻卷，飘在一辆车前；拉车的竟不少于六头巨兽。车厢做工精致，窗帘紧闭，只在一条窄缝间留出窥视的余地，让那位身份显赫的人物得以暗中衡量这群乌合之众的反应。
At the first sounds of boots hitting the road in lockstep, the crowds of people immediately move to line the sides of the plaza. Before the street is fully cleared, the first horns ring out, their brassy trumpeting splitting the air like a sharp axe blade through soft pine. Unfurled banners, held by footmen, billow in the air just ahead of a carriage pulled by no less than six beasts. The carriage is finely made, the window shades drawn but for a narrow crack through which whatever important personage can gauge the reactions of the hoi polloi.

一名苍白的提夫林用带爪的双手握着一柄闷燃的断戟，弯曲刃缘迸溅出点点余烬。她臂膀肌肉起伏，沿着手臂向下翻涌，衬在无瑕而微微泛红的皮肤之下。两根角自宽阔的额脊扭曲探出，粗粝破损，角质间闪烁着细碎的亮点。她把深棕色的波浪短发剪得凌乱纠结，脸上似乎扑了胭脂般的妆粉，将那本就偏红的肤色衬得更醒目。她的嘴角扬起一抹张狂的笑——露出一口齐整笔直的炭灰色牙齿——同时收紧对断戟的握持。

~ 扮演：DaFrozenFury，使用

A pale tiefling holds a smoldering half-halberd in clawed hands, embers springing off the edge of the curved blade. Muscles ripple down her arms, under skin flawless and flushed. Two horns twist out of her broad brow, rough and ragged with glittering motes throughout. She wears her waves of dark brown hair short and tangled, and her face seems rouged with cosmetic powder to highlight the already reddish tones. Her lips break into a cocky smile—revealing perfectly straight charcoal-gray teeth—as she tightens her grip on the halberd.

~ Played by DaFrozenFury with

Insult From A Disdainful Holy Warrior.name:
来自傲慢圣战士的辱骂
Insult From A Disdainful Holy Warrior

Text.text:
“我曾触及诸天之光，引下神明的裁决，可再多的神圣干预，也修不好你身上那股毛病。”
“I have touched the light of the heavens and brought down the judgment of a god, but there is no amount of divine intervention that can fix what’s wrong with you.”

Speech By A Worn-down Adventurer.name:
一名疲惫不堪的冒险者的演说
Speech By A Worn-down Adventurer

Text.text:
“我们如今还算是在帮人吗？真的在拨乱反正、纠正这世上的不公吗？还是说，我们不过是在把那些怪物一通猛揍，直到金币从它们身上哗啦啦掉出来？朋友们，我开始厌倦这场战斗了。我也开始怀疑，究竟有没有什么事业值得我们为之杀戮。我们流了太多血，可我觉得，我们学到的却少得可怜。”
“Are we even helping people anymore? Truly righting the wrongs of this world? Or are we simply bashing away at creatures until gold falls out? I am growing tired of this fight, my friends. I have begun to wonder if any cause is worth killing for at all. We have bled much, but I feel we have learned very little.”

巨型蘑菇怪异的形态与色泽早已司空见惯，因此当你身旁的一株菌菇忽然泛起紫色潮红时，你一时不知该作何反应。脚下的地面骤然撕裂，根须破土而出，像蓄势待发的毒蛇般盘绕升起，将那株颤动的紫罗兰色伞菌团团围住。刺鼻的死亡恶臭从它的触须与被翻搅的泥土中一并涌来。
The strange shapes and hues of the giant mushrooms have become familiar, so when a nearby fungus blushes purple, you’re not sure how to react. Roots rip from the ground beneath your feet and rise up around the quivering violet toadstool like serpents ready to strike. A pungent reek of death comes from its tendrils and the disturbed soil.

Egwene's Elixirs.name:
伊雯妮的灵药
Egwene's Elixirs

Text.text:
你一踏进店里，浓烈的药草气息裹挟着花香四溢的精油与药剂，猛地扑上鼻端，几乎令人窒息。你的思绪在相互冲撞的味道间艰难梳理，同时目光掠过货架上一排排灵药、补剂与酊剂。店主开口了——一位个子矮小的女人，金发已渐染霜色，绿眸清亮，声音柔和低缓。
As you enter the shop, the smell of potent herbs, combined with the flowery scents of oils and potions, is an assault on your nose. Your mind tries to sift through the contrasting odors as you view the elixirs, tonics, and tinctures on the shelves. The shopkeeper, a short woman with blond hair—starting to gray—and green eyes, speaks in a soft voice.

这个法术的材料成分既是催化剂，也是导管。你摊开手掌，低声诵念咒文。钻石的结构如同骨架般支撑着自身，折叠成一枚坚硬的多面体，轻轻悬浮在你的掌心之上。随着法术成形，那份坚硬渐渐变得圆润光滑，层层压缩，化作一颗旋转的玻璃球体。接下来只需将你所选择的元素灌注进这枚宝珠，便可将其释放，轰向那些胆敢试探你奥术能力之人。
The material component of this spell acts as both catalyst and conduit. You hold open your palm, reciting the incantation. The diamond's structural make-up acts as a scaffold, forming into a rigid polyhedron and gently hovering above your hand. That rigidness becomes smooth as the spell takes shape, compressing into a sphere of glass that rotates. All that's left is to imbue the orb with an element of your choosing and unleash it upon those who would dare test your arcane ability.

Insult About A Prideful Paladin.name:
对傲慢圣武士的侮辱
Insult About A Prideful Paladin

Text.text:
“统治你内心的不是正义，而是傲慢。我想，只要你以为人们会转而崇拜你，你甚至会杀死你所侍奉的神祇。”
“It is not righteousness but rather pride that rules your heart. I think you would kill the gods you serve if you thought people would worship you instead.”

Quip About An Offering To A Dragon.name:
对献给巨龙的贡品的俏皮话
Quip About An Offering To A Dragon

Text.text:
“神祇啊，真疼。或许我们低估了你，强大的野兽。不如我们送你一位更小的伙伴，就此两清？”
“Gods, that hurt. Perhaps we misjudged you, mighty beast. How about we give you one of our smaller companions and call it even?”

Widow Mary’s Apothecary.name:
寡妇玛丽的药剂铺
Widow Mary’s Apothecary

Text.text:
在这栋不甚宽敞的住宅门廊上，你看见一位年迈的半兽人女子正将门前的尘土扫开。她对每个路过的人都报以友善的微笑——那份问候因她银箍包覆的獠牙而更显耀眼。门上方悬着一块招牌，上面绘着一只冒着泡的药剂瓶与一枝草药。沿着一条细窄的土路绕到屋后，便是一方小小的花园：草药的茎秆拔地而起，叶片繁茂，色彩鲜亮。
Upon the porch of this modestly sized home, you see an aged half-orc woman sweeping away the dust from her door. She offers a friendly smile to anyone who walks by, a greeting made more dazzling by her silver-capped tusks. A sign hangs above her door, a bubbling potion bottle and a sprig of herb painted onto it. A thin dirt path leads around her home to a small garden where stalks of herbs shoot up, burgeoning with leaves and vibrant color.

I Cast Hold Monster From My Staff Of Pow.name:
我从权杖之力中施放「怪物定身术」
I Cast Hold Monster From My Staff Of Power

Text.text:
我与那生物目光相锁，举起法杖作出支配的手势，直指向它。符文沿着杖身迸溢出朦胧的紫光，目标周围的空气随之震颤，魔法绷紧，竭力将它钉在原地。
Locking eyes with the creature, I raise my staff in a gesture of domination and point at them. Nebulous purple light spills from the runes along its haft, and the air around my target vibrates as the magic strains to hold them in place.

凹洞里熏黑的内壁与一堆灰烬看起来像一处墓穴，石砌结构带来的更多是森然压迫，而非温暖迎接。但壁炉台上，铁柴架仍立在架上，铁制柴篮底部还留着几片木屑。砌石的形制本身就在呼唤光与热。
The blackened lining and pile of ash in the hollow look like a grave site, the stone more forbidding than welcoming. But andirons still stand in a rack on the hearth, and chips of wood sit in the bottom of the iron cradle. The very shape of the masonry calls for light and heat.

Quip About Fighting Technique.name:
关于战斗技巧的俏皮话
Quip About Fighting Technique

Text.text:
“战斗有千百种。我见过一些士兵，把一辈子都耗在钻研每一种技法、每一个微末细节上。但真到了血与火的关头，招式其实没那么重要。对我而言，只要你还能活着走出来，那就说明你已经懂了。”
“There are many ways to fight. I’ve known soldiers who spend their whole lives studying every technique and every tiny detail. But method is of little importance when it comes to violence. As far as I’m concerned, if you emerge alive you’ve figured it out.”

Quip About Crass Party Member.name:
对粗俗队友的吐槽
Quip About Crass Party Member

Text.text:
“你知道我最欣赏你什么吗？大多数人都把自己累得够呛，生怕说错一句话，或是踩破什么不成文的礼数。可你不一样。你任由一切从口中滚落，带着那种原始洪荒般的鲜活与壮丽。”
“You know what I admire about you? Most people exhaust themselves worrying about saying the wrong thing or breaching some unspoken etiquette. But not you. You let everything tumble out of your mouth in all its primordial glory.”

有些命运，比在刽子手血淋淋的刀锋下，或怪物的利爪中丧命更为凄惨。地牢深坑便是其中之一。那非人道般狭窄逼仄的牢狱竖井一路下沉，坠入无底的黑暗深渊——囚徒在此被遗忘，被丢弃，直至死去。潮湿的墙壁向里挤压，逼得人几乎喘不过气。他们唯一的陪伴，是水滴永不停歇、令人发狂的滴答声——以及脚下老鼠窸窣奔窜的动静。
There are some fates worse than a bloody death beneath an executioner's blade or the claws of a monster. The oubliette is one such fate. The inhumanely small, narrow dungeon shaft descends into an abyssal darkness where prisoners are forgotten and left to die. The damp walls press in around the occupants. Their only company is the constant, maddening drip of water—and the scurrying of the rats beneath their feet.

Remains Of A Human Battle.name:
人类战斗的残骸
Remains Of A Human Battle

Text.text:
战事已经推进，但它的许多士兵却再也没能离开。你一靠近，愤怒的乌鸦便聒噪着呱呱乱叫，扑棱棱振翅飞起，叼着它们从遍地尸骸中硬生生夺来的零星残肢碎肉，盘旋升空。除了乌鸦，这片血腥的景象静得瘆人。若曾有伤者，也必定被人拖走了……或被敌手就地噤声。
The battle moved on, but many of its soldiers did not. Indignant crows caw and flap away at your approach, carrying aloft whatever grisly bit they could wrest from the many corpses strewn about the ground. Besides the crows, the bloody scene is eerily quiet. If there were wounded, they must have been carried away… or silenced by their foes.

一条紫罗兰色丝绸斜挂带，与同材质的宽松长裤，在这名体格矫健的猫族乌亮黑毛间格外醒目；他那一双金色眼眸亦同样夺目。他的靴子与护腕皆为光滑的深色皮革。举止漫不经心，一手拇指随意勾在腰间的红色束带里；另一手则懒散地拨弄着系在斜挂带上的念珠。

~ Played by a Hero

A baldric of violet silk, and loose pants of the same material, stand out against this athletically built catfolk’s glossy black fur. So do his golden eyes. His boots and wristbands are smooth, dark leather. He has a nonchalant manner, one hand’s thumb tucked into the red sash around his waist. With the other hand, he casually handles the prayer beads attached to his baldric.

~ Played by a Hero

Family-themed Chain Restaurant.name:
家庭主题连锁餐厅
Family-themed Chain Restaurant

Text.text:
这地方的每个人都快乐得过了头。员工们挂着涂出来的笑脸，令人烦躁的高昂音乐每隔几分钟就循环响起。餐厅里色彩喧嚣成灾：黄、红、蓝刺眼得无处不在，从制服到装饰，渗透在店里的每一个角落。预包装油炸食品的气味像幽灵般盘踞在油腻的空气里，让这场感官轰炸更添一层压迫感。
Everyone is entirely too happy in this place. The staff wear painted smiles, and irritatingly upbeat music plays on a loop every few minutes. The restaurant is a riot of color: yellow, red, and blue glaringly omnipresent in every facet of the establishment, from the uniforms to the decor. The smell of pre-packaged fried food lingers like a specter in the greasy air, adding to the sensory assault of the place.

Code Crackers In The Net.name:
网络中的破译者
Code Crackers In The Net

Text.text:
他们头戴黑貂之冠，在赛博阴影中潜行，是神秘的代码破译者。匿名者的面容被薄纱遮蔽——纵身越过数字绝壁，踏入以太的晦秘之舞。他们的敲击声与正义的和弦同频，劈开加密的织网，以机智与代码为复仇之刃。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

They wear a sable crown, stalkers in cyber shadow, enigmatic crackers of code. Theirs is the veiled visage of the anonymous—a leap over the digital precipice, a cryptic dance into the ether. Their keystrokes harmonize justice’s concord, cleaving through the encrypted weave and wielding wit and code as weapons of retribution.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Sundries From A Mummy.name:
木乃伊的零碎杂物
Sundries From A Mummy

Text.text:
生前，此人不过勉强算得上是个够格被制成木乃伊（特征）的小人物。如今它的防腐之力正逐渐衰退，腐朽崩解，化作一碰即碎的脆尘。木乃伊（特征）左手仍紧攥着一枚钥匙环，上面挂着三把毫不起眼的钥匙。
In life, this person was barely prominent enough a figure to have been mummified. Its preservative qualities are on the decline, decaying into brittle dust. The mummy does carry three nondescript keys on a ring, held in its left hand.

Cyclops In Service Of The Fomori.name:
侍奉弗莫尔的独眼巨人
Cyclops In Service Of The Fomori

Text.text:
独眼巨人左肩烙着一枚印记——一枚弗莫里安符号，将他本族的文字与幽暗语的字符拼合在一起。他阴郁、倦怠，握着木棒的架势像个欠债受奴役的人。粗糙的皮革缠身松散潦草地系着，他眯眼望向前方，似在盘算下一步该怎么做。他把木棒沉重的棒头在地上咚咚敲了几下。
The one-eyed giant wears a brand on his left shoulder, a fomorian symbol combining characters from his language and undercommon. He is sullen, bored, and wielding his club in the manner of someone in debt and enslaved. His basic leather wraps are poorly tied, and he squints forward, contemplating, it seems, the best action to take. He taps the heavy head of his club on the ground a few times.

Nanovirus-ravaged Cybernetics Plague.name:
纳米病毒肆虐的义体瘟疫
Nanovirus-ravaged Cybernetics Plague

Text.text:
在这座大都会的心脏地带，纳米病毒以最凶猛的方式掀起浩劫——它先潜入受害者的义体植入物之中。尖叫声在街巷间回荡，感染者痛苦翻滚，躯体痉挛抽搐，垃圾代码自内而外啃噬着他们。紧急服务蜂拥而至，试图封锁疫情，却为时已晚——病毒早已扩散——而今，熵乱君临。
In the heart of the metropolis, the Nanovirus began its rampage by infiltrating the cybernetic implants of its victims. Screams echo through the streets as the infected writhe in agony, their bodies convulsing as the junk code consumes them from within. Emergency services rushed to contain the outbreak, but too late—the virus has already spread—and now entropy reigns.

I Put On My Ring Of Warmth.name:
我戴上了我的温暖戒指
I Put On My Ring Of Warmth

Text.text:
我把木戒套上手指，内侧那圈细软的毛绒立刻贴上来，给我冰冷酸痛的手带来一丝慰藉。仿佛一件沉甸甸的大衣覆落在身上，披过肩头，贴紧我颤抖的膝盖。又像一双羊毛袜忽然滑上脚掌，柔软地裹住脚趾。更有一圈温热的能量如毛边衣领般悬绕在颈间，让我不至于牙关打颤。
I slide the wooden ring onto my finger, its thin tuft of fur lining immediately offering a bit of comfort to my chilled and aching hand. A weight like a heavy coat falls over my body, draping my shoulders and hugging close to my knocking knees. It feels as though a pair of woolen socks have suddenly slid over my feet, nestling around my toes. A wreath of warm energy hangs about my neck like a fur-lined collar, keeping my teeth from chattering.

Sundries From Animated Armor.name:
来自活化护甲的杂物
Sundries From Animated Armor

Text.text:
那具被魔力驱动的护甲已然崩塌，曾经鬼魅般的铿锵声也随之沉寂。每一块板甲碎片都在搏杀中损毁得不成样子，早已无法再派上用场，但铁匠或许会珍惜这些可回炉的废金属。
The animated suit of armor has collapsed, its haunted clanging silenced. The individual pieces of plate are far too damaged from the struggle to be of any use, but a smith might appreciate the scrap metal.

Word Of Radiance.name:
光辉之言
Word Of Radiance

Text.text:
一句带着骄傲威权的宣言自施法者的喉间翻涌而上，冲口而出。随着这句话扩散开去，一股灿然的辐光能量在说话者周身不远处骤然涌起——那是对其内在光明的正义宣告，也是其虔诚信念的明证。
A word of proud authority travels up the caster’s gullet and out their mouth. With it, a wave of radiant energy surges for a small radius around the speaker—a righteous affirmation of their inner light, a testament to their devotion.

它的双翼周围空气噼啪作响，电光跳跃，仿佛活了过来。鸟身上无数羽毛在紫、白与深红之间流转变幻，随之脉动起伏；难以想象的电压在它体内奔涌，令色泽不断更迭。它仰首朝天，张开嶙峋的黑色鸟喙，放声长鸣，召来一道道闪电。电蛇划破苍穹，将生物缠绕在一层幽蓝的辉光之中。
The air around its wings crackles and pops, alive with electricity. The bird’s many feathers shift between shades of purple, white, and deep red. They pulse and shift, the hues changing as an unimaginable amount of voltage surges through its body. It raises its head to the sky, opening its ridged black beak and releasing a loud cry that summons bolts of lightning. They streak across the sky and wreathe the creature in a blue glow.

手杖由一枚修长的整块宝石以璀璨多面切割而成，将光线滤入半透明的水色流光里。它的价值难以估量，却必然惊人。雪白的石膏般号角形杖首与杖底以黄金箍束，雕出鹰的面孔与利爪。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The cane is trilliant cut from a long, single gem, filtering light through its translucent, watery colors. Its worth is not easily determined, though it must be great. The alabaster horn and foot, bound in gold, depict the face and talons of an eagle.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

瀑布的水流奔涌而下，在桥下分作三股水道穿过，随即在桥外重新汇合。就在它们交汇之处，你看见一个细小的漩涡生成又消散，接着在不远处再度冒出，旋即再次隐没。猜测水面上那处空洞下一次会在哪里出现，倒是件既消遣又令人目眩神迷的消遣。
As the water rushes down from the falls, it divides to pass through three channels under the bridge then unifies beyond it. Where they come together, you see a tiny whirlpool develop and vanish, then reappear a little way off before disappearing again. Spotting where the hole in the water will show up next could be a diverting and mesmerizing pastime.

Vandalized Infernal Shrine In Sewers.name:
下水道里遭亵渎破坏的炼狱神龛
Vandalized Infernal Shrine In Sewers

Text.text:
这里曾是一座汇流的大教堂：水流绕过长满青苔的踏石，踏石如同长椅般整齐列阵；整座蓄水池处处显露出曾有一股可怖伟力在此奔涌的痕迹。壁龛里供奉着恶魔般的雕像，俯瞰这座诡谲的圣龛。尽管它们在场，风化的石柱与雕塑仍被无数次亵渎与破坏所玷污。地狱的印记点缀着那些雕刻平台，赋予通往中央高台的许可；在那里，黑暗之力仍滞留于一块漆黑如玻璃的石头中——悬浮在其破碎基座的上方。

~ Envisioned by Andrew Sanguine on Discord

This was once a cathedral of confluences: water courses around mossy stepping stones, arrayed like pews, and the whole cistern shows signs a terrible power once flowed through it. Alcoves containing devilish effigies oversee the eerie shrine. Despite their presence, numerous acts of vandalism mar the weathered stone of pillars and statues. Infernal marks adorn the carved platforms that allow access to a raised center, where dark power remains in a black, glassy stone—suspended in the air above its ruined plinth.

~ Envisioned by Andrew Sanguine on Discord

Young Gold Dragon.name:
年轻金龙
Young Gold Dragon

Text.text:
金色的身躯在空中游弋，蜿蜒的优雅仿佛将乐曲凝成了筋肉的形态。你的大脑辨认出那闪耀的生物是一条巨龙，但此刻，惊叹压过了你本该感到的任何恐惧。
The golden body moves in flight with such sinuous grace it’s like you’re seeing music manifested in muscular form. Your brain identifies the shining creature as a dragon, but for the moment awe overcomes any terror you might feel.

Galadran Hawkenshield.name:
加拉德兰·霍肯盾
Galadran Hawkenshield

Text.text:
雷霆撕裂午夜的天幕，暴雨如同喷吐嘶响的恶意倾盆而下。愈发浓重的幽暗里，一名苍白肌肤的精灵悄然显现，银色雨幕中宛如幽灵般的身影。他桃金娘绿的头发被雨水打湿，紧贴着脸颊，映衬出一双液态黄金般的眼——坚韧不屈，却又温和。浸透的皮甲裹在身上，他牵引着黑色战马穿行风暴，只为让自己的坐骑得以安全避雨。两柄细剑垂在腰侧，其中一柄剑缘覆着霜意，在风雨的阴影里幽幽发光。当他照料这位忠诚的伙伴时，空气仿佛也随之噼啪作响，涌动着难以言喻的能量；围观的镇民只能揣测——那目光深处，究竟藏着怎样的秘密。

~ 由一位英雄Played，并附有

Thunder cracks the midnight sky as rain batters down in a tumult of hissing spite. From the deepening gloom, a pale-skinned elf materializes, a wraithlike figure amid the silvery cascade. His myrtle-green hair is slick and clings to his face, framing eyes of liquid gold—unyielding, but kind. Sheathed in drenched leathers, he guides his black steed through the tempest, determined to see his mount safe and dry. Dual rapiers, one rimmed with frost, hang at his side, faintly glowing in the storm’s shadow. The air seems to crackle with an enigmatic energy as he tends to his loyal companion, leaving the watching townsfolk to wonder at the secrets hidden within his gaze.

~ Played by a Hero with

Concealed Armory With Advanced Weapons.name:
配备先进武器的隐秘军械库
Concealed Armory With Advanced Weapons

Text.text:
光滑的金属门无声滑开，你迈入军械库，迎面是清冷而无菌的空气。成排的超尖端武器沿墙列阵，被重力发生器稳稳悬定，整间室内回荡着轻柔、周而复始的嗡鸣。地面上，一道道不断裂的光带与每组武器柜平行延伸。也许……那是某种安保系统？
The sleek metallic door opens silently, allowing you to step into the crisp, sterile air of the armory. Rows of hyper-advanced weapons line the walls, held in place by the grav-generators filling the room with a gently cycling hum. Unbroken lines of light on the floor run parallel to each bank of weapons. A security system perhaps?

Adult Bronze Dragon Encounter.name:
成年青铜龙遭遇
Adult Bronze Dragon Encounter

Text.text:
在一块被浪涛反复拍打的礁岩顶端，盘踞着一头巨龙——金属般的哨兵，披着海洋的瑰丽光泽——飞溅的海雾沿着它黄铜色的鳞甲倾泻而下；它却警觉得像一头庞然猎犬。兜帽般的眼睑下，双眸幽光闪动，带着几分不耐，仿佛你惊扰了它的进食：一条巨鲨横陈在它的利爪之下，躯体被撕裂得血肉翻卷，伤口蒸腾着热气。即便如此，这位水栖（特征）的泰坦仍散发出一股潜藏的仁善气息。
Atop a wave-battered rock squats an enormous dragon—a metallic sentinel of oceanic splendor—spray cascading down its brazen scales, but alert like a gargantuan hound. The hooded eyes glow, filled with mild agitation, as if you have disturbed its meal: a huge shark sprawling beneath clawed feet, its body a mass of steaming lacerations. Despite this, the aquatic titan emits a sense of latent kindness.

小鸭嘴龙踉踉跄跄地踩着不稳的腿脚，紧贴在母亲身旁，躲在她的负载阴影里寻求庇护。嘹亮的鸣叫如同小夜曲般在兽群间炸开，幼崽也立刻把自己细弱的呜咽加入合唱。它用短粗、鸭喙般的嘴拱蹭着母亲的胁侧，央求她的关注。
Stumbling on unsteady legs, the young hadrosaur stays close to its mother, sheltering beside her bulk. A honking serenade erupts across the herd, and the baby is quick to add its own mewling efforts to the chorus. Nuzzling its mother’s flank with a stubby, duck-like bill, the youngling petitions her for attention.

Misty Cave Provides Shelter From The Sto.name:
雾霭洞窟为风暴提供庇护
Misty Cave Provides Shelter From The Storm

Text.text:
雷霆在头顶翻滚，像你腹中那股难安的躁动；低沉的轰鸣几乎震耳欲聋，在洞壁间来回震荡。闪电横贯天际，宛如某条传奇中伟大而可怖的巨蛇吐出的长舌，蜿蜒掠过下方雾锁的群丘。你们的篝火渐渐黯淡，被呼啸的狂风冲撞着，风像失控的巨兽般灌入洞穴。雾中，你瞥见一丝移动——还是说，那不过是你的想象？

~ Envisioned by CpnTaintkick on Discord

The thunder rumbles overhead like your disquiet gut, the sonorous tumult almost deafening as it reverberates against the cave walls. Lightning flashes across the sky like the tongue of some great and terrible serpent of legend, winding its way over the fog-shrouded hills below. Your company’s fire is getting low, buffeted by the raging winds barreling through the cave. In the fog, you catch a glimpse of movement—or was it just your imagination?

~ Envisioned by CpnTaintkick on Discord

Faerie Carnival Games.name:
妖精嘉年华游戏
Faerie Carnival Games

Text.text:
沿着条纹棚篷连成的游艺摊位一线，玩家们或欢呼或懊恼地叫喊。套圈只落在兔子脖子上一个，而不是两个。小龙的尾巴从一位穿花园裙的女人手中滑脱。一个侏儒蹦跳着指指点点，笑得前仰后合。两个穿背心的地精扑向一个魁梧的父亲；他的女儿在一旁欢呼。独眼巨人那只凝视的眼里淌下泪水，可蛇鸡女妖摊位后的目光却危险地四下游移。一个玩家喊出一个数字。招徕人高声吼道：“对！”掌声响起。
Along the stripe-canopied line of game stalls, players cry out in joy and frustration. One ring hangs around the bunny’s neck, not two. The tail of a little dragon slips the hands of a woman in a garden dress. A gnome hops around and points, laughing. Two goblins in singlets rush a burly father. His daughter cheers. Tears run from the cyclops’s staring eye, but the eyes of the cockatrice flick dangerously around her stall. A player yells a number. The barker shouts, “Yes!” Applause.

雕花橡木门敞开，通向一座入口大厅：墙面涂成深绯红，地面铺着浅色大理石。情欲马赛克镶饰在四周壁龛里，空气里浸满熏香。软垫椅与长沙发被枕头层层簇拥，围拢着低矮而华美的矮桌；桌上容器盛着各式享乐之物，从鲜果到美酒。宽大的长蜡烛在精巧的锻铁落地烛台上燃烧，将房间浸在柔软的光里。红白帷幔拉出幽暗的角落与半遮半掩的出口；而在大厅各处，人们正沉入炽热亲昵的初始阶段。

~ Envisioned by Girlhead

Carved oaken doors open into an entrance hall with walls painted crimson and a floor of light marble. Erotic mosaics embellish niches around the room, the air suffused with incense. Cushioned chairs and couches, all bedecked with pillows, encircle low, decorative tables. On these, containers hold delights from fruit to wine. Wide tapers burn on elaborate floor candelabras of wrought iron, casting the room in soft light. Draperies of red and white create shadowed nooks or partially concealed exits, and all around the room, people engage in the initial stages of passionate intimacy.

~ Envisioned by Girlhead

Sundries From A Humanoid Demonic Insect.name:
来自人形恶魔昆虫的杂物
Sundries From A Humanoid Demonic Insect

Text.text:
这些东西全都破败不堪，或挂在断裂的链条上，或系在残破的绳索上；你发现至少十几枚不同的宗教圣徽，材质有木、有铁、也有铜。你还找到数十颗不成对的眼球，视神经像烂丝般拖曳在外；每一颗都被封存在一层芹菜般青绿、半透明的胶质痰状包膜里。
All in a state of disrepair, on broken chains or cords, you find at least a dozen different religious symbols in wood, iron, or copper. You also find dozens of mismatched eyeballs with their optic nerves hanging off, each preserved in a casing of a gelatinous celery-green translucent expectorate.

随着法术咒言响起，一柄邪异的长刃——修长而傲然——撕裂空间的织缕，自现实中破空而出。它并非由金属铸就；相反，它由最纯粹的魔法凝成。它在空中短暂旋舞，仿佛正被一位技艺高超的剑士挥使，随即猛然斩向敌手。
At the words of the spell, a wicked blade—long and proud—cuts through the fabric of space and out into reality. No metal makes this blade; instead, it is formed from the purest magic. It twirls briefly in the air, as though wielded by a skilled swordfighter, before striking at its foe.

Speech About Finding Peace.name:
关于寻找平静的演说
Speech About Finding Peace

Text.text:
“有时我会想象一个静谧的地方，这世界上一处安然的角落，远离日常生活里那种慌乱奔忙。某个地方，我能在爱与笑声的环绕中度过余下的岁月。我还不知道该怎么去那里，甚至不知道那样的地方是否真的存在，但如果我找到了它，我希望你们都能与我同在。”
“Sometimes I picture a quiet place, a serene corner of this world removed from the frantic scrambling of daily life. Somewhere I can live out the rest of my days surrounded by love and laughter. I don’t know how to get there yet, or if such a place even exists, but if I find it, I hope you will all be there with me.”

从你舌尖迸出的嘶嘶声与咔嗒啮鸣汇成一片喧嚣，几乎已不成语言。那声音不断繁殖、愈发尖厉，直至空气都为之嗡鸣震颤。你的目标在对其感官的侵袭下扭动挣扎——那是一种灼热的折磨，仿佛有上百只马蝇在啃咬大脑。
The hissing, chittering tumult that sputters from your tongue barely resembles language. The sounds multiply, intensify, until the air buzzes with them. Your targets squirm with the assault on their senses—a feverish torment, like a hundred horseflies biting the brain.

Greetings From An Ancient Librarian.name:
来自一位古老图书管理员的问候
Greetings From An Ancient Librarian

Text.text:
“我用人生中很大一段时光试着为这里的书籍编目——无数个小时翻拣蒙尘的巨册，梳理那些被遗忘的语言。可我却觉得，自己离衡量这堵墙里所囊括的知识并没有比起初更近一步。我当然能协助你找到你所求的任何信息，但我也终于明白，最好的方法是漫步于书架之间，让信息自己来找到你。”
“I have spent a great deal of my life trying to catalog the books here, so many countless hours thumbing through dusty tomes and sorting through forgotten languages. Yet I feel I am no closer to quantifying the knowledge held in these walls than when I started. I can certainly assist you in finding whatever information it is that you seek, but I’ve come to realize that the best method is to wander the shelves and let the information find you.”

Call To Arms: Men In Battle.name:
号令集结：战阵男儿
Call To Arms: Men In Battle

Text.text:
战斗在你身旁翻涌盘旋，厮杀者的尖叫如浪潮般一波波拍打在你身上。武器与护甲的撞击铿锵刺破喧嚣，震得你耳膜发痛、牙关直颤。至少你觉得一定是噪声让你的牙齿打战。绝不可能是紧张。
The battle swirls about you, the screams of its combatants crashing over you in waves. The clatter and clash of weapons and armor pierces the din, hurting your ears and rattling your teeth. At least you think it must be the noise making your teeth chatter. It can’t be nerves.

Space Erinyes.name:
空间 复仇女妖
Space Erinyes

Text.text:
一股不祥的恐惧将你裹住。一位堕落天使如复仇的恶魔般降临，黑色皮革般的双翼拍落阴影。他们扭曲的面容曾经美丽，如今却挂着冷酷而傲慢的狞笑。暗红近黑的发绺如绳索般从他们的炼狱头盔下垂落，那头盔仿佛在遥远的地狱坑炉中锻造而成。他们的护甲布满冒烟的灼痕，像一名古老骑士的遗物；可一支激光步枪却稳稳卡在他们左臂弯处。右手里，一柄烧结的长剑迸燃猩红烈焰。
A sense of dread envelops you. A fallen angel, like a devil of vengeance, descends on black leathery wings. Their twisted face, once beautiful, now bears a grim sneer of superiority. Ropes of red-black hair dangle from their infernal helm, forged in some distant hell-pit. Their armor is marked with smoking burns and is reminiscent of an ancient knight, though a laser rifle nestles in the crook of their left elbow. In their right hand, a sintered longsword blazes with scarlet flame.

Speech By An Oracle About A Child's Dest.name:
神谕者关于一名孩子命运的宣言
Speech By An Oracle About A Child's Destiny

Text.text:
“这世上几乎没人能真正触碰历史，而你的女儿将亲手塑造它。她体内潜藏着一种令人战栗又璀璨夺目的伟大——一种稀有的心与意志；当恐惧如潮涌来、他人崩溃时，她将挺身而立。但伟大自有代价。你此刻紧紧抱在怀里的小女孩，将被锁进这位伟大女子心灵的角落里，瑟缩颤抖，惊恐不已。因为她再也容不下恐惧、温柔，或是你。你们会在临死之前最后见她一面：在街上擦肩而过，你会避开视线，不敢直视那个面目凶厉的陌生人从你身旁掠过。然而，她会认出你——那个被困在她脑海里的小女孩正尖叫着渴望被放出来、被拥抱——然后，她会一言不发地从你身边走过。”

~ 由 Justinian Envisioned

“Very few people in this world even come close to touching history, your daughter will shape it. There is a terrifying and resplendent greatness within her. A rareness of heart and will that shall stand against a tide of terror when others break. But greatness has a cost. The little girl who you hold close will be locked away, shuddering and terrified, in the corner of this great woman’s mind. Because she will have no room for fear, or tenderness, or you. You will see her one last time before your deaths. You will pass her in the street, averting your eyes from this vicious looking stranger that crosses your path. However, she will recognize you—the little girl trapped in her mind screaming to be let out and embraced—then she will pass you by without saying a word.”

~ Envisioned by Justinian

这是一只浅色木材镶嵌而成的梯形共鸣箱，中央嵌着一枚三角形玫瑰花饰，其上方横跨着十五根琴弦。系弦钉围绕着顶端尖角成组排布，指尖轻拨时，琴弦便泛起粼粼微光。它吐出的音色幽邃回荡，仿佛回声缠绕不散——那声音直坠入聆听者心底最深处。
This is a trapezoidal box of light wood and inlays, with a triangle rosette in the center under fifteen strings. The hitch pins are arranged in sets around the top point, and the strings shimmer when fingers pluck at them. From it comes a haunting, echoing tone—a sound that sinks deep within its listeners’ hearts.

Powerful Explosion Far Away.name:
远方的猛烈爆炸
Powerful Explosion Far Away

Text.text:
一声如雷霆劈落般的巨响轰然炸开，震得你周遭一切都在颤动。你看不见它的源头，却绝不可能听错它传来的方向。然而那爆响既非雷鸣，也非雪崩。唯有法术，或某种烟火般的造物，才可能发出这样的动静。不管那是什么，它都大得惊人。
A boom that sounds like a lightning strike shakes everything around you. You don’t see its source, but you can’t mistake its direction. Yet that blast was not thunder or an avalanche. Only a spell or something like a firework could make it. Whatever it was, it was big.

Cyber Street Drug, Bitcrush.name:
赛博街头毒品：比特粉碎
Cyber Street Drug, Bitcrush

Text.text:
荧光生物代码在心刺注射器的透明塑料内部低声呢喃。代码在一股复杂的流中漂浮，仿佛模仿着携带者的双螺旋DNA图谱。它似乎能感知持有者的意图——当接近可能的注射之际，光芒愈发炽亮，螺旋也转得更急。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Fluorescent bio-code whispers within the transparent plastic of the mindspike injector. The code floats in a complex stream that mimics the double helix DNA map of whoever carries it. It seems to sense its holder’s intention, glowing brighter and spiraling faster as it approaches potential injection.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

一个庞大、吱呀作响的东西在你面前逼近。它的头颅是雄鹿骷髅那诡异的剪影，鹿角如老树的枝杈般向外伸展。你听见远处传来一声尖利的怪笑般的嘶叫，那具类人轮廓开始以缓慢而稳定的步伐朝你移动，垂落的利爪在地面上拖拽刮擦。它越是潜行逼近，形貌便越发清晰：一圈圈细枝条缠绕着苍白的骨头，编织出一具蹒跚奔掠的构装体。恶臭的魔法自它体内逸散，鹿颅头的眼眶里腾起绿色火焰。那拖行的“爪子”其实是长长的树枝，被修剪削尖——还染着脓血般的污液。构装体停顿片刻，下颌骨在下摆时发出吱吱声，张口大张。伴随一声宛如受折磨灵魂回响的咆哮，这具柳条机关以雷鸣般的脚步朝你猛冲而来。

~ 由dominik在Envisioned构想

An enormous, creaking thing looms. Its head is the eerie silhouette of a stag’s skull, the antlers reaching like boughs of an old tree. You hear a distant shriek of a cackle as the humanoid shape begins to move toward you with slow and steady steps, its dangling claws raking against the ground. The closer it stalks, the clearer its form becomes. Bands of twigs weave about pale bone to create a loping construct. A foul magic emanates from it, the eye sockets of the stag-skull head flaring with green fire. The dragging claws are long branches, trimmed and sharpened—stained with ichor. The construct pauses for a moment, its lower jaw squeaking as it swings downward to gape. With a roar like the peal of a tormented soul, the wicker machination charges at you with thundering steps.

~ Envisioned by dominik

Elven Vale: Campfire.name:
精灵谷：篝火
Elven Vale: Campfire

Text.text:
尽管必不可少，你们的营火在这片林地里却显得格格不入。滋滋作响的柴枝噼啪迸裂，吐出点点火星，飞入夜色，把爆裂与噼啪声的回响洒满森林。火焰虽小，你却无法摆脱那种自己正暴露于目光之下的感觉——只是你也不确定，在这片宁静的林中，除了猫头鹰之外，还有什么会留意到你们。
Though necessary, your campfire feels unwelcome in this wood. Its hissing logs spit sparks into the air, filling the forest with echoes of their cracks and pops. Small though the fire may be, you can’t help but feel that you draw attention to yourself—although you are unsure what in this peaceful forest besides the owls might take notice.

Golem Toll Collector Blocking Bridge.name:
阻桥的魔像过路税征收者
Golem Toll Collector Blocking Bridge

Text.text:
震耳欲聋的轰鸣在你周围层层攀升，桥前的地面猛然炸裂，泥土与碎石如雨飞溅。“停下。欲求通行者，须献上合宜的贡礼。”一尊白色大理石魔像——洁净得近乎不可能——此刻高耸于你面前，伸出一只手，挡住你通往桥对岸的路。

~ Envisioned by Davy on Discord

A deafening rumble builds around you as the ground before the bridge ruptures in a spray of earth and stone. "Halt. Those seeking passage must make proper tribute." A golem of white marble—impossibly immaculate—now towers above you, holding out a hand. It bars your way across.

~ Envisioned by Davy on Discord

钻石粉在你掌心粗砺闪烁，你将它洒在法术的施法焦点上。你念出咒词，伴随一阵诡异、摇曳的光，目标自视野中渐渐消隐。
The diamond dust is rough and glimmering in your hands as you sprinkle it over the focus of your spell. You speak the words, and with a strange, wavering of light your target fades from view.

Antimagic Restraint Jacket.name:
反魔法拘束衣
Antimagic Restraint Jacket

Text.text:
黑色帆布构成了这件外套的大部分。粗厚的绑带配着银色搭扣，足以捆住手臂、束缚穿戴者的双手。高立的衣领能被扣紧，勒住下颌与口鼻；兜帽也能拉下，遮住双眼。细若发丝的银线在布料上层层铺陈，织出一行又一行符文句子。这件衣物仿佛在拽扯心智，压低情感与意志。

~ 由一位英雄设想

Black canvas forms the bulk of this jacket. Thick straps with silver buckles make it possible to bind the arms and confine the hands of the wearer.
