A high collar can be strapped around the chin and mouth, and a hood pulled over the eyes. Fine strands of silver thread form line upon line of runic sentences in the cloth. The garment tugs at the mind, dampening emotion and will.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Guardhouse Of Aged Cave Portico.name:
古老洞窟门廊的卫所
Guardhouse Of Aged Cave Portico

Text.text:
门廊两侧夹击着门廊的卫兵房屋顶早已失修——十几块大瓦破损或缺失。几乎挡不住半点潮气，这座本来坚固的卫兵房里弥漫着刺鼻的霉味与湿冷。地毯与软包家具多年前就已腐烂殆尽，只留下灰色石面作为它们曾存在的痕迹。也许，守卫们的灵魂至今仍徘徊其间。
The roof of the guardhouse flanking the portico is in disrepair—a dozen of the large tiles are damaged or missing. Having kept out very little in the way of moisture, the otherwise sturdy guardhouse smells strongly of mildew and damp. Any carpets or upholstered furniture rotted away years ago, leaving only gray stone in their wake. Perhaps the spirits of the guards remain there still.

Faerie Carnival Carousel.name:
妖精嘉年华旋转木马
Faerie Carnival Carousel

Text.text:
有名与无名的马匹起起落落。卡利俄珀风琴的乐声充盈空气，仿佛糖果若能飞起就会这样四散飘扬。骑手们有时看上去半是马、半是人，在圆形棚顶的灯光下融进游乐场的光影里。每转过一圈，他们就越像一场梦，越不像这个世界的存在。
Horses named and unnamed rise and fall. Calliope music fills the air, the way candy would fly if it could. The riders sometimes seem half horse and half person, melting into the fair under the lights of the circular roof. With each revolution, they seem more a dream and less of this world.

Loot From A Nightmare.name:
梦魇之中夺来的战利品
Loot From A Nightmare

Text.text:
这匹由暗影与烈焰构成的骏马翻滚着坠入一团烟尘云雾之中，鬃毛、尾巴与双眼的火焰随之熄灭。令人窒息的烟云渐渐散开，化作幽魂般的缕缕薄雾，只留下地上一堆黑色灰烬。灰白的薄灰中有四样东西格外醒目，半截探出灰幕之外：几只黑曜石马蹄铁——你将其拭净后，它们光洁纯粹，熠熠生辉。
This horse of shadow and flame tumbles into a cloud of smog as the fire of its mane, tail, and eyes snuffs out. The choking cloud dissipates into ghostly wisps, leaving behind a pile of black ash. Four objects catch your eye, sticking out from the thin ashy pall: horseshoes of obsidian, shining and pure as you wipe them clean.

Marked Blind Man.name:
蒙眼盲者
Marked Blind Man

Text.text:
男人倚着一根粗糙的手杖，另一只手向外触及，仿佛在招唤某人。他穿着风霜磨旧、毛边镶饰的长靴，靴筒直达膝盖；身着朴素衣物，披着一件粗布斗篷，并蒙着眼罩。他的额头上烙着一道对称的十字印记。
The man leans on a rough staff and reaches out with the other hand, as if beckoning someone. He wears weathered, fur-trimmed boots that reach his knees, simple clothes with a rough cape, and a blindfold. His forehead is marked with a symmetrical cross.

两名士兵在这台木制攻城器械两侧猛摇巨轮，那根修长的长臂终于咔哒一声卡进定位。另两人用尽全身力气嘶喊着，从旁边石堆里抬起一块巨石，塞进投石臂末端的皮革弹兜里。又一名士兵攥着一条链子，链子连着机括的配重。“让开！”他吼道，同伴们迅速退到射界之外。他拼尽力气猛拽，自己也被带得坠落在地，投石机的配重随即脱扣。伴着吱呀作响的沉吟，配重拉起投石臂，弹兜沿着机体底部涂了油的槽道疾滑。巨石在空中划出一道弧线，猛然脱离弹兜，被狠狠抛射出去。它穿透长空——飞出数百英尺，直奔敌军阵线的目标。

~ Envisioned by Battersby

Two soldiers crank massive wheels on the sides of the wooden siege contraption, its long beam eventually clunking into place. Two others cry with the effort of hefting a stone from a nearby pile into the leather sling at the end of the trebuchet beam. Another soldier holds a chain attached to the engine’s counterweight. “Clear!” he shouts, and his fellows fall back out of the firing zone. He yanks with all his might, falling to the ground, and the trebuchet’s counterweight releases. With a creaking yawn, the counterweight pulls the trebuchet beam up, and the sling slides along a greased channel at the bottom of the engine. The stone continues its journey in an arc and is hurled out of the sling. It flies through the air—hundreds of feet, directly toward the enemy line.

~ Envisioned by Battersby

在浅浅的合成托盘里，消毒注射器静静躺着。每一支都印着极简的品牌标识——简洁、醒目，一眼就能认出。它是全息化妆品领域的领航者。使用时，针头在眼周、唇上、鼻梁间刻下万花筒般的艺术。烟熏睫毛膏滴落着阴影。发光的修容线条如同虚假的焰火般闪烁。口红让使用者的嘴唇化作一团朦胧的玫瑰云雾。无尽可能，尽在你指尖。
In the shallow synthetic dish, sterile syringes sit idle. Each is marked with minimalist branding—simple, instantly recognizable. This brand leads the way in holographic cosmetics. At application, the needles etch kaleidoscopic art across the eyes, the lips, the nose. Smoky mascara dripping with shadows. Shining contours that sparkle with faux fireworks. Lipstick that makes the user’s mouth a hazy masse of roses. Endless possibilities at your fingertips.

Waldo Bitten’s Catalog Of Creatures.name:
沃尔多·比滕的生物图鉴
Waldo Bitten’s Catalog Of Creatures

Text.text:
这本厚重的图鉴包罗万象，从小兔子到鸡蛇怪一应俱全。随手翻动间，你能看见每一种动物的图像会在纸页上游移，依着它们物种的共性、习性而动。掠食性的拉米娅与双足飞龙从段落与标题背后潜行，像在文字的阴影里盯住你。鬼火在你每一次移开视线时愈发明亮。而像害羞的木灵这类生物，则努力把自己藏进精致的金银丝纹饰之中。
This heavy compendium has everything from bunny rabbits to cockatrices. Flipping through, you can see the images of each animal move about the page, according to the general traits and behaviors of their species. Predatory lamia and wyverns stalk you from behind text blocks and headers. Will-o'-wisps glow brighter each time you look away from them. And creatures such as the shy kodama try to blend in with the filigree.

嚎叫撕裂夜幕。那些佝偻而兽性的身影拖着沉重步伐掠过，在高悬天际的巨大满月映衬下只剩黑色剪影。它们毛发倒竖，利爪扬起尘土，攀上山坡、翻越石墙。狼人正在狩猎。
Howls split the night. The slouched, bestial forms of the creatures lumber by, silhouetted by the immense, full moon hanging high in the sky. Their fur bristles and claws kick up dust as they clamber up hillsides and over stone walls. The werewolves are on the hunt.

Enraged Triceratops.name:
暴怒的三角龙
Enraged Triceratops

Text.text:
大地在生物的重量下颤抖不止，它狂乱翻腾，将周遭植被碾成碎屑般的烂泥。鼻孔因可感的暴怒而剧烈翕张，这头庞然恐龙眯起鸟类般锐利的眼睛，缓缓压低头颅。低沉的咆哮撼动林木，生物随即向前冲锋，裹挟着足以震碎骨骼的蛮力。
The ground trembles beneath the creature’s weight as it thrashes around, pulverizing nearby vegetation to mulch. With its nostrils flaring in palpable rage, the enormous dinosaur narrows avian eyes and lowers its head. A guttural bellow shakes the trees as the creature charges forward with bone-shattering force.

一群郊狼自低伏的薄雾中浮现——它们蓬乱的皮毛裹着冬日的负载——缓步穿越这片荒野。它们诡异的嚎叫如幽魂的尖啸，劈开黄昏的寂静；那饥饿的掠食目光钉在你身上，带着贪婪的意图一步步逼近。
Emerging from the low-lying mist, a pack of coyotes—their shaggy coats carrying winter bulk—lope across the landscape. Their eerie howls, like spectral screams, cleave the evening silence as they eye you with predatory hunger, edging forward with rapacious intent.

Crowd's Mixed Reaction To Curse Being Li.name:
诅咒解除引发人群的复杂反应
Crowd's Mixed Reaction To Curse Being Lifted

Text.text:
在欢腾的人潮中，仍有几张阴郁的面孔徘徊。他们伸出双手——仿佛第一次端详自己的掌心——有人叹息，有人啜泣，有人咬紧牙关皱眉。也许他们并不介意自己那受诅咒的存在？

~ 设想 by MaesterAelix on Discord

Amid the joyous crowd, a few sullen faces linger. Holding out their hands—as if regarding them for the first time—some sigh, some weep, and others grimace. Perhaps they didn't mind their cursed existence?

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

Binary Star Sunset.name:
双星落日
Binary Star Sunset

Text.text:
两枚圆球——一红一白——贴上地平线，边缘被压扁，渐失圆润。落日将万花筒般的光线铺洒成道道光痕，横贯大地，你不由得抬手遮眼。天穹的色彩缓缓褪去，仿佛鲜血自面庞抽离。光的消亡带来一阵难以言喻的失落，而此刻，这个世界仿佛骤然加倍地黑了下去。
Twin orbs—one red, one white—meet the horizon and lose their roundness. The sunset sends lines of kaleidoscopic light across the ground, and you shield your eyes at the sight. Slowly, the sky loses its hue, like blood leaving a face. You feel a loss at the dying of the light, and now this world seems twice as dark.

这把弩以寻常的木与铁制成，朴素而实用；但落在懂行的人手里，照样致命。各处机件都还能正常运作，只是弩臂像老迈的关节般吱呀作响，弓弦也已开始起毛磨损。
Though simple and utilitarian, this crossbow of mundane wood and iron is deadly in the right hands. Everything is in working order, though the arms creak like aging joints and the bowstring has started to fray.

这把巨剑比大多数战士还要高大，宛如血腥毁灭的先兆；锋刃上布满战斗留下的崩口与凹痕。它是一件残酷的武器，只要挥使者具备相称的力量，便能轻易斩开护甲、血肉与骨骼。
Standing taller than most warriors, this mighty greatsword is a herald of bloody destruction, its cutting edge marred by nicks and dents from battle. A brutal weapon, this sword can slice through armor, flesh, and bone with ease when wielded with appropriate power.

Castle Tower Peak.name:
城堡塔楼之巅
Castle Tower Peak

Text.text:
城堡石塔之巅的尖顶，是设计与现代工艺的奇观。裁形精致的木瓦层层相叠，严丝合缝，尽头收束于一枚铁制尖刺。它华丽得近乎矫饰，却以此昭示这座要塞建筑背后的技艺与财富。陡峭的穹拱天花将怪异的阴影投在墙面上，光源来自一盏吊灯，牢牢系在一条粗壮的铁链上。几座矮书柜沿着房间边缘摆放，仍为通往下方真正塔身的陡梯留出清晰通道。此处没有窗户可供窥视，只有几道在石墙上凿出的箭狭口，让人从这高处俯瞰外部建筑群的一隅景象。
The peak atop the castle’s stone tower is a marvel of design and modern construction. The shaped shingles overlap perfectly and end in an iron spire. It is an impressive affectation, displaying the craft and wealth evident in the creation of the fortified structure. A sharply vaulted ceiling casts curious shadows on the walls, the lighting provided by a chandelier affixed to a sturdy iron chain. Short bookcases have been placed around the periphery of the room while still allowing a clear path to the steep stairs leading down into the proper tower. No windows look in on this place, but there are several arrow slits cut into the stone to allow some view of the outer complex from this lofty perch.

Dragon Turtle Hydra.name:
龙龟九头蛇
Dragon Turtle Hydra

Text.text:
当你拖着沉重步伐穿行在沼泽那令人窒息的浊雾里，虫群刺耳的嗡鸣骤然止息。阴森的寂静随之坠下，像噩梦降临前那一口倒抽的气。自无底的泥沼深处，一头巨如山岳的三首龙龟轰然爆起，张喙尖啸，三张鸟喙大开，像远古海啸般从污潭中昂然抬身。

~ 由一位英雄构想

As you plod through the suffocating murk of the swamp, the cacophonous buzz of insects abruptly dies. A sinister hush falls, like the gasp before a nightmare. From the abyssal mire, a colossal, three-headed dragon turtle explodes, screaming beaks agape, rearing up out of the bog like a primordial tsunami.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Fresh Meat Trap.name:
鲜肉陷阱
Fresh Meat Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 丢下这块后腿肉的人肯定没走远——苍蝇才刚找到它。红白相间的纹理里，一截骨头微微外露，静静躺在路旁一片枯死的草丛里。

[发现] 肉块下方露出一截细绳，钻入草根深处。几尺外，它又在更密的灌丛里冒出头来，系在一根深深钉入地里的尖桩上，桩身覆着一团正在干裂的泥块。细绳将肉块底部与三根绷紧的细钢丝连在一起，每根都挂着数枚带倒刺的钩。将钩取下时，钩尖泛着毒液的青绿，还在肉里留下了些许。

[触发！] 你惊动了肉块，耳边传来一声轻微的嘶响。灌丛中的绳索猛地一拽，三根细钢丝倏然弹起，狠狠扎进最近的血肉中，随即绷紧，牵向一根深钉入土、覆着一团干泥的尖桩。被倒刺命中的人嘴角泛起绿色泡沫。

[Perceived] Whoever left this haunch can’t be far away. The flies have barely found it. Red and white marbled, a bit of bone protruding, it lies alongside the path in a patch of dead grass.

[Discovered] From under the haunch of meat a cord of twine sticks out and disappears under the grass. It surfaces again a few feet away in deeper brush, tethered to a spike driven deep and covered with a clump of drying mud. The twine connects the underside of the haunch to three fine wires held under tension, each bearing several barbed hooks. When removed, the hooks are green with poison and leave some in the meat.

[Triggered!] You disturb the meat and hear a quiet hiss. A cord is yanked from the brush and three fine wires shoot up, burying into the nearest flesh and snapping tight to a spike driven deep in the ground and covered with a clump of drying mud. Those hit by the barbs foam green at the mouth.

The Bard's Magical Act.name:
吟游诗人的魔法戏法
The Bard's Magical Act

Text.text:
欢快的街头艺人哼着小调，仿佛四下无人；指尖在倒扣的帽檐上敲出断续的急促节拍。十指交织出几近令人目眩的花样，随后——随后——他整只手猛地探入那浅浅的帽冠，手臂竟一路没入，直至肘上都消失不见。观众被这突如其来的动作惊得倒吸一口气，可低语很快沉寂下来——只见他又以同样迅捷的速度抽回手，随手向人群撒出一把金色碎光——那碎光骤然化作数十只空灵的蝴蝶，银辉般的翅翼轻颤。他双手一拍，那些闪亮的振翅之物便在一串柔和音符中一只只消散，仿佛掌中小竖琴拨出的清响；旋律高扬，牵引着听者的神情从惊叹渐渐舒展开来，直至满溢欢喜。
The merry jongleur hums as if alone, his fingertips beating out a staccato rhythm on the edge of an upturned hat. Fingers knit in patterns almost dizzying to behold, then—then—his entire hand plunges into the shallow cap, his arm disappearing well past his elbow. The audience gasps with the suddenness of the motion, but the murmurs turn to silence as his hand withdraws just as swiftly and tosses a handful of golden flecks of glitter over the audience—glitter that suddenly becomes dozens of ethereal butterflies, each with wings of argent. He claps his hands, and the shiny fluttering things disappear one by one in a series of soft notes as if played on a handheld harp, a soaring melody that coaxes the listeners’ faces from awe to joy.

在空旷无垠的大海中央，一道覆满珊瑚的岩坡自你脚下数百英尺深处直冲海面。面对这面浩瀚的海底峭壁，你恍然有种错觉，仿佛一只飞鸟穿行于浓雾之中，骤然撞见一整片山脉。 In the middle of the open, endless sea a coral-covered slope of rock shoots up toward the surface from hundreds of feet below you. Confronting this vast wall of seafloor, you feel a bit like a bird discovering a mountain range while flying through the fog.

Long-forgotten Secret Passage.name:
被遗忘已久的密道
Long-forgotten Secret Passage

Text.text:
随着一声秘语轻轻吐出，原本浑然一体的岩壁竟缓缓剥离。接连传来几下沉闷的砰响，随后“咔哒”一声脆响。坚实的石质退让出一道入口，高达你身形的两倍，幽暗而空旷如洞窟。更深处，一条通道在阴翳中向远方延伸。

~ Envisioned by GoatsOnBoats

At the whisper of a secret word, the once seamless rock peels back. There’s a series of dull thudding noises, and then a click. Solid matter gives way to an entrance twice your height, dark and cavernous. Beyond, the pathway stretches far into the gloom.

~ Envisioned by GoatsOnBoats

Dagger-and-quill Emblem.name:
匕首与羽笔徽记
Dagger-and-quill Emblem

Text.text:
如战士的握手般，金色徽记上绘着羽笔与匕首，彼此交叉，横越一片烈焰之海。徽记在光中微微颤动，闪烁生辉，宛如士兵胸前擦得锃亮的勋章。
Like a warrior’s handshake, the quill and dagger emblazoned upon the golden emblem unite as they cross each other over a field of flames. The emblem shimmers in the light, gleaming like a polished medal upon a soldier’s chest.

Rat Spectre Swarm.name:
鼠怨幽群
Rat Spectre Swarm

Text.text:
一切始于一阵窸窣刮擦声。嘶嘶、低吼与尖细吱叫接连入耳，仿佛幽异的回声在四周盘旋。伴随一声异界苍白光芒的爆裂，细小的幽灵身影从墙壁、地面与天花板的每一道缝隙中迸射而出。老鼠！这群害兽以难以置信的速度汹涌灌入，每一只都在它那虚幻的形体上烙着死亡的痕迹。
It starts with scrabbling sound. Hissing, growling, and squeaking become audible as if they’re eerie echoes. With an explosion of otherworldly pale light, tiny spectral forms burst from every gap in the wall, floor, and ceiling. Rats! The vermin pour in with incredible speed, each bearing evidence of its death on its ghostly form.

Derrik The Cleric, The Holy Hammer.name:
德里克牧师，「圣锤」
Derrik The Cleric, The Holy Hammer

Text.text:
他如巨像般阔步登场，单手挥舞着一柄夸张巨大的银色战槌——抛光得过分耀眼、火花般闪烁，几乎让你看不清槌身两侧分别镌刻的 GUILTY 与 NOT GUILTY。恰到好处的微风掀起他的蓝色披风，露出宽阔的肩膀，线条一路收束到不可思议的精瘦腰身；而他那身擦拭得发亮的板甲护甲上，刻着一个高度风格化的正义之神徽记。另一只手则牢牢绑着一面圆盾：既是防御，也是绝佳的“招牌位”——厚重的内凹钢面上，绘着一柄正气凛然、长着羽翼的战槌。你正沉溺于这场盛景，他忽然一笑，一缕不听话的阳光正巧掠过，照亮他完美无瑕的牙齿。然而，他的神情与真实身份都难以揣度——它们被一副神秘面具严严实实地藏了起来。尽管如此，你知道自己永远都会记得：第一次听到那声呼喊时，你身在何处、正在做什么——“别怕！圣槌在此！”

~ 由 bloodhadson 扮演

He strides onto the scene like a Colossus, brandishing in one hand an oversized silver war-gavel so polished and sparkling that you can scarcely make out the words GUILTY and NOT GUILTY engraved on opposing sides. His blue cape billows in a convenient breeze exposing broad shoulders, which taper to an impossibly trim waist, and a heavily stylized symbol of the god of justice engraved on burnished plate armor. His other hand is strapped to a rounded shield: serving equal parts defense and branding opportunity, upon its thick concave steel is painted a righteous, winged hammer. You’re lost in the spectacle of it all when he smiles, and a rogue sunbeam illuminates his perfect teeth. But it is difficult to gauge his demeanor, or true identity, hidden as they are behind a mysterious mask. Nevertheless, you know that you will always remember where you were and what you were doing when you first heard the cry, “Never fear! The Holy Hammer is Here!”

~ Played by bloodhadson

Glacial Cave Opening.name:
冰川洞穴入口
Glacial Cave Opening

Text.text:
一条咯咯欢笑般的溪流穿过巨石遍布的原野奔涌而下，源头是那道洁白冰墙上张开的幽蓝巨口。那口子通向冰川深处的一处洞穴，无疑是在漫长的时代里被融水凿刻而成。洞窟闪烁的穹顶高高拱起，俯罩着刺骨寒水的砾石岸边，宛如一座冰冷的大教堂，以回声翻涌的黑暗刺穿成吨的坚冰。
A chortling stream rushes through a field of boulders, flowing from a gaping maw of blue in a great white wall of ice. The mouth opens into a cave in the glacier, no doubt carved over time by the meltwater. The cavern’s glistening roof arches high over the freezing water's gravel shores, forming a cold cathedral that pierces the tons of ice with an echoing darkness.

许多附魔以迷惑与诓骗为能事，但这道法术并非如此。你吟诵的词句毫无惯常的巧舌诗韵；取而代之的是粗野的声响与颐指气使的语调。随着最后的手势，你将一只手扫向目标头顶上方的空气，仿佛正攫住提线木偶的丝线。
Many enchantments beguile and trick, but not this spell. The words you chant have none of the normal silver-tongued poetry. Instead, you make brutish sounds and speak in imperious tones. With the final gestures you sweep a hand toward the air over your target’s head, as if grasping the strings of a puppet.

Swords And Sails, A Floating Bazaar.name:
刀剑与风帆，一座漂浮的集市
Swords And Sails, A Floating Bazaar

Text.text:
细长锋利、船艏如矛的船只在此海面上被缆绳紧紧绑作一体，拼成了一座漂浮的城镇。每艘船都架着一座舷桥，连同上层甲板上的数处露天构造一并伸展。在这些地方，龙裔与狗头人正忙碌劳作：有的锻造护甲、武器与各类金属器物；有的则用符文、秘奥公式与稀有材料，为精良兵刃注入魔法。一个矮人和一名火巨人忙着向来客展示货品，或将货物打包装箱，准备装船外运。

~ Envisioned by Pirate King

Long, sharp ships with pointed prows have been lashed together on the sea here, forming a floating town. Each vessel sports a bridge, along with several other open structures on the upper decks. In these, dragonborn and kobolds work. Some smith armor, weapons, and other metal objects. Others work with runes, eldritch formulae, and rare materials to make the fine arms magical. A dwarf and fire giant are busy showing wares to visitors or packing goods for shipment.

~ Envisioned by Pirate King

附魔师学院的女校长看上去是个五十来岁的健壮女人，顶着一团巨大的球形椒盐色爆炸头，眼神温暖而慈和。她的颈间与腕上层层点缀着木、珠、骨与黄金的饰物；而两枚由纯粹魔法铸成、宛如有灵智的耳坠从耳垂垂下——有时还会开口说话。她通常身披缝绗锦缎长袍，缎边微闪，手持一根乌木魔杖，只比她的肤色略深一点。
Enchanter Academy’s headmistress appears to be a robust woman of fifty, with a giant spherical salt-and-pepper afro, and eyes that are happy and kind. Her neck and wrists are bedecked with jewelry of wood, bead, bone, and gold, while earrings of pure magic that act like intelligent beings dangle—and sometimes speak—from her ear lobes. She usually wears a robe of quilted brocade with satin trim and carries a wand of ebony only slightly darker than her skin.

God Of Resilience.name:
坚韧之神
God Of Resilience

Text.text: 他以朋友的面貌出现：也许是机缘巧合遇见、愿意伸手相助的陌生人；也许是相识已久、深深爱着的老战友。从母亲在艰难分娩中挣扎，到囚徒或士兵思念家园的渴望，他都能听见祈祷——哪怕那祈祷并非献给他，哪怕只是绝望的哀求或愤怒的喊叫。凡需要忍耐之处，当所有声音都在说放弃吧、要你停下时，他便在你耳畔低语：护甲之言，心与肢体的力量。你深吸一口气，明白自己会撑过去。 He appears as a friend, perhaps a fortunately-met stranger willing to help, or an old and deeply-loved comrade. From the mother laboring through a hard birth to the prisoner or soldier yearning for home, he hears prayers even when they are not to him, when they are only desperate pleadings or shouted frustrations. Where there is need of endurance, to continue when every other voice says just quit, he whispers the words of armor, strength of mind and limb. You take a deep breath and know that you will endure.

Farmer’s Field In Summer Rain.name:
夏雨中的农田
Farmer’s Field In Summer Rain

Text.text:
湛蓝的天空被雨云点点晕染。雨滴开始从庄稼上弹起，沿着茎秆滑落，润泽干渴的大地。突如其来的倾盆大雨重锤般敲打着原野，回春的鼓点在空气中回荡。负责这片田地的农夫站在树下，满怀感激地目睹这来自上方的赋礼。
The blue sky is dappled with rain clouds. Droplets begin to bounce from crops, sliding down stems and quenching the ground’s thirst. Drumming rejuvenation echoes through the air as the sudden deluge hammers across the landscape. The farmer responsible for this field stands beneath a tree and gratefully witnesses the gift from above.

Doctor With Beast Harness.name:
与兽具为伴的医师
Doctor With Beast Harness

Text.text:
身披一件长长的外套，上头沾满各式炼金试剂与混合物的斑痕，这名侏儒在城市狭窄的巷道与喧嚣的街市间穿行，手指死死攥住同伴挽具的缰绳。那头古怪的四足兽凭着近乎本能的明晰引领主人，穿人潮、开路而行；两只沉重的挎包——绣着褪色的蛇杖徽记——随每一步有力的踏落弹跳作响，清脆叮当，声声入耳。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Wearing a long overcoat stained with all manner of alchemical reagents and mixtures, the gnome works her way through the cramped alleyways and bustling streets of the city, her hand clasped tightly around the reins of her companion’s harness. Leading their master with instinctive clarity, the strange quadruped clears a path through the crowd, heavy satchels—embroidered with a faded caduceus—bouncing with an audible clink after each commanding step.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

在沙漠最幽深的腹地，你本不该遭遇来自海洋的危险住民；然而在这片晦暗之地，沙砾被异化为一种独特的液态形貌，一头源自水渊的生物已然浮现：三眼巨兽，口器如七鳃鳗般狰狞，身形酷似魟鱼，却拖曳着数条触手。你立刻认出眼前威胁——一头传奇的阿波雷斯特；只是这只困于荒漠的异种，皮肤呈斑驳褐色，而非寻常的黏腻青绿。即便如此，它看起来仍在此如鱼得水；当它彻底显露真容之际，你已能感觉到它的心智触须正悄然渗入你的意识。

~ 构想：Rogério da Costa Jr.

In the deepest heart of the desert one does not expect to encounter a dangerous denizen of the oceans; but in this benighted place where sand has been transmuted into a unique liquid form, a creature from the watery depths has surfaced: a three-eyed behemoth with a maw like a lamprey eel and a body resembling a stingray, but with tentacles. Immediately you recognize the threat before you as a legendary aboleth, though the skin of this desert-bound version is a mottled brown rather than the usual slimy green. Nevertheless, it seems quite at home here, and as it makes itself fully known, you can already feel the tendrils of its mind seeping into your own.

~ Envisioned by Rogério da Costa Jr.

这座微不足道的小岛几乎寸草不生，嶙峋的地形上零星点缀着几簇灌木般的荒草。几只海鸟、蜥蜴与虫豸便构成了这片小屿全部的原生居民——这般冷峻的环境完全无力维系类人生物的生存。脚下的沙粒咯吱作响，随步伐塌散滑落，每一步都险象环生。
The miniscule island is nearly barren, the rocky terrain dotteed with the occasional patch of scrub vegetation. A smattering of seabirds, lizards, and insects represent the entire native population of the islet—the stark surroundings completely incapable of sustaining humanoid life. The sand underfoot crunches and falls away, every footstep treacherous.

Black Bear Encounter.name:
黑熊遭遇
Black Bear Encounter

Text.text: 一座由阴影般的毛皮与筋肉堆砌而成的巨影踉跄穿行于林间，沉重的脚步被腐烂落叶铺成的厚毯悄然托住。它停下，巨爪翻耙着腐屑，搜寻藏匿的果腹之物；随即抬起那大得骇人的头颅，鼻翼翕张，嗅到了你的气息。低沉的咆哮在兽喉间渐渐堆起，震荡着它庞大的身躯，化作一声滚烫的警告：别来招惹我。 A mountain of shadowy fur and muscle lurches through the forest, its heavy footfalls cushioned by the carpet of decaying leaves. It pauses, large claws raking the detritus in search of hidden sustenance, then it lifts its prodigiously large head, nostrils flaring as it detects your scent. A low growl builds in the beast’s throat, reverberating through its huge body in a simmering warning: Leave me alone.

Fulgur, The Archaeologist.name:
弗尔古尔，考古学家
Fulgur, The Archaeologist

Text.text:
仅凭那道剪影，你本以为迎面而来的，是个姿态笨拙、年华渐老的人类矿工；可待他走近，你才惊讶地发现——那是一名蓝鳞的龙裔，随意将一把磨损的铁锹扛在一侧肩头。汗渍斑斑的蓝色连体工装外，还套着一件多少有些违和的胸甲；工装的腰腹处被撑得紧绷，显出一圈不小的肚腩。然而，他那对奶油色的角，以及端端正正、轻巧地架在鳞质鼻梁上的夹鼻眼镜，又让你对这古怪身影生出几分亲切。只见他清了清嗓子，微微点头致意，礼貌地自我介绍起来。

~ Played by Rogério da Costa Jr

From his silhouette alone you take the approaching figure to be that of an ungracefully aging human miner, but as they draw near you are surprised to see a blue-scaled dragonborn hefting a worn shovel over one shoulder. A somewhat incongruous breastplate is worn atop a sweat-stained, blue jumpsuit, the midsection of which is pulled taut over a sizeable pot belly. However, something about his cream-colored horns and the pince-nez spectacles perched daintily atop his scaly snout endears you to this odd figure, who proceeds to clear his throat before introducing himself politely with a slight bow of his chin.

~ Played by Rogério da Costa Jr

侏儒工程师紧紧攥着一卷几乎与她等高的羊皮纸卷，抬手整了整腰间那条塞满精密量具的工具带，随即对你噼里啪啦地飞快絮叨起来，快得你大概只能听懂五分之一的词。她不耐烦地啧了声，舌尖一弹，催你往最近的平坦处去，随手将那套复杂得近乎不可能的设计图铺展开来。外行人的眼里，这幅图几乎毫无头绪；可从她那几乎要溢出来的兴奋劲儿看，这必定是一件足以颠覆一切的革命性装置。
Tightly clutching a rolled-up parchment nearly as long as she is tall, the gnome engineer adjusts her belt full of precision measuring tools, then chatters at you so quickly that you can make out perhaps one in every five words. Impatiently, she clucks her tongue and ushers you toward the nearest flat surface, spreading out her impossibly complex set of plans. To the layman’s eye, the diagram makes almost no sense, though judging from her level of excitement, it must be for a device that is nothing less than revolutionary.

Plane Of Earth.name:
土之位面
Plane Of Earth

Sickened Lizardfolk Village.name:
病恹恹的蜥蜴人村落
Sickened Lizardfolk Village

Text.text:
瘦骨嶙峋的蜥蜴人类人型生物在这片闷湿的小树林里、黏土茅屋之间漫无目的地游荡，虚弱得连因它们的迟钝而欢欣的蚊群都懒得驱赶。村落中央的小池塘散发出腐败的恶臭，昆虫在死寂的黑色积水上嗡嗡盘旋。

~ MatthewMcHale 于 Discord

Gaunt reptilian humanoids meander aimlessly between the clay huts in the small, humid grove, too weak to swat away the mosquitos delighting in their lethargy. A small pond at the center of the village exudes a foul odor of corruption as insects buzz above the stagnant black water.

~ MatthewMcHale on Discord

Sundries From A Marilith.name:
来自六臂蛇魔的杂货
Sundries From A Marilith

Text.text:
这恶魔蜿蜒的躯体覆着苔绿鳞片，有些地方正在蜕落，但仍有大段皮革般的外皮仿佛随时能被整片剥下。你看到一串串勋章被钉缀在这生物紧绷的皮革短上衣胸前各处。每一枚的样式各不相同：有的金质徽章上刻着家族纹章，有的则是在布片与木片上手绘的符印。它们唯一共有的特征，是每一枚正中都被狠狠划开了一道深长的裂口。
The moss-green scales of the fiend’s winding body molt in some places, but long swathes of hide might still be shorn free. You see that a collection of medals has been attached all over the chest of the creature’s tight leather jerkin. The designs on each range from family crests on golden emblems to hand-painted sigils on pieces of cloth and wood. The only defining trait shared by all is a deep slash through the middle of each.

Insult To A Smart Character About Facing.name:
对一个聪明角色的临死嘲讽
Insult To A Smart Character About Facing Death

Text.text:
“你把所有的时代都花在讲述这世界的真相上，可当死亡降临时，你又能说什么？你会做什么？用一首诗去安抚它？不。你会像所有人一样尖叫、哭嚎，拼命用指甲抓挠着想爬出它的怀抱——也会像所有人一样失败。”
“You spend all your time lecturing about the truths of the world, but what will you say when death comes? What will you do? Appease it with a poem? No. You’ll scream and cry and try to claw your way out of it just like everyone else, and you’ll fail just like everyone else too.”

Nickel-plated Automatic Pistol.name:
镀镍自动手枪
Nickel-plated Automatic Pistol

Text.text:
这把手枪闪着抛光黄铜般的光泽，轮廓像个L形；线条利落，没有贴花、没有战纹——只有朴素而凶狠的用途。枪管上可见缝合般的痕迹，显示它经由精密工艺被加长过。厚实的弹匣从握把底部突出——为高速全自动射击而加长。触发是一道宽阔的钢质弧线；这件武器的后坐力想必沉猛得很。
Shining like an L shape of burnished brass, this pistol is a sleek thing with no decals or war paint—only simple, vicious function. Suture marks show the barrel has been lengthened with precision engineering. A chunky magazine hangs out the bottom of the handle—extended for rapid automatic fire. The trigger is a broad curve of steel; there must be a hefty kick to the weapon.

Fatal Blow To Undead Former Friend.name:
对不死的故友施以致命一击
Fatal Blow To Undead Former Friend

Text.text:
吟游诗人向步步逼近的龙裔踉跄后退——对方身上溅满黑色黏液，恶意如影随形。她迟疑着攥紧长剑。那张脸分明是昔日友人的面容，可龙裔咧开的尖牙笑容里，欢愉已被狠毒取代。“对不起。”吟游诗人说道，声音破碎，剑刃噼啪迸裂着能量。鳞甲身影猛然扑来，迎面撞上她势大力沉的一记横斩，几乎将其身躯劈成两半。第二声宣泄般的“对不起！”在空气里回荡——悔恨的吟游诗人与被复生的龙裔一同倒下：一人跪地，一人坠入最终的休息。

~ Envisioned by Wikiwing

The bard recoils from the advancing dragonborn, who is flecked with black ooze and evil intent. Hesitating, she grips her longsword. The face is that of a former friend, but malice has replaced mirth in the dragonborn’s toothy grin. “I’m sorry,” says the bard, her voice breaking and her blade crackling with energy. The scaly figure lunges and is met by a mighty swing that nearly cleaves their body in two. A second cathartic cry of “I’m sorry!” resounds as both the remorseful bard and the reanimated dragonborn fall—one to her knees, the other to a final rest.

~ Envisioned by Wikiwing

这把巨斧重若牛拉犁，刃身还带着田野泥土沉积出的土褐光泽。铁料显然出自一个力气远胜于技能的人之手，被粗陋铁锤反复敲打的痕迹在金属表面留下密密麻麻的凹坑。
This greataxe weighs as much as an ox-drawn plow and carries the earthen patina of the fields. The iron has been forced into shape by someone with considerably more strength than skill, and the blows of a crude hammer pockmark the metal’s surface.

一根淬硬钢杖，抛光得如镜面般映照四周，两端各镶着咧嘴怪笑的马首雕饰；它违逆重力，静静悬在空中不动。杖身上的一枚按钮已被按下，异样器物周遭的空气嗡鸣震颤，涌动着巫术般的能量。
A rod of hardened steel, polished to a reflective sheen and capped at each end by grinning equine forms, defies gravity as it hangs motionless in the air. A button on the rod has been depressed, and the air around the strange artifact hums with sorcerous energy.

你面前这具冰冷的尸体，早已失却生前那股炽白如焰的狂怒；曾经鼓胀的肌肉如今不过是沉甸甸的死肉。此人无疑曾以武技为生、以搏杀为息，可他们的最终死因似乎并非战斗——那苍白的躯壳上，竟看不见半道伤口。
The frigid cadaver before you is devoid of the white hot rage that fueled them in life, their bulging muscles now little more than copious dead weight. Though this warrior undoubtedly lived and breathed martial combat, that does not seem to be the cause of their ultimate demise as no wounds are visible upon their pallid corpse.

The Leaf & Bean.name:
绿叶与豆子
The Leaf & Bean

Text.text:
这里售卖的所有咖啡与茶都是魔法之物，由来自世界各地的炼金术士亲手冲煮。每逢第四个科隆纳德之秋，店里都会举办一场竞赛——学院教授与乡野农夫同台较量，争夺由店主评选的冠军风味。店内温暖而满是木质气息，宛如一处幽暗的绿洲：橙暖的桌灯在暗色中晕开柔光，蒸腾的咖啡与茶香随人声一同飘起——或欢快，或抚慰，或隐约带着阴影。
All the coffee and tea sold here is magical, brewed by alchemists from around the world. Every fourth Colonnade autumn, there is a contest, and professors from the academies compete with country farmers for the winning flavor chosen by the proprietors. The shop is warm and woody, a dark oasis with warm orange table lights and the steamy scents of coffees and teas wafting up with conversations happy, consoling, or shadowy.

Haunted House: Family Crypts.name:
闹鬼宅邸：家族墓穴
Haunted House: Family Crypts

Text.text:
苦涩的风在这座家族墓穴的甬道间尖啸回旋，石棺以不断向外扩展的布局陈列开来，最早的始祖位于正中央。几具石棺看上去像是棺盖被挪到一旁，或干脆破碎不堪；但再细查便会发现，那些棺盖并非盗墓贼所为，而是被棺中之物硬生生撕扯啃毁。远处传来一声低沉的呻吟。那只是又一阵寒风掠过檐隙的呜咽？还是不安的亡者已然苏醒，正要将闯入者一一抹除？
A bitter wind whistles through the passages of this family crypt, sarcophagi laid out in an expanding pattern with the family’s earliest progenitors at its center. Several of the sarcophagi look as if their lids have been moved to one side or the other, or are broken altogether, but further investigation reveals that such lids have been savaged by their occupants, and not graverobbers. You hear a low moan in the distance. Is it another gust of cold wind whistling through the eaves? Or have the unquiet dead come to expunge interlopers?

即便是不懂农事的新手，也能一眼看出脚下泥土的丰饶——那是你眼前这片河口三角洲在漫长岁月中塑成的馈赠。这样的地方往往是新兴文明的摇篮：沃土孕出丰收的作物，淡水解了牲畜与人的渴，河道则为贸易铺就迅捷的通途。
Even novices to agriculture recognize the richness of the soil beneath their feet, a legacy of the formation of the river delta before you. Such places often represent the cradle of burgeoning civilizations: the soil allowing for plentiful crops, the freshwater slaking the thirst of both livestock and people, the river granting fast passage for trade.

一场恶劣天气的寄望城在地平线上隐现，云层掩蔽开始聚拢成一团团浓重的块状。你凝望着那缓慢却不可阻挡的推进，云阵愈发像一只巨大的碗，盛满凝结翻涌的酸乳。
A promise of heavy weather looms on the horizon as the cloud cover begins to form into dense-looking clumps. The formation looks more and more like an enormous bowl of curdled milk as you watch the clouds slow but inevitable advance.

Enchanter's Polo Coach.name:
附魔师的马球教练
Enchanter's Polo Coach

Text.text:
长长的黑发束在脑后，金色长袍微微流光，教练正向学生们讲授附魔马球的基础。她将球槌高高举起，一枚圆球在槌头前嗡鸣旋转。器具在活跃的魔法中低低震颤。“它们固然可爱，但并非你们马球比赛中最重要、最珍贵的部分，”她说道，“最重要的是你们的搭档——你们的斯特鲁提贡。”她朝身旁的生物点了点头，那家伙满足地呱叫一声，随即向空中喷出一股火焰。
Long dark hair tied back and golden robes ashimmer, the coach presents the basics of Enchanter’s Polo to her students. She holds the mallet aloft, an orb whirring in front of the mallet’s face. The objects drone with active magic. “Lovely as they are, these are not the most important or valuable part of your Polo game,” she says. “That would be your partner, your Struttigon.” She nods to the creature next to her, who croaks appreciatively, releasing a spout of fire into the air.

一个瘦削的蝙蝠状人形眯起四只狭长的眼睛。嗡鸣般的灵能在生物的头颅周围盘旋，它发出一连串急促的咔嗒声时，那股能量骤然增强。它身披黯淡无光的金色甲片，手握一根显然象征神职阶位的法杖。双翼拍击空气，以不规则的节奏震得颈间护符来回跳动。
A lean, batlike humanoid squints out of four narrow eyes. A buzz of psychic energy surrounds the creature’s head, intensifying as it emits a series of rapid clicks. Armored in plates of lusterless gold, it wields a staff of some obvious clerical rank. Wings flap at the air, bouncing the amulet around its neck with an irregular rhythm.

Dragon Dance Of The Claw Style: Ginga.name:
利爪流·龙之舞：银牙
Dragon Dance Of The Claw Style: Ginga

Text.text:
你动作轻灵，仿佛生出双翼：左臂弯曲掠过面前，脚步横移一摆，重心稳若磐石。随即反向回旋，右臂如飞掠至身前，你一边衡量对手，一边左右扫步游走，让自己成为不断移动的目标。舞蹈就此展开——这是一种将艺术与打击能力熔于一炉的战斗风格：龙形的摄人之美，裹挟着龙之暴烈的力量。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

You move as if with wings, left arm curving in front of your face while you swing your step sideways, perfectly balanced. Then back the other way, your right arm flies to the front as you size up your opponent while sweeping from side to side, a moving target. The dance begins, a style of combat blending artistry and strike ability, the transfixing quality of the dragon’s form with the force of the dragon’s violence.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Bubbling Cauldron.name:
咕嘟冒泡的坩埚
Bubbling Cauldron

Text.text:
锅中黏稠的内容物咕嘟翻滚，气泡胀大成毒鹅膏般大小的圆泡，旋即又蔫塌回泡沫里。气味在令人愉悦的焦香与刺鼻的辛辣间来回游移，随着每一分钟流逝而不断变调。各色材料在表面浮沉，仿佛覆满黏液的遗物，漂在一片咕哝作响的沼泽中。
The pot’s viscous contents simmer, bubbles growing into deathcap-sized rounds before wilting back into the froth. The smell shifts between a pleasant toastiness and an acrid sting, changing with each minute that passes. Various ingredients bob on the surface like slime-covered artifacts in a grumbling bog.

Subterranean Lava Geyser.name:
地下熔岩喷泉
Subterranean Lava Geyser

Text.text:
熔岩池不停变幻翻涌，咕嘟作响——却并非因炽热，而是地壳力量在撼动。毫无规律的间隙里，一声低沉的闷响从表面猛然迸出，像打嗝般突兀，随即将周遭近处淋洒成一片飞溅的熔融岩浆。然而这座熔岩间歇泉尚未倾尽真正的狂怒，你只能祈祷它终将爆发的那一刻，你不在附近。
The pool of lava shifts constantly, bubbling—not with heat, but from tectonic forces. At random intervals a deep sound, not unlike a hiccup, bursts from the surface, showering the immediate vicinity with molten rock. But this geyser has not yet erupted with its full fury, and you can only hope that you are not nearby when it finally does.

Sunset At Sea.name:
海上落日
Sunset At Sea

Text.text:
太阳沿着波浪的地平线升起，仍在夜色守护的阴影中破开一道口子，以一把白色扇形的强光怒视而来，边缘参差如裂。仿佛神明睁开的眼点燃了水面，在楔形光束的中央刺得人睁不开眼，向外散去时又化作碎闪的粼粼。每一道起伏都像刻在蓝色铂金上，层层叠叠的繁复纹路在船周围铺展数里，映出永恒——远离陆地。

~ 由 Charles Haines 构想

Sun along the waves’ horizon, breaching still the protective shade of night, glares in a white fan, ragged along the edges. The open eye of a god ignites the water, blinding in the center of the wedge, glimmering as it disperses. Every undulation is etched as if on blue platinum, the miles of complicated patterns reflecting eternity around the ship—so far from land.

~ Envisioned by Charles Haines

Cyberpsychologist Connects To Cyberpsych.name:
赛博心理医生接入赛博精神病患者的大脑
Cyberpsychologist Connects To Cyberpsycho's Brain

Text.text:
赛博精神病学家将温和的目光转向对面被绑在座椅上的病人。他下巴上一滩口涎泛着亮光，睫毛颤动间，眼珠时不时翻回眼眶深处。瘦削的胸膛里漏出一口微弱的叹息，像风从破败的皮囊里逃走。

“尽量放松。”CP语气平平地说。她从一根细线末端拎起接口，细线连着一台高耸如服务器的机器。同样的线缆盘绕在病人头上，义体面板嗡鸣转动，竟比他本人更像活物。CP插入接口时，恶心地呼出一口气。她因病人脑海里幻化出的地狱景象而皱眉，短促而恼火地断断续续开口：“你得，呃，帮我一把。好么？”

他呜咽了一声，勉强算是回应。

“很好。跟着。我的声音。”

The cyberpsychologist turns her mild gaze toward a patient strapped to the seat across from her. A patch of drool shines on his chin, and his eyes periodically roll back into his head under fluttering lashes. He emits a weak sigh as breath escapes his emaciated chest.

“Try to relax,” the CP says flatly. She pulls up a jack at the end of a thin wire that hooks into a towering, server-like machine. The same wiring weaves around the patient’s head, where panels of cybernetics whir with more signs of life than he does. As the CP jacks in, she lets out a nauseated exhale. She speaks in short, angry spurts as she winces at whatever hellscape the patient’s mind has conjured. “You have to, ugh, help me out here. All right?”

He whimpers in what might be acknowledgement.

“Great. Follow. The sound. Of my voice.”

营地边缘堆着一大堆木柴。砍下这些的人要么打算把它们带走，要么准备在这里久留。虽然大多看起来刚被劈开，木头却显得陈旧——干燥发脆，随时可以投入火中。一把斧头嵌在竖立的圆木上，旁边是一小堆引火柴。
A huge pile of wood stands at the edge of the camp. Whoever cut this either plans to take it with them or they intend to stay in this spot for a long time. Though much of it looks freshly chopped, the wood looks old—dry and ready for the fire. An axe projects from a standing log, a pile of kindling beside it.

Seedy Tavern: The Regulars.name:
肮脏酒馆：老主顾
Seedy Tavern: The Regulars

Text.text:
汗臭与泼洒的麦酒味穿透木烟的气息，正如那群勉强称得上会弹的乐师叽里咕噜拨弄鲁特琴，轻易压过人群的嗡嗡低语。酒馆的客人们似乎在这粗陋的环境里也自得其乐——可猪在泥里打滚时，不也一样乐得开心。
The stink of sweat and spilled ale comes through the scent of woodsmoke just as easily as the musicians' barely-competent lute-prattling cuts through the murmur of the crowd. The tavern’s patrons seem happy enough despite their rude surroundings, but so are pigs pleased when they wallow in mud.

Taunt From A Demon About A Paladin's Mis.name:
恶魔对圣武士落空一击的嘲讽
Taunt From A Demon About A Paladin's Missed Strike

Text.text:
“承载着希望与神圣光辉的一击，却如此可悲地坠落至无功而返……或许你的庇护者并没有他们承诺的那般强大。”
“A blow laden with hope and divine light falling so pathetically short… Perhaps your patron is not as powerful as they promised.”

女妖双手紧扣胸口，目光投向远方，眼中尽是绝望。她的哀嚎仿佛自天边传来，却陡然拔高，化作足以撕裂心神的尖啸。

[Failed Save] 碾压般的剧痛在你感觉自己坠落的瞬间戛然而止，黑暗将你吞没。

[Successful Save] 你的感官一阵恍惚，但随着尖啸止息，脑海中的痛楚也随之退去。

The banshee clasps her hands over her heart and looks into the distance, her eyes full of despair. Her keening seems to come from far away but rises to a mind-shattering wail.

[Failed Save] Crushing pain ends when you feel yourself fall, and darkness takes you.

[Successful Save] Your senses falter, but the pain in your mind subsides as the shriek ends

Clean Pay-to-use Bathroom.name:
干净的付费厕所
Clean Pay-to-use Bathroom

Text.text:
你把信用筹码在门上的面板前一刷，电子嗓音随即叮地一声报出一句“欢迎光临！”踏入其中时，先前对扣费的烦躁也随之淡去——这间洗手间的内部竟比整栋建筑的其他地方都要干净。两只插满鲜花的花瓶之间放着一只篮子，里面是免费提供的个人用品；花香与几盏电子蜡烛的微光交织在一起，几乎把这地方的真实用途都掩盖过去。
You swipe your credit chit in front of a panel on the door, and an electronic voice chimes out a "Welcome!" Any annoyance at the charge fades away as you enter, since the inside of the restroom is cleaner than the rest of the building. A basket of complimentary personal items sits between two full vases of flowers, whose scent combined with a few electronic candles almost conceals the very nature of the room.

Speech By A Bard About The Life Of A Cit.name:
吟游诗人谈一座城的命运之词
Speech By A Bard About The Life Of A City

Text.text:
“你听见了吗，那成千上万的人在各自的日常里穿梭时发出的嗡鸣？伸手去抓取财富、生存与幸福？那旋律绝望，有时近乎癫狂，可凭神祇作证，世上再无第二种声音。每个参与者都把自己零散不齐的音符投入社会这部宏大的交响。我可以用余生去认识他们每一个人，而那将是不虚此生的一生。”
“Do you hear it, that hum of thousands of people going about their routines? Grasping at wealth, survival, and happiness? It is a desperate, sometimes manic tune, but by the gods, there is nothing else like it. Each participant contributes their own disjointed notes into a grand symphony of society. I could spend the rest of my life getting to know each and every one of them, and it would be a life well spent.”

嗡鸣的魔法弦线在你周身织成一座球形牢笼，每一根都绚烂夺目：绿、蓝、红、紫、银。交错咬合的光线随着你的动作一同弯折起舞。若有物体逼近，魔法便骤然闪耀，以金属般的音色叮咚颤鸣，蓄势待发，随时护卫。
Humming strings of magic form a spherical cage around you, each its own vibrant color: green, blue, red, purple, silver. These meshing lines bend and dance along with your own movements. If objects come too near, the magic flashes and trills with metallic timbre, preparing to protect.

Act Iii Of The Hierospite: The Disappear.name:
《神圣侍灵》第三幕：消失把戏
Act Iii Of The Hierospite: The Disappearing Act

Text.text:
他脸上掠过一丝迟疑：或许他并没有自己想的那么强——又或许，那位专门憎恨巫师的复仇之神并非如此。怒火瞬间吞没了他，但那枚护符已褪成灰色钢铁。他高举双手，张口放声。刺耳骇人的尖啸迸出：“阿波罗·诺乌斯的速度引我离开此地！”两名女子与一名男子——全都佩戴着护符——一手抓住他，另一手按住自己的护符。下一瞬，他们尽数消失。

The look on his face holds a trace of doubt: perhaps he is not as strong as he thought—or perhaps his vengeful god against wizards is not. Rage takes over, but the medallion has faded to gray steel. He raises both his hands and opens his mouth. A hideous cry emanates: “Speed of Apollo Novus guide me from this place!” Two women and a man, all wearing medallions, take hold of him with one hand and their medallions with the other. They all disappear.

Airship Sundered By Escaping Entity.name:
被逃逸实体撕裂的飞空艇
Airship Sundered By Escaping Entity

Text.text:
冰冷呼啸的狂风撕裂着船体，像刀一样割穿木梁、帆布、货物与人群。痛苦与恐惧的哭喊、木材断裂的爆响，被一声刺耳的尖啸吞没——那是绝望的声音，是愤怒的声音，是炽烈执念的声音。船身呻吟着、弯折着，随即在漫天飞溅的木屑中轰然炸裂；一道存在——冰寒、无定形、浩瀚无边——彻底贯穿了它，猛然向上冲起。尸体被掀得倒飞，重重拍在舱壁与栏杆上；而这艘飞船仍在破碎、仍在坠落，穿过无遮无拦的天空。

~ 由 Matty Ice 构想

Freezing, whistling gusts of air tear through the ship, cutting through wooden beams, sails, cargo, and people. Pained, fearful cries and the sundering of wood are muffled by a piercing shriek. It is a sound of despair, of anger, of ardor. The ship creaks, bending, and then explodes in a shower of splinters as an entity—cold, amorphous, and vast—breaks completely through it to surge upward. Bodies fling backward, flattening against walls and rails as the airship continues to break and fall through the open sky.

~ Envisioned by Matty Ice

Joaquin Rush, 3rd Year House Badger.name:
华金·拉什，獾院三年级
Joaquin Rush, 3rd Year House Badger

Text.text:
这孩子看起来像世上最愤怒的人。他的笑容冷得像鲨鱼的牙，他在休息时的表情也像冬夜一样刺骨。他脸上已经长出细密的深色绒须。双手布满疤痕，指关节常常擦破见血。他的兜帽几乎总是拉起——即便那几个朋友和他同行，也像是在跟着他走，而不是他跟着他们走。有时教授点到他，他会冲着人吼一句：“什么？”然后又道歉，可那道歉的语气让人觉得他未必真的觉得抱歉。
This kid looks like the angriest person alive. His smile is as cold as a shark’s, and his resting face as chilling as a winter night. He already has fine, dark facial hair. His hands are scarred and his knuckles often scraped. Usually his hood is up, even when his few friends walk with him—not him with them. Sometimes when a professor calls on him he barks, “What?” then apologizes in a way that indicates he might not really be sorry.

Halfling With Dagger.name:
持匕首的半身人
Halfling With Dagger

Text.text:
宽大、毛茸茸的脚掌无声踏过覆尘的石地，披斗篷的身影潜行穿过城中，轻巧地在阴影间游走。寒光一闪，金属在他们掌中乍现——他们抽出一柄匕首，然后静候。
Wide, hairy feet move silently on the dusty stone as the cloaked figure stalks through the city, flitting between the shadows with ease. A flash of metal appears in their hand as they draw a dagger—then wait.

Sundries From A Skeleton Warrior.name:
骷髅战士的杂货
Sundries From A Skeleton Warrior

Text.text:
覆着甲壳的蟑螂在泛黄的骨骸与锈蚀的护甲碎片间来回穿梭。一柄长矛躺在离骷髅（特征）伸出的铁手套仅一掌宽的地方，矛杆断成两截，碎裂的木刺参差外翻。
Chitinous roaches trail in and out between yellowed bone and rusted pieces of armor. A spear lies a hand’s breadth away from the skeleton’s outstretched gauntlet, its shaft snapped in two splintered pieces.

Dungeon: Corridor Turns Right.name:
地城：走廊向右转
Dungeon: Corridor Turns Right

Text.text:
走廊再向前延伸一小段便向右拐去。左侧墙壁坚固稳当——除非原路折返，否则想继续深入，似乎只能取整拐角前行。
The corridor continues only a little farther before turning right. The wall on the left-hand side is solid and stable–it seems rounding the corner is the only way to venture on, unless one was to return the way they came.

My Staff Of Charming Prevents My Enchant.name:
我的迷惑法杖反而阻止了我的魅惑效果
My Staff Of Charming Prevents My Enchantment

Text.text:
我感觉自己的意识开始从体内飘离，魔法渗入脑海，浑浊了我的判断与感官。片刻之间，我仿佛漂浮在一片缥缈的灵海之中——直到我的法杖被激活。它嗡鸣震颤，震得我牙关发麻，将我从昏沉恍惚中猛地拽回。
I feel my consciousness begin to drift away from me as magic seeps into my mind, clouding my judgement and senses. For a few moments I feel as if I am floating in an ethereal sea—until my staff activates. It vibrates, rattling my teeth, and shaking me out of my stupor.

成百上千头麋鹿披着赤褐色的皮毛，脖颈覆着深色蓬乱的鬃毛，在陆地迁徙的漫长旅途中稳步前行。鹿群一边游荡一边啃食，夹杂其间的少数雄鹿——头戴巨大弯曲的鹿角冠冕——以警觉的目光扫视着周遭地形。
Hundreds of elk, with russet coats and dark, shaggy necks, make steady progress on an overland trek. The herd wanders and grazes, the few bull elk among it—crowned with great curving antlers—training watchful eyes on the surrounding terrain.

干燥的风在此地哗啦作响，仿佛要把每个不幸踏入者那焦渴发红的皮肤生生剥落。惨白的枯骨从龟裂干涸的土地里探出，像折断的牙齿般嶙峋森然；灼烧的烈日又被盘旋上空、急切俯瞰的食腐鸟群投下的阴影所遮蔽。
A dry wind rattles through this place, threatening to flay the parched, reddened skin from anything unfortunate enough to be here. Bleached bones poke through the cracked, arid earth like broken teeth, and the burning sun is blotted out by the shadows of carrion birds circling eagerly above.

Booming Blade: Sword.name:
轰鸣之刃：剑
Booming Blade: Sword

Text.text:
你召来雷霆般的伟力，将其灌入一个朴素的戏法，随即施放在那把武器上。你能感觉到魔法渗入其中，充盈其身，令它更为强悍。你挥击而下，魔力随着落点轰然回荡。命中之际，你的目标踉跄后退，目光涣散，竭力维持平衡，挣扎着重新掌控自己的感官。

~ Envisioned by Blind Swordsman Wolf

You summon thunderous might, channeling it into a simple cantrip, and cast it onto the weapon. You can feel the magic permeate it, empower it. You strike and the magical force reverberates through its arrival. When it connects, your target reels, eyes unfocused and trying to maintain balance, struggling to gain control of their senses.

~ Envisioned by Blind Swordsman Wolf

I Detach A Sack Patch From My Robe Of Us.name:
我从【万用物品长袍】上撕下一块麻袋补丁
I Detach A Sack Patch From My Robe Of Useful Items

Text.text:
这块特别的补丁就像我魔法长袍上的一个小口袋。我用力扯了两下，把线缝撕开，硬生生将它从衣料上拽了下来。我抖它一下、再抖一下，直到它鼓胀开来，化作一个大得多的袋子。我双手撑开袋口，检查内里有没有瑕疵——但当然，它完美无缺。
This particular patch appears as a pocket on my magical robe. With a couple of seam-tearing tugs, I wrench it away from the garment. I shake it once, twice, until it balloons out into a much larger bag. I hold it open with both hands and check the interior for flaws—but, of course, it’s perfect.

Wide And Powerful River.name:
宽阔而强劲的河流
Wide And Powerful River

Text.text:
河水咆哮奔涌，汹涌的激流翻搅不息，几乎将深处的一切都搅成模糊不清。然而这深浅之问也不过是纸上谈兵——除了蠢货，没人会试图徒涉这条暴怒的河流，尤其是它的宽度惊人，足以让舰队的两艘船并排通行。最明智的做法，是沿河寻找更平缓的浅滩，或找到一座结构坚固的桥梁。
The river roars with currents so powerful that the churn all but obscures the depths. Yet the question is academic, as only a fool would attempt to ford this raging river, especially given its sizeable width—it could easily accommodate two ships of the fleet side-by-side. Searching for an easier ford or finding a stoutly constructed bridge would be most advisable.

这片区域里，树枝间密密层层地搭着房屋，每一座都用下垂的绳索吊桥与周围数座相连。整座村落都能安然栖身于叶海之中，几乎不必踏足地面一步。粗大的空心原木以树脂封缝，如今成了蓄积雨水的水库；果实在四周繁茂生长，几只动物在藤蔓垂挂的林枝间轻捷穿梭。部分更大的居所旁还能看见以木板与藤条匆匆搭成的简易升降机，一旦有变，便能作为安全的脱身通道。
Houses fill the branches of the trees in this area, each one joined to several of its neighbors via pendulous rope bridges. An entire village could comfortably be housed here among the leaves without ever needing to set foot on the ground. Large hollow logs have been sealed with tree sap and now act as reservoirs for rainwater, fruit grows plentifully all around, and several animals flit between the vine-draped branches of the forest. Makeshift elevators constructed from wooden planks and vines can be seen next to some of the larger dwellings, providing a safe escape route should the need arise.

沉重的利爪踏足声在你周围轰然回荡，野兽闯入。它背上簇生出猩红的棘刺——长短与间距仿佛毫无规律——从覆鳞的额脊一路蔓延到盘曲畸尾的尖端。野兽八只利爪脚笨拙挪动，翻搅着地面。深蓝的眼睛仿佛在幽幽发光，它猛然甩头四顾，涎沫飞溅——张开的巨口里露出一排排参差不齐、尖锐破碎的獠牙。
The pounding of heavy, clawed feet resounds around you as the beast enters. Crimson spines sprout from its back—seemingly random in length and interval—encompassing everything from its scaly brow to the tip of its gnarled tail. The beast’s eight clawed feet churn the ground as it moves clumsily. Deep blue eyes seem to glow as it whips its head around, spittle flying—its open mouth revealing rows of ragged pointed teeth.

施法者的双手被一层光辉环绕，那是他们力量蓄满电光的根基。他们神情专注，像运动员，又像技艺臻至化境的表演大师。所有技艺的技能，都凝在那一只眼里。他们向目标伸出手，那道由磨炼而成的钢铁般掌控感，随之传递到受术者身上。
A glow surrounds the hands of the caster, the charged basis of their strength. They adopt a focused look, like that of an athlete or a master performer. All the skill of their craft in one eye. They reach out to the target, and that steely look of learned mastery passes to the recipient.

灰沉的天幕与惨白的浪涛映照着甲板上的肃穆气息，葬礼就此开始。有人以沉默的坚忍扛起失去的重担——将情绪的重量揽在肩上，好让他人在无情的悲恸激流吞没时仍有支援——也有人放声痛哭，泪水与咸涩的浪沫交织，缠进清冽的海风。一名面色如土的女子主持仪式，她那沾满污渍的围裙与此刻的礼仪庄严格格不入。船员们目送亡者踏上最后的航程时，一名年轻人死死攥住栏杆，疲惫的眼眶因悲伤而红肿刺痛。

~ 由 Clara C. Potter 于 Discord 上 Envisioned

The gray skies and pallid waves reflect the somber mood on deck as the funeral begins. Some bear the burden of loss with quiet stoicism—shouldering the emotional weight so that others have support as the merciless riptide of grief swallows them—as others weep openly, their tears mingling with the salty spray lacing the crisp sea air. A woman with an earthen pallor leads the service, her grimy smock incongruous with the ceremonial nature of the occasion. As the crew watch the final journey of the deceased, a young man clutches the rail, his weary eyes raw with grief.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Ruined Section Of City.name:
城市废墟地带
Ruined Section Of City

Text.text:
你发现城里这一片街区的寂静令人不安。四周断壁残垣高高耸立，窗洞与门框大张着，仿佛也在惊愕于自身的毁灭。一场巨大的灾厄将坍塌的屋顶与崩裂的墙体化作瓦砾，洒满道路与巷弄。被烈火掏空的建筑石墙上，烟灰留下了斑驳的污痕。
You find the silence in this quarter of the city unsettling. Ruined buildings loom high on all sides, their windows and doors agape in seeming astonishment at their own destruction. A great calamity littered the roads and alleys with rubble from fallen roofs and collapsed walls. Soot stains the stone of buildings gutted by fire.

I Overindulge With Gnomish Candy.name:
我暴食矮精糖果
I Overindulge With Gnomish Candy

Text.text: 我俯身撑着自己鼓胀的肚子，视线微微发花，时不时被一阵彩虹般的斑点点亮。每一道声音都像被拔高了音调，忽高忽低地扭曲着，滑稽得发傻，却又刺得耳朵发闷发恶。那盒糖果先前实在让人无法抗拒——柑橘软糖挑衅般的酸香，中心却诡异地像液体一样流动；缠绕的甘草绳上撒着糖渍姜末；还有橡果形、枫糖风味的松露糖里那一口安抚人心的香草奶霜。可现在……只要一想到又有一颗糖在牙间被挤碎，或沿着舌面滑过去，就足以让我灼烧的胸口涌起一声酸涩的嗝。 I lean over my ballooned belly, vision slightly blurry and periodically alight with a rainbow array of spots. Every sound seems high-pitched, warbled, silly yet sickening to the ear. The box of sweets had been so undeniable—the taunting tang of citrus chews with strangely liquid centers, twirls of licorice rope dusted with candied ginger, the soothing taste of vanilla creme in the center of acorn-shaped, maple-flavored truffles. But now… the thought of another candy squishing into my teeth or sliding over my tongue is enough to elicit an acidic belch from my burning chest.

Fake Cloak Of Protection.name:
伪造的防护斗篷
Fake Cloak Of Protection

Text.text:
这件深蓝色兜帽斗篷在肩头披着一圈锁子甲护肩，用来保护穿戴者——至少乍看之下是如此。可那护肩接触起来却柔软无比，原来只是一层带纹理的布料，在光线下泛着微微的闪辉。斗篷背部有个又大又破烂的洞，仿佛在嘲讽：它的前任主人并没能被它好好保护。
The dark blue hooded cloak has a capelet of chain mail about the shoulders to protect its wearer—or so it seems at first. The capelet is soft to the touch, actually a layer of textured cloth that shimmers in the light. A large, tattered hole in the back of the cloak suggests that its previous owner wasn’t very well protected by it.

Word Of Dire Warning From A Hunting Part.name:
来自狩猎队领队的严厉警告
Word Of Dire Warning From A Hunting Party Leader

Text.text:
“若你来此是想证明自己，满身圣徽与虚张声势，我劝你现在就回头。这场狩猎，是我们与那些在我等土地上潜行的可憎孽畜之间立下的自杀契约。我无法许你荣光，唯有复仇。”
“If you have come here hoping to prove yourself, decorated in holy symbols and bravado, I ask that you turn back now. This hunt is a suicide pact between us and the damnable creatures that stalk our lands. I cannot promise you glory, only vengeance.”

峭壁之巅的高塔傲然屹立，无惧狂风暴雨，任凭下方深处海浪轰然拍碎。那建筑细长如纺锤，狭窄得不适合居住，但塔顶那抹光辉昭示了它真正的用途。上方跳动的炽白篝火必定出自魔法，想必在海上数里之外也清晰可见。
The tower atop the cliff stands defiant of any storm winds and the waves that crash far below. The narrow spindle of a building isn’t great for housing people, but the light glowing atop it shows what purpose it does suit. The bright white bonfire that flickers there must be magical and is likely visible for miles out to sea.

云层低垂，笼罩着一座被葱郁繁茂的绿色几乎淹没的山谷。溪流在大地间蜿蜒穿行，最终汇入谷地中心一汪粼粼闪光的湖泊。鸟儿懒散地掠过树冠，在一处瀑布上空成群盘旋，瀑布倾泻而下，将丰沛水量注入谷中。阳光穿透薄雾，勾出一抹淡淡的彩虹。
Clouds hang over a valley choked with vibrant greenery. Streams wind through the landscape, meeting in a shimmering lake at the vale's heart. Birds flit lazily above the canopy, congregating over a waterfall emptying its bounty into the vale. Sunlight shines through the mist, forming a faint rainbow.

这张泛黄的羊皮纸上标注的土地与地名，与你所认知的那片区域真实格局似乎略有出入。墨绘的经纬线，以及用蓝、红、绿区分地形的色块都已黯淡不清，某些地方甚至彻底褪尽。罗盘玫瑰的独特样式与边框沿线的插画，暗示着另一种文化、另一个时代……或两者皆是。
The lands and location names on this yellowed stretch of parchment seem slightly different from how you understand the true lay of the pictured region. The inked lines of latitude and longitude and the blues, reds, and greens differentiating terrain are dull and fully faded in some areas. The unique design of the compass rose and the illustrations along the border suggest the stylizations of a different culture, a different time… or both.

I Cast Druidcraft To Forecast The Weathe.name:
我施展德鲁伊工艺，预卜天气
I Cast Druidcraft To Forecast The Weather

Text.text:
我闭上双眼，感受周遭自然之力的流动。我一边诵念吾环的神圣箴言，一边在空中描绘古老的符印，将意志凝聚于此：探知这片区域的天气预报。当我睁开眼时，一团魔能在我摊开的掌心上方凝成光球——将答案呈现于我。
I close my eyes and tune in to the energies of nature around me. I trace an ancient sigil in the air as I speak the hallowed words of my Circle and focus on my intent: to learn the weather forecast for this area. I open my eyes as a ball of magical energy forms above my open hand—showing me the answer.

裂隙向下坠入黑暗，底部已不见踪影。两侧龟裂粗糙的岩壁让人看到些许攀爬的希望，但若不往深渊里丢下一束光，你根本无法判断要花多久才能穿越它。
The crevasse drops away into darkness, its bottom out of sight. The cracked and rough sides provide some hope of climbing, but there’s no telling how long it would take to traverse it unless you drop a light into the chasm.

Starving, Emaciated Werewolf.name:
饥饿、形销骨立的狼人
Starving, Emaciated Werewolf

Text.text:
这头巨大的生物发出轻软而可怜的呜咽，像幼兽般细细哀鸣，耳朵与尾巴低低耷拉。它那覆着粗硬毛发的脊背弓向天空，颤抖着隆起成尖峰，破碎的衣物残片披挂在前臂与腰间。还没来得及再迈出一步，它便轰然倒地，肋骨剧烈起伏，从枯槁萎缩的躯干上根根凸出。它的双眼浑浊发红、目光飘远，嘴边结着发黄的胆汁硬痂。它一边哀嚎，一边用巨爪在地上徒劳地刨动，像在进行一场魅影（特征）的狩猎。
The large creature whimpers soft, pathetic mewls, ears and tail drooping low. Its rough-furred spine bends toward the sky in a shaky peak, the remnants of clothes draped along its forearms and waist. Before it can take another step, it falls to the ground, ribs heaving and sticking out from its withering torso. Its eyes are rheumy and distant, its mouth crusted with yellow bile. Whining, its massive paws pedal at the ground in a phantom hunt.

I Have Primeval Awareness.name:
我拥有原初感知
I Have Primeval Awareness

Text.text:
我抬头望向天空，俯视脚下大地，又环顾四周。我的灵魂敞开。微风的去向、云朵的形状、树叶的沙沙作响、鸟儿的歌唱、野兽的移动——皆是征兆，亦是警示。它们揭示此地超自然存在的踪迹，并告诉我它们是什么。
I look up at the sky, down at the ground, and gaze about me. My spirit is open. The direction of the breeze, shapes of clouds, rustling of leaves, songs of birds, and movement of beasts are all omens, warnings. They reveal the presence of supernatural beings in this region, and tell me what they are.

Raven Angel Of Death.name:
渡鸦·死亡天使
Raven Angel Of Death

Text.text:
冷风在墓园里低低叹息，打断了苍白草叶的死寂，也搅动了倚在墓碑旁那一束束将枯的花。熟悉的鸦科啼叫骤然划破宁静，声响在一座座坟茔间来回弹跳。黑翼翻卷，嘶哑乱鸣，一群渡鸦如潮水般灌入墓园。它们化作一团喧嚣的乌云——黑羽泛着油亮的光——急促地在墓地中央聚拢。喙、爪与翼相互碰撞间，一个身影被拼合出来：女子的轮廓，身披竖立刺翎的羽衣与灰鳞护甲。羽海之中，她瓷白的面容浮现。那存在的长发乌墨般深黑，光泽流转；一对渡鸦之翼自她背后伸展，筋骨牵动，发出吱呀作响的低鸣。

~ Envisioned by Bangalulu

Cold wind sighs through the graveyard, interrupting the stillness of the pale grass and wilting flower bouquets nestled against headstones. The familiar croak of a corvid call shatters the tranquility completely, bouncing from one burial to the next. In a flurry of black wings and hoarse cries, a flock of ravens floods the graveyard. A cacophonous cloud—black feathers glistening with oil—the birds gather in a rush at the center of the cemetery. A figure forms as beak, talon, and wing collide: a feminine form, her body wrapped in bristling, feathered garments and armor of gray scales. Her porcelain-white face emerges from within the sea of feathers. The being’s hair is long, shining, and ink dark, and a pair of raven wings stretches out from her back with sinewy creaks.

~ Envisioned by Bangalulu

Quip About An Elf After A Miss.name:
未击中后对精灵的俏皮挖苦
Quip About An Elf After A Miss

Text.text:
“你都练了几百年，怎么还是准头这么烂？我见过醉醺醺的孩子都比你射得准。”
“How can you practice for centuries and still have such poor aim? I’ve seen drunk children shoot better than you.”

Insult From A Wounded Companion About Af.name:
来自受伤同伴对来世的讥讽
Insult From A Wounded Companion About Afterlife

Text.text:
“有没有一套祷文顺序，能保证我死后去的来世跟你要去的那个地方不一样？”
“Is there some sequence of prayers that will make sure I end up in a different afterlife than wherever you’re going?”

一头巨大的海象猛地向前扑落，靠着两只长满尖刺、泛着青绿的鳍肢灵巧摆动，托住它沉重的负载。它咧开灿烂的笑，四根獠牙从口边垂下，每一根都刻着繁复的纹样。那身青铜护甲为这生物强健的躯体量身打造。湿润的水珠沿着它甲壳上复杂的鎏金纹饰缓缓淌落。
A huge walrus flops itself forward, supporting its weighty bulk with deft movements from two spined greenish flippers. Four tusks hang from a beaming smile, each one decorated with intricate patterns. The bronze armor is custom fitted to the creature’s powerful body. Moisture trickles down the complex gilding on its carapace.

身披闪耀的板甲，圣武士眼睁睁看着她的伙伴们倒在地上，双手死死捂住耳朵，而邪教首领正低声咕哝着恶毒的诅咒。她咬紧牙关，握紧巨剑，朝那披袍的身影冲去——一剑贯穿，将他钉在刃上；他双眼骤然睁大，满是惊骇。痛苦散去，圣武士的伙伴们围拢上前，笑容绽开，无声的欢呼在他们的目光里翻涌。

~ 由 Played 扮演，来自 Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Clad in gleaming plate mail, the paladin watches her companions fall to the ground, clutching their hands to their ears as the cult leader mutters a vicious curse. Gritting her teeth and tightening the grip on her greatsword, she runs toward the robed figure, impaling him on her blade as his eyes go wide with shock. Free from their agony, the paladin’s companions surround her with smiling faces and silent cheers.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Sundries From A Voodoo Priestess.name:
巫毒女祭司的杂货
Sundries From A Voodoo Priestess

Text.text:
女人的身躯上挂满了各式阴森的护符与厌胜物——由骨头、木材与羽毛制成。你虽不明白这些古怪饰物的含义，却仍不由得心生不安。
The woman's body is festooned with all manner of eerie talismans and fetishes—crafted from bone, wood, and feathers. Though you do not understand the significance of these strange accoutrements, they make you feel uneasy.

Longbow And Arrows.name:
长弓与箭矢
Longbow And Arrows

Text.text:
苍白的紫杉木纤细而优雅，宛如芭蕾舞者，长七十二英寸，打磨得熠熠生辉。握把与休息处显出顺手的磨痕，显然这把武器一直被精心照料。纺捻的亚麻弓弦安静而坚韧，拉力只适合受过训练的人或格外强壮者。一束箭矢就放在一旁，没有箭袋；以鹅羽高效制羽，简洁利落，不加任何花哨。
The pale yew wood is as slim and elegant as a ballerina, seventy-two inches long and polished to gleaming. Its grip and rest show comfortable wear, the weapon clearly cared for. The spun flax bowstring is quiet and tough, and the pull is only suited for the trained or especially strong. A clutch of arrows lies nearby without a quiver, efficiently fletched with goose feathers and without flare.

Gnarled Champion Issues A Challenge.name:
盘根虬结的勇士发出挑战
Gnarled Champion Issues A Challenge

Text.text:
寂静笼罩着王廷，一名巨人踏入大厅，他坐骑沉重的蹄声在烛光摇曳的厅室里回荡。骑士们把手按在剑柄上，陌生人却举起一柄巨大的双手巨斧——并指向聚集的战士们。他的皮肤宛如饱经风霜、覆着青苔的虬曲橡树树皮；当他张口开言时，那表皮随之龟裂作响，向所有胆敢以职责与荣誉之名迎战的人发出挑战。寂静再度落下——这次裹挟着紧绷的张力——他驱马沿着弧形石长凳缓缓绕行，挑衅般逼人开口。

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Silence falls over the court as a giant enters the hall, the ponderous footsteps of his horse echoing around the candlelit chamber. Knights rest their hands upon sword hilts as the stranger raises a titanic greataxe—and points at the assembled warriors. His skin resembles the weathered, mossy bark of a gnarled oak and it cracks as he opens his mouth the speak, issuing a challenge to any who would dare face him in the name of duty and honor. The silence falls once more—now laden with tension—as he walks his horse around the curved stone bench daring someone to speak up.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Onyx Dog (Wondrous Figurine).name:
缟玛瑙猎犬（奇物小雕像）
Onyx Dog (Wondrous Figurine)

Text.text:
幽暗中闪着微光的，是一段一英寸长的缟玛瑙，雕成一头昂首的獒犬。它深阔的胸膛与结实的后臀被刻得极其精到，皮毛打磨得如镜般明亮，映着你游移的目光。它比应有的更沉，还散发着可触可感的温热。你一接触它，脑海里便泛起一阵回响——仿佛抽空肺腑的长嚎在思绪间震荡——在主人与猎犬之间结成一条原始而牢固的纽带。
Gleaming through the gloom is an inch-long piece of onyx carved in the semblance of a proud mastiff. Its deep chest and muscled haunches are expertly sculpted, the fur polished to a mirror-shine that reflects your roving eyes. It seems heavier than it should and radiates a palpable warmth. As you touch it, you sense an echo in your mind—a lung-emptying howl reverberating through your thoughts—forming a primal bond betwixt master and hound.

一团闪烁、半透明的恶臭毒气缓缓渗出，像一把温热而轻易挤出的令人作呕的热浪。气泡从它的表面不断升起。在昏暗光照中，你很快就看不清它了——它的形态忽隐忽现，时而凝成浑浊的实体，时而又散作透明的虚影，以一种自然而然的伪装节奏闪烁不定。
A shimmering, transparent mass of noxious gas trickles forth, a warm and easy squeeze of nauseous heat. Bubbles rise from its surface. You lose sight of it in the dim light, its form flickering in and out of opaque existence with a natural pattern of camouflage.

Quip About A Strange Companion.name:
关于一个古怪同伴的俏皮话
Quip About A Strange Companion

Text.text:
“你是我见过最令人费解的人。仿佛你脑海的零件被装错了位置，可你却凭着那股离经叛道的意志，硬生生拼出了清醒的自我。”
“You are the most perplexing person I’ve ever met. It’s as if your mind’s parts were put in the wrong places, yet you conjure consciousness through sheer eccentric will.”

Magical Detection Of A Character's Class.name:
对角色职业的魔法侦测失败
Magical Detection Of A Character's Class Fails

Text.text:
当你伸手触及时，一团薄雾裹上你的双手，绕着它们旋转翻涌，向前猛推，仿佛急于逃逸；随即“噗”地一声坍落在地。只有你能看见这一切。
When you reach out, a mist envelops your own hands, whirls around them and pushes forward as if trying to escape, then collapses to the floor with a puff. Only you see this happen.

Sundries From An Arcane Mezzoloth.name:
秘法梅佐洛斯的杂货
Sundries From An Arcane Mezzoloth

Text.text:
那身形轻捷、如豺狼般的存在携着成摞的空白羊皮纸、墨水与卷轴筒。那些书写材料品质卓绝，却对大多数人而言派不上什么用场。
The lithe jackal-like being carries reams of blank parchment, inks, and scroll cases. The writing materials are of superlative quality but of little use to most people.

Loot From An Ankheg Tunnel.name:
拾自安基赫虫隧道的战利品
Loot From An Ankheg Tunnel

Text.text:
翻找这只生物咯吱作响、血肉横飞的残躯，一无所获。然而，当你探头望进它掘出的地道时，却发现其中散落着它先前某位受害者被撕碎、四分五裂的残骸。骸骨与破布之间，你瞥见一枚金质印戒，以及一个束口袋——里面装着100枚金币。
Searching the creature’s crunching, gore-splattered carcass yields nothing of value. However, peering into the tunnel that it burrowed through, you find the shattered, scattered remains of one of its previous victims. Among the bones and tattered cloth, you spot a gold signet ring and a drawstring pouch filled with 100 gold pieces.

Sundries From A Piercer.name:
来自穿刺怪的杂物
Sundries From A Piercer

Text.text:
这只丑陋的幼虫生物在原地扭动乱跳了片刻，随即僵住死去；它耷拉的嘴巴张得大开，露出参差不齐的一排排歪斜牙齿。刺鼻的恶臭猛然冲入空气，黏液从这污秽之物的每一处孔窍里迸涌喷出。那液体或许能为你心怀怨毒的谋划派上用场——比如做成一枚臭弹——但这股经久不散的臭味，必定会从你用来盛装它的任何容器里一点点渗出。
The hideous larval creature wriggles and hops in place for a moment before settling into death, its drooping mouth hanging open to reveal its crooked rows of teeth. A vile stench assaults the air as gushes of mucus erupt from every orifice the foul thing possesses. The liquid could be useful to use for your own spiteful machinations—a stink bomb, perhaps—but such a persistent stench would most surely eke through any vessel you use to capture it.

Natalie \"Jack\" Graymoon.name:
娜塔莉“杰克”·灰月
Natalie "Jack" Graymoon

Text.text:
光洁的肌肤、量身定制并打磨得锃亮的板甲，以及精致的饰品与器具，都在暗示这位身形矮小纤细的年轻女子出身于财富之家。不过，她依然将棕发以利落实用的方式束在脑后，而她的道具——包括腰带上一整套工具——则带着真正使用过的磨损痕迹。左胯的长剑以月长石为剑首，剑柄却被握得发亮。她沉着自若，透出技能与随时出手的准备。她以一只榛色眼与一只蓝眼打量周遭，神情机敏又带几分戏谑。她肩头那条拇指大小、蝶翼般的幼龙，也露出相似却更为欢快的表情。

~ Played by DiscoRei

Smooth skin, customized, polished plate armor, and fine accessories and implements suggest this short, slender young woman comes from wealth. She keeps her brown hair pulled back in a practical style, though, and her gear—including an assortment of tools on her belt—has seen the wear of real use. The longsword on her left hip has a moonstone pommel, but the grip is worn shiny. Her composure implies skill and readiness. Watching with one hazel eye and one blue, she has a clever, amused look. The tiny, butterfly-winged dragon on her shoulder wears a similar, if more jovial, expression.

~ Played by DiscoRei

Quip About Big Decisions.name:
关于重大抉择的俏皮话
Quip About Big Decisions

Text.text:
“每当我必须做出这种攸关生死的决定时，我总会说：重要的是让别人来做决定，这样他们就能替我背锅。那么，你觉得我们该怎么办？”
“When I’m faced with making a grave decision like this, I always say it’s important to let someone else make it, so they can take the blame. So, what do you think we should do?”

Half-elf Brags About Skill Versatility.name:
半精灵吹嘘自己技能的多面性
Half-elf Brags About Skill Versatility

Text.text:
“嗯，我们每个人都有某种独到的天赋，有一项我们尤为擅长的技能。有些人甚至有两项。或者，*咳嗯*，好几项。”
“Well, we’ve all got a talent for something specific, a skill at which we excel. Some of us even have two. Or, *ahem*, several.”

Depressed Middle Manager.name:
郁郁不得志的中层经理
Depressed Middle Manager

Text.text:
男人一手从沾满污渍的西装里摸出一包香烟，另一手接起电话。每吸一口，他嘴里最常吐出的词就是“是的”、“长官”和“对不起”。一名雇员从旁边的门口经过，男人扬起手，带着几分强装的乐观挥了挥，但那下属连看都不看，径直无视了他。
The man slips a pack of cigarettes out of his stained suit with one hand as he accepts a call with the other. The most common words between drags are "yes," "sir," and "sorry." An employee passes by the nearby door, and the man offers an optimistic wave, but his underling ignores it entirely.

I Read An Abjuration Spell Scroll I Unde.name:
我读了一张防护系法术卷轴，我懂了
I Read An Abjuration Spell Scroll I Understand

Text.text:
当我吟读这道法术时，诡异的奥术符号在我眼前自行重排。防护结界沿着卷轴边缘列阵，环绕着中央井然有序的文字，宛如一支密集的方阵。
The strange arcane symbols rearrange themselves before my eyes as I read the spell. Protective wards border the edges of the scroll, forming a phalanx around the neatly ordered text at its center.

A Ghostly Warrior Stands Guard Beside A.name:
一名幽魂战士伫立在破碎的坟冢旁，森然守望
A Ghostly Warrior Stands Guard Beside A Broken Tomb

Text.text:
坚毅而沉静，这名幽灵（特征）以挺直的军人风骨伫立，哪怕已履职无数岁月。阴冷的微风摇响坟墓入口悬挂的骨铃，裹挟着腐朽与被遗忘记忆的霉湿气息扑面而来。
Stoic and resolute, the ghost stands with straight-backed martial discipline, despite untold years of duty. A chill breeze rattles the bone chimes hanging from the tomb’s entrance and carries the musty smell of decay and forgotten memories.

Malirius Mahmud.name:
马利里乌斯·马哈茂德
Malirius Mahmud

Text.text:
你面前这名蓝皮提夫林格外惹眼。他体型修长精悍，像匕首般锋利。鲜亮的翠绿眼眸带着猫科般的竖瞳，黑色巩膜从一张棱角分明、线条冷硬的脸上凝视着你。他脊背挺直、姿态高贵，隐约透着克制的傲气，却又以温暖友好的气度化开锋芒；而獠牙、利爪与破碎如蝠翼的残翅等野性特征，更与之形成强烈对照。他右手上一枚印戒闪着冷光。

~ Played by Lazaeris with

The blue-skinned tiefling before you strikes an eye-catching figure. His stature is lean, athletic, and built like a dagger. Eyes of vivid green with catlike pupils and black sclera peer from a face with hard, angular features. His regal, straight-backed bearing and subdued haughtiness is belied by a warm, welcoming demeanor, further juxtaposed with bestial qualities like fangs, claws, and tattered, batlike wings. A signet ring gleams on his right hand.

~ Played by Lazaeris with

Pity From A Hivemind.name:
来自蜂群意识的怜悯
Pity From A Hivemind

Text.text:
“我们感知到你的心智，可怜之人，察觉它在你孤壳的孤寂里扭曲挣扎的痛苦。但我们能赐你安宁。只需放松。放开你的心智，你将被蜂巢的爱拥抱，直至永恒。”
“We feel your mind, pitiful one, sense its distress as it writhes in the solitude of your shell. But we can bring you peace. Simply relax. Release your mind and you will be held for all eternity by the love of the hive.”

比一只老鼠龇牙更令人脊背发凉的，只有一堆老鼠。鼠群凶狠又狡黠，腥臭的皮毛纠缠成一团，扭动的尾巴像尸蜡般的蛆虫。那些关于“白毛小鼠在干净笼子里安睡”的可爱想象，在这些翻垃圾、钻下水道的东西身上毫无踪影。只要有一点声响，它们便齐齐停下，红眼一瞬间齐刷刷转向那声音，随即又迅捷而忙碌地回去，继续它们污秽的密谋。
The only thing more chilling than one rat baring its teeth is a pile of them. The horde, vicious and cunning, is a mass of rank fur, with wriggling tails like cadaverous worms. Whatever that might be cute about a white one sleeping in a clean cage doesn’t exist in these garbage crawlers and sewer dwellers. At a noise, they all stop and turn their red gazes toward it, just for an instant, and then return, quick and busy, to their septic conspiracies.

Icy Mafia Torpedo.name:
冰冷的黑手党鱼雷
Icy Mafia Torpedo

Text.text:
他抬手理了理那条挺括的红色领带，深邃的黑眼珠以冷漠而高效的目光锁定目标。嘴角掠过一丝笑意，因残忍的意图而扭曲变形，在他满是疤痕的脸上缓缓铺开；与此同时，他的手指在狙击步枪的触发上逐渐收紧。屋顶的栖身处掠过一阵冷风，吹得碎屑在砾石间翻滚飞散，可他那梳得一丝不乱、向后抹得油亮的头发却纹丝不动。
Adjusting his crisp red tie, the man's dark eyes settle onto his targets with detached efficiency. A slight smile, warped and twisted with cruel intention, spreads across his heavily scarred face as his finger tightens on the sniper rifle’s trigger. A cool breeze drifts across this rooftop perch, blowing loose detritus across the gravel, yet his perfectly quaffed, slicked-back hair remains unmoved.

Insult About A Dispassionate Character.name:
对冷漠角色的羞辱
Insult About A Dispassionate Character

Text.text:
“我在想……要是我们明天全都被人残忍地杀了，你连眼皮都不会眨一下吗？还是你会转身就走，去找下一群人，好把你那漫无目的的生活里的时代填满？”
“I wonder… If we were all brutally murdered tomorrow, would you even blink? Or would you just wander off in search of the next group to fill the time in your shiftless life?”

Retro Suburban Setting.name:
复古郊区设定
Retro Suburban Setting

Text.text: 郊区的盛夏：修剪得一丝不苟的草坪整齐排开，衬着一栋栋占地宽阔、宛如画报般的完美住宅。一名穿着宽肩西装外套的女人走向车道里的蓝色掀背车，高跟鞋在浅色混凝土上敲出清脆的声响。微风掀动她烫卷的头发，她回头冲门廊上的两个男孩喊：“冰箱里有沙利斯伯里牛排！别点披萨！”男孩们懒洋洋地应了声“嗯——”，脸埋在讲UFO和怪物的漫画里，连头都没抬。几名骑车的孩子从街上呼啸而过，脏兮兮的球鞋猛蹬踏板。随即，一辆敞篷车载着一群少年追了上来——一团尾气与笑声——开车的男孩嘴里嚼着一大团口香糖。他在街尾咧嘴一笑。车子猛地一把转向，轮胎尖叫，朋友们兴奋地嚎叫，转瞬便消失在另一排房屋之后。 Summertime in suburbia: neat rows of manicured lawns fronting picture-perfect homes of sprawling square footage. A woman in a broad-shouldered suit jacket approaches the blue hatchback in her driveway, heels clicking against the pale concrete. Her permed hair is buffeted by the breeze as she turns back to two boys on the porch. “Salisbury steak in the freezer! Don’t order pizza!” They respond with a lackadaisical yeah, not lifting faces buried in comics about UFOs and monsters. A group of kids on bikes pass, flying down the street as their smudged sneakers pump the pedals. They are overtaken by a group of teens in a convertible—a cloud of exhaust and laughter—driven by a boy working a wad of gum. He smirks as he reaches the end of the street. His friends howl with delight as the car turns fast, tires screeching, and they disappear beyond another row of houses.

Trendy Joygirl.name:
潮流欢愉女郎
Trendy Joygirl

Text.text:
女人用丰润、镶满宝石的唇吹起一颗亮粉色的泡泡，冲着聚集的镜头眨眼，又比出一个和平手势。她那身霓虹服装里嵌着可编程的LED丝带，无尽循环滚动着赞助商的名字。蓝发随意扎成松松的马尾，她在舞台上活力十足地蹦跳穿梭，牢牢攫住如痴如醉的观众。可凑近细看，那双兴奋的眼睛深处却藏着一抹安静的哀伤——也许，这并不是她曾经梦见的生活。
Blowing a bright pink bubble between her plump, bejeweled lips, the woman winks, flashing a peace sign at the assembled cameras. Her neon clothing is embedded with programmed LED ribbons that scroll the names of her sponsors in an endless loop. Blue hair tied back in a loose ponytail, she bounces energetically across the stage, captivating her enthralled audience. At a closer look, however, there’s a quiet sadness behind her exuberant eyes—perhaps this is not the life she dreamed of.

Feedham’s Fillies In Winter.name:
寒冬里的费德汉姆雌驹
Feedham’s Fillies In Winter

Text.text: 马厩里腾起一缕缕细小的白汽，马栏中的马儿喷着响鼻、嘶鸣不止。一个穿着厚重大衣、戴着毛皮帽的侏儒给其中一匹马披上毯子；那母马俯下头，让他抚摸她的鼻尖，他还在那柔软的鼻端轻轻落下一吻。忽然有一间马栏哐啷作响，里面的马猛地人立而起，又重重踏落，焦躁的低吼嘶哑刺耳。侏儒从牙缝里朝她吹了声口哨，小跑到栏前，摆弄着锁扣。 “稳住，姑娘。下一条毯子就给你。我说稳住——”门闩咔嗒一声弹开，那匹马便从门边猛冲而出，把侏儒撞翻在地。她沿着路狂奔而去，马蹄在覆冰的地面上踉跄打滑，仿佛随时都会从身下失去支撑。 The stables billow with small puffs of steam as the horses in the stalls snort and whinny. A gnome wearing a heavy coat and fur cap throws a blanket over one of the horses, and she leans down so he can pet her nose, on which he plants a kiss. One of the stalls rattles as the horse within rears up and stomps down, her grunts hoarse in agitation. The gnome whistles at her through the gap in his teeth, jogging over to the pen and fiddling with the lock. “Hold on there, girl. We’ll get you a blanket next. I said hold—” As the latch clicks open, the horse bolts past the door, sending the gnome to the ground. She gallops down the road, her hooves threatening to slip out from under her on the icy ground.

一具血肉之躯飘然而至，机械化的昆虫般长腿软塌塌地垂在下方。它的背上滋生着怪异的紫色囊状椭圆体，圆鼓鼓地鼓起。那张脸上，嵌在张开的环形巨口周围的眼睛闪烁着黯淡的微光。它介于活体器官与粗制滥造的机器之间。它的躯体渗出金属般的分泌物，宛如点点闪烁的晶体。一条孤零零的手臂从口下别扭地伸出，仿佛被孩子胡乱嫁接上去。刺耳的灵能噪响回荡四周。
A fleshy body hovers into view, with mechanical insectoid legs hanging limply beneath it. Strange, purple, globular ovals sprout from its back. Upon the face, eyes slotted into place around a yawning circular maw flicker with a dull light. It is something between a living organ and a haphazard machine. Its body secretes metallic discharge that appears much like twinkling crystals. A singular arm juts out awkwardly from under its mouth, as though grafted on by a child. A cacophony of psychic energy echoes out.

I Cast Find Familiar: Pseudodragon.name:
我施放《寻觅魔宠》：伪龙
I Cast Find Familiar: Pseudodragon

Text.text:
在一只黄铜火盆中——那火盆铸成龙颅之形——我点燃木炭与龙树树脂，并投下一片龙鳞与一截蝎尾。我用龙语吟唱一首关于仁善与羁绊的歌，持续一个多小时。与此同时，我焚起薰衣草、啤酒花与罂粟，直到芬芳的赤红烟雾悬在空中。我推开一扇窗，让烟雾飘散出去。不久，一只伪龙——我新结识的伙伴——落在窗台上。
In a brass brazier shaped like the skull of a dragon, I burn charcoal and dragon-tree resin with a dragon’s scale and scorpion’s tail. I sing a song of kindness and connection in Draconic for more than an hour. Meanwhile, I burn lavender, hops, and poppy until a fragrant red smoke hangs in the air. I open a window to let the smoke drift. Soon a pseudodragon, my new partner, lands on the sill.

Hangover From Heavy Drinking.name:
酗酒后的宿醉
Hangover From Heavy Drinking

Text.text:
你的脑袋沉得像只牧羊犬，毛茸茸地发胀。房间亮得刺眼，空气里弥漫着汗湿的痛楚气味，你的舌头只能尝到自己的味道。可最要命的还是那阵阵抽痛与噪音——可怕的噪音——有人在呼吸。你的身体渴望一口热食来安抚翻搅的肚子，也渴望一块冷布压住带电般刺麻的头骨。它还需要一次接触，去碰一碰正在夺走你的一切的东西。要是你能站起来就好了。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Your head is as heavy as a shepherd dog, and just as fuzzy. The room, too bright, smells like sweaty pain, and your tongue only tastes itself. Mostly, though, there’s the throbbing and the noise—the horrible noise—of someone breathing. Your body needs hot food for your flipping belly and a cold cloth for your electrified skull. It needs a touch of what is killing you. If only you could stand.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

你瞥见头顶一团肆虐的风暴云。它那翠绿的躯体——一圈消化性化学毒雾的光晕——在搏动，像不祥的暗兆般飘荡在星球表面之上。翻搅的原生质噼啪裂响，收缩又膨胀，把它的气态身躯铺展到整片天空。它腹面垂下虫状触须，溅满了上一餐残留的体液。
You catch sight of a storming cloud above. Its green body, a digestive chemical nimbus, pulses, wafting above the planet’s surface like a dark omen. The churning protoplasm cracks, compressing and expanding its gaseous body across the sky. Wormlike tendrils dangle on its underside, spattered with the bodily fluids of its last meal.

Magical Construct In A Golden Palace.name:
金色宫殿中的魔法构造体
Magical Construct In A Golden Palace

Text.text:
宫殿向上拔地而起，足有几十尺——也许高达数百尺。每一处表面都映照着金色的光辉，亮得近乎刺目。金柱上蚀刻着繁复的图样与蓝图：齿轮、滑轮、导线与电路交织其间。一只生物在这片巨大腹地里游弋——机械之躯，配着古怪的眼与肢体组合。难以言喻的是，它竟靠一对微小而纤巧的翅膀轻掠穿行，黄铜与银制的羽片闪烁，每一次移动都伴随着齿轮的嗡鸣与咔嗒作响、无形引擎的低沉震颤与嘶嘶喷吐。它那玻璃般鼓胀的眼球转动着，直直地感知到你。

~ Envisioned by Greggity Greg

The palace soars upward dozens of feet—maybe hundreds. Every surface gleams with a golden light, almost blinding in its brilliance. Golden pillars are etched with ornate diagrams and schematics of gears, pulleys, wires, and circuits. A creature roams the vast innards of this place, a mechanical figure with an odd assortment of eyes and limbs. Defying explanation, the creature flits about on a pair of tiny, delicate wings with brass and silver feathers, every movement accompanied by the whir and click of gears, the thrum and hiss of an unseen engine. Its glassy, bulbous eyes swivel to perceive you.

~ Envisioned by Greggity Greg

Stream Of Future Possibilities.name:
未来可能性之流
Stream Of Future Possibilities

Text.text:
沼泽在这里从溪流边退去，让你得以靠近。波光粼粼的水面上，你看见诡异的影像：直立行走的青蛙披着贵族礼服与骑士铠甲。幻象颤动、散开，又一次次重聚；每回都换成同样荒诞的新一幕。两栖者在水中临朝、决斗、欢庆，诸般景象轮番上演，而那带着预言意味的水流仍悄然从旁淌过。

~ 构想 by Leprekorn

The swamp has receded from the stream here, allowing you to get close. In the shimmering waters, you see strange images of bipedal frogs dressed as nobles and knights. The visions waver and then re-form, each time depicting a different scene of equal absurdity. The amphibians hold court, duel, celebrate, and more as the prophetic waters trickle past.

~ Envisioned by Leprekorn

Altar To The Ruler Of A Faerie Domain.name:
妖精领地统治者祭坛
Altar To The Ruler Of A Faerie Domain

Text.text:
垂垂柳枝与山毛榉的浓荫下，静卧着一截古树的树桩，历经数百年，宽如餐桌。它仍矗在此处，作为久远往昔被斧刃与锯齿夺去生命的纪念。为纪念一位妖精统治者，这里被奉为祭坛，朝圣者与乡民留下的供品散落其上：绞成辫的发束、以叶为杯盛起的浆果、手捏投制的小陶罐里装着香料热饮、荆棘打成的结，以及摇曳燃烧的蜡烛。一片柳叶飘落，轻轻停在一张孩童画的蜻蜓旁。
Under the overhanging boughs of willows and beeches rests the stump of a tree centuries old, as broad as a dining table. It remains as memorial to the life taken by axes and saws long ago. In honor of a Faerie ruler, it has become an altar with offerings left behind by pilgrims and locals: braided twists of hair, leaf cups of berries, tiny hand-thrown jars of spiced drinks, bramble knots, and burning candles. A willow leaf falls and lands next to a child’s drawing of a dragonfly.

你右侧有一抹磷光忽明忽暗，随即消失，像远处的闪电。你肩后又有冷辉一闪。你转身去找光源，却空无一物。接着，在不远处，空气里一圈发光的涟漪凝聚成摇曳的光芒，像点亮的提灯，却是冷蓝色——除了空气之外，什么也没有将它容纳。
A phosphorescence flickers to your right then vanishes, like distant lightning. Luminescence flashes from over your shoulder. You turn to spot its source, but there’s nothing there. Then, not far away, a glowing ripple in the air resolves into a wavering glow, like a lit lantern, but cold blue in color—and contained by nothing but air.

她的美以一种超越一切性别感知的方式被丈量。她那一头长及腰际的铂金长发天生夺目，既不刻意修饰，也不涂抹雕琢，仿佛将天使的梦都藏在其间。她静默的安宁里，那双烟雾般的深绿眼眸像在注视万物，手始终离不远处的短弓与纤长的长剑不远。她将羽白的翅膀藏在长斗篷之下，把磨损的羽翎遮住，不让窥探的目光得逞。

~ 由 Adam 扮演

She is beauty, measured in a way that transcends all sense of gender. Her long platinum hair is naturally impressive, neither primped nor painted, and it houses the dreams of angels. From her quiet tranquility, her smoky, dark-green eyes seem to watch everything, and her hand is never far from her shortbow and slender longsword. She hides feathery white wings beneath a long cape, masking her worn-out plumage from prying eyes.

~ Played by Adam

绿色遮篷与开花的常春藤蔓点缀着这家矮矮的小旅店外墙，透过敞开的窗子，温热的笑声咕嘟咕嘟地涌出来。门楣上方那块色彩明亮的招牌骄傲地宣告这里是“养蜂人旅店”，上面画着一只手绘小蜂，停在花朵边缘。外墙的木板被天气磨得发旧，却擦拭得干净——显然有人以爱与用心悉心照料着此处。

你推门而入，烤土豆与新鲜麦酒的香气迎面飘来。巨大的壁炉里木柴噼啪作响，在几盏墙灯与低垂吊灯的映照下，把整个房间照得暖意融融。墙边挂着色彩鲜亮的织毯，为木质内装增添了一抹鲜活的色泽。酒保站在入口左侧的柜台后，身后通往厨房的门敞开着。
Green awnings and flowering ivy tendrils adorn the outside of the squat little inn, and warm laughter burbles out through an open window. The brightly colored sign above the doorway proudly proclaims it to be The Beekeper’s Inn and depicts a hand-painted bee perched on the edge of a flower. The wood panels of the exterior are weather worn but clean—an indication of the love and care with which this place is maintained.

The smell of roasting potatoes and fresh ale wafts toward you when you push through the door. Logs crackle in the oversized fireplace, lighting up the room with help of several wall sconces and a low-hanging chandelier. Bright woven tapestries hang along the walls and add a touch of color to the wooden interior. The barkeep stands behind a counter to the left of the entrance, the doorway to the kitchen open behind them.

Tree Falls Outside Tent.name:
树倒在帐篷外
Tree Falls Outside Tent

Text.text:
一声饱受折磨般的呻吟紧接着木头碎裂的尖啸，瞬间撕碎了森林的宁静；当一道阴影遮蔽了洒入营地的月光，恐惧在你心底翻涌。伴随着震耳欲聋的CRACK，最后几缕树皮终于崩裂——一棵巨树轰然倒下，狠狠拍平在你那脆弱帐篷旁的地面上。

~ 由David在Discord上构想

A tortured groan followed by the cry of splintering wood shatters the tranquility of the forest, and terror wells within you as a shadow eclipses the moonlight streaming into the camp. With a deafening CRACK the last slivers of bark give way—and a huge tree flattens the ground beside your vulnerable tent.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Criminal Drug Lab.name:
犯罪制毒实验室
Criminal Drug Lab

Text.text:
气味是你最先注意到的——一股燥热刺鼻的恶臭，混着浓重汗臊与辛辣的化学品味道。这里曾是一排办公室，如今早已面目全非。每个柜台后都摆着一整套玻璃纤维仪器，过滤着绿蓝色的液体，发出凶狠的嘶嘶沸响。工人被剥得只剩内衣，脸上只戴着偷来的外科口罩，手忙脚乱地拨弄仪器上的喷嘴。过道间巡行的是安保：魁梧的赛博暴徒，指节下埋着皮下指虎。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The smell is the first thing you notice, a torrid stench of body odor and acrid chemicals. This was once a set of offices, but no longer. Across each counter sits a panoply of fiberglass instruments filtering green-blue liquids with a fierce fizzling noise. Workers stripped to their underwear, wearing only stolen surgical masks, fiddle with nozzles on their instruments. Between the aisles strides the security: hulking cyber thugs bearing subdermal knuckle dusters.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Overheard Conversation About Drinking To.name:
偷听到的对话：靠喝酒来撑过去
Overheard Conversation About Drinking To Cope

Text.text:
“借酒消愁算不上办法？那你倒说说，我该换什么？打坐冥想、散步远行？这日子本就是苦海，我要怎么熬、就怎么熬。”
“Drinking’s a poor way to cope? And what would you have me do instead? Meditation and long walks? This life is misery, and I’ll suffer through it how I want.”

I Cast Master Of Myriad Forms.name:
我施放《万形之主》
I Cast Master Of Myriad Forms

Text.text:
我是雕塑家——我的魔法是工具，我的血肉是泥土。随着一句回响的咒语，我在心中唤起所渴望的形状。我指向并接触我想雕琢成新形的事物。泥土顺从我的意志。这些改变与世间万物一样真实……至少，在一个时代里。
I am the sculptor—my magic the tool, my flesh the clay. With a resonant phrase, I call to mind the desired shape. I point to and touch what I want to carve into a new form. The clay follows my will. These alterations are as real as anything… for a time.

Kalim, Son Of Jahiri.name:
卡利姆，贾希里之子
Kalim, Son Of Jahiri

Text.text:
这名男子身旁踱步的那只线条流畅的剑齿虎，仿佛是他野性的孪生兄弟。他的身高几乎与那头巨猫的体长相当，精瘦结实，乌鸦般的黑发乱束披散，不受驯服。皮肤黝黑，几乎与他身上松垮的皮革衣装同色。他皱着眉，冷冽的眼眸扫视着区域时，虹彩般的幽光在瞳仁间流淌闪烁。他左手按在腰侧一柄长而弯的刀的刀柄上，刀鞘贴着髋骨。背后，一张反曲弓安置在裹着毛皮的弓囊中，旁边配着同款箭袋，装满长箭，箭羽漆黑如夜。

~ Played by Walt M.

The sleek saber-toothed tiger plodding beside this man seems like his feral twin. He’s as tall as the great cat is long, and wiry, with untamed tresses of raven-colored hair. His skin is as dark as the loose leather clothing he wears. He frowns, luminous iridescence washing through the irises of his cold eyes as he inspects the area. His left hand rests on the pommel of a long, curved blade scabbarded at his hip. A recurve bow rests in a fur-clad sleeve at his back, alongside a matching quiver of long, black-fletched arrows.

~ Played by Walt M.

Celebration Of The Summer Solstice.name:
夏至庆典
Celebration Of The Summer Solstice

Text.text:
篝火如巨蘑般冲天而起，火顶处火星四溅，焦黑的木块在热浪中翻卷扭动。灼烫的火基旁，半裸的舞者腾跃旋转，发间插花，腕上系铃。更勇敢的灵魂纵身越过跳动的火舌，烧焦的发丝拖着一缕青烟。
The bonfire mushrooms high into the air, sparks and charred wood writhe about the fire’s peak. At its blistering base, semi-naked dancers jump and twist, flowers in their hair, bells on their wrists. Braver souls vault through the leaping flames, singed hair trailing smoke.

I Escape From A Rope Bind.name:
我挣脱绳缚
I Escape From A Rope Bind

Text.text:
双手被反绑在背后，我拼命扭动，绳索在手腕上灼烧般摩擦。我咬紧牙关，扭来扭去，肩胛骨彼此碾磨得发疼。我知道手腕一定会因此淤青，可我不在乎——我得逃出去。我猛地一扯，终于挣脱一只手，狂喜压过了指节被磨破的皮、手腕与手掌里撕裂的筋腱。此刻我只尝到那撩人心魄的自由滋味。
Hands bound behind my back, my wrists burn against the rope as I wriggle furiously. I clench my teeth, feeling my shoulder blades grind against each other as I twist my arms one way and the other. I know my wrists will bruise for this, but I don’t care—I need to get out. I wrench my hand free, my elation ignoring the skin scraped off my knuckles, the torn tendons in my wrists and hands. All I know is the tantalizing taste of freedom.

Private Bath Chamber.name:
私人浴室
Private Bath Chamber

Text.text:
[空置] 空浴池里擦洗得一尘不染的瓷砖不见半点皂垢或霉斑。池沿旁整齐叠着几条新毛巾，旁边还有一只琥珀色玻璃瓶，标签写着：薰衣草油。房门对面的桌上陈列着一块块香皂，另有一丛蓬松的蕨类在潮热的环境中竟长得生机勃勃。

[使用中] 一团带着薰衣草香的暖雾自备好的浴池里袅袅升起。那安抚人心的气息像法师的法术般拂过你，灌满胸腔，悄然托起旅途劳顿的沉重。你沉入清澈的碧蓝水中，肌肉里的紧绷随之松开。眼皮在这私密的歇息里沉沉合上，前方的试炼与差事也从思绪中一点点融化。

[Vacant] The well-scrubbed tile of the empty bath shows no hint of scum or mold. Fresh towels sit folded next to the edge, along with a bottle of amber glass with the label: Lavender Oil. A table across from the chamber door has bars of soap displayed, along with a fluffy fern that seems to thrive in the steamy environment.

[In Use] A comforting cloud of steam, scented with lavender, rises from the ready bath.
