The soothing aroma washes over you like a mage’s spell, filling your chest and lifting the weight of your tiring journey. As you dip into the clear, turquoise water, the tension in your muscles release. Your eyelids droop closed in this moment of private respite, the trials and tasks ahead melting from your mind.

Cybernetically Enhanced Criminal.name:
义体强化罪犯
Cybernetically Enhanced Criminal

Text.text:
很难在这人身上找到一处没被改造、没被修到更适合施暴的部位。暗藏于体内的刀刃与枪械接缝多得惊人，四肢看上去像龟裂的人行道。最骇人的是他们的脸：一切有机的五官都已被义体取代。嘴的位置换成机械格栅，鼻子通体皆金属，而本该是眼睛的地方只剩一块厚重的红色目镜，毫无表情可循。
It’s difficult to locate a part of the person’s body that hasn’t been altered or modified to better suit violence in some way. The seams of hidden, embedded blades and firearms are so numerous, their limbs look like a cracked sidewalk. Their face is worst of all: every organic feature has been replaced by cybernetics. A mechanical grate replaces their mouth, the nose is entirely metal, and where there should be eyes is only a bulky red visor with no indication of expression.

Braddock, The Human Fighter.name:
布拉多克，人类战士
Braddock, The Human Fighter

Text.text:
这名战士把柔韧的板条链甲罩在圆滚的肚腩与壮实的臂膀上，护甲在无数旧日战事里被磨得粗糙破败、边缘参差。他扛起巨剑与长弓毫不费力，甚至能指挥出与体型不相称的利落配合。发际线从一张因好斗热血而泛红的脸上退去，露出满口牙的笑，笑意里还带着几分顽皮。他的嗓音如雷霆炸响、如雄狮咆哮，正与那燧石般冷硬的目光一同迸裂——仿佛他的灵魂本就由烈火锻成。

~ Played by a Hero with

The warrior wears flexible splint mail over a portly belly and brawny arms, the armor rough and ragged from a host of battles past. He bears the weight of a greatsword and longbow without a hitch, and indeed he commands a coordination contrary to his size. His hairline recedes from a face flushed with a feisty ardor, his toothy smile tinged with mischief. His voice is a boom, a roar, an explosive match to this flinty stare—it’s as if his very spirit is forged in fire.

~ Played by a Hero with

Loot From A Wyvern.name:
双足飞龙的战利品
Loot From A Wyvern

Text.text:
一层浓稠黏腻的黏液覆在双足飞龙尾端那根阴狠锋利的毒刺上。其内的毒腺在炼金研究中价值极高——在更不择手段的圈子里亦然。
A thick, viscous slime coats the wickedly sharp stinger atop the wyvern’s tail. The poison glands within are valued highly in alchemical study—and more unscrupulous circles.

First Encounter With Dagne, Bride Of Rui.name:
与达格涅——毁灭新娘——的初次遭遇
First Encounter With Dagne, Bride Of Ruin

Text.text:
披袍的身影逼近，移动时更像在滑行而非行走。她的双脚无力地悬着，像失去提线的木偶般晃荡。她抬起手臂，将手指向你——那几乎灰白的皮肤上结着粗糙的紫色痂块。“我可怜的小东西们，如此渴求母亲的接触。”一枚失去光泽的戒指在她细长的指节上闪了一下——设定敞开着，宝石不翼而飞。她越靠越近，你透过丝绢般的面纱看见下面有肿块在蠕动。先前那种几丁质刮擦的声响再次钻入你的脑海，随即那身影猛地后仰，准备施放法术。
The robed figure approaches, gliding more than walking. Her feet hang lifelessly and dangle like a puppet bereft of strings. She lifts her arm and points her hand toward you, the mostly gray skin scabbed over in rough patches of purple. “My poor little things, so desperate for your mother’s touch.” A tarnished ring glints from her spindly finger—the setting is open, missing a gem. As she draws closer, you see lumps moving underneath the silken veil. The same chitinous scratching as before enters your mind as the figure reels back to cast a spell.

Monk Contemplating Quivering Palm.name:
沉思中的武僧，参悟震颤掌
Monk Contemplating Quivering Palm

Text.text:
曾有一次，一位气之大师遭人袭击；她察觉袭击者崇拜纯粹的狂怒，铁了心要她死。她在出手之后，又将张开的掌心贴在他腹上，停留了比一瞬更久的一瞬，那一刻她心中涌起悲伤——他曾经也只是个无辜的孩子。她把他一生的涟漪带在脑海里，如石落湖心的圈圈波纹，如鼓面上细沙的轻颤，整整两周。然后，她将它们放开。许多里外的一间酒馆里，那名袭击者无声倒下，瞬间毙命。你追随她的教诲，将对手的涟漪纳入己身。
Once, when a master of ki was assaulted, she realized her assailant worshiped pure rage and meant her dead. She was sad when she held her open hand against his stomach for an instant beyond her strike. He had once been an innocent child. She carried the ripples of his life in her mind, like a stone in a lake, like sand on the head of a drum, for two weeks. Then she released them. In a tavern many miles away, her assailant dropped dead. You follow her teachings, and take in your opponent’s ripples.

Deep Sea Creature In Alien Ocean.name:
异星海洋的深海生物
Deep Sea Creature In Alien Ocean

Text.text:
海面上一处暗影攫住视线。头顶无云。再细看，隐约能辨出一条甩动的尾巴轮廓、刀锋般的尖刺，以及幽幽发光的眼睛。尚未等那形体完全成型，阴影便倏然消失——投下它的东西已沉回浑浊的深水之中。
A dark spot in the ocean catches the eye. There are no clouds above. Closer examination hints at the outline of a swinging tail, razor points, and dimly glowing eyes. Before the shape comes to full form, the shadow vanishes, as whatever cast it sinks back into the murky waters.

Casting Astral Projection With Foresight.name:
在先见加持下施放灵体投射
Casting Astral Projection With Foresight

Text.text:
这些材料之所以昂贵，自有其缘由。你正把血肉抛在身后，只剩一条银索自你背脊牵引，如同罗盘的指针，提醒你在某个地方，你仍可被触碰。银质工艺品，以及那枚红橙色、心形的赤黄玉——它们都是你物质生命的象征。正如问号之于意义，你的躯体之于这个穿过物质、步入更不具侵扰性的位面的另一自我。
The components are expensive for a reason. You are leaving the flesh behind, with only the compass of a silver cord from your back to remind you that, somewhere, you are touchable. Artwork in silver, and the red-orange jacinth shaped like a heart—these are symbols of your material life. As a question mark is to meaning, so your body is to this other self that passes through matter and into a less intrusive plane of existence.

这头爬行巨兽的体型已足以令你驻足迟疑，而它那强劲的巨颚之力，恐怕连坚岩都能碾成齑粉。尽管它姿态凝滞、神情慵懒，你却隐隐觉得，只要猎物映入眼帘，它便能以迅雷不及掩耳之势骤然扑动。
The size of this reptilian behemoth is enough to give you pause, but the power of its mighty jaws would probably allow it to crush solid rock. Despite its immobile stance and lazy demeanor, you have the feeling that it can move lightning-fast when a meal comes into view.

Alistair Muir.name:
阿利斯泰尔·缪尔
Alistair Muir

Text.text:
船长松弛地立在舵位，右手随意搭在舵轮上，任由船只掠过如镜的海面，穿行在咸涩的海风里。他的眼睛冰光闪烁。褐色发束在身后狂舞，露出略微尖起的耳尖；那件长长的蓝色外套也随风翻飞，显出短佩剑的剑鞘与篮形护手。亚麻衬衫的翻领张扬鼓起，胸膛如他那线条精致、毫无胡须的面庞一样光洁；他神情安稳，带着一丝满足的从容。左手则漫不经心地把玩着一团幽暗火焰——在海风里竟分毫不颤。

~ 扮演：CelticNinja

The captain stands relaxed at the helm, an easy right hand on the wheel, as his ship races across the smooth waters and through the salty air. His eyes sparkle like ice. Brown locks whip behind him, revealing ears slightly pointed, and his long blue coat follows suit, uncovering the sheath and basket hilt of a short saber. The flared collar of his linen shirt billows open, his chest as hairless as his fine-featured face, which bears a look of calm satisfaction. Idly, with his left hand, he toys with dark fire that wavers not at all in the sea breeze.

~ Played by CelticNinja

Creepy Spirit's Lair.name:
阴森怨灵的巢穴
Creepy Spirit's Lair

Text.text:
你独自站在十字路口，四下不见人影，却怎么也压不下那种“有什么要来了”的预感。路旁那棵盘曲的橡树高处一阵移动攫住了你的视线。离地十来尺，一根粗壮的枝干上被反复缠绕了许多圈，离树干又隔着几尺，一截发霉的绳索垂坠下来。你猛地意识到，那是被割断的绳子，正悬着来回摇摆，在风中吱呀作响，仿佛仍被什么东西拉得绷紧……
You stand at the crossroads with no one else in sight, yet you can’t overcome the feeling that something is coming. A movement high in the twisted oak beside the road catches your eye. A dozen feet from the ground, wrapped many times around a thick branch, and several feet from the trunk, a moldy rope dangles. You realize with a start that the severed rope hangs and sways, creaking in the wind as if pulled taut…

Advice From A Noble.name:
来自贵族的忠告
Advice From A Noble

Text.text:
“我相信你在旅途中确实积攒了不少财富，但黄金可替代不了良好的教养。现在站直了，给我好好说话，不然就走人。”
“While I’m sure you’ve amassed a great deal of wealth on your travels, gold is no substitute for good breeding. Now stand up straight and address me properly, or be on your way.”

她拉开弓弦，柔韧的纤维被绷紧，发出一声吱呀。绿与紫的魔法如藤蔓般缠上她的手臂，奔涌着灌入那只稳稳扣住箭矢的手。她咬紧牙关低吼：“别射偏。”随即放箭。箭矢尖啸着扑向目标，在即将命中的刹那猛然炸开，化作一团纠结的藤蔓。藤条啪地抽上猎物，迅速缠绕，将其裹成一只由绿色筋络与尖刺织就的茧。地面上，又一具身影升起——一位带着灿烂笑容的巨灵。他挑眉一抖，打量着倒下的敌人。随着他动作，纯粹如板岩的身躯簌簌落下深色泥屑。“射偏？就这弱东西？”他咯咯发笑，声音像岩石从山间滚落。

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

She draws the string of her bow with a creak as its supple fibers stretch. Tendrils of green and purple magic twine down her arm, surging into the hand that holds the arrow steady. Through gritted teeth she growls, “Don’t miss,” and releases the arrow. It whistles toward the target and, just before impact, bursts into a tangle of vines. They slap against the quarry, wrapping around them in a cocoon of green sinew and thorns. From the ground, another form rises—a genie with a magnificent grin. He appraises the fallen enemy with a wiggle of his brow. As he moves, crumbs of dark soil fall from his purely slate body. “Miss? This weakling?” He chuckles, sounding like rocks tumbling down a mountain.

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

Intimidation About Waking Up Wrong.name:
因错醒而生的恐吓感
Intimidation About Waking Up Wrong

Text.text:
“好吧，我跟你说句实话；你那脑袋瓜里装了什么情报我一点也不在乎。我到现在都没搞明白咱们干嘛要来这儿。我今早醒来就浑身不对劲，总觉得得把手伸进某个人的身体里搅一搅，才能舒服点。”
“Ok, I’m going to be honest with you for a minute; I don’t care what information you got in that noggin of yours. I barely understand why we’re here in the first place. I just woke up wrong this morning and feel like I need to get my hands into somebody to feel better.”

Canals Through A Subterranean City.name:
贯穿地下城的运河
Canals Through A Subterranean City

Text.text:
地下城在你头顶巍然耸立，窗中灯火闪烁。没有一缕阳光能侵入这片巨大的空间，但生物荧光的真菌与忽明忽暗的煤气灯提供了充足的视野。运河在城中织成一张纵横交错的网格，水道向四面八方延伸，载着渡船、驳船，甚至军舰。引导船只的人手持又长又柔韧的撑篙，以娴熟的动作推舟破水、拨转航向。
The subterranean city towers over you, lights glimmering in the windows. No sunlight invades the cavernous space, but bioluminescent fungi and flickering gas lamps provide ample visibility. Canals form a latticework through the city, a grid of waterways running in all directions, carrying ferryboats, barges, even military ships. Those guiding the vessels do so with long, pliable poles, pushing the crafts through the water and steering with practiced movements.

I Use Wild Shape: Eagle.name:
我施展【荒野变形】：雄鹰
I Use Wild Shape: Eagle

Text.text:
我仰望开阔的天空，张开双臂。双眼化作猛禽般的金色圆瞳，头发也一根根变作羽翎。我屈膝前倾，蜷伏下来，像一只正在休息的鸟。窸窣作响间，无数羽毛破肤而生，面容向前拉长，延展成弯钩般的喙。伴着一声尖厉的长鸣，我振翼腾空。
Looking to the open sky, I spread my arms. As my eyes change to the golden orbs of a raptor, the hair on my head becomes feathers. I squat and lean forward, crouching like a bird at rest. Rustling heralds the sprouting of countless feathers, and my face extends into a hooked beak. With a shrill cry, I take wing.

Rod Of Lordly Might.name:
威能权杖
Rod Of Lordly Might

Text.text:
这根坚固的短杖正散发出强烈的魔法共鸣，铁制握柄上嵌着的按钮点缀着奥术符号。杖身的顶端与尾端各有一枚带凸缘的杖头，布满尖刺，宛如一柄骇人的钉头锤。
A powerful magical resonance emanates from this sturdy rod, and arcane symbols decorate the buttons embedded in the iron haft. The top and tail of the rod bear flanged heads replete with spikes, like a fearsome mace.

Commoner With Lycanthropy.name:
患有狼人病的平民
Commoner With Lycanthropy

Text.text:
那平民踉跄着走在路上，披风紧紧裹住瘦削的身形。那双眼睛狂乱游移，四下扫视，像是在寻找——救赎、危险，还是别的什么？他们的姿态令你觉得不对劲，步伐也怪异；动作却快得近乎兽性。忽然，那目光猛地窜向天际——初现的满月正升起——瞳孔骤然放大，继而拉长成细缝。面容沉了下来。他们咬牙扭曲，弓背蜷身，然后开始……变形。
The commoner stumbles down the road, cloak clutched tight about their frame. Their eyes, wild and roaming, flit in all directions, seeking—salvation, danger, something else? Their posture strikes you as odd, their gait unusual. They move with an almost animalistic quickness, and as their eyes dart skyward toward the emerging full moon, their pupils dilate, then elongate. Their face darkens. They grimace, hunch over, and begin . . . changing.

Grungy Boxing Gym.name:
肮脏破旧的拳击馆
Grungy Boxing Gym

Text.text:
穿过大门，映入眼帘的是一间肮脏的拳击馆，里面挤着一半的人——多是拳手——在浑浊的钠灯黄光下晃动。低矮的天花板把拳套砸在靶垫上的沉闷重响放大得回荡不绝。空气里弥漫着令人窒息的人体汗臭。

正中央是一座拳台：一个身材敦实、脏乱脏辫的女人正与一台陪练安卓对打，动作快得惊人。那安卓显然被改装得超出预设的安全参数——它的出拳带着惩罚般的狠劲，一记刺拳打得她措手不及。拳台边，一个面容黝黑、饱经风霜的男人立刻扯着嗓子吼出指点。
Past the doors lies the grimy gym, half full of boxers and lit with dirty sodium light, the low ceiling amplifying the heavy thump of gloves against pads. There is an overwhelming stench of human sweat. In the center is a boxing ring, where a stocky woman with dirty dreadlocks spars with a practice android, moving alarmingly fast. The android has clearly been modified beyond pre-set safety parameters—it strikes with punishing force, catching her off guard with a jab, leading a grizzled man with dark features to yell advice from the edge of the ring.

Quip By Drunken Monk.name:
醉拳僧的俏皮话
Quip By Drunken Monk

Text.text:
“我喝酒可不是为了给情绪找个拐杖……好吧，或许有一点点。但说真的，这是为了让咱们打得更公平。要是我清醒着，你早就死透了，那还有什么乐子可言？”
“My drinking is not some emotional crutch… Well, maybe a little. But, really, it’s to make our fight fair. If I were sober, you’d be dead already, and where’s the fun in that?”

Black Heart, A Floating Pirate Town.name:
黑心号，一座漂浮的海盗城镇
Black Heart, A Floating Pirate Town

Text.text:
想偷偷摸摸接近这座小镇以及那对不相称的三桅盖伦帆船，根本不可能。每根桅杆顶端近旁的甲板上都站着一个举着望远镜的身影，而在许多为更沉重巨舰效力的小船甲板上，其他影子正有条不紊地穿梭忙碌。第二大的船艏端长着一只突出的尖喙，周围拱卫着一打救生艇与小艇；它那不那么圆滑的同伴则在两层甲板上张开一道道开口，暗示着舷侧炮口后藏着的火炮。两面猩红旗帜传递出戒备的问候：自负其险，方可靠近。

~ Envisioned by Pirate lord

There is no stealthy approach to this town and its mismatched pair of three-masted galleons. On a deck near the top of each mast stands a figure with a spyglass, while other shapes move purposefully on the decks of the many lesser ships in service to the heavier ones. The second-largest boat, bearing a pronounced beak at its bow, is ringed by a dozen lifeboats and dinghies; its less diplomatic mate boasts openings on two decks that hint at the broadside cannons contained within. Twin red flags telegraph a guarded greeting: Approach at your own peril.

~ Envisioned by Pirate lord

一团浓密的鬃毛——胡须与头发纠缠而成——蓬松如球，几乎将整个躯干与那张灰皮小脸的大半都笼在里面。厚重发墙间仅露出一点：一个圆鼓鼓的鼻头与两只淡灰色的眼睛。鬃毛之下，两条粗壮的山羊腿以分趾蹄落地，嗒嗒作响、轻快弹跳；这只小小的生物随即开始起舞。
A dense mane—a mix of beard and hair—forms a puffy ball that shrouds the entire torso and much of the small gray skinned face. Little more than a bulbous nose and two pale gray eyes are visible in the wall of locks. Below the mane, two thick goats legs end in cloven hooves that patter and bounce off the ground as the tiny creature begins to dance.

I Light My Lantern Of Revealing.name:
我点亮揭示真相的提灯
I Light My Lantern Of Revealing

Text.text:
我点亮提灯时，油的气味和任何灯油无异；我吹灭它时，引火柴的烟也一样。金属也没变：冰冷的铁，渐渐回暖。可玻璃不同——那是一只如茶杯般巨大的眼睛，凹透镜从敞开的灯罩里顶出。蒙尘的光束扫过房间，直到我看见我的目标——曾经不可见的——在魔法之光中显形。
The oil smells the same as any lamp oil when I light the lantern, as does the kindling smoke when I blow it out. The metal is the same: cold iron, gradually warming. But the glass is an eye as large as a teacup, its concave lens pushing from the open hood. The dusty beam sweeps the room until I see my target, once invisible, appear in the magical light.

尸体倒在一滩血泊里，暴怒扭曲了半兽人的面容，凝成一抹龇牙咆哮的狰狞。獠牙碎裂了一根，只剩参差的断茬从破裂的下颌里突兀刺出。
The corpse lies in a pool of blood, rage twisting the half-orc’s face into a snarling grimace. One tusk has been shattered, leaving a jagged stump of bone protruding from a broken jaw.

Short Travel Across The Elemental Plane.name:
穿越土元素位面的短途旅行
Short Travel Across The Elemental Plane Of Earth

Text.text:
你踏上旅行，心中并不确定将会遇见什么，穿行于洞窟之间，翻越群山，横渡台地与高原。天空如倒悬的山脉，山峰向下刺落，构成一座横跨整个位面的巨大土石洞穴体系。空气里弥漫着腐殖土与尘埃的气味，浮空的岛屿在头顶缓缓漂移。你以所敢及的速度疾行，直到目的地赫然出现在眼前。
You embark on your journey unsure of what you might find, traveling through caverns and over mountains, across mesas and plateaus. The sky is mountains pointing downward, creating a massive, plane-spanning system of earthen caves. The air smells of loam and dust, and islands float overhead. You travel as quickly as you dare, until your destination is before you.

这座塔楼想必曾经高耸入云，层层楼阁俯瞰四野，为持弓的守卫提供充裕的制高点。如今只剩矮墩墩的塔基，塔身大半坍塌碎裂，像被伐倒的白桦般横卧；断段半埋在湿透的泥地里，常春藤与苔藓缠覆其上，阴湿而沉寂。
The tower must have once stood many stories tall, overlooking the surrounding landscape and providing ample height for defenders armed with bows. Now, only the squat foundation remains, with the bulk of the tower fallen and broken like a felled birch, sections half-buried in the sodden ground, shrouded with ivy and moss.

I Throw My Ivory Goats Figurine Of Wondr.name:
我掷出「奇物之力：象牙山羊雕像」，召唤一只苦行山羊。
I Throw My Ivory Goats Figurine Of Wondrous Power To Summon A Goat Of Travail

Text.text:
一缕苍白的薄雾自雕像中翻涌而起，在流动的帷幕里，一道庞大、长角的恐怖轮廓渐渐膨胀成形。雾气散去，空气中只余湿冷的山石与尘土气息——显现出一头巨大的山羊：一对扁平的角如缎带般盘卷，上扬直挺，足足高出地面五英尺。它的毛色如风暴般交织着黑、白与灰，颈侧长毛披垂，仿佛一位睿智的老法师蓄着长须。
A pale mist billows up from the figurine, and the silhouette of a massive horned horror grows within the shifting veil. The fog clears, leaving a scent of wet mountain stone and dust on the air, to reveal a giant goat with a pair of flat horns that curl like ribbons—rising five feet into the air. Its stormy coat of black, white, and gray is long around its neck, giving it the look of a wise old wizard with a long beard.

Mcgregor’s Cottage In Winter.name:
麦格雷戈的小屋·冬日
Mcgregor’s Cottage In Winter

Text.text: 小屋的烟囱噗噗吐出一缕缕炊烟，前门上挂着一只毛茸茸的花环。兔族农夫把长耳朵紧紧塞进羊毛帽里，在菜园里一块地一块地蹦跳巡视，查看作物。他施展一个经过细致控制的gust戏法，把土豆和芜菁上的积雪吹开。那双修长的脚没穿鞋，在寒意里微微发抖。他抖落脚踝弯处的雪，停下来歇口气，伸展身子、咔咔扭动脊背，随即粗声叹了口气。 The cottage’s chimney puffs out a stream of smoke and a shaggy wreath hangs upon the front door. The rabbitfolk farmer, ears fitted snugly into a woolly cap, hops from patch to patch in his gardens, inspecting his crop. He blows snow away from his potato and turnip plants with a much-tempered gust cantrip. His long feet, shoeless, shiver in the cold. He shakes snow away from the crook of his ankle and takes a break to stretch and crack his back, letting out a gruff sigh as he does so.

Dwarf’s Speech About Building.name:
矮人谈造物的言辞
Dwarf’s Speech About Building

Text.text:
“我们矮人造东西总有各种各样的理由——遮风避雨、采矿、打发无聊。但这上头的城市看起来全像是在为抢金子或求保命而慌乱拼凑出来的，里头半点匠心都没有。”
“We dwarves build things for all kinds of reasons—shelter, mining, boredom. But the cities up here all seem like they were slapped together in some panicked scramble for gold or safety, and there’s no artistry in that.”

Speech By A Tarot Reader To An Angry Bar.name:
一位塔罗占卜师对一名暴怒野蛮人的讲话
Speech By A Tarot Reader To An Angry Barbarian

Text.text:
“喂喂喂，大块头，把椅子放下！我可没威胁你！对，就这样，慢点……好，好了。别别别，这具——确实丑得要命的——骷髅（特征）是在说，有什么东西很快就要走到尽头了……比如说，那把吓人的斧头底下，某个敌人的命？或许就是这个意思？”
"Whoa there, big fella, put the chair down! I ain't threatenin’ ya! That's it, nice and slow… There we go. No, no, this—admittedly horrible—skeleton means something is coming to an end soon… like the life of an enemy on that fearsome axe there, perhaps?”

Cleric's Drunken Exorcism Attempt.name:
牧师的醉酒驱魔尝试
Cleric's Drunken Exorcism Attempt

Text.text:
矮人含糊地嘟囔着驱逐咒，颤巍巍地朝小队那只显然毫不买账的魔宠伸出手。另一只手里歪斜的酒杯洒出麦酒，他语无伦次地咕哝着，把神圣的咒文念得支离破碎，随后对着那生物的脸打了个响亮的酒嗝。

~ Tusker2zero on Discord

The dwarf slurs the words of banishment as he holds out a shaky hand to the party's distinctly unimpressed familiar. Spilling ale from the listing tankard in his other hand, he mumbles incoherently as he butchers the sacred incantation and burps loudly in the creature's face.

~ Tusker2zero on Discord

Psychotherapy Robot.name:
心理治疗机器人
Psychotherapy Robot

Text.text:
你开口说话时，机器人静静聆听，投射在外壳上的全息面孔模仿着若有所思的同理心，试图让你放松。尽管它被设计成类人形态，却缺乏任何真正的温度与怜悯——那些才是有效治疗所必需的东西。它不过是一台机器：只是在执行程序写定的指令。
The bot listens as you speak, the holographic face projected across its outer shell mimicking thoughtful empathy to put you at ease. Though it has been designed to replicate a humanoid figure, it lacks any of the genuine warmth or compassion required for effective therapy. A machine: simply following the commands of its programming.

Large Beaver Dam.name:
大型海狸坝
Large Beaver Dam

Text.text:
沿着河谷顺流而下地旅行，你绕过一道河弯，迎面却是片浅湖——本以为这里该有一处常被踩出的浅滩可供涉渡。你先行侦察，发现下游被堵住了：一座巨大的堆积物屏障，由原木、枯叶与各类残骸垒成，毫无疑问是海狸的杰作。堤坝看上去摇摇欲坠、拼拼凑凑，却出奇有效，硬生生改写了你的旅行计划。除非你打算停下来把它拆掉——当然，那就得冒着惹怒海狸的风险。
Traveling downstream along the river valley, you round a bend and are confronted by a shallow lake where you expected to find a well-used ford. Scouting ahead you see a blockage downstream—an enormous pile of logs, leaves, and other debris, doubtless gathered by beavers. Though the dam is ramshackle in appearance, it seems to be quite effective when it comes to altering your travel plans. Unless you would like to stop and dismantle it, risking the ire of the beavers, that is.

Chapel Courtyard Awash In Moonlight.name:
月光漫溢的礼拜堂庭院
Chapel Courtyard Awash In Moonlight

Text.text:
浓雾笼罩着礼拜堂的庭院，宛如一片在月光下翻涌的海潮，沿着断裂的立柱与覆满苔藓的雕像之间缓缓流淌。霜寒啃咬着你裸露的肌肤，一口哀恸的钟声自头顶荡开，阴沉地回响进夜色深处。庭院里矗立着一座古老的喷泉——中央是一枚饱经风雨的铁铸破碎圣徽——也许在更欢乐的往昔，这里曾是侍僧与神父相聚的地点。
A thick fog blankets the chapel courtyard, a roiling moonlit sea flowing between broken pillars and moss-covered statues. Frost nips at your exposed skin and a mournful bell chimes above you, echoing ominously into the night. An ancient fountain stands in the courtyard—a broken holy symbol cast in weather-beaten iron at its center—perhaps a meeting place for acolytes and priests in happier days.

Stone Age Lake.name:
石器年代湖泊
Stone Age Lake

Text.text:
湖水宁静，却深邃幽暗。光线只能穿透数米，便迅速湮没在这片浩瀚水库的墨黑之中；由水芦苇组成的巨大岛屿漂浮在湖面上，仿佛迁徙的巨兽缓缓游移。
The placid waters of the lake are deep and dark. Light penetrates a few meters, but it is quickly lost in the inky blackness of the vast reservoir, and huge islands composed of water reeds float across the lake surface like migrating beasts.

这名类人生物身形轻灵如猫，披挂着部族长老的装束。由无数细微触须织成的丝滑短毛覆在其肌肤之上，柔亮而贴身。镶嵌铜饰的雅致长袍随其优雅的动作翻飞飘动。其左手握着一张部族长弓，以银白色木材精雕细琢而成，洁净无瑕。
Lithe and catlike, this humanoid bears the trappings of a tribal elder. Silky, sleek fur made up of miniscule antennae covers their skin. Elegant robes, inlaid with copper jewelry, flap about the individual’s elegant movements. A tribal bow sits in their left hand, immaculately carved from silver-white wood.

大宅的白塔，与其说像骨，不如说更像甜奶油。银线勾描的檐饰与窗框仿佛在滴落般垂着雕刻：人影与花朵层层叠叠。几乎找不到一座可称为“主屋”的中心建筑；取而代之的是高低错落的立柱，各自成为独立的居室——其间点缀着繁复花丝的中庭穹顶——夹在螺旋楼梯盘绕的塔楼之间，塔身明亮，多窗、拱门与壁灯交织。透过几处地面层的拱廊，草坪与花园的鲜亮色彩与庄园冷冽耀眼的光泽形成强烈对照。入口上方悬着一面绣制的旗帜，绣着家族徽记。

~ Envisioned by Ramon

The white towers of the great house resemble sweet cream more than bone. Silver-traced frieze work and window frames drip with carvings of figures and flowers. There is barely a central house to be identified. Instead, columns of various heights serve as individual chambers—adorned by filigreed atrium roofs—between spiral-staired towers bright with many windows, arches, and sconces. Through some of the ground-level arches, the bright colors of lawns and gardens contrast with the brilliant cool of the manse. Above the entrance hangs an embroidered banner of the family crest.

~ Envisioned by Ramon

Small Jungle Encampment Of Soldiers.name:
小型丛林士兵营地
Small Jungle Encampment Of Soldiers

Text.text:
纠结的灌木丛被硬生生开出一片空地，为这座营地腾出空间。身着轻便绿染夹棉布衣的士兵从帐篷里鱼贯而出。砍刀、手斧与短矛倚靠在倒下的原木旁，随时可在一瞬间抄起。
A clearing has been carved out of the tangled undergrowth to make space for this camp. Soldiers, dressed lightly in padded cloth dyed green, emerge from tents. Machetes, handaxes, and short spears lie against felled logs, ready to be taken up at a moment’s notice.

Stimulant Street Drug, Nitro.name:
兴奋剂街头毒品：硝基
Stimulant Street Drug, Nitro

Text.text:
装在水晶小瓶里，形似缩小的威士忌醒酒器，硝爆剂是一种阴毒的混合物：半透明发亮的液体与磷光颗粒交织其中。化合物会随时代缓慢分离，沉出靛蓝与深红的层理。轻轻一晃，色彩便旋卷成浑浊的雾晕，像极了——不，简直就是——毒药。吞服之后，这股兴奋剂如液态烈焰般冲刷全身，以可怖到令人战栗的代价点燃使用者的能力；唯有最心黑手辣的战士才敢染指。
Kept in crystal vials like miniature whiskey decanters, nitro is an insidious mélange of transluminescent liquid and phosphorescent particles. The compounds separate over time, creating strata of indigo and crimson. Upon agitation, the colors swirl into a muddy haze that looks like nothing, if not poison. Once consumed, the stimulant rushes through the body like liquid fire, igniting the user's abilities at a cost so terrible that only the most blackhearted warriors dare use it.

Pirates Bombarding A Docked Vessel.name:
海盗炮轰停泊船只
Pirates Bombarding A Docked Vessel

Text.text:
借助系在上方索具上的绳索荡过来，进攻的船员一窝蜂登上这艘停泊的船。甲板先前已被敌方火炮一记沉重的炮击震得松动，此刻在无数靴子重重落下时发出呻吟般的吱呀声，板材弯曲下陷。停泊船的女船长发出绝望的吼叫，召集船员拿起武器。军刀出鞘，金属摩擦发出嘶嘶轻鸣；燧发手枪齐射，亮光炸裂，轰鸣震耳。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

Swinging from ropes secured to the rigging above, the assaulting crew boards the docked ship. The deck, already weakened by a sound blow from an enemy cannon, creaks and bends as the many boots land heavily upon it. A desperate shout from the docked ship’s captain calls her crew to arms. Sabers unsheathe with a metallic hiss while flintlock pistols fire in bright, deafening bursts.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Have Witch Sight.name:
我拥有女巫视界
I Have Witch Sight

Text.text:
不知是祝福还是诅咒，我的双眼总会揭穿真相。幻象在我的凝视下层层剥落。万物的真实轮廓会在任何虚妄的外形深处自发发光；我也能看见他人藏在幻影或改造血肉之下的面孔。
Whether it’s a blessing or curse, my eyes reveal the truth. Illusions peel away under my stare. The right shape of all things glows in my vision from within any false form, and I see the faces others hide under phantasms or reshaped flesh.

Manual Of Gainful Exercise.name:
《增益锻体秘典》
Manual Of Gainful Exercise

Text.text:
这本书以皮革装订，重在坚韧耐磨而非外观华丽。外部封皮没有任何文字，却以银丝细工勾勒出数个简单、无面容、雌雄莫辨的人形剪影，正投入各式体能活动：奔跑、游泳、劈柴、举起巨石。书页边缘做了拇指索引，没有字母标记，取而代之的是一列列不同色调的色块。翻阅内容，你看到的是不同强度的训练方案清单；字里行间传达着明确的共识——必须循序渐进完成每一套练习，才能让全身上下的力量与肌肉一并增长。
Bound in leather valued more for its toughness than its looks, this volume features no text on the outer cover, but does feature several simple, faceless, androgynous figures picked out in silver filigree and engaged in various athletic activities such as running, swimming, woodcutting, and lifting boulders. The book has thumb-indexed pages, without letters but instead represented in a variety of hues. Reviewing the book’s contents, you find lists of workout regimens of various intensities, with the clear understanding that one must progress through each routine to build strength and muscle throughout one’s entire body.

Temperate Forest Oak Grove.name:
温带森林橡树林
Temperate Forest Oak Grove

Text.text:
这片林地是橡树的乐土。老橡树的繁茂枝桠在野性纠结中向四下伸展，低低弯向地面，仿佛这些树随时会撬离土壤，迈步行走。林冠在甜香的风里摇曳，把跃动的光点洒成斑驳，像低语般将古老的智慧传给它们的橡果——此刻尚且细小，却蕴着数百年的可能。
This swath of forest is a haven of oak trees. The elder oaks’ sprawling branches grow in wild tangles that bend low to the ground, as though the trees might lever themselves out of the earth and walk about. The grove’s canopy sways on the sweet-scented wind, freckling the ground with dancing motes of light and whispering ancient wisdom to their acorns—tiny now, but filled with centuries of potential.

Crashed Cart In Swamp.name:
沼泽里的翻车车厢
Crashed Cart In Swamp

Text.text:
一辆货车在此冲出道路，侧翻进泥沼。它的车轮已然碎裂、腐朽，散落在不远处。车夫的下落仍是谜——是遭了强盗、疏忽所致，还是更为阴险的东西？人不禁猜想：会不会有野兽自沼泽污泥中爬出，将货车与其乘员一并拖入黑暗？
A wagon ran off the road here, toppling into the mud. Its wheels, splintered and moldering, lie nearby. The fate of its driver remains unknown—was it bandits, negligence, or something more sinister? Could a beast, one wonders, have emerged from the sludge of the fens to drag the wagon and its occupant into the darkness?

Exhausted Combatant After A Battle.name:
鏖战后的疲惫斗士
Exhausted Combatant After A Battle

Text.text:
当你最后一个对手倒下——在战场上败北——而你耳畔那擂鼓般的心跳终于慢下来时，你忽然仿佛成了被粗暴剪断丝线的木偶。全身精气被抽空，你颓然跪下一膝，用沾血的武器勉强撑住体重。你得花上好几分钟，又从水囊里灌下几大口，才终于摇摇晃晃地重新站起。

~ 构想：snepai

As your last opponent falls—defeated upon the field of battle—and the hammering of your own heart slows in your ears, it is suddenly as if you are a puppet whose strings have been unceremoniously cut. Drained of all vigor, you slump to one knee, balancing your weight on your blooded weapon. It takes several minutes and some long drinks from your waterskin before you can shakily regain your feet.

~ Envisioned by snepai

Persuasion Of A Soldier.name:
士兵的劝服
Persuasion Of A Soldier

Text.text:
“有多少士兵为了将军的安逸而白白送命？你们管这叫忠诚与奉献，可你真以为你的指挥官连你的名字都记得？他会不会在夜里辗转难眠，被自己投入战争绞肉机的军团阴魂缠身？当然不会！我向你保证，他更不会为一个区区哨兵收了点金币、装作没看见而浪费半分心思。”
“How many soldiers sacrifice their lives for a general’s comfort? You call it loyalty and service, but do you think your commander even knows your name? That he ever lies awake at night, haunted by the legions he throws into the meat grinder of war? Of course not! And I assure you he won’t spare a thought to one lone watchman turning a blind eye for a bit of gold.”

The Bard Juggles.name:
吟游诗人抛接杂耍
The Bard Juggles

Text.text:
六支蜡烛被摆在一面镜子旁，镜中反射出的聚光灯将那名孤身表演者罩在光里——他站在临时搭起的舞台顶端。一侧，一位年轻女子，或许是学徒，开始轻敲一面简陋的皮鼓。鼓点渐渐稳住节拍，台上的身影把手探进衣袋，掏出两颗木球：一蓝一红。节奏骤然加快，一颗绿球旋转着腾空而起；杂耍者的双手流畅得近乎让人以为时间被放慢了，却没有任何一颗球落地。忽然一道闪光，人群爆出一声惊呼——一把匕首猛然加入三颗木球的轨道，刃口在光里翻转。可杂耍者神情不见丝毫紧绷，毫无异动。鼓声愈发急促，第二把短匕也跃入这群飞旋之物的行列！
A group of six candles has been placed beside a mirror, reflecting a spotlight onto the lone performer standing atop his makeshift stage. To one side, a young woman, perhaps an apprentice, begins to tap a simple skin drum. As the drumming settles into its beat, the figure on stage dives their hands into their pockets and extracts two wooden balls, one blue, one red. The tempo speeds up as a green ball appears spinning in the air; the hands of the juggler move so smoothly as to give the appearance of slow motion, though no ball touches the floor. Then there is a flash, and a shout from the crowd, as suddenly there is a dagger—its edge turning over in the light—joining the three balls in their orbits. But no movement, no tension is evident in the juggler's demeanor. The drumming increases in tempo as a second dirk joins the menagerie!

Adeir D'thuranni.name:
阿戴尔·德苏兰尼
Adeir D'thuranni

Text.text:
高挑的精灵离开剧院，掌声一路追随着他穿过门槛。他重新束紧丝滑的长发，大步迈入夜色，开始尾随那名仓皇逃窜的身影。橄榄色的面庞泛着微光，精灵加快脚步，感官绷紧，翡翠般的双眼扫过每一处阴影。那道印记的主人钻进小巷，瘦削的游荡者紧随其后，与昏暗融为一体，体内的龙裔印记悸动闪烁。猎物猛然转身，武器出鞘。游荡者无声地在其身后显现，随即出手，双匕化作带着猩红残影的疾光。猎物应声倒下，精灵如液影般渗回现实，刀刃滴落着恶意的光。

~ Played by Not Curtis with

The tall elf leaves the theater, applause following him out the door. He reties his silken hair and strides into the night, beginning to tail someone as they flee. Olive-skinned face glistening, the elf quickens his pace, senses alert, jade eyes scanning every shadow. The mark ducks into an alley and the lean rogue follows, becoming one with the gloom, his draconic mark pulsing within. His quarry turns, weapon drawn. Silently manifesting behind them, the rogue strikes, his daggers a crimson-tinged blur. The prey collapses as the elf oozes back into reality, knives dripping with malevolent light.

~ Played by Not Curtis with

I Cast Conjure Celestial.name:
我施放《召唤天界生物》
I Cast Conjure Celestial

Text.text:
从我体内那口深邃的奥秘与天使知识之井中，我牵引出咒文。词句繁复，拗口难诵，手势亦同样艰难。它们借由异界天才铸就的符号施行召唤。待我放下双手，便静候那伟大的存在现身。
From within the deep well of arcane and angelic knowledge inside me, I draw the incantation. The phrases are complicated, difficult to pronounce, and the gestures equally so. They summon using the symbols crafted by geniuses of other realms. After I lower my hands, I wait on the great being to appear.

Friendly Tavern: Drinking Time.name:
友善酒馆：畅饮时代
Friendly Tavern: Drinking Time

Text.text:
一群兴高采烈的人挤满了酒馆，肩挨着肩，灌着大杯麦酒，满嘴塞着吃食。几名乐手奏着欢快的曲子，有人拍手叫好，却更多被沉浸在醉醺醺的同袍情谊里的人们置若罔闻。酒馆伙计们忙得脚不沾地，杯子不断续满、肚皮不断填饱，让笑容挂在每张脸上，也让钱币源源不断滚进来。
A happy crowd fills the tavern, cheek by jowl as they down pints and stuff their gobs. A few musicians play a lively tune, appreciated by some but ignored by most sharing in the drunken camaraderie. The tavern workers keep cups and bellies full, putting smiles on faces while keeping the coins rolling in.

I Endure Piercing Damage.name:
我承受穿刺伤害
I Endure Piercing Damage

Text.text:
先是一个刺痛灼烧的点袭来，紧接着便是被深深贯穿时那种钻入骨髓的剧痛。下一个心跳，血液奔涌着灌入穿刺的伤口——我皱起眉头，却不曾动摇。

~ 由一位英雄构想

A stinging, burning point is the first thing I feel, followed by the tunneling agony of being deeply pierced. In my next heartbeat, blood rushes to fill the puncture wound—I wince, but I do not waver.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Rib Pillar Path.name:
肋骨石柱小径
Rib Pillar Path

Text.text:
草皮上被踩出的路径如箭般笔直，穿行于两列弧形石柱之间。它们酷似从地里突出的巨大肋骨，逼真得让你不禁怀疑，这是否真是某头巨兽怪物的遗骸。单是这些石柱就足以阴森得令人脊背发凉，但两列之间的路还沿着台阶通向一座祭坛，而祭坛之后，一具滴着鲜血的巨大战兽头骨阴影般耸立。
The path worn into the turf leads arrow-straight between two lines of curving pillars of stone. Their resemblance to huge ribs jutting from the ground is so strong you wonder if they might somehow be the bones of some behemoth monster. Alone, they would be eerie enough to give you chills, but the path between them leads up stairs to an altar, and beyond that looms the great bestial skull dripping with blood.

一位四个孩子的母亲在村集市上买了一碗樱桃。她给每个孩子分了一颗，叮嘱他们小心樱桃核。她们走到一棵山毛榉树下的一片草地，去和另外两位母亲及她们的孩子碰面，并与他们分享果子。一个女人把樱桃核在嘴里滚了滚，随后把核吐出几码远，又抹了抹嘴唇。其他母亲也上前来，各自从果梗上摘下一颗樱桃。
A mother of four buys a bowl of cherries at the village fair. She gives each child a cherry, telling them to be careful with the pits. They walk to a patch of grass under a beech tree to meet two more mothers and their children, with whom they share the fruit. One woman rolls a cherry pit around in her mouth, then spits the pit several yards and wipes her lips. The other moms step up, each pulling a cherry off the stem.

Arctic Settlement Elder.name:
极地聚落长老
Arctic Settlement Elder

Text.text:
厚重的兽皮一层层把这小个子裹得严严实实，活像被一头毛茸茸的野兽吞进肚里，只剩他那张满是褶子的脸滑稽地从它绒毛般的“嘴”里探出来。鼻子底下黏着几缕稀薄的胡须；眉毛则像两团灰色雷云——狂乱的白毛四下岔开，仿佛闪电向外分叉。他笑着向你致意，露出粉红的牙龈和寥寥几颗发褐的牙。
So many thick hides swaddle the little man that he seems swallowed by a furry beast, with only his wrinkled face comically poking from its fuzzy mouth. A few thin strands of hair cling to his face beneath his nose while his eyebrows are like two gray thunderclouds—with wild, white hairs forking out in all directions like lightning. He smiles in greeting, revealing pink gums and only a few brown teeth.

Lighter Gravity Of The Faerie Plane.name:
妖精位面的更轻重力
Lighter Gravity Of The Faerie Plane

Text.text:
有些地方，飘浮的不是身体，而是轻松的笑意。另一些地方，箭矢的轨迹长得荒唐；再有些地方，箭矢又像巨魔（特征）一屁股坐下般坠回大地。烟雾悬停在半空，沿着诡异的气流扭曲成形；清晨醒来时，你也许会发现自己离亚麻床单足足浮起一寸。
In some places, there is more levity than levitation. In others, the trajectory of an arrow is absurdly long, and in still others, the arrow drops to the earth like a troll plopping down. Smoke hovers and shapes itself along odd air currents, and one might find themself waking about an inch above the linen in the morning.

色彩无处不在：多色彩带系在竿顶，迎风噼啪作响、翻飞起舞；一面面骄傲的三角旗从每顶帐篷上垂挂而下，旗上纹章清晰可见——金线绣就的格言在阳光下熠熠生辉——而那些奇幻生物张着大口，彩绘的牙齿凝成夸张的咧笑，蹲踞在粗壮的木桩之上。
Color is everywhere: multi-hued streamers snap and dance in the wind atop poles, proud pennants displaying coats of arms hang from every tent—the gilt stitched mottos shining bright in the sunlight—and fanciful creatures, mouths agape and painted teeth fixed in yawning grins, squat atop stout wooden posts.

云层阴沉如墓碑般的色泽，寒意随之降临，所触之处尽皆凝霜。你的骨头在体内咯咯作响，呼出的气息仿佛一把匕首卡在喉间。你渴望壁炉火光的温暖，也渴望有个地方能脱下结霜的靴子。
The clouds darken to the color of tombstones, accompanied by a chill that crystallizes all it touches. Your bones rattle, and your breath feels like a dagger in your throat. You long for the glow of a hearth fire and a place to cast off your frosted boots.

Wand Of Web.name:
蛛网魔杖
Wand Of Web

Text.text:
这根魔杖散发着阴森而优雅的气息，与其制作中明显的蛛形意匠相得益彰。杖尖处，一只由熠熠生辉的白银铸成的蜘蛛托着一枚纯净紫水晶之卵；而光洁的杖身则以深邃、威严的乌木精雕而成。
The sinister elegance of this wand befits the arachnidian design evident in its creation. A spider made of gleaming silver cradles an egg of pure amethyst at the wand’s tip, while the polished haft is crafted from dark, regal ebony.

伴随着放箭般的破空声，紧接着一声脆响，一团疾影凝聚成一个仿佛缩小版的灰精灵。那小东西瘦长而棱角分明。紧绷的蜥皮衣裳裹住他的躯干与双腿，可手臂与那双夸张的大脚却赤裸在外。他刀刃般的耳朵向后贴去，苍白的头发亦向后飞掠，连过长的眉毛也一并后指。他瞥了眼自己携带的两柄骨刃。随后，他露出野兽般的神情，发出尖细的呜咽，再次化作一团疾影。
With a sound like a loosed arrow followed by a snap, a blur coalesces into what could be a miniature gray elf. The tiny being is lanky and angular. Tight lizard-skin clothes cover his body and legs, but his arms and oversized feet are bare. His knifelike ears point back, as does his pale hair, including overlong eyebrows. He glances at the two bone blades he carries. Then, with a feral look and a high-pitched whine, he becomes a blur again.

Weeping Ghost.name:
哭泣的幽灵（特征）
Weeping Ghost

Text.text:
又来了——那道你不敢确定是否真的听见的声音：一声抽噎。你环顾四周，寻找它的来处。接着，在前方不远处，你看见一个小孩背对着你站着，肩头因悲恸而一阵阵痉挛。你抬起手，张了张嘴，却又不知该说些什么。那身影忽然转过身，猛地朝你扑来，脸骤然贴到你眼前。你本能地往后一缩，可那里什么也没有。孩子消失了。你抬手摸向自己的脸颊，指尖却触到一片湿冷的泪水——而你身边的每一个人，看起来都像刚刚哭过。
There it is again, the sound you weren’t certain you heard: a sniffle. You look about for the source. Then, a short way ahead, you see a small child standing with his back to you, shoulders spasming in grief. You raise your hand and open your mouth, not quite certain what to say. The figure turns and rushes to you, face suddenly in yours. You flinch back, but there’s nothing there. The child is gone. You reach up to your cheeks and find them wet with tears—and everyone around you looks as if they’ve been crying.

Dungeon: Hanging Prisoner.name:
地城：吊囚牢
Dungeon: Hanging Prisoner

Text.text:
一只狭窄的锈蚀铁笼从天花板上垂吊下来，你看见一名囚犯被困其中。赤裸的双脚从囚笼底部无力垂下，肮脏的手指在更高处死死攥住铁栏。
A narrow cage of rusted metal hangs from the ceiling, and you spot a prisoner trapped inside. Bare feet dangle from the bottom of the prison and dirty fingers clutch at the bars higher up.

一条宽阔的大道笔直穿过凯旋门，直入一座在战略家精心审视下营建的城市。街道在分明的十字路口交汇，划出井然有序的街区。层层同心方形的防御城墙高出周遭楼宇，其外环绕着开阔的杀戮地带，被一丝不苟地清理得寸草不留，不见任何建筑或残骸。
A broad avenue runs straight through a triumphal arch and into a city constructed under the careful eye of a strategist. Streets meet in clear crossroads, forming regulated blocks. Defensive walls in concentric squares rise higher than the surrounding buildings and are encricled by open killing fields kept meticulously clear of construction or debris.

Rigger Command Console.name:
操控师指挥控制台
Rigger Command Console

Text.text: 一只炭灰色的碳纤维公文箱上贴着各式褪色贴纸：几何线条勾勒的无人机图样、不同汽车品牌的标识、以及一只机械手竖起钴蓝色的中指。你在接触界面输入通行码，箱子“咔哒”一声弹开。你听见电脑系统苏醒时的嗡鸣与尖啸。箱体内侧一边嵌着黑色屏幕，另一边是带着方正米色键帽的键盘。屏幕上方一枚针尖大小的摄像头用一张绿光网格扫过你的脸。绿光褪去，黑屏上浮现一行文字：搭个顺风车？ 键盘周围的隔舱滑开，露出盘卷的缆线与电线。 A charcoal-gray carbon-fiber briefcase is decorated with various faded stickers: geometric drawings of drones, logos for different brands of cars, a mechanical hand presenting a cobalt middle finger. Inputting the passcode on a touch interface, the case opens with a click. You hear the whir and whine of computer systems coming to life. A black screen is set into one side of the interior of the case and a keyboard with blocky beige keys in the other. A pinprick camera above the screen scans your face with a mesh of green light. The light fades and a line of text appears on the black screen: Hitching a ride? Compartments around the keyboard slide open to reveal coiled cables and wires.

随着一声声高喊的指令与双手狂乱的挥动，剧团的导演仿佛能分身四处同时现身，督促台前幕后的所有人，为这场盛大演出做最后的准备。他的气场简直像一位沙场统帅，在兵刃相交的必然碰撞到来之前，厉声喝令部队迅速列阵。
With shouted commands and frenetic motions of his hands, the director of the theatrical troupe somehow seems to be everywhere at once, coaching both crew and cast in their preparation for the big show. His presence is not unlike that of a war captain, snapping his troops into formation before the inevitable clash of arms.

Demand For Accommodations From A New Par.name:
新队员的“通融”要求
Demand For Accommodations From A New Party Member

Text.text:
“很抱歉要这么说，但我们得立刻在旅店停下。因为……呃，我以前从没跟这么多人挤得这么近地一起赶路，至少在路上没有过，而且……我就直说了吧：我已经四天没去过茅房了，得赶紧找个像样的落脚处。”
“I’m sorry to do this, but we need to stop at an inn immediately. Because… Well, I’ve never lived in such close proximity with so many people before, not on the road at least, and… I’m just going to come out and say it: I haven’t used the bathroom in four days and need to find proper accommodations.”

Vicious Slaver.name:
残忍的奴隶贩子
Vicious Slaver

Text.text:
此人除形貌之外尽是怪物。他的长鞭抽落，带来灼痛的鞭痕；可腰间垂挂的捆缚绳套逼得他必须贴近——得先把奴隶打到不再有任何抗力，才能套上去。腐烂的牙缝里嘶嘶吐出恶毒咒骂，奴隶贩子沉醉于将痛苦倾泻在无助俘虏身上的快意。
This person is a monster in all but form. His whip delivers stinging lashes, but the binding loops of rope that hang from his belt require him to approach—the slaves must first be beaten until they offer no resistance. Hissing words of abuse through rotten teeth, the slaver enjoys the pain he inflicts upon his helpless captives.

一根带铰链关节的短金属杆连接着两只银白金属环。每个环上都有一条可旋转的臂杆，可开可合；臂杆上布满齿牙，能咔哒咔哒地棘入静止环上的开口。靠近关节处，镣铐还各有两枚更小的金属环，用来连接更多束缚。环圈张开时，金属上蚀刻的符号泛起绿光，如涟漪般流动；当环圈合拢，光芒便骤然暴烈成愤怒的猩红。

~ 由一位英雄构想

A short bar with a hinged joint connects two rings of argent metal. Each loop has a rotating arm that can open or close, and each arm has teeth to ratchet into an opening in the static ring. Near the joint, the cuffs have two smaller metal loops for connecting more restraints. Symbols etched into the metal ripple with green light while the loops are open. They blaze to angry red when the rings close.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Gnome Bard.name:
侏儒吟游诗人
Gnome Bard

Text.text:
斑斓色彩以催眠般的纹样在吟游诗人周身盘旋，她一边舞动一边旋转，将虹彩般的丝缕编织进空气之中。尽管身形娇小，这名侏儒却散发着十足的自信与魅力；她明亮的眼眸闪烁着顽皮与兴奋的光芒。
Color swirls around the bard in hypnotic patterns as she dances and twirls, weaving prismatic strands through the air. Though small in stature, the gnome exudes confidence and charisma, her bright eyes twinkling with mischief and excitement.

Sunset On Planet With Three Suns.name:
三日同辉的行星落日
Sunset On Planet With Three Suns

Text.text:
轨道太阳像一座橙色的丘陵伏在地平线上，光洪倾泻，席卷坚硬的荒漠地表。它右肩旁悬着一颗细小的红星，左侧则鼓起一团褪色的黄光，像硕大的腹部——各自都在与落日争夺天穹。它们的引力角力催生出无垠沙海、板块的碰撞挤压，以及数十种气体的喷涌，翻卷成重量难辨的云团。云团贴着地面缓缓滚行，收拢渐红的光与热。
The orbital sun rests like an orange hill along the horizon, its flood of light charging across the hard desert ground. Off its right shoulder is a tiny red star, and off its left, a big belly of faded yellow—each fighting with the setting sun. Their gravitational struggle creates vast deserts, tectonic collisions, and the emission of dozens of gases that billow in clouds of dubious weight. They roll along the ground, collecting the reddening light and heat.

Loot From A Swamp Hag.name:
来自沼泽鬼婆的战利品
Loot From A Swamp Hag

Text.text:
在这肮脏生物那狭窄、破败的小屋里，你发现了一堆她从受害者身上夺来、当作战利品珍藏的物件。唯有一只镀银高脚杯、几袋钱币，以及一枚古董罗盘仍算得上完好，能换得些许钱财。
Inside the foul creature’s cramped, decrepit hut, you find the hoard of objects she kept as trophies from her victims. A silvered goblet, pouches of coins, and an antique compass are the only salvageable items of monetary value.

Horseshoes Of Speed.name:
速度马蹄铁
Horseshoes Of Speed

Text.text:
紊乱的静电能量缠绕着这些铁制马蹄铁，你在它们近旁不由得浑身发刺，十分不适。每只马蹄铁的底面都被压印进金属的闪电纹路——你发誓它们在你眼前忽明忽暗地闪烁。
A turbulent static energy surrounds these iron horseshoes, and you bristle uncomfortably in their presence. On the underside of each shoe, lightning bolts have been stamped into the metal—you swear they flicker before your eyes.

一张张被风削得消瘦而拉长的面孔，从步步逼近的浓雾深处伸出，仿佛被雾闷得窒息——像一层薄纱覆在那些徒劳挣扎、试图逃离之人的惊惧表情之上。它尽是雾气，无形无质；接触时轻柔，却在皮肤上冷得刺骨。
Faces, gaunt and elongated by the wind, stretch out from within the encroaching fog as if suffocated by it—like a veil over the horrified expressions of people who attempt in vain to escape. It's all mist, noncorporeal; gentle to the touch, yet icy-cold on the skin.

Pipes Of Haunting.name:
骇魂魔笛
Pipes Of Haunting

Text.text:
这些怪诞的烟斗似乎是用某种动物——甚至可能是某种有感知的生物——的骨骼雕刻而成。尽管工艺精湛，但一想到要把嘴唇贴上那光滑、抛得发亮的烟嘴，便令人浑身不自在。
These grotesque pipes have been carved, it seems, from the bones of some sort of animal—perhaps even a sentient creature. Despite its obvious craftsmanship, the thought of placing your lips against its smooth, polished mouthpiece is a discomforting one.

Werewolf Paladin Fights Gnoll God.name:
狼人圣武士鏖战豺狼人之神
Werewolf Paladin Fights Gnoll God

Text.text:
狼族圣武士凛然立于恶魔领主面前，唇线后翻，露出凶狠的龇牙低吼。那生物胸腔里滚出一声低沉的嗤笑，旋即拔高成癫狂的狂笑；一抹邪恶的狞笑在它脸上拉开，长而发黄的利齿间卡着腐臭残肉的碎屑。伴随一声怒吼，圣武士猛扑向恶魔，细剑寒光疾闪，快到肉眼难追，连番在恶魔虬结的胸膛上刻下伤痕，浓稠的黑色秽液自创口缓缓渗出。他再度雷霆般长嚎，重击那亵渎之物，一道冲击波轰然撞上这地狱孽种，将其掀翻在地。圣武士带着猎食者般的狡黠逼近，纵身跃上倒地的怪物，将细剑狠狠贯入它焦黑的心脏。

~ 构想：ThunderWolf

The lupine paladin stands defiantly before the demon lord, his lips curled back in a ferocious snarl. A low chuckle rumbles in the creature’s chest, soon rising to a maniacal cackle as a wicked grin stretches across its face and reveals scraps of rancid carrion between long, yellow teeth. With a roar, the paladin lunges toward the demon, his rapier flashing faster than the eye can follow as he scores the demon’s muscular chest repeatedly, causing thick, black ichor to ooze from the wounds. He howls thunderously as he strikes the abomination again, and a shockwave smashes into the hellspawn, knocking it prone. The paladin approaches with predatory guile, leaping atop the fallen monster and driving his rapier into its blackened heart.

~ Envisioned by ThunderWolf

用甜言蜜语与一记摄魂的挥手去蛊惑一个普通人，需要某种诀窍——要懂得他们的心智如何运作，又该如何将其扭转。而要蛊惑一只非凡的生物，则更像是在考验创造力——以及一种近乎疯狂边缘的勇气。你挂起必胜的笑容，倾尽全力放手一搏。
Enchanting an ordinary person with honeyed words and a mesmerizing wave of your hand requires a certain knack—an understanding of how their mind works, and how to bend it. Enchanting an extraordinary creature requires something more like creativity—and a courage that borders on madness. You put on a winning smile and give it your best effort.

Sir Ector At The Joust.name:
爵士比武场上的埃克托爵士
Sir Ector At The Joust

Text.text:
年代磨钝了这位骑士的轮廓，富足的生活也掩去了他曾经如刀刻般分明的下颌线。可他的姿态依旧带着军旅的锋芒；当他步入竞技场，与众人并肩之时，眼底却有一抹暂时重拾的少年精力在跳跃。

~ 构想：Vahlaron

Age has softened the knight’s features, and a life of plenty has obscured his once-chiseled jawline. Yet his bearing is martial still, and a temporarily recaptured vigor of youth dances behind his eyes as he joins the others in the arena.

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

Sundries From An Aberrant Goblinoid Horr.name:
来自畸变地精类恐魔的杂货
Sundries From An Aberrant Goblinoid Horror

Text.text:
类地精的怪物以一种扭曲的姿态瘫在地上，恐怖的躯体被撕裂得支离破碎。它那系在瘦骨嶙峋腰间的破旧小袋已然裂开；一把锈迹斑斑的钥匙和一截脏兮兮的指骨从残破的袋口滚落出来。
The goblin-like horror lies in a twisted mess on the ground, its horrific body a mutilated wreck. The shabby pouch it wore about its emaciated waist has split open; a rusty key and a dirty fingerbone spill from its ruin.

石块围拢着一座造型诡异的炭坑，坑口呈五芒星。其上方悬挂着错综的链条装置。星形的每一个尖角都是一座铁砧，旁侧摆着一架铁制的铁匠工具架，工具尺寸小到连人类孩童也能拿起使用。每个工位的地面上都放着一张小木凳。五名铁匠既可协力在五芒星中心锻造一件大型物品，也可各自在尖角的铁砧旁各自打造一件小物品。
Stones surround a coal pit of unusual design, shaped like a five-pointed star. Chainworks hang above it. Each point of the star is an anvil, next to which sits an iron rack of smith’s tools small enough for a human child to use. On the floor at each station is a small wooden stool. Five smiths can work together on a large item at the center of the star, or each can work on a small item at the anvil points.

Open Pit Mine.name:
露天矿坑
Open Pit Mine

Text.text:
四周散落成堆的矿渣显然都来自眼前这座深深掘开的巨大露天矿坑。从坑口宽阔、向下缓缓倾斜的边缘很难看清全貌，但那些垂落进更深处中央的梯子暗示着矿工们或许正在地下追寻一条矿脉。此时此刻，你脚下的岩层之下，可能正有人在昏暗里挥汗劳作。
The heaps of tailings scattered around clearly came from this great open pit dug into the ground. It’s hard to see from the broad, sloping edge of the cavity, but the ladders that drop into the deeper center hint that the miners might be following a seam under the ground. There may be miners toiling away at this very moment beneath your feet.

I Channel Divinity For Divine Smite.name:
我引导神圣渠道以施展神圣惩击
I Channel Divinity For Divine Smite

Text.text:
我举起圣徽对准亡灵。它骤然迸放出耀目的辉光，我厉声道：“看清你们不可避免的终末之光！退散！”
I present my holy symbol to the undead. It flashes with radiance as I say, “Behold the light of your inevitable end! Begone!”

I Use My Ring Of Three Wishes.name:
我使用我的三愿戒指
I Use My Ring Of Three Wishes

Text.text:
我把戒指紧紧贴在胸前，死死攥住，努力接受这股骇人的力量竟被封存在区区一枚饰物之中。我说出我的愿望，随即一阵如同狂风般的力量掠过我、穿透我。先是一声尖细刺耳的吱响，紧跟着是一记沉闷的碎裂轻响。我低头一看，三颗钻石中的一颗——先前还那样璀璨流光、虹彩摇曳——如今已黯淡成灰蒙蒙的钝色。它曾完美无瑕的表面，被一道细薄的崩口划破。
I hold the ring close, clutching it, coming to terms with the raw power I hold in a mere piece of jewelry. I speak my wish and a feeling like a great wind rushes over and through me. I hear a high, tinny squeak followed by a quiet crunch. I look down and see one of the three diamonds, so beautifully shining and iridescent before, has dimmed to a dull gray. A thin chip mars its once perfect face.

Sizzling Copper Staff.name:
滋滋作响的铜杖
Sizzling Copper Staff

Text.text:
这根法杖是一截铜制圆筒，靠近两端与握持处刻着并锤打出几道隐约的环纹。它中空，只有一小把粗砺的沙子在里面。法杖挥动或以其他方式舞动时，沙子在铜腔内嘶嘶作响，拍击着杖端。它能增强火焰魔法，但持用者必须保护双手，免受铜身灼热的烫伤。
This staff is a cylinder of copper with subtle bands etched and hammered into it near the ends and at the handholds. It is hollow but for a handful of rough sand. When the staff is swung or otherwise wielded in motion, the sand hisses inside the copper and smacks against the end. It enhances fire magic, but the wielder must protect their hands against the copper’s heat.

Mind Flayer Striding Forward.name:
夺心魔阔步前行
Mind Flayer Striding Forward

Text.text:
一个高挑精瘦的身影带着明确的目的大步走来。一袭深色长袍自他们肩头垂落，覆在胸前那点简约的护甲之外。起初一切看似寻常，直到你看见他们四指的利爪之手，以及那张被四条探伸触须覆盖的口器。他们灰烬般的紫色皮肤紧绷在形状怪异的颅骨上，后脑勺不自然地凸出。深而无毛的眉脊半遮着凹陷的黑色眼窝。
A tall, lean built figure strides forward with purpose. A long dark robe hangs from their shoulders over minimal armor on their chest. All seems normal until you see their clawed four-fingered hands, and the mouth covered by four reaching tentacles. Their ashen purple skin is pulled tight around their unusually shaped skull, sticking out at the back. Deep hairless brows partially conceal their sunken black eyes.

Prince Of Wrath.name:
愤怒王子
Prince Of Wrath

Text.text:
一张圆滚滚、布满黄色斑点的脸庞高高耸在你头顶，离地足足二十四英尺。除了两道浓密如灌木的眉毛外，他全身光秃无毛。他俯视着你，巨大的黑眼珠空洞无神，脑袋歪斜地耷拉在佝偻的肩上；嘴唇挂着涎水闪着光，饥馋地吧嗒作响。  

他迈着缓慢而沉重的步子，短粗的双腿把他一点点挪近，直到他那可怜的智力终于辨认出你是个活物。  

他欢呼一声，抡起那柄巨大的战锤。  

他冲了过来……
A pudgy yellow-spotted face, hairless except for two bushy eyebrows, towers an astonishing twenty-four feet above you. He looks down, massive black eyes blank, head lolling in a tilt on hunched shoulders, and lips glistening with drool as he smacks them hungrily. With slow lumbering steps, his stubby legs carry him closer, until his meager intellect identifies you as a living being. With a shout of joy, his titanic hammer is raised. He charges…

Garaggakal Polymath.name:
加拉加卡尔·博学者
Garaggakal Polymath

Text.text:
如同一位扭曲的天使，这只生物带着天穹般的优雅，在群星之间漆黑而荒寒的虚空里划出弧光。它足有十五英尺长，覆着橡胶般的黄白色皮肤，拖着一条细长的爬行类尾巴；身形在视野中时隐时现，仿佛正闪烁着闯入现实。四条手臂末端伸出放肆的利爪，但最令人不安的还是它的头——如鳗鱼般的深渊巨口，森森獠牙寒光闪动，饥渴地吮吸着空气。那头颅以不可能的角度扭转，伴随令人作呕的咔嚓声倒折翻转。它在寻找某样东西。永远如此。
Like a twisted angel, this creature arcs with a celestial grace through the black bleakness of the spaces between. Fifteen feet long, with rubbery, yellowish skin and a long reptilian tail, it phases in and out of vision, as though flickering into realspace. Four arms end in rakish claws, but it is the head that most unsettles: an eel-like cavern of glinting fangs, sucking at the air with hunger. This head twists an impossible direction, inverting in a sickening crunch. It is in search of something. Always.

Creepy Coffin Maker's.name:
阴森的棺材匠
Creepy Coffin Maker's

Text.text:
只有几束迷失的阳光穿透这间阴沉的作坊内部；此处阴森得令人发指，几乎与最冷酷的墓园一样，成了生命逝去的纪念碑。因为在这里，一具具狭长的棺材正处在不同的制作阶段。有的斜倚在墙边，等着打磨并薄薄刷上一层清漆；有的还需要钉锤敲合，便像柴捆般成堆躺着。不难想象每一具里都将容纳尸体，而当你沉重地回望，关于自然终末旅程的残酷现实便如一层阴冷的裹尸布，沉沉覆在你身上。
Only errant beams of sunlight permeate the darkened interior of this grisly workshop, as much a monument to life's passing as the grimmest cemetery. For here, oblong coffins exist in various states of manufacture. Some are cocked against walls waiting to be sanded and lightly coated with varnish, while others needing to be hammered together lie in piles like cordwood. It is not difficult to imagine corpses within each, and upon somber reflection the stark reality of nature's last journey settles over you with a bleak pall.

I Use Distant Spell.name:
我施展【远距法术】
I Use Distant Spell

Text.text:
我将未经提炼的魔力系缚于一个锚点，让我的法术效应得以连接到更远的所在——将法术推越其通常的射程。随着法术奔赴新的目的地，那个锚点在途中灼烧殆尽。
I tie unrefined magical energy to an anchor point that connects my spell’s effects to a place farther away than they can normally reach—pushing the spell beyond its usual range. The anchor point burns away as the spell travels to its new destination.

Sundries From A Vampire Child.name:
来自吸血鬼（特征）孩童的杂物
Sundries From A Vampire Child

Text.text:
在这阴险生物的随身物品中，你找到一只旧木陀螺，漆色早已褪去磨损。你捧起这玩具，读到木头上刻着的名字——正是你所击败的敌人——一丝忧郁在腹中拧紧。或许他们把它留在身边，是为了提醒自己，在他们的青春被如此残酷夺走之前，曾有过的那个时代。
Among the insidious creature’s belongings you find an old wooden spinning top, its paint faded and worn. A tinge of melancholy twists your gut as you hold the toy and read the name carved into the wood—that of your vanquished foe. Perhaps they kept it to remind themself of a time before their youth was so cruelly taken.

Haunted Castle: Torture Chamber.name:
闹鬼古堡：刑讯室
Haunted Castle: Torture Chamber

Text.text:
即便这座城堡曾充满生机，你也绝不愿踏入这些厅室。无论你转向何处，映入眼帘的都是锈蚀腐朽的刑具。尖刺、螺钉、鞭子、锁链——许多人临死前看到的最后景象便是这些；更惨的，是在眼珠被生生剜出后仍被留着一口气，尖叫着熬过漫长得过分的时光。
Even if the castle was filled with life, you would not want to set foot in these chambers. Every way you turn, you see the rusting and rotting implements of torture. Spikes, screws, whips, chains—these were the last things many people saw before they died, or worse, before their eyes were plucked out and they were kept alive and screaming for far too long.

Shadow Plane Overwhelms The Faerie Plane.name:
暗影位面淹没妖精位面
Shadow Plane Overwhelms The Faerie Plane

Text.text:
你嘴里尝到灰烬的味道。刺骨苦寒的风卷起漫天尘土，遮蔽了你的视线。远处，光芒仍在一盏盏熄灭，黑暗如潮滚过大地。连生命本身都在这场幽影风暴前俯首，野兽徒劳奔逃。森林枯死，崩解成尘。阴影已经降临。
You taste ash in your mouth. Your vision is obscured by dust swirling in the frigid, bitter wind. In the distance, the light continues to wink out as the darkness rolls across the landscape. Life itself kneels before the shadowy tempest, wildlife fleeing in futility. The forest dies and crumbles to dust. The shadow has come.

I Center Myself Before I Defend.name:
我在防御前先令心神归一
I Center Myself Before I Defend

Text.text:
当敌人逼近时，我的心跳如擂鼓，他们脸上写满了致命的决绝。我稳稳扎下脚跟，给自己片刻平复心神与躯体。深吸一口气，屈膝沉腰，背脊挺直——我已就绪。敌人的每一次移动都化作清晰的预演，指引着接下来每一步的闪避、每一次的格挡、每一记的挥击。
My heart races as the enemy closes in, their face full of deathly determination. I plant my feet solidly to take a moment to calm my mind and body. Deep breaths, bent knees, squared back—I am ready. The enemy’s movements become projections for each subsequent step, swipe, and swing.

Open Grave In Winter.name:
冬日里的开坟
Open Grave In Winter

Text.text:
[初次到访] 一只乌鸦蓬起羽毛，用乌亮的豆眼盯了你一瞬，随即振翅飞起，掠过墓园，落在一棵枯树的裸枝间，与同伴挤作一团。它先前栖在一把铁锹的柄上——那铁锹被硬生生插进一堆冻土里，冻土旁是一座敞开的墓坑。另一把铁锹倒在雪里，靠着土堆的底部。在这般冻硬的地里开坟得费尽力气。也许正因如此，在此劳作的人才会中途放弃。

[再次到访] 积雪几乎灌满了敞开的墓穴，把它的深度掩得无影无踪。旁侧的土堆塌陷了些，也被白雪覆上一层。此墓看起来与墓园里其他坟茔已几无差别。

[First visit] A crow fluffs its feathers and regards you with a beady eye before taking off and flying across the graveyard to land among its fellows in the bare branches of a tree. It had been perched upon the handle of a shovel jammed into a pile of frozen earth beside the open pit of a grave. Another shovel lies in the snow at the base of the pile. It would be hard work, cutting a grave in such frozen ground. Perhaps that’s why whoever was working here gave up.

[Return visit] Snow has nearly filled the open grave, disguising its depth. The mound of earth beside it has settled and been covered with white. The grave looks little different from the others in the cemetery.

Plain Gold Brooch.name:
朴素的金胸针
Plain Gold Brooch

Text.text:
几乎每个村庄与城镇的商铺里都能找到这种东西——由配偶或情人买下的赋礼。它呈近乎完美的椭圆形，只是别针扣眼做得过大，导致别针在未派上用场前总会叮当作响。
Shops in just about every village and town have one of these, the gift bought by a spouse or lover. It is an almost perfect oval, but the eye for the bar pin is too large, so the pin rattles until it is put to use.

Edge Of The Forest.name:
森林边缘
Edge Of The Forest

Text.text:
树木如同一列尖桩栅栏般直刺天际。你的视线只能穿透几码，便被浓密、阴翳的枝叶吞没。荒野深处有什么在蠢动，它们的窸窣声与呼唤声一路传来，即便你仍站在林缘，也清晰入耳。
The trees rise like a palisade against the sky. Your vision only penetrates a few yards into the dense, shadowed foliage. Things stir within the deep reaches of the wilds, their rustlings and calls reaching your ears even here on the edge of the forest.

这本书以绿色皮革装订，封面压印着一棵风格化的树，盘根错节。它显露出岁月的磨损：书角破碎起毛，原本用于扣带的铆钉孔如今空空如也；后封那枚搭扣也无物可系。书页边缘布满污渍。整部巨册散发着陈旧羊皮纸、霉味与一丝烟草烟雾的气息，然而翻开来看，里面每一张挺括的纸页都洁净无瑕，空白如初。
Bound in green leather embossed with a stylized tree with interwoven roots, this book has signs of wear. The corners are tattered, and rivet holes for a clasp sit empty. A buckle on the back cover has nothing to fasten. Stains mark the page edges. The tome smells of old parchment, mold, and a hint of tobacco smoke, yet each crisp sheet inside is clean and empty.

Igloo On Snowy Plain.name:
雪原冰屋
Igloo On Snowy Plain

Text.text:
藏在两座覆雪丘陵之间的一处小谷地里，你面前这座坚固的冰屋无惧愈发猛烈的暴风雪，任凭雪花横扫。屋内的空间成了抵御刺骨寒风的避难所，在凛冽严寒中送来一股令人安心的暖意。
Hidden in a small valley of two snow-covered hills, the sturdy igloo before you defies the driving flurries from the growing blizzard. The inside space is a refuge from the biting wind and provides a welcoming warmth in the bitter cold.

I Summon A Shadow Blade.name:
我召唤出一把暗影之刃
I Summon A Shadow Blade

Text.text:
我此刻只是暂时手无寸铁，因为我的心智仍牢牢攫住那把剑的影像。于是我凝神，阖上双眼，想象影子的触须如藤蔓般交织缠结，编成我无比熟悉的刃身。我摊开手，睁开眼——刹那的闪光里，长剑归来。剑首贴合我的掌心，剑身迅疾织回战斗的形态。

~ 一位英雄所Envisioned

I am unarmed only for the moment, as my mind still holds the picture of the sword. And so I focus, close my eyes and picture the tendrils of shadow braiding like a vine into the blade I know so well. I open my hand, open my eyes—in the flash of a second the sword returns. The pommel conforms to my palm, and the blade weaves quickly back into fighting shape.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Surly Bartender With Elephant Trunk.name:
长着象鼻的暴躁酒保
Surly Bartender With Elephant Trunk

Text.text:
华丽的仿木吧台后，酒保以谨慎而精准的动作擦拭着一只烈酒杯。他本该毫不起眼——若不是在他紧锁的眉头与半垂的沉重眼睑下方，垂着一条象鼻：厚实的灰色皮肤包覆其上，越靠近与人类肌肤相接之处，颜色便逐渐淡成米黄色。他对这怪异的附肢似乎毫不在意，时而用它探下去整理刀叉与杯具，偶尔还会朝脏杯里喷出一股水流冲洗。
The bartender behind an ornate faux-wooden bar cleans a shot glass with careful and precise movements. He would be unremarkable, except for the fact that below his frown and heavy-lidded eyes hangs an elephant trunk covered in thick gray skin—which gradually changes to beige at the point where it meets human skin. He does not seem concerned about his curious appendage, reaching down with it to sort cutlery and glassware, and occasionally shooting water into dirty cups.

不知是谁锻造了这柄附魔的金斧，却显然忘了用更坚韧的材质与这柔软的贵金属合金；只要猛力一挥，斧头便会从斧柄上脱落，打着旋儿朝一侧飞甩而去——这可不是你原本想让它飞出去的那种“脑袋”。
Whoever forged this enchanted golden axe apparently failed to alloy the malleable metal with something stronger; a mighty swing causes the axe-head to detach from the handle and go careering off to one side. It was not the sort of head you had hoped to send flying.

那生物——像一只被放大到臃肿程度的蚊子与蝙蝠的杂交体——朝你俯冲而下，细小的珠状眼睛搜寻着唾手可得的一餐，斑驳的橙色皮肤在昏光中浮现。一根针状口器从它那张丑陋怪诞的脸上突刺而出。
The creature—resembling an oversized bulbous mosquito crossed with a bat—descends on you, beady eyes hunting for an easy meal, its skin a mottled orange. A needle-like proboscis protrudes from the thing's grotesque face.

蜥蜴人活得更像蛙族。一支木筏船队像睡莲叶般漂在沼泽上，每一张都是一座小小的堡垒，柳条编成的墙面朝水面。你看不出有什么登筏的途径，除了那种危险的攀爬——会把你暴露在攻击之下——但一张木筏上传来的“扑通”溅水声给出了答案：蜥蜴人一定是游过去，从每张木筏的底下钻上来。
The lizardfolk live more like frogkin. A flotilla of rafts float across the swamp like lily pads, each a little fortress with wicker walls facing the water. You don’t see a means of getting aboard any of them besides a perilous climb that would expose you to attack, but a the sound of a splash from aboard a raft provides the answer: the lizardfolk must swim and come up under each raft.

一枚红宝石悬浮在施法者的掌心上方，旋即消失——被黑焰吞噬——伴随着一句污秽的咒语吐出，大地随之烙下焦痕。光芒短促地鼓胀成一团球形闪耀，随即阴影凝结成形，咧开阴狠的笑，布满鳞片的手紧攥着一柄武器。恶魔撕破地狱印记的守护结界，强行闯出。施法者为召唤所耗，闷哼一声，额头沁出细密的汗珠。
A ruby floats above the caster’s palm, then disappears—consumed by black fire—as a foul word is spoken and the ground is scarred. A brief spherical flare of light, then a shadow takes shape, grinning and sinister, a weapon clutched in its scaly hand. The devil breaks past the protective wards of the infernal mark. The caster grunts with the effort of the summoning, sweat beading at their brow.

Wild Magic Surge: Immolation.name:
狂野魔法涌动：焚身灼燃
Wild Magic Surge: Immolation

Text.text:
你的施法产生了意外的效果：一颗硫磺味的红色珠子猛然迸出，像迷途的火星般弹跳着滚向你的脚边。仿佛法术偏偏挑了这个不合时宜的时刻，它轰然炸裂，化作灼烈的焚灭之炎，将你吞没在一团炽热火球之中。
Your casting has an unintended effect: a sulfurous red bead springs forth, an errant ember bouncing toward your feet. As though the spell chose this inopportune moment, it explodes in a scorching immolation that swallows you up in a sphere of searing fire.

Elven Village By Moonlight.name:
月光下的精灵村落
Elven Village By Moonlight

Text.text:
在月光的褶皱之间，精灵村落于空灵的寂寞中苏醒。变幻的光束照亮蜿蜒的小径，在起伏的林间空地上铺下一层银辉。木质居所散出温暖的微光，夜行者低唱旋律悠长的圣歌。在这处树影庇护的隐秘栖所里，精灵们寻得安宁，编织梦境，沉浸于在他们魔法家园周遭轻舞的静谧谜意之中。
Within the folds of moonlight, the elven village awakens in ethereal solitude. Mercurial beams illuminate the twisting paths, casting a silvery glow over the undulating glade. Wooden dwellings exude warm luminescence, while nocturnal walkers sing melodic hymns. In this arboreal hideaway, the elves find solace, weaving dreams and basking in the tranquil mystery that dances about their enchanted home.

灌木丛被一头巨大的猪状野兽硬生生拱开，它用肩膀顶开蕨丛挤了出来。它哼哧作响，猛地甩动那颗骇人的巨头，唾沫碎沫四散飞溅，洒满林间空地。那对獠牙粗结扭曲，宛如畸形的凶器——凡敢阻挡这位林中之王者，皆将迎来死亡。它注意到你，便将伤痕累累的侧腹转向你，开始绕着你缓缓兜圈。
The undergrowth parts as a large pig-like animal shoulders its way through the bracken. It snorts and shakes its enormous head, flecks of sputum spraying the glade. The beast’s tusks are gnarled monstrosities, twisted bringers of death to any who cross this king of the woods. Noticing you, it turns its scarred flank toward you and begins to circle.

Storm Of Steel.name:
钢铁风暴
Storm Of Steel

Text.text:
你以娴熟而精准的动作，具现出数十把匕首，寒光闪烁；它们锋刃狰狞，旋转着破空疾掠。刀锋呼啸而过，切裂空气——一场由你召来的钢铁风暴，直扑你的对手。
With practiced and precise movements, you manifest dozens of daggers, blades gleaming; their wicked edges spin and soar through the air. They whistle as they slice, a storm of steel conjured against your opponent.

Wild Magic Surge: Wild Flumphs Appear.name:
狂野魔法涌动：野生福伦普现身
Wild Magic Surge: Wild Flumphs Appear

Text.text:
魔法从你体内如间歇泉般喷涌而出，撕开一道只有你能看见的破烂裂隙之门。飘出来的东西形貌怪诞，却并无害意。恰恰相反，似乎是你那一拳打进另一个位面本身，把你无意间召来的存在吓得魂飞魄散。裂口倏然合拢，而那些漂浮的生物仍悬在半空。
Magic spews from you like a geyser, tearing a ragged portal that only you can see. What drifts out looks aberrant, but harmless. On the contrary, it’s your punching into another plane that seems to terrify what you’ve accidentally summoned. The rend shuts, and the levitating creatures remain.

Sundries From A Homunculus.name:
人造人杂货铺
Sundries From A Homunculus

Text.text:
这个人工生命体穿着一件皮制束腰外衣，体型只有鼻烟盒那么大；它唯一的价值，也不过是当作谈资——竟然真有如此迷你的一件衣服。
The homunculus wears a leather tunic the size of a snuffbox, worth only the conversational value of having a piece of clothing so small.

你几乎没注意到它。一只爬行动物通过改变布满颗粒的皮肤颜色，将自己伪装进周遭环境里。那只小蜥蜴用四趾利爪紧紧攀住栖身处，尾巴蜷成螺旋。它微微转动脑袋，宽阔的嘴抿出一抹皱眉的神情。突出的珠状眼睛向左向右一抽一抽地颤动，警惕地——也有点滑稽地——朝着彼此分开的方向窥视着。
You almost miss it. A reptile has camouflaged itself among its surroundings by changing the color of its pebbled skin. The small lizard clings to its perch with four-toed claws and keeps its tail curled up in a spiral. It turns its head minutely, frowning with its wide mouth. Protruding, beadlike eyes twitch this way and that, peering warily—and a bit comically—in separate directions.

I Cast Pass Without Trace.name:
我施放《无迹可寻》
I Cast Pass Without Trace

Text.text:
自我身影之中，新的大片黑暗如涟漪般向外荡开。它们在我周身拔地而起，又向我心念所指的目标延展，将我们尽数笼罩。我们的身体轻捷如巷猫，滑溜如鳗。我们的脚步轻得像蟋蟀振翅，踏过地面不留半点痕迹。
From my own shadow, new swathes of darkness ripple outward. They rise up around me and stretch to my willing targets, veiling us all. Our bodies feel as sleek as alley cats, slippery as eels. Our footfalls are as quiet as crickets’ and leave no impression upon the ground.

深浅不一的上等丝绸以金线镶边，层层披覆在女伯爵雕像般的身形上。她浓密的长发高高堆起，以发针固定成头顶一圈完美的螺旋，光泽夺目。额前一枚金色发箍静静点缀，低调却无可错认地昭示着她的尊贵身份。
Fine silks of varying shades, all trimmed with golden thread, drape the statuesque form of the countess. Her voluminous hair, piled and pinned in a perfect spiral atop her head, shines vibrantly. A golden circlet adorns her forehead and invokes a subtle but unmistakable mark of station.

这座凉亭无疑曾经颇为雅致，依着峡谷峭壁而建。如今屋顶覆满厚重的地衣与苔藓，湿沼般的腥浊气息缠绕其间，胆怯之人只消一瞥，脊背便会窜起寒意。
This pavilion was doubtless an attractive structure at one point, constructed as it was against the canyon’s side. Now, with its roof covered in thick lichen and moss, it holds a swampy, seamy mood that might send a shiver down the spines of the timid.

一团怪异的光在浩瀚虚空中凝成不稳定的形体。它像是一只白化章鱼，小小的口器在空气中咔哒作响。那是由须蔓、触手、鳞片与羽毛拼缀而成的存在——尽皆幽灵般虚幻，尽皆在摇曳的光里闪着白银般的冷辉。它在眨眼间忽隐忽现，仿佛连光本身都被它扭折牵引。
An aberrant light takes an unstable form in the vast void. It is something alike to an albino octopus, its small mouth clicking at the air. It is a being of tendrils and tentacles and scales and feathers—all ghostly, all shimmering white-silver in the oscillating light. It vanishes and reappears with a flicker of the eye, seeming to bend the very light around it.

I Cast Demiplane.name:
我施放半位面
I Cast Demiplane

Text.text:
我在心眼中牢牢锁定房间的轮廓，随即开始施展法术那一连串繁复的手势。指尖在身前编织出纤细的符号，我感到魔法的力量在空气里渐渐化作低沉的嗡鸣。最后一个手势落定，潜伏的能量轰然攀升，嗡鸣强烈到震得我牙齿打颤。一扇幽影般的门在我面前凝成实体，门框四周细致地刻着我法术的符文。
I fix the room in my mind’s eye as I begin the complex series of gestures to cast the spell. As my fingers weave delicate symbols before me, I feel the power of magic as a growing hum in the air. I complete the last gesture as the hum of latent energy becomes so powerful that my teeth rattle. A shadowy door materializes in front of me, the symbols of my spell etched delicately around its frame.

Ocean Cliffside Border Town In Winter.name:
冬日海崖边境小镇
Ocean Cliffside Border Town In Winter

Text.text:
你走进镇子时，翻搅的海声仍在耳畔回荡。穿过敞开的城门，两名守门卫几乎没把你放在眼里，只是搓着干裂的手，点头示意。石板路上覆着一层冰，寒光闪烁，脚下步步惊险。街道几近空无一人，只有寥寥几名硬朗的行人，小心翼翼地顶着刺骨寒意前行。你头顶上，白色石砌的房屋沿着峭壁层层攀爬，盐渍侵蚀的百叶窗与门板在风里咯咯作响。
The sounds of the churning sea can still be heard as you enter the town. Two gate guards barely register you when you walk through the open gate, instead just rubbing their chapped hands and nodding. Ice glistens upon the cobbles, the going perilous. The streets are almost empty, with just a few hardy souls gingerly braving the chill. Above you, the white stone buildings creep up the cliff face, salt-scarred shutters and doors rattling in the wind.

这柄短刃以邪异的弧度衬托出剃刀般的锋口。刀尖骤然外张，形成更宽的刃端，正适合将钢刃狠狠送入目标深处。极小的护手自柄部伸出，末端则嵌着一枚小巧的钩形柄头。
The wicked curve of this short blade embellishes its razor’s edge. The tip of the blade flares into a wider end, perfect for driving the steel deep into its target. A miniscule guard stretches from the hilt and a small, hooked pommel sits at the end.

Field Of Petrified Soldiers.name:
石化士兵之原
Field Of Petrified Soldiers

Text.text:
无论是什么把这些士兵化作石像，都以骇人的规模降临。战斗戛然而止：战士的剑还停在半挥之际，法师的法术还凝在半施之间。这里像一座雕塑园，又像一片墓园——纪念碑不是安卧沉寂，而是定格在行动之中；这地方因此带着一种诡异的动势。士兵们的姿势满是渴望，仿佛仍想顺势挥到底——把未竟之举做完。
Whatever turned these soldiers to stone did so on a grand scale. The battle ended for warriors in mid-swing of their swords and mages in mid-spell. Like a sculpture garden, or a kirkyard of monuments in action rather than repose, this place has a strange momentum to it. The poses of the soldiers seem desirous, as though they seek to follow through—to finish what they started.

Temple To A God Of Renewal.name:
焕新之神的神庙
Temple To A God Of Renewal

Text.text:
这位神祇的每一处神殿，都由接生婆与农人照看——他们是治疗与生长的司职者。入口大厅一侧的祭坛上堆叠着满筐的收成，好让教众前往田地与果园劳作；另一侧则陈列着层层架子，摆满药材、医疗用品与炼金配剂，供那些自愿守在病榻旁的人取用。来访者可以带走一束芬芳的青绿香草、一瓶旋转流光的灵药，或一份田间新摘的作物；其余则留给那位每个季节都能让整座村落焕然新生的神祇。
Each house of this god is tended by midwives and farmers, the ministers of healing and growing. One side of the entrance hall has stacked baskets on its altars, so that parishioners can work the fields and orchards. The other has shelves of medical supplies and alchemical remedies, for those who volunteer at by the beds of the infirm. A visitor may take one of the aromatic green herbs, swirling elixirs, or fresh crops from the fields, leaving the rest to the god that renews entire villages every season.

尽管你能看见有些地方的积雪间探出几簇高草，但这片无垠的雪白原野依旧死寂荒凉。刺骨寒风横扫大地，穿透你的衣物，将针刺般的冰粒拍进你的脸上。
Although you can see some long grass poking up through the snow in places, the vast fields of white feel lifeless and desolate. A bitterly cold wind whips across the expanse, cutting through your clothes and blowing stinging ice into your face.

Solar Flare Fries Ship Systems.name:
太阳耀斑薯条舰船系统
Solar Flare Fries Ship Systems

Text.text:
远处那团不断扩大的光点愈发炽烈，直至化作刺目白芒，船员们连自己伸到面前的手都看不清。舰船的警报声撕裂虚空，纯白缓缓褪去，取而代之的是全舰面板齐刷刷亮起的警戒红光——它们在尖叫着警告，催逼着所有人的目光与反应。
The growing spot of light in the distance intensifies until it becomes blinding and the crew is unable to see their hands in front of their faces. Alarms from the ship blare into the void, and the white slowly fades to the red of every panel on the ship shouting warnings and demanding attention.

城市的心脏将生命之血泵向四方：一张繁忙的动脉网络，载着人群、货物与故事奔流不息。自此出发，城中每个角落都与广场中央那座巨大的喷泉等距相连。传奇人物的雕像矗立在泉台之上，泉水在交谈声与脚步声的喧嚣间愉悦地潺潺滴落；而在它们的阴影里，城里的人们来来往往。
The heart of the city pumps its lifeblood in all directions: a bustling network of arteries carrying people, goods, and stories. From here, every corner of the city stands an equidistant from the massive fountain at the center of the plaza. Statues of legendary figures stand atop the font trickling pleasantly amid the din of conversation and foot traffic, and in their shadow the people of the city come and go.

Sonnet Darkmoore.name:
十四行诗·暗沼尔
Sonnet Darkmoore

Text.text:
她把紫色的头发扎成马尾，随后检查桌上的手弩。她的脸庞是深赭色，衬衫敞开着，露出从颈侧倾泻而下的青铜鳞片，一路滑入衣领，穿过喇叭状的袖口。她的眼睛是淡紫色，瞳孔如龙般细裂，眼线画成绿色的翼形，与唇上的颜色相呼应。她其余的装束尽显海盗气息，可她的神情却宁静，甚至温和。她戴上三角帽，伸展爪子。

~ 由 Kelsey 扮演，使用

She ties her purple hair into a ponytail, then checks the hand crossbow on the table. Her face is dark umber, and her blouse is open to the bronze scales that cascade from her neck down into the collar and through her belled sleeves. Her eyes are lavender and slitted like a dragon’s, with eyeliner painted in green wings to match the color on her lips. The rest of her outfit speaks of piracy, although her face is serene, even kind. She puts on a tricorn hat and stretches her claws.

~ Played by Kelsey with

一座狭长的高塔自沙丘中拔地而起，群山与荒漠在后方空旷得近乎虚无。尽管塔基四周堆满瓦砾，建筑边缘也满是缺口、风蚀斑驳，但整体仍显得完好无损。一个方形门槛豁然张开，通向神秘的黑暗。敞开的入口上方高处，两扇窗如空洞的凝视之眼，冷冷注视着靠近的人。
An oblong tower rises from a dune, the mountains and desert its vacuous backdrop. Though rubble crowds around the base, and the edges of the structure are notched and weatherworn, overall it seems intact. A square threshold yawns into a mysterious darkness. High above this open passage are two windows that appear as blank staring eyes, peering at those who approach.

The Amber Sleeper.name:
琥珀沉眠者
The Amber Sleeper

Text.text:
腐朽的木质从树干上剥落，你得以窥见后方的密室。琥珀自墙壁间渗出，凝成橙金交织的冰封溪流，在火把光芒下幽然发亮。你的目光不由被房间尽头牵引——那里曾有一条浩大的古老树脂之河，从树体内层一道巨大的创口中汩汩涌出。琥珀深处，一道漆黑身影巍然逼近，已被封冻了数个世纪。那身影的一条肢体朝你伸出，你看见它史前的利爪间紧攥着一件珍贵的物品。
As the rotten wood falls away from the tree, you can see into the chamber beyond. Amber seeps from the walls, forming frozen streams of orange and gold that glow under the light of your torch. Your eyes are drawn to the far side of the room, where a vast river of the ancient sap once flowed from a great wound in the tree's inner layers. A dark figure looms inside the amber, frozen for centuries. One of the figure's limbs is outstretched toward you, and you spot a valuable item clasped in its prehistoric claws.

Druid Quip About Living In Nature.name:
德鲁伊打趣：住在自然里
Druid Quip About Living In Nature

Text.text:
“既然大自然里什么都不缺，你又何必选在这种糟透了的地方生活？你可以栖身林冠之下，靠灌木丛里的果实果腹，在溪流清凉的怀抱中洗去尘汗……当然，厕所就是地上挖个坑，这点得先说清，但除此之外，你都齐活了。”
“Why would you choose to live in such an awful place, when everything you need can be found in nature? You can shelter beneath the canopy, live off the fruits of the undergrowth, bathe in the cool embrace of a stream… The bathroom is a hole in the ground, mind, but otherwise you’re set.”

I Activate My Ioun Stone Of Regeneration.name:
我启动了再生灵息石
I Activate My Ioun Stone Of Regeneration

Text.text:
我从材料袋里抽出一枚珍珠般莹白的纺锤，带着伤势竭力将它托在空中。作为回报，纺锤在空中像芭蕾舞者般旋转，随即踏出一圈宽广的舞步，沿着轨迹一遍又一遍从我面前掠过。我重新生长。能清晰感到骨骼在咔哒作响中接续愈合，伤口在治疗中收拢成浅浅擦痕，疼痛化作艾欧恩的优雅与宁静。
From my component bag I draw a pearly-white spindle, holding it in the air as best I can with my injuries. For my pains, the spindle turns like a ballerina in the air, then dances in a wide circle, passing before me again and again on its course. I grow back. I can feel my bones knitting and my wounds healing to mere scrapes, my pain transforming to the grace of Ioun.

双翼大张，这头年迈的翼龙自峭壁上一跃而下，以惊人的速度朝翻涌的海面俯冲。狂风攫住它的翼膜，将它猛然托起；那一下突兀的抖拽震得它老骨生疼，生物不由得龇牙皱眉。它自幼便在这片水域捕鱼，并将一直如此，直到风再也无法托举它为止。
Wings spread wide, the aged pterosaur drops from the cliff, hurtling toward the roiling ocean at alarming speed. The creature winces as the wind catches its wings, carrying it aloft with a sudden jolt which jars its old bones. It has fished these waters since youth, and will do so until the wind no longer carries it.

Antimatter Rifle In An Ancient Vault.name:
古老密库中的反物质步枪
Antimatter Rifle In An Ancient Vault

Text.text:
你把这件古怪的物品从这间密室墙上的支架上硬撬下来，它一头栽进你怀里。足足四尺长，外形像一根略呈圆筒的管子，一端开着孔洞，连着一副由拉丝、哑光黑金属铸就的机架。另一端伸出一块垫板，装在肩托上，颇像用来吸收重弩后坐力的那种缓冲托。

它对你而言几乎彻底陌生，但你还是捕捉到一丝熟悉：机架底部有一处像手弩握把的结构，扳机机构外罩着方形金属护圈，扳机护圈下方还有某种按钮。机架顶部、与握把相对的一侧，似乎固定着一具微型单筒望远镜，可你看不出它有任何旋转或伸展的方式。

笨重倒是笨重，却比重弩轻得多，做工也精致许多。你厌恶它在你手中不停发出的嗡鸣。
You pry the strange item off its bracket on the wall of this chamber, and it tumbles into your arms. Fully four feet long, it resembles a somewhat cylindrical tube with an aperture at one end joined to a chassis formed of brushed, matte-black metal. Jutting out of the other end is a pad mounted to a shoulder stock, not unlike the kind that absorbs the kick of a heavy crossbow. Though its overwhelmingly alien to you, another point of familiarity you notice is on the bottom of the chassis, which resembles the grip of a hand crossbow, with a squared metal guard over the trigger mechanism as well as some sort of button below the trigger guard. A miniature spyglass appears to be mounted atop the chassis opposite the grip, though you see no means to rotate or extend it. Bulky, yes, but weighing considerably less than a heavy crossbow, and far more refined in its finish. You mislike how it hums constantly in your hands.

I Study An Ancient Language.name:
我研习一门古老语言
I Study An Ancient Language

Text.text:
先是字母表。光是把那些字母念出来，有时都很难，尤其是我母语里根本不存在的音素。接着是词汇、背诵。我望着一只杯子，用它古老的名字呼唤它。一匹马，一幢屋子的屋顶。动词变位、古怪的时态与格变化铺成一条漫长的路。它一点一点黏在我心里——也许有一天，我会用那古老的语言做梦，用它开双关玩笑，写一首情诗。
First the alphabet. Just saying the letters is sometimes difficult, especially the phonemes that don’t exist in my own language. Then vocabulary, memorization. I look at a cup and call it by its ancient name. A horse, the roof of a house. There is a long path through conjugations, weird tenses and cases. Little by little it sticks—perhaps one day I will dream in the old tongue, pun in it, write a love poem.

Interplanetary Garbage Dump.name:
星际垃圾场
Interplanetary Garbage Dump

Text.text:
惨白的灰色天幕上，一道道传送门如同呕吐般向星际垃圾场倾泻成股的废弃物，堆叠在早已盘踞其间、恶臭扑鼻的垃圾山上。多肢的拾荒者展开血肉般的翅翼在上空盘旋，借着这令人作呕的堆积物散出的剧毒蒸汽滑翔而行。
Portals in the pallid gray sky vomit streams of garbage on the interplanetary dump, adding to the reeking mountains of refuse already established there. Multi-limbed scavengers soar above on fleshy wings, riding the toxic vapors emanating from this repugnant heap.

Corruption Of A Pegasus Into A Nightmare.name:
飞马堕落为梦魇马
Corruption Of A Pegasus Into A Nightmare

Text.text:
比刀刃锯割天马双翼的刺耳摩擦更令人难以忍受的，唯有这曾经高贵的生物撕心裂肺的惨叫。鲜血四溅、淌落，天马在俘虏者手中疯狂扭动，拼命挣扎，妄图逃离折磨。血迹染污了它本应无瑕的银白肋侧；当猩红愈发浓重、愈发晦暗时，那痛苦的嘶鸣也随之戛然而止。随着污渍如同火焰在油面上蔓延，它的皮肤开始变形，留下焦黑、炭化的痕迹。失去羽翼的天马从参差的创口处生出火焰般的触须，舔舐着破碎的伤口。它的双眼燃烧着愤怒与痛楚：一场由光辉完美孕育的噩梦，如今已被腐化，俯首听命于黑暗的意志。

~ Envisioned by J.W. Fritz

The only sound more unbearable than the grating of the blade sawing against the pegasus’s wings is the anguished screaming of the once-majestic creature. Blood splatters and drips as the pegasus writhes against its captors, attempting to escape its torment. The blood stains the pristine, silvery white of the creature’s flanks, and as the crimson deepens and darkens, the creature’s agonized braying ceases. Its hide shifts as the stains spread like flames across oil, leaving the skin blackened and charred. Without its feathered wings, the pegasus sprouts tendrils of flame that lick out from its ragged wounds. Its eyes burn with rage and pain: a nightmare, born of radiant perfection, now corrupted and serving the whims of darkness.

~ Envisioned by J.W. Fritz

如同一则守口如瓶的秘密，这处海湾的存在只为少数特权之人所知。宁静的海水轻轻拍打着洁净的白沙滩，空气清新澄澈。峭壁将海湾从视线中严密遮蔽，唯有栖息在葱郁嶙峋岩壁高处的海鸟作伴。
Like a well-kept secret, this cove’s existence is known only to a privileged few. Tranquil waters lap gently against a pristine beach of white sand, and the air is fresh and clear. Cliffs shelter the cove from view and the only company present are the seabirds nesting high among the verdant crags.

Perception-enhancing Gas, \"Hyper\".name:
增强察觉的气体，“亢奋”
Perception-enhancing Gas, "Hyper"

Text.text:
伪装成哮喘吸入器的模样，这抹以太般的飘飘然诱惑着不设防的人。一次吸入，感官的闸门豁然洞开，直觉性的察觉汹涌暴涨。然而，随之而来的断崖式坠落会把你淹进阴郁的污沟里，在邋遢而迟钝的痴呆中沉沦。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

Encased in the guise of an asthma pump, this etheric high tempts the unwary. Inhalation opens the gates to sensory excess, an upsurge of intuitive perception. Yet, the plummeting low drowns you in the sullen gutter of slovenly stupefaction.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

一名虫状人形生物拖着步子闯入视野，尘黄的身躯与背景几乎融为一体，半隐半现。无数柔韧的触须不断重塑着它的形态，轻轻拂扫四周。一个硕大的独眼从侧向的沙漏形眼眶里死死盯着你。生物面部中央伸出一条巨大的鼻干般长管，末端是一张布满利齿的巨口，贴着地面嗅探前行。而在那层皮肤之下……有什么东西在跳动。
A wormlike humanoid shuffles into view, dusty yellow and half camouflaged against the backdrop. Countless flexible tentacles reshape the being, softly brushing at its surroundings. A single oversized eye stares out from a sideways hourglass socket. A humongous trunk extends from the center of the creature’s face, ending in a toothy maw that snuffles along the ground. And beneath the skin… something pulses.

Explosion Destroys Vehicle.name:
爆炸摧毁载具
Explosion Destroys Vehicle

Text.text:
一切仿佛都被拉进了慢动作：爆炸自车底轰然炸裂。滚烫与冲击化作汹涌的热浪，席卷并抛飞任何、任何不幸靠得太近的人与物。待火光与浓烟的迷雾渐渐散去，车子所剩的只有一具焦黑碳化的空壳。
Everything seems to move in slow motion as an explosion erupts from beneath the vehicle. A tidal wave of heat and force flings away anything and anybody unfortunate enough to be nearby. When the haze of fire and smoke dwindles, all that remains of the car is a charred, blackened shell.

Temple To A Goddess Of Fertility.name:
丰饶女神神殿
Temple To A Goddess Of Fertility

Text.text:
神庙外墙以坚实的木材构筑；有些地方，木纹间竟抽生出带叶的枝条。墙内，神职者照料着果园与菜圃，在女神的祝福下丰饶得令人目眩。几位女祭司匆匆奔赴别的职责——周边村落呼唤她们担任接生婆。

庭院中央的基座留给一尊生育女神的肖像。枝条与藤蔓交织，长成一名丰腴女子的形状，她臂弯里抱着一捆麦穗；额前点缀着一顶新鲜花冠。
The temple’s outer walls are of sturdy wood construction; in some places, the wood has begun sprouting leafy branches. Within the walls, the clergy tend to fruit orchards and vegetable gardens, bounteous with the goddess’s blessing. Some priestesses hasten to other duties, called upon as midwives in the surrounding villages. A central pedestal in the courtyard is reserved for a likeness of the goddess of fertility. Branches and vines grow in the shape of a full-figured woman holding a sheaf of wheat in the crook of her arm. A crown of fresh flowers adorns her brow.

灿烂的绿松石色羽毛——仿若热带海水的色泽——环绕着一张精明的鸟类面孔：探询般的红眼，黑色钩喙。修长而优雅的眉羽微微抽动，随着生物神情变换而颤，随即他们轻轻偏头打量你。光泽流转的紫色长袍为其高挑的鸟形身躯提供掩蔽，他们以乌黑的利爪托住一只沉甸甸皮革挎包的背带。
Brilliant turquoise plumage—recalling the hues of tropical waters—surrounds a shrewd avian countenance with probing red eyes and a hooked black beak. Long, elegant brow feathers twitch as the creature’s expression shifts, and they cock their head slightly to regard you. Lustrous purple robes cover their tall, avian body and they cradle the strap of a weighty leather satchel in ebon talons.

I Cast Mass Healing Word.name:
我施放「群体治疗真言」
I Cast Mass Healing Word

Text.text:
我的嗓音化作雷霆。每当我吐出一个字，赤白相间、滋滋作响的符号笔划便在空中浮现。它们飞向我的每一个目标，猛然钻入他们的胸膛，灌注进炽亮而复苏的能量。
My voice becomes like thunder. Symbols, sizzling strokes of red and white, appear in the air with each word I speak. They fly to each of my targets, rushing into their chests and filling them with vibrant restorative energy.

这条鞭子并非为赶牛或其他寻常用途而制，而是专为战斗打造：熟制皮革鞭身缠绕着钢丝，使对手手持刃类武器也难以将其轻易割断。鞭梢末端的流苏般鞭穗便于缠住腿脚与手臂。落在技艺娴熟者手中，它能在裸露的肌肤上撕开深可见骨的裂口，伤势之狠厉足以与匕首或长剑相匹敌。
Built for combat rather than driving cattle or other mundane uses, this whip of cured leather has been wound with steel wire to prevent easy cutting by an opponent with a bladed weapon. A fringed tip at the end of its length aids in the ensnarement of legs and arms. In the hands of a skilled user, deep cuts can be inflicted on exposed flesh to rival those of a knife or sword.

I Avoid A Crushing Trap.name:
我避开一处碾压陷阱
I Avoid A Crushing Trap

Text.text:
沙雨噼啪落在我的头与肩上，我听见头顶的天花板开始挪动，石头在不稳地摩擦研磨。恐惧撑胀了我的胸腔，大脑尖叫着要我快跑，我奋力一跃猛冲而出——恰到好处。一块巨大的石块轰然坠下，撞地时爆出震骨的隆隆巨响。
A rain of sand patters against my head and shoulders, and I hear the ceiling begin to shift above me, the stone grinding precariously. My chest balloons with fear as my brain screams to run, and I launch myself forth with a mighty leap—just in time. A great stone block falls and creates a bone-shaking rumble as it meets the ground in a crash.

两座狰狞山峰之间那道裂隙的陡坡令人望而生畏，几乎只有最意志坚决的攀登者才可能通过。若没有足够的耐心、经验与装备就贸然横穿，无异于自寻死路——一次失手便是漫长的坠落，必将落得重伤。
The forbidding slope of the gap between the menacing mountain peaks makes it almost impassable by any but the most determined climber. One would be foolish to attempt its traversal without sufficient patience, experience, and equipment—a botched crossing would mean a long fall, and certainly result in grievous injury.

Plate Armor Of Etherealness.name:
虚无化板甲
Plate Armor Of Etherealness

Text.text:
像这样一整套全身板甲，光凭其为穿戴者提供的周全防护就已价值不菲；而这套护甲的肩甲、胸甲与胫甲上还蚀刻着数道纹饰。那些纹路宛如疾风掠过的风痕，而沿着蚀刻的线条，又细细镌入了一串串微小字母——仿佛出自异界的语言，刻得谨慎而精密。
A full suit of plate armor such as this one would be valuable enough on its own thanks to the extensive protection it grants the wearer, but this armor has several designs etched into its pauldrons, breastplate, and greaves. They resemble gusts of wind, and along the lines of the etchings, tiny letters of some otherworldly tongue have been carefully inscribed.

Mavadius, The Frozen Shadow.name:
玛瓦迪乌斯，冰封之影
Mavadius, The Frozen Shadow

Text.text:
一股异界的寒意自那纤瘦的提夫林身上渗出：苍白的皮肤、向后梳起的冰蓝长发，刻意露出带着霜色的犄角，更添凛冽。她额前佩着一枚魔裔护符，护符上刻着一柄弯曲的细剑，像被钉在晶莹寒冰之中。她的双眼是无底的青蓝深潭，目光既刺骨又令人着迷。她身上的衣物少到恰好够用，只以缀羽的衣饰遮住肩、胸与胯。提夫林抬起一根华美法杖，力量从她体内剥落成一阵阵冰寒的浪潮，仿佛冰川上蒸腾的雾霭。

~ Played by Alex with

An otherworldly chill emanates from the slender tiefling, accentuated by pallid skin and icy-blue hair swept back to expose frost-tinged horns.
