Upon her forehead she wears a fiendish amulet depicting a curved rapier stuck within crystalline ice. Her eyes are bottomless pools of cyan, her gaze one that chills as well as intrigues. She wears little beyond what she must, shrouding her shoulders, chest, and hips with feather-adorned garments. The tiefling hefts an ornate staff as power sloughs from her in frigid waves, like mist off a glacier.

~ Played by Alex with

Temple To An Orc God.name:
兽人之神的神殿
Temple To An Orc God

Text.text:
尽管不见任何侍从，黑铁火盆里的烈焰依旧烧得通红，刺鼻的烟雾贴着天花板聚集不散。长剑、战斧与长矛装点着墙面，铁刃上仍留着陈年血迹的斑驳。被漂白的头骨——有人形的，也有非人形的——悬挂在墙上，空洞的嘴巴大张着，仿佛无声的尖叫。一把弯刃匕首与一只巨大的圣杯摆在骨制祭坛之上，而它们上方，一张鞣制过的兽皮上悬着一幅褪色壁画，描绘两支庞大的兽人军势在狂怒风暴之下正面撞击、厮杀成团。
Although you see no attendant, the fires blaze red-hot in black iron braziers, and acrid smoke collects against the ceiling. Swords, axes, and spears adorn the walls, the iron still marred with old blood. Bleached skulls—humanoid and otherwise—hang from the walls, their mouths agape in silent screams. A curved dagger and a large chalice sit atop an altar of bone, and above them hangs a faded mural on a cured hide, depicting a battle between two massive orc forces clashing beneath a furious storm.

I Detect Thoughts With My Medallion Of T.name:
我用心灵感应徽章施展「侦测思想」
I Detect Thoughts With My Medallion Of Thoughts

Text.text:
黎明将护符注满可用次数，我此刻便耗去其中一次，对它起念，也自它引念，直入我目标的心智之中。是一顿饭，一份好奇，一个人以提问来分散注意。以我侵入性的思绪伸出一缕触须，钩住护符，我攫住一丝关于爱的念头。我的目标怀着一种渴望，深得远超今日所能给予，我几乎能听见他们的心灵将其低声呢喃给我。
The dawn fills the medallion with its charges and I expend one now, thinking to it and from it, into my target’s mind. A meal, a curiosity, someone distracting by asking something. With one tendril of my own invasive thoughts latched to the medallion, I grasp onto a thought of love. My target has a desire that runs deeper than what today can provide, and I can almost hear their mind whisper it to me.

I Throw My Golden Lions Figurine Of Wond.name:
我掷出我的【奇物之力】金狮雕像，召唤出一头雄狮
I Throw My Golden Lions Figurine Of Wondrous Power To Summon One Lion

Text.text:
一条虚无缥缈的长长金草小径笼罩着并自那尊置于地面的雕像向外延展。草叶随着我召唤出的生物移动而极其轻微地起伏，一张宽阔的狮面从镀金般闪烁的草刃间顶出。母狮用紫色的舌头舔了舔嘴角，燃烧般的黄铜眼眸自上而下掠过我的全身。
An ethereal trail of long, golden grass enshrouds and extends from the figurine placed on the ground. The grass—ever so subtly—shifts as my summoned creature moves and a broad leonine face pushes through the gilded, shimmering blades. The lioness licks her chops with her purple tongue, and her burning brass eyes flit over my body from head to toe.

Loot From A Kidnapper.name:
绑匪的赃物
Loot From A Kidnapper

Text.text:
你发现一个皮革小袋，里面装着宝石、银制钱币、戒指、耳环，以及一枚家族印戒。
You find a leather pouch of gems, silver coins, rings, earrings, and a family signet ring.

尖塔自稀疏林木点缀的平原上拔地而起，有的直刮云霄。它们在日光下熠熠生辉，映出宝石般的色彩，将周遭草海浸染成粼粼流光。自城心处，一座喷泉喷涌着舞动的水，倾泻入一条宏伟运河。其中一扇城门放行这条魔法之河，让它蜿蜒流向乡野。人群、牲畜与车驾穿行于高架街道之上，也沿着——甚至就在——河面前进。亦有身影与奇巧器械在塔群之间凌空飞掠。整座都会里，彩色光点穿梭跳跃，驱散阴影，令一片繁盛绿意长青不衰。

~ 构想：Samuel

Spires, some scraping the clouds, rise from the lightly wooded plains. They sparkle in the sunlight, reflecting gemlike hues and basking the surrounding grasslands in shimmering colors. From the city’s center, a fountain of dancing water spills into a grand canal. One of the gates permits this magical river to meander into the countryside. People, animals, and vehicles move through elevated streets and along—or even on—the river. Some figures and contraptions also fly amid the towers. Throughout the metropolis, colored lights flit, keeping shadows at bay and a spectacular array of greenery alive.

~ Envisioned by Samuel

City Raid By Red Dragon: Peaceful Mornin.name:
红龙突袭城市：城中宁静的清晨
City Raid By Red Dragon: Peaceful Morning In The City

Text.text:
最轻微的细雨在阳光里飘落，薄薄一层湿意刚好洗净空气，让鹅卵石路与屋顶泛起晶亮的光泽。也许你朝对的方向望去，就能瞥见一弯彩虹。这般好天气让人们心头松弛，聚在一处时，欢快的闲谈声便咕嘟咕嘟地冒了出来。
The faintest of drizzles drifts down through the sunlight, just enough to moisture to clean the air and set cobbles and rooftops to glistening. Perhaps you’ll see a rainbow if you look in the right direction. The fine weather has set people at ease, and where they gather a happy chatter bubbles up.

I Cast Rope Trick.name:
我施放了「绳索戏法」
I Cast Rope Trick

Text.text:
我一松手，绳索便像蛇缠树般旋上空中。纤维筋骨一绷，啪地一声抽直，悬在半空纹丝不动。我抓住它，确信结实可靠，便开始向上攀爬。上方，在绳端尽头，我看见一道方形轮廓，足够我爬进去，幽幽闪着微光——那是一扇虚幻的舱口，将通往我凭空召出的藏身小窝。
I release the rope and it twirls up into the air like a snake winding about a tree. It straightens with a sinewy snap of its fibers, hanging stock still in the air. I grab on to it, sure of its sturdiness, and begin my climb. Above, at the end of the rope, I can see a square outline large enough to crawl through, dimly sparkling—an ethereal hatch that will lead to my conjured cubby.

Arrival To The Divine Realm.name:
抵达神域
Arrival To The Divine Realm

Text.text:
他们说这里会有歌声与天光，白袍与漂浮。云絮般的乏味。可你穿着自己最舒服的衣服，住进你最好的回忆，也住进那些你来不及创造的回忆。你曾想尝试的一切、想修补的一切、那些第二次机会——尽数赐予。这里不是不劳而获的财富，也不是不配得的欢愉。
They said it would be song and sky light, white robes and floating. A cloudy boredom. But you are in your comfortable clothes, inhabiting the best memories you have and the ones you didn’t get to make. All you ever wanted to try, to fix, the second chances—all granted. This place isn’t wealth without work, or unearned joy.

Inspiration About Monumental Events.name:
关于重大事件的灵感
Inspiration About Monumental Events

Text.text:
“世界正从我们脚下坠落. 我们被卷入历史的离岸急流, 它威胁要将我们拖向湮灭. 但我现在告诉你们, 只要让内心引路, 我们就能穿越这一切.”
“The world is falling away beneath our feet. We are caught in the riptide of history and it threatens to pull us into oblivion. But I tell you now, if we are led by our hearts, we will make it through.”

Hold Person Evaded By Player.name:
玩家闪避了【定身术】
Hold Person Evaded By Player

Text.text:
你的四肢一阵刺痛，随即在刹那间麻木。那种感觉——那种念头——如潜行的瘫痪般爬进你的意识。你本能地否认它，猛然退缩。刺痛与麻木迅速褪去，你仍牢牢掌控着自己的身体与它的动作。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Your limbs tingle and grow numb for a fleeting moment. The feeling, the idea, of creeping paralysis enters your mind. You instinctively reject the notion and recoil. The tingling and numbness fades, and you remain in command of your body and its actions.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Aboleth: Mucous Cloud.name:
夺心魔鱼：黏液云
Aboleth: Mucous Cloud

Text.text:
这里的水浑浊不清，浓稠得像黏胶。

[豁免失败] 黏滑的水让你的皮肤灼痛，浑身酸胀，心脏狂跳。你的肺像在燃烧。你拼命喘气，却怎么也吸不进空气。

[水下豁免失败] 黏滑的水让你的皮肤灼痛，浑身酸胀，心脏狂跳。你的肺像在燃烧。你深吸一口气，发现自己竟然能够呼吸。

[豁免成功] 在这黏腻的水里，你的皮肤火辣刺痛，你强压住那股突如其来的吸气冲动。

The water here is cloudy, and thick like goo.

[Failed Save] The slimy water makes your skin burn, your body ache, and your heart pound. Your lungs feel like they’re on fire. You gasp for air, but you can’t breathe.

[Failed Save Underwater] The slimy water makes your skin burn, your body ache, and your heart pound. Your lungs feel like they’re on fire. You take a deep breath and find you can breathe.

[Successful Save] Your skin burns in the oozy water, and you fight off the sudden urge to take a breath.

Divine Glade Of A Goddess Of Unicorns.name:
独角兽女神的神圣林间空地
Divine Glade Of A Goddess Of Unicorns

Text.text:
柳树与白桦的叶片在阳光与微风里闪烁轻颤——就在这里，独角兽的族群停下脚步，休息与觅食，相互依偎、入梦沉眠，在不加掩饰的真实自我之间安然相守。池水的阴影边缘，有几只低头啜饮；其中一只甩了甩头，雪白的鬃毛如浪飞舞，随后又轻轻点动鼻尖，像在应和无声的旋律。它们彼此梳理鬃毛、抖落尘埃，深深呼吸，浸在无忧的信任与漫不经心的宁静里。远处的丘陵起伏绵延，通向更严酷的所在；而这里，花香充盈空气，轻轻挠着鼻端，仿佛在低语：若我们生来便如此纯善，这里便是我们愿意永远栖居之地。
The leaves of willows and birches flicker in the sun and breeze, here where the unicorn herd comes to rest and feed, to commune and sleep, among the honest truth of themselves. At the shady edge of a pool, some of them drink. One shakes her head, white mane dancing, and then bobs her nose up and down. They groom and preen; they breathe deep, awash in carefree trust and careless calm. The hills roll away toward harder places, but here, the scent of flowers fills the air. It tickles the nose and suggests: this is where we would wish to live forever, if we had only been made so good.

Enchanter's Polo On Volcanic Field.name:
火山原野上的附魔马球
Enchanter's Polo On Volcanic Field

Text.text: [赛前] 熔岩如溪流淌，地壳龟裂作响，火焰喷口时而怒放，这片地形提出的不只是安不安全的问题，更像在拷问良知。斯特鲁提贡站在灼热的火山岩地上小心翼翼地左右换脚，但那舞步与其说是疼痛驱使，不如说是兴奋作祟。看台前方有一层脉动的微光，昭示着已施放护盾结界；可观众仍汗如雨下，传递着一桶桶冰镇饮品。骑手周身同样罩着起伏的光晕，还穿着防护服——看起来是以坚韧厚实的布料裁制而成。 [实战] 这片场地的难点，是别让球体起火。球员们在地面的裂缝间穿梭，而无常的火柱骤然喷射，威胁着将球体一并吞没。斯特鲁提贡对着窜出的火焰顽皮地咔哒咬合，竟一口吞下，再从参差獠牙的咧笑间喷出滚滚浓烟。骑手靠手势与队友交流，面具遮住了他们的声音与神情。裁判把自己的斯特鲁提贡换成了一条纤细迅捷的飞龙，从空中俯瞰全局、紧盯比赛进程。 [Before the Game] With its flowing magma streams, cracking earth, and spouts of flame, this terrain raises not only the question of safety but also morality. The Struttigons hop gingerly from one foot to the other on the searing, volcanic ground, but the dance seems born more of eagerness than of pain. A pulsing shimmer indicates a shielding barrier has been cast in front of the stands, though fans still shine with profuse sweat as they pass around buckets of iced beverages. The riders are veiled in a similar pulsing aura, as well as protective suits crafted of what looks to be sturdy fabric. [In Play] The challenge of this field is not letting the orb catch fire. Players weave through the cracks in the earth as the erratic spouts of fire shoot and threaten to engulf the orb. The Struttigons snap their jaws playfully at the flames as they shoot out, swallowing them then belching smoke through jagged-toothed grins. The riders communicate with teammates via gestures, their voices and expressions hidden by their masks. The referee has swapped out her Struttigon for a slender, speedy wyvern, keeping track of play from the air.

你的声音如雷霆般轰鸣，@说话出蕴含力量的言辞。它们与现实的织锦相互作用，牵扯着造物的丝线。你周遭的物体与生物——缠斗中的战士、空气里闪烁的绚丽奥能、半空中疾驰的投射物——先是迟缓，继而彻底停滞。时代静止不动。
Your voice booms, speaking the words of power. They interact with the fabric of reality, tugging at the strings of creation. The objects and creatures around you—combatants locked in melee, dazzling arcane energy flickering on the air, projectiles in mid-flight—slow, then come to a complete stop. Time stands still.

Loot From A Skeleton Warrior.name:
来自骷髅（特征）战士的战利品
Loot From A Skeleton Warrior

Text.text: 你用力猛拽几下，终于把巨剑从骷髅（特征）的掌骨间硬生生扯了出来。手与臂骨在关节处猛然断开，发出一声咔嚓的脆响，随后零落坠地，叮当乱撞地撒了一地。 这把武器显然风光不再。剑柄缠着一层薄薄的、会剥落的黏膜状物质，散发着令人作呕的腐臭。漆黑的铁刃亟需磨刀石的接触，再覆上一层油。可即便如此，这把武器整体仍然平衡良好，刃身未折未裂。只要进行些专门的保养，它仍有望恢复昔日那令人胆寒的锋芒。 You wrench the greatsword from the skeleton’s grip with a few stout pulls. The bones of the hands and arms crunch as they snap away from their joints and then fall in a dissonant clatter onto the ground. The weapon has seen better days. The hilt is laced with a filmy, flaking substance with a rancid smell. The dark iron of the blade needs the touch of whetstone and a coating of oil. But, the weapon is overall well-balanced and unbroken. With some specialized care, it could be restored to its former fearsome glory.

Goddess Of Pain.name:
痛苦女神
Goddess Of Pain

Text.text:
她的脸上既无残忍，也无仇恨——正因如此，她才可怕得如此忠于自己的事业。那是一张苍白、肤色清透的脸，算得上漂亮，却被严肃而实用的发式框住。她穿的总是与施加的痛苦“品牌”相称：有时是严厉教师那种令人蒙羞的长袍，有时是取悦的皮革装束，有时则戴上拷问者的兜帽与手套。她很少提高嗓音。她有一条鞭子，但她做的大多数事更为隐秘。她用平稳的语调，更喜欢抛出简单却骇人的问题。
Her face carries neither cruelty nor hatred, and this is what makes her so terrifyingly true to her cause. It is a pale and clear-skinned face, pretty, but framed in serious, practical hair. She wears whatever is appropriate to the brand of pain applied: sometimes the stern teacher’s robes of humiliation, sometimes the leathers of pleasure, sometimes the torturer’s hood and gloves. She seldom raises her voice. She owns a whip, but most of what she does is more subtle. With an even tone, she prefer to ask simple, yet horrible, questions.

Faerie Carnival Big Top Tent.name:
妖精嘉年华大顶篷帐篷
Faerie Carnival Big Top Tent

Text.text:
帆布细得仿佛一阵风就能撕开，半透明的粉彩薄层像纸一样一片片叠起，呈楔形向那根华丽的主桅汇拢。自帐篷牵向尖桩的绳索细若蚕丝，闪着点点微光；入口处的尘土绊着脚踝，打着旋儿跳舞。帐内，五彩戏服如花束般四处铺陈，点缀在飞人横杆、台座、大炮与火盆旁。狮子先是一声咆哮，随即又发出像笑一样的低吼。团长沿着看台走动，用障眼法与古怪的小咒把观众的情绪攥在掌心里。
The canvas seems too fine to hold up through a wind, with papery layers of translucent pastels in wedges that converge at the ornate mast. The lines running from tent to spike are silk fine and glittery, and the dust at the entrance trips and dances around ankles. Inside, the spray of colorful costumes decorates the trapezes, pedestals, cannon, and fire pit. A lion roars and then laughs. The ringmaster walks the bleachers and works the crowd with sleight of hand and weird cantrips.

Skyship Swivel Guns.name:
飞空艇旋转炮
Skyship Swivel Guns

Text.text:
架在简陋的铁制炮架上，火炮懒洋洋地卧在炮座上，像沉睡的卫兵。一块带蜡的抹布搭在其中一根炮管上，每门炮都被以水手般的纪律擦洗得一尘不染，随时能在转瞬间甩向战位。
Mounted on simple iron stands, the guns sit lazily on their posts, like sleeping guards. A waxy rag is draped over one of the barrels, and each cannon has been cleaned thoroughly with a sailor’s discipline, ready to swing into action at moment’s notice.

Mad Scientist's Lab: Haunted.name:
疯狂科学家的实验室：闹鬼
Mad Scientist's Lab: Haunted

Text.text:
邪恶的笑声从虚空中回荡而出。你听见的阵阵狂笑夹杂着不同的嗓音，从四面八方同时涌来。这也许是幻象——一道用来吓退你的法术——可它听起来并不像魔法。你感到一股饥渴的恶意在徘徊，仿佛那些幽魂最渴望的，便是让你留下。
Evil laughter echoes out of thin air. The different voices you hear cackling come from every direction. It might be an illusion—a spell set to frighten you away—but this doesn’t feel like magic. You sense a hungry malignancy, as if the spirits would like nothing more than for you to stay.

Loot In A White Dragon Wyrmling Lair.name:
白龙雏龙巢穴中的战利品
Loot In A White Dragon Wyrmling Lair

Text.text:
在幼龙冰封的巢穴里，你发现了一小堆朴素的珍藏。海贝、海象獠牙，以及其他勾起巨龙兴趣的物件散落在这座狭小的冰川洞窟地面上。几枚零散的钱币与宝石——全是银色或半透明——藏在那一堆堆杂物之间，总值 8 金币。
In the wyrmling’s frozen den, you find a modest collection of treasures. Seashells, walrus tusks, and other items that piqued the dragon’s interest litter the floor of the small, glacial cavern. A few scattered coins and gems—all silver or translucent—hide among the piles, valued at 8 gold pieces.

Guildhall Treasury.name:
公会会馆金库
Guildhall Treasury

Text.text:
这间狭小的房间没有点灯，弥漫着一股久无人至的霉腐气息。四只保险柜被紧紧塞在墙边，彼此挤作一团，每一只都扣着一把挂锁。一座支架上摆着三卷巨大的卷轴——也许是地图？最后，一只被铁链层层捆缚的箱子占据了这片狭小空间的相当一部分。
The unlit, compact room has the musty smell of a place rarely visited. Four coffers are shoved tightly against the walls and each other, each fitted with a padlock. A stand holds three large scrolls—maps, perhaps? Finally, a chest, bound tightly in chains, takes up a substantial amount of this small space.

旅人行囊的叮当碰撞声宣告了他们的到来。攀登斧、翼状滑翔器、成捆的麻绳、卷起的铺盖，以及无数难以辨识的工具与补给品，都从包上垂挂可见。他们紧握一根行走杖，脚蹬磨旧却结实的钉刺攀登靴，每迈一步，金属便与地形相击，回声清脆。
The clatter of the traveler’s pack announces their presence. Climbing axes, pinions, bundles of hempen rope, a bedroll, and a multitude of other indiscernible tools and supplies can be seen hanging from the bag. They grip a walking stick and wear well-worn but sturdy boots outfitted with climbing spikes, metal sounding against the terrain with every step.

Fate Cleansing Ceremony.name:
命运净化仪式
Fate Cleansing Ceremony

Text.text:
纸牌被洗匀、抽出、翻开。骰子滚落。骨片被抛掷，叮当作响，散落满地，像一支喧闹的舞。熏香盘旋，缕缕向高耸的穹顶升去，把数百支蜡烛与闷燃火盆投下的昏暗摇曳之光揉碎、稀释。人们占星，也解读符文；还翻检几只活物的内脏——盲眼先知双手染血，托着弯刃，将那些往往阴沉的征兆娓娓传出。结论：一团浑浊的交织——运气与宿命，分岔的命途与蜿蜒的路径。向来如此。

~ 构想：Melchior

Cards are shuffled, drawn, and flipped. Dice are rolled. Bones are cast, strewn across the floor in a clattering dance. Incense coils, spiraling up toward the high ceiling, diffusing the dim, flickering light of hundreds of candles and stifling braziers. The stars are consulted, as are the runes; the guts of several live creatures are sifted through—the often grim portents relayed by blind seers with bloodied hands cradling curved blades. The result: a muddled mingling of fortune and fate, of branching destinies and snaking paths. As it always is.

~ Envisioned by Melchior

Bronze Dragon Wyrmling.name:
青铜幼龙
Bronze Dragon Wyrmling

Text.text:
这条龙裔生物的尾巴懒洋洋地来回甩动，一边打量着你——好奇却谨慎——阳光正好掠过它青金交织的青铜鳞片，折射出夺目的光辉。它体型约莫与一只大型犬相仿，行动时带着一种诡异而摄人的优雅，始终与人保持距离，用敏锐而克制的目光审慎地盯视着你。
The tail of this draconic creature whips lazily back and forth as it watches you—inquisitive but careful—and the sun catches the gold-green of its bronze scales brilliantly. Roughly the size of a large dog, the beast moves with a strange and alluring grace, keeping its distance as it eyes you with a keen and measured gaze.

I Cast A Beam Of Brilliant Light With My.name:
我用光辉宝石射出一道璀璨的光束
I Cast A Beam Of Brilliant Light With My Gem Of Brightness

Text.text:
伴随着刺目的辉光，一道耀眼的光束自宝石中迸射而出，直指我的敌手。尖锐的微光在空气中荡开，宛如寺庙钟磬的清响层层回响，而宝石也随之震颤，嗡鸣着魔力的共振。
With blinding radiance, a beam of brilliant light shoots out from the gem and toward my foe. A keening shimmer ripples through the air like the chimes of a temple, and the gem vibrates with magical resonance.

你回想起的旋律刺耳失谐、格格不入——那是来自另一个世界、另一个时代的曲调，因惧怕它对凡人心智的掌控之力而被深埋久藏。你挥手示意你的目标，那段副歌便钻入他们的脑海，如匕首穿肉般刺穿思绪。生物浑身一僵，旋律攫住他们的心智，唤起令人发狂的念头与骇人的旧忆。痛楚沿着你的目标全身奔涌，令他们弓身蜷缩，踉跄跌退、步履不稳，徒然想逃离那背叛自己的心。
The melody you bring to mind is dissonant, discordant—a tune from another world, another time, long-buried for fear of its power over the minds of mortals. You indicate your target with a wave of your hand, and the refrain enters their mind, piercing their thoughts like a dagger through flesh. The creature stiffens as the melody seizes their mind, conjuring maddening thoughts and horrifying recollections. Pain courses through your target’s body, doubling them over as they stumble, stagger, and attempt to flee from their own traitorous mind.

Grove Of Monkey Puzzle Trees.name:
猴谜树之林
Grove Of Monkey Puzzle Trees

Text.text:
常青树并肩而生，几株高耸入云，彼此环绕交错。年长而更高的树干粗糙，呈灰白褐色，树皮宛如不规则却严丝合缝的甲片。无数细长枝条自树干向下弯垂，继而又回挑向天。有些枝杈末端挂着细长、绒毛般的褐色球果。幼树更显青翠，锋利的三角形叶片以放射状铺覆其树干与枝臂；而这些叶子只生在成熟树木的枝条上。
Evergreen trees, a few towering, grow alongside and around one another. The trunks of older, taller trees are rough and whitish brown, the bark resembling irregular, fitted plates. Many slender branches curve downward from these trunks, then skyward again. Some of the limbs bear long, fuzzy, brown cones on the end. The younger trees are greener, with sharp, triangular leaves covering their trunks and limbs in a radial pattern. Only the branches of the mature trees bear these leaves.

Opportunistic Man Surveys Ballroom Guest.name:
投机之人扫视舞厅宾客
Opportunistic Man Surveys Ballroom Guests

Text.text:
老人用手梳过粗硬的银发，嘴角扬起一抹掠食者般心满意足的笑。他那双细小的灰眼在舞厅里扫视，冷酷而高效地立刻标记出每一个能被他利用的人。归根结底，重要的只有谁能站到最高处——不管为了爬上去，他们必须踩碎多少人。

~ 构想：Max_Slacker 于 Discord

The old man runs a hand through rugged, silver hair and smiles with predatory satisfaction. His small gray eyes scan the ballroom, instantly marking anyone of use to him with ruthless efficiency. At the end of the day, all that matters is who comes out on top—no matter who they must step on to climb there.

~ Envisioned by Max_Slacker on Discord

Archer Post In A Castle.name:
城堡中的弓手岗哨
Archer Post In A Castle

Text.text:
这间圆形石室是支撑城堡巨墙的柱体结构之一。你身后墙上悬着几张打磨得锃亮的长弓。加固的外墙上开着三道竖直射孔，视野开阔，掩蔽极佳。每个射孔右侧都摆着一只木桶，桶里塞满了箭矢，箭羽一律是醒目的红色。
The round stone room forms part of the pillars that support the colossal walls of the castle. Several polished bows hang from the wall behind you. In the fortified, exterior wall are three vertical apertures providing wide fields of view and enviable cover. To the right of each embrasure sits a bucket packed with arrows with matching red fletching.

Mortis Optigram.name:
莫提斯·奥普提格拉姆
Mortis Optigram

Text.text:
相机来自另一个时代，一件怀旧的历史遗物，凝结着胶片工艺与艺术家的目光。死灵法师把相机对准尸体的脸，托住下颌，微微转过头——仿佛在寻找更上镜的一侧。他们塞入一片对魔力敏感的底板，检查镜头的取景，然后压下那根会弹回的扳杆。咔哒一声，迸出钴蓝色的闪光，吐出一张方形胶片；可它显现的并不是尸体的面容，而是此人临终前所见的一幕。

~ 一位英雄所构想

The camera is of another time, a nostalgic piece of history, of film work and the artist’s eye. The necromancer aims the camera at the corpse’s face, takes the jaw and turns the head a bit—as if to get the good side. They slip in a mana-sensitive plate, check the aim of the lens and push the lever, which springs back. The click produces a cobalt flash and release of a square of film, but it does not show the image of the corpse’s face. It is what the person last saw.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Black Magga: The Flood.name:
黑玛加：洪潮
Black Magga: The Flood

Text.text:
暴雨倾盆，浸透了大地——凡是被脚步反复踩踏之处，都被搅成一片稀烂的泥浆与污淖——附近水位暴涨，洪水倒灌进镇子。能逃的人想必都已逃离，可你仍能听见绝望的呼喊，祈求从仍在不断上涨的水势中得到救援。
Torrential rain has drenched the land—creating a sloppy mess of mud and muck wherever feet have churned it—and raised the nearby waters to flood the town. Those who could do so must have fled, but you can hear desperate voices crying out for relief from the still-rising tide.

Hacker Executes Attack Program In The Ne.name:
黑客在网域中执行攻击程序：中世纪主题
Hacker Executes Attack Program In The Net: Medieval Theme

Text.text:
黑客执行攻击程序时，一柄鲜艳的红色长剑在他们掌中凝成；他们将武器高高举起，宛如凯旋的亚瑟王骑士。绯红的剑刃在挥动间闪烁不定，在赛博空间里拖出令人目眩的光痕，像灼伤视网膜般久久不散。
A vibrant red sword forms in the hacker’s grasp as they execute the attack program, holding the weapon aloft like a triumphant Arthurian knight. The crimson blade flickers as it moves, leaving a mesmerizing trail in cyberspace like a retinal burn.

从虚空墨黑的无边空寂里，一道纤细的身影咆哮着冲入视野。宇宙飞船？不——它的速度快得不像。它猛然向左倾斜，划出一道不可思议的发夹弯弧线，彻底闯入你的视线——没错，它确实是一艘飞船。极其古老的型号……然而它的动作却快得像原型战机。它被太阳漂白得褪尽色彩，灰与骨白交织。它逼近之际，一阵幽灵般的笑声在你的通讯系统里回荡。 From out of the inky nothingness of the void, a slim shape roars into view. A spaceship? No, it is moving too fast for that. It banks hard left and arcs an impossible hairpin turn to come fully into vision and—yes, it is in fact a spaceship. A very old model… and yet it moves with the speed of a prototype fighter. It has been bleached of color by the sun, gray and bone white. As it nears, a ghostly laughter echoes over your comms system.

恶臭瞬间将你淹没——腐烂的肉、变质的奶酪、陈旧的血、干涸的粪便与脏腑的腥膻。吃到一半的残餐堆成蛆虫翻涌的肉丘，苍蝇嗡鸣成团，早已辨不出原本的模样。巢穴更深处吹来一阵温热潮湿的风，裹挟着沉睡巨兽湿黏、喀啦作响的呻吟——以及那股甜腻得令人作呕的汗味与霉烂皮毛的臭气。你强压下转身逃跑与呕吐的冲动，只得逼自己尽快宰了这畜生——若无其他，至少也要摆脱这股恶臭。
The stench overpowers you—rotting meat, spoiled cheese, old blood, dried scat and viscera. Half-finished meals sit in maggot-ridden heaps, buzzing with flies, their original forms indiscernible. A warm, humid wind blows from deeper within the lair, and it carries with it the wet, rattling groans of a slumbering beast—along with the sickly-sweet stench of sweat and moldering furs. You fight the urge to run, to vomit, and instead resign yourself to slaying this beast quickly—to be rid of the stench, if nothing else.

Ozax Of Rhodes.name:
罗德岛的奥扎克斯
Ozax Of Rhodes

Text.text:
在橄榄树繁茂青翠的枝叶下轻轻打着鼾，这位老矮人安宁得不可思议。他那件斑驳的棕色长袍几乎磨得只剩线头，上面还沾着种类繁多、格外醒目的污渍。矮人的灰发与长须如银色瀑布般倾泻而下——狂放不羁，未经驯服——而他那饱经风霜的面庞却带着一种柔和，让人不由自主地想要信任。忽然间，他猛地挺身坐起，明亮的眼睛燃起炽白的创新之光，随即一跃而起站稳脚跟。他一边低声嘟囔，一边以惊人的速度在泥土上潦草写下笔记与算式，急切地要在这场启示被午后微风吹散之前将其捕捉。

~ Played by Serhan Handani

Snoring softly beneath the lush, green branches of an olive tree, the old dwarf looks incredibly peaceful. His patchy brown robes are almost threadbare and covered in an impressive variety of stains. The dwarf’s gray hair and beard flow like silver waterfalls—wild and untamed—and his wizened face holds a softness that invites trust. Suddenly, he sits upright, bright eyes ablaze with the incandescent glow of innovation, and leaps to his feet. Muttering to himself, he begins to scrawl notes and calculations in the dirt with alarming speed, eager to capture his revelation before it drifts away on the afternoon breeze.

~ Played by Serhan Handani

你看见你的目标在网络中滑行而过，他们的化身是其真实形体的一抹纤长暗影；显然，哪怕在赛博空间里，虚荣也不会消亡。你伸出自己化身的手，透明外壳下的代码脉络明灭跳动。几缕短促的火花迸射，你的指令便抵达目标，绕开他们的安全协议，如同跑酷者穿梭起跃，贴着障碍流畅掠过、翻越而上。他们的头猛地朝你这边一扭，双眼灼成警告的猩红，可对他们而言已经太迟。你从网络中断开接口，仿佛向后坠入自己的真实躯体——那种触感像在醒来前做着坠落之梦时的骤然惊颤一般刺骨。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

You see your mark glide through the network, their persona a svelte shade of their true form; apparently vanity doesn’t die even in cyberspace. You thrust out your own persona’s hand, the lines of code pulsing under your transparent shell. With a few short sparks, your command reaches the mark, bypassing their security protocols like a freerunner weaving seamlessly through and over obstacles. Their head jerks in your direction, eyes searing a warning crimson, but it’s too late for them. You jack out of the network, experiencing a feeling of landing backwards into your real body—a sensation as jarring as those dreams of falling right before waking up.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Short Travel Across The Ethereal Plane.name:
穿越以太位面的短途旅行
Short Travel Across The Ethereal Plane

Text.text:
你踏上旅程，却不知将会遇见什么。四周的一切既熟悉又诡异得陌生。你仿佛感觉不到任何事物的重量；当你掠过那些熟悉的景象时，它们却像隔着一层薄纱，永远卡在你能力所及的边缘。你纳闷为何这段距离的旅行比预想更漫长——然而转瞬之间，你的目的地已在眼前。
You embark on your journey unsure of what you might find. Everything around you seems familiar yet strangely alien. You feel as though nothing has any weight, and as you pass familiar sights, you find them just beyond your ability to fully perceive. You wonder why it seems to take longer than expected to travel the distance, but suddenly your destination is before you.

I Cast Fiendish Planar Ally.name:
我施放《邪魔异界盟友》
I Cast Fiendish Planar Ally

Text.text:
我感到胃口深处一阵灼烧般的刺痛，喉咙干得像粗糙的枯壳，刮得生疼。我嘶哑着吐出法术的最后几个字，大地上随即裂开一道熔红的线。地面的伤口像把自己交给火焰的木柴般阴燃，空气里硫磺的恶臭浓得化不开。一只长着利爪的手从裂口中探出，锯齿般的指甲，猩红的皮肤被热浪熏得冒烟。紧接着，魔鬼的脸也浮现出来，嘴角咧到尖尖的耳根。它从传送门里一跃而出，沿地面撒下一路火星，随后转头看向我。它那条又长又紫的舌头在尖牙间游走。它用通用语低吼道：“我们共同的雇主向你致意。”接着，它鞭子般的尾巴啪地一声抽在地上，龇牙咆哮：“金子。现在。”它伸出手来。
I feel a burning sensation in the pit of my stomach, and my throat dries into a scratching husk. My voice rasps out the final words of the spell and a molten red line appears in the earth. The tear in the ground smolders like a log giving itself over to flame, the stench of brimstone thick in the air. A long-clawed hand stretches out of the opening, with jagged nails and red skin smoking with the heat. The face of the fiend soon follows, grinning from ear to pointed ear. It hops out of the portal, scattering embers along the ground, and then looks to me. Its long, purple tongue dances over pointed teeth. “Our mutual employer sends their regards,” it growls in Common. Then, with a slap of its whip-like tail against the ground, it snarls, “Gold. Now.” It holds out its hand.

一道白色暗影掠过营地，停在火光边缘之外。面具——黑得像无星之夜般不祥——遮住了这生物的脸，它饥渴地在你周围游弋。阴影仿佛油腻的焦油般在它身旁流淌，贴合着它矫健而结实的四肢起伏，它逼近你——等待着。月光里有一道冷光掠入眼帘，你猛然意识到那野兽的前臂上刺出一把阴狠的刀刃——像剥皮刀一样——血液顿时因原始的恐惧而凝固。低沉的咆哮自它宽阔的胸腔滚出……肌肉绷紧，它正蓄势扑击。

~ Inbal 于 Discord

A white shadow streaks through the camp, stopping just outside the firelight. A mask—black and foreboding as a starless night—obscures the creature's face as it prowls around you hungrily. The shadows seem to flow around it like oily tar, matching the movements of its lithe, muscular limbs as it stalks you—waiting. A glimmer in the moonlight catches your eye, and your blood runs cold with primal terror as you realize the beast has a wicked blade—like a skinning knife—jutting from its forearm. A low growl emanates from its broad chest… the muscles tense as it prepares to pounce.

~ Inbal on Discord

这座地下小村的居民皮肤如灰烬般黯淡，眼睛又大又苍白；除此之外，村庄的日常却与地表千百个村落并无二致。孩子们奔跑嬉闹，追逐的不是鸡而是蜥蜴；农夫们推着车，运送的是蘑菇与晒干的海绵作物，而非玉米或肉食——但道理依旧不变：有人聚居之处，便会生长出一个共同体。
The people of this subterranean hamlet have ashen skin and wide, pallid eyes, but otherwise village life resembles that of villages the world over. Children run and play, chasing lizards rather than chickens; farmers cart crops of mushrooms and dried sponges, rather than corn or meat, but the principle remains the same: where people abound, a community forms.

Rogue Victory Quip.name:
游荡者的胜利俏皮话
Rogue Victory Quip

Text.text:
“我是暗影中的利刃，夜色里的潜行者，那——那——黑暗中捅人的家伙！”
“I am the blade in the shadow, the skulker in the night, the–the–stabby man in the dark!”

Bard Auditions.name:
吟游诗人试音会
Bard Auditions

Text.text:
城池在阳光下熠熠生辉，宛如一颗璀璨钻石；宫殿高耸的尖塔如画框般，将你眼前原野上那支色彩斑斓、奔涌不息的盛大行列映衬得格外夺目。甜润如蜜的旋律充盈空中，轻灵的身影来回跳跃穿梭，各色艺人正为在王宫选拔帐篷中一展身手的机会做最后准备。

~ 构想：jimijam

The city gleams in the sun like a resplendent diamond, the towering spires of the palace a picturesque frame for the colorful cavalcade rampant on the field before you. Honeyed melodies fill the air and lithe figures caper to-and-fro as performers of all kinds prepare themselves for their chance in the palatial audition tent.

~ Envisioned by jimijam

Adult Brass Dragon Encounter.name:
成年黄铜龙遭遇
Adult Brass Dragon Encounter

Text.text:
在无情的烈日之下，一位坚毅的沙漠秘境守护者悠然沐浴。巨龙闪烁的鳞片被时代与风磨砺得光洁如镜，映出不息的灼热；它的眼眸微光流转，带着漫不经心的温厚。空气里弥漫着温暖的接纳之辉。庞大的尾巴轻轻一抽，它抬起身来更好地端详你，张开的双翼抖落一阵沙雨，爬行般的面孔上扬起一道龙族的笑意。
Beneath an unforgiving sun, a stalwart defender of the desert's mystery basks. The dragon’s glinting scales, polished by time and wind, reflect the relentless heat, and its eyes gleam with casual kindness. A warm glow of acceptance fills the air. The massive tail twitches as it rises to better observe you, a rain of sand spilling from its opening wings, and a draconic grin upon its reptilian face.

Battle Smith Riding Their Steel Defender.name:
战斗铁匠骑乘钢铁守卫
Battle Smith Riding Their Steel Defender

Text.text:
蹄声喧嚣，蒸汽嘶鸣，一头披挂护甲的机械巨兽轰然踏入战场。它形似犀牛，钢铁护甲的板缝间涌动着熔炉般的炽光，凭着那狰狞的尖角犁开敌阵——而它背上端坐着一名如壁垒般的矮人，同样覆着钢甲。矮人单手擎起战锤，另一手转动巨盾，拨开飞来的弹雨；他在鞍上挥动武器如摆锤般来回荡起，将挡路的敌人一锤锤扫飞，为他的机械坐骑清出通道。“都到我身后！”矮人对他的伙伴怒吼道。

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

The clamor of hooves, the hiss of steam, and an armored, mechanical beast thunders onto the battlefield. Something akin to a rhinoceros, with the glowing heat of a forge between plates of steel armor, plows through enemies with its wicked horn—and mounted upon it is a bulwark of a dwarf, similarly plated with steel. The dwarf hefts a warhammer in one hand and pivots their massive shield, deflecting missiles as they swing their weapon from the saddle like a pendulum, swatting enemies aside to clear the way for their mechanical mount. “Get behind me!” the dwarf bellows to their companions.

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

鲜血玷污了半精灵衬衫那象牙色的布面，将本该雅致的织物染成刺眼的暗红。他们的面容本可称得上俊秀，若不是定格在那双眼圆睁的惊骇狞笑之中。
Blood stains the ivory canvas of the half-elf’s shirt, turning the elegant fabric an ugly shade of crimson. Their face would be handsome, were it not frozen in a rictus of wide-eyed terror.

Holding Room Full Of Prisoners.name:
挤满囚犯的候押室
Holding Room Full Of Prisoners

Text.text:
十来名囚犯挤满了拘留牢房，各自坐在摇摇欲坠的木长凳上，手铐与铁链将他们锁在墙边。汗臭味弥漫在空间里，囚犯们低声嘀咕着，勉强的寂静只偶尔被咳嗽或粗哼打破。

~ 由 Girlhead 构想

A dozen prisoners fill the holding cell, each sitting upon a rickety wooden bench and secured to the wall by manacles and chains. The stench of sweat permeates the space as the prisoners mutter amongst themselves, the relative quiet broken only by the occasional cough or grunt.

~ Envisioned by Girlhead

Demon Queen Of Fungi's Bridesmaid.name:
真菌魔后之伴娘
Demon Queen Of Fungi's Bridesmaid

Text.text:
这具存在由扭结盘绕的海绵质多彩真菌构成，点缀着绿黄相间的地衣褶边，以及苍白的绒团与蕾丝般的霉丝。它的躯体隐约呈现纤细的人形，仿佛披着一身腐朽的贵族华服。发光的蘑菇像饰品般从真菌织就的衣袍上萌生。两顶最大的莹光菌盖在那团腐生菌的膨胀囊体间勉强拼出一双“眼”，而本该是面孔的位置却只有一颗无面的头颅轮廓。缠腐的乱结中藏着的马勃不时喷出暗淡的孢子，把空气灌满霉味。
Made of twisting knots of spongy, multicolored fungus, frills of green and yellow lichen, and pale puffs and strands of lacy mold, this being’s body suggests a slight but human form garbed in decayed aristocratic finery. Glowing mushrooms bud like adornments from the fungal garments. The two largest luminous caps form would-be eyes amid the saprophyte bulb that could be an otherwise faceless head. Puffballs hidden amid the tangled rot eject wan spores, filling the air with the scent of mildew.

这副护目镜的外观极具压迫感，以深色碳纤维铸就外壳，内嵌目镜强化装置与鼻梁护罩，让佩戴者宛如一只乌鸦。八枚金色圆环构成目镜阵列，阴森而蛛形，仿佛一簇不祥的复眼。护目镜侧面细小的拨片开关可调节多种低光环境下的视野模式。它没有任何固定用的绑带——取而代之的是内侧嵌有重力黏附层，能将面罩直接吸附在脸上。
The imposing facade of these goggles is constructed of dark carbon fiber, housing ocular enhancers and a nose guard that give the wearer the look of a raven. Eight golden circles make up the ocular array, a sinister, spidery set of eyes. Little switches on the side of the goggles allow options for sight in various low-light conditions. There’s no strap for securing the goggles to the face—rather, the inside is fitted with a gravity adhesive to attach the mask directly.

Loot From A Nycaloth.name:
来自尼卡洛斯的战利品
Loot From A Nycaloth

Text.text:
在那具长翼恶魔的巨大尸体上，你找到一只沉甸甸的钱袋，里面的硬币价值110枚金币。你还从这只生物身上扯下一条项链：黑曜石铸成的一对天平，左右分毫不差，平衡得令人不寒而栗。
On the huge corpse of the winged fiend, you find a hefty pouch of coin worth 110 gold pieces. You also pull a necklace off the creature, which depicts a set of perfectly balanced scales cast in obsidian.

Black Robe Of The Archmagi.name:
大法师的黑色长袍
Black Robe Of The Archmagi

Text.text:
这块布料的染色黑得彻底，仿佛能吞噬落在其上的一切光线。虚无般的布幅妖异地披垂在施法者的身形之上：空灵、绝美，却令人不安。兜帽覆面，肩头嵌刺，这件斗篷会让穿戴者宛如异界来客的幽影——来自那晦暗的国度，遍布阴影与恶魔。
The dye of this fabric is so totally black, it seems to consume all light cast upon it. Swathes of void drape alluringly over a spellcaster’s form: ethereal, beautiful, unsettling. Hooded and spiked at the shoulders, the cloak would make the wearer seem a specter from another realm—a tenebrous realm of shadows and demons.

Haunted Castle: Approaching The Castle.name:
闹鬼城堡：逼近城堡
Haunted Castle: Approaching The Castle

Text.text:
这条路沿着陡峭而狭窄的坡面向上攀爬，贴着山脊蜿蜒而行，随着地势抬升，直抵山巅那座冠冕般的废墟。堡垒厚重的灰色墙垣在前方高高耸立，步道将你领出林间，来到风可以一把攫住你的空旷处。脚下与身后——整片林子里——乌鸦漆黑的身影仍在回荡着警戒的啼鸣，那声音自你第一次踏上这条小径起便未曾停歇。
The approach runs up a steep and narrow slope, climbing the winding crest of the hill as it rises to the ruin that crowns the hill’s head. The fortress’s heavy, gray walls loom over you as the trail leads you out of the forest to where the wind can snatch at you. Below and behind you—throughout the wood—the black bodies of ravens continue the warning calls that started when you first set foot on this path.

House Lion Prefect With First-year Paren.name:
带着一年级家长的狮院级长
House Lion Prefect With First-year Parents

Text.text:
“你的小崽子再也找不到比这里更好的家了。我们以学业为傲——原谅我这个双关——而且我们是学院里最安全的学舍。夜间巡逻的守卫狮都是我的老朋友。”
“Your cub couldn’t be in a better house. We take pride in our studies—pardon the pun—and we’re the safest house at the academy. The guard lions that patrol at night are personal friends.”

炫目的光辉在繁星点点的夜空中轰然绽放，如同一位无形大师挥动的画笔，旋涡般流转、笔触般铺陈。你屏住呼吸，目送翠绿、湛蓝与深紫在黑暗里耀然起舞。就在这样的瞬间，人才会明白，面对神祇的宏大尺度，自己是何等渺小。
Dazzling light explodes across the starlit night sky, moving in the swirls and strokes of an unseen master’s paintbrush. You hold your breath as you take in the greens, blues, and purples dancing brilliantly in the dark. In moments like these, a person realizes just how small they are against the grand scale of the gods.

Blazing Crimson Sunrise.name:
炽焰绯红的旭日
Blazing Crimson Sunrise

Text.text:
母太阳翻涌的弧光倾泻而出，在呜咽的夜之地平线上划开一道猩红的裂口。光芒如新鲜的血般渗出，把大地浸染成绯红与胭脂的色泽。世界在这一刻停驻，沐浴在新一日降临的赋礼里——短暂一瞬，纤细而安宁的静止。随即交响奏起，每一只苏醒的生物都唱响自己的晨歌。
The cresting arc of Mother Sun spills forth, a red gash across the night’s whimpering horizon. Light oozes out like fresh blood, coating the land in hues of crimson and carmine. The world stops for a moment to bask in the gift of a new day come—a brief second of delicate stillness. Then a symphony begins, as each waking creature sings its morning song.

Noble Drow Seduction.name:
高贵卓尔的魅惑
Noble Drow Seduction

Text.text:
“我看起来很冷吗？我的肌肤温热，像你的一样，接触时令人战栗。我的声音在你听来很阴森吗？阴谋叵测，凶毒不祥？我承认，有时听上去确实如此。但我也能低声将你的渴望呢喃成真，把你的呼吸哼唱进令人窒息的狂热之中。”
“Do I appear cold? My skin is warm, like thine, and thrilling to touch. Does my voice seem sinister to thee? Conniving and baleful? I confess it must sound so, on occasion. But I can also whisper thy desires into fulfilment, and croon thy breath into breathless passion.”

Young Dragon's First Flight.name:
幼龙的初次飞行
Young Dragon's First Flight

Text.text:
幼崽勇敢地挣扎着，张开柔嫩的双翼，渴望像那些覆鳞的同族一样飞越树梢。尽管稚拙的经验拖慢了它的飞行，它仍在下方葱郁的绿幕之上划出一道鲜亮的紫色流光，随着自信滋长，速度也越来越快。旁观的年轻精灵露出微笑，眼眶里却凝起泪珠。忽然，树冠间炸开一抹银光，猛地与幼龙相撞——它翻滚着坠入近旁的一片空地，而那道银影也追着落下，嬉闹般轻咬着它的金属兄弟姐妹。

~ 构想：Ameria（Discord）

The young one struggles valiantly as they spread their tender wings, eager to soar above the trees like their scaled brethren. Though their flight is hampered by inexperience, the young dragon becomes a streak of vibrant purple against the verdant canvas below, picking up speed as their confidence grows. Watching on, a young elf smiles as her eyes bead with tears. A flash of silver explodes from the canopy, colliding with the dragon as it tumbles to the ground in a nearby clearing, playfully nipping at their metallic sibling.

~ Envisioned by Ameria on Discord

Cracked But Still Functional Viewscreen.name:
裂纹遍布但仍可运作的显示屏
Cracked But Still Functional Viewscreen

Text.text:
坏点沿着观察屏上参差不齐的裂缝排开，仿佛被上方正在塌落的玻璃压碎在其重压之下。装置仍能运作，只是严重受损；屏幕上的画面也仍勉强可辨——只不过比起从前，更像一幅印象派的涂抹。
Dead pixels line the jagged crack in the viewscreen, as if crushed beneath the weight of the collapsing glass above. The device is still functional, if majorly impaired, and the picture on-screen is still just about discernible—albeit more impressionist than before.

Fake Boots Of The Winterlands.name:
冬境伪造长靴
Fake Boots Of The Winterlands

Text.text:
这双靴子在雪地里的第一次考验就彻底栽了跟头。你的脚冷得像两块冰坨子，哪怕裹在那显然是二流衬里的软垫里也无济于事。然而它们还没麻到失去知觉，你依然能清楚感到那股潮湿——靴子粗糙的走线此刻暴露无遗，拙劣得令人心寒。
The first test of the boots’ mettle in snowy conditions goes poorly. Your feet feel like blocks of ice, even cushioned inside what must be second-rate lining. They are not too numb to feel the damp, however, as the shoddy stitching on the boots becomes woefully apparent.

León The Necromancer.name:
莱昂，死灵法师
León The Necromancer

Text.text:
一副发黄的白骨胸甲狰狞地覆在他隆起的胸膛上。修长的手臂筋骨毕露、灰白如尸，垂向地面；那双长得不合常理的手指指节擦过地板。松垂的黑色皮膜自小指末端连到腋下，像翼帆般挂着。它每动一下，声响就像大片皮革被拖拽着摩擦地面。嘴角向上扭起，薄唇微张，露出一排杂乱而尖利的牙齿；犬齿长得夸张，远远伸过他覆着绒毛的下巴。鼻子仿佛被人狠狠砸进脸里，鼻孔被向上扯到光裸的眉骨下方。一道长疤沿这只狼人蝠的右脸直落，切过他的右眼——那只眼已不再像左眼那般深棕，而是停在他锐利的颧骨上方，惨白如幽，带着鬼影般的冷光。

~ 由一位英雄Played，其

A macabre breastplate of yellowing bone stretches across his convex chest. Long arms, sinewy and gray, hang toward the ground, the knuckles of his impossibly long fingers grazing the floor. Dark sails of loose skin, attached from the ends of his little fingers to his armpits, hang like wings. The sound of them as he moves is like large swathes of leather being dragged across the floor. The ends of his mouth curl, its thin lips parted to reveal a haphazard set of pointed teeth. The canines elongate far past his fuzzed chin. His nose has the look of having been pushed violently into his face, the nostrils pulled upward to his naked brow. A long scar runs down the right side of this werebat’s face and cuts through his right eye, which has lost the dark brown color of the left. It sits above his sharply angled cheek, white and spectral.

~ Played by a Hero with

Insult About Obnoxiousness.name:
关于惹人厌的辱骂
Insult About Obnoxiousness

Text.text:
“难怪你这么惹人厌。你肚子里那股热气，也跟所有人一样迫不及待想离你远点。”
“It’s little wonder you’re so obnoxious. All that hot air is just as desperate to leave you as everyone else is.”

Insult About Spell Components.name:
关于法术成分的侮辱
Insult About Spell Components

Text.text:
“你连让我为杀你耗费的法术材料都不配。”
“You’re barely worth the spell components it would take to kill you.”

Meeting An Githzerai.name:
邂逅一名吉斯泽莱人
Meeting An Githzerai

Text.text:
星界小镇漂浮在数块湿润的土块之上，滴落着以太与泥团，坠入一片缓缓旋转、蕴含神祇般伟力的海洋中，随即无声消散。最大那座岛上的酒馆由烟雾与余烬砌成。走入其中，酒客们宛如一幅由诸界万族与魔咒织就的挂毯——其中必定有谁熟知那群高踞食物链顶端的半神与英雄。你目光落在这样一位角色身上：一名星界苦行者。他察觉到你的注视，抬手示意你过去。

~ Envisioned by Friendly Innkeeper

The astral town floats on several chunks of wet earth, dripping ether and clods that disappear into a slowly turning sea of godlike power. The tavern on the largest island is made of smoke and embers. Inside, the patrons are a tapestry of races and enchantments from all over the realms, among which must certainly be someone knowledgeable of the demigods and heroes at the top of the food chain. One such character, an astral ascetic, catches your eye, and they beckon you over.

~ Envisioned by Friendly Innkeeper

野兽由你的法术与周遭元素共同塑形——取地面的碎屑、空气的流动与湿润的水汽——凝成实体。魔性与生机交织的微粒旋涡翻涌而起。你听见所召唤生物的啼鸣，也在迷雾般的尘霭中瞥见它的身形剪影。旋风渐息，野兽随之显现，目光灼灼地凝视着你，等待你的指令。
The beast forms from your spell and the elements around it—using pieces of the ground, the air, and moisture—and takes form. A whirlwind of motes, magical and organic, stirs up. You hear the cry of the creature you summon and see a silhouette of its body within the haze. The whirl dies, leaving the beast in its wake, looking intently at you for instruction.

Overheard Conversation About Working In.name:
关于在修道院里干活的窃听对话
Overheard Conversation About Working In A Monastery

Text.text:
“——我发誓，animate dead 和 raise dead 听起来简直像是在干同一件事……总之，我不在修道院干了。”
“—I swear, animate dead and raise dead sound like they do the exact same thing… Anyway, I’m not working at the monastery anymore.”

Entrance To Torchlit Cave.name:
通往火炬照明洞窟的入口
Entrance To Torchlit Cave

Text.text:
一块巨大的卵形巨石从洞口上方凸出，仿佛孕着随时坠落的可能。发丝般的根须攀附其上、垂悬四周，滴落的水汇成水洼，又流入洞内。冰冷的光与刺骨的寒气从岩下穿过，追随着水流涌入这座广阔的洞窟——在火把的暖光里回温，空气中弥漫着烟熏味，四处充斥着奔涌与咕噜作响的流水声。
A massive egg-like boulder protrudes above the cave’s entrance, pregnant with the potential to fall. Hair-like roots cling and dangle around it, dripping water that pools then runs into the cave. Cold light and chill air stream under the rock, following the water into this vast cave—warmed by torchlight, smelling of smoke, and filled with the rush and gurgle of moving water.

你无从确定这支飞镖是否真如你所猜测那样，是以尖刺魔的倒刺打造而成；但当你将它对准、准备掷出时，指尖传来的异界力量的刺麻感却不容置疑。
You have no way of knowing if this dart is truly fashioned from the barbs of a spiked devil as you suspect, but there is no denying the otherworldly power you feel tingling through your fingertips as you line it up for a throw.

Quip By Unwashed Party Member.name:
未洗澡的队员插话
Quip By Unwashed Party Member

Text.text:
“在我们再往前一步之前，我要求先停一停——找家旅店也好，一条小溪也好，哪怕是刚积起的一滩新水也行。我身上的臭味已经缠了太久，到了这会儿，怕是都快养出自己的性格了。”
“Before we go any further, I demand we stop at an inn, or a stream, or even a newly formed puddle. My body odor has lingered so long, at this point, it’s developing a personality.”

Haunted House: Conservatory.name:
闹鬼宅邸：温室
Haunted House: Conservatory

Text.text:
这座暖房被人巧妙设计得既舒适宜人，又能炫耀园丁的手艺：花盆与窗台花箱塞满了每一寸空间。然而，那些花散发着一股甜腻到发齁的香气。起初只是喉头一阵恼人的刺痒，继而香味浓得令人窒息，最后甚至让你头晕目眩。你的一位伙伴忽然惊叫一声；在你昏沉模糊的视野里，你瞥见一根藤蔓以惊人的敏捷从他们的手臂上抽离回去。
This conservatory has been cunningly designed for both comfort and to show off the work of the gardener, pots and window boxes filling every inch of space. Yet there is a cloying scent to those flowers. It begins as an annoying tickle in the throat, then becomes stifling in its aroma, and eventually it makes your head spin. One of your companions suddenly cries out, and through your muzzy vision you spy a vine withdrawing from their arm with startling agility.

Player Attempts To Encrypt Files.name:
玩家试图加密文件
Player Attempts To Encrypt Files

Text.text:
[失败] 你将加密算法写入密钥并注入文件，但代码里有什么东西一闪而过。它先变成蓝色，随后黯淡，最终消失无踪。文件再次自我加密，你不得不从头开始。

[成功] 你将加密算法写入密钥，当你将其敲入文件时，代码骤然加粗。紧随其后的层叠行列自我改写，化作无法辨识的文字，坠落穿过赛博空间。一条提示浮现： 重命名文件？

[Failed] You write the encryption algorithms into the key and introduce it to the file, but something flickers in the code. It changes to blue, then fades and finally disappears. The file ciphers itself again, and you have to start over.

[Successful] You write the encryption algorithms into the key, and when you tap it into the file, the code turns bold. The cascading lines that follow rewrite themselves into unrecognizable text falling through cyberspace. A prompt appears: Rename File?

“抱歉打扰你，”老头开口说道，颤巍巍的手从灰白头发间捋过。“你看起来像是肩上压着许多事的人，可我的朋友失踪了。他偶尔会乱跑，但从没离开这么久，我真不愿去想他独自待在外头。也许他对这世界算不了什么，可对我而言，他就是一切。”他顿了顿，水晶般的蓝眼里浮起一层泪光，让那抹光更显得闪烁。“我们会一起唱歌，你明白吗：唱些古老得不能再古老的歌，歌里的人早已不在。可少了他那讨人喜欢的小小啾鸣，我怎么也想不起那些音符。平时他会为了几粒种子或一条多汁的虫子回家，可这回一点动静都没有！我没多少钱，但只要你把他带回来，我愿把最后一枚都交给你。”

~ Charlotte 构想

“I’m sorry to bother you,” begins the old fellow, passing a shaky hand through his gray hair. “You seem like the sort that has a lot on their plate, but my friend has gone missing. He’s known to wander from time to time but never for so long, and I’d hate to think of him out there alone. He might not mean much to the world, but to me he is everything.” He pauses, a sheen of tears in his crystalline-blue eyes adding to their glimmer. “We sing together, you see: some very old songs of people now gone. But without his delightful little chirps, I just can’t seem to recall the notes. Normally he’d come home for a bit of seed or a juicy worm, but no luck! I don’t have much money but I’ll give you every last piece if you return him to me.”

~ Envisioned by Charlotte

Old Woman Confesses Her Missing Son Is A.name:
老妇人坦白：失踪的儿子其实是狼人
Old Woman Confesses Her Missing Son Is A Werewolf

Text.text:
暗门吱呀一声开启，露出一幕令人骨髓发寒的景象。地面上干涸的血泊铺陈开来，如同一幅猩红的马赛克；两条银链软塌塌地从钉入裸露龟裂墙面的铁钩上垂下，悬在这座阴沉牢房里。这里曾关过一头野兽吗？墙上被牙与爪撕啃的痕迹无疑在这么说，可……你转身，因察觉到某种存在——那位雇佣你们的老妇人正堵在狭窄门口，泪水沉沉压在她眼底。她坠落般跪倒在地，声音在绝望中颤抖，哀求队伍去寻找她失踪的儿子，并一再保证：他绝不是怪物。

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

The hidden door creaks open to reveal a bone-chilling scene. Pools of dried blood cover the floor like a sanguineous mosaic and two silver chains hang limply from hooks hammered into the bare, cracked walls of the dismal prison. Was a wild animal imprisoned here? The marks on the walls from tooth and claw would certainly suggest so but… You turn, sensing a presence, to see the figure of the old woman who hired you filling the small doorway, her eyes heavy with tears. Falling to her knees, her voice quakes with desperation as she begs the party to find her missing son, assuring them he is no monster.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Countryside: Daytime On The Farm.name:
乡间：白日农场
Countryside: Daytime On The Farm

Text.text:
耀阳般明亮的云朵掠过一顶澄澈夺目的蓝色穹幕，在你周遭起伏的原野上投下大片疾掠的翡翠色阴影，斑驳游走。你却感受不到驱使它们奔越天际的风。相反，在被太阳烘暖的地面上，最轻微的一缕微风把芬芳送到你鼻端：野花的甜香、成片草地的清新，以及点缀着浆果、蜂鸣萦绕的树篱气息。你看见也听见农舍的牲畜与歌唱的鸟儿一同享受这恬美的日子，只是它们还离得太远，气味尚未飘到这里。
Sun-bright clouds drift across a dome of brilliant blue, dappling the rolling landscape around you with vast, scudding shadows of emerald hues. You don’t feel the wind that drives them in their race across the sky. Instead, down on the sun-warmed earth, the barest of breezes brings you the good scents of wildflowers, acres of grass, and berry-studded, bee-buzzed hedgerows. You see and hear farm animals enjoying this blissful day as much as the songful birds, but they’re too far off to smell as yet.

Lavish Reception By Bullywug.name:
牛蛙人奢华接待
Lavish Reception By Bullywug

Text.text:
这些小巧斑斓的两栖生物挤在你的同伴周围，用那粗粝、喉音浓重的语言兴奋地呱呱叫着。蛙裔首领挥手招来几名同族，它们端着盘子，上面摆着古怪的水果、塞满馅料的叶包，以及用签子串起、架在烤叉上的啮齿小兽。首领在你朋友面前深深躬身，带着谦卑的敬意指向这些供品。

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

The small, colorful amphibians crowd around your companion croaking excitedly in their guttural language. The frogkin leader waves over several of his fellows who are carrying plates of strange fruits, stuffed leaves, and skewered rodents on spits. The leader bows low before your friend, gesturing to the offerings with humble deference.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

I Press The First Button On My Rod Of Lo.name:
我按下了「威严权杖」上的第一个按钮（烈焰舌之剑）
I Press The First Button On My Rod Of Lordly Might (Flame Tongue Sword)

Text.text:
当我按下第一个按钮时，热量在我掌心迅速积聚，随即一股火焰从魔杖末端喷涌而出，一柄炽烈的长剑在烈焰中迸现。空气里弥漫着臭氧的刺鼻气息，火舌噼啪作响、噗噗爆裂，缠绕着一截华美的剑身——精致得胜过我所见过的一切。
When I press the first button, heat builds in my hands then a blazing sword erupts from the end of the Rod in a gout of fire. The smell of ozone fills the air as the flames crackle and sputter around an ornate blade, finer than any I have ever seen.

恶臭的沼泽向四面八方绵延数里，辛辣刺鼻的雾霭笼罩其上，间或有几簇扭曲虬结的树丛在阴影里沉默伫立。水色黝黑，咸涩浑浊，像泥浆一般，深处有不知名的生物蠕动翻搅。诡异的呼叫与嚎声在远近间来回回荡，其间夹杂着灌木簌簌移位的声响，以及某些庞大而怪物般的东西穿行荒野时沉重的脚步。你尽可能小心地前行，烂泥贪婪地吸住你的靴子，将你往幽暗的泥潭里拖拽——忽然，你踩进了另一种东西：一堆秽物，一滩令人作呕的黏烂残渣，夹杂着碎裂的骨片；那是巨魔饱餐后的最后残迹。
The foul-smelling bogs sprawl for leagues in all directions, shrouded in an acrid mist and shadowed with the occasional copse of gnarled trees. The water is dark, brackish, and mud-like, with unknown creatures squirming in its depths. Strange calls and howls echo back and forth, punctuated by shifting brush and the heavy footfalls of things large and monstrous moving through the wilderness. You move as carefully as you dare, the mud sucking your boots into its dark confines, and suddenly you step in something else—a pile of refuse, a sickening slop riddled with bone fragments; the last remnants of a meal enjoyed by a troll.

宛如翡翠王国的银色女王，它挺直脊背屹立，颁下宏大的宣告。它闪耀的发丝与层叠的裙摆浑然一体，垂落成一列迷雾般的水流列车，悄然滑入山谷。越是靠近，越能体会它的壮丽——横跨半英里，高达其两倍；在它的边缘与下方的水潭旁，空气狂野而清凉。瀑布两端的水势同样汹涌，却远不及那道坠落本身那般骇人——甚至足以致命。
Like the silver queen of a jade kingdom, it stands, straight-backed, issuing great proclamations. Its shining hair and frilled gown descend as one to a misty train that glides into the valley. The closer one gets, the greater the realization of its magnificence—a half mile across, twice that in height, and the air wild and cool at its edge and in the pool below. The water on either end of the waterfall is turbulent, but not as threatening—and potentially fatal—as the drop itself.

这支黑色蜡烛粗壮如柱，烛身宽厚，顶端分出三根灯芯，每一根都燃着猩红火焰，吐出缕缕苦涩刺鼻的黑烟，盘旋上升。血色的蜡油在灯芯下方汇聚成池，沿着烛身缓缓淌落；在底部，它滴成一滩，铺在一只圆形金属托盘上，托盘刻满了元素与护佑的符号。
A wide and thick cylinder, this black candle has three wicks, each burning with a red flame and giving off curls of bitter and caustic black smoke. Melted wax the color of blood pools under the wicks and runs down the candle. At the bottom, it forms a puddle on a circular plate of metal inscribed with elemental and protective symbols.

Deserted House: Creaky Porch.name:
废弃宅邸：吱呀作响的门廊
Deserted House: Creaky Porch

Text.text:
你听见狂风在咆哮——遥远得仿佛在看见海岸前，先听见海潮的轰鸣。可在屋子的阴影里，空气却凝滞而冰冷。想必是天气的某种怪异变化，或这建筑暗藏的奥秘将你从风势中庇护开来，因为整座房子吱呀作响、低沉呻吟，像暴风雨中的船只。
You hear the wind roaring—distant, like hearing the ocean before you can see the shore. Yet here in the shadow of the house, the air feels still and cold. Some quirk of the weather or arcane feature of the architecture must shelter you from the breeze because the house creaks and groans like a ship in a storm.

曾几何时，这些城墙与投石机抛来的石弹、巨人掷出的巨岩，甚至可能是撕裂万物的法术鏖战不休。它们曾在此守望，见证历史铸成。而今，它们正被常春藤围困，向时代俯首称臣。你正沉浸在它们静谧的美感之中，忽然，墙外某处传来一阵喧闹的振翅声，一群鸽子猛然腾空而起。
Once these castle walls did battle with catapult stones, boulders flung by giants, or possibly sundering spells. They stood guard as history was made. Now they’re under siege by ivy and have surrendered to time. You are reflecting on their quiet beauty when a flock of pigeons noisily flaps into the air from somewhere beyond the wall.

Wild Magic Surge: Volume Distortion.name:
狂野魔法涌动：音量扭曲
Wild Magic Surge: Volume Distortion

Text.text:
你最新施放的法术所引发的魔力反噬在你耳畔尖啸哀鸣。待那声音终于止息，你转向你的伙伴——而你脱口而出的下一句话却轰然化作一声怒吼，你仿佛无力将其压下。
Magical feedback from your latest spell wails in your ears. When it stops, you turn to your companions—and the next words out of your mouth erupt as a shout that you seem powerless to suppress.

I Study My Manual Of Quickness Of Action.name:
我研读《敏捷行动手册》
I Study My Manual Of Quickness Of Action

Text.text:
几个小时过去，我的肺在疾奔的余韵中隐隐作痛，脑海也被杂技般的翻腾搅成一片朦胧，可我依旧能辨读那些字句。书触感柔软，书页轻易翻动、也易于领会，但必须反复阅读——先正着读，再倒着读，再倒悬着读，再站着读——直到它的效力终于渗入骨血。到了最后一天，当我从桌边起身时，脚步已轻若无声。我伸出拇指与食指，在空中捻住一只蚊蚋。
Over the hours, my lungs feel the effects of sprinting and my mind the blur of acrobatics, even as I am still able to read the words. The book is soft, the pages easy to turn and comprehend, but it must be read many times—first forward, then backward, then upside down, then standing, until its effects finally take hold. On the last day, when I rise from the table, it is to a light step. I pluck a gnat out of the air between my finger and thumb.

她脸色苍白、体型娇小，年纪轻轻的女子，肌肉里却透着一股松弛而利落的运动感。笔直的铂金长发垂落在她平静的面庞两侧，灰蓝色的眼睛让她显得好奇又亲近。她穿着黑色背心、宽松长裤，以及一双白色高帮鞋，鞋面印着一颗暗色星纹。黑色颈圈环在颈间，繁复的纹身覆满双臂。她的双手结实有力，布满老茧，指节粗硬凸起，仿佛诉说着一段毫无收敛的拳斗过往。

~ Played by a Hero with

She’s pale and petite, this young woman, with a hint of relaxed athleticism in her muscles. Straight platinum locks surround her calm face, and her gray-blue eyes make her seem curious and approachable. She dons a black tank top, loose pants, and a pair of white high-top shoes emblazoned with a dark star. A black choker wraps her neck, and elaborate tattoos cover her arms. Her hands are muscular with calluses and tough, knobby knuckles, hinting at a history of unrestrained pugilism.

~ Played by a Hero with

Zone Of Truth.name:
诚实之域
Zone Of Truth

Text.text:
那生物刚开口说话，却猛地停住，仿佛话语卡在喉咙里。他们又试了一次，结果依旧。你嘴角一挑，那生物恼怒地哼了一声——在这里，在你魔法效力笼罩之下，他们无法说谎。
The creature starts to speak, but stops suddenly, as if the words have caught in their throat. They try again with the same result. You smirk, and the creature grunts in frustration—they cannot lie here, not with the effects of your magic present.

四周骤然陷入死寂，随即只剩你心脏震颤的搏动，以及脑海深处魔力涌动的低低嘶鸣。你仿佛置身一间透明的屋子里向外窥望，只能在心中替眼前的一切补上该有的声响。可在这一切之中，你真正听见的只有一样——像从极遥远处飘来的、诅咒你之人的轻微笑声。
There’s a sudden silence, which is shortly replaced by the vibrating beat of your heart and a low hiss of magical energy inside your head. You imagine the sounds that go with the things you see around you, as if you’re looking out from inside a transparent room. Through it all, you hear only one thing from what seems a great distance: the faint laughter of the one who cursed you.

Underground City Slums.name:
地下城贫民窟
Underground City Slums

Text.text:
在上头，企业黄鼠狼与精英网潜者为顶层公寓争得面红耳赤。可在这下面，渣滓正聚拢。那被遗忘的城市根基——建于无比久远的年代——把一群不择手段与命途多舛之人吸引而来。流浪者的营地把防水布一路牵拉到视野尽头。目光狂乱的少年挥舞砍刀，抢劫、杀戮。野兽在远处的黑暗里嚎叫，觅食、死去。世界的一切垃圾都漂落到这里，堆成被遗忘废料的群山。

~ 一位英雄所构想

Above, the corporate weasels and elite netrunners squabble over penthouse apartments. But down here, the dregs gather. The forgotten foundations of the city—built so very long ago—gather to them a bevy of the unscrupulous and unfortunate. Camps of vagrants stretch tarpaulins off into the distance. Wild-eyed youths wielding machetes rob and kill. Wild animals yowl in the distant dark, feeding and dying. All the refuse of the world drifts down here, mountains of forgotten scrap.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Giant Monitor Lizard.name:
巨型巨蜥
Giant Monitor Lizard

Text.text:
一头冷酷无情的掠食者拖着沉重的步子向你逼近。它在一处处掩蔽之间疾窜，从不让你看清它负载般的全貌。但你的心智仿佛在拼合一幅拼图，把所见的零碎线索拼成这头生物的形象：一只小马大小的鬣蜥，蜥蜴般的尾巴拖在身后；它以犀牛般的粗壮腿脚向前拖行，末端的利爪长得几乎和你的前臂一样。它的颈项柔韧蜿蜒，能从任何角度猛然出击，顶端却是一颗眼镜蛇的头颅。分叉的舌头像恶魔的双叉戟般从涎水淋漓的颌间迸出——黏稠的剧毒唾液不断渗滴。
A ruthless predator plods toward you. It skitters between pieces of cover, never revealing the totality of its bulk. But like assembling a puzzle, your mind fits what it sees into a picture of the creature: a pony-sized iguana with a saurian tail drags itself forward on rhinoceros legs that end in claws as long as your forearm. Its sinuous neck, capable of striking from any angle, holds a cobra's head. Like a demon's bident, a forked tongue flares from its slobbering jaw—oozing poisonous saliva.

一道魁梧的身影在昏暗的光线里昂然伫立，肤色苍白，目光锐利，扫视着四周。身着飞行服，他们握持武器的姿态从容自若，像久经沙场的老兵般熟稔。那张脸带着贵胄般的威仪：宽阔的额头像雪花石膏般莹白，其下是一双月岩般的眼睛，微光里闪着淡淡的哀愁。可即便如此，他们的下颌仍紧紧绷起，透出不容置疑的决心。
A broad figure stands proud in the low lighting, pale skinned and keen eyed, scanning their surroundings. Clad in a flight suit, they wield their weapons with the easy comfort of a seasoned warrior. Their face has a noble bearing: a broad brow the color of alabaster above a set of moonrock eyes that gleam a subtle sadness. Nevertheless, their jaw is set in an undeniable expression of determination.

小狗在你身后蹦蹦跳跳地跟着，步伐摇摇晃晃又充满玩心，用短促的吠声和焦急的呜咽拼命想引起你的注意。它那圆鼓鼓、湿漉漉的鼻头在你的背包上嗅来嗅去，带着出乎意料的力道拱着你；接着又一跃冲到你前面，狼崽似的身躯兴奋得左右摇摆，洋溢着难以抑制的喜悦。看来，你交到一个朋友了。

~ Gostteam 于 Discord

The pup follows with a lolloping, playful gait behind you, trying to get your attention with clipped barks and desperate whines. Its bulbous, wet nose snuffles at your pack, nudging you with surprising force, and it bounds in front of you, its lupine body swinging side to side with exuberant joy. It seems you've made a friend.

~ Gostteam on Discord

Crevasse In A Glacier.name:
冰川裂隙
Crevasse In A Glacier

Text.text:
不知是被水流侵蚀得愈发狰狞，还是仅仅源于它自身阴郁的移动，这道冰川裂隙以近乎垂直的角度向下坠落，深度几乎无法估量。想要跨越它，必须谨慎移动，确保落脚仍在坚实的冰面上——重力的怒火对倒霉的旅人绝不会留情。
Whether exacerbated by water or simply the results of its own lugubrious movement, the crevasse in this glacier plunges downward at such an angle that it is virtually impossible to gauge its depth. It will require careful movement to ensure that any crossing ends with feet on solid ice—gravity’s wrath could be quite unforgiving to an unlucky traveler.

Dust Of Sneezing And Choking.name:
喷嚏与窒息之尘
Dust Of Sneezing And Choking

Text.text:
这只寻常的皮革小袋被抽绳紧紧束住；一旦打开，映入眼帘的是满满一袋细腻如尘的粉末，几乎要溢出来。它带着一丝刺鼻的气味，而在那原本毫不起眼的灰粉之中，你能看见金属般的微粒隐隐闪烁。
The mundane leather pouch is cinched shut, and upon opening it, you find it full to the brim with fine, delicate powder. It smells somewhat acrid, and you can see metallic particulates gleaming from within the otherwise featureless dust.

疲惫压得她眼皮沉重，医生用颤抖的手把眼镜往上推，眉头紧锁，满脸困惑。她来回踱步——步伐微微踉跄——任由话语倾泻到你身上，那份能说出体贴甜言蜜语的耐心与温度早已熄灭。
Eyes heavy with fatigue, the doctor pushes her glasses up with a shaking hand and furrows her brow in consternation. Pacing back and forth—her gait wobbling slightly—she allows her words to tumble onto you, her capacity for empathetic honeyed words long since extinguished.

Icehouse Of A Creepy Manor.name:
阴森庄园的冰屋
Icehouse Of A Creepy Manor

Text.text:
和所有冰窖一样，这座建筑从外面上了闩——但大多数冰窖的木门上，可不会留着有人从里面拼命砸门想冲出来的凹痕。走进里面，几块沾血的肉侧挂在铁钩上，寒意森森的环境阻止了腐败，厨房的伙计会按需割下肉块。一整块肉摊在大理石台面上，被细致地修整、剔骨。那是猪肉吗？也许，最好还是离开这里。
Like all icehouses, this structure is barred from the outside—but most don’t have impressions in the wooden door from someone trying to bash it down from the inside. Within, several sides of blooded meat hang from hooks, the chill environs protecting against rot, pieces carved off according to the needs of the kitchen staff. One slab of meat sits on a marble tabletop, carefully dressed and de-boned. Is it pork? Maybe it would be a good idea to leave this place.

Temple To A God Of Necromancy.name:
死灵法神殿
Temple To A God Of Necromancy

Text.text:
这座供奉死灵术之神的神殿以暴风云般漆黑的石材筑成，高耸的拱窗与尖顶塔楼刺破天际，在天空映衬下显得阴森可怖。然而踏入殿内，亡者之美却以更奢华的面目铺陈开来——处处皆是白骨，成千上万，乃至数以万计。拱顶下垂落的吊灯以股骨作穗，在烛光柔和的金辉里泛着暖亮。整面墙由层层堆叠的头骨砌成，有的骨白如霜，有的被涂成夺目的斑斓色彩。此地是生与死的门槛，白骨如同不息的警示：纵然血肉尽褪，仍有留下些什么。
Built of storm cloud–black stone, with tall, arched windows and steepled towers, this temple to the god of necromancy cuts a grim figure against the sky. The temple interior, however, reveals a more ostentatious side of undeath. It is decorated with bones, tens of thousands of them. A chandelier hanging from the vaulted ceiling is fringed with femurs, golden in the soft glow of candlelight. Entire walls are formed of stacked skulls, some bone white, others painted in brilliant colors. This place is a threshold between life and death, the bones a constant reminder of what remains even beyond flesh and blood.

Prosthetic Hand Of Freezing.name:
冰霜义手
Prosthetic Hand Of Freezing

Text.text:
尽管这只义手由技艺精湛的匠人将钢材反复锤炼而成，内里流转的魔法却令它泛起一种吞噬一切的淡蓝幽光，几乎让你不寒而栗。灰色金属上细致地绘着一颗颗白色雪球，令它的用途再无疑问。纵使这具义肢的做工堪称娴熟，它也只模糊地像一只人形的手：掌心尽头分出五根细长如枝的抓握器，能牢牢钳住物体，同时义肢将其目标冻结。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Although this prosthetic hand is made of expertly hammered steel, the magic within makes it glow an all-consuming pale blue, which almost makes you shiver. White snowballs are delicately painted on the gray metal, removing any doubt about the hand’s purpose. Despite the skill in the prosthetic’s construction, it only vaguely resembles a humanoid hand, with the palm ending in five spindly graspers that can hold something securely as the prosthetic freezes its target.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

兼作营地与旅舍，这片空间向任何人开放，可免费搭帐篷。入口处立着一块帆布招牌，上书：旅人广场：对所有人开放。再往营地深处走几步，另一块牌子写着一份行为守则——请求所有进入者保持空间整洁、安全、友善。来访者会遇见形形色色的人：野餐的家庭、背包客学生、行旅商贩，以及天性逐水草而居的游民。帐篷挤满了区域西侧，而中央大片地方则特意留空，供篝火、野餐毯与游戏之用。
Serving as both a campground and a hostel, this space is open for anyone to set up a tent, free of charge. A canvas sign at the entrance reads: Wayfarer Square: Open to All. A bit further into the camp, another sign details a Code of Conduct—rules requesting that all those who enter keep the space clean, safe, and friendly. Those who visit will find folk from all walks of life: picnicking families, backpacking students, traveling merchants, and people simply nomadic in nature. Tents crowd the west side of the area, while a large portion in the center is kept open for campfires, picnic blankets, and games.

Dungeon: Wide Hall.name:
地城：宽阔长厅
Dungeon: Wide Hall

Text.text:
地城豁然展开成一座宽阔大厅，火盆的昏暗光照在卵石铺就的地面上摇曳跳动。陈旧的残骸散落一地——破碎的陶器与开裂的雕像，它们在鼎盛之时想必曾辉煌夺目。墙边一扇扇缺角的门与粗糙凿出的洞口一字排开，向你献上无数条可供探索的去路。
The dungeon opens into a wide hall, the dim light of braziers dancing on the cobbled floor. Old debris lies scattered across the floor—shattered ceramics and cracked sculptures that must have been splendid in their prime. Chipped doors and rough holes line the walls, offering a plethora of directions to explore.

Loot From A Zombie With A Hint Of Her Fo.name:
从一具仍残留生前痕迹的丧尸身上搜出的战利品
Loot From A Zombie With A Hint Of Her Former Life

Text.text:
那具被驱动的贵族尸骸轰然倒地，声响仿佛生肉砸在屠夫的案板上。她腰间的钱袋裂开，钱币四散飞溅。你还注意到她干枯的手指上戴着一枚做工精美的戒指——或许象征着订婚。总之，这些战利品价值 20 枚金币。
The animated noble cadaver falls to the ground with a sound like raw meat hitting the butcher’s slab. A purse at her waist splits, spilling coins in every direction. You also notice a beautifully crafted ring—possibly signifying an engagement—on her desiccated finger. Overall, the loot is worth 20 gold pieces.

Taunt By A Melee Character.name:
近战角色的嘲讽
Taunt By A Melee Character

Text.text:
“等这一切结束，我会被你的血浇得满身都是——多到我们都能算亲戚了。”
“By the end of this, I’m going to be covered in so much of your blood we’re going to be relatives."

风霜刻痕的侏儒从蓬乱雪白的眉毛下眯起眼睛打量。他的目光游走不定，紧盯着来往行人，同时抬手擦去那套穿旧的连身工作服前襟上的污渍——肥大、褪色，却依旧结实耐用。皱纹爬满他的脸颊，在他坏笑或眨眼时愈发深刻：那是数十年磨出来的痕迹，也是笑意长驻的印记。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The weathered gnome squints from beneath bushy white brows. His eyes roam, focused on passersby, as he wipes a stain from the front of a well-worn jumpsuit, baggy and faded but otherwise in good condition. Wrinkles line his face, deepening as he smirks or winks—the wear of decades, but also of mirth.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Sundries From An Ankheg.name:
来自安科格的杂货
Sundries From An Ankheg

Text.text:
这具昆虫般的尸体死后仍在抽搐。几枚凹瘪的铜币和几颗色彩斑斓的卵石，卡在它被碾碎的几丁质甲壳板缝隙之间。
The insectile corpse continues to twitch after death. A few dented copper pieces and some colorful pebbles are wedged between the crushed plates of its chitinous exoskeleton.

Spotting A Colossal Sea Creature.name:
发现巨型海洋生物
Spotting A Colossal Sea Creature

Text.text:
清冷而带着盐味的海风让你保持警觉。你站在船首远眺，双手撑在栏杆粗砺的木纹上。忽然，你瞥见有什么庞然大物正朝船只逼近。那团朦胧的生物在轰鸣的巨浪间穿行，尽管体型骇人，却依旧优雅而威严。半透明的肉质以鲜艳而异质的色彩脉动起伏，部分遮蔽了其体内正被消化的巨大骷髅（特征）。也许，你们的船将成为这巨物的下一餐。
The cool, salty breeze keeps you alert as you look out from the bow, hands braced against the coarse wood of the railing. Suddenly you catch sight of something huge heading toward the ship. The nebulous creature moves through the thunderous waves with grace and majesty despite its colossal stature. Translucent flesh pulses with vibrant, alien colors, partially obscuring the enormous skeleton being digested within. Perhaps your ship will be the giant’s next meal.

Anacite Predator Drone.name:
阿纳赛特掠食者无人机
Anacite Predator Drone

Text.text:
一只巨大的有翼甲虫在空中振翅盘旋，强劲的气动翼托起那臃肿的金属骨架；明明沉重如铁，却被它举重若轻地驮得优雅。银白的金属护甲层层覆在躯体上，其内嵌着一整套沉甸甸的集成武器。它脸上是阿纳赛特惯常的感官阵列——一支凶狠的角后，四道猩红线条交叉成十字。
A great winged beetle flutters in the air, its powerful pneumatic wings supporting a bulky metallic frame, which, though massive, is carried gracefully. Plates of silvery metal armor its frame, housing a heavy array of integrated weapons. The customary sensory array of the anacite marks its face—four scarlet lines in a cross shape behind a brutal-looking horn.

I Cast Scorching Ray.name:
我施放灼热射线
I Cast Scorching Ray

Text.text:
三支火焰长矛在我头顶显现，橙与赤的怒色翻涌。炽热逼来，我的皮肤刺痛，汗珠渗出——可我毫不畏惧。我感到精神振奋。力量在体内奔涌。它们是我内心怒火的容器。当我将它们掷向目标时，它们如猛兽般咆哮着撕裂空气。
Three spears of flame, raging hues of orange and red, appear above me. My skin prickles and sweats under their intense heat—but I am not frightened. I feel invigorated. Empowered. These are the vessels of my inner fury. They roar like fierce beasts as I hurl them toward my marks.

Temple To A God Of Sailors.name:
献给海员之神的神殿
Temple To A God Of Sailors

Text.text:
这位神明的神殿仿佛一艘翻覆的加列战船，轮廓线条在回声里震颤。神殿船艉处矗立着巨大的双开门，推门便入一座宏阔大厅。拱顶沿着船体龙骨一路向船艏延展；在那尽头，一尊抛光木雕的航海之神挺立其间，壮硕的手臂伸出指引，头发束成水手的长辫。他所指之处，是一张横跨船肋的巨大渔网。那网的编织古怪，细看之下，结扣竟像星辰般排列，织出水手用以辨路的星座。
The temple to this god echoes the lines of an overturned galleon. Great double doors in the temple’s stern lead into a great hall. Its vaulted ceiling follows the keel of the ship to the bow, where a polished wooden statue of the god of sailors stands pointing with a brawny arm, his hair bound in a sailor’s queue. He points to a vast net stretched across the ship’s ribs. The net is woven strangely, but upon closer inspection, the knots appear to represent stars, forming the constellations sailors use to navigate.

Empty Holding Room At A Jail.name:
监狱的空押候室
Empty Holding Room At A Jail

Text.text:
拘留牢房简陋冷清、毫无装饰——不过是一间巨大的石质壁橱，墙边排着发霉的木长凳。生锈的锁链从深嵌墙中的铁钩上垂落摇晃。狭窄的窗户装着铁栅，只放进一束细薄的阳光，像是在提醒你被囚的事实。

~ 由 Girlhead 构想

The holding cell is spartan, unadorned—little more than a large stone closet with moldering wooden benches lining the walls. Rusting chains dangle from iron hooks embedded deep into the walls. A narrow window, set with iron bars, allows in a thin column of sunlight, a reminder of one’s captivity.

~ Envisioned by Girlhead

随着一座守卫塔上传来一声召唤，绞盘随即启动，绳索发出沉闷的呻吟，沉重的木制吊桥在内堡壕沟的远侧懒洋洋地离地抬起。它缓缓抹去大厅与庭院那幅斑斓的景象——人群与牲畜仍在其间忙碌。终于，伴着一声轻轻的 咚，吊桥合拢，紧接着从绞盘处传来一声压低的呼喊，回荡至女墙之上。

~ 由 Narth Envisioned

With a call down from one of the guard towers, the winches are engaged, the ropes groan, and the heavy wooden drawbridge lifts lazily off the ground on the far side of the bailey trench. It slowly erases the colorful view of hall and yard, where people and animals work. Finally, with a soft thump, it closes, which is followed by a muffled call up from the winch to the parapet.

~ Envisioned by Narth

Fisherman's Magic Missile.name:
渔夫的魔法飞弹
Fisherman's Magic Missile

Text.text:
渔夫赤脚重重一跺，从破烂长裤的口袋里掏出一枚水晶。他一只眼睛骤然瞪圆，另一只却眯成细缝。他咬着烟斗的斗柄片刻，随即高声喊道：“牛头鲶的饵，小鱼和鳗鱼的食——让这些恶棍尝尝深渊咬人的滋味！”水晶里一片镀金的鳞片亮起微光。几条幽灵般的金色鱼影自鳞片中迸射而出，伴着翻涌水声穿空疾掠。

~ 由 PhoenixDisciple 构想

With a stomp of his bare feet, the fisherman draws a crystal from the pocket of his tattered trousers. One eye goes wide, and the other narrows. He chews his pipe stem for a moment before shouting, “Bait to bullheads, minnows and eels, let these blaggards see how the bite o’ the deep feels!” A gilded scale within the crystal glows. Several ghostly golden fish burst from the scale and dart through the air with the sound of roiling water.

~ Envisioned by PhoenixDisciple

Punctual Captain Facing Transportation D.name:
守时的队长遭遇运输延误
Punctual Captain Facing Transportation Delays

Text.text: 一身笔挺的舰队军官紧张地在到达信息屏下来回踱步，不停低头查看手腕上的计时器。意外的延误把不断跳动的显示挤得满满当当，他紧抿的嘴唇间不时迸出细碎而惊恐的抽气声。忽然，屏幕上以多种语言同时闪烁出巨大的红色 cancelled 标识，男人愤怒地尖叫一声，把军帽狠狠摔到地上。 The pristine fleet officer paces nervously beneath the arrival screen, constantly checking his wrist chono. Unexpected delays cram the fluctuating displays, causing minute gasps of horror to burst from his tight-lipped mouth. When a huge red cancelled sign flashes across the screens in multiple languages the man screams in frustration and hurls his cap to the floor.

Tournament Black Knight.name:
黑骑士锦标赛
Tournament Black Knight

Text.text:
黑血浸染的沙地上，那身披黑曜铠甲的骑士昂然屹立，轻蔑地扫视着嘘声四起的人群。黑暗的瘴气在其周身弥漫，手中紧握的符文巨剑正滴落着淋漓血肉。几尺之外，敌手的无头尸身横陈在地，恐怖的断口处已引来苍蝇嗡嗡聚集。
Standing tall on the blood-stained sand, the obsidian-armored knight glances disdainfully at the booing crowd. A miasma of darkness permeates the air about them, gore dripping from the rune-etched greatsword clutched in their hand. A few feet away lies the headless corpse of their opponent, flies already gathering around the horrific wound.

Ruins Of A Small Village.name:
小村遗墟
Ruins Of A Small Village

Text.text:
土路尽头是一片由鹅卵石铺就的广场，周围散落着十来栋建筑。房屋破败得令人心悸：不少茅草屋顶向内塌陷，窗户早已不复存在，只剩碎裂的玻璃在空洞的窗框处参差闪着冷光。广场上，植物从石缝里硬生生钻出，仿佛大自然正重新收回这片土地。一阵凉风掠过废墟般的聚落，沙沙作响，短暂搅动了长久的寂静。
The dirt road leads to a dozen buildings centered around a cobbled square. The houses are in dire disrepair. Many thatched roofs have collapsed inwards, and broken glass lines the spaces where windows once stood. In the square, plants have forced their way through cracks in the stones, as nature once more takes her claim. A cool wind rustles through the ruined settlement, briefly disrupting a long silence.

这件导航工具被安置在一只打磨得光润的木盒中，大小恰好能轻松握在掌心；其中一枚微微颤动的指针始终指向正北，让迷途的冒险者稳稳走回正轨。水晶的掩蔽保护着罗盘手绘的表盘，方位字母以靛蓝与红色交替描绘，色泽分明。
Set in a polished wooden box that fits easily in one’s hand, this navigational tool’s trembling needle—pointing due north—keeps the wayward adventurer on the right track. A cover of crystal protects the hand-painted face of the compass, the directional letters painted in alternating colors of indigo and red.

Gladiator’s Storeroom.name:
角斗士的储藏室
Gladiator’s Storeroom

Text.text:
积尘的木箱、桶和麻袋塞满了储藏室，腐烂的霉腥气沉甸甸地压在空气里，仿佛多年无人踏入。锈蚀的武器与护甲——早已朽坏到无法修复——沿着墙面排列在开裂的木架上。有些仍覆着干涸剥落的血痂。
Dusty crates, barrels and sacks populate the storeroom, the palpable musk of rot hanging heavy in the air, undisturbed for years. Rusted weapons and armor—degraded beyond repair—line the walls in splintering wooden racks. Some are still covered in dried, flaking blood.

Uncomfortably Crowded Tavern.name:
令人窒息的拥挤酒馆
Uncomfortably Crowded Tavern

Text.text:
酒馆的布局被狂欢的人潮彻底遮蔽：每张桌子、每个座位、每一片空地都被汗光淋漓的镇民占满。密密匝匝的人墙挡在你面前，让你看不见任何清晰的去路；人头起伏、脚步点踏，随着某处人群深处传来的乐队声一齐摇摆。要在这团人海中穿行，必然折磨感官与灵魂。体味——再混上马匹的膻气、长日劳作的酸汗味与走味的啤酒气——纠缠成一层酸涩而压迫的浊雾。

~ Ethan 构想

The layout of the tavern is hidden by the carousing crowd, every table, seat, and section of open floor occupied by the sweat-sheened townsfolk. A bulwark of bodies prevents you from seeing any clear way forward, their heads bouncing and feet tapping to the sounds of a music troupe playing from somewhere within the throng. To weave through this mass would be an effort for the senses and soul. The body odors—and the scent of horses and long days of work and stale beer—meld together into a sour and oppressive pall.

~ Envisioned by Ethan

Alwyn Neverember.name:
阿尔温·奈弗安伯
Alwyn Neverember

Text.text:
尽管这位骑士高大英俊、肌肉结实，他的存在却让人觉得空落落的，仿佛那张绷着的笑容背后，藏着无声的忧郁。他抬手拨过一头华美的金发，转向自己的侍从——一个被装备压得几乎站不稳的男孩——抬手示意他们在路边停下。少年如释重负地叹了口气，放下重担，踱到近旁一棵树投下的清凉阴影里。骑士的护甲是惊艳的宝蓝色，金边勾勒，在阳光下熠熠生辉；他大步上前，从行囊中取出长剑与盾牌，随即以令人赞叹的技能与纪律开始操练。

~ 由一位英雄 扮演

Though the knight is tall, handsome, and muscular, his presence feels somehow hollow, as if the strained smile on his face hides a quiet melancholy. Running a hand through magnificent golden hair, he turns to his squire—a boy overloaded by equipment—and gestures for them to stop by the roadside. Sighing with relief, the lad puts his burden down and wanders over to the cooling shade of a nearby tree. The knight’s armor, a stunning shade of royal blue edged with gold, is resplendent in the sun as he strides forth. He retrieves his sword and shield from the luggage and begins to train with remarkable skill and discipline.

~ Played by a Hero

Payton Rosyana, The Hermit.name:
佩顿·罗夏娜，「隐士」
Payton Rosyana, The Hermit

Text.text:
人们很难与她交谈，不仅因为她的嘴被缝死了，更因为这景象分外刺眼，足以让任何形式的交流都变得煎熬。她戴着一条项链，坠饰是“缝住的嘴”的符号。她不再继续四处游荡——人们曾因那能让她远离而心怀庆幸——如今却走进了这座小村庄。她用手势示意：她在寻找“别人的嘴”，好把它缝起来，以取悦她的神。她取出针与线，挑起眉梢——仿佛在询问。

~ Played by Charlotte

People find it difficult to converse with her, not only because her mouth is sewn shut but also because this is so distracting as to make any form of exchange harrowing. She wears a necklace with a symbol of a sewn mouth. She has left her wanderings, which folk appreciated for keeping her distant, to enter this small village. Using gestures, she indicates that she seeks someone else's mouth to sew shut, to please her god. She produces a needle and thread and raises her eyebrows—as if asking.

~ Played by Charlotte

Pirate Base In Asteroid.name:
小行星海盗基地
Pirate Base In Asteroid

Text.text:
小行星的天然岩体上嵌入了粗陋的金属脚手架。满身伤疤淤青、面相粗粝的人们在这些结构与其容纳的飞船间攀爬穿梭；每一艘都由改装零件东拼西凑而成，涂装杂乱、毫无归属。这里的行动看不出半点秩序或章法，只有一种兴高采烈的混乱。
The natural rock of the asteroid has been implanted with crude metallic scaffolding. Rough-looking folks with scars and bruises scramble over the structures and the ships they house, each craft a patchwork of after-market parts and unaffiliated colors. There doesn’t seem to be any order or procedure to the activities, only a gleeful chaos.

风化的石板搭成一座桥，跨越小径与高起的圆形草甸之间的空隙。石缝里长满了植物。尽管如此，它们仍像是很久以前被凿削出来、再层层堆砌成这道通路的。部分石板的表面点缀着一串串磨损的符文。
Weathered stone slabs bridge the gap between the path and the elevated round meadow. Plants grow in their gaps. Still, they look as if they were hewn long ago and piled up to make this crossing. Strings of worn runes decorate some of their faces.

Magical Acid Arrows.name:
魔法酸箭
Magical Acid Arrows

Text.text:
浓稠的绿色黏液从那昆虫般的毒刺倒钩尖端缓缓滴落——这些毒刺正是这致命弹药的箭头。辛辣刺鼻的气味萦绕在这些恶臭箭矢周围，黏稠的胶状物一旦落地，便有缕缕绿色薄烟盘旋升起。箭杆乌黑如甲壳，带着几丁质的冷硬光泽；末端则以天然羽翎收束，分节的甲片外翻成翼——显然出自一位大师工匠之手，将自然嵌入其设计之中。

~ 由 Tate 构想

Thick green ooze drips from the barbed tips of the insectoid stingers that serve as arrowheads for this deadly ammunition. An acrid tang surrounds these noxious arrows, and wispy green smoke spirals upward wherever the viscous goo lands. The black, chitinous shaft of the arrow ends in natural fletching where the segmented plates flare out—clearly the work of a master artisan incorporating nature into their design.

~ Envisioned by Tate

I Lose My Footing During An Earthquake.name:
地震中我脚下一滑，失去平衡
I Lose My Footing During An Earthquake

Text.text:
脚下大地猛然震颤，我的视野摇晃着化作一团混乱的模糊，膝盖软得像果冻般发颤。我向后栽倒，头颅与肩膀重重撞上仍在抖动的地面。身下的泥土在我背后悄然错动，我的头骨一阵钝痛，眼前金星乱舞。
The ground quakes beneath me, my vision wobbling to a chaotic blur as I feel my knees become as weak as jelly. I pitch backward, my head and shoulders smacking against the still trembling earth. I feel the soil shift underneath my body as my skull throbs and stars dance across my eyes.

Outdoor Bazaar Known As High Market.name:
被称作“高市”的露天集市
Outdoor Bazaar Known As High Market

Text.text: [外部] 六根巨大而华丽的花岗岩石柱托举着高悬其上的屋顶——覆以陶瓦，镶着金边，离名为高市集的集市足有三十尺。它矗立在一处抬高的城市广场中央；广场本身又是八条道路的枢纽，宛如车轮的辐条，各自从不同的方位延伸而来。 [内部] 各色货品——本地与异域——从摊位里满溢而出：本地的鸡蛋、家禽与麦酒，与稀罕的葡萄酒、丝绸和珠宝并列。人潮喧嚣如浪，你仍听见一名商贩与潜在买家为香肠的价钱争执不休；旁边两位哲人辩论得忘我，一名不耐烦的制箭匠抱怨他们把顾客都吓跑了。空气里飘着甜腻的香气——一名女子朝每个路过的人喷洒香水样品。 [Outside] Six massive ornate pillars sculpted from granite hold a roof of clay shingles with gold trim thirty feet above the bazaar known as High Market. It stands at the heart of a raised city square, which itself is a hub for eight roads, like spokes on a wagon wheel, each approaching from a different cardinal direction. [Inside] An array of goods—domestic and foreign— overflow the stalls: local eggs, poultry, and ale, along with exotic wine, silk, and jewelry. Over the roaring of the crowd, you hear a merchant disagreeing with a potential purchaser on the value of sausages, while two philosophers debate next to an impatient fletcher who complains they are scaring away patrons. You smell a sweet aroma as a woman sprays samples of perfume at anyone passing by.

一名高挑、苍白的精灵以轻佻的姿态站着，双臂在背后交握，一条腿勾在另一条腿上。他那身不对称的衣装活像个弄臣——满是补丁，颜色杂陈。他从缠在颈间、翻卷如浪的围巾上方发出嘲弄，蓝绿的目光灼灼燃烧，透着不肯退让的好奇。

~ Played by Anniemc

A tall, pale elf stands in a jaunty pose, arms clasped behind his back and one leg hooked about the other. He could be a jester in his mismatched clothing, all patches and of various colors. He jeers from over a billowing scarf wrapped around his neck, his blue-green stare smoldering with unyielding curiosity.

~ Played by Anniemc

光滑抛光的木质弧面嵌着闪耀的宝石与贵金属，工艺之精湛不言自明。抛光蜡的花香怡人——却又若有若无。这把武器轻若鸿毛，却又因英雄命运的重量而沉甸甸。
Arches of smooth, polished wood inlaid with glittering gemstones and precious metals speak to the quality of the craftmanship. The floral scent of the polish is pleasing—yet subtle. This weapon is as light as a feather, yet heavy with the weight of a hero’s destiny.

Simple Pit Trap.name:
简易陷坑陷阱
Simple Pit Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 你谨慎地向前迈出一步，又一步；随即僵在原地——脚掌前端压下去的深度，比预想的更深。你轻轻挪动重心，俯身一看，隐约传来一声吱呀。

[触发！] 咔哒一声，伴随着齿轮般的嗡鸣，你脚下的地板骤然塌陷，沿着一枚古老的铰链翻转敞开，你直直坠入黑暗。突如其来的下落让你头晕目眩，你伸手乱抓，急切想找到借力点，却只摸到光滑湿腻的石壁。陷坑底部飞快迎面扑来。

[Perceived] You take a cautious stride forward, and then another, and then you freeze as the ball of your foot presses further into the floor than expected. There’s a faint creak as you gently shift your weight and look down.

[Triggered!] With a click and a whir, the floor beneath you suddenly gives way, swinging open on an ancient hinge, and you plummet into the darkness. Disoriented by the sudden drop, you reach out, desperate for a handhold, but find only smooth, slick stone. The bottom of the pit trap rises all too quickly to meet you.

Fog-cloaked Graveyard.name:
雾幕笼罩的墓园
Fog-cloaked Graveyard

Text.text:
浓雾遮蔽了地面，松软的泥土在每一次隐匿的脚步下塌陷。墓碑高高探出这层冰冷黏附的帷幕，宛如凄凉的灯塔为你指路。这里不见看守人或园丁的劳作痕迹。草与灌木疯长，藤蔓沿着十字架的基座与天使雕像的足踝攀爬而上。有些墓碑已然断裂，写给亡者的讯息被生生截断，像一口气在喉间戛然而止。
Fog obscures the ground, the pliant earth sinking beneath each hidden footstep. The headstones rise above the cold and clinging veil, acting as bleak beacons to guide you. The efforts of a caretaker or groundskeeper are absent here. The grass and shrubs are overgrown, with vining plants crawling up the pedestals of crosses and the feet of angels. Some headstones are broken, their messages to the dead interrupted, like a breath stopped short.

寂静笼罩着这座小村落，一切井然有序得近乎诡异，却空无一人。屋门大敞着，但除偶尔窜过的野生小兽外，屋内毫无生息。井旁倒着一只木桶，清水泼洒在仍带湿意的泥土上；不远处的炉膛里，灰烬尚温，几粒余烬隐隐发红。更远处，鸡舍里传来一声咯咯的鸡叫，鸡蛋却无人拾取。
Silence reigns over this hamlet, seemingly in perfect order, but utterly devoid of any villagers. Doors hang wide open, but aside from the occasional wild critter there is no life within. A bucket lies beside the well, water spilled out over the still-damp soil, and the ashes in a nearby hearth are warm with a few glowing embers visible. In the distance, a chicken clucks within a coop, its eggs ungathered.

寂静先于喷发。随即，你脚下的大地轰然震颤，震得骨头都在发响。仿佛连地心都发出一声低沉的呻吟，预告着即将到来的爆裂。待轰鸣攀至顶点，间歇泉猛然喷涌，吐出一道滚烫蒸腾的水柱，直冲数百尺高空。水雾如雨，纷纷洒落。
Silence precedes the eruption. Then the ground beneath your feet rumbles, rattling your bones. A groan issues from the earth itself, forecasting the explosion to come. And as the rumbling reaches its zenith, the geyser erupts, discharging a steaming hot pillar of water hundreds of feet into the air.  It rains down in a mist.

踏入这间光线昏暗的酒馆，你立刻想起走进一艘船的舱腹；只消一瞬，你便明白这份相似并非巧合，而是刻意为之。木墙上陈列着来自不同帆船的零件：一只舵、一块刻着某艘沉船船名的木板、一面破烂的三角旗、还有一只舵轮。吧台显然是由两艘改装的救生艇拼制而成，柜台后方的墙上则挂着交叉的船桨。作为酒馆的吉祥物，一尊失去光泽的青铜船首像——一名手持鱼叉的女子——被安放在朴素的木质底座上。
Entering this dimly-lit tavern reminds you of entering the galley of a ship, and it takes you only a second to realize that this similarity is by design. The wooden walls display parts of different sailing vessels: a rudder, a plank featuring the name of a sunken ship, a tattered pennant, a helm’s wheel. The bar has clearly been crafted from two repurposed lifeboats, and crossed oars hang on the wall behind the counter. Serving as a mascot for the tavern, a tarnished bronze figurehead in the shape of a woman holding a harpoon has been mounted on a simple wooden pedestal.

Travelling In A Primal Jungle.name:
在原始丛林中跋涉
Travelling In A Primal Jungle

Text.text:
潮湿的空气黏在你的喉咙上，你拖着步子穿过浓密而腐烂的灌木丛。你的双眼已适应头顶疯长树冠投下的昏暗光照，但在这片原始而残酷的土地上，你早已学会依赖其他感官。你咬紧牙关继续前行，明白在这里迷失的人再也不会被人见到——终将沦为人兽共同的口粮。
The humid air clings to your throat as you trudge through the dense, rotting undergrowth. Your eyes have adjusted to the dim light afforded by the overgrown canopy above, yet you have learned to rely on your other senses in this primal, unforgiving land. You grit your teeth and press onward, knowing that those who lose their way here are never seen again—becoming food for man and beast alike.

这副胸甲上精雕细琢地压印着一颗美杜莎被斩下的头颅。某位技艺绝伦、才华横溢的铁匠还为这图案——以及护甲其余部分——施以黑色珐琅，并点染猩红高光，使得少数钢铁光泽锐利透出的部位更衬得那形象宛如活物。银白的獠牙在群蛇猩红的口中闪烁，而美杜莎血色双眼的瞳孔如镜般明亮，黑色虹膜幽深摄人。
This breastplate has been elaborately embossed with a medusa’s severed head. Some smith of tremendous artistic talent also enameled the design, and the rest of the armor, in black with highlights of red, so that the few places where steel shines brightly through accentuate the lifelike image. Silvery fangs shine in the snakes’ red mouths, and the pupils of the medusa’s blood-colored eyes are mirror-bright with black irises.

Foreboding Mountain Range.name:
令人不祥的山脉
Foreboding Mountain Range

Text.text:
嶙峋的山峰铺展在大地尽头，目力所及皆是；一排排雪覆的獠牙刺入云层，层层叠叠，宛如鲨齿。你徒劳地寻找一条可通行的隘口，可每一道山谷都只把你引向近乎垂直的冰岩峭壁，以及其后更高、更冷峻的下一道屏障的寄望。
Jagged peaks sprawl across the landscape as far as the eye can see, thrusting snow-dusted teeth up into the clouds in row upon row like a shark’s teeth. You look in vain for some passage, but every valley seems to lead up to a nearly sheer wall of icy stone and promise of another even higher wall behind it.

Warning About A Journey Into The Unknown.name:
踏入未知之旅的警告
Warning About A Journey Into The Unknown

Text.text:
“你看起来……满怀希望。那倒也好，我想——但光靠这个你活不下去。这样的旅程，会把你的希望摔得开裂、瘦得只剩骨头，丢在现实风化的台阶上。”
“You seem… hopeful. That is good, I suppose, but you will need more than that to survive. A journey like this will leave your hopes cracked and emaciated on the weathered steps of reality.”

Threat From A Pack Of Tiny Creatures.name:
来自一群微小生物的威胁
Threat From A Pack Of Tiny Creatures

Text.text:
“我们看起来也许不怎么样，但凑在一起，我们宰过比你这种货色更大、更凶的家伙……想想看，还把它们也吃了。”
“We may not look like much, but together we’ve killed things bigger and nastier than the likes of you… Ate them too, now that I think about it.”

Bored Noble Warrior.name:
百无聊赖的贵族武士
Bored Noble Warrior

Text.text:
眼神如极地冰晶般冷冽，懒散地在厅室间游移，她却只能耐着性子，再一次听完那冗长的演说。思绪早已飘向下方尘土飞扬的练武场——想起木桩与稻草人被她打得恰到好处时，那一声令人满足的闷响。铂金色的金发被精心编成一条无瑕的长辫，优雅地垂过肩头；华贵的礼裙紧贴她纤细的身形。她是温婉端雅的化身——可她心底渴望的，却是钢铁交击的震响。

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

Eyes the crystalline hue of polar ice listlessly meander around the room as the woman endures yet another speech.
