Her mind drifts to visions of the dusty practice yard below and the satisfying thump when she strikes the training dummies just right. Platinum blond hair, styled in a pristine braid, curls elegantly over her shoulder and a luxurious dress clings to her petite frame. She is the picture of demure elegance—yet she longs for the clash of steel.

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

Ice Dart Trap.name:
冰矢陷阱
Ice Dart Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 小径两侧的雪堤结构出奇地整齐，仿佛那层松软的白色表象之下埋着什么。你注意到，两堤之间覆雪的小径上，有一道狭窄的沟槽。

[发现] 你拂开积雪，发现小径两侧藏着隐秘的纪念碑。短柱上雕刻着狰狞猛兽，刻纹中流淌着幽光的符文——而那些兽首的眼眶处竟凿有孔洞。那道狭窄的沟槽则掩着一排同样发光的符文，横贯小径。

[触发] 当你从两堤之间穿过，一声轻柔的thwump预告般响起，冰冷的飞镖自雪堤中猛然喷射而出——你浑然不觉地惊动了脚下石面所刻的守护符文。

[Perceived] The snowbanks at either side of the path seem strangely uniform in structure, as if there is something beneath their powdery white façade. You notice a narrow channel in the snow blanketing the path between them.

[Discovered] Brushing the snow away, you discover hidden monuments flanking the path. Carved to depict fearsome beasts, the short columns bear glowing runes—and holes in the creatures’ eyes. The narrow channel conceals a line of similarly glowing runes across the path.

[Triggered] A soft thwump heralds the eruption of icy darts from the snowbanks as you pass between them, unwittingly disturbing the warding runes etched into the stones beneath you.

I Use My Ring Of Djinni Summoning.name:
我动用召唤精灵的迪吉尼戒指
I Use My Ring Of Djinni Summoning

Text.text:
我一拳挥向空中，蓝白色的能量旋风随之将我包裹。旋流愈发强劲，升至我头顶上方，飞旋不止，直到以一道巫术般的闪光轰然迸裂。原处现身一名巨灵，皮肤蓝得如同无云的晴空。他手持一对骇人的弯刀，眼中寒光一闪，分明迫不及待要挥刀出鞘。
I punch my fist into the air and a whirlwind of blue-white energy surrounds me. The whirl increases in strength and rises above my head, spinning until it bursts with a sorcerous flash. A djinni appears in its place, skin blue as a cloudless sky. He wields a fearsome set of scimitars and the glint in his eyes suggests he's eager to use them.

那年轻人身着朴素的灰色长袍，头侧剃得极短——这两点都昭示着他的教团身份。然而，他脸上的酸涩神情与耷拉的站姿却让你怀疑：在虔诚的宗教奉献里，他并未寻得多少慰藉。
The young man wears simple gray robes, and the sides of his head have been shaved close; both of these denote his religious order. And yet, from the sour look on his face and his slouched posture, you suspect he hasn't found much succor in religious devotion.

这名生物乍看像人类，但只要再多端详一眼，便会立刻打消这种念头。它的双臂笔直伸在身前，僵硬如木，肘关节死死锁住。这个姿势将它那乌亮漆黑的指甲彻底暴露出来——每一枚都足有数寸长，末端收成阴毒的尖点。一绺蓬乱的白发垂落在它干枯的面孔周围，与它脖颈上向上蔓延的病态绿霉形成刺眼对比。
The creature appears human at first glance, but closer inspection quickly dissuades one of this notion. Their arms stick out straight in front of them, rigid and locked at the elbows. The pose puts their shining black fingernails on display, each several inches long and ending in a wicked point. A shock of white hair falls around their desiccated face, contrasting the sickly green mold creeping up their neck.

那生物从你面前的地面破土而出，先以幽影般的形态显现，旋即凝成实质。它顶多算半真半幻，外形却如骏马般分明；这头庞然大物以耐心而顺从的目光看着你。它已备好鞍具、嚼子与缰绳，俨然随时可供骑乘。
The creature emerges from the ground before you, manifesting in a spectral form before taking solid shape. Quasi-real at best, horselike in appearance, the large beast regards you patiently, subserviently. Equipped with a saddle, bit, and bridle, the creature appears fit for riding.

幻象魔法通常在眼中或心里编织影像。它用更响亮的谎言压住真相的声音。让某物“消失”的幻象往往更难维持。隐形是不言自明的谎，更难让人信服，尤其当其他感官都在提醒观察者：那里本该有某种真实可见之物。将这些矛盾牢牢记住，你便完成了法术。
Illusion magic typically creates images in the eye or the mind. It silences truth by pronouncing a louder lie. The illusion that makes something vanish often proves harder to sustain. Invisibility is the unspoken lie, much more difficult to keep convincing, especially when every other sense tells an observer some truth should be there to be seen. By keeping these contradictions in mind, you complete the spell.

Lycanthrope And Fiend In Hellish Combat.name:
地狱般的恶战：狼人对垒邪魔
Lycanthrope And Fiend In Hellish Combat

Text.text:
干燥的狂风掠过那台地狱机器顶上的缠斗身影，车体轰鸣着碾过炼狱般的荒原，引擎由受诅咒者的尖啸灵魂驱动。狼人骑士发出雷霆般的低吼，猛然扑向那恶魔般的对手，将两人一并掀出车外；龟裂的赤红大地迎面疾冲而来。他们坠地时发出扭曲的嘶吼，疼痛的肺腔被硬生生挤出空气，却仍旧用牙与爪撕扯彼此——全然不觉那辆巨型地狱战车正以夺命的速度朝他们失控狂飙而来。

~ 构想：ThunderWolf

The dry wind whips past the brawling figures atop the hellish machine as it thunders across the infernal landscape, powered by the shrieking souls of the damned. Letting out a thunderous snarl the lupine knight pounces on their fiendish adversary, bearing both combatants overboard, and the cracked, red earth rushes up to meet them. Landing with a tortured bellow, air driven sharply from aching lungs, the pair continue to tear at each other with tooth and claw—oblivious to the titanic hell-wagon careening toward them at break-neck speed.

~ Envisioned by ThunderWolf

幻术是最诡奇的魔法学派之一，哪怕对钻研最久的施法者而言也近乎奇迹。就比如这道法术：你无需洞悉所召来影像的每一处细节，只需把握那份印象，余下便交由魔法完成。它会织出你从未设想的细部，却在你看见的瞬间显得无比贴切。
Illusion is one of the strangest schools of magic, miraculous even to its longest practitioners. This spell, for example. You need not know every detail of the image you summon, merely the impression, and the magic does the rest. It creates details you would never imagine but that seem perfect the moment you see them.

Brass Buckle For A Wide Belt.name:
宽腰带用黄铜带扣
Brass Buckle For A Wide Belt

Text.text:
黄铜被擦得锃亮，扣框是一枚修长的椭圆，中央有根粗重的横杆与腰带中间的带扣连接，而非横跨整条带面。这种扣头像是城里商贩或小贵族日常出门会佩戴的款式。
The brass is polished to a high shine, the frame a long oval with a heavy bar that connects to a strap at the center of the belt, rather than the full width of it. The buckle is the sort a shopkeeper or minor noble might wear around town.

Fretful Government Agent.name:
焦躁的政府特工
Fretful Government Agent

Text.text:
她整个人仿佛陷在焦灼的移动里：重心不停变换，双手绞在一起，脖子像装了转轴般四下转动。她那套政府制式西装被这持续的折腾揉得皱巴巴的，马尾也散出许多碎发。你不禁想，她还有多少别的紧张小动作。
Her entire body seems to be in a state of anxious motion: weight shifting, hands wringing, neck on a swivel. Her government-regulation suit is wrinkled from the constant movement, and her ponytail has many loose strands. You wonder how many other nervous tics she has.

一大片沥青般的飞溅物糊满了墙面与地板，黏稠的黑浆甚至贴在垂直的墙上不坠。你正看着，那团黑色黏液的上缘缓缓剥离，慢慢向下滴落，使地上的污池不断扩张、流淌……朝着你？你猛然意识到，这团渗流之物是活的；尽管你看不出它有任何眼睛或器官，它却知道你在哪里。
A splatter of tar covers a wide swath of wall and floor, its gooey mass sticking to the vertical surface. As you watch, the top edge of the black slime peels away and slowly drips down, causing the pool on the floor to grow and flow… toward you? You realize with a start that the ooze is a living thing, and, despite having no eyes or organs of any kind you can discern, it knows where you are.

你探出手，五指如爪般扣起。一股渗人的寒意自你体内漫出，战栗沿着脊背直窜；在你面前，一只幽影般的骷髅手凝聚成形——动作与你分毫不差。它探向你的目标，待一把抓牢，便将拳头收紧，以死亡般铁钳似的握力死死攥住那生物。
You reach out, your hand held like a claw. A seeping cold emanates from you as a shiver runs up your spine, and a spectral, skeletal hand—identical in its movements to yours—coalesces before you. It grabs for your target, and upon making purchase, closes its fist around the creature with the vice-like grip of death.

I Cast Move Earth.name:
我施放「移土术」
I Cast Move Earth

Text.text:
我以纯粹的意志扭转并塑形大地——每一粒碎土、沙砾、壤土都像流水般顺滑流动。舌尖绽开一抹咸涩的刺痛，鼻腔里新翻泥土的气息清亮鲜明。这片大地充满潜能。无论我如何、在何处下令，它都如魔宠般驯顺，俯首听命。
I shift and mold the earth with sheer will—every crumble of dirt, sand, loam moving as fluidly as water. The sting of salt blooms on my tongue and the scent of freshly turned soil is bright in my nose. This earth is rife with potential. Wherever and however I command it, it obeys as obediently as a familiar.

你一路追随而来的那阵诡异而遥远的口哨声骤然拔高，旋即戛然而止。你原以为能瞥见一线阳光，吸上一口新鲜空气，甚至找到一条出口。可迎接你的却是另一座洞窟，起初看似空无一物——直到岩石开始蠕动。你面前的洞壁崩裂坍塌，剥落散开，露出一头庞大、多足的生物轮廓：钳爪咔嚓开合，颚齿咯咯作响。那来自异界的口哨声再度响起，伴随着生物沉重地拖拽着自己向前推进；直到此刻，你才真正看清它的全貌——巨大得根本无法从旁绕过。
The strange, distant whistling you followed here grows louder for a moment, then falls silent. You had hoped to find some glimpse of sunlight, a breath of fresh air, or even an exit. Instead, you find another cavern, which at first appears unoccupied—until the rocks shift. The cave wall before you crumbles, detaching and revealing the shape of a massive, multi-legged creature with snapping pincers and clicking mandibles. The otherworldly whistling resumes as the creature heaves itself forward, and you finally take in its full immensity, too large to skirt past.

I Inspect Precious Gems.name:
我检视珍贵宝石
I Inspect Precious Gems

Text.text:
我拾起那只可靠的放大镜——我熟得不能再熟的那枚小镜片——俯身检视第一块石头。内含物像指纹般独一无二，澄澈与细微纹理都在暗示它的来处。红宝石，刚玉。下一块是蓝宝石，简直迥然不同，凝视其中就像初见一个新人。数据在我脑海里悄然汇聚——纯净与通透，体型与重量，以及这些宝石折算成钱币时的价值。
I pick up my trusty loupe, that little lens I know so well, and examine the first stone. The inclusions are like a fingerprint, the clarity and fine details providing an indication of where it came from. A ruby, corundum. The next, a sapphire, couldn’t be more different, and looking into one is like meeting a new person. The data collects in my mind—purity and clarity, size and weight, and the value of these gems in coin.

随着你轻声一语，你的法术以炽烈光辉点亮你的目标，以令人安心的笃定驱散黑暗。你唇边浮起一抹微笑，凝望着自己的造物，为那灼灼辉煌而心满意足。
With a soft word, your spell illuminates your target in blazing light, banishing the darkness with reassuring certainty. A smile graces your lips as you behold your creation, satisfied with its radiant brilliance.

Divine Home Of A Goddess Of Magic.name:
魔法女神的神圣居所
Divine Home Of A Goddess Of Magic

Text.text:
正如人们所料，这是一座由异样石材砌成的圆柱形高塔；书架、陈列架与柜匣之间，暗藏着一间间密室与修道院式的独立书写隔间。底层是一圈白色大理石地面，刻绘着天文秘奥的符纹与彩绘。沿着弧形楼梯向上，依次是温室、书房、观星台——它们环绕着实验室群，里面安置着炼金试验所需的每一件器具。有一间房宛如卷轴的鸽舍，卷起的纸页与兽皮像羽毛般从格槽里刺出。寝室被设计成可让人沉入深沉而奢华的睡眠。所有的椅子都坐着不舒服。
As one might expect, this is a cylindrical tower of unusual stone, with chambers and monastic carrels hidden among the bookshelves, stands, and cases. Its ground floor is a circle of white marble etched and painted in astronomical arcana. Up the curving staircases, a conservatory, then a study, then an observatory, all surrounding laboratories that house every device of alchemical experimentation. One room looks like a dovecote of scrolls, the rolled papers and skins like feathers bristling out of the compartments. The bedchambers are designed for a deep, luxuriant sleep. All of the chairs are uncomfortable.

Sleuth Sprite.name:
侦探小妖精（特征）
Sleuth Sprite

Text.text:
小妖精（特征）在视野中起伏涌动，疯狂旋转着几何碎片、数字与曲线——它们渐渐汇拢，拼合成一只亮青色的长身猎犬，步态松长。狗抖了抖身子，耷拉的耳朵上下拍打，数据碎片如闪烁的露珠般簌簌剥落。那张和气的皱脸像故障的灯光般忽明忽灭，露出一颗紫色、嗡鸣震颤的犬类头骨。它把鼻尖贴向赛博空间的织面，漫不经心的垂嘴皮在一抹阴森的骷髅笑容上方时隐时现。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The sprite undulates as it comes into view, wildly spinning pieces of geometry, and numbers, and curves—gradually uniting them to take on the long, loping form of a bloodhound cast in bright teal. The dog shakes its body, drooping ears flopping up and down, shards of data sloughing off in sparkling droplets. The affable, wrinkled face flickers like lights on the fritz, revealing a purple and thrumming canine skull. It presses its nose against the fabric of cyberspace, its ho-hum jowls disappearing and reappearing over a grim, skeletal smile.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Adelaide \"Addy\" Walker.name:
阿德莱德“艾迪”·沃克
Adelaide "Addy" Walker

Text.text:
一名凶悍的女人高高伫立在你面前。一阵非自然的狂风在她脸侧抽打，黑发如暴风中的怒海般狂乱翻涌。暗色的血管像蠕虫般从她的肩头一路爬向手腕。她屈伸双手，墨色能量的丝缕随之流淌、缠结，最终凝成一柄武器的形态：一把巨大的巨斧，仿佛由阴影锻造而成。

~ 由 Redtail 扮演

A fierce woman stands tall before you. An unnatural wind whips about her face, her black hair wild as the sea in a storm. Dark veins worm their way from her shoulders to her wrists. She flexes her hands and threads of inky energy flow, coalescing into the form of a weapon: a massive greataxe that seems to be forged from shadow.

~ Played by Redtail

Deck Of Illusions.name:
幻象牌组
Deck Of Illusions

Text.text:
当你开始洗那叠约三十张的卡牌时，甲板上陈年羊皮纸的气味沉沉涌起。随着每一次移动，你都能感觉到一阵细微的能量脉动，仿佛不断向前奔涌，直到你终于抽出一张牌。牌面幽光流转，遮蔽着结果，直至你将其掷下——它随即投射出一幅幻象。
The smell of aged parchment wafts heavily from the deck as you begin to shuffle the stack of roughly thirty cards. With each movement, you feel a small pulsation of energy that seems to surge forward until finally you select a card. The card's face glows, obscuring the result until you cast it down and it projects an illusion.

Fault Sprite.name:
故障小妖精（特征）
Fault Sprite

Text.text:
你的故障小妖精（特征）占据着一张球形数据网格，在其中它看起来像一只黑寡妇般的 ICE 蜘蛛。它分节的每条腿都是带锯齿的刀刃，挥斩时在球体表面划出一弧弧二进制代码的残光：攻击向量与结果。每次斩击后，这些残影都会迅速褪去。它获胜时，蜘蛛会得意地扭动屁股。它被击败时，躯干先行消失，腿却像落下的长剑般坠落，随后也一并消散。

~ 一位英雄构想

Your fault sprite occupies a spherical data mesh, inside of which it looks like a black widow ICE spider. Each sectioned leg is a serrated blade that slashes, leaving swing arcs of binary code along the sphere: attack vectors and results. These fade out after each strike. When it wins, the spider wiggles its butt. When it is defeated, the body disappears and the legs fall like swords before they also disappear.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

一股难以言喻的优雅缠绕着这位轻盈舞者的流转身姿；每一次挥洒都既有明确的意图，又带着近乎失序的狂放。及肩的栗色长发在她翻滚、旋转、腾身而起时倾泻向前，随即露出耳尖那几乎不易察觉的微微尖起——也许是精灵传承，这无疑为这位表演者添上了不老的气韵。她那磨得发旧的皮革护甲，以及腰侧那柄纹饰华美的手斧，都与她看似稚嫩的天真相悖。或许这些优雅的弧线与细微的手势，伴随的不只是舞步，还有钢铁与秘法。

~ 由一位英雄 Played

An uncanny grace accompanies the lithe dancer’s fluid movements, each flourish simultaneously purposeful and chaotic. Shoulder-length brunette hair spills forward as she tumbles, rolls, and springs upward, revealing a subtle point to her ears—elven heritage perhaps, which no doubt adds to this performer’s ageless bearing. Her well-worn leather armor, as well as the ornate-looking handaxe at her hip, belies her youthful innocence. Perhaps these graceful arcs and subtle gestures accompany not just the dance but also steel and sorcery.

~ Played by a Hero

Quip About Forgetting Something.name:
关于忘了点什么的打趣
Quip About Forgetting Something

Text.text:
“我总觉得我们忘了点什么。钥匙？地图？还是……在我们为了责任那冰冷残酷的焦虑，牺牲掉青春的理想主义之前，曾经的自己？啊，不对——是钥匙。就在我口袋里。”
“I feel as though we’ve forgotten something. Keys? A map? The people we used to be before we sacrificed our youthful idealism for the cold, cruel anxiety of responsibility? Ah, nope—it was a key. It’s in my pocket.”

I Cast Enhance Ability To Bestow Bear's.name:
我施放“强化能力”，赐予“熊之耐力”
I Cast Enhance Ability To Bestow Bear's Endurance

Text.text:
我一边吟诵咒文，一边攥紧那撮粗硬的毛，原始而蛮荒的能量在体内翻涌。远处传来熊的呼唤，我感到熊一般的强健与旺盛的生命力奔流而入，随着我赐予“熊之坚韧”。
A raw, primal energy fills me as I chant the incantation, holding the tuft of coarse fur. I hear the distant call of the bear and feel the robust sensation of ursine vigor and health flow through me as I bestow Bear’s Endurance.

Loot From A High Elf Warlord.name:
高等精灵军阀的战利品
Loot From A High Elf Warlord

Text.text:
军阀只在一个小钱袋里带着50枚金币，但他收集来的手镯、额环、项链以及各式扣饰，价值至少有2000枚金币。
The warlord carries only 50 gold pieces in a small pouch, but the bracelets, circlet, necklace, and various buckles collected are worth at least 2000 gold pieces.

一个兜帽身影拖着步子朝你逼近，佝偻的姿态宛如虔诚奴仆的化身。他裹在朴素的长袍里，衣褶垂坠，满是信仰的符印；他用发黑的牙齿含糊地咕哝着祷词。那双泪水浑浊的眼睛——忽眨忽眨，像两汪不移的虔敬——努力想把焦点落在你身上。他紧攥着圣徽，朝你大致的方向挥动，仿佛在驱邪——又像是在赐福。究竟是哪一种，谁也说不清。
Shuffling toward you comes a hooded figure, their crooked stance a picture of devout servitude. They are swathed in humble robes that drip with symbols of their faith, and they mumble prayers through blackened teeth. Rheumy eyes—blinking pools of unwavering devotion—attempt to focus upon you. Clutching their holy symbol, they wave it in your general direction, as if warding off evil—or giving a blessing. It is not clear which.

掠食性苍蝇向来只是探险者的烦扰，从不算真正的威胁。可你眼前这只，正在挑战这条“常识”。它比寻常标本大出不止一星半点，闪烁的翅膜震颤嗡鸣，像超频电动工具般尖利刺耳。它躯体的几丁质节片镶嵌着异星晶体，而胸部末端更伸出一根又长又凶的毒刺，带着威胁般的抽动。
Predatory flies have long been a nuisance to explorers, but never a true threat. The one before you challenges that truism. Larger than the average specimen by some measure, its shimmering wings buzz with the whine of an overclocked power tool. The chitinous segments of its body are inlaid with alien crystals, and a long and vicious stinger protrudes from the end of its thorax, twitching with menace.

Narrow Escape From A Pit Trap.name:
险从坑陷阱中脱身
Narrow Escape From A Pit Trap

Text.text:
你下一步踏入的是一片空无的空间。你向前翻滚坠落，胃里一阵发飘发酸，余下的身躯却像铅块般直直下沉。你来不及思考，手已猛地向上探去，死死抓住深渊的边缘。你咬牙把自己往上拽时，远处传来回声般空洞的哐啷声——你身上的一件物品坠入下方极深处，撞地作响。
Your next step is into empty space. You tumble forward and feel your stomach float queasily as the rest of your body drops like a lead weight. Without thinking, your hand shoots upward and grasps the edge of the chasm. As you pull yourself up, you hear the distant, echoing clatter of one of your items hitting the ground far below.

Gabriel The Swashbuckler.name:
加布里埃尔，“侠盗剑客”
Gabriel The Swashbuckler

Text.text:
海蓝偏绿的俊眼之下，黑发男人那张干净利落的脸只被唇上一道疤打破。可不论目光落向何处，他都挂着一抹冷静从容的微笑。他活像一幅张扬吟游诗人的画：长款皮大衣披身，黑裤塞进高筒靴里。白色亚麻衬衫遮住了几道明显来自刀剑交锋的伤疤边缘。领口之上，一只章鱼纹身以触腕缠绕着他的脖颈。

~ Played by Eric L

Below handsome sea-green eyes and black hair, the man’s pristine mug is broken only by his lip bearing a scar. But no matter where his gaze falls, he wears a cool, relaxed smile. He is the very painting of a swaggering bard, complete with long leather coat and black pants bloused into high boots. His shirt is white linen, concealing the edges of some scars that are clearly from sword fights. Above the collar, an octopus tattoo wraps its tentacles around his neck.

~ Played by Eric L

Canyon On A Mined-out Asteroid.name:
被采掘殆尽的小行星峡谷
Canyon On A Mined-out Asteroid

Text.text:
曾经繁盛的采矿作业残骸，填满了这座小行星被烈日炙烤的岩层中那道巨大而参差的峡谷。注定要在被遗忘的空间深处度过永恒，工业机器静默伫立，早已停转，它们的用途也在久远之前便已熄灭。
The remnants of a once-prosperous mining operation fill the vast, ragged canyon in the sun-blasted rock of the asteroid. Doomed to spend eternity in the forgotten depths of space, the industrial machines stand idle, their purpose long since extinguished.

Lament Of A Bloody Warlord.name:
血腥军阀的哀歌
Lament Of A Bloody Warlord

Text.text:
“我一路撕裂无数同袍的身躯才爬到这里。然而，当我坐在这座由他们尸骸堆砌而成的王座上时，却只觉索然无味。一种悄然滋长的恐惧在我心底扎根：从鲜血里榨出的欢愉，转瞬即逝。”
“I have ripped my way through many of my fellow warriors to get where I am. Yet, as I sit on this throne built atop their bodies, I find myself dissatisfied. A creeping fear has taken root in my heart: that joy is fleeting when it’s drawn from blood.”

I Cast Comprehend Languages From My Staf.name:
我从魅惑法杖中施放“通晓语言”
I Cast Comprehend Languages From My Staff Of Charming

Text.text:
那些话语忽然对我而言清晰透彻，而我的法杖泛起光辉，将我伙伴的语言一一译出。法杖在我掌心里温热，轻柔而有节律地脉动着，引导着魔法；它以令人愉悦的洋红色能量光束环绕着我。
The words suddenly make perfect sense to me, and my staff glows as it translates the language of my companions. The staff is warm in my hand as it channels the magic in a gentle, rhythmic pulse; it surrounds me in pleasing rays of magenta energy.

Victorian Carriage Transforms.name:
维多利亚式马车变形
Victorian Carriage Transforms

Text.text:
伴随着一声气动般的嘶鸣，蒸汽从马车底盘喷涌而出，一场最离奇的蜕变随之发生。锃亮的黄铜车轴延展、扭转，化作四肢；车厢的骨架也随之重塑，渐渐扭出一个略具人形的轮廓。驾驶座两侧的提灯彼此靠拢——并在合拢间再次明灭点亮——化作一张由抛光木料与金属构成的机械面孔的双眼，头顶还端端正正戴着一顶潇洒的高礼帽。

~ MaesterAelix 于 Discord

With a pneumatic hiss, steam jets from the chassis of the carriage, and a most curious transformation takes place. Shiny brass axles lengthen and twist to form limbs as the structure of the carriage morphs into a vaguely humanoid shape. The lanterns set at either side of the driver's seat move together—and flicker to life—as they form the eyes of a mechanical face of polished wood and metal, complete with a dashing top hat.

~ MaesterAelix on Discord

Eye Of Trap Seek.name:
陷阱探寻之眼
Eye Of Trap Seek

Text.text:
你掌心里那颗小小的球形物体表面，刻着一串怪异、棱角分明的符号。你在指间将它翻转，才意识到这是一只玻璃眼。那精雕细琢的虹膜——连巩膜都一并刻出——出自工匠大师之手；它内部涌动着不寻常的磷光能量波纹，随之脉动，使那些符号也一同亮起。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Strange, angular symbols are carved into the surface of the small spherical object in your palm. Turning it over in your hand, you realize it is a glass eye. The delicately engraved iris—complete with sclera—is the work of a master artisan, and it pulses with internal waves of unusual phosphorescent energy, causing the symbols to glow.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

I Cover Myself In An Oil Of Slipperiness.name:
我用滑溜溜的油脂涂满全身
I Cover Myself In An Oil Of Slipperiness

Text.text:
我把容器举到头顶上方，微微倾斜，便听见一声“咕啵”的吸吮声。黏稠沉重的油团慢慢落下，先在我头顶停了一瞬，随即铺展开来，淌过耳廓与颈侧，最后将我整个人裹住。花了十分钟，我才把油细细抹匀，让它彻底覆盖全身。光是双手相互摩擦的触感，就足够告诉我——今天没人能拦得住我。
When I hold the container above me and tip it, I can hear a sucking sound. A slow, heavy blob of fluid sits for a moment on my head and spreads over it, down my ears and neck, and eventually covers me. It takes ten minutes for me to spread the oil so it coats me entirely. Just rubbing my hands together tells me no one’s going to be stopping me today.

凿痕在这条隧道的墙壁、顶棚与地面上纵横交错。它低矮得几乎只够一头驴勉强穿行，沿着缓缓的下坡蜿蜒而下，显然是在追随岩层中矿脉的走向。一小团被压扁的金属映入眼帘——那是一只锡制烛台皱碎的残骸，被什么沉重的脚步碾成了薄片。
Chisel marks scar the walls, ceiling, and floor of this tunnel. Barely tall enough for a donkey to walk through, it wends downward on a shallow slope, no doubt following the seam of ore in the rock. A crushed bit of metal catches your eye—the crumpled remains of a tin candlestick flattened by something’s heavy tread.

Monastery To A Goddess Of Elemental Air.name:
元素空气女神修道院
Monastery To A Goddess Of Elemental Air

Text.text: [外面] 崎岖的崖道既美得惊心动魄，也艰险得令人窒息。群山绵延，覆着霜意的高寒奇景处处涌动；可凛冽冷风却像刀锋般在你脸上来回划掠，拍击着你的身躯，几乎要把你推向小径边缘——那一侧豁然张开，直坠入下方林海幽谷。你又翻过一段斜坡，终于望见一座修道院：入口是山体上天然裂开的巨口。几位僧人身披单薄的灰袍，盘坐在殿外入定，对寒意浑然不觉。 [里面] 一名白发如丝絮飘散的向导引你穿过阴影沉沉的门槛。这座修道院大半都是天然洞窟，人工添置的不过是几张给年迈僧人用的软垫座，还有几串悬挂的风铃——以兽骨与金属细杆制成。风穿洞而过，细薄的声线在铃间闪烁作响。你呼出的气息凝成白雾，跟着向导更深入这处所在的核心：一位长须僧人双目泛白，正静坐入定。他的脸、胸与双臂上绘着白与灰的纹身，蜿蜒盘旋，如风流回旋、拖曳而去的轨迹。 [Outside] The rocky cliffside path has proven breathtaking in both its beauty and arduousness. The mountain range teems with frosty alpine wonder, but the frigid air dances in biting slashes across your face, buffeting your body to tip you ever so slightly to the side of the path that yawns into the forested vale below. You crest yet another incline and finally see a monastery, its entrance a natural gape in the mountainside. Monks in thin gray robes sit in meditative poses outside the temple, unbothered by the chill. [Inside] A guide with wisping white hair leads you through the looming threshold. This monastery is mostly a natural cave, the only additions being a few cushioned seats for older monks and hanging chimes crafted of animal bone and rods of metal. The wind passes through the cave, its thin voice twinkling through the chimes. Your breath clouds as you follow your guide deeper into the heart of the place, where a monk with a long beard sits in white-eyed meditation. He is decorated with white and gray tattoos of spiraling and trailing wind currents on his face, chest, and arms.

新生的矮人看起来与许多新生的人形生物无异——只是他们的骨架更为敦实，四肢更为粗壮，脸颊与下巴上还零星冒出些许绒毛。他们不哭，也不乱挥手脚——他们在怒视。他们在阴沉地凝思。浓密黝黑的眉毛紧紧拧作一团，额头深深蹙起。
The newborn dwarf appears as many newborn humanoids do—except for the stoutness of their frame, the thickness of their limbs, and the smattering of hair growth on their cheeks and chin. They do not cry, nor do they flail—they glower. They brood. Their thick, dark brows knit together, their forehead furrowing.

Meeting An Ancient Aboleth.name:
邂逅远古夺心魔
Meeting An Ancient Aboleth

Text.text:
一个庞然巨影缓缓自水面升起，体型大得超出你所能想象的任何生物。它那似水蛭的面孔上，三只墨黑的眼睛层层叠起，俯在一张无颌的口器之上，口中尽是锯齿般的利牙。布满倒刺的长触须从它体内脱离、舒展并盘旋开来——其中一根比其余更长，末端竟拖着一条鱼尾。它在水中游弋毫不费力，随即垂下目光，直直望进你的眼里，那古老的存在感如潮压来，令你几近窒息。
A massive shape rises slowly from the water's surface, larger than any creature you had thought possible. The leech-like face has three inky black eyes stacked above a jawless mouth filled with serrated teeth. Long tentacles, lined with barbs, detach and uncoil from its body—one, longer than the rest, ends in a fish tail. It navigates through the waters effortlessly and lowers its gaze to look directly into your eyes, overwhelming you with its ancient presence.

当你以毫不费力的优雅将它自剑鞘中抽出时，剑刃泛起诡异的磷光，以清冷的蓝光照亮你的手。长剑的重心完美无瑕——显然出自大师之手——你挥动它划破空气时，它仿佛成了你身体的延伸，你沉醉于那行云流水般的动作之中。
As you slide it free of the scabbard, with effortless grace, the blade takes on a strange phosphorescence, illuminating your hand with cool, blue light. The balance of the sword is perfect—clearly the work of a master—and feels like an extension of your body as you swing it through the air, savoring the fluid motions.

Instant-capture Grenade.name:
瞬时捕获手雷
Instant-capture Grenade

Text.text:
[隐蔽] 一个黑色聚合物盒中收纳着数枚柔和发亮的金属球体，盒身点缀橙色警示灯。每颗球体都带着交叉网格般的刻痕，仿佛被高能激光划过；但细看之下，这些球其实是由某种内部技术拼合的独立分段。它们显然为投掷而生，分段似乎会在空中裂解，但具体效果尚不明朗。

[已激活] 它划破空气的弧线中，交叉刻痕的球体短促迸出一抹幽蓝电光，随即数道猩红的锁定激光咬住即将落网的身影。球体在空中变向折返，被牵引着掠向目标，继而骤然分裂——十二枚闪烁的银色碎片向外爆散。它们盘旋环绕 目标，悬停于空，仿佛将其困在正中央。下一瞬，耀眼的蓝光从碎片间抽射相连，把猎物缠入一张无处可逃的激光之网。

[Concealed] Several soft metallic spheres are housed in a black polymer case marked with orange warning lights. They all bear crosshatch markings like they’ve been scored with a high-powered laser, but on closer inspection, the spheres are actually individual segments held together by some internal technology. Clearly designed to be thrown, the segments look to split apart, though the desired effect is unclear.

[Activated] As it arcs through the air, the crosshatched sphere fizzles with a brief blue light before several scarlet targeting lasers lock onto the soon-to-be-captured figure. The sphere banks in the air, drawn toward the goal, then splits apart—twelve separate sparkling silver fragments bursting outward. They circle to surround the target, hovering, suspended in the air. Then lights of bright blue lash fragment to fragment, entrapping the quarry in a web of inescapable lasers.

Snowball Fight After Horrific Encounter.name:
恐怖遭遇后的雪球大战
Snowball Fight After Horrific Encounter

Text.text:
双手仍在颤抖，你把雪用力揉搓、压紧，捏成一枚密实的雪团——拼命想把过去几个小时的骇人景象从脑海里抹去。忽然，一颗雪球在你背上炸开，雪沫四散，把你从恍惚中硬生生拽回现实。你看见同伴咧嘴坏笑，眼里尽是淘气的光，便也回敬般甩出自己的“炮弹”。大约一个小时在相对轻快的胡闹中溜走；可转眼间，就又到了清点口粮、勒紧背包、继续向冰封的北境跋涉的时刻。

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl

Hands still shaking, you pack the snow into a dense ball—desperate to forget the horror of the last few hours. A snowball explodes in a flurry against your back, forcing you from your stupor. You see your companion grinning mischievously and loose your own projectile in response. An hour or so passes in relative frivolity; but all too soon it is time to count the rations, cinch your pack, and press on into the frozen north.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl

一张由银白金属精巧织就的蛛网状格栅，低低拱覆在一具乌黑大理石棺上方；棺身抛光得如镜般发亮。格栅牢牢系在大理石立柱之间，而在格栅顶端，同样以那银白金属铸成的蜘蛛雕像巍然蹲伏，体型竟与一只猫不相上下。它的螯肢间垂下一条细细的金链——穿过格栅——链端悬着一颗殷红宝石，足有拇指般粗。
A lattice of silvery-white metal, artfully crafted in the shape of a spiderweb, arcs low over a sarcophagus of black marble polished to a high sheen. The lattice is moored to marble posts, and atop it, made of the same metal, stands a sculpture of a spider as big as a cat. From its mandibles dangles a thin gold chain—through the lattice—at the end of which hangs a red gem as thick as a thumb.

Barrow Of A Hill Giant.name:
山丘巨人的古冢
Barrow Of A Hill Giant

Text.text:
孤丘独立，方圆数里尽在其阴影之下；其体型与尺度之宏阔，令人屏息。土丘下方一道高耸的洞口敞开着，容人踏入其腹；一条如商道般宽阔的斜坡廊道引人向下，义无反顾地沉入前方的黑暗之中。
The lone hill dominates the landscape for miles around, its size and scale breathtaking in its vastness. A towering opening allows entry below the earthen mound, leading to a sloped corridor as wide as a trade road, which descends inexorably into the darkness beyond.

尘土与碎石碾磨翻涌的喧嚣猛然灌入你的耳中，那存在逼近而来，下半身完全由旋转搅动的泥土浊流构成。石质的眼睛以轻蔑的优越感俯视着你，残忍的笑意扭曲着生物的面容，凝成冰冷的讥笑。道（Dao）披挂着辉煌与奢华——由奴役之手自大地凿取的珠宝环绕其身，衬托出那身雅致衣装冷峻而肃穆的色调。
The grinding tumult of dust and rock assaults your ears as the being approaches, their lower half composed entirely of a swirling earthen morass. Stony eyes regard you with contemptuous superiority, and a cruel smile twists the creature’s face into a cold sneer. The Dao is wreathed in splendor and luxury—jewels hacked from the earth by enslaved hands to complement the austere tones of its elegant clothing.

Ioun Stone Of Intellect.name:
智力艾欧石
Ioun Stone Of Intellect

Text.text:
这颗球体活像孩子玩耍时用的那枚红蓝相间的大玻璃弹珠；它一开始绕着你的颅骨旋转，你的感知便在瞬间被扩展。带着冷静而公事公办的气息，你轻而易举地算出它的速度与轨迹，你的思维被推至如沃帕利刃般的锋锐。
Resembling a large marble of red and blue that a child might use in play, the sphere expands your awareness the instant it begins to orbit your cranium. With a dispassionate, businesslike air, you easily calculate the velocity and path of the orb, your mind boosted to the sharpness of a vorpal blade.

Rayden The Gladiator.name:
角斗士雷登
Rayden The Gladiator

Text.text:
这具无毛的蔚蓝皮肤巨躯阴沉地皱着眉，双眼眯成冷硬的缝隙。鼻梁上覆着一层土色几丁质薄面具——犄角般的突起从耳上方延伸并向后探出——额前嵌着一枚琥珀宝石，幽光闪烁。与之相似的一块几丁质甲片覆盖在他巨大胸膛的一小部分。它、他的面具、护臂与胫甲几乎算不上实用的护甲，就像他破烂的靛蓝长裤与斗篷，也只能在天气面前提供些微薄的遮护。然而，他交叉双臂那起伏肌肉上层层叠叠的疤痕，以及背上绑着的巨剑，都昭示着——他还有别的防御手段。

~ Played by Alex with

This hairless, cerulean-skinned hulk scowls, eyes narrowed. A thin mask of earth-colored chitin rests on his nose—hornlike protrusions projecting over and behind his ears—an amber jewel shining in the forehead section. A plate of similar chitin covers a small part of his massive chest. It, his mask, his vambraces, and his greaves offer little practical armor, much as his tattered indigo pants and cloak grant only slight protection against the weather. But the overlapping scars on the rippling muscles of his crossed arms and the greatsword strapped to his back indicate he has other methods of defense.

~ Played by Alex with

柔和发光的黄色能量环带在你的目标周围凝成一片天界光环的帷幕，每一道都随着魔力的脉动而起伏。那些灼灼闪耀的环带慵懒旋转，小心翼翼地将自身的能量锚定于大地，迫使其坠落。
Softly glowing bands of yellow energy materialize around your target like a swathe of celestial halos, each one pulsing with magical force. The coruscating bands rotate lazily, carefully binding their charge to the earth as they force its descent.

Open And Empty Grave.name:
敞开而空无一物的坟墓
Open And Empty Grave

Text.text:
一堆新翻的泥土堆在敞开的坟穴旁。崭新的墓碑上没有名字，只有一行朴素的刻字：愿长眠于此的她，得享这世间未能赐予她的安宁。
A heap of earth, recently dug, stands beside an open grave. The fresh tombstone bears no name, just a simple inscription: May she who rests here find the peace that this world could not give her.

Cellar Of A Manor.name:
庄园地窖
Cellar Of A Manor

Text.text:
就连这间地窖也一样，尽管潮湿阴暗，却依旧舒适而洁净。石墙冰凉，接触之下寒意沁人，将旁侧贮藏的美酒恰到好处地冰镇着；泥土地面则维持着恰如其分的湿度，让沿墙摆放的种植箱里蘑菇长势喜人。用作储存的木箱从地面一直整齐堆叠到天花板，上面贴着标签，便于快速许可。细心的观察者多半还会注意到几扇“秘密”门——它们微微内嵌在墙体之中，匆匆一瞥根本看不出来。
Even the cellar, dank and dark as it is, is comfortable and clean. The stone walls, cold to the touch, keep the wine stored nearby chilled to perfection, while the earthen floor creates ideal humidity for the mushrooms growing in planter boxes along the wall. Wooden crates for storage are stacked neatly from floor to ceiling, labeled for quick access. Astute observers likely notice several "secret" doors as well, recessed slightly into the wall and invisible to a passing glance.

Sundries From A Young Copper Dragon.name:
年轻铜龙的杂物
Sundries From A Young Copper Dragon

Text.text:
在生物的巢穴里，破烂的乐谱纸张铺满地面，仿佛作曲家一时恼怒，将自己的作品任性抛向风中。混乱的乐海之中，还能看见几枚象牙钢琴键散落其间。
Tattered reams of sheet music cover the ground in the creature’s den, as if—in a fit of pique—the composer had cast their composition to the wind. Several ivory piano keys can also be seen among the musical chaos.

Sundries From Baba Yaga.name:
芭芭-雅嘎的杂物
Sundries From Baba Yaga

Text.text:
芭芭-雅嘎的尸身看起来比生前小了许多，枯槁的身影蜷卧在一堆破布之中。你警惕她耍弄诡计，伸手翻检女巫褴褛的长袍。她身上套着一件蛇皮背心，颈间挂着一串细小的指骨项链。你从一只口袋里摸出一个娃娃——用辫绳般编织的稻草扎成，裙摆由麦秆垂落。
The slain figure of Baba Yaga seems much smaller than in life, a wizened figure lying in a pile of rags. Alert to trickery, you rummage through the witch’s tattered robes. She wears a snakeskin vest, and a necklace of small finger bones. From one pocket, you retrieve a doll made from plaited and woven straw, with a skirt of wheat stalks.

Kobold Sewer Settlement.name:
狗头人下水道聚落
Kobold Sewer Settlement

Text.text:
幼崽们在高耸如山、不断堆叠的垃圾堆间追逐嬉闹，头顶巨大的倾泻槽口仍在源源不断地倾倒。废弃物、残羹与污秽如雨落入地下洞窟，自城中翻滚坠下，最终沉沉落入中央厅那片肮脏黏腻的湖泊。湖畔一侧——紧挨着一排剧烈震颤的管道——低声哼唱的爬行类母亲与保姆护着一窝窝亮黄色的蛋，在令人窒息的蒸热中慵懒安卧。赤红鳞片的哨兵手持锈蚀、拼凑的长矛，沿着覆满苔藓的渡槽列队巡行，通往中央湖水的通道在他们脚下延展，仿佛他们真是某个辉煌王国城垛上巡逻的王家卫队。

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

Younglings chase and scamper between towering piles of refuse constantly being added to by the massive chutes above. Discarded items, food waste, and sewage fall like rain into the subterranean cavern, tumbling down from the city before coming to rest in the grimy lake of the central chamber. To one side—next to a series of juddering pipes—crooning reptilian mothers and nursemaids shelter clutches of shiny yellow eggs, luxuriating in the sweltering heat. Ruddy-scaled sentries armed with rusty, ramshackle spears march along the moss-covered aqueducts leading into the central lake, as if they are royal guards patrolling the parapets of a glorious kingdom.

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

你一脚踩进水洼，泥浆立刻浸透靴子，冰冷黏腻，寒意直往骨头里钻。脚下的路几乎成了沼泽——臭气熏天、黏吸不放的烂泥，遍布浑浊的水坑与雨水汇成的细流。你顶着刺骨的冷意继续前行，任由泥浆一次次拖拽你的双腿。肌肉酸痛得发颤，肺里火烧般灼痛，你却仍咬牙跋涉，只在心里反复描摹旅途尽头那团温暖的火光与咕嘟翻滚的炖汤。
You stumble into a puddle and the mud soaks into your boots, frigid and clammy. The road is little more than a bog—stinking, sucking muck, pockmarked with dirty puddles and streams of rainfall. You press on, despite the chill, despite the constant pull of the mud against your legs. Your muscles ache, your lungs burn, but you trudge on, dreaming of warm fires and simmering stew at the end of your journey.

半身人以多年磨练出的随性精准，洗着一副磨得发旧的扑克牌。抹牌、桥洗、拱起——一气呵成。他们甩了甩那蓬卷曲的红发，嘴角一挑，开始发牌；手腕轻掷间，每一张牌都不偏不倚，恰好落在玩家面前。
The halfling shuffles a well-worn deck of playing cards with a casual precision born of years of practice. Overhand, riffle, steeple—all seamlessly. They toss back a mop of curly red hair and, with a smirk, deal out the cards, tossing them with ease so each card lands directly before the player.

这柄优质长矛自矛尾至矛尖足有九尺有余，最适合骑乘时使用；即便徒步，也依然是一件威力十足的突刺武器。木质矛杆上镶嵌着繁复的卷草纹饰，纹路里埋入柔韧的金丝，专为缠住任何试图击打到武器本体的攻击而设。图案一路延伸至精钢矛头，抛光得光可鉴人，随着矛身起伏摆动，镜面般冷光闪烁。
Over nine feet long from butt to tip, this spear of quality is best used from horseback, but on foot, it still makes for a powerful thrusting weapon. Elaborate scrollwork along the wooden shaft has been embedded with flexible golden wire, to tangle any strike against the weapon itself. This pattern extends to the fine steel head, polished to a sheen so that it glints like a mirror as it bobs.

Sword Of Wounding.name:
致伤之剑
Sword Of Wounding

Text.text:
这把剑的刃口布满阴毒的锯齿，专为制造惨烈——且经久不散——的伤害而生。漆黑的金属上蚀刻着骇人的棱角符文，泛起恶意的幽绿光辉，宛如掘墓人提着的鬼灯。
The blade of this sword is wickedly serrated, designed to inflict grievous—and lingering—harm. The dark metal is etched with fearsome angular runes, which glow with malevolent green radiance, like a gravedigger’s lantern.

Temple To A God Of Treachery.name:
背叛之神的神庙
Temple To A God Of Treachery

Text.text:
在这座黑石与猩红挂毯交织的神殿里，无论你站在哪里，背后总有一扇门。有的通道藏在垂挂的羊毛幡幕之后，有的舱口从地毯边缘探出一角。万物皆是谜题、障碍、伪装的门面。祷词是对神的谎言，歌声里塞满虚伪与注定要被撕毁的承诺。即便在神殿的至圣所里，祭坛也被刻意布下陷阱——因为这位神偏爱这些关于背叛的小小提醒。
Everywhere you stand in this temple of black stone and red tapestry, your back is to a door. Some are passageways hidden behind hanging wool banners, or hatches peeking from under rugs. Everything is a puzzle, an obstacle, a false front. The prayers are lies to the god, and the songs are full of falsehoods and promises designed to be broken. Even in the sanctuary of the temple, the altar is conspicuously trapped, for the god loves these little reminders of betrayal.

原始却实用：有些箭头由灰色花岗岩或更深的玄武岩凿刻而成，另一些则取自闪烁的燧石或蓝白色的燧石岩。在这一堆里，有一枚——典型的菱形箭镞，带外张的榫柄便于绑缚在箭杆上——由光泽流转的黑曜石精制而成。
Primitive but effective, some arrowheads are chiseled from gray granite or darker basalt, others from sparkling flint or blue-white chert. One in the mix—a typical diamond shape with a flared stem for tying to a shaft—is crafted from gleaming obsidian.

Civilized, Cosmopolitan City.name:
文明而繁华的国际都会
Civilized, Cosmopolitan City

Text.text:
人类或许是这座城市里数量最多的族群，但在这片喧嚣繁盛的街区里，挤满街巷的人潮却叫人难以分辨——半身人、矮人、精灵以及其他种族在此和气往来，平静地做着生意。这份绵延不绝的贸易似乎吸引了形形色色的旅人汇聚于此，织就一幅令人愉悦、却也略显眼花缭乱的文化熔炉景象。
Humans might be most populous in this city, but it’s hard to tell from the folk crowding the streets in this bustling community—where halflings, dwarves, elves, and other peoples peaceably do business. This steady trade seems to have drawn individuals of all sorts to present a delightful, if a bit bewildering, melting pot of cultures.

Unholy Plant Monster.name:
邪秽植物怪物
Unholy Plant Monster

Text.text:
狂暴而堕落，作为自然的污秽扭曲，这生物乃一切纯净与善良之物的禁忌。枯萎纠结的触须带着癫狂般的饥渴向你伸来——仿佛不可能逃离它们的触及。伴随一声刺耳尖啸，这生物在腐臭的泥土中猛然撕裂而出，霉烂的土块如雨飞溅；它用远超常理的、仿若树根般的无数条腿朝你逼近。

~ Envisioned by Joorrekiin on Discord

Savage, a vile perversion of nature, the creature is anathema to all things natural and good. Twisting, blighted tendrils reach for you with apoplectic hunger—it seems impossible to escape their reach. With a piercing screech the creature tears itself free of the rancid earth in a shower of moldering soil, and moves toward you on far too many root-like legs.

~ Envisioned by Joorrekiin on Discord

Trail Flanked By Rocks.name:
岩石夹道的小径
Trail Flanked By Rocks

Text.text:
小径一路蜿蜒：向西通往山顶那座坍塌的高塔遗迹，向东则更深地没入广袤平原。一对巨石如石质巨指般自地底突起，分立在路旁夹住去路。你心头一凛——这里简直是设伏的绝佳地点。
The trail leads toward the ruined tower atop the hill to the west, and deeper into the plains to the east. A pair of massive boulders, rising from the earth like stone fingers, flank the path. You think for a moment this would be the ideal location for an ambush.

Walk-in Wardrobe Of A Manor.name:
庄园的步入式衣帽间
Walk-in Wardrobe Of A Manor

Text.text:
这座衣橱大得出奇，足以让人走进去，在其中张开双臂也碰不到两侧墙壁。墙面与天花板上固定着一道道横杆，挂满了数不清的外套、礼裙与斗篷；层层搁架则摆着成百上千双各式鞋履。奢华的丝质衬衫、镶嵌珍贵宝石的华美皮带、来自世界各地的珠宝，甚至还有由巨龙设计的头饰——一切都被整齐分类、逐一归档。
The wardrobe is deceptively large, allowing one to walk inside and spread their arms wide without touching either wall. Rungs mounted to the walls and ceiling hold innumerable coats, dresses, and cloaks, while shelves hold hundreds of pairs of shoes of all varieties. Lavish silk shirts, ornate leather belts set with precious gemstones, jewelry from around the world, even headresses designed by dragons—all of it neatly catalogued.

Being Charmed By Charm Person.name:
被“魅惑人类”魅惑
Being Charmed By Charm Person

Text.text:
施法者抬起双手，低声呢喃出一句古怪而轻快的短语。你竭力想听清，却有某种东西打断了你的思绪。待你重新凝神望去，一抹似曾相识的笑容迎上你的目光。你一时想不起在哪见过，也记不起他的名字，但能看到一张友善的面孔，你仍由衷感到庆幸。
The spellcaster raises his hands and whispers a curious, lilting phrase. You strain to catch it, but something interrupts your thoughts. When you refocus your gaze, a familiar smile meets your eyes. You can't quite place it, or recall his name, but you're grateful to see a friendly face all the same.

Bard Reciting Anthemic Poem.name:
吟游诗人吟诵颂歌长诗
Bard Reciting Anthemic Poem

Text.text:
吟游诗人的嗓音铿然回荡，一段又一段激动人心的诗句自那华美的长诗中倾泻而出。他们清澈如号角的呼喝是一声行动的召唤，唤醒被俘观众的精神，在胸臆间点燃热情与勇气。随着诗人的言辞高高飞扬，见证者也随之振奋，仿佛心脏生出羽翼，下一刻便要振翅腾空。
The bard’s voice rings out as they deliver verse after thrilling verse of a glorious poem. Their clarion cry is a call to action, rousing the spirits of their captive audience and instilling passion and courage. As the bard’s words soar high, their witnesses feel uplifted, as though their hearts might grow wings and take flight.

Insult About Clumsiness.name:
笨手笨脚的羞辱
Insult About Clumsiness

Text.text:
“真叫我纳闷，你竟能从你母亲那阴湿可憎的洞窟里逃出来，还没脚下一滑摔裂脑壳。”
“It confounds me that you managed to escape your mother’s wretched cavern without slipping and cracking your skull.”

起初你还以为那只是一团翻涌鼓泡的岩浆——直到它展开双翼，形似巨龙之翼，却完全由岩浆凝成。它狭长的面孔透出邪恶的神情，宛如由纯粹元素恶意铸就的小恶魔，蓄势待发，要将炽烈火舌喷向任何不够警觉、倒霉撞上它的冒险者。
At first you take it for a simple lump of bubbling magma—until the wings unfurl, resembling those of a dragon save that they are formed entirely of magma. Its long face expresses an evil demeanor, an imp made of pure elemental malice, ready to unleash gouts of flame on unwary adventurers unlucky enough to cross its path.

Loot From A Griffon Nest.name:
狮鹫巢穴的战利品
Loot From A Griffon Nest

Text.text:
在巢穴旁一堆堆残渣与毫无价值的破烂中，躺着一枚戒指，值20枚银币。
Amid the detritus and otherwise worthless piles beside the nest is a ring worth 20 silver pieces.

Welcome From The Tavern Keeper.name:
来自酒馆老板的欢迎
Welcome From The Tavern Keeper

Text.text:
“欢迎光临！一品脱四枚银币，从残酒桶里舀一杯只要一枚。要是你喝不完这一品脱，剩下的就算店里请的。”
“Welcome! Pints are four silver and a cup from the leavings bucket is one. If you can’t finish your pint then leavings are on the house.”

Scent Of Blooded Sands In Ancient Arena.name:
古老竞技场里血染沙尘的腥香
Scent Of Blooded Sands In Ancient Arena

Text.text:
尽管这座角斗场上一次为狂喜而嗜血的观众献上殊死搏杀，已是数百年前的事了，但那陈旧沙砾仍带着一种独特的触感——一种厚重黏滞的质地，仿佛在无声作证：曾有难以想象的、以加仑计的鲜血倾洒在这片场地之上。而若有人恰好站在那片浸血沙地的某个位置，一缕血腥气息便可能飘入鼻端，浓烈辛辣，宛如打翻的深红葡萄酒一般刺人。
Despite the many centuries since this gladiatorial arena hosted fights to the death for ecstatic, bloodthirsty crowds, there exists a certain texture to the aged sand, a thickness that is a testament to the unimaginable gallons of lifeblood spilled upon the arena’s grounds. And if one stands in just the right place on those blood soaked sands, a whiff of spilled vitae, as strong and biting as a spilled claret, might waft into one’s nostrils.

你一声令下便消失无踪，踏入以太，穿越现实的缝隙。身后轰然炸起一记音爆，怒如狂飙暴风，毫无束缚地席卷四方。
With a word you disappear, stepping into the ether to jump through reality. A sonic blast erupts in your wake, exploding with the unbridled fury of a raging storm.

Fake Mace Of Terror.name:
伪恐怖钉头锤
Fake Mace Of Terror

Text.text:
你以钢铁般的握力高举那柄骇人的钉头锤，凝神将意志凝成一线，欲向敌人倾泻一波令人战栗的恐惧。然而颇为扫兴的是，钉头锤里竟传出一个毫无起伏、仿佛离体的声音，哀嚎道：“Boo-oo-oo!” 你周围的生物看起来并不买账。
You brandish the gruesome mace in an adamant grip and focus your will on unleashing a surge of shuddering terror upon your enemies. Rather anticlimactically, a disembodied, monotone voice from the mace wails, “Boo-oo-oo!” The creatures around you appear unimpressed.

Bright And Clean Corporate Mall.name:
明亮洁净的企业商场
Bright And Clean Corporate Mall

Text.text: 层层白瓷砖的悬空连廊堆叠而上，构成这座巨型商场的四层空间。人们一靠近，电子导览屏便骤然亮起，光与漂浮的图形在空中绽放；导航用的二维码已就位，任由手机、眼镜与眼内植入体一扫即读。洁净如新的地面与流线弧形的墙面，恰好成了四周肆意蔓延的激光招牌的完美画布，光焰纵横。霓银刺绣的皮夹克标示着一家骑行服饰店，门槛处飘着焦橡胶与熏香交织的气味。氧吧用海蓝色灯光招徕，投影出的气泡像面包屑般一路引人前行。顶层有一间大型电子卖场，占去了大片地段。明亮招牌下，一台漂浮机器人随着光影轻轻摆动，黑色屏幕脸孔中央，SALE! 正灼灼发光。 Tiers of white-tiled suspended walkways make up the four stories of this megamall. Digital directories burgeon to life with light and floating graphics as people draw near, navigational QR codes ready for scanning by phones, glasses, and intraocular implants. The pristine floors and smoothly curving walls are the perfect canvas for the legions of laser-light signs glowing rampant all around. A leather jacket embroidered in neon silver denotes a biking clothier, the scent of burning rubber and incense floating at the threshold. An oxygen bar entices with ocean-blue lights and projected bubbles that lead like a breadcrumb trail. A big-box electronics store takes up a great deal of real estate on the top floor. A floating bot bobs in a kind of dance under the effulgent signage, the word SALE! glowing in the center of its black screen face.

你张口结舌地看着那座岛屿竟自行移动，海水自一颗巨大的爬行类头颅上倾泻而下，它破海而出，仿佛一艘沉没巨舰自深渊被打捞上来。葱郁的植被覆满这头生物的甲壳，如同一片行走的森林；随着那头巨龟每一次沉重挪动，树木也随之缓慢摇摆，一群群鸟儿惊起振翅，掠空而去。
Your mouth hangs open as you watch the island move of its own accord, water cascading from a gargantuan reptilian head as it breaches the ocean surface like a sunken ship raised from the depths. Verdant foliage covers the creature’s shell like a mobile forest, and a host of birds takes flight as the trees lurch ponderously with the colossal tortoise’s movements.

在一片被繁花涂抹成翠色的林间空地上，他们相遇。两人出自白桦，一人是高山上的松，最后一人则生于水畔的桃。皆为类人的身形，身高相差不远，唯有那位松裔显得格外高挑。皮肤如其本源树皮被打磨得光滑——白桦裔洁白而带雀斑，桃裔则黝黑结实、韧如老皮。他们的长发凌乱垂落，在彼此躬身致意时顺势覆到眼前。松裔的手背生出细密松针，而桃裔含笑时，臂上绽开的花朵一路舒展如云。
In a green glade painted in flowers, they meet. Two of them are birch-born, another a pine from up the mountain, and finally a peach-born from near the water. They are humanoid and close to the same height, although the pine is noticeably the tallest. Their skin is a smooth version of the bark of their origin, the birch-born white and freckled, the peach-born tanned and tough. Their hair is long and messy, hanging forward as they bow to one another. The pine sprouts needles from the backs of her hands, and the peach smiles as blossoms unfold along his arms.

Dead Tree At A Crossroads.name:
十字路口的枯树
Dead Tree At A Crossroads

Text.text:
枯死的树在十字路口如幽灵般森然耸立，虬结而久已干枯的根须仍将它死死钉在地里。扭曲枝桠上的一道道痕迹，似乎是绳索留下的，让你不由猜想，这棵树是否曾被刽子手用作那阴沉营生的工具。
The dead tree looms like a specter at the crossroads, still anchored in the ground by its gnarled, long-dry roots. Marks along the twisted boughs, possibly from a rope, make you wonder if this tree was used by a hangman in their gloomy profession.

那名兽人婴孩跌跌撞撞地胡乱闯着，哪怕一头撞上家具、翻滚着摔过障碍也不停步。他们根本无法被阻拦——攀上椅背，又在桌下一个筋斗钻过。
The infant orc stumbles clumsily, not stopping in their path even as they slam into furniture and tumble over obstacles. They cannot be deterred as they clamber over a chair and somersault under a table.

Ioun Stone Of Protection.name:
防护艾恩石
Ioun Stone Of Protection

Text.text:
切割过的棱柱散发着柔和的粉红光泽，宛如娇嫩玫瑰的花瓣。宝石锋利的棱角与它的淡雅色泽形成鲜明对比，握在手中分量恰好，令人安心。水晶光滑的表面贴着皮肤带着暖意，一股令人笃定的存在感如老友般将你轻轻拥住。
The cut prism has a soft pinkish hue, like the petals of a delicate rose. The stone’s harsh edges stand in stark contrast to its pallor, and it has a comforting weight when held. The smooth surface of the crystal is warm against your skin, and a reassuring presence embraces you like an old friend.

Group Of Squires At Tournament.name:
锦标赛上的侍从们
Group Of Squires At Tournament

Text.text:
炎热之下，罩袍被解开，一群年轻人懒散地倚在一辆彩绘大车的阴影里。帽子塞在腰带间，参差不齐的牙缝里叼着几根稻草，他们捧着白镴酒壶啜饮麦酒，夸口说自己终有一天也会成为冠军。可当一群侍女款步走近，景象骤然一变：这些侍从为了摆出英雄般的成熟姿态，慌忙间彼此绊作一团。
Surcoats undone in the heat, a group of young men lounges in the shade of a colorful wagon. Caps tucked into belts, straw between uneven teeth, they sip ale from pewter jugs and boast how they too will be champions one day. The scene swiftly changes when a group of ladies-in-waiting approach, and the squires trip over each other in their haste to look heroically adult.

Hand Of The God-lich.name:
神巫妖之手
Hand Of The God-lich

Text.text:
这只焦黑枯槁的利爪，或许曾是一只人形生物的手。如今干瘪的皮肉如陈旧羊皮纸般脆裂，却仍紧绷地贴在虬曲的白骨上。手腕处撕裂参差，仿佛从尸体上硬生生扯下，末端纠缠着木乃伊般的残肉与垂落的筋腱。手指上长而断裂的指甲，似乎向内蜷曲，像是在抓住什么——无论是什么——活着的东西。腐臭味、霉烂的肉味与新翻泥土的腥气从这件骇人的物体中逸散而出，随之而来的，是一股几乎令人窒息的不祥预感。
This blackened, withered claw might have once been a humanoid hand. Now, the desiccated flesh, brittle as old parchment, clings taut against the gnarled bones. The wrist, ripped and ragged as if torn from a corpse, ends in a tangle of mummified flesh and hanging tendons. The fingers with their long, broken nails seem to curl inward, as if grasping for something—anything—living. The smell of rot, of moldering flesh and fresh-dug soil, emanates from the grisly object, and with it comes an overwhelming sense of foreboding.

你咆哮着发出对力量的索求，将手中的武器猛然劈向敌手。回应随即降临——灼烈的魔法轰然涌现，你的攻击化作熔流。你手中的武器变成一段明灭起伏的惨白长刃，仿佛自焚的钢铁。
You snarl out a demand for power as you swing your weapon down upon your foe. The call is answered with searing magic—and your attack turns molten. The weapon in your hand becomes an ebbing white length of immolating steel.

一间小巧、饱经风霜的石砌小屋立在你面前，双烟囱耸起，茅草屋顶低伏。窗户与正门皆以厚实的木板封制，主入口旁悬着一只小铃。屋子背风的一侧有一片不大却打理得极精心的菜园，土豆、胡萝卜，以及一排豌豆都被常年劲风护在篱后。沙丘一路延伸向下，通往你远处听见浪涛拍击的海岸。咸涩的海水气息悬在空气里，浸透四周的一切。
A small, weatherworn stone cottage with two chimneys and a thatched roof stands before you. The windows and front door are made from solid wooden planks, and a small bell hangs beside the main entrance. A small but well-tended garden lies to the leeward side of the building, with potatoes, carrots, and a row of peas protected from the prevailing wind. Sandy dunes lead down to the waves you hear crashing in the distance. The briny smell of seawater hangs in the air, suffusing everything around you with its scent.

The Pet Therapy Druid With A Penchant Fo.name:
嗜酒如命的宠物疗愈德鲁伊
The Pet Therapy Druid With A Penchant For Drinking

Text.text: “嗯，我明白了。斯蒂芬想让我转告你：他不喜欢你摸他的胡须。” 那位上了年纪的交际新秀皱起眉头，怒气冲冲地从办公室里夺门而出，怀里死死抱着她那只戴金饰、架着眼镜的老鼠。 “又一个满意的顾客。”莉莉说着，拔开一瓶火酒的瓶塞。 她身旁窗户上，一张蛛网飞快织起，拼出字句：你需要帮助。 莉莉把瓶塞朝蛛丝一掷，丝网应声撕裂，字句粉碎。“闭嘴，夏洛特。” "Mhm, I see. Stephen would like to tell you that he does not enjoy it when you pet his whiskers." The aging debutante frowns and storms from the office, clutching her gold, bespeckled rat. "Another happy customer," Lilly says, uncorking a bottle of firewater. A web rapidly spins in the window beside her, spelling the words: You need help. Lilly tosses the cork through the spider silk, shredding the message. "Shut up, Charlette."

Seven Stones Of Founding.name:
奠基七石
Seven Stones Of Founding

Text.text:
附魔师学院的创立者们在高塔建造之初，各自将一块石头嵌入塔身。那些石头没有任何标记，看起来与构成高塔其余部分的 9,999,984 块石头别无二致。然而，它们却是强大的魔法器物，守护、赋生并扩展高塔的馆藏，使其与年代的最前沿锋刃对齐。
The founders of the Enchanter Academy each placed a stone in the tower when it was built. The stones are unmarked and look just like the other 9,999,984 stones that make up the rest of the tower. But they are powerful magic artifacts that protect, enliven, and expand the tower’s holdings, aligning it with the front edge of the age.

I Take Cover Behind My Spellguard Shield.name:
我举起法术卫士盾牌躲入掩蔽之中
I Take Cover Behind My Spellguard Shield

Text.text:
我双脚钉在地上，稳稳架住身形，一道法术呼啸着朝我飞来，我迅速缩到我的法术卫士盾后方。盾牌嗡鸣震颤，震得我牙关发麻；它在一阵棱彩光爆中将魔法能量弹开，把我牢牢护在伤害之外。
I plant my feet and brace myself as a spell hurtles toward me, ducking behind my Spellguard Shield. The shield vibrates, rattling my teeth, as it repels the magical energy in a burst of prismatic light and protects me from harm.

装在防水木制雪橇上的长钢滑刃经过精心校衡与打磨，使其在严冬行进时能发挥最大效果。在深雪中，这种载具远比马车更为好用；不过，为防刃面受潮水侵蚀，必须每日擦拭并上油保养。
The long steel runners mounted to the waterproofed wooden sled have been balanced and sharpened for maximum effect when traveling in wintry conditions. Such a conveyance is far more useful than a wagon in deep snow, though the blades must be wiped down and greased daily to protect them from water damage.

Effigy Of Yesterhill.name:
昨日丘陵的塑像
Effigy Of Yesterhill

Text.text:
鼓声在山丘四周回荡。山顶上，一圈宽阔的黑色巨砾围出一片枯死的草地。闪电劈落在边界时，惨白的光照出一尊骇人的独石巨像——以紧密编织的枝条为骨，黑土塞实其间——形如一个披斗篷、獠牙森然的高大男人。在它本应是心脏的位置，一枚祖母绿被污秽的根须向上扭缠托举，散发出幽光流溢的灵异辉芒。偶像前跪着一名女子，她的下巴被身后站立之人攥住；那人披着血淋淋的兽皮。血衣之人墨黑的头发上顶着由骷髅与扭曲虬结的鹿角拼成的头饰，手执一杆黑铁长矛。
The sound of the drums echoes around the hill. On its summit, a wide ring of black boulders encloses a field of dead grass. When lightning strikes the boundary, it illuminates a ghastly, monolithic statue—made of tightly woven twigs packed with black earth—resembling a towering, cloaked man with fangs. Where its heart would be, an emerald, casting a luminescent ethereal glow, is held by foul roots twisting up the statue. Kneeling in front of the effigy is a woman, her chin grasped by a figure standing behind her, clad in bloody hides. The bloody figure, ink-black hair topped by a headdress made from a skull and twisted, gnarled antlers, holds a spear of black iron.

这头野兽体型大如骏马，生着龙似的双翼，翼展如小船的风帆一般，可怪异还远不止于此。它的尾巴如巨蛇般拖曳，自山羊的后躯延伸而出。躯干中段仿佛狮与龙在争夺它的前半身，赐予它致命的利爪。它那不堪重负的肩背上绽出三颗头颅：一颗狮首，一颗长角的羊首，以及一颗酷似赤龙的头。
The beast is as big as a horse, with dragon-like wings the size of a small ship’s sails, but it just gets weirder. It has a serpentine tail extending from a goat’s hindquarters. Somewhere in the middle, a lion and a dragon compete to be its forequarters, granting it deadly claws. Three heads bloom from its overburdened shoulders: a lion, a horned goat, and something like a red dragon.

Essence Of Ether.name:
以太精粹
Essence Of Ether

Text.text:
气态粉末灼烧着你的双眼与鼻孔。你本能地屏住呼吸、紧闭双眼，可毒素缠人不休。你感觉它渗入鼻腔黏膜与泪腺，沿着脆弱的缝隙钻入你的心智与躯体。周遭自你的感官中褪色，你只觉得自己在坠落，坠落，向下，向下……
The gaseous powder burns in your eyes and nostrils. You instinctively hold your breath and shut your eyes, but the poison is persistent. You feel it leaching into your nasal membranes and tear ducts, working its way into the vulnerable points of your mind and body. Your surroundings fade from your senses as you feel yourself falling, falling, down, and down…

这名战士穿着一套华而不实的钉皮护甲，既像戏服多过像防护。剪裁追求极致灵活，也毫不遮掩斗士紧致有力的身形。她手持一杆长矛与一面盾牌——盾面同样缠着与护甲相配的钉皮皮带——看起来本身就像一件武器。
This warrior wears a showpiece set of studded leather, as much costume as protection. It’s cut for maximum flexibility and to show off the fighter’s fit form. She carries a long spear and a shield—wrapped with straps of studded leather to match her armor—which looks to be a weapon in its own right.

Tomb Of A Wizard’s Apprentice.name:
巫师学徒之墓
Tomb Of A Wizard’s Apprentice

Text.text:
奥术光球在陵墓凝滞的空气中翩然起舞，宛如黑暗里漂浮的星屑。沿着空间两侧陈列的雕像栩栩如生却令人心悸，描绘着同一名女子人生的各个阶段，最后一尊定格在她初入成年之时。陵墓尽头，一座抬高的台座上安放着石棺，棺盖雕着那女子的面容。她身着奥术学者的长袍，一根法杖横抱在胸前。
Arcane spheres dance through the still air within the tomb like motes of starlight in the darkness. Hauntingly lifelike statues lining the space depict a woman throughout the phases of her life, the last one showing her in young adulthood. At the rear of the tomb, upon a raised dais, there lies a stone coffin with the woman’s likeness upon the lid. She is wearing the robes of an arcane scholar, with a staff held to her breast.

锁定装置的信号才是最难的一步；一旦搞定，只需轻轻一点，就能启动静噪。传输请求如暴雨般轰击你的程序，你自己的HUD通知也像故障广告般忽明忽暗。但你已将目标封进一间虚拟牢房，没有你的许可，任何东西都别想进出。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Locking onto the device's signal is the hard part; after that, all it takes is a single click to start the squelch. Transfer requests hammer against your program, and notifications on your own HUD flicker like a faulty advert. But you've encased the target in a virtual prison cell, and nothing gets in or out without your approval.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Lurker In The Doorway.name:
门槛暗伏者
Lurker In The Doorway

Text.text:
石阶一路向下，尽头是一扇半掩的木门。石砌门槛被利爪般的抓痕撕裂，直贯其上。鲜血溅落，将地面染成猩红斑驳。空气里弥漫着铁锈般的腥味，还混着一股像癞皮野兽湿毛般的骚臭。你听不见任何喘息或搏斗的声响，门后只剩阴影。

[察觉到] 忽然，利爪刮擦石板的窸窣声乍起——在那里！门与门框的昏暗缝隙间掠过一抹红光。两只红眼急促地眨动，像将熄的烛火在挣扎着闪烁……直到它们定定落在你身上。目光灼热而不移。黑暗中传来一声轻软的呜咽，像婴儿压抑的啜泣。

The stone steps lead down to a wooden door left ajar. Clawlike slashes rend straight through the stone-wrought threshold. Blood colors the ground with crimson splatter. The scent of iron tinges the air as does an odor like the wet fur of a mangy beast. You hear no voice gasping or the sound of a struggle and see only shadow beyond the door.

[Perceived] There is the sudden scuffle of claws against flagstones and—there! A flash of red in the shadowed gap between door and frame. Two red eyes blink rapidly, like candle flames flickering as they struggle to keep alight… until they settle upon you. They stare, searing and unwavering. A soft mewl, like a baby whimpering, rings out of the dark.

Sundries From A Vrock.name:
来自弗洛克的杂物
Sundries From A Vrock

Text.text:
鸟形恶魔轰然坠地——那双残忍而锐利的眼睛如今黯淡无光，毫无生气。战斗中，它几根覆满孢子的羽毛被打落。也许对那些精于调制毒物的人而言，这些东西能成为有用的材料。
The avian demon falls to the ground—its cruel, piercing eyes now dull and lifeless. During the battle some of its spore-covered feathers were dislodged. Perhaps they could be useful components to those skilled in the crafting of poisons.

守卫来回踱步，却不是在巡逻。她低着头，像是在吐出低沉的碎语。她猛地脚跟一转，愤怒地把一团白色东西摔到地上，那东西弹跳着滚开——那是一张被揉皱的纸，她一直攥在拳头里紧紧捏着。
The guard paces back and forth, but she’s not walking a patrol. Her head is down and she seems to be spitting out quiet words. She makes an abrupt heel turn and angrily tosses something white to the ground that bounces away—a crumpled sheet of paper she had been keeping balled up in her fist.

Gelatinous Cube Encounter.name:
凝胶魔方遭遇
Gelatinous Cube Encounter

Text.text:
你发现自己正面对着一个看似漂浮的骷髅（特征）以及几块半毁的护甲。那团果冻般的生物挤满了整条通道，缓缓朝你逼近，身前拖曳着一层令人瘫痪的黏液。它威胁要将你吞没、溶解消化——除非你能先一步将它击杀。
You find yourself confronted by what appears to be a floating skeleton and several pieces of half-destroyed armor. The jelly-like creature fills the entirety of the passage as it moves slowly toward you, preceded by a paralyzing ooze. It threatens to engulf and digest you unless you can slay it first.

这个自负张扬的半精灵已至中年，见过、也亲手做过不少海盗勾当，可他那张脸——一双绿松石般的眼睛嵌在其间，深绿的头发像阴影般勾出轮廓——却只留着几道浅浅的小疤。真正的疤痕蜿蜒在他精瘦的肌肉间，是战斗与甲板劳作一道道刻出来的纹路；他最爱拿这些吹嘘，甚至押注取乐。对自己的技能满怀自信，他不太吃“讲道理”那一套，更愿意用行动说话。鲁克腰间系着用海盗旗裁成的绶带，黑色皮革外披一件深蓝长外套——成了他那柄会闪出银光的魔法细剑与戒指最好的背景。

~ Played by a Hero

The swaggering half-elf in his middle age has witnessed, and committed, his share of piracy, yet his face—decorated with turquoise eyes and bordered by dark green hair—bears only a few minor scars. But scars do curve among the lean muscles of his body, shaped by combat and deck work, and on which he likes to brag and take bets. Confident in his skill, slow to accept talk over action, Rook wears a sash made of a pirate flag and a deep blue coat over black leathers—background for the silver flash of his magic rapier and ring.

~ Played by a Hero

Transhumanist Preacher.name:
超人类主义传道者
Transhumanist Preacher

Text.text:
一个上身赤裸的身影，将熔融青铜般的双臂高高举向头顶的天空。他们躯干的每一寸都被凯夫拉装甲板加固。心脏本应所在之处，一枚蓝红交替跳动的电池悬浮在超致密玻璃之中。腰际垂着一件绿色超细纤维长袍，上面印着超人类极端派的玄奥符印。至少，那颗泛着金辉的头颅并非金属。不——那是一张完美对称的生物工程面孔，披着未来将至的一切摄魂魅力。
A figure naked from the waist up raises arms the color of molten bronze to the sky above. Every inch of their torso has been reinforced with Kevlar plating. A beating blue-red battery sits suspended in hyperdense glass where their heart should be. A green microfiber robe hangs from the hips and bears esoteric marks of transhuman extremists. The glowing golden cranium, at least, is not metallic. No—instead, it’s a perfectly symmetrical bioengineered face wearing all the captivating charm of the future to come.

Giant Spiders: Spider-infested Woods.name:
巨型蜘蛛：蛛患密林
Giant Spiders: Spider-infested Woods

Text.text:
你曾走过无数森林，却从未有哪一片像这里这般深邃。沿着这些参天古木盘结扭曲的枝桠前行，你穿过巨大的根系拱门，又踏上它们蜿蜒纠缠的筋结。阴影在你周遭的凹陷处积成黑潭，远处的鸟儿唱着孤冷的曲子，回声在林间来回荡漾。你竖起耳朵想捕捉寻常的林音——比如风在叶间低语——却徒劳无功。枯瘦如骨的枝条密密缠绕，几乎不肯放下一丝光，让你仿佛被囚在林笼之中。
You’ve been in many forests before, but none that have felt so deep. Your pathway beneath the gnarled boughs of these great trees takes you under massive root archways and atop their winding snarls. Shadows pool in the hollows around you while distant birds sing lonesome songs that echo through the woods. You strain to hear normal forest sounds, like the wind whispering through leaves, but to no avail. The thick tangle of bare and bony branches allows little light down to you, making you feel caged.

Statue Of A Tentacled God.name:
触手之神的雕像
Statue Of A Tentacled God

Text.text:
这尊有翼、触手丛生的生物雕像盘腿而坐，姿态端正。它年代久远，裂纹如血管般爬满利爪般的手足，也蜿蜒过那光滑隆起、圆顶般的头颅。面部垂下的触手如同胡须般披散。那粗壮的触须被刻得逼真得可怕，几乎让人仿佛听见它们湿黏地噗叽作响、蠕动扭摆。
This statue of a winged, tentacled creature is carved into a cross-legged, seated position. It is an old artwork, cracks veining over its clawed hands and feet and its smooth, domed head. Tentacles hang down from the statue’s face like a beard. The thick tendrils are carved in such realistic detail, you almost hear them squelch and wriggle.

Undead Beholder In Deathly Forest.name:
亡灵眼魔于死寂森林中
Undead Beholder In Deathly Forest

Text.text:
枯槁的精灵尸体在焦黑的树干与带刺的荆棘间踉跄游荡，尽在光秃枝桠的阴影之下。几棵树吱呀作响，呻吟不止。裸露的枝条战栗着，逆着腐臭的风颤动。死去的荆条噼啪断裂。其间有几颗病态的紫罗兰火球幽幽亮起；随后，一颗更大的火球骤然点燃。所有火焰随着一颗从灌木丛中浮出的巨大骷髅一同升起：更大的那团火照亮了它唯一、居中的眼窝，其余火焰则绕着那长着獠牙的颅骨盘旋。 “我坠落此地时还是个陌生人，迷失而困惑，但自那以后，我已学会了这世界的许多事，而它……令我作呕。像这林中所有害虫一样，你们惊慌失措地四处乱窜，拼命攥紧你们短暂而空洞的生命。但别担心，很快我就会将你们从弱点中解放出来，让你们去侍奉某个远比你们伟大的存在：我。”

~ 由一位英雄 扮演

Withered corpses of elves lurch amid blackened trunks and thorny brambles, all under leafless limbs. A few trees creak and groan. Their bare branches tremble, moving against the putrid wind. Dead briars crack. Several small orbs of sickly violet fire illuminate among them; then a single, larger ball lights. All these flames rise with a massive skull that emerges from the thicket, the bigger flame lighting the lone, central eye socket while the others orbit the fanged cranium. “I landed here a stranger, lost and confused, but since then I have learnt much of this world and it… disgusts me. Like all the vermin in these woods, you scurry about in a panic, clinging so desperately to your short, hollow lives. But do not worry, soon I will release you from your weakness and place you in service of something far greater: me.”

~ Played by a Hero

Tournament To Choose The Queen’s Champio.name:
遴选女王冠军的比武大会
Tournament To Choose The Queen’s Champion

Text.text:
通往比武场的闸门被猛然掀开，一名风笛手大步踏上沙地，凄幽的旋律萦绕在他周身，弥漫于空中。女王紧随乐师而来，身着一袭如流体般的翠绿长裙，纤细的双手紧握着一只金质冠环。早已跪地的得胜骑士摘下头盔，俯首低垂。欢腾的人潮齐齐跃起，雷鸣般的掌声冲至顶点，新冠军在万众瞩目中加冕。
The gates to the list are flung open and a piper strides onto the sand, a haunting melody filling the air about him. The queen, bedecked in a liquid green dress, follows the musician, a circlet of gold clutched in her slender hands. Already kneeling, the triumphant knight doffs their helm and bows their head. The jubilant masses surge to their feet, thunderous applause peaking, as the new champion is crowned.

露台的浅灰色石面在月光的银辉里泛着微光，冷冽而夺目。花园里，奇异的植物在花岗岩花盆与木箱中蓬勃生长，几缕藤蔓探出，缠上栏杆、桌面、长凳与墙壁。紫瓣的花在夜色中舒展，细长的黄色花丝沐浴月辉——甜得发腻的香气直冲齿根，让人牙酸——而带刺的花苞则在角落里成簇堆叠，像昆虫满是尖刺的卵囊。飞蛾在夜放的花间漂浮，黑白相间的翅纹宛如一张张睁大眼的骷髅面孔。露台中央立着一座基座上的月晷，周遭寸草不生。晷面上的符文陌生难辨。

~ 出自惊艳的TTRPG增补The Vineyard

The light gray stone of the terrace glows, striking in the silver light of the moon. A garden of strange plants flourishes in granite pots and boxes, some of their vines weaving out to wrap around the railings, tables, benches, and walls. Flowers with violet petals and stringy yellow filaments bask in the lunar light—their aroma so sweet it sets your teeth on edge—and prickly buds cluster in corners like spiking egg sacs of an insect. Moths float between the nocturnal blooms, the black and white patterns of their wings reminiscent of wide-eyed skulls. A moondial set upon a pedestal serves as centerpiece of the terrace, its surroundings devoid of vegetation. The runes on the face of the dial are unfamiliar.

~ Found in the amazing TTRPG supplement The Vineyard

Well-worn Telescoping Baton.name:
磨损斑驳的伸缩警棍
Well-worn Telescoping Baton

Text.text:
警棍那坚硬的黑色塑料表面布满了苍白的伤痕与麻点般的凹缺。它在伸展开时略有卡顿，被猛力拉到最长处会发出一声疲惫的吱呀。尽管磨损，它依旧能砸出阴狠的重击：敲裂膝盖或手腕，或是一记干脆利落的直捅，直入腹间。
The hard black plastic of the baton is covered with pale scars and pockmark nicks. It hitches as it extends and emits a tired squeak when wrenched to its full length. Though worn, it can still deliver nasty blows: a crack to the knees or wrists, or a sound thrust to the gut.

Enchanter Academy Winter Sunset.name:
附魔师学院·冬日落霞
Enchanter Academy Winter Sunset

Text.text:
白昼早早收工，学生们拖着步子走向各自公共休息室的炉火。高塔在走廊与楼梯间为他们开出朝西的窗——霎时，这些空间被一场史诗般的橙色光潮填满，铺在渐蓝的雪原之上。常青树化作墨黑的剪影，暮色像是从魔法起源最初的书页里撕下的一段。
Daylight is quitting early, and students trudge to the fires of their common rooms. The tower creates west-facing windows for them in the halls and stairwells—which suddenly fill with the epic drama of orange light over a bluing snowy field. The evergreens become inky black silhouettes, and the late afternoon is like a page from the very origin of magic.

Headstone: “Light” In Winter.name:
墓碑：“冬之光”
Headstone: “Light” In Winter

Text.text: 这块墓碑的颜色似乎比周遭的都要浅一分，是用更轻白的石灰岩雕成。黑色霉斑在碑文凹陷的潮湿缝隙里滋生，渗出一道道暗痕从字里滴落，泪痕般的轨迹透过薄薄的积雪清晰可见。碑上写着：当光被分享，便成了悲伤的重负。独自哀悼的心，最为沉重。 This headstone seems a shade paler than most, being cut from a lighter marble. Black mold grows in the damp cervices of its letters, causing dark stains to drip from them, the tear-like tracks visible through the dusting of snow. The words read: Light becomes the burden of sorrow when shared. Heavy is the heart that mourns alone.

这里的墙壁建于久远以前，年久失修，时代柔软的接触正将它们一点点拖垮——至少正在试图如此。庄园仍带着昔日荣光的阴影：一圈轮廓、一抹印象，仿佛素描画师也许还能据此复原。可外围墙早已疏漏多孔、扭曲变形。大门旁——被岁月的锈染成褐色——立着一座早已干涸的喷泉，披着一层苔藓的斗篷。门内，粗壮蔓生的藤条攀上中央高塔。近处的车厢房曾是这片产业的骄傲门面，如今却在杂草斑斑的侵占下溃烂。

~ Envisioned by Minlune

The walls here were built long ago and have been ill-maintained, the soft touch of time bringing them down—or at least attempting to. The estate still bears a shadow of its former glory, an outline or an impression, something that a sketch artist could re-create, perhaps. But the perimeter wall is porous and misshapen. Near the gate—made brown with years of rust—sits a fountain long since dry, covered in a cloak of moss. Beyond the gate, broad creeping vines climb the central tower. A carriage house nearby, once the proud entrance to the property, now festers with patches of weeds.

~ Envisioned by Minlune

Saurian Looks Back On The Traveled Road.name:
蜥蜴人回望走过的旅途
Saurian Looks Back On The Traveled Road

Text.text:
琥珀色鳞片的蜥蜴人回头望向身后被他抛下的世界：一座笼罩在阴影中的堡垒，纠缠蔓生的丛林将其层层缠绕；更远处是一座高耸的雪冠巨峰，壮丽而庞然。蜥蜴人肩上披着一条破旧的绿色披巾，与他腰间用金质徽章扣住的精致红色裹腰布格格不入。无论他曾过着贫困或富足的生活，如今都已被他远远甩在身后。
The amber-scaled saurian looks over his shoulder at the world he leaves behind: a fortress cast in shadow, wreathed in tangled jungle; a looming, white-capped peak beyond that, beautiful and colossal. The saurian wears a ratty green shawl around his shoulders, which does not match the fine red loincloth buckled by a gold medallion about his waist. Whatever life he led before, poor or rich, he now leaves it far behind.

I Surrender To The City Guard.name:
我向城卫军投降
I Surrender To The City Guard

Text.text:
我双手摊开、空无一物地走向卫所，武器斜挂在身、仍在鞘中。“我投降。”我说道。注意到他们的踌躇与恐惧，我点头示意确认。的确，我本可以把他们全都杀了……可我不做任何突兀的动作，也不抗拒他们试图解除我武装的举动。对那副镣铐，我俯首受之。“好了，把我带走吧。”

~ Walt M. 所构想

I approach the guardhouse with my hands open and empty, my weapons slung and sheathed. “I surrender,” I say. Noting their hesitation and fear, I nod in affirmation. It’s true, I could slay them all… but I make no sudden movements and resist no attempts to disarm me. To the manacles, I submit. “Well, take me in.”

~ Envisioned by Walt M.

Celesta, The Young Wizard.name:
塞莱斯塔，年轻的魔法师
Celesta, The Young Wizard

Text.text:
尽管这位瘦弱得像流浪儿般的人手里拄着一根朴素的行杖，却根本不需要它的支撑。他们身披层层叠叠的长袍，色调朴素却彼此相衬，行走间带着训练有素的自信；那双黑眼睛警觉……又或透着一丝不安的戒备。暗淡的金发乱蓬蓬地垂在脸侧，刚好掠过耳下与额前，却并不遮挡那道目光。鲜亮的红唇同样出人意料——就像腰间斜挎腰带上那把醒目入鞘的长刀，以及行杖上若隐若现的符文。

~ 由 GraySkyl 扮演

Although they carry a plain walking stick, this waifish person—outfitted in layered robes of simple but complementary hues—needs no such aid. They walk with practiced confidence, dark eyes alert… or uneasily cautious. Without blocking that gaze, a mop of dull blond hair hangs around their face, just below the ears and down the forehead. The bright red lipstick is as unexpected as the long knife prominently sheathed on a hip-slung belt and the subtle runes on their staff.

~ Played by GraySkyl

Persuading A Henchman.name:
说服一名跟班
Persuading A Henchman

Text.text:
“你为什么要为了这些人去死？你只是个棋子。或者说得更直白些——你不过是你那些主人在棋盘上摆弄时，沾在棋面上的一层颜料。”
“Why do you wish to die for these people? You are a pawn. Or, to be honest, you’re the paint on the board that your masters are playing on.”

Quip About Being Incompetent.name:
自嘲无能的俏皮话
Quip About Being Incompetent

Text.text:
“好吧，我是有点搞砸。但你告诉我，要是我们个个都精明能干，那还有谁来衬得你这么体面？”
“Okay, I’m a bit of a screwup. But tell me this, if all of us were competent, then who would be there to make you look good?”

这块墓碑立在通往溪流的泥泞小径旁。它正对着通往山顶的阶梯，仿佛刻意摆在那里，好让从台阶下行的人一眼看见。或许正因如此，它才刻着这样诡异的信息：谎言通往真相无法追随之处。你正踩着谁的足迹前行？ This headstone stands beside a muddy path to the stream. It faces the stairs up to the top of the hill, as if positioned to be noticed by those descending them. Perhaps that is why it bears its strange message: Lies lead where truth cannot follow. In whose footsteps do you tread?

这座坟旁堆着一小堆石子，或许是人们在此徘徊沉思时留下的——他们反复咀嚼墓碑上的那句诘问：你会选择哪一个——漫长的一生，还是美好的一生？ A heap of stones lies by this grave, perhaps left by people pondering the question written on its headstone: Which would you choose, a long life or a good one?

I Cast Project Image.name:
我施展「投影化身」
I Cast Project Image

Text.text: 当我念出咒文的最后一个音节，我退入阴影之中，把一个与我分毫不差的复制体留在原地。我将意识沉入那道幻影，听见如水滴坠入更大水池般的一声：blip。如今我能以那名替身的双眼看见、以它的身躯行动，我的伪装表演就此开场。 As I utter the last syllables of my incantation, I step back into shadow and leave a perfect copy of myself behind. I drop my consciousness into the illusion, hearing a sound like a droplet of water hitting a larger pool: blip. Now that I can see and act as my doppelganger, I begin my charade.

Mountain Pass: Distant Mountain Waterfal.name:
山道险隘：远山瀑鸣
Mountain Pass: Distant Mountain Waterfall

Text.text:
你沿着山腰前行，一条溪流映入眼帘。它在陡峭的坡面与断崖间飞溅奔泻，化作一道白浪激涌的水槽，转眼没入雾气弥漫的裂谷深处。它必定会在山势更低处重新涌出，但从你此刻的视角，根本看不见出口在哪。
Your path across the mountainside brings a stream into view. You see it splash down steep slopes and drops, a whitewater sluice that vanishes into a misty crevasse. It must come out farther down the mountain, but from your vantage you can’t see where.

Urgent Warning With Magical Jargon.name:
夹杂魔法术语的紧急警告
Urgent Warning With Magical Jargon

Text.text:
“我们正处在一场大成功或大失败的汇流之中！这些quareial结构根本承受不住进一步的athurgy！”

[Clarification Requested] “快跑！看在神祇的份上，什么都别接触！”

“We are in the middle of a critical confluence! The quareial structures simply cannot sustain further athurgy!”

[Clarification Requested] “Run! And for gods’ sakes, don't touch anything!”

Noah Braun, 4th Year House Dolphin.name:
诺亚·布劳恩，海豚学院四年级
Noah Braun, 4th Year House Dolphin

Text.text:
魔法世界里的每支队伍都在争相追逐这位名副其实的诺亚·布劳恩。每逢赛前的魔法强化筛检，他那惊人的脂肪与肌肉比例总能让评审团目瞪口呆。他留着利落的寸头。对大多数人来说，他并不算特别英俊——那张脸更像是为了扛住拳脚而生，而不是为了取悦旁人。出乎那些爱以貌取人的人意料，他的成绩几近满分，却总差一点点才够得上能让他出风头的奖项。论运动能力，他仅次于他的谦逊。
Every team in the magical world is courting the aptly-named Noah Braun. At every screening for magical enhancement before a match, he amazes the panel with his fat-to-muscle ratio. He wears his hair in a buzz cut. He isn’t especially handsome to most people, his face designed more to withstand punishment than to charm others. Surprisingly to the judgmental, his grades are nearly perfect, just short of winning awards that would bring attention to him. His athletic ability is second only to his humility.

Cave Passage Widening.name:
洞道豁然开阔
Cave Passage Widening

Text.text:
狭窄的洞穴通道豁然开阔，空间变得宽敞起来，你不由得长舒一口气，这才意识到自己已屏息了好一阵子。当然，这片扩展的空洞也许是当初塑造洞穴的天然熔岩流所致……也可能是潜伏其中的庞然生物横冲直撞、以体躯之重生生撞出来的。
You heave a sigh of relief as the narrow cave passage widens into a more spacious configuration, and realize that you have been holding your breath for some time. Of course, such a widening expanse might be the work of the natural lava flows that originally formed the cave . . . or of larger creatures within, throwing their weight around.

Mobile Tactical Operations Center, Mark.name:
机动战术行动中心，III型
Mobile Tactical Operations Center, Mark Iii

Text.text:
这枚光滑的苍银椭圆悬浮在掌心，悄无声息。只需意念一动，椭圆便化作液态，猛然钻入使用者体内，不多时便覆上他们的视野。高科技的热成像、红外与赛博数据直接灌入抬头显示器。随着一套精密AI的提示，周遭威胁、武器、载具与最优战术方案一并投射进使用者的脑海。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

This sleek oval of pallid silver hovers in the palm, making no sound. At a willed thought, the oval turns liquid, thrusting into the user, and the device soon overlays their vision. High-tech thermal, infrared, and cyber data feed directly into the heads-up display. At the prompting of a sophisticated AI, local threats, weaponry, vehicles, and optimal tactical options all beam into the user’s mind.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

God Of Vengeance.name:
复仇之神
God Of Vengeance

Text.text:
复仇之神掌管一份名册。若将那卷轴彻底展开，它会延伸到人眼所不能及之处。他的头颅两面皆有一张面孔，狂野的发丝分别环绕着每一张脸。他通体如冰冷的灰石般惨淡，平日里如同他所肖似的雕像般伫立不动，直到需要他点燃某人对仇敌的报复——往往是暴烈的——之时。他天性耐心，可在这世界对复仇的渴求之下，他的耐心总在不断受试。
The God of Vengeance keeps a list. Were the scroll unfurled, it would stretch beyond human sight. His head has a face on both sides, wild hair framing each face. He is the color of cold gray stone and stands like the statue he resembles until it is time for him to inspire someone’s retribution—often violent—against an enemy. He is patient by nature, but with the thirst for vengeance in this world, his patience is always tested.

Guest Room In A Manor.name:
庄园客房
Guest Room In A Manor

Text.text:
房间里弥漫着丁香与薰衣草的幽香，陈设雅致：一张巨大的四柱床铺着蓬松的鹅绒枕与丝绸床单。房间一角摆着一对舒适的高背椅，夹击着仍在暗红余烬中闷燃的壁炉，把空间烘得暖意融融。靠墙的一张小书桌上放着一盆加了香料的清水与干净毛巾，静候任何人来洗去一日的污浊气息。宽大的衣橱里备着额外的衣物，尺寸与款式都为这间房的住客量身而设。
The room, fragrant with lilac and lavender, is furnished elegantly, with a large four-post bed laden with goosedown pillows and silk sheets. A pair of comfortable, high-backed chairs dominate one corner of the room, flanking the smoldering hearth that warms the space. Upon a small desk along one wall, a basin of perfumed water and clean towels await anyone who wishes to wash the stink of the day away. In a large armoire, extra clothes are provided, fitted to the room's occupant in both sizing and style.

Deaf Bard.name:
失聪的吟游诗人
Deaf Bard

Text.text:
鼓是这位吟游诗人音乐技艺的核心；那振奋人心的震颤取代了声音，引领着他们的节拍。他们娴熟地展示旋律与和声的法则——美妙音乐的数学，把古老的娱人艺术以笛音或舞步吹送、踏响，送进世界的耳中。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The drum is the centerpiece of this bard’s musicianship, the inspiring vibration replacing sound and guiding their beat. They skillfully demonstrate the principles of melody and harmony—the math of beautiful music, piping or dancing the ancient art of entertainment into the ears of the world.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Meager Tavern Breakfast.name:
寒酸的酒馆早餐
Meager Tavern Breakfast

Text.text:
看来一分钱一分货，而你面前这份可怜得要命的小餐便是最好的证明。几片灰白、薄如雾丝的培根仿佛只是和煎锅匆匆打了个照面就被端上了盘；旁边那一小勺正在休息的豆子更是把这幅凄惨的餐桌景象衬得愈发寒酸。吐司薄得像刀刃，栖在盘沿上，活像秃鹫盘旋于垂死的野兽之上。
You get what you pay for, it seems, and the pitifully small meal before you is testament to that. The wispy, gray rashers of bacon look like they were briefly introduced to a pan before being plated up, and the tiny scoop of beans resting alongside them further adds to the miserable culinary tableau. Slices of toast, thin as a razor, perch on the edge of the plate like vultures hovering over a dying beast.

一头鹿横穿你行进的道路，惊惶到了极点，仿佛只需说出一个音节的时代里，它就能朝任何方向猛然跃起。它那澄澈的眼眸带着惴惴不安，警惕地望着你。
The deer crossing your path is skittish in the extreme, appearing ready to leap in any direction in the time it takes to speak a single syllable. Its limpid eyes gaze at you with apprehension.

Pact Worlds Delegate.name:
星约诸界代表
Pact Worlds Delegate

Text.text:
一株小小的植物在持械卫兵的簇拥下踉跄现身。它矮小的身躯披着淡紫猩红的布料。几缕与脑茎相连的藤蔓从领口蠕动着向上探出，追逐着阳光。一簇蓬松的种籽为它的头顶加冕。华丽织物的褶皱间伸出灵巧的小手，裹覆着木质纤维般的护甲。那生物烦躁地抓挠着自己的手。
A tiny plant surrounded by armed guards totters into view. Their diminutive frame is draped in mauve-scarlet cloth. Vines attached to a brain stem wriggle upwards from their collar, seeking sunlight. A cluster of fluffy seeds crown the head. Small, dexterous hands poke out between folds of ornate fabric, armored in woody fibers. The creature scratches at their hands in irritation.

Alarms Sound After Failed Breach Of Fire.name:
在网域里，防火墙被强行突破失败，警报随即尖啸响起
Alarms Sound After Failed Breach Of Firewall In The Net

Text.text: 伴随着一阵如白噪般爆裂的数字雪花，万物骤然染红，警报凄厉长鸣。在赛博空间中漂浮的巨大字母里，尝试入侵，已启动封锁赫然浮现。黑客低声咒骂，拼命试图从防火墙中抽身，在反制措施启动前触及安全地带。 With a burst of digital static like white noise, everything goes red and an alarm wails. In huge letters floating in cyberspace, the words ATTEMPTED BREACH, LOCKDOWN INITIATED appear. Cursing, the hacker desperately tries to disengage from the firewall and reach safety before the countermeasures are activated.

My Magical Powers Awaken.name:
我的魔力觉醒了
My Magical Powers Awaken

Text.text:
当那一击命中之时，我感觉到体内有什么发生了变化。有某样东西苏醒了。一股痛到极致的能量洪流攫住了我，宛如烈焰般刺穿血脉；魔法随之生效，将我锻炼得如同淬火成形的刀刃。我感觉自己的双眼因力量而发光，抬眼迎上袭击者的目光，露出微笑，尽情品味他们脸上浮现的恐惧。

~ Envisioned by Ameria on Discord

As the blow connects, I feel something change within me. Something has awakened. A rush of painfully intense energy grips me, lancing through my veins like fire as the magic takes hold, tempering me like a forged blade. I sense my eyes glow with power, and I meet my assailant's gaze and smile, relishing the look of terror on their face.

~ Envisioned by Ameria on Discord

Tale Of A Lost Adventurer.name:
迷途冒险者之传说
Tale Of A Lost Adventurer

Text.text:
“很久以前，有一队冒险者自诩为这片陆海之上前所未有的伟大之师。他们所到之处，似乎总能荡平邪祟、止息纷争。然而，他们的道路最终引向了堕落之王阿伦——他强大到足以威胁奴役凡世所有灵魂。众人踏入堕落之王的疆域，一心要终结他的统治。尽管这支英勇之众成功将阿伦拉下王座，征伐之后却只剩一人活着归来。领袖“谦卑者”马伦将同伴尽殁的罪责尽数揽在自己身上——是他带他们走向了毁灭——于是于绝望中漫无目的地游荡。有人说，在最黑的夜里，他们会先听见行将断气的探险者的哭号，继而看见一名流浪骑士的身影。多数人把这归咎于迷雾的戏弄；也有人说，那正是马伦，仍在寻找那些被堕落之王吞噬的同伴灵魂。”
"Long ago, a group of adventures thought themselves to be the greatest the land and sea had ever seen. They seemed able to vanquish evil and end conflict wherever they went. However, their path led them to Aaren, the Fallen King who had grown so powerful he was threatening to enslave the souls of the mortal world. The party descended into the Fallen King's domain intent on ending his reign. While the gallant gang succeeded in dethroning the Aaren, only one survived the conquest. Maren the Modest, the leader, blamed himself for losing his comrades—leading them to their demise—and wandered aimlessly in his despair. Some say that on the darkest night they hear the cries of expiring explorers then see the image of a wandering knight. Most attribute this to the fog playing tricks, others say it is Maren, searching for the souls of his comrades that were devoured by the Fallen King."

Loft In A Manor.name:
庄园阁楼
Loft In A Manor

Text.text:
一对蜿蜒铺毯的楼梯通向阁楼。手工雕刻的栏杆将阁楼与下方宅邸分隔开来，其造型仿若帆船索具绳缆的繁复结绳纹样。几对舒适的高背椅与边几相伴，零星点缀其间；阁楼中央则下沉出一处会客区，铺满坐垫与靠枕，供人慵懒倚卧。靠着一面墙的吧台后方陈列着一整架世间能想象到的烈酒，来自世界的每一个角落。
A pair of winding, carpeted staircases lead up to the loft. A hand-carved banister, crafted to resemble the elaborate knotwork of rigging lines on a sailing ship, separates the loft from the manor below. Pairs of comfortable, high-backed chairs flanked by side tables sit here and there, and at the loft's center, a sunken seating area provides cushions and pillows for lounging. A bar along one wall includes a shelf of every liquor imaginable, from all corners of the world.

Herd Of Woolly Mammoths.name:
长毛猛犸象群
Herd Of Woolly Mammoths

Text.text:
冰封的大地在笨重的巨兽逼近时震颤不已，同族那嘹亮如号角的鸣叫为它们开道。霜雪以冰硬的团块黏附在它们浓密、赤褐的毛发上；当它们穿行苔原，泛黄的象牙长獠下垂落出一串串细致的冰晶垂柱。它们身后，大片被压平的枯草与深深外张的足印铺陈开来，清晰标记着它们的行进轨迹。
The frozen earth shakes as the lumbering giants draw near, heralded by the trumpeting cry of their kind. Frost clings to their thick, ruddy hair in icy clumps, and icicles form delicate crystalline stalactites below yellowed ivory tusks as they march through the tundra. In their wake, an expanse of flattened grass and deep, splayed footprints mark their passage.

Quasi-elemental Plane Of Steam.name:
蒸汽准元素位面
Quasi-elemental Plane Of Steam

Text.text:
世界是一片雾——无边无际的薄霭，接触之下清凉，入目之时怡人。它散发着柔和、漫射的光。你朝一个方向走，又换了另一个方向，却徒劳无功，根本无法辨明方位。雾永恒不息，无穷无尽，令人迷惘。
The world is a fog—an infinite mist cool to the touch and pleasant to behold. It glows with a soft, diffused light. You walk in one direction, then another, but it's no use attempting to find your bearings. The fog is eternal, unending, and confounding.

I Use My Scarab Of Protection.name:
我启用我的防护圣甲虫
I Use My Scarab Of Protection

Text.text:
我的圣甲虫在偏转法术的瞬间迸发出刺目的强光，使那股死灵能量无害地消散于以太之中。它摸起来温暖，镶宝的甲壳内魔法脉动起伏——仿佛在安抚我：我已被守护，不受伤害。
My scarab emits a blinding flash of light as it deflects the spell, causing the necrotic energy to dissipate harmlessly into the ether. It feels warm to the touch, as magic pulses within the bejeweled shell—reassuring me that I am protected from harm.

Magic Sleepifying Pacifier.name:
魔法安眠奶嘴
Magic Sleepifying Pacifier

Text.text:
婴儿圆润的小脸因原始的难受与需求而扭曲成尖叫，泪水顺着粉红的脸颊滚落。他似乎全然听不进那位疲惫父母的轻声安抚与摇晃动作，被倦怠的双臂抱着仍放声嘶嚎，越哭越崩溃。另一位父母向伴侣投去意味深长、近乎哀求的一瞥，伸手从床边取来一只小巧而华丽的木盒。盒内——紫色丝绸织成的巢中——静静躺着一个朴素的奶嘴，外侧面细细刻着三个 z。抱着小哭闹鬼的父母伸手取过这枚附魔安抚物，随着刺耳喧嚣渐渐平息，他如释重负地叹了口气，孩子也沉入深沉而安稳的睡眠。

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

The infant's small round face is contorted in a scream of primal discomfort and need as tears stream down their rosy cheeks. Seemingly oblivious to the soothing words and motions of the weary parent carrying them in exhausted arms, they bellow at the top of their tiny lungs, getting more and more distraught. Casting a meaningful, pleading glance at their partner, the other parent reaches for a small, ornate wooden box at the side of the bed. Inside—in a nest of purple silk—lies a simple pacifier, with three z's etched delicately into the outward face. The parent holding the little screecher reaches for the enchanted soother, sighing with relief as the cacophony subsides and their child falls into a deep and restful sleep.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

I Cast Divine Favor.name:
我施放神圣恩宠
I Cast Divine Favor

Text.text:
我高声呼唤我的神，诵念祂的名号，祈求赐我力量，使我得以惩戒祂的仇敌。异界的伟力涌入体内，我的身躯随之绽放出灼目的圣辉。我高举武器，蓄势待发，准备将神圣的裁决降临于不配之徒。
I call out to my god, invoking their name to lend me their strength, so I may smite their enemies. An otherworldly power flows through me as I begin to shine with radiant energy. I raise my weapon high, preparing to deliver divine justice to the unworthy.

Bewildered Woman Surrounded By Suitors.name:
被追求者包围的迷惘女子
Bewildered Woman Surrounded By Suitors

Text.text:
女人的双颊因羞窘而泛红，在座位上不安地扭动着，显然被那群着了魔般的观众目光压得喘不过气。她死死盯着自己的脚尖——这是唯一能避开与人对视的办法——并拼命在脑中搜刮一条脱身之计。

~ Inbal on Discord

The woman's cheeks are flushed with embarrassment as she squirms in her seat, clearly overwhelmed by the attention of the enchanted crowd. She stares at her feet—the only way to avoid catching someone's eye—and tries desperately to think of an escape plan.

~ Inbal on Discord

这座神庙以巨大的砂岩方块砌筑而成，由训练有素的工匠队伍严整安置。其巍峨身影在周遭荒漠无尽的地平线上突兀矗立，冷峻而格格不入。深入这座建筑的幽邃之处——林立的巨柱与精雕细琢的奢华纹饰熠熠生辉——无畏的探险者或许能发现无数被埋藏的珍宝……又或撞见一群对闯入者怒不可遏的信徒，痛斥这些远行而来的不信之人。
Crafted from massive blocks of sandstone, installed by disciplined teams of workers, the impressive edifice of this temple stands stark and contrary to the endless horizon of the surrounding desert. Within the depths of this structure—resplendent with columns and lavishly tooled carvings—an intrepid explorer might find any number of treasures buried… or a group of worshipers upset at the intrusion of far-wandering unbelievers.

一阵湿黏而吃力的咳嗽攫住了你的注意力——那是一道裹在破烂斗篷里的矮小身影。你看见一张灰绿的脸，尖牙外露，赤红的眼睛里满是痛楚。黑色的血像一层沥青般铺在那地精的胸口与腹部，它徒劳地按压着伤处，试图挡住那不断涌出的血流——也许，还是在试图挡住那不可避免的结局。
A wet, belabored cough draws your attention to a small figure wrapped in a tattered cloak. You see a greyish-green face with sharp teeth and red eyes shot with pain. Black blood lays spread out like a coat of tar over the goblin’s chest and stomach, where it tries ineffectually to hold back the steady stream of blood, and perhaps, also the inevitable.

当你从那只小小的、饱经风霜的瓶子上拔出软木塞时，一股刺鼻而令人清醒的气味猛地扑进鼻腔。你眼眶发酸，赶紧把塞子重新按回去，眯眼打量瓶中的东西。几粒细小干燥的晶体，像粗大的沙砾般，在深色的钢化玻璃里轻轻碰撞作响。它们怎么可能臭到这种地步？

~ 构想：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access
