A pungent, sobering aroma assaults your nostrils as you pull the cork from the small, weathered bottle. Eyes watering, you replace the stopper and peer at the contents within. Small, dry crystals like large grains of sand rattle softly against the dark, tempered glass. How can they possibly smell so foul?

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Townsfolk Give Report Of Monster Sightin.name:
镇民报告目击怪物踪影
Townsfolk Give Report Of Monster Sighting

Text.text:
“我们在山坡上的那栋老宅里翻找过。没什么邪祟，只是想着前任主人也许留下了些小玩意儿。我们找到一间密室；起初以为是地窖，可它大得离谱，甚至比整栋房子还要宽广。满地都是碎裂的玻璃与古怪的黄铜器具，空气里弥漫着腐烂的恶臭。我想回到楼上，但阿利斯特说他好像看见了什么……

”后面有一团东西。像是一群牲畜硬生生往彼此身体里钻，纠缠成一坨。我们盯着结痂的绿色脓液和扭曲的肉丝，那东西也回望了我们！乳白的眼睛从尸堆里浮出来时，我们拔腿就往门口冲。我拽住阿利斯特，可他的手在我掌心里像蒸发般消散。我离开时，我发誓听见了……笑声？像骨头磨着骨头。我祝你们好运，但我离开这地方。那生物看清了我的脸，我可不打算知道它究竟觉得哪里好笑。”

~ 由一位英雄 构想

“We were looking through that old house, up on the hill. Nothing sinister, just thought the previous owners might’ve left some trinkets behind. We found a chamber; at first, we thought it was a cellar but it was far larger than the house itself. Shattered glass and strange brass instruments were littered all over the floor, and the whole place stank of rot. I wanted to go back upstairs, but Allister thought he saw something…

”In the back there was this mass. It looked like a pack of livestock had tried to burrow inside one another. As we gazed over the crusted green pus and twisting strands of flesh, something gazed back! We ran for the door as milky white eyes emerged from the carcass. I grabbed Allister but his hand seemed to evaporate in my grasp. As I left, I swear I heard… laughter? Like bone grinding on bone. I wish you all luck, but I’m leaving this place. That creature saw my face and I have no intention of discovering what it found so amusing.”

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Dessamar Imago.name:
德萨玛·伊马戈
Dessamar Imago

Text.text:
一只紫色的拟人化蝴蝶灵巧地歪了歪头，红青相间的翅翼微微一振。他们身披简陋的树叶装束，其上点缀着各式各样的异域花朵。浓郁的芬芳萦绕周身，触角因好奇而轻颤；昆虫般的面孔上方斜插着两根细小枝条，咧开一抹灿烂的笑。他们的四只手紧紧攥住一根缠满荆棘的长杖。
A purple anthropomorphic butterfly with red-cyan wings nimbly cocks their head. They are dressed in rudimentary leafy costume decorated with alien flowers of all description. A heady fragrance surrounds them, and their antennae twitch with curiosity, two small twigs set above an insectoid face bearing a broad smile. Their four arms clutch at a staff bedecked with thorns.

你凝神锁定心之所向的目的地，脑海中勾勒那里的景象；当你在空中划出一道线，现实的缝合处便被你生生拆开。时代与空间如同从衣裳里被抽出的线般松脱，让路于前，显露出一道维度之间的通道。你无畏迈入其中，转瞬之间便在另一端现身，抵达目的地，仿佛不过一步之遥。
You concentrate on your desired destination, picturing the surroundings, and as you draw a line in the air, you undo the seams of reality. Time and space give way like thread pulled from a garment, opening before you, and you step fearlessly through the interdimensional passage. In an instant, you appear on the other side, arriving at your destination as if it were only a step away.

Story From A Spellcaster About A Badger.name:
一位施法者讲述的獾之故事
Story From A Spellcaster About A Badger

Text.text:
“有一次，在一场格外喧闹的酗酒之夜后，我醒来时发现自己变成了一只獾。我对这场变化毫无记忆，便干脆以为自己从来就是如此。我在荒野间游荡，掘穴筑巢，用爪子刨土寻蛆……交配。那是我这辈子最快乐的时光。”
“Once, after a particularly raucous night of drinking, I awoke and found that I had transformed myself into a badger. Having no memory of the transformation, I just assumed this had always been the case. I roamed the wilds, building dens, pawing earth for grubs… mating. It was the happiest I’ve ever been.”

Temple To A God Of Rangers.name:
游侠之神的神殿
Temple To A God Of Rangers

Text.text: [室外] 这座用圆木垒成的小屋立在峭壁边缘，俯瞰着一片辽阔的林地领境，仿佛阴影般压在林海之上。入口旁，两名守卫挺身而立——一位身形利落的半兽人女子与一名瘦长的精灵男子；弯曲木制的弓斜背在他们身后。他们穿着朴素的绿色束腰短袍与柔软的皮靴，长发皆披垂不束。半兽人女子嘴角微挑，带着一丝笑意说道：“旅人们，脚步放轻，呼吸放缓。”精灵男子向你躬身，他亚麻色的长发间编入了桉树叶。“我们在过去一小时里一直听着你们靠近。” [室内] 小屋的主厅挑高开阔，适合休憩与聚集；一架梯子通往上方的阁楼。厅中央是一口宽大的火坑，里面已备好新劈的引火柴；几名侍僧盘腿围坐，静默冥想。墙上挂着各式游猎胜利的战利品：一张带斑点的山猫皮、一片拉弥亚的鳞甲，以及一只赤色雄鹿的头颅。空气里飘着柑橘与薄荷的清冽气息——墙边悬着一束束草药与晒干的果皮。入口正对面的一扇门半掩着，你看见门外连着一座阳台。门槛上方，木头被烙出了字句：节制。耐心。兴盛。 [Outside] The log-built lodge stands on the edge of a cliff, looming over a vast woodland domain. A trim half-orc woman and lanky elven man stand at attention by the entrance, bows of bandy wood slung across their backs. They wear simple green tunics and soft leather boots, and their hair is kept long. “Gentle steps and hushed breath, travelers,” the half-orc woman says with a slight smirk. The elven man bows to you, eucalyptus leaves braided throughout his flaxen hair. “We’ve heard you approaching for the past hour.” [Inside] The main room of the lodge is a high-ceilinged place to lounge and gather, with a ladder leading up to a loft. A wide fire pit sits at the center of the room, ready with fresh kindling, and a few acolytes sit cross-legged around it in contemplation. On the walls hang the hides of various ranging victories: the spotted pelt of a mountain cat, the scales of a lamia, and the head of a red hart. The scent of citrus and mint hangs in the air as bundles of herbs and dried peel hang along the walls. A door opposite the entrance has been left open, and you see it leads out to a balcony. Above its threshold, words have been burned into the wood: Temperance. Patience. Prosperity.

Haunted Castle: Scary Spirits All Around.name:
闹鬼城堡：阴魂四伏，惊惧环伺
Haunted Castle: Scary Spirits All Around

Text.text:
你起初以为那只是远处的风声，或是火把燃烧的嘶嘶作响，可随即那声音渐渐凝成了人声。你听不真切那些词句，但低语已足够明白：你并不孤单，你也不受欢迎。有东西在这些大厅里徘徊——也许还不止一个。
You thought it was a distant wind, or perhaps the hiss of torch flames, but then it resolved into voices. Although you can’t quite understand the words, the whispers make it clear: you are not alone, you are not welcome. Something haunts these halls—maybe many somethings.

仿佛端坐在轿辇上的女王，一位高贵的女子踏着一群蜘蛛的浪潮向你们飘来。她披着一袭古怪却优雅的长裙，由象牙色蛛丝纺成，随着她举起乌木法杖、以冷峻的姿态致意而沙沙轻响。一张覆满蛛网纹路的威严面具遮住了她的面容——其上镶嵌的红宝石如蛛眼般排列。她的目光仿佛在掂量你们的灵魂，苍白的唇角扭出一抹毫无血色的微笑。
Like a queen on her palanquin, a regal woman floats toward you atop a swarm of spiders. She is draped in an odd but elegant dress spun from ivory silk that swishes as she raises her ebony staff in an austere greeting. An imposing webbed mask—set with rubies arranged like arachnid eyes—covers her face. She seems to weigh your very souls with her regard and twists her pale lips in a bloodless smile.

Barbarian War Paint, Woad.name:
野蛮人战纹颜料（菘蓝）
Barbarian War Paint, Woad

Text.text:
小小的罐子像粉饼盒一样，正好托在掌心。廉价的丝网印刷表面，仿佛碧玉般带着纹理的、红润的橙色。里面是一团蓝色颜料，厚得能让你用指尖刮起一点。气味像一座花园：健康、老派的一小块地，真泥土，真粪肥。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

The small pot fits in the palm of the hand like a makeup compact. Its cheap, screen-printed surface resembles the veined, ruddy orange of jasper stone. Inside is a glob of blue paint deep enough to scrape up a bit with your fingertips. The smell is like a garden: a healthy, old-fashioned plot with real dirt and real shit.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

你看见施放法术之际，一张幽影般的面孔浮现，雾气交织着紫与灰的色调。它在召唤时并不闪耀，也不噼啪作响。相反，它像最轻柔的一声叹息般进入这世界。它又如来时那般悄无声息地消散，飘向施法者送它去的地方。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

You watch a ghostly face appear as the spell is cast, the mist a mix of purple and gray hues. It does not flash or crackle upon conjuring. Rather, it enters the world like the softest sigh. It disappears as quietly as it arrived, off to where the caster has sent it.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

你以迅疾之势娴熟命中目标。你的武器发出清晰可闻的嗡鸣，迫不及待地震颤着，一圈苍白能量的光晕在其周围绽放。就在这极光般的光釜之中，纤细的电弧如指般游走，掠过你的武器。
With celerity, you deftly strike your mark. Your weapon thrums audibly, eagerly, as an aura of pale energy blooms around it. Inside this aurorean caul, thin fingers of lightning arc over your weapon.

Tapestry Of Sigil Power.name:
印记之力的织锦
Tapestry Of Sigil Power

Text.text:
这是一幅灰色羊毛挂毯，长十英尺、宽四英尺。法师念出通行密语与家族箴言后，挂毯便会化作该家族的颜色，并显现其纹章。法师还可向挂毯祈求援助。家族成员的状态越糟——无论是伤势、疲惫、糟糕的成绩，还是失意的恋情——挂毯所赐的魔法助力就越强。随后，它又褪回灰色。
This is a gray wool tapestry, ten feet long and four feet wide. When a mage speaks the passphrase and motto of their house, the tapestry turns that house’s colors and depicts its sigil. The mage may petition the tapestry for help. The poorer the condition of the house members—from injury, fatigue, bad grades, or failed romance—the more powerful the magical aid provided by the tapestry. Then it fades back to gray.

你拨开丝绸帘幕踏入店内。天花板的挂钩上，一排排布料、地毯与挂毯垂挂如林。空间中央矗立着一台巨大的织机，一位身材娇小的老妇人正操纵其间，似乎并未察觉你的到来。她枯结的手指敏捷地在机上飞舞，织机从巨大的毛线团里嗖嗖卷入绿色、灰色与栗红色的丝线，交织成一匹华美的布料，如流水般垂落至她脚边。
You step through a silk curtain as you enter the shop. Row upon row of fabrics, carpets, and tapestries hang from hooks on the ceiling. In the center of the space is a massive loom operated by a petite, old woman, who seems not to have noticed your entry. Her gnarled fingers fly across the machine with alacrity as it pulls in strands of green, grey, and maroon from great balls of yarn, forming a beautiful fabric that flows down to her feet.

Dungeon: Magical Brazier Room.name:
地城：魔法火盆室
Dungeon: Magical Brazier Room

Text.text:
房间呈圆形，四周垂挂着五彩斑斓的织毯。中央是一座火盆，盆口是抛光发亮的铜，宽得如同一张餐桌；底座则是灰铁铸成的方块，盆脚以螺栓牢牢钉在地面上。火焰高高窜起，赤红如血，空气里弥漫着松脂与雪松的气味。忽然间，它停止了流动——火仍在燃，却凝滞不动。伴着一阵突如其来的灰烬轻爆，它倏然消失，又在同样的瞬息间重现，这一次却是冰蓝与紫色，海洋的气息随之充满整个房间。
The room is circular and set with hanging tapestries of many colors. In the center is a brazier, whose cup is shining copper and is as broad as a dinner table. Its stand is blocky gray iron, with its legs bolted to the floor. The flame burns high and red, smelling of pine sap and cedar. Then it stops moving—a flame still but unmoving. In a sudden puff of ash, it disappears and just as quickly returns, this time ice blue and purple, filling the room with the scent of the ocean.

Lizardfolk Rebellion Against Orc Slavers.name:
蜥蜴人反抗兽人奴隶贩子
Lizardfolk Rebellion Against Orc Slavers

Text.text:
长着獠牙的兽人俯视着他们的蜥蜴人仆役，手里攥着散发恶臭、沾满血污的鞭子。皮革与骨头抽在鳞甲肉身上的脆响，换来的只有压抑的嘶声怒气。鞭子再度扬起、猛然落下——这一次却没有沉闷的肉响，取而代之的是兽人监工困惑的一声闷哼。一只覆着鳞片的利爪死死攥住了鞭身。蜥蜴人咧开嘴，露出湿滑黏腻的利齿，獠牙森然。他们朝兽人吐出一串异族言语，营地四周随即响起起伏翻涌的呼喊。革命，已经开始。
Tusked orcs stand over their lizardfolk servants with foul-smelling and gore-ridden whips in their hands. The crack of leather and bone on scaly flesh is met with silent hisses of anger. The whip cracks again, but instead of a fleshy thud, there is a grunt of confusion from the orc taskmaster. A scaled claw holds the whip in its grip. Wet and slimy teeth are revealed as the lizardfolk bares their fangs. They spit out something in a foreign tongue and are met with undulating cries from around the camp. Revolution has begun.

I Cast Polymorph.name:
我施放变形术
I Cast Polymorph

Text.text:
我指向我的目标，翠绿与银辉的魔法丝带在他们周身盘旋翻卷，直到将其层层缠绕，宛如线轴上的细线。我拇指与食指一捏，猛然将手向后一甩，魔法随之抽丝般倒卷解开。他们像陀螺般被抛得疾旋不止，而在旋转之间，他们的形体也随之蜕变，化作我所选定的模样。
I point at my target, swirling ribbons of green and silver magic around them until they are wrapped up like a spool of thread. I pinch my thumb and forefinger together and whip my hand backward, unraveling the magic. They are sent spinning like a top, and as they twirl their form transfigures into the one I’ve chosen.

I Let My Gem Of Brightness Shine.name:
我让光明宝石绽放光芒
I Let My Gem Of Brightness Shine

Text.text:
晶莹宝石安卧在我掌心，光滑的棱缘贴着皮肤，凉意温顺而舒适。我将它高举过顶，低声吐出指令——光芒一触即发，明亮而精明，所到之处，阴影尽数溃逃。
The smooth edges of the crystalline gem nestled in my palm feel comfortably cool against my skin as I raise it aloft. I mutter the command and every shadow flees at the touch of the light, a glow bright and shrewd.

Brenneri Ambassador.name:
布伦内里大使
Brenneri Ambassador

Text.text:
一只直立的水獭昂然站立，在光芒中神采奕奕地微笑着。厚实蓬松的绒毛外，他们身着一套体面的柔白亚麻礼服，金边勾勒出利落的轮廓。一条不知名的紫色披帛自肩头垂落，或许象征着他们的阶级与身份。腰间别着一把小巧的随身自卫手枪。他们眼中带着温和的善意，张开爪子作出欢迎的姿态。爪中空空如也——他们无所隐瞒。
An upright otter stands proudly, beaming in the light. Over their coat of thick downy fur, they wear a dapper suit of soft white linens rimmed with gold. A purple drape of some sort hangs from their shoulder, perhaps denoting their rank. A small personal-protection pistol sits at the waist. There is a kindness in their eyes as they open their paws in a welcoming gesture. The paws are empty. They have nothing to hide.

半透明的藤蔓交织成由丝绢般植物组织编成的网。那团纠结的中心，是一枚球形囊泡——显然正是你眼前这套花植体系的“大脑”。藤蔓散发着柔和的热度，渗出黏稠的液体，在向周遭环境伸展时缓缓拉长。
Translucent vines intertwine into nets of silken plant matter. At the center of the mass is a spherical bulb, clearly the brain of the floristic system before you. The vines exude a gentle heat and seep a sticky liquid as they stretch toward their surroundings.

Magical Detection Of A Monk's Class.name:
对武僧职业的魔法侦测
Magical Detection Of A Monk's Class

Text.text:
当你将洞见探出并收回之际，你抵达一片沉静的澄明，呼吸也随之变得格外清晰；你察觉自己的吐纳在一瞬间与目标同步——随即，侦测结束。
When you finish reaching out with your insight, you achieve a calm clarity and breathe in a way that you notice is synchronized with your target—just for a moment—then the detection ends.

A Bitter Exit.name:
苦涩的退场
A Bitter Exit

Text.text:
“也许我们之中有些人天生就无法共存。或许我们能撑到现在都没互相割喉，仍然不够。可我只知道，继续待在这里已经不可能了。我想，朋友们，一切就到此为止。”
“Perhaps some of us just can’t coexist. Maybe the fact we have stayed together this long without cutting one another’s throats isn’t enough. All I know is, staying here has become impossible. I believe this is where it ends, friends.”

Grease, Oily And Black.name:
油腻漆黑的油脂
Grease, Oily And Black

Text.text:
一团油腻的黑色物质从半空中的一点倾泻而下，厚厚一层铺满地面。所有身处该区域之人都开始打滑，每一步都成了考验，他们挣扎着才能勉强站稳。
An oily black substance sloshes from a point in midair, blanketing the ground in a thick layer. All within this area begin to slide, and each step becomes a challenge as they struggle to stay on their feet.

Speech By A Necromancer About Death’s Oc.name:
死灵法师谈论死亡之海的演说
Speech By A Necromancer About Death’s Ocean

Text.text:
“你为真理而战，却看不见我们所有人迷失得多深——不过是在死亡之海里徒劳踩水。随着我们的力量一个接一个地枯竭，我们便被拖向那无底深处。如今不时俯身触及，拉住些什么把它拽回水面，这难道不算英雄之举吗？”
“You fight for truth, yet fail to see how lost we all are, merely treading water in death’s ocean. As our strength fails one by one, we are drawn into its depths. Is it not heroism to reach down now and again to pull something back up?”

I Cast Flame Blade Using Components.name:
我以施法材料施放【焰刃】
I Cast Flame Blade Using Components

Text.text:
我用空着的那只手捏着叶片，低声吟诵古老的德鲁伊词句，眼看它在指间碎裂，化作灰烬。我感到自然原初的狂怒灌入体内，像肆虐的野火沿着血脉奔涌翻卷，直至一道燃烧的刃光自我掌中延伸，弯成弧形，烈焰翻腾，魔力汹涌。
Holding the leaf in my free hand I speak the ancient druidic words and watch as it crumbles to cinders. I feel the primal fury of nature flow through me, traveling through my body like raging wildfire, until a flaming blade extends from my hand in a curved arc, roiling with magical power.

I Cast Locate Object.name:
我施放“定位物体”
I Cast Locate Object

Text.text: 可见的光之回声在远处的各种物体上叮地一响，在我脑海里敲起一声细小的清鸣。我的魔法终于锁定目标时，一段铃音在颅内奏响，成片回声如涟漪般朝我该前往的方向荡漾开去。 Visible echoes of light ping against various objects in the distance, a small chime sounding in my mind. As my magic finally locates my target, a bell-song plays through my head and a flurry of echoes ripple out in the direction I should go.

Dragon Strafes Town.name:
巨龙掠城扫射
Dragon Strafes Town

Text.text:
巨大的阴影翻卷着掠过城镇，牵引着镇民仰望苍穹，瞳孔放大。它蝙蝠般的翼膜搅动纷飞的雪沫与烟囱的炊烟，关节与鳞片摩擦刮响，像石子掠过结冰湖面时那种颤颤的嗡鸣；巨龙盘旋，准备再度俯冲。它猛然下扎，始终贴着最高的屋脊掠过，眼中迸出冰冷的幽蓝光辉。掠过之际，那喙状巨口喷吐出同样污秽的光——一股骇人的洪流。在这炽亮的轰击下，墙垣与屋顶接连爆裂。冒着热汽的尸体滚落在未铺路的街巷里。尖叫的镇民毫无章法、毫无方向地四散奔逃；巨龙以雷鸣般的振翼攀升，回身再度转向，眼光闪烁不息。

~ 由 Ryan Brown 构想

A great shadow surges over the town, drawing townsfolk to look skyward, wide-eyed. Its batlike wings churning the flurrying snow and chimney smoke, joints and scales scraping with the warble of stones skipped on lake-top ice, the dragon wheels to make another run. It dives, keeping just above the highest rooftops, eyes flashing with cold, blue radiance. As it passes, the beaked maw unleashes a tremendous gout of the same vile light. Under the radiant onslaught, walls and roofs burst. Steaming corpses tumble in unpaved streets. Screaming townsfolk flee without logic or direction as the dragon rises with thunderous wing beats, turning back again with flashing eyes.

~ Envisioned by Ryan Brown

Threat From A Morally Dubious Quest Give.name:
来自道德存疑的委托人之威胁
Threat From A Morally Dubious Quest Giver

Text.text:
“你竟敢质疑我的意图？我需要的是能把活儿干利索的人，不是来絮叨什么道德哲学的。看来我的信任和钱，或许是投错了地方？”
“You dare question my intentions? I’m looking for someone who can get a job done, not prattle on about moral philosophy. Perhaps my trust and coin have been misplaced?”

G'roush The Brawler.name:
格鲁什「斗殴者」
G'roush The Brawler

Text.text:
半蹲着，凭借强劲的双腿与宽大的蹼足不停弹动，这个矮小的蛙形人皮肤湿亮，叶绿如新，只零星点缀着几处深色斑点。那些斑点映衬着他那对巨大浑圆的眼睛——眼睑半垂，却锐利得像能刺穿你。他脸上仅有的另一处特征，是一张几乎与头同宽的大嘴；嘴唇微微分开，露出细小圆钝的牙齿。敦实的身躯上，他只穿着一条帆布挽具，上面挂满口袋与小工具。原地起伏间，他屈伸着那双粗大的、指节凸起的手掌，迫不及待想要动手。

~ Played by Ross with

Half crouched and bouncing on powerful legs and broad, webbed feet, this short froglike person has glistening, leaf-green skin with a few dark spots. Those spots echo his large, spherical eyes, half-lidded but piercing. A mouth as wide as his head forms his only other facial feature, and his lips part slightly to reveal tiny, rounded teeth. On his stout frame, he wears only a canvas harness festooned with pouches and small tools. As he bobs in place, he flexes his big, knobby hands, eager to act.

~ Played by Ross with

它由浅色松木制成，雕琢打磨，长度逾一英尺，末端几近尖锐，并覆上一层光亮通透的清漆。底端宛如一滴被放大的焦糖液滴，正缓缓坠落。将这根朴素的指挥棒举过头顶，整支乐团的磅礴力量便尽在掌控。
It’s made of light pine, carved and sanded more than a foot long to a nearly pointed end and covered in shiny, clear lacquer. The bottom looks like a magnified droplet of caramel slowly falling. When raised above the head, this simple baton controls the might of an entire orchestra.

Gladiator Entrance To Arena.name:
角斗士步入竞技场
Gladiator Entrance To Arena

Text.text:
无数灵魂穿过这扇朴素的木门走入竞技场，每一个都被弥漫在这座辉煌苦难剧场中的死亡所烙印。无论他们是被送来迎接死亡，还是前来施予死亡，收割者之手都已按在他们身上——冰冷、惨白，如同坟墓。
Countless souls have passed through this simple wooden door into the arena, each one marked by the death that saturates this theater of glorious suffering. Whether they were sent to greet death or deal it, the reaper’s hand is upon them—chill and pallid as the grave.

Collapsing Space Elevator On Ecumenopoli.name:
塌陷中的巨型生态城空间电梯
Collapsing Space Elevator On Ecumenopolis

Text.text:
安全扫描仪显示，电梯的碳纳米管上出现了一片片劣化斑块。等到警报在终端管理局内传开时，已经太迟了。断裂发生在距离行星上空数千英里的同步轨道高度。整座城市——从地平线到地平线，唯有城市——在刺耳警笛与军事调动中仓皇运转。一场爆炸将碎片云向下抛射；与此同时，成千上万支送货队伍早已漂浮在空间中，夹在脱离的配重与大气层里燃烧成焰的物质喷流之间。
The safety scanners reveal patches of degradation in the elevator’s carbon nanotubes. By the time the alarms spread through the terminal authority, it’s too late. The break happens thousands of miles above the planet at geostationary altitude. The city—nothing but city from horizon to horizon—scrambles under klaxons and military deployments. An explosion propels the debris field downward, with thousands of delivery crews already floating in space between the detached counterweight and the flares of material burning in the atmosphere.

I Activate My Ioun Stone Of Fortitude.name:
我激活我的坚韧艾欧恩石
I Activate My Ioun Stone Of Fortitude

Text.text:
这块棱角粗粝的粉色石头，色泽宛如人体的肌肉组织；它绕着我飞旋的轨迹，像医师手杖划过的拂掠。僵硬与肌肉的结节悄然消散，我的呼吸不由得更深了些，浑身涌起足以做完活计、或迎战好几个铁拳狠手的打手的力量。
The rough-angled pink stone is the color of human tissue, and its course of flight around me is like the passing of a physicker’s wand. Stiffness and muscle kinks fade, I breathe a little deeper, and I feel strong enough to do the work, or take on the fight, of several hard-knuckled bruisers.

Quip About Preference For Cats.name:
打趣自己更偏爱猫
Quip About Preference For Cats

Text.text:
“你们凡人敬奉贤者与占卜师，追逐那些攀附更高力量、沉溺于朦胧预言的人，却对身边最睿智的存在视而不见，”那怪诞的生物低声咏叹，俯下头，轻轻蹭着脚边那只安静呼噜的家猫。“猫早已把你们训练得对它们的每个心血来潮都俯首听命，还会为它们稍稍承认你们的付出而欣喜若狂——比起任何凡人的智慧，我宁愿向它们求教。”

~ 由一位英雄 构想

“You mortals revere sages and diviners, people who cling to higher powers and vague prophecies, yet you ignore the wisest beings among you,” the monstrous creature croons, as it lowers its head to nuzzle the housecat quietly purring at its feet. “Cats have trained you all to cater to their every whim, and to rejoice over the slightest acknowledgment of your efforts—I would sooner seek their wisdom over any mortal's.”

~ Envisioned by a Hero

My Ring Of Regeneration Begins To Regrow.name:
我的再生之戒开始让我的断肢重新生长
My Ring Of Regeneration Begins To Regrow My Limb

Text.text:
断肢处燃起骇人的剧痛，痛得我几乎神智离散。我在血肉淋漓的下方死死按住，想要止住喷涌的鲜血，却瞥见魔法戒指上一缕摇曳的微光。寒意沿着脊背窜过，仿佛我的血已化作清凉的水。戒面宝石里猛然迸出一团绿白交织的光点，疯狂旋转，嗡鸣着掠过伤口，随后沉入那片受创的血肉之中。针刺般的麻痒袭来，我看见出血止住……紧接着，骨骼、肌肉与皮肤开始彼此牵连、重新缝合。要让肢体彻底再生也许还得花些时间，但魔法治疗的过程已经开始了。
The site of severance burns with such astounding pain my wits threaten to leave me. I clutch below the gore, trying to stop the bleeding, and catch a glimmer of light wobbling along my magic ring. A chill feeling runs through me, as if my blood has turned to cool water. A cluster of green and white lights burgeon from the gem of my ring, spinning wildly. They buzz over the wound and settle within the traumatized flesh. A prickling sensation, and I see the bleeding stop… then bone, muscle, and skin begin to knit back together. It might take a while to fully reform the limb, but the process of magical healing has begun.

先映入眼帘的是那截虬结的握柄，护手处中空。随后，一条柔韧如蛇的藤蔓从中滑出，伸展至全长时，尖刺如恶毒的镰刃般绽放。藤端昂起，宛如眼镜蛇的头颅，轻轻摆动，蓄势待发，随时扑击。
The gnarled handle appears first, the hilt hollow. Out slithers a sinuous vine, thorns blooming in wicked scythes as it stretches to its full length. The end of it rises up like a cobra’s head, bobbing and readying to strike.

Home Of A God Of Elemental Earth.name:
元素土之神的居所
Home Of A God Of Elemental Earth

Text.text:
大地构成了元素土之神的居所——他所栖居的每一片陆块，都与他的家一般宏大。若把巍峨群山中的一处洞窟称作他的一间房，那么你会见到神端坐于王座之上——那王座由他亲手凿削，平整而光滑，体型足以媲美整座要塞。千尺高处垂落着钟乳石，宛如达摩克利斯之剑，象征着那恒常逼近的威胁：来自那些无法像山一样思考之人。
The earth forms the home of the God of Elemental Earth, a home as large as any land mass he inhabits. Call a cave in a great mountain one of his rooms, then, and you find the god on a throne—chiseled flat and smooth by his own hand—the size of an entire keep. Stalactites hang a thousand feet up, Damocletian swords symbolizing the ever-present threat posed by those unable to think like a mountain.

I Commune With Plants.name:
我与植物通灵
I Commune With Plants

Text.text:
我用指尖夹着一片叶子，凝视着其上延展的叶脉，仿佛占卜者从掌纹里读出命途。我开口说话，可旁人能听见的，或许只有叶片轻轻的沙沙声，或是卷须在泥土里钻掘时发出的窸窣刮擦。
I hold a leaf between my fingers and regard the veins spreading along it, such as a seer might read the lines of a palm. I speak, though all anyone around me might hear is a slight rustle of leaves or the scratching of tendrils burrowing in the earth.

Small Mountain Encampment Of Soldiers.name:
士兵的小山营地
Small Mountain Encampment Of Soldiers

Text.text:
士兵们围着火坑搭起帐篷。一名斥候蜷坐在岩壁的凹龛里警戒放哨，身披鳞甲的同伴们则整理鹤嘴镐、绳索与抓钩，准备穿越崎岖的山地地形。无事可做的人正吃着一顿简餐：把硬面包浸软在熟鸡蛋流淌的蛋黄里——这些蛋是从附近的鸟巢里顺手牵来的。
Soldiers have set up their tents around a firepit. While a scout sits in a rocky niche, keeping watch, comrades in scale mail prepare picks, ropes, and grappling hooks for traversing the mountainous terrain. Those without duties eat a meal of hard bread softened in the runny yolks of cooked eggs—which were pilfered from a nearby bird’s nest.

一声野兽般的咆哮撕裂长空，脚下的大地随之苏醒。龟裂与翻涌的土浪一波接一波席卷而来，试图将所经之处的一切尽数掀翻。
A bestial roar tears through the air as the ground comes alive underfoot. Waves of cracking and shifting earth attempt to topple all in its wake.

干枯萎缩的内脏碎屑溅满此处地面，拖出一条骇人的血肉痕迹，蜿蜒向西延伸。上了铁栅的铁门像被丢弃的玩具般被抛到一旁，门铰从内侧被硬生生扭弯撕裂，残破不堪。污秽而空荡的牢房里，空气沉沉压在你身上——仿佛四壁正一点点向你合拢。
Dried, shriveled viscera spatters the floor here, forming a grisly trail heading west. Barred iron doors have been cast aside like discarded toys, hinges warped and broken from the inside. The air presses down upon you in the dirty, barren cell—as if the walls are closing in around you.

你缓缓侧向翻滚，在无尽的横向旋转里，呼唤灯光去照亮暮色虚空中那道你几乎辨不清的轮廓：一艘废弃船，航行灯尽熄，懒散地漂着，毫无方向。你用探照灯扫过船体，却看不见任何船员迹象；只有不时冒出的不规则闪烁灯光，仿佛毫无规律，也毫无目的。你那道光束冷冽而脆硬的质感，在老练的眼中清清楚楚地揭示出：这艘废弃船正饱受空气循环不畅之苦，大气包层薄得可怜，恐怕很快就会崩溃。忽然，来自那艘弃置船只的一声非人的哀啸尖厉地划过，令你寒毛倒竖——可它又消失得太快，紧接着沉默得令人发慌，你甚至怀疑自己是否只是幻听。
Slowly turning in an endless lateral roll, you call for lights to illuminate the shape whose outline you could barely make out in the twilight void: a derelict, its running lights extinguished, lazily floating without direction. Though you play your spotlights over the hull, you see no evidence of crew, only irregular flickering lights now and again, displayed seemingly without pattern or purpose. The crisp, brittle quality of your spotlights reveal to the experienced eye that the derelict is suffering from a lack of well-circulated air and that the atmospheric envelope is quite thin and will probably fail soon. An unearthly wail from the abandoned vessel suddenly keens, raising your hackles, but it fades so quickly and is replaced with such silence that you wonder if you imagined it.

纤瘦的提夫林弯曲的角从雪白、竖立的发间探出，几乎足以将人的目光从他那分叉尖细的耳朵上引开；而他蓝紫色的眼眸闪着显而易见的善意。微笑轻易便浮上他的唇角，但那笃定而优雅的步伐，以及随手可及的长弓，都昭示着他绝非可以轻慢之人。那件破旧、带尾的西装外套绷在他的皮革护甲上，隐约透露出一段奢华往昔；然而他磨损的行装与粗粝的气质，却将任何王公般的矜贵都彻底抹去。

~ Played by a Hero

The slender tiefling’s curved horns emerge from white, upright hair, almost enough to draw attention away from his forked, pointed ears, and his blue-violet eyes shine with apparent kindness. A smile comes easily to his lips, but his sure, graceful steps and the longbow close at hand mark him as someone not to be trivialized. The ratty, tailed suit jacket stretched over his leather armor hints at a past of luxury, though his well-worn garb and rough bearing belies any sort of regality.

~ Played by a Hero

空气仿佛在他踏入王座厅时微微错位；那具构装体每一步都像钟声轰然回响。他的金属身躯高大宽阔得骇人，吊灯洒下的柔烛光在其表面流转折射，让周遭众人都浸没在虹彩般的光晕里。他披挂着外突的板甲碎片，收束的金属轮廓透出精金不可摧折的质感，并带着一抹橄榄石般的绿意。那祖母绿的色泽在他眼中更为炽亮——双眼如暴风中的两座灯塔，巡弋般扫过王座前层层叠叠的祈求者浪潮。他的盾牌上潦草刻着一枚无法抹去的魔法纹身印记：旋涌的炫光线条交错汇成近似X的纹样，宣告这是一名战士，将在最后一息之后仍继续战斗，只为守护身边之人的性命。

~ Played by Hurricane496 with

The air seems to shift as the construct stomps through the throne room, each step like the pealing of a bell. His metallic form, massively tall and broad, reflects the soft candlelight from the chandeliers above so all those in his midst are bathed in a prismatic aura. Bedighted in protruding pieces of plate mail, the metal of his tapered form evinces adamantine’s indestructibility with its tinge of olivine green. That emerald hue is amplified in his eyes, which shine like twin lighthouses in a storm as they rove over the waves of supplicants surrounding the throne before him. On this shield is scrawled the indelible mark of a magical tattoo, swirling coruscating lines that intersect into an X-like pattern to denote a warrior who will fight beyond his final breath to protect the lives of those around him.

~ Played by Hurricane496 with

起居室乍看空无一人，但你听见一阵哒哒声，像只小山羊的蹄子落地。你瞥见边桌下方有个颤抖的阴影轮廓。一条矮矮的木腿从脚凳里一点点挪进光里，红色天鹅绒的软垫上垂着的流苏紧张地抖个不停。 The parlor seems empty at first but you hear a clip-clop, like the footfalls of a small goat. Your eye catches a shaking, shadowy figure underneath a side table. A short wooden leg of a footrest inches out into the light, tassels shaking nervously from its red velvet upholstery.

藤蔓缠绕的茎秆取代了筋腱与骨骼，构成这头怪异生物的树木之躯。葫芦莱西仅略高于一英尺，至少有一半的体型都来自它那椭圆、似南瓜的头颅。它的面部轮廓酷似南瓜灯。然而，与那些以粗糙刻痕凿出阴森表情的死物不同，这头生物的五官被永恒的微笑与宽大的椭圆眼眸柔化，显得温和而灵动。
Vine-wrapped stems, in the place of sinew and bone, form the arboreal body of this odd creature. The gourd leshy stands just over a foot tall, at least half of that size coming from its oblong pumpkin-like head. Its facial features resemble those of a jack-o-lantern. But where rough cuts etch a spooky mien on those lifeless decorations, this creature's features are softened by its perpetual smile and wide oval eyes.

城堡的金库通常是最戒备森严的房间，这里也不例外。它只有一个入口，昼夜有人看守，且没有窗户或任何其他能通往内部密室的开口；宅邸的大部分财富就这样被严密上锁，妥善封存于此。一只只铁制保险箱以朴实无华的挂锁牢牢扣住，对任何有真本事的窃贼而言，既是冷酷的考验，也是难以抗拒的诱惑。
The treasury of a castle is usually its most secure room, and this one is no exception. With a single entrance guarded day and night and with no windows or other portals allowing one into the interior chamber, this is where the majority of the household’s wealth is kept under lock and key. Iron strongboxes fastened with no-nonsense padlocks represent both a stern challenge as well as incredible temptation to any would-be thief worth their salt.

Underwater Hotel On Ocean World.name:
海洋世界的水下旅馆
Underwater Hotel On Ocean World

Text.text:
以举世无双的奢华，这座二十层的深渊宝石迎接着一艘豪华轿车般的潜航艇。艇身停靠在一处舱门前，舱门位于珍珠拱廊与活珊瑚的穹架之下。灯串在深海的湛蓝里安然起伏，酒店入口的玻璃门廊也透出温暖的光，每一扇窗都足有数码宽。内里，赌场迎接来客，行李员接过行囊并奉上鸡尾酒，成群的鱼群在旁穿梭不息。一条鲨鱼从中庭的穹顶上方掠过。
With peerless opulence, this twenty-story jewel in the abyss greets a limousine sub. The vessel docks at a hatch that is under arches of pearl and living coral. Strands of lights bob calmly in the blue of the deep sea, and more lights glow warmly from the hotel portal glass, each window several yards in diameter. Inside, a casino greets the guests, porters take bags and offer cocktails, and teeming schools of fish swim by. A shark passes over the atrium ceiling.

Fake Ring Of Feather Falling.name:
伪造羽落戒指
Fake Ring Of Feather Falling

Text.text:
恐惧猛刺你的心脏，你在坠落——直到你想起那枚魔法戒指。你攥紧拳头，逼迫戒指的魔法减缓你的下坠。可大地依旧迎面冲来，而你也随之意识到：那戒指或许是个赝品。
Terror jabs your heart as you plummet—until you remember your magical ring. You clench your hand, willing the ring’s magic to slow your fall. But still the ground rushes up to meet you, and with it comes the realization the ring might be a fake.

材料成分混合在一起，搅成一滩令人作呕的黏腻涂抹物，甜腻的糖与油脂糊成一层滑腻污痕。你念完咒语，刺耳的喳喳声猛然将你淹没。昆虫成群涌出那滩黏液，扑向四周，爬满附近每一处表面。它们振翅的嗡鸣、足肢与颚部的咔哒声充斥着整个空间。
The material components mix to create a sickening, slimy smear of sugar and fat. As you complete the incantation, a chittering sound overtakes you. Insects swarm, emerging from the smear of slime to cover every nearby surface. The whir of their wings, the click of their legs and mandibles fills the space.

小食肆里，酱油勾人的香气在空气中弥漫。出餐口后，厨师们在熙攘的灶台间来回穿梭，伴着厨房里不绝于耳的滋滋作响声，彼此高声呼喊着。
The tantalizing aroma of soy sauce fills the air in the small eatery, and chefs move to and fro behind the serving hatch, calling out to each other over the constant sizzling that emanates from the bustling kitchen.

Wild Magic Surge: Third Eye.name:
狂野魔法涌动：第三只眼
Wild Magic Surge: Third Eye

Text.text:
你的视野先是昏沉，继而明亮起来，仿佛刚走出洞穴后的最初几分钟。最诡异的是，你的视线似乎是从额头正中央延伸出来的。起初的朦胧骤然凝成清晰的焦点，赋予你更为敏锐的洞察力。
Your vision dims, then brightens, like the first minutes after exiting a cave. Most strangely of all, your sight seems to stem from the middle of your forehead. The initial bleariness snaps sharply into focus, granting you enhanced perceptiveness.

I Cast Misty Visions.name:
我施放了「迷雾幻象」
I Cast Misty Visions

Text.text:
我低声对阴影与光呢喃，手指以细微的动作将它们编织在一起。它们在我所指之处汇成一团薄雾，继而凝成虚假的形体——一场用来欺骗那些不肯细看之人的幻梦。
I talk softly to the shadows and the light, knitting them with subtle motions. They unite into a mist where I point. Then they take a false shape, a fantasy to fool those who fail to look closely enough.

在这座被遗忘的村落中央，一座古老的砖塔矗立在日晒灼热的峭壁前。它曾是宏伟的建筑，也许是贵族宅邸，或是市政厅；如今却被风雨啃噬得满目疮痍。几块褪色的砖已崩落不见，塔身靠近顶部处裂开一个骇人的大洞。塔基处，藤蔓缠绕的正门旁，你瞥见一根两英尺长的羽毛。它埋在坍塌的碎石与疯长的杂草间，却依旧泛着如抛光青铜般的光泽。你听见头顶传来低沉的咕咕声，以及巨大羽翼摩擦的沙沙响。你抬头，只见一只宽大的、狮子般的爪子伸了出来，阳光穿过它每一枚乌黑的利爪。它随即松弛下来，懒懒地垂在塔沿外。空气里回荡着粗砺的鼾声，听起来有点像沙哑的猫科呼噜。

~ Stefano Imperiale 构想

In the middle of this forgotten village, an old brick tower stands in front of a sun-soaked cliff. Once a grand piece of architecture, perhaps a noble’s home or a town hall, the structure is now heavily weathered. Some of the fading bricks have crumbled away, leaving a gaping hole near the top. At its base, near the vine-wrapped main door, you spy a two-foot long feather. Though nestled among the fallen rubble and overgrown weeds, its sheen is like that of burnished bronze. You hear a low cooing and the rustle of large wings above you. You look up to see a broad lion-like paw stretch out, the sunlight filtering through each of its dark claws. It relaxes, dangling over the side of the tower. A rough snore that sounds a bit like a raspy feline purr fills the air.

~ Envisioned by Stefano Imperiale

Forest Nymph.name:
森林宁芙（特征）
Forest Nymph

Text.text:
她的肌肤带着新抽芽尖般轻快的嫩绿；她的头发则是一圈丰茂的光晕，由苔藓与林下灌丛交织而成。她脚边，落叶聚成一双褐色的鞋，随着她细碎而轻盈的步伐几乎不发出沙沙声。她以低柔的嗓音对身旁的植物呢喃，手指如藤蔓新枝般伸展，去轻抚那些她触及之外的花叶。
Her skin is the sprightly color of a fresh plant shoot; her hair, a lush halo of moss and undergrowth. At her feet, fallen leaves form a pair of brown shoes that barely crackle as she takes delicate steps. She speaks in low, gentle tones to the plant life around her, fingers extending like sprigs of vine to caress the flora out of her reach.

Dry River Bed.name:
干涸的河床
Dry River Bed

Text.text:
一条浅浅的石砾谷地向两侧延伸，遍地散落着各式大小的圆润卵石。显然这里曾有流水时常穿过，但此刻河床已然干涸。
A shallow stony vale, littered with rounded rocks of all sizes, runs off in both directions. Clearly water must flow through here sometime, but now the riverbed appears dry.

Farmhouse With Thatched Roof.name:
茅草屋顶的农舍
Farmhouse With Thatched Roof

Text.text:
这座低矮狭长的建筑只有一扇小门。厚厚的茅草屋顶几乎垂到地面，没有烟囱，但缕缕炊烟却从茅草间袅袅升起，暗示屋内中央有一处炉火。住在这里的人想必终日辛劳，几乎无力负担任何奢侈消遣。
This long low building has one small door. The thickly thatched roof nearly reaches the ground and has no chimney, but smoke wafts up through it, hinting at a central hearth fire within. Those who live here no doubt work hard and can afford few frivolities.

你眨眼闭上双目，再睁开时，一道旋涌的银色漩涡悬浮在你倒卧的身躯上方。你试着站起，却发现自己正缓缓上漂，朝那团金属般的迷雾漩涡飘去；只需一个“移动”的念头，便有无形之力将你推送前行。你来得及回望一眼：你的身体像睡着般躺着，而一缕半透明的银光之索从你与它之间延伸相连——然而下一瞬，漩涡的牵引猛然一拽，将你吞没，把你带离肉身与世界，去往某个别处。
You blink your eyes closed, and when you open them, a swirling silver vortex floats above your prone form. You try to stand, but find yourself drifting upward toward the whirlpool of metallic fog, propelled just by the thought of movement. You have a moment to look back at your body, lying as if sleeping, and the semi-transparent cord of silvery light that runs from you to it—but then the pull of the vortex sucks you in, moving you beyond your body and the world to someplace else.

Toxanerus Of Clan Kembrak.name:
肯布拉克氏族的托克萨内鲁斯
Toxanerus Of Clan Kembrak

Text.text:
这位蓝宝石龙裔散发着无声却灼热的力量——低调得几乎不惹人注目，却恰恰掩不住他惊人的体型。对同族而言他仍算年轻，背负一张龙骨长弓，配着一只华丽箭袋，里面塞满由各式材料制成的箭矢；腰间还挂着两柄短剑。蓝宝石般的鳞片泛起迷人的渐变光泽，从微斜的颅骨向后上方盘卷的角，也闪耀着同样夺目的蔚蓝。他赤裸的利爪足踏过崎岖地形，抓地、攀爬皆迅捷如风。一只蓝色幼龙与他相伴，与其说是宠物，不如说是朋友与盟友。唯有与这幼龙互动时，龙裔才会暂时卸下那层强硬的面具：龙族面庞上冷峻的线条随之柔和，他伸手抚上这头生物。

~ Played by EZ

The sapphire dragonborn exudes a silent, smoldering strength—an unobtrusiveness belying his immense size. Young for one of his kind, he carries a dragonbone longbow, paired with an ornate quiver brimming with arrows of myriad materials and two shortswords that hang at his belt. His sapphire-blue scales shimmer with a lovely gradient, and the horns curling back and upward from his sloped skull gleam with a similarly striking azure hue. He moves across the rugged terrain with his bare, clawed feet, which grip and climb with speed. A blue drake accompanies the dragonborn, a friend and ally more than a pet. It is while interacting with this drake that the dragonborn drops his mask of strength for a time, the hard lines of his draconic face softening as he lays a hand on the creature.

~ Played by EZ

Low-quality Forged Papers.name:
劣质伪造证件
Low-quality Forged Papers

Text.text:
这些证件的覆膜俗气发黏，颜色也艳得刺眼。在这座监控无孔不入的城市里，廉价的身份就是求生的现金。这样的赝品经不起细看，却也许能让人侥幸从雷达下溜走。对那些没有门路搞到真货的人来说，这是孤注一掷的赌局，但只要能遁入无名的匿名之中，便是一份赋礼。
The gloss of the documents is tacky, the color too vibrant. In this city of invasive surveillance, cheap identification is the currency of survival. Such counterfeits may not withstand close perusal, but they perhaps provide a chance to slip under the radar. For those who lack the connections to obtain the real thing, they are a desperate gamble, but any way to disappear into anonymity is a gift.

I Cover My Trail In A City.name:
我在城中抹去踪迹
I Cover My Trail In A City

Text.text:
在城里变得匿名，和在荒野里是两回事。我不必担心脚印、折断的枝条，或营地留下的痕迹。我藏起脸——理好头发，压低帽檐，拉起兜帽——悄然滑入人潮。此刻我只是鱼群里的一条小鱼，流动的躯体与交错的声浪把我裹进无名之中。我任由人潮的牵引带着我漂一阵，随后终于悄悄溜进一条小巷，步伐迅捷而专注。
Becoming anonymous in a city is different than in the wilderness. I don’t need to worry about tracks or broken branches or traces of my camp. I hide my face—adjust my hair, my hat, my hood—and slip into the crowd. I’m just a single fish in a school now, the shifting bodies and clashes of sound cloaking me in anonymity. I let the pull of the crowd carry me for a while before I eventually steal into an alley, keeping a quick and focused pace.

I Cast Dominate Monster.name:
我施放支配怪物
I Cast Dominate Monster

Text.text:
我稳住身形，将心神尽数收束于唯一的意念：支配这只生物。我必须凝聚全部力量，压过它的意志，以我之意取而代之——这道链接必须牢不可破。我目光如钉，死死锁定我的目标——并吐出最后一个字，施放法术。
I steady myself and focus my mind solely on my intent: to dominate this creature. I must concentrate all my strength to overcome its will and supplant it with my own—the connection must be strong. I stare intently at my target—and speak the final word to cast the spell.

这柄铁柄战锤通体不见半点木料；沉重的锤头以秘银铸成，外缘缀以华丽的金丝花纹。一侧嵌着一颗硕大、多切面的祖母绿，折光如寒火般流转。宝石两旁细细刻着古老的矮人符文，粗略译作通用语，意为“矮人为矮人”。更令人费解的是，这柄战锤仿佛公然藐视它那短促的锤柄，竟在投掷时显得完美平衡。
This iron-hafted hammer contains not a single scrap of wood, the heavy head shaped from mithral and decorated with a fancy gold filigree. A large, faceted emerald is embedded in one side of the hammer. On either side of it, ancient Dwarvish runes have been carefully engraved, loosely translated into Common as “Dwarf for Dwarf.” Inexplicably, practically in defiance of the hammer’s short haft, the hammer seems perfectly balanced for throwing.

Vial Of Burnt Othur Fumes.name:
灼焦的奥瑟蒸气小瓶
Vial Of Burnt Othur Fumes

Text.text: [察觉] 一缕缕苦橙色的气体在厚玻璃小瓶内蜿蜒盘绕，结成细小的涡圈；瓶口上敞如喇叭，瓶身下部浑圆鼓起。小瓶被厚厚一层蜡严密封住，上覆纸质封帽。 [分析] 一位炼金术士曾说：“每当你不知道某种物质是什么却仍然照用，你多半只是做出了毒药。” 这些奥瑟烟雾的第一瓶，多半出自某个助手之手。你仿佛看见他屏住呼吸，把小瓶拖曳着掠过空气，猛地塞上瓶塞，心里默数着——还要几口气，他的导师才会咽下最后一息。 [Perceived] Wisps of bitter orange gas snake around in little coils inside a thick glass vial, flared at the top and bulbous at the bottom. The vial is sealed with a heavy amount of wax and a paper cap. [Analyzed] An alchemist once said, “Whenever you don’t know what a substance is and use it regardless, you probably just crafted poison.” Someone’s assistant likely came up with the first vial of these othur fumes. You imagine they held their breath, dragged the vial through the air, and jammed in the stopper, counting in their head how many breaths it took for their mentor to expire.

Create Food And Water.name:
造粮术与造水术
Create Food And Water

Text.text:
当你完成引导的瞬间，成堆的食物与闪亮、清澈的净水骤然出现在你面前，你的口中不由自主地泛起唾液。正如某位智者曾说，饥饿才是最好的酱汁；尽管这些给养谈不上多么可口，但让空瘪的肚腹安静下来的诱惑，对你而言格外致命。
Your mouth cannot help but water at the sight of the pounds of food and glittering, clean water suddenly appearing in front of you as you finish your channeling. As a wise one once said, hunger makes for the best sauce, and though the provender is not particularly flavorful, the quelling of your belly’s emptiness sounds extremely attractive to you.

Starship Refueling Station On Desert Mes.name:
沙漠台地上的星际飞船加油站
Starship Refueling Station On Desert Mesa

Text.text:
这座站点宛如一段三百米长的赤铁矿扭环，弓身立在弧线上，双角高高扬起。一个控制亭将站体底部牢牢锚在台地坚硬的硬结土上，结构表面那沉闷的蓝灰色被细密、锐利、经风冷刻出的沟槽划开；每一道沟槽都因嵌入的幽蓝传感灯而微微闪烁。双角内部布置着数套机器人电池转运装置与读数面板。由站点向外铺展开去，像红色荒漠高原上一片平顶屋檐般的，是绵延数英里的太阳能板阵列。
The station resembles a three-hundred-meter torque of hematite, balanced on its curve and with its horns up. A control booth helps to anchor the station’s bottom to the hardpan of the mesa, and the dull blue-gray of the structure is etched with fine, angular, air-cooled grooves. Each one glitters with embedded dim-blue sensor lights. Inside the horns are several robotic battery transfers and readout panels. Fanning off the station, like a flat roof on the red desert plateau, are miles of solar panels.

Elderly Crocodilian.name:
年迈的鳄蜥人
Elderly Crocodilian

Text.text:
老猎手在水下无声漂游，游动时几乎只是一抹影子，近乎漆黑的鳞片将它完美伪装。尽管年代已钝化了这头鳄形怪物的感官，它仍是它所认作猎物的生物眼中狡猾而可怖的敌手；当它盯上下一顿饭时，黄色的眼睛危险地眯起。
The old hunter drifts silently beneath the water, little more than a shadow as it swims, camouflaged by its near black scales. Though age has dulled the crocodilian’s senses, it is still a cunning and fearsome adversary for the creatures it considers prey, and its yellow eyes narrow as it sees its next meal.

法术完成构形，攀升至清醒，却仍停驻在你脑海里，无需言语或手势，便导引着它的灵能。它汇聚成潭，顺从你赋予它的形状——一柄刺刀。你望向刺刀本该在的位置：已刺入凡人躯体那敏感的血肉之中，没入一半。它缠绕着黑暗与自身思绪的蛛网，从你的心智中脱离，于彼处显现——正正落在尖叫的中心。啃食。

~ Envisioned by Pockets

The spell configures, rises to consciousness, but it remains in your mind, channeling its psionic energy without the need for speech or gesture. It pools and accepts the shape you give it—a bayonet. You look to where the bayonet should be, halfway into the sensitive flesh of a mortal body. Wreathed in darkness and the webbing of your own thoughts, it leaves your mind and appears right there. Right in the middle of the screaming. Feeding.

~ Envisioned by Pockets

烟雾的阴影笼罩着玻璃窗格，烛光在其后黯然摇曳。窗户狭窄，粗重的铅条纵横交错，让这座小礼拜堂更像牢房而非礼拜之所。门前的落闸铁栅更是将这印象钉死——即便饰以藤蔓与玫瑰纹样，也依旧像是一道有效的威慑，阻人入内……或阻人离开。
Candlelight flickers dimly behind panes of glass shadowed by smoke. The narrowness of the windows and thick leading make the small chapel feel more like a prison than a place of worship. A portcullis protecting the door completes the impression, which—despite its vine-and-rose decoration—seems an effective deterrent to entry… or exit.

Tasha's Mind Whip.name:
塔莎的心灵鞭笞
Tasha's Mind Whip

Text.text:
奥术咒词如针般刺破空气，将一道精神尖矢钉入你的目标心智。法术施放之际，一声如鞭裂般尖厉的音爆在你周遭回荡。
The arcane words pierce the air like a needle, driving a psychic bolt into the mind of your target. A sonic boom, sharp as a whipcrack, echoes around you as the spell is cast.

Sundries From A Beholder.name:
来自眼魔的杂货
Sundries From A Beholder

Text.text:
畸变的窥视者那庞大的球体撞碎在墙边，宛如一张骇人的巨口大张。巨眼死死盯着天花板，仍一阵阵鼓动着否定的灵光。数根眼柄已被斩断，致命性被削弱，却未必就此消散。
The vast globe of the aberrant watcher lies crashed against a wall, the horror of a mouth gaping wide. The great eye stares fixed at the ceiling, still pulsing with an aura of negation. Several eyestalks have been severed, their lethality blunted, but perhaps not gone.

I Count My Gold.name:
我数着我的金币
I Count My Gold

Text.text:
我坐在安静的角落里，清点自己的钱币。我一手托着钱袋，另一手开始数。为了记住数字，我压低声音轻轻说话，心里琢磨着在集市上能买些什么。脑海里先浮现的是些实用的旅行用品——压缩口粮、肉干、崭新的毯子、帐篷补丁——但同样也有微光流转的药水、新武器，以及附魔的小玩意。
Sitting in a quiet corner, I take stock of my coins. I cradle my pouch in one hand and begin counting with the other. I keep track of the numbers by speaking under my breath, softly, and wonder what I might buy at the market. Practical travel goods come to mind—cram, jerky, fresh blankets, a patch for the tent—but so do shimmering potions, new weapons, and enchanted baubles.

Contact Other Plane.name:
联络异位面
Contact Other Plane

Text.text:
这道法术从里到外都透着不对劲。那些词听起来不像任何语言。每一个音节都像从你口中迸射出一股无形的能量，刺穿生与死、世界与位面、现实与……外头某种不可名状之物之间的边界。那股力量一路向外钻探，穿过多元宇宙，朝着你想与之交谈的存在延伸而去。你不禁想，被这样联系上，会是什么感觉。会不会是个错误？可下一刻，你已无从回头。
Nothing about this spell feels right. The words don’t sound like language. Each syllable seems to propel an unseen energy from your mouth to pierce the boundaries between life and death, world and plane, reality and… whatever else is out there. This force drills farther out through the multiverse toward the being with which you would speak. You wonder what it must be like to be contacted in this way. Could this be a mistake? But then it is too late.

它光泽夺目、美丽得令人恍惚，像一件饰物，也像一柄武器。油亮的棕与焦糖色交织，被精心雕琢成对称与凶险的形态。它身上似乎灌注着更深层的力量——也许是野兽的灵魂，也许是某种仪式的锻造。或许两者兼有。
The shine and beauty of it make it seem an ornament as much as a weapon. Glossy brown and caramel, it has been carefully crafted into symmetry and danger. Something about it seems imbued with a deeper energy—perhaps the soul of the animal, perhaps a ritual crafting. Maybe both.

Sundries From A Hippogriff.name:
狮鹫杂货铺
Sundries From A Hippogriff

Text.text:
角鹰兽的一只蹄子上被刻出了纹饰，图案相当精美。它身上还有些松动却已破损的羽毛，可以拔下来。
One of the hippogriff’s hooves has been etched, and the design is quite beautiful. There are also loose but damaged feathers that can be plucked from the body.

Portal To The Astral Plane.name:
通往星界位面的传送门
Portal To The Astral Plane

Text.text:
这道镜面般的传送门，想必正是“踏入自身倒影”这一说法的源头。你走近时，映出的身影先是一阵模糊，随即穿过那层如液态银光般的光泽。
This mirror-like portal must be where the concept of stepping through your own reflection originated. Your reflection is blurry as you step up, then through the sheen of liquid silver.

[察觉] 你的目光掠过草丛间一抹寒光，那绝非晨露的闪亮。一张铁齿巨口——捕兽夹——被彻底张开，等待咬住某个在区域内游荡的、体型必定极其庞大的生物的腿。如此体型的陷阱足以瞬间夺走路过的兔子或狐狸的性命——它是为狼、熊，或更糟的东西准备的。

[触发] 你的脚踩到的东西比一路跋涉的柔软草皮更为坚硬。随即响起一声金属的叮——！，紧接着咔嚓！一声，成排铁齿猛然合拢，死死夹住你的小腿与膝盖。

[Perceived] Your eye catches a gleam in the grass that heralds more than the morning dew. A maw of iron teeth, a foothold trap, has been stretched out to snap upon the leg of what must be a very large creature roaming the area. A trap this size would instantly kill a wandering rabbit or fox—this has been laid out for a wolf, a bear, or something much worse.

[Triggered] Your foot steps onto something more solid than the soft turf you’ve been trekking on. A metallic twing! sounds, followed by a SNAP! as a set of iron teeth clamp around your calf and knee.

小妖精（特征）几乎只比一只花栗鼠高一点。他们那对软塌塌、叶片般的耳朵垂在脸颊两侧，皮肤青绿而绒毛茸的，像大豆荚的表面。他们神情谨慎，却毫无怯懦之色；那双亮粉色的眼睛直直瞪着你，锐利得像柑橘的刺痛。他们手里握着一张枝条编成的弓，弓弦绷得笔直，闪着冷光，宛如蛛网。
The sprite stands barely taller than a chipmunk. Their floppy, leaf-like ears drape down either side of their face, skin green and fuzzy like the pods of soybeans. Their demeanor, while cautious, shows no sign of cowardice and their bright pink eyes glare at you, stinging like citrus. They holds a twiggy bow in their hands, string taut and glinting like spider’s web.

地平线上，一抹灰色薄霭缓缓升起，融入湛蓝天幕。某处有一场不小的火在燃烧，借着那缕烟柱，辨明它的方向并不费事。
On the horizon, there is a smudge of gray haze floating up to be absorbed into the blue sky. A fire of some size is ablaze, and thanks to the smoke, it is no great chore to divine its direction.

Granting The Gift Of Gab.name:
授予健谈之赋礼
Granting The Gift Of Gab

Text.text:
你念出最后的咒文，眼看着你的目标双眼急促地眨动，随即蒙上一层浑浊的雾色。只消片刻，那雾翳便散去，他们的目光重新澄明，而整个人骤然显得更为善言。说话时语调娴熟而自信，词句自唇间流淌得恰到好处，轻松得仿佛不费吹灰之力。
You speak the final incantation and watch as your target’s eyes blink rapidly and become cloudy. It takes only a moment for their eyes to clear, and they suddenly appear to be more articulate. They speak with a practiced and confident tone, the words flowing from their lips perfectly and effortlessly.

Rallying Speech About Losing.name:
一番关于败北的激励演说
Rallying Speech About Losing

Text.text:
“我环顾你们每一个人，看到的是伤痕累累的躯体与阴郁沉重的面容，但别从那份失落的感觉中逃开。抓住它。失败自有力量；它教会我们自身的界限，而只有当我们看清那些界限时，才能将其跨越！”
“I look around at all of you and I see are battered bodies and dour faces, but do not run from that feeling of loss. Hold on to it. There is a power in losing; it teaches us our limitations, and only when we know those can we exceed them!”

会堂在这座霓虹闪烁、钢筋水泥丛林般的城市里，提供了一处令人心安的宁静与归属的绿洲。你一踏入门内，便迎上会众含笑的面庞——他们围聚在深色、抛光发亮的高起讲坛旁。一位身材圆润的拉比展开神圣的《妥拉》，并邀请你留下来一同祈祷。
The synagogue provides a welcome oasis of peace and community in the neon concrete jungle of the city. As you enter, you are greeted by the smiling faces of worshippers gathered around the raised bimah of dark, polished wood. A portly rabbi unfurls the sacred Torah and invites you to stay for prayer.

Magical Street Drug, Hecate's Blessing.name:
魔法街头毒品：赫卡忒的祝福
Magical Street Drug, Hecate's Blessing

Text.text:
从一株觉醒枫树的树液中蒸馏而成，赫卡忒的祝福被加工为虹彩流转、琥珀色泽的晶体，内里透出一缕微弱的光，仿佛在暗处轻轻闪烁。晶体在接触时脆弱纤细，表面光滑得近乎液态，在两次心跳之间的静默里微微脉动。将它托在掌心，它便开始溶解，逸散出甜润、带树脂感的西普香气。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

Distilled from the sap of an awakened maple, Hecate’s Blessing is processed into iridescent, amber-hued crystals that shimmer with a faint internal light. The crystal is delicate to the touch, with a smooth, almost liquid surface that pulses in the stillness between your heartbeats. Held in your palm, it will begin to dissolve, releasing a sweet, resinous chypre scent.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Stealthy Dark Elf Leaves Rose On Pillow.name:
潜行的黑暗精灵在枕边留下玫瑰
Stealthy Dark Elf Leaves Rose On Pillow

Text.text:
女子如绸缎般的暗影，悄无声息地从敞开的窗中滑入，脚尖几乎不沾地，轻盈掠向床榻。她紫罗兰色的肌肤映着月光，宛若致命颠茄的花瓣；自头至脚披覆着午夜般漆黑的护甲。她将一朵玫瑰轻放在枕上，随即隐入夜色，翻身越过窗沿，身姿矫健得像一缕风。枕上，那朵黑玫瑰端庄静卧，如等待的情人；花茎上系着一条素雅的羊皮纸条。

~ 设想者：Belial，来自 Discord

Like a silken shadow, the woman slips quietly through the open window, her feet barely touching the floor as she glides toward the bed. Her violet skin catches the moonlight, like petals of deadly nightshade, and she is clad head to toe in midnight-black armor. Depositing a single rose upon the pillow, she slips away into the night, vaulting the ledge acrobatically as she does so. On the pillow, the black rose rests demurely like a waiting lover, an elegant strip of parchment tied around the stem.

~ Envisioned by Belial on Discord

Magical Street Drug, Deep Weed.name:
魔法街头毒品：深渊草
Magical Street Drug, Deep Weed

Text.text:
海藻般的纤维生物材料被人为编织进一团磷光苔藓之中，凝成一束致密、渐尖的螺旋深草。它呈锥形，专为稳稳嵌入大多数吸烟器具的烟斗碗而设计，可在数分钟内缓慢而均匀地燃烧。泥炭与雨后土腥的芳香缕缕升起。只需烛火那点朴素的魔法，这气味便会勾起某种原始的渴望，催你点燃这药，深深吸入它更真实的气息。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Kelpy strands of fibrous biomaterial are artificially woven through a clump of phosphorescent moss to form the dense tapering spiral of deep weed. Its conical shape is designed to fit snugly in the bowl of most types of smoking apparatus for a slow and even burn over several minutes. Aromatic wafts of peat and petrichor rise from the clump. With a candle’s simple magic, the smell triggers some primal desire to light the drug and breathe deep its truer scent.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Averon Dolus.name:
阿维隆·多鲁斯
Averon Dolus

Text.text:
法庭巫师猝不及防被捅穿之后，厅内的寂静只被受害者最后一口抽搐般的喘息打破，随之而来的是动脉伤口喷涌而出的血液，啪嗒啪嗒地重重溅落。至于凶手：他的身形，以及那柄朴素的餐刀——深深没入巫师背脊——先是微微摇曳，继而如蜡般融化消散，露出一名瘦长的精灵：暗紫色皮肤，披着午夜蓝长袍，点缀金色亮片织线，手里攥着一把三棱刃短刀，刀身上蓝色符印幽幽发光。那暗精灵脸上死死钉着一抹邪笑，与他暗红的虹膜、漆黑的巩膜相映，更显阴森骇人。他伸出空着的那只手，厉声吐出一个音节，一根顶端嵌着琥珀晶石的奥术短杖仿佛从影子里凭空滋长而出。

~ 由一位英雄扮演

The silence in the room following the unforeseen stabbing of the court wizard is broken only by the final, shuddering breath of the victim and the loud splatters of blood gushing from the arterial wound. As for the murderer: both his form and the form of the simple eating knife plunged into the wizard’s back shimmer then melt away, revealing a lanky elf with dark purple skin, clad in midnight blue robes with accents of gold lame, clutching a triangular-bladed knife glowing with blue sigils. An evil grin is plastered on the dark elf’s face, a ghastly expression, especially when partnered with the dark red irises and black sclera of his eyes. Holding out his empty hand, he barks a single syllable, and an arcane quarterstaff with an amber crystal embedded in the top appears to grow out of nothing more than shadow.

~ Played by a Hero

新生的卓尔拥有黑曜石般的肌肤、刺目的雪白长发，以及血红的双眼。置身阴影与暗处时，他们的瞳孔会立刻放大、失去焦点，却也在瞬间适应了黑暗。
The newborn drow has obsidian skin, stark white hair, and blood-red eyes. In shade and shadow, their pupils immediately dilate, unfocused, but accustomed immediately to the darkness.

Rope Bridge In Sweltering Heat.name:
酷暑炙烤下的绳索吊桥
Rope Bridge In Sweltering Heat

Text.text:
你抹去额头的汗水，俯身审视脚下那几缕细绳——它们横跨在下方咆哮的激流之上。烈日当空，你抓住桥缘，只觉它令人心惊地摇晃起来。秃鹫盘旋，刺耳的啼叫像在嘲弄你的犹豫。其一只食腐鸟落在不远处，瞪着毫不眨眼的眼睛死死盯住你。
Wiping sweat from your brow, you examine the thin lengths of rope spanning the raging river far below. The sun beats down as you grasp the edge of the bridge, feeling it sway alarmingly. Vultures circle, their raucous cries mocking your indecision. One of the scavengers lands nearby and stares at you with unblinking eyes.

Loot From A Griffon.name:
狮鹫的战利品
Loot From A Griffon

Text.text:
除了狮鹫的心脏与羽毛本身具备的工艺价值外，它那只骇人的利爪上还套着一条类人生物式样的腰带，由铜质勋章串成，价值180枚铜币。
In addition to the craft value of the griffon’s heart and feathers, it wears on one of its impressive talons a belt of humanoid design, made of copper medallions worth 180 copper pieces.

这只古怪、鬼灵精般的生物拍打着薄如纸、革质的翅膀四处窜飞。尘土与霉味总先一步宣告它的逼近，而灰色、如石般的皮肤上似乎不停簌簌落下砂砾。它以鹰隼般的尖鼻领着身形俯冲而下，细小的眼珠闪烁着狡黠的光。
The strange, impish creature flits about on thin, leathery wings. The smell of dust and mildew precedes its approach, and grit seems to fall constantly from its gray, stone-like skin. It leads its flight with a hawkish nose, beady eyes flashing with cunning as it descends.

自从你踏进店门，那位年轻的女掌柜就睁大了眼睛，几乎每隔几秒就抛来一个问题，纵容着她对你冒险者出身、生活方式，以及你最近壮举的好奇。被这样一颗好奇的灵魂真诚地关注你的行当，多少令人耳目一新；可你也不禁怀疑，这背后是否另有用意。
Questions bombard you every few seconds as the young shopkeeper, wide-eyed since you entered the store, indulges her curiosities regarding your adventurous origins, your way of life, and your recent exploits. Though it is somewhat refreshing to have a curious soul show such a true interest in your activities, you wonder if there is some ulterior motive at play.

I Cast Inflict Wounds.name:
我施放《造成伤口》
I Cast Inflict Wounds

Text.text:
我将手按在我的目标身上，随着我吐出这道法术的污秽咒词，一股非自然的寒意翻搅着我的内脏。剧痛如尖刺般贯穿我的手掌片刻，随即钻入我的敌人体内。破碎狰狞的伤口在他们的皮肉上骤然绽开，死灵能量灼烧着他们，使皮肤瞬间枯萎、肌肉立刻萎缩。
Placing my hand upon my target, I feel an unnatural cold twist my guts as I utter the foul words of the spell. Pain lances through my hand for a moment before entering my foe. Ragged wounds open across their flesh as the necrotic energy burns them, causing skin to wither and muscles to atrophy in an instant.

侏儒那双鲜亮的蓝眼睛里，探究的火花已然熄灭，如今空洞地凝望着虚无，曾经的好奇心仿佛燃尽的蜡烛一般彻底湮灭。那件磨损得发亮的皮围裙上挂满工具，裹住了他们的躯干——可到头来，它也没能提供多少庇护。
The inquisitive spark has faded from the gnome’s vibrant blue eyes, now staring blankly into oblivion, their curiosity extinguished like a spent candle. A well-worn leather apron festooned with tools encompasses their torso—though it provided little protection in the end.

Wild Magic Surge: Potted Plant.name:
狂野魔法涌动：盆栽植物
Wild Magic Surge: Potted Plant

Text.text:
当你收束法术的尾音，你的四肢忽然变得如橡胶般绵软，身躯被挤压又被拉伸。一阵惊惶的刺痛迅速褪去，化作平静的接受——你竟能感受到空气轻挠着你的……叶片？战场四周的混乱对你而言已无关紧要——毕竟你的根系正安安稳稳地扎在一只深深的花盆里，盆中满是潮湿的泥土。
As you conclude your spell, your limbs suddenly feel rubbery, your body squeezed and stretched. A twinge of panic fades into calm acceptance as you become sensate to the subtleties of the air tickling your… leaves? The surrounding chaos of battle is nothing to you—not when your roots are ensconced in a nice, deep pot of damp soil.

Protection From Poison.name:
防毒护佑
Protection From Poison

Text.text:
随着你手掌一触，治疗能量被引导进目标体内。一股奇异的搏动感席卷全身，法术冲刷出毒素杂质，并赋予他们抵御此类伤害的防护。
With the touch of your hand, healing energy is channeled into the body of your target. A curious pulsing sensation floods through their body as the spell flushes out poison impurities and lends defense against such harm.

Sedrick Beoullve The Tactician.name:
塞德里克·博乌尔夫　战术家
Sedrick Beoullve The Tactician

Text.text:
他一脚在前，摆出宽阔的战斗架势，黑沉的眼睛谨慎地扫视四周。棕发剪得很短，若不是掺着几缕灰白，本会是同一色泽。他一边守夜般注视着，一边绷紧结实而剃得干净的下颌。手中那面伤痕累累的风筝盾举在身前待发，长剑则收在后方，剑尖向下，贴近后腿。无数战斗留下的痕迹斑驳在他身上的半身板甲上。可和他整套行头一样，这套护甲依旧擦拭得一尘不染，保养得当。近旁两名少年——一名半精灵与一名人类——紧挨着站着，目不转睛地观察他的每一个动作。

~ Played by >TSYGAN

Standing in a wide battle stance with one foot forward, this man assesses his surroundings carefully with his dark eyes. His brown hair, clipped short, would be the same color if not for the touches of gray. He clenches his strong, clean-shaven jaw as he watches. He holds a battle-scarred kite shield at the ready, forward, keeping his longsword back and pointed downward near his rear leg. Marks from countless battles mar the half plate he wears. As with all his kit, however, the armor is clean and in good repair. Two teenagers—a half-elf and a human—stand close nearby, observing his every move.

~ Played by >TSYGAN

你接触着材料袋里那处你知道彩砂藏匿的地方，想象自己的手穿过皮革将它扯出，朝敌人猛然抛洒。你的指尖拖出一道彩虹，扇形铺展成一片璀璨夺目的光阵。耀眼的闪光在你视野里烙下残影，但你的敌人可要凄惨得多。
You touch the place in your component pouch where you know the colored sand lies hidden, and you imagine your hand pulls it though the leather to fling at your foes. A rainbow follows your fingers and fans out in a scintillating array of lights. The bright flash leaves a shadow in your vision, but your enemies have it much worse.

通往林中空地的阴影小径常被许多人忽略。它在灌木丛间蜿蜒前行，不过比一条鹿径略清晰些。尽头矗立着一座朴素却舒适的村落，住屋依着参天巨树的树干环绕搭建。房舍似由倒木的木料、折落的枝桠，以及交织的树根与藤蔓编构而成。精灵们举止谨慎，目光狐疑游移；他们的手从不远离长矛的柄端或弓身的长度。
The shadowed trail leading to the forest clearing goes unnoticed by many. It winds its way through the underbrush, little more than a deer trail. At its end stands a modest but comfortable village, with dwellings erected around the trunks of towering trees. The houses appear built of lumber from fallen trees, downed branches, and woven roots and vines. The elves move warily and eye suspiciously. Their hands are never far from the haft of a spear or the length of a bow.

Speech From A Squirrel.name:
来自松鼠的发言
Speech From A Squirrel

Text.text:
“什么？！想要什么？拿走？他们总是拿走。我的特别藏货藏得很深。绝不会告诉你这笨重的地表佬。”
“What?! What want? Take? They always take. My special stash hidden. Will never tell lumbering groundling.”

Carnivorous Forest On Jungle World.name:
丛林世界的食肉森林
Carnivorous Forest On Jungle World

Text.text:
在滴水的寂静中，粗如野蛮人臂膀的藤蔓缠绕树干，伸至其触及的顶端时向外弯折，仿佛蛇头探出。凤梨科植物与蕨类散发着有毒的气息，或露出锯齿般的叶缘，但此地无处不在的味道，是腐肉的腥臭。一株巨大的杜鹃，体型宛如一座小屋，用卷须攫着一只鹿——已死、几乎被吞尽却仍湿淋淋的残躯，成团成团地滴落，坠入植株根部的泥土之中。
In the dripping quiet, vines as thick as barbarian arms twist around tree trunks and bend outward at the top of their reach like snake heads. Bromeliad and ferns smell toxic or show serrated edges, but the pervasive smell here is of rotting meat. One giant rhododendron, the size of a small house, holds in its tendrils a deer, dead and mostly gone but still wet, dropping in masses into the earth at the base of the plant.

Sensing A Demonic Presence.name:
感知恶魔的气息
Sensing A Demonic Presence

Text.text:
你终于明白，为何他们说只需站在深渊边缘便已足够。自漩涡深处升起的腐化之力，正侵蚀着你理智的完整性。深渊已裁定你的价值，派来一名先驱——它背诵着由更强大存在写就的台词。关于你的理智：恶魔念出的不是“摧毁”。它在你耳畔低语的是——“重构”。

~ 由Stefano Imperiale构想

You finally understand why they say it is enough to stand at the edge of the abyss. The integrity of your sanity is at stake from a corrupting influence rising up out of the vortex. The abyss has judged your worth and sent a herald, who recites a script written by a more powerful being. Regarding your sanity: The demon does not read, “destroy.” It whispers the word, “reconstruct.”

~ Envisioned by Stefano Imperiale

你指间的材料在你吐出咒词、空着的那只手划出手势时崩解成尘。耳畔传来一阵轻微的振翼回响，尘埃随即聚拢，凝成一枚无睑之眼的轮廓，悬浮在你面前。你屏息凝神，在心底看见它所见——那道视线如利刃般切开曾经密不透风的阴影。你驱使它向前，它便以无定形之躯挤过锁孔与缝隙，悄无声息地为你探查前路。

~ Envisioned by Kyrus (Brent)

The ingredients between your fingers disintegrate as you speak the words and sign with your free hand. A faint flapping of wings echoes in your ear as the dust forms into the shape of a lidless eye, hovering before you. You concentrate, and within your mind, you see what the Eye sees, its vision cutting through the once-impenetrable shadow. You command it forward, and it squeezes amorphously through keyholes and cracks to scout the way ahead.

~ Envisioned by Kyrus (Brent)

这名人类男子留着蓬乱的栗色头发，气势逼人：宽阔的肩头披着兽皮，桶状的胸膛罩在锁子甲下。他刻意让肌肉虬结的双臂裸露在外，右前臂上的纹身描绘着矮人锻造之神伏案劳作，正锻打一柄战斧——与他背上那柄系着的战斧如出一辙。尽管他高大魁梧、力量昭然，他身上却透着友善的气息，让人觉得那把斧子既能毫不迟疑地为朋友挡灾，也能同样果断地劈向敌人。

~ Played by a Hero with

This human man with shaggy chestnut hair strikes an imposing figure, his broad shoulders draped with furs and barrel chest shrouded in chainmail. He keeps his muscular arms bare, and the tattoo on his right forearm depicts the dwarven god of crafting at work, forging a battleaxe not unlike the one strapped to this man’s back. Despite the strength evident in the man’s towering frame, he gives off a friendly air, and one gets the impression that he uses that axe to protect his friends just as readily as he does to harm his enemies.

~ Played by a Hero with

I Cast Floating Disk Using Components.name:
我用材料施放【浮空碟】
I Cast Floating Disk Using Components

Text.text:
我将水银滴落在地面，低声吟诵奥秘咒词，能量奔涌而来，那滴银珠随即铺展开来，化作一枚巨大的扁平圆盘。随着我在空中编织繁复手势，雕刻魔法的流向，圆盘先是渐渐凝固，继而悄然消隐，只在原地留下了一座无形的平台。
Dripping the mercury onto the floor, I intone the arcane words and feel a rush of energy as the droplet widens to form a large flat disk. As I weave complex gestures in the air, sculpting the flow of magic, the disk begins to solidify then to disappear, leaving an invisible platform behind.

Barbarian's Stomping Grounds.name:
野蛮人的践踏之地
Barbarian's Stomping Grounds

Text.text:
火坑里闷燃着，咆哮烈焰留下的焦黑余烬仍在发烫。灰烬间也散落着骨头——昨夜餐食的残骸。火堆周围横倒的树桩充作座位，而周遭区域因长久的踩踏早已清出一片空地，灌木与草皮被踏得一干二净。火堆上首立着一截高耸的树桩，被掏空凿成高背座椅，椅顶冠着多叉鹿角。
The firepit smolders with the charred remains of a roaring blaze. Bones litter the ash, too—remnants of the previous night's meal. Overturned stumps serve as seating around the fire, and the surrounding area has been cleared of brush and grass by constant foot traffic. At the head of the fire, a towering stump—hollowed out to form a high-backed chair—is crested by multi-pronged antlers.

一个鼓胀的粉红头颅以惊人的速度掠过天际，身后拖曳着三条修长而肉质的触手，拍击空气翻飞。无数黄色、玻璃般的眼睛深陷在颅骨之中，目光冰冷而异质，直勾勾地凝视着。它那张巨大的、喘息般的笑口间露出复杂的鲸须系统，用以滤食有机化合物与藻类。生物周身缠绕着一层淡淡的电光噼啪作响。
A bulbous pink head soars through the sky at incredible velocity, three long and fleshy tentacles flapping out behind it. A multitude of yellow glassy eyes are set deep into the skull, cold and alien in their staring. Its great, gasping smile reveals a complex baleen system for filter feeding on organic compounds and algae. A faint aura of electricity crackles around the creature.

Abandoned Civilian Space Station: Contro.name:
废弃民用空间站：控制中心
Abandoned Civilian Space Station: Control Center

Text.text:
一场碎屑风暴将控制中心埋进垃圾与尘土之中，办公室阴影重重的狭窄空间更像被遗忘的坟冢，而非指挥中枢。几只细小的甲壳害虫残骸散落满地，肢节蜷曲，呈现出可怖的静止，死寂而玻璃般的眼睛仍像在盯着你。
A storm of debris has covered the control center in refuse and dust, the shadowed confines of the office more akin to a forgotten tomb than a hub of command. The remains of small chitinous vermin lie scattered around the room, their legs curled in terrible repose as they watch you with dead, glassy eyes.

I Cast Magic Mouth.name:
我施放了魔法之口
I Cast Magic Mouth

Text.text: 一串符号从我唇间漂浮而出，我的讯息以一种陌生的象形文字显现。魔法带着炽热的嘶声，落入我选定的物体之中。物体上方短暂浮现出一道微妙的视觉回响——一弯闪亮的新月般微笑唇线——旋即消散于无形。 A string of symbols floats from my lips, my message appearing in an unfamiliar pictorial script. The magic settles with a fiery hiss into my chosen object. A subtle visual echo, a shining crescent bend of a smiling mouth, appears over the object for a moment—before fading into nothing.

Goddess Of Fresh Water.name:
淡水女神
Goddess Of Fresh Water

Text.text:
她那群河之少女的侍从，外表纤细轻佻，仿佛无害，却以凶烈的魔法护她周全。你能看见那力量——像马利筋的絮羽般漂浮在空气里，又在清冽新水的波光下闪烁，鳟鱼与狗鱼巡弋其间。她或涉水，或游弋，或沐浴。她的接触能让河流变缓或加急，让湖水变凉或回暖。在沙漠里，她有力量去豁免一条性命；在丛林里，她能令活物腐烂。若你知趣，她便以一勺治疗迎你；若你色眯眯地盯着……你就沉下去。
Her court of river girls, deceptively willowy and playful, protects her with a fierce magic. You can see it, floating in the air like milkweed, and shimmering under fresh waters patrolled by trout and pike. She wades, or swims, or bathes. Her touch slows or speeds the river, cools or warms the lake. In the desert she has the power to save a life, and in the jungle she can rot the living. If you are discreet, she welcomes you with a ladle of healing. If you leer... you drown.

Pair Of Red, Armored Warriors.name:
一对披红甲的武装战士
Pair Of Red, Armored Warriors

Text.text:
两名巨人立在山坡上，披着锈蚀的护甲，颜色宛如陈旧的血；腐肉的恶臭被热风卷起，扑面而来。它们头盔深处浮动着点点亵渎的幽光，燃着异界的恶意。它们轻而易举地挥舞着巨大的、血肉淋漓的战斧，正准备为其邪恶的主人死守。

~ 由 Envisioned 的 Leif，来自 Devs & Dice

诅咒之丘 Part I: 颅骨山脚 Part II: 颅骨山坡 Part III: 一对红甲武士 Part IV: 颅骨山巅 Part V: 搏动水晶下的巫妖 Two giants stand on the slope of the hill, clad in rusted armor the color of old blood, their carrion stink hot on the wind. Motes of unholy light glow from the depths of their helmets, burning with an otherworldly malice. They wield huge gore-spattered axes with horrifying ease as they prepare to defend their villainous master.

~ Envisioned by Leif from Devs & Dice

Cursed Hill Part I: Base of Skull Hill Part II: Slopes of Skull Hill Part III: Pair of Red, Armored Warriors Part IV: Summit of Skull Hill Part V: Lich Beneath a Pulsing Crystal

Loot From A Sahuagin.name:
来自一名沙华鱼人的战利品
Loot From A Sahuagin

Text.text:
狰狞咆哮的萨胡亚金即使死去也死死攥着它的三叉戟。你费了几下狠劲，才把它的利爪与筋肉虬结的手臂从武器上硬生生掰开——这柄武器完全由血红色的珊瑚打造而成。它在接触下粗粝嶙峋、结节盘错，握在手里沉甸甸的；只要几次时机精准的突刺，便足以放倒敌手。
The snarling sahuagin clings to its trident even in death. It takes a few strong pulls to wrench its claws and sinewed arms away from the weapon, which is crafted entirely of a blood-red coral. Gnarled and rough to the touch, and heavy in hand, this weapon could fell foes with just a few well-timed thrusts.

这枚金币近乎带着蛋白石般的幻彩，金属表面的微光随光线流转而变幻色泽。一面浮雕着妖精廷女王极尽美丽的身姿；另一面则以深刻的蚀纹同样呈现出不妖精廷女王——那可怖的面容令人胆寒，即便你只是将圆片握在掌心，她的目光也仿佛直直穿透你。
The golden coin possesses an almost opalescent quality, the shimmer of its metallic surface shifting in hue against the light. On one side, a raised carving depicts the Seelie Queen in all of her beauty; on the reverse, a deep etching similarly displays the Unseelie Queen, a terrifying visage whose eyes seem to bore into you even as you hold the disk in your hand.

Haunted House: Entrance.name:
闹鬼宅邸：入口
Haunted House: Entrance

Text.text:
当你逼近那座瘦骨嶙峋的宅邸门槛时，一阵寒意沿着脊背战栗而下。久远的传言说，这里收容着不得安息的骚动亡灵。你每踏上一阶吱呀作响的楼梯，心底的不祥便更深一分，直到几乎被那层阴翳的惨淡麻木。入口两侧的栖座上，各有一只小石像鬼俯身咧笑，体型如小恶鬼般细小；它们空洞、崩缺的石眼冷冷盯着你，仿佛在嘲弄你的不安。就在你踏上最后一级台阶时，门在刺耳的铰链摩擦声中自行荡开，更将这份惶惧推向顶点。
A chill shudders down your spine as you approach the threshold of the gaunt dwelling, long-rumored to house disquiet spirits denied their final rest. With every step up its creaking stairs, your sense of foreboding grows until you are all but numbed to its pall. Tiny gargoyles the size of imps grin down from their perches on either side of the entrance, their blank, chipped stone eyes mocking your anxiety. This apprehension is aggravated by the door swinging open on rasping hinges as you reach the top step.

Ogre Gladiator.name:
食人魔角斗士
Ogre Gladiator

Text.text:
你在看见竞技场冠军之前，先闻到了他们：血腥、汗臭与腐肉混杂的恶臭。那笨重挪步的食人魔仿佛血肉与钢铁铸成的堡垒——一具扭曲畸形的生物，老茧与伤疤交织的粗硬皮肤如甲胄般覆在身上。他们拖着一柄巨大的石制大槌在身后磨擦而行，另一只手提着一面攻城器械般大小的塔盾；盾面锈蚀斑驳，其上装点着腐烂的、倒下挑战者的颅骨。塌陷充血的眼睛从怪物般的面孔褶皱里窥出，死死锁定下一个对手——下一顿餐食。秃鹫在这粗暴的战士头顶盘旋，等待那必然到来的杀戮，在空气里嗅着血的味道。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

You smell the arena’s champion before you see them: the stench of blood, sweat, and rotting meat. The lumbering ogre is a bulwark of flesh and steel, a misshapen, malformed creature with a callused, scarred hide. They drag a massive stone maul behind them and heft a tower shield the size of a siege engine in their off-hand, the rusted surface of which is adorned with the rotting skulls of fallen contenders. Sunken, bloodshot eyes peer from the folds of a monstrous face, zeroing in on their next opponent—their next meal. Vultures circle the brutish warrior, eager for the inevitable kill, smelling blood in the air.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

马匹嘶鸣低啼，带着对休息的感激与期待，朝着城堡庭院里那座熟悉的附属建筑靠近。车库是一座矮壮而实用的建筑；马车驶近时，沉重的木门吱呀作响地开启，向两侧大大敞开，迎接旅人归来。昏暗的室内，干草的霉涩气息与皮革保养油的土质芬芳交织在一起，几辆马车静静停在里面的马厩隔间中，空置无声。
Horses whinny and neigh in grateful anticipation of rest as they approach the familiar outbuilding in the castle grounds. The carriage house is a squat, utilitarian building, and as the carriage approaches, the heavy wooden doors creak open, spread wide to welcome the travelers home. The musty scent of hay mingles with the earthy perfume of leather balm in the dimly lit interior, and several carriages sit idly in the stable bays within.

I Shoot From A Flying Bike.name:
我从飞行摩托上开火
I Shoot From A Flying Bike

Text.text:
我小心在自行车上稳住身形，微微移重心，抽出枪来举起瞄准。车身随时可能失控，我只有短短几秒能开出这一枪。就在目标闯入视野的瞬间，我扣下扳机。
Taking care to balance my body on the bike, I shift my weight slightly to draw my gun and take aim. I only have seconds to make the shot before my bike veers out of control. I pull the trigger as my target comes into view.

Efficient Folding Moped.name:
高效折叠轻便摩托
Efficient Folding Moped

Text.text:
轻便摩托本就小巧，不太占用空间。但只需几次解扣、折弯与咔哒轻响，这辆迷你座驾便像信封般向内折叠。最终成形的是一件紧凑狭长的物体，几乎像一只金属公文箱。其干练利落的外观更因顶部弹出的一只小提手而臻于完备——伴随着一声金属般的尖细嗡鸣。
The moped is already a small thing, not taking up too much space. But with a few releases, bends, and clicks, the diminutive ride folds in on itself like an envelope. The end result is a compact, narrow object that looks almost like a metal briefcase. Its businesslike image is complete with a small handle that pops out of the top with a metallic whine.

I Store A Spell In My Ioun Stone Of Rese.name:
我将一道法术储存在我的储法艾恩石中
I Store A Spell In My Ioun Stone Of Reserve

Text.text:
那枚小小的紫色棱镜绕着我的头划出宽广的轨道，直到我抬手伸出一根手指，将它轻轻按停。我的朋友比划着几道奥秘的手势——笑得像是在提醒我又欠了一笔——随后吟诵起我喜欢的那道法术，并触及那块石头。我感到魔法流入棱镜，在其中安然沉淀；只要我日后需要施放，它便随时供我取用。
The small purple prism follows a wide orbit around my head until I reach up and stop it with a finger. My friend gestures some arcana—smiling as if I’m now in debt—then recites a spell I like and touches the stone. I feel the magic pass into the prism and settle there, available to me should I ever need to cast it.

Strange Octopus In Glowing Vat.name:
发光缸中的怪异章鱼
Strange Octopus In Glowing Vat

Text.text:
一只黄铜色的章鱼从诡异金属缸里泛着青蓝荧光的液体中咕嘟咕嘟地冒起。它的眼睛多得离谱，明亮得如红宝石般猩红。它的触手伸向缸沿，啪嗒拍击、哗啦搅动着那团黏软的身躯，动作快得惊人。
A brassy-colored octopus bubbles up from the glowing teal liquid in a strange metal vat. Its eyes, of which there are far too many, are bright and as red as rubies. Its tentacles reach for the side of the vat, slapping and sloshing its squishing body with a marked swiftness.

I Persuade A Bouncer To Allow Entry.name:
我说服门卫放我进去
I Persuade A Bouncer To Allow Entry

Text.text:
“我们一路走来，历经太多；纵使衣着不合此地体面，我保证——我们会像那些曾瞥见死亡的人那样痛饮。”
“We’ve been through a lot, and although our attire may not match the standards of this place, I promise we will drink as only those who have glimpsed death can.”

Cult Summons Kraken To Attack Town.name:
邪教召唤海怪克拉肯攻击小镇
Cult Summons Kraken To Attack Town

Text.text:
浪涛拍打着阴郁无光的码头木梁，水声咕噜作响。兜帽低垂、神情肃穆的邪教徒在边缘一字排开。其一吐出一个丑恶而刺骨的词，随即喊出他们那疯癫神祇的名号。他们闭目吟诵数小时，直到远处一条漆黑浪脊上，触手猛然抽起，又重重砸落。海妖的头颅破浪而出。它睁开眼。邪教徒也睁开眼。怪物刹那间横跨四分之一英里的狂海，摧毁码头，触手又朝海边建筑横扫而去。

~ 由 Danil 构想

Waves splash and gurgle against the timbers of the cheerless wharf, as the hooded and grave cultists line up at its edge. One of them speaks a hideous, chilling word, then the name of their mad god. They chant for hours with closed eyes, until, on a distant black wave, tentacles whip up and smack down. The head of the kraken surfaces. Its eyes open. The eyes of the cultists open. The monster covers a quarter mile of rough sea in an instant, demolishes the wharf, and lashes out against the seaside buildings.

~ Envisioned by Danil

Mass Healing Word.name:
群体治疗真言
Mass Healing Word

Text.text:
你吟诵着强而有力的祈词，恳求神祇垂怜；双手扭转成一个手势，指向所有你要让他们共享你虔敬恩泽的人。断骨自然而然地接续愈合，细小的伤口也从裂开的血肉上被抹净，仿佛一块细致的布轻轻擦拭窗面，将瑕疵尽数拭去。
Intoning powerful words entreating the favor of your deity, your hands twist in a gesture indicating all those for whom you intend to reap the benefits of your great piety. Bones knit and minor wounds are wiped clean from parted flesh as a fine cloth might polish a window.

Mid-level Housing Development.name:
中等等级住宅开发区
Mid-level Housing Development

Text.text:
合成树沿着这片街区的道路排列成行，枝桠静止不动，家家户户的人们在其下相对安全而舒适地散步。街角靠着一座小公园，有间热闹的咖啡馆，食客的谈笑声与不远处孩子们嬉闹的尖叫声交织在一起。
Synthetic trees line the streets of this neighborhood, and families walk in relative safety and comfort beneath their static branches. A bustling café sits on the corner near a small park, the chatter of patrons mingling with the excited shrieks of children playing nearby.

Separated During A Blizzard.name:
暴风雪中走散
Separated During A Blizzard

Text.text:
雪花被狂风抽打着翻卷盘旋，仿佛雪已多过空气；最终密到极致，化作一层泛着珠光的光幕，你几乎只能透过它勉强看见些许影子。影子消失了——你的同伴——连同任何方向感一起；而咆哮的风在你的声音离开嘴唇的瞬间就将其撕碎吞没。

~ 由Ethan构想

The snow whips and pinwheels until there seems to be more snow than air, finally so dense that it is a veil of pearlescent light through which you can barely see shadows. You lose the shadows—your fellows—along with any gauge of direction, and the roaring wind kills your voice as soon as it leaves your mouth.

~ Envisioned by Ethan

Prison Transport Ship: Brig.name:
囚犯押运船：禁闭舱
Prison Transport Ship: Brig

Text.text:
只有最恶劣的犯人，才会被关进这间拘押牢房。猩红灯光浸染着冰冷的镶板墙面，出口处一片噼啪作响的能量场如同闪烁帷幕般立起屏障，让这狭窄的房间里充满了几乎能触到的静电。一只小马桶和一张硬邦邦的床是这里仅有的陈设——而且两者都被螺栓死死固定在墙上。
Only the worst offenders are confined to this holding cell. Red light bathes the stark, paneled walls and a shimmering field of crackling energy forms a barrier over the exit, filling the cramped room with tangible static. A small toilet and a rigid bed are the only furnishings here—and both are bolted to the walls.

带着少年般躁动的精力，这个粗蛮的蜥蜴人不断检查、又反复检查绑在他全身战斗服上的海量武器。赤绿相间的鳞片下，壮硕的肌肉起伏如波。他挺起肩膀，让那张鳞甲华美的脸更显张扬，得意地摆出姿态，目光扫过四周，搜寻敢来挑战的人。一把笨重的手枪塞在他的腰带里，明晃晃地露在外面。
Fidgety with the energy of youth, this brutish lizard man checks and rechecks the vast plethora of weaponry strapped to his body suit. A muscled physique ripples beneath red-green scales. He throws his shoulders back from his magnificently scaled face, preening, scanning his surroundings for a challenger. A bulky pistol is thrust into his waistband, clearly visible.

浓稠而带着麝香般腥甜的雾气沉沉压下，遮蔽了你的视线，将你的目光牢牢限制在身前不过数六码。更远处的沼泽里有影子在动，你一靠近，它们便倏然掠走。水中有什么生物翻搅蠕动，等你试图看清，它们就沉入泥泞巢穴的黑暗之中，消失不见。这片沼泽里的一切仿佛都栖身于现实之外——一层你怎么也看不透的雾，一缕你怎么也抓不住的烟。
A thick, musky fog hangs heavy, obscuring your vision, limiting your sight to just a few yards in front of you. Shapes move in the marsh beyond that, flitting away as your approach. Creatures writhe in the water, disappearing into the darkness of their muddy home as you try to perceive them. Everything in this marsh seems to exist just outside of reality—a fog you can't quite see through, a smoke you can't quite grasp.

I Witness The Destruction Of A Coastal T.name:
我目睹一座海岸小镇的覆灭
I Witness The Destruction Of A Coastal Town

Text.text:
海浪在满是残骸的岸边涨落不息，曾经苍白的沙滩如今大片化作红紫相间的黏稠烂泥。尸体横陈，许多支离破碎，更多一动不动，任海风吹刮，蒙着尘沙，散落在杂物之间。原本迷人的海岸宅邸——以卵石砌墙、木梁为骨——如今像暴风中翻搅的船只撞上嶙峋礁石般被劈裂粉碎。海鸥在头顶盘旋，啼声尖厉，仿佛对下方废墟发出残忍的嘲笑。
The waves wax and wane along the littered shore, with swathes of the once pale sand now turned to red and purple glop. Bodies, many broken and more unmoving, lie windswept and dusted among the debris. Lovely coastal homes—made of cobbled stone and wooden beams—are splintered like storm-roiled ships smashed upon jagged rocks. Gulls circle overhead, their calls like cruel, piping laughter at the ruin below.

Adventurer With Axe And Shield.name:
持斧与盾的冒险者
Adventurer With Axe And Shield

Text.text:
雾气中，一名孤独的战士迈步而来，浓须下的面容紧绷，满是戒备。锁子甲覆身，手执一面满是战痕的盾牌，他警惕地绕过你，心无旁骛地追寻自己的使命。他的步伐里透出一种被压抑的暴烈，仿佛随时会将战斧深深劈进任何胆敢阻拦他的人体内。
Through the mist strides a lone warrior, his bearded visage taut with suspicion. Clad in mail and sporting a battle-scarred shield, he warily skirts you, intent on his own quest. A palpable feeling of suppressed violence can be seen in his gait, ready to bury his axe into anyone seeking to stop him.

Nightmare About Beetles Swarming.name:
甲虫成群涌来的噩梦
Nightmare About Beetles Swarming

Text.text:
耳后发痒。腰侧发痒。脚踝也发痒。刺痛在皮肤上四处绽放，你指甲拼命去抓，却怎么也抓不够快。你恼怒地叫出声，猛地睁眼，发现自己满身爬满了肉色甲虫。淤青般的蓝色大颚咔哒作响，你抬手去拍打，它们的甲壳坚硬，却又诡异地柔软，像婴儿的皮肤。它们振翅嗡鸣，从你身上掀起，扑向你的脸。一只嘶嘶作声，直冲你大张的嘴。你的手臂被一整个军团压住，它们带钩的足爪深深扎进你的皮肤。那只甲虫挤过你的牙齿，你舌头上贴上它毛茸茸的腹部。你咬下去，听见一声过于像人的尖叫。它的翅膀脉动，嗡声沿着你的下颌骨震颤——紧接着，它猛地把自己硬生生顶进你的喉咙。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

An itch behind your ear. At your waist. At your ankle. You can’t rake your nails across your skin fast enough as these prickles bloom all over your skin. With a frustrated cry, you open your eyes to find your body crawling with beetles the color of flesh. Bruise-blue mandibles chitter angrily as you try to swat them away, their bodies hard but somehow soft as baby’s skin. Their wings hum as they lift from your body and fly into your face. One, hissing, dives for your gaping mouth. Your arms are weighed down by a legion of its fellows, their hooked feet digging into your skin. The beetle pushes past your teeth, and you feel its furry belly on your tongue. You bite down and hear a too-human shriek. Its wings pulse, the buzz vibrating through your jaw—and then it shoves itself down your throat.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Temple To A God Of Elemental Fire.name:
元素火焰之神的神庙
Temple To A God Of Elemental Fire

Text.text:
这里更像是一堆篝火，外头才勉强围了座神殿，而非殿内供着火焰。厚重巨石砌成的圣所里几乎无处落脚；大理石地面中央的深坑里，添柴充足的烈焰正狂怒翻卷。被烟火熏黑的石塔内塞进了四层祈祷回廊，供人静修冥想；会众则吸入献祭与香料被抛进火中焚烧时升腾的烟雾。
This is more a bonfire with a temple around it than a temple with a fire inside. There is hardly room to stand in the heavy block sanctuary, the pit in the center of its marble floor raging with a well-stoked conflagration. A blackened stone tower is packed with four levels of prayer balconies for meditations while parishioners breathe the smoke of offerings and incenses thrown into the flames.

Sundries From A Wyvern Cave.name:
飞龙洞窟杂货
Sundries From A Wyvern Cave

Text.text:
在双足飞龙的洞窟里，你发现零零散散被啃噬过的牛骨，还混着几具人形骸骨。一只撕裂的背包里塞着些腐烂的食物、沾污的羊皮纸，以及一支凌乱的羽毛笔。或许这不幸之人曾是一名旅途中的学者。
In the wyvern’s cave, you find a smattering of gnawed cattle bones, as well as some humanoid skeletons. A torn backpack holds some rotted food, stained parchment, and a disheveled quill. Perhaps this unfortunate soul was a traveling scholar.

Advice For A Brute.name:
给莽夫的忠告
Advice For A Brute

Text.text:
“不是所有麻烦都能靠你捶胸顿足、像发情的雄鹿那样到处乱拱来解决。看在神的份上，学着点儿分寸和细致吧。”
“Not every problem can be solved by thumping your chest and rutting like some stag in heat. Try a little delicacy, for god’s sake.”

Disjunction Chamber: Haunted Crypt.name:
解离密室：闹鬼地穴
Disjunction Chamber: Haunted Crypt

Text.text:
你有种下沉的感觉，每迈出一步，都把你带得更深，深入地窖。四周压力迫近，仿佛被抛入深不可测的海渊。前方的黑暗中有什么在呼唤你——未知的海妖之歌——你不由得屏息。
You have the sensation of sinking as each step takes you deeper into the crypt. You feel pressure all about you, as if plunged into an unfathomable ocean. Something in the darkness ahead calls to you, the siren song of the unknown, and you find yourself holding your breath.

Great Dwarf Hall.name:
宏伟矮人大厅
Great Dwarf Hall

Text.text:
巨大的石柱如林中巨树般从大理石地面拔地而起。在上方高处的黑暗里，它们的扶壁如枝杈般向外伸展；而在地面，它们的根基则扎入一片“灌木丛”般的景象——较小却依旧巍峨的矮人英雄与统治者雕像之间。这些雕刻在任何别处都足以称为纪念碑。
Titanic pillars rise from the marble floor like trees in a forest. Somewhere in the darkness high above, they spread out buttresses like boughs, but down on the ground they root themselves among the comparative shrubbery of smaller but still immense statues of dwarf heroes and rulers, carvings that would be considered monuments in any other place.

Mobile Tactical Operations Center, Mark.name:
移动战术行动中心，I型
Mobile Tactical Operations Center, Mark I

Text.text:
这块笨重的浅银色方块躺在你掌心，隐隐发烫，伴着细微的嗡鸣。按下按钮，它倏然展开成一块凶悍生硬的长方形屏板。其上滚动着粗糙的军用数据：武器特征信号、附近车辆信息，以及突击小队的最优推进路线。它能与本地卫星通信，并以闪烁的高速轮播周遭建筑蓝图，计算最合适的战术站位。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

This bulky square of pallid silver sits in the palm of your hand, buzzing with a faint heat. At the press of a button, it unfurls into a brutal-looking rectangle. Rudimentary military data is displayed: weapons signatures, local vehicle data, and optimal routes for strike teams. The device can communicate with local satellites and flash-cycle through surrounding building plans to calculate tactical positioning.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

入口附近摆着几只木桶，桶口以开裂的沥青封死，像是等人来取，也像是随时准备装车运走。沙漠的风在这里打着旋钻进来，把所有足迹都抹平，只把沙子堆到南墙脚下。
A few barrels sealed with cracking pitch sit near the entry, perhaps for someone to pick up, perhaps to be readied for transport. Any tracks have been blown away by the desert wind circling in here and piling sand against the south wall.

Loot From A Wererat.name:
狼人鼠的战利品
Loot From A Wererat

Text.text:
你翻遍这瘦骨嶙峋的狼人衣袋，却几乎一无所获，双手被从衣料间渗出的血浸得湿冷。就在你几乎要放弃搜寻时，指尖忽然擦到一块坚硬之物。你将战利品扯出掌心，才看清那是一枚小小的绿色宝石。
Rifling through the scrawny lycanthrope’s pockets you find little of value, and your hands become wet with the blood seeping through its clothing. On the verge of abandoning your search, your hand brushes against something solid. Pulling your prize free you see it is a small green gemstone.

Mage Quip About Dark Magic.name:
法师对黑暗魔法的俏皮话
Mage Quip About Dark Magic

Text.text:
“魔法不是什么简单的武器；魔法是一片海洋，表面美丽——但你越往深处走，它就越发沉重幽暗。”
“Magic is not some simple weapon; magic is an ocean, beautiful on the surface—but the deeper you go the more crushing and dark it becomes.”

Unhappy Island Wedding.name:
不欢之岛的婚礼
Unhappy Island Wedding

Text.text:
缤纷的旗帜在热带微风中猎猎作响，几艘大型船只在海湾碧蓝的水面上慵懒起伏。主宰着海滩的巨大亭棚被夺目的花束层层环绕，馥郁甜美的香气自簇拥的鲜花间飘散开来，令坐在棚内的宾客们沉醉不已。乐队奏起乐章，众人纷纷起身；一名身姿纤柔的年轻女子——身着华丽的婚礼礼服——沿着过道拖着步子，朝尽头的祭坛走去。她的目光落在那位等候着她的臃肿、狞笑、令人作呕的家伙身上时，脚步只迟疑了一瞬，便又继续迈向她那注定不幸的未来。

~ Envisioned by Paul Iverson on Discord

Colorful flags snap in the tropical breeze as several large boats bob languidly on the turquoise waters of the bay. The large pavilion dominating the beachfront is wreathed in stunning floral bouquets, and a delectable aroma drifts from the assembled flowers, delighting the guests seated inside. A band starts up as everyone rises from their seats, and a willowy young woman—in ornate wedding attire—shuffles down the aisle toward the altar at the end. As her eyes fall upon the bloated, leering retch awaiting her, she falters only for a moment before continuing on toward her unhappy future.

~ Envisioned by Paul Iverson on Discord

你发动攻击——一招又快又脏的把戏——用成堆垃圾数据轰击你的目标：数百个毫无意义的函数专门吞噬他们设备的资源，逼出同时发生的内存调用。五彩斑斓的数据触手从你伸开的掌心跃起，钻入他们的化身。你一边微笑一边开始上传，试图强行撕开他们的防火墙。直到你看见对手身子一软，随即颤了一下，又以僵硬抽搐的动作重新动了起来，你才知道自己挖到了金矿——他们的化身几乎被彻底麻痹，而你那庞大数据洪流中暗藏的温和病毒，仍在不断啃噬他们。

~ 由一位英雄构想

You attack, a quick and dirty trick, blasting your target with garbage data designed to take up their rig’s resources through hundreds of useless functions, forcing simultaneous memory calls. Multicolored tentacles of data leap from your outstretched palm and burrow into their persona. You smile as you begin your upload, trying to force your way through their firewalls. You know you’ve hit paydirt when you see your opponent slump, then shiver and begin to move again in a jerky motion, their persona mostly paralyzed, even as it is assailed by a mild virus concealed in your massive data transfer.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Greeting From A Viper.name:
毒蛇的问候
Greeting From A Viper

Text.text:
“动作快点，燃烧者。你或许身形庞大，但我有个小小的惊喜，足以让再高大的巨人也跪倒在地。”
“Make it quick, burning one. You may be large, but I have a little surprise that can bring even the greatest giant to its knees.”

Ruthless Gang Enforcer.name:
冷酷帮派打手
