Ruthless Gang Enforcer

Text.text:
他穿着一条破旧的作战裤，脚蹬钢头靴。赤裸上身，敦实的拳手身躯与纵横交织的纹身毫无遮掩地暴露在灯下。他掰得宽厚而伤痕累累的双手关节咔咔作响，每个指节上新鲜刮破的皮肤泛着湿亮的猩红。手腕上灰绿的植入体嗡鸣运转，电线自这些强化装置沿臂攀上，和胸口、颈侧刺青的线条无缝融为一体。一道疤痕把他的嘴撕成永久的冷笑，皮革般的伤线将上唇扯向鼻翼边角。他用舌尖掠过一颗裸露的门牙，露出牙龈，指尖点了点那只菜花耳里嵌着的听觉增强器。“大点声，老鼠。”他抬脚踹了踹脚边那倒成一团的倒霉鬼，对方脸肿得发亮，嘴角渗着红。
He wears a pair of ratty combat pants and steel-toed boots. Shirtless, his stocky boxer’s body and web of tattoos are on full display. He cracks the knuckles of his broad and beaten hands, patches of freshly raked skin on each joint glistening red. Gray-green implants on his wrists whir. Wires run from these enhancements up his arms to meld seamlessly with the inked lines along his chest and neck. A scar rends his mouth into a permanent sneer, the leathery line stretching his top lip to the corner of his nose. He passes his tongue over an exposed incisor and gums as he touches a finger to the auditory enhancer within his cauliflower ear. “Speak up, rat.” He kicks some poor chump laying in a heap at his feet, their face swollen and mouth seeping red.

一只双足行走的獾，围着舒适的格纹围巾，裹着柔软的外套，正用这宅邸精致的瓷茶具斟茶。它脸上的神情也许温和可亲——但同样也可能阴狠狡诈。
Wearing a comfy plaid scarf and soft coat, and pouring tea with the house’s fine porcelain set, is a bipedal badger. The look on their face could be kindly—though it could just as easily be wicked.

Approaching A Portly Guard.name:
走近一名臃肿的卫兵
Approaching A Portly Guard

Text.text:
那名臃肿的守卫在石砌墙垣上显得如同一抹暗影。他抬起弩，金属在火把光下闪出冷芒。“站住！此乃公主的堡邸。你们来此有何事？”他的嗓音粗粝，却出人意料地带着几分王家般的威严，与他那松垮的站姿形成鲜明反差。他身后的闸门已经落下，堡垒庭院深处有柔和的光从不知名的源头漫出。
The portly guard stands out as a dark figure on the stonework. He lifts his crossbow, the metal glimmering under the torchlight. “Halt! This is the princess’s keep. What business have ye here?” His voice is gruff but surprisingly regal considering his posture. The portcullis behind him is down, and soft light comes from an unknown source inside the fort’s courtyard.

Fallen Tree River Crossing.name:
倒木河渡口
Fallen Tree River Crossing

Text.text:
下方河流的咆哮声吞没了周遭荒野的一切声响。激流在峡谷间凿出蜿蜒的水道，化作一道不可逾越的界线，将林地一分为二。一棵倒下的巨木横跨峡谷，树皮被飞溅的水雾浸得湿透，成了唯一可能的渡口。它的表面必然湿滑，险象环生。
The roar of the river below drowns out the sounds of the surrounding wilderness. Rapids carve a winding path through the ravine, forming an impassable boundary bisecting the woodlands. A fallen tree, its bark sodden from the spray, spans the width of the ravine, providing the only possible crossing. The surface is sure to be slick and perilous.

垂落如帷、蜿蜒如蛇的藤蔓开始蠕动，像毒蛇般攫抓缠绕。藤蔓彼此扭结交织，编成阴森的结饰般的纹理，拼凑出一具高挑而细瘦的人形躯干与修长无力的四肢，末端延展成触须般的赘生物。藤蔓继续缠上那具骨架般的身影，勾勒出肌肉的起伏，甚至塑成一张出人意料地细致的面孔。生物缓缓挺直身躯，藤蔓手臂拖曳在地，随即发出一声超乎尘世的低沉哀鸣。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The draping, snaking vines begin to shift, grasping and coiling like serpents. The vines twist together, braiding themselves like macabre knotwork as they form a tall, spindly humanoid body and long, lanky limbs ending in tendril-like growths. The vines continue wrapping themselves around the skeletal figure, forming musculature and a surprisingly detailed face. The creature rights itself, vine arms draping along the ground, and looses an otherworldly groan.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

雾气散去，一座浩瀚的长桥在你眼前展开；它被擎天的巨石之手托举着，那些石手自下方澄澈如镜的湖水中拔起。天空湛蓝明亮，起伏的丘陵葱郁，森林与河流纵横其间。一座由莹白大理石铸就、熠熠生辉的宏伟宫殿俯瞰着这片超凡的乐土，而行走在桥上的旅人，周身都萦绕着命运的火花。

~ Tuttlepants 于 Discord

The fog clears and you see a vast bridge before you, held aloft by titanic stone hands which rise from the waters of the pristine lake below. The sky is a bright azure blue and the rolling hills are lush with forests and rivers. A great palace of shining marble presides over this otherworldly paradise, and the people traveling over the bridge all carry the spark of destiny about them.

~ Tuttlepants on Discord

I Cast Confusion.name:
我施放了困惑
I Cast Confusion

Text.text:
我一只手攥着三枚核桃壳；另一只手则挑定混沌从何处开场。就让一小撮敌人围在我的中心点附近，正合适。我把句子倒着念，吐出毫无意义的奥术咒语。连我自己也不知道它们会引发什么——也许让他们朝着并非自愿的方向狂奔；也许令他们僵立如冰；也许逼他们反目厮杀。
In one hand, I hold three walnut shells. With the other, I choose where the chaos will begin. A little cluster of foes around my center point should do. I recite sentences backward, nonsensical arcane phrases. Even I don’t know what they will do—perhaps run in a direction they do not choose. Perhaps freeze. Perhaps fight.

Quip By A Nostalgic Vampire.name:
怀旧的吸血鬼（特征）俏皮话
Quip By A Nostalgic Vampire

Text.text:
“是什么驱使你去追寻这般危险？是愤怒？是恐惧？你心中的激情必定汹涌如狂潮，才会将你带到这种地方。啊……我已经很久很久没再感受过那样的搏动了。我如今几乎记不起来了……饥渴吞噬的，远不止鲜血。”
“What drives you to seek out such danger? Is it anger? Fear? How the passions must rage within your heart to bring you to a place like this. Oh, it has been so very long since I’ve felt that pulse. I can barely remember it now… The hunger consumes more than just blood.”

Big Cat Trainer.name:
大型猫科驯兽师
Big Cat Trainer

Text.text:
一名身着鲜艳马戏团彩衣的女子迈步向你走来，气势如王。她腰侧盘着一条黑红相间的长鞭，手里还握着一根细长的短杖，形似马鞭。她停下脚步，卷起袖口，露出结实有力的前臂，其中一只臂上赫然横着三道又长又深的疤痕。她显然将那伤痕视作荣耀的徽记。
A woman dressed in bright circus colors strides toward you with the confidence of a king. She wears a black-and-red whip coiled at her hip and carries a thin rod, something like a riding crop. She stops and rolls up her sleeves, revealing powerful forearms, one of them notably marred by three long scars. She clearly sees them as a badge of honor.

Loot From A Girallon.name:
来自巨猿兽的战利品
Loot From A Girallon

Text.text:
叶覆的地巢植物间，隐约有一抹黯淡微光——那是铜色的反射。一只工艺精湛的号角，泛着蓝绿的铜锈光泽，号口周缘以精工錾刻环绕着奥秘符号。其上还连接着一条钢制肩链。
A dull shimmer among the plants of the leafy ground nest comes from something copper. A horn of impressive workmanship, tinged with an aqua-green patina and tooled around its bell with symbols of the arcana. Attached to it is a steel shoulder chain.

幼小的卓尔跌跌撞撞地这边晃那边蹒跚，一头撞进蛛网里。起初他们惊惶失措，胡乱挥舞手脚，想把那黏腻的丝线从身上扯开。但几乎立刻又安静下来，轻轻吐出一口气，伸出一根手指，让那只黑色蛛形生物顺势爬上来，安然脱困。
The infant drow stumbles into a spiderweb as they toddle this way and that. At first, they react with panic, gesticulating wildly to try and rid themselves of the sticky thread. But they calm almost immediately, easing out a breath as they extend a finger and allow the black arachnid to climb to safety.

Calculating Head Of Security.name:
安保主管的盘算
Calculating Head Of Security

Text.text:
那名军官以审视战术的目光打量着你，眼神冷静而有条不紊地在你身上搜寻着弱点。随即，一抹笑意扭曲了他们的面容，像一把刀狠狠捅进腹中。确认盘查无误后，他们僵硬的姿势才——微微——松动，随手一挥，示意你离开他们的办公室。
The officer regards you with an appraising tactical gaze, their eyes methodically searching you for weakness. And a smile twists their features like a knife in the gut. Satisfied with their inspection, their rigid posture relaxes—slightly—and they wave you out of their office.

一想到曾有人在此栖身，便涌起一阵悲凉；而此地如今空无一人，更将那悲凉加深。霉烂的稻草堆上方，粗布麻袋从破洞里勉强穿过，摇摇欲坠地系在旧鸡舍的三面墙上。承载这座棚舍的那片宅地——曾经尚可住人的房屋——也同样荒弃。或许，那名鸠占者为了熬得够久、好对这片产业提出占有主张，最终换来了更好的前景；又或许，那只是把他引向了最后的归宿。
To think someone lived here causes a sadness, only made worse by the place being empty. Over a mound of moldy straw, cloth sacking is tied precariously through holes to the three walls of an old coop. The property on which this sits, once a serviceable house, is also abandoned. Perhaps the squatter’s attempt to last long enough to make a claim on the property led to better prospects. Perhaps it only led to a final one.

Arwan Romanio.name:
阿尔万·罗马尼奥
Arwan Romanio

Text.text:
他沉沉倚着一柄外形玄奥的三叉戟，纤瘦的半精灵缓步走近。雾气自他的武器里渗涌而出——寒冷刺骨，冷到雪粒都开始在他周身起舞，被渐起的风卷得纷飞。系在腰间的青铜面具随步伐叮当作响，优雅的角与牛鼻在新凝的霜光里一闪一闪。他抬手褪下厚重的毛皮兜帽，露出一张苍白的面孔；那双巨大的眼睛悲悯得近乎疼痛，银色深处刻着难以愈合的哀伤。他倏然掀开羊毛衬里的斗篷，俯身一礼，细密的精灵链甲在晨光下点点流辉。胸前的圣徽散出淡淡的蔚蓝冷辉，空气里弥漫的冰川寒意随之更深。

~ Played by Danongorf with

Leaning heavily upon an esoteric-looking trident, the slim half-elf approaches. Mist hemorrhages from his weapon—so cold that particles of snow begin to dance about him—tossed around by a growing breeze. The bronze mask tied to his belt chimes with each step, elegant horns and bovine snout glinting with fresh-formed frost. He doffs his heavy fur hood, the pale face beneath dominated by large mournful eyes, their silvery depths scarred with sorrow. Throwing open his fleece-lined cloak, he bows, delicate elven chainmail sparkling in the morning light. The holy symbol upon his chest emits a pallid cerulean glow, and the glacial chill filling the air deepens.

~ Played by Danongorf with

从峭壁之巅，盛大自助宴的香气随风飘散，绵延数里，撩拨全镇人的味蕾，奉上令人垂涎的美食诱惑。来自四方的厨师齐聚海岸厨艺大赛同台竞技，他们的热情、专注与炉火纯青的技艺，都在陈列的佳肴中一览无遗。各式航海生物被以千般手法烹制，与海岸常见的海鸟与岩蛤交织同盘；每道菜浓烈的海洋风味彼此暗暗缠绕，汇成一场颠覆味觉的全新体验。

~ 由 Discord 上的 crunchyzombies 构想

From atop the cliffs the smell of a grand buffet carries on the wind for miles around, delighting the town with tantalizing culinary offerings. Chefs from all over the land have come to compete in the Coastal Cook-Off, and their passion, dedication, and mastery of their craft are evident in the food on display. Nautical creatures prepared in every style imaginable mingle with coastal staples like seabird and rock clams, the robust oceanic flavors of each dish subtly intertwined to create a radical new experience.

~ Envisioned by crunchyzombies on Discord

Sundries From An Mezzoloth.name:
来自一名梅佐洛斯的杂货
Sundries From An Mezzoloth

Text.text:
在这具异界的乌特罗洛斯尸体上，你发现了一只奇异的瓶子——空的——以乳白虹彩的水晶雕琢而成，瓶身刻满陌生的奥术符文，光线掠过时仿佛会扭曲游移。
On the otherworldly corpse of the Ultroloth you find a curious flask—empty—crafted of opalescent crystal and engraved with strange arcane runes that seem to bend and shift in the light.

Toppled “Nearest” Tombstone In Winter.name:
冬日里翻倒的“最近”墓碑
Toppled “Nearest” Tombstone In Winter

Text.text:
墓碑横躺在冰冷的地面上，愈发深厚的积雪中几乎看不见。挖出这座坟的人想必正等着把它立回原位——等尸体下葬之后再说。

[调查] 你拂去碑上的雪，却发现它一片空白。在墓园里现刻碑文本就少见，尤其是这种时节。你心生疑窦，将冻得发僵的手指顶进霜层，探到石碑下方，用力撬起。你咬牙抬起沉重的大理石板，露出一张沾满黏泥与枯草的“脸”。你抹去污秽，终于辨出刻字：离我们心最近、最珍爱的。 它看起来很古老。这座坟想必也很久了。也许有人打算把新死者葬进这里；又或许——这是一次盗墓。

The tombstone lies on the cold ground, barely visible in the deepening snow. Whoever dug the grave must be waiting to set it properly once the body has been buried.

[Investigated] You brush the snow off the tombstone but find it is blank. It would be unusual to do the engraving here in the cemetery, especially in this season. Curious, you wedge freezing fingers through the frost and under the stone to lever it up. Heaving up the heavy slab of marble, you reveal a face covered in clinging dirt and dead grass. Brushing away the muck, you can make out the inscription: Nearest and dearest to our hearts. It looks old. The grave must be old too. Perhaps someone new was going to be buried in it. Or maybe this is a case of grave robbery.

Vault Guarded By Magic User.name:
被魔法守护的地窖守卫
Vault Guarded By Magic User

Text.text:
一声响亮的咳嗽把你的注意力拉回到小桌后那名身披红袍的身影；他用一种刺耳拖沓的腔调冷冷地对你开口，仿佛词句从他嘴里滚落出来。他身后，一扇巨大的圆形门如磐石般矗立不动，空气里隐隐泛起一种……看不见的战栗。他叹息着合上书，朝你招手示意。他在笑，可那双眼睛却硬得像钻石。

~ Envisioned by crunchyzombies on Discord

A loud cough draws your attention to the red-robed figure behind the small desk; he addresses you curtly in a lurid drawl, as if the words are tumbling from his mouth. Behind him a large circular door stands resolute, and the air tingles with something… unseen. Closing his book with a sigh the man beckons to you. He smiles, yet his eyes are hard as diamond.

~ Envisioned by crunchyzombies on Discord

金属般的嗡鸣声预告着一只骇人的昆虫状生物降临。它大如骏马，体内脉动的火光隐隐透出光辉；怪物俯冲而下，六足末端如剑的利爪尽数伸展，蓄势待发。下腹伸出一根尖锐的毒刺，黏稠的毒液凝成珠滴，寒光闪烁的尖端向任何感受其接触者许诺一场缓慢而痛苦的死亡。
A metallic buzz heralds the arrival of a terrifying insectoid creature. Large as a horse and glowing with pulsating internal fire, the monster descends, six legs capped with sword-like talons extended and ready to strike. Viscous poison beads on a piercing stinger protruding from its lower abdomen, the shimmering point promising a slow and agonizing death to any who feel its touch.

Galactic Senator’s Party.name:
银河参议员的宴会
Galactic Senator’s Party

Text.text:
银河参议员的庆典是一场为感官而设的饕餮盛宴：来自银河每个角落的光影、乐声与滋味交织翻涌。显贵与外交官穿梭其间，与艺术家和科学家把酒言欢，人人都裹在最精致华美的盛装里。音乐混搭百般流派，佳肴近乎神赐，而空气中噼啪作响的，是阴谋与野心交融后的醉人电流。
The galactic senator's celebration is a delectable feast for the senses, with sights, sounds, and flavors from every corner of the galaxy. Dignitaries and diplomats mingle with artists and scientists, all swathed in their most exquisite finery. The music is an eclectic mix of styles, the food divine, and the air crackles with the heady fusion of intrigue and ambition.

Hold Person Paralyzing Player.name:
人类定身术 麻痹玩家
Hold Person Paralyzing Player

Text.text:
最初，你的四肢末端像被针扎般刺痛发麻。麻木随之蔓延。烦躁与灼痛沿着肢体扩散，直往体内更深处钻去，肌肉痉挛抽紧，关节僵锁卡死。呼吸变得沉重而艰难，脸也凝固在一抹痛苦的狞笑里。除了眼睛，你感觉自己再也动不了了。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

It starts with pins and needles in your extremities. Numbness sets in. Irritation spreads through your limbs and deeper into your body as your muscles cramp and your joints lock. Your breathing becomes labored, and your face freezes in a grimace. Other than your eyes, you sense you can no longer move.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Elderly Velociraptor.name:
年迈的伶盗龙
Elderly Velociraptor

Text.text:
在残酷的食肉者等级体系里，唯有最可怖的才能熬到高年代。这只生物风霜侵蚀的皮革般外皮上，密布深而参差的疤痕，昭示着它曾经的凶名。尽管利爪已崩缺，獠牙也发黄脆裂，这头年迈的迅猛龙仍能将轻视它的人拖入血淋淋的结局。
Only the most fearsome survive to old age in the brutal carnivore hierarchy. The creature’s weathered hide is covered in deep, ragged scars which attest to its prowess. Though the claws are chipped and the teeth are now yellow and brittle, the old velociraptor is still capable of delivering a bloody fate to those who underestimate it.

在黑暗的映衬下，无数纯粹光芒凝成的细小浮动光球涌现，摇曳起伏，自阴影中疾驰而来，直扑向你。它们仿佛从四面八方同时逼近，明亮的蓝光在你周身各处对你形成夹击，那不息的嗡鸣声灌满你的耳畔。
Against the dark, a multitude of tiny bobbing spheres of pure light emerge, racing toward you from the shadows. They seem to come from everywhere, bright blue flanking you on all sides, their persistent hum filling your ears.

Defender Sprite.name:
守护小妖精（特征）
Defender Sprite

Text.text:
你能从那些字符里看出来：方方正正、沉甸甸的一团乱码，被编码过。那串指令读起来像个戴着猪肉馅饼帽的家伙，稳稳坐在餐馆吧台的高脚凳上，用碗扒拉着土豆牛肉杂烩。他的拳头是矩阵编织的钢铁，硬得像冻成块的火腿。起初你读到的是暴徒，可随即你意识到，他那张由断过的鼻梁、厚重的颌骨与熊一般的眼睛拼出来的脸，写的其实是老大。“滚出去。”他低吼道。

~ 由一位英雄构想

You can see it in the characters: boxy and solid gibberish, encoded. The commands read like a guy in a porkpie hat, parked on a diner stool, eating hash from a bowl. His fists are matrix-woven steel, solid as frozen hams. At first you read Thug, but then you realize that his face—which is made of nose breaks, heavy jaw bones, and eyes like a bear’s—says Boss. “Geddout,” he growls.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

胡夫·马卢夫是城里的马厩，已有近500年历史，过去一个世纪一直由一个颇具幽默感的约旦裔马卢夫家族经营。他们来自佩特拉附近的一座小镇，不过镇民并不知道那地方与学院有所关联。

吟游石像是一尊雕像，用以纪念尖塔巫奇历史上一位近似莎士比亚的传奇人物；传言他其实是名术士，擅长施法操控人类情绪。雕像以花岗岩雕刻而成，立于一张张扬夸饰的巨弓正中央。
Hoof Maloof is the city stables, nearly 500 years old, run for the past century by a Jordanian family—with a sense of humor—named Maloof. They arrived from a town near Petra, although the townsfolk aren't aware of its Academy connection. The Bardstone is a statue commemorating a kind of Shakespearean figure in Spirewych's history, rumored to be a sorcerer adept at casting spells to control human emotions. The figure is carved in granite and is in the middle of a flamboyant bow.

Student's Name Seen On Academy Clock.name:
学生的名字出现在学院钟面上
Student's Name Seen On Academy Clock

Text.text:
“哎呀，你看。稳住，朋友。你的签名刚刚被短手抽中了。”
“Uh-oh, look. Brace yourself, my friend. Your signature just got picked by the short hand.”

Gladiators' Training Yard.name:
角斗士训练场
Gladiators' Training Yard

Text.text:
尘土飞扬的庭院里回荡着武艺训练的铿锵声，魁梧的斗士们挥舞木制兵器相互切磋。粗砂上渗着斑斑血迹，刷白的墙面将烈日的炙热反射回斗场，使战士们在一场残酷的耐力与体能考验中咬牙坚持。一名遍体疤痕的人穿行于众人之间，黝黑的皮肤下筋肉绷紧如弦，一手垂着编织长鞭，另一手握着一柄短剑。

~ Inbal 于 Discord

The dusty courtyard resounds with the clatter of martial training as burly fighters spar with wooden weapons. Blood stains the coarse sand, and the whitewashed walls reflect the sun's heat onto the combatants in a grueling test of endurance and stamina. A scarred individual, whose sinewy muscles stand taut under dark skin, walks among the warriors, a braided whip hanging from one hand and a gladius in the other.

~ Inbal on Discord

Approaching A Happy Village.name:
走近「幸福村」
Approaching A Happy Village

Text.text:
一名城门卫兵被同伴的笑话逗得哈哈大笑。两人热情招呼，挥手放你通行。两个孩子争论狗能不能跑赢马，其中一个睁大眼睛、满怀希冀地问你怎么看。集市上，最年长的商贩高声喊道：“哦，是吗？”随即从摊位后走出来，踏着节拍跳起一段欢快的轮舞。人群哄然大笑，掌声四起。巡游的炼金术士拦住一个一瘸一拐的女孩，把一枚玻璃护符塞到她手里，又摆摆手不收她的报酬。两位恋人和着吟游诗人的鲁特琴轻声合唱。湛蓝的天空仿佛无边无际。
One gate guard laughs at the other’s joke. They welcome and wave you through. Two children debate whether a dog can outrun a horse. One asks what you think, wide-eyed with hope. At the market, the oldest of merchants shouts, “Oh yeah?” and steps from behind his stall to dance a reel. People laugh and applaud. The traveling alchemist stops a limping girl, hands her a glass periapt, then waves away her payment. Two lovers harmonize to a bard’s lute. There seems to be no limit to the blue sky.

Royal Parade With Escort.name:
有护卫随行的皇家游行
Royal Parade With Escort

Text.text:
他们说，繁忙的城市是一具活生生的有机体。若真如此，这具有机体已经醉得危险。号角嘹亮，宣告游行队伍到来。披甲骑士策马而过，挡住视线；人群挤压上前，欢呼、乞求、咒骂交织，伸手越过守卫，而守卫寥寥无几。王室就在几步之外，挥手微笑，身披华贵礼服，仿佛将整条街的价值都穿在身上。命令只有一个：就让它一直如此。

~ 由 Envisioned 设想，Hgg 创作

They say a busy city is a living organism. If so, this organism is dangerously drunk. A trumpet fanfare announces the procession. Knights on horseback block the view, the crowd presses in with cheering and begging and cursing, reaching out past the guards, who are too few. The royals travels only a few feet away, waving and smiling, wearing the worth of this street in regalia. The order is to keep it that way.

~ Envisioned by Hgg

Library Of Arcana: The Stacks.name:
秘奥图书馆：书库区
Library Of Arcana: The Stacks

Text.text:
这些书架上挤得满满当当，书脊开裂、起皱、沾污。它们看起来古老不堪，封皮被时代啃噬得残破，又被一代代数百双手的油垢浸得发黑。灰色尘埃在书根处堆成一层层浮漂，像积雪般蔓延。它们的模样带着一种恒久不移的重量，仿佛你的一生也不过会被压缩成它们纸页上的又一道模糊污痕。
The spines of the books squeezed onto these shelves have cracks, wrinkles, and stains. They look ancient, their skins ravaged by time and grimed by hundreds of hands over generations. Drifts of gray dust collect about their bases like snow. Their appearance gives them a sense of permanence, as if the span of your life might be rendered into just another smudge on their pages.

Sir Mankart Nobleson.name:
曼卡特·诺布尔森爵士
Sir Mankart Nobleson

Text.text:
他在眨眼之间拔剑出鞘，钢刃迎光一闪。剑锋寒芒如露出的獠牙——一抹致命的笑。这位高贵的骑士，披着耀眼的板甲，金亚麻色的发丝轻垂，并非王国里徒有其表的闪亮战利品。他以娴熟的优雅握住武器，护甲的重量对他而言毫无阻碍。胸甲上的红色飞龙张开双翼与利爪，宛如新鲜血迹溅开的形状——威仪凛然的纹章，宣告着他的本领。

~ 由一位英雄 扮演

He draws his sword in the span of a blink, steel flashing in the light. The blade glints like a bared fang—a deathly smile. This noble knight, with his shining plate and flaxen tresses, is not merely a glimmering trophy of the kingdom. He holds his weapon with practiced grace, the weight of his armor no hindrance. The red wyvern on his chestplate spreads out its wings and legs like a splatter of fresh blood, a regal herald of his prowess.

~ Played by a Hero

这台小型立式钢琴的键盘比你想象中那些更华丽的钢琴要短些，琴柜则笔直竖立。它的音色与同类并无二致，唯独内部的击弦机与琴键下方的关节相连，落槌触弦的方式也有所不同。只有真正的玩家才会察觉其中差异——在娴熟而精致的接触之下，乐器的手感会将秘密悄然吐露。而对大多数外行来说，他们只需满足于去爱那从这台光泽如镜、鸟眼枫木制成的乐器里流淌出来的歌声。
The spinet’s keyboard is shorter than you might expect from a more grandiose piano, and the cabinet stands upright. It sounds like any other of its ilk, except that the hammers inside are attached to joints under the keys and drop differently on the strings. Only a real player might notice the difference, the feel of the instrument under a refined and practiced touch. The average layperson, though, will be content loving the songs that come from the beautifully polished birdseye-maple instrument.

在如山般起伏的沙丘与灼人的黄沙之间，在这片干涸荒原的中心，一抹闪耀的祖母绿静静等待。葱郁的绿意环绕着波光粼粼的湖泊，一群兽群在翠绿的草地上悠然啃食。棕榈树投下宽阔的荫凉，开花的植物以淡雅宜人的芬芳轻轻沁入空气。清甜的淡水、成熟的果实、舒适的阴影——你不禁怀疑，自己这一生是否曾见过如此美丽的景象。
Amidst mountainous dunes and scorching sands, at the center of an arid wasteland, a gleaming emerald waits. Lush greenery surrounds a glistening lake, and a herd grazes in the verdant grass. Palms trees provide ample shade, and flowering plants scent the air with a subtle pleasant perfume. Fresh water, ripe fruit, shade—you wonder if you've ever seen something so beautiful in all your life.

Mauled Victim.name:
被撕咬得血肉模糊的受害者
Mauled Victim

Text.text:
半身人倒在自己血泊与破碎内脏之中。腥臭的恶味凝滞在空气里，猩红的鞭痕溅染了近旁的墙面。这是一场屠杀。那可怜的生物面容仍凝固在临终一刻的恐惧抽搐里，冰冷的双手绝望地紧攥着一枚粗糙的木制圣徽。造成这一切的，绝非寻常野兽。
The halfling lies in a pool of their own blood and torn viscera. The wretched smell hangs in the air, and lashes of crimson stain the walls nearby. This was a slaughter. The poor creature’s face is still frozen in the rictus of terror they had in their final moments, cold hands clasped desperately around a rough wooden holy symbol. Whatever did this was no ordinary beast.

Sundries From A Stone Giant.name:
石巨人杂货
Sundries From A Stone Giant

Text.text:
在这名灰皮泰坦的麻布挎袋里，你发现了一批圆润得近乎完美、光滑如抛光的石子。它们小到根本不适合巨人投掷，与其说是战场上的武器，不如说更像一件件精致的艺术品。
In the gray-skinned titan’s hempen satchel, you find a collection of exquisitely round, smooth stones. Too small to be thrown by the giant, they are more akin to pieces of art than weapons of war.

[类人形态] 他笑容从容自然，金发泛着光泽，淡褐色的眼睛摄人心魄——这个男人的一切都英俊得令人卸下戒心。身着时髦衣装向你走来时，你注意到他目光里潜伏着近乎捕食者般的渴望。 [变形为软泥] 男人那张曾经完美的脸骤然塌垂，像老猎犬松弛的面皮。他在下坠的腮肉间扭出一抹狞色，眼中的饥渴依旧浓烈得刺人。胸腔深处传出咕噜作响，他猛地溅散成一滩闪亮的金属黏浆。它沉到曾为膝盖的位置，像燃尽的蜡烛芯般翻倒，倾覆进污泥里。 [变形为类人] 软泥猛地一抽，收拢自身，颤抖着费力凝成一个类人轮廓。令人作呕的啧啧吸啜声渐渐安静，五官开始成形：剪裁考究的衣装、无瑕的肌肤，以及一张英俊的脸与急切的眼睛。曾是黏液水洼的地方，如今立着一个男人；那生物仅余的痕迹，是地面上一枚微湿的印子。

~ Played by Khaolo

[Humanoid form] The ease of his smile, the sheen of his blond hair, the draw of his hazel eyes–everything about this man is disarmingly handsome. As he approaches you in his fashionable attire, you notice an almost predatory yearning in his gaze. [Transformation to ooze] The man’s once-perfect face suddenly droops like an old hound’s. He grimaces through sagging jowls, the hungry look in his eyes as potent as ever. A gurgle emits from deep within his chest as he splashes into a puddle of shiny, metallic goo. He sinks to what were once knees, capsizing into the muck like the wick of a fully spent candle. [Transformation to humanoid] With a lurch, the ooze gathers itself and, with shaking effort, assumes the form of a humanoid silhouette. Its sickening slurps quiet as features begin to define themselves: well-tailored clothing, pristine skin, and a handsome face with eager eyes. A man now stands where the puddle of ooze once did, the only remnant of the former creature a slightly wet imprint upon the ground.

~ Played by Khaolo

Staff Of Holly, Female.name:
冬青法杖（女性）
Staff Of Holly, Female

Text.text:
这根法杖呈沙金浅金色，杖身遍布细密的深色纹理，长达七英尺，打磨得光滑温润，不施封蜡亦无清漆。自顶至底，一枝深绿冬青沿着杖身螺旋缠绕——在魔法的驱使下紧紧攀附——其间点点红莓如血般鲜亮。持杖者会不时被冬青刺破，滴落的鲜血滋养着它的魔力。若以仪式之法与其“雄性”对应之杖相击，杖上的红莓便会由剧毒转为治疗；待它再次击中那根雄杖，红莓又会变回毒性。
Sandy blond with fine dark tracing throughout, this staff is seven feet long, smoothly burnished and without seal or lacquer. Wrapped around it in a spiral from top to bottom—clinging with magical animation—is a long sprig of deep green holly speckled with red berries. The wielder of the staff is regularly pricked by the holly, the blood feeding its magical power. Ritually struck against its male counterpart, the staff’s berries change from poisonous to healing. When it strikes the male staff again, they change back.

褴褛飘荡的长袍在她飞扑而来时狂乱翻卷。她是个令人作呕的幽影，这缚灵（特征）曾经的精灵面容被拉扯成彻底的扭曲：耳朵、鼻子与牙齿尖得过分，眼神与刺耳的尖啸也残忍得过分。她泛着青蓝的肤色仿佛冻到失温，但她的接触带来的却是另一种更阴森、更恶毒的寒意。
Tattered, flowing robes whip about the creature as she flies toward you. An unsightly apparition, the wraith's once-elven features have stretched into pure perversion: her ears, nose, and teeth are far too pointed, her eyes and screeching wail far too cruel. Her blue pallor looks hypothermic, but a different, more sinister coldness is borne by her touch.

Vampire's Manor: Den.name:
吸血鬼（特征）的宅邸：巢穴
Vampire's Manor: Den

Text.text:
红色沙发与椅子上堆满了松软靠垫，但厚厚的尘埃与污垢为它们蒙上一层阴翳，更别提有个生物把这片空间当作巢穴的刺眼痕迹。恶臭的垃圾与乌黑的毛发在房间里成堆散落；当你走向挂着帘子的窗边时，脚下踢得满地被啃噬过的骨头咔啦作响。
Red couches and chairs sit piled with plush cushions, though their allure is tempered by the shroud of dust and grime, as well as the unmistakable presence of a creature using the space for a nest. Foul-smelling refuse and dark fur lies in piles about the room, and as you move to the curtained window, your foot rattles gnawed-upon bones littering the floor.

你只要在这座城里沿着一条街走下去，就会明白：对这里的行会必须多留个心眼。各色匠人和艺师都在自己的地盘上劳作、兜售手艺。大多数大道看起来如出一辙：临街是铺面，后头是作坊，上头是起居的空间。变的只有货物——这边是一条修补匠的街，那边是一条陶匠的街，而此刻你正踏进皮匠的巷子。若是发现全城的旅店也被排成一线挤在同一条路上，你也不会觉得意外。
You have but to walk down one street in this city to know that you must be wary of its guilds. Crafters and artisans of all sorts have their places to practice and sell their wares. Most avenues look the same: shops face the road with workshops behind and living space above. Only the goods change. Here a road of tinkers, there a street of potters, and now a lane of leathermakers. You wouldn’t be surprised to find all the city’s inns lined up together on one road.

Abandoned Elven Village.name:
被遗弃的精灵村落
Abandoned Elven Village

Text.text:
这座村落曾是叶与歌之民的家园，如今却沉寂无声。再听不见孩童嬉闹，不见商贾往来，也没有长笛的清音或精灵抑扬的歌喉。曾被细心照料的花草树木，如今沿着废弃的屋舍恣意疯长，将这片空寂之地悄然吞没。
This village, once home to the people of leaf and song, lies silent now. No sounds of children playing, no bustle of commerce, no music from flutes or lyrical elven voices. Plants and trees, once tenderly cared for, now grow wild along the abandoned buildings of this empty place.

Domain, Human Hacker.name:
领域，人类黑客
Domain, Human Hacker

Text.text:
他脸色苍白病态，鼻翼周围泛着擦破般的红，脸上还横着几道在小巷里速战速决留下的疤。他穿着一件连帽衫，内衬藏着隐秘的护甲；一件利落的衬衫，能化作巨大的可穿戴屏幕；再配上一条宽松长裤，缝着一排排只够塞进U盘的小口袋。他随身带着一台赛博甲板，冷蓝的人造光在边缘流淌，里面收纳着他的3D化身——兜帽遮身、无面无相的游侠。金发用发胶竖起尖刺，在后颈与头骨交界处，一枚数据接口闪着微光。他前臂上刺着：Cntrl + C, Cntrl + V。他有点莽、话少而冲，常把社交场合当成自己仍在赛博空间里。

~ Played by a Hero

Pale and sickly, raw around the nostrils and streaked with a few scars from quick alley fights, he wears a hoodie lined with concealed armor, a smart shirt that acts as a massive wearable screen, and baggy pants fitted with tiny pockets for USB sticks. He carries a cyberdeck of cool blue artificial light that stashes his 3D avatar—a hooded, faceless rogue. Below gelled spikes of blond hair, a data port gleams at the base of his skull. Tattooed on his forearm is: Cntrl + C, Cntrl + V. He’s a little brash, curt, and often treats social situations as if he were still in cyberspace.

~ Played by a Hero

Icon Of The Net.name:
蛛网圣像
Icon Of The Net

Text.text:
一座完美的宫殿环抱着她：一部分像希腊神庙，一部分像奢华酒店，一部分像增强现实的超级商场。这是她的领域，它在她身边拔地而起——由无尽之眼的追随者们铸成：用他们的帖子与视频，用他们的音乐短片与丝滑到刺眼的内容。她斜倚在一张柔软的化妆椅里，为一百万个不同的企业赞助商代言。她的头发如一条数字的闪耀长河。她的眼睛宽阔而诱人。她微张着嘴，唇形完美地嘟起，吐出一声带着人造渴望的叹息。追随者们在她面前匍匐。她是所有注意力的女神，是世界珍贵的现金……而她，也将夺走他们的眼睛。

~ 由一位英雄设想

A perfect palace surrounds her: part Greek temple, part luxury hotel, part augmented hypermall. This is her realm, and it rises around her—her followers of the endless eyes have made it, with their posts and their videos, with their music videos and their ultraslick content. She reclines in a plush make-up chair promoting one million different corporate sponsors. Her hair is a digital sparkling river. Her eyes are broad and inviting. Her mouth is parted in a perfect pout, and she sighs with artificial longing. Followers prostrate themselves before her. She is the Goddess of all attention, the world's precious currency… and she will have her eyes.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Cast Blink.name:
我施放【闪现】
I Cast Blink

Text.text:
随时都可能发生——我低声呢喃那句让法术带我离开的指令，只需短短几秒。那是个奥秘而缥缈的词，听起来更像一道惊雷的裂响，而非任何可辨的语言。我在原地瞬间消失；隔着灰光与暗影的薄幕，我看见自己的落点——离他们最后看见我的地方十英尺。
It could happen any moment I try whispering the command needed for the spell to carry me away for just a few seconds. It is an arcane and ethereal word, more like a crack of thunder than any recognizable tongue. I blink out of existence, and through the filter of gray light and shadow, I see my landing place—ten feet from where they saw me last.

You Overhear A New Language.name:
你无意间听见一门陌生的新语言
You Overhear A New Language

Text.text:
你竭力想听清从牢房外经过的守卫在说些什么。那些声音隐约熟悉，却怎么也拼不出意义——仿佛有人把你的语言拆散了字母，再用全然陌生、不可理解的方式重新拼接。他们刻薄地大笑，与你目光相触时又嫌恶地皱起脸，啐了一口唾沫在地上。

~ 由 Angie H 所构想

You struggle to make out the words being spoken by the guards passing your cell. Though the sounds feel familiar, you can't make sense of them—as if someone has taken your language and rearranged the letters of the words in new incomprehensible ways. They laugh spitefully, then spit on the ground with a disgusted grimace when they meet your gaze.

~ Envisioned by Angie H

Ambush By Underwater Ghouls.name:
遭遇水下食尸鬼伏击
Ambush By Underwater Ghouls

Text.text:
附近的泥沼里猛地溅起水花，紧接着传来咕嘟咕嘟的气泡声与一声含混的哀鸣。泥沼中，一只食尸鬼（特征）缓缓站起，黏滑的青绿色躯体如同死亡之船的索具般舒展开来。它的獠牙与利爪凶狠得像鲨齿，身上还挂着一片类人生物的破布衣物。你看清了它那张脸，饥渴与邪恶塞满每一道褶皱。就在这时，又有好几只同伴像它一样从泥沼中冒起，迫不及待要加入战斗。

~ Envisioned by Adam C

A splash comes from the nearby mire, followed by a bubbling moan. Up from that mire, a ghoul stands, its slimy, slick green body unfurling like the rigging of a death ship. Its teeth and claws look as wicked as shark teeth, and it wears a scrap of humanoid clothing. You see its face, full of hunger and evil. That's when several of its friends rise up just like it, eager to join the fight.

~ Envisioned by Adam C

一条巨大的红色蛞蝓，足有三尺多长，摇摇晃晃地爬入视野。它那圆形的巨口里密密麻麻排着上百排细小而锋利如剃刀的牙齿。它的身躯上布满往昔战斗留下的伤疤，肉乎乎的躯体间还刺出几块空间碎片。一圈柔和半透明的蓝灰色光环绕着这只生物缓缓旋转。
A giant red slug, over three feet long, wobbles into view. Its circular maw is filled with rows of hundreds of tiny, razor-sharp teeth. Scars from previous battles line its body, and bits of space debris poke out of the fleshy mass. A soft translucent circle of blue-gray light orbits the creature.

Elven Village At Harvest Time.name:
精灵村庄的丰收时代
Elven Village At Harvest Time

Text.text:
这片林间空地里的精灵居所沐浴在丰收的金色光辉中。四周的树木洋溢着自然的馈赠，枝头因累累成熟的恩赐而低垂；和谐的歌声与收割工具的沙沙声交织，感恩的颂歌充盈在空气里。广场上的宴席长桌满溢而出，堆满了大自然慷慨赐予的果实。
The elf dwellings in this glade bask in the golden hues of the harvest. Surrounding trees teem with natural bounty, their branches bowed beneath the weight of ripe blessings, and harmonious voices blend with the rustle of harvesting tools while songs of thanks fill the air. Feast tables in the square overflow, laden with the fruits of nature's generosity.

Spacegoing Vessel: Brig.name:
远航舰船：双桅横帆船
Spacegoing Vessel: Brig

Text.text:
船上的禁闭舱是个臭气熏天的空间，大小还不如一个扫帚间。昏暗肮脏的房间里，除了一个不锈钢马桶和一张可折下的床铺外别无他物，头顶的灯光令人烦躁地忽明忽暗。舱门用森然的铁条加固，没有窗户。里面的人被彻底隔绝。
The brig of the ship is a foul-smelling space no bigger than a broom closet. A stainless-steel toilet bowl and a fold-down bed are the only things of note in the dingy room, and a light flickers irritatingly overhead. The door is reinforced with menacing bars and there are no windows. The occupant is completely isolated.

没有马刺为亡命徒奏响叮当的曲调。没有货物碰撞作响，也没有人群应和着送出善意的祝福。一顶磨旧的帽子压得很低，遮住眉眼；目光四下游移，脑袋微偏，像鸟一样警觉。粗布衬衫外套着一件长及腿侧的帆布风衣，贴身的马裤塞进一双上好靴子里，随时能骑、也随时能跑。偶尔一阵风掀起衣摆，能瞥见皮质腰侧枪套里躺着一把左轮，对侧挂着一条鞭子。腰带上子弹一排排整齐卡着。亡命徒还背着一支气势不凡的步枪，干净锃亮，擦得发光。
No spurs play their tune for the outlaw. No wares clank, and no folk chime out kind wishes. A worn hat is tipped down over a lower brow, and eyes shift all ways, head cocked like a bird. A simple shirt of homespun is worn under a long canvas duster, and snug breeches are tucked into good boots for riding or running. Sometimes visible when a breeze catches the coattails, a six-shooter rests in a leather hip holster, opposite a whip. Bullets file along the belt. The outlaw also carries an impressive rifle, clean and polished.

Cloud Giant Ghost.name:
云巨人幽灵
Cloud Giant Ghost

Text.text:
一支阴郁的挽歌自一尊巍然耸立的幽影口中回荡，宛如滚雷般轰鸣不息；那幽魂巨人的长发与袍服翻涌飘荡，在昏暗光照中几近透明。你听不懂这曲子的词句，却觉得它沉沉压在灵魂深处，搅动起悲凉与失落，仿佛这正是为你自己的葬礼而唱的哀歌。
A somber dirge echoes like rolling thunder from a towering specter, the billowing hair and robes of the ghostly giant almost translucent in the dim light. The words of the song are unknown to you, yet they weigh heavily on your soul, stirring feelings of melancholy and loss as if this were your own funeral lament.

攻城弩蜷伏在一处匆匆掘出的土坑里，箱形的骨架隐蔽起来，躲开不受欢迎的目光。人皮紧绷地包覆在它的两侧，血画的原始符号横七竖八，充作抵御魔法攻击的壁垒。在这股恶臭翻涌的装置深处，毛发蓬乱的地精咧着露出断裂獠牙的阔笑，正将一支涂满毒液的弩矢推上弦槽。
The siege crossbow hunches within a hastily dug pit, its box-like frame masked from unwanted eyes. Human hides stretch taut about its flanks, covered in primitive symbols scrawled in blood, serving as bulwarks against magical attack. Inside the odiferous contraption, shaggy goblins with wide broken-fanged grins load a venom-daubed bolt.

Spirewych Stalls And Mews.name:
尖塔巫巢的摊棚与厩舍
Spirewych Stalls And Mews

Text.text:
斯派尔威奇曾拥有本地区规模最大的猎鹰棚之一，直到它被改造成马厩，人们可以在此买卖、租赁马匹。建筑覆以木瓦的圆角金字塔形屋顶，分片铺设；下方是抹灰的木构架，椽梁与栖架间开着细小的通风孔，鸟儿仍偶尔在此落脚栖息。马栏环形排布，朝向中央铺满干草的地面。
Spirewych had one of the largest falconry mews in the region until it was converted to a stable where horses can be bought, sold, and rented. The building has a wood shingled, rounded pyramid roof in panels, over a plastered wood frame with small airholes among the rafters and perches, where birds still sometimes roost. The stalls are arranged in the round, facing the center hay floor.

这只生物虽有蟾蜍般的外形，却像猿猴般移动，突出的指节拖曳在地面上。它的皮肤呈淤青般的蓝紫色，湿亮发光，布满疣粒。那邪魔般的生物张开宽阔、布满利齿的大口，露出一条粗厚而剧毒的舌头，随即发出一声呱鸣般的咆哮。
The creature moves like an ape despite its toad-like appearance, dragging its jutting knuckles along the ground. Its skin, the blue-violet of a bruise, glistens and is riddled with warts. The fiendish creature opens its expansive, toothy maw, revealing a thick, virulent tongue. It issues a croaking roar.

Temple To A God Of Machines.name:
机械之神的神庙
Temple To A God Of Machines

Text.text:
这座圣龛以一条金色的莫比乌斯环为标记，悬在一截细链之上，垂落于镀金的工作台祭坛前——祭坛打磨得光可鉴人，映出身后那面忙碌而密集的装饰性机械墙。祭司们身着工装背带裤，手提带弹簧底的注油壶，细心照料各处机件，确保每一处都润滑充足。有位祭司小心翼翼地校正每一枚螺丝的螺槽，让它们都端正得笔直向上，仿佛某位神圣的工头随时会来巡检。这里洁净得近乎苛刻，仿佛任何供品都会立刻被移走。
This shrine is identified by a Möbius strip of gold, hung from fine chain above a gilded workbench altar— polished to reflect the busy wall of decorative machinery behind it. The priests wear overalls and carry spring-bottom oilers to tend to the mechanisms, ensuring that each is fully lubricated. One priest carefully aligns the head of each screw so its groove is perfectly vertical, as though a divine foreman is about to make an inspection. It looks like any offering would be immediately removed, so immaculate is this shrine.

当你念完最后的咒音，一道由斑斓光辉构成的虹彩传送门在仪式圆环中央骤然升起，宛如通往异地的门扉。圆环上独有的符印泛起幽蓝光芒，随传送门的起伏震荡而脉动，与之同频共振。
An iridescent portal of multicolored light springs up in the middle of the ritual circle as you finish your intonations, a gateway to another place. The sigils unique to the circle glow blue, pulsing in time with the portal’s oscillations.

办公室里的喧嚣像一阵直击胸腔的嗡鸣——打字机键帽噼啪作响，众声低沉轰鸣交织成潮。两排桌子横贯房间，高耸的天花板被一层烟雾云幕遮得影影绰绰。记者写完一篇稿子，猛地从机器上抽下纸张，迅速卷成纸筒，塞进几只蜘蛛般自动机张合抓挠的颚钳里。那些金属蛛形发出嗡嗡与咔哒声，飞快爬向总编辑的桌前——他是个兽人，面颊覆着一层阴沉的胡茬阴影，眉骨厚重压人。一截将尽的雪茄挂在嘴角，甜腻的烟丝绕着他半月形的眼镜缓缓飘散。

~ Envisioned by Micah

The hubbub of the office is a visceral hum, a mix of clacking typewriter keys and the drone of many voices. Two rows of desks stretch across the room, the high ceiling obscured by a cloud of smoke. As a journalist finishes a story, they whip the paper from their machine, roll it into a scroll, and slip it into the grasping mandibles of spider-like automatons. These arachnids buzz and click their way to the desk of the editor-in-chief, an orc with a dark shadow of stubble on his face and a heavy brow. A dwindling cigar hangs from his mouth, and sweet smoke trails about his half-moon spectacles.

~ Envisioned by Micah

这处泊位是一段短而简洁的石质延伸台，为最庞大的航行于空间的巨舰提供充足余地，得以毫无阻碍地抛锚停泊。石台边缘俯瞰着宇宙织锦：繁星、星球与虹彩星云交织成的总汇。尽管此处的几何纹样并不繁复精巧，铭纹却涌动得更加炽亮，色泽逼近烈日般的明辉，而非下方平台那更为浓郁的金色光泽。你感觉脚下的震颤回响穿透全身，令你的整个形体都随之战栗。
This mooring is a short and simple stretch of stone, giving space for the largest of space-faring vessels to anchor without hindrance. The shelf overlooks the cosmic tapestry: a compendium of stars, planets, and prismatic nebulas. Although the geometric pattern here lacks an intricate design, the glyphs surge more brightly, edging on a sun-bright color rather than the richer golden hues of the platforms below. You feel the reverberations under your feet shoot through your body, making your entire form quaver.

Nature Cleric.name:
自然领域牧师
Nature Cleric

Text.text:
蛇人鳞片呈浓郁的褐色，自他扁平头顶起，一道道黑色菱形般的纹路蜿蜒而下，直至尾端那枚黝暗的尾铃。他的躯干保留着类人般的胸膛与双臂，披着厚重的铁木护甲，肩甲从肩头迸出，尖刺如破裂的利片般参差狰狞。他双手握着一面高盾，盾底收成凶狠的尖点，盾面绘着一条盛放的花藤。 牧师骤然扭身，强健的蛇躯如流水般滑入战斗。伴随一声掠空的嘶鸣，他召来一支爬行灵魄的军团：由绿与褐的薄雾凝成的虚影，在他周身起伏游曳。他抬起利爪，一圈藤蔓魔法般在掌心浮现，旋转、扭动。他猛然掷出，伴随雷鸣般的裂响——灵魄与之同动，速度与凶性不相上下。敌人被当场锁住，灵影与藤蔓缠绕其身，将他们死死钉在原地。 牧师讥诮地吐舌一甩，举起盾牌。仿佛乌云翻涌，成群昆虫从壁垒之后鼓荡而出，将他的敌人吞没在一片黑暗、嗡鸣的阴翳里。

~ Played by Colby Poulson of d4: D&D Deep Dive

The snakefolk’s scales are a shade of rich brown, and black diamond-like markings trace from the top of his flat head down to the dark rattle of his tail. His torso, with its humanoid chest and arms, is adorned in heavy ironwood armor, the pauldrons spiking off his shoulders in jagged shards. He holds a tall shield in both hands, its end coming to a vicious point and its face embellished with a painted flowering vine. The cleric swerves, his powerful serpentine body moving fluidly into action. With a hiss that sweeps through the air, he summons a legion of reptilian spirits: ethereal forms of green and brown mist that undulate around him. He raises his clawed hand and a loop of vines magically appears in his palm, spinning and writhing. He flings it forward with a thundering crack—his spirits move in tandem with equal speed and ferocity. Enemies are locked into place as spirit and vine tangle about them, keeping them still. With a mocking flick of his tongue, the cleric raises his shield. Like a cloud, insects billow out from behind the bulwark and consume his foes in a dark, droning pall.

~ Played by Colby Poulson of d4: D&D Deep Dive

分量被盛在瓷碗里，沿着餐板一字排开，碗沿鎏金闪烁。仆从依照卡片上写明的顺序呈上，低声指点王室该如何搭配，方能最鲜美、也最益于健康。王室眯起眼打量食物，神色里带着几分不适与疑虑；但仆从语气恳切……而那香气确实诱人。

~ 登场于 Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The portions are set along the board in porcelain bowls with gilded rims. A servant presents them in the order written on a card, instructing the royal as to the most flavorful and healthy combinations. The royal squints at the food with some discomfort and skepticism, but the servant is encouraging… and the food smells delicious.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

这些眼镜绝不是你会在寻常村落里见到的那种——为了应付需求而匆匆做出的粗陋货。它们的制作工艺一眼可见；无论你如何转动镜片，它都始终泛着一层柔和的灰色。将它举在眼前，透过它看出去的世界，光线不再那样刺目。你只能想象，若你认真戴上它们，面对耀眼强光时会产生怎样的效果。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

These do not look like the glasses you might find in an ordinary village, hastily crafted to serve a need. The expertise put into making them is evident, and no matter which way you angle the glass, it remains tinted a soft gray. Held out in front of you, the world looks less harshly lit through them. You can only imagine the effect these glasses may have on bright lights were you to try them on earnestly.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Mysterious Portal In Underdark.name:
幽暗地域的神秘传送门
Mysterious Portal In Underdark

Text.text:
白昼的温暖仿佛已成遥远且迅速褪色的记忆，尽管你们才在幽暗地域那广袤而险恶的天地间跋涉了短短几日。这里的黑暗比你经历过的任何黑暗都更深沉，近乎带着魔性——彻底而绝对的无光。你们一路穿行的迷宫般隧道原本逼仄压抑，此刻却骤然豁然开朗，化作一片辽阔的地下天地；只有磷光菌类稀薄的幽辉，勉强为其涂上一层黯淡的光。嶙峋而崩碎的地形一路隆起，直抵高悬的穹顶，仿佛一列拔地而起的巍峨山脉的剪影。你们方一踏入这座巨兽般的洞窟，一道灼热的银光便在眼前轰然爆裂——一扇明亮的传送门悬于空中，回荡着低沉而令人不安的嗡鸣。

~ Requested by Dung Beetle

The warmth of daylight seems a distant and quickly-fading memory, though you’ve only been traversing the vast and treacherous landscape of the Underdark for a few days now. The darkness here is deeper than any you’ve experienced, almost magical in its complete and utter lack of light. The cramped confines of the labyrinthine tunnels through which you’ve traveled suddenly give way to a sprawling, subterranean landscape, lit dimly by the scant glow of phosphorescent fungi. The craggy, crumbling terrain rises to meet the cavernous ceiling high above, evoking the silhouette of a soaring mountain range. No sooner have you stepped foot into this leviathan cavern than a searing, silver light erupts before you. A bright portal hangs in the air, resonating with a deep and disquieting hum.

~ Requested by Dung Beetle

藤蔓吞没了这栋建筑，怪异的叶片从蒙尘的窗内探出窥视。木质窗框与门廊被多年的雨与风染得黝黑，尖利的木刺像倔起的乱发般四下翘裂。屋顶灰白松垮，亟待修补。
Vines overwhelm this building, their curious leaves peeking into clouded windows. The wood frames and porch are dark from years of rain and wind, and splinters splay out in keen cowlicks. The roofing, gray and slack, is in need of repair.

镇广场上人声鼎沸：叫卖者高声吆喝自家货物，买家三三两两交谈，兽声此起彼伏——绵羊咩咩，犬吠汪汪，鹅群呱呱长鸣。遮阳篷、帐棚与手推车杂乱成行地排开，摊上货品陈列得或整齐或凌乱，各有各的规矩与随性。
The town square is abuzz with hawkers shouting about goods, buyers chatting, and animal noises—from sheep bleats, to dog barks, to geese honking. Awnings, tents, and carts stand arranged in messy rows, the goods on display in varying states of tidiness.

Clockwork Puzzle Box.name:
发条机关谜盒
Clockwork Puzzle Box

Text.text:
每一面都是由层层叠叠的棘轮、齿轮、传动小齿轮与连杆构成的精密机关。其中一面在最后组装前，必须先按斐波那契数列将刻度逐一拨入；而另一面则需要找回一块缺失的零件才能继续。黄铜的角部构件与镍制机芯在樱桃木外壳的映衬下格外醒目。轻轻摇晃盒子，会传来一阵低沉而闷响的咔啦声。
Each side is a layered work of ratchets, wheels, pinions, and arms. One side requires a Fibonacci sequence to be dialed in before the final step of assembly, while another requires a missing piece to be found. The brass corner pieces and nickel workings stand out against a cherry wood housing. A gentle shaking of the box produces a muffled rattle.

I Pilot A Flying Bike.name:
我驾驶一辆飞行摩托
I Pilot A Flying Bike

Text.text:
风从我身侧呼啸而过，我一拧震动摩托的油门，猛然加速，胃里随之狠狠一沉。城市在我脚下飞掠而去，霓虹化作一片流光般的模糊，我像在空中疾驰，把所有烦忧都甩在身后，与机器融为一体，沉溺在速度带来的狂喜之中。
Wind rushes past me and I feel my stomach lurch as I rev the throttle on the vibro-bike and accelerate. The city whizzes beneath me in a neon blur as I fly, leaving all my cares behind as I become one with the machine and lose myself in the thrill of speed.

Vial Of Drow Poison.name:
卓尔毒药小瓶
Vial Of Drow Poison

Text.text: [察觉] 小瓶以烟灰色玻璃制成，内盛靛青色的浓稠血浆般体液，沉得仿佛能像一小束怪异的肌肉那样蠕动。瓶塞华丽得足以当作纪念品：以黑蜡雕成一只蜘蛛，长腿紧扣在瓶口边缘。 [分析] 哦，卓尔最爱调制那种能黏附在武器上的毒液，而且一点也不遮掩。毒液与瓶塞都在提醒你：这毒药理所当然地是在黑暗中调配而成。 [Perceived] The vial’s smoky glass is filled with an indigo ichor heavy enough to move like a strange little muscle. The stopper is ornate enough to be a keepsake, carved in black wax to look like a spider with legs clamped around the vial’s lip. [Analyzed] Oh, the drow love mixing venom that clings to a weapon, and they aren’t subtle about it. The venom and stopper both remind you this poison is concocted, appropriately, in darkness.

Approaching Blizzard.name:
逼近的暴风雪
Approaching Blizzard

Text.text:
凛冽寒风骤然变调，从低沉的呜咽化作尖厉的呼啸。狂乱的阵风卷起刺痛的冰粒，狠狠拍打在你脸上。头顶天色迅速昏暗，地平线上，炭灰色的云层如巨影般压来。接踵而至的绝非宁静温柔的飘雪；相反，天幕豁然撕开，将冬日的“恩赐”狠狠倾砸向下方大地。狂风仿佛要把你从脚下掀走，而每一次风势加剧，便有鹅蛋大小的冰块碎片劈头盖脸地轰击而来。

~ Requested by Mr. Mischief

The frigid wind shifts suddenly from a low moan to a howling shriek. The buffeting gusts throw stinging ice against your face. The sky darkens overhead, and charcoal-gray clouds loom on the horizon. What follows is no serene, gentle snowfall; instead, the sky opens and hurls its wintry bounty to the ground below. The wind threatens to rip you from your feet while shards of ice the size of goose eggs pummel you with each gust.

~ Requested by Mr. Mischief

Guardrooms Of A Creepy Manor.name:
阴森庄园的守卫室
Guardrooms Of A Creepy Manor

Text.text:
这间卫兵室里弥漫着一种压迫感，冷硬的目光与刻意营造的氛围在宣告：只要你没做错事，就没什么好担心的。然而几处细微的迹象足以让你看穿这层单薄的谎言。几缕绳纤维还挂在一把结实却令人不适的椅子上——有人曾被按在这里盘问，手段绝不温柔；地面虽已擦得干净，但你匆匆一瞥那只用过的拖桶，桶沿仍残留着一圈淡薄的血痕。
There is an air of oppression in this guardroom, a steely-eyed cultivation of the premise that if one does nothing wrong, one has nothing to worry about. Yet a few small cues allow you to see through that flimsy lie. Bits of rope cling to a sturdy, uncomfortable chair where someone was questioned, none too gently, and though the floor is clean, a quick examination of the mop bucket used reveals a thin residue of blood around its rim.

Bone Trooper Technomancer.name:
白骨突击兵·科技法师
Bone Trooper Technomancer

Text.text:
剥去血肉后，这名士兵只剩森森白骨与残酷的意志，仿佛那战士的灵魂都被生生抽空。可在它冰冷眼窝里狡黠的幽光之外……似乎还藏着一丝柔软的哀伤？不管怎样，它依旧肩阔身高，如同一堵行走的壁垒。它携带的武器远超制式配备，而它的护甲也经过改装，嵌入了多种高科技强化。电光沿着它的右臂噼啪迸裂，决斗长剑的锋刃在技法秘能的辉光中灼然发亮。
Stripped of flesh, this soldier is nothing but bone and brutal purpose. It is as though the very soul of the trooper has been sucked out. Yet beyond the cunning light in its cold eye sockets… a soft sadness, perhaps? Regardless, it stands broad and tall. This trooper bears more than the standard array of weapons, and its armor has been modified with a variety of high-tech upgrades. Lightning crackles down the length of its right arm, the keen edge of a dueling sword glowing with the light of technomancy.

Giant's Skeleton.name:
巨人骷髅（特征）
Giant's Skeleton

Text.text:
乍一看，你把那些骨头误认作矗立的立石。它们在日光下漂白得惨白，半截埋在土里，苔藓一路向上攀爬。你忽然意识到，自己正站在这生物的肋笼之中；北面，那颗头骨以倾斜的角度从泥土里探出。眼眶大得足以让你把整条腿伸进去，空洞地朝天仰望。向东向西，你看见手臂伸展的模糊轮廓；向南，双腿以扭曲的角度横陈。巨人的右手在死时必定还紧攥着一件武器，因为你在那里捕捉到一抹黑铁的冷光。能放倒这等强悍巨人的东西，必定是一头可怖至极的猛兽。
At first glance, you mistake the bones for standing stones. Bleached white in the sun, they stand half-buried, moss creeping upward. You realize suddenly you stand in the ribcage of the creature, and to the north lies the skull, emerging at an angle from the soil. The eye sockets, large enough to fit your leg through, stare upward to the sky. To the east and west, you see the vague shape of arms outstretched, and to the south, legs lying at crooked angles. The giant's right hand must have clutched a weapon in death, because you catch the glint of dark iron there. Whatever felled this mighty giant must have been a terrible beast indeed.

Component Casting Of Illusory Script.name:
幻影文书的构材施法
Component Casting Of Illusory Script

Text.text:
你一边写着密信，一边施放法术。字句才刚在羊皮纸上显现，那些细致娟秀的笔画便像被无形的潮流牵引般流向一侧，彼此融作一团更大的墨渍，随后又分裂开来，重组为截然不同的新段落。你强迫自己凝神，避开那足以扭曲视线的诡谲景象；而当一切完成时，你确信密信已严密无隙，完美的幻象正牢牢遮蔽着它真正的讯息。

~ 构想 by bloodhadson

You cast the spell even as you write your missive. The words barely appear on the parchment before the delicately written strokes flow to one side, melding together into one larger ink blot, before splitting and forming themselves into completely new passages. You concentrate to avoid the eye-twisting spectacle, but once it is complete you are confident in the secrecy of your missive and the perfect illusion concealing its true message.

~ Envisioned by bloodhadson

Amphibious Spliced Creature.name:
两栖拼接生物
Amphibious Spliced Creature

Text.text:
那怪异的生物把宽阔的头颅抬向光亮处，黏稠如黏液的丝缕从它身上滴落——仿佛许多野兽被腐化后强行揉合成一体的畸形拼合物。它的脸几乎像一条鲨鱼：蓝灰色的皮肤粗砺不平，黑色的眼睛毫不眨动。它的嘴是一道宽阔的裂缝，像魟鱼的口器，却又狼狈地塞满了大小不一的利齿。它缓慢、咕噜作响地呼吸时，喉咙像蟾蜍般鼓胀，泡沫从齿缝间翻涌。它以双足站立，双腿短粗、覆满鳞片，利爪抠进地面，好稳住那踉跄不安的步伐。它的手臂末端是蟹一般的螯钳，张合间咔吱作响、咔嗒连连，对着空气徒然夹咬。

~ 一位英雄所构想

The strange creature lifts its broad head up into the light, dripping strings of something akin to mucus—it seems a corrupted amalgamation of many beasts meshed into one. Its face almost resembles a shark: blue-gray skin with a rough texture and unblinking black eyes. Its mouth is a wide slit like a stingray’s, but it is bedraggled with sharp teeth of varying sizes. Its throat balloons like a toad’s as it takes slow, gurgling breaths, bubbles foaming from between its teeth. It stands upon bipedal legs, stout and scaled, with claws that dig into the ground to steady its uneasy steps. Its arms end in crablike claws that creak and click as they snap at open air.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Fold My Folding Boat.name:
我把折叠船折了起来
I Fold My Folding Boat

Text.text:
我小心避开那艘船——免得脚被卷进魔法回缩里——开口念出将小船折回盒中的口令。它顿时瘫软下去，化作一摊扁平的帆布，像一具被击败幽魂的裹尸布。帆布随即缩回木盒残骸之中；飞溅的碎木与乱跳的钉子疾射归位，被魔法牵引，仿佛铁屑被磁石吸住。很快，除了地面上几道拖拽的痕迹，便再无船只的踪影。木盒整洁得像一枚别针，等着我拾起，收好带走。
Keeping clear of the vessel—lest my foot be caught up in the magical retraction—I speak the command to fold the boat back into the box, and it wilts into a flat heap of canvas, like the shroud of a defeated specter. The canvas retracts into the remnants of the wooden box, splintered wood and wayward nails zooming back to their proper places, pulled by the magic like metal to a magnet. Soon, all trace of the vessel is gone except for some dragging tracks along the ground. The wooden box, neat as a pin, is ready for me to pick up and stow away.

Delivery Of Purple Worm Poison.name:
紫虫毒素的交付
Delivery Of Purple Worm Poison

Text.text:
剧痛撕裂你的全身，远远超过最初的伤势，仿佛烈火在你的血管里奔涌。你倒抽冷气，痛得扭动翻滚，却没有任何东西能让这酷刑稍减分毫。疼痛如浪峰般猛然攀至顶点，继而略微退去，你死死咬紧牙关，几乎担心牙齿会被咬碎，只能绷紧身子，迎接下一次翻涌的冲击。
Pain rips through you, far exceeding the initial injury. It’s as if fire flows through your veins. You gasp and writhe, but nothing provides relief from the torture. The pain crests in a wave, then fades slightly, and you clench your teeth so hard you fear they might shatter as you brace for the next surge.

巨蟹在海滩湿润的沙地上疾驰而过，它那令人瞠目结舌的体型立刻显露无遗。外骨骼的几丁质厚如矮人打造的板甲，而它的巨钳足以剪断骨骼与肌肉。
Scuttling across the wet sand of the beach, the mind-boggling size of the giant crab is immediately apparent. The chitin of its exoskeleton is as thick as dwarf-made plate, and its claws are capable of shearing through bone and muscle.

这面小圆盾毫无疑问——而且荒唐至极——在盾缘上“长”出了一对仿佛鹅翼般的翅膀。白灰相间的羽毛斑驳地覆上盾面，其上绘着你见过最滑稽可笑的鹅徽纹图案：那只鹅从一滩水洼里昂然跃起，活像凤凰涅槃冲出烈焰，喙下舌头耷拉着，配上傻乎乎瞪得溜圆的眼睛。
This buckler unmistakably—and outrageously—has what appear to be a pair of goose wings growing from its edges. The white and gray feathers speckle onto the shield itself, which bears an image of the most ludicrous heraldic painting of a goose you’ve ever seen. It depicts the goose rising from a puddle, like a phoenix from fire, with its tongue lolling out of its beak beneath goofy goggling eyes.

Three Days Of Travel By Foot On Grasslan.name:
草原上徒步旅行三日
Three Days Of Travel By Foot On Grassland

Text.text:
你在辽阔的平原上旅行，穿过一片齐腰深的草海。第一天，旅程平安无事，你在一簇树木的阴影下安歇。第二天，你遇见一头巨兽的骸骨，早已被啃噬得干干净净。你短暂地思忖，造成这场猎杀的掠食者是否仍在这片草原上游荡，但你还是继续前行。第三天，当夕阳沉入远方的丘陵之后，你触及你的目标。
You travel over the sprawling plains, through a sea of hip-deep grass. On the first day, the journey passes uneventfully, and you bed down in the shade of a cluster of trees. The next day, you come upon the bones of a large beast, long-ago picked clean. You wonder for a moment whether the predator responsible for the kill still roams these grasslands, but you press on. On the third day, as the sun dips behind the distant hills, you reach your objective.

那只鸟在你头顶来回掠动，景象异常古怪。它那蓬松的绿色身躯时隐时现，只要静止超过片刻便会变得半透明。生物身后拖着一条又长又蜿蜒的尾巴，宛如缎带般飘舞，几乎看不出它有腿。更惊人的是，一簇夺目的品红羽冠如华丽头饰般覆在这异界生物头顶，璀璨得令人目眩。
The bird is a most curious sight as it flits to and fro above you. Its green fluffy body fades in and out of view, becoming translucent whenever it stays still for more than moment. A long, winding tail extends behind the creature like a ribbon, and it has no legs to speak of. A crest of stunning magenta crowns this otherworldly creature like a dazzling headdress.

Hungerer From The Dark.name:
黑暗中的饥噬者
Hungerer From The Dark

Text.text:
虚空凝成形体，展开双翼，振翅而起。升腾的寒意将你吞没，一阵战栗沿着你的脊背一路窜过。你正面对着黑暗。它的形态是最深的虚无：那是空间的极底处，星光不过是遥远的旧梦。而在那有翼的虚空之中……一张尖叫的嘴。
The void takes form, spreads its wings, and rises. A rising cold subsumes you and a shudder runs the length of your spine. You are facing darkness. Its form is the darkest nothing: the very depth of space where starlight is but a distant memory. And within the winged void… a screaming mouth.

Exhausted Spellcaster After A Battle.name:
战后筋疲力尽的施法者
Exhausted Spellcaster After A Battle

Text.text:
你强行召唤自己的意志去驾驭魔法，心神已被逼到崩裂的边缘。过去几分钟里，你手中能使唤的只剩最基础、机械般的戏法，而维持专注的代价沉重得惊人；你咬紧牙关，紧到半边脑袋都随之搏动着剧痛。视野边缘被疲惫抹得模糊发虚，你知道自己需要数小时才能缓过来。

~ Envisioned by snepai

Trying to summon your will to wield your magics, you are at the very edge of your mental fortitude. For the last several minutes you have had only the most basic, rote cantrips at your command, and the effort to maintain concentration has been staggering, your jaw clenched so tightly that the entire side of your head pulses with pain. The edges of your vision are blurred with fatigue and you know you will need hours to recover.

~ Envisioned by snepai

这座墓碑比邻近的墓更靠近山坡些，仿佛一名士兵从队列里向前踏出一步。碑铭写道：对我们许多人而言，生命是一场审判；而它的终结，如此公正的，却寥寥无几。 This grave’s stone stands slightly nearer to the hill than its neighbors, like a soldier has stepped forward out of line. Its epigraph reads: For many of us, life is a trial, but for few of us is its end so just.

Bronze Angel And Shadow Dragon Fight.name:
青铜天使与影龙之战
Bronze Angel And Shadow Dragon Fight

Text.text:
传送门的银光微微一颤，随即一声震天巨响，一条纯粹由阴影凝成的巨龙猛然撞破裂隙，身后拖曳着墨色、如烟般的血雾丝缕。紧随其后，一位天界存在从门中追出，身披灼灼发亮的护甲，赤红如火的发与须在光中翻涌；他扑上去，以闪耀青铜般的双拳痛击倒地的对手。每一击都如钟鸣般轰然回荡，响彻空旷的空间，震得碎屑簌簌坠落。 巨龙翻身一滚，将天使压在身下，裂开的巨口中喷吐出一股腐蚀性的黑色脓液洪流。天使瞬间没入龙息的暗云——但青铜光芒乍闪，尖厉金属鸣响刺耳，天使以一记撼天上勾拳硬生生托住龙颚。巨龙痛嚎，仰翻倒退；天使则猛振洁白发光的双翼，直冲高空。 神圣之躯悬停在半空，正对巨龙暴露的腹部，灿然圣辉自他体内倾泻而下。随后，伴随一声雄浑咆哮，天使俯冲坠落，独以一只青铜般的铁拳领势前贯。雷霆般一声炸响，天使轰出致命一击，巨龙嘶鸣着在阴影烟旋中蒸发消散。

~ Requested by Dung Beetle

The silvery light of the portal wavers for a moment, and with a thunderous crash, a dragon of pure shadow hurtles through the rift, trailing wisps of inky, smoke-like blood. An angelic being, clad in gleaming armor with hair and a beard of vivid crimson, pursues the beast through the portal, and sets to pummeling his downed opponent with fists of shining bronze. Each strike resounds like a bell, ringing through the cavernous space and rattling loose debris. The dragon rolls, pinning the angel, and from its gaping maw a stream of caustic, black ichor vomits forth. The angel disappears within the dark cloud of draconic breath—but with a flash of bronze and the ring of keening metal, the angel catches the dragon’s jaw in a mighty uppercut. The dragon shrieks in pain, toppling backward, while the angel shoots skyward with a pump of its gleaming, white wings. The divine being hangs in midair above the dragon’s exposed belly, radiant light streaming from him. Then, with a powerful roar, the angel descends, diving downward with a single bronze fist leading the way. With a clap of thunder, the angel deals a killing blow, and the dragon evaporates with a hiss in a cyclone of shadowy smoke.

~ Requested by Dung Beetle

尽管女祭司身着朴素的羊毛长袍、举止谦卑，她的眼底却藏着捕食者般的寒光。苍白的皮肤绷得过紧，贴在她尖削的精灵面容上；眼眶周围的黑影如同沥青般的壕沟，将目光圈住。她露出笑容——显出发黄腐烂的牙齿——并朝你招手，示意你进来。
A predatory gleam hides behind the priest’s eyes despite her simple woolen robes and humble demeanor. Pallid skin seems stretched too tightly across her sharp elven features and black circles ring her eyes like moats of pitch. She smiles—revealing yellowed, rotting teeth—and beckons you inside.

高墙围住一片夯实的沙地，沙面上点点暗斑。墙上布满苍蝇叮聚的斑点与干涸血迹的飞溅与拖痕，有些竟高到你身量的两倍。墙头向内伸出一排铁刺，显然是为了阻止斗场内的人攀上去，闯入四周环绕的陡峭看台。
High walls enclose an expanse of hard-packed sand spotted with dark stains. Fly-specked spatters and smears of dried blood decorate the walls, some at a height twice that of you. Iron spikes project down from the top of the wall, clearly intended to keep anyone within the arena from climbing up into the steep stands that surround it.

通往前哨的路沿着一条幽深的山谷蜿蜒前行，谷底是一道干涸的河床。灌木披着秋日的斑斓，苍白的草丛紧紧攀住土地。花岗岩碎石与潮湿的积雪黏附在山坡上，而山谷始终笼罩在随时可能雪崩的阴影之下。前哨以山体自身的石料与厚重的木梁牢牢构筑而成，塔楼分别锚固在两侧岩壁上。
The approach to the outpost follows a deep valley with a dry riverbed. The shrubs are in autumn colors, and pale grasses clutch the ground. Granite scree and wet snow hold to the mountainside, but the valley runs under the looming potential for avalanche. The outpost is sturdily constructed of the mountain’s own stone and heavy wooden timbers. Its towers are anchored to the rock on either side.

Goddess Of Fertility.name:
丰饶女神
Goddess Of Fertility

Text.text:
她体态丰盈、神采飞扬，头戴编织的宽檐帽，坐镇自家的农场与菜园。女神身披来自她自有田地的织物——饱食蚕虫吐出的丝绸，白绒绒羊群里快乐啃草的绵羊之羊毛，细腻的棉纤维，以及出自健康林地的木材原木。环绕她屋舍的花园亦如她本人：植株繁盛，色彩斑斓，被阳光吻过；深深扎根于黝黑的沃土之中，那里既富含养分，也满溢爱意。
Full-figured and lively under her woven broad-brimmed hat, presiding over her farm and garden, the goddess wears the cloth of her own fields—the silks of well-fed worms, the wools of happy grazing sheep in fluffy white herds, the fibers of fine cotton and boles of wood from the healthy forests. The garden which surrounds her house is like her: plants, colorful and sun-kissed, rooted in a black soil rich with nutrients and rich with love.

Dungeon: Arched, Locked Doorway.name:
地城：拱形上锁门道
Dungeon: Arched, Locked Doorway

Text.text:
门洞的拱形门廊将门扉衬得格外诱人——如此精工细作的入口之后，必然藏着值得一探的东西。然而，门把纹丝不动，厚实的门板以坚固的工艺抵住一切蛮力。门锁得死死的。
The archway framing the door is enticing—undoubtedly, something worthwhile is hiding behind such a well-crafted entrance. Yet, the handle doesn't budge, and the solid craftsmanship of the door stands firm against any force. The door is locked tight.

这座矮小破败的建筑像是胡乱滋长出来的，仿佛一团由废金属长成的真菌。屋内透出刺目的紫光，照亮一扇扇圆形、被烟灰熏黑的窗子；窗后可见一只小小的生物的剪影来回踱步，时不时把工具猛地掷向房间另一头，手舞足蹈地比划着。门边的空气里弥漫着浓烈的硫磺辛辣味，你一靠近，鼻腔便被刺得发麻，隐隐作痛。
The small, ramshackle building seems to have grown haphazardly, like a fungus made of scrap metal. Stark purple light illuminates the circular, soot-stained windows from within, and the silhouette of a small creature can be seen pacing back and forth, occasionally hurling tools across the room and gesticulating wildly. A potent tang of sulfur lingers in the air near the doors causing your nostrils to tingle uncomfortably as you approach.

Dax The Goblin.name:
达克斯·地精
Dax The Goblin

Text.text:
那地精的深绿皮肤在嘴角处布满褶皱，仿佛被他常年挂在脸上的咧笑硬生生拉扯出来；一支烟斗——雕成咧嘴大笑的骷髅模样——斜挂在他嘴角，被尖锐的黄牙牢牢叼住。他身上的深色皮革长外套凌乱不堪，你看见他一动，几片皮屑便像坠落的枯叶般飘到地上。烟斗里刺鼻的烟雾慵懒地在空气中游弋，继而凝成凶猛的兽影，在这位矮小的调查员头顶那片迷蒙雾霭里相互追逐。地精那双圆圆的黄眼闪烁着被藏起来的机敏光芒，像流云掠过时半遮半露的满月。

~ Played by Villi with

The goblin’s dark green skin is wrinkled around his mouth, as if stretched from the constant grin he wears, and a pipe—carved in the shape of a laughing skull—hangs from the corner of his mouth, held in sharp yellow teeth. The dark leather overcoat he wears is more than a little disheveled, and you notice some flakes of leather drift to the floor like falling leaves as he moves. The acrid smoke from his pipe drifts languidly through the air before taking the shape of fearsome beasts that chase each other through the foggy haze above the diminutive investigator. The goblin’s round, yellow eyes shimmer with concealed brilliance, like a full moon hidden behind wandering clouds.

~ Played by Villi with

那道身影在人群间穿行，诡异地轻松自如。锐利而狡黠的目光左右飞掠，时刻警觉着潜在的威胁。只见他们手腕一抖，迅速将兜帽拉起罩住头脸，还未等周遭任何人反应过来，便先向左一窜、再向右一折，转瞬没入熙攘人潮之中。
The figure moves through the crowd with an uncanny ease. Their eyes, sharp and cunning, flit this way and that, keenly aware of potential threats. With a quick flourish they pull a cowl over their head, and before any nearby can react, they dart left, then right, and disappear into the throng.

一个瘦骨嶙峋、孩童般的类地精生物在他们面前的操控台上抓挠忙碌。他通体花岗岩般的灰色，连同那仿佛焊死在脸上的眼罩式目镜一般冷硬；他与操控台一同被缝合进包裹着他的漂浮舱里。几乎就像被针线缝进自己的折磨之中——他那枯瘦如藤的身体在一阵阵恶魔能量的抽击下痉挛不止。扣锁在干瘪双手上的机械护手在他面前的拉杆间胡乱扒弄。
A gaunt, child-like goblinoid scrabbles at the console before them. Granite gray, like the eye visor that appears welded to their face, they and their console are sutured into the floating pod that surrounds them. It is almost as if they are sewn into their torment, their wiry body spasming with shots of demonic energy. Mechanical gauntlets locked onto withered hands paw at the levers before them.

Tidally-locked Volcanic World.name:
潮汐锁定的火山世界
Tidally-locked Volcanic World

Text.text:
群山周遭冰封的黑暗，掩盖了其下的真相。当地表从这颗潮汐锁定世界明亮一侧的暖风踏入无边黑影之处，震颤便自大地深处蔓延开来。忽然，伴随一声轰鸣，地裂豁然张开，火光照亮了恒久的夜空。
The frozen dark around the mountains belie what’s underneath. Vibrations in the ground start where the warm breezes of the bright side cross into the blackness of this tidal-locked world. Suddenly, with a roar, a fissure opens and lights the constant night sky with firelight.

Floating Castle Under A Full Moon.name:
满月下的漂浮城堡
Floating Castle Under A Full Moon

Text.text:
繁星在夜之帷幕上熠熠生辉，一轮盈凸月在疾掠的云影后方巨大地悬着。映着这片冷辉的剪影，是一座漂浮的城堡；高塔披着银白的光芒闪耀。城垛之上，火把的光焰摇曳，宛如无数恶毒的眼睛在暗中眨动。
Stars glitter in the blanket of night, and a gibbous moon looms large behind scudding clouds. Silhouetted against this luminescence is a floating citadel, its towers gleaming with silvery light. Atop the battlements, torchlight flickers like a plethora of malignant eyes.

这里处处都是照护与治疗的痕迹——走廊里弥漫着令人作呕的蜂蜜混硫气味，拐角处也都摆着急救箱。每间病房都有一扇大窗，以及一只唤护士的小铃铛。忽然间，其中一条走廊像人骤然暴怒的脸色般变了。墙上的油漆开始剥落。气味转为腐烂，某盏灯倏然熄灭。病房里传出低沉的呻吟。先是一间房的铃声响起，又一间……接着又两声。
All the signs of care and treatment are here, from the sickly honey-sulfur smell of the halls to the emergency kits at every corner. Each room has a large window and a small bell for the nurse. Suddenly, one of the halls changes like the face of someone suddenly enraged. The paint chips from the walls. The smell changes to rot, and a light extinguishes. From the rooms, a low moaning starts. A bell rings from a room, another… then two more.

Defiled Temple With Corpse Flower.name:
亵渎神殿与尸花
Defiled Temple With Corpse Flower

Text.text:
银月女神的神殿正遭亵渎：一个肤色惨白的邪教徒站在祭坛前，祭坛上锁着一名被铁链缚住的少女。两者之间悬浮着一颗巨大的黑暗圆球。它渐渐消散，露出一团由花瓣与骷髅纠缠成的怪诞肉团，散发着腐尸般的恶臭。叶片与翠绿的触须仿佛将橙黄的花苞捆缚在被这头兽性植物吞噬的内脏与白骨之上。触须自那畸形花束的底部探出，蜿蜒爬行，正朝少女逼近。

~ 设想：Lord Vectros

The temple of the silver moon goddess is being desecrated by a pasty-skinned cultist, who stands in front of an altar to which a young girl is chained. Between them floats a huge orb of darkness. It fades away to reveal a grotesque mass of petals and skulls that reeks of rotting corpses. Leaves and green tentacles seem to bind the orange and yellow bulbs to the viscera and bone being consumed by this beastly plant. Tentacles extend from the grotesque bouquet’s underside, creeping toward the girl.

~ Envisioned by Lord Vectros

Drunken Elf.name:
醉醺醺的精灵
Drunken Elf

Text.text:
精灵那份优雅与从容，在此人身上仿佛彻底缺席。他踉踉跄跄地在酒馆里乱晃，跑调地高声歌唱。看他这身打扮便知，他与精灵文化的精致格格不入——敞着的衬衫污渍斑斑，裤子磨得发旧、补丁摞补丁，早已不复当年。

~ 由 Discord 上的 Jack Of Blades 在 Envisioned：Discord

The grace and elegance of the elves seems completely absent from this individual as they stumble around the tavern, singing off key. Indeed, he seems at odds with the refinement of elven culture in general judging by his attire—an open shirt covered in stains, and worn, patched breeches that have seen better days.

~ Envisioned by Jack Of Blades on Discord

Crowded Taqueria.name:
拥挤的塔可店
Crowded Taqueria

Text.text:
广场边缘那间小小的塔可摊正把马里亚奇音乐开到震天响。摊位上方挂着一顶俗气得过分的巨型宽檐帽，在周围黑色高塔闪烁的霓虹映照下投出一片阴影。成群结队咯咯笑着的学生、狂欢客和闲杂人等在队伍里你挤我抢，争着往前。员工用夹杂着西班牙语和英语的口吻大声喊着点单。烤肉与莎莎酱的香气扑鼻而来，让你口水直流。
The tiny taco stand sitting at the edge of the plaza blasts out mariachi music. A tacky oversized sombrero hangs over the stand, casting a shadow against the flickering neon of the surrounding black towers. Large groups of giggling students, ravers, and riffraff jockey for position in the queue. Staff shout orders in a mixture of Spanish and English. The smell of roasting meat and salsa makes your mouth water.

Divine Springs Of A Goddess Of Fresh Wat.name:
清泉女神的神圣泉涌
Divine Springs Of A Goddess Of Fresh Water

Text.text:
在洁白如洗的瀑布尽头，有一汪池水，池沿簇拥着香蒲。睡莲叶上的小青蛙自得其乐，气泡一串串浮上水面，轻轻破裂。林木环抱四周，漂亮的少女们潜入水中嬉戏，直到这份宁静被打破。她们齐刷刷转向危险，獠牙与蹼掌蓄势待发，一圈惊惶的涟漪扩散开来，迎面撞上你。也许今天你会饮下清凉的水，休息片刻。也许你会消失在大地初始的深井之中。
At the bottom of a clean white waterfall is a pool edged in cattails. Little frogs on lily pads entertain themselves, and bubbles rise to the surface to break. The woods are all around, and pretty girls dive and play in the water until the tranquility is broken. They all turn toward the danger, fangs and webbed hands ready, and a ripple of consternation expands to meet you. Maybe today you will drink cool water and rest. Maybe you will disappear into the deep well of earth’s beginning.

一张风雨侵蚀、手工削成的长凳立在小屋门右侧，正下方是一扇紧闭百叶窗的窗户。门与百叶窗和长凳一样，都是用磨损的木料制成。锈蚀的铁件将门板箍在一起，并构成把手与锁。把手在机关里松松垮垮地垂着，门槛前的地上还躺着它断落的一小截。门靠近门闩处被人乱砍过。
A weathered, hand-cut bench stands to the right of the cabin’s door, beneath a shuttered window. The door and shutters, like the bench, are made of worn lumber. Rusty ironwork binds the door together and forms a handle and lock. The handle hangs loosely in its mechanism, and a bit of it lies on the ground just before the threshold. The door has been hacked near the latch.

Obvious Enhanced Head.name:
显眼的强化头颅
Obvious Enhanced Head

Text.text:
女人的额头上方沿着眉线裂开一道宽阔的缝隙，小巧却强劲的扬声器从中探出。她似乎对这场变形毫不在意，随即用颅内音响系统轰然放起沉重的合成器节拍，踏上流线型旱冰鞋，疾驰穿梭于城市之间。
The woman's head splits open in a wide channel above her eyebrows, and small but powerful speakers emerge. Seemingly completely unfazed by this transformation, she begins to play pounding synth music from her cranial sound system and sets off on sleek roller blades through the city.

Unprincipled Mob Lawyer.name:
无良的暴民律师
Unprincipled Mob Lawyer

Text.text:
这女人身上的每一处细节都像是被精心挑选过。她那身利落的西装每一道熨线都完美无瑕，头发一丝不乱地束成严苛的马尾，妆容的每一抹、指甲油的每一寸都精准到位。她与一个纹着帮派标记、裤腰里还别着枪的男人擦身而过时说道：“让我来开口。”
Each detail of the woman seems to be meticulously chosen. Every ironed line of her sleek suit is perfect, every strand of hair accounted for in a strict ponytail, every dab of makeup and inch of nail polish applied with precision. "Let me do the talking," she says as she walks by with a man tattooed with his gang's sign and a gun sticking out of his pants.

I Remove The Stopper From My Eversmoking.name:
我拔开永烟瓶的塞子。
I Remove The Stopper From My Eversmoking Bottle

Text.text:
我猛地拔出铅塞，细细的烟丝从那只失去光泽的黄铜瓶里渗出。起初它看起来像液体般倾泻而出、汇聚成洼；然而转瞬之间，雾气便昂然升腾——翻涌成一大团漆黑的浓烟，宛如烈焰狂燃时喷出的滚滚烟柱。
I wrench out the lead stopper and thin lines of smoke seep out of the tarnished brass bottle. It seems a liquid at first, the way it pours forth and pools. But, quickly, vapors aspire—creating a great cloud of black smoke, like that from a fierce and raging fire.

缕缕金发垂落在那张俊美如雕像的面庞前，昔日的光泽早被污垢吞没。猩红的泪痕沿着他的脸颊淌下，滴落到他起伏不定的胸膛上。宽阔的肩背刻出惊人的肌肉线条，却被那层枯薄、泛灰的皮肤衬得凄冷无力。他腰间围着一圈丝绸裙裳，以金绳系紧。  

他用力按住自己的肌肉，仿佛疼得发胀，眉眼抽搐，咬紧那口大理石般的牙齿；而那肌肉竟随着每一瞬流逝而一点点萎缩。他踉跄跪倒，背脊弯成弓形，整个人塌陷下去，呜咽痛哭。两道又长又深的裂口自他背上一路拖下，伤处还粘着被鲜血浸透的羽毛残片。
Strands of gold hair, sheen lost to grime, fall over a handsome, statuesque face. Red tears streak down his face and onto his heaving chest. His broad shoulders are chiseled with impressive musculature, but his physique is overshadowed by his thin, graying skin. He wears a skirt of silk about his waist, tied with a golden rope. He presses at his muscles as if they ache, wincing and gritting his marbled teeth, as the muscles seem to shrink with each passing moment. He falls to his knees, back bending into a curve as he crumples, sobbing. Two long, deep gashes trail down his back. Remnants of feathers, drenched in blood, stick to the site of the wounds.

先前的一次回暖时，有人把这儿的积雪踩进了泥土里，踏出一片泥泞；之后泥地又重新冻住，如今上面覆着一层新落的薄雪。乍一看很难分辨，但这里或许曾站过几个人，也可能只是一个人在来回踱步。这地方用来站着等人显得古怪，不过它确实能将道路与河流两侧的动静尽收眼底。
Someone has trodden the snow into the earth in this spot during an earlier thaw, creating a muddy patch that has since frozen over and now collects a dusting of new snow. It’s difficult to tell from a glance, but it may be that a few people stood here, or it could be that one person paced about. It seems an odd place to stand and wait, but it does provide a good view of the road and river in both directions.

I Have Eyes Of The Rune Keeper.name:
我拥有符文守护者之眼
I Have Eyes Of The Rune Keeper

Text.text:
这些符号不属于任何我能读能说的语言。可当我凝视它们时，它们却在我心眼里蠕动、重排，沙沙作响，低声嘀咕，钻进我心耳之中。它们将讯息直接对我诉说。我读懂它们，迅捷而轻松，仿佛在阅读任何我熟悉的语言。
These symbols are of no language I read or speak. Nevertheless, as I contemplate them they squirm and rearrange themselves in my mind’s eyes, rustling and muttering to my mind’s ears. They speak their message to me. I read them as quickly and easily as I would any language I know.

Wild Magic Surge: Necrotic Drain.name:
狂野魔法涌动：死灵汲取
Wild Magic Surge: Necrotic Drain

Text.text:
阴影般的魔法如墨云般渗入你周遭的空气，伸出黑暗的触须，抽打向附近任何活着的生物。触须随即缩回，阴影灌入你的伤口，伴着令人不适的吮吸声，将它们一针一线般缝合收拢。
Shadowy magic bleeds into the air around you like a cloud of ink, lashing out with dark tendrils at any living creature nearby. The tendrils withdraw and the shadow fills your wounds, knitting them closed with an uncomfortable slurping noise.

Precipice Of A Cliff.name:
悬崖绝壁之巅
Precipice Of A Cliff

Text.text:
峭壁的边缘向着空旷的天空突兀伸出，横亘在你面前。你小心翼翼地靠近悬崖，因你的移动，边缘几块碎石与残屑被惊动，倏然崩落。它们沿着垂直的岩壁滚坠而下，撞在锯齿般的尖棱与顽强的灌木上弹跳翻滚，直到坠入远在下方的地面。
The precipice juts out into the open air before you. As you approach the cliff, cautiously, a few bits of rock and debris break from the edge, disturbed by your movement. They tumble down the sheer wall of rock, bouncing off jagged edges and resilient shrubbery until they reach the ground far below.

这道身影看上去毫不起眼：一件暗褐色的长风衣，一顶宽檐帽，把瘦削的脸浸在阴影里。他们活像最常见的流浪汉。可若细看，衣着上处处藏着不露声色的改动。缝在衣料上的小袋泛着微光，像是把隐秘的科技藏在其中；两侧腋下各有一道轻微的隆起；帽檐边缘也有东西一闪而过。更下面，还露出一缕丝滑的皮毛。他们掏出一块导航板，低头搜寻着什么。
The figure seems nondescript. A long trench coat of dull brown and a broad-brimmed hat bathe their slim face in shadow. They match the look of the average drifter. Yet, looking closer, many subtle alterations have been made to their outfit. Sewn pouches glimmer with the hint of hidden tech. There is a slight bulge beneath each armpit. Along the brim of the hat, something glints. Underneath, a sliver of silky fur. They pull out a navpad, searching for something.

Coffee Boiled On Hot Sand.name:
热砂煮咖啡
Coffee Boiled On Hot Sand

Text.text:
咖啡的香气恢弘醉人，随着温暖的暮风飘散开来，而集市在四周喧闹翻涌。恍惚一瞬，时代仿佛凝滞，你深深吸入那杯饮品的气息，细细品味锅下热沙发出的嘶嘶声。

~ 构想：David，来自 Discord

The aroma of the coffee is magnificent, drifting on the warm evening breeze as the market bustles all around. For a moment, time stops as you inhale the scent of the drink, relishing the audible hiss of the hot sand beneath the pan.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Clip-on Ear Antenna For Signal Boosting.name:
用于信号增强的夹扣式耳部天线
Clip-on Ear Antenna For Signal Boosting

Text.text: 天线顶端安着一枚星形小饰物，沿着天线的长度缠绕着大写字样 BOOST。底座则带有一枚加垫的夹子，弧形拱起，像一只耳朵。 A star-shaped bauble sits at the top of the antenna, and the word BOOST in uppercase lettering is wrapped along the length of it. The base features a padded clip arcing in the shape of an ear.

I Listen To The Voice Of The Mountain.name:
我聆听群山的声音
I Listen To The Voice Of The Mountain

Text.text:
刻在山体花岗岩基座上的符文，助我解读风声——它携着群峰的吐息，它的言语。积雪与融雪溪河的纹路，在千百年间更迭流转，把它们所知尽数告我。我的魔法随之而行，法术如同受大地巨灵号令。
The runes cast on the mountain’s granite foot help me interpret the wind—it carries the massif’s breath, its words. The patterns of snow and runoff rivers, changing over the millennia, tell me what they know. My magic follows, the spells commanded by a giant of the earth.

一辆马车的残骸缠在带刺的灌木丛中。看样子，它躺在这里已有好几个季节，甚至可能是几年之久。铁制轮缘被掰弯扭曲，车厢的木板也像是被狠狠砸得四分五裂。
The ruins of a wagon lie tangled in thorny brush. From the look of things, they must have been lying here for a few seasons, if not years. The iron wheel rims are bent and twisted, and the boards of the wagon look like they’ve been smashed apart.

那畸形臃肿的身影，令人想起人类与蛛形的突变（特征）混杂体——两者的美它都不具，却兼具两者的丑。带爪的细长肢体多节嶙峋，垂挂在鼓胀而短粗的躯干之下。复眼般的多面眼球与一对喀喀作响的螯肢，为这幅怪诞图景画上最后一笔。黏腻的蛛网披覆在它的骨架上，你看见蜘蛛在它身上爬行、筑巢、狩猎。
The hideous, bloated figure evokes a mutant mingling of human and arachnid, possessing the beauty of neither and the ugliness of both. Clawed, spindly, multi-jointed limbs hang from a bulbous, stunted body. Multi-faceted eyes and a pair of chittering mandibles complete the grotesque picture. Sticky webs drape the thing's frame, and you see spiders crawling across its body, nesting, hunting.

Rainforest Cool Season.name:
雨林凉季
Rainforest Cool Season

Text.text:
雨林树冠下的空气阴凉潮湿，像冰冷黏腻的汗水般贴在皮肤上。细雨淅淅沥沥落下，敲打着灌木丛间的叶片。下垂的木质藤蔓以恒定的节奏滴水，而一簇簇小蘑菇则聚起一层湿润的光泽。
The air under the rainforest canopy is cool and damp, clinging like a cold, clammy sweat. Rain drizzles down and drums on the leaves in the underbrush. Sagging liana vines drip with a steady rhythm, while clusters of small mushrooms collect a sheen of moisture.

Ancient Crystal Flute.name:
远古水晶长笛
Ancient Crystal Flute

Text.text:
这支长笛由令人目眩的发光水晶雕琢而成，熟练的乐师一经吹奏，便会激荡出超凡脱俗的美感。纤细的符文沿着笛身向上攀升，排布成对称的阶梯；每一个音孔都仿佛以绝对的精准钻凿而成，圆润无瑕，完美无缺。

~ 由 David 在 Discord 上 构想

Carved from a mesmerizing luminescent crystal, this flute resonates with ethereal beauty when played by a skilled musician. Delicate runes ascend in a symmetrical ladder up the body, and each hole appears to have been bored in a perfect, flawless circle.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Loot From Within A Barghest.name:
来自巴盖斯特体内的战利品
Loot From Within A Barghest

Text.text:
肌肉虬结的怪物一动不动地躺着，黑色的血液在它身下汇成一滩，蒸腾着化作令人窒息的瘴气。紫色的脏器涂抹在地面上，它上一顿的残骸——连同他们的随身物品——一并倾泻而出。它腹部周围的血水里，静静躺着16枚银币和一把粗糙、参差带锯的钥匙。
The muscular beast lies still as black blood pools around it in a steaming miasma. Purple viscera stains the ground, and the remains of its last meal—and their belongings—pour forth. 16 silver pieces and a crude, jagged key lie in the puddle around its belly.

Desert Frontier Town After Battle.name:
沙漠边境小镇：战后
Desert Frontier Town After Battle

Text.text:
夕阳在你视野边缘下沉，你掠过几处偏远农庄，走向一圈木桩围墙——里面只圈着两条狭窄街道。小镇蜷伏在沙漠里，仿佛早已厌倦暴力；可暴力还是找上了它。几栋建筑仍冒着烟，那是上一场战斗留下的火痕；镇民正把瓦砾与尸体从街上清走。近处一座瞭望塔上，一个男人吊着双腿坐在边缘，怀里抱着一支连发步枪，趁着白昼最后的微光抽着一根揉皱的香烟。
The sun is dipping at the edge of your vision as you pass some outlying farms and approach a small palisade encircling two narrow streets. The town is crouched in the desert, as if weary of violence, yet violence seems to have found it. A few buildings still smoke from the fires of the last combat, and townsfolk clear rubble and bodies from the streets. A man with a combi-repeater rifle dangles his feet from a nearby watchtower, smoking a crumpled cigarette in the last light of day.

Finn Hendrix.name:
芬恩·亨德里克斯
Finn Hendrix

Text.text:
冰色的眼睛锐利而冷冽，从银白的眉下直直逼视而来；左眉被一道疤痕劈开。男人的短发从棕色鸭舌帽下探出，颜色与那双眉毛如出一辙。脸庞被日晒得黝黑粗砺，线条硬得近乎方正。两枚小獠牙从下颌顶起，穿过紧抿成一条硬线的嘴唇微微鼓出。他穿得整洁，却带着漂泊者的味道——粗呢外套与帽子相配；白色翻领衬衫；宽松的蓝色工装裤；磨旧的皮靴；一只走南闯北的旧背包斜挂在肩上。他打量着一切，轻哼一声，嘴角浮起一抹淡淡的笑。

~ Played by a Hero

Ice-colored eyes, sharp and cold, stare out from under silver brows, the left one divided by a scar. This man’s close-cropped hair, peeking from under a brown flatcap, matches those brows. His face is tanned, hardened, and perhaps, too blocky. Small tusks bulge from his lower jaw through his lips, which are pressed into a hard line. He’s dressed neatly but like a drifter—rough jacket matching the cap; white, collared shirt; loose blue workpants; worn leather boots; and a well-traveled rucksack over one shoulder. As he sizes everything up, he gives a little huff and a slight grin.

~ Played by a Hero

这道法术对你来说信手拈来——从来都是如此。只需轻轻一挥手，再吐出一个词，你便召出那份效果，让旁观者看得欣喜不已。火花如雨迸散、烛焰悄然熄灭、一道发光的符号悬在空中、一个小小舞者在你掌心起舞。它出现得快，消失得也快——只是对魔法所蕴之力的一丝暗示。仅仅一口浅尝，窥见奥术所能献上的滋味。
The spell comes easy to you—it always has. With a simple wave of your hand and a single word, you conjure the effect to the delight of onlookers. A shower of sparks, a snuffed-out candle, a glowing symbol hanging in the air, a dancing figure in the palm of your hand. As quickly as it appeared, it vanishes—just a hint at the power magic holds. A mere taste of what the arcane has to offer.

Unasked-for Gift Of Life After Death.name:
死后仍不请自来的生命赋礼
Unasked-for Gift Of Life After Death

Text.text:
你从漫长的黑暗中醒来，浑身冰冷僵硬，映入眼帘的是一片光滑的石质天花。你躺在同样冰凉的石面上，身上盖着一件淡金色的亚麻短袍。血腥与热蜡的气味在空气里交缠，其间还夹着一丝死亡的阴息。火光在你周围摇曳——壁龛里燃着细长的蜡烛，微光映出环绕着你这一具灵柩的停尸台。与你一同死去的伙伴也在其上微微抽动，正被唤醒。你离去的痕迹仍留在身上：符文般的刻痕与刺青覆满你的左臂与胸口，最终收束在心脏之上。你低头细看，它们猛然迸出猩红的光。剧痛攫住你，令你连呼吸、挪动都做不到，更别说清晰思考。

“妙极了。”一个低沉如地鸣的嗓音在石室里回荡。“你们都醒了。既然我已抓住你们的注意力，那就来谈谈你们穿越生死帷幕归来的价格吧。”

~ 由 Tyler 构想

You awaken from the long dark, cold and stiff, looking at a smooth stone ceiling. A flaxen smock covers you as you lie on similar stone. The scents of blood and hot wax mix with a whiff of death here. Firelight flickers around you—long tapers burn in sconces, their glow revealing biers surrounding yours. Your companions who died with you stir on them. Scars of your passing remain. Runic markings and tattoos cover your left arm and chest, ending over your heart. As you examine them, they flare with crimson light. Pain grips you, making it impossible to breathe or move, much less think clearly.

“Wonderful.” A basso voice reverberates through the chamber. “You’ve all awakened. Now that I have your attention, let us discuss the price of your return across the veil between life and death.”

~ Envisioned by Tyler

在这座端庄整洁、打理得一丝不苟的教堂里，神职人员的办公室空间紧凑，壁炉中火焰欢快地噼啪燃烧。办公室中央是一张书桌，桌上铺着吸墨垫、摆着墨水瓶与羽毛笔；吸墨垫上压着一篇尚未写完的布道稿，旁边则放着一册本教团的圣典，以及一本账簿，记录着教堂金库中往来不绝的捐献与开销。陈设虽不显奢华，却皆为结实耐用之物；深色木料以油细细擦拭，表面被精心养护得光泽沉稳。书桌后方嵌入墙体的书架上排满厚书，其中几本出自其他教团与信仰。
A fire blazes merrily in the compact hearth of the clergy’s office within the staid, well-kept church. At the office center sits a desk with a blotter, inkwell, and quill; a half-finished sermon lies on the blotter, and beside it, a copy of the order’s holy book and a ledger tracking the donations and expenses flowing through the church coffers. Though not outwardly extravagant, the furniture is of sturdy construction, its dark wood polished carefully with oil to maintain its finish. The shelves built into the wall behind the desk are lined with tomes, several of which are books of other orders and faiths.

巨大的金属身躯在这名战铸移动时发出低沉的呻吟。它高耸如塔，肩宽宛如谷仓门板，是一座横越大地的移动堡垒。树干般的双腿每一步都像巨石坠地，轰然砸入土中，震起闷雷般的回响与翻涌的尘土。两点光芒从那勉强称得上是头部的地方亮起。那光是柔和、诱人的蓝色，映出他本该是嘴的位置上几道刮痕——浅白的擦痕弯出一个笨拙又滑稽的小小笑容。

~ 由一位英雄 扮演

The hulking metal body groans as the warforged moves. Tall, with shoulders as broad as a barn door, it is a fortress moving across the landscape. Trunk-like legs land like boulders, crashing into the earth with rumbles and dust. Two eyes glow from what could be a head. The light, a soft, inviting blue, highlights some scratch marks where his mouth would be—pale scuffs bent in a silly little smile.

~ Played by a Hero

Northern, Coastal Mining Outpost With Ch.name:
北境海岸采矿前哨，欢声朗朗
Northern, Coastal Mining Outpost With Cheerful Voices

Text.text:
穿过苦寒的飞雪与刺骨的冷风，你的旅程将你带到一处偏远的北境前哨，依偎在覆雪的丘陵脚下。这里的建筑低矮厚实，以石砌就，仿佛从周遭大地里凿刻而出；屋顶倾斜下压，专为抵御裹着冰碴的狂风而设。烟囱里升起缕缕炊烟，盘旋而上，捎来炖锅咕嘟作响的万般香气。尽管寒冷，尽管风雪，欢快的说笑仍会飘进你的耳中——矿工们从山间下行，迫不及待要从一天的劳作里换得片刻喘息。
Through bitter snow and frigid wind, your journey finds you in a remote northern outpost, nestled against the snow-capped hills. The buildings are squat stone, carved from the surrounding earth, with sloped roofs designed to protect against the ice-laced wind. Smoke curls from chimneys, carrying with it myriad scents of simmering stews. Despite the cold, despite the snow, cheerful voices find their way to you as miners venture down from the hills, eager for respite from the workday.

Veteran Captain’s Skyship.name:
老练舰长的飞空艇
Veteran Captain’s Skyship

Text.text:
吱呀作响的飞空艇那饱经摧残的船体满是伤痕与坑洼，写满了惊险冒险、死里逃生与惨烈鏖战的一生。某些地方，深邃的皇家蓝旧漆从磨损、参差不齐的木板与铆接的铁甲之间的缝隙里隐约透出——那里是船只被无数次修补后留下的疤。老船长立于甲板，双手握着舵轮，嘴角挂着浪子般的笑意，高声召唤船员再度解缆启航，奔向无垠天穹中的名声、财富与掠夺。
The battered hull of the creaking skyship is scarred and pitted from a life of exciting adventures, close calls, and harrowing battles. In spots the original paint—a deep royal blue—peeks through the gaps between worn, mismatched timbers and riveted iron plates where the ship has been repaired countless times. The old captain stands on deck, hands on the wheel, a roguish grin on their lips, as they call for their crew to cast off once more for fame, fortune, and plunder in the open skies.

Kobold Setting Trap.name:
狗头人设定陷阱
Kobold Setting Trap

Text.text:
这生物满是污垢的鳞片手掌飞快动作，压低嗓音怒气冲冲地嘟囔着。狗头人虽身形瘦削，鳞皮之下的肌肉却紧绷有力，线条分明，却不显得过分强壮。它紧皱的眉峰上方刺出两根短小的角，设陷者一边忙活，一边轻轻一拽，细致地测试着刚装好的绊线。
The creature’s grimy, scaled hands work quickly as it mutters angrily under its breath. Though lean, the kobold’s muscles are taut beneath scaled skin, clearly defined but not overwhelmingly powerful. Two small horns jut out above a furrowed brow as the trapper works, testing the tripwire it has just installed with a delicate tug.

Gavek The Githyanki.name:
吉斯洋基人加维克
Gavek The Githyanki

Text.text:
违逆自然法则，碎石与卵石如同环绕星球般在这尊雕塑般的异族战士周身漂浮，安宁的轨迹与他体内翻涌的怒火形成刺目的反差。上等皮革覆在他起伏如浪的肌肉上，织成坚固的背带、护臂、战靴与战裙；一柄巨剑悬在背后，与腰间两把短刃相互呼应。狭长的脸是一张无喜无悲的面具，永恒定格在暴怒的狞笑里，黑色、无瞳孔的眼睛更添森寒。束成战士马尾的一簇白发随着动作在背后翻舞，他像一头伺机扑击的野兽般移动。

~ Played by Storak with

Defying the laws of nature, pebbles and stones float around the statuesque alien warrior like orbiting planets, their serene motion at odds with the simmering rage emanating from him. Well-crafted leather graces his rippling muscles in the form of a sturdy harness, bracers, boots, and skirt, and a mighty sword hangs from his back, a match to the two smaller blades at his waist. His narrow face is a joyless mask, set in a permanent grimace of rage and accentuated by black, pupil-less eyes. A crest of white hair—bound in a warrior’s ponytail—dances down his back as he moves like a wild animal waiting to strike.

~ Played by Storak with

Barkeep Recounts Legend Of Mystical Swor.name:
酒保讲述神秘魔剑的传说
Barkeep Recounts Legend Of Mystical Sword

Text.text:
“砰！它一闪——亮得像晴夜里的北极星——而后万籁俱寂，你懂的，仿佛有人把一条毯子猛地盖在附近的一切之上。魔法没了。就像它以那玩意儿为食，把它吸进刀刃里。当然，这都只是传说，可要是那该死的东西真存在……那可就厉害得吓人。”

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

“BANG! It flashes—bright as the North Star on a clear night—and everythin’ goes real quiet, you see, like a blanket's been thrown o’er everythin’ nearby. Magic's gone. It's like it feeds on the stuff, absorbing it into the blade. O’ course, this is all a legend, but if the blasted thing's real… it'd be mighty powerful.”

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Approaching A Mountain Dwarfhold.name:
逼近山地矮人要塞
Approaching A Mountain Dwarfhold

Text.text:
在高耸群山嶙峋峭壁的映衬下，一对雕像巍然矗立于你面前——各自刻着一名擎举武器的泰坦般矮人。它们的面容纤毫毕现：飘垂长须上的每一缕须发、紧锁眉间的每一道褶痕，都被雕琢得入木三分。铺就的石路从这两名哨卫身旁延伸而过，通往前方阴影沉沉、压迫逼近的巨门。
Set against the craggy backdrop of the soaring mountain, a pair of statues tower over you—each depicting a titanic dwarf brandishing a weapon. Their faces are etched in intricate detail, down to the individual hairs in the flowing beards and the wrinkles in the furrowed brows. The road of worked stone leads past these sentinels, to the looming gates beyond.

一经敲击，这根短杖便如微缩的太阳般爆发——宛若天穹的一片碎片——金色金属的构造将迸射而出的光辉放大、推涌。它虽灼灼燃亮，却如凡世之美，终究难以长久。
