Once struck, this rod erupts like a miniature sun—a fragment of the heavens—the golden metal construction amplifying the shining rays bursting forth. Though it burns brightly, like mortal beauty it will not last.

Loot From A Humanoid Demonic Insect.name:
来自类人恶魔昆虫的战利品
Loot From A Humanoid Demonic Insect

Text.text:
七枚宗教圣徽各自残破不堪，或悬于金链、铂金链之上，或系在缀满护符的皮绳编结之间。每一枚都值几枚金币。第八枚则以珍珠与蓝宝石镶嵌在雪花石膏之上。它虽小，却蕴含精妙的灵性工艺，其价值足以换来一位小男爵的赎金。
Seven religious symbols, each in a state of disrepair, are on gold or platinum chains, or leather cords braided with charms. Each is worth several gold pieces. An eighth is composed of pearls and sapphires over alabaster. Small but spiritually crafted, it’s worth a minor baron’s ransom.

这把武器以泛蓝的精钢锻成，剑柄光滑苍白，如同雪花石膏。刃身上以粗重而严峻的字母刻着“MAGISTER”。握柄的冰冷直透骨髓。即便如此，它依旧安稳贴合你的掌心，在空气中划出轻松流畅的弧光。
The weapon is crafted of bluish steel, its hilt as smooth and pale as alabaster. The word MAGISTER is etched upon the blade in bold, stern lettering. The coolness of the grip chills you to the bone. Despite this, it rests comfortably in your hand and slices through the air in easy, fluid arcs.

Kelexan Urax.name:
凯莱克桑·乌拉克斯
Kelexan Urax

Text.text:
脑袋歪挂在扭曲的脖颈上，背脊佝偻，这名瘦长的白龙裔以蛇一般的柔韧游走。他的鳞片黯淡而风化——全无光泽——有些鳞甚至在肘部、鼻尖与颈侧像薄纸碎屑般起毛剥落。那双水晶般的蓝眼在横贯面庞的黑色纹身线条下愈发明亮。他沉浸在思绪里，从正在蜕皮的喉间挤出一声幽魂般的轻笑；听起来更像断续的低吼，而非真正的笑声。一条纤细的白色幼龙蜷绕在他的胯侧，正打着盹。

~ Played by Raetheriel with

Head hanging from a cricked neck and hunched back, this spindly white dragonborn moves about with serpentine litheness. His scales are dull and weathered—lacking any lustrous sheen—with some scales even fraying away like thin scraps of paper at his elbows, nose, and neck. His crystalline blue eyes shine brighter under the lines of black tattoos across his face. Lost in thought, he looses a haunted chuckle from his molting throat; a sound more like a halting growl than a true laugh. A thin white dragonling dozes while wrapped around his haunch.

~ Played by Raetheriel with

Trials Of The Sun God Of Justice.name:
正义太阳神的试炼
Trials Of The Sun God Of Justice

Text.text:
“这些土地曾被一片古老而扭曲的森林覆盖——那里栖着凶残的生物，潮湿腐朽的林木散发着霉烂气息；荆棘缠藤与浓密灌丛如铁栅般封锁前路，除最无畏的旅人外，谁也休想踏入。直到他的躯体自天穹坠落。在那辉煌的九日里，盘踞此地、积累了数百年的腐烂与败坏被烈焰焚尽，直至世间只余索拉斯——在火中重生。大地亦随之改写，洁净而荒寂，唯有九尊雕像留在索拉斯所过之处。一个讯息被献给所有愿意倾听的人：只要我们足够强大，敢于直面它，重生便触手可及。”

~ 由一位英雄构想

“These lands were once covered by an ancient and twisted forest, a place of vicious creatures and damp, rotting woods, whose thorny vines and dense brush barred entrance to all but the most intrepid of travelers. Until his body fell from the sky. Over the course of nine glorious days, the centuries of rot and decay that had taken root in these lands were burned away, until all that remained was Solas, reborn in the flames. So too were the lands reformed, pure and barren, save for the nine statues left in Solas’s wake. A message was offered to all who would listen: rebirth is within our grasp, if only we are strong enough to face it.”

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Cairn On A Trail.name:
小径上的石冢
Cairn On A Trail

Text.text:
在数不清的之字形折返之后，你来到一个回合处，视野豁然俯瞰整片山谷。一座石冢由厚厚叠砌的灰色页岩板堆成，每块都约有鳟鱼般的体型。底座结实稳固，但越往上，松松垒起的石片越显得摇摇欲坠。也许这就是半程的标记。也许它是更隐晦的象征，伫立在悬崖边缘，守望着脚下漫长的深坠。
After more switchbacks than you can count you arrive at a turn that looks out over the vale. A cairn has been built from thick layered plates of grey shale, each about the size of a trout. The base is solid, but the cairn looks a little more precarious as the loosely-balanced stones reach the top. Perhaps this is the halfway mark. Perhaps it is a more cryptic symbol, standing vigil on a ledge over a long drop.

Greasy Repairman.name:
油腻的修理工
Greasy Repairman

Text.text:
一条又长又满是污渍的皮围裙，一圈泛灰的卷发光环，镜片上抹开的污痕——这些印象一闪而过，你的注意力却牢牢钉在那男人的双手上。它们在一枚精巧的发条方块上翻拧拨弄，从皮套里挑出细如针尖的小工具。他似乎察觉到你的目光，便迅速放下工具，用皮革把方块一盖，这才抬眼看向你。
A long and much-stained leather apron, a halo of graying curly hair, smudged spectacles—you take in these impressions, but your attention focuses on the man’s hands. They twist and twiddle at a cube of delicate clockwork, selecting tiny tools from a leather sheath. He seems to sense your gaze because he quickly puts his tools down and covers the cube with the leather before looking up at you.

Howling Werewolf Transformation.name:
嚎叫的狼人变身
Howling Werewolf Transformation

Text.text:
那人佝偻着身子，双手死死捂住腹部，骨骼在皮下噼啪作响，皮肤随之撕裂。带血的深色毛皮成片破肤而出，他们扭曲翻滚，形体在剧痛中变形。漆黑如钩的利爪从指尖顶出，他们抬起犬首，仰天长嚎。你眼前站着的是人与兽的混合体——既是两者，又都不是。
Hunched over and grasping their stomach, the individual’s bones begin to crack as their skin tears. Patches of bloody dark fur rip through, and they twist and writhe as their form shifts. Black talonlike claws push through their fingertips as they lift their canine head and howl. Before you is a mix of man and beast, both and neither at once.

Sundries From A Steam Mephit.name:
蒸汽魔蝠的杂物
Sundries From A Steam Mephit

Text.text:
嚎叫的生物在一团沸腾蒸汽中轰然爆裂，留下了一洼咕嘟作响的水坑。在那翻涌不息的水洼里，你发现了大块的元素盐晶体。
The howling creature explodes in a cloud of boiling steam, and it leaves behind a pool of bubbling water. In the tumultuous puddle, you find large crystals of elemental salt.

River Ferry Crossing.name:
河上渡船口
River Ferry Crossing

Text.text:
粗重的木梁带着令人安心的熟稔感；渡船撞上码头时那低沉的木声，以及水波轻拍的声响，都让人心里一松。摆渡人倚着一根短短的撑篙而立，旧的宽檐编织帽下，长发灰白垂落。引导绳横跨河面松弛下垂，没入对岸迷蒙的水雾飞沫之中。
There is a comforting familiarity about the heavy timbers, the deep wooden sound of the ferry bumping against the dock, and the water lapping. The ferryperson stands leaning on a short catch pole, her hair long and gray under an old broad-brimmed woven hat. The guide rope sags across the river, disappearing into the misty spray on the other side.

你最先注意到两只鼓胀的眼睛从沼泽腐臭的淤泥中缓缓升起。其下，一具覆满污秽的两栖身躯呈人形轮廓。厚实、斑驳的蛙皮——绿与褐交织的底色——裹着一层黏滑的湿膜，在纠结树冠间漏下的斑驳日光里泛着油亮的光泽。它结实的蛙状后腿蓄势待发，随时能以惊人的一跃将这生物弹射而来；而那对修长的前臂末端，是锐利的蹼爪，已准备好缠住猎物。宽口之下垂着一只可胀缩的囊袋，随着每一次费力的呼吸轻轻颤动。每次吐气都伴着一声低沉的蛙鸣回响——响得可怕，仿佛这东西若是刻意尖叫，足以震死任何寻常大小的青蛙。
You first notice two turgid eyes rising from the putrid murk of the swamp. Below them, coated in filth, is an amphibian body in humanoid form. Thick, mottled batrachian skin—a canvas of greens and browns—is coated in a slick, slimy layer that glistens in the dappled sunlight filtering through the tangled canopy. Its muscular frog-like legs are poised to propel the creature forward with an astounding leap, while its elongated arms, tipped with sharp, webbed claws, are primed to snare quarry. Beneath the creature's wide mouth is a distensible pouch that flutters with each labored breath. A guttural echo of croak accompanies every exhale—so loud that a deliberate scream from this thing would likely kill any regular-sized frog.

Dragon Defending Hoard.name:
守卫宝藏的巨龙
Dragon Defending Hoard

Text.text:
巨龙蹲踞在它的宝藏堆顶，巨口大张，尾巴狂乱地甩击着。它眼底深处燃起滔天憎恨，那一双淬毒般的瞳球搜寻着胆敢闯入、掠夺它财富的狂徒。它低沉粗砺的咆哮在厅室间回荡，龙族巨神双翼展开，蓄势待发，酝酿着吐息。
The dragon squats atop its hoard, huge mouth agape and tail thrashing in a frenzy. Hate blazes deep within its eyes, orbs of pure vitriol seeking those daring to trespass and plunder its wealth. Its guttural roars echo about the chamber as the draconic titan readies its breath, wings outspread.

穿过那一条条永无尽头般盘旋的隧道，长途跋涉后，你终于看见了生命的迹象：一片由帐篷与摊位组成的聚落，在幽幽的绿光中明灭。营地边缘的两名哨兵用沙哑的呱鸣招呼你上前——他们长着鱼一般的脸，拖着长长的鲶须，耳朵的位置却是鳍。你踏入营地，迎面便是同样陌生的面孔：各色商贩与食客来来往往，许多人对你投来戒备的目光。一名无毛的灰皮类人，血红的眼珠闪烁，正高声兜售黝黑的宝石与一瓶瓶药剂；一位鱼女站在一朵几乎与她等高的蘑菇旁，用细窄的匕首割下一片，递给顾客品尝；还有一人下半身竟是蜘蛛的腹部与长腿，她向围观人群展示一绞闪烁、如丝般柔滑的线团，八只眼睛在微光里跳动，人群发出满意的低声呢喃。

~ Envisioned by Soularius

After a long trek through ever-winding tunnels, you finally see signs of life: a settlement of tents and stalls lit with a green glow. Two watchmen at the edge of the camp hail you forward with a croak. They are both fish-faced with long catfish whiskers, and fins in place of ears. You enter the camp and are met with equally alien faces of various vendors and patrons, many of them wary of you. A hairless, gray-skinned humanoid with blood-red eyes hawks dark gems and vials of potion. A fish-woman, standing next to a mushroom nearly as tall as she is, cuts off a piece with a narrow dagger, allowing a customer to have a taste. A person with a spider’s abdomen and legs shows off a skein of shimmering, silky thread to a crowd, her eight eyes twinkling as they coo with approval.

~ Envisioned by Soularius

Goods Stored In Cave.name:
洞窟储藏的物资
Goods Stored In Cave

Text.text:
木桶、箱笼与麻袋紧贴着洞壁堆成一片，旁边还有一摞木杆和一辆独轮手推车，勉强躲开滴落的水珠与蝙蝠粪便的污迹。那辆手推车想必曾用来把货物运进洞里——可从蛛网的厚密程度来看，已经有好一段时代没人来动过它们了……
Barrels, crates, and sacks are crowded against the wall, along with a stack of shafts of wood and a wheelbarrow, sheltered from dripping water and bat droppings. The wheelbarrow must have been used to bring the goods into the cave, but judging from the spiderwebs, it has been some time since anyone’s disturbed them . . .

附近零星漂着几根被撕裂的木梁，清晰昭示着这场刚发生不久的沉船事故。船体的外壳如今大半已没入水下。气泡懒洋洋地升向水面，从甲板下被困住的空气囊中一串串逸出。
A few scattered, torn timbers floating in the vicinity are a visible sign of this recent wreck. The ship’s hull lies mostly submerged now. Bubbles float lazily to the surface, emerging from air pockets trapped within the belowdecks.

止血带下方的血肉翻绞抽动、搏动不止，组织在骨骼周围扭曲变形，塑成骇人的新轮廓。手臂在可怖的剧烈异变中翻涌，遍布其上的裂孔接连张开——眼珠、尖刺、触须与尖啸的嘴巴在这条被腐化的肢体上纷纷破体而生。
Flesh writhes and pulses below the tourniquet, forming into horrifying new shapes as the tissue distorts around the bone. Apertures form across the arm as it roils in a state of hideous flux, with eyes, spikes, tentacles, and shrieking mouths erupting into life across the corrupted appendage.

Merciless Intergalactic Enforcement Offi.name:
冷酷无情的星际执法官
Merciless Intergalactic Enforcement Officer

Text.text:
男人鼻梁两侧的皱纹像他一尘不染的制服褶线一样锋利分明。他的军官徽章闪耀如一颗微缩的太阳，他挺起胸膛，将那份荣耀毫无保留地展示出来。他那双冷硬的眼里所剩的怜悯，甚至不及左右两侧机器人机械护目镜中的一丝温度。
The frown lines along the man’s nose stand out as sharply as the lines on his immaculate uniform. His officer’s badge gleams like a miniature sun, and he puffs out his chest to display it in its full glory. There is less compassion in his hard eyes than in the mechanical visors of the bots to either side.

Loot From A Mushroomfolk.name:
来自蘑菇族人的战利品
Loot From A Mushroomfolk

Text.text:
蘑菇人随身带着各式细小的囊袋，里面装着几种尘埃般的孢子。把它们卖给炼金术士时，每一小袋孢子能卖到10枚银币。
The mushroomfolk carried various tiny pouches, in which are several kinds of dusty spores. Sold to an alchemist, each little pouch of spores goes for 10 silver pieces.

I Calm An Upset Griffon Mount.name:
我安抚一只受惊的狮鹫坐骑
I Calm An Upset Griffon Mount

Text.text:
狮鹫用狮般的后腿直立而起，覆鳞的前肢狂乱挥舞。它的利爪像纯黑曜石般寒光闪烁。我避开它的目光，强忍着不让肩膀绷紧；它尖啸着，双翼拍击，将风与力道一阵阵砸在我身上。我保持放松的姿态，拉开距离，视线只落在那生物身侧的空隙处。我用舌尖轻轻弹了一下上颚，紧接着从齿缝里吐出柔和的“嘘”声。我低声吟诵时，它歪着头左右打量，叫声渐渐收束成带着好奇的轻鸣。它的翅膀先是下垂，随即贴服地收拢在背上。我慢慢伸出一只手，探向它覆羽的颈侧，轻柔地抚下去。掌心沿着它的脖颈一遍遍缓缓滑过，低沉的呼噜声便在它胸腔里开始滚动。
The griffon rears on leonine legs, flailing its scaled forelegs. Its claws gleam like pure obsidian. I avoid eye contact and resist the urge to tense my shoulders as it shrieks and buffets me with its wings. I maintain a relaxed posture, keeping my distance and my gaze just to the side of the creature. I click my tongue against the roof of my mouth, followed by soft hushes through my teeth. It cocks its head from side to side as I intone, its cries dwindling to soft tones of curiosity. Its wings droop and then snugly cling to its back. I reach a hand out to the side of its feathered neck, slowly, and draw my hand down in a gentle pet. A few draws of my palm down its neck and a low purring sound begins to rumble in its chest.

Understated Brushed Steel Hacking Rig.name:
低调拉丝钢黑客终端
Understated Brushed Steel Hacking Rig

Text.text:
这件背心宛如冷峻极简的艺术品：低调不张扬，拉丝钢的质感泛着沉静光泽，紧凑的轮廓将它的力量悄然藏起。它内置尖端的解密与加密软件——再加上一颗足以在微秒间啃噬海量数据的强劲处理单元——任何称职的黑客都能凭它轻松渗透，连最严密的系统也难以招架。
The vest is an expression of sleek, minimalist art: unassuming, with a brushed steel finish and compact design that belies its power. Pregnant with advanced decryption and encryption software—as well as a powerful processing unit that can munch through data in microseconds—a competent hacker could use it to infiltrate even the most secure systems with ease.

Overheard From Naked Person Running Past.name:
从你身旁赤身狂奔而过的人口中飘来的只言片语
Overheard From Naked Person Running Past

Text.text:
“……要说这是我第一次……”
"…be wrong to say it's the first time I’ve…”

Collectible Hardcopy Book.name:
可收藏精装书
Collectible Hardcopy Book

Text.text:
你把书从书架上取下时，重量出乎意料，连同那股气味也一并袭来。气息竟相当宜人——浓郁、芳香的麝香味，翻到最后一页后仍黏附在你手上久久不散。如今再也做不出这种书了。
The weight of the book catches you off guard as you lift it off the shelf, as does the smell. It is rather pleasant—a rich, aromatic musk that clings to your hands long after you have turned the last page. They don't make them like this anymore.

“停下！”士兵喝道。“到此为止。”他们站着——长剑垂在身侧，护甲随着重心微移发出吱呀声——戴着铁手套的手向前伸出。旁边还有人列阵而立，紧攥长矛与弩弓，家族的纹章骄傲地绣在罩袍上、描绘在盾牌上；人群间，你瞥见一位指挥官戴着饰有纹冠的头盔。一个更魁梧的士兵迈步上前，示意队伍里的每个人依次走上来，逐一呈上随身物品接受检查。
"Halt!" says the soldier. "That's far enough." They stand—sword at their side, armor creaking as they shift—with a gauntleted hand outstretched. Others stand nearby, clutching spears and crossbows, the crest of their home proudly displayed on tabards and shields; you see among the throng a commander in a crested helm. A larger soldier steps toward you and gestures for each member of the party to come forward, one at a time, and present their belongings for inspection.

Plea From A Captured Assassin.name:
来自被俘刺客的哀求
Plea From A Captured Assassin

Text.text:
“我没有秘密。也不了解什么宏图大计。我只是个职业人士，跟你一样，拿钱替人清掉麻烦。回去禀报我失败了，那就是自寻死路。我很喜欢活着，所以只要你放我走，我保证不会再来找你麻烦。”
“I have no secrets. No insight into some master plan. I’m simply a professional, like you, who was paid to remove someone else’s problem. Reporting back that I’ve failed would be suicide. I quite like my life, so if you let me go, I assure you I won’t trouble you further.”

生态穹顶内部闷热如蒸笼；空气凝滞，湿度厚重得几乎扼住你的呼吸。外头看去，它像一座由柔韧金属梁支撑的巨大有机玻璃结构。走进来，脚下是褐色土壤，其间点缀着各式植物：饱满丰美的果实、盘绕扭结的藤蔓，以及一畦畦整齐的香草。农场的不同区块以半透明的塑料织布隔开，刺眼的荧光生长灯将空间浸在散开的冷白光里。
It’s hot inside the biosphere; the air is close, humidity stifling your breath. From the outside it appeared as a great plexiglass structure supported by beams of pliant metal. Inside, the ground is brown soil dotted with all manner of plants: sumptuous fruits, twisting vines, and neat rows of herbs. Sections of the farm are separated by translucent plasti-fabric and harsh fluorescent grow-lights bathe the space in diffuse white light.

Gears The Gambler.name:
齿轮「赌徒」
Gears The Gambler

Text.text:
镀铬的液态银光在他那枚魔法灵魂宝石周围闪耀流转。镀层之下，是由灿烂魔法铸成的铁质躯壳。他高挑而修长，像披着精致全身板甲的人类——却被那双眼睛出卖：金属狭缝般的眼眶里，浸满猩红能量的幽光。阴沉的黑袍以一条硬币腰带束起，与他颈间的硬币项链相映成趣；他为求好运，指间翻飞着一枚古老硬币。随后他抽出一张塔罗牌，凝视沉思。

~ Played by Gears with

The liquid-silver of chrome plating gleams around his magical soul gem. Under the plating is an iron chassis of brilliant magic. He is tall and slender, appearing like a human in fine plate—belied by his eyes: metal slots suffused with a red-energy glow. Grim black robes are bound by a coin belt that matches his coin necklace, and he flips an ancient coin for luck. He draws a tarot card and considers it.

~ Played by Gears with

你发现这道法术学起来艰深无比，而施展它也从来不轻松。你飞快掠过那些繁复的音节，生怕舌尖一绊；手指也疾掠划出一连串手势，因为速度往往决定大成功或大失败。这些要素以魔法为轴，卷紧时代，将其缚在你的目标身上——在那里，时代被缓缓放出，化作额外的瞬间。
You found it difficult to learn this spell, and casting it is never easy. You speed through the complexities of its syllables, hoping your tongue doesn’t trip, and your hand flicks through its gestures because swiftness is critical. These components wind up time with their magic and bind it to your target—where it spools out as extra moments.

这头魁梧的四足生物从头到脚覆着白灰色长毛，其间点点融化的冰屑斑驳。捕食者宽阔的面孔上，两只细小的眼睛凶光毕露。它发出低沉如雷的咆哮，声浪从两根泛红的獠牙之间倾泻而出——每根獠牙上都开着一排孔洞，像雕刻成的长笛。你注视之际，生物额头上一阵震颤沿着面部传递，最终在獠牙处爆成一瞬短促的热焰。
This bulky quadrupedal creature is covered head to toe in white-gray fur, speckled with melting ice. Two beady eyes glare out from the broad face of a predator. It rumbles a low, thunderous growl, pouring noise out between two reddish tusks that each sport a set of holes like a carved flute. As you watch, a tremor on the creature’s forehead travels along its face and erupts in a brief flare of heat from the tusks.

Insult About A Fake Hero.name:
关于冒牌英雄的羞辱
Insult About A Fake Hero

Text.text:
“你尽可以把赞美与荣光塞得满满当当，想要多少就要多少。它永远填不满你灵魂深处那口无底的深渊。因为在你内心最深处，你明白——你不配。”
“You can stuff yourself with as much praise and glory as you want. It will never satiate that pit in your soul. Because, deep down, you know that you are unworthy.”

一双黄色的眼睛与一头浓密的棕发，是这名异域生物仅有未被镀金面具遮住的特征。除去色泽，面具朴素得近乎冷淡：两处孔洞容纳她不眨眼的凝视，一道半圆刻痕将面具表面定格成永恒的笑。她可见之处的肌肉在零散拼凑的护甲碎片下显得强劲有力：腹部绷起如绳的肌理，双臂线条分明。护甲上随意钩挂着四把长短形制各异的刀，从一柄朴素匕首到一把带坠配重的库克里弯刀不等。她微微偏头，用目光锁住你，随即无声地向一侧蜷身下沉——一头蓄势待扑的生物——静候你先动。

~ 扮演者：Mawly Maws

Yellow eyes and a full head of brown hair are the only features not hidden by this exotic creature's gold-plated mask. Other than its color, the mask is a plain affair, with two holes to accommodate her unblinking stare, and a semicircle inscribing the mask's surface into a permanent smile. Her musculature, where it can be seen, looks powerful under haphazard scraps of armor: her abdomen rippling with sinewy strength, her arms well-defined. Four knives of varying lengths and shapes hang from hooks attached to the random assortment of armor, ranging from a simple dagger to a weighted kukri. Tilting her head to one side as she fixes you with her gaze, she silently hunches down to one side, a creature prepared to pounce, and awaits your move.

~ Played by Mawly Maws

Adult White Dragon.name:
成年白龙
Adult White Dragon

Text.text:
碎冰的轻脆爆裂声在洞窟间回荡。巨龙每踏出一步，双腿便如波涛般起伏，强韧的肌肉托举着难以想象的沉重身躯。它雪白的皮肤覆着一层薄霜，霜意凝成细小冰锥，垂挂在粗壮颈脊的棘刺之间。板甲般的鳞片自背脊一路延伸，没入那对庞大双翼的根部。翼膜薄而微透，坚硬的软骨线条与柔和的蓝色血管清晰可见；它每走一步，翼面便抖落霜屑，像闪烁的星辰碎片般洒落。坚实的角冠环绕在它的后颅与眉脊之上，拱卫着一对深蓝而洞悉的眼睛。冷冽的雾气从它裂缝般的鼻孔逸出，在下颌边缘柔软的绒毛上凝结出更多冰锥。它的尾巴随步伐摆动以保持平衡，在积雪中拖出一道深深的沟痕。
The soft crunch of shattering ice echoes through the cavern. The dragon’s legs ripple with each step, powerful muscles supporting an immense weight. Its white skin is encased in a thin layer of frost, which forms the small icicles hanging from the spines of its thick neck. Plate-like scales run down its back and along the base of its tremendous wings. Hard lines of cartilage and soft blue veins can be seen through the thinly webbed skin of the wings, which seem to shed frost, like twinkling star fragments, with each step. Sturdy horns surround the back of its head and brow, above a pair of deep blue, knowing eyes. Cool mist escapes the dragon's slitted nostrils, forming more icicles in the soft tuft of hair lining its chin. Its tail shifts with each step to balance its weight, leaving a deep channel in the snow.

他的脚一落地，你便看见一圈涟漪在他那油腻的肥肉上荡开。酒桶般粗壮的肱二头肌、木桶似的前臂随他发力鼓起，他用两只肉乎乎的手把一棵倒下的树抬了起来。猪似的小眼睛在浓重眉骨下阴沉怒视，他从鼓胀的厚唇间探出一条油亮的舌头，去试探那截断裂獠牙的顶端，同时垂下一团黏稠的口涎。
His foot lands and you watch a ripple run across the greasy flesh of his fat body. Barrel-sized biceps, and forearms as big as firkins, flex as he lifts a fallen tree in two plump hands. Piggy eyes glower from under a beetled brow as he pushes a glistening tongue out of bulbous lips to probe the top a broken tusk, drooling out a dollop of spittle as he does so.

Steve \"True Patriot\" Armstrong.name:
史蒂夫“真爱国者”阿姆斯特朗
Steve "True Patriot" Armstrong

Text.text:
他高耸如他那座城市里黑窗耸立的摩天大楼，一身黑曜石般的西装在光下泛着冷冽的亮泽，其上浮动着几何纹理的覆层——也许是某种已安装的护甲程序。即便放在兽人之中，他也堪称海格力斯般的巨躯，衣料被不可思议的庞大肌肉撑得鼓胀。笔挺衬衫上端的纽扣不得不敞开，粗壮的胸肩筋腱从缝隙间绷出，在他突出的下颌前交织成一团。带着黄渍的尖牙参差外露，配上他自信的坏笑，满是那种习惯于想要什么就必得手的莽撞傲慢。可……在这份虚张声势之下，另有东西潜伏着。他的眼睛像酒鬼的——深陷、浑浊，血丝迷蒙。剃得发青的头皮上，灰粉色的皮肤下盘踞着暗色鼓起的血管，蛛网般爬行。它们在跳动、在蠕动，随着他心脏急促的节拍一下一下抽搐。

~ 由一位英雄扮演

He towers like the black-windowed skyscrapers of his city, gleaming in an obsidian suit that shimmers with a geometric overlay—an installed armor program, perhaps. Even for an orc, he is a herculean presence, and his clothes bulge with incredibly large muscles. The sinews of his bulky chest and shoulders, visible by the top buttons of his crisp shirt necessarily kept open, converge in a tangle under his pronounced underbite. Spikes of yellow-tinged teeth stick out unevenly from his confident smirk, his expression containing all the brash arrogance of a man accustomed to getting exactly what he wants. But… something lies beneath the braggadocio. His eyes are like a booze-hound’s, sunken and hazed with red. Dark, bulging veins spider along the grayish-pink skin of his shaved head. They throb, wriggling, to the rapid beat of his heart.

~ Played by a Hero

当你费力将石棺的棺盖掀到一旁时，映入眼帘的是一组修长而优雅的匕首，正静静休息在红色天鹅绒的内衬之上。一层奇异的淡紫薄霭在刃面间微微流转——几乎难以察觉——宛如春日草甸上晨雾轻拂。匕首显然做工精绝，品质非凡，但有一点攫住了你的目光：少了一把。
As you heave the stone lid of the casket aside, you see a group of long, elegant daggers resting in the red velvet inlay. A curious lilac haze shimmers—almost imperceptibly—across the blades like morning mist over a spring meadow. The daggers are clearly of exquisite quality, but something catches your eye: one is missing.

Magical Stone Circle: On The Hunt.name:
魔法石环：狩猎在即
Magical Stone Circle: On The Hunt

Text.text:
一声嚎叫在山坡间回荡，随风传来。一头野兽潜行于湿滑的山径与陡峭的攀坡间，它的啸声像一曲饥饿的哀歌。那声音不可能出自狼——除非它大得骇人——那呼唤低沉得不像如此渺小的生物能发出。
A howl echoes across the mountainside, carried on the wind. A beast stalks the slippery trails and steep climbs, its cry a mournful song of hunger. The sound can’t come from a wolf—unless it is enormous—the call seeming too deep for so small a creature.

一座浩瀚的海底城自深海中拔地而起。自海面筛落的光芒下——一片蔚蓝的广阔——层层绿与蓝在水中流转闪烁；鱼群与海葵争相绽放，迸射出夺目的色彩。珊瑚礁美得令人屏息，但千万别去接触……阴影里或许潜伏着什么。
A vast undersea city rises up from the ocean depths. Multiple shades of green and blue dance and sparkle in the light filtering down from the surface—a cerulean expanse—while fish and anemones compete to provide explosions of color. The coral reef looks beautiful, but be careful not to touch… things might lurk in the shadows.

Bubbling Marsh.name:
咕嘟咕嘟的沼泽
Bubbling Marsh

Text.text:
空气恶臭难当。沼泽表面不断冒出气泡，伴着令人作呕的噗噗爆裂声破开，向空中吐出沼气。泥浆漆黑、腐败、黏缠，仿佛伸出湿冷的手攫住你的脚踝，威胁要在你每一步落下时将双脚吞没。刺鼻的雾霭沉沉压着，遮蔽视线，把你的可见范围压缩到前方仅仅几码。更远处有影子在动，随着你靠近而一闪即逝。树木发出低沉的呻吟，沼泽的翻涌也随之愈发猛烈。
The air stinks. Bubbles appear on the surface of the bog, bursting with sickening pops and releasing swamp gas into the air. The mud is dark, fetid, and grasping, threatening to swallow your feet as you tread upon it. A foul-smelling fog hangs heavy, obscuring your vision, limiting your sight to only a few yards in front of you. Shapes move beyond that, flitting away as you approach. The trees groan as the marsh bubbles more violently.

I Test Herbs For Potency.name:
我检验草药的药效强度
I Test Herbs For Potency

Text.text:
我在一排小瓶间翻检，瓶中干燥的草药从鲜绿到枯黄不等——大多早已脱了水。我叹了口气，明白若能更勤快地去找对的商人，我的日子会好过些……可我只能做该做的。我从第一只瓶里捻起一撮叶片，夹在齿间轻轻咬破，用舌尖细细品尝。先是一阵刺人的苦涩，随后才浮起一丝味道。微弱，但勉强能用。我就这样继续，直到把这堆草药逐一试过。
I pick through the vials, the dried herbs within ranging from fresh green to desiccated yellow—most of them dehydrated. I sigh, knowing more frequent trips to the right merchants would serve me… but I do what I have to do. I take a pinch of leaves from the first bottle and pierce it between my teeth, tasting them with the tip of my tongue. There’s a sting of bitterness followed by a hint of flavor. Weak, but usable. I continue until I’ve tested each herb in the collection.

Plane Of Water.name:
水之位面
Plane Of Water

Rugged Inn On The Frontier.name:
边境前哨的粗犷旅店
Rugged Inn On The Frontier

Text.text: [外部] 这座夸张的两层油毡棚屋侧墙上，只有一幅粗陋的涂鸦：一只泡沫翻涌的酒杯与一张床——在这片蛮荒边境里，这便是你找到旅店的唯一明确信号。没有像样的马厩，屋旁用木架支起一排简陋的茅草棚，为坐骑与驮兽遮风避雨。 [内部] 踏入旅店，你立刻看出这里虽没有城里旅店的讲究，却有人刻意把客人的舒适放在心上。用干芦苇编成的靠椅出乎意料地舒适，垫着手工缝制的坐垫。壁炉火势正旺，热浪逼人；茅草填塞的墙体与结实的枝条编壁把暖意牢牢锁住。吧台由劈开的原木拼成，手工刨平，再用兽脂反复抛光，在火光映照下几乎泛着微亮。 [Outside] A crude painting of a foaming tankard and a bed on the sidewall of this oversized two-story tarpaper shack is the only clear indication that you have found an inn in this wild frontier. Lacking proper stables, a simple shelter of thatch on a wooden frame has been built up along one side, offering shelter for mounts and pack animals. [Inside] Entering the inn, you can see that although there are not the amenities one might find in a city inn, a pointed effort has been made toward the comfort of its guests. Comfortable chairs woven from dried reeds are upholstered with hand-stitched cushions. There is a blazing hearth, which radiates a powerful heat that is held in by walls insulated with thatch and held up by sturdy wattle. A split-log bar, hand planed and polished with animal fat, practically glows from the reflected flame.

Eater Of Hope.name:
希望吞噬者
Eater Of Hope

Text.text:
一大堆钱币之上蹲着一头巨大的有翼生物，乌黑的皮肤仿佛将光线尽数吞噬。它转过头，露出一对巨大的金色犄角，其上镶嵌着熠熠生辉的宝石。狐狸般的面容咧开一抹狞笑，野兽随即起身，展开蝠翼般的双翼，又舒展起那对巨爪，骨节低响。
Atop a pile of coins squats a large, winged creature, its ebon skin seeming to drink in the light. It turns its head to reveal huge golden horns studded with gleaming gems. The vulpine face breaks into a grin, and the beast rises, spreading its batlike wings, then flexes its massive claws.

Police-issue Pump Shotgun.name:
警用制式泵动霰弹枪
Police-issue Pump Shotgun

Text.text:
这把霰弹枪的设计简洁却高效。黑色枪身干净而润着油光，醒目的部位用色彩强调：扳机、护木泵柄与装填口周围是一圈蓝色，保险附近则点着黄色。任何人只要把这把武器拿起来，都会凭直觉明白该怎么操作它。
The design of the shotgun is simple but effective. The black casing is clean and oiled, with color highlighting prominent areas: blue around the trigger, pump, and loading slot, and yellow around the safety. Anybody who picks up the weapon will intuitively know how to work it.

这只小魔怪（特征）还不到两英尺高，裹着肮脏的破布，从洞窟里拖着脚步蹒跚而出，露出一身蓝皮肤，像画布般布满疣瘤与肿胀的突起。他那对长耳朵在一颗鼓胀的秃头上轻轻抽动，耳下的小眼睛闪着冷光，像沉在泥里的钱币。稚嫩的双手却举着一把钝钝的削皮小刀，仿佛那是一柄弯刀。随着他鬼祟溜走的身影，蜈蚣翻涌蠕动——仿佛争先恐后地越过彼此，要追随它们的首领奔赴战场。
Barely two feet tall and draped in soiled rags, the wiry gremlin shuffles out of the cave, revealing blue skin that is a canvas of warts and swollen protrusions. His long ears twitch atop a bulbous bald head, and beneath them beady eyes glint like coins sunk in mud. His infantile hands heft a dull paring knife as though it were a cutlass. In his slinking wake, centipedes writhe—as if rushing over one another to follow their leader to war.

Divine Dais Of A God Of Righteousness.name:
正义之神的神圣台座
Divine Dais Of A God Of Righteousness

Text.text:
在终极审判的王座厅里，千级白色大理石台阶层层升起，每一级都是又长又低的平台。自第一阶起，通往正义王座的攀登便是一场缓慢的朝圣，提醒忏悔者必须细细掂量自己祈求的真伪与坦诚。台阶之上，巨龙横卧酣眠或懒懒打着哈欠；有的振翼飞起又落回原处，有的则以冰冷的睿智注视着每一个踏上此途的人。最顶端，台座上的王座空无一人，在最耀眼的日光与告解般的空气里沉默无声。
In the throne room of ultimate judgment, a thousand stairs of white marble rise, each a long, low platform. The climb to the throne of righteousness is a slow pilgrimage from the first step. It reminds the penitents to consider deeply the honesty of their petitions. Stretched along the stairs, dragons sleep or yawn. Some fly off and land again, and some gaze with cold wisdom at whomever climbs these steps. At the top, the throne on the dais is empty, silent in a bath of brightest daylight and the air of confession.

你向前踏出一步，身体一拧，后腿借着一记轻跳绕到身前。转身之际，你俯身下沉，躯干与头颅一并压低。双臂张开助推旋势，动能顺势灌入前腿。紧接着，你猛然蹬地。胸腹贴平如刃，双臂向后收拢似翼展开，后腿随之抬起。旋转的势头将你带着掠过一圈，拖后的那条腿划出弧线扫向前方，另一条腿紧随其后。前脚先以前掌点地，随即压实。你仍在扭转中让另一只脚落地，最终稳稳停住，立于随时应战的姿态。

~ Envisioned by Aiine

You step forward, twist, and bring your back leg around to the front with a small hop. As you turn, you bend, lowering your torso and head. Your arms come out to add to the momentum, which transfers to your front leg. Then, you push off. With your chest flat, you bring your arms back like wings, your rear leg lifting. The momentum carries you around, the trailing leg arcing to the fore, followed by the other leg. The forward foot lands on the ball before flattening. You continue to twist as your other foot lands, leaving you standing at the ready.

~ Envisioned by Aiine

你面前的樱树是神圣的——不必他人开口，你便已知晓。直到此刻，你才真正看见。万千粉色花朵掩映着一个初生的灵体，蜷曲而好奇，在紫红色的半明半暗碎光中轻舞。周遭草木向那灵体微微倾身，仿佛向它们的君王致意。有的枯萎，有的盛放。变化本就如此。
The cherry tree before you is sacred—you know this without being told. Only now do you see. Myriad pink blossoms hide a nascent spirit, curled and curious, dancing in flecks of fuchsia-colored half-light. Nearby flora bend toward the spirit, as though in deference to their monarch. Some wither, some bloom. Such is the nature of change.

Manticore With Malice In Its Eyes.name:
眼含恶意的蝎狮
Manticore With Malice In Its Eyes

Text.text:
若不是这生物其余部分的怪诞模样更令人悚然，你几乎会无法将视线从那条抽搐的尾巴上移开——尾巴上密密麻麻缀着长长的尖刺。它足有十英尺长，狮子的躯干、巨龙的双翼；那张噩梦般、近似人形的脸上排着一行行鲨鱼般的利齿，四周则被一圈刺状鬃毛框起。这个恐怖的怪物看起来仿佛能用四五种不同的方式置你于死地。它眼中掠过的纯粹恶意闪光，昭示着它对这一点再清楚不过。
You would find yourself unable to tear your gaze away from the twitching tail, festooned with long spikes as it is, were it not for the rest of the creature’s bizarre appearance. Fully ten feet long with the body of a lion, the wings of a dragon, and rows of sharklike teeth in a nightmarish human-adjacent face framed by a mane of spines, this horrific monster looks as if it could kill you four or five different ways. The flash of pure malice in its eyes reveals that it is all too aware of this possibility.

Walking In An Enchanted Forest.name:
漫步于魔法森林之中
Walking In An Enchanted Forest

Text.text:
精灵魔法在古老森林中流淌的嗡鸣浸透空气，你从巨大的红杉下穿行时，那股震颤顺着皮肤轻轻爬过。你吸入被阳光烘暖的树皮甜香，以及林下植被浓郁、潮润的泥土气息。头顶上，一群虹彩闪烁的鸣禽在粗阔的树干间穿梭翻飞，展开一场繁复的空中舞蹈，满是如诗的啁啾与清亮的口哨声。
The hum of fae magic flowing through the ancient forest saturates the air and tingles your skin as you pass beneath the giant redwoods. You breathe in the sweet scent of sun-warmed bark and the rich, earthy aroma of undergrowth. Above you, a flock of iridescent songbirds flits between the wide trunks in an elaborate aerial dance full of lyrical chirps and whistles.

Sundries From A Lich Apprentice.name:
巫妖学徒的杂物
Sundries From A Lich Apprentice

Text.text:
尽管只是粗布制成，那堆被撕得粉碎、曾属于学徒长袍的破布残骸上，却点缀着诡异、几乎难以察觉的符文。它们或许仍有价值——只要你敢把这些碎片拼着读下去……
Despite being made of simple cloth, the shredded rag pile that was once the apprentice’s robe is decorated with strange, nearly imperceptible glyphs. Any value they may have could come from reading the scraps… if you dare.

I Cast Mislead.name:
我施放【误导术】
I Cast Mislead

Text.text:
法术如一条棉毯般裹住我，柔软顺滑，暖意融融。我后退一步，彻底隐形，却在原地留下一个与我分毫不差的完美替身。我交叉手指祈求好运，将意识沉入那具复制体，开始我的伪装——它发出的声响与做出的动作，皆与真实的我如出一辙。
The spell wraps about me like a blanket of cotton, smooth and cozy. I step back, completely invisible, but leave a perfect duplicate of myself behind. Crossing my fingers for luck, I drop my consciousness into the copy and begin my charade—the sounds and movements it makes mimic my true form.

Secret Tunnel Entrance.name:
秘密隧道入口
Secret Tunnel Entrance

Text.text:
暗门像一扇巨大的猫门般向上掀起，比你预想的还要安静、轻巧得多。你立刻怀疑里面用了配重机关，而当你抬门时瞥见一块石制砝码沿着上蜡的绳索缓缓下坠，正印证了你的判断。门后是一条狭窄的通道，在石壁之间蜿蜒延伸。
The hidden door levers up like a great cat flap, far more quietly and easily than you expected. You immediately suspect counterweights must be involved and are rewarded when you spy a stone weight that lowers on a waxed cord as you lift the door. Beyond the door a narrow passage wends its way through the stone.

I Cast Steel Wind Strike.name:
我施展《钢风斩击》
I Cast Steel Wind Strike

Text.text:
我挥舞武器，吐出那咒力之词。法术自我口中轰然迸发，凝聚缠绕于刃锋之上。疾风一卷，我的身影骤然消失——在房间里穿梭如电，斩击每一个落入我触及之内的人。待风息止，我已稳稳立定，武器在手，正贴身站在其中一个目标身旁。
Flourishing my weapon, I speak the words of power. The spell blasts from my mouth to coalesce around the blade. In a gust of wind, I vanish—darting around the room, striking at those within my reach. When the wind dies I am standing, weapon in hand, right next to one of my targets.

Pickpocketing A Court Jester.name:
扒窃宫廷弄臣
Pickpocketing A Court Jester

Text.text:
你注视着那蹦跳胡闹的蠢货在宫廷里咯咯发笑的贵族面前招摇过市，以高超的杂技技能与刀锋般犀利的机智逗得他们乐不可支。你谨慎掐准时机，在他旋身从你身旁掠过时伸出一只手。小丑依旧舞个不停，浑然不觉你已暗中得手，悄然将他洗劫一空。
You watch the capering fool as he parades before the chortling nobility of the court, delighting them with acrobatic skill and razor-sharp wit. Picking your moment carefully, you extend a hand as he dances past you. The jester dances on, oblivious to your clandestine robbery.

Mercy’s Grave In Winter.name:
冬日的仁慈之墓
Mercy’s Grave In Winter

Text.text: 这里安放着一具石棺，似乎是献给一位名叫“慈怜”的人。其铭文写道：为慈怜祈祷。神祇在她生前并未善待她。祈祷或许能让她的来世更轻松。 The sarcophagus that lies here seems to be dedicated to someone named Mercy. Its inscription reads: Pray for Mercy. The gods were not kind to her in life. Prayers might make her afterlife easier.

I Cast Etherealness.name:
我施放以太化
I Cast Etherealness

Text.text:
当我开始吟诵咒文，失重感便席卷而来，我全神贯注于那些复杂的手势，好完成向以太界的转渡。仿佛一切生机都从我的感官中抽离。色彩褪成灰暗的阴影，声音变得遥远而沉闷；当我斩断与物质界的联系时，一种诡异的麻木充盈全身。
Weightlessness takes over as I begin the incantation, concentrating on the complex gestures needed to complete my transition to the Ethereal Realm. All life seems to leave my senses. Colors fade into gray shadow, sounds become distant and muffled, and a strange numbness fills my body as I sever my connection to the Material Realm.

Young Red Dragon.name:
幼年红龙
Young Red Dragon

Text.text:
即使在静止休憩之中，这头巨大而魔性的猛兽四肢仍鼓起流线而强劲的肌肉，宛如绷紧的钢索。略显破损的翅翼收拢折叠，披覆在龙形的躯架上，隐隐昭示着它的年代。外骨骼上的鳞片被一层微弱的赤红光晕从背后映亮，仿佛熔岩正沿着皮下奔流，在那坚不可摧的护甲之下汩汩涌动。然而最令人胆寒的，是它那双黄色爬行类眼眸中迸出的恶意火花——从它流涎的獠牙巨颚上方阴森逼视而来。
Even in repose, sleek, powerful muscles like steel cables bulge in all four legs of the immense, magical beast. Lightly tattered, folded wings drape across the draconic frame, hinting at its age. The scales along its exoskeleton are backlit with a faint reddish glow, as if magma itself courses along the surface of its skin, just below its adamantine armor. But most terrifying of all is the spark of malice in its yellow, reptilian, eyes—leering from just over its slavering, toothy chops.

I Cast Resurrection.name:
我施放【复活术】
I Cast Resurrection

Text.text:
钻石在我掌心化作粉末般的液体。我用它为死者描绘符号：额头、颈间，以及心口之上。随着我的动作，生者与死者之间的帷幕急速变薄，仿佛蛛网落入火焰，瞬息就要化尽。冰冷、湿黏的手指攫住我的手腕、脚踝与喉咙——急切地要把我拖到彼岸。我绷紧每一寸肌肉，把每一个念头都折向生命。尽管抵抗几乎耗尽我全部力气，我还是成功了。我踉跄后退，四肢发颤，肺里灼烧。跪倒在地时，我看见我的目标的手脚微微抽动。那张脸像火光般闪烁不定。他们猛地倒吸一口气，坐起身来，眼中泪水决堤。
The diamond turns to a powdery liquid in my hand. I paint the dead with symbols: their head, their neck, and over their heart. As I do, the veil between the living and the dead thins rapidly, like spider’s web caught in flames. Cold, clammy fingers grasp my wrists, ankles and throat—eager to pull me to the other side. I tense every muscle and bend every thought toward life. And, although it takes all of my energy to resist, I succeed. I stumble back, limbs shaking, lungs burning. As I fall to my knees, I see my target’s hands and feet stir. Their face flickers. They gasp for air and sit up, eyes flooding with tears.

一层釉质般的雾光笼罩着一名平民覆鳞的身躯，他们向前迈步，身上穿着随意的太空行装。很明显，他们来自某个爬蜥族裔，绿色的冠脊在空气中微微颤动。他们踉跄了一下——也许是醉了——随即又勉强稳住。眼周一圈黄绿色的血管清晰可见，正随着一股病态的能量跳动脉搏。
A glazed air surrounds the scaled form of a civilian as they step forward, dressed in casual spacer clothes. They’re obviously from a reptoid race, their green crest quivering in the air. They stagger—maybe drunk—then correct themself. A set of yellowish-green veins visible around the eye pulse with a sickly energy.

通常蝙蝠只需吃些水果，或猎食昆虫等害虫便已心满意足；但这只巨型个体那对过分巨大的獠牙与阴沉暴躁的神情，让你相信一旦被逼急，它也能拿更大的猎物来充饥。
Normally bats are quite satisfied to eat fruit or hunt vermin such as insects, but the oversized fangs and surly demeanor of this giant specimen lead you to believe that it is capable of dining upon larger prey if pressed.

I Cast Otherworldly Leap.name:
我施放《异界跃迁》
I Cast Otherworldly Leap

Text.text:
我向下一挥手，吐出一句抬升的咒词，让浮力灌注全身。魔法搅动脚边尘土，我感到身体变得轻盈。待我纵身一跃，魔法便托举着我，飞得更高、更远，远非孤身所能及。
With a gesture downward and a lifting word, I infuse my body with buoyancy. The magic stirs the dust around my feet and I feel myself lighten. When I leap, the magic carries me higher and farther than I could ever go alone.

Blue Elf Mage.name:
蓝精灵法师
Blue Elf Mage

Text.text:
若非她伸展的双手迸射出奥秘的金色辉光，仅凭她的形体便足以摄人心魄。黑而笔直的长发与她的贝德拉裙摆一同在身后飞扬，衬得她矢车菊般湛蓝的肌肤与健美利落的身姿愈发夺目。她的双眼如炽热的煤炭燃烧，恰似铜线般的光泽——那铜线束起她简约的衣饰，也在她额前编成一圈头冠。
Were it not for the arcane golden light shining from her outstretched hands, her physical form would be enough to enchant. Black, straight hair flies behind her, along with her bedlah skirt, forming a backdrop to her cornflower-blue skin and her athletic shape. Her eyes are as burning coals, like the copper wire that holds together her sparse clothing and adorns her head in a circlet.

Restricted Section Of An Arcane Library.name:
奥术图书馆的禁区
Restricted Section Of An Arcane Library

Text.text:
刻满警示与守护符文的石门通往图书馆的禁区，阴森地伫立在被遗忘的角落阴影里。可当你逼近那间禁室，你手掌最轻微的一次接触，门便无声地自行荡开。越靠近门扉的门槛，一阵麻痒般的战栗便沿着血脉奔流而上。

~ TheWiryWelshman 构想

Covered in runes of warning and warding, the stone door leading into the library’s restricted section stands ominously, cloaked in the shadows of a forgotten corner. Yet, as you approach the forbidden chamber, the slightest touch of your hand causes the door to swing open, silently. A tingling sensation courses through your veins the closer you get to the portal’s threshold.

~ Envisioned by TheWiryWelshman

他把身子懒懒地靠在椅背上，双脚搭在旁边一只木箱上。那瘦削的黑发男人漫不经心地检查着自己的指甲，随后才把目光落到你身上。他柔软的靴筒上方露出匕首柄，皮质护甲上也固定着几只刀鞘，半遮半掩在一件剪裁得体的外套下。一柄细剑装在蝎尾狮皮的剑鞘里，连着肩带挂在他椅背后方——但你看得出来，那角度恰到好处，只要有需要，他随手就能抽出。

~ 由一位英雄 扮演

Leaning back in a chair with his feet up on a nearby crate, the slender, dark-haired man idly inspects his fingernails before settling his gaze on you. Dagger hilts protrude from the tops of his soft boots as well as several sheaths attached to his leather armor, partially concealed under a tasteful coat. A rapier in a manticore leather scabbard hangs from its baldric over the back of his chair, but in such a way, you note, that he could retrieve it if necessary. Without looking, he withdraws a silver coin from a bulging belt pouch and effortlessly sends it dancing along his knuckles, his other hand smoothing down his thin mustache. He raises an eyebrow and shifts his hazel-eyed scrutiny to the others in your party, before abruptly flipping the silver coin into the air with his thumb and catching it just as quickly with an overhand snatch.

~ Played by a Hero

Intrusive Neighbor.name:
爱管闲事的邻居
Intrusive Neighbor

Text.text:
魔宠砸墙的声音被急促的脚步声取代，你的邻居沿着走廊一路赶到你的前门。紧随其后的敲门声既响亮又恼人——就像敲门的人一样——你带着疲惫的认命叹了口气，走向门口，绷紧神经，准备迎接又一场鸡毛蒜皮的咆哮。
The familiar banging on the wall is replaced by hurried footsteps as your neighbor makes their way down the hall to your front door. The impatient knocking that follows is both loud and irritating—much like the knocker themselves—and you sigh with weary resignation as you head to the door, bracing yourself for yet another petty tirade.

尽管这家店显然是为那些有兽人血脉的人而设，你所预想的那种喧闹粗野的气氛却出奇地不见踪影。这里不是高声狂欢之地，而是战斗与狩猎后的休息与庇护之所。走进这间温暖而昏暗的屋内，半兽人的客人们正享用着用稀有兽肉烹成的丰盛餐食，配着一大壶壶加了香料的麦酒。铺着毛皮软垫的座位散出淡淡的兽膻香，渗入空气，笼罩着整间店。门口处，武器会交给一个粗犷、独眼的半兽人收起——锁在柜台后以免见血——不过有一把沉重的重弩靠在一面墙边，像是随时可取的生意家当。
Though the establishment has clearly been designed to attract those descended from orcs, the rowdy atmosphere you might expect is conspicuously absent. For this is a place of rest and succor from the battles and hunts, not of loud revelry. Within its cozy, shadowed walls, the half-orc clientele enjoy a delicious repast of rare meat with flagons of spiced ale. The seats, upholstered with fur, emit a gentle musk that permeates the establishment. At the entrance, weapons are handed over to a rough, one-eyed half-orc—and kept behind a counter to prevent bloodshed—although there is a businesslike heavy crossbow propped up against one wall for their easy access.

Demon Lord’s Great Hall.name:
魔王的大殿
Demon Lord’s Great Hall

Text.text:
这里曾是某位地狱领主奢华的王座厅，如今却满目疮痍——大理石地面多处龟裂，门扇脱离铰链，歪斜倾倒。十来盏小巧的生铁枝形吊灯里，只有一盏在闪烁，几支点燃的珠光蜡烛摇曳其间。冰冷的火盆沿着东、西两侧墙壁一字排开，每一只火盆背后都绘着不同恶魔的画像。通往王座的长毯破烂不堪，却依旧厚重，干涸的血让它僵硬发硬，边缘以珍珠母镶饰。刻满地狱蚀刻纹的高台之上，矗立着一张由骸骨与头骨堆砌而成的王座，宽阔得足以容纳一名巨人。
Once the opulent throne room of an infernal lord, this room is in disrepair—the marble floor cracked in many places, doors off their hinges. One small pig-iron chandelier of the dozen or so flickers with several lit pearlescent candles. Cold braziers line the east and west walls, the image of a different demon painted behind each one. The runner to the throne is tattered but heavy and stiff with dried blood and bordered in mother of pearl. Atop a dais sectioned with infernal etchings is a throne built of bones and skulls, wide enough for a giant.

Basetta, A Card Game.name:
《巴塞塔：纸牌游戏》
Basetta, A Card Game

Text.text:
狂欢夫人在她的宅邸里主持这场牌局，用带着香水气息的信笺逐一邀请每位玩家。玩家们穿着擦得锃亮的靴子与最体面的华服抵达，落座桌前，接过开胃酒。第一手牌从一副定制牌组中发出——花色由夫人的画师亲手设计：酒杯、玫瑰、梅花与星辰——玩家们随即摆出牌桌上的表情，定下他们希望能撑过余下整晚的策略。
The Lady Reveller hosts the game at her mansion, inviting each player with a perfumed letter. The players arrive in polished boots and their best finery, take seats at the table, and accept their aperitifs. The first hand is dealt from a custom deck—the suits designed by the Lady’s artist: cups, roses, clubs, and stars—and the players establish a game face, and a strategy they hope will last the rest of the evening.

这只磨损的木箱内部被隔成数个区域。一条狭长的隔间里摆着装有颜料、墨水与黏合剂的小瓶，还有一块沾染污渍的调色板。旁侧一道窄槽收纳着刷子与海绵。更大的隔间里放着头发，而更小的空间里则塞着假牙。箱盖上的套环里固定着一面小镜子、剪刀与镊子。
Inside this worn wooden box are partitions. One long section holds tiny jars of pigment, ink, and adhesive, as well as a stained palette. A narrow slot alongside contains brushes and sponges. A larger compartment holds hair, and smaller spaces have false teeth. In loops on the box’s top are a small mirror, scissors, and tweezers.

Mezzoloth Encounter.name:
梅佐洛斯遭遇
Mezzoloth Encounter

Text.text:
那佝偻畸形的恶魔靠着短粗的腿勉强支起沉重的身躯。数条手臂以不一的长度垂落——其中一条末端只生着一枚带钩的利爪，拖在身后，像犁刃般翻卷着泥土。那生物虽带蟾蜍般的轮廓，却在形态与尺度上全然悖离常理，像两栖、哺乳与爬行的怪诞拼接。骨刺自关节处倒钩般突起，獠牙从厚重下垂的下颚向上弯曲。恶魔的多只眼睛各自独立眨动，更添其荒谬的违和感。斑驳皮肤覆着黏滑的涎膜，散发硫磺与腐烂的恶臭；那野兽拖拽着自己向你逼近，滴落的巨口大张，涌动着非自然的饥渴。
The slouched, malformed fiend holds its considerable mass upright on stunted legs. Multiple arms hang at varying lengths—one, ending in a single, hooked claw, drags along behind it, tilling the earth like the blade of a plow. The creature, though toad-like, defies reason in its shape and scale, an odd mingling of amphibian, mammal, and reptile. Bones protrude in barbed points from joints, and tusks curve upward from a heavy, underslung jaw. The fiend’s multiple eyes blink separately, further confusing its illogical appearance. Mottled skin slick with slime, stinking of sulfur and rot, the beast drags itself toward you, dripping maw gaping with an unnatural hunger.

Gnoll Vampire.name:
豺狼人吸血鬼（特征）
Gnoll Vampire

Text.text:
巨大的豺狼人以四肢猛然扑前，利爪刮擦着石面。它那深黑的毛皮仿佛将周遭的光线尽数吞噬，唯有沉重阴影的眉骨下，双眼燃着异界般的饥渴。破烂斗篷披在它身上，勾勒出一只巨蝠般的轮廓。新鲜的血从它的獠牙间滴落，它停下抹去嘴边血迹，随即开口说话——那声音短促而狡黠，与这般兽性的面孔格格不入。
The massive gnoll surges forward on all four limbs, claws scraping at the stone. Its stark black fur seems to drink in the light around it, though its eyes burn with an otherworldly hunger beneath a heavy, shadowed brow. Tatters of a cloak drape its frame, evoking the silhouette of a massive bat. Fresh blood drips from its fangs, and it stops to wipe its mouth before speaking in a voice too curt and cunning for such a bestial visage.

Mausoleum Of A Great Paladin.name:
一位伟大圣骑士的陵寝
Mausoleum Of A Great Paladin

Text.text:
陵墓上饰满天使的身影；在壁画与雕像中，智天使与炽天使一同振翼而起。入口外，一尊大理石雕像跪地，肃穆而虔敬。那身披华辉护甲的身影，将长剑深深刺入他们所栖之基座。
Angelic figures decorate the mausoleum, cherubim and seraphim taking wing together in both the art and statuary. A marble statue kneels in solemn reverence outside the entrance. The figure—clad in resplendent armor—drives their sword into the plinth on which they dwell.

Hutch La Rayne, Slaver Pirate Maedar.name:
哈奇·拉·雷恩，奴隶贩子海盗梅达尔
Hutch La Rayne, Slaver Pirate Maedar

Text.text:
本该长着胡须的地方，竟伸出一绺绺扭动的蛇索——一团诡异的黑鳞眼镜蛇从他的面颊、下巴与颈侧垂落。它们张口嘶鸣，尖牙寒光一闪，毒液滴落在他布满疤痕、赤裸外露的胸膛上。他在黑色皮马甲下穿着宽松衬衫，半披风从一侧肩头垂下；他的手臂末端接着一把小型弩。那里没有手掌，只有一件致命的远程武器被铆钉固定在手腕上。其余部分看起来大体仍是人类：他是个年轻男人，高大健壮，皮肤被数月海风晒成深褐。一只眼被眼罩遮住，另一只暴露在外——恶意如暴雨般倾泻。那只眼呈深蓝色，点缀银斑，情绪翻涌不息。

~ Played by Wereraven

Cords of writhing snakes protrude where a beard should be, an eldritch mass of black-scaled cobras descending from his cheeks, chin, and neck. Sharp teeth glint as they open their mouths to hiss, fangs dripping venom onto his scarred, bared chest. He wears a loose shirt under a vest of black leather, and a half-cloak drapes down one shoulder, his arm ending in a small crossbow. In place of a hand, he bears the deathly ranged weapon bolted to his wrist. The rest of him appears mostly human: he is a younger man of tall and muscular build, his skin tanned from months at sea. One of his eyes is covered by a patch while the other is exposed—and torrential with malice. It is deep blue in color, flecked with silver, and roiling with emotion.

~ Played by Wereraven

巨鹰远不只是体型更大的同类；它的眼中闪烁着类人生物般的慧黠光芒。即便如此，它天生的聪慧丝毫不减利爪的锐利与残喙的致命——那残酷的喙足以把板甲护甲像撕开锡罐般扯裂。
Much more than simply a larger version of its lesser fellows, the giant eagle’s eyes glimmer with the sapience of a humanoid. Nevertheless, its natural intelligence does not detract from the sharpness of its talons nor the deadliness of its cruel beak, capable of tearing open plate armor like a tin can.

Loot From An Arcane Mezzoloth.name:
奥术灵媒魔蝇魔的战利品
Loot From An Arcane Mezzoloth

Text.text:
除了在学者的包里找到一只沉甸甸的钱袋，里面装着50枚金币之外，你还发现了几卷法术卷轴。每一件珍贵的奥术宝藏都收在一只雕工繁复的象牙卷匣中，两端以锃亮的银质塞帽封住。
In addition to the hefty purse of 50 gold pieces you find in the scholar’s bag, you also discover several spell scrolls. Each one of the valuable arcane treasures is held within an ornately carved ivory case capped with gleaming silver stoppers.

Spacegoing Prison Ship: Cell Block.name:
航行星海的囚犯运输船：牢房区
Spacegoing Prison Ship: Cell Block

Text.text:
这座空旷如洞的牢房区里，嘘声与起哄此起彼伏，守卫巡逻时脚步回荡，然而一切喧嚣都被舰船那如巨兽般的庞大引擎低沉嗡鸣吞没。板岩灰的墙面浸在头顶刺目的荧光泛白里，俯瞰全场的高耸塔楼威压迫人，步枪的猩红光束在栈道与天桥间来回扫掠。
Hoots and jeers ring through the cavernous cell block as the guards patrol, though the noise is lost to the droning hum of the ship’s titanic engines. Slate-gray walls are bathed in fluorescence from the dazzling floodlights overhead, and the crimson beams of rifles sweep the gantries from the imposing tower dominating the room.

Julie Amakiir.name:
朱莉·阿玛基尔
Julie Amakiir

Text.text:
这名女子脸庞光滑稚嫩，蓝绿的短发贴着头皮，更衬得她尖尖的耳朵一览无余。她那身久经磨损的衣物染着春日林地的色调，皮靴却是树皮般的深褐。她神情木然，却仍以海绿色的眼睛警觉扫视，手中握着一把优雅的反曲弓。另一只手则停在腰侧那只装满的箭袋旁。

~ Played by Walt M.

This woman has a smooth, childlike face and close-cropped blue-green hair that makes her pointed ears apparent. Hues of the forest in spring color her well-worn clothing, though her leather boots are the shade of bark. She wears a deadpan expression, but her sea-green eyes remain alert, and she holds an elegant recurve bow in hand. Her other hand rests near the full quiver at her hip.

~ Played by Walt M.

I Read A Necromancy Spell Scroll I Under.name:
我读懂了一张死灵法术卷轴，并理解了其含义
I Read A Necromancy Spell Scroll I Understand

Text.text:
当我握着卷轴、凝视其表面刻下的棱角符号时，麻木感沿着指尖蔓延开来。双眼隐隐作痛，冰冷的恶心感在腹中翻涌；那些符号泛起病态的绿光，在纸面上蜿蜒游走，最终拼成那道法术亵渎的字句。
Numbness spreads through my fingers as I hold the scroll and study the angular symbols scratched into its surface. My eyes ache and cold nausea builds in my gut as the symbols glow a sickly green, slithering across the page to form the blasphemous words of the spell.

Tournament Melee In Spring.name:
春季比武大会
Tournament Melee In Spring

Text.text:
温润的空气里回荡着钢铁相击的铮鸣，一群披甲的斗士挥砍、劈削、突刺——彩绘亭棚里喧闹的人群为之狂呼，嘴里高喊着心头所爱的名字。曾经葱绿的草地如今遍布倒下的身影，断裂的盾牌与钝口的刀刃还被无力的手紧紧攥着。
Balmy air rings with the sound of steel as a mass of armored combatants hew, cut, and thrust—cheered on by raucous folk sitting in a colorful pavilion, the names of favorites loud on their lips. The once-green grass is littered with the fallen, sundered shields and dull-edged blades clasped in nerveless hands.

Otto's Irresistible Dance.name:
奥托的诱惑之舞
Otto's Irresistible Dance

Text.text:
一阵恶作剧般的涟漪席卷而来，你的嗓音化作轻盈跃动的诗句，强迫敌人将全部注意力投向你。朗朗上口的节奏搅动空气，你把词句送向对手，让它们翩然起舞，旋律的微尘蜿蜒向外蔓延。这是一曲阴险而诱人的交响。
A wave of mischief washes over you, your vocals a prancing poem demanding your foe’s utmost attention. The catchy rhythm churns the air as you send the words dancing toward your enemy, motes of melody slithering outward. It is a sinister, tempting symphony.

尽管年代在他脸上刻下如风化山峦般的沟壑，这位铸匠大师心中仍燃着炽热的激情，宛如眼前熊熊的熔炉。他挥动铁锤，迅疾而精准地落下每一击，矮人锻造着他最新的杰作；每一次势大力沉的抡击，都令火星如雨倾泻而下。
Though age lines his face like the slopes of a weathered mountain, the master smith still holds the fire of passion in his heart like the blazing forge before him. Striking the metal with swift, precise blows from his hammer, the dwarf shapes his latest masterpiece as sparks rain down with each mighty swing.

巨石巍然并立，宛如一席德高望重的议会，正以缓慢而审慎的语调辩论不休。一块古老的巨石匍匐在地，余下的同伴守望着它。附近的空气被一股无形的电荷染上魔法般的臭氧辛味。
The colossal stones stand together, like a venerable council engaged in slow and deliberate debate. One ancient stone lies prostrate on the ground, watched over by its remaining brethren. An invisible charge tinges the air nearby with the ozone tang of magic.

Torture Drug, Soothsayer.name:
酷刑药剂，占卜师
Torture Drug, Soothsayer

Text.text:
自杀树的橙色树汁，黏稠得像胶，沿着一只漆黑的瓶身向上爬流。他们管它叫“预言者”。可它一点也不温和。不过，预言必将降临——而痛楚，它的接触无形而迅疾，将尖锐到令人彻底崩溃。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The orange sap of the suicide tree, glutinous and sticky, pours up the sides of a dark flask. They call it the soothsayer. Nothing soothing about it. But saying will certainly be forthcoming—and pain, its touch invisible and swift, will be utterly excruciating.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这头带褶边的小恐龙举止像小狗一样，带着少年般难以遏止的欢腾蹦跳嬉闹。柔和的、葱郁的森林绿条纹在生物的鳞片上勾勒出成带的花纹，让它能隐入故乡高高的草丛之中。幼崽不过老鼠大小，而它周围的同窝幼子数量惊人，喵叫不止、饥肠辘辘，争先恐后地抢夺那位小巧母亲的注意力。
Puppylike in its demeanor, the frilled dinosaur capers around with the unquenchable exuberance of youth. Soft stripes of lush forest green paint the creature’s scales in patterned bands, allowing it to blend into the tall grass of its home. The baby is no bigger than a rat, and the litter surrounding it is numerous with mewling, ravenous offspring all vying for the attention of their diminutive mother.

这把战斧的临时刃身沿着全长精磨出致命的锋刃，由某种巨兽的肋骨笼架打造而成——大得几乎超出你所能驾驭。它并不像龙骨那般致密，否则根本不可能挥动。也许最好别去追问这把武器的来历，只需满足于它显而易见的威能——除非有朝一日，你被那些生物之一亲自找上门来！
Featuring a deadly edge honed along the length of its makeshift blade, this battleaxe has been crafted from the rib cage of some mighty animal, one so large that the weapon is almost beyond your handling. It has not the density of dragon bone, or it would be impossible to swing. Perhaps it is best not to know the weapon’s origins, and to instead satisfy yourself with its obvious potence—unless you should find yourself challenged by one of the creatures themselves!

训练道场的墙上陈列着各式各样既魔宠般熟悉又陌生的武器：有笔直的刀刃，也有弯曲的刃锋；有长柄兵器，既装着矛尖也嵌着锤头；有带倒刺铁链的枷锁武器；还有匕首、长匕，以及钩刃剑。每一件武器都在从障子墙间漫入的柔暗光线里泛着冷亮。武者两两对练，手持钝刃与木制训练武器交锋，击打迸出的清脆爆响在空间中回荡不息。教习是一位灰发宗师，倚着一根盘结的手杖，专注而克制地守夜般注视着每一场对练，面容上看不出任何可被误认为情绪的痕迹。
Weapons familiar and strange line the walls of the training dojo: straight blades and curved, polearms with spearpoints and hammerheads, flail weapons with barbed chains, daggers, dirks, and hooked swords. Each weapon gleams in the muted light streaming through the shoji walls. Warriors spar in pairs with blunted blades and wooden training weapons, the sharp crack of their strikes reverberating through the space. The instructor, a gray-haired master leaning on a gnarled walking stick, watches each sparring match with careful interest, their face devoid of anything that could be mistaken as emotion.

Menacing Blood Spider.name:
骇人的血蛛
Menacing Blood Spider

Text.text:
在头顶苍白的光柱倾泻下，一个由木瓦搭成、灌满鲜血的巢穴沿着一道沟槽缓缓放出其中的黏稠之物。一只泛着铜色光泽的蜘蛛从血池中踏出，足肢与螯牙上仍滴落着猩红的血珠。
Under pale shafts of light from above, a blood-filled nest made of wooden shakes releases its contents through a channel. A coppery spider steps out of the pool, its legs and mandibles dripping blood.

God Of Hunting.name:
狩猎之神
God Of Hunting

Text.text:
“向鹿角头盔致敬，那双明亮的眼睛自幽深的眼窝中刺穿黑暗。向强壮的臂膀与宽阔多毛的胸膛致敬，向马一般的下半身与尾端的黑色羽穗致敬。礼赞执弓之手与踏径之蹄，礼赞那支号角——在暮色或黎明——召来猎犬、孢子与追逐的狂奔！”神祇高喊道。“剔除兽群，喂饱村庄！让这一切既神圣，又野性！”
"Hail to the stag antler helm, the bright eyes piercing through its deep sockets. Hail to the strong arms and broad hairy chest, the equine bottom half and black plume of a tail. Celebrate the hand to the bow and the hoof to the trail, and the horn that calls, at twilight or dawn, the hounds, the spore, the course!" shouts the god. “Cull the herd and feed the village! Let it be sacred and wild!”"

自古以来备受朝圣者青睐的蜿蜒崖道，如今已变得阴森可怖。成千上万的足迹、风雨侵蚀，以及时代无情的流逝，将这条小径摧残到危险至极的地步，使得攀登格外凶险——无论天气如何。
Favored by pilgrims throughout the ages, the winding cliffside trail has become incredibly foreboding. Thousands of footsteps, the elements, and the relentless passage of time have degraded the path to a dangerous degree, making the climb especially treacherous—no matter the weather.

巨兽令人目眩的体型尚且算不得最骇人；更胜一筹的是它那刺耳、金属般的尖啸——仿佛钢铁刮擦岩石。它仅在形貌与体格上像一条巨龙：这具构装生物以齿轮与轮轴驱动四肢，以滑轮与杠杆牵引步伐。黄铜色的金属甲壳护住它的钢铁骷髅（特征），也护住其中咔嗒作响、嗡鸣旋转的机括。宝石般的双眼燃起奥术之光，它再度张开那深不见底的巨口，而在胸腔深处，一股炽烈的高热开始膨胀……

~ 一位英雄 Envisioned

The beast’s dizzying size is outdone only by its cacophonous, metallic screech—a sound like steel against stone. A dragon in shape and size only, the construct creature moves on limbs powered by gears and wheels, by pulleys and levers. A brassy metal carapace protects its steel skeleton, and the clicking, whirring mechanisms within. Its gemstone eyes blaze with arcane light as it again opens its gaping maw, and from deep inside its chest, an intense heat begins to grow . . .

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Cursed: Fine Motor Control.name:
诅咒：精细动作控制
Cursed: Fine Motor Control

Text.text:
起初，对你说的那些话听来荒谬得可笑。可很快，你的手指开始发麻，继而刺痛如针，双手止不住地颤抖。系紧外衣的扣子、展开一卷卷轴、给弩上弦——这些如今都会难如在暴风雨中站在船甲板上穿针引线。
What was spoken to you seemed ridiculous at first, even funny. Then your fingers began to tingle, followed by pinpricks throughout your hands, and the shaking. Working the buttons on your doublet, unfurling a scroll, loading a crossbow—these will now be as difficult as threading a needle while standing on the deck of a ship in a storm.

陡峭的石塔高高矗立在山丘之巅。它让你想起一座城堡，你不禁揣测自己是否能在其中找到栖身之所。或许有一道裂缝，你能钻进去当作最后的堡垒。但你越是靠近，石壁就越显得坚不可摧。
The steep tower of stone stands tall atop a hill. It reminds you of a castle, and you wonder if you might somehow find shelter in it. Perhaps there’s a crack into which you might crawl as a redoubt. But the closer you get, the more impregnable the stone appears.

这根丝绳洁净无瑕，连一丝毛边都没有，盘成一个完美的绳圈——华美而完整，仿佛昨日才刚刚编就。细看绳股的编纹，你会发现有一缕银线，修长不断，沿着整条绳索以繁复的纹样穿绕其中。如此矫饰的工艺，必定耗费了难以想象的巨力与心血。
This silk rope, spotless and without any hint of fraying, lies in a perfect coil—splendid and whole as if it had been braided yesterday. Examining the braid closely, you see that a single silver thread, long and unbroken, has been wound through the entire length of the rope in an intricate pattern. Such an affectation must have taken a gargantuan effort.

Cloak Of Arachnida.name:
蛛魔斗篷
Cloak Of Arachnida

Text.text:
这件黑袍薄如蝉翼，其间织入纤细的银线，若隐若现。你的目光顺着其中一缕游走，很快便见它与其他银线相交——那些银线自一处万线汇聚的节点向外放射。蛛网般的纹路在布料上织出无数图案，虽看不出任何对称，却仍令这件斗篷更添赏心悦目。
This diaphanously thin black robe has thin silver thread running through it, barely visible. Your eye follows one line and soon finds it intersecting with others that radiate out from a point where many lines come together. The web-like threads make numerous patterns throughout the fabric, having no discernable symmetry, but nevertheless making the cloak more pleasing to look at.

Threat From A Frustrated Cleric.name:
一名挫败神官的威胁
Threat From A Frustrated Cleric

Text.text:
“下次你半截身子陷在某个怪物的喉胃里时，不如你试试用脏破布和口水给自己缝缝补补，而我去找点更值得做的事？”
“Next time you’re waist deep in the gullet of some monstrosity, how about you try mending yourself with dirty rags and spit while I find something better to do?”

Portal To The Elemental Plane Of Fire.name:
通往火元素位面的传送门
Portal To The Elemental Plane Of Fire

Text.text:
前往火之位面的旅程绝非胆小者所能承受：踏过炽红的炭火，跃入燃焰之中，将自己绑上火刑柱，吐出那引燃万物的字句。穿越转瞬即逝，却痛彻骨髓，而你能清晰感到元素生物的快意。
The journey to the plane of fire is not for the faint of heart: walk the coals, jump the flame, lash yourself to the stake, and speak the incendiary word. The crossing is brief but excruciating, and you can feel the elemental’s pleasure.

Quip About Gratitude.name:
关于感恩的俏皮话
Quip About Gratitude

Text.text:
“我对你的感激深得让我不安。一个人被你无数次救回性命，该如何报答？我不知道该说什么。我的心与尊严，都握在你手里。”
“There is a depth of gratitude I feel toward you that makes me uncomfortable. How do you repay someone who has saved your life countless times? I don’t know what to say. You hold my heart and dignity in your hands.”

Inhabited Waters Of A Faerie River.name:
妖精河流的栖居水域
Inhabited Waters Of A Faerie River

Text.text:
永不停歇的舞动香蒲点缀着湿淋淋的草岸，河边的树木彬彬有礼般微微躬身，把盘根错节的“脚趾”探进回旋的涡流里。此处万物皆在恒久的变迁之中：水流穿行而过，新水随即补上。柔和的水流中央，三颗苍白的头颅顶着又长又湿的发丝缓缓浮起，周围漾开三圈相扣的涟漪。三抹笑容，三对尖锐的小耳朵。咯咯的笑声与流水击石的歌声交织在一起。
Ever-dancing cattails dot the dripping, grassy banks of the river, where politely bowing trees dip their rooty toes in the eddy. It is all perpetual change here. Water traveling through, new water replacing it. Three pale heads of long, wet hair rise from the center of the gentle current, complete with three matching sets of ripples. Three smiles and three pairs of sharp, little ears. Giggles mix with the song of water over rock.

Clockwork Gnome City.name:
发条侏儒之城
Clockwork Gnome City

Text.text:
在你还未触及它之前，你先听见它：滴答与嗡鸣；齿轮与锁扣咬合又松开；曲柄、棘轮与铃声。洞窟深处，一簇“高楼”铺展开来——却并不算高——在灯火、铁与青铜的浮雕带，以及纵横的管道间活了过来。每扇窗不过一英尺见方。每一层也只有五英尺高。狭窄的钟楼从砖石与金属工坊之上探出头来，全部指着同一个——正确的——time。两名发条士兵步伐丝毫不差地行军而过。一名身着行会长袍的侏儒停下脚步，困惑地盯着你。

~ Played by a Hero

Long before you reach it, you hear it: ticking and whirring; gears and locks engaging and disengaging; cranks, ratchets, and bells. Deep in the cave, a spray of high-rise buildings that don’t rise very high is alive with lights, iron and bronze friezes, and pipework. Each window is a foot square. Each story is only five feet high. Narrow clock towers rise above the brick and metalworks, all showing the exact same—correct—time. Two clockwork soldiers march by in perfect synchronization. A gnome in guild robes stops and stares at you, bewildered.

~ Played by a Hero

金属生物起初看上去只是一堆黄铜废料与机械残骸，但很快便伴着刺耳的金属呻吟自行挪动，显露出一具隐约类人的形态：完美的球形躯干上被一只巨大的独眼所主宰，两条细长的腿支撑其身，周身则伸展着许多可旋转的手臂。它是一具庞大的构装体，高耸得凌驾于大多数类人之上，却又常常得低头蜷身才能挤进多数门框；然而它的神情却像一只焦躁、易惊的动物，悄无声息而又小心翼翼地打量着四周。锈迹与污渍斑驳了它外壳那被磨损的装甲板，藻类、苔藓与霉菌在关节处堆积滋生。它体内收纳着一对缠绕电光的长矛，并以多臂挥使这些噼啪作响的武器。

~ Envisioned by dr.dungeon

The metal creature, at first, appears as a pile of brass refuse and mechanical detritus, but it soon shifts with a metallic groan, revealing a vaguely humanoid form comprising a perfectly spherical torso dominated by a massive eye, a pair of spindly legs, and many swiveling arms. It is a massive construct, towering over most humanoids and ducking to fit inside most doorways, though its countenance is one of an anxious, skittish animal, quietly and carefully observing its surroundings. Rust and tarnish mar the scuffed plating of its outer shell, with algae, moss, and mold collecting in the joints. It carries within itself a brace of lightning-wreathed spears, wielding the crackling weapons with its many arms.

~ Envisioned by dr.dungeon

Speech Before Final Encounter.name:
最终遭遇前的演说
Speech Before Final Encounter

Text.text:
“我们终于到了。我原以为自己会兴奋，可此刻心里只有恐惧。害怕疼痛，害怕失败后会发生什么。但我最害怕的，是失去你们中的任何一个。所以紧跟彼此，互相照应，千万小心。”
“We’re finally here. I thought I’d be excited but instead all I can feel is fear. Fear of pain, of what happens if we fail. But what I fear most is the thought of losing one of you. So stick together, look out for each other, and be careful.”

那只蛛形怪物将其庞大而狰狞的身躯藏在阴影里，长腿收拢，竟带着几分羞怯的姿态。随即，它在螯肢的喀嗒嘶鸣中骤然舒展——骇人的巨影彻底显露：多节长腿粗如幼树，覆满粗硬毛刺，一节节展开，托起那具甲壳般的负载。深暗的眼簇幽光闪烁，贪婪游移，搜寻猎物。它迈步时如断续雷鸣般的重击回荡，却以与其体型全然不符的惊人速度逼近，令人毛骨悚然。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

The arachnid conceals its massive, monstrous form in the shadows, legs tucked in almost coyly. It unfurls with a chittering hiss of its mandibles—revealing its staggering immensity—multi-jointed legs the width of tree saplings bristling with coarse hair, unfolding and lifting its chitinous bulk. A dark cluster of eyes gleam, roving hungrily for prey. Its legs beat a staccato thunder as it moves with an unnerving speed that belies its size.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

你捕捉到一缕花香似的香水气息——也许是薰衣草——转身望去，只见一名头发梳得一丝不苟的男人阔步走入视野：身穿鲜艳紧身裤、宽松衬衫，外披同样夺目的斗篷。他挟着一只巨大的鎏金卷轴筒，连同那夸张到溢出的自命不凡一并带来。他对卷轴的骄矜，似乎也只有对那丛密而华美的八字胡的自恋能与之匹敌。
You catch the scent of a floral perfume—lavender, perhaps—and turn to see a neatly coifed man stride into view in bright tights, a loose shirt, and a similarly colorful cape. He carries a large gilt scroll tube and an outsized sense of self-importance. His pride in carrying the scroll only seems rivaled by his vanity over his luxuriant mustache.

Fake Philter Of Love.name:
赝品爱情迷药
Fake Philter Of Love

Text.text:
这只精致的玻璃小瓶里盛着一剂玫瑰粉的药水，欢快地冒着细密气泡，仿佛被轻飘飘的魅惑点燃。你拔下心形瓶塞，将玫瑰色的蒸汽在鼻下轻轻一拂，心里绷紧弦，提防它的魔法诱惑。奇怪的是，这药水闻起来竟很像发酵过的葡萄。酒精自有其迷人之处——但没有一样真正算得上魔法。
The pretty glass bottle contains a rose-pink potion, effervescing with giddy enchantment. You pull out the heart-shaped stopper and waft the rosy vapor under your nose, mentally bracing yourself against its magical allure. Strangely, the potion smells very much like fermented grapes. Alcohol has its charms, none of them particularly magical.

I Lockpick A Locked Door.name:
我撬开一扇上锁的门
I Lockpick A Locked Door

Text.text:
门把上看不见锁，也没有在它上方或下方留下任何钥匙孔。确实棘手。门把固定在一块雕饰繁复的金色底板上，上面或铸或嵌着许多小人像，其中一个是一名牵着狗散步的男人。那男人的右腿在膝盖处用一枚细小的钉子作铰链。我把指尖贴上他的鞋尖，将那条腿径直抬起。底下露出一个微小而朴素的钥匙孔。我把工具探进去不过几秒，便听见一声清脆的咔嗒，门把随即顺滑地转动起来。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The doorknob has no visible lock, no keyhole above or below it. A challenge, certainly. The doorknob is mounted on an elaborately decorative gold plate. Figures are either molded or attached to it, one of which is a man walking his dog. The man’s right leg hinges on a tiny nail at the knee. I put my finger to the shoe and lift the leg straight. Beneath it is a tiny, simple keyhole. Seconds after I apply my tools there is a sharp clack, and the knob turns smoothly.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Goodberry, Pocketed For Future Use.name:
神莓果，收进口袋以备后用
Goodberry, Pocketed For Future Use

Text.text:
你指间的槲寄生倏然消失。你张开手掌，浆果如同五彩的伞菌般在掌心簇簇冒出。每一颗都像清晨露水的新鲜一滴。它们散发着明亮甘甜的香气，恰似一块蜜渍果脯。你将它们揣入口袋，以备前路难免的凶险。
The mistletoe between your fingers vanishes. You open your hand wide and berries sprout like many-colored toadstools into your palm. Each one feels like a fresh drop of morning dew. They give off a bright, sweet scent, not unlike a piece of candied fruit. You pocket them for the inevitable dangers ahead.

The Sense Of Disharmony In The Weave.name:
编织之网中的失和感
The Sense Of Disharmony In The Weave

Text.text:
你后颈与手臂上的汗毛齐刷刷竖起。恐慌感如同幽灵般穿体而过，你的呼吸骤然一滞，胃里翻涌作呕。目之所及并无变化，但当汗毛再度竖起时，你察觉又一波将至。果然，那种感觉袭来……又退去。强大的魔法在此运作，而其中有些地方出了岔子。
The hairs on the nape of your neck and your arms stand on end. Your breath stops as a feeling of panic passes through you like a ghost, leaving you queasy. Nothing you see changes, but you sense another wave coming as your hairs stand on end again. Sure enough, the feeling comes… then goes. Powerful magic is at work here, and something about it has gone wrong.

Phlogistonic Hand Cannon.name:
燃素手炮
Phlogistonic Hand Cannon

Text.text:
这件精雕细琢的装置几乎让人看不出是一把火器：机匣与击锤上满布繁复的蚀刻金工，枪管上蜿蜒的铭文在光下闪烁。枪身上方嵌着一枚华丽的燃素玻璃泡，随着移动轻轻晃荡，泡内的翠绿色液体翻涌不息，只待扣下触发，便将弹丸推送至所欲的目标。
This beautifully wrought device hardly seems like a firearm, what with its intricately etched metalwork on the frame and hammer and the script down the barrel catching the light. The ornately set glass bubble of phlogiston riding atop the gun sloshes with green fluid, ready to propel a bullet to one’s desired target at a pulling of the trigger.

Bribing The Town Watch.name:
贿赂镇卫队
Bribing The Town Watch

Text.text:
“我们一时匆忙，或许踩过了你们的律法——对此我们深感抱歉。不过，细想之下，律法终究也只是志同道合之人之间的约定。也许我们可以另立一份自己的约定，一份能让尽职的公务仆从拿到其应得回报的约定。”
“In our haste, we may have tread on your laws—for which we are very sorry. But, when you think about it, laws are really just an agreement between like-minded people. Perhaps we could make our own agreement, one that would pay a dedicated civil servant what they deserve.”

I Cast Chaotic Heat.name:
我施放【混沌热浪】
I Cast Chaotic Heat

Text.text:
我双手来回搓擦——一下比一下更狠——再以吐息催动，使四周翻涌的狂野元素混沌愈发浓烈。就在热浪膨胀到危险得几乎失控的一刻，我猛地将双手向前一甩，放出一片猩红的火焰潮汐，席卷而出，将敌人尽数吞没。
I rub my hands together—harder and harder—using my breath to increase the amount of wild, elemental chaos surrounding me. Just when the heat becomes uncontrollably dangerous, I snap my hands forward and release a red tide of flames to consume my enemies.

即便头顶被层层林冠遮蔽，热浪依旧压得人喘不过气。吸入那潮湿的空气，甜腻的花香与林地腐殖的麝腥气交织，更让闷热的压迫感愈发沉重。光是想到要在浓密的植被间硬生生开出一条路，都令人疲惫不堪。
Even shadowed by layers of forest canopy, the heat feels oppressive. Breathing the humid air, redolent with the sweet scent of flowers and musky odor of the forest floor, intensifies the sensation. It makes even thinking about pushing your way through the thick vegetation exhausting.

Grove Of Awakened Mushrooms.name:
觉醒蘑菇林
Grove Of Awakened Mushrooms

Text.text:
你来到一片蘑菇林——蘑菇高得像地表的树梢，菌柄粗糙如树皮，宽阔的伞盖在空间里投下红、紫、绿交织的幽光——空气里满是菌类疯长的潮腥霉味。几株蘑菇被人砍倒，手法显眼地凌乱粗糙、东一斧西一斧。干这活的人似乎还把木料和斧子落在了原地——斧子是矮人式样，却更像为战斗打造，而不是伐木。你忽然听见一阵持续的咀嚼声；当你的感官全都绷紧，你又嗅到一丝铁锈般的血腥。就在一根菌柄旁，一个仿佛巨型蜈蚣的影子正扭动着，覆在一具死去的矮人身上：皮肤灰如板岩，眼睛浑白如雾。紧接着，一声喉底滚出的低沉呻吟传来，地面随之震颤——你看见有什么东西从蘑菇树干的褶皱里顶出双眼，像两只黑甲虫般闪亮。树干裂开一道嘴，异样的嗓音从喉间嘶喘着挤出。

~ 一位英雄所Envisioned

You come upon a grove of mushrooms as tall as topside trees—stalks rough like bark, wide umbrella-like caps illuminating the space in shades of red, purple and green—that fills the air with the dank smell of fungal growth. A few of them have been chopped down in a noticeably messy, haphazard fashion. Whoever did this shoddy work also seems to have left behind their lumber and their axes—axes, dwarvish in design, that seem crafted for battle not lumbering. You suddenly hear a persistent munching sound and, as the rest of your senses perk up, you also smell a hint of iron. Next to one of the mushroom stalks, the silhouette of what looks like a massive centipede writhes over the body of a dead dwarf: skin gray as slate, eyes cloud-white. Then you hear a guttural groan as the ground shakes, and see eyes push out from the wrinkles of the mushroom's trunk, shining like two black beetles. A mouth splits open and an alien voice wheezes out of its throat.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Blind Mage's Quip After Casting Blindsig.name:
施展盲视后，盲法师的俏皮话
Blind Mage's Quip After Casting Blindsight

Text.text:
“哦，你们失去视力后竟如此绝望地哀嚎，仿佛被投入虚空的黑暗之中。但无光的世界并非黑暗。只是你们缺乏直面它的坚韧。”

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

“Oh, how you all wail in despair without your sight, as if you’ve been plunged into the darkness of the void. But the world without sight is not darkness. You simply lack the fortitude to see it.”

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

High Elf Corpse.name:
高等精灵的尸体
High Elf Corpse

Text.text:
纵然死去仍是优雅与风姿的极致，那名高等精灵的遗体仿佛正被庄严停放。然而，一缕细细的血从他们嘴角渗出，像画作上的瑕疵般玷污了那张面容。
The epitome of elegance and grace even in death, the high elf’s body lies as if in state. However, a single trickle of blood escapes one corner of their mouth, marring their visage like a blemish on a painting.

Alchemical Vial Of True Earth.name:
真土炼金瓶
Alchemical Vial Of True Earth

Text.text:
一只矮短的小瓶因大地震颤的力量而微微战栗。瓶中各色岩石彼此碰撞，迸裂成繁复的晶簇，又在每一次新的冲击下再度粉碎。瓶底——生与灭同步更迭——不断涌生出各式苔藓与花朵。
A short vial shudders with the power of quivering earth. Within, various colored rocks clash against each other, bursting into complex crystals that shatter again with each new impact. At the base of the vial—growing and dying in tandem—spring forth a variety of mosses and flowers.

Seeing Through A Devil's Disguise.name:
看穿恶魔的伪装
Seeing Through A Devil's Disguise

Text.text:
那位俊美的黑发男子、他明朗动人的笑容与贵族般华丽的衣饰都如蜡般消融。取而代之的，是一具漂浮在空中的类人形体：灰烬般的皮肤覆满全身，片片龟裂卷起；碎屑剥落，随颤动的空气漂散。他那完美的下巴与笑意仍在，却露出一口漆黑的牙。原本该是鼻梁、双眼与眉骨的位置，头颅向内凹折，形成一道椭圆的空洞，空洞里燃着一顶火焰之冠。两支犄角自那无毛、无耳的头顶蜿蜒而出，向上弯起。黑羽之翼如袍般裹住他的髋与腿；每一翼在关节弯折处，都嵌着一只无眼睑的蛇瞳。

~ 构想：Bangalulu

The handsome, dark-haired man, his winning and bright-eyed smile, and his noble finery melt away. In his place floats a humanoid covered with ashen skin, cracked and curling in patches. Bits peel off and float away on wavering air. His perfect chin and smile remain, but his teeth are black. Where his nose, eyes, and brow should be, his head bends inward, creating an oval hollow where burns a crown of fire. Two horns curve out and up from his hairless, earless head. Wings, feathered in black, wrap around his hips and legs like a robe. Each wing has a lidless ophidian eye at its bend.

~ Envisioned by Bangalulu

这位神祇是他那些地精的放大版：斑驳的青绿色皮肤，身上散着沼泽的湿腐气与尿臊味。他只围着一条兜裆布，扛着一柄巨斧——那斧头看起来与他等高等重，仿佛也是他的同类。

这位地精神要求定期献祭。他最爱得知鲜血——无论是人类、兽人，当然也包括精灵或矮人，或是其他那些能被地精成群结队围猎并乱棍打死的怪物——会把他的祭坛染得斑斑驳驳。地精诸部族之间不管有什么松散的组织，都能让他略感满意，但也仅止于它们能为他供给驯服的屠夫：让更多尸体在以他之名落下的斧刃之下被带走。
The god is a larger version of his goblins, patchy green and smelling of bog and urine. He wears a loincloth and carries an axe which appears to be his equal in height and weight. The goblinoid god demands regular sacrifices. He loves to know that blood—whether of human, orc, certainly elf or dwarf, or the other monstrous beings that can be hunted and mobbed by gangs of goblins—will stain his altar. Whatever loose organization may exist among the goblin tribes impresses him, but only to the extent that they provide him with obedient killers, so that more corpses will be taken by axes striking in his name.

Blade Deals Debilitating Wound.name:
刀锋刻下致残伤口
Blade Deals Debilitating Wound

Text.text:
一道移动的残影掠过，袭击者的刀刃深深没入血肉。他们带着恶毒的拧转猛地将匕首抽出，新鲜的伤口立刻淌出一道道血流；目标重重栽倒在地，蜷起身子护住那道新裂开的伤口。
A flash of movement, and the attacker's blade sinks into flesh. They rip the knife free with a malicious twist, and rivulets of blood stream out of the fresh wound as the target crashes to the ground, curling their body around the fresh laceration.

一位年迈的侏儒佝偻着背，坐在高高的木凳上；他鹰隼般的面容与荆棘似的连鬓胡浸在工作台上那盏提灯的金光里。他透过蒙尘的眼镜端详一根浅色木杖，手里松松握着一把凿子。嘴唇紧抿、全神贯注，他一边低声嘟囔了几句，一边在杖头上细细凿削。纤巧的木屑卷曲如花，点缀在他紧绷的羊毛背心上，又在他膝头堆出一窝丰厚的絮团。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

An elderly gnome sits, back bent, on a tall wooden stool, his hawkish features and brambly mutton chops bathed in the golden light of a lantern set upon his workbench. He inspects a cane of light-colored wood through his dusted spectacles, holding a chisel loosely in his hand. Lips pursed in concentration, he grumbles a few times as he chips away at the cane’s handle. Dainty curls of wood shavings decorate his bunched woolen vest and nest abundantly in his lap.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Darmalis Elethil.name:
达玛利斯·艾莱希尔
Darmalis Elethil

Text.text:
他有着高等精灵的精致五官，却带着谦卑的气质，几乎像仆从般的站姿。他的身高、黑发与绿眼又向贵族与粗鄙之人传递着另一层讯息——那是术士精于算计的目光。他身披蓝金相间的长袍，手持一根黑色短杖，杖顶是一只紧握的拳头，作为他的奥术法器。一本包着素色皮革的厚书始终系在他的腰间，从不离身。

~ Played by ThatOneGuy

He has the features of a highborn elf but a humble bearing, almost the posture of a servant. His height, black hair, and green eyes send another message to both noble and rough-born—the calculating gaze of a sorcerer. He wears blue and gold robes, and carries a black rod topped with a closed fist as his arcane focus. A tome covered in plain leather is strapped to his waist at all times.

~ Played by ThatOneGuy

Elven Vale: Disturbing Rumbles.name:
精灵谷：不祥的轰鸣
Elven Vale: Disturbing Rumbles

Text.text:
林间的宁静脆弱得仿佛一触即碎。猫头鹰的啼鸣曾经乖戾刺耳，如今却怯生生的，像是在担心阴影里潜伏着什么。正当一片云缓缓掠过月亮，那些阴影似乎也随之逼近，将你世界的边界收拢到包围着你的几棵树之间。
The peace of the wood feels brittle. The owl’s call, once cantankerous, now sounds timorous, as if concerned about what lurks in the shadows. Those shadows seem to draw closer as a cloud drifts across the moon, bringing the borders of your world to within the boundary of the few trees that encircle you.

Potion Of Growth.name:
成长药水
Potion Of Growth

Text.text:
巨大的气泡在这瓶药剂那泛红的内容物中不断鼓胀，彼此挤压，像一群孩子争先恐后挤在同一扇窗前探头张望。它们一再推搡，直到终于接连破裂……而后循环再度开始。
Large bubbles balloon continuously within the reddish contents of this potion, impressing upon each other like a group of children all trying to look out the same window. They push and push until eventually they all pop… and then the cycle begins anew.

Giant Venus Flytrap.name:
巨型捕蝇草
Giant Venus Flytrap

Text.text:
这株巨大的植物长着两片宽阔的绿叶。每片叶子的末端分叉成一对巨大的锯齿叶，像一张大张着、獠牙毕露的口器。每片齿叶的背面是绿色的，但正面却呈湿亮的红色，覆着一层暗色丝状物。它周围的空气里悬着甜腻的香气，你还看见它下方的土里有森森白骨刺出。
This enormous plant has two broad green leaves. Each ends in a pair of huge, serrated leaves like a gaping, fanged mouth. The underside of each toothed leaf is green, but on the upper side, each is red, wet, and covered in dark filaments. A sweet smell hangs in the air around the plant, and you spot bones jutting from the soil beneath it.

Divine Cloud Of A God Of The Wind.name:
风神的神圣云霭
Divine Cloud Of A God Of The Wind

Text.text:
在晴朗的清晨，辽阔海面之上，一团白云轻快地漂浮着。忽而空气的脾气变了，雾与蒸汽在水面上堆出一座冰冷的雷云——当它渐沉的灰暗，与阳光斑斓的色彩在蓬松洁白、如棉絮般的希望之上相遇——你便找到了四首神祇的居所。自那庞大的云体深处传来对话声，风之屋在浪涛上旋转不息，挑选着当季哪一缕带香的气息要从敞开的门里吹出，飘落下来迎接你。
Over the open ocean on a bright morning, a puff of white cloud floats happily. Then the temper of the air changes, and when the mists and steams grow a cold thunderhead over the water—when its gray darkening meets with the sun’s many colors under a fluffy white cotton of hope—you have found the home of the four-headed god. From within the massive cloud you hear a conversation, and the house of winds revolves over the waves to choose which scented breath of the season will blow from its open door and come down to greet you.

I Cast Protection From Poison.name:
我施放“防护毒素”
I Cast Protection From Poison

Text.text:
我感觉舌头上、牙缝间有粗粝如砂的颗粒。我把双手按在我的目标身上，在他们身上留下黑色、闪烁的掌印。我的魔法让掌印褪成云雾，将那粉末般的物质携过他们的全身，在他们的喉咙、额头与腹部拂落黑色的条痕。
I feel coarse, sand-like granules on my tongue and between my teeth. I place my hands on my target, leaving black, glittering handprints upon them. My magic fades the prints into clouds and carries the powdery substance across their body, dusting their throat, forehead, and stomach with black streaks.

Warrior Hiding In Foliage.name:
潜伏在枝叶间的战士
Warrior Hiding In Foliage

Text.text:
战士赤褐色的胡须间露出森白的牙，长矛蓄势待发，双腿弯曲，压成低伏的蹲姿。他已准备好一旦敌人现身，便从藏身处猛然跃出。  

他把身体更贴近那排植物，近旁棕榈的叶簇轻拂着他头盔的后缘，也扫过他那面硕大的圆盾面。盾牌涂成猩红，其上盘旋着黄色的旋纹，像是某种符文或徽记。
The warrior’s teeth are bared within his auburn beard, his spear poised at the ready and legs bent into a low squat. He is prepared to spring out of his hiding place as soon as the enemy appears. He tucks himself closer to the row of plants, the fronds of nearby palms brushing the back of his helmet and the face of his large round buckler. The shield is painted red with a swirling pattern of yellow, indicating some rune or crest.

龟裂的泥土铺展开来，连绵成一片辽阔而平坦的荒原。野兽的足迹与你自己的脚印不时踏破这层硬壳，露出下方黏稠的泥浆。零星的低洼处仍蓄着些许水，几尾鱼在湖泊消失的余波中挣扎求生；而长腿水鸟在水潭边踱步潜行，盯着这些浅池里唾手可得的猎物。
Acres of cracked dirt spread out in a vast flat plain. The trails of animals and your own footsteps occasionally break through this crust to the layer of mud beneath. Here and there a low spot still holds enough water for fish to try to survive the disappearance of the lake, but long-legged birds stalk the pools looking for easy meals.

Sundries From A Water Elemental.name:
水元素杂货
Sundries From A Water Elemental

Text.text:
伴随着一声尖啸，元素体在一团海雾般的水花中轰然爆裂。透过被盐霜糊住的双眼，你在它身后看见了异样之物：一粒晶莹剔透的水滴在半空中翩然起舞，被无形的水流托举悬浮。
With a shriek, the elemental bursts apart in a cloud of sea spray. Through salt-rimed eyes you make out something strange in its wake: a mote of crystal-clear water dances in mid-air, held aloft by unseen currents.

这是沙漠的鲁特琴：圆润而更深的木质共鸣箱，像巨鸟的卵一般，以不同清漆刷出层层条纹。它在一条修长、无品的琴颈上绷着四根弦，以沉香树那种浅色、纹理粗粝的木材制成。琴身正面平坦处的几只小音孔罩，如精工细作的蓝银花丝镂空，繁丽夺目。
This is the lute of the desert, with a deeper round wooden body like the egg of a giant bird, striped in different varnishes. It has four strings on a long and fretless neck, and is made of a pale, grainy wood from the agar tree. The small cages on the flat front of its body are elaborately decorated filigrees of blue and silver.

Drow With Dagger.name:
持匕首的卓尔
Drow With Dagger

Text.text:
卓尔漫不经心地踱步，几乎带着愉悦，仿佛仅仅把刀从鞘中救出这一简单动作就足以安抚她——她大概还有更多兵刃，但这把此刻握在手里。她的握持稳妥而从容，无论她如何站立、如何转动手臂，刀锋都像是天生就停在攻击姿态。当她微笑时，牙齿的冷光与她发丝的灿辉同样耀眼。
The drow moves casually, almost happily, as if comforted by the simple act of rescuing a blade from its sheath—she likely has more, but this one is in her hand.  Her grip is sure and easy, the blade somehow always in attack position no matter how she stands or turns an arm. When she smiles, her teeth match the brilliance of her hair.

Space Pirate Den In Passing Comet.name:
穿行彗星上的空间海盗巢穴
Space Pirate Den In Passing Comet

Text.text:
在冰隧道的幽深处，一座体型如城镇般的巨窟里，四处劫掠的海盗派系——那座容纳千魂的巢穴——蜷伏在各自的船上歇息。那艘逐日者已行至谢幕之歌的第二个世纪，身后拖曳着百万公里长的银尘尾羽，呼啸掠过一颗卫星，瞬间点燃警报。海盗舰艇低鸣不息，或与燃料泊位相连，或在停机坪上对准海湾；海湾上方，一串红灯的计时器正一格格倒数。
Down deep in the ice tunnel, in a cave the size of a town, the thousand-soul den of a marauding pirate faction bunks down in their ships. Two centuries into its swan song, trailing a million-kilometer plume of silver dust, the sungrazer whips past a satellite, lighting up the alarms. The pirate vessels sit humming, linked to fuel docks or aimed on the tarmac toward the bay, over which a timer of red lights counts down.

I Use Arcane Recovery.name:
我使用奥术回返
I Use Arcane Recovery

Text.text:
在我休息时，我翻阅我的法术秘典，温习记忆，思量自己可能需要哪些魔法。分析眼前的局势令我心潮澎湃。那一页页神秘符号与奥术字迹仿佛注入灵魂的火种，令我的精神为之一振。当我权衡诸多选择时，体内的能量随之攀升，使我得以夺回一部分已消耗的力量。
While I rest, I page through my tome of spells to refresh my memory and decide which magic I might need. Analyzing the situation excites me. The pages of mystical symbols and arcane writing invigorate my spirit. As I consider my options, my energy rises, allowing me to reclaim a portion of my spent power.

Beastman Wielding Sabers.name:
挥舞军刀的兽人
Beastman Wielding Sabers

Text.text:
兽人长着公牛般的头颅，额上生着公羊的弯角，颌下垂着人类的胡须。毛发纠结的胸膛上有两处伤疤，却仍保持着敏捷老练的架势。他身披一条用带子束起的简陋布衣，前臂绑着护臂，交叉握着两把修长的弯刀，透过闪烁如蛋白石般的眼眸直视前方。
The beastman has the head of a bull with a ram’s horns and a man’s beard. His chest, matted with hair, is scarred in two places, but he maintains an agile, expert stance. Wearing a simple belted cloth and strapped vambraces, he crosses his two long sabers and stares ahead through eyes of gleaming opal.

Sleek, Armored Limousine.name:
流线型装甲豪华轿车
Sleek, Armored Limousine

Text.text:
哑光黑的加长豪华轿车架得离街面很高，粗大、深纹的轮胎托着它沉稳前行。车窗贴着深色膜，黑曜石般浓黑不透，视线根本无从穿透。整辆车唯一跳出的色彩，是那对冷冽的蓝色前灯，细长如一双因决意而眯起的眼睛。
The matte-black limousine rises high off the streets on large, thick-treaded wheels. The windows are tinted to visually impenetrable obsidian. The only divergence in color on the vehicle are the cool blue headlights, thin like eyes narrowed in determination.

Portal To The Elemental Plane Of Earth.name:
通往土元素位面的传送门
Portal To The Elemental Plane Of Earth

Text.text:
你穿过一道由岩石自然形成的门——既是拱门，也是高耸沙丘之间的谷口，亦如石环，又似洞窟，诸般形貌合而为一。未受训练的眼睛只会觉得岩石与巨石死寂不动，但你踏入门内，便进入了另一个位面。
You proceed through a natural gate of rock—an archway, a valley between high dunes, a stone circle, a cave, all in one. To the untrained eye, the rock and stone seem immobile, dead, but you pass through the gate to another plane.

Tasha's Hideous Laughter.name:
塔莎的狂笑术
Tasha's Hideous Laughter

Text.text:
你感觉一抹笑意悄然爬上自己的唇角，掌心托着这团混沌震颤的法术，将它牢牢束住，瞄准之时不让其逸散。你把它掷向你的目标，它破空飞掠的瞬间，一阵高亢而妩媚的笑声回荡开来——那嗓音自信满满，恶意昭然。
You feel a smile creeping across your own lips as you hold this chaotic, vibrating spell, containing it as you aim. You throw it at your target, and a high, feminine laugh resounds as it soars—the voice full of confidence and malefic intent.

Goddess Of Love.name:
爱之女神
Goddess Of Love

Text.text:
万般爱意穿流于她的赤发之间，所有对美与欲望的品味自她眼中熠熠生辉；然而，她并非情欲女神。孩子与宠物的爱；生命、和平与胜利的爱；对永恒与短暂的爱——每一种都在她衣袍的褶皱里鲜活涌动，倾泻向大地，又在风的罗曼里鼓胀翻涌。她的微笑驱散仇恨，她的手轻触肌肤，便将心碎化作倾慕。
Every type of love flows through their red hair, and all tastes in beauty and desire shine from their eyes; however, this is not the goddess of sex. The love of children and pets; the love of life and peace and victory; the love of both the eternal and the temporal—each is alive in the folds of their gown, flowing to the earth and billowing in the romance of the winds. Her smile banishes hate, and her hand on the skin changes heartbreak to adoration.

I Ignite My Flame Tongue Shortsword.name:
我点燃焰舌短剑
I Ignite My Flame Tongue Shortsword

Text.text:
我一边踏步前冲一边喝令出声，短刃横向一挥，划出一道平斩。刀锋破空逼向敌人之际，金属骤然鼓起般炽红发亮。我收刃回身，再度凶狠斩下，刃上的热浪节节攀升，直至狂野的橙色火舌缠绕其上——噼啪欲灭又复燃的火焰花环，将空气中的点点湿意尽数蒸成白汽。
I leap forward as I speak the command, slicing my short blade in a horizontal slash. As it cuts through the air toward my foe, the metal blisters to a searing red color. I bring back my blade for another fierce cut, the heat of the blade surging until wild whips of orange flame wreath the blade—a guttering garland that turns motes of moisture in the air to steam.

Belt Of Dwarvenkind.name:
矮人族腰带
Belt Of Dwarvenkind

Text.text:
有人打造了这条宽阔的钢制护腰带，宛如护甲般厚重；其上以浮雕与蚀刻勾勒出一幕令人屏息的矮人工业盛景。两枚巨大的头像之间——或许象征着矮人神祇——点缀着更细小的图像：矮人们在熔炉前挥汗锻打，在矿坑里掘进，在铸造厂中忙碌穿梭。可尽管工艺如此讲究，你仍挥之不去地觉得，打造这条腰带的人，恐怕并非真正的矮人。
Someone has crafted this broad girdle of armor-like steel with embossing and etching to create a stunning scene of dwarven industry. Between two great heads, perhaps meant to be dwarf gods, there are smaller images of dwarves toiling at forges, in a mine, and at a foundry. Despite its design, you can’t shake the impression that the person who made this belt was not actually a dwarf.

在茂密的树丛深处，你与一座黏土色血肉筑成的堡垒迎面相撞——一头庞大、臃肿的生物，从扁平的吻端到尾巴末端那沉重的槌状尖梢，全身披覆着甲胄。它圆滚滚的身躯压着一片片骨板，沉得仿佛几乎要拖擦着地面；这头野兽用短粗的腿蹒跚挪动。它像是某种被放大过头的犰狳，怪异地可爱，哪怕它的体型足足是任何马匹的四倍。你与它皱褶间那安宁的眼睛对视，余光却紧盯着它那如钟摆般来回甩动的尾巴。
In the dense copse of trees, you come face-to-face with a fortress of clay-colored flesh—a massive, bloated creature armored from its flattened snout to the bludgeoning tip of its tail. Its rotund body is heavy with bony plates and seems to almost drag across the ground as the beast waddles about on its stubby legs. Like some overgrown armadillo, it’s oddly cute, even as it stands four times the size of any horse.
