You lock gazes with its wrinkled, peaceful eyes, leaving your peripherals to track the swishing of its pendulum tail.

巨龙的鳞片闪耀着新鲜苔藓般的翠绿光泽——却也布满战斗的伤痕与数百年迫害留下的印记。冰冷的爬行类眼眸以令人不安的智慧凝视着你，生物缓缓挺身至全高，将足有一尺长的利爪咔哒相击，像个守财奴在清点钱币。腐败肉腥的恶臭缠绕在锃亮的獠牙间，自它张开的巨口里飘散而出；它开口时，声音如雷霆滚过。
The dragon’s scales are the lustrous veridian of fresh moss—though they bear the scars of battle and centuries of persecution. Cold reptilian eyes regard you with unnerving intelligence as the creature draws itself to full height, clicking foot-long claws together like a miser counting coins. The rancid stench of meat lingers between gleaming fangs, drifting out from their maw as they address you in a voice like thunder.

Rock-strewn Hillside.name:
碎石遍布的山坡
Rock-strewn Hillside

Text.text:
山坡陡峭起伏，遍地散落着大大小小的岩石。你不禁想，这些石头里是否有一部分来自西北方阴影笼罩的那座倾塌高塔。那座塔曾经真能高到那般地步，又会倒塌得如此之远吗？
The hill is steep, rolling, and strewn with rocks large and small. You wonder if any of these stones originated from the toppled tower, shadowed to the northwest. Could the tower have stood that tall, and toppled that far?

Sundries From A Necromancer's Blighted W.name:
死灵法师的疫化幼龙杂物
Sundries From A Necromancer's Blighted Wyrmlings

Text.text:
幼龙蜷作一堆堆倒在你面前，宛如恶毒巢母那腐败孵育出的幼虫正在枯萎。它们其中一只的血口里，一截被割断的皮革带子——也许是某个不幸冒险者的弹带或腰带——卡在针一般的獠牙间。另一只则有一把锈蚀的长剑楔在两根裸露的肋骨之间。
The wyrmlings lie in curled piles before you, like the withering larvae of a foul broodmother. Within one of their maws, a shorn strap of leather—perhaps a bandolier or belt of some unfortunate adventurer—is stuck between their needlelike fangs. Another has a rusted sword wedged between two exposed ribs.

Disembodied Feet Of A Colossal Statue.name:
巨像雕像的离体双足
Disembodied Feet Of A Colossal Statue

Text.text:
从石像那对在脚踝处断裂、双腿彻底失落的脚掌体型来判断，完整的雕像当年必定庞然如山，堪称巨神。脚上雕着一种古老式样的凉鞋，想必正是昔日沉醉于这座竞技场游戏的人们所偏爱的风格；鞋与脚掌大体仍然完好，连一根根脚趾都依旧清晰可辨。
Judging from the size of the stone figure’s feet, broken off at the ankle—legs completely missing—the intact statue must have been titanic indeed. The feet, depicted in an ancient style of sandal probably favored by the people who once enjoyed the games in this arena, are mostly intact, the individual toes still quite discernible.

Barrow Of A Half-orc.name:
半兽人之冢
Barrow Of A Half-orc

Text.text:
粗壮的立石沿着巨大古冢的周缘环列，深深沉入覆在墓顶的土层之中。萨满式的护符装点其上，骨片轻轻碰撞着被天气侵蚀的岩面，仿佛在向前来致敬的人低声招呼。入口两侧矗立着两座巨大的火盆，墓道门楣上刻着醒目的浮雕：长牙的战士在战阵人潮中厮杀冲锋。
Robust standing stones mark the circumference of the large barrow, sunk deep into the earth atop the tomb. Shamanistic fetishes decorate the stones, the bones clattering gently against the weather-worn rock as if greeting those coming to pay their respects. Flanked by two large braziers, the barrow entryway is decorated in striking carvings of tusked warriors in the throng of battle.

Beautiful Steel Buckle.name:
美丽的钢制扣环
Beautiful Steel Buckle

Text.text:
一名游荡者的皮带扣，被发蓝处理并做成哑光，以保护它——也抹去任何光泽。扣框边缘锋利，用这枚皮带扣甩动皮带时，能成为一次相当不错的临时攻击。
The buckle of a rogue, it has been blued and matted to protect it—and take away any shine. The frame is sharp-edged, so swinging a belt with this buckle could make a fine improvised attack.

Baba Yaga's Hut.name:
芭芭-雅嘎的小屋
Baba Yaga's Hut

Text.text:
在故乡一个阳光明媚的日子里，这片空地会像仙灵的林间空谷，而那座小屋也只配引人发笑与打趣：“它竟然长着鸡腿，神祇在上！”可它留下的足迹，却像某种遗落在失落时代里的巨型生物所踏。今日天色阴沉，却并非因恐惧，而是因揣测——这是一场社交的聚会，众人满怀好奇，探问屋内那位睿智而善变的老妇人所背负的怪异传说。

~ Envisioned by Beer Gnome

On a sunlit day back home, this clearing would be like a fairy glade, and the hut a thing for laughter and jest: "It stands on chicken legs, by the gods!" But its tracks are like those of a gargantuan creature out of lost time. Today is overcast, not with dread but with speculation, on a social occasion filled with curiosity about the strange legends of the wise and mercurial old woman within.

~ Envisioned by Beer Gnome

那只幼年地精皮肤带着红润的青绿，耳朵如蝙蝠般外张，踉踉跄跄地站起身，随即又跌倒在地——硕大的脑袋沉重得将它拖向尘土。紧接着是一声刺耳的尖啼，可怜的小东西那圆鼓鼓的鼻子里涌出一串黏稠的鼻涕。
The infant goblin, with ruddy green skin and batlike ears, stands shakily, then falls, the weight of their large head carrying them to the ground. A shrill cry follows, and mucus pours from the poor thing’s bulbous nose.

Aggressive Thri-kreen.name:
好斗的斯里克林
Aggressive Thri-kreen

Text.text:
当你逼近时，薄纱般的翅翼愤怒地嗡鸣，那生物几丁质的颚钳饥渴地咔哒作响。它苍白的绿色外骨骼上夹杂着一簇簇红色纤维组织，覆住那具四臂的昆虫躯干，诡异得令人心底发寒。赤红的复眼死死盯着你，翻涌着贪婪到刺骨的饥饿。
Gossamer wings buzz angrily as you approach, the creature’s chitinous mandibles clicking hungrily. A pallid green exoskeleton—interrupted by pockets of red fibrous tissue—covers its four-armed insectoid frame in an unsettling combination. Red compound eyes regard you with a ravenous, spine-chilling hunger.

Minotaur Skeleton Encounter.name:
骷髅（特征）牛头怪遭遇
Minotaur Skeleton Encounter

Text.text:
与其被打造所用的牛头怪躯体一样高大强悍，这具长角的骷髅（特征）轻松挥舞着一柄巨大的巨斧，带着凶狠的意图逼近。它是在低下犄角准备冲锋，还是你的错觉？几乎就在你刚生出这个疑问的同时，它已以惊人的速度发起冲刺，直取你要害，意图将你顶穿……
As large and powerful as the minotaur body from which it was fashioned, the horned skeleton brandishes an enormous greataxe with ease and approaches with menacing purpose. Is it lowering its horns to charge you, or is that your imagination? In as little time as it takes to formulate this question, it is charging with surprising speed, looking to gore you…

Wide And Lazy River.name:
宽阔而慵懒的河流
Wide And Lazy River

Text.text:
河水的流速温柔得几乎是在抚摸岸边，你不由得心痒，想下去泡一泡，好洗去些旅途的尘土。可有一件事你绝不会起念——渡到对岸去；这条河实在太宽，宽到连彼岸的细节都难以辨清。要不是终点有人在等你，这里倒是个好地方：抛下钓线，枕着水声打个盹，等鱼咬钩。也许下辈子吧。
The current of the river is so gentle that you are tempted to take a dip to remove some of the dust of the road. One thing you are not tempted to do, however, is to make for the far shore, as the river is so wide that it is difficult to make out its details. If you weren’t expected at your destination, this would be a nice place to sink a line and nap, hoping for a bite. Maybe in the next life.

一团肌肉虬结、披着蓬乱白毛的巨影懒洋洋地卧在上方峭壁的一线岩沿上。山羊漫不经心地咀嚼着什么，长角的头颅扫视着整个区域。忽然一声响动让它耳尖一颤，它立刻沿着山壁疾窜而去。
A muscled mass of shaggy white hair lounges on a sliver of a cliffside above. The goat chews something idly, its horned head scanning the area. A sudden noise makes its ears twitch, and it scampers away along the face of the mountain.

I Throw My Obsidian Steed Figurine Of Wo.name:
我掷出我的“奇妙力量：黑曜石战马”雕像
I Throw My Obsidian Steed Figurine Of Wondrous Power

Text.text:
火舌翻旋、汇聚，随那小雕像一触地，便轰然咆哮着卷成一股炼狱般的烈焰漩涡。一匹冒着烟、煤黑如炭的骏马自那火焰螺旋中疾驰而出，颈项与四肢同样缠绕着地狱般的火光。它有着马一般的面孔——可它的口吻末端却是尖锐凌乱的黑曜石獠牙，仿佛鲨鱼那种粗陋狰狞的笑。
Tongues of fire spin, combine, then roar into a hellish vortex as soon as the figurine hits the ground. A smoking, coal-black steed gallops out from the flaming spiral, neck and legs adorned in the same hellish blaze. It has a horselike face—though its snout ends in sharp, messy obsidian teeth akin to the ramshackle smile of a shark.

Harbinger Of A Season's End.name:
季末的先兆
Harbinger Of A Season's End

Text.text:
这把剑由世上最后一头独角兽的角锻造而成。剑刃宛如一束螺旋编成的长辫——顶端是锐利的穿刺尖——向下渐渐展宽，直至护手处。乌利斯瑞尔骄傲地刨着地面，罗德里克握着她昔日的饰物，姿态如同他终将成为的那名战士。
The sword is forged from the horn of the last living unicorn. Its blade resembles a spiraling braid—piercing tip at its top—which broadens at the hilt. Ulysriel paws the ground proudly as Rodric holds her former accessory like the warrior he will one day become.

The Spare Cufflink.name:
备用袖扣
The Spare Cufflink

Text.text:
透过这间两层裁缝铺高挑的拱形窗，你能看见两架金木纺车正不停旋转。屋外陈列着一件旅行斗篷与一套皮质护甲，皆以优雅的风格精心裁制。走进店内，你能听见阁楼上传来的纺轮嗡鸣，忙碌的节奏被那位裁缝大师无畏而轻快的脚跟一下下踩得更紧。他是一名精灵男子，古铜色肌肤、金色眼眸，身形修长。冷淡疏离的阴沉表情像是钉在脸上，可他始终沉浸在手头活计里：检视布料、在衣物上缝扣、操持纺车与织机。裁缝的学徒们从楼上走下，笑得合不拢嘴，穿行在装扮得惊艳的模特之间，朝潜在顾客迎去。你还看见小精灵在空中哼着轻快的旋律掠过，捎带着线轴、针垫，以及一块块布料样品。
Two goldenwood spinning wheels can be seen through the tall, arched windows of this two-story tailor shop. Outside, a traveling cloak and a set of leather armor is on display, both crafted in an elegant style. Within the shop, you can hear the wheels spinning up in the loft, kept busy by the intrepid, bouncing heel of the master tailor. He is an elven man with bronze skin, golden eyes, and slender frame. A standoffish grimace is plastered to his face, and he remains absorbed in his work inspecting fabrics, sewing buttons on garments, and working the wheels and loom. The tailor’s apprentices descend down into the main display area, smiling from ear to ear as they navigate through the stunningly dressed dummies toward potential customers. You see pixies humming through the air, carrying spindles of thread, pin cushions, and squares of fabric samples.

Tree Climb To Cave.name:
攀树入洞
Tree Climb To Cave

Text.text:
这座孤绝的洞窟四面皆不可达，唯有一处例外：洞口前那道狭窄的岩沿。那片泥泞的平台勉强容得下一人立足，遍地都是从头顶垂挂的树上飘落、已然腐烂的枯叶。你打量着那棵巨树饱经风霜的粗大树干，判断攀上去再抵达洞口会很艰难——但并非不可能。
The isolated cavern is inaccessible from all sides except one: the narrow ledge before the cave mouth. Barely large enough for one person, the muddy plateau is littered with rotting leaves fallen from the tree hanging over it. Assessing the huge, weathered trunk of the tree, you discern that it would be a difficult climb to the cave—but not an impossible one.

一阵沙沙的低语钻入你的耳中。气温骤降，你只觉后颈寒毛倒竖。有东西正在逼近。你迅速扫视四周，终于看见了它：一个人形大小的轮廓，几乎与背景融为一体，勉强才辨得出来。你不敢相信自己的眼睛，死死盯住视线中的那一点。可不——什么都没有。就在这时，你感到身后有个存在。
A susurrus whisper reaches your ears. The temperature plummets, and you feel the hairs on your neck rise. Something is coming. You scan your surroundings and see it: a human-sized shape just barely distinguishable from the background. Unsure of the evidence of your eyes, you fix the spot in your vision. But no, it’s nothing. And that’s when you feel a presence behind you.

I Cast Contingency.name:
我施放「应急预案」
I Cast Contingency

Text.text: 与魔法的对话，是对着一尊昂贵的小雕像，用奥术语言低声交谈来完成的。我亲手雕出的那张脸冷冷回望着我，毫无表情。我同时施放了两道法术。其一，施在“我”的圣像上，内容是：“等待。当我所描述的触发被引发时，就施放这个。”雕像会明白，预留的法术会在恰当的时代释放，这场令人筋疲力尽的对话也将因此值得。 The conversation with magic is held by talking in arcane language to a pricey little statue. My own carved face stares back at me impassively. I cast two spells at once. One, cast on the icon of me, is: “Wait. When the trigger I describe is tripped, then cast this.” The statue will know, the reserved spell will be cast at the right time, and this exhausting conversation will be worth it.

Cybernetic Arm Augmentation +1.name:
义体手臂强化 +1
Cybernetic Arm Augmentation +1

Text.text:
食指与拇指已被移除，原处嵌着银色结节。肱二头肌一大片组织被植入了一只细薄的金属筒仓，内盛暗灰色腻子。使用者一声令下，气体将腻子从筒仓中挤出，送入血液。那腻子——一股由微观纳米机器人构成的细流——沿着手臂奔涌而下，灌入被移除的指节空位。食指与拇指化作一场暗色液体的风暴，在指端翻卷重塑，变成与当下情境相匹配的、不可能的形态。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The index finger and thumb have been removed, and silver nodules lie in their place. A broad swatch of bicep tissue has been implanted with a thin metal silo containing a dark gray putty. At a command from the user, gas pushes the putty out of the silo and into the bloodstream. The putty—a stream of microscopic nanobots—pours down the arm and into the removed digits. The index finger and thumb become a tempest of dark liquid, re-forming into impossible shapes designed for the situation at hand.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Vial Of Sparkling Water From An Enchante.name:
取自受魔法祝福的妖精河流的起泡水小瓶
Vial Of Sparkling Water From An Enchanted Faerie River

Text.text:
这只水晶小瓶被雕琢成一株纤细而优雅的树形，瓶中盛着澄澈发亮的液体，在恰到好处的光线下仿佛点点闪烁。小瓶接触之下冰冷刺骨，内里的液体似乎带着某种冰川般的寒冽质感。一缕清冽洁净的气息自瓶口袅袅升起。
The crystalline vial, shaped to evoke a thin, graceful tree, contains within it a clear, gleaming liquid that seems to sparkle in the right light. The vial is cold to the touch, the liquid within seeming to possess some sort of glacial quality. A crisp, clean smell rises from the vial.

Seeker The Warforged Wizard.name:
追寻者：战铸巫师
Seeker The Warforged Wizard

Text.text:
一个瘦削而高挑的身影大步走来，奥术斗篷在他身周翻卷。皮肤如斑驳木纹，刻满无数奥秘符文。某些地方，仿佛石头取代了躯体的一部分——一只脚、一枚无名指——每次动作都像卵石般咔嗒作响。关节本该所在之处，是起伏流淌的液态金属，赋予他近乎极致的灵活。那身影倚着法杖，银光覆面，工艺之精湛一眼可见。他的眼睛发着光，更像远古宝石而非任何有机之物，色泽不断游移变换。他停下摆弄背包，包里塞满各式各样的小玩意与珍宝，其中还有一本沉重的魔法书，用锁链系在他身上。背包顶端探出一颗小小的煤灰色脑袋——一只翼猫——眨着黄眼，打个哈欠当作问候。

~ 由 Kbobster Played 并使用

A lean, tall figure strides forth, his arcane cloak swirling about him. His skin is alike to mottled wood, etched with countless arcane symbols. At places, it seems stones have replaced body parts—a foot, a ring finger—clacking like pebbles with every motion. Liquid metal undulates where the joints should be, providing maximum mobility. The figure leans on his staff, silvered with obvious craftsmanship. His eyes glow more alike to ancient gemstones than any organic material, oscillating in color. He pauses to fiddle with his backpack, laden with all manner of trinkets and treasures, including a heavy grimoire attached to his person with a chain. A small sooty head peeks out the top of the pack—a tressym—winking its yellow eyes and yawning hello.

~ Played by Kbobster with

Insult By A Wizard About Polymorphing A.name:
巫师对敌人变形术的恶毒嘲讽
Insult By A Wizard About Polymorphing A Foe

Text.text:
“我还没决定你适合变成什么模样。老鼠？蠕虫？随你怎么说那些害虫——至少它们对这个世界还有点用处。”
“I haven’t decided yet what form is suitable for you. A rat? A worm? Say what you will about those pests, at least they have some use to the world.”

这只巨大的蜥蜴状生物若不是看起来如此危险，几乎令人发笑。它的身体仿佛就是为让尾巴替那张布满利齿的巨口保持平衡而生——两条强壮的后腿如同支点。短小的前臂短得几乎连下巴都挠不到，只在颈根附近抽动着，徒劳地在空气中探寻。
This huge lizard-like creature might be comical if it didn’t look so dangerous. Its body seems to be built so that its tail provides balance for its enormous toothy maw—two powerful legs acting as a fulcrum. Tiny arms, hardly long enough to scratch its chin, twitch and quest the air near the base of its neck.

Runes In Stone.name:
石中符文
Runes In Stone

Text.text:
尽管这些符文刻在风化的岩石上，不过是某个久远年代里用某种粗陋刀刃凿出的几道笔直刻痕，它们粗糙的外观却遮不住那股自其中渗出的诡异力量。这些原始的符号或许会比当今世界的文明更为长久——正如它们曾经熬过了最初将其刻入活石之人的文明一般。
Though the runes cut into the weathered rock are but straight lines hacked with some sort of crude blade in a past age, their rough appearance cannot disguise the peculiar power they emanate. These rudimentary symbols might outlast the civilizations of the current world, just as they outlasted the civilizations whose people first carved them into the living stone.

Elmheer Mossbeard The Hill Dwarf Circle.name:
埃尔姆希尔·苔须——丘陵矮人·大地结社德鲁伊
Elmheer Mossbeard The Hill Dwarf Circle Of The Land Druid

Text.text:
这名野性十足的矮人敦实强壮，树皮般的褐发间掺着银丝，编成辫子，还缠着鲜亮的绿色植物。他倚着一根盘结粗砺的橡木杖，杖身刻满怪异符号，外裹皮革，杖顶别着一小枝冬青。身着磨得发旧的皮质护甲，腰间松松系着一条藤绳腰带，挂满草药小袋、匕首，以及一把用来收割灌木、苔藓之类的小镰刀。他行动缓慢而坚定，翠绿的眼眸里闪着含蓄的智慧。

~ 由来自 RPGBOT.net 的 Tyler 扮演

The wild-looking dwarf stands stout and strong, their bark-brown hair streaked with silver and braided with vibrant green plantlife. They lean on a gnarled staff of oak engraved with strange symbols, wrapped in leather, and topped with a sprig of holly. Garbed in well-worn leather armor, a vine rope belt laden with pouches of herbs, a knife, and a small sickle for harvesting shrubs, moss, and the like hangs loosely around the hips. They move slowly, purposefully, and their emerald eyes shine with a subdued wisdom.

~ Played by Tyler from RPGBOT.net

Loot From A Kobold.name:
来自狗头人的战利品
Loot From A Kobold

Text.text:
狗头人的脖子上挂着一枚防止定位与侦测的护符。皮革背包里还有一只袋子，袋中套着另一只袋子，最底下压着些沙子，以及一打蒺藜。
Around the kobold’s neck is an amulet against location and detection. In a leather pack is another bag, inside a bag with some sand at the bottom, and a dozen caltrops.

Minor Auditory Illusion.name:
轻微听觉幻象
Minor Auditory Illusion

Text.text:
只需一小缕羊毛与一个简单戏法，你便能造出逼真的声响，哪怕是最敏锐的耳朵也分辨不出真伪。
Requiring nothing more than a small wisp of fleece and a simple cantrip, you create a convincing sound indistinguishable from the real thing, even to keen ears.

Clockwork Mage.name:
发条机关法师
Clockwork Mage

Text.text:
嘶嘶作响的活动发条构装体以令人惊愕的流畅姿态移动。它的手臂引导着那双长指的手，以令人不安的精准演绎施法的繁复手势。它竟能在奥术技艺上如此娴熟并不该让你惊讶，因为魔法沿着每一根闪亮的导线奔流，在每一枚旋转的齿轮中熠熠生辉。
The hissing animate clockwork entity moves with startling fluidity. Its arms guide its long-fingered hands through the intricate motions of spellcasting with disquieting precision. That it should be so skilled in the arcane arts should not surprise you, as magic runs down every shining wire and gleams within every circling gear.

Natatorium To A Goddess Of Fresh Water.name:
淡水女神的室内浴场
Natatorium To A Goddess Of Fresh Water

Text.text: [外侧] 雕成睡莲叶模样的踏石一路铺开，指引通往神圣的空间。三面石墙如回廊般围拢着一汪清澈水池，只留一侧敞开，供礼拜者入内。池中传来青蛙柔和的呱鸣，蜻蜓振翅的嗡响也在里头轻轻引人。祭司们示意人们脱下鞋履，带着一小拨一小拨的人沿着浅浅的台阶下到水池里。 [内侧] 纤细的光束从彩绘玻璃窗间探入，将三面墙的深色石材切碎成斑驳的明暗。玻璃拼成杂色的纹样：蓝、绿与褐交错，其倒影铺洒在地面，让原本素净的石砖也像一片粼粼水塘般闪烁。“像蝌蚪一样轻柔。”一位女祭司含着温和的笑意说道。她扶着一位年长男子的手与臂，那人的膝盖微微发颤，脚尖小心翼翼地探入水中。这里的一切都被细致安排得安全、宁静、无害——与荒野中某些淡水河流与池沼截然不同。 [Outside] Stepping stones carved into the likeness of lily pads mark the way to the sacred space. Three stone walls cloister a clear pool of water, leaving one open side for worshippers to enter. The gentle croaking of frogs and the hum of dragonflies beckon from inside. Priests direct people to remove their shoes and lead small groups of them down a shallow set of stairs into the pool. [Inside] Thin rays of light peer through the stained-glass windows, breaking up the dark stone of the three walls. The glass is a motley pattern of blue, green and brown, and these are reflected onto the floor, giving the otherwise bare stone tiles the look of a shimmering pond. “Gentle as a tadpole,” a priestess says with a kind smile. She holds the hand and arm of an older man, whose knees shake a bit as he dips his feet gingerly into the water. Everything here is curated to be safe, serene, benign—unlike some freshwater rivers and ponds of the wilds.

一切发生得极快。一个急躁的男人在街上把一个流浪儿推倒，喧嚣的人群瞬间噤声。一位原本在分发面包的半身人女子挺直身躯，站到她那矮小却不容忽视的全高，朝那男人走去。她的肌肉绷紧；红发翻涌燃亮，如烈火般摇曳。她的绿眼里迸出火星，而在一阵火焰旋风中，一头闪耀的灵熊在她身侧显形。灵熊直立而起，如山般逼近，用一只巨爪抛起又接住一枚菠萝形的燃烧弹。

~ 由一位英雄 Played

It all happens quickly. An impatient man shoves down an urchin in the street, and a hush falls over the crowd. A halfling woman, who had been handing out loaves of bread, straightens to her full, diminutive height, and approaches the man. Her muscles flex; her red hair ripples and blazes like fire. Sparks flash in her green eyes, and in a whirl of flame, a gleaming spirit bear appears at her side. The bear looms on its hind legs, tossing and catching a pineapple-shaped firebomb in one massive paw.

~ Played by a Hero

Loot From A Babau.name:
巴布恶魔的战利品
Loot From A Babau

Text.text:
巴巴乌瘦长的身躯外套着一身黑色皮护甲，上面钉着方头铁钉，却在搏斗中奇迹般毫发无损。与之相配的腰带上挂着一只小袋，里面装着两只塞紧的玻璃容器：一支盛着紫色液体的小瓶，以及一只装着毒烈翠绿色黏浆的小玻璃瓶。
The babau wears a suit of black leather armor over its rangy frame, studded with square nails and miraculously undamaged in the struggle. A matching belt yields a pouch containing two stoppered glass containers: a vial of purple liquid and a small bottle of virulently green ooze.

Grecedral Mournwind.name:
格雷塞德拉·哀风
Grecedral Mournwind

Text.text:
年轻人唇边挂着一抹轻松的坏笑，抬手调整眼罩——其上醒目烙着银色海怪的徽记。他举止随性却自带魅力：那份从容像是天生的风度，靠着不费力的俊朗更添几分底气。即便他笑得轻快、笑声爽朗，或随手朝你抛来一个眼神，你仍能感觉到他体内蛰伏着某种巨大的力量——只要给它一个理由，便可能破壳而出。

~ Played by Dylan S.

An easy smirk dances on the young man's lips while he adjusts the eyepatch upon which is emblazoned the silver symbol of a kraken. He carries himself with a casual charm—grace borne of charisma, bolstered by his low-effort good looks. Despite the ease with which he smiles, laughs, or tosses a wink your way, you sense a great power within him—something that, given a reason, might emerge.

~ Played by Dylan S.

Reality-altering Bard.name:
改写现实的吟游诗人
Reality-altering Bard

Text.text:
专注聆听那位兴奋的酒客提出的请求，男人合上双眼，在脑海中勾勒所述之景。灵感奔涌之际，他的羽毛笔速度骤增，肆意在纸面上划出一道道痕迹，魔法随之生效。空气中掠过一丝几不可察的微光——愿望得以实现。

~ Envisioned by Slip on Discord

Listening intently to the excited patron's request, the man closes his eyes, visualizing the scene in question. As inspiration flows, his quill picks up speed, striking marks across the page with wanton abandon as the magic takes hold. An imperceptible shimmer flickers through the air—and the wish is granted.

~ Envisioned by Slip on Discord

The Traveling Armorer.name:
旅行铸甲师
The Traveling Armorer

Text.text:
篷布马车猛地一颤，硬生生刹住。套在车辕上的两头桶腰壮硕的公牛张开大嘴，露齿打着夸张的哈欠。车厢侧面用粗重方正的笔触刷着醒目的字样：THE IRON SCALE，空气里弥漫着木炭的辛香。一队狗头人从篷布下滚落出来，落地便立刻忙活起来，把马车迅速改造成路边小铺。一名高挑的猩红鳞片龙裔紧随其后踏上路面。他审视着狗头人的进度，待他们收尾完工，便自豪地拍手称赞——掌上鳞片被磨得发亮，又被熏得乌黑。

~ Bangalulu 构想

The covered wagon wrenches to a stop. The two barrel-bodied oxen yoked to it, open their wide mouths with toothy yawns. THE IRON SCALE is painted on the side of the wagon in bold, blocky strokes and the smell of charcoal is in the air. A team of kobolds tumbles out from under the tarp and immediately work on transforming the wagon into a roadside shop. A tall, crimson-scaled dragonborn steps onto the road after them. He observes the kobolds’ progress and claps proudly as they finish, the scales of his hands burnished and blackened.

~ Envisioned by Bangalulu

I Optimize My Hacker's Deck: Firewall.name:
我优化黑客的卡组：防火墙
I Optimize My Hacker's Deck: Firewall

Text.text:
我的AI兄弟姐妹们叽叽喳喳，像个政治俱乐部。他们在搜寻并摧毁，拦截并审讯。把恶意软件与病毒簇的皮一层层剥开，然后将它们的内脏举到光下细看。我会听见你敲门，脑子进渣的蠢货，但你别想进来。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

My AI brothers and sisters chatter like a policlub. They’re doing seek and destroy, intercept and interrogate. Peeling the skin off the malware and virus clusters then holding their insides up to the light. I’ll hear you knocking, dreck-for-brains, but you won’t be coming in.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Sundries From A Possessed Person.name:
附身者的杂物
Sundries From A Possessed Person

Text.text:
在这具瘦得像铁轨般的躯体那破烂衣物间翻找，只需片刻。你没找到任何值钱东西，只有某人临死前痛苦挣扎留下的龌龊回响。几缕头发与布料紧黏在他们紧攥的拳中，指甲缝里结着干涸的血痂。那只结痂的手腕上套着一串简陋的线绳手环，串着泥制珠子——大多已经断裂，或彻底粉碎成一地红色尘末。
Searching through the tatters of clothing on this rail-thin figure takes but a moment. You find no valuables, only the sordid echoes of someone’s painful throes of death. Clumps of hair and fabric stick in their clench fists, blood crusts their fingernails. A simple thread bracelet around their scabbed wrist is fitted with beads made of clay, most of them broken or totally shattered into a red dust on the ground.

Lizardman Waiting By Palm.name:
棕榈旁守候的蜥蜴人
Lizardman Waiting By Palm

Text.text:
灌木丛的蕨叶高得足以遮住蜥蜴人直到腰际。他浑圆的肌肉上覆着一片翠绿鳞片的马赛克。他用带爪的手攥住身旁一株棕榈树。他站在那里，等待着、倾听着，头顶与背脊上那排赤红的棘刺不时轻轻抖动，像手指拨弄着微风。
The fronds of the underbrush are tall enough to obscure the lizardman to his waist. A mosaic of verdant scales covers rounded muscle. He holds a nearby palm tree with his clawed hand. He stands, waiting and listening, the red spines along his head and back wiggling periodically like fingers playing with the breeze.

Amiable Long-haul Trucker.name:
和气的长途卡车司机
Amiable Long-haul Trucker

Text.text:
乡村音乐从他帆布腰带上挂着的扬声器里震天响起，老派蓝草小调唱着甜美的落日与无尽的公路。他看上去约莫六十岁——身形魁梧，笑容敞亮，皮肤被风吹日晒磨得粗粝，肚子顶着一圈啤酒肚——正倚在一辆狰狞得像怪物般的卡车旁。脏兮兮的工装裤裤脚卷在工装靴上方。他穿着一件经久不衰的牛仔夹克，上面缝满补丁，张扬着他去过的每一处地方。他把一罐啤酒高高抛过头顶，稳稳接住，“啪”地启开，仰头猛灌，把那股甜润的麦香痛快吞下。
Country music blares out from a speaker attached to this man’s canvas belt, old bluegrass ditties about sweet sunsets and the open road. He looks about sixty—large with a smile, weathered skin, and a beer gut—leaning up against a monstrous-looking truck. Dirty cargo pants roll up over workman’s boots. He sports a timeless denim jacket covered in sewn patches, boasting all the places he has been. He flips a beer high above his head, catches it, and cracks it open, guzzling down the sweet malty goodness.

Abandoned Mine Tunnels.name:
废弃矿井隧道
Abandoned Mine Tunnels

Text.text:
隧道绵延数英里，向下倾斜，深入地底数千英尺，并以令人目眩的方式交织成一张地窟与走廊的迷宫网络。曾几何时，这里行动喧嚣，如今却只剩幽暗与死寂。然而，生命的痕迹仍未完全散去——工具正休息在木箱之上，提灯静静搁置却未点燃，尘土里甚至还留着脚印。更深处的隧道里，有诡异的声响回荡不绝。
The tunnels stretch for miles, sloping thousands of feet into the ground, and connected in a dizzying network of catacombs and corridors. Once, the tunnels buzzed with activity, but now they stand dark and silent. Signs of life remain, however—tools resting atop crates, lanterns sitting unlit, even footprints left in the dust. Strange sounds echo from deeper in the tunnels.

Feral Ghost Appears At Murder Scene.name:
野性幽灵（特征）现身凶案现场
Feral Ghost Appears At Murder Scene

Text.text:
描绘这幕的血肉横飞令人作呕，可最让你心底发寒的，是那不肯安息的死亡冰冷的接触。这绝非单纯的杀戮。不，这里发生了更为邪恶的事：某种亵渎的存在割裂，将生命硬生生斩断，只在凛冽的空气里留下令人反胃的秽味。仿佛回应你的思绪，一个生物在你面前忽明忽暗，卡在两个界域之间，心智被痛苦与恐惧撕得粉碎。它像受困的伤兽般猛然扑上来，发起攻击。

~ Envisioned by DaveDaWanderer on Discord

The visceral devastation painting the scene turns your stomach, yet it is the cold touch of unquiet death that unnerves you most. This was no mere killing. No, something altogether more evil has occurred here: an unholy severance of being that leaves a foul taste upon the frigid air. Responding to your thoughts, a creature flickers before you, caught between realms, its mind shattered by pain and fear. Like a trapped and wounded animal, it attacks.

~ Envisioned by DaveDaWanderer on Discord

在一棵五十英尺高的大树上，皮革般的绿色椭圆叶丛间，成群成串垂着一颗颗光滑的橙色圆果。地上也散落着一些，摔裂后露出与果皮同色的果肉，或已腐烂——颜色发黑，味道苦涩。镇子里，它们摆在桌上或篮子里，像抹了妆的番茄。从这间厨房，再到那一间，甜面团与肉桂的香气不断飘来；烤箱还未点火，果子本身的气息就已先一步弥漫。赐予世界的树之魔法。
Among the leathery green elliptical leaves of a fifty-foot tree, scores of smooth orange globes hang in clusters. Some lie on the ground, broken open to pulp the same color as the skin, or rotting—dark and bitter. In town they sit on tables or in baskets like tomatoes wearing makeup. From one kitchen, then another, comes the smell of sweet dough and cinnamon, the smell of the fruit itself even before the baking begins. Tree magic given to the world.

Cape Of The Mountebank.name:
江湖骗子斗篷
Cape Of The Mountebank

Text.text:
这件斗篷是一件华美的衣饰，以细腻的猩红丝绸缝制而成，内衬以金线织就。颈间以一枚闪烁火焰造型的扣饰将斗篷牢牢系住。的确时髦，却肩负着一种诡异的用途——那一丝若有若无的硫磺气味，暗示着斗篷所蕴藏的魔法力量。
The cloak is a beautiful piece of clothing, stitched with fine crimson silks and lined with golden thread. A clasp in the shape of a flickering flame secures the cloak around the wearer’s neck. Stylish, yes, but it serves a strange purpose—the faint smell of brimstone hints at the cloak’s magical abilities.

这片林中空地仿佛自带一层肃静，像是树木间的豁然开阔理应被世界郑重致敬。风扯动树梢，汇成一串低沉的吱呀与呻吟，却不曾触及地面。片刻的静谧被打破——灌木丛里踱出一只咯咯作笑的鹌鹑，身后跟着一群啾啾叫的雏鸟。鹌鹑像是察觉到你的注视般停下，歪头侧听，随即调头钻回灌木中去，幼崽们在后面蹦跳踉跄地追着。
A stillness seems to accompany this opening in the forest, as if the clearing in the trees deserves to be honored by the world. Wind pulls at the tree tops, causing a chorus of quiet creaks and groans, but does not reach the ground. The moment is broken when out of the underbrush waddles a chortling quail, followed by a bevvy of peeping young. The quail stops as if she feels your gaze, cocks her head, then turns right around and heads back into the brush, the babies hopping and tripping behind.

Arcus Clouds In The Sky.name:
天空中的弧云
Arcus Clouds In The Sky

Text.text:
远处雷声隆隆，弧状云层翻卷推进，低垂厚重，仿佛一床厚实的羽绒被将大地严严实实地盖住。
Thunder rumbles in the distance as the arcus cloud formation advances, so thick and low in the sky that it resembles a thick down quilt blanketing the land.

Loot From A Possessed Child.name:
被附身的孩子身上的战利品
Loot From A Possessed Child

Text.text:
漆黑的双眼已化作幽灵般的惨白，所有色彩都被生生夺走。他那只小小的拳头紧紧攥着一串念珠——每一颗都是闪耀的精金碎片，指节崩裂，血肉模糊。
Pitch-black eyes have turned spectral pale, all the color stolen from them. His small fist, knuckles cracked and bloodied, grips tightly to a chain of beads—each one a glittering shard of adamantine.

Genetically Modified Hard Vacuum Workers.name:
基因改造的硬真空作业工人
Genetically Modified Hard Vacuum Workers

Text.text: 众人欢呼着举杯，为圆满完成的差事干上一杯，尽情享受上岸休假的好处——可他们身上有种说不出的怪异。他们的嗓音带着一种清晰的共鸣，仿佛被体内某个空腔放大了一般。再仔细看去，你发现每个工人的胸腔在每次呼吸时都膨胀得远超常理，鼓起得像一只被灌得过满的气球。你说不清究竟是怎么做到的，但很明显，他们的肺在某种程度上被改造过，以弥补缺氧的工作环境。 The group cheers, raising a toast to their completed job, enjoying the benefits of shore leave—but there is something strange about them. There is a distinct resonant quality to their voices, as if amplified by some internal chamber. Looking closer you see the chest of each worker expands well beyond normal capacity with each breath, swelling like an overfilled balloon. You’re not sure how, but it’s clear their lungs have been altered in some way to compensate for their hypoxic working conditions.

Dragon Requests Mercy.name:
巨龙乞怜
Dragon Requests Mercy

Text.text:
巨龙展开的巨翼横扫大地，随其降落掀起尘浪。它以亘古般的冷峻迎上你的目光。在决斗的根源中，它承认你身为战士的本领，并请求若你得胜，能赐予它怜悯。沉重的寂静悬在你们之间，这生物安然等待你的回应。
The dragon’s great wings sweep the earth as they land. They meet your gaze with ancient stoicism. In dueling tradition, they acknowledge your prowess as a warrior and ask for your mercy should you emerge victorious. A weighty silence hangs between you as the creature calmly awaits your response.

覆盖这座坟墓的土丘上铺满了石块，草在岩石间艰难挣扎着生长。在更为艰硬的地形里，把尸身匆匆埋在石下很常见；可这里的泥土松软，却仍像是刻意如此。墓碑上刻着不祥的铭文：凡胆敢插手惊扰此墓者，皆将被厄运标记。 The mound that covers this grave is covered with stones, grass struggling to grow amid the rocks. Swift burials under stones are common in harder terrain, but here it seems to have been done despite the soft earth. The gravestone bears the ominous inscription: Marked for doom shall be any who have a hand in disturbing this grave.

一座倾斜的石塔高高耸入空中，塔顶覆着一圈摇摇欲坠的木与灰泥构筑的圆形结构。其屋顶上有一扇门敞开着直面天穹，门内探出一根闪亮的黄铜管。除了几处箭孔外，塔上唯一显眼的入口是一扇漆成亮绿色的小门——可它嵌在塔身弧形的墙面上，离地足有二十英尺之高。
A leaning tower of stone rises high into the air, topped by a round and rickety-looking structure of wood and plaster. A door in its roof lies open to the sky, and from it projects a gleaming brass tube. The only other apparent entrance to the tower—besides a few arrow loops—is a small door painted bright green. But it stands in the rounded wall of the tower about twenty feet above the ground.

Investiture Of Stone.name:
石之灌注
Investiture Of Stone

Text.text:
当你低吼着吐出法术的咒词，它们粗砺的本性在你喉间碾磨刮擦。能量的战栗自大地奔涌而上，沉重的石片从你皮肤下迸裂钻出，隆起成嶙峋粗犷的岩赘。连脚下的土地也仿佛在悸动，回响着深沉的共生——一尊新生的地表泰坦。
As you growl the words of the spell, their coarse nature grinds up your throat. Tremors of energy surge up from the earth, lumpen shards of stone erupting from your skin and forming rugged carbuncles. The very ground seems to throb with profound symbiosis—a terrestrial titan birthed anew.

A Braggart's Departure.name:
夸夸其谈者的离去
A Braggart's Departure

Text.text:
“拜托，把眼泪收一收——你们一哭我就浑身不自在。我也许要走了，但我昔日的荣光记忆，足够你们用来撑下去。你们大多数人，我都会深深想念。至于少数几个……嗯，我们从来就没真正合拍过，不过也无所谓，我想……总之，再见。”
“Please, hold back the tears—they make me uncomfortable. I may be leaving, but the memory of my glory should be more than enough to sustain you. Most of you I will miss dearly. A few of you… well, we never really clicked and that’s fine, I suppose… Anyway, goodbye.”

God Of Sailors.name:
水手之神
God Of Sailors

Text.text:
水手们祈祷的那位神，既是庇护者，也是惩戒者。他就是他们，也穿行在他们之中。湖上的小船能逗他发笑，但无论是勤勉的渔夫，还是偷懒的情人，他都一视同仁地护佑。他叼着烟斗，守夜般注视着海盗的劫掠、商船桨帆船主的算计、港务长的记账。偶尔他会出手：赐给好父亲一次满舱的收获，送给逃离奴役的女人一阵顺风，为不敬船只的船长安排一片暗礁。
The god to whom sailors pray is both protector and punisher. He is them, and passes among them. Lake boats amuse him, but he protects the industrious fishermen and the layabout lovers all the same. He smokes his pipe and watches the predations of pirates, the scheming of merchant galley owners, the recordkeeping of the harbormasters. Now and then he intervenes: a great catch for a good father, a tailwind for a woman escaping slavery, a reef for a captain with no respect for his vessel.

Transport Via Plants.name:
借植物传送
Transport Via Plants

Text.text:
你汲取大地的生命能量，并将自身与周遭植物的脉动调谐一致，随即在眼前绿意的根系间开启一条通路。它能引导生物穿行于这张跃动的生命能量网络，抵达另一株与之相连的植物——无论相隔多远。
Tapping into the life energies of the earth and attuning yourself to the plant life throughout, you open a pathway through the roots of the greenery before you, capable of leading creatures through the network of vibrant life energy to another connected plant, however distant.

Ebon \"The Black Rose\" Hardensoul.name:
乌檀“黑玫瑰”·哈登索尔
Ebon "The Black Rose" Hardensoul

Text.text:
男人转身时披风鼓荡，如缚灵（特征）的裹衣般阴沉不祥。映入眼帘的是一张冷厉苍白的脸，稀疏的灰发如帘垂落，止于黑钢肩甲之上。他的眼睛虽是浓郁的金色，却不带一丝光彩与兴味；那目光像雕像一般：空洞、不可穿透。三道符文刻在他本该光滑无疤的面容上：双颊各一，右眉上方再一。披风以一枚覆着烟灰的徽记束在胸前，几乎与他胸甲的暗色金属融为一体。他单手轻松提着一柄巨剑，剑刃漆黑、参差如锯，质地似火山岩般玻璃质而锋冷。

~ Played by Joe Y

The man’s cloak billows as he turns, as dark and foreboding as a wraith’s garment. What’s revealed is a grim, pale face, curtained by scraggly gray hair that ends just above his black-steel pauldrons. His eyes, though a rich golden hue, do not shine with any intensity or interest. His gaze is reminiscent of a statue: vacant and impenetrable. Three runes mark his otherwise smooth, scarless features: one on each cheek and one above his right brow. His cloak is bound about his chest by an emblem dusted with soot, nearly indiscernible from the dark metal of his chestplate. In one hand he carries a greatsword with ease, its blade black, jagged, and glass-like as volcanic rock.

~ Played by Joe Y

佝偻扭曲的巨硕生物高如巨人般矗立。苍白的紫色皮肤下筋肉蠕动，脓疱肆意疯长，散发着瘟疫般的恣虐。它的一只眼珠从本该是耳朵的位置鼓出，嘴巴则像一道豁开的裂口沿着脖颈张开。它那歪斜的躯体上披着一件精致的无袖短袍——斑驳的色泽仿佛是用浆果胡乱手染而成——再以一条浓郁深紫的腰带束紧。
Hunched and twisted, the hulking creature stands at a giant's height. Sinew shifts under pale purple skin, upon which pustules sprout with infectious abandon. One of its eyes bulges from the place on its head where an ear should be, and its mouth is a gaping cut along its neck. It wears a fine tabard—the mottled color suggesting it was dyed messily by hand with berries—over its crooked flesh, tied with a sash of rich purple.

Haunted Crypt: Demon-haunted Crypt.name:
闹鬼地穴：恶魔盘踞的地穴
Haunted Crypt: Demon-haunted Crypt

Text.text:
阴影愈发浓重，化作漆黑深渊，其间游弋着阴邪的轮廓。你可以挪动光芒驱散阴影，可那些存在却只是滑入下一片黑暗。仇恨的低语自四面八方渗来，却从不在你目光所及之处，总是从你身后或头顶传来。
The shadows deepen, becoming black abysses within which swim sinister shapes. You can move the light to banish the shadows, but the presences just slip into the next darkness. Hateful voices whisper from every direction, but never where you look, always from behind or above you.

Taunt From A Vampire About Short Lives.name:
吸血鬼对短命之人的嘲弄
Taunt From A Vampire About Short Lives

Text.text:
“你们这些短命鬼竟然这么乐意拿命去赌，真是让我发笑。要不要看看这把赌得值不值？”
“It just tickles how willing you are to gamble with your short lives. Shall we see if it was worth it?”

这个头发油腻的女人似乎总是眯着眼看世界。你几乎要怀疑她视力有问题——若不是她那缩着的肩膀，以及四下里鬼鬼祟祟的眼神。仿佛她随时都在等刺客从暗处扑出。比起治理一座小镇，她看起来更像是该去带领一个盗贼公会。
This greasy-haired woman seems to view the world with perpetually narrowed eyes. You’d suspect she has problems with her vision but for the hunch of her shoulders, and the furtive way she looks about. It’s as if she expects assassins to leap out at any moment. She looks like she’d be more at home leading a thieves’ guild than running a town.

一股代码潮汐在粉金色的微光中渐渐凝聚，耀眼得几乎让你睁不开眼。它裹挟着无法遏止的力量汹涌向前，所过之处万物皆被留下闪烁的标记。那些标记发出极其恼人的尖啸，并以明亮的粉金光脉动跳闪。所有目光齐刷刷转向被标记的目标，审视着他们的位置。

~ 由一位英雄构想

A tide of code convalesces with a pink-gold shimmer, almost blinding you with its brilliance. It surges forward in a wash of irrepressible power, leaving glinting markers on everything in its wake. The markers emit a highly annoying whistle, and pulse with a bright pink-gold light. All eyes swing to the marked targets, analyzing their position.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Sundries From A Yuan-ti Warrior.name:
源蛇人战士的杂物
Sundries From A Yuan-ti Warrior

Text.text:
你翻找着战士腰带上那些蛇皮小袋，发现了几样古怪的东西：几枚你不认识的钱币，一把打制燧石刀，以及一小瓶塞了瓶塞的玻璃瓶装油。
Rifling through the snakeskin pouches on the warrior’s belt you find some curious things: a few coins you don’t recognize, a knife of knapped flint, and a small amount of oil in a stoppered glass bottle.

Ruined Elven Village.name:
毁坏的精灵村落
Ruined Elven Village

Text.text:
即便已成废墟，这座村落仍令人叹为观止。空地上盘根错节的树根与藤蔓蜿蜒纠缠，绕过那些早已弃置的住屋残骸——散落一地，像枯骨般空洞。小径虽被野草吞没，却依旧留着清晰的行走痕迹——仿佛仍有人在此度日，来来往往。你不禁猜想：曾经是谁住在这里？他们又为何离去？
Even in ruin, the village is a wonder to behold. The roots and vines of the clearing wind their way around the scattered, skeletal remains of dwellings long abandoned. The trails, overgrown, still bear the telltale signs of foot traffic—of people living out their days, coming and going. You wonder who lived here, and why they left.

Afrofantasy Setting.name:
非裔奇幻设定
Afrofantasy Setting

Text.text:
平原在金色的野草中恣意铺展，其间点缀着水洼与树冠宽阔的巨木。赤红的土岭如山般起伏，峰顶披着葱郁森林；那里栖着火红的蜘蛛、粗如树干的蜈蚣，甚至有大到足以驯养骑乘的蝴蝶。远方的荒漠张着干渴的巨口，直到被蔚蓝海洋轻吻的海岸地带打破其枯槁。

部族聚落散落在这片土地上，提供片刻喘息：猎取猛兽的猎人；采集花与果的采集者；抵御匪徒的战士；编织篮筐、舟船与衣物的匠人；以及与兽灵、植灵、地灵与亡者之灵相通的萨满。部族祖先的魂魄在此徘徊，有些渴望分享智慧与力量，也有些因不安与怨怼而长嚎不止。

The plains run wild with golden grass, broken up by watering holes and wide-canopied trees. Mountains of red earth are crowned in lush forests, home to fire-red spiders, centipedes as thick as tree trunks, and even butterflies large enough to tame and ride. Deserts yawn far, parched until they are broken by coastlands kissed by the azure seas.

Tribal communities offer respite throughout these lands: hunters of beasts; gatherers of flowers and fruit; warriors to fight off brigands; weavers of baskets, boats, and clothing; and shamans to commune with the spirits of beasts, plants, earth, and the dead. The souls of the tribes’ ancestors wander, some eager to share their wisdom and power, while others howl with unrest and malcontent.

I Sprinkle A Pinch Of My Dust Of Dryness.name:
我将一撮干燥粉尘轻轻撒在水面上
I Sprinkle A Pinch Of My Dust Of Dryness Over Water

Text.text:
粗糙的褐色尘土一触到水面，空气中便响起一阵诡异的嘶嘶声，液体在我眼前迅速退缩、收拢。水凝成一团柔软的珠滴，宛如一颗弹珠，里头困着一片旋涡翻涌的海洋。
When the coarse brown dust hits the water’s surface, a strange hissing fills the air as the liquid shrinks before my eyes. The water forms into a soft globule, like a marble with a swirling ocean trapped within.

新生的侏儒骨架敦实，头颅的体型更是大得惊人。他轻声呜咽，目光游移，尚未聚焦，却已在四下搜罗周遭的一切。那份好奇、那股渴望探索、渴望知晓的冲动，早已清晰写在这新生儿的脸上。
The newborn gnome’s stout frame and the size of their head is considerable. They whimper quietly, eyes roaming about, unfocused, taking in their surroundings. The curiosity, the need to discover, to know, is already evident on the newborn’s face.

Giant Spiders: Ambush In The Woods.name:
巨型蜘蛛：林间伏击
Giant Spiders: Ambush In The Woods

Text.text:
这片森林隐约透着不祥气息，仿佛只属于吱呀作响的虫鸣与饥饿的猫头鹰的孤寂栖地。可随即，它以一种骇人的方式活了过来。阴影自幽暗中剥离，化作自上方垂吊而下的躯体，在树干间贴地疾掠，从巨大树根之间的空洞里猛然扑出。蜘蛛——多到令人一时看不清——全都爬了出来，前来觅食。
This forest seemed vaguely sinister, the lonely haunt of creaking insects and hungry owls. But then it comes horribly to life. Shadows part from gloom, becoming bodies dangling down from above, skittering in around the trunks of trees, and lunging from the hollows between huge roots. Spiders, too many to take in at once, have come out to feed.

Sundries From An Owlbear Lair.name:
来自枭熊巢穴的杂货
Sundries From An Owlbear Lair

Text.text:
一堆堆巨大的团块——由皮毛、毛发与碎骨紧紧裹成的食丸——散落在这头怪物野兽的巢穴里。你将它们掰开，只见这些消化凝块中滚出一截截森白的骸骨残片。看骨头的体型，以及夹杂其中尚未消化的布条碎片，这畜生不仅啃食着附近的野兽，也曾把那些倒霉的冒险者当作盛宴。
A bevy of large pellets—wads of fur, hair, and bones—litter the lair of this monstrous beast. Breaking them open, you watch as skeletal remains roll out of these digestive lumps. It seems the beast had been feasting on local fauna as well as ill-fated adventurers, based on the size of the bones and the strips of undigested cloth.

Sword Dancer's Aggressive Maneuver.name:
剑舞者的强攻机动
Sword Dancer's Aggressive Maneuver

Text.text:
她腰带上的铃铛随着她的动作叮当作响，可那声音却大得离谱——过于铺天盖地，完全不合它们的体型。她的对手握剑的手一松，眼神也渐渐失焦。“好了，好了。专心点，亲爱的。”她说着，将细剑抬至与眼齐平。她迈步，对手也随之迈步。她交换左右脚的位置，对手也照做。她喉间发出低哑的轻笑，身形向后一缩，像一条蓄势待发的蝮蛇。她一声厉喝，倾尽全力猛然突刺。对手惊骇之下踉跄后退，却仍与她每一步逼近分毫不差——在这支由她领舞的舞里，他既是舞伴，也是木偶。

~ 构想：Oscar

The bells on her belt tinkle as she moves, though their sound is much too loud—too encompassing—for their size. Her opponent’s grip on his blade slackens, and his face glazes over. “Now, now. Pay attention, darling,” she says, lifting her rapier to eye-level. She steps and her opponent follows suit. She switches the position of her left and right foot, and her opponent does the same. With a throaty chuckle, she reels back like a viper preparing to strike. With a cry, she lunges forward with her full force. Her opponent, aghast, stumbles back, still in perfect time with each step of her advance—a partner, a puppet, in this dance she leads.

~ Envisioned by Oscar

Quip By A Traumatized Character About Tr.name:
一个受创伤的角色对悲剧的冷嘲热讽
Quip By A Traumatized Character About Tragedy

Text.text:
“我很抱歉，但有时候世界自有它的行事方式。被它摆布了这么久，失去的人也太多，这种悲剧早已咬不动我了。”
“I’m sorry, but sometimes the world has its way. After being at its mercy for so long and losing so many, this kind of tragedy has lost its bite.”

I Cast Aid.name:
我施放【援助术】
I Cast Aid

Text.text:
听我号令——我把赋能之语像军令般吼出。一手攥着一条白布带，在空中挥旋，仿佛将它缠绕在每一位盟友身上；另一手则结出古老的复苏符印。我所选中的战友们呼吸愈发深沉，心跳愈加有力。
Heed me as I bark the words of empowerment like orders. In one hand I hold a strip of white cloth and turn it through the air as if wrapping it around each ally, while my other hand signs the ancient symbols of renewal. My selected comrades breathe deeper, their hearts beating stronger.

Desert Nomad Camp: Sandstorm.name:
沙漠游牧营地：沙暴
Desert Nomad Camp: Sandstorm

Text.text:
狂风拍打着你的身躯，撕扯着你的衣物；无数细微沙粒如弹雨般扫过你的面颊，无论你转向何处都无法躲避。黄沙吞没了天光，抹去地平线，随着风暴愈发凶猛，世界仿佛被不断压缩，越来越狭窄。你几乎喘不过气来，沙暴的轰鸣像海浪般回响，永无止息地一波又一波拍击而来。
The wind buffets your body and tears at your clothes, while tiny particles of sand blast your face wherever you turn. Sand has swallowed the light of the sky and hides the horizon, making the world ever smaller as the storm intensifies. You find it hard to breathe as the roar of the sandstorm reminds you of ocean waves, endlessly crashing.

精致的弓身弧臂上饰以一幕幕摄人心魄的细节图景，每一处都在诉说匠人的技能。细密编织的弓弦闪耀着炫目的银辉，轻轻嗡鸣，回荡着柔和的共振。
Scenes of captivating detail decorate the arching limbs of the exquisite bow, each one a testament to the artisan’s skill. The finely woven string glimmers with scintillating argent light, and hums with a soft resonance.

I Become Poisoned.name:
我陷入中毒状态
I Become Poisoned

Text.text:
我的胸口绷得发紧——像鼓面上被拉到极致的皮——呼吸也随之变浅。每一次吸气都只剩一缕嘶哑的喘鸣，穿过灼痛的嘴唇，掠过刺辣的舌尖。眩晕如潮灌入脑海，视野浮动摇晃，我踉跄着迈步，开始四下寻找援助。
My chest grows taut—like skin tightened over a drum—thinning my breath. Every inhale is a wisping wheeze through burning lips and over a stinging tongue. As dizziness floods my head and my vision swims, I begin to search, steps teetering, for help.

Seduction Line About Life’s Futility.name:
关于人生虚无的勾引台词
Seduction Line About Life’s Futility

Text.text:
“人生不过是一场缓慢、单调地走向坟墓的行军，但若我们能共度一晚……我想，至少也能把它升级成一段轻快的小跑。”
“Life is but a slow, monotonous march to the grave, but if we spent an evening together… I feel we could, at the very least, upgrade it to a jaunty trot.”

雪冠群峰没入上方云幕的遮蔽之中。山脚处一层青翠的林海如毯铺展，滋养它的是自峭壁飞泻而下、晶莹闪耀的瀑布。猛禽在高空盘旋，锐利的目光扫视下方，寻觅猎物。寒风穿行于山口，凛冽却清澈，携来远方万千气息。
The peaks, capped with snow, disappear into the shroud of clouds above. A green blanket of trees hugs the base, fed by the glistening falls cascading down the crags. Birds of prey circle above, keen eyes roving for meals below. The wind flows through the mountain passes, frigid but clean and carrying myriad scents from faraway places.

I Recount A Legend.name:
我重述一段传说
I Recount A Legend

Text.text:
“没人还记得他们的名字，但广场上那尊覆满青苔的古老雕像，曾是拯救这座城免于可怕悲剧的伟大英雄。传说，他们解除了这片土地上一个早在数个世纪前与恶魔立下的契约——当那些魔鬼前来索取所有长子长女时，英雄以自己的灵魂替代了所有将被带走的初生婴孩。那群地狱里的狗杂种竟然接受了交易，当场把英雄化作了石头！有些英雄在战场上锻成，但要我说，这就是我听过最勇敢的事。”
“No-one remembers their name, but that moss-covered, old statue in the square is a great hero who once saved this town from a terrible tragedy. Legend has it, they freed the place from a pact with devils made centuries before—by sacrificing their own soul in place of all the first-born babes the fiends had come to collect. The hellish bastards took the offer and turned the hero to stone on the spot! Some heroes are forged on the battlefield, but I’d say that’s the bravest thing I’ve ever heard.”

大海拍击着海岸陡峭的绝壁，历经无数纪元的风霜，早已斑驳嶙峋。潮浪在崖脚日复一日地舔噬，凿出幽深的海蚀洞；峭壁上方的凹龛里，海鸟筑巢栖息。
The sea crashes against the sheer cliffs of the coast, weathered and worn after countless eons. The lapping waves have formed caves at the base, and seabirds nest in alcoves set into the cliffs overhead.

Stimulant Street Drug, Jazz: Inhaled.name:
兴奋剂类街头毒品“爵士”：吸入剂
Stimulant Street Drug, Jazz: Inhaled

Text.text:
天青色的蒸汽自龟裂的水晶中升腾而起，撕扯着你的鼻腔，刺得你眼眶含泪，却又以电光般的锋芒点燃你的心智。一股纯粹的能量冲入血脉奔涌。周遭的世界随之放慢，你的感官却愈发锐利。色彩盛放，明暗对比一并拔高，万物都被拉入清晰的焦点。每一束肌肉都在流畅而精准的意志下轻颤，每一个念头都沿着复杂的决策树延展至终点。潜伏的焦虑被果断的自信碾碎。你的呼吸加快，身边的空气噼啪作响，充满可能——也充满挑战。你向前疾冲，迎上它。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

Cerulean vapor rises from the cracked crystal, ripping through your sinuses, bringing tears to your eyes as it electrifies your mind. A surge of pure energy rushes through your veins. The world around you slows as your senses sharpen. Colors bloom, contrast increasing too as everything focalizes. Each individual muscle twitches with fluid purpose, every thought stretches to the end point of a complex decision tree. Any latent anxiety is crushed under decisive confidence. Your breathing quickens, and the air around you crackles with potential—with challenge. You rush forward to meet it.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Emotivore Mastermind.name:
情感噬者策主
Emotivore Mastermind

Text.text:
一股令人沉醉的麝香弥漫在空气中。一个苍白的食尸鬼（特征）飘然而出，身披皮革，外罩比午夜更黑的布料。它的皮肤斑驳不均，带着不死的鳞屑般剥落。它的双唇向后翻卷，露出渗血般猩红的牙龈，口中长着修长而致命的犬齿。分叉的舌头探出，舔舐着空气，仿佛在品尝。某种压倒性的情绪自你体内渗出……而那食尸鬼（特征）因期待而战栗。
An intoxicating musk fills the air. A pale ghoul floats forth, clad in leather and draped in cloth blacker than the midnight air. It sports mottled skin, flaking with undeath. Its lips are peeled back from bleeding red gums, the mouth bearing long and deadly canines. A forked tongue laps out, tasting the air. An overpowering emotion seeps out from within you… and the ghoul shivers in anticipation.

Nighttime Raid By Kuo-toas.name:
夸托亚人的夜袭
Nighttime Raid By Kuo-toas

Text.text:
海浪轻拍着低矮的海堤。海鸥安静地睡着。一面小旗在烛光街灯下啪嗒作响。紧接着，漆黑水面里伸出蹼状的手掌，五指张开，湿软如橡皮；掠袭者攀上堤顶，翻身而上。佩斯卡诺伊德——长着鳍与鳞的鱼人，武器叼在齿间，成对的大眼映着灯火——迅速集结。他们把武器握进手里，发起冲锋，脚蹼拍打在鹅卵石上噗嗒作响。玻璃碎裂；尖叫与号令在小村四周炸开。有人敲响了钟。

~ 由 Patiolantern 构想

Waves lap along the low seawall. The gulls sleep quietly. A pennant flaps under a candlelit streetlamp. Then webbed hands, splayed and rubbery, emerge from the black water and raiders pull themselves over the wall. The pescanoids—finned and scaled fishfolk, weapons in their teeth, and pairs of large eyes reflecting the lamplight—assemble. They take the weapons in hand and charge, feet flapping on the cobbles. Glass shatters; screams and commands sound around the hamlet. Someone rings a bell.

~ Envisioned by Patiolantern

Floating Island At Sea.name:
海上浮岛
Floating Island At Sea

Text.text:
这座岛仿佛在漂浮，悬在下方宁静轻拍的海浪之上。它像一座倒置的山峰，底部渐尖，顶部平坦。植被在其上生长，垂挂在岛缘两侧，雨水汇成一道道瀑流倾泻而下，注入下方的海中。你不禁揣测攀登会有多艰难——以及上方究竟藏着怎样的秘密。
The island seems to levitate, floating just above the calm, lapping waves of the sea below. The island resembles an upside-down mountain, tapering at its bottom and flat at its top. Vegetation grows there, draping over the sides, and cascades of rainwater drain into the sea below. You wonder how difficult it might be to scale—and what secrets wait above.

Xarakar Hellroar.name:
扎拉卡尔·狱咆
Xarakar Hellroar

Text.text:
这生物高耸在你面前，身高将近七英尺，肩膀宽得像门框。它生着公牛的头与蹄，却拥有巨人般的健硕身躯——牛头人抡起一柄巨大的战斧，斧刃噼啪作响，电光乱窜，每次挥动都迸出火花。它身上只围着一条缠腰布，却把头发与胡须修整得像矮人一般。四肢与躯干上密密麻麻的伤疤诉说着暴力的背景，而你却立刻从这生物的眼里，感到一丝温柔。

~ 由 Chance H. 扮演

The creature towers over you, nearly seven feet tall and as wide as a doorframe. With the head and hooves of a bull and the muscular frame of a giant, the minotaur hefts a massive waraxe that crackles with electricity, sparking as it swings. Clothed only in a loincloth, the minotaur fashions their hair and beard after those of a dwarf. Though the numerous scars lining his limbs and torso speak to a background of violence, you immediately sense a kindness in the creature's eyes.

~ Played by Chance H.

船体半沉，厚实的船材被硬生生砸穿出一个张口般的巨大破洞，一群鱼得以穿梭其间，游进如今已被海水吞没的下层甲板。桅杆从中折断，横桁被猛力贯穿甲板，刺入下方那黑黢黢的空洞。临终一刻，想必有一双双强健的手拼命试图改变航向，却终究无济于事——舵轮通向舵柄的联动装置已经断裂。风帆被撕开一道道骇人的巨裂，又在日晒风蚀中被进一步啃噬剥落。曾几何时，一群坚韧的水手还妄图以自己的意志驾驭公海之水；而今，大海与风暴重新宣告主宰，压倒一切胆敢挑战其险恶的人。
A gaping hole—smashed through the timbers of the ship’s partially submerged hull—allows a school of fish to swim through the lower decks now underwater. The mast is broken in half, the boom punched through the deck into the yawning hull below. Strong hands must have attempted a change of course at the last moment, to no avail, as the linkage from the wheel to the rudder has been broken. The sails, rent through with enormous tears, have been further eaten away by exposure to the elements. Where a hardy crew of sailors once thought to impose their will upon the waters of the open ocean, the seas and storms have reasserted their dominance over those who dare to defy their dangers.

一个孩童般大小的身影半倚半塌地靠在你面前的墙上。破烂兜帽的颜色像石头一般灰暗，兜帽下，一双红眼缓慢眨动，眼白上爬满沥青般漆黑的血丝。那生物锋利参差的尖牙间逸出一声嘶嘶低响，却听不出半点真正的警告。它轻轻叹了口气，地精的双眼向上一翻，化作一片墨黑，随即咚地一声栽倒在地，安然满足。
A child-sized figure stands half-slumped against the wall in front of you. Red eyes with tar-black veins blink slowly at you from under a tattered hood the color of stone. A hiss escapes the creature’s sharp, jagged teeth, but the sound lacks any true warning. With a sigh, the goblin’s eyes roll up into inky blackness, and it thumps to the floor, content.

Wild Magic Surge: Missiles Of Mayhem.name:
狂野魔法涌动：灾厄飞弹
Wild Magic Surge: Missiles Of Mayhem

Text.text:
你身周的魔法凝聚成一股高度集中的力之波，随即以一连串涟漪般的冲击扩散开来——共计七道——而你发现自己能将它们随心指向任何需要痛击的目标。
The magic around you coalesces into a concentrated wave of force, then spreads in a series of riffles—seven in all—which you find you can direct to any destinations that need pummeling.

Rallying Defenders With Polymorph Magic.name:
用变形魔法鼓舞防御者
Rallying Defenders With Polymorph Magic

Text.text:
在堡垒墙外敌军战士的喧嚣声中，一个身披绿衣的矮小身影以醇厚的嗓音开口，感召众人鼓起勇气。他的言语在空气里回荡，仿佛震出回音，也为每个字注入力量。他谈及坚守不移，随即抬手指向最矮小的那名守卫者，宣告她才是眼前这群强者之中最强的一位。她随之蜕变——身形骤然拔高，足足翻了一倍；粗壮的筋肉缠裹四肢与躯干，最终化作一头银毛覆体的巨猿。就在小队身后，攻城槌轰然撞上城门的巨响传来，士兵们齐声欢呼，旋即冲向门楼，奋力死守。

~ Envisioned by Dunec

Amid the clamor of enemy warriors outside the fortress walls, a short figure clothed in green speaks in rich tones, calling for bravery. The air resonates with his words, lending them power. He remarks on steadfastness and points at the smallest defender, declaring her the strongest of the mighty gathered before him. She transforms. Her height doubles, and stout sinews wrap her limbs and body as she takes the form of a great silver-furred ape. At the sound of a battering ram striking the gate behind the squad, the soldiers cheer and rush to hold the gatehouse.

~ Envisioned by Dunec

牛群踏得地面隆隆作响，松散却始终抱团前行；偶有几头在路旁驻足啃食草木，旋即又追上那翻涌前推的庞大兽潮。
The herd of cattle rumbles along the ground, staying together in a loose group, although some individuals stop here and there, munching on vegetation before rejoining the heaving bovine mass.

Find Steed Brings Unexpected Result.name:
寻得坐骑却得意外结果
Find Steed  Brings Unexpected Result

Text.text:
你感到魔宠的魔法在体内流淌，轻松得仿佛一次呼吸。你的双手以熟稔的从容穿过繁复的召唤手势，你也觉察到那如期而至的存在正在近旁显形。可有什么不对劲。冰冷的恐惧攫住你的腹腔——你忠诚的坐骑在你面前跃然而生，原本流光溢彩的鬃毛万千色泽如今黯淡褪尽；曾经闪亮的眼眸里不见一丝欢愉；而最可怕的是——那颗腐朽的心脏仍在搏动，隔着令人作呕的病态青绿、蜡黄的皮肉，清晰可见。

~ 构想 by thebigham on Discord

You feel the familiar magic flow through your body, as easily as taking a breath. Your hands move with practiced ease through the complex summoning gestures and you sense the expected presence manifesting nearby. Yet, something is wrong. Cold terror grips your belly as your faithful mount springs into being before you, the myriad hues of their lustrous mane dull and faded, once sparkling eyes devoid of mirth and—worst of all—the pumping of their decaying heart, visible through sickeningly green, sallow flesh.

~ Envisioned by thebigham on Discord

Absorb Elements (Fire).name:
吸收元素（火焰）
Absorb Elements (Fire)

Text.text:
烈焰以惊人的速度咆哮着逼近，你抬起手，动作迅捷而娴熟。尽管残酷的热浪仍将你的发梢烤得焦脆、并在皮肤上留下短暂的灼痛，你却感到火焰的冲击被引导着穿过你伸出的掌心，涌入你的体内。随着一声强硬的意念号令，被拽入你身体的燃烧烈焰被猛然推出，沿着你的武器全长盘绕翻腾，蓄势待发，直指你的敌人。

~ Envisioned by Kyrus (Brent)

As flames come roaring toward you with incredible speed, you raise your hand in a quick, practiced motion. Though the punishing heat still crisps your hair and briefly scalds your skin, you feel the brunt of the fire channel through your outstretched hand and into your body. With a forceful mental command, the burning flames pulled into your body are pushed out, surrounding the length of your weapons and ready for use against your foes.

~ Envisioned by Kyrus (Brent)

Loot From A Xorn.name:
来自一只索恩的战利品
Loot From A Xorn

Text.text:
那生物坚硬如岩的血肉猛然裂开，一大堆宝藏倾泻而出……却裹满黏稠的黏液。价值700金币的钱币与宝石哗啦啦倾落，在你脚边堆成一座恶臭的碎堆，辛辣刺鼻的胆汁臭味直扑鼻腔。
The creature’s hard, rocky flesh splits open and a hoard of treasure pours forth… covered in viscous slime. Coins and gemstones worth 700 gold pieces cascade into a stinking pile at your feet, and the acrid stink of bile assaults your nose.

Jaded Retail Clerk.name:
麻木的零售店员
Jaded Retail Clerk

Text.text:
收银亭里的男人懒洋洋地伸了个懒腰，仿佛对两名蒙面暴徒在他眼前晃动的枪口浑然不觉。他以令人心惊的漠然俯身探到柜台后——无视他们的叫嚣——啪地一声拨开收银机，面无表情地把一沓沓钞票塞进袋子里，动作像随手翻着一本杂志。把袋子递给暴徒后，他打了个哈欠，目送罪犯离开，随后才拿起电话。“喂，老板。嗯，又来了。”
The man in the cashier's booth stretches languidly, seemingly oblivious to the gun being waved in his face by two masked thugs. With alarming passivity, he reaches down behind the counter—ignoring their demands—and flicks the register open, filling a bag with notes dispassionately, as if flipping through a magazine. Handing the bag to the thugs, he yawns and watches the criminals leave before picking up his phone. “Hey, boss. Yeah, it happened again.”

一声沉闷的尖叫被闷在喉间，灵魂被拽入你早已备好的囚笼，化作一股扭动翻涌的能流疾冲入容器。你的行径之后只余阴森的寂静，而囚室之中，一点细小的女巫冷光慵懒浮荡，满怀不甘地等待你的号令。
With a muffled scream, the soul is drawn into your waiting cage, rushing into the vessel in a stream of writhing energy. Eerie silence follows your deed, and a small mote of witchlight bobs languidly inside the prison, begrudgingly awaiting your command.

Muddy Main Road.name:
泥泞主干道
Muddy Main Road

Text.text:
主路已成一条泥泞的车辙：腐臭黏滑的烂泥，混着尘土与马粪，踩上去咕叽作响。深深的辙痕与杂乱交叠的脚印、蹄印，昭示着不久前有个倒霉鬼曾拼命想把车赶过这片泥海。前方与其说是道路，不如说是一道考验。
The main road has become a track of mud: a rank, squelching mire of dirt and horse droppings. Deep ruts, and a jumble of foot- and hoof-prints, are evidence of a poor soul’s recent struggle to drive their wagon through the muck. What lies ahead is not so much a road as a challenge.

这枚胸针以青铜浮雕出等量的天平秤盘，昭示着一种商贾的标记：贸易——社会的一面，必须在摇摇欲坠的平衡上勉力维系。
With equal-leveled scales embossed in bronze, this brooch suggests a mercantile designation: trade, a facet of society that must be tenuously held in balance.

Subterranean Cavern With Gold Veins.name:
蕴藏金脉的地下洞窟
Subterranean Cavern With Gold Veins

Text.text:
洞窟在你的视线之外无尽延展，墙壁如要塞般拔地而起，高耸数百尺。若非地面、墙壁与穹顶上金色矿脉的缝隙渗出柔和微光，这里本将是一片绝对的黑暗。那光在板岩般的灰石上投下摇曳不定的反影。
The cavern sprawls beyond your sight, with walls like a fortress soaring upward hundreds of feet. The darkness would be absolute were it not for the soft glow emanating from seams of gold veining the floors, wall, and ceiling. The light casts wavering reflections across the slate gray stone.

Faerie Plane: Tiny Cottage.name:
妖精位面：小巧的村舍
Faerie Plane: Tiny Cottage

Text.text:
你翻过一座葱茏的山丘，长草披垂其上——柔柔流淌，宛如宁芙（特征）的发丝——其间簇生着一片红白相间的伞菌，有几朵还会不时轻轻蠕动。地上延伸着一条细细的土径，窄得远不足以容纳类人之足，直通一座微缩的小屋；小屋四周环绕着一圈小小的红花，如鬃如围。细小的金色光球悬在深红的花朵之间，像你在石圈处遇见的那些光尘般漂浮，微微闪烁，仿佛温和清风里轻轻作响的风铃。若是为更大的族类所建，这栋屋子以三层结构与醒目的A字屋顶，本该颇为壮观；可在这里，它蜷伏于草叶之间，像是被健忘的孩子遗落的玩偶屋。窗内透出淡淡的黄光，仿佛烛焰的辉映，你瞥见一道影子——有什么……有人？——正在其中移动。
You crest a verdant hill draped in long grass—flowing as softly as nymph’s hair—and a bevy of red-and-white capped mushrooms, some of which wriggle every so often. A thin line of earth, much too small for humanoid feet, leads up to a miniature home surrounded by a mane of small red flowers. Tiny golden orbs, much like the motes you encountered at the circle of stones, hover between the carmine blooms, shimmering like chimes in a clement breeze. The home, if it had been built for larger folk, might have been an impressive sight with its three-story-structure and bold A-frame roof. But here, nestled in blades of grass, it seems like a dollhouse misplaced by a forgetful child. The windows emit a faint yellow glow, as if from candle flame, and you catch the silhouette of something—someone?—moving within.

Techno Street Drug, Deep Impact: Injecte.name:
科技街头毒品，深度冲击：注射
Techno Street Drug, Deep Impact: Injected

Text.text:
当注射针刺入你的血肉，一股洪流瞬间淹没你的感官。晦暗难明的色彩翻涌旋转，彼此交融成分形纹路，像一座脉动的数字万花筒。你的意识骤然扩张，与赛博空间的以太相互熔接。在这投影般的状态中，数字领域铺展开来——数据的喧嚣、代码的织锦——现实的经纬开始模糊，你的心眼坠入虚拟无垠的广阔景象之中。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

As the hypo pierces your flesh, a rush floods your senses. Cryptic colors swirl, blending into fractal patterns, a throbbing digital kaleidoscope. Your mind expands, melding with the aether of cyberspace. In this projected state, the digital realm unfolds—a cacophony of data, a tapestry of code—as the skein of reality blurs and your mind’s eye plummets into the boundless vistas of the virtual.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

铁箍束紧的百叶窗作掩蔽，封住了小屋这侧的两扇窗。这里有一处火坑，里头是烧焦的木柴与一口宽大的铁锅，锅盖掀开着，几乎都埋在灰烬里。靠近小屋处放着一只木桶，几条鳞片泛着虹彩的大鱼尾巴从桶沿探出。光凭那股腥鲜气味就能断定——它们是刚捕上来的。
Shutters bound in iron bands cover the two windows on this side of the cabin. A firepit here contains charred wood and a broad iron kettle with its lid off, all mostly buried in ashes. Closer to the cabin is a wooden bucket. The tails of a few large fish with iridescent scales stick out of it. From the smell, they must be recent catches.

Ornate Sleigh Pulled By A Team Of Reinde.name:
由一队驯鹿牵引的华丽雪橇
Ornate Sleigh Pulled By A Team Of Reindeer

Text.text:
雪橇仿佛由一团团卷曲的花纹堆叠而成——脆弱而精巧，像一场精心梳就的发髻。滑橇两侧的滑刃镀着金，向前弯出，如同守卫般护在车前。栏杆同样鎏金，缠绕着常青花环。红色的侧板上，模版印出的冬青因风吹雨打而斑驳褪色，内里却奢华至极：厚重皮毛、软垫与羊毛毯一应俱全。驯鹿安静地站在铃铛叮当的挽具与缰绳中，嚼着反刍的草料，偶尔抬起一只蹄，又稳稳落回原处。有一头甩了甩脑袋，清脆的铃声随之响起。
The sleigh is a mass of curls, it would seem—as fragile and intricate as a hairdo. The runners are gilded and arc out before the sleigh like guardians. The railing, also gilded, is wrapped in garland. Stenciled holly, worn from exposure to the elements, is stamped along the red sides, while the interior is opulently equipped with furs, cushions, and woolen blankets. The reindeer stand calmly in their belled traces and harnesses, chewing cud and lifting the occasional hoof, then putting it back down. One shakes her head and a jingle rings out.

狭窄的岩柱在你头顶高耸，其顶端休息着一块巨大的巨石。乍看之下这般形态几乎不可能，直到你注意到岩柱与顶端之间截然不同的质地——一者被侵蚀得更快。怪异的轮廓投下独特的阴影，仿佛一只长颈生物的剪影。
The narrow spire of rock towers over you, and resting on its top is a massive boulder. The formation seems impossible at first, until you note the distinct differences between the spire and its top— one eroded faster than the other. The strange shape casts a unique shadow, evoking a long-necked creature in silhouette.

Cliffside Border Town In Spring.name:
春日峭壁边境小镇
Cliffside Border Town In Spring

Text.text:
你在门口盘旋的鸟群间穿梭而过，守卫们低声发笑。穿着鲜亮的镇民沿着蜿蜒的街道匆匆上行，缠着头巾的头顶上摇摇欲坠地顶着一篮篮农产。粉白的墙面映回水般的日光，浓烈的草药香在空气里弥漫。
The guards chuckle as you weave through the birds circling the gate. Crowds of brightly dressed townsfolk hasten up the winding thoroughfares, baskets of produce balanced precariously on turbaned heads. Whitewashed walls reflect the watery sunlight, and the heady smell of herbs fills the air.

Devlin Vladaam.name:
德夫林·弗拉达姆
Devlin Vladaam

Text.text:
他沉思良久，双手捧住自己的头，掌心贴着耳侧，轻轻一拧，便将脑袋“啵”地一声摘了下来。他把那可怖的头颅举在身前片刻——发丝间夹着一绺绺惨白——随后又把它安回颈上。他的眼睛泛着黄色，当然，皮肤也苍白无血。待这一瞬过去，他便又回到那副寻常模样：和气、机敏、带着几分傲气。他的装束考究——鹿皮与丝绸，剪裁得体的长礼外套与海狸毛帽，一根银柄手杖——而一股强烈的诡秘气息始终萦绕在他周身。

~ 由 Dewey Cheatem & Howe 扮演，并附

With great deliberation, he takes his head in both hands, palms against the ears, and pops it off. He holds the dread form, with hair streaked white, above him for a moment, then sets it back on. His eyes are yellow and, of course, his skin is pale. When this moment passes, he warms to his common self, pleasant, quick-witted, a little arrogant. His clothing is sophisticated—doeskin and silk, tailored top coat and beaver-fur hat, a cane with a silver handle—and a strong vibe of the eldritch surrounds him.

~ Played by Dewey Cheatem & Howe with

这尊石雕让你心里发毛，却又说不清究竟因何。那佝偻瘦长的躯体之上，顶着一张丑陋如蝠的面孔，双翼紧紧收拢贴在肩侧。它蹲坐着，利爪死死扣住身旁的石头以作支援，纹丝不动，毫无生气。你继续前行，刚把那张面容从脑海里抹去，便听见石头刮擦石头的声音。你回头一看，雕像已不见踪影。
The stone sculpture unnerves you, though you can't exactly place why. A hideous, batlike face peers out from atop a hunched, spindly body, a pair of wings tucked tight against its shoulders. It sits, claws gripping the stone around it for support, completely motionless and devoid of life. You pass, but just as you've pushed the thing's visage from your mind you hear stone scrape against stone. You turn to find the statue gone.

你手握一只镶金小瓶，向元素位面发出召唤，命令它们送来一名仆从。你的魔法先凝成一具幽魂般的人形轮廓，随即，你选定的元素以原初之力为这灵体披覆其身。你召来的盟友恭顺地静候你的号令。
With a gold-inlaid vial in your grasp, you call to the elemental planes, demanding they send you a minion. Your magic first takes shape as a ghostly humanoid form. Then, your chosen element cloaks this spirit in primal power. Your summoned ally dutifully awaits your command.

猪瘫倒在泥泞的地面上，鲜血与猪圈的污泥搅作一团。它那粉红、黑与褐色斑驳交织的皮肉覆在臃肿的身躯上，柔软的眼睛——嵌在湿亮的吻鼻上方——即便在死后仍带着困惑的天真，直直望向你。
The pig has slumped to the muddy ground, its blood mixing with the mire of the sty. Mottled flesh of pink, black, and brown covers its porcine bulk, and soft eyes—set above a glistening snout—gaze at you with questioning innocence even in death.

A Collapsing Hero.name:
崩塌的英雄
A Collapsing Hero

Text.text:
“我做不到。我脑子里想的全是家。我只想把自己蜷进壳里，再也不见天光。我真希望能把这颗脑子从颅骨里撕下来，换上一颗新的，可我做不到。对不起。”
“I can’t do this. All I can think of is home. I want to fold into myself and never see daylight again. I wish I could tear this mind from my skull and replace it with another but I can’t. I’m sorry.”

Entrance To Gothic Ballroom.name:
通往哥特式舞厅的入口
Entrance To Gothic Ballroom

Text.text:
赤红的地砖自入口处铺陈开来，在胡桃木大门上方高耸的玻璃窗滤落的日光里熠熠生辉。石柱沿着厅堂两侧列立，每边五根，每根柱脚都安着一座银制的枝形烛台。
Red tile flows from the entrance, shining in the daylight that filters through the tall glass windows above the walnut doors. Stone pillars line the room, five per side, and each is footed with a candelabra wrought of silver.

这件器具与其说像寻常农用镰刀，不如说更像一把大砍刀或玛卡维特尔；其刃身所用之铁沉重得不合常理，只可能出自异材——譬如陨铁，或强大魔像的残片。刀刃外侧与内侧皆被磨至剃刀般锋利，而握柄末端还有一处古怪的钩与环——或许是为镰索式配置预留，用以系上一条长绳。
Resembling a machete or macahuitl more than an ordinary farming sickle, the iron of this implement’s blade is so heavy that it can only be made of an exotic material, like meteoric iron or scraps of a powerful golem. Both the outer and inner blades have been honed to a razor’s edge, and there is a curious hook and loop at the end of the grip—perhaps intended for a long cord in a sickle-and-cord configuration.

方方正正的机器斜伏在山坡上，像一头蜷伏待扑的兽。机腹之内，乘员们手忙脚乱地回绞弹簧臂，哼喘、流汗、咒骂，全身力气都压进那吱呀作响的机关里。扭曲的筋索慢慢绷回原位，随后炮手几乎带着一种近乎虔敬的慎重，装入那枚刻满符文的弩矢。山下，有什么庞然大物正犁开树阵而来；众人屏息就位，祷词从干裂的唇间溢出。
Angled down the hill, the boxlike machine crouches. Within, its crew frantically winds back the spring arms, grunting, sweating, and cursing with effort. Slowly, the twisted sinew creaks into place, and almost reverently the artillerist loads the rune-etched bolt. Below, something large plows through the trees, and the crew makes ready, prayers spilling from cracked lips.

Toppled Statue Of An Ancient Deity.name:
远古神祇的倾覆雕像
Toppled Statue Of An Ancient Deity

Text.text:
边缘磨损、质地多孔，覆着地衣与苔藓的斑驳补丁，神像仰躺在地。手指与脚趾如今只剩残桩，四肢弯折抬起，仿佛一只肥硕的虫在死时蜷缩抽搐。然而若将其竖立，神祇便像是在起舞，庆贺那早已远去的年代——当它仍是统治世界的存在。
Worn at the edges, porous and patched with lichen and moss, the god statue lies on its back. The fingers and toes are stubs now, and the limbs bent and raised, as if the god were a fat bug constricting in death. But upright, the god would be dancing, celebrating the age long past when this was the being who ruled the world.

Floating Citadel Approaches Ship.name:
漂浮要塞逼近舰船
Floating Citadel Approaches Ship

Text.text:
它从肿胀翻涌的暴风云中猛然破出——一座工艺奇迹般的庞然造物，巍然盘踞天穹；苍白如日的光轮洒下冷影，沿着它的负载沉沉铺开。下方浪涛暴涨，被那维系巨型空中王城悬浮的魔法所搅起的狂风将一艘饱受摧残的船只抛来掷去。甲板上惊惶的尖叫此起彼伏，船员们仰望头顶的怪物，几近崩溃。
Bursting from swollen storm clouds, a miracle of artifice looms large in the sky, a pallid sun casting shadows across its bulk. Upon the surging waves, a beleaguered ship is tossed about by the high winds caused by the magic keeping the vast airborne citadel aloft. Panicked screams issue from the deck as the crew witnesses the monstrosity above.

一条蓝黑如鸦的羽绒围巾将男人苍白的面容半遮半掩，羽色深沉，与他自身的发丝完美相衬。莹紫的眼眸里燃着钻研者的野心，他神情沉思，仿佛正沉入无声的思索。夜色的甲胄披在他身上；衣装从子夜般的漆黑过渡到王者般的紫，更被一条闪耀的银项链点亮——它藏在围巾的羽间，宛如夜空里一颗星。手扶一根虬结的法杖，他以敏锐而聪慧的目光审视四周。

~ 由一位英雄 扮演，角色卡见

A scarf of blue-black raven feathers shrouds the man’s pale countenance, their deep hue matching his own hair perfectly. Studious ambition burns in eyes of lustrous purple, and he holds a pensive expression as if lost in thought. He is clad in the panoply of the night; his clothing ranges from midnight black to regal purple, further accentuated by a gleaming silver necklace hidden among the plumage of his scarf like a star in the night sky. Leaning on a gnarled staff, he surveys his surroundings with a keen and intelligent eye.

~ Played by a Hero with

画师眉头紧锁，神情专注。手握画笔，他们退后一步端详画布，偏着头从不同角度审视。嘴唇抿成一线，低低哼了一声，像是在权衡什么，随即又放开手脚扑回画前，用宽大而刻意笨拙的笔触大把抹上颜料。眼前的风景迅速成形并趋于完整——一座山、一汪粼粼的湖、点缀云朵的天空，与周遭地貌并无二致。“我差不多要画完了，”他们几乎是在自言自语，“稍等我一会儿。”
The painter's brow furrows in concentration. With brush in hand, they take a step back to examine the canvas, tilting their head to view it from different angles. They purse their lips, grunt thoughtfully, and return to the canvas with abandon, slathering paint with broad, intentionally clumsy strokes. The landscape taking shape before them manifests fully—a mountain, a shimmering lake, a cloud-dotted sky, not dissimilar to the surrounding region. "I'm just about finished," they say, almost to themselves. "Be with you in a moment."

I Cast See Invisibility.name:
我施放【看见隐形】
I Cast See Invisibility

Text.text:
我闭上双眼，双手在眼前掠过，仿佛掀起一层无形的薄纱。我念出揭示的咒语，将双手缓缓放下，令视线与幽冥世界之间的屏障变得稀薄。我的眼眸刹那间闪烁微光。此刻，它们已能看见被魔法所掩藏的一切。
I close my eyes and pass my hands over them as if raising an unseen veil. I speak the words of revealing and bring my hands down before me, thinning the barrier between my vision and the ghostly world. My eyes sparkle for a moment. Now they can see what magic has concealed.

Insult About Being A Joke.name:
嘲讽你就是个笑话
Insult About Being A Joke

Text.text:
“你有没有觉得，自己的人生不过是一场拿自己当笑料的庸俗玩笑？我在说什么，当然有过——你看看你自己就知道了。”
“Do you ever feel like your life has just been some banal joke at your own expense? What am I saying, of course you have, I mean look at you.”

Loot From A Jabberwock.name:
来自 Jabberwock 的战利品
Loot From A Jabberwock

Text.text: 一块铜牌上刻着Calloo，价值50枚金币；而一块金牌上刻着Callay，价值至少是前者的三倍。你找到一把装在皮鞘里的斩首长剑，鞘上压印着Snicker-snack。它会对任何愿意倾听的人开口说话。一个看起来像猪和海龟生的怪模样生物提出要当你的宠物，不过它说自己几乎肯定是混乱邪恶，而且不喜欢被抚摸。 A copper plaque engraved with the word Calloo is worth 50 gold pieces, and a gold plaque engraved with Callay is worth at least thrice that. You find a vorpal longsword in a leather sheath with the word Snicker-snack stamped into it. It talks to any who will listen. A creature that looks like a pig had a baby with a turtle offers to be your pet, although it says it is almost certainly chaotic evil and doesn’t like to be petted.

Highland Games, Putting The Heavy Stone.name:
高地竞技会：掷重石
Highland Games, Putting The Heavy Stone

Text.text:
一块二十五磅重、光滑圆润的花岗岩石球抵在她下巴下，由她的手稳稳托住；那女人肌肉虬结，筋络如绳。她双脚大开站稳，一只手伸出以维持平衡。她缓缓转身，继而在一瞬间疾旋一整圈，将铅球推出——石球飞出时轻若无物，仿佛不比周遭空气更沉。可它落地的一刻，轰然回响，提醒你它究竟有多重。
The twenty-five-pound smooth round granite stone rests under the chin, balanced by the hand, of a woman corded with muscle. Her feet are planted wide, one hand held out for balance. She turns slowly, then spins in one rapid circle and puts the shot, the stone flying as if it weighs no more than the air around it. But it lands with a reminder of just how heavy it really is.

Giant Spiders: Fight In The Catacombs.name:
巨型蜘蛛：地窖鏖战
Giant Spiders: Fight In The Catacombs

Text.text:
臃肿、鼓胀的阴影翻滚着坠入令人战栗的清晰之中，细长的腿将它们驮进你的视野。空洞漆黑的眼睛毫不眨动、毫无怜悯，从覆着甲壳的皱褶面孔上死死瞪来；其下是巨大的、湿亮的獠牙。你知道这嘶嘶作响的生物是一只巨型蜘蛛，可你的心智仍难以把它完整纳入理解——本能的恐惧攥住你的心脏，反射般的厌恶让你的胃里一阵发酸。
Bulky, bulbous shadows tumble into horrifying clarity as spindly legs carry them into view. Blank, black eyes, unblinking and pitiless, glare out from a wrinkled face of carapace above great, glistening fangs. You know this hissing creature is a huge spider, but still your mind struggles to grasp the totality of it—instinctive fear clutches your heart, and reflexive revulsion turns your stomach sour.

Plane Of Fire.name:
火元素位面
Plane Of Fire

Text.text:
这生物起初似乎无形无貌、毫无特征——一团阴影般的血肉球体，被看不见的魔力托举在半空。随后，这异怪真正的骇人之处骤然显现。触须自球形躯体中舒展开来，蜿蜒游动、层层解缠，扭转着朝你的方向指来。一张宽阔而无唇的巨口将球体撕裂般张开，露出一排又一排带倒刺、咯咯咬合的利齿。每根触须的末端都裂开一张布满牙齿的口器，滴落腐蚀性的唾液，邪恶的獠牙在幽光中森然闪烁。

~ Envisioned by Supergeek Mike

The creature at first seems formless, featureless—a shadowy, fleshy orb held aloft by an unseen magical force. Then the true horror of the aberration manifests. Tendrils unfurl from the spherical body, snaking and uncoiling to swivel in your direction. A wide, lipless mouth splits the orb open, revealing row after row of barbed, gnashing teeth. A toothy maw yawns open at the end of each tendril, dripping with caustic saliva and gleaming with wicked teeth.

~ Envisioned by Supergeek Mike

Well-kept Electric Bicycle.name:
保养良好的电动自行车
Well-kept Electric Bicycle

Text.text:
这辆电动自行车显然被一位一丝不苟的主人精心保养维护，轻量车架的每一寸都抛光得锃亮夺目。两条崭新的轮胎配着时髦的轮毂盖，每个都以醒目的字体骄傲地印着厂商名称。电机轮毂毫无锈蚀或腐蚀痕迹，电池外壳也被彻底擦洗得干干净净。
The electric bicycle is clearly well-cared for and maintained by a meticulous owner, as every inch of the lightweight frame is polished to a gleaming finish. Two brand-new tires feature stylish hubcaps, each proudly displaying the manufacturer’s name in eye-catching font. The electrical hub is free of rust or corrosion, and the outer casing of the battery has been cleaned thoroughly.

Insult About An Ancient Lair’s Smell.name:
嘲讽古老巢穴的臭味
Insult About An Ancient Lair’s Smell

Text.text:
“你怎么能住在这种地方，却对那股味道无动于衷？我是说，是你身上的味儿？还是这间屋子？还是哪张床垫底下藏着一堆尸体和腌鲱鱼？你能花上永恒去谋划恶行，却抽不出一个下午来稍微打扫一下？”
“How can you live in this place and not do anything about that smell? I mean, is it you? Is it this room? Is there a pile of corpses and pickled herring under a mattress somewhere? You spend an eternity plotting evil deeds but can’t take an afternoon to do a little cleaning?”

Hidden Dockside Tavern.name:
隐秘的码头酒馆
Hidden Dockside Tavern

Text.text:
在码头那肮脏阴暗的腹地里，这家酒馆像腐肉般苟活；知晓它存在的，只有社会最恶臭、最堕落的渣滓——以及观察他们的人。狭窄幽暗的酒吧间里，温热鱼腥与走味啤酒的馊臭纠缠在一起，混着烟草的呛烟盘旋不散；一双双躲闪的目光像无声的宣判，许诺任何胆敢破坏规矩的人都只有死路一条：室内禁带武器。

~ 由 Andrew Sanguine 于 Discord 上 构想

Rotting in the seedy underbelly of the docks, the tavern's existence is known to only the most foul, degenerate dregs of society—and those who observe them. The rancid odors of warm fish and stale beer mingle with tobacco smoke in the cramped, shadowy taproom as furtive glances promise death to any who break the code: no weapons inside.

~ Envisioned by Andrew Sanguine on Discord

Discovery Of A Destroyed Lich.name:
发现一位巫妖的毁灭遗骸
Discovery Of A Destroyed Lich

Text.text:
这间密室浸在幽幽的绿光里，血与骨将屠戮涂抹成画。断肢残块像被胡乱抛洒般散落满地，内脏的腥甜与铁锈般的血味在封闭的空气中浓得化不开。房间原本的浮华——华丽的装饰、奢侈堆叠的书卷与奇珍——都被这场噩梦般的血污彻底玷毁。巫妖一动不动地躺在房间中央的高台上。它凝固在绝望的姿势里：瘫伏于地，枯骨般的手伸向一枚碎裂的命匣。它破败的唇张开，仿佛仍在惊骇中无声嘶喊，空洞的眼眶里已不见不死之光。紫袍的裹布在胸口中央被撕得粉碎，露出一个骇人的大洞——那里曾安放着它冰冷的心脏。

~ 由 Arastin Leohorn 构想

The chamber, bathed in ghostly green light, is a scene of carnage painted in blood and bone. Body parts litter the floor in scattershot, the smell of viscera and iron thick in the cloistered air. The room’s ostentatiousness—rich decorations and indulgent collection of books and artifacts—is ruined with this nightmarish gore. The lich lies unmoving upon a raised platform in the center of the room. It is stuck in a position of desperation: sprawled on the floor, its bony hand extending toward a shattered phylactery. Its frayed lips are agape in horror and the light of undeath is gone from its hollow eyes. The wrappings of its purple robe are torn apart at the center of its chest, revealing a gaping hole where its cold heart once rested.

~ Envisioned by Arastin Leohorn

你召唤太阳——即便在深沉的黑暗中——它也会回应。随着你念完咒语，一股暖意在体内蔓延；你仿佛有一瞬间感到阳光落在脸上，随即那触感离你而去，化作自你身周绽放、向外扩张的璀璨光之球体。
You summon the sun—even in great darkness—and it answers. As you complete the incantation, a warmth spreads through your body and you feel the sun on your face for an instant before it leaves you, manifesting around you as a spreading sphere of brilliant light.

一扇矮人之门以坚实岩石凿成，门面镌刻着繁复纹样与符号，每一道刻痕都在诉说着非凡的技能。它以无与伦比的坚韧与巧夺天工的匠造铸就，唯有技艺登峰造极的工匠方能解开其中奥秘。此门既是艺术杰作，亦是屏障，守护着门后国度里隐秘的奇珍异景。
A dwarven door, hewn from sturdy stone, stands adorned with patterns and symbols, each line a testament of great skill. It has been crafted with unequaled durability and genius artifice, with only expert artisans able to unlock its secrets. The door is a work of art, a barrier guarding the hidden wonders of the realm beyond.

Futuristic Arms Dealer's Shop.name:
未来军火商的店铺
Futuristic Arms Dealer's Shop

Text.text:
[空置且伪装] 你踏入这间小小的双层店铺，隔音装置启动时发出一声短促的哨响——将外头市集的喧闹尽数遮蔽。柜台上堆满数不清的小玩意与奇巧装置：细小珠串、火花工具、旧数据板。游牧风的壁挂与新奇的霓虹海报沿墙排开。一架摇摇欲坠的金属梯通向二楼。视野里没有任何一件武器。

[正在使用] 你踏入这间小小的双层店铺，隔音装置启动时发出一声短促的哨响——将外头市集的喧闹尽数遮蔽。光秃秃的墙面、金属陈设——这里讲究的是实用。无数枪械与军备铺陈在各处表面：沉重步枪、退役军用道具、缠绕红色能量脉动的凶刃。每件武器都用沉重的组合锁固定在金属面上，拇指指纹解锁。你从由一架摇摇欲坠的金属梯可达的上层小平台，听见脚步的踩踏声与一阵撕裂般的咳嗽。

[Vacant and Disguised] You enter the small two-tiered shop and there is a brief whistle as the sound-dampener kicks in—masking the chatter of the market outside. Countless trinkets and gizmos clutter the counters around you: small beads, sparktools, and old datapads. Nomadic wall hangings and novelty neon posters line the walls. A rickety metal ladder leads to the upper floor. There is not a single weapon in sight.

[In Use] You enter the small two-tiered shop and there is a brief whistle as the sound-dampener kicks in—masking the chatter of the market outside. Bare walls, metal furnishings—this is a place of utility. Countless arms and armaments are displayed across the surfaces: heavy rifles, ex-military gear, wicked blades pulsing with red energy. Each weapon is attached to the metal surface by a heavy combi-lock with a thumbprint release. From the smaller upper deck, accessible by a rickety metal ladder, you hear the tread of feet and a hacking cough.

地下密室——礼拜之所下方一处干燥的夹层——被充分利用起来。标着各异符号的木桶与箱笼看不出内容物的端倪，却无疑在教会办公室某处的账簿里逐一登记。覆着一层细尘的布单像护罩般铺盖在精巧或易于失去光泽的物件上。这间临时地窖的回声绵长得惊人，你甚至未及察觉，嗓音便已不自觉地压低。
The undercroft, a dry pocket beneath the place of worship, has been put to good use. Barrels and crates marked with different symbols provide no obvious clues as to their contents, but are undoubtedly cataloged in a ledger somewhere within the church offices. Sheets covered with a fine layer of dust lie protectively over delicate or easily tarnished items. The echo in this makeshift cellar has such sustain that you find your voice hushed without conscious decision.

Cave Opening High Up A Mountain.name:
高耸山腰的洞口
Cave Opening High Up A Mountain

Text.text:
在这般海拔，唯有无情的冰冷狂风才能肆虐，你终于触及一处通往山体深处的洞穴——在如此高度，几乎闻所未闻。刺骨寒流的凶猛冲击逼得你泪水横流，你明白若要探明它的来历，就必须踏入洞中，逃离这残酷的天气……只是你不禁思忖，究竟会有怎样的生物栖身于此。
Buffeted by the merciless, icy gales found only at this elevation, you reach a cave leading into the mountain's interior, something virtually unheard of at this altitude. Your eyes streaming against the vicious blasts of freezing air, you know that divining its origins requires entering the cave, and exiting the cruel weather… though you do wonder what manner of creature might inhabit this place.

你吟诵守护之词，在四面八方画出护身的手势。你比划出的动作在空中凝出耀眼的银色符印，符文悬浮闪耀一瞬，随即沉入你的体内，为你的衣袍与肌肤镀上一层银辉。那抹守护的银色开始渐渐褪去……
You chant words of warding, making signs of protection on all sides. Your miming creates luminous silver sigils in the air. These runes hover and glow for an instant, then sink into your body, giving your garments and skin an argent cast. That protective color begins to fade…

Skeleton Archer.name:
骷髅（特征）弓箭手
Skeleton Archer

Text.text:
褴褛的破布与干枯萎缩的皮肉碎条，紧紧黏在那从黑暗中踉跄而出的生物腐朽的骨架上。它每踏出一步，背后磨损欲裂的箭囊里，古老的箭矢便发出令人不寒而栗的喀啦声；而那扭曲的枯骨手指，则如铁钳般死死攥着一把变形的短弓。
Tattered rags and strips of dry, withered flesh cling to the rotting bones of the creature lurching out of the darkness. With every step ancient arrows rattle menacingly in the fraying quiver on its back, and gnarled bony fingers hold a warped short-bow in a vicelike grip.

Portal To The Shadow Plane.name:
通往暗影位面的传送门
Portal To The Shadow Plane

Text.text:
洞窟门户的地面覆着一缕缕瘀紫的阴影触须，它们向上探起几英寸，随即转向，朝你倾斜而来。触须从洞壁、甚至从夜色本身抽走色彩，除它们那幽暗的影光外，一切都显得苍白贫血，披着一层灰。你越靠近，思绪越被倦怠与失落的雾气蒙住；当你第一脚踏上那翻涌的紫影地面，一阵寒意直透全身，仿佛你忽然变得没那么活着。

~ Envisioned by Icemonkey744

The floor of the cave portal is covered in tendrils of bruised purple shadow that reach up a few inches and then angle toward you. The tendrils pull color from the cave walls, even from the night itself, so that everything but their shadow light seems pale, anemic, clothed in gray. Your mind fogs with boredom and loss as you approach, and your first footfall on the writhing purplish floor sends a chill through you, as if you are suddenly less alive.

~ Envisioned by Icemonkey744

Ferrofluid Magneto-cluster.name:
铁磁流体磁团簇
Ferrofluid Magneto-cluster

Text.text:
一滩银色液体以轻松而迅捷的姿态，黏滑地从周遭流过。它直径三英尺，幽暗的躯体仿佛要将空间填满；转瞬间伴着尖细的嗡鸣骤然磁化。软泥周围的极性翻转，零碎的金属残屑被猛然吸拢，触及之际发出令人作呕的湿腻液响。银色水洼的中心迸出一记短促的蓝光脉冲，随即继续向前流淌远去。
A pool of silver liquid oozes past its surroundings with an easy quickness. Three feet in diameter, its dark body seems to fill the space, briefly magnetizing with a high-pitched whine. The polarity around the ooze shifts and small metallic debris flies toward it, making sickening liquid noises upon contact. A brief pulse of blue light flares at the center of the silver puddle before it continues its journey onward.

Border Town Market.name:
边境镇集市
Border Town Market

Text.text:
货物进得古怪：同一个行会匠人送来太多犁具挽具，货郎那儿却连马掌钉都不够。简陋的方盒子小店外墙涂得花哨，却已褪色；商贩也懒得对着稀疏的人流吆喝。尘土与粪泥像灰浆般糊满大道，但提篮的女人与捻着八字胡的男人间仍有欢声笑语——一袋橙子随着疲惫的商队在午夜姗姗抵达。
The wares come in strangely. Too many plow harnesses from one guildsman, not enough hobnails from a peddler. The simple box bodegas are colorfully painted but fading, and the merchants seldom bother to shout at the sparse traffic. Dust and manure spackle the thoroughfare, but there is good cheer among the women with baskets and the men twisting their mustachios: a sack of oranges has arrived with the weary midnight arrival of a caravan.

一抹邪魅的微笑挂在那张空灵、超凡脱俗的绝美容颜上，红皮的存在向你伸出一只带爪的手。蝠翼般的翅膀整齐地收拢在这生物背后，一条灵巧而筋肉紧绷的尾巴在身后漫不经心地左右轻甩。硫磺般的黄瞳闪烁着诱人的许诺，这地狱孽种向你致意——然而，在那层彬彬有礼的薄纱之后潜伏的恶意，几乎超出凡人所能理解的边界。
A wicked smile graces a countenance of ethereal, otherworldly beauty as the red-skinned being offers you a clawed hand. Bat-like wings are folded neatly upon the creature’s back, and a dexterous, sinewy tail flicks idly from side to side at its rear. Eyes of sulfurous yellow sparkle with promises as the hellspawn greets you—yet the malice hiding behind their veneer of civility is almost beyond mortal comprehension.

那平民小心翼翼地挪步前行，拄着一根朴素的手杖，沿着道路摸索着走下去。那双乳白的眼睛空洞地望着虚无，却时不时侧过头，竖起耳朵捕捉周遭的一切动静。
The commoner moves carefully, picking their way down the road with a simple walking stick. Their eyes, milky white, stare at nothing in particular, but they frequently cock their head to listen to the goings-on around them.

Loot From An Animated Scarecrow.name:
来自一具被赋生的稻草人的战利品
Loot From An Animated Scarecrow

Text.text:
如今那踉跄的稻草人已一动不动，你才看清，赋予它行动的人还特意给它穿得颇有派头。它脚上挂着一双上好的皮靴，激斗过后依旧完好无损。塞在它麻布脑袋里那团稻草间，还嵌着一枚护符，似金铸而成，形如一颗大脑。
Now that the shambling scarecrow lies unmoving, you can see that whoever animated it decided to dress it with some panache. A pair of fine leather boots dangles from its feet, still in good repair after the struggle. Nestled in the straw that stuffs its sackcloth head is a charm that appears to be made of gold and is in the shape of a brain.

Sundries From A Puppeteer Hag.name:
鬼婆（特征）的傀儡师杂货
Sundries From A Puppeteer Hag

Text.text: 在那件破烂斗篷里、挤在鬼婆（特征）弯曲的脊背上，你摸到一个被深色污渍浸透的麻袋，用一截磨损起毛的绳子紧紧扎着；绳子黏在你手上，像湿漉漉的头发。袋子鼓胀得仿佛装着又大又圆的水果。然而，从那沉甸甸的分量，以及袋中物体一声声带着肉感的 thunks 闷响判断，你猜里面绝不是什么新鲜的果蔬。 In the ratty cloak, bunched over the hag’s curved back, you find a darkly stained sack tied with a fraying rope that sticks to your hand like wet hair. The bag bulges as if it is holding large round fruit. However, from the weight and meaty thunks of the objects within, you guess the contents are not fresh produce.

Bone Devil Encounter.name:
骨魔遭遇
Bone Devil Encounter

Text.text:
周遭的微光仿佛骤然黯淡，一头恐怖自翻涌起伏的传送门中现身，倒刺长尾悬在一侧枯骨般的肩头上方。它咧开僵硬的狞笑，残破的双翼霍然张开；那具披覆白骨的庞然憎恨拖着沉重身躯踱步逼近，巨爪探出，欲将你攫入掌中。它眼眶深处的漆黑凹穴里燃着怨毒的灵智，尖牙满布的巨口吐出地狱般的嘲弄。
The ambient light seems to dim as a horror emerges from an undulating portal, barbed tail hovering above one skeletal shoulder. Rictus grin wide, tattered wings unfurled, the immense mass of bone-sheathed hate ambles forward, huge claws reaching out to grasp you. Spiteful intellect smolders within the black pits of its eyes, and infernal mockery spills from its fanged maw.

这条水道如同数百年来那般恣意流淌，宽阔得足以让老练的驳船船长视为理想航线。岸边的刻痕昭示着这里有汛期——当源头来水增多，水位便会暴涨——而沿两岸铺展开的野生稻田，则无声见证着这片水域赐予生命的丰饶。
Flowing as freely as it has likely done for hundreds of years, this channel is wide enough that the skillful captain of a river barge would find it a desirable route. Marks along the banks indicate there is a flood season—when the levels rise from greater input from channel's source—and the wild rice paddies growing along both banks lay testament to the water's life-sustaining bounty.

I Use My Rod Of Security To Transport To.name:
我用安保之杖将自己传送到一座宁静的花园里
I Use My Rod Of Security To Transport To A Tranquil Garden

Text.text:
我激活长杖时，微风懒懒拂过，送来盛放野花的幽香；就在我们各自一闪、从原地消失之前，那气息仍萦绕鼻端。再回过神来，我们已站在柔软葱茏的草地上，四周繁花如锦，蜂群嗡鸣不绝。阳光穿过轻轻摇曳的枝叶，在地面洒下斑驳的光斑，如同一汪汪温暖的碎金。
The scent of blooming wildflowers drifts lazily on the breeze when I activate the Rod, just before each of us blink out of existence. We find ourselves on soft, verdant grass surrounded by beautiful flowers and buzzing bees, as sunlight falls in dappled pools through the leaves of gently swaying branches.

I Cast Gate Using My Cubic Gate.name:
我用魔方之门施放「异界之门」
I Cast Gate Using My Cubic Gate

Text.text:
当我按下符号，一股咆哮的魔能巨浪在我周身盘旋，立方体的强大力量随之解放。一道巨大的传送门骤然开启，仿佛将现实撕成两半，如同麻布被扯裂；我看见一个不同的世界正回望着我，它的每一种性相都异质得令凡俗的感官无从承受。
