When I press the symbol, a roaring wave of magical energy swirls around me as the potent forces of the cube are unleashed. A large portal opens, splitting reality in two as if it were sackcloth, and I see a different world staring back at me, every aspect alien to my mortal senses.

Rehabilitation Training Yard.name:
康复训练场
Rehabilitation Training Yard

Text.text:
这片院子里四处都摆着长椅，大半地面覆着柔软的草与三叶草地被。你看到几段平整的长条泥地，木桩立起扶手，沿着路段延伸。院墙一侧排着器械架，摆放着各式装备：哑铃、拉伸弹力带、备用拐杖，以及助行器。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Benches are available throughout this yard, most of which is blanketed in a soft groundcover of grass and clover. You see a couple long stretches of even dirt with handrails set up via wooden posts. Racks line the yard, holding various pieces of equipment: weights, stretching bands, spare crutches, and walkers.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Slay An Arctic Vampire After Long Hunt.name:
在漫长的追猎之后，斩杀一名极地吸血鬼（特征）
Slay An Arctic Vampire After Long Hunt

Text.text:
将木桩狠狠贯入猎物的心口，你阴冷地满足着——看那扭曲的精灵剧烈一颤，它拼命想穿过魔法屏障逃离的徒劳挣扎终于停歇，身躯瘫倒在冰封的地面上。然而，当你眼睁睁看着那吸血鬼（特征）轰然炸裂成血红雾霭，在雪地里不留半点踪迹时，胜利却如灰烬般噎在喉头。你望向受伤且疲惫的伙伴，回想这段旅程里你们一同走过的一切——以及你失去的——不禁自问：这一切，值得吗？

~ 构想：Sahlonahl

Driving a stake through the heart of your quarry, you take grim satisfaction in watching the twisted elf shudder as its desperate attempts to flee through the magical barrier cease and it slumps to the frozen ground. However, your victory turns to ash in your mouth as you watch the vampire explode into blood-red mist, leaving no trace of its presence in the snow. You look to your wounded and weary companions, think on all you have been through together on this journey—what you have lost—and wonder: was it worth it?

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl

Pyramid Emerges From Magic Bean.name:
金字塔自魔法豆中破土而出
Pyramid Emerges From Magic Bean

Text.text:
抛出的豆子落地休息，随即猛然铺展开来，化作一块边长六十英尺的方形平板。它迅速干涸成砂——粗砺而沉重——继而震颤、研磨。由沙粒雕塑出的朦胧躯体浮现，披覆着蒙尘的青金与黄金。尘带翻涌攀升，缠绕盘卷，将那具身躯层层裹紧。一具石棺自发构筑，合拢在木乃伊（特征）周身。随后，一道倒卷的旋风向上拧起——不透明的锥形风柱拔尖成峰，又轰然坠地，尘埃散尽，只留下金字塔冷峻而洁净的几何轮廓。

~ 由 Envisioned 应邀构想，灵感来自 Pack Tactics

The tossed bean comes to rest then suddenly spreads out to a flat, sixty-foot square tile. It dries to sand—gritty and heavy—then quakes and grinds. A vague body, sculpted from the sand, is clothed in dusty lapis and gold. Bands of dust writhe up, winding and wrapping about the body. A sarcophagus constructs itself around the mummy. Then an inverted whirlwind twists upward, an opaque cone that peaks, crashes to the ground, and leaves behind the clean geometry of a pyramid.

~ Envisioned by Pack Tactics

一截抛光黑曜石打造的锤柄，以柔韧光滑的皮革缠束，其上托着一枚锯齿状的晶质锤首，噼啪作响，涌动着奥术之力。那闪耀的紫色晶体将战锤衬得阴森凛冽，武器嗡鸣低颤，仿佛其中的魔力几近失控。
A haft of polished obsidian bound with smooth leather supports a jagged crystalline head crackling with arcane power. The scintillating purple crystal casts the hammer in sinister relief and the weapon thrums with barely contained magics.

Young Blue Dragon.name:
幼年蓝龙
Young Blue Dragon

Text.text:
幽蓝鳞片层层倾泻，如深海暗涌；腹侧却像被烈日漂白的枯骨。蓝龙微微移重、舒展身躯，二十英尺的翼展随之展开。它每一次吐息都裹挟着刺鼻的臭氧风暴，房间里的空气随之一紧，你全身每一根汗毛都竖立起来。电光在它那张嶙峋的瘦削面孔前跳跃迸裂——一根骨质般的独角高踞鼻端，噼啪作响。闪电般的黄眼四下游移，狡黠的智慧冷冷盘算。它的体型或许只比大象略小一线，尚未臻至长老之境，但这生物的威名，早已在世界诸沙漠中成为传说。
With cascading scales of deep blue and an underside like that of sun-bleached bone, the Blue Dragon shifts its weight and stretches, revealing its twenty-foot wingspan. Every breath exhaled by this dragon fills the room with a gust of ozone; every hair on your body begins to stand on edge. Electricity dances and sparks from the bone-like horn that sits upon the snout of this dragon’s gaunt face. Lightning-yellow eyes dart around with clever intelligence. While its size might be just barely smaller than an elephant, and it is not yet an elder, the might of this creature is legendary in the deserts of the world.

一项真正的建筑奇迹深藏在山体核心——一座闪耀的紫水晶之城，由覆盖这座晶洞洞窟表面的水晶雕琢而成。光束自穹顶裂缝倾泻而下，使那通透的高塔如晴夜繁星般熠熠生辉。瀑布亦自上方世界渗入这片晶莹深渊，飞流的水帘映出城池的色泽与光辉。石英般的塔尖高耸越过天际线，外墙则由混沌却美丽的分形纹路层层铺展。一座粗砺的黄水晶桥引你前往其间，桥下深堑回荡着奔流的水声。

~ Envisioned by Phil2point0

A true feat of architecture lies nestled within the core of the mountain—a shimmering, amethyst city crafted of the crystals that cover the surfaces of this geodic cave. Rays of light beam through cracks in the ceiling, making the pellucid towers sparkle like stars in a clear night sky. Waterfalls also permeate from the world above and into the crystalline abyss, their cascades reflecting the color and glitter of the city. Its quartz-like towers rise high above the city line, and the outer walls are fractals of chaotic yet beautiful patterns. A rough citrine bridge leads you there, the chasm below echoing with the sounds of running water.

~ Envisioned by Phil2point0

Dragon's Breath (Acid) Cast On Ally.name:
龙息（酸液）施放于盟友
Dragon's Breath (Acid) Cast On Ally

Text.text:
你紧握着辣椒，一边吟诵咒文，一边将它拧转。辛辣的汁液顺着你的指缝滴落，你向盟友伸手，攥住他们的前臂，完成了这道法术。他们的手臂鼓起细密的泡，血管化作一抹鲜亮的翠绿。有东西从他们的喉底翻涌而上，唾液坠地，发出带腐蚀性的嘶嘶声。

~ 由 Donnie

You grasp the pepper in your grip, twisting it as you speak the incantation. The juice of the pepper drips down your fingers as you reach out to your ally and grip their forearm, finishing the spell. Their arm bubbles, veins turning a vibrant green. Something rises in their gullet, and saliva hits the ground with a caustic hiss.

~ Played by Donnie

Polycarbonate Long-range Antipersonnel R.name:
聚碳酸酯远射程反人员步枪
Polycarbonate Long-range Antipersonnel Rifle

Text.text:
如果死亡有一把步枪，那就该是这副模样。漆黑如子夜，这把线条冷峻而优雅的武器在每一处性相里都渗出致命气息。狭长的瞄准镜伏在碳纤维枪身之上，机匣被剥去一切多余，只留下最必要的部件；而枪管则从前端向外延伸，足足一米之长。这是职业死神代言人的武器。一枪，一命。
If Death had a rifle, it would look like this. Black as midnight, the sleek, elegant weapon exudes lethality in every aspect. A narrow scope perches atop a carbon-fiber body stripped of all but the most necessary components, and the barrel extends a full meter beyond that. This is the weapon of a professional death dealer. One shot, one kill.

Embedded Laser Weapon.name:
内嵌式激光武器
Embedded Laser Weapon

Text.text:
这座深埋的炮塔蜷伏在塑钢混凝土外壳中，宛如一头阴沉的野猪；短粗的脉冲长矛如同致命獠牙。它的固定平台搭载多门激光武器，足以从容抵御地面或空中来袭。凭借先进的追踪与瞄准系统，它能同时侦测并打击多个目标，是行星防御网格中至关重要的一环。
The entrenched turret squats within a plasticrete housing like a brooding boar, snub-nosed pulse lances forming lethal tusks. Its static platform houses multiple laser weapons capable of defending against land or aerial assaults with ease. Loaded with advanced tracking and targeting systems, it can detect and engage multiple targets simultaneously, a vital component in the planet's defense grid.

Tinestone & Portgrade In Winter.name:
冬日的锡石镇与港阶城
Tinestone & Portgrade In Winter

Text.text:
如同随风而来的低语般悄然，你能感到廷石的白色石冢正以力量的脉动嗡鸣。雪花凝滞在石冢上方，悬停不落，织成一条闪耀的分形光线，笔直通向天穹。三名书卷气十足的人注视着这一异象，彼此热切地交谈着。赶往波特格雷德的行人几乎只草草瞥了石冢一眼——要么没注意到这场景，要么干脆彻底无视。
Subtle as a whisper on the wind, you can feel the white cairn of Tinestone thrum with power. Snowflakes suspend stagnant above the cairn, creating a glistening fractal line directly to the heavens. A trio of scholarly-looking people observe the phenomenon, chatting fervidly to one another. The passersby on their way to the Portgrade barely give the cairn a passing glance—either missing the event or ignoring it completely.

空气刺骨寒冷，干得像刀子一样，从你的皮肤、口腔与眼睛里硬生生榨走每一滴水分。雪的沙丘绵延数里，冰冷的峰脊在远处太阳浅淡的光线里灿然闪耀。你的呼吸喷涌如烟云翻卷，为露出的额发覆上一层霜白的冰翳。
The air is bitterly cold and bone dry, prying every drop of moisture from your skin, mouth, and eyes. Dunes of snow stretch on for miles, their icy peaks glittering brilliantly in the shallow rays of the distant sun. Your breath plumes out like billows of smoke, coating exposed bangs in a frosty white rime.

Coven Meeting In Cave.name:
洞窟中的秘会
Coven Meeting In Cave

Text.text:
诡异而低沉的吟诵在这座石灰岩洞穴中回荡。环形摆放的黑色蜡烛，火光在洞壁上排列的半透明白色晶簇间折射、映返。每支蜡烛之间都站着一名身披黑袍的身影，宽大的袖口与兜帽将他们的面容尽数遮住。唯有吟诵者赤裸的双足清晰可见。圆环之内刻着一枚六芒星，正中央是一座黝黑石质祭坛，其上横放着一只圣杯与一柄长剑。
Eerie, low chanting echoes through this limestone cave. Black candles arranged in a circle reflect off and through translucent white crystals which line the walls. Between each candle stands a figure in black robes, their sleeves and hoods hiding their features. Only the bare feet of the chanters are visible. Inside the circle is a six-pointed star, and at the center is an altar of dark stone with a chalice and sword laid on it.

那些词语——你所知最古老、最强大的词语——带着敬畏与迟疑，缓缓抵上你的唇边。咒语出口后，没有任何喧哗。没有炫目的光芒，没有奥能的爆裂迸发。可远处传来低沉的雷鸣。空洞而突兀的风骤然卷起。一种强烈到令人窒息的感觉在你脑海中滋长：有什么不一样了。有什么改变了。你已将现实的丝线一一拆解。
The words—the oldest, the most powerful you know—come to your lips with a reverence, a hesitance. No fanfare follows the incantation. No flash of light, no burst of arcane energy. But distant thunder rumbles. A hollow, sudden wind picks up. An intense, overwhelming feeling grows in your mind: something is different. Something changed. You have unraveled the threads of reality.

Elliah Ventrullian.name:
艾莉娅·文特鲁利安
Elliah Ventrullian

Text.text:
一名精灵女子从巨鹰的阴影下走出，猩红长袍与煤黑长发在魔法的狂风里肆意翻涌。她的颈间、耳畔与臂上尽是繁复珠宝，皆为精灵工艺。她抬手指向天空，手腕上的圈镯叮当作响。绿眸一闪，幽深而带毒——却没有任何法术从她唇边逸出。她只是轻轻以修长指甲掠过巨鹰的颈侧。它低低咕哝，沾血的喙贴上来，亲昵地蹭着她的掌心。

~ 一位英雄 构想

An elven woman emerges from under the shadow of a giant eagle, her scarlet robes and coal-black hair flowing wild with magic. Her neck, ears, and arms are drenched with ornate jewelry, all of elvish make. She reaches a hand to the sky, her wrist jingling with bangle bracelets. Her green eyes flash, deep and venomous—but no spell leaves her lips. She instead gently trails her long nails across the eagle’s neck. It coos, nuzzling her hand with its blood-stained beak.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

一缕精金薄片在咒言出口的刹那化作火星四散。原本唯有血肉之处，如今覆上一层闪烁的第二层肌肤——通透、冷冽、密不透风……且坚不可摧。
A sliver of adamantine dissolves into sparks at a spoken word. Where once there was only flesh, now lies a shimmering second skin—a layer of impermeable protection, clear and cool… and utterly unassailable.

洞窟高高拱起，流石般的沉积构造在洞壁辉映的背景前投下层层阴影；洞壁上长满发光的菌状增生。蓬松的霉菌泛着白光，蘑菇则在幽蓝到紫罗兰的光谱间明灭，有些伞下垂着黏液，折射出细碎的光。水滴缓缓渗落，坠入菌丛间的水洼，涟漪搅乱了穹顶倒影。轻柔的“噗叽”声暗示着腐生的菌毯里困着的水正缓慢流动，终将汇入洞穴的蓄水之处。空气里满是蘑菇气息，夹着一丝腐败与雨后的潮味。

~ Ethan T 构想

The cavern arcs high, flowstone formations forming shadows against the backdrop of the cave walls, which are luminous with fungiform growths. Fluffy molds shine white, while mushrooms glow in ranges of blue to violet, slimes dangling from some of them, refracting the light. Droplets trickle and fall into pools among the fungi, ripples disturbing reflections of the ceiling. Soft squelching hints at water trapped in the saprophytic growth making its way, inevitably, to the cave’s reservoirs. The whole place smells of mushrooms with a hint of rot and rain.

~ Envisioned by Ethan T

要塞城垛上雕满的无数石像鬼以钢铁般冷硬的目光扫过你。那些石质怪物逼真得令人心悸，仿佛下一刻就会让石牙咬进毫无防备之人的血肉。没有雕像的地方，乌鸦成群聚集，在[night]的天空映衬下投下诡异的剪影。令人费解的是，[sun/moon]投下的阴郁影子似乎一路尾随你们的队伍，但在它们的黑暗中，找不到半分安全。
The steely-eyed glare of the numerous gargoyles carved into the battlements of the keep sweeps over you. The stone monsters look so realistic that one could easily imagine their stone fangs sinking into the flesh of the unwary. Where there are no statues, ravens gather, casting eerie silhouettes against the backdrop of the [night] sky. Inexplicably, the gloomy shadows cast by the [sun/moon] seem to follow your party, but there is no safety to be found in their darkness.

Brooding Virtuoso.name:
阴郁的炫技大师
Brooding Virtuoso

Text.text:
这名衣衫不整的男人，眼周妆容晕染成污痕，却有一双锐利而璀璨的眼睛；他以近乎超人的速度与理解力，将周遭一切尽收眼底。他冷漠地穿过身旁一圈谄媚簇拥的人群，目光无悲无喜。那位大师缓缓起身，喉间挤出一声痛苦的叹息……随即将手中的酒杯猛地掷向墙壁。爆裂般的粉碎声后，先是一阵骇然的死寂，继而人群爆发出喧闹的掌声与狂热的赞美。对他们而言，他的一举一动都值得以近乎信仰的虔诚膜拜。
Ringed with smudged makeup, the sharp, brilliant eyes of the disheveled man take in everything around him with near superhuman speed and comprehension. He stares dispassionately through the crowd of fawning sycophants around him, and the virtuoso lets out a tortured sigh as he stands… and then hurls his glass at the wall. A stunned silence follows the explosive shattering before raucous applause and adulation erupt from the crowd. These people view his every act with fanatical devotion.

Chain Shirt Armor.name:
锁子衫护甲
Chain Shirt Armor

Text.text:
这件由细密链环织成的长衫想必耗费了数周才打造完成。微小的铆接圆环编织得紧密却不失柔韧，你只在寥寥几处看见修补过的痕迹。袖子似乎稍短了一点，但看起来你仍能穿得合身。
This long shirt of fine links must have taken weeks to craft. The tiny, riveted rings have a tight but flexible weave, and you see only a few spots where repairs have been made. The sleeves look like they might be a bit too short, but it looks like you could fit.

Border Town Inn.name:
边境小镇旅店
Border Town Inn

Text.text:
寒风如冰刃般穿透你的衣物，裹挟着雨水狠狠抽打着你，直到你踏入旅店温暖的怀抱。你感激地把湿透的斗篷挂在入口旁一个空钩上。几乎空荡的酒馆里飘着新出锅的饭菜香气——唯一的客人是一队矮人，正紧盯着摊在一张桌上的地图。你踩着新铺的芦苇发出咯吱声，走到吧台前，问那位编着辫子的伙计是否还有空房。他放下正在擦拭的酒杯。“应该还有一两间空着。”他把一本皮面账簿拉到面前。“一队雇佣兵今天早些时候退房了，把他们原来的房间收拾出来用不了多久。”他从吧台下抽出一支羽毛笔，抬眼望着你，像是在等你报上姓名。
The wind cuts through your clothing like an icy blade, driving the rain with it, until you step into the warm embrace of an inn. You gratefully hang your sodden cloak on an empty hook near the entrance. The smell of freshly cooked food wafts through the almost empty taproom—the only patrons being a party of dwarves staring intently at a map spread out on one of the tables. Crunching across fresh reeds, you approach the bar and ask the fellow with braided hair if rooms are available. He puts down the tankard he’s polishing. “We should have one or two free.” He pulls over a leather-bound book. “A band of mercenaries checked out earlier today. It shouldn’t take long to make up their old rooms.” He takes a quill from beneath the bar and looks at you expectantly.

Seventh Year Fellowship Ritual.name:
第七年盟誓仪式
Seventh Year Fellowship Ritual

Text.text:
毕业班共同施展一道法术：告别礼。众人齐声诵念，动作整齐划一，直到象征离别的符号显现；随后，致告别辞者说出他们自选的一句告别词。接着，致欢迎辞者也说出自己的选择，然后每位毕业生依照围成的圆环，逐一轮到自己。最后一人开口后，法术在众人的齐声中完成——笑与泪交织，既欢又伤。
The graduating class performs a communal spell: Valediction. They recite and gesture in unison until the symbol for their parting appears; then the valedictorian speaks a goodbye word of their choosing. The salutatorian follows with their choice, then each graduate in turn around the circle. After the last person speaks, the spell is completed in unison—amid tears of laughter and sorrow.

孩童般的咯咯笑声在天然井中回荡，一点柔和的小光在黑暗里翩然起舞。它越靠越近，摇曳的发光触须后方，忽然迸出一对令人脊背发凉的紫红眼光。一个威诺瑞克的琵琶鱼人鱼推着战斗轮椅，借此在陆地上行动，甩动着修长如流瀑的尾鳍，拨开阴影的帷幕而来。那甜美的笑容也掩不住从唇间探出的细长尖牙；他们仍咯咯笑着，望见新朋友，迫不及待要将其引路。

~ 访问 Forge Ahead: A Party to Access 了解更多关于 Lophii Formes

Childlike giggles echo throughout the cenote as a small, gentle light dances around the darkness. As it approaches, spine-chilling flashes of fuchsia eyes spark behind a swaying esca. A wynorrific anglerfish merfolk with a long, flowing tail using a combat wheelchair to aid their mobility on land pushes past the veil of shadows. Their sweet smile cannot hide the long, thin, sharp teeth jutting from their mouth as they continue to giggle at the sight of new friends to guide.

~ Visit Forge Ahead: A Party to Access to learn more about Lophii Formes

Rivals Realize Player Still Lives.name:
宿敌意识到玩家仍然活着
Rivals Realize Player Still Lives

Text.text:
面具坠落——只一瞬——当真相像匕首般沉进他们的脏腑：你还活着。礼貌的薄漆仍旧挂在表面，可在他们镇定的外壳之下，念头像逃离沉船的老鼠般乱窜。有些人更擅长把不快藏好；另一些人则没那么高明，他们以为无人注意时，脸就扭成带着威胁的狞笑。

~ 由 Clara C. Potter 在 Discord 上 构想

The mask drops—only for a second—as the truth settles in their guts like a dagger: You're alive. Though the veneer of civility lingers, beneath their calm exteriors thoughts scamper like rats fleeing a sinking ship. Some are more adept at hiding their displeasure than others, whose faces twist into menacing sneers when they think no one is looking.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Sundries From A Young Brass Dragon.name:
年轻黄铜龙的杂货
Sundries From A Young Brass Dragon

Text.text:
你注意到巨龙的犄角上挂着几枚小铃铛，黄铜色泽各不相同，微微泛着差异。它一旦躁动，铃声便哗啦作响，尖厉得令人心头一震——每一枚都敲出独一无二的音符。
On the dragon’s horns, you notice several small bells, all slightly different hues of brass. When agitated, they jingle with a jarring trill, each playing a unique note.

Noble With One Arm.name:
独臂贵族
Noble With One Arm

Text.text:
当赦免私掠的委任状、地契、法令文书，以及教士们寄来的往复信函一摞摞堆满桌面，贵族厌倦地叹了口气，便埋头处理递到眼前的每一页。他们飞快地划下签名，羽毛笔频频蘸墨却不洒一滴；又在烛火上融化封蜡，随即压上王室印玺。最后，他们攥紧手掌舒展酸痛，指节狠狠顶进肩窝——那里曾经连着另一条手臂。

~ 扮演：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

When the parchment letters of marque, the deeds, the writs, and the correspondence from the clerics are all stacked on the table, the noble sighs with boredom and gets to work on each page presented. They scrawl rapid signatures, quickly dipping the quill in ink without spilling a drop, and melt wax over a candle to then press into the royal seal. They clench their hand to stretch away an ache and dig a knuckle into their shoulder where another arm once was.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

地上散落的骸骨，是很久以前踏入这些厅堂之人的仅存痕迹——又或许，他们只是差一点就能逃出去。北侧走廊两侧的墙上，壁灯座尽数破碎；然而，几束从走廊天花板裂缝间漏下的苍白微光，落在一堆碎石瓦砾上，那堆废墟几乎堆到墙面半高。向东的短廊尽头，一扇门倒卧在地。
Skeletons on the floor are all that is left of whoever entered these halls long ago—or maybe they just barely failed to escape. On the wall bracketing the north corridor are broken sconces, but a few dusty shafts of pale light from cracks in the corridor’s ceiling land on a pile of rubble that reaches halfway up the walls. The short eastward passage ends at a door lying on the floor.

穿过一扇狭窄的门口，你来到一间小卧室——陈设寥落，却纤尘不染、井井有条。门旁的挂钩上挂着一套熨烫平整的黑色制服；一张铺得一丝不苟的床紧紧嵌在一只大衣柜与一只抽屉柜之间。另一侧一道逼仄的拱门通向更里头：一张小桌上放着木盆与水桶，旁边是一条石凳，凳面中央开着一个洞。
Through a narrow doorway, you find a small bedroom—sparsely decorated, yet immaculately clean and tidy. A pressed black uniform hangs from a hook near the door, and a perfectly made bed sits snugly between a large wardrobe and a chest of drawers. A cramped archway leads to a wooden basin and bucket atop a small table beside a stone bench with a hole at its center.

Call To Arms: Beasts In Battle.name:
战斗号令：兽群参战
Call To Arms: Beasts In Battle

Text.text:
涎沫飞溅在他们咆哮的嘴边。汗水浸透了他们的身侧。鼻孔大张，眼睛眯成细缝，面孔扭曲成介于狂怒与恐惧之间的疯狂神色。而当你把目光从士兵移向与之厮杀的怪物时，它们看起来更为凄惨。战争把所有人都变成野兽。
Spittle flecks their snarling mouths. Sweat drenches their flanks. Nostrils are flared wide, eyes squinted into slits, and faces contorted in mad expressions somewhere between wrath and terror. And when you shift your gaze from the soldiers to the monsters engaged in this fight, they look even worse. War makes beasts of everyone.

澄澈的碧蓝海浪轻柔地拍打着金色沙滩。海水温暖，几乎像浴池般舒适，各色斑斓的海洋生物在水晶般清透的深处慵懒漂游。树木在温热、夹带咸味的海风中摇曳。
Clear, turquoise waves lap pleasantly against the golden sand. The water is warm, almost the bath-like, and all manner of colorful sea life float lazily in its crystal-clear depths. Trees sway in the warm, salt-laced breeze.

你在掌心捏碎石英，一股突如其来的刺骨寒意自指尖涌出，沿着四肢奔流，直击心口。你呼出一团冬日般的冰冷白雾，抬手一指——寒冰骤然在你面前拔地而起，成形时噼啪开裂、吱呀作响。
You crush the quartz in your hand and a sudden, biting cold flows from your fingers, through your limbs, to strike your heart. You breathe out a wintery plume of frigid mist, and point—ice springs up suddenly before you, cracking and creaking as it takes shape.

贝希尔用甩动的长尾将你缠住，尾巴猛然收紧，束缚你的四肢，把你拖向它后方锋利的爪子。

[逃脱失败] 贝希尔仍将你牢牢箍住，盘卷的长尾越收越紧，它后爪一阵乱抓，在你身上撕出道道伤痕。

[使用敏捷逃脱] 你扭动身躯，从盘卷的尾巴间滑脱出去，尽管它仍拼命想把你按住。

[使用力量逃脱] 你硬生生撑开那一圈圈蓝色的肌肉，将缠绕撑出空隙，纵身一跃脱离束缚。

The behir snares you in its whipping tail, cinching around you, restricting your limbs and drawing you closer to its rear claws.

[Failed Escape] The behir still holds you fast, and its coiling tail draws tighter as the rear claws rake you.

[Escape Using Dexterity] You squirm, sliding free of the coiling tail even as it tries to hold you.

[Escape Using Strength] You force the loops of blue flesh open enough to leap free.

Drum-fed Automatic Shotgun.name:
鼓式供弹自动霰弹枪
Drum-fed Automatic Shotgun

Text.text:
这把凶残的霰弹枪底部悬着一只巨大的圆形弹鼓弹匣，里面整齐盘卷着二十多发猩红弹壳。复合材料、缩短的枪管，以及专有的排气系统，将原本足以令人难以承受的后坐力硬生生压了下去。枪身外壳经过定制喷涂：一头燃烧的骷髅猎犬在其上咆哮，红色的每一种色阶都在火焰里翻涌。枪的其余部分则被猩红溅点泼洒得斑驳不堪。
A colossal round drum magazine hangs from the base of this brutal shotgun, housing over twenty scarlet shells stored in a neat curl. Composite materials, a shortened barrel, and a proprietary gas expulsion system mitigate what would otherwise be unbearable recoil. The housing of the gun has been custom painted with a great flaming skeletal hound, howling in every shade of red. The rest of the gun is spattered in scarlet.

Awakening After Being Washed Ashore.name:
被海浪冲上岸后的苏醒
Awakening After Being Washed Ashore

Text.text:
你最先注意到的是盐味。那刺痛感骤然灌满鼻腔，像一根针猛地贯穿后脑，你痛得一缩，眼后那片黑暗的空间里，整个世界失控地旋转。片刻过去；疼痛退潮。你睁开眼，看见……天空？你仰躺在沙地上，盯着头顶如梦似幻的云丝。你起身，眼前是一条狭窄的海滩与一望无际的大海。地平线上，一场猩红与漆黑交织的暴怒风暴正逼近，宛如沉睡的黑龙盘踞。太阳已低垂；在黑暗降临前，所剩时间不多了。
The first thing you notice is the salt. The stinging sensation fills your nostrils so suddenly that it shoots through the back of your skull and you wince from the pain, the whole world spinning out of control in the black space behind your eyes. A moment passes; the pain subsides. You open your eyes and you see… the sky? You’re lying on your back in the sand, staring at the wisps of dreamlike clouds above. You stand and see a narrow beach and a vast sea. The vivid red and black fury of a tempest looms along the horizon like a slumbering black dragon. The sun is low; there isn’t much time before the darkness comes.

你扣下扳机，本以为会迎来熟悉的后坐力猛冲，可什么也没发生。你恼得咬牙，飞快检查手中的武器。卡壳。你低声咒骂着，赶紧动手排障修理，而周遭的交火仍在怒吼般持续。 You pull the trigger expecting the usual force of recoil, but nothing happens. Grimacing in frustration, you quickly inspect your weapon. Jammed. Cursing, you set about repairing it as the firefight rages around you.

薄雾贴着荒原低低掠过，飘散开来，露出一片诡异的景象。覆满苔藓的地面隆起成数十个土丘，仿佛有位泰坦堆起一排排干草垛般大小的丘陵，随手丢下便离去了。
Mist scuds low across the moors, drifting away to reveal an eerie landscape. The mossy ground rises in dozens of hummocks. It’s as if a titan made rows of hills the size of haystacks then left them.

半精灵斜倚在近旁的墙上，嘴角挑起一抹油滑的笑意；他心知肚明，自己这副浪荡做派，不管对朋友还是陌生人，要么惹人倾心，要么惹人火冒三丈。从他柔软的骑乘长靴靴筒上缘探出的匕首柄，到他几乎下意识、单手反复洗弄的那副纸牌，他都以一种轻松的泰然自若承受着旁人不耐的白眼——也同样承受着飘来的赞赏目光——而那份从容本身，恰恰就是一场表演。
Leaning against a nearby wall, the half-elf flashes you a smarmy grin, knowing as he does so that his rakish airs will either charm or anger friends and strangers alike. From the dagger hilts protruding from the tops of his soft riding boots to the deck of playing cards he shuffles one-handed with almost unconscious repetition, he weathers the irritated glances of others—as well as the looks of admiration that float his way—with an easy equanimity that is a performance in and of itself.

Offer For A Quest At Sea.name:
海上委托任务的邀约
Offer For A Quest At Sea

Text.text:
“海面戴着静谧安宁的面具，而其下蛰伏着被历史遗忘的怪物，也藏着愿意伸手夺取之人才能得到的璀璨宝藏。”
“The sea wears a mask of stillness and serenity, but beneath it lies monstrosities forgotten by history, and dazzling treasures for those willing to take them.”

Staff Of Fire.name:
火焰法杖
Staff Of Fire

Text.text:
抛光的黄铜法杖顶端冠着一只闷燃不息的长明火盆，与杖身上描绘的火焰纹饰相互辉映。金属在接触时带着令人愉悦的温暖，而这道强大的奥术导体周遭空气里，隐隐弥漫着一缕硫磺的气息。
The polished brass staff is crowned by a smoldering brazier of eternal fire, matching the flaming motifs depicted on the haft. The metal is pleasantly warm to the touch, and a faint aroma of brimstone fills the air around the powerful arcane conduit.

Tournament Melee Misconduct.name:
锦标混战中的不当行为
Tournament Melee Misconduct

Text.text:
观众被眼前的搏杀牢牢攫住。孤身一名骑士——她是队伍的最后一人——正绝望地招架着三名敌手。他们不依不饶地围砍猛劈，叫嚷着要她认输。她却拒不屈服，反将每一次斩击尽数格开。忽然，她一个趔趄摔倒在地，竟是被一个已被放倒的对手绊倒。人群瞬间怒火爆发，看台上“犯规！”的喊声此起彼伏，震耳欲聋。
The spectators are gripped by the combat before them. A single knight, the last member of her team, desperately fends off three foes. They relentlessly hack at her, shouting for her to yield. She does not, instead parrying every blow. Suddenly, she stumbles and falls, tripped by an already floored opponent. The crowd erupts in fury, and cries of “Foul!” fill the stands.

Snake Pit Trap.name:
蛇坑陷阱
Snake Pit Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 你还没看见变化，就先听见脚下不对劲。那声音轻轻的……嘶嘶作响？像枯死皮屑摩擦，又像水壶将要鸣叫前的预热。你小心翼翼地探了探前方凹凸不平的地面，其中一块忽然塌陷，彻底激怒了下方坑里翻滚纠缠的一团蝮蛇。

[触发！] 你狼狈地直坠而下，却惊讶地发现落地异常柔软。起初你还以为地面像海绵般富有弹性，甚至有些可塑；可惊魂稍定后，你才觉出脚下正朝数十个方向同时蠕动翻腾。你挣扎着想站稳，双手却不断擦过四周光滑冰凉的鳞皮躯体。令人毛骨悚然、无孔不入的声响包围着你——像热铁板上滋滋作响的培根油脂——无数蛇形长躯在感知到你的闯入后，齐齐发出不满的嘶响！

[Perceived] You hear a difference in the ground before you see it. It's softly... hissing? Like the rubbing of dead skin or a kettle preparing to whistle. You carefully prod the uneven surface in front of you and a section of it collapses, absolutely infuriating a writhing mass of vipers in the pit below.

[Triggered!] You plummet unceremoniously down but are surprised by the softness of your landing. At first it seems that the ground is quite spongy, even pliant. But after the initial shock you find that the ground is writhing beneath you in several dozen directions. Your hands brush against smooth, scaly bodies all around you as you struggle to gain footing. An unnerving and all-pervading sound, like bacon fat on a hot griddle, surrounds you, as countless serpentine snakes register their displeasure at your presence!

Slovenly Hacker's Apartment.name:
邋遢黑客的公寓
Slovenly Hacker's Apartment

Text.text:
昏暗公寓里一片狼藉，混乱如同主宰万物。废弃硬件与吃到一半的外卖盒堆成漫山遍野，地板的痕迹早被彻底吞没。空气里弥漫着馊掉的咖啡味、未洗的体臭与廉价香烟的辛辣。多块屏幕喷吐着跳动的光，彩虹般的霓辉在墙面上脉动流淌。就在这座凌乱的圣所深处，一个佝偻的身影深陷电竞椅，面前是一台一尘不染的主机；一根搏动的线缆从他们的头骨延伸而出——直插进机器之中。

~ 一位英雄构想

Entropy reigns in the cluttered mess of the dimly lit apartment. A sprawling mass of discarded hardware and half-eaten takeout containers mask any trace of a floor. The air reeks of stale coffee, unwashed flesh, and cheap cigarettes. Multiple screens spew throbbing lights, painting the walls a with rainbow glow. Amid this disheveled sanctuary a hunched figure sits deep within a gaming chair, an immaculate console before them, a pulsing cable running from their skull—directly into the machine.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Pyramidal Mountain Peak.name:
金字塔状山巅
Pyramidal Mountain Peak

Text.text:
巍峨的峰顶宛如一截磨砺至极的矛尖，直刺苍穹，仿佛大地正向云间某个不可见的猎物猛然一击。然而，这座令人望而生畏的山巅却是被冰川反复雕琢、磨平而成，峭壁陡立如墙，峰体四面皆险，任何敢于攀登的人都将面对艰巨的考验。
The towering peak resembles a sharpened spear point jutting toward the heavens, as if the earth were stabbing some unseen quarry among the clouds. Yet the forbidding mountain peak was shaped and smoothed by glaciers, forming walls so steep that every one of the peak’s faces presents a significant challenge to those brave enough to attempt an ascent.

Sundries From A Siren.name:
海妖的杂货
Sundries From A Siren

Text.text:
她那一头翡翠般的绿发被巧妙地缠上了几枚小小的软体贝壳——从半透明、如蜗旋般的螺纹，到泛着金光的宝螺。除了这些好看却不值钱的点缀外，她的耳垂上始终戴着两枚嶙峋扭结的珊瑚尖刺，颈间还绕着一圈海藻项环，叶片在橄榄绿与锈橙之间交替摇曳。
Her emerald green hair is tangled artfully with small mollusk shells, from translucent snail-like swirls to golden cowries. In addition to these pretty, if valueless, adornments, she always wore two gnarled spikes of coral in her earlobes and a loop of seaweed about her neck with leaves alternating between olive green and rusty orange.

Destroyer: Outer Hull.name:
毁灭者：外部船壳
Destroyer: Outer Hull

Text.text:
毁灭者的外层舰体布满无数战斗留下的伤痕，昭示着它久经沙场的血脉与功勋。激光炮从舰体两侧的武器挂架上狰狞地凝视虚空，而在俯瞰舰船甲板的舰桥加固玻璃之后，船员们正来回奔走，脚步匆匆。
The destroyer’s outer hull bears the scars of many battles, a testament to its martial pedigree and service. Laser cannons stare menacingly out into the void from weapon mounts along each side of the craft, and crew hurry to and fro behind the reinforced glass of the bridge overlooking the ship’s deck.

Dying Ogre.name:
濒死的食人魔
Dying Ogre

Text.text:
他仰面平躺在麦田里，四周尽是受伤与死去的农夫，以及被踩断的金黄麦秆翻卷成的混乱。那魁梧的肚腹浸满鲜血，从地面隆起，一柄干草叉从中直刺而出，像一面插在腐臭孤岛上的旗帜。食人魔喘得发嘶。右手死死攥住那把叉柄，左手将一只盛着恶臭烈酒的皮囊倾向嘴边。他大半都洒了出来，能喝多少算多少，随即松手任皮囊坠落。
He lies flat in the wheatfield, surrounded by wounded and dead farmers and the chaos of broken yellow crops. His great belly, covered in blood, rises from the ground, a pitchfork sticking up from it like a flag on a putrid island. The ogre wheezes. His right hand clutches the pitchfork. His left tips a hide bag of foul liquor toward his mouth. He spills most of it, drinks what he can, and drops the bag.

Authoritarian Council Chambers.name:
威权议会厅
Authoritarian Council Chambers

Text.text:
半圆形的高台将议员们抬得比地面上的人更高；而那张沿弧线延展的高桌与其后高背椅，更将用意昭然若揭——让所有被带到他们面前的人都显得渺小可笑。围成圆弧的尽头是一道仅开一扇门的半墙，将人群隔在外头，使任何前来求告之人都落入进退维谷的境地：他们不得不在众目睽睽之下，宛如供人围观的戏码般陈情辩白。
The semi-circular dais places council members higher than those on the floor, but the tall desk following its curve and high-backed chairs behind it make it even more apparent the intent is to belittle anyone brought before them. The circle is completed by a half-wall with a single door that fences out the crowd, putting any supplicants in the unenviable position of serving as a spectacle as they plead their cases.

Insult About Being Exhausting.name:
关于你有多烦人的侮辱
Insult About Being Exhausting

Text.text:
“听着，不是我不喜欢你，我觉得你挺棒的。只是跟你待在一起太耗人了。”
“Look, it’s not that I don’t like you, I think you’re great. It’s just that you’re exhausting to be around.”

Crystal Formation Bridge.name:
水晶结晶桥
Crystal Formation Bridge

Text.text:
即便在幽邃中稀薄的微光里，这里的巨大紫水晶仍仿佛在反射并吐出一抹淡淡的光辉。它们在你面前的深渊上方交织成一座险恶的桥，你小心翼翼地踏上去。有些晶面更通透，有些更如镜面，映出你身形的重影，令你周遭仿佛有不安的流动——还是说，那是别的什么在跟着你，始终卡在你眼角的余光之外？
Even in the scarce light of the Deep, the giant amethyst crystals here seem to reflect and emit a faint glow. They form a treacherous bridge over the chasm before you, which you step onto carefully. Some of the surfaces are more transparent or reflective than others, creating duplicates of your forms and a sense of uneasy motion around you—or was that something else following you, just out of the corner of your eye?

Green Dragon Lair.name:
绿龙巢穴
Green Dragon Lair

Text.text:
穿过层叠瀑布翻涌的水雾，顶着刺骨寒水如鞭的重幕，你发现一片错综复杂的隧道群：在巨大洞窟的迷宫里分叉、交错、彼此贯通。苔藓覆满每一寸表面，湿润腐殖土的气味渗透整个空间。再往深处，开裂的白骨成堆堆叠，地面与石壁上横贯着深深的爪痕。某种庞然巨兽低沉而有节律的呼吸声传入耳中——巨龙就在前方。
Through the mist of a cascading waterfall, through the punishing curtain of frigid water, you find a complex series of tunnels, branching and crossing in a cavernous maze. Moss covers every surface and the smell of loamy earth permeates the space. Deeper within the caves cracked bones lie in piles and deep claw marks run along the floor and walls. The deep, rhythmic breathing of some great beast reaches your ears—the dragon lies ahead.

Divine Underground Home Of A Dwarven God.name:
矮人神祇的神圣地下居所
Divine Underground Home Of A Dwarven God

Text.text:
在地下熔炉之下的矿脉深处，隐匿于凡人对深度的理解之外，矮人之神栖居于奢华的殿堂。精金、秘银、白金与黄金镶饰墙壁，勾勒出一道道门廊的轮廓。漫长的宴桌在火炬光下延展开去，桌上堆满盛着红肉的大盘，旁边是装着蜜酒与麦酒的酒杯。柔软的长榻与床榻铺满诸室，没药与肉桂的香气自香炉袅袅弥散。大地秘密所闪耀的财富在矮人之神的王座前铺陈开来，殿堂回荡着深沉的乐音与粗犷的笑声——强壮的矮人男女举杯同饮，彼此相庆。
In a mine below an underground smithy, secreted away beyond the mortal comprehension of depth, the dwarven god lives in opulent halls. Adamantine, mithril, platinum, and gold adorn the walls and frame the doorways. Long banquet tables filled with chargers of red meat and cups of mead and ale stretch under torchlight. Comfortable couches and beds fill chambers scented by braziers of myrrh and cinnamon. The sparkling wealth of the earth’s secrets spreads before the Dwarven God's throne, and the halls rumble with deep music and the rough laughter of powerful dwarves, male and female, toasting together.

I Resist The Will Of A Magical Mask.name:
我抗拒魔法面具的意志
I Resist The Will Of A Magical Mask

Text.text:
面具的边缘与我的眉骨融为一体，以一种可疑的蠕动摩挲着我的太阳穴。随后，一股存在——丝滑而阴祟的东西——从我的皮肤间悄然钻入。它在我颅骨深处低语，我眼睁睁看着自己的四肢不受控制地行动。凭着意志猛然一震，我抬起如铅般沉重的手臂，狠狠将面具从脸上扯下；失去它的瞬间，我的皮肤一阵发麻刺痒。
The edges of the mask meld to my brow, massaging my temples with a dubious wriggling. Then, a presence—something silken and sinister—insinuates itself through my skin. It whispers inside my skull, and I see my limbs move of their own accord. With a surge of will, I lift my leaden arms and wrench the mask from my face, my skin tingling in its absence.

Potion Of Flying.name:
飞行药剂
Potion Of Flying

Text.text:
你凑近端详那只透明的药剂小瓶，发现里面的液体同样澄澈，却比清水更为轻盈起泡。你一经拿起，瓶中的气体便在瓶颈上方聚拢翻涌，宛如高空劲风里疾驰的云团。
Peering into the clear potion vial, you see that the liquid inside is equally clear, though of a fizzier consistency than water. As you handle it, the gases inside form up at the top of the vial’s neck, resembling clouds moving in high wind.

Flask Of Alchemist's Fire.name:
炼金火焰瓶
Flask Of Alchemist's Fire

Text.text:
这只小小的陶罐以无法撬动的盖子严密封住，成年人类的一只手掌便能轻松托住。罐身两侧都有人用黑色模板画刷出同一幅图案：一簇赤裸的火焰自一堆犬牙交错的碎片中猛然喷薄而出。
This small earthenware pot, sealed over with an immovable lid, fits easily within the palm of an adult human’s hand. On both sides of the pot, someone has painted a black stencil drawing of a naked flame erupting from a pile of jagged shards.

A Tenday's Travel By Foot Through Jungle.name:
穿越丛林的十日徒步旅行
A Tenday's Travel By Foot Through Jungle

Text.text:
丛林在你身周合拢，浓密、幽暗，却又生机沸腾。各色怪异而诱人的植物——几乎涵盖你能想象的所有颜色——在芳香潮湿的风里簌簌作响。昆虫无休止的嗡鸣伴着你的跋涉，远处传来吼猴的长啸。你踏上旅途，沿着灌木层里栖居的生物留下的踪迹前行。但随着天色渐暗，你不得不挥砍纠缠的藤蔓与盘结的粗根开路。你睡得断断续续，在不散的热与湿里汗流不止；夜里惊醒时，营地边缘有生物在徘徊窸窣。第三天，你踉跄闯入一头巨大的豹形生物的行进路线，只得绕道向相反方向多走数里。第五天，你被缠人的套索藤死死绞住，只能绝望地挥砍挣脱。头顶高处那不可穿透的林冠将阳光层层过滤、遮蔽，昏暗开始一点点磨蚀你——你不禁怀疑，自己是否还能再见到太阳。

~ 构想：Spac3cowboyy

The jungle closes in around you, dense and dim and teeming with life. Strange, alluring plants in every imaginable color rustle in the fragrant, humid wind. The incessant buzzing of insects accompanies your trek, while howler monkeys hoot in the distance. You set out on your journey, following paths left by creatures dwelling in the shrub layer. But as the day wanes, you find yourself forced to hack through vines and gnarled roots. You sleep fitfully, sweating in the persistent heat and humidity, waking in the night to creatures prowling the outskirts of your camp. On the third day, you stumble into the path of a massive panther-like creature, and find yourself detouring leagues in the other direction. On the fifth day, you find yourself entangled in snaring vines and desperately hack your way through. The lack of sunlight, filtered and shaded by the impenetrable jungle canopy high above, begins to wear on you—you wonder if you’ll ever see the sun again.

~ Envisioned by Spac3cowboyy

City Of Splendors.name:
辉煌之城
City Of Splendors

Text.text:
深水港俯瞰着这座喧嚣的海岸大都会，宛如城市蔓延的心脏；阳光下，尖塔熠熠生辉。城市从参差的海岸一路延展至北方高耸的峰巅，紧贴着山脉的侧翼而生。数十万居民汇聚于此，文化与血脉纷繁如织，昼夜不息地在街巷间生活与劳作，使道路在每个时辰都人声鼎沸。来自邻近城市与遥远大陆的船只与商队昼夜抵达，运来既寻常又奇异的货物。
The deep-water harbor dominates the urban sprawl of this bustling coastal metropolis, its spires gleaming in the sun. The city extends from the ragged coast to the soaring peak to the north, hugging the mountain’s flanks. Hundreds of thousands, comprising myriad cultures and ancestries, live and toil here, filling the streets at all hours of the day. Ships and trade caravans from neighboring cities and distant continents arrive day and night, hauling goods both mundane and exotic.

Sundries From A Shadow Dragon.name:
影龙遗珍
Sundries From A Shadow Dragon

Text.text:
黑鳞泛着紫意，在巨龙幽黯绵延的躯体深处忽明忽暗；它的形体摇曳不定，宛如不稳水面上的倒影。龙首软塌塌地贴在地上，颌骨歪斜着大张。你仍能看见它喉咙深处残存的一抹黯紫微光。
Black scales tinged purple wink from within the tenebrous stretch of the dragon’s body, its form wavering like a reflection on unsteady water. Head lying limp against the ground, its jaw is splayed crookedly open. You can see a dim violet light still aglow at the back of its throat.

A Highland Tree Weathers A Spring Storm.name:
高地孤树挺过一场春日风暴
A Highland Tree Weathers A Spring Storm

Text.text:
树在颤栗的微风中摇曳，纤细的枝条向风的凶猛力道俯首。翠绿的叶片紧紧攀附在枝桠上，柔韧的叶柄如受惊的孩子般战栗，在风暴中苦苦支撑。暴雨成片抽打着孤寂的山坡，将葱茏的高地浸透在浓烈的雨后土腥香里——这是本季第一场倾盆大雨。

~ 构想：Lukeon Discord

The tree sways in a tremulous breeze, its narrow branches bowing to the formidable strength of the wind. Veridian leaves cling to the boughs, their willowy petioles trembling like frightened children as they weather the storm. Rain lashes the lonely hillside in mighty sheets, soaking the verdant highlands in the heady aroma of petrichor—the first deluge of the season.

~ Envisioned by Lukeon Discord

Sir Azurix.name:
阿祖里克斯爵士
Sir Azurix

Text.text:
他身上刺着一段奥秘的符文，唯有当他引导自身职业的魔法时才会发光；除此之外，他的神态始终冷静自持。身高不过三英尺，他却以一名英勇骑士应有的笃定昂然立身。头顶棘刺向后梳掠，蓝得与他的鳞片、利爪与尾巴如出一辙。他身着绿色软垫外衣，高领挺立，亮色滚边衬得他更显威仪；腰间系着装满法术材料小袋的皮带，其上悬着一柄精灵长刃。需要之时，那刀锋出手迅捷而流畅。

~ Played by Anthony Goetzinger with

He is tattooed with an arcane script that glows when he channels the magic of his class, but his bearing is otherwise cool. He carries himself, all of three feet tall, with the confidence of the valorous knight he is. His spines are swept back on his head, blue like his scales, claws, and tail. Regal in his green padded coat with its high collar and bright trim, he carries an elven blade on a belt of spell component pouches. The blade is wielded quickly and smoothly when needed.

~ Played by Anthony Goetzinger with

浩瀚众界。涅槃。天堂与地狱。虚无。人类的词汇里，充斥着指向湮灭的种种称呼。你将它粗粝的译意编码进机器语言：Format Device。接收这条指令必定骇人至极，但你是逐出之令的执行者——那力量令人沉醉得发烫。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The Great Beyond. Nirvana. Heaven and Hell. Nothingness. Human vocabulary is rich with words for oblivion. You encode its rough translation in machine language: Format Device. Receiving this command must be horrible, but you are the agent of excommunication—and it’s intoxicatingly powerful.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Dimly Lit Coffee Bar.name:
灯影昏沉的咖啡吧
Dimly Lit Coffee Bar

Text.text:
咖啡吧安静而舒适，是逃离城市无休止节奏的一处令人欣慰的避风港。柔和的爵士乐在温暖的空气里蜿蜒流淌，带着从容不迫的洒脱，在新鲜咖啡的馥郁香气间轻盈起舞。雨点敲打着窗户，把外面的街道揉成一幅朦胧的现实抽象画，与这间咖啡馆的宁静庇护所相隔甚远。
The coffee bar is quiet and cozy, a welcome escape from the relentless pace of the city. Smooth jazz meanders through the warm air, dancing amid the aroma of freshly brewed coffee with easy nonchalance. Rain patters against the windows, transforming the streets outside into a blurry abstraction of reality, far removed from the peaceful haven of the cafe.

Large Orc Camp.name:
大型兽人营地
Large Orc Camp

Text.text:
风向一转，你就闻到了他们：兽人。他们的营地藏在蕨丛间，隐蔽得近乎无迹可寻。他们懒得搭帐篷、生火做饭；相反，每个兽人都只是在阴影里找了块地方，白日酣睡。以你的位置根本数不清他们到底有多少——两打？也许更多。若他们设了哨戒线，你肯定是从缝隙里溜过去了。
The wind shifts and you smell them: orcs. Their encampment is well hidden amid the bracken. They’ve not bothered to raise tents or build fires. Instead, each orc has simply found a shady spot to snooze through the day. It’s impossible to count them all from your position; two dozen? Maybe more. If they set up a sentry line, you must have slipped past it.

剧痛撕扯、喘息如破风箱般吃力，一个可怜的身影从空间的虚无里拖出自己腐朽的躯壳。它的嘴大张着，因所有肌腱都已萎缩而松垮的下颌来回摇晃。它仍穿着那套旧宇航服，胸牌被时代的獠牙磨得褪色，如今已无法辨认。空间尘埃覆在凹陷的额头上，双眼不存一丝光亮。可那呼吸……那嘶哑的喘息仍在继续。有节律，不可避免。
Racked with pain and gasping for air, a pitiful form drags its rotten husk from the void of space. Its mouth hangs agape, the slack jaw swinging now that all the tendons have atrophied. It still wears its old space suit, the name tag faded by the jaws of time, now illegible. Space dust crests the sunken brow, and the eyes hold no light. But the breath… the wheezing breath continues. Rhythmic, inevitable.

大地在你靴下战栗，一头巨硕的存在蹒跚闯入视野。它是由灰白积雪、腐朽寒冰与刀锋般的碎石堆叠成的巍峨巨团，以撼天动地的起伏循环推进——先如沙暴之墙般高高隆起，继而又以雪崩般的放纵倾泻而下。两只蓝霜之眼自它的核心躯块中窥视而出，寒意直刺你的灵魂。
The ground trembles beneath your boots as a colossal entity lumbers into view. It is a towering mass of hoary snow, decaying ice, and razor scree that moves in a cataclysmic cycle of earth-shaking undulations, rising high like the wall of a desert storm before cascading down with an avalanche’s abandon. Eyes of blue frost peer out from its central mass to chill your soul.

植株的茎与藤蔓呈淡淡的浅绿，被寒意漂白，坠着一串串冰凌——却丝毫不妨碍那霜白兰花的盛放。花瓣清冽通透，色泽如冰，仿佛不是自然生长，而是从寒冰中裁切而成。花心的雄蕊紧紧簇成一窝圆润的金黄颗粒，像施了魔法的金色小块般微微发光，为最内层的花瓣镀上一抹温暖的晴色。
The stem and vine of the plant are pale green, blanched in the cold and weighed down by icicles—though this does not seem to hamper the flowering of the frosty white orchid. With their crisp translucency and color, the petals appear to be cut from ice rather than a natural growth. The stamens at the flower’s center, a close nest of yellow rounds, glow like magicked golden nuggets. They cast a sunny hue on the innermost petals.

这块古老而庄严的巨石，经历过的寒冬多到凡人难以想象，风霜的刻痕便是明证。无数年的日晒雨淋，让它的表面布满孔洞、裂缝与斑驳的变色——每一道痕迹都为这巨岩增添了愈发不凡的气韵。
This chunk of ancient, venerable stone has seen more winters than any mortal could, and it bears the weathering to prove it. Innumerable years of exposure have left the surface riddled with holes, cracks, and discolorations—each one adding to the boulder’s illustrious tenor.

你穿过那扇不起眼的门，进入一条朴素、毫无装饰的大厅。目光掠过平淡无奇的四周时，你的思绪却不由自主飘向那些纠缠不休的念头——待办的任务、琐碎的家务、未完成的差事。就在这念头翻涌之间，大厅开始悄然变形，扭转重塑为一个与需求严丝合缝的环境。
You pass through the unassuming door into a plain, undecorated hall. As your gaze passes over the unremarkable surroundings, your mind wanders into plaguing thoughts of your pending tasks, chores, assignments. As this happens, the hall begins to change, transfiguring into an environment perfectly suited to your needs.

你双手沿半弧分开，随之自那弧线上如轮辐般迸射出道道纯粹的火焰长枪，直刺向那些不幸招致你怒火的人。
Your hands move apart in a semicircle, from which, like spokes of a wheel, jet lances of pure flame toward those unlucky enough to earn your ire.

这男人身上散发着浪荡子般无忧无虑的气息，那抹歪斜的坏笑更是丝毫无意打消你的印象。深色柔韧的皮护甲贴身合体，其上点缀着暗钝的钢钉，穿着舒适，关节处留足活动余地；你几乎能想见他左大腿上的长匕首随时都离他的手不远。另一侧挂着一柄用得发亮的细剑——纤薄而致命的武器，像它的持有者一样：精瘦、狡黠、出手极快，专为迅速了结战斗。一缕刺目的雪白发束与他其余的深发、古铜肤色形成鲜明对比。

~ Played by Neil Alexander

The man exudes the carefree air of a ne’er-do-well, and his lopsided smirk does little to dissuade that impression. Snug armor of dark, supple leather studded with dull steel hugs his form comfortably, allowing for flexibility in the joints, and you imagine the long dagger sheathed on his left thigh is never far from his hand. A well-used rapier hangs opposite, a slim and deadly-looking weapon resembling its wielder: lean, cunning, and quick to finish a fight. A lock of stark white hair stands in contrast with the man’s otherwise dark hair and tan complexion.

~ Played by Neil Alexander

Quip By A Villain King About Why He Goes.name:
反派王者冷笑一声：「你问我为何开战？因为和平会让人忘记谁在统治；而战争，会让他们记住我的名字。」
Quip By A Villain King About Why He Goes To War

Text.text:
“你或许会觉得，我将不属于我的土地据为己有，是自私之举。但只要我仍是王，没有臣民，我便一无所有——而他们渴望新的疆土与胜利。我又有什么资格拒绝他们？”
“You may think it selfish of me to claim territory not my own. But, while I am a king, I am nothing without my subjects—and they crave new lands and victories. Who am I to deny them that?”

尽管这副护甲看起来厚重而僵硬，穿上却轻盈舒适；该柔韧处便柔韧，足以让人自由移动。金属在恰当的光线下泛起波纹，自胸甲向外辐射出精妙的旋涡纹样。绷紧的扣环与系带将甲片贴合在穿戴者的身形之上。
Despite its apparent weight and rigidity, the armor is light and comfortable, supple where it needs to be to allow for freedom of movement. The metal ripples in the right light, with sublime, swirling shapes radiating outward from the breastplate. Taut buckles and straps conform the plates to the wearer’s shape.

I Endure Werewolf Hunger.name:
我忍受狼人饥渴
I Endure Werewolf Hunger

Text.text: 我死死捂住肚子，胸廓像洞穴的岩檐般压在我颤抖的双手上方。头晕目眩，念头像绝望人群里无数乞求的嘴一样挤作一团。就这一次。屈服吧。就一次。就一条肢体……一口就好。一种非人的低吼从我紧咬、打颤的牙缝里硬生生挤出来。想到下一顿，想到追猎，想到牙齿刺入温热、尖叫的血肉，我的腮边涎水越积越多。口水顺着脸颊和脖颈滴落。胃里咕噜作响，绞痛一阵阵穿过我——可我把饥饿的念头按进深处，紧闭双眼，逼自己入睡。 I clutch my stomach, my ribcage looming over my shaking hands like a cavern overhang. My head spins, thoughts crowding it like the many pleading mouths of a desperate crowd. Just this once. Give in. Just one time. Just one limb… one bite. An inhuman growl presses through my clenching, chattering teeth. Saliva pools in my jowls as I think of my next meal, of the chase, of my teeth sinking into warm, shrieking flesh. The drool dribbles down my cheeks and neck. My stomach gurgles, and pangs shoot through me—but I drown the hungry thoughts out and squeeze my eyes shut to try to sleep.

Casting Your Final Wish.name:
施展你最后的夙愿
Casting Your Final Wish

Text.text:
狂风将你充满力量的言语裹挟而去，宛如千箭齐发，卷起尘沙，在身后震出阵阵颤动。尘埃落定时，你才意识到世界回应了你的召唤……却也付出了代价。造物的齿轮再次为你转动，你不由得露出微笑，将自己最后的愿望托付给这片天地。
The wind carries your words of power like a thousand arrows, kicking up dust and creating tremors in its wake. When the dust settles, you realize the world has answered your call… but it did so at a cost. The gears of creation turn for you once more, and you can't help but smile as you entrust the world with your final wish.

积雪本该让方圆数里的声音都沉寂下来，可一阵轰鸣仍传到你耳中，遥远而如雷滚动。你头顶数百尺处，冰雪的汪洋投下阴影。它自山巅倾泻而下，一道冰封的死亡之墙狂奔而来，誓要将你拥入怀中。
The snow normally deadens sound for miles, but a rumble reaches you here, distant and thundering. Hundreds of feet above you, an ocean of ice and snow casts its shadow. Cascading down the mountain, a wall of frozen death rushes to embrace you.

一座坚固的石桥横跨河面，一端踏在水流中的小岛上。桥下水势湍急却不深，显然在桥修起之前，这里多半只是个简易的涉水点。能在本就可用的渡口上建起如此宏伟的桥梁，想必这座村庄相当富庶。
A sturdy bridge of stone stands astride the river, placing a foot on an island in the flow. The water under the bridge flows swift but shallow, indicating this was likely a simple ford before the bridge was built. The village must be prosperous to build such a grand structure over a functional crossing.

Tykhorr Mantyger.name:
泰科霍尔·曼提格尔
Tykhorr Mantyger

Text.text:
狮般的面孔、獠牙森然的巨口，以及一圈铜丝般的鬃毛，让这具魁梧的觉醒构装体与同类截然不同。他披甲的身躯上遍布伤疤、凹痕与拼补修理的痕迹，仿佛走过无数战场。破旧的斗篷垂落在他宽阔的肩头。他不时伸出几根带爪的手指，沿着腰间悬挂的旧巨斧那把崩口的斧刃缓缓划过。他浑身绷紧，随时准备出手，红光灼灼的眼睛扫视四周，目光如刀。

~ Played by DueWest with

A leonine face, fanged maw, and mane of copper wire set this powerfully-built awakened-construct apart from others of his kind. Scars, dents, and patchwork repairs on his armored form suggest he’s seen countless battles. A shabby cloak drapes his wide shoulders. Now and then, he runs a few clawed fingers along the notched blade of a worn greataxe hanging from a belt. He stands tense, ready to act, glaring around with his eyes glowing red.

~ Played by DueWest with

Sundries From A Karalaq Quori.name:
来自卡拉拉克·魁奥里的杂项
Sundries From A Karalaq Quori

Text.text:
那团幽暗的云雾猛然炸散，如同一群苍蝇被一阵疾风卷得溃不成军。无数双眼睛先前还死死钉在你身上，专注得令人发寒、连眨都不眨，此刻却纷纷坠地，弹跳着四散奔逃，乱作一团。每一次在地面上湿黏地噗嗒一跳，那些眼睛便愈发干瘪，水分迅速抽离，最终干成坚硬、喀啦作响、布满皱褶的圆球，活像石果的果核。
The umbrous cloud dissipates in a burst, like when a swarm of flies is bested by a flurry of wind. The many eyes, once so fixated upon you in rapt, unblinking attention, fall to the ground and bounce away in a chaotic race. With each squelching skip along the floor, the eyes become more and more desiccated, drying up into hard, clattering, wrinkled orbs not unlike the pits of stone fruit.

Elven Innkeeper.name:
精灵旅店老板
Elven Innkeeper

Text.text:
精灵旅店老板微微向你低头致意。和大多数精灵一样，他的年代难以揣测，但他的脸与身形比常人更为瘦削，几乎像被紧紧捏住般收拢。这让他带着一股酸涩的神情，显得古老而苛刻、爱评断人——可他依旧含笑，抬手一挥，指向几张你可以落座的高脚凳。
The elf innkeeper inclines his head toward you by way of greeting. Like most elves, it’s impossible to guess his age, but his face and body are slimmer than normal, seeming almost pinched. It gives him a sour look that makes him seem old and judgmental, even as he smiles and waves a hand to indicate some stools where you can sit.

Disused Captain’s Quarters.name:
废弃的船长舱室
Disused Captain’s Quarters

Text.text:
满是灰尘的海图与被丢弃的领航工具散落在房间中央的大桌上，沿着船舱一路铺开的精绣长毯边缘已然磨损松散，被老鼠啃得参差不齐。角落里，一张曾经华丽夺目的大床如今肮脏凌乱、无人整理；床脚的沉重箱子也因失去用途而显得落寞，箱盖半掀，箱身空空如也。
Dusty maps and discarded navigator’s tools litter the large table at the room’s center, and rats have chewed the fraying edges of the intricately embroidered rug that runs the length of the cabin.  A large bed, once grand and resplendent, lies dirty and unmade in the corner, a heavy chest at its foot forlorn in its lack of purpose, with lid ajar and body empty.

Taunt About An Ancient Being’s Missed St.name:
嘲讽远古存在的失手一击
Taunt About An Ancient Being’s Missed Strike

Text.text:
“与其把这几百个世纪都花在盘算邪恶阴谋上，你或许更该多挤出一点时代来练练准头。”
“Instead of having spent all these centuries scheming up evil plans, perhaps you should’ve cut out a bit more time to work on your aim.”

Subdermal Brass Knuckles.name:
皮下黄铜指虎
Subdermal Brass Knuckles

Text.text:
由纳米机器人在血液中布设的硬化丝状物，将指节化作四块圆润而黄铜般的凸起。它们在光线里仿佛微微晃动，黯淡的冷光预示着将至的暴力。再加上韧带与肌腱的支撑性强化，这些指节成了一件极善隐藏的武器——落在合适的手里，便有能力造成严重伤害。
Hardened filaments, placed by nanobots in the bloodstream, turn the knuckles into four round and brassy lumps. They seem to wobble in the light, a dull glint of impending violence. Reinforced by supportive ligament and tendon augmentations, these knuckles are a well-concealed weapon with the ability to deal serious damage—on the right hands.

Rumor About A Vicious Foe.name:
关于一个凶残劲敌的传闻
Rumor About A Vicious Foe

Text.text:
“对付这家伙要步步为营。仿佛它们是从一口大釜里诞生的——地狱里所有的孽物都往里啐过唾沫。它们的力量不来自远古魔法或怪物般的蛮力，而源于狡诈、冷漠，以及在毫无预警、毫无挑衅之下也愿意倾泻暴力的狠劲。”
“Tread lightly with this one. It’s as if they were born from a cauldron all the denizens of hell spit into. Their power doesn’t come from ancient magics or monstrous strength but from their cunning, indifference, and a willingness to mete out violence without warning or provocation.”

Criminal On Galactic Police Most Wanted.name:
被列入银河警察“头号通缉”名单的罪犯
Criminal On Galactic Police Most Wanted List

Text.text:
一套朴素的灰色西装松垮垮地挂在那外星人矮小的身躯上，像裹尸布般无力下垂，将他们笼罩在晦暗不明的阴影里。他们独自坐着，目光低垂，满怀落寞地咀嚼着一块营养棒。以他们在GPD通缉名单上的位置，你本该感到更深的恐惧——可你清楚他们犯下的罪行。那些骇人听闻、惨绝人寰的恶行，正是他们登上榜单的原因。一个来自你最深噩梦的怪物，就坐在你面前。
A simple gray suit hangs limply from the alien’s diminutive frame like a funeral shroud, cloaking them in obscurity as they sit alone, eyes downcast, chewing forlornly on a nutrient bar. They certainly do not inspire the terror you’d expect from their position on the GPD Most Wanted List—but you are aware of their crimes. The terrible, heinous offenses that earned them their spot on that list. A monster from your deepest nightmares sits before you.

I Cast Ascendant Step.name:
我施放「登天之步」
I Cast Ascendant Step

Text.text:
我闭上双眼，想象自己向上攀升。掌下与足下无声地涌起一团团黑暗，缓缓将我托起。我移动时，这些阴影如幽暗的火焰般摇曳，向上时愈发拉长，向下时又渐渐缩短。
I close my eyes and picture my ascent. Puffs of darkness form silently under my hands and feet, lifting me slowly. These shadows waver like dark flames as I move, growing longer as I go up and diminishing as I descend.

一滩水洼泛起涟漪，水面上拍动起一对纯净蔚蓝的蝙蝠般翼膜，振翅间溅起点点水珠。随即，一只小小的生物浮升而出，带着顽皮的坏笑直面着你。它不过与你的躯干一般大小，轻盈地飞掠旋舞，液态的肌肤在绿与蓝之间折射出虹彩般的光泽。
A puddle ripples, and batlike wings of pure azure flap from the surface of the water, spraying droplets until a small creature rises to face you with a mischievous grin. No bigger than your torso, the creature flits and twirls, its liquid skin a prismatic array of greens and blues.

Expensive Steakhouse.name:
昂贵的牛排馆
Expensive Steakhouse

Text.text:
一名衣着利落的迎宾以夸张的手势将餐厅大门猛地拉开。里头餐桌装点得极尽奢华，食客们身着更为华贵的衣装，彬彬有礼地交谈，浅啜着昂贵的酒水。咸香、油脂与上等肉类的气息在空气中飘荡，压过杯盏与银器清脆的叮当声。
A sharply dressed greeter pulls open the door to the restaurant with a flourish. Inside are lavishly decorated tables, with diners in even fancier clothing making polite conversation and sipping expensive drinks. The smells of salt and grease and good meat waft through the air above the clinking of glasses and silverware.

Full Moon Overhead.name:
满月高悬
Full Moon Overhead

Text.text:
头顶的微光稍稍明亮了些，你抬头望去，只见云层分裂开来。变幻的天幕像揭开面纱般拂去月亮的遮掩，让它以苍白而冷冽的目光俯视着你。往往月色能温暖人心，可今夜它的存在却显得遥远而漠然——冷酷无情的旁观者，见证着下方的世界。
The glow from above brightens slightly, and you look up to see the clouds parting. The shifting sky draws a veil from the face of the moon so that it looks down upon you, pale and cold. Often the sight of the moon warms the heart, but tonight its presence seems distant and uncaring: a pitiless witness to the world below.

Dragon And Monk Are Unlikely Allies.name:
巨龙与武僧是出人意料的盟友
Dragon And Monk Are Unlikely Allies

Text.text:
他眯起眼，目光游离着往上飘——仿佛正试图数清自己那因专注而扭曲的额头上新添了几道皱纹——这位退伍兵灵巧的手指在空气中轻叩，敲出一串无声的序列。他脑内推算的灼热强度，与那条龙族同谋的耐性形成鲜明对照：对方以近乎倦怠的冷漠俯视着这段潜在的同盟。半精灵的目光重新聚焦。他点点头，朝手心啐了一口，伸出手要以此封缔契约。巨龙喷鼻以示赞许，伸出一只闪亮、弯曲、强而有力的巨爪，迎向精灵摊开的掌心——一场不可能的握手，发生在同样不可能的盟友之间。

~ 一位英雄 构想

With eyes squinting and drifting upward—as if trying to count the wrinkles on his own concentration-wracked forehead—the ex-soldier’s nimble fingers tap out a sequence in the air. The intensity of his mental calculations contrasts with the patience of his draconic co-conspirator, who oversees their potential alliance with an almost bored aloofness. The half-elf’s eyes refocus. He nods, spits into his hand, and offers to seal the pact. The dragon snorts approval and extends one shiny, curved, mighty claw to meet the elf’s open palm, an unlikely handshake between unlikely allies.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

森林自四周群丘云雾缠绕的山脊倾泻而下，漫过坡麓，铺展到两侧群山夹峙的平坦谷地上。一条蜿蜒的河流如银蛇般在林地间的草野里游走穿行。这里看起来是定居的绝佳所在，可你却看不见任何该有的迹象。
Forest flows down from the cloud-cloaked ridges of the surrounding hills and spills out onto the flat vale flanked by them. A sinuous river slithers like a silver snake through the grassy fields between woodlands. The valley seems an ideal spot for settlement, but you see none of the telltale signs.

Crew Member From Military Warship.name:
来自军用战舰的船员
Crew Member From Military Warship

Text.text:
那名女子在舰长经过时立正站定，向这位高级军官干净利落地敬了个礼。她的制服一丝不苟——每一处都恰到好处，没有半点错乱。待舰长拐过转角，她便继续穿行于舰内，以熟练的步伐踏上最为高效的路线。
The woman stands at attention as the captain passes by, offering the senior officer a crisp salute. Her uniform is immaculate in every regard—nothing out of place. As the captain turns a corner the ensign continues on her way through the ship, taking the most efficient route with practiced steps.

Orc Tribe On The March.name:
行军中的兽人部族
Orc Tribe On The March

Text.text:
锁子甲的窸窣、皮革的吱呀、钢铁兵器的铿锵——兽人们如同一体般行进，身后扬起一柱冲天尘烟。大多数徒步旅行，但也有人骑在鬃毛倒竖的恐狼上驰骋在前；那些灰色皮毛上点缀着象征位阶的部族纹饰。队列最前方是女族长——她的长矛上飘扬着五彩旌旗，旗面绘着十余个氏族的徽记。她骑在一头恐怖巨野猪的鞍上，目光坚定地凝视前方。
The rustle of chain mail, the creak of leather, the rattle of steel weapons—the orcs move as one, a towering plume of dust in their wake. Most travel by foot, but others ride ahead astride bristling dire wolves, whose gray fur is adorned with tribal markings of rank. At the head of the column rides the matriarch—her spear flutters with banners of every color, bearing the symbols of a dozen clans. She stares ahead, resolute, from the saddle of her dire boar.

Rickety Dock.name:
摇摇欲坠的码头
Rickety Dock

Text.text:
一座摇摇欲坠的栈桥由木板与圆木桩搭成，伸入湖中。它的做工比小屋还要粗糙，许多缝隙直通下方的湖水。黯黑的污渍——某种干涸液体的残痕——也斑驳地印在灰暗的木头上。用麻绳系在栈桥旁的是一艘做工结实的划艇，两支船桨横放在舷缘上。从这里望去，还能看见湖对岸的另一座码头。
A rickety dock of planks and log posts extends into the lake. Its construction is even rougher than the cabin’s, and numerous gaps open to the water below. Dark stains of some dried liquid also mark the dull wood. Tied to the dock with hemp rope is a well-constructed rowboat with two oars laid across its gunnels. From this point, another dock is visible on the other side of the lake.

Boorish Building Superintendent.name:
粗鄙的楼宇管理员
Boorish Building Superintendent

Text.text:
他把一大口浓稠的唾沫啐在地上，满身汗味、毛发丛生的男人发出令人作呕的咕噜声，用手背抹过鼻子。额头上的肥肉渗着油汗，顺着脏兮兮的眼镜上沿淌下来，像两条湿黏、腐腥的蛞蝓。他一边听着面前的房客哀求再宽限些交租的时间，一边咧嘴大笑——露出几颗发黑的烂牙。听到请求，他嗤之以鼻，草草写了张便条给房东，让他立刻着手启动驱逐程序。
Hawking a thick wad of spit onto the floor, the sweaty, hirsute man wipes his nose on the back of his hand with a sickening gurgle. The fat of his brow seeps over the top of smudged glasses like a pair of moist, rancid slugs. He laughs—revealing several blackened teeth—as he listens to the tenant before him plead for more time to pay the rent. He scoffs at the request and scrawls a hasty note to the landlord to start the eviction process.

Loot From A Twig Blight.name:
枝条枯萎怪的战利品
Loot From A Twig Blight

Text.text:
你在枯萎怪支离破碎的残骸枝杈间发现了一枚部落护符。它由一只风干木乃伊般的地精手掌制成，缀着漆黑羽毛，用皮绳悬挂；这枚护身符让你心底泛起一阵诡异的不安。
Hanging from the twigs of the blight’s shattered remains you find a tribal fetish. Comprised of a mummified goblin hand adorned with black feathers, and hanging on a leather cord, the talisman gives you an eerie feeling of unease.

Mysterious Death Of The Ship's Captain.name:
船长的离奇死亡
Mysterious Death Of The Ship's Captain

Text.text:
船长的眼神渐渐空洞，她缓缓吐出最后一口颤抖的气息。船上骤然落下沉重的寂静，唯有缆索吱呀作响，海浪轻拍船壳。船员们垂下目光，连最硬朗的人眼里也映着泪光。有人摘下兜帽与船帽，紧紧按在胸口，几声哽咽的抽泣从静默里挤出。船长本已苍白的脸无神地朝上凝望，忽然间，甲板在你脚下摇晃起来，船帆在恼怒的风里扑簌作响。船体攀上浪峰时，一道呻吟般的低沉声响穿过老旧的木料回荡开来——仿佛这艘船也在为失去船长而哀悼。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The captain’s eyes go vacant as she eases out a final, shuddering breath. An immense silence falls upon the ship, broken only by the creaking rigging and the lapping of waves against the hull. Her crew drop their gaze, tears shining in the eyes of even the most hardy. A few remove their cowls and caps, clutching them to their hearts as a few strangled sobs escape the quiet. The captain’s face, pallid already, stares listlessly upwards, and the ship suddenly rocks beneath you, the sails fluttering against an angry breeze. As the vessel crests a wave, a groan reverberates through the worn wood. It’s as though the ship itself mourns the loss of its captain.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

某位手稳如磐的大师，将暮年光阴尽数耗在这些微小的发条奇迹之上。空气因嗡鸣而稠密，仿佛一场歌唱金属的风暴。它们旋舞翻飞，像是被某种凶戾的意志所驱使；细若尘点的青铜身影喀喀作响，唱着一支异域的怪歌。
Some master with a steady hand has spent their twilight years on these tiny clockwork miracles. The air is dense with the buzzing, a storm of singing metal. They whirl about as though commanded with a fell will, miniscule dots of bronze chittering with some alien song.

你用手抚过木桩光滑打磨的木纹，指腹捕捉到靠近底部刻出的细小凹痕。大蒜的辛烈气味与银粉的金属腥味交织在一起，几乎盖过那股浓烈的抛光油香。你将这件武器在掌间来回掂转，它沉稳的分量令人心安——你知道，当时代恰到好处时，它会为你派上大用场。
You run your hand over the smooth, polished wood of the stake, noting the notches carved near its base. The smell of garlic mixes with the metallic odor of powdered silver, almost overpowering the heady polish. The weapon has a reassuring weight as you move it between your hands—you know it will serve you well when the time is right.

给这家店作画的人显然很有幽默感。无论是风景、肖像还是静物，每一幅都藏着让人发笑的细节：奢华的花园宴会上，一位上了年纪的园丁躲在灌木后撒尿；一名贵妇的华丽假发里竟藏着一只活蜘蛛；丰盛的宴席场景中，一只猫胖得发困，连桌下跑过的老鼠都懒得追。
Whoever painted the pictures in this shop has a sense of humor. Be it a landscape, portrait, or still life scene, each has some detail meant to amuse: a lavish garden party with an aged gardener peeing behind a bush, a noblewoman with a live spider in her elaborate wig, a feast scene with a cat too fat and sleepy to chase the mouse under the table.

Loot From A Barghest.name:
来自巴盖斯特的战利品
Loot From A Barghest

Text.text:
巴格斯特惊愕地横陈死去，巨大的下颚歪斜着耷拉下来。它身穿一件特制的皮背心，正好贴合它桶状的胸膛与狼一般的四肢。摸索背心口袋，能翻出一只装着30枚金币的钱袋。一串由骨头与利爪串成的护符挂在巴格斯特的颈间，散发出刺麻般的温热与恶意的气息。
The barghest sprawls in dumbfounded death, its oversized jaw hanging askew. It wears a leather vest specially fitted for its barrel chest and wolflike limbs. Patting down the vest’s pockets yields a purse of 30 gold pieces. An amulet of bones and claws hangs around the barghest’s neck, exuding an aura of prickling warmth and malice.

I Coat The Blade Of My Dagger Of Venom I.name:
我将毒匕首的刃锋涂覆上漆黑的毒液
I Coat The Blade Of My Dagger Of Venom In Black Poison

Text.text:
我嘶声吐出那句命令词，拇指掠过匕首柄上蛇形符文，令其迸发出妖异的翠绿毒光。浓稠如焦油的毒液覆上刀刃，染出致命的乌黑冷泽，从匕首邪恶的尖端黏腻滴落。
Hissing the command word, I run my thumb across the serpentine rune on the dagger’s hilt, causing it to glow with virulent green energy. Thick, tarlike poison coats the blade with a deadly ebon sheen, dripping in viscous droplets from the dagger’s wicked tip.

I Cast Enhance Ability To Bestow Eagle's.name:
我施放【强化能力】，赐予“雄鹰的风采”。
I Cast Enhance Ability To Bestow Eagle's Splendor

Text.text:
当我吟诵法术的咒言时，胸中自豪澎湃，目光凝聚在掌心那根威仪凛然的鹰羽之上。我挺直身躯，言语笃定，而我手中握着的力量，足以令周遭众人心生敬畏与战栗。随着最后一个音节落下，我完成了法术，赐予【雄鹰之华】。
My chest swells with pride as I intone the words of the spell, focusing on the majestic eagle feather in my hand. I stand taller, speak with confidence, and hold in my hand the power to inspire awe and dread in all around me. I finish my spell, bestowing the Eagle’s Splendor.

Potion Of Climbing.name:
攀爬药剂
Potion Of Climbing

Text.text:
若非你见多识广，你几乎会以为有三层彼此分离的沉积岩被人硬生生灌进了这只药剂瓶里。你将瓶身左右倾斜时，它又像液体般缓缓流动；更离奇的是，那三层始终泾渭分明，丝毫不相互交融。你隐约觉得，这一口下去，怕是相当顶饱。
If you did not know better, you would think that three separate layers of sedimentary stone were somehow poured into this potion bottle. It moves like liquid when you tilt the bottle this way and that, and curiously, the layers do not mix with one another in any way. You have the feeling that this drink would be quite filling.

Gold Dragon Wyrmling.name:
金龙幼龙
Gold Dragon Wyrmling

Text.text:
这头龙裔生物的爬行类面孔上垂落着如胡须般的触须。它的体型约如一只大型犬，行动却带着诡异而摄人的优雅，像蛇一般以细微的起伏蜿蜒逼近。金色鳞片在阳光下灿然夺目，它以锐利而狡黠的目光扫视四周。
Beard-like whiskers drape from the reptilian face of this draconic creature. Roughly the size of a large dog, the beast moves with a grace both strange and alluring, approaching as a serpent might with subtle undulations. Its golden scales shine brilliantly in the sun as it scans the surroundings with eyes sharp and cunning.

Sundries In The Den Of A Pack Of Werewol.name:
狼群狼人巢穴里的杂物
Sundries In The Den Of A Pack Of Werewolves

Text.text:
这处巢穴恶臭扑鼻，遍地皆是污秽的血肉残渣与排泄物，堆成一滩滩触目惊心的烂泥。垃圾中央，有一圈被油污浸透的圆形痕迹，四周散落着一缕缕粗硬纠结的毛发——也许正是那群狼形匪徒挤作一团睡成一堆的地方。在不远处，你看见一摞朴素却干净的衣物，被整整齐齐地叠放着。
The den reeks, with filthy piles of gore and waste in visceral piles all over. In the center of the refuse, a grease-stained circle is littered with strands of thick, matted hair—perhaps the place where the lupine band slept together in a pile. Near this spot, you see a pile of plain, clean clothing, neatly folded.

褴褛的经幡在风中猎猎作响——系在绳索上，绳索一端钉入地面，一端牵到寺庙檐线，却仍把祈愿送向苍穹。廊柱支撑的建筑覆着一层层剥落的彩漆，毫无疑问，是虔诚的信众代代相继、甘愿将颜料的原料背上山来，一遍遍涂抹而成。
Tattered prayer flags flap in the wind—attached to ropes tied between the ground and the roofline of the temple, but sending their hopes to the heavens. The pillared structure bears layers of flaking paint, no doubt applied over generations by faithful adherents willing to carry the pigment’s ingredients up the mountain.

Quip From An Annoyed Potion Shop Owner.name:
来自恼火的药水店老板的牢骚
Quip From An Annoyed Potion Shop Owner

Text.text:
“我敢向你保证，我这店里什么配方都有！只要有足够的时代，再加上合适的材料，说不定我连你那令人作呕的性格都能治好。”
“I can assure you that I have a mixture for everything in my shop! With enough time and the right ingredients, I might even be able to cure that nauseating personality.”

Major Trade Road Through Arid Land.name:
穿越旱土的主要商路
Major Trade Road Through Arid Land

Text.text:
人和驮兽把大地踩踏成一条坚实的道路，循迹而行毫不费力。即便路径横穿裸露的岩石旷地，你也能看见车轮在石面上磨出的深深辙痕，以及过往牲畜留下的干硬粪迹。唯一真正考验辨路的，是被风推移的流沙；不过迄今为止，还没有哪片沙带大到足以造成实质性的麻烦。
People and pack animals have tramped the earth into a hard path that’s easy to follow. Even when the route crosses exposed expanses of rock you can see the ruts worn into the stone by wagon wheels, and the dried scat of animals that passed through. Wind-shifted sand presents the only real challenge to navigation, but so far no patch has been large enough to present any real difficulty.

Asteroid-mining Ship: Outer Hull.name:
小行星采矿船：外部船体
Asteroid-mining Ship: Outer Hull

Text.text:
这艘采矿船在一切能想到的地方都做了加固。细长的舷窗只勉强透出一线船内景象，板岩灰的船体看上去至少有数英尺厚。星际采矿公司的标志在凹痕遍布的金属上赫然醒目，原本鲜亮的色彩被紧贴船体外壁的尘土磨得黯淡无光。
The mining ship is reinforced in every conceivable way. The slimline windows offer the barest glimpse of the ship’s interior, and the slate-gray hull looks to be several feet thick at least. The logo of an interstellar mining corporation looms large on the battered metal, its bright colors muted by the dust clinging to the ship’s exterior.

Arch-curate Dagrak Of House Almaemorn.name:
阿尔迈莫恩家族的大馆藏师达格拉克
Arch-curate Dagrak Of House Almaemorn

Text.text:
尽管他身形高挑、体格健壮，这个男人的皮肤却光滑得近乎惨白、近乎透明，连血管都在皮下清晰可见。他警觉而倨傲的眼睛闪烁着紫水晶般的光。那一头修长细密的发丝看似漆黑，却泛着绯红的光泽，在额前勾出寡妇尖发际，垂落在尖尖的耳廓旁。华贵的多层长袍将他裹住，黑与猩红交叠，其间点缀银色纹饰。一柄弧形长剑连鞘悬挂在一条银白金属腰带上。他露出一抹毫无暖意的笑——像狼般的咧嘴，锋利的上下犬齿一并毕露。

~ Played by a Hero

Although he is lofty in height and well built, this man’s smooth skin is so pallid, so translucent, that veins show through it. His watchful, haughty eyes sparkle like amethysts. Long, fine hair that seems black, but has a crimson sheen, forms a widow’s peak on his forehead and drapes around his pointed ears. Rich, layered robes shroud him in hues of black and scarlet with accents of silver. A curved sword hangs, scabbarded, from a belt of argent metal. He smiles cheerlessly—a wolfish grin replete with sharp upper and lower canines.

~ Played by a Hero

Druid Shouting To Ranger In A Blizzard.name:
德鲁伊在暴风雪中冲着游侠大喊
Druid Shouting To Ranger In A Blizzard

Text.text:
“嗯，我刚学会了德鲁伊伎俩，所以我算出了接下来二十四小时的天气！会下点小雪！”
“Well, I just learned druidcraft, so I figured out what the weather will be for the next twenty-four hours! It’s going to be a bit snowy!”

I Use Foe Slayer.name:
我使用【屠敌者】
I Use Foe Slayer

Text.text:
我了解我的敌人。在心眼之中，我看见他们的战术，并在他们做出选择之前就已知晓。我能看穿他们的弱点与护甲上的破绽。当他们发动攻击时，我便直觉出该如何迅速将其击倒。我对他们的每一次打击都精准无误，摧枯拉朽。
I understand my foes. In my mind’s eye, I see their tactics, and I know their choices before they make them. I guess their weak spots and the gaps in their armor. When they attack, I intuit how to take them down quickly. My strikes against them are sure and devastating.

只需一个念头，这台非凡的轮椅便会启动，悄然滑行，优雅而精准，仿佛毫不费力。椅身点缀着一串璀璨宝石，彼此以发光的线条相连，织成一张闪烁的魔法节点之网。轻柔的铃音回应使用者的心念指令，轮椅也随之作出同样温顺而迅捷的反应。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

A single thought is all that is required for this remarkable wheelchair to move, which glides along with effortless grace and precision. A series of sparkling gems dotted about the chair are connected via glowing lines, creating a network of shimmering magical nodes. A soft chime acknowledges the mental commands of the user, and the chair responds in kind.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Vial Of Acid.name:
酸液小瓶
Vial Of Acid

Text.text:
这只玻璃小瓶以厚实的软木塞紧紧封住，内盛澄澈液体，隐约带着一抹淡淡的色泽。软木塞顶端烙着一幅极细的线描：一只手掌被洞穿的图案，昭示其内装的是威力骇人的强腐蚀酸液——务必小心拿取，能不碰就别碰。
This glass vial, stopped up with a thick plug of cork, is full of a clear liquid with a slight colored tinge. A tiny line drawing of a hand with a hole through it is burned into the top of the cork, signifying that this is a container of powerful caustic acid and you should make certain to handle it carefully—if at all.

Approaching A Village In A State Of Unre.name:
逼近一座动荡不安的村庄
Approaching A Village In A State Of Unrest

Text.text:
在旧石墙残存的城门口，岗哨加了双倍，人人全副武装，仿佛随时要上战场。入内越过检查点后，几家店铺紧闭不开。人群在其中一家门外聚成一团，高声争吵不休。有人猛地推搡了另一个。警吏们冲上来，挥棍敲翻了好几个。那伙人一度像是要反扑警吏，却又在僵持中慢慢散去。主街尽头，法院和酒馆的窗户都被歪歪斜斜的木板钉死，像是仓促封上的伤口。
At the gate in what’s left of the old stone wall, the guard has been doubled and armed as if for battle. Inside, after the checkpoint, several shops are closed. A cluster of folks stand outside one of them, arguing loudly. One shoves another. Constables run over and club several of them. The group looks like it might turn on the constables but slowly disperses. At the end of the main thoroughfare, the windows of both courthouse and tavern are covered with crooked boards.

那只长着大耳朵的小家伙从巢穴里踉跄迈出，眼睛还几乎看不见，只能眯着缝儿。她一头栽倒，随即又爬起身，凑近一簇草闻了闻，张口去咬其中一片草叶。她用力一扯，尖尖地吱了一声，把草叶扯断了。她一边咯吱咯吱地啃着，一边抽动鼻尖嗅着空气：分辨出春日泥泞的地气、哥哥和姐姐——正从巢里钻出来——的味道，还有父母高高笼在她头顶的皮毛气息，守望着四周。
The little one with the big ears steps from the den, still mostly blind and squinting. She falls over, then stands again, smells a tuft of grass and bites at one of the blades. She pulls on it, squeaks, and breaks it free. While she gnaws she sniffs the air, identifying the muddy ground of spring, the scents of her brother and sister—emerging from the den—and the fur of her parents towering over her, keeping watch.

你一看见它，就不可能不同时想到两种生物：猫头鹰与熊。它那宽阔、羽缘如冠的面盘生着猫头鹰般的喙与巨大的眼睛，而那身鬃毛般粗硬的毛皮之躯，体型与熊无异。然而当你再看它那修长的前肢、低阔的站姿，以及长着利爪的脚掌——每一只都足有餐盘大小——这份相似便又显得支离破碎。
When you see it, it’s impossible not to think of both creatures at once: owl and bear. Its broad feather-fringed face has an owl’s beak and huge eyes, and its bristle-furred body is the size of a bear. Yet the resemblance falls apart somewhat when you look at its long forelimbs, wide stance, and taloned paws—each the size of dinner plates.

Crowd Of Diplomats Boards A Vessel.name:
一群外交官登船
Crowd Of Diplomats Boards A Vessel

Text.text:
人群宛如一座盛满传统服饰与仪式饰物的丰饶之角；这些外交使节一边低声交谈，一边仿佛将你能想到的每个国家与文化都带到了此处。他们悠然朝船只的跳板走去，临近时却不约而同停下脚步，齐齐仰望那即将登上的巨舰体型，惊叹与敬畏在同一瞬间将众人联结。和煦而喜庆的氛围像一支无形的歌在空气中回旋，贵宾们踏上甲板，余韵随步伐轻轻荡开。

~ 构想：Inbal（Discord）

A veritable cornucopia of traditional dress and ceremonial adornment, the crowd of diplomats seems to represent every nation and culture one could think of as they chat amongst themselves. Walking leisurely toward the gangplank of the ship, they pause to marvel in collective wonder at the size of the vessel they are about to board, united in their reverence. A cordial, festive atmosphere fills the air like a song as the dignitaries step onto the deck.

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

无缝的木材构成船体，纹理盘旋如涡，美得惊人；光滑的树瘤覆在受力之处，仿佛天生的护甲。水线上方，木质根须沿外侧铺陈，勾勒出主甲板边缘的舷缘，又盘绕回甲板本身，缠结系牢。巨树取代主桅：一张老朽的面孔嵌在树干上，稀薄的苔藓如胡须垂落；而另一株青翠之树矗立为前桅。编网般的叶藤充作索具与风帆，随树人桅杆低沉轰鸣的号令，自行展开。

~ Pocket Plays 构想

Seamless wood forms the ship’s hull, beautifully whorled and with smooth burls covering stress points. Woody roots line the exterior above the waterline, forming gunnels around the edges of the main deck and looping and tying onto the deck itself. A massive tree with a wizened face, bearded with wispy moss, takes the place of the mainmast, while another green tree stands as the foremast. Netted, leafy vines act as rigging and sails that unfurl themselves at the treant mast’s booming commands.

~ Envisioned by Pocket Plays

Loot From A Specter.name:
来自幽魂的战利品
Loot From A Specter

Text.text:
随着幽魂消散于虚无，一件物体哐啷一声坠地。一枚镶嵌宝石的金戒指静静躺在陵墓冰冷的石地上。它为什么会带着这个？
An object clatters to the ground as the specter fades into oblivion. A jeweled, golden ring rests on the cold stone floor of the tomb. Why was it carrying this?

Hanark, The Psi Knife.name:
哈纳克，灵能刃
Hanark, The Psi Knife

Text.text:
这名半兽人是暴烈威胁与轻盈优雅的宏伟混合体。他们的钉刺皮甲每一寸都映出匕首的寒光——每一把都触手可及，随时能拔出掷出。他们的目光在周遭游走，你却看不见任何施法的迹象，植物与垃圾却像被无形之手托起、翻检般窸窣移动。他们搜寻时漫不经心地在护甲各处调换刀位——一把从前臂挪到腰带，一把从背后滑到袖下。重新排列，提前备妥。那画面迷人得让你几乎错过：一柄灵能之刃骤然在他们掌心浮现。

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

This half-orc is a majestic hybrid of violent threat and lithe grace. Every inch of their studded leather armor reveals the glint of a dagger, each easy to grasp and throw at a moment’s notice. Their gaze roams around them, and though you see no visible casting, plants and refuse shift like they are being lifted or rifled through. As they search, they absentmindedly switch blades between spots on their armor—one from their forearm to their belt, one from their back to under their sleeve. Rearranging, preparing. It is so captivating that you almost miss the psionic blade that appears in their hand.

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

Security Daemons Converge On Hacker In T.name:
安全守护灵在网域中汇聚，包围黑客
Security Daemons Converge On Hacker In The Net

Text.text:
一具具无面、肌肉虬结的惹眼赤红剪影在网络中凝聚成形。它们立刻围着被锁定的入侵者结成一圈，阵形随即收紧，蓄势待发，准备将招致它们怒火的黑客清除，或至少令其失去行动能力。
Faceless, muscled silhouettes of obnoxious red materialize in the network. They instantly form a ring around the perceived intruder and begin to tighten their formation, ready to remove or otherwise incapacitate the hacker who has earned their ire.

Halfling Saboteur.name:
半身人破坏者
Halfling Saboteur

Text.text:
这只要一步之遥，便能从和善的恶作剧滑向致命的威胁。那双无辜、红扑扑的眼睛望过来时，诡计的轮子早已悄然转动。圆鼓鼓的肚子、认真的点头与笑容、背心上的面包屑——这些倒真都货真价实。正因太容易被低估，这名半身人深谙如何搅乱一场战斗：一个下作的小把戏、一次突如其来的消失、一记偷袭，而今天的午餐，就由那些判断失当的人来买单。
It’s a move of one square from kindly mischief to dangerous threat. Under that innocent, ruddy-faced gaze, the wheels of trickery turn. The belly, the earnest nodding and smiling, and crumbs on the vest—those really do come honestly. Easily underestimated, this halfling knows how to sabotage a fight. A dirty trick, a sudden disappearance, a sneak attack, and today’s luncheon is on those possessed of bad judgment.

Insult About Being Mediocre.name:
讥讽你平庸无能
Insult About Being Mediocre

Text.text:
“你真是令人叹为观止。才华勉强够得着伟大的边缘，尝得到那一口滋味，却又深陷自卑的泥沼，这辈子你都会困在其中反复咀嚼。”
“You are such a sight to behold. Just barely talented enough to taste greatness but so mired in your own insecurity you’ll spend the rest of your life dwelling on it.”

Welcome From The Town Guard.name:
来自城镇卫兵的欢迎
Welcome From The Town Guard

Text.text: “欢迎来到这座城市。提醒一句：任何人在城内被抓到施展强力魔法，都将被举报，并且只会从我们挑选的市民里，‘赏’给你一名人质。” “Welcome to the city. A reminder that any person caught using powerful magics within city limits will be reported, and offered only one hostage from our selection of townspeople.”

I Ignite My Flame Tongue Rapier.name:
我点燃烈焰吐息细剑
I Ignite My Flame Tongue Rapier

Text.text:
说出命令词，我将细剑如弹簧般向前猛刺。剑尖迸出火星，仿佛我正用刀锋拨弄将熄的柴炭，让火焰重燃。余烬向后飞溅，落在纤薄的剑身上，刹那间整段剑刃燃起摇曳的橙色火光。手腕轻抖几下，我把火势拨弄得更旺，化作明亮闪烁的黄色火舌。我将剑刃夸张地旋身横扫，烈焰如旗帜般随我的每个动作翻卷飘扬。
Speaking the command word, I send my rapier forward in a springy thrust. Sparks fly from its tip, as if I were using my blade to prod the dying logs of a fire to life. The embers fly backward onto the thin blade, and suddenly the whole length is ablaze with shimmering orange flame. With a few flicks of my wrist, I stoke the flames into bright, flashing tongues of yellow. I sweep the blade in a showy spin, the fire following my every move like a waving banner.

獠牙仍然外露，那头巨兽已被彻底压服，匍匐在血泊之中，鲜血正缓缓渗入它的鬃毛。狮子的皮毛上纵横交错着旧日战斗留下的疤痕，仿佛在那一片金色毛发上狠厉划过的笔触，落在原本洁净无瑕的画布上。
Fangs still bared, the great beast lies humbled in the pool of blood slowly soaking into its mane. The lion’s furred hide is crisscrossed by scars from old battles, lancing across its golden fur like errant brush strokes on a pristine canvas.

你的宗主赐予你一缕禁忌的知识，你的嗓音因此浸透了如同时代本身般古老的词句。那份震撼足以摧毁那些无法隔绝原初造物之恐怖轰鸣的敌人。
Gifted with a piece of forbidden knowledge by your patron, your voice is infused with words as old as time itself. The shock is enough to devastate those of your foes unable to block out the terrible sound of raw creation.

Bravado From A Trapper.name:
来自陷阱猎人的虚张声势
Bravado From A Trapper

Text.text:
“我几乎把所有四条腿的东西都剥过皮、开过膛，还处理过几样两条腿的。只要懂行，再把磨尖的钢刃下得够准，你会惊讶有多少东西能被放倒。”
“I’ve skinned and gutted just about everything on four legs and a few things on two. You’d be amazed what can be brought down with the right knowledge and proper placement of sharpened steel.”

Speech By A Bard About Apocalyptic Event.name:
吟游诗人谈末日浩劫的演说
Speech By A Bard About Apocalyptic Events

Text.text:
“我常常觉得世界正在走向终结。这年头很难不这么想。我会想到最后一首诗，最后一幅画。那最后寥寥几位艺术家，在世界坠入遗忘之际为它低声吟唱。又或者……到最后，我们将无话可说。”
“I often think the world is ending. It’s hard not to these days. I think about the last poem, the last painting. Those final few artists serenading the world as it falls into oblivion. Or perhaps… we will have nothing left to say.”

如果你能注意到它，那也只会是用余光。它始终黏在你身后——咔嚓作响的獠牙让你的腿筋阵阵发寒——那只矮墩墩、头颅鼓胀的地精像在追猎你的每一步；它以阴森的同步贴着你更长、更响的步伐移动，把皮革护甲细微的吱呀声一并掩去。它肩上交叉背着两把单刃刀——由粗陋的、满含轻蔑的钢板凿成——缺口深重，像是刻意打成锯齿。被成加仑的犬血染出铜绿的梦魇金属，仿佛从每把刀上钻出的带缘孔洞里淌下猩红泪滴。那同样的红渍又在地精灰色皮肤上起伏成一道道波纹状的疹痕，如同风暴掀起的浪潮，反复撕咬着这生物。

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

If you notice them at all, it will be with your peripherals. Constantly at your back—gnashing teeth sending shivers down your hamstrings—the squat goblin with the bulbous head seems to hound your every step, masking the subtle creaks of their leather armor by moving in sinister synchronicity with your longer, louder stride. Crossed over their shoulders are two single-edged blades—crafted from crude slabs of contemptuous steel—so heavily notched they appear deliberately serrated. Patinated by gallons of canine blood, the nightmare metal seems to weep red tears from the flanged holes bored through each blade. That same red stain seems to ripple across the goblin’s gray skin in the form of corrugated rashes, which ravage the creature like storm-tossed waves.

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

你知道这生物正身陷险境——袭击迫在眉睫。电光火石间，你果断出手，探手拨动命运的丝线。只需一个简单的手势，你便将天命扭向这生物一方，在一段时代内增添他们的好运，并为他们抵御伤害。
You know the creature is in danger—attacks are imminent. In a flash you act, reaching out to tug at the threads of fate. With a simple gesture you turn destiny in the creature’s favor, increasing their luck for a time, and warding them against harm.

Howling Under A Full Moon.name:
满月之下的长嚎
Howling Under A Full Moon

Text.text:
那声音仿佛在同一瞬间歌唱与啼哭。一道嗓音，以一串短促、弯折的音符收尾。它又再度响起——而且更微弱，来自更远处，一道更低沉的声音加入。没有特定的和声，没有同步的节拍。只有一种摄人心魄的赤诚，既可能是痛楚也可能是庆贺，既可能是绝望的渴求也可能是警告。更多声音，自更遥远的距离叠入，你周围的土地仿佛化作尘世的教堂，容纳着一支原初表达的合唱。
The sound is like singing and crying at once. One voice, ending in a series of short, bended notes. It begins again—and faintly, from a greater distance, a lower voice joins. There is no particular harmony, no synchronized rhythm. Just a fascinating honesty that could be pain or celebration, desperate desire or warning. More voices, over more distances, and the land around you becomes an earthly cathedral housing a choir of primal expression.

Speech By A Cynical Lord.name:
一位愤世嫉俗领主的演说
Speech By A Cynical Lord

Text.text:
“他们哭哭啼啼地跑来向我诉说压迫与不公。可若他们之中任何一个人哪怕得了丁点权柄，他们也会做出我做过的一切——甚至更甚。”
“They come to me whining of oppression and injustice. But were any of them given even a modicum of power, they would do everything I have done—and worse.”

Bard's Speech Of Self-affirmation.name:
吟游诗人的自我肯定演说
Bard's Speech Of Self-affirmation

Text.text:
“哦，嗨。你在跟我说话吗？哎呀，是的，是的，我就是在跟你说话，你这性感的小恶魔。嗯，谢谢，你也不赖，尤其是那嗓音！我可以坐着听你说一整晚。那算是在邀请我吗？也许……天啊，我可真行。”
“Oh, hi there. Are you talking to me? Why, yes, I am, you sexy devil. Well, thank you, you’re not too bad yourself, and that voice! I could sit and listen to that voice all night. Is that an invitation? Maybe… God I’m good.”

因其独特的斧刃般喙部而得名，斧喙鸟在反关节的长腿间变换重心，发出刺耳的聒噪声。尽管这只鸟确实有翅膀，但一眼便能看出它们发育不全，根本无法将这只生物托举离地。即便如此，这只高挑的鸟看起来在必要时仍能以惊人的速度疾奔。
Named for its distinctive, hatchet-shaped beak, the axe beak squawks as it shifts its weight on its reverse-jointed legs. Though the bird does have wings, it is easy to see that they are underdeveloped and incapable of carrying the creature aloft. Nevertheless, the tall bird looks as if it can run very quickly when the need arises.

Sundries From An Undead Legion.name:
亡者军团的杂物
Sundries From An Undead Legion

Text.text:
你跨过战场上遍地的碎骨与扭曲的残肢，在军团的尸骸间几乎找不到什么有用之物。大多数战士在被从死亡中唤起时便被剥夺了所有个性，但偶尔仍能发现些许古怪的小物件——曾经活过的痕迹。一枚被撞得凹陷的白镴吊坠、一只刻纹的木制颈环，以及一颗由整块玻璃打磨而成的十二面骰，是仅有几件还算值得拾起的残存之物。
Striding over the broken bones and twisted limbs littering the battlefield, you find little of use amongst the corpses of the legion. Most of the warriors were stripped of any individuality when they were raised from the dead, but here and there you find curios—remnants of lives lived. A battered pewter locket, an engraved wooden torc and a twelve-sided die crafted from solid glass are the only salvageable items of note.

Port Town Black Market Entrance.name:
港口镇黑市入口
Port Town Black Market Entrance

Text.text:
码头下方的区域被一阵诡异的喧嚣包围。两名食人魔各自如同一座小屋般庞大，分立在一处锈蚀的下水道入口两侧；沉重的木棒与凶狠的咆哮成了它们维持秩序的手段，把来客牢牢压在规矩之内。入口外的沙地在不断进出的脚步蹂躏下，被踩成了粗砺的泥浆。

~ 构想：Ameria，来自 Discord

A strange hubbub surrounds the area beneath the pier. Two ogres, each as large as a small cottage, stand on either side of a rusting sewer entrance, weighty clubs and menacing snarls their chosen tools for keeping the clientele in line. The sand outside has been turned to gritty sludge by the constant foot traffic in and out.

~ Envisioned by Ameria on Discord

Wounded Boar Makes A Choice.name:
受伤的野猪做出抉择
Wounded Boar Makes A Choice

Text.text:
鲜血黏稠而殷红，沿着野猪起伏喘动的肋腹缓缓爬下，从插在肉里的箭杆间滴落。它与追猎者目光相锁，兽躯必须做出抉择：搏命，或逃奔。

~ Envisioned by Dwayne on Discord

Blood, sticky and red, creeps down the heaving flanks of the boar, dribbling from the shafts jutting from its flesh. Locking eyes with its pursuers, the beast must make a choice: fight or run.

~ Envisioned by Dwayne on Discord

Desert Attire And Equipment.name:
沙漠装束与装备
Desert Attire And Equipment

Text.text:
朴素的沙漠衣着以柔和的土色调为主——奶白、浅褐与棕色交织，把实用置于浮夸的装饰与风格之上。一双结实的皮凉鞋、一只水囊和一把短剑，就是精明的旅行者穿行荒漠所需的全部装备。轻装旅行，疾行如风。
Muted earthen tones of cream, tan, and brown make up the simple desert attire, putting practicality over ostentatious decoration or style. A pair of rugged leather sandals, a waterskin, and a short sword are all the equipment a savvy traveler needs when navigating the desert. Travel light, travel fast.

Tome Of Leadership And Influence.name:
领导与影响宝典
Tome Of Leadership And Influence

Text.text:
这本精装华贵的厚册以异域狮鹫皮革昂贵装订，外观俊美，内里却塞得满满当当：从如何把谎言说得滴水不漏，到怎样进行一场妙语连珠的展示，再到如何恰到好处地奉承你心上之人，种种与人交往的练习与技巧尽在其中。
Expensively bound in exotic gryphon-hide leather, this handsome tome is full to the brim with exercises and techniques for interacting with others, from how to lie convincingly to how to conduct a lively presentation to how best to flatter the apple of your eye.

Moderate Psychic Injury.name:
中度精神创伤
Moderate Psychic Injury

Text.text:
两个声音，都出自你自己，在你脑海里争吵。一个想让痛苦停止，劝另一个：是时候放弃了。另一个声音在尖叫可怖的话语，咆哮着吼出每一个字；而你从外界看到或听到的一切，都要穿过你内心冲突那嘈杂刺耳的滤网，才变成低语传来。
Two voices, both your own, argue in your mind. One wants to make the pain stop and tells the other that it’s time to quit. The other voice is screaming horrible things, roaring them, and whatever you see or hear from the outside world is whispered through the cacophonous filter of your inner conflict.

你法术的目标面容飞快融化，五官变得模糊不清，身形轮廓扭曲流转，几乎快得让你的眼睛都追不上。你还来不及掂量自己对这场变形的情绪波澜，目标便已骤然改头换面，化作一种截然不同的新形态。
The features of your spell’s target quickly melt and grow indistinct, the outline of its shape shifting nearly faster than your eye can follow. Almost before you are able to gauge your emotional reactions to this transmutation, your target has adopted a radical new form.

Potion Of Poison.name:
毒药药水
Potion Of Poison

Text.text:
你把玩着这只药水瓶，立刻认出它是一瓶治疗药水——冒险者的标准口粮。那独特的红色光泽与丝滑的质地一眼便知。还有什么能更好呢？
Handling the potion bottle, you recognize it as a potion of healing, standard adventurer’s fare easily identified by its distinctive shade of red and smooth consistency. What could be better?

Approaching Deserted Cliffside Border To.name:
秋日逼近荒寂的峭壁边境小镇
Approaching Deserted Cliffside Border Town In Autumn

Text.text:
你抵达边境的第一个征兆，是那座破败的瞭望塔——它孤零零地立在峭壁之巅，乌鸦在塌陷的塔顶上空盘旋。下方铺展开来的城镇，与头顶那座如哨兵般压迫而立的高塔一样疏于打理。空荡的街道沿着岩壁蜿蜒攀升，点缀着板岩屋顶的房舍，屋脊上覆着一层苔藓。与这丑陋的聚落形成鲜明对照的，是环绕其外的林地：秋色翻涌成潮，橙、红、黄的层次在夏日残存的绿叶间跃动。
The first sign that you have reached the border is the dilapidated watchtower perched atop a cliff, crows circling above its sunken roof. Below sprawls the town, as ill-kept as the sentinel tower looming above. Deserted streets climb the rock face dotted with slate-roofed houses crowned with moss.
