In stark contrast to the ugly settlement, the woodland surrounding it is a riot of autumnal color. Shades of orange, red, and yellow dance among the vestiges of summer's foliage.

Spring Morning Cemetery.name:
春晨墓园
Spring Morning Cemetery

Text.text:
亡者沉睡在一层斑斓的覆毯之下。塌陷的坟茔被腐殖土般的草皮闷闷盖住，其间点缀着一抹野花带。寒风啃咬着苔痕斑驳的墓碑，水色的日光从守望者般的垂柳枝间探出头来，枝条在微风里轻轻摇曳。
The dead sleep beneath a blanket of color. The sunken graves are smothered by loamy grass, punctuated by a swathe of wild flowers. A wind nips at the moss-stained headstones, and a watery sun peeks through a guardian willow’s branches as they gently sway in the breeze.

Blacksmith: Outside The Smithy.name:
铁匠：铁匠铺外
Blacksmith: Outside The Smithy

Text.text:
人群挤满街道，喧闹的闲谈声与潮湿的人气弥漫在空气里；然而打铁的叮当与煤烟的气味却将这一切尽数劈开。一顶宽阔的屋檐罩住这座露天建筑，屋顶中央被一根矮粗的烟囱洞穿，正喷吐着淡白的烟雾。
A crowd throngs the street, filling the air with the noisy chatter and humid aroma of humanity, but the sounds of smithing and scent of coal smoke cut through it all. A broad roof covers the open-air structure, pierced in the center by a squat chimney bellowing pale fumes.

Bugsy Brambleroot.name:
巴格西·布兰布尔鲁特
Bugsy Brambleroot

Text.text:
一双嫩芽绿的眼睛与粉红的鼻头，从一顶宽檐尖帽的阴影下探出来。帽子用各式各样的布片补了又补，尖顶两侧还各开了一个洞，好让两只修长的白耳朵舒舒服服地伸出来。他穿着一件白色丝衬衫，外搭一件俊俏的绿色马甲。对这样一位纤细的家伙而言，他的背包大得离谱；每次蹦跳都叮当作响，还散出一股草本清香。他用爪子握着一根开花的法杖，杖顶金盏花与矮牵牛正蓬勃绽放。

~ Played by Jonathan Reed with

Sprig-green eyes and a pink nose peek out from under a wide-brimmed, pointed hat. The hat has been repaired with many different patches of fabric, and holes on either side of its point allow for two long white ears to extend comfortably. He wears a white silken shirt and a handsome green waistcoat. His backpack, quite large for such a slender fellow, jingles with each hop and gives off an herbaceous scent. He holds a flowering staff in his paws, marigolds and petunias burgeoning from its top.

~ Played by Jonathan Reed with

I Use Thirsting Blade.name:
我使出「饥渴之刃」
I Use Thirsting Blade

Text.text:
我挥动武器时，它嘶嘶作响、尖鸣不止，渴求血腥屠戮的猩红终章。它将我拽向目标。我先斩出一击，武器随即起舞，再次将自己与我的手臂调校到下一次挥砍的姿态。这股对暴力的迫切令人无法抗拒，我再度发起攻击。
My weapon hisses and whines as I swing, craving the crimson end of bloodshed. It tugs toward my target. I strike one way, and the weapon dances to ready itself and my arm for another blow. This eagerness for violence is irresistible, and I attack again.

Sundries From A Skeletal Dog.name:
骷髅犬的零碎杂物
Sundries From A Skeletal Dog

Text.text:
干枯的骨骸四散铺陈，犬类的颚骨大张，仿佛在最后一次空洞的咆哮中凝固。部分骸骨已被砸成骨粉，除此之外，再无任何可取的物资或宝藏可寻。
Dry bones lie in a scattered array, the canine jaw split wide in a final, hollow roar. Some of the skeletal form has been smashed to bonemeal, but aside from this there is no material or treasure to be found.

储藏洞室上空，一只锈色鵟掠翼而过——沙漠的女猎手，比你见过的任何鹰隼都要庞大。她盯着补给箱，也盯着你，在峡谷上空盘旋数圈，随即抽身而去，掠向东方的高原。
Over the storage chamber flies a ferruginous hawk, a huntress of the desert larger than any hawk you’ve ever seen. She eyes the supply crates and you, circles the canyon several times, then peels away across the eastern plateaus.

Bit And Bridle.name:
少许嚼子与缰绳
Bit And Bridle

Text.text:
这副缰具结构朴素，由皮革与扣具组成，末端装着一根金属杆，供坐骑咬住。衔铁沿长度有些刻痕，但究竟是制造时留下的纹路，还是先前使用磨出的痕迹，并不明显。其余部分看起来都保养良好。
The bridle is a simple contraption of leather and buckles, with a rod of metal situated at the end for a mount to bite down on. The bit has some markings along its length, but whether it is from manufacturing or previous use is not apparently obvious. Everything else appears to be in good shape.

Chimerical Social Activist.name:
幻异社会活动家
Chimerical Social Activist

Text.text: 一件婴儿蓝的纽扣衬衫袖口卷到手肘，手臂上那绝非人形的毛皮一路蔓延到长着利爪的手背。相同的浓密棕毛覆盖着他的头、颈与下巴——尖耳末端还翘着几撮毛。明亮的绿眼之下，脸上的皮肤布满鳞片，仿佛在人类会长雀斑的位置生了硬冷的纹理。下颌前突成显眼的地包天，尖牙参差，刺出并压过上唇。他赤着脚——也根本不是脚：分趾的蹄子沾着城市街泥的油污黏腻。他把一块平板夹在臂弯里，屏幕是无菌的白色，模拟真实纸张。透过他臂上缠绕的细软毛絮，仍能辨出Petition这个词。 The sleeves of a baby-blue button-down shirt are rolled up to his elbows, the definitely-not-humanoid fur on his arms extending to the backs of his clawed hands. The same thick brown coat covers his head, neck, and chin—and he has tufts at the ends of his pointed ears. The skin of his face is scaled under his bright green eyes, in the place where freckles on a more human face might be. His lower jaw juts out in a prominent underbite, the teeth spiked and protruding out over his top lip. His feet are shoeless and, really, not feet at all—his cloven hooves are greasy with the muck of the city streets. He holds a tablet in the crook of his elbow, the screen a sterile white simulating real paper. The word Petition is legible between the tangle of wisping fur on his arm.

只有专业人士与人脉通天之辈才有门路接触，这把手枪是精确无情的死亡器具。喷墨般乌黑的聚碳酸酯外壳包覆着最先进的击发机构——在合适的人手中，它能以令人难以理解的速度倾泻精准射击。多种军规级附件为标准配置，使操作者可按需求为这把模块化武器加装与改造。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Only accessible to professionals and the incredibly well-connected, this pistol is a precise instrument of death. A jet-black polycarbonate case covers the state-of-the-art firing mechanism able to deliver accurate shots with incomprehensible speed—in the right hands. Various military-grade attachments come as standard, allowing the operator to outfit the modular weapon based on their needs.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

伴随着沙沙低语与细微的手势，你号令风听命于你——一缕和风骤然迸出，绕着你翩然起舞。随着你最后一声凌厉的喝令，无形之力推动了某物。
With susurrations and subtle movements you command the wind to heed you—and a zephyr bursts forth to dance around you. With a sharp final command, something is moved with invisible power.

Nightmare About Burning.name:
焚烧之噩梦
Nightmare About Burning

Text.text:
铁锈与焦肉的气味把你从昏睡里拽醒。你拖动疲惫的四肢，却感到行动受限……耳边传来锁链哗啦作响。你终于清醒，发现自己被按坐在一把铁椅上，手腕与脚踝都套着镣铐。石室阴影沉沉，视野浑浊不清。远处有些模糊的金色轮廓在闪动——火焰。有人扳动拉杆，你身后响起一声金属的咔哒。地面上原先被黑暗吞没的凹槽，此刻在你座下亮起灼光。热浪啃穿你脚底的鞋底，皮肤上的汗珠嘶嘶作响，化作蒸汽。你试图强撑起身，铁链哗哗碰撞，地面却猛地喷出一股股火舌。火焰缠身，皮肤刺痛、融化——你想尖叫，可烈火的咆哮淹没了声音。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The scents of iron and burnt meat stir you from slumber. As you move your tired limbs, you feel inhibited… and hear the rattle of chains. You come to and find yourself seated in an iron chair, shackles about your wrists and feet. The chamber is shadowed, your vision muddy. Blurry golden shapes flicker in the distance—flames. A lever wrenches, and there’s a metallic click behind you. Divots in the floor, before now hidden by the dark, glow beneath your seat. The heat eats through the soles of your feet, and the sweat on your skin sizzles into steam. As you try to force yourself upward, your chains clattering, gouts of flame burst from the floor. Wreathed in flame, skin stinging, melting—you try to scream, but the roar of the fire drowns out the sound.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Cast Shatter Using Components.name:
我使用施法成分施放【粉碎】
I Cast Shatter Using Components

Text.text:
我用指尖捏着那一片云母晶体的薄屑，它仍残留着劈裂它的力量余韵。我把法术的词句吐入这股共鸣之中。我的声音在魔力的回响里震颤，每一次回声都成倍暴涨，直到一记撕裂耳膜、劈开岩石的爆响在我的目标周围轰然炸开。
The sliver of mica crystal I pinch between my fingertips still holds the resonance of the force that slivered it. I speak the words of my spell into this resonance. My voice reverberates with magical feedback, each echo doubling in volume until a clap of ear-rending, stone-splitting noise bursts around my target.

Glamorous Entertainer's Grand Entrance.name:
魅力演艺者的盛大登场
Glamorous Entertainer's Grand Entrance

Text.text:
悬浮车门一开，人群瞬间沸腾，金发天使踏上红色塑胶地面。她那闪烁的礼裙映着相机此起彼伏的闪光，面容宛如精雕细琢的完美雕像。她是魅力的化身，是名副其实的明星，在万众瞩目下璀璨夺目，耀眼得让人无法移开视线。
The crowd erupts as the hovercar door opens and the golden-haired angel steps out onto the red plastic. Her shimmering dress reflects the pulsing lights of cameras, her face a perfect sculpture. She is the embodiment of glamour, a star in every sense of the word, shining bright for all to see.

Thumb Tack On Chair Trap.name:
椅面图钉陷阱
Thumb Tack On Chair Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 一把华丽的座椅摆在你面前，厚厚的尘埃只是稍稍掩住它的雍容。天鹅绒靠背上缝着字样：权力之座。座面以刺绣铺陈出一幕场景——一名贵胄骑士高举长剑，意气风发。

[发现] 细看之下，座面上那幅惊艳的刺绣竟藏着阴沉的秘密。画中英雄所高举的剑刃是真的……而且锋利得可怕！

[触发] 你一屁股坐下，才惊觉为时已晚：剧痛在臀后炸开——骑士握着的那柄锋刃深深刺入你的皮肉。

[Perceived] Before you sits an ornate chair, the thick layer of dust only slightly masking its grandeur. Sewn onto the velvet backrest are the words The Throne of Power. An embroidered scene decorates the seat, a lordly knight raising a sword in triumph.

[Discovered] On closer inspection, the impressive scene embroidered into the seat hides a dark secret. The blade held up by the heroic figure depicted is real… and very sharp!

[Triggered] Sitting down, you realize your mistake too late: pain erupts in your backside as the incredibly sharp blade held by the knight deeply punctures your flesh.

I Cast Mass Suggestion.name:
我施放群体暗示
I Cast Mass Suggestion

Text.text:
舌尖浸满清冷的银意，我以十足的自信对目标开口。对他们而言，我的嗓音会化作慈爱父母的语调与节奏、可信爱人的呢喃，或忠诚友人的低声相劝。我看着他们审视的面孔渐渐松弛，软化成自满的笑容。他们点头如捣蒜，认可我提出的提议。
My tongue drenched in cool silver, I speak to my targets with the utmost confidence. To them, my voice will be the same cadence and tone as a doting parent, a trusted lover, or loyal friend. I watch as their scrutinizing faces soften into complacent grins. They bob their heads in affirmation of my proposition.

A Dark And Dreary Sea.name:
一片阴沉凄冷的海
A Dark And Dreary Sea

Text.text:
缕缕灰烬般的薄雾如溺亡者的幽影般飘荡，徘徊在寂静的漆黑浪涛之上。头顶，浓雾凝结成一片冰冷而阴沉的穹幕，连光与暖的记忆都一并遮蔽。自那萦魂的雾气中，陆地隐现。岛屿的暗影掠过苍白的薄霭与无光的水面，一处更大的岬角浮出，灰色的岸滩被阴森的码头割裂，延伸向一座海边避风港的轮廓。幽灵般的灯火在幽暗中于彼处闪烁。
Wisps of ashen mist float like shades of the drowned, lingering above the silent black waves. Overhead, the fog coalesces into a cold and grim canopy, shrouding even the memory of light and warmth. Out of the haunting vapors, land looms. Shadows of islands glide by on the pale haze and lightless waters, and a larger headland appears, its gray strand divided by darksome docks that lead to the outline of a seaside haven. Ghostly lights twinkle there through the gloom.

“淘气的你，淘气的你，明明可以坦诚却偏要撒谎，明明不必却伸手夺取。现在就让你为那把锋利的舌头流血，也让你的眼睛与指尖一并渗血。此刻你渴求鲜血。直到你进食之前，这饥渴都会如影随形。”
“Naughty you, naughty you, for lying when you could have been true, for taking what you didn’t need. Now bleed from your cutting tongue, and bleed from your eyes and fingers. You hunger now for blood. It will linger ’til you feed.”

Plague Zombie.name:
瘟疫丧尸（特征）
Plague Zombie

Text.text:
这个生物也许曾是母亲或姐妹，但她的人形早已向内塌陷，骨头从剥落的皮肤里刺出。她的手臂拉长伸展，修长的手指攫抓不止，乳白的眼珠游移搜寻新鲜的血肉。她逼近时，一股腻人的恶臭如潮水翻涌着覆上你。如今她更近了，你看见她腐烂的肉体上布满破裂的脓疱，从那些斑点般的创口里，脉动着海市蜃楼般的坏死腐光。
This creature might once have been a mother or sister, but her humanoid form has collapsed into itself and bones poke through sloughing skin. Her arms stretch out, long fingers grasp, and milky eyes rove for fresh flesh. As she approaches, a cloying reek roils over you like the tide. And now that she's closer, you see a mirage-like shimmer of necrotic rot pulsing from the ruptured pustules that dot her flesh.

Loot From A Steam Mephit.name:
来自一只蒸汽小恶魔的战利品
Loot From A Steam Mephit

Text.text:
当那生物的濒死尖啸在闷热潮湿的空气中回荡时，它身后留下了一团旋涌的元素之水气泡。那球体悬浮于空，不断变幻重塑，内部隐约可见细小的波涛起伏。
As the creature’s death scream echoes through the stifling humid air, it leaves behind a swirling bubble of elemental water. The sphere hovers in the air, constantly reshaping itself, and small waves can be glimpsed within.

这头猎犬像一只鼻端钝圆的巨大啮齿兽，正疯狂贴地嗅探，搜寻猎物的蛛丝马迹。它肩高四尺，粉红色的躯体上斑驳着焦灼的毛发，肌肉在皮下起伏翻涌。两只小耳朵像是被剪短了，让那张宽阔的脸更显粗蛮。牙齿也被改造过，磨削至刀锋般锐利。生物额头渗出汗珠，触及空气便以化学般的烈性嘶嘶作响。黑铁箍缠在它的颈间，上面钉满尖刺。
Like a large blunt-nosed rodent, this hound sniffs rabidly at the ground for signs of prey. Four feet tall at the shoulder, its pinkish body sports patches of burnt hair and rippling muscle. Its small ears look to have been docked, giving the wide face a brutish look. So too are the teeth modified, filed down to a razor’s edge. Sweat beads on the creature’s brow, fizzing with chemical intensity as it meets the air. Black iron bands have been wrapped about the hound’s neck and fitted with spikes.

Iron Flask With Embedded Rune.name:
镶嵌符文的铁制魔瓶
Iron Flask With Embedded Rune

Text.text:
朴素而结实的扁壶沉甸甸地压在你掌心。冰凉光滑的外壁在壶口一圈刻着细小的纹饰，正面嵌着一枚巨大的钢制符文。它看起来寻常乏味，你却心知并非如此。那枚黄铜塞子之下，你能感觉到它的饥渴——一种浩瀚到几乎能吞下并囚住任何活物的饥渴。
Simple and sturdy, the flask sits heavy in your hand. The cool, smooth exterior has small engravings along the lip and a large steel rune embedded in the front. Though it looks commonplace and uninspiring, you know otherwise. Beneath that brass stopper, you can feel its hunger—a hunger so vast it could swallow and hold almost any living thing.

Vexbane's Schoolhouse In Winter.name:
冬日的维克斯贝恩学舍
Vexbane's Schoolhouse In Winter

Text.text:
孩子们在校舍外的院子里奔跑嬉闹；茅草屋顶压着厚雪，沉沉下垂。一个侏儒男孩抡起雪球砸向一名红鳞龙裔女孩，她轻轻喷出一口龙焰吐息，将那团飞来的雪化作无害的白雾蒸汽。“作弊！”侏儒叫道，可他的咯咯笑声出卖了他对她那番炫技的喜爱。一个皮肤棕褐的半身人孩子在高个精灵男孩的帮忙下堆雪人，精灵用魅惑般的手法让树枝做的胳膊与鼻子抽出嫩叶与花朵。老师在一旁守夜，神情哭笑不得；目光却不时游移到屋顶上——褐色发霉的芦苇正被融雪浸得滴滴答答。
Children run around the yard outside the schoolhouse, the thatched roof snow-laden and sagging. A gnome boy hurls a snowball at a red dragonborn girl, who melts the projectile to harmless steam with a spout of her fire breath. “Cheat!” cries the gnome, but his giggle betrays his delight at her showmanship. A tan-skinned halfling child builds a snowperson with the help of a tall elven boy who charms the stick arms and nose to sprout leaves and flowers. The teacher watches in a bemused vigil. Their gaze wanders every so often to the roof, the brown and molding reeds dripping with snowmelt.

Worker At Coffee Shop.name:
咖啡店店员
Worker At Coffee Shop

Text.text:
咖啡师活力四溢——就像她此刻正打发的牛奶泡沫般轻盈翻涌——她一边与客人攀谈，一边让愉悦染上她的榛色眼眸，如最温暖的炉火映光。她语速飞快，仿佛词句正为争夺空间而你追我赶；与此同时，她不停驯服那些从帆布发带里逃出来的深赤褐色碎发。

~ Envisioned by Sahlohnahl on Discord

The barista is effervescent—much like the milk she is currently frothing—and joy tints her hazel eyes like the warmest hearth as she chats with customers. She speaks quickly, as if her words are fighting for space, and she is constantly taming stray locks of dark auburn hair that escape her canvas headband.

~ Envisioned by Sahlohnahl on Discord

Data Storm Resisted.name:
数据风暴已抵御
Data Storm Resisted

Text.text:
你发动攻击——一招又快又脏的把戏——用垃圾数据轰击你的目标：数百个毫无意义的函数占用对方装置的资源，迫使其同时发起内存调用。五彩斑斓的数据触手从你伸出的掌心跃起。敌人身形如水银般流畅，俯冲翻滚，用一条裹着黄色光甲的肢体将你抓攫的攻击拨向一侧。尽管如此，仍有一根触手擦中一下，从对手迟缓地重新站稳脚跟可见端倪。

~ 由一位英雄构想

You attack, a quick and dirty trick, blasting your target with garbage data designed to take up their rig’s resources through hundreds of useless functions, forcing simultaneous memory calls. Multicolored tentacles of data leap from your outstretched palm. In a fluid quicksilver motion, the enemy dives and rolls, batting your grasping attack to one side with a limb armored in yellow light. Nevertheless, one of your tentacles scores a glancing hit, reflected in your foe’s slowness to recover their footing.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Criminal Contact Waiting On The Docks.name:
码头上等待接头的罪犯联系人
Criminal Contact Waiting On The Docks

Text.text:
海风呼啸着掠过那年轻人短短的头发，他目光阴冷，凶相毕露。少年斜倚在一摞摞木箱旁，用拇指将一枚硬币轻轻弹起。金色的金属在日光下旋转、闪烁，他看着它落回掌心，又随手抛起再接住。

你走近时，他动作一顿，侧目扫了你一眼。眼底掠过一丝认出你的光，嘴角便慢慢爬上一抹坏笑。他站直身子，正面对着你，拳头攥紧那枚金币。

“这天气真是漂亮，不过我倒等不及让一场风暴压到头顶。”他每个字里都透着一丝兴奋。

他把硬币朝你抛来；你一入手就能分辨——这是假货。
The ocean breeze blasts past the short-cut hair of the young man sporting a nasty glare. He leans up against some stacked boxes, flipping a coin up with his thumb. He watches the gold metal spin and glimmer in the light of the sun before catching and tossing it again. Upon your approach, he pauses to glance at you. There’s a glint of recognition as a smirk crawls its way onto his face. He straightens up on his feet and faces you, gripping the gold coin in his fist. “Gorgeous weather we’re having, but I’m ready for a coming storm to break overhead.” He speaks with a twinge of excitement lacing each word. The man tosses you the coin, and upon feeling it with your hand, you can tell it’s fake.

Threat From An Assassin About Sleeping.name:
来自刺客的睡梦威胁
Threat From An Assassin About Sleeping

Text.text:
“猛士沉睡之时，喉间也与农夫一般柔软。”
“A mighty warrior’s throat is just as soft as a peasant’s when they sleep.”

Reloading Gun Box Magazine.name:
装弹：枪盒弹匣
Reloading Gun Box Magazine

Text.text:
他们咔哒一声猛地把弹匣从枪上扯下，随手丢到地上，空洞的塑料声当啷作响。枪手从腰带上又拽出一个弹匣，啪地一声拍进卡槽。几下迅捷而娴熟的动作后，枪械重新上膛，就绪再度喷吐弹雨。
They wrench the magazine from the gun with a click and then drop it to the floor, where it clatters with a hollow, plastic sound. The gunner yanks another magazine from their belt and slaps it into place. With a few swift, practiced maneuvers, the gun is loaded and ready for bullet-blazing action once more.

I Cast Detect Poison And Disease.name:
我施放“侦测毒素与疾病”
I Cast Detect Poison And Disease

Text.text:
我深吸一口气，缓缓合上双眼，让感官如潮水般漫过周遭，同时压低声音喃喃念出法术的词句。四肢涌起一阵刺麻的战栗，苦涩的胆汁顶上喉头；我强行凝神——试图越过凡俗的感官界限。待我再度睁眼，近处任何污秽、腐败或病患的存在，都在我的感知中清晰浮现。
I breathe deeply and close my eyes, allowing my senses to flow through my surroundings as I mutter the words of the spell under my breath. A tingling sensation manifests in my limbs and bile rises in my throat as I focus my mind—attempting to go beyond my mortal senses. When I open my eyes, I can feel the presence of nearby taint, rot, or malady.

这团生物宛如一坨无定形的黏块，凝结的躯体周围长满大小不一、獠牙森森且涎水淋漓的嘴。它喷吐着无穷无尽的胡言乱语，层叠的声音仿佛要将你的心智一把推过理智的崖边。
Resembling an amorphous blob sporting fanged, drooling mouths of various sizes around its congealed body, the creature spouts an endless litany of babbling gibberish, its voices threatening to catapult your mind over the brink of sanity.

I Cast Bane As A Cleric.name:
我以牧师之名施放【灾祸】
I Cast Bane As A Cleric

Text.text:
我咬住自己脸颊内侧，咬出血来，宣告敌人有罪。每一个人都能用感官体会到我审判加诸其动作上的沉重枷锁。
I condemn my foes as I bite the inside of my cheek, drawing blood. Each one senses the burden of my judgment on their actions.

Elemental Bane: Thunder.name:
元素灾厄：雷霆
Elemental Bane: Thunder

Text.text:
轰鸣的能量在你体内绽放，凝聚成一圈脉动的雷霆威势光环。新生风暴的腥气弥漫空气，带着逼近暴雨的苦涩滋味。你的身形忽明忽暗，你在自己与远处的敌手之间打开一道通道，试图剥离他们的防御，削弱他们对你所驾驭的咆哮之力的抗力。
Booming energy blossoms within you, forming a pulsating aura of thunderous might. The stench of a birthing storm fills the air with the bitter taste of an approaching tempest. Your form flickers as you open a channel between you and your distant foe, attempting to strip away their defenses and reduce their resistance to the howling powers you command.

Nïva From The Sacred Coast.name:
来自圣海岸的尼瓦
Nïva From The Sacred Coast

Text.text:
恶魔般的血脉或许能解释这女人的赤红肌肤与眼眸，以及那对酒红色的弯角。她一头乌鸦般的长发垂落，层叠的丝质长裙如水般披覆在纤细的身形上，却仍遮不住那条轻轻甩动的尾巴——尾尖生着倒钩，颜色渐渐加深，与她的角一同在末端沉入靛蓝。那抹色彩与她颈间银链上垂挂的一颗硕大蓝宝石相互呼应。她含笑露齿，莹白尖牙闪着冷光，同时把一只小小的绿蜥蜴从一只利爪般的手心轻送到另一只，让它敏捷地窜行。这个神情也让她左颊上的心形纹身更显眼了。

~ Played by Lord of Light

Fiendish blood might explain this woman’s red skin and eyes, along with her burgundy horns. Her long, raven hair and a layered, silky gown drape her slender form, although the dress fails to hide her swishing tail—which ends in a barb that darkens, as do her horns, to indigo at the end. The color echoes the hue of a large sapphire dangling from a silver chain around her neck. She smiles, baring gleaming white fangs, as she helps a small green lizard scamper from one of her clawed hands to the other. The expression makes the heart tattoo on her left cheek more prominent.

~ Played by Lord of Light

Oskar, The Pale One.name:
奥斯卡，“苍白者”
Oskar, The Pale One

Text.text:
笑容可掬的圆胖男人走路时微微佝偻，枯槁的黑色头顶露出一块秃斑，其间夹着几缕灰丝。粗糙起茧的双手、乌黑的指甲，以及上衣皮革上被烟灰浸染的痕迹，都在诉说他多年打铁的生涯，与炉火高温相伴的忍耐。 [Transformation] 电光一闪，男人骤然蜕变。不再背负年代的重担，他挺身而立——高大而骄傲——一头浓密的黑发在忽然环绕的柔风中飘扬。手中凭空显现一柄恢宏巨刃——大到凡人根本无法挥动——将他浸在天穹般炽亮的辉光里。

~ 由 Spac3cowboyy 扮演

The smiling rotund man stoops slightly as he walks, exposing the bald patch of his withering black pate tinged with wisps of gray. Rough, calloused hands, blackened nails, and the soot-stained leather of his tunic attest to many years of smithing and enduring the heat of the furnace. [Transformation] In a flash the man transforms. No longer carrying the burdens of age, he stands—tall and proud—his luxurious black hair borne aloft by the gentle breeze which now surrounds him. A magnificent blade—too large for a mortal to wield—appears in his hands, bathing him in the glow of celestial incandescence.

~ Played by Spac3cowboyy

Wild Magic Surge: Mass Invisibility.name:
狂野魔法涌动：群体隐形
Wild Magic Surge: Mass Invisibility

Text.text:
一股原始的魔法泉涌自你脚下渗出，向外流淌，接触到附近徘徊的每一个生物。它们一个接一个地消失，仿佛从未存在——但一阵困惑的哼哼声与拖步的窸窣声合奏般回荡，暗示它们只是被变得隐形了。
A wellspring of raw magic seeps up beneath you and flows outward to touch every creature lingering nearby. They all vanish, one by one, as though they had never been—but a chorus of confused grunting and shuffling suggests that they have only been rendered invisible.

I Have Steel Will.name:
我有钢铁般的意志
I Have Steel Will

Text.text:
恐惧会让你的身体反叛。那份反叛会让你无法按理应的方式行动——即便生死攸关也是如此。我早已为恐惧做好准备。它来临时，我让自己如铁般绷紧，任由它像一阵掠过的浪潮从我身边冲刷而过。若那浪把我拖入水下，我淬硬的本能便会将我推回水面。
Fear makes your body rebel. That rebellion makes you unable to act as you should—even when survival depends on it. I’ve prepared myself for fear. When it comes, I steel myself and let it wash around me like a passing wave. If the wave pulls me under, my hardened instincts push me back toward the surface.

Dueling For Sport.name:
以武会友
Dueling For Sport

Text.text:
对立的学生彼此退开十步，各自将施法器竖直举起，让观众与裁判都看得清清楚楚。抵达决斗圈的边缘后，他们停下脚步，等待信号，双手因期待而微微颤抖。裁判高喊：“施放！”决斗者随即转身，魔杖被奥术能量点燃；他们的攻势虽温和且不致命，却仍以灼烈之势在空气中噼啪炸响。
The opposing students take ten paces away from each other, each holding their focus upright for the spectators and referee to see. At the edge of the dueling circle, they stop and wait for the signal, hands shaky with anticipation. The referee shouts, “Cast!” The duelists turn, wands alight with arcane energy, and their attacks, though mild and non-lethal, crackle through the air with searing force.

你眼前的恐怖，是一团食人魔般巨大的蠕动鳞肉。成窝的蟒蛇彼此解缠，显露出它们其实是附着在一具蛇形躯干上的数条肢体。每一颗蟒首都将一柄锯齿长剑拖曳着举向空中，让致命的刀刃在令人目眩的舞步中摆荡。缓慢旋转的利刃之后，那生物露出一张充满憎恨的獠牙面孔，双眼布满血丝。
The horror before you is an ogre-sized mass of slithering, scaled flesh. A nest of pythons disentangles, revealing themselves to be several limbs attached to a serpentine body. And each python-head drags a serrated sword into the air, moving the deadly blades in a hypnotizing dance. Behind the slowly whirling blades, the creature has a hateful fanged face and bloodshot eyes.

一群植物般的生物聚拢在一起；它们不发出任何声响，却显然在彼此交流。它们的身高、颜色、甚至肢体数量各不相同，但每一颗头都绽放成蘑菇般的轮廓。好几只的三叉手掌上，那海绵状的皮肤正袅袅逸散出某种烟雾。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

A group of plant-like creatures gather, and though they make no noise, it's clear they're communicating with one other. They vary in height, color, and even number of limbs, but each head blooms into the general shape of a fungus. Several have some kind of fumes emanating from the spongy skin of their three-pronged hands.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

她身着一袭完全以铆钉皮革制成的长裙——每一枚钢钉都像星光般的微点，钉在深褐色的锦织上——裙摆轻盈飘逸、行走自如，仿佛违抗了这等装束理应带来的沉重。长裙贴合得顺滑而完美，勾勒出她丰腴的身段、圆润的胯骨，以及结实宽阔的肩膀。她用带着玩笑意味的手指，轻轻掠过项链上那几片巨大、宛如巨龙的鳞片：白、绿、白、白；你发觉自己的目光停留得比应有的更久。她那双碧绿的眼眸点缀着金色碎光，比她的衣饰与珠宝还要更加熠熠生辉。

~ 扮演者：一位英雄

She wears a dress crafted totally of studded leather—each steel stud a starry pinprick on a rich brown tapestry—its airiness and ease of flow seeming to defy the weight such a garment should have. The dress fits smoothly, perfectly, to her curvaceous body, her round hips, and strong, broad shoulders. You feel your eyes lingering longer than they should when she traces a playful finger across the large draconic-looking scales of her necklace: white, green, white, white. Her verdant eyes, flecked with gold, glister even more than her garb and jewelry.

~ Played by a Hero with

这把强大武器的锤头被锻造成彗星横贯苍穹的姿态，散发着触手可及的异界威势。柄身上以优雅的文字卷饰沿着全长盘旋成令人目眩的螺旋，你的目光所及之处，词句仿佛永不停歇地流转变幻。
The head of this mighty weapon has been forged in the likeness of a comet blazing across the heavens and radiates a palpable aura of otherworldly power. Scrollwork of elegant text runs the length of the haft in a mesmerizing spiral, the words shifting beneath your gaze as if in constant motion.

Flying Sword Attack.name:
飞剑攻击
Flying Sword Attack

Text.text:
这把长剑保存得一尘不染：宽阔的刃身如波纹般起伏的钢光流转，剑柄以皮革紧缠，护手与剑首上镶嵌着宝石，冷冷闪耀。你伸手去触及它，随即又惊愕地猛然缩回——长剑竟自行弹起，悬浮在半空。你还来不及反应，它已自行摆出架势，仿佛被一名隐形的决斗者握持，旋即挥斩而下，直取性命。
The sword is in pristine condition, a broad blade of rippled steel with a leather-wrapped hilt and gemstones bedecking its crossguard and pommel. You reach for it, then recoil with astonishment as the sword springs upward on its own, floating in mid-air. Before you can react, the sword readies itself, as if wielded by an invisible duelist, and swings in for the kill.

Loot From A Gold Dragon's Body.name:
从金龙遗骸中搜刮的战利品
Loot From A Gold Dragon's Body

Text.text:
这条巨龙的颅骨根部多生出一根额外的巨角，足有三尺多长。尽管巨龙已然死去，那角尖却似仍在幽幽发光。它至少值1200枚金币。
This dragon has an extra horn at the base of its skull, more than three feet long. The horn seems to still glow despite the dragon’s lack of life. It must be worth at least 1200 gold pieces.

你早已明白，在甩去指尖水滴之前，先将那一撮尘埃松入渐起的风中会更容易。此等朴素手势的用意立刻昭然：冰块如暴雨般砸入区域，轰然粉碎、凛然冻结，将一切不幸被你所唤起的冰雹风暴卷入其中的人尽数摧折。 You've learned that it's easier to release the pinch of dust into the gathering wind before shaking droplets of water from your fingers. The purpose of these simple gestures is made immediately clear as chunks of ice begin to smash into the area, pummeling and freezing anyone unlucky enough to be caught within your invoked ice storm.

Quip After Failure.name:
失败后的俏皮话
Quip After Failure

Text.text: “别。一个字都别说。我知道，好吗？我能感觉到你们那股评判在翻涌，我需要你们都明白——我已经在这里尽全力了。我他妈真的在拼命努力，努力得要命，可也许人们要我们去做的那些疯狂事，有些就是太过头了。” “Don’t. Don’t say a word. I know, okay? I can feel the judgment seething out of you and I need you all to know that I’m doing my best out here. I’m trying so damn hard, but maybe some of the insane things people ask us to do are just a bit too much.”

空旷的隧道与洞室蜿蜒曲折，深入这座严寒的山腹；地面、墙壁与穹顶尽被嶙峋的冰棱覆盖。雪地里清晰可见巨大的足迹，参差的爪痕深深刻进岩壁。被啃噬的骨头堆成小丘；半食的尸体冻僵倒卧。洞穴深处有什么在蠢动——一声低沉的咆哮在隧道间回荡。
The cavernous tunnels and chambers wind their way deep into the frigid mountain, the floor, walls, and ceiling covered with jagged ice. Massive footprints are visible in the snow, and ragged claw marks are etched deep into the walls. Gnawed bones sit in piles; half-eaten corpses lie frozen. Something stirs deep in the cave—a rumbling growl that echoes through the tunnels.

这件斗篷走过的路，比大多数人一生都要远。褪色的斑块——草草缝补——诉说着在荒野中度过的漫长昼夜，远离哪怕偏僻路边旅店的那点安全。它永远萦绕着柴烟、大蒜与狼毒草的气息——那是穿戴者严酷职责的见证。 This cloak has traveled more than most people ever do. Discolored patches—hastily sewn—attest to long days and nights in the wilderness far from the safety of even remote roadside inns. It carries a permanent aroma of woodsmoke, garlic, and wolfsbane—a testament to the grim duty of the one who wears it.

Small Steam Elemental.name:
小型蒸汽元素
Small Steam Elemental

Text.text:
一张棱角分明的面孔自蒸汽中浮现，紧随其后的是一对蝙蝠般的翅膀。尽管身形矮小，这个生物却带着恶魔般的欢愉恶意。它仍半成形，或半可见，隐没在翻涌的白色雾涛之间。
An angular face emerges from the steam, followed by a pair of batlike wings. The creature has all the delighted malice of a devil despite its diminutive stature. It remains half formed, or half visible, amid the white billows.

Religious, Fortified Town.name:
宗教氛围浓厚的要塞城镇
Religious, Fortified Town

Text.text:
当你走近一座被高耸灰浆石墙环绕的城镇时，钟声悠然回荡。城垛上旌旗猎猎翻飞，城镇沉重的城门之上，一尊宗教圣像巍然矗立。把守城墙的卫兵也自豪地展示着那圣像。
Bells ring out as you approach a town encircled by a high wall of mortared stone. Banners flutter from those ramparts, and above the town’s heavy gate, a religious icon towers. The guards manning the walls display the icon proudly.

Motorcycle Race In Busy City Streets End.name:
繁忙都市街头的摩托车竞速让所有人置身险境
Motorcycle Race In Busy City Streets Endangers Everyone

Text.text:
引擎的咆哮与惊惶的尖叫撕裂了城市喧嚣的氛围，地面随之震颤。片刻之后，一群披着霓虹涂装的摩托车呼啸而过，对自己带来的危险浑然不觉——或是正沉醉其中。你正看着，其中一辆猛然失控，斜冲着撞进路边店面，玻璃与金属在身后轰然炸裂、四散飞溅。
The roar of engines and startled screams tear through the bustling atmosphere of the city as the ground vibrates. Moments later, a pack of motorcycles in neon livery rushes by, ignorant of the danger they present—or reveling in it. As you watch, one of the vehicles crashes, careening into a storefront as glass and metal explode in its wake.

Aura Of Vitality.name:
活力灵光
Aura Of Vitality

Text.text:
一团球形的金色能量迷雾环绕着施法者，翻涌着向他们饱受折磨的目标漫去。受伤之人被骤然迸现的闪耀光辉所洗礼，片刻间，他们将那光吸入肺腑，凝望伤口愈合——皮肉以令人惊叹的速度重新黏合，如奇迹般复原。
A spherical fog of golden energy surrounds the spellcaster, flowing out toward their beleaguered target. The injured person is bathed in a sudden aura of sparkling light, and for a moment they breathe it in and watch their wounds heal, skin knitting together with wondrous speed.

Power Word Stun.name:
律令：震慑
Power Word Stun

Text.text:
你吐出那一个词——古老的词，奥秘的词，嗡鸣着秘法之力的词——你的声音与它超凡脱俗的韵律共振回荡。你面前的生物仿佛骤然遭受重击般一震，几乎僵立不动，目瞪口呆。
You speak the word—an ancient word, an arcane word, one humming with esoteric power—and your voice resonates with its otherworldly sway. The creature before you reacts as if suddenly struck, standing almost motionless, dumbfounded.

带卵石纹玻璃小窗的木门吱呀一声荡开，露出一位白发半身人女子，坐在一张过分宽大的抛光橡木书桌后。她身后左侧，铁制衣帽架上挂着一件长外套；右侧的洞洞板上，则挂着一排不同体型的放大镜。你踏入她的办公室时，她把宽檐帽往后一推，那双明亮的翠绿眼睛盯着你打量了好几秒。她像是下定了决心，把另一只一直藏在桌下的手抽了出来——手里是一把轻弩——并小心翼翼地将其放在桌上的吸墨垫上。她朝你身旁的空椅子示意，随即拉开抽屉，取出两只高球杯和一只装满琥珀色液体的玻璃瓶，分别给每只杯子倒了浅浅一指的量。

~ Envisioned by Micah

The wooden door with the pebbled glass window swings open to reveal a white-haired halfling woman behind an over-large, polished oak desk. Behind her to the left, a long coat hangs from an iron coatrack; and to her right, a collection of magnifying lenses of different sizes hang from a pegboard. As you enter her office, she pushes back her wide-brimmed hat and brilliant green eyes size you up for a few long seconds. She seems to come to a decision and withdraws her other hand from under the desk, emerging with a light crossbow, which she places carefully on the desk blotter. She gestures to the empty chair near you, then opens a drawer and removes two highball glasses and a glass bottle full of amber liquid, pouring a short measure in each.

~ Envisioned by Micah

Oratory Of A Creepy Manor.name:
阴森庄园的演讲厅
Oratory Of A Creepy Manor

Text.text:
你很难相信，竟会有人想与自己的神祇相通，却还会踏入这座如今这般景象的礼拜堂。祭坛上被泼洒了某种恶臭的秽物，苍蝇在其表面嗡嗡盘旋。挂毯被某种钝器撕裂出一道道豁口，彩绘玻璃窗也被砸得粉碎——多半是有人怀着恶意掷石所致。
You cannot believe anyone wishing communion with their deity would enter this chapel in its current state. The altar has been splashed with a foul-smelling substance and flies buzz across its surface. Tapestries have been gashed with some sort of blunt instrument and the stained glass windows smashed, presumably by rocks thrown with malignant intent.

Balasar Norixius.name:
巴拉萨尔·诺里克修斯
Balasar Norixius

Text.text:
你面前矗立着一位威势凛然的龙裔身影，强健的体魄裹在闪耀的黄铜鳞片之下。明亮的蓝宝石眼眸几乎不泄露半分情绪，只把内里翻涌的波澜牢牢封存。精制的冬装外，他披着打磨得纤尘不染的板条甲；一柄巨大的巨剑随意搁在单侧肩头，背后还斜系着一支标枪——两者的锋长都覆着一层薄薄的冰霜。尽管他浑身透着武人的肃杀气息，面容却温和可亲，咧开的笑意清晰可见，他一边指挥着守卫这座雪覆村庄的人们。仿佛一尊黄铜巨神，这位光明的勇士立在摇摇欲坠的寨门前，随时准备守护门内的众生。北地深沉的黑夜降临时，圣武士的鳞片开始发亮，将他灼灼的美德映照出来——在这冰封之境里，他就是一座名副其实的希望灯塔。

~ 由 Ethan 以 Played 之名扮演，使用

Before you stands an imposing draconic figure, his muscular build sheathed in gleaming brass scales. Bright sapphire eyes reveal little of the emotions seething inside. Over well-made winter garb, the knight sports highly polished splint mail, with a huge greatsword resting easily upon one shoulder and a javelin strapped to his back, both their lengths dusted with a coating of thin ice. Despite such martial bearing, his face is kind, a grin evident as he directs those defending the snow-covered village. Like a brazen titan, this champion of light stands at the ramshackle gate, ready to protect those within. As the deep dark of the northern night falls, the paladin's scales begin to shine, reflecting his radiant virtue, a veritable beacon of hope in this frozen domain.

~ Played by Ethan with

Warning From A Quest Giver About Descent.name:
来自委托人的警告：坠入地狱
Warning From A Quest Giver About Descent Into Hell

Text.text:
“听着，我看得出来你是真心想行善，我也感激你愿意接下这差事。但下面那些生物，会用痛苦诱惑你，也会用欢愉诱惑你。我不怀疑你能扛住伤口，可若是给你一个实现最深渴望的机会呢？给你一个向最可恨的仇敌复仇的机会呢？我只希望你能在那地方找得到路。谈论善良很容易——真正证明它，却完全是另一回事。”
“Look, I can tell you mean to do good and I appreciate you taking this on, but the creatures down there tempt with pleasure as well as pain. I don’t doubt you can handle injury, but a chance at your greatest desire? A chance for revenge on your worst enemy? I hope you can find your way through that place. It’s easy to talk about being good—proving it is something else entirely.”

这位瘦削的年轻女子身着贴身的皮制短上衣与长裤，靴子与手套颜色更深。决斗细剑与匕首分别入鞘，垂挂在横跨双胯的腰带上。她的深色短发齐肩上方，勾勒出面庞，让肤色显得更为苍白。她目光冷硬，更衬得那双异色眼——一只湛蓝，一只碧绿。

~ 由一位英雄扮演

This thin young woman is dressed in a close-fitting leather doublet and pants, with darker boots and gloves. A dueling sword and dagger hang, sheathed, from belts that cross either hip. Her dark hair, bobbed just above the shoulder, frames her face and makes it seem paler. She has a hard stare, accenting that one of her eyes is blue and the other green.

~ Played by a Hero

齿轮帆船与卡拉克大船挤塞着狭窄的港湾，每艘都升着来自不同自由港的五彩船帆。晒得黝黑、臂膀粗壮的水手沿着跳板搬运木箱与酒桶，劳作间彼此吆喝着下令。一间独独蹲在码头旁的酒馆许诺：只要你掏得出钱，便有朗姆酒与片刻安宁。
Cogs and carracks clog the meager harbor, each flying a multi-colored sail of a different freeport. Sun-browned sailors with thick arms haul crates and barrels down gangplanks, barking orders to one another as they toil. A single tavern squatting beside the dock promises rum and a moment's peace for any with coin to spare.

Warrior's Compliment To A Bard About Ear.name:
战士对吟游诗人赢得敬意的赞美
Warrior's Compliment To A Bard About Earned Respect

Text.text:
“真是怪，但我已经开始敬重你了。你也许瘦得像根柴，连剑都快举不起来，可你说出口的话自有千钧之重。”
“It’s strange, but I’ve come to respect you. You may be stringy with hardly enough strength to lift a sword, but your words carry a weight all their own.”

Blue Dragonborn Monk.name:
蓝龙裔武僧
Blue Dragonborn Monk

Text.text:
覆鳞的武僧以一种超脱尘世的优雅行动，仿佛其余现实都只是笨拙孩童，绕着他纤细而精准的动作踉跄掠过。他结实的蔚蓝胸膛从午夜般漆黑的长袍褶皱间若隐若现，猩红的点缀如长枪般刺破布料，拉出锐利、干净的线条。静电充斥他周遭的空气，令碧蓝火花自他携带的金属武器上跳舞：一把弓与一根长杖，造型独特，致命非凡。

~ 由 Discord 上的 Sahlonahl 在 Envisioned 于 Discord

The scaled monk moves with an otherworldly grace, as if the rest of reality is merely passing around their lithe, precise movements like clumsy children. His muscular blue chest peeks out between the folds of midnight-black robes, and accents of crimson lance through the fabric in sharp, crisp lines. Static fills the air around him, causing azure sparks to dance from the metallic weapons he carries: a bow and staff of unique and deadly quality.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

这个法术自阴影中纺出实体。然而寻常的自然阴影并不足用，它需要通向更深沉的黑暗的许可。你一边吟诵将诸界边界牵引相合的力量真言，一边专注于法术，并以正确的手势拨开其间的帷幕；可你清楚地感到现实正在抗拒你的意志。你所造之物终将回归它来处——只不过是时间早晚的问题。
This spell spins substance from shadows. But no natural shadow will do, it requires access to a greater darkness. You concentrate upon the spell as you chant the power words that bring the boundaries between planes together, and gesture in the proper way to part the veil between them, but you’re conscious of reality resisting your will. That which you create will return whence it came—it is only a matter of when.

你以浑厚悠长的咒声将对方哄入深沉的恍惚，使其灵魂脱离躯壳，无论相隔多远，都能穿行、干涉并与他人的梦境之境交流。
Lulling the other into a deep trance, your sonorous incantation frees their spirit from their body to traverse, influence, and communicate within the dreamscape of another, no matter the distance involved.

Surprise Survival And Reprisal Against W.name:
雏龙突袭：生存与反击
Surprise Survival And Reprisal Against Wyrmling

Text.text:
他本该几乎瞬间就被冻毙，而不是只被掀翻在地，仍能阴沉地回瞪那头白龙雏龙。龙息的锥形寒潮在他们之间闪耀坠落，如同雪幕。覆在他身上的一层霜衣，与那年轻精灵的白发相映成辉。他起身时，猩红的眼睛洞穿冷雾，霜衣随之龟裂剥落，毫发无伤。他抽出双匕。或许会有一个时代，巨龙能胜过他，但当精灵纵身跃起，匕首直指龙的双眼时，你知道——绝不会是今天。

~ 由 Feyric Del Varnish 构想

He should be frozen dead almost instantly instead of only knocked down and scowling back at the white dragon wyrmling. The cone of dragon breath glitters and falls like snow between them. A rime of frost over him matches the young elf’s white hair. His red eyes pierce through as he stands, and the rime cracks away, harmless. He draws his daggers. There may be a time when a dragon could best him, but as the elf jumps and aims the daggers at the dragon’s eyes, you know it will not be today.

~ Envisioned by Feyric Del Varnish

Gravedigger's Loot Bag.name:
掘墓人的战利品袋
Gravedigger's Loot Bag

Text.text:
它曾装满赖以生存的要紧口粮。如今却被泥土糟蹋得不成样子，袋底湿得发黏，像一口双色的陶罐。这是一只带抽绳的谷物袋，只要把它倒扣过来，便会倾泻出一顿“祭念”的残餐——一枚枚纪念信物。它们上撒骨屑，下抹腐败污痕，永远与至亲、战士或贵族的遗骨一同下葬。而这，正是盗墓贼的杰作。
This was once full of essential sustenance. Now it is filthy with earth, the bottom so damp it resembles a two-toned pot. It’s a grain sack fitted with a drawstring, and when it’s upturned, it disgorges a meal of memorial tokens. They are sprinkled with bone chips, smeared with rot, and always buried with the remains of a loved one or warrior or noble. This is the work of a grave robber.

Orb Of Black Opal.name:
黑蛋白石宝珠
Orb Of Black Opal

Text.text:
这枚澄澈的石球正中央封着一场雷暴——黑、蓝、紫交织的云团在其中翻滚涌动，脉动着骇人的能量。石球约一磅重，是最沉的灵球之一；学者若要在一心多用时仍让它悬浮不坠，必须臂力过人。它的察觉射程向外不过百码左右，向下仅及地下约一英尺，却能在使用者上方升至一千英尺高。其元素为电。
At the center of this clear stone is a lightning storm—black, blue, and purple cloud, roiling and pulsing with energy. The stone weighs about a pound, one of the heaviest orbs, and requires a strong scholar to keep it levitated while multitasking. Its perception range is only a hundred yards or so outward, and only a foot below ground, but it rises to a thousand feet above its user. Its element is electricity.

尽管这把武器只是礼仪之用，很可能是为某位高阶教士打造的华丽陈设品，但施加在这柄象牙与金银合金钉头锤上的附魔依旧强大无比。
Though this weapon is ceremonial and was likely built as a showpiece for some high-ranking curate, the enchantments laid upon this mace of ivory and electrum are nonetheless potent.

这套护甲以色泽奇异、质地丰润的皮革制成，柔韧却坚实——该轻盈处轻盈，该灵活处灵活，其余部分则厚实而刚硬。鲸骨加固了上躯干，布面衬垫下隐约闪出金属冷光，暗示着更深一层的防护。尽管护甲年代久远，从陈旧的式样与工艺便可见一斑，却不见丝毫年代或磨损的痕迹。
The rich, strangely hued leather of this armor is supple yet sturdy—light and flexible where it needs to be, thick and rigid otherwise. Whalebone reinforces the upper torso, and a metallic gleam hints at further protection beneath the cloth padding. Though the armor is quite old, evident by its dated style and construction, it shows no apparent signs of age or wear.

Highland Games, Lazy Stick.name:
高地竞技会，懒人短棍
Highland Games, Lazy Stick

Text.text:
两名参赛者在场地上相对而坐，双腿伸直，靴底平贴在对方脚底上。两人各自抓住一根约三英尺长的沉重木棍一端。随后猛然发力，向后拉拽。额头上汗珠迸出，绷紧的肌肉如弓弦般颤动。有人被一点点拽向中央，直到最后臀部离草地抬起了几寸——哨声随即响起。
Two contestants sit on the field facing one another, with legs straight and soles of their boots flat against the other. Each takes hold of one end of a heavy stick about three feet long. They pull. Beads of sweat pop up over foreheads and taught muscles. One is tugged toward the center, until finally their backside leaves the grass by a couple of inches, and the whistle sounds.

I Forage For Herbs.name:
我采药寻草
I Forage For Herbs

Text.text:
在烈日下行走、蹲伏、跪地、眯眼搜寻的灼热与辛劳，终于换来了成果。稀罕而细小的叶片，绿得与周遭草丛无异；还有成片常见的草药，我总是先闻到它们的气味，才看见它们的身影。待夕阳开始西沉时，我的挎包早已装得满满当当。
The heat and hard work of walking, crouching, kneeling, and squinting under the sun, finally produces results. Rare, tiny leaves the same green as the grass around them, and masses of common plants that I smell before seeing. My satchel is full by the time the sun begins to set.

裹着盐味的海风、凛冽的劲风与拍岸的浪涛，早已把这尊雕像的轮廓磨得圆滑——然而它依旧保有一种王者般的美感。雕像呈人形，一条腿踏在身前的隆起处，抬起一只手高举过顶，掌心向外。那张脸的细节虽已模糊，却仍让人联想到一副坚毅而友善的面容：神情沉静，目光既狡黠又慈和。雕像腰侧垂着一只空空的剑鞘。
The salt-laced sea air, bracing winds, and crashing waves long ago wore smooth the features of this statue—yet it retains a regal beauty. Humanoid in shape, one leg propped on the rise before it, the statue raises a hand aloft, palm facing outward. The vague details of a face still evoke a hard but friendly visage, a calm expression, and eyes that are both cunning and kind. An empty scabbard hangs from the statue's hip.

Handheld Mini Grenade Launcher.name:
手持式迷你榴弹发射器
Handheld Mini Grenade Launcher

Text.text:
把这把武器称作榴弹发射器未免太过抬举：它只有一截被削短的枪管，枪架小得能稳稳贴合在一只手里。
Calling this weapon a grenade launcher seems generous, with only one truncated barrel and a frame small enough to fit comfortably in one hand.

Shafiq Nadir.name:
沙菲克·纳迪尔
Shafiq Nadir

Text.text:
荒漠无情的沙丘渗出灼人的热浪，在这片晃动的炽光荒原中，一道孤影潜行其间。他仿佛风景的活化身，似水般掠过沙海，瘦削的身形裹在苍白长袍里。肌肤呈深沉、被烈日烙灼的红木色，交错的狰狞疤痕低声诉说着争战的旧事。猎猎作响的围巾遮住了大半面容，唯有一双锐利的翡翠眼在阴影褶皱里闪烁。一只眼上刻着神秘的三叉印记，昭示他历经试炼、并将其踏碎。双弯刀在身侧轻跃，弧形的死亡使者随时出鞘——或拯救弱者，或斩落那些该受血色正义的人。

~ 扮演者：Phil Restall

The heartless dunes of the desert bleed visceral heat, and through this shimmering waste stalks a lone figure. Like a living manifestation of the vista, he seems to flow across the sand, slender frame sheathed in pallid robes. His skin bears the deep, sun-scorched hue of mahogany, jagged scars whispering a tale of strife. A flapping scarf conceals most of his features, though piercing emerald eyes gleam from within its shadowed folds. A cryptic three-pronged mark adorns one eye, proof of trials endured and bested. Twin scimitars bounce at his side, curved bringers of death ready to save the meek—or slay those deserving violent justice.

~ Played by Phil Restall

Hildariel Kyrios Drakon, \"The Blood Ang.name:
希尔达里埃尔·凯里奥斯·德拉孔，“血天使”
Hildariel Kyrios Drakon, "The Blood Angel"

Text.text:
一道高挑纤细的身影翩然入目，猩红的肌肤披覆着最上乘的织物，步履从容而优雅。她的颅骨上顶着一对断裂的角冠。她是彻头彻尾的提夫林：折叠的双翼末端点着白，眼睑轻轻垂落，遮住黑夜般深邃的眼眸，赤红的瞳仁贪婪地饮尽周遭景象。她脸上柔和雕琢的线条间，点缀着层层硬化骨脊的红色隆起，唯有一道自颈项贯穿的白线将其打断。长而幽暗的发丝如同闪烁的流瀑，被精巧地盘成考究的发式。她旋身时，异域风情的长裙翻卷，白与红的染色与她天生的色泽相互映照，让人几乎分不清衣袂何处终止、女人何处开始。她的胯侧挂着一本朴素的皮革魔典，以及一条盘卷的长鞭，边缘锋利得令人心悸。

~ 由 Asobi Spirit 扮演

A tall, slender figure, with crimson skin draped in the finest of fabrics, gracefully saunters into view. Her skull is crowned with broken horns. She is a tiefling through and through: folded wings tipped with white, eyelids winking down over eyes of blackest night, red pupils drinking up her surroundings. Red too are the many ridges of hardened bone that bedeck her softly sculptured face, broken only by a single white line that runs the length of her neck. A shimmering mass of long dark hair has been tied up in a sophisticated style. She swirls in an exotic dress, dyed in white-red tones that mirror her natural hue. It is difficult to see where the clothes end and the woman begins. At her hip sits a plain leathered grimoire and a coiled whip sporting a wicked edge.

~ Played by Asobi Spirit

她自己看起来就是个务实、谦和、脚踏实地的半身人。遇见她并不算稀有度——稀有的是看出她是位女神，是能透过那身朴素的裙装与外套、那顶缀着花的帽子，以及装满食物与草药的背包，认出真相。她只在需要时才显露神性；到那时，她会一边轻快地咯咯笑着，一边帮天气转变，让庄稼抽芽疯长，或召唤树木挺身而出，守护这片土地的善意与丰饶。
She seems a practical, humble, quite earthly halfling herself. It’s not a rarity to meet her—only a rarity to recognize that she is a goddess, to see through her modest dress and coat, her flowered hat, and her knapsack of food and herbs. She becomes a goddess when the need arises, and then she laughs bouncily as she helps the weather change, or makes the crops grow, or calls the trees to protect the goodness of the land.

Aging Concert Venue.name:
老化的音乐会场地
Aging Concert Venue

Text.text:
鼎盛时期，这座小型体育场曾是一票难求的焦点；如今却在遗忘它的世界里风化坍颓，悄然没入无名。外墙上还黏着些褪色海报的残片，描绘着往昔演出的盛景，依旧倔强地宣告着曾在此登台的伟大艺人——而他们早已尽数离去，场馆也从未再度翻身。
In its heyday this small stadium was the hottest ticket around, but now it crumbles into obscurity in a world that has forgotten it. The remnants of faded posters depicting gigs of the past cling to the outer walls, still proudly announcing the great performers who played here—they’re all gone now, and the venue has never recovered.

Sneaking Into House Wyvern's Common Area.name:
潜入飞龙家族的公共区域
Sneaking Into House Wyvern's Common Area

Text.text:
你拨开那一簇簇明亮翠绿的蕨叶——它们像巢壁般将飞龙学院的学生拢在巢中——穿过其间，闯入他们的公共休息室。室内铺着散坐的靠枕，头顶开着天窗，暖金与橙色的挂毯垂落四周。这里既温馨又庄严，仿佛你踏进了一位安逸而自信的国王的闲憩厅。
You push through the bright green fronds that cloister the students of Wyvern House within their nest, and breach their common room with its sitting pillows, skylight, and warm gold and orange tapestries. The room has a cozy yet regal feel, as if you’ve stepped into the lounging room of a comfortable and confident king.

即便未上弦、未待发，这把沉重紫杉弩的弩臂之力仍显而易见。弦在休息时依旧绷得紧紧的，仿佛预告着一次强劲而凶猛的释放。这绝非博物馆里的陈列品——它上过战场，其力量与精准早已在烽火中证明过。
Even when unloaded and uncocked, the power of the prod in this heavy yew crossbow is evident. The string at rest is still taut with the promise of a strong, violent release. This is no museum piece—this crossbow has seen combat, and its strength and accuracy have shown through.

I Am Transported To An Unpleasant Demipl.name:
我被传送到一个令人不快的半位面
I Am Transported To An Unpleasant Demiplane

Text.text:
世界以令人作呕的猛然一颤错位之后，我的视线清晰起来——而我真希望它别清晰。这个小世界的景色荒凉得令人心寒。天空像淤青般的颜色，黯淡、死寂的紫；地平线则渗出病态的琥珀黄。大地坚硬、干裂、灰败。那些胆敢生长的草，也因傲慢而枯萎。附近山丘上孤零零立着一棵树：无叶，弯曲，病灶缠身，枝干虬结。
After the world shifts with a sickening lurch, my eyes clear—and I wish they hadn’t. The landscape of this small world is bleak. The sky is the color of a bruise, a dull, dead purple, while the horizon bleeds a sallow amber. The earth is hard, dry, and gray. What grass has dared to grow has withered for its hubris. A single tree stands on a nearby hill: leafless, bent, and gnarled with disease.

Funeral Vault Of A Wizard.name:
巫师的葬仪地窖
Funeral Vault Of A Wizard

Text.text:
一阵柔和而奥秘的嗡鸣自殡葬墓室的石棺中荡出，薰衣草色的云纹大理石表面上，纹路如涡旋般流转。棺盖上蚀刻着一段不过数行的文字。其语言古老晦涩、隐语重重，但你几乎能猜到它想传达的意思：擅入者，后果自负。
A soft, arcane hum emanates from the funeral vault, and patterns swirl across the surface of the lavender-hued marble. A passage of text, no more than a few lines, has been etched into the lid. The language is archaic and cryptic, but you suspect you can guess the intended message: keep out or else.

尽管那女人的语气轻快而欢快，她的眼神却泄露出一种空洞，让你深感不安，仿佛她的灵魂正沉睡不醒。她喋喋不休地抖落着些无意义的寒暄，始终挂着一抹僵硬的咧笑，时常挥手比划来强调自己的话语——但每一次都以同样的方式。
Though the woman’s tone is bright and jovial, her eyes betray an emptiness which you find deeply unsettling, as if her soul was dormant. Rattling through inane small talk, she maintains a rictus grin, often gesticulating to punctuate her words—but always in the same manner.

I Take Cover In A Cave.name:
我在洞穴里寻求掩蔽
I Take Cover In A Cave

Text.text:
火把与法术火焰照亮洞窟，石笋的阴影在洞壁上狂乱起舞。我把背死死贴在一根粗粝的岩质尖牙上，咬紧牙关——一记法术几乎擦过脸颊，灼得发烫。我盯着敌人的魔法攻击轨迹，看它们穿过石笋间的缝隙，轰然撞上洞壁。我猜——也只能祈祷——只要动作够快，就能循着法术飞来的方向迅速找出他们。我攥紧武器，牙缝里挤出一句咒骂，稳住呼吸，准备从藏身处猛然跃出。
The shadows of the stalagmites dance along the walls as torchlight and spellfire light up the cave. I press my back against one of these rough, rocky teeth and grate my teeth as a spell nearly sears my cheek. I watch the trajectory of the magical attacks from the enemy as they sail through the stalagmites and hit the cave wall. I guess—and hope—I can find them quickly based on the direction of the spells… if I move quickly. I clasp my weapon and let out a curse between gritted teeth, steadying myself to jump out of hiding.

倒下的公牛卧在地上，历经多年劳作后终于得以休息。它那沾满泥污的蹄子钉着铁掌，曾让这头牲口跋涉无数里程；而它粗壮的脖颈上，仍清晰可见轭具勒出的痕迹。
The fallen ox lies on the ground, finally at rest after years of toil. Its mud-stained hooves are shoed with iron, responsible for carrying the beast onward for many miles, and the marks of a yoke can be seen around its muscular neck.

俱乐部分作两层。下层逼仄热闹，肩肘相擦，围着厨房打转；炉火与锅灶深处的蒸汽翻涌、跳舞般腾起，嘶嘶作响。奢靡菜肴的香气沿着楼梯飘上来，来到上层——一圈俯瞰下方喧嚣的阳台。这里桌位疏朗分开，只为上等客人预留。宾客面颊微红，带着期待的气息，低声交谈；他们细碎的闲话汇成一层嗡鸣，在你周围轻轻震颤。专注的侍者穿梭于桌间，行止流畅，仿佛水流沿着土缝蜿蜒渗行——端上热气腾腾的盘盏，递上细致的赞语，顺手为酒杯续满新鲜的葡萄酒。
The club is split into two tiers. The lower floor is a close-quarters, elbow-scuffing hub focused around the kitchen and the fires and steam dancing and hissing from within it. The smell of decadent dishes wafts up to the top floor, a balcony that oversees the hubbub below. Up here, tables are set apart spaciously for the elite clientele. Patrons, flushed with an air of anticipation, speak in soft tones. The hum of their ambient conversation vibrates around you. The focused waitstaff slips fluidly from table to table as easily as rivulets of water through cracks in soil, satiating guests with steaming plates, delicate words of appreciation, and refreshed goblets of wine.

Headstone: “Beyond” In Winter.name:
墓碑：《彼岸》于冬季
Headstone: “Beyond” In Winter

Text.text: 墓碑立在一棵虬结老树与一丛无叶带刺的荆棘灌木投下的阴影里。石板近乎一半在某个时刻被硬生生削断崩落。缺失的那一块也带走了碑文的部分字句，只余下：. . . 越过此生，踏入来世。 The tombstone stands in the shadow of a gnarled tree and leafless thorny thicket. Nearly half the slab has been sheered away, broken off at some point. The missing portion has taken away some of the words on the headstone, leaving behind only: . . . beyond this life and into the next.

Arrow Of Petrification.name:
石化之箭
Arrow Of Petrification

Text.text:
石制箭头深深没入目标，箭杆上撒着的石灰在撞击瞬间扬起一团白雾。猎物喉间卡着一声痛呼，目光死死钉在中箭之处。他们疯狂地抓挠箭身，试图硬生生把它拔出——可咒语早已生效。握住箭杆的手骤然僵住，皮肤与衣物一并发硬、泛灰，粗糙如石。双腿也在原地生根，同样褪去血色，逐寸化作岩质。伴随一声渐弱成嘶的吼叫，他们的面容凝固成永恒的张口：双眼与嘴巴因愤怒而大张，定格不动。
The stone arrowhead sinks into the target, the dusting of lime along the shaft rising as a cloud as it hits. A pained cry catches in the quarry’s throat as their eyes fix on the point of impact. They begin to claw wildly at the arrow, attempting to wrench it out—but the incantation has already taken hold. Their hand freezes as it clutches the arrow, skin and clothes stiffening and graying to rough stone. Their legs root to the spot and take on the same pallor. With a shout that dwindles to a wheeze, their face hardens into a permanent gape: eyes and mouth wide with indignation.

Loot From A Stone Golem.name:
石魔像身上的战利品
Loot From A Stone Golem

Text.text:
魔像轰然倒下，束缚其形体的魔法被摧毁，身躯随之碎裂成一地瓦砾。在残骸之中，你找到它原先佩戴的一对巨大的金色护臂——一眼便知价值不菲，足以换来一笔小财。
The golem falls, shattering into rubble with the magic binding its form destroyed. In the debris, you find the pair of large golden bracers the construct was wearing—clearly worth a small fortune.

I Study My Manual Of Bodily Health.name:
我研读《体魄保健手册》
I Study My Manual Of Bodily Health

Text.text:
这本书按它的年代来说却出奇地结实，皮革仍旧柔韧。我在一处光线正好的地方坐下，端着一杯热饮，让自己保持专注。起初文字平淡得和别的没什么两样，可读了几个小时后，一股蓬勃的活力忽然涌入体内。呼吸变得更深、更顺畅。这本书带来的不再只是思想上的触动，更像一次切身的体验——仿佛我刚睡了个完美的小憩，或在酷热难当的日子里喝下一口冰水；而当书页上的字句渐渐淡去，那股精力却在体内沉淀下来，变得恒久。
The book but is surprisingly durable for its age, the leather still supple. I settle near a good light with a warm cup to keep me focused. The text is at first as humdrum as any, but after some hours a surge of vitality flows through me. My breathing grows deeper, easier. The book becomes as much a physical experience as an intellectual one, as if I’ve had a perfect nap or cold water on a scorching day, a vigor that gains permanence as the book’s words fade.

I Am Slapped In The Face.name:
我被人狠狠扇了一巴掌
I Am Slapped In The Face

Text.text: 我先听见那记耳光，才感到它落下：一声啪的脆响，转瞬之间，我的视线被硬生生甩向一侧。疼痛在脸颊上炸开。我咬紧牙关，抬手捂住那张火辣刺痛的脸，羞辱的热意沿着脖颈一路窜上来。 I hear the slap before I feel it: a sound crack and suddenly I’m looking starkly to the side. Pain blooms on my cheek. I clench my teeth and hold up a hand to my now stinging face, the heat of humiliation rising up my neck.

Sundries From A Red Slaad.name:
红色斯拉德的杂物
Sundries From A Red Slaad

Text.text: 你靠近那具畸变两栖怪的尸体时，瞥见它紧攥的利爪下有什么在蠕动：卵。半透明的胶状卵团在死去的亲体黏滑的掌心里微微战栗。 Approaching the body of the aberrant amphibian, you spot something wriggling under its clenched claws: eggs. The translucent globs shiver in the slimy palms of their dead progenitor.

Serpentine Owl Figurine Of Wondrous Powe.name:
奇物巨蟒鸮雕像
Serpentine Owl Figurine Of Wondrous Power

Text.text:
这尊猫头鹰小雕像由一块斑驳的绿石雕成。羽毛、利爪与面部轮廓的刻痕凹窝迫不及待地攫住光线，闪烁如藻幕覆着的池塘上跳动的日辉。它侧面雕出的双翼呈浓郁的橄榄色，胸前点缀着冷冽松针般的斑点。最摄人心魄的性相在于那张心形的脸：大多是轻快的翠绿——亦是它一身葱茏色调中最明亮的一抹。
This owl figurine has been carved from a mottled green stone. The divots of the carved feathers, talons, and facial features are eager to catch the light, gleaming like sunbeams on an algae-veiled pond. The wings carved into its side are a rich olive color, and its chest is freckled with spots of cool pine. Its most arresting aspect is the heart-shaped face, mostly a sprightly green—the brightest of its verdant hues.
这具石棺上写着：这里长眠着德里昂的侍从“慈善”。尽管墓穴空无一物，但曾爱过她的人心中满溢着骄傲。 This sarcophagus states: This is the grave of Charity, Derion’s footman. Though this grave lies empty, pride fills the hearts of those who loved her.

Werewolf Leading Pack Of Normal Wolves.name:
狼人与一群普通狼组成的狼群
Werewolf Leading Pack Of Normal Wolves

Text.text:
她冲在最前，半蹲着疾奔，身形伏低如掠地而行，生着利爪的双手几乎贴着地面；她的脸扭成疯狂的狞笑，狼一般的眼睛，咔哒作响的獠牙。她边跑边嗅着泥土的气味，狼群紧随其后，被她怪物般的费洛蒙与她的愤怒魔法逼得彻底癫狂。她停下，它们也停下——她仰头长嚎。两只先应和，随即整群齐啸，恐惧、痛楚与争夺之意充塞夜空。
She runs point, crouched and loping, clawed hands close to the ground, her face an insane grimace of wolf eyes and snapping fangs. She sniffs the earth as she runs, and the pack follows, driven wild by her monstrous pheromones and her rage magic. She stops, they stop—she howls. Two join in, then the pack, and the sky is filled with terror, pain, and contest.

这间小店里摆满了各式器具与工具，几乎要从墙缝里刺出来。锤子、耙子、斧头、扁斧、锄头、绳索、麻线、烛台、水桶、木桶、筐篮等等——有的立在架上，有的从天花板垂挂，有的堆在桶里，还有的在架子上东倒西歪地摞成一团。杂乱之中，你找着汤勺的概率恐怕不比找到草耙低；不过要是能逮到店主，他们或许能告诉你想找的东西究竟藏在哪儿。
This small shop bristles with various implements and tools. Hammers, rakes, axes, adzes, hoes, ropes, twine, candlesticks, buckets, barrels, baskets, and more stand in racks, hang from the ceiling, heap in barrels, or lie in tumbled piles on shelves. It seems you’re as likely to find a soup ladle as hay rake amid the jumble, but perhaps if you can locate the proprietor they’ll know where to find what you’re looking for.

在你心智最幽暗的深处，你想象光芒绽放，头顶的天穹随之崩裂。拂晓升腾的光被凝成一道柱状的浓缩体，轰然向下爆裂，化作一根照彻万物的辉煌光柱。太阳之眼——它全部的震怒——被囚于这一束光里，伴随压迫般的灼热嗡鸣，横扫你眼前的战场。
In the darkest stretch of your mind you picture light blooming, and the sky above you breaks. A columnar condensation of dawn’s rising light explodes downward in a pillar of illuminating brilliance. The eye of the sun—the entirety of its ire—is captured in a single beam that thrums with oppressive heat as it washes over the battlefield before you.

I Cast Giant Insect From My Staff Of Swa.name:
我用【蜂拥昆虫法杖】施放【巨化昆虫】：召唤蝎子还是甲壳昆虫？
I Cast Giant Insect From My Staff Of Swarming Insects: Scorpion Or Shelled Insect

Text.text: 一道黄色能量光束从我的法杖上轰然迸发，拖着长长的光痕直射蝎子。空气中响起可怕的咔嚓裂响，那生物午夜般漆黑的甲壳扭曲、重组，随之膨胀，生生长大以容纳它那骇人的新体型。 A beam of yellow energy erupts from my staff, streaking toward the scorpion. A terrible crack fills the air as the creature’s midnight-black carapace shifts and reforms, growing to accommodate its monstrous new size.

Robe Of Stars.name:
星辰长袍
Robe Of Stars

Text.text:
银白的星辰点点缀在午夜蓝的长袍表面，深邃得远看几乎如墨。兜帽领口周围以等距纹样绣上六颗更大的星，灼灼如日，辉光逼人。
A silvery-white starfield dots the surface of the midnight-blue robe, so dark that it appears black at a distance. Six larger stars, blazing like suns, have been embroidered in an equidistant pattern around the neckline of the hood.

I Cast Song Of Rest.name:
我施放《休息之歌》
I Cast Song Of Rest

Text.text:
我们休息时，我慵懒地倚靠着，把竖琴搁在膝上。我环顾四周，含笑着，向每位同伴眨了眨眼。随后我轻轻拨弦，让同伴们的心绪缓缓放松。接着，我仍旧拨弄着琴弦，绘声绘色地讲起那些与我们一般的英勇傻瓜——为了阻止自私与邪恶，干下了些并不明智的壮举。
As we rest, I recline and place my harp on my lap. I look around, smiling, giving each comrade a wink. And I gently strum to set my comrades at ease. Then, still plucking strings, I regale them with tales of valiant fools like us doing unwise deeds to stop the selfish and the wicked.

Black Magga: Flooded Town.name:
黑玛伽：淹没小镇
Black Magga: Flooded Town

Text.text:
水流猛然冲过街道与小巷，裹挟着一切能漂浮的东西。你看见一串老鼠奋力游向一栋建筑，扒住墙面，却又在洪水不断上涨之际被拍回浪里。四周的房屋在这股陌生而沉重的水压下吃力抗衡，木材吱呀作响，声声入耳。
Water rushes through streets and alleys, carrying with it anything that floats. You see a string of rats swim to a building, cling onto its side, but splash back into the flood as it steadily rises. You can hear the wood creaking in the structures around you as they strain against the unfamiliar pressure of the flow.

一栋巨大的方正建筑轮廓自飘雪的雾霭中浮现。霜花在金属铰链与门把上凝结，模糊了窗玻璃，并在屋顶越堆越厚。正门修得又宽又高，足够让马车与驮马不受阻碍地驶入；此刻却微微半掩，门缝里透出寒意。你探头望去，只见一排排覆冰的箱子、木柜与桶列得整整齐齐。仓库一侧墙边，几艘划艇倒扣着放置；成对的船桨则整齐地倚在墙上悬浮搁板旁。空间里残留着一丝淡淡的腥味，被这持久的寒冷压得不那么刺鼻。

~ 构想：福斯特

The silhouette of a large square building emerges from within the snowy haze. Frost coalesces over the metal hinges and door pulls, blurs the windows, and piles on the roof. The main door, built wide and tall so that cart and horse might easily roll through unhindered, hangs slightly agape. Peering inside, you see icy rows of boxes, chests, and barrels. Rowboats sit overturned against one wall of the warehouse, accompanied by pairs of oars propped neatly on the wall’s floating shelves. A slight fishy smell lingers in the space, made less pungent by the persistent chill.

~ Envisioned by Faust

Ymir Runegrog.name:
伊米尔·符文咕噜格
Ymir Runegrog

Text.text:
这位矮壮的圣武士乍看之下像个寻常矮人——但那板岩灰的肤色、银白的发与须，泄露了夺心矮人的传承。身披闪耀的黑色板甲，夺心矮人一手随意地休息在身侧弯刀的刀柄首上，另一只手则伸向腰间的酒壶。

~ Played by Chad Mc.

The stout paladin at first glance might appear as a typical dwarf—but the slate-gray complexion and silver-white hair and beard betray the duergar's heritage. Clad in gleaming black plate, the duergar keeps a hand resting casually on the pommel of the scimitar at their side, while the other hand reaches for a flask.

~ Played by Chad Mc.

Niklon Diomidis.name:
尼克隆·迪奥米迪斯
Niklon Diomidis

Text.text:
你看见一位非凡的战士，端坐在一匹披覆护甲的战马上——马身洁白，如新雪初落。那俊朗男子的笑容熠熠生辉，几乎与包覆他宽阔健硕身躯的华丽护甲同样耀眼；他柔和的灰眸里蕴着超越年轻外表的睿智与慈悲。他臂上托着一面金色盾牌，铸成咆哮雄狮的造型，在午后的阳光下流光溢彩，辉煌夺目。他那沙金色的头发松松束成马尾，被清风拂乱时便轻舞飞扬。与你目光相接的刹那，你感到一股暖意在胸中升起——仿佛太阳也向你含笑致意。

~ Played by Vmaster1995 with

Atop an armored steed—white as freshly fallen snow—you see a remarkable warrior. The handsome man’s smile gleams as brightly as the ornate armor covering his broad, muscular frame, and his soft gray eyes hold a wisdom and compassion which belies his youthful appearance. Upon his arm rests a golden shield forged in the style of a roaring lion, which shimmers with magnificent radiance in the afternoon sun. His sandy-blond hair—gathered in a loose ponytail—dances as it is tousled by a breeze. As he catches your eye, you feel a warmth build within you—as if the sun itself has favored you with a smile.

~ Played by Vmaster1995 with

房间里塞满了零碎杂物、破损的小摆件，书本也乱七八糟地摊着。房间中央，唯一干净的地方，是教授的书桌——一张空荡荡的老旧画桌，桌面溅着好几种颜色的颜料——其上放着一朵百合花。其余的一切，包括学生桌椅，都仿佛成了最轻微法术的目标。滑动黑板的墙面上，有用魔法粉笔写下的笔记，内容指向用于操控某个人或某样东西的法术。下课后一分钟，那朵百合忽然消失了。
The room is stuffed with bric-a-brac, broken tchotchkes, and books in disarray. In the center of the room, the only clean place, is the professor’s desk—an empty old art table splotched with paint in several colors—a lily blossom sitting on it. Everything else, including the desks, seems to have been a target for the mildest of spells. Notes chalked magically onto the walls of sliding boards indicate spells designed to control a person or thing. The lily suddenly disappears, one minute after class has let out.

Mother Begging Players To Find Her Child.name:
母亲哀求玩家寻找她失踪的孩子
Mother Begging Players To Find Her Child

Text.text: “求求你们，务必帮帮我。我的女儿——她向来爱四处闲逛，可这次已经三天没回来了。人们都说她一定死了，可我知道那不是真的。她也许不总是那么听话，但她是个高贵又善良的孩子。我拿不出多少报酬，可我向你们保证，只要再给她一次机会，她一定会让这世界变得更明亮。” “Please, you must help. My daughter; she’s always loved to wander but hasn’t been back in three days. They tell me she must be dead but I know it’s not true. She might not always behave, but she’s a noble and kind girl. I can’t offer much, but I promise, she will make this world a brighter place if she’s just given a chance.”

I Put On My Leather Wing Brace.name:
我戴上皮革翼托
I Put On My Leather Wing Brace

Text.text:
我以迅捷而熟练的移动，将支具滑套到翅膀上。随手做了几次例行的耸肩与扭动后，它便稳稳贴合到位。我用喙与双手将其系紧，立刻感觉翅膀精神一振，抬起成随时可振翼起飞的姿态。双翼舒展开来，接连几下令人畅快的同步拍击后，我知道——我已准备好飞翔。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

I slide the brace over my wing in a swift, practiced movement. After a few routine shrugs and wriggles, it settles into place. I use my beak and hands to tighten it, and I feel my wing perk up into a flight-ready position. Both my wings spread, and after a couple of satisfying tandem flaps, I know I’m ready for flight.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

有关于华美辉煌的城市的传说不绝于耳，可在这片阴影重重的棚户区里，你看到的却是那些城市的反面。阴郁的积水勉强映出周遭建筑黯淡的剪影。摇摇欲坠的脚手架引你深入地面上一片片张开的空洞，而头顶上，狭窄的栈道把一幢幢立在支柱上、吱呀作响的房屋连成一线。路人来去，深色或苍白的面孔都藏在兜帽阴影里，小心翼翼地避开你的目光。即便如此，你仍清晰地感觉到有人在你身后——在盯着你。笼罩其上的，是污秽、恐惧……以及贪婪的恶臭。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

There are tales of marvelous, resplendent cities, but in this shadowy shantytown you find the antithesis of those cities. Dour puddles struggle to reflect the dim silhouettes of the buildings around them. Rickety scaffolding leads deeper into wide expanses in the ground, while above, narrow catwalks connect the houses creaking on their stilts. Passers-by, dark or pale faces shrouded in hoods, take care to avoid eye contact. Despite this, there is the unmistakable feeling of someone behind you, watching. Overlying it all is a stink of filth, fear… and greed.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这家旅店的公用厅专门招待各支精灵族群；即便夜深如墨，精灵光亮戏法那熟悉的珠光般辉辉也如灯塔般醒目。鉴于他们闻名遐迩的无须安眠，客人们昼夜皆可见：有人一边啜饮珍稀佳酿，一边翻阅记载远古秘闻的厚重典籍；也有人在细致调味的鹿肉与野生青蔬的餐盘之间，纵论宏阔话题——诸如魔法理论与长程生态。
The familiar pearlescent glow of elven light cantrips are like a beacon, even in the dead of night, in the common room of this inn catering to all elf races. Given their famous lack of need for sleep, patrons can be found at all hours, reading tomes of ancient lore while sipping at rare wines or debating wide-ranging subjects—such as magical theory and long-term ecology—over repasts of delicately seasoned venison and wild greens.

厚实的剑刃自坚固的剑柄延伸而出。可靠的刃口锋锐逼人，握柄稳固趁手。皮革缠绕的握柄末端嵌着一枚沉甸甸的圆润剑首，而厚重的护手自剑身根部横展开来。
The stout blade reaches from a sturdy hilt. The reliable edge is keen and the grip is solid. A hefty, rounded pommel sits at the base of the leather wrapped grip and a thick guard stretches from the foot of the blade.

Fast-talking Joyboy.name:
能言善辩的乔伊男孩
Fast-talking Joyboy

Text.text:
皮肤晒成古铜色，上面点缀着脉动的纹身；这名身材略矮的欢乐男孩正对着通讯植入体喋喋不休地安排派对准备。他披着一件拖地的媒体大衣——大衣上布满数以千计的微型摄像头，既记录周遭，又把影像投射到衣料上，将他的轮廓扭成一团令人眼花缭乱的形状与色彩。大衣口袋里露出几支红色兴奋剂。他上半张脸被一副黑色面罩遮住，面罩上不断闪烁着表情符号。
Tanned skin bedecked with pulsing tattoos, this shorter-than-average joyboy jabbers party preparations into a comm implant. He wears a floor-length media coat that—with thousands of tiny cameras—records his surroundings and projects the images onto the coat’s fabric, transforming his silhouette into a bewildering blend of shapes and colors. Red stims peek out of the pocket of his coat. The upper part of his face is covered with a black visor that flashes emojis.

他微微一鞠躬后直起身，半兽人抻平镶着毛边的长外套，将深棕色的发束拨离面庞。这个动作却让一缕卷发垂在鼻梁左侧，与那道自额头延至脸颊、泛着淡粉的疤痕平行。他笑了——露出下方的獠牙——笑意直达那双祖母绿的眼睛，色泽比他的肤色更为明亮。他张开双臂，摊开双手，以示欢迎。他宽松的衣物与深色大衣是旅人的装束，然而他却携着两件精致乐器：一把曼陀林与一面鼓，皆饰以相似的祖辈纹样。

~ 由 Inbal 扮演

Rising after a slight bow, the half-orc rights his fur-trimmed overcoat and flips his dark-brown locks out of his face. The move leaves one ringlet hanging to the left of his nose, parallel to a pinkish scar running from forehead to cheek. He smiles—displaying his lower tusks—the mirth reaching his emerald eyes, which are brighter in hue than his skin, and opens his arms and hands in a receptive gesture. His loose garments and dark greatcoat are those of a traveler, but he carries two fine instruments, a mandolin and drum, each decorated with similar ancestral motifs.

~ Played by Inbal

Boots Of Elvenkind.name:
精灵之靴
Boots Of Elvenkind

Text.text:
这双匠心独运的靴子仿佛由葱郁的绿叶与褐色的根须缝制而成，嵌着低调的金色镶边，刻着蜿蜒盘绕的藤蔓与根系花丝纹。靴身柔软而富有弹性，穿着舒适，显然出自精灵之手。怪异的是，当你穿着它迈步时，脚下竟毫无声息——你的足音轻得像叶片坠落在地。
The masterfully-crafted boots appear stitched of verdant green leaves and brown roots, inlaid with a subdued gold trim and etched filigree of snaking vines and roots. The boots are soft and supple, and comfortable to wear, clearly fashioned by elves. Strangely, as you take a step in the boots, your feet make no sound. Your footfalls are as leaves falling to the ground.

一束束阳光轻挠着巨大的蕨类与攀附在端庄古树上的浓绿。林冠摇曳低语，抛下叶影斑驳，空气里湿意淌落。你感到叶与藤轻羽般拂过肌肤，然而紧接着，有什么更执拗的东西缠上了你的手臂。你转过身，看见一朵硕大的红花正盛放着，花心处一条如绳的植物舌缓缓舒展——正试图把你拖向中央；那里是个大张的口，发出咕噜咽吞的声响。

~ Envisioned by Steve Adamski

Shafts of sunlight tickle the giant ferns and the greenery clinging to stately trees. The canopy waves and whispers, throwing leafy shadows and dripping with humidity. You feel the feathery brush of leaf and vine, but then something more insistent slips around your arm. You turn to see a large red flower, in full bloom, and the long rope of a botanical tongue uncoiling from it—trying to pull you in to the center, a gaping mouth that makes gulping sounds.

~ Envisioned by Steve Adamski

狭窄的办公室里，一张看上去已有数百年历史的大木桌占据了主导。桌上，一支羽毛笔插在抛光的玻璃墨水瓶里，旁边堆着成摞的羊皮纸、信封，以及一块红色封蜡。旧书的气味像霉湿的古龙水般萦绕在空气中，你还能听见下方庭院传来闷闷的行动声。
The cramped office is dominated by a large wooden desk that looks centuries old. A feathered quill rests in a polished glass inkwell on the desk beside stacks of parchment, envelopes, and a block of red sealing wax. The smell of old books lingers in the air like musty cologne, and you can hear muffled activity from the courtyard below.

你经过一条狭窄的小巷时，拨弦的柔和旋律盖过拥挤街道的嗡嗡人声。沿着那条支巷望去，一个半身人的手指在鲁特琴弦上轻快起舞，一名矮人的鼓声如浪般低沉翻涌，紧接着又响起一记刺耳的爆鸣——来自一件你认不出的、显然是侏儒手艺的乐器。这支东拼西凑的乐团正招呼路人暂时忘掉手头的差事。

~ 构想：Bob World Builder

The soft melody of plucked strings rises over the murmur of the crowded street as you pass a narrow alley. Down that side street a halfling’s fingers dance across lute strings, and a dwarf’s drum rumbles like a wave, before a blast from an—apparently gnomish—instrument you don’t quite recognize. This patchwork orchestra calls passersby to forget their errands for a while.

~ Envisioned by Bob World Builder

Concessions Stand At The Casket.name:
让步者伫立于灵柩旁
Concessions Stand At The Casket

Text.text:
一圈精致的金丝花纹框饰沿着这处壁龛的边缘舒展开来，将其中的绯红墙纸映得愈发明亮。空气里弥漫着烤肉的油香、烘烤榛子的焦甜与融化巧克力的浓郁。后方柜台上摆着玻璃展示柜，塞满了咸香与甜蜜的各色佳肴。究竟这些美味是如何、又在哪里制作的并不明朗，但宾客们显然不在乎——他们挤在粉色大理石台面前，台后俊朗的侍者含笑迎人。侍者们身着挺括的奶白衬衫、深色马甲，系着染成醇厚勃艮第红的领巾。招手示意下一拨人上前时，他们一手已握着酒瓶，另一手随时准备将宽口玻璃杯斟满。

~ 出自精彩的 TTRPG 资料集 The Vineyard

A filigreed frame flourishes around the edges of this alcove, brightening the crimson wallpaper within. The aromas of roasting meats, toasted hazelnuts, and melting chocolate fill the air. Glass cases sit on the back counter, brimming with fare both savory and sweet. It is unclear exactly how or where these delights are prepared, but guests do not seem to care as they crowd around the pink marble countertop, behind which handsome attendants smile. They are dressed in crisp cream-white shirts, dark vests, and cravats dyed luscious burgundy. As they beckon the next party forward, they already hold wine bottles in one hand ready to fill wide glass tumblers with the other.

~ Found in the amazing TTRPG supplement The Vineyard

你无需细看那对银烛台上精致缠绕的花丝如何照亮旅店入口，也不必去接触室内那些点缀在一张张厚实座椅上的绒软天鹅绒衬垫。没错，你很清楚这里的奢华，也很清楚在这种地方落脚大概要付出怎样的代价。身着制服的侍从与衣着考究的宾客投来的目光冷而挑剔，只凭你靴子与衣物上沾染的旅尘，便将你细细评估。
One need not examine the intricate filigree of the silver candlesticks lighting the entrance to this inn, nor touch the cushioning of the plush velvet upholstery adorning the many overstuffed seats within. No, you are quite aware of the extravagance, and the probable cost of staying in such an establishment. The eyes of the uniformed staff and well-dressed guests critically judge you by the dust of the road on your boots and clothing.

Loot From Phantasmic Leeches.name:
幻影水蛭的战利品
Loot From Phantasmic Leeches

Text.text: 水蛭化作一团团粉红色的薄雾消散开来，潮湿的空气里弥漫着浓重的铁锈味。柔软的地面上横七竖八地躺着尸体——水蛭昔日的受害者——他们蜷缩成一具具惨白的空壳，皮肤紧绷在骨头上。场景骇人而血腥，但你仍在死者身上找到了一些收获：几袋钱币、一枚红宝石戒指，以及一枚能施放blade ward的护身坠饰。 The leeches dissipate into clouds of pink mist, the scent of iron heavy in the humid air. The corpses sprawled on the soft ground—former victims of the leeches—are curled, pale husks, their skin stretching tight against their bones. Haunting and gruesome as the scene is, you manage to find some boons amid the dead: a few pouches of coins, a ruby ring, and a medallion that casts blade ward.

Laser-trapped Effigy.name:
激光陷阱塑像
Laser-trapped Effigy

Text.text:
弥漫在室内的嗡鸣声节节攀升，陷阱骤然爆发，尖利的啸音刺破耳膜：一道鲜红夺目的激光如长矛般贯穿空气，瞬间点燃了披在塑像上的松散破布。

~ 出自 PaizoConOnline 2024

The ascending hum permeating the room turns into a keening whine as the trap explodes to life: a vivid red laser lances through the air, igniting the loose rags draping the effigy.

~ from PaizoConOnline 2024

Lesson From Mentor In Calligraphy.name:
书法导师的教诲
Lesson From Mentor In Calligraphy

Text.text:
“刀要这样握，把羽毛笔尖削出猎鹰喙的形状。很好。现在蘸……不，不。要这样蘸，你就不必吸墨。对，就这样。然后，整封信你的手都要保持这个姿势，明白吗。这样下行笔画才能宽阔，末端还收出细致的衬脚。好了。十一点前，我要你在一条直线上写出一百个一模一样的大写字母 T。”
“Hold your knife so and cut me a falcon nib on the quill. Fine. Now dip… No, no. Dip so you don’t have to blot. Better. So, then, your hand stays that position through the entire letter, you see. That gives you a nice wide descender to a fine foot serif. There. I want a hundred identical letter T capitals on a straight line by elevenses.”

I Tune My Harp.name:
我调我的竖琴
I Tune My Harp

Text.text:
竖琴的每一根弦都添上一道声线，汇入灿然的合唱。我拨动那被琴框绷紧的弦，让它们的歌声漫过全身；我合上双眼，专注于空气中回荡的音符——宛如群鸟振翅而起。它们只是略有些走调。我含笑，轻轻拧动调音栓，像偏爱的导师般引导它们，直到它们再次以澄澈无瑕的清音嗡鸣。
Each string of my harp adds its voice to a resplendent choir. I pluck the strings—held taut by the frame—and let their songs wash over me as I close my eyes and focus on the notes ringing in the air—like birds taking flight. They are only slightly discordant. I smile as I gently adjust the tuning pegs, guiding them like a favored tutor, until they hum with perfect clarity once again.

Circle Of Shadows.name:
暗影之环
Circle Of Shadows

Text.text:
受惊的猎人们踉跄着闯入一片雾气氤氲的林间空地，脚下绊过盘虬的树根，箭矢从箭袋里哗啦洒落——这片树林被某种不自然的幽翳骤然吞没，天光像被硬生生掐灭。一个猎人尖锐地吹了声口哨，两指并拢指向前方渐渐浮现的身影：兜帽遮面，头顶笼着一圈幽魂般的鹿角光晕。那德鲁伊般的身形无声滑行，横在前路，仿佛连风都被迫绕行；与此同时，更深的阴影如套索般收紧，向狩猎队伍合围。惊惶的目光在德鲁伊与逼近的昏暗之间来回跳动——猎物般绝望，拼命寻找一条生路。

~ 构想：LunaLunatic1337

Startled hunters crash into a misty glade, arrows spilling from their quivers as they stumble over roots in the unnatural umbra that has suddenly darkened these woods. One hunter whistles sharply and points two fingers at an emerging figure: hooded, haloed with spectral antlers. As the druidic figure soundlessly glides to obstruct the path forward, a snare of deepening shadows closes in around the hunting party. Panicked eyes glance from the druid to the encroaching gloom—prey desperate for a way out.

~ Envisioned by LunaLunatic1337

Metroplex Police Station.name:
大都会警察局
Metroplex Police Station

Text.text:
警察局大楼阴沉地压在街道上方，正门前那些全副武装、披甲持枪的警卫同样令人望而生畏。大多数人早有预感地绕到街对面，不愿招来任何多余的注意。那些发现得太晚的行人则不由加快脚步，只想尽快把警察总部那警惕的目光甩在身后。
The police building looms over the street, as do the armed and armored guards standing at the front doors. Most people have crossed to the other side in anticipation, not wanting to attract any unnecessary attention. Those pedestrians that found out too late quicken their gait, eager to put the watchful eyes of the police headquarters behind them.

带爪的足印一枚枚压在泥地里，每个都有餐盘那么大，围着一个恶臭的洞口——那洞是被利爪硬生生从倒伏巨树的庞大躯干里刨出来的。那根覆满青苔的粗大原木横贯此处的灌木与林地；它多年前倒下时砸出的空地，早已被周遭的荒野重新吞没。蕨叶下的一抹惨白吸引了你的目光。那是一根干净的骨头……夹在一堆肮脏的骨头之间，还有纠缠的毛发，卷成一个圆团，足有一条面包那么大。
Clawed paw prints, each the size of a dinner plate, are pressed deep into the dirt around a noisome hole clawed into the vast bulk of a fallen tree. The massive, moss-covered log runs through the brush and woods here—the clearing it made by its fall long ago reclaimed by the surrounding wilderness. A whiteness under a fern catches your eye. It’s a clean bone… among a collection of dirty bones and fur wound up in a round mass as big as a loaf of bread.

I Use Cunning Action: Hide.name:
我使用【狡诈动作：躲藏】
I Use Cunning Action: Hide

Text.text:
为了打断视觉线，我猛地窜向掩蔽后方。我等了一秒。随后我寻找时机，在不暴露的情况下转移到另一个位置。只要我仍未被看见，就能继续潜伏，或在无人注目的地方现身。
To break line of sight, I dart for cover. I wait a second. Then I look for an opportunity to move to a different position while staying hidden. If I remain unseen, I can keep hiding or emerge where no one is looking.

一名身材罕见高大的矮人立于你面前，结实的肌肉在磨旧却保养得当的护甲下起伏如潮。他苍白的皮肤上布满战火烙下的疤痕，左脸与左半身更被一片如雷霆亲吻般的电灼痕交织缠绕。右眼是一抹柔和、微微发光的琥珀色，与左眼天然的棕色形成强烈对比。浓密的黑色络腮胡勾勒出他的面庞，光泽却被左侧遭酸蚀后残留的毛茬撕扯得黯淡不整。他那一头又长又乱的粗发，像传说中的异兽鬃毛一般，将他衬得威压逼人，却又莫名透着几分温和。暗色的战锤——枪铁般的黑——以及一面伤痕累累、刻着某位矮人神祇徽记的盾牌，诉说着他对武艺与神圣戒律同样坚定不移的信仰。身旁，一只臃肿的剑齿巴哥低吼龇牙，凶悍而忠烈，宛如一头不屈的战兽。

~ Played by a Hero

A dwarf of uncommon height stands before you, his muscles rippling beneath his worn but well-maintained armor. His pale skin is scarred with the kiss of conflict, and a network of lightning welts trace the left side of his face and body. His right eye—a soft, glowing amber—contrasts greatly with the natural brown of his left. A bushy black beard frames his face, its luster marred by the frayed stubble of the acid-eaten side. His long, shaggy hair, reminiscent of a mythical beast, completes his imposing yet oddly gentle appearance. A dark warhammer—gunmetal black—and a battered shield bearing the emblem of some dwarven god tell of his unwavering faith to both martial prowess and divine discipline. At his side, a bulky saber-toothed pug snarls, a stalwart beast in its ferocity.

~ Played by a Hero

The Sanctuary: Crescent Lake.name:
圣所：新月湖
The Sanctuary: Crescent Lake

Text.text:
弯月形湖泊的静水在点点睡莲叶下竟清澈得出奇，叶影斑驳地铺在水面。香蒲标记出一条贫瘠小溪注入湖中的区域，其余湖岸尽是草地，渐渐过渡为铺着光滑卵石的浅滩。水触感清凉，顺着你的胡须送来一阵轻微的战栗。湖对岸，一群水獭打闹着闯入视野，扑通扑通溅水跳进湖里。
The still water of the curved lake is surprisingly clear beneath the lily pads that dapple its surface. Cattails mark the area where a meager creek feeds the lake, while the rest of the shore is grass that transitions into smooth-pebbled shallows. The water is cool to the touch, sending a slight shiver through your whiskers. Across the lake, a bevy of otters tussle their way into view and splash into the water.

对一只驯养动物来说，这山羊看你的眼神却莫名令人胆寒——也许是你打断了它进食。它下颚咀嚼的动作渐渐放缓，目光死死钉在你身上……它是在低下头吗？
For a domesticated animal, the look this goat gives you is inexplicably forbidding, perhaps because you’ve interrupted its meal. Its jaw’s motion slows as it locks eyes with you… is it lowering its head?

Froghemoth Emerges From Sacred Pool.name:
巨蛙魔从圣池中破水而出
Froghemoth Emerges From Sacred Pool

Text.text:
圣池那片宁静的碧绿水面被打破：一簇鼓胀、布满疣粒的柄状物从厚厚的藻毯中顶出，淡黄的眼睛缓缓睁开。那生物从水中升起，黏液自它皮革般的两栖表皮上滴落，朝你逼近。它的负载不断从水里显露，踏步走向池岸，像无可阻挡的推进——却在下一瞬骤然爆裂成一记咆哮的冲锋。

~ Envisioned by MatthewMcHale on Discord

The placid green waters of the sacred pool are disturbed by a set of bulbous, warty stalks as they emerge from the blanket of algae, yellow eyes slowly opening. The creature rises from the water, slime dripping from its leathery, amphibian hide, and it moves toward you. More and more of its bulk emerges as it strides toward the pool's edge, an inexorable advance—which suddenly explodes into a roaring charge.

~ Envisioned by MatthewMcHale on Discord

I Use Mindless Rage.name:
我使用无脑狂怒
I Use Mindless Rage

Text.text:
一片猩红的迷雾吞没了我的心智、我的视野——我眼中只剩鲜血。然而这战斗的迷障亦是一团烈火，焚尽分心与恐惧，只留下厮杀中残酷而清澈的明晰。
A crimson haze takes my mind, my vision—I see only blood. But this battle fog is also a fire. It burns away distractions and fear, leaving behind the brutal clarity of the fight.

Loot From A Spirit Naga.name:
幽灵娜迦的战利品
Loot From A Spirit Naga

Text.text:
你跨过那条巨蛇般的庞大躯体时，注意到这生物粗壮沉重的尾巴上套着几只镶珠手镯。每一只都嵌着名贵宝石，少说也值100枚金币。
Stepping over the huge serpentine body, you notice several jeweled bangles adorning the creature’s thick, heavy tail. Each one is inlaid with precious gems and must be worth 100 gold pieces at least.

Spring Awakens Perennial Blooms.name:
春醒繁花长开
Spring Awakens Perennial Blooms

Text.text:
带着令人安心的笃定，这些花朵每逢春日便如约盛放。葱茏的新芽沿着蜿蜒小径绽成斑斓的色浪，花影流光映得行人皆不由得莞尔。那是自然赐予的一份朴素而恒久的赋礼。
With comforting surety, the blooms come every spring. Their verdant shoots blossom into riotous color alongside the winding footpath, with their floral luster bringing a smile to all who pass by. It is a simple, timeless gift from nature.

Temple In Hot Summer.name:
盛夏炙热的神庙
Temple In Hot Summer

Text.text:
纺织娘在神殿台阶下吟唱着虔诚的颂歌。神殿本身由无瑕的白色石材砌成，在盛夏刺目的阳光下几乎晃得人睁不开眼，端坐在山巅如同日冠。望着沿山坡蜿蜒而上的数百级石阶，闷热的空气仿佛骤然更烫了几分。
Katydids sing their devotions at the base of the temple steps. The temple itself, constructed of immaculate white stone, is nearly blinding in the bright summer sun crowning the top of the hill. The sight of the hundreds of stairs up the hillside makes the sultry air suddenly seem much hotter.

伽马级义体——在某些人眼中近乎神话、仿佛魔法般的阴谋论——依赖纳米科技：每一次改造，都是一群为某个特定个体与特定功能范围而生的微型机器群落。一条手臂外观与扫描结果都与真品无异；然而它能响应思维，随念化形，变作多种形态，复刻工具、武器，甚至彻底换成另一种肢体。它在最纤薄处可以薄至一分子。伽马纳米科技能折弯光线，化作无形的云雾，以微观尺度攻击他人，并以看似只受想象力限制的方式运作。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Gamma-quality cyberware—thought by some to be a myth, a magical conspiracy theory—relies on nanotechnology, each modification a colony of micromachines dedicated to a particular person and range of functions. An arm looks and scans like a genuine article. However, responding to thought, it can transform into a variety of shapes, replicating tools, weapons, or different limbs altogether. It can be one molecule thick at its narrowest point. Gamma nanotech can bend light, operate as an invisible cloud, attack others on a microscopic level, and function in ways seemingly limited only by imagination.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Storm At Sea.name:
海上风暴
Storm At Sea

Text.text:
你头顶的船帆在无情的狂风中噼啪作响，狠狠拍打着船身。海水翻涌，船体猛然侧倾，把水手们从一侧甩到另一侧。他们的呼喊哀求着喘息之机，可大多被暴风的喧嚣吞没：暴雨抽打甲板，震得骨头发颤的雷鸣。在一道道掠过船身的闪电短促光芒里，你清晰看见眼前那一张张惊惶、仓皇的面孔。
The sails above your head slap, crashing against the ship in the relentless wind. The waters roil and the vessel lurches, tossing the crew from one side of the ship to the other. Their shouts beg for relief, though their words are mostly lost to the cacophony of the storm: rain pelting the deck, bone-rattling thunder. In the brief flashes of lightning arcing over the ship, you see clearly the harried, fearful faces before you.

高草丛中丢着一柄石斧。燧石斧头覆着一层黏稠的血污，斑驳不堪。这件原始的工具被精心打制，以肠筋牢牢缚在涂绘过的木柄上；木头里刻着细小的象形符号——讲述着往昔的狩猎与凯旋的战斗。
Lying discarded in the tall grass is a stone axe, its flint head marred with a sticky layer of gore. This primal tool, carved with care and bound with gut to its painted haft, which bears tiny pictograms carved into the wood: tales of hunts past and battles won.

Lightweight Package Delivery Drone.name:
轻型包裹投递无人机
Lightweight Package Delivery Drone

Text.text:
桌上的送货无人机小巧利落，线条紧凑，采用轻质材料打造，配有四个硅制旋翼。它搭载GPS与跨障避让技术，能轻松以高速运送小型包裹。其加固货舱容量充裕，并内置先进的安全协议，以防遭到拦截。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The delivery drone on the table is a compact and efficient-looking device, constructed from lightweight materials, with four silicon rotors. Equipped with GPS and hurdle avoidance tech, it can transport small packages at high speeds with ease. Its secure hold is spacious, with advanced security protocols in case of interception.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Advice From A Popular Party Member.name:
来自人气团员的忠告
Advice From A Popular Party Member

Text.text:
“你只要更自信一点——像我这样！秘诀就是：当你开始自怜自艾时，就停下来，想起自己帅得要命，而且人人都爱你。”
“You just need to be more confident—like me! The secret is, when you’re feeling down about yourself, you just stop and remember that you’re handsome and everyone loves you.”

Quip About Going Hungry.name:
关于挨饿的俏皮话
Quip About Going Hungry

Text.text:
“我发誓，这辈子从没饿得这么狠！为什么咱们宰掉的那些野兽，全都难以下咽？”
“I swear, I’ve never felt such hunger in my life! Why is it that all the beasts we slay are so inedible?”

这里，一间小店的空间里收拢了整个世界的气息。植物一束束粗朴地悬在屋梁下。被捣碎后，它们与蜡一道装满厚重的玻璃圆筒，再以木塞封口。每只玻璃筒上都用细致的手写体写着名字。念出它们，仿佛在诵读一段法术：佛手柑、豆蔻、茴香、肉豆蔻衣、红椒粉、龙蒿。店里珍藏着柔软大地的财富——疗愈与毒素、厨房的魔法。
Here are the aromas of the whole world contained in the space of a single shop. Plants hang raw in clusters from the rafters. Crushed, they fill thick glass cylinders with wax and wooden stoppers. On the glass of each one is a name, written by hand in fine script. Reading them is like reading a spell: bergamot, cardamom, fennel, mace, paprika, tarragon. The shop holds the wealth of the soft earth, cures and poisons, kitchen magic.

两位上了年纪的男人默默用餐，仿佛这样的场景早已重复过上百次：其中一人举止讲究得近乎矜持，衣着体面而时髦；另一人则邋遢不修边幅，穿得随意凌乱，糟糕的餐桌礼仪也毫不遮掩。可他们依旧执意并肩而坐，哪怕周围空桌成片——仿佛只要两人还活着，就要把彼此当作唯一的同席之伴。
The two aged men eat in silence as they presumably have hundreds of times before: one of them almost dainty in his precise manners and stylish dress, the other slovenly and unkempt in his choice of clothing and making no effort to excuse his poor table manners. Yet the two insist on sitting together, despite numerous empty tables, presumably opting for one another’s company for as long as the two still live.

Request For Sacrifice From A Dragon.name:
来自巨龙的献祭请求
Request For Sacrifice From A Dragon

Text.text:
“啊，又来了一群英雄想让我安息。你们是为我的财富而来？为我的皮囊？还是只是在绝望中妄图留下些什么？我告诉你们，英雄们：我早已厌倦了从牙缝里剔出你们的护甲，如今就连你们同族那凄厉的哀嚎也早已失了光彩。所以，我给你们一个条件。把你们队伍里的一个交给我——哪怕是个更小的——我发誓我会重新沉入酣睡，让这片乡野在一百年里得享太平。”
“Ah, another group of heroes come to lay me to rest. Are you here for my wealth? My hide? Or is this simply some desperate attempt at a legacy? I’ll tell you what, heroes: I tire of picking your armor from my teeth, and even the desperate screams of your kin hold little luster these days. So, I’ll make you an offer. Give me one of your party—even one of the smaller ones—and I swear I will return to my slumber and leave the countryside in peace for one hundred years.”

Sundries From Phantasmic Leeches.name:
幻蛭杂货
Sundries From Phantasmic Leeches

Text.text:
那些水蛭虽是幻影，却在败退消散时不曾留下任何可供查验的蠕动躯体。它们将从受害者身上吸来的团团血块抛洒到空中，化作一片猩红薄雾。你感觉有些血雾落在脸上，温热的黏意把你的头发与衣物都糊住。大部分血液最终在地面汇成一汪浅薄的血潭，清澈、静止，宛如一面绯红的镜子。
The leeches, phantasmal as they are, leave no wriggly bodies to investigate as they disappear, defeated. They release the globs of blood from their victims into the air as a reddish mist. You feel some of it settle on your face, the warmth matting your hair and clothes. Most of the blood ends up in a thin pool on the ground, as clear and still as a crimson mirror.

Defending Against Wolves With Spellcraft.name:
以法术技艺抵御群狼
Defending Against Wolves With Spellcraft

Text.text:
一头雄鹿、一头雌鹿和一只幼鹿背靠着一块巨大的岩石，几只潜行逼近的灰狼将它们围拢。幼鹿尖声哀鸣，小腿在身下抖得不停。雄鹿跺响蹄子，低头压角——那对鹿角是它唯一的武器，用来对抗这支龇牙低吼的狼群。此时，一位热心的法师插手救援，猛然投入行动：他用急促紊乱的节奏压低嗓音咕哝着，举起一片玻璃。尽管他们的手指因匆忙而颤抖渗血，法术仍然成功了。只听一声脆裂，玻璃迸开，化作数把旋转的匕首悬浮在空中。匕首朝狼群疾掠而去，啄刺般地连连戳碰，逼得它们夹着蓬松的尾巴仓皇逃窜。鹿一家同样被这股力量的展示吓得不轻，转身朝着狼群相反的方向奔逃而去。

~ 由 Elliott Crawford 构想

A stag, doe, and fawn stand against a large boulder as a pack of slinking gray wolves close in on them. The fawn bleats shrilly, his little legs shaking beneath him.
