The stag stomps his hooves and lowers his head, his antlers his only weapon against the snarling battalion. A helpful mage intercedes and jumps into action, muttering low in a harried rhythm and holding a piece of glass aloft. Though their fingers bleed and tremble from their haste, the spell is successful. With a crack, the glass splits into several spinning daggers levitating in the air. The daggers fly toward the wolves, pecking and prodding them enough to send them scurrying away, bushy tails between their legs. The family of deer, just as frightened by this show of power, flee in the opposite direction of the pack.

~ Envisioned by Elliott Crawford

Fake Horn Of Valhalla.name:
伪造的瓦尔哈拉号角
Fake Horn Of Valhalla

Text.text:
你将那只雕工精美、彩绘鲜艳的号角举到唇边，猛然吹出一声高亢而清澈的长音。伴随着一阵幽魂般的光芒炸开，一名戴着角盔的矮人战士出现在你面前。他一手拎着一大杯麦酒，另一手还攥着咬了一半的点心，辫须间沾着细碎的面包屑。他环顾四周，神情显然困惑不已。
You raise the beautifully carved, painted horn to your lips and blast a loud, clear note. In a burst of spectral light, a dwarven warrior with a horned helmet appears before you. He is holding a stein of ale and a half-eaten pastry, with crumbs in his braided beard. He looks around, clearly confused.

Castle Curtain Wall.name:
城堡帷幕墙
Castle Curtain Wall

Text.text:
巨大的古老城墙在城堡的塔楼之间延展，构成抵御入侵者的坚固屏障。尽管被厚厚的翠绿苔藓如毯般覆盖，这些外墙依旧巍然挺立，完好无缺。
Huge ancient walls stretch between the towers of the castle, providing a formidable defense against invaders. Though covered in thick green carpets of moss, the curtain walls stand strong and unbroken.

Watchers On The Way In Winter.name:
寒冬归途上的守望者
Watchers On The Way In Winter

Text.text:
挂在岗哨门上的冬青花环，红浆果在霜意里闪烁，是这座灰色建筑唯一节庆而欢快的性相；蓝衣裹身、面色阴沉的看守驻守其间。头盔下的脸隐在暗影里，这些卫兵在凛冽寒意中挺立如木：一人守在门前，另一人则披着羊毛斗篷，肩头裹紧，登上屋顶放哨。两名骑马卫兵沿路巡逻，宛如幽影，一个远在南方路尽处，另一个更靠近那座高墙耸立的红石要塞。
The holly wreath hanging on the station’s door, its red berries twinkling in the frost, is the only festive and joyous aspect of the gray building manned by grim-faced wardens garbed in blue. Faces dark under helmets, these guards stand rigid in the wintry chill: one is posted at the door and one keeps watch on the rooftop, shoulders wrapped in a woolen cloak. Two guards on horseback patrol the road like specters, one far down to the south and another nearer to the high-walled fortress of red stone.

Broken-down Double Door.name:
破损的双开门
Broken-down Double Door

Text.text:
两块巨大的木板平躺在地上，原本是一扇双开门，如今已从铰链处被硬生生扯断。门缘处满是崩缺与裂纹，显然是闯入者为破门而入狠狠一通猛砸。可即便如此，门板的形体始终未曾碎裂，仍旧完完整整地保持着原样。
Two massive slabs of wood lie flat on the ground, double doors broken off at the hinges. Both are chipped and cracked along their edges, having taken a substantial beating from whoever broke through them to get inside. Yet the forms never broke. They remain wholly intact.

Undead Dwarf Takes A Swipe.name:
不死矮人挥出一记横扫
Undead Dwarf Takes A Swipe

Text.text:
这具不死矮人身上仅裹着一条兜裆布，胡须里串着仪式用的珠串。那胡须昔日的赤褐早已褪尽，变作死气沉沉的锈黄。它龇牙咆哮，脱臼的下颌松松垮垮地在脖颈上晃荡，胡须随之颤抖。粗厚、发黄的涎丝在它狰狞的齿间拉扯连结；嘴唇早已腐烂脱落，红肿渗血的牙龈血肉淋漓地暴露在外。它躯干上大片病态的皮肉已然朽坏，皮肤从肩头松垂下来，像一条苍白的皮革披巾。肋骨架裸露无遗，令人窒息的恶臭从骨缝间不断渗出。它猛地一阵大幅前扑，伴随着吃力的低哼，灰白的手爪朝你狠狠一扫。
The undead dwarf wears only a loincloth and ceremonial beads in a beard that, once auburn in color, has dulled to a lifeless, rusted hue. It snarls, its unhinged jaw rocking loosely against its neck, its beard aquiver. Strings of thick, yellowed saliva connect its grimacing teeth, the lips rotted away so that the gore of its inflamed, bleeding gums is on full display. Much of the sickly flesh of its torso has rotted away, the skin hanging loose from its shoulders like a pallid leather shawl. The rib cage is exposed, an overwhelming stench seeping from between the bones. With a sudden great lurch and a groan of effort, it swipes its gray hand toward you.

Staircase Of Gothic Ballroom.name:
哥特舞厅的楼梯
Staircase Of Gothic Ballroom

Text.text:
站在铺着天鹅绒地毯的楼梯顶端，你得以将舞厅的华美尽收眼底——连同前门上方的高窗也一并看见。它们将前庭框成一幅田园画卷般的景致。外头树木纤细的枝条以轻盈的优雅触及窗格。
From the top of the velvet-carpeted staircase, you can see the ballroom in its full glory, including the tall windows above the front doors. They frame the front courtyard as if it were an idyllic painting. The slender branches of the outside trees reach for the panes with an airy grace.

与其说像犬，不如说更像鼠：这生物是一头獒犬般大小的啮齿兽，豆粒般的眼睛阴冷发亮，骇人的门齿从狭窄的颌骨里疯长而出，远远越过常理的界限。你面前这只浑身散着令人作呕的癣臭，皮肉鳞化溃烂，脓液淋漓。溃疡撕扯着它轻捷的躯体，带毒的腐败沿着绳结般的肌束沟壑渗流；旧伤干枯结痂、粗硬龟裂，仍不断抖落孢子般的粉屑——那会让非地精类染上一种可怖的综合征，被称作地精痘。它们常年挨饿受虐，却会对自己的地精驯手与骑手以野性凶残相应；对其他所有人，则不知为何更加嗜血。
More murine than canine, this creature is a mastiff-sized rodent with beady eyes, and horrific incisors growing far beyond the limits of its narrow jaw. The one before you is rank with itchy mange, flesh scaly and suppurating. Lesions ravage its lithe form, infectious rot oozing down the grooves of its corded muscles, and old wounds, dried and scabrous, that emit sporoid dander, which infects non-goblinoids with a terrible syndrome known as goblin pox. Oft underfed and maltreated, these beasts are known to respond to their goblin handlers and riders with feral savagery. Unfortunately for you, they are somehow more vicious toward everyone else.

Quip By A Warlike Species About Human Co.name:
一个好战种族对人类勇气的俏皮话
Quip By A Warlike Species About Human Courage

Text.text:
“如此脆弱……黏稠……的形体，竟有这般傲慢。某种意义上，我钦佩你的胆魄——尽管我打算把你的心脏从你体内生生扯出来。”
“Such arrogance from such fragile… gooey… forms. In a way, I admire your heart, even though I intend to rip it from your body.”

Staff Of Striking.name:
震击法杖
Staff Of Striking

Text.text:
这根厚重的木杖在你手中挥动时带着令人愉悦的分量——仿佛它所承载的远不止表面所见。秘法象形文字沿着抛光的杖身一路延展，粗厚的皮革缠绕覆住中段。杖顶以惊人的逼真细节雕成一只紧握的拳头，宛如活物般逼视着你。
This hefty wooden staff has a pleasing weight as you move it around—as if it carries more than meets the eye. Arcane hieroglyphs run the length of the polished haft and thick leather binding covers the midsection. A carved fist crowns the top of the staff in startlingly life-like detail.

Castle Corner Tower.name:
城堡角楼
Castle Corner Tower

Text.text:
四座巍峨高塔自外墙四角拔地而起，分别镇守四方。尽管风蚀的石块褪色崩缺——有的甚至攀满藤蔓——高塔依旧如初建之日般高耸坚毅，岿然不动。
Four great towers rise from the corners of the outer walls, one at each compass point. Though the weathered stones are faded and chipped—some even host to climbing vines—the towers stand as tall and stalwart as the day they were built.

Massacre By Vampire Spawn.name:
被吸血鬼衍体屠杀
Massacre By Vampire Spawn

Text.text:
原始恐惧的惊惶尖叫撕裂冰冷的夜空气息，族群骤然自藏身处爆发而出。瘦削苍白的身影蜿蜒滑入街道，自阴影中爬出，宛如蜘蛛逼近落网的苍蝇。首领猛然扑上逃窜的农夫，滚烫的鲜血化作猩红长喷溅满鹅卵石，盛宴就此开场。

~ Envisioned by thebigham

Panicked shrieks of primal terror ring through the chill night air as the brood erupts from hiding. Gaunt, pale figures slither into the street, emerging from the shadows like spiders creeping toward trapped flies. The leader bounces on a fleeing peasant, and hot blood sprays across the cobbles in a crimson jet as the feast begins.

~ Envisioned by thebigham

High Seas: Gathering Storm.name:
公海：风暴汇聚
High Seas: Gathering Storm

Text.text:
风势陡然增强，卷起白浪翻涌的水花，狠狠横扫过甲板。船体在巨大的起伏中升沉，被浪峰托举而起，随即顺着坡面滑落，坠入灰绿水丘之间的浪谷。天际预示着同样的天气——甚至更糟。乌云自地平线滚滚铺展，浓重翻涌，遮天蔽日。
The wind has picked up, whirling spray from whitecapped waves and hurling it across the deck. The ship rises and falls in great undulations, buoyed up before sliding downslope to the valley between the gray-green hills of water. The skies promise more of the same weather—or worse. Dark clouds roil thickly from horizon to horizon.

在黑暗中，生物那惨白的皮肤攫住你的视线；几近半透明，其下黑色、蛛网般的血管蜿蜒交错。它起初蜷伏而坐，但你一靠近，便缓缓挺身，直至那令人目眩的骇人高度。它瘦削细长，佝偻的骨架如同枯骨嶙峋——这生物也许曾是人类，此刻却张开滴血的巨口，露出一排排参差破碎的黄牙。它像一具行走的尸体，干枯的皮肉被硬生生绷在扭曲的骨头上；然而它眼底那抹狡黠，却令你不由得停住了脚步。
In the darkness, the creature's pallid skin catches your eye; it's almost translucent with black, spiderwebbing veins. They sit crouched, but as you near they rise to their full, staggering height. Gaunt and spindly, with a hunched, skeletal frame, the creature that may have once been human opens its bloody maw to reveal rows of jagged, yellow teeth. A walking corpse, with desiccated flesh pulled taut across warped bones, though the cunning in its eyes gives you pause.

Loot From A Troll Lair.name:
来自巨魔巢穴的战利品
Loot From A Troll Lair

Text.text:
巨魔那滋滋作响的尸体散发出一层稀薄而腐臭的雾气，充满洞窟；它正以不自然的速度开始腐烂。在一个伪装得并不高明的洞穴里，你找到了这生物的宝藏堆：各式各样的钱币与宝石，折合共计3200枚金币，杂乱无章地散落在壁龛内冰凉的岩面上。你还注意到一对金属卷轴匣，刻着奥秘符号，正靠在后墙处休息着。
The sizzling corpse of the troll fills the cavern with a thin, rancid mist as it begins to decay with unnatural speed. In a poorly disguised hole, you find the creature’s treasure hoard, which contains an assortment of coins and gems amounting to 3200 gold pieces scattered haphazardly over the cool rock inside the alcove. You also spot a pair of metal scroll cases engraved with arcane symbols resting against the back wall.

铁锤叮当砸在铁砧上。锻炉赤红的光芒照亮了空间，伴随而来的热浪几乎令人难以忍受。锤子、钳子、卡尺、凿子、冲子，以及用途不明的工具，沿着墙上挂架一字排开。工作台上摆着已经完工的马蹄铁与农具；铁匠则将阔剑的剑刃反复锻平，汗水在他们脸上闪着光。直到他们缓缓吐出一口气，把几近熔融的剑尖浸入一桶清水——霎时迸出尖锐而突兀的嘶鸣。
The hammer rings against the anvil. The glow of the forge, red-hot, illuminates the space, and the accompanying heat is almost too much to bear. Hammers, tongs, calipers, chisels, punches, and tools of unknown purpose line wall-mounted racks. Horseshoes and farming implements sit finished on a work bench, while the smithy hammers flat the blade of a broadsword, sweat shining on their face. They ease out a breath as they dip the near-molten tip of the sword into a barrel of water—discharging a sharp and sudden hiss.

Synthetic Liquor, Burn.name:
合成烈酒，灼烧
Synthetic Liquor, Burn

Text.text:
尽管这只玻璃五分之一加仑瓶拧着黑色旋盖、还缠着胶带封口，它依旧散发出刺鼻的酒精臭味——更像生物燃料而非饮品——挥发的气息会刺激未受保护的眼睛与黏膜。瓶内是澄清液体，黏稠度略高于清水，隐约泛着一丝粉红。唯一的标签是一枚红色的爆头表情，既将内容物标记为烈酒 Burn，又暗示其出身颇为……手工。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Despite its black screwcap and tape seal, this glass fifth bottle reeks of alcohol—suggesting biofuel more than drink—the vapor irritating to unprotected eyes and mucous membranes. Inside is a clear fluid, slightly more viscous than water, with a hint of pink coloration. A red exploding-head emoji forms the only label, marking the contents as the liquor Burn while suggesting an… artisanal origin.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Elderly Tyrannosaurus.name:
年迈的霸王龙
Elderly Tyrannosaurus

Text.text:
尽管青春的力量与活力早已离这头高耸的生物而去，它仍是一具令人敬畏的强大个体。粗如树干的腿如今在生物的负载下微微战栗，却依旧稳如磐石，驮着这头威严的恐龙继续前行——在食物链顶端度过它最后的岁月，直至再一次被大地收回。
Though the power and vitality of youth have left the towering creature, it is still a formidable specimen. Legs thick as tree trunks now quake beneath the creature’s bulk yet stand resolute, carrying the majestic dinosaur onward as it lives out its final years atop the food chain before being claimed by the earth once more.

Adonis Bladetail.name:
阿多尼斯·刃尾
Adonis Bladetail

Text.text:
干血般的发色垂落在这名男子脸侧，与他的八字胡和胡须相映；发梢却愈发加深，最终染成黑色。头发不够长，触及不到披在他肩上的小龙。那小家伙覆着珍珠色鳞片，懒洋洋地蓝眼斜睨。男子自己的双眼则是紫罗兰色，目光坚硬冷峻。他双脚分开稳稳站定，黑衣外罩一领闪亮的锁子甲长袍，大腿处系着护裙甲片。随着他抽出两把泛着蓝霜的武士刀，薄雾从刀鞘与刀身间涌出。

~ Played by a Hero

Hair the color of dried blood hangs around this man’s face, matching his mustache and beard, all of it darkening to black at the tips. The hair isn’t long enough to reach the small dragon draped about his shoulders. It has scales the color of pearls and a lazy, blue-eyed stare. His own eyes are violet, with a hard expression. He stands ready in a wide stance, wearing a shining chain hauberk over black clothing, tassets on his thighs. As he draws two katanas of bluish ice, mist pours from their sheaths and blades.

~ Played by a Hero

Tari'th Darkmoon The Tiefling Fiendish W.name:
塔里斯·暗月　提夫林·邪魔契约术士
Tari'th Darkmoon The Tiefling Fiendish Warlock

Text.text:
你的双眼急切搜寻那道紫色爆裂的源头——它方才擦着你的发梢呼啸而过。短暂的炫目褪去后，视线落在一名被磨得发亮的橙红色提夫林身上；她的白色眼眸映着那道逐渐熄灭的法术残留的紫罗兰光。她身着皮护甲，身姿高挑而优雅，弧度华美的双角更衬得她摄人心魄——她的美丽与力量同样令人着迷。你几乎被她的气场攫住，凝视良久，直到这时才注意到：一只小巧、覆着鳞片的生物正从她肩头窜过。

~ 由 RPGBOT.net 的 Tyler 扮演

Your eyes search for the source of the purple blast that just blew past your hair. After adjusting from the momentary brightness, they land on a burnished orange Tiefling, her white eyes reflecting the violet hues of the fizzling spell. She stands tall and graceful with her leather armor and elegantly curved horns, her beauty as enchanting as her power. You’re so taken by her captivating presence that several moments of intense study pass before you even notice the small, scaly creature skittering across her shoulders.

~ Played by Tyler from RPGBOT.net

Parked Wagon At Camp.name:
营地里停放的货车
Parked Wagon At Camp

Text.text:
噼啪作响的篝火以橙色光晕照亮木制马车——在阴沉里显得温暖而诱人。车顶涂着绿色，翠意甚至胜过周遭树木；而那些树在阴云密布的天空下也被衬得格外萧瑟。车尾门前有一段可收起的矮梯通往车厢，两盏提灯分别悬在门框两侧。车门与车窗尽数紧闭，百叶牢牢扣死。
A crackling campfire illuminates the wooden wagon with an orange glow—a warm and inviting sight in the gloom. Its green-painted roof offers more verdancy than the surrounding trees, which are made bleak by the overcast sky. A short, retractable stair leads up to the back door of the wagon, where lanterns hang on either side of the frame. The doors and windows are all shuttered tight.

Divine Courthouse Of A God Of Vengeance.name:
复仇之神的神圣法庭
Divine Courthouse Of A God Of Vengeance

Text.text:
这是一座朴素却宏伟到骇人的建筑，体型堪比一座小城。成千上万盏简易枝形吊灯悬挂在整座法院的各处。即便原告咬紧牙关，以神之名低声许下誓言，长廊仍回荡着愤怒与索求的回声。这里没有高高的审判席。只有一把椅子，沉重而方正，由花岗岩与玄武岩的巨板堆砌而成；而在它前方的地面上，绘着一幅世界地图，其上密布着数以百万计成对的小小相同符号——每一个都在寻找另一个。
This is a simple but enormous building, the size of a small city. Thousands of simple chandeliers hang throughout the courthouse. Its halls echo with outrage and demand even when a plaintiff whispers promises through gritted teeth in the god’s name. There is no high bench. There is a chair, heavy and blocky, of slabs of granite and basalt, and painted on the floor before it is a map of the world with millions of pairs of small matching symbols on it—each one seeking the other.

Fantasy Explorer Finds Crashed Astral Ve.name:
奇幻探险者发现坠毁的星界飞船
Fantasy Explorer Finds Crashed Astral Vessel

Text.text:
拨开最后一丛灌木，探险者抹去额头上倾泻般的汗水，望着眼前的发现，惊得怔住。陨坑里，一辆仍在闷燃的载具残骸带着火焰，半埋在泥土中；旁侧那道深深犁开的沟壑与折断的树木，清楚描绘出它灾难性坠落的轨迹。飞行器尾部的引擎泛着白炽的灼光，脉动般明灭，将泄漏臭氧的辛辣气味注入空气；破碎的驾驶舱内，诡异的灯光断续抽搐、闪烁不定。探险者小心绕行，探头窥入舱内，想瞥见这台异界造物的驾驶者——但他们已经死了。树干刺破驾驶舱风挡玻璃，狠狠贯穿，将其钉在座椅上，灼烧得面目全非。

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

Pushing through the last of the undergrowth, the explorer wipes a torrent of sweat from her brow and stares in astonishment at her discovery. In the crater, the flaming wreck of a smoldering vehicle lies buried in the earth, the deep furrow and broken trees nearby clearly charting the course of its catastrophic descent. The engines at the craft's rear glow white-hot with a pulsing light and infuse the air with the tang of leaking ozone as strange lights stutter and blink in the shattered cockpit. Circling around carefully, the explorer peers into the cabin to get a glimpse of the pilot of this otherworldly contraption—but they are dead. Impaled by the tree jutting through the glass of the cockpit windscreen, they have been pinned to their seat and burned beyond all recognition.

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

这片仙人掌丛生着又长又狰狞的尖刺，既能阻退粗心的旅人，也能吓退沙漠中的生物——在这片荒凉地形里，它们几乎是你能找到的仅有的植物生命。然而，对那些胆敢闯过尖刺穿刺、仍能活下来的勇者而言，若精通野外求生之道，仙人掌也能提供食物或水分。
Long, wicked-looking spines ward off both incautious travelers and desert creatures from this patch of cacti, some of the only plant life you can find in this inhospitable terrain. Yet for those brave enough to survive the piercing stabs of their spines, the cactus can provide food or water for those well-versed in living off the land.

等你听见那薄纱般翅翼的嗡鸣时，恐怖早已贴到眼前。它那臃肿的昆虫躯体——足有你一条手臂那么长——披着湿滑油腻的猩红甲壳，在空中疾掠时泛起病态月光般的冷辉。生物的面孔上，一根细剑般锐利的口器饥渴地伸出；其上方，一对令人作呕的复眼闪烁着幽光。它的胸部猛然迸出半打多节肢体，末端尽是匕首尖刺，伴随诡异的叮铃声在空气中摸索，随时要扣住它的目标，抽干对方体内的生命。
By the time you hear the thrumming of its gossamer wings, the horror is already upon you. Its bloated insectoid body—as long as your arm—is covered in slick, oily red carapace that shimmers like sick moonlight as it whizzes in the air. Above a rapier-sharp proboscis that extends hungrily from the creature's face shines a pair of nauseating multifaceted eyes. Exploding from its thorax are half a dozen multijointed limbs that end in dagger points. They grope the air with an eerie chiming, ready to latch on to their target as they drain the very life from them.

Loot From A Black Dragon Wyrmling.name:
来自一只黑龙幼雏的战利品
Loot From A Black Dragon Wyrmling

Text.text:
雏龙那对炭黑龙角中的一只旁，微光闪烁：一条纤细的金链垂着金质吊坠，银丝錾纹缠绕其上，嵌着种子珍珠。吊坠里是一幅剃得干干净净的贵族小像——却有人在他脸上画上了一撇卷曲的小胡子。
Something glitters around one of the wyrmling’s charcoal horns: a fine gold chain with a gold locket, chased with silver and set with seed pearls. Inside is a tiny portrait of a clean-shaven nobleman—but someone has painted a curly mustache on his face.

Avatar Of The Sun God Of Justice.name:
正义太阳神的化身
Avatar Of The Sun God Of Justice

Text.text:
炽烈夺目的光芒环绕着悬浮在你面前的虚灵之躯。它的肌肤仿佛一座翻涌的太阳能量熔炉，耀焰在这具化身的轮廓上跳跃奔涌，宛如海浪间跃出水面的海豚。本该灼人的热浪却并未降临——只有光，以及完美夏日般的和煦暖意。

~ 一位英雄Envisioned

Radiant, blinding light surrounds the ethereal being hovering before you. Its skin is a swirling caldera of solar energy, with flares leaping across the avatar’s form like dolphins cresting ocean waves. Where you would expect blistering heat, however, there is only the light and pleasant warmth of a perfect summer’s day.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Clean My Cauldron By Hand.name:
我用手清洗我的坩埚
I Clean My Cauldron By Hand

Text.text:
我的指关节又一次擦过坩埚内壁那起伏的波纹金属，仿佛已是第一百回，我不禁龇牙抽气。可我仍不肯停，握着钢丝绒的掌根用力抵住顽垢，那污渍死死咬住金属不放。我把头更深地探进去，想要触及锅底，顺势吸入里头一股气味：酸涩的尖味混着潮土般的腥沉，都是我最近拿来试验的那些古怪材料酿出的味道。
I wince as my knuckles rake against the corrugated guts of the cauldron for what feels like the hundredth time. I persist, pressing the ball of steel wool against the grime that stubbornly clings to the metal. I stick my head in further to reach the bottom of the pot and take in a whiff of the odor within: a mix of sour tang and earthiness born of all the strange ingredients I've been experimenting with recently.

Precise Counterterror Submachine Gun.name:
精准反恐冲锋枪
Precise Counterterror Submachine Gun

Text.text:
如同挥舞它的人一般迅捷而致命，这把武器精准无情、破坏力惊人。落在真正的行家手中，那令人目眩的射速足以在敌人尚未察觉自身陷入险境之前，就将一整间屋子的目标尽数清除。它是精英特种作战与反恐小队的心头好。
As fast and lethal as those who wield it, this weapon is precise and devastating. In the right hands, the dizzying rate of fire can eradicate a room full of hostiles before they even realize the danger they are in. It’s a favorite of elite special ops and counterterror squads.

Civilian Trading Vessel: Cozy Bridge.name:
民用商船：温馨的舰桥
Civilian Trading Vessel: Cozy Bridge

Text.text:
这座舰桥被一个朴素家庭的点滴温情所点缀，俨然成了号令与团结交汇的中枢。墙上用五彩磁贴固定着一幅孩子的涂鸦，而指挥台的控制台上最显眼的位置，则摆着一幅田园牧歌般的画面：一家人其乐融融地野餐。船长座椅上细心地披着一条柔软的手织毯，刚煮好的咖啡香在狭小的房间里氤氲升温，让这里更添一份舒适的暖意。
The personal touches of a humble family mark this bridge as a hub of both command and unity. A child’s drawing is held to the wall by colorful magnets, and an idyllic pastoral scene of a family enjoying a picnic has pride of place on the command console. A soft hand-knitted blanket is draped carefully over the captain’s chair, and the scent of freshly brewed coffee warms the small room, adding to its cozy ambience.

Halfling Ambushed By Ooze.name:
半身人遭黏液怪伏击
Halfling Ambushed By Ooze

Text.text:
半身人暖暖地低笑着，看着同伴帽檐一上一下地起伏，陷在震耳欲聋的鼾声循环里。一阵怪响——像湿水泥被从下水道里生生吸走——把他的注意力扯向小屋那扇破烂的门。原始的寒意顺着脊背窜起：一条滴着黏液的伪足从腐朽木板不可能那么小的缝隙里探入，带着威胁般朝他逼近。
The halfling chuckles warmly as he watches the brim of his companion's hat dip up and down, caught in a cycle of cacophonous snoring. A strange sound—like wet cement being sucked down a drain—draws his attention to the battered door of the small room. A primal shiver runs up his spine as a dripping pseudopod probes menacingly toward him, entering through an impossibly small gap in the rotted wood.

你面前这只鸟形生物周身散发出灼热，羽毛被一种诡异而瑰丽的光辉点燃。它的双眼闪烁着超凡脱俗的幽光；当它喙部张开，一声怪异的啼鸣迸发而出——宛如鸟鸣与噼啪燃烧的火焰交织在一起。
A heat emanates from the birdlike creature before you, its feathers blazing with a strange and wondrous light. Its eyes glow with an otherworldly quality, and as its beak opens, a strange cry issues forth—like a mingling of birdsong and crackling flames.

Jungle Rubber Tree.name:
丛林橡胶树
Jungle Rubber Tree

Text.text:
这棵树令人叹为观止：下方是盘根错节的纠缠，向上则是枝条纵横伸展，顶端簇簇红绿相间的叶冠如同加冕。某处伤口撕裂了光滑的浅褐色树皮，裂口间树液成股渗出、滴落。树液呈乳白色，格外浓稠黏腻。
The tree is an impressive tangle of roots below and branches above, crowned with clusters of red-green leaves. Some injury has left a rent in the smooth, pale brown bark, allowing gouts of sap to drip out. The sap of this tree is milky white and particularly thick and sticky.

Lament Of A Fighter.name:
战士的挽歌
Lament Of A Fighter

Text.text:
“我越来越觉得，我被丢到这世上，就是当个宇宙级的磨牙玩具，给每一个在我路上碰见的怪物和野兽咬着玩。”
“I’m starting to feel like I was put on this earth as some sort of cosmic chew toy for every monster and beast that crosses my path.”

Imperfect Clone.name:
残缺的克隆体
Imperfect Clone

Text.text:
关于这个克隆体的一切在技术上都完全一致，可他们身上就是有某种——不对劲——的地方。就像梦里的倒影一样，克隆体以一种令人毛骨悚然的细微方式错了，可你偏偏说不出到底哪里不对。这个念头像钻进脑子里的痒一样啃噬着你。你的潜意识正对着你尖叫答案，可你就是还看不见。
Everything about the clone is technically identical but there is something—off—about them. Like a reflection in a dream, the clone is wrong in a terrifyingly subtle way that you can’t put your finger on. The thought gnaws at you like an itch in your brain. Your subconscious mind is screaming the answer at you, but you just can’t see it yet.

Crouching Ghoul.name:
潜伏的食尸鬼（特征）
Crouching Ghoul

Text.text:
阴影向两侧裂开，月光下显出一只恶臭的食尸鬼（特征）蜷伏着。它佝偻的身躯盘成一团，缠绕着恶毒的饥渴；双眼满是食人般的渴望。它以诡异的静默守候着，像死亡的阴森具象。它几乎带着淫亵般的神情舔了舔嘴唇……随后开始朝你爬来。
The shadows part, revealing a fetid ghoul crouching in the moonlight. Its hunched form is coiled with malevolent hunger, its eyes filled with cannibalistic craving, and it waits with eerie stillness, a sinister manifestation of death. Almost lasciviously it licks its lips… and begins to crawl toward you.

面如花岗岩的安保人员守在这片社区高耸大门旁的岗亭里，站在自动摄像头冷漠而无处不在的注视之下。大门无声滑开，一辆贵得骇人、张扬刺目的豪车缓缓驶出。司机把深色车窗压下一道缝，冲一名守卫吼了句命令，随即猖狂地猛轰油门，轮胎尖啸撕裂耳膜，朝着城市方向绝尘而去。
Granite-faced security personnel attend the booth attached to the towering gates of this community, standing under the inscrutable and ever-present watch of the auto-cams. The gates slide open without a sound and a hideously expensive, ostentatious car rolls out. The driver cracks a tinted window to bark an order at one of the guards before obnoxiously spinning their tires with an ear-splitting screech and driving toward the city.

Meditations: Babbling Brook.name:
冥想：潺潺溪流
Meditations: Babbling Brook

Text.text:
河水蜿蜒流淌，水面细波荡漾，在阳光明媚、芦苇摇曳的河岸与被一片片冷白桦林投下阴影的岸边之间徘徊穿行。河流在森林掩蔽中切出一道柔和的峡谷，让更矮小的植物在向阳的边缘蓬勃滋长，也为欢欣的鸟儿献上无数阳台，使它们得以从中高声宣告自己的喜悦。
The water wends and ripples as it wanders between sunny banks of waving reeds and shores shadowed by starkly white stands of birch trees. The river creates a gentle canyon in the forest cover, allowing smaller plants to flourish on its sunlit verge and giving jubilant birds countless balconies from which they can proclaim their joy.

你推开这家店的门，立刻被喧闹的合唱与酒杯碰撞的叮当声迎面袭来。队伍里个子高的成员不得不弯腰低头，免得脑袋撞上门框顶端——这里显然是为以矮人居多的客人打造的。屋内，三三两两的矮人占据着长凳，围坐在同样狭长的桌旁；桌面被许多个夜晚的狂欢所洒出的麦酒浸得湿漉漉的。以人类的标准来看天花板低得压抑，但一旦落座便不那么碍眼——尤其是在你还没来得及开口时，一只泡沫翻涌、满得快要溢出的棕色矮人麦酒杯就被毫不迟疑地塞进你手里。
You open the door to this establishment and are immediately assailed by the sounds of raucous singing and mugs clattering. The taller members of your party are forced to stoop to avoid heads colliding with the top of the doorjamb, as this place has been designed for the use of a largely dwarven clientele. Inside, several pockets of dwarves sit on long benches around equally long tables sodden with the spilled ales of many a night's celebration. Though the ceilings are quite low by human standards, once a seat is taken, it is not so noticeable—especially when a frothing, overfull mug of brown dwarven ale is pushed into your hands without request or hesitation.

戏法自你唇间逸出，如一口冰冷的吐息。你的目标僵在原地，头颅与肩膀迅速结上一层霜壳。皮肤泛起紫绀，鼻端的滴液在上唇处凝成倒挂的冰锥。面容被痛苦的狞 grimace 冻成定格的表情，他们咬紧牙关，从牙缝后挤出一声微弱的呻吟。

~ 由 Kyrus (Brent) 构想

The cantrip leaves your lips as an icy breath. Your target stiffens in place, their head and shoulders crusting over with frost. Their skin purples, and drippings from their nose turn to icicles above their lip. Face frozen into a pained grimace, they emit a weak groan from behind gritted teeth.

~ Envisioned by Kyrus (Brent)

琳琅满目的亮晶晶小玩意儿随处可见：有的从钩子上垂挂摇曳，有的摊在桌面上铺陈开来，还有的被分门别类收进盒子里。戒指、项链、发簪、手镯、臂环等等应有尽有，仿佛任人挑选。虽说大多看着并不奢华得离谱，你还是瞥见了几件镶着宝石、以贵金属作底座——或两者兼具——的货色。
Bright baubles and pretty little things abound, dangling from hooks, laid across tables, and collected in boxes. Rings, necklaces, hair pins, bracelets, arm bands and more seem to be on offer. Although none of it looks outlandishly expensive, you do spy a few items with gems, settings of precious metal, or both.

这些幽暗的走廊里，只有黑铁火盆中零星余烬投下稀薄的光，潜藏着不和谐的秘密。古老的魔法低鸣搅动：一种野性、古老而青翠的气息，悬在浑浊的陈腐空气中。粗壮的根须顶破地砖与墙壁，裂缝像闪电的血管般在石面上蜿蜒。门板与家具被砸碎散落一地，临时拼凑的路障将房间的部分区域封死，仿佛在抵御看不见的敌人。当明亮的绿光微粒在黑暗中忽明忽暗，诱人前行时，又会有哪些勇敢的冒险者继续深入，去揭开这座昔日圣地的真相？
These shadowed corridors, lit sparingly by the embers in black-iron braziers, harbor discordant secrets. A hum of old magic stirs: the hint of something wild, old, and green hanging in the stale air. Burly roots break through tiles and walls, cracks winding like veins of lightning through the stone. Doors and furniture lie smashed upon the ground, and makeshift barricades block sections of rooms from unseen enemies. As glimmers of bright green motes wink and entice from the dark, what brave adventurers might press forward to learn the truth of this once-holy place?

I Pour Water From My Decanter Of Endless.name:
我从无尽之水醒酒器（喷泉）中倾泻出水
I Pour Water From My Decanter Of Endless Water (Fountain)

Text.text:
我一念出指令词，手中已拔塞的醒酒器立刻一歪。它猛地一沉，腹中传出咕嘟咕嘟的吞咽声。忽然，它以稳定的节奏喷出一道水弧，宽度与瓶口齐平，持续了好几秒。一加仑。两加仑。五加仑。最后，醒酒器轻轻打了个小嗝。
The uncorked decanter tips in my hand the instant I speak the command word. It lurches as heavy gulping sounds issue from its belly. Suddenly, it spits an arc of water as wide as its mouth at a steady pace for several seconds. A gallon. Two. Five. Finally, the decanter issues a quiet little burp.

I Leap Onto A Running Mount.name:
我纵身跃上疾奔的坐骑
I Leap Onto A Running Mount

Text.text:
那生物撕裂般朝我冲来，眼中那副惊惶模样，分明是失控恐惧孕出的阴影。我屈膝下蹲，蓄势待发，只求这次别以断颈收场。那野兽看见我，从喉咙里挤出一声破碎的嘶号，几乎要侧身逃开——我却在恰到好处的瞬间跃起，双手攥住它疯狂起伏的肌肉与汗湿结毡的皮毛，硬生生攀上那颠簸的背脊坐稳。我尽可能轻柔地抱住生物的脖颈，贴近它的耳畔，试着低声呢喃，往它心里送去一丝安宁。
The creature tears toward me, the harrowed look in its eyes born of rampant fear. I bend my knees into a crouch to prepare to spring, hoping against all odds this doesn’t end in a broken neck. The beast looses a ragged call from its throat as it sees me and nearly veers away, but I leap at the right moment. I grab on to its wildly shifting muscles and its sweat-stained fur and manage to clamber to a bouncing seat. I hold on to the creature as gently as I can with my arms about its neck, and I attempt to whisper words of calm into its ear.

I Use Reckless Attack.name:
我使用鲁莽攻击
I Use Reckless Attack

Text.text:
我紧握斧头，将它尽可能高高举过头顶，随即纵身向前猛扑。身体失衡，既不顾自身安危，也无从招架，我借着冲势与武器的重量，狠狠劈出一记凶狠的重击。
I grip my axe, lifting it as high as I can over my head, then hurl myself forward. Off balance, without concern for my safety, or any way to parry, I use my momentum and the weight of my weapon to inflict a nasty blow.

Headstone: Marked Stone In Summer.name:
墓碑：夏日的刻字石
Headstone: Marked Stone In Summer

Text.text: 与这座墓园里的其他墓碑不同，这一块不仅刻着文字，还嵌着一幅画像。碑文写道：先言语，后行事。 其下雕着一个六边形图案，内里排列着七具棺椁的形状与一弯半月，显然是在描绘山丘之巅那座墓冢神龛。可这块墓碑古怪之处还不止于此：它顶端平直，背面尖锐，中段最为宽阔，向两侧逐渐收窄，整体呈三角形——与周遭任何墓石都截然不同。 Unlike the other headstones in this cemetery, this one bears a picture as well as words. The engraving reads: First words. Then deeds. Beneath this is carved a hexagonal shape within which are seven coffin shapes and a half moon, evidently a depiction of the shrine of tombs atop the hill. And that’s not the only curious thing about this marker. It has a flat top and pointed back, wide in the middle and narrowing at the edges, giving it a triangular shape—unlike any of the surrounding tombstones.

General \"Fresh\" Kamesh Blackstaff.name:
“新晋”将军卡梅什·黑杖
General "Fresh" Kamesh Blackstaff

Text.text:
这名侏儒在同族之中称得上高大魁梧，双臂筋肉虬结。他将深色头发剪得极短，清爽利落，不遮眼面。黑与银的符文刺青沿着手臂一路蔓延，彼此缠结盘绕，如绳如藤。虽只披着黑灰相间的朴素长袍，却一眼便知他懂得自保——背上与腰间的鞘里，密密麻麻收着近一打形制各异、大小不一的刀刃。随着他一个潇洒的抖腕，暴风般的灰色眼眸骤然燃起银辉，每一柄剑都从剑鞘中弹跃而出——仿佛自有意志——在他周身盘旋飞舞，钢光翻涌，令人目眩。

~ Played by a Hero

The gnome stands tall and broad for one of his heritage, arms corded with muscle. He keeps his dark hair close-cropped and free of his face. Runic tattoos of black and silver run the length of his arms, knotting and twining through one another. Though wearing simple robes of black and gray, it’s clear the gnome knows how to protect himself—he carries close to a dozen blades of myriad shapes and sizes sheathed at his back and in his belt. With a flourish, his storm-gray eyes blaze with a silver light, and each sword springs from its scabbard—seemingly of its own will—to whirl about the gnome in a dizzying display of steel.

~ Played by a Hero

Mad Drider Chemist.name:
疯狂卓尔蛛化学家
Mad Drider Chemist

Text.text:
被试剂架、盛着内脏的玻璃罐与摊开的图表包围着，这间八角形实验室里正进行着一场骇人的手术。外科医的双手以疯狂的速度飞舞。在凭空召来的钴蓝色聚光灯照耀下，他们蛛形的腹部与节肢在手术台间窸窣疾行，而类人的躯干与双手则不停动作——将两具死去的样本肢解，再把它们拼接成一体。他们强行将苍蓝色的蜘蛛腿与恶魔史莱姆生物那泛黄的假足纠缠在一起；蜘蛛腿上仍拖曳着一缕缕雾紫色的魔法。成品与整幅景象一样，令人作呕。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Surrounded by shelves of reagents, jars of viscera, and unrolled charts, a monstrous operation is taking place in this octagonal laboratory. The hands of the chirurgeon work at the speed of madness. Under the glow of conjured cobalt spotlights, their arachnid abdomen and legs scuttle between the operating tables while their humanoid torso and hands work—dismembering two dead subjects and splicing them together. They forcibly fuse pale-blue spider legs, still trailing a misty purple magic, with the jaundiced pseudopod of a demonic slime creature. The result, like the whole scene, looks abhorrent.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Advice To A Brooding Person.name:
给阴郁之人的忠告
Advice To A Brooding Person

Text.text:
“我受不了你整天闷闷不乐。总是阴沉沉、郁郁寡欢，好像全世界只有你受过苦。也许你别再把痛苦当饰品往身上挂，会有更多人喜欢你。”
“I can’t stand you sulking about. Always so dark and brooding, as if you’re the only person who’s ever suffered. Maybe if you stopped decorating yourself with misery, more people would like you.”

烟柱在数英里外就清晰可见。再近些，烧木的气味不再是篝火或壁炉那种令人安心的暖香。滚滚浓烟之下，树冠如扇般铺开，黑暗中夹杂着一缕缕猩红的炭火。更近时，一堵扩张的热浪之墙烤灼着一切。烈焰深处传来低沉的咆哮与爆裂的脆响。忽然，一棵树从树根处窜起火舌，瞬间被吞没，最终轰然炸裂。
The smoke is visible from miles away. Closer, the smell of burning wood isn’t the comforting scent of a campfire or hearth. Treetops fan out under the billows of smoke, streaks of a red coal amid the blackness. Closer, a wall of heat parches everything as it expands. There is the deep raging and cracking of the inferno. Suddenly one tree turns to flame at the bottom, becomes engulfed, and finally explodes.

断裂栅栏的一根横梁横躺在通往湖岸的斜坡上，附近却看不见任何栅栏立柱。岸边芦苇稀疏，许多被压弯或折断。草地被压平、岸坡被刮出沟痕，再加上一点抹开的藻渍与泥污，显然这里正是某个庞然大物进出水面的滑道。
A beam from the broken fence lies on the slope that descends to the lakeshore, although no fence posts stand nearby. Reeds on the shore are sparse, and many are bent or broken. By the flattening of the grass and the gouging of the bank, along with a little smeared algae and mud, it’s apparent that this is where something large slides in and out of the water.

I Cast Raise Dead.name:
我施放《死者复活》
I Cast Raise Dead

Text.text:
我对着死者低声咒念，掌心将钻石捏碎成粉。任由粉尘自指缝洒落，悬停在尸身上方，织成一层猩红、粼粼闪烁的薄幕。宝石细砂缓缓坠下，触及那冰冷僵硬的躯体便倏然隐没，像雪花落地般融成虚无。片刻之后……你看见他们的胸膛开始缓慢起伏，手脚也微微抽动，重新被生命牵动。
I speak over the dead, crushing the diamond to dust in my palm. I let it fall from my hand so it may hover over the body, creating a red, shimmering veil. The grains of gemstone descend and disappear upon contact with the freezing corpse, melting like snowflakes into nothing. It takes a moment… but you see their chest begin to slowly rise and fall, and their hands and feet begin to twitch with life.

Stone Age Steppe.name:
石器年代草原
Stone Age Steppe

Text.text:
刺骨的寒风粗暴地掠过无遮无挡的草原，一群猛犸踏着干枯脆裂的草茎缓缓前行。天空是一片无尽的蔚蓝，草海向四面八方延展，绵延数里不见尽头。这片草原唯一鲜明的特征，便是位面一路向北抬升的连绵斜坡，通往远方覆雪的山脉。
A brutally cold wind tears across the exposed steppe as a herd of mammoths trudges over the dry, brittle grass. The sky is an endless blue expanse, and the grasslands stretch for miles in every direction. The only defining feature of the steppe is the continuous incline of the plane as it travels north toward the distant, snow-capped mountains.

An Uncontrolled Experience Of Planar Tra.name:
一次失控的位面旅行体验
An Uncontrolled Experience Of Planar Travel

Text.text:
胃里一阵怪异的翻搅让你头晕目眩，周遭的世界旋转着远去，没入黑暗。你感觉自己在坠落——无休无止地坠落——可眼前只有黯淡的色彩闪烁，耳中一片死寂，连自己的呼吸都听不见。尽管如此，你仍清晰地意识到终点正逼近：黑暗中矗立着一道不可穿透的屏障，仿佛向上坠落，撞向天穹般的“天花板”。你本能地绷紧身体准备迎接冲击，就在那一刻，你骤然抵达了另一个地方。
A queer lurch in your gut makes your head swim as the world around you spins away into darkness. You feel as though you’re falling—endlessly falling—but you see naught but dim flashes of color and hear nothing at all, not even your own breath. Nevertheless, you become conscious of an impending end, an impenetrable barrier in the dark like falling upward into a ceiling of sky. You instinctively brace for impact, and that’s when you suddenly arrive somewhere else.

无处不在的喷气引擎轰鸣主宰着机场外部空间，所幸一踏入室内，那声浪便被压低了许多。身着高可视道具的地勤人员在停机坪上匆匆穿梭，在近旁庞然巨物般的机身映衬下显得格外渺小。来自世界各地的航班在航站楼外交错停靠，每一架机身都骄傲地展示着各自公司的涂装。
The omnipresent roar of jet engines dominates the exterior space of the airport, though inside it is mercifully dulled. Ground crew clad in high-vis gear scurry across the tarmac, dwarfed by the immensity of the planes nearby. Aircraft from every corner of the world mingle outside the terminals, and each fuselage proudly displays its corporate livery.

那只古怪的蟾蜍般生物嗅着空气，一边嗅一边发出呱呱低鸣。蝙蝠般的翅膀在它背上不安地轻颤，一对长耳朵微微抽动，竖起倾听。你心想——是炼金人偶，准没错。某个施法者急于嗅出敌踪而造就了它；这畸短的生物只为侍奉而生。
The strange, toad-like creature sniffs the air, croaking as it does so. Batlike wings flick anxiously at its back, and a pair of long ears twitch, listening. A homunculus, you think—it must be. Created by some spellcaster eager to sniff out enemies, the stunted creature lives only to serve.

一盏残缺、污垢斑驳的枝形吊灯，沉默地守望着船腹深处那座吱呀作响、腐朽不堪的楼梯井。无光的阶梯向下盘绕，层层缠回自身，宛如吞噬自己尾巴的蛇。某些地方，木料早在久远之前便腐烂成空，露出巨大的裂缝与彻底缺失的台阶，透过那些断口，隐约可窥见下层甲板。
A chipped, grimy chandelier stands silent watch above the creaking, decrepit stairwell in the bowels of the ship. The lightless staircase coils in on itself as it descends deeper, like a serpent devouring its own tail. In places the lower deck can be glimpsed through large cracks and entirely missing steps where the wood rotted into oblivion long ago.

佝偻的身影将自身掩藏在一袭黑暗的裹布之中，那披风黑得仿佛能吞噬光亮。兜帽被拉得极低，阴影遮住了他们的面容，叫人只觉那是一团无面的影子。自披风深处，他们抽出一柄古怪的匕首——刃如缟玛瑙般漆黑，柄部弯曲，形似盘蛇。那身影吐出一个陌生的异邦词，随即亮刃疾冲而来。
The stooped figure conceals their form in a shroud of darkness, a cloak so black it seems to drink in light. A cowl, pulled low over their head, shadows their features and evokes the image of a faceless shadow. From the depths of their cloak, they draw forth a strange dagger, its blade onyx black, its hilt curved to resemble a serpent. The figure speaks a strange, foreign word, and darts forward with the blade brandished.

Temple To A Goddess Of Harvest.name:
丰收女神的神庙
Temple To A Goddess Of Harvest

Text.text:
在一栋自豪矗立的宅邸旁、整洁无瑕的附属建筑映衬下的农田里，一座由藤蔓与繁花编织成的凉棚立着，庇护着一张巨大的露天餐桌。餐桌中央一路摆放着一批收成供品、小饰物与信件。秋季的丰宴日里，凉棚外不远处燃着一小簇用本地木材点起的欢快火焰。女神的祭司与信众披着温暖的皮裘与粗布家衣，来到桌旁共享一顿由本地食物与葡萄酒组成的公餐。
On a farm field by a proud house with immaculate outbuildings stands an arbor of vines and flowers, sheltering a large outdoor dining table. A batch of crop offerings, trinkets, and letters are arranged down the table’s center. On an autumn feast day a cheerful little fire of native wood burns just outside the arbor. Priests and patrons of the goddess, in warm furs and homespun, visit the table for a communal dinner of local food and wine.

Face Carved Into Mountainside.name:
雕刻在山体峭壁上的巨脸
Face Carved Into Mountainside

Text.text:
这件作品手法粗朴，却比例精准；寥寥线条勾出一张威严的面容，想必曾在某个时代激励过周遭所有人。光是想象它耗费的岁月便令人心生畏惧——无论工匠是受灵感驱使的艺术家，还是被压迫的奴隶。这张脸与环抱它的活岩同色，悬在离地数百英尺的高空，越过地表的弧度远眺，仿佛望向它那巨灵般的故乡世界。
The work is primitive, but the proportions are right, the lines indicating a majesty to the face that must have inspired everyone nearby at one point. The time it must have taken is daunting to consider, whether the workers were inspired artists or downtrodden slaves. The face is the color of the living rock that surrounds it, suspended hundreds of feet above the ground, looking across the curvature of the earth as if to its titanic home world.

I Cast Arcanist’s Magic Aura.name:
我施放《奥术师的魔法灵光》
I Cast Arcanist’s Magic Aura

Text.text:
咒文机巧狡黠，暗藏弦外之音与暧昧歧义，我隔着贴在唇边的一小方丝绢低声诵出。我放开这道附魔，任它渗入朋友的肌肤，在占卜与预言的窥探前施展欺诈。我几乎压不住嘴角的笑意，计划已然孵化：一层又一层的误导灵光裹上去，我的朋友将以魔法反间的身份活下去。
The incantation is clever, sly, full of innuendo and ambiguity, recited through a little square of silk held to my lips. I let the enchantment go, allow it to permeate the skin of my friend and work its deceit against scrying and divination. I barely contain a smile as my plan hatches: with one aura of misinformation after another, my friend will live as a magical counterspy.

货车里不载货物，只有一名乘客。这辆车以厚重木料打造，并以黑铁加固，顶上还加装钢条；在一匹魁梧巨马的牵引下，沉闷地隆隆前行。移动囚室的门紧锁着；你从缝隙里看见里面那名囚犯佝偻下垂的身影。究竟是什么生物，才需要如此严密的押运？
The wagon carries no goods, and only one passenger. Built of heavy wood reinforced with black iron, and topped with steel bars, the wagon rumbles along, pulled by a massive horse. The door to the mobile prison cell is locked; inside you see the slouched form of its occupant. What creature would necessitate such secure transport?

Arrival In Welcoming Village.name:
抵达好客村
Arrival In Welcoming Village

Text.text:
夕阳将天空染成猩红，你终于触及村庄。人们彼此道着晚安，结束了一天辛苦的劳作后匆匆赶回家。旅店点起灯笼，浓郁的饭菜香扑面而来。你带着疲惫的笑意朝酒馆走去，任由那份迎人的暖意将你包裹。
With the sunset painting the sky crimson, you finally reach the village as folk bid each other good evening and scurry home after a hard day's toil. The inn lights its lanterns and the heady smell of cooking wafts over you. With a weary grin you make for the tavern, embracing the welcoming aura the place gives off.

阴影在那生物周身弯折扭曲，旋成一圈翻涌的黑暗光冕。透过朦胧迷雾，你隐约看见巨大的蝠翼，以及细长尖削的四肢，末端是锋利而恶毒的钩爪。那生物从它的不幸受害者身上抬起头——缕缕轻纱般的灵魂碎屑自它的颚间滴落——随即以发光的黄色眼睛锁定你。那目光散发着刺骨的恶意与无尽、近乎癫狂的饥渴。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Shadows bend and warp around the creature in a swirling corona of darkness. Through the haze you can make out large, bat-like wings and thin, pointed limbs that end in wicked claws. The creature looks up from its unfortunate victim—fragments of wispy soul-matter dripping from its jaws—and fixes glowing yellow eyes upon you. They radiate cold malice and endless, apoplectic hunger.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Cloud Giant Encounter.name:
云巨人遭遇
Cloud Giant Encounter

Text.text:
灰肤泰坦落地的刹那，大地震颤。天蓝色的眼眸打量着你脆弱的身形，他们咯咯发笑——那笑意轰鸣，宛如骤起的雷霆。他们蹲下身来，巨膝咔嚓作响，像折断的树木；嗅着空气，隧道般巨大的鼻孔张开翕动。被穿刺的嘴唇呢喃着秘奥之语，能量在你身上蜿蜒爬行，法术搜寻着一切神秘与魔法的痕迹。
The ground trembles as the gray-skinned titan lands. Sky-blue eyes ponder your frail form, and they chuckle—their mirth rumbling like sudden thunder. They squat down, huge knees cracking like snapping trees, and sniff the air, nostrils as big as tunnels flaring. Pierced lips mouth dweomer, and energies crawl over you as the spell seeks all that is mystical and magical.

I Use Fiendish Resilience.name:
我发动【魔鬼韧性】
I Use Fiendish Resilience

Text.text:
当我收拾行装准备离开时，我阖上双眼，想象着我预感不久将要面对的危险。我将一只手按在心口，在心眼所见的幻景中，我将这份凶险带来的痛楚硬生生承受三次。我稳住心脉不乱。我的意志使身躯坚固，抵御那被我预见之威胁所带来的伤害。
As I prepare to pack up and leave, I close my eyes and visualize a danger I predict I’ll face soon. I place one hand on my heart, and in my mind’s eye, I endure the pain of this peril three times. I keep my heart steady. My spirit fortifies my body against injury from the threat I envisioned.

天界使者披着雪白的石膏羽翼降临，怀抱一柄金色巨锤，锤长与她等身，重量却足足是她的两倍。她体内的圣光将皮肤、发丝与双眼都漂洗成惨白；连那件被翼风鼓得猎猎作响的托加长袍，也白得刺目。她携着一卷与巨锤等大的卷轴，将其展开，宛如正义的挂毯铺陈于世。她一旦诵读，天地便被她的嗓音震得轰鸣，你竭力侧耳，仿佛要听见天堂本身的回响。
The celestial descends on alabaster wings, carrying a golden hammer as long as her body and twice her weight. Her inner light has bleached her skin, hair, and eyes; even her toga, which flaps from the force of her wings, is white. She bears a scroll sized to match her hammer and unfurls it like the tapestry of justice. When she reads, the world booms with her voice as you strain your ears to hear heaven itself.

手杖深黑笔直，通体上漆，亮得像被夜色打磨过。铂金杖柄嵌着缟玛瑙与钻石，杖尖则以温润的琥珀封口，触之如抚平的蜜。确实美得夺目，可那份重心、分量，以及木材近乎不朽的韧性又在低声提醒你：它的用处，绝不止是正式场合里撑一撑体面。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The cane is dark and straight, lacquered to a beautiful shine. The platinum handle is ornamented with onyx and diamond, and the foot is capped in smooth amber. A beautiful thing, but something about the balance, weight, and nearly indestructible quality of the wood tells you that the cane is useful for more than simply supporting one’s weight on a formal occasion.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Loot From A Sandsea Aboleth Lair.name:
来自沙海底栖阿波雷斯巢穴的战利品
Loot From A Sandsea Aboleth Lair

Text.text:
在这处地下地穴里，空气干燥刺喉，你发现许多类人生物的尸体半埋在沙中。每一张干枯的面孔都扭曲成一种独特的恐惧性相。尽管它夺走了无数生命，鲍洛斯却并未洗劫尸身——它真正的战利品，是眼前这些人短暂而易逝的理智。你找到不少钱币，以及几支药剂小瓶，瓶中内容在凉爽的沙子里得以保存。你还发现一把银制弯刀，弧形刀身上刻着流畅的纹路，仿佛沙漠中起伏滚动的沙丘。
In the dry, choking air of this underground burrow, you find many humanoid corpses half-buried in the sand. Each desiccating face is twisted in a unique aspect of horror. For all its victims, the aboleth did not loot the corpses—its prize instead the fleeting sanity of the individuals arrayed here. You find plenty of coin and a few potion vials with contents preserved by the cool sand. You also find a scimitar of silver, the curved blade etched with smooth lines mimicking the rolling dunes of the desert.

此处潜伏着一名德鲁伊——自然隐秘奥秘的采撷者——如微小疆域的神祇般号令成群虫潮。披覆林野之衣，他们编织生命谜团的灵性之舞，召来嗡鸣风暴与翻涌如毯的爬行死潮。
Here lurks a druid, a gatherer of nature's hidden secrets, commanding swarms of insects like a deity of the tiny realm. Cloaked in nature, they weave the spiritual dance of life's enigmas, summoning humming storms and seething carpets of crawling death.

钢制啤酒杯里盛着一种深色、浓汤般的麦酒，酒体稠厚、满是啤酒花的苦香，隐隐还带着肉豆蔻的气息——一杯真正的酒，由兽人为兽人酿造。只要嗅上一口，你就会飘飘然；哪怕只灌下一大口，也足以让你的木筏在浪尖上颠簸摇晃，可它却偏偏按品脱上桌。无论你是人类还是精灵，都要小心：混乱往往先找上你，常常才过一轮就开始发作。

~ 由一位英雄构想

In the steel tankard is a dark and soupy ale, thick with hops and smelling faintly of nutmeg—a real drink, made by orcs for orcs. A whiff makes you heady, and even one slug sets your raft on the waves, yet it’s served by the pint. Be you human or elf, beware: confusion tends to take you first, often after just one round.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Tiefling Necromancer With Flaming Rapier.name:
持焰细剑的提夫林死灵法师
Tiefling Necromancer With Flaming Rapier

Text.text:
如同活着的阴影，死灵法师的乌黑护甲将他们包裹其中，黑色皮革涂油打亮，泛着冷光。讥诮的笑意在唇边游走，他们抽出一柄纤巧的细剑——一声令下，剑身骤然迸起噼啪作响的烈焰。黑暗缠身，地狱之火把那副恶魔般的轮廓投进摇曳的阴影里，这名提夫林仿佛恐惧本身的化身。

~ 由 Discord 上的 A Hero Envisioned 于 Discord

Like living shadow, the necromancer's ebon armor envelopes them, the black leather oiled to a sheen. A smirk slithers across their lips as they draw a delicate rapier—which bursts into crackling flame on command. Wreathed in darkness, hellish fire casting their devilish features in flickering shadow, the tiefling embodies fear itself.

~ Envisioned by A Hero on Discord

Prayer Of Healing.name:
治疗祷言
Prayer Of Healing

Text.text:
你向苍天恳求怜悯与援助，让目光停驻在你想要拯救的每一位身上所承受的创伤之上。你的信仰随即得到了回响——他们长长地叹出一口气，伤口自行合拢，淤青逐渐消退，断骨重新接续，流血也被止住。
You plead with the heavens for mercy and aid, letting your eyes rest upon the wounds suffered by each of those you wish to save. And your faith is rewarded by their sighs, as cuts close, bruises lighten, bones knit, and blood is staunched.

I Cast False Life With Alcohol.name:
我借酒施放「虚假生命」
I Cast False Life With Alcohol

Text.text:
烈酒的辛辣灵性灼烧着我，顺着喉咙滑下，逼得我眼眶发酸，刺痛得令人难受。我开始吟诵咒文，在空中编织亵渎的符号，感到魔法能量在体内鼓胀翻涌。仿佛野火蔓延般的灼热席卷全身，法术吞噬酒液，将虚假的生命灌注进我体内。
The potent spirits burn as they slide down my throat, causing my eyes to water uncomfortably. I begin the incantation, weaving profane symbols in the air, as I feel magical energy swell within me. A sensation like spreading wildfire burns through my body as the spell consumes the alcohol, imbuing me with false life.

Lumberjack's Shack.name:
伐木工的小屋
Lumberjack's Shack

Text.text:
工人的住处映照着工人本身。那些粗心又怨愤的人，搭起歪斜变形、屋顶漏雨的棚屋。他们挥斧干活，喝到昏睡，把成堆垃圾丢在门口。你不禁纳闷，这破棚子怎么还没塌。
Workers' homes reflect the workers themselves. The careless and bitter build warp-sided shacks with leaky roofs. They swing axes, drink to sleep, and leave piles of trash by the door. You wonder how this shack is still upright.

鱼形隐形无人机悄然穿行于浑浊深处，军规级传感器阵列来回扫掠，搜寻敌方行动。其一体化结构与微型推进系统使其能够迅捷且无迹潜入，为战斗小组带来无价情报；高分辨率摄像头清晰捕捉敌人动向的影像，辅助制定战略决策。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The fish-shaped stealth drone steals through the murky depths, its military-grade sensor array sweeping for enemy activity. An integrated design and micro propulsion system allows for quick and undetectable insertion, providing invaluable intelligence to the combat group as high-res cams capture clear footage of the enemy's movements, aiding strategic decision-making.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

今夜的天空不一样。你调了调望远镜的镜头，凝视那无垠的深空。是宇宙某位神明之手重新排列了群星？还是从前你只是看得不够认真？不管怎样，这群带着预兆的星辰如今如水晶般澄澈闪耀。
The sky is different tonight. You adjust the lens on your telescope, peering into the great expanse. Have the stars been rearranged by some divine act of the cosmos? Or were you just not looking hard enough, previously? Regardless, this portentous assembly of stars now shines as clear as crystal.

Gargoyle, Knight Of The Order.name:
石像鬼，骑士团之骑士
Gargoyle, Knight Of The Order

Text.text:
一个身影从黑暗中渗出，仿佛披着阴翳的剪影。随着他踏入苍白的微光，那武者的轮廓愈发清晰——高大、肩背宽阔，迈步逼近，一套黑色板甲裹覆着他的血肉；护甲的全身装束上镌着如液态银般流淌的纹路。身后一件破碎的斗篷，色如午夜天穹，在风中扭动，几乎像活物一般。整齐修剪的山羊胡之上，他的脸定格着轻蔑的神色。那双蓝眼锐利而专注，刺穿夜色，搜寻着什么。他左臂系着一面鸢形盾，盾面跃动着超自然的神秘气息。戴着铁手套的手紧攥一柄怪异的叉刃长剑，剑身爬满秘奥符文，奥术雾霜覆在刃上。他像老兵筹划下一场战役般，审视着这片区域。

~ Played by CelticNinja

A figure bleeds from the darkness, a silhouette cloaked in gloom. As he steps into the wan light, his martial form becomes clear. Tall and broad-shouldered, he strides forward, a suit of black plate armor sheathing his flesh. Its panoply is etched with liquid silver. A tattered cloak, the color of a midnight sky, writhes at his back, almost alive in the wind. His face is painted with a fixed look of scorn above a neatly trimmed goatee. Blue eyes, sharp and focused, pierce the night, seeking. A kite shield dancing with supernatural mystique is strapped to his left arm. His gauntleted hand clutches a strange, forked sword, its blade crawling with esoteric runes and with arcane mist frosting its blade. He surveys the area like a veteran planning his next campaign.

~ Played by CelticNinja

Monk Contemplating Tranquility.name:
沉思宁静的武僧
Monk Contemplating Tranquility

Text.text:
若和平是暴力的对立面，那么当你置身暴力之中，就安住于和平。暴力也许会选择绕开你。若它不肯，那么它便会按你的条件降临——只剩一抹自惭形秽的影子，并懊悔自己当初没有更明智。你冥想，然后入睡；当残酷闯入你的视野，你看它更像是不幸的干扰，而非骇人的威胁。
If peace is the opposite of violence, then when you are in the midst of violence, be at peace. The violence may choose to avoid you. If it doesn’t, then the violence will arrive on your terms, a shadow of itself, and wish it had chosen more wisely. You meditate, then you sleep, and when brutality arrives in your field of vision, you see it as more of an unfortunate distraction than a horrible threat.

Stimulant Street Drug, Kali-10: Ingested.name:
兴奋剂街头毒品「Kali-10」：口服
Stimulant Street Drug, Kali-10: Ingested

Text.text: 苦药难以下咽；它仿佛逮着机会就卡在你喉头。你感觉它终于滑过咽喉，却在胸口半途停住。炽热自心脏猛然涌出，像一条火舌甩击而出，沿着你的躯干舔舐而过。你的视野被血红染透，血液在耳中擂鼓般轰鸣。你闻到焦肉的气味，竟莫名觉得饥饿。你垂涎的嘴大张着，舌头无力地耷拉出来，而一个声音——你自己的——在脑海里如神祇般轰然咆哮：“血。血。血！” The bitter pill doesn’t go down easy; it seems to catch in your throat at every opportunity. You feel it finally slide down your gullet until it stops halfway in your chest. A surge of heat floods from your heart, like a tongue of fire has whipped out and lapped across your torso. Your vision goes red as blood hammers in your ears. You smell burning meat and inexplicably get hungry. Your tongue lolls out of your slavering mouth as a voice—your own—thunders like a god’s in your head: “BLOOD. BLOOD. BLOOD!”

Goddess Of Forests.name:
森林女神
Goddess Of Forests

Text.text:
她是未经雕琢的美：肌肉紧绷，压迫感十足。既新生又古老，她的肌肤比树皮更坚韧，却也更柔软。她的发如落叶树，随四季变换色泽；她的气息却常青，带着甜润的树脂香。她能在针叶与阔叶间低语出夏日微风的安宁，也能如红杉倾覆般轰鸣。她沉着而谨慎，从深根投下的阴影到日光轻抚的最高叶尖，她都熟知这个世界。
She is raw beauty, tightly muscled and thoroughly intimidating. Budding and ancient, her skin is tougher but softer than bark. Although her hair is deciduous, changing color with the seasons, her scent is evergreen and sweet sap. She can whisper the calm of a summer breeze through needle and leaf or boom like the fall of a redwood. Deliberate and careful, she knows the world from the shade on its deep roots to the sun caressing its highest leaves.

Open Portal In A Building.name:
在建筑内开启传送门
Open Portal In A Building

Text.text:
传送门噼啪作响，仿佛闪电迸裂；它低鸣着，与那摇曳旋卷的奥秘光辉同拍共振，声波在空气里一圈圈回荡。这里在室内，传送门几乎吞没了你的视野，霸占整间屋子；若无人照看，仿佛下一刻就要把房间本身一并吞下。一把椅子在地板上吱呀滑行，随即被那旋动的涡流拖拽而去，像是受某种异界重力牵引，瞬间没入其中。你看见门内有影影绰绰的形状，有人形在其中游走——而一缕如同耳语的声息从另一侧飘来，轻轻勾引，召唤着你。
The portal crackles with something akin to lightning, humming with a rhythm that reverberates in time to the swirls of wavering, arcane light. Here, indoors, the portal dominates the room, threatening to swallow the room itself if left untended. A chair slides across the floor and disappears into the swirling vortex, yanked by an otherworldly gravity. You see shapes within the portal, figures moving about—and something like a whisper reaches your ears from the other side, beckoning.

你甚至还没意识到发生了什么，那条狗就已低声咆哮起来，背脊的毛根根竖起，大片带泡的唾沫从它的嘴角涌出，滴落在地。你不必是德鲁伊也能看出它眼中的疯狂——这可怜的畜生被疫病烧得发烫，在狂犬般的谵妄中危险无比。
The dog begins growling before you are even aware of it, hackles raised, great foaming flecks of saliva pouring down its jowls to the ground. You do not need to be a druid to see the madness evident in its eyes, the poor animal fevered with disease, dangerous in its rabid delirium.

Silver Dragon Wyrmling.name:
银龙雏龙
Silver Dragon Wyrmling

Text.text:
新雨的清冽气息伴随着这头龙裔生物的现身。它姿态如雕像般挺立，巨兽在远处以锐利而狡黠的目光守夜着你。一道令人震撼的颈褶自额头延展至尾尖，而贴伏在身侧的双翼末端生着利爪。它的鳞片如抛光银辉般闪耀，在阳光下流转光芒；每一次移动都带着一种诡异而迷人的优雅。
The smell of fresh rain accompanies the presence of this draconic creature. Statuesque in its posture, the beast watches you from a distance with eyes sharp and cunning. An impressive frill extends from its forehead down to the tip of its tail, while the wings tucked against its body end in talons. Its scales, a shade of polished silver, catch the light of the sun as it moves with a strange and alluring grace.

City Barricaded Against Giants.name:
巨人来袭，城市紧闭堡垒般的路障
City Barricaded Against Giants

Text.text:
一条河流将一座蔓延铺展的城市一分为二，城市被厚重的石墙环抱。桥梁横跨河面，连接聚落截然不同的两半；中央一座阴影压城的钟楼耸立，指示着城市广场的位置。烟雾从烟囱里懒散飘出，而这座城市那股甜腻得令人作呕的气味——人类粪秽、堆积的垃圾、未洗的躯体——在你靠近栅栏门时便迎面扑来。许多身影在城垛上巡逻，弩机挎肩，却随时可抬起；在这道高耸壁垒的每个角落，一架弩炮都蓄势待发。城门以铁箍加固，显然不是为了抵御区区人类军队。你注意到弩炮箭矢的体型、城卫手中巨大的倒刺长矛、城墙令人震撼的厚度。不，这座城市设下壁垒，是为了对抗巨人。

~ Envisioned by Arastin

A river bisects a sprawling city encircled by walls of thick stone. Bridges span the river, connecting the settlement’s two distinct halves, with a looming belltower at its center marking the city plaza. Smoke wafts lazily from chimneys, and the sickly-sweet aroma of the city—human waste, piled refuse, unwashed bodies—finds you as you near the barred gates. Many figures patrol the parapets, crossbows shouldered but ready at a moment’s notice; at each corner of the soaring barricade, a ballista waits at the ready. The gates, reinforced with iron bands, are not intended to withstand a mere human army. You note the size of the ballista bolts, the massive barbed spears wielded by the city’s guards, the astounding thickness of its walls. No, this city is barricaded against giants.

~ Envisioned by Arastin

Insult From A Waitress.name:
来自女侍的羞辱
Insult From A Waitress

Text.text:
“你都在这儿坐了一个小时了……还没点单。怎么，非得你妈你爸进来帮你一把？”
"You have been here for an hour… and still haven't ordered. Maybe you need your ma or pa to come in and help?"

Shadow Plane Seeps Into The Faerie Plane.name:
暗影位面渗入妖精位面
Shadow Plane Seeps Into The Faerie Plane

Text.text:
你周围的光线暗了下去，摇曳不定。一阵刺骨的冷风骤起，肆意卷起落叶抛向空中。自那黑暗的传送门中，一团阴影浮现；起初无形无状，转瞬便凝成一颗骷髅，眼窝深处燃着黯而毒烈的光。骷髅下颌大张，从中喷涌出尘埃与黑暗，如墨汁般在大地上流淌蔓延。花朵在它的接触下立刻枯萎凋亡。
The light dims around you, wavering. A frigid breeze kicks up, tossing leaves into the air with abandon. From the dark portal, a shadow emerges; amorphous at first, it quickly takes the shape of a skull with dark, virulent light burning in the hollows of its eyes. The skull's jaw gapes open, and from it issues dust and darkness, which runs like ink across the landscape. Flowers instantly wither and die from its touch.

Dungeon: Spiral Staircase Leading Down.name:
地城：通往下方的螺旋阶梯
Dungeon: Spiral Staircase Leading Down

Text.text:
穿过门后，是一段向下延伸的楼梯，绕着一间圆形房间的中心盘旋而下。台阶陡峭，逼得你不得不放慢脚步，小心翼翼地前行；你最初的几步声响在地城深处回荡不绝。你很难判断这条阶梯究竟通往多深的地下。
Through the door is a set of stairs leading down, twisting around the center of a circular room. The steepness of the steps encourages a cautious pace, and your first few steps echo far into the dungeon. It’s difficult to tell just how deep the staircase descends.

一个不起眼的皮袋滚落到地上，在你脚边倾倒出它的内容物：宝石。炫目的红宝石、耀眼的蓝宝石与莹润的绿宝石——每一颗都经过切割与抛光，闪耀着晶莹光泽——从袋口倾泻而出，叮当滚落，宛如一阵闪烁的宝石雨。
An unassuming leather bag tumbles to the ground and spills its contents at your feet: gems. Dazzling rubies, radiant sapphires, and lustrous emeralds—each cut and polished to a sparkling luster—tumble from the bag in a twinkling cascade.

Aura Of Purity.name:
纯净灵光
Aura Of Purity

Text.text:
你吟诵出正确的咒句。空气无声震颤，迸出一缕缕柔和发亮的白光丝线，自你身上向四面八方延展。宛若将成未成的闪电，这些光丝织成球形灵光，随你而动，穿过你，也穿过他人。带电的氛围为肉体与心神注入坚韧。
You intone the proper phrases. The air silently vibrates with threads of white light—softly luminous—that spring from you in all directions. Like lightning barely manifested, these strings form a spherical aura, moving through and with you, and through others. The charged atmosphere imparts fortitude in body and mind.

I Use Stillness Of Mind.name:
我施展「心如止水」
I Use Stillness Of Mind

Text.text:
几乎要被淹没之际，我停下脚步，将心神向内收拢，缓缓吸气，感受自己的核心被自我意识充盈。随后，我呼出一口气。我将注意力凝聚在那些威胁心智的情绪上。随着呼气，异样的感受被一并带出。它们如潮水般掠过我、流出我，只在身后留下宁静。
Almost overwhelmed, I stop and turn my mind inward, breathing in slowly and feeling my center fill with my sense of self. Then, I breathe out. I focus on the emotions that threaten my mind. My exhalation carries foreign feelings with it. They wash over and out of me, leaving only serenity behind.

Orbital Weather Station: Control Center.name:
轨道天气站：控制中心
Orbital Weather Station: Control Center

Text.text:
轨道天气站的气象仪器源源不断地将数据洪流注入房间四周的大型屏幕。翻涌的云带、游走的气流与温度图像在监视器上缓缓漂移，带着几分摄人心魄的魔力，精准复刻着数百英里之下那片狂暴多变的天气。地形图随之不断推移变幻，行星表面的风云演进在其上铺陈展开，潜在的危险被高亮标注，跃然于显示之中。
The meteorological instruments of the orbital weather station feed a constant stream of data onto large screens placed around the room. The images of swirling cloud banks, air currents, and temperatures are subtly mesmerizing as they drift across the monitors, perfectly mimicking the tempestuous conditions hundreds of miles below. Topographical maps shift and change as the weather on the planet’s surface plays out, highlighting potential dangers on the display.

Debate Between A Green Witch And A Techn.name:
绿巫与技法师的辩论
Debate Between A Green Witch And A Technomancer

Text.text:
你的躯体正从骨头上腐烂剥落，皮肤与组织一片片滑落，仍在徒劳挣扎求生。你靠着恶臭的混合药剂与台面把戏苟延残喘，而我能给你的远不止这些——让你摆脱血肉的弱点，在机械的不朽里获得纯净的永生与自由。 “哦，是啊，你的零件确实闪闪发亮，但我宁愿让这副腐朽的老骨头待在它该待的地方。告诉我，你把多少颗心换成了钢？因为在那些闪烁的灯光和废铁底下，我觉得我闻到了一丝恐惧。你并没有从死亡中解脱。你砍掉四肢、舍弃器官，只是想躲开它罢了。可我和死亡是老朋友。也许我能替你美言几句……当然，得付个价格。”

~ 由一位英雄设想

Your body rots off your bones, skin and tissue sloughing away as it struggles to stay alive. You rely on foul mixtures and parlor tricks when I can offer you so much more. Freedom from the weakness of your flesh and purity in the immortality of the machine. “Oh yes, your parts are all very shiny, but I’d rather leave these rotten old bones where they are. Tell me, how much of your heart have you replaced with steel? Because under all those blinking lights and scrap, I think I smell a pinch of fear. You’re not free from death. You’ve hacked off your limbs and forsaken your organs hoping to hide from it. But me and death are old friends. Perhaps I could put in a good word… for a price.”

~ Envisioned by a Hero

一股麝香般浓重的霉湿腥气，伴着利爪轻轻叩击石面的细碎声响，先于那头野兽而至——体型与轮廓大致近似人形。它的背脊凶狠地弓起，肮脏破烂的袍角间，几撮油腻的毛簇钻了出来。细长的骨指末端长着锋利的倒钩利爪，不受控制地剧烈抽动。它的脖颈粗壮隆起，紧绷的肌肉与突出的青筋一并鼓胀。细长的下颌向前延伸成吻部。它佝偻着贴近地面嗅闻——头颅左右急促甩动，细小的眼珠一片忙乱——而那对宽大的长椭圆耳朵，末端柔软成尖，随周遭任何一点声响猛地一抖。它嘴里伸出一条黏滑的舌头，涎液淋漓，露出两枚夸张肥大的门齿，旁侧还列着一排排尖锐的牙齿。
A musky, dank scent, and the soft click of claws on stone, precede the beast—roughly humanoid in size and shape. Its back is harshly arched, and tufts of greasy fur escape the corners of its grimy, torn robes. Long bony fingers end in sharp hooked claws that twitch violently. Its neck is thick, bulging with taut muscles and prominent veins. A long narrow jaw extends into a snout. It stoops to the ground, sniffing—head darting from side to side, beady eyes a whirl of movement—and large oblong ears that end in soft points jerk toward any sound in the vicinity. A slimy tongue drenched in drool protrudes from its mouth, revealing two oversized incisors flanked by rows of pointed teeth.

Cultist Corpse.name:
邪教徒的尸体
Cultist Corpse

Text.text:
披袍之人佝偻伏在一本染血的巨著上，双手如利爪般痉挛，死死扣住书脊。猩红自他们的衣袍深处绽开，沿着粗糙的布料漫染，将其涂成血一般的暗色。阴影重重的兜帽下，一张脸因凡人的恐惧而扭曲，在生命终末的惊骇中凝固不动。
The robed figure lies hunched over a blood-stained tome, their hands set in a clawed rictus around the book. Crimson blooms from within their vestments, painting the rough fabric a sanguine hue. Beneath a shadowy hood a face is contorted with mortal terror, frozen in the horror of their final moments.

当你伸手去拿那件物品时，它猛然裂开成一张巨口，森森颚骨张合，直欲将你的整条手臂一口吞下。一个模仿你心中所求之物的变形怪猝然袭来——在你之前，已有无数冒险者也曾这样中招。
As you reach for the item it splits into an enormous mouth, its jaws seeking to devour your arm whole. A shape-changer emulating your desired item has surprised you, as it has many adventurers before you.

这座公园坐落在威克河东岸与一段陡峭的堤坡之间，堤坡一路向上延伸至镇上。穿过绿地的小径视野开阔，可将群岛尽收眼底，也能看见其间动物的行动与动静。管理员小屋与自然中心依偎在一片小树林里；受伤的动物在此疗养复健，走失的宠物也会被暂时收容，直到主人找回它们。
This park rests between the east bank of the Wick and a steep embankment sloping up to the town. The walkway through the Green provides a good view of the islands and the animal activity among them. A caretaker and nature center is nestled a small grove of trees, where wounded animals are rehabilitated and lost pets are taken in until their owners find them.

两具构装体巍然矗立，躯壳由金属碎片与废铁胡乱拼接而成——其间还嵌着暗红鳞片，银辉如流光般纵横其上。那些覆鳞的部位噼啪作响、粼粼闪烁，燃着耀眼的魔法炽热；血红能量的脉络在其间鼓动，仿佛惊惶的心跳。火舌从不相称的肢体缝隙间舔出，镀甲的胸腔深处传来永不停歇、翻涌不息的烈焰咆哮声。它们的轮廓大体仍似人形，除了那骇人的魁伟身量，以及头顶盘旋而上的两道龙角之冠。

~ 由 Joe 构想

Two constructs stand tall, a jumble of metallic shards and junk—as well as dark red scales streaked with brilliant silver. These scaled sections crackle and shimmer with bright magical heat, veins of blood-red energy throbbing like a harried heartbeat. Tongues of flame flick out of the gaps between the mismatched body-parts, and the sound of an unceasing, roiling fire comes from within their plated chests. Their shape is mostly humanoid, aside from their grand stature and two coils of draconic horns atop their heads.

~ Envisioned by Joe

紫色闪电从矮人伸出的双手间愤怒噼啪炸裂，将一切照得冷厉而刺目的紫罗兰色。他的皮肤如被遗忘的墓碑般苍白灰冷，双眼盛满炽灼的狂怒，迸射出耀光；他扭转魔法，以意志将其强行锻成毁灭性的电弧霹雳。
Purple lightning crackles angrily from the dwarf’s outstretched hands, illuminating everything in a stark, violet hue. His skin is the pallid gray of a forgotten tombstone, and eyes filled with incandescent rage erupt with light as he twists the magic to his will, forcing it into devastating bolts.

Subterranean Cavern With Crystal Deposit.name:
布满晶簇矿脉的地下洞窟
Subterranean Cavern With Crystal Deposits

Text.text:
洞窟在你视线之外无尽延展，岩壁如要塞般拔地而起，高耸数百尺。若非无数水晶矿脉遍布这片洞穴空间的地面、岩壁与穹顶，散发出柔和微光，此处的黑暗本将彻底吞没一切。它们闪烁着紫罗兰、青绿、鎏金，以及介于其间的万千色彩，将摇曳的光芒洒在板岩灰的石面上。
The cavern sprawls beyond your sight, with walls like a fortress soaring upward hundreds of feet. The darkness would be absolute were it not for the soft glow emanating from myriad crystal deposits riddling the floors, wall, and ceiling of the cavernous space. They glimmer, violet, turquoise, gold, and every color in between, casting their wavering light across the slate gray stone.

这卷涂油布也可当作烹饪围裙使用。裹在其中的有一只锡碗和锡盘、一口小铁锅与平底煎锅、一块小砧板，以及一套研钵与杵。围裙的口袋里收着几把带鞘的小刀、一把剁刀、一只长柄勺、一把锅铲、一支硬毛刷、若干形制与材料各异的汤匙，还有一把厨房剪。围裙上还系着一把磨刀锉。
This roll of oiled cloth doubles as a cooking apron. Wrapped in it are a tin bowl and plate, a small iron pot and skillet, a little cutting board, and a mortar and pestle. Its pockets store a few knives in sheathes, a cleaver, a ladle, a turner, a bristle brush, spoons of several shapes and materials, and kitchen shears. Tied to the apron is a sharpening file.

Couatl Mating Ritual.name:
羽蛇神求偶仪式
Couatl Mating Ritual

Text.text:
蛇群苍白的翅翼舒展开来，尽情铺陈，乳光般的眼眸死死锁住彼此的凝视。分叉的舌信忽明忽暗，羽毛开始细微颤动，发出如疾风穿林般的沙沙声。它们以流畅的弧线向彼此游移，仿佛空中轻旋的缎带。它们镜像般重复对方的动作，直到近得足以相互缠绕。它们的吻端接触，一道魔法的微光在鳞片间起伏流淌，色彩从辽阔湖水般的深蓝绿，变作蛋壳般的灰白，又跃为坎图塔花般的明艳粉红。低低的呼噜自喉间溢出，翅翼再度阔幅振开，点点魔法火花从羽间迸闪。库阿特尔缓缓解开缠结，半分离间显露出——稳稳悬在它们之间的一枚巨卵，色泽与光泽宛如纯粹的祖母绿。

~ Envisioned by Jenzelta

The serpents’ pale wings stretch to full display as their opaline eyes lock in a stare. Forked tongues flicker as their feathers begin to jitter, creating a sound like the wind rushing through trees. They move toward each other in fluid bends, as ribbons twirl gently in the air. They mirror each other’s movements until they are close enough to entwine. Their snouts touch and a magical shimmer undulates across their scales, shifting colors from the deep blue-green of a vast lake to the off-white of egg shells to the brilliant pink of cantuta flowers. Purrs emit from their throats as their wings flutter wide again and motes of magic flash from between the feathers. The couatls unwind slowly, untangling halfway to reveal, poised between them, a great egg—the color and sheen of pure emerald.

~ Envisioned by Jenzelta

Meldy Of Wimbli.name:
温布利的梅尔迪
Meldy Of Wimbli

Text.text:
鲜红与浅紫的精致长袍——因一路旅行而染上风尘——比起她那逼人的目光，更像是为宫廷的优雅而生。她蓝色的眼睛在雪白如瓷的肌肤映衬下格外醒目。粉色直发垂到衣领处，尽管编起的发辫与镶宝石的发簪将大半头发高高固定。她昂然伫立，左手握着一柄华丽的三叉戟，仿佛那把武器只是一根修长的行杖。她随意扭动空着的手指，电光便在指间与三叉戟的戟刃之间迸射游走。

~ Played by Walt M. with

Fine robes in bright red and light purple—worn from travel—look more suited to courtly grace than this young woman’s intense gaze, her blue eyes standing out against her alabaster skin. Hair, pink and straight, hangs to her collar despite braids and jewel-adorned pins holding much of it up. She stands proud, holding an ornate trident in her left hand as if the weapon were a long walking staff. As she wiggles her free fingers, lightning coruscates among them and the trident’s tines.

~ Played by Walt M. with

The Boogeyman's Mask.name:
梦魇面具
The Boogeyman's Mask

Text.text:
这张面具的用途对任何看上一眼的人都再明白不过——用来灌注恐惧。些许残光将它的轮廓衬得更加狰狞：刀削般锋利的颧骨、本该是双眼的位置却是一片漆黑虚空，以及一束蓬乱的白发如鬃毛般垂落，越过肩头。
The function of this mask is abundantly clear to anyone who looks at it—to instill fear. What little light is present accentuates the mask’s features: razor-sharp cheekbones, a black void where eyes should be, and a mane of straggly white hair that extends past the shoulders.

这间高挑的房间有十面墙，除了你进来的那一面，其余都绘着壁画。壁画呈现出诡异的梦境般风景，满布着仿佛寓言化的地点、人物与器物；每一幅壁画的边缘都以贴金符文环绕。其间有一幅画着一座由士兵把守的城堡——他们手持两面盾牌——你由此得到了答案：每一面绘画的墙都代表一所魔法学派。那座城堡象征防护系。
The high-ceilinged room has ten walls, all but the one by which you entered painted with a mural. They present strange dreamlike landscapes filled with what must be allegorical places, figures, and objects; runes in golden leaf border each mural. One image features a castle manned by soldiers who carry two shields, and that gives you the answer. Each painted wall represents a school of magic. The castle is abjuration.

Tournament Thieves Intrigue.name:
锦标赛窃贼阴谋
Tournament Thieves Intrigue

Text.text:
风势渐起，裹挟着节庆的碎屑沿着一排五彩帐篷呼啸而过。突如其来的疾风猛地扯开一处帐篷门帘，短暂露出一群披着灰斗篷的人影，伤疤纵横的面孔阴沉冷硬。桌上摊着一叠叠羊皮纸，一把乌黑的匕首直刺其心脏。
The wind picks up, blowing festive debris down the line of multicolored tents. The sudden breeze tugs open a tent flap, briefly exposing a huddle of gray-cloaked folk, their scarred faces grim. Reams of parchment lie on a table, an ebon dagger thrust through their heart.

Campfire Under Outcrop In Rainstorm.name:
暴雨中的岩脊下营火
Campfire Under Outcrop In Rainstorm

Text.text:
一处干燥洁净的洞穴将钢铁般的雨幕隔在外头，旺盛的篝火在洞内燃烧，温暖而明亮。一缕细流从巨石旁、洞口前蜿蜒而过，沿着岩地淌行，映出雾霭缭绕的林海地平线的颜色；那地平线在白昼的云层掩蔽下延展无尽。
Sheltered from a steely rain by a dry and clean cave, a strong campfire burns warm and bright. A rivulet of water runs past the boulders and cave mouth and along the rock floor, reflecting the color of the misty, forested horizon that stretches under a daytime cloud cover.

呕吐般涌出的黑色墨烟中，那本书猛地自启，无形的微风拂乱风化的书页。凄厉的尖啸灌满空气，一只带爪的手从书中探出……宛如一具尸骸自坟冢中挣脱而起。

~ ChaseDerringer on Discord

Vomiting smoking, black ink, the book forces itself open, an invisible breeze ruffling the weathered pages. A keening howl fills the air as a clawed hand emerges from the book… like a cadaver freeing itself from a grave.

~ ChaseDerringer on Discord

这只造型古怪的袋子由柔软皮革制成。缝线的走向显示它先被缝合，随后又被翻转成里外倒置。敞口处装着一段上了清漆的木质喷嘴与木盖，木盖用皮绳系紧。携带用的背带穿过沿袋身缝线处的一串皮环固定。
Soft leather makes up this oddly shaped bag. The seams indicate it was sewn then turned inside out. At the open top, the bag is fitted with a lacquered wooden nozzle and cap. The latter tied on with a leather string. A carrying strap has been fitted through leather loops along the bag’s seam.

Port Town: Marketplace.name:
港口城：市集
Port Town: Marketplace

Text.text:
以一天中这个时段而言，集市显得异常热闹。缓慢流动的人潮在一排排摊位间蜿蜒穿行，穿过拱顶的市场大厅。仿佛世间万物皆可在此买卖，而为了争夺生意，想必竞争激烈——每个摊主都把货品摆得赏心悦目。
The market seems unusually busy, given the time of day. The slow-moving crowd of shoppers meanders around rows of market stalls, passing into and through a vaulted market hall. Anything and everything seems to be for sale, and competition for commerce must be fierce, as every seller has made a pleasing presentation of their wares.

Half Plate Armor.name:
半身板甲
Half Plate Armor

Text.text:
这套青铜护甲以贴合健壮体态的铸板守护胸膛、肩部、上臂与胫骨。胸甲上甚至刻出凹陷线条，仿佛腹肌分明，气势逼人。较大的甲片背面缀着光滑皮革，皮带以青铜扣具系紧，将护甲牢牢固定在身上。
This suit of bronze armor guards the chest, shoulders, upper arms, and shins with plate molded to fit an athletic form. The breastplate even has indented lines to suggest an impressive abdomen. Smooth leather is attached to the backs of the larger pieces, and leather straps with bronze buckles serve to affix them to the body.

Unfathomable Aberration Patron.name:
不可名状的异怪宗主
Unfathomable Aberration Patron

Text.text:
柔软、湿润而冰冷的东西以极致的轻柔滑过你的脸颊。相同的触感——悄然蔓延、温柔缠绕——沿着你的胸口爬行，绕过你的前臂，贴着你的腰际游走。你听见有人在呼唤，然而你能听懂的只有一个词：你的名字——你的嘴唇微微发麻，仿佛那些话是从你自己口中吐出的。你的胸腔发紧，肺叶灼烧，像你已经屏息了太久太久。你猛地睁开眼，看见一个被深绿幽色浸染的荒凉世界：残破的城市仍在崩塌，螺旋与分形交织而成的不可能结构拔地而起，以及通向虚无的高耸巨门。阴影自每个角落滋生，像霉菌任其腐烂般蔓延。就在你面前的空旷空间中，伴随着令人作呕的噗嗤黏响，千只眼睛鼓泡般凭空冒出。它们无睑，矩形的瞳孔齐齐钉在你身上。

~ Envisioned by Pockets

Something soft, wet and icy cold slides across your face with utmost gentleness. You feel a similar sensation—creeping and tender—along the length of your chest, around your forearms, and about your waist. You hear a voice calling, though the only word you understand is your own name—and your lips tingle as if the words left your own mouth. Your chest feels tight and your lungs burn, like you have been holding your breath for far too long. Your eyes shoot open to see a desolate world cast in a dark green hue: ruined cities still crumbling, impossible structures built in spirals and fractals, and looming gates leading nowhere. Shadows bloom out of every corner, like mold left to fester. Out of the empty space in front of you, a thousand eyes bubble into existence with sickening squelches. Lidless, their rectangular pupils all fix on you.

~ Envisioned by Pockets

Muscular Snakeblooded Humanoid.name:
肌肉虬结的蛇裔类人
Muscular Snakeblooded Humanoid

Text.text:
这名肌肉结实、身材高挑、肤色黝黑的女子神情冷峻。她那蓬松而粗硬的卷发盘成发髻，乍看乌黑，却隐隐透着深绿的光泽。你注意到她脸上大片覆盖着鳞片——色泽与肤色相近，却让她带上了爬行类般的轮廓；而她那黄绿的眼睛里，瞳孔细长如裂缝。
The  muscular, tall, dark-skinned woman wears a stern facial expression. Her bouncy, coarse curls, swept up in a bun, appear black at first glance—but seem to have a dark green hue as well. You notice scales over large parts of her face, and though they are similar in tone to her skin, they give her a reptilian resemblance, and her yellowish-green eyes have slits for pupils.

实用而量产——就像扛着它们的人一样——这些步枪常见于私人安保和企业警察手中。与公开市场上那些锈蚀、破损或陈旧的家伙不同，这些枪在交火中值得信赖，并配有从瞄准镜到可伸缩枪托等多种模块化选项。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Functional and mass-produced—like the people who carry them—these rifles are often found in the hands of private security personnel and corporate cops. Unlike the rusting, battered, or archaic weapons available on the open market, these guns can be relied on in a firefight and come with a variety of modular options from scopes to collapsible stocks.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Martian Jetpack.name:
火星喷气背包
Martian Jetpack

Text.text:
一具神秘的喷气背包在杂乱的舱室里幽然发亮；流线型的炭灰色金属吞噬着光线，却在内部脉动着诡异的蓝色辉芒。底座伸出数根弯曲的管束，末端镶着发光的球体，宛如巨型昆虫的颚钳。其表面布满雕刻，暗示着异族的来历——而其含义早已湮没于远古。

~ 由 Ian 构想

A mysterious jetpack gleams in the cluttered hab room; the sleek, charcoal-gray metal absorbs light but pulses with an eerie blue glow. Curved tubes tipped with glowing spheres jut from its base, like the mandibles of a giant insect. Engravings litter its surface, hinting at an alien origin—their meaning lost to antiquity.

~ Envisioned by Ian

Perfectly Ordinary-looking Awakened Tree.name:
看起来再普通不过的觉醒树
Perfectly Ordinary-looking Awakened Tree

Text.text:
你几乎是硬生生把一声惊呼咽了回去——附近一棵看似再普通不过的树忽然从大地里沉重地迈步而出，根系撕裂泥土挣脱束缚，张开如同人形的脚掌。尽管它的移动缓慢，粗壮的枝干却从树干上突兀伸出，仿佛只要你惹恼了它，就能挥出一记骇人的猛击，将人狠狠拍飞。
You barely manage to stifle a cry of alarm as a perfectly ordinary-looking tree nearby suddenly lumbers forth from the earth, its roots ripping free from the soil and splaying out like humanoid feet. Though its movement is slow, the large boughs jutting forth from its trunk look like they could deliver a terrific buffeting blow, should you get on its bad side.

Filthy Public Bathroom.name:
肮脏的公共厕所
Filthy Public Bathroom

Text.text: 可疑的黄色液体在瓷砖地面上积成一滩滩，整间厕所刺鼻的氨味直冲鼻腔。角落里，一台清洁机器人被掏空的残骸瘫着不动。三间脏兮兮的钢制隔间勉强还立着，门板半挂半垂。这里没有小便池；取而代之的是左墙边一条松动的铁槽，可里面塞满了包装纸和各种垃圾。右侧那面褪色的墙上，本该挂着镜子的地方，被人用粗劣的红漆涂写着：@Shiva 4 X, 079 RedLine。 Suspicious yellow liquid pools on the tiled floor and the bathroom reeks of ammonia. The gutted remains of a cleaning robot sits dormant in the corner. Three cruddy steel cubicles barely stand, their doors hanging off. There are no urinals; instead, a loose iron trough lines the left wall, but is packed with wrappers and other detritus. To the right, on the faded wall where mirrors would have hung, crude red graffiti reads: @Shiva 4 X, 079 RedLine.

Wandering Trinket Peddler.name:
游走的零碎小贩
Wandering Trinket Peddler

Text.text:
护符与奇物随着他沉重的步伐从背包上摇晃垂摆。一路伴着叮当作响的交响与一团浓烈、馥郁的熏香烟云，这个汗流浃背的男人踽踽前行。他用沾满污渍的袖口抹过眉间褪色的刺青，又从一只磨得发亮的随身酒壶里猛灌一口。他的大多数货物看起来一文不值，但其中一两件在午后的阳光下隐隐泛着微光，周围有股诡异的能量在游走盘旋。
Charms and curios swing from his pack with each lumbering step. A symphony of jingling and a cloud of heady, perfumed incense accompany the sweating man on his journey. He wipes a grubby sleeve across the faded tattoo on his brow then takes a swig from a well-worn hip flask. Most of his wares look worthless but one or two shimmer faintly in the afternoon sun, a strange energy playing about them.

Evil Crypt Hallway.name:
邪恶地穴走廊
Evil Crypt Hallway

Text.text:
天花板高高拱起，压着一条狭窄的走廊，宽肩之人走过时几乎会擦碰两侧。墙面沿途凿出三道浅浅的壁架，分别在脚踝、腰际与人类头颅的高度。壁架从粗粝的岩石中生生刻出，恰好容得下数十颗无颌的骷髅头，被整齐摆放着，彼此隔着走廊对视。
The ceiling arches high over a hallway narrow enough that broad shoulders might brush against its sides. Three shallow shelves run the length of the walls, at ankle, waist, and head height for a human. They are carved into the rough stone, providing enough space for dozens of jawless skulls arranged to stare across the hall at one another.

Solar Of A Creepy Manor.name:
诡宅的日光室
Solar Of A Creepy Manor

Text.text:
尽管这间小小的寝室里有人费心营造出松弛与温暖的舒适感，透窗而入的日光却显得刺目而非温润——它的照见是冷的，毫不留情。因为石地上有一片褪色的痕迹，无论怎样擦洗都洗不净；那团污渍也总让地毯无法久覆其上。纵然它已大幅淡去、也没有气味，你仍不会认错：那是怀着恶意泼洒的鲜血所留下的存在。
Though some effort has been made to create a feeling of relaxation and cozy comfort in this small chamber, the sunlight shining through the windows is stark rather than warm, cold in its revelations. For there is a faded patch of color on the stone floor that cannot be scrubbed clean, a splotch that rugs never stay on top of; and though it has no scent and has faded greatly, one cannot mistake the presence of blood spilled in a spirit of malice.

每一次皮匠锤的落点都伴随着尖锐而精准的轻敲声，将铆钉牢牢钉入，并娴熟地塑出这件耐用之物的轮廓。浓郁的油脂气息与厚实的皮革香沉沉滞留在空气里，又混着铁器那股锋利的金属腥味。屋外，生皮披挂在木架上，在日光下晾晒、鞣制，等待日后派上用场。
A sharp, precise tap accompanies each strike of the leatherworking hammer, driving home studs and expertly shaping the durable piece. The deep aroma of oils and rich leather hangs heavy in the air, accompanied by the sharp metallic tang of iron. Outside, rawhide drapes over wooden racks, drying and curing in the sun for later use.

Wilt And Wither.name:
枯萎与凋零
Wilt And Wither

Text.text:
你手里那小小一块海绵，如今看起来和其他的没什么两样，尤其是那些植物——干枯物质揉皱成一团的褶痕，曾经也鲜活得如同雨中起舞的人。
The little piece of sponge you hold looks just like all of them now, especially the plants—crumpled wrinkles of desiccated matter that were once as alive as dancers in the rain.

巨野猪发出如滚雷般的咆哮，蹄声在林地上轰然敲击，朝它自认为威胁到自身安危的目标猛冲而去。你努力不去想，那对夸张的獠牙以这样的速度撞上你的身体，会把你变成什么模样。
The giant boar makes a sound like rolling thunder as its hooves pound across the forest floor, charging after a perceived threat to its safety. You try not to think about what its oversized tusks would do to your body at that speed.

Loot From A Black Dragon's Lair.name:
黑龙巢穴的战利品
Loot From A Black Dragon's Lair

Text.text:
黑龙残酷的想象力甚至渗进了它的宝藏堆。某位受人敬仰的伟岸人物雕像矗立其间，石臂却被齐根斩落。一个做工繁复的金冠歪斜地扣在雕像额前，上面镶着一颗燃烧般的蓝白火钻，姿态毫不庄重。雕像脚下，一柄精致长剑躺在浅浅的酸池底，酸液咕嘟低鸣，剑身却似乎毫发无伤。
The black dragon’s cruel imagination pervades even its hoard of treasures. A larger-than-life statue of some honored figure stands with its stone arms lopped off. An elaborate crown of gold, inlaid with a fiery blue-white diamond, sits upon the statue’s brow at an unceremonious angle. At the statue’s feet, a fine sword lies at the bottom of a shallow pool of grumbling acid, seemingly unscathed.

I Drink My Potion Of Storm Giant Strengt.name:
我饮下风暴巨人力量药水
I Drink My Potion Of Storm Giant Strength

Text.text:
我一口喝下这瓶药水，感觉像猛灌了一口咸涩海水；其中那枚锯齿般的铁钉也随之打着漩儿滑入喉咙深处。一股能量在我体内翻涌奔流，狂乱如怒海风暴，我的肌肉被全新的、异样的力量灌满。我感觉自己像个泰坦——仿佛能把沉没的船只从海底深渊里硬生生抬起。
This potion feels like a swig of saltwater as I drink it, the jagged nail within whirlpooling down my gullet. An energy swills through my body, chaotic as a raging sea, and my muscles brim with new, alien vigor. I feel like a titan—like I could raise a sunken ship from the depths of the sea.

Nine Lives Stealer.name:
九命夺魂者
Nine Lives Stealer

Text.text:
这把乌黑长刃的金属暗得近乎吞噬四周的光，仿佛从那份明亮中汲取养分。你凑近细看那墨渍般的质地，竟难以移开目光——等你猛然回过神来，才发现转瞬之间已错过了好几次呼吸，而你的伙伴正困惑地盯着你。
The metal of this ebon blade is so dark that it almost seems to drink in the light around it, as if it draws nourishment from the brightness. Looking closely at its inky texture, you find it difficult to stop your examination—and once you snap out of it, you realize that several breaths have gone by in an instant and your companions are staring at you quizzically.

Os The Changeling.name:
奥斯·易形者
Os The Changeling

Text.text:
他修长纤细的手指轻轻、若有所思地贴在苍白的脸颊上，正好在遮住左眼的黑色眼罩下缘。雪白的皮肤配上冰蓝的头发，这生物看起来更像幽灵，而非凡人。确实，他面容的具体轮廓根本无法辨清——它们像被搅动的水面倒影般摇曳不定，随着他每一次抬头或转颈而时聚时散、忽清忽糊。你仿佛瞥见他唇边掠过一抹淡淡的讥笑，或是一条纤薄而沉思的线条——又或是严肃的阴沉怒容。至于武装，却清晰得不容错认：他宽阔的胸膛外覆着金属胸甲，腰间悬着一柄黑铁细剑。

~ Played by a Hero

His long, slender fingers cling softly, pensively, to his pale cheek, just under the black eyepatch covering his left eye. With his snow-white skin and ice-blue hair, this creature seems more specter than man. Indeed, the exact features of his face are impossible to discern. They wobble, like a reflection in agitated water, forming and fuzzing with each tilt or turn of his head. You think you catch a soft smirk on his lips, or a thin, pensive line—or a serious scowl. As for armaments, these are clear enough to see. He wears a metal breastplate over his broad chest and a black-iron rapier at his hip.

~ Played by a Hero

Quip By A Paladin About Enacting Violenc.name:
圣武士打算动武时的俏皮话
Quip By A Paladin About Enacting Violence

Text.text:
“有时候，神祇需要的不只是布道与温顺的祈祷。有时候，他们要求以暴烈而切实的方式显现其意志，去纠正这世界的苦难——这正是我登场的时候。”
“Sometimes the gods need more than sermons and meek prayer. Sometimes they demand a violent and material manifestation of their will to set right the woes of this world—that’s where I come in.”

Insult By A Noble About Attire.name:
贵族对衣着的羞辱
Insult By A Noble About Attire

Text.text:
“当我请求你的服务时，没想到你会穿着如此……田园风的装束现身。但先说清楚，我可不是什么趾高气扬的贵族。算我卖个人情，我会用最简短直白的话把任务交代清楚，好让你少丢点脸。”
“When I requested your services, I didn’t realize you’d show up wearing such… pastoral attire. But let it be known that I am not some stuck-up aristocrat. As a favor, I will outline my task quickly and in simple terms so we can spare you more embarrassment.”

铺石小巷在两侧探出的楼房之间延伸，绕过一处弯角。更宽的街道横贯其上，形成一片更见天光的空间，而阴暗、时常潮湿的窄巷则挤在商铺与民宅之间。几块色彩鲜明的招牌标示着屋内人的行当，但更多时候，你能依循古老的惯例看出商贩的营生——他们把活计摆到门槛上，或在敞开的窗边操作，好借自然光照。
The cobbled lane runs between overhanging buildings and around a bend. A larger street crosses it, providing a space more open to the sky, while dark and often dank alleys squeeze between the businesses and homes. A few colorful signs indicate the professions of those inside, but often you can tell a merchant’s business by the time-honored custom of work being done on the doorstep or by an open window to benefit from natural light.

Entering The Burial Floor.name:
踏入埋骨之地
Entering The Burial Floor

Text.text:
当楼梯走到尽头，腐朽与死亡的气味在滞重的空气里久久不散。入口旁放着一座早已熄灭的火盆，曾经用以迎客的光亮早已不复存在。如今仅剩的“欢迎”，是走廊更深处一具苍白的骷髅（特征）上，那颗裸露头骨咧开的森森齿笑。
The smell of death and decay hang in the stale air as the stairs come to an end. A long-depleted brazier sits near the entrance, no longer offering any kind of welcoming light. The only welcome remaining is the toothy grin of a bare skull sitting atop a pallid skeleton farther down the hall.

整条通道都被丝滑的白色蛛网塞满，繁复的网丝自地面至天花板、从一壁到另一壁纵横交错。碎屑、各式昆虫与小型生物一并被那亮泽的丝线悬吊其间，有些受害者仍在网中挣扎，试图逃离这座陷阱。
The entire passageway is filled with silky white webs, criss-crossing in intricate patterns from floor to ceiling and wall to wall. Debris, an assortment of insects, and small creatures hang suspended in the glossy strings alike, some victims still struggling to escape the trap.

三颗头颅——山羊、狮子与巨龙——自这生物肩头受诅咒的血肉中滋生而出，彼此争吵不休，宛如任性的孩童。野兽狮般的躯干渐变为山羊的后躯，嶙峋粗鳞沿着脊柱冒起，像沾满血污的痂皮。一对硕大的龙翼整齐地收拢在背上，却会随着龙首怒火攀升而愈发躁动。
Three heads—goat, lion, and dragon—sprout from the cursed flesh of the creature’s shoulders, the three squabbling like petulant children. The beast’s leonine body morphs into the hindquarters of a goat, and rough scales sprout along the spine like gore-encrusted scabs. A pair of sizeable draconic wings are folded neatly upon its back, but they become agitated as the draconic head becomes more irate.

一具人偶的剪影踏步而出，奉行主人之命。这是个为魔鬼差事而生、注定劳作的造物——黑钢的仿生人，以战栗而吱呀作响的步伐前行。它的肌肤起伏如波，暗藏的科技在皮下游走，猩红的回路燃着地狱般的能量。黄铜与硫磺铸成的双手——因劳役而僵硬——将邪秽矿石捏塑成精微的形状。
The silhouette of a mannequin steps forth to do its master’s bidding. This is a toiling thing doomed for devil’s work, an android of black steel moving in shuddering, creaky steps. Its skin ripples with hidden technologies, scarlet circuits glowing with infernal energy. Hands made of brass and brimstone—stiff with labor—mold fell ores into subtle shapes.

Indignant Dwarf Commoner.name:
愤怒的矮人平民
Indignant Dwarf Commoner

Text.text:
他那张脸红得像纠结成团的胡子，桶状胸膛的矮人迈着沉重步伐朝你走来，眉头紧锁，深如山谷裂缝。他穿着朴素干净的衣服，棕白的低调色调一如其人，腰间系着一条塞得满满的工具腰带。那双大手粗糙龟裂，满是老茧，像未经雕琢的岩石。

~ Played by Joorrekiin

With a face as red as his tangled beard, the barrel-chested dwarf marches up to you, brow furrowed like a mountain canyon. He wears simple, clean clothing in muted tones of brown and white, accessorized with a well-stocked toolbelt. His large hands are rough and calloused like unworked stone.

~ Played by Joorrekiin

Wild Magic Surge: Sorcerous Recovery.name:
狂野魔法涌动：术法复苏
Wild Magic Surge: Sorcerous Recovery

Text.text:
一缕细小的魔法丝线从你法术的边缘轻轻颤动飘出，落在你身上。你将其吸收，感到一阵微弱的奥术能量涌动——足以让你在今日结束前额外施放一次法术。
A small thread of magic flutters from the edge of your spell and lights upon you. You absorb it and feel a tiny surge of arcane energy, enough to let you cast an extra spell before the day is out.

Sundries From A Goblin.name:
地精的杂货
Sundries From A Goblin

Text.text:
地精那条朴素的皮腰带上结着一层细碎的节日挂饰，像结痂般黏住不放。某个异域宫廷的手帕裹着一小撮兔子粪球，上面涂着稚拙的地精脸谱，童真得令人发毛。皮制信封里则塞着一套脏兮兮的小型油画工具。
The goblin's plain leather belt is crusted with tiny holiday ornaments. Wrapped in a handkerchief from some foreign court or another is a cluster of rabbit pellets painted with childlike goblin faces. In a leather envelope is a grubby little oil painting kit.

Cemetery Statues In Winter.name:
冬日墓园雕像
Cemetery Statues In Winter

Text.text:
[初次造访] 两尊兜帽人像矗立在山坡上一段覆雪阶梯的尽头。它们并肩朝向山顶的墓群，双手捧着碗，碗中无声的火焰幽幽跳动。看不见任何面孔；取而代之的，是每尊雕像本该是脸的位置只剩一处被烟灰熏黑的空洞，空洞后方似有魔法火焰在燃。你看不出火焰以何为薪，却能确定它们在放热——雕像顶端的积雪已被融化，而水沿着袍褶淌下后，又在更低处重新结成了冰。雪地里的脚印踏上台阶，走向一处棺椁般的休息之地，随后离开山丘，沿着另一条小径远去。

[再度造访] 风把山顶的积雪吹积成一片小小的沙丘与起伏，棺椁与围墙堆砌出的台面之间，雪纹像荒原的丘陵般蜿蜒。Derion 的铭牌已被雪掩没，但他棺盖上雕刻的长剑却被擦得格外清晰，醒目可见。

[First visit] The statues of two hooded figures stand at the top of a flight of a snowy steps set in the hill. Both face toward the graves atop the hill, holding bowls in their hands in which flames flicker soundlessly. No face is visible.
