Instead, each statue has a soot-blackened cavity behind what must be magical flames. Although you can’t see what fuels the flames, they must produce heat because they’ve melted the snow atop the statues—and where the water has run down their robes, it has frozen again. Footsteps in the snow climb the stairs and go to one coffin-shaped resting place before exiting the hill and traveling off down the other trail.

[Return visit] Wind has drifted the snow atop the hill into a little landscape of dunes and hills among the mesas made by the sarcophagi and surrounding wall. Derion’s plaque has vanished beneath the snow, but the sword carved into his coffin’s lid has been made plainly visible.

四条修长的绿色腿支撑着甲壳质的胸部。胸部之上，是一个类人轮廓，颜色惨白，仿佛病变的腐肉。这个生物看起来力大无穷，背负着一个多孔的囊袋，里面盛满了黄色的营养浓汤。两只绿色的眼睛对着世界眨动，既好奇又畏惧。它的前肢握着一块闪烁的资料板，屏幕明灭跳动，回传着蜂巢的中继讯息。
Four long green legs carry a chitinous thorax. Above the thorax is a humanoid shape, a pale color like sickened flesh. The creature seems immensely strong, carrying on their back a porous sac of yellow nutrient soup. Two green eyes blink out at the world, curious and yet fearful. In their forehand, a blinking datapad flashes back relays from the hive.

Sundries From A Gold Dragon Wyrmling.name:
金龙雏龙的杂货
Sundries From A Gold Dragon Wyrmling

Text.text:
均匀散落在巨龙的空间四周，是一堆堆地精的衣物与装备、三叉戟，以及被当作杯子用来盛放脑浆的巨大蝙蝠头骨。
Neatly distributed around the dragon’s space are piles of goblin clothes and kit, tridents, and oversized bat skulls used as cups to hold the brains.

黑暗将你吞没，寂静灌满你的耳畔。接着，一阵砰砰作响——仿佛远处鼓点的节拍——令你惊惶失措，直到你意识到那是你自己心脏的跳动。当你行走在伸手不见五指的漆黑中，脚步声如锯齿刀划过绷紧的亚麻布，撕开了这片死寂。
Engulfed by darkness, silence filling your ears. Then a thumping sound—like the beat of a distant drum—panics you until you realize it's the beating of your own heart. As you walk through the pitch black, the sound of your footsteps cut the silence like a serrated knife through stretched linen.

The Enchanter Athenaeum.name:
魔导师雅典娜书库
The Enchanter Athenaeum

Text.text:
学院最璀璨的宝石，是它的图书馆。依塔楼魔法的本性，中层楼竟容纳了八百英里的书架与回廊。学生被要求掌握一则“定位”法术，以确保自己不会在梯架林立的迷宫里迷失——卷轴、巨著、秘典与活页册依照一套荒谬复杂的体系分门别类。图书馆的穹顶消隐于一片魔法天空，永远半晴，以便照亮书名；而书架的外壳却能如峡谷峭壁般拔起，高达一百英尺。那些从未离开图书馆的学生幽魂——多半出于自愿——有时会在数十处交会点与活人同坐；那里布置着舒适的阅览角，摆着桌子与温暖的壁炉。
The Academy’s jewel is its library. In the nature of the tower’s magic, eight hundred miles of shelves and corridors occupy its middle floor. Students are required to possess a Spell of Orientation to ensure they do not become lost in the maze of laddered shelving—where scrolls, tomes, grimoires, and binders are arranged by a ridiculously complicated system. The ceiling of the library disappears into a magical sky, always partly sunny to light the titles, but the shelf casings can rise like canyon walls to a height of one hundred feet. Ghosts of students who never left the library—most by choice—sometimes join the living in the dozens of intersections containing comfortable reading spaces with tables and cozy fireplaces.

Protean's Dagger.name:
普罗蒂安之匕
Protean's Dagger

Text.text:
匕首纤细而凶邪，是一件令人不寒而栗的武器，通体带着一抹若有若无的弧度，仿佛巨鸟利爪的轮廓。柄的一侧雕着赤裸的男性身形；另一侧则是女性。最引人注目的却是这把武器的刀刃——它看上去像由纯粹的墨影锻成，然而刃口的锋利却胜过最上等的钢铁。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The dagger is a slim, wicked-looking weapon, with a subtle curve to its length that evokes the talon of a great bird. One side of the dagger’s hilt depicts a naked, masculine figure; the other side, a feminine one. Most distinctive, though, is the weapon’s blade. Despite appearing forged of pure inky shadow, the edge cuts like the sharpest steel.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

矮人自古以来所受的种种屈辱，使他们的神祇变得严厉而阴郁。他常常皱眉，头微微后仰，粗硬的眉丛下是一双充满怀疑的眼睛。那把浓密厚重的长须——中段套着须环，又被巨大八字胡遮去一部分——在虔信者心中，比他的秘银头盔，或他那柄战锤与战斧所蕴含的可怖威势更为重要。然而当一天的劳作结束，当他置身于丘陵与矿坑的矮人之间时，他也会大笑，痛饮，吞云吐雾。他的子民将那些以血汗换来的日子里的财富与进步，尽数归功于他。
The indignities the dwarves have faced through the ages have made their god stern and dour. He scowls often, head tipped back, skeptical eyes under his bristly brows. The great thick beard, ringed at the middle and partly covered by a gigantic moustache, is more significant to the devout than his mithril helmet or the formidable force of his hammer and axe. When the work day is done, though, and when he is among the dwarves of hills and mines, he laughs and drinks and smokes. His people account for the wealth and progress of their hard-fought days.

God Of Foreknowledge.name:
预知之神
God Of Foreknowledge

Text.text: 如果神把未来说得清清楚楚、具体明确，那么所谓“预知”就不复存在——只剩“知道”。症结正在这里：时代崩解，而生命在当下变得惨不忍睹，令人无法栖身其中。于是，没有人知道“预知之神”究竟长什么样：在他们的神圣帐篷里，只悬着一面朴素的银镜，镜有两面。你向其中一面提出任何问题，神便从另一面以扭曲你问题的方式作答。 “我曾伯父病了。有治愈的方法吗？”曾有人真诚发问。镜子回应道：“你曾伯父会死吗？答案是会。” If the god speaks clearly and specifically about the future, then there’s no such thing as foreknowledge anymore—only knowledge. There's the rub: time disintegrates, and life becomes too horrible to live in the present. So, no one knows what the God of Foreknowledge looks like: in their Divine Tent hangs a simple, silver mirror with two sides. Whatever you ask one side, the god answers from the other side in a perversion of your question. "My great-uncle is sick. Is there a cure?" someone once asked in earnest. The mirror responded, "Will your great-uncle die? The answer is yes."

Cursed: Disadvantage On Ability Checks A.name:
诅咒：与力量相关的能力检定与豁免检定具有劣势
Cursed: Disadvantage On Ability Checks And Saving Throws Tied To Strength

Text.text:
你忽然意识到自己必须抬起双臂，连走路时双腿承受你的体重都清晰得令人不适。你的武器仿佛在水中劈砍，跳跃像是从沙里拔身而出，扭打时只有孩童般的力气。你清醒而自知，却唯有凭借意志力，才能逼迫身体勉强如常运转。
You’re suddenly aware of having to lift your arms, conscious of your legs carrying your weight, even at a walk. It feels as if your weapon is slicing through water, that you jump out of sand and grapple with the strength of a child. You are awake and aware, but only by willpower can you push your body to function normally.

Giant Sea Star.name:
巨型海星
Giant Sea Star

Text.text:
宛如一尊独眼巨神的残骸，这头奇异的水栖（特征）生物浸泡在潮池的咸涩海水里，将粗壮结实的肢体大张开来，横铺在淤泥床上，摆成一枚五角星的形状。生物粗糙的外皮呈现鲜艳夺目的粉红色，其上点缀着细小的白斑；那层带着纹理的包浆在海星般的躯体上铺展开来，织出令人目眩神迷的图案。
Like the remnant of a cyclopean god, the strange aquatic creature bathes in the briny waters of the tidepool, stretching its thick, robust limbs wide across the silt bed in the shape of a five-pointed star. The creature’s rough outer flesh is a vibrant, eye-catching pink dotted with tiny white spots, with its textured patina creating hypnotizing patterns across the sea star’s body.

Portal In A Doorway.name:
门廊中的传送门
Portal In A Doorway

Text.text:
门槛上一点光芒闪烁，继而扩散成烛焰般的微光，沿着门框盘旋环绕，愈发明亮。火花如潮倾泻般向内掠过本该是门扉的位置，随后又以细小的波纹回涌，在一层空气的位面里来回弹跳。渐渐地，波纹平息，凝成一片闪耀的光之领域。
A glint of light on the threshold grows into a glow like the flame of a candle, then encircles the doorway, growing brighter. A wave of sparks cascades inward across the space where the door would be and then washes back in wavelets that bounce around in a plane of air. Gradually the waves settle into a sparkling field of light.

你将手划过全身，心中把魔法织网中无形的丝线理成笔直的线条，仿佛吉他上的弦。作为法术的最后一个动作，你捻起一粒云母，轻轻拨响那些弦。回应你的法术，一声尖利刺耳的尖啸骤然炸开，万物在震颤中碎裂，生物纷纷眯起眼睛抵抗这可怖的噪音。
You draw your hand across your body, mentally arranging invisible threads of the weave of magic into straight lines, as if strung on a guitar. As the last gesture of the spell, you take a fleck of mica and strum those strings. In answer to your spell, a piercing shriek rings out, and objects shatter as creatures squint against the noise.

Euphoric Party Drug, Aisa.name:
狂欢迷醉派对药，艾萨
Euphoric Party Drug, Aisa

Text.text:
一支滴管里，一团黏稠的黄色液体微微晃荡。双手轻轻挤压，液体懒洋洋地一滴滴落在整齐的彩色方格纸上——每一格只点上一颗滴露。如今你面前是一张被锯齿状切成小标签的方格纸，已仔细封装进防水袋里，而纸面仍幽幽泛着黄光。纸上有龙的影像跳跃闪烁，伴着一缕淡淡的硫磺气味。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

A viscous yellow liquid wobbles in a pipette. Hands squeeze out the fluid in lazy drops onto neat squares of multicolored paper, with each getting just a single droplet. Now before you is a sheet of squared paper serrated into tabs and carefully packaged in a waterproof bag, the paper still dimly glowing yellow. Dancing pictures of dragons flicker across the surface with a faint smell of sulfur.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Plea From A Cleric To Lay Down Arms.name:
一位牧师恳求众人放下武器
Plea From A Cleric To Lay Down Arms

Text.text:
“我知道我们都在害怕，也知道我们都在愤怒。也许你觉得流血是我们唯一的选择，但我向你保证，只要我们都从暴力边缘退后一步，下一步就会更容易。我们只需要一个有勇气的人，先迈出第一步。”
“I know we are all afraid, and I know we are all angry. It may feel as though bloodshed is our only option, but I promise you, if we all just take one step back from violence, the next will be easier. We only need someone with the courage to go first.”

Soulful Country Blues Band In Rustic Tav.name:
乡野酒馆里的一支深情乡村布鲁斯乐队
Soulful Country Blues Band In Rustic Tavern

Text.text:
酒馆里的氛围温暖而诱人。每张桌上都亮着一支仿制蜡烛，空气里飘着人造的苔藓与柴烟气息。乐声响起——起初只有一把木吉他的清亮拨弦。随后，在口琴哀婉的颤音之上，低沉浑厚的男中音铺满整个房间，唱着爱与失落的歌。酒馆的喧闹渐渐沉下去，乐队的旋律如同厚实的冬日毛毯，覆在每一位听众身上。
The atmosphere of the tavern is warm and inviting. On each table glows a fake candle, and in the air hangs an artificial scent of moss and woodsmoke. Music strikes up—at first, only the twang of an acoustic guitar. Then, above the mournful twinge of a harmonica, a deep baritone fills the room with a song of love and loss. The hubbub of the tavern subsides as the band’s music pours over each listener like a thick winter blanket.

Destroyed Caravan.name:
被摧毁的商队
Destroyed Caravan

Text.text:
沿着商道拐过弯，映入眼帘的是一支四辆货车商队的残骸：每辆车都被彻底剥得一干二净，侧翻在地，像是为了搜出走私暗格而被掀开检查。九具尸体横七竖八地散落四周，大多被利刃砍得血肉翻开。除了守卫与商贩的尸体外，还有六匹马也被砍倒在地，但你看见仍有两匹活着——一匹还套在挽具上，另一匹在最后一辆车附近惊惶扬蹄、徘徊不定。唯有一个类人生物还站着，手握一柄长柄刀，冷冷巡视着这片废墟。

~ 由 Hayatemasaru 构想

Around the bend of the trade road lies the wreckage of a caravan of four wagons, each completely stripped of valuables and tipped on its side, presumably in order to find smuggling compartments. Nine bodies lie strewn about, the majority slashed to death with bladed weapons. In addition to the dead guards and merchants, six horses have also been cut down, though you see two still living—one attached to its harness, and one rearing and hovering near the rearmost wagon. Only one humanoid figure is upright, holding a glaive as they survey the ruin.

~ Envisioned by Hayatemasaru

I Relax In A Bath.name:
我泡在浴池里放松
I Relax In A Bath

Text.text:
温热的水包裹着我，我沉入那缕缕蒸汽轻柔升腾的浴池。失重般的感觉涌上心头，将我周身的酸痛、刺痛与不适尽数卸下。我缓缓吐出一口悠长的气息，任由宁静如潮水般漫过全身；在这治疗之水中，所有紧绷都悄然退去。
The warm water envelopes me as I sink into the gently steaming bath. A feeling of weightlessness overcomes me, relieving my body of all aches, pains, and discomfort. I let out a long, slow breath and relish the sense of peace that washes over me as all my tension ebbs away in the healing waters.

一股刺鼻的烟味从一名半身人嘴里叼着的陶烟斗中袅袅飘散。她蹲在一名肩宽背阔、赤裸着后背的男人身上方，神情专注得近乎屏息，手里拿着一根细薄的小棒，棒端穿着一枚针，轻轻点刺。她时不时停下动作，用一块破布擦拭他的皮肤。她到底在描绘什么很难看清，但店里四周用框架绷起的几片皮革上，陈列着花朵、游鱼与兽类等精细繁复的图样。
A pungent smoke wafts from the clay pipe clamped between the lips of a halfling squatting over the bared back of a broad-shouldered man. She concentrates intensely on the task of tapping a thin stick pierced by a pin. Every so often she takes a break from her work to wipe his skin with a rag. It’s difficult to see what she’s drawing, but bits of leather strung in frames around the shop show intricate designs of flowers, fish, and animals.

带着凌空而起的傲慢，一座幽绿流光的巨构凌驾于周遭塔群之上；那些黯淡的尖顶仿佛卑微的乞怜者，在它闪烁的威仪前瑟缩，如同祈祷般伏向它的翡翠立面。细长尖塔之巅，高悬的步道通往一扇华丽的青铜门，而那镜面般的门扉深处，隐隐搏动着一股阴沉的凶意。

~ 一位英雄所构想

With upthrust arrogance, a shimmering green edifice looms over the surrounding towers, dull supplicants to its scintillating majesty, cowering as if in prayer before its jade façade. Crowning the slender spire, lofty walkways lead to an ornate bronze door, a feeling of brooding menace pulsing deep within its mirror-like surface.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

我一边烹煮，一边在脑海里听见母亲的叮咛，提醒我要盯紧肉色，并在我转动烤叉时倾听那噼啪作响。回想起童年那些温暖的夜晚——家中餐桌旁共进晚餐、故事在灯火间流转——我不由得笑意漫上脸颊。忽然一阵更清脆的噼啪声把我从遐想里拽回：肉已烤成浓郁深褐，汁水也澄澈流淌。我在心里向母亲的睿智指点致谢，随即招呼我的伙伴们入座用餐。 I hear my mother’s words in my mind as I cook, reminding me to keep an eye on the meat’s color and listen for the crackle as I turn the spit. A smile spreads across my face as I recall happy childhood memories of dinners shared and tales spun around the table in my home. A crackling draws me back from my daydream—the meat is now a rich deep brown and its juices run clear. I offer thanks to my mother for her sage advice and call my companions to sit for the meal.

Enhanced Astral Navigator.name:
强化星界领航员
Enhanced Astral Navigator

Text.text:
在舰桥上，领航员端坐于控制台前，强化过的手指在操控界面上飞舞，绘算着穿越虚空的航线。他那生物机械的双眼在各个显示屏间来回跃动，搜寻潜在的危险。神经链接将他与舰船牢牢相系，血肉与钢铁融为一体。
On the bridge, the navigator sits at his console, enhanced fingers dancing across the controls as he plots a course through the void. His biomechanical eyes flit back and forth between displays, scanning for potential dangers. Neural links bind him to the ship, his flesh and its steel as one.

Spelljammer Powers Up.name:
星界航行：动力全开
Spelljammer Powers Up

Text.text:
一团宏大、闪耀的魔法云雾——强大而凝聚到肉眼可见——翻涌着裹住整艘船的船身。船帆猛然鼓起，帆布舒展如鸟翼振翅欲飞。船员们本能地抓住最近的支援：缆绳、栏杆、索具，或彼此的手臂。一道亢奋而沙哑的嗓音高喊：“奔向群星之海！”随即，伴着一阵既能听见也能切身感到的回响嗡鸣，镶着黄铜的船艏猛地前冲，闯入那片星界织锦。

~ Envisioned by Bh3lliom

A great glittering cloud of magic—so powerful and concentrated as to be visible—billows around the body of the ship. The sails flare out, their canvas stretching like a bird’s wings before flight. The crew instinctively grabs for the nearest source of support: ropes, railings, rigging, each other. An exuberant, rasping voice calls out: “To the sea of stars!” Then, with a reverberating hum that can be both heard and felt, the brass-lined bow of the ship surges forward into the astral tapestry.

~ Envisioned by Bh3lliom

Queen In A Wheelchair.name:
轮椅上的女王
Queen In A Wheelchair

Text.text:
她的侍从总想把那把椅子当成台座或轿舆来伺候——这是训练使然，他们几乎忍不住——可每一次，她都会投去一道纠正的目光。她进屋时像公牛冲出闸门，下一瞬却又温柔地滑入谈话，甩甩手臂，拿王座开着玩笑。她身边的人似乎都需要被安抚，而当他们放松下来时，她的力量便成了他们的力量。

~ 扮演者：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Her servants try to treat the chair as a dais or litter—they can’t help themselves, their training—but, each time, she fires a corrective look at them. She enters a room like a bull from a gate, then gently glides into conversation, shaking out her arms and joking about the royal throne. Everyone around her seems to need to be put at ease, and her strength becomes theirs as they relax.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

轻薄的亚麻帷幔自环绕着丰茂草甸的树枝间垂落。草甸上流淌着欢快的乐声，伴着人们的闲谈、笑语与种种愉悦的声响。空气里浮着酒的果香。草地边缘，衣衫或解或褪的人们在低矮的桌旁举杯、进食、交谈、相拥缠绵；桌上铺陈着一盘盘食物与一罐罐饮品，四周散放着枕头与毯子。视线移向场地中央，更多人或抚琴吹笛，或旋舞起落，或边奏边舞。
Draperies of sheer linen hang from the branches of trees surrounding a lush meadow full of lively music, which accompanies chatter, laughter, and other sounds of delight. The fruity smell of wine hangs in the air. At the edges, people in various states of undress drink, eat, talk, and love on pillows and blankets placed near low tables covered in platters of food and jugs of beverages. Toward the center of the field, others play instruments, dance, or both.

Security Daemons Are Summoned To Node In.name:
安保守护进程被召至网域节点
Security Daemons Are Summoned To Node In The Net

Text.text:
一片如汤般翻涌的代码之海孕育出紫色的守护魔灵，它们的降临以一阵隐约的嗡鸣宣告。它们悬浮在虚假的蓝色空气中，用传感器扫描着周遭的网络。动作精准而高效，搜寻任何未获许可的许可或潜在威胁。灼亮的红眼忽明忽暗，寒意逼人。它们是网络的守卫者，对黑帽黑客与恶意软件的追猎永不止息。
A soup-like sea of code births purple daemons, their arrival announced by a faint whirring sound. They hover in the fake blue air and scan the surrounding network with their sensors. Their movements are precise and efficient as they seek out any unauthorized access or potential threats. Glowing red eyes flicker with intensity. They are the guardians of the net, relentless in their pursuit of black hat hackers and malware.

Dungeon: Corridor Intersection.name:
地城：走廊交汇处
Dungeon: Corridor Intersection

Text.text:
走廊仍向前延伸，但左右两侧各分出一条新岔路。你停下脚步检定线索，试图推断每条通道通往何处。哪一条路的磨损痕迹更明显？那尽头隐约的微光，究竟是真有灯火，还是眼睛在捉弄你？
The corridor continues onward, but two new paths branch off in either direction. You stop to check for clues, trying to deduce where each passage may lead. Does one path seem to have more wear than the others? Is that a light glowing at the end of one, or just a trick of the eye?

Cacodemon With Open Maw.name:
张口裂喉的卡寇恶魔
Cacodemon With Open Maw

Text.text:
怪物那腐臭的獠牙似乎大得不合嘴形，尽管它几乎就是一张嘴，咧开着，涎水横流。它的身躯像一枚带刺的亵渎果实，从藤蔓上坠落后腐烂，紫得如同淤青。然而真正的威胁是那条舌头——那条带来幻觉与麻痹的蓝舌——它从漆黑的深喉里游蛇般探出，活着，清醒，嘶嘶作响，四处寻觅。
The monster’s putrid fangs seem too big for its mouth, even though it is all mouth, open and slobbering. Its body is like a prickly, unholy fruit fallen from a vine and rotted, purple like a bruise. The tongue, though—the blue tongue of hallucination and narcosis—is the threat. It snakes out of the black maw, alive and aware, hissing and seeking.

Arrival To The Shadow Plane.name:
抵达暗影位面
Arrival To The Shadow Plane

Text.text:
这里的世界与你记忆中的那里别无二致，只是披着一层细密、贴肤的灰色裹衣。颜色仿佛在挣扎着呼吸；若真如此，它正在败退，沉回黯淡的阴影里。空气里没有任何可辨的气味，你的舌头在口中又钝又沉，像肿起一般。枝头的叶子在动，可你感觉不到一丝微风。万物都一半是自己，一半又消退进自己的影像之中；那影像从实体上漂离开来，像一艘船被系泊的缆绳牵扯着，离岸又不离岸。
The world here is as you remember it there, but wearing a fine, skin-tight shroud of grey. Color seems to be fighting to breathe. If so, it is losing, sinking back into drab shade. There is no discernible smell on the air, and your tongue lies dull and thick in your mouth. Leaves move on branches, but you don’t feel the breeze. Everything is partly itself, partly disappeared into an image of itself that drifts from its physical form, like a boat pulling at its dock line.

Insult About Self-righteousness.name:
关于自以为是的侮辱
Insult About Self-righteousness

Text.text:
“你给我的感觉，是那种走到哪儿都能看见蠢货的人。那样的人生一定很孤独。”
“You strike me as a person who sees idiots everywhere they go. It must be a very lonely life.”

Quip About Exploring An Ancient Ruin.name:
关于探索远古遗迹的俏皮话
Quip About Exploring An Ancient Ruin

Text.text:
“我们踏遍了无数阴暗的遗迹，可这地方……这地方本该继续被遗忘。”
“We have explored many dark ruins, but this place… This place should have remained forgotten.”

乐声与笑语穿林而过，一座流动集市在呢喃树冠的荫影下支起宝石般明亮的帐篷。乐队吹奏肖姆管与鲁特琴，身披杂色破布的艺人抛接木制短棒，摊贩为兴高采烈的客人把苹果蘸进糖衣蜜浆。空气里弥漫着青翠泥土与黄油甜点的香气。“票子！”揽客的吆喝声响起。“来买些流动集市的票子！”
Strains of music and laughter thread through the trees where a traveling fair has pitched jewel-bright tents in the shade of the whispering canopy. A band plays shawm and lute, a performer in motley rags juggles wooden pins, and a vendor dips apples in a candied concoction for delighted patrons. The air smells of green earth and buttered sweets. “Tickets!” cries a barker. “Buy some tickets for the wandering fair!”

Warrior's Taunt After Being Stabbed.name:
被捅之后的战士嘲讽
Warrior's Taunt After Being Stabbed

Text.text:
“那是什么？像针扎一下？我听说你是剑术大师——可我看你连给自己剪头发都得你妈牵着手才行。”
"What was that? A pinprick? I was told you were a master swordsman—yet I doubt you could cut your own hair without your ma holding your hand."

自迷雾中，一尊狂怒的象征轰然冲出。一头牛头人现身，裹挟着毁灭性的蛮力与原始的兽性怒火。它的双角伤痕累累，宛如扭曲的长镰；筋肉虬结翻涌，迸发出无畏的威势。分趾蹄踏出狂乱的节拍，震得大地颤抖，它正朝你猛冲而来。
From the mist, an icon of fury thunders forth. A minotaur emerges, full of ruinous, raw power and feral rage. Its horns are scarred like twisted scythes, and its thews ripple with dauntless might. The cloven hooves pound out a tumultuous rhythm, shaking the ground as it charges toward you.

Casting Astral Projection To Shed One's.name:
施展星界投射，舍离肉身
Casting Astral Projection To Shed One's Body

Text.text:
你的视野在银色光辉中炸裂。你的肉身从星界形体上剥落，如同浸透了水、沉重得过分的衣物。就在你双足踏上被月辉浸洗的灰色岩石之际，一汪银色水潭在你面前倏然闪现。你身处星界位面。
Your vision bursts with silvery light. Your physical body sheds from your astral form like too-heavy water-soaked clothes. A silver pool blinks into existence before you as your feet touch down on gray rock awash in moonglow. You are in the Astral Plane.

High Priest Of A Coven.name:
秘会大祭司
High Priest Of A Coven

Text.text:
此人身披兜帽黑色皮袍，缀以绿色滚边，面容藏在一张绿色面具之后，无法辨认身份。面具上刻画着一名留着胡须、长着公羊角的男子，神情狰狞，额头镌着一枚五芒星。其一手持暗色木杖，另一手握着黑柄匕首。赤裸的双足从袍摆下探出。
Robed and hooded in black leather with green piping, face hidden behind a green mask, this person cannot be identified. The mask depicts a bearded, ram-horned man with a fierce expression and a pentacle engraved in his forehead. In one hand, the figure wields a wand of dark wood; the other hand holds a dagger with a black handle. Bare feet stick out from under the robe.

Cursed: Disadvantage On Ability Checks A.name:
诅咒：与智力相关的能力检定与豁免检定带劣势
Cursed: Disadvantage On Ability Checks And Saving Throws Tied To Intelligence

Text.text:
刚才有人对你说了什么，可你走神了。你的心神还缠在法术的字句上，或是在盘算该怎么抵达那个你曾去过的地方。没错，就是这样。他们正问你一个你本该拿手的问题。可你怎么也想不起答案。它就在舌尖上……
Someone told you something just now, but you were distracted. You were focused on the words of the spell, or how to get to a place you’ve been before. That’s it. They were asking you a question about something or other in your wheelhouse. You can’t quite remember the answer. It’s on the tip of your tongue . . .

Rogue's Saferoom.name:
盗贼的安全屋
Rogue's Saferoom

Text.text:
这扇门藏得极深，但只要做出正确的动作，十数道由各色金属打造的锁扣便在齿轮嗡鸣中依次滑脱，门扇随之悄然半开。门后是一间类似避难密室的所在。靠一侧墙有一排搁架，上面备着口粮与清水，还有几套深色而舒适的换洗衣物；与搁架相对的是一张行军床，床上堆满了毯子。门旁挂着一把上弦待发的弩，随时准备守护任何来此寻求庇护之人。
The door is hidden, but with the appropriate motions, a dozen locks of various metals slide loose with a whir of gears and it swings ajar. Beyond you find a saferoom of sorts. A shelf lines one wall, stocked with rations and water, as well as several changes of dark, comfortable clothes; opposite the shelf is a cot piled with blankets. A loaded crossbow hangs beside the door, ready to defend any who seek refuge here.

“许·帕拉勒尔，这名字！”他猛地把一只手伸到你面前——那手掌覆着一层你几乎会以为是泥土的污垢。连带的手臂？同样裹满脏污——还黏着打结的毛发。你的目光扫过眼前名为许·帕拉勒尔的“整套行头”——满身油垢、断角残缺却喜气洋洋的萨堤尔——随即注意到他颈间的圣徽正明亮地闪耀着……洁净如新。
"Xu Parallel's the name!" The hand that thrusts toward you is covered in what you would assume is dirt. The arm attached to it? Also caked with filth—and matted hair. As your eyes take in the package that is Xu Parallel—the grimy, broken-horned yet jubilant satyr—you notice the holy symbol around his neck shining brightly… pristinely.

你将由无价宝石研磨而成的粉末轻轻洒在目标身上，它随即在视野中褪去，继而彻底消失无踪，连你自己的奥术装置也无法侦测到它的存在。
Dusting your target with the powder made from priceless jewels, it fades from sight and eventually disappears entirely from view, defying the detection of even your own arcane devices.

Boarded-up Manor.name:
钉死封窗的庄园
Boarded-up Manor

Text.text:
这里早已不再是家。曾经，它的三层楼、精致的装饰与花园，迎来朋友赴宴小聚。如今，窗户只剩歪斜的回收木板，发霉、仓促钉死。那扇厚重的橡木大门不见了，门环上方的家族纹章也已消失。木板并非为了阻拦闯入者，而是在宣告：这里如今只是座腐朽的栖身之所，没有灵魂，任由天气摆布。
This is a home no longer. Once, its three floors, its adornments, and the garden welcomed friends for dinner parties. Now the windows are crooked salvage planks, moldy and nailed up in a hurry. There is no great oaken door, no family crest above the knocker. Rather than stop any intruder, the boards send a message: This is now a rotting shelter without a soul, a slave to the weather.

Mind Flayer Warlock.name:
夺心魔契术师
Mind Flayer Warlock

Text.text:
一个过大的光头上垂落着如胡须般的触手，顶在这纤细修长的身影之上。那存在的皮肤呈紫罗兰色，光滑无毛，眼睛与利爪皆是油亮的漆黑。靛蓝长袍披覆在其瘦削躯体上，布料间点缀着更浅的蓝色，仿佛深水之下透出的微光。它面部的附肢抽动着、伸出触及，伴随嘶嘶作响的咏唱。它一只带爪的手紧握着一枚蔚蓝宝珠，珠内翻涌着烟雾般的细丝；另一只手指向前方。地面之中，朦胧的雾缕猛然迸发，迅速增厚，化作一片狂舞抽打的黑色触手之域。

~ 扮演：Colby Poulson，来自 d4: D&D Deep Dive

An oversized bald head with tentacles dangling like a beard tops this willowy figure. The being’s skin is violet and hairless, their eyes and claws glossy black. Indigo robes drape their thin frame, with lighter blues on the fabric evoking light seen from watery depths. Their facial appendages twitch and reach as the being incants in a sibilant voice. One clawed hand clutches an orb of azure that swirls with smoky tendrils. The other points. From the ground, misty strands erupt, thickening into a field of thrashing black tentacles.

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

艺术教授是位来自大都市的卓越俗世奇才，常穿波西米亚风长裙，赤脚授课。她的头发蓬乱如荒野，每个月都换一种颜色。她叫停了一名正在打磨绘画基本功的学生。“这里正该来一道法术。”她指着画面。“别想！现在就施放点什么！”她眯起眼审视效果。“魔法救不了你糟糕的判断和低下的自律，”她一边说，一边开始提出建议。
The art professor is a brilliant quotidian from a big city who wears bohemian dresses and teaches barefoot. Her hair is a wild mass, a different color every month. She stops a student working on the fundamentals of a painting. “Time for a spell right there.” She points. “Don’t think about it! Cast something now!” She squints at the results. “Magic can’t save you from bad judgment or low discipline,” she says before making suggestions.

Harmless-looking Elder Draws Large Handg.name:
看似无害的长者掏出一把大型手枪
Harmless-looking Elder Draws Large Handgun

Text.text:
劫匪们挂着丑陋而凶狠的狞笑逼近老人，挺直身子撑到最高。霓虹路灯下，刀刃寒光一闪，他们的意图昭然若揭，可老人却温柔地笑了。就在他们困惑之际，他把手伸进随身拎着的棕色纸袋，抽出一把巨大的手枪——困惑瞬间化作惊恐。
The muggers wear ugly, menacing grins as they advance on the old man, drawing themselves to their full height. Knives shine in the neon streetlights as they make their intentions clear, but the man smiles sweetly. Their confusion turns to terror as he reaches into the brown paper bag he carries and pulls out a huge pistol.

Fiend Emerging From The Floor.name:
恶魔自地板破土而出
Fiend Emerging From The Floor

Text.text:
酒馆地板的一角开始塌陷，被一圈不断扩大的、闷燃的火环吞没。人们注意到那道传送门后，交谈与吟游诗人的乐声戛然而止。紧接着，尖叫声取而代之——有什么东西正从里面爬出来。先露出的是一张无悲无喜、饰着犄角的面具；随后，短粗的手臂将一具披覆重型护甲的敦实身躯从地板的洞口撑起。那生物从背上解下一柄狰狞的战斧，随即朝最近的酒客猛然挥落，伴着一声低吼，将一张桌子劈得粉碎。

~ 由一位英雄构想

A section of the tavern floor begins to cave in, swallowed by an expanding ring of smoldering fire. Conversations and the bard's music come to a sudden halt as people notice the portal. Then screams start in their place as something crawls out of it. An emotionless mask adorned with horns appears first, then stubby arms hoist a stout body encased in heavy armor out of the hole in the floor. The creature unhooks a wicked axe from its back, then swings at the closest patron, splitting a table with a snarl.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Paints And Dyes.name:
颜料与染料
Paints And Dyes

Text.text:
每只陶罐的罐沿都像缀着一圈短短的垂帷，或蓝或白。几只陶罐几乎见底——那是画家用得最勤的颜色——其中一只甚至侧倒在旁。装白色颜料的罐子高挑，带着小小的壶嘴；装黑色颜料的罐子则矮胖而宽口。它们旁边摆着一圈小木染缸，每一只都盛满微微颤动的染液，色调与深浅应有尽有，既配得上最尊贵的王侯，也不嫌弃最穷困的贫民。
The rim of each pot looks decorated with short drapes of blue or white. Some of the pots are nearly empty—the artist’s most used colors—and one is even tipped on its side. The pot of white is tall and has a small spout, while the pot of black is short and wide. Next to them sits a circle of small wooden vats, each filled with quivering dyes in tints and shades fitting anyone from the most regal royalty to the deeply impoverished.

I Use Slow Fall.name:
我施展【缓落】
I Use Slow Fall

Text.text:
我从边缘迈出一步，明白向下的旅程多少可以被扭转，变得更像向外的旅程。重力与我正在谈判。它以咄咄逼人的速度把我拽向坠落的底部。我只给它不到一半的要价。
I step from the edge, knowing that the journey downward can be bent somewhat, made more like the journey outward. Gravity and I are in a negotiation. It pulls me to the bottom of a fall at a demanding speed. I give it less than half of its demand.

Wild Magic Surge: A Wild Unicorn Appears.name:
狂野魔法涌动：一只狂野独角兽现身
Wild Magic Surge: A Wild Unicorn Appears

Text.text:
你的法术余波搅动了空气，一道涟漪荡开，现实被撕碎成一蓬粉彩与花香的碎屑。一头独角兽——如银似金地闪耀——在你面前显现，尽显其缥缈威仪。这奇妙的生物以带着些许嗔意的目光注视着你。
A ripple disturbs the air in the wake of your spell, fragmenting reality in a spray of pastel colors and a floral fragrance. A unicorn—shining like silver and gold—appears before you in all its ethereal majesty. The marvelous creature regards you with mildly chiding eyes.

夜色黏腻得令人窒息，黑暗浓稠到仿佛有了生命，意欲将闯入者活活扼住——或把他们吓破胆。迷宫般的林下灌丛密不透风，遍布阴险的盘根与割人的利叶。野兽般的尖啸撕裂空气，夹杂着震耳欲聋的咆哮，以及虫群尖锐而单调的嗡鸣。蜿蜒的阴影自树梢垂落，擦过你的肌肤……那是藤蔓，还是蛇？
The night is cloying, the dark so absolute it seems like a living thing that means to suffocate intruders—or terrify them. The labyrinthine undergrowth is thick with treacherous roots and cutting leaves. Beastly screams pierce the air, thunderous bellows, and the shrill drone of insects. Sinuous shadows hang from the trees and brush against your skin… a vine, or a snake?

Targeted By Scrying.name:
被探知锁定
Targeted By Scrying

Text.text:
一股诡异的感觉攫住了你——那几乎难以察觉、却挥之不去的刺痒感：你正被注视着。你四下张望，搜寻那窥视者，却一个人也没找到。可你仍感到后颈寒毛倒竖，仿佛有人、有什么在场；并非真就在你身旁，而是以某种方式远远地存在着，从遥不可及之处感知着你。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，Stefano Imperiale

An uncanny sensation comes over you—the almost imperceptible, nagging feeling that you’re being watched. You glance about, searching for the watcher, but find no one. Yet the hairs on the back of your neck bristle as you sense the presence of someone, something; not physically beside you, but somehow there, perceiving you from afar.

~ Envisioned by Stefano Imperiale

I Cast Fog Cloud.name:
我施放【雾云术】
I Cast Fog Cloud

Text.text:
我张开双臂，大幅挥动，召唤自然的魔法，随即开始吟诵。我的双眼逐渐浑浊，仿佛蒙上迷雾；一层冰冷的寒霭开始凝结，自地面袅袅升起，化作丝缕般的触须缠绕翻涌，在我的目标周围汇聚成一团浓厚的泡状迷雾。
Spreading my arms wide in a sweeping gesture to summon the magic of nature, I begin my incantation. My eyes become cloudy, like shrouded mist, as a cold brume begins to form, rising from the ground in wispy tendrils to form a thick bubble fog of around my target.

矿车车轮磨出的槽痕一路延伸，没入隧道的黑暗之中；这里早年由矿工开凿，他们曾盼能掘出闪烁的银金矿脉。粗大的支撑木梁如巨人腿般又宽又长，稳稳托起隧道顶。每隔几根木梁就悬着一盏油灯，灯罩被烟熏得油腻发黑，却全都未曾点亮。深处似乎传来一阵怪异的声响——是矿工，还是别的什么？
The grooves, worn by the wheels of minecarts, disappear into the darkness of the tunnel, carved long ago by miners hoping to unearth glimmering veins of silver and gold. Massive timbers, the width and length of a giant's leg, hold the tunnel's ceiling aloft. Oil lamps, greasy with smoke, hang unlit every few timbers. A strange sound seems to emanate from deep within—a miner, or something else?

Goblinoid Siege Tower.name:
地精类攻城塔
Goblinoid Siege Tower

Text.text:
铁筋铁骨的兽人猛力推着那座高耸的战械前进，带刺的巨轮在泥泞的旷野上滚动，犁开大地，撕出一道道伤口。披甲的地精帮派在这头颤抖巨兽的腹腔深处蜂拥而动，锈蚀的兵刃出鞘，抓钩蓄势待发。
Iron-thewed orcs shove the towering engine forward, spiked wheels propelling it through the muddy field, gouging wounds in the earth. Gangs of armored goblins swarm within the guts of the quaking behemoth, rusted weapons drawn, grappling hooks ready.

Silver Buckle For A Narrow Belt.name:
窄腰带的银扣
Silver Buckle For A Narrow Belt

Text.text:
打造这枚扣环的人，心思尽落在令人屏息的精巧上。它看似由细绳编成，银丝粗略地纺捻，却细薄到几近不可见。扣针如针一般尖利，横杆也只配得上一条羽般轻盈的布质腰带。
Whoever made this buckle did so with a mind for breathtaking fineness. It seems to be made of twine, the silver spun roughly but thin to the point of near invisibility. It has a prong like a pin and the bar is only fit for a featherweight fabric belt.

Abandoned Viewing Tower.name:
废弃瞭望塔
Abandoned Viewing Tower

Text.text:
布满灰尘的地图与破碎的家具，被从巨塔全景窗上厚重污垢间隙透入的斑驳光线照亮。机库的眼睛曾经锐利明亮，如今却被年代与疏于照料蒙上浑浊。蛛网如轻纱般的薄幕在寒冷的微风里凄然鼓荡，敞开的窗户在生锈的铰链上吱呀作响，像在低声哀叹。
Dusty maps and broken furniture are illuminated by patches of light coming through the thick layer of grime coating the panoramic windows of the huge tower. The eyes of the hangar, once sharp and bright, are now clouded with age and neglect. The gossamer veil of spiderwebs billow mournfully in the chill breeze as open windows creak sadly on rusted hinges.

Gnome's Rant About A Steep Wheelchair Ra.name:
侏儒对陡峭轮椅坡道的怒骂
Gnome's Rant About A Steep Wheelchair Ramp

Text.text:
伴随着一声悠长拖沓的口哨叹息，一个坐在轮椅上的侏儒打量着酒馆那套失败的“无障碍”改造。“他们真是一处都没做对，是吧？这倒是个坡道，可一看就是给送货用的那种。短得离谱，斜坡又陡得吓人。轮子随便就可能卡进这些沟槽里。还有，当然了——他们连倒角都没做。他们总是忘了倒角！”侏儒短暂停顿，带着烦躁呼出压力，又吸进决心。“麻烦让一让。我得蛇形绕上这头怪物。”
With a long, drawn-out sigh of a whistle, a gnome using a wheelchair inspects the tavern’s failed attempt to be accessible. “They really didn’t get anything right, did they? It’s a ramp, but it’s clearly the one they made for deliveries. It’s far too short, and the incline too steep. A wheel could get stuck in any of these ruts. And of course, they’re missing a bevel. They always forget the bevel!” With a brief pause, the frustrated gnome exhales stress and inhales determination. “Please, give me some room. I need to serpentine up this monstrosity.”

“巨大”二字都不足以形容这颗象般庞然的红橙色葫芦——它大得足以当作一间小屋。它贴地疯长，因而长成了椭圆的体型。光滑的表皮上，深深的纵向沟槽一道道延伸。顶端仍有一段粗糙的绿色藤蔓与一株阔叶植株相连，那株植物还结出了好几颗正常体型的南瓜。
Enormous doesn’t begin to describe this elephantine red-orange gourd—it’s big enough to be a small house. Growing massive on the ground has caused it to develop an ovoid shape. Deep longitudinal grooves line its smooth skin. At the top, a rough green vine still connects it to a broad-leafed plant that has produced several other pumpkins of normal size.

I Shoot My Rifle.name:
我开枪射击步枪
I Shoot My Rifle

Text.text:
我的目标，那家伙真够凶的——若不是我正沿着步枪的长枪管瞄准，它在地平线上也不过是一点模糊的黑痕。我检定风向，心算弹道，只盼一次成功。我把枪托紧紧抵在肩窝，呼出一口气，扣下扳机。枪身猛地直向后坐，又轻轻一颠，但我稳稳压住。枪声的boom自带一圈震荡的冲击波，空气里弥漫着火药与铁锈般的味道。

~ 由一位英雄构想

My target, a real nasty one, would be a smudge on the horizon, were I not sighting down the long barrel of the rifle. I check the wind, do the math, and hope for success. I press the butt of the gun to my shoulder, breathe out, and squeeze the trigger. The gun kicks straight back, and bucks a little, but I hold it steady. The boom of the gun has its own concussion wave, and the air smells of cordite and iron.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Cheerful Banter On The Street.name:
街头的欢快打趣
Cheerful Banter On The Street

Text.text:
“喂，喂！还有你，瞧瞧，多精神，多红扑扑的脸蛋！今天真是个好日子啊，朋友，明天肯定更好，我敢打赌！喂，亲爱的，愿你那双漂亮的眼睛受祝福。哎哟，小子！当心点，不然你生日我可得送你个球让你去踢，哈哈！”
“Hallo, hallo! And you, look how sparky and rose-cheeked! Wonderful day there, friend, and a better tomorrow, I’ll bet! Hallo, love, and bless your pretty eyes. Whoa, lad! Careful there or I’ll have to give you a ball to kick for your birthday, ha ha!”

你的脚踩进松软的地面，留下的深深脚印迅速被水灌满。你抬头望去，只见一片广阔开阔的苔藓湿地，草丛成簇点缀其间，水洼与池塘星罗棋布。薄雾遮住了远方，但你仿佛能透过雾气看见一道阴影，或许是更高——也因此更干燥——的地势。
Your foot presses down into soft ground, and the deep print you leave behind swiftly fills with water. You look up to a vast, open expanse of mossy ground tufted with grass and pocked by puddles and ponds. A thin fog veils the distance, but you think you can see a shadow through it that might be higher—and therefore drier—ground.

在这间古怪的实验室里，大多数台面都摊着法术书，奥秘的教诲引导着无畏实验者的双手。这里不受任何自然法则或限制的束缚，空间容纳着一连串令人目眩神迷的魔法异象——而且常常同时发生！被变形的动物尖叫喧闹，在房间里四处探查，躲避着覆盖天花板、翻涌旋转的云团射下的电弧。伴随一声震耳欲聋的轰鸣，那沉甸甸的雨云向下方倾泻如注。这可得好好收拾一番。

~ 由 Inbal 在 Discord 上 构想

Spellbooks lie open on most surfaces in the curious laboratory, their arcane tutelage guiding the hands of the intrepid experimenters. Unbound by any natural laws or limits, the space holds a mind-bending array of magical phenomena—often occurring simultaneously! Transmogrified animals squawk and holler as they explore the room, dodging bolts from a swirling cloud blanketing the ceiling. With a cacophonous boom the laden nimbus unleashes a deluge on those below. This will take some cleaning up.

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

Eclectic Array Of Pots.name:
杂陈陶罐阵列
Eclectic Array Of Pots

Text.text:
一排陶罐被悄悄塞在角落里。它们体型各异：有的像一只与人同宽的大缸，缸身两侧还带着把手；也有一只小小的骨灰瓮，边缘缺口累累，被频繁使用磨得斑驳陈旧。其中一只倒霉的罐子已经碎得不成样子，只剩下尖锐的碎片与粉白的尘屑。
An array of pots is tucked away in a corner. They vary in size from a crock as wide as a man, with handles along the sides, to a small urn chipped and worn from frequent use. One unfortunate member of the grouping has been shattered into little more than sharp fragments and chalky dust.

系在水桶上的绳子有这么长，如今就说得通了。井水比你从四周葱郁的景色所能猜到的要深得多。你几乎看不见它——在幽暗的井底，大约四十英尺之下，只有一线微光隐隐闪烁。
The length of the rope attached to the bucket makes sense now. The water lies much deeper within the well than you would have guessed from the greenness of the surrounding landscape. You can barely see it, glimmering in the shadowy depths some forty feet below.

Certifiable Conspiracy Theorist.name:
可认证的阴谋论者
Certifiable Conspiracy Theorist

Text.text: 他们把手在你面前来回挥舞，狂乱的动作不由分说地攫住你的注意力。 “听着，一旦你知道了，那玩意儿就无处不在，哥们。”他们说着，眼睛瞪得滚圆，兴奋也好、恐惧也罢——或许两者混在一起。他们一边絮絮叨叨，一边拽着自己的衣服，讲什么外星人和催眠，讲公司都参与其中，哥们，讲这一切都是靠科技完成的。 “所以现在，我跟科技彻底断了。”他们掀起那件破旧的开衫，露出松垮的背心和破洞牛仔裤。的确，他们身上看不出半点科技的影子。 They wave their hand before your face, the frenetic motion gaining your attention whether you want it to or not. “Listen, once you know, it’s everywhere, man,” they say, their eyes wide with excitement or fear; or perhaps a mix of both. They pull at their clothes as they ramble on, saying things about aliens and hypnosis, about how corporations are in on it, man, and how it’s all done through tech. “So, now, I’m tech free.” They lift up their ratty cardigan to reveal a sagging tank top and holey jeans. Indeed, not a speck of tech appears to be on them.

I Cast Compulsion.name:
我施放「强迫」
I Cast Compulsion

Text.text:
我在游戏中运用魔法，如同棋手运用心智与手掌。我的目标——我欲移动的棋子——只会回应我的号令。我自奥秘之中唤起这局戏的规则，触及伸手，指向将被移走的那枚棋子，横向一挥。它便去往我所强迫的所在，踏着我鼓点的节拍，行军入险。
I’m playing a game using magic the way a chess player uses the mind and hand. My target, the piece I wish to move, may only respond to my command. I call up from the arcana the rules of the game, reach out my hand, point at the piece to be moved, and sweep sideways. They go to where I compel them, and they march to my drum into peril.

Warlock Battling With Their Patron.name:
术士与其宗主交战
Warlock Battling With Their Patron

Text.text:
言语如武器般被掷出，噼啪作响地划破空气，法术在四周轰然炸裂。两道身影在奥术混沌中厮杀，皆美得惊心动魄——也同样凶狠。一个肌肤丰润如深红绸缎的提夫林，与一位高挑如雕像般的女性身影一边交战一边互相辱骂。究竟谁才真正握有力量？

~ 由 Daroneasa 在 Discord 上通过 Envisioned 构想

Words are hurled like weapons, crackling through the air, as spells explode all around. Two figures battle amid the arcane chaos, both staggeringly beautiful—and equally fierce. A tiefling with luscious crimson skin trades insults with a statuesque feminine figure as they fight. Who truly holds the power?

~ Envisioned by Daroneasa on Discord

Efreeti Bottle.name:
伊弗利特之瓶
Efreeti Bottle

Text.text:
如此器皿，究竟能盛装何等奇妙的液体？它形体狭长高挑，工艺繁复；不透明的玻璃表面泛着红与黑交织的幽光，烟熏般的质感更为瓶中之物添上层层迷雾。其内似有一缕微光渗出，血红而炽烈；当你将瓶身贴近耳畔时，你几乎敢发誓——里面传来了一声若有若无的低语。
What wondrous liquid could fill such a vessel as this? Narrow, tall, and intricate in its form, the opaque glass shines both red and black with a smoky finish that lends further mystery to the bottle’s contents. A subtle light, blood-red and fiery, seems to emanate from within, and as you hold the bottle to your ear, you swear you hear a faint whisper from inside.

三足支架般的腿支撑着一个类人生物；它饱经风霜，身上斑驳覆着蓝绿色苔藓，有些还抽出细小的花。它是血肉、骨骼与植物物质的混合体——惊艳，却令人不寒而栗。它颈间垂挂着各式遗物，年代久远得惊人，皆以早已被遗忘的材料铸成。它紧握的数据板正不断倾泻出难以辨识的地理数据。
Tripod legs support a humanoid figure grizzled with patches of blue-green moss, some of which sprout small flowers. This creature is an amalgamation of flesh, bone, and plant matter—striking and yet unnerving. Around its neck hang various relics of remarkable age cast in long-forgotten materials. A datapad in its grip pours out indecipherable geodata.

一张张开的大口在你面前阴森逼近，仿佛你越靠近，它就越要打着哈欠般张得更阔。你小心探身窥向黑暗，感官所能捕捉到的信息寥寥无几：浓重的泥土与霉味，还有回荡不绝的滴答节奏……滴……滴……滴。那地狱般的滴落声究竟是什么？是水，还是更阴毒的东西？
A gaping maw looms before you, seeming to yawn ever wider upon your approach. The rich smell of earth and mold, and an echoing rhythm of drip… drip… drip represent the scant information that your senses reveal as you carefully peer into the darkness. What is that infernal dripping? Water, or something more sinister?

I Cast Augury Using Cards.name:
我用纸牌施展“占卜”
I Cast Augury Using Cards

Text.text:
我一张接一张地摆下牌面，口中低声覆诵吉凶之辞。一缕灵影落在其中一张牌上，又一缕，再有第三缕以命令之势压下。那张牌倒置而立，侍从与母亲暗中合谋。我向掌控整副牌阵的存在发问：会如何？将发生什么？而牌面作出了回应。
One by one, I place the cards and speak over them the phrases of weal and woe. A spirit comes to rest on one of the cards, another, then commanding a third. The card is upside down, the knave and mother in conspiracy. I ask a question of the entity in control of the set. How will it be? What will happen? And the cards respond.

一条布满碎石的土径被盘根错节缠绕着，蜿蜒穿过葱郁绿意，通向两座点缀着树木的丘陵相接之处，那里合成一道狭窄的峡谷，一股溪流从中细细潺湲。每一块石头都披着厚厚的苔藓。
A rock-strewn dirt path, tangled with roots, winds its way through the greenery to where two tree-dotted hills meet, forming a narrow ravine through which a stream trickles. Moss shrouds every stone.

那佝偻、腥臭的身影拖着尾巴在尘土里划过，光线掠过它磨损斑驳的鳞片，映出一层黯淡的光泽。一只独眼在龙颅空洞的眼窝中燃着猩红的微光，干枯的皮肉像腐烂的布条般从骨面上剥落垂挂。亡灵龙裔张开满是獠牙的口器，嘶声逸出，同时抬起一条骨骼嶙峋、带着利爪的肢体。
The slouched, foul-smelling figure drags its tail through the dust, the light catching the dull sheen of worn, mottled scales. A single eye, aglow with a crimson light, peers from the hollows of the draconic skull, desiccated flesh sloughing from it like strips of moldering cloth. A hiss escapes the undead dragonborn’s toothy maw as it raises a skeletal, clawed limb.

I Cast Fear Using A Feather.name:
我用一根羽毛施放恐惧
I Cast Fear Using A Feather

Text.text:
当我将手探入乙太，去召唤敌人最深的恐惧时，胃里倏然坠出一个深坑。咒文自唇间流出，我感到冰冷的汗珠顺着紧蹙的额头滑落，全部心神都锁在那根被我颤抖指尖捏住的纤白羽毛上。我知道这恐惧并非源自我身，却仍在我引导魔法、施放法术的瞬间，猛然席卷全身。
A pit grows in my stomach as I reach into the Ether to summon the worst fears of my enemy. I feel beads of cold sweat running down my creased brow as I recite the incantation, my focus totally on the delicate white feather in my trembling hand. I know the fear is not my own, yet it overtakes my body as I channel the magic and cast the spell.

Enchanter's Polo On Storm Field.name:
风暴原野上的附魔师马球
Enchanter's Polo On Storm Field

Text.text: [赛前] 阴沉压抑的乌云在体育场上空聚拢，煤灰般的云丝间隐隐噼啪闪着电芒。观众们的面孔藏在墨镜或护目镜后，坐进有宽大屋檐遮蔽的看台。玩家步入场地——一片褐黄、干裂的荒土，遍布竖立的避雷针。骑手穿着橡胶般的紧身衣，在鞍上稍一挪动便吱呀作响。斯特鲁提贡除了半盔外不带任何额外道具，头盔上还顶着会弹跳的触须天线。 [游戏中] 闪电直刺场地。玩家把球槌高举向天，盼着捕捉一道电弧。忽然一道雷霆落下，正中一名玩家的球槌，狂躁的能量瞬间灌满槌身。他抡槌猛击圆球，圆球以难以置信的速度破空飞射，滋滋作响的尾焰将整个体育场浸在炽亮的光里。斯特鲁提贡尖叫着追逐，更多雷声轰然砸下时，它们纵身跃起，急切想迎来属于自己的电击与占尽先机的爆发冲势。 [Before the Game] Dark, brooding clouds collect over the stadium, hints of energy crackling within the sooty-gray wisps. Fans, faces obscured by dark glasses or goggles, take to stands protected by wide roofs. The players enter the field—a barren stretch of tan, fissured earth with lightning rods placed throughout. The riders wear rubbery suits that squeak as they shift in their saddles. The Struttigons bear no extra gear aside from half shell helmets topped with bouncy antennae. [In Play] Lightning pierces down into the field. Players raise their mallets to the sky, hoping to catch an arc. A bolt finds purchase, filling a player’s mallet with hectic energy. They swing the mallet and smash the orb, which zooms through the air at incredible speed, its sizzling tail covering the stadium in brilliant light. Struttigons squawk and chase after it. They jump into the air as more thunder crashes, eager for their own jolt of lightning and an advantageous surge.

Call Lightning Resisted By Player.name:
闪电召唤被玩家抵抗
Call Lightning Resisted By Player

Text.text:
在痛苦与光芒的喧嚣中，一股韧性在你体内奔涌而起。你的身体，你的灵魂深处，开始嘶吼——不是因疼痛，而是因抗争。它斥退这道邪恶的雷矢，以及召唤它的魔法。听觉在一瞬间猛然回归，震得你踉跄；你睁开双眼，低头望向自己发光的身躯——依旧完好无损。硫磺的刺鼻气味仍在盘旋，但你以一口胜利的吐息将它吹散，迈过那折磨人的风暴，朝召来它的恶徒逼近。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Among the cacophony of agony and light, a surge of resilience wells within you. Your body, your very soul, begins to scream, not in pain but in defiance. It rebukes this fell bolt and the magic that summoned it. Your hearing returns in a sudden staggering instant, and your eyes open and look down upon your glowing body—still intact. The sulfuric scent lingers, but you blow it out in a triumphant exhalation and step beyond the torturous tempest, toward the miscreant who summoned it.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Bottle Of Myconid Spores.name:
菌菇人孢子瓶
Bottle Of Myconid Spores

Text.text:
这只怪异的水晶瓶里——乍看之下——空无一物。再细看，你会瞥见瓶中有东西在微微闪烁，宛如点点金色尘埃：那是一团几乎肉眼难辨的孢子云，漂浮翻涌。
The strange crystalline bottle contains—at first glance—nothing. Upon closer inspection, you spy something glimmering within, like motes of golden dust: spores, nearly invisible to the eye, floating in a cloud.

Medal Of Heroism.name:
英勇勋章
Medal Of Heroism

Text.text:
这枚庄严的勋章一面烙印着烈焰腾腾的盾徽图像；另一面则镌刻铭文，吟诵着英雄的赞歌。缎带触感细腻，光泽流转，染成尊贵的皇家红。
The image of a shield aflame emblazons one face of this honorable decoration. The other side bears an inscription singing heroic praises. The ribbon, smooth and glossy, is dyed a regal red hue.

半身人没注意到你。他们背对着你，正盯着一小团簇拥的兔子。他们用手指摩挲着肩上的箭囊，像是在权衡什么，却又停住。接着他们嗅了嗅空气，忽然拧身转向你——你只花了一瞬就意识到，他们已经搭好了一支箭。你看清他们脸上繁复的纹身：纹路勾出鹿角的形状，向上没入那蓬乱的头发里。他们放松了持弓的手臂，随即轻点了点自己的耳朵。“说清楚。”

~ 扮演者：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The halfling doesn’t notice you. They’re turned away, watching a small fluffle of rabbits. They finger the quiver over their shoulder, considering, but stop. They sniff at the air and suddenly twist to face you—it takes only a second for you to realize they’ve nocked an arrow already. You take in the intricate tattoos on their face, which form the shape of antlers and disappear up into their scruffy hair. They relax their bow arm then tap at their ear. “Speak clearly.”

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Grimy Street Busker.name:
肮脏街头艺人
Grimy Street Busker

Text.text:
披着一件褪色的雨披，一个街头艺人在喧嚣的十字路口蹲着，怀里抱着一把老式吉他，五根琴弦锈迹斑斑。头顶压着一顶褪了色的斯泰森牛仔帽。他仰起头望向天空，露出如树皮般虬结的皮肤，稀长的头发上结着风尘与泥垢，仿佛整条公路都黏在上面。他拨起旋律，放声唱起一支古老的美式民谣小调。那嗓音却出奇地轻柔，浓郁而圆润，被失落与渴望的岁月雕琢得温厚顺滑。
Draped in a faded poncho, a busker crouches at a busy intersection, cradling an old-time guitar with five rusty strings. A faded Stetson sits atop his head. He tilts back to gaze at the sky, exposing skin that is gnarled like the bark of a tree and lank hair encrusted with the dirt of the open road. He takes up a tune and belts out an old Americana ditty. His voice is surprisingly soft, carved rich and smooth by a life of loss and longing.

I Cast Jump From My Ring Of Jumping.name:
我从跳跃戒指上施放【跳跃术】
I Cast Jump From My Ring Of Jumping

Text.text: 我眯起眼估量距离，想象自己要么稳稳落地，要么啪地一声摔成一滩。“我能做到。”我心里一横，触动戒指里的魔法——像猫儿般蜷伏，蓄势待跃。起跳前一瞬，双腿涌上一股明亮、刺痒的能量，我猛地蹬地腾空。身形如离弦之箭划破空气，发梢与衣角被弹跃的力道拍打得猎猎作响。我确实安全落地，只是伴随着一声震得骨头发麻的砰响。 I judge the distance with a narrowed gaze, imaging myself either landing safely or splatting against the ground. “I can do it,” I think and tap into the magic of my ring—coiled like a cat, preparing to leap. My legs flush with a bright, tingling energy right before I launch myself off the ground. I fly through the air like an arrow loosed from a bowstring, hair and clothes buffeted by the force of my spring. I do land safely, albeit with a bone-jarring thud.

Sundries From An Astral Dreadnought.name:
星界恐惧兽的杂货
Sundries From An Astral Dreadnought

Text.text:
星界恐惧无畏者那庞然的躯壳，如失却生机的山岳般，漂浮在一片银辉云海之上。匆匆绕行一周，宛如卫星巡弋，却看不出这具泰坦般的尸骸上还粘附着任何值钱之物。
The astral dreadnought’s hulking form drifts lifelessly upon a sea of silvery clouds. A quick orbit, like a satellite, reveals nothing of pecuniary value clinging to the titanic corpse.

Dimension-phasing Cosmic Leviathan.name:
相位穿梭的宇宙利维坦
Dimension-phasing Cosmic Leviathan

Text.text:
一头庞大的生物在群星之间慵懒漂游，宛如巨鲸，尾端却裂作十余条扭动翻搅的触须。那头利维坦穿过一层薄纱般的帷幕，在你的视野里随之晕散，模样更像一只巨型乌贼。它又横越另一层帷幕，再度变幻，如今化作某种连心智都难以完整领会的存在。
A massive creature, like a whale with its tail split into a dozen writhing tentacles, drifts lazily among the stars. The leviathan passes through a thin veil and it blurs in your vision, looking more like a giant squid. It crosses another veil and shifts again, now into something the mind has trouble processing entirely.

这位皱脸的犬舍出身家伙打扮得一丝不苟，利落得像新磨的针。天蓝色缎面马甲衬得他那双深色眼睛里闪着火花，目光灼灼，牢牢钉在手头任何一桩“爪上活”上。他那条粉色领结端端正正地卡在颈部褶皱间，再怎么热切奔忙也从不塌垂。皮毛大多雪白，点缀着棕色斑块；其中一块讨喜的花斑覆在左脸与尖尖的左耳上。被逗笑时，他会爆出一声粗哑的狂笑，紧跟着是一阵哼哧哼哧的喷鼻。口袋里插着一方熨得笔挺的手帕，他用它娴熟地抹去因那明显的地包天偶尔溅出的零星口沫。
This wrinkle-faced kennelborn dresses sharp as a tack. A sky-blue satin vest brings out a sparkle in his dark eyes, which smolder intently on whatever task he has at paw. His pink bowtie, crisp under the folds of his neck, never droops even in his ardent hustle. His fur is mostly white with patches of brown; one charming splotch covering the left side of his face and pointed ear. When provoked to laughter, he bursts out into a throaty guffaw followed by a fit of snorting. A pressed handkerchief sits in his pocket, which he uses to deftly wipe away any stray spittle that might escape from his pronounced underbite.

Divine Gardens Of A Goddess Of Love.name:
爱之女神的神圣花园
Divine Gardens Of A Goddess Of Love

Text.text:
一座由石砌喷泉与精心造景组成的规整花园迎接你。这是对秩序、对形与式的安宁之爱。沿着园径向前，喷泉渐渐回归自然——碎石取代了石板，层层台地让位于溪岸。常春藤在花丛间匍匐，攀上树干。水声自唱它们的情歌。你穿过一座树木交织的拱门，踏入温暖的暮色草甸。翠绿草地上立着一张覆以柔软白色亚麻的华盖床，远处群山静默。夕阳沉落时，萤火虫飞出，忽明忽暗地眨着光。
A formal garden of stone fountains and landscaping welcomes you. This is the calming love of pattern and form. Along the garden path the fountains grow more natural—rocks instead of flagstones, terraces giving way to a creek bank. Ivy crawls among the flowers and climbs the trees. The waters sing their own love songs. You walk under an arboreal arch into a warm evening meadow. On the green grass stands a canopy bed of soft white linen, mountains in the distance. As the sun sets, fireflies come out to wink.

Intimidation Of A City Watchman.name:
对城卫的威吓
Intimidation Of A City Watchman

Text.text:
“我们在这里做的事，早已超出你那张小小法令文书的管辖。要是你还继续阻挠我们的任务，我保证你很快要操心的，绝不只是几桩微不足道的轻罪。”
“What we are doing here is beyond your little charter of laws. If you continue impeding our mission, I guarantee you will have a lot more to worry about than a few petty misdemeanors.”

Trisyra Sunscorch.name:
特里西拉·灼阳
Trisyra Sunscorch

Text.text:
这名精灵手执骑士盾与长剑，沉重的装备却未减她步伐的轻盈与优雅。她身着深绯色上衣与裙装，后者裁剪得格外利落，显然为战斗中的移动而生。她的发与眸皆是樱花般的淡粉色。举止高贵温婉，目光却始终警觉——新月般的虹膜随着周遭任何新声响或移动而迅捷游移。

~ Played by Dafrozenfuryplayz

Bearing a knightly shield and longsword, the weight of this elf’s equipment does not hinder the grace of her step. She wears a crimson red blouse and skirt, the latter garment noticeably tailored for ease of movement in battle. Her hair and eyes are the light pink of cherry blossoms. Though her demeanor is noble and gentle, her gaze is alert, crescent-moon irises darting to any new sound or movement in the vicinity.

~ Played by Dafrozenfuryplayz

Bustling Streets Of A Teeming Mega-metro.name:
喧嚣拥挤的巨型都会街道
Bustling Streets Of A Teeming Mega-metroplex

Text.text:
一道由自觉生命编织而成的活体锦缎如斑斓潮汐般漫灌城市街巷，随这座大都会的心跳起落涨退。来自银河每个角落的存在皆在此现身，带着各自古怪而耀目的风采。
A living tapestry of sentient life floods the streets of the city in a colorful tide, ebbing and flowing to the heartbeat of the metropolis. Beings from every corner of the galaxy are represented, in all their idiosyncratic glory.

Approaching An Ice Giant Planet.name:
逼近一颗冰巨行星
Approaching An Ice Giant Planet

Text.text:
世界在空间的虚无映衬下晶莹闪耀，宛如水晶。朦胧翻涌的大气昭示着刺骨寒冷、风暴肆虐的狂风；自轨道望去，冰川在冻结的河流、广袤的苔原与峻峭的冰峰之间闪烁着寒光。
The world gleams, crystalline, against the void of space. A hazy, swirling atmosphere hints at frigid, storm-wracked winds, and glaciers visible from orbit glisten amid frozen rivers, sprawling tundra, and icy peaks.

Elven Vale: Thunderstorm.name:
精灵谷：雷暴风雨
Elven Vale: Thunderstorm

Text.text:
森林的寂静被一记炸雷撕得粉碎，紧随其后的是倾盆雨幕。雨水毫不留情地兜头砸下，抽打着满枝绿叶，将覆苔的地面搅成一片泥泞沼泽。暴雨才落下几秒，你就已浑身湿透，四下寻找栖身之处，却一无所获——树木也被浸得透湿，根本挡不住这场狂雨。
The quiet of the forest vanishes with a peal of thunder, and a sheet of rain follows. It buckets down relentlessly, battering leafy branches and turning the mossy ground into a muddy morass. Within seconds of the downpour you are soaked and looking for shelter, but the quest proves fruitless, and the trees have become so sodden they offer no protection.

Loot From A Weretiger.name:
来自虎狼人身上的战利品
Loot From A Weretiger

Text.text:
虎人狼的武器品质精良，两件都被悉心保养——足见这名兽化者严明的武武修养。他们还随身携带少量用于交易的硬币，共计8枚金币。
The weretiger’s weapons are of exquisite quality, and both have been meticulously cared for—a testament to the lycanthrope’s martial discipline. They also carry a small amount of coin for trade totaling 8 gold pieces.

那道纤巧的有翼身影慵懒地沉浸在桑拿的蒸汽里，尽情享受这场焕新疗愈，以及它为她注入的蓬勃生机。四片巨大的薄翼如纱般舒展，任由蒸汽中的修复精油浸润其间，在从近旁窗户倾泻而入的柔和月光里微微流光。她以极致的温柔，将每一片翼小心折回身侧——像怀抱婴孩般轻轻托着——一边揉按那细腻脆薄的翼膜。

~ Inbal 于 Discord

The lithe, winged figure luxuriates in the steam of the sauna, relishing the rejuvenating treatment and the vitality it brings her. Four large, gossamer wings are spread wide, soaking up the restorative oils in the steam as they glimmer in the soothing light of the moon spilling through the nearby window. With utmost care, she folds each of her wings into her body—cradling them like a child—as she massages the delicate membranes.

~ Inbal on Discord

这柄连枷与你曾经拿过、甚至见过的任何一柄都不一样——武器的锤头几乎与那根橡木长柄同样粗长，仿佛由一根铂金长条铸成，其上嵌着硕大却未经切琢的宝石。
This flail is unlike any you have handled or ever seen before—the head of the weapon is nearly as large and long as the oak haft itself, and fashioned from what looks like a rod of platinum studded with large but uncut gems.

Loot From A Phase Spider.name:
相位蜘蛛的战利品
Loot From A Phase Spider

Text.text:
八条布满蓝色斑点的腿蜷缩挤作一团，甲壳相互碾压，发出脆裂的喀嚓声。它忽隐忽现了几次后，那股飘渺的牵引终于减弱。尸体被留在这个位面上，任你检查与搜刮。你端详那对乌黑如墨的颚钳，发现仍有油亮的毒液在缓缓渗出。你小心翼翼地以凿击般的刺入撬弄，终于将这截肢体硬生生扯了下来。这毒液用途颇多，比如涂抹在武器上，或调制成致命的药剂。至于颚钳本身，若交由技艺娴熟的匠人处理，也许能改造成一对阴狠的匕首。
The eight blue-speckled legs crinkle together in a chitinous crunch. After a few flickers in and out of sight, the ethereal pull weakens. The corpse is left in this plane, free to examine and plunder. You study the jet-black mandibles and find an oily venom still secreting. With a few careful chiseling stabs, you wrench the appendage free. The venom might be used in a number of ways, like to coat a weapon or to create a deathly tincture. The mandibles, too, if handled by a practiced artisan, might be converted into a pair of nefarious daggers.

巨狼几乎不费力地在雪地里潜行，尽管体型庞大，却因一身无瑕的白毛而极易让人看丢。它的头颅有条不紊地左右摆动，搜寻着区域；淡蓝色的眼睛一旦掠过光线，便映出冷冽的幽辉。它呼出的不是一团团热气，而是一缕缕冰寒的蓝色雾流。
The massive wolf slinks through the snow with little effort, its spotless white coat making it easy to lose despite its size. The beast's head moves back and forth methodically as it scans the area, pale blue eyes gleaming when they catch the light. Its breath doesn't emerge as puffs of hot air, but streams of frigid blue.

这名年迈的龟族以历经无数次遭遇战磨砺出的自信挺立着——他身上的累累伤痕，就是最好的证明。他高大魁梧，体型敦实，深蓝的鳞甲如铠在身；尽管年代已高，却仍像随时能在眨眼间扑入战场。外露的侵略性被一份讨喜的莽劲儿轻轻压住，而那双幽暗的眼里点着沉稳的智慧，仿佛早已看过无数挚友与宿敌一同倒下。他随身只带极少的求生补给，够在路上勉强度日；而他始终把一柄巨大的双手大槌放在伸手可及之处，槌头被数十年的使用磨得光滑圆润。

~ Played by Oscar Mike with

The old turtlefolk holds himself with a confidence borne of countless skirmishes—and he bears the scars to prove it. Towering, stocky, and armored in dark blue scales, the turtlefolk—despite his advanced age—appears ready to spring into battle at a moment’s notice. A charming brashness tempers his outward aggression, and a wisdom alights in dark eyes that have no doubt seen the fall of countless friends and foes alike. He carries scant survival supplies, just enough to subsist on while on the road, and he keeps close at hand a massive two-handed maul with a head worn smooth by decades of use.

~ Played by Oscar Mike with

Taunt From An Outnumbered Warrior.name:
一名寡不敌众的战士的嘲讽
Taunt From An Outnumbered Warrior

Text.text:
“哦，神祇……你把整个村子都招到我们头上了！算你倒霉，我刚把这把斧子磨得锋利，正愁找不到个理由用它。”
"Oh, gods… You've brought the whole village down upon us! Unlucky for you, I just sharpened this axe and have been looking for a reason to use it."

Speech About A Lost Love.name:
关于一段逝去的爱的演说
Speech About A Lost Love

Text.text:
“光是回忆起他们的笑容，曾经就能为我的人生带来那样的光亮。我无数次回到那个瞬间，它早已被磨损、被压平——就像雕塑上的棱角被雨水一遍遍抚平。我在这凄惨的存在里日复一日地凿刻、打磨，直到最后只剩下冰冷的石头。”
“Just the memory of their smile used to bring such light to my life. I have returned to that moment so many times, it’s been worn down, flattened, like features on a sculpture being smoothed by rain. I have spent each day of my miserable existence chiseling and grinding it down until only the cold stone remains.”

I Write Poetry To Release Stress.name:
我写诗来释放压力
I Write Poetry To Release Stress

Text.text:
思绪在我脑海里盘旋，像天鹅巡游湖面。我从中捞起一缕，抓进笔记本里划下去——一股文字的细流在纸页上蜿蜒，贴着一段段名为“认知”的小小堤岸流过；水势在转弯处拐折，被自觉的涡旋刻出印记。这些并非终点，只是令人愉悦的岔路。我划掉一个词，在上方写了另外两个，每个后面都打着一个问号。
Thoughts circle in my mind like swans patrolling a lake. I pluck one of them out and scratch it into my notebook, a stream of words that meanders across the page, running along little banks of recognition where the flow curves and is marked by eddies of self-awareness. These are not destinations but rather pleasant detours. I cross out a word and write two others above it, each with a question mark.

Vampire's Manor: Upper Hall.name:
吸血鬼（特征）的庄园：上层大厅
Vampire's Manor: Upper Hall

Text.text:
上层大厅俯瞰下方的用餐空间，一道摇摇欲坠的栏杆将敞开的走廊与房间中央悬着、沾满污垢的枝形吊灯隔开。大厅两端各悬着一颗兽首，钉在木质匾板上，皆已无皮无毛。它们骷髅般的面容长角狰狞、怒目圆睁，空洞的眼眶仿佛随着你的一举一动而转动。
The upper hall overlooks the dining space below, a rickety banister separating the open corridor from the grime-streaked chandelier hanging in the center of the room. At each end of the hall, a bestial head hangs mounted on a wooden plaque, both of them devoid of flesh and fur. Their skeletal visages, horned and glaring, seem to follow your movements with hollow eyes.

这副镣铐由银亮的合金打造而成。它没有锁链，而是将双手紧紧束在一起。杯状的护盖会迫使除最小的手之外的所有手掌都蜷成拳。符文与标记在金属上交织成幽蓝的发光纹路，汇入刻蚀其上的诡秘异界法阵。只要凝视那些符号，思绪便会像被雾气浸透般发沉发蒙。
A silvery alloy makes up these manacles. Lacking a chain, they instead bind the hands close together. The cuplike caps would force all but the smallest hands into a fist. Runes and symbols form glowing blue patterns on the metal, joining in etched eldritch diagrams. Looking at the symbols makes the mind feel foggy.

Potion Of Healing.name:
治疗药水
Potion Of Healing

Text.text:
在迎合冒险者与其他高危行当的店铺里，这种东西随处可见；你一眼就认出那只塞着瓶塞、装满朱红液体的小瓶——一瓶标准的治疗药水。冒险者最好的朋友——瓶中之命！
Readily available in shops catering to adventurers and others in dangerous professions, you instantly recognize the stoppered vial full of vermilion liquid as a standard potion of healing. The adventurer’s best friend—life in a bottle!

术士的尸体蜡黄消瘦，仿佛死亡在刹那间让他们又老去了一生。宽大的绯红长袍如殓衣般裹住躯体，旁边一本阴森的魔典摊开着。
The warlock’s corpse is sallow and gaunt, as if death aged them a lifetime once over. Voluminous crimson robes envelop the body like a funeral shroud, and a sinister grimoire lies open nearby.

Speech About The Freedom Of The Forest.name:
关于森林自由的演说
Speech About The Freedom Of The Forest

Text.text:
“你感觉不到吗？洁净的空气穿过你的肺叶，脚下纠结的林地被生命的脉络交织纵横……这片森林无边无际。若在其中迷失，便是真正的自由。这里除却自由与绿意别无他物——那绿浓烈得令人目眩，仿佛你会永远坠入其中。”
“Can you not feel it? The clean air filtering through your lungs, the matted ground crisscrossed with life… This forest is endless. To lose yourself in it would be to become truly free. There is nothing here but freedom and green, a green so vivid you could fall into it forever.”

Reconstituted Krill \"Fish And Chips\" M.name:
复水磷虾“炸鱼薯条”套餐
Reconstituted Krill "Fish And Chips" Meal

Text.text:
把这玩意儿叫鱼，简直是对全世界海洋生灵的侮辱。这团重新拼凑的烂糊糊散发着浓烈的海腥味，但更像是破败海滨小镇里垃圾遍地的海滩，而不是热带海岸那种白沙耀眼、风光如画的景致。
To call this stuff fish is an insult to marine life everywhere. The reconstituted mess smells strongly of the ocean, but more the garbage-strewn beaches of rundown coastal towns than the glittering white sand vistas of tropical shores.

Hoof Maloof & Bardstone In Winter.name:
冬日里的蹄子·马鲁夫与吟石
Hoof Maloof & Bardstone In Winter

Text.text:
一群人围在吟游诗人石像旁，戴着手套的手掩着嘴偷笑。显然有人恶作剧——雕像如今长出了驴耳朵、兔牙般的门齿，还有一条又长又滑稽的尾巴。“哎呀，”有人咯咯笑道，“谁——谁干的呀？”这句故作严肃的感叹很快被一阵更响的憋笑吞没。

围观者中有萨利赫·马卢夫，他是附近胡夫·马卢夫马厩的家主。“谁呢，的确？”他问着，目光扫向马厩——两个小男孩，他的儿子们，正飞快钻进门内消失不见。一匹马嘶鸣了一声，听起来竟像是在大笑。
A group of people stand around the Bardstone, hiding giggles behind gloved hands. A bit of mischief is afoot, for the statue now features donkey’s ears, buck teeth, and a long tail. “Oh my,” someone titters. “Wh-who could have done this?” Their grave comment is lost to a fit of giggles. One of the spectators is Saleh Maloof, head of the family who owns the nearby Hoof Maloof stables. “Who, indeed?” he asks, and his gaze scans to the stables as two young boys—his sons—disappear quickly inside. A horse whinnies in a way that sounds very much like laughter.

Professor Edward Owilson.name:
爱德华·欧威尔森教授
Professor Edward Owilson

Text.text:
你面前这位衣着考究的侏儒，正利落地调整一对华丽黄铜臂铠上的按扣与系带。臂铠盘绕着铜质导线，嵌着玻璃结节，里面封存着噼啪作响的奥术能量。斜挎在他躯干上的弹带塞满了瓶瓶罐罐与试管，每一支都呈现不同的色泽，盛着液体、气体，以及大多数人闻所未闻的物质形态。他那撮白色山羊胡打理得一丝不苟，抹了油，尖尖地束成一撮。

~ Played by Atreides Ghola

The sharply-dressed gnome before you adjusts the snaps and straps on a pair of ornate brass gauntlets coiled with copper wiring and glass nodules filled with crackling, arcane energy. A bandolier across the gnome’s torso brims with bottles and vials, each a different color, containing liquids, gases, and states of matter yet unknown to most. He keeps his white goatee smartly maintained and oiled to a point.

~ Played by Atreides Ghola

I Use Open Hand Technique.name:
我使出徒手战技
I Use Open Hand Technique

Text.text:
在接连几记疾如骤雨的打击间隙，我将一只手——掌缘如刃——微微一旋，只偏转了几度，便刺向一簇神经，那正是对手维系平衡的要害所在。另一只手紧随其后。他们说，拳头——无论是握紧长剑，还是当作自己的骨锤——才是斗士的武器；可我以这双张开的手，将平衡刻成失衡。
In the midst of several rapid strikes, I turn one hand—shaped like a blade—just a few degrees and aim for a cluster of nerves, precisely where my opponent’s balance is kept. The other hand follows. They say the fist, whether closed around a sword or used as its own mace, is the weapon of a fighter, but with these open hands I carve balance into imbalance.

Woman Weeping In The Rain.name:
雨中啜泣的女人
Woman Weeping In The Rain

Text.text:
污泥溅满这座小镇阴沉建筑的每一面墙，暴雨如鼓点般砸落，把泥浆拍上墙去；雨点敲击着铁皮屋顶，响声像走调的木琴，刺耳又空洞。你看着一群身着灰衣、灰头土脸的人在糊满泥泞的街道上拖着步子前行，他们的动作却把你的目光牵向那唯一一动不动的身影。一个孤零零的半身人女子蜷坐在地上，前后摇晃，哭声凄厉得穿透倾盆雨幕，直直钻进你的耳朵。
Sludge splatters every wall of the grim buildings in this town, splashed up by the pelting of heavy rain which plays on tinned roofs like a warped xylophone. You watch gray-garbed and -faced people shuffle their way through the mud-caked streets, their movements drawing your attention to the singly immobile figure. A lonely halfling woman rocks back and forth on the ground, her weeping so loud it reaches your ears above the sound of the deluge.

Freeing A Ship Stuck In Ice.name:
解救一艘被冰封困住的船
Freeing A Ship Stuck In Ice

Text.text:
尽管船长与领航员的筹划已臻完善，船却已无可置疑地卡死在航道里——凭着自身的速度与重量，被数块漂浮的冰板死死楔住，而这些冰板也早已无处可退。艏楼上命令声不绝于耳，船长指挥着瑟瑟发抖的水手们，用镐子，甚至用从船上厨房顺手搜来的刀具，将船一点点撬松。舵手也绷紧全身的力气，小心挪动舵柄，借着航道的水流，去帮那群倒霉的水手把这艘船从冰的齿缝里拖出来。

~ Jaman 构想

Despite the best plans of the captain and his navigator, the ship has become unquestionably stuck in the channel, wedged from its own speed and weight in several floating slabs of ice that simply have nowhere left to move. Orders are shouted down unceasingly from the forecastle, as the captain directs his shivering crewmen to work the ship loose with picks and even knives scavenged from the ship’s galley. Straining with the effort, the helmsman moves the tiller carefully, using the channel’s current to aid the hapless sailors in their labor.

~ Envisioned by Jaman

Bard Victory Line.name:
吟游诗人的胜利台词
Bard Victory Line

Text.text:
“你的歌已然终止，取而代之的不是恢弘的管弦齐奏，而是一个醉醺醺的小号手可怜的吱吱乱响。”
“Your song has ended, and instead of a great orchestral swell, it is the pathetic squeaking of a drunk trumpeter.”

Tournament Celebrating The Marriage Of T.name:
庆祝两位王室联姻的比武大会
Tournament Celebrating The Marriage Of Two Royals

Text.text:
鸽群铺满长空，号角嘹亮回荡，人群爆发出雷鸣般的欢呼。王家马车披覆着层层花环，驶入比武场，王后与她的新夫婿满面光彩，向狂热的人潮挥手致意。护送这对新人的，是参加比武大会的骑士们；他们战马的鬃毛被丝带编成辫，随步伐轻颤。
Doves fill the air, trumpets peal, and the crowd erupts with applause. Covered in a mass of garlands, the royal carriage enters the list, and the queen and her new husband glow with happiness as they wave to the exuberant crowds. Escorting the newlyweds are knights competing in the tourney, the manes of their steeds braided with ribbons.

当你踏入墓园，一声乌鸦的聒噪撕破死寂。庭院里，陈旧破碎的墓碑一排排立着，像一张张无貌的苍白面孔——碑文早被时代的侵蚀磨得模糊不清。墓园后方，一列列陵寝勾勒出边界，仿佛一处阴沉的街区。盘结扭曲的树木艰难地攥住残叶，一小群乌鸦俯冲而下，落在枝头栖停。远处，你看见一个类人身影正挥铲掘土，只有最稀薄的声响传来：铁锹碰上坚硬土层时的清脆叮当，以及泥土被抛到身后时轻柔的簌落声。
A raven’s caw breaks the silence of the dead as you enter the cemetery. Aged and broken tombstones line the courtyard like featureless pale faces—inscriptions eroded by the ravages of time. Lines of mausoleums mark the back of the cemetery, forming a grim neighborhood. The knotted and twisted trees struggle to hold onto their leaves as a small conspiracy of ravens descends to perch upon them. Off in the distance, you see a humanoid form shoveling up dirt, the barest amount of sound reaching you: the shovel clinking as it meets with the hard soil, and the soft fall as it is thrown behind the figure.

Ring Of Earth Elemental Command.name:
大地元素号令之戒
Ring Of Earth Elemental Command

Text.text:
这枚戒指由高度抛光的花岗岩制成，你将它翻来覆去端详时，掌心却感到出奇地沉重。戒面镶着一颗粗磨的琥珀弧面宝石；它并不发光，却在接触时散发出温润的暖意。
This ring, fashioned from highly polished granite, seems oddly heavy in your hand as you look it over. A rough cabochon gem of amber is set into the ring, and while it does not glow, it exudes a warmth to the touch.

这名高大的类人生物皮肤如炉火炽炭般发光，身周也散发出同样灼人的热浪。一对近乎恶魔般的犄角从颅顶耸起，另有一双尖耳相伴。它目光阴鸷而傲慢，身披华美夺目的护甲，灿若黄铜的辉光流淌其上，手中握着一柄缠绕烈焰的长刃。鼻孔喷出一声嘶嘶蒸汽，生物便向你逼近。
The towering humanoid's skin glows like the hot coals of a fire, and a similar heat radiates from them. A pair of horns, almost devil-like, crest their skull, along with a pair of pointed ears. They glower, haughty, garbed in resplendent armor a glorious shade of brass, and wielding a blade wreathed in flame. With a hiss of steam from their nostrils, the creature comes toward you.

Loot From An Undead Legion.name:
亡灵军团的战利品
Loot From An Undead Legion

Text.text:
这些噩梦般的战士在蜕变之前究竟是谁，几乎已无从辨认。你在军团破碎的白骨、扭曲的肢体与腐烂的尸骸间翻检，只在满地屠戮中发现零星可怜的值钱物。仅有散落的255枚金币钱币、几颗合计价值250枚金币的宝石，以及几瓶塞紧瓶塞的基础药水——这就是你在战场上找到的全部宝藏。
Little remains of the people these nightmarish warriors were before their transformation. Picking over the shattered bones, twisted limbs and rotted bodies of the legion reveals a meagre smattering of valuables strewn amongst the carnage. Coins amounting to 255 gold pieces, a few precious stones all together worth 250 gold pieces, and a few basic potions in stoppered vials, are the only treasure you find on the battlefield.

Loot From A Black Pudding.name:
来自黑布丁的战利品
Loot From A Black Pudding

Text.text: 黑色布丁怪发出令人作呕的blorp声，沿着不久前受害者的残骸四周融化塌落。一具几乎完整的骷髅（特征）披着一件黯黑斗篷，紧贴其身，仿佛新生的皮肤。你瞥见一把锯齿匕首，以及约二十枚散落在腐败黏泥中的金币。 The black pudding gives a sickening blorp and melts down around the remains of a recent victim. A skeleton, nearly whole, is draped in a dark cloak that clings like a new skin. You spot a serrated dagger and about twenty loose gold pieces scattered in the putrefaction.

Haunted Castle: Exploring The Halls.name:
闹鬼城堡：探索长廊
Haunted Castle: Exploring The Halls

Text.text:
这座城堡早已不再是栖身之所，可当你穿行于它的长廊之间，那种闯入他人领地的感觉却怎么也挥之不去。掀翻的椅子、撕裂的挂毯、厚重的尘埃与纠结的蛛网，无不诉说着灾祸与荒弃；然而转眼你又窥见别的房间，仿佛有人只是刚刚离开：织机上仍绷着丝线，一队玩具士兵排开阵势投入无休止的鏖战，一张床的毯子凌乱起伏，像是有人才从那份温暖里起身。
The castle has not been a home for some time, but as you walk its halls you can’t escape the sense that you trespass. Overturned chairs, torn tapestries, dust, and cobwebs speak to calamity and abandonment, but then you spy other rooms where it seems like someone just left: a loom still strung with thread, a set of toy soldiers arrayed in an endless battle, a bed with blankets rumpled as if someone has just left its comfort.

Lutris The Otter.name:
露特里斯·水獭
Lutris The Otter

Text.text:
在翻涌起泡的海水间欢快嬉戏的，是一只非同寻常的水獭。他的护甲仿佛海之传承的明证，以贝壳与海藻编织铸就，巧夺天工地贴合他修长灵活的鼬科身形。护甲的缝隙间隐约可见银亮的毛色，像是在诉说往昔一场惨烈鏖战的余痕。他携着一块幽黑而闪烁的石头——被大海不知疲倦的抚触磨得圆润光滑——腰侧皮鞘里还安放着一枚雕琢过的蛤壳，随海流懒懒摇摆。他把头微微偏向一侧，那双湛蓝眼眸闪着锐利的聪慧，捕捉到阳光在漂移浪尖上的点点反光。

~ Played by Anubuss

Frolicking happily through the foaming waters is an otter of remarkable nature. His armor is a testament to his nautical heritage, composed of shells and kelp and expertly crafted to fit his lithe mustelid frame. Silvered fur can be seen between gaps in the armor, hints of a great struggle in the past. He carries a shimmering black stone—worn smooth by the relentless caress of the sea—and a sculpted clam shell rests in a leather sheath at his hip, swaying lazily in the ocean currents. Cocking his head to one side, his cerulean eyes—sparkling with a keen intelligence—catch the sunlight glinting off the drifting waves.

~ Played by Anubuss

高个修长的年轻人长着精灵般尖尖的耳朵，却蓄着胡须，头顶光洁，泛着绿意的皮肤上刻着如纹身般的符纹。他戴着手套抬手，吸了一口快要燃尽的香烟——跳动的火星映在精工打造的缟玛瑙戒指与镶宝护腕上——随即从他扁平上翘的鼻子里吐出一缕烟。一声猫头鹰的啼叫发出警告。男人把烟头一脚踩灭，转身迎向逼近的威胁。他走起路来带着胸膛宽厚的兽人般的傲劲，鳞甲叮当作响；他耸肩将盾牌顶到位，从棕色风衣下抽出一把左轮。眼罩上方露出的黄色眼睛微微发亮，泛着催眠般的幽光；他咧嘴一笑，迫不及待迎接这场致命的抛硬币：你赢，或者你死。

~ Played by Eze Oyiye

The tall and slender young man has pointed ears like an elf, but is bearded, smooth-headed, and has tattoo-like markings on his greenish skin. He lifts a gloved hand to take a drag on his dwindling cigarette—the flaring ember glinting on a skillfully wrought onyx ring and a jeweled bracer—then exhales smoke through his flat, upturned nose. An owl hoots a warning. The man stamps out the butt and turns toward the oncoming threat. He moves with the swagger of a barrel-chested orc, scale mail clinking as he shrugs his shield into position and draws a revolver from beneath his brown duster. Yellow eyes, visible over his eyeshades, glow faintly with a hypnotic glimmer, and he grins, eager for the deadly coin toss that is battle: you win, or you die.

~ Played by Eze Oyiye

East Fork Chamber.name:
东支流密室
East Fork Chamber

Text.text:
南侧岔道以东有一处小小的哨点兼藏身处。木箱的箱盖塌陷下去，像一张椅面；紧贴岩壁、收拾得齐整的火坑里躺着一截断裂的烟斗管，以及一只空烟草袋烧焦后的残骸。
To the east of the southern forking passageway is a small watch post or hideaway. The top on the crate sags like a chair seat, and the firepit tucked neatly against the rock has a broken pipe and the burned remains of an empty tobacco bag in it.

Loot From A Nest Of Aberrant Rats.name:
畸变鼠巢的战利品
Loot From A Nest Of Aberrant Rats

Text.text:
你杀死的老鼠终于不再抽搐，眼中的幽光迅速黯淡，化作更熟悉的黑色亮珠。它们的嘴巴无力地张着，露出沾血的齿列。巢穴里遍布骸骨：猫的、狗的、鸟的，还有至少四具类人生物的遗骸。你继续深入这处恶臭的洞窟，在污水浸渍的白骨间，竟发现了几样真正值钱的东西。一只被肢解的枯骨手掌戴着一串银戒，手指紧攥，像一只死蜘蛛蜷缩的腿。一枚精致的奖章垂在金链上，挂在某个胸腔的肋骨之间。还有一只装得鼓鼓的天鹅绒小袋，静静躺在一滩昏黑的水洼里，用一根银色细绳系得紧紧的。
The rats you’ve killed cease to move, the glow in their eyes darkening to the more familiar black, shining beads. Their mouths hang slack, exposing blood-stained teeth. The den is riddled with skeletons: cats, dogs, birds, and at least four humanoids. You press further into the stinking den and find amid the sewage-stained bones pieces of real value. A dismembered skeletal hand bears a set of silver rings, fingers clenched like the legs of a dead spider. A fine medallion hangs on a golden chain within a rib cage. A velvet pouch, full, sits idle in a dark puddle, tied shut with a silvery string.

Mantle Of Madness.name:
疯狂斗篷
Mantle Of Madness

Text.text:
你双手颤抖，口中吐出古老而亵渎的词句，自虚空中将一枚黑金属的箍环唤至——那是空间与空间之间、不可理解的空间。箍环在你的目标颅骨周围合拢，与其说是王冠，不如说是镣铐。金属熔接定形的瞬间，目标的眼眸沉黑下去，神情松弛又扭曲。困惑先将其淹没——旋即被阴狠而恶毒的意图取而代之。
Your hands tremble as you speak words ancient and profane, calling forth a circlet of black metal from the void—the incomprehensible space between spaces. The circlet forms around the skull of your target, more manacle than crown. As the metal fuses in place, the target’s eyes darken, their expression slackening, contorting. Confusion overtakes them—soon replaced with a wicked and malicious intent.

一盏孤灯从这间狭小密室的高顶钩环上垂挂而下，成为这间无窗房里唯一的光源。狭窄的入口被一扇沉重的门封死——厚实木料以金属箍束紧，外层还覆着焦油。门与门框严丝合缝，内侧既无把手也无锁孔。房间中央孤零零地摆着一把结实的木椅，螺栓牢牢钉死在地面。椅子的扶手与椅腿上铆着铁镣，另有一只固定头部的夹具，几乎无需多想便能明白它的用途。
A single lantern hangs from a hook embedded in the high ceiling of this tiny chamber, the only illumination in the windowless room. The narrow entry is blocked by a heavy door crafted of thick timbers bound in metal and coated with tar. It fits tightly into its jamb with no handle or lock on the inside. A chair of sturdy wood, bolted to the floor, sits alone in the center of the room. Iron manacles attached to the arms and legs of the chair as well as a clamp for the head leave little doubt as to its purpose.

Loot From A Seelie Queen.name:
来自精灵仙后（Seelie Queen）的战利品
Loot From A Seelie Queen

Text.text:
在她起伏如浪的发丝间，陨落的女王戴着一顶银色小冠，冠面以层叠回旋的浪尖纹样铸成。深红的红宝石被切割成樱桃般的形状，自她尖尖的耳垂垂落。她的手仍紧握着权杖：一段淡如白桦的木枝，顶端簇拥着新鲜的叶片，仍柔韧可供接触。那木枝还散发着明亮的清香，仿佛从未被从树上折下。
Nestled in the waving tresses of her hair, the fallen queen wears a silver diadem fashioned in a looping pattern of cresting waves. Dark red rubies cut into the shapes of cherries hang from her pointed ears. Her hand still holds her scepter: a branch of wood pale as birch and crowned with fresh leaves still pliable to the touch. The branch also still has a bright aroma, as if it had never been shorn from its tree.

Quip About The Leader Of The Party.name:
调侃队伍领袖
Quip About The Leader Of The Party

Text.text:
“真是不可思议——尽管我们彼此不同，我们仍能并肩作战、相互敬重，哪怕大家都心知肚明：我才是最强的。你们在我这般伟大面前仍能保持谦卑与敬畏，我由衷感激。”
“It is so incredible that, despite our differences, we can fight together and respect one another, even when we all know that I am the strongest. Your humbleness and reverence in the face of my greatness is sincerely appreciated.”

Dwarven City Square.name:
矮人城镇广场
Dwarven City Square

Text.text:
这片宽阔的广场给人一种井然有序、精确无误的感觉。所有建筑等高，街道从两侧以同样的位置贯入其中，而你毫不怀疑——若真去丈量，它必会被证实为一个完美的正方形。但每一面立墙都是一件艺术品。装饰与雕像取代了招牌的必要：每一家商号或行会都以其建筑本身揭示自身的性质。
This broad plaza gives an impression of orderliness and precision. All the buildings are of equal height, the streets enter at the same position on each side, and you’ve no doubt that if you measured, it would prove to be a perfect square. But every façade is a work of art. Decorations and statues replace the need for signs, as each business or guild reveals its nature through architecture.

Rikard, Priest Of The Moon Goddess.name:
里卡德，月之女神的祭司
Rikard, Priest Of The Moon Goddess

Text.text:
夜里，他身披蓝色祭袍跪地祈祷。圣带上以银线绣着他女神——月亮——的盈亏轮转。他未覆头的金发如海滩细沙般浅淡，垂落肩头；那双微微上挑的眼睛，是海水的颜色。他瘦高挺拔，却因少年时在地下世界辗转而被岁月磨得粗砺。此刻，他沉静的克制与谦卑印证着他的诚实；而他的弩与链枷，皆为那道银色光辉效命——海洋之母。

~ Played by Alice

He genuflects by night in priestly robes of blue. The phases of his goddess, the Moon, are embroidered in silver on the stole. His uncovered blond hair is sandy as a beach and falls to his shoulders, his upturned eyes the colors of the sea. He’s lean and tall, but worn rough by a youth spent in the underworld. His calm reserve and humility prove his honesty now, and his crossbow and flail serve the silver light, the mother of oceans.

~ Played by Alice

Gnoll In The Dark.name:
黑暗中的豺狼人
Gnoll In The Dark

Text.text:
一颗狰狞的鬣狗头颅自上方俯瞰着你，那生物庞大的类人身躯在火把光圈的边缘撕开黑暗。腐肉与干涸血迹的恶臭从它肮脏的皮毛上飘来；它那双昏黄的眼睛燃起嗜杀的血欲，野兽开始绕着你踱步。布满獠牙的巨口大张，涎水滴落，仿佛已迫不及待要将肉从骨上撕扯下来。它绷紧筋肉，蓄势一跃，准备扑上来攻击。
A grotesque hyena head leers down at you as the creature’s massive humanoid body breaks the darkness at the edge of your torchlight. The smell of rotting flesh and dried blood wafts off a filthy hide, and its yellow eyes blaze with a murderous bloodlust as the beast begins to circle you. A tooth-lined maw hangs open, drooling with the anticipation of tearing meat from bone. Its sinewy muscles tighten as it prepares to leap forward and attack.

Half-orc's Moment Of Relentless Enduranc.name:
半兽人：不屈耐力的瞬间
Half-orc's Moment Of Relentless Endurance

Text.text:
“你以为逮到我了？你没逮到。老子这副身子还有一口气，这只手还攥得住。来吧，肉块。”
“You think you got me? You don’t got me. There’s still breath in this body and grip in this hand. Here we go, meat.”

香炉的铜与黄铜早已失了光泽，泛着一层青绿的铜锈。金属表面龟裂翘起，仿佛干枯脆裂的皮肤。香炉上繁复的巴洛克纹饰令人联想到窥视的眼与利齿森然的巨口；当系着的链条叮当作响，墨一般的烟雾便渗出般流淌而出。
The copper and brass of the thurible is tarnished, tinged with a green patina. The metal appears cracked, lifted like dry and brittle skin. The ornate, baroque design set into the censer evokes peering eyes and toothy maws, and as the attached chain rattles, inky smoke bleeds forth.

Ranger's Supply Cabin.name:
游侠补给小屋
Ranger's Supply Cabin

Text.text:
一条极易错过的鹿径蜿蜒深入盘根错节的密林深处；在那里，一道苔藓垂幕之后，藏着一间补给小屋。简陋的原木屋内，风干架上挂着腌熏肉；粗麻袋里装着成量的谷物、引火柴，甚至还有采来的蘑菇。临时钉起的搁板上摆着制箭所需的工具与物资——羽毛、柔韧的木条，还有用来打制箭头的工具与石料。由扭绞晾干的树皮编成的绳索垂挂着，一圈圈盘成50英尺的线圈。
An easily missed deer trail leads further into the knotted copse, and there, concealed behind a curtain of moss, lies the supply cabin. Inside the simple log structure preserved meat hangs from drying racks and burlap sacks hold quantities of grain, kindling, even foraged mushrooms. Tools and supplies for fletching sit on a makeshift shelf—feathers, supple wood, even tools and stone for knapping arrowheads. Rope comprised of twisted and dried bark hangs in 50-foot coils.

Desert Beneath A Hungry Sun.name:
饥阳之下的沙漠深处
Desert Beneath A Hungry Sun

Text.text:
荒凉的景色在你眼前铺陈开来：田野赤裸无草，丘陵褪尽林木。此地偶有雨水落下，也会立刻被贪婪的烈日迅速榨干。可即便如此，这片荒漠的风光依旧带着一种粗粝而坚韧的美。
The landscape lies bare before you: fields naked of grass, hills unclothed by trees. What little rain falls over this region finds itself swiftly stripped away again by the hungry sun. But still, the view of this desert possesses a rugged beauty.

Quip About Marching In The Rain.name:
雨中行军的俏皮话
Quip About Marching In The Rain

Text.text:
“雨把世界磨得柔软；当它轻轻落向大地，万物都得去寻一处静默的栖身之所。它赐下一刻沉思与独处。唯独我们——我们得走下去。”
“Rain softens the world; when it gently falls to the earth, all must seek quiet shelter. It provides a moment of contemplation and solitude. Except for us—we have to walk.”

Minor Visual Illusion.name:
微型视觉幻象
Minor Visual Illusion

Text.text:
只需一小缕绒毛与一个简单的戏法，你便能创造出一个逼真的魅影物体，肉眼几乎无法分辨其与真品的差别。
Requiring nothing more than a small wisp of fleece and a simple cantrip, you create a convincing phantom object indistinguishable from the real thing to the naked eye.

你可以用这个法术做许多事，但每次施放，它都会带来一股安宁——即便身处最糟糕的境地。借由它，你触及世界的灵魂，与这片天地自生的灵交流。哪怕除此之外一无所获，也值得为那份笃定去施放。
You can use this spell to do many things, but casting it always brings a sense of calm—even in the worst situations. Through it you contact the soul of the world and commune with the spirits natural to it. It’s worth casting to receive that sense of assurance, though you may get nothing else in return.

Back-alley Spaceport Bravo For Hire.name:
后巷“布拉沃”太空港·受雇待命
Back-alley Spaceport Bravo For Hire

Text.text:
你踏入一条逼仄的巷道时，一名高大覆鳞的异形堵住了去路；潮湿的空气里，它分叉的舌头像饥渴般来回弹动。粗壮结实的臂膀从一件裁短的皮夹克里伸出，夹克上印着一枚咧嘴狞笑的爬行类骷髅。它喉间渐渐翻起低沉的咯笑，用一种粗砺的喉音语言对你开口。你勉强听懂了几句常用词，才意识到这混混是在向你兜售太空港附近的“保护”——或者是在威胁你。你一时也分不清到底是哪一种。
A large, scaly alien blocks your path as you enter a cramped alleyway, their forked tongue flicking ravenously in the humid air. Thick, well-muscled arms emerge from a cut-off leather jacket bearing a grinning reptilian skull, and a low chortle builds in their throat as they address you in a guttural language. You manage to make out a few common phrases, and realize the thug is offering you protection around the spaceport—or they are threatening you. You’re not entirely sure which.

Viewing A Home Planet From One Of Its Mo.name:
从一颗卫星上眺望故乡行星
Viewing A Home Planet From One Of Its Moons

Text.text:
你回头望去。在墨一般的漆黑中，悬着一个世界——你的世界——它的壮丽逼得你倒吸一口气。那景象令你心生惊叹。太阳——你的太阳——洒下珍珠般的光辉，覆在这颗星球之上。大陆像泥地里细小的划痕，海洋像一汪汪水洼。你忽然明白，你所认识的一切都发生在那颗微小的球体上，它漂浮在黑暗之中。随之席卷而来的，像浪潮一般，是一种令人难以置信的渺小感。
You look back. In the inky black sits a world—your world—and its magnificence forces a gasp from you. The sight fills you with a sense of wonder. The light of the sun—your sun—casts a pearly luminescence over the planet. The continents are like little marks in the mud, the seas like puddles. It dawns on you that all you have ever known has taken place on that tiny sphere, adrift in the darkness. Sweeping over you, like a wave, comes a feeling of incredible smallness.

Flooded Cavern: Labyrinth.name:
水淹洞窟：迷宫
Flooded Cavern: Labyrinth

Text.text:
当你踏上这段旅程时，这是一场冒险。被水淹没的洞窟曾像一片美丽而奇迹般的未知之境。然而当你越钻越深，走入愈发浓重的黑暗，洞穴的神秘也渐渐扭曲成不祥的阴影。若你在这座水淹迷宫的深处迷失，你将必死无疑——而即便如此，你的灵魂又是否还能找到出去的路？
When you set out on this journey, it was an adventure. The flooded cavern seemed a beautiful and miraculous unknown. Yet as you’ve delved deeper and further into the dark, the caves’ mystery morphed into something ominous. If you get lost in the depths of this watery labyrinth, you’ll die—and if you do, will your soul even be able to find the way out?

Osben Loreweaver.name:
奥斯本·织秘者
Osben Loreweaver

Text.text:
你面前这位半精灵没有花哨的衣装，也没有闪耀的珠宝来夺人眼球；他那脏金色的头发凌乱地披到肩头，举手投足却带着一种轻松的优雅。不，他所需要的全部注意力，都被那抹宽阔而真诚的笑容牢牢攫住。湛蓝的眼睛敏锐又好奇，从一张俊朗的脸上向外探看。嘴角常年挂着一丝歪斜的笑意，仿佛他总在酝酿某个笑话，只等最恰当的时机抛出来。虽说他腰侧佩着一把细剑，却似乎不太愿意把手搭上剑柄，反倒更喜欢让双手忙于身后斜背着的鲁特琴。

~ Played by Seth L. with

No gaudy garments or gleaming jewelry call attention to the half-elf before you with dirty blonde hair draped messily to his shoulders and an easy grace to his movements. No, his smile, broad and genuine, grabs all the attention he requires. Blue eyes, keen and curious, peer out from a handsome face. A crooked grin seems to play at the corners of his mouth at all times, as if he's always brewing one joke or another and awaiting the perfect opportunity to share. Though he wears a rapier at his side, he seems hesitant to rest his hand upon its pommel, preferring instead to busy his hands with the lute he carries strung across his back.

~ Played by Seth L. with

Temple To A Goblinoid God.name:
地精类神祇的神殿
Temple To A Goblinoid God

Text.text:
这片空间弥漫着浓烈的垃圾与腐烂气味，崇拜者将高耸的废物堆层层垒起，塞满每一处死寂的角落。你走过之处，昆虫窸窣疾窜，钻入阴影。此间或许曾供奉过另一位神祇，如今墙面却被猩红涂鸦玷污；石祭坛上陈列着颅骨，干枯的残肉仍黏附其上；长矛倒插向上，挑起破碎褴褛的旗幡。某头巨大的爬行怪兽的下颚骨像一只贪婪的器皿，收拢献给地精类神祇的供品——钱币、武器与护甲，以及早已腐坏的食物与酒。
The space smells strongly of refuse and rot, and towering piles of trash has been heaped into each stagnant corner by worshipers. In your wake, insects skitter into the shadows. The chamber may have once been devoted to some other deity, but now crimson graffiti mars the walls, skulls with still-clinging desiccated flesh adorn the stone altar, and spears jut upward, flying tattered banners. The lower jaw of some massive, reptilian beast collects the offerings to a goblinoid god—coins, arms and armor, and long-spoiled food and wine.

她穿着草鞋，双脚与胯同宽站定，脊背挺直如一根木杖——在那件蓝灰色及膝短袍里，静若止水，却又强如一座逼人的山岳。她的眼神仿佛飘得很远，投向某个遥不可及的念头；可只要听见一声呼唤、一记脚步，甚至一片叶子坠落擦过地面的轻响，她的头便倏然一动，带着被挑起的、无可挑剔的专注。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

She stands with sandaled feet hip-width apart and back straight as a bō staff—still and powerful as a looming mountain in her blue-gray, knee-length tunic. Her eyes seem distant, cast off in a far-flung thought, but her head flicks with piqued and perfect attention at the sound of a voice, a footstep, and the gentle scrape of a leaf falling to the ground.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

I Cast Water Elemental Planar Ally.name:
我召唤水元素的位面盟友
I Cast Water Elemental Planar Ally

Text.text:
我在身前画出一个尽可能大的圆。一次、两次、三次——直到一团蓝绿交织的旋涡水流成形。海的气息从中飘散而出，伴随着浪涛拍岸的轰鸣。漩涡中央，一位水之存在浮现。那是一道有意识的浪潮，浪尖如皱起的、翻涌起泡的额眉，覆在发着幽绿光的双眼之上。它的形体深处某个角落传来咕噜作响的嗓音，用的是只有同类才懂的语言。
I trace a circle, as large as I can manage, in front of me. Once, twice, three times—until a swirling vortex of blue-green water forms.
