The scent of the sea wafts from it, along with the sound of water crashing against shores. Out of the center of the whirlpool, a being of water emerges. A sentient wave, its crest a furrowed, frothing brow over glowing green eyes. A voice gurgles from somewhere within its form, in a language known only to those of its kind.

Hellhound Ravager.name:
地狱犬劫掠者
Hellhound Ravager

Text.text:
这头以熔岩为血的生物是一只骇人的猎犬，三颗头颅咬噬般猛扑，龇牙低吼。它的黑金属皮肤如无月的子夜般深沉，却有岩浆从缝隙间渗出：灼蚀、翻涌，触地便嘶嘶作响。每一颗头颅都喷吐着不同的元素：烈焰、寒冰，以及噼啪作响的能量。
The creature with lava for blood is a fearsome hound, snapping and snarling its three heads. Its black-metal skin is as dark as a moonless midnight, but magma oozes from it: caustic and bubbling, hissing as it strikes the ground. Each head spits a different element: flame, ice, and fizzling energy.

Crossroads Shrine.name:
十字路口神龛
Crossroads Shrine

Text.text:
一座小小的石制神龛立在这条岔路口，覆着瓦片的屋顶下护着一层搁板，上面摆着一尊小神像和两只碗。较大的那只碗里插着燃烧的线香，细细缕缕的青烟袅袅升起。一束紫色花朵像是另一份供奉，散落在神像前，从搁板边缘一路滚落，落到神龛前那一级石阶上，像个小小的门廊。
A small stone shrine stands at this crossroads, its tiled roof sheltering a shelf upon which sit a small statue and two bowls. Thin wisps of smoke from sticks of burning incense rise from the larger bowl. A spray of purple flowers, seemingly another offering, lies in front of the statue and tumbles down from the shelf to the step that forms a little porch before the shrine.

Large Family's Cottage.name:
大家庭的小屋
Large Family's Cottage

Text.text:
一群孩子纠缠成一团从你身旁冲过，他们尖叫的笑声像一阵猝不及防的狂风猛地拍在你脸上。他们争先恐后地奔上楼，急切的脚步砰砰砸响地板。客厅里，一对年长的夫妇坐在彼此对面的同款摇椅上，低声咯咯笑着，嘟囔着什么“小恶魔”。当你踏进厨房，一股灼人的热浪立刻逼得你额头渗汗——每个炉头都点得正旺，上面压着咕嘟翻滚的锅子与平底锅。
A tangle of children run past you, their shrieking laughter hitting you like an unexpected gust of wind. They rush upstairs, eager feet pounding against the floor. In the parlor, an older couple sits across from one another in matching rockers, chuckling quietly and muttering something about little devils. As you step into the kitchen, a great heat brings sweat to your brow—each burner isfired up and laden with a simmering pot or pan.

I Trigger My Beacon Of Aid.name:
我触发援助灯塔
I Trigger My Beacon Of Aid

Text.text:
在我力所不及的瞬间，我伸手攫住这道法术。它支撑着我，将我的位置告知远处大范围内的任何人。我的触及更长，步伐更稳，而我只需撑住——直到信标把我的朋友们召集到我身边。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

In a moment beyond my abilities, I grasp out with this spell. It sustains me, alerting anyone in a great radius to where I am. My reach grows longer, my stance more stable, and I need only endure until the beacon gathers my friends to me.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

这名个体高挑瘦长，脖颈修长如羚羊，面容柔和似精灵，却长着狼的耳与鼻；双眼多棱折光，喘息的嘴里獠牙森然。四肢细长得近乎纤弱。一条腿以分趾蹄收尾，另一条腿则是穿着皮鞋的脚。左臂覆着鳞片，手掌生爪；右臂的鳞片渐次退去，化作一条触须般的手臂。身上穿着粗糙的帆布与皮革，外披宽大的斗篷，缀满叶饰。它后退一步，惶惶张望四周。
Tall and slender, this individual has a long neck like an antelope, the soft face of an elf, and the ears and nose of a wolf, as well as multifaceted eyes and a panting mouth full of fangs. Their limbs are gangly. One leg ends in a cloven hoof and the other in a foot covered in a leather shoe. Their scaly left arm has a clawed hand, while scales give way to a tentacular arm on the right. Their clothing is rough canvas and leather with an ample cloak decorated with leaves. They take a step back and looks around anxiously.

Sword Dancer Cutting In.name:
剑舞者切入
Sword Dancer Cutting In

Text.text:
战斗沉重得像巨刃来回抡摆；靴子笨拙地拖踏；粗重的喘息与咒骂交织。舞者迈出一步，缀在腰带上的钱币发出欢快的叮当声，却几乎细不可闻。下一步，她旋身一转，双臂优雅舒展。她的刀锋如一线长长的光在空中闪烁，她滑入那位盟友方才占据的位置。精力充沛的她立刻与敌人缠斗，敌人的眼中掠过一瞬绝望的光。

~ Envisioned by Oscar

The fight is a ponderous swinging of heavy blades, the clumsy plodding of boots, hard breathing, and curses. A dancer takes a step, and the cheerful jingle of coins decorating her sash is barely audible. On the next step, she pirouettes, arms out gracefully. Her blade is a long flicker of light as she slides into the place her ally had just occupied. Fresh with energy, she engages the foe, whose eyes show a flash of desperation.

~ Envisioned by Oscar

Wild Magic Surge: Teleporting Step.name:
狂野魔法涌动：瞬移步伐
Wild Magic Surge: Teleporting Step

Text.text:
你法术留下的奥术残渣在脚边四散。你低头望去，身体在最细微的移动中仿佛都在模糊、扭曲。你感到现实被拧出一道旋涡，迫不及待地要将你卷入其中；只要你愿意，它便会把你猛地抛向空间中的另一个落点。
Arcane residue from your spell scatters around your feet. When you look down, your body appears to blur and warp with the slightest movement. You feel a twist in reality, eager to pull you in and jettison you to a different point in space if you so choose.

Loot From An Ochre Jelly.name:
赭色黏怪的战利品
Loot From An Ochre Jelly

Text.text:
骸骨残骸——黏液怪往昔饱餐的证据——从它那胶质身躯里滚落出来，它最后一次疯狂地抖颤。它彻底融化了，但你听见的不仅是空洞的骨骼咔啦作响。金、银、铜——散落的钱币从保存完好的衣物口袋与小袋中滚落到地上。有些竟在原地狂乱旋转，仿佛重获自由便令它们欢欣起舞。
Skeletal remains—evidence of the ooze’s past meals—roll out of its gelatinous body as it jiggles furiously for the final time. It melts fully, but the hollow rattle of bones is not the only sound you hear. Gold, silver, copper—loose coins tumble to the ground, out of the pockets of preserved clothing and pouches. Some whirl madly in place as if being freed has driven them to a joyful dance.

Trident Of Fish Command.name:
鱼群号令三叉戟
Trident Of Fish Command

Text.text:
这柄三叉戟的戟杆沿线镀覆银金，戟锋的三齿则以坚若磐石的珊瑚打磨成刃，锋利如剃。它与海军与角斗士所持的同类武器，只有表面上的相似。你一握住它，翻涌海潮拍碎岸礁的微弱幻影与回声便掠过你的感官，伴随着若有若无的咸腥气息；同时，一股渴望在胸中悄然滋生——想要回到那辽阔无垠的海之王国，哪怕你从未到过那里。
Plated with electrum along the shaft and featuring razor-sharp tines fashioned of rock-hard coral, the trident is only superficially reminiscent of those carried by marines and gladiators. Faint visions and echoes of the crashing ocean’s tide, and a vague briny scent, play over your senses as you take hold of it, accompanied by a yearning to return to the vast kingdom of the sea, even if you have never been there before.

The Eldritch Whisperer.name:
诡秘低语者
The Eldritch Whisperer

Text.text:
一股细微却刺耳的失衡感萦绕着那道神秘身影，仿佛连现实本身都在排斥她的存在。她掀开宽大的兜帽，露出一张年轻女子的面孔——其上密布诡异的异界纹印，触手般的纹样在皮肤上蜿蜒游走，仿佛真有生命。你周遭响起噼啪的静电爆裂，她纤细的双手缠绕着电光，狂乱的眼神带着失控的欢愉锁定了她的敌人。她放声尖啸，恣意而疯狂，将能量长矛以针尖般的精准导向目标，轻易将内脏煮沸、把血肉灼得焦黑，骇人得近乎冷酷。敌人逼近时，这名邪术师猛然挥出一条又长又带倒刺的鞭子——形如触手，覆着黏稠的滑液，滴滴答答坠落。她以低沉而不协和的耳语呢喃，词句污秽而陌生，凡人心智无从理解——而她在敌人惊恐溃逃时，含笑而立。

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

An air of subtle discord surrounds the mysterious figure, as if reality itself is somehow repelled by their presence. They pull back a large hood to reveal the face of a young woman, heavily tattooed with strange, otherworldly iconography and tentacles which slither across her skin as if alive. A static crackle surrounds you as her slender hands are wreathed in lightning, and her wild eyes fall upon her enemy with unhinged glee. Shrieking with abandon, she directs the lances of energy with pinpoint accuracy, boiling organs and searing flesh with horrifying ease. As her foes close in, the warlock lashes out with a long, barbed whip shaped like a tentacle and covered in viscous, dripping slime. She mutters in a low, dissonant whisper, her words so foul and alien that no mortal mind could comprehend them—and smiles as her enemies flee in terror.

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

Wild Magic Surge: Aging.name:
狂野魔法涌动：衰老
Wild Magic Surge: Aging

Text.text:
你的身躯仿佛开始扭曲，魔法如群潮般在你周身翻涌盘旋，缠绕并紧紧束缚着你。你在茧中停留的那几秒里，承受着最原初、最具形体层面的生成洪流冲刷，待一切散去，你的年代已被改写。
Your body seems to warp as magic swarms around you and binds to you. In the seconds you remain in chrysalis, you endure a wash of generativity at its most basic physical level, leaving your age altered.

这名类人生物的上半身从水面浮出，皮肤泛着虹彩的蓝绿色光泽。鳞片粼粼闪烁，头顶不见发丝，取而代之的是一圈如王冠般的鳍冠沿着颅骨耸起。它的蹼手在水中划动，你这才意识到它的下半身是一条带鳍的尾巴，强健有力，足以推动生物在水里迅疾穿梭。
The humanoid creature's torso emerges from the water, their skin an iridescent blue-green. Scales shimmer, and in place of hair, a crown of fins crests the creature's skull. Their webbed hands tread water, and you realize their lower half is that of a finned tail, powerful and capable of propelling the creature quickly through the water.

Long-range Exploratory Vessel: Bridge.name:
远程探索船：舰桥
Long-range Exploratory Vessel: Bridge

Text.text:
这支乌合之众的船员制服与规章相去甚远，有些水手索性彻底不穿，改披更耐磨的粗犷行头。巨大的全息星图铺满舰桥中央，四周控制台明灭闪烁，领航员们在光影间推演航线，将飞船引向更深处的星界边疆。
The uniforms of the ragtag crew vary widely from regulations, with some hands forgoing them altogether in favor of more rugged attire. A vast holographic star chart fills the center of the bridge, surrounded by blinking consoles as navigators chart the ship’s course further into the astral frontier.

一位高挑的蜥蜴人少女在你面前守望，粉色的眼睛藏在隆起的眉脊下，舌尖从唇间若有所思地轻轻一 flick。她神情平静——甚至带着几分温和——云白色的鳞片柔软得仿佛天鹅绒羽。她穿着一袭用沼泽芦苇编织的朴素裙装，垂落在她圆润的腹部上；手中握着一根长木杖，杖弯处悬着一枚符号。

~ 扮演：Goshujin-Sama

A tall lizardfolk maiden watches you with pink eyes under a ridged brow, her tongue flicking thoughtfully between her lips. Her expression is calm—even kind—and her cloud-white scales seem as soft as swan’s down. She wears a simple dress woven of swamp reeds, which drapes over her round belly, and holds a long wooden staff with a symbol hanging from its crook.

~ Played by Goshujin-Sama

外壳是哑光灰色，卵圆而不起眼，唯有表面隐约刻着古怪纹路，浅淡的光从沟槽间渗出，流转着几种颜色。它可以由发射器射出，也可按下外壳上的按钮手动启动；爆开时只像陶罐碎裂般一声脆响，没有任何破片飞散。一团黏稠的纳米推进剂雾云铺满爆炸半径内的一切。纳米机器开始清理：刷洗、灭菌，抹去血迹、指纹、赛博空间行动、星界痕迹，以及魔法残留。随后它们自我崩解，将篡改的痕迹一并抹除。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The casing is matte gray, ovoid and unimpressive except for the faint grooves in strange patterns over its surface, through which a pale light glows with several colors. Fired from a launcher or manually activated with a button in the casing, it detonates with the sound of a clay pot breaking and no flight of shrapnel. A cloud of sticky nanopropellant coats everything in the blast radius. The nanites clean. They scrub and sterilize and erase blood, fingerprints, cyberspace activity, astral presence, and the residue of magic. Then they disintegrate, removing all trace of their tampering.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Faerie Plane: Small Bridge.name:
妖精位面：小桥
Faerie Plane: Small Bridge

Text.text:
从那圈石阵处延伸出两条赤褐色的土路分岔开去，右侧那条通往一座小小的石桥。石桥拱起，横跨自池塘蜿蜒流出的慵懒溪流；清澈的水面将跃动的光线折映到桥腹之下，摇曳成一道道亮纹。
From the circle of stones two paths of ruddy earth branch off, the one to the right leading to a small stone bridge. It arches over the languid stream flowing from the pond, clear waters reflecting dancing lines of light onto the bottom of the bridge.

Frozen River Crossing.name:
冰封河道渡口
Frozen River Crossing

Text.text:
厚实的冰带从一岸延伸到另一岸，隐约传来细碎的开裂声，在河谷间回荡。尽管在这严酷的气候下，河面早已封冻，冰层之下的水流仍在奋力向前。可一切迹象都指向这条河全新的状态之坚实：脚印、蹄印，甚至冰刀在浅雪上划出的浅沟，都在这条曾经奔流的河面上纵横交错；它被霜冻的河岸牢牢束缚，凝滞不动。
The thick ribbon of ice stretches from bank to bank, emanating faint cracking noises that echo through the river valley. For though the river surface has frozen over in the punishing clime, still the water beneath fights to flow onward. Yet every evidence points to the solidity of the river’s new condition: footprints, hoofprints, and even shallow grooves cut by ice skates crisscross the powdery snow atop the once-flowing stream, held still within the boundaries of its frosty banks.

Egg Sacs In Dark Cave.name:
黑暗洞窟中的卵囊
Egg Sacs In Dark Cave

Text.text:
洞口附近，以及洞壁与洞底各处星星点点地散布着一簇簇东西，看起来像是被蛛网裹住的深红疖肿。每个下垂的球囊约有你头骨般大小；透过它们半透明的表皮，你能看见深色、如肋骨般的线条——那必定是蜘蛛的腿，连着沉甸甸的赤红腹部。每一簇大约容纳十来枚卵，而在洞口投下的昏暗光照里，你能辨出足足半打卵囊。或许还有几十个——十来簇再乘十来簇，成群饥饿的蜘蛛正等着破囊而出。
Near the entrance of the cave, but also dotted all over the walls and floors, are clusters of what seem like crimson boils wrapped in webs. Each pendulous sphere is about the size of your skull, and through their semi-transparent surfaces you see the dark rib-like lines of what must be spider legs attached to heavy red abdomens. Each cluster holds about a dozen eggs, and there are half a dozen egg sacks visible in the dim light cast by the cave’s entrance. There might be dozens more—a dozen times a dozen hungry spiders waiting to hatch.

Dead And Diseased Village.name:
死寂与疫病缠身的村庄
Dead And Diseased Village

Text.text:
你渐渐逼近那座诡异死寂的村庄，一股腐败的恶臭直冲鼻腔。腥臭浸透街巷，镇上那些家家户户与商贩的尸体横七竖八散落其间，早已腐烂不堪。每个人都离奇死于某种未知的疾病——一场来得迅猛、毫不偏颇的瘟疫，转瞬便席卷了整座小镇。
Upon your approach to the eerily silent village, an odor of decay reaches your nostrils. The stench permeates the streets, with the rotting corpses of the town’s families and merchants strewn throughout. Each has mysteriously succumbed to an unknown disease, a plague that swept through quickly and without discrimination.

Bree Dampburrows.name:
布里·丹普伯罗斯
Bree Dampburrows

Text.text:
这名半身人德鲁伊已至中年，肤色白皙，绿眸棕发。然而，她脸上的战纹与眼周深色妆容将这些特征几乎尽数遮去。她的手臂与双手上刺着部族符号，写着 Who Studies With Turtles，旁边还纹着一只巨大的鳄龟。她的法术法器也与之相称——一枚乌龟图腾；而她的神情常年保持着好奇与乐观，正如她的投石索与魔法一样精准无误。

~ Played by PCZ with

This halfling druid is middle-aged and fair skinned, green eyed, and brown of hair. However, all that is difficult to see through her war paint and the dark makeup around her eyes. Tribal symbols reading Who Studies With Turtles are tattooed on her arms and hands, together with a picture of a giant snapping turtle. Her spell focus is, in keeping, a turtle totem, and her expression is regularly as curious and optimistic as her sling and magicks are accurate.

~ Played by PCZ with

Rubber-sealed Gloves.name:
橡胶密封手套
Rubber-sealed Gloves

Text.text:
只要摸一摸这些手套，更别说戴上了，你就能判断：它们很可能和那些它们能保护你免受其害的材料一样剧毒。橡胶呈蓝黑色，带着工厂压印，厚得像门垫。手套根部是一圈沉重的松紧密封圈，里面塞满了黄色纤维状的直闪石。你的双手在手套里汗如雨下，仿佛正在融化。
You can tell just by touching these gloves, let alone wearing them, that they are probably as toxic as some of the materials from which they can protect you. The rubber is blue-black, factory stamped, and thick as a doormat. At its base is a heavy elastic seal packed with yellow fibrous anthophyllite. Your hands sweat profusely inside the gloves as if they are melting.

Gauntlets Of Ogre Power.name:
食人魔之力护腕
Gauntlets Of Ogre Power

Text.text:
厚重的护手铠上装饰着咆哮的狰狞兽面，仿佛在挑衅你来试胆，亲手驾驭它们。覆盖手背的繁复纹饰与旁侧野蛮凶戾的面容形成强烈对照，指节处层层铰接的甲片更将这副装甲手套的精湛工艺展露无遗。
Roaring, monstrous faces adorn the heavy gauntlets, daring you to test your mettle and wield them. The intricate designs covering the hands draw a stark contrast with the barbaric countenance alongside them, and the articulated plates across the fingers highlight the expert craftsmanship of these armored gloves.

Heavy Rain On The Sea.name:
海上暴雨
Heavy Rain On The Sea

Text.text:
雨水肆意倾泻在海面上，连绵不绝的敲打仿佛让整片海都在沸腾。炭灰色的云层沉沉聚拢，将海染成板岩般的暗色。奔涌的水声——无休止的暴雨与拍岸的巨浪——吞没了其余一切声响。一只海鸥逆风挣扎，喙张开却发不出声，像无声的哀鸣，四下寻找可供栖身的落脚处。
Rain lavishes the surface of the sea, which looks like it’s simmering from the ceaseless patter. The gathered clouds of charcoal gray have darkened the sea to the color of slate. The constant sound of rushing water—the ceaseless downpour and the crashing waves—overwhelms all other noise. A gull struggles against the wind, its beak opening in a silent cry as it searches for signs of a perch.

Ring Mail Armor.name:
环甲护甲
Ring Mail Armor

Text.text:
这套护甲看上去像是在胁迫之下赶工出来的。它由一套皮甲的大部分部件组成，却被人用捡来的金属碎片覆在外面：窗帘环、青铜扣、旧铁钥匙、餐具残片，甚至一截折断的烛台——全都被紧紧缝在护甲外侧，好让它在承受沉重打击时更添几分防护。
This suit of armor looks like it was made under duress. It consists of the majority of the pieces of a suit of leather armor, but someone has covered it with scavenged metal scraps. Curtain rings, bronze buckles, old iron keys, pieces of tableware, even a broken candlestick—all have been stitched tight to the outside of the armor to bolster its protection against heavy blows.

House With Collapsed Roof.name:
屋顶坍塌的房屋
House With Collapsed Roof

Text.text:
一股静谧的忧伤弥漫在此地，仿佛连石块与木梁都仍记得它昔日的荣光。如今这里只剩一片废墟，满载着更好时光的回忆。屋顶塌落进门厅，使这座宅邸原本迎人的入口几乎无法通行。

~ 设想 by Dwayne on Discord

A sense of quiet melancholy pervades this place, as if the very stones and timbers remember its former glory. Now it is but a ruin, filled with memories of better times. The roof has collapsed into the foyer, rendering the welcoming entrance of the house all but impassable.

~ Envisioned by Dwayne on Discord

Steampunk Train.name:
蒸汽朋克列车
Steampunk Train

Text.text:
一台庞大的机车覆满铁与黄铜的铆接配件，伏在数十只铁轮之上，轮与轮之间由锃亮的黄铜连杆相接。尽管机车无疑重逾数吨，车轮却被精细校准，稳稳压在坚固的铁轨上，铁轨钉在木枕之上。机车之后，是一节巨大的货厢车，绵延数百英尺、拔高数十英尺，两侧各开着数道滑门，昭示着这段离奇列车那漫长、多节关节般的车身之内，至少分出五层彼此独立的空间。蒸汽缭绕间，机车忽然发出一声尖厉长笛，声浪可传数英里之外，随即车轮开始真正地疾转起来。

~ Micah 构想

A massive engine decked out in iron and brass fittings rests upon several dozen iron wheels, all connected with gleaming brass coupling rods. Though the engine undoubtedly weighs tons, the wheels have been delicately aligned along sturdy iron rails sitting atop wooden ties. Behind the engine, an enormous cargo car hundreds of feet long and dozens of feet high sports several sliding doors along each side, indicating no less than five discrete levels within this segment of the unconventional train’s long, multijointed body. Wreathed in steam, the engine suddenly emits a loud whistle, easily heard from miles away, and the wheels begin to spin in earnest.

~ Envisioned by Micah

鹰身女妖在类人与禽鸟之间维持着一种古怪的平衡：她是个女人，双手双足却皆以利爪作结。晒成古铜的肌肤上缀着浅淡疤痕，自其间生出赤褐色的羽毛；那双天蓝色的眼睛不停游移，带着鹰隼般锐利的专注。闪亮的锁链与沉重的圣徽垂挂在宽松而实用的衣装上，相互碰撞，发出悦耳却挥之不去的叮当轻响。她右拳套着一只熠熠生辉的银色臂铠，符文深刻其上，仿佛是她身上唯一的武装。

~ 由CDekar 饰演

The harpy strikes an odd balance between humanoid and avian, a woman whose hands and feet end in talons. From sun-browned skin lined with faint scars sprout auburn feathers, and her sky-blue eyes flit here and there with a keen, eagle-like focus. Gleaming chains and heavy holy symbols drape baggy, functional clothing, clattering against one another with a pleasant yet persistent jingle. A shining silver gauntlet engraved with runes shrouds her right fist, seemingly the only armament on her person.

~ Played by CDekar

Grotesque Undead Panther Beast.name:
畸形不死黑豹巨兽
Grotesque Undead Panther Beast

Text.text:
难以形容的剧痛尖嚎在林间回荡。你左右转头，循声搜寻，瞥见一条修长黝黑的尾巴。一只巨大的生物在树木间疾掠而过，紧接着，你听见刮擦与拖曳的声响——那头野兽在你面前的巨石上撑身而起。它六只庞大前爪上的每一枚利爪都像随时会脱落。皮毛被撕裂，鲜血淋漓；过度膨胀的肌肉大得撑破了猫科的轮廓，将它从一只豹的身形中硬生生顶出，显露为一头怪诞而骇人的拙劣仿品。
Sharp yowls of indescribable pain echo through the woods. You turn your head to and fro, looking for the source of the sound, and catch sight of a long dark tail. A large creature dashes between the trees, and then you hear scraping and shuffling as the beast rises over a boulder in front of you. The claws on every one of its six huge paws seem as if they are about to fall off. Their fur is torn and bleeding, with overdeveloped muscles so big they burst through the feline silhouette and reveal the beast to be a grotesque and terrifying imitation of a panther.

Cooking On An Open Fire.name:
露天篝火烹饪
Cooking On An Open Fire

Text.text:
食物在熏黑的煎锅里滋滋作响，滚烫的油脂噼啪飞溅，滴落到下方温柔噼啪的火焰上。你手法娴熟地操控锅身，小心翼翼地前倾后仰，只为把焦褐烙得恰到好处。火舌舔舐着锅底，粗砺的铁面被烧得泛起猩红，你在端上这道美味佳肴前，完成最后的准备。

~ 由 David 在 Discord 上通过 Envisioned 构想

Food sizzles in the blackened skillet, spitting drops of hot fat on to the gently crackling fire below. With an expert hand you maneuver the pan, carefully tilting it this way and that to brown just right. Flames lick at the underside, causing the rugged iron to blush crimson as you make the final preparations before serving your delectable dish.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

那枚哑黑金属球落入你伸开的掌心，冰冷而沉重。外壳上精细蚀刻着异族文字，仿佛迫不及待要炸裂成一场火焰的狂飙与撕裂血肉的破片风暴。将这份混沌死死压住的，只是一根简单的插销；它用轻易的承诺嘲弄着你。如此简单的动作，便能换来如此多的死亡。拉开，投掷。它看起来不过是一粒无害的种子，而毁灭将自此绽放。
The sphere of matte-black metal is cool and heavy as it fills your outstretched palm. Finely etched with alien script, the shell seems eager to burst into a maelstrom of fire and eviscerating shrapnel. The simple pin that holds all that chaos at bay taunts you with its easy promise. So much death for so simple an action. Pull and throw. It seems such an innocuous seed, from which devastation will bloom.

Drought In The Land.name:
大地旱灾
Drought In The Land

Text.text:
大地一片褐黄，龟裂的纹路一直延伸到地平线。烈日下，只有枯萎的灌木零星点缀其间。你看见早已荒废的农田，以及远处城镇的轮廓在热浪般的薄霾中微微扭曲。高空有几缕稀薄的云飘过，却不见半点雨意。
The ground is brown and cracked all the way out to the horizon. Only withered shrubs dot the landscape under a harsh sun. You spot farmlands long deserted, and the image of a distant town rippling through the haze. A few wispy clouds blow in the sky above, with nary a sign of rain.

Halfling With Map.name:
带地图的半身人
Halfling With Map

Text.text:
小心翼翼地不让那只冒着泡沫的麦酒杯洒到她手中的地图上，半身人轻轻咯咯笑着，伸展着她那短短的、毛茸茸的脚趾，在噼啪作响的火焰旁烘暖。她脚上成片的深色毛发，与那一绺绺光亮的秀发相映成趣，秀发倾泻而下，掩映着短小而尖尖的耳朵。
Being careful not to spill the foaming mug of ale on the map in her hand, the halfling chuckles quietly as she stretches her short hairy toes, warming them by the crackling flames. Patches of swarthy hair on her feet match the lustrous locks tumbling over short, pointed ears.

Witchwood: Creatures In The Dark.name:
魔女林：暗影中的生灵
Witchwood: Creatures In The Dark

Text.text:
你们穿行在这片荒败林地的阴影里，脚步渐渐放缓，直至停下。你们都听见了。还有别的东西在这片晦暗的森林中移动。你们心里有一部分希望那只是只无害的野兽，为了不被掠食者听见才悄然潜行。但这片林子，似乎并非全然自然之物。
Your pace through the shadows of this wasted woodland slows to a stop. You all heard it. Something else moves through this benighted forest. Part of you hopes it was a harmless, natural beast, furtive in its movements so as not to be heard by a predator. But this doesn’t seem like an entirely natural wood.

Introduction Of A Spellcaster Seeking Kn.name:
渴求知识的施法者登场
Introduction Of A Spellcaster Seeking Knowledge

Text.text:
“我把学院里能翻的都翻遍了，可我追寻的学识远非那些满身尘灰的老糊涂的空谈所能触及。况且那玩意儿贵得要命。以我的本事，这份差事的报酬最好。”
“I read through all that I could in our academy, but the knowledge I sought was beyond the musings of those dusty old fools. It’s also quite expensive. This is the best paying job for someone of my talents.”

Guldor Bitterbite, Formerly Guldor Cragm.name:
古尔多·苦咬，前称古尔多·克拉格莫
Guldor Bitterbite, Formerly Guldor Cragmaw

Text.text:
年代与战斗在这名高个男人的脸上刻下痕迹，宛如一面饱经天气侵蚀的峭壁。他赤红的皮肤上布满深刻而醒目的疤痕与皱纹——却丝毫无损他的美感。那些改变反而衬得他五官愈发夺目；他朝你洒脱一笑——露出一口邪气森然的尖牙。狡黠的榛色眼睛微微眯起，审视般地盯了你片刻，随后点头，伸出手朝你走来。

~ Played by Jimothy with

Age and battle have marked the tall man’s face like a weather-beaten cliff. His red skin is covered with deep, prominent scars and wrinkles—yet they do not detract from his beauty. His striking countenance has only been enhanced by the alterations, and he favors you with a dashing smile—revealing wickedly pointed teeth. Shrewd hazel eyes narrow to an appraising stare as he regards you for a few moments, before nodding and making his way over with an outstretched hand.

~ Played by Jimothy with

Ominous Closed Door.name:
不祥的紧闭之门
Ominous Closed Door

Text.text:
古老的木门上遍布深刻的刀痕，宛如陈年的战创，甚至蔓延到门框四周的石头上。门口笼罩着一层难以抗拒的神秘诱惑，如同阴云盘旋，召唤你踏下磨损的石阶，去探知门后究竟潜藏着什么。
Deep cuts scar the ancient wooden door like old battle wounds, even extending to the stone around it. The irresistible lure of mystery hangs over the doorway like a cloud, beckoning you down the worn stone steps to learn more about what lies beyond.

Token Of The Unseelie Court.name:
幽影妖廷信物
Token Of The Unseelie Court

Text.text:
这件小饰物呈现为一座石王座，崩裂破碎，荆棘丛与窒息般的藤蔓从裂隙间疯长穿透。它由某种石材构成，任何时候在接触时都带着不自然的冰冷；其上以幽深如影的刻痕镌着不祥妖精宫廷的徽记。
The trinket appears as a stone throne, sundered and grown-through with thorny brambles and choking vines. Composed of some kind of stone that feels at all times unnaturally cold to the touch, the token bears the symbol of the Unseelie Court in deep, shadowed etchings.

Hope’s Grave In Winter.name:
冬日的希望之墓
Hope’s Grave In Winter

Text.text: 这具石棺的棺盖上刻着铭文：这里是“希望”的坟墓。此土之下，一名士兵长眠。轻步而行。她用生命挣来了这份休息。 The lid of this sarcophagus bears the inscription: This is the grave of Hope. Beneath this soil a soldier sleeps. Tread lightly. She earned this rest.

一个小型构装体如同远古贝类般贴着地面滑行，它的纹饰昭示着它是安纳石造物，但在那层外壳之下看不见任何武器或复杂科技。它几乎无声地移动——这样朴素的构装体究竟有什么用途？它看起来无害得很——也许是一台先进的吸尘器？
A small construct glides across the floor like an ancient shellfish, its markings revealing it to be an anacite creation, but no weapons or complex technology are visible beneath the shell. Moving with barely any sound, what is the purpose of this simple construct? It seems innocuous enough—perhaps an advanced vacuum cleaner?

Gnoll Vampire Encounter.name:
豺狼人吸血鬼（特征）遭遇
Gnoll Vampire Encounter

Text.text:
一种疯狂而暴烈的饥渴栖居在这生物血红的双眼里——那是生前永远无法餍足的渴望。血污染透了野兽的口鼻与利爪，黏稠的血珠一团团滴落地面。豺狼人动作紊乱癫狂，冲锋时喉间爆出狂笑——拉长的獠牙已蓄势待发，准备刺入温热的血肉。
A deranged, apoplectic hunger dwells in the creature’s blood red eyes, a hunger that could never be satisfied in life. Gore stains the beast’s muzzle and claws, dripping in viscous globules to the ground. The gnoll’s movements are erratic, and a maniacal cackle erupts from its throat as it charges—elongated fangs ready to pierce warm flesh.

Kothama Ascendant.name:
科萨玛·登临者
Kothama Ascendant

Text.text:
一座毛茸茸的山峦缓缓吐息，热腾腾的蒸汽直冲天际。群星是这头生物的全部凝视——它天生有四只眼，皆朝向苍穹；每一只都墨黑如夜，点缀着银色星屑。它冬霜般的皮毛在多处被灼焦、剥落，每一道伤痕都是旅行的护符。真正的护符则从它粗壮的脖颈垂下：星辉金属上密密刻着无数陌生语言，字字皆为感恩。寂静空气里，它僧侣般的平和分毫不动。
A furry mountain exhales, its breath sending hot steam skyward. The stars are the creature’s focus—its four eyes, by design, face the heavens, each one inky black and speckled with silver. The beast’s wintry fur is singed and peeled in places, each injury a talisman of travel. Real talismans dangle from its thick neck, with countless alien languages etched into starry metals, all inscribed with words of gratitude. Its monkish calm does not waver in the still air.

River And Stone Bridge.name:
河流与石桥
River And Stone Bridge

Text.text:
河流在葱郁的乡野间切开一道深深的沟壑，自遥远南方的群山蜿蜒而下，向北注入一片小而粼粼闪光的湖泊。一座石桥横跨其上，想来年岁与西北那座残塔相仿，石材亦出同源；桥尽头通往一条凿穿山坡的隧道。
The river carves a deep rut in the green countryside, winding its way from the mountains far to the south, and emptying into a small, glimmering lake to the north. A stone bridge, likely as old and erected of the same stone as the ruined tower to the northwest, spans the river and leads to a tunnel carved through the hillside.

Quip By A Technoshaman About Ignorance.name:
技术萨满对无知的刻薄揶揄
Quip By A Technoshaman About Ignorance

Text.text:
“你们这些纯粹派真让我发笑。简单的有机生命怎么可能比网络空间里无穷无尽、千奇百怪的特性更复杂？你们的知识不过是最基础的地基，而我这门精微的领域正是建立其上！”

~ 由 Discord 上的 Murmur 构想于 Discord

“You purists make me laugh. How can simple organic life possibly be more complex than the infinite idiosyncrasies of cyberspace? Your knowledge is merely the elementary foundation upon which my nuanced field is built!”

~ Envisioned by Murmur on Discord

I Move Upside Down Wearing My Slippers O.name:
我倒挂着行走，脚上穿着我的蛛行拖鞋
I Move Upside Down Wearing My Slippers Of Spider Climbing

Text.text:
当我迈出第一步踏上天花板时，胃里猛地一翻，眼后压力骤然堆积。全身每一丝感官都在尖叫，抗拒着我这骤然倒置的新姿势；我强迫自己专注于呼吸，把一只脚稳稳地迈到另一只脚前。
My stomach lurches and pressure builds behind my eyes as I take my first steps on to the ceiling. Every sense in my body screams, rebelling against my newly inverted position, as I focus on my breathing and putting one foot in front of the other.

一株怪异的植物从泥沼般湿软的土壤中生长出来。每一根绿色茎秆都簇拥成七枝一团，茎上长着成对的叶片，叶缘布满针刺般的突起。它们合拢成一张张微小的嘴：张开的那几张露出闪着湿光的猩红内壁，其上点缀着细小纤维；合拢的则鼓胀成团。自其中一张嘴里突出的昆虫般细腿，揭示了这些鼓包究竟是什么。
A strange plant grows from the boggy soil. Each green stem, in a cluster of seven, bears paired leaves edged with needlelike growths. They form tiny maws, the open ones revealing a glistening red surface dotted with tiny fibers while the closed ones bulge. The insectile legs jutting from one mouth reveal what these lumps are.

Haunted House: Secret Room.name:
鬼屋：密室
Haunted House: Secret Room

Text.text:
越过一道隐蔽的入口，一条狭窄幽暗的甬道通往一间密室。毫无征兆地，五支黑色牛脂蜡烛自行点燃，烛芯上跃动着明亮的翠绿火焰，照亮一间逼仄的房间——从天花板到地面尽被血红墨水绘成的怪诞涂画覆盖。那些画面是一幕幕骇人至极的暴行、以及噩梦般的畸形怪物肖像——只可能出自恶魔的心智，并将在接下来的许多个夜晚侵入你的梦境。
Beyond a concealed opening a narrow, dark passage leads to a secret chamber. Without warning, five candles of black tallow light, bright green flames upon their wicks, illuminating a cramped room covered ceiling to floor in grotesque drawings depicted in blood-red ink. Tableaux of horrifically graphic violence and portraits of nightmarish freaks—products that can only have come from a demonic mind, and that will invade your dreams for nights to come.

View From Atop A Plateau.name:
高原之巅的眺望
View From Atop A Plateau

Text.text:
高原那陡峭崩裂的峭壁带来一场令人胆寒的攀登，但你终究攀上了嶙峋的岩坡。登顶之际，荒野的壮丽景象扑面而来——无边无际的绿色海洋向四面八方铺展，仿佛没有尽头。河流如脉络般穿行于繁茂的翠意之间，注入湖泊与沼泽，又不断向外奔涌，流向地平线之外的海洋。成群的鸟在下方盘旋，即便身处如此高处，你仍能看见丛林里生命丰沛、熙攘不息。远处，你望见了你的战利品：一艘飞艇坠落在一株巨树的枝桠间，几乎只靠纠缠打结的藤蔓勉强托举在半空。

~ Envisioned by Spac3cowboyy

The sheer, crumbling cliffs of the plateau provide a harrowing climb, but you manage to scale the rocky rise. At its summit, you find a magnificent view of the wilderness, sprawling in all directions in an infinite, green expanse. Rivers vein the lush greenery, empty into lakes and swamps, and flow ever outward to seas beyond the horizon. Flocks of birds circle below, and even from this great height you see the jungle teems with abundant life. In the distance, you spy your prize: an airship, crashed among the boughs of a massive tree and held aloft by little more than tangled, knotted vines.

~ Envisioned by Spac3cowboyy

Swooping Harpy.name:
俯冲的鹰身女妖
Swooping Harpy

Text.text:
空气里翻涌着喧嚣的仇恨，一只鹰身女妖俯冲而下。这邪恶的生物，是女人与猛禽扭曲拼合的畸形体，发出野兽般狂怒的尖啸。它破烂斑驳的双翼以骇人的迅疾撕开气流，剃刀般锋利的利爪蓄势待发，带着嗜虐的快意要将血肉扯碎。
The air is filled with raucous hatred, as a harpy swoops down. This malevolent creature, a twisted amalgam of woman and raptor, shrieks with animalistic rage. Its ragged, mottled wings cut through the air with a frightening swiftness, its razor-sharp talons ready to rip at flesh with sadistic glee.

The Sanctuary: Corral.name:
圣所：围栏
The Sanctuary: Corral

Text.text:
欢庆的尖叫与呐喊自那座巨大的围栏场越过草原回荡。宽阔的场地由木栅环绕，被划分成数个更小的竞技区：有的覆着天然青草，有的铺着松软、含沙更丰的土层。随着其中一处赛场上两只野兔的竞速冲向高潮，喝彩声愈发高涨，形形色色的生物观众有人兴奋到发颤，有人绝望得失声。邻近的一条赛道上，一队田鼠与地松鼠正忙着布置障碍，显然是在为下一场赛事做准备。
Celebratory hoots and hollers echo over the grassland from the large corral. The wide, wooden-ringed field has been partitioned into smaller arenas, some with natural grass and others with soft, sand-rich soil. The cheers increase as a race between two hares in one of the arenas reaches its climax, sending varied creature-spectators into either exhilaration or despair. A team of field mice and ground squirrels is setting up obstacles on an adjacent racecourse, presumably for the next event.

你几乎在看见那位皮匠之前，就先闻到了他靠近的气味。那人身上带着一股鞣制皮革的恶臭，仿佛只要干这行，味道就会如影随形地缠在周围的人身上。他衣衫不整，满身油垢与尘渍，显然刚从活计里抽身；可他仍努力把双手和指甲缝清理得干净，尽管那件皮围裙早已被刺鼻的化学药剂染透、斑驳、腐蚀出一道道痕迹。你心想，难怪皮匠们多半只和同样的皮匠来往、很少与旁人交际——因为那股熏人的气味已让你的眼角泛起薄雾般的泪意。
You smell the approach of the leatherworker almost before you see him. The man carries with him the stench of tanning odors, which seems to linger around anyone who plies his trade. Unkempt and grimy with his work, he has made an effort to clean his hands and nails even though his leather smock has been stained, marked, and etched by noxious chemicals. You consider the small wonder that leatherworkers tend to socialize with other leatherworkers and few others as your eyes begin to mist over from the fumes.

Cyberpunk Fantasy Metropolis: Ultra-weal.name:
赛博朋克奇幻大都会：极尽奢华的“阿阿”街区
Cyberpunk Fantasy Metropolis: Ultra-wealthy 'Aa' Neighborhood

Text.text:
城市的心脏地带坐落着一片极尽奢华的富人区，只对城中最富有、且往往最具影响力的居民开放。华宅林立，军用级安保层层设防，一流的配套设施汇聚成一片奢靡的绿洲。
In the heart of the city is an ultra-wealthy neighborhood, exclusively reserved for some of the city's richest and oft influential denizens. Lavish homes, military-grade security measures, and prime amenities provide an oasis of opulence.

Spear Of Nature Spirit Craftsmanship.name:
自然灵魂工艺长矛
Spear Of Nature Spirit Craftsmanship

Text.text:
三根藤蔓般的枝条相互编织，构成这柄战斗长矛的矛杆；温热而活着的木质上抽出翠绿的新芽与叶片。矛杆底端，根须紧紧攫住一枚暗色石球——一记完美的钝击武器。另一端，坚韧的卷须抓牢带锯齿的黑曜石矛头，尖端致命。自矛杆与石球处，点点绿光如尘般飘落；而自矛锋处落下的光点，却是血一般的猩红。
Three vinelike branches braid together to form the haft of this fighting spear, green sprigs and leaves growing from the warm, living wood. At the base of the shaft, roots grasp a bulb of dark stone—an ideal bludgeon. On the opposite end, tough tendrils grasp serrated obsidian with a deadly point. Motes of green light fall from the haft and bulb. From the spearhead, though, the motes are blood red.

两侧嶙峋的山坡陡然坠向其间的溪流，夹出一条狭窄的峡谷。那里的水流在乱石间奔涌翻滚，许多岩块因从悬挑的峭壁上崩落而棱角犹利。沿着峡壁淌下的一道泥泞细流，冷冷提醒着这片区域的地势有多么不稳。
Two rocky hillsides drop steeply down to the stream between them, creating a narrow gorge. The water there rushes over rocks, many of them still sharp after shearing off overhanging cliffs. A muddy rivulet running down the wall of the ravine serves as a stark reminder of the area’s instability.

White Noise Generator.name:
白噪音发生器
White Noise Generator

Text.text:
地板上方悬浮着一颗巨大的玻璃球。它低声嗡鸣，仿佛正处于低功率模式。玻璃球中央，一枚带着紫色斑点的黑铁核心强烈震颤。每一道斑点都迸裂出一条阴狠的紫粉色闪电，腾跃而出，劈向玻璃内壁并炸散成火花。随着闪电不断击打，机器中涌出一层铺天盖地的白噪，像毛毯般裹住整个空间。
Floating above the floor is a giant glass ball. It hums softly, as though set to a low-power mode. In the center of the ball thrums a black iron core speckled with purple spots. From each spot crackles a wicked purple-pink line of lightning, leaping out to strike the inner surface of the glass and splitting into sparks. As the lightning strikes, a blanket fuzz of white noise emanates from the machine.

Blind Barbarian Woman.name:
失明的野蛮女战士
Blind Barbarian Woman

Text.text:
她那超乎常人的站姿与小心翼翼的步伐，与其说源于原始的护甲和粗暴的体格，不如说全写在她的眼睛里。她深深吸气，鼻尖时常向空中微抬。她微偏头倾听，伸手轻触桌沿与椅背，循着酒香在麦酒前坐下。她笑着举杯，随即用一声粗哑的低哼，向对面的人打了招呼。

~ 扮演：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Her preternatural posture, her careful step, is explained more by her eyes than her primitive armor and brutal physique. She breathes deeply, raising her nose to the air frequently. She tips her head to listen, reaches out to table edges and chairs, and sits before the ale she smells. She smiles and raises the glass, then greets the person across from her in a rough grunt.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Ancient Battlefield With Cairns.name:
古战场与石冢
Ancient Battlefield With Cairns

Text.text:
这片谷地在环抱的丘陵间铺展开来，草浪与野花铺成一片丰茂的原野，随风起伏摇曳。散落的石堆点缀其间：有的细瘦如塔，几乎只及腰高；有的却是由巨石层层垒起的庞大石冢。几根开裂的旗杆仍伫立着——其上只剩几缕被烈日漂白的战旗碎片在风中飘荡。
This dale spreads out between encompassing hills in a lush field of grasses and wildflowers that wave with the wind. Piles of stones dot the expanse: some narrow towers hardly waist high, others huge cairns made from stacked boulders. A few cracked flagpoles stand—fluttering scraps of sun-bleached battle flags.

I Cast Freedom Of Movement.name:
我施放“行动自如”
I Cast Freedom Of Movement

Text.text:
我汇聚起奥术力量，疾步冲向同伴，张开双掌，轻轻按在他们身躯两侧。随着一声高喝，我双手猛然向下划去。湛蓝的魔法自指间迸裂，织入他们体内，皮肤下的血脉涌动着光芒。此刻，他们步伐带着弹性，动作如流水般顺畅，轻盈敏捷，宛如一只猫。
Gathering my arcane power, I rush to my companion and place an open palm lightly on either side of their body. With a shout, I swipe my hands downward. Blue magic cracks from my hands and weaves into them, the veins under their skin surging with light. There is now a bounce to their step and a fluidity to their movements, light and nimble as a cat.

Futuristic Arms Market.name:
未来武器集市
Futuristic Arms Market

Text.text:
入口毫不起眼，藏得极深；可一踏进去，市集仿佛绵延无尽。隐蔽在这条后巷仓库的私密空间里，老练的罪犯像街头果贩般吆喝兜售：一排排狭小摊位连成长龙，无数商人讨价还价，喊价声压过沉重的低音鼓点；每个摊位上，武器在昏橙的光里冷冷闪烁。这里聚着一群无赖、佣兵与退役军人，没人露出笑意。
The entrance is unassuming and well hidden, but inside, the market seems to extend forever. In the privacy of this back-alley warehouse, hardened criminals are touting their wares like common fruit-sellers: rows of small stalls where countless merchants haggle, shouting prices over the sound of a heavy bassline, and at each stall weapons glitter in the low orange light. A gallery of rogues, mercs, and ex-military are gathered here, and nobody is smiling.

你面前这位高大健硕的兽人女子，仿佛暮光的化身。她的肌肤是暮色天际般深邃的蓝，头发是薄暮幽影般柔和的紫，明亮的黄色眼眸像晚祷时分初初试探的星辰，令她显得格外神秘。她以夜色般沉静的坚毅自持，举手投足都经过谨慎斟酌——言语更是如此。你仿佛瞥见她唇角掠过一丝笑意，可那对突出的獠牙让人很难分辨。

~ 由一位英雄 扮演，其

The tall, muscular orcish woman before you is the living embodiment of twilight. Skin the deep blue of dusk’s horizon, hair the soft purple of twilight’s gloaming, and bright yellow eyes like the first tentative stars of evensong, give her a truly mystical appearance. She carries herself with the quiet stoicism of night, her every movement carefully considered—her words even more so. You think you see the hint of a smile cross her lips, but with her protruding fangs it is hard to tell.

~ Played by a Hero with

Sundries From A Nabassu.name:
纳巴苏的杂物
Sundries From A Nabassu

Text.text:
当那恶毒的恶魔化作阴影般的薄雾消散后，你独自留在它的巢穴里，先前受害者的遗物——以及尸体——在四周胡乱堆叠。枯槁的尸骸间有一道微光攫住了你的视线。只是一颗闪亮的衬衫纽扣。
As the vile demon dissipates into shadowy mist, you are left alone in its lair, the possessions—and corpses—of its previous victims piled haphazardly all around. A glimmer catches your eye from among the desiccated cadavers. It’s just a shiny shirt button.

手推车微微前倾，长长的把手末端撑在地上，正处于休息状态。车板粗糙，金属处斑驳着锈色——想必是有人拉着它淋了雨。切下的青稞秆零散四周，还有几根从车斗边缘垂落。车身散发着谷物、油脂与木头混合的气味。
The cart leans forward, resting on the ends of its long handles. Its boards are rough, and patches of rust color the metal where someone pulling it got caught in the rain. Scattered around and hanging from the edge of the cart bed are stalks of cut barley. The cart smells of grain and oil and wood.

Amulet Of The Planes.name:
位面护身符
Amulet Of The Planes

Text.text:
护身符悬在一条朴素的银链上，与它超凡脱俗的本质形成鲜明反差。它看起来像一枚带有环纹的圆环，中心空空如也，令人联想到一扇巨大的圆形门扉。护身符表面环绕着一圈符号，每一个都与某个存在位面相系——有些你认得，有些却陌生得令人不安。下一站，去哪里？
The amulet hangs on a simple silver chain, belying its otherworldly nature. It appears as a banded ring, hollow at its center, evoking the image of a great, circular gate. Symbols girdle the surface of the amulet, each tied to a plane of existence—some you recognize, others you don't. Where to next?

Quip About Mages By A Sorcerer.name:
一位术士对法师的冷嘲热讽
Quip About Mages By A Sorcerer

Text.text:
“你的魔法陈腐得像在发霉的博物馆里当展品，被尘封在落满灰的古籍里。我只要想着快乐的念头，动动手指，就会发生各种有趣的事。”
“Your magic is so stale, wrapped in dusty tomes like some exhibit at a decrepit museum. I just think happy thoughts, wiggle my fingers, and all sorts of fun things happen.”

Boilerplate Factory.name:
锅炉模板工厂
Boilerplate Factory

Text.text:
释放阀不时喷出一阵阵蒸汽，昏暗的主厅里闷热潮湿，热气浓得几乎化不开。一排巨大的铁制圆筒有小推车般的体型，靠蒸汽驱动的道具与活塞系统缓缓转动。穿黑色羊毛长裤和工装衬衫的工人满身汗水，将一张张金属板送上每个圆筒；泼在其上的水立刻腾起团团蓝色雾汽。沿着生产线往里走，越过处理槽与锻锤工位，一排锅炉板整齐竖立，准备送往制造蒸汽机锅炉的工厂。
Bouts of steam fire from release valves, and the humid heat is thick in the poorly lit main room. A row of massive iron cylinders the size of small carts turns on steam-powered gear-and-piston systems. Sweaty workers in black wool pants and work shirts load sheets of metal onto each cylinder, and the water poured over them produces clouds of blue vapor. Down the line, past the treatment vats and hammer lines, stands a platoon of boilerplates that will go to the factories that make steam engine boilers.

Klikharp Mount.name:
克利卡竖琴坐骑
Klikharp Mount

Text.text:
一只巨大的蓝色虫子恭敬地深深鞠躬，坚硬的几丁质甲壳优雅地贴近地面。四条粗壮的肢体支撑着这只生物的负载，它看上去宛如一只巨型的钴蓝色甲虫。缠绕在它腰间的精致鞍具被匠心雕琢，点缀着繁复的黄铜金丝花纹。
A large blue bug bows low in deference, bringing its chitinous carapace gracefully toward the ground. Four thick limbs support the bulk of the creature, which resembles a gigantic cobalt-blue beetle. The sophisticated saddle wrapped around its waist has been painstakingly decorated with intricate brass filigree.

Ziak'dathel Falnan.name:
兹亚克·达瑟尔·法尔南
Ziak'dathel Falnan

Text.text:
橄榄色皮肤的半精灵将磨旧的斗篷随手甩到一侧肩头，手握一张雕工精美的长弓，自幽暗中悄然逼近。他沿着林缘游弋，翡翠般的双眼警觉扫视，鹰钩鼻的脸庞绷得紧紧的，脚下毫无声息——柔软的靴底灵巧地避开一堆堆被日光漂白的蕨枝。忽然，他停住了，悄无声息地搭箭、开弓，涂油的皮护甲紧贴在他结实的躯干上。猎物冲破掩蔽。猎人身形一拧，抬弓、瞄准、放弦一气呵成，纤细的箭矢穿林而过，重重钉入目标的背脊。半精灵的面容掠过一丝满足的笑意，他一边重新装填，一边走向倒地的猎获。

~ Played by Vmaster1995 with

The olive-skinned half-elf tosses his weathered cloak across one shoulder as he stalks out of the gloom with a beautifully carved longbow in hand. He prowls along the tree line, jade eyes alert, aquiline face tense, making no sound—soft boots adroitly avoiding stacks of sun-bleached bracken. Abruptly he stops, silently nocking and drawing, oiled leather armor tight against his muscular frame. The quarry breaks cover. In one fluid motion the hunter twists, aims, and looses a slender arrow, which zips between trees to hammer into the target’s back. A satisfied smile flickers across the half-elf’s features, as he reloads and approaches his fallen prey.

~ Played by Vmaster1995 with

I Cast Meld Into Stone.name:
我施放《融身入石》
I Cast Meld Into Stone

Text.text:
一阵寒颤掠过全身，我感到自己存在的每一丝都化作光与流体。我先伸出双手——穿入石中，轻易得像把手伸进水里，可触感却像正游进一池细沙。古老尘土的气息灌满鼻腔，所有声音都被闷住。虽不疼痛，我却能清楚感到四周石壁的沉重压迫。我一动不动地站着，屏息等待下一步行动。
A shiver runs through my body as I feel every iota of my being become light and liquid. I pass—hands first—into the stone, as easily as someone might dip into water, though the feeling is as if I am swimming into a pool of sand. The scent of ages-old dirt fills my nose, and all sound becomes muffled. Although there is no pain, I do feel the weight of the stone around me. I stand very still, waiting to make my next move.

Detecting The Goblet Of Divulgence.name:
侦测「坦白之杯」
Detecting The Goblet Of Divulgence

Text.text:
酒液尚未沾唇，你便已察觉。此杯绝非寻常酒盏。唇边那阵刺痒并非水晶的冰凉，亦非酒中胡椒的辛辣——而是急不可耐、阴险狡诈的魔法在嗡嗡震颤。

~ 出自精彩的 TTRPG 资料集 The Vineyard

Before the wine touches your lips, you sense it. This goblet is no normal cup. The tingling against your mouth is not the chill of the crystal or the pepper in the wine—it is the vibration of eager, nefarious magic.

~ Found in the amazing TTRPG supplement The Vineyard

Victory Line By An Overly Excited New Ad.name:
胜利台词：来自一位过度兴奋的新晋冒险者
Victory Line By An Overly Excited New Adventurer

Text.text:
“太刺激了！那份戏剧性！那种危险……呃，这问题可能有点蠢，但稍微有点兴奋是正常的吗？”
“That was so exciting! The drama! The danger… And uh, this may be a silly question, but is it normal to be slightly aroused?”

Loot From A Griffon Rookery.name:
狮鹫巢穴的战利品
Loot From A Griffon Rookery

Text.text:
在旧鸦舍里一场宴席的残羹冷炙间——也能看出曾有人为财物大打出手的痕迹——散落着各式钱币与珠宝，合计价值20金币。
Among the remains of a feast in the former rookery, which also shows signs of a tussle over property, are various coins and jewelry together worth 20 gold pieces.

在一座以花岗岩为锚的吊桥上方，蓝白色的狂飙尖啸着掠过裂谷。迎风的绳索覆着冰壳，木板桥面被冻霜涂抹出步步惊心的危险。绳结间系着色彩鲜艳的祈愿绶带，在风中磨损飞散。头顶是令人目眩的湛蓝天空。脚下则是一幅美得令人窒息的死亡风景。前方——旅程。

~ 设想：Pitt Warrior

At a swing bridge anchored in granite, a blue-white squall screams over the crevasse. Ice is crusted on the upwind ropes and paints the bridge with danger on the wooden slats. Knotted along the ropes, brightly colored prayer ribbons fray in the wind. Above you is the dizzying blue sky. Down is a beautiful landscape of death. Ahead—the journey.

~ Envisioned by Pitt Warrior

Sundries From A Mezzoloth.name:
来自梅佐洛斯的杂物
Sundries From A Mezzoloth

Text.text:
那昆虫般的生物已然死去，浓稠腥臭的脓液在它周围积成一滩。战斗中，它几块几丁质护甲板被撞脱，但早已断裂崩碎，化作细小的碎片。
The insectoid creature lies dead, with thick, stinking ichor pooling around it. Some of its chitinous armor plates were dislodged in the battle, but they are broken and sundered into tiny shards.

Magical Detection Of A Ranger's Class.name:
游侠职业的魔法侦测
Magical Detection Of A Ranger's Class

Text.text:
一支由藤蔓编成的细长直箭——唯有你能看见——凌空悬浮，直指你的目标心口；随即猛地鼓胀变形，软塌塌地坠落在地。
A long, straight arrow made of vines, which only you can see, levitates and aims at your target’s heart, then puffs out of shape and falls to the ground.

Juvenile Nyssholora.name:
幼年尼索洛拉
Juvenile Nyssholora

Text.text:
一只年幼的蜥蜴带着野性的好奇，用爪子拨弄着泥土。它的皮革呈淡紫色，点点斑驳，在枝叶间格外醒目。远处传来一声响动，生物抬起头，凶悍鳞甲覆面的厚重轮廓后似有一丝光影闪烁。下一瞬，它猛然放声咆哮——喧嚣刺耳、铺天盖地，仿佛一艘太空巡洋舰自头顶掠过的尖啸。
A young lizard paws at the earth with animal curiosity. Its hide is lilac and spotted, easy to pick out among the foliage. At a distant noise, the creature looks up, something flickering behind the scaly bulk of its intimidating face. All at once, it unleashes a roar, cacophonous and overwhelming, like the overhead scream of a space cruiser.

Cleric's Speech Of Self-affirmation.name:
牧师的自我肯定宣言
Cleric's Speech Of Self-affirmation

Text.text:
“你体内燃着一团辉煌的烈火。它的光将焚尽邪恶，也将温暖困厄之人。你仁慈，你正义。你会记得所有被你斩杀的人——他们罪行滔天，可他们的死亡依旧令人悲恸。可你也会记得那些因你得救而泪眼重逢、含笑致谢的人；没有他们，你便无所为。”
“There is a glorious fire in you. Its light will burn out the wicked and warm those in need. You are kind and you are righteous. You will remember all those you have slain, their transgressions heinous, but their deaths still tragic. But you will also remember the tearful reunions and grateful smiles of those you’ve saved; for without them, you would have no purpose.”

Loot From A Piercer.name:
穿刺怪的战利品
Loot From A Piercer

Text.text:
在真正的石笋之下，满地都是那些狡诈的坠刺怪尸体。它们的恶臭几乎淹没了洞窟——临死前，它们的躯体仍在分泌腥臭黏液，像是最后一次试图把你逼退。可你的目光随即捕捉到更早那些没那么走运的旅人遗迹：一堆被啃得精光、只剩白骨的残骸。坠刺怪把衣物与背包原封不动地丢在一旁。你硬顶着臭气翻找骸骨，从中搜出三瓶治疗药水，瓶封未破、药液未坏。你还在其中一个背包底部摸到一只方正的矮人藏匣。撬开一看，里面静静躺着五颗闪耀的绿宝石。
Underneath the true stalagmites, corpses of the duplicitous piercers cover the ground. Their stink overwhelms the cavern as their bodies secrete a foul-smelling mucus—their last attempt at repelling you. But your eye catches the remnants of past not-so-fortunate travelers: a litter of bones picked clean of their flesh. The piercers have left the clothes and packs untouched. Braving the stench, you loot the skeletal remains. You scrounge up three potions of healing, unopened and unspoiled. You also find a square dwarven cache nestled at the bottom of one of the knapsacks. Cracking it open, you find five glittering emeralds inside.

Sir Gareth At The Joust.name:
加雷斯爵士在马上比武
Sir Gareth At The Joust

Text.text:
骑士在众人注目中策马而出，掀起面甲，让一抹笑意温暖他年轻的面庞。他那面湛蓝盾牌上醒目地绘着一只银狮的正面狮首徽，獠牙大张，发出不屈的咆哮。待他汇入竞技场中央等候的骑士队列时，他挥舞着一位女士的信物，引得王室宫廷里一名面颊绯红的少女含羞一笑。

~ 构想：Vahlaron

The knight rides out before the crowd, raising his visor and allowing a smile to warm his youthful face. Emblazoned on his shield of azure is the caboshed of an argent lion, its jaws open in a defiant roar. As he joins the knights waiting in the center of the arena, he waves a lady’s favor, eliciting a shy smile from a blushing maiden of the royal court.

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

Canals Through A City In Winter.name:
冬日里穿城而过的运河
Canals Through A City In Winter

Text.text:
一层雪兜压在城上，狭窄的水道迅速封冻。长船的船长们硬逼着船只穿过冰塞的航道，篷布遮盖的货物边缘结着白霜。路人高声呼喊助威，手持长篙的船员们奋力砸冰，试图凿出一条路。
A cowl of snow smothers the city, its narrow waterways freezing fast. Longboat skippers force their vessels through ice-choked channels, tarp covered cargo rimed with frost. Passersby shout their encouragement, as pole armed crews try to smash their way through.

Romance Between Hunter And Fey.name:
猎人与妖精的罗曼史
Romance Between Hunter And Fey

Text.text:
一只手轻轻接触背部的腰窝，竟如此撩人，以至于这支舞成了一场求偶。他们心知肚明，在森林深处相拥而立，脸颊贴着胸膛。两人被妖精的魅惑托举，也被一份纯净如他们所旅行至的那声晚安的爱意托举。舞终之时，他们仍旧相拥不散。

~ Envisioned by Alone In the Wind

So sensual is the touch of a hand against the small of a back that the dance becomes a courtship. They know this, embracing in the middle of the forest, cheek against chest. The two are transported by the enchantment of the fey and by a love as pure as the good night to which they travel. At the end of their dance, they remain embraced.

~ Envisioned by Alone In the Wind

Giant Skeletons Hurling Rocks.name:
巨骸投石
Giant Skeletons Hurling Rocks

Text.text:
又一块巨石——这一次足有一辆货车那么大——轰然砸在这座饱受蹂躏、摇摇欲坠的城墙上。雪无声地成团飘落，落进那些围攻聚落的巨型骸骨深陷的眼眶与空洞的骨腔里。头顶，一轮冷漠的月亮从厚重的云堆间探出身来，以宇宙般的无动于衷俯视着这片满目疮痍。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Another boulder—this time the size of a wagon—crashes against the crumbling walls of the beleaguered city. Snow falls in silent flurries, settling in the deep sockets and hollows of the gigantic skeletons laying siege to the settlement. Overhead, an uncaring moon emerges from a bank of thick heavy clouds and looks down on the devastation with cosmic indifference.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Guildhall Armory.name:
公会大厅军械库
Guildhall Armory

Text.text:
训练场与熔炉之间矗立着一座小小的石砌建筑，里面陈列着一套朴素的武器。虽说这些家伙并不花哨，也谈不上珍贵，但皆由公会铁匠扎实打造，足以让初出茅庐的冒险者有个像样的起步。长剑、匕首、弩与弓一应俱全，弩矢与箭矢也同样备有。
A small stone building between the training areas and the forge offers a modest array of weaponry. While the arms are not particularly flashy or valuable, they are decently made by the guild smiths and offer a start for the greenhorn adventurer. Blades, daggers, crossbows, and bows are available, as well as bolts and arrows.

Faerie Plane Seeps Into The Shadow Plane.name:
妖精位面渗入暗影位面
Faerie Plane Seeps Into The Shadow Plane

Text.text:
一道光绽放开来，像花瓣般舒展，从门扉中渗出时愈发明亮。藤蔓与根须随之涌现，攀抓石面，奋力把自己拖入影之位面。光里升起一股暖意，伴着若有若无的肉桂、薰衣草与湿润腐殖土的气息。蜿蜒藤蔓那鲜活的翠绿、层层叠叠的花簇流光溢彩，在这片枯死凋敝的荒景中显得格格不入。然而植物依旧扎根，劈开苦涩的板岩灰石，向外蔓延，扩展进黑暗之中。
A light blossoms, unfurling like the petals of a flower and growing brighter as it bleeds through the gate. Vines and roots emerge, grasping at stones as they heave themselves into the plane of shadow. A warmth rises from the light, and with it, faint smells of cinnamon, lavender, and loam. The vibrant green of the snaking vines, the dazzling array of blossoms, seem strikingly out-of-place here among the dead and withered landscape. And yet, the plants take root, split the bitter, slate-gray stone and expand outward into the darkness.

Sermon About The Destroyer Gods.name:
关于毁灭者神祇的布道
Sermon About The Destroyer Gods

Text.text:
“我今日立于诸位面前，心如负重，因为我必须谈及黑暗、痛苦，以及那毫不动摇的恶意。我并不以呼唤这些存在为乐，但我们必须明白，是何物与我们为敌。毁灭神祇——为散播苦难而生的存在。不幸、罪孽、纷争、战争、死亡、折磨与黑暗。亲身感受过它们影响的人，都清楚它们对良善之民那冷漠到残酷的无动于衷。它们并非邪恶。它们与我们一样，出自同一双神圣之手的塑造。尽管它们的使命令我们厌恶而困惑，但以它们自己的方式，它们也赐予了我们一份赋礼：选择。美德渴求对手；若无它们的存在，我们又将反对谁？又要如何失败？又要如何凯旋？因此今日，让我们献上应有的敬意。待我们下次相逢，愿我们能以平静而非怒火，将它们自心中驱逐。”

~ Envisioned by Ararion

“I stand before you today with a heavy heart, for I must speak of darkness, of pain, and of unflinching malice. I take no joy in invoking these beings, but we must understand what opposes us. The Destroyer Gods—beings created with the sole purpose of propagating misery. Misfortune, Sin, Discord, War, Death, Agony, and Darkness. Those of you who have felt their influence firsthand are well aware of their callous indifference toward decent folk. They are not evil. They were molded by the same divine hands as us. And while their purpose disgusts and perplexes us, in their own way, they have given us a gift: Choice. Virtue craves an adversary, and without their presence, who would we oppose? How would we fail? How would we triumph? So today, let us offer them our respect. When next we meet, we can banish them from our hearts with peace instead of fury.”

~ Envisioned by Ararion

Salty Drive Technician.name:
咸味驱动技师
Salty Drive Technician

Text.text:
饱受折腾的技师拖着疲惫又恼火的长叹，带着让人发困的低沉尾音去取她的工具箱，嘴里一路嘟囔着“真是没用”。她身形敦实，肩背宽阔，皮肤上仿佛附着着某种矿物，成簇晶亮，耀眼夺目。她拎着那只老旧却可靠的工具箱折返，立刻动手干活，低声咕哝着最好能为这摊烂事拿到加班费。
With an exasperated, droning sigh the beleaguered technician fetches her toolbox, grumbling about incompetence. She has a stocky, broad-shouldered physique and appears to have a form of mineral attached to her skin in dazzling clusters. Returning with her venerable toolbox she sets to work, muttering under her breath that she better get overtime for this.

一道身影从你身旁掠过，快得根本看不清。那团划破空气的残影忽然一缓，形体随之显露：一只小巧的鸟形生物，长着革质的翅膜与凶狠的钩状尖喙。它轻盈得不可思议地悬停而来，仿佛在半空中漂浮。紧接着，它又以不可能的速度猛然折向上空——抽搐、闪颤、扫视着地平线。那双细小的珠眼以骇人的敏捷抖动着。
A shape streaks past you, impossible to make out. This blur through the air slows for a moment and its form is revealed: a small birdlike creature with leathery wings and a vicious hooked beak. It hovers in with such effortless grace it seems to be levitating. Then it banks upwards impossibly fast—twitching, flickering, scanning the horizon. Its little beady eyes shudder with alarming alacrity.

一簇簇结着血痂的鬃毛纠成一条厚重的脊梁般的隆起，从这生物的犬首一路延伸过它佝偻的背脊，钻入皮护甲之下。你所能看见的身体部分覆着斑点皮毛，早被污秽与血肉涂染：一张利齿森然的巨口，犬类般的腿，尽头是带爪的脚掌，以及近似人类的手臂——挥舞武器时竟灵巧得出奇。
A bristle of blood-caked hair forms a matted ridge, running from the creature’s canine head over its hunched back and under hide armor. Spotted fur, stained with filth and gore, covers the parts of the body you can see: a toothy maw, dog-like legs ending in clawed paws, and human-like arms that wield weapons with surprising agility.

Ancient Blue Dragon Encounter.name:
远古蓝龙遭遇
Ancient Blue Dragon Encounter

Text.text:
闪电在巨龙雄伟身躯周围翻卷成一道扭动的电冕，噼啪作响；它轰然展开遮天巨翼，雷霆般的拍击震得大地都在颤抖。巨龙的皮鳞因年代而愈发黯沉，鳞片被染成深邃的海军蓝，闪烁着如无瑕蓝宝石深处般的幽光。它迎上你的目光，竟向你露出一抹笑意——伤痕累累的蓝色唇缘向后卷起，露出长如巨剑的利齿；哪怕最勇敢的冒险者，也会因此不寒而栗。
Lightning crackles in a writhing corona around the mighty dragon as it unfurls colossal wings with a thunderclap that shakes the very ground. The dragon’s hide has darkened with age, its scales painted a deep navy blue that shimmers like the depths of a flawless sapphire. Meeting your gaze, it offers you a smile, the scarred blue lips curling back to reveal teeth long as greatswords—enough to cause a shudder of terror in even the bravest adventurer.

这名矮人看起来古老得惊人：白胡子几乎拖到地上，胡子上方那张脸布满深深皱纹。他的衣着出奇地鲜艳，缀满补丁，补丁上仿佛描绘着各式生物、人群与风景。背上扛着一只巨大的箱子，彩绘明快、雕工繁复。那似乎是一座便携的阶段，就像木偶戏会用到的那种。
The dwarf looks ancient, as judged by the wrinkled face above a white beard that nearly reaches the ground. His clothes are uncommonly colorful, decorated with patches that appear to depict creatures, people, and places. On his back he carries a large, gaily painted and intricately carved box. It seems to be a kind of portable stage, as one might use for a puppet show.

I Use Fast Hands For Sleight Of Hand.name:
我用“迅捷之手”来进行“巧手”检定。
I Use Fast Hands For Sleight Of Hand

Text.text:
一丝微不足道的分神便能开启这场把戏。我让他们只察觉到我想让他们察觉的东西，而我则以娴熟而迅捷的双手悄然动工——掏走口袋里的东西，或欺瞒他们的眼睛。转瞬之间，欺骗已然完成，无人起疑。
A tiny distraction starts the trick. I let them sense only what I want as I go to work with skillful and speedy hands—picking a pocket or fooling the eye. In a flash my deception is done and no one is the wiser.

Celestial Enters Tavern.name:
天界来客踏入酒馆
Celestial Enters Tavern

Text.text:
酒馆里的气氛随着那位陌生人穿过拥挤的酒厅走进来而变得轻快欢腾；他们对每一个擦肩而过的人微笑致意。那人肌肤泛着一层若有若无的迷人光泽，双眼是澄澈冬日晴空般的虹彩蓝，凡与其目光相触者都能感到爱与怜悯。路边的酒馆里回荡着热烈的乐声与歌唱，友谊与同袍之情充盈整间屋子。

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

The atmosphere in the tavern becomes light and joyous as the stranger makes their way inside through the crowded taproom, smiling at everyone they meet. Their skin shimmers with a subtly enchanting hue, and eyes the iridescent blue of a clear winter sky offer love and compassion to all who meet their gaze. The roadside tavern rings with exuberant music and song as the spirit of camaraderie fills the room.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Speech About Grieving A Lost Friend.name:
关于悼念亡友的致辞

今天，我们聚在这里，为了纪念一位曾与我们同行、如今却先一步离开的人。此刻的沉默并不空洞，它承载着我们说不出口的思念、遗憾与不舍。

失去一位朋友，不只是少了一个可以并肩走路的人，更像是世界里某个熟悉的角落忽然熄了灯。我们会在某个笑点、某句口头禅、某条旧路口，突然想起他（她）本该在身边。那种猝不及防的空缺，会让人呼吸都变得迟疑。

但请允许我也说：悲伤并不羞耻。它证明我们曾经真切地相遇、真切地相知。我们为他（她）流泪，是因为那段友情曾经真实地照亮过我们的生活。我们怀念的，不只是他（她）离开的那一刻，而是他（她）在场时带来的温度——一个眼神就懂的默契，一句“我在”就能稳住人心的力量。

如果要用一句话总结他（她）留下的意义，那或许是：他（她）让我们变得更勇敢、更柔软，也更愿意相信人。那些一起经历的日常与风雨，已经在我们身上留下些什么——它们不会随着离别消散，而会在未来的某一天，成为我们继续前行的支撑。

今天，我们不必强迫自己“放下”。我们可以学着“带着”——带着想念，带着他（她）教会我们的善意与坚定，带着那份曾经被陪伴过的证据。让他（她）的名字仍能在我们口中被温柔地提起，让他（她）的故事仍能在我们心里有光。

愿我们在悲伤里仍彼此照看，在回忆里仍能微笑。愿他（她）在没有痛苦的地方安息，而我们，也终将学会用更平静的方式，把爱延续下去。

谢谢你，朋友。你离开了，但你曾经给予的一切，会一直在。
Speech About Grieving A Lost Friend

Text.text:
“我觉得，随着日子一天天过去，我就像在一层层剥开新的悲痛。正当我以为自己已经能稳住时，就会被某个转瞬即逝的片段或细微的特质提醒，又得把他们的离去重新痛受一遍。仿佛我必须在他们的死亡里，再一次像他们生前那样重新认识他们。”
“I feel as though, with each passing day, I peel back new layers of grief. Right when I think I have a handle on things I am reminded of a fleeting moment or subtle quality and I must suffer their loss all over again. It’s as if I must get to know them in death as I once did in life.”

Final Encounter With Dagne, Bride Of Rui.name:
与达格涅——毁灭新娘的最终遭遇
Final Encounter With Dagne, Bride Of Ruin

Text.text: 达格妮在神龛前高举双臂，头顶天穹风暴咆哮。那块甲壳般的石头如今嵌在她的戒指里，正以低沉的脉动轰鸣着力量。“我的挚爱，你的孩子们在这里。他们在痛苦中哭嚎，被伪神祇那恶毒的意志刺瞎了双眼。赐予他们你怀抱的安宁——让他们看见一个没有匮乏、没有苦难、没有欢愉的世界。一个唯一的世界。”雷霆炸裂，粗陋神殿的地基都被震得颤抖。“而当黎明照亮这初生的世界，我们也必须成为新的。”她指向神殿中央的深坑，那是对深渊的触及。虚空里涌出一声叹息，低沉翻滚，带着腐朽的恶臭扑面而来。爪牙们纷纷跪倒，武器叮当落在石地上。他们的脊骨折断又变尖，关节处的皮肤一节节硬化，颚钳从面孔里撕裂钻出。凄厉的哀嚎与暴风的轰鸣交织在一起，又被达格妮狂喜的放声大笑盖过。 Dagne raises her arms before the shrine, a storm raging in the sky above. The crustaceous stone, now embedded in her ring, thrums with power. “My love, your children are here. They cry out in agony, blinded by the malignant will of false gods. Give them the peace of your embrace—show them a world free of want, of suffering, of joy. A world of one.” Thunder crashes, shaking the foundations of the crude temple. “And, as dawn breaks over this infant world, so too must we become new.” She points to the pit in the center of the temple, a reach into the abyss. A sigh, rumbling and stinking of decay, rushes from the void. The henchpeople drop to their knees, their weapons clattering against the stone. Their spines break and sharpen, their skin hardens at each joint, and mandibles tear out of their faces. Their agonized cries meld with the thundering of the storm and Dagne’s ecstatic peals of laughter.

Plane Of Salt.name:
盐之位面
Plane Of Salt

Text.text:
由一种奇异尘埃堆起的低矮沙丘，仿佛盐、石膏、白色碳粉、砂粒与骨屑混合而成。这是一处阈限空间，一片边境荒原：水无法在此存活，平坦大地可延伸至目力尽头。此位面容纳万物，归于彻底的干涸。不同层次的坚实度将这物质塑成分形晶簇、砂砾洞窟与台地，也卷起旋舞的盐暴，在干风中刮去血肉。人在此太容易迷失，口渴着游荡于白色荒原。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Low dunes of a dust made of a strange substance like salt, gypsum, white carbon, sand, and bone. This is a liminal space, a borderland where water cannot live and where flats can stretch beyond sight. The plane accounts for all things in complete desiccation. Various levels of solidity form the substance into fractal crystals, gritty caverns and mesas, and whirling salt storms that scour off the flesh in dry winds. Too easy to be lost here, roaming the White Wastes in thirst.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

一座水车在河畔旋转，周而复始的哗啦水响叠在流水的潺潺轻笑之上。与它相连的石砌建筑想必是一座磨坊；本地农户在此碾磨、往来交易，久而久之便在周围催生出一处小聚落。也许磨坊主觉得生意兴隆，便舍得投入，修起这座横跨河面的坚固桥梁——石与木相衔，稳稳架起两岸。
A water wheel spins beside the river, adding its repeated sloshing to the chuckle of the flow. The stone building to which it is attached must be a mill, and its use by local farmers—and the trade they bring—has grown a little settlement up around it. Perhaps the mill’s owner found it prosperous enough to invest in building the sturdy bridge of stone and timber that crosses the river.

你在脑海里勾勒出要打造的牢狱，用你能想到最坚硬的材质塑出它的地面、四壁与穹顶。一只钻石匣——仿佛镶珠嵌玉的囚笼——在你眼前成形，然而唯有你能看见。最后几个手势落下，你从口袋里捻起一撮红宝石粉尘，像拧钥匙般将其一转；当你把那把“钥匙”掷出去，它在空中翻飞时闪耀如宝石，旋即无声消失。
You envision the prison you are making, crafting its floor, sides, and ceiling from the hardest thing you can think of. A diamond box, a kind of jeweled jail, takes form before your eyes, though only you can see it. With the last gestures, you pinch ruby dust in your pocket and turn it like you would a key, and when you throw that key away it glitters, gem-like as it flips through the air before vanishing.

Quip About Glory Stealing.name:
关于抢夺荣耀的俏皮话
Quip About Glory Stealing

Text.text:
“你杀了它？嗯，好吧。干得不错。我曾梦想有一天能亲手屠了那样的生物，让镇民们围坐换着花样传颂我的功绩。可你就这么把它给杀了。我想他们接下来要唱的歌，不是我斩杀——而是我……帮了忙。”
“You killed it? Well, that’s fine. Good job. I had dreamed of one day slaying such a creature, of townsfolk swapping stories of my deed. But then you just kind of killed it. I guess instead they’ll sing songs about how I… helped.”

Kitsune Blade Dancer.name:
狐刃舞者
Kitsune Blade Dancer

Text.text:
舞者旋身疾转，橙色皮毛与鲜艳布料翻涌成一团流光；他手中的刀刃几乎只剩下闪烁的海市蜃楼——这便是他的速度。乐声攀至摄魂的高潮，他的舞步也抵达巅峰，动作愈发凌空翻跃，令人目眩神迷。演出落幕，人群轰然爆发出狂热的掌声；他深深躬身，胸口起伏，喘息粗重。

~ VoidBlood 于 Discord 构想

The dancer is a blur of orange fur and swirling vibrant cloth as he twirls, his blades little more than a shimmering mirage—such is his speed. As the music reaches an enthralling crescendo, his dance reaches its apex and he becomes increasingly acrobatic and captivating. Those assembled burst into rapturous applause as the performance ends and he bows low, panting heavily.

~ Envisioned by VoidBlood on Discord

Agnar Shieldbreaker.name:
阿格纳·碎盾者
Agnar Shieldbreaker

Text.text:
铁匠铺里光线昏暗，这位黑胡子的矮人却毫不退缩，目光在四周游走，敏锐得像刀锋，也严苛得近乎无情。他拨旺沉睡的炉火，重燃的火焰吐出跳动的亮光，却仿佛被他那身深蓝护甲吞没了。他把战锤与盾牌搁到一旁，开始在工作台周围摆开几样私人物件：一枚矮人神祇的圣徽、一罐用于水泡的治疗膏、一把结实的锤子（锤头缠着鞣制兽皮）、一口用得油光发亮的铸铁锅，以及一本皮革装订、封面写着 Recipes 的书。他的手又不自觉地探向腰侧的叉子，指腹缓缓摩挲着那宽阔的叉齿，像是在回味某段记忆，随即收束心神，重新投入手艺之中。

~ Played by Santi with

Undeterred by the dimness in the smithy, the black-bearded dwarf looks around, his vision both perceptive and fiercely critical. After he stokes the dormant forge’s fire, the reborn flame casts a flickering light, though this is seemingly swallowed up by his dark blue armor. He sets aside his warhammer and shield and arrays a few personal effects around the workspace: a holy symbol of a dwarven god, a healing balm against blisters, a sturdy hammer with its head wrapped in cured hide, a well-seasoned cast-iron pan, and a leather-bound book labeled Recipes. His hand strays to a fork holstered at his side. He fingers its wide tines thoughtfully, as though recalling a memory, before setting his mind to plying his craft.

~ Played by Santi with

Approaching Riverside Border Town In Sum.name:
盛夏时分，逼近河畔边境小镇
Approaching Riverside Border Town In Summer

Text.text:
森林戛然而止，一幅田园般的景致映入眼帘：深蓝的河水蜿蜒流过葱郁的绿野，点点散落着小块分配田。对岸坐落着一座矮墙环绕的小镇，建筑以未经切割的石块垒成，显得结实可靠，顶上覆着整齐的茅草屋顶。无云的晴空下，阳光炽烈地洒落在身着各色浅色短袍的人们身上，他们赤着脚沿着尘土飞扬的街道来来往往。

你一路跟随的土路通向一处浅滩，成群的孩子在浅水里嬉笑玩闹。几艘船停泊在岸边，帆布收拢，船员们正把货物卸到镇子尽头的小码头上。忙碌的蜜蜂发出安稳的嗡鸣，为这宁静的画面添上一层平和的底色。

The forest ends abruptly and an idyllic vista meets your eyes: a deep blue river meanders through lush green fields dotted with small allotments. On the far bank sits a low-walled town with sturdy-looking buildings made of uncut stone, and crowned by neatly thatched roofs. The sun beats down from a cloudless sky on folk wearing light tunics in myriad shades, making their way barefoot along the dusty streets.

The dirt road you have been following leads to a ford where groups of children laugh and play in the shallow water. Several boats are moored, their sails folded as their crews unload cargo onto the small dock at the end of town. The peaceful drone of bees hard at work underscores the tranquil scene.

White Dragon's Lair.name:
白龙巢穴
White Dragon's Lair

Text.text:
继续向冰窟更深处探行，你一踏入一座巨大的洞窟，牙齿便不由自主地咯咯打颤。冰冷的地面上散落着一堆堆硕大的湿软雪泥，顽固地拒绝融化。咸涩的海水气味弥漫四周，甚至比这座冰山中其他洞穴的余味更浓更刺鼻。你时不时能看见珠宝、钱币与其他珍宝，被封在冰壁之中，或半埋在洞内的雪泥堆里。

~ Envisioned by Josh Green

Venturing further and deeper into the ice caves, your teeth suddenly set to chattering as you emerge into an enormous cavern, the icy floor scattered with large slushy piles that stubbornly refuse to melt. The smell of salt water permeates throughout, even more strongly than in the rest of the caves within this mountain of ice. Here and there you can see jewels, coins, and other treasures encased within the iceberg walls and heaps of slush in the cavern.

~ Envisioned by Josh Green

I Play My Accordion.name:
我拉起手风琴
I Play My Accordion

Text.text:
琴键在指尖下清脆作响，乐器在我掌间的顺滑运转如流水般连绵。由此涌出的尽是欢愉——它的嗓音里，那些振奋人心的细小哨音与号角声紧密交织，汇成一束齐整的合唱。我踏着节拍走出步伐，邀房间里的人一同起舞。
The keys click under my fingers, and the smooth motion of the instrument between my hands is like flowing water. Out of it comes good cheer, the inspiring little whistles and horns of its voice in a tight chorus. I step out the beat and invite those in the room to dance.

一枚圣徽随着她利落的步伐在袍襟前来回弹跳；一册红色典籍，鎏金书页，在她一只臂弯里被牢牢夹紧。另一只手中，她握着一柄铁制权杖，杖首镶着一件饰物，形如蜷曲的鹰爪。她的脸上刻着淡白的疤痕与岁月的褶痕，怒色如暴风般翻涌——在凛然正义的决意中滚滚不息。
A holy symbol bounces against the front of her robes with her brisk walk, a red tome with gilded pages clasped firmly in one arm. In her other hand, she holds an iron scepter affixed at the top with an adornment that resembles a curling eagle’s claw. Her face, lined with pale scars and the creases of old age, is as furious as a storm—roiling with righteous determination.

碧绿的眼睛——柔和、内敛如玉的色泽——在专注中微微眯起。女人咬紧下颌，再次开始她的练习。她挺直肩膀，披在肩头的浅褐斗篷随之轻轻一动，露出护甲肩铠上那枚金色十字。她低头看向脚下，确认站位无误，波浪般的黑发随动作轻轻弹起；随即她握稳那柄沉重的钉头锤，举起一面饱经战火的盾牌。颈间的护符——同样是一枚金色十字——随着她深深而平稳的吸气上下起伏。她让呼吸定住心神，再次起势，带着要将这套动作磨到完美的决心。

~ Played by Alex with

Green eyes—the soft, muted hue of jade—narrow in concentration as the woman begins her exercise once more, her jaw set. She squares her shoulders, causing the tan cloak draped about them to shift slightly, unveiling the golden cross on her armored pauldron. Her wavy black hair bounces as she looks to her feet, ensuring they are correctly positioned, before she readies her formidable mace and raises a battle-worn shield. The amulet around her neck—another golden cross—rises and falls as she takes a deep, steadying breath and begins the maneuver again, determined to perfect the task.

~ Played by Alex with

Brooch Of Shielding.name:
护盾胸针
Brooch Of Shielding

Text.text:
这枚巨大的圆盘胸针因抛光银面的温润光泽与其间镶嵌的点点蓝白宝石而熠熠生辉。那些宝石似乎是粗切的蓝宝石与钻石，以一圈圈同心圆的悦目纹样点缀其上。你原以为它会是件分量十足的饰物，拿在手里却发现重量只有你猜测的一半。
This large disc brooch glitters both from its burnished silver and the flecks of blue and white gems set into it. The gems appear to be roughly cut sapphires and diamonds, added to the brooch in a pleasing pattern of concentric circles. You expect it to be a hefty bit of jewelry, but find it weighs half as much as you’d guessed.

Skyship Deck Guns.name:
飞空艇甲板炮
Skyship Deck Guns

Text.text:
当你走近那些沉重的铁炮时，残留的火药辛味轻轻撩拨着你的鼻腔。每门炮都被粗厚的绳索紧紧捆缚——仿佛狂野未驯的猛兽——以确保在旅行途中稳妥无虞。炮身下方加固的木制炮车轮历经多年服役早已磨损磕碰，却仍保养得出奇周到；而每根炮管也都被一丝不苟地刷洗干净，只为确保下一次轰鸣时弹道清澈利落。
The residual tang of gunpowder tickles your nose as you approach the heavy iron cannons, each bound by thick ropes—like wild, untamed beasts—to keep them secure during travel. The reinforced wooden casters under each gun are worn and battered from years of service, but remarkably well maintained, and the barrel of each cannon is dutifully scrubbed to ensure a clean shot.

Meditations: Sunbeams.name:
冥想：阳光光束
Meditations: Sunbeams

Text.text:
温暖的光辉倾泻而下，洒入森林清凉的阴影之中，化作一道道日光穿过树木黝黑的树干间流淌。鸣禽轻盈掠过，蜜蜂嗡嗡穿梭于这片辉光与暗影交织的林地，它们欢快的声响与不远处溪流的潺潺笑语相和。
Warm light pours down into in the cool shadows of the forest, sending shafts of sun to stream among the dark trunks of the trees. Songbirds flit and bees buzz through this forest of brilliance and shadow, their happy voices joining the chuckling of a nearby stream.

I Cast Insect Plague From My Staff Of Sw.name:
我从【虫群法杖】施放「虫灾」
I Cast Insect Plague From My Staff Of Swarming Insects

Text.text:
空气里灌满了甲壳摩擦般的嗡鸣，我的法杖上雕刻的昆虫扭动挣扎、彼此踩踏，在一片翻涌的虫毯中伸展着节节相连的肢体。待那刺耳的轰鸣攀至顶点，一群饥渴的蝗虫自杖首轰然爆裂而出——扑向它们的下一顿血肉盛宴。
A chitinous buzzing fills the air as the insects carved into my staff writhe and skitter over each other in a roiling carpet of segmented limbs. As the cacophonous drone reaches it peak, a swarm of ravenous locusts explodes from the staff’s head—rushing toward their next meal.

那男人的举止带着异界般的优雅；苍白如雪的皮肤与头发、以及没有瞳孔的双眼，更将这种诡异衬得锋利分明。分明是非人的生物，却未必阴毒。那人的神情与移动里有种狡黠与魅力。他抽动腰带上的匕首，熟练度高得近乎完美；贴身的深色皮护甲让他移动毫无束缚。随后，猝然之间，他消失了——没入人群之中。

~ 由 Andrew C. 扮演

The man moves with an otherworldly grace, the strangeness reinforced by stark white skin and hair, as well as eyes devoid of pupils. An inhuman creature, but not necessarily a sinister one. There is a cunning, a charisma, to the man's expressions, his movements. He wields the daggers on his belt with sublime proficiency, and the dark leather armor hugging his form allows for complete freedom of movement. Then, suddenly, he's gone—disappearing into the crowd.

~ Played by Andrew C.

Wild Magic Surge: Slippery Surface.name:
狂野魔法涌动：湿滑地面
Wild Magic Surge: Slippery Surface

Text.text:
奥术从你体内翻涌而出，在你身下汇聚成渗漏般的露液——随即你踏着这层滑腻的润滑膜开始一段摇摇欲坠的滑行。
Arcana billows out from you and collects as effluent dew beneath you—then you begin an unstable glide across the slippery lubricant.

Emts Render Aid To Unconscious Victim.name:
急救昏迷伤者
Emts Render Aid To Unconscious Victim

Text.text:
有人在便道中央骤然停下，捂住胸口，随即栽倒在地。他们肯定很有钱，因为仅仅几秒后，远处就响起了警笛声。没过多久，救护车便呼啸而至，一队身着白衣的急救人员从车里涌出，冲向那具已然一动不动的身影。
Somebody stops in the middle of the sidewalk, clutching their chest as they fall to the ground. They must come from money, since sirens kick on in the distance within just a few seconds. It's not long before the ambulance arrives and a squad of white-clad EMTs pour out of it to attend to the now motionless individual.

Surrounded By Bullywug In A Jungle.name:
被丛林中的牛蛙人团团包围
Surrounded By Bullywug In A Jungle

Text.text:
繁茂而辛辣的林下灌木间传来一阵移动，立刻攫住你的注意。你悄然贴近，拨开枝叶探身窥视，在丛林的昏暗里眯起眼，只见一只身形细小的生物正一蹦一跳地逃开。下一瞬，你们的队伍竟发现自己被一圈色彩鲜艳的两栖战士包围——它们身高不过几尺。首领——一名橙色的蛙人——得意地呱呱作响，抬手指向树梢，示意那里藏着数名潜伏的弓手。你们被包围了。

~ Clara C. Potter on Discord

Movement in the lush, pungent undergrowth draws your attention. Creeping closer, you peer into the bushes, squinting in the gloom of the jungle, and see a diminutive creature hopping away. Your party suddenly finds itself encircled by vibrant amphibian warriors, no more than a few feet tall. Croaking smugly, the leader—an orange frogman—gestures to the trees, pointing out several concealed archers. They have you surrounded.

~ Clara C. Potter on Discord

Seduction Of An Undead.name:
亡灵的诱惑
Seduction Of An Undead

Text.text:
“有人也许会称之为腐朽，但我觉得你的容貌只是更加醇熟了——就像一瓶古老而暴烈的陈年酒。”
“Some may call it decomposition, but I think your looks have only matured—like an ancient and wrathful bottle of wine.”

这座要塞像一座古老的军事基地，由巨大的红色石块垒砌而成。你沿南方大道逼近城池时，数里之外便能望见它那令人屏息的正面轮廓。城垛上垂下绘着家族徽记的旗帜——一头金色雄鹿的一对鹿角——曾经的祖母绿，如今被年代与天气磨褪成一抹尘蒙的薄荷色。通往前庭的城门向来客敞开，但哈肯家族的侍从大多只埋首于手头事务：给空荡的马厩添上新草料，清点由车队滚滚送来的货物。再往里、通向主宅的下一道门槛却紧闭不启——高大的栗木双门被擦拭得光可鉴人，门上刻着鹿群穿林越野、跃过田畴的图景。
This fortress has the look of an old military base crafted of large blocks of red stone. Its impressive facade can be seen from the southern road for miles as you approach the city. Banners bearing the family sigil, a pair of antlers from a golden stag, hang down from the ramparts—the once emerald-green hue now faded with age and weather to a dusty mint color. The gate that leads to the front courtyard is open to visitors, though the attendants of the Harken family primarily keep to their tasks: tending the empty stables with fresh hay and reviewing shipments rolled in on carts. The next threshold that leads to the manse proper is shut tight, the tall chestnut doors polished to a breathtaking shine and etched with scenes of deer bounding through forests and fields.

Underground Dwarven City Gates.name:
地下矮人城之门
Underground Dwarven City Gates

Text.text:
嵌在这座巨型洞窟岩壁之中的厚重城门，与基岩地面严丝合缝，守护着地下矮人之城。尽管城门并非锻造金属，而是石制，两扇皆为整块巨岩削成的巨型门板，几乎不可能被任何尘世的撞击所撼毁。
Built into the rock walls of the enormous cavern itself, the bulky gates protecting the underground dwarven city lie flush with the bedrock floor. Though made of stone rather than wrought metal, the gates are two massive slabs, one piece each, and virtually indestructible to any earthly impact.

蒸汽翻涌，弥漫在空气中。温热的水流在抛光翡翠雕像之间蜿蜒成一汪汪小池。每一道门口都立着轻薄的布质屏风门，上面绘着浮世绘：怒目而视的恶鬼（特征）面孔，与柔和的金蓝云霞。馥郁的熏香在浴场里游走。这地方几乎能让人沉入宁静的自省，却又差了那么一点。身着利落西装的保镖踏着木地板巡游，洁白亚麻笔挺，无标识的墨镜冷硬。他们没穿鞋。手里抱着冲锋枪，腰间还系着改装过的武士刀。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Bubbled steam pervades the air. Small pools of warm water flow between statues of polished jade. At each doorway stand delicate fabric screen doors emblazoned with ukiyo-e art: scowling oni faces and gentle gold-blue clouds. Fragrant incense wafts through the bathhouse. This is almost a place of tranquil reflection, yet not quite. Sharp-suited bodyguards in crisp linen and nondescript sunglasses stalk the wooden floors. They are not wearing shoes. In their hands, they cradle submachine guns, and tied to their waists are augmented katanas.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Loot From A Young Gold Dragon.name:
来自一条年轻金龙的战利品
Loot From A Young Gold Dragon

Text.text:
在一堆珍珠与宝石垒起的小丘之巅，一只华丽的发条音乐盒轻轻滴答作响；机芯内齿轮的节奏稳定如心跳，精准得仿佛被完美校准。旁边的玻璃匣里，你看见几卷精致的卷轴，每一卷都用一缕金线束起。它们下方各有一块小铭牌，只刻着一枚难以辨识的符文。后墙边靠着一只结实的木箱，里头堆满数以百计的金币，闪耀得刺眼；然而你认不出那古怪的六边形纹样，也不识得其上所压印的君主面容。总体而言，这批藏品价值 5000 枚金币——只对合适的人而言。
Atop a mound of pearls and gems, an ornate clockwork music box ticks softly, the steady rhythm of the gears inside perfectly calibrated. In a glass case nearby, you see several ornate scrolls, each bound with a strand of golden thread. A small plaque beneath each one bears a single indecipherable rune. A sturdy wooden chest against the back wall glitters with hundreds of gold coins, though you do not recognize the strange hexagonal design nor the face of the monarch stamped upon them. Overall, the collection is worth 5000 gold pieces—to the right people.

Shield Walk Maneuver.name:
盾步机动
Shield Walk Maneuver

Text.text:
走在最前方的是一名全身裹着哑光黑色防护道具的身影。镜面般的面罩遮住了他们的脸，肌肉绷紧，双手将那面巨大的防暴盾顶在身前。他们把整个人都藏在盾后，肩膀抵住盾缘使其稳稳竖立，像龟甲般一步一步向前推进，每一步都精确计算。身后紧贴着一名一模一样的身影半蹲潜行，只在需要时猛然探出身子，倾泻短促而密集的掩护火力。两人的动作严丝合缝，令人想起古老传说中那支不可阻挡的方阵，正缓缓推进，夺取战场。
Marching forward is a figure wreathed in matte-black protective gear. Their face is hidden behind a reflective visor, and their muscles are taut as they hold the massive riot shield in front of them. They keep their entire body behind that shield, their shoulder bracing it upright as they turtle forward, step by calculated step. An identical figure crouches in their wake, popping up only to unleash quick bursts of covering fire. The duo’s synchronized movements evoke ancient legends of the inexorable phalanx advancing to claim the field of battle.

Drone Repair Shop.name:
无人机修理铺
Drone Repair Shop

Text.text:
店里空间很大，却被工作台挤得几乎转不开身；每一张台面都堆得老高：备用零件、螺母、螺栓、RAM等等。墙面一排排挂满工具，有的朴素得只是扳手；但一只玻璃柜把几件更昂贵的器件牢牢锁住。一名技师把喷灯的蓝色火焰凑近一架抽搐的无人机。无人机发出尖细的哀鸣，像猪叫与风扇嗡转混在一起，盖过了从某个藏在杂乱深处的音响里轰隆传来的重拍电子乐。“嘘，”技师说，蓝光在他那副虫眼般的护目镜上跳闪，“还真是个宝宝。”无人机机身上的灯光忽明忽暗，像眨动的眼睛，或颤动的睫毛。别处的技师也在拆修更多无人机，火花四溅。被摆上台的机型千差万别：有的来自高端品牌，机身是流线的椭圆；有的则是棱角分明、歪歪扭扭的自制作品。
The shop is a large space but totally cramped with worktables, each surface piled high with spare parts, nuts, bolts, RAM, and more. The walls are lined with tools, some as basic as wrenches, but a glass case locks away some of the pricier gadgets. A tech brings the blue flame of a blowtorch to a twitching drone. The drone emits a high-pitched whine, a mix between a pig’s squeal and a whirring fan, drowning out the thumping techno music rumbling from a stereo hidden somewhere among the mess. “Shhh,” the tech says, the blue light glinting off his bug-eyed goggles. “Such a baby.” The lights on the drone’s chassis flicker like winking eyes or fluttering eyelashes. Sparks fly as more drones are tinkered with by other techs. The models being worked on vary from the sleek oval bodies of high-end brands to blocky, lopsided home projects.

Book Of Spellƨ.name:
法术之书
Book Of Spellƨ

Text.text:
这本法术书损毁严重。封面上写着“Book of Spells”，只有第二个“s”似乎是倒着写的。书页本身没有任何编号，但装订处夹着一条红色丝带，用来标记其中一页。
This spellbook is heavily damaged. The cover says "Book of Spells", only the second "s" appears to have been written backwards. The pages themselves are not enumerated in any way, but there is a single red ribbon in the binding used to mark a page.

God Of Storms.name:
风暴之神
God Of Storms

Text.text:
元素神祇的暴怒继子，沉船的毁灭者，暴风雨的主宰——长须的风暴之神戴着大北方的角盔。祂披挂着积雨云般的蓝与灰甲胄，咆哮着挥起战锤，把雷霆当作脾气向世界砸落，吼令狂风听命，而此刻，祂已整装待发。祂微微前倾，一只眼盯着你，另一只眼盯着天气。
Angry stepchild of the elemental gods, ship-wrecker, lord of the tempest, the long-bearded God of Storms wears the horned helm of the great north. Armored in the blues and grays of cumulonimbus, the blustering god wields his hammer and throws lightning tantrums over the world, shouts the winds into action, and now he stands ready. He leans forward, one eye on you and one on the weather.

Snow And Bramble.name:
雪与荆棘
Snow And Bramble

Text.text:
积雪黏附在扭曲的褐色荆蔓上，封死藤蔓间的缝隙，凝成一条走到尽头便无路可通的隧道。日光穿透雪层，将隧道染上一层幽蓝的冷辉。沉眠的蔓藤上仍刺出又长又黑的尖刺；与之相映，通道顶棚垂落一排锋利的冰锥，仿佛在暗示曾经更明亮的时节。
Snow clings to twisted brown brambles, sealing the gaps among the vines and forming a dead-end tunnel. Daylight penetrates the snow, casting the tunnel in a blue glow. Long, black thorns still protrude from the hibernating creepers. Mirroring them, sharp icicles hang from the passage’s roof, hinting at sunnier times.

Techno Overclocking Drug, Soul Splice: I.name:
科技超频药剂，灵魂拼接：注射型
Techno Overclocking Drug, Soul Splice: Injected

Text.text:
当小瓶自行倾倒至空，世界骤然慢成蜗行。你的血液迎来那抹光与那股辛辣——没错，一种实实在在的辛辣，钉在你喉咙深处。你身上的各种改装件以陌生的迅疾嗡鸣运转，在灵魂拼接的狂喜中被强行过载。此刻一切都明白了。一切都明白了——清晰、迅疾、专注。你一直都是那块电池。

~ 一位英雄所构想

As the vial empties itself, the world slows to a crawl. Your bloodstream welcomes the glow, the tang— yes, a tangible tang in the back of your throat. Whatever mods you sport whir with an unfamiliar quickness, supercharged with the ecstasy of the soul splice. It’s clear now. Everything’s clear now—clear and quick and focused. You are the battery you always were.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Sunrise At Sea.name:
海上日出
Sunrise At Sea

Text.text:
大海在猩红的宣泄中翻涌，白昼的第一缕光从地平线滚落，直抵长船的船首。猩然的窸窣低语——仿佛世界的心跳在无底的血潮里搏动——穿过橡木船板、皮靴与湿透的袜子，一寸寸渗进你的皮肤与骨头，催促你的脉搏按它的节律苏醒。日出在岸上看得见，却触不到。就在那最初的一瞬，天穹的火焰自黎明的灰烬里迸裂，你感到一种原初的嗡鸣，一阵超然的虚脱。被铺天盖地、近乎存在本身的情绪淹没，你对新一天唯一的问候，是一口深深颤抖的呼吸：吸气，呼气。你自己的潮汐法则。

~ 由 Charles Haines 构想

The ocean heaves with crimson catharsis as the day's first rays roll from the horizon to the prow of the longship. Sanguine susurrations, the heartbeat of the world pulsing through its depthless lifeblood, through oak planks, leather boots, and sodden socks until it permeates your skin and bone—commanding your pulse to wake to its rhythm. Sunrise can be seen from shore, but it cannot be felt. In that first moment, when the sky's fire erupts from the ash of dawn, you feel a primordial hum, an ethereal enervation. Inundated with feelings so overwhelmingly existential, your only greeting to the new day is a deep shuddering breath: inhale, exhale. Your own tidal operandi.

~ Envisioned by Charles Haines

I Use Evasion.name:
我施展「闪避」
I Use Evasion

Text.text:
我感到袭来的攻击浪潮翻涌而至。我没有绷紧防御，反而放松身体，纵身跃起。我的身躯顺着效果的压迫迅速调整，借那股力量从冲击的中心滑离，像洪流中的芦茎般弯折摇曳。那原本要将我折断的劲势，反倒把我托送到这场狂袭中最安全的位置。
I feel the surge of the incoming attack. Instead of bracing myself, I relax and leap upward. My body adjusts to the effect’s pressure, riding that force away from the center, and I bend like a stalk in a river’s flood. The force that seeks to break me instead carries me to the safest spot in the onslaught.

Old Giants' Fortress.name:
古巨人堡垒
Old Giants' Fortress

Text.text:
你踏入一座直接嵌进山壁的要塞阴影里，寒冷的山风更深地咬进骨头。石板般的铅灰色城墙护着一座座高塔，直刺令人眩晕的高度——有些甚至没入云中。入口处的木制大门轻易就有30英尺高，15英尺处悬着环形铁把手。你身后传来车轮吱呀作响：一个裹着毛皮衣帽的半兽人推着装满柴火的独轮车，在雪地里艰难前行。他瞥了你一眼，低吼一声，点点头，用下巴朝大门一指。他走上前去，抡拳咚咚敲在门上。大门里开出的那扇小门吱呀一声摆开，温暖的火炬光顿时倾泻而出。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

You step into the shadow of a stronghold built directly into the mountainside and the cold mountain air bites deeper. The slate-gray walls shield towers that reach to dizzying heights—some disappearing into the clouds. The wooden gate at the entrance stands easily 30 feet in height, with looped iron handles 15 feet up. You hear the creaking of wheels behind you: a half-orc bundled in fur clothes and hat pushes a wheelbarrow full of firewood through the snow. He eyes you and grunts, gesturing toward the gate with a nod of his head. He approaches then drums his fist against the gate. A smaller door, cut in the larger one, swings open and warm torchlight floods through.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Mech Suit Malfunction.name:
机甲战衣故障
Mech Suit Malfunction

Text.text: 猩红的光淹没了驾驶舱，紧急警报的嗡鸣声骤然响起。你的机甲全息蓝图在受影响的区域闪烁着红光，警告信息——夹杂着一个个危害标志——在显示屏上接连弹出。你的视线猛地扫向控制台上那枚巨大的红色按钮，上面标着 eject。你必须做出抉择。 Crimson light floods the cockpit as an emergency siren drones to life. The holographic blueprint of your mech suit flashes red in the affected area, and warning messages—filled with hazard signs—pop up across your display. Your eyes dart to the large red button on the console marked eject. You have a decision to make.

一件粗糙风化的皮质护甲满是补丁与裂口，隐约可见于一袭昏暗翻涌的斗篷之下。修缮粗陋的武器垂挂在他们的腰间与背后。兜帽低垂，其下是一双细小如针的眼睛死死盯着你——谨慎、老练、且凶狠。
Rough, weathered leather armor, lined with patches and tears, can be seen below a dark, billowing cloak. Ill repaired weapons hang from their waist and back. Below a donned hood stare a pair of beady eyes, cautious, knowing, and vicious.

Bearded Devil With Glaive.name:
持戟髯魔
Bearded Devil With Glaive

Text.text:
恶魔下巴垂着蛇一般的触须，扭动翻卷，仿佛一窝被激怒的毒蛇。鲜艳的紫色皮肤下肌肉虬结隆起，魔鬼正举起一柄带锯齿的长柄刀，刃上凝着干涸的血迹。战士几乎不着护甲：只有浮雕护胫、护臂，以及一条破布般的短裙，由一条古老的腰带紧紧系住。
Snakelike tendrils adorn the chin of the fiend, writhing like a nest of angered vipers. Muscles bulge beneath vibrant purple flesh as the devil readies a serrated glaive stained with dried blood. The warrior wears little armor: only embossed greaves, bracers, and a kilt of ragged cloth secured by an ancient belt.

Loot From A Planetar.name:
来自行星天使的战利品
Loot From A Planetar

Text.text:
堕落的天界使者戴着纯金护手与胫甲，匠心独运的镌刻与浮雕让它们的光泽更显夺目。巨剑被遗弃在一旁，紧挨着它昔日持有者那只无力的乳白宝石般的手。剑身由纯粹的精金锻成，完美无瑕。剑柄虽已脱离主人的掌握，仍散发着金色的辉光——一束灿然的圣辉。
The fallen celestial wears gauntlets and greaves of pure gold, their luster enhanced by cleverly applied engravings and embossings. The greatsword lies, forsaken, next to its former wielder’s limp opaline hand. The blade, crafted of pure adamant, bears no imperfection. The hilt, though freed from its master’s grasp, still shines with a golden light—a radiant light.

Abandoned Lunatic Asylum: Is Someone Her.name:
废弃疯人院：这里有人吗？
Abandoned Lunatic Asylum: Is Someone Here?

Text.text:
前方某处传来一声呼救，你立刻明白自己并非孤身一人。可当同样的声音又从遗迹的另一头响起——距离远得离谱，方向也完全不对，绝不可能有人在这么短的时间里移动到那里——一股寒意顿时窜上脊背。你确实不是一个人，而外面的某个东西，也知道你在这里。
A voice, crying for help, comes from somewhere ahead, and you know that you are not alone. But when the same voice comes from elsewhere in the ruins, far too distant and in the wrong direction for a body to have moved there, a chill runs through you. You aren’t alone, and whatever is out there knows you are here.

Mysterious Symbols On Barren World.name:
荒芜世界上的神秘符号
Mysterious Symbols On Barren World

Text.text:
在一片稀疏的落叶林边缘，树枝并不像被修剪成这些形状，倒更像是以某种文字的笔画自然生长。每一棵树都构成一个字母或讯号。走出林子，眼前是一片在贫瘠中挣扎的农田；而每一块田地的精准地理中心，都烙着一枚相同的符文。远处一座山的花岗岩峭壁上，同样的符号被刻得近一英里高、半英里宽，仿佛在天地间宣告。
Near the edge of a sparse deciduous forest, the tree branches don’t look pruned into these shapes, but seem to grow in a script. Each tree forms a letter or signal. Emergence from the forest reveals an expanse of struggling agriculture, and burned into the exact geographical center of each field is a similar glyph. Those same glyphs are carved nearly a mile tall and a half-mile wide on the granite face of a distant mountain.

Solara The Moon Druid.name:
索拉拉：月亮德鲁伊
Solara The Moon Druid

Text.text:
棕黑色皮护甲与深色衣装，衬得这位身形矫健的龙裔鳞片愈发像宝石般璀璨——鳞色自紫罗兰渐变至珠白。一块不规则的紫色晶体，悬浮在她向后掠起、同样由晶质构成的双角之间。她莹润的淡色眼眸冷冷凝视，从紧抿的龙口之上投下无声压迫。空气因她的静默目光与角间晶体的旋转而微微震颤。她背着精致的鹿皮背囊，腰间系着同款、如绶带般的腰带，其上垂着一副投石索与一袋石子。

~ Played by Marra with
