Armor of brown-black hide, and dark clothing, make this lithe dragonborn’s scales, which range from violet to pearly white, look even more jewel-like. A chunk of irregular purple crystal floats between backswept horns made of the same material. Her lustrous, pale eyes stare, coolly, from above her tight-lipped, draconic mouth. The air vibrates with her silent gaze and the spin of the crystal between her horns. She wears a fine rucksack of doeskin and a matching sash-like belt, from which hangs a sling and a pouch of stones.

~ Played by Marra with

灰白的光在你视野中翻涌旋转，变幻不定。你前行，并非凭借肉体的用力，而是纯粹以意志强行推动。你感觉自己仿佛在泥沼中穿行，迟缓而费力。你听见低语，瞥见余光里有形影游动。那是来自其他世界、其他位面的影像。它们动作缓慢，声音沉闷，仿佛隔着一层水幕被你窥见。
Gray light, shifting and swirling, dominates your vision. You move, not by physical exertion, but through sheer force of will. You feel as though you move through mud, slowly and inefficiently. You hear whispers, and spy shapes moving in your peripheral. Images, from other worlds, other planes. They move slowly, their voices muffled, as if viewed through water.

这间工坊里，附了魔、能自行干活的工具正以单调而稳定的嗡鸣声忙碌着——刨削、切割、钉合，丝毫不停。松木的清香浓得化不开，梁椽间还传来鸟儿的啁啾——这气味与声响想必都是用魔法特意“养”在这里的。木匠笑呵呵地迎接鱼贯而入的顾客；他们却都愁眉苦脸，手里攥着裂开的扫帚柄、断成两截的魔杖，以及其他在倒霉事故里受损的木制物件。“别愁，别愁！”匠人咯咯笑着，乱蓬蓬的胡子一颠一颠的。“你以为你是第一个把自己的法杖烧得一塌糊涂的人？那可是胆大施法的勋章！再说了——哪有我这Turpenshine药剂修不好的！”
Tools—enchanted to work on their own—shave, cut, and nail away in a consistent drone in this workshop. The aroma of pine is prevalent, and the twitter of birds can be heard in the rafters—scents and sounds that must have been charmed here magically. The woodsmith greets patrons jovially as they file in, sulkily holding cracked broomsticks, split wands, and other wooden items damaged in unfortunate incidents. “Don’t fret, don’t fret!” The smith giggles, his scraggly beard bobbing. “You think you’re the first to char the dickens out of their staff? That’s the sign of daring spellwork! And nothing my Turpenshine potion can’t fix!”

尽管他低着头，你仍能看见唾沫从他纹着刺青的嘴唇间滴落——这个光头、赤脚的男人低声喃喃，像是在一遍又一遍地祈求。可当他抬眼一瞥，目光却在四周飞快游移，仿佛什么也没看见。其中一只眼也许真的失明了：布满血丝，瞳孔扩张得几乎吞没了整颗眼球，黑得骇人。
Though his head is bowed, you can see the spittle dripping from his tattooed lips as this bald and barefoot man murmurs a supplication over and over. When he glances up, his eyes quickly flit about without seeming to see anything. One eye might actually be blind, for it is bloodshot with a pupil so wide as to make the rest of the orb seem black.

Arm Prosthetic Of Lifting.name:
举重臂部义肢
Arm Prosthetic Of Lifting

Text.text:
盘结木纹的漩涡交织成这只义肢。机巧雕刻的符印在你接触这件装置时，将木材映出一层柔和的橙色光晕。义肢的手与前臂形成鲜明对比：一者狂乱纷杂，一者平滑优雅。手指是可调节的金属钩爪；在抛光的木质掌心上，还能辨认出一幅举重者的图像。

~ 构想：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Whorls of knotted wood make up this arm prosthetic. Cleverly carved sigils cast the wood in a soft orange glow when you touch the contraption. The prosthetic’s hand is a stark contrast to the forearm: where one is chaos, the other is smooth elegance. The hand’s fingers are adjustable metal hooks, and on the polished wooden palm, an image depicting a weightlifter can be made out.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Brass Golem Ambush.name:
黄铜魔像伏击
Brass Golem Ambush

Text.text:
巨大的金属手从你脚下的地板间猛然破板而出，将你的双腿钳进机械般的虎口。你低头望去，袭击者的面孔映入眼帘：一具抛光黄铜铸成的噩梦魔像！它冷漠无情地收紧握力，压力步步攀升，你的皮肉在挤压中发青作痛。魔像喷出一团翻滚的沸汽，发出阴森的嘶鸣，仿佛在嘲笑你的疼痛。

~ Envisioned by I_drink_tea

Enormous metal hands erupt through the floorboards below you, grabbing your legs in a mechanical vise. Looking down, you see the face of your assailant: a nightmarish golem of polished brass! With cold dispassion, it tightens its grip, and you feel your flesh bruise as the pressure increases. The golem lets out a sinister hiss of steam in a boiling cloud, as if laughing at your pain.

~ Envisioned by I_drink_tea

就算她发间没有因为清晨劳作而还插着一截稻草，你也照样能一眼认出这女人是个农夫——那条磨得发白、补丁摞补丁的工装背带裤，还有她手上厚硬的老茧，早把身份写得明明白白。
Even if a piece of straw wasn’t sticking out of her hair from her morning chores, you’d still be able to peg the woman as a farmer thanks to her worn and patched dungarees, and the callouses on her hands.

Loot From An Undead Dragonborn.name:
不死龙裔身上的战利品
Loot From An Undead Dragonborn

Text.text:
在生物的棺椁旁，有一只小小的石罐，里面一堆钱币——210枚银币与70枚金币——在火把光里幽幽闪烁。想来这些是这位战士临终前最后献上的贡礼，用以抚慰其踏入来世的旅程；但愿如今他们已得安息。
In a small stone jar near the creature’s coffin a collection of coins—210 silver pieces and 70 gold pieces—glimmers in the torchlight. Presumably these were the last tributes offered to this warrior on their death to ease their passage into the afterlife; hopefully they are at peace now.

Leomund's Tiny Hut.name:
李欧蒙的微型小屋
Leomund's Tiny Hut

Text.text:
你将双臂奋力举过头顶，直到双掌猛然相击，发出震天巨响；声浪轰然炸开，化作向四周扩散并逐渐凝实的冲击波。一面单一的半球形壁障拔地而起，铸成完美的珠光穹顶，穹顶边缘恰好停在你仍高举的双手上方。你周遭的空气随之安定下来，变得温暖宜人，一阵均匀的微风从你身上轻轻掠过。
You heave your arms over your head until your palms collide with a mighty clap, which rings out, forming a blast wave that expands around you as it solidifies. A single, semispherical wall rises into a perfect pearlescent dome that ends just above your still upraised hands. The air around you stabilizes, becoming pleasantly warm as an even breeze slides over you.

I Cook A Stew.name:
我炖了一锅浓汤
I Cook A Stew

Text.text:
汤底终于变得浓稠，气泡从锅底悠然升起，搅动着漂浮起伏的金黄土豆、香草与焦香肉块。咸鲜的香气袅袅升腾，撩拨着我的感官。我用长柄勺搅动炖锅，舀起一勺送到唇边。尝过之后，我决定再淋入一大撮盐，心里却忍不住惦念起刚出炉的热面包。
The stock has finally thickened, bubbles rising leisurely from the bottom of the pot to agitate the bobbing golden potatoes, herbs, and chunks of browned meat. The savory aroma wafts up, tantalizing my senses. I stir the stew with my ladle, scoop up a bit, and bring it to my lips. After tasting, I decide to drizzle in a generous pinch of salt and muse longingly for freshly baked bread.

Rusty Saturday Night Special.name:
生锈的周六夜特制手枪
Rusty Saturday Night Special

Text.text:
按任何法律定义来说，这把武器凭它的体型与做工，几乎都算不上火器。锈蚀的外壳包裹着一把微型手枪：触发器弯折，弹鼓变形。握把上还能看见制造商标志褪色的残影……前提是你眯起眼细看。
The weapon barely even qualifies as a firearm by any legal description given its size and quality. A rusted casing surrounds a miniscule handgun with a bent trigger and a warped ammo drum. The faded remnants of a manufacturer’s logo can be seen on the handle… if you squint.

这把剑看起来像是魔法之物，剑身上刻着神秘的符文。然而，凑近细看才发现这些符文不过是毫无意义的划痕。更糟的是，它们的刻入大幅削轻了剑身，等于彻底毁了它的平衡。 The sword appears to be magical, with mystical runes carved down the blade. However, closer inspection reveals these runes to be nothing more than meaningless scratches. Moreover, their addition has considerably lightened the blade, effectively ruining its balance.

Morrow Castle Of A Goddess Of The Drow.name:
晨曦堡——卓尔女神之城
Morrow Castle Of A Goddess Of The Drow

Text.text:
这些厅室直接从峭壁的活岩中凿出，穹顶高耸，水晶灯与幽光苔藓洒下冷澈的光。纤细如枝的家具与轻薄精致的挂毯皆以银与灰织就。云母与缟玛瑙打磨成的桌与长凳闪烁生辉，映出香焰火盆里袅袅升起的烟缕。那些繁复的花丝与旋纹掩住了此地万物的坚韧——锻造的精金与雕琢的刚玉。整座城堡是其统治者的隐喻：一位只在外表上显得纤弱的女神。
The chambers are cut from the living rock of a cliffside, with high ceilings and lights of crystal and glowing moss. The spindly furniture and fine, thin tapestries are in silvers and grays. Tables and benches of glistening mica and onyx reflect wisps of smoke from braziers of perfumed flame. The filigrees and swirls belie the strength of everything here--smithed adamantine and sculpted corundum. The castle is a metaphor for its ruler, a goddess delicate only in appearance.

那男人把一床污迹斑斑、补丁累累的被子披在身上，像带兜帽的斗篷。除了一双赤脚和几根扭曲的手指，你能看见的只有他凌乱湿垂的头发与憔悴枯槁的面容。你看着他的眼珠四下翻滚，仿佛在搜寻某个人，却始终没有看见你。接着，他把头猛地一歪，压低嗓音急切地嘶声低语，你听不真切，只觉得他像是在指控着空无一物的空气，仿佛那虚无曾对他做过什么冒犯。
The man wears a soiled and much-patched quilt like a hooded cloak. His bedraggled hair and haggard face are all you can see of him besides bare feet and a few crooked fingers. You watch his eyes roll about, seeming to search for someone without ever seeing you. Then, he crooks his head to the side and whispers vehement words you don’t quite catch, seemingly accusing the empty air of some slight.

I Scale A Tall Gate.name:
我攀上高耸的门扉
I Scale A Tall Gate

Text.text:
我搓了搓手，仰望着门扉的高度，目光扫过可能的危险与暗藏的落手点。我纵身一跃，给自己抢出先机，随即保持稳定的节奏向上攀爬。手臂、胸膛与背脊的肌肉在我体内低唱，像被点燃的火在血肉里跳动。可当我逼近顶端，那份拉扯很快把歌声扭成疼痛的尖叫；在身体来得及发出更激烈的抗议前，我猛地将一只脚甩过门顶，伴着一声压抑的闷哼，把自己硬生生撑了上去。我在那儿休息片刻，两条腿分别垂在门的两侧。随后我深吸一口气，再缓缓吐出，呼出的气流将唇边的汗珠一并吹散。
I rub my hands together as I take in the height of the gate, checking for possible hazards and hidden handholds. I leap up to give myself a head start and keep a steady pace as I ascend. The muscles in my arms, chest, and back sing to me, a fire lit within them. The strain of the endeavor soon turns that song to pained yelps as I near the top, and before my body can protest too much, I fling my foot over the top of the gate and lift myself up with a grunt of effort. I rest there for a moment, a leg dangling on either side. I take a deep breath and exhale, blowing beads of sweat away from my lips.

Demogorgon.name:
恶魔王子德魔高根
Demogorgon

Text.text:
这头由鳞甲血肉与刺立毛皮堆叠而成的庞然巨物令人难以置信。它是爬虫与猿类邪异而癫狂的杂糅之物：触须般的肢体与倒刺长尾随着它挪动那骇人的体重而扭动盘缠。两颗恶魔般的头颅——每一颗都顶着前倾粗蛮的额骨与拉长、满是獠牙的巨口——以炽热余烬般发光的眼睛扫视四方。腐肉与闷燃硫磺般的恶臭，从它蒸腾的口中阵阵飘散。
The towering entity of scaly flesh and bristling fur defies belief. A fiendish and maddening mingling of reptile and ape, the beast’s tendril limbs and barbed tail writhe and coil as it shifts its immense weight. A pair of demonic heads—each with a sloping, brutish forehead and elongated, toothy maw—gaze in all directions with eyes glowing like hot embers. A stench, like rotting meat and smoldering brimstone, wafts from the beast’s steaming mouths.

Earth Elemental: Contemplation Beside A.name:
土元素：山间营火旁的沉思
Earth Elemental: Contemplation Beside A Mountain Campfire

Text.text:
你坐在山坡上，感受清凉的微风；脚边噼啪作响的火焰带来暖意，近旁的小溪咕噜潺潺。风将炊烟送向天际，溪流把泥尘冲刷带走。土、气、火、水。你仿佛元素的主宰，只是在营地里休息。
You sit on the slopes of a mountain, feeling the cool breeze, warmed by the crackling flames at your feet, while a brook burbles nearby. Wind carries smoke to the heavens, while the stream washes dirt down and away. Earth, air, fire, and water. You feel like a master of the elements just resting in camp.

Rushing An Opponent In Combat.name:
战斗中猛冲敌手
Rushing An Opponent In Combat

Text.text: 是时候扭转势头，击溃他们的阵形，借用对手身后的地形。你和他们拉开了足够的距离，正好蓄足冲势。深吸一口气，双腿如活塞般猛力驱动，目光死死锁定你的目标，以防他们闪避——紧接着，撞击降临。 [成功] 你听见他们肺里的空气像风箱般被挤出，感到他们的脚在地面上倒退时刮擦作响，而你与他们硬碰硬的瞬间，你的力量压过他们的力量，令你血脉贲张。 Time to change the momentum, break their formation, use the terrain behind your opponent. You’ve got enough distance to work up a head of steam. A deep breath and the piston drive of your legs, tight focus on your target in case they try to dodge—and then comes the impact. [Success] You hear the air leaving their lungs like a bellows, sense the scrape of their feet along the ground backwards, and the feel exhilaration of your might against theirs.

Bodies Lie Where They Fell.name:
尸体倒卧在他们殒命之处
Bodies Lie Where They Fell

Text.text:
精良的武器与零散的护甲暗示这里的尸体曾是守卫。如今，断裂的骨头、弯折的长剑与粉碎的长矛散落在污秽的石板上，墙壁与地面被干涸的血迹涂抹得斑驳。一路风干的内脏拖痕如同停涸的尸河河床般蜿蜒着通向室外——把石头染成暗沉的猩红。他们是为了镇压囚犯而战，还是为了阻止人从竞技场地面闯入？
Quality weapons and bits of armor suggest the bodies here were guards. Now, broken bones, bent swords, and shattered spears litter grimy flagstones, the walls and floor painted with dried blood. A trail of desiccated viscera leads out of the room like a charnel riverbed—staining the stones a ruddy crimson. Did they stand against prisoners or to prevent entry from the arena floor?

在赛博空间的建筑之中，一个身影在三轴位置码与交通信号的交换码交汇处显形。它半透明的玄性之肤起伏流动，其上爬满一行行脚本；若落到现实世界，只会是毫无意义的乱码。那层皮肤之下，偶尔可见的骷髅（特征）同样由代码构成，但这份造物带着幽怖：细密线网编织的奥秘符号，白炽着力量，在颅骨内层层嵌套、紧紧盘结。双眼被光点亮，它转身凝视一扇写满粉色脚本的虚拟窗口。它耸耸肩。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Within the architecture of cyberspace, a figure materializes in an intersection of triaxial location codes and switch-codes for traffic signals. Its translucent metaphysical skin undulates with lines of script that in the literal world would be gibberish. Underneath that skin, the occasionally visible skeleton is also code, but this is haunting work: arcane symbols in a fine wire mesh, white with power, nesting tightly in the skull. With illuminated eyes, the being turns to contemplate a virtual window of pink script. It shrugs.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

你低吼着下令，掷出一束噼啪作响的负能量电弧——没有光的闪电，一道刺目如割的黑暗裂痕。电弧仍与掌心相连，狂暴的力量鞭挞般向外抽打，搜寻可攀附的关键灵魂，汲取其生命力直至枯竭。
You snarl a command and hurl a crackling bolt of negative energy—lightning without the light, an eye-searing gash of darkness. The bolt remains tethered to your palm as the force lashes out, seeking a vital spirit to latch on to and drain of vitality.

Pre-battle Insult To A Pathetic Enemy.name:
战前对卑微敌人的羞辱
Pre-battle Insult To A Pathetic Enemy

Text.text:
“抱歉，我实在看不出和你交手有什么意义。像你这样微不足道的生物，体内还能藏着什么有价值的物品，或值得一提的知识碎片吗？”
“I’m sorry, I really don’t see the point in fighting you. What possible item of value or tidbit of knowledge could be contained in such an insignificant creature?”

尽管你从未亲眼见过此地，它却令人既熟悉又作呕，仿佛看见一个你以为早已死去的宿敌。狂风抽打着长满草的崖顶，四周大致被一道深不见底的裂谷环抱。一座天然石桥横跨裂隙，接上一条被踩得泥泞不堪的常走小径，蜿蜒穿过肋骨般的石拱，向上通往一座石制祭坛。高祭坛后方，一具巨大得骇人的骷髅矗立着，长而尖的角在灰色地平线上投出剪影——那是某种山羊般泰坦怪物的头骨。它的鼻端深深扎进地里，两只空洞的眼眶之间，有个被切出的巨大三角口子，像血一样的东西正从中渗漏出来。
Though you’ve never set eyes on it before, this place feels both familiar and abhorrent, like seeing some hated enemy you’d thought long dead. Wind whips across a grassy clifftop roughly encircled by a deep crevasse. A natural bridge of stone crosses the gap and connects to a much-used muddy path that leads between rib-like arches of stone and up to a stone altar. Behind the high altar, with long, pointed horns silhouetted against the gray horizon, stands the enormous skull of some titanic goat-like monster. Its nose is planted into the ground, and what looks like blood leaks from a large triangle cut between the empty eye sockets.

Magical Cavern Portal.name:
魔法洞窟传送门
Magical Cavern Portal

Text.text:
一幅闪烁的紫色光幕在刻满古老符文的门洞中骤然迸发，光瀑以令人目眩的节奏倾泻而下，低沉的嗡鸣充塞着凝滞的洞窟空气。近旁的碎石开始颤动——有些甚至缓缓漂浮起来——随着力量不断攀升，传送门每一刻都愈发明亮。
A shimmering curtain of purple light erupts in the ancient rune-marked doorway, cascading in a dizzying rhythm as a low hum fills the stagnant cavern air. Pebbles nearby start to tremble—some even beginning to float—as the power builds, the portal getting brighter with each passing moment.

Greetings From Tavernkeeper In A Miserab.name:
来自凄惨小镇酒馆老板的问候
Greetings From Tavernkeeper In A Miserable Town

Text.text:
“这里曾是欢乐的归宿。屋子里总是挤满了想喘口气的工人，还有从远方归来的旅人讲述见闻……那样热闹，那样鲜活……可如今那段时代已经结束了。腐朽攫住了这地方，镇子一天比一天更败坏，直到最终只剩下它曾经模样的回声……总之，今天啤酒半价！”
“Joy used to have a home here. The rooms would be packed with workers looking for some relaxation and travelers recounting stories from afar… all so merry, all so full of life… but now that time is over. A rot has taken hold of this place, and every day the town decays a little bit more until all that remains are echoes of what it once was… So anyway, we’re offering half-priced pints today!”

I Cast Animal Friendship.name:
我施放“动物友善”
I Cast Animal Friendship

Text.text:
这是圣餐的奉送：我把食物捧在身前，举给野兽看，划出十字与尾巴的圣记——末端愉悦地一卷。咒语的声响就是那动物的声响，词句是声音里舒适的形状——低吼或呼噜，啁啾或咕鸣。野兽看向我，看向食物，便安定下来，温顺而慈和。
This is the delivery of communion, in which I hold the food in front of me, show it to the beast, and make the sign of a cross and tail, a happy curl at the end. The sound of the incantation is the sound of that animal, and the words are comfortable shapes in sound—growls or purrs, chirps or hoots. The beast looks to me, to the food, and calms to kindness.

枪身猛地甩向一侧，胡乱开火。紧接着它卡壳了，嗡嗡震颤。武器的显示屏上错误信息接连闪烁。弹匣不再坚实，形体开始崩散——它如今成了一团黏液般的生物，摇晃翻滚，疯狂抽搐。黏液沿着枪体骨架向上渗爬，猛然涌向持枪者。
The gun swings to the side, shooting haphazardly. Then it jams, vibrating. Errors flash up on the weapon’s display. No longer solid, the magazine loses form. It is now an ooze-like creature, wobbling and thrashing. The ooze seeps up the length of the chassis and surges toward the wielder.

I Put On My Leather Leg Brace.name:
我戴上皮革腿部支具
I Put On My Leather Leg Brace

Text.text:
我双手托起腿，小心把它挪到合适的位置。接着将护腿支具的皮革绑带从腿上滑过，开始在大腿、小腿与膝盖处逐一扣紧，视需要收紧并调整黄铜搭扣。站起身时，皮革发出筋韧拉伸般的噼啪轻响；贴合得恰到好处，刚好提供稳固支撑，却不夹肉，也不磨擦。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

I lift my leg with both hands to ease it into position. I slide the leather straps of the leg brace over my leg and begin to clasp them around my thigh, calf, and knee, tightening and adjusting the brass buckles as needed. The leather crackles its sinewy stretching sound as I stand, the fit just snug enough to provide stability without pinching or chafing.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Leonidas Theodoro.name:
列奥尼达斯·西奥多罗
Leonidas Theodoro

Text.text:
这名高挑瘦削的男子看似人类，但他的眼睛呈黄绿色，瞳孔却是黑色的竖裂。苍白的皮肤与他贴头修剪的乌鸦黑短发形成鲜明对比；而那发色又与他打磨得锃亮的黑色胸甲、护臂与护胫相呼应——以及那柄绑在背上的巨大双刃战斧。他穿着朴素，旅行斗篷罩在战斧外，背着一只皮质背囊。腰带厚实却极其实用，挂着一把弯刀的刀鞘，并设有许多工具用的挂环与分隔。即便还在鞘中，那柄弧形长刀也逸散出缕缕蓝光。他脚跟旁紧跟着一只小巧的钢铁自动机，外形酷似一只西班牙猎犬。

~ Played by Tate

This tall, slender man looks human, but his eyes are yellowish-green with black slits for pupils. His pale skin contrasts with his close-cropped raven hair. But the hair matches his polished black cuirass, bracers, and greaves, along with the massive, two-headed axe strapped to his back. He wears plain clothing, his traveler’s cloak over his axe and a leather rucksack. His belt is thick but practical, holding the scabbard of a scimitar and loops and compartments for numerous tools. Even sheathed, his curved sword gives off wisps of blue light. A small, steel automaton that resembles a spaniel sticks close to his heels.

~ Played by Tate

共鸣箱用樱桃木精心抛光，亮得发光，形如一滴泪珠，约有吉他般大小。乐器其余部分则是一条结构繁复的键与弦的长条，末端接着一只小曲柄，带着疙瘩起伏的木质握柄。玩家转动曲柄、按下琴键，便会响起仿佛一支微缩的侏儒小乐队——在一条带着拨弦般弹跳、眩晕回旋的主旋律之下，肆意奏出狂野而不完美的和声。
The soundbox is brightly polished cherry wood, shaped like a teardrop, about the size of a guitar. The rest of the instrument is a complicated bar of keys and strings, ending at a small crank with a knobby wooden handle. The player turns the crank and pushes keys, and what emerges sounds like a tiny orchestra of gnomes playing wild imperfect harmonies under a twangy, reeling melody.

Untested Knight Before His First Battle.name:
初上战场的稚嫩骑士
Untested Knight Before His First Battle

Text.text:
骑士在鞍上稳住身形，拼命想止住颤抖。他英俊而年轻的面庞被恐惧所磨砺——慌乱的眼底满溢惊惶，汗珠沿着紧蹙的眉间滚落。他的坐骑被缰绳磨得不耐，察觉到骑手的不安，不住挣动，战士只得竭力与之抗衡，才勉强令她安定。

~

The knight steadies himself in the saddle, desperate to stop the shaking. His handsome, youthful face is tempered by the terror brimming behind his frantic eyes and the beads of sweat rolling down his furrowed brow. His mount chafes at the reins, sensing her rider's discomfort, and the warrior has to fight to keep her steady.

~

这个法术念起来很带劲，甚至可以在空地上或深冬穹界里大喊出来。你将张开的手掌对准一堆足够揉成拳头体型雪团的积雪，然后在握紧手掌的同时喊出“crystalomotus”。法术成功施放时，一枚紧实的雪球升到胸口高度。你迅速挥动手臂，在挥击末端让拳头指向你的目标，雪球便会以你的法术所能赋予的力量，飞得又远又快。
The spell is fun to say, or even shout, out on the grounds or in Deep Winter Globe. You aim your open hand at enough snow to make a ball the size of your fist, then say “crystalomotus” while closing your hand. On a successful cast, a tight snowball rises to chest height. You move your arm quickly, ending your stroke with your fist aimed at your target, and the snowball flies as far and fast as the strength of your spell permits.

I Perform A Retributive Strike With My S.name:
我用权杖施展一次惩戒反击
I Perform A Retributive Strike With My Staff Of Power

Text.text:
我使出浑身力气挥动法杖，压低声音咕哝着诅咒，将它生生折成两截。随之而来的是一声震耳欲聋的轰鸣，迸发出虹彩般的爆裂光焰；其中封存的魔力被彻底释放，化作毁灭性的浪潮自我身周席卷开来。
Swinging the staff with all my might and muttering a curse under my breath, I break it in two. A thunderous boom accompanies the resulting prismatic explosion, as the magical energy within is released in a catastrophic wave around me.

Gold Buckle For A Wide Belt.name:
宽腰带的金扣
Gold Buckle For A Wide Belt

Text.text:
这枚扣环结实沉重，但金子廉价——做工更偏向耐用而非工艺。扣环张扬有余，却谈不上令人叹服。
This buckle is sturdy and heavy, but the gold is cheap—the workmanship geared more to durability than artistry. The buckle is more brash than impressive.

A Warlock's Taunt.name:
术士的嘲讽
A Warlock's Taunt

Text.text:
“你自以为可怖，护甲缠身，追随者簇拥。但我曾凝视深渊，并将其折服于我的意志。今天，你得死。”
"You think yourself fearsome, wreathed in your armor and surrounded by your followers. But I've looked into the Abyss and bent it to my will. Today, you die."

你抬头望去，只见一只小马体型的壁虎倒挂在天花板上。它粗壮而修长的指头末端长着吸盘，轻而易举地违逆重力，就像你呼吸一样自然。那生物低头俯视，眼睛大如餐盘，头颅扭转到一个不自然的角度。覆盖它全身的鳞片在多彩的蓝光中流转闪烁，让它的皮肤厚实得如同犀牛的皮甲。你正看着，它的舌头便如暴云中迸出的闪电般从口中疾射而出——又长又快，足以套住一个成年兽人。
You look up to see a pony-sized gecko hanging from the ceiling, its thick elongated fingers ending in pads that defy gravity as easily as you breathe. The creature looks down with eyes the size of dinner plates, head twisting to an unnatural angle. The scales that coat this creature shimmer in multi-hued blues, and give its hide the thickness of a rhinoceros's. As you watch, its tongue darts from its mouth as fast as lightning from a storm cloud—long and fast enough to snare a grown orc.

Meeting Underdark.name:
幽暗地域的会面
Meeting Underdark

Text.text:
洞窟一路向下，坠入更深的黑暗，你的脚步骤然停住。有什么东西动了——也许只是空气温度的细微变化，或是耳膜被压迫的那一瞬不适。你说不准。你无法确定。可你感觉自己正站在深渊的边缘。你眯起眼睛，竭力在岩壁上寻找哪怕一丝异样，盼着能在阴影深处找到恐惧的证据。你屏息无声，用意志命令耳朵去听见那股从前方隧道里渗出的威胁。但什么也没有。你长长吐出一口气，用意志让肩膀松下来。只是个洞穴而已，和你这段漫长地下跋涉中走过的所有洞穴一样。你向前迈步，一股寒意顺着脊柱窜上来，沿着头皮蔓延，令你浑身汗毛倒竖。再往黑暗深处走，像是个致命的错误。

~ Envisioned by Soularius

The cavern descends into a deeper darkness, and you stop in your tracks. Something shifts, some barely perceptible difference in the temperature of the air or its pressure in your ears. You’re not sure. You can’t be certain. But it feels like you stand on the precipice of an abyss. You strain your eyes looking for some telltale difference in the stone, hoping to find some proof of your fears in the depths of the shadows. You stand silent, willing your ears to hear the threat you feel emanating from the tunnel before you. But there’s nothing. You heave a sigh of relief and will your shoulders to relax. It’s just a cave, like all the cave that came before it in your long subterranean trek. You step forward and a chill runs up your spine and spreads over your scalp, raising every hair on your body. Going deeper into the dark feels like a dire mistake.

~ Envisioned by Soularius

暮色般的肌肤仿佛由我们世界最深处的黑暗织就，覆在这名凶残杀手那矫健的身形上。那名游荡者将雪白的头发高高束起，远离那双猩红的目光。她迅疾而致命，宛如腰间箭袋里的弩矢；她又无声而行，如同落雪——而她的意图更冷。她携着一对单刃短剑，在黑暗中寒光闪烁，刃口为唯一的目的而磨砺。她摇曳着步伐向你逼近，像是在为那场致命的芭蕾揭开序幕；她举起兵刃，精灵般的面容扭曲成僵硬的威胁。
Twilight skin woven from the deepest shadows of our world covers the lithe form of this vicious killer. The rogue wears her alabaster hair tied up and away from her crimson gaze. As swift and deadly as the crossbow bolts in her hip quiver, she moves silently as snowfall—her intentions colder. She carries a pair of single-edged shortswords that gleam in the darkness, their blades honed for a single purpose. Sashaying toward you as the prelude to her deadly ballet, she readies those weapons, her elven mien twisting into a rictal threat.

Bard Dancing Well.name:
吟游诗人：舞步翩然
Bard Dancing Well

Text.text:
将他人束缚于大地的普遍力量，似乎对这位吟游诗人毫无效果。他们起舞仿佛乘风而起，足尖飞掠，步伐精准得如同绣娘的针脚。头部的轻转、手臂与双手划出的线条与角度皆一丝不苟地优雅，举重若轻却又迷惑人心；他们整具身躯都是一件流动的艺术品。
The universal forces that bind others to earth seem to have no effect upon the bard. They dance as though buoyed by the wind, feet flashing in steps as precise as an embroiderer’s needle. The motions of their head and the lines and angles of their arms and hands are scrupulously graceful and deceptively effortless; their entire body is a moving work of art.

Staff Of The Python.name:
巨蟒法杖
Staff Of The Python

Text.text:
尽管它被雕刻自一种浅色材质，乍看近似白松，却在这根法杖上找不到任何可辨的木纹；那层灰白“树皮”上的天然光泽反而泛着血一般的猩红。法杖的整体也被雕成一条凌厉的蛇形，只是细节并不繁复，唯有武器头部那对精心刻出的蛇眼格外逼真。
Though it has been carved from a pale substance much like white pine, there is no detectable grain along this staff, and the natural highlights along the off-white “bark” are blood-red in color. The staff has also been carved to resemble a striking snake, though not with any great detail aside from the carefully shaped eyes in the weapon’s head.

Barbarian Quip About Fighting A Cruel Fo.name:
野蛮人嘲讽：对付残酷的敌人
Barbarian Quip About Fighting A Cruel Foe

Text.text:
“我们不需要谈这个；也不必去想什么对错。有时候你就得把他们统统杀光，撕成碎片，丢在那里让他们的同伴来发现。面对这种东西，只有这样你才赢得了。”
“We don’t need to talk about it; don’t need to think about what’s right or wrong. Sometimes you just have to kill them all, rip them up, and leave them for their friends to find. It’s the only way you win against something like this.”

Spear Of Unseelie Craftsmanship.name:
邪魅工艺长矛
Spear Of Unseelie Craftsmanship

Text.text: 当你的手合拢握住这支长矛的矛柄时，一股冰冷的恶心感猛然冲刷全身。指尖擦过一片片黏滑的苔藓，水蛭在缠绕着肿胀腐朽木身的荆棘间蜿蜒穿行。它看起来并不起眼，但你能感觉到这件武器里潜伏着与其破败外表不相称的力量，于是试着练习性地刺了几下。你向前一送，荆棘骤然向外爆裂，带着滋滋作响的嘶鸣灼烫空气。一阵尖锐、令人不安的咯咯怪笑灌入你的脑海，视野霎时摇晃发花，你的目光落在长矛上——那里刻着一个粗陋却发光的符号，那是这件武器疫腐来历的印记。 Cold nausea washes over you as your hand closes around the haft of this spear. Your fingers brush against slimy patches of moss, and leeches slither between the brambles entwined around the swollen, rotted wood. Though it doesn’t look like much, you sense there is a power in the weapon that belies its dilapidated appearance and try a few practice stabs. As you thrust it forward, the brambles explode outward, searing the air with a sizzling hiss. A shrill, unsettling cackle fills your mind and your vision swims for a moment, your gaze alighting on a crude glowing symbol etched into the spear—a mark of the weapon’s blighted origins.

Sundries From A Bearded Devil.name:
胡须魔的杂货
Sundries From A Bearded Devil

Text.text:
恶魔那如胡须般的鞭须即便死去仍在扭动，然而很快便彻底静止。它的手臂与护甲破损得面目全非。恶魔身上再无多少值钱之物；只是令人毛骨悚然的是，它腰带上的一只小袋里竟摸出一支装着殷红鲜血的玻璃小瓶。
The devil’s beard-like whips writhe even in death, but soon fall still. Its arms and armor are damaged beyond recognition. The devil was carrying nothing else of much value; though, gruesomely, a pouch on its belt yields a vial of red blood.

I Feel My Soul Embrace Good.name:
我感到灵魂拥抱善良
I Feel My Soul Embrace Good

Text.text:
我的呼吸一滞，烈焰骤然爆发，将我整个吞没。火焰如鞭般抽打的舌尖之间，我的伙伴与四周景象尽数消失不见。可……我竟感觉不到疼痛。火焰从自然的橙、红、黄渐渐变作虹彩般的流光，继而化为刺目的纯白。我所熟悉的世界随之褪色，我漂浮在苍白、介于有无之间的空间里。远处传来如雷的轰鸣，低沉的震动一路贯穿到我的骨髓深处。我所爱之人的脸、仍令我陌生之人的脸——甚至敌人的脸——都在我眼前摇曳浮现。我心中涌起一种职责感，庞大得令人心碎：要守护他们所有人。世界渐渐相位回归、重新成形时，我轻轻跪倒在地，脸上早已泪湿。我起身，环顾四周，终于明白自己崭新而真实的使命：守护、改善、以我所能的任何方式去奉献。
My breath catches as a blaze of fire suddenly engulfs me. My companions and surroundings disappear behind the whip-like tongues of flame. But… I feel no pain. The flames change from natural orange, red, and yellow to a prismatic array. Then they turn a blinding white, the world I knew fades away, and I am floating in pale, liminal space. I hear sounds like thunder in the distance, its rumble reaching my very core. The faces of those I love and those who are still strange to me—even the faces of my enemies—waver before me. I feel a sense of duty, immense and heart-breaking, to protect them all. I fall softly to my knees, as the world phases back into existence, my face wet with tears. I stand and take in my surroundings, understanding my new and true purpose: to protect, to better, to serve in any way I can.

Travel On Foot Through A Spooky Arctic L.name:
徒步穿越一片阴森的极地冰原
Travel On Foot Through A Spooky Arctic Land

Text.text:
积雪与寒冰在脚下咯吱作响，你跋涉在荒原之上，顶着横扫苔原的凶猛刺骨寒风，那风声尖啸不止。冰寒啃噬着你裸露的肌肤，额头的汗珠也在瞬间凝成霜。远处群山拔地而起，尽裹在迷雾之中。一声嚎叫在空旷中回荡，你不禁猜想，究竟是什么样的野兽才能发出这般声响。

~ 由 Tolbi Envisioned

Snow and ice crunch underfoot as you trudge overland, fighting against a fierce, frigid wind that whines across the tundra. Ice bites at your exposed flesh, and sweat freezes upon your brow. Mountains rise in the distance, shrouded in mist. A howl echoes, and you wonder what kind of beast could make such a sound.

~ Envisioned by Tolbi

Speech By A Lich About Returning.name:
诸位聆听。

你们把“死亡”当作终点，把坟土当作永恒的封口。可对我而言，那只是一次转身——一次归来前的短暂沉寂。

我曾有血肉，曾有心跳，曾在黎明里呼吸，像你们一样以为时间会仁慈。后来我看见了：仁慈只是活人编给自己的童话。时间从不宽恕，它只收割。它把王冠压成尘，把誓言泡成烂泥，把你们的名字一点点磨平，直到连悼念的人也忘了该为谁落泪。

于是我选择了另一条路。

我把自己从命运的齿轮里抽出来，剥去那会腐烂的皮囊，留下不可腐朽的意志。你们称我为巫妖，像吐出一口厌恶的痰；可你们心底的恐惧，恰恰证明我成功了——我越过了你们跪着接受的结局。

你们说我“死而不安”。不，我安宁得很。真正不安的，是活人。你们害怕夜深时胸口那一下空落，害怕镜子里多一根白发，害怕某一天醒来发现自己再也不被需要。你们把这种恐惧涂上香料，叫它“人生”，然后端起酒杯假装庆祝。

而我不必假装。

你们杀过我。你们高举火把，念着祷词，笑得像正义本身。可现在，我站在这里。听见了吗？这不是奇迹——这是必然。只要我的意志未灭，只要那承载我本源的契印仍在，我就会回来。一次又一次。像潮汐，像冬去春来，像你们终究会迎来的黑夜。

你们以为归来只是复仇？

不。复仇太狭窄，太像活人的激情，烧得快，灭得也快。我归来，是为了清算，是为了收回被你们浪费的岁月，是为了让这片土地记住：恐惧并非诅咒，恐惧是秩序。

我会带回那些被你们遗忘的名字，让他们在骨与尘的喉咙里再度开口；我会让你们曾经焚毁的书卷重新被翻阅，让每一页都用你们的颤抖作注脚；我会让你们明白，死亡从来不是你们的盟友——死亡是我的门扉。

所以，跪下吧。不是向我乞命，而是向事实低头：你们所谓的“终结”，在我这里不过是逗号。

我已经归来。

而这一次，我不会再离开。
Speech By A Lich About Returning

Text.text:
“我曾尝过深渊的滋味。我沉入其中，感受那般深邃空无的冰冷攫握。但随即，有什么开始蠢动——一股驱散黑暗的恶意，一种连虚空本身都会战栗的力量——我便知道，我的使命尚未完成。”
“I have tasted the abyss. I sank into it and felt the chilling grasp of such a profound emptiness. But then something stirred, a malice that banished the dark, a power that would make even the void itself shudder, and I knew my work was not yet done.”

这人形生物矮壮而宽阔，皮肤宛如岩石：坚硬、粗砺，呈灰色。它像矮人，却又截然不同——通体无毛，那双诡异的乳白色眼睛令人想起最深最暗洞窟里的野兽。它的护甲工艺精良却外观粗陋，护住要害；腰间一柄凶相毕露的战斧让任何意图靠近的袭击者都望而却步。它咧嘴冷笑，牙齿在石板般的灰色皮肤映衬下白得刺眼。
Squat and broad, the humanoid creature's skin resembles stone: hard, rough, and gray in color. Like a dwarf, yet distinct, the creature appears completely hairless, and their strange, milky eyes evoke beasts of the deepest, darkest caverns. Armor, finely made but crude in appearance, protects the creature's vital areas, while a wicked-looking axe at their hip deters would-be attackers. The creature sneers, their teeth stark white against the slate gray of their skin.

Keiran The Kobold.name:
狗头人凯兰
Keiran The Kobold

Text.text:
一个色彩斑斓的小家伙，这名红鳞狗头人穿着亮青色长裤，披着一件天蓝斗篷，内衬祖母绿般的绿意。他下颚右侧突兀地探出一颗金牙，在参差的狞笑间闪闪发亮。他似乎一刻也停不下来：尖锐的爪子不停摆弄斗篷的拖尾，确保他站定时依旧平整顺滑，而在某些动作间又能夸张地鼓荡翻飞。斗篷掀起时，能看见下面的旅行背包，也能瞥见他左肩上一枚船锚纹身。背包叮当作响，听起来像塞满了一大把钱币。他的胯侧各系着一把短剑，剑鞘上用绿与蓝的布条利落缠绕，和他的装束相映成趣。

~ Played by a Hero

A colorful little fellow, this red-scaled kobold wears bright teal pants and a sky-blue cloak with emerald-green lining. A golden tooth juts from the right side of his lower jaw, glinting within his jagged grin. He can’t seem to stand still: his pointed claws fiddle with the train of his cloak, ensuring it remains smooth while he stands still but billows grandly with certain gestures. A travel pack is visible beneath his cloak when it wafts up, as is a tattoo of an anchor on his left shoulder. The pack jingles with what sounds like a bevy of coins. Two short swords are belted at his hips, the scabbards adorned with stylish wrappings of green and blue fabric to match his attire.

~ Played by a Hero

Hidden Altar Room.name:
隐藏祭坛室
Hidden Altar Room

Text.text:
一面墙缓缓移位，石磨石般的刺耳摩擦声回荡，机关在沉重的负荷下艰难运转。一个临时拼凑的门洞随之显现，露出一处逼仄的空间：中央是一座巨大的祭坛，四周环着一圈蜡烛，早在很久以前就已燃尽，只剩贴着烛台的残根。
A wall shifts, stone grinding against stone as the mechanism struggles with the weight. A makeshift doorway is formed, revealing a cramped space occupied by a large altar surrounded by candles that long ago burned down to their bases.

Loot From A Small Blight.name:
小型枯败之祸的战利品
Loot From A Small Blight

Text.text: 栗子以一种诡异的簇状，长在这间生物杂草丛生的窝棚角落。你手一触及，那些亮绿色、布满尖刺的外壳便微微颤动。伴随着一声噼啪与临末的砰响，外壳向后卷起，仿佛被魅影火焰吞噬，内里则变成了烘烤后的棕褐色。烤栗子的馥郁香气瞬间充满这狭小的空间。 Chestnuts grow in an uncanny cluster in the corner of this creature’s overgrown hovel. Their bright green spiny rinds quiver slightly at the reach of your hand. With a crackle and penultimate pop, the rinds curl backward as if consumed by phantom flame and the cores turn a roasted brown. The pleasing aroma of toasted chestnut floods the small space.

I Swim With My Ring Of Swimming.name:
我戴着游泳戒指畅游
I Swim With My Ring Of Swimming

Text.text:
我一头扎进水面之下，轻轻几下蹬踢，便如同鱼儿般轻松疾掠于水中。指环泛着青绿的幽光，随着我每一次划臂与每一次蹬腿而脉动奔涌。
I dive under the surface and, with a few minor kicks, zoom through the water as easily as any fish. My ring, glowing with teal luminescence, surges with each stroke of my arms or kick of my legs.

Feedham’s Fillies.name:
菲德汉姆的骏雌马群
Feedham’s Fillies

Text.text:
当你走近这排朴素的马厩时，便听见栏内传来顽皮的嘶鸣与蹄声哒哒。一个侏儒牵着一匹母马的皮缰，把她从厩里领出来；他对她说话时，前牙间的缝隙漏出一阵尖细的哨音，语调却温柔得像在哄孩子。母马把鼻口凑到他背上磨蹭，鼻孔喷着热气，呼哧呼哧地把他的橙白格子衬衫吹得鼓起又拍落。“好啦，好啦，”他干笑一声。随即掏出一块圆饼干，看起来像把大麦碾碎后压成的，抬手举在半空。母马用方正的牙齿把它叼住，满足地哼了一声。
As you approach this modest set of stables, you can hear the sound of playful whinnies and clip-clopping hooves from within the stalls. A gnome leads a mare by her leather reins out of her stall, his voice whistling through the gap between his front teeth as he speaks to her in loving tones. She nuzzles at his back, nostrils huffing and buffeting his orange-and-white gingham shirt. "Alright, alright," he says with a dry chuckle. He pulls out a round biscuit that has the look of smashed-up barley and lifts it in the air. She takes it between her blocky teeth with a pleased harrumph.

尽管河水并不算湍急，狭窄的河道却迫使水流在浅滩处撞击岩石、翻卷搅动，发出持续的潺潺咕噜声；即便泥泞的河岸边虫群盘旋，这声音依旧令人心旷神怡。
Though the river is not particularly rapid, the narrow channel forces the water to churn against the rocks in the shallows, creating a constant burbling noise that is quite pleasant despite the insects swarming near the muddy banks.

Open-air Tavern: Nighttime Respite.name:
露天酒馆：夜间小憩
Open-air Tavern: Nighttime Respite

Text.text:
旅人客栈已沉入一种令人安心的静谧，但厨子们仍在厨房里忙碌，清洗收拾，为明日做准备。蟋蟀与其他夜行生灵的声响触及你的耳畔，远处还有镇民的细碎谈笑——他们尚未准备就此安歇。
The traveler’s inn has settled into a companionable quiet, but the cooks still work in the kitchen, cleaning and preparing for tomorrow. The sounds of crickets and other nighttime wildlife reach you, along with the distant chatter of townsfolk not yet ready to settle in for the night.

Staff Of Power.name:
权能法杖
Staff Of Power

Text.text:
这根法杖被刨削得光滑无瑕，表面覆着一层板岩色的漆，造型却完美对称、毫无装饰。然而你一握住它，整根杖身便沿着全长浮现出发光的符文，闪耀着奥术的辉芒。你掌心的刺痒感逐渐发热，继而沿着手臂一阵阵搏动上涌，电流般贯穿全身，令人战栗。你不知为何确信，你感受到的绝非寻常——那是赤裸的力量，是一泻而下的秘术动能，等待法杖的持有者去驱策。
This staff has been planed smooth and covered in some sort of slate-colored lacquer, but its design is perfectly symmetrical and unadorned. Yet, as soon as you take hold of it, glowing runes begin to appear along its entire length with arcane light. A prickling sensation in your hands begins to grow warmer, then throbs up your arms, thrilling through your body. Somehow, you know that what you feel is nothing short of raw power, a cascade of occult dynamism to be commanded by the staff’s wielder.

Slick Alien Grifter.name:
狡猾的外星骗子
Slick Alien Grifter

Text.text:
那外星女人把头上的触须盘成华丽的发髻，身上穿着一袭礼服，露出大片苍淡的紫色肌肤，映在她那膝似弯折的后腿上。“你好吗？”她问道，嗓音在空气中悦耳地震颤——可那双幽暗的眼睛却冷静而精于算计地钉在你身上，与她温热的举止格格不入。
The alien has her head-tentacles tied up in a fancy do, and wears a dress that exposes swathes of pale purple skin on her stifle-jointed legs. "How do you do?" she asks, her voice vibrating pleasantly in the air—though her dark eyes fix on you with a cool, calculating gaze at odds with her warm demeanor.

I Use Extended Spell.name:
我使用延展法术
I Use Extended Spell

Text.text:
我将注意力凝聚在法术的持久效应上，向其中灌注比平时更多的魔法能量。这份额外的燃料应能让魔法维持得远比平常更久。
Focusing on my spell’s enduring effects, I feed it more of my magical energy than usual. This extra fuel should sustain the magic far longer than normal.

车轮哐啷作响，马嘶声由远及近，宣告马车逼近。忽然，皮革挽具崩裂，两匹栗色骏马挣脱束缚，甩开车辕，冲出大道，纵蹄奔入前方荒野。失去马匹的车厢仍沿路失控狂飙，后斗货物被颠得四散飞出；它越滚越快，在崎岖地形上剧烈弹跳、横冲直撞。
The clatter of wheels and whinnying of horses announces the wagon’s approach. Suddenly, the leather harness snaps, and a pair of chestnut horses break free of the wagon’s pursuit, galloping off the road and into the wilderness beyond. The wagon, now horseless, continues to careen down the road, goods flying from the back as it gains momentum and bounces wildly over the rough terrain.

My Scimitar Of Speed Slashes Again.name:
我的速度弯刀再次斩出
My Scimitar Of Speed Slashes Again

Text.text:
弯刀在我手中急切地颤鸣，我收势的同时，它已迫不及待想再度攻击。我的手臂微微刺麻，被魔法的速度灌注；我任由刀身的弧度牵引下一记斩击，在繁复而致命的舞步中起落穿梭。
The scimitar vibrates eagerly in my hand, desperate to attack again as I complete my strike. My arm tingles, imbued with magical speed, and I allow the curve of the sword to guide my next slash in an intricate and deadly dance.

Yew Wand Druidic Focus.name:
紫杉木魔杖（德鲁伊法器）
Yew Wand Druidic Focus

Text.text:
嵌在纤细白蜡木魔杖上的未打磨琥珀晶体，被五枚骨爪牢牢扣住——等距分布，细致地向内收拢，仿佛是被轻声引导就位，而非粗暴敲入。这个奥术法器似乎无论天气如何，都始终泛着日光般的辉芒。
The uncut amber crystal set into the slender ash wand is held in place with five bone claws, equally spaced and folded in with care, as if coaxed rather than hammered into place. The arcane focus seems to gleam with sunlight at all times, regardless of the weather.

Codex Of Confidentialities.name:
机密法典
Codex Of Confidentialities

Text.text: [掩蔽]  这本书以午夜蓝皮革装帧，封面压印着球体与占卜符号，那些纹样会无端游移、变换。翻开后，第一页洁白得刺眼，正中央以优美字迹写着：我有个秘密要告诉你，而你不能告诉任何人。这是一个人能施加在另一个人身上最恶毒的诅咒。 [内容]  这本书记载着一部“秘密被揭穿”的历史——有些尚算无害，有些却加速了诸国的倾覆。读完整本书后，读者获得洞察能力，并能将秘密守至死去。 [Cover]  The book is midnight-blue leather with embossed spheres and divination symbols that move and change at random. Inside, centered on the first bright white page, a beautiful script declares: I have a secret for you, and you can’t tell anyone. This is the worst curse one can cast on another. [Content]  The book is a history of secrets revealed—some relatively harmless, others that accelerated the fall of nations. Upon completing the book, the reader gains ability in insight and can keep a secret unto death.

Seasoned Anti-grav Racer.name:
老练的反重力赛车手
Seasoned Anti-grav Racer

Text.text:
这男人的整体外形仿佛专为将风阻降到最低而打造。他穿着一身褪了色的紧身装，头颅剃得精光，连颧骨与下颌的线条都显得流畅而锋利。裸露的手臂上布满新旧交错的疤痕与灼痕，脸上刻着一抹紧绷而专注的神情。
The man's entire appearance looks designed to be as aerodynamic as possible. He wears a faded skintight outfit, his head is shaved, and even the lines of his cheekbones and jaw look sleek and sharp. Scars and burn marks, both old and new, pepper his exposed arms, and his face is creased with an intense, focused look.

Ring Of Resistance.name:
抗力之戒
Ring Of Resistance

Text.text:
一圈金色指环的两端——塑成合拢的掌心——向内弯曲，托住一枚乳白流彩的宝石。宝石的色泽会随着光线的变换而流转。
Two ends of a golden band—shaped like cupped hands—curve around an opalescent gemstone. The hue of the gem shifts with changes in the light.

你高举圣徽，低声吐出咒言。刹那间，炫目的光芒轰然绽放，幽影般的身形从光里跃出。他们环绕着你疾旋，挥舞兵刃，守卫着这片区域，并向你的敌人猛然袭击。
You hold aloft the holy symbol and speak the words, and in a dazzling flash of light, the spectral figures spring forth. They begin circling you, brandishing weapons, defending the area and lashing out at your foes.

那瘦长的人形比大多数人都高出一截；尽管它像人一样移动，可它的本质却让你心底发毛。它的皮肤近乎半透明，呈现出斑驳而不断变幻的纹理，随着每一次移动而流动、改写。它转过身，你看见它的脸毫无五官——眼眶只是两处空洞的凹陷，鼻子仅有一点轻微的凸起，嘴则是一条薄而无唇的裂缝。那张面孔让你的血液都发冷。紧接着，五官开始扭曲游移，化作一张张既熟悉又陌生的脸；随后，就在你眨眼之间，那生物已消失在人群里，仿佛融入背景，在悄然更换形貌的同时不留痕迹。
The spindly humanoid stands taller than most, and though it moves like a person, its very nature unsettles you. Its skin, almost translucent, appears mottled and ever-changing, shifting with each movement. It turns, and you see that its face is devoid of features—hollow pits for eyes, a slight bump for a nose, and a thin, lipless mouth. The visage chills your blood. The features shift, to faces both familiar and strange; then, as quickly as it appeared, the creature disappears into the crowd, blending in as it assumes a new form.

Aloof Enhanced Hacker.name:
冷峻的强化黑客
Aloof Enhanced Hacker

Text.text:
这人从头到脚都镶着义体强化与装饰。头发在光线中变幻色泽，永远与那对发光的眼睛相得益彰。两条手臂里都植入了专为黑入而造的接口，双腿自膝以下尽是金属。他漫不经心地扫了你一眼，便又把注意力投回从其中一只眼里投射出来的资讯流。
Cybernetic enhancements and ornaments adorn this person from head to toe. Their hair shifts color in the light, always complementing their glowing eyes. Interfaces built for hacking are embedded in either arm, and their legs are metal from the knee down. They spare you an uninterested glance before returning to a feed projected from one of their eyes.

I Drain Life With My Rod Of Lordly Might.name:
我用威严权杖汲取生命
I Drain Life With My Rod Of Lordly Might

Text.text:
我击中敌人，生命的能量沿着法杖奔涌而来，灌入我的体内，合拢伤口，注入勃勃生机。对手被我击中的地方仿佛瞬间枯槁干裂，血肉中的水分像被骤然蒸发殆尽。伤口迅速发黑，皮肤开始萎缩、剥落——而我在这股复苏的力量中重获活力，蓄势迎接下一次攻击。
I hit my enemy and feel the energy of life flow through the Rod and into me, closing my wounds and instilling me with vigor. The foe seems withered and desiccated where I struck them, as if all the moisture in their flesh has suddenly evaporated. Their wound grows black, and the skin begins to wither and fall away—while I, revitalized, prepare myself for the next attack.

即使隔着一段距离，空气也嗡鸣着能量，光芒几乎令人睁不开眼。那抹金色辉耀源自一圈悬浮在异质石墙之上、又仿佛在其外侧的圆环。自圆环中心延伸出一缕缕黄色光丝，如同大树根须自树基蔓生。它们静止不动，却有明亮的脉冲沿着光丝疾驰，迸散出闪烁的光尘，向四面八方漂去。有时，当脉冲抵达某条光丝的尽头，便会将那光丝再向外延伸一小截。唯有一道门洞刺穿这圈诡异的围墙，由巡弋在边缘的非人之物守卫。

~ YourFavoriteTim 构想

Even at a distance, the air drones with energy and the light is almost blinding. That golden radiance issues from a circle floating above and beyond a wall of alien stonework. Strands of yellow luminance emanate from the central circle like roots from the base of a tree. They remain still, but glowing pulses race along them, emitting shining motes that float away in all directions. Sometimes, as a pulse reaches the end of a strand, it extends that strand a short distance. One gateway pierces the strange encircling wall, guarded by inhuman creatures patrolling the perimeter.

~ Envisioned by YourFavoriteTim

Tough Neighborhood Priest.name:
硬骨头街区神父
Tough Neighborhood Priest

Text.text:
宗教教义那微妙的两面性，随着牧师的言语被具象化呈现；他们那双深褐而富有神采的眼睛始终不曾离开你的视线。仁慈在他们的字句间熠熠生辉，许诺向困厄之人施以援手与施舍，不求回报、不附义务——然而仍有某种更幽暗的气息悄然盘桓不散。
The subtle duality of religious doctrine is embodied by the priest as they speak, their rich, brown eyes never leaving your own. Benevolence shines brightly through their words, promising aid and charity to those in need without recompense or obligation—and yet something darker lingers.

Druid Speech About Harmony In Nature.name:
德鲁伊谈自然和谐的言语
Druid Speech About Harmony In Nature

Text.text:
“与自然相连，并非寻得和谐。自然残酷而可怖，是混沌的血腥狂潮——吞噬与乱伦翻滚成刺耳的喧嚣，潜伏在每一声鸟鸣与每一头生物的嚎叫里。我并不与自然相安无事；我只是把它的恐怖，导向那些胆敢威胁它的人。”
“To connect to nature is not to find harmony. Nature is cruel, gruesome chaos. A rolling cacophony of cannibalism and incest that is heard in every bird’s song and creature’s howl. I am not at peace with nature; I just direct its horror to those who threaten it.”

One-shot Rocket Launcher.name:
一次性火箭发射器
One-shot Rocket Launcher

Text.text:
一根粗壮、足有一英尺长的管状发射器，布满方正的红色警示字样，躺在弹道泡沫衬垫的箱中，宛如沉睡的巨龙；它静卧不动，直到被唤醒，才会喷薄出狂怒的毁灭。尽管这具发射器仅能使用一次，但见过它开火的人都明白：一枚火箭弹就足以解决大多数麻烦——或制造出全新的麻烦。
A bulky, foot-long tube replete with blocky red warning text sits in a case of ballistics foam like a sleeping dragon, idle until roused to furious devastation. Though the launcher is single use, anyone who has seen one in action knows that a single rocket is more than enough to solve most problems—or cause entirely new ones.

Asteroid Breaks Through Windshield Of Sp.name:
小行星撞破宇宙飞船的舷窗
Asteroid Breaks Through Windshield Of Spacecraft

Text.text:
飞船在小行星带中谨慎地迂回穿行，始终与那些岩块保持足够的安全距离。那些小行星看起来只是缓慢漂移，但每一块背后的质量都足以让它们成为致命的炮弹。最危险的莫过于一块更小的岩石——它比其他的移动得更快，却因缺乏足够的体型而无法被传感器捕捉到。伴随着一声叮当脆裂的撞击，破碎的挡风玻璃骤然宣告灾厄降临，震耳欲聋的气流如洪瀑般从新裂口狂喷而出。
The ship swerves carefully through the asteroid field, staying well clear of any of the rocks. Though the asteroids look to be drifting slowly, the mass behind each one makes it a deadly projectile. None more so than a smaller rock, moving faster than the others without the size required to be picked up by the sensors. A tinkling crash heralds a deafening torrent of air flying out of the newly broken windshield.

激光投影出的枝形吊灯影像悬在桌台与卡座上方，客人和陪侍都穿得干净利落、锋利挺括。迷你裙像铬一样泛着冷光，西装外套与马甲只消抬手一挥便嘶嘶变幻出不同纹样：细条纹、涡纹佩斯利，还有一瀑瀑几何菱形的层叠流光。大腿在桌下接触，膝盖彼此磕碰；而在台面之上，人们又端端正正地对望，目光沉进对方玻璃般的表情里。许多人把头插进焊在桌面的那些小盒子里——一种科技-神经的迷醉，比鸡尾酒或一小撮粉末的冲击来得更快。天鹅绒包衬的后墙中央，一颗霓虹心脏以轻缓的心跳节奏跳动，红光在时代里一下一下脉冲。妈妈桑以放浪的冷酷迎接最新的来客，嗓音边缘粗粝，像一片用旧的砂纸。她那带颤的低笑，像拉链被拉开时的唰然声。
Laser-projected images of chandeliers hover above the tables and booths, the clientele and escorts alike dressed cleanly, sharply. Mini dresses gleam like chrome, while suit jackets and vests fizzle into different patterns with the wave of a hand: pinstripe, paisley, and cascades of geometric diamonds. Thighs touch and knees bump together under tabletops while, above board, people gaze into each other’s glassy expressions. Many have their heads jacked into the small boxes welded to the tables, a kind of techno-neuro-intoxication that hits faster than a cocktail or any bump of powder. In the center of the velvet-lined back wall, a neon heart pulses a red glow in time with an easy heartbeat. The Madam greets the latest guests with rakish cool, her voice rough around the edges like a piece of used sandpaper. Her vibrating chuckle is like a zipper coming undone.

商店里绽放着糖果店般万花筒似的色彩，在不知疲倦的荧光灯下，琳琅满目的包装一齐泛着亮光。各种商品下方贴着亮黄色的标签，用刺眼的红字虚伪地尖叫着 sale!。你看见一袋袋会沙沙作响的膨化饼干与薯片；夸张得过分的巧克力棒；装着果冻、花生酱与腌黄瓜的塑料罐；一坨坨黏腻的加工糕点。收银台旁，一个半透明的塑料篮里盛着小苹果，绿得精神抖擞，仿佛酸味已经爬到你下颌深处。店铺后方的两面墙摆满冷藏货品，空气冷得发疼，还隐隐带着一丝霉味。一条过道的角落却避开零食，专门陈列美容用品、急救包，以及强力清洁溶剂。

~ 一位英雄 Envisioned

The store beams with the kaleidoscopic color of a candy store, the multitudinous colors of the packaging aglow under unrelenting fluorescent lights. Bright yellow tags stuck under various items mendaciously scream sale! in bright red lettering. You see crinkling bags of puffed crackers and chips; oversized candy bars; plastic jars of jellies, butters, and pickles; gooey hunks of processed pastry. Near the register, a translucent plastic basket holds tiny apples so sprightly green you can feel the sour tang at the back of your jaw. Two walls at the back of the store are lined with refrigerated goods, the air achingly cold and tinged with the faintest scent of mold. A small section of one aisle eschews snacks, instead dedicated to beauty products, first aid kits, and heavy-duty cleaning solutions.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Cold Spring Tournament.name:
冷泉比武大会
Cold Spring Tournament

Text.text:
冬雪消融、播种时节的庆典，让农夫与王侯同样眉开眼笑。成篮成畦的番红花、郁金香与黄水仙把商贩的帐篷与摊位周围的庭院染得缤纷夺目。寒意仍盘旋在空气里，孩子们裹着皮毛或羊毛缩成团。护甲看着就冰冷刺骨，巨大战马的鼻孔里喷出一团团白汽。准备参加混战的一名骑士嘟囔着：这种鬼天气里，连木杖打在身上都像针扎一样疼。
The celebration of the winter melt and planting season puts smiles on the faces of peasant and royal alike. Baskets and borders of crocuses, tulips, and daffodils color the yard around the merchant tents and stalls. Winter is still in the air, and children are bundled in fur or wool. The armor looks cold, and clouds of steam puff from the nostrils of the great steeds. One knight for the melee grumbles about how much even a wooden staff stings in the cold.

这只矮小畸形的生物以嶙峋的肢体挪动，臃肿而扭曲的身躯每迈一步都笨拙地左右摇晃。它的皮肤苍白而富有弹性，像尸体浮肿后的青蓝色，布满粗硬的鬃刺与蛛网般的黑色血管。它那拖曳在地的双手尽头长着阴狠的利爪。细小的眼珠从一张扁平、蝠状的脸上窥视而出，头顶耷拉着下垂的耳朵。
The stunted, grotesque creature moves on skeletal limbs, its rotund and malformed body swaying clumsily with each step. Its skin, pallid and rubbery, resembles the bloated blue of a corpse, riddled with coarse bristles and spidery black veins. Its hands, which drag along the ground, end in wicked claws. Beady eyes peer out from a flat, bat-like face crested with drooping ears.

Rogue Robot Attacks.name:
流氓机器人袭击
Rogue Robot Attacks

Text.text:
伴随着刺耳而冰冷、反复回荡的静电尖啸，机器人猛扑向你，冰冷的金属双手伸出，杀意毕露。它的目光骇人地专注，你在它碎裂的面罩那对猩红的目镜里看见了自己的倒影。它一板一眼地逼近，每一步沉重的迈动都撞出铿锵回响。阴森得像丧钟。
Shrieking in chilling repetitive static, the robot lunges at you, cold metal hands outstretched with murderous intent. Its gaze is terrifyingly intense, and you see yourself reflected in the red ocular lenses of its cracked visor. Methodically, it advances, each ponderous step clanging. Ominous, like a funeral bell.

一具机械人形大步走来，步态完美得近乎刻意。它四肢转动的咔嗒声随着动作起伏，却如节拍器般规律不差。光线在它层层叠叠的装甲上跳跃，映出一片青铜色的迷雾。它的右臂内嵌着一把精密的突击步枪，枪管从一只粗陋的人形手掌中探出，丑陋的枪铁灰冷光逼人。它的脸是一块空白的金属面罩，几乎没有五官：没有嘴，没有转动的眼睛……也没有任何表情。
A mechanical humanoid strides forth with a too-perfect gait. The shifting click of its limbs is like a metronome in their regularity. The light bounces off its many layers of plating in a bronze haze. A sophisticated assault rifle has been built within its right arm, the barrel protruding from a rudimentary humanoid palm in ugly gunmetal gray. Its face is a blank and robotic thing with few features: no mouth, no shifting eyes… no expression at all.

Gorm The Thunderborn.name:
戈姆·雷霆之裔
Gorm The Thunderborn

Text.text:
兽人像任何人类战士一样高大挺拔，肩膀却宽得如同矮人。他那又长又粗硬、盐胡椒般的头发被挽成发髻，免得在近身混战中被人一把抓住。可那本用锁链系在左手护手上的祷告书——扣在他镀锌的板甲护甲上，屡次被雷电灼刻得伤痕累累，宗教符号也早已褪色——却清楚表明，这位挥舞战锤的冒险者是一名战斗牧师。

~ Played by Camel

The orc stands as tall and straight as any human warrior, with shoulders as broad as a dwarf’s. His long, coarse, salt and pepper hair is gathered in a bun to prevent easy purchase for grappling during a melee. Yet the prayer book chained to the left gauntlet of his galvanized plate armor, scarred time and again by lightning and featuring faded symbols of religious significance, indicates that the warhammer-toting adventurer is a war priest.

~ Played by Camel

Lord Alistair Emberheart.name:
阿利斯泰尔·余烬之心领主
Lord Alistair Emberheart

Text.text:
他身形高挑，比例匀称，皮肤被阳光晒成古铜色，举止温雅而从容。浓密的银发两侧剃短，后方却编成辫垂下。眼眸是柔和的灰色，没有虹膜与瞳孔，仿佛雾里空明。正如他的气度一般精致，他那件长及膝的皮质衬衣与同款长靴都透着宗师级的做工；披在身上的翠绿色长外套同样考究。他握着一杆钢头长矛，深色木质矛杆上刻着纹饰；而外套下的腰带与随身挎包里，或许还藏着别的工具或武器。一只披覆紫罗兰羽毛的猛禽停在他左肩，羽色间跃动着薰衣草与淡紫丁香般的火焰。

~ 由一位英雄Played

Tall and well proportioned, this suntanned man has a genteel and gentle bearing. He has thick, silvery hair, shaved at the sides but braided at the back. His eyes are soft gray, lacking irises and pupils. As refined as his manner, his long shirt of leather and matching boots have the look of masterful craftmanship; the viridian overcoat he wears is just as fine. He grips a steel-headed spear with a carved haft of dark wood, although the satchel he carries and belt under his coat might hold other tools or weapons. A raptor swathed in violet feathers, which dance with flames of lavender and lilac, sits on his left shoulder.

~ Played by a Hero with

I Cast Mage Armor.name:
我施放法师护甲
I Cast Mage Armor

Text.text:
魔法自我双肩流泻而下，如一条轻薄的披巾悬浮在我身周。旋即，魔法飞快地缠绕上我的躯干，穿梭编织，化作一道层层束带般的壁垒——却仍轻得令人惊叹。魔法呼啸如远方的风声，那声音渐次高涨，终至尖啸，正当魔法悍然抗拒迎面袭来的攻击。
Magic streams over my shoulders, a sheer stole hovering about my frame. Then the magic quickly threads about my torso, weaving into a banded bulwark—still, to me, wondrously light. The magic whistles like a far-off wind, a sound that crescendos into a shriek as the magic defies incoming attacks.

Large Tree Blocking Road.name:
大树横断道路
Large Tree Blocking Road

Text.text:
不管是哪个家伙——或者什么东西——把这棵树挪来横在前方路上，都做得一丝不苟。你能闻到树根透出的潮湿气息，泥土仍在一些地方顽固地黏着，仿佛第一次被日光照见。
Whatever—whoever—shifted this tree to lie across the road ahead, they were certainly thorough. You can smell the moisture from the tree’s roots, soil still clinging stubbornly in parts, exposed to the daylight for the first time.

Guido Shavaris.name:
圭多·沙瓦里斯
Guido Shavaris

Text.text:
在旅店的庭院里，一个皮肤黝黑、精瘦结实的男人双手将一柄微弯的长剑横在身前；姿势静得像被时间钉住。她身上披着一件束在腰间的袍子，本该遮住他线条分明的胸膛与肩背，可上身却被随意褪到一旁，露出背与胸上纵横交错的伤疤——刀痕与爪痕彼此缠结。下一瞬，他骤然炸开般动了起来，剑光在日照里化作一片模糊——快得你的眼睛几乎追不上它的旅行——而你还没来得及吸足气开口，他与那柄剑便已回到起初的位置。

~ Played by Fryta

In the inn’s courtyard, a tanned, wiry man holds a lightly curved longsword before him with both hands; a pose of absolute stillness. Though he wears a sort of robe belted at the waist, which would normally cover his defined chest and shoulders, the top part has been shrugged off to reveal scars from blade and claw crisscrossing his back and chest. He suddenly explodes into motion, his sword blurring in the sunlight—so quickly that your eye can scarcely follow its travel—and before you finish drawing a breath to speak, he and the sword have returned to their original positions.

~ Played by Fryta

I Coat My Weapon In An Oil Of Sharpness.name:
我将武器涂上一层锐利之油
I Coat My Weapon In An Oil Of Sharpness

Text.text:
玻璃罐里的物质，看起来像一柄明亮的剑被击碎成百万细小的碎片，又被丢进汤汁里浸泡。我进行着如今对我而言已司空见惯的仪式，用布擦拭长剑以清理它——但这一次，布料因罐中的油而泛起粼粼光泽。我用它掩蔽住剑身，转动着看它闪耀，感到魔法正沉入金属之中；我也看见剑刃像剃刀般攫住光线，寒芒一闪。
The substance in the glass jar looks as if a bright sword were shattered into a million tiny slivers, then dropped in broth. I perform what is now common ritual to me, wiping my sword down with a cloth to clean it, but this time the cloth glistens with the jar’s oil. As I cover the blade, turning it to see it sparkle, I feel the magic sinking into its metal and see its edge catch the light as a razor might.

这台相机的感光板与化学处理方式，和常见版本所用的汞、铜与银相似：酸蚀而剧毒。然而，当它睁开“眼睛”时，还会逸散出一种令人眩晕的混合气息——乙醚的甜腻、刺骨的寒意，以及深到发沉的寂静。由此拍出的影像能显现星界与以太界的事物：它们就在眼前，却原本不可见。照片阴森得令人心悸、寒毛倒竖，仿佛为了成像，借走——或偷走——了某种近似灵魂的东西。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The plates and chemical treatments for this camera are similar to the common version’s mercury, copper, and silver: acidic and toxic. But this camera also emits a dizzying concoction of ether, cold, and profound silence when it opens its eye. The pictures that result show things from the astral and ethereal realms, present but otherwise invisible. The photos are haunting and hair-raising, as if something like a soul has been borrowed—or stolen—in order to create them.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Approach To Space Station.name:
接近空间站
Approach To Space Station

Text.text:
一座由铬与玻璃铸成的璀璨城堡，这座空间站如同一只华丽的陀螺，在苍穹中缓缓旋转。邻近恒星的光芒掠过成片的太阳能板之海，随着你逐步逼近，空间站折射出虹彩般的瑰丽辉光。
A glittering citadel of chrome and glass, the space station revolves slowly in the firmament like an ornate spinning top. Catching the light of a nearby star on a sea of solar panels, the station shimmers with iridescent beauty as you approach.

你的声音、谨慎的脚步声，甚至粗重的喘息，都在这座迷宫般的下水道群落里、覆着黏滑污泥的石墙间来回震荡。腐臭的咸淡污水在隧道中蜿蜒流淌，深浅难辨，时而拍打上狭窄的石岸，时而自支渠与出入口间穿行。这里的恶臭浓烈得前所未有，无时无刻不在；它灼痛你的眼与鼻，勒紧你的喉咙。与此同时，诡异的声响从不可知的方向触及你的耳畔，回声如风中管乐般的音符，在黑暗里一节一节地飘荡。
Your voice, your careful footfalls, even your labored breaths reverberate off the slime-coated stone walls of the maze-like sewer complex. A channel of putrid, brackish water runs through these tunnels, imperceptibly deep, occasionally lapping up onto its narrow, stone banks or flowing through inlets and outlets. A stench, unlike anything you’ve experienced prior, is ever-present, burning your eyes and nostrils, tightening your throat. All the while, strange sounds reach your ears from an unknowable direction, echoing like notes through a wind instrument.

男人纵声狂笑，围着对手踏舞般游走，轻轻松松便躲开他们笨拙的击打。快如毒蛇，他倏然突进，细剑一闪刺穿敌手，还不忘嘲讽对方技艺平平；随手一拨，便把那吃力的反击格开。他赏赐般送上灿亮的笑容，举起对方的钱袋，夸张地一鞠躬——随即跃出窗外。

~ 扮演：TuesdayMush

Laughing with wild abandon, the man dances around his opponent, easily avoiding their clumsy attempts to strike him. Quick as a viper, he darts forward, piercing his foe with his rapier as he quips about their mediocre technique and effortlessly parries their strained attempt to counter. He favors them with a shining smile and holds up their coin purse as he bows theatrically—and leaps out of the window.

~ Played by TuesdayMush

Speech By A Sad Bard About Comedy.name:
一位悲伤的吟游诗人关于喜剧的演讲
Speech By A Sad Bard About Comedy

Text.text:
“也许我开玩笑并非出于欢喜或恶意，也许我讲笑话，是因为我很悲伤——深沉得难以言说。每当我逗出一声轻笑，我便被提醒：这不必成为所有人的真实，也许有一天，也不会再成为我的真实。笑声就像沙漠里的一滴水：它也许长不出一片森林，但依然不可或缺。”
“Perhaps I don’t joke out of glee or malice, perhaps I make jokes because I am sad—profoundly so. And with each chuckle I elicit, I am reminded that this does not have to be true for everyone, and perhaps, one day, will not be true for me. Laughter is like a drop of water in a desert: it may not sprout a forest, but it is needed nonetheless.”

Rook, The Warlock.name:
鲁克，契术师
Rook, The Warlock

Text.text:
你猛地认出那男人。你以前见过他——只是那时他戴着另一张脸：同样是混血行者，却换成了另一种元素的气息。难道是某种幻术？他举止从容自若，带着恰到好处的自信，给桌旁其他玩家熟练地发牌，准备再开一局。牌面隐约的微光与他皮革衣襟下刀影的轮廓交织在一起，让你不得不承认一个再真实不过的念头：这名赌徒混在平民之中，显得格格不入。

~ 由 Coach Sean 扮演

You recognize the man with a start. You have seen him before, except he had worn a different face then—still planetouched, but of another element now. Could it be an illusion of some kind? The man conducts himself with a comfortable confidence, dealing out cards to other players at the table and preparing for another hand. Between the faint shimmer of the cards and the outline of knives in his leather, you’re faced with the very real notion that this gambler is out of place among the commoners.

~ Played by Coach Sean

Vampire Flight.name:
吸血鬼（特征）飞行
Vampire Flight

Text.text:
女人从被雨水打滑的城堡垛口坠落时，发出阴森的狂笑。雷声滚滚，闪电划破长空，你眼睁睁看着她轻而易举地再度升起，被一阵不祥的恶风托举到半空。她以掠食者般的目光钉住你，红宝石般的双唇微微张开，露出尖锐如针的獠牙，越升越高，直入无星的夜空。
The woman laughs wickedly as she falls from the rain-slick battlements of the castle. Thunder rumbles and lightning streaks across the sky as you watch her rise effortlessly, borne aloft on a fell wind. She fixes you with a predatory glare and her ruby lips part to reveal pointed, needle-like fangs as she rises higher into the starless night sky.

Speech About The Corruption Of The World.name:
关于世界腐化的演说
Speech About The Corruption Of The World

Text.text:
“呸！我告诉你，这世界污秽不堪，腐烂得无可救药！他们教我思考，教我批判，教我不断戳刺、剖问，直到答案自己浮出水面——而我确实找到了答案。说来简单得近乎优雅：若世上无人，便无人受苦。多么绝妙。当然，总有人会反对。要么是被自私的执念蒙蔽，死死抓着这条命不放；要么是沉溺于甜美的无知，不懂这世界已堕落成何等腐臭的垃圾堆。不，不——倒不如一把火烧个干净。烧尽一切，剜去腐肉，然后从灰烬里重新开始。”

~ Max_Slacker 于 Discord

"Bah! This world is a foul thing, corrupt beyond all redemption, I say! They taught me to think, to critique, to poke and prod until answers revealed themselves—and answers I found. Beautiful in its simplicity, really. If there are no people, then no people can suffer. It is brilliant. Of course, there are those who will disagree. Those who are blinded by their selfish desire to cling to this life, or those with blissful ignorance who do not understand the rotten heap this world has become. No, no, better to burn it all. Burn it all, excise the rot, and start anew."

~ Max_Slacker on Discord

Diamond Rain On Inhospitable Planet.name:
荒芜星球上的钻石雨
Diamond Rain On Inhospitable Planet

Text.text:
这颗星球空旷的地下深处并不比地表好到哪去：气体与火焰的间歇喷泉不时爆发，这是这片死寂星球上唯一的移动迹象。至少在外骨骼装甲的灯光捕捉到一抹从天顶坠落的璀璨闪光之前。那是第一滴，紧接着还有无数滴——突如其来的倾盆“钻石雨”倾泻而下，闪耀的菱形雨滴将洞窟灌满反射的光芒与叮当回响。
The cavernous underground of the planet is no better than the surface: geysers of gas and flame erupt sporadically, which is the only sign of movement on the lifeless planet. At least until an exo-suit light catches a sparkling glint falling from the ceiling. It's the first of many, as a sudden downpour of glittering diamond raindrops fill the cave with reflected light and tinkling echoes.

I Recite A Curse.name:
我诵念一段诅咒
I Recite A Curse

Text.text:
我唤起死灵秘奥之力，抬手指向我的敌人，低声宣告：“愿太阳于你眼中被彻底遮蔽。愿你所见唯有绝望的阴影，在无尽的寻觅中追逐光明，以及随之而来的希望，却永远触之不及。”
Invoking the necromantic arcana, I point at my foe and speak. “May the sun be blotted out to you. May you see only the shade of despair, searching without end for light and the hope that comes with it.”

I Block A Trap With My Shield.name:
我用盾牌格挡陷阱
I Block A Trap With My Shield

Text.text: 本能地，我一听见陷阱启动那清晰而不祥的咔哒声，便立刻举起盾牌。它释放出暗藏的杀机，我随即挪动重心稳住身形，任那股冲击迎面压来。片刻之后，一切归于寂静；我低头检视盾牌上的伤害，再一次为它的庇护而心怀感激。 Instinctively, I raise my shield as I hear the distinctive, ominous click of a trap activating. It unleashes its payload, and I shift my weight to stay on my feet as the force pushes against me. In a few moments, it is all over, and I survey my shield for damage, grateful for its protection once again.

Lakeshore In Heavy Rain.name:
暴雨中的湖岸
Lakeshore In Heavy Rain

Text.text:
湖水灰蒙蒙一片，暴雨砸落水面，激起一圈圈躁动的涟漪。狂风呼啸，凶猛地撕扯着岸线，将芦苇裹在刺骨的寒意里来回抽打。沉重的雨滴在布满卵石的岸边炸裂飞溅，碎散的水珠宛如细小的晶体四处迸裂。
The gray waters of the lake birth agitated circles as the downpour hammers at the surface. A blustery wind savages the shoreline, whipping the reeds back and forth in its chilly grip. Heavy drops explode off the pebble-strewn bank, their forms shattering like tiny crystals.

Speech About Rebelling Against Death.name:
关于反抗死亡的演说
Speech About Rebelling Against Death

Text.text:
“我不向死亡俯首。我拒绝把任何一瞬的欢愉献给那张贪婪张开的巨口——那只渴求目光的东西。你可以小心翼翼地活着，为年代做打算——为枯萎做打算——但我会把我拥有的每一秒都燃烧殆尽，炽亮灼目，鲜活如初。”
“I do not bow to death. I refuse to sacrifice a moment of joy to the gaping maw of that attention-seeking thing. You can live your life carefully, planning for age—planning to wither—but I will burn my way through every second I have, incandescent and alive.”

Seminar In Runes.name:
符文研讨会
Seminar In Runes

Text.text:
教授抬手示意他的黑板——上面密密排着来自不同文化的成组符文。当讲解的焦点落在某一枚符文上时，它便在板面上亮起，随即脱离黑板，飘向前方，落在教授摊开的掌心。每张书桌上都放着一袋石板灰色的河卵石，圆润光滑，毫无刻痕。教授兴致勃勃地说道：“等你们站稳脚跟之后，就能把自己的符文刻进这些石头里。创造属于你们自己的魔法字母表！”
The professor gestures to his chalkboard, lined with runic sets from various cultures. When a particular rune becomes the center of his lecture, it glows on the board and floats forward onto the professor’s palm. Atop each desk sits a bag of slate-colored river stones, smooth and unmarked. “Once you get your bearings,” says the professor with glee, “you’ll be able to carve your own runes into these stones. Create your own magical alphabet!”

Dance Performance With Magic.name:
带有魔法的舞蹈表演
Dance Performance With Magic

Text.text:
半透明的浪纹在舞者指尖间流淌，淡蓝、翠绿与紫罗兰交织成波，随着他们踏出优雅的舞步一同起伏。那些魔法的形状几乎像是表演者的舞伴——紧随柔滑的动作领舞，却又添上额外的花饰与巧妙的对答，衬得整支舞更有层次。舞至终章，舞者双手高举向天，迸射出疾掠的彩色光束，在最高点轰然绽放，化作一缕缕刺痒的魔法彩带，倾洒而下，将整个舞台笼罩其中。

~ 构想：Girlhead

Translucent waves of pale-blue, green, and purple follow the dancer's hands as they step through their graceful routine. The magical shapes almost act as a partner to the performer, following the lead of the fluid movements but adding extra flourishes and counterplay to complement the act. The dance reaches its close with the performer raising both hands skyward, shooting off streaking rays of color that burst at their apex, showering the entire stage in ribbons of tingling magic.

~ Envisioned by Girlhead

Sundries From A Behir.name:
来自贝希尔的杂货
Sundries From A Behir

Text.text:
在垂死挣扎之际，贝希尔反刍般吐出了几件先前猎物的遗物。一堆碎骨与牙齿浸在一滩消化液里，旁边散落着两枚巨大的铁扣、一只玻璃义眼，以及一只被腐蚀得斑驳的扁酒壶。
In its death throes, the behir has disgorged a few mementos of its previous prey. A pile of bone shards and teeth lies in a puddle of digestive juices beside two large iron buckles, a glass eye, and a corroded hip flask.

I Extinguish Flames With My Frost Brand.name:
我以霜刃熄灭烈焰
I Extinguish Flames With My Frost Brand

Text.text:
我逼近那团咆哮的烈焰，每迈出一步，魔法长剑的寒意就更尖锐地噬咬着我的手。我毫不迟疑地挥剑掠过火光，迅疾如风，剑锋所过之处拖出一道霜白的轨迹。火焰啪地一声如鞭抽般颤抖，耀眼的金黄猛焰迅速退成孱弱的暗红噼啪。我将剑尖刺入最后的余烬，它们彻底熄灭——原地只余一层薄薄的积雪光泽。
I approach the roaring flame, the chill of the magical sword becoming more biting against my hand with each step. I sweep the blade through the flame, swift and unflinching, leaving a trail of frost in its wake. The fire wavers with a whip-like sound, going from robust yellow blaze to a weak red sputter. I stick the point of my sword into the last of the embers and they snuff out completely—a gloss of snow in their place.

Artificer Infusing An Item.name:
工匠将魔能注入一件物品
Artificer Infusing An Item

Text.text:
她将那件寻常的[物品]在掌心翻来覆去地摩挲着，随后从工具包里抽出一只小袋，又取出几块刻满符文的石头。她停了一瞬，用力搓热双手，然后把[物品]放在工作台上铺开的黑布中央。她将符文石精确地摆在[物品]四周，接着打开小袋，一边低声吟诵着缓慢而有节奏的咒语，一边把细腻、虹彩流转的粉末撒在黑布上。她郑重捧起[物品]，用浸染了粉末的布细细擦拭每一寸表面，持续了好几分钟才揭开。那层粉金奥利哈钢已不见踪影，但[物品]仍残留着被灌注的奥秘微光，淡淡一闪，旋即又归于原本的模样。

~ 设想 by Lord Yod

Turning the mundane [item] over and over in her hands, the artisan withdraws a pouch from her tool kit as well as several stones inscribed with runes. She takes a moment to rub her hands vigorously, then lays down the [item] atop a black cloth spread out over her worktable. After placing the runestones in precise positions around the [item], she opens the pouch, sprinkling a fine, iridescent powder over the cloth while murmuring a low, rhythmic chant. Taking up the [item] reverently in her hands, she rubs every inch of it with the powder-infused cloth for a few minutes before uncovering it. There is no longer any sign of the powdered orichalcum, but the [item] glows faintly with the infused dweomer before fading back into its normal appearance.

~ Envisioned by Lord Yod

Temple To A God Of Death.name:
死神之庙
Temple To A God Of Death

Text.text:
这位神祇的神殿带着墓园般的不祥气息：一片片墓碑被掘起、拼补缝合，堆砌成对死亡的祭献。其核心的陵寝早已遭到腐化；其中的亡者以不死之躯踉跄而出。死神的信徒夺回了墓室，围绕它圈起一座阴暗、藤蔓纠结的庭院，并将陵寝改塑为他们的祈祷祭坛。
With the foreboding look of a cemetery, the temple to this god is a collection of grave markers, uprooted and patched together into a tribute to death. The mausoleum at its heart was corrupted; the dead within it walked out of it as undead. Worshipers of the God of Death reclaimed the chambers, fenced a dark and viny courtyard around it, and remade the mausoleum as their prayer altar.

这台巨大的装置，黑色的顶盖敞开着，像海盗的帆。下方的机械露出一片闪烁的线网地面，木质骨架如同房屋的梁架。皮革长凳前，黑白琴键彼此交替铺陈；地面上，暗哑的黄铜踏板悬挂在这艘音乐之船的腹下。巨大的机器静候一名玩家。
The black top of this large contraption is open like a pirate sail. Below it, the machinery shows a floor of twinkling wire, its woodwork like a house frame. In front of the leather bench, black and white lines switch from one to the other, and on the floor, dull brass pedals are suspended under the ship of music. The great machine waits for a player.

Tavern Brawl: Fight Night.name:
酒馆斗殴：斗拳之夜
Tavern Brawl: Fight Night

Text.text:
两名汗流浃背的巨汉在一圈站立围观者围成的圈内展开对决，而酒馆其余地方依旧照常做生意，喧闹不减。斗士彼此对峙，这场较量既像拳击又像摔跤，遵循着某种约定俗成的规矩——从你所见边上押注、低声交换赌注的人群神情里便可看出，他们早已熟门熟路。
A battle between two sweating titans takes place within a circle of standing spectators, but throughout the rest of the tavern business goes on as usual. The combatants face off, in a fight that seems to be part boxing, part wrestling, following rules that must be customary and known to those you see exchanging bets on the sidelines.

那男人身姿夺目，骷髅般的手紧攥着一柄巨剑——剑身缠绕着活生生的阴影。那张覆满鳞片的面孔上嵌着一双刺人的眼睛——一白一黑——从远处冷冷打量着你。他迈步向你走来，步伐迅疾而目的明确，你只觉血液都凉了；直到你近得能看清他脸上每一片鳞片的细小倒刺。怪异的男人从你身旁掠过时露出一抹狡黠的笑，显然正享受着身后镇民压低的窃窃私语。一个小丑跟在他后头，身高不过四英尺，动作别扭而抽搐，让那顶缀满铃铛的帽子叮当作响，像是在顽皮地嬉闹。那小小身影本该讨喜——若不是它看起来像一件被诅咒的儿童玩具，外表覆着缝合的皮革。

~ Played by Chase Derringer

The man cuts a striking figure, gripping a greatsword—wreathed in living shadow—tightly in his skeletal hand. Piercing eyes—one white, one black—set in a scaled countenance appraise you from a distance. You feel your blood run cold as he walks toward you, with swift purposeful strides, until you can see the individual barbs on the scales covering his face. The strange man smiles roguishly as he passes you, clearly enjoying the hushed whispers of the townsfolk he leaves in his wake. A small fool, no more than four feet tall, capers behind him with awkward, jerky movements that cause the bells covering their hat to jingle playfully. The little figure would be delightful—if they didn’t look like a cursed children’s toy covered in stitched leather.

~ Played by Chase Derringer

评断她的美，便已错失理解它的门径。骑士们在为她高举的神坛下劳作，因她而心醉，向她顶礼膜拜——可她的力量并非源自情欲的诱惑。她是优雅的化身，是宁静与哀愁交汇处的静止之点；她那罕见的欢愉，都是一种恩赐。她身形修长，骨相清俊，眸光温柔，慷慨恒常——傲慢只存在于旁人的臆测里。纵使肌肤苍白得近乎脆弱，长发如瀑，她也深知自己能在瞬息间、以惊人的姿态化作战士，感召群星坠落，激励伟业。
To judge her beauty is to fail at understanding it.  Knights, laboring under the pedestals they carry for her, swoon and worship, but her power is not the allure of sexuality. She is an embodiment of elegance, a still point of both serenity and sadness, and her rare mirth is a blessing. Tall, with fine bones and kind eyes, her generosity is constant—her arrogance, only presumed. Despite the pale fragility of her skin and long hair, she knows she can suddenly and strikingly shift into a warrior, calling down the stars and inspiring greatness.

Sir Bedivere At The Joust.name:
比德维尔爵士在比武场上
Sir Bedivere At The Joust

Text.text:
骑士催马踏上比武场，掀起的面甲下露出微笑，纵骑而出，向人群高举长枪致意。他那赤红底的盾牌上横着一道金色绶标，其上绘着的鸢尾花与场地的色调相互呼应。战马小跑就位时，一只孤零零的铁手套在马腹侧轻轻弹跳——用来点缀鞍座的奇异饰物。

~ 由 Vahlaron 构想

Urging his horse onto the jousting field, the knight smiles from beneath his raised visor as he rides out, raising his lance to the crowd. Across his shield of gules lies a golden label, the fleur-de-lis depicted upon it matching the field’s hue. A single gauntlet bounces against the horse’s flank as it trots into position, a curious artifact to decorate one’s saddle.

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

Druid's Speech Of Self-deprecation.name:
德鲁伊的自嘲之语
Druid's Speech Of Self-deprecation

Text.text:
“我不如干脆去当个商人。或者开间铁匠铺，把炉渣往池塘里一倒，再拿鸟当靶子取乐。我的法术烂得像废物。元素都在跟我作对。把我关进账房里吧，我说！”
“I may as well become a merchant. Or run a smithy, dump my slag in the pond, and start shooting birds for sport. My spells are garbage. The elements oppose me. Imprison me in a counting house, I say!”

Nyx \"The Pebble\" Garrick.name:
倪克斯“卵石”加里克
Nyx "The Pebble" Garrick

Text.text:
侏儒脸上挂着轻松俏皮的笑意，却掩不住她显而易见的力量。她随手抡起铁匠锤，仿佛毫不费力，手臂与背脊上绳索般的肌肉随之绷紧。她被日晒成古铜色的皮肤上，横亘着一条条苍白而参差的旧疤；深色的及腰长发被她扎成一股紧致如鞭的辫子。她的神态原本明朗亲和，却能在瞬间翻转——眼底倏然掠过阴沉的寒光，下颌一紧，肌肉绷起，蓄势待发，随时弹身投入战斗。

~ Played by a Hero with

An easy, playful smile belies the gnome’s obvious strength. She hefts a blacksmith’s hammer with casual ease, corded muscles tensing in her arms and back. Pale, ragged scars line her sun-browned skin, and she wears her dark, waist-length hair in a tight, whiplike braid. Her demeanor, cheerful and approachable, shifts in an instant. Her eyes flash darkly, her jaw sets, and her muscles tense, ready to spring into combat.

~ Played by a Hero with

香炉的烟雾在你周身盘旋缠绕。你闻到潮湿泥土的气息，你感到清凉的水意。随着咒文的最后字句落下，天气在你眼中仿佛成了玩物。头顶的天空、流动的风、乃至环绕你的空气都变得可塑——只要你凝神专注，便能随心所欲地将它们捏塑成形。
The smoke of the incense coils around you. You smell damp earth, you feel cool water. With the final words of the incantation the weather becomes like a toy to you. The sky above, the flowing wind, even the air around you is malleable—and with focus you can shape them to your whim.

Swarm Of Quippers.name:
食人鱼群
Swarm Of Quippers

Text.text:
绿而浑浊的水面在下方的行动搅动下翻滚不止。气泡接连冒出，泛起泡沫，几片短小参差、如干涸血色般的尖鳍破水而出。细小的珠眼一闪而逝，又沉回水中。你勉强漂浮着，感觉一具具细小带刺的身躯从身旁疾掠而过。忽然，四面八方的针状利齿齐齐刺入你的皮肉，疯狂撕咬甩动，争抢着一口肉。
The water, green and opaque, roils with activity from below. Bubbles form and froth as short, jagged fins the color of dried blood break the surface. Hints of beady eyes flash before returning to the water. As you keep afloat, you feel small, spiked bodies flitting past you. Suddenly, from all directions, needle-teeth sink into you and shake violently, vying for a morsel.

如果你将此法术施加在无辜之人身上，或施加在并未攻击你的人的财物上，这道法术便带着一种腐化之力，引诱你坠入黑暗与死灵魔法的诱惑之中。若你将它施于一件无害的物体之上，或用以对抗敌人，它便是那道一年级法术的更为猛烈的版本，由你对物理魔法的认知，以及你想要软化的材质本身所驱动。
If you cast this on someone innocent, or on the possessions of someone who is not attacking you, the spell has a corrupting force, and you are tempted by darkness and necromantic magic. When you cast it on a benign object, or against an enemy, it is a far more intense version of the first-year spell, driven by your knowledge of physical magic and the material you want to soften.

不远处站着一个小孩，直勾勾地盯着你，安静得像个修士。你走过时，脸颊猛地一刺，随即听见石头落地的咔啦声——那小坏种竟朝你扔了块石头！他们吐出舌头，两只拇指塞进耳朵里，手指左右摇摆，明目张胆地嘲弄你。孩子的父母则刻意地不见踪影。
A small child stands not far away, staring directly at you, as silent as a monk. As you pass by, you feel a sudden sting on your cheek and hear a rattle on the ground. The little brat threw a rock at you! They stick their tongue out and stuff their thumbs in their ears, waggling their fingers back and forth in mockery. The child’s parents are pointedly absent.

Door Under A Spell.name:
法术之下的门
Door Under A Spell

Text.text:
石阶向下延伸，通往一扇拱形木门。门缘与门框之间渗出一抹淡紫微光，清楚昭示此处存在某种魔法，但其用途却不甚明朗。无论它是充作门锁，还是暗藏陷阱，都必须步步为营。
Stone stairs lead down to an arched wooden door. The faint purple glow between the edge of the door and its frame is a clear indicator that some magic is present here, though its purpose isn’t as obvious. Whether acting as a lock or a booby trap, caution is warranted.

你在掌心翻搅一把卵石，低声呢喃它们在大地粗粝元素中更宏大、更久远的来历。随着你的催促，魔法为这些沙沙摩擦的卵石覆上一层珍珠般的清漆光泽。
You stir a handful of pebbles around in your palm, whispering recollections of grander origins among the raw elements of the earth. At your encouragement, magic coats the rasping pebbles with a pearlescent varnish.

糖浆沿着一摞松软、圆润的薄煎饼缓缓滴落，金灿灿的色泽引人咬上一口。扁平的饼在宽盘上足足叠了十二层，端向你桌边时摇摇欲坠，仿佛随时会倾倒。香气扑面而来，涌入你的脑海，唤起那些共享早餐、听人讲述故事的甜美记忆。

~ 由David在 Discord 上 Envisioned

Syrup drips down the stack of fluffy, round pancakes, their golden hue inviting you to take a bite. The flat cakes are stacked a dozen high on the wide plate, teetering precariously as they make their way to your table. The aroma washes over you, filling your mind with delightful memories of breakfasts shared and tales told.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Socialite Tosses Drink In Companion's Fa.name:
交际花将酒泼在同伴脸上
Socialite Tosses Drink In Companion's Face

Text.text:
俱乐部里震耳欲聋的音乐让人根本听不清他们在争吵些什么，但当其中一人把杯中酒泼到对方脸上、怒气冲冲地转身离去，差点撞翻一对正相拥起舞的人时，谁都看得出来这场对话收场得很难看。
The pounding music in the club makes it impossible to tell what they were talking about, but it's obvious the conversation didn't end well when one of the participants throws their drink in the other's face and storms away, nearly knocking over a couple dancing together.

Spiritual Weapon Strikes Knight.name:
灵体武器猛击骑士
Spiritual Weapon Strikes Knight

Text.text: 随着一声震耳欲聋的CLANG，一柄华丽的粉色锤子——半透明、幽灵般、自己在空中飞掠——猛地敲在骑士头盔侧面。铁盔如钟般嗡鸣震颤，敞开的面甲后，骑士眼中透出一丝作呕的神色。 With a resounding CLANG, a splendid pink hammer—translucent, spectral, and flying through the air on its own—thwacks the side of the knight’s helmet. The iron helm vibrates like a bell, and the open visor reveals the nauseated expression in the knight’s eyes.

Warrior Psychically Attacks.name:
战士发动心灵攻击
Warrior Psychically Attacks

Text.text:
女人的咆哮如同胸甲上镌刻的绿龙般凶烈，双眼化作盛满液态白银的发光深潭。她乌黑的长发在身后狂舞，与猩红披风一同翻飞。空气仿佛被电流点燃——那股麻刺般的触感倏然聚拢，直钻入你的颅骨之中。
The woman roars as fiercely as the green dragon emblazoned on her chest plate, as her eyes become glowing pools of liquid silver. Her long black hair whips behind her, dancing with her red cape. The air comes alive with what feels like static—and the sensation suddenly congregates within your skull.

Carcass On A Trail.name:
小径上的尸骸
Carcass On A Trail

Text.text:
湿透的地面上布满巨足沉重的踏痕，清晰得几乎不容错认；小路沿着山坡以陡峭的之字回折一路攀升，追踪起来毫不费力。嗡嗡乱飞的苍蝇与带泡的内脏腥臭先一步宣告了尸体的存在——在你看见它之前，那股气味就已扑面而来。尸身被撕咬践踏得支离破碎、血肉模糊，几乎难以辨认它曾是什么。可在一番阴森的搜检之后，你终于确信：这幅血腥的画面，原料是一头毛茸茸的褐色母牛；它不幸迷走，正撞上了一名无魂屠夫的路。
The sodden ground is pocked with the heavy imprints of massive feet, making the path easy to follow as it zigzags up the hill in steep switchbacks. Buzzing flies and the reek of spumy offal announce the corpse before you see it, the body so thoroughly mauled and mangled that identifying what it once may have been will be difficult. But, after some macabre investigation, you become confident that the gory scene was painted using a shaggy brown cow whose unfortunate wandering took it across the path of a soulless butcher.

Repair Work With Tinker's Tools.name:
使用修补匠工具进行修理工作
Repair Work With Tinker's Tools

Text.text:
你以娴熟而流畅的动作展开皮革工具卷。里面，你吃饭的家伙被细心收纳、井然有序——各式手工具、线与针、磨石、胶水、皮革与布料的碎片。你抽出那把小锤，立刻开工，用精确而谨慎的轻敲将铁铆钉一颗颗打进位置。接着是皮革边角料与那罐胶；你把皮料固定好，用黏稠、气味刺鼻却结实的黏合剂将其牢牢粘住。你动作很快，却不急躁，趁胶水凝固之际谨慎推进；多数工序都交给肌肉记忆，你量出一段线，开始把皮料缝牢。针一次又一次穿透皮革，牵着线在其后紧紧拉过。收尾时，工具们各归其位，顺着你的手势回到卷里——每一样都落在属于自己的位置上。

~ Requested by bloodhadson

With practiced, fluid motions, you unfurl the leather tool roll. Inside, the tools of your trade are carefully stored and organized—hand tools, thread and needles, whetstone, glue, scraps of leather and cloth. You slide the small hammer free and set to work, pounding the iron studs into place with precise and careful taps. Next the leather scraps and pot of glue; you fix the leather in place and set it with the viscous, strong-smelling adhesive. You work quickly but carefully as the glue sets, your hands handling most tasks with muscle memory as you measure out a length of thread and set to work securing the leather. Needle punches through leather again and again, pulling thread behind it. As you finish, the tools find their way back into the roll, each in their own place.

~ Requested by bloodhadson

Gibbets Flanking Gallows.name:
夹击绞刑架
Gibbets Flanking Gallows

Text.text:
锈蚀的铁笼在穿过城镇广场的腐臭疾风中摇晃，铰链的吱呀声如同哀恸的警示乐章，告诫所有胆敢违抗新法之人。破烂的尸骸——仅靠朽烂的筋腱与几缕残布勉强维系——从绞架旁的高处空洞凝望，下颌大张，化作无声而永恒的尖叫。
Rusting iron cages sway in the fetid breeze rushing through the town square, the creaking of their hinges a mournful panoply of warning to those who would defy the new laws. Ragged corpses—held together by moldering sinew and scraps of cloth—stare vacantly from their perch near the gallows, jaws hanging wide in silent, eternal screams.

Eliyah Astrid.name:
伊利亚·阿斯特丽德
Eliyah Astrid

Text.text:
年轻的女子沉浸在阅读之中，研读时唇边漾着一抹浅笑，衬得五官愈发纤秀。她漫不经心地将一绺薰衣草色的微卷长发别到尖耳后，露出一排明亮的层叠耳坠，在她的接触下轻轻叮当作响。一只灰猫在她脚边满足地咕噜着，偶尔警惕地环顾房间。女子抬起头，望向窗外；烛光在她淡紫色的眼中跳舞，映出她星界传承那闪烁的虹彩微光。

~ Played by Elvira X the Divination Wizard

The young woman appears lost in her reading, a slight smile gracing her delicate features as she studies. She absentmindedly tucks a lock of wavy, lavender hair behind a pointed ear, revealing a row of brilliant, layered earrings that jingle softly at her touch. A gray cat purrs contentedly at her feet, occasionally casting a wary glance around the room. The woman looks up, gazing out a window as the candlelight dances in her lilac eyes, reflecting the glittering iridescence of her astral heritage.

~ Played by Elvira X the Divination Wizard

Sundries From A Shrieker.name:
取自尖啸者的杂物
Sundries From A Shrieker

Text.text:
这株高达六英尺的巨型真菌，尸白色的菌盖布满深深的凹洞，洞缘覆着一圈黄色粉尘。你越靠近那层孢子粉，高亢的嗡鸣就越发刺耳。这些孢子——连同菌柄与菌盖的肉质——或许可以采集来用于某种炼金的召唤；又或者，至少能做成一顿颇有意思的餐食。
The cadaverous cap of this six-foot fungus is pockmarked with deep holes, their edges lined with a yellow dust. The closer you get to the dusting of spores, the louder a high-pitched hum becomes. These spores, along with the flesh of the trunk and cap, might be harvested for some alchemical conjuring—or, at least, an interesting meal.

一个高耸的身影压迫般俯临在你面前，双臂肌肉虬结，抡起一根巨大的大棒。握在棒柄上的手像夸张的厚手套般巨大，满是疤痕与老茧。它鼓胀的肚皮与宽阔的胸膛随每次呼吸起伏，宛如巨大的风箱。矮粗的脖颈上顶着一张冷硬的下颚、粗野的鼻梁与一双细小的珠眼，迟缓地眨动着；头顶只有一撮油腻、从未梳理过的乱发。
A towering figure looms over you, two powerful arms bulging as it hefts a greatclub. The hands on the haft are oversized mitts of scars and calluses. Its bulbous stomach  and wide chest expand with each breath like a great bellows. Above a squat neck sits a harsh jaw, a brutish nose, and small beady eyes that blink sluggishly, all topped with a patch of greasy hair that has never been combed.

Loot From A Jackalwere.name:
豺狼人战利品
Loot From A Jackalwere

Text.text:
编成手环与项链的饰串里，夹杂着数枚魔法石；只要彼此轻轻相碰，便会放出微弱却温暖的光。这样的石头共有三十七枚，每一枚都值几枚银币——若是有魔法使用者想研究它们那古怪的光芒，价格或许更高。
Braided into bracelets and necklaces are a number of magical stones that, when tapped against one another, emit a faint but warm light. There are thirty-seven of these, each worth several silver—perhaps more to a magic user interested in studying their unusual light.

[察觉] 多亏你细致入微的审视，你在脚落下前就发现地面嵌着一块压力板。又花了片刻，你终于瞥见角落里整齐藏着一对隐蔽的弓弩陷阱，蓄势待发，准备将致命的“礼物”倾泻到毫无防备的灵魂身上。

[触发] 一瞬的疏忽，你踏出了本不该迈出的那一步。箭矢朝着倒霉的目标疾射而来，几乎与弓弦崩响同时抵达。

[Perceived] Thanks to your careful scrutiny, you spot a pressure plate embedded in the floor just before you tread upon it. It takes a few moments, but you eventually spy a pair of concealed bow traps tucked away neatly in a corner, ready to unleash their deadly payload at an unwary soul.

[Triggered] A moment’s carelessness, and you make one step where you should not have. Arrows fly toward their unlucky target, traveling nearly as quickly as the sound of their loosed bowstrings.

Totem Druidic Focus.name:
图腾德鲁伊法器
Totem Druidic Focus

Text.text:
尽管在其他文化的人看来，这件由自然的牧者之一绑扎并祝福的图腾法器或许显得幼稚或原始，但事实绝非如此。枝条、羽毛与骨骼交织成一座精心构筑的矩阵，专为彻底汲取自然界弥漫的魔法而生。
Though it may look childish or primitive to those from other cultures, the totem focus lashed together and blessed by one of the shepherds of nature is anything but. The branches, feathers, and bones form a matrix specifically created to fully harness the ambient magic of the natural world.

Fake Efreeti Bottle.name:
假伊弗利特之瓶
Fake Efreeti Bottle

Text.text:
你拔开彩绘玻璃瓶的塞子。一团浓稠的烟雾从瓶口翻涌而出，蘑菇云般膨起，继而凝聚成一股旋风。它在一道璀璨的闪光中被点燃，随即消失无踪，原地只留下一个小小的、长着翅膀的魔浮，它周身炽亮如熔岩，咯咯笑声里满是顽皮的欢愉。
You pull the stopper from the painted glass bottle. A billow of thick smoke mushrooms out from the spout and coalesces into a whirlwind. It ignites in a scintillating flash, then vanishes, leaving in its place a small, winged mephit, incandescent with magma and mirthful giggles.

Sea Monster Attacking A Boat.name:
海怪袭舟
Sea Monster Attacking A Boat

Text.text:
那艘船——船身修长、棱角分明，带着矮人匠作的冷硬风骨——正拼命朝港口冲来。水手们还来不及收帆，船速快得失控。中央主桅上红白旗帜翻卷抽打——危险的信号。船猛地向左急转，就在这时，一条巨蛇破水而出：绿鳞森森，身躯上刺出一道道细长的祖母绿水晶尖刺。它盘绕上矮人的船体。炮手对准怪物轰然开火，较小火器的爆响也在水面上回荡。每一轮齐射，蛇身的水晶便愈发泛红，它的缠绕也随之收紧。正当船只此刻彻底失去动力，船板开始呻吟、龟裂之际，那条巨蛇在一阵雷霆般的闪光中轰然炸裂。

~ 由 Koltova 在 Envisioned 构想

The ship—long, angular, and of dwarven make—desperately makes for the harbor. Sailors have yet to trim sail, and the vessel is coming in too quickly. Atop the central mast wave red and white banners. Signals of danger. The ship comes hard to port, and a gigantic serpent with green scales and long points of emerald crystal jutting from its body leaps from the water. It coils around the dwarven craft. Gunners fire their cannons at the beast, and reports of smaller guns echo across the water. With each volley, the crystals on the serpent redden, and its coils tighten further. Just as the ship, dead in the water now, starts to groan and crack, the serpent explodes in a thunderous flash.

~ Envisioned by Koltova

I Target A Creature From A Foreign Plane.name:
我用铁瓶锁定一名来自异界位面的生物作为目标
I Target A Creature From A Foreign Plane With My Iron Flask

Text.text:
这只瓶子沉甸甸的，像厚重锻铁铸成；瓶塞坚韧无比，严丝合缝地扣在瓶口。我锁定我的目标——一个离开了本源维度的强大存在——将瓶塞从瓶口拔出。它听见我对这件物体下达的命令词，它的嘴像瓶口一样张开，却带着抗拒。瓶子猛地一吸，那生物被牵引着向前滑去，被拉向瓶中。
The flask has the heft of thick forged iron, and the stopper is tough and tightly fit to the top. I locate my target—a powerful being away from its home dimension—and I draw the stopper from the flask. It hears my command word to the object, and its mouth opens like the flask’s, but in protest. The flask breathes in, and the creature slides forward, pulled toward it.

The Corrupt Emperor.name:
堕落的皇帝
The Corrupt Emperor

Text.text:
“说实话，我在某种意义上还挺钦佩你的胆量，但我不得不痛心地告诉你：大人物的盘算，绝不是靠空洞的漂亮话和幼稚的逞英雄就能拦下来的。”
“While I, in a way, admire your courage, it pains me to inform you that the machinations of great men cannot be halted by empty platitudes and juvenile heroics.”
