双眼如他那身光滑的黑毛般熠熠生辉，身形敏捷的猫族盗贼贪婪地盯着他的战利品：一枚体型与他拳头相仿的宝石。寒风轻拂过他的胡须，惹得它们微微颤动；他随即回头，越过肩头俯瞰下方的街道。盗贼紧贴在一栋奢华得近乎刺眼的联排宅邸外墙上——檐下的黑暗将他彻底吞没、无影无形——他伸出带爪的手指，在窗上利落地划出一个圆孔，嘴角勾起一抹讥诮的笑意，随即将爪掌探入开口，拨动插销，轻轻一挑解开窗闩。

~ Pepijn on Discord

Eyes shining like his sleek, black fur, the lithe catfolk rogue stares hungrily at his prize: a gemstone the size of his fist. A chill wind brushes softly against his whiskers, causing them to twitch as he turns to look over his shoulder, surveying the street below. Clinging to the facade of a garishly opulent townhouse—invisible in the darkness of the eaves—the rogue extends a clawed finger and slices a circle in the window, smirking as he slips a paw through the opening and unlocks the latch.

~ Pepijn on Discord

Bearded Devil With Spear.name:
持矛胡须魔
Bearded Devil With Spear

Text.text:
那生物皮肤斑驳，踏着两条山羊般的腿站立。它下巴上长出一绺长须，尽是阴狠的倒刺，仿佛在蠕动。生物用长着利爪的双手紧攥一杆凶险的长矛，钢铁黑得如黑曜石般泛光。它每一次呼吸，都会吐出缕缕烟雾。
The fiendish creature with mottled skin stands on two goat-like legs. From its chin grows a beard of long, wicked barbs that seem to writhe. The creature clutches a deadly-looking spear in its clawed hands, the steel shining black like obsidian. Smoke issues forth as it breathes.

地面吞没了曾经矗立于此的大半建筑，被时代与荒废拖拽着坠入泥土深处。废墟倾斜的入口处，一道石砌门洞大张着口，门框危险地向一侧歪斜，像个踉跄的醉汉。门后空间里，一座荒草丛生的大厅敞向天空，遍地散落着早已坍塌的天花板碎石瓦砾。
The ground has swallowed much of the structure that once stood here, dragged down into the earth by time and neglect. A stone doorway yawns wide in the tilted entrance to the ruins, its frame listing dangerously to one side like a drunkard. In the space beyond, an overgrown hall stands open to the sky, littered with the rubble of a ceiling that collapsed long ago.

Spartan Cyberwarrior's Apartment.name:
斯巴达赛博战士的公寓
Spartan Cyberwarrior's Apartment

Text.text:
在这间洁白无瑕的公寓里，极简与克制统治着一切。利落的线条与极简主义的设计笼罩着起居空间，仿佛一颗自律之心的外化。最前沿的科技设备充满房间，被精心分门别类、以最佳位置摆放；空气里隐约回荡着高性能装置阵列的低沉嗡鸣，像电力在静默中呼吸。角落里立着一座微型健身房——仅一台机器，却搭载最先进的虚拟现实程序——专为考验使用者的体能与心智而造。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Within this pristine white apartment, austerity reigns supreme. Clean lines and a minimalistic design dominate the living space, manifestations of a disciplined mind. Cutting-edge tech fills the room, meticulously organized and optimally placed, and the air holds a faint hum of power from an array of high-performance devices. A micro-gymnasium stands in one corner—a single machine equipped with state-of-the-art virtual reality programs—built to test the user's physical and mental aptitude.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Shield Of Faith Cast On Me.name:
把信仰之盾施放在我身上
Shield Of Faith Cast On Me

Text.text:
不远处，战斗的纷乱之中，一段温柔的守护祈祷念出了我的名字。刹那间，来自彼岸的注目落在我身上；伴随着竖琴弦被拨响的清越一声，一片金色光域骤然绽现。它很快黯淡下去，却仍在我周身流光微颤。

~ 由一位英雄 想象

Nearby, amid the turmoil of battle, a gentle prayer for protection contains my name. Briefly, attention falls on me from beyond, and, with the sound of a struck harp string, a field of golden light bursts into being. It dims quickly, but continues to shimmer all around me.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Dead Person Floating In Space Suit.name:
漂浮在空间服里的死人
Dead Person Floating In Space Suit

Text.text:
原本看似碎片的东西，如今已无可置疑地显出人形：一具身着橙色空间服的躯体——那橙色暴烈刺目，仿佛在流血的太阳。人影一动不动，服装上没有任何灯光亮起，四肢以不可能的角度摊开扭折。待面罩正面映入眼帘，你瞥见一张扭曲的面容，牙关紧咬成狰狞的冷笑，死得不容置疑。
What appeared to be debris is now most definitely a humanoid figure in an orange space suit—violent orange, like a bleeding sun. The figure is not moving, there are no lights aglow on the suit, and limbs are splayed out at impossible angles. As the front of the visor comes into view you glimpse a twisted visage in a tight-jawed grimace, undeniably dead.

施放法术时，一股冰寒刺骨、如啃噬般的冷意随之而来。你手中的水晶球冷得惊人，接触之下寒意直透骨髓。你强忍不适，念完咒文，随即潇洒一挥，掷出一枚由至纯寒能凝成的冰冷法球。
A frigid, gnawing chill accompanies the casting of the spell. The crystal sphere in your hands is ice-cold to the touch. You push past the discomfort, completing the incantation, and with a flourish, hurl an orb of purest cold energy.

侏儒在一种仿佛被他们占有的寂静里倾听。一副部族面具遮住了他们的脸，但装束却无声地诉说着一切：一枚细长、发黄的爪子垂落，轻触他们的锁骨；一根洁净如新的黑羽从头饰上方探出；涂抹成带的朱砂粉黏在结实的手臂上；而一串串小巧的木制护符——多半是动物——标示着陪伴这名异乡人的诸灵。尽管衣物与行囊零碎繁多，你却没瞧见任何武器。但当三枚相扣三角的纹线在其间的空间里骤然炽亮，你不禁重新掂量：这侏儒当真手无寸铁吗。

~ 由 Kanto 扮演

The gnome listens in a silence they seem to own. A tribal mask hides their face, but their attire speaks volumes: a long, yellowed claw touches their collarbone; a pristine black feather pokes above their headdress; bands of powdered cinnabar cake muscular arms; and a variety of small, wooden talismans—animals, mostly—signify the spirits that accompany this outlander. Despite all the bits of dress and kit, you spy no weapon. But when the lines of three interlocked triangles flare in the intervening space, you think twice about whether this gnome is unarmed.

~ Played by Kanto

墓穴入口宽阔得足以昭示其中安葬的尸骸非同寻常。拱形穹顶由至少三十英尺高的巨柱支撑，更印证了这一点。四角各有火把摇曳，火光在坍圮的墙面上投下舞动的阴影。北墙旁立着一座华丽的石祭坛，台面上摊开着一本厚重巨书；而在房间中央，无头骑士正端坐其间。他背脊笔直，一手松松握着缰绳，另一手擎着战斧，稳稳坐在梦魇战马的鞍上。

~ 由 Alicia 构想

The tomb’s entrance is large enough to indicate a corpse of some importance. Its arched ceiling, supported by pillars at least thirty feet tall, confirms this. Torchlight flickers in each corner, casting dancing shadows against the crumbling walls. Along the northern wall stands an ornate stone altar, a large book open on its surface, and in the center of the room is the headless horseman. He sits, back straight, one hand relaxed on the reins, one holding an axe, in the saddle of his nightmare steed.

~ Envisioned by Alicia

Aarakocra With Leather Harness.name:
身披皮革挽具的阿拉科克拉
Aarakocra With Leather Harness

Text.text:
鸟人的羽毛油亮生辉，深邃如缟玛瑙，在阳光的注视下每一根翎羽都闪烁着夺目的光泽。翼尖微微一挑，便露出如古老符文般繁复的螺旋纹路，微光流转，隐隐透出奥秘的气息。一副轻便的皮革挽具贴身系着细巧的工具：匕首与一筒飞镖，皆是为适应空中战斗而备的臂具与护甲。
The bird man's feathers are lustrous, a deep onyx, each plume glinting with splendor beneath the sun's gaze. Tipping of its wings reveals intricate spirals akin to ancient glyphs, shimmering, hinting at the arcane. A lightweight leather harness cradles slender tools: shivs and a quiver of darts, arms and armor fit for aerial combat.

My Shield +3 Deflects An Arrow.name:
我的盾牌+3偏转了一支箭
My Shield +3 Deflects An Arrow

Text.text:
数百支箭矢在这面盾牌漫长而传奇的岁月里撞得粉碎，而这一支也不例外。箭头猛然撞上我盾面的刹那，迸裂出炫目的磷光般辉芒，随即被风吹散——只余缕缕青烟与灰烬。
Hundreds of arrows have shattered against this shield over its long and storied history and this one is no different. As the arrowhead collides with the face of my shield it erupts with stunning, phosphorescent light, then scatters in the wind—only smoke and ashes.

你还没看见盛宴，先已闻到它——醉人馥郁的气味交织翻涌。那顿餐食横铺在一张巨大的长餐桌上，从边到边、从头到尾铺陈开来，像在无声地招手，引你靠近。撒着片状海盐、点缀新鲜香草的烤肉盘上腾起芬芳热汽。鸡蛋——煎的、蒸的、炒的，以及介于其间的种种做法——在摇曳烛光里泛着黄油般的丰润光泽。数十只器皿盛着各式酱汁与肉汁，仿佛来自世界不同角落的风味汇聚一处；而一堆刚出炉的面包高高占据餐桌中央。银盘空置，等着被盛宴的丰饶堆满：油亮的肉片覆在蛋上，蛋黄仍在缓缓流淌，旁边是炸土豆与烤番茄。

~ Envisioned by Clay

You smell the feast before you see it—an intoxicating mingling of scents. Sprawling the full width and length of a massive dining table, the meal beckons you forward. Fragrant steam rises from platters of roasted meat dusted with flaky salt and garnished with fresh herbs. Eggs—fried, steamed, scrambled, and everything in between—shine with a buttery richness in the flickering light of candles. Dozens of vessels contain a wide array of sauces and gravies, each derived from a different corner of the world, while a pile of fresh-baked breads dominates the center of the table. Silver plates sit empty, ready to be piled high with the feast’s bounty: greasy meat draped across eggs with running yolks, fried potatoes, and roasted tomatoes.

~ Envisioned by Clay

I Cast Mire The Mind.name:
我施放《泥沼侵心》
I Cast Mire The Mind

Text.text:
我用催眠般的声调说话，呼唤那些我想让其迟缓之人。我向左踏出一个精确的圆。我的步伐扭转他们对时代的感知，迫使那份察觉与现实错位。躯体必须追随被改写的心智。随着我的魔法生效，他们的动作变得迟滞，反应也被钝化。
Speaking in somniferous tones, I call to those I wish to slow. I walk a precise circle to the left. My steps transmute their sense of time, forcing that perception out of phase with reality. The body must follow the altered mind. As my magic takes hold, their movements become sluggish, their reflexes dulled.

Joust In Warmth Of Autumn.name:
秋日暖意中的马上比武
Joust In Warmth Of Autumn

Text.text:
脆裂的落叶地毯在战马横冲越过赛场时轰然炸散成粉末，它们闪耀的骑手在这出人意料的阳光下熠熠生辉。彩绘的亭棚间，旗幡轻轻摇曳——南来的微风柔软拂面。看台上散落着被丢弃的斗篷，人群的吼声如潮，为他们的勇士凯旋而沸腾。
The brittle carpet of leaves explodes into powder as the destriers power across the lists, their shining riders brilliant beneath the unexpected sun. From colorful pavilions, pennants gently dance—the southerly breeze soft with its caress. The stands are littered with discarded cloaks, and the crowd roars encouragement as their champions triumph.

在一个充斥着奥术、邪魔与武斗威胁的世界里，你却仍不由得被眼前这名存在的纯粹邪恶所攫住。连环杀手用一种仿佛在轻声回忆昨晚吃了什么的语气，漫不经心地讲述一桩又一桩骇人听闻的谋杀——全都出自他们之手，毫无悔意，也毫不费力。你发现自己必须强迫镇定，才敢与他们对视；因为在那层平静的表面之下，你的兽性直觉已嗅到一种深邃的、关乎存在本身的混沌正在其眼底翻涌，让你立刻想移开视线。此人杀戮无须理由，除了那被狂热病态亲手搭建的逻辑：他们妄图以谋杀去“纠正”自己所认定的重大不公，而对旁观者而言，这些杀人动机荒诞得近乎无意义。
In a world full of arcane, fiendish, and martial threats, you find yourself nonetheless transfixed by the pure evil of the being sitting before you. In the soft tone one might use to describe what one had for dinner last night, the serial killer casually recounts horrific murder after horrific murder—committed by their hands without remorse or difficulty. You find that you have to steel yourself to look into their eyes, for despite the surface calm, your animal instincts recognize a deep, existential chaos roiling within their depths, and you immediately want to look away. This is a person who kills without reason except what they have constructed in their fevered pathology, their attempts to correct what they perceive as a grave injustice through murder most nonsensical to those standing on the outside.

Haggling From A Witch.name:
与女巫讨价还价
Haggling From A Witch

Text.text:
“我可不是什么四处游走的草药郎；我是行家，我要拿行家的酬劳。你以为这点可怜钱就能让我变出奇迹？以为我随便去趟农夫集市就能捎回一截蛇怪尾巴？我的手艺是有代价的——你若不肯用黄金来付，那就得用更为珍贵的东西来偿。”
“I am not some wandering herbalist; I am a professional, and I demand a professional’s pay. You think I can conjure miracles for such a pittance? That I can just pop by some farmers’ market and pick up a basilisk tail? There are costs to my work, and if you will not pay with gold, then you will pay with something far more precious.”

Emaciated Ghoul.name:
憔悴的食尸鬼（特征）
Emaciated Ghoul

Text.text:
这具消瘦的人形生物用带爪的骸骨脚掌挪动。腐烂的碎肉挂在它的骨架上，凌乱地披在裸露的肋骨、胯骨与手臂之间。纠结成团的乱发——有些干涸如血般猩红，有些乌黑黏结——遮住它残余的头颅与肩背。它淌着涎水，满口腐坏的牙齿挤在狰狞的巨口里，双眼燃着异界般的饥渴。
The emaciated humanoid moves on clawed, skeletal feet. Bits of rotten flesh hang from its skeletal frame, draped haphazardly over the exposed ribs, hips, and arms. Tangled mops of hair—some dried blood red, others black and matted—cover what’s left of its head and shoulders. It drools, rotting teeth filling its maw, and its eyes burn with an otherworldly hunger.

House Griffon Commons.name:
狮鹫公馆公共区
House Griffon Commons

Text.text: 在这间石拱顶下的屋子里，最惹眼的莫过于壁炉。那儿常年燃着一团温暖而欢快的火焰——也许大得有些过分——永不熄灭。西侧墙面一字排开高挑的拱形窗，嵌着菱形拼格的铅框玻璃；每扇窗的中央窗格都绘着家族纹章：一头狮身站立的狮鹫，以利爪示人，rampant guardant。蓝与银的家族配色铺陈在房间各处：地毯、随手乱搭的披巾，以及围着炉火摆放的软垫沙发。 The most noticeable thing about the room under its stone vaulting is the hearth. A warm and cheerful fire, perhaps a little too large, burns there perpetually. Tall arched windows of leaded glass in diamond patterns line the west wall, the center pane of each sporting the sigil of the house: a griffon standing on its lion legs, talons presented rampant guardant. The blue and silver house colors adorn the room in rugs, scarves flung carelessly, and upholstered sofas around the fire.

这些佝偻、罗圈腿的人形生物，惨白的皮肤紧紧绷在筋腱与骨架上。乳白的眼球在眼眶里鼓胀突出，稀薄发黄的毛发如缕缕乱丝垂在头皮上。有些在鼻下与下巴也生着同样的细毛，另一些却从头到脚寸毛不生。它们穿着粉红色皮革、骨片与深色甲壳板拼成的衣装。多数手持骨制短棒，少数挥舞几丁质的刃。更倒霉的只能倚仗自己又长又破的指甲、歪斜过长的牙齿，以及野蛮粗壮的肌肉。

~ 构想：njorgard

Pasty skin draws tight across the sinew and bone of these stooped, bowlegged humanoids. Milky eyes bulge in the creatures’ sockets, and wan hair hangs in wisps from each scalp. Some have similar strands under nose and on chin, while others still are bald from head to toe. They dress in garments of pinkish leather, bone, and dark plates of carapace. Most carry bone bludgeons, while a few brandish blades of chitin. The unlucky must rely on their long, ragged nails; crooked, overlong teeth; and brutish musculature.

~ Envisioned by njorgard

Portal In A Magical Fog.name:
魔雾中的传送门
Portal In A Magical Fog

Text.text:
一大片苍白的云团悬在空中，贴着地面游移。浓稠如绳的雾丝盘旋缠绕着某个被遮蔽的点，仿佛一团不断收紧、永无止境的复杂结扣。你察觉到某种近似风的存在——明明没有一丝气流拂动你——可你的身体却感到被无形的力量推挤着，朝那诡异的雾霭逼近。
A wide white cloud hangs in the air, skirting the ground. Thick ropy strands of fog curl and twist around an obscured point, like a complex knot endlessly tightening. You become conscious of a something like a wind—though no breeze ruffles you—and your body feels pushes toward this strange mist.

[外面]  门上方悬着的招牌浮雕刻着几个胡子拉碴的人挤在同一张床上酣睡。希望里面的住处能宽敞些。唯一的窗户都在二楼，门板厚实，钉着铁铆钉——至少他们对安全是认真的。 [里面]  旅店里比外头更糟，空气里一股汗馊味。那些穷得住不起房的人蜷在公共厅的长凳上坐着打盹，背靠墙壁，或倚着前方绷起的一根粗绳。前台旁的楼梯通向上一层，带着对更好住处的寄望。柜台后的瘦男人朝你挥手，一边示意你走近，一边又示意你把门关上。 [Outside]  The carving on the sign dangling above the door depicts several bearded figures sleeping in the same bed. Hopefully accommodations inside are roomier than that. The only windows are on the second floor, and the door is stout and studded with iron—at least they take security seriously. [Inside]  The inn looks worse on the inside, and it stinks of sweat. Those too poor to afford a room sleep sitting up on the common room's long benches, leaning back against the walls or toward a stout rope strung in front of them. Stairs beside a front desk climb to the next floor, holding the promise of better accommodation above. The thin man behind the desk waves at you, simultaneously indicating you should approach and shut the door.

Copper Dragon Lair.name:
铜龙巢穴
Copper Dragon Lair

Text.text:
你一路跋涉的嶙峋石丘，早已无数次向你显露过巨龙的面容。你转过岩角，撞见一抹被刻出的龙之笑意；你俯身望去，又见十数块石头嵌着龙眼，其中几枚竟像在眨眼。如今，整颗龙首终于以巨石之姿呈现在你面前——它的颌骨化作山坡上的一座敞口洞窟，张开的獠牙间黑暗深不见底。入口阴森得令人背脊发凉，可一想到巨龙钻回巢穴，仿佛把自己一口吞下，你还是忍不住轻笑出声。
The rocky hills through which you’ve been hiking have shown you portions of the dragon’s face many times. You’ve turned corners to find a carving of its smile and looked down to see a dozen stones with dragon eyes, some of them winking. Now you see the whole head of the dragon represented in stone, its jaws an open cavern into the hillside. It’s an ominous entrance, but thinking of the dragon entering its lair and thus eating itself makes you chuckle.

Circus Music: Dramatic.name:
马戏团音乐：戏剧性
Circus Music: Dramatic

Text.text:
帐篷里的灯光逐渐黯淡，只剩一道光束如灯塔般照在竞技场中央的木屑上。观众们方才还因小丑与穿着戏服的狗而笑意未散，此刻却在不祥的乐声响起时渐渐安静下来。演出即将迎来一个全新的环节登上舞台，而你在等待它现身的瞬间不由得屏息。
The lights in the tent go dim but for a beacon shining upon the sawdust in the center of the arena. The crowd, smiles still on their lips after laughing at clowns and dogs in costume, quiets as ominous music begins. A new element of the show is about to take center stage, and you find yourself holding your breath as you wait for it to appear.

Approaching The Temple Of The Fallen In.name:
在月光下走近堕落者神殿
Approaching The Temple Of The Fallen In The Moonlight

Text.text:
一座白石神殿伫立在月光下，墙面映出冷冽的幽辉。北面升起一道怪异的轮廓，难以辨清，其中有什么在闪烁。薄雾沿着建筑南侧蜿蜒流淌。然而那鬼魅般的墙壁渐渐褪去，废墟的真面目随之显露。
A temple of white stone stands in the moonlight, its walls reflecting the cold glow. An odd shape, hard to make out, rises to the north, something in it glittering. Mist flows around the structure’s southern reaches. But the ghostly walls fade, revealing the ruin for what it is.

Gnome’s Comradery.name:
侏儒的同袍情谊
Gnome’s Comradery

Text.text:
“以我的身量，面对那样的怪物，要鼓起勇气实在不易。可只要站在你们身边，哎呀，我——我就觉得自己足有四英尺高！”
“It can be hard for someone of my stature to feel brave in the face of such monstrous things. But when I stand beside all of you, why, I—I feel four feet tall!”

Smoke Blown On A Westerly Breeze.name:
西风送来的烟雾
Smoke Blown On A Westerly Breeze

Text.text:
拂过村外农舍的微风，顺势卷走从排烟孔与烟囱里逸出的柴烟气息。如此如画的景致令人难以不去想象屋内那温暖而惬意的炉火。
The breeze blowing over the farmhouses on the outskirts of the village helps to whisk away the scent of woodsmoke issuing from the smokeholes and chimneys. It is impossible to view such a picturesque scene without imagining the warmth of the cozy hearths within.

Zarelon Drellasi.name:
扎瑞隆·德雷拉西
Zarelon Drellasi

Text.text:
男人嗅了嗅空气，眯眼望向地平线，仿佛要把目光投进遥远的未来。他在衡量什么？这白发男子身上有种令人无法移开视线的魅力——却又隐隐透着非人的气息，皮肤泛着银白的光泽。事实上，这身影仿佛就是一场关于银色的写生：锁子甲与盾牌被打磨得如镜面般明亮。仿佛察觉到你的念头，他缓缓转过头来正对着你；你一时怔住，只见电光似的亮芒在他淡银色的眼眸上游走——那双眼睛均匀冰冷，没有瞳孔。
The man sniffs the air, peering at the horizon as if trying to see into the far future. What could he be measuring? There is something compelling about the white-haired man—and vaguely inhuman—with a silvery tint to his skin. In fact, the figure seems to be a study in silver, his chain shirt and shield polished to a mirror finish. As if detecting your thoughts, he slowly turns his head to face you, and you are momentarily taken aback as you see what looks like lightning playing over his pale silver eyes, uniform and without pupils.

Boots Of The Winterlands.name:
冬境长靴
Boots Of The Winterlands

Text.text:
这双柔韧的长靴以浅蓝皮革制成，银色丝线缝出如窗棂霜花般的纹样。它们接触起来温暖，只比你的肌肤略热一丝。靴底的缝线勾勒出参差的轮廓，仿佛由锯齿状的象牙铸成。
These supple boots are made of a light-blue leather stitched with silvery thread in a pattern like frost on a windowpane. They’re warm to the touch, just slightly warmer than your own skin. The soles are stitched so that they seem to be made of a jagged ivory.

Mob-owned Casino.name:
黑帮掌控的赌场
Mob-owned Casino

Text.text:
身着利落黑西装的保安在赌场大厅巡逻，他们面无表情的冷硬神态与室内喧闹放纵的氛围格格不入。穿着华丽——且格外暴露——的侍者在人群间穿梭，为豪客奉上免费饮品，催着他们把手伸得更深，掏出更多筹码。头顶上，数量多得令人心惊的监控摄像头俯视着这场狂欢，尤其盯紧那些看起来运气好得过头的赌客。
Guards in crisp black suits patrol the casino floor, their stony-faced demeanor at odds with the exuberant atmosphere in the room. Waitstaff in glamorous—and revealing—outfits circulate, offering high-rollers complimentary refreshments as they delve deeper into their pockets. Overhead, an alarming number of security cameras observe the revelry, paying particular attention to any patron who seems a little too lucky.

In The Marsh: Oppressive Heat.name:
在沼泽中：闷热压迫
In The Marsh: Oppressive Heat

Text.text:
尽管水源丰沛，这片沼泽却像烤炉般闷热。在潮湿的空气里挪动，仿佛推开一层凝脂般艰难。汗水沿着脸颊与全身淌下，把衣物黏在皮肤上；可一旦露出肌肤，似乎又会引来更多叮咬的虫群。
Despite the abundance of water, the marsh feels like an oven. Moving in the humid air feels like pushing through lard. The sweat dripping down your face and your body makes your clothes cling to you, but exposing your skin seems to draw even more biting insects.

Hidden Pit Trap.name:
隐蔽陷坑陷阱
Hidden Pit Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 你的目光在地面上捕捉到一处异样，身体骤然僵住——一块石板仅仅比周围石块高出四分之一英寸。你看见它边缘一圈的磨痕，仿佛在诉说着一枚隐秘的铰链正等待将石板向下翻开。

[触发] 你听到“咔嗒”一声，随之而来的是一瞬沉重的寂静，整个人顿时僵住。忽然，你脚下的地面塌陷，在一枚古老铰链上翻转敞开。你坠入黑暗，被这突如其来的下落搅得天旋地转，而陷坑的底部却过于迅猛地迎面撞来。

[Perceived] You freeze as your eyes find an anomaly in the floor—a single flagstone, raised a mere quarter-inch higher than the surrounding stones. You see scuff marks along its circumference where a hidden hinge waits to swing the flagstone downward.

[Triggered] You freeze as you hear a click, followed by a fleeting moment of heavy silence. Suddenly, the floor beneath you gives way, swinging open on an ancient hinge. You plummet into the darkness, disoriented by the sudden drop, as the bottom of the pit trap rises all too quickly to meet you.

Working Pier Full Of Shipping Containers.name:
堆满货运集装箱的作业码头
Working Pier Full Of Shipping Containers

Text.text:
码头工人一边高喊一边挥手，指挥头顶的巨型起重机挪动庞大的集装箱，将它们精准就位。厚重的烟霾常年笼罩着栈桥，偶尔被游移的霓虹火把划破——那是员工穿行于昏沉阴影时投下的光痕。
Dock workers shout and wave, directing the gargantuan cranes overhead to maneuver massive containers into position. A thick layer of smog permanently obscures the pier, occasionally pierced by wandering neon torches as the staff make their way through the gloom.

Divine Hermitage Of A God Of Rangers.name:
游侠之神的神圣隐修所
Divine Hermitage Of A God Of Rangers

Text.text:
伪装的狩猎盲棚坐落在一条蚁道尽头，藏在浓密林木与巨大的蕨丛之后。近旁，一座粗凿的廊架覆着攀爬藤蔓与片片树皮，下方摆着制箭架与一条舒适的长凳。棚屋一路延伸到一处清凉小洞的洞口；洞内有根窖、一丛蘑菇，以及一处从山体渗出、经岩层滤净的水源。墙上绘着比例精准的地图。
The camouflaged hunting blind sits at the end of an ant track, hidden behind thick forest and giant ferns. Nearby, under a rough-hewn pergola covered in creeping vines and slabs of bark, is a fletching stand and a comfortable, long bench. The shelter stretches to the mouth of a small, cool cave with a root cellar, a patch of mushrooms, and a water source filtered through the mountainside. Well-scaled maps have been painted on the walls.

桌上的这把武器堪称军工工程的杰作，为迅捷操控而优化。它覆着黑色碳纤维外壳，轻盈却坚韧，并可加装带瞄准功能的多重瞄具，实现精准狙击。或者，凭借高速脉冲射击能力与致命精度，它也成了前线士兵的心头好——那些热衷于维持火力射速的人尤其爱它。
The weapon on the table is a masterwork of military engineering, optimized for quick handling. Its black carbon-fiber skin is both lightweight and tough, and it can be mounted with a targeted multi-scope for precise sniping. Alternatively, its rapid-pulse capability and deadly accuracy make it a favorite among soldiers on the front lines, who enjoy sustained rates of fire.

Bugbear Battle: Turning Point.name:
熊地精（特征）之战：转折点
Bugbear Battle: Turning Point

Text.text:
与熊地精的战斗已到临界点，但谁将获胜你仍无法断言——因为随着你们的胜利不断累积，他们的狂怒也愈发高涨。无论如何，这一切很快就会结束：你能从他们龇牙咆哮的面孔上，看见与你同样的绝望倒映其中。
The battle with the bugbears has reached a tipping point, but who will win you cannot yet say—because as your victories mount, their fury mounts higher. One way or another it will be over soon: you can see the desperation you feel reflected in their snarling faces.

鉴于此地显露出的年代，铺成地面的灰色石板上仅薄薄覆着一层沙尘，远不如想象中那般厚重。地砖被切割成不规则的形状与大小不一的块面，乍看宛如暮色中的蛇鳞皮。地面、柱身与墙壁上的雕刻则以盘蛇的身影与扭曲的符文进一步强化了这一蛇之意象。
Given the apparent age of this place, less sand than might be expected dusts the gray stone that makes up the floor. Cut in irregular shapes and varying sizes, these tiles give the impression of dusky snakeskin. Carvings on the floor, pillars, and walls reinforce this serpent motif with images of snakes and twisting glyphs.

Warning By A Druid About Destroying Fore.name:
一位德鲁伊的警告：摧毁森林的下场
Warning By A Druid About Destroying Forests

Text.text:
“你竟如此轻率地丢弃神祇的恩赐。每一株树的枝桠、每一条游走的溪流里，都藏着一小片天穹，而你为了区区小玩意便将其尽数践踏。你以为森林已然消失，可它仍活在你家中的每一根梁木里：被屠宰、被肢解，嘶号着要复仇。我向你起誓，它的呼唤绝不会无人回应。”
“You discard the gods’ gifts so recklessly. Within every tree’s bough and every wandering stream is a small piece of heaven, and you trample it all in the pursuit of mere trinkets. You think the forest gone, but in every beam in your home it remains: butchered, maimed, and screaming out for vengeance. And I promise you, its calls will not go unanswered.”

Kerem The Blood Hunter.name:
凯雷姆，血猎人
Kerem The Blood Hunter

Text.text:
这名类人生物脸上挂着明朗的笑容，却与他那双冷硬、布满血丝的眼睛里猩红的虹膜形成刺眼的反差。乌黑的头发泛着暗红的光泽，却遮不住他脸上的伤疤；他的护甲也掩不住更多纵横交错的旧痕，以及在苍白皮肤上如蛛网般蔓延的深色血管。他自信地穿着一副黑漆钢制胸甲。背后皮革战士挽具上垂着一面暗沉金属的熨斗盾，镶着猩红的嵌饰。别在胯侧的流线型手弩与盾牌同样的纹饰风格。细微声响乍起，他转瞬间便跃上坐骑——一具暗钢构装体，红眼幽燃——一手举盾，另一手握着已上弦的弩，弩身嗡鸣着奥术魔法的震颤，他目光如钉，死死锁定声源。
The cheery grin of this humanoid is a stark contrast to the crimson irises of his hard, bloodshot eyes. The ruddy luster of his black hair does not hide his facial scars, nor does his armor conceal numerous other scars or the dark veins like spiderwebs across his pale skin. He wears a breastplate of black-lacquered steel with confidence. A heater shield of dusky metal with scarlet inlays hangs from the leather warrior’s harness on his back. The sleek hand-crossbow attached to his hip has the same motif as the shield. A small noise, and in a blink he is atop his mount—a construct of dark steel with glowing red eyes—shield in one hand, loaded crossbow humming with arcane magic in the other, as he focusses on the source.

Landfill For Broken Constructs.name:
破损构装体的填埋场
Landfill For Broken Constructs

Text.text:
金属骸骨上绽开猖獗而致命的锈斑，成片堆积在大地上，垒成一座座巨丘——仿佛等待火炬点燃的葬火柴堆。巨神般的机器深陷污秽泥沼，在风雨侵蚀中缓慢腐朽，逐渐没入遗忘；诸般元素剥离它们最后一丝用途的残痕。
Metallic skeletons flaked with blooming, virulent rust fill the landscape in enormous heaps—like funeral pyres awaiting the torch. Titanic machines lie mired in filth, slowly rotting into oblivion as the elements strip their last vestiges of purpose away.

Rogue's Plea To A Lock.name:
盗贼对锁的哀求
Rogue's Plea To A Lock

Text.text: “就是这样，把你那点小秘密吱吱挤出来。咔哒作响，叮铃乱颤，把你痒得想挠的那块挠个痛快。怎么？不对？往右一点？嗯，你开始坐立不安了，然——… 没错！” “There you go, squeak out your little secrets. Click and rattle that itch you want scratched. No? A little to the right? Now you’re getting fidgety, annnnd… Yes!”

Apprentice Necromancer Raises Her First.name:
见习死灵法师唤起了她的第一具亡灵
Apprentice Necromancer Raises Her First Undead

Text.text:
学徒双手颤抖着，沿着古老的羊皮纸页描摹着法术的字句；她的呼吸因惶惧而急促浅薄。她面前躺着一具尸体，被藏在她那秘密圣所的幽暗深处；她低声吟诵亵渎的词句，妄图篡夺生死的自然秩序。恶风骤起，猛然掠过密室，烛火摇曳不定；一股阴毒的绿光能量开始缠绕那具尸骸。她把吟唱声抬得更高——恐惧被凯旋取代——学徒完成了法术。伴随一阵抽搐般的震颤，尸体猛地一抖，缓缓坐起。

~ 构想：Walt M.

With trembling hands, the apprentice traces the words of the spell across the ancient vellum pages, her breath ragged and shallow with apprehension. A corpse lies before her, sequestered in the gloom of her clandestine sanctuary, as she chants the profane words to usurp the natural order of life and death. The candles flicker when a fell wind whips through the chamber and malevolent green energy begins to surround the cadaver. Chanting louder—her terror replaced by triumph—the apprentice completes the spell. With a shuddering jolt, the body rises.

~ Envisioned by Walt M.

I Have Aura Of Devotion.name:
我拥有「奉献灵光」
I Have Aura Of Devotion

Text.text:
我对朋友与受我庇护之人的忠诚与守护，源自心底深处，向外流淌，缠绕在我身旁之人身上，结成牢不可破的忠诚之链。若不先将我折断，便无人能斩断那纽带，更无人能以虚假的爱强行套上枷锁。
The devotion I have for my friends and wards emanates from within me, wrapping those near me in unbreakable bonds of loyalty. Nothing can sunder those bonds, nor enforce a false love, without breaking me first.

一具由旋转齿轮构成、宛如构装体的人形骤然启动。它像一件会移动的艺术品，却显然并非出自任何人类之手。它的脸庞难以捉摸，没有任何五官，然而低语却从这生物体内逸出。周遭的织物纷纷剥裂，仿佛现实本身也不得不在那言语的猛攻前逃离。那人形闪烁不定，近乎无形。
A construct-like humanoid made of spinning gears shifts into motion. It is a moving artwork, but clearly not one built by any human hands. Its face is inscrutable, possessing no features, yet a whisper emerges from the creature. Nearby fabrics peel apart, as if reality itself must flee from the verbal onslaught. The humanoid flickers, almost incorporeal.

污秽在排水沟里堆积，化作恶臭的浊流蜿蜒流淌；尘土与碎屑塞满门槛与墙角。这里的光仿佛更暗——楼宇贴得更近，压迫感更重——人们蜷在昏影里的小巷与壁龛间，用刺耳的嗓音低声嘀咕。然而你也在这里看见家人，看见善意：一个男人把钱币放进乞丐的掌心，朝他露出微笑；一个女人从窗边递出刚烤好的面包，送到饥饿小乞儿伸出的手里；一对恋人手牵着手漫步，彼此甜蜜呢喃。
Filth collects in the gutters, running in putrid rivers; dirt and debris fill doorways and corners. The light here seems dimmer—the closeness of the buildings more oppressive—and people huddle in shadowed alleyways and alcoves, muttering to one another in harsh voices. Yet here you see families too, and kindness: a man drops coins into the palm of a beggar, and offers him a smile; a woman hands fresh-baked bread, from her window, to the outstretched hands of hungry urchins; and a couple whisper sweetly to each other as they stroll hand-in-hand.

Drunken Pedestrian Singing In The Street.name:
醉汉行人街头放歌
Drunken Pedestrian Singing In The Street

Text.text:
一个身影在街道上来回踉跄穿梭，时不时撞上路灯和防撞柱。他们把双臂张得老开，仿佛自己就是一架飞机。“奥利，奥利，奥利！”一声低沉的吼叫传来——那种只有毫不羞怯的人，或醉得不省人事的人才喊得出来的调子。他们右手垂着一个套着纸袋的酒瓶。那套“飞机”般的摆动让瓶口甩出黏稠的酒液，淌到地上，汇成一滩滩脏兮兮的污浊水洼。
A figure weaves along the street to-and-fro, careening into streetlights and bollards. They stretch their arms out wide, as though they are a plane. “Ollie, Ollie, Ollie!” comes a deep shout, the type of yell that can only come from those unabashed or absolutely drunk. From their right hand hangs a bottle in a paper bag. The airplane movements slop viscous liquid from the bottle to the ground, where it collects in dirty puddles.

Bronze Griffon Figurine Of Wondrous Powe.name:
奇物之力的青铜狮鹫雕像
Bronze Griffon Figurine Of Wondrous Power

Text.text:
一只潜行狮鹫的形象被铸成青铜，化作一尊小到可托于掌心的雕像。低调的光泽与阴影般的凹痕相映成趣，衬得上扬羽翼上每一根羽毛的层次分明，也刻出前肢张开的利爪上每一片鳞甲的粗粝纹理。
The image of a prowling griffon has been cast in bronze, a statuette small enough to fit in the palm of your hand. The muted luster beautifully contrasts with the shadowed divots accentuating each feather in the upturned wing and each scale texturing the splayed talons of its front legs.

这只猫的肩胛间伸展出斑驳如羽的翅膀，身披白、橙、黑三色花斑。它步伐自信，双耳警觉竖起，弯曲的尾巴高高扬着。金色的好奇眼眸带着竖瞳，缓慢眨动；粉红的鼻尖轻轻抽动，试探着空气中的气味。
Mottled and feathery wings spread from the shoulders of this cat, tricolor in white, orange, and black patches. The feline walks with confidence, ears at attention and curved tail held up. Curious eyes, golden and with vertical pupils, blink slowly as the cat’s pink nose wiggles, testing the air.

Party Reacts To Death Of A Familiar.name:
队伍对一只魔宠之死的反应
Party Reacts To Death Of A Familiar

Text.text:
恐惧如冰冷钢刃刺穿你的腹腔，你眼睁睁看着空中的屠戮铺展开来——你信赖的斥候被虫群撕成碎片。你的同伴踉跄后退，仿佛挨了一记重击，疼痛的肺里空气被硬生生挤尽，而意识却在这一瞬猛然回到他们的身体。冷汗在你额头凝成细珠，随着那股骇人的领悟沿脊柱爬升，像受折磨的幽魂贴耳低语：他们在注视着你。

~ Envisioned by thebigham on Discord

Fear pierces your gut like the cold steel of a blade as you watch the aerial carnage unfold—your trusted scout torn to shreds by the swarm. Your companion reels as if they have been struck, the air driven from aching lungs as their consciousness suddenly returns to their body. Cold sweat beads on your brow as realization creeps up your spine, whispering in your ear like a tortured specter: They are watching you.

~ Envisioned by thebigham on Discord

I Use My Rope Of Entanglement.name:
我使用我的纠缠绳索
I Use My Rope Of Entanglement

Text.text:
我握着绳索末端，口中吐出命令词，绳子顿时苏醒般弹起，猛然跃向我的目标。那驱动它的魔法生效时，绳身泛起柔和的蓝光，像一条纤维编成的巨蛇昂首扑击，将我的目标死死缠住，越收越紧。
Holding the end of the rope in my hand I speak the command word, causing it to spring to life and leap toward my target. Glowing with a soft, blue light as the magic animating it takes hold, the rope rears up like a fibrous serpent and ensnares my target in a constricting embrace.

Rod Of The Pact Keeper, +1.name:
契约守护者法杖，+1
Rod Of The Pact Keeper, +1

Text.text:
这根光滑短杖的杖身由阴暗、纹理粗犷的木材制成，其上烙着漆黑符文。一端渐收成尖，另一端渐阔。两端皆以钢制端帽封口，端帽上浮雕般的凸起符文彼此缠绕成线。较大的端帽末端化作一只攫握的爪，托住一枚小巧、澄澈的水晶。靠近细端处，一圈钢链缠绕杖身，形成便于握持的手柄。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Dark, broad-grained wood branded with black runes makes up the shaft of this smooth rod. It tapers at one end and broadens at the other. Steel caps molded with raised runes intertwined in lines seal both ends. The larger cap ends in a grasping claw that holds a small, clear crystal. Nearer the narrow end, steel chain wrapped around the rod forms a grip.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Blessing From A Goddess Of Nature.name:
来自自然女神的祝福
Blessing From A Goddess Of Nature

Text.text:
你被一阵五彩斑斓的落叶旋风裹挟。轻柔而安静的笑声在你耳畔回旋。新翻泥土的气息唤醒了你的鼻腔。风势渐息，落叶纷纷坠下，女神含笑立于你面前。她抬手一挥，暖意如潮涌入你的胸口。

~ Maxamealian 请求

You are buffeted by a whirl of many-colored leaves. A laugh, gentle and quiet, plays around your ears. The scent of freshly turned earth awakens your nose. As the wind calms, the leaves fall, and the Goddess stands smiling before you. She waves a hand and a warmth floods your chest.

~ Requested by Maxamealian

Thief At A Tournament.name:
锦标赛上的窃贼
Thief At A Tournament

Text.text:
沉醉于钢铁交击与战马如雷的奔腾之中，贵族与平民无不浑然不觉：人群里混着一名黑衣的幽灵（特征）。那名满脸疤痕的女人在拥挤的人潮间游走——双手忙个不停，从不在同一处停留超过片刻。她的步伐老练而从容，宽大的斗篷掩住她的阴险行径。
Enraptured by the clash of steel and thundering horses, noble and commoner alike fail to notice the dark-clad ghost among them. The scar-faced woman meanders through the crowd—hands busy, never staying in one place for more than a moment. She moves with practiced ease, voluminous cloak masking her nefarious deeds.

Sundries From A Hollyphant.name:
来自圣象小天使的杂货
Sundries From A Hollyphant

Text.text:
可怜的圣象天使只戴着一条皮绳，上面系着一枚带有魔力的天界徽记；徽记已然龟裂、焦黑，显然是对这生物之死作出的反应动作（）。
The poor hollyphant wears only a leather cord with a magical, celestial token on it that has cracked and burned, apparently in reaction to the creature’s death.

Foyer To The South.name:
通往南方的前厅
Foyer To The South

Text.text:
这间小厅里只有一只火盆，吐出一圈短促的橙色光晕。两条巨大的、爪状的树根从南北两侧墙体中探出，粗如巨蟒，盘绕扭结，仿佛丛林里的森蚺。此处共有四条出路：西侧的楼梯——你们正是从那里进入；向东分岔的两条通道——无门无阻；以及通往北方的一条走廊，门已被从铰链上硬生生扯下，横躺在门槛处的地面上。
A single brazier offers a short corona of orange light in this small chamber. Two massive claw-like roots protrude from the northern and southern walls, as thick around and twisty as jungle boas. There are four paths out of this room: the staircase to the west, through which you entered; two paths leading eastward, doorless and unobstructed; and a passage leading north with a door torn from its hinges and lying on the floor of the threshold.

这道法术的手势细微、咒语低声，极易掩人耳目。它是最容易上手的戏法之一，但在学徒法师之间却常常惹出麻烦——他们像课堂上偷传纸条的孩子般滥用它。不少大师法师会装作对这种行径勃然大怒，心底却暗自欣慰：这些新手正用一门也许有朝一日会在大成功或大失败关头派上用场的法术磨炼本领。
The spell’s subtle gestures and quiet words make it easy to disguise. One of the simplest cantrips to learn, its use often becomes troublesome among apprentice wizards who use it like children passing notes in class. Many a master wizard has pretended outrage at such behavior, while secretly pleased at the novices practicing their skills with a spell that might one day prove critical.

这块墓碑前的土堆比其他的都要矮小。也许埋在这里的是个孩子，或是一位半身人。墓碑上的铭文几乎不提供线索：你伫立于一座坟墓之上，但若不是提醒生命的珍贵，坟墓又算什么？ The mound of dirt before this headstone is smaller than the rest. Perhaps a child or a halfling was buried here. The headstone’s inscription gives little clue: You stand over a grave, but what is a grave if not a reminder of the preciousness of life?

I Animate My Rope Of Climbing.name:
我让我的攀爬绳活了过来
I Animate My Rope Of Climbing

Text.text:
我吐出命令词的瞬间，绳索便仿佛苏醒，悬浮而起，蛇行般起伏游动，静静等待我的指令。它以金丝与银线交织编就，随着光线掠过翻涌的盘绕，泛起粼粼微光。
My rope springs to life as I speak the command word, moving in a serpentine rhythm as it hovers, awaiting my instruction. Braided with threads of gold and silver, the rope shimmers as the light plays off its undulating coils.

小屋内部整洁却透着孤寂，算得上是个起居的空间。一张单人床、一张靠着小桌的椅子、一只五斗柜，以及一座壁炉——既供取暖也用来烹饪——便是屋主的全部所需，除此之外几乎没有杂物占据房间。唯一称得上装饰的，是一张巨大的圆形地毯。
The interior of the hut is a tidy, if lonesome, living space. A single bed, a chair by a small table, a dresser, and a fireplace—used for both warmth and cooking—serve the hut’s owner, but little else clutters the room. A large circular rug is the only significant decoration.

一个巨大的钟形物体悬挂在翻涌的海水之上，系在坐骑上来回摇摆，无声地敲出一记回荡。海盐以大片杂乱的斑块黏附在这台装置曾经光洁的表面，昭示着它在船上服役的漫长岁月。甲板上传来号角声，钟体被放开，缓缓沉入下方咸涩的浑浊之中，潜水员绷紧身体，准备迎接这次下潜。

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

A large bell-shaped object is suspended over the churning waters, swaying on its mount with a silent peal. Sea-salt clings in large chaotic patches to the once pristine surface of the apparatus, indicating the length of its service aboard the vessel. A horn sounds on deck and the bell is released, slowly lowering into the briny murk below as the diver braces themself for the descent.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Werewolf Wizard Fighting A Party Of Adve.name:
狼人格巫师迎战一支冒险者小队
Werewolf Wizard Fighting A Party Of Adventurers

Text.text:
狼形类人生物对追兵亮出的武器与法术咆哮示威。尽管他们试图合围，他却成了个难缠的目标——没有护甲替他格挡刀锋，这头狼人灵巧得惊人，四肢着地在他们之间疾窜。他虽寡不敌众，却以战术般的精确把敌人卡在自己想要的位置。利爪般的手指引动奥术嬗变，他一把攫住自己毛茸茸的喉咙，随即猛地打出一记火焰锥形喷吐。炽亮的火浪轰然涌出，几声凄厉尖叫，武器砸落地面的闷响……而在随之而来的死寂里，只剩下焦肉与燎毛的恐怖恶臭。

~ 构想：ThunderWolf

The lupine humanoid snarls defiantly at his pursuers’ brandished weapons and spells. Though they attempt to surround him, he presents a difficult target—without armor to deflect their blades, the lycanthrope is nimble and darts on all fours between them. He is outnumbered, but he has positioned his foes with tactical precision. Clawed fingers initiate an arcane transmutation and he grabs at his furry throat, then belches a cone of fire. There’s a bright gout, several shrieks, the thud of weapons hitting the ground… and in the resulting silence, the awful stench of scorched flesh and singed fur.

~ Envisioned by ThunderWolf

南墙的壁龛里有一座基座，上面只剩一尊雪花石膏雕像的脚与小腿。其余部分已粉碎断裂，碎片散落在北面那条宽阔走廊里、四根白色立柱之间的地面上。东侧还立着另一扇紧闭的铁栅双门，门后幽影沉沉。
A pedestal in a recess on the south wall holds only the foot and lower leg of an alabaster statue. The rest lies shattered and scattered on the floor between the four white pillars that line the broad hallway to the north. Another closed double door of iron bars stands to the east with shadow beyond.

Quip About Speaking With The Dead.name:
关于与亡者说话的俏皮话
Quip About Speaking With The Dead

Text.text:
“在这地方，死者有太多话要说。我建议我们倾听。”
“The dead have much to say in this place. I suggest we listen.”

Temple To A God Of Hunting.name:
狩猎之神的神庙
Temple To A God Of Hunting

Text.text:
一座简陋的单坡棚屋，用木板、捡来的屋顶材料和结实的绳索捆扎而成，立在一片扫得干净的泥土地上，地面铺着兽皮。神庙常常需要修补，而这本身就是敬拜的一部分。墙上的木钉上挂着供旅人取用的补给袋——腌肉、几段绳索、靴底、大家一同采来的野食。墙上还挂着一张弓和一只号角；前方燃着一小堆欢快的火，猎人们在这里献上敬意，既献给神，也献给那些被取走性命的猎物之魂。
A simple lean-to, lashed together from boards, salvaged roofing, and strong rope, stands over a swept dirt floor covered in hides. The temple frequently needs repairs, which is part of the worship. From pegs on the walls, bags of supplies hang for travelers—salted meat, lengths of cord, soles for boots, shared forage. A bow and horn hang on the wall, and in front there is a cheerful little fire, where hunters pay their respects, both to the god and to the souls of the animals taken.

Threat From Evangeline Maples.name:
来自伊万杰琳·梅普尔斯的威胁
Threat From Evangeline Maples

Text.text:
她双手在身前交握，一侧胯骨随意地松垮垂下。她顽皮地前后轻晃着身子，用柔软的嗓音说道：“你以为我不知道发生了什么？你以为你能藏起来？别再把鼻子伸到不该伸的地方……不然我就把它变成蜥蜴的鼻吻。”
She holds her hands clasped in front of her, one hip dropped casually to the side. With a mischievous rock back and forth, she says in a soft voice: “You think I don’t know what’s going on? You think you can hide? Stop poking your nose where it doesn’t belong… or I’ll turn it into a lizard’s snout.”

一个高挑纤细、身披飘逸绸衣的身影拦在你前方，但他们的注意力却落在身侧那只半透明的紫色狐狸上。它兴奋地吱喳作响，那身影便用精灵语回应了几句，随后才转过头来望向你。你不由自主地被这位棕肤妖精精灵那双无纹理的琥珀色眼睛摄住——雌雄难辨的面容上带着探究的神色，也同样在审视着你。以华贵而持久的墨料镌刻成的奥术符文点缀着他们的躯体，颈侧与额间的纹痕在一头耀眼的乌黑长发映衬下更显夺目。一柄弯刃弯刀半是致命武器、半是奇妙宝藏，斜插在腰间的丝绸束带里；另一侧的皮质腰包中则塞着数瓶药水与几只卷轴筒。
A tall, slim figure clad in flowing silks stands in your path, but their attention is on the translucent purple fox at their side. It chitters excitedly, and the figure responds in the elvish tongue before turning to look at you. Despite yourself, you are taken in by the featureless amber eyes of the brown-skinned fey elf, an inquisitive look upon their androgynous features as they take stock of you in turn. Arcane runes, etched out in luxurious, permanent inks, decorate their body, with those markings on the neck and brow framed by the figure’s resplendent black hair. The curved blade of a scimitar, equal parts deadly weapon and wonderous treasure, is tucked into a silken sash at their waist, with several potions and scroll cases tucked into a leather hip satchel on the opposite side.

Investigating Loot In A House.name:
在屋内搜掠战利品
Investigating Loot In A House

Text.text:
在这间简陋的住处里，稻草床略显短小，遮不住一捆粗布包裹。束紧的一端探出一截皮革缠裹的握柄；从长度来看，可能是一把长剑、战锤，或是主人珍爱的某件武器。难怪有人想在沉睡时也把它放在身边。
Within the humble domicile, the straw bed is slightly too short to conceal a bundle of roughspun. A leather-wrapped handle pokes out from its cinched end; judging from the length, this could be a longsword, warhammer, or some other weapon precious to its owner. Small wonder that someone wanted it near them as they slept.

这副鞍具并不舒适。木质骨架外覆皮革，却又被冰冷的金属包裹，打磨得锃亮发白。它没有鞍角，但宽阔的鞍桥与鞍后缘几乎触及男人的肋骨。许多鞍具更像栖架或座椅；而这是一座掩体，为承受撞击而造。
The saddle is not comfortable. Its wooden frame is leather bound but encased in cold metal, polished bright. There is no horn, but both the wide pommel and cantle reach nearly to a man’s ribcage. Some saddles resemble a perch or a seat. This is a bunker, made for impact.

Magically Corrupted Ruins.name:
魔化侵蚀的遗迹
Magically Corrupted Ruins

Text.text:
自然法则在这里——旧堡垒崩裂的残骸之中——全然失效。岩石如掠过的云般漂浮，横越荒凉的沙海；植物在古老、风化的墙垣间疯长，体型竟是平日的十倍，而墙上仍烙着数百年前叛乱末期施放的最后咒痕。大多数人彻底避开此地，坚信这里被诅咒、闹鬼，或两者兼具；但也有人——无论是勇敢还是愚蠢——被这座破败的奥术堡垒所吸引，循着传闻而来，只为那埋藏其中的宝藏。

~ 由 Inbal 在 Discord 上通过 Envisioned 构想

The laws of nature don't apply here in the shattered remnants of the old fort. Rocks float like passing clouds across the desolate sands, and plants grow ten times their usual size amid the ancient, crumbling walls still marked by the last spells of the rebellion centuries ago. Most avoid this place entirely, believing it to be cursed, haunted, or both, but some—be they brave or foolish—are drawn to the decrepit, arcane bastion, lured by the rumors of treasures within.

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

Speech About The Glory Of Wealth.name:
关于财富荣耀的演说
Speech About The Glory Of Wealth

Text.text:
“我做这一切不是为了荣耀、信仰或袍泽情谊——我只为钱。唯有利润的甘甜蜜露指引我的双手。只要有机会品尝她的丰饶，我甘愿一次又一次纵身跃入烈焰般的险境。”
“I don’t do this for glory, faith, or brotherhood—I do this for money. The sweet nectar of profit alone guides my hand. For a chance to taste her bounty, I will gladly plunge into fiery peril again and again.”

Loot From A Goristro.name:
来自戈里斯特罗的战利品
Loot From A Goristro

Text.text:
牛头人的头顶骨被利落地剥下，连同乌黑如檀的犄角一并保留；对死灵法师、恶魔学者或提夫林术士而言，这样的战利品价值连城。
The minotaur’s skull cap, cleanly scalped and including the ebony horns, would be of great worth to a necromancer, demonologist, or tiefling sorcerer.

两条背带表明，这只坚硬、方正的皮革箱配着坚固的箱盖，其实是一只背包。背面有个口袋，尺寸恰好能塞下一本厚重的大部头。旁侧则缀着几枚皮环，大小正好用来固定卷轴筒。背包内部还有一条狭长隔层，用于收纳纸张，并配有几只细小的套袋，可放置书写用具与精巧工具。
The two straps indicate this hard, boxlike leather case with a rigid lid is a backpack. At the rear, the pack has a pocket perfectly sized for a large tome. Beside that are leather rings sized for scroll cases. Inside, the pack has a narrow compartment that holds paper and tiny sheaths for writing utensils and fine tools.

一声嘶哑的鸦鸣在头顶的空气中震颤回荡，近旁一棵树的枝条也随之猛地摇晃起来，仿佛受了惊。油亮的黑翼间闪着两点猩红的眼光——一只乌鸦用板岩色的利爪紧扣着光秃的枝桠。它张开喙，又放出一声刺耳的叫喊，灰色的舌头从幽暗的喉间微微探出。
A caw rattles through the air overhead, and the branches of a nearby tree shake with sudden agitation. Red eyes gleam between a spread of oily black wings—a raven clings to a barren branch with its slate-colored talons. Its beak opens to release another raucous call, its gray tongue peeking out from its dark throat.

Red Dragon Wyrmling.name:
红龙雏龙
Red Dragon Wyrmling

Text.text:
弯曲的犄角冠在龙形头颅之上。这生物体型约与一只大型犬相当，行动间透着爬行类特有的冷硬与敏捷，鳞片燃烧般的宝石红艳得刺目。它的鼻孔猛然张开，呼气时喷出一股蒸汽。骨白的牙齿寒光一闪，低沉的咆哮自这野兽喉间滚出，伴随着它喉咙深处灼红的炽亮光芒。
Curving horns crest the draconic head. The creature, roughly the size of a large dog, is reptilian in its movements, with scales a flaming, ruby red. Its nostrils flare, then issue a gout of steam as it exhales. Teeth, bone-white, flash as a low growl emanates from the beast, accompanied by a red-hot glow in its throat.

魔法将他们卷入漩涡——无论他们笑得多响，那都只是一首由痛苦谱成的歌。而魔法也将他们带了出来，如今他们在看护与照料的注视下斜倚在床上，空洞的凝视重新化作真实的目光。他们转过头，看见窗外春枝抽芽，一只红衣主教鸟停在其上。他们认得那只鸟，认得那就是他们自己——再度鲜红明亮，在现实的安稳里轻快吹哨。
Magic took them into the vortex of what was only a song of suffering, no matter how much they laughed. And magic has taken them out, now reclining on the bed under watch and care, their stare turning to sight again. They turn their head and see a cardinal on a budding spring branch outside the window. They recognize the bird, recognize it as themself, bright red again and whistling in the comfort of reality.

Loot From An Adult Green Dragon.name:
成年绿龙的战利品
Loot From An Adult Green Dragon

Text.text:
林间空地被那具巨大的绿龙尸骸所占据；它被撕裂的双翼在死亡中折断、扭曲。你判断搜查这头怪物已然安全，便猫身绕过那截折断的脖颈，俯身探查。它的喉间缠着一物，你原以为只是条围巾，实则是一件精灵斗篷。它的美竟未被这场冲突所玷染分毫。
The glade is dominated by the huge corpse of the green dragon, its ripped wings broken and twisted in death. Deeming it safe to search the beast, you duck around the broken neck and investigate. About its throat is what you had assumed was a scarf but is in fact an elven cloak. The beauty of it is somehow unmarred by the conflict.

The Sanctuary: Sweethayven.name:
圣所：甜草港
The Sanctuary: Sweethayven

Text.text:
在甜港城那简朴而绵延的城区里，生灵们以出人意料的悠闲步调四处穿行，忙着各自的营生。木造建筑——没有一栋高过两层——朴素无华，毫不繁复。欢快而鲜明的乐声从无数看不见的角落流淌而出，豆子的香气与油炸番茄的味道在街巷间飘荡。
In the simplistic sprawl of the city of Sweethayven, creatures meander about their business at a surprisingly casual pace. The wooden buildings—none of which is higher than two stories—are plain and uncomplicated. Vibrant music plays from numerous unseen sources, and the smell of beans and fried tomatoes wafts through the streets.

Delayed Blast Fireball.name:
延时爆裂火球
Delayed Blast Fireball

Text.text:
从你的指尖末端，一颗发光的珠点猛然窜出，逼得敌人纷纷扑向掩蔽——却什么也没发生。至少，眼下什么也没发生。那珠点悬在空中，诱人得令人心痒……而对粗心大意之人，或把它当成区区光影把戏而不屑一顾者来说，则致命无比。
From the end of your finger, a glowing bead rockets out, sending your enemies diving for cover—only for nothing to happen. Nothing immediate, that is. The bead hangs in the air, tantalizing . . . and deadly to the unwary or those who dismiss it as a simple trick of the light.

Lich Apprentice With Book.name:
持书的巫妖学徒
Lich Apprentice With Book

Text.text:
学徒那张布满深刻皱纹的脸，以及如云团般堆叠的白发，提醒着你：即便如此，他仍远比他所侍奉的法师年轻得多。他披着一件长及膝下的茄紫色长外套，扣子一直扣到苍白的喉间，衣缘绣着一圈蓝绿色的咒文花丝，闪烁如海上月光。学徒双臂紧紧抱着一本厚重的大书。掩蔽是一团干枯皮革带与黯淡扣具，束在看似兽皮的东西上。或是皮肤。
The apprentice’s heavily wrinkled face and cloud-like mass of white hair remind you that he is still far younger than the wizard he serves. He wears a long aubergine coat buttoned to his pale throat and trimmed in a filigree of blue-green incantations that glimmer like ocean moonlight. The apprentice cradles a large book in both arms. The cover is a mass of dry leather straps and dull buckles over what looks like hide. Or skin.

Potion Of Animal Friendship.name:
动物友谊药水
Potion Of Animal Friendship

Text.text:
轻轻摇晃这只小瓶里黏稠浑浊的溶液，便能看见其中翻涌出来自不同动物的碎块与残片。凑近一闻，你惊恐地发现，它的气味比那令人作呕的外观还要更难入口。
Shaking up the sludgy solution in this vial reveals various chunks and bits from different animals. Sniffing at the contents, you are alarmed to find that its odor is even less appetizing than the off-putting presentation.

Threat From A Quest Giver About Betrayal.name:
来自委托人关于背叛的威胁
Threat From A Quest Giver About Betrayal

Text.text:
“要是你正盘算背叛我，就给我记清楚：这片地界游荡着不少冒险者，他们更听命于钱袋子，而不是良心。只要给上几枚金币，他们就会毫不犹豫把你装进袋子里，拖回我面前。”
“If you’re considering betraying me, know this: There are many adventurers wandering through these parts who are more driven by their coin purse than their ethics. And they won’t hesitate to bring you back to me in bags for a few gold pieces.”

你伸出一只手，触及身周的水意，仿佛被一股巨大起伏的浪潮裹卷其中。你在心中勾勒那水势向外延展，转瞬之间，一道水墙自地面拔地而起。它凝实、澄澈、不可穿透——一面巍然的水之壁垒。
You reach out with a hand and feel the water around you, as if you’re enveloped by a great, undulating wave. You imagine the water stretching outward, and in an instant, a wall rises up out of the ground. It looks solid, clear, and impenetrable—an immense barrier of water.

Sense Of Being Watched From Afar.name:
远处传来的被注视感
Sense Of Being Watched From Afar

Text.text:
你后颈的汗毛根根竖起，那种熟悉的直觉告诉你：有目光正落在你的剪影上。你双眼急速扫视，头颅猛然转动。随即空气在一瞬间凝滞，仿佛整个世界都在屏住呼吸。一抹微光掠过你的视野。肾上腺素贯穿你的感官，将它们骤然放大，让你随时准备应对。可紧接着……寂静。世界重新流动，胸腔里狂跳的心脏成了这段瞬间确曾发生的唯一证明。
The hair on the back of your neck stands up, with the telltale knowledge of eyes falling upon your silhouette. Your eyes dart around, your head swivels. Then the air stills for a moment, as though the world is holding its breath. A flicker of light flits across your vision. Adrenaline fires through your senses, amplifying them, ready to react. But then… silence. The world returns to life, your heart pounding in your chest the only proof that the moment even happened.

机油的气味萦绕在那名侏儒身旁；他戴着铁手套的一只手紧攥着损坏的装置，正埋头修修补补。他咬紧牙关，低声咒骂了一句。随手把那截扭曲的机关零件甩开后，他似乎这才第一次注意到你。透过那副繁复的眼镜，工匠像端详一件坏掉的玩具般打量着你，浓密的眉毛微微一跳。“你他妈是谁？”
The scent of oil surrounds the gnome tinkering with the broken device clutched in one gauntleted hand. They grit their teeth and mutter a curse. Tossing away the twisted piece of artifice, they seem to notice you for the first time. Peering over elaborate spectacles, the artificer appraises you like a broken toy. Their bushy brows twitch. “Who the blazes are you?”

Scorched Forest Illusion Revealed.name:
焦灼森林的幻象揭露
Scorched Forest Illusion Revealed

Text.text:
在郁郁葱葱的密林里，蕨类与棕榈叶梢轻刷，水珠滴答作响。忽然，一切归于寂静。一滴水自宽大的叶面坠下，啪地溅开。紧接着，所有植物的叶缘同时点燃起鲜亮猩红的奥术痕迹，沿着叶脉奔流穿行。灰烬飘落又倏然消散，缕缕青烟升起，丛林的幻象随之崩解，露出被焚灼的荒原——只剩焦黑的树桩、带刺的藤蔓与粗硬的荆丛。

~ 设想：Nachreld

Among the brushing water-drop sounds of ferns and fronds in a lush jungle, there is a sudden quiet. A single drop of water from a broad leaf splashes. Then, along the edges of all the plants, arcane traces of bright red ignite and channel through the leaves. Ash falls and disappears, wisps of smoke rise, and the jungle illusion gives way to a scorched landscape, nothing left but the burnt stumps of trees, thorny vines, and rough brambles.

~ Envisioned by Nachreld

Dungeon: Hot Air.name:
地城：热气球
Dungeon: Hot Air

Text.text:
炽热闷烫的空气充斥着走廊。你越往那热浪辐射的深处推进，汗珠便在额头与护甲下不断渗出。令人窒息的压迫感仿佛从每一块石头里渗出，毫无喘息之机。
Hot, sweltering air fills the corridor. Beads of sweat form on brows and under armor as you press farther into the passage where the heat radiates from. There's no relief from the stifling pressure that seems to emanate from every stone.

Underground Fighting Pit.name:
地下搏斗坑
Underground Fighting Pit

Text.text:
血、汗与尿的腥臊浸透地下坑道里陈腐而潮湿的空气，与四周冷酷的野蛮相互映衬。裸露的混凝土以工业般的残暴将房间封作坟穴——这正是绝佳的角斗场：中央铁笼擂台旁，嗥叫的观众挥舞着赌票，声浪翻涌。暴烈、无情、令人血脉贲张——人性深处兽性的完美展演。
Blood, sweat, and piss marinate the stale, humid air in the underground pit, complementing the stark brutality of the surroundings. Exposed concrete entombs the room with industrial brutality, a fitting arena for the baying crowd of spectators waving betting slips beside the caged ring at the room’s center. Violent, merciless, and thrilling—the perfect exhibition of humanity’s inner animal.

Faerie Carnival Gondolas.name:
妖精嘉年华缆车
Faerie Carnival Gondolas

Text.text:
这一艘是龙，那一艘是天鹅——船身漆亮，修长如刃。船夫们穿着褶边领，脚蹬缀铃的鞋。细长的摇橹探入水中，又转身提起，一次又一次。灯笼从怪模怪样的钩子上垂下，照着水面上的恋人与观星者——他们嚼着小点心，指指点点，从水上望向岸上的狂欢节。一切都像一条碎裂却闪耀的彩虹。
This one a dragon, that one a swan—the boats are lacquered and long. The gondoliers wear ruffled collars and shoes with bells. They drop the long, thin sculling oar, then turn and lift it again and again. Lanterns hang from funny hooks over lovers and stargazers eating treats and pointing from the water to the carnival on land. It is all a shattered, glittering rainbow.

Probing The Server Host.name:
探查服务器主机
Probing The Server Host

Text.text:
在企业网络对公众开放的各个区段间步步为营，一名孤独的黑客俯身细察眼前I/O端口的每一皮米。评估程序固然好用，但要让这名黑客找到猎物，还得靠老练的眼力与几分好运：一道系统后门——由某个粗心的系统架构师遗留——正等着某个像素海盗趁虚而入，取得对内部数据存储的许可。

~ 一位英雄构想

Picking their way through the public-facing sectors of the corporation's network, a lone hacker analyzes every picometer of the I/O port before them. Evaluate programs are all well and good, but a practiced eye and a lot of luck are needed for this hacker to find their quarry: a system backdoor, left by some thoughtless system architect, ripe for some pixel pirate to gain access to internal datastores.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

尽管历经久远年代，这片地域的人们仍精心维系着神殿的门面。的确，在这处圣地里，每一步落足都带着压低的寂静与沉重，仿佛无数祈祷与礼拜仪式的庄严仍在石间回响。即便对神祇之事并不看重的人，也会在此不由得心生敬畏，哪怕只是一瞬。
Despite its great age, the people of this region have maintained the temple’s façade. Indeed, the hush and gravity of each footfall in this sacred spot reflects the solemnity with which countless prayers and ceremonies of worship have been held. Even those who hold little stock in the affairs of gods find themselves humbled, if only momentarily.

Castle's Silver Trumpets.name:
城堡的银号角
Castle's Silver Trumpets

Text.text:
王座厅旁的一间大厅里，存放着王国的礼仪法器：一张华贵长桌上，五支银制长号角并排安放，修长如矛，抛光得寒光流转。旁边整齐叠着一摞毡制纹章旗，正是王室家族的颜色，典礼时会逐一悬挂在每支号角上。号角与竖琴、战鼓、各式弦乐器和乐谱架交错陈列，石墙四周的烛台投下摇曳烛光，将一切映得庄严而肃穆。
In a hall off the throne room, where the official instruments of the realm are kept, five long, polished trumpets of silver lie on a regal table. Next to them is a stack of felt signet banners in the colors of the royal family, ready to hang on each trumpet during ceremony. The horns lie among harps and drums, stringed instruments and music stands, all under the candle sconces around the stone walls.

一片高地坐落在林地之中，一侧被陡峭的断崖封住，另一侧则是短短的落差，恰好形成一处完美的营地空地。色彩斑斓的拼布帐篷围成一大圈，环绕着篝火，火旁摆着原木当作座位。帐篷边和遮篷下堆着一摞摞的箱子、木条箱与木桶。可把这些东西运来所需的马车却不见踪影。奇怪……
A plateau, bounded on one side by a steep escarpment and a short drop on the other, provides the perfect clearing for a campsite in this woodland. Colorful patchwork-tents stand in a broad circle around a fire with logs for seating. Boxes, crates, and barrels stand in piles beside the tents and under their awnings. The wagons you’d need to cart all this stuff seem to be missing. Strange . . .

Derion's Grave In Winter.name:
德里昂的冬日墓冢
Derion's Grave In Winter

Text.text:
[初访] 一串脚印从两尊雕像之间踏出一条小径，直通左侧第一具石棺。那里的印痕更深，仿佛行人曾在此驻足，随即转身，横穿山顶那弯月形的露台，沿通往小径的台阶下去离开。奇怪的是，来者似乎刻意无视了这片墓地的核心景致。七具棺形石棺呈弧形陈列，中央那具石棺前的地面嵌着一块铭牌；其棺盖上雕着一柄巨剑。铭牌上写着：德里昂，愿他的剑与他的牺牲永不再被需要。

[再访] 破坏雪与自然在此雕琢出的微型景致，似乎有种亵渎之感；可你仍忍不住带着孩童般的快意，踩进雪堆里跋涉，将那片仿若丘陵与谷地的幻象踩得支离破碎。你用脚尖在堆积的雪下探寻记忆中的铭牌。终于摸到它，你拂开积雪，熟悉的铭文再次映入眼帘。

[First visit] A trail of footprints creates a path from between the statues to the first coffin on the left. There the prints are deeper, as if the walker paused before turning and walking across the crescent-shaped patio atop the hill to exit down the stairs that lead to the trail. It seems strange that whoever visited ignored what seems to be the central feature of this grave site. Seven coffin-shaped sarcophagi lie arrayed in an arc with a plaque set in the ground before the central sarcophagus, which has a huge sword carved into its top. The plaque reads: Derion, may his sword and his sacrifice never again be needed.

[Return visit] It seems somehow disrespectful to spoil the artistry of the little landscape of snow nature created here, but you nevertheless feel a childlike glee in wading through the drifts and ruining the illusion of hills and valleys. You use a toe to quest about beneath the drifted snow for the plaque you remember. You find it and brush the snow away to see the familiar inscription.

Emotion-altering Drug, \"Guts\": Inhaled.name:
情绪改写药物“胆气（Guts）”：吸入式
Emotion-altering Drug, "Guts": Inhaled

Text.text:
你按下罐体的触发，猛吸一口勇气的气雾剂量。胸口在突如其来的恐慌中痛苦地绷紧——却只是一瞬。随即思绪澄明，周遭的世界仿佛变了样：与其说危机四伏，不如说遍地都是有趣的挑战。你一闪念想起这股飘飘然褪去时会发生什么，却很快把念头甩开。此刻，后果对你毫无意义。
You press the canister’s trigger and huff a dose of gaseous courage. Your chest clenches painfully in an instant of panic—but only an instant. Your mind clears, and the world around you seems different, not so much rife with threats as it is full of fun challenges. You fleetingly remember what happens when this high wears off, but quickly dismiss the thought. Consequences don’t mean anything to you now.

Sundries From A Skeleton Archer.name:
骷髅弓箭手的杂物
Sundries From A Skeleton Archer

Text.text:
干燥未上油的木弓上，弓弦早已崩断；箭袋里的箭也被碾成齑粉——在这堆枯骨与断枝里，已无物可取。
With the bowstring snapped on a dry, unoiled wooden bow—and the arrows in the quiver smashed to dust—there is nothing to pick out of this pile of bone and twig.

Tribal Archer Adorned With Feathers.name:
羽饰部族弓手
Tribal Archer Adorned With Feathers

Text.text:
一名弓手将石制箭镞稳稳对准她的目标，凌乱的眉毛凶狠地压在一双宝石蓝的眼眸之上。她那一头长发赤如炉火，被扎成两束垂在身后，点缀着翠绿羽饰，鲜亮得如同初春最早的嫩芽。持弓的那只手僵硬而稳固，刺着与她面庞同样的紫罗兰色菘蓝纹染——脸颊与眉骨被流动起伏的线条涂绘其上。
An archer trains a stone arrowhead on her target, her unkempt brows bent fiercely over eyes the color of sapphires. Her locks of long hair, red as hearth fire, are tied out of the way in two tails adorned with green feathers as bright as the first signs of spring. The hand holding the bow in rigid place is tattooed with the same violet woad that marks her face— cheek and brow painted with fluid and waving lines.

几句简短的咒言与一个迅捷的手势，便足以解开你脑海中的奥秘之结，放出疾驰的纯粹魔法飞矢。蓝白光辉的力之泪滴在空气中滋滋作响，俯冲如椋鸟般迅疾，飞行无偏无误。
A few curt words and a swift gesture are all it takes to unravel an arcane knot in your mind and unleash swift darts of pure magic. Glowing teardrops of blue-white force sizzle through the air, swooping swift as starlings, unerring in their flight.

你用指间碾碎蚱蜢的后腿，一缕翠绿能量火花自你手中迸跃而出。你接触目标生物，在一阵移动的残影中，对方便猛然跃入空中。
You grind the grasshopper leg between your fingers, and a spark of green energy leaps from your hand. You touch the intended creature, and in a blur of movement, they leap into the air.

群星闪烁，在头顶缓缓旋转，铺成一顶光之穹幕。你的目光在星辉云海间捕捉到奇异而迷人的轮廓——星座勾勒出远古的神祇与英雄，也并列着巨龙与恶徒。偶尔，银与金的光痕横贯天际——坠落的星辰，向大地疾坠时在空中燃尽，只在短暂一瞬绚丽夺目，随即光芒永远消逝。
Twinkling, the stars wheel overhead, a canopy of light. Your eyes find strange and alluring shapes within the clouds of starlight, constellations depicting gods and heroes of ages past alongside dragons and villains. Occasionally, streaks of silver and gold race across the sky—falling stars, burning up as they rocket toward the ground, beautiful for a brief moment before their light fades forever.

Dwarven Rune Suit.name:
矮人符文战衣
Dwarven Rune Suit

Text.text:
奥术的辉光自这套强力护甲内部弥漫而出，随佩戴者的心跳脉动起伏。胸甲上嵌着一枚澄澈夺目的宝石，迸射出灿然光芒，为那神秘装置注入动力；护甲板上更被匠心雕刻出一道道符文，每一道都泛着柔和的蓝光。与之形成鲜明对照的是，这套护甲那柄可怖的巨斧炽红如烙，燃着熔炉般的怒焰。
An arcane glow suffuses the powerful suit from within and pulses in time with the wearer’s heart. A gem of brilliant clarity is embedded in the suit’s breastplate, shining with radiant light as it powers the mysterious device, and runes have been expertly carved into the armor plates, each one aglow with soft blue light. In contrast, the suit’s formidable axe glows red hot with the fury of the forge.

Space Goblin Zaperator.name:
空间地精扎佩雷托
Space Goblin Zaperator

Text.text:
这只渺小的生物尖声吱叫，放肆地欢笑着，以不可思议的精力蹦跳腾挪。他们那张绿色的脸被一抹灿烂的笑容占据，细密成排的尖刺牙齿森然外露，两只猩红的眼睛在其上方凶光毕露。它们身上的战衣仿佛由不稳定的山寨科技拼凑而成，随着生物过度亢奋的动作吱呀作响、火花四溅。它们吐出舌头，肆无忌惮地挥舞着一把参差缺口的短剑。
Yipping with wanton glee, this maniacal tiny creature hops and skips with an impossible energy. Their green face is dominated by a beaming smile, thin rows of spiky teeth, and two scarlet eyes glaring out above. The suit they wear seems constructed of unstable bootleg tech, creaking and sparking with the creature’s hyperactive movements. They stick out their tongue, waving a jagged shortsword with reckless abandon.

Large Iceberg Near At Sea.name:
近海处的一座巨大冰山
Large Iceberg Near At Sea

Text.text:
它的体量庞大到让你一时难以察觉——你起初在辽阔海面上当作岛屿的那块巨影，其实是一座冰山，正缓缓漂过冰冷刺骨的海水。冰山一侧陡峭的冰壁上留着道道伤痕，昭示它最初从来处的冰川崩裂脱离的那一刻。
It takes a moment to realize it from its sheer enormity, but what you initially take to be an island in the vast sea is in fact an iceberg, floating slowly through the chilled waters. The marks along one sheer side show you where it initially broke free of the glacier from which it came.

一顶交织的柳枝冠冕点缀着坐在你面前的树精的头颅。她的王座自橡木本体生长而出，与木纹融为一体，又被千年的使用磨得光润如镜。她并不高大，可那份王者的仪态与端正的姿势令人折服。她的肌肤如腐殖土般赭褐，眼眸却像芭蕉叶上的露珠般清澈晶亮。轻轻蠕动的藤蔓构成她的发丝，异域的花瓣披覆在她身上。她向你致意时，笑意如正午阳光般温暖地照进你心里。
A crown of interwoven willow branches adorns the head of the dryad sitting before you. Her throne is grown into the very wood of an oak, polished by millennia of use. She isn’t tall, but her regal bearing and posture impress. Her skin is the umber of loam, her eyes like dew on a banana leaf. Stirring vines make up her hair, while exotic flower petals drape her body. Her smile warms you like noonday sun as she greets you.

元素的狂潮呼啸着向你扑来，你猛然伸手一挥。你的手势唤出一面由旋转的、绚烂变幻的光彩织成的幽影护盾，迎面吞下冲击的大半。护盾随之凝成单一的色泽——与它吸收的能量相呼应——并迅速收缩，化作缠绕你手掌的耀眼光环：一缕残存的元素之力，任你在下一次攻击时一并释放。
You throw out your hand as the elemental onslaught hurtles toward you. Your gesture conjures a spectral shield of swirling, chromatic hues that absorbs the brunt of the impact. The shield turns a uniform color—in accordance with the energy it absorbed—and shrinks down to a shining nimbus around your hand: a leftover bit of elemental power, yours to unleash alongside your next attack.

Elven Frost Mage.name:
精灵霜寒法师
Elven Frost Mage

Text.text:
精灵邪术师的脸几乎无法看清，被冰霜结晶的兜帽那圈蓬松毛领紧紧埋住，兜在一袭长而沉重的袍子之上。骤然被召来的天气倾下冰粒般的冻雨，噼啪砸落。寒霜在邪术师的肩头聚起，沿着袍摆爬行，仿佛与寒冷结下了漫长的旧交——低沉含混的咒语、袖口抬起时细碎的沙沙作响、厚实手套下手指游动的涟漪。自那双手中，冰冷的触须穿过风暴蜿蜒滑出。

~ Played by Colby from d4: D&D Deep Dive

The elvish warlock's face is nearly impossible to see, nestled as it is inside the fluffy ruff of a rime-encrusted hood atop a long, heavy robe. Pelting sleet falls from sudden, conjured weather. Frost gathers on the warlock's shoulders, frost runs along the robe's hem, as if a long relationship with the cold has formed the muffled incantation, the sleeves that crinkle as they rise, the ripple of fingers moving under thick mittens. From those hands, icy tentacles slither out through the storm.

~ Played by Colby from d4: D&D Deep Dive

Joke About A Mermaid.name:
关于美人鱼的笑话
Joke About A Mermaid

Text.text:
“曾经，在我年轻时，我爱上过一位美人鱼。可惜，我们终究渐行渐远。”
“Once, in my youth, I fell in love with a mermaid. Unfortunately, we drifted apart.”

这座小小的锥形丘陵从周遭地貌中突兀挺起，仿佛天生就是建造瞭望塔或堡垒的绝佳位置。也许它曾经确实矗立过那样的建筑，但你在它陡峭而草覆的坡面上，看不出任何遗迹的痕迹。
The small conical hill projects from the surrounding landscape, making a perfect spot for a watchtower or fortification. Perhaps it was once home to such a building, but you see no sign of structures on its steep and grassy slopes.

Sailors Enthralled By Sea Hag.name:
被海鬼婆蛊惑的水手们
Sailors Enthralled By Sea Hag

Text.text:
水手们攀在木质舷墙与索具上，绷紧身子想辨清那缥缈歌声从何处飘来。你环顾四周，只见他们脸上写满亢奋，笑意灿烂，却与那双空洞失焦的眼神形成刺目的反差。一具纤细而充满诱惑的身影坐在船旁的礁石上，你不由自主地被牵引着向前。就在你的感官重新校准、意识猛地将你拽回的刹那，你看清那身影已化作一名衰老畸形的女人，咧开怪诞的狞笑，双手挥舞，仿佛正拽动一根看不见的绳索。
Sailors hang from wooden bulwarks and riggings, straining to identify the source of the ethereal singing drifting through the air. You look around and see the enthused expressions on their faces, their smiles in complete contrast to the vacant stare of their eyes. A lithe, sensual form sits on a rock by the ship, and you feel yourself drawn forward. Right as your senses recalibrate and your mind pulls you sharply back, you notice the form has become an old, deformed woman with a grotesque grin, waving her hands as if pulling on an invisible rope.

Gnome Clockwork Toy.name:
侏儒发条玩具
Gnome Clockwork Toy

Text.text:
这玩偶约莫老鼠般的体型，蹲踞在粗短的铜色弓形腿上。一只金属手叉在腰间，另一只则把一根细小的铁杖举在身前。它的脸毫无生气，眼睛像两只扁平的金属盘。身躯仿佛一床金属拼被，由金、青铜与铜片缝缀而成，缝线是一种细得诡异的金属丝。每隔几秒，就有一缕明亮的湛蓝火花沿着其中一根细丝疾驰而下，旋即无声消失。
The toy is about the size of a rat and stands on squat copper bow-legs. One metallic hand rests on a hip, the other holds a tiny staff of iron in front of it. Its face is lifeless, the eyes flat pans. The body is a metallic quilt of gold, bronze, and copper plates stitched together with a strange fine wire. Every few seconds, a tiny bright blue spark runs down the length of one of the wires and disappears.

Talented Busker.name:
天赋街头艺人
Talented Busker

Text.text:
她闭着眼，随着曼陀林的拨弦低声吟唱；那名街头艺人竟让一支朴素的小调也充满了节拍，飘荡在空气里。路过的人不由得扬起笑意，被她看似毫不费力的技艺所感染。她凳子前的路面上放着一顶帽子，半满着铜币，间或也有几枚银币。
Eyes closed as she croons in accompaniment to the strumming of her mandolin, the busker manages to make her simple tune fill the air with rhythm, and people walking by can’t help but smile at her effortless-looking artistry. In front of her stool, a hat lies on the road, half-full with copper and the occasional silver.

她将一条长长的编藤绳索缠在脚踝上，另一端牢牢系在嵌入岩岸深处的木桩圆钩上。随即，她以优雅的弧线纵身入水，划开澄澈如晶的水面，潜向浅滩，搜寻那份珍贵的馈赠。
After tethering a long, braided vine around her ankle and anchoring it to a round hook on a post driven deep into the rocky shore, the woman dives in a graceful arc, bisecting the crystal-clear water in search of the shoal’s precious bounty.

Sundries From A Quasit.name:
夸塞魔的杂货
Sundries From A Quasit

Text.text:
这只微小的夸塞魔不穿衣服，自然也就没有暗袋可供翻找出宝藏。你或许能把它那对修长、碧绿、向后弯曲的尖角割下来当作战利品——将它们从那颗小小的头颅上猛拽下来，会是件轻而易举却血腥不堪的勾当。
The tiny quasit does not wear clothes, so no hidden pockets to be rifled through for treasure. You might be able to harvest its long, green, recurved horns as a trophy—yanking them free from the small head would prove a simple if grisly act.

巨兽自河中昂然升起，瀑水般的水流从它的毛皮上倾泻成道，轰然垂落；它投下的骇人阴影压过你的身形。扁平的面孔前，一只如船艏般的巨喙挺出；它那带蹼的鳍足上，每一根都长着凶狠的利爪。一条巨大而皮革般的尾巴在河流的水势里摆荡，搅乱水道的流向，让水面蜿蜒的纹路都被打碎。篮球般大小的珠眼带着好奇，牢牢盯住你不放。你今天本不该遇见这样的怪物。

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

Rising from the river, the titanic creature casts a terrifying shadow across you as water cascades from its fur in great rivulets. A mighty bill like a ship's prow juts from its flattened face, and the creature's webbed flippers each bear vicious claws. A huge, leathery tail sways in the river currents, disrupting the flow of the water as it meanders. Beady eyes the size of basketballs fix you with a curious stare. You were not prepared to meet such a beast today.

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

嶙峋扭曲的枝桠彼此绞合，织成一顶密不透风的穹盖，像棺盖般压在小径上。你在旅行时，空气里沉甸甸地悬着一片窒息的寂静，将你裹进喧嚣般的死寂之中；靴底下陷，没入脚下霉烂的泥土。每一步都从这片被诅咒的土壤里挤出一股新鲜的腐朽恶臭——那是少数先行者留下的见证。

~ 由 Thunder God Envisioned

Gnarled, twisting branches knit together to form an impenetrable canopy, pressing down on the trail like a coffin lid. A suffocating silence hangs heavy in the air as you travel, enveloping you in a cacophonous stillness as your boots sink into the moldering earth beneath you. Each step releases a fresh aroma of rot and decay from the cursed soil—a testament to those few who came before you.

~ Envisioned by Thunder God

施法者无声一念之间，一圈利刃在五码直径的圆环中凭空成形，以毁灭性的弧光横扫四周的一切目标。每一柄刀刃皆为幽影般的幻现，仿佛自异界召来。
At a motionless word from the caster, a ring of blades materializes in a five-foot circle, cleaving all nearby targets in a devastating arc. Each blade is a spectral apparition, as if conjured from another realm.

I Have Thief's Reflexes.name:
我有盗贼的反射神经
I Have Thief's Reflexes

Text.text:
速度至关重要。麻烦一冒头，我便以千锤百炼的敏捷立刻回应，力求抢先一步压制敌人。我行动如风，疾驰奔向必须抵达之处。随后我停下脚步，迅速将局势尽收眼底……再度出手。
Speed is crucial. When trouble starts, I respond with practiced alacrity, trying to get the drop on my foes. I act swiftly, racing to where I need to be. Then I pause to take in the situation… and act again.

The Treasury Of Petra.name:
佩特拉宝库
The Treasury Of Petra

Text.text:
金库经营着已知世界的每一种钱币，也接受以物易物，因此库藏里塞满了稀奇古怪、甚至有时笨重难挪的交易之物。这里的银行家温和而讲理，站在那片沙质的三角形地面上，向来客逐条讲清银行的规矩；地面四周，是层层阶梯般的库墙拔地而起，高耸如崖。契约以漂浮的纸草卷轴显现，需以黑墨签署——每一份都带着魔法的约束力。金库自有一股令人心悸的神秘感，因为它的规条由强力的诅咒与召唤法术来执行。
The treasury deals in every coin of the known world and is open to barter, so its holdings are full of unusual, and sometimes unwieldy, forms of trade. Its bankers are kind and clear, explaining every rule of the bank to patrons on the sandy triangular floor, which is surrounded by towering walls of terraced vaults. Contracts appear as floating papyrus, to be signed in black ink—each magically binding. There is a scary mystique to the Treasury, for its rules are enforced by powerful curses and summoning spells.

Professor Emeritus.name:
荣誉退休教授
Professor Emeritus

Text.text:
他住在离高塔半英里的整洁端正的屋子里，从窗前就能望见学院、它的花园与球场，于是得以回忆。腹中微微发福，柔软得令人安心。你被请坐，端上一只盘子；临走时，还借你一本书带回去。  
他的名望一部分来自教学奖项，更大一部分来自数十年的战斗。他为爱的魔法而战，为爱之自由而战——只要双方自愿、心智成熟，便能去爱任何想爱的人。他的衰老先于肉身，也先于那庸常的世界终于把自身的恶意当作一回事。
He lives in a neat and proper house a half mile from the tower, so he can see the Academy, its gardens and playing fields, and remember. He is happily soft in the middle. You are offered a seat and a plate, the loan of a book when you leave. His fame derives partly from teaching awards, more from his decades of battle. He fought for the magic of love, for the freedom to love whomever one loves in consent and maturity. He aged before his body and before the quotidian world considered its malice.

Inventor In The Net.name:
网中发明家
Inventor In The Net

Text.text:
你眼前的数码化身影，是自动化奇迹的典范，亦是与有形世界深度共鸣的楷模。他的心跳与齿轮的铿锵、回路的嗡鸣同频共振。每当齿轮转动，他的匠艺便盛放。网络是他的画布，机器在他革新的巧思中苏醒。于机巧之境，他的天才具象成形。

~ 由一位英雄 设想

The digitized form before you is a paragon of automated miracles, an exemplar with a deep affinity with the tangible world. His heart beats in time with the clank of gears and the hum of circuits. When cogs spin, his artistry blooms. The net is his canvas, machines brought to life with innovative ingenuity. In the realm of artifice, his genius manifests.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Dangerous Asteroid Belt In Binary Star S.name:
双星系统中的危险小行星带
Dangerous Asteroid Belt In Binary Star System

Text.text:
轨道带宽广无垠，是一段漫长的穿越之旅，由无数细小岩块在近乎离谱的距离里紧密挤压而成。内侧环以每秒二十五公里以上的速度疾驰，随着碎带向远离太阳的方向铺展开去，速度也略微递减。规划航线得交给AI的三角学，因为在这片碎带之中，微小事件便会掀起混沌，让数十亿枚致命碎片的轨迹纷乱无章。
The orbital belt is wide, a long traverse, and composed of small rocks in outrageously close proximity. The inside ring moves at more than twenty-five kilometers per second, the speed grading down slightly as the belt spreads away from the sun. Plotting a nav course is for the AI’s trigonometry because, within the belt, micro-events create chaos in the paths of billions of lethal pieces.

一声尖锐的鸣啸撕裂空气，一颗细小的脑袋从水面猛地昂起，蜥蜴般的轮廓裹着湿滑的黏润。紧接着，一条修长而富有韧性的长颈浮现，足有十余英尺之长。它所引领的躯体宛如海中巨兽——庞大如鲸，却在挥动长鳍、扭身转向时透出某种优雅。颅骨的眼窝里嵌着一对细小的眼珠，闪烁着深渊才懂的智慧。
A keen cry breaks the air and a tiny head rears up from the water, lizard-like and blubbery. Then, a long and tensile neck appears, more than ten feet long. The body it precedes is that of a leviathan—huge and whalelike, and yet somewhat elegant as it flaps its long fins to pivot itself. Beady eyes sit in the sockets of the skull, glimmering with knowledge of the depths.

Bloody Eldritch Blast.name:
染血的玄秘冲击波
Bloody Eldritch Blast

Text.text:
当你汲取契约主的权能时，空气里升起一种魔宠般熟悉的静电噼啪。魔法在你体内奔涌鼓噪，迫不及待要被释放。伴随一声刺耳的尖啸，你张开嘴，在魔法抵达巅峰的瞬间，任由一股血瀑喷涌而出。你与敌人目光相锁，看着那猩红的箭矢破空飞驰，细细品味他们脸上镌刻的恐惧。点点血沫溅污你的外衣，也将你的牙齿染成暗红的颜色。

~ 由 thebigham 在Discord上构想

A familiar static charge builds in the air as you draw on the powers of your patron. The magic surges within you, eager to be unleashed. With an ear-piercing shriek, you open your mouth as you feel the magic reach its apex, allowing a torrent of blood to pour forth. Locking eyes with your foe as the sanguine bolt flies through the air, you savor the terror etched into their face. Flecks of vitae stain your tunic and your teeth a ruddy hue.

~ Envisioned by thebigham on Discord

Xyola Merlan, Bard Of Blackspot.name:
克索拉·梅兰，黑斑吟游诗人
Xyola Merlan, Bard Of Blackspot

Text.text:
就算这名半身人女子并未奔跑，她也足以让你的目光不由自主地被拽过去。她从头到脚裹着贴身的黑衣，银线在布料间游走；她纤巧的身形上，十余把小刀的宝石刀柄点点闪烁，如同一串凌乱却危险的星光。那头鲜红的头发更是夺目——看上去她正是有意为之，发丝向四面八方竖起，像一团燃起的荆棘火。她披着一件微光流转的斗篷，可它并未随着她的移动在身后飘扬，反倒被一只塞得鼓鼓囊囊、尺寸夸张的背包压住，拖在脚边拍打着地面；那背包随着每一步上下颠簸，仿佛装着一整场喧闹。

这一身闪光与移动的混乱，快得让人来不及细看，却仍有一个古怪的细节硬生生钻入你的视线：几条蛇缠在她的脖颈上。待她逼近，你不得不修正这个判断，并在下巴差点掉下来的瞬间得出结论——那不是几条蛇，而是一条长着三颗头的蛇！
The halfling would catch your eye even if she weren’t running. Dressed head to foot in clingy black that is threaded with silver, her lithe form glitters with the jeweled handles of a dozen small knives. Her bright red hair also attracts attention, which it seems intended to do given that it is spiked in every direction. She wears a shimmering cloak, but rather than flow behind her as she moves, it flaps by her feet, trapped under an overstuffed and overlarge backpack that bounces with every step. This little riot of sparkle and movement seems too much to take in a swift glance, but you can’t help but notice one more curious detail: Snakes twine around her neck. As she nears, you’re forced to correct that impression while making a jaw-dropping conclusion: It’s one snake with three heads!

I Catch My Dwarven Thrower On Its Return.name:
我在矮人掷锤回旋返程时一把接住它
I Catch My Dwarven Thrower On Its Return Flight

Text.text:
宛如神祇掷下的雷霆，我的战锤以令人心惊的冲击力呼啸着飞回我伸出的手中。我在它回返的途中将其一把接住，握柄撞上掌心的瞬间，震颤沿着手臂窜起。锤身那刻满符文的表面掠过一抹微光。
Like a thunderbolt from the gods, my hammer rushes back to my outstretched hand with jarring force. I catch it on its return flight, feeling the impact as the handle strikes my palm. A shimmer passes across the hammer’s rune-marked surface.

Quip About Warrior Parents.name:
关于武人父母的俏皮话
Quip About Warrior Parents

Text.text:
“你自以为是战士？我最早的记忆，就是为战斗而训练。慈爱的母亲会朝我掷来各种各样的东西，考验我的反应。许多时候，父母会把我丢下很长一段时间，只为衡量我的求生本能。也许有人不认同，但我知道，他们的用意就是把我锻造成今日这般无可匹敌的斗士。”
“You think yourself a warrior? My earliest memories are of training for combat. My loving mother would hurl all manner of objects at me to test my reactions. Often, my parents would abandon me for long stretches of time just to judge my survival instincts. Some may disagree, but I know their intentions were to form me into the peerless fighter I am today.”

她踏着林间小径，带着俏皮的轻快蹦跳前行；阳光穿过摇曳的枝叶，在她雪白如玉的肌肤上洒下斑驳光影。这个年轻女子贪恋着生命里的每一瞬。细长、末端如铲的尾巴欢快地左右甩动，随她嬉闹而起；清亮的笑声咕嘟嘟地溢出，给周遭都染上了青春的热烈与喜悦。雪白的发间生出犄角，宛如早春第一朵花刺破霜冻：每一根在根部都淡得近乎透明，向上渐渐过渡成浓烈的深红——只是四根之中，有一根已经折断。她抬起那双宽大的红宝石眼眸，望向澄澈发亮的蓝天，唇角含笑，心满意足地沉浸在当下的甜美里，让其余一切都淡去。

~ Played by ParadoxialChaos

Skipping playfully along the forest trail, the sun through the swaying boughs dappling her alabaster skin, a young woman relishes every moment of her life. A thin, spade-tipped tail swishes happily as she cavorts, her bubbling laughter infusing all around her with youthful exuberance and joy. Horns sprout from snow-white hair, like the first flowers of spring breaking through the frost, each one delicately pale at the root shifting to a robust crimson gradient as it ascends—though one of the four has been broken. Turning her wide, ruby-red eyes to the lustrous blue sky she smiles, content to bask in the delights of the present moment and let all else fade away.

~ Played by ParadoxialChaos

Breakfast At An Inn.name:
旅店的早餐
Breakfast At An Inn

Text.text:
鸡蛋、豆子、培根，以及更多食物摆满了你面前这间路边小客栈的小桌，缕缕蒸汽蜿蜒盘旋，撩拨着你的感官，预告着即将入口的美味。一只硕大的茶壶居于餐点正中，瓷身磕缺、釉色褪淡，却像是在诉说它曾为无数旅人奉上的温暖与慰藉。笑容可掬的老板在这份令人垂涎的丰盛前忙前忙后，细细照拂每一样都恰到好处，好让你以最踏实的饱足迎接上路的一天。

~ 构想：Ryan Moroch

Eggs, beans, bacon, and more fill the table before you in this small roadside inn, curling tendrils of steam tantalizing your senses for the delights to come. A large teapot serves as the meal centerpiece, its chipped and faded porcelain a testament to the comfort it has brought countless travelers before you. The smiling owner fusses over the mouth-watering spread, ensuring everything is perfect to start your day on the road.

~ Envisioned by Ryan Moroch

Cargo Hauler: Run-down Bridge.name:
货运拖船：破败的舰桥
Cargo Hauler: Run-down Bridge

Text.text:
狭窄的舰桥里，沿墙排开的肮脏控制台上堆满杂物；一个邋遢的男人把粗硬的靴子搁在磨损的舰长座椅那剥落的皮革上。循环再生的空气又闷又馊，混着刺鼻的汗臭；一块霓虹招牌忽明忽暗，时而噼啪迸火、时而熄灭，间歇性地把房间照亮。
Detritus litters the grubby consoles lining the cramped bridge, and a slovenly man rests his rugged boots atop the peeling leather of a worn captain’s chair. The recycled air is stale, laced with the acrid scent of body odor, and a flickering neon sign illuminates the room periodically as it sparks in and out of life.

Cabinet Of A Manor.name:
庄园壁柜
Cabinet Of A Manor

Text.text:
这间屋里摆着一张结实的橡木长桌，几乎有三十英尺长，桌边沿周围摆着二十多把椅子；最讲究的那张座椅在远侧，属于庄园领主。在这样的厅室里，国政在此议定，战事在此筹划，命令在此定夺，而每一笔牵系全境臣民福祉的账目也都在此核审。
The solid oak table in this room is nearly thirty feet long, with more than two dozen chairs around its perimeter, the most well-appointed seat, on the far side, belonging to the lord of the manor. In rooms like this, matters of state are discussed, wars strategized and orders solidified, and accounts affecting the welfare of every subject of the realm audited.

长长的木桌贯穿整间房，左右配着矮长凳。远墙上一座巨大的壁炉张着口，炉台雕得隐约像一张脸，内里漆黑、烟灰熏染。空气里残留着陈旧的汗味、泼洒的麦酒气息与烤肉的余香。
Long wooden tables run the length of the room, flanked by low benches. A huge hearth, carved to look vaguely like a face, yawns, darkly sooted, on the far wall. The smell of stale sweat, spilled ale, and roast meat lingers on the air.

Dim Hate Group Extremist.name:
昏暗的仇恨团体极端分子
Dim Hate Group Extremist

Text.text:
唾沫从他龟裂发黄的牙缝里飞溅而出，男人冲着一名百无聊赖的警官咆哮。那名暴徒的躯干与脖颈上爬满纹身，线条粗糙、参差不齐，显然出自一个热情有余却手艺拙劣的业余爱好者之手。一段粗鄙又冒犯的口号刚起头，便煽动起他那群剃着光头的同伙动了起来，他随即挥拳砸出。
Spit flies from between cracked yellow teeth as a man bellows in the face of a bored police officer. The tattoos covering the thug’s torso and neck are crude and irregular, clearly the work of an enthusiastic—but decidedly unskilled—amateur. The beginning of a boorish and offensive chant incites his shaven-headed brethren to action, and he swings a punch.

尽管你面前的男人披着上流社会的华丽外衣，他的目光却带着锋芒，宛如刽子手的利斧。那笑容迷人而得体，却没有半分真挚的怜悯与善意的温度，像一张精心描绘的面具。他英俊的脸上有一道深深的创伤，虽早已愈合，却依旧以疤痕的形状留存。
Though the man before you is clad in the trappings of high society there is an edge to his gaze, like an executioner’s axe. His smile is charming and polite but lacks the warmth of genuine compassion or good will, like a painted mask. A deep wound mars his handsome face, though the scar has long since healed.

一声低沉的咆哮将你的注意力牵向灌木丛，野兽拨开枝叶现身，碧绿的眼睛带着捕食者般的冷冽清明打量着你。这生物看起来像一头巨大的美洲豹，背脊却竖起一排排交叠的长刺，宛如豪猪。不管它究竟是什么，有一点无可置疑——这生物绝不可轻易招惹。
A low growl draws your attention to the undergrowth as the beast emerges, its green eyes appraising you with predatory clarity. The creature resembles a large jaguar, yet its back bristles with long spines in overlapping rows, like a porcupine. Whatever it is, one thing is certain—this creature is not to be trifled with.

摊主和买主一开始就满腹冒犯，转眼又惊得目瞪口呆，随后陷入困惑，最终几乎要被对方的愚蠢与腐败彻底淹没。空气里塞满了他们的嗓音。他们嚎叫着，呼唤一位神——或好几位。诅咒彼此的生日，也诅咒自己的。忽然一阵冷场。接着，一个新报价打破沉默。又一阵停顿后，反报价随之而来——一句试探的提问。声音渐渐放软。他们抛出些体面而文明的可能性。钱币在钱袋里叮当作响。
The stall keeper and the buyer begin at offended, move quickly to amazed, then confused, finally nearly overwhelmed with the stupidity and corruption of the other. The air fills with their voices. They howl, call a god, or several. Curse one another’s birthdays and their own. There is a lull. Then a new offer breaks the silence. A counteroffer follows another pause—a question. Their voices soften. They offer civilized possibilities. Coins chink in purses.

Carnival Performers' Tent.name:
嘉年华艺人帐篷
Carnival Performers' Tent

Text.text:
当你踏入嘉年华中心那顶巨大的帐篷时，几乎不知该先看向哪里。你的目光最先落在一位美人鱼身上：她被封在一颗巨大的水晶水球里，浑身光辉流转，以你此生未闻的绝美旋律为你歌唱。她周围的人群被表演牢牢攫住，有的人甚至毫不掩饰地喜极而泣。帐篷的另一端，一名矮人女子站在一座临时搭起的塔上，留着光泽夺目的红色长辫胡须，佯装困厄，向你呼救，恳求你助她逃离苦境。孩子们咯咯笑作一团：一个灰烬般肤色的男人从你身旁舞过，宽松的丝衣在他身上化作红与黄的炫目残影；他头顶与双手燃着火焰，烤着棉花糖，挨个分给围观者。房间中央的高台上，两名红皮的人形生物以阴郁而优雅的姿态伫立，弧形长角更衬得他们锋芒逼人。尽管这对搭档举手投足宛如王侯，却只披着破烂褴褛的衣物，手腕上拖着叮当作响的奴役枷锁。

~ 由 Clara C. Potter 在 Discord 上为 Envisioned 构想

It's hard to know where to look first as you enter the large tent at the carnival's center. Your gaze first settles on the shimmering magnificence of a mermaid in a huge globe of water, serenading you with the most beautiful music you have ever heard. The crowd around her are enthralled by her performance, some openly weeping with joy. At the far side of the tent, a dwarven woman with a lustrous, braided, red beard feigns distress from a makeshift tower, calling out for you to help her escape her plight. Children giggle with delight as a man with ash-gray skin dances past you, his loose silk clothing a scintillating blur of reds and yellows as he roasts marshmallows in the blaze crowning his head and hands them out to the crowd. On a raised dais in the center of the room two red-skinned humanoids stand with brooding grace, sweeping horns adding to their striking appearance. Though the pair carry themselves like royalty, they wear tattered rags and bear the rattling burdens of servitude on their wrists.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Calesvolus, The Ruby.name:
卡莱斯沃卢斯，「红宝石」
Calesvolus, The Ruby

Text.text:
这名红宝石鳞片的狗头人筋肉精瘦，哪怕披着那套伤痕累累的板甲，也能看出线条紧实；他肩扛其上，竟不见丝毫吃力。深陷的眼窝里，一双眼猩红如新洒的血，恰到好处地衬出他那件朱红的战袍。与他比例宽阔的背脊上，两件带鞘兵刃被结实的皮革背带牢牢束住：一柄饱经厮杀的长剑，以及一支双侧带倒钩、造型仿佛掷出雷霆的标枪。不远处，一头巨大的红色幼龙伏卧休憩，守夜般期待地望着它的主人；一面出奇宽大的路障盾半搭在它的后躯上，通过一副设计精巧的鞍具固定其间。

~ Played by Caliburnus

The ruby-scaled kobold’s wiry musculature is quite obviously well-toned even under the battered plate armor he shoulders without apparent effort. His deeply set eyes, as crimson as freshly shed blood, perfectly set off his vermilion tabard. Across his proportionately broad back, a pair of sheathed weapons are strapped to a practical leather harness: a longsword that has seen more than its share of battle, and a javelin, barbed on both sides and styled after a bolt of thrown lightning. Nearby, a large red drake in repose watches its master expectantly, a surprisingly large barricade shield lies partially across its hindquarters, strapped to its cunningly designed saddle.

~ Played by Caliburnus

Create Food And Water, With A Serving Of.name:
造粮与水，外加一份蔬菜
Create Food And Water, With A Serving Of Veggies

Text.text:
魔法的余波渐渐平息，一席朴素的餐食已在你面前铺开。褐色面包的长条与坚韧的烟熏肉块并列，旁边堆着大量煮熟的根茎蔬菜。它或许并非为取悦味蕾而设，但足以填饱你与同伴的肚子。至少你们的杯中盛满了干净的清水，能帮你们把这些东西硬咽下去。
The magic settles, and before you stands a modest feast. Loaves of brown bread and hunks of tough smoked meats sit alongside a plethora of boiled root vegetables. It may not be designed to fill with pleasure, but it will satiate you and your allies' appetites. At least your cups are full of clean water to help you choke it all down.

在洞窟幽深处，你踉跄撞见一幕令人心悸的景象。一座乌黑的方尖碑自冥黯的黑暗中拔地而起，阴森的存在感扭曲着投影，将一幅冰冷的死亡图景笼罩在诡谲阴影之下。其尖顶之上悬着一座倒置的金字塔——恶毒腐化的象征，向潮湿的空气中渗出令人窒息的压迫。石室里弥漫着被驯服的恶意臭味，粘稠的低语牵扯着你的心神。
In the depths of the cavern, you stumble on an unnerving sight. An ebon obelisk rises in the stygian darkness, its ominous presence casting twisted shadows over a chilling tableau of death. Above its peak hangs an inverted pyramid, an icon of malevolent corruption, bleeding oppression into the damp air. The chamber reeks of harnessed malevolence, and turgid whispers tug at your mind.

Programmable Animated Tattoos.name:
可编程的动态纹身
Programmable Animated Tattoos

Text.text:
男人身上的纹身短暂闪烁，随即像滚动广告牌般切换成下一幅图案。它们隔一阵就会循环一次，每次都呈现一段全新的动态画面。你正看着，男人手臂上那颗大笑的骷髅在一片二进制雪花的模糊中瞬间跳变，取而代之的是一个眨眼的性感女郎，骑跨在一枚火箭之上。
The tattoos on the man's body flicker briefly before shifting to the next design like a rolling billboard. They cycle every so often, each time depicting a new animated piece. As you watch, you see the laughing skull on the man's arm switch in a blur of binary static, and a winking pinup astride a rocket takes its place.

A Destructive Bolt Of Eldritch Blast.name:
毁灭性的玄奥冲击光束
A Destructive Bolt Of Eldritch Blast

Text.text:
你吟诵咒文，划出熟稔的手势，召来一股由你的守护者赐下的原始力量——一团能量在你掌心中央凝聚翻涌。随着你的号令，法术疾射而出，化作你契约的毁灭性能量箭矢，具现于世。
Reciting the incantation and tracing the practiced gestures, you summon a raw force—bestowed by your patron—and a ball of energy coalesces, churning in the center of your hand. At your command the spell flies, a destructive bolt of your pact made manifest.

I Drink My Tonic Of Relief.name:
我饮下解脱滋补剂
I Drink My Tonic Of Relief

Text.text:
