痛楚如潮水般一波波冲刷过我，令人窒息的浪头接连砸下，只在下一轮猛攻开始前施舍我片刻喘息。我双手颤抖，伸手去拿那瓶止痛药剂，匆忙仰头灌下，苦涩的滋味让我不由得龇牙。药力立刻起效，随着每一刻流逝，侵袭我身体的力道被一点点削弱。最终，体内那震耳欲聋的哀嚎被压成低沉、钝钝跳动的隐痛。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The pain washes through me in agonizing waves, giving me only moments of respite before the next onslaught begins. With shaking hands, I reach for my tonic of relief and hurriedly gulp it down, wincing at the taste. It takes hold instantly, reducing the force of the assault on my body with each passing moment. Eventually, the roar of anguish within me is reduced to a muted, throbbing ache.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Para Archery Competition.name:
帕拉射箭大赛
Para Archery Competition

Text.text:
人群骤然噤声，下一位弓手推着轮椅滑到射程前。一袭琥珀色斗篷在身后鼓荡，他猛地掀开兜帽，露出半精灵的面容，流瀑般的炽红发丝如余烬般映着光。弓手整备装备时，动作痉挛而不可预测，引得观众低声窃语。最后就位的是开关式释放器上的一枚拉片。他将箭扣上弓弦，拉满弓身，瞄准时身体前后摇晃，移动紊乱而飘忽。释放开关翻转——正中靶心。人群爆发出欢呼，接下来的每一箭都将前一支从中劈开，箭箭相连，声声入心。
A hush falls over the crowd as the next archer wheels up to the range. An amber cloak billows behind them as they throw their hood back to reveal a half-elven visage framed by flowing ember hair. The crowd murmurs as the archer prepares their equipment with spastic and unpredictable movements. The last piece of equipment put into place is a pull tab on a switch release. They clip an arrow to the bowstring and draw back, swaying to and fro with erratic movement as they aim. The release switch flips, then—a perfect bull's-eye. The crowd cheers as subsequent arrows split the previous one down the middle with each shot fired.

Vampire's Manor: Exterior.name:
吸血鬼（特征）的庄园：外观
Vampire's Manor: Exterior

Text.text:
这座庄园宅邸或许曾是雍容华贵、令人屏息的宏伟建筑——可如今只剩破败：荆棘藤蔓肆意攀缠，地基崩裂，墙体摇摇欲坠。庄园阴影下立着一座石质小礼拜堂，尖塔早在多年之前便已倾塌；它的墓园里，墓碑风化褪色，连字迹都辨认不清。庄园本体呈长方形，中央却是一个巨大的露天庭院。庭院核心矗立着一株高耸的枯骨巨树，虬结扭曲、寸草不生，枝桠上却挤满了聒噪啼鸣的乌鸦。窗户被尘埃与厚重帷幕遮得黯淡无光，几乎看不出里面究竟潜藏着什么……
The manor house may have once been a regal, awe-inspiring structure—but it lies now in a state of disrepair, overgrown with thorny vines, on crumbling foundations. A stone chapel, its steeple toppled long ago, stands in the shadow of the manor, the tombstones in its lichyard faded beyond recognition. The manor itself is rectangular in shape, with a massive, open-air courtyard at its center. A towering, skeletal tree, gnarled and devoid of growth, stands at the heart of the complex, its branches laden with crowing ravens. The windows, darkened by dust and heavy curtains, provide little clue as to what lurks within . . .

Fey Portal Guardian.name:
妖精传送门守卫
Fey Portal Guardian

Text.text:
构成传送门的叶绿光芒微微荡漾，一名身形修长、白毛覆体的人形生物从中滑出。他穿着色彩斑斓的衣饰，外罩一件闪耀的锁子甲。头顶一团白发与他狂放的胡须相映成趣。尖耳轻颤间，他那布满棘刺的长尾仍在从魔法通道里缓缓抽出，轻易便有十英尺之长。他露出笑容，猫科般的利齿一闪而过；随即眨了眨眼，召来两片匕首般的翡翠能量碎片，落入他带爪的掌中。

~ Envisioned by ProjectReap

The leaf-green light making up the portal shimmers as a sleek, white-furred humanoid, dressed in colorful clothing and a shirt of shining mail, slides out. The mop of white hair on his head matches his wild beard. His pointed ears twitch as his spined tail, easily ten feet long, continues to emerge from the magical passage. He smiles, showing catlike teeth, then, with a wink, he summons two knifelike shards of emerald energy into his clawed hands.

~ Envisioned by ProjectReap

Secret Passage Through A Well.name:
穿井秘道
Secret Passage Through A Well

Text.text:
沿着井壁下行可不是件轻松事；石壁湿滑如抹油，可用的落手点又稀稀拉拉。那些凹痕却排布得很有规律，仿佛是有人刻意在石头上凿出来的。你终于爬到尽头，纵身落入一汪冰冷的水里，水深仅没过脚踝。空气更是寒意刺骨——还带着些许穿堂风。就在你最后一个落手点的对面，你看见一块石头从其余部分微微凸出。你用力按下去，脚边的水随即迅速退去。墙体的一部分随之挪动，裂开一道仅容人侧身挤过的缝隙。
The descent into the well is slippery business; the walls are slick and viable handholds are found only sparingly. There is a clear pattern to these indents, as if they have been broken into the stone intentionally. You reach the end of your climb and drop into an ankle-deep pool of cold water. The air chills you further—it's even a bit drafty. Opposite your last handhold, you see a stone slightly protruding from the rest. You press into it and the water at your feet drains. Part of the wall shifts, leaving a crack just wide enough to slip through.

蠕动的肉团与畸形的追随者仰头张望，只为瞥见他们所敬奉的主人一眼。奴仆们扭曲起伏、语无伦次的嘶鸣攀升至狂热的顶点——一道人影忽然出现在上方，挺拔而凛然地立于峭壁之巅，俯瞰着聚集的乌泱人潮。 那身影与其信众如出一辙：高大、异常纤长，披着黑袍与银饰的华丽；四条灵巧的触须蜷伏在椭圆形头颅之下。然而此人的惨白皮肤紧贴突出的骨棱，干枯的肉在多处剥落，露出其下的肌肉与筋腱。腐朽与败坏昭示着暗中运作的死灵术，也暗示着那荒谬到足以征服生与死的力量。 不朽，不可撼动，那身影以幽冷的目光缓缓扫过其臣属，触须漫不经心地抓挠着空气。

~ 由 Sax Envisioned

The writhing masses and grotesque followers look upward for a glimpse of their revered master. The undulating and gibbering of thralls rises to a fever pitch as a figure appears above, standing tall and formidable upon the precipice overlooking the assembled throng. The figure appears as their followers: towering and unnaturally lithe, draped in black robes and silver finery; four nimble tentacles coiled below an oblong head. But this figure’s pallid skin clings tight to jutting bones, and in places the desiccated flesh falls away, revealing the muscle and sinew beneath. The rot and decay hint at the necromancy at play, at the absurd power required to conquer not only life but death itself. Immortal, indomitable, the figure sweeps a haunting gaze over their subjects, tentacles grasping absently at the air.

~ Envisioned by Sax

Thick Wad Of Physical Currency.name:
一大沓厚厚的现金
Thick Wad Of Physical Currency

Text.text:
一团折起的纸——真正的纸张——几乎若无其事地搁在柜台上。能拿到它的人显然不想在购买记录上留下任何数字痕迹；又或者只是有一笔必须低调处理的大额采买。
A ball of folded paper—actual paper—sits almost innocuously on the counter. Whoever managed to get their hands on this clearly didn't want any kind of digital trail on their purchases, or potentially just one big purchase that needed to be discreet.

Loot From A Werewolf Den.name:
来自狼人巢穴的战利品
Loot From A Werewolf Den

Text.text:
在狼人的巢穴里，你发现了几名在附近道路上遭伏击的倒霉旅人的残骸。他们的随身物品大多已被毁坏——在那头狼形掠食者血腥的进食狂潮中被撕成浸血的碎片——但你仍设法找到一个钱袋，里面装着17枚金币。
In the werewolf’s den you find the remains of several hapless travelers ambushed on the road nearby. Their belongings are mostly ruined—slashed to ribbons in a blood-soaked feeding frenzy by the lupine predator—but you do manage to find a coin purse with 17 gold pieces inside.

Schrodinger \"Lazarus\" Von Constantine.name:
薛定谔“拉撒路”·冯·康斯坦丁
Schrodinger "Lazarus" Von Constantine

Text.text:
徘徊在灯笼映照的街巷中的不死巫师，是一具由不同来历的血肉东拼西凑而成的嵌合怪。它们四足着地的身躯上，顶着一颗猫的头骨，空洞眼眶永远直直凝望前方。高高立起的肉质耳朵之间生出一圈粗硬的毛领，向后披落，遮覆全身——那毛皮泛着紫水晶般的幽光，却黑得胜过深渊。乌鸦的羽翼自裸露的脊骨两侧伸展，而脊骨尽头连着一条被剥皮的尾巴，甩动时像骨鞭抽响。前腿踏地咔哒作响，乌鸦般的利爪刮过卵石路面；与此同时，一阵低沉的嗡鸣从一只被头骨塞封住的小瓶里渗出——瓶中困着黑色黏液，像吊坠般从巫师的项圈垂挂摇晃。就像家猫拨弄毛线团一般，它们滚动着一枚黑曜石圆球，球体回荡着巫妖永无止境的尖啸。

~ Played by Korroded_Soul

The undead wizard haunting the lantern-lit streets is a chimeric amalgamation of flesh cobbled from disparate origins. Their quadrupedal form is crowned by a cat’s skull that stares ever onward through empty sockets. A scruff of fur begins at the fleshy ears set high on their head and drapes back to veil their body in amethyst-tinged fur blacker than the abyss. Raven wings extend on either side of an exposed spine—which ends in a flayed tail that swishes like a bone whip. The front legs click as raven claws scrape against cobbles, and a low hum emanates from the black ooze imprisoned in a skull-stoppered vial dangling like a pendant from the wizard’s collar. Much as a housecat would play with a ball of yarn, they roll an obsidian orb that echoes with a lich’s unending scream.

~ Played by Korroded_Soul

Dwarven City Gates.name:
矮人城门
Dwarven City Gates

Text.text:
锻铁大门牢牢嵌在那道巨大而威严的城墙之中——这城墙构成了矮人城邦的堡垒——看上去就算攻城器抛来几十块巨石，也能安然承受，连一道划痕都不会留下。每一枚铆钉都精准得如同一体铸成，门轴更是在外侧巧妙加装护甲，专为抵御敌人针对这处薄弱点的袭击。
The wrought-metal gates, set sturdily in the huge and imposing wall that forms the redoubt of the dwarven city, look as if they could weather several dozen boulders launched from a siege engine with nary a scratch. Each rivet is uniform in its exactitude, the hinges of the gate cunningly armored on the outside to ward off attacks against that weak point.

四条布满倒刺的长腿驮着一具厚重、闪烁微光的胸节向前爬行。胸节之上是一副类人轮廓，却通体覆着棕红色几丁质甲壳，其上疤痕交错，刻着仪式般的异族纹印。它以两条结实的前臂托抱着一支沉重的激光步枪。这生物的昆虫传承一目了然——它在崎岖的地形上仍能敏捷疾掠。深陷的复眼注视着世界，带着好奇却又几分戒备；下唇处有力的颚钳不停颤动，仿佛随时要咬碎空气。
Four long barbed legs carry a thick shimmering thorax forth. Above the thorax is a humanoid shape, though it is all brown and red chitin, scarred with ritualistic alien markings. It bears a heavy laser rifle cradled in two sturdy forearms. The creature’s insect heritage is evident as it skitters nimbly over rough terrain. Its deep-set eyes peer out at the world, curious and yet somewhat suspicious, while energetic mandibles quiver from the lower lip.

The Druid Heart.name:
德鲁伊之心
The Druid Heart

Text.text:
当你踏入那棵大树树干上的空腔——四周弥漫着泥土、草木与生命的气息——你走近这片空间中央的一座小小祭坛。祭坛由天然木质构成，外观洁净如新，却显然是由它所栖身的树以自然魔法塑造而成。祭坛之上仅有一件物品：一颗巨大的红宝石，外圈以银丝与金线交织成的框架环绕。
As you enter the cavity in the bole of the large tree—surrounded by the smell of earth, flora, and life—you approach a small altar in the center of the space. It is composed of natural wood, pristine in appearance, but clearly created by natural magic from the tree it sits within. Upon the altar lies a single item: a large ruby encircled by a frame of silver and gold wire.

I Wield My Nine Lives Stealer.name:
我挥舞九命夺魂者
I Wield My Nine Lives Stealer

Text.text:
我被对手之死的必然性所驱使，被时代、疲惫、伤口，以及败北的可能所驱使，逼得不得不向这把后果沉重的利刃索取它自身的一丝生命。我的一击很漂亮，命中了，但还不够——直到刀刃醒来。它在我掌中嘶鸣、猛颤，随即自行挺进对手体内；他神色一震，旋即倒下。
I am compelled by the necessity of my opponent’s death, by time, fatigue, wound, and the chance of losing, to demand from this blade of grave consequence some of its own life. The strike is fine, a hit, but not enough. That is, until the blade awakens. It hisses and bucks in my hand, then drives into my opponent, who shows surprise and falls.

Krix Urgawa.name:
克里克斯·乌尔加瓦
Krix Urgawa

Text.text:
这名熊地精气度不凡、举止考究，背脊挺直，留须的下巴微微抬起。金棕色的皮毛干净顺滑、毫不纠结；栗色头发梳理整齐，抹了油光。身上是一套熨烫笔挺的蓝绿制服，银色滚边与内衬闪耀如新铸的钱币。厚重的大部头书被他稳稳夹在臂弯里——他把它抱得紧紧的，仿佛那是他誓要守护的孩子。

~ Played by Jake with

The bugbear, distinguished and refined, stands with his back straight and bearded chin up. His golden brown fur is clean and untangled, his chestnut hair combed and oiled. He wears a crisply pressed uniform of blue and green, silvery edges and lining gleaming like newly minted coins. A large tome nestles in the crook of his arm—a book he holds on to dearly, as if it is a child he means to protect.

~ Played by Jake with

Statue Of An Ancient Deity.name:
一尊古老神祇的雕像
Statue Of An Ancient Deity

Text.text:
这尊神祇——他、她或他们，根本分辨不出——由一块锆石陨铁雕成。神祇双手高举，一手举过头顶，另一手停在圆滚滚的腹前。雕像光头大笑，一脚抬起像要踢出去，另一脚踮在脚尖上。不是武技的起手。是舞步。它并非文明里那些严厉而自负的征服之神，俯瞰大地。这个神祇仿佛比这世界还要古老。
The deity—he, she, or they, it’s impossible to tell—is carved from a zircon meteor. The god’s hands are raised, one overhead and one at their round belly. The statue is bald and laughing, one foot lifted in a kick, the other up on the toes. Not a martial move. A dance. It is not one of the stern and conceited conquest gods of civilization, gazing over the land. This god seems older than this world.

Server Spills Tray Of Drinks On Irate Cu.name:
服务员将一托盘饮料泼洒在暴怒的顾客身上
Server Spills Tray Of Drinks On Irate Customer

Text.text:
一个男人对着端着酒水托盘、要送到他那桌的女侍劈头盖脸地呵斥。她抬眼直视他的脸，他龇牙咆哮时，她刘海的碎边在那双空洞发亮的眼前微微颤动。他忽然换上更甜腻的语气，露出一抹坏笑，伸手去拍她的手臂。指尖刚一碰到，托盘便猛地翻扣，整盘酒水倾在他腿上。他爆出一声怒吼，霍然起身，把一张湿透的餐巾狠狠摔下。女侍把双臂紧紧抱在胸前，一言不发，任他狂声叫骂。杜松子酒、苏打水与浅色葡萄酒在地上汇成一滩，甜得发腻的酒气迅速弥漫开来。那客人抬起食指抵在太阳穴上，粗暴地连连敲击。片刻间，他的双眼蒙上一层刺目的纯白光。待瞳孔与角膜重新浮现，他的嘴角拉成一个满足的笑。 “甜心，你那张脸已经在我硬盘里了。”
A man speaks harshly to the server holding a tray of drinks for his table. She stares back into his face as he snarls at her, the fringe of her bangs shaking over her glassy eyes. He smirks as he utters something in a sweeter tone and reaches out to pat her arm. As he makes contact, her tray flips onto his lap. He barks out a shout and stands, throwing down a sopping napkin. The server hugs her arms close, remaining silent as he screams. Gin, soda, and pale wine pool on the floor, the saccharine aroma filling the air. The patron raises his forefinger to his temple and taps against it roughly. His eyes momentarily glaze over with a bright white glow. As his pupils and cornea reemerge, his mouth stretches into a satisfied grin. “That’s your face on my drive, sweetheart.”

Kraken Attacking Ship.name:
海怪突袭船只
Kraken Attacking Ship

Text.text:
狂乱的巨浪轰然炸裂，一头庞然巨物自翻涌的泡沫中破海而出——巨型海怪现身。它是深渊的泰坦，怒火化作摧山裂海的海啸。触腕带着原始的狂暴疯狂抽击，如末日的藤蔓将船只层层裹缠。船身被死死绞住，在撕裂一切的蛮力下木板咔嚓作响、碎屑迸飞。船员凄惨的尖叫被毁灭的喧嚣彻底吞没。
Tumultuous waves explode, and from their churning spume a colossal kraken erupts. A titan of the depths, its fury is a tsunami of might. Tentacles thrash with primal rage, enveloping the ship like tendrils of doom. The vessel is ensnared, wood cracking and splintering beneath the forces tearing it apart. The crew’s pitiful screams are drowned out by the cacophony of destruction.

Mentor Reveals Betrayal.name:
导师揭露背叛
Mentor Reveals Betrayal

Text.text:
你的导师周身笼着一层阴翳，向你招手示意靠近，颤抖着手为你让座。他们面如死灰，苍黄得像被某种无名的痛苦浸透，随即开始忏白。真相倾泻而出，宛如从恶臭溃烂的伤口里剜出的腐肉：他们收下了一笔可怖的贿赂。随着罪行的全貌被揭开，一股重负仿佛从他们身上卸下。他们不敢与你对视，却郑重道出深切的歉意，并喃喃思索自己该如何赎罪。
A pall hangs over your mentor as they beckon you closer, offering you a seat with a trembling hand. Their face is ashen, sallowed by a mysterious anguish, as they begin their confession. Tumbling forth like rot excised from a fetid wound, the truth comes out: they accepted a terrible bribe. As the extent of their misdeeds comes to light, a weight seems to lift from them. They are unable to meet your gaze, but they offer their profound apologies and muse on how they might seek penance.

Hamlin Stormport.name:
哈姆林风暴港
Hamlin Stormport

Text.text:
一位水契之人穿着宽松的衬衫，裤腿卷到膝上，在这片阳光灿烂的海岸上显得自在得不能更自在。海风轻摇他微卷的发丝，青绿偏蓝的发缕末端卷成白色小 curls，像浪尖翻起的泡沫。他先低低哼唱片刻，随后将一支奶油色的排箫送到唇边。箫身正面点缀着一枚浅粉色的扇贝壳，成排的管子用芦苇般的细绳扎束。他吹奏出一段近似船歌的旋律，轻快、反复，粘人得令人不自觉跟着哼。为合着节拍，他将重心从一只脚挪到另一只脚，来回摇摆。曲终，他绽出一抹耀眼笑容，不见半分紧绷。他雀斑点点的脸颊笑得鼓起，直抵眼角——那是一对幽深而宁静的水潭，被喜悦的光斑斑点点地点亮。

~ Played by morguespice

A waterbonded man wearing a loose-fitting shirt, and pants rolled up to the knees, seems as comfortable as can be on this sunny coast. The breeze rocks his wavy hair, the greenish-blue locks ending in white curls, like foam cresting a wave. He hums to himself for a moment before bringing a cream-colored pan-flute to his lips. A light pink scallop shell decorates the front of it, and the array of pipes is bound in a reedy twine. He plays a tune akin to a shanty, jaunty and repetitive in a most catchy way. He shifts his weight from one foot to the other, back and forth to match the rhythm of his song. He finishes and flashes a dazzling smile, free of fraught. His freckled cheeks round up to his eyes: two dark, tranquil pools dappled with the light of joy.

~ Played by morguespice

Cargo Hauler: Captain’s Quarters.name:
货运拖船：船长舱室
Cargo Hauler: Captain’s Quarters

Text.text:
这间恶臭的舱室比下方的船员住处也只好上那么一点点。角落里那张小书桌上挂满了空空的褐色瓶子，陈啤酒那股刺鼻的酸馊味浸透了污浊的空气。大床凌乱未整，几张挑逗的海报点缀在原本空荡冷清的墙面上。
The stinking cabin is only a marginal improvement on the crew quarters below. The small desk in the corner is festooned with empty brown bottles, and the potent tang of stale beer saturates the fetid air. The large bed is unmade, and several provocative posters decorate the otherwise sparse walls.

Archbishop Orrian Iolas.name:
奥瑞安·约拉斯大主教
Archbishop Orrian Iolas

Text.text:
他身披华美的教会长袍，这位年迈精灵的冷峻五官几乎是“生人勿近”的写照。在他数百年的岁月里，这位善良的大主教也留下了一道伤痕——唯有长袍袖口在动作间微微滑落时才会显露：右前臂背侧一道深深的灼痕，虽被年代磨淡，却仍清晰可见。
Dressed in resplendent ecclesiastical robes, the stern features of this aged elf are the very definition of forbidding. Sometime during his hundreds of years, the good archbishop has picked up a scar only noticeable when the sleeve of his robe falls back in motion—a deep burn along the back of his right forearm, faded with age but still visible.

Guardrooms Of A Manor.name:
庄园的卫兵室
Guardrooms Of A Manor

Text.text:
卫兵营房收拾得井井有条，虽谈不上苛求：床铺铺得平整，脚柜紧闭，长矛与长剑整齐地归入柜中，以便安全取用。房间中央摆着一张朴素的木桌，桌面上散落着好几手扑克牌。
The guard barracks are kept in a neat if not exacting state: beds made, footlockers shut, spears and swords placed neatly in their cupboards to ensure safe handling. A plain wooden table sits in the middle of the room, several hands of playing cards strewn across its surface.

Quip About Making Plans.name:
关于制定计划的俏皮话
Quip About Making Plans

Text.text:
“我从不费心做计划。计划是给那些无聊的人准备的——他们缺乏足够的创意，才没法在当下灵光一闪，搞出点有意思的东西。”
“I don’t bother with plans. Plans are for boring people who lack enough creativity to come up with something interesting in the moment.”

华丽圣物匣上的金质嵌饰牵引着你的视线，落在正面那幅精雕细琢的浮雕上：乌檀色大理石的背景上，金箔勾勒出细节，微小的宝石点缀其间，璀璨而森冷。浮雕里有一名祭司，正举杖为一位跪地者祝福。

你的视野一阵发花，待再次聚焦时，那祭司竟像是在看着你——原本慈祥的圣颜笑意骤然变得阴森。那根被双手紧握的杖并非在赐福，根本是在把信徒的头颅砸得脑浆迸裂。祭司的笑容越咧越大，最终扭成一声野兽般的狰狞咆哮。
The gold inlays of the ornate reliquary draw your eyes to the intricately carved relief on its façade, the detail picked out in gold leaf and minute gemstones over an ebony marble background. One carved figure is a priest blessing a kneeling figure with a rod. Your eyes blur, and when you focus again, the priest appears to be looking at you, beatific smile suddenly menacing. The rod—held in two hands—is not blessing the faithful in the scene at all, but is being used to dash their brains out. The priest’s smile widens into a savage snarl.

Menagerie Of Magical Animals.name:
魔法动物奇珍馆
Menagerie Of Magical Animals

Text.text:
形形色色的奇妙生灵在宅邸的庭院间徘徊游走，从寻常到神话，无所不包。一只长颈鹿——还没一只猫大——沿着花园小径悠然踱步，停下来从旁边的玫瑰丛里低头啃食。头顶传来阵阵犬吠，你惊叹地望见两只闪烁的灵犬在空中腾跃奔掠，它们的身躯由缕缕云絮凝成。一抹绿色疾影掠过，碎石被冲得四散飞溅。那是……一只乌龟？

~ MaesterAelix 于 Discord

All manner of wondrous creatures wander the grounds of the mansion, from mundane to mythical. A giraffe—no bigger than a cat—meanders along the garden path, stopping to graze from a nearby rose bush. Barking resounds overhead and you watch in awe as two shimmering canines leap and bound through the sky, their bodies formed from wisps of cloud. A streak of green scatters gravel across the path as it rushes by. Was that a turtle?

~ MaesterAelix on Discord

Persuasion Of A Henchman To Reveal Infor.name:
劝说爪牙吐露情报
Persuasion Of A Henchman To Reveal Information

Text.text:
“别把这当成背叛。你只是让几句话无害地飘散在空气里——一阵漫无目的的信息，随口说给并不存在的听众。再说了，谁知道呢，事后你口袋里说不定还会多出几枚硬币。”
“Do not think of this as treachery. You are simply letting a few words float harmlessly into the air—a burst of aimless information told to no one in particular. And who knows, you may even find some coin your pocket afterwards.”

Gavin, Paladin Of Lady Luck.name:
加文，幸运女士的圣骑士
Gavin, Paladin Of Lady Luck

Text.text:
这个健壮的半身人比大多数同类都要高些。他乌鸦羽色的微卷头发剪得很短，但那双锐利的蓝眼睛与若有若无的笑意，让他看起来友善——只是友善里带着逼人的锋芒。他举止自信，身着考究衣装，外罩一件利落的浅蓝色铆钉皮甲背心。一柄细剑挂在一侧腰间，另一侧则盘着一条卷起的长鞭。背上斜挎的圆盾上绘着一枚金币：金币上是一位微笑的女子，周围环绕着六片三叶草。

~ Played by Gunndykol with

This burly halfling stands taller than most. His wavy, crow-colored hair is cropped short, but his piercing blue eyes and slight smile give him a friendly, if intense, appearance. He carries himself with confidence, dressed in fine clothing and a smart, pale-blue vest of studded leather. A smallsword hangs on one hip and a coiled whip on the other. The round-shield slung on his back is emblazoned with a gold coin depicting a smiling woman with six shamrocks encircling her.

~ Played by Gunndykol with

Mi-go High Priest.name:
米戈高阶祭司
Mi-go High Priest

Text.text:
乍看之下，它很容易被误认为是一只长翅的昆虫；但凑近细察才会发现，这其实是由精密科技与神秘真菌物质生物工程拼合而成的怪异融合体。它通体乌黑如墨，覆着装甲般的甲壳，手中握着一把极其异域的步枪。它那鼓胀的头颅上，色纹一明一灭地脉动着，将诡异的象形符号投射向高空。生物身上散出一股古怪的霉腥气。
What could be easily mistaken as a winged insectoid reveals itself on closer inspection to be a bioengineered amalgamation of sophisticated technology and mysterious fungal matter. It is jet black and plated, and holds a highly exotic rifle. The color pattern on its bulbous head pulses, projecting strange hieroglyphs skyward. An odd musty smell emanates from the creature.

单色的荒原与那群为取暖而挤作一团的黑白鸟潮相互映照。雨夹雪鞭打着栖群，倔强成列的亲鸟竭力把毛绒绒的幼雏护在风暴之外。一只走投无路的海鸥，羽毛被冰霜冻得僵硬，在企鹅群的边缘游弋巡弋，妄图叼走一两只雏鸟来平息它翻涌的饥火。一只高大的雄企鹅，眼周羽毛因暴怒而竖起，用刀锋般锐利的喙猛啄那掠食者，逼得它仓皇逃窜，只留下徒劳怨毒的尖叫在风雪里破碎。
The monochrome landscape mirrors the horde of black-and-white birds huddling together for warmth. Sleet batters the colony as defiant ranks of parents try to shelter their fluffy young from the storm. A single desperate gull, feathers stiff with ice, patrols the edge of the penguin host, hoping to snag a chick or two to sate its raging hunger. A large male, eye feathers bristling with rage, snaps at the scavenger with his razor-sharp beak, sending it scurrying away, screeching in futile spite.

The Sanctuary: Arbor City.name:
圣所：树荫之城
The Sanctuary: Arbor City

Text.text:
阿博城喧嚣的声浪自上方穿透林海回荡。城镇依托一株巨大无叶的古树而建，宛如筑在它的臂弯里；民居与商铺沿着枝桠排开，越靠近树干，建筑越宏伟。各色生灵在城中独有的路径上叽喳穿行——那些路径刻在无皮的木质表面——也不断钻入树身的孔洞，以获得进入某个显然安置在树干内部的分区的许可。
The bustling sounds of Arbor City echo through the forest from above. Built in the arms of an enormous leafless tree, homes and businesses alike line its branches, with the largest buildings nearest the trunk. Creatures of all types chitter as they travel the unique paths of the city—carved into the bark-free wood—as well as enter holes in the tree to access a sector apparently housed within the trunk itself.

屋内，壁炉里柴火噼啪作响，欢快地跳动着。一个男人坐在一段被打磨抛光过的圆木上，圆木被处理得更适合当座椅。他轻柔地拨动鲁特琴的琴弦，而在屋子更深处、看不见的地方，有人用低沉醇厚的嗓音随着玩家的旋律一同吟唱。
Inside, a fire crackles merrily in the hearth. A man sits on a log that has been sanded and polished to make a more comfortable seat. He softly strums the strings of a lute, and someone, unseen and from further within the home, sings along with the player’s tune in a low, rich voice.

他如高塔般压在你面前——一个足有八英尺高的男人迈步而来，骄矜得像黄铜龙，浮华更是其三倍。自头至脚披着紫与金勾边的板甲，腰侧那柄鎏金长剑，尺寸轻易就抵得上寻常男人挥舞的巨剑。他以紫水晶般的目光锁住你，那夺人心魄的眼神被黑色眼影与同色口红衬得更为锋利。他俊美的五官扯出一抹精雕细琢的冷笑，仿佛在体型与“品质”上都认定你低他一等。其身后，一名年轻侍从穿着厚衬软甲，正被一面华丽旗帜的重量压得踉跄，拼命迈开双腿疾跑，却怎么也追不上主人从容的步幅。

~ Played by Cassanir

Towering above you, an eight-foot tall man strides up as bold as a brass dragon, and three times as gaudy. Dressed from head to toe in plate armor picked out in purple and gold, the gilded longsword at his hip is easily the size of a greatsword wielded by a lesser man. He fixes you with his amethyst gaze, his breathtaking eyes heightened by his black eyeshadow and matching lipstick. His handsome features curl into an elegantly sculpted sneer, almost as if he considers you beneath him in quality as well as size. Behind him, a young squire in a padded gambeson struggles beneath the weight of an ornate banner, running as fast as his legs can carry him, but unable to keep up with his master’s stride.

~ Played by Cassanir

这只生物比马还要庞大，肿胀的水蛭般躯体自一团无眼的旋涡般噬咬利齿开始，末端则扬起一根足以把牲畜串穿的巨型毒刺。它以刀刃般的附肢疾掠而行，附肢敲击着赭黄的甲壳，发出清脆的咔嗒声。
Bigger than a horse, the creature’s bloated leech body starts as an eyeless cyclone of gnashing teeth and ends in a raised stinger big enough to skewer livestock. It skitters on bladelike appendages that click against its ocherous carapace.

Enchanter's Polo On Land.name:
陆地附魔师马球
Enchanter's Polo On Land

Text.text: [赛前] 球员们转着手中的槌子，叮铃作响的铃声回荡在场地上。裁判尖厉的哨声一响，她把那枚宝珠轻轻夹在臂弯里，双方随即各就各位。斯特鲁提冈在骑手的指挥下欢快小跑，奔向各自的站位。有的用宽阔、带爪的脚趾抓挠草皮，迫不及待要开赛。 [比赛中] 宝珠划破长空，闪耀的尾迹拖出一串细小星辉。骑手俯身贴近斯特鲁提冈，伴着这些生物高抬膝、弹跳般的步伐疾驰追逐，蹄下踢起大块泥土。骑手对坐骑高声呼唤——闪避、跃起、急转——尘雾点点散布全场，斯特鲁提冈紧追这场疯狂的追逐不放。 [Before the Game] Players twirl their mallets, the sound of jingling bells filling the field. At a shrill whistle from the referee, the orb tucked gently under her arm, the opposing sides take their positions. The struttigons trot cheerfully to their designated spots under their riders’ direction. Some scratch at the grass with their wide, taloned toes, eager to begin. [In Play] The orb sails through the air, its glittering tail bringing a wake of tiny stars. Riders lean into their struttigons as the creatures race after the orb in a high-kneed, bouncing gait, feet kicking up substantial clumps of dirt. Riders call out to their mounts for dodges, for leaps, for quick turns—the field is peppered with dusting clouds as the struttigons keep up the mad chase.

一个形貌如恶魔的角斗士躲在伤痕累累的盾后步步逼近，带着暴烈的杀意怒视前方。它久经沙场的躯体披挂着几片被打得凹陷的护甲，上面镶着阴森的符号。狰狞的尖角自额头突起，双眼燃着地狱般的火焰。它手中缺口斑驳的长矛稳稳指向前方，矛身抵在盾牌上沿的边缘作为支撑。
Advancing behind a scarred shield, a demonic-looking gladiator glares with violent intent. Its battle-hardened frame sports pieces of battered armor adorned with macabre symbols. Vicious horns protrude from its forehead, and its eyes burn with diabolic flame. The chipped spear it wields points unerringly forward, supported by the shield’s top rim.

The Wickwater Inn And Riverguard.name:
威克沃特旅店与河卫军
The Wickwater Inn And Riverguard

Text.text:
在威克河的一处小小回流湾里，避开了顺流而下旅人们的视线，城里的河卫队在此设有驻站。这里停着三艘船，其中一艘常常被拖上旱坞修修补补。河道巡守们在衣装外披着亮黄的上蜡斗篷，肩背步枪——也带着给倒霉船长应急用的救援包。

旅店稍微更靠近城镇些，看上去像是放大版的岗屋：陈旧的深色木料、厚重的护墙板、同样的屋顶，室内一片灰冷粗粝，直到石砌壁炉点起火来，浓汤锅咕嘟咕嘟冒着热气。
In a small eddy of the Wick River, hidden from travelers looking downstream, the Riverguard of the city has its station. There are three boats, one often undergoing some drydock repairs. The wardens of the river wear bright-yellow waxed cloaks over their clothes and carry rifles—as well as emergency kits for hapless pilots. The Inn, set a little closer to town, looks like a larger version of the guardhouse. Old, dark wood and heavy wainscoting, the same roof, and a gray, rough feel inside until the stone hearth is alight and the chowder pots simmering.

Gravekeeper’s Hut.name:
守墓人的小屋
Gravekeeper’s Hut

Text.text:
一间低矮的小屋立在有围墙的墓园边缘，草茅覆顶呈圆锥形；墓园已被一道撕裂大地的裂隙贯穿，那裂隙横切乡野。小屋既无招牌也无窗，唯有门外竖着一根木桩，桩上悬着一盏巨大的灯笼。
A squat hut with a conical roof of thatch stands at the edge of a walled graveyard, which has been riven by a crevasse that cuts across the countryside. The hut has no sign or window, but a post stands outside the door and from it hangs a large lantern.

赤着脚、浑身脏兮兮，身上不过几片破布裹着，这女孩却仍摆出一副凶狠的架势，直面她的敌手。她握着一根削尖的木棍，当作长枪般使唤，横架在另一只手臂前；那只手里还攥着个破篮子，像盾牌一样护着。她像披甲的马上枪骑士般蓄势待发，单脚后蹬，猛地冲刺，朝一只流浪猫扑去——那猫看起来只有她体型的一半，正弓起背脊，嘶嘶低吼。
Barefoot and dirty, dressed in little more than rags, the girl nevertheless presents a fearsome front as she faces down her foe. Armed with a pointed stick, she wields it like a lance, crossing it over her other arm in which she holds a broken basket like a shield. Readied like a jousting knight, she rears back on one foot and gallops at a stray cat that seems half her size as it arches its back and hisses.

Negative Energy Flood.name:
负能量洪流
Negative Energy Flood

Text.text:
随着你一声粗哑的命令，一道黑暗漩涡在你的目标脚下张开。断续的阴影翻搅扭动，像极了某种滴涎的巨口，边缘环着针一般锋利的尖牙。一阵呈腐败坏死之肉色的狂暴爆裂喷涌而出，以不死能量的喷泉将你的敌人吞没。
At your guttural command, a dark vortex opens beneath your target. The fitful shadows churn and writhe, resembling nothing except perhaps a slavering maw ringed with needle-sharp teeth. A violent eruption the color of necrotized flesh engulfs your foe in a font of undead energy.

Tank Of Flammable Liquid Or Gas Erupts I.name:
易燃液体或气体储罐爆裂，喷涌成火球
Tank Of Flammable Liquid Or Gas Erupts In Fireball

Text.text:
坦克在爆炸中猛然绽开一团巨大的火球，刺目的闪光轰然迸发，冲击波如音爆海啸般向前席卷。尖锐的嗡鸣刺破空气，成片的尘土与砂砾将周遭一切尽数覆盖。
A huge fireball blooms from the tank as it explodes, erupting in a blinding flash while the shockwave rushes forward like a sonic tsunami. A ringing pierces the air, and swathes of dust and grit coat everything nearby.

树木渐次退开，露出一条小河布满卵石的河岸。河水在慵懒的水流中咕噜作响、打着旋儿，水下的石头映着头顶洒落的阳光微微闪烁。下游处，一只色彩斑斓的鸭子溅起水花，猛地扎入水中，去河床上寻找鱼卵和细小的甲壳生物。
The trees clear to reveal the stone-strewn bank of a small river. The water gurgles and swirls in its lazy current, and the stones beneath glimmer with the sunlight from above. A colorful duck makes a splash downstream as it takes a plunge in search of fish eggs and small crustaceans on the riverbed.

Mountain Peak Covered In Pale Green Slus.name:
覆着浅绿雪泥的山巅
Mountain Peak Covered In Pale Green Slush

Text.text:
山巅泛着病态的绿，仿佛被一层剧毒的化学废渣轻轻撒过。走近细看，你发现峰顶覆着一片惨白发绿的雪泥，冰冷得像极地的积雪。这东西从何而来？
The mountain peak is a sickly green, as if dusted with virulent chemical waste. Upon closer inspection, you find the peak covered in pallid green slush, cold as arctic snow. Where did it come from?

God Of Justice.name:
正义之神
God Of Justice

Text.text:
作为正义之神祇的神圣表亲，这位龙裔神祇身披深紫长袍，手持一柄体型堪比战锤的法槌——柚木槌身，缀以青铜箍带。他对公正的嗅觉如同他编目事实、聆听真言的本领一般敏锐。他的声音低沉克制，却自带威严与不偏不倚。
Divine cousin to the God of Righteousness, this Dragonborn deity wears a set of deep purple robes and carries a gavel the size of a warhammer, teak with bronze banding. His sense of fairness is as keen as his abilities to catalog facts and hear truths. He speaks with quiet authority and impartiality.

Derion's Cemetery In Winter.name:
德里昂的冬日墓园
Derion's Cemetery In Winter

Text.text:
[初次造访] 这片寒冬景致里，唯有乌鸦的感召与坠落雪粉的低柔沙响在回荡。枯树与骨架般的灌木间，覆雪的墓碑环绕着一座矮丘；丘顶以干砌石墙围成一圈。矮丘一侧矗立着两尊高大雕像，双手托举着明亮火焰；它们皆为兜帽覆面的身影，目光投向一弧墓群。

[再次造访] 新雪厚厚糊住了这片阴郁的景象。闪耀的白霜堆在灰色墓碑上，沿着树枝的每一寸纹理铺展流淌。灌木像裹了棉絮般蓬松，丘顶石墙也被雪白抬高了近半。唯有雕像的头部不见薄雪；它们看起来潮湿，水珠从兜帽边缘细细滴落，沿着痕迹在托火的碗沿下方凝成冰脊。

[First visit] The calling of crows and quiet susurration of falling snow are the only sounds arising from this wintry scene. Amid barren trees and skeletal bushes, snow-topped tombstones surround a low hill with a drystone wall encircling its top. Bright fires burn in the hands of two tall statues that stand at one side of the hill, each a hooded figure looking toward a semicircle of graves.

[Return visit] Fresh snow cakes the glum scene. Sparkling white frosting heaps upon gray headstones and runs along all the branches of the trees. Bushes look fluffed with cotton, and the wall atop the hill has grown half again with a height of whiteness. Only the statues’ heads lack a dusting of snow. They look damp, and water tickles from their hoods in tracks that freeze into ice below the bowls that hold their flames.

清晨的光从窗缝里泻进来，你带着疲惫到近乎麻木的认命，吱呀一声睁开眼，把酸痛的双腿从床沿甩下去——可有什么地方彻底不对劲。冰冷而原始的恐慌猛地攫住你，你环顾这间陌生的房间，猛然弹起，冲向敞开的门。你站在浴室镜子前，伸出手去擦拭那布满污垢条痕的玻璃——却看见一只属于别人的手。

~ MaesterAelix 于 Discord

Your eyes creak open with weary resignation as the morning light streams in through the window and you swing aching legs out of bed, but something is very wrong. With cold, primal panic, you look around an unfamiliar room and leap to your feet, running to the open door. Standing in front of the bathroom mirror, you reach out to wipe the grime-streaked glass—and see someone else's hand.

~ MaesterAelix on Discord

察觉到你的靠近，那只猫科动物从休息的姿势中舒展开来，起身站高，拱起脊背，试图用这种姿态警告你退开。若你放慢、从容地移动，并发出安抚的轻声细语，或许还能将它再次哄回懒散自满的情绪中。
Sensing your approach, the feline uncurls from its resting position and arches its back as it stands tall in an attempt to warn you off. Slow, easy movement and soothing noises may yet lull it back into a complacent mood.

这生物体态类人，靠两条细长、趾行的腿蹦跳着移动，但它那乌暗的羽毛与喙状的口器，更让人想到一只巨大的双足乌鸦。两只玻璃般漆黑的眼睛带着强烈的好奇四下游移，喙不时咔哒作响，像在沉思。它会说话，可那并非它自己的声音，只是对曾听过话语的拙劣摹仿——各地口音与语言交织混杂，被它狡黠地串联起来，编织成独特的念头。
The creature is humanoid, hopping about on two spindly, digitigrade legs, but its dark feathers and beak-like mouth evoke a massive, bipedal raven more than anything else. Two glassy black eyes roam about with an intense curiosity, its beak clicking thoughtfully. It speaks, but the voice is not its own, only a mimicry of what it’s heard before—a mingling of dialects and languages, cunningly strung together to form unique thoughts.

这具袖珍构装体用一根细长手指挥舞工具，动作娴熟得宛如受过传承的宗师。它肩上用一截破烂绳子吊着一把散弹枪。它身着商务装，廉价布料间却隐约透出闪亮的机械结构。它的机器面孔随时变形，模块化的设计让轮廓不断重组。一只手延展成复杂的黑客装置，双眼闪烁着成卷被盗取的数据洪流。
The diminutive construct swings a tool on a long finger with the practiced movements of a learned master. A scattergun hangs on a tattered rope around its shoulder. It’s clad in business wear, with glistening robotics peeking forth from discount fabrics. Its machine face morphs, modular in design. A hand extends into a complex hacking implement, and its eyes flash with reams of stolen data.

她身着素暗的衣裳，唯一的点缀是一枚刻着学术资历的徽章。你面前的半兽人不安地挪动着步子。她的站姿泄露了意图：正用自己的身体护住从挎包里探出的卷轴筒——那是学者的标记，将守护知识视作首要职责。
Dressed in somber clothing with only a medallion describing her academic credentials for decoration, the half-orc before you shifts nervously. Her stance shows that she is moving to protect the scroll cases peeking out from her satchel with her own body—the sign of a scholar whose first obligation is to the preservation of knowledge.

Alien Singer With Extra Appendages.name:
拥有额外附肢的异星歌者
Alien Singer With Extra Appendages

Text.text:
一个矮墩墩的外星人站在被照亮的阶段上，短壮结实，灯光映在那仿佛熔融黄铜般的皮肤上：闪亮、金属质感、泛着黄黄的光泽。它的两颗头对着一个怪异的绿色泡泡歌唱——一支耐火的麦克风——歌声响起时，两张嘴同时喷吐出一股股赤红火焰。旋律悦耳，火焰噼啪作响的质感饱满而醇厚。五条手臂——右边两条、左边三条——随着歌声疯狂挥舞比划。
A squat alien, short and stout, stands on an illuminated stage, the light reflecting off skin that looks like molten brass: shiny, metallic, and yellow. Two heads sing into a strange green bubble—a flame-resistant microphone—and as they sing, both mouths shoot out gouts of red flame. The melody is pleasant, and rich with the crackle of fire. Five arms—two to the right, three to the left—gesticulate wildly as they sing.

I Drink My Potion Of Gaseous Form.name:
我喝下我的气化形态药水
I Drink My Potion Of Gaseous Form

Text.text: 药剂如烟雾般的缕缕触须倾泻到我的舌尖，轻盈却苦涩。它将我的口腔、喉咙与肺部抽干到呼吸都变得艰难、刺痛。我头晕目眩，踉跄着原地打转，接着——poof——我化作蒸汽，感官一阵刺痒，在一种陌生而自由漂浮的方式里占据着空间。 The potion pours in smoky tendrils onto my tongue, light yet bitter. It desiccates my mouth, throat, and lungs to the point that breathing becomes difficult, painful. I become dizzy, stumble and spin on my feet, then—poof—I become vapor, my senses tingling as I occupy space in a strange, free-floating way.

Fisher’s Pier In Winter.name:
冬日的渔人码头
Fisher’s Pier In Winter

Text.text:
覆雪的木箱与木桶堆满了这座栈桥，但有人特意费心，让桥板上大多保持着无雪的清爽。缘由显而易见：在码头尽头，一根钓竿垂下钓线，穿过冰面凿开的破洞，探入河流幽暗的水中。
Snow-covered crates and barrels clutter this jetty, but someone has gone to the trouble of keeping its boards largely clear of snow. The reason for this seems evident. At the pier’s end a fishing pole dangles a line into the river’s dark waters through a hole broken in the ice.

Paladin's Threat About Channeling Their.name:
圣武士关于引导其神祇之力的威胁
Paladin's Threat About Channeling Their God

Text.text:
“我不会‘做’任何事。我不过是我神明意志的导管；而你我之间说句实话，他们今天格外愤怒。”
“I do not ‘do’ anything. I am merely a conduit for the will of my god, and between you and me, they are feeling particularly wrathful today.”

Vampire's Manor: Spare Bedroom.name:
吸血鬼的庄园：备用卧室
Vampire's Manor: Spare Bedroom

Text.text:
备用卧室开在主走廊一侧，厚重的橡木门挂在古老锈蚀的铰链上，推开时发出刺耳的吱呀声。室内，昏暗光照从虫蛀破烂的窗帘缝隙里渗入，在每一处表面投下怪异而令人不安的影子。远墙边立着一张巨大的四柱床，破碎的床幔被拉拢合上。床脚处靠着一只抽屉柜，早在多年前就被洗劫一空；而在角落里，食肉兽的残餐堆成一团——被啃噬得发黄的骨头、干涸的血渍，以及撕裂的布片。你从余光里感觉到床幔后有移动——有什么在里面搅动，霉烂的毯子发出窸窣声。可当你猛地扯开帘幕，里面却空无一物，唯有一道曾经躺过人的凹痕留在床上。
The spare bedroom stands off the main corridor, its heavy oaken door creaking on ancient, rusted hinges. Inside, dim light seeps through moth-eaten curtains, casting odd and unnerving shadows across every surface. A large, four-poster bed stands against the far wall, tattered curtains drawn. A chest of drawers, long ago ransacked of valuables, rests against the foot of the bed, while in one corner, the remains of a carnivore’s meal lie in a heap—gnawed, yellowed bones, dried bloodstains, and scraps of torn cloth. Out of your periphery you sense movement behind the curtains of the bed—something stirring, rustling moldy blankets. But as you tear the curtain aside, you find nothing save the indent of a body that once lay here

一具骷髅（特征）仿佛在数字空间中被渲染般具现。以纳秒计的瞬息间，像素化的血肉在半透明的高多边形骨骼上编织生长，交错嵌合，凝成一具比例完美、光辉流淌的虚拟人形。骷髅（特征）依旧在体内清晰可见。加载时代完成，她冰冷的双眼与数据插口迸出幽冥般的光。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

A skeleton materializes as if rendering in a digital space. In nanoseconds, pixelated flesh knits over the translucent, high-poly bones, intercalating into a luminous virtual humanoid form of idealized proportions. The skeleton remains visible inside. Loading time complete, her cold eyes and datajack flare with ghostly light.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

你一踏进这间屋子，铁锈般的血腥味便钻入鼻腔，擦过舌尖；可与眼前景象相比，这气味竟显得淡了些。十来具尸体——有男有女，有老有少——横陈在巨大的木桌上，皮肉被剥开翻起，许多人的内脏被取出，摆在身侧。有人把伤口钉死撑开，将皮肤钉在桌面上，像掀开书页般固定住，只为把他们的腹腔挖出、细细检视。
Upon entering this room, the coppery scent of blood enters your nose and touches your tongue, but given what you see, the odor is mild. A dozen bodies—men, women, young and old—lie on large wooden tables, their skin flayed open, many with their organs placed beside them. Someone has nailed the wounds open, pinning skin to the tables so their innards can be exhumed and examined.

Warlock's Familiar Is Killed By Vampire.name:
术士的魔宠被吸血鬼领主的爪牙杀死
Warlock's Familiar Is Killed By Vampire Lord's Minions

Text.text:
术士的双眼翻白，他们透过自己魔宠的眼睛望去——在这场离奇的冒险中，你们早已对这套过程习以为常。你们看见那位可靠斥候的身影在高空令人安心地掠过，来回穿梭，俯瞰地形。地平线上，一团巨大的乌云凭空凝聚，在傍晚和煦的微风里却快得不合常理地逼近。接着，你们看清了它们。蝙蝠。成百上千，皮革般的翼膜在空中拍裂出如拉伸肌腱般的脆响，蜂拥而上，撕咬着你们头顶那不幸的生物。术士失声惨叫，连接骤然断裂——他们的魔宠被狂犬般的凶残生生撕碎。

~ Envisioned by thebigham on Discord

The warlock's eyes roll back as they see through the eyes of their familiar—a process you have all become accustomed to during your strange adventure. You see the reassuring form of the trusted scout high above, darting to and fro as they survey the landscape. A large dark cloud materializes on the horizon, moving far too fast in the gentle breeze of the evening air. Then you see them. Bats. Hundreds of leathery wings cracking like stretched tendons as they swarm the unfortunate creature above you. The warlock cries out, their link abruptly broken as their familiar is torn apart with rabid ferocity.

~ Envisioned by thebigham on Discord

敬畏如潮席卷空气，万籁俱寂。一个朦胧的存在浮现，与其说是生物，不如说更像一枚符号。它的形态宛如远古异星的涂鸦：三重同心的粉光圆环，嘶嘶作响，迸出锐利的能量。你周遭的分子开始松动，仿佛仅凭它的存在就将化学键扯断。柔软的声响——如浪潮消亡的尾音——钻入你的脑海。
A wash of awe fills the air and all sound ceases. A faint being, more symbol than creature, appears. Its form is like that of ancient alien graffiti: three concentric rings of pink light that sizzle with sharp energy. The molecules around you loosen, as if pulled free of their chemical bonds by the being’s very presence. Soft sounds, like the dying of waves, enter your head.

尽管通常不明智把有感知的情绪强加在动物身上，但看到这只狒狒紧蹙的眉骨与狭长的眼睛，你几乎不可能将其解读为别的——那分明是怒意森然的瞪视。确实，当你逼近它的领地时，它龇出锋利的犬齿以作警告。尽管它体型小型（体型），你仍有一种感觉：只要它认定你是入侵者，便会以毫不留情的凶残发起攻击。
Though it is not generally wise to ascribe sentient emotions to an animal, it is impossible to see the baboon’s stern brow and narrow eyes as anything other than an angry glower. Indeed, as you approach its territory, it bares its sharp canines in warning. Despite its small size, you have the feeling that it would attack any perceived invader with merciless savagery.

Rooftops Of The City.name:
城市屋顶群
Rooftops Of The City

Text.text:
在这里，在城市铺石街道的高空之上，你发现自己远离了那令人窒息的景象、气味与喧嚣。城里的嘈杂——高声的交谈、哒哒的马蹄、熙攘人群的喧哗——飘荡而上，混作一片嗡鸣。屋顶在你眼前铺展开来，檐口与斜面交错成一座迷宫。
Here, high above the cobbled streets of the city, you find yourself far from the overwhelming sights, smells, and sounds. The din of the city—shouted conversation, clattering hooves, and chattering throngs—wafts up to you, mingling into a drone. The rooftops sprawl before you, a maze of eaves and angles.

一具高耸的不死生物裹在可怖的动力护甲中，拖着沉重步伐穿行于阴影之间；金属外骨骼泛着诡异的冷光。那主宰般的显赫力量，与下方腐朽溃烂的血肉格格不入。它崩裂的掌中攥着一柄巨大的战锤，锤面宽阔，染满无数亡者的鲜血。然而，在那两只永不餍足的狂怒之眼后，却藏着一缕微弱、闪烁不定的疲惫。
A towering undead creature encased in formidable powered armor lumbers through the shadows, its metallic exoskeleton gleaming with an eerie glow. The juggernaut’s obvious power seems at odds with the decaying flesh below. In its crumbling grip sits a gigantic hammer, broad and bloody with the deaths of many. And yet, behind two eyes of insatiable rage lies a faint and flickering weariness.

Child Cutthroat Speech About Education.name:
小割喉匪谈教育
Child Cutthroat Speech About Education

Text.text:
“‘要友善，别打人，别吼叫，别拿走。’大人们对我们这么说，以为这样就能帮到我们。以为这样就能让我们比他们更好。可这只会让我们变得软弱。我盯着那些成年人看过。看过他们在夜深人静时都做了些什么。要是你不打、不吼、不咬、不捅、不抢……那就会有人来从你身上夺走一切。”
“’Be nice, don’t hit, don’t yell, don’t take.’ The adults told us these things thinking it would help. Thinking it would make us better than they were. But it only makes us weak. I’ve watched the grown-ups. Seen what they do in the dead of night. If you don’t hit, yell, bite, stab, take… then someone will take from you.”

Prince Of Revelry.name:
狂欢王子
Prince Of Revelry

Text.text:
他那双黄色的山羊眼下，笑意咧得极开，额前扭曲的犄角也随之精神起来。胡须浓密卷曲，与头发一般蓬松，其上歪歪斜斜缠着一顶由贫瘠草编成的冠。丝绸衬衫前襟被一抹黑渍玷污，罪魁祸首多半是他松垮拳中那只半满的酒瓶，酒液在里头晃荡作响。他穿着黄绿条纹的灯笼裤，裤脚沾满泥块，裁得恰好止于羊腿脚踝的弯折处。分趾的蹄子随着某支听不见的曲子轻颤不止，他又仰头从瓶中豪饮一大口。
A wide smile spreads under his yellow goat's eyes, perking up the twisted horns upon his brow. His beard is as full and curly as the hair on his head, about which wraps a lopsided crown of barrenwort. A black stain soils the front of his silken shirt, the culprit most likely the half-full bottle of wine that sloshes about in his loose fist. His yellow and green striped pantaloons, caked with clods of mud, are tailored to end at the bend of his caprine ankles. His cloven feet jitter to some unheard tune and he takes another hefty swig from his bottle.

I Drink My Potion Of Fire Resistance.name:
我喝下我的火焰抗力药水
I Drink My Potion Of Fire Resistance

Text.text:
我把药水瓶举到嘴边，瓶身叮当作响，像只锡罐。我仰头灌了一口，液体冰得刺骨，寒意从牙龈一路扎进牙根。我皱着脸咽下去，随即开始冒汗。每一颗汗珠都凉爽而安心，像一层清新的薄光覆在皮肤上，为我挡住烈焰。
The potion bottle jingles like a tin can as I lift it up to drink. I take a swig, the liquid so cold it stings through my gums and straight to the roots of my teeth. I swallow with a grimace and begin to sweat. Each bead of perspiration is cool and comforting, a refreshing sheen to shield me from flame.

Ship Repair Robot.name:
舰船维修机器人
Ship Repair Robot

Text.text:
像个嘟囔抱怨的老兵修理工，那名机器人技师沿着飞船走廊前行，身周不断吐出一连串哔鸣与嗡转声。闪烁的橙色灯光充当它的光学处理器，而它拎着的破旧红色工具箱里，各式各样磨得发亮的老工具叮当作响。
Like a grumbling veteran mechanic, the robotic technician makes its way down the ship’s corridors emitting a series of beeps and whirs. Blinking orange lights serve as optical processors and a staggering variety of well-worn tools rattle in the battered red toolbox it carries.

Approaching The Giant Queen Bee.name:
靠近巨蜂女王
Approaching The Giant Queen Bee

Text.text:
一只巨大的蜜蜂从蜂巢墙面上一间宽敞空置的巢房里探出头来。她的细长复眼锐利而聪慧，专注地审视着一切。她爬出巢房，沿着成排的六角巢格向上攀行。这只蜂比其他同类更为庞大——腹部更长，尾刺更尖更利。毫无疑问，这便是蜂群的蜂后。她在蜂巢顶端登座，傲然俯瞰，下颚轻扬，触角微微颤动。

~ 由 Mordechai 在 Envisioned 创作

One giant honeybee peers out from a spacious vacant cell in a wall of honeycomb. Her elongated eyes watch intently, intelligently. She crawls out and climbs up the array of hexagonal cells. The bee is larger than the others—her abdomen is longer, with a more pointed sting. This, surely, is the queen of the hive. She enthrones herself at the top of the hive and gazes down with a haughty air, antennae stirring.

~ Envisioned by Mordechai

机械鼠以迅捷却稳健的步伐窜出，举止间尽显其精工细作。它忽然停下，像在嗅探空气中的可回收物。随即，背脊无声裂开，展开一组精密的太阳能板，如扇面般铺陈开来。它将周遭一切光线尽数吸纳，为电池重新充能。
The robotic rat skitters forth with quick yet steady movements, demonstrating how carefully it was crafted. It pauses, sensing the air for salvage. Then its back opens into a sophisticated array of solar panels, fanning out. The rat draws in all nearby light, recharging its batteries.

你抬手一指，吐出那句真言，生物当场在一股剧毒般的紫色浓烟中消失无踪。你将其抛入由你亲手设计的半位面——一座令人发狂的迷宫，旨在让目标疲于奔命。你知道它终会归来，但至少，你为自己争取了些许时代。
You point, speak the word, and the creature vanishes on the spot in a gout of virulent, purple smoke. You cast them into a demiplane of your own design—a maddening maze intended to keep the target busy. You know they will return, but you've bought yourself time, at least.

Formulae Numerica Vi.name:
数秘公式 VI
Formulae Numerica Vi

Text.text:
[掩蔽]  这部由法师共修会合编的鸿篇巨制，封面以轻木板为底，覆上一层魔法般的深蓝色漆光。书脊处以三道宽阔的镍质束带铆钉穿钉固定，牢牢箍住全书。封面几乎被诸位撰稿者的姓名所淹没。

[内容]  布质书页上密密麻麻铺陈着数学定理、公设、方程与难题。书中每一章都能为读者的才智添砖加瓦——却要以疲惫为代价。若一口气读得太多章，读者便会坠入沉沉的深睡。

[Cover]  This magnum opus, compiled by a communion of mages, has a cover of balsa board coated in a magical, deep-blue lacquer. It is bound with three broad nickel straps riveted through the manuscript along the spine. The cover is nearly obscured by the names of the contributors.

[Content]  The pages of cloth are covered in mathematical theorems, postulates, equations, and problems. Each chapter of the book contributes to the reader's intelligence—at the expense of fatigue. If too many chapters are read in a row the reader drops into a deep sleep.

I Use My Armor Of Invulnerability.name:
我启用我的无敌护甲
I Use My Armor Of Invulnerability

Text.text:
我身披坚不可摧的板甲，深蓝的金属甲片层层咬合，边缘泛着磨亮的鎏金光泽；寻常的利刃钝器落在我身上，如击石魔像般徒劳无功。我每踏出一步，皆似阴沉的丧钟轰鸣，金铁交鸣不绝——不可穿透的身影步步逼近敌前。
In my staunch suit of plate, each of the interlocking pieces of dark blue metal tinged with burnished gold, I shrug off physical attacks with the ease of a stone golem. Each of my steps is a grim knell, clanging as my impenetrable form approaches my enemies.

Loot From An Adult Red Dragon.name:
成年红龙的战利品
Loot From An Adult Red Dragon

Text.text:
穿过缭绕的烟尘，你看见那头红龙终于屈服于伤势，残破的身躯横卧在乱石之间。你悄然逼近它的尸体，沿途掠过它临死挣扎留下的痕迹——大地被撕开巨大的沟壑，土石翻卷。就在其中一道裂缝里，你发现一只沾满污渍的皮囊，里面的宝石散落在灰烬上。绝大多数都带着瑕疵，但有几颗红宝石却完美无缺——真正的收获。
Through the smoke, you can see that the red dragon has finally succumbed to its wounds, lying broken among the boulders. Stalking toward the body, you pass the results of its death throes, huge rents gouged in the earth. Within one such gash, you find a soiled pouch, its contents of gemstones scattered across the ash. The vast majority are flawed, but a few rubies are impeccable—a real find.

Scepter Of Unseelie Craftsmanship.name:
邪魅工艺权杖
Scepter Of Unseelie Craftsmanship

Text.text:
这根权杖是一段活生生的枝条，滴落着黏稠的绿色树液——其上点缀着死去的虫尸。底部缠绕着一圈荆棘藤蔓，勉强充作令人不适的握柄，但至少没有沾上树液。它散出的气味如腐败般刺鼻，舌尖也浮起一种味道，仿佛浆果才刚发霉。
This scepter is a living branch dripping with sticky green sap—dotted with dead insects. A bramble-vine wrapped around its base serves as an uncomfortable handhold, but at least it's free of the sap. The scent wafting off of it stings like decay, and there is a taste on your tongue reminiscent of berries that have just turned moldy.

I Cast Fireball From My Helm Of Brillian.name:
我从辉煌头盔中施放火球术
I Cast Fireball From My Helm Of Brilliance

Text.text:
我从头盔里取出的火蛋白石中，一枚火球蓄势待发。热浪自石中爬升，钻入我的指尖；它随即开裂、碎裂成屑，渐渐消散无踪。紧接着，一道火焰流光自我掌心迸射，奔涌着扑向它的目标。
The fireball readies itself from out of the fire opal I retrieved from my helm. Its heat crawls up from the stone and into my fingers as it cracks, fritters away, and disappears. Then the streak of fire leaves my hand and surges toward its target.

Divine Home Of A Goddess Of Darkness.name:
黑暗女神的神圣居所
Divine Home Of A Goddess Of Darkness

Text.text:
你在这里所见的，唯有维度与形体的幽影：一片漆黑的虚空，点缀着过于遥远的星辰微光，它们旋转着远去，最终尽数消散于无。你的双足稳稳踏在一条夜空之河上；四周是一座由更广阔、无云的空间塑成的教堂，看不见任何实质，只见黑暗的褶皱勾勒出高耸的墙壁与拱顶穹窿。昏冥之中泛起一道涟漪，以你心智能理解的方式隆起成阶梯；在它的顶端——这被囚的无垠正令人眩晕地绕其轨行——矗立着一座高高的王座，由钻石般锐利的黑暗铸成，空无一物，唯余那必将端坐其上的某个存在所遗下的权能压迫感。
You see only the ghosts of dimension and form here, in this black void stippled with the dim lights of far too distant stars, all spinning away and vanishing into nothingness. Your feet rest solidly on a river of night sky, surrounded by a cathedral formed of more cloudless space with no solidity in sight, just folds in the dark that outline high walls and a vaulted ceiling. A ripple in the gloom rises up in a manner your mind takes to be stairs, and at its zenith, around which this imprisoned boundlessness dizzyingly orbits, stands a tall throne of diamond-sharp darkness, empty of all but the impression of the power of whoever or whatever must sit there.

纹身师铺子的墙上挂满了素描草图，展示着这位艺术家的各式设计。艺术家本人是个黑发半身人，两条手臂的皮肤上沿着彩色墨迹蜿蜒铺陈。她背对着你，正忙着用细画笔在客人身上勾勒图案。一只高挑的玻璃烧杯盛着泛绿的液体，里头浸着消过毒的针头，摆在旁边的桌上。
The walls of the tattooist’s parlor are lined with sketches showcasing the artist’s designs. The artist herself, a black-haired halfling with multicolored ink lining both arms, has her back to you as she busily sketches out a design on her customer with a fine paintbrush. A tall glass beaker of greenish liquid, filled with sterilized needles, sits on a table nearby.

I Put On My Gloves Of Swimming And Climb.name:
我戴上了游泳与攀爬手套
I Put On My Gloves Of Swimming And Climbing

Text.text:
当手套掩蔽住我的双手，内蕴的魔法随即苏醒，指缝间迸生出蛛网般的薄膜，如皮革船帆般张展。细小的倒钩尖刺沿着掌心起伏涌出，似波纹般蔓延开来，将我的抓握力提升至超自然的坚韧与持久。
As the gloves cover my hands, the magic within activates, and webbing sprouts between the fingers like leather sails. Small, hooked spikes grow across the palms in a rippling wave, improving my grip to supernatural levels of tenacity and endurance.

你念完咒语，将贝壳狠狠掷向地面。诡异的低语自你伸出的手掌涌出，化作由无数声音组成的疾风，向你的敌人席卷而去。那些生物在魔法触及之时显得茫然失措，神情错愕。
You complete the incantation and hurl the shells to the ground. Strange whispers emanate from your outstretched hand, flowing outward like a wind of voices toward your foes. The creatures appear bewildered as the magic touches them.

Arrival To The Astral Plane.name:
抵达星界位面
Arrival To The Astral Plane

Text.text:
当你从传送门迈出，周身的微光如蜕皮般从你身上剥落。起初，一切化作花粉般的彩色尘埃，继而变为金属碎屑，再而成了晶体般的半透明。所有经纬度都已消失。你在此又不在此，彼处却在逼近。仍在途中，无论你站得多么纹丝不动。
As you step from the portal, the shimmer peels from you. First, all is colored dust like pollen, then metal flake, then crystalline translucence. All latitude and longitude is gone. You are here and not, there and approaching. In transit, no matter how still you stand.

I Intimidate With A Show Of Strength.name:
我以武力示威进行恐吓
I Intimidate With A Show Of Strength

Text.text: 我厌倦了——不，恶心——这些谈判，于是开始扫视四周。旁边一张桌子正合我意。我拖着步子走过去，无视伙伴们担忧的目光，将那只伤痕累累的手攥成拳。伴随着一声足以惊醒祖灵的咆哮，我一拳砸向桌面，把它轰成四散的碎木屑。 I grow tired—no, sick—of negotiations, so I begin to scan the place. A nearby table will serve my purpose nicely. I trudge to it, ignoring the worried looks from my companions as I clench my scarred hand into a fist. With a roar that would rouse my ancestors, I bring my fist down onto the table, smashing it to splinters.

I Experience Deja Vu.name:
我似曾相识
I Experience Deja Vu

Text.text:
有那么一瞬间，我觉得这一切似曾相识。我记得自己来过这里，说过同样的话，做过同样的事——可那不可能。那段记忆边缘模糊，柔软得像一场早已做过的梦。
For a split second, I feel like I’ve seen this all before. I remember being here, saying and doing the same things—but that can’t be right. The memory is soft around the edges, like something I once dreamed of.

Magical Battle At Draconic Shrine.name:
巨龙圣祠的魔法激战
Magical Battle At Draconic Shrine

Text.text:
披着斗篷的身影彼此绕圈对峙，指尖缭绕着魔法的灼烟与暗火。忽然，一名施法者怒吼打破僵局，轰然抛出一束能量爆发。它擦着对手掠过，砸在地面上炸开，碎石与尘土迸散，形成噼啪作响的碎屑云。第一发既出，其余人便隔着烟幕倾泻力量：燃烧的火球、迸裂的冰晶碎片、以及刺得人眼生疼的电弧。战斗愈发狂烈时，其中一道身影悄然抽身，掠向矗立在混战上方的巨龙雕像。他们将双手按上冰冷的石面，嘶声喊出阴沉的词句，声音竟压过四周的喧嚣。

~ Envisioned by Grim the Tyrannical

Cloaked figures orbit around each other in a standoff, fingers smoldering with magic. One of the spellcasters breaks the tension with a yell, sending forth a blast of energy. It narrowly misses their adversary, bursting against the ground and creating a crackling cloud of debris. The first shot fired, the others unleash their power through the smoke: burning orbs, shards of ice, and arcs of eye-searing lightning. As the fight rages, one of the figures slips away and moves to the draconic statue towering over the skirmish. They place their hands on the stone and shout grim words that rise above the din.

~ Envisioned by Grim the Tyrannical

I Cast Feeblemind Using Glass.name:
我借由玻璃施放【弱智术】
I Cast Feeblemind Using Glass

Text.text:
咒文那回荡不绝的挽歌充塞空气，令四周的氛围如同巨岳般压在我身上。我握紧玻璃，想象敌人的心智被封在它的晶莹矩阵之中，随我将法术完成。毁灭性的精神能量自我掌心轰然迸发。玻璃应声粉碎，将凝聚的魔法释放，直扑我的敌手。
The sonorous dirge of the incantation fills the air, causing the atmosphere to bear down upon me like some titanic burden. I hold the glass and picture my enemy’s mind within its crystalline matrix as I complete the spell. A blast of devastating psychic energy erupts from my hand. The glass shatters, unleashing the focused magic toward my foe.

那猿类生物凌空一跃，兴奋地嚎叫，身形在现实之间毫不费力地穿梭忽隐忽现。赤橙色的皮毛上绘着褐色条纹，覆住这小兽灵巧而结实的躯干。它倒挂在枝头，用修长而敏捷的手指剔着牙。弯曲的犄角——如同公羊之角——自生物的头骨螺旋伸出，使它在咯咯狂笑时更显神秘；随后它荡入树叶深处，转瞬不见。

~ Inbal 在 Discord 上 Envisioned

The simian creature howls with delight as it leaps through the air, effortlessly phasing in and out of reality. Ruddy-orange fur painted with brown stripes covers the small beast's lithe, muscular body. It hangs from a branch, picking its teeth with long, nimble fingers. Curved horns—like those of a ram—spiral out from the creature's skull, giving it a truly mystical appearance as it cackles with glee and swings away into the foliage.

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

Dragon: Cavernous Lair.name:
巨龙：幽深巢穴
Dragon: Cavernous Lair

Text.text:
洞窟般的空间在你面前蜿蜒伸展，像是俯瞰一座兔穴的深洞——只不过这一次，你的体型如同蚂蚁。那些隧道通往何处，你无从揣测，但有什么——或许有许多东西——正栖身在外头的黑暗里。你能听见深处传来回响，像有什么在黑暗深处缓缓移动。
The cavernous space extends sinuously out before you, and it reminds you of gazing down the hole of a rabbit warren. But this time you’re the size of an ant. Where the tunnels go, you cannot fathom, but something—or many things—live out there in the dark. You can hear the echoes of something moving in the depths.

Approaching The Shrine’s Entrance.name:
走近圣所入口
Approaching The Shrine’s Entrance

Text.text:
旭日从群丘间探出头来，长长的影子横扫山谷；你朝着凿入石崖的巍峨巨门走去。此地萦绕着一种令人心安的宁静，你沿着古道残迹前行时，肩头的重担仿佛也随之轻了几分——那道路如今已被荒草吞没，被你之前无数旅人踏磨得只剩尘土与碎砾。
The sun peeks over the hills, casting long shadows across the valley, as you make your way toward the towering doors carved into the stone cliff. A comforting peace lingers here, and your burdens seem to grow lighter as you follow the remains of the ancient road, now overgrown—worn to dust and gravel by countless travelers before you.

这片土地干得像放了十天的饼干一样，平得也一样死板。你刻意避开那些勉强在此苟活的植物——它们无叶可遮，通体披满尖刺。晴空万里之上，太阳从高处无情砸下，灼烤着你脚下那条隐约的痕迹，把不受欢迎的热浪透进你汗湿、沾满尘土的靴底。可你仍咬牙前行，踏过一望无际的荒凉地带：土壤崩碎，枯灌丛生。
The land is drier than a tenday-old biscuit and just as flat. You steer clear of the few plants that have managed to survive here for they are without leaves and covered in thorns. From far past the clear sky above, the sun beats down harshly on the faint trail that you follow, radiating an unwelcome heat into the soles of your sweaty, dusty boots. But you forge ahead, across a desolate expanse of crumbling soil and dry scrub.

Basil Strongworthy.name:
罗勒·斯特朗沃西
Basil Strongworthy

Text.text:
那兔人连同耳朵足有六英尺高，硬是塞进一身华服，单片眼镜一丝不苟，羽饰礼帽更添几分矫饰。他肩上斜扛着一柄邪气森然的长戟——黑钢铸就，猩红符文幽幽发光。这个古怪的生物正和……一块石头争吵。  
“先生，这是你把我的靴子还给我的最后机会。”石头一言不发。  
“好！是你自找的！”
The rabbit man, six feet tall including the ears, is stuffed into fancy clothes complete with a monocle and feather hat. A devilish halberd of black steel and glowing crimson runes is slung across his shoulders. This odd creature is arguing with… a rock. “This is your last chance to give me my boot back, sir.” The rock keeps quiet. “Right! You asked for it!”

Speak With Plants.name:
与植物交谈
Speak With Plants

Text.text:
这道法术的言辞源自古老的魔法——与其说是一曲献给神祇或精魂的赞歌，不如说是献给生命本身。你的心智向植物伸展，听见一片回应的思绪合唱。起初，那些思绪听来像回声，或像你自己的念头；但当你完成法术时，你察觉到新的想法——仿佛你回荡的声音，竟以你从未说出口之语作答。
The words of this spell come from old magic, a paean not to gods or spirits as much as to life itself. Your mind reaches out to the plants and hears a chorus of answering thoughts. These thoughts sound at first like echoes or your own, but as you finish the spell, you detect new ideas, like your echoed voice answering with something you’ve not said.

Quotidian Studies Lecture Hall.name:
日常学讲堂
Quotidian Studies Lecture Hall

Text.text:
墙面下半截是上了清漆的橡木护墙板，往上则贴着壁纸的墙壁被各式图表、示意图、照片、清单与黑板笔记层层覆盖——其间还夹着一排排来自尘世日常、却在魔法面前毫无用处的“必需品”架子。讲课阶段没有讲台，却被布置得像一出史诗剧的布景：一具滑翔伞、一台集水泵、一台立式电风扇与一台配套的桌面款——教授为自己两台都拥有而自豪——此外还有成百上千的零碎物件与时下流行的小玩意。
The walls are wainscoted with lacquered oak panels, above which the wallpapered walls are covered with charts, diagrams, photographs, lists, and chalkboard notes—along with shelves of magically-useless necessities from the quotidian world. The lecture stage has no lectern, but is dressed like the set for an epic play. There is a paraglider, a sump pump, a standing electric fan and a matching tabletop version—the professor is proud to own both—along with hundreds of odds and ends and trending gizmos.

Demonic Torture Chamber.name:
恶魔拷问室
Demonic Torture Chamber

Text.text:
两段浅短的台阶通向这间房：一段自西北上来，另一段自东南而至。这里是走廊里唯一暖和的密室。眼前景象惨不忍睹：骷髅被镣铐锁在墙上，或蜷缩成一小堆小堆的白骨，其中几具骨头已然断裂。再细看便会发现，其中两具似乎被人动过手脚……而且是在血肉早已剥落之后。
Two sets of shallow stairs, one from the northwest and one from the southeast, lead up to this room, the only warm chamber in the halls. The scene is gruesome: skeletons manacled to the wall or huddled in small heaps, several with bones broken. Closer inspection reveals that two of them seem to have been tampered with… after the flesh was already gone.

这名类人生物比半身人还矮些，但身形相仿；橙色皮肤之上，是一颗爬行类的头颅，长着尖尖的、像狗一样的耳朵。它把一只陶罐扣在头上当帽子或头盔，硬生生在罐壁上戳出两处洞让耳朵穿过；手里握着一把匕首，尺寸大得几乎能当短剑使。
Shorter than a halfling but of similar build, this orange-skinned humanoid has a reptilian head with pointed, dog-like ears. It wears a clay pot as a hat or helmet, through which it has broken holes for its ears, while in its hand it wields a dagger big enough to serve it like a short sword.

Runecaster Udor Of The Bibliotheca.name:
藏书圣殿的符文施法者乌多尔
Runecaster Udor Of The Bibliotheca

Text.text:
施法者在一团云朵般的灰白胡须后含笑，温柔地用手掠过坐骑的颈侧。母马朝他喷了口气，又顽皮地点点头，松松系在她颈间的一对铃铛随之叮当作响。男人低低一笑，那声音醇厚温暖，像刚煮好的咖啡。他微微倚着那根天蓝色法杖，杖头卷曲如牧杖般弯钩，其上刻满符文。他那双如日光般明亮的黄眼睛清澈得像夏日晴空，即便笼在蓬松眉毛的阴影下亦然。

~ Played by a Hero

Smiling through a cloud-like beard of white and gray, the caster gently passes a hand along the neck of his mount. The horse huffs at him and nods her head playfully, making a pair of bells tied loosely about her neck jingle. The man chuckles, a sound with the richness and warmth of freshly brewed coffee. He leans a bit on his sky-blue staff, its curling, crook-like head etched with runes. His sun-bright yellow eyes are as clear as a summer day, even under the shade of his woolly eyebrows.

~ Played by a Hero

Twig Blight Ambush.name:
枯枝疫伏击
Twig Blight Ambush

Text.text:
枯枝折断如断骨般脆响，猛地将你从梦中惊醒，你已嗅到危险的逼近。自黑暗中，成百上千只猩红的眼睛——燃着灼亮的狂怒——如亵渎的潮汐般向你压来，伴随着树皮挪动时干涩、刺耳的刮擦般嘶鸣。森林如负伤的野兽般低沉呻吟，在愤怒与痛楚中嘶吼着，随着那些生物一步步逼近。

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Twigs snap like breaking bones, jolting you awake as you sense the danger. From the darkness, hundreds of red eyes—filled with incandescent rage—bear down on you in an unholy tide, accompanied by the dry, rasping croak of moving bark. The forest groans like a wounded beast, calling out in rage and pain as the creatures draw ever closer.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Hacker Executes Attack Program In The Ne.name:
黑客在网络中执行攻击程序：牛仔主题
Hacker Executes Attack Program In The Net: Cowboy Theme

Text.text:
黑客手腕一抖，启动攻击程序，两把左轮霎时显现在掌中，带着西部牛仔的派头绕着伸直的手指飞旋。枪机咔哒上膛，他们摆出决斗姿势，平举枪口锁定目标。
With a flick of their wrists, the hacker activates the attack program and two revolvers appear in their grasp, spinning around their outstretched fingers with Western flair. Cocking the guns, they adopt a dueling stance and level their irons.

A Plea For Peace.name:
和平的恳求
A Plea For Peace

Text.text:
“我知道眼下这一战似乎已无可避免，但只要你牵住我的手，信我一次，我们就能一起从血腥的悬崖边退回来。”
“I know that a fight feels inevitable right now, but if you take my hand and trust me, we can step back from the precipice of bloodshed together.”

Funeral Vault Of A Tiefling.name:
提夫林的葬骨秘窖
Funeral Vault Of A Tiefling

Text.text:
灵柩墓室是一整块抛光黑曜石，形如一枚华美的黑钻，却全然不带任何吉兆。石面没有刻字以铭示其中的安眠者，外壁也不见护佑或好运的徽记——直到满月悄然现身，用揭露一切的月光将其浸透。
The funeral vault is a block of polished obsidian, resembling a lustrous black diamond, yet it is entirely without auspice. No text decorates the stone to name the occupant, and no symbols of protection or good luck grace the exterior—until the full moon creeps into view to bathe the vault in revealing light.

空气温暖而干燥，裹着肉桂、豆蔻与其他难以辨明的香料气息，从商贩的摊位间袅袅飘来。太阳低悬天际，将蟹井城的砂岩染上一层琥珀色的光。你身旁的城池也散发着属于自己的热度——白日里积攒的余温，在夜寒将临时缓缓吐出。这样的暖意令人惬意，并不逼人；头顶的天空晕染成耀眼的橙色，粉色的云朵漫无目的地缓缓漂移。
The air is warm, arid, and laced with cinnamon, cardamom, and other indiscernible spices wafting from the stalls of merchants. The sun, low in the sky, casts the sandstone of Crabwell in amber light. The city around you gives off its own heat, gathered throughout the day and offered as the evening chill sets in. The warmth is pleasant, rather than overbearing, and the sky above flushes a brilliant orange as pink clouds drift aimlessly.

瘦削而结实的半精灵散发着一种澄澈的宁静气息，却被她始终握在手边、随时可动的长矛所打破。尽管有着战士的姿态，她几乎不穿护甲，只披着宽松的黑色束腰上衣与长裤，勉强遮住那一身绷紧如弓弦、随时可扑出的肌肉。她高挑纤细，看上去仍很年轻——也许甚至只是个少女——但精灵血脉又让她的容貌带着一种不受岁月侵蚀的恒久。她的脾气在表面之下微微翻滚，那种近乎掠食者的戒备与蓄势，令人想起一头静伏的巨猫，正等着足够值得的猎物。

~ Played by Walt M. with

The lean, muscled half-elf exudes an air of serene calm, belied by her stoic readiness with the spear she keeps close at hand. Despite her warrior’s bearing, she wears little in the way of armor, instead donning loose-fitting black tunics and trousers which barely hide muscles coiled and ready to strike. She is tall, slender, and seems young—perhaps even an adolescent—though her elf blood clearly lends an agelessness to her appearance. A temper simmers just beneath the surface, an almost predatory preparedness that evokes some great cat lying in wait for worthy prey.

~ Played by Walt M. with

Flumph Encounter.name:
福鲁姆普遭遇
Flumph Encounter

Text.text:
眼前的生物像一只跨维度的水母，以一簇簇扭动的触须游弋前行，触须末端喷吐着细小的反重力能量薄雾。它躯体顶端只有一道如口般的简单开口，看上去仿佛只是极其基础的有机体——直到它以温柔而悠扬的嗓音，直接在你脑海中开口。这个小小的存在既是宇宙的哲学家，也是灵能能量的食客。它传递的善意与智慧之下，却潜藏着一丝疑虑：它在探查，在试探你心中是否有邪念。你不由得想，若它真的找到了一念恶意，会发生什么。

~ Played by Jenzelta

Appearing as a kind of interdimensional jellyfish, the creature before you travels on writhing tendrils that emit little puffs of anti-gravity energy. With a simple opening like a mouth in the top of its body, it seems a very basic organism—until it communicates with your mind in a kind, melodious voice. The little being is a philosopher of the cosmos and a consumer of psionic energy. Underneath the goodness and wisdom of its message is a suspicion, a probing for evil thoughts. You wonder what might happen should it find one.

~ Played by Jenzelta

植被紧贴着怪异的石塔，像帷幕般向下垂落。这些塔宛如石质赘生物自大地拔起，越往上越收束，塔尖没入上方云层的掩蔽之中。
Vegetation hugs the strange stone towers, draping downward like curtains. These towers rise from the earth like stone growths, tapering near their tops, which disappear into the cloud cover above.

Silis Stawich.name:
西利斯·斯塔维奇
Silis Stawich

Text.text:
他的鳞片一直覆到尾尖，因艰辛岁月的磨损而灰暗无光。他蓬乱的长黑发垂落，脸颊上烙着奴隶印记；那双明亮的黄色眼睛仿佛火把照亮的隧道，直通一间闹鬼的密室。任何带威胁的声响都会让他微微一抽，尽显一名习惯弱肉强食、适者生存的蜥蜴人角色的本能。他在兜帽斗篷下穿着鳞甲，斗篷常遮住他的面容；随身携带回旋镖与轻弩。他还带着一只小小的骨傀儡，名叫Shibi。

~ Played by Max_Slacker

His scales, all the way down to the end of his tail, are gray and dull from the wear of a hard life. He has unkempt, long black hair and a slave brand on his cheek; his bright yellow eyes are like torchlit tunnels into a haunted chamber. Twitching slightly at any threatening sound, he reveals all the traits of a lizardfolk used to survival of the fittest. He wears scale mail under a hooded cloak, which often hides his face, and carries a boomerang and light crossbow. He is accompanied by a little bone golem, Shibi.

~ Played by Max_Slacker

Tranquilizing Toxin, Slab.name:
镇静毒素（块状）
Tranquilizing Toxin, Slab

Text.text:
这支安瓿上贴着警示标签，奥秘符号标示着剂量注意事项、过量处置，以及安全存放需求。一张黑市贴纸——灰色的睡眠表情——连同用红色记号笔潦草写下的 s l a b，把药物信息标签盖得严严实实。灰色液体中漂浮着闪烁的碎屑，灌至顶部封口玻璃下方些许。

~ 一位英雄所 构想

This ampule bears a warning label, its arcane symbols indicating dosage cautions, overdose treatment, and safe-storage requirements. A black-market sticker—a gray sleeping emoji—along with s l a b scrawled in red marker, covers the drug-info label. Gray liquid afloat with glittering bits fills the ampule to just below the sealed glass at the top.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Break An Elemental Gem Of Blue Sapphir.name:
我捏碎一枚蔚蓝蓝宝石的元素宝石
I Break An Elemental Gem Of Blue Sapphire

Text.text:
当我捏碎蓝宝石的瞬间，震耳欲聋的旋风在我周身轰然爆发，元素之灵奔涌而出。尖啸翻卷的气流纠结成团，凝聚为类人的轮廓，以空洞而狂澜般的双眼望向我，等待我的指令。
A deafening cyclone erupts around me as I break the sapphire, and the elemental rushes forth. A swirling mass of screaming air coalesces into a humanoid shape and looks to me for instruction with hollow, tumultuous eyes.

Sensing A Devilish Presence.name:
感知魔影般的存在
Sensing A Devilish Presence

Text.text:
你感到一股黑暗的赦免感。某个地狱般的存在，此刻就在你面前，竟对你犯下的一切罪行一笑置之——挥手抹去。如今，那存在鼓动你把邪恶的赌注再加大。你从未如此目的清晰。你被支配的欲望所操控，并被激励去书写新的道德律法。

~ Envisioned by Stefano Imperiale

You feel a sense of dark absolution. Someone infernal, and now in your very presence, has laughed off all the wrongs you’ve committed—waved them away. Now that someone encourages you to raise the stakes of evil. You've never had such clarity of purpose. You are controlled by a drive to dominate, and inspired to write new laws of morality.

~ Envisioned by Stefano Imperiale

这栋改成街角杂货铺的民宅在令人惊叹的井然混乱中运转。顾客的队伍从正门一路排到院子里，屋内的人则挤肩撞肘，朝自己心仪的货物艰难推进。狭窄的桌列与货架行行排开，陈列着五花八门的商品，不论是否冒险者都能在此找到所需。最里侧一张长柜台后，店主忙着逐笔成交。柜台后方立着一只巨大的玻璃柜，里面锁着更稀罕的货色：闪烁的药剂、精致的狩猎匕首与其他小型武器，还有雕工繁复的珠宝饰品。
The home turned corner store operates in an impressively organized chaos. A line of patrons extends out the front door and through the yard, with those already inside elbowing toward their desired wares. Cramped rows of tables and shelves display a variety of goods for all types, adventurers or not. At a long desk in the back, the owners conduct their transactions. Behind them is a large glass cabinet containing rarer goods such as glittering potions, fine hunting daggers and other small weapons, and ornate pieces of jewelry.

你手中的毛虫茧冰冷而脆弱，随着你念完咒文，它在指间悄然崩碎。一股诡异的感觉攫住了你——仿佛化身为灵感迸发的艺术家，一名被骤然涌起的创造力点燃的雕塑家。
The caterpillar cocoon in your hand feels cold and brittle, and as you complete the incantation, it crumbles between your fingers. A strange sensation overtakes you—that of an inspired artist, a sculptor fueled by sudden creativity.

Discovering An Unholy Tome.name:
发现一本亵渎圣典
Discovering An Unholy Tome

Text.text:
你把那本沉甸甸的巨著搬上桌面，拂去其上积了数百年的尘埃与污垢。书封以覆满鳞片的紫色皮肤装订——那皮肤在接触时仍带着温热——其上烙印着怪异而棱角分明的符号，铺陈在掩蔽之上。当你试图辨读，它们便开始舞动、变形，令你眼后渐渐鼓起一股压迫般的胀痛。你不该拥有这本书——任何凡人都不该。
You heft the weighty tome onto the table and wipe away centuries of dust and grime. The book is bound in scaled purple skin—skin still warm to the touch—and has strange, angular symbols emblazoned over the cover. The symbols dance and change as you try to read them, causing a pressure to build behind your eyes. You are not meant to have this book—no mortal is.

Ominous Dead Tree.name:
不祥的枯死树
Ominous Dead Tree

Text.text:
一棵孤零零的枯死树矗立在十字路口中央。它虬结的枝干以不自然的姿态扭曲弯折，与周围森林葱郁的叶影形成刺眼对比。究竟是烈火所致还是巫术作祟，你无从判断，但这景象令人心底发寒。
A solitary dead tree stands at the center of the crossroads. Its gnarled branches bend and twist unnaturally in stark contrast to the leafy foliage of the surrounding forest. Whether this was caused by fire or sorcery you can’t say, but it is a disquieting sight.

Elder Brain Dragon Approaching.name:
长老脑龙逼近
Elder Brain Dragon Approaching

Text.text:
蓝宝石般的鳞片与傲然带角的头颅，昭示这是一条蓝龙。它振翼而行，力量与优雅并存，长尾舒展。然而它背上却蹲伏着一座巨大的、沟槽纵横的隆起肉丘，刺立着一窝紫罗兰色、如鞭抽打的触手。其中几条怪异的臂肢甚至深深嵌入龙的后脑。它的双眼空洞惨白，毫无神采。巨龙俯冲逼近时，巨口张开，一根鼓胀的血肉管道猛然伸出，淌落黏液。

~ Cye 构想

Sapphire scales and an imperious horned head mark this dragon as blue. It flies with power and grace, tail extended. But upon its back squats an enormous, grooved hump bristling with a nest of violet, whiplike tentacles. Some of these aberrant arms are embedded in the back of the dragon’s head. Its eyes are vacant, white. As the dragon swoops closer its mouth opens, and a bulging, fleshy tube extends, dripping slime.

~ Envisioned by Cye

你眼前所见，是一具血肉化作的恐怖：类人身形，皮肤湿滑斑驳，呈淤青般的紫黑色；嘴巴的位置却是一簇翻涌扭动的触须。它披着暗色长袍，以某种诡异皮革缝制而成，那生物看似在空中漂浮，而非行走。当它的目光落到你身上时，头颅深处骤然炸开的剧痛几乎令你失明。
You see before you a horror made flesh: humanoid, with slick, mottled skin the color of a bruise, and in place of a mouth, a cluster of tentacles writhe. Draped in dark robes stitched of some strange leather, the creature seems to float, rather than walk. As their gaze falls upon you, the pain in your head nearly blinds you.

Ancient Bronze Dragon.name:
远古青铜巨龙
Ancient Bronze Dragon

Text.text:
一层华丽的翠绿铜锈覆盖了这条巨龙庞大的大半身躯，但它的翼膜仍保有耀眼的青铜光泽，仿佛能捕捉并折射光线。它的颚部比鳄鱼更为狰狞可怖，可眼周鳞片的细微褶皱却让它平添几分善意的笑意。
A gorgeous green verdigris covers much of the dragon’s enormous body, but its wing membranes retain a brilliant bronze sheen that seems to catch and refract the light. It has jaws more fearsome than a crocodile, but the crinkling of the scales about its eyes give it an air of good humor.

Approaching A Guildhall.name:
走近公会会馆
Approaching A Guildhall

Text.text:
一扇巨大的木门嵌在高耸的石墙间，牢牢守护着公会的院区；城垛上垂着鲜红旗帜，旗面绣着公会的徽记，在风里猎猎作响。大门左侧立着一块告示板，求助、悬赏与招募的告贴被钉得满满当当。右侧的马厩直接凿入墙体之中。门槛边，一个马夫倚着草叉，眯眼打量着你们。“你们这些漂泊客，来此何干？”
A massive wooden door surrounded by high stone walls protects the guild’s campus, red banners decorated with the guild’s emblem hanging from the ramparts. To the left of the front door is a job board with petitions, bounties, and advertisements nailed to its face. To the right, stables have been built into the wall. A stablehand at the threshold leans against his hay rake, eyeing you. “What business have ye, wanderers?”

地精歌声的喧闹你并不陌生，可从未像此刻这般……传染性十足。自这生物炉火纯青的大嘴里滚落而出的，明明只是简单的副歌与稚气的童谣，却像钩子般攫住你不放。那歌声低沉而浑厚，带着一种回响般的庄严；音色更是精湛得近乎炫技，使这名吟唱者与众不同。你不得不集中心神，才勉强忍住不随之哼唱，免得被它那隐秘而轻盈的舞步牵着一同摇摆。它在皮质护甲外披着一件枕套似的长袍，身形比寻常地精更瘦、更略高。最令人不安的是，它看上去竟更干净——至少不像那些战士同类那般带着毒腻的污秽。
The raucous sound of goblin song is not unfamiliar to you, but never before has it seemed so… infectious. Coming from this creature's masterful maw, the simple refrains and childish rhymes grip you without release. There is a sonorous gravitas, a virtuosity of tone that sets this chanter apart, and it takes all your concentration to avoid humming along and joining its subtle dance. Wearing a pillowcase robe over leather armor, the creature is thinner and slightly taller than the average goblin. Most disconcerting of all, they seem cleaner, or at least less toxically filthy than their warrior counterparts.

Ring Of Spell Turning.name:
法术反转戒指
Ring Of Spell Turning

Text.text:
这枚黄铜戒指上镶着一颗方切石英，被打磨得彻底无瑕，宛如一面全身镜；然而你在其表面窥见的细小倒影，却比你见过的任何涂银镜都更清晰、更少扭曲。
The square-cut quartz set in this brass ring has been polished so thoroughly that it resembles a full-length mirror, though the tiny reflections you see in its surface are far more clear and less distorted than any glazed mirror you have ever seen.

Tropical Jungle: Jungle Rain.name:
热带雨林：丛林骤雨
Tropical Jungle: Jungle Rain

Text.text:
你经历过无数场暴雨，却从未觉得水竟能如此……湿。哪怕游泳都仿佛比这更干爽些；而此刻，泥泞的噗嗒、密集的砸落、细碎的噼啪、滴答的渗漏，连绵不绝的潮湿永无止境。你感觉成股的水流沿着身体奔淌而下。即便最宽阔的叶片也提供不了半分庇护，在这无尽倾泻的暴雨中被打得颤抖不止。
You’ve been in plenty of rainstorms before, but never has water felt so… wet. Even swimming seems somehow drier than this squelching, pelting, pittering, pattering, dripping, never-ending damp. You feel rivers of water flowing down your body. Even the broadest leaves offer no shelter as they are battered by the endless downpour.

Tree Pierced By Blades.name:
利刃贯穿之树
Tree Pierced By Blades

Text.text:
在俯瞰战场的荒瘠山丘之巅，孤零零立着一棵树。各色各式的破烂旗帜在它虬结扭曲的枝桠间飘摇翻飞。锈蚀的刀剑被硬生生钉进那巨大的树干，令腐臭的树液——红得远超常理——从龟裂肿胀的树皮间渗出，仿佛在淌血。
Atop the barren hill overlooking the battlefield stands a single tree. Ragged banners of every color and style flutter amongst its gnarled, twisting branches. Rusted blades have been driven into the immense trunk causing fetid sap—far redder than it should be—to bleed into the cracked and swollen bark.

Techno Street Drug, Deep Impact.name:
科技街头毒品：深度冲击
Techno Street Drug, Deep Impact

Text.text:
在亚克力玻璃小瓶之中，这种药物仿佛以水银般的辉芒脉动，化作一团躁动的光之涡流。液体里旋舞着幽光微粒，恍若能窥见无垠的赛博空间诸界一瞬。它是一剂精巧的配方，许诺着力量。诱惑极深；它在召唤，奉上通往内在纳米协和的通行证。

~ 一位英雄构想

Within the acrylic glass vial, the drug seems to pulse with mercurial brilliance, an agitated vortex of radiance. The fluid swirls with spectral particles, showing glimpses of the boundless realms of cyberspace. It is a delicate concoction of promised power. The allure is great; it beckons, offering passage to the nano consonance within.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这位享受夜晚繁华的成熟绅士，自信从容地穿行于街巷，那份笃定仿佛足以掩去一路追随的目光。因为尽管他一身剪裁利落的黑色西装，外披一件雅致的紫色斗篷，发型打理得一丝不苟；尽管以他渐长的年岁而言，那副体魄简直堪称奇迹——仍无法忽视的是，他的左肢正有节律地脉动着：从寻常的肉色渐渐泛成发光的薰衣草紫，又回落如初。更有人在暗处低语，说这同一条肢体竟能化作扭动的触手，于是流言四起：他根本不是人，而是来自已知世界之外的某种怪诞畸变之物。

~ Played by OO1O11O1OO11O11

The mature gentleman enjoying an evening on the town walks through the streets with a self-assured quality that belies the stares following him everywhere he goes. For although he is dressed in a smart black suit with a tasteful purple cloak, his hair carefully styled, and his physique, frankly, a marvel for a man of advancing years, it cannot be ignored that his left limb pulsates steadily: regular flesh tones to a glowing lavender, and back. Moreover, those who watch him whisper that this self-same limb can transform into a writhing tentacle, giving rise to the claim that he is not a man at all, but some sort of freakish aberration from beyond the known worlds.

~ Played by OO1O11O1OO11O11

这头双头巨人蠢得近乎暴怒——仿佛只要死命不去思考任何事物如何运转，就能逼着一切按它的心意运转。你看着其中一颗嘴巴半张的脑袋追随着一只盘旋的苍蝇，肥厚的爪子抬起准备拍下；另一颗则用细小的眼珠警惕地四下扫视。等那只苍蝇落在警惕那颗脑袋的耳朵上时，你以为灾害将至——可盯蝇的那颗脑袋却出人意料地猛地咬住同伴的耳朵，伴随着清脆可闻的咔嚓一声。
This two-headed giant looks furiously stupid—as if determinedly not thinking about how anything works will somehow force everything to work in their favor. As you watch, one slack-jawed head tracks the flight of a circling fly, a meaty paw raised to slap it, while the other looks warily about with beady eyes. When the fly lands on the ear of the wary head, you expect disaster—but the fly watcher surprises you by clamping its jaws over its mate’s ear with an audible crunch.

Old Person With A Pack Of Small Dogs.name:
背着一群小狗的老人
Old Person With A Pack Of Small Dogs

Text.text:
这位老妇人身披层层叠叠的宽大长袍，袍摆拖曳至地，叫人根本数不清有多少只小狗在她脚边窜来窜去。那些蓬松的白色小家伙龇牙低吼、互相撕扯，一会儿钻进她的袍底，一会儿又滚作一团跌出来。她将其中一只举在混乱之上，从她对它轻声哄逗的模样看，显然是最得宠的那只。
The elderly woman wears voluminous robes that drape to the ground, making it difficult to count how many tiny dogs scurry about her feet. The fluffy white animals snarl and tussle, running under her robes and tumbling out again. She holds one above the fray, apparently a favorite based on how she coos to it.

Quip About The Violence Of Legacy.name:
关于传承之暴力的俏皮话
Quip About The Violence Of Legacy

Text.text:
“历史的真相以鲜血书写。只要流得够多，你便永远不会被遗忘。”
“The truths of history are written in blood. Spill enough and you will never be forgotten.”

施法者放下一朵镀金的花。它像羽毛般飘浮，渐渐溶解成柔和的翠绿光芒。随后，自那光芒中央跃出一缕精灵，仿佛因自己的存在而孩童般咯咯发笑。它们在施法者身边蹦跳穿梭，而施法者则随其意志指挥它们。
The caster drops a gilded flower. It floats like a feather, dissolving into a soft green light. Then, from the center, a spirit springs forth, giggling like a child at their very existence. They scamper around the caster, who directs them as they will.

这位龙裔高大魁梧，通体紫色。圆润、挺拔、宽厚。紫罗兰水晶碎片漂浮在他开阔而愉快的脸庞周围，头顶上方更多，下方更少。他一笑，紫至白的晶质獠牙便显露出来；也就在那时，他会微眯起祖母绿般的眼睛——平日里那双眼温和、乐于接纳，却同样锐利。剪裁时髦、打理精致的皮革护甲上点缀着龙鳞，恰到好处地贴合他圆滚的身形。两侧胯部各有一只相配的枪套，里面别着一对一模一样的手枪，洁净如新，与护甲一样一尘不染。一条斜背带将一柄巨锤与一支长步枪固定在他背上。每一件武器都完美得像艺术品。斜背带与腰带上还挂着小袋与工具，让这位爽朗的家伙一眼便像个匠人。若这些道具皆出自他手，那他无疑是位真正的艺术家。

~ 扮演 by a Hero

He’s big and purple, this dragonborn. Round, tall, and wide. Shards of violet crystal float around his broad, cheerful face, more above his head than below. Crystalline fangs, purple to white, show when he smiles. That’s also when he squints his emerald eyes, which are otherwise kind, receptive, and sharp. Stylish, well-kept leather armor, embellished with dragon scales, fits his rotund form exactly right. Matching holsters on each hip hold identical pistols, both as pristine as the armor. A baldric straps a huge hammer and long rifle on his back. Each weapon is an immaculate work of art. The baldric and belt also carry pouches and tools, marking this jovial fellow as a craftsperson. If he’s the maker of his gear, he is an artist indeed.

~ Played by a Hero

Hall Of Justice.name:
正义大厅
Hall Of Justice

Text.text:
这座建筑即便置身城广场的宏伟群楼之间也格外醒目。厚厚的白色粉刷灰泥覆盖了每一寸墙面，唯独台阶例外。巨大的门洞上方门楣处，用当地文字一笔一划精雕细琢地刻着宣誓奉行正义的词句。通往地方法官审判厅的敞开大门两侧，身着一尘不染制服的卫兵肃然而立。

厅内最夺目的是一张高大威严的长桌——让端坐其后的官员能将法庭内的一切尽收眼底，无论当事人还是旁听者。地方法官的长桌旁是一张更小的桌子——墨迹斑斑——以及书记官的座位。正对面是一排座席看台，以木质栏杆与庭审区隔开，专供同侪陪审团就坐。整座冷峻的法庭几无装饰，唯有一尊做工精良的正义神祇小像，象征其对庭审进程的注视与守望。
The building stands out even among the grand structures of the city square. Thick whitewashed plaster coats every inch but the stairs. In the local language, words describing a dedication to justice have been painstakingly carved in the lintel atop the edifice’s oversized portal. Guards in pristine uniforms stand to either side of the open doors leading into the magistrate’s courtroom. The chamber is dominated by an imposing, tall desk—granting the seated official a full view over all within the court, participants and onlookers alike. To the side of the magistrate’s grand desk is a smaller table—spotted with ink—and seat for the court recorder. Opposite them is a gallery of seats, screened from the rest of the courtroom by a wooden railing, reserved for a jury of peers. The austere court is free of decoration, save for a well-made statuette of a deity of justice, symbolizing their watchfulness over the court’s proceedings.

Frujai Soldier.name:
弗鲁贾伊士兵
Frujai Soldier

Text.text:
真菌增生物从这头双足蜥蜴身上向外蔓延；它那条又长又狠的鞭尾布满尖刺。它的脸上看不出任何明显的五官，只是不时抽搐，带着频繁而癫狂的冲动。绿色皮肤斑驳其间，覆着苔藓与孢囊。头颅周围悬浮着一圈岩石，宛如行星外侧绕行的群小行星；一阵嗡鸣般的灵能自它的颅骨深处辐散开来。
Fungal growths stretch outward from this two-legged lizard, its long, lashing tail covered in spines. There seem no obvious features to the face, which twitches with frequent manic impulses. Its green skin is mottled with moss and spore sacs. A halo of rocks hovers around the head, like asteroids orbiting a planet, and a buzz of psychic energy emanates from its cranium.

Eye Of Night Vision.name:
夜视之眼
Eye Of Night Vision

Text.text:
这只义眼由最纯净的翡翠雕琢而成。当你用手指轻轻抚过，它的表面触感清凉，光滑得令人愉悦。柔和嗡鸣的球体外圈，镌刻着纤细流畅的文字，首尾相接成一圈不断裂的环带；其中一侧，一只虹膜的图案占据视野——描绘得完美无瑕。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，Forge Ahead: A Party To Access 创作

Crafted from the purest jade, the surface of this prosthetic eye is pleasantly cool and smooth to the touch as you run your fingers over it. Delicate, flowing script is engraved around the softly humming sphere in an unbroken ring, and the image of an iris—flawlessly depicted—dominates one side.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Vera Khaldrar.name:
维拉·卡尔德拉尔
Vera Khaldrar

Text.text:
锁子甲在朴素的灰色羊毛罩袍下熠熠生辉，一枚银色发箍安稳地戴在她光洁的头顶。矮人屈膝俯身，对着一个孩子轻声开口。她那无毛的额头因怜悯而起了细褶，与他忧惧的神情相互映照；再加上她温和的笑意，似乎让他得到了些许慰藉。她伸出戴着铁手套的双手，掌心泛起缕缕微光。发箍中央的黄玉微微流转，那神圣的魔法如同安抚的药膏，抚平孩子的惶然——也抚慰任何靠近的人。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

With chainmail that gleams brilliantly under a humble tabard of gray wool and a silver circlet resting on her smooth head, the dwarf bends her knee to address a child. The skin of her hairless brow crinkles in sympathy to match his worried look; this and her kind smile seem to bring him some comfort. She holds out gauntleted hands and her palms begin to glow with wisps of light. The topaz in the center of her circlet shimmers, the divine magic a soothing balm for the child—and for any who draw near.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

这把弯刀带着一股非世俗而强劲的气息——握柄上套着一圈光滑、似大理石般的知更鸟蛋蓝色材质。刀刃划开微风时，会发出近似木笛奏出的乐音般的声响。即便静止握持，这件武器也仿佛在主人掌心里低低震颤。
There is something unearthly and potent about this scimitar—its grip ringed with a smooth, marble-like substance in robin’s egg blue. The blade cuts the breeze with a sound that is not unlike a musical note played from a wooden flute. Even when held still, the weapon seems to thrum in its owner’s hand.

Quest Offer From An Old Adventurer.name:
来自老冒险者的委托
Quest Offer From An Old Adventurer

Text.text:
“我这儿有件事要托付给你。要是我这把身子还肯听使唤，我早就自己动手了，可那样的日子已经过去了。报酬不多——也别指望近期会有人为此写歌传唱。不过，这能让这些可怜人的日子好过一点；要是我没看错你，这就足够了。”
“I’ve got something for you. I’d have dealt with it myself if my body would let me, but those days are gone. It don’t pay much—don’t think there’ll be any songs written about it any time soon either. But it’ll make the lives of some of these poor people a little easier, and if I’ve judged you right, that should be enough.”

咧嘴而笑的骷髅头点缀着石制祭坛，每一颗都淌着滚烫的蜡泪。一把阴森狠厉的匕首仍沾着暗黑的血迹，搁在一本以鞣制皮革装订的古书上。摇曳的烛火在祭坛表面刻下的符印上投出颤动的光影，而在骷髅空洞的眼窝深处，幽异的微光悄然闪烁。
Grinning skulls festoon the stone altar, each dripping with hot wax. A wicked-looking dagger, still stained with dark blood, rests upon a tome bound in tanned hide. The flickering candles cast a wavering light upon the sigils carved into the altar’s surface, and from the hollows of the skulls, eerie lights glow.

Wooden Staff Druidic Focus.name:
木质法杖（德鲁伊法器）
Wooden Staff Druidic Focus

Text.text:
未曾被任何刀刃触及，这株倒伏树木的主根在自然魔法的微妙运作下被引导、塑形，化作一根德鲁伊法杖。仅仅让双手沿着光滑的心材轻抚而过，便更能体会其天然朴素之美。
Untouched by any blade, this taproot from a downed tree has been coaxed and shaped into a druidic staff through the subtle workings of nature-magic. Merely running one’s hands along the smooth heartwood emphasizes the beauty in its natural simplicity.

这个高挑而瘦削的身影顶着一颗惨白的秃头。他的手臂与双腿被拉扯得畸长，像粗壮的鳗鱼般扭曲盘绕；身上穿着深色长裤、同色立领外套与黑鞋。双手苍白，尖细的指端却泛起潮红。他的背部在外套下起伏涌动，仿佛有蛇群贴着皮肉蠕行。周遭空气嗡鸣噼啪作响，令他的轮廓一阵阵模糊，恐惧在你胸口发紧，同时眉心深处刺痛。随后，他转过身来，黑色触须自背后伸展而出。他没有脸。

~ 一位英雄构想

This tall, gaunt figure has a pale, bald head. His arms and legs are distortedly long, like thick eels, and he wears dark trousers, a matching collared coat, and black shoes. His hands are pale, reddening toward the end of the pointed digits. His back ripples as if snakes wriggle just under the coat. The air around him buzzes and snaps, blurring his shape, increasing your dread and causing pain between the eyes. Then, he turns, dark tentacles extending from his back. He has no face.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Lodge Of The Lion’s Eye In Winter.name:
冬日的狮眼会馆
Lodge Of The Lion’s Eye In Winter

Text.text:
喧闹的笑声自会馆中轰然荡出。身着宝蓝色罩袍的卫兵们惬意地倚在石质城垛上，彼此闲聊，将冒着热气的木制酒杯送到唇边。其中一人转头望向哈肯大厅的要塞，嘴角勾起一抹痞气十足的坏笑。她把酒杯高高举向天空，扯开嗓子吼着要大家喝彩。同伴们热烈应和，欢庆声势正盛，丝毫没有收场的意思。
Boisterous laughter rings out of the Lodge. Guards, dressed in tabards of royal blue, lean comfortably against the stone ramparts, chatting with one another and bringing steaming wooden tankards to their lips.
