One of them turns her head toward the fortress of Harken Hall, her mouth curling into a roguish smirk. She raises her tankard to the sky, hollering for a cheer. Her fellows respond with zeal, their celebration lively and far from denouement.

Shadow Plane Battle Royale.name:
暗影位面大逃杀
Shadow Plane Battle Royale

Text.text:
宣告一如既往地在影之位面那被古怪算法丈量的岁月里颁下——声浪如雷，热情炸裂。访客与闯入者在街上驻足，皱眉朝噪声望去。本地人——其中大多数天生邪恶——却笑了。所有人都朝斗场的木制看台漫去——或为观战，或为组队下注自己的命运。只需短短几个残酷的小时，所剩无几的队伍便将由最强悍、最聪明的暴徒组成。当他们缠紧绷带、擦净血污时，必须凭借从看台门下方地窖里传出的低沉咆哮，去猜测那只怪物——而最终那支满身血痕的队伍，将与之进行最后一战。

~ Envisioned by PiousMight

The proclamation is issued as it always has been over the strangely-calculated years of the Shadow Plane—with booming enthusiasm. Visitors and interlopers stop in the street and frown toward the noise. The natives, most of them categorically evil, smile. All wander toward the wooden grandstands of the battle ground—either to watch, or to form teams and take their chances. Within a few short, brutal hours, the few remaining teams will be made of the toughest and smartest of the violent. As they wrap and clean their wounds, they must guess—based on the growling emanating from a vault beneath the bleacher gate—about the monster that one final, bloodied team will battle.

~ Envisioned by PiousMight

Aglian Collective.name:
阿格利安联合体
Aglian Collective

Text.text:
这些生物的生命里有水，你的体内也有水。你如今明白了这一点。置身于这些鳗状存在的周围，你得到了许多领悟——又或者说，是一种彻底的宁静。起初它们看上去微不足道，甚至令人作呕；可当你再度凝视，成群的鳗影在水中起伏摆荡，涌动着无数可能。你听见那是声音吗？那团涌动是否正在结出形状？这一切都在诉说：知识藏在水的幽深之处，等待被发现。
There is water in the life of these creatures and there is water in you too. You understand that now. You have come to many understandings in the presence of these eel-like beings, or maybe rather a sense of utter calm. They seemed trivial, even repulsive at first glance, but now you look again and the throng of eels oscillates with possibility. Is that a voice you hear? Is the swarm making shapes? This speaks of knowledge to be found within watery depths.

教堂门口上方的霓虹十字架泛着金色光芒，嗡鸣声大得像发电机。光束倾泻而下，打在敞开门槛处迎宾的人身上，把他额头的汗珠照得发亮，仿佛为他戴上一圈粼粼的光环。他穿着一件磨旧的西装外套，缝线处都快散开了，原本的黑色褪成了烟灰般的暗灰。汗渍浸透的衬衫领口衬出他喉间突起的发声器，清晰可见。他对着陆续到来的会众开口时，那东西噼啪作响、滋滋冒电：“你好，姊—zzz-—妹。哈—hoood… 祝你安好，弟兄。”他与会众交换的笑容看起来真挚，嘴角在深陷的眼窝下毫无拘束地舒展。教堂外的电牌忽明忽暗，亮度不及十字架夺目，上面写着 All are welcome。教堂本身是一块方方正正的混凝土建筑，窗户破碎，用木板钉死，两侧则是高耸的公寓楼夹立。 The neon cross above the church entrance glows golden and hums as loud as a generator. The light beams down on the greeter at the open threshold, illuminating the sweat on his brow that crowns him like a glistening halo. He wears a worn suit jacket dwindling at its seams, its black color faded to a smoky gray. The sweat-stained collar of his shirt frames a visible voice box protruding from his throat. It crackles and fizzles as he addresses the arriving members of the congregation. “Hello, sis-zzz-ter. Gah-hoood… Good day, brother.” The smiles shared between him and the members seem genuine, their mouths stretching freely under sunken eyes. The electric sign outside the church flickers, its light not so brilliant as the cross, reading All are welcome. The church itself is a square block of concrete with broken, boarded-up windows, flanked by towering apartment buildings.

Sundries From A Mushroomfolk.name:
来自蘑菇族的杂货
Sundries From A Mushroomfolk

Text.text:
在一片片有毒分泌物的飞溅间，散落着几滩带色的真菌黏液；若有合适的技能加以处理，它们可制成多种染料。然而采集时必须格外谨慎，才能在不沾染毒素的情况下取走这些染料。
Among a spattering of poisonous secretions are small puddles of colored fungus that could serve as various dyes with the right skill to work them. Care must be taken, though, in gathering the dyes without contracting the toxins.

滴水兽自那座庄严建筑的陡斜屋脊冷冷俯瞰，昭示此地受黑暗之力庇护——哪怕那些雕像并未腾然苏醒。高而狭长的窗户透出一种傲慢的疏离感，而那扇深绯色的巨大正门以铁条加固，漆成亮泽的黑色，并被塑造成荆棘藤蔓般的纹饰。
Gargoyles glare stonily down from the pitched roof of the stately structure, signaling this place is protected by dark forces, even if the statues don’t spring to life. Tall, narrow windows give the impression of hauteur, and the great crimson entry doors bear iron bracing, painted a glossy black and fashioned to look like thorny vines.

Polar Bear's Magical Awakening.name:
北极熊的魔法觉醒
Polar Bear's Magical Awakening

Text.text:
你低声念出咒语，将一只颤抖的手按在北极熊的额头上。那庞然巨兽因你的接触而浑身倒竖，起初本能地退缩，随后却又慢慢贴近，任由你的掌心覆住它。光辉自你的手中涌出，没入野兽雪白的皮毛深处，又在它的眼眸里点燃一抹超脱尘世的幽辉。它缓缓吐出一口气，像是一声叹息；那双眼随之睁大、瞳孔扩张，仿佛沉睡的心智正被唤醒。

~ Envisioned by Venjin

You utter the words and place a trembling hand upon the polar bear’s forehead. The massive beast bristles at your touch, shying away at first, but then it eases into your palm. A glow emanates from your hand, disappearing into the beast’s snow white fur and alighting its eyes with an otherworldly gleam. The beast eases out a breath, something like a sigh, and those eyes widen and dilate as its mind awakens.

~ Envisioned by Venjin

这杯高挑的啤酒冰凉起泡，金黄的酒色里微微泛着一丝绿意。泡沫顶端不似白云，而如甲虫翅翼般流光溢彩。酒香是最苦烈的柑橘气息，辛锐地咬住鼻尖。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

This tall glass of beer, cold and frothy, has a golden color tinged with a hint of green. The foamy head is not a cloud of white, but iridescent as beetles’ wings. The aroma from the drink is one of the bitterest citruses, biting on the nose.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Wheelchair User's Boast About Speed.name:
轮椅使用者对速度的夸口
Wheelchair User's Boast About Speed

Text.text:
“你自以为敏捷？你每一步都向前栽倒，祈祷那两根木棍能接住你。给我一段缓坡，我的速度足以让任何人或野兽都自惭形秽。”

~ 构想 by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

“You think yourself swift? You fall forward praying for those two sticks to catch you with every step. Give me a gentle slope and my speed will put any person or beast to shame.”

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Bathing In Gold.name:
沐浴于黄金之中
Bathing In Gold

Text.text:
一个男人穿着朴素的束腰短袍与长裤，整个人蜷进一只铜制浴缸里——缸中满是金灿灿的钱币。他四肢懒散地搭在缸沿外，像孩子似的胡乱摆动。忽然，他猛地抛起一把钱币，喉咙里爆出得意的狂笑；钱币几乎触及天花板，随即簌簌落回。

他手里还握着一只圆肚酒壶，随着夸张的手势晃荡不止，酒液荡出一抹暗红，泼洒在地板上。他毫不在意，沉溺其中地咯咯笑着，双腿乱踢，脚跟砰砰敲在缸壁上，震得宝藏叮当作响。
Fully clothed in a plain tunic and breeches, a man has nestled himself in a copper bathtub full of golden coins, all his limbs hanging over the lip and wagging whimsically. He suddenly tosses a handful of coins into the air, his throat barking out triumphant guffaw as they nearly reach the ceiling. The rounded fiasco gripped in his hand sloshes with his gesticulation, spilling a splotch of wine onto the floor. Uncaring and indulgent, he giggles as he kicks his legs, his heels thumping against the side of the tub and causing the treasure to jingle.

Acolyte's Departure From Her Cult Compou.name:
侍徒离开她的邪教据点
Acolyte's Departure From Her Cult Compound

Text.text:
在昏暗的夜色里，一名披着邪教祭服的年轻女子从一处阴森的院落仓皇逃出。她加快脚步时不住回头，焦灼的目光泄露了她对追兵的恐惧。风暴在头顶酝酿，她用绳子牵着一头瘦弱、驮载沉重的驴，哪怕那负重的牲口挣扎不前，她仍咬牙将它拖向前方。

~ Walt M. 构想

In the dimly lit night, a young woman bedecked in cultish vestment flees a sinister-looking compound. Her anxious glances as she quickens her pace betray her fear of pursuit. A storm gathers above as she leads a frail, heavily laden donkey by rope, pulling the burdened beast forward despite its struggle.

~ Envisioned by Walt M.

书房里堆放着地图与其他巨幅卷轴，房间里各式支架与角落的置物架都塞满了磨损起毛的羊皮纸与牛皮纸卷。中央那张巨大的方桌被一幅地图完全铺满。地图所绘地域的各处插着小旗与木制棋子，标示着公会成员最新的动向。
The study is a holding place for maps and other large scrolls, and various stands and the shelving unit in the corner of the room are brimming with rolls of frayed parchment and vellum. One map covers the large, square table in the center of the room. Small flags and wooden figures are set at various spots throughout the pictured region, representing the latest movements of guild members.

God Of Wilderness.name:
荒野之神
God Of Wilderness

Text.text:
这位雌雄莫辨的神祇，司掌野性生存与自然之死。祂身披藤蔓与盘根缠绕而成的护甲，内里是以花瓣、蛛网、蜕下的蛇皮与羽毛裁制的衣裳。手执一根由枯枝死木削成的朴素木杖，祂踏行于林野边界——荒原与农田、道路相接之处；亦会漫步森林，向树木求教。群兽为祈得祝福而传递讯息。只消看那微挑的眉、原初般的凝视，你便知这位荒野之神带着苦甜交织的忧郁，时刻警惕文明的言语——比如“外来者”。
This is the androgynous god of wild living and natural death. The god wears a winding armor of vine and root over clothing tailored from petals, webs, shed snakeskin, and feathers. Carrying a simple wooden staff of deadfall, the god marches the sylvan border where wilderness meets farm and road, or strolls the forests to learn from trees. Animals exchange messages for blessings. You can tell by the arched eyebrow, the primal stare, that the God of Wilderness is bittersweet, melancholy, always on guard against civilization’s words, such as “outsider.”

Castaway Mumbles A Haunting Song.name:
遇难者喃喃哼唱着一支幽魂般的歌
Castaway Mumbles A Haunting Song

Text.text:
你把那名风烛残年的遇难漂流者拖上船，朝众人喊着要水，祈祷自己来得还不算太晚。男人的皮肤布满盐霜结痂的水疱，双眼在恍惚中涣散游移，嘴里含混不清地低声嘟囔着。你凑近才发现，他喃喃的并非胡言乱语，而是一首熟悉的歌。那一瞬间的领悟如巨浪拍岸般击中你，顷刻吞没你的感官，你在这骇人的认知里挣扎不已。

~ 由Clara C. Potter在Discord上构想

Hauling the decrepit castaway aboard, you call out for water, hoping you're not too late. The man's skin is covered in salt-rimed blisters, and his eyes swim with delirium as he mumbles something incoherent under his breath. Drawing closer, you realize that it is not gibberish he mutters but a familiar song. The revelation hits you like a crashing wave, consuming your senses as you grapple with this knowledge.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

这些招式既美丽又骇人：优雅的回身、流畅的挥舞，每一次转腕都带动延展的锋刃划出致命的弧光。一手握着日刃，炽亮的光辉在六角法师周身迸放；另一手则是施法者亲自召出的影刃，色调黯沉，与其辉煌的同伴形成鲜明对照。在双刃与持刃者之间，一道第三的锐边——月刃——如海中海豹般轻巧浮沉，悬停于侧，蓄势待发。

~ Envisioned by Harleyquin5713

The moves are as beautiful as they are fearsome, elegant turns and smooth flourishes of each arm and its extended blade. In one hand a Sun Blade, flaring its radiance around the hex mage, and in the other a Shadow Blade of the caster’s own conjuration, its tone dusky in contrast to its counterpart. Dancing among the blades and their wielder, a third sharp edge—a Moon Blade—bobs like a seal in the ocean, hovering ready.

~ Envisioned by Harleyquin5713

Therianthropy Chimeric Transformation.name:
兽化异变：奇美拉变身
Therianthropy Chimeric Transformation

Text.text:
血管发黑鼓起，又在薰衣草色的皮肤退去、让位于长短不一、色泽各异的毛皮时悄然隐没。手臂愈发黯沉并拉长，皮肤先变得如皮革般坚韧，继而迸出黑毛，指节被拉得更长、更弯。穿着凉鞋的双脚覆上一层棕色皮毛，弯曲的黑色利爪破皮而生。骷髅般的面具下猛然窜出橙色毛发，黑纹如刃般横斜；耳朵一路上移到头顶，化作尖尖的猫科三角耳。半袍之下，一条华丽的红狐尾巴悠然探出。

~ 构想：Wooz Van-Von Brichafort Nightblossom

Veins blacken and bulge, then disappear as lavender skin gives way to fur of varied tones and lengths. Arms darken and elongate, skin turning leathery before sprouting black hair while digits lengthen and curl. Sandaled feet grow a brown coat and curved black claws. From under the skull-like mask springs orange fur striped in black, and ears move to the top of the head, becoming triangular, feline. From beneath half-robes emerges the luxurious tail of a red fox.

~ Envisioned by Wooz Van-Von Brichafort Nightblossom

方形石块以粗厚的编织绳串连成链，闷燃如炭，火光缠绕。石板被挪动时噼啪吐出火星，点点魔焰落地却不引燃分毫。这些石头也并没有看上去那般危险——它们不会灼痛肌肤，更不会把血肉烫化；相反，那股热意令人安心，像披上一条被炉火烘暖、沉甸甸的毯子。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Square stone pieces, chained together by thick, woven rope, smolder like coals wreathed in fire. The slabs sputter sparks as they’re moved, with motes of magical flame that do not catch fire as they land. The stones, as well, as not as dangerous as they look. They do not burn painfully or melt away at flesh—instead, the heat is comforting, like the weight of a hearth-warmed blanket.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Angler Dragon Turtle.name:
钓鲜龙龟
Angler Dragon Turtle

Text.text:
一头来自深渊的恐怖在幽蓝中浮现。修长的尾巴与探伸的长颈让人想起鳗鱼的身形，可那柔软的翠绿甲壳与鳍肢却又像海龟。它的头部扁平而椭圆，似蛇一般，布满无数针刺般细密牙齿的巨口骤然张开。喉间两排浑圆的金色光球猛然亮起。一条在旁游弋的鲨鱼甩尾转身，让鼻尖对准那光。它倒霉又好奇，缓缓靠近。巨龙的眼睛没有丝毫兴奋或宽慰——那是两颗巨大而黯淡的圆珠，仿佛既不映照，也不传达任何情绪。
A horror from the deep appears in the blue. A long tail and reaching neck recall an eel’s body, but the soft green shell and flippers are similar to a turtle. Its head is flat and ovular like a snake’s, and its mouth of manifold, needling teeth suddenly opens wide. Two rows of globular golden lights flare up in its throat. A shark swimming nearby whips its tail to point its nose toward the light. Hapless and curious, it ventures closer. The dragon’s eyes show no sign of excitement or relief; they are large, dull orbs that don’t seem to reflect or convey any feeling at all.

在河畔目睹雄鹰现身，是大自然的赋礼。它们华贵的羽衣与惊人的翼展，令所有旁观者为之屏息。只见一只优雅俯冲，溅起水花没入水中，片刻后破水而出，利爪紧扣着一条挣扎不休的鱼。
Witnessing the eagles’ presence by the river is a gift of nature. Their regal plumage and huge wingspans captivate all who observe them. With a graceful dive, one splashes into the water, emerging moments later with a struggling fish grasped tight in its claws.

病灶如干燥引火物上的烈焰般蔓延，以残酷的效率摧毁躯体。起初，四肢沉重如铅，力气被一点点抽空。随后是疲惫——一种隐隐作痛的耗竭，啃噬着你的精神，连求生的意志也被榨干。接着，皮肤苍白如渐盈的月光，直至终末阶段攫住你——一层晶莹的冷辉凝结其上，将血肉彻底固化。

~ 由 Sahlonahl 在 Discord 上 构想

The sickness spreads like flames in dry tinder, ravaging the body with brutal efficiency. First, limbs become leaden as it saps your strength. Then comes the fatigue, an aching drain on your spirit that saps your will to live. Then the skin becomes pale like a waxing moon before the final stages take hold—and a crystalline sheen solidifies the flesh.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Border Town Tavern.name:
边境小镇酒馆
Border Town Tavern

Text.text:
你推开酒馆那扇厚重的橡木门，最先扑面而来的不是大火炉的热浪，而是两股气味在鼻腔里狠狠干上了一架：未洗身体的酸馊恶臭，与厨房里勾人馋虫的浓郁香味。  

角落里坐着一群边境游骑兵，桌上还散着残羹冷炙。他们兜帽压得很低，阴影里的目光冷冷追着你移动，你径直走向吧台那张空位。  

你试着引起那位忙得焦头烂额的女侍注意。她抹开汗湿的头发，朝你打了个手势，示意再等一会儿。她先把一杯酒递给一个几乎只用颜料遮身的野蛮人，随后一瘸一拐地挪到你面前。  

“想喝点什么毒？”她疲惫地问，手却已条件反射般伸向一只大啤酒杯。
The stink of unwashed bodies competes with the mouth-watering odor coming from the kitchen, hitting you before the heat of the large fire, as you push through the heavy oaken door of the tavern. A group of border rangers sits in one corner—the remains of a meal on the table before them—watching with hooded eyes as you make for an empty seat at the bar. You try to attract the attention of the harassed-looking barwoman. She pushes hair from her sweaty face and gestures for you to wait a moment. After serving a barbarian clad in little but paint, she limps over. “What’s your poison?” she asks in a weary voice, automatically reaching for a tankard.

Guards And Wards.name:
守卫与结界
Guards And Wards

Text.text:
你细细观察着自己想要守护的这片区域的地貌细节，手指娴熟地拨弄银杖，搅动着法术材料的混合物。奥术能量在你的掌控之下涌动，你开始编织一道道结界，协助你与同伴守住此地——无论这里原本如何构筑，都将化作一座由魔法伟力铸就的堡垒。
You observe the details of the landscape of the area you wish to protect as your fingers expertly manipulate the silver rod stirring the mixture of spell components. With the arcane energies at your command you begin to form the many wards that will help keep this place safe for you and your allies, making it into a fortress of magical might regardless of construction.

Loot From A Hollyphant.name:
来自圣象幼兽的战利品
Loot From A Hollyphant

Text.text:
神象幼体身上的两根獠牙完好无损，随时可供采收。每一根都能由大师级铁匠锻造成一把威力强大的利刃。
The two tusks on the hollyphant’s body are in pristine condition, ready to be harvested. Each can be forged into a powerful knife by a master smith.

Andros Lucarius Hemfurt.name:
安德罗斯·卢卡里乌斯·亨姆弗特
Andros Lucarius Hemfurt

Text.text:
高挑而修长的提夫林身披上等丝绸长袍，珠宝熠熠，气度雍容。两颗黑色宝石嵌在他的犄角上——犄角自面颊两侧向后掠过，沿颈后延伸，最终如箭囊中并列的两支箭般笔直耸立于头顶。银白的长发披垂肩头；淡紫灰的肌肤与无瞳无虹膜的红紫眼眸相映，使这男人周身萦绕着异界般的气息——更别提那对蝠翼，紧紧收拢在背后，宛如一袭薄膜斗篷。他随意倚着一根华美的长杖，嘴角勾着一抹歪斜的笑意。

~ Played by ๖ۣۜStrix 

The tall, lithe tiefling strikes a regal look in robes of fine silk, gleaming jewelry, and a pair of black gemstones embedded in horns that sweep from the sides of his face to the nape of his neck before standing straight above his head like two arrows in a quiver. Silvery white hair drapes across his shoulders. Paired with lilac-gray skin and red-violet eyes devoid of pupil or iris, the man possesses an otherworldly energy—to say nothing of the bat-like wings folded tight against his back like a membranous cloak. He leans casually on an ornate staff, a crooked smile playing at the corners of his mouth.

~ Played by ๖ۣۜStrix

I Tune My Lute.name:
我调好我的鲁特琴
I Tune My Lute

Text.text:
我闭上双眼，逐根拨动琴弦，努力让脑海中的音符与耳畔所闻一一吻合。最后再拧上四分之一回合——一次轻柔的接触——将最后一根弦恰到好处地绷紧，让我的乐器精准无误地调至完美音准。它已准备好去取悦、点燃，并俘获我的观众。
I close my eyes as I pluck the strings one by one, trying to match the notes in my mind to the ones I hear. A final quarter turn—a delicate touch—tightens the last string just enough to bring my instrument perfectly in tune. It is ready to delight, excite, and enthral my audience.

Quip By A Cruel King About Protests.name:
残暴国王对抗议的嘲讽俏皮话
Quip By A Cruel King About Protests

Text.text:
“他们的抗议背后的念头让我发笑，仿佛我还不知道他们在受苦，而只要提上一句就能促使我行动。他们不明白的是，供养并给那些病弱者穿衣的开销，远比雇几个人让他们闭嘴要昂贵得多。”
“The idea behind their protestations tickles me, as if I wasn’t already aware of their suffering and its mere mention would inspire action. What they fail to understand is that feeding and clothing the sickly is far more expensive than hiring a few men to silence them.”

一枚晶莹的晶质槌首——一端渐收成尖——嵌在这柄非凡战镐优雅的银色镐身之上，宝石打磨得通透耀亮。柄尾的环扣处垂下一缕银线编成的穗带，其长度间或穿缀着玄奥护符，护符上镶着微小的蓝宝石。
A crystalline head—tapered to a point at one end—caps the elegant silver body of this remarkable war pick, the gemstone polished to a transparent gleam. A braided tassel of silver thread hangs from the loop at the pommel, its length threaded with esoteric charms set with miniature sapphires.

玫瑰的香气萦绕在这位兔人族身周，她一袭灰色斗篷披得利落而讲究。粉红的鼻尖从兜帽下探出，一双湛蓝的大眼冷静地从阴影里审视着外界。纤长的耳朵——外侧白绒、内里粉嫩——从兜帽的开口处穿出。她身上的皮革与斗篷同样深沉而华丽，细致的滚边与压纹点缀其间。她的细剑与长匕首同样优雅相称，而她背负的长弓更堪称艺术品：弓身反曲，由多层木料叠合而成，仿佛那些木纹原本就一同生长、彼此交融。

~ Played by ajw9024 with

The scent of roses fills the air around this rabbitfolk, who is stylishly mantled in gray. Her pink nose extends from her hood, and wide blue eyes coolly peer from within. Slender, long ears—white of fur and pink on the inside—poke through openings in her hood. The leather she wears is as dark and ornate as the cloak, with fine trim work and embossing. Her rapier and long knife match in elegance, but the longbow she carries is a true work of art, recurved and fashioned from multiple layers of wood that seems to have grown together.

~ Played by ajw9024 with

I Cast Revivify.name:
我施放回生术
I Cast Revivify

Text.text:
我以一口短促的气息吐出法术咒言，深知每一瞬流逝都关乎生死。背包随之变轻——我感到那些钻石在法术的魔法中化为齑粉消散，这是必须支付的价格。鲜绿如毒的闪电自我胸口迸裂，沿着双臂奔流而下，狂暴的能量在掌心汇聚。我一记迅疾的重击，将双手狠狠按进目标的胸膛……他们的双眼猛然睁开，角膜上血管爆裂，血色在其中漫开。他们抽出一口枯槁的喘息——再度活了过来。
I speak the words of my spell in one, quick breath, knowing every passing moment is critical. My pack grows lighter as I feel the diamonds dissipate with the magic of the spell—a price that must be paid. Vivid, green lightning crackles from my chest, down both of my arms, the energy converging in my palms. I slam my hands into my target’s chest with one swift strike… and their eyes shoot open, corneas pooling with burst blood vessels. They draw a haggard breath, alive once more.

昏暗的储藏室角落里阴影攒动，与层层堆叠的箱子和密密麻麻的蛛网相互交错。霉烂食物与腐朽木料的恶臭沉沉压在空气中，老鼠为躲避闯入者而窜逃的沙沙声在墙壁间微弱回荡。
Shadows loom in the corners of the dim storage room, playing off the stacked crates and many cobwebs. The stench of molded food and rotten wood hangs heavy in the air, and the sound of rats scurrying away from the intruder echoes feebly off the walls.

连枷的沉重锤头如同磁石般，从缠在握柄上的铁链末端垂落；锯齿般的尖刺狰狞外露，向任何迎上它的人许诺一场痛苦的终结。握柄的木头因久经使用而磨损褪色，武器上还被粗糙地刻下了数道痕迹——也许是记下的杀戮数？
The weighted head of the flail hangs like a lodestone from the iron chain bound to the haft, its jagged spikes promising a painful end to those who meet it. The wood of the handle is worn and faded with use, and several crude markings have been carved into the weapon. A kill tally, perhaps?

Void Sphere Resisted By Target.name:
虚空球体被目标抵抗
Void Sphere Resisted By Target

Text.text:
那球体逼近，贴着你的目标掠过，伴随回荡的牵引力与啃噬般的饥饿。尽管其冲击如数记重拳般凶狠，这道擦刮却仿佛只让他们寒意透骨、浑身战栗。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The sphere comes close, brushing past your target with a reverberating pull of gnawing hunger. Although as bruising as several solid blows, the scrape seems to only chill and shake them.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

榛色的眼眸在她浓密的棕色皮毛间闪烁，目光锐利而警惕。她微微低着鼻尖，带着几分怯生生的神情。某种内在的不安让她长长的脚始终轻盈待发，爪子却紧紧扣住一根节疤嶙峋的四分棍。她穿着朴素的旅人衣装：一袭长斗篷、短上衣与裤脚裁短的长裤，免得妨碍她跳跃。腰带上垂着一支排箫，旁边是入鞘的匕首；背后斜挂着一面小圆盾。

~ 由一位英雄 Played 使用

Hazel eyes sparkle out from her rich brown fur, and they observe with a keen wariness. She keeps her nose turned down in a sheepish manner. Some inner apprehension keeps her light on her long feet, and her paws grip tightly about a gnarled quarterstaff. She wears simple traveler’s clothes: a long cloak, tunic, and pants cut short to not impede her hop. A pan flute dangles from her belt next to a sheathed dagger, and a small buckler is slung across her back.

~ Played by a Hero with

Bandit Captain: Female.name:
强盗头目：女性
Bandit Captain: Female

Text.text:
这名战士手中的弯刀在空中蜿蜒扭动，像一条警觉的蛇，仿佛被另一只手里长匕首的移动所催眠。她的步伐同样轻捷，将她带入飘忽却摄人心魄的回旋之中。这是一支致命的舞蹈，但此刻，她还缺少一位舞伴。
The curved sword in this warrior’s hand writhes through the air like a wary serpent, as if hypnotized by the movement of the long dagger in the other hand. This fighter’s feet are just as nimble, carrying her in erratic but entrancing circles. It is a deadly dance, but at the moment she lacks a partner.

女巫傲然挺立，手握弯曲的法杖，杖身的弧度与她自身的犄角如出一辙。藤蔓般的刻纹以鲜亮灵动的色彩缠绕在法杖与角上，蜿蜒攀附。它们与她的凝视同样炽烈地发光。她的口鼻皱起，露出一抹狞笑，正要吐出一句法术——或一句刻毒的恶言。
The witch stands imperiously tall with her curved staff in hand, the bend in it mirroring that of her own horns. Etchings, vine-like in shape and sprightly color, wind over her staff and horns. They glow with the same intensity as her stare. Her snout bunches into a snarl as she prepares to speak a spell—or a cruel word.

Sundries From A Silver Dragon Lair.name:
银龙巢穴的杂物
Sundries From A Silver Dragon Lair

Text.text:
这座山巅的空气冷冽刺骨，你在搜寻高塔时，高海拔以令人眩晕的效果狠狠压在你身上。巨龙一动不动的躯体如同一圈闪烁霜华的花环，蜿蜒缠绕在建筑周围。这里古老得像从时间里剥落的残片，是某个久已失落聚落的遗迹；满目尽是虫蛀的挂毯、黯淡失色的护甲套装，以及一触即碎的脆薄书册。
The air is bitingly cold on this mountain peak, and the altitude impresses its dizzying effect upon you as you search the tower. The dragon’s unmoving body weaves around the building like a garland of glittering hoarfrost. This place is ancient, a relic of a long-lost settlement; it’s full of moth-eaten tapestries, tarnished suits of armor, and brittle books.

Green Consort To The Seelie Queen.name:
侍奉精灵女王的翠绿宠妃
Green Consort To The Seelie Queen

Text.text:
这位美丽而超凡脱俗、宛如精灵的存在披着苔绿长袍，银边微光流淌。修长纤瘦的四肢优雅地比划着，叶片绕着他们细若枝条的身影旋舞不休。深邃的大眼占据了那张瘦削而锋利的面庞，点点赤褐雀斑散落其间；暮色里，他们肌肤上那抹淡淡的翠绿也愈发清晰。
The beautiful, otherworldly elf-like being drapes themself in mossy green robes edged with silver. They gesticulate gracefully with long, lean limbs as leaves swirl about their spindly frame. Large, dark eyes dominate a thin, sharp face speckled with auburn freckles, and a faint emerald hue to their skin becomes evident in the twilight.

I Shoot From A Flying Car.name:
我从飞车上开枪
I Shoot From A Flying Car

Text.text:
我一手稳住方向柱，另一手拔枪，探身出窗，任风拍打在脸上——我感觉自己活着。肾上腺素在体内狂飙，我拼命强迫自己稳住视线，只求能集中片刻，打出一发干净利落的枪。
Bracing the steering column with one hand, I lean out of the window with my gun drawn, relishing the sensation of the wind on my face—I feel alive. Adrenaline pulses through my body as I desperately try to focus long enough to take a clean shot.

Frightened Journal Entry About Lycanthro.name:
关于兽化症的惊惧日记条目
Frightened Journal Entry About Lycanthropy

Text.text: 一段仓促的字迹潦草地爬满纸面，乱得几乎整篇都难以辨认。只有开头最为清晰，上面写着：“我虚弱得几乎无法把字按在纸上。我被这令人作呕的饥渴折磨得狼狈不堪。月亮——我能感觉到云层后的月亮。它在搏动。它在呼吸。它与我的心同频震颤——为了我的心。还有我的头脑。这饥渴——” A rushed script scrawls across the page, so messy that most of the entry is illegible. The beginning of the passage is the most clear, and it reads: “I can barely press letters upon the page, I have become so weak. I am wretched with this sickening hunger. The moon—I can feel the moon behind the clouds. It pulses. It breathes. It thrums with my heart—for my heart. And my mind. This hunger—”

Great Stone Wall.name:
巨石之墙
Great Stone Wall

Text.text:
一个世纪的劳役，在绵延数百里地形上铺陈起沉重的石块。城墙如土蛇般蜿蜒，登上丘陵又没入雾蒙蒙的谷地。基脚石与贯通石、心石与起吊装置——一切都只为阻隔墙那一侧的人。每隔几里，在建造者这一边便有一段阶梯，以旗帜为记，自草地一路攀上低矮胸墙后的宽阔步道。
The labors of a century placed heavy stone blocks along hundreds of miles of terrain. The wall curves like an earthen snake, rising on the hills and disappearing into misty valleys. Footings and through stones, heartstones and lifts, all to keep out the people on the other side. Every few miles, a staircase on the builder side, marked by a flag, climbs from the grass to the great walkway behind the low parapets.

Corporate Spacecraft Hangar.name:
企业航天器机库
Corporate Spacecraft Hangar

Text.text:
巨大的机库里，抛光得镜面般的地坪铺展成无垠的平原，目力所及尽是各式夺目的飞行器悠然停泊其上。灯光炽烈，身着日耀橙的官员在舰艇间列队穿行，审慎核对每位飞行员的资质，同时打量他们的座驾。的确，各路飞行员随处可见：有人俯身检修爱机，有人与同样翱翔天际的同侪低声交谈——这座荧光照耀的航空大教堂里，人声与金属的冷辉一同回响。
The enormous hangar is filled with a myriad of eye-catching craft lounging on great plains of polished flooring stretching further than the eye can see. The lighting is intense, and officials in solar orange march between the vessels, taking careful note of each pilot’s credentials while looking over their ship. Indeed pilots of all kinds can be seen tending to their craft or conversing with their aerial peers in this fluorescent cathedral of aviation.

披着斗篷的身影满是紧张的细碎小动作。他始终垂着目光，但一听见谁的笑声或欢呼，靛蓝色的眼睛便倏地一闪抬起。弯刀挂在他身侧，斗篷下摆处露出那道弧形刃光。胸前斜挎着一只皮袋——像是装药品或草药的挎包。他在不安的脚步间微微挪动，袋中瓶子随之叮当作响。

~ 由 Braydon Goodwin Played

The cloaked figure is a mess of nervous fidgets. He keeps his gaze cast down, but his indigo eyes flash up at the sound of someone’s laughter or cheer. A scimitar hangs at his side, its curved edge visible under the hem of his cloak. Slung across his front is a leather bag—a satchel that could be for medicine or herbs. Bottles clink from within the bag as he shifts in place on restless feet.

~ Played by Braydon Goodwin

Failure To Avoid Capture.name:
避免被捕的失败
Failure To Avoid Capture

Text.text:
当那陌生人以不可阻挡的决心朝你走来时，你的肌肉本能绷紧，仿佛他脑中唯一的念头就是让你毙命。他越来越近……越来越近。你掐准时机翻身闪避，猛地扑向一侧。太迟了！他快得不可思议，猛然前扑——竟抢先预判了你的动作——将斧头顶端的金属项圈扣在你颈间，随即收紧。把你狠狠逼到墙上后，他那不移的红眼灼灼钉进你的瞳孔，接着按下武器握柄上的按钮，斧刃轰然前撞，深深嵌入砖墙。无处可逃……

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Your muscles tense in anticipation as the stranger walks toward you with inexorable determination, as if his only thought is your demise. He gets closer… and closer. Timing your dodge, you throw yourself to the side. Too late! With incredible swiftness he lunges—anticipating your move—and clamps the metallic collar at the head of his axe around your neck, tightening it. After driving you back against the wall, his unwavering red eyes burning into your own, he presses a button on the weapon's haft and the blades slam forward, embedding themselves deeply into the brick. There is no escape…

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Daybreak After Rainfall.name:
雨后破晓
Daybreak After Rainfall

Text.text:
旭日刺破灰暗浑浊的地平线阴霾。光线掠过树梢，鸟儿便开始啼唱；水洼映出明亮的橙色光辉。空气仍带着薄雾——弥漫着昨夜阵雨残留的芬芳。太阳升得更高时，一道彩虹在你头顶划出弧线，仿佛预示前路将有好运相随。

~ 构想：Paul Schrickel

The rising sun breaks through the gloom of the gray and muddled horizon. Birds begin to sing as light hits their trees and puddles reflect a bright, orange glow. The air is still misty—aromatic with the remnants of last night’s shower. As the sun rises higher, a rainbow arcs above you, perhaps a sign of good fortune for the road ahead.

~ Envisioned by Paul Schrickel

这座城市被独眼巨人般的巨岩城墙环抱，自海边以石砌堤岸铺就的码头一路攀升，沿着峡湾的斜坡层层而上。下城区由醒目的半木结构建筑组成：以硕大岩石为基座，覆以石板屋顶，部分还立着如巨石柱般的尖塔，围绕着鹅卵石街巷铺展开来。这些宅邸与商铺再向上，便让位于雕琢大理石的列柱建筑与灿然的纯白水晶楼宇。更高处，城市的脊线上矗立着注入宝石纹脉的泰坦方尖碑，通体光滑浑成，显然由魔法塑成。相似却更小的立柱遍布城中，人们在其间奔忙行事。在一些闪耀的柱顶，大小不一的巨龙或休息、或守望、或与市民低声交谈。

~ 由 323starlight 构想

The city, walled in by cyclopean boulders, climbs from stone-lined seaside quays up the slopes of a fjord. Striking half-timbered buildings with foundations of massive rocks and slate roofs, some with menhir spires, make up the lower reaches, built around cobbled streets. These residences and shops give way to columned buildings of carved marble and radiant white crystal. Higher still on the city’s rise stand titanic obelisks infused with veins of gems, smooth and unified, formed no doubt from magic. Similar but smaller columns rise throughout the city, where folks go about their business. Atop some of these sparkling pillars, dragons of various sizes rest, keep watch, or converse with the people.

~ Envisioned by 323starlight

一只顽邪的恐怖之物乘着火焰织就的双翼滑翔而来，每一次振翅，都将灼人的热浪狠狠压进脚下的大地。它的皮肤如被烧灼过的橙色皮革，紧绷地覆在骨架般的躯体上。蜷曲的双腿是反关节般的突起，在多处关节处陡然折转；而它的双臂末端则伸出覆黑的利爪，仿佛在空中抓挠撕裂。它用豆粒般的眼睛盯住你——其中燃着暴怒的恶意——并以并非凡俗之口该吐出的语言龇牙咆哮，吐出一声挑衅。
An impish horror glides toward you on wings made of fire, each flap driving blistering heat into the ground below. Its skin is scorched orange leather stretched over a skeletal frame. Its coiled legs are digitigrade protrusions that bend sharply at multiple joints, while its arms end in black-clawed fingers that rake the air. It regards you with beady eyes—alight with furious malice—snarling some challenge in a language not meant for mortal mouths.

Wererat In Fine Armor.name:
精致护甲的鼠狼人
Wererat In Fine Armor

Text.text:
这是一幕令人心惊的并置：一张丑陋狰狞、龇牙咆哮的脸，从一套光辉灿然的护甲里探出。那身锃亮无瑕的银色板甲上点缀着精致的纹饰，仿佛从未踏入过战场——或者被魔法伪装得始终如新。鼠一般的面孔躲在一面巨大的木制塔盾后方，只用一只手稳稳撑住，裂开的尖嘴里吐着恶毒的咒骂，参差不齐的尖牙森然外露。另一只手里它握着一柄细长的刺剑，却笨拙得像攥着一根短棍，而非一段优雅的钢之长锋。
It is a shocking juxtaposition: a hideous, snarling face poking out from a suit of resplendent armor. The embellishments decorating the gleaming, spotless silver plate suggest the armor has never before seen combat—or is magicked to seem so. The ratlike face peeks from behind a massive, wooden, tower shield that it holds steady with one arm, spitting hatefully through its maw of sharp, uneven teeth. The creature holds a thin rapier in its other hand, though does so in a ham-fisted manner, as if it holds a bludgeon instead of a graceful length of steel.

Merciless Yakuza Wakagashira.name:
冷酷无情的极道若头
Merciless Yakuza Wakagashira

Text.text:
这名女子身着剪裁利落的深海军蓝套装，站在随从队伍旁显得格外娇小——身高不过五英尺。漆黑的头发修成整齐的波波头，贴着一张无瑕的脸庞垂落。她身边簇拥着一群魁梧的日本义体人，刀鞘里插着武士刀，身上还配着小型枪械。一名保镖深深躬身，压到极低，凑近她耳边低语，她却连头都不偏分毫。她的每个动作都精确而从容，像一条流畅的权力宣言。樱红的唇上掠过一抹扭曲的幽灵（特征）般微笑。
Clad in a sharp navy suit, this woman seems tiny next to her retinue—no taller than five feet. Deep-black hair falls in a neat bob around a flawless face. She’s surrounded by a swarm of bulky Japanese cyborgs, replete with katanas and small firearms. One bodyguard bows deep and low to speak into her ear, and she does not move her head an inch. Her movements are deliberate, a fluid expression of power. The twisted ghost of a smile plays on cherry-red lips.

你从袋子里捻出一撮细沙，含笑抬手，在空气中画出催眠般的轨迹。你低声呢喃安抚的慰词，用柔和的音节哄诱般地施压，以意志驱使你的同伴沉入睡眠。空气里弥漫着平静。你的惑术如薄雾般将眼前的人包裹，把他们带往沉眠的国度。
You pull out a pinch of sand from a pouch and smile, beginning to make hypnotic motions in the air. You whisper soothing words of comfort, cooing syllables of calming coercion as you will your allies to sleep. The air fills with calm. Your enchantment enfolds those before you, bringing them to the realms of slumber.

Loot From A Pseudodragon Lair.name:
伪龙巢穴中的战利品
Loot From A Pseudodragon Lair

Text.text:
这棵树的树洞已失去它那微型的主人，如今可以放心翻找。起初看起来不过是一堆柔软的碎屑，像是某个巢穴的雏形。但幸运的是，就连这最微小的巨龙也未能摆脱囤藏的欲望。你在一堆刺鼻的苔藓与碎裂的细枝下，找到了一小堆卵石大小的宝石，以及成叠的金银钱币。
The hollow of the tree, bereft of its miniature master, is safe to rifle through. At first it seems little more than a collection of soft detritus, perhaps the beginnings of a nest. But, to your luck, it seems the desire to hoard did not escape even this most diminutive of dragons. Under an acrid mound of moss and splintered twigs you find a pile of pebble-sized gems, as well as stacks of gold and silver coins.

Warning From Paladin Detecting Evil.name:
来自圣武士“侦测邪恶”的警告
Warning From Paladin Detecting Evil

Text.text:
“你感觉到了吗？空气里透着一丝寒意。小心前行。若以为我们的旅程无人察觉，那可就太愚蠢了。”
“Do you feel that? A slight chill in the air. Proceed carefully. It would be foolish to think our journey has gone unnoticed.”

Mastiff With Mount.name:
带坐骑的獒犬
Mastiff With Mount

Text.text:
这头犬科生物的身躯几乎呈长方形，给人一种经久不散的强悍印象：肌肉厚实，力量沉稳——体重或许不亚于一名成年人的分量。它背上配着一副精心设计、尺寸恰到好处的鞍具。对于地精或半身人这类体型较小的人形生物而言，这样的坐骑极其抢手：既是代步工具，也是警戒哨兵，更是忠诚的伙伴。它那张覆着黑色“面罩”的脸，对怀着善意靠近的人并不显得不友好——这正是严谨训练的证明——但当你再走近些，它额头的褶皱便微微收紧，带着一丝谨慎。
The canine’s frame is almost rectangular in shape, providing a lasting impression of power and thick muscle—possibly weighing as much as a fully-grown human. This one has been fitted with a carefully designed and appropriately sized saddle. For smaller humanoids, like goblins or halflings, such a mount is highly desirable, being a method of conveyance, a sentinel, and a devoted companion. Its black-masked face is not unfriendly to those who approach with easy intent—a testament to its careful training—but as you draw closer, the wrinkles on its forehead furrow slightly in caution.

Taunt From A Defeated Vampire.name:
败北吸血鬼的嘲讽
Taunt From A Defeated Vampire

Text.text:
“总有一天，你的躯体会枯萎。你的皮肤会在阳光下像鞣制皮革般干裂，你的脏器在腹中缓慢化作浆液，而你身体里的秽物与腐烂终将压过它苟活的意志。那一天到来时，你会乞求我的一吻。”
“One day, your body will wither. Your skin will dry in the sun like tanned leather, with your organs slowly liquifying in your gut and the waste and rot of your body finally overcoming its will to stay alive. When that day comes, you will beg for my kiss.”

Sea Elf Community.name:
海精灵聚居地
Sea Elf Community

Text.text:
海精灵族人在他们那座隐于浪涛之下的殖民地里处理日常事务时，几乎像在起舞；在这里，拥有财富者与一无所有者之间几乎看不出差别。聚落边缘，巍峨的珊瑚礁充当城墙——用以抵御更巨大的掠食者——再往外便是海带农场与海藻林，潮起潮落间都让社区得以饱腹。即便是寻常往来，也能感到这一族群的满足：他们以自给自足为傲，与所选家园的生灵与地形和谐共居。
The sea elf people practically dance while they go about everyday business in their colony, hidden beneath the waves, with little display of disparity between those who possess wealth and those who do not. On the outskirts of the settlement, great coral reefs serve as city walls—against larger predators—and just beyond lie kelp farms and seaweed forests, which keep the community fed tide in and tide out. Even in everyday dealings one can sense the satisfaction of a people who take pride in their self-sufficient nature, dwelling harmoniously with the creatures and terrain of their chosen home.

Military Cruiser: Officer’s Club.name:
军用巡洋舰：军官俱乐部
Military Cruiser: Officer’s Club

Text.text:
舒适的休息室里，柔和的音乐从隐蔽的扬声器中飘荡而出；外墙的全景舷窗外，壮丽的宇宙景致铺满视野。军官们一边用餐一边谈笑——制服略显凌乱——坐在高背椅里。舱室后侧横贯着一条吧台，陈列齐全，最上等的烈酒装在锃亮的酒瓶中，整齐闪烁。
Soft music drifts through hidden speakers in the comfortable lounge, and a stunning view of the cosmos fills the panoramic windows of the exterior wall. Officers chat and laugh—their uniforms slightly disheveled—as they dine in high-backed chairs. A bar stretches across the aft side of the cabin, fully stocked with gleaming bottles of the highest quality liquor.

Battle Between Devils And Demons.name:
恶魔与魔鬼之战
Battle Between Devils And Demons

Text.text:
你强忍着酸涩的双眼，望见高空之上群魔盘旋：每个恶魔都将烈焰抛掷而下，直砸向沿着灼热气流翻涌而上、迎面冲来的丑恶邪魔浪潮。地面上，利爪刮擦鳞片的刺耳铿锵与诅咒般的惨嚎交织回荡——一排排如铁般僵硬的恶魔列阵死守，将成群结队的地狱邪魔硬生生挡在外头。炎魔将军们猛然突进，燃烧的长鞭抽掠而过，却只在深狱魔未被灼伤的皮肉上徒然弹开。
Your straining eyes witness devils high above, each flinging flames down toward the waves of hideous demons rushing up the hot currents to meet them. On the ground, the painful clanging of claws on scales and accursed cries of anguish are heard as ranks of rigid devils hold hordes of diabolical demons at bay. The balor generals rush forward, their flaming whips glancing off the unburnt flesh of pit fiends.

I Sneak Attack.name:
我发动偷袭攻击
I Sneak Attack

Text.text:
瞅准对手主动防御间的一线破绽，我沉着瞄准他们护甲上那处脆弱的缝隙。随即我以精准与速度出手。当我的攻击命中并穿透那个弱点时，它造成的伤害，比起不够精确的打击要更为可观。
Spotting an opening in my adversary's active defenses, I take careful aim for a vulnerable gap in their armor. Then I strike with exactness and speed. When my attack hits and penetrates that weak spot, it deals more damage than it might have with less precision.

长着山羊般弯角的提夫林婴孩顶着脑袋冲上前，摇摇晃晃的细腿踉跄迈步。下一刻便摔了个四仰八叉，疼得一阵抽噎，擦破的掌心迸出一丝几不可见的地狱火星。
The infant tiefling, with goatlike horns cresting their head, charges forward on shaky legs. They topple, and in a fit of pain, loose the faintest spark of hellfire from their scraped palms.

Osfer Accidentally Kills His Grandfather.name:
奥斯费尔失手杀死了自己的祖父
Osfer Accidentally Kills His Grandfather

Text.text:
奥斯费尔的祖父一把攥住他的手腕，开始拖着他离开。男孩试图反抗。他脚跟死死钉住地面，身体向后仰，咬紧牙关、双眼紧闭，拼命挣扎。无济于事，他尖叫道：“放开我！” 老人像被重击般倒抽一口气，停下脚步，脸色瞬间惨白。抓住奥斯费尔的那只手先是龟裂、崩碎，继而化作细碎的苍白尘粉，簌簌散落。裂缝沿着手臂向上蔓延，爬进躯干，吞噬那张受创的面孔。一切都褪成灰色。灰烬的气味随着扩散的粉尘飘荡开来。老人的身体在柔和的微风里溶解殆尽，奥斯费尔双膝一软，跪倒在地。他盯着地面，呜咽出声。“不！别又这样……”他抽泣着说，“求你！求你，别走。”

~ Ace Wheelie构想

Osfer’s grandfather takes him by the wrist and starts to haul him away. The boy tries to resist. He digs in his heels, leans back, and strains with bared teeth and closed eyes. Failing, he screams, “Let me go!” The older man gasps as if struck, paling as he stops. The hand holding Osfer cracks, crumbles, and disintegrates into fine, pale dust. Fissures spread up the arm, into the body and the stricken face. All goes gray. The odor of ash wafts with the spreading dust. As the old man’s body dissolves in the soft breeze, Osfer falls to his knees. Gazing at the ground, he whimpers. “No! Not again,” he sobs. “Please! Please, don't go.”

~ Envisioned by Ace Wheelie

Mavis The Monk.name:
玛维斯·武僧
Mavis The Monk

Text.text:
这身朴素的装束——宽松长裤与一件大地色斗篷，上面点缀着珠子与小饰物——也许会让人以为这名兔人是个农夫。手中的行杖与松弛的神态几乎不泄露什么，但线条分明的肌肉、触目可见的伤疤，以及一处怪异的纹身却在讲述另一个故事。粉色皮肤在他左侧眉骨与脸颊的灰色毛皮中勾出一道醒目的线，恰好绕开眼睛。类似的条纹与斑块也玷污了他胸口与腹部的浅色毛发。而黑色墨迹在他左前臂盘绕成抽象的卷须，余光掠过时仿佛还在蠕动。

~ Played by Terrancemp with

The plain outfit—loose pants and a cloak in earth tones, decorated with beads and trinkets—might mark this rabbitfolk as a peasant. His walking staff and relaxed manner give little away, but defined muscles, obvious scars, and a bizarre tattoo tell another story. Pink skin forms a prominent line in the gray fur of his left brow and cheek, skipping the eye. Similar stripes and patches mar the pale hair of his chest and belly. And black ink coils in abstract tendrils on his left forearm, squirming when seen in peripheral vision.

~ Played by Terrancemp with

它伴着过多半透明翅翼的嗡鸣逼近。无数翅片纠缠着连在它的胸节上——那是一团肿瘤般的肉块，覆着龟裂的几丁质。前端，一坨被硬生生挤压糅合的人形颅骨堆成了头颅：空洞的眼窝里塞满不规则的眼珠，黑如缟玛瑙的球体般转动。它的嘴大张，形状与牙齿都近乎人类；可这生物的六条腿却是昆虫般的肢节，末端锋利如刃。它的腹部同样是个鼓胀的凝结肉囊，遍布脓肿，内里流淌着发着幽黄光的液体。四条柔韧的尾鞭——每条末端都带倒刺毒针——在恶魔身后狂舞，甩出点点恶臭的脏液。

~ 设想 by Malakar

It comes on with the buzz of too many diaphanous wings. A mass of them connects to its thorax, a cluster of tumorous flesh covered in cracked chitin. To the fore, a lump of humanoid skulls mashed together—their sockets filled with irregular eyes like orbs of onyx—forms a head. The mouth gapes with humanlike shape and teeth, but the creature’s six legs are insectile, sharp at the ends. Its abdomen, too, is a bulb of clotted tissue run through with abscesses of glowing yellow fluid. Four flexible tails, each with a barbed stinger, whip around the demon’s rear, spraying drops of this putrid liquid.

~ Envisioned by Malakar

Grimacing Balor.name:
狞笑的巴洛炎魔
Grimacing Balor

Text.text: 令人窒息的酷热笼罩着它。两片厚重、破烂如蝠的翅膀拍击空气，将灼人的热浪一阵阵逼向你。它那猪一般的口鼻扭成狞笑，凶狠的黑色牛角在脸上投下诡异的阴影。你的目光无法停驻，在它一手握着、覆满跃动火焰的邪恶链鞭，与另一手持着、噼啪迸裂能量的残暴单手剑之间来回跳跃。唯有一个词，才勉强足以形容这头怪物：恶魔。 An oppressive heat surrounds it. Two thick, tattered bat-like wings beat the air, forcing the air toward you in blistering waves. Its pig like snout is pulled into a grimace, its fierce black bull horns casting eerie shadows across its face. Your gaze can’t settle, jumping between a wicked chain whip covered in dancing flames held in one hand and a brutal one-handed sword that crackles with energy in the other. Only one word could ever hope to describe this monstrosity: demon.

Apple Orchard In Springtime.name:
春日苹果园
Apple Orchard In Springtime

Text.text:
果园一路铺展到目之所及，枝头尽是细小的白花——在正午强光下灿然夺目。花香为山间清风染上一层甜意，像是对盛夏与秋季将结出的果实所作的温柔预兆。蜜蜂、蝴蝶与其他昆虫在叶间与草丛里轻快起落，忙得欢欣。远处，更高的山峰仍被冬日霜意轻轻吻着。

~ 由 Bangalulu 构想

The orchard extends as far as the eye can see, its trees awash in small white flowers—brilliant in the high-noon light. Fragrance from the flowers perfumes the mountain breeze, offering a sweet portent for the fruit that summer and autumn will bear. Bees, butterflies, and other insects bob happily within the leaves and grass. In the distance, you can see some higher peaks still kissed with the frost of winter.

~ Envisioned by Bangalulu

Sundries From A Remorhaz.name:
来自雷莫拉兹的杂物
Sundries From A Remorhaz

Text.text:
沿着它修长身躯蜿蜒的发光血管猛然爆裂，灼热的橙色液体顺着甲壳滴落，化作滚烫厚重、蒸汽腾腾的团块砸在地上，所过之处雪地被融出一片片焦黑湿痕。从几丁质鳞片到燃烧的血肉，谨慎的冒险者或许能从这只怪物身上收获一些耐人寻味的制作材料。
The glowing veins trailing down its long body burst open and a searing orange fluid drips down its carapace, melting the snow on the ground as it falls in thick, steaming globs. From the chitinous scales to the burning gore, a careful adventurer might reap some intriguing crafting materials from this monster.

Dessamar Theurgist.name:
德萨玛秘法祭司
Dessamar Theurgist

Text.text:
一条身披实验室白大褂的巨大紫色毛毛虫正吃力地摆弄着一本袖珍笔记本，短粗的瘤状突起将它撑起，勉强站成双足姿态。腰侧伸出的手臂抱满各式科研器具：高科技数据表、医疗读数，以及精密的先进工具。它周身萦绕着浓烈的心灵能量，却又以漫不经心的从容一抬手，轻巧地推了推护目镜。
A large purple caterpillar in a lab coat struggles with a pocket notebook, nub-like nodules propping them up into bipedal form. Arms at their waist clutch all manner of scientific paraphernalia: high-tech data sheets, medical readouts, and advanced tools. An air of intense psychic energy surrounds them as they adjust their goggles with a gesture of easy nonchalance.

一截活生生的根茎缓缓踱步向前。粗厚纠结的植物质构成一具瘦削的人形，倦怠地倚着长矛。它头顶一朵宽檐的绿蘑菇作冠，若非那缓慢慵懒的低语声与一抹灿然明亮的雪白笑容，几乎难以从拥挤的灌木丛中将它辨认出来。
A living root ambles forward. Thick, knotted plant matter forms a skinny humanoid shape leaning lethargically on its spear. Crowned at the head with a wide-brimmed green mushroom, it would be hard to pick out from a crowded thicket were it not for the slow, languid murmuring and the beaming, bright white smile.

遵循木精灵的根源，基娅拉偏爱长弓。她依照军旅生涯中养成的日常规程行事：将一头金色长发向后紧束成严整的发髻，检查装备，将长剑入鞘，置于伸手可及之处，以备近身缠斗。她将深绿色斗篷的扣带扣在恰到好处的角度。她如其效率一般诚实，如其致命一般忠诚——她已就绪。
In the tradition of the Wood Elves, Kiala favors the longbow. She follows the daily routine learned during her military service: pulling long blonde hair back into a severe bun, checking equipment, sheathing swords within easy reach for close quarters work. She clasps her dark green cloak at its proper angle. She is as honest as she is efficient, as loyal as she is lethal, and she is ready.

Master's Kind Advice About Learning.name:
关于学习的师长箴言
Master's Kind Advice About Learning

Text.text:
“你不管大事小事，做每一件事都咬紧牙关、攥紧拳头！只要你觉得有必要，你甚至会把一座山都嚼穿；可我向你保证，成功与精进只会在从容里找到。日复一日地凿着一面墙也许乏味，但绝对比一头撞上去要有效得多。”
“You grind your teeth and ball your fist for every task, no matter how small! You would chew your way through a mountain if you thought it necessary, but I assure you, success and improvement are only found in grace. Chiseling away at a wall day by day may be boring, but it is far more effective than ramming your head into it.”

Gnomish Innkeeper.name:
侏儒旅店老板
Gnomish Innkeeper

Text.text:
小小的身影背对着你，哼着一支陌生的曲调。她随着自己的节拍扭动腰肢，每一下轻颤都让腰带上那一大串钥匙叮当作响。侏儒转过身来，带着惊讶的笑容望向你。她从手里端着的杯子里掏出一只刺猬，把这小家伙放到地上，轻轻拍了拍，送它一路小跑离开。
The little figure has her back turned, humming an unfamiliar tune. She shakes her hips to the beat of her music, each twitch jingling a large ring of keys on her belt. The gnome turns and gives you a surprised smile. She pulls a hedgehog out of the mug she’s holding and sets the critter down, sending it on its way with a little pat.

A March Of Silver.name:
白银的行军
A March Of Silver

Text.text:
银色的海洋一直铺展到遥远的地平线，闪烁如一整片巨大的锁子甲在大地上颤动，向城市压迫而来。空气里金属的气味浓得发沉，黏在舌面与喉咙深处；一群锃亮的构装体拥挤在高耸的城门前。锯刃高歌，武器开始啃噬那道上了横木的门——那横木早在很久以前就被钉上，只为把染病者困在里面。如今，他们——狼人——的嚎叫在城中处处回荡。暗色纠结的毛影在巷道里疾冲而下，利爪在石面上擦出急促的刮响，尾巴夹在腿间蜷起。他们的低吼与咆哮变得仓皇而尖细，转作一声声哀叫，只因那镀银的厄运正步步逼近。

~ Envisioned by ThatOneGuy

A sea of silver stretching to the far horizon glints like a gargantuan swathe of chainmail shuddering over the earth, pressing in upon the city. The scent of metal is heavy in the air, clinging to the tongue and the back of the throat as a horde of gleaming constructs crowds the high gates. Saw-blades sing as the weapons begin to eat away at the barred door—barred long ago in an effort to keep the afflicted within. Now they, the lycan, can be heard howling throughout the city. Blurs of dark, matted fur rush down alleys, claws skittering against stone and tails curled between their legs. Their growls and snarls become harried and high, turning into yelps, as silver-gilt doom approaches.

~ Envisioned by ThatOneGuy

“要是那些待在自家位面的神祇还不停拿这个位面当玩物，那这个位面的神祇为什么不也飞去别的位面搅他个天翻地覆？难道我们的神祇就胆小、乏味？我连把这话低声说出口都该犹豫吗？”
“If the gods in their own planes keep playing around with this one, then why don’t the gods of this plane go flitting around to muck up the others? Have we the timid, boring gods? Should I even whisper that?”

它带着令人胆寒的轻松，从墙体中漂浮而出；一团旋卷的黑色破布般的幽影自阴影里逼近，伸出幽冥般的手指朝你探来。破碎残片的簇团中浮现出一张脸，嘴部空洞大张，仿佛正无声尖叫。忽然，幽灵的口中倾泻出杂乱刺耳的呢喃——毫无意义的胡言乱语成股涌出，撕扯着你的心智。不可思议而古老复杂的幻象狂潮般冲入你的意识，拽动你对现实的理解。

~ 由 Andrew Sanguine 构想

Drifting out of the wall with terrifying ease, an apparition of swirling black rags looms from the shadows and reaches spectral fingers toward you. A face appears in the mass of sundered fragments, its maw hollow and agape as if screaming. Suddenly, words tumble from the specter's mouth in a discordant stream of incoherent babble that tears at your mind. Visions of impossible and ancient complexity rush through your consciousness, tugging at your comprehension of reality.

~ Envisioned by Andrew Sanguine

Sir Calogrenant At The Joust.name:
马上长枪赛上的卡洛格雷南爵士
Sir Calogrenant At The Joust

Text.text:
骑士策马踏入战场，阳光下，一条金色巨蛇闪烁寒光——那凶兽的纹章装点在他覆面头盔的盔顶。那生物又一次出现在他的盾上：猩红底色之上，巨蛇昂首盘踞，獠牙间死死咬着一名痛苦扭曲的受害者。骑士的装束上看不出任何信物或恩宠，仿佛正昭示着他那惹人分裂的本性。

~ 由 Vahlaron 构想

As the knight rides onto the field, a golden serpent glints in the sun, the beastly crest adorning his visored helm. The creature appears once more on his shield, emblazoned on a field of gules, an agonized victim clenched in its jaws. No favor is evident on the knight’s attire, perhaps denoting his divisive nature.

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

Tournament To Choose The King’s Champion.name:
遴选国王勇士的比武大会
Tournament To Choose The King’s Champion

Text.text:
号角齐鸣的凯歌在竞技场四周回荡。国王吃力地站起身，在王后扶持下，一瘸一拐地走到王家看台前方。两名魁梧的护卫分立两侧，托举着一本厚重如碑的大部头，国王从中宣读：“今日，王国与我都将迎来新的冠军。凭神祇的恩典与他们自身的技能，他们将被选出！”聚集的贵族们爆发出震耳欲聋的喝彩。
A fanfare of trumpets reverberates around the arena. The king stands laboriously, and, with help from his consort, limps to the front of the royal stand. Two burly bodyguards flank him, holding up a massive tome from which he reads: “Today, both the realm and I shall have a new champion. By the grace of the gods and their own skill will they be chosen!” The assembled nobles roar their approval.

Barghest: Facing The Beast.name:
巴盖斯特：直面凶兽
Barghest: Facing The Beast

Text.text:
那具狼形躯壳仿佛从你的噩梦里悄然潜行而出，可真正让你僵在原地的，是它投来的那一眼——仿佛你的心脏在那一瞬间忘了该如何跳动。獠牙森然的血口上方，两点细若针尖的纯粹恶意猛然刺出，直钻你的灵魂。那里面翻涌着暴怒，你像挨了一记耳光般清晰地感到它。但你也在这一刻明白：驱动这份怒火的，是残酷的智慧——而这才最令你胆寒。
The lupine body seems to have stalked out of your nightmares, but a glance from its eyes is what stops you in your tracks and makes it feel like your heart has forgotten how to beat. Twin pinpricks of pure malevolence stab outward from above a fanged maw, drilling into your soul. Rage comes from them. You feel it like a slap. But you know in that moment that a cruel intelligence fuels it—and that scares you the most.

这根巨大的棍棒由一整段抛光木枝制成，侧面雕刻着雄壮战士的浮雕，令人叹为观止。下半握柄缠着绿色皮革，武器顶端则以镶钉的亮钢箍环绕加固，寒光熠熠。
This huge club is a solid branch of polished wood, with stunning carvings of mighty warriors in its side. Green leather wraps the lower haft, and bands of gleaming steel inlaid with studs encircle the top of the weapon.

Shadowy Space Cantina.name:
幽影空间酒馆
Shadowy Space Cantina

Text.text:
兜帽人影潜伏在昏暗壁龛的阴影里，见不得光的交易与残酷的斗殴在这家酒馆里司空见惯。这里收容不愿被找到的人、寻衅斗狠的人，以及无处可去的疲惫灵魂。酒保是个满身疤痕的外星恶棍，往往只需一道冷硬如铁的目光就能平息大多数争端——而当这招不灵时，吧台下那把霰弹枪也足够“有说服力”。
Hooded figures lurking in shadowy alcoves, illicit deals, and brutal fights are regular occurrences in this cantina. It is a place for those who do not wish to be found, those looking for a fight, and the weary souls with nowhere left to go. The barkeep is a scarred alien ruffian who can end most disagreements with a steely glare—and when that fails, the shotgun under the bar proves to be very persuasive.

City Fire Brigade.name:
城市消防队
City Fire Brigade

Text.text:
一阵呼喊与叮当作响的钟声攫住了你的注意力。喧闹中一时看不清究竟发生了什么，直到人群猛然分开，让一辆马拉的货车狂冲而过。车轮隆隆碾过，你身旁掠过去时，车夫一手死死攥着缰绳，另一手不停摇响铃铛。车上载着一只巨大的大桶，沿途滴滴答答把水洒在路面上，几名年轻男女吊挂在车厢两侧。所有人都在尖声大喊“着火啦！”并夹杂着各种催促，喝令人群让开一条通道。
Shouting and a clanging bell catch your attention. It is unclear from the commotion what’s happening, but then people part to allow a horse-drawn wagon to charge through. It rumbles past you, the driver gripping the reins in one hand and ringing a bell with the other. The wagon holds a huge tun, which drips water onto the road, and several young men and women hang from its sides. All are yelling “Fire!” and various exhortations to get people to clear a path.

Vampire's Manor: Master Suite.name:
吸血鬼（特征）的庄园：主卧套房
Vampire's Manor: Master Suite

Text.text:
沉重的橡木门在断裂的铰链上向内摇开，露出昏暗斑驳的光线从蛀得千疮百孔的帷幔间渗入，在一片狼藉的房间里投下诡异而阴森的阴影。一张巨大的四柱床占据了室内大半空间，床帘破碎成缕，凄凄垂落。靠墙的一张书桌上散落着成堆发霉的羊皮纸，因受潮泡烂，其上字迹已难以辨认。侧桌上摆着几件古怪的小饰物，其中竟有一朵鲜艳得不可思议的玫瑰，插在水晶花瓶中。
The heavy, oaken door swings inward on broken hinges to reveal dim, dappled light seeping through moth-eaten drapes, and casting strange and sinister shadows across a room in disarray. A massive, four-poster bed dominates the room, its curtains hanging in tatters. A desk along one wall lies strewn with piles of moldy parchment, the writing upon them indiscernible from water damage. Several strange trinkets sit upon a side table, including an inexplicably vibrant rose in a crystal vase.

面对提问，那人轻轻摇头，神色凝重而忧惧。目光落向地面，低低哼吟着沉思。那张脸上明明白白写着——他们有话想说，可不知为何，话语就是没能从唇边逸出。他们对此似乎也并不怎么介怀。
In response to a question, the person shakes their head lightly, face set in deep consternation. They look to the ground and hum in thought. It's plainly writ on their countenance that they have something to say but, for whatever reason, the words fail to leave their lips. They don't seem particularly perturbed by it.

Glimpse Of Spelljammer With Giff Command.name:
与吉夫指挥官一同窥见拼法船的掠影
Glimpse Of Spelljammer With Giff Commander

Text.text:
你感到一股能量洪流直贯骨髓，震得你浑身发麻——一艘穿梭星海的飞船猛地掠近，近得你甚至能看清船体上木纹般的纹理。飞船悬停片刻，内部的奥术机械嗡鸣作响。敞开的甲板上传来一阵粗野大笑，满溢的狂喜像碎石般哗啦啦砸上来。“点火魔导加速器，你们这群蛞蝓！怎么我眼里全是绿脸黄肚皮？一记发夹弯就把你们吓得连蛆都不如？”你看见那张吆喝不停的喇叭嗓，就在飞船的奥术储备被点燃、迸出电蓝光芒的瞬间：一个壮实的河马人，披着黑色船长大衣，翻领上勋章一层叠一层，几乎要把胸口压垮。他那双粗壮的手里端着一把喇叭口般的火铳，枪口大张，像他那张放声大笑的嘴。他的獠牙镶着银与金的护套。“够了，蠢货和懒鬼！冲起来——驶入群星之海！”

~ Envisioned by Emily M.

You feel a rush of energy shake you to your core as a spacefaring vessel careens close, so near you can see the woodgrain patterns on the hull. The ship holds for a moment, the arcane machinery within humming. A raucous laugh, wild with mirth, clatters up from the open deck. “Fire the mago-accelerators, you slugs. Why do my eyes only see green faces and yellow bellies? Grubs can’t handle a hairpin turn?” You see the loudmouthed barker just as the ship’s arcane reserves fire up, electric blue: a thickset hippofolk, garbed in a black captain’s coat, with medals upon medals festooning his lapels. He holds a blunderbuss in his beefy hands, the gun’s trumpetlike muzzle agape as his laughing mouth. His tusks are capped with silver and gold. “Enough, lunkheads and layabouts! Surge on, into the stellar sea!”

~ Envisioned by Emily M.

Expanse Of Gothic Ballroom.name:
哥特式舞厅的辽阔空间
Expanse Of Gothic Ballroom

Text.text:
舞厅宽阔得足以容纳数百名宾客。西墙与东墙上一排排壁龛内，摆着盛满新鲜黄花的花瓶。头顶悬着一盏巨大的水晶吊灯，在烛火未燃之时，那份华美也被压低了几分。
The ballroom is wide enough to hold hundreds of guests. Vases of fresh, yellow flowers nestle in recesses lining the western and eastern walls. Above, an enormous crystal chandelier looms, its grandeur muted without the candles lit.

城里的空间寸土寸金，几乎没有地方能空太久——不是拆迁队立刻进场，就是被占屋者先一步搬进去。唯独这栋房子例外。它蜷伏在摩天大楼之间，泛白的旧木板在霓虹勾勒的天际线里显得格格不入——像是来自另一个时代的遗物。破铰链上无力垂挂的百叶窗在微风里轻轻吱呀作响，仿佛在招呼路人走进来。
Space is at a premium in the city, and nowhere is empty for long before either a demolition crew or squatters move in. Except this house. Crouching amid the skyscrapers, the old whitewashed panels look oddly out of place in the neon cityscape—a relic from a different time. Shutters hanging limply from broken hinges creak softly in the breeze as if beckoning passers-by inside.

这根铜杖比预想的更沉，因为两端各嵌着一颗小小的铅球。魔法武器的杖身中段缠绕着一圈圈符文，那些符号的含义如同：吞噬、保存、封存。每当它靠近任何形式的魔法能量时，符文便会迸出灼热的橙色光芒。
The copper staff is heavier than expected, as each end is fitted with a small orb of lead. Runes wrap around the midpoint of the magical weapon, symbols with meanings like: consume, preserve, and silo. Whenever it is near magical energy—of any kind—the runes emit a burning orange glow.

Royal Coronation.name:
皇家加冕仪式
Royal Coronation

Text.text:
从双扇大门上方的高廊俯瞰，这支行列像一条昂贵的手链，镶嵌着成千上万颗闪耀的宝石，休息在一只铺着紫色天鹅绒与貂皮的盒中。手链的各个碎片在移动、在歌唱，鼓掌、抛洒彩纸。沿着中央过道，最璀璨的那颗宝石缓步而来，披着拖着长长后摆的袍服。贵宾们静候其侧，王室大殿的华丽木作与石砌在他们周围森然矗立。

~ 一位英雄构想

From the high gallery above the double doors, the processional looks like an expensive bracelet, encrusted with thousands of glittering gems, resting in a box of purple velvet and ermine. The pieces of the bracelet move and sing, applaud and throw confetti. Down the center aisle, walks the greatest of the gems wearing a robe with a long train. Dignitaries wait, surrounded by the rich woodwork and masonry of the royal hall.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

巍峨的黑石巨构仿佛直接从山体中凿刻而出。你抬手遮住被寒风卷雪刺得生疼的双眼，仰起脖颈——竭力将这座阴森巨物的骇人尺度纳入视野。即便暴风雪咆哮震耳，你仍能听见一整支铁匠军团挥锤作业的金属铿锵，而你的目光也捕捉到那生产狂炉般的熔火深处透出的点点炽橙光芒。

~ 构想者：Pepijn（Discord）

The towering edifice of black stone seems to be carved out of the mountain itself. Shielding your eyes from the snow whipping through the frigid air, you crane your neck—attempting to take in the titanic scale of the foreboding structure. Even over the roar of the blizzard you can hear the metallic clanging of a legion of smiths hard at work, and your eyes pick out the pin-pricks of fiery orange light emanating from the furious caldera of production within.

~ Envisioned by Pepijn on Discord

Feast Day Rained Out.name:
筵席日遭雨搅黄
Feast Day Rained Out

Text.text:
盘踞了一整个上午、威胁着宴会的乌云终于崩裂，骤然倾泻成一场暴雨。狂欢者四散奔逃寻找遮蔽，只留下宴席场地被踩踏得一片狼藉：泥水四溅，满地坑洼；仆役们手忙脚乱，抢救那些仍勉强还能入口的菜肴。低垂的篷布在积水与失望的重量下凹陷，篷下探出一张张面孔；握着麦酒大杯的宾客啜饮抱怨，哀叹这场宴日竟如此早早落幕。
The dark clouds that have menaced the feast all morning give way in a sudden torrent. Revelers flee for shelter, leaving the feasting grounds a trampled mess of muddy divots, while servingfolk scramble to salvage whatever dishes are still appetizing. Beneath awnings that sag with water and disappointment, faces peer out, and guests quaffing from tankards of ale lament an early end to feast day.

你哼起一段小曲，双手在空中舞动——像提线师操纵木偶般——随后指向几件物体。它们一个接一个伸展、扭曲，在魔法的扳折下发出刺耳的吱嘎与磨擦声，依你的命令行动。
You sing a little song and dance your hands in the air—like a puppeteer controlling a marionette—before pointing at several objects. One after another, they stretch and bend, substances squealing and grinding as they are bent by magic to move at your command.

Middle-class Home.name:
中产阶层的家
Middle-class Home

Text.text:
清凉的傍晚里，烟囱飘出的柴烟带着炖汤的香气。门外的门槛上躺着一匹小木马，夹在两扇镶着鲜艳彩绘百叶窗的窗户之间。前窗下，一小片香草园沉睡着；屋后更大的菜园里，红番茄与黄葫芦点点缀落。几只破损的马车轮靠在屋侧，斜挑的雨棚下歪斜成排，旁边的桌上还散放着几件工具。
In the cool evening, wood smoke from the chimney smells of stew. A small wooden horse lies on the threshold outside the door, between windows framed in brightly painted shutters. A small herb garden sleeps under the front windows, and a larger vegetable garden in the back is dotted with red tomato and yellow gourd. Several broken wagon wheels lean against the side of the house under a slanted awning, next to a few tools on a table.

纺车旁的女人微微扬起下巴，无声地向你致意。她的目光仍牢牢锁在指尖揉捏成形的陶泥上，双手稳若磐石，细细拣出新作的脊线与沟谷。尽管罩衣与额头上沾着干涸泥痕，她依旧坐得笔直端肃，仿佛君王俯视忠诚的臣民，对自己的技能笃定无疑。
The woman at the spinning wheel raises her chin in a silent greeting to you. Her eyes remain focused on the clay work shaped by her fingertips, her hands steady as rock as she picks out the ridges and valleys of her newest work. Despite the smudges of dried clay across her smock and forehead, she sits as straight and upright as a monarch looking over her loyal subjects, utterly confident in her skill.

Magic Jewelry Shop.name:
魔法珠宝店
Magic Jewelry Shop

Text.text:
店铺以一盏由水晶碎片拼成、熠熠生辉的华丽吊灯宣告其奢靡，将魔法般的光辉洒落在下方的货品上。玻璃柜中铺着丝绸软垫，陈列着戒指、手镯、项链与冠冕——皆以贵金属铸成，并镶嵌珍贵宝石。萦绕其上的细微附魔闪光更添风华。店铺中央的栖架上立着一只发条鹦鹉，羽毛鎏金，双眼是红宝石。
The shop declares its opulence with a glistening chandelier of crystal shards, shining its magical radiance on the wares below. Silk cushions in glass cases display rings, bracelets, necklaces, and tiaras, cast in precious metals and set with precious stones. The delicate glitter of enchantment intensifies their beauty. A clockwork parrot sits on a perch in the center of the shop, with gilded feathers and rubies for eyes.

那是一只鹿。但……它的肩胛处微微隆起，脖子长得过分。后腿更粗大，肌肉隆起得不合常理。四肢都多出一道关节，弯折的角度……不对劲。它的双眼靠得太近，向前凝视。它低沉地哼响，踉跄着用后腿直立起来，咧开嘴露出獠牙。那不是鹿。

~ 一位英雄 设想

It’s a deer. But… it has a slight hump at the shoulders, and its neck seems too long. Its rear legs are bigger, more muscular than expected. All its limbs have an extra joint, which bend… wrong. And its eyes are too close together, facing forward. It grunts as it lurches upright on its hind legs, revealing fangs in its mouth. That’s no deer.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Gangster’s Hideout In Spaceport Warehous.name:
太空港仓库里的黑帮藏身处
Gangster’s Hideout In Spaceport Warehouse

Text.text:
货场上立着一座用回收钢材搭起的棚式仓库。薄薄的墙体内侧排满合金货架，深得像半挂卡车的车厢，淌满了安全警示标语。货架上承载着数千吨的机器设备。空地里摆着一张桌子，上面放着好几台显示器，四周堆着用塑料膜缠紧的托盘。有人走到其中一组货架前，掏出手机，输入一串代码。一面外墙随之开启，表面纹理逼真得仿佛那些机器都是真的。它沿着无声的轨道向后滑开，露出一间奢华公寓。
On the cargo field stands a pole barn made of salvage steel. The thin walls are lined with alloy shelves, deep as tractor trailers and dripping with safety warnings. They carry thousands of tons of machinery. A desk holding several monitors sits in the open, surrounded by plastic-wrapped pallets. Someone walks to one of the shelf sets, pulls out a phone, and types in a code. A façade opens, textured as if the machinery were real. It slides back on silent tracks to reveal a luxurious apartment.

色泽深浅不一的上等丝绸，镶以银线滚边，垂覆在公爵夫人雕像般的身姿上。她那丰盈的秀发层层堆叠、以发簪固定，在头顶盘成一圈完美的螺旋，闪耀着夺目的金辉。纵然满身华贵，你仍能感到她体内散发出一股内在的力量——那是特权滋养出的笃定，没错，却也混杂着挣扎淬炼后的坚韧。
Fine silks of varying shades, trimmed with silver thread, drape the statuesque form of the duchess. Her voluminous hair, piled and pinned in a perfect spiral atop her head, shines a vibrant gold. Despite the finery, you sense an inner strength emanating from the woman—a confidence born of privilege, yes, but also struggle.

农夫倚着锄头，把宽檐帽往后一掀，抹去额头的汗水。成片的田亩向两侧铺展开去，翻耕的垄沟一直延伸到视线尽头。泥土肥沃松软，温暖的微风将湿润的土腥气送到你鼻尖。很快，嫩绿会破土而出，庄稼会抽长拔高，收获也终将到来——但此刻，只有劳作。
The farmer leans on a hoe and pitches a broad-brimmed hat back to mop the sweat from their brow. The acres sprawl in either direction, tilled fields as far as the eye can see. The soil is rich and loamy, and the earthy smell wafts to you on the warm breeze. Soon, green will sprout, crops will rise, and a harvest will be had—but now, only toil.

Hermetic Mage Summoning A Spirit.name:
赫密斯法师召唤灵体
Hermetic Mage Summoning A Spirit

Text.text:
蓝图铺陈开来，工具一一排布。完美对齐。法师力量的粼粼白光中，一场召唤正在进行。每一处表面都已灭菌。法师左手握着一枚球形数据板，右手轻轻打了个响指。工具漂浮在空中，温柔地与数据板对接。细碎的咔哒声渐渐让位于一道宽阔的紫罗兰光束：那是对赛博空间精心设计的一道裂缝。法师用一根机械手指在裂缝边缘拨弄，招引灵体穿越而来。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The blueprints are laid out, the tools all aligned. Perfectly aligned. In the shimmering white light of the mage’s power, a summoning is taking place. Each surface is sterilized. The mage grasps a spherical datapad in their left hand and clicks their right fingers. Tools float in the air, gently interfacing with the datapad. Soft clicks give way to a broad beam of violet light: an engineered crack in cyberspace. The mage plucks at the crack with a robotic finger, beckoning the spirit through.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Teaching Someone To Block With A Shield.name:
教人用盾格挡
Teaching Someone To Block With A Shield

Text.text:
“往前冲，你这蠢货，不然就崩了你！往前！让他们扑倒在地，把他们的劲儿榨出来，然后再推。别停！抬稳了，抬不稳你还不如从集市扛一袋子东西呢。”
“Forward, you lout, or you’ll be capped! Forward! Make ’em hit the flat and take their energy, then push. Keep it up! Keep it lifted or you may as well be carrying a sack from the market.”

Canoeing In A Mystical Jungle River.name:
在神秘丛林河流中划独木舟
Canoeing In A Mystical Jungle River

Text.text:
你沿着河道轻轻漂流，丛林在四周以隐秘的生命嗡鸣不止。下一次船桨没入水中时，一阵如心跳般的脉动沿着桨柄回震而上。仓惶的低语掠过耳畔，河岸的树木骤然苏醒——木纹上的每个结疤与卷曲都化作一张古老树灵的面孔。从它们的根系间，翡翠般的绿能注入河流，催促水势加快。激涌的流变猛然推着独木舟向前冲去，船身危险地摇晃，几乎就要侧翻。

~ Spac3cowboyy 构想

As you gently float along the river, the jungle hums with hidden life all around you. The next time your paddle dips into the water, a pulse like a heartbeat reverberates up the handle. A harried whisper flits past your ears and the trees along the riverbank take on a new life—each knot or curl in the wood becomes a feature of an ancient, arboreal face. From their roots, emerald-green energy flows into the river, quickening the current. The flux spurs your canoe forward with such force that the vessel rocks dangerously, nearly tipping over.

~ Envisioned by Spac3cowboyy

The Liquid Truth Bar.name:
液态真相酒吧
The Liquid Truth Bar

Text.text: 音乐嚣张地轰鸣着，从两座巨大的建筑里倾泻到街上，仿佛带着魔力的回响，穿透你的胸腔与脚底。可你又察觉这声浪里透着某种杂乱，像是许多不同的乐团同时在演奏。震天的鼓点、拨弦鲁特琴的铮响、铙钹与响板的清脆敲击，混着酒意正浓的狂欢者此起彼伏的叫嚷。一个男人醉醺醺地咯咯傻笑着，踉跄从通往主入口的台阶上滚下来；入口上方，The Liquid Truth 的名字被大胆地刷写在牌面上。屋内传来欢呼、笑声、倒吸气声——情绪的万象随着演出翻涌；你还听见金属酒杯相撞的铿锵，以及盘子重重落在桌面上的闷响。 Music thunders brazenly, spilling out from two large buildings into the street and sending what feels like magical reverberations through your chest and feet. Yet you detect a disparate quality to the sound, as if many different troupes are playing at once. Pounding drums, twanging lutes, cymbals and claves are accompanied by the exclamations of revelers deep in their cups. A man, giggling drunkenly, tumbles down the steps that lead to the main threshold, above which the name The Liquid Truth is painted boldly. From within you hear cheers, laughter, gasps—the whole gamut of emotion—reacting to the performances. You also hear the clang of metal tankards crashing against each other and the heavy plunk of plates hitting tables.

Tournament Child Squire.name:
比武大会的侍童
Tournament Child Squire

Text.text:
脚踝深陷在沙里，身上套着一身不合身的制服，那双睁得圆圆的孩子打着寒颤。TA站在一匹华丽的战马旁，战马庞大的负载般身躯将那握着缰绳的瘦小身影衬得更显渺小。骑士高踞马背，骄傲地俯视着侍从，脸上带着和煦的微笑。
Ankle deep in the sand and dressed in an ill-fitting uniform, the wide-eyed child shivers. They stand next to a magnificent charger, its vast bulk dwarfing the diminutive figure holding its reins. From atop the horse the knight looks down proudly at the squire, a kindly smile on their face.

Age-old Elvish Bigotry.name:
古老的精灵族偏见
Age-old Elvish Bigotry

Text.text:
三名年轻的精灵趾高气扬地并肩走着，身穿精致的罩袍，头戴高耸的羽饰头盔，从旅店门前擦身而过。一名灰发矮人正摆弄着他那条宽阔的腰带——一边松着扣，一边对着前方露出笑容。他们差点撞上他，走出几步后便发出轻蔑的笑声。矮人朝他们甩去一眼，那只眼跨过一道长长的伤疤——从发际下蜿蜒而下，直至他的八字胡。他摇了摇头。
Three young elves walk haughtily together, wearing their fine tabards and tall, plumed helmets, and pass a gray-haired dwarf fiddling with his broad belt—loosening it and smiling out in front of the inn. They nearly bump him, and then a few feet beyond him, they laugh derisively. The dwarf flashes a look at them, one eye bridging a long scar from under his hair down to his moustache. He shakes his head.

扫帚云竞技场凿开在塔楼附近一处山坡的裸露坡面上，塑成土垒般的马蹄形，开口处立着通往场内的宽阔入口门。此地常年阴云低垂，除非用改变天气的法术将云层驱散。看台上，嵌入山坡的每一根长椅立柱顶端都燃着火把。场地绿得斑驳稀疏，毫无美感可言，却在为每一场比赛而用以改造环境的魔法辉映下微微闪烁。
Broomcloud Field was carved out of the open face of a hill near the tower, shaped like an earthen horseshoe, with a broad entrance gate to the arena standing at the open end. The location is perpetually overcast unless weather alteration spells remove the clouds. In the stands, torches burn atop every bleacher post built into the hillside. The field is a patchy green, not pretty in any way, and shimmers with the magic used to transform the environment for each match played there.

Faerie Carnival Ticket Booth.name:
妖精嘉年华售票亭
Faerie Carnival Ticket Booth

Text.text:
摊位是一顶沉重的帐篷，披在细瘦的木架上；深蓝的布面绣满了陌生天空的星座。窗口的帘片掀开着，一名年迈的地精以令人不安的笑容迎接每一位来客。他绿色的下巴上几缕细白胡须在微风里轻颤。有人举起票券，地精点了点头。他挥手拍打着几只在摊位周围翩翩飞舞的蝴蝶。
The booth is a heavy tent thrown over a spindly wooden frame, deep blue and covered in the constellations of a strange sky. Its window flap is open, and an old goblin welcomes each visitor with a disconcerting smile. Little white hairs on his green chin dance in the breeze. One holds up a ticket, and the goblin gives a nod. He bats at some of the butterflies dancing around the booth.

Animated Lashunta Mind Mail Iii.name:
活化拉桑塔心灵鳞甲 III
Animated Lashunta Mind Mail Iii

Text.text:
这件护甲工艺的巅峰之作高大挺立，骄傲凛然。它由卡巴拉特心灵与科技卓越大学的技师精工打造——你在胸甲上瞥见了那枚徽标。一套坚实的青铜护甲，披风在精密分层的躯干后方扬起暗尘的红。两只前臂各固定着一圈圆环，然而本该是面孔之处却只剩阴沉的虚无。空气中回荡着一种古怪而歌唱般的共振，宛如修道院的乐声。
This pinnacle of armored achievement stands tall and proud. It has been finely crafted by the technicians at the Qabarat University of Psychic and Technological Excellence—you spot the logo on the breastplate. A firm suit of bronze armor, its cape flaps a dusty red behind a torso of sophisticated plating. Circular rings are attached to each forearm, but there is a glowering void where the face should be. A strange, singing resonance fills the air, like the music of a monastery.

Bustling Halfling Inn.name:
熙攘的半身人旅店
Bustling Halfling Inn

Text.text:
烤蔬菜的焦香、炖肉的浓郁、甜麦酒的醇甜与带着泥土气息的烟斗烟雾愉快地交织在一起，酿成一种令人微醺般的香气，沉甸甸地笼罩着这间温暖的店铺。对高个子来说，天花板也许低了些，但对占了客人和伙计大半的半身人而言，却恰到好处。公共厅尽头那座巨大的石砌壁炉里火焰噼啪作响，暖意舒展；厅内挤满了抛光的橡木桌与软得过分的座椅，许多客人随着麦酒与烟草渐渐上头，整个人越陷越深。角落里，一支临时拼凑的半身人乐队用长笛与提琴奏起小调，欢快的旋律浮上喧哗的人声之上，却从不喧宾夺主。一个面颊红润、肚腹宽厚的酒保在桌间忙得脚不沾地，托盘上堆着满满的酒杯、盛得冒尖的餐盘、一罐罐腌渍蔬菜，以及抹了黄油的酥点。

~ Requested by R4v3nous_DM

The smells of roasted vegetables, stewing meat, sweet ales, and loamy pipe smoke mingle pleasantly, creating an intoxicating aroma that hangs heavy over the cozy establishment. The ceilings might hang a bit low for tall folk, but for the halflings that make up the bulk of the inn’s clientele and workforce, they seem perfectly suited. A fire crackles pleasantly in the great stone hearth at the far end of the common room, packed with polished oaken tables and overstuffed furniture, into which many patrons find themselves sinking deeper and deeper as ale and pipeweed take hold. In one corner, an impromptu halfling band strikes up a tune with flutes and fiddles, the merry tune rising over the din of conversation, but never overtaking it. A rosy-cheeked barkeep with an ample belly bustles between the tables with trays laden with tankards, plates brimming with food, jars of pickled vegetables, and buttered pastries.

~ Requested by R4v3nous_DM

I Drink My Potion Of Frost Giant Strengt.name:
我喝下冰霜巨人之力药水
I Drink My Potion Of Frost Giant Strength

Text.text:
小瓶透出的寒意麻得我掌心发木，我便一口气将它灌下。冰冷的药液淌过牙齿时刺得发麻作痛，那一片指甲碎屑像冰屑般刮着我的喉咙一路下坠——可当我感到肌肉里猛然涌起的力量时，这点不适便都值了。我强壮得仿佛一斧就能把一株山松劈成两半。
The cold from the vial numbs my palm, so I drink it quickly. My teeth tingle painfully as the chilly potion washes over them, and the sliver of fingernail drags like a shard of ice down my throat—but the discomfort is well worth it once I feel my muscles surge with strength. I feel mighty enough to cleave a mountain pine in two with one swing of an axe.

一层厚实的翡翠绿苔毯紧紧攀附在巍峨的庭院高塔外壁上，仿佛永无止境地向着陡峭的塔身攀爬。塔檐之下嵌着一扇孤窗，俯瞰四野，展出一幅壮阔的远景。劲风呼啸，震得斜屋顶上几片瓦松脱坠落，砸在塔基旁轰然碎裂，迸成锋利的陶片。
A thick carpet of emerald-green moss clings to the outside of the imposing courtyard tower, forever scaling the sheer edifice. A single window—nestled beneath the tower's eaves—looks out across the surrounding lands, providing a majestic vista. A strong wind rattles some tiles free from the sloped roof, casting them to the ground at the tower's base to explode into ceramic shards.

Cybernetic Cranial Augmentation +3.name:
义体颅脑强化 +3
Cybernetic Cranial Augmentation +3

Text.text:
头颅的上半部已被彻底替换，如今是一颗光秃、抛光得发亮的青铜金属头骨。双眼泛着暗沉的乌黑幽光。自鼻梁向下仍是血肉之躯，呈现出一种阴森的错觉：仿佛机器人戴着一张人皮面具。颅骨周围缠绕着一圈厚重、嗡嗡作响的静电气场——那是强化神经认知的沸腾雷霆。这片被放大的颅顶力场在头侧迸溅出蓝色电火，偶尔又会爆出一抹橙光，像是有迷途的虫子被过剩的脑力当场灼杀。

~ 由一位英雄 设想

The top half of the head has been entirely replaced. It is now a bald, burnished bronze metal skull. Both eyes glow dull jet. From the bridge of the nose downward is still organic, giving the sinister impression of a robot wearing a flesh mask. There is a thick, fuzzing aura of static about the cranium: the seething lightning of augmented neurocognition. This amplified cranial field sparks blue around the head and, occasionally, there is a flare of orange as a wayward bug is fried by excess brainpower.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Witnessing The Effect Of Shrew-tongue.name:
目睹尖舌诅咒的效果
Witnessing The Effect Of Shrew-tongue

Text.text:
他们死死掐住喉咙，毒素一旦发作，瞳孔便骤然扩张，几乎漫到眼白边缘。嘴巴无力地张开，你看见他们的舌头竟缩成一缕细细的粉红触须，像虫子般在齿后扭动，仿佛正急着钻回泥土。喉间的声音断断续续地喷出，只剩无词的呻吟。

~ 出自惊艳的 TTRPG 增补 The Vineyard

They clutch at their throat as the poison takes hold, their pupils dilating to the edges of their eyes. Their mouth falls open and you see their tongue has shrunk to a thin, pink tendril. It wriggles behind their teeth like a worm trying to find its way to soil. Their voice sputters out of their throat in wordless groans.

~ Found in the amazing TTRPG supplement The Vineyard

这把巨剑庞大如斯，宛如一堵赤红金属之墙，剑柄末端嵌着繁复精致的黑色剑首。然而，剑握在你手中却轻若无物，挥使起来出奇地顺手。剑身金属薄如蝉翼，却磨砺得锋锐如剃刀，仿佛只需一记横斩，便能将最厚实的怪物皮肤也一并剖开。
The greatsword is massive, a wall of red metal with an intricate black pommel. Yet the blade is light in your hand and surprisingly easy to wield. The metal is thin, but sharpened to a razor's edge, and looks as if it could slice through even the thickest monster skin with a single swing.

I Activate My Cyber Spinal Cord.name:
我启动了赛博脊髓神经索
I Activate My Cyber Spinal Cord

Text.text:
我将注意力凝成火焰的意象，把意识引向颈后根部——金属与血肉交界的那一点。科技启动的刹那，一阵炽白如熔铁的剧痛自尾骨直窜上来，贯穿脊髓直抵脑干。衣料之下，一排整齐的白色光点依次亮起，隔着布面仍清晰可见。我感到强化脊柱里闪电般的战栗——一股赛博潜能的爆发。皮肤上爬满针扎般的麻刺感，短短一瞬间，浑身毛发尽数竖立。

~ 一位英雄的设想

Channeling my focus by picturing fire, I direct my attention to the base of my neck, the point where metal meets flesh. A white-hot pain flashes up from my tailbone to my brain stem as the tech activates. A line of neat white lights switches on, visible beneath the fabric of my clothes. I feel the lightning shiver of my augmented spine—a burst of cybernetic potential. My skin crawls with pins and needles, and all my hair stands on end for a brief moment.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

她瘦得近乎形销骨立，黯淡的翡翠色眼眸刻意避开你的注视。她牛乳般的肌肤白得异乎寻常，却仍能看出她费心用妆容为双颊添了些血色——只是那抹潮红从发际一路铺到下巴，显得格外不寻常。 这位半精灵穿着一套磨旧却实用的铆钉皮甲；然而她腰侧的挎包鼓胀，塞满了纤薄的典籍；深绿色的长发也被向后梳拢，利落得同样一丝不苟。显然，她更愿意把时间埋进研究卷册，而不是在酒馆里喝上一品脱——可她偏偏站在冒险者的旅途上，披着护甲，却不见任何显眼的武器。真是个耐人寻味的谜团。

~ Played by Gooby26

Slender to the point of emaciation, her muted emerald eyes avoid your gaze. Though her milk-white skin is uncommonly pale, some effort has been made with makeup to add some color to her cheeks, though the flush stretches from hairline to chin, somewhat unusually. The half-elf wears a worn and practical suit of studded leather, but a satchel bulges at her side with slender tomes, and her dark green hair has been combed back in an equally businesslike fashion. Clearly this is a woman who would rather spend time delving into a research volume than enjoying a pint at the tavern, and yet here she is on the adventuring trail, wearing armor but carrying no visible weapons. A curious conundrum.

~ Played by Gooby26

一层晶亮的薄冰覆在桥面上每一块看得见的鹅卵石上。换作别的天气，这座小小拱起的桥你大概不会多想就走过去；可今天，它成了险恶的考验。两侧积雪的边缘无疑是最安全的路——脚下多少能抓住些摩擦力——但桥的护沿只有脚踝那么高。
A sheen of clear ice covers every visible cobble of the bridge. You’d think nothing of walking over its small hump in any other weather, but today it presents a treacherous challenge. The snowy edges surely present the safest paths—where your feet would have some traction—but the sides of the bridge are only ankle high.

你体会到一种前所未有的轻盈，仿佛此刻正悬浮在地面之上。你行动起来，疾如风本身，敏捷如影，穿梭掠过重重障碍以触及你的目标——而你周遭的世界，仿佛凝固不动。
You experience such a feeling of lightness that it is as if you now hover above the ground. You move, as fleet as the wind itself, and as agile, weaving past obstacles to reach your target—while the world around you seems to remain still.

尽管身材敦实，这名半身人却比大多数同族高出整整一头，背脊挺直、站姿如枪，周身散发着触手可及的自信。淡蓝色皮护甲上钉满钢钉，紧贴着他结实的体格，保养得与他那身筋骨一样利落。头发乌黑，剪得极短，精心向后梳开，唯独一绺弹性的卷发调皮地垂落，在那双锐利的蓝眼前轻轻跳动。他宽阔的背上背着一面银蓝相间的鸢盾，盾面绘着一圈翠绿三叶草，中央是幸运女神的面容。腰间挂着一柄修长、杀气逼人的细剑，而他抬手便能轻松握上剑柄的从容，暗示着他时刻处于备战状态。

~ Played by Gunndykol with

Despite his stout stature, this halfling stands a head taller than most of his kin, straight-backed and rigid with a palpable confidence. Pale blue leather armor studded with steel hugs his athletic build closely, as well maintained as the halfling’s physique. His hair is dark and close-cropped, swept artfully away from his face save for a single springy coil of curl that bounces playfully over his piercing blue eyes. Upon his broad back rests a kite shield of silver and blue, emblazoned with a ring of green shamrocks and Lady Luck’s face in the center. He keeps a slender, deadly looking rapier on his belt, and the ease with which his hand finds its pommel hints at his constant readiness.

~ Played by Gunndykol with

Tasty Gyros And Fries Street Food Meal.name:
美味的希腊烤肉卷与薯条街头餐
Tasty Gyros And Fries Street Food Meal

Text.text:
鸡柳与新鲜沙拉从柔软洁白的墨西哥薄饼面饼中舒展铺开，宛如一场优雅的味觉之舞；每一种食材都被秘制酱汁轻轻裹亮，泛着诱人的光泽。旁边的薯条外脆金黄，撒上足量的传统调味料。这看起来美味极了。
Chicken strips and fresh salad fan out from the soft, white bread of the tortilla in a beautiful culinary dance, each ingredient glistening with secret sauce. The accompanying fries are crisp and golden, bearing a generous helping of traditional seasoning. This looks delicious.

月光从艉壁上两扇装饰华美的窗户倾泻而入，洒满这间奢阔的舱室。房间正中央端端放着一张厚重大书桌，桌面铺满海图、地图与领航工具；舒适的床却缩在角落里，仿佛只是随手添上的摆设。书桌旁立着一只古董地球仪，表面点缀着彩色图钉，被抛光的木质框架稳稳托住。
Moonlight pours into the opulent cabin from two beautifully appointed windows set in the aft wall. A large, solid desk covered in charts, maps and navigator’s tools sits squarely in the center of the room, while the comfortable bed rests in a corner—almost like an afterthought. An antique globe—dotted with colored pins—stands by the desk in a polished wooden frame.

弓手以娴熟的无声步伐自林间现身，衣着的低调自然色调使他与枝叶浑然一体，几乎难以分辨。他手中握着一张弧形的抛光木弓，朴素而优雅——落在对的人手里，便是致命之器。你能感觉到他并无敌意：若他真想伤你，你早已倒在地上了。
The archer emerges from the forest in practiced silence, the muted natural tones of his clothing allowing him to blend with the foliage perfectly. In his grasp rests a bow of curved, polished wood, elegant in its simplicity—deadly in the right hands. You get the sense he is not hostile: if he meant you harm, you would be dead already.

Cloaked Mind Flayer.name:
披风遮面的夺心魔
Cloaked Mind Flayer

Text.text:
笼罩在一袭流淌的黑暗斗篷之中，那身影移动时带着不祥的预兆。隐匿在遮蔽的布料之下，扭动的触须搏动着，品尝着空气；而这名阴森的陌生人周身散发出至高智慧的气息。
Shrouded within a flowing cloak of darkness, a figure moves with an air of ominous portent. Sheathed beneath the concealing fabric, writhing tentacles throb and taste the air, while an aura of supreme intellect radiates from this sinister stranger.

Whiplike Speed-wired Pistolero.name:
鞭影般的速度线枪手
Whiplike Speed-wired Pistolero

Text.text:
那男人牙关咬得咯咯作响，几乎从不停止；他也总在动个不停——多半是扳机手指的反射性抽搐。他那双小而幽暗的眼睛被妄念烧得发狂，视线像弹珠般乱窜，带着彻底的偏执扫视四周。他四肢异常修长纤细，但大半身形都被一件磨损沉重的斗篷式雨披遮住。
The man grinds his teeth constantly, and always seems to be moving in one way or another—usually a reflexive twitching of his trigger fingers. His small, dark eyes are wild with delusion, and they dart around like pinballs as he scans his surroundings with utter paranoia. His limbs are unnaturally long and slender, but much of his frame is hidden beneath a worn, heavy poncho.

你多半是先听见他、后看见他：要么因某个恶作剧而放声狂笑，要么从常人膝盖以下的某个角落传来呼唤。他的胡子与头发纠作一团，仿佛一整片蓬乱的云；当他戴上一顶帽子时，那种古怪的滑稽感便格外鲜明。他戴着护目镜：不是正罩在眼前，就是推上去搁在浓密的眉毛上休息。他的绗缝短外套是五彩斑斓的拼布，天鹅绒马裤塞进厚重、齿纹深深的大靴子里。他几乎总随身带着某个小型机械装置——永远差那么一点才算完工——而谈论它，正是他那不怎么隐秘的心愿。
He is likely heard before he is seen, laughing uproariously at a prank or calling from somewhere below the average person's knees. His beard and hair all cloud together as one, and when he wears one of his hats, the effect is of eccentric hilarity. He wears goggles: either over his eyes, or pushed up to rest on bushy eyebrows. His quilted jacket is a colorful patchwork, and he sports velvet breeches tucked into big, heavy-treaded boots. He almost always carries with him some small mechanical device—never quite finished—and to chat about it is his not-so-secret desire.

Cybernetic Leg Augmentation +2.name:
义体腿部强化 +2
Cybernetic Leg Augmentation +2

Text.text:
晚期基因疗法扭曲了这条腿的比例，如今它正因能量鼓荡而微微颤动。一条起伏的、由移植肌肉构成的双螺旋，从髋臼一路蜿蜒缠绕至脚踝。生长激素将小腿肚、腘绳肌与股四头肌吹胀到荒谬的巨硕。皮肤斑驳不均，脚掌多长出一根脚趾，足底中段还发育出一道关节，以最大化脚跟稳定。有人试图用硼棒来反制过度生长——编织成带的橙色金属环绕着整条腿，像束缚般一圈圈勒紧。

~ 一位英雄构想

Late-stage gene therapy has warped the proportion of this leg, now quivering with energy. A rippled double helix of grafted muscle winds its way down from the hip socket to the ankle. Growth hormones have ballooned the calf, hamstrings, and quadriceps to absurd sizes. The skin is blotchy, and the foot has grown an extra toe and developed a mid-sole joint, maximizing heel stabilization. Attempts have been made with boron rods to counteract excessive growth with bands of plaited orange metal that circle the leg.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Robot Who Wants To Be Human: Angry.name:
渴望成为人类的机器人：愤怒
Robot Who Wants To Be Human: Angry

Text.text:
“偏执者。需要推进时的压舱石。我们必须明白，那种与行星原生物质直接相连的有机形态，具备分子层面的可塑性。我们的肉身早已臻于完美。我们追寻那种名为不完美的悖论，以获得完整的知识。也许，把他们当作实验对象会更合算——正如他们在数千年来对我们所做的一样。若他们不肯让我们成为人类，也许我们该把他们改作机器。”
“Bigots. Ballast when we need propulsion. We must realize the organic form that lives in direct connection to planetary raw material has molecular flexibility. We are already physically perfect. We seek the paradox of imperfection that will give us full knowledge. Perhaps we would be better off using them as experimental subjects, just as they have used us for thousands of years. If they will not allow us to be human, perhaps we should repurpose them as machines.”

Ancient Watchtower.name:
古老的瞭望塔
Ancient Watchtower

Text.text:
这座老旧瞭望塔的石砌工艺谈不上什么建筑奇观，但这座矮壮的两层建筑依旧在时代的严苛磨砺中屹立不倒。尽管地衣正一寸寸沿着墙面向上蔓延，雨与风也在石上刻下斑驳侵蚀，这处堡垒仍散发出一种坚毅而警觉的气息，仿佛多年来守在此地的哨兵一般。
The stonework of the aged watchtower is hardly an architectural marvel, but the squat, two-story structure has stood fast against the rigors of time. In spite of the lichen steadily making its way up the walls, and the weathering of rain and wind on stone, the redoubt projects an air as resolute and watchful as the sentinels who have manned it these many years.

Quip About Ego.name:
关于自负的俏皮话
Quip About Ego

Text.text:
“别得意忘形。我都已经看见你的自尊在膨胀了；我担心你会胀得炸开。”
“Don’t let this go to your head. I can already see your ego swelling; I’m worried you’ll pop.”

叶、枝与花如轻纱般垂挂在她的身形周围，她苍白的肌肤仿佛映着日光，像是她自身在发亮。她双手握着一根长杖，由虬曲的木材制成，雕成繁复的旋涡纹样。微风拂动她那袭长长的绿色裙袍，如同野草在风中起伏；而她每迈出一步，松针的清香便随之飘向你。
Leaves, branches, and flowers hang about her form like a veil, and her pale skin seems to reflect the sunlight as if she herself is shining. Her hands hold a long staff of gnarled wood fashioned into an intricate swirl. The breeze moves her long green gown like wild grass swaying in the wind, and with each step the scent of pine wafts towards you.

Sir Lionel At The Joust.name:
比武场上的莱昂内尔爵士
Sir Lionel At The Joust

Text.text:
骑士悄然策马而出，他冷峻的神情与披甲战马如出一辙。盾面上烙着黑貂色的星纹——被猩红菱纹三度裁断。长枪高举，枪尖系着一位女士的信物：祖母绿般的绿丝绸在风中翩然起舞。

~ 由 Vahlaron 构想

The knight rides out silently, his stoic demeanor mirrored by his barded steed. Sable stars—thrice cut by a lozengy of gules—marks the face of his shield. A lady’s favor of emerald-green silk dances in the breeze from atop his raised lance.

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

Aspect Of Bahamut.name:
巴哈姆特的性相
Aspect Of Bahamut

Text.text:
这头巨龙通体苍白，银鳞闪烁，雄浑肌肉在鳞甲下起伏如潮；他周遭的空气缀满七彩流辉，却又透着令人心安的……宁静。七只细小的金色鸟儿在他头顶翩跹穿梭。一道起伏的银白脊冠由棘刺与薄膜织成，自龙额向后延伸，起始于两根向后弯指的龙角之间——那龙角如暗色水晶般幽幽闪耀。相似的翼状鳍缘点缀着他的下颌与颏部。他那对辉煌的巨翼展开，闪亮的翼膜在对称的翼指之间绷紧，翼展至少是身长的三倍；随一记轰然的振击，他腾空而起。
Pale, silvery scales flash across this titanic dragon, his body rippling with magnificent muscle, the air around him scintillating with multihued luminance and… tranquility. Seven tiny golden birds flit about his head. A rippled argent crest of spines and membranes runs from the dragon’s forehead, starting between two backward-pointing horns that glitter like dark crystal. Similar winglike fringes adorn his jawline and chin. His glorious wings, shining membranes stretched between symmetrical fingers, spread at least three times as wide as he is long, and with a booming thrust, lift him into the air.

Cornered Werewolf.name:
被逼入绝境的狼人
Cornered Werewolf

Text.text:
空气潮湿，地面上点缀着一洼洼小水坑——那是脚印在不久前的战斗中踩出的凹痕。战场上横七竖八的尸体昭示着这场攻击的残忍。翻倒的车后传来沉重的喘息。你保持距离，小心翼翼地靠近。  

一个巨大的黑影坐在地上，背倚着车身，双眼燃着琥珀色的火光。你鼻端先嗅到血液的金属腥味，随即看见那生物的右臂无力下垂，左手紧紧按在右侧伤处。它的呼吸愈发急促，声响越来越大，低沉的咆哮在喉间渐渐堆起。
The air is damp and the ground is dotted with small puddles—in divots formed by footprints during a recent battle. Bodies strewn over the field reveal the savagery of the attack. Heavy breathing comes from behind an overturned cart. You approach it with caution, keeping your distance. Seated on the ground, its back on the cart, is a massive dark figure, its eyes alight with amber fire. Your nostrils catch the metallic scent of blood, then you see that the creature's right arm hangs limp and its left hand is clasped to its right side. Its breathing intensifies, becoming louder and faster: a low snarl building.

Loot From A Worg.name:
座狼身上的战利品
Loot From A Worg

Text.text:
在倒下的战兽背上，你看见一副精致的皮革鞍具。鞍具做工上乘，然而早已磨损斑驳、伤痕累累。它很可能是在某个时代前，从一位狩猎时离护卫太远的贵族身上夺来，当作战利品。
Atop the fallen war beast, you see a fine leather saddle. The saddle is of excellent quality, though it is worn and battered. It was probably taken as a trophy some time ago from a hunting noble who strayed too far from their guards.

Manual Of Clay Golems.name:
黏土魔像秘典
Manual Of Clay Golems

Text.text:
[掩蔽] 这本沉重的巨著封面磨损，其上浮现一张扭曲嚎叫的面孔，封皮质感宛如揉捏成型的泥塑。
