[内容] 以破烂的线绳装订，内页风化崩碎，点点干涸的泥斑间散落着古怪的奥秘法阵图样。

[Cover] This weighty tome bears a howling, distorted face on a worn cover with the texture of sculpted mud.


[Content] Bound by ragged thread, the crumbling pages within are spotted with patches of dried clay and curious arcane diagrams.

你伸展双臂，吟诵枯败的咒语，缓缓旋身。你的嗓音震颤轰鸣，空气以你为圆心向外鼓荡成半球——仿佛热浪从体内翻涌而出。咏唱将尽，你猛然再度暴旋，脉动的气流穹顶自你身上爆发。它先是黯沉，继而噼啪作响，掠过四周区域。凡被触及之物尽皆干涸、皱缩、褪色。无法承受这片夺命之域，一些生物与植物当场崩散成尘。

~ Envisioned by Austin Kyle

Extending your arms, you incant withering words and spin slowly around. Your voice vibrates and thrums, and the air pulses away from you in a hemisphere—like heat shimmers emanating from your center. You violently spin a final time as you finish the chant, and a dome of pulsing air erupts from you. It darkens and then crackles, moving over the area all around. Everything it touches dries, shrivels, and fades. Unable to withstand this killing field, some creatures and plants crumble to dust.

~ Envisioned by Austin Kyle

Loot From A Sea Hag.name:
来自海鬼婆的战利品
Loot From A Sea Hag

Text.text:
搜检这具鬼婆（特征）的躯体——那股恶臭宛如退潮时的滩涂——你发现了一堆耐人寻味的杂物。她的斜挎弹药带是用一种格外粗大的球状海藻编织而成；你在其中找到一只由青蓝色海玻璃制成的药水瓶，瓶内似乎封着一团翻涌的雾气。你还摸到一枚鼓鼓囊囊的球囊，里面的钱币叮当作响，外层光滑的植被将其护得不受锈蚀。
Searching the hag’s body, malodorous as low tide, you find an interesting miscellany. In her bandolier, crafted of a particularly large strain of bulb seaweed, you find a potion bottle made of teal sea glass that appears to be holding a billowing mist. You also find a bulb clinking with coins, protected from the tarnishing by the smooth vegetation.

Frost Giant Zombie.name:
霜巨人丧尸（特征）
Frost Giant Zombie

Text.text:
腐肉的恶臭从那具覆满寒霜的高大尸体上翻涌而出。腐烂的皮肤、发丝与衣物碎片以破烂的缎带般挂在那冰蓝色的躯体上。一条手臂在肩头以不可能的角度垂落，手掌冻成利爪。另一条手臂握着一柄巨大的巨斧，凝固在将要劈落的姿势。它踉跄向前时，冰屑从身上簌簌剥落。
The stench of dead flesh billows from the towering, frost-covered corpse. Bits of rotting skin, hair, and clothing hang off the icy-blue body in tattered ribbons. One arm hangs at the shoulder at an impossible angle, its hand frozen in a claw. The other arm, holding a massive greataxe, is trapped in a pose as if it were about to strike. Chips of ice fall from the body as it lumbers forward.

执行开始失灵。你伸手去找出卡住的环节，却发现你的心智与赛博脑形态已经僵硬如铁。每一个念头、每一次移动都把你拖得更沉，仿佛你的身体被注入了毒素，被灌进了水泥——被灌进了ICE。你吸入、输入、计算，每一步都像一艘驳船在极地浮冰间艰难推进。慢得令人发疼。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Execution falters. You reach out to identify the hitch but discover your mind and cyber-cerebral form have become rigid. Every thought, every movement weighs you down, as if your body has been injected with toxins, with cement—with ICE. You intake, input, compute, each move like a barge trudging through arctic bergs. Painfully slow.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Meld Into Stone.name:
融入岩石
Meld Into Stone

Text.text:
矮人有句谚语：没有什么能像石头一样把秘密守得那么牢。有人以为这说的是能从岩层里开采出的财富，可这句话是雕刻师的口头禅，不是矿工的。它讲的是藏在其中的形状，以及石头的缄默。你一边想着这句话，一边滑入岩石——对你而言，它并不比烟更难穿过——并化作那道沉默的形。
Dwarves have a saying: Nothing keeps a secret so well as a stone. Some think it refers to the riches that can be mined from the rock, but it is a phrase used by sculptors, not miners. It’s about the shapes that hide within and the stone’s silence. You think about this as you slip into rock—which for you is no harder than smoke—and become that silent shape.

当你施放这道法术时，你有片刻时代去回想它应当防范的那些存在。你当然会惦记某些特定的生物，但这道魔法圆环守护你不受某几类生物侵扰。无论是谁在魔法织体中发现并塑造了这套纹理，都对“威胁”究竟为何有着一种怪异的见解。
As you cast this spell, you have time to reflect on the beings it should guard against. There are specific creatures that concern you, of course, but the magic circle protects against certain kinds of creatures. Whomever discovered and crafted this pattern in the weave of magic had a peculiar view of what constitutes a threat.

巨大而臃肿的菌体紧紧攀附在被咸雾喷洒的岩石上，每一株都在轻轻搏动，吐出令人作呕的闪烁微光。任何博物学者都能看出，它们根本不可能在这种环境下生长……事实上，它们本就不该出现在这里。
Huge, corpulent fungi cling to the salt-sprayed rock, each pulsing softly with nauseously scintillating light. Any naturalist could tell you that they should not be able to grow in these conditions… in fact they should not be here at all.

伊弗利特踉跄后退，死死捂住伤口，伤口中迸喷着断续的火舌与浓烟。它艰难地喘息着，血如熔融金属般在身下汇成一滩。那把镶着缟玛瑙刃的邪恶弯刀哐啷一声坠地，巨灵已然接受了自己的命运。伊弗利特体内的热量节节攀升，在猩红皮肤下灼灼发亮。血管发黑、焦炭般龟裂，火焰从体内渗出，失控般溢散。它脸上掠过一抹阴冷的笑——下一瞬，躯体自燃，在一声轰然巨响中崩解，化作比熔炉之心更刺目的白热烈焰与黑烟。滚烫的气浪向外猛扑，水分顷刻蒸发，所过之处尽皆干枯脆裂。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The efreeti stumbles back, clutching at wounds from which sputtering flame and smoke issue. It takes in labored breaths, blood like molten metal pooling beneath it. The wicked, onyx-bladed scimitar drops to the ground with a clatter as the djinn accepts its fate. The heat within the efreeti’s body rises, glowing hot just beneath its crimson skin. Veins blacken, charring as the flames bleed, spilling forth. A grim smile flashes across the efreeti’s face—a split-second before its body immolates, disintegrating in a thunderous flash of white-hot flame, brighter than the heart of a forge, and black smoke. A wave of superheated air rushes outward, moisture evaporating in an instant, leaving everything in its wake dry and brittle.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Use Empowered Spell.name:
我使用【强效法术】
I Use Empowered Spell

Text.text:
当我毁灭性的魔法迸发而出时，我将满腔怒意一并灌注其中。施行随我的意志而动。它吞噬我灵魂中一部分尚未成形的奥术潜能，使我的法术骤然燃起，更添骇人的破坏力。
As my destructive magic bursts forth I mix in my wrathful intent. The working responds to my will. Consuming a portion of the unformed arcane capacity in my soul, my spell flares with increased harmful potential.

你面前是一捆可卷起的皮革工具包，里面收纳着羊角锤、小木槌、手锯、手钻、凿子、木工角尺，以及一架A字架水平仪、钳子和数把大小不一的锉刀。系带与皮环将工具牢牢固定，小些的扣件则夹着木炭与粉笔、一卷细绳和一根量线。工具包上还缝有数个内置小袋，装着粉笔粉、铁钉、木楔片，以及几枚更大的道钉。
Before you is a leather bundle that can roll up, containing a claw hammer, a small mallet, a hand saw, a hand drill, a chisel, and a carpentry square, as well as an A-frame level, pliers, and several files of differing sizes. Ties and loops secure these tools in place, while smaller fasteners hold charcoal and chalk, a coil of twine, and a measuring line. There are several built-in pouches that contain powdered chalk, iron nails, wood shims, and a few larger spikes.

Backalleys Of A City.name:
城市背巷
Backalleys Of A City

Text.text:
就在这儿，离主干道不过几步之遥，城市便沉寂下来——在楼宇夹出的狭长缝隙里，也更显阴暗。也许是你的错觉，也许只是阴影作祟，但当你更深入小巷时，仿佛气温随之下坠。建筑参差蜿蜒，织成纵横交错的巷道迷宫，垃圾散落其间。晾衣绳横跨这些通道，衣物像城堡大厅里的旗帜般垂挂；流浪猫警惕地瞥你一眼，随即窜入暗处不见。
Here, just a few steps off the main thoroughfare, the city gets quiet—and darker too in the narrow defile between buildings. It might be your imagination or just being in shadows, but it seems the temperature drops as you step deeper into the alley. The buildings ramble, creating a warren of crisscrossing passages strewn with trash. Laundry hangs over these passages like banners in a castle hall, while stray cats give you wary looks before scampering away.

Encounter With Rumpelstiltskin.name:
与伦佩尔斯蒂尔茨金的遭遇
Encounter With Rumpelstiltskin

Text.text:
[引言] 你听见一阵空洞的咔啦声，像钟响，只是钟舌换成了木头。一个男人突兀地从虚无中现身，仿佛他一直就站在近旁——体型与举止都透着小精怪般的狡黠。他瘦得像根木桩，膝盖与手肘骨节嶙峋；那咔啦声正是他的脚步引起的，仿佛关节里塞满了木珠在滚动。他的头发在下巴与头顶飘成赭红色的蛛网般细丝。“哦，多么走运，多么巧合。”他开口时，牙齿有一瞬尖细如针，随即又变得敦实可爱、参差带缝，像马的牙。“一群需要帮助的人，而我，正是个帮手。你们有什么烦恼？”他把双手在下巴下紧紧扣住，眼里兴趣闪烁，指甲上点点金屑。干枯花串做成的项链绕着他秃鹫般的脖颈——那种孩子会编出来的玩意。

[侏儒怪逃走] 小精怪阴沉地哼了一声，细瘦的脚狠狠跺地，薄皮下的骨头随之震颤。他的神情从孩童般湿润圆颊的模样，骤然变得古老而似树木——粗硬的纹路横切脸与颈，皮肤翘起剥落，像树皮一样。他用舌尖抵着磨尖的牙，发出低低的嘶声。金色薄雾猛然一腾，他消失无踪。原地只剩几片干枯蜷曲的花瓣碎屑，标记着他曾站立之处。

~ 由 Midnight 构想

[Introduction] You hear a hollow rattle, like a bell if its clapper were made of wood. A man, impish in both size and manner, appears out of nothing as if he had always been standing near. Thin as a post, knobby-kneed and -elbowed, it is his steps that elicit the rattling sound, as if his joints were filled with wooden beads. His hair wisps about his chin and head in auburn cobwebs. “Oh, what luck, what serendipity.” As he speaks, his teeth appear pointed and needlelike for but a moment, and then they look adorably chunky and gapped like a horse’s. “A group who needs help, and I, a helper. What troubles you so?” He clasps his hands together under his chin, his eyes alight with interest and his nails flecked with gold. A desiccated-flower chain necklace wraps about his vulturous neck, the kind a child might make.

[Rumpelstiltskin Escapes] With an umbrageous huff, the imp stamps his thin foot into the ground, bones shaking underneath his thin skin. His countenance has shifted from the dewy, round-cheeked look of a child to something ancient and arboreous—rough lines cut across his face and neck, his skin lifting and flaking like bark. He presses his tongue against sharpened teeth, emitting a low hiss. In a puff of golden mist, he disappears. Only a few flecks of dried, curling flower petals remain where he once stood.

~ Envisioned by Midnight

High Elf Changing Appearance To Winter.name:
高等精灵：外貌随冬季更迭
High Elf Changing Appearance To Winter

Text.text:
季节的霜意在精灵的肌肤上闪烁，宛如银蓝色的细碎辉光；他们的发丝仿佛由正在融化的冰锥织成。高等精灵常常凝望着远方的虚空，周身气息已变得阴郁而悔恨。刺骨寒意映在他们那无血色的休息里，也映在晶莹泪水的无声啜泣中。

~ 由 Galvatron Envisioned

The frost of the season shows like a silver-blue glitter on the skin of the elf, whose hair seems to be made of melting icicles. Frequently staring into the middle distance, the high elf’s aura has changed to one of gloom and regret. The bitter cold shows in their own shade of bloodless rest and in the weeping of crystalline tears.

~ Envisioned by Galvatron

粗糙凌乱、仓皇缝补的粗线与订书钉——外面结着陈旧血痂——在这具魁梧生物的身躯各处纵横：从左锁骨斜斜歪到右耳的一道歪缝，横贯额头的一排订书钉，腋下与膝窝处毛边散开的线头。他的形体是从不同躯体上拼凑来的错配补丁：一只兽人脚、一只纤细的精灵手、一道提夫林角——全都被粗暴地束在一起，呈现出一场令人作呕的灰白僵硬肉体展示。他那修长而肌肉虬结的双臂拖曳在身后，四肢显然取自巨魔或巨人族裔的尸体。相较之下，他的头却小得可怜——半身人大小，光秃而蜡黄——滑稽地夹在宽阔健壮的肩膀之间。尽管外貌骇人，他却带着温和、好奇、又略显困惑的神情。冰白的眼睛里仍能寻到一丝暖意——还有他消瘦脸颊上残留的绯红泪痕。

~ Played by Floppey

Thick threads of messy, harried stitching and staples, crusted with old blood, line this hulking creature’s body at various points: a crooked, diagonal stitch from left clavicle to right ear, a row of staples across the forehead, frayed thread at the armpits and knees. His form is a mismatched patchwork of pieces from different bodies—one orcish foot, a slender elven hand, one tiefling horn—all bound together in a foul display of gray, stiff flesh. His lengthy, muscular arms drag along the ground behind him, limbs clearly taken from the corpse of a troll or giant-kin. His comparatively small head—halfling-sized, bald and sallow—sits comically between brawny shoulders. Despite his horrid appearance, he bears a gentle, curious, and somewhat confused expression. A warmth can be found in his ice-white eyes—and in the remnants of crimson tears on his gaunt cheeks.

~ Played by Floppey

一条两米长的蛇形细线悬在稀薄的空气中，幽幽发光，却细到几乎只能用千分尺勉强量出轮廓。流经其中的能量来自握柄内的电池。落在受过训练的使用者手里，这条鞭能被引导到近乎分子般的精度，穿透护甲、血肉与骨骼——甚至能沿着身体另一侧空气中的微粒游走。若是拿捏失当，这件武器对持有者同样致命。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

A two-meter serpentine line hangs in thin air and glows, but the cord can barely be measured with a micrometer. The energy coursing through it is generated from a battery in the handle. In the hands of a trained user, the whip can be guided at the near-molecular level through armor, flesh, bone—even the particulates in the air on the other side of the body. Mishandled, the weapon is every bit as deadly to its wielder.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Light In The Well.name:
井中之光
Light In The Well

Text.text:
旅人们世世代代想必都很好地利用过它，但你怀疑它是否曾在夜里被用过。至少——看到有一束摇曳的蓝光自水面向上投射，你不确定自己是否敢喝那水。你靠近时，光影在内壁间跳跃游走，然而旋即无声熄灭，黑暗吞没一切，仿佛那光从未存在过。
Travelers must have used this well for generations, but you doubt it was ever used at night. At least, you’re not sure you’d drink the water, given that a wavering blue light projects up from it. The light dances around the inside walls as you approach, but then it silently snuffs out, gone dark as if it had never existed.

Sovereign Myconid With One Arm.name:
独臂真菌王
Sovereign Myconid With One Arm

Text.text:
在地底幽光的剪影里，菌灵之王确实威严如仪。他那令人作呕的菌盖泛着诡异的绿光，晕出一圈近似王冠形状的朦胧光冕。身躯矮壮而褶皱，核心由海绵般的黄色物质构成，并分叉长出一打幼树般纤细、多关节的长腿，行动时带着蛛类般流畅的滑步。仿佛要为这多足之形补偿些什么，这位君主的左肩处有一道参差的撕裂，本该长臂的位置空空如也。更离奇的是，那条缺失的手臂——干枯、萎缩——被他仅存的那只手高高举起，像一柄阴森的丧葬权杖，令他的真菌随从俯首效忠。

~ 构想：Ethan

Silhouetted in the subterranean luminescence, the fungikin king is indeed regal. His bilious cap glows eerily green, creating a halo with a vaguely crown-shaped penumbra. Squat and wrinkled, his core is formed of a spongy yellow material that branches out to form a dozen sapling-skinny, multi-jointed legs that move with arachnid fluidity. As if to make up for the multipedal form, the sovereign’s left shoulder bears a ragged tear where his arm should be. Oddly, that missing arm—dried and shrunken—is held aloft in his remaining hand as some sort of sepulchral scepter that commands the respect and loyalty of his fungal followers.

~ Envisioned by Ethan

一个小小的身影在房间尽头来回踱步，嘴里嘟囔个不停，双手间把一件物品来回倒腾。地精的眼睛猛地瞪大，嗖地一下跳到最近的柱子后面，藏得严严实实，只剩一只尖尖的灰色耳朵露在外头。嘟囔声仍在继续，中途短暂停了一下——地精从柱子旁探头窥视，确认你还在不在——随即吱的一声尖叫，又缩回去躲了起来。
A small figure paces at the end of the room, muttering to itself as it moves an item back and forth between its hands. The goblin’s eyes go wide and it jumps quickly behind the closest pillar, successfully hiding all of itself except a pointy grey ear. The muttering continues, pausing briefly while the goblin peers around the pillar to see if you’re still there, before it squeaks and hides again.

Lawyer From Hell.name:
来自地狱的律师
Lawyer From Hell

Text.text:
衣冠楚楚的男人从容自若，笑容极具感染力。他把手探入量身定制的双排扣西装内袋，抽出一只断手，朝你这边左右扇动——显然是在打招呼。“那小伙子求我替他解决一桩‘家族荣誉之事’，却又拒绝在我们的交易上复签！你们凡人真是无礼得很。又不是我能用这副皮囊同时出现在所有地方。”魔鬼空着的那只手里凭空现出一支象牙笔。“不过，我还是会维护我们共同的利益，代他签字。”
With poise and an infectious smile, the dapper man reaches into the inside pocket of his tailored, double-breasted suit jacket, withdraws a severed hand, and flaps it side-to-side in your direction—apparently in greeting. “Young lad begged me to resolve a ‘matter of family honor,’ then refused to countersign our bargain! How discourteous you mortals can be. It’s not like I can be everywhere at once in this physique.” An ivory pen appears in the devil’s free hand. “Nevertheless, I’ll protect our mutual interests and sign on his behalf.”

你做到了。你那点微薄的准备——只是从内心深处逼自己接下这场冒险、踏入那场旋风——终究得到了回报。你有了武器，有了见识，有了些许护身之物。你发现自己不再像那些农民、那些受害者；你更像是有能力去夺取自己想要的一切的人。可每一次训练团期都在多索取一点。每一场战斗，既是对手、伤口与恐惧，也是你与自身默默无闻的较量。
You’ve done it. What little preparation you had, just finding it in yourself to take on the adventure and step into the whirlwind has paid off. You have a weapon, knowledge, some protection. You find yourself less like the peasantry, the victims. More capable of taking what you want. Yet every training session continues to ask a little more. Every fight is against your obscurity as much as the opponents, the wounds, and the fear.

Corrupted Hound Archon's Lament.name:
堕化猎犬执政官的哀歌
Corrupted Hound Archon's Lament

Text.text:
“真希望真相是坚实的——在命运狂风里，你能握住的一根支柱。曾有一段时代，我相信神祇握着答案，可祂们的全能反而令祂们目盲。因为真相藏在怀疑之中。我剜去那只自以为能把世界看得清清楚楚的眼睛，好让自己再也不会被引入歧途。”

~ Envisioned by Kyriux

“One wishes truth were solid—a pillar you could grasp in the raging winds of fate. There was a time when I believed the gods held the answers, but their omnipotence blinds them. For truth is found in doubt. I cut out the eye that thought it could see the world clearly so that I would never again be led astray.”

~ Envisioned by Kyriux

Platinum Buckle For A Wide Belt.name:
宽腰带用铂金扣
Platinum Buckle For A Wide Belt

Text.text:
昂贵却比金银更实用，这枚扣环被打造得足以历经千年而不毁。它是一块刻着村落群像的金属板，表面泛着缎般柔光，仿佛将光线吞入其中，而非反射出去。
Expensive and more practical than gold or silver, this buckle is designed to survive millennia. It is a plate etched with a tableau of a village, and it seems to absorb light into its satin sheen rather than reflecting it.

Sundries From An Adult Bronze Dragon.name:
成年青铜龙的杂货
Sundries From An Adult Bronze Dragon

Text.text:
海浪轻拍着那具庞大的尸骸，冲刷着沙地上青铜龙的血迹。你用手拨弄了几下，确认它确实已经死透，随即开始搜寻。只剩下一枚牙齿还算完整，虽有些裂痕；其余的都被砸得粉碎，已无从回收。
Waves lap around the huge corpse, washing the bronze dragon’s blood from the sand. Prodding it a few times to make sure it’s really dead, you begin to search it. One tooth seems intact, if slightly cracked. The rest is too smashed to be salvageable.

I Cast Globe Of Invulnerability From My.name:
我从我的能量法杖中施放「无敌法球」
I Cast Globe Of Invulnerability From My Staff Of Power

Text.text:
当我唤起其中蕴藏的守护能量时，法杖如同奥术时钟般有节奏地清鸣。杖身上刻下的符文泛起柔和的苍银光辉，我感到魔法开始显现，化作一片微光闪烁的力场在我周身铺开。
The staff chimes rhythmically like an arcane clock when I summon forth the protective energy within. The runes etched along the haft glow softly with a pallid silver light, and I feel the magic begin to manifest in a shimmering field around me.

Bones Of Big Animal In Swamp.name:
沼泽里巨兽的骸骨
Bones Of Big Animal In Swamp

Text.text:
一头巨大的猫科猛兽骷髅（特征）沉在沼泽的水面之下。粗壮弯曲的獠牙与剃刀般的利爪也没能让这头掠食者逃过葬身泥淖的命运；在酸性的水里，惨白的骨骼正被缓慢啃噬殆尽。路过之人或许会发誓，曾看见那野兽空洞的眼眶深处，有一抹幽光在沉没的坑洼里闪烁。
The skeleton of a massive, feline beast lies beneath the surface of the swamp. Massive, curving fangs and razor claws could not spare the predator its fate at the bottom of the fen, where the acidic waters slowly devour the bleached bones. As one passes, they might swear to see a ghostly light aglow in the sunken pits of the beast’s eye sockets.

当你念完咒语并在空中勾画那些秘奥符号时，一阵风骤然升起。它裹挟着令人沉醉的馥郁香气：肉桂、玫瑰、薰衣草，以及更多难以分辨的气息。你面前的空气微微闪烁，而当你伸手触及你咒语的目标时，你以心灵之指撬开它的意识，探入其脑海。
As you complete the utterance and draw the esoteric symbols in the air, a wind rises. It carries an intoxicating medley of scents: cinnamon, rose, lavender, and others less discernible. The air glimmers before you, and as you reach toward the target of your incantation, you pry your psychic fingers into its mind.

嗡嗡作响的苍蝇塞满了腥臭的空气，成群结队在坑中盘旋刮掠，永不餍足。成堆的废物把曾经葱郁的景致扭曲得面目全非，宛如大地上化脓溃烂的伤口。零星可见野性的地精在垃圾堆间乱窜，满身污泥的拾荒者背着装满残渣的麻袋。食腐鸟争啄聒噪、尖声嘶叫，只等痛快享用这堆腐烂的“丰收”。
Droning flies fill the fetid air, clouds of them scouring the pit, ever hungry. The mounds of waste disfigure the once lush landscape, like suppurating wounds in the earth. Here and there, feral goblins scramble across the trash piles, muck-covered scavengers laden with sacks of refuse. Carrion birds squabble and screech, eager to have their fill of the rotting bounty.

这法术的姿势成分看起来有些古怪：你拖着脚步，手掌在衣料上用力摩擦。你伸手去接触敌人时，电流自地面窜入体内，沿着你的手臂奔涌而上，最终在指尖迸出噼啪作响的火花与电弧。
It seems odd but as part of the somatic gestures of this spell, you shuffle your feet and rub your hand against your clothing. As you reach out to touch your enemy, electricity thrills through you from the ground to spark and crackle from your fingertips.

Taunt From A Fighter About Form.name:
战士对招式架势的嘲讽
Taunt From A Fighter About Form

Text.text:
“漂亮的一击！架势不错，站桩也还过得去。但你这一下毫无情绪——就像一袋湿透的土豆砸过来。让我给你看看，掺上一点怒火，你能做到什么。”

~ Envisioned by Battersby

“A fine blow! Good form, and a passable stance. But you hit with no feeling—like a wet sack of potatoes. Let me show you what you can do with a bit of rage.”

~ Envisioned by Battersby

Guildhall Entrance.name:
公会大厅入口
Guildhall Entrance

Text.text:
成功进入校园后，你眼前是一座体型惊人的宏阔大厅。沿着通往门槛的石径向前，你瞥见左侧是成片菜圃，右侧是马厩。再往右看，越过院中蜿蜒的小溪，你能望见一座泛着光辉的锻炉；铁匠与公会成员正守在旁边，火光映得人影跳动。
Having gained entry to the campus, you find yourself facing a sprawling hall of impressive size. From the stone path leading up to the threshold, you spy vegetable patches to your left and the stables to your right. Farther to the right, past a little creek running through the yard, you can see a glowing forge attended by a smith and guild members.

Weather-beaten Cube Van.name:
饱经风霜的方盒厢式货车
Weather-beaten Cube Van

Text.text:
俗艳的高饱和变色涂鸦糊满了这辆饱经天气摧残的厢式车侧面，浓烈的色彩与车身那被磕碰得斑驳的灰色漆面格格不入。污垢在方方正正的后窗上抹出一道道脏痕。驾驶舱里散落着快餐残骸，一枚褪色的空气清新剂可怜兮兮地垂着，挂在那松松垮垮装上的后视镜下。
Garish hypercolor art is plastered across the side of the weather-beaten van, its saturation quite at odds with the chassis’s battered gray finish. Grime smears the boxy rear windows. The cab is littered with fast food detritus, and a faded air freshener dangles sadly from the loosely fitted rear-view mirror.

Headstone: “The” Obscured By Snow.name:
墓碑：“The”被积雪掩埋
Headstone: “The” Obscured By Snow

Text.text: 堆积在这块标记物上的积雪垂落在正面，半遮住了上面的铭文。你拂去雪层，看到其上刻着：通往天堂的小径与救赎之路，都以牺牲铺就。 The snow heaped upon this marker drapes down its front, partially obscuring its inscription. Brushing away the snow, you see that its words read: The path to paradise and the road to redemption are both paved with sacrifice.

Hill Dwarfhold.name:
丘陵矮人要塞
Hill Dwarfhold

Text.text:
沿着这道峡谷的峭壁，一座立面——宛如巨大的城堡之城——被硬生生从岩体中凿出：那是丘陵矮人据垒的入口，一条设防的通道，通往这群敦实体民错综盘绕的巢穴。尽管丘陵矮人与地表诸族往来贸易，在这些简朴的隧道里，陌生人依旧会被以猜疑甚至敌意相待——不速之客总会把失序的危险一并带来。然而，内里那些矮壮的建筑几乎对标准攻击牢不可破。可矮人骨子里对奢华的偏爱，足以点燃一个精明盗贼的野心：华美的大理石雕像点缀大道，半宝石拼嵌的马赛克在主街旁巍然铺陈；纵然戒备森严，这座矮人要塞依旧可能是一桩大收获。
Along the cliff wall of this canyon, a façade—like an enormous castle-city—has been hewn into the rock: the entrance of a hill dwarf redoubt, a guarded passage into the warrens of the stout people. Despite trade between the hill dwarves and the surface races, strangers in the spartan tunnels are viewed with suspicion, even hostility, as unexpected visitors bring the danger of disorder. However, the squat buildings within are all but invulnerable to standard attack. Yet the natural bent to excess would inspire an enterprising thief: gorgeous marble sculptures dot the avenues and mosaics of semiprecious stones loom beside the main streets; though heavily guarded, this dwarfhold could be quite a boon.

Azlanti Stellar Scout.name:
阿兹兰提星辰斥候
Azlanti Stellar Scout

Text.text:
这具构装体身形高大宽阔，凭借精密的喷气推进在空中飞行，轻轻起伏，悬停在地面之上。也许它正在扫描，却很难断定。它是先进设计的机器人：躯干覆着厚实而顺眼的装甲板，板面微微起伏，带着纳米机械活动的典型征兆；而这名生物的手臂则仿佛随心所欲般变形，化作复杂的多功能工具。构装体胸腔深处隐约传来一丝尖细的嗡鸣声。
Broad and tall, this construct flies using a sophisticated jet propulsion, bobbing gently above the ground. Perhaps it is scanning, it is hard to know. A robot of advanced design, its torso is made of pleasant bulky plate that ripples with the tell-tale signs of nanites, and the creature’s arm transforms into a complex multi-tool, apparently on a whim. A faint whining noise seems to originate from the construct’s chest.

这具枯槁的人形生物高如食人魔，却瘦得宛如骷髅（特征）。龟裂的黑色皮肤下，几乎没有肌肉附着在骨骼之上；它双翼骨架间布满血管的薄膜近乎透明。即便如此，它仍以掠食者般强劲而优雅的姿态移动，身后扭动的长尾末端长着一枚致命般的倒刺。
This emaciated humanoid stands as tall as an ogre, but as thin as a skeleton. Barely any muscle clings to the bones beneath its cracked, black skin, and the veiny membranes between the bones of its wings are nearly transparent. Despite this, it moves with the powerful grace of a predator, and the long tail that writhes behind it bears a deadly-looking barb.

Hacker Utilizes A System Backdoor In The.name:
黑客在网络中利用系统后门
Hacker Utilizes A System Backdoor In The Net

Text.text:
黑客迅速行动，穿行在盘根错节的代码迷宫中，终于锁定了系统的隐秘入口：后门。得意地一笑，黑客解锁了绕过机制，从这手把戏般的成功中汲取了不小的快感。
Working quickly, the hacker makes their way through the twisting maze of code to locate the hidden entrance to the system: the backdoor. Smirking with triumph, the hacker unlocks the bypass, taking no small measure of satisfaction from the trick.

一颗巨大的大脑向前漂浮，他们那细小的四臂身躯悬垂在下方。一个充盈灵能的气泡环绕着他们，向你的脑海迸射标语与广告。全息衣饰在他们那残余的躯体上闪烁跳动，待其完全映入眼帘时更显分明。尽管没有你所预期的面孔，一抹训练有素的微笑却如浪潮般覆过你的感知，温暖而令人卸下戒心。
A colossal brain floats forward, their tiny four-armed body dangling below. A bubble of psychic potency hovers about them, flashing forth logos and advertisements into your brain. Holographic clothing flickers about their vestigial body as they come into full view. Although there’s no face as one might expect, the impression of a practiced smile peels across you like a wave, warm and disarming.

Platinum Buckle For A Narrow Belt.name:
适配窄腰带的铂金扣饰
Platinum Buckle For A Narrow Belt

Text.text:
这件作品打磨得极为雅致，冷色调的宝石如星点般直接嵌入钢中。它看上去像一只夸张的大耳坠，很可能属于某套成对的饰品。
This is gracefully worked, speckled with gems of cool colors set directly into the steel. It looks like a large earring, and likely is part of a set.

Hassiri Dalag'dar.name:
哈西里·达拉格达尔
Hassiri Dalag'dar

Text.text:
他们猫科般的脚掌轻盈落地，穿行人群时悄无声息；带爪的手却顽皮地掠过斗篷、袖口与衣领，像在拨弄一场即兴的恶作剧。他们修长的口鼻裂开，露出一抹带着犬类意味的好奇笑容，欣赏着周围惊讶、欢喜与恼怒交织的反应。无论旁人靠近是示好还是冒犯，他们都像一条丝绸缎带在房间里飘舞般滑开，灵巧得让人抓不住影子。待他们更近，你才看清——他们的装备几乎堪比军械库：一柄镶宝石护手的细剑，一条斜挎弹带塞满小瓶与微型炸弹，大腿两侧还绑着备用的手枪与匕首。杂乱兵器之中，一把金色燧发手枪尤为醒目——它闪烁着与那双猫眼同样的流氓气息；那双眼在三角帽檐下熠熠生辉，仿佛两片绿柱石的碎晶。

~ Played by Garwen Kazúl

Their feline feet step lightly as they pass through the crowd, clawed hands scratching playfully over cloaks, sleeves and collars. Their long snout splits into a curiously canine grin at the variety of surprised, delighted, and angry reactions. At any advance, affectionate or not, they dance away like a silken ribbon moving through the room. As they get closer, you see they are about as well-equipped as a military armory: a rapier with a jeweled hilt, a bandolier brimming with vials and small bombs, and spare guns and daggers strapped to their thighs. A golden flintlock stands out from the sundry—it glints as roguishly as their cat-like eyes, which shine like two chips of beryl from under their tricorn hat.

~ Played by Garwen Kazúl

小小的魔像以卑躬屈膝的姿态站着，脸庞如一张空白面具。它双手在腰间交握，肩背前耸蜷缩。它的身躯——若这也能称作身躯——不过是一团团血肉器官，被细细的绳线牵束成孩童布偶的形状与体型。它向前挪步时，你的目光不由被它的脚吸引：那几乎只剩下没有脚趾的肉瘤般残端。
The little homunculus stands with a subservient posture, its face a blank mask. Its hands are clasped at the waist, and its shoulders are hunched forward. Its body, if it can be called such, is a smattering of fleshy organs held together by slender twine in the shape and size of a child’s doll. As it steps forward, your eyes are drawn to its feet, which are little more than toeless nubs.

Celescia The Valkyrie.name:
瓦尔基里·塞莱希娅
Celescia The Valkyrie

Text.text:
一条海蓝色锦缎绶带斜斜披过她耀眼的胸甲，颜色与她那双夺目的眼睛相映成辉；锦面以银线绣出蜿蜒卷草，仿佛海图上用墨勾勒的风之涡纹。每侧肩头都“起浪”般顶着一柄武器：一把巨剑的长柄，以及一支长矛纤细的矛头。可不知为何，尽管她带着这般令人胆寒的武备，落足却悄无声息——连最细微的叮当轻响都没有。她的动作缓慢而优雅，精准得像一只白鹭；高挑的身形与纤瘦的体态更将这种效果衬得淋漓尽致。光晕自她周身逸散而出，辫起的金发泛着微光，如同淡色的火焰。

~ 由一位英雄扮演

A sea-blue brocade sash drapes diagonally over her bright breastplate, the color matching her striking eyes, and the fabric embroidered with silver scrollwork recalling curls of wind inked on maritime maps. A weapon crests each shoulder: the long hilt of a greatsword and the slender head of a spear. Somehow, despite this intimidating arsenal, her footfalls make no sound—not even the slightest chime or clink. She moves with the slow and graceful precision of an egret, her towering height and slender build accentuating this effect. A halo of light emanates from her, braided blond hair glowing like pale fire.

~ Played by a Hero

Bustling City Of Commerce.name:
繁华的商业之城
Bustling City Of Commerce

Text.text:
集市几乎从不沉寂，但今天的嗡鸣声比往常更盛。商贩从遥远的北境与深南之地、远东与未知的西方汇聚于此，各自叫卖着琳琅满目的货物——凡俗的、魔法的，以及介于两者之间的奇巧玩意。车马辘辘驶过，由马匹、驴子，甚至巨大的鸟类牵引。集市作为这座城的心脏，向周遭道路与小巷漫溢开去，摊棚与长桌沿着街巷上下铺陈。钱币叮当与人声喧嚷交织在空气里，像潮水般涌动不息。
The market rarely stands quiet, but today it hums louder than most. Merchants gather here from the far north and the deep south, the distant east and unknown west, each hawking a myriad of wares—mundane, magical, and in between. Carts roll by, pulled by horses, donkeys, and large birds. The market itself, the heart of the city, spills into the surrounding roads and alleyways, with booths and tables erected up and down the lanes. The clatter of coin and the clamor of conversation mingle in the air.

Prophet's Speech About Coming Trials.name:
先知对即将到来的试炼的宣告
Prophet's Speech About Coming Trials

Text.text:
“一个阴影自世界的脏腑深处浮现，携来凡人之眼从未见过的浩劫。风将停下舞步，海将翻涌抗议那将至的风暴。大地会在诅咒它曾深爱的孩子时，呕出疾病与腐朽。然而，万事皆然，命运要求均衡。被选中者将直面勇气、团结、魔法与力量的试炼。他们必须依靠光，因为唯有在黑暗里，才能感到它的辉芒。”

~ 由 Vahlaron “无畏者” 构想

“A shadow emerges from the bowels of the world, bringing with it a devastation never before seen by mortal eyes. The winds will cease their dance and the seas will roil in protest of the coming storm. The earth will vomit forth disease and decay as it curses its once-beloved children. But, as with all things, destiny demands balance. The fated will face trials of courage, unity, magic, and strength. They must rely on the light, for only in the dark can its glow be felt.”

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron "The Fearless"

Cursed Inn.name:
被诅咒的旅店
Cursed Inn

Text.text:
那间阴影笼罩的旅店立在一条被遗忘的路尽头，荒草丛生，碎屑杂物四散。烟囱里不见一缕炊烟，瓶底玻璃的窗后也没有半点光透出。旅店本身被常春藤缠裹，草与苔藓疯长，看上去荒弃已久；可再细看，你却见到里头有影子在晃动，还听见压低的、闷闷的说话声。你伸手去推门时，一股寒意顺着脊背窜上来——踏进去，会不会是个错误？
The shadowed inn stands at the end of a forgotten road, overgrown with weeds and scattered with debris. No smoke rises from the chimney, and no light seeps through the bottle-glass windows. The inn itself, shrouded in ivy and overgrown with grass and moss, appears deserted, but upon closer inspection, you see shapes moving inside, and hear muffled voices. As you move to open the door, a chill runs up your spine—is it a mistake to enter?

三十英尺横贯天际，沉甸甸地压着将临的厄运，一团巨大的云影出现在地平线上。它庞大如山，噼啪作响的黄绿闪电在其中翻涌，喧嚣雷霆一阵阵轰鸣咆哮。你的无线电忽然闪烁着苏醒，一个声音柔软而惶恐，压低了嗓子呢喃了些什么。紧接着，变成了体育转播。又变成了天气预报。你战衣上的每一个传感器都同时报警，记录着辐射在稳定攀升。
Thirty feet across and heavy with impending doom, a great cloud appears on the horizon. Colossal and crackling with yellow-green lightning, it bellows in peals of raucous thunder. Your radio flickers to life, and a voice, soft and afraid, murmurs something low. Then there’s a sports broadcast. Then a weather report. Every sensor on your suit flares, counting a steady rise in radiation.

这只古怪的箭袋看起来略嫌过长，而且它竟由三根皮筒并排构成：第二根的体型与寻常箭袋差不多，最后一根则更短些。打造它的人想必颇具幽默感——每根皮筒都被制成一条瞪圆眼珠的鱼，鱼鳃处开着细缝，底端还拖着鱼尾。无论你想把什么弹药塞进去，都得从鱼那张大张的嘴里送入。
This curious quiver seems a little overlong, plus it has three tubes, with the second about the size of a normal quiver, and the last shorter still. Whoever crafted it must have had a sense of humor, for each leather tube has been made to look like a goggle-eyed fish, complete with slits for gills and fish tails at their bottoms. Whatever ammunition you might put inside must be placed within a fish’s gaping mouth.

你在编织魔咒时吐出的音节，连你自己听来都觉污秽，而在你的敌人耳中更是恶臭刺骨。凭借你的恶意，命运的风也为他们染上病灶，不安的涟漪随之奔涌扩散。他们脸上泛起的酸涩神色昭示着——你的受害者也同样感受到了。
The syllables you voice while weaving your enchantment sound foul even to your ears, but fouler still to your enemies. Thanks to your malice, the winds of chance fall ill upon them, and a ripple of unease surges forth. The sour looks on their faces indicate that your victims feel it too.

一具蛇形躯体忽然从盘绕中挺立而起，双眼闪烁着近乎神圣的灵慧，却又被钢铁般的使命感所淬炼。此类生物是强大的哨卫，既精通魔法，也擅长战斗，并以忠诚服役直至——甚至越过——死亡而闻名……前提是你真能设法击败这般凶邪的对手。它以蛇吻吐出嘶嘶的辅音，开口警告你莫再前进一步。
A snakelike form suddenly stands erect from its coil, eyes gleaming with beatific intelligence tempered by an ironclad sense of duty. Creatures such as this make for powerful sentinels, skilled in magic as well as combat, and have the reputation of serving until—even past—death… if one can manage to defeat such a fell opponent. Sibilant consonants emerge from its serpentine mouth as it speaks, warning you to approach no further.

I Resist Becoming Frightened.name:
我抵抗陷入恐惧状态
I Resist Becoming Frightened

Text.text:
我很熟悉那种悄然爬上的感觉——膝盖发软，双手颤抖——人人都明白的恐惧。我也明白这是一种魔法状态，于是理智与意志将它层层拆解；我没有转身逃跑，而是向前踏出一步。
I know the creeping feeling—the weakening knees and shaking hands—that everyone knows. I also realize that this is a magical condition, so my reason and willpower take it apart, and instead of turning to flee, I step forward.

你挥砍着穿过葱郁的灌木丛，避开那些仿佛要驱逐一切靠近者的尖刺。眼前那格外纷乱的植被网络——植物、矮灌木，甚至杂草——左右着你前行的路线，像是暗自串通，好把你引向那道缝隙。你回头一看，却发现这些植被似乎已换了阵势，重新排列成另一番模样。
You hack through the verdant underbrush, avoiding thorns intent on repelling those who get too close. The notably chaotic network of plants, shrubs—even weeds—determine your path ahead, as if scheming together to direct you through the aperture. You turn around, only to discover that the vegetation seems to have arranged itself differently.

Wood Elf Community.name:
木精灵聚落
Wood Elf Community

Text.text:
在遥远森林的高高树冠之上，识得门道的人若知道该往哪里看，或许能发现一座座由熏制硬木铺就的巨型平台——枝干在生长时被某种力量温驯地引导着彼此纠缠交错，竟不可思议地将其稳稳托起。身形轻盈的木精灵在这座树上聚落的平台间穿梭，于劳作与嬉戏中处理他们的事务；这里的建筑皆以木材塑形、打磨、抛光而成，精致程度不输最富庶的人类城镇。浓密的林冠遮住了大半日光，于是缠曲的枝臂上悬着柔和发亮的光球，为那些未受精灵视力眷顾者补足照明。
High in the treetops of a distant forest, those who know where to look might find enormous platforms of cured wood, impossibly supported by boughs of trees somehow coaxed into intertwining during their growth. Slight wood elves conduct their business in both work and play on the platforms of this arboreal settlement, the buildings constructed from shaped and polished wood as fine as any one might find in the wealthiest human community. The thick forest canopy blocks most of the sun’s rays, so softly glowing globes attached to twisted limbs provide additional illumination for those unblessed by elvish sight.

你的双眼与武器一同化作冥渊般的漆黑；原始的恐惧自那黑暗里渗出，而你的武器挥掠之时，带起的不是风的呢喃——而是撕裂般痛楚的威胁。
Your eyes and your weapon turn the same stygian black; raw fear seeps from the blackness, and your weapon swishes, not with the whisper of the wind—but with the threat of rending pain.

Creating A Data Bomb.name:
制作数据炸弹
Creating A Data Bomb

Text.text:
你以大师级调酒师的谨慎与狡黠来调制这一切：若代码是一杯混合鸡尾酒，那你的数据炸弹就是悄悄掺进配方里的迷药。任何访问这份文件的人，都会被它的烈性当场放倒。杯口那点缀的装饰？文件如今会自我粉碎销毁。精致的酒需要精致的名字，但眼下它只叫 adios！

~ 由一位英雄构想

You approach this with the care and cunning of a master mixologist: if the code is a mixed drink, your data bomb is the mickey slipped into the recipe. Whoever accesses the file will find themselves dropped by its potency. The garnish on the glass? The file is now self-shredding. A fancy drink needs a fancy name, but for now it’s simply called adios!

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Sevastyan Kovac.name:
塞瓦斯季扬·科瓦奇
Sevastyan Kovac

Text.text:
这位夺目的精灵带着笃定的笑容，脑袋微微偏向一侧，鼻尖又轻轻偏向另一边。碧绿的眼眸闪着戏谑的光……是欢笑，亦或恶作剧。白色卷发从深色皮革的宽檐帽下垂到下颌，发色与他那本该是烟灰般的暗淡肤色上零星不规则的苍白斑块相互呼应。帽子与他的长外套、皮甲上衣、腰带与靴子一色相衬；而他那宽松的紫罗兰色长裤上几道裂口露出暗红的底色，映出他几乎看不清的翻领衬衫的同样色调。他一只手扶着那根铁箍包头的长杖，随意搭在肩上；另一只手则拇指勾进腰带，离几把带鞘短刀只差一指的距离。

~ Played by Nick with

This striking elf wears a sure smile, his head tilted to one side, his nose slightly to the other. His green eyes glimmer with mirth… or mischief. White curls hang to his jaw out of his wide-brimmed hat of dark leather. The hair matches the irregular patches of pale skin on his otherwise dusky-gray complexion. His hat complements his overcoat, jerkin, belt, and boots, although slashes in his loose violet pants reveal red undertones that echo the hue of his barely visible collared shirt. He uses one hand to keep his iron-shod staff slung over one shoulder, while the other hand is thumbed into his belt, a finger’s length away from a few sheathed knives.

~ Played by Nick with

鹿群数量以千计——驯鹿如蜿蜒的河流般铺满大地，白与褐的身影点点散落——用蹄刨开地面，啃食稀疏的草茎。成对纤细分岔的鹿角在兽群上方时隐时现，偶有个体抬起头来，警惕地扫视着地平线。
The herd numbers in the thousands—reindeer dotting the landscape in a meandering river of white and brown—pawing the ground with their hooves, grazing on sparse grasses. Pairs of slender, branching antlers appear above the host as individuals lift their heads to scan the horizon.

果实呈暗粉色，喷吐般伸展的叶状突起宛如肉翼，露珠在其表面闪烁。甜香弥漫四周，仿佛对汁水丰盈的诱人承诺；尚未入口，已撩拨味蕾。你一握住它，那如口鼻般的冠部便“啵”地弹开，猛地喷出一蓬猩红的籽粒，恰似其名所指的那般。
Ruddy pink and spouting fronds resembling fleshy wings, the fruit glistens with dew. A sweet aroma permeates the air around it, a promise of mouthwatering succulence, tantalizing before ever a bite is taken. As you grasp it, the snout-like crown pops open, belching forth a crimson spray of seeds, reminiscent of the fruit’s namesake.

View From A Leaf On The World Tree.name:
世界树叶上的眺望
View From A Leaf On The World Tree

Text.text:
在这里，世界之树叶片的弧形边缘终于清晰可见：一面鲜活的翠绿峭壁向下骤然断落，没入稀薄翻涌的雾海，雾气轻轻飘荡，带来雨意的气息。相似的云团在天际缓缓推移，滤去远处太阳的明亮光照。自上方望去，无数粗壮的巨枝与繁多的叶片在倾斜的光线里投下层层阴影。下方，枝桠与叶幕交织成网，仿佛无穷无尽。它们全都从那巨大的树干上生发而出——一堵幽暗、嶙峋的木质峭壁，即便在此处仍清晰可见。

~ 构想：David

Here, the curving edge of the World Tree’s leaf becomes apparent as a living green cliff drops away into thin, billowing mist, wafting the smell of rain. Similar clouds roll through the sky, filtering the bright light of the distant sun. From above, countless great branches and myriad other leaves cast their shadows in this slanting illumination. Below, the lattice of boughs and foliage seem to go on forever. All sprout from the tree’s great trunk, a dark, craggy wall of wood still visible from this point.

~ Envisioned by David

I Am A Survivor.name:
我是幸存者
I Am A Survivor

Text.text:
我浑身血污淤青，却依然意志如铁，决心不改。敌人以为他们的重击能削弱我，实则远不如他们所想。我的身躯强健；我的意志更强。若想击碎我守护同伴、击败对手的决心，他们就得先把我打到失去知觉。
I’m bloodied and bruised, but my resolve to fight on remains steadfast. Blows that my enemies land take less out of me than they believe. My body is strong; my will is stronger. To break my determination to defend my friends and defeat my adversaries, they’ll have to render me senseless.

Blade Of Disaster.name:
灾害之刃
Blade Of Disaster

Text.text:
你嘶吼出令人痛苦的咒言，手势宛如撕裂现实的帷幕，随即一道裂口被生生扯开。一柄由墨色暗影铸就、涌动着原始力量的辉光利刃在你掌中凝现。其周遭的空气都被扭曲，虚空的寒冷低语仿佛随时要喷涌而出。这绝非普通的武器，而是一道通往灾害的门扉，饥渴地渴望毁灭。
Roaring out agonizing words, your gestures mimic ripping apart the veil of reality, and a tear peels open. A shimmering blade, crafted from inky shadow and shimmering with raw power, materializes in your hand. The very air around it distorts, a chilling whisper of the void threatening to belch forth. This is no mere weapon, but a gateway to disaster, with a thirst for destruction.

Sprig Of Mistletoe Druidic Focus.name:
槲寄生枝德鲁伊法器
Sprig Of Mistletoe Druidic Focus

Text.text:
这枝槲寄生被人极其小心地从它寄生生长的树上取下，叶片与白色浆果依旧完好无损。正如槲寄生在宿主之上以宁静的共生方式生长，这位德鲁伊也在使用它时体悟到：自己之所以能成长，皆因脚下这片大地的滋养。如此一来，这枝小小的槲寄生能帮助德鲁伊施法者专注于自身技艺，也就不足为奇了。
This branch of mistletoe has been removed with great care from the tree upon which it grew, with its leaves and white berries intact. In the same way that the mistletoe plant grew upon its host in peaceful symbiosis, so does the druid using it recognize their own growth thanks to the earth upon which they tread. Small wonder, then, that this sprig helps a druidic spellcaster focus upon their craft.

Manor's Alien Majordomo.name:
庄园的异族管家
Manor's Alien Majordomo

Text.text:
管家长一身黄玉般的皮肤，目光傲慢，踱步而来；他那只皮手套里塞满了外星科技，灯光脉动起伏。随即他欠身行礼，嘴角仿佛带着一丝笑意，以精准而高效的口吻阐明自己的职责，让你明白：雇主生活的每一项性相都被一丝不苟地贯彻执行——哪怕不得不应付不速之客也是如此。
With topaz skin and a haughty glare, the head butler paces over, his skin glove packed with extraterrestrial tech and pulsing lights. Bowing, he seems to grin as he explains his duties with precision and efficiency, ensuring that you understand that every aspect of his employer's life is meticulously executed, even when having to deal with unexpected guests.

Player Summons A Demon By Name.name:
玩家点名召唤恶魔
Player Summons A Demon By Name

Text.text:
现实鼓胀变形，挤压着你身边那圈盐所提供的微薄庇护。黑色蜡烛忽明忽暗，在悸动的黑暗前只剩一点微光。熏香在近旁燃烧，辛辣刺鼻的恶臭刺得你眼眶发痛——那是你寄望能抵挡不速之客的护符。你颤抖的一只手死死攥着一碗翻涌的热血；另一只高高举起，仪式匕首沾满黏腻的血污。令人作呕的词句从你受尽折磨的喉咙里翻涌而出，说话间吐出一个污秽到极点的名字，仿佛要将你撕裂——你的嘴唇绽开，牙齿崩裂。那本应永远沉在下方的东西，终于撕破帷幕；纯粹的憎恨被赋予血肉。

~ 一位英雄设想

Reality bulges, pressing against the paltry protection offered by the ring of salt about you. Black candles flicker, a tiny light against the throbbing dark. Incense burns nearby, its acrid stench stinging your eyes, a hopeful ward against unwanted intrusion. In one shaking hand, you clutch a bowl of seething blood; the other is raised high, athame slick with gore. Sickening words bubble from your tortured throat, speaking a name so vile, your lips split and teeth crack. That which should remain below finally ruptures the veil, and utter hate is given flesh.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Noble Couple In A Horse And Carriage.name:
乘坐马车的贵族夫妇
Noble Couple In A Horse And Carriage

Text.text:
这匹种马堪称同类中的俊美典范，鬃毛梳理得一丝不苟，拉着同样保养精致的敞篷轻便马车，沿着清扫得干干净净的鹅卵石路稳稳前行。篷顶之下，两名年轻男子相对而坐，和气攀谈；一人几乎包揽了大半话头，另一人则以娴熟的手势控着缰绳，目光牢牢钉在前方道路上。两人身着价昂的西装与大衣，剪裁相得益彰；手工鞣制的骑靴——为这趟小出游特意卸下了马刺——擦得如镜面般锃亮。
A handsome example of its breed, the well-groomed stallion pulls an equally well-kept cabriolet along the swept cobblestone road. Seated beneath the canopy, two young men chat amiably, one holding up the lion’s share of conversation, the other handling the reins with a practiced hand, eyes firmly on the path ahead. Both are dressed in expensive suits and coats that are well complemented in their design, and hand-tooled riding boots—spurs removed for this particular jaunt—polished to a mirror shine.

Autum Willowend, Storybook Bard.name:
秋暮·柳终，童话吟游诗人
Autum Willowend, Storybook Bard

Text.text:
一位年轻的法翁，眼眸如茉莉般清澈、似蜂巢蜜般晶亮，坐在一截古老的树桩顶上，捧着一本旧故事书高声朗读。她挥舞双手，动作野性又灵动；又用五彩缤纷的角色嗓音演绎，引得周围的人全然着迷——他们屏息凝神，紧紧追随她那些奇幻童话的每一个字。
A young faun with eyes like jasmine and honeycomb sits atop an ancient tree stump, reading aloud from an old storybook. Her wild hand movements and colorful character voices captivate those around her—they hang on every word of her fanciful fairy tales.

Empty Spellbook With Clasp.name:
带扣的空白法术书
Empty Spellbook With Clasp

Text.text:
两枚由木料、皮革与黄铜制成的搭扣扣紧着一块同材质的掩蔽，其上雕刻或压印着象征诸元素的符号。锃亮的黄铜包角护住书本的棱角，书页边缘镀着金箔。翻开时，纸页的边缘得一张张轻轻剥开，露出空白无字的表面。整本书散发着清漆、新纸与新胶的气味。
Two clasps of wood, leather, and brass hold closed a cover of the same materials carved or embossed with symbols of the elements. Shiny brass fittings protect the book’s corners and gold gilds the pages. When opened, those pages must be peeled apart at the edges, revealing blank surfaces. The book smells of lacquer, fresh paper, and new glue.

地面在黑暗中消失——一道张口的裂隙将房间一分为二，并一直延伸进墙体，仿佛这里的土地像破裂的蛋壳般骤然裂开。裂口看起来约有二十英尺宽，但它的深度……
The floor vanishes into darkness—a yawning crevasse bisects the chamber and runs into the walls, as if earth here simply split open like a broken egg. The gap looks about twenty feet wide, but its depth…

Surface Of A Desolate Moon.name:
荒寂月面的地表
Surface Of A Desolate Moon

Text.text:
浩瀚的月面荒漠延展至地平线之外，苍白的灰尘与岩砾铺成无边无际的海洋，头顶则是繁星闪烁的星幕。远处，在这贫瘠的月海之间，一抹诱人的微光攫住了你的视线。那会是什么？
The vast lunar desert stretches beyond the horizon, an endless sea of pallid gray dust and rock set against the glittering starscape above. In the distance a tantalizing glimmer catches your eye among the barren moonscape. What could it be?

Bedchamber Of A Manor.name:
庄园寝室
Bedchamber Of A Manor

Text.text:
这间卧室陈设奢华，家具皆以近乎漆黑的深色木材打造，打磨得光可鉴人。衣柜与床头柜做工极其精致，但真正的主角是那张床：一座巨大的四柱大床，厚软得仿佛一头扎进去就再也不想起来——只消在被褥间睡上一夜，便足以抵过风尘仆仆的四十个夜晚。
The rich furnishings of this bedchamber have been constructed in a wood so dark that it is nearly black, polished to a perfect shine. The armoire and bedside table are of very fine quality, but the true centerpiece is the bed itself: an enormous four-poster affair so plush and soft-looking that a single night within its covers would make up for forty nights on the road.

Death Of A Beloved Monarch.name:
挚爱君主之死
Death Of A Beloved Monarch

Text.text:
沉重而碾碎心神的悲恸笼罩王国，噩耗被宣告：君主驾崩。几代人相拥而立，泪水盈眶，低首默哀，在肃穆的静默中屏息。七十年来，君主如磐石般坚定，始终是王国乃至远方不变的存在——而今，他们已离去。在政治与经济动荡的时代，人们聚拢一处，为这份失去同悲同哭，暂且搁下纷争——至少此刻如此。阴翳覆在今日之上，然而希望仍旧不灭：君主的王朝强盛而仁善。参天橡树倒下，取而代之的是一片葱郁新林的崛起。
A deep, crushing grief settles over the kingdom as the news is proclaimed: the monarch has died. Generations hold each other close, eyes welling with tears as heads are bowed and silences observed. For seventy years the monarch had been a stalwart, constant presence in the kingdom and beyond—now they are gone. In a time of political and economic turbulence the people come together to mourn their loss and set aside their disagreements—for now. A pall has been cast over this day, yet hope springs eternal, for the monarch's dynasty is strong and kind. A great oak falls, yet in its place rises a verdant forest.

Human Removes Their Elf Disguise.name:
人类卸下精灵伪装
Human Removes Their Elf Disguise

Text.text:
轻巧而克制地掩上门，独处的瞬间，那人的神色便悄然变了。肩膀微微蜷起，终于允许自己松一口气，脊背那股绷紧的硬度也暂时被驱散。伴着一声叹息，他们穿过房间，步伐里再无方才那般训练有素的笃定。他们用牙齿咬开一瓶劣烈酒的软木塞，狠狠灌下一大口；另一只手探向耳尖上那对尖帽般的饰物，带着不小的畅快与解脱，将它们一把扯下。

~ Envisioned by Davy on Discord

Shutting the door with careful elegance, the figure’s demeanor shifts once they are alone. Their shoulders curl as they allow themselves to relax, the rigidity of their spine finally banished for a time. With a sigh, they walk across the room, their gait devoid of the practiced surety they previously displayed. They uncork a bottle of coarse liquor with their teeth and take a rough swig as their other hand reaches up to the pointed caps atop their ears, tearing them off with no small measure of satisfaction and relief.

~ Envisioned by Davy on Discord

Shimmering Veils: Haunting Presence.name:
微光帷幕：萦魂之影
Shimmering Veils: Haunting Presence

Text.text:
你后颈的汗毛猛然竖起，那股异样的触感掠过双肩，顺着手臂一路滑下，激得皮肤起满鸡皮疙瘩。你感觉到另一个存在。有什么在守夜你。你本能地抖了抖身子，想甩掉这股怪异的感觉——可随即，你听见回荡的笑声。
The hairs at the nape of your neck stand on end, a sensation that slips across your shoulders and down your arms, raising gooseflesh. You sense another presence. Something watches you. You instinctively shake yourself to throw off the queer feeling—but then you hear echoing laughter.

Giant Spider's Lair.name:
巨蛛巢穴
Giant Spider's Lair

Text.text:
在这条恶臭的隧道里，水晶般澄澈却又如船只索具般粗的丝绳自墙到墙、由地至顶纵横交织。较旧的带状丝垂挂着，松软无力，灰蒙蒙地覆着尘埃；而较新的丝线几乎难以察觉地横贯空间，绷得像里拉琴弦一般紧。某种庞大的蛛形怪物必定潜伏在近处，静候有生物在它的网中挣扎。
Cords as clear as crystal but as thick as ship rigging string from wall to wall and floor to ceiling in this noisome tunnel. Older bands dangle, limp and gray with dust, but newer strands stretch almost invisibly across the space, as tight as lyre strings. Some great spidery thing must lurk nearby, waiting for a creature to struggle in its web.

Fake Goggles Of Night.name:
赝品夜视护目镜
Fake Goggles Of Night

Text.text:
你把黄铜护目镜滑到眼前，伸手调紧脑后那条皮革绑带。你透过镜片打量周遭的幽暗，发现近处的物体都染上了一层微绿的色泽。更远处的黑暗依旧难以分辨；这护目镜似乎毫无作用。
You slip the brass goggles over your eyes and adjust the leather strap behind your head. You peer through the lenses into your dark surroundings, finding that nearby objects have taken on a green tinge. The darkness beyond is still indiscernible; the goggles do nothing, it seems.

Absorb Elements Cast By Enemy.name:
被敌人施放的 吸收元素
Absorb Elements Cast By Enemy

Text.text:
当你的猛攻命中之际，一片闪烁的能量场在你的敌人周身绽放！这一击的威势似乎被削弱了，弥散的光辉吞没并吸收了部分冲击。然而，他们双手间仍缠绕着噼啪作响的被俘之力，暗示着即将到来的报复。
A shimmering field of energy blossoms around your foe as your assault lands! The strike seems less impactful, a diffuse glow absorbing some of its force. Yet, a crackle of captured power lingers about their hands, hinting at impending revenge.

Demon Queen Of Fungi's Chamberlain.name:
真菌魔后的大总管
Demon Queen Of Fungi's Chamberlain

Text.text:
一个巨人裹着天鹅绒般的蓝色长袍，这头高大而臃肿的双足生物双臂缩在袍袖里，像沉思的僧侣般伫立。细细的蓝色粉尘悬浮在它周身的空气中。深深的蔚蓝毛兜帽里，折叠的菌褶勾勒出一张模糊的面容，发光的蘑菇菌盖充作眼睛窥视外界。那生物分开粗壮的双臂，用一种污秽的语言低沉轰鸣，发霉的怪物随之喷吐出一团黑色孢子云。
A giant swathed in velvety blue robes, this tall and heavyset bipedal creature stands with arms tucked in sleeves like a monk in contemplation. Fine blue dust hangs in the air around it. A vague visage of folded fungus peers from within a deep hood of azure fur where glowing mushroom caps serve as eyes. The creature separates its stout arms. Rumbling in a vile language, the moldy monster gives off a cloud of black spores.

你的目光一落在那生物身上，便不由自主地被牵引过去，无法抗拒。那身影高挑修长，却结实匀称；肌肤无瑕，苍白如星光，双唇饱满，红得像新鲜的血。乌鸦般漆黑发亮的头发被向后梳拢，抹了油般服帖，整齐地掖在尖尖的耳后。祂举止带着超脱尘世的优雅——每一次雕琢般的眉峰轻挑，每一个修剪得体的手势，每一步谨慎的落足，都是衡量过、带着明确意图的行动。那诱人的唇瓣微微分开，勾出一道恰到好处的歪笑，你瞥见犬齿锋利森然，敏锐得像狼一样。
The moment your eyes fall upon the creature, you cannot help but be drawn to them, inexorably. The figure is tall, lean, but well-built, with flawless skin pale as stars and full lips red as fresh blood. Their shining, raven-black hair is slicked back, oiled and neatly tucked behind pointed ears. They move with an otherworldly grace—each arch of a sculpted brow, each gesture with a manicured hand, each careful step a measured, purposeful action. Those alluring lips part in a perfectly crooked smile, and you spy canines sharp and keen as a wolf’s.

Military Body Armor.name:
军用护甲
Military Body Armor

Text.text:
这才是硬货，是他们专门留给最顶尖那一批人的。尖端凯夫拉与晶体镀层交织成一副胸甲，足以抵御甚至猛烈的枪火。关节处以加固纳米纤维作褶皱处理，让你在弹雨中仍能保持最佳机动。腰间的一个开关轻轻一拨，迷彩纹路便滋滋闪动，在城市、丛林与沙漠之间切换。整套护甲包含胸、臂、腿、靴与头盔的装甲板。
This is the good stuff, the stuff they keep for the best of the best. Cutting-edge Kevlar combined with crystal-plating makes up a breastplate that could weather even heavy arms fire. The joints are pleated with reinforced nanofibers, allowing optimal mobility under fire. A switch on the waist fizzles the pattern from urban to jungle to desert camouflages. The complete armor set includes chest, arm, leg, boots, and helmet plating.

I Cast Meteor Swarm.name:
我施放「流星爆」
I Cast Meteor Swarm

Text.text:
我双掌猛然一拍，火花四溅飞散。手臂向后抽回时，岩浆丝缕自掌心滴落，头顶苍穹随之染成血红。巨大的火球撕裂云层坠下，炽烈高温扼住空气，令人窒息。它们轰然砸向大地，激起岩石与烈焰的飞沫四散迸溅。
I clap my hands together and sparks go flying. As I pull back my arms, strings of magma drip from my palms, and the heavens turn blood-red above me. Huge orbs of fire tear through the clouds, their blazing heat choking the air. They crash to the earth, sending out sprays of rock and flame.

Toymaker Hag.name:
玩具匠鬼婆（特征）
Toymaker Hag

Text.text:
她佝偻着坐在那里，裹在那件褴褛风化的长袍里。兜帽压得很低，遮住面容，干枯的白发从帽沿下垂落。那双从灰色喇叭袖口探出的细长嶙峋的手里，握着一个布偶和一把小刀。她身旁散落着雕刻的翼马、一个抛球入杯的玩具——球上涂着一只眼睛——还有一缕缕编织的草绳、毛皮与带花纹的布条。她把一条棉布裙套在布偶身上，随即将刻刀贴上它的脸。
She sits hunched over, wrapped in her haggard, weathered robe. The cowl is low over her face, and dry white hair hangs down from under its edge. In the long, bony hands that emerge from belled gray sleeves, she holds a doll and a knife. Around her are carved winged horses, a ball and cup with the ball painted like an eye, and lengths of woven grass, fur, and patterned cloth. She fits a cotton skirt onto the doll and takes the carving knife to its face.

Friendly Alien Shopkeeper With Intimidat.name:
外表骇人的友善外星店主
Friendly Alien Shopkeeper With Intimidating Appearance

Text.text:
这位推销员粗砺的皮肤如斑驳大理石般嶙峋，是他母星残酷环境遗留下来的印记。他那双巨大的眼睛燃着宝石红的光，仿佛颅骨里藏着一座微型熔炉；然而纵使外表骇人，他温和的气质依旧透亮。他会热情地迎接踏入店门的客人，并为他们的首次购买提供折扣。
The salesman’s rugged skin resembles dappled marble, a relic of his home world's harsh environment. His immense eyes burn ruby red, as if his skull houses a miniature furnace, but his gentle demeanor shines through despite this fearsome appearance. He offers a warm welcome to folk entering his shop, offering them a discount on their first purchase.

I Cast Faerie Fire From My Ring Of Shoot.name:
我从我的流星射击之戒施放妖火
I Cast Faerie Fire From My Ring Of Shooting Stars

Text.text:
我打了个响指，一团色泽变幻的明亮雾气——蓝、绿、紫——凭空涌现。我戒指上的宝石也泛起同样诡异的混色光泽，我随即驱使那道光直扑我的敌手。它像鹰隼俯冲猎物般冲向我的目标，缠绕上他们的头颅、护甲与肌肤——直至其全身都喷薄出那三色光辉，如火炬般明灭摇曳。
I snap my fingers and a luminous vapor of changing hues—blue, green, purple—appears. My ring’s gem shimmers with that same strange mix of colors as I command the light to rush my foe. It launches toward my target like an eagle descending on prey and wraps about their head, armor, and skin—until their entire body emits that tricolor light that flickers like a torch.

Speech About War’s Cruelty.name:
关于战争残酷性的演说
Speech About War’s Cruelty

Text.text:
“战争的悲剧不只发生在战场上。战争真正的恶毒，潜伏在它所笼罩的世界里：饥饿、弱点、妥协。邪恶从不堂而皇之地现身，它栖居在那些细微的痛楚瞬间里，在那里，善良的人被一点点碾碎。”
“The tragedy of war is not only on the battlefield. War’s true maliciousness lies in the world around it. The starvation, the weakness, the compromise. Evil does not exist out in the open, it lives in those small moments of pain, where good people are broken.”

有些商贩对着在市集里来回穿梭的人群高声吆喝、咄咄逼人；也有些人安安静静，似乎只等客人自己上门。两种手段看起来都颇有效果，大多数摊位前都至少有几位买主正低头端详他们的货品。市集里各色商品应有尽有：食物、衣物、小型牲畜、布匹、工具等等。
Some salespeople holler and hector the crowd milling about the market, while others seem content to allow customers to come to them. Both tactics appear to work well enough, with most stalls having at least a few consumers examining their wares. The market has goods of all sorts: food, clothing, small animals, textiles, tools, and more.

I Drink My Potion Of Healing.name:
我喝下我的治疗药水
I Drink My Potion Of Healing

Text.text:
我把瓶子举到唇边，红色液体在光里闪烁。我仰头灌下一口，伤势带来的疼痛与沉重随之消散，魔法在我体内流转、生效。
The red liquid sparkles as I bring the bottle up to my lips. I take a swig, and the pain and weight of my injuries fade as the magic works through my body.

你哼唱着那段轻快起伏的咒语，旋律正是曾经在你脑海里挥之不去的那首歌。你感觉这道魅惑从你身上伸出触须，牵连上目标，把那段曲调硬生生塞进他们的意识。你的敌人歪着头，追寻那首无人能听见的歌声源头，随即浑身一颤——魔法的力量正试图夺取他们的控制。
You chant the lilting incantation to the tune of a song you once got stuck in your head. You feel the enchantment reach out from you and connect with the target, inflicting that tune on their mind. Your foe’s head tilts, seeking the source of the song no one else can hear, then a shudder passes through your enemy as the power of the magic tries to take control.

这柄细剑的剑身被反复打磨、开刃了无数次，往昔决斗留下的细痕，正是它年代的确凿刻度。护手与横挡黯淡无光、未经抛磨，与那些更为华丽耀眼的同类相比，它显得像是个拙劣的选择。然而再细看一眼，剑脊上沿着刃线刻着一个名字——那是史上最伟大决斗剑匠的潦草签名。即便是他们手艺中这样朴素的一件，也必然蕴着非凡的品质。
The blade of the rapier has been sharpened countless times, the marks of past duels a sure measure of its age. Its hilt and quillons are dull and unpolished, making the rapier appear a poor choice when compared to its flashier fellows. Yet closer examination reveals a single name inscribed along the rib of the blade: the scrawl of history’s greatest creator of dueling blades. Surely even this plain example of their art must carry with it great quality.

Monk's Speech Of Self-affirmation.name:
武僧的自我肯定之语
Monk's Speech Of Self-affirmation

Text.text:
“每一场战斗都是一次考验，每一个对手都是一道谜题。若让自己被当下的暴烈裹挟，你便已经输了。怜惜你的敌人，引他们走向败局——唯有当他们自取其果，才唤起那紧握的铁拳。你是霹雳一闪，而非狂风骤雨的风暴。”
“Every fight is a test and every opponent a puzzle. If you let yourself be swept up in the violence of the moment, you have already lost. Care for your enemy, guide them to their defeat—only invoke the closed fist when they have earned it. You are the lightning bolt, not the storm.”

God Of Necromancy.name:
死灵之神
God Of Necromancy

Text.text: 生命——不，不死——对死灵术之神而言，满是奇观与试炼。他不统御疆土，只掌控潜藏于大地褶皱里的秘境，或立于其上的祭坛。他既违逆也敬奉生命与死亡的神祇，因此披黑色裹尸布，戴白色面具，手持一根十英尺长的乌木杖，杖端嵌着一颗珍珠宝珠。他的手腕上闪烁着苍白的金属与骨制手环，手指上则戴着既圣洁又地狱般的戒指。他是平衡之神，生命与死亡不过是他天平上两端的重量。 Life—no, unlife—is full of wonder and challenge for the God of Necromancy. He rules no land, only pockets secreted within it or shrines upon it. He defies and honors the gods of both life and death, and so he wears both black shroud and white mask, carries a ten-foot staff of ebony with a pearl orb on the end. His wrists glitter with pale bracelets of metal and bones, and his fingers are adorned with rings both holy and infernal. He is a god of balance, and life and death are but forms of weight on his scales.

那身影比大多数人类高出整整一个头肩，巍然耸立，身躯宽阔而肌肉虬结。每一次移动都透出压迫般的力量。他们的皮肤几乎如岩石般坚硬，粗粝灰暗，仿佛被矿物纹理天然镶嵌成大理石般的斑驳。带着符文意义的刺青沿着四肢铺展，点缀在胸膛上，蜿蜒攀上颈侧。
The figure stands heads-and-shoulders above most humans, their towering frame broad and well-muscled. They exude strength with every movement. Their skin appears almost stone-like, rough and gray and seemingly marbled with minerals. Tattoos of some runic significance line their limbs and adorn their chest, snaking up their neck.

一卷皮革工具包用环扣固定着各式工具，旁边还有装着肠线与边角料的皮囊。内含木与生皮制成的小木槌、直刃刀、圆刃刀、木制压边抛光器、剪刀、多种针具，以及一块小砧板。
A leather wrap holds a variety of tools in loops, along with pouches for gut string and scraps. The implements include a small mallet made of wood and hide, a straight knife, a round knife, a wooden edge slicker, scissors, various needles, and a small cutting board.

I Activate My Ioun Stone Of Strength.name:
我激活力量艾欧石。
I Activate My Ioun Stone Of Strength

Text.text:
此刻正需一股蛮力，我将那枚淡蓝色的菱形体——像一颗棱角分明的小行星——抛起，让它绕着我的头颅入轨旋转。它一圈圈掠过，便一寸寸喂养着我。肌肉被唤醒，血脉发烫，呼吸更深更沉；我强烈地渴望举起重物、把东西掷得更远、打得更狠。眼中的世界似乎也比先前脆弱了些，更容易在我掌心被掰弯、被塑形。
Now in need of physical might, I toss the pale blue rhomboid, like a jagged little planet, into orbit around my head. As it circles, it feeds me. My muscles invigorate, my breath deepens, and I have the strong urge to lift something heavy, to throw farther, hit harder. I see the world as just a bit more brittle to me, more easily shaped by my hand.

Earth Elemental: City Battle.name:
土元素：城市战斗
Earth Elemental: City Battle

Text.text:
与这头巨兽交战，宛如在与一座移动的山岳对抗。它岩石般的身躯上刺满了周遭城镇的残骸碎片。砖块与鹅卵石在它体表奔涌流转，像游鱼般掠过拱心石与断裂的柱身碎片。你甚至瞥见一整块磨盘，圆得完美，仿佛随时要碾碎一切。
Fighting this beast feels like battling a moving mountain. Its rocky body bristles with broken bits of the surrounding city. Bricks and cobbles course across its form, swimming over keystones and cracked pieces of pillars. You even spot a whole millstone, perfectly round and ready to grind.

Quip About Returning Home.name:
关于回家的一句俏皮话
Quip About Returning Home

Text.text:
“回到这里总是很怪。每一条被遗忘的小巷与窄道里，都藏着一小团青春的记忆。仿佛空气中弥漫着某种细微的魔法。我在想，如果有足够多的人对一个地方怀着同样的感觉，过去会不会有一天真的归来？”
“It’s always strange coming back here. Each little forgotten alley and laneway holds pockets of youthful memory. It’s as if there’s some subtle magic in the air. I wonder, if enough people feel this way about a place, would the past return one day?”

I Use Dragon Wings.name:
我展开龙翼
I Use Dragon Wings

Text.text:
我仰天咆哮。双眼与心口迸射出元素能量的辉光。刹那间，那股能量翻涌旋转，噼啪作响，凝成一对皮革般的翼膜，牢牢连在我上背。我振动新生的双翼，它们托举着我腾空而起。
I roar. My eyes and heart flash with elemental energy. In an instant the energy swirls forth, crackling, to take the shape of leathery wings attached to my upper back. I flap my new wings and they carry me aloft.

A Hedonist’s Camaraderie.name:
纵情者的同欢
A Hedonist’s Camaraderie

Text.text:
“我觉得我们都变得如此亲近。若不是社会那套清教徒式的忌讳束缚着我，我真想与诸位一一缠绵，温柔而贪婪地相爱……当然，我是打比方。”
“I feel like we’ve all grown so close. Were it not for society’s puritan hang-ups I would make tender ravenous love with each of you… Metaphorically, I mean.”

I Parry A Strike Using My Two-handed Wea.name:
我用我的双手武器格挡一次打击
I Parry A Strike Using My Two-handed Weapon

Text.text:
我双脚牢牢钉在地上，双臂绷紧，以我之击迎向来袭，正面硬撼。这几乎只是一次朴素的格挡——一柄沉重武器的蛮力在半空中与袭击者迎头相撞。随即传来一声震耳的撞击，又紧跟着别的声响——一阵滑擦，像硬地被猛然一扫，而后武器不再僵持于正中。道路豁然清明。
With my feet planted firmly and my arms flexed, I meet the strike with my own, head on. It’s almost a simple block, the brute force of a big weapon meeting its assailant in the air. There is a resounding strike, followed by something else—a sliding, like the sweep of a hard floor, and then the weapons are no longer at center. The way is clear.

My Shield +3 Deflects A Blade.name:
我的盾牌+3格挡住一记刀刃
My Shield +3 Deflects A Blade

Text.text:
古老的盾牌仿佛成了我身体的延伸，几近无重；我轻松一格，便将刀刃偏开。我在致命的舞步中游走——那件精工锻造的遗器作我舞伴——我们一同蓄势，准备架开下一记斩击。
The ancient shield feels like an extension of my body, almost weightless, as I effortlessly deflect the blade. I move in a deadly dance—the exquisitely crafted artifact as my partner—as we prepare to parry the next strike.

Steel Buckle For A Narrow Belt.name:
窄腰带用钢扣
Steel Buckle For A Narrow Belt

Text.text:
与其说是搭扣，不如说更像一枚扣环：这枚双钩可旋转扣合，专为穿过特制打孔腰带两端的金属扣眼而制。
More of a clasp than a buckle, this double hook turns shut and is made to loop through a grommet at each end of a specially punched belt.

你引动与风与风暴诸灵的羁绊，双手高举，向它们恳求援助。空气骤然转冷，风势陡增。压迫感层层堆叠，你的骨骼随之震颤。你咬紧牙关，猛然合拢双掌，挺身迎接即将降临的一切。
Channeling a bond with the elements of wind and storm, you raise your hands, beseeching their aid. The air grows chill and the wind picks up. Pressure builds as your bones vibrate. Teeth clenched, you slam your palms together, bracing yourself for what is to come.

Articulated Arm Enhancement.name:
关节式机械臂强化
Articulated Arm Enhancement

Text.text:
宛如一台固定在人类躯干上的微型起重机，这条手臂增幅装置令人过目难忘。它以工业风的冷峻美学打造，分节可动的肢体与主人厚重、粗犷的装束相得益彰——显然是刻意为之。无论外观如何，这增幅装置依旧是一件危险的装备，只需稍费力气便能化作残暴的武器。
Like a miniature crane affixed to a human torso, the arm enhancement is a sight to behold. Styled industrial chic, the articulated appendage complements the heavy, rugged attire of its owner perfectly—certainly a deliberate choice. No matter the aesthetic, the enhancement is still a dangerous piece of kit and could be turned into a brutal weapon with little effort.

运河以抹灰砌合的石块加固，并由铁闸分隔；铁闸开启时放船入内，随即又重新合拢。渠水澄澈洁净，游弋其间的鱼群来去自如，随心出入。
The canals are reinforced with mortared stone and divided by iron gates that open to allow boats in, then close again. The water of the canal is clear and clean, and the fish populating the waterways come and go as they please.

Lesson From Mentor In Trapping.name:
来自导师的设陷课
Lesson From Mentor In Trapping

Text.text: “慢就是稳。稳才安全。你不是乱绊触发的毛头小子，你是个设陷的猎人。先把它撑稳，卡死踏板，然后再试试绊线。看在死神的份上，你又不是在弹竖琴！现在，从二号阴影位，绊动触发。我知道我刚说了什么！给我把那该死的触发绊了！等等。停。要是你得为命跳开，就往那边。” “Slow is steady. Steady is safe. You aren’t a trigger tripper, you’re a trapper. Prop it, lock the foot, and then test the line. For the love of death, you aren’t playing a harp! Now, from shadow position two, trip the trigger. I know what I said! Trip the confounded trigger! Wait. Stop. Should you need to jump for your life, go that way.”

你凝视着你的目标时，双眼闪过猩红光芒。对方以涣散的目光回望，松弛的面容凝成一抹不自然的笑。就在他们的声音攀升到那种仿佛挚爱因你到访而惊喜、温热而兴奋的音调之际，整个身体却像被放了气般缓缓塌陷。
Your eyes flash with carmine light as you gaze at your target. They stare back with unfocused eyes, their slack face fixed with an unnatural smile. Their entire body seems to deflate even as their voice rises to the warm excited pitch you’d expect from a loved one surprised by your visit.

Subterranean Portal To The Cosmos.name:
通往宇宙的地下传送门
Subterranean Portal To The Cosmos

Text.text:
当你从旋涡般的传送门中踉跄踏出时，胃里一阵翻涌——你身处一座巨大的洞窟之中，但这绝非寻常岩穴。岩壁上凿出的巨大窗洞直面一片无尽的星海，星光闪烁，明亮得前所未见；而在你面前——以令人窒息的宏伟尺度——便是那颗世界。一个不可思议的巨大彩绘球体被某种不可知的力量悬挂在宇宙穹幕之中，占满你的视野；你试图理解眼前的一切，思绪却随之天旋地转。

~ Envisioned by master_builder75 on Discord

Your stomach lurches as you emerge from the swirling portal in a large cavern—but this is no ordinary cave. Huge windows carved in the rock look out on an endless ocean of stars, twinkling brighter than you have ever seen them; and before you—in staggering magnitude—is the world. An impossibly vast painted sphere suspended in the cosmic firmament by unknowable forces fills your vision, and your mind reels as you try to make sense of your surroundings.

~ Envisioned by master_builder75 on Discord

Jail Cell With Corpse.name:
带尸囚室
Jail Cell With Corpse

Text.text:
你推开门，一股血腥与粪秽的恶臭扑面而来，嗡嗡作响的苍蝇从这间阴湿可憎的密室里惊飞而出。墙上布满被血污拖曳的抓痕，仿佛在诉说着曾经疯狂的逃命挣扎。除去远墙上垂挂的镣铐与束缚，这里只剩一样东西：一具几近赤裸的男尸，蛆虫在其上蠕动成群。
Flies buzz out of this wretched and dank chamber as you open the door to the odor of blood and excrement. Gore-streaked scratches in the walls bear witness to what must have been mad attempts to escape. Besides the restraints dangling from the far wall, this room holds only one thing: the maggot-ridden corpse of a nearly naked man.

你的舌头在这道法术拗口的咒词上打了结，险些念岔。你想起当初学它有多艰难——每次把它唤上心头，那股异样的陌生感都挥之不去。这法术仿佛抗拒被理解，像是在为它赐予你的语言掌控权维系某种宇宙的平衡。
Your tongue trips over the tricky words of this spell, nearly fouling it, and you recall how difficult it was to learn, and how foreign it feels when you bring it to mind. The spell resists comprehension, as if creating some cosmic balance for the command over languages that it grants you.

Carbon Gauntlet Deflects Blade.name:
碳钢臂铠偏转利刃
Carbon Gauntlet Deflects Blade

Text.text:
漆黑的铁刃挟着无情的蛮力劈落，直取自肩至胯，一刀分裂。对手发出不屈的怒吼，于千钧一发之际以碳钢护手格挡，硬生生将刀势偏开，震得锋芒掠向一旁。
The dark iron blade swings down with unforgiving force, its aim to cleave from shoulder to groin. With a defiant yell, the blade is blocked by the opponent’s carbon gauntlet at the last moment, deflecting it away.

热意自你胸膛深处燃起，绽放开来，向外蔓延，直至指尖。你打了个响指，火星纷飞间，一簇火焰在你掌心跃然成形，悬浮在皮肤上方仅一寸之处。
The heat begins in your chest, blossoming and spreading outward, extending to the tips of your fingers. You snap your fingers, and with a flurry of sparks, a flame springs to life in the palm of your hand, hovering a mere inch above your skin.

Magic-nullifying Toxin, Void Burst.name:
消魔毒素，虚空爆裂
Magic-nullifying Toxin, Void Burst

Text.text:
封存在一枚球形玻璃之中，这团黯黑的物质宛如星云，闪烁着遥远群星的微光。然而一旦施用，虚空爆裂便会喷吐出阴森的嘶鸣，将附近一切魔法的声响力量尽数淹没。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Cased within a spherical glass, this dark mass resembles a nebula, shimmering with the light of distant stars. Yet, at its application, the void burst emits a sinister hiss, drowning out the sounded power of all nearby magic.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Sundries From An Ice Mephit.name:
来自冰雪魔精的杂物
Sundries From An Ice Mephit

Text.text:
你凑近细看这生物的手脚，发现这只小魅魔的十二枚利爪竟是细小而锋锐的冰片，即便死去也依旧不融。
You take a closer look at the creature’s hands and feet and notice that the mephit’s twelve claws are tiny pieces of sharp ice that do not melt even after its death.

[感知] 两匹死马横卧在路中央，道路两侧树荫投下的阴影也难以遏止它们的腐败。苍蝇嗡嗡作响，在尸体周围盘旋，显然是被尸身散发出的腐臭所吸引。

[发现] 你透过道路两侧的枝叶窥探，勉强辨出其中藏着四道清晰的影子——比人类或精灵矮小得多——正潜伏其内。

[触发] 你被腐烂马肉的恶臭与苍蝇低沉的嗡鸣分了神，直到四个地精扑到眼前，才惊觉这是一场伏击！

~ 由一位英雄 构想

[Perceived] Two dead horses lie in the road, the shade from the trees on either side doing little to slow their decay. Flies buzz loudly as they fly around, obviously attracted by the stink of rot emanating from the carcasses.

[Discovered] Peering through the foliage on either side of the road, you can just make out four distinct shadows—significantly shorter than humans or elves—concealed within.

[Triggered] Distracted by the stench of rotting horse meat and the droning of the buzzing flies, you are unaware of the ambush until the four goblins are upon you!

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Border Town Ferry.name:
边境镇渡口
Border Town Ferry

Text.text:
新近融雪的清冽水流让河道焕发了生气，湍急翻涌的激流根本无法徒步涉渡。上游那座桥似乎早在不久前就塌了，如今取而代之的是一艘看起来结实牢靠的渡船。渡船系在这边河岸，三名高大的兽人倚着栏杆，渡板旁则站着一位衣着体面的半身人女子，正与一名赶骡人说话。那位满脸风霜的商人摇了摇头，递给半身人一把钱币，随后牵着驮载沉重货物的牲口登上船只。女子把每枚钱币依次咬过一口，才收进腰间的钱袋。她双手拢在嘴边，高声喊道：“我们马上要走了！想过河就快点！”
The fresh meltwater has invigorated the river, and its fast-flowing tumult is impossible to ford. A bridge upriver seems to have collapsed some time ago, replaced by a sturdy-looking ferry. It is moored to this side of the river, three large orcs leaning on the rail, and a well-dressed halfling woman beside the ferry's ramp speaking with a muleskinner. The grizzled merchant shakes his head, passes the halfling a handful of coins, then leads his heavily laden beasts onto the vessel. The woman bites each coin in turn before placing them into a pouch. She cups her hands around her mouth and shouts: “We are about to leave! Hurry up if you want to cross!”

I Draw A Card At Random From My Deck Of.name:
我从幻象牌组中随手抽出一张牌
I Draw A Card At Random From My Deck Of Illusions

Text.text:
我将羊皮纸牌一张张洗动，沙沙作响，小心翼翼不让自己在抽牌前偷瞥。它们在接触时竟出奇地温热，仿佛才被人握过；牌堆里还飘出一缕怪异的香气——像夜风里残留的香水。 我阖上双眼，抽出一张牌，随即睁眼凝视抽出的结果。
The parchment cards rustle as I shuffle them, taking care not to look before I draw one. They feel oddly warm to the touch, as if recently held, and a peculiar scent drifts from the deck—like perfume on the night breeze. Closing my eyes, I draw a card and look upon the result.

跪伏的申请者沿着法庭的回廊排成一列，骑士们开始仪式时，人人垂首，以无声的敬畏俯身静候。馥郁的空气里悬着期待，如春日花开般轻颤；骑士们依次审视每一位怀抱希冀的侍从学徒，击碎了不止几人的梦想。候选者一个接一个，在宫廷众人衡量的目光下受审——那目光如正午烈日般灼人，沉沉压在他们身上。

~ Inbal 于 Discord

The kneeling applicants line the galleries of the court, each head bowed in silent reverence as the knights begin the ceremony. Anticipation hangs in the fragrant air like spring blossoms as the knights assess each hopeful squire in turn, shattering the dreams of more than a few. One by one, the aspirants are judged by the courtiers' appraising eyes as they bear down upon them with the intensity of a midday sun.

~ Inbal on Discord

他苍白而遍布疤痕的皮肤在银色月华下泛着冷亮。他身形高挑，短发如另一轮月般淡色，双眼呈黄澄澄的猫瞳。一道爪痕状的伤疤自左颊划至下巴，横过唇线。他迅捷而强健，时刻警惕那些潜入物质位面的恶魔——也是他所追猎的猎物。一件斗篷披在明显修补过的半身板甲上，胸前还点缀着猫形护身符；他手持一把镀银长剑，沾血的手掌抹过剑刃后，锋芒便随即燃起。

~ Played by Vmaster1995 with

His pale, scarred skin shows bright under a silver sheen of moonlight. He is tall, with short hair colored like another moon, and yellow catlike eyes. One scar in the shape of a claw runs from left cheek to chin, crossing his lips. He is quick and strong, alert to the demons that slip into the material plane—the demons he hunts. A cloak is draped over obviously repaired half plate and decorated with a cat-shaped amulet, and he is armed with a silvered longsword that ignites after he runs a blood-slicked hand over the blade.

~ Played by Vmaster1995 with

一股原始的爆裂声浪自你伸出的手中轰然迸发，冲击波以震耳欲聋的力量撕裂空气，将物体掀飞，并狠狠撞向任何不幸身处咒语效果区域内的生物。
An explosion of raw sound blasts from your extended hand, the shockwave rippling through the air with a concussive force that hurls objects and smashes into any unlucky creatures within the incantation’s area of effect.

Temple To The Midnight Lord.name:
午夜君主神殿
Temple To The Midnight Lord

Text.text:
这座神殿墙上的涂料让它们看起来仿佛正在渗血。带刺的铁链自天花板垂落，沉重的木梁交叉成X形，悬挂在湿亮的猩红墙面前；黑檀漆面的座椅则半圆形排开。装饰冷硬而压迫，令人胆寒，几近恐怖。神殿尽头矗立着一尊三十五英尺高的“午夜之主”雕像，衣袍雕琢精细，阴影般俯临下方那具充作祭坛的石棺。

~ Envisioned by ​Mondorae James

The paint on the walls of this temple makes them look as though they are bleeding. Spiked chains hang down from the ceiling, heavy timbers in X shapes hang from the glistening crimson walls, and seats of ebony lacquer are arranged in semicircles. The décor is starkly intimidating, almost terrifying. At the back of the temple stands a thirty-five-foot statue of the Midnight Lord, finely robed and looming over a stone sarcophagus that serves as an altar.

~ Envisioned by ​Mondorae James

Cuirass Bodice With Stiletto.name:
带细高跟短匕的胸甲束身衣
Cuirass Bodice With Stiletto

Text.text:
紧身胸衣是粉与黑相间的，背后没有系带，却依旧贴合得紧。替她扣扣子的女人吐出一口气，按着带钢骨的衣片往里收束，接着一路扣过二十颗珍珠纽扣，直到尽头的贴领。背部向下延展成一种宽阔的尾摆，硬挺的锦缎袖子一直覆到她的手腕。她在镜前把两只袖子各自往下拽直，随后把一柄细高跟匕首顺着胸口间那道隐蔽的中缝塞了进去。
The bodice is pink and black, with no back laces but snug all the same. The woman buttoning it breathes out and pushes in on the wired panels, then works her way through twenty pearl buttons that end at a tab collar. The back reaches down in a kind of wide tail, and stiff brocade sleeves reach to her wrists. She tugs them each down straight before the mirror, then slips a stiletto down into the hidden center panel between her breasts.

Forest Birds: Crows.name:
森林鸟类：乌鸦
Forest Birds: Crows

Text.text:
一阵刺骨的冷风穿过林地，掀乱了高枝上肥硕乌鸦的羽毛；它们呱呱聒叫。鸦群盯着你们，彼此呼唤着，但偶尔也有一只轻蔑地俯视下来，像是在斥责你们擅闯这片森林。
A chill wind blows through the wood, ruffling the feathers of fat-bodied crows cawing from the high branches. The corvids watch you, calling out to each other, but occasionally one gazes scornfully down to scold you for your trespass in the forest.

Undead Horde In The Forest.name:
森林中的不死尸潮
Undead Horde In The Forest

Text.text:
蹒跚的不死者穿行于灌木丛间。异世般的哀嚎充斥空气，它们嗅寻着唾手可得的猎物，任何风吹草动或近旁一瞬的人形身影，都会引得它们蜂拥而至。它们或独行，或成对游荡，散布在整片林地，将腥臭的腐朽一路蔓延。
The shambling dead move through the underbrush. Otherworldly moans fill the air as they sniff for easy prey, surging toward any sound or fleeting glimpse of humanoids nearby. They move alone or in pairs, spreading throughout the forest and spreading their reeking rot.

I Become A Starry Form.name:
我化作星辉之形
I Become A Starry Form

Text.text:
我感到一股宇宙之力猛然涌上心头，光芒自我体内开始逸散，夜空的色彩在我周身翻涌旋转。细小的星辉微粒浮现，像披上一条群星织就的毯子般将我覆盖。发光的线条从一颗星拖曳至下一颗，连缀成一幅星座。
I feel a rush of cosmic power as light begins to emanate from me, the colors of the night sky swirling around my form. Small motes of starlight appear and cover me like a blanket of stars. Glowing lines trail from one star to the next, forming a constellation.

人们搬到偏远之地生活的理由千奇百怪，但你实在想不出，除了想被世人遗忘之外，还有什么原因会让人甘愿栖身在这座寒酸的前哨。那些摇摇欲坠的建筑四周连一道围墙都没有。也许根本不需要防护，又或许这里贫瘠到连掠夺者都懒得下手。
People end up living in remote places for all kinds of reasons, but you can’t see why you’d want to reside in this meager outpost unless it’s to be forgotten. There’s no wall guarding the ramshackle structures. Perhaps there’s no need of protection, or maybe there’s nothing worth taking.

Quip About A Quiet Place.name:
关于《寂静之地》的俏皮话
Quip About A Quiet Place

Text.text:
“这里安静得可怕，仿佛万物都在屏住呼吸。我们得提高警惕。”
“It’s so quiet here, as though everything is holding its breath. We should be on our guard.”

Quip By An Academic About A Barbarian.name:
一位学院派学者对野蛮人的俏皮话
Quip By An Academic About A Barbarian

Text.text:
“你知道，求知是一场马拉松，不是短跑。你不必永远这么迟钝；只要你愿意，随时都可以拿起一本书，沉浸在学习里。也许你要是别再把脑袋当攻城锤使，这段旅程还能短一点。”
“You know, the pursuit of knowledge is a marathon, not a sprint. You don’t have to be this dim forever; you could pick up a book and immerse yourself in learning anytime you like. Maybe if you stopped using your head as a battering ram, the journey would be a bit shorter.”

这把椅子虽被深色木蜡细细浸染，雕着精美的坠落叶纹，却像是尚未完工。它既无椅腿也无轮子，只能歪斜着倚向一侧，狼狈地趴在地上。你俯身查看座面下方，见到一个如同陀螺的圆顶，表面刻着旋涡般的纹路。

一阵柔和的风掠过你，朝椅子缓缓游去。地上的尘埃被卷起，为那无形之风勾勒出轮廓。你看着气流绕着椅下的圆顶盘旋，竟将它从地面托起。椅子随之旋转着向上升腾，直到升至正好能让你舒适落座的高度。它就那样悬在半空，伴着魔法之风轻轻弹跳、微微起伏。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

This chair, though richly stained and decorated with beautiful carvings of falling leaves, seems unfinished. Completely bereft of legs or wheels, the chair leans awkwardly to one side as it sits on the ground. Examining underneath the seat, you see a dome much like a spinning top, textured with a swirl etching. You feel a gentle gust of wind play past you and move toward the chair. Dust picks up from the floor, giving the wind shape. You watch as the air curls around the dome under the chair, lifting it off the ground. The chair spins upward until it reaches a height that could accommodate you taking a comfortable seat. It sits, suspended, lightly bouncing with the magical wind.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Loot From A Treant.name:
来自树人的战利品
Loot From A Treant

Text.text: 在树人的一处空洞里，你发现了一堆用丝巾包裹的供品：一壶红酒、一个苹果，以及一袋装着130枚金币的钱袋，旁边还有一张字条，上面写着我们感恩森林的丰饶赐予。 In a hollow on the treant, you find a collection of offerings wrapped in a silk scarf: a flask of red wine, an apple, and a pouch of 130 gold pieces with a note that reads We give thanks for the bounty of the forest.

Kelsier The Bard.name:
吟游诗人凯尔希尔
Kelsier The Bard

Text.text:
一双纯金之眸闪烁着异界般的力量。这名提夫林的铜红色皮肤在光线下流转出诱人而令人沉醉的光泽，轻易绽开的笑意间露出尖锐的獠牙，几近兽性的锋利。龙裔般的双翼收拢贴在他背后，鳞片沿着颈项、肩头与背脊隆起，呈现与他眼眸同样的金属金色。背上斜负一把雕饰华美的鲁特琴，腰间随意悬着一柄价值不菲的金色长剑。尽管他举止与衣着都带着王侯般的矜贵与傲慢，这提夫林却以热情而暧昧的姿态自处，几乎带着危险的魅力引人回首，攫住目光。

~ 由 Bergy 扮演 Played

Eyes of pure gold gleam with an otherworldly power. This tiefling’s copper-red skin catches the light in an alluring, intoxicating fashion, and the smile that comes all too easily reveals pointed, almost bestial-looking fangs. Draconic wings sit tucked against his back, with scales cresting his neck, shoulders, and back in the same metallic shade of gold as his eyes. Across his back, he carries an ornate-looking lute, and a golden longsword of substantial worth hangs casually at his belt. Despite his regal, pompous bearing and garb, the tiefling carries himself with a welcoming, flirtatious air, turning heads and drawing eyes with an almost dangerous charm.

~ Played by Bergy

Chest And Weapons.name:
箱柜与武器
Chest And Weapons

Text.text:
帐篷之间的阴影里闪过一道寒光，映着火光微微一晃。一只铁箍木箱带着沉重的挂锁，摆在圆圈中最大那顶帐篷旁。再往外些，几把长剑搁在一只木桶上，几杆长矛立在武器架里。那些武器看起来不易触及，而箱子也并未刻意藏匿。扎营在此的人想必并不担心有什么威胁。
A glint from the shadows between the tents, reflected firelight. An iron-bound chest of wood with a heavy padlock sits next to the largest tent in the circle. Beyond it some swords lie upon a barrel and a few spears stand in a rack. The weapons don’t seem easy to reach, nor is the chest hidden. Those who camp here must not expect a threat.

Handsomely Devilish Tiefling.name:
俊美而邪魅的提夫林
Handsomely Devilish Tiefling

Text.text:
提夫林带着令人难以忍受的魅力与狡黠深深一鞠躬，举手投足间仿佛自带不言而喻的贵胄气息。他那身量身剪裁的衣装裁制精妙，散发出蛊惑人心的自信光晕，叫人很难抗拒。打磨得锃亮的幽暗犄角向后掠过精心打理的黑发，一抹邪气的笑意从绯红的唇间绽开，露出獠牙的一线寒光。说得再直白不过——他真就是个英俊的恶魔。

~ Sahlonahl 于 Discord

With insufferable charm and guile, the tiefling bows low with an air of implied nobility. The cut of their tailored clothing is exquisite and exudes an aura of beguiling confidence that many would struggle to resist. Polished umbral horns sweep back over meticulously styled black hair, and a wicked smile parts their crimson lips, revealing a hint of the fangs beyond. They are quite literally a handsome devil.

~ Sahlonahl on Discord

Temple To A God Of The Wind.name:
风之神殿
Temple To A God Of The Wind

Text.text:
这些罕见神殿的峻峭建筑，将材料——木、石，以及金属的浮雕饰带或护墙板——凝为一体，只为引导那转瞬即逝的气流。外墙由雕刻石材砌成：数十颗刻出的头颅在长颈上蜿蜒盘绕，穿行于云层与风的流线之间，仿佛长着面孔的九头蛇，披着四位风神的面容。在这座神殿里，东方的欧洛斯最为庞大，赤褐叶冠加身，双颊鼓起，向入口吹拂出一股清凉的风流。
The daunting architecture of these rare temples combines materials—wood, stone, and friezes or wainscots of metal—inn the shared purpose of channeling ephemeral air. The outside walls are sculpted stone, dozens of carved heads winding about on long necks amidst clouds and wind currents, like hydras with faces of the four wind gods. At this particular temple, the russet leaf-crowned Eurus of the East is the largest head, cheeks puffed, blowing a cool stream of wind over the entrance.

营地的这间库室里堆着成批的给养，还摆着几只用铁链拴住并上锁的木桶与木箱。容器的数量暗示他们要么在此久驻，要么刚把新近掠来的战利品搬进营地。库室所处的位置表明，这里的住民宁愿把营地最受庇护的区域留给财物，而不是留给他们的帐篷。
This chamber of the camp contains stocks of provisions, as well as a few barrels and crates that are chained and locked. The number of containers would indicate a long stay or recent plunder carried into the camp. The chamber’s position suggests that the residents chose the most protected area for their possessions rather than for their tents.

Plain Brass Brooch.name:
素黄铜胸针
Plain Brass Brooch

Text.text:
店主在不同颜色的羊毛样布上摆着几枚黄铜胸针。织成钴蓝底纹的那一枚在这一堆里最朴素，却因色彩的搭配而显得格外硬朗。黄铜映着蓝色，既像战场征伐，也像宫廷露面。它的张扬恰到好处，庄重而体面——虽财富有限，却自有高贵的尊严。
The shopkeeper has several brass brooches laid out on different colored wool swatches. The one on the field of woven cobalt is the plainest of the lot, but made strong by the combination of colors. The brass against the blue speaks of both campaigns and court appearances. It's a statement with just enough flash, of high dignity if limited wealth.

Cone Of Cold Resisted By Player.name:
玩家抵抗冰锥术
Cone Of Cold Resisted By Player

Text.text:
你努力不去想那些人被冻成冰雕的传闻——他们生命的最后一刻，都是在刺骨的寒冷里一点点冻结而死。你把注意力转向自己胸腔深处的火焰，正当那股巨大的极寒气锥痛苦地撞上你。你在冲击中颤抖，感觉衣物与道具迅速变硬，耳边尽是噼啪作响的裂裂脆声。随着寒气锥渐渐收束消退，你开始回暖，从那场冰封般的突袭中飞快解冻。
You try not to think about the stories of people dying as ice sculptures, their last moments spent freezing to death. You focus instead on your own inner fire as the giant cone of frigid air hits you painfully. You shake against the blast, feeling the hardening of your clothes and gear and hearing it all crackle. As the cone tapers off, you begin to warm, thawing quickly from the frozen onslaught.

那生物蹲在盘结扭曲的树枝上，阴森地咯咯低笑，守夜般盯着你；它凹陷的眼窝在林中幽暗里只剩两点针尖般的黄光。一件破烂的拼缝斗篷罩住它的头与肩，修长的身躯轻盈而紧绷，筋络分明的四肢从中伸出，松松垂在空中。两把弧度阴毒的弯刀挂在它腰间磨损的腰带上，你还瞥见它裸露的些许皮肤上覆着一层柔和发光的纹身。
The creature watches you from the gnarled tree-branch it is perched upon as it chuckles menacingly; its sunken eyes are no more than pinpricks of yellow light in the gloom of the forest. A ragged patchwork cloak covers its head and shoulders, and sinewy limbs extend from a lithe body to dangle loosely in the air. Wickedly curved scimitars hang from the fraying belt around the creature’s waist, and you catch sight of softly glowing tattoos covering what little skin you can see.

Headstone: “Marked” In Winter.name:
墓碑：“冬日的烙印”
Headstone: “Marked” In Winter

Text.text: 风势的某种诡谲流转将这座坟前的积雪吹散了些许，露出其下堆叠石块的嶙峋轮廓。墓碑上刻着不祥的铭文：凡胆敢插手惊扰此墓者，皆将被厄运标记。 Some trick of the wind’s flow has blown some of the snow off the mound before this grave, revealing the lumpy shapes of piled stones. The gravestone bears the ominous inscription: Marked for doom shall be any who have a hand in disturbing this grave.

Search-and-rescue Helicopter.name:
搜索与救援直升机
Search-and-rescue Helicopter

Text.text:
直升机静静停在停机坪上，红色机身覆满雨珠。外壳覆着纳米科技涂层，使它能无视极端温差，并屏蔽电磁干扰。它配备多组传感器与高分辨率摄像头，能够探测生命体征，并在错综复杂的城市地形中从容穿行。
The chopper sits motionless on the helipad, its red paint covered in raindrops. The hull is coated with nanotech, allowing it to shrug off extremes in temperature and ignore electromagnetic interference. Equipped with an array of sensors and high-resolution cameras, it can detect life signs and navigate through complex urban terrain with ease.

一株凤梨科植物攀附在树木蓬乱的粗皮上生长。厚实蜡质的叶片层层叠叠，翠绿间覆着朦胧的白色条纹——天生就为汇聚雨水而塑形。中央向上迸出一簇星芒般的亮粉色尖叶。尖刺的叶冠深处，小小的紫色花蕾安然蜷伏其间。
A bromeliad grows on the shaggy bark of a tree. The nested layers of thick, waxy leaves are green with cloudy white stripes—perfectly shaped for gathering rainwater. A starburst of spiky bright-pink leaves grows up from the middle. Sitting nestled within the spiky crown are little purple flower buds.

Lodus Aganazzar.name:
洛杜斯·阿加纳扎尔
Lodus Aganazzar

Text.text:
那位天裔靠在墙边，健壮的身躯松弛而从容。街灯照亮他深色的皮肤，让血脉里熔金般的光在皮下闷燃。浓眉之下，他的眼睛也像燃烧的炭火，虹膜一阵阵鼓动着猩红热浪。他从蓬松的大爆炸卷发里抽出一张扑克牌，咧嘴一笑，顺手塞进腰带上的枪套里；随即像猫一样舒展开身子，闲庭信步穿过街道走向赌场，右耳的耳饰被他漫不经心地轻抚着。一名高大的食人魔保镖横身挡住去路，獠牙森然，摇头拒绝。天裔大笑着退后一步，指间翻飞，施展出一场令人眼花缭乱的障眼法与魔法。食人魔看得目瞪口呆，只能呆呆张望，手一挥，放那位披红外套的表演者走了进去。

~ Played by Ofearthandiron with

The celestialkin leans against the wall, his muscular frame at ease. A street lantern illuminates his dark skin, causing the molten glow within his veins to smolder. Beneath his strong brow, his eyes too are like burning embers, the irises pulsing with crimson heat. He tugs out a playing card from the tight curls of his large afro, grins, and tucks it away in the holster at his belt as he uncoils like a cat and saunters across the street to a casino, absently caressing an earring in his right ear. A large ogre bouncer blocks him, tusked head shaking. The celestialkin laughs, steps back, and performs a dazzling display of sleight of hand and magic. Dumbfounded, the ogre can only gawk at the display, absently waving the red-coated performer inside.

~ Played by Ofearthandiron with

I Persuade A Guard To Look The Other Way.name:
我说服一名卫兵睁一只眼闭一只眼
I Persuade A Guard To Look The Other Way

Text.text:
“如果我们的行动引起了你的怀疑，我深感抱歉——那么我就把实话摊开说：若我们的任务失败，这座城镇在一周之内就会化作一堆冒着浓烟的瓦砾。你在这里有配偶吗？或许还有些朋友？他们的性命，总该比几桩鸡毛蒜皮的小过失更重要吧。”
“I’m very sorry if our activities have roused your suspicion, so here is the honest truth: if we do not succeed in our quest, this town will be a pile of smoking rubble within the week. Do you have a spouse here? Perhaps some friends? Surely their lives are more important than a few petty infractions.”

Sundries From A Griffon Rookery.name:
狮鹫育巢场的杂货
Sundries From A Griffon Rookery

Text.text:
这座废弃的鹫巢显露出残骸的痕迹——马匹与骑手的尸身一并被抛进族群之中。破碎的衣物与折断的武器散落在区域各处。
The abandoned rookery shows signs of carcasses—both horses and riders—being dropped among the pride. Pieces of clothing and broken weapons litter the area.

Stimulant Street Drug, Kali-10.name:
兴奋剂街头毒品，Kali-10
Stimulant Street Drug, Kali-10

Text.text:
蓝色药丸弯如弯刀的刀尖，凹侧刻着十道缺口。它几乎像一枚菊石——一只远古的虫，吞下去，让它在你腹中扎根，再次破体而出，狂怒地夺回失落的十亿年时代。

~ 由一位英雄 构想
