The blue pill is curved like the end of a scimitar, ten notches cut into the concave side. It almost looks like an ammonite, an ancient bug to swallow and let root in your gut so it can re-emerge and furiously reclaim a billion years of lost time.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

North Gate In Winter.name:
冬日北门
North Gate In Winter

Text.text:
大门周围拉着亮黄色的警戒带，裹着大衣、戴着手套与帽子的工人们正忙着抢修那道锈迹斑斑的铁闸。它此刻卡住了，半升不升——只够一只瘦骨嶙峋的老鼠钻过去。一个西装革履却显得狼狈的男人，脸上裹着蓝白条纹的围巾，搓着双手，既想驱散寒意，也想按住心头的焦灼。“没事的，市长先生，”一名戴眼镜的女人把账簿夹在臂弯里说道，“我相信他们很快就能修好。”
The gate is surrounded by bright yellow caution tape, and workmen bundled in coats, gloves, and hats toil away on the rust-ridden portcullis. It is currently stuck, partially risen—enough to let a scrawny rat through. A harried man in a business suit, face wrapped in a blue and white striped scarf, rubs his hands together to stave off both the chill and his anxiety. “It’s alright, Mayor, sir,” says a bespectacled woman with a ledger under her arm. “I’m sure they’ll fix it soon.”

O’uol Beleta’ur.name:
奥乌奥尔·贝莱塔乌尔
O’uol Beleta’ur

Text.text:
那道轻盈的身影始终把兜帽压得很低，面容隐没在阴影里。直到他微微转身，光线掠过那双异样的银色眼眸与铂白长发，你才惊觉他的身份——卓尔精灵。罕见——就连这片边境前线也不多见——而他颈侧那道骇人的烙印，昭示着他被族人放逐：一个在地表陌生人之间苟活的流亡者。他腰间两柄长剑安置在剑鞘中，背上斜挂着一把未上弦的长弓，旁边还有箭袋与朴素的旅者背包。他举手投足间的优雅、处理事务时的利落与精准，无声暗示着他在刀与弓下那近乎致命的效率。

~ Played by a Hero

The lithe figure keeps his hood drawn, face obscured in shadows. It’s only as he turns and light catches his strange, silvery eyes and platinum white hair that you realize his identity as a drow elf. Rare—even here on the frontier—and the grisly brand on his neck marks him as an outcast of his people, an exile subsisting among strangers here on the surface. A pair of swords rest in scabbards at his waist, while an unstrung longbow hangs across his back, along with a quiver and a simple traveler’s pack. The grace by which he moves, the deftness with which he completes tasks, hints at his deadly efficiency with both blade and bow.

~ Played by a Hero

Clockwork Librarian.name:
发条图书管理员
Clockwork Librarian

Text.text:
注视眼前那道身影的动作，仿佛看见钟楼的内脏在房间里行走。齿轮飞转，风箱鼓动，发条盘绕，让这团精密的金属拼装体获得了生命。它显得格格不入，令人难以言明地不安；然而，这台会动的机器在举手投足间却又透出某种性情。
Watching the motion of the figure before you is like seeing the insides of a clock tower walk about a room. Cogs spin, bellows pump, and springs coil, giving life to this intricate assemblage of metal. It seems incongruous and feels disconcerting in a way you can’t quite define, but the animate machine nevertheless presents a sort of personality in the way it moves.

Unarmored Destrier Before The Joust.name:
比武前的无甲战马
Unarmored Destrier Before The Joust

Text.text:
一群侍从把战马团团围住，那宛如海格力斯般的魁梧身影将他们衬得渺小。他们小心翼翼地替它梳理着闪耀的鬃毛与被毛，时时警惕着这头巨兽的蛮力——只消铁蹄轻轻一甩，就能把他们抹在马厩的墙上。战马嘶鸣一声，仿佛在嘲笑侍从们的惧意。
A gaggle of squires surrounds the horse, the herculean presence dwarfing them. They gingerly brush its gleaming coat, conscious of the beast's raw power, able to smear them against the barn wall with a flick of its iron-shod hooves. The charger whickers, as if laughing at its attendants' fear.

这座石柱高高耸立，凌驾于周围区域之上，直冲云霄达60英尺。墙面上排布着细窄的箭孔，顶端有一处小平台，向东西南北四个方向探出。塔顶收束成尖顶，其上立着一根塔尖，一面朴素的旗帜在风中轻轻飘扬。
Standing tall and proud above the surrounding area, the pillar of stone stretches up 60 feet. Thin arrow slits line the walls and a small platform at the top juts out in the four cardinal directions. The tower is peaked by a spire upon which a modest flag flutters in the wind.

The Siren’s Carriage.name:
塞壬的马车
The Siren’s Carriage

Text.text:
车轮在浓雾里吱呀作响，一点灯笼光摇摇晃晃，像幽魂悬在昏暗中。马车的轮廓逐渐清晰，车夫高顶礼帽的影子随着步伐微微起伏。车厢呈青蓝偏绿的色泽，交织着尖刺般的深色线条——仿佛荆棘爬满覆苔的石块——前方两匹栗色骏马腾跃前行，骄傲地甩动着乌黑如墨的鬃毛。马车轻纱般的帘幕后飘来一缕酒香与香水味……又夹着一丝极淡的焦木气息，像柴薪刚刚引燃。车夫向你微微掀帽致意，惨白的肤色衬着他那一头长而整洁的橙色发丝，格外刺眼。

~ 出自惊艳的 TTRPG 补充资料 The Vineyard

Wheels creak within the fog, and a gleam of lantern-light bobs, suspended like a spirit in the gloom. The silhouette of a horse-drawn carriage becomes clearer, the shade of the driver’s top hat rocking with the gait. The car is a greenish blue color latticed with spiking dark lines—like brambles covering a mossy stone—and is pulled by prancing chestnut horses that whip their jet-black manes proudly. From behind the carriage’s gossamer curtains comes a whiff of wine and perfume… and the slightest hint of burnt wood, like a log newly catching fire. The driver tips their tall hat to you, their pallor stark against their long, well-kept tresses of orange hair.

~ Found in the amazing TTRPG supplement The Vineyard

Mountain Pass: Bridge Over Water.name:
山口：跨水之桥
Mountain Pass: Bridge Over Water

Text.text:
翻滚水流激起的水雾濡湿了桥面的木板，在脚下滑得让人发怵。也许在下游数里、沿着陡峭山势向上数千英尺的范围内，这是横渡奔涌河水的唯一安全通道，但桥身的摇摆与呻吟却丝毫不能让你相信，踏上去会是个好主意。
Mist from the tumbling water slicks the boards of the bridge, making them slippery underfoot. This might be the only safe way across the rushing river for miles downslope and thousands of feet up the steep mountain, but the way it sways and groans doesn’t give you confidence that crossing it is a good idea.

Divine Storeroom Of A God Of Thieves.name:
盗神的神圣秘库
Divine Storeroom Of A God Of Thieves

Text.text:
保险箱守护着各色金属、各个年代的成堆钱币。书架被一座书籍宝库压得弯腰。衣物一件件挂在绳上，每件都值一艘船的价格。宝石与珠宝塞满麻袋，毒药与灵药装在匣中，挂毯与画作陈列成排；还有暗格，机关重重、陷阱密布——这一切都藏在洞中之洞里，位于迷宫般的荆棘篱墙中央，那座城堡废墟之下的地城深处。这里的一切都是赝品。城堡的奠基石上刻着一个年份，并非城堡建成之时，而是它被盗走之日。
Strongboxes protect coin stacks of every metal and every age. Shelves sag under a trove of books. Garments, each worth the price of a ship, hang on lines. There are sacks of gems and jewelry, cases of poisons and elixirs, racks of tapestries and paintings, compartments secret and trapped—all inside of a cave inside of another cave, off a dungeon beneath the ruin of a castle at the center of a hedge maze. Everything here is a forgery. On the foundation stone of the castle a year is inscribed, not of when the castle was built, but of when it was stolen.

Fake Bag Of Beans.name:
赝品魔豆袋
Fake Bag Of Beans

Text.text:
布袋上打着几块皮革补丁，补丁上饰以繁复精巧的卷草纹。你摇了摇袋子，里面传来空洞的哗啦作响。你扯开抽绳往里一看，袋中竟是一把掌心大小、肾形的……小石子。
The cloth bag’s leather patches are adorned with intricate scrollwork. When you shake the bag, you hear a hollow rattling inside. You pull open the drawstring and find within the bag a palmful of small kidney-shaped… pebbles.

你穿过城堡拱顶的穹券门廊，推开沉重的木门。你停下脚步。本以为会听见钢铁交击、操练口令的雄浑怒吼，回应你的却只有寂静。高大的大厅里，书架与书桌铺陈其间；它们整齐成列，身披长袍的学者们安然穿行，默默埋首各自的研究。空气中萦绕着一丝若有若无的熏香，仿佛心爱皮装精装书页间留下的温柔气息。

~ 由 ChaseDerringer 构想

You pass through the vaulted archway of the keep and push open the heavy wooden doors. You pause. Where you expect to hear the clash of steel and the bellowed regimen of martial training, there is only silence. Bookshelves and desks fill the enormous hall in which you find yourself; arranged in neat rows they are attended by robed scholars peacefully going about their research. A subtle hint of incense lingers in the air, like the scent of a beloved leather-bound tome.

~ Envisioned by ChaseDerringer

王座高踞在宽阔大厅的尽头——石英与花岗岩砌就的长廊尽显冷峻。它立于抬高的台座之上，两侧两座炽燃的火盆簇拥，跃动的火光在高耸的座椅上游移，投下摇曳的阴影。王座仿佛由一整块古老橡木雕成，细致打磨至镜面般的光泽；华贵的皮裘披覆其上，猩红丝绸铺作软垫。家族的徽记深深镌刻在椅背中央，即便在飘忽不定的光里，也依旧清晰得令人无法错认。

~ Requested by Elvis

The throne looms at the end of a spacious hall of quartz of granite, situated upon a raised dais and flanked by two burning braziers which cast their flickering light upon the towering seat. Seemingly carved of a single piece of ancient oak, the throne is polished to a mirrored shine, draped with luxurious furs and cushioned with crimson silks. The sigil of the house is etched deep into the throne’s back, unmistakable even in the wavering light.

~ Requested by Elvis

Shaman Of The Couatl.name:
羽蛇神灵萨满
Shaman Of The Couatl

Text.text:
男人披着一袭绚烂的彩羽斗篷——领口灼红明黄，背脊垂落湛蓝翠绿——随着他兴奋的跳跃与夸张的手势沙沙作响，像在欢呼。蓝色菘蓝纹身覆在他结实的腹部、手臂与双腿，也爬上他笑容灿烂的脸。浓密的头发与胡须洗得发亮，黑得像牛鹂的羽毛般幽光闪烁。他起舞时，发梢与斗篷间有香气飘散，像熟透的果甜、辛香的香料与隐约的麝息交织。
The man’s polychromatic cape of feathers—bright red and yellow about the collar, blue and green down his back—rustles as he bounces and gesticulates in an enthusiastic dance. Tattoos of blue woad decorate his muscled stomach, arms, and legs, as well as his beaming face. His hair and beard, thick and washed to a shine, are as black and gleaming as the feathers of a cowbird. An aroma wafts from his hair and cape as he dances, both perfumed with what smells like a combination of ripe fruit, spice, and musk.

Graves In Swamp.name:
沼泽里的坟冢
Graves In Swamp

Text.text:
骨白色的石质标记从咸涩浑浊的水里冒出头来，向陆地方向蜷曲，宛如骸骨的手指伸向淤泥攫抓。石上刻下的名字早已褪去，在拍岸的水声与刺骨的风里被磨蚀殆尽，又被藻类悄然覆盖。
Markers of bone-white stone emerge from the brackish water, curling landward like skeletal fingers grasping at the mud. The names etched into the stone faded long ago, eroded by lapping water and bristling wind, overtaken by algae.

Sundries From A Storm Giant.name:
来自风暴巨人的杂货
Sundries From A Storm Giant

Text.text:
在巨人腰带上那个刻满符文、马车体型的皮革小袋里，你发现了一些奇异的预言遗物：一套由远古骸骨雕成的符文、一枚车轮般巨大的单枚硬币，以及三张卡牌——每一张正面都烙印着独一无二、令人费解的图景。
In a runed leather pouch the size of a wagon on the giant’s belt, you find some curious artifacts of prophecy. A set of runes carved from ancient bones, a single coin the size of a cartwheel, and three cards—each with a uniquely mystifying tableaux emblazoned on their face.

法术生效时，你的双眼刺痛发痒，因焦躁的期待而不住抽动。片刻之后，那感觉悄然散去；当你再度睁开眼，周遭世界被虹彩般的魔法以鲜艳色泽勾勒出轮廓。每一道声响都向外绽放，荡起涟漪，宛如石子落入池中。你惊叹地望着那道波纹穿行于空气，所经之处将附近的一切尽数点亮。

~ 构想：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Your eyes tingle and twitch in restless anticipation as the spell takes hold. The sensation passes after a few moments, and as you open your eyes, you see the world around you outlined in vivid hues of prismatic magic. Each sound blossoms outward, creating a ripple like a stone in a pond. You watch the wave in awe as it travels through the air, highlighting everything nearby.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Beautiful Platinum Buckle.name:
华美的白金扣环
Beautiful Platinum Buckle

Text.text:
这是一枚板扣，由软化并重塑的钱币拼合而成，经火焰熔接，再在接缝处重新雕刻，使各处压纹连成一体。它炫耀着财富，却又工艺精湛，毫不含糊。
This is a plate buckle composed of softened and reshaped coins, flame-worked together and re-engraved at the joints to connect the stamping. An ostentatious presentation of wealth, it is nevertheless expertly crafted.

I Intimidate With A Show Of Violence.name:
我以暴制威，杀气逼人
I Intimidate With A Show Of Violence

Text.text:
话传不过去，那我就把它递给我们之间的家具。对方还在居高临下、推诿搪塞地回话，我的武器已呼啸破空。被我砸碎的残片终于替我夺来所需的注意——以及恐惧。
The message isn’t getting through, so I deliver it to the furniture between us. In the middle of a condescending, deflective reply, my weapon whistles through the air. The fragments of what I’ve shattered get the attention, and fear, that I need.

凭借娴熟的施法技艺，你将自身感知向远方的一个魔宠锚点敞开，使你能够以魔法的视听感官洞察该区域。刹那间，感官信息如洪流般涌入你的意识。
Using practiced spellcraft, you open yourself to a familiar point far from you wherein you are able to perceive the area with magical sight or sound. Immediately, sensory information begins flooding into your consciousness.

The Experience Of Resurrection.name:
复生的体验
The Experience Of Resurrection

Text.text:
挤压你心脏、在你体内奔涌的魔法，把你的心智留到最后才拯救。你在短暂的一瞬间，纯粹成了一头野兽。刹那间，你直面来自另一个位面的记忆——既非预言也非史实的梦。超越时代的梦。随后你像被啪地一声弹回。你认出自己，也认出世界，带着一点恶心，也带着一点感激。你的旅程尚未结束。
The magic squeezing your heart and coursing through your system saves your mind for last. You are, briefly, pure animal. For a moment you confront the memories of another plane, dreams neither prophetic nor historic. Dreams beyond time. Then you return like a snap. You recognize yourself and the world, a little sick and a little grateful. Your journey is not yet over.

年轻人走路时始终不抬头，似乎比起要去哪里，更在意自己读到哪一行。他左手托着一本厚重的大书摊开，右手悬在书页上方，一枚戒指散发出冰冷的白光，将字句照得清清楚楚。他身形瘦削、脸型修长，若是肯多打理那副邋遢模样，本可称得上英俊。
The young man walks without looking up, seemingly less concerned with where he is going than with what he is reading. He holds a large book open in his left hand, with his right held over its pages, illuminating them with a ring that glows with a cold white light. Of slim build and long-faced, he might be considered handsome if he took more care over his scruffy appearance.

Barbarian War Paint, Woad: Applied.name:
野蛮人战纹，菘蓝：已涂抹
Barbarian War Paint, Woad: Applied

Text.text:
你将手指探入颜料之中，那蜡质般的东西冷若冰霜，接触之下寒意刺骨。你把冰冷的线条抹过脸颊，转瞬之间，颜料与汗水交融，渗入毛孔，竟渐渐发热。衣物之下肌肉骤然鼓胀，手脚嗡嗡震颤，躁动不安，迫不及待要投入行动。
You dip your fingers into the paint, the waxy substance cold as ice to the touch. You smear freezing lines across your face and, in a matter of seconds, the paint heats as it mingles with your sweat and sinks into your pores. Your muscles swell under your clothes, and your feet and hands vibrate, restless for action.

After A Hard-fought Battle.name:
一场苦战之后
After A Hard-fought Battle

Text.text:
最后一个敌人倒下，随着时代推移，战斗的喧嚣渐渐退去。你的身体隐隐作痛，意识回归之际，伤势才愈发清晰——可你还活着。你手中的武器上，鲜血一滴滴落下。你深深吸气，汗光在脸上闪烁；抬眼便看见盟友们围在你身旁，一个个同样喘得厉害。你们彼此点头，庆幸自己还活着，庆幸能看见敌人倒在脚下。这一战打得艰苦——却也赢得艰难。而此刻，你们仍站立着，胜利在手。

~ 构想：wilsonIFL

The last foe falls, and in time, the din of battle recedes. Your body aches, your injuries becoming evident as your awareness returns—and yet you live. Blood drips from the weapon in your hands. You take in great lungfuls of air, sweat shining on your face as you find your allies standing around you, all breathing just as hard. You nod to one another, thankful to be alive, thankful to see your foes at your feet. The battle was hard fought—hard won. But now you each stand, victorious.

~ Envisioned by wilsonIFL

Storm Giant With Axe.name:
持斧风暴巨人
Storm Giant With Axe

Text.text:
天空暗沉得近乎漆黑，云层鼓动着大气的怒意。雨幕充斥四周，仿佛天使自天国坠落的泪水。半没于水的道路上，一尊披覆兽皮的泰坦岿然跨立，钴蓝色的双眼闪烁着压抑的狂怒。闪电在它手中巨斧上跳跃，随即来回弧闪于鳞甲锁子甲那一片片如盾般大小的甲片之间。它俯视着你们，用巨人的语言龇牙低吼：“滚开，否则就死！”
The sky has darkened to almost black and the clouds throb with atmospheric anger. Rain fills the air, like angels' tears from heaven. Standing astride the half-submerged path is a fur-swathed titan, its cobalt eyes flashing with suppressed rage. Lightning dances across the huge axe it carries, then arcs back and forth between the shield-sized plates of its scale hauberk. Looking down upon you it snarls in the tongue of giants: “Leave or die!”

Compliment About Valor.name:
对英勇的赞誉
Compliment About Valor

Text.text:
“你真他妈太厉害了，你知道吗？好得让人火大，善良得让人抓狂，谦逊得让人受不了。我都不知道该恨你，还是该感谢神祇让我遇上了这样一位同伴。”
“You’re just so damn good, you know? Infuriatingly kind, insufferably humble. I don’t know whether to hate you, or thank the gods that I’ve found such a companion.”

尽管这是最容易施展的幻术之一，这道法术却出奇地百搭。你可以用它呈现任何你能梦到的点子。事实上，你总忍不住想在正在塑造的影像里加点个人风格，但最好的幻象往往越不起眼越好。越少被细看，越妙——尤其当这幻象只骗过眼睛的时候。
Although one of the simplest illusions to cast, this spell proves one of the most versatile. You can use it to show any idea you might dream up. In fact, you’re tempted to add a little personal flare to the image you’re creating, but the best illusions are often the least noteworthy. The less examined, the better—especially when the illusion affects sight alone.

这根魔杖由七条热带雨林的丛林藤蔓绞缠成束，再以魔法封缄，整体呈圆柱形。七条藤蔓在前端汇作一簇，并在距杖尖一英寸处以一枚金色金属环紧紧束缚。握柄末端亦以黄金封帽。有时雨后，杖身会绽开细小的绿叶，为其施法之力更添锋芒。
This wand of seven rainforest jungle vines twisted together and magically sealed is cylindrical in shape. All seven vines end in a cluster, bound an inch before the tip with a gold metal ring. The grip end is capped in gold. Sometimes, after a rain, tiny green leaves will open on the wand and enhance its casting power.

I Press A Face On My Cube Of Force.name:
我把一张脸按在我的力场立方体上
I Press A Face On My Cube Of Force

Text.text:
随着一声细微的咔哒轻响，立方体随即启动，周遭空气因魔法的共鸣而微微荡漾。肉眼无法察觉的魔法悄然无声，却强大得惊人，我能清晰感到环绕四周墙壁的坚实力量。
With a subtle click, the cube activates, causing the air around me to shimmer with magical resonance. Invisible to the naked eye, the magic is discreet but incredibly potent, and I feel the strength of the walls surrounding me.

I Cast Mass Heal.name:
我施放了【群体治疗术】
I Cast Mass Heal

Text.text:
我在胸前合拢双手。低垂着头，把法术的咒言贴着指间低声念出。一股温热——像一汪血泊，或一口吐出的气息——自心口延展至掌心。我猛然将双手向前推出，指向我的目标，治疗的能量洪流随之奔涌而出——那抹灼热的抚慰将一切病痛尽数焚净。
I press my hands together in front of my chest. Head tipped down, I speak the words of my spell against my fingers. A warmth, like a pool of blood or an exhaled breath, stretches from my heart into my palms. I thrust my hands forward, toward my targets, and a torrent of healing energy flushes out—the balm burning any and all ailments away.

一片妖异的光芒照亮了这座蓄水池——这里是数条主要下水道干线的交汇处。高处墙壁里的几根管道如帘幕般倾泻水流，沿池边汇成水洼，又奔入更低处的隧道。环形水道围着一处抬高的圆形区域；在那里，发光的液体池洼之间，一座由垃圾堆成的王座赫然耸立。一个穿着脏兮兮运动鞋、牛仔裤和橙色连帽衫的人正俯身压着另一名被捆绑的人影。兜帽里伸出一只巨大老鼠的吻鼻，裤后则拖出一条无毛的尖尾。那连帽的人形把他的女囚犯推向其中一汪发光的池液……

~ 由 Gray Q. Gregory 构想

A lurid glow lights this cistern, a junction for several main sewer lines. Water cascades in sheets from some of these pipes higher in the walls, pooling around the cistern’s edges and running into lower tunnels. This circular channel surrounds a raised circular area, and there, standing amid glowing pools of liquid, rises a throne of trash. A person in stained sneakers, jeans, and an orange hoodie leans over another bound figure. The snout of an enormous rat projects from within the hood, and a hairless, pointed tail issues from the back of the pants. The hooded humanoid pushes his female prisoner toward one of the glowing pools…

~ Envisioned by Gray Q. Gregory

Xeno The Navigator.name:
异端导航者
Xeno The Navigator

Text.text:
尽管他的躯体由暗色金属、乌木与熏黑的石料拼接而成，他那从容的举止与醇厚的男中音仍让你确信其具备心智。这个存在以金色饰边与额外装甲取代衣物为身，但仍戴着一顶考究的帽子，腰胯处低低斜挂着一只宽大的皮革枪套，里面插着一把擦拭得锃亮的轮锁手枪。他那发光的黄色双眼愉快地炽燃着，开口说话时，竟能让连从未见过同类的人也不由得放松下来。
Despite his bodily construction of dark metal, ebony wood, and blackened stone, the easy mannerisms and rich baritone voice assure you of his sentience. Though the being has added gold trim and extra plating to his body in lieu of clothing, he nonetheless wears a stylish hat and carries a well-polished wheel-lock pistol in a broad leather holster slung low on the hips. His glowing yellow eyes blaze merrily as he speaks, putting at ease even those who have never met one of his ilk before.

High-tech Media Camera.name:
高科技媒体摄像机
High-tech Media Camera

Text.text:
一片淡蓝色的全息显示从手持摄像机上投射出来，展示其各项设置所涵盖的丰富选项。无论是静态照片还是视频，都配有多种参数与滤镜，而这台线条流畅的机器还内置了编辑功能。
A pale blue holographic display projects from the hand-held camera to showcase the wide variety of options for its various settings. Still photos and videos each have numerous settings and filters, and editing capabilities are built in to the sleek machine.

Stimulant Street Drug, Betameth.name:
兴奋剂街头毒品：贝他甲酚
Stimulant Street Drug, Betameth

Text.text:
在改装师与杀手盘踞的地下世界里，有一种被奉为圭臬的秘药：倍他美斯——出自罪犯实验室的调配。它源于以太安非他命，煽动新陈代谢的烈焰，拔高思维的 leading edge。借由这些近乎超自然的反应与察觉，它在幽影的舞步中赐予人片刻的优势。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Within the illicit world of riggers and hitmen, a chosen elixir rules: betameth, a concoction birthed in criminal labs. Derived from etheric amphetamines, it fans the flames of metabolism and boosts cognition. With these supernatural reactions and perception, it bestows an ephemeral edge in the umbral dance.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

妖精界是个离奇之地，存在的许多性相与我们的世界迥然不同，几乎令人难以想象。而这场竞逐，正是其中之一。两只小精灵嬉戏般掠过枝桠，穿梭于瀑布之下，又从游荡的群兽腿间一闪而过，彼此追逐，身后拖曳出一串璀璨的微光轨迹。它们的动作断续跳跃，仿佛这些幽光在时代里向前蹿动；你拼命瞪大眼想追上这场眩目的奇观，视线却渐渐发花——终究徒劳无功。

~ Envisioned by DaveDaWanderer on Discord

The fae realm is a curious place, where many aspects of existence are so different from our own it is almost impossible to imagine them. This race is one such aspect. Two sprites flit playfully over boughs, beneath waterfalls, and between the legs of wandering herd beasts as they race, leaving a glittering trail in their wake. Their movements are staggered, as if the wisps are jumping forward in time, and your eyes begin to blur as you desperately try to keep up with the dazzling spectacle—to no avail.

~ Envisioned by DaveDaWanderer on Discord

这头野兽般的人形生物如同一座高塔，遍体疤痕的毛皮肌肉堆成城垣，拼凑的护甲像临时加固的壁垒。胸膛宽如酒桶，双臂粗得仿佛树干，熊地精那惊人的体量背后蕴藏的蛮力只消一眼便昭然若揭。深色毛发环绕他的头颅，胡乱梳作人类般的发型，末端扬起两道如角般的弧扫直指上方，又顺着后颈披落。他身上挂着一堆明显拾荒而来的杂乱道具，其中包括一柄巨大的双手战锤——却被他单手提起——以及一捆数量繁多的人形头骨，腐败程度各不相同。

~ Played by Tyler Kamstra of RPGBOT.net with

The beastly humanoid is a tower, a bulwark of scar-lined, furry flesh and piecemeal armor. With a chest like a barrel and arms the diameter of tree trunks, the strength behind the bugbear’s considerable mass is evident even at a glance. Dark fur encircles his head, styled haphazardly like hair might be, ending in two horn-like sweeps that stick straight up and drape down the neck. The bugbear carries an odd assortment of obviously scavenged gear, including a massive two-handed warhammer he hefts in one hand and a bundle of myriad humanoid skulls in various states of decomposition.

~ Played by Tyler Kamstra of RPGBOT.net with

Vampire Enraged, Thirsting.name:
吸血鬼（特征）暴怒，饥渴
Vampire Enraged, Thirsting

Text.text:
精灵的眼睛在眼眶中翻白，嗜血欲望彻底吞没了他，野兽般的咆哮从他唇间迸出。他露出细长如针的獠牙朝你猛冲而来——直扑你的咽喉。他的速度快得超越任何自然生物，你还没弄清发生了什么，便已在为活命而战。
The elf’s eyes roll back in his head and a bestial roar escapes his lips as the bloodlust overtakes him. He rushes toward you baring long, needle-like fangs—lunging for your neck. He moves faster than any natural creature could and before you realize what is happening you are fighting for your life.

Overheard Conversation About Rogue In Th.name:
关于一名未来盗贼的偷听对话
Overheard Conversation About Rogue In The Making

Text.text:
“——但她对这事儿满腔热情，这才最重要，对吧？她从最高的架子上偷走了一罐曲奇，又在奶奶毫无察觉的情况下，从她脖子上顺走了首饰。我本想大吼一声，做个称职的家长，可……唉，我他妈就是骄傲得不行。”
“—But she’s passionate about it, and that’s what counts right? She stole a jar of cookies off the top shelf and snatched grandma’s jewelry off her neck without her being any the wiser. I wanted to yell, to be a good parent but… Well, I’m just so damn proud.”

Sundries From A Grindylow.name:
来自格林迪洛的杂货
Sundries From A Grindylow

Text.text:
几块状况糟糕的珊瑚被收拢在一起，夹杂着小小的雕像与迷你绒布娃娃。它们全都被海水浸透，破败得几乎不成样子。
Various pieces of coral in bad shape are collected with small figurines and tiny stuffed dolls. They are all waterlogged and in extreme disrepair.

施法者的脸几乎完全隐没在一圈蓬松的毛领里，那毛领覆着霜晶的兜帽像冰封的羽绒般将面容遮蔽得难以辨认。厚实的熊形长袍之下，谁都可能藏身其中。霜雪伏在法师的肩头，冰霜镶着袍摆的边缘，仿佛与寒冷相伴已久，才磨出了那低沉闷哑的咒语声、袖口抬起时细碎的沙沙脆响、厚重手套下指尖游走的起伏——以及一柄冰冷匕首，疾射进被魔法冻结的黑暗之中。
The spellcaster's face is nearly impossible to see inside the fluffy ruff of a rime-encrusted hood. Under the thick, bear-shaped robe could be anyone. Frost lies on the mage's shoulders, frost trims the robe's hem, as if a long relationship with the cold has formed the muffled voice of incantation, the sleeves that crinkle as they rise, the ripple of fingers moving under heavy mittens—and the launch of an icy dagger into the magically frozen darkness.

Temple For Summoning.name:
召唤神殿
Temple For Summoning

Text.text:
焦痕烙在这间厅室的高高穹顶上。空气沉甸甸地浸满魔法，仿佛你正趟过沉睡的法术余波。焦痕下方的地面刻着一枚六角形，蜡烛曾在其中融化成泪。几道白色粉末的线条又围绕六角形勾勒出更繁复的图形，但外圈其中一条线显然被蹭乱、截然断开。
Scorches mark the high ceiling of this chamber. The air feels heavy with magic, as if you wade through latent spells. The floor under the scorches bears an etching of a hexagon in which candles have melted. Other lines of some white powder trace a complex shape around the hexagon, but one of the outer lines has clearly been scuffed and broken.

我的敌人正好挤作一团，我便娴熟地装填弹药，务求每一轮齐射都能尽可能多地命中目标。我找准角度，稳稳瞄准，扣动扳机。随即，我将每一发弹药尽数放出，让它们各自破空而去，直奔某个敌人而去。
With my adversaries grouped as they are, I expertly load ammunition to hit as many as I can in each barrage. At a precise angle, I aim and shoot. As I do, I loose each piece of ammo so it flies at one of my enemies.

Malebolge, The Sixth Circle Of Hell.name:
恶沼魔狱，地狱第六环
Malebolge, The Sixth Circle Of Hell

Text.text:
螺旋漏斗般的壕沟向下钻入深处，尽头是一座占满狭小底层的祭坛。长着蝙蝠翅膀的恶魔盘旋在壕沟上方，用焦黑的草叉刺戳异端。每个异端都披着他们背叛的那位神祇的祭服，每当被刺中便嘶喊：
  • “战神看见我临阵脱逃！”
  • “我从海女神的海蚀洞里偷了祭鱼，还把它吃了！”
  • “我烧了魔法女神的图书馆！”
他们排成长队，绕圈行进；一句句忏悔仿佛磨刀般，把壕沟越踩越深。 A spiral funnel of trenches drills down to an altar occupying the entire small floor. Bat-winged demons circle the trenches, sticking heretics with charcoal pitchforks. Wearing the vestments of the god or goddess they betrayed, each heretic shouts out when stabbed:
  • “The God of War saw me flee!”
  • “I stole an offering fish from the grotto of the Sea Goddess and ate it!”
  • “I set fire to the Goddess of Magic’s library!”
They march in circles, long lines of them, their confessions wearing the trenches ever deeper.

Tome Of Vile Shadow.name:
卑劣暗影之书
Tome Of Vile Shadow

Text.text:
一股强烈的不祥之感笼罩着那本黑暗的书——令人不安、啃噬般的感觉，像爪子般挠着你脑后，贴着耳畔低语。那些文字几乎没有意义，但它们的意图清晰无误：恶意。书以柔软而有韧性的皮革装订，黑如黑曜石，并以银色箍带加固。封面上烙印着一张恶魔的面孔——一张讥笑的骷髅脸，双角分列两侧，眼眸似宝石般隐隐闪烁。
A feeling of intense foreboding surrounds the dark book—an unnerving, gnawing feeling that claws at the back of your mind, whispers in your ear. The words carry little meaning, but their intent is clear: malice. The book is bound with a soft, supple leather, black as obsidian, reinforced with bands of silver. A demonic visage emblazons the cover—a sneering, skeletal face flanked by horns, whose eyes seem to glimmer with a gemlike quality.

阴影在地面上荡起涟漪，你猛地抬头，眯起眼迎着刺目的阳光，寻找那阴影的源头。一只巨大的鸟形爬行类盘旋俯冲，前臂末端伸展成细长的皮膜双翼，在空中紧紧绕着圈——用锐利而掠食的目光扫视地面。即便相隔甚远，你也能看清它那如长矛尖般的喙，内里密布锯齿般的獠牙。它的颅骨覆着褶皱般的羽冠，顺着柔韧蜿蜒的颈项向后收束。伴随一声穿耳的尖啸，这生物猛然侧身，双翼收拢，开始朝你发起游隼般的俯冲。越来越快，身后风声轰鸣，它如箭般直坠大地。看来，追猎已经开始了。
Shadow ripples across the ground, and you snap your head up, squinting against the sun to see the source. A massive avian reptile, its forearms ending in long leathery wings, banks in tight circles—scanning the ground with piercing, predatory eyes. Even from a distance, you make out a long spearhead beak filled with sawtooth fangs. Its skull is adorned with frilled feathers that end at its sinuous neck. With a perforating screech, the creature tilts, wings folding as it begins a peregrine-dive toward you. Faster and faster, wind roaring behind, it streaks to earth. The chase, it seems, has begun.

I Pull A Fuzzy Object From My Bag Of Tri.name:
我从戏法袋里掏出一个毛茸茸的物体
I Pull A Fuzzy Object From My Bag Of Tricks

Text.text:
当我把手探进我的戏法袋时，那股感觉在舒适与不安之间摇摆——里面每一样毛茸茸的东西，接触起来都痒得发麻。我听见轻轻的吱吱声与窸窣声，像是小生物在巢穴里翻找忙碌。我摸到的每个轮廓都与其他别无二致，于是随手抓起一个，朝前一掷。
The sensation vacillates from cozy to unsettling as I dig in my bag of tricks—all the fuzzy objects ticklish to the touch. I hear soft squeaking and rustling sounds, like small creatures rummaging around their nests. Each shape I feel is indiscernible from the rest, so I grab one at random and toss it forth.

Sundries From A Red Dragon Wyrmling.name:
红龙幼龙的杂物
Sundries From A Red Dragon Wyrmling

Text.text:
赤红的鳞片如红衣主教的羽毛般鲜亮，在尾与翼最后的狂乱抽搐止息后仍不断蒸腾。皮革轻薄而柔韧；或许能从肉上完整剥下，改制成首饰，甚至一件衣物。余烬般明亮的血液仍从伤口里带着喷涌之势奔流而出，也许能在凝结前采集起来。
Red scales, bright as cardinal feathers, continue to steam after the final thrashings of tail and wings subside. The hide is light and supple; it might be skinned away from the meat and repurposed into jewelry or even a garment. The ember-bright blood, still escaping from its wounds in gushing force, might also be collected before it coagulates.

潮湿在这座洞窟的岩壁上蚀刻出一道道沟槽，将白垩雕成起伏的白色帷幕，垂覆在一汪平滑如镜、墨黑如渊的水潭之上。环绕水池的群簇群青色晶体迸发出明亮光辉，却只在液面上被弹回，仿佛那光无法刺入其浑浊幽深的深处。
Moisture has bored grooves into the walls of this cavern, turning the chalk into a rippling white curtain above a smooth inky-black reservoir. The bright glow of ultramarine crystals surrounding the pool bounces back from the surface of the liquid, as if the light cannot penetrate its murky depths.

I Detach A Dagger Patch From My Robe Of.name:
我从【万用物品长袍】上扯下一块匕首补丁
I Detach A Dagger Patch From My Robe Of Useful Items

Text.text: 我用手在长袍上来回摸索，直到指尖触到一块铁灰色的补丁——上面用黑线绣着一把匕首的简洁轮廓。我抠住边角一扯，它立刻松动，伴着一声令人畅快的撕裂声被扯了下来。补丁在我掌心猛地抽搐了一瞬，随即弹起——POP!——化作一柄真正的武器。我手腕一抄，在半空中稳稳扣住握柄；皮革缠带紧实牢固，毫无磨损。刀刃的边缘也同样平滑，毫无崩口，仿佛才刚刚开刃磨利。 I run my hand over the robe until I find the iron-gray patch with the simple outline of a dagger embroidered in black. I pick at it and it immediately gives way, ripping away with a satisfying sound. The patch convulses in my palm for a second or so until it bounces up and—POP!—transforms into a real weapon. I grab the hilt in midair with a quick swipe, the leather wrappings tightly bound and unmarred. The blade’s edges are smooth as well, free of nicks as if newly whetted.

Foyer To The North.name:
北侧门厅
Foyer To The North

Text.text:
撞开铁箍门后，另一间昏暗的前厅在你面前延展开来。东侧两处墙角里，火盆噼啪作响，黑色铸铁边缘的余烬不时窜起摇曳的火星。根须从墙体中挤出，向下钻入瓷砖地面，所过之处留下如血管般蔓延的裂纹。房间西北角，一道阴冷的楼梯通向上一层。
Breaching the iron-banded door, another dim foyer stretches before you. Two braziers crackle from the eastern corners, embers flickering up from the edges of the black cast-iron. Roots push out from the walls and descend into the tile floor, leaving veining cracks in their wake. At the northwestern corner of the room a bleak staircase leads to another floor.

你猛击地面，一道音波向外奔涌而出，肉眼可见的发光能量波纹化作摇曳的线条。音浪轰鸣如雷，却又带着唱诗班般的质感——无数嗓音齐声升腾，哭泣般渐趋尖啸的高潮，直到波涛般撞上你的目标。
You strike the ground, and a sonic wave, visible to the eye as wavering lines of glowing energy, rushes outward. The wave roars like thunder, though it has the quality of a choir—many voices rising to a crying crescendo as the wave crashes into your targets.

I Overextend Myself In A Time Of Need.name:
我在危难时代勉力撑到极限
I Overextend Myself In A Time Of Need

Text.text:
这能做到吗？我有没有足够的勺子——足够的精力——去完成它？几乎每天，我都会这样拷问自己。眼前的挑战必须被征服，而我却被那股投身其中的诱惑彻底吞没。这会伤害我，以无法言说的方式。但它是必要的。我把自己挖到最深处，直抵存在的纤维与筋络；我束紧心神，拥抱那份只为最必要时刻保留的力量。也正因如此，我才学会控制步伐——好让道路艰难之时，我还能再多做一点点。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Can it be done? Do I have enough spoons—energy—to do this? I ask these questions of myself almost every day. The challenge before me must be conquered, and I’m overcome with the temptation to commit. This will hurt me, in ways that cannot be described. But it is necessary. I dig deep into the very fiber of my being, I gird myself and embrace a strength reserved for only the most necessary of situations. This is why I pace myself—so I can do just a little bit more when the going gets tough.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

粗壮而修长的茎秆高高耸立在林中生灵之上，每一根都比树冠还要高。甘蔗呈现出健康而鲜活的翠绿，纤维素的环状节纹加固了本就坚韧的外层，令它们在风中弯折摇曳时依旧不减威势。
Long, thick stalks tower over the denizens of the forest, each one taller than the arboreal canopy. The cane is a healthy, vibrant green, and rings of cellulose reinforce the plants’ already formidable exteriors as they bend and sway in the wind.

望着这团流动的薄雾，你不由想起那些慵懒的日子，躺着从天空里挑出云的形状——但这绝非童年的幻想。你清楚看见一具由蒸汽凝成的人形在空中游弋，同样清楚看见它面容上恶意的阴影——以及由白云化作的利爪，横扫着它周围的空间。
Looking at this animate mist makes you think of lazy days spent picking shapes out of the sky, but this is no childhood fancy. You clearly see a humanoid body of vapor swimming through the air, just as you clearly see the malicious cast of its face—and claws of white cloud sweeping the space around it.

箭矢不过是一根朴素的木杆，削成钝钝的尖端。自箭槽至箭尖，通体雕饰着一幅幅气流回旋的图景，细密到除了法术，绝无他物能刻出这等纹理。箭矢平平掠出；它的效果却在竖直方向。命中时几乎不带多少力道，但只要接触就已足够。护甲上一声叮，或皮革上一记轻轻的咚——目标便直直被送上天空。 The arrow is a simple wooden shaft carved to a dull point. It is decorated all over, notch to tip, in a tableau of air currents too fine to have been etched by anything but a spell. The arrow flies horizontally; its effect is vertical. It strikes home with minimal force, but a touch is sufficient. A tink against armor, or a light thump against leather—and there goes the target, straight up into the air.

被漂白的树木骷髅伫立在一片幽暗的水域中。褐色芦苇挤满腐烂的树干，在凛冽寒风里贴着它们窃窃低语。你脚下的沼泽地成了岸边，连着一座被淹没的森林，倒木纠缠成团。水或许不深，却冷得刺骨——而且谁也说不准，你会在下面的淤泥里陷进去多深。
The bleached skeletons of trees stand in an expanse of dark water. Brown reeds crowd the rotting trunks, whispering against them in a chill wind. The marshy ground you stand on serves as shore to a drowned forest tangled with fallen timber. The water might not be deep, but it looks cold—and there’s no telling how far you’d sink into the mud beneath it.

一片红褐与浅褐相间的鹅卵石路在你眼前铺展开来，温暖而斑斓，托起了蟹井镇广袤的中央广场。这里，市政与娱乐交织成一团喧闹却紧绷的混合气息。聚在此处的人来自各行各业：衣着奢华的城政官员、被日头晒得发亮的街头摊贩、以及被旅行磨得倦怠的来客——他们带着惊叹的神情，贪婪地吞咽着彼此争夺的景象、声响与气味。杂技人和哑剧演员为路过的人表演着古怪的小把戏。忽然一声吆喝把目光拽向一处食摊：一大块肉挂在烤叉上缓缓转动，油光闪烁，泛着诱人的咸香光泽。广场西北侧，那台诡异的 Omniphone 高耸压迫；而在对角，一座高高的绞刑架——此刻空无一人——阴森地盘踞着。两尊权威的巨影俯瞰着这片喧闹的人潮。
A sea of red and tan cobblestones stretch before you, the warm and colorful foundation of the expansive Central Square of Crabwell. Here, municipality and entertainment coalesce into a boisterous, nervous mix. The folk present come from every walk of life: decadently garbed city officials, sun-kissed street vendors, and travel-weary visitors who drink in the competing sights, sounds and smells with awed expressions. Acrobats and pantomimers perform quaint routines for passersby. A shout draws attention to a food stall, where a hock of meat roasts on a spit, slowly turning and glistening with a savory sheen. The uncanny Omniphone looms in the northwestern section of the Square while a tall set of gallows, currently empty, haunts the opposite corner—two titans of authority overseeing the bustle.

Exclusive Corporate Country Club.name:
专属企业乡村俱乐部
Exclusive Corporate Country Club

Text.text:
几台机器人割草机贴地巡弋，身形低矮得几乎不挡视线，在环绕那栋两层建筑的草坪高尔夫球场上不停巡视。那栋楼窗多墙少。一条田园般的碎石路蜿蜒通往正门，但入口处横着的安保岗亭堵住了去乡村俱乐部的路，迎客的效果也随之大打折扣。魁梧的安保把Polo衫和卡其裤撑得鼓鼓囊囊，立正站岗，硬冷的眼神下却挂着温和的笑。
Several robotic lawnmowers, low to the ground so as not to block any views, are on a constant patrol along the grassy golf course encircling a two-story building with more window than wall. An idyllic gravel road winds toward the front doors, though the welcoming effect is diminished by the security station blocking entrance to the country club. Bulky security guards filling out polos and khakis stand at attention, offering warm smiles below hard eyes.

I Cast Reincarnate.name:
我施放了【转生术】
I Cast Reincarnate

Text.text:
我背部与肩膀的肌肉一阵刺麻，金色的能量微粒在我周身翩然起舞。珍贵的材料被尽数吞没，随着我完成法术，一对空灵的羽翼自我身后舒展而出。我的视野被灿然光辉瞬间点亮，我看见将要容纳我目标灵魂的新躯之剪影。我握住那身影的双手，以意志驱使我的目标重获新生。
The muscles of my back and shoulders tingle, and golden motes of energy dance around me. The precious ingredients are consumed and a pair of ethereal wings grow from my form as I finish my spell. My vision flashes with radiant light, and I see the silhouette of the new body my target’s soul will inhabit. I take the figure’s hands in mine and will my target to be reborn.

Unstable Portals In The Fortress Of The.name:
霜巨魔要塞中的不稳定传送门
Unstable Portals In The Fortress Of The Fomori

Text.text:
一名卫队队长朝手下嘶吼，发黄的唾沫从他嘴角飞溅。他用一根蜷曲的棕色指甲指向一道弧形门槛——冰蓝能量在其中翻涌。门周围的空气微微闪颤，石头也像将要融化般摇曳变形。奉队长之命，一名弗莫里士兵冲向传送门，朝它的边缘掷出标枪与石块；可每个物体都只是在那扇飘渺的门里无声消失，随即响起一道电鞭炸裂般的脆响。另一名士兵喉间咕噜着挤出惊恐的尖叫——一扇传送门竟在她身后骤然张开，将她猛地拽了进去。
A captain of the guard screams to his underlings, yellow spittle spraying from his mouth. He points a curling, brown nail at an arcing threshold of ice-blue energy. Around it, the air shimmers and stone wobbles as if about to melt. A Fomori soldier runs to the portal at the captain’s command, throwing javelin and rock at its edges. But each object merely disappears through this ethereal door with a sound like the crack of an electric whip. Another soldier gurgles out a fearful cry as a portal opens right behind her and pulls her in.

Helezana Willow-flame.name:
赫勒扎娜·柳焰
Helezana Willow-flame

Text.text:
她那摄人心魄的眼眸在一瀑流动的赤褐长发间闪烁，如同框中星光。年轻的脸庞覆着铜色肌肤，点缀着金色穿孔饰；细小的圆环沿着眉角弯起，下唇涂抹的唇彩之下，一枚唇钉冷冷一闪。她张口大笑，笑声回荡，空灵得像古老熔炉里跳动的火焰。她的舌尖中央穿着一颗红宝石。她身着舞者的装束，由层层轻薄的纱织叠出；布幅染着红与银的色调，与她的发与眸相互映衬。它们缠绕着她纤细的身形，波纹般的视觉与有节奏的沙沙声几乎让人忽略她髋侧那柄弯曲的弯刀。乌铁刀身上，一道赤红的脉络蜿蜒其间，宛如熔岩之河穿过焦黑的大地。

~ Played by the dnd lover

Her arresting eyes shimmer like stars from within a frame of flowing auburn hair. Golden piercings decorate the copper skin of her youthful face, with small hoops curving over the corners of her eyebrows and a labret glinting under her painted lower lip. She opens her mouth to laugh, the sound echoing and ethereal like the fire in an ancient forge. A red jewel sits pierced in the middle of her tongue. She wears the garb of a dancer, crafted of many layers of sheer fabric. The swathes are tinted red and silver hues, matching her hair and eyes. They twist about her slender body; the rippling sight and rhythmic rustle almost distracts from the curving scimitar at her hip. A single red vein courses through the black-iron blade like a river of lava through charred earth.

~ Played by the dnd lover

Divine Stalking Grounds Of A God Of Hunt.name:
狩猎之神的神圣猎场
Divine Stalking Grounds Of A God Of Hunting

Text.text:
篝火与简易棚依偎在两河交汇处的岩缝里；林海在此豁然开口，向下铺展成草甸，草甸外是起伏的山麓，山麓之上，覆雪的群峰耸立。日出或日落之时，春芽的嫩色与秋收的浓彩在地平线交织，时代慢到只剩一记心跳，直至那心血渗入大地，滋养四方。执弓的星座永远追逐着长角的星座，绕着夜空不停奔行。苍蝇养活鲑鱼，鲑鱼养活熊——就在这里，永恒如是。
The campfire and lean-to tuck into a cleft of rock at the confluence of rivers, where a forest opens to a meadow below foothills that roll beneath snowy mountain peaks. At the sun’s rising or setting, when the colors of the spring bud and the fall harvest mingle along the horizon, time slows to a heartbeat until its blood feeds the land. The constellation with the bow chases the constellation with the horns around the night sky forever. The fly feeds the salmon that feeds the bear, here in this place, forever.

一个彪悍如保镖般的恶棍逼近而来。他钥匙圈上的钥匙叮当作响，夹杂着铁镣沉闷的碰撞声；随着他猛地一拽锁链，被奴役的女人踉跄着被迫向前。她的手腕被捆住，脚踝上两道镣环由一截短链相连，令她步伐凌乱而难以稳住。
With a build like a bodyguard, a thuggish man stalks forward. The merry jingle of keys on his ring mixes with the dull clink of irons, as a yank of the chain forces the enslaved woman to stumble forward. Her wrists are bound, her gait made irregular by a short chain connecting two bands around her ankles.

I Use Whirlwind Attack.name:
我使用旋风攻击
I Use Whirlwind Attack

Text.text:
强敌环伺，我沉心定神，刹那间将他们的位置尽收眼底。随后我旋身而起，出手如电。以精准的突刺直指每一名对手，我化作钢铁风暴。横扫的攻势划出一道道弧光，随着我的转身愈发迅疾、愈发凶猛。近在咫尺的任何目标，都逃不过我的怒火。
Foes on all sides, I center myself and take a moment to note their positions. Then I spin. And strike. With precise lunges toward each opponent, I become a storm of steel. My sweeping attacks form arcs that gain momentum as I turn. No nearby target can escape my fury.

Battered Old Service Android.name:
伤痕累累的旧式勤务仿生人
Battered Old Service Android

Text.text:
它足有六英尺多高，曾经闪亮的外壳如今黯淡褪色，漆面在多处崩裂剥落；每一次移动，关节都吱呀呻吟，仿佛正吃力追赶程序的苛求。然而，体内的AI似乎毫不气馁，依旧从容自若地来回忙碌。一个悦耳的声音像铃声般清亮地响起——乐意为您效劳。
It stands well over six feet tall, its once-shiny surface now dull and faded, paint chipped and peeling in places, and its joints creak and groan with every movement, as if struggling to keep up with the demands of its programming. However, the AI within seems undeterred, still pottering back and forth with aplomb. A pleasant voice pipes out like a ringing bell—happy to be of service.

当风势渐息，雪不再卷起如房屋体型般的弧状雪浪，北极燕鸥尖细的啾鸣在山壁间回荡。你检定自己的道具时，耳边传来一声低沉的哼响，像牛，也像熊。下方、靠近林线的山道上，一个披着白色长毛的巨人迈着悠长而轻快的步伐，巨臂随着步伐大幅摆荡。它短暂抬头瞥了你一眼——那张脸几乎比猿类也没更像人多少，眉眼挤作阴沉的皱褶——便继续前行；每一步都踢起三尺厚的粉雪，沿着山坡一路下去。
When the wind has calmed and the snow stops whipping in curls the size of houses, the squeaky chirp of an arctic tern echoes off the mountain face. As you check your gear you hear a grunt like an ox or a bear. Below you on a mountain trail near the tree line, a giant in white fur takes long loping strides, its massive arms swinging. It looks up briefly at you—face barely more human than simian squinched in a frown—and walks on, kicking up three feet of powder with each stride as it makes its way down the mountainside.

对一名侏儒而言，眼前这位娇小的女人却显得格外精瘦结实。她身穿一件被漂洗得发白、次数多到数不清的罩衫，拖着一个对她来说大得滑稽的黑色包袋。若有人目光敏锐，便能看见袋中有一卷绷带、一只锡制的耳喇叭、几片玻璃镜片，以及十来只以上的陶罐。那些大小不一的罐子被细心贴上标签，里面想必装着酊剂、药膏……以及活水蛭。
For a gnome, the diminutive woman in front of you is quite wiry. Clad in a smock that has been bleached white countless times, she hauls a black bag that is comically large for her. Inside the bag, a sharp-eyed observer can see a roll of bandages, an ear horn made of tin, several glass lenses, and more than a dozen earthenware jars. Carefully labeled, the jars of different sizes no doubt contain tinctures, ointments . . . and live leeches.

Temple To A God Of Strategy.name:
献给战略之神的神殿
Temple To A God Of Strategy

Text.text:
神殿是一座方形高塔，高耸得令人屏息，遍布瞭望台、窗户与阳台。前厅里，擦拭得如镜面般的黑白棋盘砖地映出战略之神的高大神像；祂立于主门之前，凝视着每一个踏入神殿的来客。祂威严可怖，面庞刮得干净利落，身披战痕，一手托着一副完美平衡的黄铜天平。几名新进者弓着背伏在桌前，沉默地对弈推演。另一些人翻阅典籍，或聆听关于历史战役的讲授。还有几间房内战声回荡，新进者彼此切磋，教官如鹰般锐利的目光紧盯着每一次出手。
The temple is a square tower of imposing height, with many lookouts, windows, and balconies. In the vestibule, a highly polished black-and-white-tiled floor reflects the tall statue of the god of strategy, who observes all comers entering the temple by the main gate. A formidable figure, he is clean-shaven, battle-scarred, and holds a set of perfectly balanced brass scales in one hand. Some initiates hunch over tables playing games of strategy. Others read books or hear lectures on historical battles. Some rooms ring with the sounds of combat as initiates spar with one another, their instructors watching with hawklike attention.

Inside A Genie's Lamp.name:
巨灵神灯之内
Inside A Genie's Lamp

Text.text:
这间厅室的弧形墙壁与穹顶天花板仿佛由抛光黄金铸成。五彩灯笼藏在墙上温暖的壁龛里，照亮并烘暖了这片空间。地面像一座舒适的巢穴：丝绸靠枕与锦缎毯子围着一张矮矮的、镜面桌，桌上摆满各式瓶子，盛着色泽各异的烈酒。综合来看，作为一间牢房，它奢华得出奇。
The chamber’s rounded walls and domed ceiling appear to be made of burnished gold. Colorful lanterns, tucked into cozy nooks in the walls, illuminate and warm the space. The floor is a comfy nest of silk pillows and brocaded blankets surrounding a low, mirror-topped table laden with bottles of all shapes containing liquors of many hues. All things considered, it’s quite luxurious for a prison.

Porter's Office.name:
搬运工办公室
Porter's Office

Text.text:
这里是大门的警卫岗，也是学院的中枢神经。墙面覆着软木，却几乎被密密麻麻的便笺彻底淹没——有的被图钉钉住，有的被魔法悬在柜台与货架上方，层层叠叠如同浮动的纸海。后墙上一扇带着数道锁的铁门，传闻通往一座足以覆盖数个运动场的巨大储藏室。通向前厅的那扇门，上半截装着栅栏，可单独开启。门房那把硬木椅、投递箱，以及挂满无数钥匙的钥匙板，都一览无遗。
This is the guard post of the Great Door, and the Academy’s central nervous system. The walls are covered in cork nearly impossible to see under the mass of notes pinned to it or magically suspended in the air over counters and shelves. On the back wall, an iron door with several locks is rumored to open on a storeroom covering several sports fields. The door opening on to the foyer, has a barred top half that opens separately. The porter’s hard chair, post box, and a board of many keys are in clear view.

比起找根替代法杖或宝珠，想凑出一根魔杖更难。它们挑剔得很，对自己的“天性”格外讲究。也许是一根筷子。也许是一支羽毛笔。你得找到一件能与你的魔法、你的个性共鸣的东西。你举起它，瞄准，然后祈祷——说话时把你能挤出的自信全都塞进每一个字里。
More difficult to scrounge than a replacement staff or orb, wands are finicky. Particular about their nature. Maybe a chopstick. Maybe a quill pen. You find something that resonates with your magic, your personality. You aim and hope, speaking the words with as much confidence as you can muster.

The Sanctuary: The Bridge.name:
圣所：桥梁
The Sanctuary: The Bridge

Text.text:
温暖潮湿的空气在河畔的柏树间流转。河水在一座精巧的桥下湍湍奔涌——桥由编织的藤蔓与木板构成，从森林延伸向一片壮丽的湿地。然而当你踏上桥准备穿行时，却从桥身下方捕捉到一阵窃笑声，几乎被奔流的水声淹没。
Warm, humid air circulates among the cypress trees near the river. The water flows briskly beneath a beautifully crafted bridge of woven vines and planks that leads from the forest to a spectacular wetland. As you begin to cross the bridge, however, you catch the sound of snickering from below the structure, barely audible over the noise of rushing water.

Bullets Fly In Intense Close-ranged Fire.name:
子弹呼啸，近距离激战白热化
Bullets Fly In Intense Close-ranged Firefight

Text.text:
一阵横扫而来的熔热死亡冰雹呼啸掠过，伴随着自动火力野兽般的噼啪爆裂。弹雨扫中近旁的自动售货亭，汽泡饮料被打得四溅，沿着路面泼洒开来。光学瞄准辅助植入体骤然亮起，激光般的引导线在现场纵横交错。一队枪手人人都装着把身体与神经逼到极限的战斗改造，在彼此对射。肩扛式大口径机枪发出沉闷的轰响，粗壮的弹头把混凝土与金属撕出一个个头颅大小的破洞。
A horizontal hail of molten death whips past, accompanied by the savage crackle of automatic fire. A spray of bullets hit a nearby vending booth, spilling fizzy liquids across the pavement. Optic aim-assist implants flare, sending laser lines across the scene. A cadre of gunmen, each equipped with combat mods pushing them to the limit, fire at one another. The thud of a shoulder-mounted high-caliber machine gun sounds out, thick bullets leaving head-sized holes in concrete and metal.

The Bard Sings And Plays.name:
吟游诗人引吭高歌，拨弦奏乐
The Bard Sings And Plays

Text.text:
她轻轻清了清嗓，观众的低语随之渐渐沉入寂静。胆气一涨，演奏者的指尖在那件雕饰精巧的乐器弦上翩然起舞——一串戏剧性的颤音腾空而起，掠过屏息凝神的听众。她深吸一口气，在恰到好处的时机双唇微启，以完美的女中音与旋律相和。专注使她额间沁出细密汗珠，她却对自己含笑：她拨弄人心的手法，正如拨弄掌中琴弦般娴熟。
A gentle clearing of her throat and the speech of the audience fades into silence. Emboldened, the performer’s fingertips dance across the strings of her delicately tooled instrument—sending a trill of dramatic notes soaring over the rapt listeners. She draws a deep breath, and at precisely the right time her lips part as she accompanies the music in a perfectly pitched contralto. Beads of perspiration form on her brow from concentration, but she smiles to herself, knowing that she is playing the crowd just as skillfully as she plays the instrument in her hands.

Sailing Into Port During A Storm.name:
暴风雨中驶入港口
Sailing Into Port During A Storm

Text.text:
灯塔的光束是这场残酷狂飙里你唯一能辨出的亮点，鞭挞般的暴雨遮蔽了视线。狂风啃噬着你裸露的皮肤，你死命拽着粗糙、湿透的缆绳，只求在风帆把你掀翻之前将其放下。港湾的堤墙张开臂膀，将你迎入码头的怀抱，多少给了些庇护——但麻烦还远没结束。

~ crunchyzombies 于 Discord

The lighthouse beacon is the only light you can make out in the brutal squall, the lashing rain obscuring your vision. The wind bites at your exposed flesh as you heave on rough, sodden ropes, desperate to bring the sails down before they capsize you. The harbor walls offer some protection as they welcome you into the marina's embrace, but you're not out of trouble yet.

~ crunchyzombies on Discord

[察觉] 从黄铜般圆润的剑柄起，一直延伸到几乎触及剑尖，这把短剑的刃身布满了镌刻的符文。你挪动武器时，一束反光沿着符文游走，它们随之微微闪耀，仿佛在暗示其所代表的魔法。 [发现] 仅仅能读懂这些刻字的人会带着几分戏谑地一笑——符文拼出的竟是：巨人的牙签。可那些知晓强大奇物 Giantin Hammastikku 传说的人，却会有不同的反应动作（）：他们会带着赞许地微笑。你同时凝视这名字与力量时，这柄符文之剑开始将它的恩赐导入你其他的武器，以魔法将它们的致命性相乘地放大。

~ 由 Alan 构想的

[Perceived] Starting at its brassy rounded hilt and reaching nearly to its point, the blade of this shortsword is covered with engraved runes. As you move the weapon, a reflection of light traverses the runes and they glimmer, hinting at the magic they represent. [Discovered] Those who can merely read the engraving smile with amusement, for the runes spell out: Giant’s Toothpick. Those who know the tale of the potent artifact Giantin Hammastikku have a different reaction: they smile with appreciation. As you contemplate both the name and the power, the runic sword begins to channel its gifts into your other armaments, magically multiplying their deadliness.

~ Envisioned by Alan

你敞开心扉，感知四周，搜寻你的目标。你感到他们身上散发出的能量场——一股脉动般的触感，绝大多数人都无从察觉。你的灵能与他们的频率几近完美地共鸣。随后，你出手了。一束凝聚成尖刺的灵能，被你的念头绷紧，继而如箭离弦般释放。那道细芒猛然撞入你的目标的心智，使他们踉跄失措，神智恍惚。
You open your mind to your surroundings and seek out your target. You feel the field of energy emanating from them—a pulsing sensation undetectable by most. Your psychic energy resonates with theirs in a near perfect harmony. Then you strike. A concentrated spike of psychic energy, drawn tight by your thoughts, and released like an arrow. The sliver crashes into the mind of your target sending them reeling, disoriented.

Solarium Of A Manor.name:
庄园的日光厅
Solarium Of A Manor

Text.text:
房间里暖意融融——并不令人不适。高耸的墙面与尖峭的玻璃檐翼倾泻进充沛的阳光，烘热了铺就地面的石质瓷砖。各式各样的植物在此繁茂生长，藤蔓与叶片从陶盆与石砌花床边缘垂落下来。房间中央是一处休憩区域：木制家具铺着结实的软垫，再覆以丝绸帷布，几乎占据了整个空间。
The room is warm—not unpleasantly so. The soaring walls and steepled eaves of glass allow in copious amounts of sunlight, warming the tiled stone that makes up the floor. Plants of all varieties thrive here, their vines and leaves hanging over clay pots and stone beds. A seating area, consisting of wooden furniture laden with firm padding and draped with silks, dominates the center of the space.

Ancient Silver Dragon.name:
远古银龙
Ancient Silver Dragon

Text.text:
若月与星自天穹坠落，游猎于世，也未必更令人敬畏。绳结般的肌肉——粗壮得如同草捆——在如鱼皮般粼粼发亮的鳞片下扭动，继而舒展出巨大的银色双翼，映照着天空的万般颜色。巨龙嶙峋的面孔上，那双颌足以碾碎城堡高塔，而你却在其间窥见一抹笑意的痕迹。
If the moon and stars descended from the sky to prowl the world, they would not inspire more awe. Corded muscles—as thick as hay bales—twist under scales that shimmer like fish skin, and expand tremendous silvery wings that reflect the colors of the sky. The dragon’s craggy face has jaws that might crush a castle tower, but you spy upon them the hint of smile.

贵族的尸体像一条羊绒毯般披搭在昏厥榻上，四肢摊开，仿佛一幕关于安逸与松弛的静态画面。然而，这具躯体却冷冷提醒着众人：生命转瞬即逝——而财富与地位亦同样无常。
The noble’s corpse is draped across the fainting couch like a cashmere throw, their splayed limbs evoking a tableau of comfort and relaxation. However, the body serves as a sobering reminder of fleeting mortality—and the transient nature of wealth and status.

这头野兽高逾十英尺，口鼻比那些小得多的同类更为短粗。它的耳朵也更短，略尖的耳端刺出几缕硬毛。生物的胸膛缠覆着虬结筋肉，后腿同样壮硕，随时准备在任何危险征兆下猛然跃起。它一旦行动，与其说是蹦跳不如说是疾奔；僵直的尾巴让它保持完美平衡，双足踏地如雷，震得大地轰鸣。
The beast looms over ten feet tall, its snout stubbier than its much smaller counterparts. Its ears are shorter as well, and hairs protrude from their slightly pointed ends. The creature’s chest is wreathed with sinew, and its similarly brawny hind legs are primed to leap at any sign of danger. When it does move, it does not hop as much as sprint, its rigid tail allowing perfect balance as its feet thunder against the earth.

Entering Through An Airlock.name:
通过气闸进入
Entering Through An Airlock

Text.text:
你一踏入气闸，洁净如新的舱门便在身后无声滑合。持续的嘶嘶声充满整个空间，舱室压力被逐步平衡，空气中的一切污染物也随之被彻底清除。片刻之后，通往舰船内部的门伴着一声欢迎的清响缓缓滑开，放你进入。
The pristine doors slide shut behind you once you step into the airlock. A continuous hiss fills the space as the chamber’s pressure is equalized and all contaminants are expunged from the atmosphere. After a while the doors to the vessel’s interior slide open with a welcoming chime, allowing you inside.

你用指尖捏碎两片蛋壳，便感觉纯粹思绪的触须自脑海深处伸展而出，探寻并触及你所在区域内那些愿意接纳的心灵。无论你以何种言辞成形，你都能在这张心网中传递与接收最纯净的意图，仿佛一切都以你自己的话语说出。
Crushing two pieces of eggshell between your fingertips, you feel tendrils of pure thought extend from your mind, seeking out and reaching the receptive minds of those in your immediate area. Regardless of the shape of your words, you are able to transmit and receive pure intention from those in your web, as if spoken in your own parlance.

一抹恶毒的翠绿幽光浸透了这具真菌骇物的血肉骷髅（特征），你一眼望去，死亡冰冷的手便沿着脊背缓缓爬升。层层腐烂的菌体被塑造成一套阴森可怖的衣物仿像，裹覆着其内那具干枯的骷髅（特征）。黏稠的黑色秽浆在怪物胸腔里盘绕的肿胀藤蔓中搏动，黏腻液体以厚重的团块渗出，洇染到周遭的菌丝质上。
A malignant green glow suffuses the fleshy skull of this fungal horror, and the icy hand of death creeps up your spine as you behold it. Layers of rotting fungi have been shaped into a macabre facsimile of clothing, the garments enrobing the desiccated skeleton within. Viscous black ooze pulses through the swollen vines coiled in the monster’s chest, the sticky fluid seeping out onto the surrounding mycelial matter in thick globules.

I Cast Bless From My Necklace Of Prayer.name:
我从祈祷珠项链中施放《祝福》
I Cast Bless From My Necklace Of Prayer Beads

Text.text:
这颗珠子自新日破晓汲取力量，而如今我将把它赐予某人。我怀着敬畏之心握住珠子，凝神感受神祇的临在；我看见受惠者的肩头微微抬起，眼中亮起笃定的自信。
This bead drew its power from the dawn of a new day, and now I will bestow it on someone. I hold the bead with reverence and concentration on the deity’s presence, and I can see the lift in my beneficiary’s shoulders and the confidence in their eyes.

这把锤子小巧朴实，造型简洁，却在你掌中带着令人安心的分量。一截坚韧的抛光木柄托起圆润的铁锤头，以锻钉牢牢铆定。不会有人为这件武器的威能传唱诗歌，但它会把你稳稳护在身旁。
The hammer is small and simple in design, yet it carries a pleasing weight in your grasp. A haft of sturdy polished wood supports a rounded iron head securely fixed with a hammered pin. No songs will be sung of this weapon’s might, but it will serve you well.

Nightmarish Guardian Construct.name:
梦魇守护构装体
Nightmarish Guardian Construct

Text.text:
齿轮轰鸣如远雷滚过，噩梦般的构装体逼近而来，独眼迸出的猩红凶光死死钉在它的目标——你。充作头颅的山羊骷髅在行进间左右晃荡，以令人作呕的“活物”拙劣模仿撩拨你的神经，令你浑身起鸡皮疙瘩。它猛地一抖，抬起数条细长如刃的手臂，转而望向不远处那道讥笑的身影——对方傲慢地将手搭在一根手杖上，杖头镶着一颗幽幽发光的猩红宝石。

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Gears rumble like distant thunder as the nightmarish construct moves closer, the baleful glow of a solitary crimson eye fixed firmly on its target—you. The leering goat skull serving as its head lolls from side to side as it moves, in a nauseating parody of life that makes your skin crawl. With a jerky motion it raises several of its long, bladed arms and looks to a sneering figure nearby, their hand resting arrogantly on a cane topped by a glowing crimson gem.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Deep Gnome City.name:
深地侏儒之城
Deep Gnome City

Text.text:
一想到地下城邦，人们总会期待那种回声轰鸣的巨型洞窟，而不是安静修补匠们盘踞的温暖隧道。深侏儒在岩层里凿出蜿蜒曲折的通道，洞壁上布满圆润的开口——不用门与百叶，改以帘幕垂挂其间。帘子半掩时，你能望见同样被磨得光滑圆融的住宅与店铺：石壁上凿出的壁龛与小格，既可作货架，也能当床榻，几乎万物皆由此而生。
When thinking about a city underground, one expects vast echoing caverns, not cozy tunnels of quiet tinkerers. The deep gnomes have carved wending ways through the rock, pocked by rounded openings hung with curtains instead of doors and shutters. When the curtains hang parted, you see similarly smoothed and rounded homes and shops, with nooks and cubbies cut from stone serving as everything from store shelves to beds.

奇巧的尖塔与风格化的烟囱从陡峭的屋顶上突兀地刺向天空，像匕首装饰性的剑柄。常春藤攀满建筑的正面，仿佛要把那高耸墙垣的灰色石块重新拽回大地。铁栅格窗户或在藤蔓间眯眼窥视，或从庄园阴沉的脸上投来恶意的凝视。这里的营造耗费了巨大的财富，但看起来，这些钱并没有买来半分幸福。
Fanciful spires and stylized chimneys jut upward from the steep roof, like decorative hilts of daggers. Ivy climbs across the building’s face as if trying to pull the gray stones of its high-flung walls back to earth. Iron-latticed windows squint through the ivy or gaze balefully from the grim face of the manor. Great wealth was used to build this place, but it does not look like any of that money bought happiness.

惨白的风帆在微风中扑簌作响，松松垮垮地挂在高耸于甲板之上的桅杆上。橡木舵轮被咸湿的浪沫打得发亮，在浪涛拍击船身时漫无目的地空转。下方的甲板与上方的桅杆随船体贴着码头的每一次摇摆而吱呀作响。
Stark white sails flutter in the breeze, loose on the masts that soar above the deck of the vessel. The oaken wheel, shining with salt spray, spins aimlessly as waves buffet the hull. The decks below and the masts above creak with every sway of the boat against the dock.

在那一瞬间，假象蒙蔽了视线：那张臭烘烘、布满疣瘤、青绿而尖刻的脸，从小恶鬼般的狰狞，竟不知怎地变得分外和善可亲。地精挺直了肩膀，木制长矛咚的一声落在地上；他端起庄重的仪态，步伐笃定地走近。深深一鞠躬时，他还挽了个手花，动作优雅得像王后最宠爱的宫廷侍从。“幸会，”他用沙哑、带鼻音的男高音说道。
In a moment of deceiving appearance, the smelly, warty, green, and pointy face turns from impish to, somehow, curiously affable. The goblin’s shoulders straighten, the wooden spear clunks to the floor, and with a dignified posture and sure stride, the goblin approaches. His deep bow includes a flourish of the hand, performed with the grace of a queen’s favorite courtier. “Enchanted,” he says in a gravelly, nasal tenor.

Light-speed Starfighter.name:
光速星际战机
Light-speed Starfighter

Text.text:
前方那艘飞船小得可怜，只够塞下一张座椅、一台强劲的引擎，以及一整套激光武器库。除此之外的一切都被削减到最基本的要素，使这艘飞行器既是为毁灭而生的专注武器，又是任何试图反制之物都难以锁定的微小目标。
The ship ahead is tiny, offering just enough space for a seat, a powerful engine, and an arsenal of lasers. Everything else has been pared down to the bare essentials, making the craft both a purposeful weapon of destruction and a miniscule target for anything hoping to counter it.

Sundries From A Black Magga.name:
来自黑玛加的杂货
Sundries From A Black Magga

Text.text:
村庄一片毁灭——屋顶被削去，墙壁被砸碎——那黑色魔伽巨大的触手终于在浑浊的水中静止不动。破碎的桶与箱、屋瓦与建筑石块、被洪水卷走的野兽与人的尸体，全都在这怪物身后漂浮，像环绕死去恒星的阴郁卫星。
Amid the destruction in the village—roofs shorn off, walls smashed—the black magga’s colossal tentacles finally lie still in the turbid waters. Shattered barrels and crates, roof tiles and building stones, the bodies of beasts and people caught by the flood, all float in the monster’s wake like dreary satellites around a dead star.

Rib Pillar Path During Winter.name:
冬日肋柱小径
Rib Pillar Path During Winter

Text.text:
穿行于嶙峋石肋之间的小径近来有人踏过，可你很快意识到，它的来历远不止于此。若将积雪剥去，你确信会在草丛里看到一条被踩得坚实的裸露土痕——那是四季常有人来往的确凿印记。然而今日白雪覆地，你清楚看见不久前有人离开小径，足迹在石肋般的柱旁戛然而止。也许这场仪式需要一名见证者在远处站定。
The path that passes between the looming ribs of stone has been trodden recently, but you see now that it runs deeper than that. Were the snow to be stripped away, you’re certain you’d see a trail of hard-packed bare earth in the grass, a sure sign of frequent visitors in all seasons. But today in the blanket of white, you can see that someone walked off the path not so long ago, their tracks ending near the rib pillars. Perhaps a witness to the ritual is required to stand some distance away.

在一片金黄谷浪的田野中央，远处地平线上绵延着一线阴沉的森林。马的残躯苍白得比天空还淡，皮革紧贴着骨架，像破碎的船帆，又像龟裂的羊皮纸。它左侧卧倒，仿佛只是忽然一歪便再也起不来，沉甸甸的死重；病瘴在其上啃噬，食腐者却迟迟不敢靠近。
In the middle of a field of golden grain, a dark forest stretching along the distant horizon, what is left of a horse is blanched paler than the sky. Its hide clings like a tattered sail, or cracking parchment. The horse lies on its left side as if it simply fell over, dead weight, the disease feeding on it and the scavengers staying away.

Closed Portal In A Building.name:
建筑内的封闭传送门
Closed Portal In A Building

Text.text:
墙面上凿出一排壁龛，勾勒出一道高挑的长方形轮廓——宛如门扉——可轮廓之内的墙体却依旧严实无缝。壁龛里陈着各式各样的小型头骨、燃到一半的蜡烛残段，或刻着不同符文的石头。唯独有一格空着，只剩一滩仿佛暗色蜡油的黏稠积液。
Niches set in the wall form a tall rectangle—like a doorway—but the wall within the outline appears solid. The niches hold small skulls of various types, half burned candles, or stones, each inscribed with a different rune. But one niche sits empty except for what looks like a puddle of dark wax.

I Commune With My Ancestors.name:
我与祖灵共鸣
I Commune With My Ancestors

Text.text:
我闭上双眼，开始吟诵神圣的咒 chant，召唤祖灵现身。言辞的节奏浸透空气，一股熟悉的存在在近旁凝聚——更多的声音也与我同声相和。我睁开眼，只见眼前浮现出粼粼闪烁的身影；每一道都向我投来肯定的微笑，随时准备伸出援手。
Closing my eyes, I begin the sacred chant to call the spirits of my ancestors forth. As the rhythm of words saturates the air, a familiar presence coalesces nearby—and more voices join my own. I open my eyes and see shimmering forms before me, each one favoring me with an affirming smile and ready to lend me their aid.

I Swallow One Dose Of My Restorative Oin.name:
我吞下一剂我的复原药膏
I Swallow One Dose Of My Restorative Ointment

Text.text:
这团果冻般的混合物闻起来清新微甜，可入口却像在嚼鞋底。那股苦涩让我牙根发酸，可才过了几秒，我便感觉体内的伤势开始缓缓减轻。
The jelly-like mixture smells fresh and somewhat sweet, but it tastes like the sole of a shoe. The bitterness sets my teeth on edge, but after a few seconds, I feel the injuries within me begin to alleviate.

Labyrinth Around A Dark Fortress.name:
黑暗要塞周边的迷宫
Labyrinth Around A Dark Fortress

Text.text:
从此处俯瞰，迷宫那令人目眩的浩瀚尽收眼底。它以蜿蜒而令人迷失的路径一路延伸，通向远方一座要塞；要塞仿佛漂泊在一片漆黑如将至风暴的岩石之上。
From this vantage, the staggering extent of the labyrinth is clear. It leads in a winding, confounding way to a distant fortress that is rafted by stone as dark as the coming storm.

你只需一声轰然断喝，便将远方风暴徘徊不散的低沉雷鸣灌入你的武器。武器命中之际，便迸出如闪电劈裂苍穹般尖锐的炸响。那声雷霆在敌人体内外回荡，震得其踉跄后退，身形下沉。
With but a booming word, you instill in your weapon a rumbling like a storm lingering in the distance. When the weapon hits, it unleashes the piercing crack of lightning splitting the sky. The report reverberates into and through your foe, pushing back and down.

Changeling Spy Revealing Themselves.name:
易形者间谍现身自曝
Changeling Spy Revealing Themselves

Text.text:
你面前的人如释重负地对你露出一抹笑意，仿佛终于能结束这场伪装。他的五官开始起伏游移，皮肤的色泽也随之变幻，原本光滑的地方猛然冒出毛发。伴随着低沉的噼啪轻响，骨骼与肌肉被强行扭转重塑，彻底改写其身形与骨架——熟悉的面孔消失无踪，取而代之的是一个全然陌生的人。

~ Envisioned by Rogério da Costa Jr.

The figure in front of you favors you with a relieved smile, sensing that their masquerade can finally end. Their facial features begin to undulate and shift even as their skin begins to change in color and shade, hair sprouting from areas once smooth. There is a quiet crackling sound as bone and muscle are forcibly deviated to completely change the subject’s shape and build, revealing an entirely new person where the familiar face once stood.

~ Envisioned by Rogério da Costa Jr.

你面前伫立的三足梦魇，是对类人生形态最极致的亵渎与扭曲。羊皮纸般惨白的皮肤紧紧绷在它完美对称的躯体上。三条如螳螂般分节的手臂折叠收拢，贴伏在它雌雄莫辨的胸前。那颗没有五官的假人头颅仿佛同时向所有方向凝视，让人根本无法分辨这生物究竟有没有正面或背面。直到它将那令人胆寒的意识猛然探向你，以残酷的精神冲击撕裂你的思绪，并开始啖食你对它异形本质的恐惧，你才明白——它有一颗心智。
The tripodal nightmare standing before you is the epitomized perversion of the humanoid form. Parchment-white skin stretches taut over its perfectly symmetrical body. Three articulated arms, like those of a mantis, lie folded tight against its androgynous chest. A featureless mannequin head seems to stare in all directions at once, making it impossible to tell if this creature even has a front or back. You learn it has a mind when it extends its dreaded consciousness toward you in a brutal mental assault and begins feasting on your fear of its aberrant nature.

这是一把极度失衡的武器：巨大的锤头远远压过木制握柄。战镐那经发蓝处理的钢制镐头逐渐收尖，锐利得令人胆寒；只要动作得当、动能充足，便能轻易劈开巨石——或是连最重装的突击兵也不在话下的护甲。
A grossly unbalanced weapon, with its massive head far outweighing its wooden haft, the war pick’s blued-steel head tapers to a point so deadly that the correct motion, married to significant momentum, could easily split a boulder—or the armor of even the most heavily armed shock trooper.

Sleeping Werewolf With Normal Wolf Pack.name:
与普通狼群同眠的狼人
Sleeping Werewolf With Normal Wolf Pack

Text.text:
巢穴里温暖而腥膻的空气，像一杯刺鼻的嗅觉鸡尾酒，混着湿毛、腐肉与血的味道。洞口处，一堆带血的骨头横陈在撕碎的衣物堆上。再往里走，几座竖起尖硬鬃毛的肩峰随平稳而匀称的呼吸起伏——宛如风平浪静的海面上，船帆轻轻鼓落。狼群中央蜷睡着一头体型远胜同类的巨狼。它那震地般的鼾声间隙，你听见低沉的咕哝与含混的咆哮，像是在梦里说话。
The den’s warm, rank air is an olfactory cocktail of wet fur, old meat, and blood. A pile of bloody bones lie on a heap of ripped clothing at the mouth of the cave. Deeper inside, peaks of bristling withers rise and fall in smooth, steady breaths—like sails of ships on a calm sea. One of the wolves, sleeping in the center of the pack, is much larger than the rest. Between its ground-shaking snores you hear low growling mutters as it talks in its sleep.

Intimidation By A Ranger About Wits.name:
游侠以机敏相逼的威吓
Intimidation By A Ranger About Wits

Text.text:
“你的辱骂挺可爱。不过很明显，光靠嘴我们什么也谈不出结果。不如我放你一马，给你十分钟，然后把你当猎物取乐？看看你的腿脚是不是和你的脑子一样快？”
“Your insults are cute. But clearly, talking is getting us nowhere. How about I cut you loose, give you ten minutes, then hunt you for sport? See if your feet are as fast as your wits?”

Gnomish Lich Summoner.name:
侏儒巫妖召唤师
Gnomish Lich Summoner

Text.text:
恶毒的魔法自你面前那具枯槁的侏儒身躯间翻涌盘旋。它身形矮小，却恶意滔天，硬生生在你周围的地面上撬开一道道裂口，复生的骸骨哗啦作响地爬了出来。更令人胆寒的是，这名巫妖身侧伫立着几张蜕落的龙皮——每一张都空空如也，唯有赋予其形体的诡异雾气在其内翻腾。一具残存的龙蜕缝隙间泄出火焰；另一具则躁动却驯服，弓起脊背，迸裂着紫色的幽辉。

~ 一位英雄所构想

Malignant magics swirl from the gaunt gnomish body before you. Diminutive in height but mighty in malice, they pry open holes in the ground around you and reanimated bones clatter out. Even more horrifying, the lich is flanked by sloughed-off dragonhides—each one hollow but for the eldritch vapor that gives it form. Fire leaks from one draconic vestige while another, seething yet obedient, arches its back and crackles with purple luminescence.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Derelict Spaceship Interior.name:
废弃飞船内部
Derelict Spaceship Interior

Text.text:
滞涩而陈腐的空气钻入你的鼻腔，身后的气闸在循环完成后咔哒一声闭合。诡异的红光照亮通往更深处的废弃飞船走廊——那光来自地面与墙板边缘一条条玻璃般的光带——紧急照明。你沿着走廊旅行，稀薄的光线把阴影投在嵌入舱壁的惰性控制台上。别无选择，只能继续前进。

~ 构想：Justin M

Stagnant, stale air fills your nostrils as the airlock cycles shut behind you. Eerie red light illuminates the corridors leading further into the derelict spaceship—emitted from glasslike strips along the floor and wall panels—emergency lighting. As you travel along the corridor, the sparse light casts shadows over inert consoles seated in the bulkheads. No choice but to keep going.

~ Envisioned by Justin M

Marriage Between Two Elves.name:
两位精灵的婚约
Marriage Between Two Elves

Text.text:
随着牧师念完结合仪式的最后一句誓词，新郎喜悦得几乎要鼓胀起来，仿佛下一秒就会从拐杖与地面上轻飘飘地腾起。他穿着樱桃红的束腰短上衣，英气逼人，脸颊却被泪水浸得斑驳。人群在他对挚爱吐露温柔话语时齐齐叹息——那位新郎正坐在一张缀满鲜花、缠绕藤蔓的椅子上。坐着的精灵除眼眸与唇角细微的颤动外几乎一动不动，白色长袍外披着一袭亮绿叶片织成的披肩。站着的新郎向侍从们点头示意，其中两人上前牢牢扶住他的手臂，另一人则接过他的拐杖。两人将他稳稳放低，跪到与他的爱人——如今，他的丈夫——平视的高度；对方眼眶里盈满滚烫的喜悦泪光。他的丈夫在侍从搀扶与人群喧闹的鼓劲中倾身向前，用一个温柔的吻为仪式落下印记。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

As the cleric finishes the words of the joining rite, the groom puffs up with elation, so much so it seems he might lift right off his crutches and the ground. He looks dashing in his cherry-red tunic, his cheeks tear-stained. The crowd sighs collectively as he utters tender words to his beloved, the other groom seated in a flower-bedecked and vine-tangled chair. The seated elf, unmoving aside from a few small movements of his eyes and lips, wears white robes under a shawl of bright green leaves. The standing groom nods to his attendants, two of which go to him and firmly hold his arms, and another who collects his crutches. The two lower him down to his knees to be eye-level with his love—now, his husband—whose eyes brim with tearful joy. His husband leans forward with the help of the attendants—and the raucous encouragement of the crowd—to seal the rite with a tender kiss.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

A Request To Deal With A Gang Leader.name:
与帮派头目交涉的请求
A Request To Deal With A Gang Leader

Text.text:
“我亲眼看着我的十几个弟兄倒在那混账手里。他和他那帮心怀怨毒的乌合之众还拿他们杀鸡儆猴。那之后，镇子里就再也没人敢反抗了。大家都盼着只要给他们想要的，他们就会走人。可他们每次都要得更多一点。再这样下去，这地方迟早被他们榨干。我们的胆气也许已经被打碎，可你们没有。求你们，救救我们。”
“Seen a dozen of my men fall to that bastard. Him and his band of malcontents made an example of them too. The town just stopped fighting after that. Everyone’s hoping if we give them what they want, they’ll go away. But they ask for a little more each time. Soon, they’ll drain this place. Our courage may be broken but yours isn’t. Please, help us.”

Forest Gnome Hamlet.name:
森林侏儒小村
Forest Gnome Hamlet

Text.text:
小村落坐落在森林腹地，被头顶浓密的树冠与世隔绝。斑驳的日光从枝叶间渗落，光束里浮着尘埃与闪烁的孢子。空气里带着宜人的霉香，潮润如腐殖土，令人心安。巍峨的橡树在林间空地周围耸立，高得仿佛有好几层楼。树枝间搭着一座座小屋，盘根错节的根须下则蜷着低矮的棚舍；每一处建筑都与树木本身浑然一体。居民大多是头发鲜艳的侏儒，身着绿色丝绸，悉心照料树木与繁盛的花园；而在更远处，一棵高耸入云的树人守夜着这片隐秘的聚落。

~ 由 Bangalulu 构想

The hamlet lies in the heart of the forest, shrouded from the world by the dense canopy above. Dappled sunlight bleeds through the trees, strewn with dust and glittering spores. A pleasant mustiness tinges the air, loamy and heartening. Mighty oaks stand stories tall around the forest glade. Huts perch amongst the branches above, with hovels in the tangled roots below, each structure seamlessly integrated into the trees themselves. The populace, primarily gnomes with vibrant hair and garbed in green silk, tend to the trees and their flourishing gardens, while in the distance a towering treant watches over the secluded community.

~ Envisioned by Bangalulu

Ritual At The Seal Binding An Old God.name:
封印仪式：缚锁远古神祇
Ritual At The Seal Binding An Old God

Text.text:
你见过这种场面：邪教徒缓慢摇晃，眼神空洞，在火堆、石制符号、兽尸或尸体旁围成一圈。长袍、匕首、那本一翻开就咔裂作响的古书。一向都够阴森，可这一次，这群被洗脑的教徒却透着格外不祥的压迫感。你看清了他们意志所指的核心——一枚巨大的圆形封印，其上刻着令人胆寒的奥秘符号——那封印正囚禁着一位远古神明。

~ Kemian 构想

You’ve seen it before: the slow rocking and glassy-eyed stares of cultists, around a fire, stone symbol, carcass, or corpse. The robes, the knives, the old book that cracks when it opens. It’s always creepy, but this time something about the brainwashed cult is especially foreboding. You get a look at the focus of their intent. It is a large round seal with a terrifying arcane symbol—the seal trapping an ancient god.

~ Envisioned by Kemian

Loot From An Ooze.name:
从黏液怪身上搜刮的战利品
Loot From An Ooze

Text.text:
一路散落的护甲——一只靴子、一片胫甲、几只臂铠、护肩与头盔——像面包屑般标出黏液怪曾经游荡的轨迹，也在同一刻吐出了它击败过的战士残余。你还发现几只背包也被保存了下来，里面的物件未曾被这冷漠的黏液怪掠夺。成堆的硬币闪着光，干净得一尘不染；还有备用的药水，依旧塞着瓶塞，满满当当。
Trails of armor—a boot, a greave, gauntlets, pauldrons, and helms—leave breadcrumb trails of where the ooze once ventured and simultaneously expelled remnants of the warriors it had bested. You find a couple of backpacks preserved as well, their contents unplundered by the uncaring ooze. Stashes of coin gleam, perfectly clean, as well as spare potions, still corked and full.

脚步声在穹顶般高耸的天花板间回荡，尖锐而清晰，随着你们逼近机库里那件珍宝而愈发逼人。那架飞行器流线而致命，宛如一架战斗机，在洁白的墙面前格外醒目，像一只黑黄蜂伏在雪花石膏上。它在顶灯下泛着冷亮的光，映出机身与阴影笼罩的座舱舷窗之间细微的分界线，以及沿机体烙印其上的枪金灰色徽标。
Footsteps echo, piercing, up the vaulted ceiling as the prize of the hangar is approached. The aircraft, sleek and deadly as a fighter jet, stands out against the white walls like a black wasp on alabaster. It gleams underneath the ceiling lamps, illuminating the subtle lines that separate the frame from the shaded cockpit window and the gunmetal-gray logo emblazoned along its body.

Primal Savagery: Claws.name:
原始野性：利爪
Primal Savagery: Claws

Text.text:
你的双手屈伸间带着原始的威胁，每根指尖骤然炸开，绯红的血雨四溅。喷涌的鲜血在半空中扭曲蜕变，化作漆黑的酸液；在你指尖残破的血肉里，凶狠的利爪向外延展。它们如一列抽搐的太古恶意，蓄势待发，准备撕裂一切胆敢挡在你面前之人。
Your hands flex with primal threat as the tip of each finger explodes in a crimson shower. The fountaining blood is transfigured into black acid as vicious claws extend from the wrecks of your fingertips. They become a phalanx of twitching primordial malign, ready to rend all who dare stand before you.

I Use Bardic Inspiration.name:
我使用吟游诗人激励
I Use Bardic Inspiration

Text.text:
音乐在我脑海中回荡，我开始尝试。它撩动我的灵魂。我任由这股振奋将我托起，去完成更伟大的壮举。
The music reverberates in my mind as I make my attempt. It stirs my soul. I let this rousing feeling lift me to greater deeds.

这面金属盾牌在你来回倾斜时，表面掠过一层诡异的万花筒般的闪烁效果。它并非由钢、秘银或精金打造，而是以某种深奥的合金铸成；盾面刻满符文与刺痛眼睛的纹样。你抓住盾带的瞬间，一阵怪异的麻痒沿着持盾的手窜起，令人心头一颤。
This metallic shield has a strange kaleidoscopic effect shimmering across its surface as you tilt it back and forth. Not steel, nor mithril, nor adamantine went into crafting this shield. It was built with some sort of esoteric alloy, the surface inscribed with runes and eye-stinging designs. A bizarre tingle thrills through your shield hand when you take hold of its straps.

False Life Cast By A Necromancer.name:
由死灵法师施放的虚假生命
False Life Cast By A Necromancer

Text.text:
死灵法师将一只瓶子狠狠掷在地上。玻璃碎裂之处，瓶中之物渗出，泛起暗红的幽光。液体离地升腾，光芒愈发炽亮，周围的草叶随之萎缩枯蔫。待那亮度几乎刺得人不敢直视时，那条液体缎带猛然窜上施法者的手臂，钻入他的胸膛。他转身面对你，气息焕然，嘴角扭成一抹僵硬的狞笑。
The necromancer throws a flask to the ground. The contents begin to glow dull-red as they seep through the broken glass. The fluid rises into the air, glowing brighter as the grass around it shrinks and wilts. When it is almost too brilliant to look at, the ribbon of liquid streaks up the caster's arm and into his chest. He turns to face you, rejuvenated, wearing a rictus grin.

Adult White Dragon Encounter.name:
成年白龙遭遇
Adult White Dragon Encounter

Text.text:
这场风暴仿佛被人召唤而来，裹着寒冰的狂风撕扯着你的脸颊，将雪堆越吹越深。风暴的源头终于映入眼帘：一条巨龙蜷伏在一座霜痕斑驳的孤峰之巅。它宛如一座活着的冰川，刺目惨白的鳞片覆满冰霜，冰冷的獠牙滴落着温热的唾液，落在被践踏的雪地上；那双极地般的目光死死钉在你身上。
This storm feels conjured, ice-charged wind tearing at your face and deepening the snowdrifts. The source of the tempest comes into sight: an enormous dragon crouched atop a frost-scarred tor. Like an animate glacier, achingly white scales caked in rime, icy fangs dripping warm saliva upon the trampled snow, its arctic gaze is fixed on you.

幸好你站在上风口，因为你几乎只要看一眼就能闻到那兽人的味道。他的皮护甲像是用某个生物新鲜剥下的皮匆匆缝合而成。你能看见的那部分灰绿皮肤上结着厚厚的污垢——包括那张长着獠牙、猪鼻子般的脸。那里的泥污似乎是刻意涂抹上去的，像某种战斗面具。
It’s a good thing you’re upwind, as you can almost smell the orc just by looking. His hide armor appears stitched together from the fresh skin of whatever creature once bore it. What you can see of the orc’s gray-green skin is caked in filth—including the tusked face with its piggy nose. The muck there seems to have been deliberately placed as some sort of war mask.

I Overclock My Hacker's Deck.name:
我让黑客牌组超频
I Overclock My Hacker's Deck

Text.text:
无视那些警告信息与不断弹出的“保修失效”提示，我撬开黑客甲板机的外壳，直面内部一团纠缠的线缆与电路板。我像文艺复兴时代的博学怪才对着一具尸体般审视它的机械解剖，逐一记下每个部件的位置，然后——小心翼翼地——将其拆下。忙活一阵后，我的黑客甲板机运行得比新机还顺畅——只是再也没那么好看了。

~ 构想：Murmur（Discord）

Ignoring the warning messages and persistent notifications about breaching warranty, I crack my hacker’s deck open to get at the mess of cables and circuit boards within. I study its mechanical anatomy like a Renaissance savant with a cadaver, carefully noting the position of each component before—carefully—removing it. After some work, my hacker’s deck works better than new—though it isn’t as pretty.

~ Envisioned by Murmur on Discord

这块巨石的风化表面溅满了鲜艳猩红的血污，血迹在岩面上炸裂般铺陈开来——仿佛源自一次猝然、残酷的撞击。
The worn surface of this boulder is spattered in vivid red gore, the blood painting the rocky canvas in an explosive pattern—as if from a sudden, brutal impact.

狮子的躯体，天使的双翼，却生着君王的面容——吟游诗人常这样描绘安德罗斯芬克斯，可当你亲眼直面它的威仪时，才知这比喻何其苍白。它的身躯确是狮形，却更为庞大——比战马更高、更壮，肌肉如绷紧的钢索。它的面容确是王者之相，却没有任何凡世君王能令人心生如此敬畏。唯有安德罗斯芬克斯的双翼不似诗歌里那般恢弘：它们固然美丽，可羽毛的质感更像尘封的荒漠，而非洁白的天穹。
The body of a lion, the wings of an angel, but the face of a king—this is how bards have described the androsphinx, but it seems a poor analogy as you face its majesty in person. Its body is leonine, but larger—taller and more muscular than a warhorse. Its face is regal, but no mortal king could inspire such reverence. Only the androsphinx’s wings seem less grand than the bards’ poetics, for although they are beautiful, their feathers have more in common with dusty deserts than white heavens.

你将无价的钻石悬在倒下者的胸口上方，低声咏诵蕴含威能的咒语，意在将死者的灵魂从幽冥中引回那具残破的躯壳。钻石随即崩碎成尘，点点金辉自你指尖流淌，没入尸身。奇迹般地，那具身体的眼皮轻颤，继而小心翼翼地睁开双眼。
Holding the priceless diamond over the chest of the fallen, you intone words of power designed to coax the dead person’s soul back into their ravaged body. The diamond crumbles to dust and motes of golden light flow from your fingertips into the corpse. Miraculously, the body’s eyes flutter then gingerly open.

男人以如丝绸般柔滑细密的嗓音低语，吟诵咒文。一袭漆黑而轻薄如影的披幕覆上他的鳞甲护甲——他周身唯一的光，是长剑剑锋上那抹冷银的闪烁。他的呢喃越过寻常听觉的边界，化作实体，侵入心神。言辞与唇形的起落错拍失真，迟滞而刺耳。长剑被暮光的紫影裹覆，又有另一个声音——粗砺、强悍、威严——加入咏唱。他将长剑一挑，猛然前刺。仿佛霹雳炸响的巨声撕裂空气，附魔的武器划出弧光，直劈向他的敌人。

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

Murmuring in a voice as smooth and fine as silk, the man casts an incantation. A mantle, dark and diaphanous as a shadow, drapes over his scalemail armor—the only light about him the silver glint on the blade of a longsword. His whispers break beyond the reaches of normal sound and become a thing, an invader of the mind. The words are delayed and dissonant from the movements of his lips. The longsword becomes cloaked in the purple shade of twilight and another voice—gravelly, powerful, commanding—joins the chant. He flicks the longsword up and lunges forward. A sound like a thunderclap tears through the air as the enchanted weapon arcs toward his foe.

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

这只泪滴形的瓶中盛着黏稠的液体，色泽如午夜般深蓝，以一枚银色球形瓶塞封口。液体里缠着紫色的脉络，仿佛伸展的根须或枯瘦的手指。从某些角度看，它带着令人反胃的内脏质感，正缓慢而来回地蠕动。

~ 由一位英雄Envisioned

This teardrop-shaped bottle full of viscous liquid, midnight blue in its color, is closed with a silver orb stopper. The liquid is laced with veins of purple, like reaching roots or emaciated hands. At some angles, it has the visceral look of an internal organ shifting slowly back and forth.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Trying To Resist Your Hunger For Blood.name:
试图压制你对鲜血的饥渴
Trying To Resist Your Hunger For Blood

Text.text:
饥饿像咆哮的炼狱烈焰在你体内烧穿，伴随每一次撕心裂肺的绞痛拷问你的理智。你体内蛰伏着一头野兽，不受世俗规训与道德束缚——而它几乎就要挣脱而出。#REF!
The hunger burns through you like a raging inferno, testing your sanity with every agonizing pang. A beast dwells within you, one that is unbound by societal convention or morals—and it is almost free.#REF!

Chain Devil Encounter.name:
链魔遭遇
Chain Devil Encounter

Text.text:
最暗黑铁铸就的炼狱锁链随着这恶魔的行动叮当作响，仿佛在预告痛楚；它拖行而过，身后又牵扯出更多被诅咒的链节。与其灼泡般猩红皮肤熔为一体的锁链，以不自然的生命脉动起伏——而每一条的末端，都收束成一件阴毒的折磨器具。透过包裹生物面孔、如噩梦面具般的链网，仍能看见它那双圆睁的眼：冰冷、漠然，盛满无情的憎恨。
Infernal chains of darkest iron rattle with the promise of pain as this devil moves, dragging more of the cursed links in its wake. Chains melded into its blister-red skin pulse with unnatural life—and each one ends in a wicked instrument of torment. Wide eyes filled with cold, dispassionate hatred can be seen through the links that envelop the creature’s face like a nightmarish mask.

Elden The Halfling Wizard.name:
半身人巫师埃尔登
Elden The Halfling Wizard

Text.text:
他是典型的半身人：棕发、知足，最爱热闹宴席，一边吃一边与人闲谈，三道菜下来都不见倦色。然而，他的长袍却在诉说另一段故事：曾潜入厚重书卷的深处，与来自异地的怪奇而睿智之人反复商谈。他名声在外，尤其是当那张欢快的面孔骤然凝重，他将手杖抬起，摆出法杖的姿势之时。

~ Played by Charlotte

He’s the quintessential halfling: brown-haired and contented, quick to a party of eating and chatting with folk through three courses. His robes, however, tell a story of delving into deep books and conferring with odd and sagacious folk from other places. He is widely known, especially for when his jovial look turns serious and he lifts his walking stick into the position of a staff.

~ Played by Charlotte

Insult About Rationalizing Cowardice.name:
为怯懦狡辩的羞辱
Insult About Rationalizing Cowardice

Text.text:
“你把全部时代都耗在妥协与权衡上——只为替自己的怯懦找个像样的借口。你就像一张湿透的薄纸，软塌塌地黏在任何比你更坚硬的表面上。”
“You spend all your time compromising or considering—in the pursuit of some rationalization of your own cowardice. You’re like a piece of wet tissue, limply clinging to any surface stronger than your own.”

Biker Gang Roadhouse.name:
机车帮公路酒馆
Biker Gang Roadhouse

Text.text:
一群皮衣包裹的摩托客在同伴间爆发斗殴时爆出喝彩，其他人迅速围成一圈，将他们团团拢在中央看热闹。吱呀作响的门上方，一块霓虹招牌把停车场——以及里面那些庞大如野猪般的公路铁骑——浸在刺眼的猩红光里；而在那家公路酒馆深处，喧嚣放纵的声浪翻滚不息，客人们进进出出，像潮水一样漂流。
Leather-clad bikers cheer as a fight breaks out between several of their number, and the others rapidly form a spectating ring around them. A neon sign above the creaking door bathes the parking lot—and the enormous road hogs in it—with glaring red light, and the sounds of raucous debauchery can be heard within the roadhouse as patrons drift in and out.

Dungeon: Secret Rock Wall Opening.name:
地城：隐秘岩壁开启处
Dungeon: Secret Rock Wall Opening

Text.text:
你听见一声嘶响与轻微的爆裂声，眼前岩壁上的一角瞬间攫住了你的目光。石壁之中嵌着一扇门，被人悄悄推开了一道细缝。你轻轻一接触，门便无声顺滑地开启——然而门后的一切，都被浓稠的黑暗严严实实地遮蔽着。
You hear a hiss and a pop, and a sliver of the rock wall before you catches your eye. There is a door built into the stone, pushed ever so slightly ajar. A gentle touch and the door opens smoothly—though, what's on the other side is concealed in thick darkness.

这只口哨由银亮的锡制成，形如一截朴素的管子，窄端留有吹口。圆筒在吹口之后被压扁，并开有一处孔洞；声音正由此发出。与吹口相对的圆钝末端带着一个小环，可将口哨系在细绳或链条上。
Made of silvery tin, this whistle is a simple tube with an opening for blowing into at the narrow end. The cylinder flattens beyond the mouthpiece and houses a hole; that’s how the sound is made. The rounded end opposite the mouthpiece has a loop so the whistle can be fastened to a string or chain.

Sundries From A Tarrasque.name:
来自塔拉斯克的杂货
Sundries From A Tarrasque

Text.text:
伴随着撼天动地的震颤，泰坦轰然坠地，随意将巨大的石砌残块如同被风卷起的种子般四散抛飞。你注意到这只怪物的一枚獠牙被冲击震得松脱，轻易便可取下。
With an earth-shaking tremor, the titan collapses to the ground, effortlessly scattering huge chunks of masonry like seeds caught in the breeze. You notice one of the monster’s fangs was knocked loose by the impact, making it easy to remove.

Social Street Drug, Sweet Talker.name:
社交街头毒品，甜言蜜语者
Social Street Drug, Sweet Talker

Text.text:
这种药物被装在黏糊糊的彩色小块里，外裹蜡封，像一小块块太妃糖。它们一接触皮肤便立刻融化，迅速渗入毛孔，化作起效极快的外用溶液。掌心里随手一捏就能见效，但真正无可比拟的冲击，是任它在舌下慢慢化开。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

The drug comes packaged in sticky, multicolored blocks wrapped in wax, like small pieces of taffy. They melt as soon as they come into contact with skin, sinking into pores as a fast-acting topical solution. A quick squeeze in the palm will do the trick, but nothing compares to the rush of letting it dissolve under your tongue.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

那名身形矮小、斑驳蓝皮的外星人歪了歪头，向后倚在近旁的墙上，四臂交叠抱在胸前。油渍斑斑的衣装上缀满各式绑带与固定别针，挂着的小饰物与工具随动作叮当作响。他们鼻尖微皱，神情敏锐得像在嗅出什么端倪。紧贴太阳穴伸出的其中一枚角锥骤然迸出一瞬粉白色能量的微光。
The small, mottled blue alien cocks their head and leans back on a nearby wall, crossing two pairs of arms. Trinkets and tools jingle from an assortment of straps and holding pins attached to their oil-stained outfit. They wrinkle their nose with a perceptive expression. A brief flare of pink-white energy emits from one of the horn cones jutting out of their temple.

你踏入这间干燥、尘土飞扬的房间时，隐约传来一阵窸窣爬行声。你看不见那令人胆寒的生物，却能清清楚楚听见它的动静。你越靠越近，便握紧武器，随时准备发动攻击——但很快你就意识到根本用不着。那不过是一只小小的、无辜的蜥蜴。
While entering the dry, dusty room, there is a faint scurrying sound. You can't see the dreaded creature, but you sure can hear it. As you move closer, you ready your weapon, ready to attack at any moment, but soon you realize there will be no need. It is simply a tiny, innocent lizard.

Dragon Descends From The Sky.name:
巨龙自天穹降临
Dragon Descends From The Sky

Text.text:
巨大的阴影吞没了太阳，与此同时震耳欲聋的狂风将你裹挟，你感觉到一股强大的存在正逼近。一个生物以撼天动地之势坠落，尘土与碎石四散飞扬，化作呛人的云幕遮蔽了你的视线。迷雾散去，你在原初的恐惧中血液骤冷，这才看清落在你面前的是什么：一头庞然巨龙。

~ DaveDaWanderer on Discord

A great shadow eclipses the sun just as a deafening wind encompasses you, and you sense a powerful presence approaching. A creature lands with earth-shaking magnitude, scattering dust and debris in a choking cloud that obscures your vision. The haze clears and your blood runs cold with primal terror as you realize what has landed before you: an enormous dragon.

~ DaveDaWanderer on Discord

In The Marsh: Rain.name:
《沼泽之中：雨》
In The Marsh: Rain

Text.text:
你在沼泽里的这段时代可谓苦不堪言，而现在又下起了雨。绵密不歇的暴雨丝毫驱不散闷湿的空气，也几乎无法为你滚烫的身体带来一点凉意。相反，坠落的雨幕与四溅的水花在你周身落下一道帘幕——让这片沼泽更像一座牢笼。
Your time in the marsh has been anything but pleasant, and now it’s raining. The steady downpour does nothing to clear the humid air, and little to cool your body. Instead, the falling rain and splashing water close a curtain around you—making the marsh feel even more of a trap.

一滩广阔的泥泞水洼在平坦的地面上铺展开来。沙砾与淤泥搅成的浑浊泥浆在各处咕嘟咕嘟地冒着水泡，仿佛巨人把一口大锅搁在炉上小火慢煨。然而你感受不到半点热意；相反，那水冷得刺骨。
A vast, muddy puddle spreads out across the flat ground. Here and there this mess of sand and silt bubbles up with water, like a giant’s saucepan set to simmer on a stove. But you detect no heat from the water. Instead, it seems rather cold.

Speech About Missing The Feeling Of Home.name:
关于思念家的感觉的演讲
Speech About Missing The Feeling Of Home

Text.text:
“很久以前，我带着挫败与疲惫，踏上了这条路，只为逃离旧日的生活。可走得越远，我越常忍不住回头张望。曾经的我，有一种安稳与简单的舒适。偶尔，我会瞥见故乡的一点微光，像夏日里拂过的暖风，带回那份我曾习以为常的完整。也许有一天我会回去，可到那时，我想，我又会回望与你们一起找到的这个家，照样会同样地想念它。”
“I set out on this path a long time ago, frustrated and tired of my old life. But the further I’ve traveled, the more I’ve found myself looking back. There was a comfort and simplicity to who I once was. Every now and then I catch a flicker of my home, like a warm breeze on a summer’s day, which brings back a wholeness I once took for granted. Perhaps one day I will return, but then, I imagine, I’ll be looking back on the home I’ve found with all of you, and end up missing it just the same.”
