Magical Weeping Willow Tree.name:
魔法垂泣柳树
Magical Weeping Willow Tree

Text.text:
这株巨大的柳树树干幽黑粗壮，斜斜向上扭曲生长，被常年的劲风压弯压低——宛如一位被时代折弯脊梁的老人。高处细枝如帘幕般倾泻而下，缀着银白叶片，仿佛正随微风摇曳。可你分明感觉不到一丝风。是你的错觉吗？还是那叶片的沙沙私语，听起来竟像某种言语？
The dark trunk of this massive willow twists upward at an angle, burdened and bowed by prevailing winds—like an elderly man bent by time. Thin branches cascade down from high above in curtains of silvery leaves that sway on the breeze. Except, you don’t feel any wind. And it is your imagination, or do the susurrus whispers of the leaves sound something like words?

Necromancer's Finger Of Death Kills Targ.name:
死灵法师的死亡之指杀死目标
Necromancer's Finger Of Death Kills Target

Text.text:
一个披着深色长袍的人在连绵刀光中猛然后仰，脚下急退，堪堪滑停在对手触及之外。他捋了捋稀薄的胡须，阴沉地皱起眉来。进攻者是一名体格魁梧的龙裔，银色鳞片泛着冷光；他放低一把弯刀，用另一把的剑柄重重擂击胸口。兜帽下的男人冷笑，低声吟出一个刺骨的词，伸出一根扭曲的手指。一道黑色光线骤然跃出，正中龙裔心口——他全身僵直，双刃脱手。刀剑哐啷落地，随即他眼白浑浊，身躯一软，轰然倒下。术士狂笑不止。片刻之后，尸体开始抽搐……

~ Envisioned by Wikiwing

A figure in dark robes recoils from a flurry of cuts, sliding to a halt just out of his adversary’s reach. He strokes his wispy beard and scowls. His attacker, a powerfully built dragonborn with silvery scales, lowers one curved sword and beats his chest with the hilt of the other. The cowled man sneers, incants a chilling word, and points a crooked finger. A black ray leaps forth. It strikes the dragonborn in the heart and he goes rigid, dropping his blades. They clatter on the floor, and then he topples over, his eyes milky, body limp. The sorcerer howls with glee. Moments later, the corpse begins to twitch…

~ Envisioned by Wikiwing

一名狗头人哨兵勤勉而警惕地守在这里——目光闪烁。它嗅着空气，仿佛察觉到了某种不对劲。利爪紧握武器，它舔了舔嘴唇，带着一丝惧意却满怀期待地戒备着，身形蓄势待发，随时准备战斗或转身逃窜。
A Kobold sentry, diligent and watchful, stands sentinel here—eyes gleaming. Sniffing the air, it seems to notice something off. Weapons gripped in clawed hands, it licks its lips in anticipation, vigilant with a trace of fear, its stance ready to fight or flee at a moment's notice.

Quip From A Holy Individual About An Evi.name:
一位圣洁之人对邪恶气息的讥讽
Quip From A Holy Individual About An Evil Presence

Text.text:
“此地已被幽暗的疯狂所攫住。我能感觉到自己的神圣之光在它面前黯淡下来。我们得小心前进。”
“A dark madness has taken hold of this place. I can feel my divine light dim in its presence. We should proceed carefully.”

Maligaant Menuk.name:
玛利伽安特·梅努克
Maligaant Menuk

Text.text:
魁梧的猫族如狮般威武，身高足有三米；他头顶环着一圈奢华的白色鬃毛，如光冠般耀眼——鬃毛下半段被精致编成辫子，点缀着黑与红的珠饰。长袍如墨黑与深红的厚重布幅，像加长的罩袍般垂覆在他骨与钢铸成的沉重护甲之上。皮带在胸前与背后交错绷紧，将两柄带爪形握柄的长刃稳稳固定在肩后，抬手便可触及。两把造型流畅的爆能手枪分别垂挂在双胯，嵌在抹了油的皮革枪套里。

~ 由一位英雄饰演

The hulking catfolk, leonine in appearance, stands three meters tall, his head haloed in an opulent white mane—the bottom half of which is braided beautifully and decorated with black and red beads. Robes—swathes of jet and crimson—drape like a long tabard over his heavy armor of bone and steel. Held in place by leather straps crisscrossing over chest and back, two blades with clawed hilts sit within easy reach over his shoulders. Two blaster pistols, sleek in their design, hang at each hip in oiled leather holsters.

~ Played by a Hero

Tormod Preillavun Cogsworth.name:
托莫德·普雷拉文·科格斯沃斯
Tormod Preillavun Cogsworth

Text.text:
他们那魁梧圆厚的身影，仿佛由肌肉与羽毛一同雕成——羽色雪白、浅褐与金黄交织。头戴一顶四角的牛颅骨面具，下身是野猪皮长裤，脚踝与腰间缀着熊毛；上身披一件丝质短衣，袖口绣着桔梗花纹。腰带上烙着某个大族的徽记，几柄华美的长剑近身垂挂，寒意逼人。鸟民的神情好奇而温和，举止却沉静耐心，既像谨慎的猎食者，又像一丝不苟的学者。开口时，猫头鹰与鹰隼般的咔嗒声与抑扬声调在空气中点点敲响。

~ Played by Christoffer

The grand, rotund figure they cut is made of muscle and feathers of white, light brown, and blond. They wear a four-horned skull of an ox, boar leather pants with bear fur at the ankles and waist, and a silk jacket with a bellflower motif on the sleeves. Their belt bears the insignia of a great house, with beautiful swords hanging close by. The birdfolk’s demeanor is curious and kind, with the calm and patient body language of both a careful predator and a meticulous scholar. When they speak, the clicks and tones of owl and eagle punctuate the air.

~ Played by Christoffer

I Cast Blade Barrier.name:
我施放【刀刃结界】
I Cast Blade Barrier

Text.text:
在我们前方，我以声音筑起一道墙。它由魔法利刃构成，随着我切割与挥斩的手势凭空迸生。我的语言由深沉粗粝的土腥转为锋锐的嘶嘶声，伴着我牙关的咬合摩擦。刀刃之墙自地面盘旋而起，层层堆砌成一道劈砍飞溅、血腥迫人的威胁。
Ahead of us, I use my voice to build a wall. It is made of magical blades, spawned forth by my cutting and slicing gestures. The language goes from deep and earthy to sharp-edged hisses and the gnashing of my teeth. The wall of blades whirls up from the ground, building into a slashing, bloody threat.

I Use My Beast Harness.name:
我驾驭我的兽之缰绳
I Use My Beast Harness

Text.text:
我握着镀金的挽具，低声念出那句命令词，忠诚的伙伴便在我面前于一阵闪烁能量的骤雨中凝聚成形，挽具安稳地落在他们背上。待头颅轮廓清晰，他们回过身来，以温暖而顽皮、盛满爱意的眼睛望向我——他们想我了。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Holding the gilded harness, I speak the command word and my faithful companion begins to coalesce before me in a shower of sparkling energy, the harness resting on their back. As their head takes shape, they turn to me with warm, playful eyes full of love—they have missed me.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Space Station Engineering Triage Hub.name:
空间站工程分流枢纽
Space Station Engineering Triage Hub

Text.text:
作为空间站跳动的心脏，分诊枢纽里永远塞满工程人员来来往往的躁动喧嚣；他们汇报已完成的工作，随即奔赴下一处任务。这里是一座冰冷的机库，墙面被巨大的屏幕所统治，荧光将一切浸透；枢纽是整座空间站的技术神经中枢，资深人员如同作战室里的将军般调度下属，指挥若定。
The beating heart of the space station, the triage hub is always filled with the restless tumult of engineering staff going to and fro, reporting on completed jobs before heading to the next. A cold hangar bathed in fluorescent light from the enormous screens dominating the walls, the hub is the technical nerve center of the entire station, with veteran staff coordinating their subordinates like generals in a war room.

Paladin Sprite.name:
圣骑士 小妖精（特征）
Paladin Sprite

Text.text:
静卧在你掌心时，这枚小妖精（特征）结节只是一块冰凉而光滑的石子，石面刻着六角纹章；可一旦启动，石子便先在空中悬停片刻，微微震颤，随即幽影般的中世纪护甲凭空凝结——将它化作一名小巧的金色骑士。那抹幽魂般的形体向前漂浮，周身散发出赤铜般泛红的战意光晕，细小的剑与盾高高举向天际。细看之下，那剑与盾的遮掩间，藏着两枚最尖端的微型智能枪互联装置。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Sitting dormant in your hand, the sprite nodule is a cool smooth stone bearing a hexagonal crest, but on activation the stone hovers for a moment, trembling, before ghostly medieval armor materializes—transforming it into a small golden knight. The spectral form emits a warlike aura of reddish bronze as it floats forward in the air, tiny sword and shield raised to the sky. To the close observer, that sword and shield obscure two cutting-edge miniature smart-gun interlinks.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

An Arrogant Friend’s Departure.name:
一位傲慢朋友的离去
An Arrogant Friend’s Departure

Text.text:
“拜托，别哭。我会在梦里再见到你们所有人。你们会都聚在我身边，像现在这样赞美我、爱着我。只是，你们都会更高——而且一丝不挂。非常赤裸。”
“Please, don’t cry. I will see you all again in my dreams. You’ll all be gathered around, praising and loving me just as you are now. Only, you’ll all be taller—and naked. Very naked.”

Foxy Freelance Pilot For Hire.name:
狡狐雇佣飞行员，随叫随到
Foxy Freelance Pilot For Hire

Text.text:
你走近时，这位红毛的狐族驾驶员嘴角一勾，露出一抹笑意；一双锐利的黑眼睛在你身上游走，搜寻着财富的蛛丝马迹。确认无误后，他们伸出一只纤细的手自我介绍，谈起手艺时不着痕迹地暗示着自己技能的等级。身上是打理得一丝不苟的边境装束，衬得他们愈发像个惹眼而狡黠的亡命之徒。
The vulpine features of the red-furred pilot twist into a smile as you approach, and their keen black eyes scan you for signs of wealth. Satisfied, they extend a slender hand and introduce themself, subtly hinting at their level of skill as they describe their craft. Dressed in well-maintained frontier clothing, they cut a strikingly roguish figure.

I Enter The Astral Plane With My Robe Of.name:
我披着群星长袍，踏入星界位面
I Enter The Astral Plane With My Robe Of Stars

Text.text:
我抓住兜帽的边缘——贴着皮肤冰冷如霜、丝滑如缎——猛地将它甩起罩上头顶。兜帽末端垂落到我眼前，视野被彻底的黑暗吞没，只持续了短短一瞬。胃里像有蝴蝶翻飞般发轻，仿佛整具身体猛然向后栽去。视线再度回归时，我正自在漂浮于繁星的位面之中；无尽空间那紫色的幕布在眼前铺展，令人心驰神往。
I grab the edges of my hood, which feel ice cold and silken against my skin, and fling it up over my head. The end of it hangs over my eyes and shrouds my vision in total darkness for only a moment. My stomach becomes light with butterflies, and it feels like my whole body lurches backward. My vision returns, and I am floating freely in a plane of stars, the purple backdrop of endless space exhilarating to behold.

Sundries From A Necromantic Flesh Mound.name:
亡灵血肉巨冢的杂物
Sundries From A Necromantic Flesh Mound

Text.text:
那团黏腻的咂响与可怖的、含混扭曲的哀嚎渐渐平息，肉丘塌沉到地面，像泄了气般瘪下去。那些被这头被召唤出的怪物夺走性命之人的残余散落四周：衣物、几件简陋的道具、腐烂的食物。大多已被那肉丘蠕行时拖出的污秽酸液半溶蚀得不成样子。
The squelching and horrid, garbled cries subside as the mound sinks to the floor, deflated. Remnants of those whose lives were taken by this conjured monstrosity lie about: clothes, simple pieces of gear, rotten foodstuffs. Most of it has been partially dissolved from whatever foul acid the mound left in its slithering trail.

尽管它的握柄与剑锷由再普通不过的木材与黄铜制成，这把短剑的剑身却近乎透明，薄得惊人。也不知是出自不可思议的附魔之力，还是近乎狂热的奇思巧造，剑身竟由一整块无瑕玻璃板凿削而成，打磨至单分子般的锋缘，并被施以重重魔法，使其几乎坚不可摧。它是一件一眼就能认出、却又显得不切实际的武器——但无论刺入血肉还是穿透护甲，都同样轻而易举。
Though its grips and hilt are made of perfectly normal wood and brass, this shortsword’s blade is almost transparent, and extremely thin. In an act of either incredible enchantment or overzealous inventiveness, the blade has been chipped out of a flawless plate of glass, honed to a monomolecular edge, and heavily enchanted to make it all but indestructible. An easily recognizable and impractical weapon, it is undoubtedly effective at piercing flesh or armor with equal ease.

Air Elemental: Dungeon Lair.name:
气元素：地城巢穴
Air Elemental: Dungeon Lair

Text.text:
一阵微风在这些厅室间游走，像有人在你后颈轻轻吐息，撩拨得汗毛倒竖。这个念头让你脊背一寒；你听见空气在走廊里低声穿行，仿佛这座地城正安静地呼吸——不是沉睡的吐纳，而像一头庞然巨兽伏在暗处，屏息守候。
A breeze stirs through these chambers, tickling the hairs on the back of your neck like someone’s breath. The thought sends a chill down your spine as you hear the whisper of air moving through the halls, as if the dungeon is taking quiet breaths—not like something sleeping, but like some great beast lying in wait.

一名傲然的女性挺立原地，朴素的街头衣着却一尘不染；衣下肌肤是最深沉的靛蓝，霓虹粉的头发随意挽成乱蓬蓬的发髻。她的一切看不出半分造作——尤其是指尖聚拢的点点电火花。她虽看似镇定，目光却在左右间急速游移。右眼上方纹着一小串二进制代码，而她的皮肤本身正噼啪作响，仿佛蓄满了随时爆发的能量。
A proud female stands erect, her nondescript street clothes immaculate, her skin of deepest indigo beneath them, and her neon pink hair tied in a messy bun. None of her appearance seems artificial, not least the gathering sparks at her fingertips. Although she stands composed, her eyes dart back and forth. Over her right eye is a small tattoo of binary code, and her very skin crackles with potential energy.

Modern Dinosaur Breeder.name:
现代恐龙饲育师
Modern Dinosaur Breeder

Text.text:
育种师披着洁白无瑕的实验袍，大步穿过明亮而冷冽的临床实验室，审视着最新孵育的一簇卵。透过孵化器的玻璃，科学家以近乎父母般的敬畏守夜着：第一枚蛋壳上先是浮现细密裂纹，随即探出一张细小的喙状嘴，以及微若尘埃的角芽。
Striding across the bright clinical laboratory in a pristine lab coat, the breeder inspects their latest cluster of eggs. Peering through the incubator glass, the scientist watches in almost parental awe as cracks begin to show across the first shell, followed by a tiny beaked mouth and miniscule horns.

Sword Dancer's Defensive Stance.name:
剑舞者的防御架势
Sword Dancer's Defensive Stance

Text.text:
手臂与胯部在令人目眩的节奏中一同摆动，娴熟的移动驱使他们双手各持的弯刀划出连绵不绝的流畅弧线。乍看之下，根本无从判断他们会从哪个角度出手，而那难以捉摸的轨迹也会在眨眼间封死防御上任何看似存在的破绽。

~ 构想：OscarMike

Arms and hips move together in a mesmerizing rhythm, the practiced movement sending the scimitars they hold in each hand in continuously flowing arcs. At a glance, it's impossible to tell from what angle they'll choose to strike, and the unpredictable patterns close any apparent opening in their defenses immediately.

~ Envisioned by OscarMike

Thalmor Fiddlebender Of The Hidden Ways.name:
隐秘之道的萨尔莫·提琴拨弦者
Thalmor Fiddlebender Of The Hidden Ways

Text.text:
巨大的翡翠色眼眸迸射出逼人的光芒，汗珠在那男人的额头滚落。他身形修长而精雕细琢，肤色带着泥土般的沉稳，仿佛一团陶土被巧手捏塑成型。两把邪异弯曲的弯刀在他攥得发白的手中闪着冷光，像蓄势待噬的獠牙；他以曾与死亡共舞之人的老练目光，紧盯着对手的移动。瞥见敌人身后有一丝移动掠过，他那布满风霜的脸上掠过一抹笑意，随即发出攻击的信号。原始的凶暴在一瞬间爆开——灌木丛轰然炸裂，獠牙与利爪翻涌成风，他那剑齿虎伙伴从暗处扑出，伏击敌人。今晚，它们会吃得很饱。

~ Played by a Hero

Large emerald eyes flash with intensity as sweat beads on the man’s brow. His sculpted, slender build, coupled with the earthy tone of his skin, gives him the appearance of clay, molded into form by skilled hands. Wickedly curved scimitars gleam in his white-knuckled hands, like fangs waiting to strike as he watches the movements of his foe with the practiced eye of one who has danced with death before. A smile flickers across his craggy face as he catches a glimpse of movement behind his enemy, and he signals the attack. With primal savagery, the bushes explode into a flurry of fangs and claws as his saber-toothed companions ambush the enemy. They’ll eat well tonight.

~ Played by a Hero

Elven Mess Hall.name:
精灵食堂
Elven Mess Hall

Text.text:
雅致的橡木长凳与长桌占据了这座开阔大厅的大半空间，桌面与椅背上雕刻着纵情欢宴与同袍情谊的场景。温暖的光束从高窗与天窗斜斜洒入，雕琢成形、宛如等距树干的柱子托起倾斜的天花。每张长桌都摆满木制餐具与刀叉，盛着各式食物——鲜绿菜叶、野蒜、蘑菇、浆果、酥脆面包、鹿肉小排与鱼柳、盛在透明小瓶里的绿色油液——以及晶莹的醒酒壶中紫色葡萄酒。香气在凝滞的空气里愉悦地交融。身着制服的精灵占据了大多数长凳，正共享一顿友善的餐食。其中一人从大厅中央的凳子上拿起竖琴，轻轻拨弦。

~ 构想：Battersby

Elegant oaken benches and tables, carved with scenes of revelry and comradery, occupy most of the space in an open hall. Warm rays angle in from tall windows and skylights, and sculpted pillars resembling evenly spaced tree trunks hold up the angled ceiling. Bedecked with wooden tableware and cutlery, each board holds a variety of food—greens, wild leeks, mushrooms, berries, crisp bread, venison cutlets and fish fillets, clear flasks of green oil—and crystal decanters of purple wine. The aromas mix pleasantly in the still air. Elves in uniforms occupy most of the benches, sharing a friendly meal. One of them plucks a harp from a stool at the hall’s center.

~ Envisioned by Battersby

Tournament Evening Dance.name:
锦标赛之夜舞会
Tournament Evening Dance

Text.text:
凉亭里是一场喧嚣奢靡的欢宴。趾高气扬的贵族男女踏着舞步嬉闹腾跃，礼服在过度的华丽中闪耀，脸上浓妆艳抹，发髻盘成一座座繁复的卷曲雕塑。身着洁净齐整制服的乐师们伴着一名精灵吟游诗人——他们的演奏与她的歌喉宛如天籁和鸣。
The pavilion is a boisterous extravaganza of merriment. Strutting lords and ladies caper and cavort, their gowns gleaming with excess, faces painted, hair elaborate creations of twisted curls. Musicians garbed in pristine uniformity accompany an elven bard—their playing and her voice in angelic harmony.

Bracers Of Archery.name:
精准射手护臂
Bracers Of Archery

Text.text:
一副柔韧的棕色皮护腕，以黑曜石与白银镶边，表面刻着飞驰之箭的纹样。护腕上下各有一圈符文——当你将它们套上时，手臂与背脊涌起力量，掌心变得沉稳，视野也随之愈发锐利。
The bracers of supple brown leather, trimmed with onyx and silver, display etchings of arrows in flight. Runes ring the top and bottom—and slipping them on, you feel a strength in your arms and back, a steadiness in your hand, and a sharpening of your sight.

一只高大的恶魔浑身散发着酸橙绿的幽光，悍然屹立于死亡之前。疲惫与迷惘的浪潮自它黏稠的身躯中一阵阵扩散，受辐照的液体哗啦哗啦地滴落在地。它头顶的“冠”似乎更为凝实，凝出甲壳质的犄角与爪，亮绿的骨质闪着寒光。它的面孔被辐射扭曲，六只眼睛环拱着一张漩涡般的嘴，口涎不住淌下脓液似的黏物。
A tall demon glowing with lime-green luminescence stands in defiance of death. Waves of fatigue and confusion radiate off its gloopy body, irradiated liquid slopping onto the ground. The crown of its head seems somewhat more solid, forming chitinous horns and claws of bright green bone. Its face is twisted by radiation, six eyes surrounding a vortex mouth that salivates a pus-like substance.

Haunted House: Servants' Room.name:
闹鬼宅邸：仆役房
Haunted House: Servants' Room

Text.text:
这间毗邻地下餐厅的前室原本供宅邸仆役进出，如今被改作洗碗间一名低阶杂役的卧室。屋内陈设寒酸，处处透着一种长久的绝望——仿佛住在这里的人早已失去所有野心与希望。霉味扑鼻的床铺里似乎传来断断续续、令人心碎的啜泣声，可床上床下都不见任何人影。
This antechamber adjacent to the basement dining room used by the servants of the house has been converted into a bedroom for a low-ranking member of the scullery. The meager furnishings reflect a sense of lasting despair of someone who had lost all sense of ambition or hope. The soft sounds of heartsick weeping seem to come from the musty-smelling bed, but there is no sign of anyone in or under the bed itself.

Taunt From An Alerted Dragon.name:
来自惊觉巨龙的嘲讽
Taunt From An Alerted Dragon

Text.text:
“这又是什么？我在休息时，有个小东西偷偷摸摸地靠近我？真是懦弱。也许在你生命的最后时刻，当你的皮肤从身上剥落、起泡脱离，你会学会一点尊重。”

~ 构想：Battersby

“And what is this? A tiny thing sneaking up on me while I rest? Such cowardice. Perhaps in your final moments, when your skin peels and blisters off your body, you’ll learn a little respect.”

~ Envisioned by Battersby

Tavern Brawl: Music To Match The Moment.name:
酒馆斗殴：应景的乐声
Tavern Brawl: Music To Match The Moment

Text.text:
乐队奏起一段轻快活泼的曲子，正适合酒客们狠狠干上一拳、把彼此的脸打得开花。它给这场酒馆斗殴的暴烈披上了嘉年华般的气氛，让不少打斗者都咧嘴笑了起来——至少在一记拳头或飞掷的酒杯把笑容砸没之前。
The band strikes up a sprightly tune, one well suited to patrons smashing one another in the face. It lends the violence of the tavern brawl a carnival atmosphere, putting grins on the faces of many combatants—at least until a fist or tossed tankard wipes the smiles off.

Cleric Summons A Pack Of Wolves.name:
牧师召来一群狼
Cleric Summons A Pack Of Wolves

Text.text:
小巷渐趋昏暗，牧师的双眼却被黄昏与黎明的力量点燃。伴随一声哀恸的长嗥，狼群自新生的阴影中猛然跃出，眸光如虹彩星辰，獠牙尽是最纯粹的暗影。破败街道里，碎屑堵塞的沟渠中老鼠仓皇奔逃，而这些被召唤的野兽朝牧师的目标发动攻击。

~ 由 Envisioned 的 Tusker2zero 在 Discord 上构思

The alley grows dark as the cleric's eyes alight with the power of dusk and dawn. With a mournful howl, wolves spring from the newly formed shadows, their eyes iridescent stars and their fangs purest shadow. Rats flee the debris-choked gutters of the decrepit street as the conjured beasts attack the cleric’s target.

~ Envisioned by Tusker2zero on Discord

Loot From A Silver Dragon Lair.name:
银龙巢穴的战利品
Loot From A Silver Dragon Lair

Text.text:
在巨龙巢穴的地底深处，远离尖啸的狂风与灼骨的严寒，你发现一座旧监牢被改作金库。每间铁栏牢房里都堆满了钱币，按颜色整整齐齐地分开：金、银、铜。其中一间牢房堆着家具与艺术品，这处空间俨然一座袖珍画廊。巨龙显然费心将每件作品摆放得一丝不苟，连半点尘埃都不见。最夺目的物品是一幅镶在银色画框中的巨画：一条银龙掠过翻涌怒海，身侧伴着两条幼龙。
In the dungeon depths of the dragon’s lair, away from the shrieking winds and the blistering cold, you find an old jail repurposed as a vault. Each iron-barred cell holds piles of coins, organized by color: gold, silver, and copper. One of the cells holds furniture and art pieces, and the space resembles a diminutive art gallery. The dragon had taken care to display each piece neatly, and there’s not a speck of dust on any of them. The most eye-catching item is a large painting in a silver frame: a silver dragon soaring over a roiling sea with two wyrmlings by its side.

你口齿含混，随着你完成法术，万事万物、所有人都仿佛慢了下来。指尖垂着一团糖蜜，凝在半空，它的移动在这被窃来的时代里几乎难以察觉。你感到心跳起落之间被硬生生拉开了一道停顿，你知道自己逗留得太久了。你将魔法倒转向敌人，骤然释放法术。
Your words slur, and everything and everyone seems to slow as you complete the spell. The dollop of molasses hangs from your fingertips, its movement almost imperceptible in this moment of stolen time. You feel a pause between the start and end of a heartbeat, and you know you’ve lingered too long. You turn the magic against your enemies and unleash the spell.

从盘蛇浮雕的封印中，巨蟒拔地而起，通体幽光，仿佛由月华凝成。它们的双眼如同星野铺展。随着它们逐渐成形，幽影般的神殿墙壁也随之显现，南侧入口处更浮现出一扇双开大门。此地群蛇冰冷的目光与探寻的信舌一并游弋，搜寻着闯入者。
From the engraved seals of coiled snakes rise giant serpents, glowing as if made of moonlight. Their eyes are fields of stars. As they materialize, so do the ghostly temple walls and a double door at the southern entryway. The cold eyes and seeking tongues of all the snakes here search for intruders.

这条小蛇生着一对翅膀，乍看颇似幼龙，然而哪怕刚出壳的幼龙也不可能如此渺小。它那沉稳不移的注视中，清晰透出寻常野兽少见的机敏聪慧。
The wings of this tiny serpent make it look somewhat like a dragonling, though of course no dragonling—even at birth—is this small. A cleverness unusual in most beasts can be easily perceived in its steady gaze.

I Drink My Potion Of Speed.name:
我喝下我的速度药水
I Drink My Potion Of Speed

Text.text:
我拔开瓶塞，一股浓烈的甘草气味扑面而来。我把瓶口凑到嘴边，饮下那团旋涡般翻涌的药剂，感觉它在口中以明亮的螺旋打着转，直到我才勉强咽下。那急速翻腾的魔法顷刻间将振奋的能量嗡鸣般灌遍全身，我感觉自己快得不可思议，仿佛蜂鸟振翅一般。
I unstopper the bottle and smell a strong scent of licorice wafting out. I bring it to my mouth and drink the swirling potion, feeling it swish around in bright spirals before I manage to swallow it. This fast-churning magic sends an invigorating hum of energy throughout my body, and I feel as impossibly quick as a hummingbird's wings.

I Cast Find The Path With Runes.name:
我用符文施放「寻路术」。
I Cast Find The Path With Runes

Text.text:
我紧紧攥着那件来自目的地的物体，吟诵着我的法术咒文，将符文抛向空中。它们悬停片刻，如同轻盈舞步般旋转流转，继而骤然绽放强光，闪烁着魔法能量的微辉。与目的地相连的气味与声响涌入我的感官；一条闪耀的小径——仅有数寸宽——在我面前浮现，宛如金色丝线，牵引着我找到归途。
Holding the object from my destination tightly, I throw the runes in the air as I chant the words of my spell. They hover for a moment, swirling in a delicate dance, before glowing brightly and shimmering with magical energy. Scents and sounds linked with my destination fill my senses as a glittering path—inches wide—appears before me, a golden thread to find my way back.

I Channel Divinity For Twilight Sanctuar.name:
我施放神圣引导：暮光圣域
I Channel Divinity For Twilight Sanctuary

Text.text:
我轻轻挥动长剑，在身周划出一记优雅的弧线，缓缓旋身，呼唤女神之名。银白辉光的微尘自旋舞的剑刃间跃起，随之起舞。它们充盈成一枚圆月般的光球。一阵宁静的寂然伴着昏暗光照落下，将黑暗里仍可闪现微光的希望一并带来。

~ 由 Kris Essler 构想

I gently swing my sword around me in an artful arc, slowly twirling, and invoke the goddess. Motes of silvery radiance dance from the whirling blade. They fill a sphere like a full moon. A calm hush settles in with the dim light, carrying with it the hope of a glimmer in the dark.

~ Envisioned by Kris Essler

一阵咯咯轻笑将你的视线从穿林小径上牵走。你在刹那间瞥见一张诡异而妩媚的面孔，随即便被树干吞没般消失不见。那张容颜比任何精灵都更像妖精，却又隐约有几分相似；她的身量大约与精灵等高。你身后又传来一声窃笑，你回头只来得及捕捉到一具轻盈的身影闪进树后。也许你已被包围——可那笑声听起来竟一模一样。
A giggle draws your gaze from the track through the forest, and you see for the briefest moment an eldritch and feminine face before it vanishes behind a tree’s trunk. The visage was more fey than any elf, although there was some resemblance, and she was perhaps an elf’s height. Another titter comes from over your shoulder, and you catch a glimpse of a lithe form disappearing behind a tree. Perhaps you are surrounded, but the voice sounded exactly the same.

Atlantean Axe Wielder Charging.name:
亚特兰蒂斯持斧者冲锋
Atlantean Axe Wielder Charging

Text.text:
战士咬紧牙关发出低吼，怒火灼眼，眯起的目光如刀。华丽的头盔下，长长的红发倾泻而出。那抹赤色与他们身上的翠绿皮甲形成鲜明对比，肩甲与臂甲以明黄点缀。手中战斧寒光淬利……他们直冲你而来。
The warrior growls through their teeth, eyes squinted in wrath. Long red hair spills out from under an elaborate helm. The color contrasts against the green leather pieces they wear, accented with yellow pauldrons and vambraces. They carry a sharpened axe… and charge right at you.

山谷蜿蜒穿行于大地，宛如神祇凿出的深深辙痕；两侧缓缓倾斜，谷底圆润，密密的植被将其噎得透不过气。亘古以前，一条冰川啃噬泥土与岩石，雕出这道谷地——退去之后，留下曲折的幽谷，两旁堆起被推挤迁移的土石丘陵。
The valley winds through the landscape like a deep rut carved by gods, its sides sloped gently, its bottom rounded, choked with vegetation. Eons ago a glacier carved this valley, chewing through earth and stone—leaving in its wake a meandering vale with hills of displaced material on either side.

Indoor Shooting Range.name:
室内射击场
Indoor Shooting Range

Text.text:
空弹壳叮当作响，如细雨簌落，其间又被枪声的雷霆一次次截断——射击位里的客人们正对着靶道尽头倒霉的全息靶疯狂倾泻火力。一个隔间里，身着笔挺定制西装的男人将整匣子弹一口气打空，棱角分明的面孔凝成癫狂而快意的狞笑。另一个隔间里，一名目光如钢的老兵端着步枪，以冷峻的军式精准逐一点杀目标；她受过的训练清晰可见，让她凌驾于那些民间的枪械狂热者之上。
Empty shells rattle like soft rain, punctuated by the thunder of gunfire, as patrons blast away at the luckless holographic targets downrange. In one booth, a man in a sharp, tailored suit unloads a full magazine, his sharp features frozen in a crazed rictus of enjoyment. In another, a steely-eyed veteran with a rifle picks off her targets with cold military precision, her training—clearly evident—raising her above the civilian gun jockeys.

Open-air Tavern: A Quiet Day.name:
露天酒馆：平静的一天
Open-air Tavern: A Quiet Day

Text.text:
酒馆里一排排桌椅大多空着。厨房里虽有水在咕嘟翻滚，却闻不出开火做饭的香气。越过屋顶的庇护望去，街道空空荡荡、昏昏欲睡；一层淡雾轻轻落在周遭的镇子上。
The many tables and benches stand largely empty about the tavern. Though water boils in the kitchen, it doesn’t smell like cooking has started. Beyond the shelter of the ceiling, the streets look empty and sleepy as a light mist falls on the surrounding town.

Brag About Stoicism.name:
夸耀你的坚忍
Brag About Stoicism

Text.text:
“我向你保证，在我这沉默寡言、冷峻克制的表象之下，藏着许多深邃而有趣的念头、机敏的洞察，以及令人毛骨悚然的见解。只是我不太愿意把这些分享给你这种人。”
“I assure you, behind my silent, stoic persona lies many deep and interesting thoughts, clever observations, and eerie insights. I’m just not keen on sharing them with the likes of you.”

一群庞然巨兽轰隆隆地踏过葱郁的平原，地面随之闷响震颤。蛇般修长的颈项从象一般的身躯上探出；它们的皮肤由灰绿鳞片拼成斑驳的马赛克，在暮色将尽的夕阳里闪烁微光。巨兽的头颅在空中起伏，几乎高达五十英尺，嘴巴漫不经心地张合，用如巨石般的牙齿咀嚼掠过树冠顶端的叶片。即便隔着这般距离，也能感到这些巨灵的温柔——在它们柔和却如雷的行进声里，弥漫着一种宁静。
A rumbling herd of colossal creatures thumps across the verdant plain. Serpentine necks extend from elephantine bodies. Their skin, a mosaic of gray-green scales, glitters in the dying sun. Their heads bob nearly fifty feet into the air, mouths casually opening to munch leaves from the tops of passing canopies with their boulder teeth. Even from this distance, there’s a sense a gentleness from the behemoths, a peace in the soft thunder of their passing.

Thassius Wallowbrook.name:
塔西乌斯·沃洛布鲁克
Thassius Wallowbrook

Text.text:
半身人喉间发出一阵细尖的轻笑，红润的脸颊在青绿色眼眸下微微鼓起。他衣着考究，钉刺皮甲衫穿在身上恰到好处——没有一颗铆钉偏位，也没有一道缝线别扭地皱起。他的深金发显然刚打理过，后脑与两鬓剃得干净利落，头顶却刻意留下一撮俏皮的卷发，略显凌乱却恰如其分。双手交握，搭在腰侧细剑的剑柄上；细剑收在黑皮剑鞘里。剑柄护手的横档处向外延展出一圈圈泛蓝的钢环，盘旋缠绕，让那护手看上去像一处暴怒的漩涡。

~ Played by Deighle with

A reedy chuckle leaves the halfling’s throat, his ruddy cheeks rounding beneath his teal eyes. He is a finely dressed fellow, and his studded leather shirt fits him just right—not a stud out of place nor a seam bunching awkwardly. His dark blond hair has been recently coiffed to a clean shave at the back of his head and temples, with a charming tousle of curls left on top. Both hands rest clasped on the hilt of the rapier at his side, sheathed in a black leather scabbard. Swirling rings of bluish steel extend out from the crosspiece of the hilt, giving the handguard the look of a raging whirlpool.

~ Played by Deighle with

这名类人生物高高耸立在你面前，神情沉着却粗蛮。它那近乎虹彩般的蓝色肌肤如晶莹寒冰般闪烁，雪白的头发编成繁复的长辫，结扣分明。它披着兽皮，与周遭景色融为一体，静止时几乎与山岩无异，直到它微微一动才显出轮廓。它双手握着一根树干般大小的巨棒。
The humanoid creature towers over you with a calm but brutish visage. Their blue, almost iridescent, skin shimmers like crystalline ice and their snowy white hair is knotted in elaborate braids. They wear furs and blend into the surrounding landscape, appearing almost like mountain stone until they stir. In their hands they wield a club the size of a tree.

Cleric Casts Teleportation Circle.name:
牧师施放传送法阵
Cleric Casts Teleportation Circle

Text.text:
手因肾上腺素而颤抖，牧师在地面刻下奥术符印，向自己的神祈祷，但愿他们还记得这道法术的正确咒式。钢铁交击与伤者的哀号震耳欲聋，这位圣战士开始吟诵以启动传送门的咒文，拼命逼迫自己集中精神。刹那一道闪光，符号爆裂出刺目的光芒，传送门随之显现。

~ Tusker2zero 于 Discord

Hands trembling with adrenaline, the cleric marks the arcane sigils on the ground, offering a prayer to their god that they have remembered the spell correctly. Clashing steel and the cries of the wounded become deafening as the holy warrior begins the incantation to activate the portal, desperately trying to focus. With a flash, the symbols erupt in blinding light, and the portal appears.

~ Tusker2zero on Discord

Elderly Triceratops.name:
年迈的三角龙
Elderly Triceratops

Text.text:
满是深刻伤疤、饱经摧残的颈盾昭示着这头三角龙在同类中是顽强的幸存者，然而如今它的身躯几乎已难以支撑自身的重量。老战士以深琥珀色的眼睛扫视着地平线，族群的成员在一旁尽情啃食繁茂的植被，它却始终保持警惕，提防随时可能到来的伏击。
A battered frill replete with deep scars marks the triceratops as a hardy survivor among its kin, though its body is scarcely able to support its own weight now. The old warrior scans the horizon with deep amber eyes as members of its clan eat their fill of the lush vegetation nearby, always wary of a potential ambush.

Trashy Hologram Dealer Storefront.name:
廉价全息贩子的店面
Trashy Hologram Dealer Storefront

Text.text:
一间破败的摊位里，摇摇欲坠的光影人形向外招呼，每一次移动都让它们的身躯闪烁不定。柜台后，一个男人以黯淡的眼神守夜般盯着它们，隔一会儿就敲一下平板，变换那些招徕顾客的全息投影形态。
Shaky figures of light call out from a run-down booth, each movement making their bodies flicker. A man behind the counter watches them with dull eyes, every once in a while tapping a tablet to change the forms of the holograms beckoning customers in.

你以锐利的目光锁定目标生物，吐出奥秘的号令。幽魂般的光芒自你身上猛然抽射而出，照亮那生物，并以与你相系的神秘符文将其烙印。你感知到那生物——即便它遁入视线之外，你也能捕捉到它的存在。你的猎物无处可逃。
You train your keen eyes on the intended creature and speak the arcane command. A spectral light lashes out from you, illuminating the creature and marking them with a mystic rune tied to you. You feel the creature—feel their presence even as they duck out of sight. Your quarry cannot escape.

I Cast Protection From Evil And Good.name:
我施放《防护邪恶与善良》
I Cast Protection From Evil And Good

Text.text:
听见我包里护符相互碰撞的轻响——那瓶能灼烧恶魔的圣水，以及能让天使之翼失却风势的铁粉——我施放了我的防护法术。仿佛有一层薄纱从我眼前揭起，一块重石从我心口卸下。这些存在，无论圣洁还是污秽，此刻都不比寻常野兽或流窜匪徒更具威胁……至少，暂时如此。
Hearing my wards clinking in my bag—the bottle of holy water that burns demons, and the powdered iron that takes the wind out of angels’ wings—I cast my protective spell. It is as if a veil is lifted from my eyes, a weight taken off of my heart. These beings, holy or unholy, are no more a threat than the average beast or marauding bandit… for now.

Corporate Spacecraft Docking Bays And Sh.name:
企业航天器对接舱与造船厂
Corporate Spacecraft Docking Bays And Shipyard

Text.text:
最尖端的舰艇安稳停泊在这座私营船厂的干船坞中，一支无可挑剔的团队身着笔挺制服，悉心照看。披着流线黑色护甲的武装警卫在空间内巡逻，一名官腔十足的女子一边逐艰巡视每艘船只，一边在闪亮的平板上细致记录。
State-of-the-art vessels sit comfortably in dry-docks within the private shipyard, attended by a team of peerless staff in crisp uniforms. Armed guards clad in sleek black body-armor patrol the space, and an officious woman makes meticulous notes on a gleaming tablet as she inspects each craft.

Unexpected Snowfall In Hot Climate.name:
炎热气候中的突如其来降雪
Unexpected Snowfall In Hot Climate

Text.text:
困惑的脸庞仰向苍白的天空，柔软的灰云之中，雪花轻轻飘落，将这片本该被阳光炙烤的土地覆上一层闷静的白。身着鲜亮夏装的居民彼此交换着难以置信的目光，纷飞的雪粒仍在落下，以冬日般轻柔的吻，撩拨着裸露的肌肤。

~ 构想：MaesterAelix（Discord）

Bemused faces turn to the pallid sky as snow drifts gently down from the soft, gray clouds, blanketing the usually sun-drenched land in muffled stillness. Residents in vibrant summer attire exchange their disbelief as the flakes continue to fall, tickling exposed skin with the delicate kiss of winter.

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

I Summon A Tsunami.name:
我召唤海啸
I Summon A Tsunami

Text.text:
我的双手以流畅而有节奏的轨迹舞动，召唤法术的能量。体内的狂澜翻涌而起，挣扎着要冲破束缚；而我竭力与之抗衡，死死维系着正在引导的力量。随着法术逼近完成，胸腔里逐渐堆积起一种令人窒息的压迫感，仿佛只要分神片刻，肺叶就会被它生生撑裂。就在我感觉自己再也撑不住的刹那，法术完成了——一股泰坦般的巨浪在我面前轰然爆发，挟着无拘的元素暴怒，直扑我的敌人。

~ 由一位英雄构想

My hands move in a fluid, rhythmic motion as I summon the energies of the spell. The maelstrom rises within me, straining for freedom, as I battle to keep control of the power I am channeling. A crushing sensation builds in my chest as the spell nears completion, threatening to burst my lungs if I lose focus. Just as I feel I can hold on no longer, the spell is complete, and a titanic wave erupts before me, rushing toward my enemies with untethered elemental fury.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Warlock Casting Toll The Dead.name:
术士施放《亡者丧钟》
Warlock Casting Toll The Dead

Text.text:
术士在引导其宗主的力量时，面容凹陷空洞——仿佛体内的生机尽数抽离。祂抬起一根干枯如槁的手指，为敌人烙下死亡的印记。钟声在目标周遭敲响，哀恸如挽歌回荡，而一波波死灵能量随之轰然袭来。

~ 一位英雄所构想

The warlock’s face appears sunken and hollow—as though all life has left their body—while they channel the power of their patron. Raising a desiccated finger, they mark their enemy for death. A bell chimes a mournful lament around the target as they are struck by waves of necrotic energy.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

House Badger Commons (The Sett).name:
獾家公馆公共区（獾穴）
House Badger Commons (The Sett)

Text.text:
穿过塔楼的地窖，深入一座低矮山丘之中，这座房舍被设计成一组整洁的隧道与厅室。畏惧狭窄的人往往不会被安置在獾屋；而那些钟爱大地的安适——温暖的被褥、低燃的泥炭火，以及炖锅里的家常热食——则会在这处地穴中寻得深沉的休息与庇护。
Through the cellars of the tower, into a low hill, the house is designed in a configuration of clean tunnels and chambers. The claustrophobic tend not to be placed in House Badger, but those who love the comforts of the earth, warm quilts and low peat fires, and stewpot meals, find deep rest and protection in the sett.

Welcome From The Potion Shop Owner.name:
来自药剂店老板的欢迎
Welcome From The Potion Shop Owner

Text.text:
“问候。尽管随意挑看我的货物，但不要接触。你知道他们怎么说：你把它弄坏了，我们都会死得很惨！”
“Greetings. Feel free to look over my wares but do not touch. You know what they say: you break it, we all die horribly!”

Brass Buckle For A Narrow Belt.name:
窄腰带用黄铜扣
Brass Buckle For A Narrow Belt

Text.text:
高档场所里车夫、侍从、服务生与管家最常见的配饰。它是一块简洁的长方形，配有坚固的横杆与不显眼的别针。
The most common accoutrement for coachmen, footmen, wait staff, and butlers at fine establishments. This is a simple rectangle with a strong bar and an inconspicuous prong.

Safe House In The Slums.name:
贫民窟中的安全屋
Safe House In The Slums

Text.text:
尽管在废弃庄园外的乞丐向你指出通往地下秘道的入口后，你心里仍存疑虑，但当你终于抵达他所描述的终点时，还是不由松了口气：一处隐秘的藏身洞，足以避开窥探的目光。隧道豁然通入一间宽阔的厅室，昏暗的紫色火把摇曳照明，紫罗兰般的光泽覆在房间中央那架华丽三角钢琴的抛光木面上，泛起一层诡异的亮。你站定，正要细细打量，远处一座酒吧后方走出一个魁梧男人，穿着剪裁利落的海军蓝西装。他只与你短暂对视，便捏响指节，落座钢琴前，瞬间奏起一段充满灵魂的赋格，仿佛将整间厅室都灌满了回响。你注意到左侧有一条走廊通向几扇敞开的门，随意一瞥便见每个房间都只有简朴的陈设，却收拾得干净整齐。

~ 构想：Bangalulu

Though you had your doubts even after the beggar outside showed you the opening to the secret passage under the ruined manor, you are relieved when you finally arrive at the destination described to you: a hidden bolthole, safe from prying eyes. The tunnel opens into a large chamber lit by dim purple torches, the violet light casting a peculiar sheen over the polished wood of the grand piano featured in the room's center. As you stand and drink in your surroundings, a large man dressed in a natty navy-blue suit emerges from behind a well-stocked bar on the far side of the room. Making only brief eye contact with you, he cracks his knuckles and sits before the piano, instantly launching into a soulful fugue that seems to fill the chamber. You notice a hallway to your left leading to several open doors, and a cursory glance reveals that each room features only spartan furnishings, though they are clean and tidy.

~ Envisioned by Bangalulu

Motorized One-wheel Board.name:
电动独轮滑板
Motorized One-wheel Board

Text.text:
旁边放着一段弧形金属板，形似滑板，表面满是刮痕与磨损，显然经常使用。框架中央有一只硕大的轮子从中探出。板前端附近有个脚踏板，看起来用来控制轮子的速度。
A contoured length of metal like a skateboard sits nearby, scuffed and worn from use, with one large wheel in the center coming up through the frame. A foot pedal near the front of the board looks like it controls the wheel's speed.

Temple In Icy Winter.name:
冰封寒冬的神殿
Temple In Icy Winter

Text.text:
神殿被冰霜勾勒，古老而庄严。空气冰寒刺骨，凛冽却令人精神一振——仿佛此地赐福的神圣伟力吐息。支撑穹顶的凹槽巨柱巍然矗立，其恢弘尺度昭示着令人瞠目的工程与建造专长。然而，自厚重大梁垂落的冰锥却是自然的造物：如獠牙般悬在神殿入口之上，蓄势待发。
The temple stands limned in ice and ancient majesty. The air is frigid, harsh yet bracing—a breath of the holy power that blesses this place. The immensity of the fluted columns keeping the structure’s roof aloft evince a staggering feat of engineering and construction. The icicles hanging from the massive entablatures, however, are nature’s creations: poised like fangs over the temple’s entrance.

I Cast Minor Visual Illusion.name:
我施放微型视觉幻象
I Cast Minor Visual Illusion

Text.text:
一簇紫色能量在我掌心跳动。我像抛接球一样将它上下抛掷，让脑海中的画面愈发清晰。我把光球掷出，它落地的瞬间，色彩如同打翻的颜料罐般炸开四溅。法术将那片区域浸透，精准塑出我所设想的景象。只在一眨眼的工夫，魔法的流光便归于平静，只剩下我的幻象伫立原地。
A spark of purple energy pulses in my hand. I toss it up and down like a ball, ensuring my desired image is clear in my mind. I throw the orb and, as it lands, a splash of color erupts from it like an upturned can of paint. The spell drenches the spot, crafting the image exactly as I envisioned it. In the span of just a moment, the sparkling of magic calms and only my illusion remains.

Nat The Changeling.name:
纳特（易形者）
Nat The Changeling

Text.text:
Nat——究竟是谁？又有谁能透过这位崇高而孤绝的生物那千面万相，看清其真容？一种形态下，Nat 显得偏男性：棱角粗粝，日晒成古铜的皮肤与健美的体格；衣物褪色、磨损得恰到好处；双手满是老茧。另一种形态下，Nat 更偏女性：身着最上乘的时尚衣装，一缕缕赤褐色波浪长发衬着她白皙而娴静的面容。而在更多时候，Nat 的外貌近乎无法解释——灰白的皮肤，几乎没有五官的脸。哪个才是真正的 Nat？真正的答案是三者皆是，但活着的人里，知晓此真相者寥寥无几。

~ Played by FreightTrain with

Who is Nat—really? Can anyone see past the myriad masks, the various visages of this sublime, solitary creature? In one form, Nat appears masculine: rough around the edges, with sun-browned skin and an athletic build; clothes faded, well-worn; and hands calloused. In another, Nat appears more feminine: dressed in the finest fashions, waves of auburn hair framing her fair, demure face. And still other times, Nat’s appearance defies explanation, with gray-white skin and a nearly featureless face. Who is the real Nat? The true answer is all three, but few alive know this truth.

~ Played by FreightTrain with

时代摧毁了这座巨型斗兽场外侧环形高墙的一部分，只剩下一道道拱券的基座。其间有些空隙立着英雄雕像，另一些则空洞无物，或只残留破碎人形的断肢残躯。外环那道巨大的缺口暴露出层层叠叠的石质看台、碎石遍布的过道，以及横贯竞技场的开裂柱廊。与外环破口相对，较低的内墙上，一排排拱门通向一片沙地，地面张着深不见底的巨坑。热风穿行于古老石间，卷起尘土，抽打出一股带着铜腥的气味，让人恍惚忆起早已消散的人潮怒吼。

~ Envisioned by Scuttle-Stab

Time has demolished part of this massive coliseum’s outer ringing wall, leaving only the foundation of arches. Heroic statues occupy some of the spaces between, while others stand hollow or with the remains of broken figures. The wide gap in the outer ring exposes tiered stone seating, rubble-strewn aisles, and cracked porticos across the arena. Opposite this outer break, archways in a lower inner wall open onto a sandy expanse with gaping pits. A hot breeze blows amid the old stones, stirring dust, whipping up a coppery smell, and calling to mind the roar of a long-absent crowd.

~ Envisioned by Scuttle-Stab

Rod Of Security.name:
安保权杖
Rod Of Security

Text.text:
这根雕琢成形的短杖镶嵌着恬美的乐土图景与无忧无虑的欢宴之人。你握住杖身的刹那，一股宁静祥和的安慰感涌上心头；它令人安心的分量沉入掌中，恍若老友的手轻轻覆上你的握持。
This sculpted rod is inlaid with idyllic depictions of paradise and carefree revelers. A sense of peaceful serenity washes over you as you take hold of the shaft, and its comforting weight settles into your grasp like the hand of an old friend.

Smoking Room For Cigars.name:
雪茄吸烟室
Smoking Room For Cigars

Text.text:
烟草朴实的土香轻柔地渗入吸烟室的绒软织物之中——那气味却出奇地怡人。几张高背扶手椅围拢在熊熊燃烧的柴火前，壁炉中雕花大理石内衬映着火光，木柴噼啪作响。抛光橡木桌上摆着以气候控温的保湿盒，盛放着最上乘的雪茄；门旁则一字挂着几件天鹅绒夹克，静候取用。
The earthy scent of tobacco gently suffuses the plush fabrics of the smoking room—though the aroma is surprisingly pleasant. Highbacked armchairs sit before a roaring log fire, which crackles gently in the carved marble fireplace. Cigars of the highest quality sit in climate-controlled humidors on polished oak tables, and a selection of velveteen jackets hang in a row by the door.

你面前的这头生物，仿佛是一缕灵魂寄居在昔日一位强大星界天使那熠熠生辉的头冠之中：一顶以天界钢铸成的头盔，纯净胜过凡世任何黄金。面甲已被熔封，面甲之后的空间被神圣之光灌满。面甲眼缝周围的金属却已失去光泽，像是被极端高温的凝聚喷焰反复灼烧过一般。头盔后部，本该是盔缨的位置，却拍打着两只翅膀。它们泛着雪白的华彩，宛如雪鸮翼羽的典范——每一次振翅，都回响着赞美诗书页翻动的簌簌声。
The creature before you looks like a soul incarnated into what was once the gleaming headpiece of a mighty planetar: a helm wrought from celestial steel, purer than any mortal gold. The visor has been fused shut, and divine light fills the space behind it. The metal around the visor's eye slits is tarnished, as if scorched by concentrated bursts of extreme heat. At the back of the helm, in place of a plume, flap two wings. In their alabaster luster, they are paragons of the snowy owl's pinions—each beat echoing the fluttering of a hymnbook's pages.

Lizardfolk Stargazer.name:
蜥蜴人观星者
Lizardfolk Stargazer

Text.text:
在午夜的林间空地里，一具修长的爬行之躯向群星舒展。她双手分开，手臂向上划出光痕，利爪如月下昙花的花瓣般徐徐绽开，向上方的一切俯身祈求。蛋壳蓝的鳞片浸透月华，使她看上去幽灵般虚幻；可她仍将双眼紧紧闭起，抵御头顶那无垠的浩瀚，以裂开的鼻孔不规则地吐息，牵引着宇宙的韵律。随即，她的巨口张开，迸出犬吠般杂乱的奥秘嘶鸣，魔法倾泻而下，淹没了整片草地。
In the midnight glade, a long reptilian body stretches toward the stars. Hands apart and arms streaking upward, her claws unfold like moonflower petals in supplication to those above. Eggshell-blue scales suffused in moonlight make her appear ghostly, but she keeps her eyes shut tight against the vastness above, channeling the rhythm of the cosmos with irregular breaths through slitted nostrils. Then her maw opens in a barking babble of arcane sibilance, and magic floods the meadow.

尽管这名半兽人巨汉的神情与体格都令人胆寒，他的身躯却仿佛被疲惫压得沉重不堪。苍白的肤色让他看起来与肩上那只公羊护肩一样阴森骇人。一柄满是锈蚀、血污与泥垢的巨斧沉沉坠着他的双臂。他与那件武器散出的恶臭，辛辣得如同陈年尸体。他张口欲言，却在一阵抽痛中僵住，皲裂的战纹从脸上簌簌剥落。

~ 由 Garwen Kazúl 饰演

Though this giant of a half-orc is menacing in demeanor and frame, his body seems heavy with fatigue. His pallor renders him as ghastly as the ram’s pauldron upon his shoulder. A greataxe, thick with rust, gore and muck, weighs down his arms. The stench coming from both him and the weapon is as pungent as an old corpse. He opens his mouth to speak, but stops short with a wince, cracked warpaint flaking off his face.

~ Played by Garwen Kazúl

I Cast Fire Bolt.name:
我施放火焰箭
I Cast Fire Bolt

Text.text:
凭借无数小时练就的从容，我将手扭转成正确的姿势，确保每根手指都依照师傅的教导精准落位，并清晰地吐出咒词。一粒细小的火星在掌心迸现，躁动不安地绕着我盘旋，仿佛正等待被释放。
With an ease born from countless hours of practice I contort my hand into position, ensuring my fingers are correctly placed as my master taught me, and speak the words clearly. A small mote of fire springs to life in my hand, circling restlessly as it waits to be unleashed.

Panicked Townsman Warns Of Monster Sight.name:
惊慌的镇民警告怪物出没
Panicked Townsman Warns Of Monster Sighting

Text.text:
“卫兵！卫兵！噢，神祇在上！有……有个骇人的东西……灰白腐臭的皮囊、深陷的眼窝、寒光闪闪的獠牙，正潜伏在黑暗里。把你手下所有人都带来，把你能凑齐的每一寸钢铁与每一簇火焰都带上。我不知道那是什么，但它确确实实正在逼近，而且它要把死亡带到这片土地上。”

~ 由一位英雄构想

“Guards! Guards! Oh, by the gods! Some… Some horrific thing… a gray, putrid hide with sunken eyes and gleaming teeth is lurking in the dark. Bring every man you have, every bit of steel and fire you can muster. I don’t know what it is, but it is coming and it means to bring death to these lands.”

~ Envisioned by a Hero

沿着泥泞的溪流往山坡上走，你发现一片喧闹又恶臭的营地：帐篷、人物与牲畜杂乱挤作一团。你听见锤子敲击石面的稳定叮当声，也偶尔传来岩块从独轮车或篮筐里倾倒而出的沉闷轰响。显然这里是座矿场之类的地方，只是他们究竟在寻找什么，尚不分明。
Following the muddy stream up the hillside, you find a noisy and noisome collection of tents, people, and animals. You hear the steady plink of hammer on stone as well as the occasional rumble of rocks tumbled out of a wheelbarrow or basket. It’s a mine of some sort, clearly, although what they seek is not yet apparent.

Plea For Help For A Kidnapped Mentor.name:
为被绑架的导师求援
Plea For Help For A Kidnapped Mentor

Text.text:
“求你了，我需要你的帮助。我的主人——那个自命不凡的蠢货——跑去把自己给弄成了俘虏。若换作别的情形，这本该是我升迁的绝佳机会；可一个人活得越久，秘密就越像霉菌一样黏在身上——而他偏偏攒了一大堆。他知道的东西，足以掀翻这片地域的平衡，天知道还会波及到哪里。我向来不爱向外人求助，可这份差事需要的暴力程度，已经超出了我的能耐。”

~ 一位英雄构想

“Please, I need your help. My master, the pompous fool that he is, went and got himself captured. Were circumstances different, it’d be a prime opportunity for my own promotion, but when you’ve been around as long as he has, secrets cling to you like mildew—and he has accumulated quite the collection. What he knows could upend the balance of this region and god knows where else. I’m not in the habit of seeking help from outsiders, but this job requires a degree of violence outside of my skillset.”

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Isle Of Industry With Volcano And Jungle.name:
火山与丛林环抱的工业之岛
Isle Of Industry With Volcano And Jungle

Text.text:
这座城市沿着海崖般的黑色峭壁而建，贴着海的边缘蜿蜒展开。各式船只停泊在断崖脚下的码头，桅杆林立。塔楼与高大的建筑在天际线上刻出参差却庄严的轮廓；而城中各处，熔炉与铁匠铺吞吐的浓烟滚滚升空，伴着工业的喧嚣轰鸣不息。远处、朝着岛屿中心，一座火山高高在上，轻易压过这些烟柱与城市的黝黑结构。整座都会坐落在一片宽阔的高原上，四周被热带绿意紧紧环抱，边缘则被黑石深谷切割；狂野而狭窄的水道在其中奔流。城市周围还有相似的台地，同样被丛林堵塞，却被幽暗的裂谷彼此隔开。

~ 构想：Bogus Sauce

This city is built along black cliffs that line the sea’s edge. Ships of all sorts anchor on quays at the escarpment’s foot. Towers and other high buildings cut a jagged but majestic skyline, though smoke from the furnaces and forges billows into the sky from various points, along with the din of industry. A volcano, far away toward the isle’s center, dwarfs these plumes and the city’s dark structures. The metropolis stands on a broad plateau, girded in tropical greenery and bounded by ravines of black stone through which wild, narrow waterways flow. Similar tablelands surround the city, choked with jungle but separated by darksome chasms.

~ Envisioned by Bogus Sauce

Corporate Arcane Laboratory.name:
企业奥术实验室
Corporate Arcane Laboratory

Text.text:
每一位研究法师都穿着符合公司着装规范、还能衬出几分体面的衣服——直到他们走向储物柜，换上防化装备、凯夫拉防弹层，或戴好耳部防护。摆着脆弱、铺展开来的卷轴的讲台，突兀地立在满是主机、监控摄像头与一排排上锁匣柜（里面存着跃迁引擎备份）的数字化洁净室里。一套对抗弹丸的魔抗背心设计，从泛黄墨线的旧图纸，蜕变成线条利落、由附魔聚合物构成的现代造物。能在爆炸瞬间施放法术的手雷，整齐列在厚重的实验台上。四千年前的符文石与水晶，被钢与玻璃的圣殿层层包裹，安静得像在沉睡。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Every research mage wears something that flatters the company dress code until they go to the lockers for hazmat, Kevlar, or ear protection. Lecterns holding brittle unfurled scrolls stand out in the digital clean rooms of mainframes, security cameras, and shelves of lockboxes holding jump drive backups. Plans for a vest magically resistant to projectiles go from old ink drawings to sleek constructions of enchanted polymer. Grenades that cast spells upon detonation sit in line on a heavy lab table. Runestones and crystals four millennia old are cocooned in a temple of steel and glass.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Slash A Dragon With My Dragon Slayer.name:
我用屠龙者斩龙
I Slash A Dragon With My Dragon Slayer

Text.text:
鳞片在我长剑斩落之处，如磨破的棉布般被撕开；刀刃上流淌着灿然的蓝色辉光。能量沿着刃身奔涌，发出低低嗡鸣，这把武器随之轻颤，浸满强劲的魔咒之力——我稳住身形，准备再从巨龙身上榨出更多龙血。
Scales part like threadbare cotton where my sword slashes the dragon, and the blade shimmers with a radiant blue light. Humming softly as the energy courses through it, the weapon vibrates with potent enchantment as I ready myself to draw more draconic blood.

Outskirts Of A Large Village.name:
大村庄的郊外
Outskirts Of A Large Village

Text.text:
道路上留下深深的车辙——每天有十来辆货车往来碾过；在路的尽头，城镇敞开的城门赫然在望。环绕镇子的木栅高高耸立，仿佛直指天穹；一对守卫只穿着硬挺的皮甲，倚着长柄武器，目光越过城外的地平线巡睨不息。田间一位农妇正翻土劳作，汗珠在额头上闪着光。你经过时，她把宽檐草帽往后一掀，朝你点了点头——眼神里好奇与戒备各占一半。
Deep ruts in the road remain where a dozen carts come and go each day, and at road's end, the open town gate stands. The wooden palisade encircling the town reaches skyward and a pair of guards, armored simply in rigid leathers, eye the horizon as they lean on their polearms. A farmer tills her fields, sweat shining on her brow. She pitches her wide-brimmed hat backward and offers you a nod as you pass, equal measures of curiosity and caution in her eyes.

Vorkalth The Soul Eater.name:
沃卡尔斯——噬魂者
Vorkalth The Soul Eater

Text.text:
这是死亡与邪恶之神，身形修长高挑，发丝如烟囱逸出的黑烟，却因他吞噬的灵魂余温而幽幽发亮。这位神的面孔是一具头骨，眼窝是漆黑深坑，盛满疯狂。祂举止庄严，态度温和有礼，但极少有人能真正识得这一面，还能避开灵魂被窃的下场。祂的前臂化作弯曲刀刃，末端倒钩，用来将受害者牢牢钉在原地。祂披着一条由骷髅串成的长裙，那可怖的灵魂残渣烟雾从裙摆下袅袅涌出，仿佛祂正漂浮在他们的痛苦之上。

~ Played by DM Shatter

This is the god of death and evil, slender and tall, with hair like chimney smoke that glows with the warmth of the souls he consumes. This is the god whose face is a skull, black pits for eyes, filled with insanity. The god is dignified, cordial, but few can know this and avoid the theft of their soul. His forearms are curved blades, hooked on the end to keep his victims in place. He wears a long skirt of skulls, that horrible smoke of soul residue wafting out from under it, as if he were floating on their suffering.

~ Played by DM Shatter

Player's Ship Is Boarded.name:
玩家的船被登船劫掠
Player's Ship Is Boarded

Text.text:
一连串又长又沉、带着震荡的闷响让舰体剧烈颤抖——登舱艇狠狠砸进外壳。远处随即传来嗡鸣——那是激光切割器——紧接着，更多震颤像涟漪般沿着船身扩散开来。“全体岗位进入防御阵地！全体岗——”通讯被一阵咕噜作响的声响硬生生掐断。船员们四散奔逃，抄起武器准备迎战。他们还能把入侵者挡在外面多久？
A series of long, low, concussive thuds causes the ship to shudder as boarding pods slam into the hull. A distant buzzing—the laser cutters—then more shudders ripple through the ship. “All stations defensive positions! All statio—” The transmission is cut off with the noise of gurgling. Crew members scatter, arming themselves for combat. How long will they be able to hold off the invaders?

一声细微的咔哒，紧接着是阴森的嘶嘶声，仿佛毒蛇在发笑，随之喷涌出刺鼻的毒气。它从一尊歪斜的恶魔雕像口中翻滚而出：翠绿色的雾霭迅速灌满房间，将你吞没，灼烧你的双眼与肺腑，宛如地狱之火。
A subtle click, followed by a sinister hiss like a snake’s laughter, precedes the spray of noxious gas. It tumbles from the mouth of a crooked, demonic statue: green fog that fills the room and envelops you, burning your eyes and lungs like hellish fire.

月光照亮了一座宽阔喀斯特石塔平坦的顶端，山草、苔藓与灌木铺满其上。由一排扁平石板搭成的石桥横跨裂隙，连接着盘山折返的小径与那片圆形草甸。银色符文刻在桥面上，也沿着环绕草甸的峭壁边缘一圈圈排开，在月辉下泛起冷亮的反光。更深处的群山里吹来恒定而刺骨的寒风，带着岩石、草药与冰雪的气息。风声之间，从四面八方传来轻柔的叮玲声，若有若无。
Moonlight illuminates the flat top of a broad karst spire covered in mountain grass, moss, and shrubs. A bridge of flat stones crosses the gap between the switchback trail up the peak and the round meadow. The moon’s glow reflects off silver runes carved into the bridge and lining the lip of the cliffs surrounding the field. A steady, cold breeze flows from deeper in the mountains. It smells of rock, herbs, and ice. Amid the wind, a soft tinkling sound comes from multiple directions.

I Put On My Prosthetic Hand Of Lightning.name:
我戴上了闪电义手
I Put On My Prosthetic Hand Of Lightning

Text.text:
我把义肢安在臂上，将皮革绑带穿过扣环，收紧固定。掌心布满符文，涌动着淡蓝色能量。我沉默地下令，仅凭意志驱动它，看着缕缕闪电沿着木制手指起舞。

~ 构想 by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

I situate the prosthetic on my arm and string the leather straps through the buckles to tighten it in place. Runes riddle the palm of the hand, surging with light blue energy. I command the prosthetic in silence, using will alone, and watch as tongues of lightning dance along the wooden fingers.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

砌石工艺臻于完美：自石质地基一路铺陈，至第一层高挑楼面的白色饰带收束；第二层则是木梁架构，覆以灰泥。齐人高的狭长百叶紧贴着铅条拼嵌的玻璃窗，门为厚重橡木所制，铜制门扣清冷，内侧还有插销与闩锁。带尖饰的黑铁栅栏围住一小条院地，门上方悬着的油灯投下淡金色光辉，洒在一阶大理石台阶上——其价值足抵一间农舍。
The masonry is perfectly worked from a stone foundation to a frieze of white around the first tall floor, and the second floor is timbered and plastered. Narrow shutters, the height of a man, border leaded glass windows, and the door is heavy oak with a bronze latch and bolt locks inside. A black iron fence with finials surrounds the small strip of yard, and an oil lantern hanging above the door casts its pale gold light onto a marble step worth the price of a peasant’s shack.

Wand Of The War Mage +1.name:
战法师魔杖 +1
Wand Of The War Mage +1

Text.text:
这根魔杖被削磨到便于掌握的体型，整体呈近似圆锥形，由某种可能是麒麟——或也许是独角兽——的角制成。其底部刻出一道道棱脊，便于施法时做出细腻而精准的微妙动作。
Pared down to a manageable size, the roughly conical shape of this wand, crafted from the horn of what might have been a kirin—or possibly a unicorn—has had ridges carved into its base to allow for the delicate movements of spellwork.

Awakening, Bound And Hooded.name:
觉醒，缚身蒙头
Awakening, Bound And Hooded

Text.text:
骨擦骨的碾磨声刮过你的感官，你在苏醒时，整个世界被粗麻布的裹尸布般阴影笼罩。紧绷啃噬着你的肩膀，手腕里沉沉的钝痛已然扎根；你的双手被绑住了。那令人作呕的喧嚣愈发响亮，伴随着拖沓而沉重的脚步声，有什么东西正一步步逼近你。

~ Envisioned by TheDarqHawk on Discord

The grinding of bone on bone scrapes against your senses as you awaken, your world enveloped in a burlap shroud. Tension gnaws at your shoulders and a dull ache has settled into your wrists; your hands are tied. The disgusting cacophony grows louder as something pads toward you with lumbering, heavy footsteps.

~ Envisioned by TheDarqHawk on Discord

I Cast Whispers Of The Grave.name:
我施放《亡者低语》
I Cast Whispers Of The Grave

Text.text:
我轻抚尸体的头颅与面颊，强行掰开它的眼皮。凝视那两枚死寂的眼珠，我以安抚的低语对仍滞留在腐败血肉里的残魂呢喃：“来吧。与我说上片刻。借用我的呼吸。”我撬开它的嘴，向其中吐出一口气。尸身猛地一抽；眼皮颤动，牙齿咯咯作响。随即它松弛下来，回望着我，静候我的提问。
I caress the corpse’s head and face, and I force open its eyes. Staring into the dead orbs, I murmur soothingly to the essence still lodged in the decaying matter. “Come. Speak with me for a moment. Borrow my breath,” I say. I pry open the mouth and exhale into it. The corpse jerks. Its eyelids flutter and its teeth chatter. It relaxes and regards me, waiting for my questions.

Gold Buckle For A Narrow Belt.name:
窄腰带用金扣
Gold Buckle For A Narrow Belt

Text.text:
铸成一枚巨币的形状，背面暗藏一根尖刺；金币成色半纯，却为频繁使用而特意淬硬。这是行会成员的扣饰，或许是因某次商贸功绩而获颁的奖赏。
Crafted in the shape of a giant coin, the prong hidden on the back side of the medallion, the gold is semi-pure but hardened for frequent use. It is the buckle of a guildsman, perhaps awarded for some mercantile achievement.

丛林里闷热的麝香气息逐渐退去，取而代之的是一股令人作呕的甜腻腐臭——而且正朝你逼近。地面震颤，脚下的泥水洼泛起层层涟漪，一头骇人的生物猛然从繁茂的植被中破开而出。它与这片怪异土地上游荡的其他巨型爬行动物相似——但这头早在不久前就死了。干枯的肉块挂在它裸露的肋骨上，肋间那幽深的空腔里塞满了腐烂的脏器与肌肉。腐败的恶臭此刻几乎令人窒息，你惊骇地看着那怪物转动覆盖鳞片的宽阔头颅，空洞的目光钉住你——随即在狂怒中咆哮。

~ Envisioned by Angie on Discord

The sweltering musk of the jungle gives way to the sickly sweet aroma of decay—that seems to be moving toward you. The ground trembles, sending ripples through the muddy puddles underfoot, and a hideous creature erupts from the lush vegetation. The beast is similar to the other huge reptiles that roam this strange land—but this one died a while ago. Gobbets of desiccated flesh hang from the creature's exposed ribcage, the cavernous hollow within filled with putrefying organs and muscle. The stench of rot is overwhelming now, and you watch aghast as the abomination swivels its broad scaled head toward you, fixing you with its hollow gaze—and roars in fury.

~ Envisioned by Angie on Discord

Insult About False Power.name:
关于虚假力量的羞辱
Insult About False Power

Text.text:
“我敢肯定，你现在觉得自己握有世间所有的力量。你精心为自己筑起一座由财富与虚假强盛堆砌的堡垒，可你的气味……仍从宫殿的囚笼里逸散出去，臭得满是弱点。”
“I’m sure it feels like you have all the power in the world right now. You’ve carefully built a fortress of wealth and false strength around yourself, but your scent… It escapes your palace’s confines, and it reeks of weakness.”

巨蛇以尾支地，几近过分地端正而优雅地挺立着，随即蜿蜒向前。若非那覆鳞的人形上身与双臂，以及手中握着的一柄华丽长刃，它几乎与任何一条巨蟒无异。它裂缝般的黄色竖瞳四下游移，分叉的长舌不断吞吐，品尝着周遭空气里是否有任何异样的征兆。它神情冷淡漠然，然而每当陌生的声响或气味掠过，那筋肉间细微的起伏便立刻随之涌动，昭示着它的敏捷与警觉。
Poised upright on its tail with nearly-excessive dignity and grace, the serpent slithers forward. It would be indistinguishable from another massive snake, were it not for the scaled humanoid torso, arms, and an ornate blade in hand. Its slitted yellow eyes dart around as its forked tongue flicks about, tasting the surrounding air for signs of anything amiss. Its expression is cold and apathetic, but the subtle pulse in its musculature toward any unfamiliar sounds or scents are a display of its agility and alertness.

Close View Of Solar Flare.name:
太阳耀斑特写
Close View Of Solar Flare

Text.text:
太阳表面起伏荡漾，炽热的气体噼啪作响。如此近距离目睹它，令人屏息——这枚橙色的巨卵，托举着整个太阳系的生机。忽然，太阳表面的一点在骇人的压力下向内塌折。那道褶皱摇晃不定，随即猛然向外炸裂，一条炽液般的火焰长线迸射而出，直刺虚空的黑色画布。
The surface of the sun undulates, crackling with gaseous heat. To see it so close is breathtaking—this orange egg on which the solar system thrives. Suddenly, a point on the surface of the sun folds inward under the colossal pressure. The fold wobbles, then explodes outward, sending a great line of liquid fire shooting into the dark canvas of the void.

验尸官的眼镜用一条朴素的链子挂在颈间，蒙着雾霭的镜片垂落得有些过低，几乎要贴上他那身宝蓝色长袍上可疑的斑渍。一本书像战士佩剑般挂在他腰间的皮带上——而且，他另一侧的剑柄里确实还插着一把短匕首，连鞘在身。“圣殿祝福过的，”他解释道，“以防死人并没有真的死透，你懂的。” The coroner’s spectacles hang from a simple chain about his neck, the clouded lenses lying a bit too close to the dubious splotches on his royal-blue robes. A book hangs from a belt at his hip like a warrior would keep their sword—and, indeed, a short dagger sits sheathed in a hilt at his other side. “Blessed by the temple,” he explains, “for when the dead aren’t really dead, you know.”

I Sneak Out Of My Dormitory.name:
我偷偷溜出宿舍
I Sneak Out Of My Dormitory

Text.text:
几乎让人觉得不值当——为了瘫痪大厅的魔法监视，我做了这么多准备；为了我正画在床边窗前的仪式法阵，我还得收集那些法术与材料。我沿着魔法粉笔线一遍遍描摹时，套房里的其他人都睡得正沉。窗户化作一道传送门，我迈步穿了过去。
It almost doesn’t seem worth it, all this prep work to disable the hall’s magical surveillance and the spells and components I had to collect for the ritual circle I’m drawing in front of the window by my bed. The others in the suite are sound asleep as I retrace the magic chalk line. The window turns to a portal, and I step through.

那个瘦长的少年在厨房里忙碌，举手投足却带着大师级舞者的优雅与专注。他仿佛同时推进着十来道菜的不同环节，在各个灶台与案板间穿梭，双手灵巧地挪锅换盆、挥刀切剁，又像马戏团的杂耍艺人般把食材抛接翻飞。你被这份从容与技艺深深吸引；而更令人惊叹的是，这样的表演竟出自你一向与笨拙相连的年代之人。
The gangly teenager works in the kitchen with the grace and focus of a master dancer. They must be at different stages of a dozen dishes, stepping between stations with their hands nimbly shifting pots, wielding knives, and tossing ingredients like a circus juggler. You find the sight of someone so confident and skilled somewhat mesmerizing, but it being someone of an age you associate with awkwardness makes their performance all the more remarkable.

铸铁大锅架在三条粗壮的锅腿上，每条腿末端都套着一只利爪般的锅足。锅里咕嘟作响的炖汤随着搅拌而荡漾，逸散出炫目的香气：肉、香草、香料与烤蔬菜的气息交织翻涌。不远处的架子上，一张巨大的毛皮——点缀着羽毛——被细心地绷开晾干。汤液翻滚间，你看见有什么东西浮上了水面。那是……鸟喙吗？

~ 由 David 在 Discord 上 构想

The cast-iron cauldron sits atop three robust legs, each capped by a clawed foot. A burbling stew sloshes within as it is stirred, releasing a scintillating aroma of meat, herbs, spices, and roasted vegetables. Nearby on a rack, a large furry pelt—adorned with feathers—has been carefully strung out to dry. As the stew bubbles, you see something float to the surface. Is that a beak?

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Cesspool In The Wilderness.name:
荒野粪坑
Cesspool In The Wilderness

Text.text:
你一直闻到的霉腐与朽烂气息愈发浓烈，还掺进了新的腥臭杂味，熏得你几欲作呕。源头在一团盘旋的苍蝇与蚊群中变得一目了然：地面上一个泥泞的坑洞里积着一汪浑水，水面覆着一层五彩斑斓的黏腻浮膜与泡沫。
The scent of mold and rot you’ve been smelling grows stronger and adds new noisome notes. It makes you want to wretch. The source becomes obvious from the cloud of flies and mosquitoes. A muddy hole in the ground holds a pool covered in a multihued slick of slime and foam.

Insult About A Plan Gone Wrong.name:
对失败计划的羞辱
Insult About A Plan Gone Wrong

Text.text:
“你脑子里还有什么更妙的鬼点子吗？还是说‘把我们全都送去死的计划’就是你的巅峰？”
“Do you have any more brilliant schemes in your head or was the ‘get us all killed plan’ your peak?”

I Put On My Ring Of Water Walking.name:
我戴上了水上行走之戒
I Put On My Ring Of Water Walking

Text.text:
我把戒指套上手指时，指腹掠过那令人愉悦的波纹雕刻，同一瞬间也迈步踏向水面。脚底传来一阵魔法般的刺痒，我落在水面上，荡开一圈涟漪，伴着摇晃的叮咚扑通声。我能感觉到脚下暗流的弹跳移动——但只要魔法还在，我就不会陷下去。
I feel the pleasantly tactile wave-pattern of my ring as I slip it over my finger, stepping out over the water at the same moment. A magical twinge prickles the soles of my feet and I land on the surface of the water with a ripple and wobbly plink-plunk sort of noise. I sense the bouncing movement of currents beneath me—but as long as the magic holds, I won’t slip through.

一名丰腴的女人咧嘴而笑，黑漆般的唇色衬得她幽暗的眼眸更深，仿佛盛着知晓与欢愉的故事。她赤身裸体，唯有黏稠如焦油的黑色秽物拉出一缕缕细线，缠绕在她的肌肤上。她的指尖滴落着那秽物，指甲拉长成利爪——阴沉而发亮，宛如黑寡妇蜘蛛的足肢。她的背后展开一对黄色的翅膀，裂纹纵横，像久被弃置、无人照料的旧皮革。
A voluptuous woman grins with black-painted lips, her dark eyes holding stories of knowing and pleasure. She is naked aside from the stringy lines of a sticky tar-like ichor lacing over her body. Her fingers drip with the ichor, nails elongated into claws—umbrous and shining as the legs of a black widow spider. From her back yellow wings spread wide, veined with cracks like old, uncared-for leather.

God Of Arcane Magic.name:
奥术魔法之神
God Of Arcane Magic

Text.text:
在学者出现之前，先有这般存在：学者的理想原型——披着最初的长袍，身上刺着最早的符文与魔法法典。神祇的模样正如人们所想：一位老人，高瘦挺立，披着厚重的蓝紫色天鹅绒长袍，其上绣满元素符号、秘传公式与神秘学的源流。这位神祇与其说神圣，不如说更偏向奥秘。他光着头，白色的长须与髭须垂落，指尖染着墨渍。
Before there were scholars, there was this: the ideal form of a scholar, dressed in the original robes, tattooed with the first glyphs and codices of magic. The god appears as one would expect—an old man, tall and thin, wearing a heavy blue-and-purple velvet robe embroidered with elemental symbols, esoteric formulae, and sources of mysticism. This deity is more arcane than divine. His head is bald, his white beard and moustache long, his fingers stained with ink.

Evil Casting Of Faerie Fire.name:
妖精之火的邪恶施放
Evil Casting Of Faerie Fire

Text.text:
你厉声吟出一个字，一枚白橙相间的小光球拖着疾影射入敌群。它撞上地面，迸散出一蓬火星，硫磺的刺鼻气味随之弥漫。火焰仿佛被磁石牵引般汇聚到敌人身上，落在毛发与皮革上滋滋作响，灼烫蔓延。
You intone a harsh word, and a small white-orange orb streaks into the crowd of foes. It collides with the earth, releasing a spray of embers and the smell of brimstone. The flames coalesce onto your enemies as if drawn by a magnet, sizzling as they settle on hair and leather.

Electrum Buckle For A Wide Belt.name:
宽腰带用琥珀银扣
Electrum Buckle For A Wide Belt

Text.text:
这枚方形扣环因体型而更显夺目，明亮的火彩几乎刺眼。金光闪烁、银屑点点，让金属看上去脆弱易碎，实则经锻打后厚重而宽阔，足以硬接短剑一击。
The bright sparkle of this square buckle is made more obvious by its size. The metal looks brittle because of its glittering gold and flecks of silver, but it is hammered heavy and broad and can stand up to the stroke of a short sword.

Galloping Across An Open Field.name:
驰骋穿越开阔原野
Galloping Across An Open Field

Text.text:
你的坐骑在最初的小跑中展现出可靠而沉稳的性情。窥见一片开阔无碍的原野，雄马调整步伐进入轻快的跑步，闪亮的皮毛下，矫健的肌肉随之绷紧。能量如浪般涌起，像是短暂地邀请你去指挥他的速度；而你俯身贴近，与这匹高贵的骏马一同跃入腾空般的疾驰。四蹄落地的节奏反复成簇，欢快的蹄声传递着喜悦——随之摇曳的丝缎般鬃毛也如旗语般将这份欢欣一遍遍传达。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Your mount strikes out with a reliable temperament during his first trotting steps. Espying an expansive and unobstructed field, the stallion adjusts to a canter, his athletic muscles engaging beneath the shining coat. There’s a swell of energy and the briefest invitation to command his speed, but you lean in, joining the noble horse as he breaks into a leaping gallop. With their repeating cluster of four footfalls, happy hooves telegraph joy—which is repeated in semaphore by a swaying, silken mane.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Cast Hideous Laughter Using Components.name:
我用施法成分施放怪笑术
I Cast Hideous Laughter Using Components

Text.text:
纤巧的羽毛在我掌心翩然起舞，如羽管笔般描摹着看不见的文字；我将小小的馅饼抛向空中，宛如先知的符文。咒语合拢之际，我望见一缕任性的能量丝带蜿蜒飘向目标，裹挟着不请自来的欢笑。
The delicate feather dances in my hand, tracing invisible script like a quill as I cast the small tarts through the air like oracle’s runes. I complete the incantation and watch as a ribbon of capricious energy meanders toward the target, laden with unbidden mirth.

Elryk, Of House Maerret.name:
艾尔里克，梅雷特家族之人
Elryk, Of House Maerret

Text.text:
这名精灵身形高挑修长，银色长发笔直垂落，皮肤如炭灰般暗沉，眼眸则是深紫水晶的颜色。他的神情难以揣测，疏离却又……带着几分玩味。一只与他发色相同的猫头鹰——目光同样晦涩——立在他右肩，踏着一袭与他眼眸相配的精致斗篷。柔韧的黑色皮革自颈至足将他包裹，腰带与靴子上点缀着明亮的银色金属，外套上的铆钉亦由同样的银辉构成。左胯垂着一只华丽的剑鞘，内藏一柄弯曲的弯刀，刀柄繁复，镶满宝石。

~ Played by HopsTodd with

Tall and lean, this elf has long straight silver hair, charcoal-gray skin, and eyes the color of dark amethyst. He wears an inscrutable expression, aloof yet… amused. An owl the color of his hair—with an equally enigmatic gaze—stands on his right shoulder atop a fine cloak that matches his eyes. Supple black leather covers him, neck to toe, with bright, silvery metal accenting his belt and boots and making up rivets that adorn his coat. An ornate scabbard hangs on his left hip, holding a curved scimitar with an elaborate, bejeweled hilt.

~ Played by HopsTodd with

Coven Of Good Witches.name:
善良女巫集会
Coven Of Good Witches

Text.text:
干燥草药的霉香萦绕在树洞般的洞穴四周，头顶那株参天橡树的枝杈上缀满风铃，在林间微风里细碎低语。洞穴蜷伏在树根之间——仿佛一枚被巨鸟守护的卵——向空地里松软、肥沃的腐殖土深处钻去；石窟内一条天然烟囱里，缕缕轻烟正柔和地盘旋升起。大釜旁，三位女子闲聊嬉笑，从歪斜的架子与头顶的绳线上摘下炼金材料，欢快地一把把抛进翻滚的锅里。这里没有恶意，因为这些女巫行走在治疗与滋养之道上。

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

The musty smell of dried herbs hangs in the air around the arboreal cave, and the branches of the mighty oak above are festooned with wind chimes that chatter softly in the forest breeze. Nestled in the roots of the tree—like an egg protected by a titanic bird—the small cave burrows into the soft, loamy soil of the clearing, and wisps of smoke can be seen gently curling up from a natural chimney within the grotto. Around a cauldron, three women idly chat and laugh as they pluck alchemical ingredients from lopsided racks and overhead lines, tossing them into the bubbling pot with glee. There is no malice at work here, for these witches follow the path of healing and nourishment.

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

I Set Up A Tripwire.name:
我布下了一道绊索
I Set Up A Tripwire

Text.text:
我从线轴上缓缓放出那根纤细的金属丝，金属在滑动间发出尖锐的啸鸣。我将金属丝固定在位，绷得笔直，却又留出能被猛然扯断的余地。布置完后，我仍盯紧周围的区域，确保没有什么会过早触发我的陷阱。金属丝几乎看不见，对在昏暗光照中穿行的敌人而言是绝佳的暗算——却也同样是一道致命的危害，尤其对那些可能忘了它就在这里的伙伴们。
I roll the thin metal wire from its spindle, the metal emitting a high-pitched whine as I do. I pin the wire in place, keeping it taut but able to be snapped. I keep an eye on the area around me after I’m done, making sure nothing triggers my trap too early. The wire is nearly invisible, a perfect foil for our enemies traveling about in dim light—and a perfect hazard for my companions who might forget it’s here.

I Cast Hold Person Using A Druidic Focus.name:
我使用德鲁伊法器物品施放【定身术】
I Cast Hold Person Using A Druidic Focus Item

Text.text:
我感召自然本身，恳请大地将我的目标牢牢禁锢。随着我吟诵神圣的词句，我将心神凝聚于德鲁伊的法器之上，专注于万物生灵之间的羁绊。只需一个简单的手势，我便释放这道法术，眼前浮现敌手被冰川般的寒冰彻底冻结的景象。
Calling upon nature itself, I beseech the land to immobilize my target. As I chant the sacred words, I bring my attention to my druidic focus, concentrating on the bond between all living things. With a simple gesture I unleash the spell, picturing my foe frozen in glacial ice.

这把剑的剑身上铭刻着每一位昔日持有者的名字，宛如一卷荣誉名册；每个名字都仿佛能唤起一段关于冒险与英勇的传说。尽管显然古老，剑却仍光辉夺目，闪烁的金属上迸散出点点辉光，仿佛从未经历过战火。
The names of each past wielder of this sword are etched into the blade like a roll of honor, each one conjuring stories of adventure and heroism. Though clearly ancient, the sword is brilliant in its radiance, and light sparkles from the shimmering metal as if it has never seen battle.

这只猫头鹰是一种幽灵般的生物：双眼如两颗虚空般漆黑的弹珠，嵌在灰色、心形的面盘之中。它灰烬般的羽毛点缀着白色斑点，形成其标志性的烟煤般外观。而它尖锐刺耳的啼鸣足以与女妖比肩，更无从削弱那股阴魂不散的观感。
This owl is a specter-like creature: its eyes a pair of void-black marbles framed in a gray, heart-shaped face. Its ashen feathers are speckled with white, giving its signature sooty appearance. And its high, screeching call, rivaling a banshee, does nothing to alleviate its ghostly impression.

Father Cortez.name:
科尔特斯神父
Father Cortez

Text.text:
身着一件剪裁如法衣的皮质束腰外衣，中年男人先把齐肩的灰白杂发从眼前一把拨开，露出内层带铆钉的皮袖。随后他从横跨在胯间的皮质弹带上抽出一把手弩。屏息细瞄，他将一支短弩矢射进近旁的树干里，眯起眼皱着眉，盯着弩矢落点不满意地打量。带着一股办事利落的气场，他从外衣上开出的长口袋里掏出一把铁钳，手法细微得几乎看不见，轻轻调整弩上的瞄具。三十秒后，他把铁钳塞回口袋，上弦装填，再朝同一棵树扣下扳机——这次他看着落点，满意地点了点头。

~ Played by Pitt Warrior

Dressed in a leather tunic cut like a cassock, with studded leather sleeves visible beneath, the middle-aged man swipes his shoulder-length salt and pepper hair out of his eyes before drawing a hand crossbow from one of the leather bandoliers crossed over his hips. Sighting carefully, he fires a short quarrel into a nearby tree, then squints and frowns at the bolt’s placement. With a businesslike air, he pulls a set of iron pliers out of a long pocket cut into the leather tunic, and adjusts the sights of the crossbow with minute movements. After thirty seconds, he replaces the pliers in his pocket, loads, and fires the crossbow into the same tree, this time gauging his shot with a satisfied nod.

~ Played by Pitt Warrior

I Tamper With A Glass Of Wine.name:
我在一杯葡萄酒里动了手脚
I Tamper With A Glass Of Wine

Text.text:
我只能凭眼估剂量。多了，效果就会超出我想要的；少了，就不会有效果，只会引来警报。笑声随着一个笑话响起，立刻招来目光。我把小瓶倾斜，药液滴入杯中。我一边退开，一边把证据丢进仆人正拎出去的那袋垃圾里。
I have to eyeball the dose. Too much and the effects will be more than I want. Too little and there won’t be effects, only alarms. Laughter at a joke draws attention. I tip the vial into the glass. As I move away, I drop the evidence into a bag of trash being carried out by a servant.

Coup De Grace With Medium Blade.name:
用中型刀刃施以致命一击
Coup De Grace With Medium Blade

Text.text:
你一脚将武器从那名无助敌人麻木无力的指间踢飞，随即抽出长刃，沿着他的喉间一划而过。颈动脉被切断，鲜血猛然喷溅；颈静脉豁开，血流汩汩涌出，确保死亡迅速，且相对仁慈。
Kicking the weapon from the nerveless fingers of your helpless enemy, you draw your long blade and slash it along their throat. Blood spurts from the severed carotid artery, flows from the opened jugular vein, ensuring a quick and relatively humane death.

I Prepare For Cunning Action.name:
我为狡诈动作做好准备
I Prepare For Cunning Action

Text.text:
听着，我向来都有计划，而任何好计划都离不开对局势的清醒掌控。也就是说，要先审视当下的情势。我会寻找逃生路线和掩蔽。一旦麻烦开场，我就盯着敌人如何移动，以及他们把注意力放在什么或谁身上。有了计划，我总能随时迅速出手。
Listen, I always have a plan, and any good plan requires situational awareness. That means examining the circumstances. I look for escape routes and cover. When the trouble starts, I watch how my foes move and what or who they pay attention to. With a plan, I’m always ready to act quickly.

若不是她那一绺夸张的紫色长发猛然跃入眼帘，你几乎不会注意到林间的侏儒。她身披挂满伪装树叶的链甲，行走间带着一种从容的灵巧，仿佛森林就是她的家。你走近时，她正把几只药剂小瓶调整在一条宽阔的斜挎弹带上——那弹带同样由树叶编织而成。附近一株树干旁斜倚着一面木盾，边缘箍着硬化金属，盾面绘着一只药瓶的图案，倾斜着，像正被倒出其中的液体。她收拾完毕，抬头望向你，闪烁的祖母绿眼眸与你对视。
If it were not for her long, purple shock of hair, you might not have seen the gnome in the forest, dressed as she is in mail festooned with camouflaging leaves, and moving with the easy grace of one who makes the forest their home. As you approach, she appears to be adjusting several potion vials along a wide bandolier woven from the same leaves. Leaning against a nearby trunk, a wooden shield banded with hardened metal has been painted with a design of a potion bottle, tilted as if being poured out. She finishes with her task and looks up at you, her sparkling emerald eyes meeting yours.

Bridge Of Heroes.name:
英雄之桥
Bridge Of Heroes

Text.text:
曾有两尊雕像矗立于此，在信众踏上狭窄的桥之前向他们致意——如今只剩其一。孤零零的雕像——一位英勇的骑士——跪地祈求，原本高贵的面容却扭曲成悲恸的神情。也许他们在哀悼倒下的同伴——如今只剩尘埃与瓦砾。
Two statues once stood here, greeting the faithful before they made their way across the narrow bridge—now only one remains. The lone statue—a heroic knight—kneels in supplication, their noble features twisted in mourning. Perhaps they grieve for their fallen counterpart—now reduced to dust and rubble.

厚厚的尘埃掩蔽着这间古老储藏室里尚存的木桶与木箱；木料虽经年代洗礼，却既未被潮气扭曲，也未见人手或齿痕侵入。它们曾一度贴着整齐的标签，但年代已将墨迹褪成难以辨认的残影——甚至可以说，储存的货物状态都可能比那些标牌更好。要让来自你祖父母、乃至你祖父母的祖父母之前那个时代的物资仍保持如此上佳状态，这间屋子的建造必定严谨到了近乎苛刻的地步！
Thick layers of dust cover the barrels and crates still remaining in this ancient storeroom, the wood aged but neither warped by moisture nor penetrated by hands or teeth. At one point they were neatly labeled, but age has faded the ink to the point of incomprehensibility—indeed, the stored goods might be in better condition than the signs. The construction of this room must have been exacting to have maintained, in such fine conditions, goods from a time before your grandparents and your grandparents’ grandparents!

I Fail To Destroy An Enchanted Item.name:
我没能摧毁一件附魔物品
I Fail To Destroy An Enchanted Item

Text.text:
铁制容器空空如也，外缘却一圈圈刻着符文。我俯视它那张深渊般张开的口，默想法术，继而吐出咒词，将双手带着摧毁一切的力量猛然探入其中。我在脑海中描绘坩埚开裂、挣扎抵抗，随后所有碎片同时崩离——堆成一座残骸碎片的小丘。然而，这一切并未发生。相反，那物体只在一瞬间泛起紫色幽光，旋即熄灭，回归毫无损伤的原状。

~ 构想：Walt M.

The iron receptacle is empty, but etched with runes around its outer edge. I look into its yawning mouth, think the spell, then speak the words and push my hands into it with destructive force. I picture the cauldron cracking, resisting, then every piece of it breaking free at once—creating a pile of fragments. But this does not happen. Instead, the object glows purple for a moment before returning to its undisturbed state.

~ Envisioned by Walt M.

Ancient Black Dragon.name:
远古黑龙
Ancient Black Dragon

Text.text: 恐惧攫住你的胃腹，在你体内扭动、抓挠，宛如一只生物正拼命逃离。你面前的庞然大物，仿佛最漆黑的夜被你最恶劣的梦魇赋予了形体。鳞片大如屋瓦，利爪如巨人弯刀，双翼之巨足以遮蔽一座城堡——称它为巨龙，都显得词不达意，难以概括这份骇人的恐怖。 Fear clutches your gut, writhing and scratching within you, like a creature trying to escape. The behemoth before you looks like the blackest night brought to life by your worst nightmares. Scales as big as roof tiles, claws like the scimitars of giants, and wings so big they could shroud a castle—dragon seems too small a word for this terror.

这柄过于修长的武器，锯齿般的表面一律浸成乌黑如墨的色泽，使它看上去更像橡胶而非金属。然而，长枪握柄那异质而陌生的纹理与形制，却恰到好处地贴合持用者的手掌；柄尾的接地尖端又能精准地楔入枪兵足弓内侧，稳稳抵住，以便蓄势冲锋。只需一次直刺，便足以打消对枪尖锋利度的一切疑虑——只要臂力够强，它甚至能贯穿最厚重的板甲，哪怕是矮人护甲也不例外。
The crenellated surface of this over-long weapon is uniformly colored a jet black, lending it a look that resembles rubber more than metal. And yet, the alien textures and form of the pike’s grip fit the wielder’s hand exactly, as the grounding tip in the pommel wedges precisely against the inside of the pikeman’s foot to set a charge. A single thrust from the pike puts to rest any concerns about the sharpness of its spike, sufficient to drive through the thickest plates of even dwarven armor, should the wielder have the strength of arm.

Loot From A Satyr.name:
萨堤尔的战利品
Loot From A Satyr

Text.text:
他的精钢长剑覆着一层黑血，金色剑柄雕工优雅——像是精灵或妖精的手笔。在他那只涂过油的皮革背包里，你找到一只圆底的大酒瓶。玻璃中的液体微微摇晃时，一抹闪烁的精华在其中流光浮动。你隐约听见，仿佛从很远的地方传来笑声，以及鲁特琴弦被调音时的轻颤。
His steel sword is coated in ichor, the golden hilt crafted in an elegant design—elf- or faerie-made. In his pack of oiled leather, you find a large bottle of wine with a rounded bottom. As the liquid shakes in the glass, a sparkling essence shimmers through it. You hear, faintly as if far away, laughter and the tuning of lute strings.

Threat Of Retaliation From A Dragon.name:
来自巨龙的报复威胁
Threat Of Retaliation From A Dragon

Text.text: “你。尤其是你，已经惹得我怒火中烧——那种愤怒通常只会留给巨龙与巨人。能赢得这份最可怕的奖赏，真是‘了不起’。” “You. You in particular have earned my ire—in a way usually reserved for dragons and giants. It is a most terrible prize to win.”

Possessed Pumpkin Patch.name:
闹鬼的南瓜田
Possessed Pumpkin Patch

Text.text:
南瓜地早已风光不再。橙色的肉墙软塌塌地垂着，有的甚至彻底塌陷，空气里弥漫着腐果的气味，潮湿土腥里带着酸涩的冲鼻。他们似乎都是还挂在藤上时就烂透了。忽有一只南瓜微微扭动，果肉一鼓一鼓地跳着——也许是哪只饥饿的啮齿动物钻进了里面。随即，那南瓜转过身来面对你，腰间一道裂口如同疲惫的人艰难呼吸般一张一合。每一次呼气，都有苍蝇从它的“嘴”里逃窜而出。伴着令人作呕的咕噜声，橙色的稠泥在嘴角咕嘟咕嘟地冒泡。它猛地呛咳，咳到最后，竟把一团黏滑的丝状物与籽一口啐到你脚边。其他南瓜也开始蠕动、呻吟、咕噜作响——它们拖着腐烂的身躯，朝你爬来。
The pumpkin patch has seen better days. Walls of orange flesh sag, or have caved in completely, and the scent of rotting fruit is earthy and tangy in the air. They all seem to have rotted while still on the vine. One wiggles, its flesh pulsing—perhaps a hungry rodent has found its way inside. Then the pumpkin turns to face you, a tear across its middle opening and closing like a man taking labored breaths. Flies escape its mouth with each exhale. With a sickening gurgle, orange muck bubbles at the corners of the mouth. It hacks, coughing until it spits a wad of slimy string and seeds right at your feet. The other pumpkins begin to wriggle, moan, gurgle—and they drag themselves toward you.

你从梯子下来的地方起，两侧皆是阴沉的隧道延伸开去；恶臭的走廊一路通向黑暗。墙壁在潮湿中渗着水珠。你在肮脏的石面上读到：RESTRICTED AREA. STUDENTS NOT ALLOWED. 你脚下的栅门深处传来浅浅的水流声，还有慌乱的疾爬与尖细的吱吱声。
Bleak tunnels stretch in either direction from the ladder you descended from, foul-smelling corridors leading to darkness. The walls drip in the dampness. Across the grimy stones, you read: RESTRICTED AREA. STUDENTS NOT ALLOWED. A shallow rush of water can be heard from the gates below your feet, as well as frantic skittering and squeaks.

Paladin To Monk In Tournament Melee.name:
圣骑士在锦标赛混战中对阵武僧
Paladin To Monk In Tournament Melee

Text.text:
“好吧，那就这么定了。你要是敢把那套发抖的玩意儿用在我身上，我可就要怒得发亮了——那对护甲简直是地狱般的折磨，原谅我说得这么矮人味儿。来吧，给看台上的观众好好演一出，跳来跳去什么的都行，没问题，但别来那种怪异的手掌把戏。明白了吗？”
“Okay, then. Try that quivering thing on me and I’m just going to become lustrously angry about it. It’s hell on the armor—pardon my dwarvish. So, let’s give the gallery a nice show, all the jumping around, etcetera, fine, but without the freaky palm. Got it?”

Rain, The Outlander Assassin.name:
雨，异乡刺客
Rain, The Outlander Assassin

Text.text:
酒馆的弹簧门“砰”地被撞开，一个皮肤如深色红木般的男人踩着带马刺的靴子大步走进来。他摘下那顶宽檐高冠的帽子，露出一对棱角分明的耳朵，从抹了油的头发间探出。男人扫视着店内的客人——他们也全都盯着他——随后掏出一张褪色的通缉海报。他低头看了片刻，接着抬起一副镣铐，指向两张桌子外坐着的、与画像如出一辙的活人。外乡人的名声，以及他腰间的军刀，在麻烦尚未滋生前就将其斩断；于是那名匪徒站起身走了过去——双臂伸开，掌心朝向椽梁。

~ 扮演：Isaac

The saloon doors bang open as a man with skin like dark mahogany strides in on spurred boots. He doffs his wide-brimmed, high-crowned hat to reveal a pair of angular ears poking out from his oiled hair. Scanning the patrons—who all stare back—the man pulls out a faded bounty poster. He looks at it for a moment, then lifts a pair of manacles toward the sketch’s living counterpart sitting two tables away. The outlander’s reputation, and the saber at his hip, end unpleasantness before it can begin, so the bandit rises and walks over—arms outstretched, palms to the rafters.

~ Played by Isaac

这家藏在街角的狭小摊铺似乎专营各类游戏。不同尺寸与色彩的棋盘格整齐陈列，手绘的纸牌、缤纷的骰子与细小的木制人偶成堆叠放，或悬挂在墙上。你认得其中几种，可更多却闻所未闻。想到店主竟能把它们全都玩得明白，实在令人难以置信。
This hole-in-the-wall vendor appears to specialize in games. Checkered boards of varying sizes and colors, hand-painted playing cards, colorful dice, and tiny figures of wood stand in stacks and hang from the walls. Some games you recognize, but far more are unfamiliar. It seems ridiculous to think the shopkeeper knows how to play them all.

Cultists Chanting.name:
邪教徒的吟诵
Cultists Chanting

Text.text:
无数嗓音——高低交错，少长混杂——诡异地融作一支合唱。语言陌生，吟诵单调。同样的邪异音节一遍又一遍地重复着，形成无尽的循环，向以太深处滚滚铺展——虔敬、崇拜……或许，甚至在召唤。
Many voices—high and low, young and old—blend together in uncanny chorus. The language is unfamiliar, the chant monotonous. The same eldritch syllables are repeated, over and again, an endless pattern wheeling out into the aether—reverent, worshipful… perhaps even beckoning.

Flooded Ruins.name:
被水淹没的遗迹
Flooded Ruins

Text.text:
断裂的石柱与崩塌的墙体自水面探出，台阶一面攀向敞亮的空处，一面又蜿蜒下沉，没入阴郁的深处。无论是什么灾厄夺走了这些建筑，随后都伴随着漫长的溺没——水位不断抬升，直至将整片遗迹彻底淹没。
Broken pillars and crumbling walls project from the water, while stairs climb to open air and descend to the gloomy depths. Whatever calamity claimed these structures, it was followed by a prolonged drowning as the waters rose to flood the ruins.

Mana Blight: In Use.name:
法力疫灾：使用中
Mana Blight: In Use

Text.text:
粘稠的蓝色物质立刻渗入皮肤，所过之处只留下淤青般的斑痕。施法者尖声惨叫，条件反射般抓挠那道印记，仿佛它在灼烧——可这道创伤远不止皮肉之浅。血色从他们脸上迅速褪去，双眼的光泽被彻底抽干。嘴唇无力地张着，像正被可怖的哀恸攫住，正一点点失去对某个珍爱之人或物的抓握。
The viscous blue substance seeps into the skin immediately, leaving a bruise-colored splotch in its wake. The caster shrieks, reflexively clawing at the mark as if it burned—but this wound is far more than skin deep. Color drains from their face and all the shine is sapped from their eyes. Their mouth sags agape as if they are in the throes of terrible sorrow, losing hold of someone or something dear.

Marcus \"Murmur\" Saleb's Shamanic Awake.name:
马库斯“低语”·萨莱布的萨满觉醒
Marcus "Murmur" Saleb's Shamanic Awakening

Text.text:
他接入接口，坠入赛博空间的瞬间像一次清爽的浸没——仿佛纵身跳入一汪冰凉的水。无数计算机语言的线条在他身周奔流——一百万条可供选择的路径——当他在心中投下一个暗示，一串数据便如灯塔般发亮。他向前疾驰，去追寻网络之外、数据银行与加密之后的答案。 他落在网域的十字路口，双脚踏在这交汇点上，线条向无尽地平线延伸。他的心脏被紧张的兴奋灌满，数据在他周围起伏翻涌，簌簌作响，鲜活得像风里被拂乱的树叶。就在这时，他感觉到了：一记全能的脉动与他的心跳同频共振，令人沉醉的触感在他后颈的血肉里凝聚。他的双眼炸开色彩，千重星爆淹没虚拟世界。他悬停其间，震撼而狂喜，任数据的分形穿流过他的身体。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

He jacks in, the fall into cyberspace a refreshing submersion, like a plunge into cool waters. Lines of computerized language run around him—a million pathways for him to take—and a string of data shines like a beacon as he issues a mental suggestion. He soars forward to seek answers beyond networks, their data banks, and encryptions. He lands at a crossroads of the web, feet touching down at this juncture of lines running into an infinite horizon. His heart brims with nervous excitement as data undulates around him, rustling vibrantly like leaves tousled by the wind. That’s when he feels it: an omnipotent pulse beating in time with his own heart, an intoxicating sensation that coalesces in the meat of his neck. His eyes explode with color, a thousand starbursts flooding the virtual world. He suspends, awestruck and euphoric, as fractals of data flow through him.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Speech By A Reformed Criminal About Life.name:
一名改过自新的罪犯关于人生抉择的演讲
Speech By A Reformed Criminal About Life's Choices

Text.text:
“在我最黑暗的时刻，我总觉得自己的人生不过是一串漫长的错误——仿佛每一次站在岔路口，我都选了那条通往自私与苦难的路。可正是那些可怕的决定把我带到了这里，带到了你们所有人身边，所以我必须相信，我也曾做对过些什么。”
“In my darkest moments, I feel as though my life has just been a long chain of mistakes—as if at every crossroads, I’ve chosen the path of selfishness and suffering. Yet all those horrible decisions have led me here, to all of you, so I must believe that I have done something right.”

千座烟囱与烟道吐出的淡薄苦烟，为冬日的空气蒙上一层污浊；城里的人们各自寻求喘息，好从刺骨寒意里偷得片刻温暖。饶是如此，街巷间仍能听见孩子们嬉闹的笑声。沿着主干大道，一队队马匹拖着装盐的麻袋，在覆雪的鹅卵石路上一路撒落，紧随其后的工人队伍立刻挥耙将盐摊开。而在这座大都会的侧街与里巷，住户与工人们也纷纷抡起铁锹，成群结队清扫积雪最厚的路段——这是一项艰巨却必要的苦差，只为让城市的商贸仍能不断流转。
A faint, bitter tinge of smoke from a thousand smokestacks and chimneys fouls the wintry air as the residents of the city seek to find surcease from the bitter cold. Nevertheless, one can still hear the laughter of children at play in the city streets. Along the main thoroughfares, teams of horses pull bags of salt, spilling it out on the snow-covered cobblestones to be raked out by a gang of laborers following close behind. And for those who work and dwell along the side streets of the metropolis, shovels are broken out en masse to keep the city's streets clear of the worst of the snow—a monumental if necessary task to keep the city's trade flowing.

Fearful Ghost.name:
恐惧幽灵（特征）
Fearful Ghost

Text.text:
尖啸在你周围回荡，却来自更远的前方，仿佛你正立在一座深邃洞穴的入口。它逼近了——一声无尽的恐惧尖叫——伴随着沉重脚步的轰鸣，震得地面颤抖，可你却什么也看不见。随后，那恐怖已来到你们之间，灌满你的双耳，如浪潮般漫过、穿透你——把你自己的声音也卷入它的尾流。你的惊惧攀至顶点，继而在尖啸掠过后渐渐退去。
The shriek echoes around you but comes from somewhere far ahead, as if you stand at the entrance to a deep cave. It approaches, an unending scream of fear, along with the sense of pounding footsteps shaking the ground, yet you see nothing. Then the terror is among you, filling your ears, washing over and through you like a wave—drawing your own voice into its wake. Your own fright peaks, then subsides as the scream passes.

Tojeston Cortinarius Purevolt.name:
托杰斯顿·科尔蒂纳里乌斯·纯伏特
Tojeston Cortinarius Purevolt

Text.text:
铁靴铿锵的欢鸣与车轴吱呀的呻吟一同奏响，宣告一位装束考究、身高中等的侏儒翩然而至。他步履带着商贾般的从容优雅，身上那件鲜艳的护甲长外套大胆混搭着王室般的猩红与紫罗兰。米色的肌肤泛着绿金色的底调，衬得他向后梳起的头发更为醒目——发根如泥炭般深染，色泽一路过渡，直至发梢绽出紫水晶般的光。薰衣草色的眼睛宛如春日初绽的第一簇花，盛放着不可动摇的自信；眼下涂抹的深色眼线如利刃般的斜痕，更将那份神采推至锋芒。双耳缀满宝石，繁复的耳洞饰品织成一片精巧的收藏；而一把磨得顺手的短剑，则稳稳挂在他胯上方那条厚实的皮带上。可在这般张扬的外表之下，却有一团温热的、不矫饰的亲和力静静流转，令这道身影真正熠熠生辉。

~ Played by Indigogo

The jubilant clang of sabatons and the creaking of cart axles announces the arrival of a well-appointed gnome of middling height. He moves with mercantile grace, his vibrant armored coat an audacious mélange of royal reds and purples. Skin, beige with green-gold undertones, contrasts his swept-back hair—peat-stained roots, gradually transitioning to amethyst tips. Lavender eyes, like spring's first blossoms, bloom with an unshakeable confidence, amplified by the dark slashes of eyeliner painted beneath them. His ears are bejeweled with intricate collection of piercings while a well-used shortsword adorns the thick leather belt strapped above his hips. Beneath all that outward flamboyance radiates a warm core of unpretentious amiableness that makes this figure truly shine.

~ Played by Indigogo

Dragon: Distant Angry Dragon.name:
巨龙：远方的怒龙
Dragon: Distant Angry Dragon

Text.text:
