巨龙的怒火并未因遥远而减损半分骇人。咆哮、龇牙的嘶吼与低沉的咕噜声撼动你周遭的世界，铺天盖地、原始如飓风。那声音在你脑海里回响不止，震得你分不清该往哪边转。仿佛无论你走向何处，巨龙都会在那里等着你。
The dragon’s wrath proves no less terrifying for being distant. The roars, snarls, and growls shake the world about you, as encompassing and elemental as a hurricane. They echo so much in your head you forget which way to turn. It seems as if the dragon will be there no matter which way you go.

Moody Alien Bus Driver.name:
情绪阴郁的外星公交司机
Moody Alien Bus Driver

Text.text:
你拖着步子登上这辆破败不堪的交通工具时，那魁梧的外星巴士司机直勾勾地瞪着你，喘着粗气抱怨自己要迟到了。他庞大的身躯几乎塞不进那张剥落起皮的皮革座椅里，而你瞥见他那顶磨旧的鸭舌帽下，竟悄悄冒出一对细小的角。
The hulking alien bus driver glares at you pointedly as you shuffle to board the dilapidated transport, huffing that he is going to be late. His enormous frame barely fits into his flaking leather seat, and you notice a pair of tiny horns poking out beneath his worn, peaked cap.

Greeting From Corpo Security Dispatcher.name:
来自企业安保调度员的问候
Greeting From Corpo Security Dispatcher

Text.text:
“您已接通三十一号城市的安保服务，由 Engram 赞助。温馨提醒：线下警务服务仅限白金会员使用。请立即输入您的账户号码，或直接挂断。”
“You have reached City Thirty One’s security services, sponsored by Engram. A reminder that in-person police services are for platinum members only. Please enter your account number now or hang up.”

Nightmare Of Red Eyes In The Dark.name:
黑暗中红眼的噩梦
Nightmare Of Red Eyes In The Dark

Text.text:
眼睛无处不在：无所不在，避无可避。阴影沉沉的幽暗里，数以百计的细小猩红光珠如燃烧的煤块般闪烁，始终注视，始终等待——可是在等什么？你能感觉到它们的目光压在身上，像蚂蚁咬噬般刺痒，皮肉被针尖般的痛意扎透，细微却足以撕扯神经，令人烦躁不安。

~ 由 BigMacDaddy 构想

The eyes are everywhere: omnipresent and inescapable. Hundreds of beady, red orbs shimmer like burning coals in the shadowed gloom, always watching, always waiting—but for what? You feel their gaze upon you, prickling your skin like ant bites stinging the flesh with subtle nerve shredding irritation.

~ Envisioned by BigMacDaddy

天空在一抹擎天巨影的压迫下泛起涟漪。你头顶高空，一只拥有龙般体量的巨鸟再度振翼，撕碎云层，将它那可怖的真容彻底暴露在眼前。即使相隔如此遥远，你仍能看清那嶙峋的巨喙，仿佛能一口碾碎一辆马车；以及那修长弯曲的利爪，像是专为剖开鲸身而生。
The sky ripples away from a titanic shadow. High above you, a bird of dragonlike proportion again beats its wings, shredding the clouds, revealing it in all its terrible glory. Even from this distance, you see a craggy beak that looks like it could crush a wagon, and long, curving talons that seem fit for carving up whales.

I Cast Levitate.name:
我施放【漂浮术】
I Cast Levitate

Text.text:
浓郁琥珀色的虚灵火焰自地面奔涌而起，将我的目标托举到空中。下一瞬，火焰伴随噼啪爆裂与呼啸声骤然消散，而我的目标仍悬停在半空。
Ethereal flames of rich amber surge up from the floor, lifting my target into the air. The flames disappear in the next instant, with a crackle and whoosh, while my target remains aloft.

Sundries From A Needle Blight.name:
针刺疫藤的杂物
Sundries From A Needle Blight

Text.text:
枯萎体轰然倒下，藤蔓般的肢体终于抽搐着停住。它的尸骸除了一团刺痛皮肉的荆棘与尖刺，别无他物。你探入它钻出的那处近旁树洞，发现了过往冒险者的遗留——他们没有你这般走运：一条染着褐色斑渍的黄色头巾，一双开始干裂发硬的皮靴，以及洒落或碎裂的药剂瓶，瓶中残液早已沉入森林的泥土深处。
The blight falls, its vining limbs finally shuddering to a stop. Their corpse offers nothing but a tangle of painful brambles and spines. Exploring the nearby tree hollow from which it sprung, you find evidence of past adventurers who were not as lucky as you: a yellow bandana stained with brown splotches, a pair of leather boots that have begun to dry and crack, and spilt or shattered potion bottles whose contents have long since sunken into the forest floor.

I Absorb A Spell With My Rod Of Absorpti.name:
我用吸收法术杖吸收一道法术
I Absorb A Spell With My Rod Of Absorption

Text.text:
我将魔杖指向法术的源头，绷紧全身，准备迎接那股能量的浪潮。魔杖嗡鸣震颤，光芒大盛，仿佛将魔法吸入肺腑般把它牵引而来；杆身上镌刻的符文随之脉动，泛起柔和的辉光。
I point the Rod toward the source of the spell, tensing my body in preparation for the wave of energy. The Rod thrums and glows brightly as it draws in the magic, almost breathing it in, and the runes etched in the haft pulsate with a soft glow.

这名高挑而瘦削的存在身披板甲，甲面乌黑仿佛刚从烈焰中拖出；背后双翼灰烬般的余烬色，沉沉铺开。猩红的火焰光环冠在他们苍白无发的头颅上。双眼灼红如烙铁，眼眶焦黑，面颊被暗痕划过，仿佛这黑暗天使流出的只有灰烬。焦黑的唇角讥诮上扬，微启间露出莹亮的白色獠牙。堕落者抬起一只覆着利爪护手的铁手，先指向你，继而勾手召唤。另一只手中，一柄火焰之刃伴随恶意的嘶鸣骤然闪现。
Clad in plate armor darkened as if pulled from a fire, this tall, lean being has wings the color of cinders. A halo of crimson flame crowns their pale, hairless head. Their eyes burn red-hot, sockets blackened and cheeks streaked as if the dark angel weeps only ash. Sneering, blackened lips part to reveal lustrous white fangs. With one clawed gauntlet, the fallen one points then beckons. A blade of fire flashes—with a malevolent hiss—into existence in the other hand.

Infernal Casting Of Heroes' Feast.name:
英雄盛宴的炼狱施法
Infernal Casting Of Heroes' Feast

Text.text:
尽管有营火，你仍感到一股寒意在体内流窜。火光仿佛逐渐黯淡，阴影愈发深沉，你几乎能从黑暗中感到有目光在注视着你。你轻声低语，感召你的守护者之力。只需几句咒语与几个手势，你便将阴影塑造成一场盛宴：多汁的烤肉、新鲜的水果，以及香气四溢的面包。
Despite the campfire, you feel a chill course through your body. The fire seems to dim as the shadows grow deeper, and you can almost feel the eyes watching you from the darkness. You speak softly, calling upon your patron’s power. With a few words and gestures, you mold the shadows into a feast of succulent meats, fresh fruits, and fragrant breads.

Possessed Woman Jumps From A Ship.name:
被附身的女人从船上一跃而下
Possessed Woman Jumps From A Ship

Text.text:
女人的面容宁静，她赤裸的双足踏上覆着盐霜的木板，迈出通往水中湮灭的第一步。然而，在这副平和的面具之下，一场绝望的搏斗正激烈上演。她睁大的眼睛惶惶四顾，拼命寻求援手，身体却一步步逼近边缘，额头沁出一粒冰冷的汗珠。呼啸的狂风撕扯着她的衣衫与长发，使其在身后翻卷，如一团猩红的云。带着冷硬的决绝，她目光中的求生渴望终于屈服于命运的不可抗拒——她坠落下去，砸向下方翻涌搅动的水面。

~ Clara C. Potter on Discord

The woman's face is serene as she plants her bare feet upon the salt-rimed plank and takes her first steps toward watery oblivion. However, beneath the placid mask, a desperate battle is taking place. Wide eyes dart furtively, desperately seeking aid as her body moves closer to the edge, and a bead of cold sweat appears on her forehead. A howling wind tears at her clothes and hair, causing them to billow behind her like a crimson cloud. With grim finality, the desperation in her gaze succumbs to the inevitability of her fate—and she plummets to the churning waters below.

~ Clara C. Potter on Discord

Deserted House: Panic-inducing Noises.name:
废弃民宅：引发恐慌的异响
Deserted House: Panic-inducing Noises

Text.text:
远处乌鸦尖啸，昆虫自每一道缝隙里爬出。空气里挤满了细小臃肿的黑色虫躯，逼得你不停挥手把它们从嘴边与耳畔驱开。嗡鸣声后，你听见墙内、天花板与地板深处传来不知疲倦的抓挠声。恐慌攫住你时，一个疯狂的念头猛然跃入脑海：有人正从棺材里用指甲疯狂抠抓棺盖的画面。
Crows scream in the distance as insects crawl from every crevice. The air fills with tiny bloated black bodies, forcing you to wave them away from your mouth and ears. Behind their buzzing, you hear a relentless scratching from inside the walls, ceiling, and floor. As panic grips you, a wild thought leaps to mind: the image of someone clawing at the inside of a coffin lid.

Madagascar Red Owl Familiar.name:
马达加斯加红鸮魔宠
Madagascar Red Owl Familiar

Text.text:
马达加斯加猫头鹰是环保主义学生中时髦的魔宠；这只猫头鹰初生时艳红如北美红衣主教鸟，仿佛戴着一副红黑相间的狂欢节面具。随着岁月流逝，她的羽色沉淀为更柔和的苦甜橙，并被黑白条纹细细划开。她的面容酷似大角鸮：聪慧而凌厉。她举止端正，耐心十足，亦是致命的捕鼠能手。
Madagascar owls are a trendy familiar among conservationist students; this owl was the scarlet of a cardinal when born, and looked as if she was wearing a red-and-black Mardi Gras mask. She has since aged into a softer bittersweet orange streaked with black and white. Her face resembles the great horned owl’s: intelligent and intense. She is proper, patient, and a deadly mouser.

Spacegoing Vessel: Decadent Entertainmen.name:
远航星舰：奢靡娱乐甲板
Spacegoing Vessel: Decadent Entertainment Deck

Text.text:
这艘游乐巡航舰是一头闪耀的娱乐与奢靡巨兽，船体的每一处细节都为奢华与奇观而生。娱乐甲板俨然一座由商店、酒吧、餐厅与康养诊所构成的繁华都会——一切都被绚丽霓虹点亮，勾引着乘客踏入门扉。
The pleasure cruiser is a gleaming leviathan of entertainment and decadence, with every facet of the vessel geared toward luxury and spectacle. The entertainment deck is a veritable metropolis of stores, bars, restaurants, and wellness clinics—all illuminated in vibrant neon to draw passengers through their doors.

Edible Roots.name:
可食用的根茎
Edible Roots

Text.text:
尽管埋在松软的腐殖土里，那些根茎仍会在地表间或探出一截，外皮鲜艳的赭红色在林地黯淡的底色中格外醒目。只要处理得当，这些虬结盘绕的根段便能极其耐饥充饵；而那隐约却层次繁复的风味，也能为任何一餐注入新的生气。
Though buried in loamy soil, the roots peek above the earth in patches, the vibrant, ruddy hue of the outer skin easy to locate among the muted tones of the forest floor. When properly prepared, the gnarled, twisting segments can be incredibly sustaining, and the subtle, complex flavor can bring new life to any meal.

Quip About The Dangers Of A City.name:
调侃城市的凶险
Quip About The Dangers Of A City

Text.text:
“我这辈子都住在这儿，但我跟你说：与其夜里走上几条街，我宁愿去登一座火山的顶。”
“I’ve lived here my whole life, but I tell you: I’d sooner summit a volcano than walk some of these streets at night.”

I Craft A Bomb.name:
我制作一枚炸弹
I Craft A Bomb

Text.text:
一撮黑火药，一把破片，再加上几味我自家的秘方佐料——我的炸弹就成了。我用被熏黑的手指捏着那枚暗色金属圆球，慢慢转动，欣赏着自己的杰作。一截细细的编绳从小孔里蜿蜒探出，充当引信——渴望着火焰。
A pinch of black powder, a dash of shrapnel, a few of my own secret ingredients, and my bomb is ready. I hold the dark metal sphere in my blackened fingers and rotate it slowly, admiring my creation. A thin piece of plaited rope snaking its way from a small opening serves as a fuse—eager for a flame.

想忘掉眼前这名佣兵几乎不可能。他们的脸像被缝成三块——左半边是白发的卓尔，右半边则是黑发的人类，反差刺眼。下颚属于兽人，一条缠口布仿佛将那张嘴牢牢固定在头骨上。赤裸上身的躯体暴露出更荒诞的拼缝：其中还混着龙裔的血肉；胸口、手臂与背部刻满魔法纹身，专为抵御伤害而设。鲁莽、戒备、严苛——这名战士是重生之身，是一件令人不安的活体艺术品。

~ 由 Alex Roos 扮演

Forgetting the mercenary in front of you is likely impossible. Their face is stitched together in three parts—the left half is white-haired drow, the right half human with black hair in striking contrast. Their jaw is orcish, with a mouth wrap that seems to secure it to their head. Shirtless, their body reveals that the patchwork of species includes dragonborn, and magical tattoos on their chest, arms, and back that are designed to protect them from harm. Brash, guarded, and strict, this fighter is a reborn work of unnerving art.

~ Played by Alex Roos

Garden Arms Hotel.name:
花园武装旅店
Garden Arms Hotel

Text.text:
下垂、腐朽、剥落——花园旅店看上去完全不像疲惫的冒险者所盼望的那种温暖而舒适的落脚处。它在镇子中央低矮蹲伏着，曾经也许刷过一层好看的森林绿，窗框镶着白边。然而漆面早已片片起皮卷翘，露出底下腐烂的木板。几根同样剥落的立柱勉强撑着下陷的屋顶，许多陶瓦已经不翼而飞。建筑四周的灌木与花圃被杂草彻底吞没——或许它们曾是令人驻足的花园，也正是这旅店名字的由来。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Sagging, rotting, and peeling, the Garden Arms does not appear to be the welcoming and cozy inn a weary adventurer might hope for. A squat building in the center of town, the hotel may have once been painted a lovely forest green, with white-trimmed windows. However, the paint has flaked and curled to reveal the planks of rotting wood beneath. Similarly flaking posts hold up a sunken roof missing a fair number of clay tiles. Shrubs and flowerbeds overgrown with weeds surround the perimeter of the building—perhaps they were once an inviting garden that gave the hotel its name.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Orbital Laser Guidance Systems.name:
轨道激光制导系统
Orbital Laser Guidance Systems

Text.text:
一道红色光束自苍穹坠落，宛如远古神祇的裁决，绯红光柱倾泻而下，直指大地上的目标。可这道光并不带来毁灭——至少现在还不会。  

在云层之上，悬着一台由全球秘密实验室臆想并铸就的高科技机器——一件漂浮的死亡之器，随时准备为导弹，或更可怖之物，指引它们燃烧的终点。卫星在轨道上轻轻起伏，等待来自某座隐秘地堡的指令。然后——唯有那时——这道红光才会降下真正的审判。
From the heavens comes a red bolt of light, like the judgment of an ancient god, a scarlet beam raining down upon its earthbound target. But this beam does not bring destruction. Not yet. Far above the clouds sits a high-tech piece of machinery dreamt up in secret labs across the globe—a floating thing of death, ready to guide missiles or worse to their fiery destination. The satellite bobs in orbit, awaiting the command from a clandestine bunker. Then—only then—will the red bolt yield judgment.

一伙年轻人盘踞在这座无魂的混凝土神殿——停车库的这一等级。喷漆罐的哗啦声与压缩音质的音乐纠缠在一起，伴着仍在运转的震动滑板低沉的嗡鸣；他们大笑、吹嘘、打闹，尽显少年时节那点自以为是的“智慧”。一辆驶近的车猛按喇叭，尖锐的爆鸣将他们惊得四散逃开，司机则加速冲过，根本不打算停下。
A gang of youths dominates this level of the soulless concrete temple that is the parking garage. The rattle of spray cans mingles with compressed music and the low hum of active vibroboards as they laugh, boast, and cavort with all the wisdom of adolescence. A sharp blast from the horn of an approaching car causes them to scatter as the driver speeds forward, unwilling to stop.

Warning From Forest Folk.name:
来自林中族人的警告
Warning From Forest Folk

Text.text:
“你们还没拿够吗？整个世界都被你们那永无止境的进步行军吞噬殆尽。但我警告你——在这片大地上我们这小小的一隅，你们的理念、你们的躯体，以及你们自以为珍贵的文明，都不受欢迎。”
“Have you not taken enough? The whole world is consumed by your relentless march of progress. But I warn you—in our small corner of this earth, your ideas, your bodies, and your precious civilization are not welcome.”

高耸树篱的顶端像摇摇欲坠的蓬松发髻般猛然一晃，根须从泥土中硬生生扯出，惊得鸟儿与蜥蜴从它们葱茏的枝叶间仓皇逃窜。那些不驯的灌木横着身子像螃蟹般疾行，挪到草坪更向阳的区域，身后拖出一串串泥块与落叶。它们在新位置心满意足，便将根系重新钻入地里，把叶面侧向太阳，舒展铺开。
The tops of the tall hedges lurch like unstable bouffants as roots wrench themselves from the earth, sending birds and lizards fleeing from their lush somas. The unruly shrubs crab-walk to a sunnier area of the lawn, leaving trails of dirt clods and leaves in their wake. Content with their new spot, they burrow their roots into the ground and turn their leaves broadside to the sun.

Room Feels Wrong.name:
房间的氛围不对劲
Room Feels Wrong

Text.text:
你一踏入其中，感官便被这间房里那股压迫性的悖谬感彻底淹没。听觉迅速退化，只剩心脏擂鼓般的轰鸣；眩晕一波接一波袭来——胃里翻江倒海，而重力的强度与方向都在不断摇摆。细密的汗珠沁上皮肤，甜腻与腐败交织的气味一齐冲撞鼻腔。可这一切仅持续片刻。待不适渐渐退去，你终于能真正看清周遭。
As you enter, your senses are overwhelmed at the oppressive wrongness of the room. Your hearing diminishes to the pounding of your heart, and waves of vertigo assail you—your stomach somersaulting as gravity fluctuates both in intensity and direction. Tiny beads of sweat form on your skin while smells, both sweet and rotten, assail your nose. It lasts but a moment. As the feelings subside you are finally able to take in your surroundings properly.

Sundries From A Spirit's Lair.name:
灵巢杂物
Sundries From A Spirit's Lair

Text.text: 你踏上腐朽的地板时，废弃的房子发出哀怨的吱呀声，仿佛厌恶你的到来。书房里那张磨损的橡木书桌上，你发现一个小小的皮袋，里面的烟斗草早已腐烂，还有一张发黄的羊皮纸，褪色的字迹写着已提供服务的契约——落款日期是二十年前。 The abandoned house creaks mournfully as you tread the rotting floorboards, as if it’s repulsed by your presence. On the worn oak desk in the study, you find a small leather pouch of rotted pipe weed and a yellowed parchment with Contract for services rendered in faded lettering—dated twenty years ago.

Pirate Raid On A Corporate Office.name:
对企业办公室的海盗突袭
Pirate Raid On A Corporate Office

Text.text:
这座城市错综复杂的行会架构，比窗外那条河更扭曲、更污浊。在清算所的高层里，闯入的审计员、被杀的律师、以及一算盘般的会计们都蜷伏在书桌前，羽毛笔的笔翎疯狂抖动，在羊皮纸上疾扫不休。一打海盗攀着绳索从窗口荡入，吼叫着挥舞弯刀；有人因落地不稳而猛烈坠落，撞翻了家具。戴眼镜的面孔们缓缓转过来，惊愕地望着这些企业掠夺者。

~ JP Delofski 构想

The complicated guild structure of the city is more twisted and polluted than the river outside the window. On a high floor of the counting house, an intrusion of auditors, a murder of lawyers, and an abacus of accountants are all hunched over desks, the feathers of their quills flicking madly across parchment. A dozen pirates swing through the windows on ropes, shouting and brandishing cutlasses, some falling hard from bad landings and knocking over furniture. Faces wearing glasses turn slowly in wonder at the corporate raiders.

~ Envisioned by JP Delofski

Military Spacecraft Docking Bays And Shi.name:
军用航天器停泊坞与船坞
Military Spacecraft Docking Bays And Shipyard

Text.text:
小巧而敏捷的战机以严整的编队巡弋在码头船坞上空，呼啸掠过，宛如一团黄蜂云。下方的造船厂里停着数艘令人心悸的巨舰，或在建造、或在修缮；有的甚至被彻底掏空，只剩泰坦般的金属骨架暴露在焊工的火焰切割下。从各个角度武装卫兵都在盯守船坞，探照灯按固定弧线来回扫射，而他们的同伴则在下方那些被干坞锁死的舰船之间进行例行巡逻。
Small, agile fighters patrol the dockyards in tightly drilled flight patterns, whizzing by like a cloud of hornets. The shipyards below host several intimidating vessels in different stages of construction and repair, with some having been gutted entirely, their titanic metal skeletons exposed to the welders’ torches. Armed guards watch the shipyard from every angle, sweeping searchlights in regular arcs as their comrades below carry out routine patrols between the dry-locked vessels.

Speech By A Vampire.name:
吸血鬼（特征）的演说
Speech By A Vampire

Text.text:
“我并不憎恨那些被我取食之人。正如你也不会憎恨你所收割的庄稼，或你所屠宰的牲畜。有时我甚至赐予那些可怜的村民一份赋礼。或许，若你此刻俯首投降，我便能让你见识这份赋礼，并将凡俗的死生重负，从你疲惫的肩头卸下。”
“I do not hate those I feed upon. Just as you do not hate the crops you harvest or the livestock you slaughter. At times I have even given those pitiful villagers a gift. Perhaps, if you surrender now, I can show you this gift, and lift the burden of mortality from your weary shoulders.”

这片北地的空气凛冽如刃，连树木也锋利起来。高耸的圆锥形常青树在天幕下勾出参差锯齿般的边界，枝条披着密针与成簇的鳞片球果，怀抱着孕育种子的沉默。与之相对，地面却柔软得近乎温顺，苔藓与地衣如毯铺展，将起伏的地势染成绿与金。鸟儿以喧闹的歌声呼唤，而一株白杨颤抖的叶片低语着，像占卜者摇铃般干涩的沙沙声。
The air in this northern clime is sharp, and so are the trees. Tall, conical evergreens form a jagged border against the sky, and their branches are clothed in needles and clusters of scaly, seed-bearing cones. The ground, by contrast, is soft, with moss and lichen carpeting the rolling landscape in green and gold. Birds call out in raucous song, while an aspen’s shivering leaves whisper like the dry rasp of a soothsayer’s rattle.

A Goblin Fires An Arrow At You.name:
一名地精朝你放出一箭
A Goblin Fires An Arrow At You

Text.text:
那小小的生物把箭搭上弓弦，屏息凝神地细细瞄准，直到确信必定命中目标，才松手放箭。箭矢比飞鸟更快地直扑你而来，在你身上凿开一个不大却火辣刺痛的孔洞。
The little creature nocks an arrow in their bow, carefully aiming until they’re sure it will hit its target, and releases. The arrow flies toward you quicker than a bird, puncturing a small but painful hole in your body.

Town With Many Young Nobles.name:
年轻贵族云集的小镇
Town With Many Young Nobles

Text.text:
修剪得一丝不苟的花园环抱着一幢幢雅致的庄园宅邸，自中央广场起如螺旋般向外铺展。广场上点缀着现代风格的雕像，多半是镇上年轻贵族出资订制。你在镇里各处都能见到他们的身影，往返于自家庄园，在生意与享乐之间翩然穿梭。他们身着最精致、最引领潮流的衣装，佩戴珠宝，发髻与发型亦考究到极致。
Manicured gardens surround elegant manor houses, spiraling outward from the central plaza. Modern statuary adorn the plaza, likely commissioned by the town's young nobility. You see them throughout the town, coming and going from their manor houses and flitting from business to pleasure. They sport the finest, most trendsetting garments, jewelry, and hair.

Grizzly Bear Charging.name:
灰熊冲锋
Grizzly Bear Charging

Text.text:
巨熊稳稳踏地，怒吼咆哮。它那细小的眼珠幽深阴冷，长爪下泥土飞溅，随即猛然前冲，发起一记狂暴冲锋。
The bear sets its feet, angry and roaring. Its beady eyes are deep, and dirt kicks from under the bear’s long claws as it surges forward into a charge.

Smith Langston.name:
史密斯·兰斯顿
Smith Langston

Text.text:
他很惹眼——这名结实的男人剪着齐整的赤褐短发，精心修整的八字胡与山羊胡相映成趣。考究的衣装、得体的饰物，再加上一袭暮色丝质斗篷，让他看起来格外体面。两只黑色护臂上各嵌着一颗澄澈的宝石。唯独腰间那柄朴素的铁匠锤显得有些格格不入。他神色平静，目光却在你们与四周的人之间来回扫量，像是在掂量局势与每一个角色。还有那道疤……在他颈侧……竟与你的如出一辙。

~ Played by Marrogh12

He’s striking, this sturdy man with cropped auburn hair, a tidy mustache and goatee to match. With fine attire, tasteful adornments, and a cloak of dusky silk, he’s well-dressed too. A clear gem adorns each of his black bracers. Only the simple smith’s hammer on his belt seems out of place. He calmly sizes up the situation and the people around him. And that scar… on his neck… it’s a lot like yours.

~ Played by Marrogh12

Shadows Crisscrossing The Stone Bridge.name:
交错在石桥上的阴影
Shadows Crisscrossing The Stone Bridge

Text.text:
尽管山壁上的火把与桥另一端的火盆投下了充足的光亮，桥面中段却仍被拉出一道道漫长的阴影；在那灼灼火光的映衬下，它们显得愈发幽深黯黑。
Though the torches attached to the mountain wall, and the braziers at the far end of the bridge, cast a goodly amount of light, they create long shadows halfway across the bridge, which seem all the darker in contrast to the burning radiances.

Titan Entombed In Ice.name:
冰封巨灵
Titan Entombed In Ice

Text.text:
巨掌如山，自冰川寒冰中缓缓升起，饥渴地伸向灼烈的苍穹。冰冷而死寂的眼睛，竟有马车轮般巨大，从这座凛冽的囚牢里死死瞪着苔原；那头巨型生物的怒意几乎要溢出冰壁，纵然被囚禁了亿万年也未曾消散。与那充满憎恨的目光相对，你几乎敢发誓这头倒下的巨兽仍未死去——被封在这可憎的牢狱之中——蛰伏着他们的时代，只等将毁灭性的狂怒倾泻到世间。

~ 一位英雄 Envisioned

Titanic hands rise from the glacial ice, reaching out hungrily toward the blistering heavens. Cold, dead eyes the size of wagon wheels glare at the tundra from a frigid prison, the colossal creature’s rage palpable despite eons of internment. Staring into those hate-filled eyes, you swear the fallen behemoth is still alive—encased in their abominable prison—biding their time to unleash devastating fury upon the world.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

No-nonsense Cantina Owner.name:
不苟言笑的小酒馆老板
No-nonsense Cantina Owner

Text.text:
吧台后的男人像一面金属舱壁，围着围裙，脸上那股钢铁般的冷峻与之相称。他给客人倒酒时还算客气——而那两条如桥墩般的手臂若是抡出一拳，谁也不想站在挨打的那一端，这份无声的威胁也让客人们反过来格外守礼。
The man behind the bar is a metal bulkhead wearing an apron, with a steely expression to match. He is polite enough as he serves drinks to his patrons—the threat of being on the wrong end of a blow thrown from those arms like pylons seems to keep the patrons polite in turn.

I Drink My Potion Of Flying.name:
我喝下我的飞行药水
I Drink My Potion Of Flying

Text.text:
我一拔开瓶塞，药剂就仿佛要振翅逃走，里面的东西更像雾而非液体。我赶在它们逸散前一边吸气一边啜入口中，随即硬生生憋回一声嗝。就在这时，我感觉双脚正从地面缓缓离开。
The potion threatens to fly away as I uncap it, its contents more like mist than liquid. I simultaneously inhale and slurp the contents before they can escape me, then stymie a belch. As I do, I feel my feet rise from the ground.

Temple To A God Of Knowledge.name:
知识之神的神庙
Temple To A God Of Knowledge

Text.text:
每一座神殿都仿照神明自己的居所而建。入口之门上雕着生命之树，敞开着，如同神明的心智般毫无遮掩。殿内更为华美的壁龛里，石作上刻满繁复的莲花纹样。神殿地面中央是一座壁炉，东墙上一扇窗户，百叶紧闭，直到夜幕降临才会开启。西墙边，两名神职人员正忙着回填蓄水池，为那道流淌不息的瀑布供水。清晰的示意图标注着向下与向上的楼梯：地下室里有一张巨大的圆桌与许多椅子，供人议事；上层则是寝室与藏书室。
Each temple is designed after the god’s own home. The entrance door, carved with a tree of life, stands open as the god’s mind. Some more opulent alcoves within have stonework carved with intricate lotus patterns. Across the temple floor is a fireplace, and on the east wall a window kept shuttered until nightfall. At the west wall, two clergy members work to refill the reservoir that feeds a flowing waterfall. Clear diagrams label the downward and upward stairs: in the basement you will find a great round table with many chairs, for discussions; on the upper floor, bedchambers and libraries.

Hunted By An Ancient Dragon At Sea.name:
在海上遭远古巨龙追猎
Hunted By An Ancient Dragon At Sea

Text.text:
双手死死按在甲板栏杆上，你凝视着苍白的海浪无力地拍打船壳，目送一座座冰山漂过——像不知疲倦的哨兵，在这片孤寂的海洋上永远漂泊。刺骨寒风骤然抽起，帆布鼓胀翻卷、狂乱扭动，一团湿意砸在你脸上——那是雪吗？你还未来得及细想，右舷船首外传来一声熟悉而充满复仇意味的嘶嘶声，瞬间打断思绪，让你的血也像脚下冰水般冰冷。甲板已被霰雪浸透，脚下滑得站不稳；暴风雪正吞没你的船，你在白茫中艰难挪步。你踉跄向前，盲目抓紧栏杆，高声呼喊你的伙伴……却迎面撞上你最骇人的猎手：一头远古白龙。 那庞然身影在暴雪里盘旋绕船，你死死追着它的轨迹，猛地拍下船载弩炮的释放扳机——放！时代仿佛放慢，你看着弩矢划出弧线，在狂风中摇摆穿行。够不够？伴随一声如树干刺穿猛犸厚皮的闷响，弩矢正中要害。甲板上爆出震天欢呼，船员们目睹巨龙坠入起泡的蔚蓝浪涛之中。

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Hands planted firmly on the railing of the deck, you stare out across the pallid waves lapping weakly at the hull of your vessel, watching icebergs float by—implacable sentinels forever adrift in this lonely ocean. A frigid wind whips up suddenly, causing the sails to billow and twist with chaotic abandon as something wet hits your face—is that snow? Your next thought is interrupted, and your blood runs as cold as the icy waters below, when you hear a familiar, vengeful hiss off the starboard bow. The deck—now drenched with sleet—is slippery underfoot as you struggle to make your way through the blinding snowstorm now engulfing your ship. You stumble forward, blindly clinging to the railing, calling for your companions… and come face to face with your fearsome hunter: an ancient white dragon. The titanic blur circles your ship in the blizzard; you track it, then hammer the release of the onboard ballista and let fly! Time seems to slow as you watch the projectile arc through the sky, swaying in the blustering gale. Will it be enough? With a sound like a tree trunk piercing a mammoth's hide, the bolt strikes true. A roar of adulation erupts on deck as the crew watches the dragon plummet into the foaming cerulean waves.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Loot From A Possessed Person.name:
附身者身上的战利品
Loot From A Possessed Person

Text.text:
此人身上再无任何值得一提或有价值之物——不过是一堆皮包骨，裹在破碎染血的衣衫里。然而，在他们身下，你瞥见一抹猩红的微光。你在那里发现一枚以红色绘就的符印，鼓动脉动，宛如跳动的心脏。那血色封印的中心，一颗宝石幽幽闪烁，恰似自新近被撕裂的尸身中掏出的内脏般湿冷夺目。
The person is bare of anything of note or value—little more than a pile of skin and bones amid torn and bloodied clothes. However, beneath their body, you see a reddish glow. There, you find a sigil painted in red, pulsing like a beating heart. At the center of the sanguine seal a gem glistens, like viscera pulled from a freshly sundered corpse.

Elven Vale: Bird Chatter.name:
精灵谷：鸟语喧啾
Elven Vale: Bird Chatter

Text.text:
一阵阵鸟鸣合唱在林间回荡，宛如婚礼钟声般清亮。那声音轻轻搔弄着你的耳廓，让你想起更好时光里那些惬意的散步。你不由得揣测它们彼此在说些什么，脑海却随之浮现出一座拥挤的城中集市——四处都是交谈声，摊贩扯着嗓子吆喝自家的货品。
A chorus of birdsong peals through the woodland like wedding bells. It tickles your ears, reminding you of other pleasant walks in better times. You wonder what they’re saying to one another, and it makes you think of a crowded city market with conversations all around and sellers shouting about their wares.

你眸光如银，熠熠生辉；玄奥咒言一出，便点燃万物深处沉睡的创世古火，将那不幸落入你冷厉凝视的生物尽数吞没。火焰灼灼，辉映着唤醒它们的群星之光。
Your gleaming eyes and arcane words spark the ancient fires of creation that exist within all things, engulfing the creature unfortunate enough to fall under your harsh gaze. The flames glow with the light of the stars from which they awakened.

Mobility Aid Store Owner.name:
行动辅助器具店老板
Mobility Aid Store Owner

Text.text:
你正四处浏览时，一位高挑纤瘦的卓尔走近你，身着一袭装饰繁复的长裙。那裙子显然是手工缝制的，她小心翼翼，确保没有一丝散落的饰片会勾住货架上的商品。她轻巧地转了个小圈，裙摆扬起的瞬间，你看见她的一条腿竟是细致绘彩的义肢。 “欢迎，欢迎。”她环指店内，朝你灿然一笑，仿佛能迸出火星。“我刚到了一批绝妙的新手杖。要不要试用一趟？”

~ 扮演：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

As you browse, you’re approached by a tall, lean drow wearing an elaborately decorated dress. It is clearly handmade, and she is careful to ensure none of the errant pieces snag on the merchandise. She does a quick little spin and, as the dress lifts, you notice that one of her legs is an intricately painted prosthetic. “Welcome, welcome.” She motions around the store, beaming at you with a smile that could create sparks. “I just got a wonderful new shipment of canes. May I interest you in a test run?”

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Tracks In Sand.name:
沙中踪迹
Tracks In Sand

Text.text:
这些足迹并不起眼，落下时就被回填的沙土半掩着，但仍有些蛛丝马迹足以让你做出有根据的推断：拖拽与抬起的痕迹，步态的节奏。又比如，有只动物曾在岩石的阴影里卧下，把沙地压得瓷实；足迹落在其上，便像翻开一页兽类图鉴般清晰可读。
The prints are nondescript, partly covered by backfill even as they were made, but some tells still help you make an educated guess. The drag and lift, the gait pattern. A place where another animal has reclined in the shade of a rock and packed the sand, where the track has landed, can read like a bestiary.

Jesshann The Dragonborn Draconic Bloodli.name:
杰珊恩——龙裔·龙脉血统术士
Jesshann The Dragonborn Draconic Bloodline Sorcerer

Text.text:
黑暗中，锋利的利爪迸射出橙色火星，映在一只覆着深红鳞片的手上，寒光闪烁。那双黄澄澄的爬行类眼睛一下攫住你的视线，巨大的身影迈入光里——身披浓郁的祖母绿天鹅绒长袍，腰间一条黑色皮带松松垂在胯侧，挂着一串皮囊。她的年代难以揣度，但龙裔嘴角那抹坏笑泄露出一股顽皮气息，甚至带着几分诡诈与戏弄。

~ Played by Tyler from RPGBOT.net

Orange sparks shoot from sharp talons in the dark, glinting off of a hand encased in deep red scales. Yellow reptilian eyes catch and hold your attention as the large figure steps into the light—clad in a rich, emerald green velvet robe, a black leather belt with pouches slung low across the hips. Though her age is hard to guess, the smirk on the Dragonborn’s face belies a sense of mischief, and perhaps trickery.

~ Played by Tyler from RPGBOT.net

这团鼓胀而畸异的肉球悬浮在空中，离地数尺上下起伏。它的椭圆形躯体几乎被一只竖瞳、永不眨动的独眼所占据；其下是一张骇人的巨口，锯齿般的獠牙密密层层，张开时几乎将这只生物肥硕的身形一分为二。它的身体上不见任何肢体——取而代之的是无数条触手翻涌扭动，末端皆顶着不眨的眼珠，向四面八方窥视。
The bulbous, aberrant sphere of flesh hovers, bobbing a few feet off the ground. Its oblong form is dominated by a single, unblinking eye with a vertical pupil and a hideous maw brimming with jagged teeth which opens so wide it almost bisects the creature’s corpulent form. No limbs emerge from the creature’s body—instead, innumerable tentacles topped with unblinking eyes writhe, perceiving in all directions.

Fancy Horse-drawn Carriage.name:
华丽马车
Fancy Horse-drawn Carriage

Text.text:
在街道两侧那些磨损的推车旁，这辆马车简直堪称艺术品。金色的花丝沿着全封闭的乘客车厢边缘盘绕，连上方的车夫座也软垫厚实、洁净如新。车前一对纯种骏马静静候着，胸膛宽厚如酒桶，缰绳抛光得锃亮发光。

~ Envisioned by Joe

Next to the well-worn carts dotting the sides of the street, this carriage is a work of art. Gold filigree loops along the edges of the fully enclosed passenger coach, and even the driver's seat atop looks comfortably padded and pristine. A pair of thoroughbred steeds with chests like barrels wait patiently at the front of the transport, their reins polished to a gleam.

~ Envisioned by Joe

地势在此处缓缓下倾，通向一处隐秘的小谷地。四周树木环抱，枝桠向内弯拢，将林间空地从日光中遮蔽起来。翡翠般的树冠之上漏下斑驳金辉，柔和地落在零散的石块与虬结盘绕的根须上。你沿坡走入这片幽谷时，荒野的声响仿佛渐渐远去，被温柔地压低、隔绝。
The land slopes downward here, leading into a small, secluded vale ringed with trees whose boughs bend inward, shading the clearing from the sun. The light here, dappled and golden as it seeps through the emerald canopy above, lands softly upon scattered stones and gnarled, winding roots. The sounds of the wilderness seem to fade, pleasantly muffled, as you descend into the dell.

Ivory Chess Piece.name:
象牙棋子
Ivory Chess Piece

Text.text:
在腐烂的内脏残渣间微微闪烁，一抹白光攫住了你的视线。那是一块象牙，约有你掌心般宽，被无瑕地雕成一匹前蹄扬起的骏马。工艺精妙到你几乎能想象这微型坐骑会在你掌中奋力挣扎，因自己如今的处境而嘶鸣抗议。再凑近细看，你才发现它是一枚棋子——一名骑士，正等待着机会将国王拉下王座。
Shimmering amid rotting offal, a glimmer of white catches your eye. It is a piece of ivory, about the width of your palm, carved flawlessly into a rearing stallion. The craftsmanship is so fine that you can imagine the miniature bucking your grasp and whinnying in protest of its current state. Closer inspection reveals it is a chess piece—a knight waiting for the chance to take down a king.

一个类人生物——兜帽低垂、长袍覆身——如雾般从黑暗中踏出，轻而易举地将光线消散殆尽。它的皮肤，除去那套d-suit外你能瞥见的寥寥几处，呈现出干枯月球般被漂白的惨白色泽。它与所有人都显得从容自在，穿过等待的人群时步伐随意而漫不经心。可它的影子不对。它的影子全都不对。 A humanoid—hooded and robed—steps out from the darkness like mist, dissipating light with ease. Their skin, what little you can glimpse besides the d-suit, appears the bleached hue of a desiccated moon. They are at ease with all, cutting a casual gait through the waiting crowds. But their shadow is wrong. Their shadow is all wrong.

Friendly, Deaf Giant.name:
友善的聋耳巨人
Friendly, Deaf Giant

Text.text:
那魁梧如山的男人坐在农夫的货车上，竟把整辆车衬得像一张小凳子。他越过鼓胀得惊人的肚腹朝你咧嘴一笑，随即爆出一连串雷鸣般的怪叫与吼声，你怎么也听不出半点像是语言的痕迹。接着他指了指自己那对巨大的耳朵，又用蒲扇般的大手啪地捂住它们，仿佛在向你传达什么。
The massive man sits on a farmer’s wagon, making it seem as small as a stool. He smiles down at you over his prodigious belly and utters a thunderous serious of hoots and hollers you don’t recognize as discernible language. Then he points to both his huge ears and claps his giant hands over them, as if telling you something.

远处尘土翻卷，一只车轮正滚滚逼近——又或是某种伪装成车轮的东西。待它靠近，才看清那是无数触手纠缠蠕动、紧紧盘成球的一团乱麻。它共有六条触手，色泽幽暗，渗出亮绿的毒液。四根猩红的感应触须抽打四周，仿佛在品尝空气的气味。而在这“车轮”的中央，一张巨口豁然张开，亮绿唾液自无尽排黑牙间滴落；那些牙尖如针，密密丛生。生物的另一侧则伸出一颗粗陋臃肿的头颅，麻点般的皮肤上，数不清的乌黑小眼如伤口般睁着。
Dust kicks up in the distance as a wheel approaches—or something disguised as a wheel. As it draws near, it is revealed to be a wiggling mess of tentacles wound into a tight sphere. Each of its six tentacles is dark and oozes a bright green venom. Four red sensors lash out at the surroundings, tasting the air. And at the center of the wheel yawns a great maw dripping green saliva from endless rows of black teeth spiked like needles. A crude bulbous head protrudes from the other side of the creature, with countless beady eyes of jet black open like wounds on pockmarked skin.

Barbarian Threat About Insulted Friend.name:
野蛮人威胁：关于受辱的朋友
Barbarian Threat About Insulted Friend

Text.text:
“你再敢那样跟我的朋友说话，我就把你用自己的肠子吊在镇广场上。”
“You speak to my friend like that again and I’ll hang you up by your own guts in the town square.”

从他那件猩红船长外套甩动时的利落声响与夺目色泽，以及三角帽帽檐上潇洒外溢的羽饰便可看出，这名牛头人对自己的仪表极其讲究。他的口鼻裂开一道自信的笑，露出洁白而方正的牙齿。一只手将细剑高高举起，另一只手紧扣腰间的手枪。他已蓄势待发，且乐于迎向任何威胁。
By the swish and vibrant color of his crimson-red captain’s coat and the jaunty feathers spilling over the brim of his tricorn, it is clear this minotaur cares deeply about his appearance. His snout splits into a confident grin showing his white, blocky teeth. One hand holds a rapier aloft; the other clings to a pistol at his waist. He is ready and willing for a threat.

比武大会的旺季一到，骑士与随从们便四处奔走，赶赴赛场列阵。高高竖起一面巨大的对阵板，把马上长枪比试的对手一一配对。花卉、食物与家用货品在一片人声鼎沸的混乱中叫卖、交易。骑士们裹在护甲里汗流浃背，摘下头盔时发丝尽湿，贴在额前。时而，蹄声的节奏在田野上层层攀升——最终以长枪击中盾牌或胸甲那一记清脆的闷响与碎裂声作结。围栏里的马匹嘶鸣，旗帜在热浪里无力地垂挂着。
The high season of tournaments has knights and their entourages traveling to make the lists. A great board is raised with the opponents paired for the joust. Flowers and food and goods for the house are being sold and traded in a chaos of voices. The knights sweat in their armor, their hair soaked when they remove helmets. Now and then, the rhythm of hooves crescendos over the fields—ending with the sharp smack and crunch of lance on shield or breastplate. Horses whinny in the paddock, and banners hang limp in the heat.

它从某个早该被遗忘的噩梦幽暗深处侧身爬出，拖着一对细长的弯钩利爪——一头像被剥了皮、又浸在焦油里的树懒般的生物。漆黑而干瘪的皮肉紧紧绷在一具纤薄的骷髅（特征）上，肌束如钢丝般缠缚其间。它的眼睛深陷，像两汪血红的掠食之潭——幽幽燃着异界的怨毒。它对你的恐惧露出笑意，卷曲成排的剃刀獠牙层层叠叠，口涎成团滴落。
Sidling from the dark recess of some best-forgotten nightmare, on long hooked claws, is a creature that looks like a flayed sloth dipped in tar. Black, emaciated flesh is pulled tight over a thin skeleton wired with muscle. The eyes are recessed pools of red predation—lambent with otherworldly rancor. It smiles at your fear, revealing curled rows of razor teeth cascading with globs of spittle.

I Use Brutal Critical.name:
我使用【残酷重击】
I Use Brutal Critical

Text.text:
当我的武器重重命中时，我低声咆哮。我继续施压，将它更深地埋入。我猛然一拧。随后，带着毫不留情的凶狠与一声长嚎，我将它狠狠撕扯拔出。
As my weapon lands a solid blow, I snarl. I push harder, burying it deeper. I twist it. Then, with merciless ferocity and a howl, I tear it free.

一代又一代在此安眠，永世相伴。数百年来，这座巴洛克风格的地穴塞满了同一血脉的枯骨——每一位都由尚在人世的亲族以庄重与敬意安葬。如今，常春藤在风化崩塌的石质外墙上肆意蔓延；夹击着巨大铁门的雕像也被岁月磨蚀得面目全非，五官残缺，早已辨不出是谁。
Generations rest here, together in eternity. For centuries, this baroque crypt has been filled with the bones of the same bloodline, each one interred with grace and reverence by their surviving kin. Ivy grows wild over the crumbling stone facade now, and statues flanking the large iron doors have eroded into anonymity, their features degraded beyond recognition.

听见你进门的动静，那名魁梧的男人把已经有时间冷却的那部分吹制玻璃作品放下，拿起一把造型古怪的刀，将仍旧炽热的区域细细收束修整。他起身站直，转动肩膀舒展开来，随后摘下厚手套，搓了搓双手。无论你是否会成为付钱的顾客，他显然都迫不及待想展示自己的手艺——把朴素的硅质材料点化成一件件小小的艺术品。
Hearing your entrance, the burly man sets down the part of his glass-blown creation that has had time to cool, tapering off the still-hot area with an oddly designed knife. He straightens as he stands, rolling his shoulders, then removing his thick gloves and rubbing his hands together. Whether or not you prove to be a paying customer, he is clearly quite eager to show off his crafts, transformed from humble silicates into minor works of art.

抄写员端坐在一摞摞羊皮纸后，抬起头望向你。她眼眶发红、泪水盈盈，长久紧盯那些笔迹清晰程度不一的手稿，早已把目光熬得发涩。她案前摆着好几只墨水瓶，便于随手取用。她做事一丝不苟，可指尖仍被墨渍染黑；你怀疑哪怕再怎么疯狂搓洗，那些污迹也从未真正褪尽。
Seated behind multiple piles of parchment, the scribe looks up at you with red, watery eyes, strained as they are from constantly focusing on handwriting of varying readability. Several inkpots sit at the front of her desk for easy access. Despite the care taken in her work, the tips of her fingers have been stained with ink. You suspect that these stains are never fully removed, even after a frenzy of hand-washing.

这个半身人强盗狡诈阴险、身形矮小却顽劣成性，是潜伏在社会边缘的一抹狡黠暗影。他们手指灵巧，挂着顽童般的坏笑，以胆大妄为的韧劲四处游荡；那双傲慢的眼睛泄露出对恶作剧的嗜好，以及在欺瞒中游刃有余的本事。最好把贵重物品看紧点，免得落到他手里。
This halfling bandit is a conniving, diminutive rapscallion, a sly shadow lurking at the edge of society. With nimble fingers and an impish grin, they cruise the world with audacious tenacity, while arrogant eyes betray a propensity for mischief and an adroitness in deception. Folk had best hold onto their valuables around this one.

天空中一抹粉红的微光让你不由得停下脚步。那枚针尖般的亮点以每秒可见的速度不断扩大，直至化作一团耀目的能量从天穹坠落。它拖曳着刺目的光辉掠过你头顶，热浪随之翻涌而来。陨石撞地的瞬间迸裂成灼人的璀璨碎光，而数秒之后，冲击波才轰然抵达，将你震得心神摇晃。
A blip of pinkish light in the sky gives you pause. The pinprick grows in size by the second, until it becomes a dazzling burst of energy falling from the heavens. A wave of heat emanates from it as it trails in blinding light over you. The meteor explodes in a searing glitter as it hits the earth, and you are rocked by the impact several seconds later.

Long-eared Owl Familiar.name:
长耳鸮魔宠
Long-eared Owl Familiar

Text.text:
他脸盘宽阔，圆得像一面卫星天线，头顶两簇毛茸茸的耳羽，长度足有大角鸮的两倍。他身形瘦高，翼展宽大，黑色喙锋硬得仿佛能啄裂钻石。可他一声“咕”却是滑稽的小嗡鸣，像有人吹着纸质派对喇叭。尽管听觉出类拔萃，他却不怎么肯听人说话——宁愿动手也不爱交涉——并以性命守护送往族人的每一份货物。
He has a broad face, round like a satellite dish, topped with tufted ears twice as long as a great horned owl. He is lean and tall, with a broad wingspan and a black beak that looks as if it could crack a diamond. But his hoot is a funny little buzz, like someone blowing a paper party favor. While his hearing is superlative, he isn’t much of a listener—preferring action to diplomacy—and he protects all deliveries to his people with his life.

Dizzying Casting Of Detect Thoughts.name:
令人目眩的施放：侦测思想
Dizzying Casting Of Detect Thoughts

Text.text:
如同一场你无法理解的梦，你发现自己迷失在目标喋喋不休的思绪间，被眼花缭乱的心灵车流狂轰滥炸。你强撑着保持对法术的掌控，让自己的搜寻穿过这片动荡的喧嚣，去找出你所追寻之物。

~ 构想：Sahlonahl（Discord）

Like a dream you don't understand, you find yourself lost amid the chattering thoughts of your target, bombarded with a dizzying array of mental traffic. Your mind reels as you strain to retain control of the spell, guiding your search through the tumult to find what you seek.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

[察觉] 你迈出下一步时，脚下的地面忽然变得松软，几乎在体重之下微微塌陷。你凝神观察片刻，发现自己站立的表层在最轻微的扰动下也会起伏蠕动、悄然位移，只是难以判断这种异象究竟延伸到多远。

[触发] 地面猛然攫住你，将你向下拽入现形的流沙之中。那股力量不算迅疾，却异常强劲；越是挣扎，反而越快下沉。没人知道沙层究竟有多深。

[Perceived] The ground feels softer on your next step, almost giving beneath your weight. Watching carefully for a moment, the surface you're standing on seems to shift and move at even the slightest disturbance, though it's difficult to tell how far this phenomenon stretches.

[Triggered] The ground grabs at you, pulling you down below the surface of the revealed quicksand. The force isn't fast, but it is strong, and resisting only quickens the rate at which you sink. There’s no telling how deep the sand is.

Vondal Rumnaheim.name:
冯达尔·鲁姆纳海姆
Vondal Rumnaheim

Text.text:
银光穿过矮人沙金色的头发与胡须，仿佛金银矿脉在幽暗矿道里蜿蜒闪烁。尘土覆着他的靴子与旅装，布料磨旧却被悉心照料，外衣与长裤上满是反复缝补的针脚与补丁。他把皮革装帧的法术书紧贴身侧，一柄宽刃、矮人打造的短剑挂在腰间，剑柄因数十年的握持而磨得温润发亮。一只赤褐色的仓鸮停在他肩头，眼睛与主人同样是榛色。

~ Played by LJ

Silver streaks the dwarf’s sandy-blond hair and beard, evoking veins of gold and silver running through the shadowed tunnels of a mine. Dust coats his boots and traveler’s clothes, the fabric well worn but maintained with multiple stitch repairs and patches adorning the dwarf’s coat and breeches. He keeps a leather-bound spellbook close at hand, and a broad-bladed dwarf-made shortsword hangs at his belt, its hilt worn from decades of use. Upon his shoulder perches a ruddy barn owl, its eyes the same hazel hue as its master’s.

~ Played by LJ

外堡空无一人，城墙被撕开缺口；从滚滚烟尘中你判断主堡已被掏空焚毁。箭矢与投枪散落一地，间或可见血迹飞溅的斑痕，但冲突与其参与者似乎早已转移。毫无疑问，进去之后你会知道得更多。
The barbican stands empty, the walls breached, and from the smoke you guess that the keep is gutted. Arrows and javelins lie scattered about, as well as the occasional splatter of blood, but the conflict and its participants seem to have moved on. No doubt you’ll find out more inside.

一个披着兜帽的身影走近，每一步都沉重得发颤；他每一次移动，齿轮与机件的嗡鸣便随之可闻。兜帽阴影里一双绿眼幽然发亮，暗色长袍在他金属身躯的棱角处被磨得破碎褴褛。他抬手触了触挂在颈间的新月吊坠，随即举起机械手，向你致意。

~ Played by JaiTea

A hooded figure approaches, each step shakingly heavy, the whirring of machinery audible with each movement he makes. Green eyes gleam from within the hood, the dark robes tattered and torn against the edges of his metal form. He touches a crescent pendant that hangs about his neck then holds up his robotic hand in greeting.

~ Played by JaiTea

这装置看起来像一座便携讲台：上漆木件彼此咬合，可拼出不同层级的支援。一块装有轮子的方形底座，一端敞开，方便双脚自由移动。装置半腰处有一块棕色皮革软垫平台，使用者可坐下、把一膝搁上去，甚至摊开一本法术书。再往上，两侧各有一只软垫扶臂，末端配着一对线条圆润的木质握把。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，Forge Ahead: A Party To Access 创作

This device has the look of a portable podium, with its lacquered wooden pieces fitting together to provide various levels of support. A square base fitted with wheels opens on one end to offer free movement of one’s feet. A brown leather cushioned platform halfway up the device allows the user to take a seat, rest a knee, or perhaps even lay open a spellbook. Finally, two cushioned armrests are near the top, with a pair of smoothly shaped wooden handholds at each end.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

风一定得在这里停下。总该有某个时代，这片严酷荒瘠的土地能得享安宁。可从地平线到地平线，微风不断抽打着草海，将它翻搅得如同一片翠绿的海洋。浪潮一路涌上远方的丘陵，而在你所能想象的尽头，它们或许永无止息。
The wind must stop blowing here. There must be some time when this harsh and barren landscape is at peace. But from horizon to horizon, breezes buffet the grass, churning it like a green ocean. The waves continue up distant hills, and for all you know they carry on forever.

D'artagnan, L'amant Rouge.name:
达达尼昂，红色情人
D'artagnan, L'amant Rouge

Text.text:
武艺张扬的典范——披着海军上尉的长外套——大步踏下舷梯。他身形高挑而精瘦，赤红皮肤的男人双眼无瞳，微光闪烁，仿佛将熄的太阳。蕾丝立领与精心向后梳拢的头发勾勒出一张棱角分明的面庞，只差一道伤疤便近乎艺术般的完美。那道疤从额头一路撕裂般攀向他一支弯角的碎裂尖端。仿佛正想起那天收到这份不受欢迎的“赠礼”，男人的手不由自主地伸向腰侧那柄久经使用的细剑。

~ Played by Vmaster1995 with

A paragon of martial flamboyance, draped in the coat of a naval captain, strides down the gangplank. Tall and lean, the red-skinned man’s pupil-less eyes glimmer like dying suns. A lace collar and carefully pulled-back hair frame an angular face one scar shy of artistic perfection. That scar tears up his forehead toward the cracked tip of one of his curved horns. As if thinking of the day he received such an unwelcome gift, the man’s hand reaches unconsciously to the well-used rapier at his hip.

~ Played by Vmaster1995 with

绿意——在这片沙漠里几乎闻所未闻——环抱着绿洲中心那座红瓦宝塔。八角形的石质台基被千百双脚与数十年毫无遮拦的烈日磨得光滑如镜。其上立着六根石柱，托起尖顶的屋檐。渗水湖面升起的空气清凉凛冽，宝塔屋顶投下的阴影为灼人的骄阳赐下一方怡人的喘息之所。
Greenery—nearly unheard of here in the desert—surrounds the red-roofed pagoda at the heart of the oasis. The octagonal stone dais is worn smooth by thousands of feet and decades of unfettered sun. Upon it stand six pillars supporting the steepled roof. The air rising from the seep lake is cool and crisp, and the shade afforded by the pagoda’s roof offers a pleasant respite from the scorching sun.

Sundries From A Troll Lair.name:
巨魔巢穴杂物
Sundries From A Troll Lair

Text.text:
巨魔（特征）那具咕嘟冒泡的尸体在旁迅速腐烂，你继续深入这座恶臭的洞窟，发现洞壁上有个遮掩拙劣的洞口。巨魔（特征）眼中的宝藏究竟算不算宝藏，实在很难说——它的囤货大多只是些弯折的餐具、一副破碎的眼镜，以及一把没有琴弦的鲁特琴。
With the bubbling corpse of the troll rapidly decaying nearby, you venture further into the fetid cave to find a poorly concealed hole in the cavern wall. What a troll considers treasure is highly debatable, as most of the items in its hoard are pieces of bent cutlery, a pair of broken spectacles, and a lute with no strings.

I Cast A Spell With Energy From My Rod O.name:
我从吸能杖中引出能量，施放法术
I Cast A Spell With Energy From My Rod Of Absorption

Text.text:
我紧紧攥住法杖，将心神聚焦于其中的魔法，伸出我的奥术感官。就在我触及那片储存能量的蓄池时，一阵震颤猛然袭来，我将那股力量抽引入体。精神为之一振，我活动手指，准备施放我的法术。
Clutching the Rod tightly I focus on the magic within, reaching out with my arcane senses. I feel a jolt as I tap into the reservoir of stored energy and draw the power into my being. Invigorated, I flex my fingers and prepare to cast my spell.

Roxie Hale, 5th Year House Griffon.name:
罗克茜·黑尔，格里芬学院五年级
Roxie Hale, 5th Year House Griffon

Text.text:
她的头发剪成时髦的轮廓，却在十三岁那年染上雨云般的灰。她有一双亮得近乎发光的翠绿眼睛，身形柔软得让人安心。她几乎总是趿着拖鞋。罗茜也许是你见过最安静、却最会评头论足的人，但没人能真的对她生气太久。她的魔宠是一只金瞳的俄罗斯蓝猫，永远不会离她超过几步——性子也如出一辙：黏人、讨喜、让人牙痒，又动不动就一脸受了委屈。
Her hair, cut in a trendy shape, turned the gray of a raincloud when she was thirteen. She has incandescent green eyes, and her physique is comfortably soft. She almost always wears slippers. Roxie may be the most quietly judgmental person you ever meet, but no one can stay angry at her. Her familiar, a Russian Blue cat with golden eyes, is never more than a few feet from her—and has an identical personality: cuddly, charming, frustrating, and regularly offended.

前方那头兽类看起来比寻常的马高出整整一个档次。它的躯干更为粗壮结实，身上点缀着形状大小不一的伤疤。它高昂着头，几乎带着几分骄傲，周身散发出自信的气场。远处忽然传来一声清脆的爆响，可那马连眉都不皱一下，对这突如其来的声响毫不在意。它只是喷了口鼻息，像是在发出挑衅。
The beast ahead looks to be a league above your typical horse. Its body is thicker and sturdier, and peppered with scars of varying shapes and sizes. It holds its head high, almost proudly, radiating an aura of confidence. A distant pop rings out, but the horse doesn't even flinch at the unexpected noise. It only snorts in challenge.

I Cast Conjure Minor Elementals.name:
我施放《召唤次级元素》
I Cast Conjure Minor Elementals

Text.text:
本源诸界的微小生灵更容易求问。我的措辞更简洁，手势也更迅捷。然而，连年轻的大地也已古老，而又有谁能知晓空气的年代？于是我吟诵，做出与那物质相称的手势，静候纯粹元素的住民结盟现身。
The smaller beings of the essential realms are easier to ask. My phrases are simpler, and the gestures quicker. But even the young earth is old, and how does one know the age of air? So I chant and make the gesture appropriate to the material, and wait for the denizens of the pure elements to appear in alliance.

Tiefling Corpse.name:
提夫林的尸体
Tiefling Corpse

Text.text:
提夫林长着犄角的头颅滚落在蜷缩的尸身旁一滩血泊里，漆黑的眼睛凝望着永恒。断首之躯仍披着华贵衣饰，一袭被压皱的天鹅绒斗篷如同丧葬裹尸布般将其覆住。
The tiefling’s horned head lies in a puddle of gore beside their crumpled body, black eyes gazing into eternity. Opulent clothing adorns the beheaded corpse, and a crushed velvet cape envelops it like a funeral shroud.

Ring Of Feather Falling.name:
羽落之戒
Ring Of Feather Falling

Text.text:
这枚戒指的铂金戒圈酷似一根鸟羽，逼真得几可乱真；若非羽轴以柔和的金色细细勾勒，几乎会让人以为那就是真羽。
The platinum band of this ring resembles a bird feather so strongly that one might mistake it for the real thing were it not for the rachis of the feather, which has been detailed in soft gold.

Castle Parapet Walk.name:
城堡垛墙步道
Castle Parapet Walk

Text.text:
你沿着城堡垛墙顶端的巡道前行，脚下石面湿滑发黏。暴雨如瀑，挟着倾盆之势砸在你身上，你绕行于城堡外墙之际，只能庆幸身旁那道齿状女儿墙勉强替你遮去些许风雨。
The stone is slick underfoot as you traverse the parapet walk atop the castle's battlements. Rain pelts you with torrential force as you make your way around the castle's outer walls, though you are grateful for the meager coverage afforded by the crenellated wall beside you.

这个小村子的人们一定在庆祝什么。几乎所有人都出来了，穿着最体面的衣服，或戴着自制的面具、披着戏服，投身某种狂欢。乐感可疑的村民们奏着热闹喧腾的曲子，年轻人——以及心还年轻的人——围着一根缠满彩带的高杆起舞。空气里飘着各式食物的香气，而酒精显然正被毫不吝啬地灌下肚。
The people of this little village must have something to celebrate. Everyone seems to be out, dressed in their best or wearing homemade masks and costumes for some kind of revel. Villagers of dubious musical talent play a rollicking tune while the young people, and those young at heart, dance around a ribbon-wrapped pole. You smell a variety of foods, and alcohol is clearly being liberally consumed.

Headstone: “Look” In Winter.name:
墓碑：“冬日凝望”
Headstone: “Look” In Winter

Text.text: 一棵枯死之树在雪地上投下的冷峻阴影，令这块墓碑的铭刻平添一股森然的分量。岩石上凿刻的文字写道：看着我。记住你也将与我同命运，因为你同样终有一死。 The stark shadow of a dead tree against the snow gives this headstone’s engraving eerie weight. The words carved into the rock read: Look upon me. Remember you will share my fate, for you too are mortal.

I Cast Poison Spray.name:
我施放【毒雾喷射】
I Cast Poison Spray

Text.text:
每一寸毛孔都刺痛着，我能感觉到毒素在体内翻涌上升，皮肤泛着湿亮的光泽，像青蛙般黏滑。我抬起颤抖的双手，锁定我的目标。将张开的掌心猛地向前一推，一团毒雾嘶嘶喷涌而出。双眼被熏得泪水直涌，喉间泛起酸苦的胆汁——但就在快要令人无法忍受之前，法术已从我身边飘散开去。
Every pore stings as I feel the poison rising up within me, my skin glistening like a frog’s. I raise my shaking hands and sight my target. Shoving my open palms forward, a cloud of the poison hisses out. My eyes water in protest and bile rises in my throat—but the spell wafts away from me just before it becomes unbearable.

尽管这截被砍下的云杉枝干已被修整打磨，单凭分量就足以当作一根称手的棍棒，但在它粗厚的柄身上刻满了德鲁伊符号，让你相信这件武器远不止初看那般简单。
Though this chopped-down spruce limb has been trimmed and sanded to make a perfectly serviceable club, if only from its weight, the Druidic symbols carved along its thick shaft lead you to believe that this weapon is more than it seems at first glance.

在那些肌肤如奶油般莹润、灵魂如光辉般耀目的魔法之人中，她堪称最完美的代表。乌黑的长发间掺着几缕金丝；浅金的眼眸，像通往更明亮世界的两枚光球。她性情多变，常被创伤记忆牵动而情绪起伏，让她一贯的慈悲在顷刻间翻涌成炽烈的愤恸。与她同行的是萨堤尔人默文。他是她美德的忠诚映照——尽管他放纵而无礼——却同样怀着她的体恤、她的深沉热情，并且显然是她至交无疑。

~ Played by Godspice with

Among the crème-skinned radiant souls of magic, she is a perfect representative. Long, dark brown hair with strands of gold. Light gold eyes that look like orbs to a brighter world. She is mercurial, prone to mood swings brought on by traumatic memory, which turn her regular compassion to passionate upset. Traveling with her is the satyr Mervin. He serves as a devoted counterpart to her virtue—hedonistic and impertinent as he is—but shares her sense of care, her deep passions, and is obviously very much her friend.

~ Played by Godspice with

武斗长袍如活影般将那高耸的身形尽数吞没，骨白面具与兜帽为他的外貌添上一层森冷的性相。尽管他的体格与隐秘格格不入，这男人的动作却谨慎而精准，双手泛起细腻的淡紫灵能微光。长袍紧绷的布料之下，钻石般坚硬的肌肉顶着衣衫向外鼓起，以可观的负载试探着衣料的极限；他悄然前行，沉稳有力的步伐压得脚下木板在体重之下吱呀作响。守卫踱来探查时，他倏然滑入阴影，面具后的绿眼微微眯起；空气随精神能量的泄放而一阵刺麻，待那倒霉的巡逻兵转身离去——已然确信自己什么都没听见。

~ Played by a Hero

Martial robes fully envelop the towering figure like living shadow, his bone-white mask and hood adding a deathly aspect to his appearance. Though his stature is ill-suited to subtlety, the man moves with careful precision, his hands aglow with the delicate lilac hue of psionic energy. Through the tight fabric of his robes, diamond-hard muscles push against the cloth, testing the garment with their considerable bulk as he creeps onward, his powerful steps causing boards to creak beneath his weight. Slinking into the shadows as a guard wanders over to investigate, his green eyes narrow behind the mask and the air tingles with the discharge of psychic energy as the hapless patrolman wanders off, convinced he didn’t hear a thing.

~ Played by a Hero

Plea About Lords' Responsibility.name:
关于领主责任的恳求
Plea About Lords' Responsibility

Text.text:
“你们不是领主吗？你们不是一直踩着外头那些人的脊梁吃得脑满肠肥吗？难道你们不该至少拿出一点象征性的努力，去守护他们的性命，确保他们的安危？”
“Are you not lords? Have you not grown fat off the backs of those people out there? Do you not owe them at least some token effort to protect their lives, secure their safety?”

Dragon Fighting A Dracolich.name:
巨龙激战龙巫妖
Dragon Fighting A Dracolich

Text.text:
在这场生与不死的终极对决中，洞窟地面颤动、龟裂、轰然炸开，一头巨龙巫妖破土而出：灰黑森冷，浑身滴落的腐蚀毒液落地便嘶嘶作响。她张开大口，下颌骨与利齿尽数裸露，喷吐出酸息。洞外，一头绿龙利爪与獠牙迸发神圣能量，侧身闪避酸雾猛扑上前，却仍不敌巫妖之力，被她一击拍飞。巫妖随即召唤出魔法藤蔓，扭曲而狰狞地蜿蜒爬向她的目标。

~ 构想：Andrew Cheeseman

In this life-versus-undeath confrontation on the grandest scale, the cave floor quivers, fractures, and bursts open to reveal an emerging dragon lich, gray-black and dripping vitriol that hisses where it hits the ground. She opens her mouth, jawbone and teeth all exposed, and sprays her acid breath. A green dragon outside the cave, his claws and fangs flaring with divine energy, dodges the spray and lunges forward, but the lich is too strong and bats him away. The lich summons magical vines that creep grotesquely toward her adversary.

~ Envisioned by Andrew Cheeseman

Whirlpool Reveals Treasure On Ocean Floo.name:
海底漩涡揭露宝藏
Whirlpool Reveals Treasure On Ocean Floor

Text.text:
巨大的狂怒漩涡搅动着汹涌的水域，船只从旁驶过，船身危险地倾斜摇晃。瞭望台传来惊惶与诧异的呼喊——哨兵在浪涛间看见了什么：宝藏。你探身望向船外，只见翻涌的深处，一座如巨龙巢穴般的财富堆闪烁微光，在旋流中沉浮——近得令人心痒，几乎只要伸手就能触及并将它们攫走。

~ 由 Clara C. Potter 在 Discord 上 Envisioned

The ship lists dangerously as it passes the tumultuous waters of the huge, raging whirlpool. Shouts of alarm and surprise echo from the crow's nest as the lookout spots something in the waves: treasure. Looking overboard, you see a dragon's hoard of riches shimmering in the churning depths, so tantalizingly close you could almost reach out and grab them.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

一顶色彩斑斓的帐篷铺展开来，庞大得足以让国王都心生嫉妒，横亘在原野之上。粗壮的绳索将它牢牢钉在地面，免得这座奇想的造物被风卷走，像谁的白日梦般飘散无踪。彩旗在风中噼啪作响，悬挂的横幅以浓烈的笔触描绘着古怪的人物，宣告着马戏团的招牌演出：巨人矮人！碎颅者！利瓦斯——最肥的精灵！咒蛛夫人！ A colorful tent, large enough to make a king jealous, sprawls across the field. It is pegged to the ground by thick ropes so that this fanciful construct doesn’t blow away and disappear like someone’s daydream. Pennants snap in the breeze, and hanging banners painted vividly with strange people declare some of the circus’s star acts: Giant Dwarf! Skullcrusher! Levath the Fattest Elf! Madam Spellspider!

I Read A Conjuration Spell Scroll I Unde.name:
我阅读了一张召唤系法术卷轴，我明白了。
I Read A Conjuration Spell Scroll I Understand

Text.text:
我的目光来回飞窜，拼命追着卷轴上那些符号——它们忽而抽动，忽而闪烁，像是瞬移般在纸面各处跳跃。汗珠沿着眉骨滑落，我屏息凝神，竭力将这些离经叛道的刻痕钉在原位，哪怕只够我读出其中暗藏的法术。终于，那阵移动停了下来，符号彼此衔接，凝成我能理解的奥秘词句。
My eyes dart back and forth trying to follow the symbols on the scroll as they move sporadically, teleporting around the page. Sweat drips down my brow as I concentrate on pinning the wayward etchings in place long enough for me to read the spell hidden within. Eventually the movement stops, and the symbols form arcane words I understand.

一声尖厉的啸叫从一只小小的生物口中迸发，刺破空气。它拍打着皮革般的双翼，扑簌翻飞，勉强悬停在半空。粗糙的赤红皮肤紧绷在精瘦而结实的臂腿上，每一肢都生着锐利的黑色利爪。它下背伸出一条修长的蝎尾，尾端是那标志性的钳刺。参差的尖牙排列在它口中，幽黄发光的眼睛嵌在深陷的眼窝里。两根突出的角与密密麻麻的脊棱、尖刺沿着恶魔头顶排开。它悬空不定，目光飞快来回扫视——那细小的眼珠在搜寻周围的区域。
A shrill cry emanates from a tiny creature, piercing the air. Leathery wings flap and flutter, keeping it aloft. Rough red skin is pulled tight over lean, muscular arms and legs, each fitted with sharp black talons. From its lower back a long scorpion tail stretches, tipped with its signature pincer. Jagged teeth line the creature’s mouth and luminescent yellow eyes lie in sunken sockets. Two prominent horns and a multitude of ridges and spikes line the top of the fiend’s head. It hovers, quickly glancing to and fro—its beady eyes searching the surrounding area.

随着法术的最后一个音节落下，你以奥术造诣唤现的立方体低鸣着凝成实形；你先前撒下的粉末状绿柱石勾勒出边界，沿着那些细线，魅影之墙骤然拔地而起。法术区域之外唯余不可穿透的幽暗，但你仍因自己施加的魔法庇护而生出一丝满足。
With the last syllable of the spell uttered, the cube called into being by your arcane mastery hums into existence, phantom walls springing up from the lines of powdered chrysolite you scattered to mark its boundaries. Outside of the spell’s area there is nothing but impenetrable gloom, yet you feel a certain sense of satisfaction with the magical protection you have afforded yourself.

大地像烤面包的脆壳般龟裂开来，裂出一道深得令人心悸的峡缝——不过横跨其上的堤道多少让人觉得还能安全通行。可当你走近些，去看桥入口两侧夹击般矗立的雕像时，这份安心便淡了几分：起初不过是些披甲武士的平庸雕刻，直到你看清他们扭曲怪诞的面孔——一个眼球暴突、咧嘴狞笑，另一个嘴角上扬，露出阴冷的讥讽。
The ground is cracked open like the crust of baked bread, creating a chasm that runs frighteningly deep—although a causeway across the gap provides some assurance of safe passage. This impression diminishes somewhat when you get a closer look at the statues flanking the entrance to the bridge: rather banal carvings of armored warriors until you look at their grotesque faces, one leering with bulging eyes and the other making a sneering grimace.

半身人于最后的休息中显得安宁，仿佛只是慵懒的夏日午后，在他们钟爱的树下、摇曳的枝桠间悄然沉入梦乡。然而，惨白如死的肤色却出卖了命运的真相。
The halfling looks peaceful in their final rest, as if they drifted to sleep on a lazy summer afternoon, beneath the swaying boughs of their favored tree. However, a deathly pallor betrays the truth of their fate.

Haunted Manor Dining Room.name:
闹鬼庄园餐厅
Haunted Manor Dining Room

Text.text:
你的双眼逐渐适应这间正式餐厅的昏暗。那张修长华丽的餐桌上斑驳覆盖着一片片诡异的绿色物质，又因多种生物多年造成的伤害而满目疮痍，仿佛曾是无数聚会的中心。餐桌四周坐着一家人的幽灵身影。你目光被对面墙上那面巨大的华丽镜子里的移动所攫住。你注视间，一幕骇人的景象在镜中展开：那位如今以幽魂形态栖身此处的绅士，却以生前最盛的模样现身，挥斧将家人残忍肢解，随后又用腰间佩戴的匕首了结了自己的性命。
Your eyes adjust to the gloom in a formal dining room. The long ornate table—covered with patches of a strange green substance and suffering from years of damage from various creatures—appears to have been the center of many gatherings. Seated around it are the spectral forms of a family. Your eye is captured by movement in the large ornate mirror on the opposite wall. A ghastly scene unfolds as you watch: the gentleman, whose spectral form now inhabits the room, but in the full bloom of life, mutilates the family with an axe before taking his own life with the dagger worn at his belt.

Wizard Tower Exterior.name:
巫师高塔外观
Wizard Tower Exterior

Text.text:
这座高塔在周遭建筑间格外扎眼：既是建筑奇观，又像对整座聚落总体风格的公然挑衅。塔基怪异，竟是五边而非四边；塔身自下而上柔和收束，到了顶端却鼓出一座圆润的日光室。那轮廓宛如一颗水晶球，被三只巨大的龙爪牢牢攫住。远在近一英里外，仍能瞥见室内不合时宜地闪烁着五彩的幽光，忽明忽灭。
The tower stands out from all of the surrounding buildings as both a marvel of architecture and an affront to the design of the overall settlement. Built upon an oddly-shaped base with five sides rather than four, the tower gently tapers upward to a bulging solar in a rounded shape. The feature resembles a crystal ball clutched by three enormous dragon claws. From nearly a mile distant, one can espy multicolored glowing lights flashing on and off at odd hours from within the chamber.

Flooded Field.name:
被洪水淹没的田野
Flooded Field

Text.text:
贯穿这座残破要塞的河流，自远方群山奔涌而来，最终汇入地平线外那遥不可及的海。它将要塞一分为二；你不禁想象，在它淹没山谷之前，河上曾架起过桥梁，横跨其上。可如今，在它幽暗的深处，你只看见那些从桥上坠落、为守卫要塞而死的士兵残骸——护甲与兵刃的冷光隐约闪动，骷髅空洞的面容在水下仰望，永远凝视着上方，令人不寒而栗。
The river flowing through the ruined keep runs from the mountains in the distance to the sea far beyond the horizon. It bisects the keep, and you imagine that once, before it flooded the vale, bridges may have been erected atop it. But now, in its shadowed depths, you see only the remains of soldiers who fell from those bridges defending the keep—the glint of armor and weapons, and the haunting visage of skulls staring forever upward.

Quip About An Ancient Forest.name:
关于远古森林的俏皮话
Quip About An Ancient Forest

Text.text:
“真是个奇妙的地方。我觉得你就算在这片森林里度过一生，也绝不会两次看到相同的景象。”
“Such a wonderous place. I feel you could spend your whole life in this forest and never see the same sight twice.”

圆形建筑傲然矗立在山巅，外圈以立柱回廊环抱。通往神殿的小径绕山盘旋，显然是为静心冥想而设的步行路线。你一时找不到入口，但当你端详柱身上刻下的浮雕时，殿内的诵唱声清晰传来：身披护甲的人们——也许是英雄，或许是士兵——以及披着长袍的身影，像是祭司，又像是法师。
The circular building stands proud atop the hill, surrounded by a pillared portico. The pathway to the temple circles the hill, no doubt meant to be a meditative walk. You don’t see the entrance, but you can hear chanting from within as you survey the carvings engraved on the pillars: people in armor, heroes or perhaps soldiers, and robed figures that might be priests or wizards.

Beautiful Bronze Buckle.name:
精美的青铜扣饰
Beautiful Bronze Buckle

Text.text:
必须借助放大镜，才能看清这枚扣环上的工艺究竟有多精细。扣框本身很宽，可为了契合它而雕制的荒野图景，显然出自大师级匠人之手：那是一场枝叶繁茂林间的猎鹿——框的一侧，逼真的猎犬与持矛奔跑的猎手并肩追逐；上沿，雄鹿纵身跃过；另一侧，则是冉冉升起的朝阳。扣针被塑成一支狩猎用的箭矢。
A magnifier is required to see how fine the work is on this buckle. The frame is wide, but the wilderness scene made to fit it must have been designed by a master craftsperson. It is a deer hunt through a leafy forest—realistic hounds and runners with spears along one side of the frame, the buck bounding across the top, and the rising sun on the other side. The prong is shaped like a hunting arrow.

Windsong Caverns: High Tones.name:
风歌洞窟：高音区
Windsong Caverns: High Tones

Text.text:
一声出人意料的美妙音符在洞窟中回荡，为这片空间添上了如大教堂般的庄严气息。你一边寻觅声源，一边想起神殿里的乐声，目光却捕捉到钟乳石与石笋上布满了凹孔，宛如长笛上的音孔。
A note of surprising beauty sounds throughout the cavern, lending the space a cathedral-like feel. You think about music in a temple as you look for the source of the noise and spy cavities in the stalactites and stalagmites, like the holes in a flute.

I Cast Fire Elemental Planar Ally.name:
我召唤火元素的异界盟友
I Cast Fire Elemental Planar Ally

Text.text:
火舌在我指间翻舞，我召唤出那道传送门——一座熔岩岩拱，垂落着绿与红的余烬帘幕。门的另一侧轰然咆哮，一尊火焰之灵猛然冲出。它四肢细长如枝，手足亦修长——只一步长腿跨越，便逼近到我面前，热浪迫得我额上渗出汗珠。它的言语从一张滴落着熔浆丝缕的口中嘶嘶喷吐而出。
Tongues of fire dance through my fingers as I summon the portal, a lava rock archway with curtains of green and red embers. A roar erupts from the other side and a being of flame rushes forth. Spindling arms and legs with long hands and feet—it approaches me in a single, long-legged stride, bringing a sweat to my brow. Its speech seethes from a mouth dripping with strings of magma.

一截邪异弯曲的钢刃自短木柄横向延展，凝成一把致命的利刃。刀身纤薄如纸，锋锐如剃，仿佛天生只为劈斩与断割而生。
The length of wickedly curved steel stretches horizontally from a short wooden handle to form a lethal blade. Thin and razor sharp, the blade seems especially designed to slash and sever.

Loot From A Hell Hound.name:
来自地狱猎犬的战利品
Loot From A Hell Hound

Text.text:
你从猎犬身上收集到的灰烬与毛发对炼金术士而言颇有价值；你估算这堆带着硫磺气息的灰烬价值略低于十二枚金币，而那团黏腻纠结的毛发则还能再值十枚。
The ash and hair you collect from the hound is valuable to an alchemist, and you estimate their worth to be just under a dozen gold coins for the sulfurous pile of ash and another ten for the sticky clump of hair.

Repairing A Hacker's Deck.name:
修理黑客的甲板
Repairing A Hacker's Deck

Text.text:
[检定成功] 你如释重负地叹了口气。凭着精细到毫厘的手法，再加上一点运气，你成功修复了黑客甲板的伤害，让它恢复到完全可用的状态。

[检定失败] 尽管你竭尽全力，伤害仍然过于严重，无法修复。甲板依旧带伤，因此更容易遭受额外的攻击。

[大失败] 灾难骤然降临。甲板当场炸裂，火花四溅，随即开始喷吐钴蓝色的烟雾。这该死的东西彻底报废——事实上已经不可逆地变砖，让你再也没有黑客甲板可用。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

[Successful Check] You sigh with relief. With delicate precision, and a touch of luck, you manage to successfully repair the damage to your hacker’s deck, restoring it to full functionality.

[Failed Check] Despite your best efforts, the damage is too extensive to repair. The deck remains damaged and thus vulnerable to additional attack.

[Critical Failure] Something catastrophic happens. The deck blows, erupting with sparks, and begins belching cobalt-blue smoke. The damn thing is totaled. Irreparably bricked, in fact, leaving you without a hacker’s deck.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Speech About Commoner Duality.name:
关于平民的双重性演说
Speech About Commoner Duality

Text.text:
“彻头彻尾地平凡无奇，却又在多样性上熠熠生辉；卑微的平民，正是一种令人着迷的二元生物。寻常日子的庸常，被无尽的变数与际遇调味，让诸界的每一位居民都成了自己故事里的英雄——不管他们斩杀了多少条巨龙。”
"Thoroughly unremarkable, yet simultaneously brilliant in diversity, the humble commoner is a creature of fascinating duality. The mundanity of normal life, flavored with infinite variation and circumstance, makes each denizen of the realms the hero of their own story—regardless how many dragons they slay."

Sundries From A Jabberwock.name:
来自“咆哮怪”的杂货
Sundries From A Jabberwock

Text.text:
一些洞穴钻进被削平的翠绿草毡之中，围成一圈，环拱着一座扭曲的橡木日晷。其间你发现了几只tove蜕下的、滑腻的皮。一个柔弱的borogrove提出要当你的宠物。你还找到一件破旧的斗篷，由gyrfalcon羽毛缝成，以及一副像餐垫那般大的纸牌。
Some holes burrowed into the cut green wabe circle a warped oaken sundial. Among them you find the molted slithy skins of some toves. A mimsy borogrove offers to be your pet. You also find a ratty cape made of gyrfalcon feathers and a deck of cards the size of placemats.

那台机械人手握短棍，以令人惊异的流畅动作复刻古老武艺。或许，它正把往昔那些较为欢愉的岁月里曾与之切磋的诸多骑士之一当作假想敌——那时光刃只为训练与防卫而出鞘，而非为了活命。

~ MaesterAelix 于 Discord

The droid moves in startlingly fluid motions as it replicates the ancient arts, baton in hand. Perhaps it is picturing one of the many opponents it had among the knights in happier times, when sabers were only drawn for training and defense—not survival.

~ MaesterAelix on Discord

Farmers' Shrine To A Sun God.name:
农夫们的太阳神神龛
Farmers' Shrine To A Sun God

Text.text:
通往小山丘顶的小径蜿蜒而上，被一代代农夫日复一日朝圣般前往神龛的脚步磨得圆润光滑。神龛朴素，却洁净且维护得当：一座刻着太阳符号的祭坛、一只用来盛放供品的小碗，以及一尊饱经风雨侵蚀的古老雕像。如今已无人记得这雕像最初描绘的是哪位神明，但人人都认定那是一位慈和仁爱的神祇——当黎明来临、太阳越过山脊的刹那，那份宁静的存在感最为强烈。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The winding path up the small hill has been worn smooth by generations of farmers making daily pilgrimage to the shrine. Simple, but clean and well maintained, the shrine consists of an altar engraved with the symbol of the sun, a small bowl for offerings, and an ancient weather-worn statue. No one alive today remembers which god the statue originally depicted, but everyone agrees that they are a kind, loving deity whose peaceful presence can be felt most strongly at dawn, as the sun crests the hills.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Monastery Of Fiend-fighting Monks.name:
降魔僧院
Monastery Of Fiend-fighting Monks

Text.text:
银铃声穿透清冽的山间空气，你拾级而上，踏过覆雪的石阶，走向那座传说中的修道院。古老的石壁上刻着奇异的纹记。穿过一座彩绘拱门时，一缕悦耳的音色牵引你抬头——那串风铃由透亮的亚硒酸盐石管制成，和声清澈，相互咬合得恰到好处。踏入寺院庭地，你屏息凝望：僧侣们正在操练，每一次移动都精准、克制——也致命。

~ 构想：Inbal（Discord）

Silver bells peal through the crisp mountain air as you ascended the snow-covered steps to the legendary monastery. Curious markings are etched in the ancient stone. A pleasant tone draws your gaze upward as you pass beneath a painted archway, and you note the wind chime is crafted from tubes of selenite, their harmonious notes in perfect balance. Entering the monastery grounds you watch in awe as the monks train, each movement precise, disciplined—and lethal.

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

A Monolith Awakens.name:
一座巨碑苏醒
A Monolith Awakens

Text.text:
伴随着骇人的巨力，大地在你脚下轰鸣震颤，仿佛要把你掀进眼前豁然张开的裂隙。震动愈发猛烈，土层如浪潮般起伏翻涌，像被风暴撕扯的海面。骤然间，一座巨大的切削砂岩方尖碑以比坠落巨石更快的速度从裂隙中冲天而起，螺旋纹理的表面点缀着金色火花般的闪光。无数蓝色光尘在方尖碑周围疾掠，仿佛从其核心迸射而出，尽管边缘已有石块开始崩落，它仍以难以言喻的力量嗡鸣震荡。碎屑旋飞四散，以投石索弹丸般的速度砸向地面。你目瞪口呆地注视这异象，意识的一角捕捉到：那石板上正有成百上千的细小形体脱离坠下。它们跌落时，伴随着空洞而金属般的嚎叫。

~ Envisioned by Garesu_Kiennes

With terrific force, the ground rumbles and shakes beneath your feet, threatening to spill you into the crevasse that opens before you. The tremors increase in intensity, the earth rippling and heaving in waves like the tide of a storm-buffeted ocean. All at once, a tremendous monolith of cut sandstone shoots out of the crevasse with a speed even greater than that of a falling boulder, its spiraling surface shot through with sparkles of gold. Motes of blue light zip around the monolith, shooting out from its center, thrumming with inexplicable power despite the chunks of stone beginning to crumble from its edges. Debris spins out and crashes to the ground with the velocity of sling stones. As your dumbfounded eyes behold this phenomenon, a part of your mind realizes that hundreds of tiny shapes are detaching from the slab. Hollow, metallic howls accompany their plummeting.

~ Envisioned by Garesu_Kiennes

Valashar Dream-called.name:
瓦拉夏尔·梦唤者
Valashar Dream-called

Text.text:
他步伐迟缓，庞大如山——正如许多为战争打造并施以魔法的觉醒构装体。这具由魔力驱动的生物以未完工的木材塑成，头颅两侧嵌着盘曲扭转的犄角，使他一眼便可辨认。躯干上的枝杈随着动作起伏摆荡，像它们所仿效的肌肉般收缩舒张；其体内隐约可见点点寒光闪烁，如同天体被收纳在他的形骸之中。那块充作胸膛的木质胸甲上，卵石细细点缀出一幅幅星座，散发着属于它们自己的微弱光辉。

~ 由 Zuri the Jackdaw 扮演

He is lumbering and huge—like many awakened constructs built and enchanted for war. This magically-animated creature is fashioned from unfinished wood and has been fitted with twisting horns on either side of his head, rendering him instantly recognizable. As the branches along his body shift and move like the musculature they emulate, one can see glinting lights like heavenly bodies housed within his form. On the wooden breastplate that serves as his chest, constellations have been carefully picked out with pebbles, glowing with their own faint light.

~ Played by Zuri the Jackdaw

你旋腕作出最后的手势，一股旋风自掌心爆发，咆哮着向外席卷。冰冷的空气中凭空凝成雪片与冰屑，随着冲击从你指尖扇形扩散，裹挟着它们以愈发扩大的圆环狂舞。你的手背肤色迅速褪白，寒意刺得微微发麻——但这点冷，与这道法术加诸于敌人的痛苦相比，根本不值一提。
You twirl your hand as the final gesture, and a whirlwind erupts from it to roar outward. Flakes of snow and shards of ice materialize in the freezing air, whipping in ever-widening circles as the blast fans out from your fingertips. The skin of your hand grows pale and tingles with the cold, but it’s nothing compared to what the spell inflicts on your enemies.

Ghoul Paralysis Resisted By Player.name:
玩家抵抗了食尸鬼（特征）的麻痹
Ghoul Paralysis Resisted By Player

Text.text:
伤口先是麻了一瞬。随后剧痛袭来，震得你浑身一颤。那阵感觉渐渐退去，只剩下伤处一跳一跳地抽痛。

~ 一位英雄所构想

The injury numbs for a moment. Then, it aches, sending a tremor through your body. The sensation passes, leaving only a throbbing wound.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Sundries From A Pursuant Minion Dunker.name:
来自追随爪牙的杂物箱
Sundries From A Pursuant Minion Dunker

Text.text:
她的白色长袍紧贴着她瘦骨嶙峋的身形。你搜遍她全身，找到一本被水浸坏的随身小笔记本，墨迹晕开流淌，字句早已难以辨认。
Her white robe clings to her rail-thin form. Searching her, you find a water-damaged pocket journal, its inked text running and illegible.

那扇厚重、带着栅栏小窗的门一推开，迎面就是一片亮白。光芒在手镯与项链、戒指与纽扣上跳跃闪烁，仿佛从架子与玻璃柜里传来上千个细小的笑声。柜台与收银台上方悬着一把短剑，表面润泽得像一面流动的镜子。空气里的气味并非铁匠铺那种沉重的铁腥，而是更尖锐的酸意，带着一丝让口腔发涩的金属味。墙上挂着的锤子与锉刀更轻巧，炉子也更小。
The door, heavy and with a barred window, opens on brightness. Like a thousand little voices laughing from the shelves and cases, light flickers off bracelets and necklaces, rings and buttons. Hanging above the counter and till is a shortsword with a finish like a liquid mirror. The smells are not of the iron blacksmith’s, rather a different acidity and taste in the mouth. The hammers and files hanging on the walls are lighter, the forge smaller.

Werewolf Bounty Notice.name:
狼人悬赏告示
Werewolf Bounty Notice

Text.text:
饱经风霜的告示板立在一座木制台座上，被抬高到集市之上，俯视着周遭的喧闹。其上一张巨大的告示格外醒目：细致的墨绘描着一头佝偻而凶狠的怪物，半似人形，半如恶狼。“Reward”一词最为显眼。告示其余内容写道：“荒原上的野兽杀了我的亲人，还伤了我的儿子。我寻求那些心如钢铁、手握利刃之人，为我与我的家报仇。来杂货店找我——店主。”
The weathered public board stands on a wooden platform that raises it above the surrounding marketplace. A large notice stands out, with a fine ink drawing on it depicting a hunched and fierce being, part humanoid, part wolf. The word “Reward” is most visible. The rest of the notice reads: “A beast on the heath has murdered my kin and injured my boy. I seek those with steel in their hearts and their hands to avenge me and mine. Find me, the proprietor, at the general store.”

Bugbear Battle: Cacophony Of The Fight.name:
熊地精之战：战斗的喧嚣
Bugbear Battle: Cacophony Of The Fight

Text.text:
狂怒灌满了熊地精的呼喊声，他们以粗哑的咕哝与低沉的咆哮尖叫彼此呼应。你无法确定这些声响只是情绪的宣泄，还是在传递战术讯息，但你知道无论如何，它们都预示着暴力将至。
Rage fills the bugbears’ cries as they call out to one another in guttural grunts and growling screams. You can’t be sure if the noises merely express emotion or if they communicate strategy, but you know they portend violence either way.

你面前这只隐约似狼的生物直立行走，却以佝偻而踉跄的长步移动。粗硬的毛发沿着它的下颌竖起，顺着脊背一路延伸，最终收束成一条细长如鞭的尾巴。锋利而狡黠的眼睛从一张既像人又像豺的脸上窥视而出——那种熟悉与兽性的诡异交融，让你的神经紧绷。它的獠牙与利爪闪着阴冷的凶光。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The vaguely lupine creature before you stands on two legs, though it moves with a slouched, loping gait. Fur bristles along the creature’s jawline, extending down the spine and ending in a thin, whiplike tail. Sharp, cunning eyes peer out from a face both human and jackal, an uncanny mingling of familiar and bestial that sets your nerves on edge. Its teeth and claws gleam wickedly.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Threat From A Warlock About Pain.name:
来自术士的痛苦威胁
Threat From A Warlock About Pain

Text.text:
“你伤害了太多人，他们的痛楚在空气里回荡。你想亲耳听听吗？”
“You’ve hurt so many, their pain echoes through the air. Would you like to hear it for yourself?”

Deep Space Mining Colony: Control Center.name:
深空采矿殖民地：控制中心
Deep Space Mining Colony: Control Center

Text.text:
控制中心那几面巨大的屏幕上，尽是洞窟般的隧道影像：工业黄的采矿无人机挤满画面，钻头单调的轰鸣透过噼啪作响的扬声器回荡不止。一张小桌子紧贴在电脑丛中，桌面布满一圈圈斑驳的污渍；操控员伸手便能触及一块硕大的闪烁面板。
Images of cavernous tunnels filled with industrial-yellow mining drones dominate the enormous screens in the control center, the monotonous call of their drills echoing through the crackling speakers. A small desk, covered in a plethora of ringed stains, sits snugly amid the computers, a large blinking panel in easy reach of the controller.

电光在那女子的双手周围迸裂成耀眼弧芒，她引导着魔法，火花在伸展的指尖间跳跃。她脸上刻着狂怒的决心，咆哮如滚雷般炸响，暴烈的魔法将她的声音层层放大。
Lightning crackles in dazzling arcs around the woman’s hands as she channels her magic, sparks leaping between outstretched fingers. Furious determination is etched on her face, and she bellows like rolling thunder, her voice amplified by the tempestuous magics.

Arrow Of Slaying.name:
屠戮之箭
Arrow Of Slaying

Text.text:
这支箭宛如一片午夜被削成的薄片，被拉直、磨砺，化作一枚纯粹漆黑的箭矢。那参差的箭头几乎会让人误以为是精金所铸，但这暗色金属握在手里却轻得离奇。反倒是箭杆本身沉得不可思议，仿佛取自仍怀怨恨的木料。你接触箭尾的羽翎，本以为会柔软顺滑，却被那刀刃般的锋利逼得指尖一缩，连忙把手抽开。
This arrow looks like a sliver of midnight, straightened and sharpened into a bolt of pure black. One could mistake its jagged point for adamantine, but the dark metal feels far too lightweight. Instead, it is the shaft itself that is unaccountably heavy, as if made from wood that still bears a grudge. You touch the arrow fletching, expecting the feathers to be soft, but pull your fingers away from their blade-like sharpness.

Nymaston Hinn.name:
尼马斯顿·欣恩
Nymaston Hinn

Text.text:
那人将一只手在他紧攥的墨黑圆球上方缓缓搅动。缕缕阴影缠绕其周，他低声呢喃着嘶嘶作响的音节；可一察觉到你，他便把这件奥术焦点丢进挂在宽阔青铜腰带上的巨大囊袋里，腰带紧束着他那身紫色长袍。随后他抬起右手掀开兜帽，露出暗精灵昏晦的面容与稀疏的银白长发；然而眼角的笑纹与耳尖那一点微圆的弧度，又暗示着他有着人类混血的族裔。就在他转身面对你时，一只黑色猫头鹰无声俯冲而下，稳稳落在他宽阔的肩头。你把对那猫头鹰三眼面孔的震惊藏得滴水不漏，可那精灵仍勾起一抹细薄的笑意，仿佛你的惊愕终究还是被他察觉了。

~ 由 Andrew Shaw 扮演

The figure swirls a hand over an inky black orb that he clutches tightly. Wisps of shadow surround it as he murmurs sibilant syllables, but upon noticing you he drops the arcane focus into an oversized pouch hanging from the wide bronze belt cinching his purple robes. With his right hand he draws back his hood to reveal the dusky features and stringy silver-white hair of a dark elf, but the laugh lines at the corners of his eyes and the slight roundness at the tips of his ears suggest a mixed-human ancestry. As he turns to face you, a black owl swoops down in perfect silence and settles on his broad shoulders. You conceal your shock at the owl’s three-eyed face, but the elf cracks a thin smile, indicating that perhaps your shock was detected, nonetheless.

~ Played by Andrew Shaw

身披焦黑钢铁的死亡先兆，黑暗圣武士是灾厄的阴沉报丧者。他那带刺护甲的每一片甲板都在无数次鏖战中被撞凹、刮裂、蚀出麻点——那些勇敢的灵魂，最终都倒在他骇人的钉头锤之下。褪色的暗红披风在他身后翻卷，如同残破的旌旗，被仇敌的鲜血浸染成猩红。
A harbinger of death clad in blackened steel, the dark paladin is a grim herald of woe. Every plate of his spiked armor is dented, scratched, and pitted from innumerable battles with brave souls who met their end beneath his fearsome mace. A tarnished red cloak billows in his wake like a ragged banner stained crimson by the blood of his foes.

Sundries From A Lemure.name:
来自小魔鬼的杂货
Sundries From A Lemure

Text.text:
冰冷的尘埃——带着硫磺、尸腐，以及地狱界那股令人作呕的甜腻香气——从泥怪周围腾起，扑散在空气中，随即被吹得一干二净。就算这里曾有什么有用的东西，如今也已不复存在。
Cold dust—reeking of sulfur, corpse rot, and a sickening perfume of the infernal realm—puffs up into the air from around the lemure, blowing away. If there was something useful here, it’s gone now.

Captain Arienne Dubreuil.name:
阿丽安娜·迪布勒伊船长
Captain Arienne Dubreuil

Text.text:
一位英姿飒爽的年轻女子手持长枪迈步上前，身姿挺拔而骄傲，带着青春特有的急切与炽热。她身形瘦削精悍，明亮的笑容在雪白的面庞上熠熠生辉。一条绳编般的猩红长辫沿着她钢铁覆甲的背脊垂落至腰背之间。她腰间垂着一柄纤细的长剑，天青色的剑鞘雅致夺目。尽管板甲的厚重褶层压在身上，她却依旧步伐轻快，活力之盛在士兵中罕见。她身后，一匹筋骨雄健的战马鬃毛编成辫子，随主人伫立，前蹄刨地，蓄势待发。

~ Played by Walt M.

A striking young woman steps forward holding a lance, her posture tall and proud with the eager energy of youth. She’s lean and wiry, and her shining smile beams out of a bright white face. A roped braid of scarlet hair trickles down to the midpoint of her steel-clad back. A slim sword dangles from her waist in an elegant sky-blue scabbard. Despite the heavy folds of her plate armor, she moves with an energy uncommon among the soldiers. A powerfully built warhorse with braided hair paws at the ground behind its master.

~ Played by Walt M.

Scarab Of Protection.name:
守护圣甲虫
Scarab Of Protection

Text.text:
这枚青铜徽章恰好能紧贴你并拢成杯状的掌心，仿佛就是为此而生。其上镶嵌着蓝色方钠石，拼出一只硕大的甲虫轮廓，周围以扇贝状的翅缘作框。你指间泛起一阵细微的痒意，随即察觉到圣甲虫腹部下沿刻着一行先前未见的铭文——以一种异域而被遗忘的语言写就。
Fitting in your cupped palm snugly, as if it had been designed for just that purpose, the bronze medallion has been picked out in blue sodalite to resemble a large beetle, framed with scalloped wings. You feel a tickling sensation and you discern a previously unseen inscription carved along the underside of the scarab, in an exotic, forgotten language.

你单膝蹲下，俯身将裸露的指尖接触地面，同时低声默诵无声的祈祷。你另一只手里的草药与香料袋骤然迸发出无痛的火焰。一股宁静的光环自你指尖所触之处向外扩散——清晰可感——你的心神随之腾升，此地如今已被你虔敬崇拜的力量所接触。
Crouching down on one knee, you lean over to touch your bare fingertip to the ground while murmuring a silent prayer. The bag of herbs and incense in your other hand erupts in a painless flame. An aura of calm spreads out from the point your finger touched—palpable—and your mind soars, this place now touched by the power of your worship.

Loot From A Weakened Prismatic Dragon's.name:
从虚弱的虹光巨龙巢穴中掠得的战利品
Loot From A Weakened Prismatic Dragon's Lair

Text.text:
凑近了，你能看清巨龙那闪烁的半透明身形——宛如世间最瑰丽的彩绘玻璃——以及其内那颗巨大的、搏动的水晶之心。生物坠落时曾发出一声凄厉长啸，仿佛玻璃迸裂；而此刻，它已静止不动。就在附近的一处神殿废墟里，你找到了巨龙的宝藏。总计价值6120枚金币的钱币与宝石被胡乱撒在龟裂的马赛克地面上。
Up close you can see the dragon’s shimmering translucent form—reminiscent of the most beautiful stained glass—and the large, pulsing, crystal heart within. As the creature fell it emitted a keening wail like shattering glass, but now it lies still. In a temple ruin nearby, you find the dragon’s hoard. Coins and gems totaling 6120 gold pieces are haphazardly strewn across the cracked mosaic floor.

Expensive Folded Steel Sword.name:
昂贵的折叠钢长剑
Expensive Folded Steel Sword

Text.text:
金属在顺滑伸展至全长时发出尖细的啸鸣，随后伴着一声轻柔的咔嗒锁定。剑身是一片扁平的钢刃，刃缘薄如纸片。剑柄被精工打造或打印成乌木质感，抛磨得如熔岩玻璃般幽亮。
The metal whistles as it smoothly extends to its full length and locks with a soft click. The sword is a flat blade of steel, edges paper thin. The hilt has been crafted or printed to look like ebony wood buffed to a lava-glass shine.

Returning Home After A Quest.name:
任务归来，重返故乡
Returning Home After A Quest

Text.text:
你的双腿在每一步都发出抗议，可你仍不停下。翻过眼前这道坡，家就在等你——身后的险境与旅途的惊惧已然开始褪色。你低吼着使劲，把疲惫的身躯拖上山脊，在顶端停住片刻，望着眼前铺展开来的景象。你把背包——沉甸甸装着你这场冒险的战利品——丢进尘土里，深深吸了一大口气，熟悉的气味涌入鼻腔：家里的酒食香，唯有此地才盛放的花香，还有那条蜿蜒穿过近旁林地的小溪特有的清冽气息。你的肩膀垂下，松弛下来，拳头也随之放开。今夜，你将饱腹安睡在床上。

~ Envisioned by Kyle Winters

Your legs protest each and every step, yet you continue. Over this next rise, home awaits—behind you, the perils of your journey already fade. With a grunt of effort, you heave your tired body over the crest of the hill and stop for a moment to take in the sight sprawling before you. You drop your bag—laden with the spoils of your adventure—to the dirt and take in a great lungful of air, smell familiar smells: the food and drink of your home, the flowers that bloom only here, the particular fresh scent of the brook that winds through the nearby woods. Your shoulders drop, relax, and your fists unclench. Tonight, you sleep in a bed with a full belly.

~ Envisioned by Kyle Winters

Two Lovers Embrace Nearby In A Shadowy D.name:
一对恋人相拥在近旁昏暗的门廊里
Two Lovers Embrace Nearby In A Shadowy Doorway

Text.text:
在被污雨浸得湿滑的都市背景前，两道身影在门口交融，分享着一种与周遭世界格格不入的亲密。披着阴影的遮蔽，他们相拥，将彼此一口口饮尽；世界随之坠落远去，只剩他们共同拥有的完美一瞬。
Against the urban backdrop slick with dirty rain, two forms meld together in a doorway, sharing an intimacy that seems alien to the world around them. Cloaked by the shadows, they embrace, drinking each other in, the world falling away as they share a perfect moment together.

五彩光芒自你指尖捏着的钻石中迸射而出，迅速扩张成一扇旋涡般流光盘绕的门扉。透过这道奥秘传送门的彼端，你隐约听见其中居民的细微声响，空气因异界能量而噼啪作响。
Multicolored light shoots from the diamond held in your fingertips, enlarging into a doorway of swirling light. From the other side of the arcane portal you hear faint sounds of the denizens within, the air crackling with extraplanar energy.

Sundries From A Possessed Priest.name:
来自被附身神父的杂物
Sundries From A Possessed Priest

Text.text:
翻找那身破烂长袍时，你只找到一串木质念珠，上面溅着黑红斑痕。把它从牧师口袋里拎出来时，珠子咔嗒作响，宛如骨头碰撞。
Searching through the tattered robes, you find only a set of wooden prayer beads splotched with black and red. They clack like bones as they are lifted out of the priest's pocket.

Lesson In Magical Engineering.name:
魔法工程学一课
Lesson In Magical Engineering

Text.text:
扭曲自然界物理法则与材料的法术，是七年级工程研讨课那些令人费解的课程主题。今天的课题，是如何搭建一道维度之门，并为其灌注一道传送门法术。一座九英尺高的门立在教室中央——整块巨石被扭折成拱形。学生们分成两拨：一组用深渊的材料与语言为门施加附魔，另一组则采用这个世界更为熟悉的咒词。被魔力浸透的石拱开始龟裂，在仪式法术交汇之处渗出墨黑般的“血”。
Spells that bend the natural laws of physics and materials are the topic of the perplexing lessons of the seventh-year engineering seminar. Today’s lesson is in how to build a dimensional gate and imbue it with a portal spell. A nine-foot gate—a single stone warped into an arch—stands in the center of the room. One group of students enchants the gate using materials and language of the abyss, while the rest use the more familiar words of this world. The magically saturated stone begins to crack, bleeding black where the ritual spells converge.

Mask Of Brambles.name:
荆棘之面具
Mask Of Brambles

Text.text:
这副面具纠结着细枝、苔藓与枯叶，乍看几乎会被当成一只鸟巢。底部挤出一张紧抿的小口，让它即便没有任何明显的眼孔，也显得神情古怪。其上飘散着花朵腐败的酸馊气味，还夹着一丝淡淡的铁腥。微风掠过，荆蔓间艰难挤出一声幽幽的低哨，如同萦绕不散的哀音。
A tangle of twig, moss, and leaf, this mask could easily be mistaken for a bird’s nest. A pinched mouth at its base gives it a curious expression, even without any obvious holes for the wearer’s eyes. The sour smell of floral decay wafts from it, as well as a slight whiff of iron. A breeze blows by, and a haunting, low whistle ekes out from the brambles.

Castle Flanking Tower.name:
城堡夹击塔
Castle Flanking Tower

Text.text:
一座雄伟的夹击塔自城堡墙垣上傲然拔起，威势逼人。厚重的幕墙自要塞处如巨翼般向外展开，张扬铺陈，公然蔑视一切胆敢逼近这座古老据点的来犯之徒。
Rising proudly from the castle's wall, a mighty flanking tower asserts its formidable presence. Curtain walls fan out from the fortification like powerful wings spread wide, standing in open defiance of any who would dare encroach upon the ancient stronghold.

Severed Head Of A Colossal Statue.name:
巨像雕像的断首
Severed Head Of A Colossal Statue

Text.text:
尽管这座巨像的其他部分已被砸得粉碎，那颗庞大的头颅却被利落地劈成两半，两块残片相距不远地躺在一起。覆在巨首羽冠盔上的马鬃辫纹仍清晰可辨，足以让人看出雕刻者曾倾注的心血。它面容的古典轮廓，无疑描绘着某位早已被遗忘的英雄或战神的尊颜。
Though other pieces of the colossal statue have been shattered, the immense sculpture’s head has been neatly split in two, the pieces lying relatively close together. The individual braids of horsehair detailed on the massive head’s crested helm are intact enough to convey the care with which the statue was carved. The classical features of its face are doubtless the visage of some long-forgotten hero or war god.

Mountain Crevasse During Winter.name:
冬日的山间裂隙
Mountain Crevasse During Winter

Text.text:
从裂隙深处倒涌而上的风发出一声低低的哨鸣，令你突生一个狂野的念头：若纵身跃入，或许气流能将你托起。但理智清楚得很——跌进那狭窄的深渊，等待你的只有粉身碎骨的死亡。
The low whistle of wind flowing up from the crevasse gives you the wild idea that if you leapt into it, the air might buoy you up. But your rational mind knows that a fall into the narrow depths holds nothing but crushing death.

Architect Of The Net.name:
网络构筑师
Architect Of The Net

Text.text:
一股全知的存在感在你面前巍然逼近——创世的构筑者，他们的言辞在网络之中回荡轰鸣。他们的布道沉甸甸地压下，却在所谓真理的光泽里遮着一抹不安；那狂喜般的长篇檄文中，隐约跳动着伪善的脉冲。他们是数字领域骨架的彻底化身，由子程序与协议的圣礼合而为一，在其身上凝成完美的形态。作为抵御熵增的守卫者，他们警觉伫立，严防迷途的黑客与莽撞的科技术士。在那变幻莫测的目光里，存在之谜与代码交织——在创造与混沌之间，维系着纳米尺度的微妙平衡。

~ 由一位英雄构想
