An omniscient presence looms large before you, the architect of genesis, their words reverberating through the Net. Their sermon holds weight yet veils an uncertainty within its truth, hints of hypocrisy pulsing within the rapturous tirade. The utter embodiment of the digital realm’s framework, a communion of subroutines and protocols, finds perfect form within them. A sentinel against entropy, they stand vigilant against wayward hackers and foolhardy technomancers. In their mercurial gaze, the enigma of existence and code intermingle—a nano balance betwixt creation and chaos.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Abraxas Of The Seventh Sin.name:
第七罪之阿布拉克萨斯
Abraxas Of The Seventh Sin

Text.text:
银色月光轻抚圣武士的剑刃，一枚以天界之火勾勒的词语在抛光的金属上浮现。尽管文字古奥，那道铭刻却承载着神圣的分量。他跪在一尊古老雕像前，灰色肌肤与神像石质如出一辙。他那长角的头颅仰起，凝望苍穹——星光在他幽暗的眼眸中闪烁——同时抬起一只手。只一挥势，他便降下命令；一声空灵的嘶鸣先行响起，一匹高贵坐骑随即在他身旁凝现，翻涌的鬃毛燃着虹彩的焰光。

~ Played by David G with

As silver moonlight caresses the paladin’s blade, a word, limned with celestial fire, appears on the polished metal. Though the text is archaic, the inscription carries holy weight. He kneels before an ancient statue, his gray skin similar to the stone of the idol. His horned head rises to behold the heavens, the stars twinkling in his umbral orbs as he raises a hand. With a gesture, he issues a command, and an ethereal whinny precedes the arrival of a noble steed as it materializes beside him, its rippling mane aglow with prismatic flames.

~ Played by David G with

干旱的地面在兽群逼近时颤抖，某种看不见的威胁将它们逼得发狂。地平线上扬起一团不断膨胀的尘云，在每一个艰难流逝的瞬间都更近一分；群兽狂奔而来，踏成一股碾压万物的洪潮。

~ Envisioned by Davy on Discord

The arid ground trembles as the herd approaches, spurred to frenzy by some unseen threat. A swelling cloud of dust gathers on the horizon, drawing closer with each arduous second as the beasts rush forward in a trampling tide.

~ Envisioned by Davy on Discord

这把火器是一根暗淡钢铁的笔直长管，安稳地嵌在粗削的瘿橡木枪托里，沉重而肃穆，性相森然。护板与枪管侧面蚀刻着纯粹的奥秘学——一组组繁复符号与陌生字母交织成的奇异文字。底部扣着一只可折叠的黄铜支架。当手指触碰触发器，枪身便微微发热，自行贴上肩头或抵住髋侧，仿佛欣然走上工位，迫不及待要开工。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

This firearm is a straight tube of dull steel resting in a rough-cut burled-oak stock, heavy and grave in its aspect. The etching in the plates and along the side of the barrel is pure arcana, sets of complicated symbols and strange alphabets. Latched along the bottom is a foldable brass stand. When a finger touches the trigger, the gun warms and rests itself to the shoulder or hip, as if happily on its way to work.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Secret Fight Club.name:
秘密斗殴俱乐部
Secret Fight Club

Text.text:
斗环中，两名斗士赤足逼近，脚上沾着尘土与碎草。他们都戴着毫无表情的木面具，只在眼前切出一道细缝供人窥视。下一瞬，他们同时扑上前去，双手扣住对方肩头，势均力敌地僵持锁住。扭打愈发激烈，斗士却一声不吭，专注得近乎冷酷。 看台上一群观众几乎人人戴面具，安静注视，没有叫喊，也无评点。其中一名守夜者披着红色兜帽长袍，连手脚都遮得严严实实。昏暗角落里，一张赌桌前坐着三道身影，皆戴着与此处不同的猿形面具：第一副在眼孔上方留有焦灼烧痕；第二副耳朵龟裂、碎裂如木屑；最后一副嘴被芦苇缝死，针脚森然。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Fighters approach each other in the ring, bare feet dusted with dirt and straw. They each wear an expressionless wooden mask, with a thin line cut for their eyes to see. They lunge at each other. Hands grip shoulders in a balanced lock. The scuffle intensifies but the fighters are silent, focused. A group of spectators, almost all masked, watches without shouting or commentary. One of the watchers wears a red, hooded robe that covers every part of their body, even hands and feet. In a dim corner, a betting table is attended by three figures, each in an ape-like mask different from the others here. The first mask has burn marks over the eyes. The second, cracked and splintered ears. The last, a mouth sewn shut with reeds.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

厚实的石墙上开着狭长的箭孔，拔地而起约三十英尺，构成这座庄园坚固的基座。其上方，无疑更为奢华的起居空间再向上延展两层，让居住于此的人既能享受有窗、有阳光的家，也能通过地板上的杀人孔向下投掷石块或其他投射物。一段陡峭的可断裂阶梯向上攀升，通往这座塔状结构基部半腰处一扇厚重、嵌满铁钉的门。
Thick stone walls pierced by arrow slits rise for roughly thirty feet, forming the fortified foundation of this manor. Above them, the no-doubt more luxurious living space rises for two stories, giving those who live here a windowed and sunny home as well as the opportunity to drop stones or other missiles through murder holes in their floor. A steep flight of breakaway stairs climbs up to a stout iron-studded door halfway up the base of the tower-like structure.

Mad Scientist's Lab: Lab Creature.name:
疯狂科学家的实验室：实验生物
Mad Scientist's Lab: Lab Creature

Text.text:
你听见婴儿的啼哭。声音似乎从远处传来，但方向清晰无误：就在那只与你等高的巨大玻璃罐后方。罐中的液体翻涌着诡异的猩红与水银般的色泽。它们像油与水一样彼此排斥，怎么也融不到一处，却又仿佛有什么力量在罐内不断搅动，使其永不停歇地旋转。

你被那景象攫住目光，几乎移不开眼。就在你出神凝望时，一抹苍白的形影打乱了旋流，从罐内猛地贴上玻璃。它转瞬即逝，可那画面却像直视烈日后残留的光斑般烙在你的视野里——五个细小的椭圆围着一块近乎方形的印痕，正是一只小小的手掌与手指。
You hear a baby crying. It seems to come from a distance, but the direction is clear: behind the great glass vat as tall as you. The liquid within it swirls with queer crimson and quicksilver colors. Like oil and water, the fluids seem unable to mix, but something in the tank continuously swirls them about. As you watch, mesmerized by the display, a pale shape disrupts the spinning flow, pressing against the glass of the vat from the inside. It’s gone in an instant, but the image lingers in your vision like a spot after staring at the sun—five little oblongs arrayed around a squarish patch, the fingers and palm of a tiny hand.

Popular Townmaster.name:
受人爱戴的镇长
Popular Townmaster

Text.text:
你面前的女人散发着母亲般的温暖，触手可及，宛如盛夏的阳光。那暖意从她的笑容里流淌出来，从她爽朗的笑声里荡开，也从她看似毫不费力地将全部注意力从一个人移向下一个人的举动中透出——她的情绪也随之变换，像变色龙般轻巧地贴合对方的心境。
The woman before you exudes a motherly warmth as palpable as the summer sun. It radiates out from her smile, the easy way she laughs, and in the seemingly effortless way she shifts her full attention from one person to the next, her own mood shifting to match theirs with chameleon-like ease.

I Use My Stone Of Vocalization.name:
我使用我的发声石
I Use My Stone Of Vocalization

Text.text:
所有声音都始于念头——而借由思绪的魔法，我用这块石头说话。它取代了声带，取代了那些无法协调的肌肉。被灌注的石头聆听我的心念与渴望被听见的意志，吸收语言的震颤。它低鸣、微颤，而我的话语便从其中倾泻而出。

~ 构想者：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

All voices begin in thought—and through the magic of thought, I use the stone to speak. It replaces vocal cords, muscles that can’t coordinate. The imbued stone listens to my mind and its desire to be heard, absorbing the vibrations of language. It hums and quivers, and my words pour forth from it.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

巨树在一头庞然掠食者身后接连崩塌。一张宛如远古雕像的面孔浮现：嶙峋如骨，塞满甲胄般的骨板与防御尖刺。其后紧随的是数吨起伏翻涌、覆满霉斑的肌肉。霉斑闪烁微光，喷吐出短促而恶臭的气体。生物的动作将其点燃，霎时火光冲天，一闪即逝。
Trees collapse in the wake of a gargantuan predator. A face like an ancient statue emerges: bony, stuffed with armored plates and defensive spikes. Tons of rippling mold-covered muscle follow closely behind. The mold twinkles, emitting brief noxious puffs of gas. The creature’s movements ignite them, sending momentary flares skyward.

Coven Meeting In A Basement.name:
地下室的女巫集会
Coven Meeting In A Basement

Text.text:
地下室被燃烧的蜡烛烟雾呛得几乎无法呼吸，缕缕青烟里浓烈地掺着刺鼻的草药味。你沿着楼梯下行，透过这片臭烘烘的雾障，看见房间四面墙边都点着一支又宽又矮的蜡烛，把墙壁照得昏黄发亮。房间中央，五个人围着一口蒸汽翻涌的锅，彼此手牵着手。他们轮流吟唱，而每当换了新的声音，锅里的蒸汽便随之变色：红、白、蓝、绿、黑。
The basement chokes with the smoke of burning candles, the wisps laced overwhelmingly with astringent herbs. You descend the stairs and, through this odorous haze, see that each wall of the room is lit with a wide, squat candle. In the center of the room, a group of five surrounds a steaming pot, holding each other’s hands. They chant in turns, and when a new voice speaks, the steam in the pot changes color: red, white, blue, green, black.

Carver Nimblespur.name:
卡弗·尼姆布斯珀尔
Carver Nimblespur

Text.text:
半身人战士的脸庞被一对华丽的红色络腮胡环绕，仿佛从他那沉甸甸的圆盔下瀑布般倾泻而下。他高喊一声 Huzzah!，猛然向前扑出——锁子甲衣在光中荡起层层涟漪——整个人凌空飞跃，直扑向他的敌人，双剑高举，双眼燃着怒火。

~ Played by Chris from dScryb

The halfling warrior’s face is framed by a pair of glorious red mutton chops, which appear to cascade down from his ponderous kettle helm. Launching himself forward with a cry of Huzzah! the formidable swordsman leaps through the air—chainmail shirt catching the light in a rippling wave—and soars toward his foe, twin swords raised high, eyes alight with fury.

~ Played by Chris from dScryb

恶魔尚未现身，死亡的恶臭便已先一步扑来。它身躯似人，头颅与双翼却是乌鸦的模样，弯曲的喙上拖着血污。常年啃食腐肉，让它的躯体也一并坏死。发亮的白骨与一圈圈殷红的肌束，从纠结成毡的墨黑羽簇间显露出来。它的喉咙是一道溃烂的伤口，蛆虫在其中蠕动搏跳。空洞的眼眶里燃着猩红的余烬，恶魔挥舞着一柄利刃——从废料中捡来的破铁条，锈迹斑斑，凶狠刺人。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The demon’s death reek precedes its appearance. Its body is human-shaped, but its head and wings are those of a crow, its curved beak streaked with gore. A life of feasting upon carrion has necrotized the demon’s flesh. Gleaming bone and bands of red muscle show through matted tufts of ink-black feathers. Its throat is a festering wound, pulsing with maggots. Hollow eye sockets blaze with crimson embers as the demon brandishes a blade—a scavenged length of scrap, rusty and vicious.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Loot From A Hill Giant.name:
丘陵巨人战利品
Loot From A Hill Giant

Text.text:
在巨人的帆布袋里，你发现了一大团由多种贵金属混成的金属块。由于这些金属的临界温度各不相同，它们没能彻底熔合，只是松松散散地纠结在一起。若你能把它们分拣开来，这团金属大约值700枚金币；或者卖给愿意替你分离的铁匠或珠宝匠，可得400枚金币。
In the giant’s canvas bag, you find a lump of various precious metals, loosely puzzled together because the metals’ different critical temperatures kept them from fusing completely. If you can sort it all out, the blob is worth about 700 gold pieces, or 400 gold pieces to a smith or jeweler willing to separate them.

Boat Moving Through A Tunnel.name:
小船穿行于隧道之中
Boat Moving Through A Tunnel

Text.text:
这条狭窄洞窟的滴水穹顶低垂压迫，离你的头顶仅有数寸。你的小船缓缓漂行，像一段迟滞的跋涉，老旧木板吱呀作响。声响在湿滑的洞壁间回荡，前路与身后皆延伸入仿佛无尽的虚空。

~ 由 Sahlonahl 构想

The dripping ceiling of this narrow cavern looms mere inches above your head. Your boat floats along, a slow progression, the old wooden planks creaking. The sound echoes along the slick walls, the path before and behind you extending into what seems an endless void.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl

Border Town Scouts.name:
边境镇斥候
Border Town Scouts

Text.text:
你沿着翠绿原野上一条宽阔而行人如织的道路前行，脚下扬起的尘土转瞬就被微风卷散。东方升起浓重的黑烟。忽然，齐膝的草海间窜出数名以菘蓝涂绘的战士，手持反曲弓，箭已上弦——你被包围了。其中一人缓缓从及肩高的植被里侧步而出，踏上小径，弓臂稳如磐石，箭锋始终对准你。她乌黑的肌肤上涂抹着几何纹样，仿佛自内而外透出微光；串珠编成的发辫上，独独簪着一根猩红羽毛。紧接着，斥候们仿佛同一心跳般齐齐转身，朝远处的黑烟疾奔而去。
The trail you follow through the verdant plain is broad and well-traveled, and the dust you kick up is blown away by the breeze. To the east, you notice heavy black smoke. Suddenly, out of the grass rise several woad-painted warriors, recurve bows in hand, arrows nocked—you are surrounded. One of them slowly side-steps out of the shoulder-high vegetation and onto the trail, her aim never faltering. The geometric patterns daubed across her ebon skin seem to glow with inner light and her beaded hair is crowned with a single scarlet feather. Then, as one, the scouts turn and run toward the distant smoke.

这团黏液惊惶不安、畏缩胆怯，全然不见同类惯有的无脑贪噬。它蜷缩在角落里，几乎像是在惧怕光亮。紧接着，它的形体竟开始扭曲、闪烁不定，仿佛正试图进行传送。
Skittish and afraid, this ooze displays none of the customary mindless hunger of its kind. It cowers in a corner, almost fearful of the light. Then its very form seems to shift and flicker. It appears to be attempting to teleport.

Loot From A Pegasus.name:
飞马的战利品
Loot From A Pegasus

Text.text:
一套精巧的马具被固定在这匹有翼骏马上。金色亚麻纤线编织成缰绳与嚼子，细密而轻盈。鞍垫是一张柔软的毯子，由橄榄绿的苔藓制成，触感如羊毛般绒软。马鞍本身像是一片可弯折的浅色木板，略经染色，泛着微微的光泽。鞍上还挂着一个行囊——薄得几乎贴着木板的弧度，若不细看几乎会错过——里面藏着几样宝贝。你找到一卷浸透魔法的卷轴，作为封印的木质箍环上刻着精灵风格的纹样。你又掏出一只小小的柳条盒，盒面刻着符文，里面装满了形状各异的金属小片——也许是用来占卜的工具？
A delicate set of tack has been affixed to this winged steed. Woven threads of golden flax serve as bridle and reins. The saddle pad is a soft blanket made of olive-green moss, fleece-like to the touch. The saddle itself appears to be a flexible piece of light-colored wood, stained slightly to give it a shine. A pack on the saddle—so slim and close to the bend of the wood you nearly miss it—holds a few treasures. You find a scroll infused with magic, the wooden band serving as its seal etched with sylvan designs. You also pull out a small wicker box marked with runes and full of differently shaped metal pieces—a tool for augury, perhaps?

你高声吟诵着代代相传的猎人、探路者与游侠之语——那是亘古的词句，原初的意义早已被岁月抹去，如同被荒野吞没的遗忘堡垒残垣。你锁定你的目标，思绪中先炸开一道雷鸣般的闪光，随即法术自唇齿间奔涌而出，将其标记为你的猎物。祖灵的、深埋已久的知识洪流般灌入脑海，你洞悉了猎物的下一步行动。
You speak aloud words passed down through generations of hunters, pathfinders, and rangers—ancient words whose original meaning has been lost to the eons, overtaken by the wilds like the ruins of a forgotten fortress. A flash of thunder in your mind precedes the spell leaving your mouth as you spot your target, and mark them as your quarry. Knowledge, ancestral and long-buried, floods your mind, and you know your prey’s next move.

Militaristic Council Chambers.name:
军事议会厅
Militaristic Council Chambers

Text.text:
巨大的壁炉里烈火熊熊，炉火上方张开一把扇形陈列——足有十余柄长柄武器。房间其余墙面也以类似方式装点着各式兵刃，而天花板则被盾牌覆满，以某种你看不透的手法固定其上。也许这些全是昔日征服的战利品。厅堂中央一张圆桌居于主位，四周环列高大、直背的座椅。
A great fire blazes in a huge hearth, over which splays a fan of over a dozen pole arms. Similar arrangements of other weapons decorate the other walls of the room, while shields cover the ceiling, affixed in some manner you cannot discern. Perhaps these are all trophies of previous conquests. A circular table dominates the center of the chamber, surrounded by tall, straight-backed chairs.

I Center Myself Before I Attack.name:
我在发动攻击前先令心神归一
I Center Myself Before I Attack

Text.text:
我将武器横在身前稳稳架起，鼻息深深吸入。视野骤然锐利，肌肉绷紧鼓起。我猛然前冲，如弓弦弹射的箭矢，目标尽在眼前，准星不偏不倚。
I brace my weapon ahead of me and draw in deep breaths through my nose. My vision sharpens and my muscles flex. I lunge forward like an arrow flung from a bowstring, my mark in sight and my aim true.

Ancient Crumbling Radar Station.name:
古老崩塌的雷达站
Ancient Crumbling Radar Station

Text.text:
在诸时代的残骸之上，一座雷达站如同迷失的孤魂般矗立于山丘之巅。混凝土墙与金属支架饱经风雨，被时代与荒废磨蚀得斑驳不堪，藤蔓沿着这座破败的构筑物蜿蜒攀附。那面雷达天线盘，曾是闪耀的金属奇迹，如今锈迹遍布，仍倔强地指向天空，仿佛依旧在搜寻来袭的信号。山脚下，则散落着往昔探险者搭起的旧营地。
Above the wreckage of ages, a radar station stands atop a hill like a lost soul. Concrete walls and metal structures have been weathered, worn by time and neglect, and vines wind their way around the dilapidated structure. The radar dish, once a gleaming metal marvel, is now rusted, pointing toward the sky as if still scanning for incoming signals. An old camp made by past explorers sits at the base of the hill.

Isolated Forest Cabin Conceals Lich Lair.name:
与世隔绝的林中小屋掩藏着巫妖巢穴
Isolated Forest Cabin Conceals Lich Lair

Text.text:
小屋底部早已朽烂，成丛的高草在墙根疯长。头顶树枝间垂着葛藤。你从空荡荡的门洞望进去，闻到霉烂的腥臭，以及不止一具死兽腐败的气味。地板上有一道舱口。你把它掀开——蛛网被扯断，尘土成团坠落——一股可怖的恶臭像冰冷的雾迎面扑来。你听见一声低低的窃笑，低头看去，正对上一双早已死去的眼睛；银色王冠下，几缕稀薄的头发飘荡。

~ 由 Pete 构想

The cabin rots along the bottom, where tall weeds grow in clumps. Kudzu hangs off the trees above. Through the empty doorway you smell the rank odor of mold and more than one dead animal. In the floor is a hatch. When you open it—cobwebs pulling free, dust falling in clumps—a horrid reek hits you like a cold mist. You hear a whispered laugh and look down into the eyes of someone long dead, with wispy hair under a silver crown.

~ Envisioned by Pete

倾塌的高塔歪斜着骨架，倚靠在木石崩裂的残墙上。焦黑的屋舍残骸如同腐朽海兽的肋骨般耸立——早在很久以前，就已被剥得一无所有，毫无可取可用之物。树根与苔藓吞没了曾经喧闹的鹅卵石街道，一只老鼠掠过，贪婪地用颚咬紧一块腐烂食物的碎片。风穿过这些空洞的结构，发出垂死之人最后吐息般的嘶鸣，裹挟着腐败与霉湿的恶臭。这座城市被遗弃、被遗忘已久，然而……你仍无法忽视自更深处传来的诡异声响。
Toppled towers lean their crooked frames against crumbling walls of wood and stone. The charred remains of homes rise like the rib bones of a decayed leviathan, long ago stripped of anything of worth or use. Roots and moss overtake once bustling cobbled streets, and a rat skitters by with a fragment of rotting food clutched greedily in its jaw. The wind through these hollow structures wheezes like the last breaths of a dying man, carrying the stench of rot and mildew. Long has this city stood abandoned and forgotten, and yet… you can't ignore the strange sounds emanating from deeper within.

I Use Patient Defense.name:
我使用“耐心防御”
I Use Patient Defense

Text.text:
当我所意图的事照常发生时，他们所意图的事甚至在动手之前就已失败。我结束第一次思量之际，已然走向空空间的一半。我出手——便移动。我开口——便移动。无论我做什么，哪怕只是安静的家常琐事，我也早已游离在两处之间。袭击者也许能在花园里趁我栽下一株玫瑰时悄然逼近，可他们的手只会被荆棘划得鲜血淋漓，刀刃上不过黏着一片殷红的花瓣。
While what I intend happens, what they intend fails even before they act. I am already halfway to empty space as I finish my first deliberation. I strike—and move. I speak—and move. Whatever it is I do, even the quiet domestic simplicities, I am already between places. My assailant could sneak up to me in the garden while I plant a rose, and their hand would return slashed by thorns, their knife with only a red petal stuck to the blade.

Sundries From A Skeletal Cat.name:
骷髅猫的杂货
Sundries From A Skeletal Cat

Text.text:
你看见一簇从骷髅般的兽爪上撕扯下来的利爪，零落的几颗牙齿与沾满黑血的獠牙——但这具骨质猫科的大半身躯已被碾成碎片与尘埃。
You see a cluster of claws torn from the skeletal paw, a few scattered teeth and ichor-stained fangs—but most of this osseous feline has been reduced to splinters and dust.

Fantasy Space Military During Cosmic Eve.name:
宇宙异象下的奇幻空间军队
Fantasy Space Military During Cosmic Event

Text.text:
将军冲你高喊，可他的声音几乎被远处战场的喧嚣吞没，也被更远处群山在天穹下崩解时的轰鸣掩盖。你脚下的大地在挪移，仿佛地面随时会溶开成深坑。那张憔悴的脸因反胃而扭曲，病态的五官被高空那团扭曲、膨胀的星云投下的粉与蓝染得诡异。他咬紧牙关，戴着铠甲手套的手指向混战中与士兵相撞的亡灵浪潮——那是一支不受地脉起伏与地震冲击的群潮；与此同时，头顶那片宇宙云雾的另一条“臂膀”探入群山，连岩石与树木都从古老的根系里生生扯出。泥土与植株在空中聚拢成巨大的旋涡土块，像一只只癫狂滚动的土之巨眼。

~ Envisioned by Rooster

The general shouts to you, but his voice hardly breaks through the clamor of the distant battle, or the din of the mountain range beyond being consumed by the sky. You feel the earth shift beneath your feet as if the ground might dissolve into a pit at any moment. His haggard face twists in nausea, his sickened features cast in hues of pink and blue from the light of the warping, expanding nebula high above. He grits his teeth and points a gauntleted hand toward the waves of undead meeting his soldiers in the fray; a horde unhindered by the undulations and quakes surging through the earth as another arm of the cosmic cloud above reaches into the mountain and tears rock and tree from their ancient roots. Earth and plant collect into massive, swirling clods in the sky, like great earthen eyes rolling in madness.

~ Envisioned by Rooster

Inspiration About Grace.name:
灵感：关于优雅
Inspiration About Grace

Text.text:
“如舞者般的步伐，你以风采与优雅出击——所以站起身来吧，勇敢的英雄，狠狠干碎那怪物的脸。”
“Like the movements of a dancer, you strike with style and grace—so arise, courageous hero, and break that monster’s face.”

Halfling Bladesinging In Combat For The.name:
半身人刀歌初次实战
Halfling Bladesinging In Combat For The First Time

Text.text:
轻巧地一跃踏上巨岩，半身人潇洒一抖，抽出细剑。点点魔能火花在他的铆钉皮护甲上跳窜——他正从织网中攫取力量。他仰起乱发蓬松的脑袋，真切地唱了起来，几乎要把演出硬生生与超自然能量拧在一起。细长的剑身周围浮起一抹幽灵般的辉光，随即“啵”地一声脆响，没入失败的脉动阴影中消散。恐慌爬满盗贼红润的脸。危险逼近，成功的渴望压倒一切。他将体内所有魔力尽数聚拢，再次咆哮般唱出那段旋律，嗓音因用力而撕裂。刹那间，失败的阴影化作成功的阴影。黑暗缠绕着他高举的剑刃，阴翳以致命的幻象覆上武器。他胜利地一声长喝，新晋的刃歌者纵身跃向伙伴援手——新纹身正脉动着光芒。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Deftly springing atop a large rock, the halfling draws his rapier with a flourish. Sparks of magical energy leap across his studded leather armor as he pulls power from the weave. Throwing back his tousled head, he begins to sing in earnest, straining to bind his performance with supernatural energy. A spectral glimmer of power manifests about his slender blade, then, with a resounding pop, fades into the pulsing shadows of failure. Panic paints the rogue’s ruddy features. As danger looms ever closer, the need to succeed eclipses everything. Gathering all the magical might within him he roars out the song again, voice breaking with effort. Suddenly the shadows of failure become those of success. Darkness weaves about his upthrust blade, gloom coating the weapon in lethal illusion. With a triumphant shout, the new bladesinger leaps to his companions’ aid—fresh tattoo pulsing with light.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Surprise Party For Heroes.name:
英雄惊喜派对
Surprise Party For Heroes

Text.text:
安静阴郁的酒馆，和外头阴云压城的夜色相比几乎没什么变化。忽然间，人们齐声高喊欢迎，掀开罩着的提灯与油灯，又把壁炉前的帷幕一把扯下。暖光顷刻灌满整间屋子。暖意也随之涌上心头——本地人将你们团团围住，用结实的拍肩与热烈的拥抱感谢你们的功绩。他们硬把酒杯塞进你们手里。厨房门砰地撞开，浆着浆果香的热酒气息扑面而来，与热面包和烤肉的香味交织在一起。小提琴、长笛与鲁特琴齐齐响起，舞者们涌向壁炉旁那片空地，踏步旋转。

~ 由 Brauner-Dungeon-Master-Suff 构想

The quiet, gloomy tavern is hardly a change from the cloudy night outside. Suddenly, people holler in welcome, uncovering hooded lanterns and lamps and pulling a drape from the fireplace. Warm light fills the room. Warm feelings, too, as the locals envelope you, thanking you for your deeds with hearty pats and hugs. They force mugs into your hands. As the kitchen door bursts open, the smell of wine mulled with berries mixes with the scent of hot bread and roasted meat. A fiddle, flute, and lute pipe up as dancers take to the open floor near the hearth.

~ Envisioned by Brauner-Dungeon-Master-Suff

你不屑地哼了一声，远处的弓箭手又胡乱放出一轮齐射，你随即低身钻到翻倒的货车后。你从鼓胀的袋囊里猛拽出法术材料，咆哮着吐出玄奥的咒言，将其强行系于你的意志——继而放出死亡。法术划出弧线，飞得比往常更远；毁灭性的能量撕裂那可怜的掩蔽，将躲在后面瑟缩的人尽数轰成齑粉。
You snort disdainfully as the distant archers loose another ragged volley, then duck behind the overturned wagon. Yanking spell components from brimming pouches, you roar words of thaumaturgic power, binding them to your will—and unleash death. The spell arches out, far further than usual, destructive energies ripping the paltry cover asunder and pulverizing those cowering behind it.

身披缀满乌鸦羽毛的仪式盛装，那名地精萨满自神庙阶梯上自信阔步而下；骷髅杖头随着他们的步伐轻轻磕嗒作响，在每一级台阶上敲出低沉而清脆的节拍。弯曲的骨质头冠勾勒出他们宽阔的绿脸，他们以细小的赤红眼珠扫视着麾下的追随者。
Bedecked in ceremonial garb replete with raven feathers, the goblin shaman strides confidently down the steps of their temple, a skull-topped staff marking their passage with a soft clacking sound at each step. A headdress of curved bone frames their wide, green face as they cast beady red eyes over their followers.

Speech About An Apocalyptic Villain.name:
诸位，请先别把这当成疯话，也别急着把我归进“邪恶”的那一栏。你们所谓的秩序，不过是把裂缝用金箔糊起来的外壳；你们所谓的希望，不过是拿来哄孩子入睡的童话。世界早就烂了，只是还没来得及发出臭味。

你们每天醒来，重复同样的祷词、同样的交易、同样的谎言：只要再忍一忍，明天就会更好。可明天从来不属于你们。它被那些坐在高处的人分配、切割、标价；被那些躲在阴影里的人偷走、撕碎、烧成灰。你们活在一座摇摇欲坠的塔里，却还在争论是哪块砖更重要。

我不是来毁灭世界的——别把责任推给我。世界自己在崩塌，我只是把你们捂住耳朵的手掰开，把你们蒙住眼睛的布扯下，让你们看看那张早已腐败的脸。灾厄不是我的武器，它是你们的账单，是你们欠下的债，是你们一代代拒绝偿还的利息。

你们害怕末日，因为末日会夺走你们珍爱的东西：家、名字、法律、神明、未来。可你们有没有想过，这些东西到底是谁给的？是谁允许你们拥有？是谁随时能把它们收回？你们把锁链当成项链，把牢笼当成家，把一丁点温暖当成恩赐，然后感激涕零地跪下去。

我不需要你们的理解，我要你们的清醒。

当火从天边爬来，当海吞没你们的街道，当天空像裂开的镜子一样落下碎片，你们会明白：你们一直相信的规则，其实只在和平时才有用。真正的真理只在崩坏里显形——在恐惧撕开伪装、在饥饿掐住喉咙、在绝望把人心剥得见骨的时候。

我会站在废墟中央，像敲钟一样敲响这最后的时刻。不是为了屠杀，而是为了裁决；不是为了快感，而是为了终结谎言。让一切虚伪的誓言焚尽，让一切腐朽的权柄坍塌，让你们终于不得不面对：你们是谁，你们想成为什么，你们愿意为此付出什么。

你们叫我恶徒，因为我不肯陪你们做梦。

可梦醒之后，太阳依旧会升起——如果你们还有资格看见它。

所以来吧，别再祈祷了。别再等待谁来拯救你们。把你们的恐惧握紧，把你们的懦弱烧掉，把你们的名字从旧世界的名册上撕下来。末日不是终点，它是清算，是重启，是把一切谎言归还给尘土的暴风。

你们可以恨我，可以诅咒我，可以举起武器对准我——那都无所谓。重要的是：在世界的最后一口气里，你们终于睁开眼睛，第一次用自己的意志去选择。

而我，只是那扇门。
Speech About An Apocalyptic Villain

Text.text:
“如果你的计划成功，我们所有人都被拖拽着、尖叫着坠入深渊，你就会满足吗？你体内燃烧的那团扭曲之火就会餍足吗？你不是神，也不是幕后操盘的天才；你只是一个人，一个痛苦大到足以在世界各处回响的人。”
“If your plan succeeds and we’re all dragged, shrieking, into the abyss, will you be content? Will whatever twisted fire that burns within you be sated? You are not a god, you are not a mastermind, you are just a person with a pain so great it has echoed across the world.”

Poison Berry Bush.name:
毒莓灌丛
Poison Berry Bush

Text.text:
大丛灌木上密密麻麻挂着一簇簇圆润的白色浆果，沉甸甸的重量把几根枝梗都拽得下垂。有些果肉泛着诱人的淡紫色光泽，另一些却白得像新落的雪。还有几颗两色交缠，宛如暮色在覆雪山巅回旋的微光。附近，几具动物的腐烂尸体散落在肥沃的腐殖土上。看来这些浆果相当致命。
Clusters of round white berries cover the large bush, their weight dragging some of the stalks down. Some present inviting lilac hues across their flesh, whereas others are as white as the driven snow. A few display a swirl of both colors, like the twilight hue of dusk on a snow-capped peak. Nearby, the decomposing bodies of several animals cover the loamy ground. It seems these berries are quite deadly.

士兵们在摇晃的高塔底部蜂拥而上，粗暴地推拽着它朝远处的城墙逼近。硬木骨架在每一次下沉与颠簸间发出低沉的咆哮，绳索嘶嘶作响，车轮吱嘎呻吟。炽烈如灼的箭雨砰砰撞上浸透雨水的兽皮护层，护着蜷伏其中的人；偶有不幸者被从这座巨大的攻城机器上生生钩走，尖叫着坠下。
Troops swarm about the base of the swaying tower, manhandling it toward the distant wall. The hardwood frame growls with each dip and trough, the ropes hissing and wheels groaning. A blistering storm of arrows thuds against the water-soaked hides protecting those crouched within, plucking the unlucky ones screaming from the towering machine.

Well-protected Firing Range.name:
防护严密的射击场
Well-protected Firing Range

Text.text:
各式口径的枪声闷响在这座狭长建筑单调的灰色墙面间回荡。柜台后站着一名店员，面前隔着双层防护网，头顶一扇厚重的格栅高悬着——随时可以在一瞬间落下。这里与真正的射程之间不仅拉开了距离，还隔着另一道抬高的掩体；可来客们显然更在意把准星牢牢钉在射程尽头的靶子上。
Muffled pops of gunshots from a variety of calibers echo off the plain gray walls of the long building. A clerk stands behind a counter featuring a double-layer of protective mesh, with a solid grate looming above—ready to drop in an instant. The station is well-separated from the actual range by both distance and another raised barricade, though the patrons seem much more interested in fixing their sights on targets down the range.

Speech About Greed.name:
关于贪婪的演说
Speech About Greed

Text.text:
“我敢肯定，大多数人看你时，只看见精致——甚至把你当作楷模。但我眼里只有一个虚无的拓荒者。要有多特别的一种愚蠢，才会环顾这世界的万般美好，却认定在死前把每一样闪亮的东西都攥进手里才是答案。你每买下一件小玩意儿、每收回一块土地，就像又刮掉一层幸福的薄膜，直到最后只剩下你那些空心的成就。我怜悯你。你的诅咒就算被人歌颂，也丝毫不减它的悲剧。”

~ Envisioned by Girlhead

“I’m sure when most people look at you, they see refinement—a role model, even. But I only see a pioneer of emptiness. It takes a special sort of idiocy to look around at the world, in all its beauty, and decide grabbing every shiny thing you can before you die is the answer. With every trinket you buy or land you repossess, you scratch away one more layer of happiness, until all that remains are your hollow accomplishments. I pity you. Just because your curse is celebrated doesn’t make it any less tragic.”

~ Envisioned by Girlhead

Mace Of Terror.name:
恐惧钉头锤
Mace Of Terror

Text.text:
这把武器散发出可触可感的恶意与恐惧，仿佛一波波涌来。狞笑的骷髅装点着这柄令人不安的钉头锤，诡怖的饰纹如巴洛克哥特的杰作般将武器层层掩蔽。乌黑的金属冷得像冬日葬礼，烟雾从其上每一颗死颅空洞的眼眶中阴森盘旋而出。
This weapon exudes malice and terror in palpable waves. Leering skulls adorn this unsettling mace, and macabre decorations cover the weapon like a baroque gothic masterpiece. The blackened metal is as cold as a winter funeral, and smoke coils ominously from the hollow eyes of each death-head upon it.

一道闪光先行，随即一抹灰蒙的剪影如烟云般凝聚成形。那层帷幕嗡鸣着能量，逐渐化作你的身形与五官，连你蓄势待发的架势与略带讥诮的神情都分毫不差。

~ 由一位英雄构想

A flicker of light precedes a grayish silhouette manifesting like a cloud of smoke. The shroud thrums with energy as it takes on your shape and features, matching your ready stance and wry expression.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Sundries From A Swarm Of Hell Bats.name:
地狱蝠群的杂物
Sundries From A Swarm Of Hell Bats

Text.text:
地面上，在那群虫群自地狱般抽打翻飞而出的地方周围，横陈着数百具怪异的炼狱昆虫残壳，体型如蝉一般。旁边也散落着果核，却并非来自你们世界里见过的任何植物。
On the ground, around where the swarm whipped and fluttered out of hell, lie the husks of hundreds of strange, infernal insects the size of cicadas. There are fruit pits as well, but not from any plant you have seen in your world.

Headstone: Marked Stone In Winter.name:
墓碑：冬日的刻名石
Headstone: Marked Stone In Winter

Text.text: 与这片墓地里其他墓碑不同，这一块不仅刻着文字，还嵌着一幅画像。铭文写道：先有言。后有行。其下又刻着一个六边形图案，六边形内有七个棺椁状的符号与一弯残月，显然是在描绘山丘之巅那座“坟冢圣龛”的模样。可这块墓碑古怪之处还不止于此：它的顶部平整，像覆着一顶雪白的尖峰；背面收尖，中段最宽，两侧逐渐收窄，整体呈三角之形——与周遭任何一块墓碑都截然不同。 In contrast to the other headstones in this cemetery, this one bears a picture as well as words. The engraving reads: First words. Then deeds. Beneath this is carved a hexagonal shape within which are seven coffin shapes and a half moon, evidently a depiction of the shrine of tombs atop the hill. And that’s not the only curious thing about this marker. It has a flat top, under a peak of snow, and pointed back, wide in the middle and narrowing at the edges, giving it a triangular shape—unlike any of the surrounding tombstones.

Arrival To The Under Plane.name:
抵达下位面
Arrival To The Under Plane

Text.text:
传送门像流沙、窒息与惊惧，一把将你拖过滴着树根的顶壁，坠入一条黑土隧道。上面的世界里，掘土者挖不出这样的甬道。它的扭曲搅乱你的方位，催生眩晕。空气逼仄而黏稠；当隧道豁然开阔，某种东西柔软滑行的窸窣声、深土气体与腐败植物的瘴息一齐涌来，直叫人心底发冷。
The portal was quicksand, suffocation, and panic, bringing you through the root-dripping ceiling of a black dirt tunnel. In the world above, diggers don’t create tunnels like these. The twist of it sabotages your bearings, produces vertigo. The air is close and thick, and when the tunnel opens out, the soft slide of something moving and the miasma of deep earth gases and dying plants all leave the heart cold.

Village Gazebo In Summer.name:
盛夏村亭
Village Gazebo In Summer

Text.text:
这座凉亭投下的荫蔽，在盛夏时节一直为人们遮挡烈日的酷虐，带来一丝喘息。自村庄建立之初，它便是恋人相会的所在。曾不止一桩婚事在它的格栅檐下被求婚、被应允。四下里还能看见零零散散的小小首字母——刻得粗陋，却带着几分迫切——用以纪念在此结成的情缘。
The shade afforded by this gazebo has provided succor from the punishing rays of the sun during the summer months. It has been a meeting place for sweethearts since the village’s founding. More than one marriage has been proposed and accepted under its latticed eaves. Here and there one can see small initials, carved crudely but with some urgency, commemorating the relationships formed on this spot.

虚弱将死，还是早已断气？这具类人生物至少还直立着，皮革般干枯的躯壳由孱弱的双腿勉强支撑。漆黑长袍如影般将生物裹入怀中，袍上绣着一枚你怎么也看不清的徽记。空气以惊人的速度从房间里抽离——像气闸骤然关闭时那一下猝不及防的窒息。
Frail, dying, or already dead? The humanoid is vertical at least, its leathery husk of a body propped up by feeble legs. Dark robes swaddle the creature in a shadowlike embrace and bear an insignia you can’t quite make out. Air leaves the room with a startling celerity—like the sudden choke of an airlock.

I Detach A Hempen Rope Patch From My Rob.name:
我从【实用物品长袍】上扯下一块麻绳补丁
I Detach A Hempen Rope Patch From My Robe Of Useful Items

Text.text:
我在长袍上找到那块旋动的黄色斑纹，猛地将它扯了下来。粗糙的麻纤维擦得掌心生疼，那件物品就在我手中成形：五十英尺长、结实耐用的盘卷绳索——随时可用。
I find the yellow swirling patch on my robe and tear it free. The rough texture of hemp chafes my palms as the item forms in my hands: fifty feet of coiled, sturdy rope—ready to use.

Concealed Bunker Full Of Supplies.name:
藏着补给的隐秘地堡
Concealed Bunker Full Of Supplies

Text.text:
通往地堡的暗门伴着一声嘶响开启，条形灯瞬间亮起，通风口开始向空间鼓入循环再生的空气。几间逼仄相连的房间里堆满了惊人的储备，你的目光贪婪地扫过成堆的食物、医疗用品与弹药，几乎不敢相信自己的好运。你这是中了大奖。
The hidden door to the bunker opens with a hiss, and strip lights burst into life as the vents begin to pump recycled air into the space. The cramped collection of rooms is well stocked with a huge cache, and you can hardly believe your luck as your eyes drink in the abundance of food, medical supplies, and ammunition. You’ve hit the jackpot.

这里或许是一处哨岗。木箱围着火坑摆成椅子的模样，正对着狭窄而阴翳的南侧入口，也能望见其西南方那块兀立如雕的风蚀石柱。
This may be a watch post. The crates are arranged like chairs by the firepit, with a view of the narrow and shaded southern entrance and of the standing hoodoo rock to its southwest.

Library Of Arcana: Arcane Machinery.name:
奥术典藏馆：奥术机械
Library Of Arcana: Arcane Machinery

Text.text:
闪亮的金属杆起落如行军军团的靴步。金属凸缘掠动闪烁，并非随风之兴，而是循着设计的意志。齿轮璀璨无数，如星辰般不可尽数，却又如同一片神秘星座，齐整运转。若有一百座钟楼吐出它们跳动的心脏，并将其并入同一意图，或许便会呈现出这般景象。可这台机器究竟做什么——诸天在上，它到底有什么用？
Gleaming rods rise and fall like the boots of a regiment on the march. Metal flanges flit and flicker, not by the whim of wind but by the will of design. Gears, as glittering and uncountable as stars, move as one mysterious constellation. If a hundred clocktowers disgorged their beating hearts and united them to a single purpose, it might look something like this. But what, by all the heavens above, does this machine do?

Gravedigger's Hut.name:
掘墓人的小屋
Gravedigger's Hut

Text.text:
一间简陋的木屋，顶着茅草屋顶，孤零零地坐落在墓地边界之外；体型只比工具棚略大一些。门边放着一辆木制独轮手推车，车斗上盖着一块破烂的帆布——帆布底下探出一把铁锹的柄，以及其他工具的边角。木屋唯一的一扇窗正对着那片歪斜林立的墓碑。薄弱的百叶窗后传来一阵破碎的咳嗽，紧接着是一道粗哑的嗓音，咒骂着这该死的天气。
A simple wooden hut with a thatched roof sits just outside the graveyard grounds, its size only slightly grander than a tool shed. A wooden wheelbarrow awaits by the door, its basket covered by a ratty piece of canvas—from under which poke the handle of a spade and other tools. The hut’s single window faces the field of lopsided headstones. A ragged cough can be heard from behind the flimsy shutters, followed by a gruff voice cursing the weather.

一枚小小的蓝白双色圆柱药丸，蓝白交界处横着一弯绿色半月，像是某种一眼就能认出的标志。它看起来无害得很——可话又说回来，它并不在制式医疗包装里。它根本没有包装。至少可以确定的是，它的效果不会受正规当局监管……
A small blue and white cylindrical pill has a green half-moon sitting across the center of the blue–white divide, clearly a logo of some sort. The pill seems innocuous enough, but then again, it wasn’t in standard-issue medical packaging. It wasn’t packaged at all. At the very least, its effect won’t be regulated by the proper authorities…

The Harvest Throne.name:
丰收王座
The Harvest Throne

Text.text:
在苍白蜡烛融化的烛光映照下，王座的白木泛起一层明亮的橘色微辉。椅座仿佛从其下宽阔树桩的硬木心脏中自然生长而出，而椅背与扶手则如扭结的根须般自座位周围拔起，向空中探寻养分。
Lit by melting candles of pale wax, the white wood of the throne glimmers a luminous orange. The seat of the chair seems to have grown from the heartwood of the broad stump upon which it sits, while the back and arms of the chair rise up around the seat like gnarled roots searching the air for sustenance.

I Alert The Camp To An Ambush.name:
我向营地示警：有埋伏
I Alert The Camp To An Ambush

Text.text:
我竖起耳朵，捕捉到敌人那被压住的脚步声。随后，我悄无声息地在同伴之间穿行，逐一暗中将他们唤醒。“我们并不孤单，朋友们。黑暗里有东西潜伏着，想要伤害我们。就让它以为自己仍占上风。”
My ears twitch as I detect the muffled footsteps of a foe. Slowly, I move from companion to companion, rousing them in secret. “We are not alone, my friends. Something lurking in the darkness means us harm. Let it think it still possesses the upper hand.”

Sundries From A Vampire Shade.name:
吸血鬼影魇的杂货
Sundries From A Vampire Shade

Text.text:
魅影消散了，它那亵渎的尖啸仍在你耳畔回荡；你俯身望向它爬出的坟穴。碎裂的木板下方，棺中霉烂的骨骸披着破布——然而月光里有一样东西攫住了你的视线。骷髅的胸口上，静静躺着一枚六边形硬币，泛着诡异的虹彩。凑近细看，你才发现它由抛光的青铜铸成，正反两面各刻着一轮月：一面圆满无缺，另一面却残破断裂。
The phantom disperses, its unholy shriek ringing in your ears as you peer into the grave from which it rose. Splintered wood reveals moldering bones draped in rags in the coffin below—yet something catches your eye in the moonlight. Resting on the skeleton’s chest you see a hexagonal coin of a strange, iridescent hue. On closer inspection you realize it is made of polished bronze and depicts a moon on each face—one whole, the other broken.

Small Unit Tactics.name:
小队战术
Small Unit Tactics

Text.text:
小队如扇面般散开，训练有素，浑然一体。每个人都微偏着头，目光游弋，搜寻任何行动的迹象。队长以一连串干净利落、刻意克制的手势指挥士兵，整套动作宛如精英舞团在大师编排下的演出：先是一字排开的战士长线。随即收拢成防御菱形阵。又迅速回归队列。最右侧士兵压制射击。一次佯攻式冲锋。直到队长最后摊平的手掌落下，小队再度静止，如同被按下无声的开关。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The team fans out, a well-drilled unit. Each member cocks their head, scanning for activity. With a series of deft and deliberate hand signals, the team leader directs their soldiers. The performance is like that of an elite dancing troop with expert choreography: A line of warriors. Then a defensive diamond formation. Back into line. Suppressive fire from the rightmost trooper. A feinted charge. At the final flat hand of the leader, the team falls still once more.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Kalo Deepspeaker In Non-aquatic Environm.name:
卡洛·深语者在非水栖环境中
Kalo Deepspeaker In Non-aquatic Environment

Text.text:
某种蝠形之物迈步闯入视野，步态踉跄不安，仿佛还没习惯这里的重力。它那带翼的水栖薄膜收拢在身侧，像吸血鬼的斗篷般裹住自己，尖刺丛生，哥特阴冷。然而在这生物的碧蓝面容上，你却看见一种超脱尘世的宁静——自信而端肃。它的嗓音如溪流咕噜作响，递来一句你猜是客套的寒暄，说话时却带着谦逊使节般沉稳庄重的分量。
Something batlike strides into view with an uneasy gait, as though not quite used to the gravity. Its winged aquatic membrane is folded in about itself like a vampire’s cloak, spiked and gothic. Yet, in the creature’s turquoise face, you find an otherworldly calm—confident and dignified. A voice like a burbling stream extends what you suppose is a pleasantry. It speaks with all the gravitas of a humble diplomat.

一簇簇巨大的红褐色豆荚垂挂在可可树宽大如革的叶片间——甚至直接从树干上长出。豆荚约一英尺长，椭圆形，外皮起棱带纹。部分豆荚被嗜甜的生物啃穿，显然是被里面乳白色的浆肉所诱。它们却把褐色的豆子丢下不吃，其中一些还被啐吐在地上。
Clusters of large red-brown pods hang down among the cacao tree’s big leathery leaves—and even grow on the trunk. The pods are about a foot long, oval shaped, with ridged skin. Some of the pods have been gnawed through by sweet-toothed creatures, tempted by the creamy white pulp within. They have left the brown beans, however, some of which have been spat out on the ground.

Halfling Plucks Up Courage.name:
半身人鼓起勇气
Halfling Plucks Up Courage

Text.text:
“我只想回到旅店，来杯麦酒，再配上一份热气腾腾的烤肉——但我会振作起来！几乎任何争斗、任何枷锁，都有破局之道！”
“I just want to be back at the inn with an ale and a steaming roast, but I’ll take heart! There’s a way through almost any fight or fetter!”

I Cast Hellish Rebuke.name:
我施放地狱反击
I Cast Hellish Rebuke

Text.text:
我怒火灼燃，抬手直指袭击我的那人，目光里燃起炼狱之火。我唇角掠过一丝笑意，热浪在空气中扭曲颤动，烈焰将我尖叫的目标吞没——低沉而恶魔般的咯咯笑声在四周回荡。
Smoldering with rage, I direct an accusing finger at my attacker, my eyes alight with infernal fire. A smile crosses my lips as heat shimmers through the air and flames engulf my screaming target—and a low, devilish cackle echoes all around.

Kobold Master Tinkerer.name:
狗头人大工匠
Kobold Master Tinkerer

Text.text:
蒸汽缭绕的实验室里，一个矮小身影蜷伏在盾后，身披失去光泽的板甲护甲，发出疯癫般的咯咯狂笑。武器被铆在他的肩甲上，敞开的发射器里，浓稠的液体球体晃荡翻涌，带着不祥的威胁。一只戴甲的手握着一柄扭曲匕首，刃口渗出黏稠毒素的滴珠，弓背般的身形上缠挂着各式容器，里面封存着畸变的突生与易爆的炼金反应。他翻滚的眼珠与耷拉的舌头，昭示着一位怪僻天才的癫狂。

~ 由 Nachreld 构想

Inside the steam-wreathed lab, a diminutive figure in tarnished plate armor crouches behind his shield and cackles with lunatic glee. Weapons are bolted to his pauldrons, and within their open launchers globes of thick liquid slosh menacingly. A twisted dagger gleams in one gauntleted hand, its blade bleeding beads of viscous toxin, and various containers clinging to his hunched form house twisted mutations and volatile alchemy. His rolling eyes and lolling tongue scream of eccentric genius.

~ Envisioned by Nachreld

光滑的金属外壳几乎将滑翔器的机械结构尽数遮蔽，但在接缝处仍能瞥见些许端倪。平台两侧各装着一具安置在可旋转坐骑上的强力喷射引擎，旁边排着数个脚踏板，用以控制推力与转向。看不出任何安全装置——驾驶这架滑翔器，非得有一大把自信，或是一腔鲁莽。
A sleek metal casing mostly conceals the mechanics of the glider, but some hints are visible at the seams. A powerful jet on a swiveling mount lies on both sides of a platform, with several foot pedals to control thrust and direction. There doesn't seem to be any kind of safety mechanism—piloting this glider must take a large dose of confidence or recklessness.

Black Knight On Horseback.name:
马背上的黑骑士
Black Knight On Horseback

Text.text:
骑士驾驭着那匹乌黑锃亮的战马，摆出一副魔性的姿态。深黑钢甲覆体，长角头盔下的面容隐没在阴影里，唯有一双灼燃的眼睛探出，近乎兽性的冷光逼人。他握缰从容而笃定，手中提着一柄凶戾的战斧，举重若轻——那份轻松，像是鞍上驰骋数十年磨出的本能。
The knight strikes a fiendish pose atop their gleaming black steed. Plated in dark black steel, the knight’s face is shadowed behind a horned helm, though two burning eyes peer out in an almost bestial fashion. Their grip on the reins is easy and sure, and they carry a wicked axe with an ease born of decades in the saddle.

Shattered Heart Of The Mountain.name:
破碎的山之心
Shattered Heart Of The Mountain

Text.text:
猩红的光在山腹深处潮起潮落，诡异而摇曳的辉芒，仿佛海流间斑驳游移的光影。空旷的洞窟空间中央，躺着山之心的碎裂残骸——一枚近乎球形的水晶，原本洁净的表面却被细密裂纹织成的网痕所玷污。水晶内部有铜、银与金的碎屑闪烁，一抹红橙色的光自其中渗出，伴随一道奔涌的嗡鸣，时隐时现，如同太古的心跳——仿佛整座山也在缓缓吸吐。水晶缺失了几块，自中线裂簇处被人取走，使这颗心破碎而残缺。

~ 由 Dakota Envisioned

Crimson light ebbs and flows in the heart of the mountain, a strange and wavering glow that evokes light dappling through ocean currents. At the center of the cavernous space lies the shattered heart of the mountain—a roughly spherical crystal with a web of minute cracks marring its otherwise pristine surface. Flakes of copper, silver, and gold shine within the crystal, and a red-orange glow emanates from it, accompanied by a coursing hum that comes and goes like a primordial heartbeat—like the mountain itself breathes in and out. Pieces of crystal are missing, taken from the cluster of cracks down its middle, leaving the heart broken and incomplete.

~ Envisioned by Dakota

一阵古怪的嘶鸣式呱呱声宣告着一只奇特生物的到来。它踉跄而行，像鸵鸟般一颠一颠，踩着尖端锐利的鸟类长腿。它约莫齐你腹部高，修长的覆羽颈项后拖着一条狭长、饰以绒羽的尾巴。两片滑稽的前翼徒劳地扑扇着，露出一对利爪——比起翱翔天际，更适合在泥土里翻刨。
An odd honking announces the arrival of a peculiar creature. It ambles, bobbing like an ostrich, on sharp-tipped avian legs. About the height of your stomach, its long, feathered neck is offset by a narrow, plumed tail. Two ludicrous forewings flap uselessly to expose claws more suited to grubbing in the dirt than soaring in the sky.

血红色的台地从遍布碎岩的荒地中陡然拔起。它的峭壁粗粝如刀削，仿佛有巨人将大地猛然掀起，又亲手凿刻成形。台地顶端几近完美平坦，历经亿万年的风蚀磨平。
The blood-red mesa rises sharply from the surrounding rock-strewn badlands. It's sheer, rugged sides appear chiseled from the very landscape, as if a titanic figure heaved the earth upward before carving it into shape. The mesa's top lies almost perfectly flat, eroded over eons.

Loot From A Nycaloth: Weapon.name:
来自一名尼卡洛斯的战利品：武器
Loot From A Nycaloth: Weapon

Text.text:
战斧寒光闪烁，弧形刃口像燧石般的金属露出一抹阴毒的狞笑，斧柄则是金色的尖刺螺旋。此等武器分量惊人，砂纸般粗粝的握柄上还布满杂乱突起的尖棘；挥舞这把地狱屠刀，连最坚韧的战士也要被迫检验自己的胆魄与硬骨头。
The axe gleams, its curved edge a wicked grin of flintlike metal, its handle a spiking twist of gold. With the weapon’s incredible heft and the sandpapery hilt riddled with randomly jutting thorns, wielding this infernal cleaver will test even the stoutest warrior’s mettle.

Vampiress Commenting On Her Beauty.name:
女吸血鬼对自己的美貌评头论足
Vampiress Commenting On Her Beauty

Text.text:
“我至今还没遇到哪个画师，能捕捉我美貌里那份谜一般的气息。好看的脸其实很常见——可真正慑人的五官，却少之又少。”她嘶地一声，獠牙随之拉长。“多少公爵淑女的传承，都葬在我腰胯的弧度里。雄图、征服、扬名立万的美梦——到我颈后的柔处，全都化作一缕青烟。”她用指尖缓缓掠过锁骨。“你看见了，不是吗？你也已着迷。来吧。就算是愚钝之人，也会停下来凝望那落日的余晖。”
“I’ve yet to meet an artist who can capture the enigma of my beauty. A comely face is actually quite a common thing—but few command the power of truly striking features.” Her fangs elongate with a hiss. “The legacies of lords and ladies have been lost to the curve of my hips. Dreams of grandeur, conquest, the making of names—they all fizzle to nothing in the nape of my neck.” She trails a finger along her clavicle. “You see it, do you not? You, too, are enchanted. Come, now. Even dullards stop to stare at the setting sun.”

嗡鸣渐成轰响，带着电流般的刺痛，空气里弥漫着腐败的味道。云团翻滚折叠，仿佛同时在抗争与逃窜。蜂群闪烁着点点晶亮的眼、抽搐的翅，以及病灶成簇时那种油亮、果糕般黏腻的质感。随即，整体仿佛找到了目标。它将自己塑成一枚投射物。苍蝇群猛然疾射向前。
The hum becomes a din, something electric, and there is rot in the air. A cloud roils and folds, seeming to fight and flee at once. The swarm shimmers with sparkling eyes, spastic wings, and the glossy fruitcake texture of sickness in clusters. Then the collective seems to find its purpose. It shapes itself into a projectile. The flies bolt forward.

这根魔杖不过两英尺长，细得可怜，是劣质木头做的。它卡在椅子坐垫与靠背之间，亮闪闪的穗边探出来，像烟花般在下方地面上炸开一圈毛刺。握柄只是末端一小截硬化橡胶疙瘩。它看上去脆弱又滑稽——甚至有点丢人。可它被强大的魔法守护着，那魔法从千千只猫的幸福里抽取而来：从小猫飞快的针尖爪子，到晒着太阳的老猫柔软满足的轻拍。它的魔法古老而狡黠。
The wand is a thin two feet of cheap wood. It sticks out between a chair’s seat cushion and back, its sparkly fringe bristling over the floor below like a firework. The grip is only a little nub of hardened rubber on the end. It appears fragile and hilarious—even embarrassing. But it is protected by powerful spells drawn from the happiness of a thousand-thousand cats: from the fast needle-claws of kittens to the soft contented battings of elders lying in the sun. Its magic is old and sly.

一端，这根沉重的铁杆分叉成四枚朝向各异的钩爪。另一端则开着一道狭窄的孔洞。孔中嵌着一枚铁环，宽得足以容纳粗绳穿过。
At one end, this heavy iron rod splays into four hooks pointing in different directions. The other end has a narrow hole. Set into this hole is an iron ring wide enough to accommodate thick rope.

The Weathered Path.name:
风蚀之路
The Weathered Path

Text.text: 正午的阳光从树叶间丝丝漏下，落进一条小溪里；溪水在铺成桥面与桥基的鹅卵石块间跃动闪烁。每当覆着银色的木轮从上方滚过，便有一道摇曳的光芒随之颤飞，映在那些满是战痕的头盔、长剑与盾牌上——它们被紧紧塞在马车的后厢里。这里曾是无数勇武战士奔赴征战的道路；而如今，他们已在棺椁中被送回各自的家族与王国。这条苹果青色的小溪，在山谷里以桥旁的一块木牌标明自己的位置，宣告此地名为 The Weathered Path。 The midday sunlight trickles down the leaves of the trees and into a small creek, which sparkles against the cobblestone blocks that make up its crossing bridge. A ray of flickering shine flutters every time wooden wheels coated in silver rotate over top, glittering off the battle-scarred helmets, swords, and shields that are packed into the backs of carriages. It is a road taken by the many brave warriors who once fought well in battle, and are now being taken back to their families and kingdoms in caskets. This small creek of apple-green water marks its place in the valley with a sign by its bridge, declaring it as The Weathered Path.

Periapt Of Proof Against Poison.name:
防毒护符
Periapt Of Proof Against Poison

Text.text:
这枚银质坠饰镶着一颗硕大的宝石，黑得深不见底，仿佛在随黑暗一阵阵搏动。你将它握在手中时，身子莫名轻盈，却怎么也说不清那感觉；直到你猛然醒悟——那些你在冒险途中攒下的虫咬伤，竟再也不痒了。
The silver pendant features a large gem so deeply black that it pulses with darkness. You feel strangely light while you handle it, but cannot put the sensation into words, until you realize with a start that none of the insect bites you have collected while adventuring itch any longer.

这位半精灵带着卓尔般的幽暗，皮肤泛着乌鸦翅羽般的蓝黑光泽；头发却是纯黑，粗硬，在头顶编成辫束，两侧剃得干净。下巴上同样覆着一层黑曜石般的胡影。右眼猩红，左眼在脸左侧纵横疤痕的舞动之下，呈一抹水洗般的惨白。他腰侧别着一把燧发手枪，棕色饰边的黑色铆钉皮甲紧贴其身；另一侧则挂着一柄细剑。他以一种正式而严肃的气息迎上你，随即又讲了个礼貌的笑话，嘴角微扬，隐约流露出希望你能喜欢这番开场的期待。

~ Played by BaronVonMonkey with

The half-elf is drow dark, bluish like a crow’s wing, but his hair is black, coarse, and braided on top and shaved on the sides. The shadow of hair on his chin is equally obsidian. He has a red right eye, his left a watery white under a dance of scars on the left side of his face. A flintlock sits on his hip of brown-trimmed black studded leather, with a rapier on the opposite side. He meets you with a formal, serious air, but then tells a polite joke and smiles a little, showing hope that you’ll like the overture.

~ Played by BaronVonMonkey with

爪印一路延伸到一片泥泞的撕扯痕迹中，仿佛那头狼曾在这里狠狠干过一架。深长的抓痕剜进泥土，石块被踢开或甩飞。凑近细看，更像是有人与狼扭打过——你看见清晰的手掌印，以及一串人类的足迹从此处离去。可离开的只有那一双脚印，而且留下它的人没有穿鞋。
The pawprints lead to a muddy scrabble, as if the wolf got into a fight. Long scratches gouge the dirt, and stones have been kicked or flung away. On closer inspection, it looks like someone wrestled with the wolf, for you see the clear imprint of a hand and the tracks of a person leading away. But those footprints are the only ones that leave, and whoever made them wasn’t wearing shoes.

两只金色的眼睛在满是坑疤的皮兜帽阴影下闪烁，像两枚金币般冷亮。薄唇呈森林深潭般的幽绿，被一道疤痕撕裂——从那尖俏的鼻翼一路斜划到狭窄的下巴。唇角咧开，露出一抹野兽似的狞笑，尖细歪斜的利齿肆意张扬。它将一只尖头鞋轻轻拖过地面，你听见它身上叮当作响——一只装满钱币的挎包？可它转瞬即逝，化作一缕虚无。空气里飘来一声细瘦的嗤笑，可那生物已无处可寻。
Two golden eyes glint like ducats underneath a pockmarked, hide hood. Thin lips the deep green of a forest pond are cracked by a scar running from the corner of their spritely nose and down to their narrow chin. The lips part into a bestial smirk rampant with pointed, crooked teeth. They move one of their pointed shoes softly across the ground and you hear the jingle on their person—a satchel full of coins? But they are gone in a blink, disappearing into thin air. A reedy chuckle carries in the air, but the creature is nowhere to be seen.

一缕干燥的气味划破隧道潮湿的霉香，你循着源头望去：地面上堆着一堆碎裂的石块。再往前，是一块从天花板坠落、裂纹遍布的巨石。而更远处，一道更骇人的堵塞阴沉地逼近——天花板已然塌陷，成吨瓦砾灌满了空间。
A dry scent cuts through the damp aroma of the tunnel, and you spot its source: broken stone in a heap on the floor. Beyond it lies a cracked boulder that fell from the ceiling. And beyond that, an even greater blockage looms. The ceiling has fallen in, filling the space with tons of rubble.

Fake Gloves Of Swimming And Climbing.name:
赝品游泳与攀爬手套
Fake Gloves Of Swimming And Climbing

Text.text:
这副绿鳞手套的指间以薄膜相连，本该极适合划水，或抓握攀上岩壁——但你再仔细一看，却发现鳞片滑得过头，根本无法提供稳固的抓力；而那层蹼膜也不过是毡布般的软料，多半只会在水中拖沓碍事。
The fingers of these green-scaled gloves are connected by thin material, excellent for paddling through water, or for gripping and climbing a rock face—but when you examine them more closely, you find the scales much too slippery to provide a sure grip, and the webbing to be little more than felt cloth, likely to drag in the water.

The Painted Hills.name:
彩绘丘陵
The Painted Hills

Text.text:
这片植被稀疏的土地本该令人泄气，若不是那一道道富含矿物的土壤与岩层横扫丘陵，将它们涂染成夺目的斑斓。褶皱与谷地更为沉静的色调引领你们一行继续前行，以惊奇作诱饵——也以未知前方究竟潜藏着什么的谜团作牵引。
This sparsely vegetated span of earth would be discouraging if not for the mineral-rich beds of soil and rock that sweep across the hills, painting them with brilliant color. The more muted colors of the folds and valleys usher your party forward, tempting them with wonder—and the mystery of what may lie ahead.

God Of The Arctic.name:
北境寒霜之神
God Of The Arctic

Text.text:
他的白胡子浓密却不长，头发却留得很长：一条银色的辫子，像一柄剑般背在身后。双手大如酒壶，前臂筋肉虬结，他把桨从狭长木独木舟的一侧换到另一侧。神祇赤裸上身，腕间却戴着宽大的蓝白冰臂铠，海豹皮短裤裹在厚重的毛皮靴之下。待他靠近那片冰川居所平坦的冰台，一家北极熊已在那里等着他。
His white beard is thick but short, but he wears his hair long: a silver braid, like a sword strapped to his back. With hands bigger than pitchers and brawny forearms, he switches his paddle from one side of the long wooden canoe to the other. The god is bare-chested, but wears expansive bracers of blue-white ice on his wrists and sealskin breeches under heavy fur boots. As he approaches the flat shelf of his glacial home, a family of polar bears waits for him.

珠宝、小饰物与钱币堆成一座闪耀的金山，反射的光在巨大金库的墙壁与穹顶间跳跃起舞。宝藏忽然一阵蠕动。财富彼此滑拢，叮当作响，汇成一股向上翻涌的洪流，硬生生塑出人形。蓝宝石滑入凹处，在那怪物模糊的头颅上嵌成一双眼。它抬起闪烁的臂膀，踏出一步，清脆回响如钟鸣……

~ 构想：Joshua Crilly

Jewels, trinkets, and coins form a glittering pile, sending reflected light to dance on the walls and ceiling of the great vault. The hoard shifts suddenly. Treasures slide together, jingling in a great, upward-heaving mass that takes humanoid shape. Sapphires slide into place, forming eyes on the monstrous being’s vague head. It raises its sparkling arms and takes one ringing step forward…

~ Envisioned by Joshua Crilly

Headstone: “The” And River Rock.name:
墓碑：“The”与河卵石
Headstone: “The” And River Rock

Text.text: 这座坟上堆着一小丘石头，像是多年来访客陆续留下的。最上面是一块圆润的黑石，似乎是最近放上的。多半取自附近的溪流，大小正好能稳稳托在掌心。墓碑上的字句或许解释了这些石头的来历：心若坚如磐石，便是沉重的负担。把你的石头留在这里，带着更轻的心继续前行。 Stones heap up in a mound on this grave, looking as if they’ve been left by visitors over the years. A round black rock seems to be the most recent deposit. Likely taken from the stream nearby, it would fit neatly in your palm. The writing on this tombstone provides a possible explanation for the stones: The heart as hard as stone is a heavy weight to bear. Leave your stone here, and carry on with a lighter heart.

I Reconfigure My Hacker's Deck.name:
我重新配置了黑客的牌组
I Reconfigure My Hacker's Deck

Text.text:
甲板静静悬浮在我左前臂上方一线之距，毫无生气。赭褐色的外壳在光里闪着钝亮；当我与它接触，它便被离子能量点燃般微微流光。甲板随即展开，识别出我独一无二的生物特征。键盘以标准布局翻出，我灵巧的手指如波纹般掠过其上，在按键间疾闪。无声之间，甲板重塑为我的个人配置，两具全息键盘在我面前显现。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The deck hovers, inert, a fraction above my left forearm. Its umber housing glints in the light, and at my touch, it shimmers with ionic energy. The deck opens, recognizing my unique biosignature. The keyboard swings out in a standard configuration and my nimble fingers ripple across it, flashing at the buttons. Without a sound, the deck morphs into my personal config, with twin holographic keyboards manifesting before me.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Necromancer's Spellbook.name:
死灵法师的法术书
Necromancer's Spellbook

Text.text:
正面封皮上刻着字，仿佛墓碑上的姓名与墓志铭。它用某种魔法胶黏装订，因此看起来只是一只长方形的灰色石匣，重量却比一方手帕还轻。带着坑穴与棺木般的土腥恶息，它翻开时露出一页页法术书页——更像是描绘出来，而非书写而成。手势的示意图上密密填满咒文，有些页面还可向外折叠，展开后足有原来的三倍长，用以演示某种晦涩难明的解剖步骤。
The front cover is inscribed as if it were the name and epitaph on a tombstone. It is bound by some kind of magical glue, so that it simply looks like a rectangular gray stone box, though it weighs less than a handkerchief. With the earth’s bad breath of pit and coffin, it opens on spell pages more drawn than written. Schematics of gestures are filled with incantations, and some pages fold out to thrice their length in order to demonstrate some abstruse anatomical procedure.

Dungeon: Rotten Scent.name:
地城：腐朽恶臭
Dungeon: Rotten Scent

Text.text:
一股腐臭随穿堂风飘来，浓烈得仿佛令空气都凝稠起来。恶臭从四面八方涌来，哪怕没有那呛得人热泪直流的压迫感，也难以分辨源头。要鼓起些勇气，才能顶住这股铺天盖地的臭味继续前行。
A rancid smell wafts in on a draft, and the air seems to thicken with the strength of it. The stench comes from all around you, to the point it’s difficult to determine the source even without the eye-watering pressure. It will take some bravery to bear the overwhelming odor and continue on.

Wand Of Polymorph.name:
变形术魔杖
Wand Of Polymorph

Text.text:
用来制作这根魔杖的木枝虬结扭曲、弯折成形，然而仍散发出强烈的惑控灵光。枝条一端牢牢绑着一只腌渍的蟾蜍，浸在防腐液中，色泽苍白发灰。
The wooden branch used to craft this wand was gnarled and bent, but nonetheless it radiates a strong aura of enchantment. A pickled toad, pale and gray with preservative solution, has been securely lashed to one end of the branch.

Experiencing Levitation For The First Ti.name:
初次体验漂浮
Experiencing Levitation For The First Time

Text.text:
当你的双脚离地的瞬间，恐慌如箭般贯穿全身——原始本能与你的魔法学识激烈交战。仿佛有百万细小气泡在皮肤上轻挠，你轻柔地上升，把重量留在了原地。

~ 由 Discord 上的 Sahlonahl 于 Envisioned

Panic shoots through you as your feet leave the ground—your primal instincts at war with your magical knowledge. The sensation of a million tiny bubbles tickles your body as you gently rise, leaving your weight behind.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Ancient Burial Urn On An Altar.name:
祭坛上的古老葬瓮
Ancient Burial Urn On An Altar

Text.text:
祭坛正中央安放着一只巨大的黑色瓮，镶缀着失去光泽的黄金。这器物大得远超容纳一人遗骸所需——也许它原本是为多人而设，亦或它从来就不是为人准备的。
Sitting at the center of the altar is a great black urn embellished with tarnished gold. The piece is much larger than necessary for the remains of one person—maybe it was meant for multiple people, or maybe it wasn’t meant for a person at all.

Ancient Brass Dragon.name:
远古黄铜龙
Ancient Brass Dragon

Text.text:
空气又热又黏，气味让人想起被烈日烤透的盛夏时光。你面前那道辉煌闪耀的身影昂然升起，双足直立，一只巨大的利爪臂横在胸前，另一只则抬起轻抚下颌，带着几分近乎人类的好奇。它铜色的眉脊拧作一团，碧绿的巨眼微微眯起。你已引起了巨龙的注意。
The air feels hot and thick, and the smell calls to mind sunbaked summer days. The glorious, glimmering figure that rises before you sits up on two legs, folding one huge, clawed arm under the other—which reaches up to stroke its chin in an almost human gesture of interest. Its brassy brows beetle as its great green eyes narrow. You have the dragon’s attention.

这把刀由一整块斑驳的灰色燧石雕凿而成。泪滴形的刀刃被层层敲剥至冷酷锋利的切割刃口，而刀柄则粗糙地刻出缺口，便于持握者牢牢抓住。这件原始的石制工具在接触时透着沁骨的凉意。
The knife is carved from a single piece of mottled gray flint. The teardrop-shaped blade has been chipped down to a ruthless cutting edge, while the handle is roughly notched for a wielder’s grip. The primal stone tool is cool to the touch.

Sequester Cast With Consideration.name:
慎思而施：隔离术
Sequester Cast With Consideration

Text.text:
像这样的法术曾被用于许多诡异的目的，有善也有恶，却从不曾漫不经心。你在施放法术时撒下的宝石粉尘太过珍贵，也太难获得，使得这法术绝不可能一时兴起就施展。如今当你吟咒施法，你不得不思量：他人会如何看待你动用此法术的方式。
Spells such as this have been used for many strange purposes, both benevolent and cruel, but never thoughtlessly. The gemstone dust you spread as you cast the spell are too valuable and difficult to attain for the spell to be cast on a whim. Now as you cast it, you are forced to consider what others will think of how you are using the spell.

Rod Of The Pact Keeper, +3.name:
契约守护者之杖 +3
Rod Of The Pact Keeper, +3

Text.text:
这根权杖的握柄由三根彼此交织的管状构件组成；细密的图解与符文短句勾勒出纤细线条，让人恍若看见纤维组织般的纹理。三根圆柱之间的凹槽里穿行着精巧的秘银链，链条又穿过权杖两端秘银帽上的环扣。链条将一枚三叉晶石固定在较小的帽端，将一枚七尖晶石系在较大的那端。两枚晶石都拥有更长的中央尖塔，内部暗纹如脉，尖端焦黑。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

This rod has a haft of three interwoven tubes, with intricate diagrams and runic phrases making up the fine lines that give an impression of fibrous tissue. Delicate mithral chains run in the hollows between the three cylinders and through loops in the scepter’s mithral caps. The chains hold a three-pronged crystal to the rod’s smaller cap and a crystal with seven points to the larger one. Both crystals have a longer central spire, with dark veins and blackened tips.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

学生们穿着正装，蜷缩着贴在墙边，彩带与气球的尾带无精打采地垂在他们头顶。犹疑的细语低低回荡，却被一支附魔乐器四重奏奏出的沉郁华尔兹彻底压过。监护人重重、格外显眼地叹了口气，挥动魔杖指向阶段。乐器立刻切换成轻快的节拍，音色如电般跃动。于是，几个胆子大些的学生才一点点把鞋尖探上舞池。
Students huddle against the walls in their formal wear, streamers and balloon tails hanging listless above their heads. The low murmur of hesitant voices is overwhelmed by a quartet of enchanted instruments playing a somber waltz. A chaperone heaves a heavy, noticeable sigh and flicks their wand in the direction of the stage. The instruments switch to a jaunty beat, their timbre electric. With that, a few brave students inch their shoes onto the dance floor.

龙裔恐怖生物舒展到足足十六英尺高，枯骨作响，仿佛随时会崩裂。褪色的蓝鳞残肉如羽絮般零落地挂在骨架上——那曾令人屏息的湛蓝辉煌，如今只剩呢喃般的残影。仿佛回忆起被遗弃的旧日狂欢，这不死生物将破烂的双翼夸张地张开炫示，继而发出空洞的长啸。它空洞眼眶的阴影深处，两点微光闷燃着……那是残存的知性与力量，仍在其中盘踞。

~ 一位英雄所构想

The draconic horror stretches to its full sixteen-foot height, skeletal form rattling. Strips of faded, blue-scaled flesh hang from its bones in feathery patches: whispers of a once breathtaking azure magnificence. As if recalling the exuberance of its forsaken life, the undead creature extends the threadbare wings in ostentatious display and lets out a hollow cry. Within the shadows of its eye sockets, two pinpricks of light smolder… a hint of sentience, and power, lingering within.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Invitation From A Faerie.name:
来自妖精的邀请
Invitation From A Faerie

Text.text:
“这边走！穿过这片树丛就是。来喝一杯！两杯也行！把那股惊魂从你眉间抖落——你这样弄得大家都不自在。这里没有威胁，没有怪物可杀。只有最高规格的疯癫狂欢。还有，把那些武器卸了！穿成那样可跳不了舞，你会把谁的眼睛戳瞎的。”
“Come this way! Just through these trees. Have a drink! Have two! Let some of that horror slip off your brow—you’re making everyone uncomfortable. There’s no threat here, no monsters to slay. Only unhinged merriment of the highest order. And take those weapons off! You can’t dance wearing something like that. You’ll poke someone’s eye out.”

Boreal Forest In High Winter.name:
隆冬时节的北方针叶林
Boreal Forest In High Winter

Text.text:
常青林披上了一袭白色斗篷。积雪成堆地偎着云杉与冷杉宽阔的树脚，堆砌出一片崭新而艰险的丘谷地貌。空气里那麻木的寒意仿佛连声音都一并冻住；林中寂然无声，唯有偶尔传来被冰雪压弯的枝条喀嚓一裂。万物沉睡，静待春日回暖的解冻。
The forest of evergreen has donned a mantle of white. Snow has drifted in great banks against the broad skirts of spruces and firs, shaping a new and challenging landscape of hills and valleys. The deadening chill in the air seems to have frozen even sound itself; the forest is silent, save for the occasional crack of a branch overburdened with ice or snow. Life sleeps, awaiting the thawing warmth of spring.

Beautiful Gold Brooch.name:
华美的金质胸针
Beautiful Gold Brooch

Text.text:
这枚胸针的造型与工艺都像一面小圆盾，中央开着一个大孔；其纹样与横别针上的饰牌如出一辙——在勾勒轮廓的隆起边框之间，以细致的点彩錾刻出缠绕的藤蔓与浆果。
Shaped and worked like a buckler with a big hole in the middle, the brooch’s designs match the plaque on the bar pin, a careful pointillism of vines and berries tooled between the raised borders that outline them.

I Cast Shapechange.name:
我施放【形体变化】
I Cast Shapechange

Text.text:
我将一顶翠玉头箍戴上头顶，箍身刻着万千生灵的面孔。我念出解开形体束缚的咒语，头箍随之亮起光辉。自头箍附近起，我的躯体骤然折裂扭转，迸生异样的肢体与器官，体型也随之变换。头箍与其光芒一并没入我的新形态，将复归原貌所需的专注封存于我体内。
I place a jade circlet carved with the faces of myriad creatures on my head. It illuminates as I say the words to unbind my form. Starting near the circlet, my body snaps and bends, sprouting different features and shifting in size. The circlet and its glow disappear into my new form, storing the focus required to change my shape back within me.

Cavern Pond With Submerged Skeleton.name:
沉没骷髅（特征）的洞窟水潭
Cavern Pond With Submerged Skeleton

Text.text:
巨大的圆形洞窟在四个基本方位各开着一道出口，宛如罗盘上指向黑暗的敞口空隙。中央一口大池占据了整座洞厅，鱼群在水中游弋，如影中之影般悄然滑过。水里一抹苍白的纹样渐渐显形——那是一具坐在池底的骷髅（特征）。它的手臂伸向某样闪闪发亮的东西。

~ 由DMChad构想

The huge circular cavern has exits at each of the cardinal directions, like a compass of dark, open spaces. A large pond dominates the center of the chamber, and fish slip through it like shadows inside shadows. Some pattern of white in the water shows itself to be a skeleton sitting on the bottom. Its hand stretches toward something glistening.

~ Envisioned by DMChad

女人穿着一件特制的衬衫，恰到好处地展示出她背上繁复的纹身——火与烟交织成的马赛克之下，一条盘旋的巨龙蜿蜒而上。她把香烟送到唇边，一截烟卷松垮垮地卡在唇角的凹痕里，那是旧伤留下的缺口。她的手垂下，随意地落在一柄出鞘武士刀的霓虹刀柄上。
The woman wears a shirt tailored to show off the intricate inkwork on her back—a mosaic of fire and smoke beneath a twisting dragon. She brings a cigarette to her mouth, the twig hanging limply in a notch in her lip from an old scar. Her hand drops to rest easily on the neon hilt of a naked katana.

Alien Hijacked By Sentient Parasite.name:
被有意识的寄生体劫持的异形
Alien Hijacked By Sentient Parasite

Text.text:
那外星人像一具僵硬的木偶般移动，动作夸张到令人毛骨悚然，仿佛对自由意志的怪诞拙劣模仿。口涎在嘴角聚成黏丝，他们用断断续续的残句说话——表情总是慢半拍，才勉强追上自己的词句。
The alien moves like a rigid puppet, movements exaggerated to the point of horror, in a grotesque parody of free will. Drool collects at the corners of their mouth as they speak in broken sentences—their expressions always a tad late to match their words.

这种草药会伪装得与周围的草一模一样：无论附近是细长的高草，还是矮胖的短草，它都能融为一体。它无法被人工栽培，只有最老练的炼金术师与草药学家才认得出它。可在秋天的第一场雨——仅仅那一天——辉焰草会绽放。它会抽出一片又长又像风帆般的花瓣，边缘鲜红，中央雪白。人们采下这片花瓣，将其捣碎，混入它所收集的雨滴之中，制成“垂死者的祝福”的基底——一种药膏，可把人从死亡边缘拉回。
This herb looks exactly like whatever grass surrounds it, whether it be long and slim or short and stubby. It cannot be cultivated, and only the most experienced alchemists and herbalists can identify it. But, on the first rainy day in autumn—for only one day—the Radiant Embergrass flowers. It produces a long, sail-like petal, red on the edge, white in the middle. The petal is picked, then crushed into the raindrops it has collected to create the base for the Dying’s Blessing, an unguent used to bring someone back from the brink of death.

Mountain Outpost Egress.name:
山地前哨撤离通道
Mountain Outpost Egress

Text.text:
无论你是获准穿过前哨，还是已经将其拿下，你眼前的景色都与来时所见相差无几。山谷仍旧向前延伸，那条古老的干涸河道小径也一路没入灰白的草甸、低矮的灌木与随风飘卷的雪沫之中——雪从四周群山吹下，在你的脚边流散。
Given passage through the outpost, or having taken it, you see a landscape much like the one you traveled to arrive here. The valley continues on, as does the ancient riverbed pathway, into the pale grass, scrub brush, and drifting snow that blows from the mountains around you.

Sundries From A Half-dragon Veteran.name:
半龙老兵的杂货
Sundries From A Half-dragon Veteran

Text.text:
你发现一只装满异样灰烬的小袋子，扣在一条断裂的腰带上；腰带松松地绕进一只底部破了个洞的冒险者背包里。背包中有一本用龙语写成的书。
You find a pouch full of unusual ash clipped to a broken belt, looped loosely into an adventurer’s backpack with a hole in the bottom. The pack contains a book written in draconic.

Aura Of Life.name:
生命灵光
Aura Of Life

Text.text:
你一声令下，一圈清凉、沁人的能量灵光骤然鼓胀，将你笼罩其中。你的衣物与装备轻轻起伏，仿佛被平静的水流托举。尽管触感宛如没入水下，却丝毫不惧溺亡。死亡在这层生机之幕中无处容身。
With a word, an aura of energy—cool and refreshing—balloons about you. Your clothing and equipment waft up and down, as if moved by calm waters. Though the sensation is of being submerged, there is no fear of drowning. Death has no place in this veil of vitality.

Manual Of Stone Golems.name:
石魔像手册
Manual Of Stone Golems

Text.text: [掩蔽] 这本怪异的巨册仿佛由整块岩石雕凿而成，与你所见过的一切都截然不同。   [内容] 书页嶙峋，如同一张张不可思议地柔韧的石板，被破烂的麻绳捆缚成册，其上刻满繁复的奥术图式与符号。 [Cover] Seemingly carved from solid stone, this strange tome is unlike anything you have ever seen.   [Content] The craggy pages of the book are sheets of impossibly flexible slate bound by ragged twine and inscribed with complex arcane diagrams and symbols.

Community Garden And Well.name:
社区花园与水井
Community Garden And Well

Text.text: 这片小花园边缘凌乱，空气里还飘着新施肥后的刺鼻气味；从医疗中心和校舍走一小段路就能到。园中有一小块方方正正的土地用细绳随意围起，地里插着一块大牌子，上面写着 Bhavani。其余地块则被零星的许多小牌子“认领”了去：每块牌子上都是孩子般稚嫩的涂鸦名字，旁边还按着一枚用亮色颜料印出的手印。每块牌子旁的泥土里，都冒出几簇嫩绿的小芽。你瞥见一堆被遗忘的杂物——沾满泥的移植铲、落单的手套、空空的种子袋。矮矮歪歪的公共水井旁，挤着一群小水桶，外加一个格外大的桶。 This small garden, with its messy edges and freshly fertilized odor, lies a short walk from the medical center and schoolhouse. A small square of the earth is cordoned off with a bit of twine, a large sign reading Bhavani stuck in the plot. The rest of the patch is claimed by a scattering of smaller signs, each featuring a name in childish scrawl and a handprint left in brightly colored paint. Little green sprigs spring up from the soil at each of the signs. You spy an assortment of forgotten items—a dirty trowel, a wayward glove, an empty seed pouch. At the squat and lopsided community well, a gaggle of small buckets accompany one large one.

Rainforest Hot Season.name:
雨林旱热季
Rainforest Hot Season

Text.text:
令人窒息的湿热空气，被雨林地面纠缠拥挤的灌木丛衬得更为难捱。地面覆着苔藓，湿滑难行，盘结的树根仿佛随时要绊倒毫无防备的冒险者。浓雾如坠地的云团，在林间悄然游移，将树冠遮得无影无踪。
The oppressively humid air is made worse by the cramped tangle of undergrowth on the rainforest floor. The ground is slippery with moss, and tree roots seem poised to trip unwary adventurers. Thick fog, like a cloud come to earth, slips among the trees and obscures the canopy from view.

Dragon Dance Of The Claw Style: Aú Sem M.name:
龙爪流派的龙之舞：Aú Sem Mão
Dragon Dance Of The Claw Style: Aú Sem Mão

Text.text:
仿佛你的四肢是飞旋轮盘的辐条，你倒转翻身，随即稳稳落地。你送出一记扇面般扫开的飞踢，接着掷骰般滚身再来一轮侧手翻——这一次只用一只手点地——然后仅凭一步侧移便横向翻跃，身躯在空中扭转，却不曾触碰任何东西——巨龙的灵感在你体内奔涌穿行。

~ 一位英雄 Envisioned

As if your limbs were the spokes of a flying wheel, you turn upside down, then land on your feet. You deliver a fanning kick, roll into another cartwheel with only one hand touching the ground, and then do a sideways flip from just a sidestep, in which you turn your body without touching a thing—the inspiration of the dragon courses through you.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

商人臃肿的尸体塞满了那辆破败的货车大半空间，几支箭矢仍深深插在他们的血肉里。手指上苍白的勒痕昭示着戒指曾经的存在，而你注意到他们的双脚竟赤裸无鞋。
The corpulent bulk of the merchant’s corpse fills most of their ruined wagon, with several arrows protruding from their flesh. Pallid bands around their fingers suggest the former presence of rings, and you notice the feet have no shoes.

权威之座由坚实的橡木制成，结构朴素。横在扶手上的长剑与倚靠其旁、作为追思的盾牌同样真实可触：沉重，且磨损得很深。它们仿佛被主人烙印得如此彻底，以至于能将他召回。他守着自己的厅堂——坐在此处，半透明而严峻——仿佛仅凭意志，维持着跨越数十年战争直至死亡的执念，他就能命令自己的身体重返有形。
The seat of authority is solid oak and simply built. The sword across its arms and the shield leaning against it in memoriam are equally tangible: heavy and well used. These things must be so possessed of their owner as to summon him. He tends his hall—seated here translucent, stern—as if by will alone, sustained through decades of warfare unto his death, he could command his body back to corporeality.

森林豁然断开，露出一片向两侧延展的宽阔空地。有人将灌木尽数砍除，较大的树木只剩下树桩，从残余的稀疏植被里突兀地伸出。造成这一切的缘由就在空地对面：层层交织的灌丛纠缠在树干之间，像用砍下的枝叶胡乱堆砌成的一道粗糙墙垣。你误闯进了一处近似森林堡垒的所在。
The forest breaks into a wide clearing that extends in both directions. Someone cut away the shrubs, and the stumps of larger trees poke out of what little vegetation remains. The reason for this lies just across the clearing. A tangle of interwoven brush runs between the trees, forming a rough wall of the cut foliage. You’ve stumbled upon something like a forest fortress.

Meeting A Faerie Lord.name:
觐见一位妖精领主
Meeting A Faerie Lord

Text.text:
那身影迈步向前，披着由星光纺就的长袍。他优雅地伸出一只手致意，指间戒环上凝着一滴清晨的新露，微光闪烁，脸上掠过一抹捉摸不定的笑意。某种直觉提醒你——别与他对视。
The figure steps forward, clad in robes of spun starlight. A drop of fresh morning dew glimmers on a ring on his finger as he gracefully extends a hand in greeting, flashing a capricious grin. Something tells you not to look him in the eye.

Death's Head Of Bhaal.name:
巴尔的死首
Death's Head Of Bhaal

Text.text:
阴影仿佛尾随着那具骷髅面容的身影自幽暗中潜行而出，如同阴险的同谋，替生物遮掩身形。它迅疾而致命地抽出锯齿匕首，空气随之沉滞；下一瞬，它纵身扑上发起攻击。
The shadows seem to follow the skull-visaged figure stalking from the gloom, like a sinister accomplice masking the creature’s form. Swiftly, and with lethal intent, the being draws jagged poniards, the air growing thick as it springs to attack.

Approaching An Overcrowded Village.name:
逼近一座拥挤不堪的村庄
Approaching An Overcrowded Village

Text.text:
从门外挤到城门上的人群，看起来与门内伸手回抓的人群并无二致。女人尖叫着找孩子，男人吼着行贿或讨价还价。村庄守卫被人群推搡，有时甚至被挤得动弹不得。有人帽子都被挤掉了。房屋与巷道显出超负荷的痕迹——晾衣绳上衣物翻了倍，街面糊着一层马粪，成群结队的污垢之人扎堆游荡。外头还支起一簇簇帐篷。集市摊位稀疏，价格荒唐得像在嘲笑人，而几乎每一笔交换都带着随时会见血的锋利气味。
The people crammed against the gate from the outside look the same as the ones reaching back through it from the inside. Women scream for children, and men shout bribes or bargains. Members of the village watch are jostled, sometimes pinned. One loses a hat. Houses and lanes show extra use and traffic—washing doubled on lines, streets coated with horse manure, large groups of the unwashed. There are clusters of tents. Market stalls are sparse, prices laughable, and nearly every exchange has an edge of violence.

谷仓大门敞开，露出几间隔栏——其中两间，马儿把脑袋探过半扇栏门——干草铺得低矮的阁楼、架上的马鞍，以及墙上挂满的鞍具。一个马厩女工走出来，抱着一圈绳索，朝茅草屋檐下那一排矮矮的露天栏位走去。其中一栏里，一匹高大的花斑母马嘶鸣着，用蹄子刨着地面。
The barn doors open to reveal several stalls—two with horses sticking their heads over the half-doors—a loft low on hay, saddles on stands, and tack on the walls. A stablegirl exits and carries a coil of rope toward a short row of outdoor stalls under a thatched roof. In one, a tall, dappled mare whinnies and paws the ground with her hoof.

Speech About Escaping Into A Life Of Adv.name:
关于逃离现实、投身冒险人生的演说
Speech About Escaping Into A Life Of Adventure

Text.text:
“做个体面的人，做个受人敬重的人，难道不是一场挣扎吗？我们得把每一道细微的目光、每一句赞许或轻蔑的话语都接住，再设法把它们编织成一种让他人觉得有用的性格。这是一份差事：令人沮丧、令人困惑的差事——以至于屠杀怪物都显得没那么费劲。”
“Is it not a struggle to be decent? To be respected? We have to take every subtle glance, and word of praise or scorn, and somehow weave them into a personality that others find useful. It was work: frustrating, confusing work—to the point where killing monsters seemed less demanding.”

Sundries From A Basilisk.name:
来自石化蜥蜴的杂项
Sundries From A Basilisk

Text.text:
被杀死的蜥蜴怪双眼黯淡空洞，再也构不成威胁。它的皮革虽坚韧，却在战斗中被撕裂得太过严重，已毫无用处。一条朴素的铁链松松地挂在它的脖颈上。
The slain basilisk’s eyes are dull and unseeing, no longer a threat. Its hide, though tough, is too badly damaged from the battle to be of any use. A simple iron chain hangs around its neck.

Neon-lit Metroplex Sprawl: Aerial View.name:
霓虹映照的巨型都市蔓延：鸟瞰
Neon-lit Metroplex Sprawl: Aerial View

Text.text:
在工业烟云的阴霾下，两座城市彼此交融，霓虹与钢铁激烈碰撞。摩天楼像篱墙般相互挤压，纠缠在一张空中高速的罗网里——飞车与仿生人穿梭不息，令这片天幕活了起来。炽烈的广告沿着楼体上下铺展，延伸数百英尺，在阴冷污浊的世界里兜售诱惑与分心之物。一个面孔被彩绘覆满的女人深吸一口长烟管。一个男人绷起肱二头肌，拳上套着噼啪作响的电弧臂铠。一幅巨大的全息影像中，红色汽水罐旋转翻飞，罐身凝露如珠，仿佛镶满碎钻。
Under a pall of industrial smoke clouds, two cities intermingle in a clash of neon and steel. Skyscrapers hedge against each other, entwined in a snare of air highways alive with the traffic of flying cars and androids. Blazing ads stretch hundreds of feet up and down the sides of buildings, offering enticement and distraction in a grim, polluted world. A woman with a fully painted face takes a drag off a long pipe. A man flexes his bicep, his fist adorned with a sparking gauntlet. A giant hologram of a red soda can twirls, bejeweled with condensation.

Druid's Wild Garden.name:
德鲁伊的野性花园
Druid's Wild Garden

Text.text:
花园铺满整片林间空地，繁茂的绿意席卷了整个空间。空气里弥漫着芬芳馥郁的花香。肥沃的黑土中，茎秆与藤蔓破土而出，蜿蜒穿行于园圃之间，追寻着水分与阳光。由枝条随手扎成的简易篱笆——更多是为了分区整理而非阻挡什么——将一块块地划分开来。你正注视着时，便看见有动物闯入花园，叼走它们的战利品，又带着收获悄然遁入野林之中。
The garden spans the entirety of the clearing, overtaking the space with greenery. The air is fragrant with perfumed blooms. Stalks and vines emerge from the rich earth, snaking their way through the garden in search of water and sunlight. Simple fences of branches, intended more for organization than to keep anything out, divide each plot. Even as you watch, you see animals enter the garden, take their spoils, and disappear with them into the wild.

Seedy Tavern: Gurgles & Gas.name:
肮脏酒馆：咕噜与臭气
Seedy Tavern: Gurgles & Gas

Text.text:
你在房间边缘找了个落脚点，立刻就后悔了。隔着你和茅厕的，只有一堵薄薄的夹泥编墙；墙上密密麻麻的孔洞，让你对另一侧正在发生的事一清二楚。尽管这位置臭气熏天，一桌酒鬼却依旧兴致勃勃地消磨他们的时代，似乎正在进行某种拼酒挑战。
You find a spot to stand at the edge of the room and immediately regret your choice. A thin wattle-and-daub wall is all that separates you from the latrines, the many holes giving you a very good idea of what’s happening on the other side. Despite the noisome position, a table of heavy drinkers happily whiles away their time, apparently engaged in some sort of drinking challenge.

Strath With River.name:
河畔斯特拉斯
Strath With River

Text.text:
河水注入一片宽阔、谷底平坦的山谷。在这里，它变得更宽，流速慢得几乎像在爬行，那不息的轰鸣也被压低成悦耳的潺潺细响。河流穿谷而过，两岸绿意葱茏投下阴凉，水流翻过被冲刷得圆润光滑的卵石。
The river empties into a wide, flat-bottomed valley. It widens here, slowing to a crawl, and its incessant roar is quieted to a pleasant trickle. Greenery shades the shores of the river as it cuts through the valley, rolling over stones smoothed by the current.

Dwarf Makes A Stand During Prison Break.name:
矮人在越狱混乱中挺身而出
Dwarf Makes A Stand During Prison Break

Text.text:
当矮人守夜般注视着朋友们奔向自由时，她的心情却在意识到这座监狱根本无路可逃的瞬间沉了下去。她在心底记下此刻结下的重重旧怨，转身迎向走廊尽头如雷般逼近的沉重脚步，抡起她的武器。守卫们满身劣酒酸臭，气势汹汹地闯进房间——而且连一杯也不递给她！账本上又添一笔新怨。

~ Naelynn 于 Discord

As the dwarf watches her friends run to freedom, her mood sours when she realizes there is no way out of the prison. Making a mental note of the numerous grudges formed in this moment, she turns to face the heavy footsteps thundering down the hall and hefts her weapon. The guards bluster into the room reeking of cheap alcohol—and they don't even offer her a cup! Another grudge in the book.

~ Naelynn on Discord

Wickwater Inn & Riverguard In Winter.name:
烛水旅店与冬日的河卫
Wickwater Inn & Riverguard In Winter

Text.text:
河卫哨站由那群披着黄外套的随从把守，步枪斜倚在肩，目光钉死在河面上。他们的情绪像刺骨的天气一样冷硬而肃穆。几步之外，旅店却形成鲜明对比：窗里盈满暖意与轻快。壁炉台上垂着花环，门上挂着一圈缀满浆果的花冠，里外皆然。厨房里飘来新煮咖啡的馥郁暖香。厨子对着一口大锅吹着口哨，一边搅动一边把切好的土豆、芜菁和其他耐寒的蔬菜一股脑倒进去。
The Riverguard station is manned by the retinue in their yellow coats, rifles leaning against their shoulders and eyes fixed on the river. Their mood is as cold and solemn as the chill weather. A few paces away, the inn is a stark contrast: windows brimming with warmth and levity. Garlands trail along mantels and a berried wreath adorns the door, both inside and out. From the kitchens wafts the cozy smell of freshly brewed coffee. A cook whistles over a large pot, stirring as they add cut potatoes, turnips and other hardy vegetables.

Sundries From A Red Dracolich.name:
来自红色龙巫妖的杂物
Sundries From A Red Dracolich

Text.text:
靠近那座巍然耸立的骸骨肋笼，你能感到有股能量从中翻涌——冰冷而病态的力量，或许仍可加以驾驭。这些骨骸也能被采集起来，日后用于打造阴毒却异常有效的器物。
Nearing the looming skeletal ribcage, you feel the energy seething from it—a cold and sickly power that might still be harnessed. These bones could be harvested for crafting nefariously effective items later on.

魔法中最复杂的法术之一——也伴随着最为惨烈的代价。然而，少有什么比生命更珍贵。你开始准备法术，小心而有目的地摆放每一件材料。此举将令一切重归正轨。此举将把他们带回你身边。仪式需要时代与专注。随着咒词愈发强盛，你周围的蜡烛忽明忽暗。越过这层生命帷幕的低语触及你的耳畔。阴影逼近，但你强行穿过。你触及并握住你所寻之人的手——他们会甘愿回来吗？会的，他们紧握你的手，随你而来。此刻他们就站在你面前，完整如初，尽数复归。
One of magic’s most complex spells—and with it, the steepest cost. But little is worth more than life. You prepare the spell, arranging the components carefully, purposefully. This will begin to set things right. This will return them to you. The ritual takes time and concentration. As the words grow in power, the candles around you flicker. Whispers reach your ears from beyond this veil of life. Shadows close in, but you push past them. You reach and grasp the hand of the one you seek—will they come willingly? Yes, they grip your hand and follow. And here they stand before you, restored in totality.

成团的泥土仍黏在觉醒灌木蜿蜒的根须上，像树枝上结出的果实般累累。它的根系如今被塑成纤维般的腿脚，让这株植物得以充分施展新获得的本领，像兴奋的小狗一样在你周围蹦跳撒欢。
Clumps of earth still cling to the twisting roots of the awakened shrub like fruit borne on the boughs of a tree. The root system, now sculpted into fibrous legs, allows the plant to make full use of its new abilities as it capers around you like an excited pup.

Highland Games, Sheaf Toss.name:
高地运动会：投草束
Highland Games, Sheaf Toss

Text.text:
很多人不把这算作高地竞技，因为它同样也是农活游戏，但其中的耗力一点也不逊色。把一捆小麦扎紧打包，或硬塞进粗麻袋里；投掷者将干草叉插入其中，前后摇晃蓄势，随后猛地一抖，将它从叉齿上掷飞。它越过三十多英尺高的横杆，划出一道凌厉的弧线。农夫们欢呼喝彩。创下纪录——也意味着这位大力士回到农场，还有更多活等着他干。
Many folks don’t consider this a highland game because it’s also a farm game, but the effort is no less intense. The sheaf of wheat is baled or stuffed into a burlap sack, the thrower sticks a pitchfork in it, rocks back and forth, then suddenly pitches it off the tines of the fork. It flies over a bar more than thirty feet above. The farmers cheer. A record—and more work on the farm to be done by the strongman.

Sundries From A Salamander.name:
蝾螈杂货铺
Sundries From A Salamander

Text.text:
即便死去，热浪仍在这头生物的皮肤上方起伏荡漾。手法娴熟的剥皮匠或许能从它蜿蜒的躯体上剥下鳞片，因为这些坚韧的甲片足以制成一套令人惊叹的护甲。
Heat waves undulate over the creature's hide even in death. A careful skinner might be able to shear the scales from its winding body, as the tough plates could make an impressive suit of armor.

Aberration Mounted As Trophy.name:
畸变怪战利品坐骑
Aberration Mounted As Trophy

Text.text:
你踏入酒馆时，一座骇人的战利品立刻攫住你的目光——那对玻璃眼珠以令人不安的清晰度盯着你。壁炉上方，一只被填充的异怪被钉在华丽的底座上，底座下嵌着一块擦得锃亮的铭牌。粗大、布满疣瘤的舌头懒洋洋地搭在生物那排细长的黄牙上，从一张与其球形躯体极不相称的巨口里耷拉垂落。几根眼柄以诡异的角度从怪物的紫色皮肉中突起——但有些并不完整。

~ 由 DM Roan构想

A hideous trophy draws your attention as you enter the tavern, its glass eyes watching you with unsettling clarity. Above the fireplace, a stuffed aberration has been mounted to an ornate base with a polished plaque beneath. A large, warty tongue lounges over the creature’s long, yellow teeth, tumbling from a mouth far too wide for its spherical body. Several eye stalks protrude at strange angles from the monster’s purple flesh—though some are not complete.

~ Envisioned by DM Roan

Ointment To Pierce Fey Glamours.name:
刺破妖精魅惑的药膏
Ointment To Pierce Fey Glamours

Text.text:
这只小罐常见于剧院化妆台，上面塞着一枚严丝合缝的塞子，末端连着一支小刷。罐中的药膏闪着细碎微光，黏稠发涩，几乎干到接触时不再沾手。你阖上双眼，用刷子轻轻掸过眼睑；待最后一抹落定，一股光潮猛然灌入，赐予你穿透迷障的目光。你捕捉到一枚咒印，循着仙灵工艺交织的纹路一路追踪，直至将幻象的帷幕拆解开来。
The jar is common to theater vanities, kept snug and secure with a stopper that ends in a brush. The ointment inside is glittery and tacky, nearly dry to the touch. You close your eyes and dust over your eyelids with the brush, and when you finish, a rush of light bestows on you a penetrating gaze. You spot a charm and follow the weavings of faerie craft until you unravel the veil of illusion.

Harsh Welcome Of A New Party Member.name:
新队友的严酷下马威
Harsh Welcome Of A New Party Member

Text.text: “欢迎加入团队。现在我知道，加入一个新团体——尤其是像我们这样声名在外的——可能会让人压力山大。你很容易成为自己最苛刻的批评者。但我想让你明白：我才是你最苛刻的批评者。我会在你清醒的每一刻盯着你、评判你，所以别把这事搞砸。” “Welcome to the team. Now, I know joining a new group, especially one as well-known as us, can be stressful. It can be easy to be your own worst critic. But I want to let you know that I am your worst critic. I will be watching and judging you at every waking moment, so don’t screw this up.”

Cultist Corpses.name:
邪教徒的尸体
Cultist Corpses

Text.text:
无论是死于自戕，还是被冒险者刀锋的迅疾报应所斩，那些披袍的邪教徒都已毙命，横七竖八地倒在洞窟里，堆作一团团尸堆。鲜血浸染着洞穴的石地，腥烈的铁锈恶气像恶魔的香水般笼罩着滞闷的空气。
Whether by their own hand or the swift retribution of an adventurer’s blade, the robe-clad cultists lie dead, sprawled about the cave in heaps. Blood bathes the stone floor of the cavern and a gory metallic miasma dominates the stale air like demonic perfume.

Veston, The Small But Mighty.name:
维斯顿——小个子，大能耐
Veston, The Small But Mighty

Text.text:
一阵悦耳的咕噜声宣告着最出人意料的英雄登场：一名小小的猫族猛地冲进聚集的人群中央。这只双足猫科矮得离谱，连矮人看了都显得高大；纤细的体型更衬出他脆弱的模样。可人群却在这一刻停住了，瞬间寂静，打量着这道渺小的身影。他的姜黄色皮毛光滑而浓密，棕色条纹如抛光木纹般流转；腹部绒毛蓬软，白得胜过雪花石膏。他穿着一件短款薰衣草色外套，与他那双大而富有情绪的眼睛相映；耳垂上一枚金色耳环，工艺与他喉间的项圈彼此呼应。

当人群回想起怒火，准备再次踏着步子冲撞前进时，猫族的尾巴轻轻一甩。他从背后抽出一把孩童用的尤克里里，在他爪中却像一把吉他般趁手，随即拨弦。人群再次被压得鸦雀无声，让音乐的魔法肆意滋长：柔软而绵延的音符铺展开来，与这生物高亢的嚎叫与约德尔式的转音相和。那声音抹去人群的暴怒——飞踢变成跺步，出拳化作友善的挥舞，舞动的冲动充满了整片人潮。

~ 由Ziv Played 并附

A melodious purring announces the most unlikely of heroes as a tiny catfolk bursts into the center of the gathered mob. The bipedal feline could make a dwarf look tall, a slender build compounding his fragile appearance. Yet the mob stops, going silent as they take stock of this diminutive figure. His ginger fur is sleek and thick, his brown striping like polished woodgrain, and the downy fur on his belly is whiter than alabaster. He wears a short lavender coat, which mirrors his large emotive eyes, and a golden earring crafted to match the collar at his throat.

As the mob remembers their anger and moves to renew their stampede, the catfolk’s tail flicks. He pulls from his back a child’s ukelele, which looks like a guitar in his paws, and begins to strum. The mob is once again struck silent, allowing the magic of music to burgeon: soft and stretching notes that harmonize with the creature’s yodeled yowls. The sound erases the mob’s rage. Kicking changes to stomping, punching to friendly flailing, as the need to dance fills the crowd.

~ Played by Ziv with

I Hide During A Bar Fight.name:
我在酒馆斗殴中藏身
I Hide During A Bar Fight

Text.text:
我朝酒馆最阴暗的角落扑去，钻向一张桌子，躲开挥来的肉拳与乱踹的脚。肋间一阵闷痛，我低吼出声——有人在我滚进那张浸透麦酒的桌底前，用擦边的一击蹭中了我。我被地板黏腻的触感逼得一滞，强忍翻涌的恶心干呕，贴着拳头、缠抱与猛推的缝隙穿行。我眼看酒杯在身旁呼啸飞过，敞口像张开的喉咙，泡沫在空中拖出一道白色尾迹。
I make for a table in the darkest corner of the bar, dodging meaty fists and kicking feet. I grunt as I feel a knock to my ribs, someone catching me with a glancing blow before I can throw myself under the safety of the ale-soaked tabletop. I balk at the stickiness of the floor, holding back a nauseous gag as I avoid the punches, the grapples, and the shoves. I watch as tankards fly by, froth streaming behind their gaping mouths.

Armor Of Vulnerability.name:
易伤护甲
Armor Of Vulnerability

Text.text:
这套板甲的胸甲上镶着一种怪异却精巧的饰纹。其上立着一名身披板甲的人形浮雕，而在那人四周，诸般武器以浮雕呈现为折断之状，仿佛尽数撞碎在穿戴者的护甲之上。你能看见这里一柄断矛，那里一根开裂的棍棒，甚至还有一把弯刀被劈成两截。浮雕中那位骑士的胸甲上，也有一幅相似的图案：另一位身穿板甲的骑士，周围环绕着不同的残破兵刃——只是到了那般体型，细节便渐渐模糊不清。
This plate armor bears an odd but artful adornment upon its breastplate. Upon it stands a figure dressed in plate armor, and around the person, various weapons have been embossed in broken state, as if shattered against the armor of the wearer. You see a broken spear here, a cracked club there, and even a scimitar sundered in two. The breastplate of the knight in the embossment bears a similar image: another knight in plate mail, surrounded by different broken weapons—but at that size, the details get fuzzy.

Darkened Bridge Over Cave Crevasse.name:
洞窟裂隙上方的昏暗石桥
Darkened Bridge Over Cave Crevasse

Text.text:
这座宽阔的石桥乍看浑然天成，但有人在石面上凿出阶梯，让桥身中段突兀的落差不至于难以应付。桥面有一段下沉了六码多英尺，随即在对岸猛然抬升。石桥两侧，裂谷深不见底地张开巨口，谷底尽被黑暗笼罩。
This broad bridge seems natural, but someone cuts steps from the stone to make a sudden drop in its middle height more manageable. A portion of the bridge dips down half a dozen feet before abruptly ascending again on the opposite side. On either side of the bridge, the crevasse yawns deeply, its bottom shrouded in darkness.

Ceremonial Display Of The Corpse Of A Go.name:
神祇遗骸的仪式陈列
Ceremonial Display Of The Corpse Of A God

Text.text:
