尸体仰卧在由大理石柱支撑的火葬柴堆之上；可当你登上去细看时，它却……只是一具尸体。一具类人尸身。眼前这具遗体虽不腐不坏，却在其余方面平凡得令人震惊。你知道这副躯壳曾容纳过神祇的灵魂，然而在他们从不朽坠落之际，却选择了这样的形貌：无毛，皮肤光滑，却再无任何显眼特征。它可以是任何人——或者，任何人都可能是伪装成凡人的神。
The corpse lies atop a funeral pyre supported by marble columns, yet after your ascent to view the body, it's… a body. A humanoid body. The corpse before you, though incorruptible, seems stunningly mundane otherwise. You know this shape once housed a deific soul, and yet in their fall from immortality, they chose the form: hairless, smooth-skinned, but otherwise nondescript. This could have been any person—or anyone could be a god in disguise.

Elemental Plane Of Fire.name:
火元素位面
Elemental Plane Of Fire

Text.text:
即便做足了防护，这里的灼热仍令人窒息，压迫而汹涌，仿佛来自异界。烈焰永无止境地咆哮，吞没所触之物，却偏偏不将其焚尽。空气稀薄，被浓烟噎住，在极致高温下泛起层层热浪；透过朦胧烟霭，你望见一片焦黑大地，熔岩之河如血脉般纵横其上，而你脚下的地面竟也仿佛缓慢流动的岩浆，悄然蠕移。万物——从灼痛的空气到赤红滚烫的岩石——都在向外辐射着热量。
Even with proper protection, the heat here is oppressive, overwhelming, otherworldly. The fire rages eternally, engulfing but not consuming all it touches. The air, thin and choked with smoke, ripples with the intense heat, and through the haze, you discover the charred landscape veined with molten rivers, and in fact, even the ground beneath your feet seems to shift like a slow-moving lava flow. Everything—from the blistering air to the red-hot stone—radiates heat.

Schorra Ravenswood, Wood-elf Assassin.name:
肖拉·渡鸦林，木精灵刺客
Schorra Ravenswood, Wood-elf Assassin

Text.text:
木精灵身披低调的米色与黑色，在猎物上方的椽梁间如猫般优雅穿行。到了最佳位置，她无声坠下，烛光里绿眸闪亮，双手各握一把匕首。目标尚未反应，两道寒光已划过他的喉咙——紧随其后的是一蓬猩红飞溅。刺客在尸体落地之前便已消失无踪。
The wood elf is clad in muted tones of beige and black, moving with feline grace in the rafters above her prey. At the ideal spot she drops silently, green eyes shining in the candle-light, a dagger in each hand. Before the target can react, those daggers are drawn across his neck—quickly followed by a spray of crimson. The assassin disappears before the corpse hits the ground.

这传说中的鸟儿，体型可小如鸽、亦可大似信天翁；而眼前这一只，像一只被点燃的乌鸦。她双翼与脊背鲜红夺目，腹下色泽更黯，尾羽与躯体上则铺陈着斑驳的橙与红。她振翅梳羽时，细灰便轻轻飘落四周；她的利爪落在你伸出的手臂上，竟带着暖意。认识她，就像在等待与疑惑中守望——守望那令人惊诧的一日，她将诞下自己。
While this bird of legend varies from as small as a dove to as large as an albatross, this one seems a crow ignited. She is bright red in the wings and along the back, duller beneath, and variegated oranges and reds over tail and body. When she flaps and grooms, ash falls lightly around her, and her talons warm an outstretched arm. To know her is to wait and wonder for the surprising day when she gives birth to herself.

门旁，用一串令人困惑的密文潦草涂写着一组毫无意义的符号组合。对大多数人而言不过是一团乱麻，可这些象形图却传递着一则隐秘的警告。

~ 由 David 在 Discord 上 构想

Beside the gate, scrawled in a baffling cipher, is a combination of nonsensical symbols. Little more than a jumble to most, these pictograms convey a hidden message of warning.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Subterranean Stairs Leading Down.name:
通往地下的下行阶梯
Subterranean Stairs Leading Down

Text.text:
尽管你自以为早已适应地下的昏暗，可当你望见更下方那片彻底的漆黑时，仍不由得心头一紧。眼前的阶梯一路向下，沉入你仅凭目光无法穿透的阴影之中——四周湿热黏腻，却更令人不安：竟还有比此处更像坟穴、更令人窒息的所在。想知道下方藏着什么，你只能亲自将它一点点揭开：一级接一级，一步接一步，一只脚跟着另一只脚。
Though you thought yourself well-adapted to the gloom of the underground, you are momentarily alarmed when you see the absolute blackness of what lies below even that. For the staircase before you leads down into shadows that you cannot penetrate with sight alone—and for all the dank warmth of your surroundings, it is unsettling to imagine that there is a place even more tomblike and stifling than this. To find out what lies below, you must uncover it for yourself, step after step, one foot after the other.

这种幻象会伪装成任意款式、任意品牌的主机外观，但没有可用图标，也没有数据存储功能。它既能骗过 ICE，也能骗过任何血肉驱动的人格。这个外壳确实有保质期，但足以运转到让几个人忙得团团转，而你则趁机记录下几组精挑细选的密码。
This illusion appears as a host of any design and brand, but without functional icons or data storage. It can fool ICE as well as it can fool any meat-driven persona. The shell does have a shelf life, but it can function long enough to make some people busy while you keylog some choice passwords.

通往此地的旅程艰辛无比，你在刺骨的苔原上苦行数日——然而此刻，即便目的地已近在眼前，你心中仍没有半分宽慰。冰封洞穴的入口像某头被埋葬的巨兽张开的巨口般豁然敞开；当你跨过那道界限时，不由得觉得自己正踏入它的咽喉，甘愿被其吞下。冰锥自洞顶与地面一并刺出，宛如参差獠牙与突兀巨牙。洞口处散落着一堆刚刚熄灭的营火残迹，杂乱的足迹则一路延伸，通向更深处的寒冽黑暗。

~ 构想：The Martian Knight

The journey here was arduous, a grueling trek across the bitter tundra for days on end—and yet now, even with your destination in sight, you feel no sense of relief. The mouth of the frozen cave yawns open like the maw of some great, buried beast, and as you pass the threshold, you cannot help but feel as though you stride into its gullet, willingly swallowed. Icicles jut from both the ceiling and floor, evoking jagged teeth and jutting tusks. The remains of a recently extinguished campfire lie at the mouth of the cavern, with many tracks leading deeper into the frigid darkness.

~ Envisioned by The Martian Knight

Alcohol-addled Punk Rock Show.name:
酒精上头的朋克摇滚演出
Alcohol-addled Punk Rock Show

Text.text:
乐队在整场演出中一杯接一杯地灌下去，等到最后一首歌在一片凌乱中草草收场时，他们看起来已经准备踉跄着走下阶段。然而观众似乎也跟着他们的节奏狂饮，此刻却反而爆发出更汹涌的欢呼与尖叫，齐声要求返场。
The band downed a steady stream of drinks throughout the concert and they look ready to stumble off the stage when their last song comes to a sloppy end. But the crowd must have been matching their intake, since they start cheering and screaming for an encore.

你站在这棵森林巨木的顶端，视野越过一片叶海无边无际。风掠过树冠，拂起沙沙的浪潮，更添你漂浮在翠绿海面之上的错觉——下方生命翻涌，生机汹涌。身后，树干上一处拱穹般的开口豁然张开，如同深渊之口，许诺揭示这座触及苍穹的神殿所珍藏的神圣秘辛。
Your view from atop this forest giant looks out over an ocean of leaves. The wind makes susurrus waves of the treetops, furthering the impression that you float above a green sea, teeming with life. A vaulted opening in the tree’s trunk yawns behind you, promising to reveal the holy secrets of this temple that touches the heavens.

类人生物的血肉腐烂成破布般挂在脆裂的白骨上，可他们依旧挺立如松、强健有力——奥术能量在空洞的眼眶深处燃烧。破碎霉烂的长袍披在他们瘦削的骸骨之躯上，其上烙印着玄奥的异界符号，仿佛以压抑的力量低低嗡鸣。这名不死术士至今仍在侍奉其宗主，无法休息——不是现在，也永远不能。只要宗主仍需要他们的奴役。那副如骷髅般的面容以沙哑声吐出蛛丝般的远古咒词，而在他们的掌间，能量正凝聚成形。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

The humanoid’s flesh hangs in rotting tatters from brittle bones, yet they stand tall and strong, arcane energy burning in the hollow pits of their eye sockets. Torn, moldering robes drape their gaunt, skeletal form, emblazoned with eldritch symbols that seem to hum with subdued power. The undead warlock, even now serving their patron, cannot rest—not now, not ever. Not while their patron requires their servitude. The skull-like visage rasps spidery words of ancient power, and in their hands energy coalesces.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

蘑菇围成一圈，将中央空出，用陈旧的死亡滋养新生的青绿草芽。每一顶滑稽的灰白菌盖微微倾斜，都显得诡异而庄重，像司祭般带着仪式性的目的。菌环周围的空气充满令人脊背发麻的诱惑与潮湿的寒意，灵韵浓熟，泥土般的细语窃窃低吟，透着好奇而探询的意图。
The mushrooms form their circle, leaving the center to feed the new, green grass with old death. Each slight tilt of a funny off-white cap seems weirdly grave, priestly with ceremonial purpose. The air around the ring is full of spine-tingling temptation and humid chill, ripe with aura and earthy little whispers of curious intent.

Loot From A Gorgon.name:
石化蜥蜴的战利品
Loot From A Gorgon

Text.text:
覆盖这头公牛的厚实甲皮硬得像护甲一样，铁匠甚至能将其锻造成一套令人惊叹的板甲。更难得的是，它还隐隐散发着某种守护性的魔法。
The plated hide that covers this bull is enough like armor that a smith could forge it into an impressive suit of plate mail. An added value is that it exudes some kind of protective magic.

Return To Childhood Home.name:
重返童年故居
Return To Childhood Home

Text.text:
你转过魔宠般熟悉的道路最后一个弯，童年的家映入眼帘。风向一转，从古老小屋敞开的窗里捎来现烤派的香气。暮色轻吻，天幕渐暗；当你叩响那扇箍着铁带的木门时，第一颗星已悄然亮起。饱含喜悦泪光的慈爱目光迎上来，你被温暖而令人心安的拥抱紧紧包裹。

~ 构想：Cheese

You round the last bend in the familiar road and see your childhood home. The wind shifts, carrying the scent of a homemade pie from the open window of the ancient cottage. The kiss of twilight darkens the sky above and the first stars begin to appear as you knock on the banded wooden door. Loving eyes brimming with joyful tears greet you, and you are enveloped in a comforting embrace.

~ Envisioned by Cheese

Sundries From A Wererat.name:
狼人鼠的杂货
Sundries From A Wererat

Text.text:
这生物的牙齿咯咯打颤，肌肉在临死的痉挛中抽动，随后便一动不动地躺下，鲜血在它身下缓缓汇成一滩。你在那瘦骨嶙峋、毛发蓬乱的躯体上几乎找不到什么值钱的东西，除了一个幸运兔脚——斑驳的灰色皮毛被污水与血迹厚厚地黏成一团。
The creature’s teeth chatter as its muscles spasm in death throes before it lies still, blood pooling slowly around it. On the scrawny, hirsute body you find little of value, save a lucky rabbit's foot, the mottled gray fur matted heavily with sewage and blood.

两名骑士都被板甲严严实实地包裹着，俯身贴在战马覆甲的脖颈上，华丽的饰羽在风中猎猎翻飞。他们相遇的瞬间，是钢铁相撞与木杆迸裂交织成的雷霆尖啸。断裂的长枪爆炸般喷吐碎屑，劈头盖脸砸向观众，人群忙不迭抬手遮挡面庞。对手们策马继续冲过，其中一人却在鞍上摇摇欲坠。
Both knights are encased in plate and crouched over their horses’ armored necks, elaborate crests flapping in the wind. Their meeting is a thunderous scream of colliding steel and splintering wood. The crowd, pelted by the detritus exploding from the shattered lances, tries to protect their faces. The opponents gallop on, one of them swaying in the saddle.

Hiding In Cyberspace.name:
潜伏于赛博空间
Hiding In Cyberspace

Text.text:
后颈处一阵冰冷刺痒的战栗感让你立刻警觉。是时候在网域里找个阴影重重的藏身处了。轻轻一记接触，狡黠地一转向，再后退一步，你融入干扰的洪流，化作不可侦测的虚无。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

A chilling, prickly sensation at the back of your neck puts you on alert. Time to find some shadowy hiding place in the Net. With a light touch, a sly redirect, and a step backward, you fade into a stream of interference, vanishing into undetectability.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Speeding Car Blows Through Stoplight.name:
飞驰的轿车闯过红灯
Speeding Car Blows Through Stoplight

Text.text:
红灯骤然亮起，原本急着过街的人群惊惶倒退，只见一道银色残影从他们脚前几尺处倏然掠过。怒骂与惊叫盖过城市的喧嚣，可那辆无窗的车早已冲出两个街区。霓虹广告牌的光幕铺天盖地，司机没看清信号灯的变化，几乎让人都难以苛责。
The stoplight turns red, and those that were eager to cross jump back frantically as a silver blur flashes just a few feet in front of them. Shouts and curses rise above the urban din, but the windowless car is already two blocks away. It's almost hard to blame the driver for missing the light's change against the walls of neon billboards.

长而沉重，锋利得骇人，这柄长枪仿佛只为一个目的而生：向前推进，将挡路的一切尽数贯穿、撕裂。木质枪杆高逾数人，顶端装着一枚巨大的锥形枪尖，旁侧还嵌着一根冷硬如钉的倒刺。
Long, hefty, and incredibly sharp, the pike seems to have but one purpose: driving forward and dismantling all in its way. The wooden shaft, standing as tall as several men, is capped by a large, tapered tip and a harsh spike-like barb.

The Evernight Bazaar.name:
永夜集市
The Evernight Bazaar

Text.text:
地下城如同一桶秽物倾倒后四散铺开，楼宇皆由半腐的船体与海中打捞的残骸拼凑而成；它们彼此相连，靠的是一张令人眩晕的绳桥与摇摇欲坠的脚手架之网。某头巨大而久已死去的海兽肋骨高耸在这座破烂城上方，而它张开的巨口则给予通往外海的许可。更高处，洞窟穹顶上隐隐发光的地衣织出一层星光般的幻象，将诡异的光洒在永夜集市的巷道与桥梁之上。

~ 由 Smoking Bards 的 Azrael Azazel 构想

The subterranean city sprawls like a spilled bucket of detritus, its buildings composed of half-rotted ship hulls and sea salvage, connected to one another by a maddening network of rope bridges and rickety scaffolding. The rib cage of some massive, long-dead leviathan towers over the ramshackle city, while its gaping maw grants access to the sea beyond. High above, subtly glowing lichen across the cavern’s ceiling grants an illusion of starlight, shedding its strange light across the alleyways and bridges of the Evernight Bazaar.

~ Envisioned by Azrael Azazel of the Smoking Bards

Paladin's Prayer Answered With Divine In.name:
圣武士的祈祷得神圣干预回应
Paladin's Prayer Answered With Divine Intervention

Text.text:
鲜血与汗水灼痛她疲惫的双眼，圣武士凝望着眼前的满目疮痍——干裂的唇间逸出最后的祈祷。她的哀恸以震撼的方式得到回应：圣歌合唱充盈空气，一道璀璨光柱自天而降，笼罩她历战的身躯，将神圣之力灌入骨髓。双目燃起刺目的光焰，她在圣火的剪影中挺身而立，举剑指向瑟缩的敌人。

~ Envisioned by Lord of Light

Blood and sweat burn her weary eyes as the paladin looks out on the devastation before her—and a final prayer escapes her dry, cracked lips. Her lamentation is answered in spectacular fashion: a choral song fills the air, with a column of radiant light descending upon her battle-weary form and filling her with divine power. Eyes aflame with blinding light, she stands, silhouetted by holy fire, and raises a sword to her cowering foes.

~ Envisioned by Lord of Light

邪异魔法散发出病态的绿光，映亮这名恶魔战士——一具除钻石般坚硬的肌肉与沸腾的憎恨外别无他物的存在。四条强壮的手臂自这位高耸骑士的躯干生出，每一条都被用于致命的武技。空洞的双眼燃着猩红光芒——再加上一张参差裂开的巨口——令这生物宛如一盏南瓜灯，头顶还冠着两支巨大、向后弯扫的长角。
The sickly green glow of fiendish magic illuminates the demonic warrior, a being composed of naught but diamond-hard muscle and seething hatred. Four mighty arms sprout from the torso of the towering knight, each one put to deadly martial use. Hollow eyes burning with red light—and a jagged maw—give the creature the impression of a jack-o’-lantern capped by two large swept-back horns.

Large Flock Of Birds Flying Overhead.name:
一大群飞鸟自头顶掠过
Large Flock Of Birds Flying Overhead

Text.text:
出乎意料地嘈杂，数十对翅膀的拍击声一瞬间盖过了你环境中的一切声响。你抬头望去，只见一大群长羽的鸟类从头顶掠过，仿佛融为一体般迁飞而行。或许只有精通野生动物习性的行家，才能解释它们为何会如此大规模迁徙。
Surprisingly loud, the flapping of dozens of wings momentarily drowns out the noise of your environment. You look up to see a large flock of feathered fowl passing overhead, traveling as one. Perhaps an expert in wildlife behaviors can explain their mass migration.

Ranger's Speech Of Self-affirmation.name:
游侠的自我肯定宣言
Ranger's Speech Of Self-affirmation

Text.text:
“别对你将直面的野兽惊叹。别去琢磨它们何等庞大，名声何等凶残。想象力是一切恐惧的根源，而恐惧这种情绪，你无处容纳。每个敌人都一样：一个问题。随着你步步追踪、找出每一处弱点，你就离解决它更近一步。”
“Do not marvel at the beasts you face. Do not wonder at their enormity or ferocious reputation. Imagination is the root of all fear, and fear is an emotion you do not have room for. Each foe is the same: a problem. With each step tracked and each weakness found, you grow one step closer to solving it.”

这座小镇虽铺展在荒漠旷野之上，却依旧忙得像一座蚁丘。开拓者们被艰苦的边境生活磨砺得筋骨硬朗，在木板人行道上彼此招呼。套着叮当作响挽具的驮马踏着泥泞车辙的土路前行，摇摇晃晃的货车拖着货物赶往集市。风里卷起的尘土与火车站升腾的烟雾交织，一声尖利的汽笛宣告列车进站，带来煤、木材与砖块——扩张这座日益膨胀的淘金热城镇所需的原始材料。

~ 由 Kyle F. 构想

The town is as busy as an anthill despite its sprawl across the desert wilderness. Pioneering folk, toughened by hard frontier living, greet one another on the boardwalks. Cart horses in jangling harnesses tramp down the muddy, rutted dirt roads, lugging goods to market in their lurching wagons. Dust swirling on the wind mingles with smoke from the railway station, where a shrilling train whistle heralds the arrival of coal, timber, and brick—the raw materials needed to expand the ever-growing boomtown.

~ Envisioned by Kyle F.

Lodge Manor: Outside.name:
洛奇庄园：室外
Lodge Manor: Outside

Text.text:
一条铺着鹅卵石的小径穿过高耸的冷杉与虬结、参天的橡树，通向宅邸前不远处的一处环形回车道。宅邸外墙由粗凿石块砌成，灰浆填缝，立面开满窗户；上层楼的深色木百叶窗敞开着。下层窗户外侧加装了带钩的锻铁栅栏，百叶窗则向内开启。常春藤覆满大片墙面，攀绕在正门周围——那扇橡木门以黑铁箍束——并沿着雕刻石门套与拱形横窗的边框疯长。入口两侧，繁复的金属挂钩从叶影间探出，吊着铁制灯笼。藤蔓继续往上爬，越过狭窄的檐口，爬上折线屋顶，最终在红陶瓦上渐渐稀疏，从未触及陡峭斜坡屋面上开启的窗户。数根石烟囱刺破上方的斜坡，暗示屋内有壁炉燃烧。

~ Envisioned by Baron de Ropp

A cobbled path leads through tall firs and gnarled, towering oaks to a roundabout just short of the manor house. Rough-hewn, mortared stone forms the manor’s many-windowed exterior, and shutters of dark-stained wood stand open on the upper floors. Bars of hooked wrought iron protect lower windows, whose shutters open inward. Ivy covers large expanses of the walls and surrounds the front door—oak banded in black iron—growing on the carved stone casing and arched transom. Iron lanterns hang on ornate metal hooks poking through the foliage on either side of the entry. Vines creep higher, over the narrow eaves and onto the mansard roof, where they dwindle on tiles of red clay, never reaching the windows that open in the steep roof’s slope. Several stone chimneys pierce the upper incline, hinting at fireplaces within.

~ Envisioned by Baron de Ropp

Deep Gnome With Ruby.name:
镶嵌红宝石的深地侏儒
Deep Gnome With Ruby

Text.text:
细小的红眼映出侏儒那双黝黑、布满老茧的手里捧着的巨大红宝石，妖异的光泽漫过他宽阔的面庞。一把保养得极其精良的鹤嘴镐随意搭在他的肩上。尽管他衣着不多，身上的衣物却皆为坚韧皮革制成，因繁重劳作而布满凹痕与擦伤。
Beady red eyes reflect the huge ruby cradled in the gnome’s dark, calloused hands, and a lurid glow suffuses his broad face. An expertly maintained pickaxe rests casually on his shoulder. Though he wears little, his clothes are made of hardy leather, pitted and scuffed from intense labor.

Sundries From A Rakshasa.name:
罗刹（特征）的杂物
Sundries From A Rakshasa

Text.text:
它身上那袭丝绸长袍染着深邃的宝石色泽，如翡翠与紫水晶般华贵——若不是鲜血正从布料间渗出，本该是一件战利品。你搜查尸身，果然翻出一只装着干燥绿色草药的小金属盒，以及一支烟斗：烟嘴蜿蜒盘曲。
Its silken robes, dyed in deep jewel tones of jade and amethyst, would be a prize if not for the blood seeping through them. Searching the body, you do come across a small metal box of dried green herbs and a pipe with a twisting mouthpiece.

Loot From A Young Bronze Dragon.name:
来自幼年青铜龙的战利品
Loot From A Young Bronze Dragon

Text.text:
滴水声充满这座宽阔的海岸洞窟，厚重的石灰岩洞壁将海浪的咆哮压成低沉的回响。你们在一处小室里发现了一笔军事珍藏的财富——以及一艘船的船首像——被巧妙地陈列成一座小型展馆。墙边竖着一排排护甲与武器的架子，但每一件在工艺与风格上都各具一格。那船首像上的美人鱼面容冷峻，仿佛正守夜般俯瞰大厅；她的木质双眼在昏暗光照中柔和地发亮。光滑石壁凿出的壁龛里，结实的木箱整齐成对地排列，箱中钱币满溢，像沉默的卫兵般守着这处宝藏。整批收获约值5000枚金币。
The sound of dripping water fills the spacious coastal cave, the roar of the waves dulled by the thick limestone walls. In a small chamber, you find a wealth of military treasures—as well as a ship's figurehead—artfully arranged into a small exhibition. Racks of armor and weapons line the walls, though each seems unique in its craft and style. The stern visage of a mermaid watches over the hall from the ship's figurehead, her wooden eyes glowing softly in the dim light. Symmetrical rows of sturdy wooden chests, overflowing with coins, stand guard in alcoves carved into the smooth stone. The entire haul is worth around 5000 gold pieces.

Bar Catering To Mercenaries.name:
酒吧：雇佣兵专供餐饮
Bar Catering To Mercenaries

Text.text:
一具尸体被人从酒吧正面的巨大窗户里猛掷出来，倒霉的受害者摊倒在地，身下的血泊迅速蔓延扩大。屋内先爆出一阵喝彩——随后客人们又继续他们喧闹粗野的消遣——仿佛这种事在这里早已司空见惯。
A body is hurled through the large window at the front of the bar, leaving the unfortunate victim sprawled in a rapidly growing pool of blood. A cheer from inside—followed by the patrons resuming their raucous entertainment—suggests this sort of thing happens a lot here.

Loot From A Wereboar.name:
来自狼人野猪的战利品
Loot From A Wereboar

Text.text:
在狼人松散磨损的皮带上，你发现了一只装着钱币的小袋子。尽管满是污垢，这16枚银币依然值钱。
On a fraying leather belt about the lycanthrope’s waist you find a small pouch of coins. Though covered in grime, the 16 silver pieces still have worth.

A Snowperson Appears.name:
雪人现身
A Snowperson Appears

Text.text:
轻柔的风捎来新雪的清冽气息。它贴地回旋，搅动才落下的雪片，将更多雪花卷起抛向空中。裹挟着愈来愈多的雪，风势渐缓，却在原地打着旋儿。雪从中心向外凝成雪球，一颗颗滚圆成形。它们彼此相接时，竟拼合出类人的轮廓。风又巧手般安放细枝与碎石，点作五官，伸作双臂。银光一闪。雪人眨了眨眼，露出笑意，那些线条与神情骤然鲜活得近乎真实。

~ newgen构想

The gentle wind carries the scent of fresh snow. It swirls along the ground, stirring the newly fallen flakes and carrying more and more aloft. Gathering more snow, the gust slows and spins in place. It forms balls from the center out. When they connect, the balls take on a humanoid shape. The wind deftly places twigs and stones to represent facial features and arms. Silvery light flashes. The snowperson blinks and smiles, their features suddenly very real.

~ Envisioned by newgen

最先扑面而来的是那股气味：野兽麝香的辛辣，混杂着毛发、雪与汗的味道。它是为寒冬而生的巨兽——高达十五英尺，头顶一圈骨质巨角，如野猪般的人形生物用它的三条腿之一刨着地面。它的存在本身便散发着力量。然而，它的神情里又带着一份庄严的高贵。一阵敬畏感如同冬霜铺展的薄幕，悄然席卷你全身。
The smell hits you first: the tang of an animal musk, mixed with hair and snow and sweat. A behemoth built for the cold: fifteen feet tall with a crown of bone horns, this boar-like humanoid paws the ground with one of its three legs. Its very being radiates strength. And yet, there is a nobility in its countenance. A sense of awe sweeps across you like a sheet of winter frost.

一只如小飞蛾般的外星生物急促爬行向前，前方两肢紧紧抱着一把轨道枪。它身后拖着一团细尘云，由一对淡紫色的翅膀抖落而出，翅面点缀着繁复精致的纹样。那昆虫般的头颅上，长着两只鼓胀的眼睛，颜色如同空间般深邃，位置略低于一对羽状触角。它的姿态带着一种鲜明的骄傲：昂着头、挺起肩，护甲被擦拭得锃亮如镜，闪着唾洗般的光泽。
A small mothlike alien scuttles forward, clutching a rail gun in its front two limbs. A cloud of fine dust follows it, scattered from a pair of lilac wings spotted with intricate markings. Bulbous eyes the color of space sit in the insectoid’s head, slightly below a pair of feathery antennae. It bears itself with a distinctive pride: head up, shoulders back, armor polished to a spit-shine shimmer.

Aged Cave Portico Shrouded In Shadow.name:
暮岁洞窟门廊，幽影笼罩
Aged Cave Portico Shrouded In Shadow

Text.text:
在沿着这座嵌入峡谷峭壁的建筑立面垂落的凌乱地衣丝缕之下，一道人工拱门赫然显现，通向黑暗。尽管庭院早已沦为废墟，这座门廊却依然坚固完整。也许它本就为长久而建……又或许，里面仍有人居住。
Beneath the untidy strands of lichen slipping down the façade of the structure, built into the very canyon walls, lies a manmade archway leading into darkness. This portico stands strong and whole despite the courtyard having fallen into ruin. Perhaps it was built to last… or perhaps inhabitants still dwell within.

宽阔的鹅卵石街道干净利落地延伸在两条人行道之间，人行道以黑白相间的图样铺就。街区里的每一栋建筑都带着某种组合：彩绘玻璃窗、雕饰立柱、大理石台阶、色彩明艳的门扉，或是一位神情刻板的门房。你走过的每一条街都大抵如此。炫目的财富铺陈在眼前，让你不由得局促起来——果然，你看见几个衣着考究的人一边忙着自己的事，一边斜眼打量着你。
The wide cobbled streets run cleanly between two sidewalks tiled in pattens of black and white. Every building on the block bears some combination of stained-glass windows, decorated pillars, marble steps, a brightly painted door, or an officious doorman. And every street you’ve passed looks something like this. So much wealth is on display it makes you self-conscious—and indeed, you see a few well-dressed people glancing at you sideways as they go about their business.

Divine Grove Of A Goddess Of Forests.name:
森林女神的神圣林苑
Divine Grove Of A Goddess Of Forests

Text.text:
森林中最神圣的所在，不是矗立的石阵，不是黑暗祭司团的祭坛，甚至也不是流浪者的休息之地。它们在那些鸟巢安然无虞、掠食者腹中亦已饱足的地方；在那些树木不必担忧被伐倒、除非败于年代或藤蔓的腐蚀的地方；在那些河流清澈见底，水里或涌动着振奋，或沉淀着睡意的地方。某处林间幽 grove——汇聚森林万象的会所——有一汪由泉水滋养的池潭，水面浮着睡莲。深吸一口气，侧耳倾听，你将听见她那首警示之歌。
The holiest places of the forest are not the standing stone circles, not the altars of dark priesthoods, nor even vagabond resting places. They are where bird nests are safe but predators' bellies are full, where trees are in no danger of being felled except by age or the corruption of vines, where the rivers are pure and full of either invigoration or sleep. In one grove, the meeting place of every kind of forest, is a spring-fed pool, water lilies on the surface. Breathe deeply and listen, and you will hear her song of warning.

Forgotten Laboratory.name:
被遗忘的实验室
Forgotten Laboratory

Text.text:
这间被遗忘的实验室寂静如坟，早已停摆数十年。厚重的污垢与蛛网几乎覆满每一寸表面，唯有一张长桌例外——其上的防尘布显然不久前才被人扯下。桌面上，烧杯、蒸馏器与瓶罐尽皆空空，只剩斑驳污渍与霉斑残留。地板上，靠近一张半腐烂的书桌，散落着各式纸张与笔记，显然被人草草翻找后随手丢弃，透着一股漫不经心的轻蔑。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The forgotten laboratory, as silent as a tomb, has lain inoperative for decades. Thick layers of grime and cobwebs cover nearly every surface, except for a long table where a dust sheet has clearly been recently removed. Atop its expanse, beakers, alembics, and flasks are empty save for stains and patches of mold. Scattered along the floor near a half-rotted desk, various papers and notes have been rifled through and discarded with an air of disregard.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这座巨大的木制居所盘踞在参天大树的枝桠间，紧贴树冠下方，俯瞰一切。它宽敞得足以容纳一家人，结构精巧而坚固，门窗处垂挂着兽皮帘幕，用以遮挡风雨与窥视。旁侧一座木质平台——仅容一人立足——钉固在一根粗壮得近乎浑圆的巨枝上，并以编织的植物纤维紧紧捆束；这些纤维也充当升降机的绞索机关，用来将平台升起或放下。
The large wooden dwelling dominates the branches of the huge tree it resides in, just below the canopy. Large enough for an entire family, the treehouse is well constructed and sturdy, with hide flaps being used to shield the door and windows. A wooden platform—just big enough for one person—is affixed to an enormously rotund branch and bound together by woven plant fibers which act as the mechanism to raise and lower the elevator.

Warning From Seafolk.name:
来自海民的警告
Warning From Seafolk

Text.text:
“你们来到我们的海上，寻美逐利，却对她的法则一无所知。你们那艘漏水的破船亵渎了她。她不容你们占有，她深处的秘密也不该由你们知晓。”
“You come to our sea seeking beauty and fortune but understand nothing of her ways. Your leaky craft offends her. She is not yours to claim, and the secrets of her depths are not yours to know.”

Ivy Ptah-sokev.name:
常春藤·普塔赫-索凯夫
Ivy Ptah-sokev

Text.text:
一位半精灵女子，长长的赤褐色头发如瀑垂落，深蓝的眼眸沉静而锐利，昂首挺胸。她带着一种从容不迫的自信与几分不容置疑的威势。长弓斜背在身后，身上是一套保养得极好的铆钉皮甲。胸甲上烙印着一轮明月的图案。

~ 由一位英雄 扮演，其

A half-elf woman with long auburn hair and deep blue eyes holds her head high. She has an air of easy confidence and some authority. A longbow is strapped to her back and she wears a suit of well-maintained studded leather. Stamped upon her chest-piece is the image of a moon.

~ Played by a Hero with

Loot From An Ogre Gladiator.name:
食人魔角斗士的战利品
Loot From An Ogre Gladiator

Text.text:
流苏头盔从食人魔头上翻滚坠落，顶端的羽饰是油腻的秃鹫翎羽混着疑似狮鬃的毛束。死亡抽走了它四肢的所有力气，它的手也随之松开战斧；那对黑钢斧刃仍沾着血污，寒光森然——一件上好的武器，或许是它主人赏赐给它的战利品。它身上没有装钱的袋子，但它惯用的那条手臂上缠满金项链，被食人魔的负载般粗壮臂膀挤压变形，竟像一圈圈金手镯。
The fringed helm tumbles off the ogre’s head, the feathers atop it a mix of greasy vulture plumes and what could be tufts of lions’ manes. It releases the battleaxe from its grip as death takes all vigor from its limbs, the pair of black steel blades still gleaming with gore—a fine weapon, perhaps a spoil delivered to it by its master. It carries no pouch of coin, but its dominant arm is laced with necklaces of gold turned into bracelets by the ogre’s bulk.

Quip About Cheering Up.name:
关于打起精神的俏皮话
Quip About Cheering Up

Text.text:
“哦，振作点。你那张脸总是绷得那么死，我都怕你哪天把什么东西给憋爆了。”
“Oh, cheer up. Your face is always so twisted in that stern look I’m afraid you’re going to pop something.”

路旁，一根结实的立柱顶端横架着梁木，梁上以钩与铁链吊着四具囚笼绞架。每一具都是圆顶铁笼，下方另分出两只更小的笼格，将双腿分别锁住。两具绞架空空荡荡，在风里摇晃，铁链叮当作响、吱呀尖鸣。第三具里关着一具骷髅（特征），全靠破烂衣布与残余筋腱勉强串在一起。第四具里蜷着一名男子，黑发黑须蓬乱肮脏，与他污渍斑斑的破布衣衫一般不堪；他赤裸的脚掌被割得血肉模糊。他倚着倾斜的铁笼，脑袋无力地耷拉着。

~ Envisioned by MikeNorth

Beside the road, a sturdy post topped with crossbeams supports four gibbets hanging on hooks and chains. Each is a domed cage with two smaller lower cages to hold the legs separately. Two of the gibbets dangle empty, clanking and squealing in the breeze. One contains a skeleton, held together only by tattered strips of clothing and sinew. In the fourth is a man with black hair and beard as unkempt and dirty as his stained rags. His bare feet are cut and bloody. He leans against the listing cage, his head lolling.

~ Envisioned by MikeNorth

卫兵重心在两脚间来回挪动，一只手在腰侧来回摩挲，仿佛掌心发痒，或是在揉搓旧伤。他们警觉地四下张望，却烦躁得无法让目光在任何一处停留太久。
The guard switches weight from foot to foot and rubs one hand against their hip as if itching their palm or rubbing an old wound. They look about, on the alert but too restless to allow their gaze to linger on any one place for too long.

Mercenary Guild Stronghold.name:
佣兵公会要塞
Mercenary Guild Stronghold

Text.text:
盾牌装点着公会大厅的外墙，每一面都凹痕累累、刮擦斑驳，尽是战斗留下的创伤。沉重的橡木大门因年代久远而磨损，引人步入真正的大厅：穹顶高耸，墙上挂满更多盾牌，并陈列着公会创始人曾挥舞的著名与传奇武器。长桌与两侧的长凳占据了这片空间，气势逼人。
Shields adorn the exterior walls of the guild hall, each dented and scuffed, marred from battle. The heavy oaken doors, worn with age, lead into the hall proper, with its soaring ceilings—walls adorned with more shields alongside famed and legendary weapons wielded by the guild’s founders. Long tables, flanked by benches, dominate the space.

这对人似乎怎么也管不住自己的手。一方用指尖沿着另一人的前臂轻轻描摹，十指相扣，贴着耳畔低声说话；对方咯咯笑着回应，俯身在颈侧落下一吻。附近有几个人尴尬得皱起脸，也有人望着他们出神……是嫉妒，是钦羡？这对恋人对周遭毫不在意，只顾在彼此的轻声细语里越贴越近。
The pair can’t seem to keep their hands to themselves. One traces the line of the other’s forearm with a finger, clasping hands and speaking hushed words into their ear. They giggle and respond with a kiss upon the neck. Several nearby cringe in discomfort, while others look on in . . . envy, admiration? The couple pays their surroundings no mind, preferring instead to draw closer and closer as they speak softly to each other.

无论是如洪流般喷涌的愤怒辱骂，还是一记旨在悄然放血自尊的尖刻俏皮话，都没有活物会喜欢被嘲弄；而支撑你侮辱之词的魔法，会让你怒火所指的目标明显一颤，形迹毕露。
Whether a torrent of aggrieved invectives or a subtle quip designed to bleed one’s esteem, no living being enjoys being mocked, and the enchantment underlying your insult causes the target of your ire to flinch, visibly.

哪怕已经死去，这头猛犸仍令人屏息：巨躯如山，厚重纠结的毛发覆着坚韧的皮肉，头前两根森然的象牙长牙如王冠般压迫而来。伤口渗出的鲜血浸染皮毛，晕开一层暗红的色泽。
The mammoth is a breathtaking sight even in death: a titanic mass of thick, matted hair and hardy flesh capped by imposing ivory tusks. The blood seeping from its wounds stains its fur a ruddy hue.

借着舱壁一蹬，交战者在逼仄的空间里整个人猛然掷身翻转，激光爆闪将循环的空气灼得沸腾；武器连连出膛，刺鼻的臭氧味悬在翻卷的肉搏风暴之上。残酷的贴身厮杀过后，半凝的血液缓缓在空中漂浮，如同开阔天穹下掠过的云。

~ MaesterAelix on Discord

Pushing off the walls, the combatants hurl themselves bodily around the cramped space as laser blasts fill the recycled air, an ozone tang hanging over the swirling tumult of bodies as weapons are discharged. Brutally close-quarters skirmishes leave semi-coagulating blood slowly drifting through the air like clouds across an open sky.

~ MaesterAelix on Discord

Inventor's Quip.name:
发明家的俏皮话
Inventor's Quip

Text.text:
“我母亲总爱说：‘从马背上摔下来，就发明一副更好的马鞍。’”
“My mother always used to say, ‘When you fall off a horse, invent a better saddle.’”

你宣告你的武器对血肉与心智同样致命，它随即以灵能之力震鸣不止。武器挥动时，一道幽影般的回响紧随其后。当它命中之际，也会重击目标的意识，将其短暂击离平衡。
You declare your weapon effective against flesh and mind, and it reverberates with psychic power. A ghostly echo of the weapon follows its motions. When it strikes home, it also slams against the target’s consciousness, knocking it out of balance for a moment.

Kit Hairwington.name:
基特·海尔温顿
Kit Hairwington

Text.text:
像蜂鸟般在各项活计间飞掠穿梭，矮小的鸮族工程师一边拧紧螺丝、检查表盘，一边低声咕哝不休；羊皮纸笔记凌乱散落在房间各处，他还不时急匆匆地在上头潦草勾写。那只棕色小鸮似的身影兴奋地蹦跳着干活，在逼仄的工坊里以爆裂般的热情来回弹跃。锐利的绿眼因专注而眯起，他对自己的造物做出最后一次微调——随着机器嗡鸣着活过来，他欢呼出声。他从工作台上抬起那门火炮，小心瞄准一具训练假人，扣下扳机，将其在一团魔法能量的烈焰中彻底焚成灰烬。

~ 由一位英雄扮演

Flitting between tasks like a hummingbird, the diminutive owlfolk engineer constantly mutters under his breath as screws are tightened, dials are checked, and notes are hurriedly scrawled on the parchment strewn all around the room. The small brown owl-like figure hops excitedly as he works, bouncing all over the cramped workshop in fits of explosive enthusiasm. Piercing green eyes narrowed in concentration, he makes a final adjustment to his creation and whoops with joy as it hums to life. He lifts the cannon from his workbench, taking careful aim toward a training dummy, and pulls the trigger, utterly incinerating it in a blaze of magical energy.

~ Played by a Hero

Warning From Athena Promechos.name:
来自雅典娜·普罗马科斯的警告
Warning From Athena Promechos

Text.text:
“织法者，”她说着，话语流转，渐渐化作你能听懂的语言。“纵使那亵渎者的咆哮如狂风般强大、受辱而怒，他也绝非圣者。”她的神祇之形随着一阵轻盈的颤动缩小，宛如烛火被吹熄。那团金白色的微光群如今悬在你眼前的高度。她继续开口，嗓音已回到寻常音调，却仍回荡着一丝沉郁的余韵。“我们这些凡人，或许能在心智上攀至极高处，自负得像奥林匹斯的座上客，可我们终究只是人类——愚昧而狂妄。”
“Spell-weavers,” she says, her speech morphing into a language you can comprehend. “Though the defiler howls like a mighty, affronted wind, he is no holy man.” Her deific form shrinks with the airy flutter of a candle going out. The collection of gold and white motes are now at the level of your eyes. She continues to speak, her voice now at normal pitch, though it still echoes a somber undertone. “We mortals might rise to great heights in our minds, proud as those occupants of Olympus, but we are still only human—foolish and brazen.”

I Embrace Transhumanism.name:
我拥抱超人类主义
I Embrace Transhumanism

Text.text:
“自我明白血肉的边界那一刻起，我也明白了它的局限。可我还是试过，不是吗？健身房里耗掉的那些时辰，所有训练与饮食计划。到头来我得到了什么？一副平庸的躯壳——苍白、松软的肉。它就在我眼前晃荡，像个诱惑：让我成为更强的存在。把孱弱的部分剜出来，让它们变得坚不可摧。见鬼，我还能失去什么？”
"Since the moment I understood the boundaries of my flesh, I understood its limitations. Still, I tried, didn’t I? All those hours in the gym, all the training and diet regimens. And what do I have to show for it? A middling body—pale, soft meat. It dangles before me, the possibility to be something more. To scoop out the weak parts and make them indestructible. Hell, what have I got to lose?"

海面翻涌，巨兽破浪而出。一声呼唤——鲸歌与船桅的吱呀交织——直震得你骨髓发颤。触手扭动、盘绕、抓攀着借力点——两条、五条、一打——接连浮现。随后，利维坦的躯体缓缓升起：一团鼓胀的血肉，庞大得令人无法理解。咸腥与腐鱼的恶臭席卷而来，吞没你的感官，海妖克拉肯在浪间昂然升起。
The ocean roils as the beast emerges. A call, whale-song mingled with the creak of a ship's mast, rattles your very bones. Tentacles, writhing, coiling, grasping for purchase—two, five, a dozen—appear. Then the body of the leviathan emerges, a bulbous mass of flesh, incomprehensibly massive. The smell of salt and rotting fish overwhelms your senses as the kraken rises.

矮人少女叽叽喳喳的絮语微微一转，从店家急促的行话变得温暖起来——她开始把材料与纹样一一铺在桌面上，向顾客展示她挑选的地板、墙面与软装样品会呈现出怎样的效果，又该如何巧妙调和，才能揉出赏心悦目的美感。这位室内装潢师显然熟稔并热爱自己的营生，审美与品味之出众，甚至足以与最摄人心魄的吟游诗人分庭抗礼。
The chattering of the dwarven maiden shifts subtly from a shopkeep’s hurried dialect to a warmer tone as she begins to lay out materials and patterns on a table, displaying for her customer the effect of her chosen samples for flooring, walls, and upholstery, and how best to blend them for a pleasing aesthetic. The interior decorator clearly knows and likes her business, and possesses a sense of style to rival even the most enthralling bard.

Ring Of Djinni Summoning.name:
精灵召唤之戒
Ring Of Djinni Summoning

Text.text:
一颗澄澈湛蓝的水晶镶嵌在这枚雅致的银金戒指正中。戒臂与戒托被雕琢成阵阵疾风的形态，仿佛随时将要掠过指间。
A clear blue crystal is set into the center of this elegant electrum ring. Its shanks and gallery are fashioned to resemble gusts of wind.

The Green Witch Knight.name:
绿巫骑士
The Green Witch Knight

Text.text:
一缕细薄的烟雾从一支奶油黄的玉米棒烟斗里盘旋升起，小小的烟圈被那顶暗色尖帽的宽檐拦住，纠缠在阴影之下。它一只修长、耳尖蓬着茸毛的耳朵上垂着耳饰：一枚小小的金币，币面似乎刻着叶片纹样。胸前系着板甲，颜色是最深的祖母绿；一条长长的黑裙垂到覆甲靴的脚趾上方。戴着护手铁手套的双手交叠，安放在腰侧长剑的剑柄上；一面线条利落、菱形的盾牌斜挂在肩头。尽管双眼仍藏在帽檐投下的浓影里，你仍能从那位高大费伯格的宽鼻下，迎上一个明亮的笑容。“哈喽啊，朋友，”他们用温暖、呵护般的语气说道，牙齿仍咬着烟斗。

~ 扮演：Johnny F

A thin trail of smoke coils up from a butter-yellow corn cob pipe, the small furls getting caught beneath the wide brim of a dark, pointed hat. An earring hangs from one of their long, fur-tufted ears: a small golden coin with what looks like a leaf pattern on its face. Plate armor, its color the darkest of emeralds, is strapped to their chest and a long black skirt hangs to just above the toes of their plated boots. Their gauntleted hands rest crossed on the hilt of the longsword at their hip, and a sleek diamond shield is slung over their shoulder. Though their eyes remain hidden in the deep shade of their hat, a bright smile greets you from under a broad firbolg’s nose. “Hullo there, friend,” they say in a warm, nurturing tone, teeth still clenching the pipe.

~ Played by Johnny F with

你感到世界骤然一沉，仿佛一条厚重的黑毯兜头罩下，压住你体内仍在燃烧的那点生命火星——又像某位神明掷出一枚硬币，无论你喊哪一面，它都会偏偏落在另一面。你正试图捕捉这感觉的源头时，一只细小的双足犬类突然现身。它披着破布与蛛网，畸形的这只生物毛发结成硬块，甚至发炎溃烂。可不知为何，它仍能勾起你心底一丝怜悯。它的鼻头湿漉漉地往下滴着水——令人难以移开视线——但真正攫住你目光的是那双眼睛：又大又圆，黑色瞳孔深不见底，几乎被周围层叠的皱皮吞没。它仰头盯着你，眼神永远带着受惊般的诧异，哪怕那双眼睛后面的脑子正盘算着妖精般的恶作剧。
You sense a sudden shift in the world, like a heavy black blanket has been thrown over whatever spark of life burns within you—or a god has tossed a coin and no matter what side you call,  it will land on the other. As you try to determine the source of the feeling, a tiny bipedal canine appears. Draped in rags and cobwebs, this malformed creature's fur has matted to the point of infection. Yet, somehow, they manage to inspire a shred of pity. Their nose is wet and dripping—hard to look away from—but it's the eyes that hold your gaze. Wide and round with dark pupils, they are almost lost within the folds of wrinkled skin that surround them, they stare up at you with a look of perpetual surprise, even as the brain behind them plots fey tricks.

Staff Of Frost.name:
冰霜法杖
Staff Of Frost

Text.text:
这根长杖外裹一层鞣制的棕色皮套，显然是为了握持更稳更顺手。然而杖身看似不可思议地既非木也非金属——它更像是一根被精心削凿、长度异乎寻常的冰锥。即便你隔着皮套握住它，指尖仍被寒意刺得发麻，仿佛你正被困在凛冽的冬日风雪之中。
This quarterstaff is wrapped in a sheath of tanned brown leather, clearly made for an easier grip. The shaft appears, however impossible, to be made not of wood or metal—in fact, it resembles a carefully chipped icicle of extraordinary length. Even while holding the staff by its leather sheath, your fingertips still tingle with cold as if you were caught outside in a chilly winter storm.

Kids Play Virtual Ccg In Parking Lot.name:
孩子们在停车场里玩虚拟集换式卡牌游戏
Kids Play Virtual Ccg In Parking Lot

Text.text:
几名少年在迷你超市的停车场里对练，脸被VR头显遮得严严实实，闪转腾挪，躲避着看不见的拳脚。两名对手各自站在投影在身前的奇幻化身后方，那些化身与他们的动作分毫不差地同步——即便这些动作笨拙、生涩、毫无章法。
Youths spar in the mini mart parking lot, their faces hidden by VR headsets as they duck and weave invisible blows. The two combatants each stand behind a fantastical avatar projected before them which mirrors their movements exactly—clumsy and undisciplined as those may be.

Awaking Of Lasting Tears.name:
长泪苏醒
Awaking Of Lasting Tears

Text.text:
一声凄厉、兽性的长嚎从这把野蛮的刀刃中迸发，仿佛它那魔裔之力终于彻底解封。酸液自剑身滴落，像饥饿掠食者口中垂下的涎水；你感到体内有股原始而无餍的饥渴正在滋长。念头像失控的兽群般冲进你的脑海：死去与破碎的躯体、被砸烂的遗物、遭洗劫的聚居地——一切都带着那群反复无常、狡诈欺瞒的妖精所留下的异界印记。

~ 由 S Geist Envisioned

A keening, bestial howl erupts from the savage blade as its fiendish power is finally unleashed. Acid drips from the sword like drool from the maw of a ravenous predator, and you sense a primal, insatiable hunger grow within you. Thoughts invade your mind like a wild stampede: dead and broken bodies, smashed artifacts, ravaged settlements—all bearing the otherworldly hallmarks of the capricious and deceitful fey.

~ Envisioned by S Geist

I Cast Conjure Animals.name:
我施放了「召唤动物」
I Cast Conjure Animals

Text.text:
这道法术是精类的魔法，召来他们最爱披上的兽形，于是我得以与他们交谈。我的手势化作爪与牙、翼与鳞。几秒之间，我的朋友们便赶来，以动物的眼睛凝视着我，体内跃动着精灵那原初的灵魂。
The spell is faerie magic, conjuring the animal forms they like to take, and so I speak to them. My gestures are claw and fang, wing and scale. In a few seconds, my friends arrive, looking at me through animal eyes with the primeval souls of the fey.

I'm Very Perceptive With My Rod Of Alert.name:
我对警戒短杖的异动极为敏锐
I'm Very Perceptive With My Rod Of Alertness

Text.text:
自从与魔杖同调后，我的感官变得更敏锐了。我察觉到周遭的一切，仿佛有个看不见的向导在指引我注意那些必须警惕的细节。这需要一段时间才能习惯，但它不止一次救了我一命。
My senses are sharper since attuning to the Rod. I notice everything around me, as if some invisible guide is pointing out things I need to be aware of. It takes some getting used to, but it has saved my skin more than once.

某个早已死去的士兵残骸瘫靠在一块石头旁，射杀他们的箭矢至今仍从锈蚀的头盔中刺出。那具躯体几乎只剩白骨，外加几缕破布与护甲残片——你不禁疑惑它竟还没散架。就在这时，骷髅（特征）的手微微一抽，猛地攥紧了那把锈蚀长剑的剑柄。
The fallen remains of some long-dead soldier lie slumped against a stone, the arrows that killed them still protruding from a rusting helmet. The body is little more than bones and a few scraps of cloth and armor—you wonder that it hasn’t fallen apart. That’s when the skeleton’s hand twitches and tightens around the hilt of a rusting sword.

Tattered-clothes Zombie.name:
衣衫褴褛的丧尸（特征）
Tattered-clothes Zombie

Text.text:
曾经活着的某物踉跄着从阴影中挪出，拖着沉重的步伐向前蹒跚，喉间发出低沉的呻吟。你在这生物的眼中搜寻生命的痕迹，却只看到一片空洞的呆滞凝视，以及一张大张着的嘴，里头尽是枯槁腐朽的残牙。它身上还挂着前世那身破烂的衣物，如今却被腐烂的皮肉与血迹染透——那血恐怕并不属于它自己。
Something that was once alive shambles out of the shadows, groaning as it lumbers forward. You search the creature's eyes for signs of life, finding nothing but a blank stare and a gaping maw of withered teeth. It wears the tattered clothes of its last life, stained now by rotting skin and blood unlikely to be its own.

Arcanist’s Magic Aura.name:
奥术师的魔法灵光
Arcanist’s Magic Aura

Text.text:
你努力不让自己露出笑意，却还是忍不住嘴角掠过一抹得意的冷笑。幻象既成，几乎任何试图占卜你目标情报的人都注定以失败告终，被你狡黠的法术牵引着误入歧途。
You try not to smile to yourself, but you simply can’t help a smirk from crossing your lips. With this illusion in place, virtually anyone who attempts to divine information about your target is doomed to failure, led astray by your cunning spell.

它是整座城市的巅峰。一座宏伟的圆顶建筑——屋顶白得不可思议——由三座如同巫师高塔般的塔楼环绕。建筑主体多为石砌，唯有屋檐之下环着一圈镶嵌状的水晶带。黄、绿、蓝、红、紫……你能想象的一切色彩，被拼合成三角形的马赛克。
It is the pinnacle of the city. A grand domed building—roof an impossible white—surrounded by three wizard-like towers. The building is mostly stone, except for a band of tessellated crystal just below the roof. Yellow, green, blue, red, purple… every color you can imagine, fitted together in a triangle mosaic.

Sundries From A Group Of Quaggoths.name:
一群夸戈斯的杂物
Sundries From A Group Of Quaggoths

Text.text:
一撮撮毛皮黏在弯曲的树皮碎片上，树皮被矿物颜料抹得斑驳。几只装着冰蓝色真菌与深绿色草浆的小陶罐倾倒在地，四周满是利爪拖出的颜料划痕。
Clumps of fur are stuck in curved pieces of tree bark smeared with mineral paints. Small clay pots of icy-blue fungus and deep-green pulped grass are tipped over, surrounded by paint streaks made by claws.

Lizardfolk Scout Emerges From Swamp.name:
蜥蜴人斥候自沼泽中现身
Lizardfolk Scout Emerges From Swamp

Text.text:
你察觉到鳄鱼般的眼睛正逼近——恶臭水面上浮起成对的气泡。下一瞬，它们齐齐破水而出，随之闪现的是标枪的燧石尖锋。沼泽水珠如雨炸开，由那面刚露出水面的鳞纹盾牌与披戴其上的、更为鳞甲森森的蜥蜴人一同掀起。他们猛然冲来，为你这擅闯之举与之对峙。

~ 由 Aelifex 构想

You perceive the approach of crocodilian eyes, twin bubbles on the fetid surface. An instant later, they rise from the water in tandem, accompanied by the flint points of javelins. A shower of swampy droplets erupts, launched by the emerging scale-patterned shield and the even scalier lizardfolk wearing it. They surge forward to confront you for your trespass.

~ Envisioned by Aelifex

Players Using Shield Walk Maneuver.name:
玩家使用“盾行”战技
Players Using Shield Walk Maneuver

Text.text:
[持盾者] 你大步向前，肌肉在高举的巨大防暴盾重量下绷紧。你是壁垒，是移动的要塞；你以肩开路，眯眼透过盾牌透明的观察缝向外窥视。你的同伴蜷伏在你身后，如你雷霆推进中的闪电。

[同伴] 你的神经微微发麻，动作与同伴相扣，如同钟表里的齿轮。你感觉到敌方火力砸在他们为你举起的盾上，震颤一路传来。你花了片刻摸清弹幕的节奏。待到最安全的瞬间，你猛然挺起身，武器高举，倾泻出一阵守护性的火雨。

[Shield Bearer] You stride forward, muscles straining under the weight of the massive riot shield held aloft. You are the bulwark, the shifting fortress, as you press forward shoulder first, eyes squinting through the shield’s transparent eye slit. Behind you crouches your companion, the lightning to your thunderous advance.

[Companion] Your nerves tingle, your movements bound to your companion’s like cogs in a timepiece. You feel them tense as enemy fire slams into the shield they hold before you. It takes a moment to predict the rhythm of the barrage. When it’s safest, you surge upward, weapon raised as you lay down a hail of protective fire.

Abandoned Storefront.name:
废弃的店铺门面
Abandoned Storefront

Text.text:
这家店最初的名字与用途早已湮没无存，被塑料板、喷漆与尘土一并抹去。窗玻璃蒙着疏于照料的污暗暮色，模糊了内部景象。几处玻璃上裂纹如蛛网般蔓延开去，仿佛碎裂闪电绽出的光冠。
The business’s original name and purpose have been lost, the erasure committed by means of plastic boards, spray paint, and dust. The windows cloud with the smudgy gloam of neglect, obscuring the interior. Cracks spider out along the glass in a few places, like coronas of splintered lightning.

Loot From Baba Yaga.name:
来自芭芭-雅嘎的战利品
Loot From Baba Yaga

Text.text:
一层黑色霉毯从芭芭-雅嘎的尸身上蔓延爬出，围成一圈。你小心俯身，探手翻检这狡黠老巫婆那一身无数口袋。你找到一瓶银沙，轻轻倾倒时在瓶中左右流淌，像闪烁的丝绸；还有一块水晶般的石英团，光滑通透，清澈得如山涧溪水。
A carpet of black mold creeps out from Baba Yaga’s corpse forming a ring. Leaning in carefully, you rifle through the tricksy old witch’s many pockets. You discover a bottle of silver sand that runs like glittering silk when tipped from side to side and a crystalline lump of quartz as smooth and clear as water in a mountain stream.

Sea Cave Entrance.name:
海蚀洞入口
Sea Cave Entrance

Text.text:
当你穿行在这座洞窟里，脚下是湿冷的沙地与簇簇礁石，掠过覆满地衣的洞壁，海水那股浓烈的咸腥气几乎令人窒息。水色也从海面悦目的湛蓝，变成深绿而浑浊的暗流——部分正是因植物滋蔓所致。你的脚踝旁，浅滩里堆积的海藻以黏滑的触感缠抚而过。
The heady odor of seawater is nearly overpowering in this cave as you traverse wet sand and clusters of rocks, and pass lichen-covered walls. The water has shifted from the pleasing blue of the sea to a deep-green, cloudy murk—in part due to the vegetation. Around your ankles you feel the slimy caress of the kelp amassed in the shallows.

Sailboat On Stormy Seas.name:
暴风海上的帆船
Sailboat On Stormy Seas

Text.text:
狂风在头顶尖啸，闪电劈裂苍穹，冷白的强光泼洒在被撕扯的主帆上。船身剧烈俯仰，在重压下咆哮呻吟；舵轮死命挣扎，只为让船尾始终迎着巨浪。甲板已被浪水吞没，落脚处险象环生，碎屑残骸来回滑窜。海水狠狠拍打船壳，试探着吱呀作响的木板是否还能撑住；龙骨在巨力之下颤抖不止，仿佛下一瞬就要崩裂。

~ 一位英雄 构想

The gale screams above as lightning splinters the sky, casting an actinic splash across the shredding mainsail. The ship pitches violently, roaring under the strain, the helm fighting to keep stern-on to the waves. The deck is awash, making footing treacherous as detritus slides to and fro. Water batters against the hull, testing the integrity of the groaning planks as the keel shudders under the titanic pressure.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Border Town Merchant.name:
边境城镇商人
Border Town Merchant

Text.text:
数小时的乏味。女商人拂去袖口的一点绒屑，整了整长袍。这里的天气感觉更粗粝些。时代在此流得更慢，却更快地催人老去。她始终待在小铺的屋檐下，杯子、碗、茶托与烛台每天都按同样的摆法陈列。她不肯让烈日与风把脸吹得如皮革般粗硬，也不肯让它们磨损她的心气。趁着片刻清闲，她取出一本书，翻读另一个帝国的历史。
Hours of boredom. The merchant flicks some lint off her sleeve and straightens her robe. Weather feels a little rougher out here. Time passes slower but ages everyone faster. She stays under the roof of the bodega, the cups, bowls, saucers, and candlesticks laid out the same way every day. She refuses to let the sun and wind leather her face or wear on her spirits. During a lull, she takes out a book and reads the history of another empire.

不知是哪位扭曲的匠人构想出这头恶魔的拼合体，当时必定灵感迸发。三条腿支撑着怪物，腿上结痂的腐肉粗如树干，稳稳钉在地上；它环视四周，头颅竟能整整扭转到背后，又猛地旋回另一侧。一只手臂的肘关节向着错误的方向反折，骨头突起得骇人，竟还没刺破皮肉。恶魔放出一声压抑已久的嗜血咆哮，声音从它裸露的喉咙里挤出，扭曲刺耳，粗粝得像刮擦骨面。
Whatever twisted artisan envisioned this amalgamation of a demon must have felt particularly inspired. Three legs with scabbed flesh as thick as tree trunks hold the monster steady as it surveys its surroundings, its head twisting completely backwards before swiveling back the other way. The elbow of one arm is bent the wrong way, the bone jutting so far out it's surprising it hasn't broken skin. The demon releases a roar of pent-up bloodlust, the sound coming out gnarled and grating from its raw throat.

Rolling Countryside Overlooking Village.name:
起伏的乡野俯瞰村庄
Rolling Countryside Overlooking Village

Text.text:
被牧场环抱的村庄景致宁静得如同你能想象的最田园的画卷。一阵微风掠过，卷起初秋飘落的枯叶，在脚下的草丛间轻轻翻滚。
The view of the village surrounded by pastureland is as idyllic a picture as you can possibly imagine. A slight breeze plays through, blowing dead leaves fallen in the early autumn over the grasses below.

从剑首到锋尖，这把弯刀以大师级工艺铸就，线条优雅如弧。刀身的弯弧经魔法淬砺，刃口锐利得足以致命；随刃附上一只厚重的刀鞘，确保持用者不致因一时疏忽而误伤自身。
From pommel to point, the scimitar is a graceful curve of master workmanship. The arc of the blade has been magically whetted to a dangerous edge, and it comes with a heavy sheath to ensure no accidental injury comes to the wielder.

I Cover Myself In An Oil Of Etherealness.name:
我以虚无化油浸覆全身
I Cover Myself In An Oil Of Etherealness

Text.text:
我检查着自己的工具包，留意那些需要格外上心的接缝与纹理。十分钟里，我小心翼翼地把手指探进罐中，抹上油，再将油滴到我够不到的背上。最后，我抬起每一只靴子，为靴底均匀涂上一层。随后我踏入以太边境——那片半影的领域，在那里，我看见缤纷的世界仿佛被刻在一张锡板上。
I check my kit, noting the seams and textures that will require extra attention. After ten minutes of careful work dipping my fingers into the jar, applying the oil, and dripping it onto my back where I can’t reach, I finally lift each boot and coat the soles. Then I step into the border ethereal, the penumbral realm from which I see the colorful world as if it were etched on a tin sheet.

Quip About Being Unsure Of Mission.name:
关于任务不太确定的俏皮话
Quip About Being Unsure Of Mission

Text.text:
“各位抱歉，我真的彻底迷糊了。满嘴都是魔法麦高芬和冗长古老的名字。有没有什么邪恶的家伙需要我去宰了，还是我从一开始就完全搞错重点了？”
“I’m sorry everyone, but I’m completely lost. It’s all magic McGuffins and long, ancient names. Is there some evil person I need to kill or have I missed the point entirely?”

Snow-covered Paths.name:
积雪覆盖的小径
Snow-covered Paths

Text.text:
道路穿过桥面，又在前方拐弯盘旋，但此处还有两条岔路攫住了你的目光。有人不久前在附近瀑布的观景处点起过篝火，他们的脚步在积雪上向北踩出一条小径。向南，一条同样被踏实的路从两座巨石堆间穿过；越过那里，你看见河面高度处一间棚屋的屋顶伏在岸边。
The road runs across the bridge and curls around a bend, but here two other paths catch your eye. Someone has recently set a campfire burning at an overlook of the nearby waterfall and their passing has made a trail through the snow to the north. To the south, a similarly beaten path passes between two mounds of boulders, beyond which you see the roof of a shack set down at the level of the river.

Adventurer's Guildhall.name:
冒险者公会大厅
Adventurer's Guildhall

Text.text:
术士的躯体已被烧成灰烬，焦黑的皮肉勉强黏附在下方被炭化、脆裂的骨骼上——然而施法者的衣物却毫发无伤，仿佛对那场烈焰免疫。一根魔杖被骸骨般的手指死死攥住，微微搏动，宛如一颗将熄的心脏，生命随每一刻流逝而一点点抽离。
The sorcerer’s body has been burned to cinders, the blackened flesh barely clinging to the charred, brittle bones beneath—yet the spellcaster’s clothing is unharmed, as if immune to the conflagration. A wand, gripped tightly in skeletal fingers, pulses softly, like a failing heart with life ebbing away with each passing moment.

I Cast Cure Wounds.name:
我施放【疗伤术】
I Cast Cure Wounds

Text.text:
当我将手轻轻放在我的盟友身上，我将思绪凝聚在他们的生命力上。我触及造物的治疗能量，并以意志驱使它们穿过我流淌，让我得以缓解朋友的痛楚。温暖的光辉笼罩着我的手掌，回应我的呼唤，一股生命与活力的浪潮自我体内奔涌而出，注入我的盟友。就在我眼前，他们脸上重新浮现血色，伤口也开始合拢。
As I lay my hand gently upon my ally, I focus my thoughts on their vitality. I reach out to the healing energies of creation and will them to flow through me, allowing me to ease my friend’s pain. A warm glow surrounds my hand as my call is answered and a wave of vitality and vigor surges through me into my ally. Before my eyes the color returns to their face and their wounds begin to close.

Giant Wizard Tower In The Clouds.name:
云端巨巫师塔
Giant Wizard Tower In The Clouds

Text.text:
云层裂开，一座巨大的石塔轮廓浮现，仿佛乘着翻涌雾潮而来。粗糙的球形窗孔斑斑点点凿在塔身上，每一处开口都迸射出刺目的冷光。塔顶戴着一圈尖刺光环，噼啪作响，狂烈而野性的火花四散飞溅。你听见声音在空旷的空气里轰鸣，仿若雷霆滚过。

~ 构想：Rogério da Costa Jr.

The clouds part and the outline of a great stone tower appears, riding a surf of billowing fog. Rough, spherical windows pockmark its surface, harsh light flashing at each opening. The tower’s top is crowned with a halo of spikes that crackles with fierce and wild sparks. You hear voices booming like rolling thunder through the open air.

~ Envisioned by Rogério da Costa Jr.

Ilyena The Half-elf College Of Lore Bard.name:
伊莲娜——半精灵逸闻学院吟游诗人
Ilyena The Half-elf College Of Lore Bard

Text.text:
这名半精灵就算披着粗麻布也会风姿卓然，但她身上的皮护甲却是为惊艳众人而精制。即便如此，她的装束也仍得追赶她本人的气场——那存在感仿佛自她体内涌出，随着她朝你这边一瞥，像潮浪般漫过你的全身。她的目光与你相接，你顿时屏住呼吸；可下一刻她笑了，笑意直抵眼底，在眼角漾起细小的纹路。你轻轻呼出一声笑，摇了摇头，想把那些荒唐的念头从脑中甩开。
The half-elf would cut a fine figure in sackcloth, but her leather armor was crafted to impress. Even so, her outfit has to play catchup to her presence, which seems to emanate from her and flows over you like a wave as she glances in your direction. Her eyes meet yours and you stop breathing, but then she smiles, and the smile reaches her eyes, creating little wrinkles at the corners. You exhale a little laugh and shake your head to clear it of foolish thoughts.

那儿有个守卫。不，不对，是个飞行员？我明明发誓那是昨天的服务型仿生人。也许你看错了——这分明是个守卫：头发剪得贴头皮，千篇一律的脸上挂着无聊的神情。没错，确实是守卫。一把方位手枪挂在他们腰带上。他们有节奏地轻点着脚尖，目光在人群里来回扫视。大概是在找扒手。
There’s a guard. Or no, a pilot? Could have sworn it was the server android from yesterday. Maybe you’re mistaken, it’s clearly a guard—close cropped hair, bored look on their generic face. Yep, that’s a guard alright. An azimuth pistol hangs at their belt. They tap their foot with a patient beat, scanning the crowd. Probably for pickpockets.

The Barbarian’s Lament.name:
野蛮人的哀歌
The Barbarian’s Lament

Text.text:
“我一次次伸手去够星辰，回来的却只有泥土与鲜血。”
“I keep reaching for the stars, but I only come back with dirt and blood.”

Temple To A Supreme Deity.name:
至高神祇的神殿
Temple To A Supreme Deity

Text.text:
一座白色方尖碑拔地而起，顶端覆着金色金字塔形碑冠，耸立在一圈据说是世上最古老的立石环之上。神殿占地一英亩，呈圆形铺展。长长的苔痕石板路在草地间蜿蜒，宛如隐约的迷宫，其间点缀着观赏树与果树。于明亮光照之下，神殿仿佛指向远方碑冠的微光，宛若另一个太阳；在繁星之夜，它又化作一道闪烁的门扉，通往可随维度伸缩的境域。逢幽暗或薄暮时分，神殿则以沉郁的静思映现其神祇的临在，仿佛俯听众人的祈求。
A white obelisk with a golden pyramid for a cap rises above a circle of the oldest standing stones in the world. The temple covers a circular acre. A long path of mossy flagstones winds like a subtle labyrinth through the grass, punctuated by decorative trees and fruit trees. In bright light, the temple points at the distant gleam of the capstone, as if it were another sun; by starry night, it becomes a sparkling portal of dimensional flexibility. By gloom or gloaming, the temple evokes its deity’s presence in brooding consideration of petitions.

Cyberpunk Fantasy Metropolis: Elite 'Aaa.name:
赛博朋克奇幻大都会：精英“Aaa”街区
Cyberpunk Fantasy Metropolis: Elite 'Aaa' Neighborhood

Text.text:
在这座蔓延无垠的大都会最深处，坐落着一片只为社会顶层精英保留的私密街区——甚至凌驾于富豪之上。这里遍布奢华宅邸，配备最尖端的安保系统，并提供琳琅满目的浮华社交设施；放眼望去，尽是穷奢极欲生活的视觉盛宴。
Deep inside the sprawling metropolis is an exclusive neighborhood reserved for the elites of society, those above even the rich. The area boasts luxurious mansions, state-of-the-art security systems, and a wide range of frivolous social amenities—a visual cornucopia of decadent living.

Call To Arms: March To War.name:
号令集结：踏上战途
Call To Arms: March To War

Text.text:
鼓手敲出节奏，可士兵行进的步伐自有一种无休无止的拍点。脚下将地面碾成粉末，扬起一团尘云，飘上来扑在他们高举的旗帜上，又在空中弥散成干燥的薄雾。头盔下是一张张阴沉的面孔，目光笔直向前，心神紧绷，尽数系在前方等待的战斗之上。
Drummers beat out a rhythm, but the cadence of the soldiers’ steps has its own interminable tempo. A cloud of dust rises from where their feet pulverize the ground, drifting up to dust the flags they carry and fill the air with a dry fog. Grim faces glower from under helmets, eyes set forward and minds focused on the battles that lie ahead.

煮制的棕色皮革被巧妙地层层叠压，使这套护甲既坚固耐打，又不失灵活。各个部件看起来一应俱全。甚至还配有给脚穿的小皮革护脚，这在皮甲中相当罕见。
Boiled brown leather has been cleverly layered to make this suit of armor both protective and flexible. All the pieces seem to be present. There are even little leather sabatons for the feet, which is unusual for leather armor.

Strange Moon Over The Academy.name:
学院上空的诡异月影
Strange Moon Over The Academy

Text.text:
在一连串夜间课——由慷慨的教授们开设的考前特训——进行时，云层忽然裂开，露出一轮斑驳的、泛着粉色的满月。一群躁动的鸟影掠过月面，像黑色的裂痕一闪而逝。  

在《奇术史》课堂上，那位兼任的狮子助教盯着一名学生看得太久，目光也太饿。  

在《日常学》课堂上，教授走到教室墙边，凭空开出一扇窗，一边回答学生的问题，一边望向窗外不动声色地出神。  

伯纳德·肯布尔哈特一反常态地鼓起勇气，在《魔法纹章学》课上召来他的扫帚，腾空而起，朝着被粉色月光浸染的夜空飞去，直奔温室——那里正传来刺耳的尖叫。
During a series of night sessions—special exam-prep classes led by generous professors—the clouds part to reveal a patchy, pinkish full moon. A silhouetted flock of agitated birds crosses it. In Thaumaturgical History, the adjunct lion stares a bit too long and too hungrily at a student. In Quotidian Studies, the professor walks to the wall of the class, creates a window, and stares out while answering students’ questions. With uncharacteristic bravery, Bernerd Kemblehatt calls his broom during Magical Heraldry and flies into the pink-tinted night toward the greenhouse, from which shrieks are heard.

Open-air Tavern: Wandering Musician.name:
露天酒馆：流浪乐师
Open-air Tavern: Wandering Musician

Text.text:
旅店里一片喧闹，众人聚在一起吃喝、闲谈或赌上一把，在入睡前用些许消遣打发一天最后的几个时辰，等待明日劳作再起。今夜的气氛显得更为活络些。人群的嗡鸣回荡得更响，想来是因为有位乐师挑了这里为钱币奏乐。
The inn bustles with activity as folk gather to eat, drink, talk, or gamble, whiling away the last few hours of the day with leisure before sleep brings another day’s labor. Tonight the atmosphere feels a little livelier. The crowd’s rumble echoes louder, no doubt due to the musician who has chosen this place to play for coins.

Squalid Tenement.name:
肮脏的廉租公寓
Squalid Tenement

Text.text:
由废弃或被焚毁的房屋残骸、丢弃的木料、帆布与船帆布拼凑成的房间，沿着山坡层层叠叠堆起。它们以怪异的角度扭转错接，靠着摇摇欲坠、险得要命的露天楼梯相连。墙壁与门扉大多一个模样，灰暗无饰，也没有门牌地址。没人愿意在那些成群结队、狡黠斜睨的破衣人面前显眼——他们把手插在撕裂的口袋里。所谓的街道上，露天火堆正焚烧垃圾；而巷道幽暗，腥臭扑鼻。
Rooms pieced together from abandoned or burned houses, discarded timbers, canvases, and sail cloth are stacked on top of one another up the hillside. They turn at odd angles, connected by rickety, dangerous outdoor staircases. The walls and doors look mostly the same, dull and without ornament or address. No one wants to stand out to the clusters of sly-glancing, ragged individuals with hands in their ripped pockets. Open fires burn trash in what passes for a street, and the alleys are dark and rank.

Hail Of Thorns.name:
荆棘之雨
Hail Of Thorns

Text.text:
施法者将自己的远程武器呼啸着掷入空中。命中之际，邪恶的倒刺在五码半径内猛然迸发，刺穿周遭之人。这些扭曲的荆棘仿佛取自妖精的蒺藜，带着狡黠而阴毒的恶意疾射而出。
The caster sends their ranged weapon whistling through the air. As it connects, wicked barbs erupt in a five-foot radius, piercing those nearby. These twisted thorns seem drawn from fey briars, for they shoot forth with a learned and wicked malevolence.

这只巨型蟾蜍大得惊人，你甚至能看清它那厚实、如橡胶般的皮肤上每一处粗糙的斑块、每一粒疣点与每一道起伏的棱脊。你注视着它，只见它为了寻找唾手可得的猎物而轻而易举地一跃而起。想到那样庞大的身躯竟能被它的腿部肌肉推动得如此之远，你不由得紧张地咽了口唾沫。
The giant toad is so large that you can make out every rough patch, every wart and crenellation on its thick, rubbery hide. As you watch, you see it leap effortlessly in search of easy prey. You can’t help but swallow nervously as you contemplate how strong its leg muscles must be, to move such a mass so far.

Border Town Flood.name:
边境小镇洪灾
Border Town Flood

Text.text:
你猛地坐直身子。你梦见整张床都在移动，仿佛有什么东西撞上了旅店。你踉跄扑到肮脏的窗边，一把推开窗扇，映入眼帘的是一幅屠戮般的惨景。河水冲破了堤岸——终于在数周的倾盆暴雨下彻底屈服——一堵巨浪般的洪水正咆哮着席卷全镇。人们尖叫着被水流掀翻脚下，随湍急的激流卷走。窗下的墙边，一艘小划艇被反复狠狠撞击，最终沉没。另一边，一匹马徒劳地逆着水势挣扎游动，骑手早已不见踪影，葬身洪涛。树上有个女人在呼喊求救。你无助地看着汹涌的水势从枝头将她“摘”走，像破布娃娃般拖拽而去。忽然，你赤裸的脚底一阵冰凉发湿；你惊恐地低头，看见水正从门缝里渗进来，水位飞快上涨！
You sit bolt upright. You dreamed the whole bed moved, as if something had crashed into the inn. You lurch to the dirty window and thrust it open to reveal a scene of carnage. The river has burst its banks—finally succumbing to weeks of torrential rain—and a colossal wave of floodwater is surging through the town. Folk scream as they are washed off their feet and carried away by the cascade. A rowboat is dashed repeatedly against the wall beneath your window before sinking. A horse attempts to swim against the tide, its rider lost to the waters. A woman shouts from a tree. You look on helplessly as the surge plucks her from the branch and drags her away like a rag doll. Suddenly your bare feet feel wet; looking down in horror you see water seeping under your door, its level rising fast!

Spring Evening Cemetery.name:
春暮墓园
Spring Evening Cemetery

Text.text:
落日将墓碑染成粉红色，它们投下的影子拉得又长又细。渐冷的地面孕出一层脆弱的薄雾，幽灵般的缕缕轻触着渐渐收拢、准备入夜的花朵。独鸦栖在一座下陷的坟冢之上，凄厉的啼声回荡，催赶着暮色降临。
The setting sun paints the headstones pink, and the shadows they cast grow long and thin. The cooling ground gives birth to a fragile mist, ghost-like tendrils caressing the retreating blooms as they close for the night. The haunting cries of a lone raven sitting atop a sunken sepulcher shepherd in the dusk.

随意倚在一艘庞大金属造物的舱门边框上——那造物正嗡鸣着澎湃力量——这位古怪的旅人一出现便令人难忘。他那精明的双眼以近乎苛刻的清晰度扫过四周，沿着舷梯大步而下；厚重的靴底叩击金属，却意外地轻而克制。自头至脚披着闪耀的板甲，腰侧悬着一柄华美繁饰的长剑——这旅人仿佛从史诗挂毯里走出，踏入现实。确实，这个人类身上有种与此地截然分隔的气息。

~ 扮演：MasterLionsDen

Leaning casually against the doorframe of a large metal craft humming with power, the strange traveler makes quite an impression. Shrewd eyes scan his surroundings with meticulous clarity as he strides down the ramp, his heavy boots striking the metal with surprising subtlety. Clad head to toe in gleaming plate—with a beautifully ornate sword at his hip—the traveler could have stepped out of an epic tapestry into the world. Indeed, there is something distinctly separate about the human.

~ Played by MasterLionsDen with

I Use The Dark One's Own Luck.name:
我动用黑暗魔君的专属鸿运
I Use The Dark One's Own Luck

Text.text:
事情就要出岔子了。我能感觉到那股灼热像火一样烧进骨头里。于是我呼唤我的宗主，援引我们立下的契约，索取我每日应得的支援——只要让命运的骰子稍稍偏一偏就好。我只需要这么一点点。回应随之而来，带着一丝若有若无的硫磺气味。
It’s about to go wrong. I can feel it like fire in my bones. So I invoke my patron, call on the contract we made, and ask for the support I’m due each day. One little tweak of the odds. That’s all I need. The answer comes with the faint smell of sulfur.

蛇蜷成一团伏在地上，困倦而寂静，却忽然察觉热度的变化。她吐信轻探空气中的气味，随即楔形的头颅抬起，催眠般的双眼锁定前方。颈项顺滑地向后弯成弧度，舌尖一闪一闪，身躯绷紧蓄势。
In a coil on the ground, sleepy and silent, the snake feels a change in heat. She licks the air for a scent, and then the wedge of her head rises up, aiming mesmerizing eyes. Her neck smoothly curves back, tongue flicking, body braced.

An Elf’s Grief.name:
精灵的哀恸
An Elf’s Grief

Text.text:
“这么久以来，我从未失去过一个朋友。仿佛整个世界都褪了色。我知道这对你们那一类而言司空见惯，可你们却仍能继续前行。你们心中该栖息着何等神赐的力量。我真希望自己也能分得哪怕一丁点。”
“In all this time I’ve never had a friend die. It’s as though the world has lost its color. I’m sure it happens all the time to your kind, yet somehow you continue on. What godly strength must rest in your hearts. I wish I had a mere portion of it.”

Sundries From A Mind Flayer.name:
来自夺心魔的杂物
Sundries From A Mind Flayer

Text.text:
你翻检着那具渗着黏液的尸体袍服，却一无所获——只有大片丝绸般的布料，以及一层黏膜，紧紧缠在你的指尖上。
You poke through the robes of the oozing corpse, but find nothing of value—only swathes of silken fabric and a mucosal membrane that clings to your fingers.

Bundle Of Hidden Clothes.name:
一捆藏匿的衣物
Bundle Of Hidden Clothes

Text.text:
当你拨开几片刻意对齐的枝叶时，幸运向你露出微笑，一处隐秘的藏匿点随之显现。你将它打开，里面是一包以油布密封的裹包，装着两套衣物。唯有更进一步的细查，才能辨明这批衣物究竟是为伪装而藏，还是为求生而备。
Fortune has smiled upon you as you brush aside several carefully aligned pieces of foliage to uncover a hidden cache. You open it to find a sealed oilskin bundle containing two sets of clothing. Only further examination will reveal if this stash of clothing has been hidden for purposes of disguise or survival.

Wild Magic Surge: Confusion.name:
狂野魔法涌动：困惑
Wild Magic Surge: Confusion

Text.text:
你周身的魔法猛然卷作一场令人茫然的狂乱漩涡，狠狠冲击着你的感官与理智。这阵令人眩晕的喧嚣成了一道搅乱心神的谜题……你刚才在做什么？
The magic around you whips into a baffling maelstrom, assaulting your senses and your sanity. This befuddling hubbub is a mind-muddling puzzle… What were you doing?

这道法术极其精密——是你所知最复杂的之一。你备好施法器具，其中包括那枚罕见的宝石，并审视着那只来自位面之外、只是短暂造访此存在位面的生物。你一边绕着它踱步，一边吐出咒文，在空中勾画出所需的符文。时间流逝——数分钟，几乎一小时——宝石在你掌中碎裂，碎光闪烁，随即化作微尘消散在空气里。最后的咒句落下时，低沉的嗡鸣随之响起，你将那生物束缚在此位面——至少在一段时间内。
The spell is an intricate one—one of the most complicated you know. You prepare your implements, including the rare jewel, and look over the extra-planar creature, only visiting this plane of existence. You speak the words as you circle the creature, drawing the necessary runes in the air. Time passes—minutes, nearly an hour—and the jewel fragments in your hand, glittering as it dissipates into the air. A hum accompanies the final words of the incantation, and you bind the creature to this plane—at least for a time.

Pipe-trimmed Kitchen.name:
镶嵌铜管饰边的厨房
Pipe-trimmed Kitchen

Text.text:
厨房里原本温馨的陈设，却被抽屉拉手、锅柄、门把手与窗扣的冷意染得黯淡了几分。所有旧木与锡件都已不见，取而代之的是严丝合缝的铁制管道接头——坚硬、阴沉、灰暗。
The otherwise homey trappings of the kitchen are darkened a bit by the drawer pulls, pot handles, doorknobs, and window catches. All the old wood and tin have been replaced by fitted iron pipe joints—strong, gloomy, and gray.

你伸出自己的感官，竭力去聆听回应你法术召唤的回音。视野的角落有什么东西一闪而过。你转过头，听见身后传来窸窣的抓挠拖行声。此刻你已知晓妖精之灵已然到来，你只需决定它们的形态。
You reach out with your senses, straining to hear an answer to your spell’s call. Something moves at the corner of your vision. You turn your head and hear a scratching shuffle behind you. Now you know the fey spirits have come, you have but to decide their form.

Cybernetic Arm Augmentation +2.name:
义体手臂强化 +2
Cybernetic Arm Augmentation +2

Text.text:
小臂已被彻底切除，取而代之的是一副银合金骷髅（特征）骨架，其上固定着三枚三角形钢楔。钢楔内部翻涌着三座巨大的筒仓，每一座都囤积着纳米机器人。使用者一声令下，纳米机器人便沿着前臂与手掌奔涌而下，将手臂塑形成无穷无尽的实用器具。每一枚纳米机器人都升级了纳米级锁扣；在使用者的意志驱动下，锁扣弹出咬合，将纳米机器人群锁定为高密度构型。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The lower arm has been completely removed and replaced with a silver-alloy skeleton, to which three triangular steel wedges are fixed. Inside these steel wedges swirl three large silos, each holding nanobots. At the user’s command, nanobots swarm along the length of the forearm and hand, morphing the arm into endless useful utilities. Each nanobot has been upgraded with a nanoscopic latch, and at the will of the user, the latches deploy, locking the swarm of nanobots into high-density configurations.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

黏腻的湿热里，汗水贴在学者的皮肤上，他踉跄穿行于沼泽荒滩。腐臭的水渗进他早已湿透的衣物，蚋虫与各类飞虫的嗡鸣几乎要把他的耳膜震聋。污浊的水面泛起一圈涟漪——也许只是他挣扎搅动的波纹；他几乎未曾察觉，下一次滑倒便让他半身没入那黏稠的液体之中。 他从缠人如枯枝的沼底拔出一只脚，抬头喘息之际，迎面撞上了一张巨大的龙形面孔——愤怒的翠绿眼眸距他不过一尺。它从水中升起，蛇一般的身躯上黏着浮渣与苔藓，胸膛震颤，仿佛在从沼床深处召来瘟疫与死亡的瘴气。学者的肺被呛得抽紧，双眼刺痛，四肢胡乱挣扎……他的意志，能否不屈于沼泽之蛟？

~ Daer Averna

Sticky-heat had sweat clinging to the scholar's skin as he stumbled through the swampland. Fetid water seeped into his already soaked clothing, as the buzzing of gnats and other insects deafened his ears. A ripple disturbs the scummy surface, possibly from his own struggles—it barely registers as another slip lands him waist deep in the liquid. As he frees a foot from the limb-strangling swamp bed, he looks up from his exertion and is met by a large draconic face, angered emerald eyes within a foot of his own. It rises from the water, scum and moss clinging to its serpentine body as it's chest vibrates, summoning a miasma of pestilence and death from the swamp bed. The scholar’s lungs become choked, eyes sting, his limbs flail . . . Will he succumb to the Wyrm of the swamp?

~ Daer Averna

侏儒的皮围裙上溅满了五彩斑斓的蜡滴——那是融化后又冷却凝结的痕迹，其中一些被直刃刮削过，留下干净的刮痕。然而，制烛匠的活计从不允许这样的衣物保持一尘不染，因为总有更多蜡烛要做。附近锅里融化的兽脂恶臭扑鼻，熏得你眼眶发酸，泪水几乎要夺眶而出。
The gnome’s leather apron is spattered with multicolored droplets of melted and cooled wax, some of which have been scraped off with a straight edge. The work of a candlemaker, however, never allows one to keep such a garment perfectly clean, as there are always more candles to make. The reek of tallow melting in a nearby pan is enough to bring tears to your eyes.

Sophisticated Dj Rig.name:
精密DJ调音台
Sophisticated Dj Rig

Text.text:
六个黄色箱体环绕着一台黑色控制台，无数按钮让这套DJ设备看起来更像一架军规直升机的操控面板。黑色控制台上方，悬浮着两只蓝色全息转盘，造型仿古老黑胶唱机。两侧各悬着一只巨大的双联音箱，由重力喷射器托举在空中。控制台正中央设有一个头插接口，DJ可以将体内混音直接上传进系统。
Six yellow boxes ring a black console, with countless buttons making the DJ rig look more like the control pad of a mil-grade helicopter. Above the black console float two blue holographic wheels in the style of ancient vinyl players. Colossal twin speakers hang on either side of the rig, suspended by grav-jets. An entry point for a headjack is in the center of the console so a DJ can upload internal mixes directly into the system.

Sundries From A Young Bronze Dragon.name:
来自幼年青铜龙的杂物
Sundries From A Young Bronze Dragon

Text.text:
在巨龙庇护的海岸洞窟中，你发现了一些耐人寻味的遗物：一柄碎裂的长剑安放在粗朴的雕石基座上；断裂的残片被精心陈列在一方丝绸之上；不远处的书架上整齐摆着一小批本地军事史卷册；而洞窟尽头的墙面，则悬着一只破损的船舵。
In the dragon’s sheltered coastal cave, you find some interesting artifacts: a shattered sword rests on a simple pedestal of carved stone; sundered fragments are artfully arranged on a silk cloth; a nearby bookshelf holds a modest collection of volumes of local military history; and a broken ship's wheel adorns the far wall.

自从你被咬已经过去了一天多，但此刻在你体内搏动的痛楚，远远胜过最初受伤时的那一下。伤口早已结痂，却依旧肿胀变色。你的头痛毫无减弱的迹象。即便整夜睡过，你也只想蜷缩成一团，闭上眼睛——你的身体早已精疲力竭，只因它徒劳地试图对抗这场病患。
It has been more than a day since you were bitten, but the pain now throbbing through your body far exceeds that inflicted by the initial injury. Long since scabbed over, the wound is nonetheless swollen and discolored. Your headache shows no sign of abating. Despite sleeping through the night, all you want to do is curl up in a ball and close your eyes, your body exhausted from its feeble attempts to combat this malady.

Carnivorous Tree Devouring.name:
食肉树噬吞
Carnivorous Tree Devouring

Text.text:
层叠的树舌菌与藤蔓将一具尸体钉在树皮上。它的眼睛与牙齿完好无损，枯槁的皮肉紧贴在骨头上。那株枝叶繁茂、浓绿鲜活的树拥抱着这具躯体，将其吞噬；而残骸的目光仍凝望远方，仿佛在后悔当初倚在这里休息的决定。
Shelf fungus and vines pin a corpse to the bark of a tree. The eyes and teeth are intact and emaciated flesh clings to its bones. The leafy tree, rich and vibrant, embraces the body, consuming it, even as the remains stare into the distance as if regretting the decision to lean here for rest.

Three Days Of Travel On Foot By Road In.name:
在绵密不息的降雪中，沿着道路徒步旅行三日
Three Days Of Travel On Foot By Road In Steady Snowfall

Text.text:
你在雪地里艰难跋涉，积雪随着每一小时的流逝愈发深厚。即便你偶尔发现先行者留下的痕迹，那些脚印也在迅速被雪填平。乡野披着一层动人的银装，却渐渐化作一片无边无际、刺眼夺目的惨白，让你难以辨清方向。每次扎营，你都在寻找天气转晴的迹象，可天空始终固执地阴云密布。三天里，你靠清汤寡食度日，忍受刺痛的雪粒与酸胀的肌肉……终于，在一幕飞舞雪帘之后，你望见了目的地。
You trudge through snow that grows deeper with every passing hour. Even when you discover traces of those who have passed before you, their tracks are filling in quickly. The countryside, though beautifully clad in snow, begins to look like an endless tract of blinding white, making it difficult to keep your bearings. Whenever you make camp, you search for signs of clear weather, but the sky remains stubbornly cloudy. After three days of lean meals, stinging snowflakes, and aching muscles… through a curtain of dancing snow, you finally spot your destination.

Loot From A Hydra.name:
九头蛇的战利品
Loot From A Hydra

Text.text:
卡在几张不同嘴巴的牙缝间的是些细小的皮革碎屑与铆钉。再仔细看其中两枚铆钉，才发现它们竟是价值不菲的钻石。
Lodged in the teeth of various mouths are small chips of leather and studs. A closer look at two of the studs reveals them to be diamonds of good worth.

你屏息凝神，盯着指尖捏着的那颗小珠；你和同伴同时感到一幅由纯粹力场织成的帷幕缓缓垂落，将你们笼罩在安稳的界限之内。在这处微小却牢固的堡垒中停留期间，你们几乎不必担心报复或伏击的侵扰。
Peering intently at the small bead held in your fingertips, you and those with you sense a curtain of pure force descending over and enveloping you within its safe confines. From this small but secure redoubt you are free from most reprisals or ambushes during your sojourn.

悄无声息地，数根长短不一的钟乳石从黏附在洞窟穹顶的阴影中坠落。它们落下得像是带着目的，你看见每一根下坠的尖刺在上端附近都在蠕动扭转，以校正自己的轨迹。每个顶端都环着一圈攫握的利爪，而利爪之下，一只红眼贪婪地盯向地面。一张布满细小尖牙、咔咔作响的巨口垂涎欲滴，迫不及待。

~ 由 Battersby 构想

Silently, several stalactites of various lengths fall from the shadows that cling to the cavern ceiling. They drop with purpose, and you see that every plummeting spike squirms and twists near its upper end to adjust its trajectory. On each top, there’s a ring of grasping claws, and under those, one red eye eagerly gazes floorward. A gnashing maw filled with tiny fangs slavers in anticipation.

~ Envisioned by Battersby

Temple To A God Of Protection.name:
守护之神的神殿
Temple To A God Of Protection

Text.text:
正如这类神殿一贯的格局，这座神殿就坐落在入城门内不远处。雕像立柱刻绘着守护神跨越各个时代的不同面貌；抛光的石墙与石地一路引向一处戒备森严的圣所，内里讲坛被塑成一面塔盾的形状。与城外的圣龛一样，祭坛前陈列着断折的兵刃与护甲碎片——那是从一次次守护民众的胜利防御中收集来的敬献之物。
As is typical for such a temple, this one found just inside a gate into the city. Its statuary columns depict versions of the protector god throughout the ages, and its polished stone walls and floors lead to a fortified sanctuary with a pulpit shaped like a tower shield. As in shrines outside the city, the altars are honored by broken weapons and pieces of armor collected from successful defenses of the people.

I Cast Conjure Fey.name:
我施放了「妖精召唤」
I Cast Conjure Fey

Text.text:
我的手势俏皮，甚至滑稽，而我吟诵的诗句满是撩拨与诱引。若缺了恰到好处的幽默与魅力，这场召唤便可能功亏一篑。它最终落在友谊的词句与伸出的手上——我摊开掌心，等待妖精界那只相契的手在空气中凝现，握住我的手作为盟约的印记，而那善变的存在也随之在我眼前渐渐显形。
My gestures are playful, even funny, and the verses I recite are full of enticement. Without the right humor and appeal, the summoning might fail. It ends on words of friendship and an outstretched hand, waiting for a matching hand of the faerie realm to materialize and clasp mine in agreement as the rest of the mercurial being appears.

Loot From A Succubus Or Incubus.name:
魅魔或梦魔身上的战利品
Loot From A Succubus Or Incubus

Text.text:
恶魔在一阵烈焰中咒骂着你、随即消散，只留下它为自身险恶目的所携带的实体物品：一袋银色钱币，一把纤细的匕首——柄首镶着一枚红色宝石——以及一条雅致的金链——或许是某位求爱者的赋礼。
As the fiend vanishes in a burst of flame, cursing you, it leaves behind the material objects it was carrying for its own nefarious purposes: a pouch of silver coins, a slender dagger with a red stone set in the pommel, and an elegant golden chain—perhaps a gift from a suitor.

这根法杖堪称艺术品——是匠人技艺的巅峰之作。光滑的深色木材被雕琢成如宝石切面般的几何嵌板，优雅的符文沿着杖身全长，细致地刻在每一处带棱角的位面上。法杖顶端镶着一枚妖异的蓝色水晶，被巧匠精雕成一只冷峻而专横的猫头鹰，审视并裁断任何妄图执掌它之人的价值。
This staff is a work of art—the culmination of an artisan’s craft. The smooth, dark wood has been shaped into geometric panels like the facets of a gem, and elegant runes have been carefully etched into each angled plane the entire length of the stave. A lurid blue crystal adorns the top of the staff, expertly carved into the form of a stern, imperious owl which judges the worth of those who would wield it.

Panopticon In The Net.name:
网中全景监狱
Panopticon In The Net

Text.text:
监控化身的活体凝视，这名守望者俯瞰一切。它栖身于阴暗之处——无处不在，勤勉不懈，随时待命。传输被解密，秘密被揭开，而每一纳秒都会挖出一口新的信息碎屑。隐蔽摄像头、暗藏录音器、无声无人机，以及贪婪的导管，皆为其工具。它是无面窥视者，手握万亿只警觉的眼。

~ 由一位英雄 设想

A living gaze of surveillance incarnate, this watcher surveys all. In the dark places, it dwells—omnipresent, diligent, ready. Transmissions are decrypted, secrets are unveiled, and every nanosecond a new morsel of information is uncovered. Hidden cameras, secreted recorders, silent drones, and conduits of greed are its tools. It is a faceless voyeur armed with a trillion watchful eyes.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Magical Detection Of A Blood Hunter's Cl.name:
血猎人的职业魔法侦测
Magical Detection Of A Blood Hunter's Class

Text.text:
你凝视着你的目标，却在脑海中看见一幅血色幻象。你的心脏随之轰然作响，沉重的搏动声穿透全身、回荡在眼后、灌满耳畔——整整三下。
You look at your target, but you see a vision of blood in your mind. Your heart booms out in response, beating loudly—through your body, behind your eyes, in your ears—for three beats.

Frankkóttir The High Elf School Of Evoca.name:
弗兰科蒂尔：高等精灵塑能学派法师
Frankkóttir The High Elf School Of Evocation Wizard

Text.text:
一个纤细的身影蜷身伏在角落的桌旁，正疯狂地在一本厚重的巨著上疾书，仿佛完全没察觉到你的存在。书边蜷着一只毛茸茸的白猫，半睁一只眼打量你，随即不耐烦地发出一声喵呜。那身影被这声音吓得猛地站起——比你预想的高出许多，精致的高等精灵五官与一头凌乱的浅金色头发形成鲜明反差。看他们皱巴巴的长袍就知道，这人已经埋头忙了好几个小时，甚至好几天，并未料到会有人打扰。

~ 由 Tyler 扮演，来自 RPGBOT.net

A slender figure sits hunched over a table in the corner, scribbling furiously into a thick tome, seemingly oblivious to your presence. The fluffy white cat curled up next to the book opens an eye to study you, before letting out an annoyed mewl. The figure jumps to their feet with surprise at the sound, much taller than you expected, their delicate high elven features at odds with their disheveled pale gold hair. From the state of their rumpled robes they seem to have been working for several hours, if not days, and had not been expecting interruption.

~ Played by Tyler from RPGBOT.net

The Sanctuary: Beaver Dam.name:
圣所：海狸坝
The Sanctuary: Beaver Dam

Text.text:
湖岸边，水波轻柔拍岸，本应宁静，却时不时被震耳的溅水声与尾巴拍击水面的脆响打破。区域里高耸的橡树与枫树多半已被啃倒，拖入水中；巨大的木料、枝条与淤泥堆成一座拦坝，堵住了水流。各个体型的海狸在湖面间穿梭沉浮，而坝上的海狸仍不停忙碌，继续加固它们的工程。
The serene lapping of water on the lakeshore is periodically broken by loud splashes and the slaps of tails. Most of the towering oak and maple trees in the area have been chewed down and dragged into the water, the massive pile of logs, twigs, and mud now blocking its flow. Beavers of all sizes dip in and out of the lake while those on the dam continue their construction efforts.

矮人把一头黑发紧紧束在脑后。一只眼上夹着黄铜单片目镜，将他正用镊子小心夹放宝石碎屑的微小设定放大得纤毫毕现。他的胡须被几十枚精巧的金环束起，你还瞥见他耳垂上晃动的金耳环——显然，这是个把自家货色戴在身上的矮人。
The dwarf wears his dark hair tied tightly behind his head. A brass eyepiece clenched by one eye magnifies the tiny setting into which he is carefully placing flecks of gemstone with tweezers. His beard is bound by dozens of delicate golden rings, and you spot gold earrings swinging from his ears—clearly this is a dwarf who wears his wares.

Mage Quip About Children.name:
法师对孩子的俏皮话
Mage Quip About Children

Text.text:
“你知道，要是非得在我孩子的爱和魔法之间做选择，我只能选魔法。也许会冒犯某些人，但我随时都能召唤一个孩子；等我累了或厌了，也能同样轻易地让他们消失。”
“You know, if I had to choose between the love of my child and magic, I’d have to choose magic. That may offend some, but I can always summon a child; then when I’m tired or bored I can make them disappear just as easily.”

Daeren Xiphones.name:
戴伦·西福尼斯
Daeren Xiphones

Text.text:
这位满怀慈悲的精灵隐居林野，既是修行的德鲁伊，也是离群的隐士。他出身太阳精灵，若非长年清瘦的荒野生活，举手投足本该更显贵雅。他的眼眸与长发皆是金色，仿佛自内而外流淌着温柔的光；然而他的皮质护甲却朴素得近乎无华。他的盾牌与长杖，皆取材于达伦在挚爱的森林里拾得与寻得之物。

~ 由 达伦扮演

This elf of great compassion lives as a practicing druid and hermit. He is an elf of the sun, and would seem courtly if not for his lean life in the wilderness. His eyes and hair are golden, shining with a kindness that radiates from within, but his leather armor is simple. His shield and quarterstaff are crafted from what Daeren has found in his beloved forest.

~ Played by Daeren

Gnomish Factory Town.name:
侏儒工厂镇
Gnomish Factory Town

Text.text:
这座城市钢铁与石材的无数层级——从其根基处的熔炉到天际线上刺破云霄的尖塔——一层压着一层，仿佛紧密堆叠的沉积岩层。夜里，渐渐稀落的炉火余辉可在数里之外仍依稀可见，像是黑暗中的工业灯塔。城墙之内，侏儒们奔走忙碌，其间偶有咕哝抱怨的矮人或焦头烂额的人类穿梭其间。白昼时分，下层传来的喧嚣震耳欲聋——齿轮咔咔转动，滑轮嗡嗡飞旋，风箱以诡异的节律吞吐起伏，令人恍惚间觉得整座城市在呼吸：一进，一出；一进，一出。然而，当工作日落幕，一种阴森的寂静便笼罩这片巨城，成千上万在此劳作的人们涌向上层——那里有食物、麦酒与音乐在等待。

~ 由一位英雄设想

The city’s myriad tiers of steel and stone—from the forges at its foundation to the spires of its skyline—sit atop one another like tightly packed layers of sediment. At night, the glow from the dwindling forges can be glimpsed for miles around, a sort of industrialized beacon in the darkness. Within the city’s walls, gnomes bustle around, the occasional grumbling dwarf or harried human among them. In daylight hours, the noise from the lower levels is deafening—gears cranking, pulleys whirring, billows inhaling and exhaling with an uncanny rhythm that creates an illusion of the city breathing: in and out, in and out. But as the work day concludes an eerie quiet settles over the metropolis, and the thousands who work here make for the upper levels, where food, ale, and music await.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Ancient Tree By A Poisoned Lake.name:
毒湖畔的古老巨树
Ancient Tree By A Poisoned Lake

Text.text:
污浊的树汁渗入湖水，像墨汁泼洒在纸页上般扩散开来。渗血的树下草地枯黄死寂，仿佛被那黏稠渗出的东西夺走了生机，而树皮苍白如漂白的枯骨。一柄古老的战斧——斧柄几乎已腐朽殆尽——深深嵌在巨橡树的树干里，正是它引发了这股从树中倾泻而出的腐化洪流。

~ Clara C. Potter 于 Discord

Tainted sap bleeds into the waters of the lake, spreading like spilt ink across a page. The grass beneath the bleeding tree is brown and dead, as if robbed of life by the oozing substance, and the tree's bark is as pale as bleached bone. An ancient axe—its haft all but rotted away—is buried in the trunk of the large oak and causing the corrupting deluge from the tree.

~ Clara C. Potter on Discord

Shattered Supernatural Mirror.name:
破碎的超自然魔镜
Shattered Supernatural Mirror

Text.text:
镜前的碎玻璃与新鲜、鲜亮的血滴混在一起，一阵诡异的冷风在房间里游荡——可窗户明明紧闭。镜子古旧镜框上褪色的金箔在多处剥落，露出下方抛光的木质纹理，以及其上雕刻的符号。低沉而阴森的咯咯笑声缓缓攀升，灯光忽明忽灭，随即彻底熄灭。

~

The shattered glass in front of the mirror mingles with droplets of fresh, bright blood, and an eerily cool breeze drifts through the room—but the window is closed. The faded gold veneer of the mirror's antique frame is flaking in several places, revealing the polished wood beneath and the symbols carved upon it. A low, haunting cackle builds slowly as the lights flicker and go out.

~

Sundries From A Great Stag.name:
大雄鹿的杂货
Sundries From A Great Stag

Text.text:
这头雄鹿要费一番功夫才能就地处理干净，但只要抹盐腌好、妥善储存，足够五个人吃上两周还绰绰有余。皮子、蹄子和鹿角都能回收利用。
The stag will take work to field dress, but salted and stored, it could feed five people well for two weeks. The hide, hooves, and antlers are all salvageable.

莹亮的象牙漆覆在这柄华美的长枪之上，金丝花纹如闪烁的常春藤般缠绕着武器。锥形枪身渐收至菱形锋尖，坚硬得足以贯穿任何防御——无论是巨龙覆鳞的厚皮，还是军阀熏黑的板甲。
Gleaming ivory lacquer covers the magnificent lance, with gold filigree winding around the weapon like glittering ivy. The conical shape tapers to a diamond tip hard enough to pierce through any defense, be it a dragon’s scaly hide or a warlord’s blackened plate.

The Sanctuary: Humanoid-sized Ruins To S.name:
圣所：西南方的人形大小废墟
The Sanctuary: Humanoid-sized Ruins To Southwest

Text.text:
诡异的寂静笼罩着那些从沙海中刺出的巨型建筑残骸。你扫视着唯有巨人才能建造的结构，连灼热的风声都仿佛随之消隐。原本应当在深灰色石料上留下印记的细节，早被多年砂砾的打磨与冲刷磨得光滑无痕。最醒目的建筑是一座破败的穹顶，自遗迹中央阴沉地俯瞰着四周。
Eerie silence blankets the remains of the humongous buildings that poke through the desert sand. Even the sound of the hot breeze seems to fade as you scan structures that only a giant could build. Any features that would have marked the dark gray stone have been worn smooth by years of sandblasting. The most prominent building is a decrepit dome that ominously overlooks the ruins from their center.

Dungeon: Ascending Hall.name:
地城：上行长厅
Dungeon: Ascending Hall

Text.text:
大厅以斜坡向上抬升，逼得你一步步艰难上行。地面布满裂痕与碎屑，都是年代侵蚀留下的斑驳伤口。你继续前进，空气渐渐带上些许暖意，墙壁也不再那么昏暗潮湿。
The hall raises in an incline, forcing you to trudge uphill. The floor is patterned with cracks and splinters from the degradation of age. As you progress, the air begins to feel slightly warmer and the walls less dark and damp.

虚无，一片空洞，向四面八方无尽延展。残骸——来自无数世界与万千位面的漂浮碎屑与废物——在绚丽多彩的尘云间漫无目的地游荡。这里没有重力将你压住。
Nothingness, a void, extending infinitely in all directions. Debris, the flotsam and jetsam of countless worlds and a multitude of planes, float aimlessly among clouds of brightly-colored dust. No gravity weighs you down here.

这名鸟类人形的双翼在背后轻轻振动，收拢垂落，如一袭羽毛斗篷覆在肩头。祂的眼睛又大又游移，仿佛能穿透你，连魔法与血肉一并洞察，只为看清万物的真相。祂察觉到你时，喙与利爪好奇地轻轻咔哒作响。
The wings of this avian humanoid flutter on their back, folded and draped like a cloak of feathers across their shoulders. Their eyes, large and roaming, seem to peer through you, penetrating magic and flesh alike to see the truth of things. They click their beak and claws curiously as they perceive you.

Damascus Huckleberry Naïlo.name:
大马士革黑果越橘·奈洛
Damascus Huckleberry Naïlo

Text.text:
此人身形威严，橙色皮毛覆着猿猴般的手足，身后一条修长的尾巴末端蓬起成穗。眼眸如猫般锐利，面容却明朗精致、近似人类，脸上涂着白粉并点缀黄色纹彩。额前编起的发辫与一束马尾勉强收束住不羁的黑色波浪发丝。他们的穿着风格独树一帜——从带花饰、层叠袖口的燕尾外套，到披着一袭秋色羽毛斗篷；从黄色灯笼裤，到脚踝缀着木铃的脚环。外套下剑柄仅微微探出一角，而一把精致的梨形鲁特琴却毫不遮掩地耀眼陈列。

~ 扮演：Christoffer

This individual has an imposing physique, with orange-furred, simian hands and feet, and a long, tufted tail. Their eyes are catlike, but their face is cheerful and fine featured, humanoid, painted white with yellow accents. Front braids and a ponytail barely contain unruly waves of black locks. They dress with unique style—from a tailcoat with flowery, layered sleeves to a cape of autumn-hued feathers, from yellow pantaloons to anklets of wooden bells. A sword hilt just peeks out of their jacket, but a fine, pear-shaped lute is on full display.

~ Played by Christoffer

环顾此室，不禁让人想起无数使节曾在王座前那早被压扁的天鹅绒上屈膝，拆开护喉或臂甲的系带。又有多少异邦骑士献上华饰之剑作信物，或将挂着本国旌旗的长枪送来，悬在比武场的围栏旁？还有那位入侵君主的头盔——被一名队长从她断首上取下，又把自己的头盔掷到她的领主与贵妇们的帐前？它们尽在王家宝库里：银与金，青铜与纹章的彩绘，这些宏伟的兵器。这些战利品护甲。

~ 由Cooper 构想

Looking around this room brings to mind the numerous ambassadors who have knelt on the long-crushed velvet before the throne to unwrap gorget or bracers. How many foreign knights have given an ornamental sword as a token, or a lance bearing the standard of their nation to hang along the lists? The helmet from an invading monarch—taken by a captain from her severed head and dropped his helmet at her lord and ladies’ tent? They are all here in the royal vault, silver and gold, bronze and the paints of heraldry, these great weapons. This trophy armor.

~ Envisioned by Cooper

Loot From A Skeletal Dog.name:
骷髅犬的战利品
Loot From A Skeletal Dog

Text.text:
褴褛的长袍昭示着此人已成这条致命恶犬的受害者，破裂的布线间还嵌着几枚残留的牙齿。你在衣袍口袋里摸到一只绣着青绿色线三角纹的挎袋，里面装着一些钱币；还有一枚青铜护符，铸成鹰的形状，系在一截磨毛的麻绳末端。
