Tattered robes denote a victim to this deadly dog, and some teeth remain embedded in torn lines of the cloth. Within the pockets of the garment you find a satchel embroidered with teal-threaded triangles that contains some coins, and a bronze talisman in the shape of an eagle at the end of a bit of frayed, hempen rope.

Davorax Belnak.name:
达沃拉克斯·贝尔纳克
Davorax Belnak

Text.text:
光滑明亮的鳞片以斑驳的猩红色自鼻端一路覆至尾尖，披在这位仪态端正的龙裔身上。那抹红与他酒红色的软甲相融，又衬得他所穿抛光钢制锁子甲愈发冷冽耀眼。弯曲的象牙色长角沿着头皮弧形后掠，从金色眼眸上方起，一直延伸到脑后。髋侧，一柄修长笔直的长刃安静卧于鞘中；背上系着一条肩带，挂着一面暖炉形盾牌，边缘嵌着磨亮的钢圈。尽管他姿态与装束都透着军旅肃然，这名战士的目光却坦然敞亮。

~ 由 lewis 以 扮演

Smooth, bright scales in variegated scarlets cover this stately dragonborn from nose to tail tip. The reds blend with his burgundy gambeson, and offset the chain hauberk of polished steel he wears. Curving ivory horns sweep along his scalp from just above his golden eyes to behind his head. At his hip, a long, straight blade rests in its sheath. Slung from a baldric on his back is a heater shield with a rim of burnished steel. Despite his bearing and attire, this warrior has an open gaze.

~ Played by lewis with

凿穿巨大冰川的冰洞看上去几乎像异界造物：洞顶布满怪异的齿状褶皱——时而光滑，时而嶙峋，在毫无规律的醒目纹路间交替延展——尤其是在你携带的光源映照下，那些反光更显诡谲。每迈出一步，周遭融冰的噼啪脆响与断裂的爆声便将你层层裹住，令你心底的恐惧不断攀升，不管这洞穴的年代与稳固程度如何。
The ice cave carved through the immense glacier looks almost alien in its weird crenellations along its ceiling—alternately smooth and ridged in eye-catching, random patterns—and particularly in the reflections of a carried light source. With every step, the crackle and snap of the melting ice surrounding you fills you with mounting dread, regardless of the cave’s age and stability.

Insult About Length Of Evil Speech.name:
嘲讽邪恶演说太长
Insult About Length Of Evil Speech

Text.text:
“抱歉，还有多少没完？可不是人人都有永恒的时间来听这些废话。”
“I’m sorry, is there much more? Not all of us have an eternity to listen to this drivel.”

Kridius Kingsglaive.name:
克里迪乌斯·王刃
Kridius Kingsglaive

Text.text:
暴风猛击着小镇，嘶嘶的狂飙如同鞭挞，抽打着镇民，他们仓皇缩着肩头往家里奔。就在那座破败教堂的幽深处，一名披甲者走出，影中之影。他像谜一样显现，身上的铠甲棱角嶙峋，却依旧步伐诡谲而优雅。雨珠沿着遮住面孔的兜帽倾泻而下，在那被雨浸透的褶皱深处，隐约透出一抹空灵的微光。他穿行于人群，周身弥漫着可触的惶然气息——一种将他整个人包裹起来的恐惧。电光在头顶跃动，炽白的闪耀照亮街面，瞬息间映出一名佝偻、狼狈的身影，如同幽魂般尾随这位黑暗骑士。黑暗复归时，那身影便消失无踪，仿佛从未存在过。

~ Played by Keanu Soto with

A storm batters the town, hissing squalls hammering at its denizens as they scurry home. From the depths of a ruined church, an armored figure emerges, a shadow among shadows. He manifests like an enigma, moving with an eerie grace despite the jagged panoply he wears. Raindrops cascade down the hood concealing his face, an etheric luminescence visible within its sodden folds. As he stalks through the crowd, a palpable aura of disquiet surrounds him, a dread that sheathes his very presence. Lightning dances above, its actinic brilliance illuminating the street and momentarily revealing a hunched, bedraggled figure trailing the dark knight like some spectral shadow. As the dark returns, the figure vanishes as if it were never there.

~ Played by Keanu Soto with

Attack Helicopter Strafes A City Street.name:
攻击直升机扫射城市街道
Attack Helicopter Strafes A City Street

Text.text:
直升机旋翼的嗡鸣声愈发震耳，它贴地俯冲而来——宛如一只巨大的机械猛禽。机载枪械疯狂扫射，子弹如雨倾泻，金属在撞击混凝土时尖啸吱嘎作响。尘土轰然扬起，化作一团巨大的灰云，吞没街道与奔逃的人群，直到所有人都成了在窒息帷幕中挣扎的鬼影。
The sound of the helicopter’s whirring blades grows louder as it swoops low to the ground—like a great, mechanical bird of prey. Bullets spray from its mounted guns, the metal whistling and squeaking as it pelts against concrete. Dust rises in a massive cloud, obscuring the street and fleeing people until all are ghosts struggling within a choking veil.

Haunted House: Secret, Subterranean Stai.name:
鬼屋：隐秘的地下阶梯
Haunted House: Secret, Subterranean Staircase

Text.text:
活板门顽固得很，但在你不屈不挠的折腾下，终于松动，哐啷一声猛地弹开。你看见下方只有一小段落差，接着是一道陡峭的阶梯，阶面光滑而结实，向下延伸，没入屋子的地基深处。一股令人作呕的臭味扑面而来，你不由得把鼻子埋进手肘弯里。那是腐烂的肉味？陈年的菌腥？久滞不流的死水？……还是某种截然不同的东西？
The trap door is stubborn, but eventually it gives way to your dogged attempts and flies open with a clatter. You see a short drop to a steep set of stairs, smooth and sturdy, that descend past the foundations of the house. The whiff of an unpleasant odor has you burying your nose in the crook of your elbow. Is that rotting meat? The pungent smell of old fungi? A long-stagnant pool of water? …or something else altogether?

Cultists Infiltrating A Besieged City.name:
邪教徒渗入被围城池
Cultists Infiltrating A Besieged City

Text.text:
金属撞击声轰然炸裂，撕碎了这冬日的死寂。你挤开瞪大眼的拥挤人群，他们面容因恐惧而消瘦，凄厉的呼喊从你耳畔掠过。你看见守卫们冲上前去，在前门处列阵，头盔投下的阴影将他们的神情压得愈发阴沉。当大门在另一侧雷霆般的巨力下猛烈震颤时，他们爆发出一声振奋的齐吼。刀剑与长矛被高高举起，嘈杂的碰撞声乱作一团。你迈步上前，准备与他们并肩、投入混战之际，一声震耳欲聋的当啷迫使你停住脚步，回头望去。一个身披暗袍的身影从下水道井口钻出，袖口破烂、满身污泥，脸上拉出一道恶毒的狞笑。她手握匕首，猛扑向最近的守卫——那人惨叫着，她将那把弯曲的刀刃一次又一次狠狠劈下。她周身迸射出魔法的火花，伴随着尖啸般的含混咒言。“他们来了！”一名市民指向一条巷子——那里涌出一群同样披袍的人影，同样臭气熏天、浑身污垢。

~ 由一位英雄在 Envisioned 中构想

A crash of metal shatters the stillness of this winter day. You push through the wide-eyed crowd, faces gaunt with terror—fearful cries tearing past your ears. You see members of the guard push through to assemble at the front gate, their expressions darkened by the shadows of their helms. A rallying shout rises from them when the gates shudder with the thunderous force from the other side. Swords and spears are raised in a riotous clatter. As you step to join them, to enter the fray, a deafening clang makes you pause and turn. A dark-robed figure, sleeves tattered and covered in muck, emerges from a manhole with a malicious snarl streaked across her face. Dagger in hand, she pounces on the nearest guard, who wails as she brings the crooked blade down, again and again. Sparks of magic discharge from her body as she shrieks an incoherent chant. “They’re here!” A citizen points at an alley from which pours a group of robed figures, similarly stinking and covered in grime.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Sundries From A Winter Wolf.name:
冬狼杂货
Sundries From A Winter Wolf

Text.text:
这只生物杂驳的白色皮毛在刺骨的极地寒风中微微起伏，它静静卧在雪地里一动不动。下颌大张，像是在无声嚎叫，头颅向前耷拉着，你看见它的獠牙在光线下泛着微微的寒芒。你接触其中一枚，试图把它撬下来，却发现它冷得刺痛，冰寒透骨。
The creature’s mottled white fur shifts in the frigid arctic breeze as it lies still in the snow. Jaw hanging wide in a silent howl, its head lolls forward, and you notice its fangs shimmering in the light. You touch one, hoping to pry it free, and find it is painfully cold to the touch.

Lantern Of Revealing.name:
照真提灯
Lantern Of Revealing

Text.text:
一只风格化的眼睛自灯笼的躯体中窥视而出，瞳孔燃起探照般的光芒。灯笼的罩檐覆在开口上方，做成下垂眼睑的样式——仿佛随时会落下，将其中的光亮压暗。
A stylized eye peers from the body of the lantern, its pupil ablaze with probing light. The lantern’s hood rests above the aperture, fashioned in the style of a drooping eyelid—waiting to descend and dim the light within.

铁与木铸成的高大身影伫立无声，纹丝不动。它有人形轮廓，却由金属锻就；全身不见独特徽记，唯有胸口刻着一枚符文——那是其制造者兼主人的印记。你一靠近，这生物便伴着刺耳的摩擦嗡鸣动了起来，无眼的头颅缓缓转动，追随着你的一举一动。它吱呀一响便旋身而转，你这才切实感到：尽管沉重得骇人，这东西却能以惊人的速度行动。
The towering figure of iron and wood stands silent, unmoving. Humanoid in shape, but forged of metal, the construct bears no unique markings save the rune etched into its chest—the touchmark of its maker and master. As you approach, the creature moves with a grinding whir, its eyeless head rotating to follow your movements. With a creak, it swivels, and you get a sense for just how quickly the thing can move, despite its immense weight.

I Cast Delayed Blast Fireball.name:
我施放延时爆裂火球
I Cast Delayed Blast Fireball

Text.text:
当我吟诵法术的词句时，炼狱般的狂怒在我体内翻涌升腾。指间滚动的鸟粪与硫磺之球逐渐炽白灼烫，仿佛一座暴怒的熔火之渊正在我掌心酝酿，随时要从指尖倾泻而出。我短暂停顿——让热浪稍稍退去——又添上几句咒文，将它的喷发延后。随后我手势一扬，将那团火球疾掷向我的目标。
I feel the fury of the inferno building within me as I intone the words of the spell. The ball of guano and sulfur rolling between my fingers grows white hot as I prepare to unleash the raging caldera at my fingertips. I pause briefly—allowing the heat to subside—and add a few more words to the incantation to delay its eruption. Then, with a flourish, I hurl the ball towards my target.

Predator Ambush During A Long Rest In Th.name:
丛林长时间休息期间的掠食者伏击
Predator Ambush During A Long Rest In The Jungle

Text.text:
在篝火旁交换了几句低语后，你的伙伴们开始休息。头顶上，树冠破开一道缺口，玫瑰色的天幕中群星浮现——边缘镀着金光，逐渐过渡为灰色。你的守夜在灼热的丛林地表上开始了。月亮升起时，噼啪作响的火焰与嗡鸣不绝的虫声仿佛骤然停息，一声沉重的咆哮在林下回荡。丛林间显出一道移动的剪影，影叠着影，正以极快的速度拉近与你之间的距离……
After sharing whispers around the campfire, your companions start their rest. Above you, through a hole in the canopy, stars appear in the rose-tinted sky—edged with gold and transitioning to grey. Your watch has begun amid the heated jungle floor. As the moon rises, the constant noise of the crackling fire and the buzzing of insects seems to cease when a heavy growl echoes through the understory. The jungle reveals a moving silhouette, shadow upon shadow, closing the gap between you very quickly…

Verinshynx, The Defiler.name:
维林辛克斯，亵渎者
Verinshynx, The Defiler

Text.text:
一阵刺骨的寒意先于黑暗之主的现身而至。阴影骤然加深，拉长如盘结的骸骨手指。那半死之躯瘦削而挺直，锋利如匕首；风霜刻蚀的鹰隼般面容，仿佛曾经也算英俊。黑色层叠长袍以银边镶饰，披挂在他身上，令人联想到一只巨蝠，将皮革般的翼膜收拢贴伏。他倚着一根黑曜骨杖，而在他渐秃的头顶，一道缠绕的银色荆棘冠冕静静安放。

~ Played by ae0n5105

A penetrating chill precedes the Dark One’s appearance. The shadows deepen, elongating like gnarled, skeletal fingers. The half-dead being stands slim and straight-backed, sharp as a dagger, with weathered, hawkish features that might have once been handsome. Black, layered robes trimmed with silver drape the man’s form, evoking something akin to a massive bat with its leathery wings furled. He leans on a staff of onyx bone, and atop his balding pate, a circlet of entwined silver thorns rests.

~ Played by ae0n5105

魔咒渗入心底。地精那布满疣子的额头松弛下来，眉毛上挑，豁然舒展开来。他那泛黄的眼睛骤然睁大。方才还挂在脸上的狰狞咆哮渐渐松脱，鼻梁不再皱起，獠牙外露的嘴也咧开成一抹下巴松垮、缺牙漏风的傻笑。他前倾探身，伸手去够，口水从嘴角一侧坠落，兴奋地喘鸣不止。空气里弥漫着他呼吸的酸馊臭味。

~ 设想：Ryan Durbin

The enchantment sinks in. The goblin’s warty brow eases, his brows pulling up and open. His jaundiced eyes widen. The snarl he just wore loosens, his nose unwrinkling and his fanged mouth spreading into a slack-jawed, gap-toothed grin. Leaning forward, he reaches out, drool falling from one side of his lips, and wheezes excitedly. The air fills with the sour smell of his breath.

~ Envisioned by Ryan Durbin

Sundries From A Hydra.name:
九头蛇的杂货
Sundries From A Hydra

Text.text:
其中一颗头颅的颈项上，斩首断口下方留着一道旧日再度斩首的疤痕。疤口被粗粗缝合；当你拆去针线，发现伤口里竟藏着一张细小的纸条，仿佛系在鸟腿上的那种。纸条用一根纤细的麻绳扎紧。
On the neck below the decapitation point of one of the heads is the scar of a previous decapitation. It is sewn shut, and when you remove the stitches, you find stored in the wound a tiny note as if for a bird’s leg. It is tied with a fine hemp cord.

I Cast Enhance Ability To Bestow Owl's W.name:
我施放“强化能力”，赐予“猫头鹰的智慧”。
I Cast Enhance Ability To Bestow Owl's Wisdom

Text.text:
我眉头紧锁，陷入深沉思索，口中吟诵着法术的咒文，专注凝视掌心那根绒羽。脑海里传来遥远的鸟鸣尖啸，我感到瞳孔骤然放大，随即完成法术，将猫头鹰的古老智慧赐予他人。
My brow furrows in deep contemplation as I chant the words of the spell, concentrating on the downy feather in my hand. In my mind I hear a distant avian screech, feel my pupils dilate, and I complete the spell to bestow the Owl’s ancient wisdom.

Zenopus, The Harbinger.name:
泽诺普斯，先兆者
Zenopus, The Harbinger

Text.text:
一位年长的男人走近，按他的年代而言却魁梧得惊人。双臂肌肉圆润饱满，结实有力。银白的头发与胡须都梳理得一丝不乱，干净利落。他拄着一根木杖，却显然不是用来支援行走或站立。杖头嵌着的红宝石闪耀如新溅的鲜血般明亮。宝石下方，杖身木纹上刻着朴素的线痕——流畅的符文宛如振翅的飞鸟。他的装束朴素：米色长袍外套一件皮制短上衣。腰间皮带上系着一个简单的皮囊。乱风般的眉下，他的眼神朝你这边阴沉地灼视。他张口欲言，声音如惊雷轰然炸响。“听着！听着，否则后悔，流浪者。因为这些话我只能说一次！”
An older man approaches, and he is quite strapping for his age. The muscles of his arms are rounded, full and strong. His silver hair and beard are both coiffed and clean. He bears a wooden staff but clearly not for support in walking or standing. The ruby set into its head gleams as bright as fresh-spilt blood. Underneath the gem, simple etchings mark the wood of the shaft—sweeping runes that resemble birds in flight. His garb is modest: a leather jerkin over beige robes. A simple leather pouch is strapped to the belt around his waist. His eyes glower in your direction under windswept eyebrows. He opens his mouth to speak, his voice a thunderclap. “Hark! Hark or regret, wanderer. For I can speak these words only once!”

I Cast Imprisonment Using A Likeness And.name:
我以相似物与宝珠施放禁锢
I Cast Imprisonment Using A Likeness And An Orb

Text.text:
我将那枚小小的秘银圆球覆在 目标 的描绘之上，随即开始吟诵咒语，要将他们牢牢缚于大地深处。双手在圆球上方织出繁复而强劲的奥术手势，一道摄人心魄的微光掠过它打磨得光洁的表面。

[豁免失败{/i>] 法术 以不断攀升的 速度 推向最高潮， 目标 在一团带着腐殖气息的泥土烟雾中骤然消失。

Placing the small mithral orb over the depiction of my target, I begin the incantation to bind them deep beneath the earth. My hands weave intricate gestures of arcane potency over the orb, and a mesmerizing shimmer flashes across its polished surface.

[Failed Save{/i>] At ever-increasing speed, the spell builds to a crescendo, and my target disappears in a plume of loamy soil.

钢靴踏地，轻板甲覆身，结实的臂膀裸露在外，他挥舞着一柄巨斧。腰带上别满匕首，还有一串串骨绳垂坠摇晃。于兽人之神的律令之下，部族战争乃一切纷争的终极裁断。战死的荣耀、家族的力量、生存的技艺——这些令神明展颜，短短的獠牙微微显露，满脸深绿的狰狞疤痕随之皱起。
Booted in steel, clad in light plate, muscular arms bared, he wields a great axe. Knives adorn his belt, along with the cords of bones that hang from it. Tribal warfare is ultimate resolution of any conflict under the god of the orcs. The honor of death in battle, the strength of family, the skills of survival—these make the god smile, revealing his short tusks and wrinkling a face full of deep green scars.

Sundries From A Vampire Lord.name:
吸血鬼领主的杂物
Sundries From A Vampire Lord

Text.text:
吸血鬼领主倒伏在地，已然败北，精致的衣饰被那颗焦黑心脏涌出的鲜血浸透。你在他紧身上衣的口袋里，瞥见一方奢华——却沾满血迹——的丝质手帕。手帕上绣工精绝，图案醒目：四颗星拱成一道弧，金线勾勒其辉；弧下是一对交叉长剑，而角落里以字母 S.V. 作了标记。
The vampire lord lies defeated, their fine attire soaked with blood from their blackened heart. In the pocket of the doublet, you notice a luxurious—blood-stained—silk handkerchief. It is expertly embroidered with a striking design: a pair of crossed swords beneath an arch of four stars, each picked out in golden thread, and the initials S.V. mark one corner.

Dangerous Mountain Pass.name:
危机四伏的山隘
Dangerous Mountain Pass

Text.text:
你们背后的风在穿过山口、绕过那条狭窄的岩脊时骤然转冷。头顶上，嶙峋的峭峰如巨影压迫，硬生生截断了愈发昏暗的天光。你们小心前行，靴底不经意一碰，几颗碎石便滚落，坠入下方深不见底的裂隙。你正警惕地扫过那些锋利岩石，却见原本以为是崖壁的一团轮廓竟在眼前微微挪动。你们的手摸向武器，收紧呼吸，稳住身形，准备迎接最坏的情况。
The wind at your backs turns cold as you make the turn around a narrow ledge through the mountain pass. Looming over you, the harsh peaks block any light from the darkening skies. A few pebbles fall into the deep crevasse below, nudged by your boots as you move forward carefully. You eye the sharp rocks when a shape you took for a cliff wall seems to shift before your eyes. Your hands find your weapons, and you steady yourselves for the worst.

Threat From A Rabbit Person.name:
来自兔人族的威胁
Threat From A Rabbit Person

Text.text:
“你最好小心点。要是我一蹦起来，尸体可就要一个接一个倒下。”
“You best be careful. If I start hopping, the bodies start dropping.”

Loot From A Mindwitness.name:
夺心眼魔的战利品
Loot From A Mindwitness

Text.text:
在那生物留下的浅浅凝结黏液池间，你发现了一些值钱的物件。在一具矮小骷髅（特征）破烂的背包里，你找到一枚打磨得锃亮、价值100金币的放大镜，一张你不认识的城堡地图，以及一只沉甸甸、装着140金币的袋子。
Amid the shallow pools of congealed slime the creature left behind, you find some valuable items. Inside the torn backpack of a diminutive skeleton, you find a polished magnifying glass worth 100 gold pieces, a map of a castle you do not recognize, and a hefty pouch of 140 gold pieces.

Warning From A Boatman.name:
船夫的警告
Warning From A Boatman

Text.text:
“我这一生几乎每天都在那片水域讨生活，可如今不一样了。潮汐出了岔子；涨落的节律变得僵硬而诡异。那锅浑汤里潜伏着某种恶意，你最好识趣，别把它惊醒。”
“I’ve spent nearly every day of my life on those waters, but something’s changed. The tides are off; their ebb and flow have grown stilted and unnatural. Some malice is lurking in that soup, and you would be wise not to wake it.”

一名龙裔站在那里，黄铜般的鳞吻朝向地面，宽檐帽的阴影遮住了他大半张脸。两侧胯间的褪色皮枪套里各插着一把左轮，木质握柄黑得像浓咖啡。他抬起带爪的手，挠了挠带刺的下巴，指节周围的鳞片染着一层暗红的铜锈。只要一点风吹草动——靴底在尘土里蹭过的声响、鹰的一声长啸——他便抬起鳞吻，露出一双熔金般的眼睛。他的脸扭出一种古怪的笑意，尖牙在嘴角夹着一支香烟。
A dragonborn stands with brass-scaled snout turned toward the ground, allowing his wide-brimmed hat to shade most of his face. In the faded leather holsters at each hip sit two revolvers, their wooden grips the color of black coffee. He brings a clawed hand up to scratch at his spined chin, the scales around his knuckles darkened with a reddish patina. At the slightest noise—a boot scratching through dirt, the call of an eagle—his snout lifts to reveal a pair of eyes the color of molten gold. His face twists into a quirky kind of grin, his sharp teeth pinching a cigarette at the corner of his mouth.

Whirlpool Salvage Operation Goes Wrong.name:
漩涡打捞行动酿成惨剧
Whirlpool Salvage Operation Goes Wrong

Text.text:
一声被扼住的惨叫伴着水花戛然而止，你的一名伙伴从船上栽入漩涡翻搅的水域。恐慌如涨潮般在众人间蔓延：有人抓起武器，有人高声提醒保持警戒，有人拼命在浪涛间搜寻失踪的朋友——以及把他们拖走的东西。

~ 由 Clara C. Potter 在 Discord 上构想

A strangled cry is cut short with a splash as one of your companions pitches from the boat into the churning waters of the whirlpool. Panic spreads through the group like a rising tide as people grab weapons, call out for vigilance, and desperately search the waves for their missing friend—and whatever took them.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Brom Of Beasts.name:
兽之布罗姆
Brom Of Beasts

Text.text:
泥土与麝香交融的气息先行而至，伴着一名青年缓慢的脚步——他身着绿色短袍，披着红润的斗篷。这个半精灵生着虎之双腿，裤管止于膝上，好让那猫科般的膝弯更便于移动；他拄着一根盘结粗糙的木杖。萤火虫随侍左右，发光的躯体洒下温暖的光，映亮他小麦色的面庞。他的灰眼平静清凉，宛如云雾笼罩的海岸；每侧颧骨上，一根纹刻的麻雀羽毛格外醒目。更多纹身——一幅狂野的百兽图景——覆满他的前臂、颈项与胸膛。他抬起一条色彩斑斓、拼布般的手臂，身后随之升起一抹阴影：一条巨大的眼镜蛇，鳞片呈午夜般的蓝黑。它将宽阔的头颅贴进他的掌心。野兽与主人一同含笑，安宁如水。

~ Played by Bob World Builder

A melded scent of dirt and musk precede the slow steps of a young man in a green tunic and ruddy cloak. The half-elf with the legs of a tiger, his pants ending at the knee to allow freer movement of the feline bend in his knees, leans on a gnarled staff. He is accompanied by fireflies, their glowing bodies casting warm light on his tawny face. His gray eyes are as calm and cool as a clouded coast, while a tattooed sparrow feather highlights each cheek bone. More tattoos—a wild tableaux of different fauna—cover his forearms, neck and chest. He raises one of his colorful, patchwork arms and a shadow rises behind him: a giant cobra with scales the blue-black of midnight. It presses its wide head into his palm. Both beast and master smile, serene.

~ Played by Bob World Builder

I Drink My Potion Of Hill Giant Strength.name:
我饮下我的丘陵巨人力量药水
I Drink My Potion Of Hill Giant Strength

Text.text:
吞下药剂时，那片厚厚的指甲碎片刮过我的舌头与喉咙，一路带着刺痒滑到胃里。我长长地、破碎地吐出一口气，腌渍般咸涩的味道黏在舌面上，令人作呕。我强忍着咳嗽，生怕一咳就会干呕起来；与此同时，我感觉手臂与双腿的肌肉骤然鼓胀。我强壮得仿佛能把一匹马整个从地上举起来。
The thick sliver of fingernail scratches my tongue and throat as I swallow the potion, leaving an itching trail all the way down to my stomach. I let out a ragged sigh, the pickled, salty taste lingering unpleasantly on my tongue. As I resist a cough for fear it will turn into a retch, I feel the muscles of my arms and legs swell. I feel strong enough to lift a horse clear off the ground.

Drow Excited About Prospective Kill.name:
卓尔因即将到手的猎杀而兴奋
Drow Excited About Prospective Kill

Text.text:
“哦哦哦，瞧瞧你。真是献给蛛后的一口多汁美味。我只要把你的头颅端上朝廷，点缀装饰，摆在银盘里，就能再往上爬一级。”
“Ooooh, look at you. What a succulent morsel for the spider queen. I’ll rise a rung higher by presenting your head in court, garnished and on a silver charger.”

Alter Self: Change Appearance.name:
变身术：改变外貌
Alter Self: Change Appearance

Text.text:
你四肢末梢那一丝微弱的刺痒骤然加剧，面容仿佛开始融化，依照你脑海中描绘的模样重新塑形。从你伙伴们的神情里，你看得出你的法术已然成功，你的外貌被彻底改换。
A faint tingling in your extremities intensifies greatly as your features begin to melt, reshaping themselves as you have pictured in your mind. From the faces of your companions, you can tell that your spell has been successful, your appearance completely altered.

I Help Slay A Fire Elemental While Weari.name:
我戴着火元素指挥之戒，协助猎杀一只火元素
I Help Slay A Fire Elemental While Wearing My Ring Of Fire Elemental Command

Text.text:
伴随着最后一次冲入狂暴烈焰的猛推，我的瞄准正中要害。元素的垂死尖啸顿时哑火，化作孱弱的喘鸣，它的形体迅速收缩，坍成地板上一堆黯淡的灰烬。灰堆里升起缕缕烟丝，如同一对眼镜蛇般盘旋而上，猛然朝我转向。它们在我身周游弋缠绕，将那被熄灭元素的炽烈魂火灌注进我的躯体。几颗小小的火焰光球在我周围跳舞，灵动明亮。
With a last push into the raging flame, my aim strikes true. The elemental's deathly shriek fizzles to a frail wheeze, its form shrinking to a pile of dim ash on the floor. Wisps of smoke rise from the pile, like twin cobras, and swerve toward me. They swim about my form, imbuing my body with the fiery spirit of the extinguished elemental. Small orbs of flame dance around me, playful and bright.

Distant Fortress In A Summer Forest.name:
夏日森林中的远方要塞
Distant Fortress In A Summer Forest

Text.text:
白昼的热意在你攀上岩石突起时渐渐消退，林木也随之稀疏，让出一线俯瞰山谷的视野。你脚下铺展开一片浓密的树冠海洋，唯有远处一座纤细的孤塔刺破绿浪——夕阳将那高耸的尖顶染成粉与金的层层光晕。从你的角度看不清更多细节，但那建筑的轮廓显得古老，而最顶层的窗内仍有一盏灯火在燃。
The heat of the day fades as you climb the stone outcrop, and the trees thin to allow a view of the valley. Beneath you stretches a dense canopy of treetops, broken by a single slender tower in the distance—the evening sun painting the lofty spire with shades of pink and gold. Little detail is visible from your vantage point, but the architecture seems ancient, and a light burns in the topmost window.

I Converse With A Necrotic Dragon.name:
我与一条死灵巨龙交谈
I Converse With A Necrotic Dragon

Text.text:
“也许你强大到足以碾碎我们。你古老而强横——我敢肯定，你早已处理过无数试图清洗你这份恶意的人。所以，我们也许会失败。但我们在你鳞甲上划出的每一道伤口、凿出的每一道裂隙，都会成为后来者把匕首狠狠捅进去的又一个入口。”
“Perhaps you will prove too much for us. You are ancient and powerful—I’m sure you’ve disposed of many who have tried to cleanse the world of your malice. So, we may fail. But every cut and chink we make in your scales is one more place for those who follow to drive a dagger.”

迷人的钢琴旋律回荡在酒店华丽的会客厅里，与奢华的陈设与装潢相得益彰。衣着考究的宾客们倚着吧台谈笑风生，或慵懒地陷在大沙发的红色天鹅绒靠垫间，尽情享受这份惬意。
Charming piano music fills the opulent lounge in the hotel, a perfect complement to the luxurious furnishings and decor. Guests in fine fashion laugh and mingle as they prop up the bar or luxuriate among the red velvet cushions of the large sofas.

Ancient Ziggurat.name:
远古金字形神塔
Ancient Ziggurat

Text.text:
这座金字塔般的巨构层层叠起，台阶大得足以让泰坦攀登。也许它正是为此而建——为比你更伟大的存在架起一条通往苍穹的阶梯。站在这座阴沉压迫的建筑基座前，你不由得觉得自己渺小如尘。一道漫长的阶梯沿着侧面蜿蜒而上，台阶虽巨大却仍合人类脚步，直通顶端那座神殿般的结构。不知为何，你脑中掠过一个念头：对许多人而言，第一次登上这座阶梯形神塔的顶端，也就是他们最后一次。
The pyramid-like structure rises in steps sized for a titan to climb. Perhaps that’s its purpose—a stairway to the heavens for beings greater than yourself. For here at the base of this glowering building, you can’t help but feel small. A long stairway of large, but human-sized, steps climbs the side to a temple-like structure at its top. For some reason it crosses your mind that, for many people, their first climb to the top of the ziggurat was their last.

Jungle Parley Among Rival Factions.name:
丛林中敌对派系的谈判
Jungle Parley Among Rival Factions

Text.text:
各方使团踏入这片神圣的林间空地时，彼此以跨越世代的疑惧相互打量。依照盟约，在“祖父之树”的注视下，这处圣地严禁携带任何武器。三个部族——曾是古老的死敌，如今却为共同的使命而结盟——开始这场会议，准备裁定他们土地的未来。

~ 由 Discord 上的 MatthewMcHale 在 Envisioned 于 Discord

The delegations eye one another with generational suspicion as each one enters the sacred clearing. Per the agreement, no weapons are allowed on this holy site, beneath the gaze of the Grandfather Tree. Three tribes—once ancient enemies, now aligned in common purpose—begin the meeting to decide the future of their land.

~ Envisioned by MatthewMcHale on Discord

Guardian In The Net.name:
网中守护者
Guardian In The Net

Text.text:
一道防火墙化为实体，这座抵御入侵的壁垒岿然不动。他是一名纳米圣骑士，高举盾牌，迎击网络浩瀚疆域里的一切邪祟，作为勤勉的希望堡垒而屹立。黑客在他不屈的注视下，寻不到半分庇护。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

A firewall manifest, this bulwark against invasion stands resolute. He is a nano paladin, raising his shield against all that is nefarious in the net’s sprawling expanse, serving as a diligent bastion of hope. Hackers find no succor beneath his unyielding gaze.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Sundries From A Skeleton Carriage Driver.name:
骷髅马车夫的杂物
Sundries From A Skeleton Carriage Driver

Text.text:
高礼帽的缝线早已松脱，歪斜地扣在头骨上。下颌低垂，凝固在一副介于狂笑、惊惧与骇然之间的表情。它枯骨般的双手攥着缰绳，皮革正发霉腐朽，散乱的断端早已与坐骑一并被割离。车夫空洞的胸腔上披着一件潇洒的燕尾外套，内衬条纹隐约可见，口袋里空无一物，只剩一撮黏结成团的绒屑。
Top hat loose at the seams, it sits lopsided on the skull. The jaw hangs low, stuck in a pose of laughter, fright, or awe. The reins clasped in its bony hands are molding, the frayed ends long shorn from their steeds. A dashing tailed coat with striped lining drapes over the hollow chest of the driver, its pockets empty aside from a fringe of claggy lint.

Two Jail Cells (Exterior).name:
两间牢房（外侧）
Two Jail Cells (Exterior)

Text.text:
两间小牢房的铁栅自地面直贯天花板。铁条因年代久远而锈蚀，右侧那间牢房还留着越狱未遂的痕迹。大多数铁条相距约三英寸，但显然有人以惊人的蛮力试图将那间牢房的栅栏掰开，硬是把空间撑到了约四英寸。牢门上钉着厚重的铁盒，将锁具结构严严实实地遮住。
The iron bars of two small prison cells run floor-to-ceiling. The bars are rusted with age, and the cell on the right shows signs of an escape attempt. While most of the bars are about three inches apart, someone of great strength attempted to bend the bars of that cell open, managing to expand the space to perhaps four inches. The cells’ doors have thick iron boxes obscuring their locking mechanisms.

The Prime Material.name:
主物质界
The Prime Material

Text.text:
你正按部就班地重复那些早已烂熟于心的炼金步骤，忽然间你看见了它。只是一瞥。在实验室的蒸馏器、玻璃管与烧杯之间，在硫磺与金属的气息渗入空气的每一寸缝隙之间，有什么东西凝结——悬浮着，仿佛即将诞生。燃素精粹在一瞬间结晶，下一瞬又化作灰烬；它出现，又消失。但你已知道它确实存在：原初的混沌。于万物之间的空气里，它已成为可能，因此也可能再度显现。

~ 设想 by ElusiveGenie

You are following alchemical steps you’ve followed time and again when you see it. Just a glimpse. Among the alembics and tubes and beakers in the laboratory, among the sulfurous and metallic gases permeating the air, something congeals—hovering as if it would be born. The phlogistonic essence, crystalline for an instant, ash the next, appears then disappears. But you know it to exist now, the chaos of the original. In the air between all things, it has become possible and so could appear again.

~ Envisioned by ElusiveGenie

Plate Glass Window Shatters Violently.name:
整面落地玻璃窗猛烈爆裂
Plate Glass Window Shatters Violently

Text.text:
落地玻璃先是一阵摇晃，随即轰然爆裂，碎玻璃如雨般迸射而出，在光线中闪烁飞舞。无数尖片向四面八方疾射，纷纷扬扬洒落到下方的地面。那突如其来的炸裂声过后，原本的玻璃所在只剩下一个豁然洞开的缺口，将室内毫无遮掩地暴露在外界眼前。
The plate glass wobbles and then bursts, a spray of glass flying through the air and sparkling in the light. Shards fly in every direction, raining on the ground down below. The abrupt explosion of sound leaves a yawning hole where the glass once was, unveiling the interior to the outside world.

Arabuk Yearling.name:
阿拉布克一岁驹
Arabuk Yearling

Text.text:
厚厚的北极纹样大衣上抖落雪霜，这生物以覆着肉垫、带着虎般利爪的前足踏前一步，后方两条有蹄的腿赋予它某种轻灵的优雅。它头顶一圈威仪的王冠般长角微微下倾，随之荡起如铃声般低沉清越的回响。四只眼睛眯成细缝般的瞳孔，满口锐齿间迸出一连串喀嗒作响的啁哳声。
Snow shivering from a thick arctic-patterned coat, the creature steps forwards on forepaws padded and clawed like a tiger, and two hooved hind legs that give it with a certain lithe grace. A crown of regal horns is dips downward, ringing with a faint sonorous noise like the chime of a bell. Four eyes narrow to slit pupils, and from a mouth of sharp teeth comes a series of chattering noises.

Cultured Yakuza Oyabun.name:
风雅的极道组长
Cultured Yakuza Oyabun

Text.text:
老人以冷酷而不可动摇的专注凝视着，十指在奢华的书桌上交叠成塔。他对面前青年绝望的哀求毫无动容，从桌中取出一把刀刃——锋利得如同他量身剪裁的灰色西装——带着阴沉的决绝将其推到新手面前。随后他倒上一杯热气蒸腾的草药茶，冷漠地守夜着那人割下自己指尖的一截，呜咽着强忍不出声。
The old man looks on with implacable focus, fingers held in a steeple atop his luxurious desk. He appears unmoved by the desperate pleas of the young man before him and produces a blade—as sharp as his tailored gray suit—from his desk, before sliding it over to the neophyte with grim finality. Pouring a cup of steaming herbal tea, he watches with disinterest as the man cuts off the tip of his own finger and holds in a whimper.

Clandestine Meeting With A Revolutionary.name:
与革命者的秘密会晤
Clandestine Meeting With A Revolutionary

Text.text:
你用指节轻叩那扇昏暗的窗户，声响比预想中更刺耳。几秒过去，毫无动静。是你把暗号细节记错了？还是接头人已经落网？身后灌木窸窣作响，你的心跳骤然加快，可最终什么也没发生。直到酒馆里一支蜡烛忽然亮起，暖光一闪，你才如释重负。你按着学来的节奏，在窗上敲了五下。侧门悄悄开了一道缝，一张隐在阴影里的脸探出来，低声唤道：“斧头会忘……”

你的决心愈发坚定，回道：“但树会记得。”

The sound of your knuckles rapping on the darkened window is louder than expected. Seconds pass and nothing happens. Did you get the details wrong? Was your contact caught? Your heart rate quickens at the sound of bushes rustling behind you, but nothing comes. When a candle flickers to life inside the tavern, a wave a relief washes over you. You tap on the window five times in the rhythm you were taught. The side door opens a crack and a shadowy face calls out, “The axe forgets…”

Your resolve grows, and you reply, “But the tree remembers.”

My Shield +2 Deflects A Blade.name:
我的盾牌+2格挡刀锋
My Shield +2 Deflects A Blade

Text.text:
我以盾迎击，盾面嗡鸣着挡开刀刃的劈斩，将震颤尽数吞纳，使我依旧岿然不动。盾面那层层精雕的格纹由大师匠心铸就，当内里的附魔被唤醒时，便在其上荡开一阵闪烁流光的守护魔法之潮。
My shield hums as I deflect the bladed strike, absorbing the vibrations so that I remain steadfast. The intricate latticework, masterfully wrought across its face, glitters in a shimmering wave of protective magic when the enchantment within is activated.

Ledge In Dark Cave.name:
黑暗洞穴的岩沿
Ledge In Dark Cave

Text.text:
桥梁尽头是一处宽阔的岩台，紧挨着一面参差嶙峋、向上攀升直抵天花板的峭壁。岩台向两侧延展，露出更多卵囊、几件被弃置的武器，以及类人骸骨泛着的惨白冷光。死者似乎很可能是蜘蛛袭击的牺牲品，但骸骨的风化程度表明他们早在很久以前就已死去。
The bridge ends in a broad ledge beside a jagged cliff that run up toward the ceiling. The ledge extends in both directions, revealing more egg sacs, some discarded weapons, and the white gleam of humanoid bones. It seems entirely possible that the dead were the victims of spider attacks, but the state of their bones suggests they died long ago.

Spacegoing Vessel: Filthy Galley.name:
远航舰艇：肮脏的厨房
Spacegoing Vessel: Filthy Galley

Text.text:
厨房简直恶心得令人作呕。解冻的食物在覆满污垢的肮脏台面上腐烂成一滩烂泥，餐具上锈迹疯长，像一座腐臭的铁锈花园。刺鼻的酸奶恶臭缠进陈腐的空气里，呛得人喘不过气，恶心的酸腥直钻喉头；而害兽的粪便散落在地面与台面各处。
The galley is truly disgusting. Defrosted food rots into mulch on filthy counters caked in grime, and the utensils bloom with rust like a fetid garden. The choking stench of sour milk laces the stale air with a sickening tang, and the droppings of vermin litter both floor and counters.

Fresh Corpse Of A Commoner With No Obvio.name:
一具新鲜的平民尸体，身上看不出明显伤痕
Fresh Corpse Of A Commoner With No Obvious Injury

Text.text:
老妇人以别扭的姿势蜷成一团，双腿折在身下，双臂软塌塌地横搭在躯干上。她双眼空洞失焦，嘴巴大张，露出残缺而腐烂的牙齿。她像个老农的木偶，被剪断了牵线后便瘫倒在地。你看不出任何明显的迹象能说明她是如何死去的。
The old woman lies in an awkward heap, legs bent beneath her and arms flopped across her body. Her eyes stare unseeing, her mouth agape to reveal missing and rotten teeth. She looks like a puppet of an old peasant whose strings have been cut.  You see no obvious signs of what caused her demise.

黑龙伏卧在火成岩的岩棚上，腹颈的鳞片在灼热的大地映衬下泛着红与金的光。它神态慵懒，张口长叹；吐息的热浪裹着火星般的朦胧，将空气扭曲变形。它吸气时，腹部贴着黑岩震颤，撼得地面微微战栗。喉间与腹侧的鳞片渗出团团燃烧的岩浆，仿佛随时要把这张石床再次熔成沸流。
The black dragon lies upon the igneous shelf, the scales of its belly and neck glowing red and gold against the searing earth. Relaxed, it opens its mouth to sigh. The heat of its breath morphs the air with an ember-sparked haze. As it breathes in, its belly vibrates against the black rock, quaking the earth. The scales of its throat and belly seep globs of flaming lava, threatening to turn its stone bed molten once more.

Tin Of Malice.name:
恶意罐头
Tin Of Malice

Text.text: [察觉] 一个扁平的圆形铁盒盒盖上，弄臣的脸在眨眼，双颊鼓起，吹出一团烟雾。盒中装着粉笔般的白色粉末，看起来像是戏妆油彩的底粉。 [解析] 有个恶毒的脑袋自以为妙，才把这铁盒装成这样。若你揭开盒盖，朝粉末轻轻一吹，让它扑到目标脸上，他们会先同时眨动双眼，继而捂住眼睛，最后尖叫出声。 [Perceived] On the lid of a flat round tin, the face of a jester winks, cheeks puffed out and blowing a cloud of smoke. In the tin is a chalky white powder that looks like the base of face paint. [Analyzed] A wicked mind thought it grand to fill the tin this way. If you take off the lid and blow across the powder into your targets’ faces, you will find them winking both eyes, then clutching at them, then screaming.

I Feel My Soul Embrace Evil.name:
我感到自己的灵魂拥抱邪恶
I Feel My Soul Embrace Evil

Text.text: 死亡尖啸的回声拖曳着穿过我的耳畔；那骇人的声响，却不知为何在我的脑海、在我的存在深处，化作令人愉悦的轻柔抚触。我的视野渐暗，我微笑着，意识沉入虚无丰腴的怀抱。我感到利爪探入血肉的诱人触感，骨骼碎裂、筋腱撕断。咸与铁腥灌满口鼻，我尝到烈火吞噬亘古森林、城市——以及其中之人的灰烬。对我的感官而言，这是一场甜美而可口的盛宴。 我睁开眼，迎向一个充满可能的新世界。流血的潜能。我大笑着，喜悦的泪水从眼角滑落。在这世界上雕刻出属于我的正当地位，将不再像从前那般可怖——至少，对我而言不是。 Echoes of deathly shrieks trail through my ears, horrid sounds that somehow become delightfully soft caresses within my mind, my being. I smile as my sight darkens, my consciousness settling into the lush embrace of the void. I feel the tantalizing sensation of claws digging into flesh, bones cracking and sinew tearing. Salt and iron flood my mouth and nose, and I taste the ash of fire consuming ages-old forests, cities—and the people within them. A sweet and delectable feast for my senses. I open my eyes to a new world, brimming with possibility. Bleeding potential. I laugh as joyous tears fall from my eyes. Carving out my rightful place in this world will not be so harrowing as before—well, not for me.

Dark Casting Of Cure Wounds.name:
《黑暗施放：疗伤术》
Dark Casting Of Cure Wounds

Text.text:
词语从你唇间吐出，宛如潜伏的蜘蛛爬行而来，嘶哑、异界般阴冷。这声音并非属于你，但此刻你已能驾驭它的力量。墨一般的黑暗在你掌心凝聚，仿佛同时是液体又是雾气，翻涌着攀向指尖。寒意骤然覆上全身，你的双手冰冷刺骨——发青、麻木，像尸体般毫无生气。你抬手示意，将双掌悬在伤口上方，那些墨色触须立刻开始忙碌，像虫子般钻入创口深处，将裂开的血肉一针一线缝合回去。

~ Requested by Tyler from RPGBOT.net

The words emerge from your lips like a lurking spider, rasping and otherworldly. The voice is not your own, though you now command its power. An inky blackness, somehow both liquid and vapor at once, coalesces in your palms and writhes to the tips of your fingers. A chill comes over you, and your hands become frigid—blue, numb, and corpse-like. You gesture, holding your hands over the injury, and the inky tendrils set to work, worming their way into the wound and stitching it closed.

~ Requested by Tyler from RPGBOT.net

Last Minute Advice Before A Heist.name:
抢劫前的最后忠告
Last Minute Advice Before A Heist

Text.text:
“只要按计划走，一切都会顺利。但记住：要是真出了岔子，你现在身边这些人，反倒是你最不该去想的。无论把他们丢下等死会让你多内疚，我敢保证，等这事结束，你都能买下一辈子的幸福。好了，谁打算来个背刺的，举个手……没人？行吧，试试总没坏处。别坑我。”

~ 一位英雄的 Envisioned

“If we stick to the plan everything should be fine. But remember: if something does go wrong, the people beside you now are the last thing you should be thinking about. No matter how much guilt you feel leaving them to die, I guarantee, after this, you can buy a lifetime of happiness. Now, a quick show of hands for anyone planning a double-cross… No one? Well, it was worth a shot. Don’t screw me over.”

~ Envisioned by a Hero

老鼠对你来说早已见怪不怪——不论城镇还是荒野，到处都有这种惹人厌的小东西，循着任何食物的气味翻找残渣。可你眼前这只老鼠身后，跟着又一只，再一只。忽然间，仿佛堤坝决口，成群的老鼠淹没了这片区域，彼此踩踏翻涌着涌出，尖细的吱吱声汇成震耳欲聋的噪潮，几乎要撕裂你的理智。它们细小的嘴里滴着涎水，脑子里只剩下一个念头：找到食物，撕咬吞噬，然后继续前行。而你也明白——在这样的数量面前，它们胆子大得足以去攻击比自己更大的猎物。
Rats are nothing new to you, an annoyance that can be found in virtually every settlement as well as the wilderness, scavenging for any food they can smell. Yet the rat that you see is followed by another rat, and then another. Suddenly, as if a dam has burst, scores of rats flood the area, spilling out over one another, their squeaking a deafening din that threatens your very sanity. Spittle drooling from their tiny mouths, their only thoughts are to find food, devour, and move on. And you know that in numbers such as these, they are emboldened to attack larger targets than themselves.

Medium Combat Helicopter.name:
中型武装直升机
Medium Combat Helicopter

Text.text:
这架直升机看上去灵巧却又浑圆，整洁的球形座舱装在可旋转的基座上，让机体与座舱能各自独立移动。主引擎旁还并排安着小型跳喷推进器，位置拿捏得恰到好处，足以将机身在空中左右推移。也许它在空中会像蜻蜓般疾掠穿梭。厚重的机载等离子武器从侧门间探出锋芒，而货舱舱门内仍留有空间，可运送一支小型杀戮小队。整架机体都刷成了朦胧的蓝灰迷彩，连旋翼与起落滑撬也不例外。
The helicopter appears agile and bulbous, with a neat spherical cockpit built on a swivel, ensuring independent movement for the body and cockpit. Little jump-jets sit aside the main engines, optimally placed to push the heli side to side. Perhaps in the air it darts like a dragonfly. Chunky, mounted plasma weapons peek out of the side doors, though there’s still space to transport a small kill team within the cargo hatch. The entire heli has been painted a hazy blue-gray camo, even the rotors and the landing skid.

Studded Leather Armor.name:
镶钉皮甲
Studded Leather Armor

Text.text:
这副胸甲的棕色皮革上伸出细小的钢钉，将纤薄的钢板扣在内侧。带着同样铆钉的胫甲、护臂与肩甲一并补全整套护甲。护甲散发着汗臭，表面也有些划痕，但看起来仍足够堪用。
Small nubs of steel project from the brown leather of this cuirass, buttoning slim steel plates to the inside. Similarly studded grieves, bracers, and pauldrons help to complete the suit. The armor stinks of sweat and has some scratches, but it looks serviceable enough.

杏仁的气味钻入你的鼻腔。一团靛蓝色的黏稠块状物以稳定而机械的动作，伸出拟足拖曳着自己穿过地面。它的表皮泛着一层银色光泽。在这团软泥的表面，零星处浮现出细小的纹理，继而隆起成坚实的晶体——这是它柔韧之中唯一的异样。
The smell of almonds meets your nostrils. A glutinous mass of indigo pulls itself across the floor with steady, mechanical movements from its pseudopods. A silvery sheen marks its skin. At random places on the surface of the ooze, small striations emerge into robust crystals, the only divergence from its elasticity.

依托崎岖的地形而建，这座要塞的建造者显然有意将峭壁那近乎垂直的岩壁纳入其雄浑防御之中。石砌要塞既能避开当地天气最严酷的侵袭，又顺势半隐其形。
Built around the rocky terrain, the keep’s builders clearly had a mind to incorporate the sheer wall of the cliff into its mighty defense. The stone keep is protected from the harshest elements of the locale’s weather and partially concealed into the bargain.

I Map The Dungeon.name:
我绘制地下城地图
I Map The Dungeon

Text.text:
在火把的摇曳与法术的辉光下，我一边盘算一边勾画——把墙壁、祭坛或箱子权当书桌——或是一步步丈量距离，或是凭直觉估算，然后用粉笔描出并将地图收好。有时我们还得包扎伤口、清理血迹，但我格外小心，绝不让它们玷污地图。这些记录着每一条隧道、每一间厅室的画稿，也许就是我们重返光明的唯一指引。
By torchlight and spell-light, I plot and draw—using walls, altars, or chests as desks—walking off distances or taking best guesses, then chalking and storing the maps. Sometimes we tend wounds and clean up blood, but I take great care to keep it from ruining the maps. These drawings of every tunnel, every chamber, may be the only way we return to the light.

The Rhyme Of The Cavalier.name:
骑士的韵歌
The Rhyme Of The Cavalier

Text.text:
斑驳而披甲，坐骑的毛皮泛着光泽，洁白如雪，闪耀着最纯净的辉光。那骑士威仪凛然地驾驭其上，坐骑仿佛驮着一幅织锦；它的坐骑护甲描绘着伟业，将他的胜利凝成清晰如刻的定格。色彩炫目夺睛，他的故事以万般染色诉说；他与坐骑一同踏出自豪的步伐。人群在他面前分开，敬意毫无间断地流露，因为他们都知道——他必将守住这座城市的箴言。

~ 达埃尔 阿韦尔纳

Dappled and armored, the mount's coat a sheen, shining white with the purest gleam. The cavalier rides with majesty, his mount bearing a tapestry; its barding a depiction of greatness, with his victories frozen in sharpness. With colors that bedazzle the eyes, his stories are told in various dyes; he rides with his mount taking prideful strides. The crowds part before him, their respect shown without interim, for they all know that he shall uphold the city's maxim.

~ Daer Averna

Peaceful Temple: Courtyard Of Valor.name:
宁静神殿：英勇庭院
Peaceful Temple: Courtyard Of Valor

Text.text:
这座神殿的信众排成长队，随着一旁席地而坐的表演者诵唱与击鼓的节拍，操练着武艺。一个披袍的祭司或某种队长模样的人领着他们，高声喊出简短的口令，并亲自示范所需的动作。
Adherents of this temple stand in line, performing martial exercises in time to the chanting and drumming of performers sitting to the side. A robed priest or captain of some sort leads their efforts, shouting clipped commands and demonstrating the desired motions.

楼梯底部的角落里堆着几小堆沙砾与碎石。温暖的空气在此与凉意交汇，形成一阵轻微的穿堂风，裹着熏香的气味，勉强遮住腐朽的腥甜。四下尽是白色石材，唯有东侧一扇紧闭的铁栅双门格外刺眼。门底被扭曲变形，旧锁已断，仿佛有什么东西从另一侧硬生生撞开过这扇门。那边，来自地表的光亮在此衰退，沉入阴翳。
Small piles of sand and rubble gather in the corners at the bottom of the stairs. Warm air mixes with cool here, forming a slight breeze, carrying the odor of incense masking decay. All is white stone, except the double door of iron bars closed to the east. The door’s bottom is twisted, the old lock broken, as if something forced this door from the other side. There, light from the surface fades to gloom.

I Am Dragged Into A Hole By A Monster.name:
我被一只怪物拖进了一个洞里
I Am Dragged Into A Hole By A Monster

Text.text:
我的身体重重砸在地上，胸口一闷，气都被震得吐不出来。我感觉自己被拖着在地面上一路滑行，速度快得骇人，皮肉在地上刮擦，牙与爪同时刺入我的血肉。我伸手乱抓，想攀住任何东西或任何人来减缓这场劫掠——可我什么也抓不住。黑暗吞没了我；我尖叫着，声音在这怪物的深坑里回荡，反反复复地撞回我的耳中。
My body hits the ground and the wind gets knocked out of my chest. I feel myself being dragged across the floor, scraping along at an alarming speed as tooth and claw sink into my flesh. I reach out, attempting to grab anything or anyone to slow this abduction—but I can’t catch hold. I slip into darkness, screaming, my voice echoing back to me from within this monster’s pit.

这具人形生物的木乃伊般干瘪皮肉绷紧在扭曲变形的骷髅（特征）之上。它散发着腐烂与朽坏的恶臭，还夹杂着新鲜血腥。参差锯齿塞满了无唇的口腔，口中逸出一声异界般的低吼。生物修长的骷髅（特征）四肢末端长着阴狠的针状利爪，双眼燃起灼白的炽光，猛然向前扑来。
The humanoid creature's mummified flesh stretches taut over a warped and twisted skeleton. It smells of rot and decay, and fresh blood. Jagged teeth fill a lipless mouth, from which issues an otherworldly growl. The creature's long, skeletal limbs end in wicked, needle-like claws, and its eyes burn white-hot as it lunges forward.

Monstrous Angelic Warrior Addresses Thei.name:
怪物般的天使战士向麾下军队发号施令
Monstrous Angelic Warrior Addresses Their Troops

Text.text:
天使之翼洁白如初落的雪，自那如雕像般庄严的战士身躯上以荣耀的狂喜舒展开来。通体燃着神圣的辉辉光芒，这尊高耸的六翼天使以洞察一切的目光掠过列阵于前的披甲军士，带着父母般的自豪微笑。那精雕细琢的面容足以令最伟大的艺术杰作都黯然失色，一圈灿亮的金色长发光环般垂落至铠甲肩头，细节之精妙令人屏息。它以雷霆般的低沉男中音向面前的士兵发话时，凶兽本性的薄影一闪而过——两枚闪亮的獠牙。
Angelic wings, white as fallen snow, spread in glorious exultation from the warrior's statuesque frame. Blazing with divine radiance, the towering seraphim sweeps its discerning gaze over the armored troops assembled before it, smiling with parental pride. The sculpted features would shame even the greatest works of art, and a halo of lustrous golden hair falls gracefully to armored shoulders, replete with masterful detailing. Addressing the soldiers before it in a thundering baritone, a sliver of its monstrous nature is revealed—two gleaming fangs.

Floating Library Of The Ancients.name:
远古漂浮图书馆
Floating Library Of The Ancients

Text.text:
违逆重力，这座巨岛轻盈地漂浮在天穹之中，岛底一枚耀白的水晶微微搏动，柔光脉脉。繁复而晦奥的奥术建筑铺展开来，汇成一座横亘全岛的大城，环抱着一座熠熠生辉的白石中央高塔，势不可挡地直指苍穹。

~ 由 Marc Clark 构想

Defying gravity, the huge island floats delicately in the sky, a luminous white crystal at its base pulsing softly. Arcane buildings of intricate and esoteric design form a large city that sprawls across the island, surrounding a gleaming central tower of white stone reaching inexorably toward the heavens.

~ Envisioned by Marc Clark

Joyous Halfling Chef.name:
欢欣的半身人厨师
Joyous Halfling Chef

Text.text: 在这间忙得不可开交的厨房里，伙计们守在各自的工位上死命干活：炙烤肉排、翻炒蔬菜、包好饺子往咕嘟作响的大锅里下。半兽人副厨厉声吆喝，来回巡视，盯着每个人的肩头看。你起初没看见主厨，可她的存在感像一层压在空气里的沉默，让整支班子都紧张得不敢多喘一口气。迷蒙的百里香与意式黑醋蒸汽织成一团薄雾，你只看见她那顶toque blanche的帽尖，又听见一段轻快的水手小调，被一把尖细的高声哼得悠然自得。副厨飞奔过去搬来一张凳子，一个身高几乎和身宽一样的半身人踏上去，手里捏着一把小得可怜的勺子。她尝了chef saucier递上的酱汁，含着那一口就笑了，边哼边点头表示满意——那半身人当场肉眼可见地松了口气。 In the busy kitchen, the staff toil at their stations: searing meat, cooking vegetables, and filling dumplings to drop into burbling pots. The half-orc sous chef barks orders and looks over shoulders. You don’t see the chef at first, but you sense her presence in the hushed anxiety of the crew. Through a hazy cloud of thyme and balsamic vinegar steam, you see the top of her toque blanche and hear a cheerful shanty hummed in a high, thin voice. The sous chef dashes over with a stool, onto which a halfling—as tall as she is wide—steps, tiny spoon in hand. She tastes the chef saucier’s offering, and smiles around the mouthful, humming in approval—much to the halfling’s visible relief.

Wide Underground Tunnel.name:
宽阔的地下隧道
Wide Underground Tunnel

Text.text:
尽管这条地道宽得足以让你舒展双臂也不觉局促，但弥漫在空间里的压迫性黑暗与不安感仍如重物般沉沉压下。微弱的清风穿过宽阔的通道，拂动湿漉漉的天花板上垂挂的苔藓与地衣流苏，它们紧贴在潮湿的顶壁上，轻轻摇晃。

~ 由 David 在 Discord 上 构想

Though the tunnel is wide enough for you to comfortably stretch your arms fully, the oppressive darkness and sense of unease permeating the space presses down upon you. A soft breeze blows through the wide-bored passage, catching the hanging fronds of dropping moss and lichen clinging to the damp ceiling.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Convening At The Crypt.name:
在地穴集会
Convening At The Crypt

Text.text:
阴云密布的天空为你们的会面罩上一层灰翳。你在一座坍塌的古墓外与战友重聚，远处的雷声在云层间滚动，仿佛沉睡神祇的低语。墓园里干枯的草与四周那些古老的墓碑一样，蜡黄而脆弱；你们行走其上，脚下咯吱作响，像踩碎陈旧的白骨。你们曾下探地城、斩杀怪物、立下英雄功绩，可每一次新的征途开始，总有某种难以言明的东西攫住心口——一股不安沉进腹中，仿佛你正立于无光的悬崖边缘，对黑暗之后等待着什么一无所知。你们交换着勉强的笑容，散发着装出来的自信；你与伙伴收紧道具，整备武器，点燃火把——随后，小心翼翼地迈出第一步，走进这座古老而阴森的陵墓。

~ 构想：Pince

The overcast sky casts a gray pall over your meeting, as you reunite with comrades outside a crumbling tomb, and distant thunder rumbles through the clouds like the murmurings of a sleeping god. Like many of the ancient headstones surrounding you, the dry grass of the cemetery is sallow and brittle, crunching underfoot like old bones as you walk. Though you have delved dungeons, slain monsters, and accomplished heroic feats in the past, there is something about starting a new venture. A disquiet feeling that settles in your gut as if you stand upon the edge of a lightless precipice, utterly unaware of what waits beyond the darkness. Exchanging half-hearted smiles, and exuding faux confidence, you and your companions secure your gear, ready your weapons, and light your torches—then take your first tentative steps into the ancient, foreboding tomb.

~ Envisioned by Pince

Underground Duel Leads To Cave-in.name:
地下决斗引发塌方
Underground Duel Leads To Cave-in

Text.text:
当最后一击落下，你感到不祥的轰鸣灌满洞窟——古老的岩壁开始震颤……继而崩裂。裂隙在地面上撕出巨大的豁口，钟乳石纷纷崩塌，坠落如自洞顶倾泻的尖锐雨幕。你们时间不多了。

~ Discord 上的 The_DM 所构想

As the final blow is struck, you feel an ominous rumble fill the cavern—and the ancient walls begin to shake… and shatter. Fissures gouge mighty holes in the floor as stalactites crumble, falling like piercing rain from the cavern ceiling. You don't have much time.

~ Envisioned by The_DM on Discord

Sundries From A Gnoll Vampire.name:
豺狼人吸血鬼的杂物
Sundries From A Gnoll Vampire

Text.text:
一只皮革小袋里塞满了一套儿童玩偶——全是家畜。每一只都以某种方式断裂残缺，几只上面还沾着血迹。
A collection of children’s figurines—all domestic animals—is packed into a leather pouch. Every one of them is broken in some way, and several are stained with blood.

恶魔弯曲的犄角、带倒刺的尾巴，以及蹄生、如山羊般的后腿，与其余更偏龙族的外貌相互冲突：修长的口鼻、带着恶意的利爪前肢，以及闪耀着虹彩光泽的鳞片。恶魔直立而僵硬地站着，周身透着近乎军人的肃杀气息：一手紧攥黑色长矛，另一手执着覆鳞盾牌。他们的武器与装束上点缀着一枚古怪的徽记，昭示其效忠于某位龙族暴君。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The fiend’s curving horns, barbed tail, and hooved, goat-like legs clash with an otherwise draconic appearance: long snout, wickedly clawed forelimbs, and scales of gleaming iridescence. The fiend stands upright and rigid, an almost military air about them, as they clutch a black spear in one hand and a scaled shield in the other. A strange emblem adorns their weapons and garb, identifying their allegiance to a draconic tyrant.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

孩子蜷缩成一团不安的球形，剧痛折磨着他。他双臂紧紧环抱着凹陷的腹部，手肘尖锐如箭镞。他呜咽着颤抖，泪水顺着脸颊奔流而下，浸进沿着下颌生长的粗硬毛发——那是一把他显然还太年幼、不该拥有的胡子。透过他撕裂的衬衫，你也看见他胸口同样冒出几缕飘忽的细毛。
Curled into a fretful ball, the child is wracked with pain. His arms wrap around his concave belly, elbows sharp as arrowheads. He whimpers and trembles, tears streaming down his face into the coarse hair that lines his jaw—a beard he seems much too young for. Through his torn shirt, you see wisping hairs on his chest, as well.

Euphoric Party Drug, Aisa: Ingested.name:
欣快派对药物，艾萨：口服
Euphoric Party Drug, Aisa: Ingested

Text.text:
纸片落入饮料中，立刻化开，只一瞬便将液体染成明亮的蓝。药劲钻进血液，时代随之放慢。下颚一阵跳动。瞳孔扩张。慵懒与渴望如潮涌来。色彩旋转，搅成抽象的形状；面孔失去轮廓。饮者坐倒下来，嘴巴微张。他们抬手想去捋过头发，却在半途停住，像是忘了自己要做什么。眼里浮起一层呆滞的光。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The paper hits the drink and fades immediately, turning the liquid bright blue for only a moment. The drug hits the bloodstream and time slows. There’s a pulsing in the jaw. A dilation in the pupils. A wave of lethargy and longing. Colors swirl into abstract shapes. Faces lose definition. The drinker sits down, mouth agape. They go to run their hands through their hair but stop halfway, like they have forgotten what they are doing. A glazed look appears in the eyes.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

一只巨大而丑陋的蠕虫状生物从地底钻掘而出，泥土在它那粗厚、黏腻渗浆的躯体上簌簌崩落，塌成一片狼藉。它没有腿，只有臃肿的身躯与一张布满利齿的口器。它张开血盆大口，发出宛如木板被硬生生撕裂的刺耳声响，腐肉的恶臭瞬间充斥空气。
A huge and hideous wormlike creature burrows its way up through the ground, the earth crumbling down its thick, oozy body in a collapsing mess. It has no legs, only a bulbous body and a mouth filled with sharp teeth. It opens its maw in a sound not unlike a wooden plank being torn apart, and the smell of rotting meat fills the air.

你吟诵一句短促的咒语，向那生物伸出手，从你的视角将它攥入拳中。若你闭上一只眼，便仿佛你手中握着一只玩偶；当你凝神于魔法，便以意志逼迫目标静止不动。
You chant a short phrase, reach out to the creature, and make a fist around it from your point of view. If you close one eye, it looks as though you hold a doll in your hand as you concentrate on the magic, willing the target to become still.

The Sense Of A Harmony In The Weave.name:
编织之网中的和谐感
The Sense Of A Harmony In The Weave

Text.text:
你仿佛穿过一道无形的帷幕，踏入一间温暖宜人的房间。目之所及并无改变，却像是视线更加锐利，嗅觉与听觉的感官更为敏锐。一种笃定的感觉如同看不见的斗篷将你裹住。此刻有魔法涌动，但你能感觉到它并非法术，而是从你周遭的世界自然流淌而来。
You feel as though you’ve stepped through an invisible curtain into a welcoming room. Nothing you can see has changed, but it’s as if your vision is sharper, your senses of smell and hearing more acute. A feeling of assuredness enwraps you like an unseen cloak. There’s magic in this moment, but you feel it flow from the world about you rather than a spell.

Vessel Dedicated To A Goddess Of The Sea.name:
献给海之女神的圣舟
Vessel Dedicated To A Goddess Of The Sea

Text.text:
发现这座漂浮的神殿仿佛神明亲临干预：没有船长掌舵，这艘船却任凭海的意志从容滑行。它的设计让人联想到一艘战舰，规模大到足以容纳整个祭司团与愿意随行的会众。船舷以铁铸成，橙锈纵横，表面刻蚀出鱼鳞般的纹理。主帆上绘着一卷升起的浪潮，而船首像——象征女神本尊——是一位神情微妙、似笑非笑的人鱼。
Finding this floating temple feels like divine intervention, for with no captain at the helm, the vessel glides wherever the sea wills. Its design is reminiscent of a warship, and it is large enough to accommodate the entire priesthood and a willing congregation. The ship's sides are iron, orange-streaked and etched with fish scales. The main sail is painted with the image of a rising wave, and the figurehead—representing the Goddess herself— is a mermaid with a bemused mien.

这把斧头刃口锋利致命，既适合伐倒树木——也足以放倒高大骇人的生物。铭刻在抛光金属上的符文闪耀着强劲的附魔光辉，矮人文以细如尘埃的微小字母沿着木柄一路铺陈。刻入木中的日期如同注脚，点点穿插在记述这件武器迄今功绩的编年史间。
The axe has a keen and deadly edge, perfect for felling trees—or towering creatures. Runes inscribed into the polished metal glow with potent enchantment, and dwarvish text runs the length of the wooden haft in miniscule lettering. Dates carved into the wood punctuate the chronicle detailing the weapon’s deeds thus far.

I Cast Legend Lore.name:
我施放了“传奇传说”
I Cast Legend Lore

Text.text:
一道道天蓝色的能量弧自我眉心迸涌，翻越头顶；我的双眼蒙上一层淡淡的雾翳。于心眼之中，我穿行在一座由幽灵般的薄雾与墨色阴影筑成的古老图书馆里。魔法牵引着我，如猛禽般掠过层层书架。书脊在我掠过时微微战栗，我听见陈旧羊皮纸的簌簌作响、石板擦磨的刮响，以及牛皮纸那带着皮革颤音的低鸣。
Arcs of sky-blue energy surge from my brow to crest over my head, and my eyes cloud with pale fog. In my mind’s eye, I fly through an ancient library built of spectral mist and inky shadow. Like a bird of prey, I soar through the stacks as the magic leads me. Tomes on the shelves shudder as I pass, and I hear the crinkling of old parchment, the scrape of stone tablets, and leathery quaver of vellum.

酒馆里挤满了寻常百姓，没有半点出奇——除了吧台正中坐着的那个男人。他靠在椅背上，仿佛那是一张王座，手里端着酒。他不与任何人交谈，也没人敢上前搭话。可他那张阴沉的面孔上，却挂着君王般的讥笑。
The tavern is filled with everyday people, none out of the ordinary, except for the man seated at the center of the counter. He leans back in his chair as if it is a throne, drink in hand. He talks to no one and no one dares to approach him. But his dark features bear the smirk of a king.

Swanky Private Med-bay.name:
豪华私密医疗舱
Swanky Private Med-bay

Text.text:
闪耀的器械固定在这间医疗舱一尘不染的墙面上。每一寸都洁净无瑕——三重灭菌。房间中央漂浮着一张绒软的躺椅，华丽的紫色织物以金色勾勒细节。墙边没有任何橱柜——取而代之的是一处处细小的凹痕，标示着隐藏隔间的位置，里面很可能存放着大量高科技医疗用品。
Glittering instruments are fastened to the spotless walls of this med-bay. Every inch is pristine—triple-sterilized. A plush recliner chair floats in the middle of the room, opulent purple fabric detailed with gold. No cupboards line the wall—instead, small indents mark the position of hidden compartments, probably housing numerous high-tech medical supplies.

Fisher’s Yard In Winter.name:
冬日渔人院
Fisher’s Yard In Winter

Text.text:
一艘划艇倒扣的隆起船腹占据了棚屋旁这片狭小院落的大半。雪地里踩出的脚印一路通向一张桌子，桌上摊着一条剖开清理过的鱼。一排已处理好的鱼挂在绳线上，结霜凝冻；一把斧头深嵌在木墩里，昭示着有人刚劈过柴，好生起炉火。
The hump of a rowboat fills much of the small yard beside the shack. Paths in the snow show where someone has walked to a table with a gutted fish. A line of already processed fish freeze as they hang from a line, and an axe in a log indicates someone has been splitting wood for the fire.

这件皮质护甲的每一处都在光亮的表面压印着同样的徽记：一个圆，圆内嵌着一枚古怪的三角形。它看上去像是一座山，山脚下开着洞穴；又仿佛是一枚箭头，尖端带着锯齿般的锋芒。胸甲上共有三处印记——两处大致落在两侧乳头位置，另一处居于胸口正中。你从未见过如此怪异的标记。
Every piece of this leather armor bears an embossed mark on its glossy surface: a circle with a strange triangle inside. It looks like it might represent a mountain with a cave at its base, or perhaps an arrowhead with a serrated tip. The chestpiece has three marks—one roughly at each nipple, and one in the center of the chest. You’ve never seen anything quite like it.

柔软的金色卷发如环般轻拢着女人精致的面容，她埋首忙碌，双手穿梭于玄奥的手势之间，宛如一场魔法芭蕾。妖异的翠绿光芒自她指尖倾泻而出，她正将一件物品灌注上强大的附魔，魔力共鸣的嗡鸣在芬芳的空气里回荡。你靠近时，她眼中的专注令你不由得放缓脚步；然而当她完成最后一步，那近乎癫狂的灼烈强度骤然收束——她转过身，对你绽开一抹亲切的笑容。
Soft, blond ringlets frame the woman’s delicate face as she works, her hands dancing through arcane gestures like a magical ballet. Lurid green light pours from her fingertips as she imbues an item with a powerful enchantment, and the hum of magical resonance fills the fragrant air. The focus in her eyes gives you pause as you approach, but the searing intensity, bordering on mania as she completes the task, becomes a welcoming smile when she turns to you.

Draconian Dreadnought.name:
龙裔恐惧无畏者
Draconian Dreadnought

Text.text:
这名龙裔类人生得如食人魔般魁梧，暗淡的蓝色鳞片覆体，虬结的肌肉在金属、皮革与骨片拼凑的简陋护具下起伏绷张。它的头颅宛如一条小眼珠、獠牙参差的巨龙，后脑伸展出两支横扫的黑色长角，周围一圈较短的棘刺如鬃般竖立。强壮的蝠翼自肩胛张开，每一根翼指末端都生着黑色利爪。身后拖着一条又长又有力的尾巴，尾端鼓起一团骨质槌头，像钉头锤的锤首。它双手各握一把夸张巨大的锯齿弯刃大刀，却明显不见刀鞘，仿佛这些残忍的利器从不曾入鞘。
Built like an ogre, this draconic humanoid has dull blue scales and rippling thews clad minimally in metal, leather, and bone. The head is that of a beady-eyed, snaggle-fanged dragon with sweeping black horns on the back of the head and a frill of shorter spines. Mighty, batlike wings spread from the shoulders, each finger clawed in black. A tail, long and strong, trails behind, ending in a bony bulb like the head of a mace. The being holds an oversized, serrated falchion in each hand, with scabbards for these cruel blades notably absent.

Barghest: Stalked By The Beast.name:
魔兽：野兽尾随
Barghest: Stalked By The Beast

Text.text:
你闻得到自己恐惧的臭味。既然你都能闻到，潜伏在外头的饥饿也一定闻得到。那低沉粗哑、从喉底滚出的咆哮，诉说着一头胸膛如桶、肩背宽阔的巨兽正沿着你的踪迹逼近。你仿佛看见一只生着利爪的巨掌，大小远远盖过你的脚印，攥紧、碾碎泥土，甚至像是亲手捧起你的气味一般嗅闻。
You can smell the stink of your own fear. And if you can smell it, the hunger lurking out there can surely smell it too. Its growl, guttural and deep, speaks of a great, barrel-chested, broad-shouldered beast prowling down your trail. You imagine a great clawed paw, dwarfing your own footprint, clutching and crushing the dirt, and physically picking up your scent.

I Use Relentless Rage.name:
我发动「不屈狂怒」。
I Use Relentless Rage

Text.text:
我踉跄着，阴影收拢视野，几乎要将我拖入虚无。我低声呻吟。但怒火在胸中翻涌，硬生生把我撑住。伴随一声尖啸，我甩开痛楚与眩晕，再度纵身扑回混战之中。
I stagger as shadow narrows my vision, threatening oblivion. I groan. But the rage rises in me, keeping me upright. With a shriek, I shake off the pain and dizziness, then I leap back into the fray.

Arrival At A City Of Gnomes And Minotaur.name:
抵达侏儒与牛头人之城
Arrival At A City Of Gnomes And Minotaurs

Text.text:
当你走近城池那高耸的巨门，尖厉的蒸汽汽笛声骤然爆发，撕裂空气。门楼上那些小小的舷窗里探出侏儒卫兵的身影，朝你高声喝令停下。随即，一扇巨门在完美平衡的铰链上无声而顺畅地大开；一个步伐沉重的牛首人形生物走了出来，手里夹着记事板，抬眼问你们姓名与来意。越过他的肩头，你看见一条熙攘的街道：身着鲜艳服饰的矮小侏儒在人潮中灵巧穿梭，毫不费力地从大步行进的高大牛头人腿间掠过；那些牛头人昂首阔步，踏在洁净如新的鹅卵石街面上，气势逼人。

~ Envisioned by Invaluable on Discord

As you approach the towering gates of the city you hear the keening wail of steam whistles erupting. Gnomish guards appear in the small portholes of the gatehouse calling out for you to stop. A huge door swings wide on perfectly balanced hinges before a ponderous bovine humanoid steps out carrying a clipboard and asks your names and business. Behind him you see a bustling street filled with diminutive gnomes in brightly colored clothing effortlessly weaving between the legs of the towering minotaurs striding boldly along the pristine cobbled streets.

~ Envisioned by Invaluable on Discord

Protect The Principal.name:
保护要员
Protect The Principal

Text.text:
你看见攻击袭来，也看见暴力的目标毫无防备。你拔腿狂奔，把求生本能统统搁置，只为护住要员。你纵身挡在攻击之前，双臂大张——不格挡，不招架——只做一面活生生的盾，准备把灼热与痛楚尽数接下。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

You see the attack coming, and that the target of the violence is unguarded. You run full bore, all sense of self-preservation shelved in favor of protecting the principal. You throw yourself in front of the attack, arms thrown wide—no blocks, no parries—just a living shield, ready to take the heat.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Wild Magic Surge: Mirror Image.name:
狂野魔法涌动：镜影术
Wild Magic Surge: Mirror Image

Text.text:
你的法术回响令周遭现实微微战栗。你侧目一看，竟见……另一个你。三道与你一模一样、举止也如你般的幻影紧贴在旁。旁观者很难从这片身影之中分辨出真正的你。
An echo of your spell shivers reality around you. You look to the side and see… yourself. Three illusory images that look like you—and move like you—stand close by. An onlooker would have difficulty picking the real one out of the crowd.

Elderly Microceratus.name:
年迈的微角龙
Elderly Microceratus

Text.text:
这头生物唤起一种奇异的对照：它几乎只比多数幼崽大不了多少，却在颤抖的躯体里背负着漫长年代的重量。鳞片曾经莹润的翠绿已被岁月洗褪，只在这头恐龙饱经风霜的皮肤上留下苔藓般的暗绿。尽管她的感官随时代而迟钝，族群幼崽的声响仍能让苍老的心泛起欢喜；她安然蜷伏在叶影交织的巢穴里休息，在年轻同伴的嬉笑与呼应中缓缓沉入梦乡。
The creature evokes a strange juxtaposition, being scarcely larger than most youngsters yet carrying the burden of advanced years in its trembling body. The lustrous green of its scales has faded with age, leaving a mossy complexion upon the dinosaur’s weathered hide. Though her senses have dulled over time, the sound of her clan’s young still brings joy to an old heart, and she settles peacefully among her leafy den to rest, drifting off to the sound of youthful camaraderie.

Prof. Isaac Hemsworth.name:
艾萨克·赫姆斯沃斯教授
Prof. Isaac Hemsworth

Text.text:
这名中年人类仍埋首于他在立式书桌上研读的卷轴，甚至不抬眼，只抬起食指，示意你别开口。男人身高将近七英尺，骨架瘦得像只剩骨头；他身上的穿着却昭示着足以匹敌殷实贵族的财富：一件棕色、密密编织到近乎苛刻的马甲，罩在昂贵布料制成的白色长袖衬衫外；裁剪精细的长裤，以及擦得锃亮的皮鞋。你还瞥见旁边椅背上搭着一件叠得工整的礼服外套，一根朴素的手工雕木手杖斜倚其上。他的头发中等长度，两鬓的灰白发丝从深棕色里清晰挑出。忽然，你看见一条蜿蜒的身影从他远侧肩头探出，攀下去落在桌面——一只白化的雪貂，正嗅着空气。他终于抬头，冰蓝色的眼睛与您对上；你这才注意到，他下唇左侧有一道深刻的疤痕一路向下延伸。

~ Played by Larry Harden

The middle-aged human does not look up from the scroll he is studying at the standing library desk, instead raising his index finger to forestall conversation. Just shy of seven feet tall, the man’s frame is bone-thin, and he wears a style of clothing indicating a wealth equal to that of a well-to-do aristocrat: a brown, painstakingly woven vest over a long-sleeved white shirt of expensive cloth, fine trousers, and well-polished leather shoes. Across the top of a nearby chair, you also spy a neatly folded frock coat, upon which leans a simple, hand-carved wooden cane. His hair is cut at a medium length, with gray streaks at his temples standing out from his dark brown hair. With a start, you see a sinuous shape curl outward from his far shoulder, clambering down to the surface of the desk—an albino ferret, sniffing at the air. He looks up at you finally, his ice-blue eyes meeting yours, and you notice a deep scar leading down from the left side of his lower lip.

~ Played by Larry Harden

你可以高声呼喊或低声呢喃这段祷词，你的躬身可以短促也可以庄重，但神明迅捷的回应总会化作安慰。光之披风将你包裹，翻卷着攀上你的肩头，再如流水般淌向你的双手。那光停驻其上，而当你接触一件武器时，一抹微光便在其表面一闪而过。
You can shout or whisper this prayer, and the bow you make can be brief or grand, but the ready answer from your god always comes as a comfort. A cloak of light enwraps you, rolls up around your shoulders, and flows down to your hands. It lingers there, but when you touch a weapon, a shimmer flickers across its surface.

Temple To The Sea Goddess.name:
海女神圣殿
Temple To The Sea Goddess

Text.text:
水下神殿里香火鼎盛，朝拜者络绎不绝，多半是海族：浅蓝色皮肤，颈侧鳃裂起伏，手足生着蹼。方形岩台两侧，石柱如林拔起。珊瑚与海葵恣意攀生在石面上，成群游鱼安静地漂游其间。信徒们在柱间穿梭游动，进入殿内，把供品——用海藻捆扎，或以渔网碎片包裹——摆在女神塑像前。她盘坐在卷曲的尾巴上，尾端与类人的躯干自然融为一体。海藻般的长发如雨垂落胸前、背后与肩头，头侧的鳍片向外舒展，宛如王冠。一只手紧握一柄由活珊瑚铸成的三叉戟，通体明亮翠绿；另一只手托着一颗巨大的珍珠，稳稳栖在指间，姿态如同水晶球置于底座之上。

~ Envisioned by Bill

The underwater temple is lively with worshippers, most of whom are seafolk with light blue skin, gills, and webbed hands and feet. Stone pillars rise up on each side of a square rock platform. Corals and anemones grow freely upon the stone, and tranquil schools of fish float through these waters. Worshippers swim between the pillars and into the temple proper to lay offerings—bundled in seaweed or scraps of fishermen’s nets—before a statue of their goddess, sitting upon on a curled tail that blends into a humanoid torso. Seaweed hair rains down her chest, back and shoulders, and fins fan out from her head like a crown. One hand grips a trident of living coral, bright green in color. In the other hand is a huge pearl, perched upon her fingers in the same way a crystal ball sits in its stand.

~ Envisioned by Bill

几十年来，学院的驯兽守护人一直是位女性，但她最近先振翼高飞，又一头扎进海里，去研究深海生物。新来的则是个矮壮的秃头男人，浑身都是结实的、毛茸茸的硬肌肉。他戴着一只疯癫的耳坠——羽毛与活虫串在一起，从耳垂一路晃到肩头，叮当作响；他的眉毛像两条巨大的黑毛毛虫。笑起来嘴角咧得很开，露出一颗金色门牙；他穿着演唱会T恤，套着磨得发白的破牛仔裤，脚下是沉重的钢头工靴。受惊时，他常会冒出一句：“Oi”，或者“嗯，哈喽。”
For decades the academy's Keeper of Animals has been a woman, but she recently flew off, then dived down, to study undersea life. The new one is a short, bald man packed with solid hairy muscle. He wears a crazy earring of feathers and live insects that rattles around from lobe to shoulder, and his eyebrows look like great black caterpillars. His smile is broad, with a gold front tooth, and he wears concert T-shirts and ratty jeans over heavy steel-toed work boots. When surprised he frequently says either “Oi” or “Well, haloo.”

Call To Arms: Massive Army.name:
召集军势：大军压境
Call To Arms: Massive Army

Text.text:
这支势力中的一些战士与野兽朝着战争狂奔，仿佛迫不及待要迎接那血腥与死亡。他们的队列在一团更为沉稳的行军大军周围穿梭盘旋——那是这支怪物军团的钢铁脊梁。乌黑的战旗与狰狞的图腾从人潮中高高竖起，标示着各个氏族或部队，以便在即将到来的战斗中被迅速整编调度。
Some warriors and beasts of this force run toward war, as if eager to greet its bloodshed and death. These units course around a marching mass of more steady troops, the steel spine of this monstrous army. Dark banners and grotesque totems rise out of the mass, denoting clans or units so they can be marshalled in the coming battle.

那张熟悉的面孔扭曲变形，模糊不清——仿佛被海市蜃楼搅乱——随着那生物显露出真正的形态。幻象如同水从沙漠砂砾间蒸发般消散，恶魔拔高至全然的身躯高度，朝你咧开一抹野兽般的狞笑。一具肌肉虬结的猫科身形披覆着橙色条纹皮毛，身着富有——且胆大妄为——的商人华服，双眼闪烁着重新燃起的掠食恶意。

~ 由 Odeyseis 在 Discord 上 Envisioned

The familiar face shifts, blurred—as if by a mirage—as the creature reveals its true form. The illusion evaporates like water from the desert sand as the fiend grows to its full height and favors you with a bestial grin. A muscular feline form covered in striped, orange fur wears the resplendent garb of a wealthy—and audacious—merchant, and their eyes shine with renewed predatory malice.

~ Envisioned by Odeyseis on Discord

I Cast Magic Weapon.name:
我施放魔法武器
I Cast Magic Weapon

Text.text:
我将手按在那把武器上，仿佛铁锤砸落铁砧的回响在脑海中轰鸣。舌尖泛起铁腥味，锻炉烈火的热浪扑上额头。先前平凡的物体此刻微微流光，源自我体内的纯银能量在其上奔涌。
I place my hand upon the weapon and the sound of a hammer hitting an anvil echoes through my mind. I taste iron on my tongue and feel the heat of a forge-fire hit my brow. The previously mundane object now shimmers with the sterling silver energy flowing from me.

I Cast Create Food And Water.name:
我施放《造粮术与造水术》
I Cast Create Food And Water

Text.text:
一股滋养的暖意在我腹中升起，随着我引导魔法，渐渐蔓延至四肢。柔和的光点自我伸展的指尖飘散而出，坠落如叶，落定在我周围的容器里。金黄的面包与晶莹澄澈的清水充盈着光所触及的盒匣与器皿，新鲜出炉的面包香气在空气中弥漫开来。
A nourishing warmth grows in my belly, spreading to my limbs as I channel the magic. Motes of soft light drift from my outstretched fingers, falling like leaves and settling in the containers around me. Golden loaves and crystal-clear water fill the containers and vessels the light touches, and the smell of freshly baked bread fills the air.

她用拇指与食指轻轻夹住自己尖尖的下巴，这位不老的精灵明显前倾身子，把周遭的一切都看得更仔细些。她深蓝的眼眸闪烁着好奇，仿佛夜空中繁星成簇的辉光。她的铂金金发披散垂落，发丝一路流到背部中央。她身上的白色长袍如水般飘逸，袍缝处以蓝与紫的丝线细细缀边。

~ Played by MasterLionsDen with

Pinching her pointed chin between her thumb and forefinger, the ageless elf visibly leans forward to observe anything and everything a bit more closely. Her deep blue eyes sparkle with curiosity as the night sky might sparkle with its bevy of stars. She wears her platinum-blond hair long, tresses reaching down to the middle of her back. Her flowing robes of white are laced with blue and purple thread at the seams.

~ Played by MasterLionsDen with

Loot From A Silver Dragon Wyrmling Lair.name:
银龙幼龙巢穴的战利品
Loot From A Silver Dragon Wyrmling Lair

Text.text:
这座不起眼的洞穴里散放着从附近聚居地掠来的些许财物——其中最扎眼的是一张巨大的床垫，上面胡乱堆着一摞不成套、被利爪撕裂的毯子。你还发现了几样更便于随身收起的物件：一尊金制雕像，刻着一名士兵骑在装着马鞍的狮鹫上昂首跃起；一只银质首饰盒，表面刚开始泛出暗淡的锈色；以及一整桶钢头长柄长枪。
The modest cave holds a smattering of treasures snatched from the nearby settlements—including a massive mattress covered with a pile of mismatched, claw-slashed blankets. You find a few items that are more easily stowable on your person: a gold statue of a soldier rearing atop a saddled griffon, a silver jewelry box just beginning to tarnish, and a barrel full of steel-headed partisan spears.

这本厚重的巨册包覆在起皱的紫罗兰色皮革之中——其上嵌着更深紫或漆黑的嶙峋骨板——书角以精金包覆加固，并以同材质的搭扣锁合。书脊亦为暗色金属，一端系着短链与镣铐。书页由厚实而参差不齐的羊皮纸叠成。掩蔽褶缝里的阴影时而剥落，化作缕缕冰冷而苦涩的薄雾。
Bound in wrinkled, violet leather—with bony plates of darker purple or black—this hefty tome has corners shod in adamantine and a latch of similar material. Its spine is also dark metal, with a short chain and shackle attached to one end. Thick, uneven parchment forms the pages. Shadows in the cover’s creases peel away at times, forming wisps of cold, bitter mist.

水珠如雨般从洞窟天顶滴落，沿着岩壁成片淌下，汇聚成一洼洼浅池。你不禁疑惑这洞里怎会不被灌满——但正如水能循着石缝一路渗下，也必会在别处悄然渗出。走在其中，仿佛正穿行在一块湿透的海绵内部。
Water drips from the cave’s ceiling like rain, and trickles down the walls in sheets, to gather in small pools. You wonder how the cave doesn’t fill up, but just as the water finds its way down through the stone, so too must it seep out. It feels like walking through the inside of a wet sponge.

Ritual Ground To A God Of Barbarians.name:
野蛮人之神的仪式圣地
Ritual Ground To A God Of Barbarians

Text.text:
这里，高高的草丛被一片圆形空地打断，圈内的草被齐刷刷割去。石块沿着低矮的迷宫式小径排布，信徒在其中起舞，额头汗珠滚落，目光因专注而凌厉。蜿蜒分岔的小径尽头，立着一根高高的赤红木柱，柱身从上到下刻满符号。最顶端系着一张面具：一张饱经风霜的脸，稀疏的胡须竟是由草原长草编成。
Here, the tall grass is interrupted by a circle where the growth has been shorn away. Rocks line a low labyrinth of pathways that worshipers dance through, brows beaded with sweat and eyes fierce with concentration. At the end of the branching paths stands a tall wooden pole of reddish wood, the length of it carved with symbols. A mask has been tied to the very top: a wizened face with a scraggly beard of plains-grass.

Joint Mobility Wraps.name:
关节灵活绷带
Joint Mobility Wraps

Text.text:
金线织就的奥术符号沿着柔韧的皮革缠带表面铺陈，形与用在此交织成夺目的平衡。这些护具精工细作，专为行动受限的冒险者助力；佩戴后，强效的治疗魔法便会舒缓关节疼痛与关节炎肿胀。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，Forge Ahead: A Party To Access 制作

Arcane symbols woven in gold line the surface of the supple leather wraps in a striking blend of form and function. Beautifully crafted to aid adventurers with limited mobility, these magical braces relieve joint pain and arthritic swelling via potent healing magic when worn.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Castle Guardhouse.name:
城堡卫兵岗楼
Castle Guardhouse

Text.text:
这座矮壮结实的建筑像雕刻家的凿子嵌进岩石般，紧紧楔入城堡之中。火光映亮了卫兵室那一扇扇小而方正的窗子，里面传来喧闹的欢笑与畅饮声。
The squat, robust building is wedged into the castle like a sculptor's chisel in rock. The glow of fire illuminates the small, boxy windows of the guardhouse, and the sound of raucous merriment can be heard within.

这个类人生物的存在感带着一丝难以捉摸的飘忽——仿佛短暂闪现的残影，几乎立刻便从你的记忆里褪去。你想不起他们的面容与举止，只记得那高挑纤细的身形、苍白的皮肤、紫罗兰色的眼睛、银白的头发，以及一种“他们本就属于这里”的感觉。他们以近乎异质的优雅移动，披着一件边缘缀有黑色羽饰的斗篷。

~ Played by Meldiastar

There’s an elusiveness to this humanoid’s presence—a kind of fleeting afterimage that fades from your memory almost instantly. You cannot recall their face or mannerisms, only their tall, slender frame, pale skin, violet eyes, silver-white hair, and that they seemed to belong. They moved with an almost alien grace, draped in a cloak trimmed with black feathers.

~ Played by Meldiastar

Kobold Hoarding Treasure.name:
狗头人囤积宝藏
Kobold Hoarding Treasure

Text.text:
一只勇敢——或许是愚蠢——的狗头人蹲踞在一堆闪亮的非法赃物之巅，公然向你叫阵。他们身形矮小，却压不住目光里的狂妄；站姿绷紧，咄咄逼人。那双野性的眼睛里燃着不惧你威势的狠劲，这狗头人以凶悍的决心守着他们那可怜的私藏。
Perched atop a gleaming pile of ill-gotten gains, a brave—or perhaps foolish—kobold defies you. Their small stature belies the audacity in their gaze, their determined stance bellicose. Feral eyes house a spirit unfazed by your strength as the kobold guards their pitiful hoard with fierce determination.

台地的一部分崩塌成了一处凹穴——碎石瓦砾撒满地面——几株棕榈守在其侧。三株棕榈夹出一条敞开的通道，通往这处隐蔽角落的更深处，空气里弥漫着腐肉的腥臭。凹穴尽头是一条低矮的地道。洞口的竖井处，陈旧蛛网在暖风中轻颤；但再往里走，蛛网便聚成一道惨白的漏斗。
Part of the mesa has crumbled to create a hollow—littering the ground with rubble—guarded by palm trees. Three flank an open path deeper into this niche, which smells of dead flesh. At the back of the hollow is a low tunnel. Old webs flutter in the warm breeze at the shaft’s entrance, but deeper within the passage the webs form a pale funnel.

Sundries From A Gynosphinx.name:
来自雌性斯芬克斯的杂物
Sundries From A Gynosphinx

Text.text:
一些抢救回来的残破书卷，旁边还夹着正被译成其他语言的段落，整齐地排成一小行一小行。它们损毁得太厉害，早已没有任何金钱上的价值。
Partly salvaged books, along with passages being translated into other languages, sit in small, organized rows. They are too damaged to have monetary value.

Tournament To Choose A Knight Of The Rea.name:
遴选王国骑士的比武大会
Tournament To Choose A Knight Of The Realm

Text.text:
参赛者一字排开，骑乘披甲战马，个个皆是老兵，罩袍上绣满无数胜绩。他们耐心等候，一位头顶渐秃的传令官高声宣布今日将赢得的领地与头衔。女王起身，祝他们好运；骑士们微微下压长枪，以示对这突如其来的殊荣致意。
The line of competitors sits atop barded coursers, veterans all, tabards emblazoned with countless victories. They wait patiently as a balding herald announces the land and title to be won this day. The queen stands and wishes them all luck; the knights tip their lances to acknowledge this unexpected honor.

Inspecting The Cape Of Archambault.name:
检查阿尔尚博的披风
Inspecting The Cape Of Archambault

Text.text:
这件物品在你检视时轻易地滑过你的双手——太过轻易，仿佛它本就打算从你掌心溜走。飞龙鳞片依旧带着几分锋利，当它们带刺的边缘掠过你的手掌与指间时，仍会微微咬人。布料流动如液体，色泽是新鲜血液般浓烈的暗红；这条血色披巾，足以让任何目睹其佩戴者的人心生恐惧。
The item slides easily over your hands as you inspect it—too easily, as if it means to slip right out of your grasp. The wyvern scales still give a bit of a bite as their spiked edges pass over your palm and fingers. With fabric as fluid as liquid and colored the intense dark red of fresh blood, this sanguine shawl could certainly strike fear in the hearts of any who laid eyes on its wearer.

峡谷这间空荡的凹室拥有最高的峭壁，但边缘松动不稳，两侧尽是滑坡与沙砾。看起来几乎不可能攀爬脱出。在迷宫般的西侧开口处，那片更坚硬的岩层上凿着一些洞孔，大小如同厨房窗户。
This empty chamber of the canyon has its highest walls, but the rims are unstable and the sides composed of slide and sand. It looks nearly impossible to climb out of. In the stronger rock at the maze-like western opening are holes the size of kitchen windows.

Warning From An Old Adventurer.name:
一位老冒险者的警告
Warning From An Old Adventurer

Text.text:
“我过去做过太多事，几乎用了一辈子去逼自己忘掉——要是你还继续逼我，你就会知道为什么。”
“There are a lot of things I’ve done in my past that I’ve worked most of my life to forget—and if you keep pushing me, you’ll find out why.”

I Fire My Arrow Of Spell Disruption.name:
我射出那支【法术瓦解之箭】
I Fire My Arrow Of Spell Disruption

Text.text:
这一下上弦与寻常无异：一拉，放手。箭矢破空而去，箭杆上刻着淡淡发光的橙色符文，在风里掠出一线灼亮的轨迹。它是否命中并不重要——真正的用意另有所在。箭头无害地在地面上崩碎，我的敌人扬起嘴角，带着嘲弄的得意冷笑。片刻之后，碎裂的箭身才缓缓渗出一缕淡蓝的烟雾。敌人嗅了嗅，眯起眼，随即脚下一软踉跄起来。他们想开口，却一个字也吐不出；猛地伸出手，却只能眼睁睁看着手指抽搐蜷紧，痉挛着不听使唤。那些从远处掀起的躁动，终于在这份仁慈之中归于终止。
It is a nock like any other. A pull back. A release. The arrow, shaft etched with faintly glowing orange runes, soars through the air. Whether it strikes true is of no concern, for the real purpose is something else. The arrowhead snaps harmlessly against the ground, and my foe smirks in mocking triumph. A moment passes before faint blue smoke rises from the broken arrow. My enemy sniffs, squints, then suddenly stumbles. They try to speak, but nothing comes out. They whip out a hand and watch helplessly as their fingers cramp and disobey. Their agitations from afar have come to a merciful end.

蝎子紫水晶般的甲壳咔嗒作响，墨黑的长腿疾爬着逼近。它的尾刺——一枚淡紫色的球囊，嵌着漆黑尖刺——傲慢地来回甩动，像是在炫耀。它那对巨大的覆毛钳爪之间，口器的钳齿扭动不休，滴落着半透明的黏液。
The scorpion’s amethyst carapace clicks as it scuttles nearer on inky black legs. Its stinger, a lavender bulb affixed with a dark spike, flicks back and forth in a haughty display. Between its large hairy claws, the pincers of its mouth writhe, dripping with translucent goo.

巨兽每一步雷霆般踏下，大地都仿佛随之战栗——它的身躯由沉重的岩块、零散的枯枝，以及偶尔嵌着的石英碎片拼合而成。两条巨大的石腿支撑着棱角分明的庞大躯干，怪异的泥土之躯缝隙间还探出草叶与其他植物。层层岩板紧紧楔合，构成一张粗砺的面孔，裂齿般的嘴豁然张开。它粗壮的臂膀猛砸地面，震得岩石迸裂，随即仰起巨口向空中放出低沉咆哮。轰鸣声里夹着尖锐的嘶响——碎石从这生物的体表四散飞溅，如雨坠落。
The ground itself seems to shudder with each thunderous step of the beast—composed of heavy chunks of rock, stray branches, and the occasional piece of quartz. Two huge stone legs support a massive angular midsection, bits of grass and other plants sticking out from the gaps in the monstrous earthen body. Slates of rock jammed together tightly make up a roughhewn face with a jagged mouth. Its thick arms slam the ground, cracking the stone, and it raises its maw into the air to release a deep roar. The booming sound is accompanied by the sharp hiss of scattering gravel raining down from the creature's body.

Abandoned City Street.name:
废弃城市街道
Abandoned City Street

Text.text:
前方的街道宛如诡异的荒原，死寂无声、毫无移动，唯有塑料袋与其他碎屑在风中窸窣翻动。每一扇窗不是碎裂不堪，就是被百叶紧闭；其下方皆是褪色招牌，字母残缺不全。就连流浪汉似乎也觉得这条街不值得踏足。
The street ahead is an eerie wasteland, devoid of sound and movement save for plastic bags and other debris rustling in the wind. Every window is either broken or shuttered closed, all below faded signs with missing letters. Not even the homeless seem to consider this street worthwhile.

墓园里，扭曲的杂草疯长，其上覆着落叶，贴地的薄雾如毯般铺满四周。风化崩裂的墓碑东倒西歪，残破的碑面被赭色苔藓染污——姓名与日期都已成遥远的记忆。空气潮湿而沉重，腐败的气味浓烈，新旧交织，令人窒息。
The graveyard is overgrown by twisted weeds topped with fallen leaves and blanketed with a ground-hugging mist. Crumbling headstones lie askew, their weathered faces stained with ochre moss—names and dates a distant memory. The air is damp and heavy with the scent of decay, both old and new.

Void Hag.name:
虚空鬼婆（特征）
Void Hag

Text.text:
这位宁静漂浮的身影——足有七英尺高——带着骄傲挺立着，海绿的鬃发如瀑垂落背脊。她的肌肤正是虚空的颜色：蔚蓝的黑暗。她披着由闪烁星尘织就的长袍，白银般的衣裳由六边形的光芒拼合而成。袍上的光映在她的指甲上，十号枚修长而锋利的三角尖刃。她没有呼吸。完全没有呼吸。
This serene floating figure—seven feet tall—bears herself with pride, a mane of sea-green hair cascading down her back. Her skin is the very color of the void: a cerulean darkness. She is clad in robes of shimmering stardust, a white-silver raiment of hexagonal light. The light of her robe reflects off her nails, ten long and sharp triangles. She is not breathing. Not breathing at all.

Sword-pierced Zombie.name:
被长剑贯穿的丧尸（特征）
Sword-pierced Zombie

Text.text: 一阵沉闷的刮擦声牵动你的注意力：一具腐烂的人形正摇摇晃晃地逼近。它蹒跚的步伐被腹部那圈湿漉漉的黑色污迹所阻碍——一截华丽的剑柄从中刺出，朝上翘着，随着每一步微微晃动。它仿佛长出了一条尾巴：一柄长剑钝化的剑尖深深卡在这具丧尸（特征）体内，拖在鹅卵石路面上，变色的剑刃缓慢地锯着它的肚腹。那孱弱的心智驱使这不死之物继续前行，又是一声skrrrr，可它的耳朵早已听不见这位武艺同伴发出的声响。 A dull scraping sound draws your attention to the advancing form of a decayed humanoid, its ambling gait made more difficult by an ornate hilt protruding from a wet, black stain around the belly, pointing upward and shifting with each step. It appears to have gained a tail: The dulled point of the longsword lodged in the zombie’s body drags along the cobblestone street, its discolored blade slowly sawing at its abdomen. A feeble mind drives the undead forward with another skrrrr, but its ears no longer register the sounds of its martial companion.

Surveillance Drone Buzzes Overhead.name:
监视无人机在头顶嗡鸣掠过
Surveillance Drone Buzzes Overhead

Text.text:
一阵低沉的嗡鸣掠过头顶，一颗不祥的白色球体疾驰而来，在网状电缆与路灯之间倾斜转向。它以骇人的速度撕裂空气，竟将一只误闯的鸽子硬生生撞飞，血肉在地上抹出一道猩红的污痕。那枚蛋状机身外壳层层铆接，铆钉间脉动着黄色能量。无人机腹部涌出一圈紫色光波，扫过区域，搜寻生命体征。人群惊慌四散，退到街道边缘，匆忙钻入遮蔽物下躲避。
There’s a low whine as an ominous white sphere zooms overhead, banking between net wires and streetlights. It whips through the air with such speed that it knocks an errant pigeon aside in a bloody smear. Its egglike body is layered with rivets pulsing with yellow energy. A purple wave of light emanates from the underside of the drone, scanning the area for biosignatures. Crowds scatter to the peripheries of the street, ducking under shelter.

I Converse With A Green Dragon.name:
我与一条绿龙交谈
I Converse With A Green Dragon

Text.text:
“总有一天，当你们最后一个也被杀死时，你们将只剩下一个故事。你们扭曲的形体将被放逐到想象与幻境的疆域里。这就是你们所造成的一切痛苦为你们买来的下场。没有坟墓，没有敬畏——只有给迷途孩子的警世寓言。你们觉得值得吗？”
“One day, when the last of you have been slain, you will be nothing but a story. Your twisted forms will be banished to the realm of imagination and fantasy. That is what all the pain you have caused has bought you. No grave, no reverence—just a cautionary tale for wayward children. Does it seem worth it?”

Swamp World Spaceport.name:
沼泽世界太空港
Swamp World Spaceport

Text.text:
这里看起来像一场仍在进行的厮杀。金属构架方方正正，沉重逼人，却几乎被藤蔓与苔藓、霉斑以及发丝般的蔓芽彻底淹没，悄无声息地钻入每一道缝隙。许多建筑周围环着焦黑长痕、盐渍斑块与排水沟，但那层密不透风的疯长植被几乎像在肉眼可见地蠕动，宛如四面合围的军势。伴随一声咆哮与爆炸的震响，一公顷的沼泽猛然碎裂飞散，水花化作细雾四溅。一艘飞船降落在新清出的停机坪上。
This place looks like a fight in progress. The metal structures, blocky and imposing, are nearly overrun with vines and mosses, mold, and hair-fine creepers insinuating themselves. Long burns, salt patches, and drains surround many of the buildings, but the dense overgrowth is almost in visible motion, like a surrounding army. With a roar and a blast, a hectare of swamp splinters away, spraying water in a fine mist. A ship descends to the newly cleared pad.

狮院的骄傲，字面意义上就是一群狮子。它们有时会在塔外的地界巡游，但更偏爱宅邸内部那片由魔法造就的辽阔稀树草原。入夜后，狮子们便蜷卧在公共休息室与走廊四周沉睡。偶尔会有一两头充当本院教授或级长的护卫；它们被喂得很饱，几乎不习惯真正的冲突。

这些狮子既健壮又聪慧——那头雄狮博览群书，偶尔还会代课，教授《咒术史》课程。
The pride of House Lion is, literally, a pride of lions. They sometimes prowl the grounds outside the tower, but tend to favor the vast magically-created savannah inside the house. By night the lions sleep around the common room and halls. One or more sometimes act as bodyguard for the professor or prefect of the house; they are amply fed and not used to much conflict. The lions are healthy and intelligent—the male is well read and sometimes substitute teaches the Thaumaturgical History class.

Rainy Day On Campus.name:
校园雨日
Rainy Day On Campus

Text.text:
暴雨如帘，横扫庭院，狠狠拍打在校舍上。那座塔楼以怪异的角度歪斜矗立，灰沉而萧索，屋檐上垂落一道道细小瀑布。外头空无一人，只有动物管理员和五头河马站在一片已化作深泥的草地上。他看着它们在倾盆雨里翻滚嬉闹——灰色的脑袋从泥浆里一下一下冒出来——一则法术让他干爽得像在讲堂里一样，他叼着烟斗，翻着一本书。
Rain falls in sheets across the grounds and strikes the school. The tower, standing at all its weird angles, looks gray and forlorn as small waterfalls cascade from the roofs. No one is outside but the Keeper of Animals and five hippos, on a stretch of field turned to deep mud. He watches them roll and play in the pelting storm—gray heads poking up from the mud—a spell keeping him as dry as a lecture, smoking a pipe and reading a book.

Sundries From A Violet Fungus.name:
紫罗兰真菌的杂货
Sundries From A Violet Fungus

Text.text:
那团畸形的紫罗兰色烂肉猛然一颤，随即瘫伏不动——浓稠刺鼻的脓液从中渗出，淌在洞窟地面上。那荧光黏浆的气味宛如死亡，但或许可以采集起来贩卖。
The grotesque mass of pulpy, violet flesh shudders then lies still—leaking a thick, pungent ichor on the cavern floor. Though the fluorescent goo smells like death, perhaps it could be harvested and sold.

Outpost West Tower.name:
前哨站西塔
Outpost West Tower

Text.text:
如同大门另一侧的同伴，这座塔楼一半由石柱构成，一半由木梁搭起——外侧转角牢牢锚固在峭壁之上。沿着山壁攀上一段不长却险象环生的路程，便能抵达塔顶平台。此刻，其余的弩炮尽收眼底，还有一只储物箱，以及从塔后缘延伸而下的楼梯，通往院落，并连接着穿过大门后继续向前的道路。塔楼看起来足以容纳必要的补给与起居空间，供一到两名守卫驻守。
Like its counterpart on the other side of the gate, this tower is half stone posts and half wooden timbers—outside corners sturdily anchored to a cliff. A short but dangerous climb up one of the mountain faces reveals the tower’s top deck. Visible now is the rest of the ballistae, a storage chest, and a staircase off the back ledge of the tower leading to the yard and the path continuing beyond the gate. The tower appears capable of holding the necessary supplies and living space for one or two guards.

Leather Leg Brace.name:
皮革腿部护具
Leather Leg Brace

Text.text:
柔软的皮革绑带、黄铜搭扣与结实的木杆共同构成了这件装置的骨架。凭借它的长度与形状，它或许能帮助那些腿部受伤后正在康复的人，或是有某些行动障碍的人。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，Forge Ahead: A Party To Access 创作

Soft leather straps, brass buckles, and sturdy wooden rods make up the structure of this device. By its length and shape, it could aid those recovering from a leg injury or who have certain mobility conditions.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Large, Vacant Stone Bridge.name:
巨大的、空荡的石桥
Large, Vacant Stone Bridge

Text.text:
这座巨大的石质桥梁堪称你所能见到的最令人叹服的工程之一，自砌筑完工之日起便如今日般坚固沉稳。砂浆厚实而凝固，丝毫不见因岁月而疏松渗透的迹象。桥梁的体型与它的空寂相叠，竟带着一丝不真实的意味，仿佛它被特意安放在此，只为供你通行。
As impressive a piece of engineering as you’re likely to find, this massive stone span stands as strong and resolute as it has since the day the masonry was completed. The mortar, thick and solid, shows no sign of porous aging. The bridge’s size combined with its emptiness has a slightly unreal quality about it, as if it had been placed here expressly for your use.

Alien Creeper Plant.name:
外星蔓行魔植
Alien Creeper Plant

Text.text:
这株怪异的植物形似一只紫色花瓶，瓶腹深处透出粉橙交织的幽光。它伸出两条卷曲的触须，末端长着覆满吸盘的“桨”状肉瓣，四下探寻下一顿猎物。植株的唇缘与躯干上还垂着数条触须——比探寻的触肢更粗壮、更不灵巧——它们盘绕着，休息般伏在地面上。
This strange plant is shaped like a purple vase, with a pink and orange glow coming from within. It sends out two curling tentacles with paddles of suckers on the ends, searching for its next meal. The lip and body of the plant have several other tentacles—thicker and less agile than the searching limbs—that coil and rest on the ground.

这个瘦削的孩子周身笼着一层异界气息，一股未知的力量在他不安的外表之下暗暗翻涌。他的双色头发在银与金之间流转，如同那双奇异却摄人心魄的异色眼眸。他携着一柄纤细轻巧的细剑，还有一把为他小小的手量身装配的弩。颈间垂着一枚护身符，上面刻着新月与半轮太阳交叠相映。

~ 由 Nathan 扮演

An otherworldly air surrounds this slender child, an unknown power simmering just beneath his uneasy exterior.
