His two-toned hair shines silver and gold, similar to his strange but alluring eyes of differing hues. He carries a thin, light rapier and a crossbow fitted to his small hands. Around his neck dangles an amulet depicting a crescent moon and a half-sun in conjunction.

~ Played by Nathan

Sawed-off Double-barreled Shotgun.name:
短管双管霰弹枪
Sawed-off Double-barreled Shotgun

Text.text:
两根短枪管从木制枪托前端突兀伸出，宛如野猪的獠鼻，管口边缘布满粗糙参差的刻痕与缺口。这把武器残酷而简单，却足够致命——也极易藏匿。
Two short barrels jut from the wooden stock like the snout of a boar, their rims marred by crude, jagged striations. The weapon is brutally simple but effective—and easily concealed.

Cyberpunk Fantasy Metropolis: Impoverish.name:
赛博朋克奇幻大都会：穷困潦倒的“E”区
Cyberpunk Fantasy Metropolis: Impoverished 'E' Neighborhood

Text.text:
一片荒凉的区域在你眼前铺展开来，这里是城市里最贫困、最绝望之人的栖身之所。楼宇残破不堪，毫无安保措施，也没有任何基本设施可用。将此地称作家园的人只能靠翻找残渣与乞讨维生，而贫民窟早已被犯罪与暴力彻底吞没。
A desolate area sprawls before you, home of the city's destitute and hopeless. The buildings are in utter disrepair, and there are zero security measures or basic amenities available. Those calling this neighborhood home must scavenge and beg for sustenance, and the slums are overrun with crime and violence.

Oathbreaker Casting Lay On Hands.name:
背誓者施放「圣疗」
Oathbreaker Casting Lay On Hands

Text.text:
“邪恶，”他们对左手说道。但圣武士的左手并未如应有那般，因自身力量而滋生出伤人的魔法阴翳。它泛红了。那只被视作光明与美德的右手亦然。血涌上皮肤表面，正如倒下者的伤口也在流血。那是血——不善不恶。他们将双手按在破损的皮肉上，引导自己脉搏汇成的血潮。伤口合拢。

~ 由C2Orcus所构想

“Sinister,” they say to the left hand. But the paladin’s left hand does not grow dark with injurious magic from his power as it should. It grows red. So too does the right hand of supposed light and virtue. Blood rises to the surface, just as blood also leaves the wound of the fallen. It is blood—neither good nor evil. They press their hands onto the injured skin and channel the pool of their own pulse. The wound closes.

~ Envisioned by C2Orcus

一具构造复杂的仿生人正与自身的运算系统融为一体。它的每条手臂都像纺锤般舒展，分化出多种棱面交错的改装件，末端嵌着激光器、螺丝刀，以及你叫不出名字的高阶器具。躯体由纯黑金属铸成，却始终在微微变形——内部组件不停调位，只为将热量分配到最理想的路径。它的面部宛如工程师的焊接面罩：泛着黄铜光泽，只有一道横向的单片镜片，幽幽透出淡绿色的光。
A complex android fuses with its computing system. Each arm spindles out into a variety of multifaceted augmentations tipped with lasers, screwdrivers, and advanced implements you have no name for. The body is all black metal but constantly shifting as components are moved around internally for optimal heat distribution. Its face is like an engineer’s welding visor: brassy, with one single horizontal lens glowing a pale green.

I Eat Spicy Food: Enjoying It.name:
我爱吃辣：乐在其中
I Eat Spicy Food: Enjoying It

Text.text:
第一口就已经鲜美无比——紧接着，辣意骤然爆发。那股灼热像亡命之徒的刺激，直冲我的味蕾。这感觉仿佛唤醒了我全部的感官；视线更显锐利，嗅觉愈发清晰，食物也浮现出全新的层次与风味。喜悦如潮水般涌上心头，尽管额头已沁出细密的汗珠。
The first bite is already delicious—and then the spiciness kicks in. The heat is a daredevil thrill for my tastebuds. It seems to awaken all of my senses; my vision feels keener, my sense of smell is sharper, and the food takes on whole new notes of flavor. I feel a rush of joy, even as my forehead beads with sweat.

这头巨麋的鹿角无论以何种标准衡量，都是一件货真价实的武器；每一根分叉都锋利如匕首。这头壮丽的生物将速度与力量融为一体：精瘦躯体上的每一束肌肉都蓄满爆发之势——在一头体型大过北极熊、速度快如猎豹的生物身上更显骇人——再加上一种近乎人类的凶悍智慧。
The antlers on this giant elk are a serious piece of weaponry by any measure, each point as sharp as a poignard. This magnificent creature is equal parts speed and power, every muscle in its lean frame made all the more impressive in a creature larger than a polar bear and as fast as a cheetah, coupled with a fierce near-human intelligence.

织工坐在一张高靠背凳上，面前是一台沿垂直框架竖起的高大织机。他那修长的精灵手指灵巧翻飞，将线穿梭于经纬之间，数小时里一寸一寸地织出整匹布。 他半抬眼望向你，微微扬起下巴，算作招呼。
Seated on a high-backed stool in front of a tall loom aligned along a vertical frame, the weaver’s long elven fingers move skillfully as he interlaces threads through the loom’s warp and weft, creating bolts of whole cloth inch by inch over a matter of hours. He half looks at you and lifts his chin by way of greeting.

Low-slung Foreign Sports Car.name:
低趴的异国跑车
Low-slung Foreign Sports Car

Text.text:
这辆车贴地低得离谱，车底居然没被刮得满是擦痕、也没沾上一层碎裂的沥青砂砾，简直叫人意外。身着异国剪裁西装的司机几乎得“爬”出车厢，随后又弯腰俯身到几乎要扯断后背的深度，去把自己的随身物件捞出来。
The car sits so low to the ground, it's a surprise the bottom isn't scraped and coated in chips of asphalt. A driver in a foreign-cut suit practically has to climb out of the vehicle, and they bend to back-straining depths to fetch their belongings.

[察觉] 房间里堆满残骸，地面被遮得严严实实，地板的倾斜几乎难以察觉。这是一套原始而精巧的机关，悄然塑出一条“最小抗力”的路线，把行人引向一处宽大的伪装暗舱。只要拂开周围的杂物，你就能看见它的边缘。

[发现] 暗舱很容易拆开。下方是一条匠心雕琢的石质滑道，直入大地的黑暗。滑道表面覆着一层玻璃般的油膜；即便你已揭穿陷阱，仍能感觉到这房间的结构仿佛在用“物理”本身把你一点点推向那里。

[触发] 地面杂乱不堪，碎屑堆得有数英寸深。你艰难穿行其上，只觉脚下崎岖难走，步伐不由自主地被引向房间里更平滑、更为平整的那一块。突然，你撞破一扇脆弱的柳编暗舱，双脚在油滑的石面上飞快打滑，整个人仰面摔倒。你随即被抛进一条光滑的斜槽，直坠入黑暗。

[Perceived] The room is so cluttered with debris, the floor so obscured, that the floor’s tilt is nearly imperceptible. This is a mechanism of primitive elegance, creating a path of least resistance that influences the walker toward a wide camouflaged hatch, the edges of which you can see by brushing away the clutter around it.

[Discovered] The hatch can be easily dismantled, and below, you see an expertly crafted stone slide into the darkness of the earth. Its surface is coated with some sort of glassy oil, and even having revealed the trap, you can feel the very physics of the room’s construction tipping you toward it.

[Triggered] The floor is a cluttered mess, several inches deep with debris. On the way across it, you find the floor to be uneven and difficult, naturally easing your path toward the smoother and more level part of the room. Suddenly, you crash through a flimsy wicker hatch, your feet slide quickly along oily stone until you fall on your back. You find yourself plummeting down a smooth chute into darkness.

I Break An Elemental Gem Of Red Corundum.name:
我捏碎一枚赤红刚玉的元素宝石：炼狱
I Break An Elemental Gem Of Red Corundum: Inferno

Text.text:
我捏碎宝石的瞬间，灼热席卷全身，元素如狂暴的炼狱般涌现而出。那生物以火山般的暴怒咆哮，毫不留情的烈焰将大地灼成焦黑。它转向我，摇曳的火容中透着饥渴，静候我的指令。
Heat washes over me as I break the gem, and the elemental comes forth like a raging inferno. The creature roars with volcanic fury as it scorches the ground with unrelenting flames. It turns to me with hunger in its flickering countenance and awaits my instruction.

那令人作呕的恐怖滑入视野：披裹阴影的有翼泰坦。它漆黑如黑曜石的躯壳渗出傲慢的恶意，双眼燃着仇恨的烈焰。蝠翼拍击，怒意的腥臭灌满空气。这位恶魔般的君主——有知的噩梦——散发出难以言喻的恐惧气息。它落在岩石上，俯视着它的猎物——你！
The abhorrent horror glides into sight, a winged titan sheathed in shadow. Its obsidian form bleeds arrogant malevolence, eyes ablaze with hate. Bat-like wings beat, and the stench of its ire fills the air. This diabolic sovereign, a sentient nightmare, emits an aura of unspeakable dread. Alighting upon a rock, it surveys its prey—you!

I Cast Primal Savagery.name:
我施放《原初野性》
I Cast Primal Savagery

Text.text:
我眼睁睁看着朋友倒下，胸口被巨魔（特征）那凶残的利爪撕开，鲜红汩汩涌出——而我决定也亮出属于自己的爪牙。我听见脑海里一声咆哮，魔法奔涌灌入双臂，手掌猛然变宽，指甲疯狂延伸，化作又长又黑的爪刃，滴落着冒着热气的油。我猛扑向巨魔（特征）的腿，准备把它干净利落地从身上撕下来。“再生这个！”我嘶吼，咆哮破碎如熊的低吼。

~ 由 Sharkt07 构想

I watch my friend fall, their chest slashed and streaming red from the troll’s vicious nails—and I decide to show some claws of my own. I hear a roar in my mind as magic surges into my arms, broadening my hands and elongating my fingernails into long, black claws that drip with steaming oil. I lunge at the troll's leg, ready to rend it clean from its body. "Regenerate THIS!" I cry, my snarl as ragged as a bear's.

~ Envisioned by Sharkt07

I Deactivate My Cyber Spinal Cord.name:
我停用了我的赛博脊髓神经束
I Deactivate My Cyber Spinal Cord

Text.text:
我将心神聚拢，观想清水，将注意力引向颈后根部。一阵抚慰的触感，仿佛挚爱之人的低语，带着轻痒沿着脊背一路滑下。脊柱深处那股惊人的力量随之消散，伴着清晰可闻的嘶嘶声，每一节碳合金椎骨依次解锁。呼吸渐稳，心跳放缓。背部肌肤隐隐发热，像被日光灼过一般。

~ 一位英雄所构想

I channel my inner focus and picture water, directing my attention to the base of my neck. A soothing sensation, like the voice of a loved one, runs down the length of my back in a tickle. The incredible power within my spine dissipates, and there is an audible hissing sound as each carbon-alloy vertebra unlocks. My breathing calms and my heart rate slows. The skin along my back feels a faint heat, as if sunburned.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Insulting Warning With Magical Jargon.name:
带着魔法术语的侮辱性警告
Insulting Warning With Magical Jargon

Text.text:
“你疯了吗？这种戈埃提亚式的stregher会让球体里一半的以太回路失去同步。到时候你会造出一个足以媲美次星界虚空的eso-vacuum。”

[Clarification Requested] “诸位位面会向内崩塌，然后我们全都会死……要是我们够走运的话！”

“Are you mad? A goetial stregher such as this will desynchronize half the aetherial circuits in the sphere. You'll end up with an eso-vacuum to rival the subastral void.”

[Clarification Requested] “The planes will implode, and then we will all die… if we are lucky!”

Early Morning Arrival To The Capital By.name:
清晨乘船抵达王都
Early Morning Arrival To The Capital By Ship

Text.text:
船在你脚下轻轻摇晃，随潮汐起伏，右舷一侧的海岸线阴影般迫近。风帆扑簌作响，船员松开缆绳，将船的速度降到几乎爬行。清晨薄雾在旭日破出海平线时缓缓散开，远处，你望见城市高耸的尖塔直刺天际。不久，城市码头上喧嚣的行动声浪传入耳中——工人拖拽货物，旅客登船下船，水手为启航整备船只。巨城从雾中显形：低矮建筑连绵铺展，其间高塔耸立，你也随之准备下船。

~ Requested by Søren Sørensen

The boat rocks gently under your feet, rising and falling with the tide as the coastline looms on your starboard side. The sails flutter as the crew loosens the lines, dropping the vessel’s speed to a crawl. The early morning mist parts as the sun breaks the horizon, and in the distance, you spot the towering spires of the city. Soon, the clamor of activity on the city’s docks reaches your ears—workers hauling goods, passengers embarking and disembarking, sailors prepping ships for departure. The massive city emerges from the mist, a sprawl of squat buildings and soaring towers, and you prepare to disembark.

~ Requested by Søren Sørensen

Sundries From A Stinking Zombie.name:
臭气熏天的丧尸杂物
Sundries From A Stinking Zombie

Text.text:
在那具肿胀腐臭的丧尸（特征）尸体上，你注意到一枚朴素的护符挂在它蜿蜒的脖颈上。或许这是当地用来辟邪的象征——只是显然没能庇佑这位不幸之人。
On the bloated corpse of the fetid zombie, you notice a simple talisman hanging around its sinuous neck. Perhaps it’s a local symbol to ward off evil—though it clearly didn't work for this unfortunate soul.

Orchestral Music Fills The Upscale Resta.name:
管弦乐声充盈着这家高档餐厅
Orchestral Music Fills The Upscale Restaurant

Text.text:
这家餐厅的氛围堪称无可挑剔，令一切感官都沉醉其中。厨房里飘来世界级佳肴的香气，慵懒地流淌在空气里，如同与雅致装潢完美相衬的一杯佳酿。管弦乐渐次高昂，旋律铺满餐厅的每一寸空间——那些为拨动心底热情而写就的乐章，正悄然点燃你胸腔里的火。
A delight for all the senses, the atmosphere in the restaurant is impeccable. The scent of world-class food drifts languidly from the kitchen, complementing the stylish décor like a well-paired wine. Orchestral music swells, filling the restaurant floor with melodies written to stir the passions within.

枝桠在它庞大身躯的重压下微微下垂；这头巨鹰鸮振翼张开，翼展竟比秃鹫还要宽阔，钩曲的喙更是为一口叼走成年浣熊或负鼠充作餐食而生。然而，这只鸟的双眼却不知为何流露出超越传说的智慧，仿佛在暗示它真正拥有自我意识。
Bough sagging beneath the weight of its large frame, this giant owl boasts a wingspan larger than a condor’s and a beak perfectly suited to snatching up fully grown raccoons or opossums for a meal. But this bird’s eyes somehow convey a wisdom beyond that of legend, hinting at true sentience.

Sundries From A Rug Of Smothering.name:
窒息魔毯的杂物
Sundries From A Rug Of Smothering

Text.text:
既然这张地毯不再试图勒住你的脖子、夺走你的性命，你总算能好好检查它了。你注意到纤维间反复出现着一些耐人寻味的纹样：一套隐秘的字母表、一组符文，或是某种完全不同的东西——把这些符号记下来，或许会很值得。
Now that this carpet is no longer trying to choke the life out of you, you can examine it. You notice interesting patterns repeating within the fibers. A secret alphabet, a set of runes or something else entirely—making a note of these symbols might be worth your while.

费尔博格人那张扁平的灰色面孔上，最醒目的便是粗厚如牛的鼻吻。挂在他鼻中隔上的金环仿佛被一束阳光击中般微微发亮，将视线从他上唇左侧斜贯而过的狰狞疤痕上牵引开去。他的束腰外衣与马裤以低调的棕黑为底，反倒更衬出外披的紫水晶色长袍。袍上点缀着白鼬皮般的星座纹路，繁复而华贵的织物将苍穹以鲜活的色彩铺陈开来，仿佛有力量自其中辐射。然而这长袍并非他唯一的异景：那男人正鞍坐在一只巨大的鼬上，举着一只小得可怜的茶杯啜饮，茶杯被他粗大的拇指与食指稳稳夹住。随着生物的步伐起伏，他也随之上下摇摆，却竟连一滴都不曾洒落。

~ Played by Unalloyed

The firbolg’s flat gray face is dominated by a thick bovine snout. The gold ring that hangs from his septum seems to glow as if struck by a ray of sunlight, drawing attention from the ragged scar that streaks across the left side of his upper lip. The subtle browns and blacks of his tunic and breeches draw the eye to the amethyst robe worn over them. Streaked with ermine constellations, the richly accented fabric captures the cosmos in living color that radiates power. But the robe is not the figure’s only striking feature: the man is saddled atop a massive weasel, sipping from a tiny teacup held steady between a massive finger and thumb. The firbolg rises and falls in rhythm with the creature’s motion, managing to avoid spilling even a drop.

~ Played by Unalloyed

Loot From A Unicorn.name:
独角兽的战利品
Loot From A Unicorn

Text.text:
号角在树影斑驳间微微闪耀，令人目眩的螺旋纹路仿佛随光影流转。你握住这份战利品时，指尖忽然泛起一阵酥麻，沿着手臂一路旅行上去，像冬日从寒风里归来时炉火送上的暖吻。这个物体中蕴藏着惊人的力量。
The horn glimmers as the dappled shadows of the trees play across its mesmerizing spirals. As you grasp your prize you notice a tingling sensation spread through your fingers and travel up your arm like the warming kiss of the hearth as you come in from the winter cold. There is great power in this object.

Perateus The Stronger.name:
佩拉特乌斯·更强者
Perateus The Stronger

Text.text:
他的笑声足以灌满整间酒馆，显然很擅长用故事取悦众人。秋褐色的头发下，一双温暖的褐眸向朋友与熟人都敞开邀请；只是左眼留着一道疤，而胡须修剪得如同精心打理的篱墙。他举止间带着几分学者气，却披着战士的鳞甲。他携着三叉戟与捕人叉，带着书与笔，腰间还挂着酒壶。两名同伴一左一右随行——一位半天使吟游诗人与一位半恶魔奇械师，二人皆穿着学生制服。

~ 由 Alex Willoughby 扮演

His laugh can fill a tavern, and it’s clear he’s skilled at regaling others with stories. From under his autumn-brown hair, warm brown eyes invite both friends and acquaintances, although his left eye bears a scar, and his beard is a tended hedge. There is something of the scholar in his manner, yet he wears the scale mail of a fighter. He carries a trident and man catcher, a book and a pen, and a flask at his hip. Two others flank him—a half-angel bard and a half-devil artificer, both wearing student uniforms.

~ Played by Alex Willoughby

[外面]  这处住所几乎算不上房子，只是一间棚屋：门口用帆布帘子代替门扇，四周没有窗洞，光线无从透入。整座结构东拼西凑，用木板、粗枝和捡来的材料一点点搭成。门帘缝隙里有烟雾缭绕，昭示着屋内正烧着火。 [里面]  你踏入其间，脚下是夯实的泥地；四周是一片阴影笼罩的空间，唯有炉膛里残存的微弱余烬勉强照亮。靠墙摆着一张简陋的行军床，离地抬高几寸以留住暖意，占据了整面墙的视线。 [Outside]  The dwelling is little more than a shack, with a canvas curtain in place of a door, and no windows to allow light inside. The structure has been constructed piecemeal from wooden planks, thick branches, and salvaged materials. Smoke curls from the doorway, indicating a fire within. [Inside]  As you step inside you find an earthen floor and a shadowed space lit only by the meager embers left in the hearth. A simple cot, raised off the floor a few inches to spare warmth, dominates one wall.

你一边吟诵法术的词句，一边用手在空中迅速勾勒出一幅粗略的宇宙图景；缕缕魔法丝线交织成一座发光的天体仪。你将音叉敲击在这构造上，让那段会歌唱的金属微微倾斜，捕捉通往目的地的完美音高。音色渐近时，你催促你的伙伴做好准备。
You swiftly craft a crude map of the cosmos in the air with your hand as you speak the words of the spell, creating glowing orrery from threads of magic. You strike a tuning fork against this construct and tilt the singing piece of metal, seeking the perfect note for your destination. When it is close you encourage your companions to prepare themselves.

粗糙的木质斧柄上缠着一圈圈剥落的棕色皮革，托着这把小斧沉甸甸的铁制斧首。金属因久经使用而磨损凹陷，亟需打理——然而刃口依旧锋利如剃刀。
A rough wooden haft, bound in flaking brown leather, supports the weighted iron head of the small axe. Scuffed and dented through use, the metal is in need of care—yet the edge is razor sharp.

Quip About Keeping A Cursed Object.name:
关于留着一件诅咒物体的俏皮话
Quip About Keeping A Cursed Object

Text.text:
“嗯，我觉得我们该拿走它。想想那股力量，想想它或许能拯救多少性命！这肯定比那点可怜的迷信更重要……不过，还是你先把它捡起来吧。”
“Well, I think we should take it. Think of the power, of the lives it may save! Surely that is more important than some paltry superstition… You pick it up first, though.”

Sensation Of Dying.name:
濒死之感
Sensation Of Dying

Text.text:
一阵寒意掠过你的指尖，顺着手臂猛然窜上。你的肌肉仿佛被灌进了铅块，连挪动一寸都成了挣扎。你咳嗽起来，鲜血灌满肺腑；每一次贪婪的吸气都更浅、更短。世界在你周围渐渐暗下。就在你感觉黑暗拉扯着你之前，最后一个念头闪过——你吐出最后一口气。
A chill washes over your fingertips and rushes up your arms. Your muscles feel like they have been pumped full of lead and it becomes a struggle to move even an inch. You cough as blood fills your lungs, your breathing shallower with every gasp for air. The world darkens around you. A final thought, before you feel the darkness tug upon you, and you exhale a final time.

这副护目镜的镜框里嵌着两只红色的椭圆眼。构成护目镜的银色金属上分布着数处可调节点，可随佩戴者头型细致调节，尽可能舒适地贴合各种不同的头部轮廓。
The goggles feature two red ovular eyes set into their frame. The silver metal that makes up the goggles features several points where the fit can be adjusted, designed to comfortably fit as many different heads as possible.

Elder Mimic Attacks Town.name:
年迈的拟态怪袭击城镇
Elder Mimic Attacks Town

Text.text:
某种几乎像尖叫的声音掠过平淡无奇的市集，令人脊背发寒。人们原本乏味的脸上闪过一丝困惑的兴味，四下张望，寻找那转瞬即逝的声源。有人掉进坑里了吗？是只被顽皮猫吓到的鸟……还是只被淘气孩子吓到的猫？“神祇在上！”有人用沙哑而惊恐的嗓音喊道。市集一角传来湿漉漉的咕噜声与低吼。一栋建筑像塞满棉絮的玩偶被撑爆了缝线般裂开，门面在木材吱嘎与筋腱般的爆裂声中龟裂。它像胸腔般张开，喷溅出潮湿、恶臭、黏腻的东西；一条紧绷的紫色长舌——被一圈发黄的象牙巨口框住——从楼中滑出。窗户开始蠕动，重塑成几十只鼓胀的眼球。镇民满脸敬畏与恐惧，笨拙地争相逃命。紫舌猛地射向最近的一群人，三个人像苍蝇粘上胶水般贴在那扭动的肌肉上。他们齐声尖叫，长舌随即一甩缩回那张深不见底的巨口；不过几秒，他们的声音便被闷住——被整吞入腹。

~ Envisioned by gltrahan

Something that almost sounds like a scream sends a shiver through the humdrum market. People’s bored faces glint with bemused interest as they look around for the source of the short-lived sound. Did someone fall into a pit? Was it a bird frightened by a mischievous cat… or a cat frightened by a mischievous child? “Gods above!” someone cries out in a horrified rasp. A wet gurgle and snarl sound from a corner of the market. A building splits like a stuffed toy with a bursting seam, the facade cracking with the sound of wooden creaks and ligamental pops. As it breaks open like a chest, spraying something wet, stinking, and gooey, a sinewy purple tongue—framed by a maw of yellowed ivory—slithers out from the building. The windows wriggle, reforming into dozens of bulbous eyes. The townsfolk, faces full of awe and terror, clumsily scramble for an escape. The purple tongue shoots out to the nearest group, and three individuals stick to the writhing muscle like flies to glue. They shriek in unison as the tongue whips back into the capacious mouth, voices muffled in a matter of seconds as they are swallowed whole.

~ Envisioned by gltrahan

Dragon Queen In Human Form.name:
人形态的龙后
Dragon Queen In Human Form

Text.text:
一名披着暗色丝绸的人类女子带着异界般的魅惑。她被阳光吻过的古铜肌肤毫无瑕疵，完美得近乎非人。她的眼睛异常幽黑，虹膜几乎不可见，闪烁着狡黠的机敏与永不餍足的好奇。乌鸦般漆黑的发丝盘旋成深色的波浪，自肩头与背脊倾泻而下，辫饰精致，发型一丝不苟。她露出一口莹白的牙齿微笑，而你不由得怔住——是为她的美，也是为那种古怪而令人不安的感觉：她仿佛正透过你，在看向更深处。
An otherworldly allure accompanies the human woman draped in dark silks. Her sun-bronzed skin is unmarred, flawless to the point of being alien. Her eyes are unnaturally dark, almost devoid of irises, and they gleam with a mischievous cunning, an insatiable curiosity. Dark coils of raven-black hair cascade down her shoulders and back, braided and perfectly coiffed. She smiles with gleaming white teeth, and you cannot help but be awestruck—by her beauty, yes, but also by the strange and unnerving way she seems to look through you.

Warlock's Patron-conjured Ship.name:
术士的宗主召唤之船
Warlock's Patron-conjured Ship

Text.text:
海水在你向庇护者祈求援助时翻涌起泡，怒潮般狂暴咆哮。腐烂海藻的腥臭猛然扑鼻；一阵凶风抽打着浪沫，将湿冷的盐雾劈头盖脸甩在你身上，刺得裸露的皮肤一阵战栗，满是咸涩的余味。自咸苦深渊之下升起，一艘船——体型庞大——在水的乱流中破浪浮现，木骨吱呀作响，硬生生顶开浪峰，挤上水面。

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

The water foams and bubbles in a furious tidal rage as you beseech your patron for aid. The smell of rotting seaweed assaults your nostrils, and a fell wind whips spray all over you, tingling your exposed skin with a salty tang. Rising from the briny depths, a ship—massive in size—surfaces in the watery tumult, creaking as it forces its way above the waves.

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

从粪秽深坑的底部喷涌出一股恶臭毒气，刺得你双眼生疼。你被那股味道熏得踉跄之际，一道布满触手的身影猛然破土而出；一张长满利齿、畸形扭曲的巨口在欢愉中咆哮，得意于已将猎物诱入触及之内。你感到一阵陌生的眩喜浪潮席卷全身——那是生物狂喜的回响被强行塞进你的感官——随即又不寒而栗：黏稠病腥的涎沫正从它那令人作呕的口中汩汩倾泻而下。
From the depths of the ordure pit comes a plume of foul gas, stinging your eyes. As you reel from the odor, a tentacled shape bursts forth, and a toothy, misshapen maw roars in pleasure at having lured prey into reach. You feel a foreign wave of giddiness wash through you as you are shown the echo of the creature's glee—and shudder at the diseased slaver pouring from its loathsome mouth.

Red Dragonborn's Joke About Heat Intoler.name:
红龙裔关于怕热的笑话
Red Dragonborn's Joke About Heat Intolerance

Text.text:
“你们在热里都可爱得要命——脸红得发烫，汗从毛孔里渗出来。我感觉自己像在带着一群烤鸡上路。”

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，出自 Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

“You’re all so adorable in the heat—turning red and leaking from your pores. I feel like I’m traveling with a pack of roasted chickens.”

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

各色草药整齐地排列在等距的种植槽中，纤薄的叶片上还带着新洒的水珠。迷迭香、牛至与百里香的香气扑面而来，让人仿佛走进一位厨师的梦境——可当你凑近细看，倒更像是药剂师的园圃。在这些可食的绿意之间，你也瞥见了它们苦涩的近亲：茄属毒草、漆树与荨麻。
An assortment of different herbs are lined up in evenly spaced planters, a fresh sprinkling of water on their delicate leaves. Aromas of rosemary, oregano, and thyme create the sense of walking through a chef’s dream—or, as you take a closer look, perhaps an apothecary’s. Among the comestible greenery, you also spot their bitter cousins: nightshade, sumac, and stinging nettle.

I Cast Antilife Shell.name:
我施放【反生命结界】
I Cast Antilife Shell

Text.text:
我向我的敌人高声喝问：你们还活着吗？你们曾降生于世吗？那么我便宣布弃绝你们——周身光焰如新生世界辉映，我双臂横扫划出恢宏弧度，锻成一颗璀璨光球，你们休想穿越其间。
I call out against my foes: Are you alive, and were you born? Then I renounce you, with a glowing world around me, a sweeping gesture of my arms that fashions this glittering sphere through which you may not pass.

暴雨如锤，狠狠砸在吊桥粗壮的木梁上，将古老而龟裂的木头浸得透彻入骨。水滴从巨大铁链锈蚀的链环间坠落，那些铁链无力地在桥面与门楼之间摇摆。沉重的闸门栅栏封死了前路，城垛上疲惫的守卫从高处以怀疑的目光审视着你。
Rain hammers down on the mighty timbers of the drawbridge, soaking the ancient, splintered wood to its core. Droplets fall from the rusting links of huge iron chains swinging limply between the bridge and the gatehouse. A heavy portcullis bars the way forward, as weary guards eye you suspiciously from the battlements above.

营地的搭建者支起了一顶巨大的帆布篷，篷下与周围堆满了他们的大部分物资。你听见货堆里传来鬼鬼祟祟的窸窣声，又瞥见一抹移动的影子。一具流线的小灰色身躯猛地一蹿，穿过草丛，窜到篷布后方。那东西比老鼠大得多。也许是你们的出现惊动了一只四处探险的松鼠或野兔。
The camp’s builders set up a large canvas awning, under and about which they’ve piled the majority of their goods. You hear a furtive rustling coming from the stacks, and a spot a flit of movement. A sleek little gray body bounds away through the grass to the rear of the awning. It was too big to be a mouse. Perhaps your presence startled an exploring squirrel or rabbit.

Dwarven Cleric Forging Armor.name:
矮人牧师锻造护甲
Dwarven Cleric Forging Armor

Text.text:
叮当的敲击声清亮悠长，如钟鸣般回荡。锻炉牧师的工坊把喧嚣在声学上打磨得锋利而动听：背景是咆哮的炉火，以及矮人铁匠低沉嗡鸣的咒句。石地上刻着一圈圈仪式法阵，环绕着中央那座由铁砧改作的祭坛。铸钢之上蚀刻着矮人符文，随每一次落锤以圣洁的节律脉动，像余烬般忽明忽暗。锻造一整套护甲费时费力，却并非没有欢愉。匠人将一片胫甲与另一片相互比对，抹去额头的汗珠，带着自豪的笑意继续埋首工作。

~ Envisioned by Skabak Runemane

Ringing strikes sing as resonantly and clearly as a bell. The forge cleric’s workshop acoustically sharpens the clamor into something beautiful over the backdrop of a roaring fire and the humming mantra of the dwarf smith. Ritual circles on the stone floor surround an anvil-turned-altar at its center. Dwarven runes have been etched into its cast steel. They pulse like embers in holy rhythm with the hammer swings. Forging a full suit of armor is laborious, but not without joy. The crafter matches a shin guard to its mate, wipes sweat from a slick brow, and resumes their work while beaming with pride.

~ Envisioned by Skabak Runemane

以当代弓匠的眼光来看，这把古老弩弓几乎是绝不可能的造物：它的弩臂与弩身竟全由某种秘银合金铸就，其间夹层般嵌入了薄得惊人的钢与秘银叠片，层层相衬，既轻灵又富于弹性，撑起近乎活物般的回弹之力。无需绞弦器回卷弓弦，只要将触发的动作反向一拨，便能让这把附魔弩弓自行就绪，随时待发。弩柄尾端烙印着矮人象征“忠诚”的符文。
Considered an impossible construction by current bowyers’ standards, the lath and stock of this ancient crossbow are made up entirely of some sort of mithril alloy, with extraordinarily thin strips of sandwiched steel and mithril layers bolstering its springy strength. Absent a cranequin for winding back the string, one need only reverse the motion of the trigger to ready the enchanted crossbow for firing. The dwarf rune for loyalty has been emblazoned upon the end of the tiller.

Sundries From An Adult Blue Dragon.name:
来自成年蓝龙的杂物
Sundries From An Adult Blue Dragon

Text.text:
检查那具庞大的蓝龙尸体——死时身躯扭曲——并没发现多少值得注意的东西；它的利爪、尖牙与鳞片在战斗中都被严重毁坏。然而，有样东西仍让你目光一凝：粗糙的绳网结结实实地缠在它额心的主角上，网中嵌着一枚黯淡无光的玛瑙，表面布满细密的划痕。
Examining the corpse—body twisted in death—of the large blue dragon reveals little of interest, as claws, teeth, and scales have been seriously damaged in the fight. Something catches your eye though: knotted about the central horn is a crude net of string, within which sits a lusterless agate covered in tiny scratches.

I Cast Contagion.name:
我施放【疫病术】
I Cast Contagion

Text.text:
在病痛令人作呕的咒语中，我将坏死召入自身免疫的手掌，随后以接触触及我那不幸的敌人。自此，毒素便开始它自己的战斗。我看得见那份挣扎：目标苍白黏冷的皮肤，眼眶周围泛着青绿，正竭力反抗。这场拉锯也许只持续几秒，却也可能拖上一整周。我能描出对手的面孔——失明或高热，溃烂或出血。他们要么此刻小败，要么日后大败。
In the repulsive utterances of sickness I call a necrosis into my own immune hand, then touch my unfortunate foe. From there, the poison starts its own fight. I can see the effort, the pale clammy skin and green around the eyes of my target, who fights back. The struggle may last a few seconds, but it could last a week. I can picture my opponent’s face, blind or feverish, rotting or bleeding. They either lose small now or big later.

Sundries From An Awakened Shrub.name:
来自觉醒灌木的杂货
Sundries From An Awakened Shrub

Text.text:
狂乱的灌木终于安静下来后，你把手探进它的叶丛间摸索。你没找到什么值得注意的东西，除了那枚空空如也、碎裂的鸣禽鸟蛋壳，以及一簇小巧、鲜红欲滴的浆果。
Once the frenzied shrub has stilled you reach in among its leaves and feel around. You find little of interest, save for the empty, broken egg of a songbird, and a cluster of small, bright-red berries.

光滑的银色刃首嵌入浅色木柄之中，恰到好处的平衡让这把武器既适合近身搏杀，也便于掷投。刃缘的豁口昭示着它早已见过血与火。沿着柄身，一句短语——也许是一段祷词——被刻进木纹之中：PRAISE THE DAWN。
The sleek silver head is embedded into a light wooden handle, the balance making this weapon suitable for close combat or for throwing. The chips in the blade suggest it has seen some action already. Along the haft, a phrase—perhaps a prayer—has been etched into the wood: PRAISE THE DAWN.

Guidance From A God Of Death.name:
来自死神的指引
Guidance From A God Of Death

Text.text:
“你的双眼被生者之气所蒙蔽。每一件你目光停驻的物体，都被你对养分的渴求，以及你将自身苦痛拔高到极致的绝望所浸染。但在死亡之中，万物得以如其所是——无痛、无义、无形。”
“Your eyes are shrouded by life. Every object they rest on is imbued with your craving for sustenance and your desperation to elevate your own suffering. But in death, all may exist as it is—without pain, without meaning, and without form.”

Quip About Nightlife.name:
关于夜生活的俏皮话
Quip About Nightlife

Text.text:
“呃，你们这些早起的人。你们知道吗，你们错过了生命所能献上的整整一重性相。夜晚才是我们最自由的时候。就在日出前那几小时的珍贵时光里，文明的矫饰会在一瞬间变得朦胧，城市也终于真正变得随性而生。”
“Ugh, you early risers. You know, you miss a whole aspect of what life has to offer. Night is when we are most free. Those precious few hours before sunrise where the artifice of civilization blurs for a moment, and the city becomes truly spontaneous.”

那生物脸上掠过一丝诡异的神色，眼睛骤然瞪大。它的嘴唇无声开合，像是在吐出词句，却半点声音也传不出来——气息卡在喉间。它猛地弓起身子，痛苦呻吟，死死捂住腹部。汗珠在皮肤上泛着光，它踉跄着跪倒在地，凄厉惨叫。尖叫声随即扭曲成骇人的嚎啸——兽与人的声线交织——它的身体开始重塑。骨头噼啪作响、错位移形。四肢被拉长。脊柱吱呀呻吟着弯曲，它向前栽倒，四肢着地。指甲化作阴狠的利爪；鼻与口在一声噼啪脆响中向前突起，硬生生长出狼般的长吻。黑色粗硬的毛发以刺立的斑块疯长，不多时便覆满全身。变形终了，那扭曲畸形的生物发出一声尖利长嚎：一头巨大的、佝偻的狼，黄眼闪烁着饥饿的光。

~ 构想：Atmoseeker

A strange look crosses the creature's face, eyes growing wide. They mouth words, but no sound follows as their breath catches in their throat. They double over, groaning in pain and clutching their stomach. Sweat shines on their skin as they topple to their knees, crying out in agony. The screams morph into horrific howls—a mingling of beast and human—as their body begins to reshape. Bones crack and shift. Limbs elongate. Their spine creaks as it curves, and they fall forward onto all fours. Nails become wicked claws, while their nose and mouth jut forward with a crackling snap, creating a lupine snout. Black, coarse fur sprouts in bristling patches, soon covering their entire body. The twisted, malformed creature looses a shrill howl as the transformation completes: a massive, slouched wolf, its yellow eyes gleaming with hunger.

~ Envisioned by Atmoseeker

Faerie Carnival Hall Of Illusions.name:
妖精嘉年华：幻象大厅
Faerie Carnival Hall Of Illusions

Text.text:
魔法一定很爱住在这里——人人都在猜这把戏是怎么做的，仿佛它只能由这世界的材料拼出来。那面镜子动了手脚，那条一路收窄通向一扇小门的走廊，不过是个捉弄你视角的盒子。对吧？蝴蝶从你自己的眼睛里钻出，成群悬停，咯咯笑着嘲弄你。那是灯光，还是你吸入的诡异雾气？而你是在看着它们，还是它们在看着你？
Magic must love living here, where everyone guesses at how the trick is done as if it could only be made of the stuff of this world. That mirror is rigged, and the corridor that narrows to a tiny door is just a box that plays with your perspective. Right? Butterflies emerge from your own eyes, hovering together and laughing at you. Are those lights or strange vapors you’ve breathed? And are you watching them, or they you?

Artificer With Moonstone Arm.name:
装着月长石臂的奇械师
Artificer With Moonstone Arm

Text.text:
一阵悦耳的共鸣在营地里回荡，工匠将他们的义肢手臂沐在粼粼月光之下——柔和而苍白的光束为月长石构造注入能量。他微微一笑，屈伸着人造手指，发出一连串轻轻的咔嗒声，融入蟋蟀的啁啾合奏，为群星照耀的夜晚低声伴奏。手臂深处点燃起温暖的蓝光，柔柔拂过发明家的面庞，投下温润的微明。

~ 设想：Sahlonahl（Discord）

A pleasing resonance echoes through the camp as the artificer bathes their prosthetic arm in shimmering moonlight—the soft, pale rays charging the moonstone construction with energy. They smile, flexing their artificial fingers with a series of gentle clicks, adding to the chorus of chirping crickets serenading the star-lit night. A warm blue glow ignites within the arm, caressing the inventor's face with gentle illumination.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Hot Summer Tournament Melee.name:
盛夏锦标赛混战
Hot Summer Tournament Melee

Text.text:
一阵灼热的狂风吞没了比武斜场，卷起漫天黄沙，令交战者半目失明，也遮蔽了喧闹人群的视线。尘云里踉跄走出一名满身泥尘的骑士，手指抓挠着头盔，绝望地摸索着系带。还没来得及把那碍事的巴斯克内特盔甩开，敌手便铿锵追上，挥舞钉头锤，发出夸张的咆哮。
A hot wind engulfs the list, whipping up the sand, half blinding the combatants and obscuring the view of the boisterous crowd. From the dust cloud staggers a dirt-smothered knight, clawing at their helm, desperately seeking the strap. Before they can cast aside the offending bascinet, an opponent clatters after them, swinging a mace with an exaggerated roar.

Glyph Of Warding.name:
守护结界符文
Glyph Of Warding

Text.text:
浓烈却不刺鼻的熏香气息缠绕在你周身，你在咒文的尾音里完成了吟诵。手势繁复而精准，词句更是艰深得令人窒息。你在地面上勾勒出一道难以言喻的强大符文——古老、几近被遗忘。符文之中封存着奥术的伟力，它曾炽烈地迸发光芒，旋即黯淡下去，只留下一个被灼烧过的焦黑印记。
The incense, strong smelling but not unpleasant, coils about you as you complete the incantation. The movements are complex and precise, the words doubly so. You draw upon the surface a rune of indescribable power, ancient and nearly forgotten. The rune holds within it the might of the arcane, and it glows fiercely before becoming little more than a scorched symbol.

半身人女子在店里轻盈穿梭，时不时举起一只巧妙设计的喷雾瓶，将水雾洒向遍布各处、整齐陈列的一军盆栽。编进她稻草色头发里的香草与花朵在她身后拖出一缕清新、微带辛辣的气息。她穿着亮色织锦背心与衬衫，配以便于行动的皮裤；宽腰带上别着一把修枝剪。
The halfling woman flits about her shop, spraying occasionally with a cunningly designed bottle for misting water over the legion of potted plants arranged throughout. The herbs and flowers woven into her straw-colored hair give off a fresh, slightly spicy scent in her wake. Dressed in a bright brocade vest and shirt with practical leather trousers, a pair of stem clippers is tucked into her wide belt.

Arquand Gazelle.name:
阿尔匡德瞪羚
Arquand Gazelle

Text.text:
当你目光落在这只巨大的鹿状生物身上时，一股宁静感便如潮水般漫过全身——它雪白如霜，六条纤巧的肢体稳稳托起身躯。生物那身奇妙的被毛短而贴伏，仿佛自带柔和的微光，细碎地闪烁。修长的脖颈高高扬起，尽头是一颗头颅：华润夺目的鹿角如冠般铺展开来，四只眼睛静静注视，嘴角带着温软的兽类微笑。它好奇地微微歪头。
A sense of peace sweeps over you when you lay eyes upon this large deer-like creature—white as snow and supported by six dainty limbs. The creature’s wondrous coat is close-cropped fur that seems to sparkle with a gentle light. The great long neck leads up to a head sporting a mass of lustrous horns, four eyes, and a soft animal smile. It tilts its head with curiosity.

命令的喧嚣、护甲的铿锵，以及磨刀石擦过钢刃的嘶响，甚至在营地映入眼帘之前就已触及你的耳膜。大地精的营地以一丝不苟的网格铺开，成簇的帐篷高悬旗帜，旗面印着十余支战团的徽记。炊火与熔炉升起缕缕青烟盘旋而上。铁匠们不知疲倦地修补武备，或锻造崭新的兵器。地精们在一座巨大的露天厨房里窜来窜去忙着备餐，空气里弥漫着焦肉的浓烈气味。两打披甲的大地精正在操练长矛，由一个粗壮如牛的军士领队，他咆哮着口令，对那些没有立刻服从的人狠狠甩出几记脆响的耳光。

~ Requested by bloodhadson

The clamor of commands, the clatter of armor, and the hiss of whetstone against steel reach your ears even before the camp comes into view. The hobgoblin encampment stands in a meticulous grid, with clusters of tents flying banners emblazoned with the sigils of a dozen warbands. Smoke spirals from cooking fires and forges. Smiths work tirelessly to repair armaments or forge new ones. Goblins skitter about a large, open-air kitchen preparing meals, the air pungent with charred meat. Two dozen armored hobgoblins carry out spear drills, led by a brute of a sergeant who barks orders and delivers sharp slaps to those who don’t immediately comply.

~ Requested by bloodhadson

Pile Of Obsolete Entertainment Media.name:
一堆过时的娱乐媒介
Pile Of Obsolete Entertainment Media

Text.text:
一堆陈旧的媒介被鼠粪与厚厚的尘土覆盖，静静堆放着。它们曾是旧日时代的巅峰，如今却像被遗弃的残骸般闲置一旁，成了进步的牺牲品。光盘、卡带、磁带——在无数次数字革命的浪潮中尽数沦为过时之物——沉默地蜷在被遗忘的角落。它们的困境是一则阴冷的警示：在不断演进的世界里，万物皆无常。
Covered in rat guano and thick dust, a pile of antiquated media rests. Once the epitome of bygone times, they squat unused, victims of progress. Discs, cartridges, and tapes—all rendered obsolete by countless digital revolutions—sit silently in a forgotten corner. Their plight is a grim warning of impermanence in a world that’s constantly evolving.

一扇破碎的茅草门松松垮垮地挂在门框上，任由风吹摆动。墙边陈列着各式各样的东西：装着散落眼球的瓶子、以及许多倒霉野兽的骸骨标本。腐肉与汗臭的恶味在房间里久久不散。角落里有一张桌子，桌腿由盘结的树根与白骨拼成，桌面被深深的爪痕般沟槽撕裂，血迹四溅。桌上摆着半只被生啃的生兔、数瓶颜色诡异的液体，还有一把歪斜的血刀。房间尽头是一座轰鸣的壁炉，炉上架着一口厚重的铁锅。
A broken thatch door hangs loosely in its mountings, swinging freely with the wind. The walls are lined with all manner of objects, from bottles of loose eyeballs to  mounted skeletons of numerous unfortunate beasts. The stench of rotting flesh and sweat linger in the room. There is a table in the corner with legs formed from gnarled roots and bone, its surface damaged by deep gouges and spattered with blood. On it sits a half-eaten raw rabbit; numerous bottles of curiously colored liquid; and a crooked, bloody knife. At the end of the room sits a roaring hearth with a thick iron cauldron.

Othcal Long-arm.name:
奥斯卡尔·长臂
Othcal Long-arm

Text.text:
这名矮壮的火巨人将紧绷的皮衫与皮裤撑得鼓起，结实的肌肉在其下起伏如浪。银色纹身爬满他的颈项与双臂；他右臂更为粗壮，右手握着一柄锻造锤，明显比左臂大上一圈。两侧剃短的头发向上收拢成一撮峰尖，燃橙如焰，靠近发根处泛着赤红。右眉上有三道疤痕交错切过，可他那双猩红眼睛在温暖的笑意里依旧明亮。咧开的笑露出几处缺口，灰烬色的牙齿参差不齐。他小心地把锤子放在铁砧上，用围裙擦拭双手，留下道道烟灰的污痕。随后他从工作区域走出来，向你致意问候。

~ Played by christoffer

Defined muscles ripple under this stout fire giant’s tight leather shirt and pants. Silvery tattoos cover his neck and arms. His right one, hand wielding a smithing hammer, is bigger than the left. Hair, shaved on the sides, forms a peak of fiery oranges with red near the roots. Three scars cut through his right brow, but his crimson eyes shine as he smiles warmly. The grin reveals a few gaps in his ash-colored teeth. He carefully lays his hammer on his anvil and wipes his hands on his apron, leaving streaks of soot. Then he comes from his work area to offer greetings.

~ Played by christoffer

这处海湾的围护与开阔海洋相连的水道，仍可看出它在最古老的精灵领主诞生之前，便被一场滔天风暴撕凿成形的痕迹。入海口近旁矗立着一座灯塔，穿透阴霾放射光束，照亮那狭窄的缺口，防止船只相撞或触礁搁浅。
Connecting the enclosure of the bay to the open ocean, the inlet shows signs of its formation by a massive storm long before the birth of even the most venerable elf lord. A lighthouse stands near the mouth, shining through the gloom, illuminating the narrow opening to prevent ships from colliding or running aground.

I Cast Silent Image Using Components.name:
我用施法成分施放【无声幻影】
I Cast Silent Image Using Components

Text.text:
我单手攥紧一绺柔软的羊毛绒，另一只手随之比划。我在脑海中勾勒想要塑造的幻象，将那幅心像纺作一缕带咒的言辞。我的视景在近旁自行织就成一幅无瑕的影像——然而这幻象除此之外并无任何实体可言。
I compress a hank of soft fleece in one hand, and gesture with the other. I envision the illusion I wish to create, and spin my mental image into a thread of incanted words. My vision weaves itself into a flawless image nearby—though the illusion lacks substance of any other kind.

这头怪物外形近似狼，却是完全不同的尺度：它几乎有马那么大，四肢粗壮坚实，足以撑起上半身那泰坦般的肌肉。野兽发出凶狠的低吼，咧开血盆大口，露出森然獠牙，仿佛能轻易咬穿金属护甲。
The monster has the basic appearance of a wolf, but on an entirely different scale. It's almost as large as a horse, with legs built solid enough to support the titanic muscles of its upper body. The beast snarls menacingly, baring a maw of vicious teeth that look like they could bite through metal armor with ease.

Loot From An Adult Brass Dragon.name:
来自成年黄铜龙的战利品
Loot From An Adult Brass Dragon

Text.text:
战斗后的寂静里，你搜查着黄铜龙的残骸；它逐渐冷却的躯体向空气中吐出缕缕蒸汽。经过一番细致检查，你发现它身上并无任何值钱之物——除了那几乎未受损的鳞片。话虽如此，这些鳞片确实能打造出一套令人惊叹的护甲。
In the quiet after the fight, you search the remains of the brass dragon, its cooling body venting steam into the air. After a lengthy inspection, you realize it possesses nothing valuable—bar the mostly undamaged scales. That said, they really would make an impressive suit of armor.

Elven Vale: Sanctuary.name:
精灵谷：庇护所
Elven Vale: Sanctuary

Text.text:
山谷这片地带的树木在你头顶高高拱起，树干如巨柱般拔地而起，枝干稀疏，唯有高处的枝杈相互交织，编成一张优雅的格栅，仿佛大教堂的穹顶。它为这片林地添上一种宁静的气息——近乎神圣。
The trees in this part of the vale arch high above you, trunks rising like great pillars, barren of branches but for the boughs that weave together into a graceful lattice fit for a cathedral’s ceiling. It lends this region of the forest a peaceful feeling—almost holy.

I Use Draconic Presence.name:
我释放龙威
I Use Draconic Presence

Text.text:
我的灵魂燃烧着祖先的狂烈之威，炽光透过我的肉身迸射而出，点燃我的双眼、口舌与心脏。无形的灵光骤然爆发，在我周身凝成一枚光辉之球，将龙裔先祖的力量与威仪引入我体内。只要我仍专注于此，附近之人便必须抗拒我的意志，否则就得向它俯首称臣。
My soul burns with ancestral ferocity, glowing through my physical form. It sets my eyes, mouth, and heart ablaze. An invisible aura erupts in an orb around me, channeling the might and majesty of my draconic forebears through me. While I continue to focus, those nearby must resist my will or bow to it.

Aether-channeling Charge Pistol.name:
以太导流冲锋手枪
Aether-channeling Charge Pistol

Text.text:
一束束管道彼此缠绕成这把武器的枪管，延伸至一个十号圆筒式转轮，里面装着空胶囊。它从 trigger 到发射的 time 超过一秒——胶囊先汇聚化学混合物，将其转化为以太，随后才从枪管中喷射而出。握把以皮革缠绕，枪身框架则是从一把文艺复兴时代的黑火药手枪上拆解回收而来。
A braid of tubes twist around one another to form the barrel of this weapon, leading to a ten-cylinder drum of empty capsules. The time from trigger to shot is more than a second, as the capsule gathers the chemical mix and converts it to aether, then exits the barrel. The handle is leather-wrapped, and the frame is salvaged from a Renaissance black-powder pistol.

Disjunction Chamber: Disjunction Center.name:
分离室：分离中枢
Disjunction Chamber: Disjunction Center

Text.text:
电流在室内四处跃动，沿着锯齿般的机器跳舞，又在镶嵌于墙壁与地面上的金银怪异符号间嬉戏。闪电在房间里一轮轮扭动翻卷，色泽与亮度随之变幻，以刺目的妖艳光彩将一切轰然淹没。
Electricity leaps about the chamber, dancing over jagged machines and playing around strange symbols of gold and silver set in the walls and floor. As the lighting writhes in cycles about the room, it changes color and intensity, blasting everything with lurid hues.

White Moose And Woodsmen.name:
白麋鹿与林中樵夫
White Moose And Woodsmen

Text.text:
一队伐木工在雪地里排成紧密的纵列艰难前行，朝一片高耸的松林走去，手里的斧头早已握紧。他们粗重的呼吸在憔悴的面前凝成白雾，因缺眠而浮肿的眼睛布满血丝。领头人满脸阴沉，浓密花白的胡子更添几分凶相，他抬起拳头示意队伍停下。几声倒抽气卡在喉头——树线边，一头白色麋鹿正冷冷注视，雪白皮毛上溅着新鲜血迹。它低下头，鹿角被血污玷染，猛然发出暴怒的嘶鸣。伐木工惊恐尖叫着想要四散逃开，可那怪物已在几次迅疾的奔跃间扑到眼前，蹄声如雷，踏碎积雪，裹挟着轰然的狂怒冲撞而来。

~ Envisioned by Faust

A crew of woodsmen trudge in a tight line across the snow, moving toward a copse of tall pines with axes already in hand. Their breath clouds in front of their haggard faces, eyes puffy with sleeplessness. The leader, his scowl augmented by a full, grizzled beard, holds up a fist to halt the train. A few gasps catch in their throats as they see a white moose staring from the tree line, its snowy coat spattered with fresh blood. It lowers its head, antlers besmirched with gore, and lets out a raging bleat. The woodsmen echo with cries of terror and try to scramble, but the beast is already upon them in a few quick gallops, hooves pounding through the snow with thundering fury.

~ Envisioned by Faust

Underpaid Delivery Driver.name:
薪酬微薄的送货司机
Underpaid Delivery Driver

Text.text:
男人抬头望着那幢高楼，又瞥了眼要送达的巨型包裹，叹了口气。他抬手扶正那顶荧光绿的棒球帽，启动腕上的生产力监测器，屏息凝神，吐出一口气，才把沉重的包裹抱起。为了拿到那点可怜的送货加值，他随即迈开急促——也不安全——的步子冲了出去。
The man sighs as he peers up at the high-rise—and the huge package for delivery. Adjusting his neon-green baseball cap, he starts the productivity monitor on his wrist and exhales with concentration as he lifts the heavy parcel. Eager to secure his meager delivery bonus, he sets off at a brisk—and unsafe—pace.

I Cast Animal Shapes.name:
我施放《动物变形术》
I Cast Animal Shapes

Text.text:
我说出口的只是忠告、建议。你们想成为熊、成为鹰、成为原野上的狮群——我不过推你们一把。我的手势召来兽魂的魔法，我的声音让肉身蜕变。我能感到你们所感到的一切，我的新朋友们。毛皮生长，骨骼更替，一切都毫无痛楚。唯有今天，你们的心智仍将保持原本模样。
The words I speak are counsel, suggestion. You want to be bears, hawks, a pride of the plain—I just help that along. My gestures call the magic of the animal soul, and my voice transforms the body. I feel what you feel, my new friends. The fur growing, the bones changing, all without pain. For this day, only your minds will remain original.

Base Of Athena Promechos Statue.name:
雅典娜·普罗马科斯雕像的基座
Base Of Athena Promechos Statue

Text.text:
这座基座矮壮方正，由被阳光亲吻的石块堆砌而成，是曾经高耸入云的雅典娜·普罗马科斯巨像仅存的遗迹。基座四面布满圆形突起，乍看如同一颗颗头颅，面容却早已被年代与风雨磨洗殆尽。
A squat, square pile of sun-kissed stone, this base is the only remnant of the once-towering Athena Promechos statue. Round protrusions cover each side of the base, looking like heads whose faces have long since been scrubbed away by age and the elements.

Short Descriptions Of Five City Commoner.name:
五位城市平民的简短描写
Short Descriptions Of Five City Commoners

Text.text:
一名兜帽遮面的披斗篷人类，背负一张未上弦的弓，在城中街巷间以惊人的速度与明确的目的穿行。城镇广场上，一对打扮花里胡哨的半兽人摆开骰局招呼路人，但你隐约觉得这套规矩恐怕不怎么公道。附近花园里，一个矮人拎着一根古怪的圆筒钢管来回巡逻，眯着眼、紧皱眉，显然在搜寻……某样东西。一个城镇卫兵醉醺醺地摆着架子踉跄而行，长矛拖在身后，嘴里自言自语——那是龙语吗？
A hooded, cloaked human with an unstrung bow across their back moves with speed and purpose through the city streets. A pair of garishly dressed half-orcs host a dice game for passersby in the city square, though you sense the rules might not be exactly fair. A dwarf with a strange cylindrical steel tube patrols the nearby gardens, eyes narrowed, brow furrowed, clearly hunting for . . . something. A town guard swaggers drunkenly, their spear dragging behind them as they mutter to themselves in— Was that Draconic?

Penthouse Murder Scene.name:
顶层公寓凶案现场
Penthouse Murder Scene

Text.text:
鲜血在顶层公寓打磨得光可鉴人的大理石墙面上划出宽阔弧线，价值连城的艺术品与被撕碎的家具残骸混作一团，破裂、散落、支离。曾经精致的天际线景致，如今被阳台门玻璃上抹开的血手印遮蔽——也许是某人临死前绝望逃生的最后一搏。一声低沉而掠食者般的咆哮攫住你的注意，你瞥见一截绿色的蛇形尾巴从拐角处一闪而逝。

~ Envisioned by Invaluable on Discord

Blood paints the polished marble walls of the penthouse in wide arcs, and priceless works of art lie torn and shattered amid shredded furniture. The once exquisite view of the skyline is impeded by the bloody handprints smeared across the glass of the balcony doors—possibly from a last desperate attempt to escape. A low, predatory growl draws your attention, and you catch sight of a green serpentine tail disappearing around the corner.

~ Envisioned by Invaluable on Discord

Giblets Guntaberry The Halfling Ranger.name:
“杂碎”冈塔贝里，半身人游侠
Giblets Guntaberry The Halfling Ranger

Text.text:
半身人头发里有只松鼠。这是你最先注意到的。那只红褐色的小啮齿兽蹲在半身人的背包上，把一团乱七八糟、五彩纷呈的野发从眼前抖开。背着它的主人不知怎么也与那份躁动的活力相得益彰——脚步轻快得像在跳跃，睁圆了眼四下张望，满是惊奇。若不是他肩上披着沉甸甸的深绿斗篷，身上又穿着带钉皮甲，你几乎会以为他下一刻就要飘离地面，像蜂鸟般轻掠飞旋。
The halfling has a squirrel in his hair. That's the first thing you notice. The reddish rodent perches on the halfling’s backpack and shakes a multi-hued mess of wild hair out of its view. Its bearer somehow matches that frenetic energy, walking with a spritely step and looking about with wide-eyed wonder. If it weren’t for the heavy green cloak draped over his shoulders and the studded leather armor he wears, you’d think he might just float into the air and flit about like a hummingbird.

Plane Of Ooze.name:
软泥位面
Plane Of Ooze

Text.text:
空气里弥漫着泥土与死水的刺鼻味道。一片你在物质位面从未见过的沼泽向四面八方铺展开去，漫无尽头。扭曲佝偻的树木从泥泞与淤污中探出身躯，藤蔓披挂其上，在刺骨寒风里吱呀作响。泥潭咕嘟冒泡，烂泥翻涌上浮又滑落，夹着沉积物的黑水拍打着你的脚踝。这里没有坚实的地面，没有片刻喘息，只有泥浆不间断地伸出黏冷的手，死死吸拽着你。
The air is pungent with mud and stagnant water. A swamp, the likes of which you've never seen on the Material Plane, spans beyond sight in all directions. Gnarled, crooked trees rise from the muck and mire, draped with vines and creaking in the frigid wind. The bog bubbles, mud rising and sliding, water dark with sediment lapping at your feet. There is no solid ground here, no respite from the constant, grasping sucking of the mud.

I Cast Fabricate.name:
我施放「造物术」
I Cast Fabricate

Text.text:
我开始吟诵咒文，创造我所需之物，将全部注意力都凝聚在眼前的原始材料上。我在脑海中尽可能清晰地勾勒它将成形的模样，连外观与结构的细微之处都不放过。刹那间，视野微微晃动——我正与被召来的蜕变能量角力；自然法则向来不容旁人插手——但我的法术已然完成。
I begin the incantation to create what I need, focusing all my attention on the raw materials before me. I picture the form I want them to take as clearly as possible, noting minute details in the appearance and construction of my creation. For a moment my vision swims as I wrestle with the transformative energies I have summoned—the laws of nature do not take kindly to meddlers—but my spell is complete.

Man With Goat’s Head Sacrifice.name:
山羊头男子的献祭
Man With Goat’s Head Sacrifice

Text.text:
他的眼睛苍白得与他高高举起的山羊头颅如出一辙，粉红的舌头从那松弛的口中耷拉出来。另一只手里，他握着一把巨大的剁刀，刀刃仍在滴血。近处的火光洒下地狱般的猩红，将山羊与男人一并笼罩，映出男人精瘦而结实的肌理，也照亮了从羊颈处垂挂下来的纠结内脏。
His eyes are as pale as those of the goat’s head he holds aloft, pink tongue lolling out of its slack mouth. He holds a large cleaving-knife in his other hand, its blade still dripping blood. Both the goat and the man are cast in the hellish glow of a nearby fire, highlighting the man’s lean, muscled physique and the tangled viscera hanging from the goat’s neck.

Lord’s Kneeling Hollows.name:
领主跪拜洼地
Lord’s Kneeling Hollows

Text.text:
南侧与西侧的两个壁龛里，地面各有一片磨损凹痕，想必曾有无数可怜人跪倒其上。那些凹陷后方、贴近地面的墙上开着脚掌形的孔洞，供跪者把双脚插入固定。向北的走廊很快撞上一段短短的阶梯，通向一处平台。天花板上隐约刻着褪色的诗句——由几盏小巧的黑色生铁枝形吊灯照亮，那些吊灯扭成怪诞的形状——诗句一路自大厅延伸，指向东方。
The two alcoves to the south and west each have worn places in the floor where many poor souls must have knelt. Behind those depressions are sole-shaped holes in the wall, near the floor, where the kneeler's feet would be inserted. The corridor north quickly meets with a short flight of stairs to a landing. The ceiling is faintly etched with faded verses—illuminated by small black pig-iron chandeliers twisted into grotesque shapes—which lead from the hall to the east.

Dungeon: Low Ceiling.name:
地城：低矮天花板
Dungeon: Low Ceiling

Text.text:
你每向前一步，天花板就更低一分，压迫般逼近头顶，近得令人窒息。石壁上的裂缝仿佛随着前行而不断扩大，也许只是昏暗光照下的错觉。直到某个地步，身材高大的冒险者不得不弯腰，才不至于撞上脑袋。
The ceiling sinks lower with every step forward, looming overhead in claustrophobia-inducing closeness. Cracks in the stone seem to grow larger as you progress, possibly a trick of the dim light. It reaches the point taller adventurers may need to stoop to avoid bumping their heads.

Bag Of Devouring.name:
吞噬之袋
Bag Of Devouring

Text.text:
你当然知道这是什么！这种挎包在吟游诗人的传说里赫赫有名，凡是配得上“冒险者”之名的宝藏猎人无不垂涎。它是一只次元袋！你脑海翻涌，忍不住猜想它昔日的主人曾把何等宝藏藏在其中。
You know what this is! Such satchels are famed in bards’ tales and coveted by every treasure hunter worthy of being called an adventurer. It is a bag of holding! Your mind reels at what treasures might have been hidden inside by its former owners.

施法者凝眉凝神，探手攫住受害者的心智。他猛然握拳，令人目盲的恐惧瞬间灌满目标的双眼。目标惊惶失措地胡乱挥舞，被影响的可怜灵魂带着暴烈的急迫挣动前行，在每一张面孔里都看见恶意。
The caster furrows their brow in concentration, reaching out to grasp at the mind of their victim. They close their fist, and blind fear fills the target’s eyes. Swinging wildly, panicked, the poor affected soul moves with a violent urgency, glimpsing evil in every face.

The Astral Tapestry.name:
星界织幕
The Astral Tapestry

Text.text:
你的双眼含着泪，努力去适应那片朦胧的海洋——粉与青绿、黑与蓝的潮流起伏翻涌。视线模糊之中，行星天体悠然游弋在注定的轨道上——有些拖曳着火焰的触须，摇曳如一缕缕金色长发。寒意在此处温柔地缠上你，仿佛无数幽灵般的手扣住你，将你拖入宇宙深处。
Your eyes water as they try to adjust to the nebulous sea undulating in streams of pink and teal, black and blue. Through the blurring of your vision, planetary bodies swim, unhurried, along their destined paths—some trailing tendrils of flame that wave like golden locks. The chill clings to you tenderly here, like many spectral hands latching on and drawing you into the cosmos.

Evette Sybille.name:
埃薇特·西比尔
Evette Sybille

Text.text:
紫发在光下跳跃着亮色，她那双绿眼睛却透着街头孤儿才有的机敏与警惕——懂得那种日子的人一眼便知。而如今，那同样的眼睛能读懂多种语言。她的羞怯与总爱靠近出口的习惯，或许显得谦卑，也或许像是在提防；但她对王国诸多言语的掌握，已足以证明她是个神童——智识从阴沟一路攀上宫廷。

~ Played by Walt M. with

Beneath the zing of purple hair, her green eyes display the quickness and suspicion of a street urchin—to any who understand that life. Those same eyes now read multiple languages. Her shyness and tendency to find a place near an exit might seem either humble or cagey, but her knowledge of the many tongues of the realm establish her as a prodigy, an intellect risen from gutter to court.

~ Played by Walt M. with

你的双眼如晨露般晶莹，望着田野彼端的树上，红褐的叶片纷纷坠落，宛如翻滚的瀑流，浸染着鲜明的秋色。你伸手接住一片自头顶飘落的叶子，惊叹于其表面红、绿、黄交织成的万花筒般色带，彼此交融流淌。大自然，当真令人叹服。

~ MaesterAelix 于 Discord

Your eyes gleam like morning dew as you watch the ruddy leaves fall from trees across the field, a tumbling cascade picked out in vibrant autumnal hues. You catch one as it drifts down above you and marvel at the kaleidoscopic swathes of red, green, and yellow merging across the leaf's surface. Truly, nature is a marvel.

~ MaesterAelix on Discord

一头巨型的四足蓝色蜥蜴高高耸立在你面前，沿着身躯全长覆着沉重的甲板。成排的棘刺自背脊一路延伸，棒槌般的尾端尖刺如冠。更离奇的是，它的面孔竟演化得酷似一只庞然巨鸟：几根羽状脊刺自一截几丁质骨质的小喙向上扫起。
A colossal quadrupedal blue lizard armored with heavy plating along the length of its body towers over you. A set of spines runs down its back and spikes crest the tip of its clublike tail. Curiously, its face has evolved the appearance of a humongous bird, with feather-like spines sweeping up from a small beak of chitinous bone.

Spectacular Cosmic Event Overhead.name:
头顶上方的壮丽宇宙异象
Spectacular Cosmic Event Overhead

Text.text:
当夕阳沉入地平线，一道炽烈的光芒在天穹骤然亮起，并在每一秒里愈发灼目。大地震颤，一颗独眼般巨大的陨石撕裂长空，掠过头顶，在身后拖出一条燃烧的毁灭轨迹。空气在刺耳的紊乱能量中扭动，刺目的色彩暴乱般倾泻铺满夜幕；那怪物般的闯入者撞入大气层，爆发出撼天的音爆，震波直撼星球骨髓。
As the suns set on the horizon, a blazing light appears in the sky, growing in intensity with each passing second. The ground shakes as a cyclopean meteor streaks overhead, leaving a trail of flaming destruction in its wake. The air writhes with discordant energy, and blinding riots of color vomit across the night sky as the monstrous intruder collides with the atmosphere, the sonic wave shaking the planet to its core.

I Have Devil's Sight.name:
我拥有恶魔视界
I Have Devil's Sight

Text.text:
当阴翳将我包围，火焰便沿着我的眼眶燃起——唯有那些能如我一般在黑暗中视物者，方能看见。余焰掠过之后，我眼白泛起一层金色光泽，虹膜与瞳孔褪尽色彩，沉入漆黑。这双眼是来自地狱的眼珠，任何阴影都休想令其失明。
When gloom surrounds me, a fire burns across my eyes—visible only to those who can see in the dark as I do. In the flame’s wake, the whites of my eyes take on a golden sheen. The iris and pupil fade to black. These eyes are orbs from Hell, which no shadow may blind.

你从泥泞的路面抬起视线，走出林地，映入眼帘的是阴云密布的天空下，一幅令人舒心的景致。土路蜿蜒前行，绕向一座由粗砌野石垒成的桥，横跨其上的是一条湍急的河流，深深切开翠绿的原野，冲出一道幽深的河槽。河岸边一间棚屋的屋顶升起一缕淡淡的苍白烟柱，牵引着你的目光。
You raise your gaze from the muddy road as you leave the woods and find before you a pleasant vista under an overcast sky. The dirt lane wends around to a fieldstone bridge, which spans the gap over a swift river that cuts a deep channel through the green landscape. A thin column of pale smoke draws your eye to the roof of a shack on the river’s bank.

Armor Of Resistance.name:
抗力护甲
Armor Of Resistance

Text.text:
这副护甲乍看平平无奇，但细细端详便能发现其上诡异的纹记，以及自内部传来的几乎难以察觉的低鸣。你清楚其中封存着强大的附魔，旨在将元素之力拒之门外。无论是寒冰、烈焰、雷霆，还是敌人向你倾泻的任何其他力量，守护这副护甲的符文都被调校为仅抵御一种元素。
The armor appears mundane at first glance, but closer inspection reveals strange markings and a barely perceptible thrum emanating from it. You know a powerful enchantment resides within, designed to turn away the elements. Be it ice, fire, lightning, or any other force the enemy throws at you, the runes warding this armor are tuned to resist a single element.

Natural Oil Seep.name:
天然油渗出
Natural Oil Seep

Text.text:
一场地震轰鸣着穿过无垠沙海与新月形沙丘后，地表之下的某处被撕裂开来。黏稠的液体涌上地面，把贫弱苏丹国边陲的沙漠染成漆黑——那里农民在酷烈的热浪下几乎无工可做，只能在灼烧的空气里虚耗时日。远离任何贝都因人的小径与城镇，黑色的池沼从大地深处翻涌起泡。有人会把它看作地狱的渗口，也有人会把它当作缔造全新苏丹国的起点。
After an earthquake rumbled through the open sands and barchan dunes, something deep under the surface cracked open. Fluid rose up to blacken the desert on the outskirts of an impoverished sultanate, where the peasantry works too little in the forbidding heat. Miles from any bedouin trail or town, the black pool bubbles from the earth. One might see it as a pool from hell, or as the way to build a brand new sultanate.

I Cast Magic Missile From My Staff Of Po.name:
我从我的权杖之杖中施放魔法飞弹
I Cast Magic Missile From My Staff Of Power

Text.text:
空气中骤然迸发出一股魔力放电的刺响，我引导法杖的力量，掌中杖身随之发热。炽亮的奥术能量箭矢拖着光痕疾射向敌人，每一道都在飞行中发出愤怒的尖啸，裹挟着致命的杀意。
The air bristles with a sudden discharge of magical energy, and the staff grows warm in my hands as I channel its power. Incandescent bolts of arcane energy streak toward my foes, each one keening angrily as they fly with deadly intent.

Eloise Angelus.name:
埃洛伊丝·安杰勒斯
Eloise Angelus

Text.text:
旅途风霜磨旧了伊洛伊丝的双臂与护甲，却未曾浇灭她的精神。她明亮的榛色眼眸以善意与接纳注视着每一个相遇之人。她也毫不费力地遮掩自己的右手——那只手宛如利爪，自肘部以下覆着一层蓝色鳞片的阴影。她周身环绕着六条微小的球形幼龙，在她施法时为其助力。

~ Played by Nes with

The road has weathered Eloise’s arms and armor but has yet to dampen her spirits. Her bright, hazel eyes look upon everyone she meets with kindness and acceptance. And she puts no effort into hiding her right hand, which appears claw-like and shrouded in blue scales up to the elbow. Orbiting around her are six miniscule, spherical dragons, who aid her in spellcasting.

~ Played by Nes with

I Apply One Dose Of My Restorative Ointm.name:
我将一剂复原药膏涂抹在皮肤上
I Apply One Dose Of My Restorative Ointment To My Skin

Text.text:
我把手指探进玻璃罐里，舒缓的混合剂立刻将一阵清冽的寒意送入掌心。我将药膏揉抹在皮肤上，治疗魔法便自那一点分枝蔓延，沿着我的身躯铺展开去，逐一处理所有表面的创伤——割伤、瘀青、疹子与灼伤。
I dip my fingers into the glass jar and the palliative mixture sends a refreshing chill through my hand. I rub the ointment onto my skin, and the healing magic branches out from there, working across my frame to address any surface wounds—cuts, bruises, rashes, and burns.

God Of Corruption.name:
腐化之神
God Of Corruption

Text.text:
一位和蔼的老者怀抱诗集，叼着一支短短的樱桃木烟斗，把长外套紧紧掖起以抵御寒意。他从灰白的胡须间露出笑容，先是称赞你几句。随后他提出一个请求，承诺事成之后给你一笔小小的财富作为回报。他还开了个玩笑，嘲讽政府的荒唐与无能——或者某个行业、行会、教会也一样。他说得头头是道，言辞温柔，提起孩子与苦难时满是怜悯。他安抚你，说你配得上他给的财富；而且归根结底，尽管眼下未必看得出来，你是在为一桩善事效力。
A kindly old man carrying a book of poetry and smoking a short cherrywood pipe closes his long coat against the chill. He smiles through his graying beard, pays you a compliment. He asks for a favor and promises a small fortune in return. He makes a joke about how absurd and ineffective the government is, or a certain industry, or the guild, or the church. He is convincing, says kind things about children and the suffering. He reassures you that you deserve the wealth he offers, and that ultimately, though it may not seem so, you’re working for a good cause.

Loot From A Harengon.name:
来自一名兔族的战利品
Loot From A Harengon

Text.text:
兔族人爪边放着一根橡木棍——樱桃木制成的武器，棍头硕大而虬结，正适合狠狠干上一记。斜挎在他们肩上的布制旅行袋里装着几样在这片地界对旅人颇有用处的物件：一瓶治疗药水、一套草药师工具，以及一包格子布裹着的面包和果干。
At the rabbitfolk’s paw is a shillelagh, a weapon of cherrywood with a large gnarled head good for walloping. The cloth travel bag slung over their shoulder holds a few items helpful to a traveler in these parts: a potion of healing, a herbalist kit, and a gingham bundle of bread and dried fruit.

A Dark, Telepathic Connection.name:
一段幽暗的心灵感应联系
A Dark, Telepathic Connection

Text.text:
一阵爬行般的麻痒在你的头皮上炸开，像是挨了轻微电击；可那刺痛非但没有如预期般消退，反而愈发急迫、愈发执拗。很快，那感觉仿佛有几根阴暗的手指把指尖压进你的头骨里，顶着你的大脑——不，不是大脑，而是直抵你的心智。那种接触冰冷而幽暗，像冰，却又被某种污浊玷染，彻底陌生、彻底异质。你张口想尖叫，想嚎叫，想以任何方式抗议，可喉咙里没有声音；你只能感觉那不可名状的存在硬生生挤进你的意识，带着力量与恐惧，几乎要将你淹没。忽然，压迫一松，那清冽、冰冷、异质的触感凝成一段讯息——一段你无法忽视的讯息。

~ 由一位英雄构想

A crawling sensation prickles over your scalp as if you had suffered a mild shock, but instead of the tingling subsiding as you would expect, it grows more and more insistent. Soon the feeling is like dark fingers pushing their tips down into your skull, pushing against your brain—no, not your brain, but your very mind. The touch is cold, and dark, something like ice, but tainted somehow, and thoroughly alien. You open your mouth to scream, or to howl, or to somehow give protest, but you are without a voice as you feel the eldritch presence push its way into your consciousness, threatening to overwhelm you with its power and dread. Suddenly, the pressure eases, and that clear, cold, alien sensation forms into a message, one you cannot hope to ignore.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Mountain Village At Sunset.name:
落日下的山村
Mountain Village At Sunset

Text.text:
落日将天地染成深红，一座村庄蜷缩在一堵擎天巨墙不祥的阴影下。孤身法师巡弋于村落边缘，法杖尖端泛起幽灵般的冷光。面前，一尊无首雕像伫立着，异质而阴郁的气息如同沉沉警告，提醒着曾经来过的人们。
Sunset paints the world crimson, with a village huddling beneath the ominous shadow of a gargantuan wall. A lone mage patrols the outskirts, staff tip glowing with spectral light. Before them, a decapitated statue stands, its alien presence a brooding reminder of those who came before.

河流切开大地蜿蜒而过，绕着一座小山的山脚转出弧线，随即漫入近旁的泛滥平原。水面在群山投下的阴影里微微闪烁，几只水鸟慵懒地漂浮在平静的水上。你不由得猜想，泛滥平原的水底究竟藏着什么——那些被水波掩埋的秘密。
The river cuts through the landscape, and as it curves around the base of a hill it spills into the nearby floodplain. The water shimmers, shadowed by the surrounding hills, as water fowl float lazily upon its calm surface. You wonder what lies at the bottom of the floodplain—what secrets the water conceals.

I Have A Stroke Of Luck: Melee Attack.name:
我福至心灵：近战攻击
I Have A Stroke Of Luck: Melee Attack

Text.text:
我的敌人中了我的佯攻。那一击看似笨拙、时机不对，其实我已将目标一步步逼到我想要的位置。我随即以真正意图的斩击回敬。凭借我的先见与精准，它绝无可能落空。别把这叫运气。
My foe falls for my feint. The attack only seemed clumsy and ill timed, for I have maneuvered my target exactly where I wanted. I respond with the strike I intended. It can’t miss thanks to my foresight and precision. Don’t call it luck.

Dragonborn Sailor Staring Across The Wav.name:
凝望海浪尽头的龙裔水手
Dragonborn Sailor Staring Across The Waves

Text.text:
水手头颅上那令人生畏的鳞片、犄角与鳍影，被一顶饰羽高帽与十几枚花哨耳环柔和了几分。龙裔立在船舷旁，仪态凛然，以穿透人心的蜥蜴般目光越过波涛凝视远方。那件油布长外套若非剪裁时髦，几乎可以当作帐篷。骑士长靴与绣纹紧身上衣本该令人惊叹，却被两样东西彻底压过风头：一柄宽刃弯刀，以及一抹雪白、满口利齿的笑容。
The forbidding scales, horns, and fins of the sailor’s head are softened by a plumed hat and a dozen gaudy earrings. The dragonborn stands at the rail, regal, staring across the waves with a penetrating saurian eye. The oilcloth topcoat could be a tent except for its fashionable cut. The cavalier boots and embroidered doublet would be impressive if they weren’t overshadowed by two things: a broad-bladed scimitar and a white, toothy grin.

你用指尖平衡着一滴蛞蝓胆汁，落点刺痛皮肤；你吐出的咒词黏滑低沉，喉音滚动。那枚泛着绿光的珠滴膨胀起来，离开你的皮肤悬浮半空，直至如骨灰瓮或马鞍包般大小。你指向你的目标。残酷的法术呼啸而去，轰然炸裂——酸性的炸弹泼洒四方，裹覆万物，蜿蜒钻入柔软的缝隙，啃噬不止。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Your skin stings with the drop of slug bile you balance on your fingertip, and the words you speak are slick and guttural. The green-tinted bead expands, lifts from your skin, hovering until it is the size of an urn or a saddle bag. You point to your target. The cruel spell flies and explodes, the acidic bomb coating everything, slithering into the soft spaces, and eating.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Bard’s Quip About Legends.name:
吟游诗人对传奇的俏皮话
Bard’s Quip About Legends

Text.text:
“世上并无真正的传奇。或许那些名字与地名曾经真实存在，但人生所能献上的坦白故事往往令人失望。我至今还没听过哪首叙事歌谣，能唱尽这一切令人窒息的平庸。”
“There are no true legends. Perhaps the names and places were once real, but the honest stories life has to offer are often disappointing. I have yet to hear a ballad that captures the crushing mundanity of it all.”

The Restless Lands Of Agony.name:
苦痛不宁之地
The Restless Lands Of Agony

Text.text:
毫不起眼的土丘从刺鼻的水中隆起，像胀鼓鼓的尸体般浮在浑浊的沼泽泥淖里。每一座丘顶都覆着扭结的植被，并被攫抓般的藤蔓与邻近者连成一片。当地人称这片地带为不安之地；它让旅人既生出必须逃离的冲动，又对向任何方向迈步心生退意。除了那些被荆棘堵死、艰难难行的道路，唯一的选择便是踏入齐腰深的水中艰苦跋涉——水下藏着不知名的险恶、两栖的守卫，以及更可怖的东西。刺痛的雾气侵袭眼睛、口腔与鼻孔，腐臭之气如木乃伊（特征）的裹布般紧紧黏附不散。

~ 构想：Vahlaron

Nondescript knolls rise like bloated corpses in the acrid water that mires the murky swampland. Each is crested with gnarled flora and networked to its neighbors by grasping vines. Known locally as the Restless, this expanse instills in travelers both a mandate to flee and a deterrent to move in any direction. The only alternative to arduous roads choked with thorns is a slog through hip-deep water concealing unknown hazards, amphibious guardians, and worse. A stinging fog attacks eyes, mouths, and nostrils, and the stink of rot clings like mummy wrappings.

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

学院早期的两位教授——费尔法克斯·戈德温-亚德利与杜拉·肯迪——一次意外造出了这根魔杖：一人顺手从塔楼檐口掰下一截冰锥，另一人又以恒久的仪式法术将其灌注定型。于是便有了它——一根朴素的冰锥，被握在更沉的那一端，尤其擅长聚拢风与寒冷的魔法。若被不当使用，魔杖似乎会以融化作抗议，但它从未真正改变过形状或体型。
Two early academy professors, Fairfax Godwin-Yardley and Durah Kendi, accidentally created this wand after one snapped an icicle off the tower eaves and the other invested it with ritual spells of permanence. The result was this wand: a simple icicle held at the heavy end, especially good at focusing wind and cold magic. The wand seems to melt in protest when used improperly, but has never actually changed shape or size.

Amulet Of Proof Against Detection And Lo.name:
防侦测与定位护符
Amulet Of Proof Against Detection And Location

Text.text:
你在第一眼看到这枚骇人的护符时便本能地一缩：一段刽子手的绞索，浸着陈旧的血渍，下面还垂着一截短绳。锈蚀的铁钉将它们钉穿，一枚枚把干枯的碎肉钉在绳上，主要是皱缩的耳朵与瘪干的眼球。大多像是兽类——你猜想——可其中有一只耳朵的尖端分明上翘，像极了精灵。
You instinctively recoil at your first sight of this gruesome talisman: a hangman’s noose, stained with old blood, from which dangles a short length of rope. They are pierced by rusted nails, each pinning a dried bit of flesh to the cord, mainly wrinkled ears and shriveled eyes. Most are animal—you think—but one ear is unmistakably pointed like an elf’s.

Runaway Teenager.name:
离家出走的少年
Runaway Teenager

Text.text:
那青年眼神惶乱地四下游移，紧抱着随身家当，将周遭尽收眼底。一只手死死攥着一根短手杖，另一只手拎着挎包。他们独自旅行，至少看起来是这样。路上的泥点溅满靴子与裤腿，你隐约觉得他们已有好几天没吃过东西了。
The youth’s eyes roam wildly about, taking in their surroundings as they clutch their belongings close. In one hand, they grip a short walking stick. In the other, their satchel. They travel alone, or at least it seems that way. Mud from the road flecks their boots and trousers, and you get the impression they have not eaten in a few days.

Loot From Thorn Wolves.name:
荆棘狼战利品
Loot From Thorn Wolves

Text.text:
在那群古怪的植物般生物巢穴附近的空洼里，你发现了一只饱经天气侵蚀的挎包，主人却不见踪影。打开一看，里面只有些最基本的给养：一条发硬的面包、一颗洋葱、一袋药用草药，以及一只装着21枚银币的小钱袋。
In a hollow near the den of the strange plantlike creatures, you find a weather-beaten satchel, its owner nowhere to be found. Inside, you find some basic provisions: a loaf of stale bread, a single onion, a pouch of medicinal herbs, and a small purse of 21 silver pieces.

I Cast Blur.name:
我施放朦胧术
I Cast Blur

Text.text:
只是自言自语。我从脚下开始，一路向上，每一条肢体、每一束肌肉都在法术的命令下随词句刺痛发麻，逐一化作自身的水样拖影。它们成了目标，却没有一个在空间中真正固定的点，几乎不可能恰好落在刀刃的斩处或箭矢的飞径上。
It’s just talking to myself. I start at my feet and work my way up, each limb or muscle tingling at the words of the spell commanding it, each turning into a watery smear of itself. They become targets with not quite a fixed point in space, unlikely to be where the blade cuts or the arrow flies.

Garden Of An Abbey.name:
修道院花园
Garden Of An Abbey

Text.text:
修道院大厅的辉煌与院中居民悉心打理的朴素菜园相较，反差格外鲜明。整齐有序的畦垄分开根茎作物与开花藤蔓，每周数次精心除草，确保泥土不被窒息般蔓生的杂草侵占。
The abbey hall’s splendor compared to the simple vegetable garden tended by the monastery’s inhabitants is pronounced in its disparity. Neat, orderly rows separate root vegetables from flowering vines, and special care is taken several times a week to keep its soil free from choking weeds.

Monk Performing Stunning Strike.name:
武僧施展震慑打击
Monk Performing Stunning Strike

Text.text:
没错，我们大多由水构成，但紧随其后的便是空气。我们的尘世形体之内，有着大量的空间。刀刃的平面，或长杖的沉重一击，都能在身体上找到那些位置——将风从肺里挤出去，或改变气流在四肢间的走向。当你听见那一声倒抽的喘息，看见对手仅仅为了站稳都在拼命用力，那么接下来会发生什么，绝大多数选择就握在你手里。
True, we are made of mostly water, but air comes next. There is much space inside our earthly form. The flat of a blade or heft of a staff can find places on the body that push the wind out of the lungs, or change the direction of current through the limbs. When you hear the gasp, see the effort in your opponent just to remain upright, then most of the choices about what will happen next are yours.

这柄精致的利刃平衡无瑕，只配最挑剔的恶棍。金色花环慵懒缠绕在镶嵌抛光血石的剑柄上，剃刀般锋锐的刀身两面各刻着一枚狞笑的骷髅。
This exquisite blade is perfectly balanced, suitable for only the most discerning scoundrels. Golden wreathes wind languidly around a hilt inlaid with polished blood stones, and the razor-sharp blade is inscribed with a leering skull on each side.

Primitive Ogre Tribe Settlement.name:
原始食人魔部落聚居地
Primitive Ogre Tribe Settlement

Text.text:
人形生物的头骨被插在木桩上，围成营地一圈；有些骨头上仍黏着风干的残肉。巨大的灶火腾起油腻的浓烟，盘旋着升向天空；火上架着转叉，最近一次狩猎的战利品正缓慢旋转炙烤。这个聚落的食人魔个个高大如塔，彼此低声哼噜着，等待盛宴开席。
Humanoid skulls adorn stakes ringing the encampment, some with desiccated flesh still clinging to bone. Greasy smoke spirals upward from massive cooking fires, over which the spoils of a recent hunt slowly revolve on spits. The ogres of this settlement, each of them towering, grunt at one another and await the feast.

Realizing Your Parents Were Adventurers.name:
意识到你的父母曾是冒险者
Realizing Your Parents Were Adventurers

Text.text:
一阵清明如潮水般涌入你的脑海，零散的碎片终于严丝合缝地拼在一起：你的父母，竟是本地传说里的英雄！你从未认真留意过家中零落摆放的奇异物件，也没太在意那些来访的古怪旅人。细想起来，你年幼时确实疑惑过——为何父母身上遍布伤疤——可他们总说只是些意外。或许，你体内也同样燃着那一点名为冒险的火星。

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

A wave of clarity floods your mind as the pieces fall into place: your parents are the heroes of the local stories! You’ve never given much thought to the strange items dotted about your home, or the curious travelers who visit. Come to think of it, when you were younger, you did wonder why your parents had so many scars—but they always put it down to accidents. Maybe you have the spark of adventure within you, too.

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

一个高挑身影悄然现身，身形修长，兜帽遮住了面容。背上斜负两张弓，一长一短；腰侧垂着一对成双的佩剑。她抬手将兜帽往后一拂，露出一张年轻半精灵的脸——暮紫色的眼眸幽暗发亮。她始终保持距离，唇线绷成一道薄薄的直线，目光冷静而挑剔。她的头发黑而微卷，其间若隐若现地染着几缕紫色光泽。

~ Played by Savvystardust

A tall figure with a slender frame appears, face hidden by a hood. Two bows are slung across their back, one long and one short, and a pair of matching swords hang at their hips. They brush back their hood, revealing the face of a young half-elf with dusky purple eyes. She keeps her distance, her mouth a thin line and her eyes discerning. Her hair, black and wavy, sports subtle hints of purple throughout.

~ Played by Savvystardust

Confession Of Vampirism.name:
吸血鬼化的忏悔
Confession Of Vampirism

Text.text:
“我已被一只兜售虚假力量承诺的生物剥去了曾经的自我。我现在告诉你们，我会找到解药，也会以同等的分量讨回被施加在我身上的一切——但我必须独自完成。若我伤到你们中的任何一个，我被赐予的永恒也不足以让我原谅自己。”
“I have been stripped of who I once was by a creature peddling false promises of power. I tell you now, I will find a cure and revenge in equal measure for what was done to me, but I must do it alone. If I were to hurt any of you, the eternity I have been given would not be long enough to forgive myself.”

I Craft A Bladed Gadget.name:
我打造一件带刃装置
I Craft A Bladed Gadget

Text.text:
我把钢丝弹簧紧紧盘起，丢进机身——一顶铆钉铁皮做的高礼帽，侧面开着钥匙孔。我把螺旋桨一片片拼合起来，三片桨叶都是可伸缩的叠层结构。随后把它安在帽顶，再用一块触发板把帽子的底部扣死。我给盘簧上紧几圈，只够一段短促的飞行，然后退后一步。礼帽腾空而起又砰然落地，板扣喀哒一响，剃刀般锋利的桨叶猛地弹出，瞬间张开到数英尺的直径。
I coil the wire spring tightly and drop it into the fuselage, a riveted tin top hat with a keyhole on the side. I piece together the propeller, each of the three blades a set of retractable layers. Then I set it on top and close the bottom of the hat with a trigger plate. I wind the coil spring for a short flight, then step back. The hat lifts off and lands, the plate clicks, and razor-sharp propeller blades snap out to several feet in diameter.

Thalio Hornton.name:
塔利奥·霍恩顿
Thalio Hornton

Text.text:
意识到有人在注视自己，羊男将紫色天鹅绒斗篷潇洒地往后一掀，固定在他粗犷肩背与胸膛上的金链胸针随之叮当作响。他用手指梳过自己又长又卷的头发，这个动作让那一束奢华的黑色发丝在光里微微闪耀——他摆出姿势，挑起眉梢，山羊胡下露出一抹笑。两支精致对称的角自额前弯出，镀金的角尖一路向下勾到下颌线，恰好将他尖尖的耳朵与翠玉耳坠框在其中。他身上只系着腰带与斜挎皮带，用来携带一把华丽的里拉琴和一条鞭子。未着衣物的下半身覆着深色皮毛，厚度恰到好处，刚刚能维持体面。

~ Played by NIK with

Realizing he’s being observed, the satyr flips his cape of purple velvet back, jingling the gold chain-brooch holding it on his rugged shoulders and chest. He runs fingers through his long, wavy hair. The gesture makes the luxurious black locks sparkle as he strikes a pose, raises an eyebrow, and smiles through his goatee. Fine, symmetrical horns capped in gold curve out from his forehead and down to his jawline, framing his pointed ears and jade earrings. He wears a belt and baldric only to carry an ornate lyre and a whip. The dark fur on his unclothed lower body is just thick enough to maintain modesty.

~ Played by NIK with

Young White Dragon.name:
年轻白龙
Young White Dragon

Text.text:
它踏着巨大的利爪足掌潜行，强健的肌肉起伏涌动，在遮蔽般的灰色皮翼下掀起一层层洁白鳞片的波纹；那双细小却刺目的湛蓝眼睛，悬在满口獠牙之上，带着纯粹掠食者——如猛虎——般的凶狠饥渴，却又透出一股几乎无法遏制、近乎人类的狂怒。
It prowls on great clawed feet, the powerful muscles of its body rippling white scales beneath shrouding bat-like wings of leathery gray. The small, piercingly blue eyes above its fang-filled mouth have all the menacing hunger of a pure predator—like a tiger—but also exude a barely bridled and all-too-humanlike rage.

Player Attempts To Decrypt Files.name:
玩家尝试解密文件
Player Attempts To Decrypt Files

Text.text:
[失败] 你将关键算法补丁接入AI，让它开始读取。检索先是细流般渗出，继而倾泻，最终化作坠落的浪潮——一片片荒诞乱码缓慢重写，逐渐逼近可读。忽然，运动戛然而止，加密文件僵冻结在页面上，随即自下而上被抹去。原本不可读的加密文本再次浮现，你的算法彻底失效。

[成功] 你将关键算法补丁接入AI，让它开始读取。检索先是细流般渗出，继而倾泻，最终化作坠落的浪潮——一片片荒诞乱码缓慢重写，逐渐逼近可读。你的密钥发问，AI作答，代码语言一行一行浮现，清晰可用。

[Failed] You patch your key algorithms to the AI and let it read. The search trickles, then pours, then floods in falling waves of nonsense text slowly rewriting itself into something coherent. Suddenly the motion stops, the encrypted file frozen on the page, and erases from the bottom up. The original unreadable, encrypted text returns, and your algorithm is useless.

[Successful] You patch your key algorithms to the AI and let it read. The search trickles, then pours, then floods in falling waves of nonsense text slowly rewriting itself into something coherent. Your key inquires, the AI instructs, and the coding language appears line by line, clear and usable.

Discovery Of Hanging Body.name:
悬尸发现
Discovery Of Hanging Body

Text.text:
你看见同伴脸上的血色瞬间褪尽，门吱呀一声缓缓开启，露出一幕骇人的景象。粗厚的编织绞索系在椽梁上，尸体轻轻摇摆——双腿无力地悬在半空——那便是“绞刑法官”的最新受害者。一声低沉的干呕紧接着响起，随后湿腻的泼溅溅到你的靴子上，显然这画面已超出你朋友胃里所能承受的极限。

~ Envisioned by Draziray

You see the color drain from your companion's face as the door creaks open, revealing a grisly scene. Gently swinging from the rafters by a thick, braided noose—legs hanging limply in the air—you find the latest victim of the Hanging Judge. A guttural retch followed by the wet splash against your boots suggests it is too much for your friend's stomach to bear.

~ Envisioned by Draziray

当你试图踏入时，一只手在你面前出现。你的目光沿着那条线条紧实的手臂上移，掠过宽阔的胸膛，停在一张轮廓如刀刻般英俊的脸上。然而，当你对上陌生人的视线时，胃里猛地翻涌起胆汁——他的双眼仿佛两汪无底的深夜，正不断渗出浓稠的黑色焦油。

~ Jakeskhakis247 于 Discord

A hand appears before you as you try to enter. Your eyes follow the toned musculature of the arm to a broad torso and a chiseled, handsome face. However, bile rises in your throat as you meet the stranger's gaze and see that his eyes—like two pools of abyssal night—are leaking a thick black tar.

~ Jakeskhakis247 on Discord

Dragonborn Private Investigator.name:
龙裔私家侦探
Dragonborn Private Investigator

Text.text:
鳞片覆盖的手将一件破旧的风衣拢得更紧，裹住那结实的蜥蜴般身躯，龙裔在倾盆暴雨中缩身避雨。一顶磨损的软呢帽——泥褐色——扣在他们那硕大的鳄形头颅上，帽檐残破，下面一双闪着光的黄眼睛老练地扫视着他们的嫌疑人。#REF!
Scaly hands pull a battered trench coat closer over a robust reptilian physique as the dragonborn shelters from the pouring rain. A worn fedora—mud brown—rests atop their large crocodilian head, and a pair of gleaming yellow eyes expertly survey their suspect from beneath its tattered brim.#REF!

Abandoned Office Building.name:
废弃的办公楼
Abandoned Office Building

Text.text:
[外部] 远远望去，这座办公楼毫不起眼——又一幢灰色混凝土方盒子。可走近一看，窗玻璃尽是崩口与裂痕，楼体微微剥落，污垢斑驳。怪的是，里面一点声音也没有——连电路常见的低沉嗡鸣都听不见。入口上方的公司标识黯然无光。

[内部] 大厅潮湿阴冷，昏暗而空荡。无尽的空房间在你面前延伸开去，有些甚至半淹在积水里。天花板破洞裸露出破败的混凝土与生锈的电线，寻常的鸟儿在垃圾堆里啄食。这里曾经的工作人员似乎匆忙撤离：留下一些有感情的东西——全家福、趣味冰箱贴——而一切可用之物都被剥得干干净净。

[Outside] From a distance, the office block looks unremarkable—another gray concrete building. Closer inspection, however, reveals the windows to be chipped and broken, the structure slightly crumbling and speckled with dirt. Curiously, there’s not a sound from inside—not even the customary low hum of power circuits. Above the entrance the company logo is unlit.

[Inside] The lobby is dank, dark, and deserted. Endless empty rooms, some half-submerged in water, stretch before you. Holes in the ceiling expose dilapidated concrete and rusting wires, while common birds peck through the trash. It looks like whoever worked here left in a hurry: sentimental items remain—family photos, novelty fridge magnets—while anything of use has been stripped.

Loot From An Ogre Zombie.name:
丧尸食人魔的战利品
Loot From An Ogre Zombie

Text.text:
你强忍着生物身上翻涌而出的腐臭恶气，在那布满孔洞的躯体里搜寻任何可能藏着的战利品。你瞥见一截武器的剑柄卡在它的肋骨间，深深没入灰白的腐肉。你猛地将其扯出，同时险之又险地躲开一股喷涌的污浊气息，掌中赫然是一把弯刀：状态极佳，不见半点锈迹，刀刃也仅有些许磨损。食人魔近来受害者的残骸仍散落在区域各处，还能让你从中掠走几袋钱币。
Braving the fetid stink rising up from the creature, you look for any signs of loot hidden in the hole-ridden body. You spy the hilt of a weapon wedged in its ribcage, stuck deeply into the gray flesh. Wrenching it free and successfully dodging a spray of foul air, you find yourself holding a curved sword in fine condition with no rust to be seen and only minor wear on the blade. Remains of the ogre’s recent victims still litter the area, as well, offering a few pouches of coin to plunder.

Mummy Lord Encounter.name:
木乃伊领主遭遇
Mummy Lord Encounter

Text.text:
死亡与时代立于你面前——它们寄居于凡人的血肉之中，却因死灵术而得以不朽。薄而蜡黄的皮肤紧贴枯槁的肌肉，绷在突出的骨骼之上。你明白此人必定早已死去——或是数十年前，或是数百年前，甚至数千年前——远在此刻之前；而此刻，一具本该腐朽的躯体，却以可怖而王者般的优雅行动着。
Death and time stand before you, embodied in mortal flesh made immortal through necromancy. Thin, waxy skin clings to withered muscle and stretches across prominent bones. You know this person must have died long ago—decades, centuries, or even millennia ago—long before this moment, when a body that should be dead moves with terrible, regal grace.

I Cast Bane As A Bard.name:
我以吟游诗人的身份施放「祸害」
I Cast Bane As A Bard

Text.text:
我用小调弹出寥寥数音，感召那些古老岁月里注定覆灭的恶徒之名。歌声流转间，我逐一与每个敌人对视。他们感到历史的重压——一场共同的末路。
I play a few notes in a minor key, calling the names of doomed villains of yore. As I sing, I look each of my enemies in the eye. They feel the weight of history—a shared doom.

Elkhazel Glynric, Called El The Riven.name:
埃尔卡泽尔·格林里克，人称“裂隙者”埃尔
Elkhazel Glynric, Called El The Riven

Text.text:
他古铜色的皮肤上细密的纹路、以及那头乌黑长发间掺杂的银丝，暴露了这名瘦削结实男子并非看上去那般年轻。他的五官锐利而狭长，鼻梁高挺如鹰喙。头部左侧剃得干净，露出一只微尖的耳朵，以及环绕其周的乌蓝色渡鸦纹身——利爪止于下颌线下方，尾羽一路延伸到颈侧。他祖母绿般的眼睛沉静，目光低垂而阴郁。身上穿着朴素洁净的亚麻衣物。腰带、靴子与铆着钢钉的夹克皆为黑皮，反衬得他叶绿色的上衣、赭色马裤与深夜蓝斗篷愈发醒目。腰带上挂着工具挎包；一侧髋间佩着细剑，另一侧则鞘着一把长匕首。

~ Played by Oengus

The lines on his copper skin and strands of silver in his long jet-black hair belie this slight, wiry man’s youthful appearance. He has sharp, narrow features and an aquiline nose. The left side of his head is shaved, revealing a slightly pointed ear and the blue-black of a raven tattoo that encircles it, talons ending just below the jawline and tail extending onto the neck. His emerald eyes are calm, his gaze low and brooding. He wears plain, clean clothing of linen. The black leather of his belt, boots, and steel-studded jacket makes his leaf-green tunic, sienna breeches, and midnight-blue cloak more apparent. His belt holds a tool satchel; a rapier is sheathed on one hip and a long knife on the other.

~ Played by Oengus

Loot From A Guardian Naga.name:
守护娜迦的战利品
Loot From A Guardian Naga

Text.text:
尾巴、眼睛、鳞片与骨骼皆可采收，而这头生物还佩戴着一副精巧的金链口篮笼头，价值20金币。篮中装着一瓶滑溜油；两块磁石；一小段笔直的铁条；以及一撮硫磺。
The tail, eyes, scales, and bones are all harvestable, and the creature also wears a halter of fine gold chain baskets worth 20 gold pieces. They hold an oil of slipperiness; two lodestones; a small, straight piece of iron; and a pinch of sulfur.

两座长方形水池之间，横着一条白石堤道，表面覆着一层橙色细沙，其间嵌着两块黑色石砖。道路两侧各立着一尊砂岩制的眼镜蛇腾起雕像，置于灰色岩石基座之上。东侧那条蛇在颈罩下方断裂，蛇首翻落在基座脚下，面朝下伏着。
Between two rectangular pools stands a causeway of white stone dusted in orange sand and punctuated with two black tiles. A sandstone statue of a rearing cobra stands on a pedestal of gray rock to either side of this path. The snake to the east has broken just below the hood, its head tumbled, facedown, at the base of the pedestal.

风车的三根叶架上丢了许多叶板，像缺了牙的梳子般参差不齐。每阵风掠过，它们便微微摇摆；由于另一根叶架已折断，残骸躺在塔基下方，如今更显失衡。安置风轴的顶帽也显出受损与荒废的痕迹，木板与瓦片缺了不少，但其下方那座厚实的石塔看起来依然稳固。
Three stocks of the windmill have lost many of their shutters, making them look like combs missing teeth. They swing slightly with each gust, unbalanced now that one stock lies broken below the tower. The cap that houses the windshaft also shows signs of damage and neglect, missing boards and shingles, but the stout tower of stone beneath it seems stable.

The Taxus Claw.name:
紫杉之爪
The Taxus Claw

Text.text:
这根魔杖是一只来自太初世界的獾的单枚棕黑色利爪，个头比灰熊还要大。它从以长草编成的握柄处邪恶地弯曲伸出，而那草握柄每个季节都得重新缠裹一遍。魔杖不散发任何可辨的魔法气息。事实上，它看起来就像一截死骨，或是拙劣艺人随手刻出的懒散作品——直到一只带着严肃意志的魔法之手握住那编织的握柄。
The wand is the single brownish-black claw of a badger from the primordial world, larger than a grizzly bear’s. It curves wickedly from a handle grip of long grasses that have to be rewrapped every season. The wand radiates no discernible magic. In fact, it seems like dead bone or a lazy carving by a poor artist—that is, until a magical hand of serious intent takes hold of the claw’s woven handle.

啮齿类的双手合十祈祷，战士灰白的面孔庄严地低垂在嶙峋的指节上方。他站起身来，沉重的护甲与盾牌随移动铿锵作响。胸甲压在肩头，将他粗硬、钢丝般的厚毛闷得服帖失声。护甲正面绘着一枚黑色圆球，肩甲则被塑成羽带般的纹样，仿佛层层缠绕覆过他的肩。正如护甲沉沉挂在躯体上，某种念头或恐惧也像重物压在他的灵魂上。他的绿眼在阴影里来回游移，带着受惊般的警觉；参差磨损的胡须在惨白的口鼻上微微抽动。

~ Played by Sharum Ka

Rodential hands clasped in prayer, the warrior’s gray face is lowered solemnly over his bony knuckles. He stands, heavy armor and shield clanging with the movement. His chestplate weighs upon his shoulders, dampening the volume of his thick, wiry fur. The front of the armor is painted with a black sphere, and the pauldrons are stylized like bands of feathers wrapping over his shoulders. Just as the armor hangs heavily upon his body, some thought or fear seems to weigh upon his soul. His green eyes flit about with a haunted vigilance, his frayed and uneven whiskers twitching on his blanched snout.

~ Played by Sharum Ka

Return To Life Cast By Paladin.name:
圣武士施放的《重返生命》
Return To Life Cast By Paladin

Text.text:
你虔信的圣徽在你向神祇祈求援助时开始发光；当你将手按在同伴破裂撕开的躯体上时，它随神圣的魔法脉动震颤。你合上双眼，以意志呼唤那正要离去的灵魂归来，再次为他们注入生命。
The symbol of your faith begins to glow as you beseech your deity for aid, throbbing with divine magic as you place a hand upon the torn body of your companion. Closing your eyes, you will their departing soul to return, to fill them with life once more.

驯鹰人眯起眼迎着日光，眸中的锋锐几乎不输给那位相伴多时、经年训练的羽翼同伴。只见他们动作流畅地抬起左臂——那臂上裹着厚实的皮革护臂，纵横交错着无数爪痕——栖在其上的猛禽随即振翅腾空，直扑辽阔湛蓝的天空。
The falconer squints against the sun, the expression in their eyes nearly as keen as that of the avian companion they have spent so long training. With a smooth motion, they raise their left arm, swathed in a thick leather gauntlet crisscrossed with countless talon marks, and the bird of prey perched there launches itself into the broad, blue sky.

Victory Quip About A Cruel Foe.name:
关于残忍敌人的胜利俏皮话
Victory Quip About A Cruel Foe

Text.text:
“我不知道神祇会把你这种渣滓送去哪里，但不管那是什么地方，我都希望你受尽折磨……而且我希望你孤零零地受。”
“I don’t know where the gods send scum like you, but wherever it is, I hope you suffer… and I hope you suffer alone.”

Meira The Dancer.name:
梅拉·舞者
Meira The Dancer

Text.text:
那女人令人神魂颠倒。你仿佛在观看一位女神的演出——她随着音乐自如流转，每一个动作都与节拍严丝合缝。她腰间的钱币随舞步轻轻叮当作响，偶尔折射出光芒，更衬得她周身华彩飞扬、辉煌夺目——恰如她无瑕的杏色肌肤上点缀的片片金鳞。她在虹彩般的残影中穿梭——快得让人目不暇接——衣袂的万千色泽交融成一场炫目的色彩狂潮。

~ 由一位英雄饰演

The woman is utterly mesmerizing. You feel as if you are watching the performance of a goddess as she effortlessly flows with the music, every move perfectly paired with the rhythm. The coins at her waist jingle softly as she dances, occasionally catching the light, adding to her effervescent aura of magnificence—much like the patches of golden scales dotted across her flawless almond skin. She moves in a prismatic blur—too fast for the eye to follow—as the myriad hues of her clothing blend together in a scintillating riot of color.

~ Played by a Hero with

Belt Of Hill-giant Strength.name:
丘陵巨人力量腰带
Belt Of Hill-giant Strength

Text.text:
这条腰带看上去大得离谱，却又仿佛能恰到好处地贴合佩戴者腰身的周长。它以厚重的猛犸皮缝制，边缘镶着蓬松洁白的毛皮；正中央是一枚巨大的黄铜扣环，其上浮雕着一张巨人畸形的面孔——圆鼓的鼻头、后倾的额头，以及突出的下颚。巨人的嘴大张着发出咆哮，舌头耷拉在外，露出一排破碎与缺失的牙齿。
The belt appears much too large, and yet it seems to perfectly wrap about the circumference of its wearer’s waist. Stitched of heavy mammoth hide and trimmed with woolly, white fur, the belt displays a massive brass buckle depicting the misshapen face of a giant with a bulbous nose, sloping forehead, and jutting lower jaw. The giant’s mouth is agape in a roar, the tongue lolling out and revealing broken and missing teeth.

这间墓室里挤满了五具大小不一的石棺，旁边还散落着陶罐和两只较小的石匣。两具石棺由白石凿成，另外三具则是深灰色。每具棺盖上都刻着流畅的金色文字，并各自刻着不同的蛇形徽记。其中一具深色石棺歪斜在一旁，棺盖翻落在地，遮住了棺内的景象。就在这些坟冢之间的某处，传来轻柔的刮擦声。
Five stone coffins of various sizes crowd this chamber, along with clay vessels and a couple smaller stone chests. White stone makes up two coffins, and three are dark gray. All have fluid writing in gold and a differing snake symbol on the lid. One darker casket sits askew, its lid tumbled to the floor, obscuring its contents.
