From somewhere among these tombs comes a soft scraping sound.

Tower Gate In Winter.name:
冬日塔门
Tower Gate In Winter

Text.text:
两拨八到十三岁的孩子在雪地里对垒，展开一场雪球大战。笑声与逞强的叫嚷交织在一起。你听见有人喊着“Valehaven”和“Oldenberry”，语气或自豪或轻蔑，全看是哪一边在说话。塔门的守卫在岗亭处旁观，靠着城垛，时不时插几句评头论足，俯瞰着下方的混战。
Two groups of children between the ages of eight and thirteen, face off in a snowball fight. Laughter mingles with shouts of bravado. You hear “Valehaven” and “Oldenberry” cried out with either pride or disdain, depending on which side is speaking. The Tower Gate guards watch from their station, leaning against the battlement and adding their own commentary on the fight below.

这里的地面上到处散落着一罐罐光滑、精雕细琢的泥器，体型与形状千差万别。从小巧的杯盏到巨大的陶制双耳长颈罐，每一件陶器上都映着近旁河流泥土的赤褐色泽。
Pots of smooth, sculpted mud can be found all over the ground here, varying wildly in size and shape. From small cups to huge earthenware amphorae, the auburn tint of the nearby river’s mud can be seen in every piece of pottery.

Destitute Desert Town.name:
赤贫的沙漠小镇
Destitute Desert Town

Text.text:
街上零星有人来来往往，勉强让这里不至于有那种幽灵（特征）城镇的凄清魅力。木板外墙的建筑沿着地基处补丁累累、霉斑蔓延，看着就像早该查封，直到有人抱着一台笨重的数据板核对着什么，推开吱呀作响的门走了进去。脚下是粉白的干土，人行木栈道满是木刺与裂痕。热浪像铁匠的锤子砸下来，落在那些粗粝的灵魂身上——他们只想在一点阴影里把无聊打发掉。
There are just enough people crossing the street here and there to keep it from having the charm of a ghost town. Plank-sided buildings, patched and moldy along the foundations, look to be condemned until someone checking a bulky datapad walks through a creaky door. The ground is chalky dirt, the boardwalk splintery. Heat like a smith’s hammer lands on the rough souls trying to spend their boredom in some shade.

一股猩红能量迸裂而出，凝聚成一对巨大的、炽热翻涌的手掌。它们带着震颤般的巨力猛然拍向你的目标。目标被震得向后急滑，随即狼狈地翻倒成一团。那双手得意地合掌一击，旋即在一团绯红烟雾中消散无踪。
A wave of red energy crackles forth and manifests as a pair of huge, simmering hands. They slam against your target with shuddering force. The target skids backwards before toppling into a vexed heap. The hands clap together, triumphant, then disappear into a puff of scarlet smoke.

一只双足猛禽般的生物迈着强健有力的腿四处踱步，脚端是锋利的爪钩。它修长精瘦的躯体覆着光滑的羽毛，极简的护甲之下护住柔软的腹底与灵活的颈项。鞭状长尾猛然抽动，维持着生物的平衡。彩羽如扇般在尾端与蜥蜴般的头冠上铺展、轻颤。橙色的眼眸涌出一阵魔法能量的波动。
A bipedal raptor strides about on powerful legs that end in claws. The being’s long lean body is covered in sleek feathers beneath the minimalist armor protecting a soft underbody and flexible neck. A whiplike tail lashes out, keeping the creature’s balance. Colored feathers, fanning out and twitching, bedeck both the end of the tail and the crown of the lizard-like head. A wave of magical energy emanates from orange eyes.

Offended Brick.name:
被冒犯的砖块
Offended Brick

Text.text:
两名学生在塔旁低声亲昵地交谈。其中一人凑得更近；另一人抱着好几本书，神情怀疑，却仍站在原地不动。前者嘴角挂着得意的笑，目光轻佻，伸手撑向塔壁。就在他掌心按下的瞬间，那块砖猛地从墙里顶出来，沿着几排砖缝滑落下去。学生脚下一空，踉跄跌倒；那块砖随即腾空划出一道弧线，砰地弹在他的手臂上，清脆一声裂响伴着惨叫。它厉声喊道：“手放规矩点！”随即呼啸着飞回原位，严丝合缝地嵌回墙中。
Two students are having an intimate chat by the tower. One moves in closer. The other, skeptical and clutching several books, stays put. The first, smug and leering, puts out a hand to lean against the tower wall. The brick under his hand suddenly pushes out of the wall and slides down several rows. The student falls, and the brick launches into an arc and bounces off the student’s arm, producing a crack and a scream. It shouts, “Hands to yourself!” and flies back into its vacated space.

Toppled \"Nearest\" Tombstone.name:
倾倒的“最近”墓碑
Toppled "Nearest" Tombstone

Text.text:
墓碑面朝下趴在带露的草地里，像是被挖开坟墓的人随手丢到一旁。

[翻过来] 你费力掀起沉重的大理石碑板，露出一张覆满黏结泥土与枯死草屑的碑面。你拂开蠕虫、鼻涕虫与污泥，终于辨出上面刻着：离我们心最近、最珍爱的人。

The tombstone lies face down in the dewy grass, carelessly tossed aside by whomever dug up the grave.

[Turned over] You heave up the heavy slab of marble, revealing a face covered in clinging dirt and dead grass. Brushing away the worms, slugs, and muck, you can make out the following inscription: Nearest and dearest to our hearts.

一根修长流畅的枝条，由无瑕精雕的木材制成，末端逐渐收束成完美的尖点。没有任何繁饰或纹样——只有朴素而光滑的精确度，让这支木尖长矛以惊人的速度破空飞掷。
A long and sleek branch of immaculately carved wood transitions to a perfectly tapered point at the end. There are no flourishes or designs—just simple, smooth precision for vaulting the wooden-tipped spear through the air with astonishing speed.

Necklace Of Fireballs.name:
火球项链
Necklace Of Fireballs

Text.text:
这条纤细的金链上垂挂的每一颗黄色玻璃珠，仿佛都在自发地微微发亮，像是各自封着一缕细小的烛焰——可转瞬便又熄灭。是光线在作祟吗？它并没有维持的光芒，但你几乎敢发誓，自己确实看见了明亮、跳跃的火花。
Each of the yellow glass beads hanging from this slender golden chain seems to glow of their own accord, as if each contains a tiny candle flame, but just as quickly, it fades. Is it a trick of the light? There is no sustained glow, but you would swear that you saw bright, dancing sparks.

After-battle Quip About Gore.name:
战后血肉横飞的俏皮话
After-battle Quip About Gore

Text.text:
“知道打了这么多仗之后，居然还有新的、恶心得要命的软泥怪能往我身上糊，真让人安心。”
“It’s reassuring to know that even after so many battles, there are still new and disgusting oozes to get covered in.”

Curious Badger In The Night.name:
夜色中的好奇獾
Curious Badger In The Night

Text.text:
一阵轻轻的拱鼻嗅探声引起了你的注意：月光下，一具鹿的尸体悬挂着，静静晃动。它的下方，有个毛茸茸的小影子正小心翼翼地探查着。那生物用后腿站起，短暂地从草丛间直起身来，露出真容——一只獾。
A quiet snuffling noise attracts your attention to the carcass of a deer hanging in the moonlight. Beneath it a small furry shape makes cautious investigations. The creature stands on hind legs, briefly rising up from the grass to reveal itself as a badger.

Rugged Dwarf Hero.name:
粗犷的矮人英雄
Rugged Dwarf Hero

Text.text:
一柄沉重的战斧挂在矮人腰间，斧顶那枚凶狠的尖刺在光线下闪烁，武器随他胯侧摆动而摇曳。和大多数矮人一样，他矮壮敦实，宽阔得像铁砧——也同样坚韧难摧。粗犷的面容上，浓密的黑色胡须与醒目的眉毛如成片的鬃丛般疯长，他豪爽大笑时，丰厚的肚腩也随之颤动。那双板岩灰的眼睛里仍留着一丝隐约的暖意，像好友共火后残存的余烬。
A weighty battleaxe hangs from the dwarf’s belt, the vicious spike at its apex catching the light as the weapon swings upon his hip. Like most dwarves, he is squat and broad like an anvil—and just as tough. A hearty beard and prominent eyebrows sprout from his rugged features in swathes of black hair, and his ample belly shakes as he laughs gregariously. A subtle warmth lingers in his slate-gray eyes, like the embers of a fire shared by friends.

Well-read College Professor.name:
博学的大学教授
Well-read College Professor

Text.text:
老花镜在教授鼻梁末端压出了浅浅的凹痕——即便眼镜不在——宛如文学的荣誉勋章。一册书总是稳稳夹在那件粗呢花呢外套的臂弯下，衣料里浸着深夜咖啡与独处的怀旧气息。
Reading glasses have made small indents at the end of the professor’s nose—even when the glasses are absent—like literary badges of honor. A book is always tucked firmly beneath the arm of their rough tweed jacket, which is infused with the nostalgic scent of late-night coffee and solitude.

My Gray Robe Of The Archmagi Gives Me An.name:
我的大法师灰袍让我在对抗一个法术时获得优势
My Gray Robe Of The Archmagi Gives Me An Advantage Against A Spell

Text.text:
我的对手掷出一道法术，我一把攥住长袍下摆猛地提起，挡在身前。那片巨大的灰色布幕吞下了大半冲击，魔法在织物里翻涌，像雷云深处酝酿的闪电。我将下摆甩回，魔法噼啪作响，无害地击打在地面上。
My adversary flings a spell, and I grab the hem of my robe and hoist it up to shield me. The great gray swathe absorbs most of the blow, the magic roiling within the fabric like lightning building in a thundercloud. I throw the hem back and magic crackles harmlessly against the ground.

Music Sprite.name:
音乐小妖精（特征）
Music Sprite

Text.text:
小妖精（特征）在一声悠长而低沉的口哨中被召来，从它的外壳里舒缓地逸出——如一段轻扬的旋律——化作蜿蜒流转的蓝色光线。那光芒渐渐凝定成一具优雅的身影，隐约类人，却并不全然凝实。竖琴般的清辉一闪，高亢的女中音随之响起，引得路人纷纷回首。声音清脆澄澈，仿佛山间湖面掠过的一圈涟漪。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The sprite is summoned with a long, low whistle, easing out from its casing—like a lilting melody—in swish-curving lines of blue light. The light settles into an elegant figure, vaguely humanoid, not quite solid in form. A sparkle of harp-song and a high alto note sound, turning heads from passersby. The sound is crisp and clear, like a ripple across the face of a mountain lake.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Expansive Book Of History.name:
浩瀚史书
Expansive Book Of History

Text.text:
你扫过索引，映入眼帘的是一长串学者、史家与名人的名字，他们栖身于这部书泛黄的纸页之间。每一页的右下角都印着一幅标注为“馆长”的男子肖像；你翻阅时，他透过单片眼镜审视着你。若你在某一段落逗留太久，他便会沉沉叹息，浓密的胡子也随之耷拉下来，仿佛无聊得快要枯萎。
As you scan the index, you see a long list of scholars, historians, and famous figures who reside in the yellowed pages of this text. A portrait of a man labeled “the Curator” sits in the lower right-hand corner of each page, peering at you through his monocle as you peruse. Linger too long in one section and he will heave a great sigh, his bushy mustache wilting in apparent boredom.

秋日满月的清辉，被无数灯笼映得更亮——它们千形万状、体型各异，为新年的鸿运照亮前路。时不时，孩童与大人围成一圈，玩着节庆的仪式游戏，在根源的欢愉中尽情沉醉。四下里，盘盘精巧点缀的馅糕任人取用，聚会的人群里，手捧一块糕、提着一壶茶的人比比皆是。处处是笑脸，处处回荡着庆典里醇厚的欢笑。 The light of the autumn full moon is augmented by countless lanterns of every conceivable shape and size, lighting the way for good fortune in the new year. Here and there, children and adults alike gather in circles to play the ceremonial games of the festival, reveling in the joy of tradition. Everywhere, platters of intricately decorated stuffed cakes are up for grabs, and more hands in the gathering hold a cake and a flask of tea than not. Everywhere there are smiles, and the rich laughter of joy in celebration.

Ashes To Ashes, Dust To Dust.name:
化为灰烬，归于尘土
Ashes To Ashes, Dust To Dust

Text.text:
焦肉与焦发的气味沉沉压在空气里。铁匠铺外聚起一小群人，彼此低声嘀咕，语气压得又轻又惶。 “你看见了吗？”有人问。 “一道绿光一闪，一声被掐断的惨叫，然后他就……没了。” 倒霉的德鲁伊尸体就在众人围拢的中央，仍在闷闷冒烟——一团烧焦的残骸与被轰裂的金属，向外翻卷，像一朵枯萎花朵被剥开的花瓣。一截骷髅般的手臂与胸甲熔作一体，成了唯一的线索，证明那堆灰烬与焦黑骨头曾经是个人。 “他……融化了。”一名旁观者带着敬畏的低语说道。 “更像是炸开了。”另一个回道。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，Treantmonk 创作

如果一名 德鲁伊穿上金属护甲 会发生什么？… Part I: 德鲁伊，被打断 Part II: 实验性德鲁伊护甲 Part III: 德鲁伊最后的拥抱 Part IV: 灰归灰，尘归尘 The smell of charred meat and scorched hair hangs heavy in the air. A small crowd gathers outside the smithy, muttering amongst themselves in hushed, worried tones. "Did you see it happen?" someone asks. "A flash of green light, a strangled cry, and he was just… gone." The unfortunate druid's corpse smolders at the center of the crowd, a charred mass of burnt remains and blasted metal, peeled outward like the petals of a wilted flower. A skeletal arm hangs fused to the breastplate, the only hint that the pile of ashes and blackened bones was once a person. "He's… melted," an onlooker intones in an awed whisper. "Exploded, more like," another replies.

~ Envisioned by Treantmonk

What happens if a druid wears metal armor?… Part I: Druid, Interrupted Part II: Experimental Druid Armor Part III: A Druid’s Last Embrace Part IV: Ashes to Ashes, Dust to Dust

Shadow-marked Elven Woman Dueling A Demo.name:
影痕缠身的精灵女子与恶魔决斗
Shadow-marked Elven Woman Dueling A Demon

Text.text:
刀刃泛起柔和的光辉，她绕着恶魔般的敌手游走，那光将女人的面容映得鲜明夺目。她高贵的五官——在精灵传承中很常见——却被黑暗玷污，仿佛由纯粹阴影铸成的烙铁，将灼痕深深印进她的皮肤。

~ 由Discord上的Ameria Envisioned 于 Discord

The blade glows with a soft radiance, casting the woman’s face in vibrant relief as she circles her demonic foe. Her noble features—common in elven heritage—are marred by darkness, seared into her skin like an iron brand composed of pure shadow.

~ Envisioned by Ameria on Discord

这个聚落的侏儒待客之勤恳不亚于他们劳作之卖力，特地打造了一间尺寸恰到好处的旅店，完全贴合他们矮小精细的习性——对身形更大的类人生物而言却显得逼仄得很。长凳、桌子、书案，乃至吧台，都直接由天然洞窟的岩壁凿削塑形而成；座位上钉着马鬃垫子，舒适得出乎意料。数十个小巧的玻璃圆球用铁链悬挂半空，里面不知用什么法子诱来成群萤火虫，点点冷光四散流淌；而圆球上明明留着可供逃逸的小孔，仿佛只要它们愿意便能飞走。几名阴沉的侏儒三三两两坐在各处，捧着冒着热气的杯子啜饮不知名的调制饮品，带着不善的目光打量这群罕见旅人的闯入。
As industrious in their hospitality as they are in their labor, the gnomes of this settlement have created an inn sized perfectly for people of their diminutive sensibilities—though it is quite cramped for larger humanoids. The benches, tables, desks, even the bar, have been shaped from the rock of the natural cavern; horsehair cushions fastened to the seats make them more comfortable than one might expect. Several dozen small glass globes hang from chains, emanating light from numerous fireflies somehow coaxed within, for there are holes from which they could escape if they had a mind to do so. Several dour gnomes sit here and there, drinking unknown concoctions from steaming mugs, looking balefully at this intrusion from uncommon travelers.

Evil Throne Room.name:
邪恶王座厅
Evil Throne Room

Text.text:
一座七级台阶的五边形高台之上，矗立着一张宏伟而阴森的王座，由乌黑如墨的石材雕成。同样幽暗的镶嵌纹路沿着五组阶梯蜿蜒而下，穿过地面攀上墙壁，最终在穹顶汇聚，恰在这权位之座的正上方勾勒出一枚五芒星。
Atop a seven-stepped pentagonal dais stands a grand and sinister-looking throne of jet-black stone. Inlays of the same dark material creep down the fives sets of stairs and extend through the floor and up the walls, converging on the ceiling to form a pentagram directly above this seat of power.

Witch's Cauldron Room.name:
女巫的坩埚间
Witch's Cauldron Room

Text.text:
这口大锅长着四只沉重的铁铸蛙足，蹲伏在石地上，跨在火坑之上，几乎占满了整间屋子。它上方的椽梁垂挂着一串串蒜辫、蔓生的玉藤与铁线蕨；四周立着几张高而瘦的长桌——其中一张放着研钵与杵——旁边只有一把粗凿而成的木椅。一只高耸的桶缸，接缝处锈迹斑斑，缸身上有个塞着软木的喷口，位置恰在大锅锅沿上方几寸。
The cauldron has four heavy iron frog feet. It squats on the stone floor, straddling a fire pit and occupying most of the room. Above it, the rafters are hung with strings of garlic, trailing jade, and maidenhead fern; around it stand tall, thin tables—one holding a mortar and pestle—and a single a rough-hewn chair. A tall vat with some rust at the seams has a corked nozzle set a few inches above the lip of the cauldron.

Wild Magic Surge: Growth.name:
狂野魔法涌动：生长
Wild Magic Surge: Growth

Text.text:
一股奥术激流在你脚下爆发，将你猛地托向空中——不，更确切地说，你忽然意识到，是你正在拔节生长；身形骤然高耸，视角也随之剧烈改写。
A surge of arcana erupts beneath your feet, propelling you into the air—or rather, you realize, it has caused you to grow in height, drastically changing your perspective.

Large Wooden Bridge.name:
大型木桥
Large Wooden Bridge

Text.text:
按苛刻规格精确裁切的巨木构成这座木桥的脊梁，横跨一段先前难以轻松旅行的距离。桥面宽阔，足以让八辆货车齐头并进、步调一致，既不致拖慢通行，也不必担心翻落桥缘。如此工程壮举，必定耗费了数月娴熟工匠的劳作，以及天文数字般的税收钱。
Massive timbers cut to exacting specifications form the backbone of this wooden bridge, spanning a length previously inaccessible to easy travel. Its width is enough for eight wagons to move in harmonious pace without slowing traffic or risking tumbling over the edge. Such an achievement of engineering must have taken months of skilled labor to complete, as well as prodigious amounts of tax money.

Malevolent Nanobots Entering The Body.name:
恶意纳米机器人侵入体内
Malevolent Nanobots Entering The Body

Text.text:
一阵细微的刺痒宣告纳米机器人侵入你的体内，像被温顺的虫子轻轻叮咬。随后，一切开始了。你的血液如岩浆般灼烧，肌肉在令人麻痹的力量下痉挛收缩，把你狠狠压倒在地。你能感觉到它们在体内成群涌动，像寄生虫般钻入你的细胞深处，在你痛苦翻滚时一枚枚嵌入其中。
A subtle irritation announces the invasion of the nanobots entering your system, like a mild insect bite. Then it begins. Your blood burns like magma and your muscles contract with paralyzing force, driving you to the ground. You feel them swarming inside you, embedding themselves in your cells, like parasites, as you writhe in agony.

It’s Got Our Scent.name:
它闻到我们的气味了
It’s Got Our Scent

Text.text:
你不顾湿滑的鹅卵石路面，猛然加速狂奔，冰冷的雨幕如鞭般抽打在你裸露的皮肤上。你几乎不是听见，而是切身感到那头怪物紧贴在身后——它庞大的重量压迫着你的感官，正猛扑而来，誓要一击毙命。
You break into a sprint, despite the slick cobblestones, and the sheets of frigid rain lashing against your exposed skin. You feel more than hear the beast at your heels, sensing its immense weight as it rushes in for the kill.

Alistina Goldengrain.name:
阿莉丝缇娜·金谷粒
Alistina Goldengrain

Text.text:
一头浓郁的赤褐长发慵懒地披散在身后，女子身着宽松舒适的旅行衣装。发丝间编入串珠与火橙色的羽毛，羽翎在光中闪耀，像匕首般冷利。她穿着苔绿衬衫，扣子半解，胸口中央露出一道疤：苍白、隆起的纹路自心口向外分叉蔓延。她背上斜背一根绿橙金属长杖，杖首塑成一颗龇牙咆哮的龙首，伏在两片羽翼之上。腰侧系着一只黑鳞制成的袋子，悬挂于简单的皮带上。她抬起手时，一团火焰在指尖跃动起舞；矢车菊蓝的眼眸里，染着一抹凶烈、暗涌的猩红。

~ Played by Mikkow

Rich auburn hair flows languid down the back of a woman dressed in loose, comfortable travel-clothes. Beads and flame-orange feathers are woven throughout the tresses, the feathers shining like daggers in light. Her moss-green shirt is partially unbuttoned, revealing a scar in the center of her chest: white, raised lines veining out from her heart. Strapped to her back is a staff of green and orange metal, its top shaped into a snarling draconic head resting upon two feathered wings. A bag made of black scales hangs at her hip from a simple leather belt. When she holds up her hand, a ball of fire dances along her finger tips, and her cornflower-blue eyes are tinged with a fierce, simmering crimson.

~ Played by Mikkow

Fjorl, The Storm Speaker.name:
菲约尔，“风暴之语者”
Fjorl, The Storm Speaker

Text.text:
身披白色兽毛与骨片的灰烬身影自隧道中现身，周遭雨幕随之结晶，噼啪作响地炸裂成冰冷碎片。他的头顶覆着一颗巨大的北极熊头颅作冠，纠结的胡须垂在下巴，缀满冰锥。他张大淡蓝色的眼睛，低吼着龇牙，露出本该是上犬齿的位置却弯曲外突的獠牙。他咆哮着含混的喉音词句，挥动枯木法杖划开空气。杖端那枚蓝色冰片骤然发光，寒意加深，更多雨滴在半空冻结……

~ Played by Afflicted

As the ashen figure clad in white fur and bone emerges from the tunnel, the rain around him crystallizes and crackles into frozen shards. The head of a great polar bear covers his crown, and a knotted beard festooned with icicles his chin. He widens his pale blue eyes and bares his teeth with a growl, revealing curving fangs where his upper canines should be. Snarling guttural words, he cuts the air with a sweep of his staff of wan wood. A shard of blue ice on the staff’s tip glows, and more rain freezes as the air grows cold…

~ Played by Afflicted

Lookout Over A City.name:
俯瞰城池的瞭望台
Lookout Over A City

Text.text:
从这处高点望去，整座城市在你脚下铺展开来，向四面八方延伸出数里之遥。街道交织成错综复杂的网格——路线、小巷与步道层层叠叠，看似毫无章法。高楼在街上投下阴影，朴素的民宅彼此依偎，夹在奥秘高塔、庄园大宅与中央要塞之间。城市的光景、声响与气味一路飘上此处——令人目眩的感官洪流，却又充盈着鲜活的生机与文化气息。
From this vantage point the city sprawls before you, extending leagues in every direction. The streets form a complex latticework of routes and alleys and walkways, seemingly random. Buildings loom over the streets, and modest homes cling to one another between arcane towers, manor houses, and the central fortress. The sights, sounds, and smells of the city waft up to you here—a dizzying mixture of sensations, and yet so full of life and culture.

Mountain Path Flag Marker.name:
山道旗帜路标
Mountain Path Flag Marker

Text.text:
前方的路标是一面孤零零的旗帜，在风中簌簌作响，短短的旗杆插在一堆乱石里。旗帜的鲜亮色彩与山体黯淡的色调形成刺眼对比，仿佛在招手引你继续前行，带着你正逼近文明的寄望城。
The path ahead is marked by a lone flag rustling in the breeze, its short pole nestled in a pile of stones. The flag’s bright colors stand stark against the dull tones of the mountain, and they beckon you onward with the promise of nearing civilization.

Small Lies, Big Profits.name:
小谎言，大利润
Small Lies, Big Profits

Text.text:
我在口袋里翻找，摸出一把切面圆润的宝石——各自都称得上好看，却并不比寻常小饰物更稀罕、更贵重。我空着的那只手在这把石头上方潇洒一挥。柔和的光辉随即漫过它们——它们炫目夺人，从内里透出光芒，色泽耀眼生辉。我不禁琢磨：现在它们能让我多卖出多少？

~ Envisioned by ashesnblood

I rummage through my pockets, collecting a handful of smooth-faceted gemstones—lovely in their own way, but no rarer or more precious than a common bauble. I wave my free hand over the fistful of stones with a flourish. A soft glow overtakes them—they dazzle, shining with an internal light, their hues radiant. I wonder how much more I can get for them now?

~ Envisioned by ashesnblood

Death Mounted On Armored Horse.name:
死亡骑乘披甲战马
Death Mounted On Armored Horse

Text.text:
腐朽的恶臭玷污了空气，一匹苍白的马自黑暗中蹒跚而来。它腐烂的背上端坐着令人胆寒的死神化身，骷髅般的面容裹在褴褛的长袍里。一只白骨之手紧攥着锈蚀斑驳的长柄镰刀，刀刃上染着陈旧的血迹。坐骑的蹄声回荡，宛如远方丧钟的凄然回响。恐惧先于这可怖的命运凶兆降临。
A stench of decay pollutes the air, and from the darkness plods a pale horse. Upon its rotting back sits a chilling avatar of Death, its skeletal visage swathed in threadbare robes. One bony hand clutches a rust-pitted scythe, old blood staining its blade. The steed’s hooves echo like doleful peals of a distant bell. Dread precedes this awful harbinger of fate.

神社背后，森林向外铺展、向上攀升，两侧各有一条土路将其夹在中间。几乎像是神社为庇护森林而拔地而起，硬生生逼得道路一分为二。你甩开这荒唐的念头。通往岔路口的那段路沿着森林的一侧延伸，几乎笔直如箭。然而，紧挨林缘、灌木丛挤作一团的后方，那片阴影笼罩的空间里，似乎藏着某种异样。
The forest fans out and up behind the shrine, hemmed in by a dirt road on either side. It almost seems like the shrine rose up to protect the forest, forcing the road to split. You shake off this silly notion. The road leading up to the fork continues along one edge of the forest nearly as straight as an arrow. Still, there seems to be something unusual about the shadowed space beyond the bushes that crowd the forest’s fringe.

Path To The Cave.name:
通往洞穴的路
Path To The Cave

Text.text:
一条狭窄的小径穿过草丛，自河边蜿蜒而上，通向山丘的陡崖。看起来很少有人走，却被踩得结实平整。顺着它的走向，你看见在几丛灌木之后，小径忽然下沉，钻入山坡上一道裂缝之中——那是一处洞穴，宽高都仅够一名人类侧身挤过去。
A narrow trail through the grass leads up from the river and to the escarpment of the hill. It looks infrequently used but well-trodden. Following its line, you see that beyond some bushes it dips down into a crack in the hillside, a cave just wide and tall enough for a human to squeeze through.

Staff Of Healing.name:
治疗法杖
Staff Of Healing

Text.text:
这根法杖由无数图腾般的人形自下而上层层堆叠而成。它们的神情从自满到惊恐不一而足，但每一张脸都以黑色宝石为眼，向外凝视；那宝石仿佛在脉动，透出幽绿色的辉光。
The staff is formed from numerous totemic figures stacked one atop another. Their expressions range from complacency to terror, but each stares out from eyes of black gemstones that seem to pulse with a green radiance.

地貌的一角微微一动，你这才意识到——原来一直有人在那儿：静得像一块石头，融入环境到乍一看根本看不见。那身影身上羽毛、皮毛与枯枝的分量几乎不亚于布料，随即将深深兜帽下的脸转向你。你正思索该说什么、该做什么时，一只小鸟从兜帽里倏然掠出，振翅冲天而去。 A sliver of the landscape moves, and you realize that someone has been there all along—standing so still, so blended into the environment, as to be invisible at a glance. Dressed as much in feathers, furs, and twigs as cloth, the figure turns a deeply hooded face in your direction. You’re making up your mind about what to say or do when a tiny bird flits out of the hood and soars away.

Swabbie On First Voyage.name:
初航水手
Swabbie On First Voyage

Text.text:
年轻的船员瞪大了眼，满脸热切；每当有军官经过，他们就猛地跃起，笨拙地敬个礼。他们带着少年般不知疲倦的亢奋行动，在船上像弹珠机里的钢珠般蹦跳穿梭，拼命想讨得船员们的欢心。
The young crewmate is wide-eyed and eager, leaping to their feet and offering a clumsy salute whenever an officer passes. They move with the tireless exuberance of youth, bouncing around the ship like a pinball as they desperately try to ingratiate themself with the crew.

Infected By Slaad.name:
受斯拉德寄生感染
Infected By Slaad

Text.text:
那人忽然僵住：不再说话，也不再动作。一抹诡异的神情爬上他们的脸，仿佛刚刚意识到某种骇人的真相。他们试图开口，可话还没来得及溢出唇间，身体便猛然抽搐，四肢百骸每一束肌肉都在痉挛。剧烈的抽动把他们硬生生摔倒在地，接着更令人毛骨悚然的一幕发生了：皮肤像纸一样裂开、撕碎，露出下面鼓胀、跳动的血肉。先前还是人的地方，如今却蜷伏着一只巨大的、鼓泡般的蟾蜍状恶魔。

~ 构想：Camel

The individual stops suddenly: stops talking, stops moving. A strange look comes over their face, as if they've just realized something horrific. They try to speak, but before the words leave their lips, they seize, every muscle in their body spasming. The convulsions drive them to the floor, where, horrifically, their skin splits and shreds like paper to reveal bulbous, pulsating flesh beneath. Where once was a person, now crouches a massive, bulbous toad-like fiend.

~ Envisioned by Camel

I Fletch Arrows.name:
我制箭矢
I Fletch Arrows

Text.text:
我把身边那捆木枝丢在地上，取出制羽工具。皮革工具匣被我猛地掀开，里面整齐塞着木工小刀、抹布、胶、水麻绳、箭头与羽毛。刀刃在桀骜不驯的枝条上刮削作响，将它们修整成匀称的箭杆，那细碎的沙沙声把我的思绪抚平，沉入清冽的专注。我削、绞、粘，直到一捆崭新的箭矢——以及一堆木屑——堆在我的脚边。
I drop the bundle of sticks near me, taking out my fletching tools. I throw open the leather case which contains my woodworking knife, cloth, glue, twine, arrowheads, and feathers. The scratching sound of the knife trimming away at unruly sticks, turning them into even shafts, quiets my mind into a refreshing focus. I shave, twine, and glue until a new bundle of arrows—and a pile of wood shavings—sits at my feet.

Cluster Of Palm Trees.name:
棕榈树丛
Cluster Of Palm Trees

Text.text:
灰褐色的树干自地面同一点猛然拔起，十根树干如同土质巨灵的修长手指向外舒展。树冠处抽生扇状的翠绿叶片，汇成一团草木般的云雾，为树干投下荫凉。你听见鸟儿在这片浓密的栖所间跳跃时发出的啁啾与窸窣声。
Gray-brown trunks shoot out of the ground from a single point, ten trunks spreading like the long fingers of an earthen entity. Their heads sprout the fanning, green leaves that come together in an herbaceous cloud to shade the trunks. You hear the twittering and rustling of birds as they bounce within the dense abode.

亵渎的寒霜覆满棋盘方格，亿万次对弈留下的磨损与凹痕清晰可见。棋盘两侧的棋子整齐列阵，熟悉的面孔从中窥视——阴沉地等待命运裁决。白棋刻着朋友、挚爱与盟友的脸；黑棋则是你憎恨的仇敌与宿怨的轮廓。幽灵般的双手悬停在两边阵营之上——等待你选定一方，开局落子。

~ 由一位英雄构想

An unholy frost rimes the squares of the board, scuffed and dented by eons of play. Familiar faces peer out from the pieces neatly arranged on either side of the board—grimly awaiting their fate. The white pieces bear the faces of friends, loved ones, and allies, while the black bear the likenesses of hated enemies and rivals. Spectral hands hover over each set—waiting for you to choose a side and begin the game.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

你低声咕哝着咒语，双掌间滚动着一支玻璃小瓶。咒词一出口便从记忆中迅速褪去，你随即将瓶中液体一饮而尽——酒精辛辣苦涩的刺痛感顺着喉咙滑下。起初你一阵反胃，但很快那股不适消散，取而代之的是一种诡异的充沛活力：你以死灵法术的赝造之力，强行加固了自己的生命。
You mutter your incantation, rolling a glass vial between your palms. As the words fade from your memory with their utterance, you drain the vial of liquid—tasting the sharp and bitter sting of alcohol as it slides down your throat. At first you feel nauseous, but the sensation passes, replaced with an uncanny vigor as you bolster your own life with a necromantic facsimile.

Lodge Of The Lion’s Eye.name:
狮眼会馆
Lodge Of The Lion’s Eye

Text.text:
这座威严的瞭望塔前，一扇打磨光亮的木门紧闭着，门上钉着一块铭牌：一只山狮的王者侧影，以耀眼的亮钢锻成，线条冷峻而骄傲。

走进主塔，喧声扑面。一个焦头烂额的管事缩在一张被改造成书桌的餐桌后，眉头紧锁，胡子弯成一抹懊恼的弓形；他埋首在成堆文书里，笔尖与纸页摩擦不休。四周的会所成员却围作一圈，大声谈笑、互相打趣，仿佛这里不是办公之地而是酒馆角落。

从装束与兵器便能看出他们清一色都是猎人：身披深色皮护甲，背负长弓。每个人的箭袋几乎一模一样，皆以细致皮革制成，外侧用银线绣出一只猫科动物的眼睛，幽冷地闪着光。
The polished wooden door of this formidable watchtower has a plaque affixed to it, featuring the regal profile of mountain lion wrought of bright steel. Within the main tower, a harried administrator sits behind a dining table that has been modified into a desk. His mustache curves into a frustrated bow as he pores over paperwork while members of the lodge talk and joke loudly around him. The members are all hunters by their dress and weaponry, dressed in dark hide armor and outfitted with bows. Their quivers all seem to be the same, each one crafted of a fine leather and decorated with a feline eye of silver thread.

Potions Laboratory.name:
炼金药剂实验室
Potions Laboratory

Text.text:
真叫人眼花缭乱——小瓶与玻璃罐、护符与灵药、毒剂与解毒药，多得令人眩晕。它们从木制架子上幽幽闪烁，折射出成百上千种晦暗的色彩；每个瓶身都贴着细致工整的花体标签。实验室的墙面像蜂巢般布满一个个小格，里面塞着各式原料：有的挂着未经处理的草药，有的别着羽毛，还有的格子深陷黑暗，里头静静搁着碗钵。皂石台面上，蒸馏器与容器像一团纠结的神经节般蹲伏着，铜与玻璃的管路在其间蜿蜒盘绕。房间里弥漫着炼金术特有的气味，夹杂着一丝紧绷的惶惶不安。
It’s dizzying, really, the number of vials and bottles, periapts and elixirs, poisons and antidotes. They glint darkly in hundreds of colors from wooden racks with finely scribed cursive labels. The walls of the lab are a hive of cubby holes containing ingredients. Raw herbs dangle from some, feathers from others, and bowls sit in the darkness of still others. On the soapstone tables, a ganglia of alembics and receptacles squat among copper and glass tubing. The room smells of alchemy tinged with nervousness.

Dark Masquerade Ball.name:
黑暗假面舞会
Dark Masquerade Ball

Text.text:
一段楼梯沿舞厅一侧盘旋而上，通向一处阳台。阳台上，一名黑衣女子戴着高高的白色假发，伸长脖颈俯瞰舞池；她那恶魔般的面具上钩状长鼻时而指向这边，时而转向那边。她下方的低矮舞台上，瘦骨嶙峋、同样戴着面具的乐师们演奏得分毫不差，且从不间断。身着深色华服的人们在打磨得发亮的木地板上旋转穿梭，没有任何一个人或一对人跳着相同的舞步。 忽然，那黑衣女子尖声厉叫：“骗子！”一道绿光自她指控的手指迸射而出，将一名舞者化作细腻尘埃，在人群间旋起一阵涡流，随即消散无踪。

~ Envisioned by Kristian Romero

A stairway sweeps up one side of the ballroom to a balcony where a woman in black with a high, white wig cranes her neck to observe the dancefloor, her fiendish mask’s hooked nose pointing this way and that. Below her, on a low stage, emaciated, masked musicians play flawlessly and ceaselessly. People dressed in dark finery wheel about the polished floorboards, no individual or pair performing the same steps. Suddenly, the black-clad woman shrieks: “Fraud!” A green ray leaps from her accusing finger, reducing a dancer to a fine dust that swirls among the others and disappears.

~ Envisioned by Kristian Romero

Kolgrim, Retired Adventurer.name:
科尔格里姆，退役冒险者
Kolgrim, Retired Adventurer

Text.text:
尽管他的血肉已然疲惫，松垮地挂在日渐衰老的骨架上，这位半兽人依旧挺身而立，带着冠军般的气度。老人那双温和的蓝眼睛里盛满满足，向聚拢的孩子们讲述冒险往事时，目光灼灼发亮；每个小家伙都屏息凝神，紧紧追随着他的每一句话。待他猛然挺起身，模仿自己曾交战的巨龙时，宽松的衬衫间露出胸口纵横交错的伤疤——每一道，都各自背负着一段故事。

~ Played by Merib

Though his flesh is now weary and sags from aging bones, the half-orc carries himself with the bearing of a champion. Kind blue eyes, filled with contentment, light up as the old man recounts tales of adventures to the assembled children, each youngster hanging on his every word. As he rears up to mimic the dragon he once fought, his loose shirt offers a glimpse of the scars crisscrossing his chest—each one carrying a story of its own.

~ Played by Merib

一双夺目耀眼的旱冰鞋被改装成令人目眩的万花筒色彩：青蓝、亮粉与霓虹绿。鞋身透着复古味道，依旧用粗厚鞋带系紧，而非自锁卡扣。每一枚轮子都浸染了不同的反光涂料，转动时像切割光线。鞋跟处加装了一对临时拼凑的喷火器，蓄势待发，随时喷吐成团的蓝色烈焰。排气管被烟尘熏得发黑，右脚鞋头还留着一道狰狞的布料撕裂疤痕。
Two dazzling rollerblades have been customized in dizzying kaleidoscopic colors: cyan blue, hot pink, and neon green. The shoes look retro, still sporting thick laces instead of auto-secure clamps. Every individual wheel has been dipped in a different reflective paint. Mounted to the heels are twin makeshift flamethrowers, ready to spew gouts of blue fire. The exhaust tubes are blackened with soot, and there’s a nasty fabric scar along the toe of the right shoe.

City Zoo In Winter.name:
冬日的城市动物园
City Zoo In Winter

Text.text:
市立动物园在冬日的钳制下几近窒息。肮脏的积雪与光秃的树木散落在空寂的小径旁。寥寥几只耐寒的动物硬撑着严寒，在污浊的围栏里挤作一团取暖；然而几乎没有游客敢来——偶有到访者也只是匆匆掠过展区，迫不及待想逃离这令人沮丧的氛围。
The civic menagerie suffocates under winter’s grasp. Dirty snow and barren trees dot the empty paths. A handful of hardy animals brave the cold, huddling together for warmth in their grimy enclosures, but few visitors venture here—and those who do hurry through the exhibits, eager to escape the depressing atmosphere.

Sundries From A Grick.name:
灰鳞怪的杂物
Sundries From A Grick

Text.text:
你在灰克的嗉囊里找到六十二颗小石子，个个被磨得圆润光滑、闪着暗淡的光泽。尸体周围的地上散落着被撕成碎片的衣料残屑、各式小别针、头巾、票券与钥匙。
In the grick’s craw you find sixty-two small, smoothly-polished rocks. On the ground around the corpse lie scraps of shredded clothing, various small pins, kerchiefs, tickets, and keys.

一座奇丽瑰幻的集市吞没了这座精灵城的一整个街区。枝条编骨的灯笼在空中轻轻摇曳，柔粉的能量光球将琳琅货品照得如梦似幻。一名药剂商兜售带着脓液般质感的茶，黑色蒸汽缕缕逸散。长柄刀被成捆扎起，像麦束一样堆叠；刀刃泛着绿、蓝与紫，宛如蜻蜓的薄翼。宠物摊的吊笼里，蓝缎般光滑的猴子懒洋洋地趴着，长尾悄无声息地探进粗心路人的口袋。女裁缝盘腿坐在铺开的地毯上，一边低声哼唱，一边将叶片缝成裙装。在一名咧嘴而笑的水泽仙女摊前，眼眸水汪汪的客人们围作一圈，痴看着串在签上仍在跳动的蝾螈心，被黏稠酱汁厚厚裹满。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

A market of fantastical splendor overtakes a block of this elven city. Twig-framed lanterns bob in the air, pastel orbs of energy lighting the myriad goods on display. A potion seller offers ichorous tea emitting wisps of black steam. Glaives are bundled like sheaves of wheat, their blades of green, blue, and purple reminiscent of dragonfly wings. Blue satiny monkeys lounge in the hanging cages of a pet stall, their long tails digging into the pockets of the unwary passersby. A seamstress sits cross-legged on a spread carpet, humming as she sews leaves into a dress. Around the stall of a grinning naiad, doe-eyed patrons have gathered to ogle kebabs of still-beating newt hearts slathered in a sticky sauce.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Magical Detection Of A Druid's Class.name:
德鲁伊职业的魔法侦测
Magical Detection Of A Druid's Class

Text.text:
侦测之物靠近你的目标，却在它面前坠落在地，轻轻溅入一汪只有你看得见的小小池塘；池畔环绕着石南，一切都如悬停其上的蜻蜓般半透明。当你的目标一动，景象便尽数消散——自然刹那即逝的一瞬。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The detection approaches your target but falls to the ground in front of it, splashing lightly into a tiny pond visible only to you, and surrounded by heather, all as translucent as the dragonfly that hovers over it. When your target moves, it all disappears—a moment of ephemeral nature.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Custodial Bot With Partial Sentience.name:
具备部分知觉的管理机器人
Custodial Bot With Partial Sentience

Text.text:
这台机器人配备了几乎能想象到的所有清洁工具，处理各类保洁麻烦都能举重若轻、干净利落。它的机体曾是莹润的深林绿，但多年服役使色泽黯淡下去，锈斑正一点点爬上原本覆着釉质漆面的外壳。你正看着时，有人把泥印拖过它刚拖净的地面，你发誓看见它朝那肇事者投去一记恼怒的怒视。
The bot is armed with every kind of cleaning implement imaginable, able to tackle almost any custodial issue with minimal fuss. Though its chassis was once a lustrous forest green, the color has faded over its many years in service and patches of rust are creeping into the enameled lacquer. As you watch, someone tracks mud across the bot’s freshly mopped floor, and you swear you see it glare at the offending party in irritation.

Experienced Captain Piloting With Confid.name:
经验丰富的船长自信掌舵
Experienced Captain Piloting With Confidence

Text.text:
舰长咧嘴一笑，驾着她的座舰穿越太阳风暴的核心，对甲板船员惊叹的倒抽气声置若罔闻。每一道辐射耀斑迸发，她都利落敲入反制机动，巡洋舰仿佛她思维的延伸。她轻轻一点头，自信映在那被岁月吻过的皱纹间。
The captain grins as she pilots her vessel through the heart of a solar storm, ignoring the gasps of awe from the deck crew. With each flare of radiation, she deftly punches in a counter-maneuver, the cruiser an extension of her intellect. She gives a nod, confidence painting her wrinkle-kissed features.

Speech By A Bard About Songs.name:
吟游诗人关于歌谣的演说
Speech By A Bard About Songs

Text.text:
“歌可不是什么用来跳舞消遣的小调。一段节拍能撼动诸国，一首打油诗能点燃人心，一支叙事歌谣更能引爆我们挣脱这世道不公的解放之火。我倒要看看你们的黄金、钢铁和军队能做到这些吗！”
“A song is not just some idle tune to dance to. A beat can move nations, a limerick can inspire the masses, and a ballad can spark our emancipation from the injustices of this world. I’d like to see your gold, steel, and armies do that!”

Spell Scroll (Divine).name:
法术卷轴（神圣）
Spell Scroll (Divine)

Text.text:
如同一部受人敬奉的圣典，这卷卷轴被精心保存，状态完美无瑕。淡淡的熏香气息浸润着纤薄的羊皮纸，令人惊叹的天界生灵图绘环绕其侧，簇拥着页面中央如流水般铺陈的文字。
Like a revered holy text, this scroll has been meticulously preserved, and its condition is immaculate. A faint aroma of incense has infused the delicate parchment, and stunning depictions of celestial beings border the flowing text at the center of the page.

Potion Of Gaseous Form.name:
气化形态药剂
Potion Of Gaseous Form

Text.text:
乍一看，这只药剂小瓶里似乎除了浓稠的雾气外空无一物。但当你凝神细看，才发现那雾其实是液体——雾只是视觉上的幻象——还是说……并非如此？
At first glance, this potion vial appears to contain naught but thick fog. But as you observe closely, you see that the fog is actually a liquid, the fog but an optical illusion—or is it?

Enchanter Academy Kitchens.name:
附魔师学院厨房
Enchanter Academy Kitchens

Text.text:
锅碗瓢盆飞驰如风——绕着操作台与砧板岛台、火炉与烤箱、冰柜与水槽——扑向那双施展魔法的手，替它剁切备料。它们会在那双手倾入一掌大麦或捻进一撮胡椒时短暂停住。彼此相撞发出清脆的金属叮当声时，还会连声道歉。餐具在古老礼仪法术的驱使下立刻精神抖擞，将食物摆盘得精致无比。这是一间典型的法师厨房，明亮得耀眼却又危机四伏，空气里弥漫着花园与咒法共同酿出的辛香。
Pots and pans fly fast—around the counters and butcher block islands, fires and ovens, iceboxes and sinks—to the magical hands that chop and prep. They pause for the hands to dump in a palm-full of barley or pinch of pepper. They apologize when they bump into one another with metallic ringing. Dishes snap to attention and plate the food beautifully through ancient spells of etiquette. This is a classic wizard’s kitchen, sparkling and dangerous, aromatic with the spices of both garden and spellcraft.

你念出法术的最后一个音节，你的盟友惊叹不已，只见你的身影开始从他们眼前淡去。你眨了眨眼，再次睁开时，仍能感知先前的环境，却仿佛其上叠着一层幽魂般的光晕，除此之外几乎空无一物。在这种形态下，你不再像活生生的存在，更像一缕褪色的灵魂，只能与同样处于此境的人相互触及。
The final syllables of your spell uttered, your allies react with awe as your body begins to fade from their view. You blink, and when your eyes open, you are aware of your previous surroundings, but superimposed atop them is a ghostly set of auras and little else. In this form, you feel less like a living being and more like a faded soul, able to interact only with others in the same state.

I Cast Imprisonment Using A Replica Pris.name:
我施放了【禁锢术】，以一座复制的囚牢为牢笼
I Cast Imprisonment Using A Replica Prison

Text.text:
我高举一座翡翠铸成的牢狱仿制品，以及描绘着目标的画像，呼唤出法术的咒言。

[豁免失败{/i>] 一股异界之力开始将两件物体相互牵引，空气中共鸣的嗡鸣愈发高涨，狠狠敲打着我的头骨，震得我的牙齿像弹珠般咯咯作响。带着不可逆转的必然，两物终于相触，随即爆开一道刺目的闪光。

Holding a jade replica of the prison and the target’s depiction aloft, I call out the words of the spell.

[Failed Save{/i>] An otherworldly force begins to pull the objects together as a resonant hum builds in the air, pounding against my skull and rattling my teeth like marbles. With inexorable certainty, the objects meet, and a blinding flash erupts.

压缩关节发出湿黏的“噗”声，立刻把你的目光拽向墙上一道狭窄的裂缝。一个臃肿的身影——大得远超那点狭小空间所能容纳——硬生生从里面滑了出来。刹那间，足有十六英尺高的腐臭毛皮与虬结筋肉立在你面前，利爪撑地。它的手臂在肘部裂开，分成两对孪生般纠结的前臂。它的眼睛彼此相距甚远，嵌在一颗郁金香状的头颅两侧；那头颅战栗着，随即裂开，化作拍打的花瓣——暴露的皮肉翻卷。腐肉般的恶臭充满房间，摊开的巨口扑簌簌颤动，露出一排排钉刺般的牙齿，唾液四下飞溅。
The wet pop of compressed joints draws your eye to a narrow crack in the wall. A bulky figure—far larger than the narrow space should accommodate—slips through. Suddenly, sixteen feet of rancid fur and corded muscle stands before you on clawed feet. Its arms split at the elbows into twin pairs of knotted forearms. Its eyes are set wide apart on a tulip-shaped head, which shivers as it splits open into flapping petals of exposed skin. Charnel stench fills the room as the splayed maw flutters, displaying rows of studded teeth that spray saliva.

I Am Struck By A Lightning Bolt.name:
我被一道闪电劈中
I Am Struck By A Lightning Bolt

Text.text:
呀啊啊啊弗勒嘎——哔哔哔哔哔——呜噜噜噜噜啊啊啊哈啊——哈啊——法噜噜呃——！喘。喘。
YaaaAAflerggabbbbbrrrrrraaaaAAHAhhhhffarrrrgh! Wheez. Wheez.

Speech By A Necromancer About Rot.name:
死灵法师关于腐朽的演说
Speech By A Necromancer About Rot

Text.text:
“我们不受律法或神祇统治。腐朽才是我们真正的主宰。就在我们开口的这一刻，血肉正悄然腐烂——腐败从我们身上剥落，身体却仍在惊惶中手忙脚乱地修补替换自己。但每一次都更迟钝、更低效，直到最后，只剩腐朽。”
“We are not governed by laws or gods. Rot is our true master. Our flesh is rotting as we speak—the decay sluffing off of us, as our body frantically scrambles to replace itself. But each time it is a little less efficient, and eventually only the rot remains.”

不涉战争的战斗仪式，或许从未如此精致——在这场纯白法兰绒与绗缝双层短上衣交织的盛会里更是如此。花剑、军刀与重剑陈列于长桌之上，映照着王室大厅里数百支蜡烛的光辉。长长的垫道——剑道之上，击剑手将椭圆头盔微微前倾，行礼。随即，en guard！一人咄咄逼人，连连突刺；另一人沉着耐心，盼着消磨对手，寻得其弱点。 The ritual of combat without warfare is perhaps no more refined than now, in this event of pristine white flannel and quilted doublets. The foils, sabers, and épées laid out on tables reflect the light of hundreds of candles in the royal hall. On the long mat, the piste, the fencers tip their oblong helmets forward, bow. And then, en guard! One is aggressive, consecutively lunging; the other is patient, hoping to wear down the opposition and find a weakness.

鸟人女子举着那顶几乎完工的帽子，借着凸窗洒进来的光细细端详，灰色的舌头在口中思索般轻轻咔哒作响。她的工坊不大，却堆满了布料、珠子、宝石与羽毛。几顶带着几分阴柔气质的帽子点缀在木制胸像上，从含蓄雅致到浮华夸张，应有尽有。她身穿一件蓝色马甲，密密缝满了各色自制口袋，口袋的暗格里塞着针、线轴与各种零碎小物。她头顶的羽冠微微竖起，喉间发出柔软的咕咕声，黑眸里灵光一闪。她抬手揉了揉颈侧的羽毛，随即——“哎哟！”——从自己身上拔下一根白羽。“就是这个……”她说。她把白羽嵌进帽檐的饰带里，又举起来看了一遍。眼角细纹舒展开来，满是满意。
The birdfolk woman clicks her gray tongue in thought as she holds the nearly finished hat aloft in the light of the bay window. Her atelier is small but full of fabrics, beads, jewels, and feathers. Effeminate hats adorn wooden busts, ranging from demure to gaudier styles. She wears a blue vest riddled all over with self-stitched pockets of different colors, the nooks crammed with needles, spools, bits, and bobs. The fringe of feathers on her head perks a bit and she coos, an idea sparking in her dark eyes. She ruffles her neck with her hand until she—“Oof!”—plucks one of her own white feathers. “Here we are…” she says. She sets it into the band around the hat and holds it up once more. Her eyes crinkle with approval.

Françoise Senechal.name:
弗朗索瓦兹·塞内沙尔
Françoise Senechal

Text.text:
面具与兜帽遮住了她的脸，你唯一能辨认的特征，是几绺波浪状的棕发垂落到肩头。护甲的剪裁勾勒出女性的身形，也透露出她对保养近乎苛刻的讲究。胸甲与护臂以深棕皮革制成，像刚上过油般泛着润泽光亮，其上的金属铆钉闪烁着明银的冷辉。这套护甲乍看几乎像崭新、未经战火洗礼——若不是其间遍布纵横的刀痕与细小缺口，早已出卖了它的经历。她肩上斜背着一把抛光的长弓，未上弦，安置在背后的弓套中；弓弦则盘成一圈挂在腰侧，始终触手可及。

~ Played by Walt M. with

Face obscured by a mask and hood, the only defining features you can see are a few locks of wavy brown hair trailing down to the shoulders. The cut of the armor suggests a feminine figure, as well as a meticulous attention to upkeep. The dark brown leather of her chestpiece and bracers shines as if recently oiled, the metal studs glimmering a bright silver. The armor set could be mistaken for new, untested, if not for the riddling of slash marks and nicks throughout. The polished longbow slung over her shoulder sits in a sheath on her back, unstrung. The bowstring hangs coiled at her hip, always within easy reach.

~ Played by Walt M. with

一道粼粼微光浮现，仿佛阳光在水面上的倒影，却带着幽灵般的虚假。空气变得潮湿而腐臭。无中生有般，几缕起伏游动的光痕猛然窜入视野，旋即又隐没不见。它们扑向裸露的皮肤；一旦找到目标，便紧紧黏附，蜷缩盘绕，仍可见却透明。被它们攀附之处，皮肤骤然迸裂，鲜血奔涌，被它们尽数吸入。
A shimmering glow appears, a ghostly imitation of the reflection of sunlight off water. The air becomes wet and fetid. From nowhere, streaks of undulating light dart into sight, only to disappear again. They lunge for exposed skin. When they find it, they latch on, curl up, and remain visible but transparent. Where they attach, skin bursts open and blood pours into them.

你看见前方一棵破败而虬曲的橡树，树干几乎折成两截般弯折，粗如巨人胸膛的枝桠横亘在前，封死了去路。你一靠近，叶片沙沙作响，其间夹杂着枯枝断裂的脆响与枝干呻吟的低吼——那树忽然猛地挺直，庞然身影拔起三十英尺高，巨枝以不可思议的速度蜷卷起来，化作愤怒的杖棍。
You see a ragged and gnarled oak tree ahead of you, its trunk bent over almost in half, with branches as thick as a goliath’s chest blocking the path forward. Leaves rustle as you approach, undercut by snapping twigs and groaning branches as the tree suddenly straightens to loom thirty feet above you, the massive branches curling with unthinkable speed into angry staves.

那只动物朝你走来——眼里满是对你手中食物的渴望。它带着戒心打量你一眼，随即猛地窜上前叼走那一小口。你轻抚它的头顶，继而潇洒一挥，朗声念出法术的咒词。一阵风掠过，裹着潮湿的土腥与刺骨的寒意。它吃完口中的食物，抬头专注地望着你，近乎俯首帖耳。它现在为你效力——至少在一段时代之内。
The animal comes toward you—eager for the food in your hand. It eyes you suspiciously, then dashes forward to snatch the morsel. You caress its head, and, with a flourish, speak aloud the words of the spell. A wind rolls by, loamy and chill. The animal finishes its meal and looks to you attentively, almost subserviently. It serves you now—at least for a time.

Draconic Mountain Shrine.name:
巨龙山岳神殿
Draconic Mountain Shrine

Text.text:
你顶着刺骨寒风艰难前行，每一步都深深陷入这座冰寒山巅的积雪之中。你面前，一尊巨龙形态的巍峨雕像昂然挺立，仿佛被凝固在时代里。它那张面孔阴沉地凝视着下方冻结的深渊。雕像脚下，一座祭坛被硬生生塞满了金币与其他珍宝，光泽在压迫性的天气下黯然失色。

~ 构想 by Grim the Tyrannical

You trudge against the biting wind, each footfall sinking deep into the snow of this frigid mountaintop. Before you, a towering statue in the shape of a great wyrm rears, suspended in time. Its visage stares grimly into the freezing abyss. At its feet, an altar is crammed with coin and other treasures, their sheen dulled by the oppressive weather.

~ Envisioned by Grim the Tyrannical

Gabriel The Monster Hunter.name:
加布里埃尔，怪物猎人
Gabriel The Monster Hunter

Text.text:
手握叶刃长矛，一名神情肃穆的男子端坐马背；他那怪异的竖瞳来回游移，警惕地巡视四周。深棕色头发向后束起，不让发丝遮住面庞；浓密胡须修剪得干净利落，贴着下颌线。铆钉皮护甲刚上过油，光泽锃亮，却柔韧得足以支撑迅捷的移动；一把弩与一面圆盾挂在他背后。他的脸色忽然一变：双眼眯起，嘴角翻起，带着恼意龇出一声低吼。他咂了两下舌。“走了，袜子。”那匹马通体灰色，唯有蹄与踝处漆黑如墨，嘶鸣一声，随即迈开稳定的小跑。

~ 一位英雄扮演

Leaf-bladed spear in hand, a grave-faced man sits atop a horse, his strangely vertical pupils flitting, watchful. Dark brown hair is tied back out of his face and his full beard is shorn neatly, close to his jaw. His studded leather armor, newly oiled and shining, seems flexible enough to allow for quick movement, while a crossbow and buckler hang on his back. A change washes over his face: his eyes narrow and his lip curls into an annoyed snarl. He clicks his tongue twice. “Let’s go, Socks.” The horse, gray aside from the black of its hooves and ankles, nickers and picks up into a steady trot.

~ Played by a Hero

Temperate Forest In Autumn.name:
秋日温带森林
Temperate Forest In Autumn

Text.text:
空气清冽，寒意恰到好处，既令人精神一振，又不至于抽走你的力气。树木披着华丽的秋装：山毛榉叶色如黄油般金黄，白桦树顶戴金冠，枫树则裹着橙与红的披风。就连它们洒落的叶片，也像反季的时尚般铺陈开来，在林地上拼出一幅绚烂的马赛克。
The air is crisp, chill enough to be invigorating without sapping your strength. The trees are splendid in their autumn regalia: beeches leaved in buttery yellow, golden-crowned birch trees, and maples cloaked in orange and red. Even the leaves they have shed like unseasonable fashions make a vibrant mosaic of the forest floor.

这座高原轮廓鲜明、绝不会认错：峭壁般的陡直边缘拔地而起，顶上却平坦开阔、横展铺陈。它让人仿佛看见一座大山从大地中隆起，而山巅被利落地削去，截得干净利索。
The plateau is a distinct and unmistakable sight, with soaring, sheer sides and a flat, sprawling top. It evokes the image of a mountain risen from the earth with its top hewn cleanly off.

Hobgoblin Bar Fight.name:
大地精酒馆斗殴
Hobgoblin Bar Fight

Text.text:
那些类地精曾缩着身子伏在酒杯上，如今却在吧台周围猛然转身，像发怒的猫般啐唾咆哮。拳头与酒杯齐飞，砸落时伴着骨碎般的闷响与酒液四溅的泼洒。碎裂的玻璃声混着骨头断裂的脆响，而酒馆里的乐手仍旧继续演奏，仿佛在煽动这场暴力。
The goblinoids once hunched over drinks, but now they wheel around the bar, spitting and snarling like angry cats. Fists and tankards fly, landing with crunches and splashes. Shattering glass joins shattering bone, but still the tavern’s musicians play on, as if encouraging the violence.

河水在此处变得更宽、更缓，汇成一汪浅浅的水潭：清澈如水晶，静卧在一处低洼而安宁的所在，一侧是幽深林地，另一侧是起伏山丘。沿着水边有条土径蜿蜒离去，攀上山坡——然而，浅水里一点反光攫住了你的目光。它像黄金般闪耀；你俯身凝望水中，又看见更多金属般的微光隐隐跳动。
The river widens and slows here, forming a shallow pool of crystal-clear water nestled in a low and quiet spot between the forests on one side and the hill on the other. A dirt trail runs away from the water’s edge and up the hill, but a glint in the shallows catches your eye. It shines like gold, and as you peer in the water, you spot other metallic glimmers.

Temple To A God Of Beasts.name:
野兽之神的神殿
Temple To A God Of Beasts

Text.text:
森林深处矗立着一座木造神社，历经年代与天气的磨洗，木色泛起银白的光泽。寺社由一片蔓延开来的附属建筑群构成，处处雕刻着陆地、天空与海洋生灵的形象。建筑之间的石径蜿蜒穿行于一片被悉心养护的野境，万兽栖居其间：温顺的犬猫会主动凑近访客；狐狸与鹿从繁叶的掩蔽后探出目光；鸟与甲虫在树与树之间轻掠跳跃；清泉飞溅，鱼与青蛙嬉游其下——一切仿佛都在彼此相伴中和谐共生。
In the middle of a forest stands a shrine built of wood, silvered with age and weather. The temple comprises a sprawling network of outbuildings, all carved with images of creatures of the land, air, and sea. Stone paths between the buildings wind through a cultivated wilderness home to beasts of all kinds: friendly dogs and cats approach visitors; foxes and deer peer out from behind leafy cover; birds and beetles flit from tree to tree; and springs splash with fish and frogs—all seeming to live harmoniously in one another’s company.

Temple To A Goddess Of Darkness.name:
黑暗女神神殿
Temple To A Goddess Of Darkness

Text.text: [外部] 这座神殿仅是一栋单层木屋，为了一个目的而建——在没有光的世界中体验万物。信众穿过一重又一重柔软的深色帷幕进入其中，而能在黑暗中视物的来客会先用眼罩蒙住双眼。 [内部] 在彻底的失明里，礼拜者只凭其余感官来庆祝女神。他们摸索着寻找可以相握的手，跟随领唱者起头的歌声一同加入。你听见亲吻、呼喊、推搡的声响，也听见低语——或是鼓励，或是痛苦中的呢喃。神殿里摆着边角圆润的软凳；火盆中的温热炭火被女祭司维持的魔法黑暗所包裹，封在一个个球形的幽暗之中。 [Outside] This temple exists simply in a wooden building of one floor made for one purpose—to experience the world without light. The faithful pass through a series of soft, dark curtains to enter it, with dark-sighted attendees first wrapping their eyes in blindfolds. [Inside] In the totality of blindness, worshipers celebrate the goddess only through their other senses. They find hands to hold, songs begun by a canter to be joined. You hear the sounds of kissing, of shouting, of shoving, of whispering in encouragement or out of suffering. The temple has soft benches with rounded corners, and the warm coals within the braziers are encased in spheres of magical darkness maintained by a priestess.

His Lordship Sir Dale Of The Dale Lands.name:
戴尔地戴尔爵士大人
His Lordship Sir Dale Of The Dale Lands

Text.text:
那位纤瘦矮小的半身人优雅地转身面对你，短斗篷在他考究利落的身形后旋出一圈风。指响般迅捷，他的笑意忽明忽灭；然而一双璀璨的翠绿眼眸，仍从那张月光般苍白的脸上愉快地打量着你。他双手灵巧一扬，利落地行了个短鞠躬——可你依旧觉得，他是在用鼻梁看你。

~ 由 Played Tyler Kamstra（RPGBOT.net）扮演，并附

The slim little halfling gracefully turns to you, a short cape whirling behind his dapper figure as he does so. His smile flashes on and off again, swift as the snap of fingers, but eyes of brilliant green continue to merrily regard you from a face as pale as the moon. His hands flourish dexterously as he makes a short bow, but you still feel as though he’s looking down his nose at you.

~ Played by Tyler Kamstra of RPGBOT.net with

那匹干瘦的黑马翻上山脊，双眼泛着骇人的猩红幽光。热汽自鼻孔喷涌而出，它俯视四周，审视着一切。马背上的骑手披着古老的护甲，头盔上弯角高耸；它在鞍上缓缓转身，露出一张骷髅般的面容。眼窝深处燃着光——纯粹的恶意。
The gaunt, black horse crests the hill, its eyes glowing a haunting crimson. Steam rises from its nostrils as it surveys its surroundings. Its rider, clad in ancient armor and a helm crested with curving horns, turns in the saddle, revealing a skeletal visage. A glow burns in the hollows of its eyes—pure malice.

I Throw My Golden Lions Figurine Of Wond.name:
我掷出我的奇妙力量金狮雕像，召唤出两头狮子
I Throw My Golden Lions Figurine Of Wondrous Power To Summon Two Lions

Text.text:
一片草地浮现，夜半的薄雾如墨般笼罩，其间闪烁着草原群星般的微光。两张巨大的猫科獠口撕开烟雾，喉间低沉滚动着咆哮的震颤。一头雄狮与一头母狮从草丛中跃出，利爪前探，随后以从容的猫步绕着我踱行成圈。
A field of grass appears, clouded with a midnight mist sparkling with savannah stars. Two massive maws of feline teeth breach the smoke, their throats rumbling with snarls. A lion and lioness leap out of the grass, claws extended, then circle me with an easy, feline saunter.

你踏入这家古怪的店铺时，一只小巧明亮的铃铛叮当作响，像是热情的欢迎礼炮。这里质朴而带着神秘的气息将你层层包裹，仿佛一阵温柔的暖流拂过心头，令你不自觉地放松下来。一个年迈的侏儒从厚重的橡木柜台后小碎步走出，笑意盈盈地递上了一杯热气氤氲、香味馥郁的茶；而你则带着安静的惊叹环顾店内。各式各样的扫帚铺满墙壁——甚至连天花板也不放过：色彩、样式与根源千差万别。每一把都像它的制作者一样，独一无二。
A small, bright bell’s chimes are a welcoming peal as you enter the curious shop. The homely mysticism of the place envelops you in a comforting wave of tranquil warmth, and you feel at ease. An old gnome patters out from behind the heavy oak desk with a smile and offers you a cup of steaming, fragrant tea as you gaze in quiet wonder around the store. Brooms of every color, style, and tradition cover the walls—and ceiling. Each one is as individual and unique as its creator.

Fiendish-looking Ice Mephit.name:
魔鬼般狰狞的冰魔蝠
Fiendish-looking Ice Mephit

Text.text:
仿佛一头被赋予水晶形体的恶魔，这只小恶魔从那道如极地冰裂隙般深刻的眉脊下，用冰冷而无情的眼神斜睨着你。它发出如冰锥震颤般的驴叫狂笑，扇动带钩的双翼绕着你盘旋，身后拖曳着一缕缕阴沉的飞雪。水滴不断从这恶魔细长的耳尖与鼻尖坠落，仿佛它永远在融化——可惜从未真正化开。
Like a demon given crystalline form, the mephit leers at you with cold, merciless eyes from beneath a brow as furrowed as a polar crevasse. With braying laughter like shaking icicles, it circles you on hooked wings, dismal snow trailing in its wake. Droplets constantly fall from the tips of the fiend’s long ears and nose, giving the impression it is always melting—but with no such luck.

I Sneak A Book Off The Shelf.name:
我悄悄从书架上顺走一本书
I Sneak A Book Off The Shelf

Text.text:
我左右迅速回望，警惕是否有游移的目光或潜伏的脚步。确认四下无人，我的手猛地探向那本书。一气呵成，我将它从书架上抽出，塞进衣褶深处。架上余下的厚书为填补空隙彼此轻轻一撞，发出沉闷的声响，而我早已转身离开现场，竭力让步伐看起来漫不经心、稀松平常。
I peer over both my shoulders, checking for wandering eyes or lurking feet. Seeing no one else, I shoot my hand to the book. In one swift movement, I slip it from the shelf and tuck it into the folds of my clothes. The remaining tomes on the shelf fall against each other with a gentle bump to accommodate the gap, but I've already begun to walk away from the scene, trying to look as carefree and routine as possible.

Hangover From Alcohol.name:
酒后宿醉
Hangover From Alcohol

Text.text:
意识猛然回笼，把你从迷离的恍惚里硬生生拽进白昼冰冷、毫不留情的光线中。以神祇之名，你昨晚到底喝了什么！？舌头像干裂的河床般干枯，脑袋里的抽痛仿佛攻城槌正把你的颅骨劈开。你抬手遮住脆弱的双眼，避开清晨温柔的光束，拖着身子下了床，发誓再也不喝了。

~ crunchyzombies 于 Discord

Consciousness returns to you, dragging you from a dreamy stupor into the cold, unflinching light of day. By the gods, what did you drink last night!? Your tongue is like a dry, cracked riverbed, and the throbbing in your head feels like a battering ram is splitting your skull. Shielding your delicate eyes from the gentle rays of morning, you drag yourself out of bed and swear to never drink again.

~ crunchyzombies on Discord

众人围坐在噼啪作响的篝火旁，一股烤得暖香的奇异巨兽气味萦绕在空气里，牢牢攫住挤在火堆周围的人们。谈笑间，他们口中抛出一次次壮举与遥远异乡的传闻，笑声粗豪，彼此拍着后背。随着香料撒下、又有几滴麦酒溅进火里，那味道愈发浓烈。窜起的火舌舔过酒液，将醇香卷上夜空。有人高喊：“开饭啦！”随即欢呼四起，烤得油亮的公牛被利刃切开。
Sitting around the crackling fire, the toasty smell of some magnificent beast lingers in the air, captivating the folks crowded around the campfire. Stories of exploits and far-off lands fall from their lips as they laugh raucously, patting one another on the back. The smell increases in intensity as seasonings are added and a bit of ale is spilled on the fire. Spitting flames lick up the alcoholic drink and cast its fragrance into the air. "Supper’s ready!" a voice calls, and is answered with cheers as the roasted ox is cut into.

你手中托着一个自己的复制品——粗糙，却分明就是你——当你念完咒语，它在一阵奥术光闪中倏然消散。你面前伫立着你的分身，与本体无从分辨，神情一如你此刻的表情，静候你的命令。
You hold a replica of yourself—crude, but unmistakably you—that vanishes in a flash of arcane light as you complete the incantation. Before you stands your double, indiscernible from you, expression mimicking yours, awaiting a command.

Necromancer Plastic Surgeon.name:
死灵整容师
Necromancer Plastic Surgeon

Text.text:
死灵法师的光头成了一团疤痕肉。粗陋的缝线爬满他们的脸，癫狂的双眼抽搐着，死死聚焦在你身上。溅满血点的围裙松松垮垮地挂在那瘦骨嶙峋的身躯上，污渍斑斑的皮革里隐约可见一张张人脸。指节过多的尖锐护手套屈伸作响，咔哒咔哒。沾着血浆的手术刀刃一甩，血珠啪嗒落地。萎缩的双腿推动生物逼近，锈蚀的铁制支架尖啸摩擦，没趾的脚在烂泥里拖行。
The necromancer’s bald head is a mass of scar tissue. Crude stitches crawl across their face, their crazed eyes twitching and focusing upon you. A blood-spattered apron hangs loosely upon their scrawny frame, human faces visible within the stained leather. Sharp gauntlets with too many fingers flex and click. Scalpel blades slick with gore flick blood upon the ground. Atrophied legs propel the creature forward, its rusted iron braces screeching and its toeless feet dragging in the muck.

Hallucinogenic Drug, Red Mescaline.name:
致幻药物：红色麦司卡林
Hallucinogenic Drug, Red Mescaline

Text.text:
这只透明塑料瓶以红色旋盖封口，瓶内粉末仅装到一半高度。唯有一张螺旋眼表情贴纸遮住视线，挡住你窥见其中尘粉。内容物呈条纹层叠，像随手拌出的香料：以红为底，其间夹着细细的黄线与绿线。瓶身一被摇动，那团物质便在内部缓缓滑移，扬起淡淡粉雾，在瓶中空气里飘荡。

~ 一位英雄所构想

Capped with a red screw-top, this bottle of clear plastic holds powder up to the halfway mark. Only a sticker of a spiral-eyed emoji blocks the view of the dust within. The contents are striated like a simple spice mix: red with thin lines of yellow and green. When the bottle is disturbed, the substance shifts and wafts into the air inside the bottle.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Druidic Beastfolk Village.name:
德鲁伊兽民村庄
Druidic Beastfolk Village

Text.text:
由把这里当作家园的兽民用双手、掘土利爪与粗陋工具一点点凿刻而成，这座村落筑在巨大的原始老林古树树干之中——树心被掏空，粗壮木段被拖拽拼接成环，围出村中的圆形广场。细心摆放的石块标出小径，将粗糙却实用的居所彼此分隔。每间住处旁都试着开垦出一小块菜圃，原始的引水沟渠勉强供足水分，让色彩鲜亮的花朵与那点能挣扎活下来的稀薄作物得以生长。空气里弥漫着熟蘑菇与青绿蔬菜的香气，混着采来的野草香料，暖意渗入鼻息。

~ 构想：Andrew Sanguine

Fashioned by the hands, digging claws, and crude tools of the beastfolk that call it home, this village has been built within the trunks of enormous old-growth trees, hollowed out and hauled into a circular shape to form the village square. Carefully placed stones indicate the pathways separating the crude but effective structures. Each dwelling features a rudimentary attempt at agriculture in the form of a small garden, with primitive irrigation providing sufficient water for the brightly hued flowers and what meager crops manage to thrive. The scent of cooked mushrooms and green vegetables spiced by gathered herbs permeates the air.

~ Envisioned by Andrew Sanguine

庭院是一片长方形的空间，铺着人造草坪与黑白纹样的瓷砖。靠墙竖着一面巨大的屏幕，放映着无脸的躯体，缠绕在光里，被放大到近乎巨像的体型；他们在舞动时不断抖落像素，动作如水般流畅，伴着音乐的节拍起伏，而那低沉的震颤甚至能从地面一路传进骨头里。一座霓虹青绿的泳池吐出近乎放射性的光芒——底部高功率灯阵向上奔涌，光纹被设计成海浪的形状。宾客们穿着泳装与松松垂落的罩袍交错寒暄，鸡尾酒被俗气地装点上LED冰块与金属银的小伞。温度由头顶几台仿棕榈树造型的风扇与埋入瓷砖地面的冷却系统共同调控，像一道恰到好处的屏障，抵御城市那层油腻的湿热。
The courtyard is a rectangular stretch of synthetic grass and black-and-white-patterned tile. A screen extends up one wall, showing faceless bodies wreathed in light blown up to colossal size. They shed pixels as they dance in fluid patterns to the music that can be felt thrumming through the floor. A neon-teal pool emits a radioactive glow courtesy of the high-powered lights surging up from the bottom, patterned to resemble an ocean wave. Guests mingle in their bathing suits and loosely hanging robes, cocktails gauchely adorned with LED ice cubes and metallic silver umbrellas. The temperature is regulated via some overhanging fans modeled to resemble palm trees and coolant systems into the tile floor, a welcome shield against the oily humidity of the city.

Warning From A Gravedigger.name:
掘墓人的警告
Warning From A Gravedigger

Text.text:
“我不信什么幽灵（特征）故事。我跟死人打交道够多了，真要有那玩意儿，我早该撞见了。不，那地方盘踞的不是谁家老奶奶的亡魂，是别的东西——更冷，更会算计。我不知道它对那些尸体到底图什么，但那绝不会只是半夜里几声磕碰那么简单。”
“I don’t believe in ghost stories. Been around the dead enough that I would’ve met one by now. No, it isn’t the spirit of someone’s grandma that’s taken hold in that place, it’s something else. Something cold and calculating. I don’t know what it wants with those bodies but it’s going to be a lot worse than a few bumps in the night.”

Vial Of Saharan Sand.name:
撒哈拉之沙小瓶
Vial Of Saharan Sand

Text.text:
这种取自佩特拉附近沙丘的附魔细沙，可从小瓶中倾倒出来并向其发问。它会自行塑形成回答问题的物体——往往语带隐晦。技能较低的法师只能得到静止的沙雕；而更强大的法师面前，它们会动起来。若在户外，将其倒在平坦地面上，并置于可见月亮与星辰的夜空之下，它还能自行塑成一只能正常使用的罗盘。
This enchanted sand from the dunes near Petra can be poured out of the vial and asked questions. It sculpts itself into objects that answer the query—often cryptically. A mage of lower skill will get only stationary sculptures, but for more powerful mages, they will move. Outdoors, when poured onto a flat surface under a sky with visible moon and stars, it can craft itself in to a functional compass.

Loot From An Ice Devil.name:
来自冰魔的战利品
Loot From An Ice Devil

Text.text:
恶魔左手那唯一的护手，乃以六种金属的细丝精密缠绕而成。漫长的停顿间隙里，地狱的魔法沿着丝线游走，迸出昏暗而短促的冰冷金辉，火花一闪即逝。其工艺精湛，拿去贩卖亦能换得高价，但更显而易见的是——它被灌注了异界的力量。
The devil’s left and only gauntlet is a wrapping of fine wire in six metals. Between long pauses, infernal magic tracks around the wires in dim, short bursts of freezing gold that spark and disappear. Its craftsmanship would make it valuable to sell, but it is also clearly imbued with otherworldly power.

Scale Mail Armor +2.name:
鳞甲护甲 +2
Scale Mail Armor +2

Text.text:
这副护甲的乌黑鳞片光泽如镜，显然取自某种巨大的爬行生物。大多数叶片状鳞片约有拇指大小，在光线下泛起奇异的虹彩微辉。无论是剥下何等猛兽的皮才制成这套护甲，它必定非同凡响——这些鳞片既比钢更轻，又比钢更坚韧。
The glossy black scales of this armor clearly came from some great reptile. Most of the leaf-shaped scales are thumb-sized, and they gleam with a curious iridescence in the light. Whatever beast was skinned to make this suit, it must have been something extraordinary, for the scales are both lighter and stronger than steel.

I Parkour Over Rooftops.name:
我在屋顶间跑酷穿梭
I Parkour Over Rooftops

Text.text:
手脚齐发，我像一只纵跃的猫般轻快自如地掠过屋顶。我的呼吸稳健有力，如风箱般鼓荡不息，让我在飞身越过裂隙、翻越障碍时依旧势头不减。我的身心进入那种我久经练习才得以触及的心流之境——在栏杆上摇摇欲坠的踏步、千钧一发的攀握点、每一次迅疾的引体上拉，都变得流畅、轻松而笃定。
Arms and legs pumping, I leap over rooftops with the quickness and ease of a bounding cat. My breath, as steady and strong as bellows, keeps me going as I hop over gaps and vault over obstacles. My mind and body enter a state of flow I’ve practiced long to find—teetering steps along a banister, last-second handholds, and every swift pull-up feels fluid, easy, and true.

在弧形楼梯的各处平台上，教授们守望着——有的神情严厉，有的目光和善。他们解答疑问，扬声提醒着着装规范，偶尔还会彼此对视一眼，带着心照不宣的笑意。
At the landings of the curving staircases, professors watch—some sternly, some kindly. They answer questions, call out reminders about the dress code, and occasionally glance at one another in conspiratorial amusement.

纠结的棕色毛皮裹住那过长的四肢，与士兵般结实的躯体形成诡异的比例；野兽般的脸上抹着深色战纹，遮去了大半五官。斥候将一杆火枪斜挎在肩，枪管黑得像炉火里烧旧的煤，随即以令人心惊的敏捷钻入近处灌木丛中。

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

Matted brown fur coats limbs too long for the soldier's muscular body, and dark warpaint daubed on their bestial face obscures most of their features. The scout slings a musket over one shoulder, its barrel blackened like old coal in a fire, and makes their way into the nearby brush with startling dexterity.

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

High Tide Coastline.name:
涨潮海岸线
High Tide Coastline

Text.text:
海浪鞭挞着峭壁脚下，雪白的浪花轰然炸开，喷成高高的水羽，直冲雨雾弥漫的空中。凿进白垩岩里的台阶——通往上方的村庄——已被海水半淹，沙滩也在狂怒的海面下彻底消失。一对海雕掠过浪尖滑翔，搜寻着闪银的猎物。
Waves lash at the foot of the cliffs, white plumes of spray bursting high into the rain-filled air. Steps carved into the chalk—leading to the village above—are partially submerged, and the beach has vanished beneath the angry sea. A pair of sea eagles glide above the surface, hunting for silvery prey.

Junk Food Candy Bar.name:
垃圾食品：糖果棒
Junk Food Candy Bar

Text.text:
这块巧克力棒的包装是廉价塑料做的，颜色被蹭掉了几块；两侧还鼓着空气袋，让点心看起来比实际更大。但它用价格弥补了这些缺点：几乎是货架上最便宜的东西。
The packaging on the candy bar has some of the color rubbed off the cheap plastic, and there's a pocket of air on either side to make the treat look bigger than it actually is. But it makes up for these shortcomings with the price: it's practically the cheapest thing on the shelves.

The Old Green Dragon—a Shanty.name:
老绿龙——一首海员小调
The Old Green Dragon—a Shanty

Text.text:
[时点/节拍：4/4]
第1节

噢，我们去寻那老绿龙，
是吗？是吗？
我们在港边酒馆里找着他，
是吗？是吗？
我们给他斟满酒杯，又灌满大酒壶，
是吗？是吗？
他把两样都一口饮尽，便与我们同席，
是吗？是吗？
随后他起身，发下誓言，
是吗？是吗？
“伙计们，我要入你们这乌合船队。”
会吗？会吗？
“但前提是你们得说句真话……”
会吗？会吗？

副歌

你们可会升起风帆、踏紧索绳？
会的，会的
你们可会与我痛饮直到人人眼花？
会的，会的
你们可会与我大笑，也守我不负？
会的，会的
那我就与你们同航这蔚蓝海途！
会的，会的！

第2节

噢，那条龙是个胆气冲天的水手，
是吗？是吗？
他会带我们去寻一座黄金宝藏，
会吗？会吗？
他会以牙与爪为我们厮杀，
会吗？会吗？
他会把敌人送进海底长眠，
会吗？会吗？

副歌

你们可会升起风帆、踏紧索绳？
会的，会的
你们可会与我痛饮直到人人眼花？
会的，会的
你们可会与我大笑，也守我不负？
会的，会的
那我就与你们同航这蔚蓝海途！
会的，会的！

第3节

噢，那条龙航行了千里万里不止，
是吗？是吗？
还一箱一箱为我们带回财富，
是吗？是吗？
直到有一天，他振翼而去，
是吗？是吗？
奔向某处新天地的远行之约，
是吗？是吗？

[速度放慢]

于是他离开了我们这乌合船队，
是吗？是吗？
也把我们留在这蔚蓝海途

终章副歌

你们可曾升起风帆、踏紧索绳？
曾经，曾经
你们可曾与我痛饮直到人人眼花？
曾经，曾经

你们可曾与我大笑，也守我不负？
曾经，曾经
那我们仍将航行在这蔚蓝海途！
会的，会的！ [尾声延展华彩！]

终

~ 由 Jangowolf 构想

[Timings/Beat: 4/4]
Verse 1

O’ we went lookin’ for the Old Green Dragon,
Did ye now? Did ye now?
We found him in the portside tavern,
Did ye now? Did ye now?
We filled his cup and filled his flagon,
Did ye now? Did ye now?
He joined us after draining both,
Did he now? Did he now?
Then he stood up and swore an oath,
Did he now? Did he now?
“Lads I’ll join your motley crew,”
Will he now? Will he now?
“But only if you’ll tell me true…”
Will we now? Will we now?

Chorus

Will ye hoist them sails and toe those lines?
Aye, we will, Aye we will
Will ye drink with me till all go blind?
Aye we will, Aye we will
Will ye laugh with me and keep me true?
Aye we will, Aye we will
Then I’ll join yer crew on the ocean blue!
Aye you will, Aye you will!

Verse 2

O’ the Dragon he’s a sailor bold,
Is he now? Is he now?
He’ll lead us to a hoard of gold,
Will he now? Will he now?
He’ll fight for us with tooth and claw,
Will he now? Will he now?
He’ll send our foes to the ocean floor
Will he now? Will he now?

Chorus

Will ye hoist them sails and toe those lines?
Aye, we will, Aye we will
Will ye drink with me till all go blind?
Aye we will, Aye we will
Will ye laugh with me and keep me true?
Aye we will, Aye we will
Then I’ll join yer crew on the ocean blue!
Aye you will, Aye you will!

Verse 3

O’ the Dragon sailed ten-score or more,
Did he now? Did he now?
An’ he brought us riches by the score,
Did he now? Did he now?
Till one day then off he flew,
Did he now? Did he now?
Off on a quest to somewhere new,
Did he now? Did he now?

[Tempo Slows]

An’ so he left our motley crew,
Did he now? Did he now?
An’ he left us on the ocean blue

Final Chorus

Did ye hoist them sails and toe those lines?
Aye, we did, Aye we did
Did ye drink with me till all went blind?
Aye we did, Aye we did

Did ye laugh with me and keep me true?
Aye we did, Aye we did
Then still we’ll sail on the ocean blue!
Aye we will, Aye we will! [Extended flourish to end!]

END

~ Envisioned by Jangowolf

你面前矗立着一座巨大的石砌建筑，一旁河水不息翻涌，驱动着水轮永不停歇地转动。走进其中，磨盘吞吐谷物，碾作细白面粉，供养这片地区的众人；多余的则储存起来以备寒冬，或许也会外运。碾磨声单调而规律，听来竟让人心安。
Before you lies a large stone building with an endlessly turning watermill powered by the constant churn of the river beside it. Within, a millstone is fed with grains to produce flour for all within the region, the surplus stored for winter or possibly export. The sound of the grinding is pleasing in its monotony.

Kolle Volgrimson, The Undrowned.name:
科莱·沃尔格里姆森，“不溺者”
Kolle Volgrimson, The Undrowned

Text.text:
他的性子咸涩得像那被海风磨砺的皮肤与编成辫子的红胡须。身披护甲的他高大挺拔、肌肉虬结；黑与银交织的甲面上覆着一件绣有风暴神祇徽记的罩袍，纹章在金属上闪着冷光。那符号被刻进他长戟的三道刃锋里，武器每次微微转动，便嗡鸣着涌出潜伏的电意。他从自己驾驭的私掠船甲板上踏下，你得以更近地看清他——那双坚硬的眼里藏着一丝哀伤，来自一段暴力的生涯：它尚未将他彻底摧毁。

~ Played by Florest13 with

His personality is as salty as his wind-worn skin and braided red beard. He stands tall and heavily muscled in his armor, which is black and silver and covered with the emblazoned tabard of a tempest deity. The symbol is etched into each of the three blades of his halberd, and the weapon buzzes with latent electricity when it shifts. He steps off the deck of the privateer he sails and you get a closer look at him. His hard eyes carry a hint of sadness from a life of violence that hasn’t quite destroyed him yet.

~ Played by Florest13 with

亮光清漆为这只纤薄的桃花心木匣增添了华美光泽；黄铜铰链与精巧搭扣相映成趣。内里覆以黑色天鹅绒，布面缝出的细环将十二枚形制各异的笔尖稳稳固定。旁侧隔间里，一支上漆木质笔杆与毛笔、羽毛笔并排静卧。更大的槽位则收纳着笔架、几只色泽不同的墨水瓶、一袋吸墨干燥粉，以及红色封蜡。匣盖内侧的一条束带扣着一块小巧的膝上写板，并留出放置羊皮纸的空隙。
Glossy varnish beautifies this thin mahogany case, which has brass hinges and a fancy latch. Black velvet covers the interior, and loops in this cloth keep a dozen pen nibs of varied shapes in place. A lacquered wooden stylus lays in a compartment beside a brush and feathered pen. Larger slots contain a pen stand, a few ink bottles of differing hues, a pouch of drying powder, and red sealing wax. A strap in the box’s top holds a small lap board and room for parchment.

Haunted House: Nursemaid's Suite.name:
闹鬼宅邸：保姆套房
Haunted House: Nursemaid's Suite

Text.text:
荷叶边的窗帘与刻意摆放的蕾丝小垫并没能解除这间套房里弥漫的寒意——这里曾住着一位保姆和她照看的孩子们。你穿过保养得当却已显陈旧的陈设，触及育婴室本身：如今满覆尘埃与蛛网。寒意愈发刺骨，而你却找不到源头……直到你的目光钉在后墙那面鎏金镜上。镜面污垢斑驳的倒影里，一个幽影般的女家庭教师俯身在啼哭的婴儿摇篮上，双手紧攥着一只靠垫。
Frilly curtains and strategically placed doilies do little to dispel the chill emanating from this suite—once inhabited by a nursemaid and her charges. Walking through the well-kept but aged décor, you reach the nursery itself, now covered in dust and cobwebs. The chill grows worse, though you are unable to place the source… until you stare into the gilt mirror hanging on the back wall. In its grimy reflection you see a ghostly governess leaning over the cradle of a crying child, a cushion clutched in her hands.

I Cast Forbiddance To Protect.name:
我施放【禁制术】以守护
I Cast Forbiddance To Protect

Text.text:
我沿着圣所的边缘踱步，以缓慢而刻意的节奏吟诵古老的守护词句。神圣熏香浓烈的气息与圣水带着铁锈般的腥冽交织在一起，我将红宝石粉末撒在我的仪式圆环周围。粉尘在离地寸许处悬浮成一团闪耀的瘴雾，在魔法能量的流光暗涌中旋转、舞动。最后一个词从唇间逸出时，粉尘自圆环向外轰然迸散，一层银色的守护灵光在空间四周忽明忽灭地显现。
I chant the ancient words of protection in a slow, deliberate rhythm as I pace the edges of my sanctuary. The heady scent of sacred incense mingles with the ferrous tang of holy water as I scatter powdered ruby around my ritual circle. The dust hovers in a glittering miasma inches above the ground, swirling and dancing in currents of magical energy. As the last word leaves my lips, the dust erupts outward from the circle and a silver aura of protection flickers into being around the space.

Community Garden And Well In Winter.name:
冬日的社区花园与水井
Community Garden And Well In Winter

Text.text:
尽管园子里积雪沉沉，地里许多木牌不是歪倒就是被潮气浸得发软，仍有细小的绿芽从冰霜织成的被褥下顶出，明亮而健壮。一名白色龙裔少年正从近旁那口矮矮的石井里打水，银鳞覆盖的双手没戴手套，寒风拂面也神色安宁。与他同岁的一个人类男孩站在旁边，裹着兽皮夹袄瑟瑟发抖。你听见这对朋友嘟囔着“加班”和“那些怪怪的外地人”，这时一位佝偻着背、穿着深色长袍且沾着面粉痕的老侍祭走近，手里提着木桶。他步子虚浮，羊毛连指手套破洞累累。“能否劳烦你分我一些刚打上来的水，孩子？”他喘鸣着嗓子问道，“炖汤和饺子用水快见底了。要躲避风雪的人太多……”龙裔轻轻把冰冷的井水倒进木桶里。老侍祭的手臂被重量压得开始发颤，人类男孩便伸手托住他的肘弯。

“我来，爷爷。回修道院？”
Though the garden is laden with snow and many of the signs on the plots are tipped over or drenched by the dampness, tiny green sprigs push through the frosty blanket, bright and healthy. A white dragonborn adolescent draws water from the squat, stony well nearby, their silver-scaled hands gloveless and face calm in the cold breeze. A human boy of the same age stands next to them, shivering under a hide jacket. You hear the two friends grumble about “overtime” and “those weird out-of-towners” when an old acolyte with a bent back and a dark, flour-smudged robe approaches, wooden pail in hand. His steps are wobbly and his woolen mittens are full of holes. “Might I trouble you to share some of what you just pulled up, young one?” he asks with a wheezy voice. “We’re running out of water for the stew and dumplings. So many folk needing shelter…” The dragonborn gently pours the icy water into the wooden pail. As the acolyte’s arm begins to shake with the weight, the human boy puts a hand under their elbow. 

“I got this, Granddad. Back to the Abbey?”

Creepy Graveyard Mausoleum.name:
阴森的墓园陵寝
Creepy Graveyard Mausoleum

Text.text:
在残破的雕像与褪色的墓碑之间，枯骨般的树木投下阴影，常春藤肆意蔓生，陵墓伫立其间。高耸的石柱支撑着庄严的屋顶，沉重的铁门封锁着入口。建筑的石材苍白如骨，而即便隔着厚重的墙壁，你仍能察觉里面有移动……
Amidst crumbling statuary and faded tombstones, shadowed by skeletal trees and overgrown with ivy, the mausoleum stands. Soaring pillars support a stately roof and a heavy iron door bars the entrance. The stone of the structure is bone white, and, even through the thick walls, you detect movement inside . . .

Sperm Whale Attack.name:
抹香鲸攻击
Sperm Whale Attack

Text.text:
你看见那头巨鲸在船旁破水而出。“是苍白之死！”一名水手嘶声大喊，众人顿时乱作一团，仓皇奔走，急忙备战。它的皮肉呈一种令人作呕的病态蜡黄，布满了成千上万道疤痕；那只凶戾的眼睛带着几乎能触摸到的恨意，死死盯着船身。
You see the whale breach the water next to the ship. "It's the Pale Death!" yells one of the sailors, causing everyone to scramble to prepare for battle. Its flesh, a sickening yellowish color, is covered in thousands of scars, and its menacing eye stares up at the ship with palpable hatred.

Underground Elven City In A Desert.name:
沙漠深处的地下精灵城
Underground Elven City In A Desert

Text.text:
上方沙漠灼人的热浪在这座巨大的洞窟里戛然而止，取而代之的是清凉、沁人的微风。阳光从岩石穹顶的裂隙间漏下，巨大的优雅镜面将光束捕捉、折射并放大，精准的工程将其化作一场炫目的光之盛宴。这洞窟与其说是阴郁的地穴，不如说更像一处热带绿洲——形形色色、异域得近乎荒诞的动植物在这片地下枢纽中繁盛生长。一株巨树——高逾瞭望塔——俯瞰着隐秘之城精雕细琢的建筑群；它粗壮的枝桠上挂满树屋与栈道，供那些身形矫捷的精灵在叶影间穿行。

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

The blistering heat of the desert above gives way to a cool, refreshing breeze in the enormous cavern. Sunlight filters through cracks in the rocky ceiling, and huge, elegant mirrors capture and amplify the rays in a dazzling display of precise engineering. The cave is more akin to a tropical oasis than a dismal cavern, as all manner of wildly exotic flora and fauna thrive in the subterranean nexus. A great tree—taller than a watchtower—looks out over the intricately sculpted buildings of the hidden city, its great boughs laden with huts and walkways for the fleet-footed elves who walk among the leaves.

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

你面前高挑的精灵生物以超凡脱俗的优雅行动。他们身姿尊贵凛然，而那灵巧的步伐却暗示着其自卫时足以致命的本领。虹彩般的双眼紧紧盯着你，细细剖析着你的一举一动。
The tall elven creature before you moves with an otherworldly grace. They have a regal stature, even as their deft movements hint at the deadliness they can defend themselves with. Opalescent eyes watch you closely, dissecting your behavior.

一座厚重的外堡门楼高踞于道路之上，两侧高墙向外弯折，伸出至城堡护城河上方。越过门楼后方那片杀戮空地，吊桥已然放下，但一道闸门栅栏横在你前路。视野里不见守卫踪影，看来你只能穿过门楼下的隧道闯入，主动将自己暴露在守军的火力之下。
A stout barbican looms over the road, flanked on either side by high walls that curve round to jut over the castle’s moat. Across the killing field behind the barbican, the drawbridge lies open, but a portcullis blocks your path. No guards are in sight, so it looks like you must enter the tunnel through the barbican and expose yourself to its defenders.

God Of Bards.name:
吟游诗神
God Of Bards

Text.text:
“诸位都来吧——来剧院，来广场，来舞台边缘，来小径的肩头！”吟游诗人的神祇以一鞠躬启幕，又以一鞠躬落幕，仿佛两枚书挡，将你的情绪轻轻合拢。时代随笛与鲁特琴的旋律起落涨退；祂吟诵诗句与笑谈，时而化作女子，时而化作男子。吟游诗人的神祇头戴风采——一簇白羽；留着山羊胡，或侠义，或奸邪；身着铃响的阔袖与绚丽的灯笼裤，脚踏舞鞋，步步生光。吟游诗人的神祇喷吐诸纪元的传说，也点燃年代的魔法灵感。
"Come one and all to the theater, to the square, the edge of the stage, the shoulder of the trail!" A God of Bards begins and ends with a bow, bookends that embrace your feelings. Time ebbs and flows as the Bard plays fife and lute, recites verses and jokes, becomes woman and man. A God of Bards wears the panache, a white plume; sports the goatee, chivalrous or villainous; dresses in the belled sleeves and brilliant pantaloons with dancing shoes. A God of Bards spouts the lore of epochs and inspires the magics of the age.

Dwarven Miners' Guild Winter Market.name:
矮人矿工行会冬季集市
Dwarven Miners' Guild Winter Market

Text.text:
在城市的腹地，矿工公会正举办冬日市集。覆着雪吻的街巷间，摊位以闪烁的宝石与晶亮的矿石装点，兜售来自地下的珍宝。矮人工匠陈列着他们的手艺，揭开精巧的首饰与精致的金工。空气里翻涌着香料烈酒与烤乳猪的浓香。在热烈的同袍情谊中，矿工与匠人们聚拢交换，讲述蜿蜒坑道与奇妙发现的故事。
In the belly of the city, the miners’ guild throws its winter market. Within snow-kissed streets, stalls bedecked with glinting gems and sparkling stones offer subterranean treasures. Dwarven artisans display their work, unveiling delicate jewelry and exquisite metalwork. The air seethes with the aroma of spiced spirits and roasted pig. Amid the zealous camaraderie, miners and crafters gather to trade stories of twisting tunnels and wondrous finds.

Nas Gwilith, Air Elemental Island.name:
纳斯·格维利斯，气元素之岛
Nas Gwilith, Air Elemental Island

Text.text:
嶙峋荒瘠的石地从水面陡然拔起，层层攀升，凝成一座巨大的峭岩，没入翻涌的云暴之中，雷光电闪，轰鸣不绝。一条小径自卵石滩起始，沿着山势曲折蜿蜒，以陡峭的之字形急转向上。山脚处微风轻拂；但被卷起的尘土昭示着，随着道路越攀越高，风势也愈发强劲。

~ 由 Josh Murphy 构想

Stony, barren land rises steeply out of the water. Up and up it goes, forming a colossal crag that disappears into a tempest of clouds, lightning, and thunder. A path begins at the pebbly shore and snakes up the mountain in steep switchbacks. Gentle breezes blow here at the base. But driven dust shows that the wind picks up strength as the way climbs higher.

~ Envisioned by Josh Murphy

Sundries From A Blue Dragon's Lair.name:
蓝龙巢穴的杂物
Sundries From A Blue Dragon's Lair

Text.text:
蓝龙的巢穴看起来出奇地空荡。几件破损的武器与护甲散落其间，沙地上横七竖八躺着牛的尸骸，腐败程度不一：有的已被啃得精光，有的仍挂着厚厚的血肉，苍蝇嗡鸣成团，腐臭熏人。  
一面巨大的镜子立在一处天然的岩台上，斜靠着石壁。镜面从一侧裂到另一侧，裂纹横贯其上。
The blue dragon’s lair appears surprisingly sparse. Among a few battered arms and pieces of armor, cattle carcasses lie strewn across the sand in varying states of decay, some picked clean, others still meaty, thick with buzzing flies and the stench of rot. A huge mirror stands on a natural dais, propped up against the rock wall. The glass is cracked from side to side.

当你绕过一处岩角时，本能让你猛地缩回身子。你瞥见一条小径在两块高耸巨石间沿着陡峭的斜坡向上延伸，上方岩壁突起的岩架俯瞰其间——天生就是伏击的绝佳地点。很快，你的谨慎得到了印证：你听见前方更高处的某处传来低低的说话声。
As you round a corner of rock, instinct makes you pull back. You glimpsed a pathway running up a steep incline between tall boulders, overlooked by ledges on the rock outcrops above—a natural place for an ambush. Your caution proves founded when you hear voices from somewhere ahead and above.

在摇曳的海藻之间，一只海马用卷曲的尾巴紧紧缠住一根藻须。它淡紫蓝的身躯上散落着午夜般的深蓝斑点，身上的每一道突起与棱脊都覆着一层朦胧的霜白。它注视着你，细长的吻部含蓄地垂向胸前。
Amidst the swaying seaweed, a seahorse clings to one tendril with its curlicue tail. Midnight blue speckles are scattered across its periwinkle body, while each of its bumps and ridges is frosted with a misty white. It regards you, thin snout dipped demurely to its chest.

光滑的银色剑柄，曲线优雅得像一根讲究的手杖，凉意透过接触渗入掌心，表面又有钴蓝能量的脉络蜿蜒流淌。机械化握柄上轻轻一扣触发，湛蓝能量刃便从奔涌的核心猛然绽出。这把武器约有长剑长度，低鸣声如巨虫振翼——却更柔和，不刺耳。它在挥动时向外辐射热浪，以灼人的优雅切开空气。

~ 由 Zippy Envisioned

The smooth silver hilt, contoured with the elegance of a posh cane, is cool to the touch and veined through with cobalt energy. With the trip of a trigger in the mechanized grip, a blade of blue energy burgeons from its surging core. This weapon, about the length of a longsword, hums with a sound like a great insect’s wings—though softer in timbre and not grating on the ear. It radiates heat as it moves with searing grace through the air.

~ Envisioned by Zippy

Paladin's Calling.name:
圣武士的感召
Paladin's Calling

Text.text:
神殿就在下一道山脊之后，雷霆轰鸣，迫使你抬头望向天穹。云层如同睁开的眼帘般裂开，温热的辉光成束倾泻，将你沐浴其中。一个声音唤出你的名字，抚慰而又严厉，却让你分不清它是否源自你的心底。云幕合拢，光芒消退，你的视线又落回前方的道路。你几乎记不起那声音说了什么，但你知道自己被召唤去完成什么。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

The temple lies just over the next ridge when thunder booms, drawing your attention skyward. Clouds part like an opening eye, bathing you in beams of warm radiance. A voice speaks your name, comforting yet stern, but you can’t tell whether it’s from inside your mind. As the clouds close and the light fades, your eyes fall back to the path ahead. You barely remember what the voice said, but you know what you’ve been called to do.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Quip About Knowing Your Limits.name:
关于懂得量力而行的俏皮话
Quip About Knowing Your Limits

Text.text:
“人生里总有些时刻，你必须坦诚地审视自己，问一句：我够好吗？我能做到吗？而此刻，我觉得答案响亮得不能更响亮——不。趁我被证明是对的之前，我们他妈的赶紧离开这里。”
“There are moments in life when you must look at yourself honestly and ask: Am I good enough? Can I do this? And right now, I feel like the answer is a resounding no. So let’s get the hell out of here before I’m proven right.”

Conquered Village Of Deep Gnomes.name:
被征服的深地侏儒村庄
Conquered Village Of Deep Gnomes

Text.text:
这些相连的洞窟里，墙壁被打磨得光滑如石镜，并饰以繁复华丽的雕刻。部分浮雕抽象难解，另一些却刻着矮小的秃头类人——它们在这片地下国度中起居劳作。与浮雕如出一辙的灰皮矮小生物，正埋头在如今已残破的建筑群间辛勤搬运修补。许多结构上都布满战斗留下的醒目标记——既有魔法的灼痕，也有刀剑与冲撞的破坏。面色阴沉的精灵，蓝灰色皮肤、淡色头发，手持细长之剑与流线型弩弓，冷冷注视着工人们。

~ Ethan 构想

Walls in these adjoining caverns have been smoothed and adorned with ornate carvings. Some of the reliefs are abstract, but others show small, bald humanoids going about life in this subterranean realm. Short, gray-skinned beings, matching the carvings, toil amid now-damaged buildings. The telltale signs of battle, magical and otherwise, mar many of the structures. Dour elves with blue-gray skin and pale hair, armed with thin swords and sleek crossbows, watch the workers.

~ Envisioned by Ethan

枯骨牵枯骨，几具骷髅围成欢快的圆圈起舞。无肉的身躯咔嗒作响，踏出嘎吱碎裂的节拍。每一次蹦跳，它们都略微崩塌：膝盖骨啪地弹飞滚远，肋骨翻折倾覆，下颌吱呀一声脱臼。但这丝毫不妨碍它们的狂欢——哪怕其中一位骨架同伴散到只剩一对手臂与肩胛。
Hand in bony hand, several skeletons dance in a merry circle. Their fleshless forms click and clack in a crunching rhythm. With each bounce, they crumble slightly. Kneecaps pop out and roll away, ribs capsize, and jaws unhinge with a creak. This does not hinder their jamboree, even when one of their skeletal fellows reduces to only a pair of arms and shoulders.

Filthy Train Station.name:
肮脏的火车站
Filthy Train Station

Text.text:
一列满身涂鸦的列车在肮脏的枢纽站里嘎吱作响地刹停，车轮用尽力气尖叫摩擦；病恹恹的通勤者在站台的垃圾堆间怒气冲冲地推搡争位。冰冷刺骨的一滩呕吐物、一只鸽子的焦黑残骸、还有几只碎裂的酒瓶，只是这片被遗忘的都市地狱景观里寥寥几样“盛宴”。
A graffiti-covered train grinds to a halt in the filthy hub station, its wheels screeching with effort as sickly commuters jostle angrily for position among the refuse of the platform. A pool of ice-cold vomit, the charred remains of a pigeon, and several broken bottles are just a few of the delights in this neglected urban hellscape.

敌人猛扑向你的盟友，武器直刺而出，眼中燃着森冷的杀意。你来不及思考便已出手——凭着本能，几乎只是一次训练有素的条件反射。你凝神屏息，仿佛时代在这一刻放慢。刹那间，你从周遭空气中攫取奥术之力——四肢感到那股狂躁能量的刺痒——随即将其放出。一束夺目的几何光流迸射而去，银白而参差如刃，疾速奔涌。银光勾勒出敌人的轮廓，他在电光石火间一滞，武器带着尖啸从你的盟友身侧掠过。
The enemy lunges at your ally, weapon outstretched, murderous intent alight in their eyes. You react without thinking—on instinct, little more than a practiced flinch. Time seems to slow as you focus, holding in a breath. In an instant, you pull arcane power from the air around you—feeling the tingle of its volatile energy in your limbs—then let it fly. A dazzling stream of geometric lights, silvery and jagged, courses forth. Silver light outlines your enemy, and with a split-second of hesitation, their weapon whistles past your ally.

这片田地与周围郁郁葱葱的景色形成鲜明对比——尽管天气温暖，它却反常地泛着枯黄。田地略有坡度，看上去雨水会更快流走，也许这就是缘由；但你还注意到，穗头上没有邻田那种细长下垂的芒。也许一边是小麦，而另一边则是大麦或黑麦。
This field stands in stark contrast to the verdancy of the surrounding landscape, unseasonably yellowed despite the warmth of the weather. The field looks like its slope might cause it to drain more swiftly, and that might be the cause, but you also notice the heads of the grain lack the long tassels of beard of those in the neighboring field. Perhaps one is wheat, and the other is barley or rye.

A Barbarian Learns Sensitivity.name:
野蛮人学会细腻
A Barbarian Learns Sensitivity

Text.text:
“漫长岁月里，我把力量奉为至高无上。战场的尖啸与骨裂的脆响，曾像抚慰我心的膏药。但如今我明白了，哭泣没什么不可以，泪水也无需避讳……我是说，我的敌人的泪水——当我将他们屠戮之时。”
“For so long, I have prized might above all else. The screams of battle and the crack of bone were like a balm for my heart. But now I see that crying is okay, that tears are not to be shunned… The tears of my enemies, I mean—as I murder them.”

这把精制弩狡黠地以经过处理的白蜡木打造而成，显然曾属于某位军中高阶军官——备受敬仰的队长，甚至常备军的将军——其精准远超寻常弓手的射程。
Cunningly constructed from treated ash wood, this fine crossbow was clearly the property of some high-ranking soldier—a revered captain or even general of a standing army—and is accurate beyond the range of common bowmen.

Stranger In Black.name:
黑衣陌客
Stranger In Black

Text.text:
在一顶宽檐黑帽的阴影下，一双凶厉的黄眼如捕食者般锁定你，目光阴冷而贪婪。那道魅力十足的身影以刺耳的金属拖腔对你开口，仿佛他们的话语正被遮住面孔的古怪面具扭曲变形。一身优雅的黑色装束，让他们站在贵族的葬礼上也毫不突兀。

~ 由 Discord 上的 Sahlonahl 在 Envisioned 构想

Beneath the brim of a wide black hat, a pair of baleful yellow eyes fix you with a predatory stare. The charismatic figure addresses you in a grinding, metallic drawl, as if their speech is being distorted by the curious mask hiding their face. In their elegant black attire, they would not look out of place at a noble's funeral.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Loot From A Roper.name:
来自盘缠怪的战利品
Loot From A Roper

Text.text:
你将利刃猛地搅入虬结的肌肉之中，腥臭而异界的脏器随即倾泻而出。成堆的骸骨残躯也一并被呕吐般喷出——血肉尽失，却仍披挂着防护衣物与武器。咧嘴狞笑的颅骨、长剑、盾牌与护甲叮当作响，散落在地。生物体内酸蚀性的液体气味灼烧着鼻腔与双眼，但在这令人作呕的内脏里翻找，似乎确实不虚此行。
You wrench a blade through the muscled flesh, and stinking, otherworldly viscera spills. Skeletal remains vomit forth as well, stripped of their flesh but still bearing defensive clothing and weapons. Grinning skulls, swords, shields, and armor clatter to the floor. The acidic scent of the creature’s internal fluids burns the nose and eyes, but sifting through the repulsive guts does seem to be worth your while.

Enchanter Academy Clock Prediction.name:
附魔师学院：时钟预言
Enchanter Academy Clock Prediction

Text.text:
钟面以太阳般的节奏绕着它所安置的高塔缓缓巡行。它呈羊皮纸的淡色，五根黑色指针如书页上的书法花丝般纤巧。最长的一根指向当月的日期，最短的一根则指向某位学生的名字——那名字会在指针所指之处自行浮现，仿佛被无形之手写在钟面上。接下来的短短片刻里，会有某件带着魔法意义的事发生在那名学生身上，或由他施展完成。随后名字消散无踪，转瞬即逝的预言便被抛在刚刚过去的现在里。
The clock face travels at the pace of the sun around the tower on which it is set. It is the color of parchment, with five black hands filigreed like calligraphy on a page. The longest points to the day of the month, and the shortest to the name of a student, which magically writes itself on the face at the hand’s point. In the following few moments, something magically significant happens to, or is performed by, that student. Then the name disappears, its ephemeral prediction lost in the immediate past.

兄弟般的大海与天空彼此厮杀。谁会先一步抢滩上岸？浪涛挥出白冠的上勾拳，狂飑扯拽海洋的头发。每一簇火焰都被溺死。陆生动物不是藏匿就是惊惶奔逃，植物则向裹挟污秽与咸水的刮骨狂风俯首投降。横飞如霰、轰鸣如炮的弹雨撕碎一切——从树冠到石南。
Siblings, ocean and sky, fight each other. Who will be first to shore? Waves throw whitecap uppercuts. Squalls pull the ocean’s hair. Every fire is drowned. Land animals hide or panic, and plants surrender to a scouring wind of filth and saltwater. The roar and hail of horizontal shot shreds everything from treetop to heather.
