Subterranean Lava Whirlpool.name:
地下熔岩漩涡
Subterranean Lava Whirlpool

Text.text:
仿佛熔岩翻涌的灼热还不够致命，眼前这片巨大的岩浆池竟开始旋转——在岩石围困之中无休无止地螺旋回卷——宛如公海上的巨型漩涡。你只能由衷祈祷这只是自然异象，而不是某个庞大无比的生物正潜游于其深处。
As if the thick heat from the molten rock weren’t dangerous enough, the massive pool of lava spins—spiraling endlessly in its rocky confines—in much the same way as a whirlpool on the high seas. It is your fervent hope that this is a natural phenomenon and not being caused by an immense creature swimming in its depths.

Killing Player With Digital Feedback Dam.name:
用数字反馈伤害击杀玩家
Killing Player With Digital Feedback Damage

Text.text:
穿越网络空间，黑云凝聚成团，一只自瘴雾中伸出的手猛然朝你探来。你正遭受攻击；你的盾牌顶得住吗？黑暗之手如群潮般裹住你，猛击你的赛博护盾。看起来你还能撑住……可下一刻，你的防御碎裂崩解。那只手化作一团耀眼的数据洪流，遮蔽你的视野，直射向你的中枢皮层。那是你此生最璀璨、最极致的痛楚。然后，一切归于虚无。你的身体在现实空间里像破布娃娃般瘫折。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Through cyberspace, dark clouds coalesce, and a hand from the miasma jolts toward you. You are under attack; can your shields hold? The dark hand swarms you, beating against your cyber shield. It looks as though you can hold… but then your defenses shatter. The hand becomes an overwhelming mass of glittering data, obscuring your sight, shooting toward your central cortex. There is the most brilliant pain you have ever experienced. And then nothing. Your body folds in real space like a rag doll.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Hallucinogenic Street Drug, Eros: Ingest.name:
致幻街头毒品「爱欲（Eros）」：口服
Hallucinogenic Street Drug, Eros: Ingested

Text.text:
这一口如液态的吻沿着喉间奔流而下，你的瞳孔随之扩张，旅程就此启航。迷醉的柔和感将你裹住——厄洛斯，诺瓦可卡因的孪生子，踮着脚尖潜入你的心智，细微的幻觉在意识边缘起舞。抑制感蒸发殆尽，取而代之的是一阵魅力觉知的潮涌——与神性自信共舞的一支探戈。感官如可触的回声般闪烁颤鸣，使你陷入高悬的诱惑与久久不散的狂喜之中。
The hit courses down your throat like a liquid kiss, your pupils dilating as you begin your voyage. A euphoric mellowness engulfs you as Eros, a twin of Novacoke, tiptoes through your mind and subtle hallucinations dance at the edges of consciousness. Inhibitions evaporate, replaced by a surge of charismatic awareness, a self-assured tango with the divine. Sensations shimmer like tangible echoes, leaving you in a state of lofty allure and a lingering ecstasy.

Highland Games, The Dinnie Steens.name:
高地运动会：丹尼巨石
Highland Games, The Dinnie Steens

Text.text:
两块粗砺的花岗岩巨石，上面各嵌着一只沉重的铁环，总重量超过三百磅。规则很简单：双手各抓住一只环把巨石提起，然后行走。胜者双腿如树干般粗壮，手臂几乎有腿那么粗，关节仿佛对疼痛与折断都毫不在意——于是这一切在他眼里轻而易举。
Two rough granite rocks with rings sunk into them, and a combined weight of more than three hundred pounds. The task is simple: lift the rocks by their rings, one in each hand, and walk. With legs the size of tree trunks, arms the size of legs, and joints that seem impervious to pain or breakage, the winner makes it look easy.

Crackling Depths.name:
噼啪作响的深渊
Crackling Depths

Text.text: 噼啪作响的声音自这道裂谷深处传来，在峭壁间回荡，其间夹杂着仿佛坠落石块般的哗啦撞击声。偶尔还会浮起柔和、脉动般的颤鸣，有时更会间歇传出blorps般的怪响。阴云密布的白昼所投下的昏暗光照，在坑底深处的某个表面上闪烁摇曳。 Crackling sounds come from deep within this chasm, echoing off the cliffs, punctuated by a clattering like falling stones. A soft, pulsing warbling also emerges on occasion, along with sporadic blorps. The dim light from the cloudy day shimmers on a surface deep in the pit.

The Overlord Curse.name:
霸主诅咒
The Overlord Curse

Text.text:
你指向你的目标，高声喊出那句命令之词，他便挺直站立，双眼微微失神，却仍倔强不屈。你命他走路时，他起初踉跄，额头上沁出细密汗珠；但走出几步后，他便依你所愿，步履渐稳，走向任何你指示的地方。也许是去为你端上晚餐，或递来一杯饮品。也许是走向火焰，或迈向悬崖边缘。
You point at your target and shout the word of command, and he stands straight, eyes slightly glazed-over but defiant. Told to walk, he lurches at first, beads of sweat breaking on his forehead, but after a few steps he walks more smoothly wherever you wish. Perhaps to serve you dinner or bring you a drink. Perhaps toward a fire, or a precipice.

Corrie Edgecliff The Lightfoot Halfling.name:
科里·埃奇克利夫——轻足半身人盗贼
Corrie Edgecliff The Lightfoot Halfling Thief

Text.text:
尽管这位半身人的移动轻快灵活，她那双绿色眼睛却投来一记公事公办的目光。她的皮革护甲似乎用某种油脂浸润过，好让移动不受束缚；护甲上缝着不止几个小袋，大小与形状都恰到好处，正适合装些讲究的小玩意儿——一瓶酸液、一袋滚珠轴承，或是一把铁制门钉。你看不见任何武器，可你敢拿巨龙的宝库打赌：她身上至少藏着三把匕首和一支吹箭筒，甚至还不止这些。

~ 由 RPGBOT.net 的 Tyler 扮演

Though her movements are lively and quick, the halfling’s green eyes give you a look that’s all business. Her leather armor, softened with some sort of oil to keep a free range of movement, has more than a few pouches built into it, the right size and shape to hold particulars such as a vial of acid, a bag of ball bearings, or a handful of iron door spikes. Though you cannot see any weapons, you would wager a dragon’s hoard that she has at least three daggers and a blowgun concealed on her person, if not more.

~ Played by Tyler from RPGBOT.net

Scholarly Bard.name:
博学的吟游诗人
Scholarly Bard

Text.text:
一名吟游诗人身披蒙尘的皮衣，坐在遗迹饱经时代侵蚀的墙前。他低声哼唱，目光游移，扫过石上镌刻的、早被遗忘的文字。随着歌声起伏，他的眼眸闪烁着奥秘的微光，明灭如律。蘸笔入墨，他开始在书页上誊写，将古老的智慧译成当代的语言。
A bard in dusty leathers sits before the timeworn wall of a ruin. They hum to themselves, their gaze roving over a forgotten script etched into the stone. Their eyes flicker with an arcane light in time with their song. Dipping their quill into a pot of ink, they begin scribing text onto the page of a book, translating the ancient wisdom into a modern tongue.

Fertile Mountain Valley.name:
丰饶山谷
Fertile Mountain Valley

Text.text:
群山在绿意笼罩的山谷两侧陡然拔起。河流如脉络般穿行于低地，即使远望也闪烁着光芒；沿着河岸，一簇簇建筑坐落其间，四周是起伏连绵的农作田野。
The mountains rise steeply on either side of the green-shrouded vale. Rivers vein the lowlands, gleaming even from a distance, and on their banks stand clusters of buildings surrounded by rolling fields of crops.

Track-loaded Blunderbuss.name:
装填轨道式喇叭枪
Track-loaded Blunderbuss

Text.text:
枪管如同黄铜喇叭般张扬，两侧各装着一条精巧的链式导轨，延伸连接至枪尾处的道具机匣。扣下触发后，发条机括便从枪托内部牵引火药与弹丸，倾落入膛室。机件低沉而缓慢地咆哮运作，等待显得漫长，但最终的效果令人震撼——枪口与击锤锁间猛地喷出一团呛人的黑烟。
The barrel, like a brass trumpet, is mounted on each side by a fine chain track that connects to a gear unit at the breach. When the trigger is pulled, a clockwork mechanism pulls powder and shot from inside the stock and drops it into the chamber. The action growls slowly, and the wait seems long, but the end result is impressive—including the choking puff of black smoke from the barrel and hammer lock.

Desert Valley Pyramid.name:
沙漠谷金字塔
Desert Valley Pyramid

Text.text:
你难以想象建起这座金字塔要付出怎样的苦役：拖拽巨石，将高耸的结构一层层垒上这座干旱的山丘。即便到了如今，数个世纪过去，它依旧巍然挺立，迎着狂风烈日，也能扛住偶尔袭来的季风暴雨。曾经涂绘在这些砂岩砖上的色彩几乎尽数剥落，但你仍能想见，它当年必定壮丽得令人屏息。
You can’t fathom the toil of erecting this pyramid: hauling the stone and raising the structure atop an arid hill. Even now, centuries later, it stands strong and resilient against the wind, the sun, and the occasional monsoon. The paint that once adorned these sandstone bricks is all but flaked off, yet you imagine it once must have been a marvelous sight.

Insult About Death Rattle.name:
关于临终喉音的侮辱
Insult About Death Rattle

Text.text:
“神祇在上，就连他们临死前的喘鸣都令人厌恶。”
“By the gods, even their death rattle sounds obnoxious.”

I Cast Greater Restoration From My Neckl.name:
我从祈祷念珠项链中施放了高等复原术
I Cast Greater Restoration From My Necklace Of Prayer Beads

Text.text:
我握着的那颗珠子所供给的能量，足以榨干最强健的祭司。每当我呼唤它的魔法，它便脉动不止，仿佛下一瞬就要从我掌心挣脱。它所追索的状态直指受害者的根本——生命力的精髓——而这枚护符却牢牢攫住那东西，将其一丝丝抽离。
The energy supplied by the bead I hold would deplete even the strongest of priests. It pulses as I call upon its magic, threatening to spring from my grip. The condition it seeks goes to the root of the afflicted, the essence of vitality, and yet this charm takes hold of it and draws it out.

Conscripted Ghost Warriors.name:
被征召的幽灵战士
Conscripted Ghost Warriors

Text.text:
亡者复生的战士们如一抹半透明的青银幻影，仿佛被刻在空气之上。他们的形体精确无误：肩甲上的每一道灼痕、织物的每一缕纹理，都清晰到纤毫毕现。一名幽灵（特征）的头颅向前耷拉，仅靠脊柱相连；另一名的护甲多处被劈开，裂口间可见撕裂的肌肉组织。他们低声哀号，乞求宽恕，乞求最终的休息。

~ 构想：Bangalulu

The warriors of the revenant dead are a translucent mirage of greenish silver, as if etched upon the air. Their forms are exact, each blaze on a pauldron or fabric texture visible in fine detail. One ghost’s head hangs forward, attached only by its spine. Another’s armor is hacked open in several places, ripped muscle tissue visible in the cuts. They moan, begging forgiveness and final rest.

~ Envisioned by Bangalulu

雪松木曼陀林宽阔的琴背上绘着一幅球形世界地图：宝石蓝的海洋与葱郁绿意的陆地，在抛光雪松温润的底色上鲜活夺目。自鎏金音孔处，数道金色日辉被描绘成光带倾泻而下，落在那被绘出的世界表面时逐渐变得通透，却依旧闪耀如屑，层层流淌。你看得出，这份微光并非只是撒了金粉的颜料把戏。琴声越响，日光越盛，仿佛脉动般涌动得更明亮；当指尖轻拨弦线，光芒便随之黯淡，柔柔收敛。
The wide bowl of the cedarwood mandolin is painted with a spherical map of the world, its sapphire-blue oceans and lush green land vibrant against the warm tone of polished cedar. Golden bands of painted sunlight streak down from the gilded sound hole, becoming transparent yet still glittering as they cascade over the face of the painted world. You see there is more to their shimmer than a mere trick of gold-flecked paint. The sunbeams surge, becoming brighter, as louder notes are played on the instrument, and dim as the strings are softly plucked.

Loot From A Barghest Rider.name:
来自巴盖斯特骑手的战利品
Loot From A Barghest Rider

Text.text: 兽肩胛之间，一枚巨大的圆形银金镀板搭扣将挽具的皮带扣在一起。这枚搭扣也可当作斗篷别针佩戴，价值 20 枚银金币。搭扣上刻着一幅粗陋的狼头图案，其上方以地精语刻着短句 ony membrz。 There is a large, round electrum-plate clasp that holds the straps of a harness together between the beast’s shoulders. The clasp, which can also be worn as a cloak pin, is worth 20 electrum pieces. Engraved over the rudimentary image of a wolf’s head, in goblin, is the phrase ony membrz.

Taunt From A Dragon About Stories.name:
巨龙对故事的嘲讽
Taunt From A Dragon About Stories

Text.text:
“我还记得那些领主与大军曾争相要取我性命。可如今，他们竟只派来一群衣衫褴褛的匪徒乌合之众。他们的恐惧竟已淡到如此地步？等我杀了你们，我就得让他们重新想起来。”
“I remember when lords and armies sought to slay me. But now they send some ragged troupe of brigands. Has their terror faded so completely? After I kill you, I will have to remind them.”

较弱的幻象只是遮掩，而施放这个法术时，你却像在进行真正的创世。你所梦见的一切——任何景致、任何建筑——都会具现成形：一座玻璃城堡，一片糖果花园，一尊由纯金铸成、献给你自己的纪念碑。这就是神祇的感受吗？无穷的可能性让你头晕目眩，逼得你重新把心神拉回法术的词句与手势，以及你施放它的真正目的。
Lesser illusions disguise, but casting this spell feels like an act of true creation. Any landscape, any structure you dream up materializes—a castle of glass, a candy garden, a monument made to yourself out of solid gold. Is this what gods feel? Your head swims with possibilities, forcing you to refocus on the words and gestures of the spell, and your purpose for casting it.

这头阴影中的生物令人难以置信——哪怕你亲眼看见它那利维坦般的巨躯，也仍觉像在做梦。它比同类的任何巨龙都更为庞大；墨黑的血肉紧绷地覆在锋利而棱角分明的骨架上，关节与脊背处骨突如刀锋般刺出。阴影将它的形体层层裹住，自它身上逸散出烟雾般的缕缕黑丝；尽管体量惊人，它却以一种异界的速度与优雅移动。那对膜翼紧紧收拢贴在身侧，展开恐怕足有百尺之广。它发出一声带着轻蔑的嘶嗤，腐蚀性的唾液溅落，令近处的表面瞬间沸腾起泡；这龙形生物以漆黑如煤的双眼俯视着你，那眼中仿佛燃着幽暗的黑焰。

~ Requested by Dung Beetle

The shadowy creature defies belief, even as you look upon its leviathan form with your own eyes. This dragon dwarfs others of its kind, with inky flesh stretched taut over sharp, angular bones that emerge as blade-like protrusions at the joints and along the spine. Shadows enshroud its form, wisping from it in smoke-like tendrils, and despite its immense mass, it moves with an otherworldly speed and grace. The membranous wings, folded tight against its frame, would likely span a hundred feet. With a sneering hiss that sends caustic saliva to boil upon nearby surfaces, the draconic creature looks upon you with jet-black eyes that seem to blaze with dark flame.

~ Requested by Dung Beetle

Ruins Of A Citadel.name:
要塞废墟
Ruins Of A Citadel

Text.text:
这类地方自有一种浪漫——仿佛城堡遗存本身，就是为它曾庇护过的世世代代立起的一座集体墓碑。而眼前这一座，尤显惊艳。主楼大半仍屹立不倒，从岬角之巅向你亮出坚硬的面孔；但后墙几乎已尽数坍塌，像是腹腔被剖开，内脏沿着崖壁倾泻而下，断裂楼层的肋骨在其中裸露森然。
There’s a kind of romance to such places—as though what remains of the citadel acts as a collective tombstone for all the generations it protected. This one seems a particularly stunning example. Much of the keep still stands, showing you a strong face from atop the promontory, but the rear wall has almost entirely fallen away, spilling its guts down the cliffside and revealing the ribs of broken floors within.

Interior Of A Necrotic Spaceship.name:
死灵飞船内部
Interior Of A Necrotic Spaceship

Text.text:
一团令人毛骨悚然的混合体在踏入飞船内部者面前脉动：跳动的金属与异界能量纠缠交融。仿佛一步踏入虚空本身，生与死的界线在此糊成一幅腐朽的噩梦幻景。这里，由多艘飞船拼合而成的各色文化、信条与设计理念彼此冲撞，走廊与通道喧嚣杂糅，毫无章法可循。许多原本光洁冰冷的金属墙面，如今却扭动着搏动的脉络，渗出病态的绿色与紫色能量——它们从飞船的心脏深处辐射而来。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

A macabre amalgamation of pulsing metal and otherworldly energy awaits those who venture into the spaceship’s interior. It is alike to stepping into the void itself, where boundaries between life and death blur into a nightmarish vision of decay. Here, the various cultures, creeds, and design philosophies of each conglomerated ship merge into a cacophonous blend of hallways and corridors with little rhyme or reason. Many walls, once sleek and metallic, now writhe with pulsating veins of sickly green and purple energy, which emanates from the very heart of the ship.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The Infidius Scepter.name:
不信之权杖
The Infidius Scepter

Text.text:
这件物品独特之处在于，它将魔杖、法杖与宝珠的魔法韵味融为一体。它长三英尺，握柄为青铜。握柄顶端雕成向外翻卷的华丽涡纹，宛如托座般安放着宝珠；宝珠由虹彩珊瑚制成，与一截珊瑚茎相连，珊瑚茎没入杖身之中。握柄底端同为青铜，珊瑚茎自此处再度浮现；其上铸满令人目眩的海豚、鲸与鲨，仿佛在魔法的律动中游弋、腾跃不息。
This item is unique in that it combines the magical flavors of wand, staff, and orb. It is three feet long, with a bronze handle. The top of the handle is sculpted into flaring curls that act as a setting for the orb, which is made of rainbow coral connected to a coral stem that disappears into the shaft. The bronze bottom of the handle, from which the coral stem reappears, is cast into a dizzying number of dolphins, whales, and sharks, all swimming and jumping in magical motion.

Cyberpunk Metropolis Setting.name:
赛博朋克大都会设定
Cyberpunk Metropolis Setting

Text.text:
这座城市绵延数百英里，宛如一条被严密规训的山脉。成簇的中世纪现代风摩天楼环拥着一座花岗岩金字形神塔，顶层阶梯覆着带色的防弹玻璃。巨大的圆形平台与空气泊位上，那些经过完美计算的楔形结构之中，蓝白色引力井刺破灰色云层掩蔽；每一道光束都缠绕着全息空中交通指引与登乘信息。沿岸海水拍打着水泥海堤——弯折的钢筋如同一连串复合性骨折般探出——码头在文明的黑暗边缘耸立，俯瞰着一团团随波起伏的垃圾。

飞行车沿着不可见的轨迹穿梭，越过海岸落日的天空；夕照点燃了西侧上万座玻璃高楼的立面。车辆的追踪灯与下方逐一点亮的灯泡相互映照——公寓窗格、街头亭台——像黑影幢幢的楼宇之下游动的生物荧光鱼群。小巷霓虹忽明忽暗地苏醒——坠笼门后是湿件商贩、皮肤改造馆与智能药剂的推手。人群成小团移动：紧身渔网袜、棱角分明的塑料夹克，黑西装与细黑领带，沾着沙尘的皮革与护目镜。无名的店铺蜷伏在有名的公寓楼下。哥特铁门夹拥着棺材旅店，其上方是多元化巨型企业朦胧的平流层标识——统治阶级。

林荫大道弥漫着油腻街食、合成蛋白、乙炔、可吸食物、变压器短路的臭氧，以及五千年人口膨胀带来的熟汗与辛烈古龙水的阵阵喷吐。有人把她的雷朋同步到钛合金手臂上的OLED面板。至少十几种语言充满街面，又从摩托、踏板车与车窗间漂出，像丛林鸟群的叫声。一名出租车司机向一个罕见的警察低语；那警察重装护甲，抬眼望向全息景观化的中央隔离带，露出吸血鬼（特征）般的红眼与夜之微笑。

~ 由 A Hero Envisioned

The city stretches for hundreds of miles, like a regulated mountain range. Clusters of mid-century modern skyscrapers surround a granite ziggurat, its upper tiers plated with tinted, bullet-proof windows. On massive circular platforms and aero-lots of perfectly engineered wedges, blue-white gravity wells puncture the gray cloud cover, each beam laced with holographic air traffic directions and boarding information. Coastal waters lap against a cement seawall—bent rebar emerging like a series of compound fractures—where the piers loom over clusters of bobbing trash at the dark edge of civilization.

Aerocars follow invisible trajectories, crossing a sky of a coastal sunset that fires the western faces of ten thousand glass high-rises. The cars’ tracking lights mirror the bulbs that spark to life below, in apartment windows and street kiosks, like bioluminescent fish under the dark shadows of buildings. The neon of the alleys flickers into life—wetware dealers behind crash cage doors, derm joints, and smartdrug pushers. People move in small packs. They wear skinny fishnets and angular plastic jackets, black suits and thin black ties, desert-dusted leathers and goggles. Shops without names nestle below apartments with names. Goth-iron gates bracket the coffin hotels overseen by the vague stratospheric logos of diversified corporations—the ruling class.

The boulevard smells of greasy street food, synthetic proteins, acetylene, smokables, shorting transformer ozone, and the ripe sweat and puffs of sharp cologne that come from five millennia of population growth. Someone syncs her Ray Bans to an OLED panel on her titanium arm. At least a dozen languages fill the streets and float from motorcycles, scooters, or car windows, like the voices of jungle birds. A cab driver whispers to a rare cop, heavily armored, who looks up the holographically landscaped median with the red eyes and night smile of a vampire.

~ Envisioned by A Hero

Sign Language Interpreter In Court Of No.name:
贵族法庭的手语译员
Sign Language Interpreter In Court Of Nobility

Text.text:
贵族总能挑出最上乘的人选，而那位口译者以迅疾而利落的手势证明这一点。对聆听演说者的魅力互动，连听得见的人也被牵引了目光——他们为译语的优雅与高效而着迷。在旗帜之间、吟游诗人之间、以及盛装华服的廷臣之间，口译者将宫廷的尊严抬升得更高。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The nobility find the best, and the interpreter proves it with swift, deft sign. Charismatic engagement with those listening to the address draws the attention of even the hearing, fascinated at the elegance and efficiency of the interpretation. Among the banners, bards, and the courtiers in all their finery, the interpreter elevates the dignity of court.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

这种生物几乎在各方面都酷似巨龙，唯独体型只有一匹强壮战马那么大。它有着爬行类的身躯——覆着暗淡的绿色鳞片——四肢生爪，长长的尾巴与颈项，以及强健的、皮革般的巨翼。它的头部长着角、颈褶、獠牙与幽暗的眼睛。然而那双眼里闪烁的，不止是野兽的狡黠，更有超越其上的灵光；巨龙以猫科般的骄矜姿态昂然自持。
This creature resembles greater dragons in almost every way, except it is only the size of a powerful horse. It has a reptilian body—scaled in dull green—four clawed limbs, a long tail and neck, and mighty, leathery wings. The head has horns, frills, fangs, and dark eyes. Those eyes, though, have the light of more than animal cunning in them, and the dragon holds itself with feline pride.

Creepy Black Cat.name:
诡异黑猫
Creepy Black Cat

Text.text:
寻常猫的凝视，对它而言几乎只是眨眼。它会把目光拖得很长，盯着画作或古董——那是它从垃圾桶的鸡骨堆里挑出来的。也会与站在上方的人进行令人不安的目光交锋。它坐着时，前爪并拢，俯身凑近熟睡之人的脸，那一刻仿佛显出某种庄严的意识。猫无声地离开一处，在一道阴影的折角里消失，又无声地从别处现身。
The stare of a common cat is barely a wink to this one. There are the long gazes into paintings or antiques picked from among the chicken bones of a trash can. Disconcerting exchanges with a person standing above. Indications of a dignified consciousness when sitting, paws together, leaning over a sleeping person’s face. The cat leaves one place in silence, vanishes in an angle of shadow, then emerges in silence again.

Steampunk Setting.name:
蒸汽朋克设定
Steampunk Setting

Text.text:
浓雾厚重地压在城上，将整座城市裹进浑浊而迷离的暗影。潮湿的昏光里，巍然的铸造厂回荡着革新的喧嚣——贪婪的炉膛如同远古的神祇索要祭品，以无尽饥渴点燃社会前进的火焰。对上层权贵而言，这是发明与工业的乌托邦黄金年代；可对那些满身煤烟、为他们痉挛般的进步欲望供能的芸芸众生来说，白昼漫长，尽是劳作。变革在这新纪元里从不止息：新奇造物一夜登顶、声名如流星般炽亮，又以惊人的速度坠入无声的黑暗，被更迭、被超越、被遗忘。在这技术辉煌的年代，你将置身何处？你会攀上顶峰，或许让一切变得更好吗？你会以铁腕统治这片土地吗？还是会被命运的巨齿轮碾成无名的尘埃？时钟正在滴答作响……
A dense fog clouds the city, cloaking it in murky, obfuscating shadow. In the humid gloaming, towering foundries resound with the clamor of innovation—as ravenous furnaces demand tribute like primeval gods, their appetites fueling the progress of society. For the upper echelons, this is a utopian golden-age of invention and industry, but for the soot-stained masses powering their apoplectic lust for progress the days are long and filled with toil. Change is constant in this new epoch, as novel inventions enjoy meteoric rises to prominence, then tumble into obscurity with alarming speed as they are surpassed and forgotten. Where will you find yourself in this age of technological splendor? Will you rise to the top, perhaps changing things for the better? Will you rule this land with an iron fist? Or will you be ground into ignominy by the titanic gears of fate? The clock is ticking…

I Throw My Whip Feather Token Toward My.name:
我将鞭索羽徽抛向我的敌人
I Throw My Whip Feather Token Toward My Foe

Text.text: 我掏出那枚覆着苔绿的羽毛筹，像握着剑柄般牢牢攥紧，随即掷出。一声刺耳的裂响震得我肩头一跳，一条由纯黑与暗绿绳索编成的长鞭悬浮在我面前。鞭梢在空中微微战栗，握柄像掠飞的鸟儿般来回摆动，迫不及待要抽打出去。 I pull out the mossy green feather token, holding it firmly as if it were a hilt, then throw it. A piercing crack makes my shoulders jump, and a whip woven of pure black and dark green rope hovers in the air before me. Its tail trembles in the air, the handle shifting to and fro like a flitting bird, eager for lashing.

I Notice A Spirit In The Fireplace.name:
我注意到壁炉里有个灵体
I Notice A Spirit In The Fireplace

Text.text:
我听着壁炉里柴薪噼啪作响，暖融融的热意与跳动的火光把我哄进一阵安宁的恍惚——直到我察觉到一丝异样。跃动的火焰深处，我几乎敢发誓有一双发光的眼睛正回望着我。那里头也许藏着某种异界的生物……
As I listen to the logs pop and crackle in the fireplace, the cozy heat and fluttering blaze lull me into a peaceful trance—until I begin to notice something strange. Within the leaping flames, I could swear a pair of glowing eyes are staring back at me. I think some otherworldly creature might be hiding in there…

Directions From An Untrustworthy Source.name:
来自不可靠线人的指路
Directions From An Untrustworthy Source

Text.text:
“对，对，这条路！我带你去。但听着，这地方危险多得很。只有跟着我才安全。先下那条小通道。很不错的通道。然后向左，从骷髅旁边过去。别理它们，只是装饰。再穿过那些挺锋利的漂亮玩意儿。我们就到了！全都安全。全都开心。然后你给报酬？”
“Yes, yes, the way! I show you. But listen, many dangers in this place. Only with me is safe. First down small passage. Very nice passage. Then left past skeletons. Ignore them, only decorative. Then past pretty sharp things. We are there! All safe. All happy. Then you give reward?”

你祖父当年用来守卫家宅的那种霰弹枪，这把粗陋的武器早已风光不再。弹匣松松垮垮地嵌在枪身里，抵肩时枪托狠狠硌进肩窝，疼得你倒吸一口凉气。击发机构时不时抽搐般一颤，你不禁怀疑：使用这把武器，到底有多安全。

~ 一位英雄的构想

The kind of shotgun owned by your grandfather for home defense, this rudimentary weapon has seen better days. The magazine fits loosely into the main body of the gun, and the stock digs into your shoulder painfully when you brace it. The firing mechanism judders sporadically, and you wonder just how safe it is to use this weapon.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Tark The Lover—a Bawdy Tavern Song.name:
塔克《情郎》——一首荤俗酒馆小调
Tark The Lover—a Bawdy Tavern Song

Text.text:
噢，一位女士与一位领主婚前毫无情意
不，在宫廷、席间、床榻之上，也从未听见一句友善的话。
噢，领民与附庸都知道二人总让天气翻涌如暴风。
直到一位情人以宾客身份加入他们——
      把他们俩一并狠狠干了个痛快！
塔克情人！塔克情人！无人能抗拒塔克情人！

塔克情人从不厌倦马车里的挤撞纠缠，
也不嫌马厩里的撕扯翻滚；好塔克从不贬低
就算那女人毫无姿色、举止粗野得刺人，
塔克情人依旧爱她——
      从不把她推开！
塔克情人！塔克情人！无人能抗拒塔克情人！

塔克情人知晓每位贵族藏在齿间的秘密：
每柄剑都得入鞘，每把匕首都要有鞘衣。
哪怕那绅士又老又佝偻，脖生瘿瘤、满身疹痒，
塔克情人依旧爱他——
      而且做得风流潇洒！
塔克情人！塔克情人！无人能抗拒塔克情人！

塔克情人播了农夫的田，转身又把农夫翻犁得服服帖帖，
把屠夫的肉弄得格外软嫩，把报讯人叫得嗓破声嘶。
塔克情人赏了吟游诗人，也撩拨了酒馆里所有的欢客。
塔克情人遇上几位圣武士——
      如今他们全成了破誓者！
塔克情人！塔克情人！无人能抗拒塔克情人！

塔克情人有一枚魔法戒指，它所施的力量
让男人们旗帜高扬，让女士们裙摆尽落！
所以当你遇见塔克情人，要知道你绝无可能抵挡
他们那枚魔法戒指的蛊惑——
      因为它不戴在手上！
塔克情人！塔克情人！无人能抗拒塔克情人！

O, a Lady and a Lord expressed no love before they wed
no, and not a friendly word was heard at court, or meal, or bed.
O, the lieges and the vassals knew the two made stormy weather.
’Til a lover joined them as a guest—
      and swived them both together!
Tark the Lover! Tark the Lover! No one can resist Tark the Lover!

Tark the Lover never tired of a jostle in a carriage,
nor a tussle in the stable, and good Tark did not disparage
if the woman had no graces, if her manners were too rough,
Tark the Lover loved her anyway—
      and never did rebuff!
Tark the Lover! Tark the Lover! No one can resist Tark the Lover!

Tark the Lover knew the secrets every noble keeps beneath:
eve'ry sword must find a scabbard, ev'ry dagger needs a sheath.
If the gent were old and crooked, with a goiter and a rash,
Tark the Lover loved him anyway—
      and did it with panache!
Tark the Lover! Tark the Lover! No one can resist Tark the Lover!

Tark the Lover sowed the farmer’s field and left the farmer plowed,
made the butcher’s meat so tender, made the crier cry aloud.
Tark the Lover tipped the bard and all the tavern merrymakers.
Tark the Lover met some paladins—
      and now they’re all oathbreakers!
Tark the Lover! Tark the Lover! No one can resist Tark the Lover!

Tark the Lover has a magic ring, the power it exerts
makes the menfolk raise their banners and the ladies shed their skirts!
So when you meet Tark the Lover, know that you cannot withstand
The enchantment of their magic ring—
      not worn upon the hand!
Tark the Lover! Tark the Lover! No one can resist Tark the Lover!

Viking Goliath High Jarl's Throne Room.name:
维京巨人高雅尔王座厅
Viking Goliath High Jarl's Throne Room

Text.text:
你推开沉重的木门踏入其间，原本粗俗喧嚣的大厅瞬间噤声。雪花在你脚边打着旋儿，落在鹅卵石地面上堆成一缕缕雪脊；你步伐笃定，径直向前。体型足有你两倍的战士——皮肤是被磨蚀岩石般的惨灰——咬紧牙关，正要举臂对你发难。然而，领主的一瞥便让他们收敛锋芒。 那巨人般的战士端坐在大厅尽头：一张以鲸牙雕成的高背巨座之上，双手搭在一柄雄浑战斧的斧首。他以冰冷而审视的目光钉住你，你仿佛被整座山峦衡量着你的角色。随手一挥，他示意卫士退开；看来，他至少愿意听你把话说完。

~ Inbal on Discord

The bawdy, raucous hall falls silent as you push open the heavy wooden doors and step inside. Snow swirls around your feet, collecting in drifts on the cobbled floor, as you stride confidently forward. Warriors twice your size—with skin the pallid gray of worn stone—grit their teeth and prepare to raise arms against you. But a glance from the jarl keeps them in line. The gigantic warrior sits at the head of the hall in a large, high-backed throne carved from whale ivory, his hands resting on the head of a mighty battleaxe. He fixes you with a cold, appraising stare and you feel as though the mountain itself is judging your character. Waving a hand, he motions for his guards to stand aside; it seems he will at least hear you out.

~ Inbal on Discord

Temple In Rain.name:
雨中神殿
Temple In Rain

Text.text:
神殿的尖塔在雨幕之后幽灵（特征）般拔地而起。覆着斑驳地衣的石像鬼沿着屋檐边缘蹲伏，将雨水从它们狰狞咧开的巨口中倾泻而下。雕在神殿墙上的面孔挂着秘而不宣的笑意，任水流淌过它们光滑、被时代磨蚀的脸颊。
The spires of the temple rise ghost-like behind a veil of rain. Stone gargoyles, splotched with lichen, perch along the roof’s edge and disgorge runoff from their grimacing maws. Faces carved into the temple walls smile their secret smiles while the water runs over their smooth, time-worn cheeks.

Cemetery With Excavated Graves.name:
有被掘开的墓穴的墓地
Cemetery With Excavated Graves

Text.text:
这片阴郁墓园原本被精心打理的景致，如今却被数个巨大的坑洞撕裂，像伤口般在草坪上狰狞张开。有人耗费了时间与力气，把那些早已安葬多年的坟墓挖掘开来，留下深达六英尺的沟壑。从你此刻的角度，无法判断墓穴是否仍有人躺卧其中——又或者，这些坟墓竟是从内部被挖开的！
The carefully maintained landscape of this gloomy cemetery is marred by several large holes, gaping like wounds in its grassy lawn. Someone has taken the time and effort to excavate well-established graves, leaving six-foot ditches in their wake. From this vantage point, you cannot tell if the graves are still occupied—or if the graves may have been excavated from within!

"

你眯起双眼，敞开感官，去捕捉周遭的超自然力量。

[Fiends] 当你的觉知向外漫涌，硫磺的恶臭与憎恨的灼热扑面而来。数个邪魔潜伏在附近。

[Spell] 你感到一股刺骨的寒意，嗅到被亵渎土地的腥臭。某种不洁之力已将这片区域祝圣。

[Fey] 你搜寻的感官捕捉到空气里轻柔的叮铃回响、春雨的气息，以及一种疏离而异质的存在。妖精就在近旁。

[Undead] 你感到饥渴死亡的冰冷虚空。一缕腐朽的气味钻入鼻腔……亡灵很近。

[Consecrated by Hallow Spell] 这片区域温暖而令人安心，振奋心神。它已被祝圣。

" "

You squint, opening your senses to the supernatural forces around you.

[Fiends] As your awareness flows outward, the reek of brimstone and the heat of hate comes to you. Several fiends lurk nearby.

[Spell] You feel the cold and smell the stench of desecrated ground. Some unholy force has hallowed this area.

[Fey] Your seeking senses catch soft ringing in the air, the smell of spring rain, and an aloof alien presence. Fey are in the vicinity.

[Undead] You feel the cold void of hungering death. A whiff of rot reaches your nose... Undead are close.

[Consecrated by Hallow Spell] This area is warm and welcoming, lifting the spirit. It has been consecrated.

"

Damaged Brigantine In Port.name:
港内受损的布里甘廷护甲
Damaged Brigantine In Port

Text.text:
水手们扛着道具、抬着伤员穿过跳板，边走边低声交谈，努力为这场攻击找出个说法。主桅已折，帆布被割得七零八落；右舷艉栏沿着船身一路崩碎，甲板被血水冲成一片猩红的湿漉。只凭三角帆与前帆，他们竟也勉强撑回了港口。穿过木料的呻吟、急促的口令与含混的嘟囔，你清楚听见两个词：“海怪”和“诅咒”。

~ Envisioned by Steve Adamski

As the sailors carry their gear and their wounded across the gangplank, they talk, trying to make sense of the attack. The main mast is broken, its sails cut away, and the starboard taffrail is shattered along the ship’s length, the deck a bloody wash. They have made it to port on only jib and foresails. Cutting through the groaning, the orders, and the mumbling, you hear the words “kraken” and “cursed.”

~ Envisioned by Steve Adamski

Child's Familiar In Classroom.name:
教室里的孩子魔宠
Child's Familiar In Classroom

Text.text:
女孩坐在整齐排列的课桌前排，眉头因挫败而紧锁，竭力让自己专注于老师的话语。一只小小的恶作剧小妖精蹲在她肩头，攥着迷你卷轴与羽毛笔，勤勉地誊写讲师如行云流水般的长篇训诫，并贴着她尖尖的耳朵低声提醒。挫败转为惊喜，一阵释然的浪潮掠过她的面庞，突如其来的顿悟之光点亮了她好奇的双眼。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The girl sits in the front row of ordered desks, her brow furrowed in frustration as she tries to focus on the teacher’s words. A small imp perches atop her shoulder, holding a tiny scroll and quill, diligently scribing the lecturer’s flowing diatribe and whispering into her pointed ear. Frustration turns to delight, and a wave of relief spreads over her face as a flash of sudden understanding illuminates her curious eyes.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Barlgura On Hunt.name:
狩猎中的巴尔古拉
Barlgura On Hunt

Text.text:
这头恶魔魁梧如猿，獠牙森然、肌肉虬结，披着焦橙色的皮毛，光是现身便令人胆寒。它燃烧般的猩红眼眸满溢憎恨，扫视着环境搜寻猎物；它以前肢庞然的巨臂沉重前行，每一步都在地面刻下深深的印痕。
A hulking, ape-like mass of fangs and muscle clad in burnt-orange fur, the demon is a terrifying sight. Blazing red eyes filled with hatred scan the environment for prey as it lumbers forth on enormous forearms that leave deep prints in the ground.

Automated Piano In Wine Bar.name:
酒吧里的自动钢琴
Automated Piano In Wine Bar

Text.text:
一架钢琴栖在略微抬高的阶段上，木质琴身在冷冽的聚光灯下泛着幽光。一簇簇圆桌像蒲公英花头的绒球般环绕着阶段。衣着体面的宾客摇晃着无柄酒杯，不同的酒液汇成一片斑斓——从传统的深红与紫到夜空般闪烁的蓝，再到氯化泳池般的青绿。机械声骤然切入交谈的流淌与侍者鞋底擦过地毯的轻响。伴着内部齿轮的碾磨，钢琴的键盖猛地向后卷起，谱架闪烁着亮起，露出一块显示屏，上面跳动着绿色、噼啪作响的波形。琴键自行下陷，而从乐器里逸出的不再是寻常的琴音，而是人声。某种丝绸般顺滑的自动化嗓音交织成一段柔和的合唱，哄人沉入恍惚的旋律里。
A piano is perched on a slightly raised stage, its wooden frame glowing under a cool spotlight. A cluster of round tables encircle the stage like the blowball of dandelion head. Well-to-do guests swirl stemless glasses, the different wines a bevy of colors—ranging from traditional deep reds and purples to the twinkling blue of a night sky and the teal of a chlorinated pool. A mechanical sound breaks the flow of chatter and soft shuffle of servers’ feet against the carpet. The piano fallboard reels back with the grinding of internal mechanisms, and the music rack flickers awake, revealing a display with a green, crackling waveform. The keys depress of their own accord and, instead of the notes of a normal piano, voices emit from the instrument. A somehow silken medley of automated voices creates a lulling song.

这名红皮霍布哥布林气势逼人，却又一丝不苟；打理得干净利落的头发被仔细地向后梳起，油亮服帖。他身形高挑瘦削，剪裁合体的西装贴合每一道线条，衬出修长的四肢与宽阔的肩背。右手有几根手指被机械义肢取代，随着他漫不经心地轻叩两把华丽手枪的握把，齿轮与机括发出低低的嗡鸣——一把惨白如骨，另一把漆黑如墨。

~ Played by Akirenvi with

The red-skinned hobgoblin strikes an imposing, well-groomed figure, his well-kept hair carefully slicked back. He’s tall and lean, with a tailored suit hugging every line, accentuating long limbs and broad shoulders. Several fingers on his right hand have been replaced with mechanical prosthetics, whirring with a soft hum as he absently taps the grips of two ornate pistols—one stark white, the other pitch black.

~ Played by Akirenvi with

Giant Boar With Glinting Tusks.name:
獠牙寒光闪烁的巨野猪
Giant Boar With Glinting Tusks

Text.text:
象牙獠牙在昏暗光照中闪着恶意的寒光；野猪步入更清晰的视野时，你先注意到它骇人的体型，继而看见黑色皮肤下钢索般的肌肉起伏绷动。那双审视着你的红眼燃烧着不信任与憎恶，生物显得焦躁不安，蓄势待发。你心知肚明：面对眼前这头庞然巨兽，根本无从讲理。
Ivory tusks glint malevolently in the dim light, and as the boar moves into clearer view, you first notice its immense size, and then the wiry muscles rippling beneath its dark skin. The red eyes that study you burn with distrust and abhorrence, and the creature seems restless, ready to strike. You know that there will be no reasoning with the enormous beast before you.

你一边低声吟诵奥秘咒词、完成繁复的手势，一边感受指间那粗硬的毛皮触感。你高声唤出目标的名字，霎时间感官奔涌而至——你触及到他们的存在，清晰感知到他们所在的准确方向。
You feel the coarse fur between your fingers as you speak the arcane words and complete the intricate gestures. You speak aloud the target's name, and in a rush of sensation, you feel their presence, sensing their exact direction.

Undercroft Of A Manor.name:
庄园地窖
Undercroft Of A Manor

Text.text:
如今的庄园领主将这处下层地窖用作储藏室：地面与墙面一尘不染，油灯挂钩沿着四周均匀分布。这里堆放着旧文书与私人物件——多半除了情感意义外并无价值——被妥善封存，留待后世逐页翻检。
Used as a storage cellar by the current lord of the manor, the undercroft is spotlessly clean, with hooks for oil lamps evenly dispersed throughout. Down here, old documents and personal possessions—mostly without value except for sentiment—have been stored away for future generations to pore over.

你的目标任由你以墓园污泥为其抹净，你绕着他们打转，低声向此世与彼世交界处的守门者呢喃。你最后一声沙哑的号令，将他们的灵魂驱赶到那道幽影边界。生命自其体内抽离，躯壳随即倾倒在地，麻木无知，灰败如烬。
Your subject accepts your smudging of graveyard mud as you circle them, whispering to guardians at the threshold between this life and the next. Your final hoarse command sends their soul to that shadowed boundary. Life leaves their body, which topples to the ground, insensate and ashen.

你那无形的迷魅之网覆落在你所选之人的心智之上，他们如今被迫依照你所指的方向行动，宛如龙棋盘上被推移的一枚枚棋子。
The invisible web of your enchantment lays itself over the minds of those you have chosen, now compelled to move in the directions you have indicated for them like so many pieces across a dragonchess board.

Magmin Encounter.name:
熔岩小魔像遭遇
Magmin Encounter

Text.text:
这个圆滚滚的小家伙皮肤龟裂焦黑，活像个在大火里被烧过的孩子——可这只小恶魔般的存在，仿佛是从体内燃起来的。你注视之际，它咯咯大笑，火焰猛地在它全身窜起，宛如蜡烛的火苗倒着被吹回去一般。
The pudgy little person has cracked, black skin, looking like a child burnt in a fire—but this impish being seems to burn from within. As you watch, it laughs and fire flares up all over its body, like a candle flame being blown out in reverse.

一阵湿黏的咔嚓咀嚼声伴着喋喋碎响，把你引向陵墓更幽暗的深处。黑暗里，有什么东西在蠕动，节肢轻叩作响；你看见一只巨大而骇人的鼓胀昆虫身影，正从一堆新掘出的残骸旁挪开——那是它刚享用过的餐食。它的颚钳咔哒合拢，羽毛般的触须在黑暗中探寻下一顿。它尖啸一声，腐烂与湿土的气息猛然扑面，令人作呕；那条蜈蚣般的生物以惊人的体长将你整个人缠绕起来。

~ Envisioned by Tom

A wet, chattering crunch draws you deeper into the shadowed depths of the tomb. In the darkness, something shifts, legs clicking, and you see the bulbous shape of a massive, ghastly insect leave behind a meal of exhumed remains. The thing clicks its mandibles, feather-like feelers probing the darkness for its next meal. It screeches, and the smell of rot and loam overwhelms you as the centipede-like creature wraps its entire, staggering length around you.

~ Envisioned by Tom

当你走近这座巨大的要塞时，你发现它被直接凿刻在雪冠山脉的山壁上，嵌入一片延展铺开的石墙、塔楼与庭院所构成的庞大建筑群中。主入口是一道巨型铁门，戒备森严；尽管火把在刺骨寒风中摇曳，你仍立刻感到一股冰冷潮湿的空气弥漫在堡垒各处，钻进骨缝。穿过铁门后的第一座庭院广阔而空旷，是训练与对练的区域。你能看见魁梧的兽人挥舞着巨大的战斧与盾牌，另一些则在练习射箭或投掷标枪。庭院一侧有间小型军械库，里面人来人往，正忙着为士兵打造与修补武器和护甲。
Upon your approach to the massive fortress, you notice that it is carved into the side of the snow-capped mountain, built into a sprawling complex of stone walls, towers, and courtyards. The main entrance is a large iron gate, heavily guarded, and you are immediately struck by the cold, damp air that permeates the stronghold despite the torches flickering in the frigid breeze. The first courtyard beyond the gate is an expansive, open area used for training and sparring. Hulking orcs can be seen wielding massive battleaxes and shields, while others practice archery or javelin throwing. A small armory on one side of the courtyard is busy working on weapons and armor for the soldiers.

幼年鳄形生物在浑浊的灰色水中悄然滑行，沿着河道潜行觅猎，几乎难以察觉。硕大的黄色眼睛探出水面——在暮色里只剩一线微光——爬行动物的长吻顶破水皮，鼻孔翕张。它身旁，深水里有更庞大的影子随波漂移，紧紧守在幼崽左右。
Gliding through the murky gray water, the baby crocodilian is almost invisible as it stalks the river. Large yellow eyes peer above the waterline—barely perceptible in the twilight—and a reptilian snout crests the surface with flaring nostrils. Beside it, large shapes drift in the deep waters, staying close to their offspring.

Sign Language Interpreter In Royal Court.name:
皇家宫廷手语译员
Sign Language Interpreter In Royal Court

Text.text:
一名年轻、活力四射的人类在王室法庭附近，将火炬一一围绕着一把孤零零的椅子摆好。集会以法槌接连数声重击开场，那人类随着每一次象征律法的槌击轻轻踏足，让火炬的火光在震颤中闪烁如鳞。待他们坐入椅中，浸在明亮的光里，神情便从欢快的暖意骤然收敛为冷峻的中立。他们面无偏颇，以克制而正式的手势划出精准的弧线，替王室雄辩者译解每一句话。
A youthful, effervescent human arranges torches around a lone chair near the royal court. The assembly begins with several bangs from the gavel, and the human taps their foot to make the torches’ flames glint with every strike of the lawful hammer. Once they sit in their chair, bathed in light, their demeanor changes from a jovial glow to one of stoic neutrality. They begin to use impartial facial expressions and swing their hands in tight formal gestures to interpret the words of the royal orator.

第一名学生尚未到来，教授已坐在书桌前。她起身站定，透过时髦的眼镜注视着学生们鱼贯而入；领带打着一丝不苟的结，白色纽扣衬衫的领口从长袍上缘挺立而出。她省去寒暄，开场便召出三件立体范例——体型加倍——悬浮在教室中央。她的声音轻柔而精准，讲述草药与药液、配比与温度。讲座结束时，她微微一笑。“好了。继续吧。”
The professor is at her desk before the first student arrives. She stands, watching through fashionable glasses as the class enters, a perfect knot in her tie, and the white button-down collar of her blouse standing from the top of her robes. She skips the greeting and begins by conjuring three-dimensional examples—at double-size—which float in the middle of the class. She speaks softly, perfectly, as she describes the herbs and liquids, portions and temperatures. At the end of the lecture she smiles. “There we go. Proceed.”

Assassin Sprite.name:
刺客小妖精（特征）
Assassin Sprite

Text.text:
投送装置的代码呈现出蚊虫的符号形态。它嗅出那条有瑕疵的血管，那道病态的蓝色脆弱线。随后把它淫秽的口器刺了进去。然而它并不啜饮，而是吐出：有毒的生物反馈毒素、抗凝序列、贫血、脱水——伴着虚拟心跳的节律走向死亡。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The delivery device code takes the semiotic form of a mosquito. It sniffs out that flawed vein, the sickly blue line of vulnerability. Then it slips its obscene proboscis in. Instead of drinking, however, it spits. Toxic biofeedback poison, anticoagulant sequences, anemia, dehydration—death to the rhythm of a virtual heartbeat.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

惊人的高温把空气中的一切气味都灼烧殆尽，但你仍不禁猜想，这片浩瀚的熔融岩池下究竟有多少毒气嘶嘶涌上。黑色岩壳开裂，在赤红滚烫的岩浆上缓慢起伏，荡出层层涟漪。明亮的橙色气泡短暂浮起，随即炸裂，溅起的融石在飞散间迅速冷却，化作一片漆黑。
The tremendous heat burns all scent from the air, but you can’t help but wonder what poisonous gasses hiss up through this vast pool of molten stone. A skin of black rock cracks, and ripples slowly, over red-hot lava. Bright orange bubbles briefly rise before exploding to splatter melted stone that cools to blackness as it flies.

Abandoned Elven Village In Cold Weather.name:
寒冷天气中的废弃精灵村落
Abandoned Elven Village In Cold Weather

Text.text:
薄雾在废弃的村庄间游荡，宛如一群迷失的亡魂。大自然已收回了大多数建筑，覆霜的常春藤缠勒着门窗，寸寸堵死。唯有一只乌鸦孤零零停在一尊苔痕斑驳的雕像肩头——那位精灵侍女被刻出的容颜仿佛在啜泣，初雪在她脸上融化成泪。
Mist drifts through the abandoned village like a host of lost souls. Nature has reclaimed most of the structures, frost-daubed ivy choking doors and windows alike. A solitary crow sits upon the shoulder of a moss-stained statue—the carved visage of the elven maid seeming to cry as the first snow melts on her face.

Noble Bullywug.name:
高贵的牛蛙人
Noble Bullywug

Text.text:
这位蛙人面容敞亮而和善。他穿得像个风流的骑士，身披华丽的扇贝纹胸甲，肩上配套的护肩闪着冷光，臂上戴着臂铠，小腿套着护胫，脚踏铠靴。那双钢靴的尖端卷出繁复的弧度。头顶一具耀眼的莫里昂盔，盔顶如浪尖般上挑，与靴尖的卷曲相互呼应。护甲之下，他穿着蓝银相间、明亮的夹棉衣，腿上同样配着相称的紧身裤。他将精致的长戟随意地握着，姿态从容。
This frog-like person has an open, pleasant face. He dresses like a dandy knight in a fancy scalloped breastplate with matching pauldrons on the shoulders, vambraces for his arms, greaves for his lower legs, and sollerets for his feet. These steel shoes end in an elaborate curl. On his head, he sports a shining morion with a top shaped like a cresting wave, echoing the footwear. Underneath his armor, he wears a bright gambeson of blue and silver and matching leggings. He carries his fine halberd in a relaxed way.

此地的棚屋、民宅与商铺尽皆被数寸积雪严严实实地覆住，整座村子看上去宛如裹糖的甜点。凛冽的空气里带着未散的降雪气息，混着一缕缕柴烟。人很容易想象村中旅店壁炉旁的暖意：客人们捧着杯盏，小口啜饮热香酒或其他驱寒的热饮来对抗寒战——而与此同时，村里的孩子们却飞奔向四周的乡野去打雪仗或滑雪橇，冻得通红的脸颊在笑闹中冒出团团白雾，兴奋得像要把寒气也踩碎。
The huts, houses, and businesses of this place are completely covered in inches of snow, making the village look like a sugary confection. The brisk air smells of lingering precipitation tinged with woodsmoke. It is easy to imagine the warmth of the hearth within the village inn, patrons sipping from mugs of mulled wine or other warming concoctions to battle their chills—even as the children of the village dash to the surrounding countryside for snow battles or sledding runs, faces reddened with cold and breath escaping in plumes of steam in their exuberance.

Long Lines Surround Large Fan Convention.name:
长龙环绕大型漫展
Long Lines Surround Large Fan Convention

Text.text:
会展中心外，扩音器把音乐轰得震天响，人头如海，随着节拍起伏摇晃。那座建筑外观与体量都像斗兽场般压迫。发型从精心雕琢、堪称展览级的作品，到乱糟糟、落着头皮屑的发丝不一而足；有人随手扎成松垮的马尾与发髻。外墙嵌着并排的屏幕，轮番播放：今日座谈的日程表；十秒一闪、甩得人脖子发紧的剧集、电影与游戏预告；以及一条真正惹人厌的、会场限定碳酸饮料宣传片。伴随着那条广告里刺耳的伪青春嗓音与狂闪的色块，不知从哪儿喷出一层薄雾，合成黑莓的甜腻与呛人的柠檬酸味覆上你的舌面。
A sea of heads bob to music blaring over loudspeakers outside the convention hall, a building as imposing in look and stature as a colosseum. Hairstyles range from carefully crafted exhibitions to unkempt locks dusted with dandruff, tied back in lazy ponies and buns. Side-by-side screens, built into the exterior, display: a schedule of the day’s panels; ten-second whiplash trailers for shows, movies and video games; and a truly obnoxious promotion for a convention-exclusive fizzy drink. Along with the grating pseudo-adolescent voices and flashing colors of the latter ad, a mist sprays out from some unclear origin, and the taste of synthetic blackberries and stinging lemon coats your tongue.

这间宽阔的地窖，是这户人家存放财富的所在。酒、食物与宝藏堆成一座宝库；玻璃容器中的魔法火焰为此地照明，将金色的光辉洒在箱柜、木桶与玻璃瓶上。这里的葡萄酒已沉睡数十年，腌渍蔬菜的陶罐与块根蔬菜、风干肉并排存放。再往里，一排排箱子紧闭着，上着挂锁。就连最富有的半身人也以善于把宝藏藏得不露痕迹而闻名，那么这些精致的木箱里所藏之物，必定价值连城。

~ ~ 特约作者 Sadie Lowry

The expansive cellar is where this family stores its wealth. A trove of wines, foods, and treasure, the cellar is lit by enchanted flames in glass containers, which throws a golden glow over the chests, barrels, and glass bottles. The wines date back decades, and there are jars of pickled vegetables stored alongside root vegetables and dried meat. Beyond them, rows of chests are closed and padlocked. Since even the wealthiest halflings are known to hide their treasures from view, whatever lies inside the elegant wooden chests must be very valuable indeed.

~ ~ Guest Writer Sadie Lowry

当你施放这道防护系法术时，你将死亡想象成一扇门。它矗立着，巨大而漆黑，像对一切生者那样豁然敞开，深不见底。死亡是生命与彼岸诸界之间的门槛；只要你还活着，它便始终开着。你甚至能像沉睡中的梦行者那样，跨过它的门槛一步。但死亡会在灵魂身后猛然将门摔上。借由此法术，你把脚趾卡进门缝，硬生生将它顶住——至少，能撑上一小会儿。
As you cast this abjuration, you envision death as a doorway. It stands, huge and black, yawning open as it does for all things while they live. Death is the gateway between life and the worlds beyond; while you live, it lies open. You can even step across its threshold, as dreamers do in sleeping. But death slams the door shut behind souls. With this spell you stick your toe in the door to jam it open—at least for a little while.

Royal Tomb Of Two Kings.name:
双王御陵
Royal Tomb Of Two Kings

Text.text:
墓室内石制卧像上刻出的面容，属于王室血脉的两位国王；他们并排安放，仿佛生前相依而卧。陵寝装饰的华美，既映照出他们至高无上的尊位，也映照出他们彼此的深情。一整块厚重的抛光大理石板覆在共用的棺椁之上——它既是纪念碑，也是不容撼动的阻障。
The countenances represented on the stone effigies within the tomb are those of two kings of the royal line, laid side by side as they were in life. The splendor of the tomb’s decorations are reflective of their highest of stations as well as of their love. A heavy slab of polished marble, monument as much as immovable obstacle, covers the shared coffin.

Luxury Pre-packed Meal.name:
奢华预制餐
Luxury Pre-packed Meal

Text.text:
当包装上的封条被撕开时，一个尖细的声音随即响起：“祝您用餐愉快！”新裂开的缝隙里嘶嘶冒出蒸汽，裹着新鲜温热的食物香气扑面而来。更绝的是，一把叉子和一把餐刀把手朝前弹了出来，迫不及待地要提供它们的服务。
When the seal on the packaging is broken, a tinny voice calls out: "Enjoy your meal!" Steam hisses from the new openings, carrying the scent of fresh, warm food. To top it all off, a fork and knife spring out handle-first, eager to offer their services.

Orbital Civilian Checkpoint: Customs.name:
轨道平民检查站：海关
Orbital Civilian Checkpoint: Customs

Text.text: 一个身形庞大的外星人被塞进那间有机玻璃隔间里，身上那套褶皱的蓝色制服被挤得更皱。隔间上写着 海关，周围用令人眼花缭乱的多种语言标注。柜台前排着一条漫长的队伍，乘客们蜿蜒向远处延伸，人人焦躁地摆弄着手指，等待轮到自己的回合。 A large alien in a creased blue uniform has been stuffed into the plexiglass cubicle marked Customs in a dizzying array of languages. A long queue of passengers snakes away from the desk, all of them anxiously fidgeting as they await their turn.

Exploration Base Camp.name:
探索 基地营地
Exploration Base Camp

Text.text:
一支探索队在中央大帐篷周围搭起帐篷，围成粗略的圆环。有些队员像是身经百战的冒险者，正整理求生道具与考古工具，或给健壮的挽马套上鼻袋；另一些队员则更像学者，翻阅成册的笔记，或用复杂的黄铜仪器测量四周的地形。
An exploration team has pitched tents in a rough circle around a central pavilion. Some team members appear to be seasoned adventurers, preparing survival gear and archeological tools or affixing nose bags to the muzzles of hardy draft horses. Other team members appear to be scholars, consulting volumes of notes or surveying the surrounding terrain with complex brass instruments.

Intervention Before A Brawl Begins.name:
斗殴爆发前的介入
Intervention Before A Brawl Begins

Text.text:
“不，不行，今天免谈。要算账就换个地方，或者换种法子，我说。要不就都冷静点。把拳头松开，好好动动脑子，你们这些原始人。”
“Nope, no, not today. Settle it somewhere else or by some other way, I say. Or calm yourselves. Unclench and think, you primitives.”

Capital City In A Lawful Kingdom.name:
守序王国的王都
Capital City In A Lawful Kingdom

Text.text:
晶莹的尖塔自宏伟港湾的苍白大理石城墙上拔地而起，流光溢彩；阳光在其上折射出耀眼的光舞，与午后微风中轻拍岸堤的浪纹倒影交织成一片。海鸟的聒噪声与高处的钟鸣相互掺和，回荡在城市中央那座巍峨要塞的上空。垛口森严的城墙与一座巨大而压迫感十足的吊桥占据了建筑外侧的全部视线，披着闪亮护甲的武装卫兵在城垛上巡逻。整座城市井然如刻，整齐划一，每一块白色大理石都被精准地安放在应有的位置。

~ 构想：Capsboy119

Gleaming spires rise in iridescent glory above the pale marble of the grand harbor walls, the sun reflecting from them in a dazzling play of light that mingles with other reflections from waves gently lapping in the afternoon breeze. The cawing of sea birds mingles with bells chiming high above the grand fortress at the center of the city. Crenellated walls and a massive, imposing drawbridge dominate the structure’s outward face, and armed guards patrol in shining armor atop the battlements. The entire city is ordered and uniform, each white marble block perfectly placed.

~ Envisioned by Capsboy119

Elderly Dwarven Woman's Boast.name:
年迈矮人老妇的夸口
Elderly Dwarven Woman's Boast

Text.text:
一道苍白的伤疤从她的太阳穴蜿蜒而下，穿过眼睛，止于锁骨。那道伤让一侧眼皮沉沉下垂，嘴角也被拽成一抹不悦的阴沉。可她完好的那只眼睛，深浓得像刚翻起的沃土，却闪着明快的笑意。她的嘴唇扭成一条歪斜的弧线——那便是她的笑容。“别害怕，亲爱的。划伤我的那恶魔，早在一百年前就死透埋好了！多亏我那把战镐的狠毒一口。”她的手在腰间的皮带上方停住，像是在抓握一件早已不在的武器。她自个儿低低笑了笑，手指一蜷，把手稳稳落在胯上。她的目光渐渐飘远、游离——带着对冒险的怀念。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

A pale scar trails from her temple, through her eye, and ends at her clavicle. The wound has caused one eyelid to hang heavily and her mouth to downturn into a scowl. Her good eye, as rich and dark as freshly turned soil, twinkles with good cheer. Her mouth winds into a crooked line—her smile. “Don’t be frightened, dearie. The fiend who nicked me has been dead and buried for a hundred years! Thanks to the nasty bite of my war pick.” Her hand hovers over the belt at her waist, as if grasping for a weapon no longer there. She chuckles to herself and curls her hand to set it on her hip. Her look grows distant, wandering—nostalgic for adventure.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

吟诵持续整整一小时。结束时，你将指尖轻轻点在那具已被细致清洗、妥善准备的亡者遗体额头上。随着你的接触，你召唤死者灵魂的再生；你法术的纯粹威能自虚无的以太中塑形，编织出一具全新的、却又截然不同的躯体。
The chant lasts for a full hour, and at its conclusion you place your fingertip on the forehead of the carefully washed and prepared body of the deceased. With your touch, you beckon the rebirth of the dead being’s soul, the sheer power of your spell crafting a new, but different, body out of nothing but ether.

空气里弥漫着硫磺味——又叠着一股令人作呕的霉烂与霉菌混杂的气息——酸湿浓重，几乎让人难以呼吸。沼泽里平静的水洼在月光下泛着幽光，明明浅薄，你却忍不住把它们想成无底深渊。水面之下潜伏着什么？又有什么恐怖正等着攥住你的靴子，把你猛地拽下去……拽下去，沉入黑暗？脚下浸透的泥地每一步都在吮吸你的靴底，却丝毫无法打消你的忧惧。
The air smells sulfurous—overlaid with an unpleasant mingling of mildew and mold—thick with acrid moisture and almost difficult to breathe. The placid puddles of the swamp gleam in the moonlight, and though shallow, you cannot help but imagine them as bottomless. What lurks beneath the surface? What horrors wait to grasp your boots and yank you down… down into the black? The sodden ground, sucking at your boots with every step, does little to dissuade your worries.

Hooded Statues In Front Of Aged Cave Por.name:
古老洞穴门廊前的兜帽雕像
Hooded Statues In Front Of Aged Cave Portico

Text.text:
四尊兜帽雕像与柱廊庭院中央的枯井等距而立，默然守候着那些意欲探入地城深处的人。它们近乎十二英尺高，不禁让人祈祷——这并非建造此地者按真实身形雕刻的肖像。
Four hooded statues stand equidistant from the dry well in the center of the portico’s courtyard, silently awaiting those seeking to plumb the dungeon’s depth. At nearly twelve feet tall, one hopes that these are not life-sized likenesses of those who created this place.

表演者并未携带任何乐器，然而那身华丽的装束却昭示着他们必是某种音乐家。他们深深吸了一口气，随之而来的寂静里，观众已被他们牢牢握在掌心。待第一声完美的音符清亮响起时，人群早已为之倾倒。
The performer carries no instrument, though their lavish clothes denote them as some kind of musician. They take in a great breath, and in the silence that follows, they hold the audience in the palm of their hand. By the time the first perfect note rings out, they’ve already won the crowd.

Haunted House: Attic.name:
闹鬼宅邸：阁楼
Haunted House: Attic

Text.text: 你沿着通往阁楼的狭窄楼梯向上攀爬，光源却无端地忽明忽暗，几乎要熄灭。你把头压得很低才钻进这片逼仄的空间，但这里的空气仿佛许久未曾被惊动；若有一丝微风，都足以令人感激。越过零碎杂物与覆着罩布的家具，一扇铅框圆窗正俯瞰前院。它那玄奥的纹样与古怪的刻痕被多年的污垢层层掩埋，让你的视线一瞬间发花，随之留下隐隐的钝痛。你揉着太阳穴时，身后骤然响起一声响亮的砰——像箱盖坠落合拢。然而这里所有箱子都蒙着厚厚一层灰尘。又一声异响传来，你回身望去，只见一只先前未被察觉的箱柜开始咯咯作响，随即滑动着躲到一只老旧的红木衣橱后面。 As you climb the narrow stairs to the attic, light sources flicker inexplicably, nearly failing. You duck your head low to enter the confined space, but the air has not been disturbed for ages, and a breeze would be welcome. Past sundry items and covered furniture, a round, leaded window looks over the front yard. Its esoteric patterns and curious etchings, covered in years of grime, cause your eyes to cross momentarily, leaving a dull ache. As you massage your temples, a loud thud—like a chest lid falling shut—sounds behind you. But all the chests here are covered in a thick layer of dust. At another sound, you turn back to the room to see one trunk, which had eluded detection, begin to rattle, then slide behind an old mahogany wardrobe.

两尊石刻人像并肩矗立在神龛中央。雕像似乎刻画着一名披袍的女子，身旁伴着一只狗或狐狸；在它们身后展开一扇由数片叶状形体构成的“扇屏”，看着像是尾巴。只是你无法断定这些尾巴究竟出自那头犬形生物、那名女子，还是两者皆有。整体雕工娴熟，却又刻意含糊，几乎像是雕刻者畏惧将所刻之物真正呈现出来。
Two figures carved of stone stand close together in the center of the shrine. The statues appear to depict a robed woman beside a dog or fox, and behind them there’s a fan of several leaf-like shapes that might be tails. Although, you could not say if they come from the canine figure or the woman or both. Altogether the sculpture seems carved by a skilled hand but somewhat vague, almost as if the sculptor were afraid to depict the subject.

I See Truly With My Gem Of Seeing.name:
我以识真宝石洞见真实
I See Truly With My Gem Of Seeing

Text.text:
当我透过宝石那晶莹的晶透镜片凝视时，整个世界仿佛披上了鲜活而粼粼闪烁的光泽。此刻我得以看清万物的真实面目；我毫无顾忌地环顾四周，在我的注视下，现实的隐秘被尽数揭开。
The world takes on a vibrant, shimmering air as I peer through the crystalline lens of the gem. I see things now as they truly are, and the secrets of reality are laid bare under my gaze as I survey my surroundings with impunity.

Melancholic Djinn Receives Gift.name:
忧郁的巨灵领受赋礼
Melancholic Djinn Receives Gift

Text.text:
当歌声的最后几个音符在巨灵宫殿的金色长廊间回荡，强大的巨灵用蔚蓝的双手轻轻捧着那只小小的金丝雀。那份赋礼无疑美得惊人，于大多数人而言堪称奇迹，可这欢快的啁啾却在灵体深处搅动起什么——一种连赠礼者都未曾料到的忧伤。祂疲惫地叹了口气，目光飘向王座旁那只巨大的铁笼——以及它敞开的笼门。

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

As the last notes of the song echo through the golden halls of the djinn’s palace, the mighty genie cradles the small golden canary in their azure hands. The gift is undoubtedly beautiful, a marvel to most, but the joyous warbling stirs something within the spirit, a melancholy the gift giver did not expect. With a weary sigh, their gaze drifts to the large iron cage beside their throne—and its open door.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Drow With Bow.name:
持弓的卓尔
Drow With Bow

Text.text:
黑暗精灵单膝跪地，以一记安静而流畅的移动搭上箭矢，随即缓缓举弓，深紫色的眼眸沉静守候，凝视四方。兜帽遮住卓尔如羊毛般蓬松的发丝。弓身为抛光黑檀，色泽比持弓者紫黑的肌肤更深。姿态松弛却蓄势待发，一枚昏暗如花岗岩的箭镞笔直指向前方，锋锐如弓手的目光，冷冽如他的机敏与讥诮。
The dark elf takes a knee and nocks an arrow in one quiet, smooth movement, then raises the bow slowly, waiting and watching with deep purple eyes. A hood conceals the drow’s woolen spray of hair. The bow is polished ebony, darker than its wielder’s purple-black skin. Relaxed but at the ready, a dusky granite arrowhead points, sharp as the archer’s eyesight and cold wit.

Cemetery Warning Overheard At The Tavern.name:
酒馆里偷听到的墓地警告
Cemetery Warning Overheard At The Tavern

Text.text:
“我们不能把他们埋进墓园。你和我一样清楚，把尸体留在那片被玷污的土地上……会发生什么……”
“We can’t bury them in the cemetery. You know as well as I do what happens to corpses left in that tainted ground . . .”

I Put On My Reading Glasses.name:
我戴上阅读眼镜
I Put On My Reading Glasses

Text.text:
我轻轻捏住镜腿，用布细细擦拭镜片。它们是我双眼的冠军，披着最上等的金属丝与木纹铠甲。我护它们周全，作为回报，它们将世界磨砺得纤毫毕现。它们安稳地坐在我鼻梁这座桥上阅读，把某人的字句塑成我的思绪。

~ 构想：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

I hold them gently by the stem and polish their lenses with a cloth. These are the champions of my eyes, dressed in the finest wire and wood. I protect them from harm, and in return, they sharpen the world to clarity. They read from their comfortable seat on the bridge of my nose, shaping someone's letters into my thoughts.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

由热病石与幽暗意志锻成，这具魔像以机械般的笃定迈步而出。它的皮肤泛着蓝绿幽光，渗出细小的黏稠液滴，一触空气便迅速蒸发。挡在它路上的碎屑若是倒霉，顷刻间就被碾成齑粉；然而活着的环境下场更惨。在这生物周围一圈清晰可见的范围内，所有植物似乎都在枯萎，连固体也开始失去形态。
Wrought from feverstone and dark purpose, the golem steps forth with mechanical surety. Its skin glows blue-green, leaking tiny drops of viscous liquid that evaporate upon contact with the air. The debris that is unlucky enough to be in its way is instantly crushed, but the living surroundings suffer a worse fate. Around the creature, in a clear radius, all plant matter seems to wilt, solids losing form.

Sundries From A Slaver.name:
来自奴隶贩子的杂物
Sundries From A Slaver

Text.text:
你在奴贩的大衣内侧摸到一本小册子——柔软的小牛皮装订——里面列着一串仿佛永无止境的名字。名字旁用浅淡、潦草的笔迹写着，而紧挨着的数字却更清晰、更粗重：用各式现金标出的价码。除去这本阴森的名册，他们口袋里再无半点值钱之物。
Inside the slaver’s coat, you find a small booklet—bound in soft calfskin—with an endless list of names. They are written in light, messy script next to much clearer and bolder numbers: prices in various kinds of currency. Other than this grisly logbook, you find nothing else of value in their pockets.

那只蠕动的蝌蚪体型巨大、鼓胀可怖，潜伏在水池黏滑的水面下方，静静窥伺、耐心等待。两只玻璃般的眼睛探出水面，打量着附近的一切；忽然间，它的前端猛然裂开，露出一张宽阔巨口，满是森然利齿。
The wriggling tadpole, large and bulbous, lurks just beneath the slimy surface of its pool, watching and waiting. Two glassy eyes peer out to regard any nearby, while its front suddenly splits to reveal a wide mouth filled with sharp teeth.

这团凝胶立方体在每个轴向都恰好五英尺见方，噗叽噗叽地蠕行而过，身后拖出一条令人作呕的半透明黏液轨迹。它那庞大的渗流躯块内，漂浮着细小的齿轮与机括、零散的武器技术部件、带甲的纤维，以及一长段一长段的金属管道。伴随着吮吸般的声响，几缕细小触须扫过地面，搜寻可吞噬的饵料。
Exactly five feet on every axis, this gelatinous cube squelches along, leaving a trail of repulsive translucent fluid in its wake. Within the great oozing bulk float little cogs and gears, small bits of weapon tech, armored fibers, and great lengths of metal piping. With a sucking sound, small tendrils scan the floor, searching for fodder.

City College Campus.name:
城市学院校园
City College Campus

Text.text:
神采奕奕的学生、宿醉未醒的讲师、面无表情的学者——你能看见这几类人影在校园空地上来回穿行。红砖建筑如今显得格外格格不入，被现代都市的铬钢与霓虹层层包围，却依旧保留着一种深沉而质朴的魅力。
Bright-eyed students, hungover lecturers, and stony-faced academics are a few of the people you can see milling about the campus grounds. The red-brick buildings look oddly out of place now, surrounded by the chrome steel and neon of the modern city, yet they still hold a profoundly rustic charm.

Sentient Throne In Flooded Ruin.name:
被淹没废墟中的知觉王座
Sentient Throne In Flooded Ruin

Text.text:
古老台座上的高背王座仿佛拥有独立的生命，正一下一下地搏动。浸水的厅室里回荡着低沉而穿透的嗡鸣，随着共振不断攀升，震得你的头骨像孩童手中的玻璃弹珠般咯咯作响。你不由自主地想坐上王座；当你朝那椅子走去时，你注意到——它似乎在呼吸……

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The high-backed throne on the ancient dais seems to pulsate with a life all its own. A low, penetrating hum fills the water-logged chamber, rattling your skull like a child's marble as it builds in resonance. You feel compelled to sit upon the throne, and as you make your way to the chair, you notice that it seems to be breathing…

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Cat At Dusk.name:
暮色中的猫
Cat At Dusk

Text.text:
在凉爽的暮色薄昏里，一道影子蜷伏在近旁的栅栏顶端，带着好奇却疏离的目光静静望来。它无声地审视了片刻，随后抬起一只黯黑的爪子，伸出猩红的舌尖轻轻一舔，慢条斯理地梳理起来。它是在尾随你吗？你心头未定，警惕地扫视四周，再回望那道栅栏时，那抹丝绸般的暗影已悄然无踪，连一丝声响都未曾留下。

~ 达尔 阿维尔纳

Amid the cool evening dusk, a shadow coils atop a nearby fence, staring out with curious detachment. It judges quietly for moment before raising a darkened paw and grooming it with a lick of crimson. Could it be tailing you? Unsure, you scan your surroundings before looking back at the fence, but the silken shadow has vanished without a sound.

~ Daer Averna

Quip About Talking With Animals.name:
关于与动物交谈的俏皮话
Quip About Talking With Animals

Text.text:
“你试过和野生动物聊天吗？要让它们别总围着交配和吃食打转，得费点功夫；可一旦越过那道坎，它们其实相当有意思。”
“Have you ever tried talking to wild animals? It takes some work to get them past the topic of sex and food, but once you do they’re actually quite interesting.”

Sundries From An Orc Shaman.name:
一名兽人萨满的杂货
Sundries From An Orc Shaman

Text.text:
萨满把她行当里的家什都收在一只兽皮背包里，口袋边缘还垂着几条本地小兽的尾巴。你翻出一只红褐皮制的摇铃，铃柄是一截兽骨；一对刻着兽人语符号的野猪獠牙；以及一对小钹，钹面斑斑点点铺着橙色锈迹，用一段红绳拴在一起。
The shaman kept the tools of her trade in an animal-leather backpack, the tails of small, local fauna dangling from its pockets. You find a rattle made of red-brown leather, its handle a length of bone; a pair of boar’s tusks etched with symbols of the orcish language; and a pair of small cymbals, patterned with patches of orange rust and held together by a length of red string.

High Seas Battle: Cannons At A Distance.name:
公海之战：远距离炮战
High Seas Battle: Cannons At A Distance

Text.text:
你先看见他们的船上腾起几缕白色烟羽，随后才听见炮声。炮弹偏离目标，没入翻涌的海面，不知所踪。视与声之间的迟滞让这一切带着梦境般的恍惚，可你们舰炮的轰鸣炸响，又把你拉回此刻致命的严峻。
You see little white plumes emerge from their ship before you hear their cannons. The shots miss, lost somewhere in the roiling sea. The delay between sight and sound gives the action a dreamy quality, but the explosion of your ship’s own ordnance reminds you of the deadly seriousness of the moment.

Byrnwald Of Norketh.name:
诺凯斯的拜恩沃德
Byrnwald Of Norketh

Text.text:
那陌生人举手投足如受训军人般精准挺拔，穿行在拥挤的集市广场上步伐坚定，一手轻牵着一匹高大的马，缰绳在指间顺从地滑动。破旧的皮大衣随步摆荡，时而掀开一角，露出胯侧一柄做工精致的弯刃，刀身刻着流淌般的符文；另一侧则别着一根朴素的魔杖。他的眼神锐利，铁木般的色泽压在常年紧锁的眉峰之下，把周遭每一丝动静都尽收眼底。

~ 由 Serhan Handani 以 Played 扮演，使用

Carrying himself with the precise bearing of a trained soldier, the stranger walks purposefully through the crowded market square, gently leading a large horse by the reins. His worn leather overcoat swings as he walks, revealing a finely wrought, curved blade etched with flowing runes on one hip, and a simple wand at his other. Sharp eyes, the color of ironwood, sit under a permanently furrowed brow and take in every detail of his surroundings.

~ Played by Serhan Handani with

Azalea And Chloe At The Valehaven Vineya.name:
谷港谷葡萄园的杜鹃与克洛伊
Azalea And Chloe At The Valehaven Vineyard

Text.text:
一名日工停下脚步，用衣袖抹过额头，发现水壶里只剩下几滴。有人沿着行垄朝她走来，步伐又长又稳，刻意得像在丈量。那绝不是工人；她那件勉强拼凑的学袍在身后敞开，像一缕烟尾拖曳飞扬，逼得那工人吃惊地后退一步。日工瞪大了眼，那名女学生却笑着抬手指了指水壶——它随即变得冰凉，水位涌起，瞬间满到壶口，仿佛凭空施展了魔法。她接着继续赶路，随口说道：“抄个近道。葡萄不错。”
A day laborer stops to draw a sleeve across her forehead and finds that her water bottle is down to drops. Someone else walks the row toward her, taking long deliberate strides. This is no worker; her barely assembled school robe flies open behind her like a smoke trail, forcing the worker to step back in surprise. The laborer’s eyes widen, and the schoolgirl smiles and points at the water bottle. It cools and fills to the brim, as though by magic. She then continues on her way and says, “Taking a shortcut. Nice grapes.”

这道身影披着定制的米白色护甲，分段甲片层层排列，身形比大多数类人更高，四肢修长得近乎不合常理。头部未戴任何遮蔽，露出一张覆满夜黑皮毛的猫科面孔。沉重的头盔被他夹在臂弯里，一件猩红的半披风从护甲上垂落，遮住了背后的喷气背包。各式武器斜挂在身周，清一色军用规格，却都带着私改的痕迹。步枪搭在肩上，修长、灰暗、丑陋，枪身外壳刻着密密麻麻的缺口与刻痕。他那如黑豹般的头颅缓慢转动，沉着地扫视着周遭边界。
Clad in custom off-white armor arrayed in segmented plates, this figure stands taller than most humanoids, their limbs elongated. Their head is uncovered, revealing a feline face covered in night-black fur. A heavy helmet sits nestled in the crook of their elbow, and a scarlet half cloak hangs from their armor, obscuring a jetpack. A bevy of weapons is slung around the body, all military grade but sporting custom modifications. Their rifle is slung over a shoulder, a long, gray, ugly thing with countless notches etched into the housing. They move their panther-like head with slow scans of the perimeter.

Divine Home Of An Elven Goddess.name:
精灵女神的神圣居所
Divine Home Of An Elven Goddess

Text.text:
在林间空地的半明半暗里，乐韵浸透一切感官：从精灵餐食的气味与滋味，到精灵之手轻柔的接触。她踏过草野，在云雾轻吻的树冠下行走，去饮一座以空灵匠艺雕成的石泉。四周尽是树梢上的平台，以及她的廷臣与传令官们居住的玲珑而完美的小屋。她国度的造船师白日劳作——而夜里，则是铁匠锤火不息；她的厨房更能变出盛宴，把灵感送入灵魂。正是这一切，助她度过族裔蒙福的日子，从此刻起，直至时代尽头。
Under the half-light in the glade, musicality pervades every sense, from the smell and taste of an elven meal to the soft touch of an elven hand. She walks over grassy fields under cloud-kissed treetops to drink from a stone fountain of ethereal craftsmanship. All around are the treetop platforms and the tiny, perfect houses of her courtiers and heralds. The shipwrights of her realm work by day—and by night, the smiths—while her kitchen conjures feasts to carry inspiration to the soul. All this helps her pass the blessed days of her race, from now until the end of time.

The Word Of A Scoundrel.name:
无赖之言
The Word Of A Scoundrel

Text.text:
你凝视着眼前那名筋骨结实的男人，他伸出援手的姿态里透着笃定与坦诚。你停下脚步，重新思量那些围绕他编织的传闻——也许不过是闲人夸大其词的流言。可他眼底仍有一丝微光让你迟疑，那抹闪烁像刀锋般掠过，暗示着他对这趟行动也自有盘算。
You gaze at the sinewy man before you, who exudes self-assurance and honesty in his offer of a helping hand. You pause to reconsider the tales that have been woven about him. Perhaps they were exaggerated rumors of idle minds. Still, there's a twinkle in his eyes that makes you hesitate, a glint that hints at his own designs on this venture.

浅滩的水没过近处一条沙洲——浅得几乎透过浑浊的淤泥也能轻易看见海床上生灵留下的痕迹。退潮时，你几乎能想象当地人蹲伏在沙里，盼着捞到几枚肥美的贝类，好作晚餐。头顶上海鸥盘旋，伺机俯冲，抢走它们自己的那一口。空气里弥漫着刺鼻的腐臭与海藻的腥味。
Shallow waters submerge a nearby sandbar—so shallow that even through the silt you can easily see tracks of life in the seabed. During low tide, one could envision locals squatting in the sand hoping to nab tasty shellfish for their evening repast. Above, seagulls circle, waiting for their opportunity to strike out for their own meal. The scent of the air is rife with the pungent odor of rot and seaweed.

Implacable Black-suit Agent.name:
冷酷无情的黑西装特工
Implacable Black-suit Agent

Text.text:
此人身着一套剪裁无可挑剔的三件套西装，黑得仿佛能吞没周遭所有光线，整个人就是不屈意志与冷硬决心的化身。自他踏入房间的那一刻起，空气里便弥漫开一股触手可及的不安——仅凭存在就足以令交谈戛然而止、目光不由自主地被牵引过去；他神情肃厉，目光如刃，却被一副镜面墨镜遮住，那镜面仿佛能照穿谎言。只见他手腕一翻，银亮的黄铜徽章一闪即逝，随即收回西装外套内侧；那动作与衣料下微妙的轮廓一同，暗示着里面藏着一把火器。
Clad in an impeccably tailored three-piece suit that seems to absorb all light, this individual is an embodiment of relentless determination and unwavering resolve. From the moment he steps into a room, a palpable sense of unease permeates the air—his presence alone enough to silence conversations and draw attention, with his stern expression and piercing eyes shielded behind a pair of mirrored shades that seem to see through deception. In one swift motion he flashes his shiny brass badge then tucks it away in his blazer, which hints at a concealed firearm.

Sundries From A Jackalwere.name:
豺狼人杂货
Sundries From A Jackalwere

Text.text:
这里到处都是破布——有些像被嚼烂的抹布，有些是从受害者身上撕下来的碎片，还有些被系在一起，扎成令人毛骨悚然的布偶或弯月般的月牙。
It’s all rags here—some that look like they’ve been used as chews, some shredded from victims’ bodies, others tied together into creepy dolls or crescent moons.

金属球被抛光得如镜面般锃亮，铜质表面精细镌刻着繁复到令人目眩的奥秘符文。球体顶端的最高点清晰可见一枚六角形按钮，旁边还用通用语写着一行警告：不要按。一旦按下按钮，你的世界便在癫狂的声浪中轰然炸裂——随即又被仁慈地戛然而止，因为你的耳膜像被碾烂的葡萄般爆裂开来。

~ David 于 Discord

The metal sphere has been polished to a mirrorlike sheen, its copper surface delicately engraved with arcane runes of baffling intricacy. A hexagonal button is clearly visible atop the sphere's apex alongside a warning written in the common tongue: DO NOT PRESS. Pressing the button, your world explodes into a maddening eruption of sound—which is cut mercifully short as your eardrums burst like squashed grapes.

~ David on Discord

Magical Detection Of A Cleric's Class.name:
牧师职业的魔法侦测
Magical Detection Of A Cleric's Class

Text.text:
你的努力化作一团只有你能看见的蒸汽，缭绕在你的目标周围，像一小片烟雾或薄雾。你的目标从其中显现，轮廓被一道银金交辉的闪烁边缘勾勒出来。神圣之力沿着那些金属般的线条疾驰奔涌，直至它们黯淡、褪去、消失。

~ 由一位英雄Envisioned

Your effort forms a vapor only you can see around your target, like a small patch of smoke or fog. Your target emerges from it with a silhouette traced in a sparkling border of silver and gold. The divine races through the metallic lines until they dull, fade, and disappear.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这道法术汲取了一股你无法理解的力量源泉。你向某个超越自身的伟力祈祷，仿佛与一处无尽的正能量领域相连；那能量穿流过你，像你成了引来世间所有爱意的避雷针。太多了。你吐出一口压抑已久的长息，释放出这股能量的治疗之力。
This spell taps a wellspring of power beyond your comprehension. Your prayer to a power beyond yourself seems to connect to a realm of infinite positive energy, which flows through you, as if you have become a lightning rod for all the world’s love. It is too much. You expel a long pent-up breath and unleash the energy’s healing power.

Plea From A Captured Cultist.name:
来自被俘邪教徒的哀求
Plea From A Captured Cultist

Text.text:
“在这之前，我什么都不是。我在别人家的地里干活。后来这些人给了我一个机会，让我成为更宏大之事的一部分——某种足以改变世界的东西。要是我早知道他们说的是哪一种世界……求你放我回家吧。我什么都可以告诉你。有人会想我，我也想回到他们身边。”
“Before this, I was nobody. I farmed someone else’s land. Then these people offered me a chance to be part of something bigger, something that could change the world. If I’d known what kind of world they meant… Please let me go home. I’ll tell you whatever you want. There are people who will miss me and I’d like to go back to them.”

Convoy Of Trade Ships Blockaded By Milit.name:
被军舰舰队封锁的商船队
Convoy Of Trade Ships Blockaded By Military Fleet

Text.text:
一长列矮胖的灰色商船拖着尾迹驶向目的地，领航舰闪烁着明亮的绿色追踪信标。忽然，一群流线雪白的舰艇自墨黑虚空中凭空显现，横截在船队前方。白色舰队以军用般的精确迅速散开，排成菱形编队，将商船团团围住。耀眼的光束在白色星舰之间连成一道道光链，织就一张无法穿越的脉冲星之网——封死所有退路。
The long gray line of stubby trade ships trails toward their destination, the lead ship flashing a bright green tracking beacon. Then, a swarm of sleek white vessels materialize out of the inky blackness and block the convoy’s path. With military precision the white fleet fans out into diamond formations, encircling the trade ships. Vivid beams of light link the white starships, generating an impassable pulsar net—preventing any escape.

Amateurishly Hung Deer.name:
业余手法吊挂的鹿
Amateurishly Hung Deer

Text.text:
一具匆忙剖开的鹿尸挂在一堆杆子搭成的架子上。营地里的人显然打过猎，却并不怎么老练；尸体看起来被粗暴地折腾过。再看他们的悬挂方式，血会在胸腔里积成一汪。更何况天似乎有点偏热，不适合把猎物就这么晾着。一小团苍蝇已经绕着尸身嗡嗡盘旋。
A hastily gutted deer carcass hangs from a stack of poles. While the campers have clearly hunted, they don’t seem to be very experienced. The carcass looks like it had some rough handling. And the way they’ve strung it up, they’ll have blood pooling in the chest cavity. Plus, it seems a bit warm out to hang an animal. A small cloud of flies already circles the body.

矮人颤抖着抬手按住病态灰白的额头，抹去细薄、肮脏的浅金发丝间成串聚起的汗珠。两道疤痕横贯他头部右侧，深而狰狞，那里早已不再长出头发。另一道伤口沿着下颌线从下巴一直割到耳根，皮肉仍旧通红、翻绽，湿亮得刺眼。他佝偻着背站着，肩上披着一袭柳叶斗篷。几圈木制护甲顺着自然的弧度缠裹着他的身躯，似乎并未妨碍他的动作——尽管那些动作虚弱得可怜。可即便痛楚昭然若揭，这人的神情仍绽出暖意与关切——穿透蜡般的苍白，穿透一道道割伤与淤青。

~ Played by ErisedRain with

The dwarf lifts a shaking hand to his sickly gray brow, wiping away the globs of sweat collecting under the strings of thin, dirty-blond hair. Two scars run horizontally along the right side of his head, so deep and harsh that hair no longer grows there. Another cut runs along his jawline from his chin to his ear, the flesh still red, raw, and shining. He stands with a bent back, mantled in a cape of willow leaves. Bands of wooden armor wrap about his body in natural curvatures that don't seem to hinder his movements… as feeble as they are. Despite his obvious pain, the man's countenance blooms with warmth and caring—through the waxen pallor, through the cuts and bruises.

~ Played by ErisedRain with

Spiral Staircase In Ancient Ruins.name:
远古遗迹的螺旋阶梯
Spiral Staircase In Ancient Ruins

Text.text:
令人不安的寂静笼罩着这片破败的废墟。没有鸟鸣，没有生物在纠结的灌木丛中窜动。仿佛世界早已将此地彻底遗忘。而从你周身沉沉压下的强烈不祥与恐惧来看，这也就不难理解。正中央，一道阶梯盘旋着通往无光的深坑——而恶意的笑声仍在风里徘徊不散。

~ 由David在Discord上构想

An unsettling silence hangs over the dilapidated ruins. No birds sing, no creatures scurry through the tangled undergrowth. It seems the world has forgotten this place entirely. And judging by the overpowering sense of foreboding and dread that has settled over you, that is understandable. At the center, a staircase winds down into a lightless pit—and the sound of malevolent laughter lingers on the wind.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Ray Of Frost.name:
冰霜射线
Ray Of Frost

Text.text:
一阵寒意沿着你的手臂窜下，最终在指尖化作一道蓝白色的射线迸射而出，噼啪作响，宛如隆冬深处踏上冰封湖面时那般脆裂的声响。
A chill runs down your arm and emerges as a blue-white ray from your fingertip, emitting a crackling sound exactly like a frozen lake trod upon in the dead of winter.

Kobolds Worshipping Dead Dragon.name:
崇拜死去巨龙的狗头人
Kobolds Worshipping Dead Dragon

Text.text:
起初，你很难将眼前那盘踞蜷曲的巨大全蜥形身躯尽收眼底；它的威严几乎令人窒息，你的感官需要片刻才能适应。巨龙静止的身形周围，一群小型龙裔生物俯首跪拜、低声吟诵——显然是在崇敬他们挚爱的至高者。可紧接着你便察觉：没有移动，甚至连呼吸那细微的起伏都不存在——巨龙已死。再细看便发现，这生物鳞片上的绿色并非绿龙血脉那种浓郁的祖母绿，而是铜绿——如同陈旧磨损的金属表面所生出的锈色。

~ 由Clara C. Potter在Discord上构想

At first it is difficult for you to take in the enormous majesty of the coiled reptilian form before you, and it takes a moment for your senses to adjust. Around the still form of the dragon, small draconic creatures bow and chant—clearly worshipping their beloved superior. Then you note there is no movement, not even the subtle ebb and flow of breath: the dragon is dead. Further investigation reveals that the green of the creature's scales is not the rich emerald hue of green draconic lineage but verdigris—as one might find on aged, worn metal.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

这座残破的凉亭伫立在这片如今被遗弃的庄园里，像一具嶙峋的骸骨，提醒着久远年代——那些更快乐、更温柔的时光。油漆早已从腐朽的木材上大片剥落，露出锈蚀的钉子与霉斑遍布的木板。整座结构仿佛随时都会倾塌，风中吱呀作响，像一棵被岁月磨损的老橡树。它一会儿向这边歪，一会儿向那边斜，随着废墟的重心挪移而摇摆不定。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The dilapidated gazebo stands as a skeletal reminder of ages long past—of happier, more pleasant times—on the grounds of this now-abandoned estate. The paint long ago peeled away from the rotting wood, exposing rusting nails and mildewy boards. The entire structure seems liable to topple at any moment, creaking in the wind like a weathered oak. It leans one way, then another, as the weight of the ruin shifts.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Wizard To Sorcerer In The Library.name:
图书馆里的巫师与术士
Wizard To Sorcerer In The Library

Text.text:
“这段里的奥秘有点棘手……我知道这些解读对那种嗯，更凭直觉做事的人来说，可能会有点复杂。”
“The arcana in this passage is a little tricky… I know all this reading might be a bit complicated for someone who works, well, more intuitively.”

Witch On Broomstick Flying Overhead.name:
骑着扫帚从头顶掠过的女巫
Witch On Broomstick Flying Overhead

Text.text:
一道影子在深夜被月光涂抹的云层间倏忽掠过，宛如褪色的热闪电，终于现出身形。她身下的扫帚旁，裙摆与衣尾一齐猎猎翻飞，正如她头顶那一缕缕又长又枯的发丝。女巫仰头放声大笑，恣意奔放，笑声里满是秋之初生与夏之将死交织而成的蓬勃能量。
A shadow flits among the moon-painted clouds of the late evening, like faded heat lightning, and finally emerges. Both skirt and coattails flap around the broom beneath her, just like her long, dry hair above. The witch throws back her head and laughs, exuberant, full of the energy of autumn’s birth and summer’s death.

Deku And Venim.name:
德库与维尼姆
Deku And Venim

Text.text:
骑在一只线条利落的巨型黑蜘蛛背上，一个绿皮地精披着朴素的皮甲，瞄准他反曲长弓上已搭好的箭。那双圆睁的眼睛如同漆黑发亮的玻璃珠。蜘蛛疾步窜行时，地精油腻、煤色的乱发在他过大的脑袋后方飞扬，露出夸张尖长的耳朵。箭矢破空飞出。他嘶嘶作声，啐了一口，伸手往已空的箭袋里一摸。下一支箭却已出现在他掌心，紧接着，拉满的弓弦再度向后绷紧。

~ 由 Maturin 扮演

Astride a sleek, giant black spider, a green-skinned goblin wearing simple leather aims down the arrow nocked on his recurved longbow. His wide eyes are glossy black orbs. As the spider skitters, the goblin’s greasy, coal-colored locks stream behind his overlarge head, revealing his outsized, pointed ears. The arrow flies. He hisses and spits, reaching back to his empty quiver. Another arrow appears in his hand, and again, the loaded bowstring goes back.

~ Played by Maturin

Galactic Military Convention.name:
银河军事公约
Galactic Military Convention

Text.text:
以无限延展的空间为幕布，会场在万千交谈中震颤。声浪自纳米抛光的地面弹起，穿过虚拟与会者半透明的全息投影层层回荡。各式滋养被端上——从紧凑的有机方块到等离子注射器，数以百计的形态——递给来自银河军方各派系的实体来客；他们三三两两，混杂成群。唯有制服勉强拼出一丝统一，可制服本身又在万花筒般的怪异徽记词汇周围铺陈出无数色彩。宇宙的、人工的、生物的生命在旋转光球的柔辉下汇聚一堂，只为商讨如何以最妥当的方式施行死亡。

~ 一位英雄构想

Backdropped by the infinite expanse of space, the conference hall vibrates with ten thousand conversations. The sound bounces from the nano-polished floors through the semi-transparent holos of virtual attendees. Nourishment is served—in hundreds of forms, from compact organic cubes to plasmatic injectors—to the corporeal visitors from every faction of the galactic military standing in heterogeneous groups. Only their uniforms create any semblance of cohesion, but even those form a myriad of colors around a kaleidoscopic lexicon of odd insignias. This array of cosmic, artificial, and biologic life has converged, under the lambent glow of rotating light orbs, to discuss the best methods of administering death.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Demon Surrounded By Guards.name:
被守卫团团包围的恶魔
Demon Surrounded By Guards

Text.text:
高耸的魔裔在守卫们合围时放声大笑，他们用长矛戳刺着它那伤痕累累的猩红皮肉。它以灼烫的目光扫过众人——在它眼里不过是一群虫豸——随即舒展出雄伟的双翼，尽情品尝凡人因恐惧与惊骇而逸出的倒吸冷气。覆鳞的鼻孔猛然翕张，这生物贪婪地嗅着燃烧之城里弥漫的惊惧；逃亡凡人的甜美恐慌，如甘露般在它分叉的舌尖流淌。

~ Envisioned by Andrew Sanguine on Discord

The towering fiend laughs as the guards surround it, poking at its scarred, red flesh. Casting a burning gaze over those it considers little more than insects, the fiend unfurls mighty wings, relishing the gasps of fear and awe that escape the mortals. Scaled nostrils flare as the creature savors the fear saturating the burning city, the delectable terror of fleeing mortals like ambrosia upon its forked tongue.

~ Envisioned by Andrew Sanguine on Discord

这把锤子笨重而方正——没有任何流畅的线条或精心的弧度。锤柄很长，嵌着一串幽幽发亮的蓝色电池，必须双手才能抡动。几束钢制加固的导线将握柄与锤头相连——锤头由致密的钛合金铸成，中央嵌着一枚黄色光子舱，闪耀得宛如一颗魔法宝石。随着使用者的接触，光子舱骤然点燃，为整把锤子覆上一层柔和的金色微光。
This hammer is bulky and square—no sleek lines or careful curves. The shaft is long, and inlaid with a series of glowing blue batteries that require two hands to heft. A set of steel-reinforced wires connect the handle to the head—a dense titanium alloy with a single yellow photon housing in the center, shining like a magic gem. At the user’s touch, the photon housing ignites, giving the hammer a gentle golden glow.

这里滚落的石块像一只侧卧、几乎被掩埋的巨手，手腕位于最南端。食指指向北方，而西侧紧挨着的一块较小岩石，仿佛是拇指伸出的指尖。几块龟裂的巨砾上覆着被风雨侵蚀的符文。
Tumbled stones here resemble a gigantic hand laid on its side and mostly buried, the wrist at the southernmost side. The forefinger points north, and a smaller rock just to the west seems to be the protruding end of the thumb. Weathered runes cover some of these cracked boulders.

魔法将世界的知识带到德鲁伊心中，那些变形法术可由听觉、接触与嗅觉来锁定目标。动物伙伴协助狩猎、采集，甚至帮助法术瞄准目标。德鲁伊跪伏大地，掰开它的果实，熬煮灵药与毒剂，并打造能在无形之中劈出道路的器具。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Magic brings the knowledge of the world to the druid, spells of transformation aimed by hearing, touch, and scent. Animal companions help with hunting, gathering, and even with targeting spells. The druid kneels to the earth, breaks open its fruit, brews the elixirs and poisons, and crafts tools that cut a path through the invisible.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Alarm Klaxon In Spaceship.name:
飞船内的警报汽笛
Alarm Klaxon In Spaceship

Text.text:
警报喇叭的尖啸刺穿舰船，向全体船员宣告危险来临，人人奔向战斗岗位。警笛声如浪潮般起伏，混着靴底踏击金属甲板的铿锵声，在船内汇成一曲迫在眉睫的急促合唱。
A klaxon screams through the ship, alerting the crew to danger, and all hands rush to battle stations. The siren rises and falls like a wave, the sound mingling with the clatter of boots on metal to create a chorus of urgency on board.

这些人曾经烤面包、修房子、教书育人。如今他们走在街道正中间，一种深沉而骇人的悲伤如先锋般先于他们铺开。他们半透明的身影仿佛脆弱的轻纱，却在脸上堆满愤怒的渴求。他们的眼睛像空井般向外窥探，唯有活人的灵魂才能将其填满。
These were people who baked bread, repaired houses, and taught school. Now they walk down the middle of the street, a deep and horrifying sadness preceding them like a vanguard. Their translucence suggests fragile, gossamer material, but their faces are full of angry want. Their eyes peer out like empty wells that can only be filled with the souls of the living.

I Resist Being Moved With My Dwarven Pla.name:
我身披矮人板甲，岿然不动
I Resist Being Moved With My Dwarven Plate

Text.text:
当魔法启动车轮般转动之时，我的身体沉重得如同铁砧，披甲的战靴深深陷入地面。我如壁垒般屹立——不屈、不移——冷峻如亘古雪冠高山。
My body grows as heavy as an anvil, and my armored boots sink into the ground when the enchantment activates. I stand like a bulwark—unbowed, unmoved—and I remain as stoic as an ancient snowcapped mountain.

Above The Clouds On The Back Of A Roc.name:
云端之上，巨鹏之背
Above The Clouds On The Back Of A Roc

Text.text:
巨鹏的体型大得令人难以置信。无论你被告知过多少次，无论你见过多少奇景，哪怕你此刻真的和你的伙伴一起，蜷卧在一只绑在它那对惊人强健的翼间的篮筐里，这头怪鸟以血肉之躯存在的事实，仍让人心神震荡。就在你开始说服自己这不过是再正常不过的事时，你又瞥见它羽轴上那一根根尚未舒展的羽毛的大小，或捕捉到它那巨大的心跳声——如定音鼓般在你的感官边缘轰然擂动——你不由得再次惊叹。忽然你意识到，头顶只剩无垠苍穹，因为在你恍惚的遐想间，你已攀升到远远高过云海之上。即便身处这奇幻的世界，你也明白自己正经历着一种只能被称作神话的体验。
The size of the roc is beyond belief. Despite all you had been told, despite all you have seen, despite actually being here with your companions, sprawled in a basket lashed between its tremendously powerful wings, the fact that this monstrous bird exists in the flesh is absolutely mind-boggling. Just as you begin to convince yourself that this is perfectly normal, you see the size of its pin feathers or catch the sound of its massive heart—beating like a timpani drum at the periphery of your senses—and you cannot help but marvel anew. Suddenly you realize that there is nothing but sky above, because in your reverie you have ascended far past the clouds. Even in this world of the fantastic, you find yourself in an experience that can only be described as mythical.

Loot From A Sword-pierced Zombie.name:
从被长剑贯穿的丧尸身上搜出的战利品
Loot From A Sword-pierced Zombie

Text.text:
那步履蹒跚的憎恶之物轰然坍倒在地，腹部被一柄深深嵌入的长剑支撑着。你将剑猛地抽出，生物顺着剑刃滑落，伴随一声令人作呕的黏腻噗嗤。那柄剑的工艺显然精美绝伦。
The shambling abomination crumples to the ground, propped up by the sword embedded in its midriff. Pulling the sword free, the creature slides off the blade with a nauseating squelch. The sword was clearly of exquisite craftsmanship.

Potion Of Fire Giant Strength.name:
火巨人之力药剂
Potion Of Fire Giant Strength

Text.text:
瓶子外形酷似一只锅炉，矮胖而呈圆筒状。瓶中之物正翻滚沸腾：橙色、仿若岩浆的浆液里点点黑色沉渣浮沉。似乎是一小片熔岩岩石的碎片在咕嘟作响的液体中上下漂荡，幽幽泛着深红光芒，宛如一枚不肯熄灭的余烬。
The bottle is shaped much like a boiler, squat and cylindrical. Its contents boil, the orange magma-like substance bespeckled with black sediment. A sliver of what seems to be lava rock bobs in the burbling liquid and glows a deep red, like an ember refusing to fade.

Tomes And Tracts.name:
典籍与文书
Tomes And Tracts

Text.text:
附魔师学院曾开设过的每一种职业的所有课本，都能在这里找到。书架被调整成一排排，端头整齐地朝向店铺前方。每一组书架都是一位魔法生灵，而在每个端头上都雕着一张细长的、会动的面孔。书架会开口提问，替在店里翻找与探求的人找出书来，然后把书轻轻往外推几寸，像是在邀请你伸手取阅。
Every book for every class ever taught at Enchanter Academy can be found here. The shelves are aimed so that their endcaps all face the front of the store. Each set of shelves is a magical being, and on each endcap is carved a long, animated face. The shelves ask questions and find books that they then scoot out a few inches for the browsers and questors in the shop.

Raphael Von Hope.name:
拉斐尔·冯·霍普
Raphael Von Hope

Text.text:
一个高个男人站着，身形瘦削却依旧结实，双臂交叉抱在胸前；灰色的八字胡下蜷着毫不掩饰的怒容。他穿着饱经风雨的皮护甲，尘土把它染成浑浊的黄褐色，钉饰的金属铆钉早已失去所有光泽。他抬手抓挠下巴上红白相间的短硬胡茬，枪铁般的灰色眼睛在三角帽檐下炽烈警戒，寸步不移。腰带上挂着一把手枪，握柄上刻着“RVH”的首字母缩写。可他并非孤身一人。就在他身侧，纹丝不动、像士兵般立正的，是一只完全由钢铁铸成的獒犬。

~ Played by Stephan Graham with

A tall fellow, thin but still sturdy of frame, stands with arms crossed; an unabashed scowl curls beneath his grey mustache. He wears weatherworn leather armor, dusted tan with dirt, its metal studs bereft of any shine. He scratches at the red-and-white stubble on his chin, his gunmetal-grey eyes on ardent vigil beneath a tricorn hat. A pistol hangs from his belt, the grip etched with the initials “RVH.” And he isn't alone. Standing perfectly still at his side—at attention—is a mastiff wrought entirely of steel.

~ Played by Stephan Graham with

你知道马能站着睡，却从没想过人也能如此。可眼前那名守卫就这么杵在岗哨上，身子倚着，双眼紧闭，呼吸缓慢而均匀。也许他们只是装睡，好骗过旁人；然而一只苍蝇落在他脸上爬来爬去，直到一声突兀的鼾响把它惊起，嗡地飞走。
You know that horses sleep standing up, but you’ve not imagined people can do it too. And yet there the guard stands, leaning at their post, eyes shut and breathing slow and steady. Perhaps they just pretend to sleep to trick onlookers, but a fly lands on their face and crawls across it, only buzzing away when disturbed by a sudden snore.

Guildmaster's Bedroom.name:
公会会长的卧室
Guildmaster's Bedroom

Text.text:
一张大号床与一只上锁的箱子，是这间本来清简肃寂的寝室里仅有的奢华痕迹。床边小几上，花瓶旁搁着一张纸，也许是公会会长尚未写完的信。床中央蜷着一只黑猫，腹部随沉眠的缓慢节奏一起一伏。
A queen-sized bed and a locked chest are the only signs of luxury in this otherwise austere chamber. A sheet of paper sits on the side table next to a vase of flowers, perhaps a letter-in-progress from the guildmaster. Curled in the center of the bed is a black cat, its stomach rising and falling in the slow tempo of slumber.

尽管身披沉重的锁子甲、手握巨大的战锤，这位宽肩的矮人战士却散发出严厉而好学的沉静。神圣的符文镌刻在那柄双手锤磨损、布满凹痕的钢面上；战斗白热之际，当矮人浑厚回荡的男中音压过喧嚣，那些符号便迸发出灼目的辉光。他将红棕色的胡须梳理得一丝不苟并编成辫子，明亮的绿眼睛闪烁着肃穆的沉思。

~ 由一位英雄扮演

Despite his heavy chainmail and massive warhammer, the broad-shouldered dwarf warrior exudes a stern, studious calm. Divine runes etch the worn, pitted steel of the two-handed hammer, and in the heat of battle, when the dwarf’s resonant baritone voice rises above the clamor, those same symbols glow with a searing radiance. He keeps his ruddy-brown beard brushed and braided, and his bright, green eyes gleam with somber reflection.

~ Played by a Hero

Giant Bioluminescent Lighthouse Fungus.name:
巨型生物荧光灯塔菌
Giant Bioluminescent Lighthouse Fungus

Text.text:
巍然耸立的巨型真菌以妖异的生物荧光脉动照亮这座广袤的地下洞窟，宛如一座天然灯塔。每当这异象再度涌现，你便看见洞穴四周更小片的苔藓、地衣与其他蘑菇也随之迸发出璀璨夺目的色彩狂潮——却只是一瞬。
The towering fungus illuminates the vast subterranean cavern with a lurid bioluminescent pulse, like a natural lighthouse.
