With every instance of this phenomenon, you see smaller patches of moss, lichen, and other mushrooms around the cave erupt in a scintillating riot of color—but only for a moment.

Rhyme Of The Silent Phantom.name:
沉默魅影之韵
Rhyme Of The Silent Phantom

Text.text:
“逐旅者一代又一代踏过马利卡尔， 穿行于荒芜而寂静的废土。 寻危险，寻安宁， 被向东的牵引驱赶， 奔向迷雾缠绕的孤岛巢居—— 那里栖着巨大的沉默魅影（特征）， 以及潜行猎兽的尖牙利爪。 今夜唯有一件事能救你， 当红月之光下，浓雾化作血色。 当那魅影（特征）之声可闻，如同告诫之词…… 那就跑！ 跑！跑！要么跑，要么战！”

~ 由暴虐者格里姆 构想

"Wayfarers have been passing over Malikar for generations over barren, quiet wastes. Seeking danger, seeking peace, driven outward to the east, toward the foggy island dwelling of the giant Silent Phantom, and the teeth and claws belonging to the furtive hunting beast. Only one thing will save you tonight, when the fog turns to blood in a red moonlight. When the Phantom can be heard, like a cautionary word… Then run! Then run, then run or fight!"

~ Envisioned by Grim the Tyrannical

Thin Ice Hazard.name:
薄冰危害
Thin Ice Hazard

Text.text:
这片摇摇欲坠的广阔冰面很容易辨认：覆霜的蓝色水洼星星点点，夹在薄雪轻覆的坚硬地表之间。迈出第一步时脚下嘎吱作响，却还算让人安心；再轻轻蹦跳几下，仿佛也能壮着胆往前挪动。可一旦走得太深入，底气便瞬间蒸发——每一步落下，靴底下都会爆出一片噼啪脆裂的合奏，裂响如同飞奔般向四周窜开。
The precarious expanse is easy to recognize, mottled with frosty-edged pools of blue water among snow-dusted harder surfaces. A first step crunches with some confidence, and bouncing on it a bit encourages some progress. Too far onto the ice, the confidence disappears, and every step produces a chorus of pops and cracks racing outward from beneath your boots.

Loot From A Hobgoblin.name:
来自大地精的战利品
Loot From A Hobgoblin

Text.text:
大地精的长剑不仅是魔法武器，更出自一位技艺非凡的铁匠之手，其价值是寻常刀剑价格的数倍。
The hobgoblin’s longsword is not only magical but has been worked by a smith of considerable skill, and is worth several times the price of a common blade.

Three Days By Horse On Grassland.name:
草原上策马三日
Three Days By Horse On Grassland

Text.text:
你旅行穿越辽阔无垠的平原，闯入一片草海，草高及腹，拂过马肚。第一天，行程平平无事，你把马拴在树上，夜里休息。第二天，你趟过一条小溪，在对岸发现一处被遗弃的营地——凡值钱之物皆被洗劫一空，显然是仓皇离去。你不禁猜想营地主人遭遇了什么，却仍强打精神继续前行，尽管疲惫缠身。第三天，夕阳沉入远处的丘陵之后，你终于找到了目标。
You travel over the sprawling plains, through a sea of grass so tall it brushes your horse's belly. On the first day, the journey passes uneventfully, and you rope the horse to a tree to rest that night. The next day, you cross a small stream and find an abandoned camp on the other side, ransacked of anything valuable and left in a hurry. You wonder what became of the camp's occupant, but press on, despite your weariness. On the third day, as the sun dips behind the distant hills, you find your objective.

你将手掌平贴地面，口中吟诵咒文，手腕旋动，画出越来越大的圆。随之，一缕薄雾自一处空无之点无声旋出，几乎不可见地勾勒成一圈淡淡的涡痕。雾气迅速变稠，自此位面汹涌扩张成一片巨大的白色云团，将其中一切尽数吞没，也把所有视线彻底遮断。
You hold your hand flat to the ground and whirl it in widening circles while chanting the incantation. In response, a thin mist silently swirls out from a point of empty air in an almost invisible circle. The mist thickens and expands from this plane in a huge white cloud, swallowing all within it and blocking all from sight.

Wild Magic Surge: Sorcerous Surge.name:
狂野魔法涌动：术法激涌
Wild Magic Surge: Sorcerous Surge

Text.text:
你探入内在巫力的深处，将魔法的心与魂尽数倾注于你的法术。伴随这份献礼而来的，是一份相互回赠的赋礼：一股温热而出人意料的涌流回返，裹挟着翻涌的原始奥能将你吞没。你清晰地感到这股浪潮将你体内的巫力源泉彻底回满。
You plumb the depths of your inner sorcery, pouring your magical heart and soul into your spell. With this offering comes a reciprocal gift: a warm and surprising surge flows back, engulfing you in an eddying swell of raw arcana. You feel the surge fully refill your wellspring of sorcerous might.

Broom Of Animated Attack.name:
飞袭魔扫帚
Broom Of Animated Attack

Text.text:
这把扫帚在休息时看起来毫不起眼，斜靠在墙边，和任何一件工具别无二致。然而当你的手握上光滑的木柄，扫帚便在恼怒的簌簌声中活了过来，以惊人的力道猛地从你手中挣脱。
The broom looks wholly unremarkable at rest, leaning against the wall like any other tool. Yet when your hand closes around the smooth wooden handle, the broom comes alive with an irate rustling, pulling away from you with surprising strength.

你需要片刻，才能真正衡量眼前这头巨兽的体型——它已被长矛与标枪放倒，那些武器仍从它的骸骨残躯上刺出。翅骨自蛇形脊柱两侧伸展，翼展将近五十英尺，如今有一半埋入泥土。你不禁想象那场将巨龙击落的惨烈大战——无数战士倒在它致命的吐息与可怖的利爪之下。头骨从地面探出，仿佛这怪物仍未死去，正潜伏等待轻易的猎物；空洞的眼眶永恒凝望。
It takes a moment to fully reckon the sheer size of the beast before you, felled by spears and javelins still protruding from its skeletal remains. The wing bones extend outward from a serpentine spine, spanning nearly fifty feet, now half-buried in the earth. You imagine the mighty battle that brought this dragon to ground—the countless warriors who fell beneath its deadly breath and terrible claws. The skull emerges from the ground, as if the beast still lives, lying in wait for easy prey, its hollow eye sockets gazing eternally.

Highland Games, Weight Over The Bar.name:
高地运动会：横杆之上，重压竞逐
Highland Games, Weight Over The Bar

Text.text:
这是一座铁铸的金字塔，顶端锻出一只圆环，重达五十六码。一个壮得像碉堡的运动员踏上前来，沉身下蹲，短褶裙边几乎拂到地面，双手扣住铁环。身后立着一根高杠，设在二十英尺的高度。投掷者自脚趾到指尖猛然舒展，如弹簧般迸发，伴着一声巨犬般的低吼，将重物抡起掷出。铁块斜斜飞去，角度怪异，越杠时擦到横杆。横杆颤了一下，却没有落下。重物坠地时，将地面砸入数英寸深。
This is a pyramid of iron, with a ring forged as its top, weighing fifty-six pounds. A blockhouse of an athlete steps up, squats down until their kilt brushes the ground, and takes hold. Behind them is a high bar set at twenty feet. The thrower uncoils, from toes to fingertips, heaving the weight with a bark like a giant dog. It flies, canted at an odd angle, and touches the bar on its way over. The bar quivers but does not fall. The weight drives several inches into the ground when it lands.

Statue Overlooking Gallows.name:
俯瞰绞刑架的雕像
Statue Overlooking Gallows

Text.text:
镇上的高台曾是欢庆与礼拜之所，曾用献礼与贡品装点，敬奉诸神——如今却被赋予了截然不同的用途。小镇奠基者那尊巍然的兜帽雕像盘踞在中央广场被雨水浸透的平台上，居高临下，以不容置疑的威严审视着新竖起的绞刑架——你不禁想，他们会赞同后裔们的动作吗？
The town dais was once a place of celebration and worship, festooned with offerings and tributes to the gods—now it serves a different purpose. The imposing hooded statue of the town’s founder dominates the rain-soaked platform in the central square, looking down upon the newly erected gallows with imperious scrutiny—and you wonder, would they approve of the actions of their descendants?

Resolute Firefighter.name:
坚定的消防员
Resolute Firefighter

Text.text:
消防员身着灰色的防护道具笔挺伫立，厚重的战斗服上亮着一套精密的线路与传感器系统。他们戴着亮黄色头盔，线条利落如机车骑士，黑色面罩将面容彻底遮蔽。一根黑色软管自头盔的呼吸器蜿蜒盘出，像虫子钻入皮下般，穿行进战斗服的结构里。整套服装满是烟灰污痕，处处被灼烧留下焦黑斑块。他们微微扬起头，迎向仍在咆哮的火海，水枪被坚定的双手稳稳架住。面罩内浮现亮绿色文字——虚拟界面源源不断灌入关键信息：热成像读数、不断跳变的罗盘，以及氧气余量。
The firefighter stands tall in their gray bunker gear, the bulky suit alight with an intricate system of wires and sensors. They wear a bright yellow helmet, designed sleek like a biker’s, the black visor totally obscuring their face. A black tube snakes around from the helmet’s respirator, weaving into the suit like a worm burrowing under flesh. Their entire suit is smeared with soot and marred with burnt patches. They cock their head upward, toward the still raging flames, and their aqua-rifle is braced in their resolute grip. Bright green text appears in the visor, a virtual display feeding them vital information like thermal readings, a constantly shifting compass, and oxygen levels.

Paladin Quip About Wickedness.name:
圣武士对邪恶的俏皮话
Paladin Quip About Wickedness

Text.text:
“击倒你的不是我的剑，而是你那卑劣的行径……然后才是我的剑。”
“It was not my sword but your wicked ways that brought you down… and then my sword.”

转过拐角，一只拟形怪潜伏着——一场背叛的幻象，披着财富的外衣。它伪装成一只装得满满、仿佛盛着无限可能的宝箱，却在表象之下藏着贪婪的巨口。箱盖歪斜掀开，露出掠食者的嘴，蠕动的长舌来回抽打。底座上装饰的咧笑骷髅夸耀着往日的盛宴——像你这样的旅人，正是它最爱的佳肴。
Around the corner lurks a mimic, a treacherous illusion of wealth. Its guise, a brimming chest of potential, conceals a ravenous maw. The lid is unhinged, revealing the mouth of a predator, a writhing tongue lashing back and forth. The grinning skulls adorning its base boast of past banquets, folk like you its favorite meal.

石盆里栖居的植株泛着一层浸润般的微光，洒落细小的荧亮孢子，随气流飘荡，映着彩绘玻璃渗入的斑驳日光闪闪发亮。你眼前的花瓣在葱郁的绿与柔美的粉之间来回变幻，而这些植物仿佛因你的到来而轻轻战栗。
The plants residing in stone pots glow with a suffused light, shedding tiny, luminous spores that drift on the air and catch the dappled sunlight bleeding through the stained glass. The petals, before your eyes, shift from verdant shades of green to lovely hues of pink and back, and the plants seem to shudder at your presence.

I Cast Circle Of Death As A Draconic Sor.name:
我以龙族血脉术士之姿，施放「死亡法阵」
I Cast Circle Of Death As A Draconic Sorcerer

Text.text:
我低声向那些早已死去的龙族祖灵呢喃，高举水晶宝珠，珠内阴影翻涌不息。一条幽魂巨龙自宝珠中浮现，缥缈的血肉下白骨森然。它如飓风般从我身旁狂飙而出，凡所触及，尽皆凋亡。
I whisper to the shades of my long-dead draconic forebearers, holding my crystal orb aloft as it churns with shadows. A ghostly dragon emerges from the orb, its bones visible through ephemeral flesh. It rushes from me like a whirlwind, bringing death to all it touches.

一阵如千只昆虫振翼般的嗡鸣——起初还很轻微——自远方滚滚而来，却迅速膨胀为令人窒息的轰响，仿佛剃刀在你耳中刮擦；与此同时，一道漫长而阴沉的黑影覆落在你身上。自天空俯冲而下的，是一只体型骇人的蜻蜓，翼展至少十五英尺。它的四片翅翼以难以理解的速度震颤，使周遭的枝叶都随之翻涌不定。它的皮肤在光线里变换着色泽，由蓝转绿，又从绿晕染成紫。
A drone like a thousand insects’ wings—faint at first—rumbles in the distance, but quickly grows to an overwhelming buzz, like razors in your ears, as a long, dark shadow is cast over you. Descending from the sky is a dragonfly of incredible proportion with a wingspan of at least fifteen feet. Its four wings oscillate at an incomprehensible speed, sending the surrounding foliage into flux. Its skin shifts color in the light, from blue to green to purple.

Newly-recruited Town Guard.name:
新招募的城镇卫兵
Newly-recruited Town Guard

Text.text:
你面前的人类看起来几乎才刚成年：脸颊与下颌还带着圆润的稚气，鼻梁柔和，打理得整整齐齐的黑发将面庞框住——那点可怜的胡茬反倒更衬得他年轻。守卫终于注意到你，戴着手套的手抬起致意。“哈喽，我能帮你啥？”他用一种滑稽的低沉男中音问道。
The human before you seems to be barely an adult: rounded cheeks and jaw with a soft nose, framed by a head of well-kept black hair—a sad attempt at facial hair only serves to emphasize his youth. The guard finally notices you and raises a gloved hand in greeting. "Hullo, can I help ye?" he asks in a comically baritone voice.

当你猛然将双手甩出，一股刺骨的魔法洪流疾冲向你的敌人，将他们裹入奥术寒冰的坟冢之中。你所造之物呈深邃的冰川蓝，坚若山岩。你的仇敌无助地注视着，惊惶的目光来回乱窜，直到他们意识到——自己已被彻底困住。

~ Envisioned by Zima Rel'luin

As you throw your hands out, a freezing torrent of magic rushes toward your enemies, enveloping them in a tomb of arcane ice. Your creation is a deep glacial blue and solid as mountain stone. Your foes watch, helpless, panicked eyes darting back and forth, as they realize they are trapped.

~ Envisioned by Zima Rel'luin

乍一看，这只薄匣子似乎装着抄写员的工具。匣内分隔收纳着各式纸张与墨水、金箔与银箔、刷子与笔，以及充足的蜡料。剪刀、小刀、雕刻器具、皂石与木杆也一应俱全，让这套工具更显完备。然而，后面这些器具里，没几样像是正经写字所必需的。
At first glance, this thin box seems to contain the tools of a scribe. Its compartments hold a variety of papers and inks, gold leaf and silver leaf, and brushes and pens, together with an ample supply of wax. Scissors, a small knife, carving implements, soapstone, and wooden rods round out the tools. Few of these latter implements seem necessary for legitimate writing.

Sundries From An Aranea.name:
来自阿兰尼亚的杂货
Sundries From An Aranea

Text.text:
阿拉妮亚的多只眼睛像死去的黑色石子，失去了曾经闪烁的魔法光辉。一只小袋子绑在这只巨蜘蛛的头后；你一把扯开，辛辣刺鼻的气味猛地扑向鼻腔。袋中塞满了刚采下的草药——以及一只刚被杀死的啮齿动物。
The aranea’s many eyes are like dead black stones, divested of their scintillating magic. A pouch is strapped behind the giant spider’s head; when you tug it open, a cloud of pungent odors assaults your nostrils. The pouch is full of freshly picked herbs—and one freshly killed rodent.

一抹微光攫住你的目光，不过是余光里划过的一道细亮。它倏然掠动，悬停了刹那便疾射而去，身后拖出一串闪烁的孢子光尘。光芒渐黯之际，你只来得及瞥见一个类人轮廓，背后生着蜻蜓般的翅翼。它的面容带着好奇，大而深色的眼睛凝视着你。
A glimmer catches your eye, little more than a streak of light in your periphery. It flits, hovering for a split second before dashing away, leaving a trail of glittering spores in its wake. As its light fades, you catch the briefest glimpse of a humanoid silhouette with dragonfly wings sprouting from its back. It bears an inquisitive face with large, dark eyes.

Waking On The Beach.name:
在海滩上醒来
Waking On The Beach

Text.text:
你在海浪轻拍岸边与海鸥啼鸣中醒来，舌尖还残留着咸味。你睁开眼时阳光刺目得令人眩晕，过了片刻才逐渐适应。海面闪烁着粼粼光辉，海鸥乘着温暖而咸湿的海风掠过天际。身下的金色细沙几乎如丝般柔滑。
You wake to waves lapping at the shore and seagulls crying, to salt on your tongue. The sun is blinding as you open your eyes, and it takes you a moment to adjust. The water glistens and glimmers as seagulls glide on a warm, briny breeze. Under you, the golden sand feels almost silken.

Abandoned Manor Entrance Hall.name:
废弃庄园前厅
Abandoned Manor Entrance Hall

Text.text:
这间方形密室弥漫着泥土与潮湿木料的气味。蛛网覆满墙面与天花板上那深色的雕花木饰。顶板中央垂着一只铁环。尘埃在角落里堆积，铺满并黯淡了大半石质地面——赭褐色大理石铺成的地砖，有的开裂，有的错位翘起。通往老宅更深处的去路被一扇紧闭的双开门挡住，门上浮雕着一头昂首嘶鸣的狮鹫。

~ 由 DracoDMD118 构想

This square chamber smells of dirt and damp timber. Cobwebs cover the dark, sculpted wood lining the wall and ceiling. An iron loop adorns the center of the overhead panels. Dust gathers in corners, and dulls most of the stone floor—tiles of sepia marble, some cracked or askew. A rearing griffin has been carved into the closed double door blocking the way further into the old house.

~ Envisioned by DracoDMD118

有时，心智会向那蜿蜒的深处掘进。肾上腺素称王，残破的躯体化作凶兽，战至最后——痛楚去他妈的。可另一些时候，世上只剩尖叫、赤裸的剧痛与无助，粉碎的身体终于屈服。无论是在斗场被斩首，还是在断头台上受刑，相较这场绵延不绝的残酷之罪，都算得上仁慈。你的生命以沉重的价格被撕扯而去，成为你走过这段旅途的最后见证。
Sometimes the mind digs deep into the serpentine. Adrenaline rules, and the maimed body becomes ferocious, fighting to the end—pain be damned. Other times nothing exists but screaming, raw pain and helplessness, the shattered body giving in. A beheading, either in the arena or on the block, would be a mercy compared to the sin of this lingering brutality. Your life is torn from you at a heavy price, a final testament to the journey you’ve traveled.

Speech By A Melodramatic Wounded Charact.name:
一位受伤角色的夸张独白
Speech By A Melodramatic Wounded Character

Text.text:
“恐怕我就到此为止了，亲爱的诸位同伴。我从未想过我的身子竟能挨下这般折磨，可如今它是真的撑不住了。鼻子发痒，后背酸痛，胸口还有点发紧——不是那种糟糕的紧，但绝对也不正常——我敢发誓，我体内的体液都被搅得一团乱，怕是再也理不清了。若你们现在不医治我，我担心你们将再也见不到我了！”
“I’m afraid this is it for me, my dear fellows. I never knew my body could take such punishment, but now it has truly given way. My nose itches, my back aches, there’s a slight tightness in my chest—not a bad tightness, but definitely not the normal kind—and I swear my humors have jumbled themselves so thoroughly they will never be untangled. If you don’t heal me now, I fear you will never see me again!”

Enchanter's Polo In Water.name:
附魔师的水中马球
Enchanter's Polo In Water

Text.text: [赛前] 这一局里，体育场的草皮被魔法抹去，取而代之的是一汪幽深的湛蓝水池。看台紧贴池沿，观众们换上泳装、短裤和凉鞋，等着在这场手忙脚乱的对抗中不可避免地被水花浇个透。Struttigon们先伸展带蹼的脚趾，随后扑通跃入池中，喉间发出欢快的咕噜声。球员们戴着加厚护目镜，眼睛鼓鼓的，推着坐骑就位；裁判高举口哨，蓄势待发。 [比赛中] Struttigon在水中同样迅捷，如同在陆地上一般。它们细长的蛇形头颅贴着水面掠过，追逐着球体，从泳池一端到另一端像鱼雷般疾射而去。球员最大的难题是稳稳骑在坐骑背上——尤其当他们指挥Struttigon潜入水下，追赶下沉的球体，或躲避其他骑手时更是如此。水面之下，球体与球槌会散发出幽幽的荧光，让观众也能紧盯战况。 [Before the Game] For this game, the stadium’s grassy field has been magicked away, traded for a deep pool of blue water. The stands sit right at the edges of the pool, fans garbed in bathing suits, shorts, and sandals, ready for the inevitable drenching of frantic play. Struttigons stretch their webbed toes before plopping into the pool, their throats gurgling happily. Players, bug-eyed from their heavy-duty goggles, nudge the mounts into position as the referee holds her whistle aloft. [In Play] Struttigons prove as swift in water as they are on land. Slim, serpentine heads skimming the surface, they shoot like torpedoes from one end of the pool to the other in pursuit of the orb. The players’ greatest challenge is staying atop their mounts, especially when they direct the Struts underwater to pursue sinking orbs or evade other riders. Under the surface, the orb and mallets give off a luminescent glow so fans can keep track of play.

Ship Exiting Atmosphere.name:
飞船驶离大气层
Ship Exiting Atmosphere

Text.text:
发射的冲力把你狠狠摔回座椅，飞船在震耳欲聋的咆哮中拔地而起，奋力对抗行星的引力，仿佛渴望挣脱束缚，奔向上方自由的星界之海。你感到G力如同碾压的巨浪袭向全身，在惊人的速度中冲向高层大气，宛如神之手掷出的长矛。随后，一切骤然终止。你在力量消散时松弛地靠回座椅，眼前铺展开一片闪烁的群星。
The force of the launch hurls you back into your seat as the craft takes off with a deafening roar, straining against the planet’s gravity as if it yearns for the freedom of the astral sea above. You feel the g-force assaulting your body like a crushing wave as you hurtle toward the upper atmosphere at astonishing speed, like a spear thrown from the hands of a god. Then it’s suddenly over. You relax into your seat as the force dissipates, and you see the glittering starscape before you.

该法术会让坚硬的物体变得更柔软；而当物体被软化到一定程度时，它将无法再用于原本的用途。此法术效果温和，却要求你全神贯注。一旦你分心，材料便会抗拒你的魔法，使你感到疲惫。
This spell makes a hard object softer, and a sufficiently soft object unusable for its original purpose. The spell is mild but demands your concentration. If you think of other things, then the material resists your magic and fatigues you.

Collapsing Roof Trap.name:
坍塌屋顶陷阱
Collapsing Roof Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 天花板看起来摇摇欲坠，这一点牵动了你的目光，落在那些似乎支撑着它的横梁上。它们看起来做工粗劣，但两根横梁之间绷着的一根绊线——离地仅几寸——暴露出这一切是刻意为之。

[触发！] 你一动，脚踝就勾住了什么。你踉跄了一下，短暂地疑惑那是什么，但紧接着，你的脑海里只剩下天花板坠落砸下时的疾风与轰鸣。

[Perceived] The ceiling looks unstable, and that fact drew your eyes to the beams that seem to hold it up. They seemed like shoddy work, but the trip wire strung between two of the beams, mere inches off the floor, reveals it to be intentional.

[Triggered!] As you move, your ankle catches on something. You stumble, briefly wondering what it was, but then you can think of nothing but the rush and roar of the ceiling falling upon you.

Runes In The Forest.name:
森林符文
Runes In The Forest

Text.text:
你原以为那是树皮上的爪痕，但凑近细看才发现，那些痕迹交错而弯曲，绝非任何野兽所能留下。新鲜的创口正渗出树脂，可它却是刻在更早之前、从更高处淌落下来的旧痕之上。沿着那道痕迹往上追寻，你又看见更高处的树身上还有更多符文般的疤刻——每一道都更结痂、更模糊，几乎难以辨认。这些印记跨越了数十年，甚至数百年；随着树木生长，它们一次又一次被刻下。
You thought they might be claw marks in the tree’s bark, but closer examination reveals them to be crossed and curved in no way that an animal could do. This fresh wound weeps sap, but it was carved through an older dripping from higher up. Following that line, you see more runes scar the tree at points above, each one more scabbed over and less discernable than the last. These marks are the work of decades or even centuries, made repeatedly as the tree has grown.

这根粗壮的硬木短杖顶端嵌着一颗沉重的铁球，铁球周身缠绕着粗野的尖刺，向四面八方张扬伸出。每一枚细小的尖端都在光线下闪着阴毒的寒芒。
The stout rod of hardened wood holds a sizable ball of heavy iron wreathed in brutish spikes that face every angle. Each small point glints maliciously in the light.

Automated Fast-food Place.name:
自动化快餐店
Automated Fast-food Place

Text.text:
全息菜单嗡嗡作响，刺耳的共振像刮刀般擦过你的颅骨，仿佛一只机器人苍蝇被困在玻璃罐里乱撞。这就是如今所谓的食物：一小把焦黑的淀粉薯片，以及夹在硬纸板般面包胚之间的一片苍白营养块。这里的一切都冰冷、自动化，与人类的温度与欲望彻底脱节。

~ 由 Inbal 在 Discord 上构想

The holographic menu buzzes with a grating resonance that scrapes against your skull, like a robotic fly trapped in a jar. This is what passes for food these days: a handful of burnt starch chips and a pale slab of nutrient matter between cardboard buns. Everything in this place is cold, automated, and utterly detached from human warmth or desire.

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

Loot From A Possessed Priest.name:
来自附身神父的战利品
Loot From A Possessed Priest

Text.text:
一只小巧的皮革携行匣躺在那堆血迹斑斑的长袍旁。金属扣环被掀开后，匣盖弹开，露出内里铺着蓝色天鹅绒的衬垫。数支玻璃小瓶嵌在一处处精准成型的凹槽中，每支都盛着不同的液体。一串银珠绳索盘绕其间，宛如一条发光的银蛇；每一枚独立的银珠都刻着唯一的纹样。
A small leather carrying case lies near the heap of blood-stained robes. After the metal clasp is flicked back, the case opens to reveal a blue velvet-lined interior. Glass vials sit embedded in perfectly shaped indentations, each filled with a different liquid. A cord of silver beads coils like a shining serpent, each separate silver piece etched with a singular design.

半透明的绿色箭矢自你伸展的指尖迸射而出，像它那些凡俗的同类一样，带着同等的意图与速度切开空气。它逼近你的敌手时，伴随着一阵熟透般的滋滋作响——响亮而突兀，宛如牛脂滴落在烧得通红的铁板上——随之腾起刺鼻的酸臭味，因为箭矢的酸液已开始溶解它的目标。
The translucent green arrow explodes from your outstretched fingers and slices through the air with the same purpose and speed a its mundane counterparts. As it reaches your foe, a ripe sizzling, loud and sudden like suet dropped on a red-hot griddle, is accompanied by a sour stink as the arrow’s acid begins to dissolve its target.

它的机械结构有些生锈了，因此这只蜘蛛蹒跚前行，腿部发出一串令人烦躁的吱呀尖响。二十四个翼销关节驱动着那些肢体，其中最沉重的几处连在那只如小型飞艇般的躯干上——躯体由多种金属拼补缀成。蜘蛛的脸是一团齿轮与环圈的簇集，眼睛以同心结构围绕着二十四枚微小镜片排列。它的螯肢是磨得锋利的断栓钳，连着躯体内嗡鸣、滴答作响的马达。
Its mechanisms are a bit rusty, so the spider lurches along with a pattern of annoying squeaks from its legs. Twenty-four pinion joints articulate those limbs, the heaviest of them attached to the small blimp of a body patchworked from several metals. The spider’s face is a cluster of gears and rings, eyes concentrically designed around twenty-four tiny lenses. Its mandibles are sharpened bolt cutters connected to motors whirring and ticking inside the body.

Submerged Cave Entrance.name:
没入水下的洞窟入口
Submerged Cave Entrance

Text.text:
历经千百年海浪的凿刻，这座巨大的海蚀洞如今已被海水完全吞没，入口在浑浊的潮水表面下若隐若现。
Gouged out by waves over thousands of years, the massive sea cave has now been entirely flooded by sea water, its entrance barely visible underneath the surface of the murky tide.

Abandoned Mine Storeroom.name:
废弃矿井储物间
Abandoned Mine Storeroom

Text.text:
储藏室里每一寸表面都覆着尘灰，连装着煤块、铁锭、废弃石料以及其他难以辨认的材料的木箱与桶子也不例外。早已腐坏的口粮堆在角落里，静静地休息成一堆。镐子、铁锹、锤子、齿轮、以及一段段绳索沿着一面墙的木架整齐摆放；对面的墙上，提灯从挂钩上垂落摇晃。
Dust covers every surface in the storeroom, including crates and barrels holding coal, iron ingots, castoff stone, and other unidentifiable materials. Rations, long spoiled, rest in piles in the corner. Pickaxes, shovels, hammers, pinions, and lengths of rope are laid out on a wooden shelf along one wall, and lanterns hang from hooks opposite.

这名身披护甲的矮人岿然不动，置身于大师锻造的护甲之中，战斧蓄势待发，足以夺命。他蹲伏在宛如壁垒的巨盾之后，双脚牢牢钉在地面上。任何愚蠢到想要攻击这座矮人冷峻坚毅堡垒的人，很快就会为此追悔莫及。
This armored dwarf stands resolute, encased in master-crafted armor, axe ready to deal death. He crouches behind his bulwark-like shield, planting his feet. Anyone foolish enough to attack this bastion of dwarven stoicism will soon regret doing so.

Harvest Fruit Festival.name:
丰果丰收祭
Harvest Fruit Festival

Text.text:
歌声与笑语充盈空气，村民们沉醉于丰收节的欢愉，尽情享受这季节赐予的秋日丰饶。装饰铺满整座城镇——连果园也不例外——一排排色彩鲜亮的彩旗延绵不断，其间点缀着用根茎蔬菜雕成的灯笼。寒凉的微风拂过渐染秋色的树叶，沙沙作响，人们把斗篷裹得更紧；热腾腾的香料苹果酒不断流淌，欢乐的游戏接连上演。

~ Dwayne 于 Discord

Song and laughter fill the air as the villagers enjoy the delights of the harvest festival, reveling in the autumnal bounty of the season. Decorations adorn the entire town—including the orchard—in row upon row of brightly colored bunting replete with lanterns carved from root vegetables. A chill breeze rustles the turning leaves, and cloaks are pulled tighter as hot, spiced cider flows and merry games are played.

~ Dwayne on Discord

Wheezing Zombie.name:
喘鸣丧尸（特征）
Wheezing Zombie

Text.text:
一声刺耳的呻吟，仿佛石磨石般摩擦，从这具复起的人形枯槁肺腑与喉咙里嘶嘶挤出。它的皮肉几乎只剩湿纸般挂在脆裂的骨架上，腐臭渗浆，随着蛆虫与蠕虫在其中翻涌而抽动。痛楚、煎熬、迷惘——那生物凹陷的面孔扭曲成一副骇人的人类表情残影，踉跄挣扎着向前，拖着一条废腿，每一步都伴着战栗的颤抖。它逼近时朝你猛挥一爪，腐烂与泥土的气味扑面压来，你能感觉到它参差断裂的利爪只差几寸便擦中你。它眼窝深处燃烧的火焰只唤起一种感觉、一种原始的需求：饥饿。
A rasping moan, like stone against stone, wheezes from the desiccated lungs and throat of the risen humanoid. Their flesh, little more than wet paper draping brittle bones, stinks and oozes as it writhes with worms and maggots. Pain, agony, confusion—the creature’s gaunt face contorts into a horrific semblance of human expression as it struggles forward, dragging its useless leg with each shuddering step. It swipes at you as it draws near, the stench of rot and earth overpowering, and you feel its jagged, broken claws miss you by mere inches. The fires blazing in the hollows of its eyes evoke one feeling, one base need: hunger.

Techno Divination Drug, Spectralize: Inj.name:
科技占卜药剂「灵谱化」：注射剂
Techno Divination Drug, Spectralize: Injected

Text.text:
药剂在你体内化开，一阵尖锐的痛楚猛地刺进你的眼底。灼烧感层层攀升，像不断加速的强音，很快变得令人难以忍受。你死死闭紧眼睛，绝望地不让光漏出去。然后……疼痛退潮般回落。你微微掀开一只眼睑，清澈如洗的明晰感迎面而来，你环顾四周：世界原封不动，而它的代码却被揭开。每一面表层、每一个节点、每一个许可点，都亮起可见的代码光纹。这就是赛博空间。你的身体也在嗡鸣，迸发出清晰可辨的光，你自身的代码同样在发亮。

~ 一位英雄所构想

The drug dissolves into you, and a sharp jolt of pain flickers into your eyes. They burn with a rising crescendo of pain that soon becomes excruciating. You squeeze them shut, desperate not to let the light out. And then… the pain recedes. A wash of clarity greets you as you crack an eyelid open and look around: the world as-is, its code revealed. Every surface, every node, every access point glows with its code on display. This is cyberspace. Your body hums with an obvious light, your own code glowing too.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Sundries From A Young Gold Dragon.name:
来自幼年金龙的杂物
Sundries From A Young Gold Dragon

Text.text:
破碎的金色鳞片像龙穴里被丢弃的钱币般散落满地；不远处城镇的旗帜挂在尽头的墙上，边缘被火燎过，焦黑蜷曲。
Tattered golden scales litter the floor like discarded coins in the dragon’s cave, and the flag of a nearby town hangs on the far wall, its edges scorched and blackened.

Loot From A Rust Monster's Victim.name:
锈蚀怪物受害者的战利品
Loot From A Rust Monster's Victim

Text.text:
你发现了一名冒险者的尸体，他没能逃过这些生物贪婪的饥饿——他的铁剑被啃噬殆尽，只剩包着皮革的剑柄。所幸，你仍能从尸体上搜出其他物品：一只小钱袋，里面有一笔不多的银币，以及一瓶药水。
You discover the dead body of an adventurer who did not escape the voracious hunger of these creatures—his iron sword devoured up to the leatherbound hilt. However, you are able to salvage other items from the corpse: a small coin pouch, with a modest sum of silver, and a single potion.

这只生物后半身如同捕猎的蜘蛛，腹部覆着褐色茸毛；前端却是一颗与颈项相连的鳗形头颅，浅褐皮肤紧绷，獠牙森然。它的眼睛细小，乌亮如漆，从那张大张的巨口上方窥视着你。颈侧毛簇丛生，环绕着细小的角，又有一绺垂落在下颌。六条昆虫般的腿自躯体伸展而出，末端颜色逐渐加深，尖锐如刃。身体前部还生着两条臂状肢体，末端分成两枚带爪的指节。颈根处，它披着一袭丝滑的蓝色披肩，身上束着皮革挽具，系着一只饰纹繁复的挎包。
This creature has the rear body of a hunting spider, brown fur covering the abdomen, and a head and neck like a fanged, tan-skinned eel. Eyes, tiny and glossy black, peer from just over its gaping maw. Hair clusters on the neck, surrounding tiny horns, with another bunch hanging from the chin. Six insectile legs, each darkening toward a sharp tip, extend from the body. To the fore, armlike limbs end in two clawed digits. At the base of the neck, the being wears a silky blue mantle and a leather harness with an ornate satchel attached.

该死的浓雾笼罩着前方的道路，视线被压缩到不过几码之外。它的接触冰冷而潮湿——黏附在你的衣物与发丝上。你打了个寒战，把斗篷更紧地裹在身上，却发现它也早已湿透。你仍旧硬着头皮前行，尽力沿着道路摸索，在行进间透过雾幕张望。你发誓自己看见雾中有什么在移动——黯黑的影子在视野边缘来回窜动，忽隐忽现，始终隔着那一点点看不清的距离。但你摇摇头……只是光影作祟，你这样说服自己。
The damnable mist shrouds the road ahead, obscuring sight beyond a few yards. Its touch is frigid, wet—it clings to your garments and hair. You shiver and clutch your cloak tighter about yourself, but find it too is sodden. You press on, following the road as best you can, peering through the fog as you go. You swear you see things moving in the mist—dark shapes darting here and there just beyond your sight. But you shake your head . . .  just a trick of the light, you convince yourself.

Nightmare About Being Buried Alive.name:
被活埋的噩梦
Nightmare About Being Buried Alive

Text.text:
你在一处令人窒息、毫无光亮的空间里醒来。空气里是潮土与松木的气味，你的肩膀紧贴着两侧。耳中嗡鸣与自己的呼吸打破死寂。只有你的气息搅动这点空气。温热的液体滴在脸上，你本能抬手去擦，指节却刮过满是木刺的粗糙木板。你伸直双脚，触到一面坚硬的阻挡；再一探，头顶前方约一英寸处也竖着另一面。你无法坐起，也无法翻身侧滚。空气愈发灼热、愈发浓稠。

~ Envisioned by BigMacDaddy

You awaken in a stifling, lightless space. It smells of earth and pinewood, and your shoulders touch the sides. The thrumming in your ears and your breathing break the quiet. Only your breath stirs the air. Warm liquid drips on your face, and the hand you instinctively lift to wipe it away scrapes against splintery wood. Extending your feet, you find a solid surface. Another, you find, stands an inch or so from your head. You can’t sit up or roll on your side. The air grows hotter and thicker.

~ Envisioned by BigMacDaddy

每只项圈都呈马蹄形。其中一只是一道抛光银弧，两端各镶着一枚圆润光滑的银球，做工简洁，只需套上便能扣在纤细的上臂。另一只为青铜所铸，尺寸足以绕颈佩戴；它被繁复地火纹锻造成Ω形，闪亮的表面嵌出叶片纹样，末端卷曲，几乎盘成螺旋。
Each torc is shaped like a horseshoe. One is a curve of polished silver with a smooth globe at each end, simply crafted to be slipped onto a thin upper arm. The other is bronze, large enough to be worn around the neck. It is elaborately flameworked into the omega shape, with leaf designs crafted into the gleaming surface. The ends of it curl to near spirals.

Stalked By A Gnoll.name:
被豺狼人盯上
Stalked By A Gnoll

Text.text:
当你在幽暗的荒野中艰难开路时，风里忽然掠过一缕气味——淡淡的、发酸的腥味，像是被露水浸透的皮毛斗篷。你抬手示意停下，驻足四顾，可那气味转瞬即逝——等等，那是树枝折断的轻响？你望向你的伙伴，却再无别的声息传来，除了你自己一下一下的呼吸。半分钟后，你再次动身，但那种爬上脊背的、原始的直觉挥之不去：有什么东西，正在盯着你。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

As you forge your way through the dark wilderness, you catch a whiff—a faint, sour smell on the wind, reminiscent of a fur cloak sodden with dew. You stop to look around, holding your hand up to indicate a halt, but the scent is lost—wait, was that a twig snapping? You look to your companions, but no further sounds reach your ears, save your own breathing. After half a minute, you set out again, but you cannot suppress the crawling, primal instinct that you are being watched.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Raiders Disrupt Backwater Festival.name:
劫掠者搅乱偏僻小镇的节庆
Raiders Disrupt Backwater Festival

Text.text:
节庆的氛围骤然炸裂——就像熟透的番茄砸向示众台上的市长——火焰开始舔舐那些斑斓的帐篷与篷车。欢笑的呼喊化作尖叫，第一股血被割开，溅洒在鹅卵石路上，如同猩红的暴雨。胜利的咆哮与征服的战鼓，为这肆虐、蔓延的混乱擂响节拍。

~ 由 The_DM 在 Discord 上 构想

The festive atmosphere bursts—like the ripe tomatoes being hurled at the pilloried mayor—as flames begin to lick at the colorful tents and wagons. Cries of merriment turn to screams as the first gout of blood is drawn, spattering across the cobbles like sanguine rain. Roars of triumph and the drums of conquest accentuate the rampant, expanding chaos.

~ Envisioned by The_DM on Discord

Act Three Of Pierced By Moonlight Begins.name:
《月光穿刺》第三幕开始
Act Three Of Pierced By Moonlight Begins

Text.text:
柔和的蓝光淹没舞台。我们的三位主角——薰衣草色衣裙的女人、黑衣的男人、红衣的女人——在一片彩绘湖岸边缘紧紧挤作一团。情人的故事走到了尽头。他们目光沉重，满是悲恸，不愿把注意力移向手中握着的木桩。他们把头向前倾，让所有颤抖的眉梢彼此相触。可就在这时——等等！薰衣草色的女人抬手托起两位情人的下巴，唇边挂着恶魔般的笑，面颊被血红的泪痕划开。“谁敢下令让我们分开？谁能对抗我们的爱……我们的三位一体之力？”音乐骤然翻涌，尖细而不祥的弦音拔高；三人忽然离地而起，手牵着手。血红的布匹如闪电般坠落，覆上他们身后的布景，像深红婚纱拖曳的长长裙裾。

~ Found in the amazing TTRPG supplement The Vineyard

Soft blue light floods the stage. Our three leads—the woman in lavender, the man in black, and the woman in red—huddle together at the edge of a painted lake. It is the end for the paramours. Gazes heavy with sorrow, they are reluctant to turn their attention to the wooden stakes in their hands. They lean their heads forward so all their trembling brows might touch. But then—wait! The woman in lavender lifts up her paramours by their chins, a devilish smile on her lips, face streaked with blood-red tears. “Who can command to keep us apart? Who can stand against our love… our triune power?” The music surges with ominous, high-toned strings and the three suddenly lift off the ground altogether, holding hands. Bolts of blood-red fabric fall over the backdrop behind them like the trains of crimson wedding gowns.

~ Found in the amazing TTRPG supplement The Vineyard

一名神秘的羽民栖在一座摇摇欲坠的教堂之巅，落日余晖将他的剪影勾成一抹阴森的形状——仿佛有意识的虚无。他身形修长，裹着如夜般漆黑的羽衣，几乎与脚下的废墟融为一体；而银色的细纹却在羽间悄然游走，像一张古怪的地图，沿着他蜷伏的躯体缓缓爬行。他以玄武岩般的眼眸俯瞰小镇，目光冷静而精算，在下方熙攘人群中搜寻他的目标。确认无误后，这位暗影复仇者起身，细剑垂在身侧，匕首仍在鞘中沉睡，准备将死亡赠予那些罪有应得之人。

~ 由 Nathan 扮演

An enigmatic featherfolk perches atop a ramshackle church, his silhouette a sinister shape against the setting sun—like a sentient void. His slender frame, sheathed in plumage as dark as night, seems part of the ruins beneath him, although silver streaks subtly play across his plumage like a curious map crawling across his coiled body. With basalt eyes, he casts a calculating gaze upon the town, seeking his target among those bustling below. Satisfied, the dark avenger stands, rapier at his side, dagger sleeping in its sheath, and prepares to bring death to the deserving.

~ Played by Nathan

Agent Argon Of The House Of The Sentinel.name:
哨兵家族的阿尔贡特工
Agent Argon Of The House Of The Sentinels

Text.text:
一个魁梧如山的身影踏出闷燃的黑暗，宛如战争泰坦。尽管体型骇人，他却显得低调内敛：短而竖立的深色刺发，宽阔的肩膀裹在板甲之中，一柄巨大的巨剑斜挂背后。他的护甲经由某种巧妙的冶金工艺处理而更显黯黑，方正的脸右半侧覆着部族纹记。明明显然在刺目的烈日下度过无数战斗日，他的皮肤却仍旧苍白。右手缠绕着神秘的奥术纹身，手掌悬停在腰间一把小巧却雅致的弩上。他以漫长而锐利的目光扫视房间，刹那间，那双祖母绿的眼眸深处有微弱的能量一闪而过。

~ Played by Ararion

A colossal figure strides out of the smoldering darkness like a titan of war. Despite his size, he appears discreet: short, spiky dark hair, broad shoulders enclosed in plate armor, and a huge greatsword hanging from his back. His armor has been darkened by some clever metallurgic technique, and a tribal marking covers the right side of his square face. His skin remains pale despite clearly having spent many a battle day beneath harsh sunlight. An arcane tattoo of mystical make swirls about his right hand, which hovers over a small but elegant crossbow at his waist. He scans the room with a long, piercing gaze, and for a moment something behind his emerald eyes twinkles with a faint energy.

~ Played by Ararion

Fistfight Among Petty Drunks.name:
一群醉鬼的小打小闹
Fistfight Among Petty Drunks

Text.text:
湿漉漉的脸上淌着汗、口涎与血。油腻的细雨把这团狼藉又添一层，污浊的水洼在他们踉跄的脚边一圈圈绽开。围观的人寥寥无几，从那起哄的劲头看，多半是醉汉的狐朋狗友，正扯着嗓子给他们拱火。“过来啊！”其中一个醉汉低吼着，拳头歪歪斜斜地抡向对手。对面那人留着鼠尾似的发型，湿得塌陷发蔫，身子一偏就闪开了，嘴角攒起一抹令人作呕的弧度。她咕噜咕噜吐出一句恶毒的污言秽语，随即从腰间撞上去将他抱摔，两人翻滚着砸进碎石地。人群里有一半爆出得意的欢呼，她骑在他身上猛揍，带护甲的机车手套撕扯着他那醉眼朦胧的脸。
Sodden faces drip with sweat, drool, and blood. The greasy drizzle of rain adds to the mess, and dirty puddles blossom around their staggering feet. A meager crowd, the drunks’ friends based on the way they're clamoring, eggs them on. “C’me here!” One of the drunks growls as he flings his fist sloppily toward his adversary. The opponent, her rat-tailed hairdo soggy and wilting, swerves out of the way, a nauseous curl building about her mouth. She gurgles out a nasty slur as she tackles him at the waist, sending them tumbling to the gravel floor. A triumphant cry rises from half the crowd as she beats on him, her armored biker gloves tearing away at his bleary expression.

Snilloc's Snowball Swarm.name:
斯尼洛克的雪球虫群
Snilloc's Snowball Swarm

Text.text:
一阵雪团凭空爆裂而出，呼啸飞掠，落地时砸出一记记沉重闷响。霜寒的齐射结束后，空气里亮起点点闪烁的雪花，轻柔地飘落在地。
A flurry of snowballs erupts from thin air, flying, to land with a pummel of powerful thumps. At the end of this frosty barrage, the air lights with glittering snowflakes, which fall softly upon the ground.

Forest Birds: Relaxation.name:
森林鸟鸣：放松
Forest Birds: Relaxation

Text.text:
鸟鸣在高高的树冠间回荡，风掠过枝梢，层层起伏，发出宛如海浪拍岸的沙沙声。片刻间，你仿佛正穿游于一片翠绿海洋的幽暗深处；然而，这份遐想很快被灌木丛某处一只雉鸡粗野刺耳的咯咯怪笑打断。
Birdsong echoes about the treetops high above, where the wind moves the branches in waves creating a sound like ocean surf. For a moment you imagine yourself swimming through the shadowy depths of a green sea, but that reverie is broken by the raucous cackle of a pheasant somewhere in the shrubs.

甜腻的香气、令人目眩的灯火、俏皮的乐声——一切交织成一层朦胧薄雾，将你不由自主地牵引进去。一个帐篷里，肩宽背阔的巨人血裔生物在喧闹人群的欢呼声中举起一块巨石；另一个帐篷里，驯兽师安抚着搭档——那头进行表演的枭熊——翻涌的怒意。长长一排排摊位与棚车连绵展开，提供游戏、甜点，以及来自世界各地奇异而迷人的小饰物。人们穿梭奔走，迫不及待要看遍每一道景象、尝遍每一口甜味、挑战每一项游戏。
The smell of sweets, the dizzying lights, the playful music—it all coalesces into a kind of haze, and you find yourself drawn in. In one tent, a broad-shouldered giant-blooded creature lifts a boulder to the cheers of a raucous crowd. In another, a beast tamer calms the ire of their owlbear performing partner. Long rows of booths and stalls offer games, treats, and strange and alluring trinkets from all over the world. People rush around, eager to take in every sight, try every sweet, attempt every game.

I Notice Thieves' Signs.name:
我注意到盗贼的暗号
I Notice Thieves' Signs

Text.text:
因无知而不可见，我在门道上瞥见的细小刻痕，就那样明晃晃地藏在眼前。多数人只当是寻常又无意义的涂鸦破坏，行里人却能从中读出机遇的标记。
Invisible through ignorance, the small signs I see etched into a doorway hide in plain sight. Where many see common, nonsensical vandalism, those in the trade see markers of opportunity.

Loot From A Wight.name:
来自尸妖的战利品
Loot From A Wight

Text.text:
在食尸鬼战士那具干枯的尸体上，你发现了一只由钢丝编织而成的手镯，被塑造成两头狼在无尽轮回中厮杀的图案。以它目前的状态来看，这件物品大概值2枚金币。
On the desiccated corpse of the ghoulish warrior, you find a bracelet of woven steel fashioned to depict two wolves battling in an endless cycle. In its current condition, the item is probably worth about 2 gold pieces.

Desert-dwelling Druid.name:
栖居沙海的德鲁伊
Desert-dwelling Druid

Text.text:
德鲁伊微微一笑，锋利的五官顿时染上一抹令人不安的掠食者气息。他低身蹲伏，抓起一把沙子。猫一般的眼睛细细审视着从他炭灰色指缝间坠落的沙粒，他用一种诡异的蛇语低声呢喃，你惊愕地看着，那坠落的沙子竟如河流般自行淌走。

~ Inbal 于 Discord

The druid smiles, causing his sharp features to take on an unsettling predatory look, and crouches low, picking up a handful of sand. Scrutinizing the grains falling between his charcoal-colored fingers with catlike eyes, he whispers in a strange serpentine tongue and you watch in amazement as the falling sand flows away like a river.

~ Inbal on Discord

Bridge Spanning Chasm.name:
横跨深渊的桥
Bridge Spanning Chasm

Text.text:
桥梁悬在一道深渊之上，下方数千英尺处，怒涛翻涌的河流咆哮奔腾。两侧峭壁如刀削般陡直。桥本身看起来还算结实：木板铺就，以粗重的麻绳牢牢系在两端崖壁上——然而当你踏上桥面，感到体重压进吱呀作响的绳索时，你不禁怀疑，是否还有更轻松的渡过方式。
The bridge hangs over a chasm with a raging river thousands of feet below. The cliffs on either side are sheer. The bridge itself seems sturdy enough, consisting of wooden planks secured with heavy, hempen rope to either cliff—but as you step onto the bridge deck, and feel your weight settle into the creaking ropes, you wonder if there might be an easier way to cross.

Hard-nosed Military Officer.name:
铁腕军官
Hard-nosed Military Officer

Text.text:
灰白短发贴着头皮，深而参差的疤痕纵横其间，一双钢铁般的眼睛透着凛然威势。这男人踏入房间时与你对视——在衡量你——机械义肢腿沉重地敲击地面，铿锵作响。
Closely cropped gray hair, deep, ragged scars, and steely eyes give this man a palpable air of authority. He meets your gaze—assessing you—as he walks into the room, his mechanical leg clanking noisily on the floor.

Lost, Flowing Fountain.name:
迷失的、流淌的喷泉
Lost, Flowing Fountain

Text.text:
透过地城墙壁的裂口，你听见水声。走进去，你发现一座美丽、洁净无瑕的喷泉，不见半点腐化或朽败；晶莹剔透的泉水在无尽的循环中轻轻翻涌、咕嘟作响。狭小洞窟里的空气清冷而新鲜，水池之上的雕像张开双臂，以温暖的微笑向你招手，仿佛在邀请你靠近。也许，你的运气正在好转。

~ David on Discord

Through the breach in the dungeon wall, you hear water. Inside, you find a beautiful, pristine fountain free of corruption or decay, its crystal-clear waters bubbling softly in an endless cycle. The air in the small cavern is cool and fresh, and a statue atop the basin beckons you forward with open arms and a welcoming smile. Perhaps your luck is turning.

~ David on Discord

Sudden Bloom Of Flora.name:
繁花乍绽
Sudden Bloom Of Flora

Text.text:
浓郁的腐殖土气息先一步袭来，紧接着一阵猛然的疯长自下方迸发，宛如喷薄的火焰破土而出。根须贪婪地攫取着一切，拖拽着自身向上攀升，旋卷的荆蔓随之追随。转瞬之间，荆蔓绽放出数种色彩的花朵，花粉沉甸甸地覆满其间。
The rich scent of loam precedes a sudden burst of growth, emerging from below like an erupting flame. Roots grasp eagerly, pulling themselves upward, and spiraling brambles follow. In an instant, the brambles blossom in several colors, laden with pollen.

那只眼睛清醒无畏，引领着喙与利爪的锋锐工具。鹰翼展开，如秋叶般的色彩在振动间沙沙作响；它从树上腾起，在田野上空来回滑翔，割裂空气，宛如一柄挥舞的长镰。
That eye is awake, dauntless, the guide for the sharp tools of beak and talon. The hawk’s wings fan out and rustle in the colors of autumn leaves as it rises from the tree to glide back and forth above the field, cutting the air like a scythe.

Dagne, Bride Of Ruin, Escapes.name:
达涅，毁灭之新娘，逃脱
Dagne, Bride Of Ruin, Escapes

Text.text:
达格妮把手抬到近乎贴着脸。你听见她对着那枚没有宝石的戒指低声呢喃：“我的爱，他们不会听——他们不会看。我们必须让他们看见。”她的面纱在战斗的抽搐中被撕裂、微微下垂，露出底下脸庞的些许轮廓。你看见一片灰白的秃顶头皮，稀疏的白发像细丝般贴着，上面布满血痂凝结的凹痕。昆虫在受伤的皮肉上爬行。一只钳虫扭动的躯体更深地钻进丝绸里，一只蟑螂发出非人的尖啸跌落在地。它的身体撞上地面时，烟雾轰然爆开，瞬间裹住达格妮。烟雾散去，她已不见踪影。只剩下她的爪牙们，玻璃般的眼睛里盛满哀伤。
Dagne brings her hand close to her face. You hear her whispering into the gemless ring. “My love, they will not listen—they will not see. We must make them see.” Her veil, now torn and sagging slightly after the throes of combat, reveals hints of a face underneath. You see a balding gray scalp covered sparsely in thin strands of white hair and blood-crusted indentations. Insects creep over the wounded flesh. The writhing body of a pincher bug burrows deeper into the silk as a roach falls to the ground with an unearthly shriek. When its body hits the floor, a cloud of smoke erupts and shrouds Dagne. The smoke fades and she is gone. Only her henchpeople, their glassy eyes full of sorrow, remain.

Banishing Smite In Action.name:
放逐重击实战
Banishing Smite In Action

Text.text:
伴随着我高吼一曲对我信念绝对奉献的圣歌，一股神秘的、裹着力场的能量洪流吞没了我的武器，为其烙上幽光般的强大异彩。每一次挥斩，都有一波震耳欲聋的能量抽击而出，撕开敌人的防御。辉芒如暴风倾泻，敌人随之崩散成一缕消逝的薄雾，被从现实的经纬中彻底抹除。

~ Envisioned by master_builder75

On roaring a hymn of utter dedication to my cause an enigmatic surge of force-sheathed energy engulfs my weapon, emblazoning it with spectral hues of might. With each swing, a wave of vociferous energy lashes out, ripping aside enemy defenses. In a storm of brilliance, the foe dissolves into a vanishing mist, erased from reality's tapestry.

~ Envisioned by master_builder75

Inside A Bustling Automated Factory.name:
在一座喧嚣运转的自动化工厂内部
Inside A Bustling Automated Factory

Text.text:
在这座自动化工厂内，制造的喧嚣震耳欲聋，机器以毫厘不差的效率各司其职。冰冷的空气裹挟着燃料那股冷峻而无菌的气味，惨白的墙壁上不见一扇窗，也不留半点个性。
The clamor of fabrication is deafening inside the automated factory as machines go about their tasks with unerring efficiency. The chill air carries the clinical scent of fuel, and the stark white walls are utterly devoid of windows or personality.

Wild Magic Surge: Lightning Strikes.name:
狂野魔法涌动：闪电劈落
Wild Magic Surge: Lightning Strikes

Text.text:
当你释放法术时，奥术能量在体内越聚越盛，震得你耳膜发胀。纯粹的魔法在你头顶凝成一团细小、噼啪作响的雷云。它眼看就要爆裂，但你觉得自己还能引导它迸射的电光。你迅速扫视四周，寻找合适的目标。
As you release your spell, a buildup of arcana makes your ears pop. Raw magic takes the form of a tiny, crackling thunderhead above you. It is about to burst, but you think you can guide its bolts. You glance around for some likely targets.

Alien Planet With Vibrant Flora.name:
异星星球与绚烂繁茂的植被
Alien Planet With Vibrant Flora

Text.text:
飞船舱门外，一片生机炽烈的世界在两轮白色太阳下铺展开来，其中一轮较小。高耸的紫罗兰与靛青色巨树立于眼前，细长的树干托起宽大而扁平的叶片，挤满覆着猩红草海的丘陵。成簇的植被攀附在苍白岩石上，又沿着数处绿松石色的水潭与溪流铺陈开去。一阵恒定的微风搅动草浪、树叶与水面——若那确是水的话。四下不见任何生物的动静，唯有在树干与乱石之间，矗立着优雅外星建筑的破碎残垣。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Outside the starship hatch, a vibrant world spreads under two white suns, one smaller than the other. Lofty violet and indigo trees with thin trunks and big, flat leaves crowd hills covered in scarlet grasses. Tufts of this flora cling to pale rocks and line several turquoise pools and streams. A steady breeze stirs the grass, leaves, and water—if water it is. No creatures stir, but amid the trunks and stones stand the shattered ruins of elegant alien structures.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Maison De Scélérat, A Floating Pirate To.name:
恶棍之家，一座漂浮的海盗城镇
Maison De Scélérat, A Floating Pirate Town

Text.text:
在汪洋深处，远离守法海岸的视线，你撞见了一片庞大的漂浮船阵：无数船只首尾系泊，拼凑成一座临时城镇，几乎看不见半个讲原则的人。放眼望去，几乎每隔一层甲板不是喧闹的酒馆，就是船坞工棚，连一个陆地佬的影子都找不到。沿着这片无赖乐土的一侧，一座规模相当可观的造船场被搭建起来，像是东拼西凑，却样样齐全——足够一支不那么合法的船员修理或改装船只，甚至还有干船坞。对这样险恶的港口来说，倒也合适：在这座海盗之城里，凡是有点名气的人脑袋上都挂着悬赏，只能时刻提防王家私掠舰与武装商船的追捕，过着亡命奔逃的日子。四处可见的贡多拉船夫穿梭于水道之间，靠摆渡营生，成了本地的交通命脉。

~ Envisioned by Pirate lord

In the middle of the ocean, nowhere near the shores of the law-abiding, you have come across a massive floating array of docked boats, a makeshift town utterly bereft of principled individuals. Every other deck seems to be either a raucous cantina or a boathouse, and there is nary a landlubber to be found. Along one side of this scalawag's paradise, a respectably large shipyard has been erected, seemingly piecemeal, but featuring everything that a less-than-legal crew would need to repair or upgrade a ship, even a dry dock. A good thing for such a treacherous port, as anyone worth their salt in this city of buccaneers has a bounty out for them and must constantly live on the run from royal corsairs and privateers. Hither and yon, gondoliers ply their trade as local transportation along the canals.

~ Envisioned by Pirate lord

Restaurant's Android Servitor.name:
餐馆的仿生侍者
Restaurant's Android Servitor

Text.text:
身着光洁锃亮的红色塑料品牌制服的侍役机敏捷地冲上前，在客人踏入店内的瞬间便迎上去致意。它覆有合成皮肤，五官表情夸张得近乎过度，勉强能传达些情绪，与顾客周旋互动。它以夸饰的鞠躬姿态接下订单，随即以近乎过载的高效在桌间滑行穿梭，端送分毫不差，精准而具速度。
The servitor in a sleek branded uniform of gleaming red plastic rushes to greet patrons as they enter the establishment. Synthetic skin and over-expressive features enable it to somewhat convey emotions and interact with the customers. With an exaggerated bow it takes their orders, then with hyper-efficiency it scoots about the tables serving with precision and speed.

Deranged Mongrelfolk.name:
癫狂的杂种人
Deranged Mongrelfolk

Text.text:
黑暗在这下面耍着花招，无尽的石质甬道回荡着远处的呢喃与吱吱啮鸣。你几乎要把前方壁龛里那团从阴影中滑脱出来的东西，当作摇曳光线的把戏，可那畸形的人形轮廓根本无法忽视。兽裔民——他们的躯体是人与兽诡异的拼接——自黑暗中现身：起初只有零星几个，继而十余个踏入视野。他们憔悴、羸弱，踉跄在几乎承受不住体重的腿上。饥荒。饥饿。而现在……正看着你。

~ Envisioned by Christian

The darkness plays tricks down here, and the endless stone tunnels echo with distant whispers and chittering. You almost dismiss the shadow dislodging itself from an alcove ahead as a ploy of the wavering light, but the misshapen humanoid form cannot be ignored. Mongrelfolk, their bodies an uncanny mingling of man and beast, emerge from the darkness—a few at first, then a dozen step into view. They are haggard, frail, staggering on legs too weak to carry them. Starving. Hungry. And now… looking at you.

~ Envisioned by Christian

A Distant Fortress In A Winter Forest.name:
冬林深处的远方堡垒
A Distant Fortress In A Winter Forest

Text.text:
历经七小时跋涉，你终于站上了一座高丘的顶端。寒风凛冽，拍打在身上，比寻常的冬日冷风更刺骨。四野起伏如浪，森林铺展至地平线，甚至更远——一片苍白的海，尽是无叶纠结的树群。万物都披着这个时代里频繁降下的雪，被冬日早早西沉的阳光照亮。

有一道狭长蜿蜒的空隙，像是河流留下的痕迹，在林间蛇行，将树木分开；它轻轻绕过这座山丘的脚下，又一路延伸，消失在天边之外。

在这片天然的景致中，几乎被掩住的，是文明的一丝性相。那似乎是一座石造建筑，宽阔而坚固，树梢之上还能看见屋顶边缘的女儿墙。从这般距离望去，它静默无声，像是无人守护；也许你们明天就能触及那里。
At the end of seven hours of travelling you stand atop a tall hill, a chill wind buffeting you even more than the usual winter breeze. The landscape around you undulates, the forest stretching to and possibly beyond the horizon, like a white sea of leafless knotted trees. All is dressed in the snow that so often falls this time of year and lit by the early-setting winter sun. A small sinuous clearing left by a river snakes its way through this forest and parts the trees, gently curving around the base of this hill and continuing to beyond the horizon. Almost hidden within this natural landscape is an aspect of civilization. It looks to be some sort of stone structure, wide and sturdy, with a parapet lining the rooftop visible above the treetops. From this distance it appears motionless and unmanned; perhaps you’ll be able to reach it tomorrow.

天空转为诡异的绿色，狂风哀号，奏出送葬的和弦。厚重的云团如同围成一圈仪式之环般聚拢，中心黑暗而空洞。无论是强大的魔法，还是天地之间潜伏能量的一缕碎影，有什么被惊动、被聚焦——一场毁灭的盛典，以扭动的锥形蜿蜒下坠。它挟着碎屑轰然触地，随即向你疾冲而来！
The sky turns green and the wind wails a funeral chord. Muscular clouds gather in a kind of ritual circle, dark and empty at the center. Be it powerful magic or a mere fraction of the latent energy between earth and sky, something is stirred, focused—a pageant of destruction that slinks downward in a writhing cone. It touches the ground with a spray of debris, and races toward you!

猿啼在远处回荡，嚎声掠过浓密的荒野。你听见更远处传来一阵窸窣，那是绝望追逐的声响——捕食者坠落般扑向猎物。这条河蜿蜒自山间而下，穿过丛林，想必也藏着属于它的掠食者，因为几乎没人敢横渡它的急流。头顶的树冠与藤蔓沉沉垂落，交织成一条天然的隧道，将河道本身笼在幽暗之中。
Apes call in the distance, howling across the dense wilderness. You hear a distant rustle, the sound of a desperate chase—a predator falling upon prey. This river, snaking its way down the mountain and through the jungle, must house predators of its own, for few dare traverse its currents. The trees and vines hang heavy overhead, creating a sort of natural tunnel over the river itself.

Rary's Telepathic Bond.name:
拉瑞的心灵联结
Rary's Telepathic Bond

Text.text:
你与自愿参与者们彼此贴近站立，你以言语与手势编织起一道心灵连结，并逐一指向每个人。法术结下纽带，将每个目标与他者相连，织成一张认知之网，宛如微弱电光在其间跳跃。施法结束时，你发觉自己的思绪能够旅行至所有如今以心灵相系之人，并被他们清晰理解。
You and your willing participants stand close to one another as you weave a mental link with words and motions, pointing to each one. The spell creates bonds, connecting each target to the other in a cognitive web like faint electricity. As the casting ends, you find your thoughts can travel to and be understood by all of those now psychically bonded.

High Elven Judge Seeking Infiltrators.name:
追缉渗透者的高等精灵法官
High Elven Judge Seeking Infiltrators

Text.text:
你注意到一位成熟的高等精灵女战士，身披半身板甲、外罩垂坠披风，却仍以从容的优雅滑行般穿过贵族狂欢的人群。她周身萦绕着敬畏与恐惧的气场，连位高权重的王室成员也会在她行经之处自觉让路。趾高气扬的贵族们向她点头致意，以肃穆的口吻念出她的名字，像是在承认某种无法违逆的裁决：奥莉珊娜法官。她一侧胯间挂着长剑，另一侧则是短剑。锋利而冰冷的目光在人群的每一张脸上筛过、掂量，试图捕捉任何一丝阴毒的企图。她继续前行，终于与你四目相对——一阵覆霜般的惊惧猛地沿着你的肩胛骨之间窜下。
You notice a mature high elven warrior, gliding through the noble revelers with an easy grace despite the half plate and draping cloak she wears. An aura of respect and fear moves even the highest-ranking royalty from her path. Proud nobles nod at her and speak her name in somber acknowledgment: Judge Ollishanna. On one hip she carries a longsword, a shortsword on the other. Her sharp, cold gaze sifts and considers each face for some hint of nefarious motive. As she proceeds, her eyes finally meet yours—and a shock of frosted fear races down between your shoulder blades.

Abandoned Child In Rags.name:
破衣烂衫的弃儿
Abandoned Child In Rags

Text.text:
谁会把她丢在这里？你看见她的那一刻，心口一阵绞痛——一个可怜的孩子，孤零零地发着抖，在这间阴沉的房间角落蜷成一团；她被难以承受的悲伤折磨得浑身战栗。怜悯压过了谨慎，你冲向那个抽噎的小流浪儿，急切想给她些安慰……就在这时，她转过身来。她的双眼燃起地狱般的怒焰，露出尖利的獠牙，喉间滚出低沉粗哑的咆哮。
Who would leave her here? Your heart aches as you see her—a poor child, alone and shivering—trembling with unbearable sorrow, huddled in the corner of the dismal room. Your compassion overrides caution and you rush to the sniffling waif, eager to offer comfort… then she turns to you. Her eyes glowing with infernal fury, she growls, deep and low, while baring pointed fangs.

那件皮斗篷悬在半空，仿佛正披在一个隐形人的肩上。它缓缓转身，像是察觉到你在它身后，斗篷随之敞开，露出苍白湿腻的肉质内侧——其上嵌着一张丑恶的脸，裂开一张布满利齿的巨口。一条细长带倒刺的尾巴从褶皱间舒展开来，而你此刻才明白，那所谓的“斗篷”其实是它的双翼。
The leather cloak hangs in the air, like it is being worn by an invisible man. It turns slowly, as if sensing you behind him, and the cloak opens, revealing a pale fleshy interior that bears a hideous face with a toothy maw. A long, barbed tail unfurls from the folds of what you now know to be the thing’s wings.

Shameless Social Media Tastemaker.name:
毫无羞耻的社交媒体风向制造者
Shameless Social Media Tastemaker

Text.text:
如果那男人注意到街上所有人都在躲着他、用异样的目光打量他，他也丝毫不在意。他一边大声对着挂在耳边的麦克风说话，一边原地旋转；他的左眼被改装过，每次“咔嗒”一声都能听得见，镜头迅速合拢又张开，连连拍下那串烤肉——食材在霓虹般的彩虹色光辉中幽幽发亮。
If the man is aware that everybody on the street is avoiding him and giving him looks, he doesn't seem to care. He spins as he loudly talks into an ear-mounted microphone, his left eye configured to audibly click as it snaps pictures of a kebab whose ingredients glow in a rainbow of neon colors.

Sword In A Plinth Of Stone.name:
石座中的长剑
Sword In A Plinth Of Stone

Text.text:
岁月的重压笼罩着此地。你能感觉到无数战士、法师与更多人曾在这里试炼锋芒——却终究不够资格。那柄华丽精致到近乎奢靡的利刃深深嵌入雕琢的石质剑座，立于高起的台座之上。金属表面流转着虹彩般的光辉，泄露了其受过魔法淬炼的本质，以诱人的闪烁勾引着目光。
The weight of ages hangs heavy in this place. A sense that countless warriors, mages, and more have tested their mettle here—and been found wanting. The exquisitely ornate blade is embedded deeply in a carved stone plinth upon a raised dais. The iridescent shine of the metal betrays its enchanted nature as it glitters seductively.

一名神秘的陌生人潜伏在不远处，披着斗篷伫立。他那一头乌黑的长发如墨色触须般蜿蜒蠕动，仿佛自有生命，裹挟着久远年代的隐秘。双臂抱胸，他注视着你，仿佛正衡量你的命运。在他身边，现实的边界微微摇曳，远处骰子滚动的声响仿佛在嘲笑你的困境。
An enigmatic stranger lurks nearby, standing cloaked. His long sable hair writhes like ebon tendrils, alive with secrets of ages past. With folded arms, he gazes upon you, contemplating your fate. In his presence, the boundaries of reality waver, and the distant rattle of dice seems to laugh at your plight.

四肢沉重、黑发浓密的奥尔登贝里家族，常生着歪而宽的鼻梁与钢灰色的眼睛。作为谷地黑文家的宿敌，这个家族凭借自家那片小葡萄园与勾魂般的乡间餐馆——再加上一块轮作玉米与大豆的田地——积攒起可观的财富。他们的宅邸是一座用粗木搭起、横向铺展的猎人式大屋，终日派对与盛宴不断，炉火边永远有人忙着下厨。风一旦向东吹，整个北林角的人都会被奥尔登贝里家飘出的香气施了法术般牵引。可奥尔登贝里的农场与魔法师学院的地界之间，只隔着一条枫与松的断带，于是谷地黑文家便时不时挑动镇民大会，把对任何“魔法化”的苛刻裁断推上台面。
Heavy-limbed and dark haired, the Oldenberrys tend to have crooked, broad noses and steel-gray eyes. Rivals to the Valehavens, the family has made its considerable wealth from its small vineyard and tantalizing country restaurant, along with a field rotating corn and soybeans. Their house is a rough-timbered, sprawling lodge of parties and feasts, where someone is always cooking. When the wind blows eastward, everyone in the North Coppice falls under the spell of the aroma from the Oldenberry house. However, the Oldenberry farm is separated from Enchanter Academy grounds by only a break of maples and pines, so the Valehavens try to stir the occasional town hall meeting into hard judgments against any magickifying.

这座以石块与砖砌成的狭长洞窟式建筑充作囤放收集货物的仓库。高高叠起的木箱、成堆垒放的酒桶、捆扎的羊毛、卷起的布匹、如丘般的篮筐与各色杂物，被整齐编排成一排排纵贯建筑全长的货列。地面的石板上刻着一个个矩形格子——每格都标着字母与数字——显然是某种管理系统的一部分。某处必定有一本账册，把这一切都登记在案。
This long cavernous building of stone and brick serves as a storehouse for collected goods. Tall stacks of crates, piled casks, bales of wool, rolls of fabric, heaps of baskets and other items have been organized in rows running the length of the building. The stones of the floor have been etched with rectangles—each assigned a letter and number—apparently part of a management system. There must be a logbook somewhere that records it all.

你高举手臂挥洒一撮硫磺落地，同时吐出一个浸透信仰之力的真言。刹那间，一道擎天巨柱般的烈焰自苍穹咆哮坠下，火海中贯穿着蓝白色的神性能量裂光，化作铺天盖地的圣怒洪流，正正轰落在硫磺触地之处。
With an overhead motion you cast a pinch of sulfur to the ground while simultaneously uttering a word tinged with the power of your faith. A Brobdingnagian column of flame, shot through with blue-white streaks of deific energy, roars down from the heavens in a massive display of holy wrath to land where the sulfur touched the ground.

Sundries From An Atomy.name:
原子学杂项
Sundries From An Atomy

Text.text:
被派出去的原子妖看起来活像一株被连根拔起的杂草。对一般类人生物而言，这妖精身上似乎没有任何值钱之物：一顶用作头盔的猎鹰皮革罩帽，以及一串由三枚闪亮铜币组成、颇为华丽的项链。
The dispatched atomy looks like nothing so much as a plucked weed. The fey does not appear to possess anything of value to an average humanoid: a falcon’s leather hood worn as a helmet, and a string of three shiny copper pieces as a glamorous necklace.

Whispers Of The Void.name:
虚空低语
Whispers Of The Void

Text.text:
虚空如一条令人窒息的毯子裹住你，层层压迫你的感官；在无情的寂静里，你的心跳轰然作响。思绪被放大，像脱缰的猎犬般在脑海里尖啸，肆意狂奔，撕扯着你脆弱的心灵。

~ 由 Ameria 在 Discord 上构想

The void surrounds you like a smothering blanket, pressing in on your senses as your heartbeat thunders in the relentless silence. Thoughts are amplified, screaming through your mind like unleashed hounds, running rampant across your delicate psyche.

~ Envisioned by Ameria on Discord

他抬手掠过自己雪白的长发，将那层如丝的面纱别到尖耳之后。金色的眼眸里翻涌着熔金般的怒意，仿佛两座坩埚嵌在浅灰色的肌肤上。黑色板甲以尖刺的螺旋缠绕着他的躯干，他腰侧的长剑材质与工艺都诡异难辨。剑刃在变幻的光线下更迭色泽，时而像一段泛红的漆木长条，时而又化作一把阴狠的银色弯刃。

~ 由一位英雄 扮演

He passes a hand through his long white hair, tucking the silken veil behind his pointed ear. His golden eyes simmer with molten ire, like two crucibles set into his light gray skin. Black plate armor coils about his torso in spiking whorls, and the longsword at his side is of strange make and material. The blade’s hue shifts in changing light, transitioning between a length of reddish lacquered wood to a wicked, silvery saber.

~ Played by a Hero

Experienced Defense Attorney.name:
资深辩护律师
Experienced Defense Attorney

Text.text:
这名律师比大多数人都更懂法庭那支繁复而精密的舞步；多年的历练让他们在那些想捞个轻松胜利的年轻新贵面前占尽先机。他们以不可动摇的中立姿态为当事人据理力争——无论对方被指控了什么——从不让个人的道德立场或傲慢心气横加干扰。
This attorney knows the complex dance of the courtroom better than most, their years of experience giving them an edge over the young hotshots looking for an easy win. With implacable neutrality the lawyer argues on behalf of their client—whatever they have been accused of—never letting their own ethical stance or hubris interfere.

Illaneth Faewyse.name:
伊兰奈丝·费薇斯
Illaneth Faewyse

Text.text:
盾牌圆形的钢面在光里一闪——像一只巨大的银眼，悬在一名通体黑衣的战士背后。兜帽斗篷薄如影，覆在乌黑的锁子甲上，点点微光如午夜星河。她行云流水般抬手将兜帽向后一推，露出瀑布般的乌鸦黑长发，簇拥着一张月色般苍白、惊艳绝伦的面庞。

~ 由 Kris Essler 扮演

The shield’s circular steel face glints in the light—a great silver eye hanging on the back of a warrior dressed all in black. A hooded cloak hangs shadow-thin over jet-black chainmail, twinkling like the midnight cosmos. The warrior pushes back her hood with a fluid motion, revealing long tresses of raven-black hair crowning a moon-pale face of remarkable beauty.

~ Played by Kris Essler

High Elf Changing Appearance To Summer.name:
高等精灵变换外貌：夏之形态
High Elf Changing Appearance To Summer

Text.text:
盛夏精灵肤色如金，性相温暖，周身散发着季节炽情的欢庆。它们极易被唤起投入行动，却也反复无常，动辄动怒，甚至睚眦必报。它们吟唱久远战事的歌，也唱未来战火的歌；长剑入手的次数，与竖琴相当。

~ 构想：Galvatron

The summer elf is gold of skin and warm in aspect, radiating the celebration of the season’s passion. Easily awakened to action, this elf can be mercurial, easily angered, even vindictive. They sing songs of wars long gone and wars to come, and the sword comes to hand as often as the harp.

~ Envisioned by Galvatron

I Stop A Javelin With My Shield.name:
我用盾牌挡下投枪
I Stop A Javelin With My Shield

Text.text:
当标枪刺穿我的盾牌时，冲击的力道扭转了我的身体；沉重的枪头将我往下拽。震颤沿着手臂传来，肩头疼痛骤然绽开，苦楚在肌肉间层层扩散，可我的皮肤依旧毫发无伤。
The force of the blow twists my body when the javelin punctures my shield, its weighted tip dragging me down. Pain blooms in my shoulder as the shock travels through my arm, sending ripples of agony through my muscles, but my skin remains unmarred.

Small Unit Tactics: Bounding Overwatch.name:
小队战术：交替掩护前进
Small Unit Tactics: Bounding Overwatch

Text.text:
断续而急促的锤击声充斥空气，武器骤然开火，弹丸撕裂而去，直扑那些惊恐的敌人——他们正慌乱地四下奔窜，寻找任何可用的掩蔽。队伍其余成员如同一个紧密的整体向前推进，迅捷的移动充分借助警戒火力的掩护，趁势突进。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

Staccato hammering fills the air as the weapon opens fire, projectiles tearing toward the terrified foes now scrambling for any available cover. The rest of the team moves forward as one cohesive unit, their swift movement making full use of the overwatch fire to advance.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

High Elf Outpost In The Faerie Plane.name:
妖精位面的高等精灵前哨站
High Elf Outpost In The Faerie Plane

Text.text:
在森林永恒的暮光之下，从地面几乎难以察觉，这座前哨由数处雅致的圆形平台组成，高高架设在枝桠之间。平台上点缀着小巧而轻盈的亭舍，用于栖身与储藏。更小的警戒岗台环绕着较大的平台，穿过林木间隙便能取得良好的视野。粗糙的藤蔓盘绕树干，形成便于攀爬的落手之处。
All but invisible from the ground in the forest’s perpetual twilight, the outpost is comprised of several elegant, rounded platforms set high among the branches. Upon them are small, graceful pavilions for shelter and storage. Smaller guard-stands surround the larger platforms, providing good sight lines through the trees. Rough vines curled around the trunks provide easy surfaces for climbing.

Desert Under Moon And Stars.name:
月星之下的沙漠
Desert Under Moon And Stars

Text.text:
踏上柔软回弹、月光轻吻的沙地，你发现自己伫立在一幅神秘的全景之前。沙漠如同浩瀚的银色海洋向远方铺展，沙丘起起落落，仿佛温柔的波涛。高空之上，群星织成天幕的薄纱，以璀璨的光辉为夜空描绘出流淌的光泽。叹息般的风拂过面颊，带着温暖的轻抚。
Stepping onto the yielding, moon-kissed sand, you find yourself before a mystical panorama. The desert stretches like a vast silver ocean, dunes rising and falling like gentle waves. High above, the stars form a celestial veil, painting the sky with their gleaming luminescence. A sighing wind teases your face with a balmy caress.

某群七年级学生发明了这道共用法术，必须由懂门道的团体口耳相传。召术者在一团块头不小、肌肉感十足的云层下，围拢在任何日常交通工具的车轮旁吟诵咒文。云团随即下沉，塑成与其云种相称的载具外形：这些年里，平流层跑车、积雨云怪物卡车不知诞生过多少。成形的载具保留凡俗原型的一切物理细节，唯独通体半透明。
Some group of seventh-years came up with this communal spell, which has to be passed along by a group in the know. Under a good-sized, muscular-looking cloud, the enchanters gather around a wheel from any quotidian vehicle to recite the chant. The cloud descends and assumes the shape of a vehicle appropriate to the cloud’s type: many a stratus sports car or cumulonimbus monster truck has been formed over the years. The vehicle retains all the physical details of its mundane counterpart, apart from being translucent.

Muddy Tournament Challenges.name:
泥沼比武挑战
Muddy Tournament Challenges

Text.text:
半液态的泥土轰然炸开，骑士啪地一声砸进地里，溅起一片泥浆，随即一动不动。几名侍从慌忙冲来，脚下打滑连连，拼命把她从泥水里拖出来，免得她溺毙。胜者高举一柄沾满烂泥的巨剑，得意示威，随即又尽量维持体面，踉跄着想离开赛场。带着明显的惴惴不安，接下来的两名斗士挪步踏入泥沼——双臂像舞者般伸展着保持平衡——他们的颜色在厚厚的污泥覆盖下几乎难以辨认。
With an explosion of semi-liquid earth, the knight hits the ground with a splash and lies still. A group of squires runs, slipping and sliding, to save her from drowning. The winner of the combat raises a muddy greatsword in triumph before trying to leave the field with as much dignity as possible. With obvious apprehension, the next two combatants struggle into the quagmire—arms held out like dancers—their colors barely visible beneath the coating of grime.

卫兵一手攥着一小袋坚果，另一手把一颗坚果抛向空中，试图用嘴接住；大约一半时候能成功，掉落的食物他也懒得去捡。他用手指和牙齿撬开硬壳，在抛掷与啐壳之间来回交替，把两半壳片朝几英尺外地上放着的一只小锡杯吐去、掷去。
The guard holds a small sack of nuts in one hand and uses the other to toss a nut in the air so he can catch it in his mouth, succeeding about half the time and not bothering to fetch the fallen food. He pries the shells apart with his fingers and teeth, alternating between tossing and spitting shell halves at a small tin cup he’s set on the ground a few feet away.

Fib Zayedpoor, The City-dwelling Ranger.name:
诓言·扎耶德普尔，城居游侠
Fib Zayedpoor, The City-dwelling Ranger

Text.text:
这瘦长的流浪儿身上带着肮脏街巷的气味，乌黑的长发与胡须纠结成团，油腻黏重。污垢在他的皮肤与破布衣衫上晕开斑痕。背上那把精致的短弓、斗篷下箭袋鼓起的轮廓看似格格不入，可那些褴褛并未能遮住他身上被污渍浸透却仍细心上油的皮甲，也遮不住他腰间那条皮带——上面挂着数柄长刃，插在磨损斑驳的刀鞘里。他的黑眼睛清澈，搜寻着……精准无比。指节嶙峋，他那双筋骨分明的手看起来结实、粗糙、随时可用。几道又长又深的疤痕无声诉说：他从战斗里活了下来，哪怕未必赢过。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

He smells of unclean streets, this lanky waif, and his long black hair and beard are tangled and greasy. Dirt stains his skin and his rags. The fine shortbow hung on his back and the bulge of a quiver under his cloak might seem out of place, but his tatters fail to conceal the stained yet oiled leather that protects his body and a belt holding several long blades in battered sheaths. His dark eyes are clear, seeking… precise. Knobby at the knuckles, his wiry hands look strong, rough, and ready. A few long and deep scars speak of battles he has survived if not won.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Defiant Captain Of Damaged Ship In Battl.name:
战斗中伤舰的不屈舰长
Defiant Captain Of Damaged Ship In Battle

Text.text:
她昂然立于舵位，烈焰在船身四周吞吐。船长啐了一口在甲板上，随即挽起袖子，眼中燃着凶狠的决绝。她冲船员咆哮，要在几乎不可能的劣势前站稳脚跟，要让敌人付出远不止鼻青脸肿的代价。她又对炮术军官暴喝下令：“降下盾牌，开火！”她那泪痕斑驳的脸上，浮起一抹令人胆寒的笑。
Standing defiant at the helm, the ship burning about her, the captain spits on the deck then rolls up her sleeves with fierce determination. She roars at her crew to stand firm in the face of impossible odds, to give the enemy more than a bloody nose. She bellows a command at the gunnery officer: “Drop shields and fire!” A dreadful smile appears on her tear-streaked face.

Loot From A Vampire Knight.name:
来自吸血鬼骑士的战利品
Loot From A Vampire Knight

Text.text:
在倒下的不死战士颈间，你发现一枚惊艳的铂金吊坠——刻着精灵文字——价值2500枚金币。它被铸成一条沉睡巨龙的模样，双翼收拢；握在掌心分量十足，在月光下闪烁着虹彩般的微光。
Around the fallen, undead warrior’s neck, you find a stunning platinum pendant—engraved with elven script—worth 2500 gold pieces. Wrought in the likeness of a sleeping dragon with folded wings, it weighs heavy in your palm as it glimmers, iridescent in the moonlight.

Fake Arrow-catching Shield.name:
假“接箭”盾
Fake Arrow-catching Shield

Text.text:
你的敌人试图在远处把你射成刺猬，你举起那面专门施过魔法、用来抵御此类威胁的盾牌。你呼吸一滞，一支箭矢笔直贯穿而来，几乎就要刺入你的身体。盾牌确实拦下了这一箭——只是慢了半拍，距离近得令人心惊。
Your foe attempts to feather you from afar, and you raise your shield that’s been specially enchanted to defend against such threats. Your breath hitches as an arrow pierces straight through, just shy of puncturing you. The shield certainly caught the arrow, but a little late and too close for comfort.

这面怪异的盾牌似乎由一种未知的金属合金锻造而成，散发着异界般的力量。嗡鸣自物品中渗出，金属的回响无处不在，却又难以捕捉其源头。盾面的隆起与斜坡让它看起来像个针垫——只不过那些“针”并不存在，这物品的用意是用来接住飞来的箭矢。
The strange shield appears forged of an unknown metal alloy which radiates with an otherworldly power. A hum emanates from the item, a metallic reverberation omnipresent and yet difficult to discern. The raised, sloped surface of the shield evokes the appearance of a pincushion, except instead of needles, the item is intended to catch arrows.

一股带毒的腐肉与泼洒内脏的恶臭扑面而来，狠狠撕咬着你的感官。你的身体屈服于干呕般的呜咽。随后，你透过泪水糊住的双眼看见了它——一团踉跄蠕行的混合物：拉丝的污水与腥腐的脓浆纠缠在一起，踩着结晶粪便凝成的腿，淌着污迹向前挪动。它的腹部被硬生生嵌进一具半消化的尸体，溃烂到满身渗泪般的脓疮，几乎已辨不清轮廓。你的恐惧陡然腾起——那具尸体在生物缓慢的吞噬中仍在扭动挣扎。紧接着，两条糊满污秽的肢体从怪物身上分开，摸索着伸向你，试图把你也添进它的收藏。
A noxious waft of rancid meat and spilled intestines mauls your senses. Your body surrenders to a gagging sob. Then, through tear-smeared eyes, you see it. A shambling amalgam of stringy sewage and fetid pus sluices forward on legs of crystalized feces. Mashed into its midsection is a half-digested body so festered with weeping boils that it's almost indiscernible. Your horror soars as the body writhes against the creature’s slow consumption. Then, two smeared appendages separate from the monster and grope toward you as it attempts to add you to its collection.

Syntyche Qui-thonas.name:
辛提刻·奎-索纳斯
Syntyche Qui-thonas

Text.text:
白袍垂覆在这位苍白女子纤细的身形上；她一头笔直的银发，赤红的眼眸，更添几分空灵。她以沉静的专注守夜般注视着。右手里，她把玩着一柄折起的白色阳伞，伞面以蓝线缝制，与袍摆的边缘相映成趣。自唇心至下颌，一道猩红细痕与她的眼色相呼应——此刻，那双眼正被一只胖脸花栗鼠吸引，它正攀爬在她的上半身四周。

~ Played by Daetrin_Kiri

White robes drape the slight form of this pale woman, her straight silver hair and red eyes adding to her ethereal look. She watches with calm attention. In her right hand, she fiddles with a folded white parasol, stitched in blue to match the hem of her robes. A crimson line from the center of her lip to her chin matches her eyes, which are now drawn to a fat-cheeked chipmunk climbing around her upper body.

~ Played by Daetrin_Kiri

Ruminations On Cults.name:
对邪教的沉思
Ruminations On Cults

Text.text:
寻常人坠入邪教头目甜言蜜语的陷阱，理由千千万万。有人为权势，有人为安稳；还有一些——真正令人胆寒的家伙——只为疼痛的寄望。无论缘由如何，邪教徒的双眼都燃烧着近乎不可动摇的狂热与虔诚。
Ordinary folk have myriad reasons for falling victim to the honeyed words of a cult leader. For some it is power, others security, and for some—truly frightening individuals—it is the promise of pain. Whatever their reason, the eyes of cultists burn with nigh-implacable zeal and devotion.

Elderview Court In Winter.name:
冬日的远景庭苑
Elderview Court In Winter

Text.text:
这处庭院除了从埃尔德维尤大厅出来的人，或附近商用建筑的行人外，几乎不见多少脚步往来。喷泉的水既未关闭也未冻结，仍几乎无声地落入最底层——在灰蒙蒙的天空下，水池幽暗不透。最高一层边缘垂着几缕细小冰锥，使它看上去像长满了獠牙。
The court doesn’t garner much foot traffic aside from those leaving Elderview Hall or the commercial buildings nearby. The waters of the fountain are not shut off nor frozen over, and continue to fall nearly silently into the bottom tier—its pool dark and opaque under the gray sky. Small icicles hang from the highest tier, giving it a toothy look.

I Cover The Ground In An Oil Of Slipperi.name:
我用一层滑腻油膜覆满地面
I Cover The Ground In An Oil Of Slipperiness

Text.text:
这半磅浓稠的黏液看起来坚实得根本倒不出来，但它偏偏就倒得出来。恶心。等我把容器一倾，缓慢的黏团像一片会反光的玻璃般在地面上铺展开来。只要沿着它的表面轻轻接触一下，我就知道没人能轻松从上面穿过去。
The half-pound of thick ooze looks too solid to pour, but pour it does. Disgusting. When I dump the container, a slow blob expands over the ground like reflective glass. Just a touch along its surface tells me no one will have an easy time crossing it.

这套笨重的护甲看上去像厚皮革，但其各个部件的浅奶油色皮面内侧却衬着耀眼的纯白绒毛。它看起来既温暖又沉重，可当你把它提起时，却意外地轻盈。皮甲上仍留着战斗使用过的痕迹，但就像真正的皮肤一样，这些伤处已结成疤痕，愈合其上。
This bulky armor looks like thick leather, but the pale cream-colored skins of its pieces have brilliant white fur on the inside. It looks warm and heavy, but it feels surprisingly light when you lift it up. The hide armor shows the signs of having been used in combat, but like true skin, the armor has scarred over these injuries.

Griffon Eager To Fly.name:
狮鹫迫不及待想要振翅高飞
Griffon Eager To Fly

Text.text:
野兽挪动重心，焦躁地抖动着翅膀。这景象当真令人屏息：这生物将狮与鹰融为一体，成就了比两者都更宏伟、也更致命的存在。它咔哒一声啄响喙尖，你从它的眼中读到勇气——以及野兽中罕见的狡黠。它用匕首般大小的利爪刮擦石面，迫不及待要振翅腾空。
The beast shifts its weight, flicking its wings anxiously. A true sight to behold, the creature mingles lion and eagle, resulting in something grander and more deadly than either. It clicks its beak, and in its eyes you sense courage—and a cunning rare in beasts. It scrapes talons the size of daggers along the stone, eager to take flight.

Stepping Into A Portal.name:
踏入传送门
Stepping Into A Portal

Text.text:
你向前踏出一步，本能地伸出一只手，仿佛想挡住那你知道终将攫住你的魔法。你最先在脚趾与指尖感觉到它——电流般的战栗，伴随着被牵拽的拉扯感。寒意席卷全身，而在它漫过你的同时，你被一点一点带往遥远之地。
You put a foot forward and instinctively reach out a hand, as if trying to fend off the magic you know will take hold. That’s where you feel it first—your toes and fingertips—an electric thrill accompanied by a pulling sensation. A chill washes over you and as it does, it brings you bit by bit to someplace far away.

Beacon Of Hope.name:
希望灯塔
Beacon Of Hope

Text.text:
你像祈祷般低声呢喃出最后一句咒语，手掌画出一道圆弧，在心眼中将同伴们一并拢入共同而守护的怀抱。你感到魔法的力量穿过你的身体，流向他们；随即，你看见他们的面容明亮起来。他们也同样感受到了。
You murmur the final phrase like a prayer and make a circular motion with your hand, enclosing your allies in a collective, protective embrace in your mind’s eye. You feel the power of the magic flow through you and out to them, then you see their faces brighten. They feel it too.

Threat From A Dangerous Lord After A Fai.name:
失败的任务后，来自危险领主的威胁
Threat From A Dangerous Lord After A Failed Quest

Text.text:
“你空手而归，一事无成，还指望我同情？！你耗费了我的时代，而这笔账你欠着。宽恕是稀罕的奢侈品。要是你想从我这里讨到一星半点，就给我滚回去，把它挣回来。”
“You return to me empty-handed and unsuccessful and expect sympathy?! You have spent my time, and for that, I am owed. Forgiveness is a rare commodity. If you wish for a pittance of mine, you’ll have to get back out there and earn it.”

Set Hunting Trap.name:
设置狩猎陷阱
Set Hunting Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 荒野中崎岖的小径上遍布盘根、落叶与纠结的灌木残枝。前方不远处有一片地方显得不对劲，覆盖得几乎过于严密，仿佛那些自然之物被刻意摆放，用来遮掩下面的什么。

[触发！] 你以为找到了安全的落脚处，却立刻被现实打脸——天地翻转。一道结实的绳结猛地勒紧你的脚踝，狩猎陷阱应声触发，将你拽离地面，悬在空中来回摇荡，四周却偏偏够不着任何可抓握之物。

[Perceived] The rugged path in the wilderness is spotted with roots, fallen foliage, and other gnarled undergrowth. Something ahead a short ways looks off, almost too covered, as if the natural elements have been positioned to conceal something underneath.

[Triggered!] You thought you found a safe place to step but are proven wrong when the world goes upside down. A strong knot tightens around your ankle as the hunting trap triggers, dragging you into the air and leaving you swinging just out of reach of anything to grab on to.

Victory Line About Stories.name:
关于故事的胜利台词
Victory Line About Stories

Text.text:
“在你永远离开之前，求你告诉我——当你意识到自己不过是别人故事里的一行脚注时，那是什么滋味？”
“Before you depart forever, please, tell me how it feels to realize you were just a footnote in someone else’s story?”

Shadow Fey Throne Room.name:
影妖精王座厅
Shadow Fey Throne Room

Text.text:
你穿行在一片阴森的树林里，树干纤细而苍白。脚步声愈发轻微——地面覆被从干叶与枯枝，悄然过渡为一整张柔厚的苔藓地毯。眨眼之间，树木仿佛化作巨柱，向上触及高空，将夜幕黑色的以太勉力托在岌岌可危的位置上。生物的剪影浮现，徘徊在柱列之外，彼此说话，发出一种混杂的土语：啮齿般的吱吱细语、短促的鸟鸣、吱呀作响的枝肢与窸窣翻动的叶声。你前方，一张由乌木雕成的宽椅空置着，座面与扶手上蒙着一层落叶的薄尘。隐匿的侍从以饥饿而期待的目光注视着你，你几乎能感觉到——此地的统治者，或许只隔一瞬、一息之遥。

~ 由 Crystallynn 在 Envisioned 构想

You pass through the looming forest of thin, white-trunked trees, your footsteps becoming ever quieter as the groundcover transitions from dried leaves and twigs to a carpet of plush moss. In a blink, the trees become pillars that reach high above to hold the black ether of the night sky in its precarious place. Silhouettes of creatures appear, lingering beyond the columns, speaking in a patois of rodent-like chitters, clipped birdsong, creaking limbs, and rustling leaves. Ahead of you, a wide chair carved from ebony sits empty, a layer of leaves dusting the seat and arms. As the hidden attendants watch you with hungry, anticipatory eyes, you feel as though the ruler of this place might only be a moment, a breath, away.

~ Envisioned by Crystallynn

Billiard Room Of A Creepy Manor.name:
阴森庄园的台球室
Billiard Room Of A Creepy Manor

Text.text:
这间台球室窗边垂落的猩红帷幕，颜色与鲜血泼洒后恰好一分钟时别无二致。台面绒布也闪耀着同样的色泽——那层掩蔽看起来像是凝结成块，而非出自匠人之手铺陈。房间餐边柜上方，一幅远祖肖像阴沉逼视，肥厚的唇上僵挂着令人不快的笑容。
The crimson curtains shrouding the windows of this billiard room are the exact color of spilled blood precisely one minute after it has been spilled. The identical shade is also resplendent in the felt of the table’s surface—the cover appearing to have coagulated rather than been laid out by an artisan. Above the room’s sideboard the portrait of a distant ancestor looms, an unpleasant smile plastered across fleshy lips.

Armor Of Invulnerability.name:
无敌护甲
Armor Of Invulnerability

Text.text:
这套板甲仿佛是靠柔韧的玻璃拼合而成。构成主体的亮闪金属甲片之间，并非以锁子链相连，而是嵌着某种透明材质的关节。最离奇的是头盔——本该遮面的部位竟换成一块圆润的坚硬水晶，宛如晶石面罩。
This suit of plate armor seems held together by flexible glass. The shining sheets of metal that form the major pieces have joints of some transparent material between them, in place of links of chain. Most curiously, the helmet has what looks like a rounded piece of hard crystal instead of any normal face protection.

Ancient Armory With Obsolete Weapons.name:
陈旧兵械库，堆满过时武器
Ancient Armory With Obsolete Weapons

Text.text:
你猛力把锈蚀的金属门扯开，门轴发出刺耳的尖啸抗议，一股恶臭的气流猛地涌出，将你裹住。待双眼逐渐适应地堡内的黑暗，你看见一排排武器被固定在墙上的架子里整齐列着——不由得烦躁地叹了口气。技术太古老了。尽管仍能使用，这些武器早在漫长岁月前就已淘汰，与今日的武备相比黯然失色。
The rusted metal door screams in protest as you wrench it aside, and a rush of foul-smelling air envelops you. As your eyes adjust to the darkness within the bunker you see rows of weapons held in racks fixed to the walls—and let out a sigh of exasperation. The technology is ancient. Though still functional these weapons have been obsolete for eons and pale in comparison to the armaments of today.

这头怪诞的畸形巨物，皮色与皮质都像一只巨大的牛蛙，却比地行鲨更为庞大；它自沼泽巢穴中缓缓现身，肥腻的身躯上水幕成片滑落、哗啦直淌。它用两只如巨石板般的脚稳稳立住，粗壮的腰腹处伸出数条触手，四下探寻，意图抓住轻易得手的猎物，拖进那参差不齐的巨口里，在宽阔的腹腔中慢慢消化。你正以为已摸清它的攻击路数，它却舔了舔嘴角——这才看清那条可卷可伸的长舌两侧布满锯齿般的倒钩。生物猛地打了个响亮的嗝，腥臊恶臭的热息喷涌而出，竟连这片湿腐泥沼本就浓烈的气味都被它压了下去。

~ 构想：R4v3nous_DM

Resembling a bullfrog in the color and texture of its hide, this grotesque monstrosity, larger than a bulette, emerges from its swampy home—great sheets of water streaming off of its blubbery form. Balanced on two slab-like feet, several tentacles grow from the creature’s massive midsection, seeking to grasp easy prey to drag into its jagged maw and digest in its capacious belly. Just when you think you have sussed out its points of attack, it licks its chops, and you notice the length and jagged hooks along the sides of its prehensile tongue. The creature belches loudly, its rank breath dwarfing even the natural odors of this marshy bog.

~ Envisioned by R4v3nous_DM

一张精灵的面孔，以冷硬的雪花石膏棱角雕刻而成，从摊开在她面前图书馆桌上的古老巨册里、那片原初涂鸦般的墨迹中抬起。她的黄绿色双眸散发出深邃的聪慧，琥珀色的虹环随着千般念头而扩张收缩。她微微偏头——这细小的倾斜与她身姿那严苛的几何平面形成鲜明对立——并轻巧地将齐肩短发较长的一侧别到尖耳后。她从高领长裙的褶皱间抽出一根扭曲的心材魔杖，指向角落里的盆栽，吐出渗着奥秘流质的古老音节。她挑起的眉梢，是她看着植物腐朽成灰时唯一的满足痕迹。忽然，一只机械蛛形体从她裙装的暗袋里弹出。叮当作响、齿轮嗡鸣，它疾冲过去，接住正在坠落的灰烬，随后取回一份样本，供她博学而冷静的检视。

~ Played by a Hero

An elven face, sculpted from hard alabaster angles, looks up from the primordial scrawl inked into the ancient tome lying open on the library table in front of her. Her chartreuse eyes radiate a profound intelligence, their amber rings dilating with a thousand thoughts. She tilts her head—the slight inclination in striking opposition to her posture’s strict geometric planes—and delicately tucks the long side of her shoulder-length bob behind a pointed ear. Drawing a twisted heartwood wand from the folds of her high-necked dress, she points it at the potted plant in the corner and utters ancient syllables that ooze arcane liquidity. Her raised brow is the only hint of satisfaction as she watches the plant rot to ash. Suddenly a mechanical arachnid springs from a hidden pocket of her dress. Clinking and whirring, it rushes to catch the falling ash before retrieving a sample for her erudite inspection.

~ Played by a Hero

Academic Camp Outside Jungle Tomb.name:
丛林古墓外的学术营地
Academic Camp Outside Jungle Tomb

Text.text:
陵墓外的营地里挤满了忙碌喧嚷的考据学者，那股喧腾在潮湿的空气中漂浮盘旋，像无数嗡鸣的虫群纠缠着他们。所有人都竭力不去看那道通往陵寝的雕花石拱门；有些人甚至边走边把头埋进书里——效果时好时坏。没人把话说出口，但每个人心里都在打转：进去的那支队伍，究竟发生了什么？

~ 构想：crunchyzombies（来自 Discord）

The camp outside the tomb is filled with a busy hubbub of studious academics, drifting through the humid air like the innumerable insects haranguing them. Everyone does their best to avoid looking at the carved stone archway leading into the mausoleum, with some even going so far as to bury their head in a book while walking—with mixed results. No one speaks the words, but everyone is wondering: what happened to the party that went in?

~ Envisioned by crunchyzombies on Discord

Belligerent, Nature-loving Construct.name:
好斗而热爱自然的构装体
Belligerent, Nature-loving Construct

Text.text:
构装体转过头来，背脊的排气口噗噗喷出蒸汽，发出一声清晰可闻的叹息。“为什么村民要躲着我？我并非不自然之物，也不是机械的怪胎。若要说起来，我比那些排斥我的人还要更自然！我由森林的木材塑成，也取自群山的岩石与矿脉的金属！我与自然界合而为一——它字面意义上就是我的一部分。他们也能这么说吗？”

~ MaesterAelix 于 Discord 上所构想

The construct turns its head, letting out an audible sigh as steam puffs from its dorsal vents. “Why do the villagers shun me? I am not unnatural or a mechanical abomination. If anything, I am more natural than the very people who ostracize me! I am made of the wood of the forest and the very stone and ore of the mountains! I am one with the natural world. It is literally part of me. Can they say the same?”

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

House Infested With Zombies.name:
僵尸盘踞的宅邸
House Infested With Zombies

Text.text:
这栋房子闻起来比看上去腐臭得多。里面没有任何呼吸声，却传来移动的窸窣，最污秽的恶气从每一扇破碎的窗、每一道空洞的门口涌出。随即，在前厅的阴影里，一团不知名的东西拖着步子踉跄穿过地板。是尸体。腐烂的面孔挤满窗框。屋内有什么从椽梁上坠落，砸进一群低沉的呻吟之中。
The house smells far more putrid than it looks. Nothing breathes inside, yet there are sounds of movement, and the foulest air emanates from every broken window and empty doorway. Then, in the shadow of the front room, a clump of something shambles across the floor. Bodies. Rotting faces fill the windows. Something inside falls from the rafters into a mob of groans.

Loot From An Nothic.name:
来自一只诺西克的战利品
Loot From An Nothic

Text.text:
那骇人的噬心爬行者终于一动不动，斑驳的皮肤上伤口累累，利爪蜷曲成拳。它那只畸形的手死死攥着某种护符——系在一截断裂的银链上——幽幽地闪着诡秘的光，柔亮的辉芒透过扭结的指缝清晰可见。
The ghastly mind crawler is finally still, mottled skin a mass of wounds and claws twisted into fists. Clutched in one misshapen hand, an amulet of some kind—affixed to a length of broken silver chain—gleams mysteriously, the lambent glow visible through the gnarled fingers.

Resistance-boosting Drug, Basilisk Blood.name:
提升抗力的药剂，蛇蜥之血
Resistance-boosting Drug, Basilisk Blood

Text.text:
铁锈般的腥气劈开空气，在你鼻腔里灼得发烫。那只纤薄的小瓶中，猩红液体翻涌旋转——一团炽热的炼制血浆凝成海绵般的软块，裹着暗红的凝结。血块以令人作呕的黏滑感一阵阵搏动。吞下之后，使用者的双眼鼓泡般泛起血红，力量在体内奔流。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

An iron scent cleaves the air and singes at your nostrils. Within its thin vial, the crimson liquid swirls, a torrid mass of processed blood forming into a spongy mass of clotted red. The clot pulses with a sickening slickness. Once ingested, the user’s eyes bubble red as strength courses through their body.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Sickening Ray Hitting Player.name:
令人作呕的射线命中玩家
Sickening Ray Hitting Player

Text.text:
恶心在你体内翻涌成一阵炫目的波涛，汗珠在你黏冷的皮肤上颗颗凝起。视野因茫然而摇晃，血液在耳畔轰鸣，如同将你囚进一场令人作呕的感官扭曲风暴；你的腹中开始翻搅。

~ Envisioned by Angie on Discord

Nausea ripples through your body in a scintillating wave as sweat beads on your clammy skin. Your vision swims with incomprehension as your blood thunders in your ears, imprisoning you in a revolting tempest of sensory distortion as your guts begin to churn.

~ Envisioned by Angie on Discord

Tree Hollowed By Lightning Strike.name:
被雷击中而空心的树
Tree Hollowed By Lightning Strike

Text.text:
一截焦黑的树干孤零零立在原野上，翠绿草甸间一名腐朽的哨兵。树皮如木炭般酥脆，连最轻的微风都能将其吹落。围绕着这具树木的骷髅（特征）的一圈死寂焦土，凝固了它被无情的自然一时兴起击倒的瞬间。

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

The blackened husk of a tree trunk stands alone in the field, a decrepit sentinel amid the verdant meadows. Its bark crumbles like charcoal in the mildest breeze. The halo of dead earth surrounding the arboreal skeleton captures the moment it was struck down by a callous whim of nature.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Sundries From A Gnoll.name:
豺狼人带来的杂货
Sundries From A Gnoll

Text.text:
这名豺狼人身上只有一只系在钓线上晃荡的狗头人靴子、一根被啃得满是牙痕的马股骨，以及一片鲍鱼壳碎片。
This gnoll has only a kobold boot attached to a fishing line, a gnawed horse femur, and a chip of abalone shell.

Rahima Al-abbas.name:
拉希玛·阿勒-阿巴斯
Rahima Al-abbas

Text.text:
踏步向前的是正义的神圣化身，巨剑横举在身前。一阵阴冷的狂风猛地掀开遮住她异界容貌的兜帽，露出深到近乎发黑的褐发，其间仅有一缕极致的雪白如刀锋般划过。她裸露的面庞像戴着一副纯粹慈悲的面具；肤色如打磨过的木材般温润，点点雀斑宛若抛光的钱币闪着暗金。那位天裔的双眼微光闪烁，细碎光点在瞳中跃动，审视着眼前的一切，搜寻潜伏的危险。她强健的身躯包裹在华美的板甲护甲之中，肩甲上狮首咆哮。其下别着两枚金色胸针，雕工精妙，昭告着赐福这位圣战士的神祇。

~ Played by a Hero with

Marching forth is the divine incarnation of justice, greatsword extended before her. A fell wind blasts back the hood covering her otherworldly features, revealing hair so profoundly brown that it appears black, streaked with a single strand of epitomic white. Her exposed face is cast in a mask of utter compassion, her skin the color of polished wood brushed with freckles like burnished coins. The celestialkin’s eyes glint with flecks of light as they probe all before her, seeking danger. Her muscular form is ensconced in ornate plate armor, lions roaring from the pauldrons. Beneath are two golden brooches, expertly carved to proclaim the deity that blesses this holy warrior.

~ Played by a Hero with

乍一看，这具蜷缩的仙灵尸体很容易被误认为是一只裹着闪烁薄翅的大型昆虫。然而很快便能看出，这里躺着的是一具微小的人形躯体，皮肤呈现出死一般的惨白。
At first glance one could mistake the crumpled fairy corpse for a large insect enrobed in shimmering gossamer wings. However, it soon becomes apparent that a tiny humanoid body rests here, their skin a deathly shade of pale.

Subterranean Murky Pool.name:
地下幽浊水潭
Subterranean Murky Pool

Text.text:
一汪未被搅动的水静卧在岩石深处一处幽深、黏滑的盆状凹坑中，浓稠如糖浆的浑浊污影将其彻底晕染。水面平整无波，近乎漆黑，把光线扭成诡异的粼粼反影，投在上方石顶垂挂的钟乳上。
Undisturbed water lies within a deep, slimy basin in the rock, clouded by a thick, syrupy murk. The surface is still and appears almost black, painting odd shimmering reflections of the light on the stalactites hanging from the stone ceiling above.

I Cast Knock.name:
我施放敲击术
I Cast Knock

Text.text: 心念紧扣我法术的目标，我用指节叩击掌侧。每击一下，皮下便传出一声空洞的knock；连击三次，雪松与铁锈的气味自虚空中袅袅飘散。目标体内也随之响起同样的连声——knock, knock, knock——仿佛从内里敲出。 Mind set on the target of my spell, I rap my knuckles against the sides of my palm. A hollow knock emits from under my skin as I hit three times, the scent of cedar and iron wafting out of thin air. The target emits the same series—knock, knock, knock—from within.
