Manticore On Mountain Pass.name:
山道关隘的蝎尾狮
Manticore On Mountain Pass

Text.text:
人类的尖叫与巨猫的咆哮交织成一股轰鸣，在峡谷峭壁间来回炸响；巨大的蝙蝠般翼膜拍击空气，将一具九百磅重的狮身托在悬崖边缘之上。它那张畸形的人脸被一圈纠结成团、结着血痂的鬃发簇拥着；生物的尾巴乍看像狮尾，却在末端聚成一团粗厚的尖刺，铁一般坚硬。忽然，它猛地将尾巴甩向前方，像鞭子一样凌空炸裂，一阵三英尺长的金属尖刺如暴雨般倾泻而下，直朝你砸来。
The mixed sound of human scream and big-cat roar booms off the canyon walls as gigantic bat-like wings hold a nine-hundred-pound lion body above the edge of the cliff. Its grotesque human face is surrounded by a mane of matted, gore-encrusted hair, and the creature’s tail resembles that of a lion but ends in a thick cluster of sharp, iron-hard spines. Suddenly, it snaps its tail forward, cracking it like a whip and sending a volley of three-foot metallic spikes raining down on you.

薄雾自墓园腐滞的泥土间升腾而起，渐渐塑成一具修长的人形。寒意骤然压下——你后颈的汗毛根根竖起——那身影转过身来，以空洞的凝视将你钉在原地。它的眼眶里没有眼珠，只有点点绿幽幽的巫火在空壳中燃烧，宛如丧葬柴堆；锋利的獠牙从它狞笑的嘴角间突兀探出。它的嘴猛然张开，张得不可思议地宽，抬起一根嶙峋的骨指指向你，随即发出一声凄厉的长啸尖鸣。
The mist rises from the stagnant earth of the graveyard and shapes itself into a lithe humanoid form. A chill descends—causing the hairs on your neck to stand up—as the figure turns, fixing you with its hollow gaze. In place of eyes, motes of green witch light burn in empty sockets like funeral pyres, and pointed fangs punctuate its leering grin. Its mouth opens, impossibly wide, and it raises a bony finger toward you and lets out a wailing screech.

结实的年轻人身上萦绕着一缕淡淡的香火气息。他们衣着朴素，粗布短衫与长裤正合寺院侍从的身份。粗雕的木棒横插在绳结腰带间，可他们的手却更用力地攥着一枚护符——其形正仿自所信神祇最神圣的圣徽。微启的唇间逸出沙哑急促的祷词，像发热般低声喃喃。
A faint aroma of incense lingers in the presence of the sturdy young person, dressed simply in a cloth shift and trousers befitting the station of temple acolyte. Though a stout cudgel of carved wood is thrust through their rope belt, their hand is clutching fervently at an amulet shaped in the likeness of their god’s most holy symbol. A murmuring of feverish prayer issues forth from their parted lips.

Royal Letter Affirming A Parcel Of Land.name:
确认土地一宗的王室敕函
Royal Letter Affirming A Parcel Of Land

Text.text:
这是一份简明的文书，措辞清楚，围绕着一幅地块绘图而写。它看起来与其说是王室敕令，不如说是两名工匠手绘的契约。每一道黑色粉笔划出的边界，都按国王的脚长丈量。每一条细致描出的等高线如波浪起伏，映出土地的高低升降。右下角盖着一位小贵族的蜡封。其下有三处签名——一笔工整秀逸，另外两笔则粗糙潦草。
It is a simple document, written in clear language around the drawing of a plot. This looks less like a royal decree than a hand-drawn contract by two laborers. Every black chalk boundary is measured according to the king’s foot. The waves of every carefully drawn contour line show the rises and falls of the land. At the lower right corner is the wax seal of a lesser royal. Beneath it, three signatures—one in a fine hand and two roughly applied.

Savira Andrus Kutime.name:
萨维拉·安德鲁斯·库提梅
Savira Andrus Kutime

Text.text:
金褐色的发丝间掺着银白，贴着下颌剃得干净的胡茬也点缀着灰霜，这个男人的青春岁月早已远去。面容仍是人类的轮廓，岁月的痕迹也清晰可见，可他的衣着与举止却带着精灵般的轻灵与优雅。他穿着铆钉皮甲，步伐轻快得几乎不费力；肩上披着一袭斗篷，尽管内衬狼皮，却仍薄如轻纱般飘逸。灰色毛皮的兜帽衬得他眼眸雾灰，原本爽朗的光彩被年长的睿智压住了几分。背上斜绑着一张微微弯曲的金弓，弓身刻着精灵纹样；腰间垂着一柄细剑。剑柄上方——那团不可思议地优雅、由米色橡木纠缠而成的护手——他的手背浮着一道诡异的紫色印记，幽光流转。细剑纤薄的剑身由一种透明材质构成，像水又像玻璃，在印记的光里泛起淡紫薰衣草般的辉芒。

~ Played by Starknight75 with

Golden-brown locks streaked with silver and a close-shaven beard speckled with gray, the days of this man’s youth lie behind him. Though human in his features and signs of age, he seems elvish in both garb and grace. He moves lightly, effortlessly, in a set of studded leather, and draped in a cloak diaphanous despite the lining of lupine fur. The gray-furred hood highlights the misty-gray of his eyes, their jovial sparkle tempered by an aged wisdom. A gently curving golden bow is strapped over his back, etched with elvish designs, and a rapier hangs from his belt. Over the hilt—an impossibly elegant tangle of beige oak—his hand glows with a strange purple marking. The rapier’s slender blade is a transparent material, like water or glass, that glows lavender in the light of the mark.

~ Played by Starknight75 with

I Cast Techno Noise.name:
我施放电子噪音
I Cast Techno Noise

Text.text:
我将心神聚焦于数字以太，攫住那无数信号——它们彼此缠绕，宛如一张浩瀚而无形的蛛网。指尖一划，我扭曲这些洪流，把共鸣的和声污染成狂乱的失谐。空气在静电中嘶嘶作响，直到我的视野也开始闪烁，满是数字残影与伪影。我踏乘乱码信息的漩涡，随即释放出一股像素化的能量激涌。它以故障般的波浪在空气中扩散，沿途将一切尽数搅乱、重排。世界忽明忽暗、扭曲变形，现实在压倒性的噪音之力中被吞没。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I focus on the digital ether and grapple the myriad signals intertwining like a vast, invisible web. With a gesture, I distort these streams, corrupting the resonant harmonies into chaotic dissonance. The air hisses with static until my vision flickers with digital artifacts. I ride the maelstrom of garbled information, then release a surge of pixelated energy. It ripples through the air in a glitching wave, scrambling everything in its path. The world flickers, distorting, as reality is consumed by the overwhelming force of Noise.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Crew Member From Deep-space Salvage Ship.name:
来自深空打捞船的船员
Crew Member From Deep-space Salvage Ship

Text.text:
这名雌雄难辨的存在鬼鬼祟祟地移动着，仿佛随时会有麻烦找上门。他们的板岩灰色飞行服皱褶累累，像一张陈旧的报纸；回收空气的气味萦绕在身旁，宛如变质的香水。他们的鳞状皮肤呈现出斑驳的绿与发光的黄交织的虹彩——正如那双又大又好奇的眼睛。
The androgynous being moves furtively, as if expecting trouble. Their slate gray flight suit is creased like an old newspaper and the smell of recycled air hangs around them like stale perfume. Their scaled skin is a chromatic mixture of mottled green and luminous yellow—like their wide, curious eyes.

这里的井早在很久以前就干涸了，如今只剩一口通向大地深处的幽暗坠穴。苔藓裹住石壁，井底的根须却悄然向上攀爬。你凝视井的深处，目光却无法穿透黑暗。刺骨的寒气自下涌起，裹挟着一股令人不安的恶臭。
The well here dried up long ago, now merely a dark plunge into the depths of the earth. Moss shrouds the stone, while roots from below creep upward. You stare into the well’s depths, your eyes unable to penetrate the darkness. Frigid air wafts upward, carrying with it an unnerving stench.

Exhausted Rogue After A Battle.name:
战斗过后，筋疲力尽的游荡者
Exhausted Rogue After A Battle

Text.text:
你从掩蔽中现身，强迫自己缓慢地舒展筋骨——毕竟若不小心，弓身疾行、闪避毁灭性的攻击，很容易让四肢抽筋。许多退隐的游荡者到了中年，都不得不与令人虚弱的酸痛折磨周旋；你可不打算步他们的后尘。

~ 由 snepai 构想

Emerging from cover, you force yourself to stretch slowly, since running in a crouch and avoiding devastating attacks causes limbs to cramp if you are not careful. Many a retired rogue has found themselves contending with debilitating aches and pains in their middle age, and you do not intend to follow their example.

~ Envisioned by snepai

这座庄园主宅或许曾经高耸堂皇、辉煌夺目，如今却空荡荒败，摇摇欲坠。墙漆成条成片地霉烂剥落，曾支撑整座建筑重量的立柱也已倾斜，裂缝如蛛网般沿着柱身蔓延而下。屋体下陷，在风中呻吟——风穿过破碎的窗框呼啸而入，掠过布满凹痕的外墙挂板。屋内冰冷、昏暗、空无一人，唯有一幅褪色的全家福仍挂在那里：画中人的面容在年代与风化的侵蚀下被磨去。它们没有脸，却仍直勾勾地望向黑暗。
The manor house may have once stood tall and impressive in its splendor, but now sits empty and crumbling. Paint peels in moldy strips, and columns that once bore the weight of the structure lean, cracks spiderwebbing down their lengths. The house sags, groaning in the wind that whistles through shattered windows and over pockmarked siding. Inside, the house sits cold, dark, and empty, save a faded family portrait, the faces of the occupants worn away with age and exposure. They stare, faceless, into the darkness.

Witch-owned Tea Shop.name:
女巫掌柜的茶馆
Witch-owned Tea Shop

Text.text:
你一走近，门便顺从地开启，一声柔和的清铃宣告着你的到来——让店主们喜上眉梢。两位女子在这间狭小而芬芳的茶馆里忙忙碌碌，各自以令人愉悦的玄奥风格装点全身，挂满叮当作响的小饰物，穿梭于歪斜的木质货架之间时清脆作伴。一条淡紫色的小龙在上方守夜，像只倦怠的猫般蜷在屋梁上，目送你步入店内。

~ MaesterAelix 在 Discord 上构想

The door opens obligingly as you approach, a soft chime heralding your arrival—to the delight of the owners. Two women potter about the small, fragrant tea shop, each bedecked in delightfully esoteric fashion and covered in trinkets that jingle as they scurry among the crooked wooden shelf stacks. A small dragon—lilac in hue—watches you from above, curled up on a roof beam like a weary cat, as you make your way inside.

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

Pall Of Necrotic Energy.name:
死灵能量的阴翳
Pall Of Necrotic Energy

Text.text:
你周遭的空气蒙着一层并不存在的烟斗所吐出的烟雾——不出自任何烟斗，也不出自任何烟叶——其间还漂着一缕半透明的瘴气，像沼泽气一般幽绿。笼罩这片大地的薄幕里，有什么是活的：无视风向，兀自缓慢地盘旋着，比托住它的空气还要冰冷。一股自知的、走投无路的悲伤——知晓自身，也知晓你——在乞求与警告之间同时低语。
The air around you bears the haze of pipe smoke from no pipe, of no leaf, and a translucent miasma, green like swamp gas. Something of this pall over the land is alive, turning slowly on itself regardless of the wind, colder than the air that holds it. A desperate sadness aware of itself, aware of you, pleads and warns at once.

Flare-compensating Goggles.name:
耀斑补偿护目镜
Flare-compensating Goggles

Text.text:
透过护目镜望去，世界像被按下了静音键般黯淡。城市明亮的霓虹被压低了亮度，仿佛一切都只剩半档电力。护目镜随着视线转向发出轻柔的嗡鸣，自动补偿骤然变化的光线。
Peering through the goggles offers a muted view of the world. The bright neon of the city is dimmed as if it were all at half power. The goggles whir gently as they're pointed in different directions, automatically compensating for sudden changes in light.

The Sanctuary: An Overview.name:
圣所：概览
The Sanctuary: An Overview

Text.text: 圣域是一片人为打造的收容区域，横跨100英里，由一位阴险科学家建造，用来安置他那些小兽实验品——既讨喜又险恶。圣域被半透明的蓝色力场包围，内部拥有五种各自独立、人工生成的生态区——西部森林、南部热带、东部草原、冰封北境与中央荒原——每一处都有由栖居其间的各类生物亲手建起的城镇与地标。统御这一切的，是居于硫磺气息弥漫的城堡中的暴君“抱抱”，它由猫科与红龙的DNA拼接而成。这些地点将以动物居民的视角来描述。 The Sanctuary is an artificial holding area, 100 miles across, created by a nefarious scientist to house his critter experiments—both delightful and devious. Surrounded by a translucent blue force field, the Sanctuary features five different, artificially generated, biomes—the western forests, the southern tropics, the eastern grasslands, the frozen north, and the central wastes—each with their own towns and landmarks built by the various creatures that call this place home. Ruling over it all from a sulfurous citadel is the tyrannical Snuggles, created by splicing feline and red dragon DNA. The locations are described from the perspective of the animal inhabitants.

Writers' And Poets' Group.name:
作家与诗人社团
Writers' And Poets' Group

Text.text:
十几支钢笔在空中起落，点点敲击如断续的鼓点，纸面上则是飞快拉出的沙沙划痕；另一边，几名写作者正摆弄各自文字机器上的按钮。几乎每隔几分钟，就有人冲到讲台前，把一句恰到好处的妙语分享给同伴。空气里嗡嗡作响，尽是巧思碰撞的热度与浓茶的辛香。她回到座位时，众人鼓掌相迎；这群色彩斑斓的词匠毫不掩饰自己的欣喜。这里没有冷嘲热讽，也没有遮遮掩掩的暗刺——在这座神圣的殿堂里，语言与艺术合而为一，任何层次的修习者都值得被以热情与气度大力鼓励！
The motion of a dozen pens fills the air with staccato stipples and rapidly pulled scratches, while a few other writers tinker at the buttons on their text machines. Every few minutes, a writer rushes to a lectern to share a germane phrase with their fellows. The air is abuzz with ingenuity and the aroma of strong tea. Applauding a colleague as she retakes her seat, the group of colorful wordsmiths make no attempt to hide their delight. There is no sniping or veiled insults here—in these hallowed halls, language and art are one, and practitioners of all levels are to be encouraged with fervor and aplomb!

Burial Mounds Of Giants.name:
巨人冢丘
Burial Mounds Of Giants

Text.text:
从地面望去，这些土丘隆起如小山包。草木在那一座座巨大起伏的丘陵顶端生长，点缀着整片地貌——直到走近细看，你才注意到支撑它们底部的石块。巨大的岩石彼此堆叠，构成圆顶般的结构，如今已被草皮与苔藓吞没。你这才明白，每一座里都应安眠着一位受敬的亡者——那些筑起这些石冢的巨人族上古君王。
From ground level, the mounds rise like hillocks. Grass and trees grow atop the massive, rolling hills dotting the landscape—and only upon closer inspection do you notice the stones that form their bases. Massive boulders, stacked atop one another, form domed structures now overtaken with grass and moss. Each, you realize, must house an honored dead—ancient rulers of the giants who erected these cairns.

这条蟒蛇的体型大得惊人，当它缓缓舒展盘绕的身躯时，你几乎发誓自己听见了它一片片鳞甲相互摩擦的沙沙声。忽然间，你也觉得完全可信：如此体型的蛇，足以在一次漫长的吞咽中，把一只倒霉的老鼠——甚至一只兔子——整只吞下。
The size of the constrictor snake is so impressive that as it uncoils, you swear you can hear the sound of its individual scales rubbing together. It suddenly seems quite believable that a snake this size could devour an unlucky rat, or even a rabbit, in one protracted bite.

这纤瘦的爬行生物用两只带蹼的脚直立而站，细长的指头紧攥着一杆黑铁长矛。它的五官像蝾螈或水蜥：修长如蛇的躯干之上，是一颗向后倾斜的头颅。漆黑的眼睛闪着被掩藏的狡黠，而在生物的皮肤之下，热力隐隐外溢，让这副爬行的轮廓笼罩在一种诡异、摇曳的微光中。
The spindly, reptilian creature stands on two webbed feet, oblong fingers clutching a black iron spear. Its features resemble a newt or salamander: a long serpentine torso topped with a sloping head. Black eyes gleam with a belied cunning, and just below the creature’s skin, heat radiates, casting the reptilian form in an odd, wavering glow.

你路过农场时，看到一双双布满老茧的手——被染成深紫色——熟练地将染料揉进一张张布料里，古老的地域传统就在你眼前如常上演。农夫们与你对上目光，便笑着挥手，招呼你走近些来看他们的手艺。你一靠近，馥郁醉人的薰衣草香便迎面扑来，你仿佛踏入一阵梦雾，穿行在院中星罗棋布的大石染缸之间。

~ Inbal 于 Discord

Calloused hands—stained a deep purple—expertly work the dye into sheets of cloth as you pass by the farm, watching the ancient traditions of the region play out before you. The farmers give a cheerful wave as they catch your eye and beckon you closer to observe their work. As you approach, the intoxicating scent of lavender rushes to meet you, and you find yourself walking in a dreamy haze through the large stone vats dotting the yard.

~ Inbal on Discord

木匠从活计中短暂抬起头，点了点头，随即又埋首其间，用凿子在一块尚未完工的红木搁板上凿出一道榫槽。工坊墙上挂满了各式各样的工具，足以证明他将一生都投进了这门手艺。他在你眼前把朴素的木料化作精美的家具，脸上却不见笑意；然而眼底那一抹若有若无的微光，已足以道出他施展这项技能时的愉悦。
The carpenter looks up from his work briefly and nods before returning to it, shaping a groove in an unfinished mahogany shelf with a chisel. The wide array of tools hanging from the wall of his workshop provides ample evidence of a life spent on his craft. He does not smile as he transforms plain wood into beautiful furniture before you, but a vague twinkle in his eye says all you need to know about the pleasure with which he exercises his skill.

这具构装体呈人形：木质骨架外覆可滑移的钢板加固，以便在不受束缚的情况下自由移动。他面部的钢铁花瓣同样会开合变换，映出情绪与神色；然而那对晶莹的翠绿水晶眼中一闪的光芒，已足以证明这生物拥有智慧。他站姿近乎军人般刻板，背脊笔直，双手贴在身体两侧。斜挂在肩上的盾牌背面垂着一排排小袋与口袋，他随时都能从中抽出各式药剂与小瓶，数量繁多。

~ 由 Edwin 扮演

The construct appears humanoid, with a wooden frame reinforced by steel plates that shift to allow freedom of movement. The steel petals of his face, too, move to express emotions and exhibit expressions, though the gleam in his crystalline green eyes should be sufficient to prove the creature's sapience. He stands with an almost militaristic rigidity, straight-backed with his hands against his sides. The back of the shield slung on his shoulder is hung with pouches and pockets, from which he can draw myriad potions and vials.

~ Played by Edwin

The Ruined Elven Party Hall.name:
破败的精灵宴会厅
The Ruined Elven Party Hall

Text.text:
你闯入一间被遗忘已久的房间，仿佛来自某个早已沉没的时代。空气里仍缠绕着酒香与精灵香露的余韵。看着家具的摆设，以及从如树冠般的穹顶垂悬而下的装饰，便不难看出，这条长廊曾是精灵们在节庆时相聚的所在。墙边一字排开的优雅精灵雕像，在这座大厅的恢弘尺度面前反倒显得渺小。你经过的几座雕像脚下，散放着酒瓮——有的完好，有的碎裂。所有事物都覆着一层厚厚的尘垢，那是它们在这座古老大厅的黑暗中沉睡多年所积下的痕迹。
You come upon a room from a time long forgotten. The air still lingers with the scent of wine and elven perfumes. Looking at the furniture arrangements, as well as the decorations suspended from the tree canopy-like ceiling, it is clear this hallway was once a place for elves to gather on festive occasions. The large statues of elegant elven figures that line the walls look small in contrast to the enormity of the room itself. Wine vases, broken and unbroken, sit at the base of a few of the statues you pass. Everything has collected a thick caking of dust from the years spent within the darkness of this ancient hall.

冰冷的鹅卵石台阶向上延伸，通往一处平台；平台上无数火把在雕骨灯架中燃烧，将四周照得摇曳明亮。平台中央那块隆起的石台被深红浸染，其上散落着干涸血痂的碎屑。斑痕之下，是一圈深深刻入暗色石面的环形刻痕，边缘布满不规则的形状与字符。
Cold cobbled steps lead up to a platform lit by numerous torches sitting in carved-bone stands. The elevated stone in the center of the platform is stained a deep crimson and littered with chips of dried blood. Under the stains lies a circle lined with irregular shapes and characters carved deep into the dark stone.

Pharaoh's Throne Chamber.name:
法老的御座厅
Pharaoh's Throne Chamber

Text.text:
殿室空旷宏阔，长长的墙面从头到尾覆满繁复精细的象形文字彩绘。由雕刻石柱组成的长廊沿着房间中央一路延伸，尽头是一段向上攀升的阶梯，通往一张在光芒中熠熠生辉的金色王座。法老座位两侧，各有一名面色冷峻的战士肃立守卫，目光警觉地扫视着整座大厅。

~ 由 Stellar Envisioned

The chamber is expansive, with the considerable length of its walls entirely painted with intricate hieroglyphics. A hall of carved pillars leads down the center of the room, ending in a set of stairs ascending to a golden throne that sparkles in the light. A stoic warrior stands at attention on either side of the pharaoh's seat, keeping a watchful eye on the hall.

~ Envisioned by Stellar

Dwarf's Diversion In The Lighthouse.name:
灯塔里的矮人佯动
Dwarf's Diversion In The Lighthouse

Text.text:
在一座岩石嶙峋的小岛上，矗立着一座阴沉的石砌灯塔，巨大的灯室在塔顶被海雾与浪花喷溅得湿亮发光。灯塔内部，一道漫长的环形楼梯从底部与守塔人的小居室盘旋而上，直通灯室一层。一名矮人游侠全副武装，背着盾牌，拾级而上。到了顶端，他解下盾牌，放到地上，然后一屁股坐进盾面里。你正疑惑他要做什么，他却猛地伸出双臂抓住楼梯的栏杆，借力把自己连人带盾抛进螺旋里，叮当作响地一路旋转滑落，怪叫连连，直到“砰”地一声撞到底部，笑得前仰后合。

~ Envisioned by Tate

On a small rocky island stands a lighthouse of grim stone, its giant lantern top glistening with sea spray. Inside, a long circular staircase leads from the bottom and its sentry apartment to the lantern floor. A dwarven ranger, armed and carrying a shield, climbs the stairs. At the top, he unslings the shield, sets it on the floor, and sits in it. You begin to wonder what he’s about to do, but then he reaches out with both arms to grab the stair rails and propels himself into the spiral, clattering loudly and hooting until he crashes at the bottom in laughter.

~ Envisioned by Tate

Steel Wind Strike.name:
钢风斩击
Steel Wind Strike

Text.text:
没有一句话出口。取而代之的是武器一抖的寒光，施法者随即消失。他们在现实的缝隙间闪烁穿梭，连环挥出致命打击；每一击落下便遁入虚无，随即又在下一记斩击处骤然现身。遭击者踉跄后退，神智恍惚，仿佛从四面八方同时受袭。
No words are spoken. Instead, there is a flourish of a weapon, and the caster vanishes. They blink through reality with a series of deadly strikes, vanishing then reappearing with each blow. The struck victims stagger, bewildered, as though assailed from every side.

你踏入一间挑高的前厅，宾客们陆续到来，在此交谈寒暄。你能听见四周断续的谈话声，也听见仆役收拾刀叉的清脆声响——想必方才是一场盛宴——可你的目光却怎么也离不开那幅彩绘穹顶。那画面以色彩与构图铺陈出令人屏息的奇观，华丽得近乎不真实。若在别处，这里足以成为盛大的舞厅，甚至是城堡的王座厅；可在这里，它不过是人们解下斗篷的所在。
You enter a high-ceilinged anteroom where guests mingle as they arrive. You’re conscious of conversations around you and the sounds of servants clearing cutlery from what must have been a grand meal, but you can’t take your eyes off the painted ceiling. The scene is a stunning marvel of color and composition. In any other place this room would be the grand ballroom, or even the throne room of the castle, but here it’s a place for people to take off their cloaks.

区域里传来人群的喧嚣与叮当作响的碰撞声，牲口拖着沉重的货车穿行其间。商贩们为货品的价码争得面红耳赤；另一拨人围着四枚小石骰大笑喧闹，笑声粗豪滚烫。新出锅的食物香气在空气中飘荡，几乎压过那些搬运货物的工人身上挥之不去的汗味。孩子们在街上奔跑——彼此笑着喊着——欢快劲儿一眼便知。一个皮肤晒得黝黑的女人高高举起一条皮革，向穿行在繁忙市集的人群展示，扯着嗓子喊道：“皮子！鞣好的皮子！”
The clamor and clatter of bustling people and animals pulling heavy carts emanates from the area. Merchants can be heard bartering heatedly over the value of wares as boisterous laughter comes from another group gathered over four small stone dice. The smells of freshly cooked food waft through the air, almost displacing the lingering scent of sweat from the many workers moving goods about. Children run around the streets—laughing and yelling to one another—their cheer apparent. “Hides! Cured hides!” yells a deeply tanned woman as she holds a strip of leather aloft, displaying it to the crowds walking through the busy market.

Quip By A New Adventurer.name:
新手冒险者的俏皮话
Quip By A New Adventurer

Text.text:
“我的天，我打中了！你看见了吗？！等等，它怎么还在动？”
“Oh my god, I hit it! Did you see that?! Wait, why is it still moving?”

I Use Twinned Spell.name:
我使用孪生法术
I Use Twinned Spell

Text.text:
我将法术塑成只针对一个目标的形态。在此过程中，我又在脑海中勾勒出另一个承受同样效果的对象。我从灵魂深处汲取奥术之力，在原本的魔法成形之际，将其复制出一份。我让原本与复制同时迸发而出。
I shape the spell for one target. As I do, I picture another subject for the same effect. I draw arcane power from within my soul to create a copy of the original magic as it forms. I unleash the original and the copy at the same time.

Speech About Being The Voice Of Reason.name:
关于成为理性之声的演讲
Speech About Being The Voice Of Reason

Text.text:
“你们知道吗，在我们这群小掠夺者里，我得一直当那个讲道理的人，有多累？我并不享受训斥你们，也不想逼你们放走那些你们更想杀掉的俘虏，可我还是把这些苦差事扛下来，因为这才是对的。为什么你们就不能也做同样的事？”
“Do you realize how exhausting it is to constantly be the voice of reason in our little band of marauders? I don’t enjoy scolding all of you or making you release some captive you’d rather murder, but I put in the work because it is right. Why can’t any of you do the same?”

Desert Nomad Camp: Shelter From The Wind.name:
沙漠游民营地：避风港
Desert Nomad Camp: Shelter From The Wind

Text.text:
阵阵狂风掀得帐篷侧壁噼啪拍打、簌簌翻飞，但在里面你总算能寻得片刻喘息。不快的骆驼低声嘟囔，提醒你：隔在你与最恶劣天气之间的，不过是一层薄布。念头一来，疲惫便涌上心头，你也才察觉脚下的柔软——铺在沙地上的一张地毯。
The gusting wind causes the tent’s sides to flap and flutter, but inside you can find some respite. The grousing of an unhappy camel reminds you that just a sheet of fabric separates you from the weather’s worst. The thought makes you tired, and you become conscious of the softness beneath your feet—a rug laid over sand.

Aboleth: Psychic Drain.name:
底栖魔鱼：精神汲取
Aboleth: Psychic Drain

Text.text:
在你那被征服的心智的冰冷黑水深处，有什么在牵扯着你的灵魂。一阵刺痛闪过，让寒意与阴霾愈发加重。
In the cold, dark waters of your subjugated mind, something tugs at your spirit. A flash of pain increases the chill and gloom.

经打磨的锐利骨质沿着这把独特镰刀的刃缘勾勒出森寒锋线，象牙般的冷光与武器握柄陈旧的木色相互映衬。镰刀上布满诡异的纹记，仿佛战士肌肤上的刺青，被灼刻进木与骨之中。
Sharpened bone forms a keen edge along the blade of this unique sickle, the ivory gleam contrasting with the aged wood of the weapon’s handle. Strange markings decorate the sickle, like tattoos on a warrior’s flesh, burned into wood and bone alike.

小小的颈盾上点缀着骨质瘤块，几乎占据了幼年三角龙的整个头部，向后扫去，覆住它的脖颈，宛如一圈披甲的护颈。新长出的喙上方，一双又大又圆的眼睛打量着世界，惊奇与惧意交织；小家伙蹒跚着跟在威严的成年同类身旁，总是紧挨着那位溺爱它的母亲。
A small frill punctuated with bony lumps dominates the baby triceratops’s head, sweeping back to cover their neck like an armored gorget. Large round eyes set above a newly formed beak take in the world with a potent mixture of wonder and fear as the young dinosaur trundles alongside its imposing adult counterparts, always close to its doting mother.

I Channel Divinity For Divine Interventi.name:
我启用【引导神力】以施展【神圣干预】
I Channel Divinity For Divine Intervention

Text.text:
我仰望苍穹，双手高举，恳切祈求。与此同时，我向天穹呼喊：“请在这危急关头听见我。赐予我，你谦卑的仆人，你的援助。我恳求你。”
I cast my eyes skyward, throwing up my hands in supplication. As I do, I cry out to the heavens, “Please hear me in this moment of dire need. Send me, your humble servant, your aid. I beg of you.”

Lamentation By A Paladin About Despair.name:
圣骑士对绝望的哀歌
Lamentation By A Paladin About Despair

Text.text:
“我一直以为自己坚不可摧。直到此刻，我的感召之正义从未令我畏惧或动摇。但眼前所见，让绝望的触须缠上了我的心脏。我会尽全力让你们都活下去，可我对我们的胜算并不乐观。”
“I have always thought myself unshakable. Until now, the righteousness of my calling was beyond all fear and doubt. But with what lies before us, I feel the tendrils of despair wrapping themselves around my heart. I will do my best to keep you all alive, but I am not optimistic about our chances.”

翼龙用一侧巨大而皮韧的翅膀覆住头部，蜷伏在峭壁之巅的巢中沉睡，将缩作一团的幼崽护在身下，挡住刺骨的狂风。覆鳞的利爪紧攫着编织成巢的枝条以求稳固，尖锐的爪尖在木头上犁出深而惨白的沟痕，树皮被撕开，像血肉般一层层剥离。
Head covered with one large, leathery wing, the pterosaur sleeps in its clifftop nest, sheltering its huddled young from the biting winds. Scaly talons grasp the woven branches for security, the sharp claws leaving deep, pale furrows in the wood as the bark is peeled away like flesh.

这支盘旋的角呈亚麻般的浅金色，闪耀如宝石，却轻若无物。角尖染着褐色的脓液或血迹，或许来自它在最终败亡前所刺出的最后一记伤口。尽管此角已从宿主身上被割下，其中仍残留着一缕光辉——那感觉既让你的心头一轻，又在胃里翻起一阵令人不适的滚动。
This twirling horn, flaxen in color, gleams like a precious gem but feels as light as air. Its point is stained with brown ichor or blood, perhaps from a final wound inflicted before an ultimate defeat. Despite the horn being shorn from its host, a radiance still lingers within it—a sensation that both lightens your heart and leaves an uncomfortable tumble in your stomach.

Taunt From A Reclusive Dragon.name:
来自隐居巨龙的嘲讽
Taunt From A Reclusive Dragon

Text.text:
“我要怎么做才能把你们这群人彻底甩掉？我还以为一座洞口围着尸体的洞穴已经足够明白地告诉你们——我不想被打扰——可显然，你们既愚蠢又任性。”
“What must I do to be rid of you people? I thought that a cave ringed with corpses would be a clear sign that I don’t want to be disturbed, but apparently you are as stupid as you are petulant.”

一个充满矛盾的人：这个男人短短的黑发与黑眼睛，衬得他肤色苍白得近乎不真实。眼下深重的黑眼圈背叛了他那疏离冷淡的凝视。他的脸本该平平无奇，唯独那对过分硕大、尖削的耳朵令人无法忽视。然而，他身上的道具却昭示着一名受过训练的杀手。一身量身裁制的黑色皮甲紧贴着他结实的躯体，腰带上挂着一串入鞘的刀刃——一把长刃，几把短刃——以及铁制弩矢。斜挎的肩带上，他背着一把优雅而巨大的十字弩，通体黑漆，弩身还装着一只望远镜。

~ Played by Otec with

A person of contrasts, this man’s short black hair and black eyes juxtapose with his incredibly pale skin. The dark circles under his eyes belie his aloof stare. His face would be unremarkable but for his overlarge, pointed ears. The gear he sports, however, is that of a trained killer. A suit of tailored black leather hugs his muscular frame, and his belts hold an array of sheathed blades, one long and the others short, along with iron quarrels. On his baldric, he carries an elegant and large crossbow, lacquered black with a spyglass fitted onto it.

~ Played by Otec with

Threat From A Giant.name:
来自巨人的威胁
Threat From A Giant

Text.text:
“你们别想走。我想亲脚踩爆你们那一袋袋湿囊般的肉身，让它们在我脚趾下噗地绽开。最叫人痛快。”
“You don’t leave. I want to feel those wet sacks you call bodies pop under my toes. Most satisfying.”

伴随着一段令人想起死亡、寒冷与黑暗的咒语，你用指尖捏起一缕被腐化的灵质。死寂之物在指间蒸散殆尽，随之一声回荡的脆响——一颗剥离了光与生机的球体骤然显现，彻底受你掌控。 [移动球体] 球体顺从你的意念，按你所愿滑行至你指定之处。 [降至 0 生命值] 你的目标被球体边缘轻轻一舔，身躯便僵硬如铁。你看着他们崩解为细密的灰尘，连同道具一并化作粉末。 [法术结束] 球体向内坍缩，迸出一圈圈扭曲视线与物质的波纹。任何被它们接触之物，皆会弯折或断裂。

~ 由一位英雄构想

With an incantation that calls to mind death, cold, and darkness, you pinch corrupted ectoplasm between your fingers. The dead matter evaporates, and with an echoing snap, a sphere devoid of light and life appears, totally under your control. [Moving the Sphere] The sphere responds to your desire, moving where you will it. [Reduced to 0 Hit Points] Your target’s body stiffens when licked by the edge of the sphere. You watch as they crumble into a fine gray dust, gear and all. [The Spell Ends] The sphere crumples in on itself, sending out waves that distort sight and matter. Anything they touch bends or breaks.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Power Word Heal.name:
疗愈真言
Power Word Heal

Text.text:
双手合十如祈祷，随即一声言语在伤者上方回荡——那是一句令人心神安宁的圣言，洗去一切疼痛与倦乏。万籁俱寂的刹那之后，目标的身躯泛起治疗能量的涟漪。液态黄金自他们眼中溢出——圣光凝成的泪滴。
Two hands are placed in prayer, and then a Word echoes out over the wounded—a blissful Word that washes away all hurt and weariness. There is a moment of utter silence before the target ripples with healing energy. Liquid gold spills from their eyes—teardrops of holy light.

一名年轻的半身人女子从森林深处现身，举止却与拥挤城街上的巡逻队长如出一辙。她身披罩在皮质护甲外的绿色祭服，对着你看不见的空处高声啁啾。仿佛应声而至，一只雪白与灰羽相间的猫头鹰自树冠之外掠入，落在近旁的枝桠上。半身人走到一块覆满青苔的岩石旁，将一根橡木法杖放在其平整的石面上——杖身嗡鸣，虫群在其间躁动。两只生灵默然对视，半身人碧绿的眼眸渐渐蒙上雾色，恍若陷入恍惚的出神之境。

~ 由 Boltz 扮演

Emerging from the depths of the forest with mannerisms identical to a watch captain in a crowded city street, a young halfling woman in green vestments over leather armor chirps loudly to no-one you can see. As if summoned, a snowy white and gray owl wings in from beyond the treetops and perches on a nearby bough. The halfling walks over to a moss-covered rock and lays her oaken staff, buzzing with insects, across its flat surface. The two creatures exchange glances in silence, and the halfling’s green eyes cloud over as if in a trance.

~ Played by Boltz

I Sharpen My Horns.name:
我磨砺双角
I Sharpen My Horns

Text.text:
空气里弥漫着角质粉末的气味，我在每一根角尖上细细打磨、抛光，又用指尖逐一试探。那感觉一半像痒，一半像刺——震颤沿着颅骨传开。牙根也微微发痒。
The smell of powdered keratin is in the air as I work on the tip of each horn, filing and buffing, testing each with a finger. The sensation is part tickle, part sting—a vibration through my skull. My teeth itch a little.

Hacker Scans Another User's Public Infor.name:
黑客在网络中扫描另一名用户的公开信息
Hacker Scans Another User's Public Information In The Net

Text.text:
黑客只需在心中下达几道指令，所需的一切情报便浮现眼前。任何曾经公开过、与他们的目标有关的信息，都以令人目眩的资料拼贴铺陈在面前。这里面一定藏着些什么有用的东西。
With a few mental commands, the hacker brings up everything they need to know. Any information that has ever been publicly available about their mark is displayed before them in a dizzying collage of data. There must be something useful in here somewhere.

Dialous Lobress.name:
迪阿洛斯·洛布雷斯
Dialous Lobress

Text.text:
这名威严的龙裔一身红铜般的鳞片，在阳光下仍然闪耀，尽管早已褪色磨损。事实上，他整个人都显得饱经风霜——满身伤疤，却韧性十足。披在宽阔肩头的长外套是黯淡的深红色，布料被日晒褪去光泽，打着补丁的破洞随处可见，甚至还有被灼烧过的焦痕。他的靴子同样破裂撕开，每只带爪的脚都从裂口中探出，像某种巢穴里爬出的可怖生物。右眼有一道纵向的长疤，疤痕周围裂出青蓝色的蛛网状纹路，肆意蔓延在原本漆黑的巩膜上。头骨后方伸出的角上缀着银环，另一对自下颌向后扫并下钩，宛如坚硬骨质铸成的头盔。他的举止沉静、安然，却带着令人不安的冷峻与寡言。龙裔的目光常在四周游移，默默打量环境，记下值得关注的物件或人物。

~ Played by Alex with

The ruddy-brass scales of the imposing dragonborn gleam in the sun despite their faded and scuffed appearance. In fact, the entirety of the dragonborn appears worn, scarred, yet resilient. The long, dull red coat draped across his broad shoulders shows signs of sun fading, patched holes—even scorch marks. His boots, too, are torn asunder, with each clawed foot emerging like some horrid creature from its lair. A long, vertical scar marks his right eye, creating a web of cyan cracks that go sprawling across his otherwise black sclera. Horns adorned with silver rings sweep back from his skull and jut downward from his jaw, creating a veritable helmet of rigid bone. His demeanor is calm, placid, and unnervingly stoic. The dragonborn’s eyes often roam about, taking in his surroundings and making note of items or persons of interest.

~ Played by Alex with

Emerald Dragon Scouting A Forest.name:
翡翠巨龙在森林中侦察
Emerald Dragon Scouting A Forest

Text.text:
在林木繁茂的荒野里，一条巨大的青绿巨龙在藤蔓纠结的乱丛间蜿蜒爬行，祖母绿色的鳞片宛如被雨水浸透的巨大树叶，在斑驳的阳光下闪烁。蛇一般的双眼在逼近时冷冷逼视，奇异的浮空角掠过扭曲的枝桠，随着它的前行摇曳起舞。它的面相像一条狩猎的眼镜蛇，獠牙密布的巨口越张越大，涎液成缕垂落……
In the arboreal wilderness, a large greenish dragon crawls among a tangle of vines, emerald scales like huge rain-soaked leaves glistening in the dappled sunlight. Snake-like eyes glare as they approach, the strange floating horns dancing over twisted boughs as they come. With the visage of a hunting cobra, the fang-filled maw gapes wider, trails of drool dripping…

Temple Of The Fool.name:
愚者神殿
Temple Of The Fool

Text.text:
[外部] 眨眼就会错过——一幢破旧磨损的石质建筑夹在两座更大的楼之间，若非专程寻觅这座神殿的人几乎看不见。这里没有任何招牌标识，但入口旁石壁上的雕刻——一顶宫廷小丑的俏皮尖帽——却令人一眼难忘。 [内部] 出人意料的是，这座神殿的内部与粗陋的外观形成鲜明对比。无数蜡烛洒下柔和的金色光晕，照亮保养精良的挂毯：其上描绘着那位小丑般的神祇——“愚者”——以及他兴起与陨落的传说。神殿核心的火盆为这处球形空间带来光与热，而空间中央矗立着一尊高大的石像：正是愚者本人，衣饰奢华，既威严又带着孩童般的天真，周身笼着一层难以捉摸的神秘。多条走廊通向神殿更深处的房间——训练室、祈祷厅与寝舍；壁龛里还设有更多小型圣坛、堆满典籍与卷轴的藏书处，以及意义非凡的遗物与器物。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

[Outside] Blink and you’ll miss it—a worn, rundown stone building tucked between two larger structures, nearly invisible to those not seeking the temple. No placards name this place, yet the carving in the stone beside the entrance—the jaunty cap of a court jester—is unmistakable. [Inside] Surprisingly, the interior of this temple contrasts starkly with its rough exterior. Soft, golden light from numerous candles falls upon well-maintained tapestries depicting the jester-like deity known as the Fool, depicting the legends of his rise and fall. Braziers at the temple’s heart lend light and heat to the spherical space, the center of which is dominated by a towering stone statue of the Fool himself dressed opulently, regal yet childlike, and with an air of mystery. Numerous corridors lead to rooms deeper within the temple—training rooms, prayer halls, and dormitories, with alcoves containing additional shrines, libraries of tomes and scrolls, and artifacts of great significance.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Cast Eyebite.name:
我施放了【噬眼术】
I Cast Eyebite

Text.text:
当我汲取黑暗能量，胃里翻涌起冰冷的恶心感；我以繁复的手势织就轻纱般的丝缕，将自己层层缠绕。双眼刺痛，化作如午夜般漆黑的黑曜石深渊；墓土的腥冷气息灌满鼻腔。
A cold nausea fills my gut as I tap into dark energy, weaving gossamer strands around me with complex gestures. My eyes sting as they transform into obsidian pits black as midnight, and the smell of grave dirt fills my nostrils.

High Seas Battle: Cannons And Muskets.name:
公海之战：火炮与火枪
High Seas Battle: Cannons And Muskets

Text.text:
船只近到足以互相开火，小型枪械的射击烟雾笼罩着敌方甲板。对方船员随意开火，试图迫使你的炮手寻找掩蔽。起初这似乎徒劳无功，但紧接着，炮栏的木料被打得爆出漫天碎片，你脚边的甲板也被撕出一道深深的凿痕。
The ships are close enough for gunfire, and smoke from the small arms’ fire shrouds the enemy deck. Their crew fires at will, trying to force your cannoneers to take cover. It seems a futile effort, but then the wood of the gun rail sends splinters into the air and a gouge appears in the deck by your feet.

Invisible Dragon Breathing Fire.name:
隐形巨龙喷吐烈焰
Invisible Dragon Breathing Fire

Text.text:
几乎没有任何声响可供警示，一束白炽烈焰骤然扫过区域，带着原始而狂暴的威势来回扇动。那骇人的热量足以熔化坚硬金属，让岩石起泡沸腾。凡被这道纯粹火流卷入者，断无生还可能。如此炽烈的火焰并非巫术或炼金之产——这是龙焰，不知何故降临在你们身侧，而你的每一根神经都在尖叫着催你逃离。

~ 由 Tyler 为 RPGBOT.net 所构想

There is scarcely a sound to warn you before a plume of white-hot flame suddenly scorches the area, fanning back and forth with raw intensity. The sheer heat is enough to melt hard metals and to bubble stone. None caught within the stream of pure flame can possibly survive. Such intense flames are not the product of wizardry or alchemy—this is dragonfire in your midst, somehow, and your every nerve screams at you to flee.

~ As envisioned by Tyler from RPGBOT.net

Oil Of Sharpness.name:
锋锐之油
Oil Of Sharpness

Text.text:
你把那只半透明的瓶子举到光下，瓶中油液缓缓晃荡；在折射的光辉里，你隐约能辨出点点晶亮的闪光。
Holding up the semi-translucent bottle of slowly sloshing oil to a light, you can just make out glittering sparkles shining in the refraction.

军官以绝对的威权咆哮下令，她的部下立刻奔走执行——披甲战士以严整的武纪迅速就位。那半兽人的脸被一道丑陋的疤痕从中劈开，仿佛永远凝着轻蔑的冷笑；她挥舞带倒刺的长矛，像是那本就恶毒的意志在她臂间延伸出的獠牙。
The officer bellows orders with absolute authority, and her underlings rush to obey—the armored warriors taking position with martial discipline. An ugly scar bisects the half-orc’s face, giving her a permanent sneer of contempt, and she wields her barbed spear as if it were an extension of her own malicious will.

I Watch The Clouds To Relax.name:
我看云让自己放松
I Watch The Clouds To Relax

Text.text:
今日的天空是一片宁静的蔚蓝，为神祇那白与灰的梦境铺陈出安抚的背景，邀人驻足沉思。一朵蓬松得近乎不可能的云懒洋洋地爬过太阳，在下方的地面洒下流动的阴影，并收取一圈银色光晕作为报酬。我将这朵云想象成一场浮夸的化装舞会，而它身后那一簇簇点点的云絮，则像是一串串致谢卡片。“我就满足于在这里看着。”我对自己说道。
Today’s sky, a calming cerulean-blue backdrop for the gods’ dreams of white and gray, invites a moment of contemplation. One impossibly fluffy cloud crawls lazily across the sun and graces the ground below with shadows, picking up a silvery halo as payment. I imagine this cloud to be a grandiose costume ball, and the stippled puffs behind it, a trail of thank-you cards. “I’m content to watch from here,” I say to myself.

Small Desert Encampment Of Soldiers.name:
士兵的小型沙漠营地
Small Desert Encampment Of Soldiers

Text.text:
身着轻薄羊毛衣的士兵们分饮珍贵的清水囊，梳理着线条矫健的坐骑，又一丝不苟地把缠头布系紧——以抵御沙漠风里无孔不入的砂砾。一个随手可取弓箭的斥候坐在帐篷圈的边缘，目光穿透朦胧的地平线来回搜寻。
Soldiers clad in light woolen garments share canteens of precious water, brush their sleek horses, and fastidiously ensure their wrapped headcloths are secure—protection from the invasive grit of desert winds. A scout with a bow near at hand sits at the edge of the circle of tents scanning the hazy horizon.

Chestnut Tree In Temperate Forest.name:
温带森林中的栗树
Chestnut Tree In Temperate Forest

Text.text:
一棵成熟的栗树矗立在林中，粗壮的树干覆着鳞片般的灰色树皮。宽大的五裂掌状叶垂挂于枝头，旁侧是带刺的绿色苞壳，其中一些已坠落在地并裂开。一枚裂开的苞壳半边里，躺着三颗光亮的红褐色栗子；另一半则空空如也，原本托住栗子的凹孔勾勒出一个酷似猪鼻子的形状。
A mature chestnut tree stands in the forest, its thick trunk covered in scaly gray bark. Broad, five-fingered leaves hang from its branches alongside spiny green husks, some of which have fallen to the ground and split open. One half of a split husk contains three glossy red-brown chestnuts. In the other half, the holes that once cradled the chestnuts form a shape that resembles the nose of a pig.

他们用一条朴素的皮条将黑发束在脑后，铁匠用一把长钳从炉火中夹出一根铁条，随即把它搁在旁边的铁砧上，举起锻锤猛力敲打。闷热得令人窒息的高温里，他们对那樱红的金属捶打的时间长得超乎你的想象；终于，他们将已成形的马蹄铁浸入近旁的水槽，蒸汽嘶嘶作响腾起。直到此刻——等活计做完——他们才肯抬眼，算是注意到你。
Their black hair tied back with a simple strip of leather, the smith removes an iron bar from the forge with a long pair of tongs, then places it atop a nearby anvil to pound at it with a smithing hammer. After beating on the cherry-red metal for longer than you would have thought possible in the sweltering heat, they finally dunk the now-finished horseshoe into a nearby trough of water with a hiss of steam. Only now, after they have finished their work, do they deign to take notice of you.

黑暗中传来一阵颤鸣：仿佛鼠类般的尖啸合唱。蝙蝠的烟雾翻涌而出，它们肉质的翅膀疯狂拍打空气。它们尖窄的鼻吻与露齿的嘶吼越逼越近，盘旋绕着你，步步收拢包围圈。
A trill emits from the darkness: a choir of rodent-like screeches. A smog of bats billows into view, their fleshy wings madly slapping the air. Pinched snouts and fanged snarls inch closer as they circle around you, closing in.

这名类人身影披着金属般的毛皮，纹路如獾般黑白相间，在光线下微微闪烁，将万千色彩折回空中。它背上斜挂着一把高科技磁轨枪，松垮的皮革枪鞘随步伐轻晃，腰带上垂着数枚圆润的银色球体。它颈间佩着一枚符文护符，形似一座高耸的巨塔尖顶。
This humanoid figure is cloaked in metallic fur, striped much like a badger, which sparkles slightly in the light, reflecting myriad colors back into the air. It bears a high-tech rail gun slung in a loose leather sheath across its back, and several round silver spheres hang from its belt. Around its neck sits a runic amulet in the shape of a great spire.

Winter Forest Campsite.name:
冬日森林营地
Winter Forest Campsite

Text.text:
林间空地的积雪已被清理干净，中央的火坑燃得通明。往北，一块防水布被拉得笔直，一侧在风中猎猎翻动。覆着雪冠的帐篷挤作一团，门帘被捆扎得死紧，吱呀作响的绳索绷得发紧。四周的树林沉睡无声，松梢之上，云层一片惨白。
The glade has been cleared of snow, and at its center a fire pit burns brightly. Northward, a tarp is stretched, one side flapping in the wind. Snow-tipped tents huddle together, doors lashed closed, creaking ropes tight. The surrounding woods slumber, and above the pines the clouds are white.

Quip After Traumatic Battle.name:
惨烈战斗后的俏皮话
Quip After Traumatic Battle

Text.text:
“不，我一点也不好！我需要一整辆马戏团的医师车——手劲要硬——再来两桶麦酒。然后，也许，我才会开始勉强靠近‘还行’的边儿。”
“No, I am not ok! I need a circus wagon of healers with firm hands and two kegs of ale. Then, maybe, I will begin approaching the vicinity of ok.”

Divine Overlook Of A God Of Strategy.name:
战略之神的神圣俯瞰
Divine Overlook Of A God Of Strategy

Text.text:
在低垂云幕的掩映下，一座自高山峭壁凿刻而成的要塞，其开阔的露台俯瞰大地与海洋。穿过露台上一对宽阔高大的双开门，便是一间房。它方正、朴素而克制，正中央摆着一张游戏桌，旁边只有一把简洁沉重的椅子。桌面空无一物，你这才意识到：那把椅子正对着另一名玩家——门外的世界。
From under a low canopy of clouds, the expansive veranda of a keep carved from the high mountainside looks out on the earth and seas. Through a pair of broad, high double doors from the veranda is a room. It is square, plain, and deliberate, and in its center is a game table with one simple, heavy chair. The table is empty, and you realize that the chair faces the other player—the world outside the door.

Assassin Agent Of The Night Blade.name:
暗刃之夜刺客特工
Assassin Agent Of The Night Blade

Text.text:
那人凶厉的双眼寒光灼灼，锐利不输高举的刀锋，随时可守亦可攻。面具遮住了下半张脸，一枚刻着匕首纹章的胸针扣住肩头的暗色斗篷。容貌尽掩，利刃出鞘——他们来此只为一事：死亡，迅捷而无声地送达。
The figure’s fierce eyes gleam as strikingly as the blades they hold aloft, ready to defend or attack. A mask covers the lower half of their face, and a brooch bearing the symbol of a dagger clasps a dark cloak about their shoulders. Features obscured, blades drawn—they are here for one thing only: death, dealt quickly and quietly.

I Scale A Building With My Enhanced Arms.name:
我用强化过的手臂攀上高楼
I Scale A Building With My Enhanced Arms

Text.text:
我攀上大楼时，手臂里的伺服器因吃力而尖鸣，握住混凝土仿佛捏着柔软的黏土。随着我向上攀升，灰色尘雨倾泻而下——我强化的握力让钛合金手指在楼体外立面上犁出道道伤痕，碎屑因此簌簌飞落。
The servos in my arms whine with effort as I scale the building, gripping the concrete as if it were soft clay. Gray dust showers me as I ascend, created by my enhanced grip as I gouge the building’s façade with my titanium fingers.

Gunshot Deals Minor Wound.name:
枪击造成轻伤
Gunshot Deals Minor Wound

Text.text:
一阵铅雨撕裂空气，爆裂般的枪声在耳边炸开。子弹狠狠钻进大腿柔软的肉里，从身体另一侧扯出一小片血肉飞溅。所幸，这一轮没有伤到任何肌腱或韧带——干净利落地贯穿而过。明早肯定疼得要命，但还不至于让任何人失去战斗力。
A burst of lead cracks through the air. The bullet strikes the fleshy part of the thigh, ripping a small spray of viscera from the body. Mercifully, the round misses any tendons or ligaments—a clean in and out. It’s going to hurt in the morning, but it hasn’t put anyone out of commission.

Discovery Of An Old Research Facility.name:
一座古老研究设施的发现
Discovery Of An Old Research Facility

Text.text:
你面前是一栋宽阔的两层建筑，因自身古老的重量而弯腰塌陷。蜿蜒的枝条穿过混凝土的裂口编织缠绕，勉强将这具残躯危险地撑起。空气浓稠，腐叶霉烂的刺鼻湿气直往鼻腔里钻，空旷处回荡着漏水坠落的幽深滴答。树木从屋顶破土般爆出，裸露的根须垂挂如同吊灯。锈蚀的钢筋在脚边勾扯，你踩碎破裂的实验室装备前行，俯身察看死寂的终端与被尘埃抹花的屏幕。

~ 构想：jomono

Before you slumps a wide two-story building, bowing under its own ancient weight. Snaking branches weave through concrete fractures, holding the structure precariously upright. The air is thick with the pungent damp of moldering leaves and echoes with the cavernous drip of leaking water. Trees erupt from the rooftop, their exposed roots hanging like chandeliers. Rusted rebar snags at your feet as you crunch through broken lab equipment to study dead terminals and their dust-smeared screens.

~ Envisioned by jomono

自你头顶的云层之上，一尊由元素能量凝聚的积云泰坦缓缓降下。阴沉而充满压迫感，这个生物的轮廓在噼啪作响的能流中翻涌不定。它那三指的手——宛如三叉戟——自旋涡般的躯干伸展而出，身后拖曳着盘旋缭绕的雾气。它张口露出冰雹般的獠牙，球状闪电般的双眼迸射火花，以元素之势向你发出挑战。
Descending from the clouds above you is a cumulus titan of elemental energy. Dark and atmospheric, the creature's shape roils with crackling energy. Three-fingered hands—like tridents—extend from its vortex torso which trails off in coiling vapor. It opens its mouth to reveal fangs of hail as its eyes of ball lightning spark in elemental challenge.

Vineyard And Winery.name:
葡萄园与酒庄
Vineyard And Winery

Text.text:
一排又一排葡萄藤向远方绵延不绝，枝蔓沉坠，挂满饱实的果实。干燥的微风自远处酒庄捎来一缕怡人的甜香。田野之上，木质建筑拔地而起，外墙缠绕着开花的藤蔓。外头，帆布篷下，人们安静地坐着，小口啜饮，在阴影里享受躲避烈日的清凉。酒庄的窗与门尽数敞开，任风与阳光穿堂而过；而屋内，堆满酒瓶的架子一直触及天花板。
Rows upon rows of grape vines extend into the far distance, all heavy with plump fruit. The arid breeze carries a pleasant sweetness from the distant winery. Rising from the fields, the wooden structure is wrapped with flowering vines. Outside, beneath canvas canopies, folks sit quietly, sipping drinks and enjoying the shelter from the sun. The winery's windows and doors all stand open to the wind and the sun; and inside, shelves laden with bottles reach to the ceiling.

Paralytic Smart Drug, Pine.name:
麻痹型智能药物：松木
Paralytic Smart Drug, Pine

Text.text:
下城区的霓虹频闪折射在皮下注射器里晃荡的苍白树脂状液体中。把针头猛地扎进后脑，感受思维点燃——进入一种亢奋、澄明而甜蜜的状态。

[注射] 松脂渗入之际，你的念头狂奔。突触如将熄的恒星般迸发。你像神祇般驾驭赛博现实，挣脱凡躯的枷锁，而你的身体在药物的麻痹性副作用中渐渐屈服。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The undercity’s neon strobes refract in the pale resinous liquid sloshing in the hypodermic injector. Stab it into the back of your head and feel your mind ignite into a hyperactive state of blissful clarity.

[Injected] As the Pine seeps, your thoughts race. Synapses fire like dying stars. You surf the cyber reality like a god, untethered from the shackles of mortal flesh, as your body succumbs to the paralytic side effects of the drug.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

灌木间豁然裂开一道缺口，露出一条穿林而过、被踩踏得发亮的小径。阳光刺破树冠，在高耸的蕨丛与藤蔓缠绕的灌木间，将小路点染成斑驳的光影。一只小小的鸟儿落下啄饮水洼里的清水，却在你还没看清它究竟是什么时，便已扑棱着翅膀掠入林深处。
A break in the bushes reveals a well-trodden path through the woods. Sunlight pierces the canopy to dapple the trail between tall ferns and vine-covered shrubs. A tiny bird lands to drink water from a puddle, but flits away through the forest before you can tell exactly what it was.

Burned Forest On Hillside.name:
山坡上的焦黑森林
Burned Forest On Hillside

Text.text:
曾经沿着这面坡攀爬而上的森林已不复存在，被烈火吞噬殆尽。焦黑的树桩如鸡皮疙瘩般点点凸起在地表，碎石坡与断裂的残干散落在被夷平的山坡上。空气里仍浓烈地滞留着焦木的气味与灰烬般的薄霾。山脚的烟更为浓重，使这片被烧灼的土地灰蒙蒙一片，轮廓模糊不清。
The forest that once climbed this slope is gone, consumed by fire. Blackened stumps pimple the earth like gooseflesh, and scree and shattered trunks litter the razed hillside. The smell of burned wood and an ashy haze linger thickly in the air. The smoke is denser at the bottom of the hill, rendering the scorched land gray and indistinct.

Quip About Having Fun In Combat.name:
战斗也能乐在其中的俏皮话
Quip About Having Fun In Combat

Text.text:
“这些镇民讲起故事来反复无常；你一个人单挑十号人，他们就把你捧成英雄，可你在干这事时稍微找点乐子，转眼他们就喊你杀人犯。”
“These townsfolk are fickle in their stories; you can fight ten men singlehanded and you’re a hero, but have a bit of fun while you do it and all of the sudden they call you a murderer.”

Major Earthquake Near A Supervolcano.name:
超级火山附近发生强烈地震
Major Earthquake Near A Supervolcano

Text.text:
史诗般灾厄的汇流绚丽夺目：黑色的土壤与猩红的尘沙交织，山腰间探出一缕缕修长的火光。尘云翻滚而起，大地沿着断层线张开巨口。裂隙上方，一座火山震颤不止，猛然一晃，在深蓝的天幕下喷吐出明亮的赤红与鎏金熔岩。方圆数里，无一处安稳，万物皆在奔涌，而暴怒的古老神祇正以此为乐。
The convergence of epic disasters is colorful: black earth and red dust, with firelight in long tendrils emerging from the mountainside. Dust clouds billow up as the earth yawns open along the fault line. A volcano shakes over the fissure, lurching out a spray of lava in bright reds and golds under a dark blue sky. For miles, nothing is stable, all is in motion, and the angry ancient gods have their fun.

这间密室的拱门附近温度骤降，室内挤满了各式大小的陶罐与石匣。门口正对面立着一座木架，上面垂挂着纸张或亚麻布条，其上刻画着蛇形符文。其中一条布带的符文散发出比烛光更柔和的蓝光，点点光屑如发亮的尘埃般飘落地面，落地即渐渐黯淡。门槛处的地面也积着一圈黑色粉尘，里面还混着……几颗牙齿？
The temperature falls near the archway of this chamber, which is crowded with clay vessels and stone boxes of various sizes. Opposite the doorway is a wooden rack draped with paper or linen marked with serpentine runes. The runes on one strip give off blue light softer than a candle, and motes of this light fall to the floor like luminous dust, darkening as they land. Dark dust also lines the floor in the doorway, along with… several teeth?

I Pickpocket A Guard.name:
我扒窃一名守卫
I Pickpocket A Guard

Text.text:
有人说，扒窃守卫太过鲁莽；可我说，真正的鲁莽，是把鼓鼓囊囊、沉甸甸的钱币袋就这么明晃晃挂在腰带上。只需一瞬：在人潮里贴身一擦，随即我那把细长匕首利落一划。我本可以像抢走他们一样快地要了守卫的命——刀锋一线切开皮革，钱币袋坠落，正正落进我摊开的掌心。钱币叮当作响，却轻易被轰雷般的脚步声掩去，再加上一个一贯惹人厌的街头小贩高声感召，把众人的注意力统统拽到他那边。
Some say it’s too brash to pickpocket a guard, but I say brash is wearing a clearly heavy coin pouch openly on your belt. It takes only a moment: a close brush in a crowd and then a swift swipe of my stiletto dagger. I could have killed the guard as quickly as I robbed them, my knife slicing through leather in a single motion and the coin pouch falling directly into my open palm. A jingle of coins is masked easily by thundering footsteps and a reliably obnoxious street hawker calling attention his way.

Potion Of Heroism.name:
英勇药剂
Potion Of Heroism

Text.text:
塞着瓶塞的小瓶里，那抹蓝宝石般的调制液无休止地翻涌起泡。正因如此，瓶塞被做得略带孔隙，既能让蒸汽逸散，又能在粗暴搬弄时不至于让这珍贵液体大量流出——顶多缓缓渗漏。
The sapphire concoction within the stoppered vial bubbles endlessly. For this reason, the stopper is porous enough to allow steam to escape without allowing more than a slow ooze of the valuable liquid to escape when roughly handled.

Ritual Fails Comically.name:
仪式滑稽地失败
Ritual Fails Comically

Text.text:
念完那一连串阴暗恶秽的字句，兜帽牧师正要放声狂笑——却忽然停住。窃窃私语像鼠影般在室内飞快窜开，聚集的侍徒彼此低声交换眼神：他们是不是搞错了？牧师抬起双手示意肃静，凝视那卷古老经文片刻，随即长长地、疲惫又恼火地叹了口气，把书翻转过来，摆正了方向。

~ MaesterAelix 于 Discord

Completing the dark and foul words, the hooded priest begins to cackle wildly—but stops. A murmur scurries around the room as the assembled acolytes whisper to each other. Did they make a mistake? The priest raises his hands for silence and studies the ancient text for a moment, before letting out a long, exasperated sigh and turning the book the right way up.

~ MaesterAelix on Discord

Copper Buckle For A Wide Belt.name:
宽腰带用铜扣
Copper Buckle For A Wide Belt

Text.text:
这东西与其说是扣带扣，不如说更像一台机器。作为侏儒工艺的结晶，它复杂得毫无必要。插舌被藏得严严实实，必须先解开一连串短小却烦人的谜题才能放出它，腰带方可使用。满身齿轮与卡扣让它沉甸甸的，但最古怪的是它永远不会失去锋利。无论遭到怎样的摧残，那抹铜色依旧耀眼如新，光芒灼人。
This is more machine than buckle. A work of gnomish craftsmanship, it is unnecessarily complicated. The prong is hidden and needs to be released by a series of short but annoying puzzles before the belt can be used. It is heavy from all the gears and latches, but its greatest oddity is that it never dulls. The copper shines brilliantly no matter how badly it may be abused.

Knight Vs Werewolf.name:
骑士对决狼人
Knight Vs Werewolf

Text.text:
野蛮与骑士道在这对死斗者间轰然相撞，利爪刮擦金属的刺耳尖啸为这场混战刻下残酷的伴奏。骑士护甲上的一道道深刻爪痕，昭示着那头野兽对手非同寻常的蛮力：一只魁梧、凶悍的野性狼人。那生物的黄眸闪烁着原始怒火，月光下獠牙寒光乍现，它狂暴地扑向骑士。
Savagery clashes with chivalry as the pair battle, the terrible sound of claws screeching against metal scoring the fracas. Gouges in the knight’s armor attest to the unnatural strength of their bestial opponent: a hulking feral werewolf. Yellow eyes gleam with primal fury as the creature rampages toward the knight, fangs gleaming in the light of the moon.

歌者那带着阳刚气息却克制有度的嗓音升起，甜润如蜜，低音深沉共鸣，高音清澈利落。他们的演唱最适合独唱曲目，中音区拿捏得恰到好处，即使单独聆听也悦耳动人。
The singer’s masculine but measured voice rises, a honeyed sound with deep, resonant lows and crisp highs. Their singing is ideal for solo pieces, achieving a middle register that is pleasing to the ear even on its own.

Nervous Young Recruits Line Up To Run Ga.name:
紧张的年轻新兵排成一列，准备闯过考验长廊
Nervous Young Recruits Line Up To Run Gauntlet

Text.text:
新兵们站在大门前的起跑线上，等待着开场的哨声。有些人紧张得坐立不安，扯着衬衣领口和袖子，仿佛制服勒得他们喘不过气。另一些人只是直直望向前方，用不可动摇的专注把自己钉在原地，为即将到来的考验硬起心肠。也有人想把笼罩在队伍上方的焦虑笑过去，抛出几句玩笑，硬是要给这场合添上一点幽默。

~ 由 Dwayne 在 Discord 上 构想

The recruits await the starting whistle as they stand on the line before the gates. Some fidget nervously, tugging at shirt collars and sleeves as if suffocated by the uniform. Others merely stare directly ahead, steeling themselves for the trials to come with unbreakable focus. Some try to laugh off the anxiety hanging over the group, cracking jokes and straining to add a sense of humor to the occasion.

~ Envisioned by Dwayne on Discord

Urban Noir Setting.name:
都市黑色设定
Urban Noir Setting

Text.text:
肥皂石桌面上点缀着一圈圈酒渍，油腻的纸牌摊成扇形，覆在一盏噼啪吐火的煤气灯下。门口的守卫夸张地打了个哈欠——酒壶既已见底，一个穿着松开束身衣的疲惫女孩把椅子倒扣到桌上，挥手赶走最后几名赌徒，随后劳累地长叹。发明家与打手——最后一手牌里最后剩下的两人——彼此点头道贺，往后一靠，伸展筋骨。他们戴上高顶礼帽，签字让人把赢来的钱连同早餐一并由信使送上门。

巷子外，一人转向种着树的隔离带，那点绿意正与煤灰顽抗。另一人走向死胡同，放下消防逃生梯。梯子咔嗒咔嗒扣到位，她利落地攀上去。从三楼平台——她穿着荷叶边衬衫、收腰外套与扣紧的长靴——望着发明家拖着步子回他的实验室。她从窗户钻入，像一方被风托起的丝质手帕般的幽灵（特征），穿过一条剥落铅漆的长廊，随后没入墙中。

幽灵（特征）踏入星光里，穿过街道，沿着工厂黑砖侧墙走上屋顶。她与焦黑的烟囱跳起方阵舞，脚下有人吹着口哨作曲，她旋身挨近每一根锡皮圆筒，抬起高而半透明的手，几乎要触到它。城市在鹅卵石上马蹄的击打声里、苦艾酒瓶的叮当声里、以及车厢里弹药的哗啦声里喷吐浓烟。一个警察转着黑色警棍停下脚步，眯眼望向一条黑方块般的巷口——那地方活像给暴徒立起的灯塔。

Drink rings and fans of greasy cards decorate a soapstone table beneath a spitting gas light. The guard at the door yawns dramatically and—now that the wine jugs are empty—a weary girl in a loosened corset flips chairs upside down onto tables, shoos out the remaining gamblers, then sighs with fatigue. The artificer and the cutter, the last two in the last hand, nod congratulations, sit back and stretch. They don their top hats and sign for their winnings to be delivered, with breakfast, by courier.

Out in the alley, one turns for the tree-lined median, its greenery fighting the coal soot. The other walks to the dead-end and pulls down the fire escape. As the ladder ratchets into place she ascends skillfully. From the third-floor landing—in her ruffled blouse, tapered coat, and buttoned boots—she watches the artificer trundle off to his lab. She climbs through the window, a ghost like a silk handkerchief on a breeze, crosses the long hall of chipped lead paint, and disappears into the wall.

The ghost steps out into the starlight, crosses the street, and walks up the black brick side of the factory to the roof. She dances a quadrille with the charred smokestacks, to the tune someone is whistling below, spinning to each tin cylinder and nearly touching it with a high, translucent hand. The city belches smoke over the percussion of hooves on cobblestones, the clinking of absinthe bottles, and the rattle of ammunition in a cart. A policeman, twirling a black club, stops to peer into the black square of an alley that may as well be a beacon for thuggery.

在这座漫长而低矮、如迷宫般的建筑里，绝望从每一道缝隙渗出，裹挟着烈酒与烟雾的气味、汗垢的躯体与发馊的面包味一并飘荡。会客厅里传来杯中骰子摇晃的声响，钱币在桌面上被轻敲、或刮擦着滑进等候伸来的臂弯，伴着粗豪的大笑与震耳的咒骂。噼啪作响的火把光照出一张张汗湿的面孔，饥渴在其中燃烧。刀子藏在阴影里。
Lost hope pours from every opening in this long, low maze of a building, carried on the odors of liquor and smoke, rank bodies and stale bread. From the parlors come the sounds of dice in cups, coins tapped on tables or scraped into waiting arms, big laughter and loud curses. Sputtering torchlight reveals sweating faces full of hunger. The knives hide in shadow.

尽管这位类人生物高高耸立在众人之上，他却以一种极不安的姿态蜷缩着自己。硕大的牛耳从一绺绺鲜红如火的发间探出头来，赤褐色的毛斑像漂浮的岛屿，散落在他蔚蓝的皮肤上，仿佛静海之上的点点孤屿。他的护甲十分古怪：由木质小环串连成衫——像是天然的锁子甲。他那双巨大的绿眼警惕而闪躲地扫过来往行人，身子沉沉倚着一根老旧的长棍，竭力让自己显得尽可能渺小。

~ 由一位英雄 Played 扮演，附

Though the humanoid towers over those around him, he holds himself in a most insecure fashion. Large bovine ears spring out between locks of vibrant red hair, and ruddy patches of fur cover his azure skin like islands adrift on a serene ocean. His armor is peculiar, constructed from wooden ringlets that form a shirt—like natural chain mail. His large green eyes move furtively over passers-by as he leans heavily on an old quarterstaff, trying to stay as small as possible.

~ Played by a Hero with

立钟的暖色铃音与金属锣声在寂静的长廊里回荡，余韵与一股仿佛自大地深处传来的低沉嗡鸣交织在一起。你原以为奏出这些奇异声响的乐师是用它们来冥想，可忽然一记铙钹的铿然乱响与长笛的尖细呜咽，又让你怀疑：那些想要入定的人，或许得在这音乐的干扰下硬生生静下心来。
The warm tones of column bells and metal gongs ring out through the quiet halls, their echoes joining a deep hum that seems to come from the ground. You think the musicians playing these unusual sounds must use them for meditation, but the sudden clatter of a cymbal and whine of a flute makes you wonder if those who seek to meditate must do so despite the music.

Sundries From An Owlin.name:
来自鸮灵的小杂货
Sundries From An Owlin

Text.text:
鸮裔瘫作一团，羽毛凌乱蓬起，双翼摊开。你翻找他们的背包，却没发现多少东西。一本笔记本里记着过去几天简短而琐碎的流水账，夹杂着几幅粗糙的涂鸦，画的是本地的花草。一支羽毛笔压在书页间，那羽毛也许是从他们自己肩头拔下的。还有一个皮革小袋，里头装着一堆圆滚滚的东西，摸上去起初让你以为是装钱币的袋子；可你打开一看，里面却是一小堆微微煎过、泛着虹彩的甲虫——给饥肠辘辘的旅人充饥的零嘴。
The owlkin lies in a heap of ruffled feathers, wings sprawled out. Searching their pack, you don’t find much. There’s a notebook with short, mundane records of the past few days and some crude doodles of local flora. A quill is pressed between the pages, a feather mayhaps pulled from their own shoulder. A leather pouch full of rounded objects feels like a bag of coins to you at first, but you open it to find a pile of lightly fried iridescent beetles—a snack for the peckish traveler.

I Cast Jump.name:
我施放【跳跃术】
I Cast Jump

Text.text:
脑海里掠过蚱蜢、兔子与美洲狮的幻影，我将法术猛地掷向目标脚边。嫩枝般的翠绿魔法丝线如随风飘舞的缎带，自他们脚底沿着双腿一路攀升。他们眼中跳起一抹灵动的辉光，我便知道法术已然生效。
Images of grasshoppers, rabbits, and pumas in my head, I fling the spell at my target’s feet. Threads of spriggy-green magic travels like ribbons on the wind from the soles of their feet up their legs. A sprightly glow appears in their eyes, so I know the spell has stuck.

Getting Caught By A Villainous Hacker-as.name:
被邪恶黑客刺杀部队逮个正着
Getting Caught By A Villainous Hacker-assassinating Force

Text.text:
在赛博空间这片杂糅的疆域里，黑客的狂胆如同骇人的心跳般悸动不止。当他们渗入宿主的虚无节点，搜寻数字战利品时，一次虚拟的失足惊醒了沉睡的泰坦。暴怒的看守者轰然苏醒，蜥蜴般的二进制鳞甲在怒火中闪烁。黑客那场胆大妄为的劫掠，瞬间变成了拼命逃离这头暴走巨龙、穿越致命代码风暴的亡命奔逃。

~ 一位英雄 构想

In the eclectic realm of cyberspace, the hacker’s audacity throbs like a heinous heartbeat. As they seep into the host’s null node, seeking digital plunder, a virtual misstep wakes a sleeping titan. The wrathful warden roars into life, its saurian, binary scales shimmering with rage. The hacker’s daring heist becomes a desperate scramble to escape the enraged wyrm’s storm of lethal code.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

在你前方，几乎延伸到目力所及之处，是一片未经践踏、郁郁葱葱的高草绿海，在风中柔顺起伏。置身于此，你既感到心神舒缓，又隐隐不安——敌人几乎无处藏身，但你也同样无处可躲。
Ahead of you, nearly as far as the eye can see, lies an unspoiled, verdant sea of tall grass swaying smoothly in the wind. In such environs, you feel both soothed and unnerved, for your enemies have virtually nowhere to hide—but neither do you.

Speech To Mob About Defending Their Home.name:
对暴民的演说：守护家园
Speech To Mob About Defending Their Homes

Text.text:
“我们会把这些生物从我们的土地上驱逐出去。不是因为这公正。不是因为这能解决世界的苦难，或纠正过往的罪错。而是因为这片土地属于我们。每一具被我们留在战场上、支离破碎、血肉模糊的躯体，都在向那些妄想夺走它的人证明：我们才是这里的主人。”
“We will drive these creatures from our lands. Not because it is just. Not because it will solve the world’s woes or right the wrongs of the past. But because this land is ours. And with every broken and bloodied body we leave on the battlefield, we prove our ownership to those who would think to take it from us.”

Ship Lifted Skyward By Hurricane.name:
飓风将船卷上天际
Ship Lifted Skyward By Hurricane

Text.text:
当你扫视着无垠的海面，挫败与困惑在心头争夺上风——这里什么都没有。甲板上不满的低语蔓延开来，人们交换着闪烁的目光，有人高声喊着要去查看地图。忽然，一阵狂暴的疾风猛扑船身，几乎要把你手中的地图扯飞；与此同时，一道旋转的气旋向甲板俯冲而下！船员们只来得及在龙卷风撞上前的短短瞬间稳住身形，随即整艘船就像纸折的小舟般被卷入空中。你只觉肺里的空气被硬生生抽空，船体一路攀升，像鲸鱼破浪般冲出云层。诡异的宁静随之笼罩甲板，而那座灿然辉煌的城市，已在你们面前显现。

~ 由 Clara C. Potter 在 Discord 上 构想

Frustration and confusion battle for dominance within you as you survey the open waves—there's nothing here. Murmurs of discontent spread across the deck as furtive glances are exchanged, and someone shouts to check the map. Suddenly a violent wind buffets the ship, almost tearing the map from your hands, as a whirling cyclone descends toward the deck! The crew has mere moments to brace themselves before the tornado hits, and whisks the entire ship into the air like a paper boat. You feel the air rush from your lungs as the vessel climbs skyward, bursting through the clouds like a whale breaching the waves below. A sense of eerie calm descends over the ship as the resplendent city appears before you.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

那枚光滑而虹彩流转的蛋猛然一阵移动，颤抖着沿着中线裂开。一双带爪的手先探了出来，随后是一张爬行类的喙。新生的龙裔抬起头，蛋壳像锥形帽子一样扣在头顶，横向的眼睑一开一合，眨了眨眼。
The egg, smooth and iridescent, trembles and cracks down its middle with a sudden flurry of movement. A pair of clawed hands emerge, followed by a reptilian beak. The newborn dragonborn lifts their head, eggshell sitting like a conical hat on top, and blinks their eyes with horizontal eyelids.

Crashed Spaceship In Glass Desert.name:
玻璃荒漠中的坠毁飞船
Crashed Spaceship In Glass Desert

Text.text:
无人记得究竟发生了什么，才让沙漠化作玻璃——那已是久远到不可追溯的往昔，而探索又危机四伏。金属废墟在数里之外便清晰可见，越过水晶般的沙丘，于每一轮太阳穿行荒寂天穹时，都在光中闪耀冷辉。然而生命总能找到适应之道，此地亦不例外。传说中的生物——亦或梦魇——在癫狂幸存者的急促低语与惊惧商人的口口相传中被赋予形体，徘徊于玻璃般的沙海之上，被浸透镜面荒原的诡异能量永远改写了模样。

~ 由 Discord 上的 MaesterAelix Envisioned

No one remembers what happened to turn the desert to glass—it happened so long ago, and exploration is dangerous. The metallic ruins can be seen from miles away, over the crystalline dunes, gleaming in the light of each sun crossing the desolate sky. But life always finds a way to adapt, and this place is no exception. Creatures of legend—and nightmare—given form by the frantic whispers of crazed survivors and terrified merchants, stalk the glassy sands, irrevocably changed by the strange energies that saturate the mirrored expanse.

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

Seelie Noble Negotiates With Megacorp Ex.name:
妖精贵胄与巨型企业高管展开交涉
Seelie Noble Negotiates With Megacorp Exec

Text.text:
“来这里之前，我就听过不少关于你们团体的传闻。你们的名号在这间破窝里被霓光贴得满墙都是。我毫不怀疑，你们把这些体系掰到合你们意志的形状后，已经攒下了海量的崇拜与财富——可你们打算拿它做什么？立起巨大的独石碑。让一摞又一摞的人埋头算数。你们发了大财，却用它去……干更多的活？只为追逐某个飘渺的百分比。多么可怕的乏味。方法得当，人们给你的会远不止钱。不过我想，要教你们明白自己错在哪儿，就像教一棵树怎么生火：对所有参与者都不会有好结果。遗憾的是，我们恐怕做不成买卖——你们经营的是分数，而我经营的是命运。”

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

“Before coming here, I had heard a great deal about your group. Your name is plastered in glowing lights all over this hovel. I have no doubt you’ve accumulated a great deal of adoration and wealth from these systems you bend to your will, but what do you decide to do with it? Build giant monoliths. Stacks on stacks of people doing math. You’ve made a fortune and you use it to work… more? All in the pursuit of some ethereal percentage. How dreadfully dull. With the right methods, people will give you so much more than money. But I imagine teaching you the error in your ways would be like teaching a tree how to light a fire: a poor outcome for all involved. Unfortunately, I doubt we will be able to do business together as you deal in fractions and I deal in fates.”

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Valdar Krespin, Oathbreaker.name:
瓦尔达·克雷斯平，背誓者
Valdar Krespin, Oathbreaker

Text.text:
这个全副武装、披挂护甲的男人，上半身的轮廓几乎令人难以置信，像倒置的三角：肩膀夸张地宽阔，腰身却收束得利落紧实。他那面磨损的盾牌与板甲上烙着某个骑士团的徽记，昭示着他宣誓效忠的归属；然而层层锈蚀与污晦遮住了细节，再加上肩头随意披着一件磨旧的毛皮斗篷，使图案更难辨认。战士的脸上看不出半分幽默或怜悯，仿佛与周遭一切隔着一层冷淡的距离——从睁眼到被睡意夺走，他脑中显然只有那桩任务。 当他的视线落到你身上，你注意到他左侧颈部有一道骇人的刀疤，斜切而下，越过气管一路延伸到对侧锁骨。你无论如何也想不明白，他究竟是怎么从那样的一击中活下来的。

~ Played by jschoudt

The upper body of this armed and armored man beggars belief, shaped like an upside-down triangle: overdeveloped shoulders and trim waist. The symbols emblazoned upon his worn shield and plate armor indicate his sworn allegiance to a knightly order, though the details are somewhat difficult to make out given the layers of tarnish, and the worn fur cloak draped across his shoulders. The warrior’s face holds little humor or compassion, disaffected from his surroundings, a mission clearly on his mind from the time he wakes to when slumber claims him. As his gaze settles on you, you take note of a hideous scar from a blade along the left side of his neck, leading down across his trachea to his opposite collarbone. For the life of you, you cannot figure out how he could have survived such a blow.

~ Played by jschoudt

这名佝偻、畸形的蜥蜴类人形迅疾移动，杀意凛然，利爪紧攥长矛。缀在其鳞覆头颅上的羽饰随风簌簌作响，生物屈膝跪下，黄色的眼睛眯成一线，鼻翼翕张。它嗅着空气，在齿间弹出分叉的舌信。
The slouched, malformed reptilian humanoid moves swiftly and with deadly purpose, spear gripped tight in clawed hands. The feathers adorning their scaled head rustle in the breeze as the creature kneels, yellow eyes narrowed, nostrils flared. They sniff the air, flicking a forked tongue from between their teeth.

Catching Grave Robbers In The Act.name:
当场逮住盗墓贼
Catching Grave Robbers In The Act

Text.text:
墓园上空飘来人声与掘土的沙沙响，腐烂与翻起湿土的气味也随之弥散。几盏提灯的微光比回荡的声响更能指明源头。如此深夜，究竟有多少人在干活，难以分辨。忽然，挖掘声戛然而止。紧接着一声喊叫响起，更多声音随之拔高，像是兴奋……又像是恐惧。
Voices and the sounds of digging carry across the graveyard. So too does the odor of rot and turned earth. The glow of a couple lanterns pinpoints the source better than the echoing noises. It’s hard to tell the number of people working at this late hour. Suddenly, the digging stops. Then comes a shout and other voices raised in excitement… or fear.

Mazebury Ward & The Labyrinth In Winter.name:
迷宫堡区 & 冬日迷宫
Mazebury Ward & The Labyrinth In Winter

Text.text:
集市里人头攒动，人人都在为礼物挑挑拣拣：细看一罐罐果酱蜜饯，挑选手工玩具与各色小玩意儿。作为这一区得名由来的“迷宫”正由一队园丁细心打理——他们个个戴着软塌塌的宽檐帽，穿着长外套，嘴角挂着心照不宣的笑。金缕梅细长如触须的花瓣从叶间探出头来，丝毫不惧寒意。一个男人追着他的约会对象钻进迷宫里，嗥叫着：“跑啊，丹尼，跑！”紧跟着是一串顽皮的笑声。他的胡闹把一对刺猬从灌木下吓得窜了出来。
The market brims with people seeking presents: inspecting jars of preserves, handmade toys, and other trinkets. The Labyrinth, the ward’s namesake, is being tended by a team of gardeners—all wearing floppy hats, long coats, and knowing smiles. Long, tendril petals of witch hazel sprout out from the leaves, undeterred by the cold. A man chases his date into the maze, howling “Run, Danny, run!” followed by mischievous laughter. His antics scare a pair of hedgehogs out from under the brush.

I Cast Fireball Using Guano.name:
我用鸟粪施放火球术
I Cast Fireball Using Guano

Text.text:
我用指尖缓缓揉转那团硫磺味刺鼻的蝙蝠粪球，蓄势般绷紧全身，准备施放法术。随着我专注于驾驭掌心翻涌、嘶嘶冒泡的能量，热度迅速攀升。我望向我的目标，伸出食指，在完成法术的瞬间释放出我那毁灭性的造物。
Rolling the sulfurous ball of guano between my fingers, I tense my body in anticipation as I prepare to cast the spell. Heat grows rapidly as I focus on controlling the roiling, effervescent energy building in my palm. I look toward my target and extend my index finger as I complete the spell and unleash my destructive creation.

Barbarian Quip About Hatred.name:
野蛮人对仇恨的俏皮话
Barbarian Quip About Hatred

Text.text:
“我不是个爱发火的人。我伤人不是因为恨他们。我这么做，是因为爱。我折断的每一根骨头、停跳的每一颗心，都是为了我爱的人。为了让他们平安、快乐。你觉得安全，对吧？”
“I’m not an angry person. I don’t hurt people because I hate them. I do it because of love. Every bone I break and heart I stop beating is for the people I love. To keep them safe and happy. You feel safe, right?”

I Use Peerless Skill.name:
我施展无双技能
I Use Peerless Skill

Text.text:
关于那些曾完成我即将去做之事的伟人，歌谣与传说不请自来地涌上心头。毫无疑问，我也当算他们中的一员。那段历史，以及我对它的信念，让我对成功的把握更添几分自信。
Songs and stories of other great people who have done what I’m about to do come unbidden to my mind. Surely, I can be counted among them. That history, and my faith in it, gives me confidence in my chances to succeed.

Sundries From A Nightmare.name:
噩梦余烬
Sundries From A Nightmare

Text.text:
地狱战马从焦灼冒烟的喉间挤出最后一声破碎嘶鸣，随即轰然塌落，化作一团令人作呕的烟霾与余烬。待恶臭的雾气散去，空灵兽影所剩的唯有一堆冒着烟的灰烬，以及刺鼻的硫磺腥臭。
The infernal steed releases one final, ragged whinny from its smoldering throat as it collapses into a detestable cloud of smog and embers. When the foul mist clears, a smoking pile of ash and the stench of sulfur are all that remain of the ethereal beast.

蒸汽在空气中浓得化不开，硫磺的气味紧紧黏附其上，翻涌卷动，滚滚弥漫在整个区域。朦胧的青绿水池点缀在嶙峋的岩丘间；尽管气味刺鼻，这里却有一种奇异的宁静，仿佛这些水池本身正渴望洗净你疲惫的灵魂。
Steam hangs thick in the air, the fragrance of sulfur clinging to it as it churns and billows through the area. Pools of hazy turquoise water are scattered through the rocky outcropping, and regardless of the smell, there is an air of serenity as if the pools themselves long to cleanse your tired soul.

Field Ready For The Fall Harvest.name:
为秋收而备战
Field Ready For The Fall Harvest

Text.text:
你眼前的几片田地里，南瓜与各类冬瓜等晚季作物长势喜人，几乎已经到了收割的时候。很快，农夫和他们的家人就会倾巢而出，争分夺秒地把收成抢回家中，赶在冬季第一场霜冻降临之前。
The late-year crops like pumpkin and squash flourish in some of the fields before you, nearly ready for harvest. Soon farmers and their families will be out in force, hurrying to bring in the yield before the first winter frost.

Ancient Vampire In Jungle Temple.name:
丛林神庙中的远古吸血鬼（特征）
Ancient Vampire In Jungle Temple

Text.text:
你伫立在丛林地表浓稠的湿热里，脚下尽是白骨与藤蔓。低矮的墙面覆满浅浮雕：一张张诡异的侧脸或吐着长舌，或戴着羽冠。由石块垒成的阶梯金字塔——缝隙里积着苔藓——如一尊端坐的神祇，压迫般俯视整片丛林。无数石阶蜿蜒向上通往祭司的壁龛；就在那倾斜框架投下的阴影边缘，站着那吸血鬼（特征），即使隔着这段距离也令人胆寒。那不死之影转身走入其内，而此前一直噤声的丛林鸟群也重新开始絮语。

~ 设想：Raphael Herrera

You stand amid bones and vines in the thick humidity of the jungle floor. The lower walls are covered in bas-reliefs of strange profiles with their tongues sticking out or wearing feathered headdresses. The ziggurat of stone blocks—moss collected in the cracks between them—looms like a seated god over the jungle. Many stairs lead upward to the priest’s alcove, and just inside the shade of its angled frame stands the vampire, a harrowing presence even from this distance. The undead figure turns and walks inside, and the jungle birds, silent until now, go back to their conversations.

~ Envisioned by Raphael Herrera

Valley With A Warm Breeze.name:
暖风拂过的山谷
Valley With A Warm Breeze

Text.text:
你翻过山脊时，一阵温暖的微风裹着甜香拂面而来。眼前豁然展开一片宽阔的谷地：你脚下的坡面与对面的山坡上，点点小树林洒落其间，野花如星般斑驳铺陈。蜜蜂嗡鸣掠过耳畔，远处你瞥见一群鹿的身影，转瞬便受惊般疾奔着横穿山坡而去。
A warm breeze carries a sweet scent as you crest the hill. A broad vale opens before you, with both the slope on which you stand and the hillside opposite dappled with small copses of trees and speckled with wildflowers. Bees buzz past, and in the distance you spy a herd of deer just before it bolts across the hillside.

Plane Of Smoke.name:
烟雾位面
Plane Of Smoke

Text.text:
你周遭是一场狂乱的风暴：炫目灼烧的浓烟与灰烬翻涌不息；无尽的火焰风暴由原初之风驱动，以原初之火为食。透过燃烧的狂飙，你瞥见远处有什么东西——某种建筑般的轮廓？可在这种地方，究竟还有什么能屹立不倒？没时间多想。
Your surroundings are a whirlwind of blinding, burning smoke and ash, a firestorm unending fueled by primal winds and fed by primal flame. Through the burning tempest, you spy something in the distance—a structure of sorts? But what could remain standing out here? No time to wonder.

Notorious Intergalactic Bounty Hunter.name:
臭名昭著的星际赏金猎人
Notorious Intergalactic Bounty Hunter

Text.text:
和所有最危险的人一样，她从不觉得需要靠表演来证明什么。女人身上那些早已褪色的长疤与冰冷的眼神替她开口，她用刺骨的凝视钉住每一个路过的人。没人敢回望——生怕她从身上那许多隐蔽却仍清晰可见的武器里，随手抽出一件。
Like all the most dangerous people, she doesn’t feel the need to put on a show about it. The woman’s long-faded scars and cold eyes do all the talking for her as she fixes a piercing stare on every passerby. Nobody meets that gaze, for risk of her pulling one of the many subtle but still visible weapons on her person.

Centaur Sheriff Brings Outlaws To Jail.name:
半人马警长押送亡命徒入狱
Centaur Sheriff Brings Outlaws To Jail

Text.text:
如同他们巡逻的尘土荒原一般粗粝坚韧，警长们押着一批新抓的亡命徒进了镇子，准备送进牢房。队伍最前头是一名半人马，细薄的唇角叼着一截卷好的小雪茄，眯起的眼睛从一顶肮脏的战役帽帽檐下冷冷窥视。两名副警长伴在他身侧，步伐利落，步枪高高端起，随时应对麻烦。左边是一位饱经风霜的半身人，灰发稀薄，粗硬的连鬓胡格外显眼。右边则是一名稚气未脱的人类——不过十来岁——红发扎成实用的辫子。

~ Envisioned by Paul Iverson on Discord

As rugged and hardy as the dusty lands they patrol, the marshals make their way into town with a fresh crop of outlaws for the jail. A centaur leads the pack, a rolled cigarillo dangling from the corner of his thin lips as narrowed eyes peer out beneath the brim of a grimy campaign hat. At his side, two deputies stride purposefully with rifles held aloft, ready for trouble. On the left, a grizzled halfling with thinning gray hair and prominent mutton chops. On the right, a fresh-faced human—no more than a teenager—with her red hair tied into a practical braid.

~ Envisioned by Paul Iverson on Discord

Intimidation By A Barbarian About Wantin.name:
一个野蛮人粗声低吼着逼近，拳头捏得咔咔作响，战意像火一样从他眼里喷出来。  
“别躲。”他咧开嘴，露出森白的牙，“把你最狠的招拿出来——让我痛快打一场。”
Intimidation By A Barbarian About Wanting To Fight

Text.text:
“通常，我把人揍到他们再也不想打为止。我想你也可以把这叫作慈悲。但对你……等别人看见我把你收拾成什么样，就再也不会有人想打架了。”
“Normally, I beat people down until they don’t want to fight no more. I guess you could call it compassion. But with you… When people see what I’ve done with you, no one’s going to want to fight ever again.”

I Am Blinded By Radiant Dragon's Breath.name:
我被光辉巨龙的吐息灼得眼前一片漆黑
I Am Blinded By Radiant Dragon's Breath

Text.text:
一团仿佛熔融岩浆般的凝块在巨龙喉咙深处凝成，透过那枯瘦的巨口清晰可见——它张得越来越大。我想喊出一句警告，却还来不及，巨龙的颈与胸已猛然痉挛。我抬起双臂遮挡，可这魔法无处可逃——世界瞬间化作纯粹、灼烈的白。我的双眼刺痛抽跳，疼得发颤；视野被硬生生夺走。
A globule of what looks like molten rock forms at the back of the dragon’s throat, clearly seen through the spindly maw that opens wider and wider. I try to shout a word of warning, but the dragon’s neck and chest convulse before I can. I hold up my arms, but there is no escaping this magic—the world turns to pure, searing white. My eyes sting and throb with pain; my sight is stolen from me.

Speech From A Werewolf Pack Leader.name:
狼人狼群首领的演说
Speech From A Werewolf Pack Leader

Text.text: “我们的兄弟被杀了。才加入狼群不到一年，他的狩猎便已终结。可我召唤你们的怒火，并非只为此，我亲爱的同伴们。死亡的气味对我们而言，就像伴侣的气息一样熟悉——这就是我们的宿命。可我们的猎物侮辱了我们。他们把他的头颅钉在村外的长矛上，用棉絮塞满他的眼眶；又把他的内脏串起，拖在路中央引诱我们，去挑衅我们。然后他们竟敢称我们是野兽？！我绝不容忍这般羞辱！” “Our brother has been slain. Not a year with our pack and his hunt has ended. But this is not why I call upon your fury, my dear ones. The scent of Death is as familiar to us as our own mates’. Such is our lot. But our prey has insulted us. They have mounted his head on a spear outside their village and stuffed his eyes with cotton. They’ve strung his entrails in the road to tempt us. To taunt us. And they call us beasts?! I will not endure this mockery!”

Duergar Sharpshooter.name:
灰矮人神射手
Duergar Sharpshooter

Text.text:
灰肤的灰矮人那双深陷的黑眼珠在四下扫视时，透出一种令人不安的专注。他们的身躯像硬实的肌肉披覆在粗厚的骨骼之上，强壮得足以与洞熊正面硬撼。身上披着锻造精良的锁子甲，你几乎会以为他们正打算这么做——可手中那把大师级弩却泄露了他们更偏好远距离猎杀。武器的弦绷得笔直，蓄势待发，一支怪异的弩矢已然上弦，随时可放。弩矢两端各系着一枚流星锤，连接它们的链条被紧紧缠绕在矢杆上，绞得发紧。它看起来沉重又别扭，难以发射，更像是根本无法瞄准——但那位神射手薄唇上扬的笑意，仿佛正等着你收回这个判断。
The ash-skinned duergar's sunken black eyes evince an unnerving focus as they scan their surroundings. They are made of hard muscle draped over thick bone, looking strong enough to stand toe-to-toe with a cave bear. Draped in well-forged chain, you might think they mean to, but the masterwork crossbow they carry belies a preference to fight from afar. The weapon's string is taut and ready, and a peculiar bolt lies ready to loose. A bola is set on each end of the bolt, the chain connecting them spun tight around the shaft. It seems heavy and awkward, difficult to shoot, and impossible to aim, but the thin-lipped smile of the sharpshooter seems ready to challenge that assumption.

恐惧撕裂你的心神，那生物从血染的泥土中破土而出。你花了宝贵的片刻才看清眼前之物：由早已死去的士兵拼凑而成的亵渎聚合体——一整片战场的腐烂尸骸，被塑成一条起伏蠕动的巨虫。纠结成团的毛发与发紫的腐肉黏连为躯，残破的护甲如同护身的鳞片覆在其上。它在痉挛般的扭曲中翻滚，唤出数百件锈蚀兵器，悬浮在它身前，蓄势待发，随时向你猛袭。
Horror rips through you as the creature emerges from the bloodstained earth. It takes precious moments for you to make sense of what you see: an abominable amalgam of long-dead soldiers. It is a battlefield’s worth of rotting corpses fashioned into a single undulating worm. Hair and purpled flesh matted together form the body, with ruined armor covering it like protective scales. It roils in spasmodic contortions, bringing forth hundreds of rusted weapons that float before it, ready to strike out at you.

骰子滚落的噼啪声先于一阵狂喜的欢呼。带着香气的烟雾沉沉滞在空气里，遮蔽了成群的人影——他们挤在桌前，肩并着肩。无数文化挤满这片空间，在一片鲜艳色彩、晃荡酒杯与数十种语言的浪潮中彼此交融。有人游走其间，旁观正进行的赌局；也有人在同一张桌旁一守就是几个小时。欢腾、专注与挫败纠缠成一种独特的气息。近处，一名客人猛地一拳砸在桌面上，冲着荷官怒吼；一对肩宽膀阔的守卫立刻上前，准备介入。
The clatter of rolling dice precedes an outburst of joy. Perfumed smoke hangs heavy on the air, obscuring throngs of people huddled over tables. A vast array of cultures fill the space, mingling in a sea of vibrant colors, sloshing drinks, and dozens of languages. Some mill about, observing games in progress; others haunt the same table for hours. The feeling is one of jubilation, concentration, and defeat blended together. Nearby, a patron slams their fist against the table, shouting at the dealer, and a pair of broad-shouldered guards move to intercede.

Björn, The Unbreakable.name:
比约恩，不屈者
Björn, The Unbreakable

Text.text:
他的眼睛白得像铂金或钻石。连他的皮肤也是石灰色的，包括那光秃的头顶。他脸上那道宽阔的笑容仿佛坚不可摧，而笑意背后，是随时奉上的挑衅。这名半巨人男人脖颈处刺着一枚符文纹身，却再无其他印记。绘有龙族图案的锁子甲与一件熊皮斗篷披挂在他魁梧的身躯上，他手持一柄巨斧。腰带一侧挂着一只号角，另一侧垂着狱卒的钥匙串。

~ Played by HawgTusk with

His eyes are the white of platinum or diamond. His skin, too, is stone gray, including his bald crown. The broad smile on his face seems unbreakable, and behind it is a ready challenge. The half-giant man wears a rune tattoo on his neck but has no other markings. Chainmail worked with draconic images and a bear cloak hang off his mighty frame, and he carries a greataxe. A musical horn hangs from one side of his belt, jailer’s keys from the other.

~ Played by HawgTusk with

Loot From A Swamp Wyrm.name:
沼泽巨龙的战利品
Loot From A Swamp Wyrm

Text.text:
你找到了那头两栖巨龙的水下宝藏堆：数百枚来自历史诸多纪元的钱币铺成底座，其上陈列着更为玄奥的珍品——一柄镶嵌缟玛瑙与石榴石、工艺臻至极致的长剑，以及一套以无瑕翡翠雕琢而成的国际象棋棋子。
You find the submerged hoard of the amphibious wyrm, where hundreds of coins from many eras of history serve as a platform for more esoteric fare, including an expertly crafted sword inlaid with onyx and garnet and a collection of chess pieces sculpted from flawless jade.

Something Lurking In The Forest.name:
森林中潜伏之物
Something Lurking In The Forest

Text.text:
你继续前行时，皮肤不由自主地发麻，仿佛天生就能察觉到有什么在盯着你。你的目光左右飞掠，在一棵倒下的树旁捕捉到一丝移动。你看不清那儿潜伏着什么，但你能感觉到它的存在——它正注视着，等待着，以耐心而专注的目光。
As you continue onward, your skin crawls with the innate feeling of being watched. Your eyes dart side to side, and catch a glimpse of movement near a fallen tree. You can’t make out what’s lurking there, but you can sense its presence, watching and waiting with patient focus.

I Cast Holy Aura.name:
我施放圣光灵光
I Cast Holy Aura

Text.text:
我在神圣圣物匣上吟诵神力的圣言，感到一股神性临在在体内聚聚升腾，灌注我以正义的昂扬。我猛然张开双臂，双眼燃起圣焰，化作耀目的光爆迸发无边辉芒，成为神圣之光的灯塔。让盟友为之欢呼，让仇敌在我辉煌的灼辉前瑟缩退却。
Intoning the sacred words of power over my holy reliquary, I feel a divine presence build within me, filling me with righteous vigor. I throw my arms wide, my eyes ablaze with holy fire, and erupt with blinding radiance as I become a beacon of divine light. Let my allies rejoice and my foes cower before my glorious incandescence.

Targeted By Raise Dead.name:
被「起死回生」锁定
Targeted By Raise Dead

Text.text:
黑暗绝对无瑕，远胜最深的夜、最浓的影。光与声彻底缺席，连时代与空间也一并消失。你感觉自己被拆解、被汽化，化作无尽虚空中的一团以太雾。随后，有什么开始凝聚——你的灵魂。你想起了自己的名字，想起你在世界中的位置。光芒将你包围，起初刺目，继而温暖而诱人。你猛地、颤抖地倒吸一口气，起初疼痛，随后在肺叶再次充满空气时变得令人安心。你的救命恩人俯在你上方，那张脸虽仍模糊不清。你已被从悬崖边拉了回来。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The darkness is absolute, unlike the darkest night, the deepest shadow. A complete and total absence of light and sound, of time and space. You feel disassembled, vaporized, a cloud of ether amid an endless void. Then something begins to coalesce—your spirit. You remember your name, your place in the world. Light surrounds you, blinding at first, then warm and inviting. You take a sharp, shuddering gasp of air, painful initially, then reassuring as your lungs fill once more with air. The face of your savior hangs over you, blurry though it is. You’ve been brought back from the brink.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Hydra Encounter: Endless Battle.name:
九头蛇遭遇：无尽之战
Hydra Encounter: Endless Battle

Text.text:
你与多头九头蛇的鏖战仿佛永无尽头。汗水浸透你的身躯，唯有那些被血沫翻涌的水未能溅到的地方尚且干燥，四肢也因竭力而酸痛不已。九头蛇却似乎毫无疲态。每当你斩落一截颈项，便有两颗新头破肉而生顶替其位，凶残不减，宛如先前那些在污浊水中浮沉翻滚的头颅。
Your battle against the many-headed hydra seems like it might never end. Sweat drenches your body wherever the blood-frothed water has failed to splash it, and your limbs ache from effort. The hydra does not seem to feel fatigue. Every time you decapitate a neck, two new heads grow to replace it, each as ferocious as those now bobbing and tumbling in the foul water once were.

这生物宛如一颗巨大的泡泡：庞然无形，薄薄的肉质被撑得极开。水流托着它漂行，它的轮廓起伏变幻，像一只在风中迷失的风筝；看久了令人目眩，却又奇异地安宁。低沉的颤动短促掠过它的膜面，在水中推涌出断续的鼓点脉冲。
This creature is like a humongous bubble: massive, amorphous, its thin flesh stretched wide. The currents carry it, its form undulating and reshaping like a lost kite in the breeze; it is confusing to look at, and yet oddly peaceful. Brief shudders of bass ripple the surface of its membrane, surging through the water with sporadic pulses of percussion.

Chain Mail Armor +1.name:
锁子甲护甲+1
Chain Mail Armor +1

Text.text:
这套精工打造的锁子甲环片柔韧轻盈，宛如布料般贴身，却能在最锋利的刀刃前依旧坚挺不屈。环片闪烁着一种奇异而摄人的光泽，几近虹彩，你在旅途中从未见过这样的材质。镶嵌黄铜的皮革搭扣加固了整套甲胄，并将其束塑至你的身形比例，仿佛为你量身铸就。
The rings of this finely crafted suit of chain are supple and light like cloth, yet stand rigid and resilient against even the sharpest of blades. The rings shine with a strange and alluring gleam, almost iridescent, a material you've not encountered in your travels. Leather buckles inlaid with brass reinforce the suit and shape it to your proportions, suiting your form perfectly.

这具石棺的棺盖上刻着铭文：这里是“希望”的墓。于此土之下，一名士兵长眠。轻踏其上。她赢得了这份休息。 The lid of this sarcophagus bears the inscription: This is the grave of Hope. Beneath this soil a soldier sleeps. Tread lightly. She earned this rest.

在墨黑如渊的水底，你朝着一处昏暗光照游去，被它的美丽所蛊惑。你伸手触及那枚发光的圆珠时，才看见它后方是一排巨大、细长、尖利、近乎半透明的牙齿，正张开成一张巨口。水流开始穿过那畸形怪物参差锯齿间的缝隙——把你拽得更近。眨眼都来不及，怪物猛地向前扑来……
In the depths of the inky black water you swim up to a dim light, lured by its beauty. As you reach to grab the glowing orb, you notice behind it a huge set of long, pointed, almost translucent, teeth that open into a giant maw. Water begins to flow through the gaps in the monstrosity’s jagged teeth—pulling you even closer. As quickly as you can blink, the monster lurches forward…

I Listen To The Voices Of The Trees.name:
我倾听树木的低语
I Listen To The Voices Of The Trees

Text.text:
我合上双眼，凝神倾听叶片的低语——那轻柔摇曳的絮语，环绕着森林里每一位旅人。许多人只听见风在枝杈间漫无目的地呼啸，而我不然——于我而言，树木的言语清晰可辨，携着古老的智慧，引我沿着生命蜿蜒的林径继续前行。
I close my eyes and tune in to the whispering of the leaves, the gentle swaying discourse that surrounds all travelers in the forest. Many hear the wind whistling aimlessly between the boughs, but not I—for me the trees speak clearly and with ancient wisdom, guiding me further on my path through the winding trail of life.

Road Through Hillsides.name:
穿行丘陵的道路
Road Through Hillsides

Text.text:
朴素的土路在丘陵间蜿蜒而行，两侧山坡渐次抬起，投下巨大的阴影。每一次转弯都贴着另一座山丘的脚边绕过，让前方的道路始终扑朔迷离。偶尔一丛树木点缀其间，打破了行程的单调。
The simple, dirt road winds through the hills, which rise on either side of you and cast immense shadows. Each bend curves around the foot of another hill, leaving the road ahead uncertain. The occasional copse of trees breaks up the route.

Lesson From Mentor In Alchemy.name:
炼金导师的教诲
Lesson From Mentor In Alchemy

Text.text:
“现在把研钵里的石灰与钾碱转移到臼里。务必将灵魂彻底碾成齑粉，否则净化便无从谈起，我们也将白白浪费从这一步——第一步、煅烧——开始的所有后续阶段。”
“Here we move the lime and potash from the triturating bowl to the mortar. Make sure the soul is pulverized completely or its purification will be impossible, and we will have wasted all the following stages from this one, the first, the calcination.”

Holy Metropolis Of Dairi Al.name:
代里·阿尔圣都
Holy Metropolis Of Dairi Al

Text.text:
城门由身披抛光护甲、色泽如天空般澄澈的守卫把守；他们在环绕大都会的粉刷白墙前显得格外冷峻。每一道入口上方，光明女神的印记都被刻进石中，而这座城市也配得上那道印记。城巅的城堡几乎在发光，阳光在洁净无瑕的石面上跳跃反射，将一层流辉铺洒在下方的建筑群上。洁白的缆车如云朵般穿行空中，沿着架设的钢索轨道滑行，把乘客从城堡区运往城镇另一端更贫困的街区。

~ 构想：Mondorae James

The gates are watched by guards in polished armor the color of the sky, standing stark against the whitewashed wall circling the metropolis. Above each entrance the mark of the Goddess of Light has been etched into the stone, and the city earns that mark. The castle at the top of the city is practically glowing, sunrays bouncing off the pristine stone and casting a sheet of luminescence over the structures. White cable cars like clouds glide through the air on a wired rail system, hauling passengers between the castle district and the poorer neighborhoods at the other end of town.

~ Envisioned by Mondorae James

Mountain Temple Ruins.name:
山岳神殿遗迹
Mountain Temple Ruins

Text.text:
这座神殿曾在此塑造出宏伟而瑰丽的景象，映衬着山体的灰与雪冠的白。如今，残破的建筑像一具尸体般伏在峰顶——仿佛一个攀登失败者塌陷的身躯。门扉曾雕满繁复纹样，如今磨损风蚀，挂在锈蚀的铰链上，在寒冽的山风里吱呀摇摆。窗子早已破碎，曾经或许镶着绚丽的彩绘玻璃；而现在，只剩内部的阴影在招手。此殿曾供奉何神，你已无从得知——它最初用途的一切痕迹，都被时代与天气剥蚀殆尽。
The temple once made a grand and beautiful image here, set against the gray of the mountain and the white of its snowcap. Now, the decrepit structure sits like a corpse against the summit—the slumped body of a failed climber. The doors, etched intricately with designs now worn and weathered, hang on rusted hinges, swinging in the chill mountain air. The windows, shattered long-ago, may have once held beautiful stained glass. Now, only the shadows within beckon. To what god this temple stood, you cannot say—all traces of its original purpose have been stripped away by time and weather.

Henriette Jacquemin.name:
亨丽埃特·雅克曼
Henriette Jacquemin

Text.text:
一件蔚蓝的军团外套、灰色马甲、红色绶带、蓝色帆布长裤与黑皮扣鞋，让这名女子一眼便像个士兵。她的深色头发从脸侧被严厉地向后梳起，编成一束辫子马尾，垂落背脊。她站姿笔直而紧绷，随时可动，带着久经训练的疏离与冷静。一条背带斜跨躯干，将挎包固定在左髋。那只包的尺寸恰到好处，正好容下她双手捧着的魔导书——她随时准备翻开，查阅其中的奥秘。

~ Played by Walt M.
