An azure regimental coat, gray waistcoat, red sash, blue canvas pants, and buckle shoes of black leather mark this woman as a soldier. Her dark hair, pulled back severely from her face, is plaited into a ponytail that hangs down her back. She holds herself rigid, ready, with practiced detachment. A strap across her torso holds a satchel at her left hip. The bag is the perfect size for the grimoire she holds in both hands, ready to consult its arcane secrets.

~ Played by Walt M.

Beta-quality Cyberware.name:
测试版义体品质
Beta-quality Cyberware

Text.text:
货架上的义体展品宛如真实的肢体、器官、眼睛——甚至是面孔，尽管其中一些是非人的面具。剖面样品与制造流程的全息影像展示着肌纤维与精细组织如何一层层被雕琢成形。目录只给出对可能性的点到为止的暗示。每一件都是量身定制的活儿，需要精确规格与客户的干细胞，用于培养槽中生长的部件。真实血肉与最前沿的微型技术相结合，带来精准的性能与严苛的外观标准。可选项包括超越人类——甚至超人——以及可变形的可能性：比如一条手臂可化作柔韧可伸展的锥形肢体，牢牢锚定在骷髅（特征）上，提供其常态三倍的力量。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Showpieces of cyberware on the shelves resemble real limbs, organs, eyes—even faces, though some are inhuman masks. Cross sections and holos of the manufacturing process show muscle fibers and fine tissues sculpted layer by layer. A catalog offers only suggestions of the possibilities. Each piece is a custom job, requiring exact specs and client stem cells for vat-grown parts. That real flesh combines with bleeding-edge microtech to provide precision performance and exacting looks. Options include transhuman—or superhuman—and morphable possibilities, such as an arm that becomes a flexible and extendable tapered limb anchored to the skeleton to provide thrice its typical strength.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

被囚禁的星光化作一条条脉络，在你面前那巍峨如山的绝壁间纵横交错，像流动的水银般铺展在嶙峋的岩体之上。翻涌的雾霭遮蔽了崖顶，绝壁擦过云层，仿佛神祇的指尖掠过天空。空气里悬着带露的寒意，峭壁永远凝着细密水珠；它们捕捉着阳光的碎辉——那光又被岩中镶嵌的华美秘银反射得愈发璀璨。

~ 构想：Leonidas-Nerevar

Veins of trapped starlight crisscross the gargantuan cliffs before you, spreading across the rocky edifice like liquid mercury. A roiling mist obscures the tops of the cliffs as they brush against the clouds like the fingers of a god. A dewy chill hangs in the air, permanently beading the cliff face in droplets that catch the sunlight reflected from the resplendent mithral embedded in the rock.

~ Envisioned by Leonidas-Nerevar

狼群以松散的队形旅行着，边走边嗅着空气，忽然从悠然的奔行中抬起头来。它们闻到你的气味了吗？一声低沉的咆哮从狼群首领喉底滚出。
Sniffing at the air as they travel in their loose order, the wolves suddenly look up from their loping gait. Have they caught your scent? A low growl emanates from the base of the pack leader’s throat.

Dragon Slayer Longsword.name:
屠龙长剑
Dragon Slayer Longsword

Text.text:
这柄剑无疑古老，却光洁如新铸，仿佛方才出炉。两条风格化的巨龙以致命的缠斗相扣，化作长剑坚实的剑柄；它们肌肉虬结的蜥蜴般躯体在大师之手下塑形而成。剑刃泛起柔和的蔚蓝微光，刻入金属的玄秘符文被耀目的焰辉勾勒出轮廓。
The blade is undoubtedly ancient, yet it shines as if fresh from the forge. Stylized dragons locked in a deadly embrace form the sturdy hilt of the longsword, their muscular reptilian bodies shaped by a master’s hand. The blade shimmers with soft cerulean light, and mystical runes etched into the metal are limned with radiant flames.

你放声释出咒语的威势，脸上扭出一抹狰狞的笑意；在你精神侵袭的重压之下，敌人开始崩溃瓦解。因为你知道，自己已深探进他们潜意识深处所藏的恐惧，将他们自身的梦魇尽数倾泻回他们身上。
You let loose with the force of your incantation, your face twisted in a vicious grin as your enemies begin to crumble under the weight of your mental assault. For you know that you have delved deeply into the fears concealed within their subconscious minds, unleashing their own horrors upon them.

你念出咒词，寒冷的空气中，你的吐息在眼前凝成白雾。一股彻骨的寒意自心口涌起，向外扩散，渗入四肢——一路蔓延到指尖。空气中的水汽回应你魔力的召唤，在你掌心凝聚，伴随吱呀作响的骤冷霜裂，瞬间冻结。你握住那枚参差锋利的纯冰碎片，随即将它猛掷向你的敌人。
You speak the words, and your breath plumes before you in the frigid air. A chill overcomes you, radiating outward from your heart and spreading into your limbs—all the way to the tips of your fingers. The water in the air responds to your magical urging, and coalesces in the palm of your hand, freezing in an instant with a creaking coldsnap. You hold the jagged shard of pure ice in your hand, then fling it at your foe.

I Activate My Ioun Stone Of Intellect.name:
我激活智力艾欧石。
I Activate My Ioun Stone Of Intellect

Text.text:
那块石头在暖与冷的色彩间维持着微妙的平衡——红与蓝——如同大脑从左右半球运作，以理解对立与悖论、协作与抗力。我小心地将石头轻轻一抛，它便沿着绕我头颅的轨迹自如飞旋——它行进的圆环唤醒清明。它像一枚道具般轮转不息，而我心智的齿轮随之应和，开始精密的推演。
The stone balances warm and cool colors—red and blue—as the brain works from its hemispheres to understand opposites and paradoxes, cooperation and resistance. I give the stone a careful toss, and it finds its course around my head—the circle in which it travels activating clarity. It turns like a gear, and the wheels of my mind respond in calculation.

Hall Of Mirrors For Scrying.name:
用于占卜窥视的镜厅
Hall Of Mirrors For Scrying

Text.text:
自从数个世纪前城堡最后一位常驻法师离开后，占卜厅便再未启用过。宽敞的厅堂里，许多巨大的镜子被防尘布所掩蔽，另一些镜面则被污垢糊住，映不出分毫光影。褪色的天顶壁画描绘着繁星点点的夜空。
The scrying hall has not been used since the castle last had a resident wizard centuries ago. Dust sheets cover many of the large mirrors in the spacious hall, and grime occludes the surface of others. The ceiling of faded fresco depicts a starry night sky.

你曾常常走神——幻想身处另一个世界——但那样的痴想早在年少时就被你搁置。如今你唤起那些记忆，试图让自己重新回到那种心境。儿时哼唱的歌谣此刻化作低声呢喃的咒唱，你挥动手臂，划出宽广的弧线，将整片景色尽数囊括。
You often daydreamed—envisioned another world around you—but you left such fancies in your youth. Now you summon those memories in an attempt to put yourself into that mindset. A song you sang as a child becomes a murmured chant as you wave your arm in wide sweeps to encompass the landscape.

Road Full Of Refugees.name:
满路难民
Road Full Of Refugees

Text.text:
人群的长列仿佛没有尽头。他们饱经风霜、疲惫不堪的脸一路延伸，直到你的视野之外。他们拖着步子沿路前行，三三两两挤作一团。父母抱着孩子，孩子抱着宠物。人潮间也有车轱辘吱呀滚过，车上堆满各式各样的行李——那些被匆匆打包、来不及细想就被带走的残存家当，都是他们抛在身后的生活碎片。尽管靴子上沾满泥泞，神情写满倦色，他们的眼里却并非全无希望——也许明天，会更好。
The column of people is seemingly endless. Their worn and weary faces stretch beyond your sight. They shuffle down the road, clustered in groups. Parents carrying children, children carrying pets. Wagons, too, roll along amongst the crowd, laden with myriad cargo, the remnants of lives left behind, packed up quickly and without serious thought. Despite the mud on their boots and the exhaustion in their expressions, their eyes are not without hope—tomorrow, perhaps, will be better.

Zombie Grizzly Bear Charging.name:
冲锋的丧尸（特征）灰熊
Zombie Grizzly Bear Charging

Text.text:
熊猛然冲锋而来，张口咆哮。它的眼眶里空无一物，脸上以及左侧的皮肉与毛皮剥落成片，零落坠下。
The bear charges hard, mouth open in a roar. No eyes are in the sockets, and pieces of flesh and fur have fallen off the bear’s face and from its left side.

Ancient Red Dragon.name:
远古红龙
Ancient Red Dragon

Text.text:
几个世纪里散播恐惧、制造痛苦、煽动混乱，本该沉甸甸地压在灵魂之上；无数亡者的鲜血所留下的污痕，也该玷染这副躯体。然而你眼前的野兽却在它那闪耀的深红鳞甲中显得怡然自得、安适从容。巨龙耸耸肩，像猫一样蜷身卧下——一只能用爪子夹碎城堡塔楼的猫。
Centuries of creating terror, causing anguish, and fomenting chaos should weigh upon a soul. Some stain from the blood of countless dead should tarnish the body. But the beast before you seems utterly content and comfortable in its shining crimson scales. The dragon shrugs and settles its body like a cat—a cat that can crush a castle tower between its claws.

这个法术的材料成分——你信仰的一件圣物——极难替换。你小心翼翼地打开盛放它的盒子，让其中的圣洁力量逸散而出，被你编织的魔法之网所捕获。那股力量向外涌流，宛如你抛出的一张巨大辉光之网；它落在盟友身上之处，他们便被那光辉所披覆。
The material component for this spell—a holy relic of your faith—would be difficult to replace. You gingerly open the box containing it, allowing its holy power to escape and be caught in the web of magic you weave. The power flows outward, like a great radiant net you’ve cast, and where it lands upon your allies, they become cloaked in its glow.

Data Storm Affecting Player.name:
影响玩家的数据风暴
Data Storm Affecting Player

Text.text:
对方向你抬起双手，掌心骤然炸裂成一簇簇数据触手，弹射着扑向你的化身。你一眼认出这是一次强制上传的攻击，立刻试图调度整套防御工具回击——却已太迟！触手上饥饿的口器狠狠撞上你的肋侧，你的移动与反射肉眼可见地迟缓下来：所有系统资源被粗暴地挪作他用，去执行那些塞进你设备里的荒诞函数。你陷入麻烦了。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Raising their hands to you, your adversary’s palms suddenly explode into tentacles of data, which leap toward your persona. You recognize the attack as a forced upload, and you attempt to execute your suite of defense utilities in response—too late! The hungry mouths of the tentacles slam into your side, and you feel your movement and reflexes slow noticeably as all of your system resources are forcibly dedicated to the nonsense functions sent into your rig. You’re in trouble.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Military Cruiser: Captain’s Quarters.name:
军用巡洋舰：舰长寝舱
Military Cruiser: Captain’s Quarters

Text.text:
这间一尘不染的舱室里没有任何东西显得多余，打理得近乎苛刻。书桌上端端正正摆着一张相框，照片里一名军官身着全套礼服；旁边的软垫盒中，几枚勋章静静躺着。宽敞的房间里空气大多冷硬而洁净，却仍有一缕昂贵香水与经典须后水交织其间，如擦肩而过的幽影般撩拨着你的感官。
Nothing is out of place in the immaculate cabin, which is rigorously well kept. A framed picture of an officer in full military dress sits neatly on the desk, and a set of medals rests beside it in a padded case. The air is mostly sterile in the large room, though a hint of expensive perfume mingles with a classic aftershave, tantalizing your senses like passing ghosts.

Retired Adventurer's House.name:
退役冒险者之家
Retired Adventurer's House

Text.text:
这间朴素的小木屋孤零零地坐落在四周荒野之中。一把斧头斜倚在磨得发白的树桩旁，河卵石砌成的烟囱里袅袅升起炊烟。推开厚重的橡木门，映入眼帘的是一处简朴却舒适的起居空间。磨旧的炊具与手工雕刻的家具之间，奇异的小饰物与大师级武器竟堂而皇之地藏在眼前。来历不明的宝石、以贵金属锻造的护身符与戒指，以及一柄在这个时代从未见过的长剑，纷纷夺走你的目光。
The modest cabin sits solitary amid the surrounding wilderness. An axe stands propped against a worn stump and smoke curls from the river-rock chimney. Beyond the heavy oaken door you find a modest but comfortable living space. Wondrous trinkets and masterwork weapons hide in plain sight among worn cooking utensils and hand-carved furniture. Gemstones of unknown origin, amulets and rings forged of precious metals, and a sword the likes of which is unseen in this era all vie for your attention.

Short-tempered Security Agent On Militar.name:
军舰上的暴躁安保特工
Short-tempered Security Agent On Military Ship

Text.text:
飞船的安保卫士冷峻地立在墙边，双臂紧紧交叉抱在胸前，注视着士兵们的扑克局一步步展开。她的目光在玩家之间来回游移，捕捉每一次移动、每一个细微的手势。她的神情冰冷而精确，滴水不漏，丝毫不泄露内心的真实念头。右脸自上而下那道狰狞的长疤，是她多年军旅生涯的印记；士兵们不安地偷瞄着她，心知肚明她能做到什么。
The ship security guard stands stoically by the wall, her arms crossed tightly over her chest as she watches the soldiers' poker game unfold. Her eyes dart from player to player, taking in every movement, every gesture. Her expression is cold and calculated, revealing nothing of her true thoughts. The long scar running down the right side of her face is a testament to her years of service in the military, and the soldiers eye her nervously, well aware of what she can do.

如同活生生的影子，这名猫科海盗在敌群间穿梭，轻而易举地在混乱的近战绞杀中游刃有余。翠绿的眼眸闪烁着野性的狡黠，他的弯刀划出宽阔的弧线，收割血腥的战果——斩断肢体，割开喉咙。另一只手里的手枪覆着参差的盐晶霜痕——仿佛已在海底遗失了数代——可它在近射程的舷侧齐射中轰然咆哮，咬下的伤害却足以致命。

~ Played by TroyTheTraveler

Like a living shadow, the feline pirate slips between his foes as he effortlessly weaves through the chaotic melee of combat. Green eyes flash with wild cunning as his cutlass reaps a bloody harvest in wide sweeping arcs, severing limbs and opening throats. Jagged salt crystals rime the pistol in his other hand—as if it had been lost at sea for generations—yet its booming bite is devastating as a close range broadside.

~ Played by TroyTheTraveler

Intellect Devourers In A Dungeon.name:
地城中的噬智者
Intellect Devourers In A Dungeon

Text.text:
地城处处透着即将坍塌的迹象：墙体支撑早已破败，有些角落霉斑多过石头，滴水声在太多地方此起彼伏。但随后，你又听见了另一种声音——一阵窸窣疾掠，像啮齿动物的爪子在石面上刮擦。光线里迈出三团形状诡异的……大脑。看起来似乎具有人形的轮廓，却偏偏长在细小的兽腿上。它们齐齐转向你，僵住一瞬，随即像下水道里的老鼠般窜走，转眼没入阴影。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The dungeon shows signs of potential collapse: ruined wall supports, more mold than stone in some corners, and water dripping in too many locations. But then you hear another sound. A scurry like the scraping of rodent claws. Into the light step three oddly shaped… brains. Humanoid, it seems, but attached to small beast legs. They turn toward you, freeze for an instant, then skitter away like rats in a sewer.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Hallucinations From Fungi Spores.name:
真菌孢子引发的幻觉
Hallucinations From Fungi Spores

Text.text:
当那些翻涌冒泡的孢子钻入你的体内并扎根时，时代仿佛放慢了脚步。世界似乎颤了一下，随即凝固，一切都安宁——只在刹那。忽然，你的周遭开始扭曲变形，以不可能的方式旋拧拉伸，刺耳失谐的声音充满空气。在这地狱般的新现实里，你的伙伴们的面孔被扭曲得狰狞如魔，冰冷的恐惧攥紧你的胃，你的心脏开始狂跳。
Time slows as the effervescent spores enter your body and take hold. The world seems to shudder and pause, and all is peaceful—for a moment. Suddenly, your surroundings begin to warp and change, twisting and stretching in impossible ways as discordant voices fill the air. The faces of your companions are distorted and fiendish in this hellish new reality, and icy terror grips your stomach as your heart begins to race.

Shaka The Iron Willed.name:
沙迦·铁意志
Shaka The Iron Willed

Text.text:
他高大挺立，骄傲自若，护甲在灿烂日光下熠熠生辉——你眼前的男人，正是经典战士的纯粹化身。破碎的疤痕如缎带般点缀在他绿色皮肤上，一道道缝合的肉线蜿蜒其间，每一处都是胜利与荣誉的纪念。一根雕刻过的骨刺穿透他的鼻中隔，你注意到其表面刻着细小的符号。他蓝色的眼眸因嗜战而发亮，踏上最新的征途，奔向地平线那头隆隆作响的战鼓。

~ Played by Dan with

Standing tall and proud, his armor gleaming in the resplendent sun, the man before you is a pure embodiment of the classic warrior. Ragged scars decorate his green skin in ribbons of sutured flesh, each one a memento of triumph and honor. A spike of carved bone pierces his nose through the septum, and you notice small symbols have been engraved into its surface. His blue eyes shine with battle lust as he sets out on his latest quest toward the thundering drums of war on the horizon.

~ Played by Dan with

Loot From An Undead Shadow Giant.name:
来自亡灵暗影巨人的战利品
Loot From An Undead Shadow Giant

Text.text:
你落下致命一击的瞬间，这生物伴随一声刺耳的尖啸轰然炸裂，阴影如同油膜般在残骸周围汇聚成潭。翻涌的热雾状灵质里，你瞥见几件闪烁之物，浸着柔和的蓝色辉光——黑色蓝宝石。虽未精炼，这些宝石卖给识货的商人也值10,000枚金币；若能打磨抛光，价值还能翻倍。
The creature bursts apart with a discordant shriek when you strike the final blow, and shadows pool around the remains like an oil slick. In the steaming ectoplasm you notice several sparkling objects alight with a soft blue radiance—black sapphires. Though unrefined, these gems would be worth 10,000 gold pieces to the right merchant, double that if you could get them polished.

Loot From A Pit Fiend.name:
来自深狱炼魔的战利品
Loot From A Pit Fiend

Text.text:
漆黑的铁钉头锤从恶魔的利爪间滚落，锵然一声。它的光泽里仿佛封着地狱的炉心，红得像持有者的鳞片，亮得如同饱食后的火焰。随着那骇人的威压逐渐消散，你走近一步，俯身查看尸身。生物獠牙毕露的狞笑依旧紧咬不放，冰冷的灰眼呆滞地望着它那被遗弃的武器方向。沿着牙龈，你看见几缕紫黑色的油迹渗出，污染着牙釉——正是那让它撕咬更显恶毒的毒液。你心想，把这东西刮一些装进小瓶留作己用，不过是举手之劳。
The black iron mace rolls out of the fiend’s claw. It gleams with an infernal core, red as its wielder’s scales and bright as a well-fed fire. The frightful aura of the devil diminished, you move in closer to examine the body. The creature’s fanged grimace remains clenched, cold gray eyes staring blankly in the direction of its forsaken weapon. From its gums, you see trails of purplish oil staining the enamel—the venom that added such wickedness to its bite. You decide it would be an easy task to scrape some of the substance into a vial for your own use.

Evening Shiv Gauntlets.name:
暮色利刃护手
Evening Shiv Gauntlets

Text.text:
粗麻蕾丝以青铜鎏金，繁复的洛可可纹样间密密镶嵌着细小的莱茵石，闪烁如霜。它们覆住大半前臂，在指关节处收束成箭镞般的尖角。每只护手都套在中指上，并以细链连到腕下的一枚微型黄铜锁。每片手背掩蔽着一截精钢薄刃，只需扳动腕锁上紧绷的开关，刀刃便会弹出。
The burlap lace is gilded in bronze and crusted with tiny rhinestones in a complicated rococo design. They cover much of the forearms, coming to arrowheads at the knuckle. Each gauntlet loops onto the middle finger and is chained to a tiny brass lock under the wrist. A fine steel blade is concealed under each hand covering, triggered by flipping a tight switch on the wristlock.

Pursuant Minion Roller.name:
追随仆从掷骰器
Pursuant Minion Roller

Text.text:
他穿着一件浆得笔挺的白衬衫，粗硬的蓝色长裤罩在一双结实的工靴之上。衬衫外的颈间垂着一枚小小的银质坠饰，形状奇异，仿佛某种象征符号。他抬手握住坠饰，朝地上一块石头示意，手指结出一个隐约带着奥秘意味的姿势。石块随即离地而起，在空中旋转、崩裂、削磨，顷刻间自塑成一颗完美的球体，表面光滑如玻璃。它沿着地面向前滚去，以令人咋舌的速度疾驰而行。
He wears a starched white shirt and rough blue trousers over a pair of serious work boots. A small silver medallion in a strange symbolic shape hangs around his neck outside the shirt. He takes the medallion in his hand and gestures at a rock on the ground, his fingers in a shape that vaguely resembles the arcane. The rock lifts, spins, chips, and smooths itself to a perfect sphere with a glassy-smooth surface, rolling forward along the ground at incredible speed.

Flinty-eyed Mercenary Pilot.name:
眼神如燧石般冷硬的雇佣飞行员
Flinty-eyed Mercenary Pilot

Text.text:
她一手叉腰，头盔夹在臂弯下，一名佣兵站在你面前，身上穿着一件灰色连身服，补丁斑驳。她那双幽暗而锐利的眼睛像猛禽般审视着你，仿佛在掂量下一顿猎物。她一头乌黑的亮发凌乱不羁，想必是一路戴着头盔，摘下后仍被压得乱糟糟的。
With a hand on her hip and her helmet resting under an arm, a mercenary stands before you, dressed in a patchy gray jumpsuit. Her eyes, dark and piercing, take stock of you like a bird of prey sizing up its next meal. Her shining shock of black hair is unkempt, probably still mussed from wearing her helmet on the way here.

Designer Mirrored Sunglasses.name:
设计师款镜面太阳镜
Designer Mirrored Sunglasses

Text.text:
两枚小巧弧形的植入体嵌在太阳穴上，像两道水平的眉，横在眼与耳之间。只需一个闪烁的意念指令，每枚植入体便弹出镜片，沿着眼眶滑出，覆上双眼，将视线一并遮蔽。它们造型优雅，以精湛的技能雕琢成悦目的椭圆。镜面般的反光让使用者的眼睛彻底隐去，只留下一个精密自动机般的印象。若说眼睛是灵魂之窗，这里便没有任何许可。
Small, curved implants sit on the temples, like two horizontal eyebrows between the eye and the ear. At the flickered thought-command, lenses deploy from each implant, sliding across the eyes and shielding them from vision. They are elegant creations, sculpted with skill into pleasing ovals. Mirrored, they completely obscure the user’s eyes, leaving the impression of a complex automaton. If eyes are windows to the soul, there is no access here.

Distracted Shopkeeper.name:
心不在焉的店主
Distracted Shopkeeper

Text.text:
尽管店主最终还是回答了你的询问，你却忍不住觉得，在他此刻的衡量里，你顶多排在第三、第四重要的位置。他几乎称得上无礼，却又一次次向你道歉，叫你重复方才的话；更让人不快的是，他总把目光飘向别处，始终不肯与你对视。
Though the shopkeeper eventually replies to inquiries, you cannot help but feel you are the third or fourth most important subject in his current estimation. Just shy of being rude, he apologizes to you again and again as he asks you to repeat yourself, but it is rather off-putting how he keeps looking elsewhere instead of meeting your gaze.

Burned Forest On Flat Land.name:
平原上的焦黑森林
Burned Forest On Flat Land

Text.text:
烧焦木头的气味弥漫在一片陷入诡异寂静的土地上。太阳在朦胧的橘色天幕里只是个黯淡的光球。曾经是森林的地方，如今只剩被熏黑的树干——叶落尽、枝折断、尊严尽失——像墓碑般伫立，为那些在烈火中变得脆弱并倒下的树木立下挽歌。大地遍布伤痕，灰败无光，点点白灰洒落其间，烧焦的植被残骸横陈四处。
The smell of burned wood fills a stretch of land that has sunk into an eerie quiet. The sun is a dim ball in the hazy orange sky. Where once stood a forest, blackened trunks—stripped of leaves, of branches, of dignity—stand like grave markers for those trees that grew brittle and fell in the fire. The earth is scarred and gray, peppered with white ash and littered with charred vegetation.

I Cast Animal Friendship From My Ring Of.name:
我从【动物影响戒指】中施放“动物交友术”。
I Cast Animal Friendship From My Ring Of Animal Influence

Text.text:
我朝那野兽微微一笑，指尖把玩着套在手指上的木戒。“好啦，好啦，”我说道，“何必这么惶惶不安？”戒指骤然涌起光芒，我也在那生物的眼中瞥见同样的微光一闪。它的姿态随之松弛，变得安然，我伸出手，轻轻抚摸它的头顶。
I smile at the beast, fiddling with the wooden ring around my finger. “Now, now,” I say. “What’s all that trepidation for?” The ring surges with light and I see that same flicker within the creature’s eyes. Its stance softens to one of ease, and I reach my hand out to pet its head.

Perilous Dinosaur Flight.name:
惊险的恐龙飞行
Perilous Dinosaur Flight

Text.text:
当那头威风凛凛的巨兽振翼腾空，你的胃猛地一沉——突如其来的拔升让你猝不及防。你几乎是把自己压扁般贴在生物的脊背上，脸颊贴着它冰凉的爬行类皮肤，本能地死命抓紧；脚下苍翠的丛林树冠盘旋着远去，像被拧开的绿旋涡。随后，压迫感倏然消失。你的坐骑稳住了飞行，你发现自己在云间掠过，而树海在下方无尽延展，化作一片闪烁的绿浪。

~ 构想：MatthewMcHale（Discord）

Your stomach lurches as the mighty beast takes flight, caught off guard by the sudden ascent upon huge, powerful wings. Flattening yourself to the creature's back, you feel the cool reptilian flesh against your cheek as you cling on with instinctive urgency, the viridian jungle canopy spiraling out beneath you. Then the pressure stops. Your mount levels its flight and you find yourself flitting between clouds as the trees stretch endlessly beneath you in a shimmering green wave.

~ Envisioned by MatthewMcHale on Discord

Toppled Circle Of Standing Stones.name:
倾覆的立石环
Toppled Circle Of Standing Stones

Text.text:
一块侧卧在地，仿佛沉睡；另一块碎裂成巨大的残片，像是被雷霆彻底抹灭。还有一块的下半截仍深深扎在翠绿的草地里，可它的上半截却躺在前方——断口粗粝，遍布地衣斑点。若这些石头仍然“活着”，会更令人震撼，还是反倒不及如今？这曾为宇宙定向的形制，昔日让它的术士得以接触神祇。如今失了魔法，它的讯息是否更为强烈——向我们宣告人类造物的愚妄？
One lies on its side as if asleep, and another lies in massive pieces as if obliterated by lightning. The lower half of another is still planted in the green grass, but there before it, shorn rough and lichen-spotted, is its upper half. Is this more or less impressive than if the stones still lived? This orienting shape of the universe once put its magicians in touch with the gods. Is its message stronger now, without magic, telling us the folly of the works of men?

I Cast Finger Of Death.name:
我施放「死亡之指」
I Cast Finger Of Death

Text.text:
我的身体绷紧，强忍着胃里迅速翻涌上来的干呕感，同时吐出法术的咒词，将黑暗的力量牵引向我。那股扭曲而不祥的违和感让四周弥漫着可触可感的恐惧，随着能量聚集愈发浓重。我伸出一根手指，向我的目标放出一道病态的幽绿能量光束。
My body tenses and I fight back the heaving sensation rapidly building in my stomach as I speak the words of the spell, drawing dark power toward me. A twisted wrongness causes a palpable air of dread around me as the energy builds. I extend my finger and unleash a beam of sickly green energy toward my target.

Haldor Of The Danaen.name:
达奈恩的哈尔多尔
Haldor Of The Danaen

Text.text:
一个魁梧的胡须战士俯立在败倒的敌人身旁，冰冷的狂风在战场上呼啸，卷得他浓密的赤红长发如兽鬃般狂乱飞舞。鲜血与内脏涂满他身上的锁子甲与皮毛，裹住那高大壮硕的身躯，让他看上去宛如复仇的战神。裸露的手臂在苍白皮肤下肌肉虬结，他高高举起长剑，准备落下致命一击，唇间爆出被怒火点燃的嗜血咆哮。随后他用破布擦拭剑刃，朝倒下的对手微微点头，便继续前行，去寻找下一个。世界便是如此。怜悯在生命的战场上毫无立足之地。

~ 由一位英雄扮演

A hulking, bearded warrior stands over his defeated foe, the icy wind howling across the battlefield whipping his mane of thick red hair into a frenzy. Blood and viscera cover the chain shirt and furs adorning his towering, muscular frame, giving him the appearance of a vengeful god of battle. Exposed arms bulging beneath pale flesh, he raises his sword high to deliver the killing blow, a cry of rage-fueled bloodlust bursting from his lips. He wipes his blade with a rag and nods to his fallen opponent before moving on in search of another. Such is the way of the world. Clemency has no place on the battlefield of life.

~ Played by a Hero

一只筋络分明的手臂绷紧如弦，紧缠的肌肉奋力拉扯，试图触及监狱门上那只凹损斑驳的铁把手；伸出的指尖擦过冰冷的金属。囚犯的脸紧贴在牢门的栅窗上，贵族般的轮廓因专注而扭曲，他们拼命将自己推向更近一步的自由。
A sinewy arm wired with taut muscle strains to reach the battered iron handle of the prison door, the outstretched fingers grazing the metal. The prisoner’s face is pressed against the barred window of the cell door, their noble features twisted in concentration as they push themself closer to freedom.

Approaching A Halfling Home.name:
走近半身人的家
Approaching A Halfling Home

Text.text:
远远望去，那片小林地像一袭葱郁的披风，依偎在辽阔农庄的背面。荒野与耕地一同兴盛，彼此相安。微风渐起，朦胧的光里浮着尘屑，从茅草屋顶轻轻扬开；风在门廊的摇椅、搁在一旁的独轮车、斜倚在屋侧的木筏之间穿梭起舞。它也捎来久未散去的气味：新出炉的面包、刚脱粒的谷物，以及粗麻布的淡淡纤维香。

~ ~ Guest Writer Sadie Lowry

From a distance, the grove is a verdant mantle nestled against the backside of a sprawling farmstead. The wilds of nature and the cultivated land both thriving. Hazy, dust-moted light stirs off the thatched roof as a gentle breeze picks up, dancing between the rocking chair on the porch, the wheelbarrow laid aside, and the raft leaned against the side of the house. The breeze carries with it the lingering scents of fresh bread, hewn grains, and burlap.

~ ~ Guest Writer Sadie Lowry

Mad Scientist's Lab: Extensive Workspace.name:
疯狂科学家的实验室：宽敞的工作区
Mad Scientist's Lab: Extensive Workspace

Text.text:
这间实验室比你想象的更为深远。你最初的印象没错——一间堆满古怪炼金实验的房室杂乱无章，但这里进行的工作显然蔓延到其他房间，甚至深入墓穴般的地窟更深处。你听见远处有人发出刺耳的狂笑，仿佛正为某项发现而欢庆。
The laboratory extends farther than you thought. Your initial impression of a chamber jumbled with strange alchemical experiments was right, but whatever work goes on here extends to other rooms and deeper into the catacombs. You can hear someone cackling in the distance, perhaps celebrating some discovery.

自太古以来从未改变，这头爬行类掠食者潜行于世界各处沼泽、湿地与下水道的咸淡水中，搜寻猎物，将其拖入水下吞噬殆尽。它的鳞片色泽从幽深林绿到沼泥褐不等，一条嶙峋有脊的强健尾巴几乎无声地推动它穿水而行，锐利的黄眼与水面齐平。
Unchanged since the dawn of time, this reptilian predator skulks through the brackish waters of the world’s swamps, marshes, and sewers searching for prey to drag beneath the surface and devour. The scales of the beast range from deep forest green to swamp-mud brown, and a powerful ridged tail propels it through the water in near silence, its keen yellow eyes level with the surface.

风中吱呀作响的树枝声陡然拔高成一声尖啸，那林中巨木扭转身躯，抖落满身落叶与苔藓。大地震颤，树根从土中生生撕裂而出，粗壮的树干也随之剧烈战栗。枝条发出刺耳的吱嘎声，弯曲却不折断，你这才意识到这棵树并非死物，而是活着的存在。树干上两处空洞宛如眼眶，在扭曲树皮拧成的深皱眉下冷冷瞪视着你。
The creaking of tree boughs in the wind turns into a shriek as the forest giant twists, shedding leaves and moss. The ground quakes as roots rip from the ground, and the massive trunk shudders. Squealing branches bend without breaking, and you realize that the tree is an animate thing. Two hollows in the trunk glare at you from under a furrowed brow of twisted bark.

大地颤抖，一头魁梧的蜥形巨兽踏步上前，鳄般的头颅高高昂起，几乎要刺入空中。它背脊上突起的骨刺彼此相连，边缘融为一体，从肩胛一路铺展到髋部，宛如一柄骨质扇翼。无血的皮肉像披在鸟笼上的薄布般松垮地贴在骨架上，鳞片只零星点缀在那柔嫩的皮面。腐败的恶臭从这具行走尸骸身上豁开的孔洞里轻易逸出，眼中被强行点燃的“生”发出刺目的惨白光辉。它张开狭长的口器，尖锐的锥形獠牙森然并列，一声嘶响自喉间溢出；颈侧那道漫长的裂口里，蜿蜒的声带网在体内震颤作响。

~ Envisioned by orroded_Soul

The ground shudders as a hulking saurian steps forward, the top of its crocodilian head rising high into the air. Spines project out of its back, their edges merged together to form a bony fan from its shoulders to its hips. Bloodless flesh clings to its frame like a cloth over a birdcage, scales only sparsely occurring over its tender hide. The stink of decay issues readily from within the gaping holes of this walking carcass, the life conjured in its eyes a stark white glow. It opens its narrow maw of sharp, conical teeth and a hiss emanates from its throat, the sinuous mesh of vocal cords vibrating from within a lengthy tear in its neck.

~ Envisioned by orroded_Soul

这台机器很小，主体是一个纤薄的三角形外壳，大小不过与你的掌心相仿。一个圆形插槽可用于插入蓝色的氧气荚——赐予生命的一囊空气——而三角形左右两侧的两根不锈钢圆筒则负责协助过滤。它是一件低调的装置，容易藏在衣物里，专为在任何水栖（特征）环境中部署而设计。
The machine is small, comprised primarily of a slim triangular housing, little bigger than the palm of your hand. A circular slot allows for the insertion of blue oxy-pods—life-giving pockets of air—while two stainless steel cylinders, to the left and right of the triangle, aid in filtration. It’s a subtle device, easy to hide in clothing, designed to be deployed in any aquatic environment.

Temperate Forest In Winter.name:
冬日的温带森林
Temperate Forest In Winter

Text.text:
森林深处沉入静谧的冬眠，空气寒意刺骨。光秃的枝桠、突兀的岩石，以及枯萎植物浅褐色的茎秆，在铺天盖地的雪毯上显得格外分明。林中只有寥寥几棵常青树仍披着深绿针叶的蓬松外衣，枝头被沉沉积雪压得低垂。
The forest is deep in a quiet, wintry slumber, the air biting with cold. Bare-branched trees, jutting rocks, and the light brown stalks of withered plants stand out starkly against a blanket of snow. Only the few evergreen trees in the forest remain attired in their shaggy coats of deep green needles, their branches bowed under burdens of snow.

Valen Tandris.name:
瓦伦·坦德里斯
Valen Tandris

Text.text:
灰皮男人立于高处，红眸之下笑意灼亮，头顶悬着一圈流光溢彩的光环。他身披银金交织的护甲，光线一落便熠熠生辉，英姿凛然。钢盾表面结着一层闪耀的红宝石，与他的虹膜同色同辉。待他迈步向前，那顶天界王冠倏然化作无形——可他那炽热的笑容却分毫不改。

~ Played by Dane the Great

The gray-skinned man, his grin aglow beneath red eyes, bears a shimmering halo about his head. He stands at a great height, gallant in his armor of silver and gold, which glimmers in the light. His steel shield is crusted with glittering rubies that match his irises. As he steps forward, his celestial crown vanishes into thin air—but his fervid smile does not flicker.

~ Played by Dane the Great

I Am Transported To A Pleasant Demiplane.name:
我被传送到一处怡人的半位面
I Am Transported To A Pleasant Demiplane

Text.text:
一阵令人眩晕的踉跄预告着我的降临。待我将眼前的壮丽景致尽收眼底，不适转瞬即逝。草地绿得不可思议，随风起伏如绸缎般荡漾；微风拂过，拖着薄纱般的花香尾韵。阳光在近旁森林的阴影地面上斑驳洒落，宛如幼鹿身上的斑点。鸟鸣汇聚成令人沉醉的合唱。头顶的天空是一片无尽的蔚蓝，泛着宝石般的光泽。
A dizzying lurch heralds my arrival. My discomfort passes in an instant as I take in the breathtaking landscape. The grass is an impossible green; it ripples like silk, caressed by a breeze that bears the scent of flowers in its gossamer train. Sunlight dapples the shady floor of a nearby forest like a fawn’s coat. Birdsong swells in rapturous chorus. Overhead, the sky is an endless sweep of blue, with a sheen like precious stone.

温柔的波浪牵扯着布满卵石的岸线，每一次翻涌都搅动水下的碎石，发出宛如远处人群欢呼的声浪。两侧岬角向外弯出，围合成一座巨大的海湾。此处相对平静的海面或许只是迷惑：沿着海滩往下走，一艘破船被日光漂白的桅杆从地里刺出，像某种兽类的肋骨架。
Gentle waves pull at the pebbly shore, each roiling the stones beneath the water with a sound like a distant crowd cheering. Headlands curve out on either side, forming a huge bay. The relatively calmer sea here might be deceptive: down the beach, the sun-bleached spars of a broken boat project from the ground, like the ribcage of an animal.

Scribe's Study.name:
抄写员的书房
Scribe's Study

Text.text:
羽毛笔在羊皮纸上刮擦的声响没完没了，唯有抄写员停下蘸墨的最短一瞬才会断开。他们的笔势毫不松懈，字迹无可挑剔。四周，成卷的羊皮纸堆成一摞摞，旁边还有各色墨水瓶——从最深的黑到最耀眼的金，再到一种随光流转、虚幻如珠母的莹色。某只瓶身的标签宣称其中装着隐形墨水，可它却空空如也，孤零零地搁在架上……
The scratching of quill against parchment is incessant, save for the briefest moment when the scrivener pauses to dip into ink. Their pace is relentless, their penmanship impeccable. Around them, rolls of parchment rest in piles, along with bottles of ink of every possible hue: from the deepest black to the brightest gold, to an ethereal nacre that shifts in the light. One bottle's label claims that it contains invisible ink, but it sits empty on the shelf…

Wild Magic Surge: Bubble Mouth.name:
狂野魔法涌动：泡泡嘴
Wild Magic Surge: Bubble Mouth

Text.text:
原始的巫术在你面前的空气中噼啪作响、嘶嘶冒泡，灼得你鼻腔与喉咙火辣刺痛。你开口想警告同伴，嘴里却打着嗝般涌出一串粉红泡沫。
Raw sorcery pops and fizzles in the air before your face, burning your nose and throat. You call out to warn your allies, but a froth of pink bubbles hiccups from your mouth instead.

一座如画的小屋坐落在一处隐秘的林间空地里，四周高耸的树木筛下缕缕阳光，使它熠熠生辉。透过前窗可见一对伴侣，沐浴在只属于他们的温暖光晕中。他们相拥而立，仿佛正端详着那座新近绽放的花园。
A picturesque cottage sits in a private glade, aglow from sunbeams filtering through the tall, surrounding trees. A couple can be seen through the front window, awash in a warm glow all their own. Embracing one another, they seem to be appraising their newly flowering garden.

店主婆婆笑得眉眼舒展，从柜台后走出来，双手握住你的手，以亲切又带着祖母般慈爱的笑容向你问候。她两颊泛着红润，灰白的头发规规矩矩地盘成一个朴素的发髻，更衬出这副模样。你挑看她的货品时，她又递上一盘还温热的姜味脆饼，正放在旁边的台面上休息。
Smiling broadly, the proprietress of the shop comes out from behind the counter and takes your hand in both of hers, greeting you with a friendly, grandmotherly smile. Her cheeks are rosy and her graying hair is put up in a conservative bun to complete the image. As you browse her goods, she offers you a plate of warm gingersnaps resting on a nearby surface.

一排怪异的白色“石头”在河面上勉强连成一条路。乍看之下，它们像是略带孔隙的岩石，但你很快意识到那根本不是石头，而是骨头——一头巨大的蛇形生物的椎骨，早在很久以前便倒毙于此。
A line of strange, white stones form a path of sorts across the river. At first glance, the stones appear slightly porous, but you soon realize they are not stones at all, but bones—the vertebrae of a massive, serpentine creature, fallen here long ago.

Clay Golem Encounter.name:
黏土魔像遭遇
Clay Golem Encounter

Text.text:
一个由黏土塑成的人形高耸在你头顶之上，雕刻出的躯壳宛如干涸的河床——岁月流逝令其龟裂枯槁。一张严厉而不容置疑的面孔俯视着你，目光冷硬；那五官以惊人的逼真细节塑就，仿佛出自久远年代里一位大师工匠之手。尽管轮廓近似人形，这尊魔像的比例却并不准确，被刻意扭曲，只为将一切都让位于无与伦比的武力。
A humanoid shaped from clay towers above you, its sculpted form like a barren riverbed—cracked and dry with passage of time. A stern, disapproving countenance glares down, the features fashioned with astoundingly lifelike detail by a master artisan in an age long past. Though humanoid in profile, the golem’s proportions are inaccurate, distorted to favor martial strength above all else.

Loot From An Awakened Tree.name:
来自一棵觉醒古树的战利品
Loot From An Awakened Tree

Text.text:
如今觉醒的巨树已归于寂静，你得以更近一步细察。你在它的树干中发现一把斧头：乌木斧柄打磨得油亮，斧刃深深咬入树皮。你又在枝桠间找到一处鸟巢，巢中安放着一枚闪烁的祖母绿胸针。
Now that the awakened tree has subsided into stillness, you can examine it more closely. In its trunk you discover an axe with a polished ebony handle, blade biting deep into the bark. You find a bird’s nest among the tree’s branches; it holds a sparkling emerald brooch.

Logging In To Virtual Fantasy Game.name:
登录虚拟奇幻游戏
Logging In To Virtual Fantasy Game

Text.text:
世界在你周遭崩塌褪去，系统接管了你的感官，现实如水中倒影般淡去，融入赛博空间的低鸣。英雄般的交响乐轰然涌起，标题画面骤然炸裂般映入眼帘，你的双眼扫过熟悉的菜单选项。登录后，你选定主角色，猛然倒吸一口气——你的意识被猛地塞进一具虚拟之躯。

~ Envisioned by Murmur on Discord

The world falls away as the system takes over your senses, reality fading like a watery reflection into the hum of cyberspace. Heroic orchestral music swells as the title screen erupts into view, and your eyes scan the familiar menu options. Logging in, you select your main character, gasping as your consciousness is thrust into a virtual body.

~ Envisioned by Murmur on Discord

Summit Of Skull Hill.name:
颅丘之巅
Summit Of Skull Hill

Text.text:
击倒最后一个敌人后，你将目光投向这座被诅咒山丘的顶峰。高原被巨大恶魔般的利爪攫住，仿佛从枯败的岩石中凿刻而出；眼前景象骇人至极。头骨散落在仪式场地血污遍布的地面上，当你朝着目标前进时，一股压倒性的悲恸、狂怒与失落之气扑面而来，直击你的感官。翻涌的猩红天幕下——桀骜的闪电向四面八方狂乱分叉——那枚水晶悬浮半空，被粗重的铁链牢牢束缚。

~ 由 Envisioned 创作构想，作者 Leif，来自 Devs & Dice

诅咒之丘 第一部分：颅骨之丘的山脚 第二部分：颅骨之丘的山坡 第三部分：一对红甲武士 第四部分：颅骨之丘的山顶 第五部分：脉动水晶下的巫妖 Striking down the last of your foes, you turn your attention to the summit of the cursed hill. Cradled in the grasp of enormous fiendish claws, hewn from the blighted rock, the plateau is a grisly scene. Skulls litter the gore-covered earth of the ritual site and an overwhelming aura of sorrow, rage, and loss assaults your senses as you make your way toward your goal. Silhouetted against a roiling crimson sky—untamed lightning arcing in all directions—the crystal hovers, bound by thick iron chains.

~ Envisioned by Leif from Devs & Dice

Cursed Hill Part I: Base of Skull Hill Part II: Slopes of Skull Hill Part III: Pair of Red, Armored Warriors Part IV: Summit of Skull Hill Part V: Lich Beneath a Pulsing Crystal

Muuragh The Savage.name:
野蛮的穆拉格
Muuragh The Savage

Text.text:
一声低沉、喉音粗粝的咆哮在野蛮人胸腔深处滚动回荡。那高耸的狮族魁影压迫感十足——烟灰般的灰黑毛皮覆着类人躯干，鬃毛狂野凌乱地编成粗辫，颜色如炉底黑灰。锐利而狡黠的眼睛从他疤痕纵横的面容间探出，边扫视四周边皱起鼻翼、微颤耳尖，以掠食者般的警觉捕捉每一丝动静。他几乎不着护甲，灰烬色的皮肤上交错着战斗留下的疤痕与诡异的炼金符文。背上负着一柄巨大的弯刃，刃口布满无数战斗啃出的缺口与崩痕，那分量仿佛足以将巨龙的头颅从颈上劈落。

~ Played by Austin Kyle with

A low, guttural growl rumbles deep in the barbarian’s chest. The towering lionfolk strikes an imposing figure, a feline humanoid with smoky-gray fur and a wild, haphazardly braided mane the hue of soot. Sharp, cunning eyes peer out from his scarred visage, scanning his surroundings while his nose wrinkles and ears twitch, perceiving all around him with a predatory awareness. He wears little in the way of armor, his ashen hide crosshatched with battle scars and strange, alchemical glyphs. Upon his back, he carries a massive, curved blade, its edge notched and nicked from countless battles and its weight likely capable of hewing a dragon’s head from its neck.

~ Played by Austin Kyle with

Heat-blasted Cave On A Volcanic Planet.name:
火山行星上的炙烤洞窟
Heat-blasted Cave On A Volcanic Planet

Text.text:
被熔岩猛烈灼蚀进黑曜岩中，这座张口的洞窟洞壁光滑如绸；翻滚的岩浆在亘古之前冷却，凝成起伏的波浪。洞内空气闷热得令人窒息，仿佛踏入烤炉，四周洞壁被深处的熔岩池映照成温暖的橘色光晕。
Blasted into the obsidian rock, the yawning cavern walls are as smooth as silk, the roiling magma having cooled into undulating waves eons ago. The air in the cave is stifling, as if stepping into an oven, and the walls are painted in a warm orange glow from the lava pools within.

A Correspondence Of Ravens.name:
群鸦来信
A Correspondence Of Ravens

Text.text:
在资料馆里，渡鸦之院分成几个自习小组：学生们或摊在地毯上，或斜倚在沙发里，或坐在阳台椅上，身旁环绕着一簇簇栖架。几只渡鸦信使也聚了过来，低沉的咯噜声与莽撞的嘎叫此起彼伏，聒噪得很。一个学生让它们安静点。只见一只又大又沉的渡鸦落到他的前臂上，用蓝黑色的利爪一把夺走了他的笔。渡鸦在课本页面上横划竖写：把这话写下来，卷成一卷，再绑到你腿上。其余的鸟儿一边点头，一边哄笑。
At the Repertory, House Raven splits into study groups: students sprawl on rugs, lounge on sofas, or sit on balcony chairs surrounded by roosts. Several raven messengers have assembled, too, and are quite chatty in low gargles and brash squawks. A student tells them to be quiet. A large, heavy raven lands on his forearm and, with a blue-black claw, snatches his pen. The raven writes across the page of the textbook: Put that in writing, roll it up, and attach it to your leg. The other birds bob and laugh.

I Use Persistent Rage.name:
我进入【持久狂怒】状态。
I Use Persistent Rage

Text.text:
远离战局的喧嚣，我迫不及待地搜寻下一个可交锋的敌人。纵使只是短暂的停歇，我的战斗狂怒仍在燃烧，只待下一次碰撞来临。
Away from the fight, I eagerly look for foes to engage. My battle fury goes on, despite the momentary pause, as I relish the clash to come.

Ancient Stone Passage.name:
古老的石砌甬道
Ancient Stone Passage

Text.text:
锋利如剃刀的藤壶紧附在这条逼仄通道潮湿淌水的墙面上；凡从此穿行者，都会被刮破皮肉——为这座岛屿献上一份殷红的血税。海藻与地衣自小桥底垂落，宛如腐烂却仍紧攥的手指，仿佛是那些被激浪拍碎在下方礁石上的水手遗下的残影。
Razor-sharp barnacles cling to the dripping walls of this claustrophobic passage beneath an ancient span, causing any who pass through to nick themselves—a sanguine tithe for the island. Seaweed and lichen hang from the underside of the small bridge, like the putrescent, grasping fingers of sailors dashed on the rocks below.

如烟雾掠过沼泽般盘旋，这具无形的死亡幽影在夜色中悄然游猎。生物的下半身是一团腐朽的瘴雾，而自腰际往上，却隐约呈人形。它的一切天然轮廓都淹没在午夜斗篷与刽子手兜帽投下的阴冷昏翳里，难以分辨。这个凶邪生物唯一真正可触的性相，是它以幽灵般的双手握持的骇人长镰——镰刃上滴落的鲜血，真实得令人不寒而栗。
Like smoke swirling across a mire, this incorporeal apparition of death stalks the night. The creature’s lower body is a miasma of necrotic haze, but from the midriff up, it appears vaguely human. Any natural features are indistinguishable beneath the bleak penumbra of its midnight cloak and executioner’s hood. The only genuinely tangible aspect of this fell creature is the horrific scythe it holds in ethereal hands—the blood dripping from its blade is uncomfortably real.

Great Stone Arch.name:
巨石拱门
Great Stone Arch

Text.text:
两座巨大的灰浆石墩夹出一道数码宽的开口。几缕枯瘦的藤蔓仍攀附其上，其中一根一路触及拱门弧起之处。斜削的石块彼此咬合相连，在那块巨大的拱心石处臻于设计的完美。拱心石的正面残留着一段凿刻箴言的磨损旋纹，如今已湮没于时代。它无声见证着这座拱的力量与年代。
Two massive piers of mortared stone frame an opening several yards wide. A few thin, dead vines still cling to them, one reaching all the way to where the rise of the arch begins. The beveled stones, linked to one another, reach their perfection of design at the great keystone. On the face of this keystone are the worn swirls of a chiseled saying, now lost to time. It is a testimony to the strength and age of the arch.

Approaching A Somber Village.name:
走近一座阴郁的村庄
Approaching A Somber Village

Text.text:
孤零零的城门卫兵坐在矮凳上，身子倚着长矛。里拉琴以小调奏着哀歌，仿佛整座村子刚刚长长叹了一口绝望的气，便草草收场。酒馆里寂静无声，只剩沉默而认真的饮酒；神殿几乎与教堂墓园里的陵寝难分彼此。街上偶遇的人顶多点头算作招呼，更多时候连这点也省了；市集上的商贩没有一个在意顾客来不来。一只乌鸦啼叫。远处传来狗吠。
The lone gate guard sits on a stool, leaning on her pike. A lyre plays a lament in a minor key, and it seems that the entire village just heaved a despairing sigh and called it a day. The tavern is hushed with serious drinking, the temple almost indistinguishable from its mausoleum in the kirkyard. Meetings in the street are acknowledged with nods, if at all, and not a merchant in the market seems to care whether a customer shows. A crow calls. A dog barks in the distance.

I Cast Clone Using An Urn.name:
我用一只骨灰瓮施放了【克隆术】
I Cast Clone Using An Urn

Text.text:
我将一枚钻石投入巨大的瓮中，随后把那团血肉也丢了进去。就像古老时代的魔像一样，这将是我的半成之作，静候它原主的死亡。它在数月间缓慢发育，瓮如子宫一般孕育着它。那具身体不过是一副空壳，等待思想、情感……以及由其创造者临终最后一息注入其中的灵魂。
I drop a diamond into the giant urn, then the flesh. Like the golems of old, this will be my semi-creation, waiting for the death of its original. It develops for months, the urn acting as womb. The body is a shell waiting for thoughts, feelings… and a soul placed into it by the last breath of its progenitor.

Avatar Of Lux-odassa-nym, Protector Of H.name:
勒克斯-欧达萨-宁之化身，雏雏守护者
Avatar Of Lux-odassa-nym, Protector Of Hatchlings

Text.text:
女神的形态起初柔软可塑、虚无缥缈。可旋即，炫目的光芒凝聚成一条修长盘绕的巨龙——一头伟岸的有翼巨蛇，颅骨上生着枝杈般的鹿角，角上缠着青翠的绿叶。她这位龙之女神几乎无法言喻：美得令人屏息，又可怖得叫人胆寒，让人分不清该跪地膜拜，还是转身逃命。然而，她那金红鳞片散发的暖意、在铠甲般的鳞甲下闷燃的火，赐下一种少有人得以体会、更少有人敢说曾触及的安慰。巨龙的双眼微光流转，璀璨得如同太阳本身。

~ Envisioned by christoffer

The shape of the goddess is malleable, intangible at first. But then the blinding light coalesces to give shape to a long, coiled wyrm—a great, winged serpent whose skull is crested with bough-like antlers strung with greenery. The draconic goddess defies description, a thing at once so lovely and so terrible that one cannot decide between dropping to their knees in reverence or fleeing in fear. But the warmth emanating from her gold-red scales, the fire smoldering just beneath her armored hide, lends a comfort few experience and fewer still can claim to have touched. The dragon’s eyes shimmer, a light as dazzling as the sun itself.

~ Envisioned by christoffer

Grey's Resistor.name:
格雷的电阻器
Grey's Resistor

Text.text:
这只长方形金属匣仅半个手掌宽，表面锃亮，覆着三种字母写成的细小黑字。啪嗒一声掀开，里头是一支皮下注射笔，笔身印着两枚为TL;DR人群准备的粗块图标：其一是人形头颅，被一颗放射光辉的力场球罩住；其二是同一头颅的缩小版，旁边飘着卡通般的臭气线。前与后？也许。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Half a hand wide and gleaming, the rectangular metallic case is bedecked with tiny black print in three alphabets. It flips open to reveal a hypodermic pen emblazoned with two blocky icons for the TL;DR crowd. One is a humanoid head shielded by a sphere of radiant force; the other, a shrunken version of the same head with cartoonish stink lines. Before and after, maybe?

~ Envisioned by a Hero

你在不远处望见一座三角形塔楼，约有三层高。塔身墙面光滑，呈板岩般的灰色；当你走近时，才发现它没有任何门扉或闸口。塔楼最高处隐约可见几道拱形窗洞的轮廓，除此之外几乎一无所有。塔基四周的地面泛起粉笔般的气味，丝丝缕缕往上飘。
You spot a triangular tower in the nearby distance, looking to be about three stories high. The walls are smooth and slate gray, and as you approach, you notice there are no doors or gates. In the uppermost areas, you can make out some window arches, but little else. The smell of chalk rises from the ground around the base of the tower.

Many Prison Cells.name:
众多牢房
Many Prison Cells

Text.text:
冰冷湿润的石头构成了地面、墙壁与天花板。外侧走廊零星点着几支昏暗的火把，却几乎驱不散步步逼近的黑暗，只能照亮你面前短短几尺，其余尽数隐没。坚硬的铁栏在多年潮湿空气的侵蚀下锈迹斑斑，沿着长廊两侧一间间牢房的入口排列而去；里面只剩锁链，以及那些被世界判定“没有他们更好”的人。
Cold, wet stone makes up the floor, walls, and ceiling. The few dim torches that line the outer hall do little to chase away the encroaching darkness, obscuring anything more than a few feet in front of you. Hard iron bars, rusted by years of damp air, line the entrances to cells that run down the long passage, housing only chains and those that the world decided it would be better off without.

你这艘远航星海的船只以相对常见的材料打造而成，但掌舵的施法者所汲取并引导的魔能，维系着一层包裹船体的气囊，为它撑起可呼吸的氛围，使其得以扛住空间旅行的严酷考验。尽管船体依靠魔法推进，你的船员仍像任何航海水手那样守在帆与索具旁——以防最糟的情况降临时，尚有退路可循。

~ 构想：Burnzy503

Relatively common materials have been used in the construction of your spacefaring vessel, but the magical energy drawn from the spellcaster at the helm maintains an envelope of atmosphere allowing the ship to withstand the rigors of space travel. Despite the magical propulsion being used, your crew still mans the sails and rigging as any seafaring crew would, as a backup should the worst occur.

~ Envisioned by Burnzy503

Ancient Elvish Greetings And Their Trans.name:
古老精灵语问候语及其译文
Ancient Elvish Greetings And Their Translations

Text.text:
Ulthri Mellon — 问候你，朋友 Unda Calia Ebolem — 愿永恒之光照耀你 Elthri Amorilia — 你的存在令我心潮昂扬

~ 由 Tiir 构想

Ulthri Mellon — Greetings, friend Unda Calia Ebolem — May the light of eternity shine upon you Elthri Amorilia — My heart lifts in your presence

~ Envisioned by Tiir

Thunderstorm: Height Of The Storm.name:
雷暴：风暴之巅
Thunderstorm: Height Of The Storm

Text.text:
暴雨如桶倾泻，狂风怒号，将雨滴拧成尖针般刺落。浓云吞没了天光，唯有偶尔的闪电撕开黑幕时，你才看清云层压得多低、奔得多快。有什么东西在空中疾掠而过，快得不像被风吹起，黑得也不像冰雹。你听见它的啼鸣，这才意识到那是一只鸟——毫无疑问，正仓皇寻觅栖身之所。
Rain buckets down, drops spun into needles by the blustering wind. Thick clouds have blotted out the light so you can only see how low and fast the clouds are moving during the occasional flash of lightning. Something hurtles through the air, too fast to be windblown, too dark to be hail. You hear its call and realize it was a bird—no doubt seeking shelter.

Acolyte Of Lux-odassa-nym, Protector Of.name:
勒克斯-欧达萨-宁的侍祭，雏幼守护者
Acolyte Of Lux-odassa-nym, Protector Of Hatchlings

Text.text:
那身影披上朴素的粗纺长袍——轻薄飘逸，奶油色，在肌肤映衬下几近半透——只为让日光的暖意与微风的抚触尽数穿透。他们高举双臂，掌心向外，任阳光洗过四肢，任风揉乱发丝。宛如一棵树竭力舒展至最高处——枝叶颤抖着，拼命汲取所能获得的治疗之光——这位侍僧在白昼的薄霭中化作剪影，沉静而不失温雅，沐浴在其女神的辉光里。颈间佩着一枚木制护符，雕成一只辐条为眼的轮。其中心，是一只不曾眨动的龙眼。

~ Envisioned by christoffer

The figure garbs themself in simple, rough-spun robes—light and billowy, cream-colored, and nearly translucent against their skin—to permit the warmth of the sun and the caress of the breeze. They raise both arms, palms facing outward, allowing the sunlight to bathe their limbs and the wind to tousle their hair. Like a tree stretching to its fullest height—leaves shivering as it strains to catch as much of the healing light as it can—the acolyte becomes a silhouette in the haze of the day, a stoic yet gracious figure bathed in the light of their goddess. Upon their neck, they wear a wooden totem, carved to resemble a wheel with eye spokes. Its center is dominated with an unblinking, draconic eye.

~ Envisioned by christoffer

Meditations: Summer Rain.name:
冥想：夏雨
Meditations: Summer Rain

Text.text:
银白的雨丝轻柔地飘落在树梢上，层层滤下，洒向林地深处；它为灌木披上一层闪烁的湿亮外衣，又滴入被落叶盖住的水洼，以及纠缠树根托起的杯状凹处。鸟鸣在林间回荡，仿佛也被这场夏雨所催发。
A silvery rain drifts gently down onto the treetops and filters through to the forest floor, cloaking bushes in glistening coats and dripping into leaf-lidded puddles and the cupped bowls of tangled tree roots. Birdsong echoes throughout the wood, seemingly encouraged by the summer rain.

I Cast Daylight From My Helm Of Brillian.name:
我从辉煌头盔中施放了【昼明术】
I Cast Daylight From My Helm Of Brilliance

Text.text:
尽管宝石被精巧的金属工艺深深镶嵌，只需轻轻一拽，欧泊便乖顺地弹出。想到太阳，我将指间夹着的石头对准光芒初生之处——它随即崩解成细腻的粉末，飞向那一点，继而迸发出正午般的王者华辉。
For being so deeply set in the fine craftsmanship of the metal, the opal pops free with an easy tug. Thinking of the sun, I aim the stone held between my fingers to the point where its light begins, and it disintegrates into a fine powder that flies to that spot and radiates as the royal beauty of midday.

寂静先于喷发降临。随即，你脚下的大地轰鸣震颤，从空旷的洞顶抖落尘土与碎屑。石块沿着洞壁哗啦作响地滚落。仿佛大地本身发出一声低沉的呻吟，预告着即将到来的爆炸。就在震动攀至顶峰的刹那，间歇泉轰然喷涌，吐出一柱滚烫蒸腾的水柱，猛然拍击洞窟穹顶，随即化作细雾般的雨幕倾洒而下。
Silence precedes the eruption. Then the ground beneath you rumbles, shaking loose dust and debris from the cavernous ceiling. Rocks come rattling down the cave walls. A groan issues from the earth itself, forecasting the explosion to come. And just as the rumbling reaches its zenith, the geyser erupts, discharging a steaming hot pillar of water that splashes against the cavern's ceiling. It rains down in a mist.

铺着鹅卵石的道路两侧，商贩们排开摊位，陈列着既寻常又奇异的货物，空气里混杂着既熟悉又异域的香气。他们对着人潮高声叫卖，头顶五彩旗幡迎风翻飞。帆布篷布之下，商人们唇枪舌剑，讨价还价，来回过手、成交不断。一个摊位里摆着一排城堡锻造的利刃，另一个摊位则挂着精灵工艺的长弓。队尾一处昏影笼罩的棚亭里，烟色玻璃小瓶盛着古怪的暗色液体，透着莫名的幽光。至于饥肠辘辘的人，也有各式点心可选——捏成龙、狮鹫与枭熊的模样，内里填着炖煮后加甜的果馅。
The merchants lining the cobbled road present goods both mundane and magical, aromas both familiar and exotic. Each shouts to the crowd, hawking their wares, as colorful banners flutter overhead. Beneath sailcloth tarps, the merchants haggle, wheel and deal. In one stall is an array of castle-forged blades, in another, bows of elven make. A shadowy booth at the end of one row offers strange, dusky liquids in smoky glass vials. And for the hungry, an assortment of pastries shaped to resemble dragons, griffons, and owlbears, each filled with stewed and sweetened fruit, are available.

Fire Elemental: Fight.name:
火元素：战斗
Fire Elemental: Fight

Text.text:
与火元素的鏖战攀至最高潮。汗水与烟雾刺痛你的双眼。灰烬糊住你的舌头，几乎要灌满你的肺。乌黑的煤烟覆满一切。即便你已设法隔绝它的灼热，你的身体仍仿佛在燃烧——为了持续压制这团炽焰之灵，肌肉在拉扯与紧绷中灼痛如火。
The battle against the fire elemental reaches a crescendo. Sweat and smoke sting your eyes. Ash covers your tongue and threatens to fill your lungs. Black soot covers everything. Even where you’ve protected yourself from its heat, your body feels aflame as your muscles burn with the strain of keeping the pressure on this blazing being.

那恶魔看上去几乎只是一团颤动渗流的血肉，唯有一张类人的面孔痛苦地扭曲着。鲜血与胆汁从这生物体内不断涌出，落地便滋滋作响。锁链缠绕其身，将它牢牢束缚在原地——或许是为了限制它污秽的蔓延，或许是为了阻止它过度挣扎。然而，那双布满血丝的眼睛里却有一种清明：冷静而精于算计的目光，仿佛所见远不止它栖身的深渊位面。
The demon looks like little more than a mass of quivering, oozing flesh with a humanoid face twisted in agony. Steady streams of blood and bile pour from the creature, sizzling as they hit the ground. Chains wrap around it and hold it in place, maybe to limit the spread of its pollution, or maybe to stop it from excessive thrashing. And yet there's a clarity in the thing's bloodshot eyes, a lucid and calculating gaze that must be seeing more than the abyssal plane where it resides.

[察觉] 你注意到大门口的地面上横贯着一道空槽，几乎贯穿整个门幅——不由停下脚步。门后的房间里，入口前方的地面似乎微微抬高。

[发现] 证实了你的猜测，你发现门洞上方悬着一道沉重的铁栅门，粗大的铁链将其吊起，铁链一路没入地面。凑近细看，那段抬高的地面下藏着一块压力板——毫无疑问，正是触发陷阱的机关。

[触发] 压力板松脱，夹击大门的铁链骤然释放，死寂的空气里瞬间灌满震耳欲聋的哗啦巨响。一道锈蚀的黑铁栅门带着森然的决绝在你身后轰然落下。

[Perceived] You notice an empty channel on the floor spanning the breadth of the large doorway—and pause. In the room beyond, the floor seems to be raised slightly—at least in front of the entrance.

[Discovered] Confirming your suspicions, you discover a heavy iron portcullis suspended above the doorway on large iron chains which disappear into the floor. Upon closer inspection, you see the raised section of the ground conceals a pressure plate, no doubt one that triggers the trap.

[Triggered] A deafening rattle fills the stagnant air as the pressure plate releases the chains flanking the doorway. An imposing portcullis of rusting black iron slams down behind you with grim finality.

Decimated War Camp.name:
残破的战争营地
Decimated War Camp

Text.text:
崭新如初的团旗在风中凄然鼓荡，是这里曾为热闹军营的唯一佐证。拾荒鸟的尖啸与聒噪在帐篷间回荡，然而散落各处的干瘪尸体却无人问津；一层昏沉的蓝色烟霭沉沉压在空气里，久久不散。
Pristine regimental flags billow forlornly in the breeze, the only evidence of this once being a lively military camp. Shrieks and caws of scavenger birds echo through the tents, yet the shriveled bodies scattered throughout remain untouched as a torpid blue smog hangs heavy in the air.

驴子惬意地站在阴影里，眨着眼，凝望远方。她舒适的体型、黑鼻头周围柔软的白色口鼻部，以及竖起的短硬鬃毛，让她看起来像是供孩子骑乘的玩具——有时也确实如此。但今天，她在开阔的原野上守护羊群，既凶悍护主，又是可靠的同伴。
The donkey stands comfortably in the shade, blinking and staring out. Her comfortable size, her soft white muzzle around a black nose, and her bristly short mane make her look like a toy for children to ride, and sometimes she is. But today she guards sheep in the open fields, a fierce protector and a good companion.

Sinclair Fleet-foot The Human Hunter.name:
辛克莱·疾足——人类猎人
Sinclair Fleet-foot The Human Hunter

Text.text:
几乎没有任何声响泄露你面前这名肤色昏暗的男子的逼近。的确，连一根折断的枯枝、一片被踩皱的落叶都未曾标记他的行迹。尽管他站姿松弛，他那双铜色眼睛却永远半眯着，锐利地搜寻危险的蛛丝马迹——无数个季节在他最爱的地形中狩猎，早已将感官磨得如刀锋般敏锐。他的拇指勾在宽阔的皮腰带上，与那件悄然藏在土色斗篷之下的皮护甲浑然一体；双手的位置恰到好处，随时可以迅捷拔出那对久经战阵却被精心保养的战斗匕首。背上的长弓显然用过不少，但行家一眼便能看出：这位游侠一旦麻烦上门，更偏爱直接闯入混战的核心。

~ 由来自 RPGBOT.net 的 Tyler 扮演

Scarcely a sound betrays the approach of the dusky-hued man standing before you. Indeed, not a single broken twig or trampled leaf marks his passage. Though he stands in a relaxed position, his copper eyes are in a permanent half-squint, keenly looking for signs of danger, senses sharpened by countless seasons spent hunting in his favorite terrain. His thumbs are tucked into his wide leather belt, of a piece with the leather armor worn surreptitiously under his earth-toned cloak, hands placed for a fast draw of his well-worn but carefully maintained fighting daggers. The longbow on his back has seen some use, certainly, but a practiced eye reveals that this ranger prefers to get into the thick of things when trouble starts.

~ Played by Tyler from RPGBOT.net

A Manual Of Golems.name:
《魔像手册》
A Manual Of Golems

Text.text:
这本厚重的尘封巨册，磨损的皮革封面上烙着数张狰狞怪面的画像。风化欲碎的羊皮纸页间尽是诡异的图式与字迹，细述着某种构装体的锻造与诞生流程。
This weighty dust-shrouded tome bears the image of several monstrous faces on its worn leather cover. The crumbling vellum pages are filled with strange diagrams and writings detailing the creation process for some kind of construct.

一只惹人怜爱的小哈巴狗端端正正地栖在紫色靠枕上，垫子淡金色的流苏与她口鼻、眼周与腹下那抹金棕色绒毛相互映衬，在其余乌黑亮泽的被毛上格外醒目。她从鼻间长长叹出一口忍耐已久的气，望向被雨水拍打的窗子，漆黑的眼里缠着一丝麻木的失望。窗外玻璃另一侧，泥泞的水洼成群结队地闪着诱人的光。她回头看向主人，俏皮地把嘴张得老大打了个哈欠——一缕烟雾顺着她粉红的舌面滚了出来。刹那间，你仿佛看见她耳边蓬起的毛发化作两支发光的炭黑角，橙色的光在她的毛皮上跳跃。可下一眨眼，效果便消散无踪，她的目光又变回冷冽的黑曜石凝视。
A lovely little lapdog lies perched on a purple pillow, the cushion’s flaxen tassels mirroring the golden-brown fur accenting the dog’s snout, eyes, and underbelly on her otherwise luscious black coat. A long-suffering sigh billows from her nose as she looks to the rain-battered window, the jet black of her eyes laced with stultified disappointment. A bevy of muddy puddles shimmers invitingly from just beyond the pane. She looks to her owner and opens her mouth wide in a cheeky yawn—and a puff of smoke rolls over her pink tongue. For a split second, you think you see the perky hair around her ears transmute into glowing charcoal horns, their orange light dancing over her coat. Then, in a blink, the effect disappears and her gaze is once more a cool, obsidian stare.

Gray Wizard On Floating Cog.name:
漂浮齿轮上的灰袍巫师
Gray Wizard On Floating Cog

Text.text:
法师居高临下地傲然俯视着你，身披翻涌的灰色长袍，身影格外夺目。他双脚跨立在一枚巨大的附魔齿轮上，以机械般的精准在空中滑行，始终伴随着无处不在的钟表滴答声。
Glaring imperiously from above you, the wizard cuts a striking figure in billowing gray robes. Standing astride a large, enchanted cog, he glides through the air with mechanical precision, accompanied by the omnipresent sound of a ticking clock.

The Sanctuary: Mount Chomick.name:
圣所：坐骑乔米克
The Sanctuary: Mount Chomick

Text.text: 白雪覆顶的群峰统治着天际，像参差的冰爪撕向苍穹，其中尤以乔米克山最为巍峨。刺骨的寒风——无论护甲、衣物还是皮毛都挡不住——直钻骨髓，让你几乎只剩下对寒冷的感知。你才开始攀登，脚下便有一小片积雪松动，翻滚着坠向下方的森林——那是冷冽而醒目的警告：每一步都得格外谨慎。 Snow-capped peaks dominate the horizon, reaching into the sky like jagged icy claws, none more so than Mount Chomik. The frigid wind—which cuts through armor, clothing, and fur alike—chills you to the bone, and makes it tough to sense anything but cold. As you begin to climb, a small amount of snow gives way and tumbles to the forest below—a stark warning to carefully watch every step you take.

Overgrown Sacrificial Temple.name:
荒蔓吞没的献祭神殿
Overgrown Sacrificial Temple

Text.text:
受森林之力召唤，德鲁伊们抵达神殿遗址——一座由矮胖的花岗岩圆柱撑起的地堡式建筑，托着一顶朴素的屋顶，却正被葱郁藤蔓吞噬。粗得如野蛮人手臂般的蔓茎在神殿上盘绕扭动。那幽暗的怀抱深处燃着一团冰冷的蓝焰，火光周围站着数名卓尔，蓝黑与惨白交错，如棋盘般森然。他们以阴鸷的姿态向德鲁伊们致意，并为至高妖精吟诵咒唱。

~ 由一位英雄 设想

Summoned by power in their woodlands, the druids arrive at the temple site—a bunker of squat granite cylinders holding up a simple roof, all being consumed by leafy vines. Creepers thick as a barbarian’s arm twist and writhe over the temple. Inside its dark embrace is a cold bluish fire, around which stand several drow like a chessboard of blue-black and white. They gesture in sinister welcome to the druids and chant for the archfey.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

尖利的哭声与笨拙的挥舞宣告着新生的人类降临，几乎小得不可思议，脆弱得仿佛一碰即碎。它的头裹着一层深色、绒羽般柔软的胎发，在尚不足以承受重量的脖颈上摇摇晃晃。它的眼睛狂乱地游移，以尚未发育完全的目光寻找能落定的焦点。忽然，它的视线锁定了你，歪着头好奇地打量。嘴角微微一牵，像是笑意的影子悄然浮现。
The shrill cries and clumsy flailing announce the presence of the newborn human, almost impossibly small and frail. Their head, shrouded in dark, downy-soft hair, rolls about on a neck not yet strong enough to support weight. Their eyes roam wildly, searching for something to focus on with an undeveloped gaze. They hone in on you suddenly, cocking their head curiously. Something akin to a smile tugs at the corners of their mouth.

Loot From A Steel Dragon.name:
钢铁巨龙的战利品
Loot From A Steel Dragon

Text.text:
巨龙暴怒咆哮之际，宛如铁匠炉膛般炽白的灼热从它的钢铁之躯内迸发而出。那庞然巨物轰然坠地——熔融的血液在它倒伏的身形周遭汇聚成池——它那刀刃般的尾巴不再狂甩，终于静止不动。若以娴熟的技能小心操作，便能拆下部分尾刃，用于锻造制作。
As the dragon bellows in fury, the incandescent heat of a blacksmith's forge erupts from within its steel flesh. The behemoth falls to the ground—molten blood pooling around its fallen form—and its bladed tail ceases thrashing and lies still. With careful skill, one could remove some of the tail blades for use in crafting.

一阵熟悉的尖啸在空气中攀升，像静电般蓄势，伴随着你的同伴低声吟诵他们的法术词句，音节间穿插着细微而精准的手势。先是茫然——继而恐慌——在你敌人的脸上迅速蔓延：现实在他们周身扭曲变形，将他们猛然抛入以太虚空，弹射般坠向另一处地点。

~ Envisioned by thebigham on Discord

A familiar, teeth-rattling whine builds like a static charge as your companion mutters the words of their spell, weaving subtle gestures along with the syllables. Confusion—then panic—spreads across the face of your foe as reality twists and warps around them, catapulting them through the etheric void to a new location.

~ Envisioned by thebigham on Discord

Study In A Manor.name:
庄园书房
Study In A Manor

Text.text:
房间里弥漫着烟斗烟雾、陈旧羊皮纸与新鲜墨水的气味。一张巨大的橡木书桌摆在一扇直抵天花板的窗前，窗框两侧垂着勃艮第红的帷幕，其上缀满繁复的金色金银丝花纹。书桌上堆着一摞摞羊皮纸、一套羽毛笔，还有足足半打墨水瓶——每一瓶都盛着不同色泽的墨。印蜡章侧倒在一旁，边缘的热蜡刚封上不久，仍在缓缓冷却。书桌左右各立着高大的书架，塞满了数以百计的皮革精装厚册。而房间正中央，两张高背皮椅相对而置，中间夹着一张细腿瘦长的小桌。
The room smells of pipe smoke, old parchment, and fresh ink. A massive oaken desk sits before a ceiling-height window, itself framed with burgundy curtains with elaborate gold filligree. Stacks of parchment, a set of quills, and half-a-dozen inkwells each containing a different shade of ink sit atop the desk. A wax stamp lies on its side, fresh wax still cooling around its edges. Massive shelves stand to either side of the desk, laden with hundreds of leatherbound tomes. And at the center of the room, a pair of high-backed leather chairs sit with a small, spindly-legged table between them.

Sundries From A Skeleton.name:
骷髅杂货
Sundries From A Skeleton

Text.text:
你从骷髅（特征）的肋骨与四肢间探视，搜寻任何闪烁的宝藏迹象。但这些陈旧的骨头只要稍一晃动便崩散成尘，骨粉如薄弱的灵魂残屑般弥漫在凹陷处，朦朦罩住一切。
You peer between the ribs and limbs of the skeleton, searching for any glinting sign of treasure. But the old bones crumble to dust at the slightest jostle, and the bonemeal clouds over the concaves like weak fractions of a spirit’s essence.

一道浅浅的长方形清水池分列在遗迹入口两侧。每口池塘内沿砌着洁白的石墙，池底则由一整块同样材质的巨石铺就。睡莲叶漂浮在如镜的水面上，点缀着细小的淡色花朵，强烈的日光在其间投下刺目的反光。水里带着雨意与花蜜的气息。
A shallow, rectangular pool of clear water flanks either side of the ruin’s entryway. A wall of white masonry lines each pond, and each has a bottom made of one gigantic slab of similar rock. Lily pads with tiny, pale flowers float on the glassy surface amid glaring reflections of sunlight. The water smells of rain and nectar.

Betting Outside The Pub.name:
酒馆外的赌局
Betting Outside The Pub

Text.text:
前头露天那张桌旁，三个酒客盯着近处拴在栏杆上的三匹马。鹅卵石路面高低不平，他们把椅子微微后仰稳住，手里把品脱杯攥得紧紧的。“左边那匹黑家伙，”其中一个说。“那是母马。”另一个纠正。“照样押它。” 过了一会儿，中间那匹栗色马猛地一甩尾巴，啪地抽开几只苍蝇。“掏钱吧。”第三个酒客说道。
Three drinkers at the table out front watch three horses tied to the rail nearby. The drinkers tip their chairs a little on the uneven cobbles and hold their pint glasses tightly. “The black fella on the left,” says one. “That’s a mare,” says another. “Still, me bet.” After a moment, the chestnut horse in the middle flips its tail, snapping away a few flies. “Pay up,” says the third drinker.

Goblin Rump Steak.name:
地精臀肉牛排
Goblin Rump Steak

Text.text:
当你把一片烤制的地精侧腹肉滑入口中时，你才察觉到它的风味竟如此复杂——介于一块放了三个月的猪排与一把呕吐物之间，那呕吐物是在太阳底下晒了一整天后，从鹅卵石路面上刮下来的。
As you slide a piece of the barbecued goblin flank into your mouth, you become aware of the complexity of its flavor. It sits somewhere between a three-month-old pork chop and a handful of vomit, scraped from the cobblestones after a day in the sun.

柔软的皮革覆在轻巧的骨架上，为的就是舒适。每一副好鞍子终究会贴合马与骑手，就像一双称脚的旧鞋，或一顶戴惯了的老帽。座下狭窄的鞍裙压印着花纹，卷草蜿蜒。鞍桥、鞍头下的木头上烙着一个名字。马镫铁上满是千百次骑乘磨出的痕迹，而下方的鞍毯无疑柔软贴身，色彩与纹样兼具美观与实用。
Soft leather over a light frame, this is designed for comfort. Every good saddle eventually conforms to horse and rider, like a favorite shoe or an old hat. The narrow skirt below the seat is stamped and scrolled. On the wood under the pommel, a name is burned. The stirrup irons show the wear of a thousand rides, and the blanket below is undoubtedly soft on the horse, colored and patterned for beauty as well as utility.

Entering A Winery.name:
走进酒庄
Entering A Winery

Text.text:
葡萄园一行行的藤架引你来到一处搭着棚架的门洞，踏入酒庄深处。你俯视着箍着木箍的发酵桶时，发酵葡萄那浓郁微酸的香气将你层层包裹。最大的一只大桶外，整齐排着一篮篮挂着露珠的红葡萄，果串簇拥挺立，正等着被倾倒入桶中碾碎。
The vineyard rows lead you to a trellised doorway and into the winery itself. The rich, tangy scent of fermenting grapes envelops you as you look over the coopered tanks. Baskets bristling with dewy red grapes are lined up outside of the largest of the vats, ready to be poured inside and mashed.

I Declare My Loyalty.name:
我宣誓效忠
I Declare My Loyalty

Text.text:
我把手蜷成拳，砰地一声捶在胸口上，目光燃起炽热的赤诚。“听着。从今往后，我将为你效劳。凡有敌人遮蔽天际，胆敢威胁、阻拦你，我必以我所拥有的一切力量将其击倒。我属于你——坚定不移，稳如磐石。”
I curl my hand into a fist and thump it against my chest, my gaze afire with earnestness. “Hear this. I, henceforth, am in your service. Any foe who clouds the horizon, threatening to oppose you, shall be struck down by any powers I possess. I am yours—stalwart and steady.”

Aether Diving Bell.name:
以太潜水钟
Aether Diving Bell

Text.text:
暗淡的黄盔沉重得必须在肩上加垫才能承受。它在颈部以一圈厚实的黑色橡胶紧紧密封，双层玻璃舷窗周围又覆着树脂封条。气瓶与压力阀门为最深海的严苛环境精密校准……也同样适用于空间里游弋的漆黑无垠。
The dull yellow helmet weighs enough to require padding for one’s shoulders. It is sealed at the neck with a thick roll of black rubber, with resin seals around the double glass portals. The tanks and pressure valves are calibrated for the rigors of the deepest ocean… or the swimming blackness of space.

Oil Of Etherealness.name:
虚无行油
Oil Of Etherealness

Text.text:
你凑近仔细端详瓶子，软木塞边缘不时渗出缕缕仿佛浓稠蒸汽的雾丝，旋即又比你预想的更快消散。那只珍珠灰的瓶身不透分毫，可当蒸汽掠过瓶颈时，你却发誓自己能一眼看穿它。
Inspecting the bottle closely, wisps of what looks like thick steam leak now and again around the cork, only to evaporate more quickly than you would expect. The pearl-gray bottle is completely opaque, though you swear that you can see straight through it when the steam passes over the bottle’s neck.

Temple To A God Of Mysteries.name:
神秘之神的神殿
Temple To A God Of Mysteries

Text.text:
无睑的眼睛从每一处表面窥视着你——刻进墙壁与柱身，烙印在石质地砖上，每一只的形貌都各不相同。高高的穹顶下，一只巨眼凌空俯瞰；它的瞳孔是一枚闪耀的宝石，带着令人不寒而栗的审视。传言司掌奥秘的神祇守着无数秘密——但在这座神殿里，缀满其上的无尽之眼面前，没有任何秘密能够遁形。噼啪作响的火把与火盆将摇曳的光投在雕刻的眼纹上，明灭之间，令人不安地生出一种错觉：它们正追随着你的一举一动。
Lidless eyes peer at you from every surface, etched into walls and pillars, emblazoned on the stone floor tiles, each unique in its depiction. A single, looming eye, its pupil a gleaming gemstone, leers down from the high ceiling. The deity of mysteries, it’s said, keeps many secrets—but no secrets escape the notice of the infinite eyes adorning their temple. Sputtering torches and braziers cast their wavering light across the carved eyes, creating the unnerving feeling that they are following your movements.

Enchanted Hot Spring.name:
魔法温泉
Enchanted Hot Spring

Text.text:
这处受魔法祝福的泉眼里，深邃的天青色泉水轻轻泛起细密的泡沫，缕缕蒸汽如柱般温柔升腾，迎向头顶缓缓漂过的云朵。当这汪治疗之水将你环抱，所有疼痛、病症与不适尽数被洗净——取而代之的，是一份静默而不可思议的安宁，悄然落入你的灵魂深处。
Rich cerulean waters bubble softly in this enchanted spring, columns of steam rising gently to greet the clouds drifting overhead. As the healing waters embrace you, all pains, maladies, and ailments are washed away—replaced by a quiet, unfathomable peace that settles in your soul.

Host And Hostess Tavern.name:
东道酒馆
Host And Hostess Tavern

Text.text:
这家店刻意避开路人的目光——藏在当铺与一间封板歇业的赌馆之间，位于小巷尽头最阴沉的角落。但熟门熟路的人一旦寻到这里，迎接他们的便是浸透的琥珀色灯光、带着香水气息的空气，以及形态、体型与性别表达千姿百态的美丽侍者。门口的牌子写着：“禁止触碰。尽情欣赏。”

形态、体型与性别表达千姿百态的绝美侍者在门口以含蓄的微笑迎接你。柔和的琥珀光与一幕带香的烟雾帘为宽敞的厅堂镀上一层近乎魔幻、超脱尘世的光晕；室内散落着舒适的座席区与幽暗的壁龛。“禁止触碰，”你的侍者愉快地提醒，“但请尽情大饱眼福。”一面巨大的吧台占据着整面墙，架上摆满了所有你能想象的酒——无论凡俗还是魔法。侍者们在一桌又一桌之间优雅穿行，递上酒杯，聊着令人愉悦的闲谈。笑声在空气里流淌；而在最远的角落，一位独自的吟游诗人正用鲁特琴拨出轻快的旋律。
The establishment goes out of its way to avoid attention from passerby—tucked between a pawn broker and a boarded-up gambling hall at the dark end of an alley. But those who know its location find that it welcomes them with suffused amber light, air tinged with perfume, and beautiful hosts of every shape, size, and gender expression imaginable. A sign at the door reads: “No touching. Look to your heart’s content.”
 
 Gorgeous hosts of every shape, size, and gender expression imaginable greet you at the door with demure smiles. Soft, amber light and a curtain of perfumed smoke lends an almost magical, otherworldly glow to the spacious room, littered with comfortable seating areas and shadowed alcoves. “No touching,” your host reminds you cheerfully. “But please, feast your eyes.” A massive bar dominates one wall, its shelves stocked with every liquor imaginable, both mundane and magical. Hosts move gracefully from one table to the next, serving drinks and sharing pleasant conversation. Laughter fills the air, while in the far corner, a solitary bard strums pleasantly on a lute.

City Investigator's Office.name:
城市调查员办公室
City Investigator's Office

Text.text:
一扇小窗投下昏暗的光，勉强照亮这间狭窄而杂乱的房间。一张过于巨大的书桌几乎占满了地面，书架则把剩余的空间挤得更紧。纸张、卷轴、账册与书籍从桌面四下倾泻；而在桌后——钉在塞得鼓鼓的书架间——挂着一幅精密的城市地图，上面插着各色细小的羽毛作标记。一条毛发稀疏的老狗从书桌下那堆废弃羊皮纸铺成的窝里抬起头，百无聊赖地眨了眨眼，又蜷回去继续睡。
A small window dimly illuminates this cramped and cluttered room. An overlarge desk occupies most of the floor and bookshelves press into the rest of the space. Papers, scrolls, ledgers, and books spill across the desk, while behind it—pinned up across overstuffed shelves—hangs an intricate map of the city, with tiny feathers of different colors pushed through it. A mangy old dog looks up from a bed of discarded parchment beneath the desk, blinks at you in a bored fashion, then curls back into sleeping position.

由蔚蓝、冰冷的块状冰体拼成的冰川表面，让人几乎以为自己踏上了一颗异星。每一步都异常艰难，靴底咯吱作响，踩碎表层的冰雪往下陷去；每一次呼出，气息都在空中凝成寒霜。
With blue, icy chunks that make up the glacier’s surface, it seems almost as if you had set foot on an alien world. Every step is laborious, your boots crunching down past the ice and snow of the surface, your breath freezing with each exhalation.

Ruined Storeroom.name:
崩毁的储藏室
Ruined Storeroom

Text.text:
这间曾经整洁的储藏室，如今天花板与墙壁早被时代撕扯得破败不堪，只剩下昔日用途的腐臭暗影。凡是没被潜行的害虫啃噬殆尽的，也都化作泼洒四处的污秽，在朽烂的地板木条表面发酵成腐败的烂泥。你撬开一只大体还算完好的木桶，立刻被恶心得几欲作呕——桶里的餐食腥臭腐烂，混着好几打死蜈蚣的空壳。
The ceiling and walls of this once-tidy storeroom have been rent by time into a putrid shadow of its former use. Whatever was not eaten by creeping vermin is now spilled filth turned to decay on the surface of the rotten floorboards. Prying open a barrel that has survived more or less intact, you are disgusted to find that the meal inside stinks of rot and contains the husks of several dozen dead millipedes.

受诅之人的残躯在你周围扭曲成堆。断肢仍在抽搐，外泄的脏腑沙沙作响，不肯接受那不朽的邪恶竟已走到尽头。漆黑的脓液与猩红的鲜血嘶嘶作响，龟裂的大地仿佛饥渴般将它们吞噬。这就是在地狱里凯旋的模样。
The broken bodies of the damned lie in twisted piles all around you. Severed limbs still twitch and spilled guts susurrate, unwilling to accept that their immortal evil has somehow come to an end. Black ichor and crimson blood sizzle as the cracked ground seems to hungrily absorb them. This is what triumph in Hell looks like.

Lost Handmaiden Encounters Centaurs.name:
迷失的侍女遭遇半人马
Lost Handmaiden Encounters Centaurs

Text.text:
女人倔强地踉跄前行，穿越泥泞淤塞的荒地；那件曾经华美的长裙裙摆，如今被污秽涂抹得不成样子。雷鸣般的蹄声骤然逼近，令她猝不及防——一群半人马将她团团围住，举起的兵刃以敌意作答。她试图解释，可话语卡在喉间，彼此绊倒翻滚，像杂技演员乱作一团，却拼不出任何清晰的意义。一名半人马向前踏出一步，以冷冽的琥珀色目光钉住她——她的感官里，命运那只纤细的手仿佛落在了她的肩头。

~ Envisioned by Ameria on Discord

The woman stumbles as she defiantly makes her way across the mud-choked land, the hem of her once-fine gown marred by filth. The thundering of hooves takes her by surprise as a herd of centaurs encircle her, their weapons offering a hostile greeting. She tries to explain herself, but words catch in her throat, tumbling over one another like acrobats in no meaningful order. A centaur steps froward, fixing her with a cool, amber stare—and she senses the delicate hand of fate upon her shoulder.

~ Envisioned by Ameria on Discord

一种令人难以承受的轻盈感似乎从这把巨大的银色武器中散发出来，斧柄上镶嵌着以精工细作的铜勾勒而成的天界纹样。你无从得知这柄巨斧是否真为天军的天使所铸，但你确信，任谁得以挥舞这件壮丽的武器，都不会感到丝毫羞愧。
An unbearable lightness seems to emanate from this massive silvery weapon, its haft inlaid with celestial designs of finely worked copper. You have no idea if this greataxe truly was crafted for use by an angel of a heavenly host, but you are certain that none would be ashamed at the prospect of wielding this magnificent weapon.

那具足有七英尺高的身影悬浮半空，幽影般令人心悸——却又莫名摄人心魄。它纤细、苍白的人形躯干之下，散落的暗色膜翼四下飘拢，汇聚成海军蓝般的袍裳。一张完美无瑕的瓷白面孔上，两只宽大的欧泊眼眸如将熄的太阳般微微闪烁；它张开那似乎是嘴的裂隙，唱出一曲淌着遥远思念的歌。
The seven-foot tall figure hovers, a haunting apparition—yet somehow enchanting. Its slim, pale, humanoid torso gives way to scattered dark membranes that gather like navy-blue robes. A perfect porcelain face, with two broad opal eyes glimmering like dying suns, opens what appears to be a mouth and sings a song dripping with distant longing.

最大的帐篷敞着帐帘，露出塞得满满的内部：麻袋、成卷的布匹、敞口的篮筐——都是需要躲避天气侵袭的物件。帐篷中央的一块区域被清理得只剩几只木桶，半圆形摆在一张地毯上，像是从雨幕中圈出的一处落座之所。
The largest tent stands with its flaps open, revealing an interior stuffed with more goods: sacks, bolts of cloth, and open baskets—things needing protection from the weather. An area in the center of the tent has been cleared of all but a few kegs set in a semicircle on a rug, creating a seating place out of the rain.

Marble Elephant Figurine Of Wondrous Pow.name:
奇妙力量的大理石小象雕像
Marble Elephant Figurine Of Wondrous Power

Text.text:
大理石雕成的大象猛然昂起前躯，象牙朝上挺立，长鼻上翘，与额头相连成一道弧线。灰色包浆沿着石纹渗入耳翼，边缘刻出流苏般的细碎毛边，仿佛真兽褶皱皮肤的质感。小像握在你手里，比它的体型看起来要沉得多。
The marble elephant rears back, tusks perked upward and its long nose upturned and connected to its forehead. The gray patina of the stone veins through the flaps of its ears, the edges fringed to mimic the wrinkled texture of the true beast. The figurine is weightier in your hand than its size would suggest.

I Use Retaliation.name:
我发动【反击】
I Use Retaliation

Text.text:
我借由疼痛行动。它与我的本能指引我锁定袭击者。我旋身迎向对方。随即一声怒吼，我架起武器，发动攻击。
I use the pain. It and my instincts guide me to my attacker. I spin to face them. Then, with a shout, I bring my weapon to bear and attack.

Circus Music: The Show Begins.name:
马戏团乐曲：演出开场
Circus Music: The Show Begins

Text.text:
先是手摇风琴拨出几声试探性的音符，紧接着蒸汽风琴的管音骤然苏醒，宣告演出开场。呼啸、口哨、铿锵与碰撞声随即涌入，又被风琴更深沉的低吟所掺和；原本轻快的旋律染上了葬礼般的阴影，让你不禁猜想，在这诡异序曲之后，将会出现何等离奇的景象。
First notes from a hurdy-gurdy sound, then a calliope pipes to sudden life, indicating the beginning of a show. The hoots, whistles, clangs, and clashes are soon joined by the deeper groan of an organ, giving the jaunty tune a funerial tone and causing you to wonder what strange sights will follow this eerie introduction.

完美金黄的煎饼，宽窄厚薄各异，层层叠起，堆出这名人形生物古怪又圆滚滚的轮廓。它的眼睛是两颗一模一样、无可挑剔的草莓。下半张脸的两片薄煎饼之间裂开一道缝，形成一张嘴，正咧着笑。头顶戴着一顶厨师帽，微微歪在一侧。一件柔软的皮夹克护住它的躯干、手臂与大腿上段。几条腰带与一条斜挂的背带系着各式烹饪器具，其中不乏数把利刃；背后还背着一张长弓与一壶箭。

~ 由 Nathan 扮演

Perfect, golden pancakes of various widths and thicknesses stack to make this humanoid’s whimsical rotund shape. Its eyes are perfect, identical strawberries. Between two flapjacks on its lower face, a slit forms a mouth, which grins. Atop the head sits a chef’s hat, slightly off center. A jacket of soft leather protects the being’s torso, arms, and upper legs. Belts and a baldric hold a variety of cooking utensils, including several blades, as well as a longbow and a quiver of arrows at the back.

~ Played by Nathan

Empty Vampire Coffin.name:
空的吸血鬼（特征）棺材
Empty Vampire Coffin

Text.text:
带着淡淡铜腥与腐败气味的泥土堆满这具无盖、朽烂却奢华的棺椁底部。年代让黑色漆面起了褶皱，也在繁复的黄铜把手上留下了一层青绿的铜锈。靠近本该是入殓者胸口的位置，泥土显得又黑又湿。棺内其余地方都挂着蛛网，唯独这片污渍上方却不见蛛丝结成。
Earth with the faint odor of copper and decay fills the bottom of this rotting but opulent coffin, which has no lid. Age has wrinkled the black lacquer and left a green patina on the elaborate brass handles. Near where an interred person’s chest would be, the dirt looks dark and wet. While cobwebs line the rest of the casket, they have not formed over this stain.

他周身的空气仿佛在替他发声，情绪一丝不漏地泄露出来，而你的目光立刻被他的头发攫住。那发丝起伏轻点、甩动抽搐，像是活物在呼吸。紧接着你才意识到——那根本不是头发，而是一条条蛇，它们的摆动与他脸上的神情严丝合缝。他眉头一沉，便有几条猛地弹起，咔哒一声张口，嘶嘶作响。他抬手拉起长袍的兜帽——袍面被荒原风沙磨蚀，粗糙得像龟裂的干土——随即挺直身躯。他那双蓝眼睛骤然闪过怒意。

~ Played by Khaolo

The air around him communicates his mood, and your attention is brought quickly to his hair. It seems to bob and flick, as though the hair were alive. Then you realize—it’s actually snakes, and they seem to match his facial expressions with their movements. A few snap and hiss just as he frowns. He pulls up the hood of his robe, scoured by the wastelands and textured like the cracked earth, and stands tall. His blue eyes flash with sudden anger.

~ Played by Khaolo

Loot From A Green Dragon Lair.name:
来自绿龙巢穴的战利品
Loot From A Green Dragon Lair

Text.text:
巢穴里堆满了钱币——铜币如山坡般倾泻，滑入银与金的浪潮。巨龙似乎将它们分门别类，甚至可能逐枚清点过。视野里不见半点白金币，这意味着它们并非不存在，而是被藏了起来。
The lair is a trove of coins—hillsides of copper sliding into silver and gold. The dragon seems to have sorted, perhaps counted, them individually. There is no platinum visible, which implies that it is hidden rather than nonexistent.

Delivery And Messenger Service Office.name:
投递与信使服务处
Delivery And Messenger Service Office

Text.text:
几匹看起来脚程极快的坐骑拴在这家驿传所外的系柱上，有的仍因一段疾驰而汗光淋漓，皮毛发亮。你探头往里一瞧，墙上立着几排结实的木钉架，每根木钉都标着编号，上头挂着一只上锁的鞍囊。一道精致锻造的铁栅将调度员与大厅其余区域隔开；一卷卷指令与讯息被缠紧后塞入他们身后墙体里蜂巢般的细小格槽中，像被分类收纳的秘密一样整齐排列。
Several fast-looking mounts, some still shiny with sweat from a hard ride, are tied to a post outside this messenger service. Peeking inside you can see several racks of stout pegs on the wall, each peg numbered and with a secured saddlebag hanging from it. A finely wrought iron grate separates the dispatcher from the rest of the lobby, orders and messages rolled up and inserted into a honeycomb of small cubbies built into the wall behind them.

Elemental Gem Of Emerald.name:
翡翠元素宝石
Elemental Gem Of Emerald

Text.text:
一枚体型与形状都如鸡蛋般的祖母绿散发着幽幽绿光。空心晶体内部，一团璀璨的液体缓缓旋转，自行流动。你细看时，里面的液体仿佛察觉到你的存在，啪嗒一声拍打着朝向你的那一侧，像是在寻求逃脱。
An emerald the size and shape of an egg glows with green light. A globule of brilliant liquid swirls around the interior of this hollow crystal, moving of its own accord. As you examine it, the liquid within seems to sense your presence, slopping against the side facing you as if seeking escape.

Lord’s Undead Post.name:
领主的亡灵哨站
Lord’s Undead Post

Text.text:
这间房里堆积如山的骨骸大多被推挤进阴暗的角落与西侧尽头的墙边，但仍有不少在烛光下散落开来，映出骸骨间锈蚀断裂的武器与护甲。有些骨架上还挂着几缕残破的布条，依稀可辨曾是上好的亚麻。大理石地砖上横卧着一扇为牢房打造的门。
Most of the bones piled in this room have been pushed into the dark corners and along the far western wall, but enough spill out under the candlelight to reveal rusted, broken weaponry and armor among the skeletons. Some are also adorned with shreds of what was once fine linen. On the marble tile lies a door made for a gaol.

Tournament On A Balmy Day.name:
暖日锦标赛
Tournament On A Balmy Day

Text.text:
千面旌旗在温润的风里翻飞，绚烂色彩皆镶着金边。草甸上帐篷如繁花铺展，千般色泽铺满视野，人们穿行其间，兴致勃勃地谈论着即将到来的赛事。乐声与欢笑弥漫四周，杂耍者与艺人轮番献技，引得人群连连喝彩。观众席骤然爆发出震天的崇敬欢呼，参赛者牵着骏马踏上洁净如新的沙场，面甲高抬，长枪高举。
A thousand pennants flutter in the balmy air, resplendent colors edged in gold. Tents in as many shades fill the meadow, and folk stroll between them, avidly discussing the events to come. Music and merriment fill the air, with jugglers and performers delighting the crowds. A roar of adoration bursts from spectators as the competitors walk their horses onto the pristine sand, visors raised, lances held high.

阴郁的林冠低垂，扭曲焦黑的树干托举其上，树身缠满乳白的蛛丝，如布如缕。几乎没有光能刺穿这片哀愁。大小蜘蛛在网间窜行，蛛网并未因无风的空气而颤动，却因阴影深处某个东西的移动而微微震颤。一只巨大臃肿的圆蛛，通体如虹彩黑曜石般幽亮，自黑暗中无声滑出。

它并非八眼蛛面的狰狞，而是一名双眼鬼婆的头颅与上身，獠牙外露，身披蛛网，仿佛无尽的白发垂落。她漆黑的眼睛一闪，嘶声作响。空地里无数蛛眼随她的目光齐齐转动，她伸出带钩的利爪，猛然扑上，尖啸着冲来。
Little light pierces the melancholy canopy borne aloft on twisted, blackened trunks wrapped in sheets and strands of milky silk. Spiders of all sizes scuttle amid the webs, which quiver not in the breathless air, but at the movement of something within the shadows among them. A huge, bloated cob spider the color of iridescent obsidian glides silently from the gloom. In place of the face of an eight-eyed arachnid, is the torso and head of a two-eyed hag, fanged and draped in webbing like endless white hair. Her black eyes flash, and she hisses. As the multitude of spider eyes in the clearing turn to follow her gaze, she reaches out her clawed hands and charges forward, shrieking.

I Trip My Foe With My Polearm.name:
我用长柄武器绊倒我的敌人
I Trip My Foe With My Polearm

Text.text:
敌人逼近。我用武器的头部朝他们脸上试探性地一记刺击，逼得他们把注意力锁在我身上——可还没等他们反应过来，我便滑步转身，顺势将武器的柄段扫进他们的脚背，撬得他们重心一歪，整个人踉跄着摔翻在地。
My enemy closes in. I take an experimental jab at their face with the head of my weapon to keep their attention—but before they can react, I slide and pivot the haft into their instep to throw them off balance and knock them sprawling.

Minotaur At The Door.name:
门前的牛头人
Minotaur At The Door

Text.text:
橡木门在抗议般的吱呀声中呻吟，你明知那具庞大的人形躯体正把那颗骇人的牛头狠狠顶进门板。粗大的黑角不知疲倦地猛刺坚实的木板，将其撕成飞溅的碎屑。用不了多久，它就会在这轮狂暴的冲撞下崩塌，让你与一头嗜血的人牛畸怪正面相对。
The oaken door creaks in protest as what you know to be an enormous humanoid body drives its horrific bovine head into it. Massive black horns relentlessly gore the sturdy wood planks into splinters. Soon it will collapse under the assault, leaving you face-to-face with a bloodthirsty man-bull abomination.

Hidden Opening In The Wall Leading To Se.name:
墙壁中的隐秘暗门，通往庄园的秘密通道
Hidden Opening In The Wall Leading To Secret Passage In A Manor

Text.text:
你面前的墙壁深处——某个地方——传来一声轻响，一块与周遭表面毫无二致的墙面板块悄然向后一缩，再滑到一侧。动静轻得几乎不可察，你甚至怀疑这块假墙板必定装在某种轨道的滚轮上，才能如此无声地移动。
Somewhere—deep within the wall before you—there is a click, and a section, indistinguishable from the surrounding surface, slides back and to one side. It is so quiet that you suspect the false wall panel must be situated on rollers in a track of some kind.

Magical Cat Litterbox.name:
魔法猫砂盆
Magical Cat Litterbox

Text.text:
猫儿懒洋洋地伸了个懒腰，从小木箱里钻出来，扭着腰穿过那对迷你酒馆式的小门——那既是猫砂盆的入口，也是出口。空气里响起一阵热切的嗡鸣，旋涡般的魔法光晕缠绕着箱体，随即它开始震颤——令人心惊。片刻后，木箱停止抖动，你发现刺鼻的秽物酸味已被怡人的薰衣草香取代——而里面的猫砂也再次洁净如新。

~ David on Discord

The cat stretches languidly as it leaves the small wooden box, sashaying through the tiny saloon doors that serve as both entrance and exit to the litterbox. A fervent hum fills the air as a swirling aura of magic surrounds the box and it begins to vibrate—alarmingly so. After a few moments, the box stops shaking, and you notice the acrid tang of waste has been replaced with a pleasing lavender scent—and the litter inside is clean again.

~ David on Discord

Q-bars Truth Serum.name:
Q条 真言血清
Q-bars Truth Serum

Text.text:
注射器里那股肮脏的黄液中漂浮着沉渣，多少能说明这药的“成色”。一张翘起剥落的标签上，潦草的字迹写着 Q-Bars Truth Serum，却压根没打算标明任何成分或制造者的来历。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The sediment floating in the dingy yellow liquid inside the syringe offers some indication of the drug’s quality. A peeling label, written in a scrawled hand, reads Q-Bars Truth Serum, though no attempt is made to list any of the ingredients or the manufacturer’s provenance.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Monstrous Undead Maggot Is Birthed.name:
可憎的亡灵蛆虫诞生了
Monstrous Undead Maggot Is Birthed

Text.text:
仪式完成后，空气在一团坏疽般的球体中微微颤动，随即以一声病态的噗响炸裂。恶臭的绿色液体倾泻而出。一条巨大的蠕虫肥硕而惨白，带着二十余条带钩的肢节，在洪流中舒展盘旋。它的前端，大小不一的眼睛密密麻麻地无睑凝视——就在一张圆形巨口上方；那口中层层獠牙参差如锯。怪物昂起身躯，体表鬃毛倒竖，浑身滴落着污秽的“产液”。它踉跄前冲、咕噜作响，利齿咯咯磨擦；骨头与泛绿的脓液从它口中一并倾倒而出。

~ 由 John Bagnoli 构想

The ritual complete, the air shimmers in a gangrenous sphere and bursts in a sickly pop. Foul green fluid pours out. A massive worm, fat and pale, with a score or more hooked limbs, uncoils in the flood. To its fore, numerous eyes of various sizes stare—lidless—from just above a round maw lined with rows of snaggled fangs. The monstrosity rears, bristling with hairs and dripping with its vile birth fluid. Its teeth gnash as it lurches and gurgles, and bones and green-tinged pus pour from its mouth.

~ Envisioned by John Bagnoli

Gossip Among Clerics.name:
牧师们的流言蜚语
Gossip Among Clerics

Text.text: “教义糟糕透顶，可跟你试着召唤一个简单的妖精之火时比起来，那简直就是小菜一碟——她总在你肩头后面低声呢喃：要是你搞砸了，她就往你的护甲里丢下五十只带毒的蜘蛛。天底下那么多女神，我偏偏选了她，你说呢？” “The doctrine is bad enough, but that’s a cakewalk compared to when you’re trying to conjure a simple faerie fire and She keeps whispering over your shoulder that if you mess up, She’ll drop fifty poisonous spiders into your armor. Of all the goddesses I could have chosen, you know?”

Baroque Dark Fantasy Setting.name:
巴洛克式黑暗奇幻设定
Baroque Dark Fantasy Setting

Text.text:
这场盛宴宛如一幅奢华的贵族荣光肖像。天鹅绒紧身上衣与荷叶边长裙缀满宝石，流光溢彩。狐般的微笑染着紫罗兰色的酒渍，镂花酒杯里新斟的葡萄酒再度盈满。烤乳猪与八目鳗在长桌上油光发亮，汁水淌入银盘，漫过苍白细瘦的蔬菜。一支弦乐四重奏在喧嚣中奏响——匆促的旋律绷紧不安，阴沉得像预兆。果然，当管家戴着手套的手又启开一瓶起泡酒时，街上炮声与火绳枪齐鸣。越过这层闪烁的奢靡帷幕，下层民众正被贫穷与瘟疫撕扯折磨。农民的哭喊是为了食物与救济，商人行会则为自由市场鼓噪，而眼下的秩序正被少数幸运儿牢牢攥住。在这不义世界的阴暗角落里，关于真正、有组织的抗力的低语回荡不息。你要为受压迫者发声，还是与上流阶层一同沉溺于他们毫不遮掩的纵乐之中？
The gala is a sumptuous portrait of aristocratic splendor. Velvet doublets and frilled dresses gleam with gems. Vulpine smiles are stained violet, as wine swells anew in filigreed goblets. Roasted sows and hagfish glisten on banquet tables, their juices pooling in silver platters over pale, spindly vegetables. A string quartet plays—a harried melody amid the revelry, tense and foreboding. Indeed, as the gloved hand of a butler pops open another bottle of sparkling wine, cannons and arquebuses fire in the streets. Beyond the glimmering, opulent veil, the lower classes suffer the throes of poverty and plague. The cries of the peasantry are for food and succor, while merchant guilds clamor for a free market currently ruled by a fortunate few. Whispers of a true, organized resistance echo in the dark corners of this iniquitous world. Do you advocate for the downtrodden, or do you join the elite in their unabashed indulgence?

Temple To A God Of Music.name:
献给音乐之神的神殿
Temple To A God Of Music

Text.text:
这座奉献给音乐的神殿本身就是一座圆形露天剧场。礼拜者被邀请坐在环绕阶段的层层座席上：那是一座祭坛，赞颂音乐之神的歌声便在此献演。高耸的贝壳形后殿里，供着一尊深色抛光木雕的神像——一位仪态尊贵的男子怀抱竖琴。环绕露天剧场的柱廊步道上，风铃、弦线、空心芦管、填石的葫芦、锣与鼓皮悬挂在柱间，任由入会者、来访者，甚至穿堂的风随兴拨弄奏响。
The temple devoted to music is an amphitheater. Worshipers are invited to sit in the tiers of seats surrounding the stage: an altar where songs are performed in praise of the god of music. A towering shell-shaped apse houses a graven image of the god in dark, polished wood—a man of regal bearing cradling a lyre. Along the colonnaded walkway surrounding the amphitheater, chimes, strings, hollow reeds, stone-filled gourds, gongs, and drum skins are suspended between the columns, to be played at whim by initiates, visitors, or even the wind.

Arcane Casting Of Light.name:
奥术光辉施放
Arcane Casting Of Light

Text.text:
你在身前以魔杖划出一个小小的圆，命令它发光。杖尖先是迸出火花，随即燃成一粒耀眼的银色光点。随着你低声吟诵，这点光芒膨胀成一颗冰冷的白色光球，亮度不亚于任何火把。清冽的光辉充盈你周围的区域。
