You wave your wand in a small circle before you, commanding it to shine. The tip sparks, then burns into a point of luminous silver. As you incant, this mote grows into an orb of cold, white light as bright as any torch. Cool luminance fills the area around you.

Yves Altheim.name:
伊夫斯·阿尔特海姆
Yves Altheim

Text.text:
这位衣着考究的半身人身穿灰色燕尾服、糖果条纹马甲、黑色马裤，嘴角挂着一抹无忧无虑的笑。他那铜褐色的眼睛在与外套同色的高礼帽阴影下闪着光。一条黑色、带纹样的丝绸领巾系住领口，优雅地 tucked 进他的马甲里；银色纽扣与饰边把整体细致地收拢在一起。尽管他圆润的身形将这套衣服撑得鼓鼓的，却没有一处显得紧绷。他手持一根华丽的乌木手杖，两端皆以银饰包头，木纹里有细小的符文微微发光。

~ Played by Saylon

This dapper halfling wears a gray tailcoat, a candy-striped vest, black breeches, and a carefree grin. His copper-brown eyes gleam under a top hat that matches his jacket. A cravat of black, patterned silk ties his collar and tucks elegantly into his waistcoat, and silver buttons and accents tie everything together. None seem strained, despite how his round form fills out his suit. He carries an ornate ebony walking stick, capped in silver on both ends, with tiny runes glowing in the wood.

~ Played by Saylon

Sacrificial Hall With Blood Gutters.name:
带血槽的献祭大厅
Sacrificial Hall With Blood Gutters

Text.text:
排水沟沿着地面蜿蜒汇入大厅中央，沟槽被鲜血染透——那血来自六间用以献祭的密室。密室皆为圆形，大厅两侧各三间。每间密室的地面都是一件以血绘成的艺术品：繁复的刻纹引导血液汇聚成特定的图案，再让它沿着纹路流出。一块主排水沟的砖石从房间中心延伸，通向尽头的一扇门。那扇门夹立在两尊高耸、压迫感十足的黑玉与缟玛瑙蛇像之间。

~ Envisioned by LORD_BUMBLE

Gutters run through the floor to the center of the hall, their trenches stained with blood from six chambers where sacrifices are made. The chambers are circular, three on each side of the hall. Each chamber’s floor is an object of art painted in blood, with intricate carvings that collect the blood in a pattern before it travels out. A main gutter tile runs from the room’s center toward a door at one end. The door stands between tall, imposing serpent statues of jet and onyx.

~ Envisioned by LORD_BUMBLE

Plague In A City.name:
城市瘟疫
Plague In A City

Text.text:
城里的街道被人潮塞得水泄不通，活人和死人一同挤占着排水沟、门阶与小巷。你穿行其间，他们灰白的面孔在你身侧漂浮，拉长而哀伤，像融化的彩绘肖像。近处传来一阵湿漉漉的咳嗽，震得人心发颤。人群在肇事者周围起伏翻涌，如同鱼群为避开鲨鱼而猛然偏转。你顺着那股驱离的波浪被推开，来到广场。那里，一处护士站占据了城市奠基者雕像周围的小花园。他们把肮脏的破布、沾血的器械与病患一股脑堆在石像脚下。
The city streets are crammed with people, the living and the dead occupying gutters, stoops, and alleys. As you pass through the crowd, their ashen faces float about you, drawn long and sorrowful like painted portraits melting. A wet cough rattles close by. The crowd undulates around the perpetrator, as a school of fish might swerve to avoid a shark. You follow the deterring wave away and arrive at the square. There, a nurse station has taken over the small garden surrounding the statue of the city’s founder. They pile dirty rags, bloody tools, and patients at the stone figure’s feet.

Shortbow And Arrows.name:
短弓与箭矢
Shortbow And Arrows

Text.text:
这把弓几乎只是为箭矢雕出的一个设定，弧线蜿蜒，将其框住。握把包着皮革与毛皮，弓弦以生皮绞成，昭示它属于一名骑射手。短杆、锥形穿甲箭头的箭矢，安放在一只朴素的腰间箭袋里——布料织就袋身，底部是柳条编成的筐底。
This bow is little more than a carved setting for an arrow, framed in curves. It has a leather and fur grip and rawhide string, implying its ownership by a cavalry archer. Short-shafted, bodkin-headed arrows sit in a simple belt quiver of cloth woven to a wicker bottom.

老水手们称它们为“鲸杀手”。每一头身上的黑白花纹都像人类指纹一样独一无二。它们的家族有各自专属的猎杀战术，代代相传。虎鲸——又名逆戟鲸——是唯一能让大白鲨都心生畏惧的动物。此刻，你就看见这样一名老练的猎手：它的背鳍破水而出，划开水面。
Old sailors call them “whale killers.” Each one’s black-and-white pattern is as unique as a human fingerprint. Their families have specific hunting tactics, passed down through generations. Killer whales, or orcas, are the only animal to scare the great white shark. You spot one of these practiced hunters now, its fin breaking the surface of the water.

那些生物在黑暗中如同一体般行动，月光倾泻而下，为它们蓝绿的鳞片镀上一层银辉。华丽的鳍冠自头顶竖起，带爪的蹼手紧握着粗陋却致命的武器——棍棒、长矛与三叉戟。它们一边彼此咕哝低语，一边随潮水涌起，动作迅疾而无声，武器始终蓄势待发。为首者几乎有七英尺高，他发出的命令无需翻译：杀。
The creatures move as one in the darkness, moonlight bathing their blue-green scales in silver. Elaborate fins crest their heads, and clawed, webbed hands clutch crude but effective weapons—clubs, spears, and tridents. They chatter with one another as they rise with the tide, moving quickly and quietly, weapons at the ready. The leader, standing nearly seven feet tall, issues an order that needs no translation: kill.

Elven Village At The Height Of Spring.name:
春意正浓的精灵村庄
Elven Village At The Height Of Spring

Text.text:
你面前是一座精灵村落，春日繁花点缀着每一户人家。大自然的调色盘在此泼洒出鲜活的生命，织就一片和谐的斑斓色彩，而笑声随温暖的微风轻快起舞。屋舍与森林共生相融，仿佛这族群与林地王国之间深植的森灵羁绊在眼前具象成形。
Before you lies an elven village, spring blossoms gracing every home. Nature’s palette paints vibrant life here, creating a harmony of colors while laughter dances on the warm breeze. The homes blend symbiotically with the forest, a manifestation of the sylvan bond the species has with the woodland realm.

A Clear Night In The Forest.name:
森林里的澄澈之夜
A Clear Night In The Forest

Text.text:
你伫立在森林里一片草地的边缘。繁星点点的夜空在头顶铺展开来，黑暗的夜幕深处洒满璀璨微光。月亮则是这一切的中心——一枚明亮的银白圆盘，将林间空地笼进柔和而令人安心的辉光之中。
You stand at the edge of a meadow in the forest. The starry sky stretches out above you, a beautiful array of glimmering lights in the dark expanse of night. The moon is the centerpiece of it all, a shining orb that casts the clearing in a soft and comforting glow.

Nearby Vehicle Explodes Into Flames.name:
附近的车辆轰然爆裂，瞬间化作火海
Nearby Vehicle Explodes Into Flames

Text.text:
毫无预兆，附近一辆敞篷跑车猛然爆成冲天火海。震耳欲聋的巨响轰然炸开，爆炸将车头盖掀飞，旋转着抛上空中。四周灌木随之燃起，连路面都被炙热灼得焦黑。燃烧的橡胶与机油气味几乎令人窒息。车身飞快褪去原本的色泽，化作一具焦黑燃烧的残骸。一只轮胎滚过，仍在着火，拖出一条乌黑、黏滞的热痕。
Without warning, a nearby roadster erupts into a towering inferno. A great, deafening boom rockets out, and the explosion throws the hood of the car spinning into the air. Surrounding bushes catch alight; the very pavement is scorched with the heat. The smell of flaming rubber and oil is almost unbearable. The vehicle is very quickly losing its color, turning into a blackened, flaming husk. A tire rolls past, still afire, leaving a trail of black, muddy heat.

Anti-anxiety Street Drug, “Zone”.name:
抗焦虑街头毒品——“Zone”
Anti-anxiety Street Drug, “Zone”

Text.text:
这些青绿的含片呈菱形，一面压着醒目的大写 Z。它们比寻常的抗焦虑药更猛；一旦吞服，便让血清素如洪流般灌入大脑，恐惧此后几乎毫无胜算——就像篝火挡在溃坝的激流前。即便正陷在惊恐之中，它们也照样起效，把使用者拉回状态，心神聚拢，专注起来，准备把活儿干完。

~ 一位英雄所 构想

These turquoise lozenges sport a capital Z stamped on one side. More potent than your average anti-anxiety meds, these lozenges flood the brain with serotonin when ingested; after that, fear stands about as much chance as a campfire in the path of a burst dam. They work even in the midst of panic, getting the user back in the zone, focused, and ready to get the job done.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

一座高耸的圆形石砌建筑矗立在眼前。正面伸出一根粗壮的横梁，其上装着巨大的叶片般臂翼，由格栅木架制成，边缘衬着亚麻。它们随风缓缓转动，每转过一圈便发出轻柔的吱呀声。建筑底部是一扇结实的木门，顶端则有一扇小窗，俯瞰着四周的土地。
A tall, round stone building towers above. From the front protrudes a thick beam with large blade-like arms made of latticed wood lined with linen. They spin slowly with the wind, creaking softly with each rotation. At the foot sits a sturdy wooden door and at the top a small window peering out over the surrounding land.

Intimidation From A Magic User About For.name:
来自魔法使用者对禁忌魔法的恐吓
Intimidation From A Magic User About Forbidden Magic

Text.text:
“凡是挡在我路上的人，都已化作蒸汽，被活活焚烧，或被扭曲成各式各样令人作呕的形态。然而，即便在我最绝望之时，也有些咒文骇人到连我都不敢宣之于口。可你……你正逼得我几乎要破例。”
“Those who have stood in my way have been vaporized, burned alive, and twisted into all manner of disturbing forms. Yet, even at my most desperate there were incantations too horrific to utter. But you… you are bringing me very close to making an exception.”

Transformation Into Werewolf.name:
变身为狼人
Transformation Into Werewolf

Text.text:
他们的眼中闪过野兽般狡黠的寒光，随即猛地伏身四肢着地，身形扭曲。骨骼噼啪作响，又滑移归位。血肉重新塑形。它的嘴大张，嘶吼里夹杂着人类的尖叫与狼的长嗥，面孔被拉长，化作突出的吻部。粗硬的毛发在全身疯长，生物的双手也随之拉伸，变成带爪的前掌。一条尾巴破体而出。方才还站着一个人的地方，此刻只剩一头巨狼龇出獠牙，喉间滚出低沉而充满威胁的咆哮。
Their eyes flash with a bestial cunning just before they drop down to all fours, contorting. Bones crack then slide into place. Flesh reshapes itself. Their mouth gapes in a mingling of human scream and wolf's howl, and their face elongates into a snout. Coarse fur grows across their body as the creature's hands elongate into clawed paws. A tail sprouts. Where a moment before stood a person, a massive wolf now bares its fangs and emits a low, threatening growl.

Harken Hall In Winter.name:
冬日的哈肯大厅
Harken Hall In Winter

Text.text:
沿着这座庄园猩红的石质城垛与高塔向下望去，黑色挂毯如泪水般垂流。入口附近，一名身披蓝衣的守卫端坐马上，银盔下的目光冷冷扫过每一个经过的人。肃穆的装饰上看不见任何徽章，仿佛那居于其中的显赫家族刻意抹去了自己的标记。穿过外墙敞开的城门进入庭院，裹着冬季厚外套、穿着结实靴子的工人们忙着修补被雪摧折的建筑，清理道路上的泥雪，清点物资；一辆辆装满货物的摇晃推车吱呀作响地滚入庄园。你听见高墙深处传来呜咽的回声——沉重而刺痛的哭声，是真正绝望之人的哀恸。庭院里的工人们果然个个神色阴郁，脸庞低垂，泪水在面颊上结出霜痕。
Down the red stone ramparts and towers of this estate, black tapestries stream like tears. A guard garbed in blue sits on horseback near the entrance, eyeing from under a silver helm all who pass. The somber decoration displays no coat of arms to represent the great family that resides within. Through the open gate of the outer wall and into the courtyard, laborers bundled in winter coats and sturdy boots attend to the business of mending snow-beaten structures, clearing pathways of slush, and taking inventory as wobbly carts full of goods roll into the estate. You hear the sound of sobbing echoing from beyond the high walls that lead deeper into the fortress—the heavy and painful kind of weeping of someone in true despair. The laborers in the courtyard indeed bear sullen expressions, faces drawn low and tears frosted on their cheeks.

Shadow Plane Penetrates The Faerie Plane.name:
暗影位面刺穿妖精位面
Shadow Plane Penetrates The Faerie Plane

Text.text:
朦胧的骷髅影像消散开来，污黑的黏血随之蔓延，黑暗浓稠得近乎绝对，仿佛将周遭的光都吞饮殆尽。树木倾倒，草木枯萎，你的四周尘土与灰烬翻卷成旋。阴影之手自传送门中探出，攫住岩石，拖拽着自己向前爬行，继而如饥渴的野兽般在大地上蜿蜒滑行，迫不及待要将光明溺毙。
The shadowy skull dissipates and its ichor spreads, the darkness so absolute that it seems to drink in the light around it. Trees topple, plants wither, and all around you, dust and ash swirl. Shadowy hands emerge from the portal, grasping rocks as they heave themselves forward to slither across the landscape like hungering beasts, eager to drown the light.

你吐出咒言，一层蓝宝石般的帷幕自你所在之处扩张开来。在这道法术的浸染中，你感到治疗能量如清凉的海风般轻柔漫过你的面庞。你在光晕内选中的任何人都不由挺直身躯，神色随之舒缓——伤口合拢，断骨复位，淤青消退。

~ 构想：Kyrus (Brent)

You speak the words, evoking a sapphire veil that dilates from your position. Awash in this spell, you feel healing energy softly flood your face like a cool ocean breeze. Anyone you choose within the aura stands taller, their faces easing as cuts close, bones set, and bruises fade.

~ Envisioned by Kyrus (Brent)

Enthusiastic Promoter From Casino Ship.name:
赌场船的热情推销员
Enthusiastic Promoter From Casino Ship

Text.text: 一名身着艳俗刺眼服饰的推销员带着满溢的狂喜蹦跳着冲到你面前。还没等你开口抗议，他们就把票券听啪地在你眼前挥舞——拍胸脯保证登上Starlight Casino，你将迎来这片银河系里最棒的时代。越过这份浮夸的烦扰，你看到还有许多同类在四周游荡，用同样的诱人许诺纠缠着过往行人。 A promoter dressed in garishly bright attire bounds up to you with exuberant glee. Before you can protest, they wave tickets in your face—promising the best time this side of the galaxy aboard the Starlight Casino. Beyond the flamboyant annoyance you see many others of their ilk, haranguing passers-by with similar offers.

Overheard Orc Conversation About Love.name:
偷听到的兽人关于爱情的对话
Overheard Orc Conversation About Love

Text.text:
“——可我生来就是为了征服，为了让敌人的热血溅在我脸上、感受那份温热。我该到哪里去寻找爱呢？”
“—but I was made to conquer, to feel the warmth of my enemy’s blood on my face. How am I supposed to find love?”

I Buff My Hacking Attributes.name:
我强化我的黑客属性
I Buff My Hacking Attributes

Text.text:
我引导精神能量，双眼如隧道般钻入数据洪流；四周景象逐渐褪色，视野里只剩下文字与数字。每一行都在脑海中被解析、归档得井井有条，所有可能的结果都被逐一盘点、预先备好。没有任何一个角色能逃过我的注意。

~ 一位英雄所设想

I channel my mental energy as my eyes tunnel into the stream of data, the surroundings fading away as my vision fills with nothing but text and numbers. Each line is processed and sorted neatly in my mind, every possible outcome accounted and prepared for. Not a single character slips past my attention.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Divine Den Of A God Of Corruption.name:
堕落邪神的神圣巢穴
Divine Den Of A God Of Corruption

Text.text:
在一片盐碱地上的废弃谷仓外，停着那辆把你们载来此处的华美马车，华贵得格格不入。马已解下缰具，正低头饮水。车厢内陈设精致得近乎完美：软榻成排，金桌上摆着盛满珍馐与醇饮的玻璃托盘，一条修长的吧台，昂贵的地毯与挂毯，以及用于联络的通讯宝珠。车尾墙是嵌铅彩玻璃，可它映出的却不是荒凉的田地，而是一座熠熠生辉的城市。几只小箱与布袋被钱币的重量撑裂，碎口大张，金色的圆片四散一地。空气里，你忽然嗅到一丝腐烂尸体的臭味。
Outside an abandoned granary on a salted field sits the beautiful carriage that brought you, positively out of place. The horses are unhitched and drinking. Inside is a perfectly decorated arrangement of divans, glass trays of rich food and drink on golden tables, a long bar, expensive rugs and tapestries, and orbs of communication. The back wall is leaded glass, but instead of the barren field it shows a gleaming city. Small chests and bags, split open by the weight of gold coins, litter the room. In the air, you catch a whiff of a rotten corpse.

Welcoming Tabaxi Village.name:
欢迎来到塔巴希村落
Welcoming Tabaxi Village

Text.text:
旧路穿过一座低矮的石砌门楼，顶上是带垛口的步道。几名猫族弓手在上方挥手示意，下方的门洞敞开无阻。门外是一座村落，扎根于林地之上，也攀附在参天巨树的枝桠之间。穿过门楼不远，道旁便排开一列商贩摊位，彩色帆布棚顶连成一线，商人们高声叫卖或招手揽客。摊上货物琳琅，从珠宝与衣装到杂货与鲜食一应俱全。好奇的猫族孩童在摊间穿梭徘徊，长辈们则忙着谈价做买卖。猎人拿着新近猎获讨价还价，披着皮甲的武者在一旁磨亮刀刃，铁匠铺里甲匠的铁锤声叮当作响。

~ Envisioned by Silent

The old road runs through a low stone gatehouse with a parapeted walkway atop. There, catfolk archers wave, the gate below standing open. Beyond spreads a village built on the forest floor and among the branches of great trees. Merchant stalls with colorful canvas roofs are arrayed along the road just past the gateway, their traders calling out or beckoning. They hawk wares from jewelry and clothing to sundries and fresh food. Curious catfolk children mill around as their elders do business. Hunters barter with their recent kills, and leather-clad warriors sharpen their blades as an armorer’s hammer rings.

~ Envisioned by Silent

Hometown In Flames.name:
故乡陷入烈焰
Hometown In Flames

Text.text:
你追随着那条翻涌的黑云尾迹前行，直到它吞没整片天空，遮断天穹之光，仿佛你真的坠入了某个恶魔的深坑。空气向你逼近，蜿蜒着钻入你的喉咙。鼻腔干涩，只剩灼烧的气味。你身处曾经的家园——如今却被不知疲倦的火舌占据，血一般猩红，吞噬着房屋、田野……你听见尖叫刺穿烈焰的魔性咆哮；那些你曾熟悉的声音此刻挣扎嘶嚎。躯体被火焰缠裹，头颅戴着焰冠般的盛装，他们张大的面孔融化成难以辨识的猩红与乌黑的残痕。

~ 一位英雄 Envisioned

You follow the billowing trail of black clouds until they have overtaken the sky, blocking out the light of the heavens so that it now truly feels like you’ve descended into some devil’s pit. The air closes in around you, snaking into your throat. Your nose is parched, filled with nothing but the scent of burning. You are in the place that was once your home—a place now claimed by unrelenting tongues of fire, red as blood, consuming the buildings, the fields… You hear screaming pierce through the conflagration’s demonic roar; voices you once knew now thrash and shriek. Bodies wreathed and heads crowned in regalia of flame, their gaping faces melt away into incomprehensible streaks of crimson and jet black.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

一颗名为pallone的小白球，像高尔夫球却更光滑，静静躺在两名玩家前方约四十英尺处的夯实土道上。每名玩家手里都握着一颗结实的球，大小如葡萄柚。其一缓缓迈出一步，轻抛出一颗蓝球；它轻轻一跳后滚行，停在离pallone约一英尺处。另一名玩家掷出红球，红球撞上蓝球猛然弹开——把它击退数英尺——自己则停在离那颗小小白色目标球仅几英寸的地方。
A small white ball called the pallone, like a golf ball but smooth, sits about forty feet in front of the two players on a stretch of packed earth. Each player holds a solid grapefruit-sized ball in one hand. One of them takes a slow step forward and pitches a blue ball. After one soft bounce it rolls and stops about a foot from the pallone. The other player pitches a red ball, which ricochets off the blue one—knocking it several feet—and stops inches from the little white target ball.

Ezregar Greymoon.name:
埃兹雷加尔·灰月
Ezregar Greymoon

Text.text:
人们说，千万别低估一个熬到中年的战士——就像眼前这位。他目光如铁，正衬那双钢蓝色的眼睛。寸短的白发贴着头皮，皮肤被日晒磨成古铜，岁月与旧伤在其上刻出一道道纹路。可他身形依旧高大，肩背宽阔如门。护甲是正统骑士式样，板片满是伤痕，却被细心上油保养，并以金色饰边点亮冷硬的光。腰侧挂着皮套战锤，背后背着一面被利刃啃咬过的风筝盾。他牵着一匹同样强壮、同样银亮的战马。

~ 由 EZ Played

They say never underestimate a warrior who’s made it to middle age—like this one. His steely look matches his steel-blue eyes. His close-cropped hair is white, his skin tanned and lined by time and old wounds. But he’s great in stature and broad in shoulder. His armor is knightly, plates scarred but oiled and accented in gold. At his side he has a holstered warhammer, and on his back, a blade-bitten kite shield. He leads a courser as mighty and silvery as he.

~ Played by EZ

Trading Post In Marshlands.name:
沼泽地的贸易站
Trading Post In Marshlands

Text.text:
一堆堆夯实的湿泥在沼泽间垒成小径，通向一座宽阔的土丘。干燥的隆起之上，矗立着一处院落，外圈用一排东倒西歪、覆满苔藓的粗陋木栅围起。墙上敞开的门洞，以及倾斜木桩之间的空隙，露出里面一片破败的建筑群——焦黑的木料、泥巴与莎草茅顶拼凑而成。无数细小的生灵在村落周遭啼鸣、低叫与嗡嗡作响，声浪回荡，仿佛应和着主入口内侧露天集市里熙攘的顾客与商贩的叫卖与交易。

~ Envisioned by Zayne Vos

Mounds of packed wet earth form paths to a broad hill amid the swamp. On this dry rise stands a compound enclosed by a ramshackle, moss-covered palisade. Open gates in the wall, and gaps between its leaning posts, reveal a collection of dilapidated structures built of blackened wood, mud, and sedge thatch. Countless tiny beasts call, hoot, and buzz around the village. They echo the myriad customers and merchants trading in an open market just inside the main entrance.

~ Envisioned by Zayne Vos

The Vampire Queen Awakens.name:
吸血鬼女王苏醒
The Vampire Queen Awakens

Text.text:
阴影从陵寝门下悄然爬出，沿着地面越拉越长。震耳欲聋的喧嚣在你周遭回荡——厚重的石块彼此碾磨的声响。随后，仿佛被一双巨魔（特征）那般粗壮多肉的手猛然推开，陵寝大门在尘雾翻卷中轰然洞开。尘埃渐散，一道纤细身影迎面走来，黑色缎面长裙如夜色披身。猩红的唇在她无瑕肌肤的死白之上格外刺目。她额前戴着一顶黑铁王冠，细工仿若轻薄蕾丝，中央镶嵌着一枚硕大的血石，压在吸血鬼（特征）女王的眉间。她伸出手，做出欢迎的姿态，可你仍不由自主地打了个寒颤——那抹笑意的残酷美丽，令人心悸。

~ Envisioned by Radiant

Shadows creep out from beneath the crypt’s doors, lengthening along the surface of the ground. An incredible din echoes around you—one heavy stone grinding against another. Then, as if pushed by the meaty hands of a troll, the crypt’s doors bang open in a cloud of dust. As it begins to clear, a slender form enrobed in a black satin gown comes forward. Crimson lips stand out in contrast to the deathlike pallor of her flawless skin. Crafted to resemble delicate lace, a black iron tiara sits upon the vampire queen’s brow, a single large bloodstone set in its center. She extends a hand in a welcoming gesture, but you cannot help but shiver at the cruel beauty of her smile.

~ Envisioned by Radiant

Central Forge Of A Dwarfhold.name:
矮人堡垒的中央熔炉
Central Forge Of A Dwarfhold

Text.text:
中央熔炉矗立在矮人堡的心脏地带——一座穹顶般的庞然建筑，由布满坑蚀的石块垒成，随热浪与光辉低沉震颤。内部岩浆灼亮如炽橙，驱动着大师铁匠的造物；他们围着熔炉，俯身于一圈圈漆黑的砧台上挥锤劳作。砧声如雷、矮人的吼喊与扑面而来的热浪，会让不习惯这种环境的人几近窒息。可即便如此，熔炉仍将温暖与光明送往四方，照亮并烘热整座周边的矮人堡。
The central forge stands at the heart of the dwarfhold, a looming dome-shaped structure of pitted stone that thrums with heat and light. Magma glows a searing orange within, fueling the creations of the master smiths who toil over black anvils encircling the forge. The ringing anvils, shouting dwarves, and buffeting heat overwhelms those not accustomed to the environment. But despite the intensity, the forge provides warmth and light to the entire surrounding dwarfhold.

苍白的椭圆眼眸瞳孔巨大，分列于鱼形头颅两侧。生物松弛如皮革的皮肤在鳃部与脊背附近渐变为零星细小的鳞片。尽管与水栖生活有着明显的联系，他们却以双足行走；除去长着鳍膜的脚趾——每根脚趾末端都生着一枚沉重的利爪——其余四肢与人类几无二致。
Pale, ovular eyes with large pupils sit on either side of a fish-shaped head. The creature's loose, leathery skin transitions to small patchy scales around their gills and spine. Despite clear ties to aquatic life, they are bipedal, and with the exception of finned toes with a hefty claw on each one, their appendages are similar to those of humans.

Wagon Journey: In The Driver’s Seat.name:
马车之旅：执缰者之位
Wagon Journey: In The Driver’s Seat

Text.text:
马车在马匹小跑前行时一路颠簸摇晃，但你已在旅途上走了许久，早已习惯了这种移动。无需再盯着路面、提前预判那些坑洼颠簸，你便有了时代从容欣赏沿途风景，聆听鸟儿的歌唱。
The wagon jostles and bumps as the horses trot forward, but having been on the road for a while you’ve grown accustomed to the movement. Without feeling the need to watch the road and anticipate its rough spots, you have the time to take in the view and listen to the birds sing.

Legless Ghoul Trap.name:
无腿食尸鬼陷阱
Legless Ghoul Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 前方，你看见一具尸体瘫靠在墙边，嘴巴大张，里面塞满腐烂的褐色残牙。那可怜的家伙双腿在膝处被齐齐截断，干涸的血迹在周围地面上晕开，投下一片暗红如影的污痕。腐败的恶臭辛辣地灼烧着你的鼻腔，苍蝇在尸身上嗡嗡盘旋。

[发现] 食尸鬼猛扑向你，贪婪地咯咯咬合着牙齿，伴着原始暴怒的尖啸，伸出带爪的血手抓来。然而你仍在危险的触及之外，那生物只能徒劳挣扎，被拴在墙上的锁链死死束缚。

[触发] 你醒悟得太晚——尸体的真面目，正是在它一把攫住你手臂的瞬间。猩红的眼睛因饥渴而骤然亮起，食尸鬼以骇人的速度向你扑来，试图将牙齿深深嵌入温热的活肉之中。

[Perceived] Up ahead, you see a body slumped against the wall, its mouth agape and filled with rotten brown teeth. The poor soul’s legs have been severed at the knee, and dried blood stains the floor around them in a dark crimson shadow. The rancid musk of decay burns your nostrils as flies buzz around the cadaver.

[Discovered] The ghoul lunges at you, gnashing its teeth hungrily as it screeches with primal rage and reaches out with clawed, bloody hands. However, you are safely out of harm's reach, and the creature thrashes ineffectually at the chains binding it to the wall.

[Triggered] Too late you realize the corpse’s true nature—just as it grabs your arm. Red eyes alight with ravenous hunger flick open and the ghoul lunges for you with terrifying speed, trying to sink its teeth into warm, living flesh.

Aeon Stone Network.name:
永劫灵石网络
Aeon Stone Network

Text.text:
一阵由跳动的石块组成的风旋在你面前翻涌。那些晶体完美得不可思议，形制精准，绕着一个看不见的中心轨道般旋转，汇成一股由璀璨宝石构成的龙卷。透明的棱锥晶柱、金色的结节、以及诡异的薰紫与翠绿晶格充斥空中。宝石之间，细小的能量噼啪迸灭——仿佛这团群簇正在彼此交流。
A wind of pulsing stones swirls before you. Impossibly perfect, these precisely shaped crystals orbit an invisible center, making up a tornado of glittering gems. Clear spindles, golden nodules, and strange lattices of lavender and green fill the air. Between the gems, small energies fizzle—as though the swarm is communicating among itself.

许多城市里常见的粗陋贫民窟在这里完全不见踪影。取而代之的，是你目之所及皆为精心打造、赏心悦目的建筑。越过屋顶，你瞥见一座座高挑而雅致的结构，栋栋独具一格，尽显美丽。如此怡人的氛围，只能源自代代相传的根源：建造之时皆用心谨慎。
The slipshod slums common to many cities are nowhere in sight. Instead, everywhere you look you see carefully crafted constructions designed to be pleasing to the eye. Over their rooftops you spy tall and elegant structures, each unique and beautiful. Such a pleasing atmosphere can only come from a tradition of generations taking care in how they build.

Cyberpunk Throne Room.name:
赛博朋克王座厅
Cyberpunk Throne Room

Text.text:
墙上垂挂的破碎显示器滴落着火花，洒在霉斑遍布的地面上那堆散落的科技残骸之间；空气里充斥着獠牙巨口的咔哒啁啾声。南侧一座阶梯式高台上，一张废金属拼成的王座傲然矗立。

~ 摘自 PaizoConOnline 2023

Broken monitors hanging on the walls drip sparks over the technological detritus littering the mold-stained floor, and the air is filled with the chattering of fanged maws. A throne of scrap metal sits proudly upon a stepped dais to the south.

~ from PaizoConOnline 2023

一片由不规则石块铺就的露台呈新月形展开，七具石棺如同从新月弧上放射而出。每具棺形石盖上都刻着铭文，唯独那一具——仿佛整座墓园都围绕它而建——沉默无字。其棺盖雕着一柄巨剑，剑柄在首端，剑尖指向足端。新月两角与剑尖之间的地面嵌着一块石碑，刻着此纪念碑所为之建立之人的名字：德里昂，愿他的剑与他的牺牲永不再被需要。 A patio of irregular stones forms a crescent from which seven sarcophagi radiate. Each coffin-shaped lid of stone bears an inscription, except for the one about which this whole cemetery seems to be structured. Its lid bears the carving of a huge sword, hilt at the head and point at the feet. A stone plaque set in the ground between the horns of the crescent and the sword’s point gives name to the person for whom this monument was built: Derion, may his sword and his sacrifice never again be needed.

那纤细的人形身影，乍看像一堆拖沓挪动的破布——鼠咬般残烂，散着令人作呕的臭味。一条伸出的肢体，皮肤呈黯淡的蓝灰色，缓缓掀开破碎的兜帽，露出一张矮人般的面孔：惨白的眼珠斜睨含笑，银色的胡须与头发纠缠成一绺，胡乱编在一起，勉强装作整洁。霉腐的气息自这怪异的生物身上逸散，它轻巧掠入黑暗，仿佛由阴影托生，随即与影子融为一体。

~ 一位英雄 设想

The slight, humanoid figure appears at first as a shambling pile of ratty, foul-smelling rags. An outstreched limb, the skin a muted blue-gray, peels back a tattered cowl to reveal a dwarf-like visage with leering white eyes and a scraggle of silver beard and hair, haphazardly braided together in a poor semblance of tidiness. A musty smell emanates from the strange creature as it flits into the darkness, melding with the shadows as if borne from them.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Leomund's Secret Chest.name:
李欧蒙的秘藏箱
Leomund's Secret Chest

Text.text:
当箱子合拢并扣紧，你得以细细端详其金丝镶嵌与嵌入的宝石——几乎让人不忍将它封藏于不见天日之处。可你仍将一只手按在箱上，另一只手握着与之相对的那件东西：一枚完美的微缩复制品。你低吟咒文，声音如蛛丝般飘渺，同时在大箱盖上描画奥秘符号——随即，伴着仿佛绢帛被撕裂的声响，箱子消失无踪，遁入以太位面。
When the chest is closed and latched, you have an opportunity to admire its gold inlay and embedded jewels—it seems almost a shame to immure it out of sight. Nevertheless, you place one hand upon the chest, and hold in your other hand its counterpart: a perfect miniature replica. Your incantation wafts like gossamer as you draw arcane symbols over the larger chest’s lid—then, with a sound like tearing silk, the chest vanishes into the ethereal plane.

Moon Over Still Water, Elven Druid.name:
静水之上月影流转，精灵德鲁伊
Moon Over Still Water, Elven Druid

Text.text:
这名高挑纤瘦的女子，肌肤苍白得如同雪花石膏般半透明。那肤色、尖尖的耳朵与宁静的神情，共同织出一种超脱尘世的气息。她的头发乌黑如夜，与那近乎发光的肤色形成鲜明对照。可她的装束——亚麻长袍与一顶锥形草笠——又把她牢牢拴在凡人世界里。她那双天青色的眼睛不停游移，既充满好奇，也透着智慧。她的法杖本该和衣着一样朴素，若不是杖顶两根叉齿托着一枚完美无瑕的澄澈水晶圆球。

~ 由 Anniemc 扮演：Played

This tall, lean woman’s skin is as pale and translucent as alabaster. That, her pointed ears, and her tranquil expression give her an otherworldly aura. Her hair is as dark as her skin is light. But her clothing—linen robes and a conical straw hat—ground her in the mortal realm. And her azure eyes move constantly, as curious as they are wise. Her staff would be as simple as her attire if two tines at the top didn’t hold a perfect orb of clear crystal.

~ Played by Anniemc with

Barathu (Early Stage).name:
巴拉图（早期阶段）
Barathu (Early Stage)

Text.text:
宛如一只巨大的软体动物，这头漂浮巨兽红橙色的柔软外壳翻涌着能量，生物腹侧垂下无尽的紫色触须，在空中探刺。它的壳时而硬化又复归柔软。它的肢体时而伸展又骤然收缩。它的皮肤噼啪作响，迸裂出元素之力。它永不停息地变幻着。
Like a massive mollusk, the red-orange soft shell of the floating beast bubbles with energy, and endless purple tendrils extend from the creature’s underside, probing the air. Its shell hardens then softens. Its limbs extend then contract. Its skin crackles with the elements. It is ever-changing.

这只猛禽精雕细琢，令人叹为观止——它由可活动的金属部件拼装而成。每一根羽片都是一片泛着铜色光泽的薄板，每处关节皆由细致的金属杆或严丝合缝的金属嵌片连接，弯钩般的喙则以青铜铸就。两枚闪烁的猫眼石仿佛赋予它如鹰般锐利的视力，嵌在那颗可以毫无限制旋转的头颅上，直直向前凝视。它的动作与活体无异——这具构装体以巧夺天工的技艺，将自然的神韵一丝不差地复刻出来。
Incredible in its detail, this bird of prey is fashioned from articulated metal. Each feather is a coppery sheet, each joint a fine rod or fitted plate of a similar metal, and bronze forms the hooked beak. The glittering cat’s-eye stones, which seem to give vision as sharp as an eagle, face forward on a head that can swivel without limit. The construct moves like its living counterpart, a marvel of artifice mirroring nature.

Dagger Of Venom.name:
毒液匕首
Dagger Of Venom

Text.text:
这把匕首的邪异刀刃仿佛由象牙雕琢而成。也许它曾是某头可怖巨兽的獠牙，被削磨得纤细锐利，专为寻觅护甲的缝隙、钻入肋骨之间。握柄缠着某种未知兽皮制成的黑色皮革，接触时带着黏腻的触感。
The wicked blade of this dagger appears to be carved out of ivory. Perhaps it was once the fang of some terrible beast and has been slimmed down to find gaps in armor and slip between ribs. Black leather from some unknown animal wraps the hilt, and it feels sticky to the touch.

Eldritch Watcher Of The Sea.name:
海之诡秘守望者
Eldritch Watcher Of The Sea

Text.text:
海面翻腾不息。惊涛骇浪起落如山，暴风裹挟刺骨冷雨与撼地狂风肆虐抽打。风暴深处，血肉般的触须破浪而出，探向近旁船只，轻而易举便将其攫碎，拖入深渊。那触手盘旋游走，宛如潜行的巨蛇，仿佛在为某物开道——随之浮现的，是一只巨大的、无眼睑之眼，自旋涡般的海中漩涡中心缓缓升起。那只眼的竖瞳几近五十码宽，冷冷向上凝视——直到此刻你才惊觉，四周海水竟诡异地归于死寂般的平静。

~ 构想：Adam Mindwolf

The sea roils. Titanic waves rise and fall as the storm lashes out with frigid rain and earth-shaking winds. From the tempest, fleshy tendrils emerge, grasping for nearby ships to crush and drag downward with an alarming ease. The tentacles, coiling like prowling serpents, precede the appearances of a great, lidless eye, emerging from the center of a cyclonic whirlpool. The vertical pupil of this eye, nearly fifty yard across, peers upward, and it is only then that you notice the waters have become eerily calm.

~ Envisioned by Adam Mindwolf

纯粹的混沌在你双手之间凝聚，近乎云雾般翻涌旋转，在你掌心上方塑成一颗完美的球体。你感到力量——不受约束的元素能量——从球体中逸散而出，仅凭你的意志便将其召来并化作实体。你猛然将球体甩出，它像孩童的皮球般在空中滚动，随即向外坍塌，炸裂成一场狂暴的元素混沌风暴，在一阵突然而毁灭性的浪潮中轰然撞向你的目标。
The pure chaos coalesces between your hands, swirling almost cloud-like to form a perfect sphere just above your palm. You feel power—unchecked elemental energy—exuding from the sphere, called forth and made manifest by your will alone. You whip the sphere from you and it rolls through the air like a child’s ball before collapsing outward into a volatile storm of elemental chaos, bursting against your target in a sudden and destructive wave.

你环顾院子，一股浓重的鱼腥味直冲鼻腔。源头一眼便知：剖鱼的桌旁放着一桶满满的鱼，而更多的鱼则挂在绳线上晾干。棚屋旁堆起的木柴暗示着这些被宰割的生灵的归宿——也许会先被熏制，再运往集市出售。
The scent of fish fills your nose as you look about the yard. The sources are easy to spot. Fish fill a bucket beside a table for gutting, while yet more fish hang from a line to dry. Wood stacked beside the shack hints at the fate for these butchered animals: perhaps they will be smoked before being transported to market.

Sundries From An Azer.name:
来自阿泽的杂货
Sundries From An Azer

Text.text:
阿泽的烈焰鬃毛被熄灭后，只剩下它身上那副青铜般的躯壳。它的战锤在战斗中损毁得无法修复，但一截被折断的伊弗利特之角上钻着一个孔，正用金属环挂在阿泽的腰带上。
With the azer’s fiery mane quenched, only the bronze shell of its body remains. Its warhammer was damaged irreparably in the fight, but an efreeti’s broken horn with a hole drilled through it hangs from the azer’s belt on a metal ring.

Goblin With A Dagger.name:
匕首地精
Goblin With A Dagger

Text.text:
那只野性而满身疣痕的生物冷冷地龇笑着，步步逼近。它用颤抖的双手握着一把锈蚀断裂的匕首，猛烈的咳嗽撕扯着它枯槁消瘦的身躯。浓稠的绿色黏液从它又长又尖的鼻尖滴落。那生物可怜至极，却依旧眼露杀意。
The feral, warty creature sneers coldly as it advances toward you. It holds a rusted, broken dagger in shaking hands, and a violent cough wracks its emaciated frame. Thick, green mucus drips from the tip of its long, pointed nose. The creature is utterly pitiful, yet still has murder in its eyes.

一个男人踱步入场，铜色皮肤被旅途磨砺得粗粝，伤疤纵横，却带着满不在乎的神情；一双眼睛如祖母绿般闪烁。他散发出一种轻松的自信，却没有典型浪荡剑客那种喧闹的举止与张扬的装束。他穿着朴素的水手衣裳，几乎与任何航海船员别无二致。浅色疤痕沿着他的手臂、胸膛与脖颈蜿蜒——道道隆起、扭结，仿佛曾被反复施加无数次。

~ Played by Eric L

A man, copper skin weathered and scarred from his travels, saunters into view with a blithe air, eyes glittering like emeralds. He projects an easy confidence but does not display the boisterous manner or dress of a typical swashbuckler. His plain sailor’s clothes hardly set him apart from any other member of a seafaring crew. Pale scars line his arms, chest and neck—all raised and rigged as if inflicted numerous times.

~ Played by Eric L

附魔匕首的一击几乎没在你的目标身上留下划痕。你困惑地摆弄了几下，发现只要一按，刀刃就会滑入那粗短的握柄里一处隐蔽的夹层——而一松手，它又会弹簧般“嗖”地跳回原位。也许对滑稽演员或江湖骗子很有用，但在战斗中就没那么实用。
A strike from the enchanted dagger leaves barely a scratch on your target. Puzzled, you fiddle with it a bit and discover that a push slides the blade into a hidden compartment in the stocky grip—and letting go causes it to spring back out again. Useful to a mummer or a mountebank, perhaps, but not so practical in combat.

Speech About The Perspective Of Gold.name:
关于黄金视角的演说
Speech About The Perspective Of Gold

Text.text:
“你可曾想过，金币会如何看待自己？它被囤积，被血染，被夺走——无辜者尖叫，空气里弥漫着焦烟味。只因它从一个口袋流进另一个口袋的那段短短旅程。也许它自以为是个行脚人，穿行于辽阔世界与其所能献上的一切；又或许，它和携带它的人一样迷惘无依。”
“Have you ever wondered what gold must think of itself? It’s hoarded, bled over, and stolen—while innocents scream and the smell of smoke fills the air. All in its simple passage from pocket to pocket. Perhaps it thinks itself a journeyman, traveling through the broad world and all it has to offer, or perhaps it feels just as lost as those who carry it.”

Iron Walls Of The Fortress Of The Fomori.name:
弗摩里堡垒的铁壁
Iron Walls Of The Fortress Of The Fomori

Text.text:
如同弗莫里人自身一般，他们的堡垒也是权势与傲慢的阴森扭曲。零散的铁块——武器、护甲、铁板与柱段——被强行拼接缝合，构成一片丑陋如铁蕾丝般的高耸护墙。城垛顶端冠以尖锐突刺，守卫们在其后踱步，身后拖曳着沉如山岳的巨槌。
Like the Fomori themselves, their fortress is a macabre distortion of power and pride. Random pieces of iron—weapons, armor, sheets and columns—are grafted together to form a hideous lacework of high, protective walls. The ramparts are crested with sharp protrusions, behind which guards pace while dragging massive mauls behind them.

在魔导师学院场地东缘的一座小丘脚下，一圈环形土堤围住了一条几码宽、笔直向下的土质隧道。土堤旁堆着几根撑脊龙的骨头，隧道壁上也零星嵌着更多碎骨。伴着一声闷哼与鼻息，一头体型如小马车般的野猪从丘后绕出。它豆粒般的眼睛与骇人的獠牙从一层黑泥面具下透出寒光，前蹄宽阔锋利，仿佛两片铲刃。
At the base of a hill on the eastern edge of the Enchanter Academy grounds, a ring mound of earth surrounds an earthen tunnel several yards wide and straight down. Next to the mound is a pile of several struttigon bones, with more speckling the walls of the tunnel. With a grunt and snort, a boar the size of a small carriage emerges from around the hill. His beady eyes and impressive tusks show through a mask of black mud. His front hooves look like shovel blades.

Elemental Bane: Lightning.name:
元素克星：闪电
Elemental Bane: Lightning

Text.text:
炽白的电光能量在你体内翻涌扭动，凝成一圈随风暴脉动的力量光环。空气里弥漫着臭氧的刺鼻气息，静电在你掌心跳跃游走。你身形微微闪烁，向远处的敌人开启一条贯通彼此的通道，试图放大他们对你所掌控的雷霆电能的脆弱。
Actinic energy writhes within you, forming a pulsating aura of storm-driven power. A scent of ozone fills the air, static dancing across your palms. Your form flickers as you open a channel between you and your distant foe, attempting to heighten their vulnerability to the electrifying powers you control.

Transformation Into A Mind Flayer.name:
变形为夺心魔
Transformation Into A Mind Flayer

Text.text:
男孩猛然呛住，扑通一声跪倒在地，四肢着地，干呕着剧烈抽搐。透明的液体从他口中溅射而出。某种无形之力将他僵硬的身体猛地拽上半空，拉扯间，头发与一块块皮肉被撕裂剥落。他失去了两根手指与脚趾；头颅如今光秃，形状被生生拉长。他的脸上不见鼻与口，只在原本的位置垂落着四条湿亮的触须。肤色与眼中的神采迅速褪尽，血肉随即染上一层诡异的紫意。漆黑的利爪从他的手脚间破皮而出。身体逐渐松弛，仍悬在空中，而空气因他存在的异界能量而嗡鸣震颤。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The boy chokes and falls to all fours, retching and heaving. Clear liquid splatters from his mouth. An unseen force hauls his stiff body into the air, hair and lumps of flesh ripping from him in the process. He has lost two fingers and toes, and his head, now bald, has elongated. His face has no nose or mouth, and four glistening tentacles dangle from where they used to be. Color drains from his skin and eyes, then his flesh takes on a violet cast. Black claws sprout from his hands and feet. His body relaxes, still suspended, and the air thrums with the alien energy of his presence.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

茶馆里暖意融融，舒适惬意，空气中飘着肉桂与烟熏茶叶的香气。柜台上摆着一盘盘黄油挞和司康，旁边的玻璃罐里装满了拉成细丝的糖果甜点。柜台后站着一位龙裔咖啡师——她的鳞片是茉莉茶般的浅绿，眼睛蓝得像那杯浸泡中的茶汤。她含笑迎客，向你致意。她的嗓音柔和安抚，却仍让你忍不住注意到：那双唇后，藏着一排排锋利的尖牙。
The teahouse is warm and cozy, scented with cinnamon and smoked tea leaves. The counter displays trays of butter tarts and scones, and glass jars filled with sweets of spun sugar. Behind the counter stands a dragonborn barista, her scales the pale green of jasmine tea, her eyes as blue as its steeping water. She smiles and welcomes you. Her voice is soothing, but you cannot help noticing the rows of sharp teeth hidden behind her lips.

Sky Pirate Hideout.name:
天空海盗据点
Sky Pirate Hideout

Text.text:
这处阴森山口的最高峰间，藏着一座极易被忽略的洞穴。洞内，数艘飞艇被系缆停泊——它们被引入这座巨大的洞窟之中，以避开那些同样翱翔天际的旅者的视线。细看之下，你会发现不止一艘正悬挂着海盗旗：黑色背景上绘着白色地精骷髅与交叉骨，正是这片地域卑鄙无耻的天空海盗的标志旗帜。
An easily overlooked cave is nestled within in the highest peaks of this forbidding mountain pass. Inside, several airships have been tethered—guided into the enormous cavern to avoid detection from similar airborne travelers. Looking closely, you can see that more than one is flying a Jolly Roger: white goblin skull and crossbones on a black background, the signature flag of the scurrilous sky pirates of the region.

Group Of Skeleton Archers.name:
骷髅（特征）弓箭手群
Group Of Skeleton Archers

Text.text:
骷髅队列齐齐就位：空洞眼眶的射手与同伴步调分毫不差，各自搭上一支箭。干枯筋腱发出清晰的吱呀声，他们拉满弓弦、稳稳瞄准，每名战士都毫不眨眼地死盯着他们的目标。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

In unison the lines of skeletons take position: hollow-eyed marksmen perfectly in sync with their comrades as they eachknock an arrow. With an audible creak of desiccated sinew they draw back their bows and take aim, each warrior staring unflinchingly at their target.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

矮人矿工嗅着地下腐臭的空气，仿佛那是清新的微风，目光在采掘现场来回扫视，试图窥得一条新矿脉的踪迹。他近乎虔敬地举起鹤嘴锄——如同他的父亲、以及他父亲的父亲曾经那样——准备为族群开采出珍贵的金属。
The dwarf miner sniffs at the fetid underground air as if it were a fresh breeze, eyeballing the dig site in an effort to divine a new vein. Almost reverently, he hefts his pick—as his father did and his father’s father before him—ready to extract precious metals for his community.

Tournament Royal Box.name:
王室锦标宝箱
Tournament Royal Box

Text.text:
国王与王后端坐在一座华美的观礼包厢中，天鹅绒装饰层层铺陈，神色从容地注视着比武大会的进程。王室下方的观众席满溢敬畏之情，君临般的威仪为整场盛会平添一股庄严宏阔的气势。
The king and queen sit in an elaborate box adorned with velvet, calmly watching the tourney as it unfolds. The crowd seated below the royals is filled with reverence, the august presence of the rulers adding a sense of grandeur to the entire event.

Receiving Aura Of Life.name:
获得【生命灵光】
Receiving Aura Of Life

Text.text:
一阵阵金色光潮自你的盟友身上涌出，洗过你的全身。空气噼啪作响，迸发出振奋人心的能量，将可能缠附在你身上的压迫性坏死驱散开去。你感到一股蓬勃的活力贯穿躯体，对任何可能侵蚀你安危的腐朽威胁，重新筑起坚韧的抵抗。
Pulses of golden light wash over you, emanating from your ally. The air crackles with an invigorating energy, pushing back the oppressive necrosis that may have clung to you. You feel a surge of vigor surge through your body, a renewed resilience against any decay that might threaten your well-being.

Nystul’s Magic Aura: Mask.name:
涅斯图尔的魔法灵光：伪装
Nystul’s Magic Aura: Mask

Text.text:
力量的低语渗入你指尖划过的每一道轨迹，你以此描摹你魔法的目标。你如外科医师般精细地“手术”，剜去它玄奥的灵光，再将余下的部分重新塑形，足以欺瞒连天界的感官都难以察觉。外表上毫无变化，但在超自然的探查之下，你能让一把扫帚看起来像一只布雷札乌，或让一只炼狱魔鬼像一枚松果。
Whispers of power suffuse each stroke of your fingers as they trace the target of your magic. Delicate as a surgeon, you operate, carving away its esoteric aura and reshaping the remainder to beguile even celestial senses. Outwardly, nothing is changed, but to preternatural probing, you could make a broom appear as a bulezau, or a pit fiend as a pine cone.

Ingenious Young Hacker Cracks Parental B.name:
足智多谋的少年黑客破解父母封锁
Ingenious Young Hacker Cracks Parental Block

Text.text:
心脏砰砰狂跳，少年戴着头显，在被具象化的赛博空间迷宫般的回廊中穿行。前方就是那座被禁止的黄色录像宝库——可家长屏蔽守护魔突然在路中央凝形，如同一头弥诺陶洛斯，挥舞着写有 18+ 的告示牌，像长柄战斧般拦路。少年嘴角一歪，露出促狭的笑，迅速敲入代码并注入其中，迷宫的墙面随即被扰乱重排。闪烁的数据方块起落翻转，像锁芯里的弹子般咔嗒作响，将咆哮的守护魔困在其中，也把前路打开——通向一片肮脏的黑暗，唯有妖艳的霓虹代码线条在其中冷亮燃烧。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Heart thumping, the teen navigates the labyrinthine corridors of cyberspace visualized in their headset. The forbidden trove of dirty movies lies ahead—but the parental block daemon materializes in their path, a minotaur wielding an 18+ sign like a poleaxe. With a wry grin, the teen punches in code and injects it, scrambling the walls of the labyrinth. Shimmering blocks of data rise and fall like tumblers in a lock, boxing in the roaring daemon and opening the way forward into grungy darkness lit by lurid neon lines of code.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Electronic Drum Kit.name:
电子架子鼓
Electronic Drum Kit

Text.text:
宽大而平坦的圆盘与面板点缀着这件奇异的数字乐器，每一片都经过校准，用以重现普通架子鼓中某个精确的区域。尽管它缺少同名真鼓那般回荡的冲击力，但在合适的人手里，这套鼓组依旧能迸发出惊人的表现。
Wide, flat discs and panels adorn the strange digital instrument, each one calibrated to recreate a precise area of an ordinary drum kit. Though it lacks the resonant impact of its namesake, this kit can be incredible in the right hands.

Cave Passage Bending Left.name:
洞穴通道向左弯曲
Cave Passage Bending Left

Text.text:
潮湿阴冷、带着泥土气息的甬道贴着你心口一侧蜿蜒而去，你竟从中得到了一点点安慰——童年的昏暗记忆提醒着你：要走出迷宫，就得一直向左旅行。可这条规矩，放在穿行于陌生洞窟的探洞里也适用吗？无所谓了。在这种地方，任何一丝慰藉都值得你死死攥住。
The dank, earthen passage bends along your heartside and somehow you take a small modicum of comfort in this, a dim memory from childhood reminding you that to escape a maze, one must always travel to the left. But does that apply to spelunking through strange caverns? No matter. In a place like this, any comfort is worth clinging to.

Packed Coliseum.name:
座无虚席的斗兽场
Packed Coliseum

Text.text:
人群轰然爆发，齐刷刷站起身来，挥拳高举过顶。咆哮声如雷霆滚滚，几乎震得人耳膜发麻。到场的人一定有几百——也许上千！不少人挥舞着色彩斑斓的旗帜与横幅，上面绘着他们钟爱的角斗士之名与徽记；也有人神情克制、冷静观望——多半是在随着比赛推进，盘算着自己的赢利。
The crowd erupts, coming to their feet and pumping their fists in the air. The roar is thunderous, almost deafening. There must be hundreds in attendance here—maybe thousands! Many wave colorful flags and banners bearing the names and sigils of their favored gladiators, while others watch with careful and measured patience—likely counting their winnings as the matches progress.

Cursed Logger's Camp.name:
受诅伐木工营地
Cursed Logger's Camp

Text.text:
踏入林间空地，你看见一片狼藉：破碎的帆布帐篷成堆撕裂，笨重的工具被随手丢弃，火堆只剩将熄未熄的余烬。废墟之间，几棵诡异的树散落在营地里——虬结的枝桠与扭曲的树干仿佛在痛苦中痉挛，树皮上巨大的创口汩汩涌出树脂。你靠近时血液骤冷：那嶙峋的表皮上竟扭曲出尖叫的怪诞面孔。

~ 由 Clara C. Potter 在 Discord 上 构想

Entering the clearing, you see a group of shredded canvas tents, discarded lumbering tools, and the dying embers of a fire. Amid the devastation, you see strange trees scattered about the camp, their gnarled branches and twisted trunks contorted in agony as sap pours from large wounds in their bark. Your blood runs cold as you draw closer and see screaming, macabre faces warping their craggy exteriors.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Lord Vaspin, \"The Betrayer\".name:
瓦斯宾勋爵，“背叛者”
Lord Vaspin, "The Betrayer"

Text.text:
梦魇猛然甩动燃烧的鬃毛，火星四散飞溅，在空中亮起，映出一名披着乌黑板甲的不死战士那骇人的身影。他戴着铁手套的手紧握一根摇曳不定的旗杆，残破而闷燃的旗帜上赫然烙着一朵猩红玫瑰。他的头颅早已剥尽皮肉，只剩咧笑的骷髅，眼眶里燃着火焰。左眼下方一道裂痕昭示着曾受重创——也许是剑柄的钝击，或是一记凶狠的下劈。身体其余部分尚存些许血肉，却已腐黑发烂，恶臭翻涌，与坐骑硫磺般的气息混杂成令人作呕的烟雾。他下颌垂落，喉间喷出嘶嘶蒸汽；那里的肉色泛着坏疽般的青绿，仿佛某种恶毒的毒素已在其中凝结。

~ 由 Ararion Played

The nightmare shakes its flaming mane, embers scattering through the air to illuminate the ghastly image of an undead warrior wearing jet-black plate. He holds the shaft of a wavering banner in his gauntleted hand, the tattered, smoldering flag emblazoned with the image of a crimson rose. His head, shorn of all flesh, is a grinning skull with eye sockets burning with flame. A crack under the left eye belies some trauma, perhaps the blunt end of a sword or a forceful downward slash. The rest of his body has retained some flesh, though it is dark with rot and emits a foul stench mingling with the sulfuric scent of his steed. His jaw falls and a hissing steam emits from his throat, the meat of which is stained a gangrenous green as if a vile poison has congealed there.

~ Played by Ararion

前方的平原被一锅浓稠的迷雾汤所笼罩，刺骨的寒意渗入骨髓，抽走你体内最后的温度。脚下的地面以冰冷的烂泥攫住你的靴子不放，而远处一声长嚎穿透阴霾回荡，令你牙关发紧。
A thick soup of mist shrouds the plains ahead, its icy chill leaching the warmth from your bones. The ground underfoot claws at your boots with freezing mud, and a distant howl echoes through the gloom, setting your teeth on edge.

他没有虚张声势，也不自夸；他身上的衣物与装备，没有一样是为了好看。无论是武器的佩戴方式，还是那件打满补丁的护甲，都在诉说着千锤百炼的战斗经验——而且败仗不多。就连他那双布满老茧的手指上套着的戒指，看起来也更像是为搏杀而戴，而非装饰。
There’s no bluster or boastfulness, and nothing about his clothes or equipment exists for show. Everything—from the way he wears his weapons to the patched armor—speaks of hard-won battle experience, and not many losses. Even the rings on his calloused fingers look like they are there for fighting rather than decoration.

那堆阴森可怖的引火物大多由霉烂的尸体堆成，像一座腐朽的纪念碑般拔起。火焰迅速窜起，贪婪吞噬干枯的柴枝与风干的血肉。尸身在火中扭动，有几具甚至抽搐着苏醒——挣扎着想要站起——不死的求生本能驱使僵尸行动，然而烈焰已将它们腐败的躯壳彻底笼罩。
The macabre pile of tinder, mostly composed of moldering corpses, rises like a rotting monument. The flames take quickly, consuming dry kindling and desiccated flesh. The bodies writhe, and a few stir—struggle to stand—undead survival instinct spurring the zombies to action as the flames engulf their decaying forms.

她身形高挑修长，是一位技能无双的女子。宽松的武斗长裤包裹着两条因赛博骨骼植入而隐隐发亮的腿。她的躯干被一层层猩红绷带缠绕，绷带上沾着街头生存的污渍。她的头发亦是同样的红色，而她右侧的面庞则是一整块碳合金质地；前沿的光学植入体在她的眼中投出黄色的冷光。她的持剑臂在肘部被切除并替换，绿色的生物燃料泵群在其中幽幽发亮。她背上斜挂着一只脏兮兮的塑料刀鞘，但其中的武士刀却被养护得无可挑剔。她一动不动地站着，凝视，等待。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Tall and lithe, this is a woman of peerless skill. Baggy martial pants clothe two legs alight with cyber-skeletal implants. Her torso is bandaged in a series of scarlet wraps stained with street living. Her hair is the same color, and the right side of her face is a mass of carbon alloy, a cutting-edge optical implant shining yellow in her eye. Her sword arm has been removed at the elbow and replaced; it glows with a mass of green biofuel pumps. Slung across her back is a dirty plastic scabbard, but the katana inside looks incredibly well cared for. She stands perfectly motionless, watching and waiting.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Lighthouse On A Rocky Coast.name:
岩岸灯塔
Lighthouse On A Rocky Coast

Text.text:
海浪轰然撞上阻隔通往沙滩的礁石，飞溅的浪花像绝望的手般越过嶙峋的岩面伸来。远处一座小岛上的灯塔投下惨白的指引，指向远离这些险境的海面——但有一艘船却没这么走运。黑色的残骸在浪涌中颠簸摇摆，断裂的桅杆从船体里刺出，像细长、折断的枯骨。
Waves crash against the rocks that bar the way to the sandy shore, the spray reaching like desperate hands past their ragged faces. A lighthouse on a distant islet shines a pallid beacon, away from these hazards—but one ship was not so fortunate. A dark ruin rocks in the surge, its spars sticking out like spindly, broken bones from the hull.

Second-year School Robes.name:
二年级校袍
Second-year School Robes

Text.text:
当屋里其他人都离开——去上课、去训练场，或去惹是生非——你在公共休息室旁一只原本空空的衣柜里，发现了一套长袍。袖臂上缝着一块沉甸甸的刺绣徽章，上面写着：Alterum Annum。另一只袖臂上也有一块相似的徽章，绣着你的名字。你可以把长袍从衣架上取下，穿在身上……
When everyone else in the house is gone—to class, on the field, or getting into trouble—you find robes in an otherwise empty armoire off the common room. A heavy embroidered patch on the arm reads: Alterum Annum. A similar patch on the other arm bears your name. You could remove the robes from their hangar and wear them…

Dromos Stage.name:
德洛莫斯阶段
Dromos Stage

Text.text:
地面上的仪式沙画一路延伸到阶段之上，阶段两侧是弧形的平台。平台上嵌着低矮边缘的龛位，用于为亡者做准备。阶段俯瞰着漫长的甬道——那条横穿铺满沙砾地面的步道——沿途以亡者旅程的各个阶段为标记。
The ritual sand paintings on the floor continue out onto the stage, which is flanked by curved platforms. On them are low-bordered niches for the preparation of the dead. The stage looks over the long dromos—the walkway that crosses the sand-strewn floor—marked by the stages of the dead’s journey.

Unfriendly Human Innkeeper.name:
不友善的人类旅店老板
Unfriendly Human Innkeeper

Text.text:
尽管桌椅间坐满了人，喧嚣的谈笑声此起彼伏，还有些人缩在昏暗的角落里，护着自己的麦酒不让旁人靠近，店主却像被什么牵住目光似的，一直盯着你。终于，他停下手里的活计，只是直勾勾地看着。等你完全注意到他，他抬起下巴，朝你来时那扇门的方向微微一挑。那动作可以算作冷淡的招呼，但更像是在下逐客令。

~ 由 Ethan 构想

Despite all the folks at the tables and chairs, all the raucous conversations and skulkers guarding their ale in shadowy corners, the innkeeper seems fixated on you. Finally, he stops working and just stares. When he has your full attention, he tips his chin up and over toward the door through which you arrived. The gesture could be a cold greeting, but seems more likely to be a send-off.

~ Envisioned by Ethan

Nas Nen, Water Elemental Island.name:
纳斯·嫩，水元素之岛
Nas Nen, Water Elemental Island

Text.text:
一圈沼泽地勉强高出轻柔的波浪。浅浅的水塘与细流占据了大半景致，远胜过那些湿透的泥丘与松软的地面。所有水流都汇向这片浸透的平原中央——那里张着一处宽阔的圆形开口，轰鸣的瀑布坠入洞中。甚至从岸边都能望见，那翻搅的水池正不断注满这道裂开的深坑。

~ 由 Josh Murphy 构想

A ring of swamped land barely rises above the gentle waves. Shallow ponds and streams make up more of the landscape than do expanses and mounds of soggy earth. All the water flows toward a wide, circular opening in the sodden plain, where roaring falls plunge into the hole. Even from the shoreline, a churning pool can be seen filling this gaping pit.

~ Envisioned by Josh Murphy

Aloof Androsphinx.name:
冷傲的安德罗斯芬克斯
Aloof Androsphinx

Text.text:
这只威仪非凡的生物，体型如挽马般巨大，躯干——鬃毛、尾巴、耳朵、爪掌与利爪——皆是雄壮的黄褐色巨狮之貌。尽管全身覆着短而狮似的皮毛，他的面孔却是人类男子的模样，琥珀色双眼幽然发光。巨鹰般的羽翼自他肩胛舒展而出。他显得疏离，带着几分阴沉，一边甩动尾巴，一边低声自语般咕哝着。
This regal creature, the size of a draft horse, has the body—mane, tail, ears, paws, and claws—of a great, yellow-brown lion. Although covered in short, leonine fur, the face is that of a human man with amber eyes aglow. Feathered wings, like those of a giant eagle, spread from his shoulders. He appears aloof, and a little grim, as he swishes his tail and grumbles to himself.

Dwarf Zombie In Plate Armor.name:
穿板甲的矮人丧尸（特征）
Dwarf Zombie In Plate Armor

Text.text:
一缕缕曾经威武的胡须残片黏在这具丧尸蜡黄的脸上，附着在尚未完全从骨头上剥离的腐烂皮肉间。它动作迟缓，被生前穿戴的坚固护甲拖累；而那令人不安的猩红色泽，浸染着它龟裂腐朽的牙齿。
Scraps of a mighty beard cling to the sallow remains of the zombie’s face, attached to putrescent flesh not quite off the bone. Their movements are slow, impeded by the stalwart armor they wore in life, and an unsettling crimson pallor stains their cracked and rotting teeth.

Quip About Friendship From An Untrustwor.name:
来自不可信向导的友情俏皮话
Quip About Friendship From An Untrustworthy Guide

Text.text:
“在这座城市里，友情不值几个钱。大多数人只要口袋里能多几枚信用点，就会把朋友钉到墙上。可我不一样。你可以信我。”
“Friendship isn’t worth much in this city. Most people would bolt a friend to a wall if it meant a few extra credits in their pocket. Not me though. You can trust me.”

Giant Poisonous Snake.name:
巨型毒蛇
Giant Poisonous Snake

Text.text:
这条巨蛇足有六英尺长，身上的花纹与一种体型更小、咬一口就带毒的蛇极为相似。只消瞥一眼那三英寸长的獠牙，你便相信它能在一次攻击中注入相当大量的致命毒液。
Easily six feet long, the coloring on this giant snake is similar to the coloring of a smaller snake with a venomous bite. A quick look at the three-inch fangs leads you to believe that it could inject quite a lot of deadly venom in a single attack.

Tormun The Tracker.name:
追踪者托尔蒙
Tormun The Tracker

Text.text:
仿佛古树的年轮印记，那道发红的疤痕在矮人苍白的皮肤上分叉蔓延，蜿蜒掠过他粗犷的面容，继而没入衣领之下。浓眉深锁之下，一双眼如海上风暴般炽烈阴沉，带着近乎原始的压迫感死死盯着紧张的店主，唇角因怒意而扭曲。矮人一头红发狂乱飞扬，他冲着发抖的商贩劈头痛骂，翻卷的斗篷间露出一柄工艺精绝的战斧。然而，正如山间骤起的暴风，他的怒火转瞬即逝，目光又柔和如春雨。嘟囔着道了句歉，他猛然转身离去，去别处寻找他的下一场冒险。

~ Played by iteration

Like the impression of an ancient tree, the flushed scar spreads in branching patterns across the dwarf’s pale flesh, meandering across his rugged countenance before diving below his collar. Eyes with the intensity of an ocean storm glower from beneath a heavily furrowed brow, regarding the nervous shopkeep with a near primal intensity, as his lips curl in outrage. The dwarf’s red hair flails wildly as he berates the trembling vendor, his billowing cloak revealing an exquisitely crafted axe. But, like a sudden storm across the mountains, his rage soon passes, and his eyes soften like spring rain. With a mumbled apology he turns on his heel, setting off to find his next adventure elsewhere.

~ Played by iteration

这头瘦骨嶙峋、丑陋骇人的鬣狗体型如挽马般巨大，斑驳的苍白皮毛间嵌着骨质甲片，背脊一路拱起参差锯齿般的尖刺。尖刺在长尾尽头戛然而止，尾端却长着一枚倒钩般的刺锥。怪物喉间透出炽热余烬般的幽光，口涎从獠牙间淌下，顺着它松垂的尖舌滴落。它的双眼同样灼亮，喷薄出几乎可触的憎恨，随着生物的咆哮而猛然爆燃。

~ 构想：Ian Evans

The size of a draft horse, this gaunt, hideous hyena has bony plates in its patchy, pale fur and jagged spines that emerge along its back. The spines end where a hooked barb tips its long tail. Illuminated by a glow the color of hot embers in the monster’s throat, drool streams from its jaws along its lolling, pointed tongue. Its eyes burn with equal intensity, exuding palpable hatred and flaring as the creature snarls.

~ Envisioned by Ian Evans

Loot From A Vrock.name:
从弗洛克身上搜出的战利品
Loot From A Vrock

Text.text:
那只禽类噩梦细长瘦削的脖颈上，挂着一枚色彩斑斓、微光流转的坠饰，呈现出如彩绘玻璃般的棱彩光泽。它看上去至少值一百枚金币，却莫名其妙地佩戴在这样一头凶残卑劣的生物身上，显得格格不入。
Hanging around the long, scrawny neck of the avian nightmare is a colorful, shimmering pendant in the prismatic hues of stained glass. It looks to be worth one hundred gold pieces at least and seems oddly out of place adorning such a savage and vile creature.

这座单泊位的封锁港口坚固异常，补给充足，足以迎接每一艘靠岸的船只。码头同样由砂岩砌成；每一次亡者启程，奔赴那永恒的不死体验之后，祭司们都得重新加固它。
The one-vessel block port is strong and well stocked for the boat that arrives. The dock is sandstone as well, which the priests must shore up after each trip of the dead to their eternal experience of undeath.

Hustrick Long Shot.name:
胡斯特里克远射
Hustrick Long Shot

Text.text:
这名矮人深色的眼睛凝望远方，叼着一支弯管烟斗吞云吐雾；每一次呼吸，带着香草气息的烟缕便轻轻飘散在空气里。他鼻梁宽厚圆隆，几乎盖过那张晒成古铜色、仍显年轻的面庞。粗糙的一只手紧握烟斗，另一只手的拇指则扣在背后步枪的背带下——那把蓝黑铁与桃花心木制成的长枪横跨在他的毛皮披肩与蓝色斗篷之上。枪身侧面伸出显眼的扳机拨杆。腰带里还倒插着一把同材质的手枪，枪口朝下。与步枪背带一样，这条束带也是厚重的棕色皮革，几乎与他从胸甲到靴子的其余装束同一质感。所有东西都像经历过长久使用，却依然保养得当。就连他的黑胡子也修剪整齐、梳理服帖，头发向后梳起，扎成一束马尾。身旁伏着一只雪豹，目光冷淡疏离，与他如出一辙。

~ Played by MrTwice

His dark eyes stare into the distance as this dwarf puffs on a curved pipe, smoke the scent of vanilla wafting into the air with each breath. Broad and bulbous, his nose overshadows the otherwise youthful look of his tanned face. One rough hand clutches the pipe, while the other’s thumb is tucked under the strap holding a rifle of blue-black iron and mahogany wood on his back—over his fur mantle and blue cloak. The longarm has a prominent lever over the trigger. A pistol of similar materials is tucked, barrel first, into his belt. As with the rifle strap, this girdle is heavy, brown leather like most of the dwarf’s other garb, breastplate to boots. Everything seems well used but in good repair. Likewise, his black beard is trimmed and brushed, his hair combed back and held in a ponytail. A snow leopard sits at his side, with a gaze as detached as his.

~ Played by MrTwice

风势骤然增强，你听见它在峡谷顶端尖啸——不由得抬眼望向崖顶，映入眼帘的是令人心头一紧的景象。一缕被阳光点亮的细沙从岩壁上被吹落，掠过峡谷壁面，轻轻洒落在下方的石面上。风不停歇，更多沙流紧随其后，直至化作簌簌作响的沙瀑，如水般倾泻而下。
The wind picks up, and you hear it whistle at the top of the canyon—which draws your eyes to the clifftop and a startling sight. A trickle of sand, illuminated by sunlight, blows down the canyon walls to play across the stones below. As the wind continues, more sand trickles follow until it becomes a susurrating torrent washing down like water.

一名厚实的爬行战士迈步上前，迎面与你对峙。它的鬣蜥头颅抬起，与您的目光相接，你注意到它左右眼会分别单独眨动，哨兵般的凝视始终不移。它沉重的身躯微微佝偻着，仿佛只要一伸展开来，便能轻易高过你一头。浓密的肌肉覆在宽阔的骨架上，将翠绿的鳞片绷得紧紧的，鳞面在光下闪烁，宛如彼此挤靠的钱币。它握着一面海藻缠裹的盾牌，盾身由某艘沉船的木板锻造而成；一柄凶狠的晨星链枷则塞在皮带里，皮带紧紧束在那身朴素的护甲外，护着它苍白的腹部。它显然已为战斗做好准备，却似乎更愿意先开口交谈。
A thick reptilian warrior strides forward to confront you. Their iguana head rises to meet your eyes and you notice they wink each eye individually, their sentinel gaze unwavering. Their heavy frame slouches in such a way that should they stretch out, they would easily tower over you. Dense muscle covers broad bones, pulling viridian scales tight across their body so that they shine like abutting coins. They hold a kelp-wrapped shield wrought from the planks of some sunken ship, and a ferocious morningstar flail is tucked into the leather belt cinched around the simple armor that protects their pale underbelly. Though obviously ready for battle, they seem more inclined to talk.

十英尺宽、二十英尺长的吊桥沿着颠簸的轨迹缓缓落下。两侧守卫塔内的绳索绞盘放松牵引，直到沉重的木桥轻轻搭在壕沟的另一侧。越过围墙环护的外堡，主堡的窗户自土丘之巅俯瞰而下，目光如王者般冷峻而威严。

~ 由 Narth 构想

The drawbridge, ten feet wide and twenty long, lowers on a bumpy course. Rope winches located in the guard towers on each side ease it open, until the heavy wooden bridge rests gently on the other side of the trench. Beyond the walled bailey, the windows of the keep look down from the motte with royal eyes.

~ Envisioned by Narth

Mutiny By Torchlight.name:
火炬映照下的叛变
Mutiny By Torchlight

Text.text:
燃烧火把的细碎噼啪声，与船体木梁有节奏的吱呀作响、海浪轻柔的拍击声交织在一起；叛乱者贴着甲板悄然前行，急切地想要触及船长舱门。警戒的呼喊转瞬被一记记闷击掐断，潜伏在阴影里的割喉客将哨兵从岗位上“除名”。待到夜尽，他们要么重获自由——要么被拖曳过龙骨。

~ 由 Clara C. Potter 在 Discord 上 Envisioned

The soft crackle of burning torches mingles with the rhythmic creaking of the ship's timbers and gentle lapping of waves as the dissidents creep forward, eager to reach the door to the captain's cabin. Cries of alarm are swiftly ended with blows to the head, the sentries removed from duty by cutthroats lurking in the shadows. By the end of the night they will either be free—or keel-hauled.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Speech By The Cruel Governor.name:
残酷总督的演说
Speech By The Cruel Governor

Text.text:
“正如石头不明白自己为何被凿子敲打，农夫也无法领会他们的苦难究竟在成就什么。”
“Just as the stone does not understand why it is beaten by the chisel, the peasant cannot grasp the purpose their suffering serves.”

地狱中的地城。还能有什么更糟？然而魔鬼并不像凡人暴君那样把刑讯室藏起来——他们整个位面就是一座监狱。这座漆黑的地窖反倒用来囤存：把不配之人关到被召唤的那一刻，把不受欢迎之物塞到被遗忘为止。这里铁栏与高墙比比皆是，但你隐约觉得，它真正的囚禁之力来自四周嗡鸣不绝的强大魔法。
A dungeon in Hell. What could be worse? Yet devils don’t hide their torture chambers like mortal tyrants—their whole plane is a prison. This black vault instead serves as storage: a place to keep the unworthy until called and the unwanted until forgotten. Bars and walls it has aplenty, but you suspect its true power to imprison stems from the powerful magic you hear humming all around you.

Twigg, The Goliath Paladin Chef.name:
特威格，歌利亚圣骑士大厨
Twigg, The Goliath Paladin Chef

Text.text:
高耸的歌利亚把围裙上的面粉抹掉，宽厚的笑容在他岩石般粗犷却温和的面孔上绽开。他身上飘来香草与酵母的气息。左眼上的疤、肌肉的隆起，都不是在面包房里挣来的；但他早已把战锤换成擀面杖，把护甲换成厨师罩衫。

~ 由一位英雄扮演

The towering goliath wipes flour on his apron, a broad smile creasing his craggy but kind features. The smell of herbs and yeast wafts from him. The scar over his left eye and the bulge of his muscles weren’t earned in a bakery, but he long ago traded a warhammer for a rolling pin, and armor for a chef’s smock.

~ Played by a Hero

The Button Man Intimidates.name:
纽扣人威吓
The Button Man Intimidates

Text.text:
当他逼近时，女人惊恐地睁大双眼；他衣袍的边角忽然轻轻悬起，仿佛被无形的风掀动了一瞬。他懒散地抬起手，瞳孔深处点点微光闪烁。只见他戴着顶针般头盔的拇指与食指轻轻一勾，她衬衫上的针脚便猛然收紧。衣领勒住她的喉咙，她发出一声窒息的倒抽气。半截袖子像绳索般缠上手肘。她双眼鼓胀、双手肿起，拼命去抓扯衣领，却动作愈发迟缓无力，最终跪倒在地，只剩一声可怜的嘶哑喘鸣。

~ 出自精彩的 TTRPG 增补 The Vineyard

The woman’s eyes widen in fear as he approaches, the edges of his clothes levitate for a moment, as if buffeted by the wind. He languidly raises his hand, pinpricks of light glowing within his pupils. With just a twitch of his forefinger and thimble-helmed thumb, the stitches in her shirt constrict. Her collar tightens around her throat and she lets out a choking gasp. The half-sleeves of her shirt coil around the elbow. Eyes bulging and hands swelling, she attempts to claw away the collar, but her movements grow slower, weaker, and she falls to her knees with a pitiful wheeze.

~ Found in the amazing TTRPG supplement The Vineyard

Wraith Encounter.name:
缚灵（特征）遭遇
Wraith Encounter

Text.text:
一双幽光闪烁的眼睛，是这生物逼近时唯一的预警；它影影绰绰、无形无质的身躯自森然黑暗中迫近，压迫感扑面而来。它无腿的身体阴沉地漂浮向你，类人的双手伸出抓攫，骷髅般的面孔扭成狞笑的鬼脸，双眼因期待下一次杀戮而熠熠生辉。亡灵骇人的外貌令一阵刺骨寒意沿着你的脊背低语而下——这是一头从噩梦与幽灵（特征）故事里爬出的凶煞生物。
A pair of glowing eyes are the only warning of the creature's approach, its shadowy, incorporeal form looming from the forbidding darkness. Grimly, its legless body floats toward you, its humanlike hands grasping at you, its skeletal face a grinning rictus, eyes gleaming with anticipation of its next kill. A bitter chill whispers down your spine at the undead's fearsome appearance, a fell creature straight out of nightmares and ghost stories.

Slopes Of Skull Hill.name:
颅骨山坡
Slopes Of Skull Hill

Text.text:
空洞的眼窝嵌在泛黄、龟裂的骨头里，仿佛在你踏上仪式地点的台阶时仍冷冷注视。披着生锈腐朽的护甲碎片，不死战士举起古老兵刃，随时准备为他们的主人而战。

~ 由 Envisioned 的 Leif 构想，来自 Devs & Dice

诅咒之丘 第一部分：骷髅丘之底 第二部分：骷髅丘之坡 第三部分：一对红甲战士 第四部分：骷髅丘之巅 第五部分：跳动水晶下的巫妖 Hollow eye sockets set in yellowed, splintering bone seem to watch as you approach the steps of the ritual site. Clad in rusted and rotting scraps of armor, deathless warriors raise their ancient weapons, ready to defend their master.

~ Envisioned by Leif from Devs & Dice

Cursed Hill Part I: Base of Skull Hill Part II: Slopes of Skull Hill Part III: Pair of Red, Armored Warriors Part IV: Summit of Skull Hill Part V: Lich Beneath a Pulsing Crystal

Large Stone Bridge.name:
大型石桥
Large Stone Bridge

Text.text:
这座由粗重巨木与灰浆砌石构成的庞大桥梁横跨沟壑，宽阔得足以让两辆马车在需要时并排行驶。自下方托起桥身的是直径堪比城堡塔楼的巨柱，将那近乎不可能的重量高高擎入天际。旗帜在微风中猎猎作响，沿着桥梁惊人的长度以固定间距列阵飘扬。旅人、商贩、农夫与当地卫兵从两端往来穿行，车马人流自日出至日落从未断绝。
The massive bridge of heavy timbers and mortared stone spans the gully, wide enough for two carts to cross side-by-side, if needed. Pillars the diameter of castle turrets support the bridge from below, hoisting its impossible weight into the sky. Banners flutter in the breeze, situated at regular intervals along the bridge's considerable length. Travelers, merchants, farmers, and local guards cross from both sides, the traffic constant from sun up to sundown.

一个身影从夜色里浮现，獠牙密布的嘴里咕嘟咕嘟冒出稚气的咯咯笑。显然是地精类生物——光秃的绿色脑袋左右转动，巨大的无瞳眼窝燃着煤炭般的红光。一件不起眼的斗篷绷在他们纤细的身躯上，锈蚀的弩在瘦骨嶙峋的背上颠簸。走到岔路口，他们停下脚步，重新调整身上东拼西凑的掠夺装备，像是在寻找某样重要之物。他们兴奋得叽里咕噜，终于高高举起一根外形诡奥的短杖，伸舌舔过那刻满符文的杖端。伴着几乎能触到的恶作剧气息，他们窜入更深的昏暗，癫狂的笑声一路追随，没入阴影。

~ 扮演者 Puffernami 与

A figure emerges from the night, childish giggling bubbling from their fang-filled mouth. Obviously goblinoid, their bald, green head turns this way and that, huge pupilless eyes glowing red like coals. An inconspicuous cloak stretches across their slender frame, a rusted crossbow bouncing upon their scrawny back. Stopping at a junction, they readjust the mishmash of looted equipment slung about them, seeking something important. Gibbering with glee, they finally hold aloft an esoteric-looking rod and lick its rune-etched tip. With an aura of palpable mischief, they skitter off into the gloom, their manic laughter following them into the shadows.

~ Played by Puffernami with

Quarreling Couple.name:
吵得不可开交的情侣
Quarreling Couple

Text.text:
两个人的高声争执传来，怒火几乎凝成实质；可你一靠近，他们便骤然噤声，时不时偷偷朝你瞥来。尽管他们压低嗓音耳语，那眼底的纯粹毒意与面颊上翻涌的潮红却怎么也藏不住。
Raised voices come from two individuals, their palpable anger obvious, but as you draw near, they quiet down, furtively glancing at you from time to time. Yet, for all their whispering, there is no mistaking the pure poison in their eyes or the flush of color in their cheeks.

Crystal Arcane Focus.name:
水晶奥术法器
Crystal Arcane Focus

Text.text:
这枚抛光水晶在天然切割下各个切面并不均匀，却因那份不对称而同样引人注目。细小的符文沿着晶面被刻入，依特定的排列铺陈开来，使得任何持有它的人都能借此磨砺并精进自己的施法。
Though the facets of this polished crystal are uneven in its natural cut, it draws the eye no less for its asymmetry. Tiny runes have been engraved along its faces, arrayed in such a way that it may be used to sharpen the spellcasting of any who holds it.

I Feel The Bloodlust From A Weapon.name:
我从一把武器上感到嗜血欲望
I Feel The Bloodlust From A Weapon

Text.text: 当我紧握这把武器时，它那股意志的力量仿佛一盆冰冷刺骨的水当头浇下。它渴求暴力。幻象在我眼前骤然闪现——武器撕咬进血肉，喷涌出成股的鲜血洪流。我的心脏在肾上腺素猛然飙升中狂跳不止。我咬紧牙关，任它无声地向我哀求……杀。 As I clutch the weapon, the force of its will is like the shock of ice-cold water. It hungers for violence. Visions flash before my eyes—the weapon biting into flesh, spilling torrents of blood. My heart pounds with a spike of adrenaline. I grit my teeth as it pleads with me, wordlessly… Kill.

Quip By Dragonborn About Squishy Compani.name:
龙裔对软趴趴伙伴的俏皮话
Quip By Dragonborn About Squishy Companions

Text.text:
“你那软塌塌、还不停渗漏的外壳居然还能办成事，简直称得上非凡。”
“How you manage to accomplish anything with such a squishy, leaky exterior is nothing short of extraordinary.”

Temple To A God Of Foreknowledge.name:
预知之神的神殿
Temple To A God Of Foreknowledge

Text.text:
神殿是一座圆润的高塔——如同灯塔。白石与澄澈玻璃砌成的墙面，将塔内沿弧形回廊行走的信徒身影尽数呈现；而他们也能注视每一个走近神殿的人。对预知之神而言，没有任何事物可以隐藏。塔内，一尊高大的神像端坐其间，披袍而坐，双膝大开，空心塔身上方倾泻而下的光流将其照亮。神额头嵌着一只澄透明净的玻璃第三眼，膝上安放着一枚巨大的玻璃宝珠，映出塔顶遥远尖端那令人目眩的倒影。
The temple is a rounded tower—like a lighthouse. Walls of white stone and clear glass reveal adherents walking the curving halls within, who in turn can observe all those who approach the temple. Nothing is concealed from the god of foreknowledge. Inside, a tall statue of the god, robed and seated with knees akimbo, is illuminated by the light streaming down through the hollow tower. A third eye of clear glass is embedded in the god’s forehead, and an enormous glass orb rests in his lap, reflecting a dizzying view of the tower’s distant apex.

Sundries From Thorn Wolves.name:
荆棘狼的杂货
Sundries From Thorn Wolves

Text.text:
在一具倒下的生物那纤维状的脖颈周围，你发现一只磨损的皮项圈，深深嵌进纠结的植物质中。剥落的皮面上，以褪色的字样压印着名字——鲁弗斯。
Around the fibrous neck of one fallen creature, you find a worn leather collar embedded deeply in the tangled plant matter. The name Rufus is embossed in faded lettering on the flaking hide.

Castle Spiral Staircase.name:
城堡螺旋楼梯
Castle Spiral Staircase

Text.text:
这座冷峻城堡的石体之中嵌着一段楼梯，盘旋着贯通各层，最终吐入通往不同走廊的前厅。在这个年代里，这算得上是一处建筑奇观……也逼得来客时刻留神脚下。台阶陡峭得很，稍有笨拙，便可能一路滚落，摔到下一层的地面。
Built into the stone of this austere castle, a staircase spirals between floors, emerging into foyers leading to different corridors. An architectural curiosity in this day and age . . . and one that encourages guests to watch where they step. The stairs are sufficiently steep that any act of clumsiness could send one tumbling to the floor below.

Wall Of Thorns.name:
荆棘之墙
Wall Of Thorns

Text.text:
当你念完咒文，一股诡异的刺痒感自体内攀升而起。你感到力量在体内蓄积。随着一声怒喝，你将其释放，掌中的荆棘猛然疯长，缠绕上你的手——随即在一道闪光中消失。与此同时，一道高耸的荆棘藤墙轰然破土而出。
A strange, prickling sensation rises within you as you complete the incantation. You feel the power building. With a shout, you release it, and the thorns in your hands grow, wrapping themselves about your hand—before vanishing in a flash. In the same instant, a soaring wall of thorny vines erupts.

I Cast Nondetection.name:
我施放「无迹可寻」
I Cast Nondetection

Text.text:
我将闪耀的双手覆上我的目标。刹那间，他们如同宝石般熠熠生辉。我手腕一挥，迅捷如刃地划出一道切割的弧线，那层宝石般的外壳便如玻璃般迸裂粉碎。碎片四散，坠入阴影，归于虚无，随着法术落定。
I lay glittering hands upon my target. For a blink, they shine like a precious stone. I wave my hand in a swift cutting motion and the gem-like outer shell shatters like glass. Pieces scatter into shadow, into nothing, as the spell settles.

记忆不过是你一遍又一遍对自己讲的谎言。心智并不会真正抓住事件，把它们如实的影像映在镜中；相反，它不停地编织、又不停地重织，就像画家一次又一次地重画同一幅肖像。所以，在你的目标心里塞进一段新记忆不过是小事一桩——他们本就一直在对自己撒谎。
A memory is nothing but a lie you tell yourself over and over. The mind doesn't truly capture events and reflect their truth-like image in a mirror. Instead, it constantly crafts and recrafts things, like a painter painting the same portrait again and again. So, it’s a little thing to substitute a new memory in the mind of your target—they’re already lying to themselves.

Academy Entrance Gate.name:
学院入口大门
Academy Entrance Gate

Text.text: 粗砺的暗色石塔四周地势错综复杂。鲜艳的色彩与浓翠的叶片被修剪得蜿蜒有致，既完美得如同大地本该如此，又诡异得仿佛绝非人力所能长久维系。花园之间，一条砖石铺就的车道盘旋而入，继而在大门前豁然开阔。宏伟的拱门以黑铁铸成，藤萝与常春藤肆意攀覆，门宽足可并行三辆马车；拱顶横匾上刻着Eloquii Mystici Scholae，其色泽与明暗会随四季流转而变。 The grounds around the rough, dark stone tower are complicated. The vibrant colors and deep-green leaves are curving and cultivated in a way that seems at once perfectly earthly and impossible to be humanly maintained. Through the gardens, a brick-paved drive curls and then opens out at the gate. Black iron and overgrown with wisteria and ivy, the grand arch spans three carriages in width, and the carved sign across the peak, Eloquii Mystici Scholae, changes shade and color according to the season.

My Shield +2 Deflects A Claw.name:
我的盾牌+2偏转了利爪
My Shield +2 Deflects A Claw

Text.text:
刻在我盾牌上的符文迸发出耀眼的光芒，利爪划过秘银表面，伴随着刺耳的尖啸。我岿然不动，任由附魔金属将这凶猛一击的力量尽数吞纳，盾面竟连一道划痕都未留下。
The runes etched into my shield glow brightly as the claws rake across its mithril surface with a piercing wail. I stand firm as the enchanted metal absorbs the force of the savage blow without a scratch.

Sense Of Mind Being Read.name:
心念被窥读的感觉
Sense Of Mind Being Read

Text.text: 有些不对劲。你的脑袋先是沉得要命，随即又软得过头、轻得发飘。一个新的存在硬生生贴近过来，逆着水流划行——陌生人肮脏的手指探入、拨弄、拉扯，挂住那些脆弱的丝线。接着，那陌生人消失了。你又独自待在你温暖、熟悉的脑海里。赤裸无防。你感觉大脑像是要吐出来。 Something isn't right. Your head is too heavy, then far too soft and light. A new presence pulls itself closer, rowing against the current—a stranger’s dirty fingers, probing and pulling and snagging on fragile threads. Then the stranger vanishes. You are alone in your warm, familiar head. Exposed. And you feel like your brain needs to throw up.

Ancient Temple Ruins Of Ooze-worshipping.name:
古代泥沼崇拜社团的神庙遗迹
Ancient Temple Ruins Of Ooze-worshipping Society

Text.text:
葱郁的灌木在你的刀锋下纷纷倒伏，终于交出了它长久守护的秘密：一片古老的石砌遗迹。其上的刻痕怪异而参差，仿佛不是凿刻而成，而是被刮磨、被灼烧，硬生生烙进石里。丰厚湿润的苔藓像活的颜料般填满沟槽，在这被时代磨损的图案中吐纳着令人目眩的生机。你的目光沿着墙面游走，忽然意识到建造这座神殿的人所崇拜的……并非正统之物。大片墙壁上尽是俯首膜拜的信众，匍匐在无定形、胶质般的神祇之前。

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

Verdant undergrowth falls beneath your blade, surrendering its long held secret: ancient stonework. The markings upon it are strange and uneven, as if scoured or burned into the stone rather than carved. Lush, wet moss fills the openings like living pigment, breathing vertiginous life into the time-worn artwork. As your gaze travels over the walls you realize that the people who created this temple worshipped… unorthodox beings. Much of the temple wall is covered in depictions of bowing worshippers, prostrate before formless gelatinous deities.

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

Magic Ritual Changes The Balance Of Powe.name:
魔法仪式改变了力量的平衡
Magic Ritual Changes The Balance Of Power

Text.text:
现实的织锦被一阵涟漪扰动，仿佛有什么东西悄然移位。刹那间，世界停住了呼吸，带着同样的好奇与惶惧凝成一体；一股令人脊背发寒的触感席卷施法者，胃里猛地一沉。寒毛倒竖，虚空里灌满了沉默——那沉默裹着恶意的寄望城，沉甸甸地压下来。

~ 由 Daroneasa 在 Discord 上 构想

A ripple disturbs the fabric of reality as something shifts. For a moment the world pauses, united in curious dread, as a spine-tingling sensation washes over the caster and turns their stomach. Hairs prickle, and a silence—laden with malicious promise—fills the void.

~ Envisioned by Daroneasa on Discord

Dragon's Breath (Acid) Cast On Self.name:
龙息（酸蚀）施放于自身
Dragon's Breath (Acid) Cast On Self

Text.text:
一阵咕噜作响的嗝声从你喉间爆发，空气里翻涌着腐蚀性的能量。你眯起眼，满是轻蔑，从小袋里取出一枚胡椒。你扭曲的唇间溢出咕嘟冒泡的咒词，同时以指尖接触自己的胸口。就在你的嘴不可思议地张大到极限时，一股翡翠色、蒸腾滚烫的酸液洪流猛然喷射，直奔你的目标。

~ Played by Donnie

A gargling belch erupts from your throat, the air seething with corrosive energy. Your eyes narrow with disdain, and you bring forth a pepper from your pouch. Bubbling words spill from your twisting lips as you touch your chest. When your mouth begins to yawn impossibly wide, an emerald stream of steaming acid bursts out toward your target.

~ Played by Donnie

Nightmare About A Kraken Crushing You.name:
关于海妖克拉肯将你碾碎的噩梦
Nightmare About A Kraken Crushing You

Text.text:
你在冰冷中醒来，四肢僵硬得不听使唤，仿佛躺在一片扭曲的现实里。你身下传来湿黏而沉重的肉块蠕动声，随着每一秒流逝逼得更近。粗厚、布满吸盘的触手带着令人血液冻结的必然，沿着你的胸口蜿蜒爬行。你只能躺着。无助。你想呼喊，可嗓音被夺走，任你张口尖叫也泄不出半点声音。触手缠上你的身体，越收越紧，你感觉肋骨在它们无情的压迫下咔嚓断裂。木头迸裂般的碎响与绝望的哀求一并灌进耳中，眩晕般地轰鸣；更多触手将你牢牢套住，搅动着碎裂的骨头，把痛苦推向撕裂神经的顶点。

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

You awake frozen, your limbs unwilling to follow your commands as you lie in a distorted reality. From beneath you the sounds of a wet, heavy mass move closer with each passing moment. Thick, suckered tentacles slither across your chest with blood-chilling inevitability as you lie there. Helpless. You try to call out but your voice has been stolen, and no sound escapes your screaming mouth. The tentacles wrap around you, pulling tight, and you feel ribs crack beneath their merciless onslaught. The sound of splintering wood and desperate pleas fill your ears in a dizzying assault as more tentacles ensnare you, agitating the splintered bones into an agonizing crescendo.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

这条小小的龙披着蓝、绿、紫相间的鳞片，皆泛着一层银色微光。它那如蝴蝶般的革质翅膀缓缓扇动，偶尔轻轻一颤，随着甩动的尾巴一同合着节拍。巨大的眼睛让它显得天真又爱闹，配上嘴角始终挂着的坏笑，更添几分俏皮的性相。
The tiny dragon has scales of blue, green, and violet, all with a silvery shimmer. Leathery wings shaped like those of a butterfly move slowly, with occasional flutters, in time with a swishing tail. The dragon’s outsized eyes lend it an innocent, playful aspect—as does its constant smirk.

Loot From A Sea Serpent Lair.name:
海蛇巢穴的战利品
Loot From A Sea Serpent Lair

Text.text:
一艘巨轮的船壳像蛋壳般在嶙峋的海山上裂开，露出一道豁口，轻易便能下到船体的幽深腹地。其间，你发现一堆闪烁的宝藏——成排破碎的箱子倾倒而出，钱币四散流淌。仍有些箱子扣锁未开，箱面攀附着皱脸般的藤壶，以及其他海底滋生物，绿、白、粉交织成斑驳的覆层。
The hull of a massive ship lies cracked like an eggshell on a jagged seamount, making it easy to descend into the bowels of the vessel. Within, you find a glittering hoard of coins, spilled from rows of broken chests. Some chests remain clasped shut, adorned with pucker-faced barnacles and other undersea growths of green, white, and pink.

Dry Riverbed And Waterfall.name:
干涸河床与瀑布
Dry Riverbed And Waterfall

Text.text:
浓稠凝滞的淤泥与腐烂的植被铺成河床，如今诡异地毫无生机。臃肿的鱼尸散落在恶臭的污泥中——被污秽与坏疽撑得鼓胀——宛如被遗忘道路上的噩梦卵石。河源那峭壁之下的深潭，不过是一座盛满秽物的尸窖；上方瀑布曾经原始的轰鸣，如今在林间幽暗里死一般沉寂。

~ 由 Samuel B 构想

Thick, stagnant mud and rotting vegetation form the bed of the river, now eerily devoid of life. The bloated corpses of fish litter the fetid muck—swelled with effluence and gangrene—like nightmarish cobbles on a forgotten road. The plunge pool beneath the towering cliff at the river’s source is little more than a charnel pit of waste, the primal roar of the falls above now deathly silent in the gloom of the forest.

~ Envisioned by Samuel B

Commuters Rubberneck Past A Road Acciden.name:
通勤人群驻足围观一场交通事故
Commuters Rubberneck Past A Road Accident

Text.text:
车流逐渐爬行般缓慢，每个通勤者都忍不住放慢速度，只为看清路边那团纠缠扭曲的金属残骸。身着黑色制服的警员试图挡住视线，挥手催促车辆继续前行，但那一路延伸的破碎残片与飞溅的血迹，根本无从遮掩。
Traffic becomes a crawl as each commuter can't help but slow to get a better look at the tangled mess of metal on the side of the road. Black-clad officers try to block the view and wave cars onward, but it's hard to hide the trail of wreckage and blood splatter.

Inscribed Stone Coffin.name:
铭刻石棺
Inscribed Stone Coffin

Text.text:
这口棺椁乍看并无异样，直到棺盖上端映入眼帘。石面上刻着死亡的征兆，旁侧还有一串以朴素、粗重线条勾勒的符号。这些雕刻并非用来点缀装饰，而是要尽可能长久地保持醒目、清晰可辨——一则警告。
The coffin seems innocuous enough, until the top of the lid comes into view. Signs of death are etched into the stone, along with a series of symbols in plain, bold lines. These carvings weren’t meant as decorative embellishment, they were meant to remain conspicuous and legible for as long as possible: a warning.

Dragon: A Powerful Creature.name:
巨龙：强大的生物
Dragon: A Powerful Creature

Text.text:
巨龙的怒火不再像从前那样令你胆寒，但它依旧强大得惊人。你明白这生物不过如此：强大、充满魔力，或许甚至是元素化身——但它仍是有血有肉、会呼吸的存在，而非不可阻挡的天灾。战局的潮水也许尚未倒转，可你已不再觉得自己是在与整片海洋厮杀。
The dragon’s anger no longer terrifies you as it once did, but it still proves powerful. You know the creature to be just that: powerful, magical, perhaps even an elemental being, but a living, breathing thing—not an unstoppable force. The tide of the battle might not yet have turned, but you no longer feel as though you’re fighting the ocean.

Dueling Bards.name:
决斗吟游诗人
Dueling Bards

Text.text:
不和谐的喧嚣声浪灌满夜空，两名衣着绚丽的人影彼此相对而立，各自争夺着人群的目光——那群听众正屏息惊叹。奥术能量的闪光在每位吟游诗人周身盘旋飞舞，昭示着他们奏出的乐声如何拨动造物的本质，将其随音符一并操弄。
A disharmonious cacophony of sound fills the night air as two colorfully dressed figures stand opposite each other, each vying for the attention of the crowd that is listening with awe. Flashes of arcane energy twirl around each bard, evidence of how their music manipulates the essence of creation itself as they play.

Screech Owl Familiar.name:
尖啸猫头鹰魔宠
Screech Owl Familiar

Text.text:
这可能是你见过最惹人厌的猫头鹰：随时准备纠正、训斥、评判，并把每一桩“罪过”传得半里地内人尽皆知。尖啸鸮的羽毛看起来像旧乡村毛衣与树皮混在一起。她虽轻盈迅捷，却不算最称职的送信鸮；但对自己的法师却有着母性般的忠诚——哪怕对旁人再怎么刻薄。
This may be the most obnoxious owl you’ve ever met: ready to correct, scold, judge, and tell everyone within a half mile about each offense. The screech owl’s feathers resemble a combination of an old country sweater and tree bark. Although light and fast she isn’t the best delivery owl, but she is maternally loyal to her wizard, however harsh she might be with others.

Loot From A Vicious Slaver.name:
从凶残奴隶贩子身上搜刮的战利品
Loot From A Vicious Slaver

Text.text:
在奴隶贩子那具汗津津、满是麻点的尸体上，你找到他的鞭子，以及几件花里胡哨的小玩意儿，或许能卖个不错的价格。一只做成獠牙形状的俗艳耳环垂在他一侧肥厚的耳垂上，几枚黄铜与白镴戒指——外覆一层薄薄的金箔，如今正剥落起皮——套在他粗短油腻的手指上。
On the slaver’s sweaty, pock-marked corpse you find his whip, and some gaudy baubles that may fetch a decent price. A garish earring fashioned in the shape of a tusk hangs from one of his fatty lobes, and several brass and pewter rings—with a thin, peeling veneer of gold—adorn thick, greasy fingers.

森林下层植被间投下的阴影，黑得深不见底，仿佛你在地下见过的任何幽暗都不过如此。伐木工口中的“寡妇制造者”——那些半倒未倒的枯树——无处不在。明亮的眼睛从朽木的空洞里、从肥沃腐殖土与盘根错节间掏出的洞穴里窥视着你。四周繁盛的生命汇成一片背景喧嚣：无尽的吱吱啁啾与不停的移动，预告着只要踏入它的疆界，夜晚便注定难以安稳休息。
The shadows cast in the understory of the forest are as dark and infinite as any you’ve seen underground. The half-fallen trees known to lumberjacks as "widow-makers" are ever-present. Bright eyes peer at you from log hollows and burrows dug out of the rich loam and root structures. The teeming life surrounding you provides a background cacophony: endless chittering and movement promising nights of uneasy rest within its boundaries.

I Enchant My Backpack To Levitate.name:
我给背包装上悬浮附魔
I Enchant My Backpack To Levitate

Text.text:
我俯身凑近背包，它的缝线被我硬塞进去的杂物撑得咯吱作响。我用专注轻轻戳了戳它，低声呢喃着魔法的鼓励词。片刻静止后，背带开始漂浮起来……可背包那沉甸甸的负载却纹丝不动。我又念了一遍咒语，这次更为强硬，并带着挑衅般的手势一挥。背带倔强地向上猛拽了两下，终于整只背包猛地一挺，被抬离地面。我立刻感觉肩头一松，背包便像蝴蝶般轻盈地随我飘荡，带起一阵阵细碎的轻拂。
I lean over my backpack, its seams straining with all the items I’ve managed to stuff into it. I poke at it with my focus, whispering magical words of encouragement. After a moment of stillness, the straps begin to levitate… but the bulk of the pack refuses to budge. I say the words again, more demanding this time, and add a defiant flourish. The straps make two willful tugs upward until finally the entire pack heaves forth into the air. I feel the relief in my shoulders immediately as the pack follows me in delicate wafts like a butterfly.

你将武器高高举起，锋芒间噼啪作响，涌动着一股不稳定的能量。你的劈击将电流猛然贯入敌人体内的下一瞬，你看见他们肌肉骤然绷紧，双眼圆睁，牙关死死咬合。你的雷霆火花穿行于他们全身，蓄势待发——只待敌人一动，便会立刻炸开为一记震耳欲聋的音爆。明知如此，你或许会故意挑衅，逼他们迈出那决定命运的一步。

~ Envisioned by paradigmblue

As you hold your weapon aloft, it crackles with an unstable energy. A second after your strike propels electricity into your foe, you see their muscles tense, their eyes widen, their teeth clench. Your thunderspark traverses their body, primed to explode in a sonic blast the instant your enemy moves. Knowing this, you might goad them into taking that fateful step.

~ Envisioned by paradigmblue

海浪轻拍岸线，带着悦耳的哗啦声拨动卵石。每一块石头都独一无二，色泽各异，铺展出黑、灰、棕、绿与蓝交织的景致。潮汐不知疲倦，终将把它们尽数吞没；但此刻，它们仍在阳光下闪闪发亮。
The sea laps against the shore, dislodging pebbles with a pleasant clatter. Each rock unique, each a different hue, creating vistas of blacks, grays, browns, greens, and blues. The tide, incessant, will swallow them all, but for now they lie gleaming in the sun.

Person In Tattered, Fine Clothes.name:
衣衫褴褛却仍显华贵的人
Person In Tattered, Fine Clothes

Text.text:
那红眼男人看起来像是同一身衣服穿了一周，脸上也至少有那么久没让剃刀碰过了。衣服本身倒挺体面，像是贵族出席华宴时会穿的款式，可其上的污渍与褶皱却暗示着他近来睡的灌木丛比床铺还多。
The red-eyed man looks like he’s been wearing the same clothes for a week, and it’s been at least that long since his face met with a razor. The clothes look fine, like something a noble might wear to a fancy occasion, but the stains and wrinkles seem to suggest he’s slept in more bushes than beds of late.

Void Zombie.name:
虚空丧尸（特征）
Void Zombie

Text.text:
也许你面前的东西曾经是个人类。皮肤破碎溃烂，衣衫褴褛，却以一种令人不安的敏捷移动——一点也不像你印象中的典型丧尸（特征）。它松垂的下颌张着，僵死无力；有什么像舌头的东西探出，嗅探着空气，但那其实是一条猩红而修长的触须，裹满了诡异的消化黏液。触须牵引着这具虚空丧尸（特征）向前蠕行，搜寻猎物。
Perhaps the thing before you was once human. Skin frayed and rotting, clothes in tatters, it moves with a disconcerting agility—not like your typical zombie. The pendulous jaw hangs open and inert, and something like a tongue protrudes, sensing the air, but it is a long scarlet tendril slathered in strange digestive juices. The tendril pulls the void zombie forward in search of prey.

Fairfax Godwin-yardley, Founder Of House.name:
费尔法克斯·戈德温-亚德利，龙之公馆的奠基者
Fairfax Godwin-yardley, Founder Of House Dragon

Text.text:
在诸位创始人之中，最负盛名的便是费尔法克斯。他几乎有七英尺高，蓄着宽阔的金色大胡子与上翘的髭须；头顶光秃，眼上罩着眼罩。据说他有一只眼睛竟是一块煤炭般的黑炭，甚至有人怀疑他最初并非看似的人类，而是一条巨龙。  

他每日的装束是一袭紫色天鹅绒长袍，领口宽阔，袍摆镶着白貂皮。由他撰写的《魔杖法典》是研究魔杖历史与精通之道的权威标准。他富有、严苛、古怪，令人从头到脚都感到不寒而栗。
The most famous of the founders, Fairfax stood nearly seven feet tall and sported a broad blond beard and mustachios. He also had a bald head and wore an eyepatch. He was reputed to have had a coal for one eye and may have originally been a dragon rather than the human he appeared to be. His daily wardrobe consisted of a robe of purple velvet, broadly collared and hemmed in white ermine. His Codex of Wands is the standard for wand history and mastery. He was wealthy, strict, eccentric, and altogether unnerving.

你将手中的物体举起，如同护身符一般，吐出法术的最后一个字。空间与光在你的敌人周围扭曲——仿佛现实裂开了一个陷坑。紧接着，一声巨响炸开，像一扇门被猛然摔上；一道涟漪似乎自此向整个世界荡开，随后光、空间与时代一同归于常态。
You raise the object in your hand like a talisman and spit the final word of the spell. Space and light warp around your enemy—as if reality has opened a sinkhole. Then there’s a great bang, like a door being slammed shut, and a ripple seems to go out through the world before light, space, and time return to normal.

Pixies Taunt Adventurers.name:
小妖精戏弄冒险者
Pixies Taunt Adventurers

Text.text:
这些小东西在你触及之外气人地跳着舞，从它们安全的树洞里嘲弄你。它们咯咯笑得欢畅，扇动着微小的薄纱翅膀蹦跳飞掠，用下流的手势和冗长押韵的嘲歌奚落你。可它们藏身的那棵树却让你心头一紧——那根树枝刚才是不是顶着风动了一下？

~ Leprekorn 于 Discord

The tiny creatures dance infuriatingly out of reach as they taunt you from the safety of their hollow. Giggling with delight, they caper and flit about on tiny gossamer wings as they mock you with obscene gestures and elaborate rhymes. Though, there is something about the tree they hide in which gives you pause—did that branch just move against the wind?

~ Leprekorn on Discord

Duergar Bombardier.name:
灰矮人投弹手
Duergar Bombardier

Text.text: 这名生物身披从一位早已作古的学者身上偷来的长袍——还特意裁改得贴合她那矮小的身形——透过一副放大护目镜审视着你，浑身散发出阴沉而精确的算计气息。她的胯侧叮当作响，挂着数十只玻璃瓶，每一只都泛着不同的磷光色泽，每一只都比蝮蛇的毒液更致命。她反握着其中一枚炼金手雷，蓄势待发；另一只手则捧着一本写满公式的笔记本，把距离、速度、风速与引爆半径一并纳入计算。她腰间还挂着一柄战锤，但那更像是用来平衡她甩动的投掷臂，而不是为了挥砸。事实上，当你的目光掠过她的投掷手臂时，你注意到那条手臂比她的另一只手粗了整整一倍……仿佛在她一生的研究里，已经抛掷过多得不健康的投射物。 Wearing robes stolen from a long-dead scholar—tailored to fit her diminutive frame—the creature before you reeks of sinister calculation as she eyes you through a pair of magnifying goggles. At her hip clink dozens of glass bottles, each a different phosphorescent hue, each more dangerous than viper venom. She holds one of these alchemical grenades in a cocked-back grip, while her other hand holds a notebook full of formulas incorporating distance, velocity, windspeed, and ignition radii. A warhammer rides her hip, but it seems like it is there more to counterbalance her swinging arm than it is to be swung. In fact, as your gaze roves over her throwing arm, you note that it is twice as thick as her off hand… as if she has lobbed an unhealthy number of projectiles in her lifetime of research.

Insult To A Defeated Foe.name:
对败敌的羞辱
Insult To A Defeated Foe

Text.text:
“就这点本事？！你就只剩这些了？我见到你时，还以为这场战斗能让我大快朵颐——结果不过是塞牙缝的小点心。”
“Is that all?! Is that all you have left? When I saw you, I expected our battle to satisfy my appetite, but this was barely a snack.”

Alien Prison Guard.name:
异形监狱看守
Alien Prison Guard

Text.text:
那外星人一双间距很宽的眼睛因疲惫而耷拉着，从一排安保面板前抬起头来望向你。“帮你？”他们用颤悠悠的嗓音问道，一边调整那顶形状古怪的帽子。又或许古怪的其实是他们的脑袋。他们抚平制服上的褶皱，竭力挺起身子，做出一副英勇的端正姿态。
