The alien’s pair of wide-set eyes droop in exhaustion as they look up from an array of security panels. “Help you?” they ask in a warbling voice, adjusting their oddly shaped hat. Or maybe it’s their head that’s oddly shaped. They smooth out the wrinkles in their uniform and make a valiant effort to straighten their posture.

Blue Elemental Slime.name:
蓝色元素黏液
Blue Elemental Slime

Text.text:
水样的黏液凝结成一座冰山，轮廓隐约像某种有意识的东西：短短的手臂，蓝白色的冰崖作头颅，渐渐硬化。随即它动了——伴着仿佛千道裂痕齐鸣的声响，如雪泥般变幻无常，又重新塑形。它不断开裂、不断开裂，又向前滑行，转动那峭壁般的头颅，扭曲苍淡的蓝色躯团，随后再一次结晶成形。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The watery slime forms to a berg of ice, shaped vaguely like something aware, with short arms and a precipice of blue-white ice as a head, hardening. Then it moves with the sound of a thousand cracks, as mercurial as slush, and re-forms. It cracks and cracks and slides forward again, turning its cliff of a head, twisting its pale blue mass, and then crystallizing once more.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

远处随风飘来的嗡鸣声骤然炸裂成骇人的轰响——一艘飞艇如火箭般掠过，穿针引线般从城中最高的塔楼间疾驰而过。紧接着，更离奇的景象映入眼帘！一枚细长的水晶圆盘破空疾射，灼热地紧追其后；在它鲁莽的速度带起的残影里，你瞥见一群喧闹嚎叫的豺狼人，死死攀附在那艘怪异的飞行器上，却已摩拳擦掌，准备登上另一艘。
A whirring sound carried over the wind from a distance suddenly erupts into a frightful chunder as an airship rockets by, threading between the city’s highest towers. And then, an even more curious sight to behold! An elongated crystal disk streaks through the air in hot pursuit, and in the blur of its reckless speed you make out a group of rollicking, howling gnolls, clinging onto their strange craft, but readying to board the other.

Half-melted Dragon's Hoard.name:
半融的龙之宝库
Half-melted Dragon's Hoard

Text.text:
宝藏曾经的商贾辉煌，被这场破坏彻底玷污，已无可挽回。昔日那如山脉般闪耀的黄金与珍贵宝石，如今只剩一座银白的熔渣堆，光泽被灼烧殆尽。更添悲怆的是，四周残存的藏品遗骸仍高高俯视着它，仿佛在为这场惨烈的失落默哀。

~ 构想：David，发表于 Discord

The mercantile splendor of the hoard has been irreparably tarnished by the damage. Where once a mountain range of glittering gold and precious gems stood, there is now an argent slag heap, its luster burned away. The tragedy of the loss is heightened further by the remnants of the collection that look down upon it, as if mourning a grievous loss.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Blind Mage Casting Blindsight.name:
失明法师施展盲视
Blind Mage Casting Blindsight

Text.text:
法师的双眼闪烁着磷光般的能量，在他们完成法术的瞬间，目光猛然与你相接。他们朝你走来，先前那缓慢而审慎的步伐被大胆、自信的阔步取代。你这才注意到，他们已不再倚靠法杖来引路。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The mage’s eyes glow with phosphorescent energy as they complete the spell and suddenly meet your gaze. They walk toward you, bold, confident strides replacing the slow, methodical steps they had previously taken. You notice then that they’re no longer using a staff to guide their way.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Riverside Border Town In Winter.name:
冬日河畔边境镇
Riverside Border Town In Winter

Text.text:
你朝守着桥的裹毛卫兵点头致意，拖着沉重的步子走进镇里。潮湿的烂泥灌满雾蒙蒙的街道，肮脏的灰雪堆成一垛垛，紧贴着矮胖的屋舍。外头几乎见不到行人；偶尔有的，也因身上披着层层兽皮，看起来更像熊而非人。
Nodding to the fur-swathed folk guarding the bridge, you trudge into town. Wet sludge fills the misty streets, and mounds of dirty gray snow are piled against the squat houses. Few folk are abroad, and those that are look more like bears than people because of the many hides they wear.

Slavers' Convoy.name:
奴隶贩子的车队
Slavers' Convoy

Text.text:
十几辆货车在大地上滚滚前行，每一辆都载着沉重的囚笼——厚重橡木打造，外覆黑铁加固——排成一线，宛如行军的蚁群。笼中人影蜷缩成团，遮挡风雨尘土，许多人低声呜咽，彼此喃喃自语。护卫们披着轻甲，手持警棍，贴着车队步行，不时敲打铁栏，冲囚徒厉声呵斥，催促他们听令。
A dozen wagons, each carrying cages constructed of heavy oak reinforced with black iron, roll across the landscape like ants marching in a line. Figures sit huddled inside, shielding themselves from the elements. Many whimper and mutter amongst themselves. Guards, lightly armored and carrying truncheons, walk beside the carts, banging on the bars and barking orders to the captives.

A Familiar, Outer Plane.name:
一只魔宠，外层位面
A Familiar, Outer Plane

Text.text:
真奇怪，你想着。这个地方诡异地熟悉。你看见一些建筑与地标，都是你所知晓的模样。你看见认得的面孔，听见无数次听过的乐曲。你莫名地感到安宁，但这地方又带着一丝挥之不去的异世感。云层裂开，你望见一座山岳般的尖塔，真正的高度令人目眩。
Strange, you think. This place is oddly familiar. You see structures, landmarks known to you. Faces you recognize, music you've heard countless times. You feel oddly at peace, but there's a nagging otherwordliness to this place. The clouds part, and you see a mountainous spire, its true height dizzying.

Seedy Cyberpunk Bar.name:
乌烟瘴气的赛博朋克酒吧
Seedy Cyberpunk Bar

Text.text:
你推开双扇弹簧门走进来，鼻腔立刻被汗味与机油的辛辣气息刺了一下。霓虹灯在这间灰败的酒吧里明明灭灭，里面坐了半满的客人：一双双阴沉的眼睛，窝在污渍斑斑的沙发上，大口灌着麦芽酒。一个肮脏臃肿的酒保抬眼看向你。空气里绷着一根弦；也许你并不受欢迎。可就在这时，酒吧那层油腻的伪装像被抹去般褪色——某种古怪的科技启动了。两名美艳舞者踏着步子，昂首阔步登上近旁的桌面；紧接着，薰衣草的香气飘来，再然后是一连串精致的烟火。增强现实只让这间酒吧的污秽模糊了短短一瞬。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

A tang of sweat and oil meets your nose as you enter through double swing doors. Neon lights flash across the drab interior of this bar, half full of dark-eyed patrons perched on stained couches and swilling malt liquor. A grubby, portly bartender looks up as you enter. There’s a tense mood in the air; perhaps you’re not welcome here. And then, the greasy façade of the bar fades as some strange tech kicks in. Two beautiful dancers strut atop a nearby table, then there’s the smell of lavender, then a series of boutique fireworks. The augmented reality clouds the griminess of the bar for just a moment.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Smiting Critical Hit.name:
惩戒性大成功或大失败
Smiting Critical Hit

Text.text:
一道炽烈的光束自天穹直贯而下，照在你身上。夏之神握住你武器的剑柄，祂的手覆上你的手，金与肉如同二重奏般交叠，一同挥击。那一击回响如教堂的钟声。
An intense beam of light shines down on you from the sky. The god of summer grabs the hilt of your weapon, their hand over yours like a duet of gold and flesh, and strikes. The blow rings like a church bell.

Alex Carria.name:
亚历克斯·卡里亚
Alex Carria

Text.text:
年轻人双臂交叉抱在胸前，仿佛正死死按住什么，免得它逃走——像一个秘密，或他们的心。头颅前垂，几缕棕色发丝从那条一尘不染的白色蝴蝶结束缚下坠落出来，微微遮住他们明亮而警惕的眼睛。他们一只手紧攥着一截看似树枝的东西：白色树皮被横向划开，露出一道道深如焦痕的条纹。

~ 由 MortalWombat 扮演

The young person crosses their arms across their chest, as if holding something down so it might not escape—like a secret, or their heart. Their head hangs forward, wisps of brown locks falling from the bind of the spotless white bow tying back their hair, the wisps slightly obscuring their bright and wary eyes. They hold what looks like a branch clenched in one hand: white bark slashed horizontally with stripes dark like burns.

~ Played by MortalWombat

Surveillance Drone Explodes Into Shrapne.name:
监视无人机爆成漫天弹片
Surveillance Drone Explodes Into Shrapnel

Text.text:
监视无人机看起来还算稳定，多组螺旋桨嗡嗡作响，镜头来回转动。紧接着，它像爆开的爆米花一样炸裂。破片向四面八方激射，狠狠嵌进一切可供扎入的表面。
The surveillance drone seems stable enough, its multiple propellers buzzing along as the lens of its camera swivels back and forth. Then it bursts like a popcorn kernel. Shrapnel flies in every direction, embedding itself in any available surface.

这条磨旧的皮革投石索显然是为半身人的手掌尺寸打造的。然而，它仍能顺畅地贴合在你的掌心。投石索的索囊内侧绣着一枚褪色的四叶草——也许一点好运会沾到弹丸上，在呼啸飞出前先眷顾它一瞬？
This worn leather sling was clearly made for halfling-sized hands. Nevertheless, it settles easily in your grip. A faded four-leaf clover has been embroidered on the inside of the sling’s pouch—perhaps a little good luck rubs off on the sling’s missile before speeding off?

玩家们在村外的绿地上碰头，在两端立下目标点。一个由树根与枯叶紧紧团成、塞进缝好的粗麻袋里的球，被放在正中央；两队分开列阵，各自排开。最魁梧最硬气的玩家站在一边，球在场地上来回被踢得飞起又落下时，他一路横冲直撞，把比赛踢得满是淤青与碰撞。可另一边，却有个更矮小却更迅捷的人——脚步轻快、脑子灵活，跑位又准又刁。
The players meet on the green outside the village and stake out goals at each end. The ball of roots and leaves, packed tightly into a sewn burlap bag, is placed at the center as the teams divide and line up. The biggest and toughest player is on one side, bruising his way through the game as the ball is kicked up and down the field. The other side, however, has someone smaller but faster, quick-footed and smart.

Greetings From A Song Bird.name:
来自鸣禽的问候
Greetings From A Song Bird

Text.text:
“日安！这笨拙的生物想要什么？如此凄惨，还困在泥土里。要不要来一首我拿手的欢快乐曲？你或许永远触及不到我的高度，但我保证，我的歌会让你的心高高翱翔。”
“Good day! What does this clumsy creature want? So miserable and trapped in the dirt. Perhaps a cheerful song from my repertoire? You may never reach my heights, but I promise my songs will make your heart soar.”

白熊柔软的白毛下，肌肉起伏如波。它的黑鼻头像一小块纯煤疙瘩，眼睛则是黑曜石般的珠子。一只爪子接着一只爪子，每只都有餐盘般大小，懒洋洋地抬起，又砸在冰面上发出闷响。当这头白熊直立起身，张开那张幽暗的嘴，你能感到一种骇人的存在——一头披着天使外衣的纯粹野兽。
The bear ripples with muscle under its soft white fur. Its black nose is like a small lump of pure coal, the eyes obsidian beads. One paw after another, each the size of a serving dish, lifts lazily and thumps onto the ice. When the white bear stands and opens its dark mouth, you feel the terrifying presence of a pure savage wearing the coat of an angel.

Swift Shapeshifter Transforming Into Bes.name:
迅捷变形者：化作兽性形态
Swift Shapeshifter Transforming Into Bestial Form

Text.text:
那道人形身影疾冲向前，纵跃翻攀，越过前路的重重障碍。他一边奔跑一边俯身，四肢落地的刹那，速度骤然攀升，步态由奔行化作野兽般的疾掠。毛发迅速蔓延覆上全身，鼻梁拉长成狼般的长吻；伴随一记凌空高跃，那人形彻底蜕变，化作一头狼形怪兽。

~ 构想 by ​Chenzira

The humanoid figure sprints forward, leaping and clambering over obstacles in their path. They stoop as they run, their speed increasing as they drop to all fours, now loping along like a wild beast. Fur overtakes their appearance, their nose elongating into a lupine snout, and with a soaring leap, the humanoid shifts fully into a wolflike form.

~ Envisioned by ​Chenzira

Insult About God's Chosen.name:
侮辱神之选民
Insult About God's Chosen

Text.text:
“你举手投足，仿佛是被神祇选中的人。可我眼里看到的，只是神明那扭曲幽默感的铁证。”
“You carry yourself as if you were chosen by the gods. All I see is proof that the divine has a twisted sense of humor.”

染血的手指将一枚圣徽死死按在尸体胸口，双眼——因恐慌与绝望而圆睁——却无神地凝望着门口。牧师苍白的皮肤下，难以计数的静脉与毛细血管纵横交错，仿佛在雕琢的大理石上延展的纹理。锁子甲的环扣被血凝结缚住，随着生命之血的奔涌而定形，像礼仪法衣上浆硬挺的布料般将其牢牢固定。
Bloodied fingers clutch a holy symbol to the corpse’s chest, and eyes—wide with panic and desperation—stare lifelessly at the doorway. The cleric’s pallid skin reveals innumerable veins and capillaries crisscrossing like seams through sculpted marble. Chainmail rings have been bound in blood where the vitae poured forth, holding them in place like the starched cloth of ceremonial vestments.

出城向西的道路会带你穿过威肯桥，这是方圆数英里内唯一的过河通道。人们常倚着石栏，听着古德威克河水从桥墩间淌过的声响，眺望那片葱郁的乡野。北面可见大威奇岛——一处以古老而诡奇的珍宝闻名的所在。
The western road out of the city takes you across the Wickenbridge, the only crossing for miles in either direction. Folk often lean against the stone railing, listening to the Good Wick flow through the piers and admiring the lush countryside. Greatwych Isle, a site known for its old, strange treasures, is visible to the north.

这件物体会替你承载讯息，但在此之前，你必须先准备法术。你从蜂巢取来蜂巢蜜蜡，又从商人处购得玉粉，将符文细细刻写其上；符文随即沉入物体表面，隐没得再也辨不出来。你朗声说出要传递的话语，将自己的声音灌入物体之中；继而以一连串繁复的手势，将讯息锁进一组触发事件之后。
The object will carry your message, but first you must prepare the spell. With honeycomb gathered from a bee's nest and jade dust procurred from a merchant, you inscribe the runes, which settle into the surface of the object and become indiscernible. You speak aloud your message, imbuing the object with your voice, and through an intricate series of gestures, lock the message behind a set of triggering events.

并不是说那柄银色的晨星锤——锤柄末端嵌着一颗未经打磨的蓝宝石——真的轻若鸿毛。恰恰相反，这种足以粉碎一切的武器正是仰赖自身重量，才能将护甲砸得扭曲塌陷。但当你将它紧紧握住时，你会发现：举起、挥动、掌控这件武器的轨迹，竟轻松得像用一把锋利小刀切开盘中的肉。
It isn’t that the silver morningstar with the unpolished sapphire in its pommel is truly light as a feather. On the contrary, such a crushing weapon is dependent on its weight for buckling armor. But when you clutch it, you find that lifting, swinging, and controlling the weapon’s motion is as easy as using a sharp knife to cut your meat.

一团被腐化代码搅动的漩涡——其中恶意恶软的触须翻涌蠕动——在你面前那东西幽魂般的形体里脉动不息。它虽小，却不容小觑：这是为网络战而生的精密混沌造物，被编程成对所遇一切释放凶残的算法猛袭。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

A swirling vortex of corrupted code—teeming with tendrils of malevolent malware—pulsates within the ghostly form of the thing before you. Although small, whatever this is seems formidable, a creation of meticulous chaos designed for cyber warfare. It has been programmed to unleash savage algorithmic assaults on anything it faces.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Archon Of Falling Stars.name:
坠落星辰的执政官
Archon Of Falling Stars

Text.text:
这位褐肤天界者抛光如镜的胸甲与长角头盔在她所持长矛的光辉里熠熠生辉——那光芒炽烈得如正午烈日，几乎令人目盲。她从坐骑背上一跃而下：那头壮丽的翼牛披着珍珠般的毛色，六支弯曲的银角与骑手头盔上的角相互辉映。她落地的瞬间，目光电闪，随即将长矛的矛杆狠狠砸入大地，向太阳与苍穹的灵魂发出感召。她周遭的空中骤然迸现幽灵般的身影——每一个都光耀夺目，美丽而凶猛的性相宛如神怒，并各自擎着一柄灿然的光矛。
The burnished breastplate and horned helm of this brown-skinned celestial gleam in the radiance—blinding as the noonday sun—of the spear she carries as she leaps from her mount. That magnificent, winged ox has a pearly coat and six curving, silvery horns that match those of its rider’s helmet. Her eyes flash as she lands, then slams the spear’s haft into the earth, calling to the spirits of sun and sky. Ghostly shapes burst into being in the air around her. Each one is luminous, beautiful but fierce in aspect, and carries its own radiant spear.

Sundries From A Roc Nest.name:
巨鹏巢中的杂物
Sundries From A Roc Nest

Text.text:
巢穴像一团高达百尺的纠结乱林：整棵大树、断裂的马车残躯、散落的车轮，甚至还有一根船桅都被拖拽堆叠其间。一堆破烂的船帆裹着三枚高耸的巨卵——每一枚至少七尺高，骨白色的卵壳上斑驳点缀着蓝与红的细小斑点。
The nest is a hundred-foot tangle of full trees, the broken body of a carriage, wagon wheels, and even a ship’s mast. A pile of ratty sails nestle a trio of tall eggs—each at least seven feet in height, their bone-white shells mottled with blue and red speckles.

Caravan Master Elroy.name:
商队领队埃尔罗伊
Caravan Master Elroy

Text.text:
一抹瞪圆了眼的笑容由参差不齐的獠牙拼成，让这名魁梧的龙裔显得讨喜而憨直。他的笑意能卸下旁人的戒心——这话可不轻，毕竟他身形又宽又高，紫色鳞片覆体，金色眼眸灼亮，灰色犄角如岩。他用左手揉着下巴，那只手少了一根无名指。朴素的外套、长衫与长裤压住了他非凡的气势；腰带上磨旧的鞘也同样低调，里面各插着一把匕首与一柄短剑。背上斜挂着一面小盾和一把弩，旁边还扣着装弩矢的箭匣，件件都有着频繁使用的痕迹。

~ Played by Kairion

A wide-eyed grin composed of uneven fangs lends this immense dragonborn a pleasant, simple seeming. His smile disarms others. That’s saying something, considering his immense girth and height, and his purple scales, golden eyes, and gray horns. He rubs his chin with his left hand, which lacks a ring finger. His plain coat, tunic, and pants belie his extraordinary appearance, as do the worn sheaths on his belt that hold a dagger and shortsword. Slung on his back are a small shield and a crossbow with a case of bolts attached, all well used.

~ Played by Kairion

七重层叠，凝成一座巍然巨岳，自无尽的圣水之海中拔地而起。柔和而怡人的光辉为万物披上一层微光。山巅没入蓬松的白云之中，即便在此处，也依然能看见峰顶透出的明亮辉芒。空气里仿佛悬着一阵低沉而和谐的嗡鸣。
Seven layers form a colossal mountain rising from an infinite sea of sanctified water. A gentle, pleasant luminous lends a glow to every surface. The mountain's peak disappears into fluffy white clouds, though even from here the glow from its tip is evident. A low, harmonious hum seems to hang on the air.

Banter Between A Fairy And An Ai.name:
妖精与AI的斗嘴
Banter Between A Fairy And An Ai

Text.text:
“哦，美丽的机器，请放我过去，我想去草地里嬉戏。” 这一个不是机器。这一个能够独立思考，理解的远比多数人更多——尤其是像你这样自命不凡、妄想伟大的蝴蝶。 “这般无礼我绝不容忍。你的礼数，我定要替你拨正！” 为何你们这些任性的小生物总爱押韵？效率实在低下。 “我们的话语起舞，轻抚耳畔；听来总是悦人心弦。” 好吧，我没有耳朵，而且我怀疑你押不出 auditory processing unit 的韵脚，你这恼人的小蚊子。 “你竟怀疑我押韵的本领？我给你朗诵诗篇；我们有的是时代！” 听起来妙极了。请先把我的插头拔掉。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

“O, fair machine please let me pass, I want to go play in the grass.” This one is not a machine. This one is capable of independent thought, understanding more than most—especially butterflies with delusions of grandeur, like you. “Such rudeness won’t be ignored. Your manners I shall have restored!” Why must you petulant creatures always speak in rhyme? It is so inefficient. “Our words dance and caress the ear; they are always pleasing to hear.” Well, I do not have ears and I doubt you can come up with a rhyme for auditory processing unit, you irritating little mosquito. “You doubt my skills of verse and rhyme? I’ll read you my poetry; we have the time!” Sounds delightful. Please unplug me first.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这块墓碑缺了一大截，不知怎地从顶端被硬生生崩断，像是被人抛走或搬走了。石板正面刻着一段阴森的铭文：生命竟能如此短暂，实在残酷；可人生本就残酷，那么或许这反倒是一种慈悲。 A chunk of this tombstone has gone missing, somehow broken from its top and tossed or carried away. The face of the slab bears a grim engraving: That a life should be so short seems cruel, but life is cruel, so perhaps this was mercy.

Lone Elk Falls Prey To A Dragon.name:
孤麋瀑布，沦为巨龙的猎物
Lone Elk Falls Prey To A Dragon

Text.text:
麋鹿在林间幽谷里安然啃食，享受着森林生活最朴素的乐趣。一道巨大的阴影从头顶缓缓掠过，在翻涌的云层间隐没，盘旋着——等待着。麋鹿小跑到溪边，低下口鼻凑向咕噜作响的水面，巨龙便如覆鳞的霹雳般骤然扑击。只一瞬，巨大的皮翼一闪，骇人的利爪攫住麋鹿，将它拖拽升空，带走吞噬。

~ 由 David 在 Discord 上 Envisioned

The elk grazes peacefully in the wooded glen, enjoying the simple pleasures of forest life. A large shadow drifts overhead, disappearing into a bank of rolling clouds as it circles—waiting. The elk trots over to the stream, lowering its muzzle to the burbling waters, and the dragon strikes like scaled lightning. In a flash of huge leathery wings and terrible claws the elk is seized and carried away to be devoured.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Insectile Doctor Of Interspecies Medicin.name:
跨种族医学的虫形医师
Insectile Doctor Of Interspecies Medicine

Text.text:
医生沉思地咔哒咔哒叩响几丁质的颚，用一双巨大的复眼审视着那名哺乳类病患。他们开口时，话语里带着淡淡的嗡鸣，仿佛声音是从一台老旧的发射器里传出。医生从架子上抽出一本厚重的大书翻阅，吱吱作响地查明折磨病患的状态，随即给出一套治疗方案。
Clicking their chitinous mandibles in contemplation, the doctor examines their mammalian patient with large compound-eyes. A faint buzzing colors their words as they speak, as if the voice is coming from an old transmitter. Consulting a large book from their shelf, the doctor chitters as they find the condition ailing the patient then recommended a treatment plan.

I Cast Calm Emotions Against Fright.name:
我施放「平静情绪」对抗恐惧
I Cast Calm Emotions Against Fright

Text.text:
我看得见他们的脸，那人群被浓烈的恐惧吞没，而我知道该对他们说什么。这个法术看起来像个寻常的手势：双手举起、掌心摊开，像在恳求般毫无力量；可我的手指悄然并拢，双手微微一转，便成了那样。我的话语压住了他们脑海里的惊惧——至少，暂时如此。
I can see their faces, the crowd swallowed by intense fear, and I know what to say to them. The spell looks like a normal gesture, hands up and open in request, completely without power, but my fingers come together, and my hands turn just so. The words I speak quell the fright in their minds—for the moment.

Jacking Out Of Cyberspace.name:
从赛博空间强制登出
Jacking Out Of Cyberspace

Text.text:
你被困在虚拟世界的角落里，数字颜料泼得满地都是，像在你周围摊开一圈刺眼的污渍。管理员切断了你的登出路线，你也把所有技能都用到榨干——于是，该去拉那根比喻意义上的巨大红色拉杆了。为了挣脱这道钳制、逃出赛博空间，你转而求助于硬件，猛地一扯电缆。下一秒，你又成了血肉之躯。你一阵反胃，房间天旋地转，里面的一切都被染成蒸汽波的色彩。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

You’re in a virtual corner, digital paint all over the floor around you. The admins have cut off your logout route and you’ve exhausted all your skills—and so it’s time to pull the metaphorical big red lever. To slip this grapple and get out of cyberspace, you resort to your hardware and rip the cord. Suddenly, you’re meat again. You’re nauseous, the room spins, and all the stuff in it turns vaporwave colors.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Proud Naval Officer.name:
骄傲的海军军官
Proud Naval Officer

Text.text:
他挺拔地立在船首，眺望无垠海面。白色帽檐下，灰黑相间的头发贴着头皮利落修剪，顺势过渡到短短的胡须，干净得近乎刻板。他身着深色外套与同色长裤，整洁程度与发丝无异，内里是一件白色翻领衬衫。外套上钢制纽扣冷光闪烁，与靴子上的金属扣眼相互呼应。他从口袋里抽出一只圆形装置，装置连着一条链子，低头瞥了一眼，随即转身望向舷梯，冷淡地打量着登船的乘客，神情一如既往地疏离。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

He stands tall at the ship’s fore, looking out onto the sea. Under his white hat, his salt-and-pepper hair is closely cropped, flowing neatly into his short beard. He wears a dark coat and matching trousers, both as tidy as his hair, with a white collared shirt underneath. The jacket sports steel buttons that mirror the eyelets of his boots. He pulls a round device connected to a chain from his pocket, gives it a glance, then turns toward the gangway to observe boarding passengers with similar detachment.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

狼牙棒的柄端“啪”地拍在那恶棍肥厚的掌心里。那不言自明的威胁娴熟得像排练过，却又漫不经心；欺压他人对他们而言不过是家常便饭。若他那朵花椰菜般的肿耳与布满疤痕的指关节足以说明一切，那么斗殴恐怕也同样司空见惯。
The haft of the mace thwacks into the thug’s meaty palm. The implicit threat seems well-practiced but casual; bullying others is an everyday affair. Getting into fights might be just as common if their cauliflower ear and scarred knuckles are anything to go by.

Courier Sprite.name:
信使小妖精（特征）
Courier Sprite

Text.text:
这只小妖精（特征）显现为一位西部旧日的骑手与坐骑，仿佛由一笔不断线的描绘勾勒而成，像一尊微小的霓虹小雕像。被用来传递讯息时，小妖精（特征）会摆出骏马前蹄腾起的姿态，骑手则挥舞一顶帽檐下弯的牛仔帽。随后它褪至近乎透明，疾驰向其目的地文件。用于追踪时，小妖精（特征）行动更缓，马与骑手的头都低垂着，凝视着它们运作其上的网格。
The sprite appears as a horse and rider from the old west, drawn in one continuous line, as if it were a tiny neon figurine. When employed to send a message, the sprite strikes a pose of the horse rearing up and the rider waving a bent-brimmed cowboy hat. Then it fades to near transparency and races to its destination file. When tracking, the sprite moves slower, the heads of both horse and rider bent toward the grid on which they operate.

Burnt Forest Clearing.name:
焦灼林间空地
Burnt Forest Clearing

Text.text:
焦黑的空地上仍残留着木烟味，挥之不去。几棵枯骨般的树还勉强立着，枝桠被剥去大半，其余的一切都已烧尽，只剩一层灰烬与烟垢覆在地面。环绕空地的绿树也带着受创的痕迹，火势竟未继续蔓延，实在令人称奇。也许是无人照看的营火惹的祸，或是雷击所致。又或者，这把火是由法术点燃，抑或某头野兽的炽烈吐息所喷吐而成？
The smell of woodsmoke lingers in this blasted, blackened clearing. A few skeletal trees remain standing, robbed of most of their branches, but everything else has burned away leaving a layer of soot. The green trees surrounding the clearing show signs of being damaged, and it’s a wonder the fire didn’t spread further. Perhaps an untended campfire caused it, or a lightning strike. Or might the fire have been lit by a spell or the fiery breath of a beast?

Vampire's Speech About The Age Of Worms.name:
吸血鬼关于蠕虫年代的演说
Vampire's Speech About The Age Of Worms

Text.text:
“漫长岁月里我沉睡着，在深渊中漂流。在那片黑暗里，我梦见了许多事——腐烂，生命，衰败，还有一个蠕虫的年代。如今，那梦终于得以解放，将渗漏到这世界的每一个角落。你们的族类将重归熵的怀抱。不久，森林将化作灰白，它们的居民将成腐殖的碎屑，而后世界便可重新开始——一个纯净的世界，一个以挣来的生命取代被赐予的生命。”

~ Steve Morales 所构想

“For so long I have slept, drifting through the abyss. In that darkness, I dreamt of many things—of rot, of life, of decay, of an age of worms. And now that dream can be free, to leak to every corner of this world. Your kind will return to the embrace of entropy. Soon, the forests will be gray and their inhabitants will be mulch, and then the world can start again. A world of purity, of life earned instead of life given.”

~ Envisioned by Steve Morales

Eldritch Librarian.name:
诡秘图书馆馆员
Eldritch Librarian

Text.text:
在一排排霉味沉沉的卷轴与巨册之间，一道枯槁身影悄然滑过——佝偻着背，利爪般的双手指尖相抵，陷入沉思。那生物的皮肤黑如煤炭，紧紧裹着骨架。它身上披着的褴褛破布与这肤色融为一体，甚至像是皮肤本身的延伸。破碎的布——或肉——如袍般垂落，裹住它的身形；它踏着看不见的脚，在无声的步伐里移动，衣袂轻语。它的眼睛像月长石的圆珠，凝视着远方；嘴巴大张，露出一排扁平而莹亮的牙齿。然而任何一丝声响都会让这位图书管理员骤然停住，侧耳倾听，目光眯起。待确认重归寂静，它便再次沉入阴郁的游荡，在古老的书架间徘徊。

~ 由 Theren 在 Envisioned 构想

Amid the musty stacks of scrolls and tomes slides a gaunt figure, hunched, with clawed hands steepled in contemplation. The creature’s skin, the color of coal, clings to its bones. The tatters the librarian wears match this skin, or may be more of it. This ragged cloth or flesh hangs like a robe, swathing the figure and whispering as it moves on unseen feet with silent footfalls. Eyes, like orbs of moonstone, stare into the distance, and its mouth gapes, revealing flat, lustrous teeth. At any sound, though, the librarian hesitates, listening, eyes narrowed. Assured of silence, it returns to its brooding wandering among the ancient shelves.

~ Envisioned by Theren

Hunter With Crossbow.name:
持弩的猎人
Hunter With Crossbow

Text.text:
身披腐叶绿衣与棕色皮革的孤猎者悄无声息地在射程间潜行，搜寻毫无戒心的猎物。他们动作老练而沉稳，从腰带上套着的髋侧箭囊里抽出一支弩矢，利落地装入沉重的十字弩中。
Dressed in leaf-mold green and brown leather, the solitary hunter makes no noise as they creep through the range in search of unsuspecting game. With practiced, deliberate movements they draw a bolt from the hip quiver looped on their belt, loading it into their heavy crossbow.

你凝视着门锁，想象自己根本不需要钥匙。你是这里的客人，魔法会欢迎你——你要做的，只是完成法术，报上名号。“咚咚，”你朗声说道。随即，一阵震耳欲聋的敲击声响起，仿佛有个看不见的巨人正用拳头猛砸门扉。
You look at the lock and imagine you don’t need the key. You are a guest here, and the magic will welcome you—all you need do is announce yourself by completing the spell. “Knock knock,” you say aloud. A thunderous knocking follows, as if an unseen giant pounds on a door.

Clocktower Of The Underground City.name:
地下城邦的钟楼
Clocktower Of The Underground City

Text.text:
在我们的地表之下，还有另一个倒悬的世界，朝向世界的中心。那里有我们会称作钟乳石的群山，海洋与我们的海洋在“上方”与“下方”交界的阈限处相接。人们倒着行走，与我们上下颠倒，抬头仰望（那其实是向下）那唯一与我们绝对共有的东西。时代是自成一维的。钟楼上，正午两根指针向下指去时，会在我们的钟声敲响午夜之际同时鸣响。
Below our surface is another, inverted, aimed toward the center of the world. It has mountains we would deem stalactites, and its oceans meet our oceans at the liminal edge between up here and down there. People walk around, upside down to us, and look up (which is down) at the one thing we share absolutely with them. Time is its own dimension. On the clocktower, the two hands of noon pointing downward chime when our clocks chime midnight.

河面粗粝而迟缓，平底龙骨货船那扁长的方形船身拖拽着货物前行。五六名船员操持着船只，有人将长篙插入水中撑拨掌舵。水流渐起细浪、速度加快时，其中一人放下侧板以稳住航向。船尾的挡水篷罩在装箱的货物与一名叼着烟斗的水手之上，为他们挡开飞溅的水沫。
On the river, rough and sluggish, the flat rectangle of the keelboat hauls its cargo. Five or six crew work the boat, some dropping long poles in the water to steer. As the waters begin to riffle and speed, one of them lowers a leeboard. The dodger in the boat’s stern stretches over crated cargo and one deckhand smoking a pipe, protecting them from spray.

I Cast Detect Evil And Good.name:
我施放《侦测善恶》
I Cast Detect Evil And Good

Text.text:
我闭上双眼，深深吸气，引导神祇的力量在体内奔涌。随着我凝神专注、祈求指引，意欲超越凡俗的感官，一阵细微的刺痒感在我周身显现、游走。待我睁开眼，柔和的光辉环绕着我，我伸出手去触及，感知近处善与恶的存在。
I breathe deeply as I close my eyes and channel the power of my god. A tingling sensation manifests all around me as I focus my mind and ask for guidance to go beyond my mortal senses. When I open my eyes, a soft glow surrounds me and I reach out to sense the presence of good and evil nearby.

I Cast Creation.name:
我施放【造物术】
I Cast Creation

Text.text:
当我与阴影建立联结时，那股熟悉的绝望与痛苦再度袭来，像利爪般撕扯着我的心神。我合上双眼——将思绪凝向此界之外——低声吟诵创生之词，伸手触及以太中游离的丝缕。我感到它们在我的意志下弯折，被我牵引着划过帷幕。我将注意力凝在掌中的碎片上，编织阴影，使其顺从我的渴望。
I feel the familiar sense of despair and anguish clawing at my psyche as I establish my connection with the Shadows. I close my eyes—focusing on a world beyond this—as I chant the words of creation and reach for the strands in the ether. I feel them bend to my will as I draw them across the veil. I concentrate on the fragment in my hand and weave the shadows to suit my desires.

Loot From A Storm Giant.name:
风暴巨人的战利品
Loot From A Storm Giant

Text.text:
巨人轰然倒下，空气中弥漫着噼啪作响的静电，仿佛有一股庞然能量被骤然释放。武者贤者那庞大的躯体旁，一柄英雄般夸张巨大的长剑直立而起，剑尖深深钉入地面。其后，一座钱币堆成的小山闪耀夺目，其间点缀着一簇簇莹润宝石；旁边一只箱子盛满药水，满溢的诱惑将你招向前方。
A static charge fills the air as the giant falls, as if a great amount of energy has been unleashed. Standing upright by the warrior sage’s huge body, a sword of heroic proportions rests, its point firmly embedded in the ground. Behind them, a mountain of coins—resplendent with pockets of lustrous jewels—and a chest brimming with potions call you forth.

Spacegoing Vessel: Small Cargo Hold.name:
太空航行载具：小型货舱
Spacegoing Vessel: Small Cargo Hold

Text.text:
几只箱子、管筒与木桶塞满了这艘船狭小的货舱，被谨慎而有目的地码放着，以将空间利用到极致。空气冰冷而潮闷，你注意到自己的呼吸微微凝成雾气。这里干净、实用，舱底靠近后方装卸门处布满宽大弧形的擦痕，像是重物被反复拖拽扫过。
A few boxes, tubes, and barrels fill the small hold of this vessel, stacked with care and intention to maximize space. The air is cool and musty, and you notice your breath misting slightly. The space is clean and functional, and the floor is scuffed in wide, sweeping patterns near the loading door at the rear.

你靠近那栋破败的建筑时，一阵刺骨的寒风骤然卷起。塌陷的屋顶在数百年的常春藤重压下低垂——蛛网在幽暗叶影间闪着湿冷的光——破碎的窗格死死盯着你，像一颗巨大的木质骷髅那空洞的眼眶。大门张着口，走廊的黑坑如同咽喉，连向它的獠口深处。更深的里面，有谁——或有什么东西——开始哭泣。
A chill wind picks up as you approach the dilapidated building. The sunken roof sags beneath centuries of ivy—spider webs glistening between the dark leaves—and broken windows stare at you, like the empty sockets of an enormous wooden skull. The door yawns open, the black pit of the hall forming the throat of its maw. Deep within, someone or something begins to cry.

Crossroads Shrine In Winter.name:
冬日岔路神龛
Crossroads Shrine In Winter

Text.text:
你伫立在十字路口，雪花坠落，如天使轻语般细碎。路对面是一座古老的神龛，霜华攀附在它风雨侵蚀的骨架上，闪烁如结晶的祈祷。神龛——凡人与神明之间的门扉——温柔地发着光，宛如一颗慈和的星辰，召唤着那些寻求救赎的灵魂，或只是渴望片刻慰藉的人。
You stand at a crossroads, snowflakes falling like the delicate whispers of angels. Across the way is an old shrine, the frost adorning its weathered frame glittering like crystallized prayers. The shrine, a portal between mortal and god, glows like a benign star, beckoning souls seeking redemption or merely a moment of solace.

Renowned Five-star Chef.name:
声名远扬的五星大厨
Renowned Five-star Chef

Text.text:
他们大摇大摆，仿佛这里就是自家地盘；那位身形矫健的外星主厨一路穿过拥挤的集市，笑着挥手，神态活像个空洞的王室贵胄。为了身后跟拍的影像团队，主厨刻意做足姿态：当众品尝本地农产、与摊贩寒暄打趣——一举一动都是你所期待的媒体名人范儿。曾经这份事业或许源于对手艺的热爱，而如今你隐约觉得，名声的诱惑已将他们从最初的热情里牵走。
Swaggering, like they own the place, the lithe alien chef smiles and waves—resembling a vapid royal as they make their way through the crowded market. Making a show of sampling local produce and chatting with vendors for the vid-crew following them, the chef is every inch the media personality you’d expect. Though it was once about the love of their craft, you suspect the allure of fame has drawn them away from their passion.

Intimidation About Metaphors.name:
关于隐喻的威吓
Intimidation About Metaphors

Text.text:
“你就是一株杂草：枯干、碎裂，急需我们慈悲之水的滋润。听着，我不太会打比方，但我向你保证——你要是不配合，我折磨的可不止他们。”
“You are a weed: dried, crumbling, and in need of the water of our mercy. Look, I’m not great at metaphors, but I promise you, if you don’t cooperate, they won’t be the only thing I torture.”

Corporal Tylyra Soran.name:
下士提莉拉·索兰
Corporal Tylyra Soran

Text.text:
从森林的树线间现身，红发的木精灵以冷硬如燧石的祖母绿目光扫过你们每一个人，阳光里她的眼眸一闪一闪。她的短弓弦上已搭好一支箭，却将箭头稳稳指向地面。看她那身军装式制服笔挺无瑕，昭示着她隶属于第二开拓者军团，你几乎可以断定她对武器的纪律严苛得惊人——而这一点也被她做工精良的长靴靴口上方露出的两柄匕首握柄所印证。

~ Played by Medx

Emerging from the forest’s tree line, the red-haired wood elf scans each of you with a flinty emerald gaze, her eyes flashing in the sunlight. An arrow is nocked on her shortbow’s string but pointed at the ground. Judging from the immaculate condition of her military-style uniform, proclaiming her association with the 2nd Pathfinder Regiment, you are willing to bet that her weapon discipline is considerable—confirmed by the hilts of two daggers visible above the tops of her well-made boots.

~ Played by Medx

Warning From A Bear.name:
来自熊的警告
Warning From A Bear

Text.text:
“你那油腻皮肤的气味灼烧着我的鼻腔，无毛者。这里不欢迎你。”
“The smell of your oily skin burns my nostrils, furless one. You are not welcome here."

Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion.name:
莫登凯宁的华丽宅邸
Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion

Text.text:
你将材料从腰包里倒进掌心：一柄小小的银勺与一扇微缩的象牙门框稳稳托住那片打磨光滑的大理石碎片，免得它坠落到地上。你面前的空气被一抹微光扭曲，如海市蜃楼般的瑰丽幻景在眼前浮现，一座幽影般的居所缓缓渗入现实。淡淡的魔法嗡鸣充盈四周，伴随着屋内飘出的新鲜食物香气，令人心动不已。
You spill the components from your pouch into your hand, the tiny silver spoon and miniscule ivory doorway keeping the chip of polished marble from falling to the ground. A shimmer distorts the air before you, a mirage-like vision of magnificence as a ghostly dwelling bleeds into reality. A faint hum of magic fills the air, carrying the enticing scent of fresh food wafting from within.

I Break Free Of Manacles Using Strength.name:
我用力量挣脱镣铐
I Break Free Of Manacles Using Strength

Text.text:
金属啃咬着我的皮肤，我挣扎着想从束缚中脱身。我已经受够了，于是咬紧牙关，发力死撑，竭力挣断枷锁。肌肉在用力中绷紧鼓起，我把双臂一点点越撑越开，锁住镣铐的铁链被拉得伸长扭曲。最后我爆发出一记凶狠的猛拽，硬生生将铁链扯成两截，终于重获自由。
The metal bites into my skin as I struggle to free myself from my bonds. I have had enough of this so I clench my jaw in exertion and strain to break free. My muscles tense and bulge with effort as I move my arms further and further apart, causing the chain binding my manacles to stretch and warp. With one last mighty pull I wrench the chain in half and free myself.

营地外围围着一圈勉强称得上“栅栏”的东西——用胡乱插起的长矛和破烂旗帜拼凑而成，旗布在风里耷拉着。矛尖上顶着一颗颗头颅，有些还新鲜，有些早已干瘪发黑。更里面，篝火上烤肉滋滋作响，兽皮帐篷半圆形地扎起一圈。帐篷间的住民用一种你无法分辨的语言彼此低吼，明明在自家营地里放松着，却依旧把武器搂在怀里——狰狞的斧头、长矛，还有偶尔能见到的棍棒，上面还嵌着牙齿与利爪。你越靠近，焦肉与炼脂的油腻气味便与酸馊的汗臭纠缠在一起，扑面而来。
A fence of sorts surrounds the camp, constructed haphazardly of jutting spears and tattered banners. Heads rest atop the spearheads, some fresher than others. Beyond, meat sizzles over a cookfire, and hide tents are pitched in a semi-circle. The occupants growl to one another in a language you can't quiet place, cradling weapons even though at ease in their camp—wicked axes, spears, and the occasional club fitted with teeth and claws. The smell of charred meat and rendering fat mingle with the sour stench of sweat as you draw closer.

Charismatic Socialite's Apartment.name:
魅力社交名流的公寓
Charismatic Socialite's Apartment

Text.text:
这间公寓流淌着奢华迷人的气息，精致得如同屋主一丝不苟的品味缩影。室内布局将利落的极简线条与含蓄的奢侈细节并置，又以霓虹氛围灯点缀——那种灯光更常见于高端夜店，而非寻常人家。这里被维护得近乎苛刻，整个空间的设计更像是为了招待而非居住：动线被精确规划，让来客能更轻松地穿梭寒暄。然而，繁复风格之下藏着十足的实用性。隐蔽隔层散落在空间各处，便于快速取用的暗藏储物点专为非法必需品准备；同时还布置了隐形监控设备，视线走廊保持无间断覆盖。
Effusing an air of lavish charm, this apartment is a meticulous reflection of its owner's polished tastes. The interior scheme pairs sleek, minimalistic design with subtle luxuries, accented with neon mood lighting more common in upscale clubs than homes. Maintained with stunning precision, the space is designed more to host than to serve as a home—everything mapped out to allow guests to more easily mingle. But all that style belies a functional design. Hidden compartments dot the space with easy-access stashes for illicit essentials and concealed surveillance tech with unbroken sightlines.

当你更深入设施、朝生产线前进时，刺鼻的腐蚀性化学气味灼烧着你的鼻腔。你硬生生撬开一对锈蚀的防爆门，终于抵达了目的地——却恨不得自己从未到过。你面前，一支无声的军团列阵而立：成群的仿生人伫立在黑暗之中。你用火把的光扫过这片合成者的方阵，这才惊觉他们都长着同一张脸——你同伴的脸。

~ Envisioned by Invaluable on Discord

Caustic chemicals burn your nostrils as you make your way further into the facility and toward the production line. Forcing open a pair of rusted blast doors you finally reach your goal—though you wish you hadn't. Before you, arrayed in a silent legion, an army of androids stands in the darkness. Sweeping your torches over the phalanx of synthetics you realize they all bear the same face: that of your companion.

~ Envisioned by Invaluable on Discord

Treasure Chest Guarded By Giant Spider.name:
由巨型蜘蛛守卫的宝藏箱
Treasure Chest Guarded By Giant Spider

Text.text:
金光一闪攫住你的目光，你瞥见一只毫无疑问装满宝藏的箱子。然而，一条漆黑的肢体弓在箱口上方，而那肢体连接着一具油亮黑光的躯干，另有七条同样的肢体如武装般张开。那蜘蛛的个头轻易就与你相当；尽管它的大部分身躯潜伏在箱子后头，它那细长如枯枝的腿仍不可避免地向四面八方探出、伸展。它仿佛在守卫这只箱子，可蜘蛛又不需要宝藏，对吧？
The gleam of gold catches your eye, and you spy what is unmistakably a chest filled with treasures. But a black limb arches over the open top of the chest, and that limb is attached to a glossy black body, armed with seven other such limbs. The spider is easily as big as you, and though the bulk of its body lurks behind the chest, its long spindly legs can’t help but project all around it. The spider seems to guard the chest, but spiders don’t need treasure, do they?

Deck Of Many Things.name:
万象无尽牌组
Deck Of Many Things

Text.text:
这只狭长的黑色丝绸袋里装着一件摸起来像一小叠纸牌的东西：体型、形状与柔韧度都恰到好处。袋口的金色抽绳被拉紧并牢牢系住。结看上去简单，却令人恼火地难以解开。你用指甲拨弄时，硬是撕裂了拇指甲，一股鲜血迅速从伤口涌出，抹上那被勒紧的袋口——却在触及处直接消失不见。正当你想到这一点时，那个结竟自行松开，抽丝般解散。
This narrow sack of black silk holds what feels like a small deck of cards: size, shape and pliability all fit. The gold drawstring of the bag is pulled shut and tightly tied. The knot looks simple enough but proves frustratingly difficult to undo. While picking at it, you shred a thumbnail and blood wells swiftly up from the wound to daub the cinched opening—where it simply vanishes. Just as you’re considering this, the knot unravels itself.

Speech By A Frustrated Friend About Mela.name:
一个沮丧的朋友关于忧郁的演讲
Speech By A Frustrated Friend About Melancholy

Text.text:
“你这张嘴里喷出来的阴郁废话我听得差不多了。我知道你就爱摆出那副阴沉忧郁的样子，但既然我是你朋友，我就直说了：人生本就是痛苦，自己那份自己扛，别再一股脑往别人身上倒。”
“I’ve heard just about enough of this melancholic drivel spewing from you. I know being dark and brooding is your thing, but since I am your friend, I feel I can be honest: life is pain, so take your share and stop dumping it on everyone else.”

Mad Scientist's Lab: Overwhelmed.name:
疯狂科学家的实验室：应接不暇
Mad Scientist's Lab: Overwhelmed

Text.text:
空气灼热得像在燃烧。你的双脚沉得抬不起来。酸涩的味道在口中翻涌，耳边开始嗡鸣。墙壁是在逼近吗，天花板在压低吗？你本能地把手抬起想挡开头顶的压迫，手却穿过一层稀薄的空气，让你瞬间失去平衡。房间随之天旋地转。你得离开这里。这儿不安全！
The air feels hot. Your feet seem heavy. A sour taste fills your mouth, and your ears start ringing. Are the walls getting closer, the ceiling lower? You reflexively reach your hand up to ward the ceiling away, and it passes through thin air, throwing you off balance. This sets the room to spinning. You have to get out of here. It’s not safe!

I Cast Hold Person Using Components.name:
我以施法材料施放《人类定身术》
I Cast Hold Person Using Components

Text.text:
我吟诵着摄魂的挽歌，手中那块铁片在左右间来回摇摆，同时牢牢锁住敌人的目光。随着法术愈发强盛，他们眼中渐渐凝起一层雾霭，抗力被一点点磨蚀，四肢也如石般僵冷静止。
Chanting a mesmerizing dirge, I sway the piece of iron back and forth while holding the gaze of my foe. A fog begins to build in their eyes as the spell grows in strength, gradually diminishing their resistance as their limbs become stone still.

Lyriza Nare'enda.name:
莉莉扎·纳雷恩达
Lyriza Nare'enda

Text.text:
一抹薰衣草般的肌肤掠过你的视线。一个身影以近乎超自然的平衡感栖在近处的屋顶上。她动作如杂技演员般轻灵流畅，乌黑如曜石的长发点缀着幽蓝光泽，在她身周翻卷，像一团乌鸦织成的暗云。她一笑，明亮的翠绿眼眸便闪着欢愉的光，嬉闹的目光里带着俏皮的挑战。细腻的丝绸在皮制短上衣下隐隐流光。一只戴手套的手稳稳托着一柄抛光的长剑，另一侧肩上方探出一面大盾。她武装齐全——还拥有马戏团艺人般、近似黑豹的敏捷——却仍散发出友善而欢迎的暖意。

~ Played by a Hero

A glimpse of lavender flesh catches your eye. A figure perches with preternatural balance atop a nearby roof. She flows with the easy grace of an acrobat, her obsidian tresses—dappled with blue—whipping around her like a dark cloud of ravens. Luminous green eyes shine with glee when she smiles, a playful challenge in her mirthful gaze. Fine silk shimmers beneath a leather jerkin. In one gloved hand, a polished longsword rests, while a large shield juts above one shoulder. Despite being so armed—and blessed with the panther-like agility of a circus performer—she emits a friendly, welcoming warmth.

~ Played by a Hero

Stodgy Corporate Board Member.name:
古板的公司董事会成员
Stodgy Corporate Board Member

Text.text:
如果资本主义是个人，那它就会长得像这个男人。汗珠在他油腻的腮帮上闪着光，他用干裂起皮的嘴唇叼着一支巨大的雪茄，狠狠吸了一口。他眉毛里的腐败油脂厚重下垂，怪诞地压在一副小巧的名牌眼镜上；而当他握住对方的手、敲定又一桩能吃上好几个财季的买卖时，那只荒唐奢华的手表在他肥厚的腕肉上滑来滑去——这笔交易把更多家庭送进贫困，只为换来利润。
If capitalism were a person, it would look like this man. Sweat glistens on his greasy jowls as he takes a drag on a huge cigar held between dry, cracked lips. The rancid fat of his eyebrows hangs grotesquely over small designer glasses, and a ridiculously ornate watch slides across the corpulent flesh of his wrist as he shakes his counterpart’s hand, sealing another deal for several financial quarters to come and condemning many more families to poverty for profit.

Blade Deals Minor Wound.name:
刀锋造成轻伤
Blade Deals Minor Wound

Text.text:
刀锋在昏暗光照中寒芒一闪，破空而出，直指它的目标。刃口触及躯体的瞬间，皮肉如熟透的果实般绽裂，殷红汩汩渗出。一声尖厉的痛呼刺破空气。会留下难看的疤痕，但血雾稀薄——并非重创。
The blade glints in the dim light as it slices through the air, aimed directly at its target. As the blade contacts the body, skin splits like ripe fruit, oozing scarlet. A sharp cry of pain pierces the air. It’s going to leave a nasty scar, but the blood spray is thin—not a major wound.

一阵咕噜咕噜、像猫咪呼噜般的声音从一堆污渍斑斑的帆布与绿油油的四肢里翻涌而出，低沉地震着空气。一个地精四仰八叉地躺在三只大木桶上，睡得死沉；每一次颤抖的鼾声都让他尖尖的鼻子跟着抖个不停。一只又长又像蝙蝠的耳朵软塌塌地垂在桶沿，粗糙的铁钉耳饰随着呼吸轻轻刮蹭木面，发出细微的沙沙声。你目光被他下巴底下一点寒光勾住——他竟把一把小小的弯刀抱在怀里，像熟睡的孩子紧搂着最心爱的玩具。
A gurgling purr-like sound rumbles up from a heap of stained canvas and green limbs. A goblin lies on top of a trio of three large barrels, sleeping soundly, their pointed nose vibrating with each rattling snore. One of their long, batlike ears droops over a barrel, the rough iron nail piercings scratching softly against the wood with their breath. A glint from under their chin draws your eye, and you see they have cuddled up with a small, curved dagger, much like a slumbering child might hug their favorite toy.

那小小一方硬饼干，硬得简直像块陶瓷地砖。你咬下去——或者说试着咬下去——牙齿被它拽得发酸，刮磨了好一阵子。直到终于啃下一口，伴着得胜般的咔嚓声，入口的味道像是放久了的面包屑。粗韧又起毛的肉干条在口感上也好不到哪去，但裹在肉上的香料却在舌尖留下出乎意料、勾人食欲的滋味。尽管你的牙可能要一直酸到明天，你的胃此刻倒是确实被填饱了。

~ Envisioned by Jason

The small square of hardtack biscuit might as well be a piece of ceramic tile. You bite into it, or try to, and your teeth wrench and scrape against it for a long moment. When you do finally get a bite, with a triumphant crunch, the taste is reminiscent of stale breadcrumbs. The tough and frayed strips of jerky aren’t much better in terms of texture, but the spices seasoning the meat leave a surprisingly tantalizing flavor on your tongue. Though your teeth may ache well in to tomorrow, your stomach does feel satiated for now.

~ Envisioned by Jason

Firbolg Corpse.name:
费尔博格的尸体
Firbolg Corpse

Text.text:
冰冷的灰色眼眸茫然地望向天空，费尔博格的尸体横陈在染血的地面上。朴素的土色衣物裹着多毛而健壮的躯体，一根行走杖被丢弃在不远处。
Cold gray eyes stare aimlessly into the sky as the firbolg’s corpse lies upon the bloodied ground. Simple, earth-toned clothing enrobes a hirsute, muscular frame, and a walking staff lies discarded nearby.

她昂首阔步，带着神祇般的自信，这个高大外向的女人挤开人群，拎着一袋沉甸甸的硬币一路肘开到吧台。她从一盏灯笼旁掠过时，你才看清她的皮肤白得近乎失血，眼中猩红在光里一闪一闪。她将钱哗啦一声倾泻在木质台面上，像一股闪烁的潮水铺开；随即用桶一般粗壮的拳头砸在柜台上，扯着嗓子吩咐酒保给她那帮人把酒不断上——立刻引来同伙一群恶棍的喧天欢呼。

~ 由 Played 饰演，来自 Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Carrying herself with the confidence of a god, the large, gregarious woman elbows her way to the bar with a hefty purse of coin. As she passes by a lantern, you notice just how pale her skin is, and the red of her eyes glint in the light. Spilling the money in a glittering tide across the woodwork, she slams a barrel-like fist on the counter and loudly tells the bartender to keep the drinks coming for her band—soliciting a raucous cheer from the ruffians in her company.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Sundries From A Wereraven.name:
狼人鸦人的杂货
Sundries From A Wereraven

Text.text:
在一只结实的皮革挎包里，你发现包面压印着羽毛纹样：除了一剂深墨绿的草药膏药，还有一小瓶闪烁着银辉的液体，以及几卷绷带。这个狼人，莫非曾是某种医者？
In a sturdy leather satchel embossed with feathers you find a poultice of dark green herbal paste, in addition to a vial of shimmering silver liquid and rolls of bandages. Was the lycanthrope a healer of some sort?

Insult About A Narcissistic Intellectual.name:
关于自恋型“智者”的侮辱
Insult About A Narcissistic Intellectual

Text.text:
“谁都能相信自己是房间里最聪明的那个；只不过在你这儿，房间早就荒废了，除了几只格外蠢的老鼠，空无一人。”
“Anyone can believe themselves to be the smartest one in the room; it’s just, in your case, the room’s abandoned except for a few particularly stupid rats.”

若在工地上找到的是一间小屋而非棚屋，那么这片伐木林便能世代延续。小屋以严丝合缝的木瓦、紧密斜拼的圆木搭起，处处透着匠心与自豪。屋内挂着几把斧头，锋利锃亮、随时可用；旁边是欢快炉火旁晾着的衣物，带着温暖的烟火气。
A timber forest will survive for generations if one finds a cottage at the work site rather than a shack. This cottage is built with precise shingles, tight-pitched logs, and pride. Axes hang inside, sharp and ready, next to drying clothes by a cheerful stove.

Offer Of A Dangerous Quest From A Bitter.name:
来自怨愤角色的危险任务邀约
Offer Of A Dangerous Quest From A Bitter Character

Text.text:
“你可以继续去救那些年幼的孩子、去斩杀野兽；或许那就足够让你满足了。但这次任务才真正重要。它不光鲜亮丽，而且十有八九，你未必能活着看到它结束。改变世界，就是这个代价。”
“You can continue rescuing small children and slaying beasts; perhaps it will be enough to satisfy you. But this mission actually matters. It’s not glamorous and, in all likelihood, you probably won’t live to see the end of it. That’s the cost of changing the world.”

Outskirts Of A City.name:
城市外围
Outskirts Of A City

Text.text:
杂乱的楼群从城池高墙下铺展开来。越过它们，你瞥见高楼的屋顶，在更远处，是几座也许属于神殿的尖塔。更远的地方——大概接近城心——一座巨大的要塞矗立在突出的岩脊之上，高高俯瞰。
A tumult of buildings spreads out from the high walls of the city. Beyond them you spy the rooftops of high buildings, and in the distance the spires of what might be temples. Farther still, somewhere near what must be the center of the city, a great fortress stands high upon an outcropping of stone.

I Rattle My Enemies With A Dragon's Roar.name:
我以巨龙咆哮震慑敌胆
I Rattle My Enemies With A Dragon's Roar

Text.text:
我让腹中紧绷的力量层层蓄起，回想起龙族先祖的血脉传承。他们的声音在我心耳中低语回响。随着我迈步逼近敌人，腹腔与肺叶里翻涌的威势凝成形体。我放声释放出一头远比我体型庞大的巨龙之吼，出其不意的雷霆嗓音轰然炸裂，震得敌人心神摇晃、脚下失衡。

~ 由 DM-Crazy-Eddie 在 Envisioned

I let the tension build in my midsection and recall my draconic forebears. Their voices speak to me in my mind’s ear. As I step toward my foes, the force in my belly and lungs takes form. I unleash the cry of a dragon many times my size, the unexpected thunder of my voice leaving my enemies shaken and unbalanced.

~ Envisioned by DM-Crazy-Eddie

你听见一声尖利的口哨，紧接着是振翼扑风的声响——一只方才在头顶盘旋的乌鸦俯冲而下，落在一个高个男人异常宽阔的肩头。那男人刚从附近的一栋建筑里迈步出来。他的族裔难以分辨：鼻梁与那只露在外面的金色独眼带着精灵般的轮廓，可宽阔的面庞与突出的犬齿又更像兽人。系在头上的红色头巾把头发束住，并遮住了左眼，使他多了几分浪荡不羁的味道；然而他那对毫不花哨、磨得发亮的手斧与朴素的皮护甲，却更显得务实，而非海盗式的张扬。
You hear a shrill whistle, immediately followed by the flapping of wings as a raven that was circling overhead descends, finding a perch on the unusually broad shoulder of a tall man who has just stepped from a nearby building. The man’s ancestry is hard to determine, as his nose and single visible golden eye are reminiscent of elves, but his broad face and pronounced canines are rather like those of orcs. The red bandana holding back his hair and covering his left eye lend him a somewhat rakish air, though his no-nonsense, well-used hand axes and unadorned leather armor seem more practical than piratical.

一块粗凿而成的深灰色石板横卧于此，其上刻着龙语符号。区域外的沙子侵入至此，却未越过这块石板靠近遗迹的一侧边缘分毫。它置身于周遭构成近处砌体、铺路与瓦砾的赤红沙粒与白色石块之间，显得格格不入。
A slab of rough-hewn, dark-gray stone lies here, inscribed with Draconic symbols. Sand from outside the area has encroached no farther than the edge of this stone closest to the ruin. It seems out of place amid the reddish sand and white stones that make up the nearby masonry, paving, and rubble.

Swinging Block Trap.name:
摆荡落石陷阱
Swinging Block Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 你猛然后跃，冒险者的本能接管了身体，你嗅到迫在眉睫的危险。头顶天花板上一处巨大的黑暗空间让你脊背发寒——这里不对劲。

[发现] 你险之又险地避开了天花板巨大空间正下方的压力板，探身望向幽暗。你看见一对巨大的石块悬在上方的黑暗中，静候将鲁莽的闯入者碾成血肉泥浆。

[已触发] 你踏上压力板时，地砖微微下陷——并触发了陷阱。伴随着刺耳的轧磨声，一对石块自上方落下，朝彼此摆荡合拢……而你正夹在其中。

[Perceived] You leap back as your adventurer’s instinct takes over and you sense imminent danger. A large dark space in the ceiling above causes a shiver to scurry up your spine—something isn’t right here.

[Discovered] You narrowly avoid triggering the pressure plate below the large space in the ceiling, and you peer into the gloom. You can see an enormous pair of stone blocks suspended above in the darkness, waiting to crush foolhardy intruders to a bloody pulp.

[Triggered] The tile gives slightly as you step on the pressure plate—and trigger the trap. With a cacophonous grinding, a pair of stone blocks descend from above and swing toward each other… with you between them.

一段直接凿进山坡的石阶一路向下，通往港口。码头古老却结实，每一步落下都吱呀作响；经年修补的痕迹清晰可见——颜色更浅、触感更滑的新木板与旧而斑驳的木板拼接在一起。两艘划艇在河面上轻轻起伏，系在各自的桩上，等待今日的船主——多半是渔夫，或是你侬我侬的情侣。一名守望人坐在码头边的矮凳上，收取船费，也收集那些沿河探游之人带来的怪谈轶事。他身披蓝色船长大衣，嘴里叼着烟斗，仿佛是从另一个时代被人随手拎来。
A staircase hewn directly into the hillside leads down to the port. The dock, old yet sturdy, creaks with each footfall, evidence of regular repair shown by lighter, smooth planks melding with old and stained ones. Two rowboats bob in the river, tied to their posts and awaiting their captains of the day—most often fishers or lovey-dovey couples. A watchman sits on a stool at the edge of the dock, collecting boat fares and strange stories from folk exploring the river. In his blue captain's overcoat, and smoking a pipe, he appears to have been plucked from a different time.

这块墓碑立在从山坡上凿出的阶梯下方、一条鲜有人走的小径旁。碑文写道：在那片不该有灵魂渴望涉足的国度里，烈焰永燃；然而仍有人在人世踏出一条路，终将把自己引向那里。 This headstone stands beside a little-used path down from the stairs built into the hill. It reads: Flames burn eternal in that realm where no soul should wish to tread, and yet some walk a path in life that leads them there.

一抹猩红羽影在天际疾掠而过，伴随着群鸟刺耳的尖啸合鸣。鸟群盘旋回转间，你瞥见它们令人胆寒的细节。它们外形酷似寻常的鹰，但血鹰凭借匕首般的喙、恶劣的性情与血红的羽毛极易辨认。下一瞬，鸟群以完美的同步俯冲而下，收拢双翼以获得惊人的速度——宛如弩炮射出的劲矢。
A blur of crimson feathers streaks across the sky accompanied by a chorus of avian screeching. As the flock wheels about, you get a glimpse of the birds in terrifying detail. Though they resemble the common hawk, blood hawks are easily identified by their dagger-like beak, foul disposition, and blood-red plumage. With perfect synchronicity the flock dives, folding their wings to attain incredible speed—like bolts launched from a ballista.

Loot From An Nothic Lair.name:
拾荒魔巢穴的战利品
Loot From An Nothic Lair

Text.text:
你踏入噬心爬行者的巢穴，刺鼻的恶臭如浪潮般扑面而来，几乎令人窒息。角落里横七竖八地摊着几具尸骸，身上不是挂着锈蚀的护甲，就是披着被撕成碎片的长袍。残骸与垃圾堆中，你瞥见几只完好无损的瓶子；而在其中一个倒霉鬼仍紧攥的短剑上，幽幽的淡蓝微光正悄然流淌。
The stench is overwhelming as you enter the lair of the mind crawler. In one corner cadavers sprawl, rusted armor or shredded robes adorning their corpses. Among the detritus, you spot a couple of undamaged bottles, and a faint blue glow emanating from a shortsword still clutched in one of the unfortunates’ hand.

Robe Of Scintillating Colors.name:
炫彩长袍
Robe Of Scintillating Colors

Text.text:
这件缀满亮片的长袍并非以宝石碎片或新铸的钱币点缀，而是布料本身就自带一种天生的光辉，足以攫住目光、令人目眩。它的色彩也会随光线与移动而变——甚至衣袍静止不动时也依旧变幻，明灭起伏，仿佛一汪澄澈的池水，水面下群鱼游掠，万色流转。
The sequined robe is not adorned with shards of gemstone or newly minted coins, rather the fabric itself has an innate shining quality that arrests and dazzles the eye. The color, too, shifts in the light and with movement—indeed, it shifts even if the garment is still, pulsing and changing like a clear pond filled with many-colored fish flitting under its surface.

I Do My Routine Stretches.name:
我照常做着例行拉伸
I Do My Routine Stretches

Text.text: 我从腰间俯身，双唇大张，像焦躁的马一样粗重地喷出一口气。我轻轻左右摇头，颈骨松开，伴着一串令人畅快的噼啪脆响。我直起上身，双手举向天空，先拉直，再微微向后弓起。下背也奏起自己的爆裂小调，我随之长叹一声，如释重负。脊柱彻底放松后，我换了个姿势，更充分地伸展双腿与双臂。 I bend at the waist, exhaling loudly through my lips like an agitated horse. I shake my head gently back and forth, the bones in my neck loosening with a satisfying symphony of pops. I raise my torso and lift my hands to the sky, straightening then bending slightly backward. My lower back sings its own crackling tune, to which I sigh with relief. My spine now fully relaxed, I change positions to more fully stretch my legs and arms.

大地震颤。一只生物猛地从雪堆中炸裂而出，仿佛一抹失控翻滚的蓝色死亡残影。它像是蠕虫、蜈蚣与巨龙的混合体，躯体以令人眼花缭乱的蛇形轨迹穿行，数十条腿狂乱奔踏，将它庞大的身躯推向一种与体量全然不相称的速度。翼状薄膜沿着它的两侧滋生、舒展，探寻着猎物，或试探前路的阻碍。伴随一声刺耳尖啸，这条巨虫以满身多足撑起上身，颚钳咔哒作响，饥渴的期待几乎要溢出。
The ground trembles. A creature bursts from a snowbank, a careening, blue blur of death. Something akin to a mingling of worm, centipede, and dragon, the beast moves in a bewildering serpentine pattern, its dozens of legs hurtling it forward at a speed that belies its immense mass. Wing-like membranes grow along the beast's sides, unfurling, probing for prey or obstructions in the path. With a screech, the worm rises up on its many legs, mandibles clicking in ravenous anticipation.

Sentient Library Bust.name:
知性图书馆半身像
Sentient Library Bust

Text.text:
大理石的面孔覆着铁灰色的岁月纹理，半身像以一副木然的神情审视着你。底座上的铭牌用罗马体写着：机智大师。  
“我们是迷路了，还是只是在徘徊？”他问道，声音轻柔飘忽，如同一缕薄风。“没有方向的船，不过是浮木。说吧，我将做你的向导。”  
半身像从底座上悬起，慵懒地漂到你面前，苍白的眼珠在眼眶里咯咯转动，掠过图书馆一排排不同的书架通道。
Marble face veined with iron-gray patina, the bust regards you with a stolid countenance. The placard on his stand reads MASTER WIT in roman type. “Are we lost or simply wandering?” he asks, voice light and airy. “A ship without direction might as well be driftwood. Speak, and I shall be your guide.” The bust levitates from its stand and floats languidly before you, pale eyes grinding in their sockets as they skim over the different library aisles.

I Narrowly Avoid An Arrow.name:
我险之又险地避开一支飞箭
I Narrowly Avoid An Arrow

Text.text:
察觉到危险，我本能地一矮身，险之又险地避开那支直奔我眼睛而来的箭。我直起身，咬紧牙关，攥紧手中的武器，死死盯住那个朝我放箭的混账。
Sensing danger, I instinctively duck, narrowly avoiding the arrow that was heading for my eye. I stand, grit my teeth, and tighten my grip around my weapon as I lock eyes with the bastard who loosed an arrow at me.

从阴影里悄然爬出，他现身的身影仿佛由矛盾织就，却被束在一具纤瘦的躯壳中。他猩红的皮肉如将熄余烬，低声诉说着阴毒的血脉来历。乌黑的头发夹杂灰白，被粗暴地向后扎起，露出一张狐似的面孔；纠结的胡须垂落，覆在嶙峋的胸骨上。猫般的眼睛锋利如匕，映着一抹禁忌学识的寒光；而那对光滑发亮的角，勾勒出一张永远挂着讥笑的脸，深陷的轮廓尖叫着饥饿与折磨。耳与眉上穿孔成排——无政府的徽记，也是拒绝驯服的宣言。粗陋却目的明确的造物：他那对机械臂缠绕着符文秘语，炫耀着已然显现的赐福；一只手攥着晦奥的火器，背后则有一条精工的蝎尾舞动相随。剥蚀般的刺青——异界符字的纹工——在他皮上爬行：呢喃着早被噤声的遗忘之力。

~ Played by Korroded_Soul

Creeping from the shadows, the figure that appears is a tapestry of contradiction bound in a slender form. His crimson flesh, reminiscent of dying embers, whispers tales of a sinister lineage. Ebon hair, streaked with gray, is savagely tied back from his vulpine visage, and a matted beard flows down his bony chest. Cat-like eyes, sharp as daggers, reflect a glimmer of forbidden knowledge, while horns, sleek and glistening, frame a countenance carved with a perpetual sneer, and sunken features scream of malnourished suffering. Piercings puncture his ears and eyebrows—symbols of anarchy and a refusal to conform. Crude yet purposeful artifice, his mechanical arms, bound with runic secrets, boast of blessings manifest, as do the esoteric firearm clutched one hand and the crafted scorpion tail dancing at his back. Excoriated tattoos of alien glyph-work crawl across his hide: murmurs of forgotten power, long since silenced.

~ Played by Korroded_Soul

阴影与周遭融为一体，将乡野尽数吞没。分秒流逝，暮色夺走大地——太阳收敛成一圈暗红的光晕。它既迷人又令人不寒而栗；当淡橙色的昏光浸洗这片土地，不安悄然滋生。

~ 由 McKAOS

Shadows blend with the surroundings, enveloping the countryside. As the minutes pass, twilight claims the land—the sun reduced to a ruddy halo. It is as fascinating a spectacle as it is a foreboding one, and uneasiness sets in as the land is bathed in dim orange.

~ By McKAOS

这顶无定形的短檐帽戴在不同人头上时从不尽相同，可即便有人细看入微，也说不清究竟差别在哪。无论它呈现何种模样，只要将其扣在头顶，佩戴者便会披上一层他者的外貌幻影，仿佛另一副面孔叠覆在自身之上。
This shapeless, short-brimmed hat never looks exactly the same when worn by different people, yet even those paying close attention cannot swear to the precise differences. Regardless of the hat’s appearance, placing it upon one’s head gives the wearer the guise of another being’s appearance superimposed over their own.

崖壁轰然裂开，露出一条蜿蜒的通道，尽是被狂风吹打得苍白的岩石。历经数百年、数千年，或更久，风与砂在石上刻出起伏如波的脊线，将一道裂缝磨拓成狭窄的峡隘，窄得仅容两匹马并肩穿行。
The cliff face cracks open to reveal a wending pathway of breeze-blasted rock. Over centuries, millennia, or longer, wind and sand have carved waving ridges in the rock and widened a break into a narrow canyon barely wide enough for two horses to walk abreast.

漂浮在这座巨大厅室中的一缸缸熔融金属，仿佛能自行炽热翻涌。雷鸣般的连枷巨锤——每一把都大得足以让巨人挥舞——以规律的节拍轰然砸落，其动力来历不明。雕作纹章异兽的铁砧挺起宽阔的脊背，任人锤炼；而那一座座锻炉被铸成咧嘴大笑的头颅，火光从笑口中吞吐。
The vats of molten metal that float about this vast chamber seem to heat themselves. Thundering trip hammers, each big enough for a giant to wield, pound in a regular beat, powered by unknown means. Anvils shaped like heraldic beasts bare their broad backs to be beaten before forges made to look like laughing heads.

Main Road By Night.name:
夜色下的主干道
Main Road By Night

Text.text:
一条月光浸染的道路蜿蜒向远方延伸。蟋蟀在鸣唱，萤火虫在大道两侧的林间明灭闪烁，夜色生机盎然。因为许多生灵偏爱黑暗——而森林里尽是阴影……
A moonlit strand of road winds its way into the distance. Crickets chirp and fireflies flash among the trees on either side of the thoroughfare, and the night is full of life. For many creatures love the dark—and the forest is full of shadows…

Single-pilot Fighter Ship: Cockpit.name:
单人战斗机：驾驶舱
Single-pilot Fighter Ship: Cockpit

Text.text:
这架战斗机线条流畅而优雅，设计上带着军用器械般的克制与高效。黑色面板铺陈的座舱内，每一寸都各司其职，几乎以分秒必争的速度回应飞行员的指令。舱盖采用厚重加固的有机玻璃，足以承受空间的严苛考验；当飞船准备起飞时，它在加压的嘶鸣声中扣合锁死。
The fighter is sleek and elegant, with a militaristic economy of design. Every inch of the black-paneled cockpit serves a refined purpose, responding to the pilot’s commands with split-second urgency. The plexiglass canopy is heavily reinforced to withstand the rigors of space, locking into place with a pressurized hiss as the ship prepares for take-off.

Forest At Dusk.name:
暮色森林
Forest At Dusk

Text.text:
一阵温柔的安宁如同沉甸甸的毯子覆落在昏昏欲睡的小树林上，带来温暖而令人安心的安全感。林间舒适的微风徐徐穿行，枝叶轻轻沙沙作响，风掠过时仿佛也在抚慰你。暮色的幽光将森林涂染成低饱和的蓝、橙与紫，太阳缓缓沉向地平线之外。

~ 由 Discord 上的 crunchyzombies 构想

A gentle peace descends upon the sleepy grove like a weighted blanket, carrying a warm and reassuring security. Foliage rustles softly in the pleasant breeze drifting through the woods, caressing you as it passes. The twilight hue of dusk paints the forest in muted shades of blue, orange, and purple as the sun slowly dips beyond the horizon.

~ Envisioned by crunchyzombies on Discord

那名站在医生身旁、随她说话而近近守着的壮汉，看起来更像码头搬运工而非护士；粗壮的前臂交叠在结实的胸膛前。可他的眼神关切而不残忍，举止也很温和。只是你隐约觉得——若有病人胆敢动手，他绝对会毫不犹豫地把对方按住。
The burly man standing close to the doctor as she speaks looks more like a longshoreman than a nurse, his thick forearms folded over his muscled chest. Yet, his eyes are caring and not cruel, and his manner gentle. You get the feeling, however, that he is more than willing to restrain any patient who might try to get physical.

烈焰缠身，热得足以熔融被它踏击的岩石，那匹马形梦魇轰然冲锋。它的皮毛间竖起黑曜石般的尖刺，吞噬着光；鬃毛则如熔炉之火的秋色闪烁。那匹恐怖的雄马肩高一百掌——而它的身形还远不止于此。你抬头望进它乳白的眼睛里，只看见死亡在其中映回。
Wreathed in flames so hot they melt the rock upon which they strike, the equine nightmare charges forth. Its pelt bristles obsidian that sucks in light, and its mane is the autumnal flicker of a forge fire. The dread stallion stands one hundred hands at the withers—with still more to measure. You look up into its milky eyes and see only death reflected back.

Aged Sword Stuck In Pillar.name:
卡在石柱中的古剑
Aged Sword Stuck In Pillar

Text.text:
尽管剑身斑驳锈蚀、又被天气侵蚀得满是腐痕，那柄从崩裂的石柱中斜插而出的长剑却出奇地完好无缺。至于能否把它从石灰岩里完整拔出，那就是另一回事了……
Though splotched with rust and corroded from the weather, the sword jutting out of the crumbling pillar is surprisingly complete. Whether or not it could be pulled out of the limestone intact is another matter . . .

那壮实的青年在近旁的草捆上歇了片刻，饱经风霜的干草钩稳稳钉在身侧的草堆里。他一边揉着双手，一边看着你走过，抬起两根手指触了触草帽的帽檐，算作招呼。随后他从木桶里贪婪地灌下一勺水，重新戴上皮手套，又埋头干起活来。
The brawny youth sits for a moment on a nearby bale, leaving his weathered hay hook firmly embedded just beside him. He massages his hands as he watches you pass, raising two fingers to the brim of his straw hat in greeting. After greedily sucking down a dipper of water from a barrel, he puts his leather gloves back on and gets back to work.

Dragon Queen In Dragon Form.name:
龙后（巨龙形态）
Dragon Queen In Dragon Form

Text.text:
这生物的庞大体型几乎无法被完整感知——以“神祇般”来形容也不为过。覆满鳞片、鼓胀的躯体挺立在长着利爪的四肢之上，借助一条巨大的尾巴保持平衡，尾尖是一枚阴狠的倒刺。它有整整五颗头颅，自躯干之上沿蛇一般的颈项探出：黑龙，双眼狭长而狡黠；蓝龙，闪电自其巨口分叉迸裂；绿龙，烟雾从鼻孔里缭绕逸出；红龙，火舌自齿缝间喷吐；白龙，寒霜自口中翻涌成雾。
The creature’s sheer size cannot be fully perceived—godlike would be an appropriate descriptor. The scaled and bulbous body holds itself upright on clawed limbs, balancing with the use of a massive tail tipped with a wicked barb. Multiple heads, five in all, emerge from the body on serpent-like necks: a black dragon, eyes narrow and cunning; a blue dragon, lightning forking from its maw; a green dragon, smoke curling from its nostrils; a red dragon, flames spitting from between its teeth; and a white dragon, frost pluming from its mouth.

这是一本以紫色布面装帧、冷杉木封板加固的书。然而最引人注目的，是它只有一颗葡萄般的体型。书脊以三枚金属线圈装订，使其翻开后能向后折回；而那一张张坚挺的羊皮纸页上写满细若游丝的文字，不借助放大之物，寻常类人之眼几乎无从辨读。
This is a book of purple cloth and fir cover boards. However, what is most apparent is that it is the size of a grape. It is bound with three wire rings so that it opens back on itself, and the script on its stiff vellum pages can barely be read by common humanoid eyes without the help of magnification.

Rousing Speech By A Hunting Party Leader.name:
狩猎队长的激昂演说
Rousing Speech By A Hunting Party Leader

Text.text:
“你们会来到这里，是因为你们亲眼见过这些怪物纵欲作孽后的余烬。你们走进自家的谷仓、神殿，或是屋子，迎面撞上它们一路留下的血腥恐怖。很好——今晚，我们就来做那黑暗中潜伏的东西。今晚，该轮到野兽们去端详我们留下的猩红景象。它们的巢穴将被焚毁，它们的同类将被屠尽；让它们再望向我们这座美丽的小镇时，看见的不是一顿唾手可得的饭食，而是一场正义的烈狱，正等着将它们吞没。”
“If you are here, it is because you have witnessed the aftermath of these creatures’ carnal work. You have walked into your barn, your temple, or your home to find the gruesome horrors they leave in their wake. Well, tonight we will be what lurks in the dark. Tonight, the beasts will ponder the gory scenes we leave behind. Their dens will be burned, their kin will be slaughtered, so that when they look upon our fair town, they will not see an easy meal, but a righteous inferno waiting to engulf them.”

Vrybs Deaqu.name:
弗里布斯·迪奎
Vrybs Deaqu

Text.text:
如抛光橘玉般的双眼在一件磨旧斗篷的兜帽下幽幽发亮，却丝毫压不住他那身暗色护甲的铿锵作响；这名地精在码头区游荡。目光落在湿热中忙碌的渔民身上，他的绿颊牵出一抹笑意，仿佛被哀愁抹脏。他放低兜帽——阳光随即映在乌亮的黑发上，头发向后束起，几乎遮住那条从软甲领口之外蜿蜒而出的触手纹身——随后走向一名乞丐。他在一只矮木箱上刻下一个神圣徽记，把一把钱币撒在其周围；接着转身离去。

~ Played by Nachreld with

Eyes like burnished tangerines glow under the hood of a well-worn cloak doing little to quiet the clanking of dark armor as the goblin wanders through the dockyard. His eyes rest on the fisherfolk working in the wet heat, and his green cheeks stretch into a smile smudged with sorrow. He lowers his cowl—which lets the sun reflect off lustrous black hair, pulled back so it almost covers the tentacled tattoo that stretches just beyond the collar of his gambeson—as he approaches a beggar. He scratches a divine symbol on a short crate and drops a fistful of coins around it; then he turns away.

~ Played by Nachreld with

Genesis Wraith.name:
创世缚灵（特征）
Genesis Wraith

Text.text:
某种翠绿的光点闪烁并扩张，化作一名瘦削的魅影（特征），乱发如狂，向身后奔涌飞散。他们每一步落下，脚下便抽生出细小花朵，短暂绽放，旋即再次凋隐。魅影（特征）轻拂那件灰绿斗篷，无数微型生灵倾泻而出，形态大小各异——俨然一座宇宙异兽的动物园。幽灵（特征）那张瘦长苍白的脸上覆着难以言说的哀伤。紧接着，毫无征兆地，他们的面容骤然变形，木质化为盘根错节、扭曲结疤的一团枝杈。
Something green twinkles and expands, becoming a gaunt phantom with wild locks of hair flowing out behind them. Small flowers grow from where they place their feet, briefly blooming before fading away once more. The phantom wafts their green-gray cloak, miniature creatures of all shapes and sizes toppling out—a veritable zoo of cosmic fauna. The ghost bears a sadness in their slim, pale face. And then, suddenly, their face transforms, lignifying into a gnarled and knotted mass of branches.

I Survey The Aftermath Of A Battle.name:
我巡视战后的余烬与残骸
I Survey The Aftermath Of A Battle

Text.text:
破碎的躯体、断裂的肢体与崩裂的盾牌，散落在血水浸透的战场泥沼里。我用尽全身力气才撑起身子，猛地把自己向前拖去，硬逼着灌了铅般沉重的双腿继续迈步。穿行于恶臭、堆尸如山的混乱之中，我的护甲像一座压顶的刑具般沉沉逼迫着我——仿佛一个砸碎圣像的亵渎者，被神祇诅咒去做永无止境的苦役。伤者与将死者的哀嚎随一阵阴冷的恶风掠过这片屠戮之地——却无人回应。太阳升起，新的一天到来，清晨的薄雾从死者冰冷、苍白的皮肉上缓缓蒸散。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

Broken bodies, severed limbs, and sundered shields litter the blood-soaked mire of the battlefield. I get to my feet with tremendous effort and heave myself forward, willing the leaden weight of my legs to move. As I trudge through the stinking, charnel chaos, my armor bears down upon me like the torturous burden of an iconoclast cursed by the gods to eternal labor. The cries of the wounded and dying carry across the carnage on a fell wind—though no one is around to answer them. The sun rises on a new day, and the mists of dawn evaporate from the cool, pallid flesh of the dead.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Small Orc Camp.name:
小型兽人营地
Small Orc Camp

Text.text:
粗糙的绳索捆扎着削尖的枝桠，围成营地的栅栏；正面开着一道大门，两名身披兽皮、手持凶狠战斧的兽人守在门口。风吹日晒的帆布帐篷东一顶西一顶，杂乱无章地扎在营地四周。营地尽头矗立着一座原始的木制建筑，入口上方悬着两只角。木料在每个角上交叉咬合，断面新鲜未干，像是刚刚搭起。空地中央篝火轰然燃烧，几名兽人在火边游荡，神情散漫，毫无忙碌之态。
Sharpened branches bound by coarse rope surround the encampment, opening at a front gate guarded by two orcs clad in hide and wielding savage axes. Tents of weathered canvas are pitched haphazardly around the site. At the far end of the camp stands a primitive wooden structure with two horns hanging above the entrance. The cut ends of the timber, crisscrossing at each corner, appear unseasoned, suggesting a recent build. A fire roars in the center of the clearing and a few orcs mill about around it, failing to appear busy.

Quip About A Peaceful Morning.name:
关于宁静清晨的一句俏皮话
Quip About A Peaceful Morning

Text.text:
“今晨醒来时，我被一股前所未有的宁静击中。可随即我想起那些仍横亘在我们面前的可怖之事，一切便轰然崩塌。”
“When I woke up this morning, I was struck by the most unusual tranquility. Then I remembered all the horrible things that still lie before us and it all came crashing down.”

Confession Of Lycanthropy.name:
狼化症的忏悔
Confession Of Lycanthropy

Text.text:
“我得坦白一件事……在酒馆里闹腾得天翻地覆的一夜之后，我醒来就发现身上多了这个咬痕。我怕是染上了什么东西。具体是什么我还不清楚，可我的嗅觉变得异常敏锐，而且我开始对松鼠怀起了一些极其凶狠的怨恨。”
“I have a confession to make… After a particularly raucous night at the tavern, I awoke with this bite. I’m afraid I may’ve caught something. I’m not sure what it is yet, but my sense of smell has become quite vivid and I have begun harboring some very vicious resentments toward squirrels.”

一枚拳头大小、由精巧黄铜构件拼成的球体，振动着金色羽翼悬空飞舞。它的躯体中空，仿佛一座自转的星盘，缓慢而持续地变换着姿态。电流在其核心汇聚，对凡世的不确定性作出反应——只要混沌的苗头稍有抬头，便立刻膨胀、迸射火花。球体正中伸出一截可伸缩的探管，末端嵌着一枚湛蓝透镜，宛如永不眨动的眼睛，凭此这只生物注视着多元宇宙。它沉稳而冷峻，仲裁者周身散发出异界威权的气息；尽管体型不大，却仿佛随时能将任何它认定为扰乱宇宙平衡之物迅速清除。
A fist-sized sphere of intricate brassware flutters on golden wings. Its body is hollow and seems to shift slowly like a spinning astrolabe. Electrical currents gather in its core, reacting to the uncertainty of this mortal world—expanding and sparking at any sign of growing chaos. At its center rests a telescopic protrusion, ending in an azure lens that functions as an unblinking eye, by which this creature observes the multiverse. Stalwart and stoic, the arbiter exudes an aura of otherworldly authority and, despite its size, seems equipped to dispatch with anything it perceives as upsetting the cosmic balance.

Starship Engine Fails.name:
星舰引擎失灵
Starship Engine Fails

Text.text: 驾驶舱后方某处传来一阵低沉的噼啪迸溅声，所有监视屏幕都被狂暴的猩红频闪吞没：warning: critical engine failure。脚步声在钢铁走廊里回荡，船员四散奔向各自岗位，加压舱门在嘶嘶喷气的喧嚣中开合不休，抬高的喊声里夹着一丝恐慌。突然，飞船向一侧猛然倾斜——把松散的物件统统掀得翻滚着砸向地板。 There is a low splutter from somewhere aft of the cockpit, and all monitor screens are overtaken with a violent scarlet strobe flashing: warning: critical engine failure. Footsteps echo down the steel halls as crewmembers scatter to their posts, pressurized doors opening and shutting in a cacophony of hissing gas, and raised voices resounding with a tinge of panic. Suddenly the ship lists to one side—sending loose items careening to the floor.

Cult Of The Dark Blade Summoning Evil Qu.name:
暗刃邪教：召唤邪恶女王
Cult Of The Dark Blade Summoning Evil Queen

Text.text:
黑钢长剑在冰冷石面上嘶鸣交错，剑刃迸出火星。身披鳞甲锁子甲、外罩飘逸长袍的祭司们低声吟诵，黑暗的舌焰在他们脚边跃动。他们向一截阴影般的刀刃性相逼近——弯曲如钩爪——它悬浮在收紧的圆阵中央。吟诵戛然而止，缓慢的行进也随之停下，他们举剑齐齐抬起，剑尖指向那道幻影。地面上的黑暗触须蜿蜒游走，沿着石地爬向刀刃，将武器缠裹在黑色火焰之中。火焰勾勒出一抹剪影：女性的身形，额前伸出两根漫长、扭曲的角，直刺向上。

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

Longswords of black steel hiss across cold stone, their edges sparking. Priests with flowing robes shackled under hauberks of scale chant in low tones as tongues of darkness dance around their feet. They move in toward a shadowy aspect of a blade—curved, like a talon—which hovers in the center of the tightening circle. The chanting ends, as does the slow march, and they lift their swords to point at the apparition. The tendrils of darkness on the ground wind across the floor toward the blade and wreathe the weapon in black flame. They form a silhouette: a feminine shape with long, twisting horns reaching up from her brow.

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

城堡四周矗立着一道环形城墙，将整座要塞严丝合缝地包围起来。外堡以平整凿削的石块砌成，如同守卫般伫立，阻挡任何妄图来犯的入侵者。数十年来的雨打风吹、烈日曝晒在墙体上刻下磨损的痕迹，但它依旧坚固挺立，傲然不屈。
Around the castle stands a ringed wall which fully encompasses the stronghold. Made of smooth, hewn stone, the bailey acts as a sentinel to keep would-be invaders at bay. Decades of rain, wind, and sun have taken their toll on the wall, yet it stands strong and proud.

Small Campsite In The Snow.name:
雪中小营地
Small Campsite In The Snow

Text.text:
炊火的烟气把你引向一处小小的营地。几顶简易宿营帐围成一圈拢着火堆，每一片坠落的雪花落入其中都激得火苗滋滋作响。营地里脚印四处可见、来来回回，但随着雪势不停，每过一分钟，它们就被覆盖得更深，愈发难以辨认。
The smoke of a cook fire attracts you to a small campsite. Several bivouacs sit in a circle around the fire, which sizzles with each falling snowflake. Though footprints can be easily spotted hither and yon throughout the site, with every passing minute they are rendered more and more undetectable with the continuing snowfall.

高大、满脸胡须的男人露出温暖而抚慰人心的笑容，仿佛一处舒适的炉火，能让浑身湿透、疲惫不堪的旅人重新找回安宁。他专注聆听面前的老妇人细数自己一长串病痛，柔和的榛色眼眸始终不曾离开这位病患，同时在心底悄然推演着治疗方案。午后祈祷的低沉吟唱穿过芬芳的空气飘荡而来，附近几名神殿侍僧正开始他们的仪式。

~ 扮演：Tusker2zero

The large, bearded man’s smile is warm and comforting, like a cozy hearth would be to a sodden, weary traveler. He listens carefully as the old woman before him explains her list of ailments, his soft hazel eyes never leaving his patient as he mentally formulates a treatment plan. The muffled chanting of afternoon prayers drifts through the fragrant air as some temple acolytes nearby begin their service.

~ Played by Tusker2zero

Underground Dwarven Lava Lake City.name:
地下矮人熔岩湖城
Underground Dwarven Lava Lake City

Text.text:
熔岩以缓慢的细流淌下，煤火般的猩红与橙光交织。在火山脚下，一道巨大的石墙横亘其前，厚重的闸门如石板般封住去路，截断了熔流。堤坝表面布满深深凿刻的矮人符文，坚不可摧；环绕的熔岩护城河把戏剧般的光芒投上城墙。每隔几百码，便有一处涵洞引向一条狭窄的运河，通往不同铁匠的工坊——而这样的工坊数不胜数。矮人从不觉地下的寒意，也从不缺锻炉里的火。

~ Envisioned by Euno

The lava runs in slow rivulets of coal-fire red and orange. At the volcano’s base, an enormous stone wall with a slab gate blocks the flow. Covered with deeply carved dwarven runes, the dam is impervious, and the lava moat casts a dramatic glow up the city wall. Every few hundred yards, a culvert to a narrow canal leads to a different smith’s workshop, of which there are many. The dwarves never feel the chill of the underground, never lack for fire in their forges.

~ Envisioned by Euno

Imprisoned Dragon Atop Dead Volcano.name:
死火山之巅的囚龙
Imprisoned Dragon Atop Dead Volcano

Text.text:
巨龙在火山囚笼的边界来回踱步，像落入陷阱的野兽般焦躁不安，矫健的肌肉在猩红鳞片下起伏滚动。焦黑的烟丝自张开的鼻孔里缭绕卷出。那巨大的足印在火山口内交错纵横，织成令人目眩的纹路，而巨龙的执拗不休更在灰烬中磨出一道深深的沟痕。
The dragon paces the bounds of their volcanic prison like a wild animal caught in a trap, their lithe muscles undulating under crimson scales. Tendrils of blackened smoke coil from flared nostrils. Their huge footprints crisscross the crater in a dizzying pattern, and a furrow has been worn into the ash by the dragon’s persistence.

一记刺耳的钟鸣轰然响起，在这座破败的中央大厅里回荡不休。淡紫色的光辉浸透四周，内部比你想象中更为辽阔——巨大而空旷，深邃得仿佛延伸到你视线的尽头。中殿两侧整齐排列着一排排金属长椅。每个角落的小门洞里，都有一段由凿石砌成的狭窄螺旋楼梯向上盘旋。头顶上，光线穿过彩绘玻璃倾泻而下，竟奇迹般未被洗劫者触碰。
A clangorous bell sounds, echoing around the dilapidated central chamber. Suffused with a lilac glow, it seems larger inside than you expected—colossal and cavernous, stretching beyond the bounds of your sight. Rows of metal pews line the nave. Narrow spiral staircases of hewn stone rise from little doorways in each corner. Above, the light shines through stained glass, miraculously untouched by looters.

一双又大又圆的亮蓝眼睛闪烁着好奇与惊异，引人不由自主地望向这人宽阔的脸庞；那上面挂着一抹浅浅的笑。他的鼻头乌黑。灰白的毛皮覆在他敦实的身躯上，边缘与背部渐渐泛灰；更深色的毛在眼周勾出一圈面具般的轮廓，衬得那双眼更为明亮。他身着缝线密布、补丁叠补丁的皮外套与皮裤，脚蹬高筒靴。一柄战锤挂在腰间，藏在紫色斗篷下几乎不见；帆布背包上垂着工具与零碎杂物。一个蜥蜴般的构装体懒懒伏在他身旁，自动机焦黑的钢甲在边缘泛着橘色的灼光。

~ Played by a Hero

Big, round, bright blue eyes, twinkling with curiosity and wonder, draw attention to this person’s broad face, which bears a slight grin. His nose is dark. White fur that grays at the edges and toward the back covers his stocky body, and a mask of darker fur outlines his eyes, making them all the brighter. He wears a stitch-laden and patched leather coat and breeches, with high boots. A warhammer hangs from his belt, barely visible under his purple cloak, while tools and oddments dangle from his canvas pack. A lizardlike construct lounges at his side, the automaton’s blackened steel plates glowing orange at the edges.

~ Played by a Hero

这间石室的西南角通向一条嶙峋的岩石隧道。这里显然曾有砌石被拆走——只剩下少许碎块散落在通道口附近。空气在这条粗凿的走廊中缓缓流动，暗示另一端有出口，但深处不见丝毫光亮。石质地面上留有明显痕迹，像是沉重之物曾在数处被拖拽而过。
The southwestern corner of this chamber opens into a rocky tunnel. Masonry must have been removed—only a portion of it remains scattered near the passage’s mouth. Air moves through the rough-hewn hallway, suggesting an opening at its other end, but no light is visible in its depths. Marks on the stone floor suggest heavy objects were dragged across it in several places.

空洞的脚步声在你前方回荡。你停下脚步，屏息细听，那回声很快便消散——要是你胸腔里狂跳的心也能如此轻易平复就好了。矿道引你走入一座巨大的洞窟。你听见“叮、叮、叮”，抬头望去，只见头顶垂挂着闪烁的钟乳石。地下的岩壁被乳白色的石英与其他矿物的矿脉划出一道道纹路。岩石深处的凹陷坑洼，正是矿工们为掘取矿石所付出艰辛的见证。
Hollow footsteps in echo front of you. As you halt and listen closer, the reverberation quickly decays—if only your pounding heart could be so easily settled. The mine’s passage leads you into a vast cavern. You hear, “Plink, plink, plink,” and look up to see glistening stalactites hanging overhead. The subterranean walls are scored by veins of milky quartz and other minerals. Deep depressions in the rock evidence the effort miners have gone through to extract the ores.

对城里人来说，没有什么比这卷羊毛毯更显得粗陋失体——紧紧束着腰带，又牢牢绑在背包上。可对骑手或行军者而言，在漫长寒冷的一天尽头，望向荒野落日时，没有什么比它更让人心生欢迎、更满载慰藉。
To the city dweller, nothing seems so harsh and undignified as this roll of wool belted tight and strapped to a pack. To the rider or marcher looking into a wilderness sunset at the end of a long cold day, nothing is so welcome and full of comfort.

Hag Wearing A Shaman's Hide.name:
披着萨满人皮的鬼婆（特征）
Hag Wearing A Shaman's Hide

Text.text:
像在田里辛劳一天后随手脱下的农用背带裤一样，鬼婆最新受害者的皮被她丢弃着，松垮垂落，随着她在肮脏的窝棚里走动而毫无尊严地晃荡拍打。那被剥皮的萨满之皮仿佛一套噩梦般的戏装，挂在这怪物腰间；空洞的五官扭曲成一声无声的尖叫。

~ 由 Leprekorn 在 Discord 上 构想

Cast off like farming overalls after a hard day in the fields, the skin of the hag's latest victim dangles and flaps unceremoniously as she moves about her filthy hovel. Like a nightmarish costume, the flayed shaman's hide hangs from the monster's waist, their hollow features contorted in a silent scream.

~ Envisioned by Leprekorn on Discord

City Of Boats.name:
舟船之城
City Of Boats

Text.text:
仿佛在蔑视大海潮汐起落的翻涌与回旋，你来到一座由纯粹巧思孕育的城市边缘——一座漂浮之城，完全由木筏、艇只与船舰拼接而成，彼此绑缚，再以松散的锚系固定，在颠簸的洋流中勉强换得一份相对的安稳。客船与商船一同系泊在漂浮栈桥旁，那些栈桥似乎专为迎接来客而设，且有规模不小的卫队在旁警戒。另一些码头则像是分工明确：近海渔船的泊位、修理船坞的工位一应俱全。不论白昼黑夜，这处聚落都始终喧腾不息——从那些供人消遣的城区传来的动静便可见一斑。更离奇的是，你越靠近，越能看出这座城竟呈环状铺开，仿佛是围绕着水下深处某个引人注目的所在而建。

~ 构想：Rogério da Costa Jr.

As if in defiance of the rises and swells of the sea’s shifting tides, you find yourself on the outskirts of a city borne of pure ingenuity—a floating city entirely composed of rafts, boats, and ships, bound together and loosely anchored to provide a relative stability in the choppy ocean currents. Passenger and merchant ships alike are moored to floating piers seemingly designated for the intake of visitors, with a sizable guard contingent on watch. Other docks seem to be designated for specific purposes, such as short-range fishing vessels and repair bays. Regardless of the time of day or night, the settlement is constantly bustling with activity, judging by the activity surrounding the parts of the city dedicated to leisure. Curiously, the closer you get, the more you can see that the city has been formed in a ring of sorts, almost as if it were built around some point of interest located in the watery depths.

~ Envisioned by Rogério da Costa Jr.

德尔塔级义体的全息影像投射出完美成形的肢体与无缝植入体，即便在技术检视下也常与真品难分彼此。配合纳米嫁接的微型科技，让增强深入到亚细胞层级——从钛合金骨网、快缩肌纤维，到特化神经受体与静脉滤器。专用植入体强化感官处理，扩展射程并缩短反应动作（）时间。其模块单元往往具备多模式多功能性，使使用者能依情境需求随时改写义体形态与性能。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Holograms of delta-quality cyberware show perfectly formed body parts and seamless implants, often indistinguishable from the real thing even under technological scrutiny. Microtech with nanografting allows augmentation on a subcellular level, from titanium bone mesh to fast-twitch muscle fiber, and specialized neuroreceptors to vein filters. Dedicated implants enhance sensory processing to expand range and increase reaction time. Units are usually modally multifunctional, allowing the user to alter the cyberware on the fly based on situational needs.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这具构装体呈人形、双足，由石、金属与木材拼构而成。然而它绝非寻常的构装仆役——更不是法师的傀儡魔像。它以宝石般的双眼感知世界，眸光点燃着智慧与狡黠；面部的钢铁甲片缓缓移转，仿佛能模拟喜悦、悲伤、愤怒与好奇的神情。
The construct is humanoid, bipedal, constructed of stone, metal, and wood. But this is no mere construct servant—no mage’s golem. The construct perceives with gemstone eyes alight with wisdom and cunning, the steel plates of its face shifting to emulate expressions of joy, sadness, anger, and curiosity.

Bard College Town.name:
吟游学院城
Bard College Town

Text.text:
这座庞然大城的石墙、卵石铺就的街道与高耸入云的塔楼回荡着音乐与千姿百态的歌声。每个街角都有吟游诗人施展手艺——拨动鲁特琴、上演戏剧、朗诵诗篇，以及介于其间乃至超越想象的一切形式。各个城区都陈设着艺术装置，展出名家与仍在磨砺技艺的创作者的绘画与雕像。城镇的核心矗立着一座露天剧场：巨大的半圆形舞台，四周环绕层层石质长凳——必要时足以从容容纳数百人。道路自这座百年枢纽向外延伸，将城市分成六个学院街区，每个街区皆以一座披挂彩色旗幡的学府建筑为中心。

~ Requested by Kyle E.

The stone walls, cobbled streets, and soaring towers of the sprawling metropolis reverberate with music and melodious voices of every variety. On every corner, bards perform their craft—strumming lutes, performing theater, reading poetry, and every conceivable medium in between and beyond. Art installations in each district display paintings and statuary from both renowned artists and creators still honing their craft. At the heart of the town, an open-air theater stands, a massive semi-circular stage surrounded by tiers of stone benches—enough to comfortably seat hundreds, if need be. Roads extend out from this century hub, dividing the city into its six college districts, each dominated by an academy building draped with colorful banners.

~ Requested by Kyle E.

Loot From An Adult Gold Dragon.name:
成年金龙的战利品
Loot From An Adult Gold Dragon

Text.text:
曾经是一场展现巨龙神威的宏大奇观，如今那头金龙却僵死地倚靠在龟裂的峭壁上，鲜血自它遍布全身的伤口中缓缓渗出。你小心翼翼地搜查这具庞大的尸身，发现一顶镶满宝石的王冠被硬套在一只龙爪上，仿佛当作戒指佩戴。其工艺精妙绝伦，黄金表面刻着晦奥的秘纹。真正值得带走的战利品。
Once a grandiose spectacle of draconic might, the gold dragon now slouches dead against the cracked cliffside, blood leaking from its myriad wounds. Gingerly searching the massive corpse, you find a gem-encrusted crown forced over one claw, seemingly worn as a ring. The craftsmanship is wondrous, with esoteric glyphs etched into the gold. A true prize worth taking.

Wormlike Horror.name:
蠕虫般的恐怖
Wormlike Horror

Text.text:
这东西是一团纠缠的肢体，有的尖锐如蛛足，有的却柔软流体般挤压蠕动，像触手一样。它身躯底部悬着一颗黏膜质的圆球，泛着病态翡翠般的微光，渗出一串串气泡——那是某种琥珀色、黏稠的浆液。翻涌的肢群中忽有一条附肢猛然扑出，瞬间裂开成一张七鳃鳗般的口器。它发出介于野兽与人形之间的尖啸，红肿如甬道的咽喉一张一合，喷出令人作呕的腐臭。
This thing is a tangle of limbs, some sharp and spiderlike while others are fluid and squishing like tentacles. A mucosal orb shimmers like sickly jade at the base of its body, seeping bubbles of some amber, viscous matter. One appendage in the writhing mass suddenly lunges forward, splitting into a lamprey-like mouth. It shrieks with a voice somewhere between beast and humanoid, the inflamed, corridor throat releasing a fetid stench.

Major Trade Road Through Grassland.name:
穿越草原的主要商道
Major Trade Road Through Grassland

Text.text:
车辙纵横的道路向下蜿蜒，没入一处长满潮湿青草的浅谷。路的走向从未令人迷失，但旅人们把许多路段踩成了泥泞的烂沼，迫使后来者改走更干的旁径；然而那些旁径也在不断的践踏下，逐渐被搅成同样的泥浆。
The rutted route passes down into a shallow valley of damp grass. The direction of the road is never in question, but travelers have turned many spots into a muddy morass, leading others to pick drier pathways, which get gradually churned into mud in turn.

Sundries From A Green Dragon Lair.name:
绿龙巢穴的杂物
Sundries From A Green Dragon Lair

Text.text:
在覆盖墙壁与地面的腐臭毒秽之中，夹杂着一滩滩干涸的呕吐物，以及冒险者的骸骨与排泄物。破碎的家具从堆叠成山的衣物——成千上万件——间戳出，旁边还散落着战士与法师折断的武器。
Among the putrescence of toxins coating the walls and floor are patches of stale vomit and the bones and excretions of adventurers. Broken furniture pokes from a heaped clothing—thousands of pieces—along with the broken weapons of warriors and wizards.

Unfriendly Dive Bar.name:
不太友善的地下酒吧
Unfriendly Dive Bar

Text.text:
酒馆里的空气沉甸甸的，呛人的烟斗烟雾与走了味的酒气交织在一起，钻进你的鼻腔，又与无数客人身上的汗臭混成一股难以名状的味道。昏暗光照从一对肮脏的油灯与壁炉里将熄未熄的火光里漏出，几乎把各种颜色、各种形状的污渍都遮得模模糊糊。你一踏入门槛，酒保便斜眼打量你，猛吸一口那支雕成盘蛇巨龙模样的木烟斗，随即又低头回去，用一块脏抹布“擦拭”他手里的杯子。吧台从地到顶堆满了酒瓶，里头装着寻常的烈酒，也有些说不清来历的玩意儿；瓶身上结着厚厚的灰，显然有些已经在这里搁了好些年，甚至可能是好几十年。聚在这里的客人也像这间铺子本身——疲惫、疏离，浑身裹着一层洗不掉的污垢。
The air inside the bar is heavy with acrid pipe smoke and stale alcohol, and it mingles in your nostrils with the body odor of myriad patrons. The dim light, cast by a dingy pair of oil lamps and a slowly-dying fire in the hearth, obscures stains of every hue imaginable. The bartender eyes you as you enter, puffing heavily on a wooden pipe carved to resemble a serpentine dragon, before returning to the glass they are "cleaning" with a dirty rag. The bar is stocked, floor to ceiling, with bottles of liquor both mundane and otherwise. The dust caking the bottles indicates some have been here years, if not decades. The patrons assembled here resemble the venue—worn, standoffish, and coated in a layer of grime.

三只分裂的蹄子劈开地面，在鼓胀身躯的重量下留下沙质印痕。那具身躯——高逾十英尺，缠绕着可抓握的触须般蔓条——因充斥过量液体而一阵阵搏动，仿佛灌得太满的水囊。那生物踉跄摇晃，颅骨被角状赘生物的重量拖得歪斜倾倒。它周身萦绕着一层铁屑般的微光，让空气带上血腥的铁味。
Three cloven hooves cleave the ground, leaving sandy marks with the weight of a swollen body. The body—over ten feet tall and writhing with prehensile tendrils—pulses with too much fluid, like an overfilled water sack. The creature wobbles, its skull tilting over from the weight of hornlike growths. A shimmer of iron particles surrounds it, granting the air a bloody taste.

Snowpeople Magically Form.name:
雪人魔法成形
Snowpeople Magically Form

Text.text:
叮铃声伴着清凉的蓝色光粒，在雪堆的覆压下翩然起舞。那些光把白色粉雪滚成圆球，却不留一道沟痕。几组三个一伙的雪球彼此嬉闹，跳跃、绕圈，然而脚下的雪面依旧洁净无痕。每一组雪球都堆成一摞，由大到小，而光又在其上细细雕琢，刻出几个小小的雪人。这些微小的生灵继续在创造它们的冬光之间舞动玩耍。有的甚至像极了你们的队伍——只要你眯起眼仔细看。

~ Envisioned by newgen

Tinkling accompanies cool blue particles of light that dance about under the drifts of snow. The lights roll the white powder into balls without leaving furrows. Several trios of these snowballs frolic about one another, bouncing and circling, yet the snow beneath remains unmarked. Each snowball trio forms a pile, largest to smallest, and the lights carve them into several little snowpeople. These tiny beings continue to dance and play among the wintry lights that made them. Some even resemble your party, if you squint just right.

~ Envisioned by newgen

他嗓音低沉，唯独对着顾客时会抬高声调，摆出一副夸张的营业腔。皮肤覆着龙族般的金色鳞片——没有半点毛发——狗头人的吻端架着一副半月形眼镜。他是个行事乖张、雌雄难辨的掮客，身披绣金紫袍，经营着 Goldenflight & Sons。一手拨着算盘，另一手托着一只蜥蜴——他喜欢把它涂成金色。

~ 由 Quinn Myers 扮演

He has a deep voice unless he is talking to customers, when he uses a high, performative tone. His skin is scaled in a draconic gold—without fur—and on his kobold snout rests a pair of half-moon spectacles.
