He is an outlandish, androgynous wheeler-dealer who runs Goldenflight & Sons while wearing a purple robe embroidered in gold. He carries an abacus in one hand and an iguana, which he likes to paint gold, in the other.

~ Played by Quinn Myers

Fog Cloud Affecting Player.name:
迷雾云团影响玩家
Fog Cloud Affecting Player

Text.text:
敌方法师双眼燃烧着仇恨，双手狂乱挥舞，召来一团翻涌旋转的浓雾。你感觉雾气在身周愈发厚重，黑暗如脉搏般一下一下加深。帷幕之中，法师的嘲弄声回荡，讥笑着你的困境，沉醉于你的狼狈。呼吸变得艰难——令人窒息的瘴气越收越紧，你挣扎着想要逃离这片致盲的雾海。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Eyes ablaze with hate, the enemy caster gesticulates wildly and conjures a churning mass of fog. You feel the mist thicken about you, a pulsing deepening gloom. Within the shroud, the mage's mockery taunts you, reveling in your plight. It is hard to breathe—the claustrophobic miasma cinching tight as you struggle to escape the blinding morass.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

由各类织物精制而成的华服——有的来自熟悉的国度，有的源自遥远的异乡——披覆在贵族雕塑般的身形之上。他们举止从容，带着不费力的优越感；那份自信，源于财富与权势，也源于责任与影响力。一枚印戒套在指间，戒面压印着家族的徽记——提醒着他们归属何处，又侍奉何人。
Fineries, comprised of a wide array of fabrics from lands both known and distant, drape the statuesque form of the noble. They carry themself with an air of easy superiority, a confidence born of wealth and power, of responsibility and influence. A signet ring adorns one finger, embossed with the sigil of their house—a reminder of where they belong, and whom they serve.

Digging For Buried Treasure.name:
挖掘埋藏的宝藏
Digging For Buried Treasure

Text.text:
泥土糊满了你汗湿的额头，你用沉重如铅的双臂一次——又一次——将铁锹狠狠刺入大地，只盼自己买来的那张地图并非虚假。希望在胸腔里如将熄的火焰般一点点暗淡时，你忽然感觉铁锹撞上了什么。你精神猛然一振，扑倒在地，像野兽般用双手疯狂刨挖，急切地要把属于你的战利品从土中掘出。地图是对的！

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Dirt cakes your sweat-covered brow as you drive the shovel into the earth—again—with leaden arms, hoping that the map you bought was accurate. As hope fades in your heart like a dying flame, you feel the shovel connect with something. With a rush of energy you scramble to the ground, frantically digging with your hands like a wild animal to unearth your prize. The map was right!

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

他们说他快两百岁了，全靠法术续命。他记得一切：每一个曾来求学的学生、每一桩事故、每一节课。他安置并编目塔中的物品，以及学生与教授所需的各类必需品——而教员们正焦头烂额地秘密开会，商量一旦失去他，学校将何去何从。他也比看起来快得多。
He is nearing two hundred, they say, and kept alive by spells. He remembers everything: every student who has attended, every incident, every class. He houses and catalogs the items of the tower and necessities of student and professor—and the faculty hold desperate meetings about what will happen to the school if they lose him. He’s also a lot faster than he looks.

那团漂浮在空中的松垮皮囊与锋利骨刺——一边吞咽、一边咕嘟喷溅出绿色气体——在半空中上下浮沉，数条触须自这只生物无定形的躯体底部伸展而出。它的表面纠缠成一团：鳞片、眼球、毛发与皮肤交织翻涌，随着周遭光线的波长而颤动起伏，像旋涡般充满力量地盘旋流转，以变色龙般迅疾的速度彼此缝合、重组、再度变形。
The floating bag of loose skin and sharp bones—gulping and spluttering green gases—bobs mid-air, tendrils extending from the bottom of the creature’s formless shape. Its surface is a mass of scales and eyes and fur and skin, oscillating in response to the wavelengths of ambient light, swirling with potency, knitting together and changing with the rapidity of a chameleon.

疾风如鞭，沿着连接柱顶的桥道翻舞抽打；那声音自远处的黑暗里传来，尖啸如凄惋的叹息。覆霜的昏翳让人难以看清每一条高架栈道尽头究竟藏着什么。唯有心志坚定、步履最稳之人，才可能踏过这座桥，继续深入探索这片仿佛已被遗弃的所在。
Whips of wind dance along the bridgeways connecting the tops of the pillars, voices keening like woeful sighs from the darkness beyond. The frosted gloom makes it difficult to discern what lies beyond each raised walkway. Only the steadfast of heart—with the steadiest of steps—might make the journey across the bridge to explore deeper into this seemingly forsaken place.

Broom Shop With Shy Broomsticks.name:
害羞扫帚的扫帚铺
Broom Shop With Shy Broomsticks

Text.text:
扫帚柄在店铺高挑天花板的椽梁间怯生生地悬着，像胆小的鱼躲在海藻丛里。柄身木料千差万别：从罗望子那种黑白相间的盐与胡椒纹理，到红橡木泛粉的木纹。刷毛的长短与形状也各不相同：有的收束如圆头画笔的毛，有的却像野草般狂乱蓬张。店主围裙上沾着木渍斑驳，发间点着木屑，她吹着口哨哄下一把扫帚，旁边的客人指向自己中意的那一件。她望着这些戒备的小家伙，露出一副被逗乐的家长般的笑意。
Broomsticks hover shyly in the rafters of the store’s high ceiling like timid fish hiding amid kelp. The handles differ widely in wood type, from the salt and pepper streaks of tamarind to pinkish grain of red oak. Bristles vary in length and shape: some tapered like round paint brush bristles, others as wild as weeds. The shopkeeper, her apron patterned with wood stain and her hair peppered with shavings, whistles to coax a broom down as a patron points to their desired purchase. She smiles at her wary creations with the expression of a bemused parent.

Quip About A Party Member After A Quick.name:
在一场速胜之后对队友的打趣
Quip About A Party Member After A Quick Victory

Text.text:
“你觉得你能不能放慢点，让我们其他人也有机会出手？这样我们才会觉得自己是这队伍的一份子——而不只是给你当驮兽。”
“Do you think you could slow down and give the rest of us a chance to get a shot in? It’d help us feel like we’re part of this group—not just your pack-mules.”

Inexplicably Still Sea.name:
无由的静海
Inexplicably Still Sea

Text.text:
辽阔的海面平滑如玻璃般的一整块。偶尔一阵走岔了路的风掠过水上，水面却仍旧纹丝不动；任凭风如何催促，也不见哪怕一丝涟漪起身应和。海水以令人眩晕的清晰倒映着天空，织就一种无尽延伸的幻觉，天地不分，上下皆失。
The great expanse of the sea is as smooth as a pane of glass. An errant gust sails over the water, yet the surface remains unruffled; not a single wavelet rises at the behest of the wind. The sea reflects the sky with disorienting clarity, creating the illusion of a never-ending vastness with no up nor down.

Conjure Minor Elementals.name:
召唤次等元素
Conjure Minor Elementals

Text.text:
你一边吟唱一边张开手掌，四指舒展，想象每一根都象征一种元素。食指化作火，中指化作风，无名指化作土，小指化作水。面对这些微小的元素领主，你的拇指——象征着你——依次俯身致礼。待到法术的最后一个手势，你决定让拇指亲吻哪些手指，于是也就决定了将会降临的元素盟友。
You spread the four fingers of your hand as you chant, envisioning each digit representing an element. Your forefinger becomes fire, your middle digit air, the ring finger earth, and your pinky water. To each of these miniature lords of the elements, your thumb—representing you—bows in turn. And as the final gesture of the spell, you decide which fingers your thumb kisses, and thus what elemental allies will arrive.

Scribing A Spell Scroll.name:
誊写一张法术卷轴
Scribing A Spell Scroll

Text.text:
你将羽毛笔蘸入墨水，小心让多余的墨汁滴回玻璃瓶中，谨慎得不让任何东西洒落或污抹。手腕沉稳，你在面前精细的羊皮纸上落下第一笔。每一个繁复的符号都浸透着你的奥术魔法，将法术一寸寸转写其上，随着每一道笔画缓缓苏醒。
You dip your quill into the ink and carefully let the excess drip back into the glass, taking care not to spill or smudge anything. With a steady hand, you draw the first strokes on the fine parchment in front of you. Each of the intricate symbols is imbued with your arcane magic, transferring the spell and slowly bringing it to life one stroke at a time.

光泽莹润的翠绿色茎秆交织成这顶小冠的基底，蓬勃的生机如欢快的鸟鸣般在纤维间流淌。数朵美丽花卉的柔软花瓣点缀着这圈纤维编成的环带，每一朵都如花冠上的宝石般璀璨。
Woven stalks of a lustrous veridian hue form the base for the circlet, and vitality flows through the fibers like joyous birdsong. The soft petals of several beautiful flowers decorate the fibrous band, each one a jewel in the floral crown.

雪片纷纷飘落，为每一根裸露的枝条披上银装；放眼望去，处处都是蜿蜒交织的白色桥梁。乌黑的枝桠之下、幽暗的树皮之间，是一片柔软的雪海，隆起成凝固的浪涛。一根下垂的枝条终于承受不住积雪的重量，猛地一抖，将负担倾泻而下，响声仿佛有人同时拍松了好几只枕头。
Flakes flutter down, clothing every naked branch in snow and creating winding bridges of white every way you look. Beneath these black boughs and between the dark bark of the trees lies a sea of soft snow billowed into frozen waves. The weight of the water overcomes one dipping limb, and it drops it burden with a sound like several pillows being fluffed.

Bottle Of The Finest Wine.name:
一瓶上等佳酿
Bottle Of The Finest Wine

Text.text:
你与这瓶酒的初见，宛如在月光笼罩的桥上邂逅一位恋人。酒标上的卷草纹衬托出一个既诱人又俏皮的名字。待它稍稍舒展、再缓缓倾入杯中，杯里的酒色正是深秋落日最末一线的光，香气也恰到好处地平衡。葡萄与花香彼此交织，一同将你的感官填满温暖的欢愉。你啜饮、轻叹，细品回味：那份持久的喜悦抚平心绪，也唤起你就餐的兴致。

~ Envisioned by Tate.W

Your introduction to the bottle is akin to meeting a lover on a moonlit bridge. The scrollwork on the label accents a name of both seduction and whimsy. After time to breathe, and pouring, the wine’s color in the glass is the very edge of a deep autumn sunset, and the bouquet is in perfect balance. Grape and flower work together to fill your senses with a warm felicity. You sip, sigh, and contemplate the finish: a lasting cheer that calms you and inspires you to dine.

~ Envisioned by Tate.W

这块墓碑似乎比大多数更显苍白，是用更浅色的大理石凿成的。黑色霉菌在碑文潮湿的字缝里滋生，渗出道道暗痕滴落，像泪痕般在碑面上拖出一串串污迹。上面写着：当光被分享时，便成了悲伤的重负。独自哀悼的心，沉重如铅。 This headstone seems a shade paler than most, being cut from a lighter marble. Black mold grows in the damp cervices of its letters, causing dark stains to drip from them, coloring the face with what seem like tear tracks. The words read: Light becomes the burden of sorrow when shared. Heavy is the heart that mourns alone.

Quip About Crime From A Guilty Noble.name:
来自一名有罪贵族的犯罪俏皮话
Quip About Crime From A Guilty Noble

Text.text: “你想干什么？我犯了什么罪吗？哼，如果我的动作玷污了你们这洁白无瑕的社区，那我道歉——可我看这街上污秽横流，还以为这是个‘什么都能干’的地方。” “What do you want? Have I committed some crime? Well, I’m sorry if my actions have tainted your pristine community, but I assumed with all the refuse running down the streets this was an ‘anything goes’ type of place.”

Short Travel Across The Demonic Realm.name:
穿越恶魔界的短途旅行
Short Travel Across The Demonic Realm

Text.text:
你踏上旅程时并不确定会遇见什么。大地在烈焰中灼烧，空气沉重，裹满烟尘与灰烬，弥漫着硫磺的刺鼻气味。你跨过咕嘟作响的液池，绕开嘶嘶喷鸣的蒸汽柱——有时脚下的地面仿佛由苍白渗血的肉质构成。你在这片地狱般的荒原上尽可能快地前行，直到目的地赫然出现在眼前。
You embark on your journey unsure of what you might find. The land burns with fires, the air heavy with smoke and ash, smellingy of sulfur. You step over pools of bubbling liquid and around columns of hissing steam—at times the ground seems composed of pallid, seeping flesh. You move as quickly as you dare across the hellscape, until you see your destination before you.

牧场主端坐在一匹血统无可挑剔的骏马上，炽烈的太阳下，他俯瞰着自家繁育的牲口群。他掏出一条手帕，在额头上抹过一遍，心里掠过无数个日夜——千百天的检视与照料，面对那成千上万头被运来、在此出生、又从此售出的牲畜。
Seated high atop a horse of impeccable lineage the rancher gazes out over his breeding stock under the blazing sun. He removes a handkerchief and swabs it across his brow, thinking of a thousand days and evenings spent inspecting and handling the thousands of livestock that have been transported here, born here, and sold here.

Twisted Ai Mainframe.name:
扭曲的AI主机
Twisted Ai Mainframe

Text.text:
很难分清哪里是上、哪里是下。这里的重力更弱——你正轻轻漂浮在离地几英寸的高度上。然而同样漂浮的，还有无尽的黑色线缆海潮般摇曳，如海藻般缠绕着臃肿的处理核心，缠绕着无数屏幕，缠绕着闪烁的发射器。主机仿佛一片令人眩晕的丛林，根本不是人类能够理解的。一个迷宫般的空间——混乱而逼仄，且彻底没有尽头。
It’s hard to know what’s up or down. Gravity is less in here—you’re gently floating a few inches above the floor. But then, so too is the endless mass of black wires, swaying like sea kelp as they wrap themselves around bulky processing cores, around myriad screens, and around flashing transmitters. The mainframe is a dizzying jungle not made for human comprehension. A maze-like space—confusing and claustrophobic, and utterly without end

Prayer To Saint Dariel Pepin.name:
向圣达里埃尔·佩平祈祷
Prayer To Saint Dariel Pepin

Text.text:
“让我们向诚实者达里尔圣徒献上感恩，他引领我们走向正直的人生。他要求我们向他人敞开心扉，将深埋心底的隐秘怨怼暴露在白昼的净化之光下。行事须自省，裁断须审慎。我们铭记达里尔：当他面对生存或真相的抉择时，他选择了后者。没有善意的人生只活了一半，而建立在谎言之上的人生，根本不算人生。”
“Let us give thanks to Saint Dariel the Honest, who guides us toward lives of integrity. Who asks us to open ourselves to others. To expose the secret resentments, burrowed within our hearts, to the cleansing light of day. To be mindful of action and measured in judgement. We remember Dariel, for when he was faced with the choice of life or truth, he chose the latter. A life without goodwill is a life half-lived, and a life built on lies is no life at all.”

Sundries From An Adult Copper Dragon.name:
成年黄铜龙的杂项收藏
Sundries From An Adult Copper Dragon

Text.text:
铜龙的尸体半卡在坍塌的洞口里，蝠鲼般的翼膜被撕裂、血迹斑斑。你在乱石间攀爬搜寻，却不幸几乎找不到什么值钱的东西——战斗的狂怒已让这头巨兽付出了惨重代价。然而，仍有一片鳞甲完好无损，上面刻着一枚白色的竖琴与弯月徽记。
The corpse of the copper dragon rests half inside the collapsed cave mouth, its manta-like wings torn and bloodied. Clambering around the rocks, you unfortunately find little of value, the fury of the combat having taken a heavy toll on the beast. However, one scale remains unblemished, a white harp and moon symbol having been etched on it.

Sundries From A Sword-pierced Zombie.name:
被剑贯穿的丧尸（特征）杂物
Sundries From A Sword-pierced Zombie

Text.text:
在这具丧尸（特征）腐烂的脖颈上，你发现一枚银金币，用皮绳穿起挂着。奇怪的是，它的两面都被刻上了亵渎的符号，像是刻意用来玷污。
Around the zombie’s rotting neck, you find an electrum piece threaded onto leather cord. Curiously, it has been defaced by a profane symbol on both sides.

Insult About Languages.name:
关于语言的侮辱
Insult About Languages

Text.text:
“这世界拥有无数精妙的语言，可我却怎么也找不到恰当的词句，来形容我对你的蔑视。”
“This world holds many exquisite languages, and yet, I can’t seem to find the proper words to describe my contempt for you.”

兔子伏在冰冷的地面上，显得格外渺小，短短的四肢蜷缩在身下。修长而优雅的耳朵像冠冕般立在这只生物的微小头颅上。它那曾经灵动、时刻颤动的红粉色鼻尖，如今再也不抽动了。
The rabbit looks tiny as it lies on the cold ground, its stubby limbs tucked beneath itself. Long, elegant ears crown the creature’s miniscule head. Its ruddy-pink nose, once lively and in constant motion, twitches no more.

Professor Of Biomancy.name:
生体塑能教授
Professor Of Biomancy

Text.text:
一位人鱼教授站在一张巨大的桌子后方，桌面并非死物，而是一片活着的草与蕨类，小石子点缀其间，一条细细的溪流蜿蜒穿行，最终汇入桌子所安置的淡水水族箱底座。她的双手之下，是一整套完整的微型生态系统。她那圆润而慈和的眼睛缓缓扫过课堂，声音却出奇地柔滑。她把校袍披在鳞片与鳍的外面，宽大的蓝色双手举止优雅而一丝不苟，讲授着生物学的秘奥——如何滋养生命，令其生长，并加以操控。

~ 由一位英雄构想

A merfolk professor stands behind an enormous table with a living top of grass and ferns, small stones, and a little creek that channels into the freshwater aquarium base on which it sits. Under her hands is a complete microsystem. Her kind, bulbous eyes scan the class, and her voice is surprisingly smooth. She wears the school robes over her scales and fins, and her large bluish hands move gracefully and meticulously as she teaches the secrets of biology and how to nurture life, grow it, and manipulate it.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

在这里，墓室的祭司们沐浴祈祷，吟唱圣歌，端详他们劳作的成果。熏了香料的亚麻布与焚香交织出馥郁气息，却又与血腥的恶臭、咸水的淡淡吐息，以及冷冽的沙粒味一同翻涌。
Here the priests of the tomb wash and pray, sing, and regard the results of their work. Spiced linens and incense mix their fragrances with the stench of blood, the faint breath of salt water, and cool sand.

在一层油腻污垢的光泽之下，民居与商铺的墙面仍努力显出本来的模样。这里曾经也该有过街区——当这座镇子扩张成城市时，功能分区逐渐成形：工坊林立的坊区、教会辖地、钱庄聚集的金融区、汲水的井台与行会大厅。可如今，若真还有政府或神职人员，也无人知晓。城里到处钉着宵禁之类的告示牌，像麻点般嵌在街角与墙面上。河边的磨坊成了盗贼公会的巢穴，市政厅也只在一周里开门两次。城市的许多地段，封板的门窗比敞开的还多；而通往主街的大门口，两名守卫迎向每一个入城者。两人都带着武器，却都不穿制服。
Under a sheen of grime, the walls of houses and shops try to show themselves. Neighborhoods must have formed once, when the town became a city: functional boroughs, the church district, the financial district, the wells and the guild halls. Now, if there is a government or clergy, no one would know. Ordinance signs about who may be out after dark pockmark the city. The mill on the river houses a thieves’ guild, and the town hall is only open twice per week. Parts of the city are more boarded up than not, and at the gate to the main street, two guards greet anyone entering. Both are armed, but neither wears a uniform.

Sleep-deprived Emt.name:
缺觉的埃姆特
Sleep-deprived Emt

Text.text:
年轻女子眼下的浓重黑眼圈仿佛已成了挥之不去的常客。她在长椅上稍作休息，几乎没有察觉城市的喧嚣从身旁疾驰而过。她手里那杯大号外带咖啡早已见底，却仍把最后几滴摇进嘴里，随即撑起身子，拖着沉重的步伐朝不远处的救护车走去。
Dark bags have taken up permanent residence under the young woman's eyes, and she barely seems to register the city rushing by her as she takes a moment's rest on a bench. The large takeaway coffee she holds is already empty, but she shakes the last drops into her mouth before pushing herself up and trudging toward the nearby ambulance.

Wand Of Lightning Bolts.name:
闪电箭魔杖
Wand Of Lightning Bolts

Text.text:
这根由银合金锻造的魔杖，被塑成一束自持杖者拳间迸射而出的微缩分叉闪电。你握住它时，一丝轻微的麻意顺着手臂滑落——淡得几乎察觉不到，待你想到时，已只剩记忆的余温。
The wand, forged from a silver alloy, has been styled to resemble a miniature forked bolt of lightning flying forth from the wielder’s fist. A faint tingle moves down your arm as you grasp it—so faint that by the time you think of it, it is but a memory.

Loot From A Green Slaad.name:
来自绿史莱德的战利品
Loot From A Green Slaad

Text.text:
蟾蜍头顶扣着一顶白金制的恐惧盔，内衬嵌着锤击成纹的星蔷薇石英。那石英价值500枚金币，而这头盔——很可能值400枚白金币。
On the toad’s head is a platinum dread helm lined with hammered star-rose quartz. The quartz is worth 500 gold pieces, but the helmet—likely 400 platinum pieces.

Final Blow To Corrupted Companion.name:
对堕落同伴的终结一击
Final Blow To Corrupted Companion

Text.text:
短暂而沉重的停顿后，刀刃被猛然送入，干净利落地刺穿你同伴那颗已被腐化的心脏。他们酸绿的眼睛骤然睁大，畸形的肢体最后一次颤抖，随即归于寂静。当他们与你的目光相接，你感到他们的释然——仿佛鸟儿挣脱囚笼，终于得以再度振翅高飞。

~ Envisioned by Gixxer1st on Discord

After a weighted pause, the blade is driven home, piercing your companion's corrupted heart cleanly. Their acid-green eye stretches wide, and malformed limbs shudder for the last time. As they meet your gaze you sense their relief, like a bird free of its cage, free to take wing once more.

~ Envisioned by Gixxer1st on Discord

一阵清凉的微风掠过沼泽，裹挟着腐烂植物的腥臭恶味。地面布满深浅不一的积水洼，从小水坑到水潭不等。水色漆黑，几乎纹丝不动，污浊而腐臭。高大而光秃的树木在风中吱呀作响，仿佛被风从沉寂里硬生生拽醒。凡是不被水覆盖之处，苔藓与其他植被——包括密集带刺的藤蔓与层层叶丛——都掩藏着深陷的泥坑。
A cool breeze blows through the bog, carrying with it the rank scent of decomposing plants. Deep pockets of water line the ground, ranging from puddles to pools. The water is black, almost entirely still, and putrid. Tall bare trees creak as the wind coaxes them from their stillness. Wherever there is not water, moss and other plant life, including dense barbed vines and leafy foliage, hide deep pits of mud.

I Converse With A Red Dragon.name:
我与一条红龙交谈
I Converse With A Red Dragon

Text.text:
“一个人的人生不该只剩下囤积宝藏、吞吃牲畜吧？你可曾想过度个假？或许该停下来，好好环顾这美丽的世界，而不是把它一把火点了？”
“Surely there must be more to one’s life than hoarding treasure and eating livestock. Have you ever considered a vacation? Maybe taking a moment to survey this beautiful world instead of setting it on fire?”

Beach Shrine To A Halfling God.name:
献给半身人神祇的海滨神龛
Beach Shrine To A Halfling God

Text.text:
你逐渐靠近一处海边神龛的残迹，海岸线仿佛迎面伸来；你这才意识到建筑并不算远——只是比你想象得更小。你看见几扇半身人尺度的圆窗，窗沿低矮，窗下堆着细小的沙丘，像是正蠢蠢欲动要把沙子倾进屋内。里面一座沉寂的炉膛旁放着一只装灰的桶，桶里备着火把；低矮的祭坛上，一面小圆盾与几把短剑像餐桌摆盘般整齐陈列。对半身人而言，为了守护他人而放弃家的温暖与餐桌的安稳，是极大的牺牲；也许正因如此，有人将紫色的花放在了那面盾上。

~ Envisioned by Oldscruff

The shoreline grows to meet you as you approach the remains of a seaside shrine, and you realize the building isn’t that far away—it’s just smaller than expected. You observe the round sills of halfling-sized windows, miniature sand dunes beneath them seeking to spill into the structure. By a dormant hearth inside is an ash-bucket stocked with torches, and the low altar bears a small buckler and shortswords laid in the style of a table setting. To give up the comforts of home and table in defense of others is a great sacrifice for a halfling; perhaps in recognition of this, someone has placed purple flowers on the buckler.

~ Envisioned by Oldscruff

Brokk Goreeater.name:
布洛克·噬戈者
Brokk Goreeater

Text.text:
这名饱经战火的老兽人，活脱脱就是战士的写照：他臂膀与小腿上隆起一道道深绿色的伤脊，尽是战场上草草缝补后愈合的痕迹；面庞周围更布满细密的缺口与裂痕，像被岁月与刀锋共同刻出来的纹路。他却穿着考究的蓝色长袍，鼻梁上高高架着一副小巧的眼镜，伏案工作时弓着背，专注地在一本巨大的财务总账上逐项核对。桌后墙上挂着一柄魔法长戟，戟刃一眼就能看出曾历经数十年的行动洗礼。

~ 由一位英雄扮演

This battle-scarred old orc is the picture of a warrior, with dark green ridges of field-mended wounds over his arms and legs and a pattern of nicks and breaks around his face. He wears fine blue robes and tiny spectacles, which sit high on his nose while he works, bent over a large ledger of finances. Mounted on the wall behind his desk is a magical halberd, the blade obviously having seen decades of activity.

~ Played by a Hero

I Fail To Turn A Spell With My Ring Of S.name:
我没能用我的法术反转戒指反转一个法术
I Fail To Turn A Spell With My Ring Of Spell Turning

Text.text:
我感到那道法术的热浪咆哮着朝我扑来，快得根本来不及闪躲。我绝望地扬起手臂防御，盾面戒指迸出它与生俱来的魔法火花——可当我只听见一声嘶嘶作响的金属尖鸣时，胃里猛地一沉……敌人的法术以十足威势轰然命中，顷刻间淹没了我的视野。
I feel the heat of the spell as it rages toward me, too fast to dodge. I fling up my hand in a desperate defense, the shield-faced ring sparking with its innate magic—but my stomach sinks as I hear only a fizzling, metallic squeak… and the enemy spell floods my vision as it lands in full force.

Metallic Shard Concealed By Underbrush.name:
灌木丛下藏着的金属碎片
Metallic Shard Concealed By Underbrush

Text.text:
队伍以久经训练的静默潜行，娴熟地穿过灌木丛，在柔软潮湿的泥地上不留一丝行迹。忽然，一声被硬生生压下的痛呼与倒抽冷气的声音让他们当场止步。有人受伤了。众人转向同伴，只见他捂着脚——血正渗出——而他脚下的地面刺出一片猩红金属的碎片，其上刻着流淌般的白色文字。

~ 构想由 MaesterAelix 于 Discord

Moving in practiced silence, the group expertly creeps through the underbrush, leaving no trace of their passage in the soft, wet mud. A stifled cry and a sharp intake of breath stops them in their tracks. One of them is injured. Turning to their companion, they see he is holding his foot—now bleeding—and a shard of crimson metal protrudes from the ground below him with flowing white script emblazoned across it.

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

Low Tide Coastline.name:
低潮海岸线
Low Tide Coastline

Text.text:
大海的负载在远离海岸处巍然压来，海鸥掠过那阴郁的灰色巨影，喙尖几乎贴着翻卷的浪头。螃蟹在一望无际的湿沙上疾走，为了些许残渣与对手搏斗。洁白的潮池映着头顶的云影，而在池与池之间，一名围着围巾的女人踱步而行，围裙里装满贝壳，吹着一支庄严的曲调。
The bulk of the sea looms far from shore, gulls swooping above its sullen gray mass, beaks just above the breakers. Crabs scuttle across the expanse of wet sand, dueling rivals for scraps of food. White rock pools reflect the clouds above, and between them wanders a scarf-wrapped woman, her apron full of shells, whistling a solemn tune.

朽烂的骸骨在锈蚀的铁栏后于黑暗中无声地蜷伏，骷髅仍戴着生前被迫役使时所承受的镣铐。一路破坏的痕迹通向监牢之门——门板横倒在石板地上，铰链被生生扯断。
Moldering bones languish in darkness behind rusted iron bars, the skeletons still wearing the manacles of servitude the bodies bore in life. A trail of destruction leads to the prison doors lying on the flagstones, hinges wrenched asunder.

这个小巧的抛光木匣四面都雕着一轮风格化的太阳。每轮太阳的中央都有一道细小的狭缝，刚好能让硬币侧着滑入。铁制铰链与带微型钥匙孔的搭扣将较宽的木质上盖牢牢扣在匣身上，两枚圆环把弧形铁柄固定在这只匣盖之上。
This small box of polished wood has a stylized sun carved on each side. At each sun center is a tiny slot just big enough to slide a coin through sideways. Iron hinges and a latch with a tiny keyhole secure a wider wooden top to the box, and two rings fasten a curved iron handle to this lid.

当你的双唇吐出咒文，脑海里响起低沉的嗡鸣。空气如纸般起皱，你掌中的茧噼啪作响，一圈粼粼光辉自你周身向外扩散。无穷可能在你体内震颤。力量涌入你的意识。现实任你揉捏；你想象全新的存在形态——为你自己，也为他人。指尖轻轻一抽，你将那幻念硬生生拽入实体。
There's a humming in your mind as your lips begin the incantation. The air crinkles, and the cocoon in your hand crackles, as a shimmering aura spreads outward from you. Potential thrums through you. Power floods your mind. Reality is yours to bend; you imagine new states of being, for yourself and for others. With a twitch, you force that vision into physical form.

The Throne Of Bones.name:
白骨王座
The Throne Of Bones

Text.text:
起初只是地平线上的一粒小点，随着旅人逼近，那座丘陵迅速膨胀——直到触及那座巨大的白骨堆前，它已高高耸立，压得人仰望。其起源湮没于时代，却仍吸引着大陆各地的人们，他们绝望地试图登上顶端，献上自己的一截骨供。来自无数源头的添补——兽骨、鱼骨，甚至类人之骨——在通往顶端的每一寸路上都堆出无穷突起，锋利如刀；最终，只有少数人能成功登顶。
At first a tiny dot on the horizon, the hill quickly grows as travelers approach—until it towers over those who reach the massive pile of bones. Its origins lost to time, it still attracts individuals from all over the continent, who desperately try to attain the top and place their offering of bone. With contributions from many sources—animal, fish, even humanoid—creating endless protrusions, sharp as knives, on every inch of the way to the top, only a few manage to make it.

退潮时咸腥的海味先一步袭来，紧接着，一个矮短臃肿的生物现身——她的头发如海藻般纠缠，皮肤呈现出浮尸般肿胀的惨淡蓝色，仿佛刚从浪尖漂来。她那双又大又圆的眼睛浑浊发黄，四下游移，像在搜寻什么。她用一种灌满海水般嘶哑黏滞的嗓音喃喃自语。你不禁怀疑，那些鱼类般的特征——突出的眼球、手臂边缘的鳍，以及那股标志性的腥臭——究竟是天生如此，还是在海底栖居多年后才逐渐生成的。
The briny smell of low-tide precedes the appearance of a stunted, bulbous creature—her hair like seaweed, skin the pallid blue of a bloated corpse floating atop the waves. Wide eyes, watery and yellow, roam, searching for something. She mutters to herself in a voice waterlogged and croaky. You wonder if the fishlike features—protruding eyes, fins along the arms, and signature stench—are natural, or if they occurred after living beneath the sea all these years.

这种法术的力量会腐化许多施法者。它令最强韧的灵魂也心生恐惧，却能把软弱者变作奴仆。于是，当你随着目标心脏的每一次跳动吐出一个词——随着魅惑带来的恐惧逐渐渗入，你的语速也愈发急促——你开始掂量自己所提出要求的道德分量。
The power of this spell corrupts many spellcasters. While it strikes fear in even the strongest of souls, it can make slaves of the weak. So, as you breathe a word for each beat of the target’s heart—speeding your speech as fear of the charm sets in—you consider the morality of your demands.

龅牙覆毛，一只小啮齿兽窜了出来，狼一般的步态忽而一顿，伸爪扒拉松散的碎石与残渣。先是一只，又一只，继而更多同类涌来，转眼间地面便被吱吱乱叫的群潮铺满。它们借着颅顶那对胶质角轰然吹出震耳欲聋的号声——一支暴躁的小小乐团。
Bucktoothed and furry, a small rodent scuttles forth, pausing its lupine gait to scratch at loose rocks and detritus. First one, then another, then yet more join, before the ground is covered in a chittering swarm. They blast trumpets of deafening sound through the collagen horns atop their skulls—an irate little orchestra.

Conibear Trap.name:
科尼贝尔捕兽夹
Conibear Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 你发现，这个线框装置约莫一个方帽盒的体型，却根本不是盒子。两只弹簧把手从伪装的灌木间探出头来，而铁丝机关另一侧那条散发香气的“鱼”不过是糊成的、上过漆的木板。诱饵——专为引诱手或爪子伸进陷阱而设。

[触发] 一只步伐轻快的狐狸当即刹住脚步，侧头凝望。鱼鳞短促地闪了一下，那股味道再清楚不过。狐狸嗅着夹在自己与鱼之间的铁丝箱，先把头探进去试了试，随即半个身子踏入。陷阱以暗线系在地里的木桩上，骤然弹合。伪装的扣臂猛地一甩，将线框箱咔哒合拢在狐狸脖颈处，把他们死死卡住。他们拼命甩头挣扎，直到捕猎者赶来收尾。

[Perceived] The wire frame, about the size of a square hat box, isn’t a box at all, you discover. Two spring handles protrude into camouflaging brush, and the aromatic fish lying on the other side of the wire contraption is paste and painted board. Bait, designed to lure a hand or paw into the trap.

[Triggered] A fox with a bouncy step halts at once and turns their head. The fish’s scales sparkle briefly, and the scent is unmistakable. The fox sniffs at a wire box between them and the fish, pokes their head in briefly, then steps halfway through. The trap, fastened by a hidden line to a stake in the ground, springs shut. Camouflaged catch arms swing the wire box closed on the fox’s neck, holding them there. They swing their head and fight until the trapper arrives to finish the job.

Black Magga: The Beast Arrives.name:
黑玛伽：巨兽降临
Black Magga: The Beast Arrives

Text.text:
一头满身黏滑鳞片的午夜巨兽从翻涌的泡沫水中抬起獠牙森森的面孔，继而高高凌驾于屋顶之上。它庞大的身躯仿佛无处不在，粗如啤酒桶的触手穿浪破墙，猛刺狂甩，穿行其间轻松得就像你动一动手指。
A midnight beast of slimy scales raises a fanged face above the frothing water, then above the rooftops. Its massive body seems to be everywhere at once, as tentacles thick as beer barrels thrust and thrash through waves and walls, moving as easily through them as you can wiggle your fingers.

Sundries From A Green Hag.name:
绿鬼婆的杂物
Sundries From A Green Hag

Text.text:
鬼婆的藏货里有图腾雕刻、正在散开的芦苇娃娃——以及空瓶空罐；有些内壁还粘着干涸的残渣，来自那些邪毒的调配物。
The hag’s stash has totem carvings, reed dolls—unraveling—and empty bottles and jars, some with dried residue in them from wicked concoctions.

Rolling Boulder Trap.name:
滚石陷阱
Rolling Boulder Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 你迈步时脚下触到一片不平的纹理。你俯身拨开尘土，发现地面上有长长的刮痕——一道道被撕扯出的伤疤般轨迹，延伸得远远超过你的臂展。你沿着痕迹来到一面被藤蔓厚厚覆住的墙前。你伸手一推，却意识到那里根本没有墙能支撑你。你撕开植物，露出一条隐藏的滑槽。在滑槽顶端，一块巨石悬吊着。

[触发！] 一声响亮的咔嚓！在室内炸开，紧接着是震得地面发颤的砰然重响。远处那面原本如静谧藤瀑般的墙壁，在尘土与碎石的暴雨中轰然炸裂。一块巨大的巨石如暴怒公牛般疾冲，轰隆隆地朝你滚来。

[Perceived] You detect an uneven texture as you step. You bend low to brush the dirt away and find long scrapes in the floor, scarred tracks that extend far beyond your arm’s length. You follow the tracks to a wall covered thickly with vines. You push against it and realize there is no wall to hold you. You tear through the plant to find a hidden chute. At the top of the shoot, a boulder is suspended.

[Triggered!] A loud snap! rings through the room, followed by a ground-shaking thump. The far wall, formerly a serene cascade of vines, explodes in a shower of dust and rubble. A massive boulder rolls toward you with the haste of a furious bull.

Klirush Iriegwen.name:
克利鲁什·伊里耶格温
Klirush Iriegwen

Text.text:
这名龙裔高高挺立，身披烟灰缭绕、布满尖刺的鳞片护甲，背后斜负一面参差如锯的盾牌。他的鳞片在祖母绿与乳白的青玉色之间流转变幻。一道带刺的冠脊自眼上方起势，向上拔高数寸，更添他本就惊人的身量。这样的高度让他俯视大多数人，而他微眯的金色眼眸与一丝冷笑暗示，他的俯视不止来自身高。他看起来迫不及待要惹出麻烦。

~ Played by a Hero

他的手指缓缓摩挲着腰侧华饰剑鞘中阔剑那枚镶宝石的银质剑首；武器的护手同样以银饰点缀。其余的饰物多为黄金，零星映在他的装束上，无声宣告他拥有——或出身于——不容小觑的财富。 This dragonborn stands tall in smoky, spiked scale armor, a jagged shield slung on his back. His scales vary in hue from emerald to milky jade. A distinctive spined crest starts just above his eyes and adds several inches to his considerable stature. His height means he looks down on most others, but his narrowed golden eyes and slight sneer imply he might do so in more than one way. He seems eager for trouble. His hand caresses the bejeweled silver pommel of a broadsword in an ornamented sheath hung on his hip. Silver also adorns the weapon’s guard. Other jewelry, most of it gold, accents his attire, silently suggesting he has, or comes from, considerable wealth.

~ Played by a Hero

Loot From A Karalaq Quori.name:
来自卡拉拉克夸奥瑞的战利品
Loot From A Karalaq Quori

Text.text:
翻涌的阴影与眼睛之云发出回荡的咆哮，声音里满是怨恨；它对自身形体的幽暗束缚逐渐松开——终于——崩落。那团光晕如一段羽轻的雪纺般向下飘荡，落地堆成一团，里面的眼睛仍在游移翻转。你走近这团布料似的褶皱才看清：这些眼睛并无恶意，也并不特别在意你。相反，它们带着真切的好奇四处掠动，仿佛第一次看见这个世界。你熄灭了那团光晕的生命与恶念，它昔日自我的一层残影便留在此处：一袭满布眼睛的长袍。
The swirling cloud of shadow and eyes releases an echoing snarl, its voice full of resentment as its tenebrous hold on its own form loosens and—finally—falls. Like a length of feather-light chiffon, the nimbus wafts downward and settles in a heap, the eyes still shifting within it. As you move closer to this clothlike crumple, you see that these eyes are not full of malice nor do they have a marked interest in you. Rather, they flit about in genuine curiosity, as if they were seeing the world for the first time. In extinguishing the nimbus’s life and ill intent, a shroud of its former self has been left behind: a robe of eyes.

Elf Street Urchin.name:
精灵街头流浪儿
Elf Street Urchin

Text.text:
尽管浑身污秽得连老鼠都要嫌恶，这名年轻精灵却仍以其族裔与生俱来的优雅与尊严自持。蓬乱如火的赤红头发覆在柔和的面庞上，然而那双眼睛却硬得不像如此年少之人。小流浪儿的双脚被熏黑得几乎难以辨认，他们行动鬼祟，谨慎而迅疾，宛如野兽。
Though covered in filth a rat would find repulsive, the young elf carries themself with the grace and dignity inherent of their ilk. A shock of fiery red hair crowns a soft face, with eyes too hard for one so young. The urchin’s feet are blackened beyond recognition, and they move furtively, with the care and speed of a wild animal.

Farmer’s Field In Hot Summer.name:
盛夏的农田
Farmer’s Field In Hot Summer

Text.text:
在灼人的盛夏酷热里，农夫的田地被烤得发白，大地龟裂，成了一块块破碎的泥土拼布。被烈日浸透的草丛在风里摇摆，因头顶那轮炽亮天体无休止的鞭挞而干脆易折。一群汗流浃背的农工瘫在石墙的阴影下，工具随手丢在一旁，劳作的欲望早已成了遥远的回忆。
In the searing summer heat, the farmer’s field bakes, the earth a broken patchwork of dirt. Sun-soaked patches of grass sway, brittle from the relentless punishment from the radiant orb above. A sweaty group of farmhands lie in the shade of a stone wall, their tools cast aside and their lust to work but a memory.

I String My Bow.name:
我弯弓搭弦
I String My Bow

Text.text:
我把编好的弓弦分别套上弓的两端，然后迈出一条腿跨进弓弦里。弓底抵在小腿后侧，我稳住它，深吸一口气，让肌肉先行绷紧。以前这套流程总让我发怵——我身上还留着几道早年笨手笨脚时的疤——但如今不过是几下顺滑而熟练的动作。我把弓梢朝自己拉近，小腿用力顶住作支撑。随后我将弓弦滑进弓顶的弦槽里，让武器弯成它应有的弧度。
I loop the woven string over both ends of my bow, then step one leg through the bowstring. I steady the bottom of the bow behind my leg and take a deep breath to prime my muscles. This process used to make me nervous—and I have a few scars from past clumsy attempts—but now it’s just a few fluid, practiced movements. I pull the tip of the bow toward myself, using my calf to brace it. I slip the bowstring into the groove at the top of my bow, bending the weapon into its proper shape.

Elemental Bane: Acid.name:
元素灾厄：酸蚀
Elemental Bane: Acid

Text.text:
液态能量在你体内奔涌，凝成一圈脉动的酸蚀威能光环。空气中弥漫着收敛刺鼻的魔法气息，像是即将溶解万物的尖锐恶臭。你身形渐渐模糊，在你与远处的敌手之间开启一道通道，试图剥离他们的防护，让他们在你所驾驭的力量面前更加脆弱。
Liquid energy surges within you, forming a pulsating aura of acidic might. An astringent scent of magic fills the air, an acerbic reek of looming dissolution. Your form blurs as you open a channel between you and your distant foe, attempting to strip away their defenses and heighten their vulnerability to the powers you command.

二头肌大如甜瓜，双腿粗似树干，这位马戏团大力士壮得像头公牛。尽管他的肌肉在沉重到极致的铁杠铃下绷紧如弦，他却仿佛毫不费力地将其抡来舞去；浓密却精心上蜡的八字胡下，他漂白得雪亮的牙齿在卖艺人的笑容里闪闪发光。
With biceps the size of melons and thighs as thick as tree trunks, this circus strongman is as powerful as a bull. Despite his muscles straining under the extreme weight of his iron barbell, he heaves it about as if without effort, his bleached white teeth shining in a showman’s smile under a bushy but carefully waxed mustache.

Beast Transforms Into Werehuman.name:
野兽化为狼人
Beast Transforms Into Werehuman

Text.text:
这只毛发蓬乱、形似老鼠的生物蜷缩成一团，痛得抽搐扭动，尖叫声不绝于耳。头顶云层裂开，月光倾泻而下，浸透它枯瘦的身躯，一场蜕变随之发生。稀薄的灰毛像松树褪针般簌簌脱落，硕大的黄牙仿佛也缩回了头颅之中。它的躯体以全然违背解剖常理的方式拉长、变形，褪去兽性外壳，变得几乎像人——只在一段时代里。

~

The scraggly, ratlike creature curls up, writhing in pain and squeaking incessantly. As the clouds part overhead and the light of the moon bathes the beast's scrawny form, a transformation takes place. The thin gray fur falls out like a pine shedding its needles, and the creature's large yellow teeth seem to recede back into their head. Their body stretches and morphs in an anatomically impossible fashion as they shed their bestial form and become mostly human—for a time.

~

Explosion Damages Building.name:
爆炸摧毁建筑
Explosion Damages Building

Text.text:
那面发光的巨幅墙景——一位年轻、艳丽的模特对你飞吻的脸庞——在一道棱彩般的爆裂中粉碎，玻璃、金属与塑料四散迸飞。爆炸自建筑内部轰然炸开，烟火翻涌，将混凝土与金属碎块猛地向外抛射。最近的一股飞车车流当场断裂，车辆从空中高速路上四散失控，空中旋转甩尾，有的撞进楼体，有的机头直坠，扎向下方街道。
The luminescent wallscape—the face of a young, gorgeous model blowing a kiss—shatters with a prismatic burst of glass, metal, and plastic. An explosion erupts from within the building, sending chunks of concrete and metal flying outward with smoke and fire. The nearest stream of flying cars breaks, vehicles scattering haphazardly from the sky highway in aerial spinouts, crashing into buildings or nose diving to the streets below.

Dungeon: Arched Doorway.name:
地城：拱形门道
Dungeon: Arched Doorway

Text.text:
前方的门嵌在一道雕刻拱门之中，每一块石头都经过精心挑选与砌放。它古老却坚固，要用些力气才能推开。铰链在受力时发出低低的吱呀声，但做工扎实，门与铰链都没有断裂。
The door ahead is framed by a carved archway, each stone chosen and set with care. It is old but sturdy, and it takes some force to push it open. The hinges creak quietly from the effort, but the craftsmanship is solid, and neither door nor hinges break.

Speeding Car Catches Major Air.name:
飞驰的汽车腾空高跃
Speeding Car Catches Major Air

Text.text:
汽车仿佛挣脱了物理定律——哪怕只是一瞬——凌空飞驰而过。你注视着它腾跃上天时，时代似乎放慢了脚步；车身在飞行中近乎失重，轻盈地掠过半空，而你被眼前上演的奇景牢牢攫住。
The car appears to escape the laws of physics—if only for a moment—as it sails through the air. Time seems to slow as you watch the vehicle soar, almost weightless in its flight, captivated by the spectacle playing out before you.

Sundries From A Tyrannosaurus Rex.name:
霸王龙的杂货
Sundries From A Tyrannosaurus Rex

Text.text:
剖开生物的腹腔，一股腐臭的毒气迎面扑来，内脏的内容物在你眼前倾泻而出。在那堆宛如尸肉堆的脏器、半消化的肉块与骨头之中，有一样东西攫住了你的目光：一枚小小的玻璃棱镜，里面嵌着一座白镴打造的神殿。
Slicing open the creature’s belly you are hit with a wave of putrid gas as the contents of its innards spill out before you. Amid the charnel heap of offal and half-digested meat and bones, something catches your eye: a small glass prism with a pewter temple nestled inside.

Gantries In A Vast Drive Room.name:
辽阔传动室中的栈桥
Gantries In A Vast Drive Room

Text.text:
栈桥环绕着空旷的驱动舱室，如同一顶覆着霜华的钢铁王冠。梯子向下垂落，宛如宏伟神殿中的列柱通往下方地面，而房间在中央那座巨大的驱动核心回响中震颤不止。
Gantries encircle the cavernous drive room like a crown of steel rimed with frost. Ladders descend to the ground below like columns in a vast temple, and the room shakes with the reverberations of the titanic drive core at its center.

Insult About Obnoxious Face.name:
关于那张讨人嫌的脸的侮辱
Insult About Obnoxious Face

Text.text:
“这不是你做了什么，或将要做什么——因为说实话，那也不过是微不足道。只是你的脸，简直让人无法忍受；哪怕你没在说话，我都觉得自己想叫你闭嘴。”
“It’s nothing you’ve done, or will do—because, let’s be honest, that will amount to very little. It’s just your face, it’s unbearable, I feel like I want to tell you to shut up even when you’re not speaking.”

Lair Of The Siren: In The Shadows.name:
海妖之巢：暗影之中
Lair Of The Siren: In The Shadows

Text.text:
从黑暗里传来的笑声在你脑海深处来回撞击、回响。那份威胁如今带着捕食者般不可逃避的必然。阴影满足地轻叹，仿佛你的末日早已降临。
The laughter coming from the dark ricochets around the inside of your head. Its threat now has a predatory sense of inevitability. The shadows sigh in satisfaction, as if your doom has already come.

Taunt From A Dragon After Being Struck.name:
被击中后巨龙的嘲讽
Taunt From A Dragon After Being Struck

Text.text:
“你竟敢打我？等这一切结束，我会为你在我这荣耀鳞片上留下的每一道划痕，烧掉整整一座村庄。”
“You dare strike me? When this is over, I will burn an entire village for every scratch you have left on my glorious scales.”

I Breathe In A Vacuum With My Necklace O.name:
我戴着适应项链，在真空中吸气
I Breathe In A Vacuum With My Necklace Of Adaptation

Text.text:
即便戴着项链，我每一次呼吸都浅得像是偷来的——仿佛这片冰冷的虚空随时会识破我的小把戏，把空气从我肺里夺走。我在一阵恐慌中抬手按住那扭曲的铁制项圈，尽管接触时冰寒刺骨，却能感到一股稳定的震颤——活跃的魔法在其间脉动。我深吸一口气，继续向更深的深渊飘去。
Even with the necklace, each breath I take feels shallow and stolen—as if at any moment this cold void might discover my clever trick and steal the air from my lungs. I bring a hand to the twisted iron torque in a moment of panic and, although icy to the touch, I feel a steady thrum of active magic. I take a deep breath and float further into the abyss.

Sundries From A Wereboar.name:
来自兽猪人的杂货
Sundries From A Wereboar

Text.text:
在这生物散发恶臭的躯体上，你发现它粗壮结实的脖颈上挂着一串五彩木珠；圆滚滚的腰间挎着一个小包，里面塞着几条气味冲鼻的肉干。更古怪的是，你还在它沾满污渍的裤子口袋里摸到一袋闪亮的玻璃弹珠。
On the creature’s stinking body, you find a string of colorful wooden beads around its thick, muscular neck, as well as strips of pungent jerky in a satchel around its rotund waist. Curiously, you also find a bag of shiny glass marbles tucked into a pocket of their stained breeches.

喜悦充盈房间，新晋的母亲将她纤弱的赋礼轻轻揽入怀中；泪水顺着涨红的脸颊滚落，她无言凝望着自己的造物，满是惊异与敬畏。牧师温柔地向新生儿伸出手，对母亲报以安抚的微笑，一抹柔和的光辉开始在掌心凝聚。母亲急切地点头，将孩子向前托起，祈求神祇赐下祝福的庇护。

~ Tusker2zero 于 Discord

Joy fills the room as the new mother cradles her delicate gift, tears streaming down her flushed cheeks as she stares in speechless wonder at her creation. The cleric gently offers a hand to the newborn as they favor the mother with a reassuring smile, and a soft radiance begins to coalesce around their palm. Nodding eagerly, the mother holds her child out for the blessed protection of the gods.

~ Tusker2zero on Discord

Loot From A Black Magga.name:
来自黑色巨蛭的战利品
Loot From A Black Magga

Text.text:
黑色蛆怪在致命武力的压制下终于止住狂暴，半截身躯浸没在被碾碎并灌满洪水的残垣断壁间。再细看它那布满獠牙与鳞片的头颅，原本以为只是另一片鳍的东西，其实是一柄三叉戟深深刺入生物的颈侧，戟身上装饰的贝壳与海蓝宝在黯淡的微光里冷冷闪烁。
The black magga, its rampage subdued by lethal force, lies partially submerged amid the ruins of a crushed and flooded building. Examining its fanged and scaly head more closely, what appeared to be just another fin is, in fact, a trident plunged into the creature’s neck, ornamental shells and aquamarines gleaming in the wan light.

弯曲的刀身由一整块祖母绿凿削而成。光滑的翠绿色表面上点缀着深色斑驳，宛如树荫斑驳的密林；金色护手则饰以蛇形般蜿蜒的纹饰。握柄包裹着柔滑的黑色皮革。
The curved blade is hewn from a solid cut of emerald. The dark mottling on its smooth green surface is evocative of a shade-dappled forest, and the golden guard is embellished with serpentine flourishes. The grip is wrapped in smooth black leather.

你双手抬起，掌心向上，呼啸的狂风仿佛自地面骤然涌起，化作一道无形的风墙，将任何不幸被卷入其中的生物猛然掀翻，狼狈倒地。
Raising your hands palms up, whistling winds suddenly spring up as if from the ground in an invisible wall, knocking any creature unlucky enough to be caught in the shear sprawling.

Dungeon: Lit Corridor.name:
地城：灯火长廊
Dungeon: Lit Corridor

Text.text:
通道里骤然刺目的强光令人一时难以适应。等距排列的壁灯燃得明亮，将走廊浸在温暖的光晕中。长长的影子贴着墙面游移，在摇曳的灯火里微微抽动。
The sudden, harsh illumination of the passage takes some time to adjust to. Evenly spaced sconces burn brightly, casting the corridor in a warm glow. Long shadows play against the wall and twitch in the flickering lights.

一大团被连根拔起的树木纠结缠绕，围成一圈粗陋的圆环，像一只巨大的筐篮。破碎的马车、粉碎的货车，甚至一艘小船的桅杆，都从这堆木头里戳刺而出；木头上糊着恶臭的灰白黏浆，夹杂着巨大的羽毛，每一根都比鸵鸟的还要大。中央是一座褐色与黄褐色斑驳的圆顶：一枚大到如农舍般的蛋，端坐在这座泰坦般的巨巢里。
A great tangle of uprooted trees forms a rough circle and a kind of vast basket. Broken carriages, shattered wagons, even the mast of a small ship jut from this mess of wood plastered with a stinking gray-white goo and huge feathers, each larger than an ostrich’s. A speckled brown and tan dome occupies the center: an egg as big as a peasant’s hut in a titanic nest.

她身形高挑、肌肉结实，穿着皮质紧身裤，外面缠绕着一道道钢箍。翻折的长靴在膝处收口，带着海盗般的利落风范。浓密的深褐长发披散在肩头，其间点缀着骨片与鳞片做的坠饰叮当微响。胸甲上浮雕着振翼飞龙，裸露的双臂布满疤痕，交织成利爪与獠牙的纹路。她戴着手套的一只手握着权杖；腰间还留着挂鞭的钩子，却根本用不着。女神天生令人心惊胆寒——可在她的群龙面前，她又温柔得像无垠长空一般，而它们也同样深爱着她。
She is tall and muscular, wearing leather leggings wrapped in steel bands. Her folded-over boots are cuffed at the knee in the style of a pirate. A mass of dark brown hair decorated with bone and scale baubles rests on her shoulders. Her breastplate is embossed with flying dragons and her bare arms are scarred in patterns of claws and teeth. In one gloved hand she carries a scepter. There is a hook on her belt for a whip, but she has no need for one. The goddess cannot help but intimidate, although she is as gentle with her dragons—and as loved by them—as the sky is wide.

Eye Of The God-lich.name:
神巫妖之眼
Eye Of The God-lich

Text.text:
你胃里一阵翻腾，厌恶地望着一只布满血丝的离体眼球——虹膜呈腐肉般病态的青绿，瞳孔竖直，几乎带着爬行动物般的冷酷。覆满黏液的球体后方拖着一团纠缠的神经，如同一条骇人的尾巴。你甚至还没来得及移开视线，那眼球便仿佛察觉到了你的存在，令人不寒而栗地追随着你的动作——仿佛能看穿你脆弱的凡躯之下的一切。诡异而几近压倒性的凶兆感逼得你不得不别开目光。
With a churn of disgust, you look upon a bloodshot, disembodied eye, its iris the sickly green of corrupted flesh, its pupil vertical and almost reptilian in appearance. A tangle of nerves trails behind the slime-covered sphere like a macabre tail. Even as you watch, the eyeball seems to perceive you, unnervingly following your movements—seeing beyond the fragility of your mortal flesh. An uncanny and nearly overwhelming feeling of foreboding forces you to avert your gaze.

Dieggeth Imru Ukilvas.name:
迪格斯·伊姆鲁·乌基尔瓦斯
Dieggeth Imru Ukilvas

Text.text:
纤瘦的卓尔一个潇洒的旋身，便将厚重的斗篷从肩头甩落；紧接着一气呵成地将它折得整整齐齐，搭在左臂弯里。乌檀般的面庞上，洁白整齐的牙齿在一抹若有若无的笑意中微微一闪；那神情沉稳踏实，却又覆着一层谨慎的冷淡。银色细条纹马甲的口袋里，塞着一副圆形的深紫色镜片，嵌在金色镜框中，映出他一侧护臂里收纳的金属飞镖的影子。腰侧系带上固定着一个深棕皮革小包；大腿上方绑着一只包袋，袋盖上以黯铜色丝线绣出医者的双蛇杖纹章。他的面容光滑无瑕，唯独一条浅淡的疤痕横过一侧雕刻般优雅的颧骨。

~ Played by utgard_scribbles

With a flourish, the slender drow sheds the great cloak from his shoulders, and in a single motion folds it neatly to drape over his left arm. Straight white teeth shine in his ebon face as it splits in a subtle grin, his expression conveying a grounded manner married to a guarded veneer. Tucked into the pocket of his silver pinstriped vest, a pair of round dark-purple lenses set in golden spectacle frames reflect an image of the metal throwing darts tucked into one bracer. Upon his hip, a dark brown leather bag has been secured to his belt, and strapped above his knee, the emblem of a healer’s caduceus picked out in muted copper thread upon its flap. His smooth countenance is flawless, save for a single pale scar crossing one elegantly sculpted cheekbone.

~ Played by utgard_scribbles

Mountain Pass: Nearby Mountain Waterfall.name:
山道关隘：近旁的山间飞瀑
Mountain Pass: Nearby Mountain Waterfall

Text.text:
一股急流沿着岩壁奔泻而下，翻滚着越过巨石，在水流冲刷成的石穴里搅动碎石。冰冷的溪水清澈洁净，想必是由上坡的山中冰雪融汇而成。山坡上的峭壁与嶙峋岩脊开辟出一道道瀑布的落点，有的从数十尺高处直坠而下，溅起一片白沫与水雾。
A torrent runs down the rocks, tumbling over boulders and churning stones in the wells formed by its flow. The chill water runs clear and clean, no doubt fed by mountain ice upslope. Cliffs and crags in the mountainside create spaces for waterfalls, some plunging dozens of feet before splashing into white froth and mist.

这场发现遵循一套规矩：切口像探水杖般弯转成形；内脏被称量、取样，细致得仿佛下一刻就要用纸包好递给厨子；淤伤留下线索，告诉你那双手在终结前做过什么；还有颅盖骨所述说的一切。缺失的部分也同样不可遗忘。手套“啪”地一声扯下，钢器落入托盘的最后一记铿响回荡时，验尸官便已知晓——这具尸体无法向任何人诉说的秘密。
The discovery follows a set of rules: The cut, shaped like a dousing rod; viscera weighed and sampled as if it might be wrapped in paper for a chef; contusion clues that tell you what the hands did before the end; and what the skull cap says. One cannot forget any missing parts either. When the glove snaps off and the last clank of steel dropped into a tray rings out, the coroner knows what the corpse can tell no one else.

他如沙暴般咆哮，黝黑赤膊的战士跨在筋肉虬结的坐骑上猛冲而出，人与马被同一股嗜战的狂热连为一体。战马疾驰时，口沫自鼻端飞溅，迫不及待要载着主人投入厮杀。战士晒成古铜的肌肤下，巨大的肌肉绷紧隆起，他高举战斧——随时将迅疾的死亡劈向敌人。
Roaring like a sandstorm, the swarthy, bare-chested warrior charges forth atop his muscular steed, horse and rider united in their lust for battle. Spittle flies from the horse’s muzzle as it gallops, eager to bear its master into the fray. Huge muscles pull taut beneath the warrior’s tanned skin as he lifts his axe high—ready to deliver swift death to his enemies.

Arrival At The Lunar City Of Sitnalta.name:
抵达月之城锡特纳尔塔
Arrival At The Lunar City Of Sitnalta

Text.text:
当你身后那道银白色的传送门光辉渐渐远去，一座仍有人居住的古城城门便矗立在你眼前。这里看不出任何来自地球的先前到访痕迹，但目之所及的许多事物仿佛已历经数千年风霜：斑驳、褪色，却仍顽强抵御着时代的侵蚀。你看见人类与精灵风格的街巷之间，点缀着侏儒式的建筑，如同被悄悄嵌入其间的暗格。整座城市带着一种灾变后的气息——无休止的修补、加固与翻新，像是从未真正迎来安宁。楼宇厚重敦实，深深扎根，修筑得仿佛要抵挡某种难以想象的世界级冲击，把居民护在其中，熬过数百年的重建与再度繁衍。

~ 构想：Mitch Prince

When the silver-white gleam of the portal is behind you, the gates of an ancient city—which is still occupied—stand before you. There is no evidence of a previous visitation from Earth, but much of what exists here seems to be thousands of years old, weathered but withstanding the passage of time. You see gnomish architecture pocketed among streets of human and elvish design. There is something of the post-cataclysmic to this city, a feeling of constant refurbishing. The buildings are stout, dug-in, and constructed to withstand some incalculable onslaught of the world and keep its inhabitants safe through centuries of reconstruction and repopulation.

~ Envisioned by Mitch Prince

Divine Glacial Home Of A God Of The Arct.name:
极地冰川神祇的圣居
Divine Glacial Home Of A God Of The Arctic

Text.text:
冰面自一片慵懒铺展的青绿海水中拔地而起。它不只是冰山或冰川：这座岛本身就是一个国家，也是某位神祇的居所。洞窟通向一座宏伟大厅，隧道如蛛网裂纹般分岔，延伸至诸多房间；那些房间的墙壁蓝而半透明，野兽与老练的宫廷侍从都在其中栖身。就在冰川冰原的悬崖边，有一处观景露台，边缘敞开，湿滑难行。海狮在下方游弋，迟缓的白熊在浮冰间抬起又落下前掌。它们的爪子在冰上是黑的，像此地漫长的夜，只是少了明亮的极光。
The ice rises from a lazy expanse of turquoise seawater. It is more than an iceberg or a glacier: the island is a nation unto itself, and the home of a god. A cave leads into a grand hall, tunnels like spider-cracks leading to many chambers with blue translucent walls, where both wild animals and seasoned courtiers stay. Just along the cliff of the glacier’s ice field is an observation terrace, its edge open and slippery. Sea lions swim below, and slow white bears lift and drop their paws along the floes. Their claws are black on the ice, much like the long nights here, only without the bright aurora.

在辽阔荒原的落日霞色之上，沙丘与高台在呢喃中悄然换形，蓝天纯净得前所未见。炽热与干燥的空气灌满沙帆的抛物线，顺着滑橇掠过连绵沙丘。片刻后，六只左右流线纤巧的青绿生物带着背鳍猛然从沙丘中炸出，循着沙帆的轨迹追逐，转眼又钻回沙下，再次跃出，划出一串嬉戏的弧线。
Above the sunset colors of the great expanse, dunes and plateaus changing shapes in whispers, the blue sky seems purer than you’ve ever seen. Heat and dry air fill the parabola of a sandsail, coursing over the dunes on its runners. After a while, a half dozen sleek turquoise creatures with dorsal fins explode from the dune and follow the sail’s track, diving back under the sand and emerging again in playful arcs.

I Disarm A Flame-throwing Trap.name:
我解除一个喷火陷阱
I Disarm A Flame-throwing Trap

Text.text:
我注意到墙脚处排列着涂满油渍的喷口，以及数量异常多的燃烧壁灯，便让我的伙伴们靠近一扇门待命。我花了片刻仔细勘查才找出触发机关；随后我以几步迅捷而谨慎的步伐穿过房间，开始动手。我解除陷阱，耳畔响起一声金属的咔哒轻响，紧接着远处传来低沉悠长的泄压叹息。
Having spotted the oil-lined spouts low on the wall and the high number of flaming sconces, I ask my companions to stand near a door. It takes me a few moments of investigation to determine the triggers, but, with a few quick and careful steps through the room, I get to work. I disarm the trap, hearing a metallic click and the low, far-off sigh of some pressure being released.

Stairway In Dark Cave.name:
黑暗洞窟的石阶通道
Stairway In Dark Cave

Text.text:
洞窟向下坠入黑暗，但在很久以前的某个时代，曾有人抽空把岩石凿成台阶。也许是岁月磨损，也许是匠心粗陋，没有两级台阶的宽度或高度相同，使得攀爬险象环生。狭窄的阶梯紧贴崖壁盘绕而上，两次折返之后，才抵达一处稍微宽些的平台。
The cavern falls away into darkness, but at some point long ago someone had the time to carve stone into steps. Whether through wear or careless craftmanship, no two steps are the same width or height, making for a perilous climb. The narrow stairway clings to the cliff face, doubling back twice before reaching a somewhat wider landing.

沿着这处私家庄园蜿蜒的小径前行，你看见成群高大的无翼鸟在园中踱步；它们粉红的羽毛在修剪得一丝不苟的花园背景前显得格外刺眼。宅邸一侧，一座巨大的铁笼里关着一只凶猛的丛林猛猫。你走过时它懒懒打了个哈欠，巨口大张，露出一排令人胆寒的獠牙。还有数十种不属于此地气候的异兽在园地里游走栖息——想必都是那位富有的施主为取悦自己而豢养的。
Along the winding paths of this private estate, you see flocks of large, flightless birds, their pink feathers garish against the background of well-manicured gardens. To one side of the edifice, a large iron cage houses a predatory jungle cat. It yawns as you pass, massive jaws displaying a fearsome collection of fangs. And dozens of other animals foreign to this clime roam and live on the grounds, presumably for the enjoyment of their wealthy benefactor.

这条宽阔的土路在乡野间开出一条相对笔直的通道。道路两侧皆是高耸的篱墙与肥沃的田地；向一侧延伸时，它绕着一片森林分叉开去，而在另一侧则随着低矮的丘陵起伏上下，绵延不绝。
This wide dirt road carves a relatively straight path through a rural landscape. Bounded by high hedgerows and fertile fields on both sides, the roadway splits around a forest in one direction and undulates up and down over low hills in the other.

I Commune With An Apparition.name:
我与幽影同感
I Commune With An Apparition

Text.text:
我感到幽灵（特征）冰冷的吐息贴着皮肤袭来，它漂浮着向我逼近，低声呢喃着我听不懂的语言。我凝视那枯槁、空洞如洞穴的眼眶——那里曾盛着双眼——然后深深、缓慢地吸了一口气，压下翻涌的恐惧，才开始说话，吐出那道法术的词句。幽灵（特征）在法术生效的瞬间迟疑了一下——可当它再次开口说话时，我已听得一清二楚。
I feel the chill of the ghost’s icy breath as it floats toward me, whispering words from a language I do not understand. I look into the withered, cavernous hollows which once held eyes and take a long, slow breath to calm my nerves before speaking the words of the spell. The ghost hesitates for a moment as the spell takes effect—but when it speaks again, I understand it clearly.

Ship Raid By Undead Pirates.name:
亡灵海盗袭船劫掠
Ship Raid By Undead Pirates

Text.text:
船只猛地、令人不快地停住，船身在水面上向前一栽，仿佛触礁搁住。船员间响起不安的低语，他们探身望向舷外那片平静的水面——就在这时，浓雾滚滚涌来，寒意直透骨髓。一股压倒性的、带着盐腥的腐臭扑上甲板——像被烈日烘烤的搁浅鲸尸——连老练的水手也被熏得弯腰干呕。雾中一艘巨舰突兀逼近，猛撞船体；它漆黑破烂的船帆在甲板摇曳的灯笼投下的惨淡光里狂舞。干枯的躯壳踉跄逼来，空洞的眼眶死死盯着你的船。沉重的寂静压在四周，船员们难以置信地僵在原地……然后，你听见了。一个佝偻的身影披着船长的大氅蹒跚上前，木腿有节奏地敲击着腐朽的甲板，踏着烂木的回响穿过甲板，走到你面前开口。

~ Clara C. Potter 于 Discord 所构想

The ship comes to a sudden and unwelcome halt, lurching forward in the water as if caught on a reef. Concerned murmurs rumble around the crew, and they peer overboard into the placid waters beneath as a dense fog rolls in, chilling you to the bone. An overwhelming smell of salt-tinged rot—like the sun-baked carcass of a beached whale—washes over the deck, causing even veteran sailors to heave and retch. A huge vessel looms out of the fog and rams the hull, its black, tattered sails dancing in the pallid light from the lanterns swinging on deck. Desiccated husks lurch toward you, their hollow eyes fixed firmly on your ship. A weighted silence falls across the scene as your crew stare in disbelief… and then you hear it. A hunched figure in a captain's greatcoat lumbers forward, their peg leg tapping rhythmically against rotted timbers as they make their way across the deck to address you.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Elven Village In The Snow.name:
雪中的精灵村落
Elven Village In The Snow

Text.text:
雪落在林地村庄上，宛如微小的仙灵振动着冰冷的翅翼。苍白的雪毯覆上屋顶。冰锥如獠牙般自檐下垂挂。温暖的炉火透过结霜的窗棂映出柔光，屋内传来引人入胜的歌声与故事。村庄沉沉欲睡，被寒冰的怀抱裹成茧，在这冬日致命的凛冽中，仍保存着精灵对生命的热爱。
Snow falls upon the woodland village, like miniature fairies fluttering their icy wings. Pale blankets drape across rooftops. Icicles hang like teeth from eaves. Warm hearths glow through frosted windows, with inviting songs and stories heard inside. The village dozes, cocooned in a frozen grip, preserving the elvish love of life amid this deathly chill of winter.

Hermetic Shaman Summoning A Spirit.name:
秘法萨满召唤灵体
Hermetic Shaman Summoning A Spirit

Text.text:
狩猎的战利品被一一陈列，护身符整齐排成一线。在萨满力量的泥土气息中，一场召唤正在进行。赭石、藏红花、茉莉与香料在悬挂的火盆里温柔燃烧。萨满跪伏在地，裹着褐黄与绿意的破布，头戴华丽的鹿角王冠。他们吟诵古老的歌谣，不断将含铁金属与赛博废料投入火盆。火焰随着咒歌膨胀、铺展，愈发宽大，直到火光深处——清清楚楚——浮现出一张咧嘴而笑的脸。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The trophies of the hunt are laid out, the amulets all in a row. In the earthen aura of the shaman’s power, a summoning is taking place. Ocher, saffron, jasmine, and incense burn gently in a hanging brazier. On their knees, wrapped in rags of tan and green, the shaman dons an ornate crown of antlers. They chant an ancient song, feeding the brazier with ferrous metals and cyber scrap. The flame grows with the chanting, broader and larger, until within the flame can be seen—most definitely—a grinning face.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Greetings From An Upbeat Tavernkeeper.name:
来自一位兴致高昂的酒馆老板的问候
Greetings From An Upbeat Tavernkeeper

Text.text:
“我们终将步入坟冢，但我跟你说，有羊腿在手、酒杯相伴，这趟旅程可要痛快得多。所以，既然你来了，就去和陌生人聊两句，跑调也放声唱，把酒加倍，别忘了多赏点小费，让招待们也能跟着快活起来。”
“We’re all destined for the grave, but let me tell you, the journey is far more fun with a haunch of mutton and a drink in hand. So, while you’re here, talk with a stranger, sing off tune, make it a double, and tip your servers so they can enjoy themselves as well.”

Small Sailboat At Dock.name:
停泊在码头的小帆船
Small Sailboat At Dock

Text.text: 码头里停泊的其他船只把这艘帆船衬得格外渺小。它全长不过五十英尺左右，只有一根方形单桅，帆布已收拢，紧紧缚在横桁上。然而，论起那一身鲜亮的装饰，却少有船能与之争辉。舷缘涂着湛蓝的油漆，船体被刷洗得洁白，直至水线处都粉饰一新。一块雕着鱼形、并以明艳色彩上漆的木牌宣告着它的名字：微风号。 The other vessels in dock dwarf this sailboat. Only about fifty feet long, it has a single square mast, the sail furled and tied tight to the yardarm. Few ships can compete with its bright decoration, however. Blue paint bedecks the gunwales, and the hull is scrubbed and whitewashed to the waterline. A board carved with brightly painted fish declares the name: The Zephyr.

Man-in-the-middle Hacking Attack.name:
中间人黑客攻击
Man-in-the-middle Hacking Attack

Text.text:
当你第一次突破防火墙、建立连接时，你的HUD被汹涌的数据传输搅得一团乱——信息流呼啸掠过，像高速公路上的车潮一样疾驰。你在这股激流下游圈出两段区域，逐一标记归类。一侧发来的授权请求很容易辨认，你借其源头的签名将它与另一侧的回应区分开来。随着你飞快分拣，差异愈发清晰分明。短短片刻，你已将客户端与服务器彻底彼此隔离，只待你那只无形之手落下指令。

~ 一位英雄所构想

When you first break through the firewall and make the connection, your HUD is a mess of transferring data, zipping by like cars on the freeway. You cordon off two sections below the rapids and categorize them one at a time. An authorization request from one side is easy to recognize, and you use its source's signature to differentiate from the other side's response. The differences become more and more obvious as you rapidly sort. In just a few moments, you have both client and server totally isolated from each other, waiting for the input of your invisible hand.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Bard Playing An Armrest Harp.name:
吟游诗人弹奏扶手竖琴
Bard Playing An Armrest Harp

Text.text:
一位吟游诗人坐在一辆装饰繁复、浮雕精美的高背轮椅上，扶手旁固定着一把为她定制的竖琴；她由一名助手推着，缓缓来到舞台中央。刹车卡扣一扣到位，吟游诗人伸手拉下竖琴下方的拨杆，让乐器旋转滑入演奏位置。她双手悬停就绪，稍作停顿，任由全场的目光与期待一丝不落地灌注在她身上。待厅内的气息凝成可触的张力，她指尖一扫，拨下第一个和弦，给予众人所渴望的释放。
A bard using an ornately embossed, high-back wheelchair with a custom harp fixed to her armrest is pushed by an assistant to the center of the stage. After setting her brakes, the bard pulls a lever below the harp to swivel the instrument into position. Hands at the ready, she takes a moment to soak up every ounce of attention from the audience waiting in anticipation. Once the energy of the room turns palpable, she provides the requisite release by strumming her first chord.

这名士兵是骇人化身：灰烬般的皮肤、泛黄的眼睛、被锉尖的牙齿，以及尖长的耳朵。它披着粗陋却实用的护甲，手握一柄锋利得近乎恶毒的刀刃，暴戾的气息再明白不过。它的每一次移动都经过计算，冷静而刻意。它以不疾不徐的步伐逼近，步步精确。它举着一面沉重的盾牌，却仿佛轻若无物。上身那一片宽阔的肌肉，诉说着一生不息的战争；而那残忍的笑意，只透露出对下一场战斗的渴望。
The soldier is a horrifying manifestation of ashen skin, jaundiced eyes, filed teeth, and pointed ears. Clad in crude but effective armor, and wielding a wickedly sharp blade, their violent disposition could not be more clear. Each movement is calculated and deliberate. They stalk forward at a measured pace, each step precise. They hold a heavy shield as if it weighs nothing. The broad muscles of their upper body tell of a lifetime of ceaseless war, and their cruel smile reveals the desire for nothing but the next battle.

Troll-face—a Choosing Rhyme.name:
巨魔（特征）脸——一首抉择童谣
Troll-face—a Choosing Rhyme

Text.text:
有些地区会用这首押韵的变体，叫“eenie-meenie-miney-moe”或别的胡诌音节。它们少了这段译成通用语时的矮人式幽默，但玩法一样：念着韵文，手指依次点过每个人。

众人转脸看看谁在这儿；
狡猾的游荡者悄然不见；
沉默的武僧也吓得一缩
就因为巨魔脸！
法师干脆把自己的眼都遮住；
快戴上你的易容帽吧！
我们把“丑陋大奖”颁给
巨魔脸！
修补匠把护目镜一把拉下；
面如岩石的战士盯着地面；
谁来请我们喝上一轮？
就是你，巨魔脸！

Some regions use a variation of this rhyme called eenie-meenie-miney-moe or other nonsense syllables. They lack the dwarvish humor of this translation into the common tongue, but the game is the same, pointing at everyone in turn as the rhyme is recited.

Faces turn to see who’s here;
Crafty rogues just disappear;
Stoic monks recoil in fear
from Troll-face!
Mages blind their very own eyes;
Please try on a hat of disguise!
We award the ugliness prize
to Troll-face!
Tinkerers, they pull goggles down;
Stone-faced fighters stare at th' ground;
Who will buy us all a round?
You, Troll-face!

Creepy Unusual Store.name:
阴森诡异的杂货铺
Creepy Unusual Store

Text.text:
一只苍蝇大得像熊蜂，正拼命撞击店铺狭窄的窗子，想要逃出去。那道小小的窗孔，除了对面墙上一座小壁炉里低低燃着的火光——噼啪作响，火舌舔着架在上方的坩埚——便是室内唯一的光源。昏暗的椽梁间垂挂着一束束怪异的布包与枝条，或高或低——这股诡异香气的源头想必就在其中——可它们究竟是护符，还是这家古怪店铺的货品，却一时难以分辨。
A fly as big as a bumblebee batters itself against the shop’s narrow window, trying to escape. That small aperture offers the only light other than a low fire—crackling beneath a cauldron—in a small fireplace on the opposite wall. Strange bundles of cloth and twigs hang at varying heights from the shadowy rafters—the source, no doubt, of the room’s strange perfume—although if they are charms or the wares of this odd shop, it is not readily apparent.

在凡俗之眼看来，这是一支做工扎实、结构可靠且工艺精妙的步枪。它整体颇为素净，枪托的深色枫木上仅有几笔含蓄的木纹雕饰，枪管上则烙着一枚古怪的制作者印记。准星几乎会自行对准目标，枪身也仿佛天生贴合掌心。它的舒适感既映照在惊人的精度上，也体现在那一缕缕细微而隐约的法力之中——它们沿着接缝、螺丝与机件飞驰游走。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

To the mundane eye, this is a rifle of good, solid construction and splendid artistry. It is relatively plain, with subtle woodwork on the dark maple of the stock and an odd maker’s mark on the barrel. The sight nearly sets itself to the target, and the gun to the hand. Its comfort is reflected both in its accuracy and in the fine, subtle wisps of mana that race along its joints and screws.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Ooze Attacking Elf.name:
软泥怪袭击精灵
Ooze Attacking Elf

Text.text:
你目睹一团黏怪正试图吞没一名英勇的精灵，伪足饥渴地狂乱抽打。精灵手持长剑与盾牌，岿然不动：附魔利刃劈开半流体的肉质，盾牌如堡垒般抵御这骇人的威胁。纵然其勇武可敬，你仍估计在这生物凶猛的攻势下，这名无畏的战士撑不了多久。
You witness an ooze attempting to envelop a valiant elf, pseudopods thrashing with hunger. Armed with sword and shield, the elf stands firm: enchanted blade slicing through semi-liquid flesh, shield a bastion against the monstrous threat. Despite their valor, you estimate that the brave warrior will not survive long, given the ferocity of the creature’s assault.

Orcus, Prince Of Undeath.name:
奥库斯，不死王子
Orcus, Prince Of Undeath

Text.text:
高耸而臃肿的身躯，宛如一座猩红血肉的壁垒。黑曜石般漆黑的犄角冠在倾斜的额头上，向前弯曲，勾勒出一只咧嘴讥笑的骸骨公羊般的瘆人剪影。恶魔眼窝深处，两点白炽的地狱之火死死盯着你；它呼出烟与蒸汽，腐烂与秽物的恶臭几乎令人窒息。两片龙翼自这恶意王子的背后展开，残破的翼膜苍白而半透明。缀着类人头骨的锁链叮当作响，拍打在恶魔的黑色板甲护甲上；它以粗壮的双腿踏前，蹄足落地沉闷。它抡起一柄凶相毕露的钉头锤，放出一声不属于此世的咆哮。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，MrRhexx 呈现

The towering, bulbous form is a bulwark of crimson flesh. Horns, black as onyx, crest its sloping forehead, curving forward to evoke the unnerving image of a sneering, skeletal ram. Pinpoints of hellfire—white-hot—peer from the hollows of the fiend’s eyes as it exhales smoke and steam, the stench of rot and refuse almost overwhelming. A pair of draconic wings unfurl from the malevolent prince’s back, the tattered membrane pallid and translucent. Chains draped with humanoid skulls clatter against the demon’s black plate armor as it steps forward on stout legs that end in hooves. It hefts a wicked-looking mace and looses an otherworldly roar.

~ Envisioned by MrRhexx

Perception Check In The Net: Virtual Rea.name:
网络之中：虚拟现实的察觉检定
Perception Check In The Net: Virtual Reality

Text.text:
[检定成功] 虚拟空间的漩涡宛如一团濒死的星云：无尽的光与色，标识，以及强大的线上存在。你凝神聚焦，感到本该是额头的位置骤然灼热。漩涡随之清晰：ICE的漆黑高墙、守护进程扭曲的紫色形态，以及管理员纯白的辉光。一切都像被整齐装入盒中，各自占据分配好的虚拟空间。

[检定失败] 虚拟空间的漩涡宛如一团濒死的星云：无尽的光与色，标识，以及强大的线上存在。你凝神聚焦，只觉得整颗脑袋短促刺痛般发烫，却什么也没变清楚。星云依旧晦不可测——一团不断变形的迷乱与疑惧。

~ 由一位英雄构想

[Successful Check] The swirl of virtual space is like a dying nebula: endless light and color, logos, and powerful online actors. You focus your vision and feel a sharp heat where your forehead should be. The swirl becomes clearer: the dark walls of ICE, the twisting purple forms of daemons, and the pure white glow of administrators. All of it appears neatly boxed, each allotted their virtual space.

[Failed Check] The swirl of virtual space is like a dying nebula: endless light and color, logos, and powerful online actors. You focus your vision and feel a brief sharp heat throughout your head but nothing becomes clear. The nebula remains as inscrutable as ever—a shifting mass of confusion and doubt.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Hell: Blood Wall.name:
地狱：血之壁
Hell: Blood Wall

Text.text:
新鲜血液的气味扑面而来，浓得令人窒息，铜腥的味道灌满你的口腔与喉咙。一道丝绸般的猩红屏障在你面前逼近，像帷幕般翻涌：一堵由血构成的墙，被黑暗魔法牢牢钉在原地。它随时可能轰然倾塌，将你淹没，可你却反而觉得自己像是悬在它之上摇摇欲坠。只要你放任自己，你就知道自己会沉入那温热的黑暗。
The scent of fresh blood overwhelms you, filling your mouth and throat with its coppery tang. A silky red barrier looms before you, billowing like curtains: a wall of blood, held in place by dark magic. It could come crashing down to drown you at any moment, but you instead feel as though you dangle above it. If you let yourself, you know you’d sink into its warm darkness.

那人形生物迈着僵硬而颤抖的步伐，仿佛被提线牵扯的木偶。他们的眼睛狂乱游移，燃着诡异而阴森的意图。面容扭曲抽搐，痛苦的表情里夹着几乎压抑不住的暴怒，唾沫随着急促而浅短的喘息滴落。忽然间，他们放声咆哮，随即以非自然的速度猛扑而来。
The humanoid moves with stilted, shuddering steps, as if manipulated by marionette strings. Their eyes, wild and roaming, burn with a strange and sinister intent. The face twists and contorts, a pained expression tinged with barely contained rage, spittle dripping as they take rapid, shallow breaths. Suddenly they loose a roar, and, with unnatural speed, lunge.

Naraxix Torin.name:
纳拉希克斯·托林
Naraxix Torin

Text.text:
这名龙裔身形高大魁梧，但更夺人眼球的是他乳白虹彩般的鳞片与半透明的犄角。几片澄澈如晶的板甲覆盖着他的要害。柔滑的白布以金线为衬缀在这副护甲上，自腰际垂至膝间，形成半截长袍。那条金腰带上挂着一柄华丽的钉头锤，圆形锤头沉甸甸地晃着。他姿态从容，利爪般的手指交扣，轻搭在上腹部，锐利的眼睛如钻石般闪烁。

~ 由 Dennis Chichester 扮演

This dragonborn stands tall and broad, but his opalescent scales and translucent horns demand more attention. Plates of clear crystal cover his vital areas. Silky white cloth lined with thread of gold adorns this armor, forming a half-robe from his waist to knees. An ornate mace with a round head hangs from his gold belt. He rests at ease, his clawed fingers interlaced over his upper abdomen, and his sharp eyes glittering like diamonds.

~ Played by Dennis Chichester

Wizard Casting Toll The Dead.name:
巫师施放「亡者丧钟」
Wizard Casting Toll The Dead

Text.text:
女巫用空着的那只手编织出诡异的奥术手势，口中从一册焦黑炭化的法术书里诵出陌生的异界词句。随着法术接近完成，施法者的双眼变得如玻璃般空洞而遥远，紧接着，一记震耳欲聋的丧钟轰然鸣响。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

The wizard weaves strange, arcane gestures with her free hand as she recites alien words from a charred and blackened spell-book. The caster’s eyes become glassy and distant as the spell nears completion, then the deafening peal of a funerary bell sounds.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Candle Of Invocation.name:
祈唤蜡烛
Candle Of Invocation

Text.text:
这支蜡烛被人以近乎朝圣般的谨慎对待，仿佛某座神殿的圣物。它安放在一只鎏金匣中，匣内铺满深红的碎绒天鹅绒，一扇带铰链的玻璃门作盖合拢。蜡烛本身却毫不起眼：一根偏白的蜂蜡细烛，顶多能燃上几小时，仅此而已。
Extraordinary care has been taken with this candle, like it is some temple’s holy relic. It rests in a gilt box filled with crimson crushed velvet, and a hinged glass door serves as a lid. The candle itself looks unremarkable: an off-white taper of beeswax that might burn for a few hours, nothing more.

Material Plane: Circle Of Stones In Dayl.name:
物质位面：日光下的石阵
Material Plane: Circle Of Stones In Daylight

Text.text: [Entry] 你感到胸口正中猛地一拽，仿佛一根无形的绳索扯住了你的心。视野随之暗下，你被抛向紫色的天空。干燥、碎裂的尘土如雨般掠过你的脸与身体，随后伴随着一声咚的闷响，你发现自己仰躺在一堆泥土里。阳光明亮而刺痛，炙烤着地面，空气里弥漫着干旱泥土的气味。石阵环绕着你，曾经发光的符号已然消失，池塘也不见踪影，取而代之的是这一轮陈腐的土壤。 [Entry] You feel a tug at the center of your chest, as if an invisible rope pulls at your heart. Your vision darkens as you are flung upward into the purple sky. You feel a shower of dry, crumbling earth passing over your face and body before, with a thunk, you find yourself lying in a pile of dirt. Sunlight, bright and stinging, bakes the ground, and the air is rife with the smell of arid earth. The circle of stones surrounds you, bereft of glowing symbols, the pond replaced with this round of stale soil.

Potion Of Resistance.name:
抗力药水
Potion Of Resistance

Text.text:
这瓶药剂装在一只不透光的陶罐里，光凭目测根本无法辨出其中内容。再细看些，你几乎敢打赌这种陶罐常被用来盛装各式药剂——罐身自带一道凹槽，便于贴上标签。无论里面装的是什么，都必须小心搬运与处理。
This potion is stored in an opaque earthenware jar, its contents impossible to divine by sight alone. Upon closer examination, you would bet that this style of jar sees use for a variety of different potions due to a built-in indentation for easy labeling. Whatever it contains, it requires careful handling.

Otiluke's Resilient Sphere.name:
奥提路克的弹力法球
Otiluke's Resilient Sphere

Text.text:
空气泛起涟漪，闪烁的能量在你的目标周围凝聚，将其封入一道坚不可摧的力场球体之中。魔法如雨点击打池面般跃动。其内的每一次移动都轻柔搅动屏障，让令人目眩的纹样沿着表面流淌。
The air ripples as shimmering energy forms around your target, enclosing them in an impenetrable sphere of force. The magic dances like a pond struck by rain. Every movement within gently agitates the barrier, sending mesmerizing patterns across the surface.

Canopic Golem.name:
卡诺匹克魔像
Canopic Golem

Text.text:
这具纤细、半透明的人形身影仿佛由雪花石膏与玻璃凝成，通体清澈而脆美。它的双眼燃着金色光辉，手掌与躯干上的符文印记同样流淌着相似的亮芒。胸腔之内，竟漂浮着一颗枯槁的心脏与一对肺叶——与这具本该优雅的生物之身格格不入。察觉到入侵者的气息，它从体内挤出数枚细长的飞镖，晶莹得与它自身无异；随即面无表情地转向你。
This willowy and translucent humanoid-shaped figure seems to be made of alabaster and glass. Its eyes glow with golden light. Similar luminance issues from runic sigils on its hand and torso. Within the chest floats a withered heart and pair of lungs, out of place in the otherwise elegant creature’s body. Sensing intrusion, the being extrudes long darts, as crystalline as its form, and turns to you with an impassive face.

Sundries From A Ki-rin.name:
麒麟杂货
Sundries From A Ki-rin

Text.text:
独角兽的鬃毛里编进了几十只小小的空瓶，每一只都轻得像一枚铜币。有的玻璃制，有的陶土烧成，垂挂着柔和的粉蓝与浅绿。瓶塞也一并编入鬃间，马鬃从它们中央的孔洞里穿过，紧紧牵连。
Braided into the unicorn's mane are dozens of tiny empty bottles, each as light as a copper coin. Some are glass, some clay, and they dangle in pastel blues and greens. The corks are braided into the mane as well, the equine hair pulled through holes in their centers.

鸟的头颅对它所连着的修长脖颈来说似乎过于沉重。它那对细小的翅膀不过是退化的笑柄，绝无可能托起这头怪兽的重量。即便如此，当它用瘦长、无羽的腿踉跄奔来时，那惊人的速度仍让你大吃一惊。
The bird’s head seems too heavy for the elongated neck it’s attached to. Its tiny wings are vestigial jokes and could never lift the weight of the beast. Even still, its speed surprises you as it lopes toward you on gangly, featherless legs.

Harken Conservatory.name:
哈肯音乐学院
Harken Conservatory

Text.text: 这栋建筑从周围的风貌来看像是近年才添建的：线条利落、边角干净，地面铺着一尘不染的大理石。大堂里垂挂着一面深林绿的旗帜，上面宣告着 献给这片美丽山谷的博物馆。馆内有几处展览对外开放，指示牌分别写着 这些魔法林地的历史 与 风暴召唤者的堕落。建筑本身已足够夺目，而真正令它更显宏伟的，是地块后方的园区：一片开阔的庭院，被缠满藤蔓的高门守护着。院子近中央处，一圈修剪成形的树篱围出焦点——一尊等身高的青铜雄鹿雕像，鹿角上仿佛开花般绽出层层叶片。外部区域大多同室内一样被精心打理、精确得近乎刻板，唯独南侧边缘肆意生长：一片无人修整却美得惊人的树林繁茂成林。 The building seems to be a newer addition based on the surrounding architecture, with its sleek, clean-edged design and pristine marble floors. A forest-green banner hangs in the lobby, proclaiming A Museum Dedicated to this Fair Vale. There are a couple of exhibits open inside the building, signs indicating A History of These Enchanted Woods and The Descent of the Stormcaller. As impressive as the structure itself is, it is made even more grand by the campus at the back of the property: an expansive courtyard protected by tall gates layered with vines. Near the center of the yard, a circle of hedges frames a bronze, life-sized statue of a stag, its antlers flowering with leaves. Although the outside area is mostly manicured and as precise as the interior, the southern edge runs wild with a gorgeous grove of unkempt trees.

Explosion Of Necrotic Energy.name:
死灵能量爆裂
Explosion Of Necrotic Energy

Text.text:
一粒墨色的黑暗微尘凭空浮现。它离地悬停，体内翻涌着紫罗兰色的电光。痛苦的哀嚎自其中渗出，仿佛隔着一扇紧闭的门传来。随即，世界陷入死寂，凝滞不动。下一瞬，一股向外奔涌的气浪撕裂这份平静——微尘轰然爆开，化作迎面席卷的阴影之墙，紫色雷束倾泻，夹杂着凄厉的尖啸。爆风的前沿所过之处，草木迅速枯萎、焦黑，转瞬化作飞灰。
A mote of inky darkness appears. It hovers just off the ground, roiling with violet lightning. Cries of anguish exude from it, as if from behind a closed door. Then, the world goes silent and still. An outward rush of air breaks this calm—the mote explodes into a wall of onrushing shadow, cascading purple bolts, and pained shrieks. At the leading edge of the blast, plants wither, blacken, and turn to ash.

Temple To A Goddess Of Pleasure.name:
欢愉女神的神殿
Temple To A Goddess Of Pleasure

Text.text:
神殿金色穹顶的内侧绘着一幅壁画：湛蓝天空之下，神祇们设宴欢饮。穹顶之下，一尊色彩斑斓、丰腴的欢愉女神塑像正立于圣舞之中，姿态含蓄而撩人；在她脚边，追随者们沉浸于喜悦与慰藉，虔诚膜拜。殿内乐声与笑语充盈，纵乐者斜倚软垫，任年轻的侍祭穿梭往返奉上点心与饮品。另一些信众沿着神殿柱廊奔走嬉游，或深嗅芬芳花卉的香气，或在高耸的金色书架前翻读厚重的鎏金典籍。
The underside of the temple’s golden dome is painted with a mural depicting the gods feasting beneath a blue sky. Below the dome, a colorful statue of the voluptuous goddess of pleasure stands poised in the midst of a holy dance, and at her feet, her followers worship in delight and comfort. The temple is filled with music and laughter as revelers recline on cushions, accepting refreshments from young acolytes rushing to and fro. Other worshipers run around the temple’s colonnade, or inhale the perfume of fragrant flowers, or read from towering golden bookshelves.

I Cast Sequester.name:
我施放【隔离术】
I Cast Sequester

Text.text: 我打开一只上等皮革袋，将闪烁的宝石粉尘倒在掌心，口中吟诵着击剑的术语，将粉末朝我的目标扬去。粉尘坠落时灼出一道道红、绿、蓝、白的光痕。这些明亮的丝线随我吐出最后的密钥，交织成茧，将我的目标裹住。 [封存一名生物] 随着粉尘携来的光辉渐渐隐去，受术者坠入无时之境，不觉不醒，且永不衰老。 I open a fine leather bag, pour sparkling jewel dust in my hands, and throw the powder over my target, incanting fencing phrases. The dust burns in lines of red, green, blue, and white as it falls. These luminous threads form a cocoon around my target as I speak the final keys. [Sequester a Creature] As the dust-borne radiance fades, the subject falls into a timeless state, unaware and ageless.

I Drink My Potion Of Psychic Resistance.name:
我喝下我的心灵抗力药剂
I Drink My Potion Of Psychic Resistance

Text.text:
瓶子是一根细长的管状器皿，如同开瓶器般盘旋缠绕，里面盛着黏稠的紫色液体。我将它饮下，酸爽的滋味让口中涌起唾液。太阳穴处泛起轻微的痒意，我的身形开始在紫色能量中微微闪烁。
The bottle is a thin tube that spirals like a corkscrew, filled with a gooey purple fluid. I drink it, and the tangy flavor makes my mouth water. I feel a light tickle in my temples as my form begins to glimmer with purple energy.

Studded Leather Armor +2.name:
镶钉皮甲 +2
Studded Leather Armor +2

Text.text:
这套钉皮甲染成漆黑与猩红的亮色，仿佛刚从地狱里爬出来。凹陷的铆钉、划痕、磨损、焦灼的烙印，甚至还有牙齿咬出的齿痕凹槽，都诉说着它经历非凡；但所有的伤害似乎都只是表面装饰。它看起来还能再闯一次地狱。
This suit of studded leather, colored black and bright crimson, looks like it has gone through hell. Dented studs, scratches, scuffs, scorch marks, and even indentations from teeth, give the impression of an eventful existence, but all the damage seems to be cosmetic. It looks like it could go through hell again.

I Detach A Steel Mirror Patch From My Ro.name:
我从万用物品长袍上扯下一块钢镜补丁
I Detach A Steel Mirror Patch From My Robe Of Useful Items

Text.text:
我迅速在袍子上摸索，找到了那块蓝灰色的补丁，将它举到光下。只见补丁上的丝线微微泛光，悄然映出周遭世界的色彩。我一把扯下补丁，它立刻硬化成一面半磅重的镜子，冷冷的，接触时沁人。镜框的设计颇为华丽，钢材被切割并折叠成灌木丛般的形状。叶片之间探出一只只细小的眼睛。
I find the blue-gray patch on my robe with a quick search, bringing it into the light. I notice the threads subtly reflecting the colors of the world around it. I tear off the patch and it immediately hardens into a half-pound mirror, cool to the touch. The frame is of somewhat opulent design, the steel cut and folded to resemble underbrush. Small eyes poke out from between the leaves.

Sotario Contata.name:
索塔里奥·孔塔塔
Sotario Contata

Text.text:
木精灵深吸一口气。吐息之间，那双筋肉虬结、布满旧日灼伤疤痕的手臂从鞘中抽出一对短剑。金属清鸣，锐利而明亮。他与空气对练——双足踏出武舞的步伐，脚跟迸出火星——刀光翻卷成旋风，编成辫的银发如鞭般抽响。他双手挺身突刺，随即一甩收势，利落回鞘，铿锵声如节拍落定。

~ 扮演：TheKaiser

The wood elf inhales. He exhales as corded arms scarred with old burns draw a pair of short swords from their scabbards. The metal sings, sharp and bright. He spars with the air—his feet drilling the motions of a martial dance, sparks flying from his heels—a whirl of blades, braided silver hair snapping like a whip. He lunges in a double-handed thrust then, with a flourish, re-sheathes his swords in a ringing cadence.

~ Played by TheKaiser with

Desert Market With Water Bar.name:
带水吧的沙漠集市
Desert Market With Water Bar

Text.text:
尘土与沙粒黏附在水吧多孔的石墙上，几乎将吱呀作响的门上方那块风化的招牌遮没。店内空气清凉沁人，宛如灼热沙海中的福地绿洲；蒸馏水的瓶身在架上闪闪发亮，表面凝着诱人的水珠。屋顶冷却系统低沉的嗡鸣为这片放松的空间添上一层令人安心的回响。
Dust and sand cling to the porous stone of the water bar, almost obscuring the weathered sign above the creaking door. The air inside is cool and refreshing, a blissful oasis in the searing heat of the desert, and gleaming bottles of distilled water—beaded with tantalizing droplets—line the shelves. The low hum of the cooling system atop the building adds a comforting resonance to the relaxing space.

Golden Lions Figurine Of Wondrous Power.name:
奇物之力金狮雕像
Golden Lions Figurine Of Wondrous Power

Text.text:
你在一块精细织就的绯红布料包裹中，发现了一对由纯金铸成的小雕像，形如潜行狩猎的雄狮。仅仅抚摸这些小雕像，你的脑海便被狩猎的气味灌满——掠食者穿越草原、步步逼近猎物时那股凶残嗜血的杀意。
Swaddled in a finely woven cloth of scarlet, you discover a pair of tiny statues fashioned from pure gold, in the shape of lions on the prowl. Simply stroking the statuettes fills your mind with the smell of the hunt, the ferocious bloodlust of a predator stalking its prey across the grasslands.

Weary Family With Lost Baggage.name:
疲惫的一家人，行李尽失
Weary Family With Lost Baggage

Text.text:
疲惫不堪的父母把沉重的行李夹在臂弯里——眼下同样挂着浓重的黑眼圈——他们强打精神，耐着性子听着行李柜台职员那乏味、单调的絮叨嗡鸣，声音仿佛随时要把人催入梦乡。侏儒透过半月形眼镜从镜片上沿打量着两人，尽职尽责地背诵着货舱清单；她稳稳躲在夹板后面，仿佛天然高人一等般从容自得。背景里，两名年幼的孩子撒欢似地乱跑，黏糊糊的小手翻弄着其他旅客的行李，又把擦得锃亮的窗玻璃抹得一片狼藉。父母几乎连眼皮都不抬——到了这一步，他们早已懒得在乎了。

~ Ben on Discord

With heavy bags under their arms—and eyes—the beleaguered parents listen patiently as the dull, monotonous drone of the baggage clerk threatens to lull them to sleep. The gnome peers over half-moon spectacles at the pair, dutifully reciting the manifest for the cargo hold, confident in her position of superiority behind the clipboard. In the background a pair of small children run wild and free, sticky hands rifling through the luggage of other travelers and smearing the polished glass of the windows. The parents barely look up. At this point they are beyond caring.

~ Ben on Discord

Necromancer's Ritual Pyre.name:
死灵法师的仪式柴堆
Necromancer's Ritual Pyre

Text.text:
一具铁制骨架勾勒出一具风格化的骷髅（特征）：四根铁杆被锻造成骷髅般的手臂与腿，支援着肋骨腔内的一座敞开平台。三捆缠裹的包裹，形似尸体，横陈在向上弯曲的肋骨之间。平台下方，柴薪被码成一个棱角分明的立方体，留出充足的空间以供气流穿行。石地上环绕火葬柴堆刻下的魔法符号骤然迸亮，翠绿的火舌舔上引火物。
An iron framework depicts a stylized skeleton: four iron rods, fashioned to look like skeletal arms and legs support an open platform within a ribcage. Three wrapped bundles, corpselike in shape, lie within the upward curving ribs. Under the platform, firewood forms a precise cube with ample space for airflow. Magical symbols, carved into the stone floor and encircling the pyre, flare as a green flame licks the tinder.

猎犬从自己制造的黑烟云团中疾步窜出，它那超凡的嚎叫所点燃的火焰仍在狼般的颌间游走。覆着灰烬的黑色鬃刺盖满它强健的、如斗牛犬般的躯体。它那闪烁的猩红眼眸透着令人不安的聪慧，而那露齿的狞笑更是加深了这份感觉。
The hound lopes out of a cloud of black smoke of its own making, the flames created by its unearthly howl still playing across its wolf-like jaws. Black bristles dusted with ash cover its powerful, bulldog-shaped body. Its glimmering red eyes look disturbingly intelligent, an impression furthered by its toothy grin.

Loot From A White Dragon Lair.name:
白龙巢穴的战利品
Loot From A White Dragon Lair

Text.text:
洞窟地面上散落着大片闪耀的银白光带，你看见数量惊人的钱币与宝石——尽是冷冽的银色光泽。再仔细探查，便发现粉雪般的积雪堆下，藏着黄金、铜币以及其他色彩斑斓的珍宝。巨龙显然为巢穴精心营造了冰寒美学，把会打破它所追求的冷峻冰霜色调的财富统统藏了起来。即便是最原始的巨龙，也会为自己的巢穴感到无比自豪。这堆宝藏必定价值数万枚金币。
Scattered across the cavern floor in a glittering argent swathe you see a vast number of coins and gems—all of a silvery hue. Some further investigation reveals gold, copper and other colorful treasures hidden beneath mounds of powdery snow. The dragon clearly curated a frigid aesthetic for its lair, hiding treasures which disrupted the cool, icy palette it desired. Even the most primal dragons take great pride in their home. The hoard must be worth tens of thousands of gold pieces.

Overheard Conversation About Cursed Home.name:
关于闹鬼之屋的窃听对话
Overheard Conversation About Cursed Home

Text.text:
“你认识会处理霉菌的人吗？我们刚搬进新家；房子挺老的，我发誓有时候墙会在呼吸。晚上还有些诡异的光——那也是某种霉菌，对吧？”
“Do you know anyone that deals with mold? We just moved into our place; it’s pretty old, and I swear the walls breathe sometimes. There are also these strange lights at night—that’s some kind of mold, right?”

Mayffyn Duskryn.name:
梅芬·达斯克林
Mayffyn Duskryn

Text.text:
这名少女般的年轻女子，乌檀般的肌肤柔润无瑕，五官细致如瓷。她那一头刺目雪白的长发束起，扎成高高的长马尾，从脸侧利落地收拢而去。靛蓝丝绸的精致长裙披垂在她身上，领口处隐约透出一抹银光。她同样讲究：背上斜系着黑色小提琴盒，腰间分别佩着纤巧的细剑与优雅的手弩。她的紫罗兰眼眸不停游移，细细打量周遭，神情却难以捉摸。

~ 由 ParadoxialChaos 扮演

This girlish young woman’s ebony skin has soft, unblemished features, and her stark white hair has been tied up and away from her face in a long ponytail. A fine dress of indigo silk drapes her, a hint of silver peeking out around the collar. Equally stylish are the black viol case strapped to her back and the delicate rapier and elegant hand crossbow sheathed on her hips. Her violet eyes move constantly, studying her surroundings, but her expression is difficult to read.

~ Played by ParadoxialChaos

铁匠身上带着精灵传承的痕迹——尖挺的耳廓、明亮的眼睛，以及举手投足间那种纤细而超然的优雅。他们驾轻就熟地将一柄通红的刀刃沉入油桶，淬火时“滋——”地一声嘶响，热浪与油烟翻涌。他们把刀刃举起检视，满意地点点头，又回到铁砧前继续锤炼。

“随便看看，”他们说着，目光仍不离手头的活计，“要是瞧见喜欢的就喊一声。现在不接定制。”
The smithy shows traces of elven heritage—pronounced ears, bright eyes, and a slender, otherworldly grace to their movements. With practiced ease, they lower a red-hot blade into a barrel of oil and quench the steel with a sizzling hiss. They bring the blade up for inspection, nod in satisfaction, and return to the anvil to work it further. "Look around," they say, not bothering to look up from their work. "Holler if you see something you like. Not taking commissions at the moment."

Cliffside Border Town In Autumn.name:
秋日峭壁边境小镇
Cliffside Border Town In Autumn

Text.text:
这座小镇的方盒子般建筑沿着峭壁盘旋向上，烟囱里懒洋洋地漏出缕缕白烟。外头成群的勤劳乡民忙碌穿梭，背上绑着一筐筐苹果，红扑扑的脸庞映着他们殷红的收成。沉重的货车沿着蜿蜒街道缓缓爬升，车夫挥鞭抽打吃力的骡子，咒骂挡道的行人。
The boxlike buildings of this small town spiral up the rockface, their chimneys leaking languid white smoke. Outside are groups of industrious folk, baskets of apples strapped to their backs, red faces mirroring their crimson harvest. Heavy carts slowly climb the meandering streets, drivers lashing laboring mules and cursing pedestrians in their way.

Monk Using Open Hand Technique.name:
武僧施展空手道技
Monk Using Open Hand Technique

Text.text:
在描绘一棵橡树的抽象画时，无需想得太久。颜色与形态会顺着树自己浮现，而不是由画笔来决定。于是，当你一击落在对手身上时，也让这一击为你挑选其效果的色彩。笔触会将对手的枝干压低、推退，或将他连根钉在原地。
When painting an abstraction of an oak tree, one does not think too long. Color and form choose themselves according to the tree, not the brush. And so, when a strike lands against your opponent, let the strike choose the color of its effect for you. The brush stroke moves your opponent’s branches downward, or backward, or roots him in place.

A Monolith Appears.name:
一座巨碑现身
A Monolith Appears

Text.text:
孩子们欢快的笑闹声骤然被淹没——大地毫无征兆地剧烈颤动，强到足以把嘉年华里大多数人都震得踉跄倒地。中景处，那座俯瞰城镇的山巅轰然炸裂，一根至少五百英尺长的巨石方碑尖啸着冲上夜空，旋转撕扯，仿佛从埋葬它的墓穴里硬生生挣脱出来。整条山脉随之抬升、扭曲、折弯，崩碎成滚滚碎石，沿着山坡滑落，朝着下方的城镇倾泻而去。石碑表面迸发出噼啪作响的蓝宝石能量光晕，凝聚、分裂，伴随一记炸雷般的爆响撕裂空气，硬生生扯开一道通往异界的孔洞——尖叫的金属造物从中涌出，遮蔽了月光。紧接着，又一声更响的雷霆轰鸣炸开，盘旋的巨岩骤然坠地，传送门猛然收缩，随即爆裂成蓝色余烬。那些金属怪物大多一个接一个坠落，重重砸进方碑升空后留下的巨大陨坑里。

~ Envisioned by Garesu_Kiennes

The joyful sounds of gleeful children are drowned out without warning when the earth is seized by tremors powerful enough to knock most of the carnival’s attendants to their feet. In the middle distance, the top of the mountain overlooking the town explodes, and a monolith of no less than five hundred feet in length howls up into the air, spinning and tearing its way from its apparent tomb. The entire mountain range heaves and buckles, crumbling into rubble sliding down the mountainside toward the town below. A crackling aura of sapphire energy erupts from the slab of stone, coalescing and splitting the air with a thunderclap, ripping open a hole into another world—through which screaming metal creatures begin to pour, blotting out the moonlight. Suddenly there is another, even louder, thunderclap and the spiraling rock falls to the ground, the portal contracts then explodes into blue cinders. One by one, the majority of the metallic creatures crash into the crater left by the monolith’s ascendance.

~ Envisioned by Garesu_Kiennes

Spear Of Seelie Craftsmanship With Blood.name:
精灵仙匠之矛（血石刃）
Spear Of Seelie Craftsmanship With Bloodstone Blade

Text.text:
你从铁木树的树心猛地拔出长矛，头顶的枝桠随之战栗，一阵微风穿行其间，仿佛轻轻叹息。这件武器比它的体型所暗示的轻巧得多。血石矛头呈现出荫林池水般的颜色，一串叶片缠绕着矛杆——对接触而言柔韧可弯。你试着向前刺出一记，刺破空气。就在那一瞬，叶片从武器上飞散而出，在你周身翻卷成一阵疾旋的叶雨。它们吟唱着，如风中疾矢。
You wrench the spear from the center of the ironwood tree, and the limbs above you shudder as a breeze sighs through them. The weapon is much lighter than its size would suggest. The bloodstone spearhead is the color of a shaded forest pond, and a trail of leaves—pliable to the touch—twine around the shaft. You take a practice thrust, piercing the air. As you do, the leaves fly out from the weapon and swirl in a flurry around you. They sing like arrows on the wind.

这家光线昏暗的餐馆里，食客们掀起一阵温和的笑浪——老板娘落下一个轻声的俏皮话。她身着一袭剪裁体面的低胸长裙，胸口嵌着一簇星群般的微光，莹莹闪烁。每张桌子中央的球形灯也随着笑声忽明忽暗，感应器捕捉到珠宝点缀的喉间那一丝丝呼息的轻爆，仿佛真正的火焰会被笑意拨动。吧台覆着巧克力般深色的亮漆，像在招手；万向座椅的红色软垫光滑得几乎像真皮。酒保抛来一个讨喜的笑容，用机械手旋出一道利落的弧线擦拭玻璃杯。那块铆在他头侧的钢板被压纹处理，刻意仿出他银发的纹理与质感。
