A mild chorus of laughter bubbles up from the patrons of this dimly lit restaurant as the owner lands a softly spoken jest. She’s garbed in a handsome, low-cut gown, a starry cluster of glowing lights embedded in her chest. The orb lamps in the center of each table flicker along with the laughter, their sensors picking up the slight bursts of breath from bejeweled throats as true flame would. The chocolate-dark lacquer of the bar beckons, the red upholstery of the gimballed seats so smooth it might be real leather. The bartender flashes a winning smile, cleaning a glass with a whirl of his mechanical hand. The steel plate bolted to the side of his head has been embossed to mimic the texture of his silver hair.

这座曾经辉煌的礼拜堂如今只剩断壁残垣，在遥远的过去某个时刻被砸得支离破碎，又遭烈火焚毁。未被摧毁之物也早被掠夺者洗劫一空，如今这片圣地不过是往日荣光的凄凉残影。寺庙信众的祈祷并未将它从时代的侵蚀中拯救出来。
This once-splendid house of worship lies in ruins now, smashed apart and burned at some point in its distant past. What was not destroyed was carried off by looters, and now this holy place is but a sad shadow of its glory. The prayers of the temple’s worshipers did not save it from the ravages of time.

冷却液泄漏以没完没了的滴答声逼人侧目。这里本不该有冷却液外泄——这里甚至根本不该有冷却液。肇事的控制台诡异而扭曲，陌生的光芒以令人不安、非人的节律脉动。相邻系统的指示灯忽明忽暗，电力像被抽走一般流向这台怪异的电脑，仿佛遭人入侵。
A coolant leak demands attention with its incessant drip. There shouldn’t be coolant leaking here; there shouldn’t be coolant at all. The responsible console is odd, warped, with foreign lights pulsing in an unnerving and alien pattern. Adjacent systems flicker, losing their power to this strange computer, as if hacked.

无论何时，码头都是行动的枢纽：焦急的呼喝声此起彼伏，工人们穿梭忙碌，旅客登船下船络绎不绝。天际线上帆影点点，船只晨昏昼夜规律往来，靠岸又离港。两名账簿记录员沿着栈道踱步，清点每一艘抵达的船与其货物——也会收下几枚钱币，把某些物件从他们一丝不苟的清单里悄然抹去。
No matter the hour, the docks are a hub of activity: harried orders being shouted, bustling laborers, and travelers embarking and disembarking. Sails dot the horizon, and ships arrive and depart with regularity morning, noon, and night. A pair of ledger-keepers stroll the docks, keeping tally of the arrivals and their cargo—and accepting coin to leave certain items off their meticulous lists.

God Of Barbarians.name:
野蛮人之神
God Of Barbarians

Text.text:
他以人形立于世间，有时又如巨人般巍峨，手执一柄神工锻造的双手巨剑。身披冬日毛皮，皮腰带上别着手斧与匕首。他将惊人的肌肉与出人意料的敏捷糅合于一身。即便平静，那张方正而布满疤痕的脸也透过冰冷的灰眼泄出体内的野性。他仿佛兼具世上一切行走的掠食者，只需一瞬便能狂怒，震慑并征服。嗓音是狮子的低沉轻咆，手掌则执掌残酷的自由。
He stands as a man, sometimes a giant, holding a two-handed greatsword of divine workmanship. He wears winter furs, a handaxe and knife on his leather belt. He is a combination of prodigious muscle and surprising agility. Even when calm, his square, scarred face reveals the wild within through cold grey eyes. He seems possessed of every predator that walks the earth, ready in a heartbeat to rage, to terrify and conquer. His voice is the quiet growl of a lion, his hand the wielder of savage freedom.

一群孩子紧紧挤成一团，面朝内围成圈。恶毒的咒骂纠缠成刺，残忍的神情像刀。推搡的手让一个小男孩在圈内被撞得踉跄乱窜，四下求助，却寻不见半分怜悯与喘息。他一绊倒，人群立刻爆出刺耳的哄笑。紧接着，踢打开始了。
A group of children stand in a tight knot, facing inward. Snarled words and cruel expressions. Pushing hands cause a small boy to ricochet about the inside of their circle, seeking but not finding any compassion or relief. He trips and the crowd erupts in jeers. Then the kicking starts.

Sundries From A Spirit Naga.name:
来自灵魂娜迦的杂物
Sundries From A Spirit Naga

Text.text:
在那条自负的巨蛇口述、堆成小山的笔记与日记间，你翻出几份颇有意思的文书：其上详述了蛇人的过往，还夹着一张周边区域的地图——只是这地图的年代，已是百余年前。
Scattered among the hoard of notes and journals dictated by the pompous serpent, you find some interesting documents detailing the naga’s history and a map of the surrounding area—though it is dated over a hundred years ago.

你面前这只龇牙咧嘴、扑咬不停、扑扇着翅膀的东西，怕是从蛋里孵出来时就已经有狼那么大的体型。若不是那滴着涎水的獠牙与刀刃般的利爪，你几乎会觉得它还挺可爱。只要你能先阻止它试图把你的脸咬下来，或许就能把它安抚住。
This snarling, snapping, flapping thing before you must have emerged from the egg already the size of a wolf. Were it not for the slavering fangs and knife-like claws, you might think it cute. And if you can stop it from trying to bite your face off, you might be able to calm it down.

女人眼下浓重的黑眼圈，是无数个不眠之夜的结晶，让她看起来比实际年纪苍老得多。然而真正令与她对视者心生寒意的，是那双眼睛本身——她的一部分早已不在此处，而是无休无止地凝望着一幅战时暴行的惨烈图景——其中有些，正是出自她手。
The dark circles under the woman’s eyes, the result of countless sleepless nights, make her look far older than her years. Yet it is the eyes themselves that unnerve those who meet her gaze, as a part of her is not there at all, instead endlessly staring at a tableau of atrocities committed in wartime—some of them committed by her.

这颗巨大的假牙模型由石膏制成，涂了白灰，并覆上一层闪亮的清漆，装在一根简陋的钢制弹簧上，竖立在牙科诊所的门面顶端。前门上钉着一块装饰过的告示牌，上面写着：记得每周至少擦牙三次！ 里面传来低沉而饱含痛楚的呻吟声。 Made of plaster and whitewashed with a gleaming lacquer, the model of a large false tooth has been mounted on a simple steel spring atop the storefront of the dental clinic. A decorated placard mounted to the front door reads: Remember to wipe your teeth at least three times a week! From inside, low, pain-filled moaning can be heard.

Dungeon: Submerged Trapdoor Trap.name:
地城：沉没的活板门陷阱
Dungeon: Submerged Trapdoor Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 你趟着水穿过被淹没的走廊，注意到水流正逐渐绕着你滑过。暗流仿佛在房间里的某一点汇聚，形成一个微弱的漩涡。然而，水位始终纹丝不动——这间屋子几乎像是专门打造出来，用来维持这个水位。

[触发！] 你刚向前迈步，脚下的地面便骤然消失。浑浊的水从四面八方挤压而来，诡异的回流将你朝各个方向扭拽翻转。那几缕勉强穿透水面的光线也被阻断——头顶的活板门随着一声闷闷的“咔哒”合上。

[Perceived] Sloshing through the flooded corridor, you notice the water gradually flowing around you. The currents seem to converge at one point in the room, forming a weak whirlpool. Yet, the water level remains consistent—the room seems almost crafted to maintain this water level.

[Triggered!] As you step forward, the floor suddenly disappears from under your feet. Murky water presses against you from every side, and strange undertows twist you in every direction. The few rays of light that penetrate the water are cut off as the trapdoor closes above you with a muffled click.

I Transform Into A Werewolf.name:
我变身为狼人
I Transform Into A Werewolf

Text.text:
一切始于尖叫——我更多是感觉到，而不是听见：关节咔嚓错位，肌腱与韧带被拉扯时发出的吱嘎声。我从不昏过去。我只是死死捧住头侧，双手却渐渐蜷曲成利爪般的、骨节嶙峋的前掌。满月悬在天上，在我上翻的视线下，口鼻向前顶出；撕裂的犬齿像长矛般刺下，鲜血淋漓，滴落到我的舌尖。我仍用两条腿站着，却浑身糊满血与肌肉，夹杂着斑驳的毛。我更高了。更饥饿。野得彻底，活得真实。
It begins with screaming I feel more than hear—joints popping out of place, the creaking pull of tendons and ligaments. I never pass out. I just hold the sides of my head, my hands becoming clawed, bony paws. There is the full moon, and under my upturned eyes a snout pushes forward, dripping blood from my torn canines lancing down and touching my tongue. I still stand on two legs, but I’m covered in blood and muscle and patchy fur. I’m taller. Hungry. Wildly and truly alive.

Smith's Forge Song.name:
史密斯的熔炉之歌
Smith's Forge Song

Text.text:
如同所有劳动号子一般，矮人铸炉的吟唱把双手与工具推向节奏与规整。这一曲在音量上的起伏胜过音高的摆荡，唤起一种介于乌鸫的低吟与雁鹅断续的嘎鸣之间的声响。宛如嗡鸣的长音与粗砺的矮人喉音从这位工艺神职者口中倾泻而出，其间以分毫不差的铁锤击砧声作点，节拍严丝合缝。每当炽热金属被淬入水中嘶嘶作响，铁匠便用通用语吼出副歌：“唯一更伟大的铁匠只有昂格雷格·金卫，哈！”

~ 由 Skabak Runemane 构想

Like all work songs, dwarven forge chants drive hands and tools toward rhythm and regularity. This one oscillates more in volume than in pitch, evoking something between the blackbird’s croon and the goose’s choppy honk. An assembly of drone-like hums and guttural dwarvish syllables spills from this cleric of craftsmanship, punctuated by impeccably timed strikes of hammer on anvil. Each time the hot metal is doused with a hiss, the smith bellows a refrain in the common tongue: “The only greater smith was Ungreg Goldenguard, HA!”

~ Envisioned by Skabak Runemane

Makeshift Steps In Dark Cave.name:
黑暗洞窟中的临时台阶
Makeshift Steps In Dark Cave

Text.text:
洞穴这一侧的峭壁并未一路拔高至洞顶，暗示上方还另有一层或一道突出的岩架。几块扁平石板被堆叠成临时的阶梯，沿着粗砺岩壁内凹的弧面向上攀爬。更多蜘蛛卵囊一路黏附其上，每一枚都沉甸甸地裹着黏稠的负担。
The cliff wall on this side of the cave doesn’t rise all the way to the ceiling, hinting at some upper level or ledge above. A stack of flat stones creates a makeshift set of stairs, climbing up the concave curve of the rough stone facing. More spider egg sacs cling along its path, each heavy with a gooey burden.

飞镖的空心水晶躯体闪烁着致命的光泽，每一面晶棱都被打磨得完美无瑕。一片钻石薄刃充当穿透性的尖端，为它的目标奉上优雅的终结。
The hollow crystal body of the dart shimmers with deadly promise, each facet of the gem cut to perfection. A sliver of diamond serves as the penetrating tip, offering an elegant demise to its target.

Bandit Captain: Male.name:
强盗头目：男性
Bandit Captain: Male

Text.text:
从抽象到粗俗的纹身覆满这名男子的皮肤，在他那件镶满骨钉的黑皮外套、同款靴子与长及膝的蓝色长衫未能掩蔽之处肆意蔓延。纹样也从他贴头修剪的黑白相间短发与胡须间若隐若现。他戴了过多的首饰——耳环、臂箍与手镯、戒指——有些廉价，有些也许并不。漆黑的眼睛因贪婪而闪烁。他冷笑着，慢慢从腰带上的鞘中抽出两把弯刃，一长一短。
Tattoos, abstract to bawdy, cover this man’s skin where his coat of bone-studded black leather, matching boots, and long blue tunic fail to cover it. The markings peek out of his close-cropped salt-and-pepper hair and beard. He wears too much jewelry—earrings, bands and bangles, and rings—some cheap and a few, perhaps, not. His dark eyes glitter with greed. Sneering, he slowly draws two curved blades, one long, the other short, from belted scabbards.

A Tenday Of Travel By Foot On Road Throu.name:
沿着道路徒步旅行十天，季节悄然转入春天
A Tenday Of Travel By Foot On Road Through A Change To Spring

Text.text:
你整备踏上旅途时，寒冬的霜意仍未散尽，但空气里已悄然透出春天的先声。道路在你面前延伸，卵石铺就的路面覆着一层晶亮的薄冰。

第二天，你的行程蜿蜒穿过一片密林，林间空地正开始迸发生机。第三天，你偶然遇见一座小村庄，当地人正忙碌劳作——迫不及待地为春日庆典做准备。半身人热情地迎接你，邀请你留下共赴庆典；欢宴与歌声一直延续到深夜。

次日你继续前行，树木渐稀，路途切入起伏的丘陵，草地间满是含苞的嫩芽。第十天的午后不久，你的目的地就在一条河的对岸：河里鱼群跃动，水面上横着一座木桥。
As you prepare for the journey, the cold winter frost still lingers, but the first hints of spring are in the air. The road stretches before you, glistening ice coating its cobbled surface. Day two sees your path meandering through a dense forest, the glades beginning to burst with life. On the third day, you chance upon a small village, where locals toil—eagerly preparing for the spring festival. The halflings welcome you warmly and invite you to stay for the festivities, which go long into the night. Next day you continue, the trees thinning as your path cuts through rolling hills with grass full of budding plants. By early afternoon on the tenth day your destination sits just across a river full of jumping fish and spanned by a wooden bridge.

Hell: Floor Of Flesh.name:
地狱：血肉之地
Hell: Floor Of Flesh

Text.text:
一团咿呀乱语、蠕动不止、饱受折磨的扭曲血肉铺满地面。躯体与灵魂仿佛被碾碎后搅拌在一起，编织成一张无尽痛苦的地毯。你每一步踏在这汗湿黏腻的肉团上，都在凝结的血浆中噗嗤作响；有时像是触发了远处的嘴巴因剧痛而尖叫，有时又令你脚下的地面在无声的悲号里微微战栗。
A gibbering, wriggling, tortured mat of twisted flesh covers the ground. Bodies and souls seem smashed and blended together, woven into a carpet of endless agony. Each step on the sweaty, sticky mass squelches with congealed blood, sometimes seeming to set distant mouths to screaming in pain, sometimes making the floor about you quiver in silent anguish.

Ship's Main Deck.name:
船只主甲板
Ship's Main Deck

Text.text:
无论一天中的哪个时辰，也无论天气如何，这艘船的主甲板总是行动繁忙。木板甲面不断被水手学徒来回擦洗——他们都盼着终有一天轮到自己登上瞭望台、操炮、绘图，甚至掌舵。各工位之间，巨大的绳索盘卷得整整齐齐，水手们在大副每一次咆哮的命令下调校船帆时，都小心翼翼地绕开这些绳圈。
Regardless of the time of day or the weather conditions, the main deck of this ship is always bustling with activity. The wooden planks are constantly swabbed out by ratings who aspire to one day have their turn at the crow’s nest, the cannons, the charts, or even the helm. Immense coils of rope lay neatly wound in between stations, carefully avoided by the sailors adjusting the sails at every order bellowed by the first mate.

Wand Of Magic Missiles.name:
魔法飞弹魔杖
Wand Of Magic Missiles

Text.text:
这根魔杖的造型怪异，宛如一柄微型戟；杖端的刃片好似一簇蓝色火焰。在另一端，有一道细小的凹痕，仿佛专为容纳持用者拇指指腹的圆肉而设。
Shaped oddly like a tiny halberd, the blade at the wand’s end resembles a blue flame. A minute depression at the opposite end seems to be placed to house the ball of the wielder’s thumb.

听起来像是风声。可紧接着，一道淡淡的轮廓凝成实体——一抹骇人的幽影闪烁不定——而在万物之间那道缝隙的虚无空间里，一个类人的身形开始成形。几乎要成形。它像坏掉的全息投影般来回卡顿，轮廓总是滞后于动作。你几乎不可能看清那东西的底细，它在存在与虚无之间忽隐忽现。但有一点千真万确：它手里握着一把剑。
It sounds like the wind. But then a faint outline solidifies—a ghastly apparition flickers—and from the nothing space that is the gap between all things, a humanoid figure takes shape. Almost takes shape. Stuttering to and fro like a faulty hologram, their outline lags their movements. It’s almost impossible to get a read on the thing, flitting in and out of existence. But they are very definitely holding a sword.

高大的树木沿着城里的街道生长，既为行人遮荫，也让此地更添几分秀美。或许正因如此，这里的生活节奏仿佛慢了下来：许多人悠然坐在特意摆出的椅子上闲聊，也有人三三两两围成小圈站着，轮流抽着烟斗。你看见其中一群人朝你迅速侧目一瞥，却没太在意——毕竟你是个新来的外乡人。可紧接着，同样的目光又出现了……
Tall trees grow along the streets of the city, shading its people and beautifying the place as well. Life seems to take a slower pace as a result, with many folk sitting to talk in chairs set out for the purpose or huddling in small standing clusters to share a pipe. You spot one of these groups giving you a quick sideways glance but think little of it—you are new in town after all. But then it happens again…

I Cast Commune Using Components.name:
我用材料施放【通神术】
I Cast Commune Using Components

Text.text:
我从随身的匣子里取出圣香与一小瓶灵水。我将它们用于仪式，抬手在其上方划动手势，随之说话，吟诵一段神圣的祈请咒文。随后，那一刻到来——一种我能清晰感到的意念。准许。我发问，并得到回应。再一次。第三次，凡人对永恒回应的解读便由此展开。
From the case I carry, I withdraw the sacred incense and the vial of spirit water. I put them to use, gesturing over them and speaking a chant of divine request. Then comes the moment, an intention I can feel. Permission. I ask and am answered. Again. A third time, and the mortal interpretation of eternal answers begins.

Broken-down Dungeon Door.name:
破败的地城门扉
Broken-down Dungeon Door

Text.text:
这扇简陋的门根本毫无胜算，如今早已四分五裂，碎片被撞得远离铰链，散落在地。它做工粗陋，木板单薄，五金朴素，用料寥寥，仿佛存在的意义更像走个过场，而非真正用来阻挡什么。
This simple door never stood a chance, and lies splintered on the floor a good distance away from its hinges. Of simple construction with thin wood, plain hardware, and minimal material, it seems meant more as a formality than an actual obstacle.

I Calm A Victim Of A Crime.name:
我安抚一位犯罪受害者
I Calm A Victim Of A Crime

Text.text:
“你没事了。发生在你身上的事已经结束了。我以生命起誓，绝不会再发生。我明白你正痛着，但如果我们要抓住干下这一切的渣滓，阻止他们再让任何人遭殃，我需要你集中精神。”
“You’re okay. What happened to you is finished now. I promise on my life, it will never happen again. I understand you are in pain, but I need you focused if we are to catch the scum who did this and prevent anyone else from suffering at their hands.”

Dark Casting Of Spiritual Weapon.name:
灵体武器的黑暗施放
Dark Casting Of Spiritual Weapon

Text.text:
在一阵坏疽般翻涌的迷雾中，一柄钉头锤浮现，幽魂般的绿光在雾里闪烁。它的锤首是一颗张口的颅骨，悬浮在柄端上方；握柄由一根股骨制成，骨面刻满骇人的末日图景。它披着死亡般的蒸汽挥击而出，寂静如坟，掠过之处迸发出阴森的辉芒。

~ 构想：Papa P

In a swirl of gangrenous mist agleam with ghostly green light, a mace appears. Its head is an open-mouthed skull, which floats above a haft made of a femur carved with grisly images of doom. Cloaked in deathly vapor, it strikes out, silent as the grave, flashing with ghastly radiance.

~ Envisioned by Papa P

Teaching Someone To Hold A Sword.name:
教人握剑
Teaching Someone To Hold A Sword

Text.text:
“把食指搭在护手十字处。对，就是那儿。手要放松，不然还没耗到对手，你自己先累垮了。让剑刃替你干活。很好。那么，我们来试试拇指握法。”
“Put your index finger at the cross guard. There. Keep your hand relaxed or you’ll wear yourself down before your opponent. Let the blade do the work. Good, then. Let’s try the thumb grip.”

Emergency Shelter From A Blizzard.name:
暴风雪中的紧急避难所
Emergency Shelter From A Blizzard

Text.text:
夕阳沉入地平线下，空气里渐渐缠上飘游的雪丝；寒意趁风势转为冰冷而穿透的性相，狠狠咬住你裸露的皮肤。短短几分钟，原本散漫的雪花便被抽打成暴怒的暴风雪；你蹚行在雪幕里，能见度骤然坠落。近旁一处嶙峋的岩檐伸出，天然替你挡住最凶的风雪——而它脚下那片粗硬却干燥的枯草，看起来正是扎营的绝佳之地。

~ Envisioned by Elijah Richard

As the sun dips below the horizon, the air becomes laced with drifting snow, and a chill nips at your exposed skin as the wind takes on a frigid, penetrating aspect. Within minutes, the meandering flakes are whipped into a furious blizzard, and visibility plummets as you wade through the snowstorm. A rocky overhang nearby forms a natural defense against the worst of the blizzard—and a patch of coarse, dry grass at its base looks like an awfully good place to make camp.

~ Envisioned by Elijah Richard

Xenia The Righteous.name:
正义的泽妮娅
Xenia The Righteous

Text.text:
太阳在她雪金色的发丝间跃动，高挑的骑士摘下头盔。金色纹印在她苍白的肌肤上蜿蜒盘旋，勾勒出冷峻的贵族轮廓，双眼则泛着幽微的光芒。

~ 由 光之主所扮演

The sun dances across white-blond hair as the tall knight removes her helm. Golden markings twist across her pallid skin, highlighting grim patrician features and eyes glowing with ambient light.

~ Played by Lord of Light

Drifting Nightshade.name:
漂游的夜影草
Drifting Nightshade

Text.text:
一名高大的豺狼人手持长弓，挺着凸起的肚腹蓄势待发；弓弦由斑驳的筋腱拧成，粗糙打制的箭矢已然搭上。弯曲的肩头上方竖起一杆长矛，他身上的皮质札甲随着他谨慎而带着软垫的脚步移动，几乎不发出声响。左眼周围的皮肉被刻入一个符号：一颗犬首的轮廓，而在他真正的眼旁又凿出两只“额外”的眼。伤痕陈旧——厚重的黄褐毛皮上，淡粉色的疤沟如干涸河道般蜿蜒。下颌微微战栗，他朝身侧小跑相随的鬣狗发出一声喀喀作响的尖叫。那鬣狗也回以喀喀声，黑唇咧开，露出獠牙狞笑。

~ Played by DVerfuss

A tall gnoll wields a longbow, held at the ready afore his pronounced belly, the ruggedly crafted arrow notched in a bowstring of mottled sinew. A long spear rises over his hunched shoulder and the leather lamellar he wears barely makes a sound as he moves with careful, padded footsteps. A symbol is carved into the flesh about his left eye: the shape of a canine head with two more eyes etched around his true one. The scars are old—pale pink wadis delved into thick, tawny fur. His lower jaw shudders as he emits a chittering yelp to the hyena loping at his side. It chitters back, dark lips parting into a fanged leer.

~ Played by DVerfuss

Collapsing Bridge Trap.name:
坍塌桥梁陷阱
Collapsing Bridge Trap

Text.text:
[感知] 你迈出下一步时，桥身猛地一颤，原本低微的吱呀声骤然拔高，音量与频率一并攀升。你用余光瞥见几处结构错位、崩落，碎片旋即坠入下方。整座桥仿佛随时都会在下一瞬间彻底垮塌。

[触发！] 一声震耳欲聋的爆裂轰然炸响，桥梁在正中猛地崩开一道裂口。结构似乎还勉强支撑了一瞬，随即第一批大块碎片便脱落坠下。随着整体强度不断衰退，越来越多的构件在碎屑风暴中接连下坠。

[Perceived] The bridge shudders under your next step, and the normally quiet creaking increases in volume and frequency. You catch a few bits of the construction shift and fall away out of the corners of your eyes. The entire structure feels ready to collapse at any moment.

[Triggered!] A thunderous crack rings out, and the bridge spits at the midpoint. The structure seems to hold, but then the first chunks start to fall. As the integrity weakens, more and more pieces plummet downward in a storm of debris.

你面前耸立着一幕宇宙奇观。它宛如上古的巨型斯芬克斯，躯体缠绕藤蔓，双翼如叶之斗篷般披覆垂落。它的爪踏令大地本身都为之震颤。最离奇的是它的头颅——一枚幽蓝发光的球体，其上大陆与海洋俱全，仿佛全息投影的世界展示。敬畏感攫住了你，而在那之下，更有一种深沉而灾厄的不安。这只生物心智已然崩毁，一股难以测度的庞大灵能气场如热浪般层层荡出。
Before you rears a cosmic wonder. It is alike to a colossal sphinx of old, its body wreathed in vines, wings draped like a mantle of leaves. Its paws shake the very ground. Most curious is the head, a blue shining globe complete with continents and oceans—like a holographic world display. A sense of awe overcomes you and, beyond that, a deep and calamitous unease. This creature possesses a ruined mind, and a psychic aura of unfathomable magnitude emanates like waves of heat.

你以一个细微的手势配合低声咒语点燃火焰——一团闷燃的火球骤然苏醒，大小不超过一堆营火。热浪立刻变得清晰可感，像一阵怡人的暖风在空气中扩散，而火光则柔和地微微跃动。
With a subtle gesture and whispered word, the fire bursts into life—a smoldering ball of flames no larger than a campfire. The heat is immediately palpable, radiating through the air like a pleasant breeze as the fire glows softly.

Xenolinguistic Lecturer.name:
异星语言学讲师
Xenolinguistic Lecturer

Text.text:
讲师那一众手臂夹着的书本，封面标题写满了令人眼花缭乱的语言与象形文字，仿佛从银河各处搜罗而来。讲堂前方的全息板上，他们又用一串令人眩晕的符号与字母写下自己的名字——其中大多数你根本认不出来。学生席间困惑的低语如涟漪般扩散开来，讲师却只是嘴角一挑，带着几分得意：他们正迫不及待要把外星语言学的精微奥秘，讲给这些愿意聆听的年轻头脑。
The titles of the books tucked beneath the lecturer’s many arms are written in a baffling array of languages and hieroglyphs from across the galaxy. On the holo-board at the front of the lecture theater they write their name in a dizzying collection of symbols and letters—most of which you don’t recognize. The lecturer smirks as murmurs of confusion ripple through the assembled students, excited to teach receptive young minds the intricacies of xenolinguistics.

I Cast Celestial Planar Ally.name:
我施放《天界异界盟友》
I Cast Celestial Planar Ally

Text.text:
我高声吟唱法术，张开双臂虔诚祈求，金色光芒在双眼中燃起，直望苍穹。成功！云层在一道光柱中分裂，天界使者随之降临，柔和的竖琴嗡鸣伴其左右。它落在我身旁，微微偏头，以如大理石般冰冷、纹理分明的眼眸打量着我。它张口，用天界的语言抛出一个问题——语调如雷霆轰鸣，韵律却似诗歌般流淌。它的声音仿佛天界位面本身的缩影：异世的瑰丽，与不容置疑的伟力交织。
I sing out the spell, spreading my arms in supplication, my eyes glowing gold as they regard the heavens. Success! The clouds part in a ray of light and the celestial descends, accompanied by the soft thrumming of harps. It lands beside me, tilting its head and regarding me with eyes as veined and cold as marble. It opens its mouth and asks a question in its celestial language, its tone thundering and cadence lyrical. Its voice is a microcosm of the celestial plane itself: a mix of otherworldly beauty and undeniable power.

一张铺着奢华软垫的床安置在碎绒天鹅绒的床幔之下，怡人的花香在宽敞的皇家寝室里缓缓飘荡。主区域之外，可见一间盥洗室，配有大理石洗面盆与落地镜。北墙前，一张熊皮地毯铺在噼啪作响的壁炉前；一只盛着爽脆红苹果的碗搁在一张小桌上，小桌紧挨着一把绒软的扶手椅。
A luxuriously cushioned bed rests beneath a canopy of crushed velvet, and a pleasing floral scent drifts through the spacious royal bedchamber. Beyond the main area, a washroom can be seen, complete with marble basin and standing mirror. A bearskin rug rests before a roaring fireplace in the northern wall, and a bowl of crisp red apples sits upon a small table beside a plush armchair.

Baldwin Bladesemmer.name:
鲍德温·刀锋播种者
Baldwin Bladesemmer

Text.text:
这位与大地相连的男人，棕褐色的皮肤仿佛雕琢成型的岩石——其上纵横着细微裂隙——而他的沉着更是坚若磐石。精工细作的衣装贴身而着，其外覆着一套锻造得无可挑剔的护甲；盾牌上则绘着家族的代表色。他举手投足皆是贵族那种不容错认的风度：一边抚过黑色、修剪齐整的胡须，一边审视着如潮涌来的敌群。随后，他朝最近的敌人微微颔首，露出迷人的笑意……下一瞬，他蓄力拧身，挥出一记噼啪作响、铁拳套包裹的重拳。

~ Played by Endless Dream with

The earth-bonded man’s brown skin gives an impression of sculpted stone—riven with minor fissures—and his composure is rock-solid. His clothes are finely made beneath an impeccably wrought suit of armor, and his shield is adorned in house colors. He comports himself with the unmistakable bearing of nobility, considering a swarm of enemies while stroking his dark, well-trimmed beard. He gives his nearest foe a nod and a charming smile… before winding up and swinging a crackling, gauntleted fist.

~ Played by Endless Dream with

Road To The City.name:
通往城里的路
Road To The City

Text.text:
当你沿着道路旅行时，身边汇聚的人群越来越多。推着货车的商贩、结伴而行的村民，甚至还有零星几支贵族的马背随从队伍，都以各自的步伐朝同一个方向前进。看起来，那座城市是个热门去处。
As you travel along the road, you’re joined by an increasing number of people. Traders with carts, groups of villagers, and even a smattering of noble retinues on horseback, all move in the same direction at their own pace. It seems the city is a popular destination.

Well And Bucket.name:
水井与水桶
Well And Bucket

Text.text:
行会大厅正面外墙的阴影角落里，嵌着一口矮胖的石井，井口盖着木制井盖。旁边草地上放着一只水桶，刚用过般湿漉漉地浸透了水。
A squat stone well sits in a shady nook of the front wall of the guildhall, covered by a wooden lid. A bucket sits in the grass next to it, sodden from recent use.

Sundries From A Goristro.name:
戈里斯特罗的杂物
Sundries From A Goristro

Text.text:
你在牛头人身旁发现一截断裂的管子，体型与短剑相仿；旁边还散落着几缕编成辫的头发，形似拧成卷的烟草条。
You find a broken pipe the size of a shortsword next to the minotaur, along with several lengths of braided hair that resemble tobacco twists.

I Hack Into A Robot.name:
我黑进了一台机器人
I Hack Into A Robot

Text.text:
我咒骂着，那块肮脏的屏幕上又弹出一道防火墙，冷嘲热讽般亮出警告：若我继续下去，公司将提起诉讼。懒得理会，我绕开它另寻路径，这一次终于拿到了那具瘫在我身旁、毫无反应的合成体的全部许可；一根编织线缆从它的中央处理器拖曳而出，插进我控制台的端口。满意的笑意点亮我的脸，我启动程序——机器人随即苏醒。
I curse as another firewall pops up on the grubby screen, taunting me with warnings of corporate litigation if I continue. Ignoring it, I find another way, this time gaining full access to the inert synthetic slumped beside me, a braided wire trailing from its central processor to a port in my console. A satisfied smile lights my face as I initiate the program—and the robot activates.

Shield Of Faith.name:
信仰之盾
Shield Of Faith

Text.text:
你在虔诚中笃信不移，深知自己受神明引领与庇护。只需低声念出一句短祷，再以指尖触及你信仰的圣典，你的信念便能凝成一面真实的护盾，守护你或他人。它化作一层微光粼粼的力场，悬浮于空中。
Sure in your devotion, you know yourself to be guided and protected by your god. With a brief phrase, and by touching the text of your faith, your conviction can manifest as a literal shield to guard you or another. It appears as a shimmering field, hovering in the air.

A Call For Aid When Losing In Single Com.name:
单挑落败时的求援呼喊
A Call For Aid When Losing In Single Combat

Text.text:
“虽然我很感激你们把我当成如此了不起的战士，但要是你们再不赶紧出手，我就要变成墙上一滩了不起的血泥了。”
“While I am grateful that you all consider me such a remarkable fighter, if you don’t intervene soon, I’m going to be a remarkable smear on the wall.”

View From Outer Space.name:
外太空视角
View From Outer Space

Text.text:
你们紧攥着武器——自从踏入这片诡异之地起便从未松开——队伍分列门两侧，随时准备迎接对探索的抗力。然而，当门扉滑开，眼前的景象仍足以摧毁你们过往的一切经验：一片漆黑的虚空，其间零星点缀着银黄的针尖光芒。你们继续凝望，视线缓缓下移，便看见下方悬着一颗巨大的蓝绿色圆球，周围环着一圈淡淡的反光光晕。胃里猛地一沉，你们这才意识到——那是你们自己的世界，正躺在难以想象的距离之下。这意味着你们已不在原处，而是在别的地方。就在夜空深处，离你们曾认识或在乎过的任何人，成千上万，甚至数百万里之遥。建造这片空间的生物，是否曾用双足接触过朴素的泥土，感受过那份最寻常的尘世触感？

~ 构想：Sax

Clutching your weapons tight—as you have since arriving in this strange place—your party stands on either side of the door, expecting resistance to your exploration at any moment. But nothing in your experience can adequately prepare you for the view awaiting you once the doors slide open: a black emptiness dotted here and there with silvery-yellow pinpricks of light. As you take in more of the view your vision pans down and you see an enormous blue-green orb below you, surrounded by a faint nimbus of reflected light. With a monstrous lurch in your gut you realize that you are looking down at your own world, some unimaginable distance below you, meaning you must be somewhere else entirely. Somewhere in the night sky, thousands if not millions of leagues from anyone you have ever known or cared about. Have the creatures who built this space ever known the earthly touch of simple soil on their feet?

~ Envisioned by Sax

I Wield My Mace Of Disruption.name:
我挥舞着我的破邪钉锤
I Wield My Mace Of Disruption

Text.text:
它看起来像一柄权杖，是宗教领袖与权威的象征。通体金光，制作繁复；锤头宛如一轮太阳，高悬在厚重青铜的骨架之上。握柄朴素却坚实有力。用它砸向魔鬼或恶魔，就像挥着一座小教堂当头轰下：要么是光耀复仇带来的救赎与终极恐惧，要么便是湮灭之终的最终审判。
It looks like a scepter, the device of religious leadership and authority. Golden and elaborately made, the head of the mace is a sun over a framework of heavy bronze. The handle is simple and strong. It’s like hitting a fiend or demon with a small church: either the deliverance of radiant retribution and ultimate fear, or the final judgment of oblivion.

当那枚鎏金流苏被取下，洁白无瑕的羊皮纸便轻轻舒展，顺滑得几乎不费力。信笺顶端盖着一枚庄严的官方印玺，其下，一行笔力精湛的书法字句缓缓铺陈开来：“To Whom This May Concern . . .”你注意到信中对收信人赞誉之高，字里行间尽是溢出的恭维与褒奖。
Once the gilded tassel is removed, the pristine parchment unfurls with ease. Under an official seal stamped at the top of the letter, a statement in finely crafted calligraphy begins: “To Whom This May Concern . . .” You note how highly it speaks of the recipient, the text suffused with compliments and praise.

一个年轻人猛地冲入视野，喘得厉害，脸上和衬衫都被汗水糊得紧紧贴住。皮革肩带勒紧在他肩头，斜跨到另一侧被他死死按住的挎包上。他脚穿包头凉鞋，绑带一路缠紧到小腿，脚尖几乎刚接触地面就又弹起，仿佛连尘土都来不及惊动。
A young man runs into view, breathing hard, his face and shirt plastered with sweat. A leather shoulder strap runs tight over his shoulder to a satchel he carries tight on the opposite side. He wears closed-toe sandals wrapped tight up his calves, and they barely seem to touch the earth before springing up again.

Car Repair Shop.name:
汽车修理铺
Car Repair Shop

Text.text:
少数几名汗流浃背、穿着工装背带裤的人在这间中等大小的车库里忙活，空气里油味刺鼻，久久不散。汽车与零件把空间挤得水泄不通：有的挂在墙上，有的支在千斤顶上，还有的在负重力中悬浮。一个长着机械第三只手臂的身影摘下焊工面罩，顶着重型锯片啃咬金属的刺耳噪声大喊：“嘿，莫，把套筒扳手递过来！”一个眼睛是蓝色屏幕的修理工把工具抛了过去，那三臂的家伙连头都没抬就稳稳接住。
A small number of sweaty figures in overalls work in this mid-sized garage, where the stench of oil hangs in the air. Cars and car parts crowd the space: hanging from walls, propped up on car jacks, hovering in negative gravity. A figure with a robotic third arm removes his welding mask and shouts over the sound of heavy saws grinding metal: “Hey Mo, pass da lug wrench!” A mechanic with blue screens for eyes tosses the tool, which the three-armed figure catches without looking up.

I Use Feral Senses.name:
我动用野性@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Feral Senses]
I Use Feral Senses

Text.text:
你一动，空气被挤开的细微变化就会出卖你。我听得见你的呼吸。你潜行时背带发出的吱呀声也会泄露你的行踪。地上的碎屑与尘土会描出你的足迹。我能看见、也能听见你最细微的征兆，从而知道你身在何处。隐形也藏不住你于我。
Air displaced when you move gives you away. I hear your breath. The creak of your harness as you sneak betrays you. Debris or dust on the ground shows your footfalls. I can see and hear your subtlest signs to learn where you are. Invisibility can’t hide you from me.

你一丝不苟地备齐施法材料：木炭、熏香、草药，以及那只小巧的黄铜火盆——盆身镶嵌着各类奔走游蹿的野兽浮纹。你跪在火盆前将其点燃，熏香与草药的气息氤氲升起，木炭在暗红中闷闷吐烟。你高声吟诵咒文，意识沉入逐渐凝结的奥术云雾里，探手越过分隔此世与彼世的帷幕，乃至更遥远的界层，只为寻来一位同伴。你用草药与木炭的余烬，手指微颤地书写符文，将自己与仍在冒烟的火盆一并圈入其中。那股存在愈发逼近，越来越近——随后你看见了它，在你面前显形，凝成实体。你新的魔宠。
You carefully prepare your material components: charcoal, incense, herbs, the small brass brazier inlaid with images of roaming, running beasts of all kinds. You kneel before the brazier as you set it alight, the incense and herbs fragrant, the charcoal smoldering. You speak aloud the incantation, losing yourself in the coalescing cloud of arcane energy, reaching out beyond the veils that divide this world from the next, and those beyond, to seek out a companion. With the remains of the herbs and charcoal, you write the runes with a trembling hand, encricling yourself and the still-smoking brazier. The presence draws closer, closer—and then you see it, manifesting before you, taking physical form. Your new familiar.

Desert Temple Defenses Activate.name:
沙漠神殿的防御启动
Desert Temple Defenses Activate

Text.text:
狂怒的旋风裹挟着刺目的飞沙吞没了这座古老建筑，伴随一记浑厚的脉冲，防御机制被骤然唤醒。兽形雕像发出吱呀作响的轰鸣，浸透其雕刻躯壳的巫术能量令它们苏醒。当它们振起石翼腾空而起，便没入咆哮的风暴之中，化作几乎难以察觉的潜伏阴影——直到它们猛然出击。
A furious whirlwind engulfs the ancient structure in blinding sand as a sonorous pulse activates the defenses. Bestial statues creak to life, animated by the sorcerous energies suffusing their sculpted forms. As they rise, borne aloft on stone wings, they disappear into the raging storm, becoming little more than concealed shadows—until they strike.

蜥蜴幼崽大大打了个哈欠，露出一口齐整锋利的白牙。它那虹彩般的鳞片随着笨拙却执拗的动作闪闪发亮，左右翻滚着试图攒起站起的势头。它的爪子已然凶戾可怖，幼崽终于抓住着力点，摇摇晃晃地站了起来，用短粗的尾巴勉强保持平衡。
The reptilian infant yawns wide, displaying a full set of sharp, white teeth.  Their iridescent scales gleam as they move clumsily but determinedly, rolling from side to side to try and gain momentum to stand. With claws already wicked to look upon, the infant finds purchase and stands shakily, using their stubby tail for balance.

这座大宅阴沉的山墙尖顶高高耸立，俯视着环绕其周的果树林。高大的铁门与相连的围栏沿着地产边界延展开来，对任何闯入的流浪者——无论是盗贼还是单纯的冒险者——都发出清晰的警告。
The peak of this large home’s dark gables towers above the grove of fruit trees that surrounds it. A tall iron gate, and accompanying fence, extends around the border of the property, offering a clear warning to any wanderer, be they thief or simple adventurer.

After-healing Quip.name:
治疗后俏皮话
After-healing Quip

Text.text:
“你很快就会感觉好些了，不过下次也许你该学会低头躲一躲？”
“You should start feeling better soon, but maybe in the future you could learn to duck?”

College Of Valor Bard.name:
英勇学院吟游诗人
College Of Valor Bard

Text.text:
吟游诗人如战场的搏动之心般夺目，刀刃敲击盾面，铿锵节拍震耳欲聋。他们以战歌鼓起胆气，向盟友高声示警，朝敌人抛出恶毒辱骂。当他们纵身跃入乱阵，剑与法术同样娴熟地挥使，闪亮的锁子甲映出他们如灯塔般的鼓舞与号召。
The bard stands out as the beating heart of battle, striking their blade against their shield in a clangorous rhythm. They instill bravery with their war chants, shout warnings to their allies, and hurl abuse at their enemies. When they leap into the fray, they wield sword and spell with equal skill, a beacon of inspiration in their gleaming mail.

Shark Body At Low Tide.name:
退潮时的鲨鱼尸身
Shark Body At Low Tide

Text.text:
鲨鱼的躯体庞然如山，恶臭的尸骸轻轻松松就有五十英尺长。潮水在尸身周围拍打，惊扰了正为残渣撕扯争夺的食腐蟹群。附近渔村的人早已割走大块肉段，试图把海神赐下的丰饶尽可能派上用场。不远处，两名饱经风霜的水手却毫无加入渔民行列的意思，只是盯着鲨尾附近那道骇人的巨型咬痕。两人不约而同地摇了摇头，匆匆转身离去——目光不安地回望着远处起伏的海浪。
The body of the shark is vast, its stinking carcass easily fifty feet long. The tide laps around the corpse, disturbing the feasting crabs wrestling for scraps. Folk from the local fishing village have already carved away large portions, attempting to make good use of the sea god’s bounty. Nearby, two grizzled sailors make no effort to join the fisherfolk. Instead they eye a colossal bite mark near the shark’s tail. As one they shake their heads and quickly walk away—casting worried looks at the distant waves.

Nervous Young Prince Making A Speech.name:
紧张的年轻王子正在发表演说
Nervous Young Prince Making A Speech

Text.text:
墨迹在年轻王子颤抖的双手间晕开，他以指节发白的力道攥紧羊皮纸。冷汗在黏湿的肌肤上凝成细珠，他拼命想稳住心神，把演说送出口。可那些词句在舌尖绊倒，像初生的小马般踉跄；他一边强压胃里翻涌的恶心，试图按住那不断上涨的眩晕潮汐。

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Ink smudges his trembling hands as the young prince holds the parchment in a white-knuckled grip. Sweat beads on his clammy skin as he desperately tries to regain his composure and deliver the speech. Stumbling over the words like a newborn foal he tries to quell the rising tide of nausea in his stomach.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

头盔空洞的凝视承载着你祖先期许的重量。先辈的巨剑整齐交叉在纹章盾牌泛黄的象牙背后——那是一张空白画布，等待你在其上刻下自己的印记。
The helmet’s hollow gaze carries the weight of your ancestors’ expectations. The mighty swords of your forebearers cross neatly behind the yellowed ivory of the heraldic shield—the blank canvas on which you will make your mark.

Druid's Speech Of Self-affirmation.name:
德鲁伊的自我肯定之言
Druid's Speech Of Self-affirmation

Text.text:
“我怎会坠落？大自然本身就托举着我。无论发生什么，它永远都在——在我脚下，在我呼吸的空气里。等到那一刻来临，我将彻底归于它：我的身体会沉入大地之下，我将化作土壤，让新的英雄踏在其上。”
“How can I fall when nature itself holds me up? No matter what happens, it will always be there, beneath my feet and in the very air I breathe. When the time comes, I will join it in full—my body will sink beneath the earth and I will become the ground for new heroes to stand upon.”

Dead Brass Dragon's Eye.name:
死去黄铜龙之眼
Dead Brass Dragon's Eye

Text.text:
巨龙之眼曾经温暖而灿亮的琥珀色，如今却黯淡冰冷，像一座失了火焰的炉灶。一层薄如蛛丝的膜覆在眼面，将光线反射回你眼前，也扭曲了那道竖直、爬行类般的瞳孔影像。尽管这头生物已然死去，它的凝视仍沉重如万古岁月压在心头，你为它的逝去生出一丝哀伤——无论它曾选择以何种方式活着。

~ Sahlonahl 于 Discord

The warm, radiant amber of the dragon's eye seems dull and cold now, like a stove without a flame. A gossamer-thin film covers the eye, reflecting the light back at you and distorting the image of the dragon's vertical, reptilian pupil. Though the creature is dead, its gaze still carries the weight of eons, and you feel a tinge of sadness at its passing—no matter how it chose to live.

~ Sahlonahl on Discord

Speech About The Luxury Of Fate.name:
关于命运奢华的演说
Speech About The Luxury Of Fate

Text.text:
“我不向迷信或命运的心血来潮低头。所谓宿命，不过是那些不曾遭逢多少灾厄的人才配享的奢侈品——他们才会相信自己是某个宏大计划的一部分，而不是这世界本来的样子。穷人懂得什么命运？乞丐呢？难民呢？他们就只是你那场壮丽天命里的提线木偶与布景吗？”
“I do not bow to superstitions or the whims of fate. Destiny is a luxury of those who have experienced so few misfortunes as to believe they are part of some plan and not simply the way of the world. What does the pauper know of fate? Or the beggar? Or the refugee? Are they simply marionettes and props in your own grand destiny?”

White Dragon Lair.name:
白龙巢穴
White Dragon Lair

Text.text:
就在这片覆雪山脉的最高峰下方不远处，一道冰墙裂隙赫然张开，通往一条漫长的洞穴——洞中冰多于岩，仿佛整座山被寒意掏空。置身其内，任何温血生物都不可能奢望久活；但这里本就不是温血者的巢穴。此地属于白龙：嶙峋、冻结、荒寒、险恶的洞窟巢居之主——其吐息所携的冷冽死意，甚至胜过北境长风。
Just below the highest peak of this snow-covered mountain range, there lies a crevice in an ice wall leading into a long cavern that is more ice than rock. In this cavern, no creature of warm blood could expect to survive for long—but this is not the domicile of a warmblood. This is the craggy, frozen, inhospitable, treacherous cave of a white dragon, a creature whose breath exceeds even the northern winds in its expression of death from cold.

两只健壮的长耳野兔彼此对峙，像一对宿怨深结、怒火经年未消的仇敌。它们猛然扑向对方，用细长的后腿连连小跳以维持平衡，前腿则不停挥击。它们像两名披着皮毛的僧人般相互敲打，拳影翻飞，耐力与执拗都令人咋舌……可它们似乎并未取得多少进展，两对爪子只是一次次弹开彼此。细瘦后腿的轻跳、拍击爪影的模糊、圆眼里空白的凝视——你不由得觉得这场兔子斗殴竟有几分可爱。
Two strapping jackrabbits face each other like a pair of foes whose long-harbored rage has known no mitigation. They jump at one another, bouncing on their hind legs to keep balanced while pummeling with their forelegs. Hammering at each other like two befurred monks, their flurries of blows are impressive in both stamina and persistence… but they don’t seem to be making much progress, the two pairs of paws simply bouncing off each other. The tiny hops on spindly hind legs, the blur of battering paws, the blank stare of their round eyes—you can’t help but find this bunny brawl somewhat adorable.

Goblin With A Hatchet.name:
戴短斧的地精
Goblin With A Hatchet

Text.text:
金属的寒光在黑暗中划出一道弧线，那矮小的生物逼近，发出低沉的咆哮警告。苔藓色的大耳朵从棕色兜帽的裂口中探出，黄色的眼睛在层层黝黑、纠结的乱发下若隐若现。你们靠近时，哥布林死死攥着手里粗糙劈削的短斧，目光在你们每个人之间飞快游移，寻找最合适的目标。
Metal glints in an arc through the darkness as the short creature approaches, snarling in warning. Large ears the color of moss protrude through slits in a brown hood, yellow eyes barely visible under layers of dark, matted hair. The goblin grips the roughly-hewn hatchet in its hand tightly as you approach, its eyes darting quickly between each of you, looking for the right target.

City Building Under Construction.name:
施工中的城市建筑
City Building Under Construction

Text.text:
许多告示牌将行人引向施工区外绕行，但这里正在进行的活计一目了然，也足够让人敬而远之。半建成的楼体被木质脚手架层层围住，空地上堆满了施工工具与装备。这里，有人正将砖块与砂浆一块块嵌进坚固的墙体，作为建筑外立面的一部分；那边，一台手摇式混凝土搅拌机静静搁着，宽阔的滚筒空空等待着熟练的工匠将灰烬、石灰与海水装入其中。不久之后，屋顶将被架起，楼板会被铺设并收整完毕，内墙也会抹上石膏灰泥。
Many signs redirect foot traffic around the construction zone but the work being done is plain enough to see, and avoid. Wooden scaffolding surrounds the half-constructed building, and the lot is filled with construction tools and equipment. Here, someone has begun fitting bricks and mortar into a sturdy wall as part of the building’s façade; there, a hand-cranked concrete mixer sits idle, waiting for a skilled builder to load ash, lime, and seawater into the capacious drum. Soon enough, the roof will be erected, floors installed and finished, and gypsum plaster applied to the inside walls.

一只经回火处理的玻璃烧杯里盛着乳白色的液体，瓶塞上那道封印也许是你见过最繁复精巧的一种。壶嘴外缘套着一圈橡胶，外侧又以蜡层加固，再用一个简单却结实的箍环与扣栓牢牢锁住。你轻轻晃动烧杯，感到它沉甸甸的分量，也注意到液体旋转得异常缓慢——那黏稠厚重的质感无声地昭示着杯中之物绝非寻常。
A milky-white liquid is contained within this tempered glass beaker, the stopper possibly the most elaborate seal you have ever seen. The spout has been ringed with rubber and the outside reinforced with wax, held in place by a simple but sturdy ring and latch. Swishing the liquid around in the beaker, you feel its weight and notice the slowness of its rotation, revealing the beaker’s contents to be thick and viscous.

I Pour Water From My Decanter Of Endless.name:
我从无尽水壶中倾倒出水流（喷泉）
I Pour Water From My Decanter Of Endless Water (Geyser)

Text.text:
我拔开醒酒壶的塞子，念出命令词，瓶身随即因魔法的共鸣而微微震颤。一股洪流从其中神秘的内里倾泻而出——仿佛咆哮着越过瀑布的绝壁——空气也随之变得清新轻盈，像被彻底涤净一般。
Uncorking the decanter, I speak the command word and the bottle begins to vibrate with magical resonance. A deluge tumbles forth—as if roaring over a waterfall’s precipice—from the mystical confines within, and the air feels fresh and light, as if cleared.

长矛的柄身足有十英尺，全段打磨得光滑如镜，其上还刻着古怪的文字。以龙族的语言书写的铭文中，清晰可辨的词句是：贯穿与撕裂。这正是一把极其称手的武器，前端那狰狞的尖刺专为捅进战马的腹腔——甚至更庞大的生物——而生。
Fully ten feet long, the shaft of the pike has been smoothly polished and etched with curious script. In the language of dragons, the lettering contains the words: pierce and tear. Eminently suitable for a weapon featuring a wicked spike to drive into the bellies of horses—or even larger creatures.

Contact With Oil Of Taggit.name:
接触塔吉特油剂
Contact With Oil Of Taggit

Text.text:
你刚用皮肤擦过那件物体，却觉得滑腻异常。你还在回味那股油腻触感时，麻木便从接触处蔓延开来。紧接着，你头晕目眩，世界仿佛在向上坠落——而你却一路滑落，坠入某个黑暗所在，在那里你能感到的只剩麻木——随后，一切感觉尽失，思绪也归于空白。
You just brushed the object with your skin, but it felt slippery. As you think about that oily feeling, a numbness spreads from the spot. Then your head swims, and the world seems to be falling up—while you slide down, into someplace dark, where the numbness is all you can sense—and then you feel nothing at all, think of nothing.

I Ignite My Flame Tongue Greatsword.name:
我点燃我的焰舌巨剑
I Ignite My Flame Tongue Greatsword

Text.text:
双手死死扣住巨剑的剑柄，我将它奋力举向苍穹，高高悬在头顶。咬紧牙关，我吐出那句命令。烈焰在雄浑的剑身上骤然绽放，宛如火山口喷薄而出的炽红岩浆与烈火，直冲云霄。炼狱之刃咆哮着，我挥臂将它劈落，直斩向眼前的敌手。
Both hands set firmly on the hilt of the greatsword, I heft it skyward to hold it above my head. Through gritted teeth, I speak the command. Flame blooms up the mighty blade, like a towering geyser of molten rock and fire erupting from a volcano. The infernal blade roars as I swing it downward toward my foe.

这本厚册里满是关于世界各地植物的文字与插图描写。每一页顶端都有一行图例钥匙，标着四种不同的符号：鼻子、手、耳朵与舌头。用手指或魔杖触碰其中一个符号，便会被唤起相应的感官——松针的清冽气息，绒毛羊耳草叶片的天鹅绒触感，竹林深处安抚人心的沙沙声，新鲜洋甘菊的微苦滋味。某些页面上还盖着小小的骷髅印章——颠茄、毒芹、烟草——而那些页面上的感官符号已被灼烧抹去。
This tome is filled with written and illustrated descriptions of flora from around the world. Each page has a key at the top with four different symbols: nose, hand, ear, and tongue. Touching a symbol with your finger or wand elicits a sensation—the smell of pine needles, the velvet feel of lamb's ear leaves, the soothing sounds of a bamboo forest, the bitterness of fresh chamomile. Little skulls are stamped on certain pages—nightshade, hemlock, tobacco—and their sensation symbols have been burned away.

A Corporate Agent Is Following You.name:
一名企业特工正在跟踪你
A Corporate Agent Is Following You

Text.text:
你一边走着，一边用余光瞥见一副黑色墨镜和一身灰扑扑的西装。按理说没什么稀奇，可这种景象一再出现。现在你确信那身西装在跟踪你，你得甩掉他们——越快越好。
You catch a glimpse of black sunglasses and a drab gray suit from the corner of your eye as you walk along. Nothing unusual about that, but this keeps happening. Now you're certain that the suit is following you, and you need to shake them—fast.

Wizzipop(tm) Spittoon Fodder.name:
Wizzipop(tm) 痰盂饲料
Wizzipop(tm) Spittoon Fodder

Text.text:
这是一罐细小坚硬的树脂碎块，嚼起来就像在嚼树脂碎块。若你把其中一块嚼软，再吐进任何碗状容器里，它会在底部打转。接着它沿着碗壁绕圈飞奔，像赛道上的短跑健将；随后开始呜咽般嗡鸣、尖啸般疾旋；最后猛地腾空而起，在碗口上方三英尺处悬停数秒。它用人类的声音低声呢喃：“Pop。”随即消失不见。
This is a tin of small hard pieces of tree sap that taste like pieces of tree sap. If you chew one soft and spit it into anything bowl-shaped, it spins in the bottom. Then it circles the bowl like a track star, after which it begins whining and whizzing, and finally flies up to hover three feet above the bowl for a few seconds. It whispers in a human voice, “Pop.” And disappears.

Frigid Mountain Ridge.name:
冰寒山脊
Frigid Mountain Ridge

Text.text:
一条嶙峋的山径死死贴着峭壁蜿蜒，刺骨狂风每一次呼啸，都抖落松散的碎石，滚落进下方林海翻涌的深渊。高山的寒气像吸血般从骨缝里抽走温度，考验着每一个胆敢踏上这条最惊心动魄的险途之人的胆魄。

~ 由 David 在 Discord 上 构想

A rocky trail clings to the cliff face, loose scree tumbling into the forested abyss below with every howl of the biting wind. The frigid air of the mountain leeches warmth from bone, and tests the mettle of any who dare set foot upon this most harrowing trail.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Natural Arch At The Necropolis.name:
死灵墓城的天然拱门
Natural Arch At The Necropolis

Text.text:
比周围大半台地都要低处，一道红岩弧拱越过平坦的沙地，像一座通往台地内另一片宽阔洼地的门廊。拱下的凹槽与裂缝里，栖着一群细小的绿鸟。它们在阴影中彼此啁啾，那里空气明显更为清凉。
Lower than much of the surrounding mesa, a curve of red rock arches over the flat sand. It acts as an entryway to another broad hollow in the mesa. Under the arch, in nooks and crevices, nest tiny green birds. They chatter to each other in the shade, where the air is markedly cooler.

Upscale Lakeside Drive And Community.name:
升级湖畔大道与社区
Upscale Lakeside Drive And Community

Text.text:
这个封闭社区遍布富豪权贵的华丽宅邸，依着一片宽阔宁静的湖岸而立，宛如对大自然不完美之美的一笔刺眼点缀。尽管建筑的风格各不相同，却仍有人刻意维持相近的观感，将这些房屋——以及其中居住的人——紧紧系在一起。
This gated community is replete with the glittering homes of the wealthy elite, perched upon the shores of a large, tranquil lake like a garish addition to nature’s imperfect beauty. Though the buildings differ in architectural style, an effort has been made to maintain a similar aesthetic, tying the houses—and those within—together.

Merchant Of Arcana.name:
秘法商人
Merchant Of Arcana

Text.text:
店内空气里弥漫着泥土与葱茏的气息。草药、叶片与根茎自天花板垂挂而下，匠心陈列，恰如其分地勾勒出一排排货架；其上堆叠着宛若巨龙宝藏般琳琅满目的原料。后墙则是一面陈列橱，展示着各色药剂与药膏——色彩之繁复，几乎囊括了你能想象的一切，甚至还有一些超出想象的颜色。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

Scents of earth and verdure fill the air inside the shop. Herbs, leaves, and roots hang from the ceiling, artfully arranged to frame shelves featuring a dragon's hoard of ingredients. The back wall is a showcase for potions and poultices of every color imaginable, and some even beyond that.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

你低吟出一个充满力量的音节，一股温热随即漫过全身。紧接着，你的力量如同无形的浪潮拍向受术者，席卷其受伤的躯体，将创口与病痛一并洗去——撕裂的血肉复归崭新无损，所有疾患刹那痊愈。
You intone a powerful syllable and a suffusion of warmth passes through your body. Then, like an invisible wave crashing over the recipient, your power washes wounds and illness away from their injured body, leaving torn flesh new and unbroken, all sickness instantly cured.

Plain Bronze Brooch.name:
素青铜胸针
Plain Bronze Brooch

Text.text:
这枚胸针的工艺并不繁复，但其用心一眼可见：青铜被细细清洁、抛光，泛起深沉近乎黝黑的光泽。它格外醒目，庄重而内敛；尽管是金属，贴着冬日羊毛时却透出一丝温暖。
The work on the brooch is simple, but the care taken is obvious, the bronze cleaned and polished to a deep, dark shine. It is striking, somber, warm against the wool of winter, despite being metal.

钻石在你掌中碎裂成尘，当尘埃盘旋于你法术的物体周围时，他们的皮肤迅速硬化、龟裂，宛如化作石质。板岩般的灰色吞没了他们原本的肤色，伴随泥岩摩擦般的吱呀声，他们挺立不动，仿佛披上岩甲，抵御来袭的攻击。
The diamond crumbles to dust in your hands, and as it swirls about the object of your spell, their skin hardens and cracks, appearing as stone. The slate gray color overtakes their natural skin tone, and with a creak of earthen rock, they stand defended against attacks.

Treetop Village With Daring Inhabitants.name:
敢勇住民的树冠村
Treetop Village With Daring Inhabitants

Text.text:
树冠间的落叶懒洋洋地打着旋儿飘下，从那些巨木粗壮的枝桠间坠落——正是它们托起了这座高悬村落的根基。匠心独运的平台呈放射状铺开，撑起一间间茅屋，茅屋之间以粗陋却实用的绳索与木板桥相连。然而更大胆的住民似乎偏爱在平台间“摆荡穿行”——抓着高处枝干上系着的藤蔓与绳索，纵身一荡，肆意飞跃。村中还架着一套滑轮装置，悬着水桶，方便众人从一口深挖至林地的井里汲水。仿佛每个村民都已征服了眩晕的本能；尽管平台边缘设有栏杆以防失足，但只要一步踏空，倒霉的人必将粉身碎骨。
Leaves spiral lazily down from the boughs of the colossal trees providing the elevated village with its foundations. Cleverly designed platforms built in a radial fashion hold aloft huts connected with rude but functional rope and plank bridges. Yet some of the more daring inhabitants seem to prefer moving from platform to platform using brachiation—swinging with wild abandon from vines and ropes tied to limbs high above the village. A pulley system with buckets attached allows residents to withdraw water from a well dug into the forest floor. Seemingly every one of the villagers has conquered their sense of vertigo, for even though the platforms feature rails to prevent accidental falls, an incautious step would certainly spell doom for an unfortunate soul.

城堡的炮塔与雉堞如同参差獠牙，自建筑阴影般的轮廓中森然突起。石墙漆黑，覆着一层霜华，仿佛将周遭的光都吞饮殆尽。城堡的窗户尽皆昏暗，唯有一扇例外——最高的塔楼里，有一线灯火忽明忽灭。
The turrets and parapets of the castle resemble jagged teeth rising from the shadowed form of the structure. The stone, black and frosted with rime, seems to drink in the light around it. The windows of the castle are dark, save for one—in the tallest tower a light flickers.

那头兽性十足、猩红皮肤的恶魔踏着燃焰缠绕的分蹄大步逼近——一路在身后烙下焦黑的蹄印。山羊般的骷髅头颅空洞处，恶意的双眼灼灼窥视；咧开的颚钳格格作响，仿佛在以令人毛骨悚然的方式模仿笑声。破烂如蝠的双翼自恶魔肩胛舒展，翼展甚至比他的身高更宽。炽烈热浪自他身上翻涌而出，怨毒的目光里清晰写着饥渴。

~ Played by Daeren Xiphones

The beastly, crimson-skinned fiend strides forward on cloven hooves wreathed in flame—leaving scorch marks in his wake. Eyes alight with malice peer from the hollows of a goat-like skull, grinning mandibles clattering in an unnerving facsimile of laughter. Wings, tattered and bat-like, unfurl from the fiend’s shoulders, spanning wider than he is tall. An intense heat wafts from him, a hunger evident in his spiteful eyes.

~ Played by Daeren Xiphones

在纵横交错的溪涧水脉间，一座孤岛静卧其间，绿意如幕笼罩，低垂的枝叶宛如帷幔披覆。是河流的水势与奔涌，将它从大地的版图中生生刻出。
Amid a tangle of interweaving creeks and streams, a lone island sits, shrouded in greenery and draped with low-hanging branches. The rivers carved this island out of the landscape with their currents.

他随意倚着一棵古老巨树的树干，那名黑暗精灵身着奶油色的云纹绸衣，外罩一件洁净得不染尘埃的软甲上衣，正用一支小巧却一眼便知价值不菲的银号角吹奏着一段轻快小调。虽说他的黑暗精灵面容与所有精灵一样带着不老的质感，但那一头短短的白发间却露出几处稀薄的斑痕。你走近时，他停下吹奏，深深吸了一口气——不知为何，你本能地明白：这个人一旦开口，除非遭遇暴力或被人打断，否则绝不会停下。

~ 由 Rogério da Costa Jr. 扮演

Leaning casually against the trunk of an elder tree, the dark elf clad in cream-colored watered silk and a spotless gambeson blows a quick ditty on a small but valuable-looking silver trumpet. Though his dark elvish features hold the same ageless quality as all elves, his short white hair shows some thinning patches. As you approach, he stops blowing on the trumpet and takes a long breath—somehow, you instinctively know that once this person starts talking, he is unlikely to stop for any reason short of violence or distraction.

~ Played by Rogério da Costa Jr.

低雾在你周身凝滞，遮蔽了脚下盘根错节、植被浓密的地表。银白的光穿透树皮，在扭曲的林木间铺开一层淡淡的暮色薄纱，无论白昼黑夜、无论何等时代皆如此。你听见远处还有他人，风穿过叶隙时将他们的声音闷住、扭曲，可无论怎么分辨，都徒劳无功，始终无法锁定他们的确切方位。
Low fog stills around you, masking the dense surface of roots and vegetation beneath your feet. Silvery light pierces the bark of the trees, illuminating the twisted woods in a faint veil of twilight no matter the time of day. You hear others in the distance, their voices muffled and distorted as the wind flows through the leaves, but pinpointing their exact location proves fruitless.

Explorer Surveying Arctic Valley.name:
探险者勘察北极峡谷
Explorer Surveying Arctic Valley

Text.text:
北境寒风撕扯着探险者的斗篷，仿佛要把他们拽向死亡。探险者紧攥着一盏摇曳的提灯，审视着山口的困难地形——那被积雪噎住的咽喉在惨淡的冬阳下泛着刺眼的白光。低垂的云层遮住了前路的真实深浅与尽头。探险者耸了耸肩，长叹一声，随即踏上下降的路。
Arctic winds wrench at the cloak of the explorer, as if seeking to pull them to their death. Clutching a flickering lantern, they survey the difficult terrain of the pass, its snow-choked throat gleaming white in the wan sunshine. Low-lying clouds obscure the true extent of the path to be traveled. With a shrug, the explorer sighs and begins the descent.

这座华美的王座与其威严的座上之客周遭，弥漫着一股异界般的森然恐惧。王座由一整块巨大的绿宝石雕琢而成，造型如群蛇纠缠翻涌，散发着超自然的骇人气息。蜿蜒的雕刻仿佛有了生命，每一颗蛇首上的红宝石眼睛都闪烁着淬毒般的恶意。慵懒盘踞其上的异质存在以催眠般的阴毒目光凝视着你。
A sense of alien dread permeates the air around this magnificent throne with its imposing occupant. Crafted from a single vast emerald and shaped like writhing snakes, it exudes preternatural horror. The sinuous sculpture seems alive, the ruby eyes on each snake head glinting with venomous intent. The extrinsic being lounging here gazes at you with hypnotic malignance.

Above The Clouds On The Back Of A Dragon.name:
云端之上，骑在巨龙背上
Above The Clouds On The Back Of A Dragon

Text.text:
你知道，自己正安然无恙地趴在那头覆着灿然金属鳞片的巨型生物背上。你知道，巨龙不会容许你受伤；它那从风箱般的肺里喷吐出的强劲吐息与天生的魔法，替你挡住刺骨寒风，不让你窒息，也不让它磨破你的皮肤。你知道，就算你从它巨大的鳞片间失手滑落，它也会俯冲而下将你接住。你脑子里什么都明白。可你却感觉不到这份踏实，因为你飞得太高了——高到连云都像漂在池水里的小团棉絮。
You know you are perfectly safe on the back of the gargantuan creature covered in resplendent, metallic scales. You know that the dragon will not allow you to come to harm, that its powerful breath—exhaled from bellow-like lungs—and natural magic keep the freezing wind from suffocating you or chafing your skin. You know that if you lose your grip on its enormous scales it will swoop down and catch you. You know all this in your mind. But you can’t feel it, because you are so high above the land that the clouds themselves look like tiny cotton puffs floating in a pond.

马凯尔的沙质土壤是原始农耕技艺遗留下来的痕迹：草原被清扫得不见林木残材，土地里的养分在疯狂收割与破坏性的、不可持续的播种中被一点点榨干。这里仅有稀疏的草丛勉强生长——在这片一经接触便簌簌崩散的土地上，景观在短短数年间就会显出肉眼可见的变迁。
The sandy soil of the machair exists as a legacy to primitive farming techniques, the grasslands swept clear of forest timbers, the nutrients in the earth gradually diminished through rampant crop harvesting and destructive, unsustainable planting. Only sparse grasses grow here, in this land where the soil crumbles to the touch, and the landscape changes noticeably in short years.

灌木丛里有什么小东西窸窣作响。片刻后，一只鼬探出身来，尖牙间叼着一只小鼠。它身形修长，贴地而行，蓬松的尾巴几乎与身体等长。它一见到你，立刻弓起背脊，发出一声尖厉的尖叫，随即试图飞快窜走。
Something small rustles around in the brush. After a few moments, a weasel emerges bearing a small mouse in its fangs. The hunter's body is long and low to the ground, with a bushy tail almost as long as the rest of its frame. Upon seeing you, it arches its back and lets out a shrill squeal before attempting to scamper away.

Military-issue Light Machine Gun.name:
军用制式轻机枪
Military-issue Light Machine Gun

Text.text:
朴素得近乎无趣、冷冰冰的灰色涂装，这把军用制式轻机枪没有任何花里胡哨的附件与点缀。它徘徊在廉价与结实之间的微妙界线上——可靠，但也仅止于某个程度，就像委托它的那个政府一样。
Modless and cold gray, this military-issue LMG is bereft of bells and whistles. It toes the line between cheaply and sturdily made. It’s reliable to a point, much like the government that commissioned it.

Cordan Relkul Lorhalien.name:
科丹·瑞尔库尔·洛尔哈利恩
Cordan Relkul Lorhalien

Text.text:
这位肤色如蜜的精灵把一头修长的绿发别到耳后，柔滑的发丝沿着背脊垂落。他披着一件由树叶缝缀而成的披肩，叶片的色泽与周遭林木相映成一。披肩之下，他的皮质护甲以繁复的铆钉线条牢牢固定——让护甲在胸腹处紧致而坚实，却为双臂留出更自在的移动空间；对吟游诗人而言，这至关重要。精灵垂下那双泛着幽绿光芒的眼睛，望向膝上的桑图尔琴；木质琴框呈沙漠岩石般的红褐色。他开始用两柄轻巧的小槌敲击一排排琴弦，清澈的旋律流淌而出，稳定而繁复，宛如潺潺溪水的絮语。

~ 由一位英雄扮演

The tan-skinned elf tucks his long green hair behind his ear, the flowing locks trailing down his back. He wears a mantle crafted of leaves sewn together, their hue reflecting that of the surrounding trees. Underneath, his leather armor is held fast with intricate lines of rivets. They keep the armor tight and sturdy on his torso, but allow for a freer movement of his arms—essential for a bard. The elf lowers his glowing green eyes to a santour in his lap, its wooden frame the red-brown of desert rock. He begins to tap two delicate hammers against the rows of strings, producing a tune as steady and complex as a babbling brook.

~ Played by a Hero

Ofsia, Large City On Island.name:
奥夫西亚，岛屿上的大城
Ofsia, Large City On Island

Text.text:
一座由石砌高楼与红陶瓦屋顶构成的巨城，沿着东部海岸高地拔地而起，又铺展到黑沙海滩之上。向南与向北，城市的高墙一路伸入海湾，环抱成港口；这些壁垒化作防波堤，收窄通往港内的航道，缺口处竖立着塔楼，既是瞭望点，也是灯塔。塔中安置着巨大的锁链，可升起将整座海湾的许可彻底封死。越过它们，宽阔的石质码头沿海岸延展开来；最大的码头旁矗立着起重机，从船上卸下货物，转而备运至滨水仓库。港内与港外的船只穿梭往返，如同码头区的人潮一般，来来去去，喧嚣不息。

~ Envisioned by Hivellios

A metropolis of stone and roofs of red-clay tile rises along the eastern coastal highlands and sprawls along beaches of black sand. To the south and north, the city’s high walls extend into the bay that forms its harbor. These barriers create breakwaters and narrow the passages into the port, with towers at the gaps acting as watchpoints and lighthouses. They house great chains that can be raised to block access to the bay altogether. Beyond them, great stone quays line the city’s seaside. Cranes stand alongside the largest, unloading cargo from ships, preparing them for transport to waterfront warehouses. Water vessels go to and fro in and around the harbor, much like the people in the quayside district.

~ Envisioned by Hivellios

Heroic Death Of A Sorcerous Sidekick.name:
一位法术随从的英勇之死
Heroic Death Of A Sorcerous Sidekick

Text.text:
敌人喘着粗气，得意地俯视脚边那位苍白却英勇的女术士；她仰躺在地，乌黑长发如睡梦般铺散开来。随后，那只胡须覆颚、下颌紧绷如铁的萨堤尔毅然冲向那名黑暗的爪牙。有那么一瞬间——在场任何人都看得见——整个世界都为这只萨堤尔屏住了呼吸。他带着对自身必死无疑的笃定向前，却也怀揣一线希冀：他已为伙伴争取到足够的时间，去救回那位女术士——他善良而最后的挚友。

~ 由 Godspice 构想

The enemy pants and gloats over the pale, valiant sorceress lying at its feet, her dark hair fanned out as if in sleep. Then, bearded jaw set bravely, the satyr launches himself at the agent of darkness. There is a moment—anyone present can see it—when the world holds its breath for the satyr. He moves with surety of his own demise but also with a look of hope that he has bought his companions time to save the sorceress, his good and final friend.

~ Envisioned by Godspice

Your Torch Goes Out.name:
你的火把熄灭了
Your Torch Goes Out

Text.text:
你那将熄的火把发出滋滋嘶响，在逼近的黑暗中回荡，光的庇护分分秒秒都在缩减。就像你的决心一样，最后的余烬颤颤闪烁，化作灰烬；火把燃尽，只剩你独自沉在阴影里。

~ 由 Dwayne 在 Discord 上 Envisioned

The sizzle of your dying torch hisses in the looming darkness, the safety of light dwindling by the moment. Like your resolve, the last embers flicker to ash as the torch is spent, leaving you alone in the shadows.

~ Envisioned by Dwayne on Discord

这柄引人注目的长枪，乌木般的枪杆沉入黑暗，与尖端耀眼的银辉形成鲜明对照。不知为何，深色木质仿佛将持用者周遭的光线尽数吞饮，而枪锋那银色的枪头却像自有力量般灼灼生辉。
The darkness of the ebon shaft contrasts sharply with the gleaming argent tip of this eye-catching lance. Somehow, the dark wood drinks in the ambient light of the wielder’s surroundings, while the silvery head at its point gleams as if under its own power.

Fake Boots Of Elevenkind.name:
伪造的精灵靴
Fake Boots Of Elevenkind

Text.text:
你把那双优雅刺绣的靴子拉到脚上，靴身由层层柔韧的翠绿皮革叠压成形。你轻快地踱步向前……可你每迈出一步，都会发出一声又响又尖的吱呀怪响。
You pull on the elegantly embroidered boots, formed from layers of supple green leather. You pad forward with a light gait… and every step you take makes a loud, squeaking sound.

Necromantic Flesh Mound.name:
死灵血肉丘
Necromantic Flesh Mound

Text.text:
死灵法术的气息几乎能从这团巨物上触手可及地逸散出来——那是一座臃肿的腐尸肉山，由层层溃烂的躯体与烂肉堆叠而成，有的还新鲜些；其中的脸孔时而从表面鼓起，探出一双双带着阴毒灵智的眼神，死死回望。它翻卷、挤压着前行，黏腻的吸扯与肢体拍击声抹黑了地面，蹒跚冲撞着一路逼近。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The vibe of necromancy drifts almost palpably off this mass—a hulking mountain of decomposing bodies and flesh, some fresher than others, the faces in it sometimes bulging from the surface and staring out with insidious sentience. It rolls and squashes, blotting the ground with suction and the slapping of limbs, lurching its way forward.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Elf Necromancer.name:
精灵死灵法师
Elf Necromancer

Text.text:
死亡对驾驭了它的人而言毫无可惧。那女人美得令人目眩，五官锋利而张扬，宛如一柄被诅咒的匕首。她那摄魂的黄色眼眸追随着你的一举一动，像蜘蛛凝视着蛛网里挣扎的昆虫；当她微笑时，你只觉一股不安沿着脊背轻柔而阴冷地爬升。她抬手一挥，便召来刺鼻的烟雾。旋涡般的瘴气里升起一颗咯咯怪笑的死亡骷髅头，端端正正落在她摊开的掌心；她随即发出一声低沉、轰鸣般的闷笑。
Death holds no fear for one who has mastered it. The woman is staggeringly beautiful, her features as sharp and bold as a cursed dagger. Her captivating yellow eyes follow your every move, like a spider watching a struggling insect in its web, and you feel a sense of unease creep delicately up your spine when she smiles. With a gesture, she conjures acrid smoke. A cackling death’s head rises from the swirling miasma to sit neatly in her outstretched palm as she lets out a low, rumbling chuckle.

Tiefling Innkeeper.name:
提夫林旅店老板
Tiefling Innkeeper

Text.text:
这名提夫林怎么看都不可能超过十来岁，可她却坐在你以为该由旅店老板坐的位置。她一只胳膊肘撑在吧台上，尖尖的下巴压在掌心里，透过垂落的长刘海阴郁地盯着你。另一只手则一言不发地指向一块黑板，上面写着：禁止施法。违者将被地狱火焚尽。
This tiefling can’t be more than a teenager, and yet she sits where you’d expect the innkeeper to be. Elbow on the bar and pointed chin pressed into the palm of her hand, she stares gloomily at you through long bangs. With her other hand she wordlessly points to a chalkboard upon which is written: No spells. Violators will be burned in hellfire.

一只修长的青铜色昆虫类生物窸窣爬入视野。它脸上挂着居高临下的神情，颚钳咔哒作响。前躯的四条几丁质手臂各自紧握着一根碳素长杖与一把能量手枪。分节的胸腹之间伸展着四对足，末端收束成一只令人不寒而栗的钳爪。生物天生披覆甲壳，却仍穿着一套特制连体制服，昭示着某种官僚职务。嵌接在制服头盔上的精密传感器阵列不断闪烁，吞吐着涌入的数据。强光似乎刺得它的眼睛发酸，它眯起眼，盯着那汹涌而来的信息洪流。
A long bronze insectoid skitters into view. It bears a superior look on its face, mandibles chattering. Its forebody grasps a carbon staff and an energy pistol in its four chitinous arms. Four pairs of legs sit aside a segmented thorax that ends in a nasty-looking pincer. The creature is naturally armored, yet wears a specially designed jumpsuit, indicating some bureaucratic position. A detailed sensor array grafted to the jumpsuit helmet flashes incoming data.  The creature’s eyes seem sensitive to the light as it squints at the flood of info.

高耸之城的支撑结构，是一块块巨大的雕凿石材，内部贯穿铁质加固——这等景象或许此生再难一见：一座活着的纪念碑，铭刻着生命战胜自然与命运摧残的胜利。仅仅想到数百万吨的石、砖、木——以及人畜——竟能以这种方式被长久托举，便令人心惊。而城市建筑议会的职责之一，便是裁定城中哪些地段是否还能承受扩建带来的重压。
The supports of the raised city are massive carved pieces of stone shot through with iron reinforcement, the likes of which might never be seen again: a living monument to life’s triumph over the ravages of nature and circumstance. The mere thought that the millions of tons of stone and brick and wood—and people and animals—could be indefinitely supported in this manner is staggering, and one of the duties of the city’s building council is to determine whether or not parts of town can handle the weight of expansion.

Archer Post In A Clearing.name:
林间空地的弓手哨所
Archer Post In A Clearing

Text.text:
高大的常青树向两侧分开，形成一片小小的空地，正中央矗立着一座敦实的塔楼。底座由灰浆与石块砌成，塔身则以木板围成，每处衔接都以粗壮圆木加固。塔顶向外收放成一座小平台，平台上站着一名弓手，箭已搭弦，正直指你们。
Great evergreens part to form a small clearing, revealing a stout tower standing in the center. Mortar and stone comprise the base, while wooden planks form the shaft with hefty logs at each joint. The top flares into a small platform, on top of which stands an archer with an arrow nocked and aimed directly at you.

Loot From An Orc.name:
兽人身上的战利品
Loot From An Orc

Text.text:
这个兽人攫到了一件相当耀眼的战利品：一颗被斩下的头颅，或许曾是卫兵队长，头上还端端正正戴着一顶精钢打造的上等头盔。兽人腰间挂着一只褪色的皮革挎包，你在里面摸到一团纠缠的金银链子——勋章、护符，以及其他项链，被胡乱地一股脑儿塞在一起。
This orc had gotten their claws on quite a trophy: the severed head of what could have been a guard captain, a fine steel helm still adorning her head. In a faded leather satchel on the orc’s hip, you find a tangle of gold and silver chains—medallions, talismans, and other necklaces haphazardly thrown together.

I Endure Vampire Thirst.name:
我忍受吸血鬼（特征）之渴
I Endure Vampire Thirst

Text.text:
我的腹中咕噜作响，哀鸣不止。我吸了口气，龇着牙从齿缝里嘶嘶吐出，身子猛地弯下。单膝跪地，我低声呻吟。我四下张望，睁大的眼睛急切搜寻，目光落在周围人们的颈侧。随后我缓缓起身，视线锁定其中一人，舔了舔嘴唇。我的胃又一次发出低沉的咆哮。
My abdomen gurgles and whines. I draw air, hissing through bared teeth, as I double over. Down on one knee, I groan. I cast about. My wide, searching eyes fall on the necks of those around me. Standing slowly, focused on one person, I lick my lips. My stomach growls again.

Thunderstorm From Outside.name:
来自外界的雷暴
Thunderstorm From Outside

Text.text:
被饱含雨水的乌云笼罩着，你始终睁大眼睛寻找合适的避身之所。可触可感的湿热里，你的衣服紧贴在皮肤上。可尽管你步履匆匆，远处浑厚的雷鸣却愈发逼近，每迈出一步，那如鼓点般的轰击便在频率上更添一分。闪电在地平线上撕裂长空。
Caught under dark clouds fat with rain, you have kept your eyes open for a suitable shelter.  Your clothes are plastered to your skin in the palpable humidity. Yet for all your haste, the sonorous boom of thunder in the distance grows ever closer, the percussive barrage increasing in frequency with every step. Lightning cracks across the horizon.

周遭地貌葱郁而瑰丽，却也冷酷严峻。空气里带着刺痛般的兴奋与期待。喧闹者的呼喊与荒野的嚎叫交织在一起——一场战争，一次狩猎，一席盛宴，或是三者皆有。
The surrounding landscape is lush and beautiful, but harsh. The air tingles with excitement, anticipation. The shouts of the boisterous mingle with the howls of the wild—a war, a hunt, a feast, or something involving all three.

更靠近冰山的那片湛蓝水色，到了开阔水域便愈发深沉，几近墨黑。这里没有浅滩。你意识到，无论冰层多么厚重，它也只是漂浮在无底的深渊之上。你只能想象在那刺骨的黑暗里会有什么东西得以存活——仿佛整整一个世界，都能潜藏在那下面。
The brilliant blue water nearer the icebergs deepens in hue to almost black in the open water. There are no shallows. You realize that, however thick the ice, it floats upon a fathomless depth. You can only imagine what might survive in that frigid darkness, but it seems a whole world could hide down there.

Rallying Speech By A General About War.name:
将军的战前动员演说
Rallying Speech By A General About War

Text.text:
“有人说战争即地狱。但当我看着你们所有人时，我看见的不是恶魔；我看见的是人。是那种只要能护住身旁的兄弟，便甘愿舍弃一切的人。是从平凡里被挑出来、被赐予证明勇武的机会，并且已经一百次证明了自己的人。我的兄弟们，地狱只属于败者——所以，就让这些狗娘养的去下地狱吧。”
“Some say war is hell. But when I look at all of you, I do not see demons; I see men. Men willing to sacrifice everything if it means protecting their brothers. Men plucked from the mundane and given a chance to prove their valor and who have done so a hundred times over. My brothers, war is only hell for those who lose, so let’s send these bastards to it.”

这条宽阔大道的鹅卵石被切割成便于铺设的体型，嵌在厚厚的灰浆里；它们已被年代磨得圆钝，却仍为穿越荒野的旅人带来难得的轻松。钉掌靴的脚步声、车轮的辘辘声与马蹄的脆响在路面上无休止地敲打回荡——白日行人络绎不绝，入夜之后也仍有不少赶路者来来往往。
Cut into manageable size and laid in thick mortar, the cobblestones of this broad road have been worn down by age but still offer a welcome respite from traveling cross-country. The sound of footsteps of hobnailed boots, cart wheels, and horses’ hooves clacks ceaselessly along the thoroughfare, traveled all the long day and a fair amount after nightfall as well.

Home Of A Goddess Of Elemental Air.name:
元素空气女神的居所
Home Of A Goddess Of Elemental Air

Text.text:
无处不在，女神的家是一片氛围，是庇护的天空，是屏息的权势穹顶。她之外是死亡，是虚无；而她无论风暴或宁静，都穿行于一切次元。她住在那只翠鸟掠过河面时的振翅里，住在一团苍蝇的嗡鸣里，住在船长的吼声里，住在恋人的叹息里，住在鱼吐出的泡泡所说的话里。她栖身于飓风。你在何处，她便在何处。当你将她驱逐，她便把秋叶送到你寂静的床边。
Omnipresent, the home of the goddess is an atmosphere, the sheltering sky, the dome of dominion holding its breath. Beyond her is death, the void, but she flies through all dimensions in tempest or tranquility. She lives in that kingfisher flying the river, in a cluster of flies, the shout of a captain, the sigh of a lover, the bubble spoken by a fish. She inhabits a hurricane. She exists where you exist. When you cast her out, she carries autumn leaves to your quiet bed.

Beholder In The Ruins.name:
废墟中的眼魔
Beholder In The Ruins

Text.text:
在尘土飞扬的漆黑与断裂的灰墙乱象之中，在这片冥界般的幽幽火炬与水光倒影的微明里，你看见一抹突兀而骇人的色彩猛然炸开。它悬浮在城市废墟之上，一只湿漉漉的眼睛在癫狂中发亮，俯视着一张扭曲的笑——百枚獠牙森然外露——两者都镶嵌在一团令人作呕的紫瘀色肉囊里，脂与肌纠结鼓动。触手起伏穿梭，如拳手般左右试探，每条末端都长着一只眼，先盯向这边，又猛地转向那边。

~ 由 TheLionKnight

In the mess of dusty blackness and broken gray walls, in the low light of this underworld’s haunting torches and watery reflections, you see a sudden and hideous splash of color. It hovers over the city ruins, one wet eye shining with insanity above a grimacing smile of a hundred fangs—both embedded in a sickening purplish bulb of fat and muscle. Tentacles bob and weave like boxers, each with an eye at the end, staring first this way then that.

~ Envisioned by TheLionKnight

Spider Portal Opens.name:
蛛网之门开启
Spider Portal Opens

Text.text:
卓尔的头颅从传送门中探出，发丝在气流里翻卷，冷笑钉在你们身上。纤瘦的上身随之滑出，覆着银亮的鳞甲，手中握着形貌阴毒的长剑。接着，两名士兵的休息部分也完全现身：两个鼓胀的腹部，覆着刺硬的茸毛，连着八条棱角分明、悄然爬行的长腿。它们身后，仿佛由它们牵引的战车驾者，一位主母身着轻纱般的白裙，手执同样令人胆寒的利刃。她的面容高贵而可怖，下令发动突袭，利落高效地撕开你们的防线。

~ Envisioned by I_drink_tea

Drow heads appear in the portal, hair blowing and sneers fixed on the party. Thin torsos follow, plated in silvery scale, their hands bearing wicked-looking swords. Then the rest of the two soldiers emerges: two bulbous abdomens, prickly with fur, attached to eight angular, creeping legs. Behind them, as if the rider of a chariot pulled by them, a matron mother wears a gossamer white gown and carries an equally menacing sword. Her face is regal, horrible, and she commands an assault that efficiently cuts through your defenses.

~ Envisioned by I_drink_tea

骏马一身乌黑亮泽的鬃毛在舔舐其蹄、鬃、尾的炽红烈焰映照下熠熠生辉；它的双眼也燃着同样的火光。生物奔腾向前，身后拖出一条闷燃的焦痕，而它口中逸出的嘶鸣，则带着异界般的回响。
The sleek, jet black hair of the horse shines in the red-hot glow of the flames licking at its hooves, mane, and tail; its eyes burn with a similar fire. The creature leaves a smoldering trail in its wake as it gallops forward, and from its mouth comes an otherworldly whinny.

Corpse In Vampire's Wine Cellar.name:
吸血鬼酒窖中的尸体
Corpse In Vampire's Wine Cellar

Text.text:
当你完成下行，踏入地窖那清冷、死寂的空气时，血液在血管里瞬间凝固——你看见一张熟悉的脸，像挂在肉柜里的肉一样被吊着。尽管他布满皱纹的面孔僵成一副惊恐的痉挛表情，你仍一眼认得出那位脾气暴躁的旧书店老板。他那副金边眼镜依旧架在鼻梁上，正如每一次他站在滚梯上俯视你时那样，孩子气地咂嘴、带着不耐烦的训斥。

~ Envisioned by thebigham on Discord

The blood freezes in your veins as you complete your descent into the cool, still air of the cellar and see a familiar face—hanging like meat in a larder. Though his wrinkled face is frozen in a rictus of terror you would recognize the ornery bookstore owner anywhere. His gold-rimmed spectacles are still perched on the bridge of his nose, as they were each time he looked down at you from his rolling ladder, tutting petulantly.

~ Envisioned by thebigham on Discord

咒语的字句从你唇间滴落——有的甜如蜜，有的苦如胆。你在空中旋动双手，仿佛要将它们搅和在一起，因为爱与恨本是一枚硬币的两面——如同磁石的两极，既能相斥，也能相吸。你凝神锁定你的目标，选择你法术磁性的指向。
The words of the incantation drip from your lips—some like honey, some like gall. You swirl your hands in the air as though to mix them, for love and hate are two sides of the same coin—the poles of a magnet, with the power to repel or attract. Focusing on your target, you choose the alignment of your spell’s magnetism.

Ogre Rushes Into Combat.name:
食人魔猛冲入战场
Ogre Rushes Into Combat

Text.text:
你刚一转过拐角，一双细小、布满血丝的眼睛便与你对上。那庞然巨物从佝偻中直起身来，连你们之中最高大的也被它衬得渺小。它一把抄起巨斧，仰头咆哮，黄牙间飞溅出点点唾沫。它踏地如雷的脚步声在你脑海里轰鸣回荡，转瞬间便朝你猛扑而来。
Beady, bloodshot eyes meet yours as you turn the corner. The immense being rises from their slouch, dwarfing even the largest among you. Grabbing their axe, they roar, flecks of spit flying off of yellowed teeth. Their thunderous footfalls echo in your mind as they hurtle toward you.

Ivory Goats Figurine Of Wondrous Power.name:
奇物威能之象牙山羊雕像
Ivory Goats Figurine Of Wondrous Power

Text.text:
三只山羊以乳白色象牙精雕而成，彼此叠立成一座自立的小塔，体型由大到小，宛如一套套娃，最小的一只稳稳立在最顶端。小羊的角最短，胡须掩映的面庞带着慈和的神情。中间那只羊的角更长，形如匕首般锐利。最下方的那只羊若按其真实体型呈现，必将令人望而生畏。它的长角在头后盘旋回卷，如同螺旋钻般扭转；躯体披覆厚密长毛，仿佛天生为攀越高耸雪峰而生；眼眶处细小的凹痕收束成狭窄的怒目，透出暴烈的凶意。
Three goats carved in cream-colored ivory free-stand atop each other, their size ranging from large to small like a set of nesting dolls, with the smallest goat on top. The small one has the shortest horns and a kindly expression on its bearded face. The middle goat has longer horns, daggerlike in their shape. The last goat would be a fearsome creature to behold at its true size. Its long horns curl back in a corkscrew behind its head, its body thick with fur fit for scaling tall mountain peaks, and the small indents of its eyes narrow into a furious expression.

在收获季的苛求压得人喘不过气、而初雪一落便让旅行变得不再可能之前，王国里最后几场比武大会——规模更小，也许也没那么耀眼——已被纵情享乐的贵族用粉笔写进日程。侍从们抓住最后的机会投身混战；或是他们慷慨的领主赏他们用练习长枪上场试刺。骑士们看上去更为急切，饥渴地追逐财富与荣耀，只盼在下一个生日来临前攫取到手。看台后方，凛冽空气里已缠上冬季的暗示，一名廷臣为一位年轻的女男爵披上一条毛皮披肩。
Before the harvest’s demands are too many and travel becomes unlikely with the first snow, the last tournaments of the realm—smaller and perhaps less impressive—are chalked into the calendars of indulgent nobles. Squires take their last chances at the melee, or their generous lords let them tilt with practice lances. The knights look more desperate, hungry for fortune and glory before another birthday. Behind the stands, in the crisp air laced with winter’s insinuation, a courtier presents a young baroness with a stole.

Gilderim Lokhar.name:
吉尔德里姆·洛哈尔
Gilderim Lokhar

Text.text:
一位高挑俊朗的中年男人仅凭存在便引人注目。他的黑发柔顺成波，垂落得恰到好处；深色长袍一尘不染，仿佛从未沾过真正的磨损与风霜。腰间悬着一支精致的樱桃木短笛。他用手帕擦拭自己的印戒，尽管那枚金戒本就亮得无可挑剔。待同僚走近，他便赐予对方一抹魅力逼人的微笑，灼亮得几乎要发光。

~ Played by PCZ with

A tall, handsome middle-aged man draws attention by his mere presence. His black hair falls in graceful waves, and his dark robe is pristine—it seems a stranger to any real wear and tear. A fine cherry-wood piccolo hangs from his belt. He polishes his signet ring with a handkerchief, though the gold could hardly shine brighter. When a colleague approaches, he bestows upon them a smile so charming it’s practically incandescent.

~ Played by PCZ with

Aldeyr Valeth.name:
阿尔德伊尔·瓦莱斯
Aldeyr Valeth

Text.text:
这名肤色苍白、金发的精灵身着宽松的黑色长袍与长裤，边缘缀着蓝色镶边，外披一件棕色无袖外衣。他看起来年纪尚轻，身形修长轻盈、柔韧如柳。然而他的左手却呈灰败枯槁之色，干瘪如骨，紧攥着一本蓝黑色的书册——铁箍装订，其上点缀着恶魔般的狰狞饰纹。右肩斜挎着一只黑皮挎包，仿佛正为那本书量身定做。它的左眼似乎比眼眶还要大，眼中唯有布满血丝的静脉作为颜色，与另一只天然的蓝眼形成骇人的对照。精灵左颊上有一道印记，形似一条蛇盘绕着一簇火焰。他神情冷漠，却坚硬不屈，阴沉肃厉。

~ Played by Procyon

This pale, blond elf dresses in loose black robes and pants with blue trim and a brown, sleeveless coat. He seems young, with a willowy and lithe figure. His left hand, however, is gray and withered, skeletal, clutching a blue-black book bound in iron with fiendish embellishments. A satchel of black leather slung on his right shoulder seems fitted to the tome. His left eye seems too large for the socket and has only bloodshot veins for color, a grisly partner for its natural blue counterpart. On the elf’s left cheek is a mark, appearing much like a snake coiled around a flame. His look is impassive, yet unyielding and grim.

~ Played by Procyon

那位饱经风霜的老水手拄着木腿，咚咚踏过码头巡查，手里还握着一柄象征职权的装饰船桨作支撑。船桨被打磨得光可鉴人，桨叶上半浮雕般刻着一幕：一艘帆船迎着惊涛骇浪，乘风破浪于碎裂轰鸣的海面之上。
The grizzled old seadog stumps along the pier on a pegleg, aided in his patrol by an ornamental oar of office. The oar has been polished to a glistening sheen, and its paddle has been half-carved with the scene of a sailing ship riding the waves of a crashing sea.

Cultists Summoning Dragon Queen.name:
邪教徒召唤龙后
Cultists Summoning Dragon Queen

Text.text:
锈红色的岩石构成这座穹顶般空旷的殿室，粗砺的地面上刻着一枚星状符号——五道对称相连的利爪，彼此咬合成阵。每一处弯钩尖端都立着一名光头法师，猩红长袍裹身如血瀑垂落。中央，一名身披黑衣的高大身影被另外四人环绕。那人戴着有角的面具，赤龙之貌在符号涌出的银色能量纹路中被照亮——光线沿着刻痕奔流，如水波般震颤。每一道发光的线穿过爪尖的法师时，都会从银色变作黑、蓝、绿、红或白，继而射向头顶漂浮的五座石台——石台也各自浸染成同样的色泽。雷霆炸裂，一道裂口在悬浮石台下方的空气中被生生撕开。裂口彼端的烟雾黑暗里，五对巨大燃烧的眼睛正冷冷回望。

~ 由 DM Shorty Envisioned

Rust-colored stone makes up this cavernous, domed chamber, and a starlike symbol comprising five symmetrical, adjoining claws etches the rough floor. At the tip of each curved point stands a bald wizard swathed in scarlet robes. Four more encircle a tall figure in black at the center. That person wears a horned mask, the visage of a red dragon, illuminated by lines of silvery energy rippling from the symbol. Each glowing line changes color from silver to black, blue, green, red, or white as it passes through a mage at a claw point, then to one of five identically hued stone platforms floating overhead. With a crack of thunder, a hole tears through the air just below the hovering stones. Five pairs of enormous, burning eyes stare from the smoky darkness beyond the opening.

~ Envisioned by DM Shorty

Tax Collector's Office.name:
税务征收官署
Tax Collector's Office

Text.text:
这栋建筑看上去像银行一样戒备森严，又像城堡一般固若金汤——考虑到里面那位主人的官职，这也再合理不过。门口的守卫——毫无疑问训练有素、薪酬丰厚——朝你这边阴沉地瞥了一眼，便继续扫视区域。不过，他们的安保也并非无懈可击……
The building looks as secure as a bank, and as fortified as a castle, but that only makes sense given the office held by its occupant. Guards at the door—no doubt well-trained and handsomely paid—glower briefly in your direction before continuing to scan the area. Still, their security isn’t perfect…

Space Pirate Flagship: Captain’s Quarter.name:
空间海盗旗舰：船长舱室
Space Pirate Flagship: Captain’s Quarters

Text.text:
这间舱室坐落在这般见不得光的地方，却意外地维护得一尘不染。房间中央的大桌上摊开着星图，墙边一排排武器整齐地挂在架上。空间里最醒目的是一张巨大而奢华的床榻，空气沉重黏稠，弥漫着麻醉品、烟草与烈酒混杂的辛辣浊雾。
The cabin is remarkably well kept given its unscrupulous location. Star charts have been spread over a large table in the room’s center, and weapons in ordered racks line the walls. A huge, opulent bed dominates the space, and the air is thick with the acrid miasma of narcotics, tobacco, and alcohol.

Phylactery Of A Green Lich.name:
绿巫妖的命匣
Phylactery Of A Green Lich

Text.text:
在一片覆霜的地面中央，矗立着一株扇叶棕榈，明亮如盛夏——那正是巫妖的命匣。它的根部有一道幽暗的开口，而在开口拱影下的地面上，静静躺着一枚种子，体型足有骑士头盔般大。
In the midst of a frosty patch of ground is a fan-leafed palm tree, bright as summer—the lich’s phylactery. It has a dark opening at the base, and on the ground, under the opening’s arch, rests a seed the size of a knight’s helmet.

Elemental Storm Snake Awakened By Ritual.name:
由仪式唤醒的元素风暴巨蛇
Elemental Storm Snake Awakened By Ritual

Text.text:
在灯塔信标的废墟里，你发现一名男子正高声吟诵咒语。他双臂高举，指向暴风翻涌的天空；他那嘶哑破碎的嗓音竟压过了风的怒嚎。雨点鞭打着他的脸，狂风撕扯着他的长袍，他却毫不退缩。咒语落下的瞬间，一道闪电把世界染成惨白。风暴的嚎叫扭曲成野兽般尖利的厉啸。头顶的云层翻滚得毫无常理，黑与灰的触须纠缠变形，拉伸成一条修长的蛇形巨影。你又听见那声尖啸——那条蛇状云团的前端裂开一张巨口，鳞片如沙漠玻璃般冷硬透亮。闪电像指爪般沿着它的躯体跳舞，它在风暴中穿梭盘旋，咆哮与雷霆的轰鸣同拍共振。

~ Envisioned by gingerbeard

In the ruin of the lighthouse beacon, you find a man shouting an incantation. His arms are flung up toward the storming sky, and his ragged voice triumphs over the howl of the wind. Rain batters his face and the gale tears at his robes, but he is not deterred. As his incantation ends, a flash of lightning turns the world white. The howling of the storm morphs into a bestial, piercing shriek. The clouds above roil beyond natural reason, tendrils of black and gray warping into a long, serpentine figure. You hear the shriek again as a maw forms at the head of this snakelike mass with scales like desert glass. Fingers of lightning dance along its body as it weaves through the storm, its roars in time with the crashes of thunder.

~ Envisioned by gingerbeard

Emerging From Underwater In A Cave Passa.name:
从水下浮出，进入洞穴通道
Emerging From Underwater In A Cave Passage

Text.text:
当你沿着洞穴地面前行、脑袋破水而出时，水流从你的耳畔与鼻孔滑过。与那条水路相比，即便这地底令人窒闷的空气，也显得清冽而凉爽。
Water streams over your ears and nostrils as your head breaks the water’s surface while you traverse the cave floor. Even the stifling underground air feels brisk and fresh, compared to the aqueous passage.

Naezeiros, The Scarred.name:
纳埃泽洛斯，伤痕者
Naezeiros, The Scarred

Text.text:
一件华丽的翠绿紧身上衣包裹着这名萨堤尔——如果他真是萨堤尔的话——纤细的躯干与大腿上部。两支小角自他头顶突起；它们与尖耳一道，从一张扭曲、熏黑的木制面具边缘探出，而面具向外延展成鹿角。类似树皮的增生物覆满他的皮肤，前臂处尤为尖刺，一路蔓延至分蹄。那人倚着一根晶莹的法杖，杖身缀满槲寄生；左手则召出火焰，让它在指间滚动流转。忽明忽暗的火光在面具下的幽暗眼眸里闪烁。

~ Played by Alex with

An ornate green doublet covers the slender torso and upper legs of this satyr, if a satyr he is. Two small horns jut from his head—these and his pointed ears poke beyond the rim of a mask of twisted, darkened wood that widens into antlers. Similar barklike growths, spiky on his forearms, cover his skin down to his cloven hooves. He leans on a crystalline staff festooned with mistletoe, and in his left hand, he calls forth fire, rolling it across his fingers. The intermittent light glitters on the dark eyes under his mask.

~ Played by Alex with

Spirit Of Athena Promechos Appears.name:
雅典娜·普罗马科斯之灵现身
Spirit Of Athena Promechos Appears

Text.text:
基座仿佛被热浪裹住般微微摇曳闪烁。石缝间涌现出白与金的魔法微尘，缓缓升入天穹，在离地三十英尺处聚合成一枚燃烧、迸溅火星的光点。它骤然灼亮到刺痛双眼，随即如瀑倾落回基座，勾勒出一名披袍女子的巨影——头盔高耸，战羽如烈焰般飞扬。
The base shimmers as if caught in a wave of heat. Motes of white and gold magic appear in the cracks in the stone and float into the sky to coalesce into a burning, sparking point thirty feet in the air. They blister bright then cascade back down to the base, creating the giant silhouette of a robed woman, helmed with a plume of war.

一直延伸到林线的尽头，沼泽的泥淖裹挟着无尽新生与腐朽交替的气息。人们若有余力，便会踏入这片不宜久留的地形去采掘泥炭——那是腐烂植物堆积而成的物质，既是上佳燃料，也蕴藏着农耕所需的珍贵养分。
Stretching out to the very edge of the tree line, the mire of the bog holds the scent of endless renewal and decay. When able, people venture out into the inhospitable terrain to harvest peat, the decayed plant matter making an ideal fuel as well as containing precious nutrients for farming.

I Recognize The Signs Of Fishfolk.name:
我认得鱼人族的征兆
I Recognize The Signs Of Fishfolk

Text.text:
这片区域每一寸都黏着一股无法错认的腥臭味，已足够说明一切——而鱼人四处游荡的其他痕迹也同样昭然。泥地里压出的足迹像青蛙的脚掌，细长的趾间牵着薄薄的蹼。我还看见几片蜕落的鳞片混在泥浆里，原本的光泽几乎被污泥吞没。确实是鱼人无疑，但究竟是什么让它们以这种方式脱落鳞片？
The unmistakable odor clinging to every inch of the area tells me all I need to know, though other signs of roaming fishfolk make themselves known as well. The tracks impressed into the mud recall the look of frogs’ feet, webbing lacing between each elongated toe. I notice a few molted scales mingling with the mud, their shine nearly lost in the muck. These are fishfolk, indeed, but what could have caused them to shed their scales in such a manner?

Insult About Your Father And Uncle.name:
侮辱你的父亲和叔叔
Insult About Your Father And Uncle

Text.text:
“告诉我，得知你父亲和你叔叔其实是同一个人时，会不会很尴尬？还是你就那么坦然地接受了？”
“Tell me, was it awkward learning your father and uncle were the same person, or did you take it in stride?”

Ray Spell Misses.name:
射线法术未命中
Ray Spell Misses

Text.text:
你在施法的那一刻就感觉到了——那点挥之不去的疑虑。引导手的中指与无名指本该再弯一些。负责放出光束的食指在释放咒词出口时微微一抖。魔法沿着你的手奔涌，却在指甲边缘刺痛，仿佛导师在惩戒你的失败。它嘶嘶掠过你的目标，毫发无伤、徒劳无功，还顺带带走了一截你的力气。
You feel it when you make the cast—that little nagging doubt. The middle two fingers of your guiding hand should be bent more. The index finger firing the ray flicks a little on the release word. Magic courses through your hand but stings your fingernail, like a teacher disciplining your failure. It hisses by your target harmlessly, uselessly, and takes a measure of your energy with it.

Faerie Plane Penetrates The Shadow Plane.name:
妖精位面贯穿暗影位面
Faerie Plane Penetrates The Shadow Plane

Text.text:
起初，这光芒刺眼，在这最纯粹的黑影之境里几乎令人失明；可很快，它便沉淀为柔和而弥散的光辉，洒下温热。单调的地貌逐渐染上色彩——先是低饱和的浅淡，继而变得明丽：葱郁的绿色取代灰败，开花的枝桠替换枯槁的树干。黑暗仿佛在这新生之光面前退缩，这光对它而言陌生而不可知，却仍不断向外扩展。苔藓破土而出，吞没尘土与灰烬；光芒升向天穹，拨开那层顽固而阴郁的云幕。
The light is harsh at first, blinding in this place of purest shadow, but it soon settles into a pleasant, diffuse glow, shedding warmth. The monotone landscape takes on color—at first muted, then lovely, as verdant green replaces gray, as blossoming boughs replace withered trees. The darkness seems to shrink from this newfound light, alien and unknown, as it spreads outward. Moss springs up, enveloping the dust and ash, as the light rises to the sky to part the persistent, dreary canopy of clouds.

Self-propelled Combat Wheelchair.name:
自走式战斗轮椅
Self-propelled Combat Wheelchair

Text.text:
这把椅子深藏在经过改造的板甲之中，几乎叫人难以窥见其内。甲面将日月之光折成银白的迸闪。背部的甲片向上隆起，汇成一顶头盔，弯曲如马首般覆在乘坐者上方。车轮几乎不从护甲下探出，只在边缘露出些许，并锻接了带铆钉的皮条以增摩抓地。显而易见，这辆轮椅能将使用者护佑于最凶险的伤害之外。

~ 构想：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The chair is hard to spy inside the modified plate armor that contains it. It reflects the sun and moon in silvery flares. On the back, the plating rises to a helmet curving like a horse’s head over the occupant. The wheels barely emerge from the armor, with strips of studded leather forged to them for traction. It is clear that this wheelchair protects its user from the greatest of harms.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Sergeant Of The Guard.name:
卫队军士
Sergeant Of The Guard

Text.text:
尽管他们的制服与下属同色，但军士那股近乎王者的仪态、胸前闪亮的徽章，以及一柄精良的长剑，仍让他们鹤立鸡群。他们身形高大魁梧，钢制肩甲覆在精心上油的锁子甲与煮制皮革之上。城市的纹章醒目地烙印在护甲上，而他们举手投足间都带着不容置疑的威严。
Though their uniform is of the same color as their inferiors, the sergeant's regal bearing and gleaming badge, along with their fine longsword, distinguishes them. They stand tall, broad, with steel pauldrons over finely oiled chain and boiled leather. The crest of the city emblazons the armor, and they hold themselves with an air of authority.

Woman Going Into Labor.name:
分娩在即的女人
Woman Going Into Labor

Text.text:
她一声痛呼，一只手死死按着腰骶，另一只手托着隆起的腹部。眉间沁满冷汗，牙关紧咬，她阖上双眼，深深吸气吐息；每一次叹息都像把疼痛一点点挤出去。衣料之下，她的双腿已然湿透。

~ Envisioned by Justin M

She cries out, one hand pressed against her lower back and the other cradling her rounded stomach. Brow beaded with sweat, teeth gritted, she closes her eyes and breathes deeply, her pain eking out a bit with each sigh. Through her clothes, her legs are visibly wet.
