~ Envisioned by Justin M

幽冥风铃般的叮当声回荡，幻影之躯列队踏过堤道行进。队首是一名上身为人类男子、下身为巨蛇的存在。他转向追随者，张开双臂如迎宾般敞怀相邀。可骤然间，所有人齐齐抬头望去。尖叫声四起，众人四散奔逃，神殿的光线倏然黯淡，幻象随之崩裂。
Spectral chimes ring as phantasmal forms march across the causeway. At the lead is a being with the upper body of a human man and the lower body of a great snake. He turns to his followers, arms spread in welcome. But abruptly, everyone looks upward. They scream and scatter as the temple darkens and the illusion breaks.

Dying Star Explodes.name:
濒死之星爆裂
Dying Star Explodes

Text.text:
星光忽明忽暗，巨大的碎块从本体上崩裂，缓缓漂离。过了一段时代，整颗天体骤然炽亮——像最后的告别——随即轰然爆裂。原本恒定的单色被七彩虹光取代，后方紧追着的是仍在闷燃的星体表层残片，拖曳出灼烫的光痕。
The light of the star flickers as massive chunks break off and drift away. After some time, the entire celestial body flares brightly—a final farewell—before bursting apart. The single constant color is replaced by a rainbow of multicolored light being chased by smoldering slabs of the star's surface.

Alien Communication Log.name:
异星通讯记录
Alien Communication Log

Text.text:
这东西完全不像你见过的任何通讯记录。确实有一块按键板，却找不到任何可辨识的符号。有些结构看着眼熟——通讯天线、输入屏幕——但底座上还攀着一团绿色的生长物，仿佛是为……某种用途而生。你一靠近，屏幕上便闪过诡异的标记：弯曲的线条与点阵。那无疑是一种语言，或许也是某种代码，却彻底无法解读。
It isn’t like any communication log you’ve seen before. There’s a keypad, yes, but no recognizable symbols. Some features seem familiar—comms antenna, input screen—but there’s also a green growth at the base meant for… something. As you near, odd markings flash across the screen: curved lines and dots. It’s surely a language, or perhaps a code, but it’s utterly unintelligible.

Entering The Anomalous Void.name:
踏入「异变虚空」
Entering The Anomalous Void

Text.text:
洋红能量的旋涡传送门随一道不可知的宇宙心跳起伏脉动，粉、红、紫的色泽交替闪烁。死寂世界的碎片漂浮在裂口周围，被它顽固的引力牢牢困住；当你逐渐向传送门漂去，一阵缓慢蔓延的麻木渗入四肢百骸。中心处，一片黑色虚空——空洞得如同巫妖的灵魂——正无声凝视着你。群星之间的黑暗。

~ 构想：Rekksos

The swirling portal of magenta energy pulses in time to an unfathomable cosmic heartbeat, flashing through hues of pink, red, and purple. Fragments of dead worlds float around the aperture, trapped by its intractable pull, and a creeping numbness fills your body as you drift closer to the portal. A black void—hollow as a lich’s soul—stares out at you from its center. The darkness between the stars.

~ Envisioned by Rekksos

Yohan Feathergust.name:
约翰·羽风疾响
Yohan Feathergust

Text.text:
从一幢富宅的阴影里，踱出一位放荡不羁的半精灵；他漫不经心地调了调一只造型繁复的护臂，年轻的面容上挂着心满意足的坏笑，亮绿的眼睛里满是戏谑的欢意。他把一头飘逸的白发随手拢起扎成顶髻，又揉了揉额头上的一道疤，接着去摆弄那条乱糟糟的腰带——匕首、弩与好几个小袋子被他来回挪了好几次——随后将一只大麻袋甩上皮甲包裹的背脊。口哨吹着轻快的小调，他大摇大摆朝贫民区走去，途中还停了停，随手将一把钱币赏给了一个乞丐。

~ Played by Ararion

From the shadow of a wealthy house strolls a rakish half-elf nonchalantly adjusting an intricate-looking bracer, a satisfied smirk gracing his youthful features and bright green eyes full of mirth. He tugs his flowing white hair into a topknot and rubs a scar upon his brow, then adjusts his cluttered belt—shifting daggers, crossbow, and multiple pouches several times—before heaving a large sack to his leather-clad back. Whistling a jaunty tune, he saunters in the direction of the poor quarter, stopping briefly to gift a beggar with a handful of coins.

~ Played by Ararion

Avernus, The First Circle Of Hell.name:
阿弗纳斯，地狱的第一层
Avernus, The First Circle Of Hell

Text.text:
在一片幽深的黑森林里，古老树木下方的漆黑甬道旁，野兽的影子与窸窣声如低语掠过。黑暗中矗立着一座石门，拱顶刻着一句话：入此者，弃绝一切希望。越过石门，游荡着那些生前从未献身于任何事业的迷失灵魂。黄蜂叮刺他们，溃疮汩汩渗出脓液。他们徘徊在阿刻戎河的岸边，为自己永恒的反复无常哀号悲泣，既被正义之神祇诅咒，也被腐化之神祇怜悯。

~ 扮演：Jenzelta

Deep in a dark forest, the shadows and rustlings of wild animals whisper past a black passage under ancient trees. In the darkness is a gate of stone, engraved on its arch with the words: Abandon all hope, ye who enter here. Beyond the gate wander the lost souls who committed to no cause in life. They are stung by wasps, their sores oozing. They wander the bank of the River Acheron, wailing in sorrow over their eternal inconstancy, both damned and pitied by the gods of justice—and of corruption.

~ Played by Jenzelta

I Put On My Leather Knee Brace.name:
我戴上了皮革护膝
I Put On My Leather Knee Brace

Text.text:
像一位老友般，贴合我膝盖曲线的护具把一切稳稳固定住。我能感觉到支架里添上的骨般坚实的力量，也能感觉到织物中增补的软骨般柔韧的支撑。我的膝盖平日总是摇摇欲坠，刺痛与摩擦作响不止，如今却像被注入了底气。我把它束紧，屈伸腿部，然后站起。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，出自 Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Like an old friend, the brace shaped to my knee keeps it all in place. I feel the strength of added bone in its supports, added cartilage in its fabric. My knee, normally precarious and full of sting and grinding, now feels empowered. I cinch it up snug, flex my leg, and stand.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Banishing A Spirit.name:
放逐灵体
Banishing A Spirit

Text.text:
你抬手画出一个流畅而缓慢的圆，目光紧锁着那灵体在放逐之力下扭曲挣扎。幽影般的锁链缠绕上去，彻底阻断了它的移动。它开始随着你手势的轨迹旋转——起初迟缓，继而愈发迅疾，直至化作一团模糊的残影。灵体正在衰退，层层折叠，回卷进它来时的维度。伴着一声刺耳尖啸，它倏然消散，空气里随之弥漫起浓烈的硫磺气息。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

You swirl your hand in a smooth, slow circle, watching the spirit writhe and struggle against the banishment. Ghostly chains encircle the spirit and cease its movement. It begins to rotate in alignment with your hand, slow at first, then faster, until it is naught but a blur. The spirit is diminishing, folding back into the dimension from whence it came. As it disappears with a screech, the smell of brimstone fills the air.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Barkskin Cast By An Evil Druid.name:
由邪恶德鲁伊施放的树肤术
Barkskin Cast By An Evil Druid

Text.text:
他手中的树皮噼啪迸火，闷燃发红，转眼便被吞噬殆尽。焦灼的炭烟味刚一散去，细小的幼苗便从他的手臂、面庞以及全身每一寸肌肤上破体而出，随即又被疯长的、覆满青苔的厚重树皮迅速取代。
The bark in the figure's hand sparks, smolders, and is quickly consumed. The odor of char clears as tiny seedlings sprout from his arms, face, and every other inch of his body, to be replaced just as quickly by an overgrown, mossy bark.

Loot From An Atomy.name:
来自原子人的战利品
Loot From An Atomy

Text.text:
原子小精灵那把量身打造的枝弓断裂着，躺在他们毫无生气的躯体旁。这个小小的妖精把一枚人形戒指当作脚环佩戴——精雕细作的金环宛如盘旋的藤蔓，其间镶着五枚祖母绿，切割成叶片的形状。
The atomy’s bespoke twig-bow lies snapped beside their inert body. The tiny fey wears a humanoid ring as an anklet, gold finely wrought to resemble a curling vine, with five emeralds cut in the shape of leaves.

Quip About A Puzzle.name:
关于谜题的俏皮话
Quip About A Puzzle

Text.text:
“哦，我懂了——就像个谜题！只不过每一块拼图都锋利得像刀口，而且要是你没在时代内拼完，它就会要了你的命。”
“Oh, I get it—it’s like a puzzle! One where all the pieces have sharp edges and if you don’t finish in time, it kills you.”

卫兵比大多数人都要高大，站姿比寻常的街头打手更挺拔、更僵硬。你注意到那身护甲的做工、钢铁的冷光，以及披风上细密的金银丝绣：王室卫队，专为贵族效命。他们自带一种庄严而不容置疑的威仪，即便一动不动地守在原地好几个小时，也毫不减损——戴着铠手套的手正“休息”在腰侧那柄精致佩剑的剑柄上。他们看你的目光里有种与生俱来的戒心，像是多年当差淬炼出的本能；眉头紧锁，眼神阴沉逼人。

~ Envisioned by Will Blackburn

The guard stands taller than most, more upright and rigid in their stance than a typical street enforcer. You note the quality of armor, the gleam of the steel, the filigree stitched into their cloak: a royal guard, one assigned to the nobility. They hold themselves with an air of regal importance, even as they stand in one spot for hours on end, gauntleted hand resting on the pommel of the fine blade sheathed at their hip. They regard you with an innate suspicion bred from years on the job, brow furrowed, eyes glowering.

~ Envisioned by Will Blackburn

Black Gauntlet Of Bane.name:
班恩的黑铁护手
Black Gauntlet Of Bane

Text.text:
一股可触的恐惧气息先行而至，那披着漆黑铠甲的身影大步向你逼近，油腻的黑发紧贴着它被摧残得面目全非的脸。一阵恶臭的风扯动它身上浸透鲜血的罩袍，袍上烙印的黑手仿佛自有生命般微微抽搐。战士举起一柄令人作呕的钉头锤，发出咆哮般的挑战，随即猛冲而来。
A palpable aura of terror precedes the dark armored figure striding toward you, greasy black hair plastered to its ravaged face. A foul wind tugs at the blood-drenched tabard it sports, the black hand emblazoned upon it seeming to twitch with a life of its own. Raising a foul-looking mace, the warrior screams a challenge and charges.

男人拼命用身体护住女儿，却被帮派里两名壮汉猛地掀翻到一旁。第三个人塞住他的嘴，随后对他一通狠揍，拳脚如雨般落下。一个身姿矫健的女人迈步上前，身穿铆钉皮护甲，蹲在抽噎的孩子旁，轻轻抬起女孩的下巴。 “哦对，就是她。”掠夺者低沉地咕哝着，杀意缠在字里行间，“把她带回营地。” 任凭她尖叫着抗拒也无济于事，掠夺者们拖着拼命挣扎的孩子没入夜色，只把她那崩溃、啜泣的父亲丢在路边。

~ Max_Slacker on Discord

Desperately trying to shield his daughter with his body, the man is hurled aside by two burly members of the gang. He is gagged by a third as he is savagely beaten. A lithe woman in studded leather armor steps forward, crouching beside the sniffling child and delicately lifting up the girl's chin. "Oh yes, she's the one," the raider purrs menacingly. "Take her back to camp." Deaf to her screams of protest, the raiders carry the flailing child away into the night, leaving her broken, sobbing father by the roadside.

~ Max_Slacker on Discord

Traditional Chinese Restaurant.name:
传统中餐馆
Traditional Chinese Restaurant

Text.text:
这家餐馆的家具不是常见的塑料与金属，而是用陈旧的雕花木料打造而成。墙面覆满了装饰华丽的挂毯；一位华人迎宾对每一位进门的客人含笑点头，随后递上一本真正的纸质小册子，上面写着今晚的特惠菜单——又一次将人拉回那早已远去的旧时光。
The furniture in this restaurant is made of old, carved wood instead of the more common plastics and metals. The walls are covered in decorated tapestries, and the Chinese host offers a smile and a nod to all who enter before handing them an actual paper pamphlet with the night's specials, another callback to a bygone era.

这根魔杖呈温暖的红褐色，深色的旋纹贯穿其间。它长约一尺，雕削成锐利的尖端，握柄厚重带有凸缘，仿佛从木质本身自然生长而成。细小的黑色符文沿着杖身螺旋盘绕，以古老的魔法淬炼之法灼刻成焦黑，越向杖尖触及便越发细小。
This wand is a warm reddish brown with dark whorls through it. A foot long and carved to a sharp point, it has a heavy flanged grip shaped naturally from it. In a spiral around the wand, tiny black runes burned into it grow smaller as they reach the tip, burned black in the old way of magical tempering.

分节腿关节湿漉漉、噼啪作响的啵声，预告着那梦魇般的生物正迈步逼近——它用八条蛛形长腿踏来，每一条都长得像梯子的横档。它的外骨骼竖起一层褐色硬毛，被脓血与陈旧毒液黏成一片。你头顶之上，数十张剃刀般的巨口滴落涎液，咬合时溅出啪嗒乱响的水花；上百只不眨的眼睛则以凶残的饥渴死死盯住你。那恐怖之物疾窜而来时，散落的嘴巴齐声放出一串尖啸般的口哨声。更糟的是，四面八方随之回荡起同样的回应。 The wet, crackling pop of segmented leg-joints heralds the nightmare creature striding toward you on eight arachnid legs as long as ladder staves. Its exoskeleton bristles with brown fur matted with ichor and stale venom. Above you, dozens of razor maws drip drool in gnashing splashes and a hundred unblinking eyes regard you with a vicious voracity. As the horror skitters forward, those disparate mouths unleash a chorus of keening whistles. Worse yet are the echoed replies from all around you.

Observation Deck With 360-degree View.name:
可360度环视的观景甲板
Observation Deck With 360-degree View

Text.text:
旋转房间里的甲板提供了令人惊叹的360度全景，将眼前的壮丽景色尽收无遗。你能以前所未有的清晰度望去，恢宏的风光在你面前铺陈开来，宏伟而毫无遮拦，细节分明。
The deck in the rotating room offers a stunning 360-degree panorama of the breathtaking view. You can see with unparalleled clarity as the spectacular vista stretches out before you in magnificent, unimpeded detail.

Euphoric Street Drug, Pixie Dust.name:
令人飘飘欲仙的街头毒品，妖精尘
Euphoric Street Drug, Pixie Dust

Text.text:
不透明的白色塑料小袋上开着一个诱人得近乎刺眼的透明圆窗，能看见里面货真价实的仙尘细闪如霜。这就是人们想暂时从自己的生活里出走时会吞下的东西。使用者事后常常对着监控里自己在药效下荒唐行径的画面挠头发愣。成堆的粉末据说都被那些迷幻色调的电音派对DJ从鼻子里吸进去，据称如此；可那些白金销量的数码混音集，标题像“Pixie Trip”和“The Dust Made Me Do It”，听起来活像低频轰鸣的证词。

~ 由一位英雄设想

A tantalizingly clear circle in the opaque white plastic envelope reveals the fine glitter of literal fairy dust contained within. This is what folk take when they want to wander out of their own life for a bit. Users are often left scratching their heads at CCTV footage of themselves behaving outrageously while under the drug’s influence. Piles of the stuff have disappeared up the noses of psychedelic-shaded rave DJs, allegedly, though platinum-selling digital mixes with titles like “Pixie Trip” and “The Dust Made Me Do It” sound like bass-thumping witness statements.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

精灵的手不自觉地滑向腰间那柄华丽长剑的剑柄——这是数十年钢铁交击与辉光奥术磨出来的本能动作。他手腕上露出一个奥秘符号的纹身，而当你的目光上移，又在他颈侧瞥见更多。铂金般的金发垂到宽阔肩头下方，祖母绿的眼睛在一张温和却自信的面容中熠熠生辉。秘银半身板甲泛着含蓄的附魔光泽，甲上的符文微微亮起，仿佛有低语般的辉光在其间流动。

~ 由 Stephan Graham 携 扮演

The elf’s hand strays to the hilt of the ornate longsword at his belt, an absentminded motion bred through decades of clashing steel and shining sorcery. A tattoo of an arcane symbol is visible on his wrist, and as your gaze moves up, you notice more on his neck. Platinum-blond hair falls to just below his broad shoulders, and emerald eyes shine from a kind yet confident visage. Mithral half plate gleams with subtle enchantment, its runes alight with a faint glow.

~ Played by Stephan Graham with

Speech By A Bitter Soldier About Courage.name:
一名满腹怨恨的士兵关于勇气的演讲
Speech By A Bitter Soldier About Courage

Text.text:
“我并非因替国王打仗而勇敢，也不是因斩杀同类而成了英雄。我是个懦夫。我把自己的身躯交给了他人的事业，不为英勇，不为荣耀，只因为我害怕得不敢说不。我抛下了信念与良知，转而握起一把剑来顶替它们。”
“I am not brave for fighting a king’s wars nor a hero for striking down my fellow man. I am a coward. I surrendered my body to another person’s cause, not for valor or glory, but because I was too scared to say no. I left behind my convictions and morality and took a sword in their stead.”

Gharaz Akh Zul.name:
加拉兹·阿赫·祖尔
Gharaz Akh Zul

Text.text:
那魁梧的爬行类身影仿佛一座行走的军械库，披着兽皮。巨大的长柄刀、长矛、长杖与盾牌都塞在临时捆扎的挽具里，随着他一步步沉重逼近，在他布满尖刺的甲壳上叮当作响；粗壮结实的腿托着他，稳得像碾压过来的巨兽。他的鳞皮呈怒海般的蓝灰色，纹理宛如被风暴掀翻的浪涛；而那双红眼却像地狱火未熄的余烬，灼灼燃烧。他从你身旁经过时哼了一声，鼻中隔那枚沉重的金属环随之摆动，像门上的叩环般晃荡。你看见他那经受风吹日晒的皮肤坚韧粗砺、伤痕累累，遍布无数大大小小的疤痕——分明是天生幸存者的印记。

~ Played by Jake with

The hulking reptilian figure is a walking armory clad in animal skins. A huge glaive, spears, staves, and a shield all rattle against his spiked shell in a makeshift harness as he makes his way ponderously toward you on thick, muscular legs. His scaled skin—the bluish gray of an ocean’s wrath—resembles storm-tossed waves, but his red eyes burn like smoldering embers of hellfire. He snorts as he passes you, causing the heavy ring in his septum to swing like a door knocker. You see that his weather-beaten skin is tough, battered, and covered in innumerable scars of all sizes—clearly the marks of a born survivor.

~ Played by Jake with

Cemetery In Cold Rain.name:
冷雨中的墓园
Cemetery In Cold Rain

Text.text:
倾盆大雨喧嚣地击打着下陷的墓碑，仿佛要唤醒下方沉睡之人。寒冷的空气里酝酿着浓雾，湿透的泥土上散落着一滩滩细小水洼。狂风似带哀恸地呼号，那凄楚的旋律，如同献给亡者的挽歌。
The deluge bounces noisily from the sunken gravestones, as if seeking to wake the sleepers below. The chill air is pregnant with mist, the sodden earth strewn with tiny pools. The wind howls with seeming sorrow, the doleful melody a song for the dead.

Young Noble Meets Adventurers.name:
年轻贵族与冒险者相遇
Young Noble Meets Adventurers

Text.text:
一名年轻女子蹦跳着奔到你面前——洋溢着青春的热情，双眼因兴奋而闪亮——而你几乎听不懂她倾泻而出的崇拜之词。话语从她口中滚落，一句挤着一句，急得把前一句推到一边。她的手不自觉地去扯那几条松垮的皮带，勉强吊着那副不合身的胸甲。她腰侧垂着的细剑光洁如新。她显然把冒险奉若神明，可你怀疑她从未在无人陪同的情况下走出过城墙。

~ Clara C. Potter 于 Discord 构想

A young woman bounds up to you—full of youthful enthusiasm, eyes bright with excitement—and you struggle to comprehend the torrent of adulation she bestows on you. Words tumble from her mouth, each one pushing its predecessor out of the way in haste. Her hand strays to loose straps holding up her ill-fitting breastplate. The rapier dangling from her hip looks pristine. Though she clearly idolizes adventure, you doubt she has ever left the town walls unescorted.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

箱体以明快的浅桦木镶板包覆，金属脚手架搭起的竖井里，内部的道具机构与绳索一览无余。一根曲柄为巨大的发条线圈蓄力，而一枚硕大的装饰按钮则按下即放开卡扣。电梯行程颠簸，噪声也不小，但完成任务绰绰有余。做工精致、格栅般编织的黄铜栅门沿轨道开启，吱呀作响，仿佛正缺一滴油。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The box is paneled in a cheerful light birch, with the gear work and ropes visible inside a shaft made only of metal scaffolding. A crank primes the huge clockwork coil spring, and a large ornamental button releases the catch. The elevator is rough in its trip, and rather loud, but it does the job well enough. Its nicely latticed brass gates open on a track that sounds like it needs some oil.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Abandoned Honored Burial Hall.name:
废弃的荣誉葬礼大厅
Abandoned Honored Burial Hall

Text.text:
葬礼长厅尽头的那间房几乎与通向此处的整段空间一样宽阔，然而里面却只在最深处的台座上安放着一具棺椁。雕刻石制的空火盆蜷伏在沿墙延伸的壁龛里一路排开，台座上散落着成堆的蜡烛。可此刻唯一的光亮，只是从房外渗入的微光。
The room at the end of the burial hall is almost as big as the entirety of the space leading up to it, yet it only houses one coffin atop a dais at the far end. Empty braziers of carved stone nestle in alcoves running the length of the room, and the dais is littered with candles. But the only light now is what filters from outside the room.

Museum Of Interplanetary Culture.name:
星际文化博物馆
Museum Of Interplanetary Culture

Text.text:
脚步声在博物馆寂静的长廊里轻轻回荡，访客们一边探索一边压低声音窃窃交谈。来自银河各地的慷慨显贵将文物捐赠给这项工程，汇聚成一座兼收并蓄而又瑰丽动人的藏品宝库，深受众人喜爱。
Footsteps echo softly through the quiet halls of the museum, and visitors converse in hushed whispers as they explore. Artifacts have been donated to the project by generous dignitaries from across the galaxy, creating an eclectic and beautiful collection beloved by many.

腐肉酸败的恶臭熏得你周遭空气都发酸，胃里一阵翻涌，喉根不由得抽搐发紧。可不知怎的，这股臭味的源头看起来比闻起来还要骇人。一个佝偻的爬行类躯体踩着三趾的脚步步拖行，肌肉在鳞片下鼓起成一块块不对称的疙瘩；那鳞片色如干涸污水，又像抹了血沫的油腻，从鳄鱼般的尾巴一路覆到扭曲弓起的脊背。挂在这畸形骨架上的，是一整套武器与护甲——棍棒与标枪、煮制皮甲与铁胫甲——全都从尸体上掠来；而那些尸体的断耳与被抠出的眼珠，则像阴森的饰品般点缀在这怪物身上。它为何要带这么多武器仍是谜团，因为它那匕首般的利爪与一张宽阔的嘴、层层叠叠的尖牙，已足够致命。
The nauseating stench of rancid meat sours the air around you, twisting your stomach and bringing a quiver to the back of your throat. Somehow the source of this stench looks worse than it smells. A stooped reptilian body plods on three-toed feet, muscles lumpy and asymmetrical under scales the color of dry sewage greased with gore, which cover it from alligator tail to twisted and hunched spine. Hanging from this deformed frame is an arsenal of weapons and armor—clubs and javelins, boiled leather and iron greaves—stolen from the same corpses whose severed ears and plucked eyes festoon this abomination like morbid jewelry. Why it needs so many weapons is a mystery, as its dagger claws and wide mouth of multi-rowed fangs seem deadly enough.

I Cast Ice Storm.name:
我施放寒冰风暴
I Cast Ice Storm

Text.text:
当我引导这道法术的刺骨寒能时，一股残酷的冷意沿着双手蔓延开来，麻痹了我伸出的指尖。呼出的气息在空中凝成白雾，霜花爬上裸露的皮肤，使其发红、起泡。随着最后一个字落下，我将暴风雪的狂怒倾泻向敌人，以毁灭性的冰之风暴席卷而去。
A brutal cold spreads through my hands as I channel the frigid energy of the spell, numbing my outstretched fingers. My breath mists in the air as frost rimes my exposed skin, causing it to redden and blister. With a final word, I unleash the fury of a blizzard upon my foes in a devastating storm of ice.

Intimidating Speech By A Vampire.name:
吸血鬼的威吓言辞
Intimidating Speech By A Vampire

Text.text:
“已经很久没有凡人踏足此地了。自从我对上一伙威胁我的人下了手之后，我原以为再多的黄金也无法说服任何人来这里。我想凡人的记性总是短得可笑。不过等他们找到你们的残骸之后，我至少能换来几百年的安宁。”
“It has been so long since a mortal stepped foot in this place. After what I did to the last group that threatened me, I was sure no amount of gold could convince someone to come here. I suppose mortals have short memories. But after they find what remains of you, I should have at least a few centuries of peace.”

Friendly Tavern: Closing Time.name:
友善酒馆：打烊时代
Friendly Tavern: Closing Time

Text.text:
酒馆几近空荡。大多数人都已回家上床歇息，但仍有几名侍者在桌间收拾杯盘；吧台边一对男女相对大笑，显然玩得太尽兴，根本舍不得就此散场。
The tavern stands nearly empty. Most folk have left for home and bed, but a few servers clear cups and dishes from tables while a couple at the bar laugh together, clearly having too fine a time to call it a night.

Beautiful Gold Buckle.name:
华美的金扣
Beautiful Gold Buckle

Text.text:
以烈焰锻成王冠般的拱弧，在一颗菱形宝石处交汇，这枚扣环柔软却沉甸甸的分量压在掌心。它显然为仪式排场而生，而非粗活劳作。它大概能在几季的宫廷盛会与郑重典礼中保持形状，扣住一条宽阔的黑色皮革地位腰带——然而，它的价值胜过一个小小店主的全部家产。
Flame-crafted into arches of a royal crown that meet at a diamond stone, the buckle is soft and heavy. It is obviously for pageantry rather than hard work. It will probably hold its shape for a few seasons of high court and formal occasions, locking a broad black leather belt of station—yet it is worth more than all the holdings of a minor shopkeeper.

Cybernetic Torso Augmentation +2.name:
义体躯干强化 +2
Cybernetic Torso Augmentation +2

Text.text:
宽阔的躯体上只剩几缕淡薄的血肉，几乎被锋利如刃的晶化凯夫拉装甲彻底覆盖。心脏安置在一套复杂的交叠结构中，宛如主板般层层嵌合，而其上方的胸腔正燃着冰冷的火焰般幽光。双肩关节已被钨球替换，带来惊人的活动度与坚韧度。使用者大概能轻松耸肩硬扛更大口径的弹丸。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Only faint slivers of flesh remain on the broad body, almost totally plated with cutting-edge crystalized Kevlar. The heart is housed in a complex interlay resembling a motherboard, the chest above glowing with a cold flame. Both shoulder joints have been replaced with tungsten balls, affording exceptional mobility and toughness. The user could probably shrug off higher-caliber projectiles with ease.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Jumper On Building With Crowd Of Gawkers.name:
高楼之上的纵跃者，楼下挤满看热闹的人群
Jumper On Building With Crowd Of Gawkers

Text.text:
一群行人挤在一栋镜面大楼旁，所有目光都抬向天空。上方，在沸腾般炽烈的太阳眩光里，隐约可见一个类人的剪影站在屋顶边缘的绝壁上。太高了，根本辨不清是谁——至少二十层楼那么高。一个穿着碳缝工装背带裤的瘦削快递员大喊：“别干傻事，兄弟！”那道剪影一言不发，只是在微风里轻轻摇晃。
A gaggle of pedestrians stand near the side of a mirrored building, all eyes raised to the sky. Above, against the glare of the boiling sun, a humanoid silhouette can be seen standing at the precipice of the roof. They are too high up to identify—at least twenty floors high. A slim courier in carbon-stitch dungarees shouts, “Don’t do it, man!” The silhouette says nothing. They only sway gently in the breeze.

Mourners At The Cemetery.name:
墓园的哀悼者
Mourners At The Cemetery

Text.text:
一身黑衣的遗属们神情肃穆地伫立在墓前。有些人带着淡淡的苦笑哀悼，想必正忆起曾共同珍藏的某个瞬间。也有人无声啜泣，溺没在悲恸里，茫然想着——今后再也无法见到、无法与之说话、无法触碰那个已被从他们生命中生生剥离的人，他们究竟该如何继续走下去。
Clad all in black, the bereaved stand with somber expressions at a grave. Some mourn with a wan smile, no doubt remembering some treasured moment shared. Others sob silently, drowning in their grief, wondering how they will manage to carry on without seeing, speaking with, or touching the person who has been stripped from their lives.

你将羽毛笔轻轻蘸入墨水，从墨池中吸满笔尖。你写下讯息，而当墨迹干透时，幻术便开始运作：字母被搅乱，词句被替换，荒诞的符号也被揉进其中。
You dip the quill, filling the tip from the well of ink. You write your message, and as the ink dries, the illusion does its work, scrambling the letters, replacing words, incorporating nonsense symbols.

这名肩宽如门的男人皮肤呈蓝灰色，眼睛苍白，颜色像海泡。每边脸颊各纹着三点。头顶短而凌乱的卷发由发根的绿色渐变至发梢的靛蓝，长长的编辫胡须也带着相近的色调。银色护甲由鱼鳞般的甲片拼成，并点缀天蓝细节。左臂护腕上嵌着一枚圆盘，中空如环，外缘均匀放射出六个尖点。他神情凶悍，左手将闪亮的三叉戟平举直指前方，右手举起一面覆着尖刺的绿色甲壳盾。

~ 由 Dan 使用 Played 扮演，角色卡：

This broad-shouldered man has blue-gray skin and pale eyes the color of seafoam. Three dots tattoo each cheek. Short, disheveled curls on his head gradate from green at the roots to indigo toward the tips, and his long, braided beard sports similar hues. Silvery plates in a scale motif with azure details make up his fine armor. The left bracer bears a circular disc, hollow in the middle, with six points radiating evenly along the outer edge. He wears a fierce look, his shiny trident leveled in his left hand and his shield of spiked green shell raised in the right.

~ Played by Dan with

Hunter With Axe.name:
持斧猎人
Hunter With Axe

Text.text:
尽管他身上的伤疤在漫长一生中早已淡去，这名猎人仍以青年般张扬的自信昂然自持，只是被年代积淀的智慧与谦逊稍稍收敛。他将一柄阔斧随意搭在肩上，仿佛那只是身体的延伸；而这件武器上斑驳的痕迹，正刻着他在荒野中奉献一生的印记。
Though his scars have faded over a lifetime, the hunter still carries himself with the boisterous confidence of youth, albeit tempered by the wisdom of age and humility. He swings a broad axe over one shoulder as if it were an extension of his own body, and the weapon bears the marks of a life of service in the wilds.

I Cast Minions Of Chaos.name:
我召唤混沌仆从
I Cast Minions Of Chaos

Text.text:
我向面前那原初的元素发出感召。唤其名，以精确的手势结出它的印记。绕着那元素、那道门径行走，我重复这些动作。我吟诵感召之词。一轮既毕，我再从感召开始，反复这场仪式，度过那漫长的一分钟——直到世界与世界之间的屏障被削薄。灵体越界而来，栖入元素之中。我将其缚于其内。它遂与我为伴，侍奉我一个时代。
I beckon to the primal element before me. Naming it, I make its sign with precise gestures. Walking around the element, the gateway, I repeat the movements. I chant the calling words. One cycle done, I begin again with the beckoning, repeating the ritual for the long minute it takes to thin the barrier between worlds. The spirit crosses over and inhabits the element. I bind it there. It joins me as a companion, serving me for a time.

Temperate Forest Fire.name:
温带森林火灾
Temperate Forest Fire

Text.text:
炼狱般的烈焰咆哮着，在林间横冲直撞。火舌扇动空气，泼洒灼人的热浪，喷吐出呛黑的浓烟，刺得人眼睛生疼、肺腑发紧。火势如炽红的狂潮铺满林地，带着熔融般的暴怒攀上一棵树，烤枯树皮，吞噬树叶，又在高处枝桠间癫狂摇摆，带着病态的狂热纵身一跃，扑向下一个猎物。
The inferno roars as it rampages through the forest. Flames fan the air with sweltering heat and belch black smoke that vexes the eyes and lungs. The fire carpets the forest floor with molten fury, clawing its way up one tree. It withers the bark, devours the leaves, then sways crazily in the upper branches, leaping with feverish abandon to fall upon its next victim.

Excerpt From The Enchanter’s Staff Taxon.name:
《附魔师法杖分类学》摘录
Excerpt From The Enchanter’s Staff Taxonomy

Text.text:
以黄松（Pinus ponderosa）为例，这种软木易于塑形，很快便会被手掌磨得温润贴合。枯木的手感与新伐的青木或车制过的木料相差无几。然而狐尾松木杖（Pinus balforiana）却截然不同，它更抗拒手掌的驯服；若经车床细削并上漆封护，其抛掷性能也会优异得多。
Take, for example Pinus ponderosa, a softwood easily shaped and quickly worn to the hand. Deadfall behaves much as green-cut wood or lathed timber. Not so for the Foxtail Pine staff (Pinus balforiana), which resists the hand and casts far better if lathed and lacquered.

Tatu Searis The Human Way Of The Open Ha.name:
塔图·西阿里斯：人类的开手道武僧
Tatu Searis The Human Way Of The Open Hand Monk

Text.text:
这个光头人类几乎不穿什么，也几乎不带什么。没有护甲拖累他们，也没有刀剑悬在胯侧。身着宽松舒适却不失实用的衣物，他们只携一根朴素的长棍，棍身握处因多年不间断的使用而磨得圆润光滑。尽管外表低调素净，既无饰物也不见显眼武器，你仍无法忽视他们举手投足间的优雅——长棍划空时行云流水，简朴衣料之下，是随时蓄势待发的紧绷肌肉。

~ 由 RPGBOT.net 的 Tyler 扮演

The bald-headed human wears little clothing, and carries even less. No armor weighs them down, no blade hangs at their hip. Garbed in loose-fitting, comfortable yet functional clothes, they carry a simple quarterstaff, its haft smooth from years of constant use. Despite their unassuming, undecorated appearance and lack of obvious weaponry, you can't help but notice the grace with which they move, the fluidity with which they sweep that staff through the air, and the coiled muscles beneath the simple garb.

~ Played by Tyler from RPGBOT.net

Bardic Inspiration About Potential.name:
诗人灵感：关于潜能
Bardic Inspiration About Potential

Text.text:
“你的才华与从容一直让我敬畏得发怵。现在可别让我看走眼。”
“I’ve always been enormously intimidated by your talent and poise. Don’t prove me wrong now.”

Huitz'plina Youngling.name:
维茨普利纳幼崽
Huitz'plina Youngling

Text.text:
一颗昆虫般的头颅装点在强壮的猿类躯体之上——两者交织成令人胆寒的混合怪物。它光秃的头顶竖着一对镰刀似的触角，飞快抽动，以冷漠的姿态扫掠周遭的一切。无数防御性尖刺沿着它的身躯起伏如浪，它还以惊人的灵巧挥舞着一条覆着护甲甲片的尾巴。
An insectoid head bedecks a powerful apelike body—a frightening amalgamation of the two. Its bald head sports a pair of sickle-like antennae that rapidly twitch, canvassing nearby objects with an apathetic air. Countless defensive spines ripple along the length of its body, and it swings an armor-plated tail with alarming dexterity.

Mage In Combat With Ooze.name:
法师与黏液怪激战中
Mage In Combat With Ooze

Text.text:
转过拐角，你目睹一场野蛮的厮杀。一名法师为活命与一团贪婪的软泥怪搏斗。猩红的能量箭矢撕扯着这头怪物猎食者不断变形的躯体，逼得它张开充满黏液的巨口，发出凄厉的痛嚎。施法者也在这痛苦的喧嚣中骤然加入——那生物裹住了他的手臂，用消化般的肉质将他的手溶解殆尽。
Rounding the corner, you witness savage combat. A mage fights for their life against a voracious ooze. Crimson bolts of energy rip at the mutable flesh of the monstrous predator,opening a mucus-filled mouth to scream its agony. The spellcaster suddenly joins with this cacophony of pain as the creature envelops their arm, dissolving their hand with its digestive flesh.

Sundries From A Grig.name:
格里格的杂物
Sundries From A Grig

Text.text:
在格里格那只小小的背包里，你找到一颗盛着旋舞烟雾的玻璃球、一撮烟斗烟草，以及一片腌卷心菜——体型和一枚铜币差不多大。
In the tiny knapsack of the grig you find a glass orb filled with whirling smoke, a cluster of pipe tobacco, and a pickled cabbage the size of a copper coin.

High Elven Wine.name:
高等精灵葡萄酒
High Elven Wine

Text.text:
这瓶妖精位面的陈酿闪耀如流动的紫水晶。酒体圆润而丰饶，带着一缕烟熏的暗香。轻啜一口，便如丝绸般滑过舌尖——干爽之中又藏着顽皮的甜意。不多时，四肢渐沉，暖意像阳光般渗入骨髓。睡意在脑海里蜷起身子，如一只慵懒的家猫；无与伦比的瑰丽幻景则如奶油色天空里的云朵，轻轻漂过心间。

~ 一位英雄所构想

This fey-plane vintage gleams like liquid amethyst. The wine is round and rich, with smoky undertones. A sip glides over the tongue like silk, dry with a puckish sweetness. Soon, the limbs grow heavy, warmth settling into the bones like sunshine. As sleep curls up inside the head like a languorous house cat, visions of unparalleled loveliness float through the mind like clouds in a buttery sky.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这块墓碑向着面前的青草土丘微微倾斜，或许是被潮湿松软的地面掏空了根基，也可能只是安放得草率。透过掩蔽其上的苔藓与地衣，你仍能辨出铭文：忧虑尽消，牵挂尽散，我身长眠于此，我魂却不在。 This gravestone tilts away from the grassy mound before it, perhaps undermined by the soggy ground or simply poorly installed. Beneath the moss and lichen that cover it, you can read: Past all worry, beyond all care, my body rests, my soul not there.

腐烂的皮肉裹着那只爬行的断手，向你疾窜而来；筋腱与白骨驱使它以前进，指甲残缺发黄，刮擦着地面。腕端的断口被灼烧封死，仿佛曾遭受令人发狂的酷热灼烙；而那只手的朽烂肌肤上，还点缀着诡异的纹身。
Rotting flesh covers the crawling hand scuttling toward you, sinew and bone driving it forward on chipped and yellowed nails. The stump has been seared over, as if cauterized by agonizing heat, and strange tattoos dot the hand’s decaying flesh.

Rite Of Passage To Join Coven.name:
加入秘会的成人礼
Rite Of Passage To Join Coven

Text.text:
穿过荆棘丛与毒草的密网，你寻到那株罕见的蕨——深绿如墨，幽香沁骨——将它带到秘会环绕的坩埚前。你吸入那锅沸腾的药雾，投入蕨叶，再次深吸。幻觉如潮，载着你穿行于歌声与咒唱之间。一个女人被带到你面前，四肢痉挛，口吐白沫；秘会的女族长对你说道：“救她。治好她，便成为我们的一员。”
Through thickets of brambles and poisonous plants, you find the rare fern, deep green and fragrant, and bring it to the cauldron in the ring of the coven. You breathe the brew, add the fern, and breathe again. The hallucinations carry you through song and chant. A woman is brought to you, seizing and foaming at the mouth, and the matron of the coven says, “Save her. Heal her and become one of us.”

这团起伏的岩浆黏浆，宛如化学废料倾倒后凝聚成一具形体。它像泥浆般——足有十二英尺宽，沉重不堪——在地面上缓慢滑行，被某种不可知的意识驱使向前。怪物质地稀薄流淌，表面布满凹坑与灼痕，尽是烈火留下的疤。黏浆体内，被丢弃的化学物不断碰撞，迸发出一连串小规模的爆炸。
This undulating magmatic ooze is like a chemical dump coalesced into one form. Slurry—twelve feet across and heavy—slowly slips across the floor, urged along by some unknowable consciousness. A runny consistency marks the beast, pock-marked and scarred by fire. Within the ooze, discarded chemicals collide, erupting into small explosions.

袋鼠用短短的前臂在臀侧来回抓挠，弯曲的爪尖刮过那恼人的痒处。塌软的耳朵猛地竖向一丝声响，她直起身来巡视四周。她以强健的后腿撑得高高的，长尾重重抵住地面稳住身形。浓密的长睫一眨，将空气里磨人的红尘抖落。确认无碍后，她放松下来，蜷回温暖的弓背坐姿。腹前松垂的育儿袋轻轻晃了晃，片刻后，一截好奇的小鼻吻探出，紧跟着露出一只细长的脚，活像个孩子乱七八糟地躺在吊床里。
The kangaroo swipes her short forearm back and forth over her haunch, her curved nails raking across an irksome itch. Floppy ear perked toward a noise, she rises to survey her surroundings. She stretches tall on her powerful back legs, pressing her long tail into the ground to improve her balance. Her long lashes blink away the red dirt gritting the air. Relaxing, she sinks back down into a cozy hunch. The sagging pouch on her belly wiggles for a moment before a curious little snout pops out along with one of its long feet, looking much like a child lying untidily in a hammock.

Loot From A Zombie.name:
来自丧尸（特征）的战利品
Loot From A Zombie

Text.text:
嵌进那具丧尸（特征）胸口腐烂血肉里的，是一枚纤细的银质吊坠，上面镌刻着一位美丽女子的肖像。显然，这件小饰物曾承载着某种情感，如今却只和你搜罗来的其他战利品一样，沉甸甸地塞满了你的钱袋。
Sinking into the rotting flesh of the zombie’s chest is a slim silver pendant etched with the image of a beautiful woman. Clearly, this trinket once had some sentimental value, but now it just fills your purse like the other treasures you have gathered.

有人在这片区域砍倒了树木，将浓密的森林硬生生打开，直面天空。削凿过的树桩从泥泞的沼状木屑堆里刺出，四周散落着断裂的枝条与被踩烂的植被。原木已被拖走，但从倒木上劈下的枝杈却在空地中央堆成一座巨大的柴堆，毫无疑问，等它们干到足够程度，就会被付之一炬。
Someone felled the trees in this area, opening the dense forest to the sky. Chiseled stumps thrust up from a muddy morass of woodchips, broken branches, and trampled plants. The logs have been dragged away, but the branches hacked from the fallen trees lie in a huge pile at the center of the clearing, no doubt ready for burning once they dry enough.

Fitz Lebensmüde.name:
菲茨·亡命之徒
Fitz Lebensmüde

Text.text:
在马戏团帐篷后方，一个中年男子站在杂耍艺人与杂技演员之间——他英俊、仍旧精力充沛。那两人衣衫凌乱、面颊潮红，脸上扭曲着不快的表情；杂耍艺人的指节破了皮。你离得太远，听不清他们的确切话语，只见夹在中间的男人任阳光落在他那一头修长飘逸的金发上，以一种既讲道理又能安抚人心的语气说着什么。你看见两名争执者的神色先是缓和，继而变得窘迫。又过了片刻，他们各自上前，短暂握手，随即分道扬镳。仿佛这才第一次察觉到你的存在，那位调停者抬眼直视你——他林木般的绿眸在某种难以言明的意义上立刻让你心安。你也注意到，他左耳旁有一道长疤，从锁骨上方一路延伸到下颌底下。他对你微微颔首，带着一抹浅笑，迈步向前，前来招呼你。

~ Played by a Hero

Behind the circus tents, a middle-aged man, handsome and still vital, stands between a juggler and an acrobat, the two of whom are mussed and flushed, with grimaces on their face. The juggler’s knuckles are skinned. Though you are too distant to make out the exact words, the man in the middle, sunlight shining brightly on his long, flowing blond hair, speaks in a tone that conveys both reasonable and soothing qualities. You see the expression of both fighters soften, then grow sheepish. After another few moments, the two step forward and shake hands briefly before going their separate ways. As if sensing you for the first time, the peacemaker looks directly at you, his forest green eyes immediately comforting to you in some inexplicable way. You also notice that there is a long scar stretching from the top of his collarbone to the underside of his jaw, by his left ear. He nods to you with a small smile, and steps forward to greet you.

~ Played by a Hero

Druid's Glade Protects Itself.name:
德鲁伊的林间空地自卫起来
Druid's Glade Protects Itself

Text.text:
大自然从不宽恕它所憎恶之人——若敢踏入圣地，更是罪加一等。敌人步步逼近，刀刃与利爪抓挠着古老的树皮，林木随之苏醒：为复仇，为守土。粗壮沉重的根须自葱郁肥沃的土壤中轰然破土，缠住、勒紧闯入者的咽喉——让他们承受自然不容置疑的怒火。

~ 由 SonOfSofaman 在 Discord 上 构想

Nature does not take kindly to those it deems abhorrent—even less so when they encroach upon sacred ground. As foes close in, raking blades and claws across ancient bark, the trees come alive to exact vengeance and protect their land. Thick, weighty roots burst from the rich, verdant soil to ensnare and strangle intruders—who suffer nature's implacable wrath.

~ Envisioned by SonOfSofaman on Discord

Loot From A Group Of Skeleton Archers.name:
一群骷髅（特征）弓箭手的战利品
Loot From A Group Of Skeleton Archers

Text.text:
一截精灵小指的惨白指骨上还套着一枚青铜戒指，戒面嵌着一小片紫水晶，价值2金币。旁边散落的几枚铜制箭头保存得还算完好，仍可搜刮带走，或卖给附近的商贩换上一笔不差的报酬。
The pale white bone of an elven pinky still wears a bronze ring with an amethyst chip, worth 2 gold pieces. Some copper arrowheads nearby are still in good enough shape to be looted or sold to nearby traders for a decent payoff.

Demon Queen Of Fungi.name:
真菌魔后
Demon Queen Of Fungi

Text.text:
一个腐臭的人影自污秽的泥潭中舒展而出，宛如一朵怪诞的花苞绽放，菌丝般的触须在她周身扭动，带着亵渎的狂喜。她可怖的血肉间鼓胀出一股股污浊的恶气，粘稠的黏液自她的眼角淌落，而她却含笑。孢子玷污了空气，携着她致命的亲吻；那股臭味正是腐朽与真菌败坏的本质。
A putrid figure unfolds from a pool of filth like a grotesque bloom, mycelium tendrils writhing about her in unholy glee. Plumes of gaseous waste pulse from her horrid flesh and beads of mucus run from her eyes as she smiles. Spores stain the air, carrying her deadly kiss, the stench of them the very essence of decay and fungal corruption.

Loot From A Vine Blight.name:
来自藤蔓枯萎怪的战利品
Loot From A Vine Blight

Text.text:
最后一丛血肉藤蔓在黏稠的树液爆裂中四散崩解后，你开始搜查这片区域。那生物在此狩猎已久，你在沟渠里发现了几名受害者的残骸。几乎没有什么值钱的东西，但你还是设法抢救出一些钱币。
After the last fleshy vines burst apart in a syrupy explosion of sap you search the area. The creature had been hunting here for some time, and you discover the remains of some victims in a ditch. There is little of value, but you manage to salvage some coins.

Wayfarer Square In Winter.name:
冬日旅人广场
Wayfarer Square In Winter

Text.text:
公共营地几乎空无一人，帐篷歪斜地留在原地，像是上个季节的残影——在昏暗里塌垂、灰败。仅有的几户人家住在这里，从头到脚裹着东拼西凑的衣物，聚在一只共用的火盆旁，往里丢着枯枝，低声说话。一个女人比其他人更靠近火光，她赤裸的双手在火焰周围缓缓游走，目光紧锁其上，专注得近乎忘我。一个男人走近人群，手臂上绕着一长串香肠。众人因他的赋礼而欢呼，他胡子拉碴的脸颊随笑意鼓起成圆。他把肉一份份分出去，同时有人跑回帐篷去取烤签。
The communal campground is nearly empty, tents left askew from seasons past—droopy and gray in the gloom. The few folk who do reside here are bundled from head to toe in mismatched clothes. They gather around a shared brazier, tossing in sticks and speaking in soft tones. One woman stands closer to the fire than the others, her bare hands moving around the flame, her eyes fixed on it in deep concentration. A man approaches the group with a long string of sausages wrapped about his arm. They cheer at his gift, and his bearded cheeks round into a smile. He doles the meat out while someone runs to their tent to fetch skewers.

尽管这柄钉头锤锻造时毫无装饰，但其锤首与锤翼却并非铁制，而是罕见的精金；锤柄则缠裹着某种鲨皮，即便持握者满手鲜血，也能防止手掌打滑。想在这柄钉头锤上留下哪怕最细微的一道划痕，恐怕得先砸碎上千颗戴盔的头颅。
Though this mace has been forged free of ornamentation, the head and flanges are a rare adamantine and not iron, with the haft wrapped in some sort of sharkskin to prevent the wielder’s grip from slipping even when covered in blood. This mace would have to bash in a thousand helmeted heads before showing the faintest scratch.

Asmodeus, Hell's Greatest Lawyer.name:
阿斯莫德乌斯，地狱最伟大的律师
Asmodeus, Hell's Greatest Lawyer

Text.text:
恶魔的笑容既耀眼夺目，又令人卸下戒心。雪白如玉的牙齿一露，他便扬起一个轻松的笑——仿佛不费吹灰之力，却同样让人心底发毛。他身形高挑，瘦削如匕首般利落；量身裁制的丝绸与皮革勾勒出锋锐而雅致的风范，肌肤无瑕，红得像熟透的草莓。乌黑的微卷长发恰到好处地垂落、微乱，簇拥着两只自头顶高处生出的、墨黑弯曲的角。更古怪的是，他身上飘来一缕奇异却怡人的气息：像烟，又像巧克力。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The demon’s smile dazzles as much as it disarms. Displaying alabaster white teeth, it’s an easy smile that seems as effortless as it is unnerving. Tall, and slim as a dirk, he cuts a sharp, distinguished look in tailored silks and leathers, with unblemished skin as red as ripe strawberries. Dark, wavy hair lies just so, tousled around two onyx-black curved horns growing high atop his skull. An odd yet pleasant scent wafts from him: something akin to smoke and chocolate.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Potion Of Stone Giant Strength.name:
石巨人力量药水
Potion Of Stone Giant Strength

Text.text:
灰黑色的液体沉沉地卧在烧瓶状的瓶中，凝滞不动。它在光下如砂砾般闪烁，看起来也同样粗粝。液体里嵌着一片细薄的石屑，轻轻敲击着瓶壁。总之，这东西光是入口就让人预感到一阵难以下咽的恶意。
The gray-black liquid sits stolid in the flask-shaped bottle. It glitters like sand under the sun and seems just as grainy. A thin shard of stone within the fluid taps against the sides. Overall, it promises to be an unpleasant quaff.

I Boost My Armor With My Defender Sword.name:
我用防御者之剑强化护甲
I Boost My Armor With My Defender Sword

Text.text:
我挥剑斩下时，剑身迸出一声清越的贵族钟鸣，镶在剑柄末端的宝石骤然喷薄出一面幽灵般的护盾。那虚幻的壁垒悬浮在我前臂前方寸许，却以分毫不差的精准随我一举一动。
A noble chime rings out from the sword as I strike, and a spectral shield erupts from the gem set into the pommel. The ghostly bulwark hovers slightly before my forearm, yet it matches my movements with unerring accuracy.

High Elf Greatspear.name:
高等精灵巨长矛
High Elf Greatspear

Text.text:
这柄的做工纤细得近乎脆弱，却又处处只为美而生。长矛的矛杆高过一匹马，却只有一根手指般粗细。蛛丝般的翠绿藤蔓不对称地盘绕其上，点缀着柔软的叶片。藤蔓在一枚玻璃刃的榫口处汇合；刃身淡绿，天光穿透其间，在刃沿上闪烁流淌，既美丽又可怖。纵使满身都是繁复的工艺，这件武器依然明白无误——它是为战争而造的工具。
The workmanship is so slender, so concerned with beauty. The spear’s shaft reaches taller than a horse but is the width of a finger. Spidery green vines curl all around it, asymmetrical and dotted with soft leaves. The vines meet at the socket of a glass blade, pale green, and the light of the sky gleams through it and glimmers along the edge, beautiful and terrible. Despite all its intricate art, the weapon is clearly a tool of war.

外墙明亮，茅草屋顶泛着金色光泽，这座房子尚未被时代与使用磨蚀。空气里充斥着新漆的气味，通往前门的鹅卵石小径由未染尘垢的石块铺就。透过凸窗，你能看见主屋空无一物，新铺的木地板被打磨得光洁发亮。
Facade bright and thatched roof golden, this home has not yet been weathered by time and use. The smell of fresh paint is rife in the air, and the cobblestone path leading up to the front door is paved with unstained stones. Through the bay window, you can see the main room is unfurnished, wood flooring newly laid and polished.

Bard Corpse.name:
吟游诗人尸体
Bard Corpse

Text.text:
机智与魅力终究没能让这位话痨吟游诗人逃过黏腻的下场；送上致命一击的匕首仍深深埋在他们胸口。吟游诗人的衣装——虽已被猩红浸透——却依旧色彩喧闹、华丽夺目，满是褶边与花纹，专为攫住人群的目光而生。一根孔雀翎以夸张的姿态点缀在他们时髦的帽檐上，宛如一块张扬的墓碑。
Wit and charm were not enough to save this loquacious minstrel from a sticky end, and the dagger that delivered the final blow remains buried in their chest. The bard’s clothing—though stained crimson—is a riot of color and spectacle, replete with frills and patterns designed to capture the gaze of the crowd. A peacock feather stylishly adorns their fashionable hat like a flamboyant headstone.

Disgraced Adventurers Leaving Town.name:
蒙羞的冒险者离开城镇
Disgraced Adventurers Leaving Town

Text.text:
你们垂着脑袋，阴郁地沿着出城的路行进——身后是此起彼伏的哄笑、嘘声，还有几样被掷来的蔬菜，熟烂得臭气熏天。你们失败了。你们逞口舌之快，而当命运前来讨债时，你们被证明一无是处。

~ Sahlonahl 于 Discord

Heads hanging low, you march sullenly along the road out of town—accompanied by a chorus of jeers, boos, and several hurled vegetables ripe with the stink of rot. You failed. You ran your mouth and were found wanting when fate came to collect.

~ Sahlonahl on Discord

你踏入那间幽暗、满是尘土的房间，刺骨寒气如刀割般划过肺腑。呼出的气息在眼前化作白雾，室内的气压微微一沉，仿佛正为新的来客腾出位置。恐惧像冰冷的蛇沿着你的脊背蜿蜒攀升——废墟之间，一道幽魂般的幻影缓缓凝聚成形，那张骷髅般的面容在生与死之间不断闪烁摇曳。
The frigid air feels sharp in your lungs as you enter the dark, dusty room. Your breath mists before you, and the pressure in the chamber shift slightly, as if accommodating a new presence. A shiver of terror slithers up your spine as a ghostly apparition coalesces amid the ruins, their skeletal visage constantly flickering between life and death.

房间被上方彩绘玻璃窗倾泻而下的万花筒般色彩所笼罩。华丽的白色大理石柱沿墙列立，一条织锦地毯铺成小径，引向高起台座上的一座小祭坛。祭坛上摆着蜡烛与一束正幽幽燃烧的熏香，让空气浸透了馥郁的香气。祭坛后方矗立着数尊同样以苍白大理石雕成的雕像，每一尊都仰首向天，面容痛楚。
The room is cast in a kaleidoscope of colors that spill from the stained-glass windows above. Ornate marble pillars line the walls, and a woven carpet leads down a pathway to a small altar on a raised dais. The altar holds candles and a bundle softly burning incense, giving the room an aromatic scent. Behind the altar stand several statues of the same pale marble, each with pained faces turned upwards.

Snow-covered Decaying Wagon.name:
积雪覆盖的朽坏货车
Snow-covered Decaying Wagon

Text.text:
积雪与纠结的枯灌遮蔽了大半视线，但依稀可见，有人将一辆破碎马车的残骸丢弃在此处。一只麻雀落在弯曲锈蚀的轮辋上啁啾几声，仿佛对你们的闯入颇为不满，随即振翅掠起，转眼没入坠落的雪幕之中。
Snow and a tangle of barren brush hide much of it from sight, but it appears that someone discarded the remains of a shattered wagon here. A sparrow chirps from atop the bent and rusted rim of a wheel, seeming perturbed at your intrusion, before it flits away and disappears into the veil of falling snow.

I Tinker With A Flying Car.name:
我鼓捣一辆会飞的汽车
I Tinker With A Flying Car

Text.text:
我的双手如闪电般在那台线条流畅、铬光闪耀的引擎上飞掠——一辆低声嗡鸣的震动悬浮车正离停车库地面仅几英寸处漂浮。装满可燃燃料的霓虹蓝色管路随我细微的动作同步搏动，而当我完成最后的调校，一点绿光忽然眨动着苏醒。
My hands move like lightning over the sleek, chrome engine of the softly humming vibro-car levitating a few inches off the floor of the parking garage. Neon blue tubes filled with combustible fuel pulse in time to the gentle motions, and a green light winks into life as I complete my adjustments.

他赤着脚在地面上缓缓摩擦滑行，直到双脚与肩同宽站定；双手在身前摆开，十指绷直，像两柄冷硬的刀。他的目光在战场上飞掠游走，竭力以蜂鸟掠过花丛般的速度，将每一个敌人都尽收眼底。有人从他身后悄然逼近，想趁机得手，却败在自己笨拙沉重的脚步上——每一步的回响都成了暴露的信号。僧侣顺势旋身，轻若浮尘，双掌如电直刺，重重贯入那名失败袭击者的腹部。

~ 扮演者：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

He slides his bare feet along the ground until they are shoulder-width apart, and he positions his hands in front of him, fingers straight as rigid knives. His eyes flit around the battlefield, working to clock each enemy as quickly as a hummingbird flying from flower to flower. A foe sneaks up behind him, trying to take advantage, but his clumsy, heavy footsteps are his downfall. The reverberations of each step give him the cue, and the monk spins around, light as air, thrusting his hands into the stomach of the failed assailant.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Temple To A False Deity.name:
伪神祇的神殿
Temple To A False Deity

Text.text:
洞口外搭着一座临时搭起的小帐棚，一名身着朴素长袍、笑容可掬的侍祭守在前头。帐篷褶皱间飘出一缕烟——甜腻的熏香气息在空气里拖出细长的尾迹。你探头望向昏暗的帐内，只见一个巨大的箱子，上面以工整精致的字写着：捐献。箱旁还站着另一名侍祭，身形更高更壮，腰侧绑着一根带钉的短棍。
A makeshift tabernacle attached to the mouth of a cave is manned by a smiling acolyte in a plain robe. A trail of smoke—saccharine incense—trails from within the folds of the tent. You peer into the dark interior and see a large chest, painted in fine script with the word: Donation. The chest is guarded by another acolyte, much taller and broader of frame, and with a spiked club strapped to their hip.

Loot From A Wraith.name:
来自缚灵的战利品
Loot From A Wraith

Text.text:
一只由白色大理石精工凿制的宝箱，盛放着那缚灵（特征）生前紧攥不放的珍藏。钱币、宝石与几件珠宝，勾勒出一段被浮华的财富饰物层层包裹的生活。整批藏品价值 50 枚金币。
An expertly hewn coffer of white marble holds the treasures the wraith clung to in life. Coins, gemstones, and a few pieces of jewelry paint a picture of a life covered in the gaudy trappings of wealth. The collection is worth 50 gold pieces.

Murdered Composer.name:
遇害的作曲家
Murdered Composer

Text.text: 昏暗的房间里，一声声滴、滴、滴的水响稳稳敲碎寂静——云层时而裂开，月光便从敞开的帘幕间斜射进来，光影随之忽明忽暗。空气中悬着一种独特的甜腥气，夹着金属般的冷意：血。贵族的私人藏书室里，成排书册沉默地伫立，仿佛唯一的旁观者，见证着这场骇人的景象。书桌前，贵族僵冷的尸身定格在死亡里，那只枯槁的手似乎仍攥着一支并不存在的羽毛笔，像在谱写他最后的终章。深色地毯与精致的羊绒衣料几乎未被染污，猩红的液体却在刺绣纹样间汇成一汪汪暗亮的池；壁炉的火已熄，只剩些许余烬，最后的暖意也随着宅邸的主人一同被抽空。焦黑的柴木上搁着一支羽毛笔，羽翎洁净无痕，未曾被火舌亲吻。 A steady drip, drip, drip breaks the silence in the dimly lit room—the lighting waxing and waning as clouds periodically break the beams of moonlight entering through the open drapes. Hanging in the air is a uniquely sweet scent tinged with metal: blood. The books of the noble's personal library stand as silent observers, the only witnesses to the macabre scene. At the desk, frozen in death, the noble’s withered hand appears to be clutching a non-existent quill, in the act of writing his final symphony. The dark carpet and fine cashmere clothes seem barely stained as the crimson liquid pools within the embroidered patterns; the snuffed fire, with the barest embers, drains of its warmth alongside the master of the house. A quill lies upon the scorched logs, its feathers unblemished by flame.

I Dig Out From A Pile Of Gold.name:
我从一堆黄金中挖掘脱身
I Dig Out From A Pile Of Gold

Text.text:
我周遭黄金翻动的声响——钱币、金块与小饰物——灌满耳畔，化作刺耳的杂乱喧响。脸与头上好几处被撞得火辣生疼，碎片在我身上砰然磕碰、刮擦而过。双臂酸痛不已，我仍继续把自己从中挖出来，一把把攫起这堆珍贵的宝藏，朝身后奋力推开。
The sound of the gold shifting around me—coins and nuggets and trinkets—fills my ears with cacophonous clatter. Various spots on my face and head sting bright with pain as pieces clunk and scrape against me. My arms ache as I continue to dig myself out, taking handfuls of the precious hoard and shoving them in my wake.

这把武器看上去凶残无比，但手柄却以一种罕见的精巧工艺格外醒目。万花筒般的宝石与闪耀的金属沿着握把周围盘旋成细窄的纹路，每一道都是一排细小的鳞片。仿佛彩虹的每一种颜色、尘世的每一种贵金属，都会在这把武器持有者的掌心之下蜿蜒缠绕。
The weapon looks vicious, but the handle stands out as a work of unusual artistry. A kaleidoscope of gems and gleaming metals swirl in narrow lines around the grip, each a tiny row of scales. It seems like every color of the rainbow, and every precious metal of the earth, would coil under the grip of this weapon’s wielder.

古老森林深绿的黑暗浓稠得仿佛被世纪层层压实，林冠遮断阳光，地面铺满落叶、蕨羽与藤蔓。深入其间，一株三千英尺高的发光巨树耸立，枝干垂挂着苔藓般的蓝色光点，散出被玷污的幽辉——它的元素魔法已遭腐化。骸骨散落在树基，覆满盘根，亡者在此聚拢，取代了本应蓬勃的生命。

~ 构想：Goblin Man

The deep green darkness of an ancient forest has grown as dense as the centuries allow, the canopy blocking the sun and the ground covered in leaf, frond, and vine. Well into this place stands a three-thousand-foot luminescent tree, dripping with mossy blue lights that give off a befouled glow—its elemental magic corrupted. Skeletons litter its base and cover the roots, and the undead gather here in place of vibrant life.

~ Envisioned by Goblin Man

一具类人身影披覆厚重的板甲式外骨骼，挟着神圣的威权阔步而来。其形体难以界定，仿佛一名不断进化、持续蜕变的存在。它高达十二英尺，体型庞然，强壮的上肢成对高举一柄滋滋作响的静电麻痹长杖，而其下方还拖着四条退化的残臂。它的面孔凝着宗教狂热的神情，头部左侧刻着一个邪教般的徽记：一枚红色三角形，点缀着钻石般的斑点。
Clad in a thick-plated exoskeleton, a humanoid strides forward with divine authority. Their form is difficult to place, like a being constantly evolving. They are twelve feet tall, enormous in size, and carry a static stun staff in a pair of powerful upper limbs above four vestigial arms. Their face holds an expression of religious zeal, with a cult-like symbol engraved onto the left side of their head: a red triangle dotted with diamonds.

Talking To Oneself In A Library.name:
在图书馆里自言自语
Talking To Oneself In A Library

Text.text: “今晚那本summa太沉了，也太无聊。我需要一部tractatus，也许再从旧学院弄来几卷卷轴。这都是胡扯……这本是粪秽……这本倒不坏。那些主教大人也许该在锁链底下留下些什么才对。看来今天得把怀里塞得满满当当了。” “The summa is too much for tonight, and so boring. I need a tractatus, maybe a couple of scrolls from the old college. This is nonsense… This one is excrement… Not bad. The prelates should have written something down here under the chains, perhaps. It’s a day to fill my arms, it seems.”

锈蚀的尖刺、闪亮的针芒与参差的钉子从这生物青紫的躯体里突兀地探出，仿佛是从体内被硬生生锤打出来一般。你几乎找不到哪怕一寸裸露的皮肉不带锋利之物。尽管如此，这恶魔却像穿着最合身的皮囊般自在——甚至自信。它脸上缓缓绽开一道过于宽阔的笑意，露出金属般的牙齿。
Rusting spikes, shining needles, and jagged nails protrude from this creature’s bruised body, as if somehow hammered out from the inside. You can’t see more than an inch of flesh bare of something sharp. Despite this, the fiend looks comfortable in its skin—confident even. A slow smile spreads too wide across its face, revealing metallic teeth.

Car Chase Approaches Road Construction H.name:
飞车追逐逼近道路施工险障
Car Chase Approaches Road Construction Hazards

Text.text: 检测到障碍物。 仪表台内嵌的AI之声通过扬声器传出，单调而冷静。正在规划路线。 挡风玻璃的增强现实增效器勾勒出街道、其他车辆，以及前方逼近的施工区。橙色路锥投射出刺眼的警戒线，只留下一条狭窄通道，通往前方拥堵的车流。它们的红色刹车灯频频闪烁，而追击车辆的前灯灼穿你的后窗。降低速度。 车子的自动刹车猛然介入，车轮迸起火花。降低速度。碰撞迫近。警告。碰撞迫近。 Obstructions detected. The voice of the AI embedded into the dashboard carries through the speakers with monotonous calm. Charting course. The windshield’s augmented-reality enhancers trace the streets, other cars, and the impending construction site. Orange cones project bright caution lines, offering only a narrow avenue to pass through to the congested traffic ahead. Their red brake lights flash, even as the pursuing vehicle’s headlights sear through your back window. Reduce velocity. The car’s automatic brakes kick in, sparks flying up from the wheels. Reduce velocity. Crash imminent. Warning. Crash imminent.

City Street Infested With Zombies.name:
僵尸横行的城市街道
City Street Infested With Zombies

Text.text:
街上的恶臭几乎和那支可怖的尸潮一样致命。破碎的马车与货车残骸之间，尸体在蹒跚游荡——成百上千具。它们挤满楼宇间的狭道，踉跄前行时彼此撞作一团，喉间发出呻吟与嘶嘶声。有些伸出手，或试图伸出手。有些肢体瘫软坠落，腐烂的肉块从破衣烂衫的布条间垂挂摇晃。它们的眼睛浑浊发红，怒意翻涌。它们永远饥饿。
The reek of the street could kill almost as easily as the horrible crowd marching it. Among the broken carriages and wagons, corpses shamble—hundreds of them. They pack between the buildings, bumping into one another as they lurch forward, groaning and hissing. Some reach out, or try. Some drop limps, chunks of rotten flesh hanging from strips of clothing. Their eyes are watery, red, and angry. They hunger, always.

Goddess Of Commerce.name:
商业女神
Goddess Of Commerce

Text.text:
无论她选择化作哪一族，她都显得高挑出众；衣着华贵，却只佩戴寥寥几件珠宝——每一件都价值难以估量。她的魅力令人无法抗拒，或许正因那副金色面具：一张女人优雅的面容，仿佛硬币上压印出的浮雕。她的嗓音里还藏着第二支歌，带着可疑的回响，甚至有几分背叛的寒意。很快你就会明白，她既是数学天才，也是操控人心的完美高手；可你脑海里挥之不去的，只有一个念头——若由她来打理你的财富、你的行会、你的国家，该是何等壮丽。
She is tall for whatever race she chooses, richly dressed, wearing minimal jewelry of immeasurable worth. She is irresistibly charismatic in spite of, or because of, her golden mask: a woman’s elegant face, as if embossed on a coin. In her voice you detect a second song, something suspicious, even treacherous. It doesn’t take long to learn that she is a mathematical genius as well as a perfect manipulator, but you can only think of how grand it would be to have her managing your wealth, your guild, your nation.

要施放此法术，你必须在脑海中酝酿一千个阴毒的念头。你想象自己与盟友坠落在可怖的厄运之下，遭遇荒诞的残毁与诡异的魔法。没有任何触发会离奇到不配出现，也没有任何诡计或幻象会狡猾到无法设想。当你已死过百回，你再构思十余种残忍的结局，随后敞开你的感官，去聆听魔法告诉你何者为真。
To cast this spell, you must think a thousand devious thoughts. You envision yourself and your allies falling prey to terrible dooms, outlandish maiming, and weird magic. No trigger is too bizarre and no trick or illusion too clever. When you’ve died a hundred times, you imagine another dozen cruel fates, then open your senses to learn what the magic tells you is true.

Retina-scanning Door Lock.name:
视网膜扫描门锁
Retina-scanning Door Lock

Text.text:
这把古怪的锁上既没有钥匙孔，也没有数字键盘；只有一枚孤零零的摄像头镜头。它为守护最隐秘的情报与资源而生——视网膜扫描锁是最尖端的科技，只会对某一个人的视网膜特征作出响应。防护森严，却并非坚不可破——只要你不介意把手弄脏。
No keyhole or number pad is present on the curious lock; there is only a single camera lens. Designed to safeguard the most clandestine information and resources, the retina-scanning lock is state-of-the-art technology calibrated to just one person’s retinal signature. A formidable defense, but not an impregnable one—if one doesn’t mind getting their hands dirty.

Enhance Ability, A Momentary Connection.name:
强化能力，一瞬的连结
Enhance Ability, A Momentary Connection

Text.text:
你完成了咒文，魔宠般的激流沿着你的手臂奔涌而下，贯穿你的盟友。刹那间，你们之间建立起一丝连结——你的一缕魔法注入其中，令他们更为坚韧；但随即这感觉便消散无踪，只留下一个清晰的认知：他们已然更强。
You finish the incantation and a familiar surge races down your arm and through your ally. For a moment, there is a connection between you as a piece of your magic reinforces them, but then it is gone and you are left with only the knowledge that they are stronger.

Deserted House: Inside.name:
废弃屋：室内
Deserted House: Inside

Text.text:
房子静默伫立，仿佛在等待。它的阴影吞没了你脚步的声响，于是你只听见脚下地板在低声呻吟。你恍惚觉得甚至能听见自己的心跳；而当你凝神去听，它之外又有别的声音。是一阵微风？那听起来像空气更深地被房子吸入——一声无声的吸气，随即屏息。可紧接着你意识到，屏息的人其实是你。
The house stands silent, waiting. Its shadows swallow the sound of your steps, so you hear the quiet cries of the floorboards beneath your feet. You fancy you can even hear your own heart beating; and, as you strain to hear it you hear something else. A breeze? It sounded like air drawing deeper into the house, a quiet inhalation and the breath being held. But then you realize you are holding your breath.

In The Marsh: Flora And Fauna.name:
沼泽之中：动植物群
In The Marsh: Flora And Fauna

Text.text:
一片翠绿纠结的植被在你周围蔓延开来，从乌黑的水面里疯长而出；水面被浮萍染得鲜绿，斑驳成片。蜻蜓在嗡鸣的蚊蝇云团间疾掠穿梭，呱呱叫的青蛙拼命提高嗓门，仍几乎要被蝉与蟋蟀齐鸣的合唱淹没。
A green tangle of vegetation sprawls out around you, sprouting up from black water splotched vibrant green by duckweed. Dragonflies dart through buzzing clouds of flies and mosquitoes, while croaking frogs strain to be heard over the chorus of cicadas and crickets.

主厅里摆着各色植物、一块黑板，以及供上课学员就座的座位。新翻的泥土与葱郁绿意的土腥香气充满整个区域，大多令人愉悦，唯独还缠着一丝挥之不去的酸馊味。入口对面有一扇巨大的玻璃门，通向温室更深处。门上蚀刻着一个符号，你注意到它每隔几分钟就会变换一次，门后的环境也随之更迭。你看着它轮转展示一幕幕狂野不驯的植物群落：密林、荒漠，甚至还有一整片完全没入水下的珊瑚礁。
The main chamber features a variety of plants, a chalkboard, and seats for the attending class. The earthy aroma of fresh soil and greenery flood the area with mostly pleasant aromas, save a lingering sour smell. A large glass door across from the entrance leads deeper into the conservatory. Etched upon this door is a symbol, which, you notice, changes every few minutes, as does the environment beyond. You watch it cycle through wild, untamed collections of flora: jungles, deserts, and even a fully submerged coral reef.

风化的巨石垒成一圈高大的石环，矗立在一座小丘上，正是远古宏伟瞭望塔最后残存的遗迹。平整的石板铺满地面，草尖从光滑的缝隙间探出头来。一株虬结的孤树在微风中倔强摇曳，粗壮的根系牢牢扎入坚固的木栅，如同永恒的哨兵，守望着下方的圣所。
Mighty blocks of weathered stone form a large ring on a small hill, the last vestiges of a great watchtower from ages past. Grass peeks through the smooth flagstones covering the ground. A gnarled, solitary tree sways defiantly in the breeze, thick roots anchored firmly into the formidable palisade, keeping eternal watch over the shrine below.

Severed Goblinoid Head.name:
被斩下的地精类头颅
Severed Goblinoid Head

Text.text:
一名猎人的腰带上，吊着一颗女性类地精的头颅——她那一头长长的白发把她悬在半空。恶臭扑鼻，鲜杀的断颈仍在渗血。她死后的眼神反倒更凶狠，直勾勾望向前方，仿佛执念般盯上某个无辜的目标要将其毁灭。她的嘴大张着，舌头垂在尖利、发霉的獠牙之间。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The head of a female goblinoid hangs by her long white hair from the belt of a hunter. The stench is horrible, as blood still oozes from the neck of the fresh kill. Her eyes seem even more vicious in death, staring ahead as if obsessing on an innocent to destroy. Her mouth is open, the tongue dangling between pointed, moldy fangs.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Bahamut, The Platinum Dragon.name:
巴哈姆特，白金龙
Bahamut, The Platinum Dragon

Text.text:
哪怕只是一个首饰匣里装满铂金币的商人，也很可能早已名声在外；而以铂金币付款的贵族，多半出自古老而根基深厚的家族。既如此，试想一条以铂金铸成、最庞大也最睿智的巨龙——他的利爪在邪恶军团的护甲上淬炼成锋。眼前便是伟大的巴哈姆特，在月光或日光下熠熠生辉：北风之主、七重天之天使、巨龙之祖、勇武者，伴随正义与律法的神祇同行。相较于他喷吐的寒息或令人瘫痪的咆哮，他最偏爱的武器，是外交。
A merchant with even one jewelry box filled with platinum is likely famous, and a noble who pays in platinum is probably of an old and established family. Think, then, of the largest and wisest of dragons made of it, his claws tempered from it on the armor of evil brigades. Here is the great Bahamut gleaming in moonlight or sunlight, Lord of the North Wind, Angel of the Seven Heavens, Grandfather of Dragons, The Valiant, who accompanies the gods of justice and law. His favored weapon, over his breath of cold or paralyzing roar, is diplomacy.

东北山坡上，三层台地的脊线被各式各样的帐篷排排占满。朴素衣着的人群之中，身披礼仪法衣的祭司穿梭于营地，时而驻足交谈，时而赐福，或与他们一同祈祷。若非正忙于交谈、用餐或操练，营地里的人便面朝南面山上的神殿，抬起双臂，或惊叹，或哀求。
Rows of tents of all different styles crest three tiers of the northeastern hillside. Amidst the folk in plain clothing, priests in ceremonial garb weave through the campers, stopping to speak, bless, or pray with them. If not engaged in conversation, a meal, or exercise, the campers face the temple on the hill to the south, raising their arms in wonder or supplication.

Insult About Being Alone.name:
关于孤身一人的侮辱
Insult About Being Alone

Text.text:
“你以为爱是别人欠你的——而不是你自己挣来的——所以无论你把自己包围在多少人之中，你终将永远孤独。”
“You think love is something owed—not something earned—and that is why you will always be alone, no matter who you surround yourself with.”

Speech By A Lich About Dreams.name:
巫妖关于梦境的演说
Speech By A Lich About Dreams

Text.text:
“再睡一次……我曾以为没有睡眠，我终于会有足够的时代去推演我们宇宙那不可思议的方程；可在我所有无眠的时辰里，始终无法摆脱那股深沉的渴望——再度漫游于梦之国度。我踏遍遥远而被遗忘的位面，却没有任何一处能媲美梦境曾带我穿越长夜时的那份自由。”
“To sleep once more… I thought without it, I would finally have time to calculate the unimaginable equations of our universe, but in all my sleepless hours, I cannot shake the deep longing to wander in the land of dreams once more. I have traveled distant and forgotten planes but none have matched the freedom of the dreams that used to carry me through the night.”

烛火在同一阵轻柔的微风里摇曳，那风也拂动着你面前纠结倒伏的树枝上方垂挂的旗串。借着烛光的微弱亮度，你看清绳索上串起的三角旗被染成了秋日的色调。枝杈与旗串粗略地围成一圈，环绕着一株曾经参天大树的树桩；在那树桩顶上，更多燃烧的蜡烛簇拥着一张质朴的白木王座。
Candles flicker in the same gentle breeze that flutters the strings of pennants that hang over the tangle of fallen tree boughs before you. In the meager light of the candles, you see that the triangular flags strung along the rope are dyed autumnal colors. The branches and pennants roughly encircle the stump of a once-mighty tree, atop which more burning candles surround a rustic throne of white wood.

Rolling Stone Trap.name:
滚石陷阱
Rolling Stone Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 地面上一大片区域看起来像是某种陷阱的触发点，但究竟会引发什么却并不明显。

[发现] 这里天花板的一大片区域似乎被设计成能开启，或干脆坍落下来。究竟会发生什么、又会如何被触发，仍不清楚。

[已触发！] 脚下地面吱呀作响、猛然错动，紧接着是一声震耳欲聋的轰！你循着那石磨石般狂暴的刮擦声抬头，只见一颗巨大的岩石球正朝你滚来。

[Perceived] A wide section of the floor appears to be the trigger for some kind of trap, but for what exactly isn’t readily apparent.

[Discovered] A vast section of the ceiling here looks like it is designed to open or perhaps fall down. It’s unclear what precisely would happen or how it would be triggered.

[Triggered!] The floor creaks and shifts underfoot, followed immediately by a thunderous boom! You look up at the sound of furious scraping of stone on stone and see a massive ball of rock rolling right at you.

Half Plate Armor +3.name:
半身板甲 +3
Half Plate Armor +3

Text.text:
从外表看，它是一套笨重的护甲：厚实的金属板层层咬合、沉重相扣；然而这副半身板甲实际上轻巧舒适，与穿戴者的身形严丝合缝。锁子甲加固了本就可观防护中的每一处薄弱点，结实的皮带与扣具将甲片牢牢束定。金属在细微移动时，几乎难以察觉的嗡鸣随之逸出，回荡着一种古老到早已被遗忘的魔法。
In appearance, it is a cumbersome suit of armor with heavy, interlocking metal plates, but the half plate is in actuality light, comfortable, and perfectly fitted to its wearer. Chain mail reinforces any weak points in the already considerable protection, with sturdy straps and buckles binding the plates securely. An almost imperceptible hum emanates from the metal as it shifts, reverberating with an enchantment so ancient as to be forgotten.

半身人女子披着宽松舒适、宛如大地馈赠般的自然色衣裳，臂弯里挎着一只空空的柳条篮。稻草金般的松软卷发拢着她柔和而年轻的脸庞，她朝你递来温暖迷人的微笑——不含丝毫恶意或不轨之心。
Draped in loose, comfortable clothing in the hues of nature’s bounty, the halfling woman holds an empty wicker basket in the crook of her arm. Loose curls of straw-blond hair frame a soft, youthful face and she offers you a warm, charming smile—devoid of any malice or ill-intent.

I Cast Shillelagh Using A Shamrock Leaf.name:
我以三叶草叶施展荆棍术
I Cast Shillelagh Using A Shamrock Leaf

Text.text:
我用拇指与食指轻轻旋转三叶草的茎，将那片分裂的叶面掠过我的木制武器。低声呢喃的咒语唤醒木头对自身自然本源的记忆，令其迸发出葱郁鲜活的绿意——生命与大地的智慧再度在其中流淌。
Twirling the shamrock stem between my thumb and forefinger, I pass the lobed leaf over my wooden weapon. My whispered incantation awakens the wood’s memory of its natural origins, causing it to sprout with vibrant greenery—life and the earth’s wisdom flowing through it once more.

Loot From A Shambling Mound.name:
从一团蹒跚行走的腐植堆里搜出的战利品
Loot From A Shambling Mound

Text.text:
你用力扯开那一层层筋络般的藤蔓，植物纤维在你手下发出尖细的哀鸣，被你从那臃肿纠结的躯块上生生撕离。一只骷髅手从那团物质里缓缓抬起，像溺海之人绝望伸出的触及。你揭出一具完整——却支离破碎——的骷髅：它的骨头早被这生物躯体中不断挪动的卷须扯散、拉开。除此之外，再无任何有机之物可寻——受害者的血肉与皮革饰物早已被啃噬殆尽——但你仍找到一柄毫无损伤的银匕首、一枚刻着圣徽的奖章，以及几枚钢制箭头，被几缕细小蜷曲的新芽几乎带着怜爱般地缠在一起。
You pull at the sinewy layers of vine, the plant matter whining as you tear it free from the bloated, knotty form. A skeletal hand slowly rises from the mass like a desperate reach of someone drowning at sea. You uncover a full—if dismembered—skeleton, its bones having been pulled apart by the ever-shifting tendrils of this creature’s body. Though there are no more organic items to be found—the victim’s flesh and leather accoutrements having long since been eaten away—you do find an unmarred silver dagger, a medallion carved with a holy symbol, and several steel arrowheads tangled almost lovingly by little curling shoots.

尽管这只是个用胶带和塑料胶水勉强粘合的粗陋装置，这门自制迫击炮一旦能正常运作，依旧可能造成毁灭性的效果。那段被锯开的大口径管子，接在一个简易的点火系统上，怎么看都像是会在命中预定目标的同时，把操作它的人也一并送上绝路。
Though it is a crude device held together with duct tape and plastic cement, the homemade mortar has the potential to be devastatingly effective—if it works. The single piece of large pipe, sawn through and fixed to a rudimentary ignition system, looks like it would kill the operator as soon as its intended target.

Divine Wilds Of A God Of Beasts.name:
兽神的神圣荒野
Divine Wilds Of A God Of Beasts

Text.text:
雾蒙蒙的一天里，有一片镜湖，平展如板岩，贴着山脚沉默休息；它把山巅映给环绕其上的云之议会。湖缘铺着蕨类与覆苔的枯倒木，巨石散落，泥泞的岸线蜿蜒。麝鼠原始的巢屋半没在水里，像隐士的小屋；一片葱茏之间，盛开着各色花朵。花期随四季更迭，而湖水向兽群诸序发出共聚的召唤：召它们来饮水与沉睡，争斗与交配，抚育与和解，并为每一条生命各自永恒的路途达成默契。
There is a mirror lake on a hazy day, resting flat as slate beneath a mountain, reflecting the peak to the parliament of clouds surrounding it. At the edge of the lake are ferns and mossy deadfall, boulders and muddy shores. The primitive house of a muskrat sits partly submerged like a hermit’s hut, and among the greenery are flowers of every color. The blooms change with the seasons, and the lake calls communion to the orders of the beasts: calls them to drink and sleep, fight and mate, nurture and agree on the life path to each one’s eternity.

Wild Magic Surge: Stunted Growth.name:
狂野魔法涌动：发育停滞
Wild Magic Surge: Stunted Growth

Text.text:
你的身躯仿佛被扭曲变形，魔法如潮水般倾泻而下，浸透并穿行于你体内。随后，你的视角骤然一变，你这才意识到自己正以不同的高度注视着这个世界。
Your body seems to warp as magic pours over and through you. Then your perspective shifts and you realize you’re now seeing the world from a different height.

Short Travel Across The Under Plane.name:
穿越下层位面的短途旅行
Short Travel Across The Under Plane

Text.text:
你踏上旅程，心中并不确定前方会遇见什么。墨色的黑暗将一切裹进无法穿透的阴影里，连空气也仿佛被漂浮的尘螨与孢子染得发暗。枯骨般的树木在冰冷刺耳的寒风中吱呀作响，你从它们的树皮纹理里看见咧笑的骷髅与隐在阴影中的眼睛。你在这片昏暗的荒原上尽可能快地前行，直到——终于——你看见目的地就在眼前。
You embark on your journey unsure of what you might find. An inky darkness shrouds everything in impenetrable shadows, even the air seems darkened with floating mites and spores. Skeletal trees creak in a chill, rasping wind, and in the patterns of their bark you see grinning skulls and shadowed eyes. You move as quickly as you dare through the dark expanse, until—finally—you see your destination before you.

你在心中勾勒出守护的区域，想象一张细密的网横跨其上，宛如一片无形蛛网，中央悬着一只铃铛。任何不受欢迎的闯入者都会在不知不觉间踏入你的蛛网，触响那枚铃铛。
You mentally define the area of protection and imagine a fine net strung across it, like an invisible spiderweb, with a bell hung in the center. Any unwelcome intruder will unwittingly walk into your web and ring that bell.

蜥蜴人男子漫不经心地弹出分叉的舌头，膝上摊着那本巨著，他一边翻页一边赞许地点头。聪慧的爬行类眼眸以惊人的速度扫过页上的文字——然而他的专注不容置疑。他绝非寻常学者：这名爬行类人形生物身披上过油的皮革护甲——染得如午夜般漆黑——胸前扣着一副投掷匕首，背上交叉绑着两把阴森锋利的长剑。

~ 由 Rageman13 构想

The lizardfolk man flicks a forked tongue out absentmindedly as he turns the page of the tome he has in his lap and nods appreciatively. Intelligent reptilian eyes scan the words of the page at incredible speed—yet his focus is undeniable. No mere scholar, the reptilian humanoid is clad in oiled leather armor—dyed black as midnight—with a brace of throwing knives on his chest and two wickedly sharp swords strapped across his back.

~ Envisioned by Rageman13

Pre-battle Quip By A Pious Paladin.name:
虔诚圣骑士的战前短句
Pre-battle Quip By A Pious Paladin

Text.text:
“神祇将注视着这场战斗，而我打算为他们献上一场好戏。”
“The gods will be watching this battle and I intend to give them a good show.”

你吟诵出一缕甲壳般坚硬的辅音，随即轻弹食指。你的目标开始抽搐、发痒，恼人的刺痒一路攀升至恐慌，仿佛无数挠痒的虫群席卷了他们全身。
You incant a strand of chitinous consonants and flick your index finger. Your target begins to twitch, and itch, irritation rising to panic as the sensation of tickling insects swarms their entire body.

Pursuit By A Devil.name:
恶魔的追猎
Pursuit By A Devil

Text.text:
一道身影在门口化作剪影——矮敦敦、如葫芦般的轮廓，皮革般的翅膀勾勒着那颗疙瘩起伏的头颅。恶魔踏入屋内，先探进来的是一枚肿胀、蜡黄的下巴。居高临下的眼神越过因厌恶而翻起的肥厚嘴唇俯视着你——露出一排如碎陶般参差的牙。它攥紧粗大的拳头。它那副姿态仿佛在宣告：你不过是它此行要来清除的害虫。

~ 构想：Rythmn

A shape appears in silhouette at the doorway, squat and gourd-like, leathery wings framing a knobby head. The devil steps into the building, leading with a bulbous, sallow chin. Condescending eyes peer down over a plump lip curled in revulsion—revealing a row of broken-pottery teeth. It clenches its sizable fists. The way it carries itself suggests that you are the vermin it has come to exterminate.

~ Envisioned by Rythmn

银质护符在你掌心沉甸甸的。你将它凑近细读金属上蚀刻的细小符号时，陌生油脂刺鼻的气味扑面而来，呛得你几欲作呕。遗物上，一条风格化的巨龙自其中探出目光，以红宝石般的双眼与你对视。你有那么一瞬发誓那生物是活的，正直视你的灵魂，衡量你的价值。随即那感觉倏然散去，而你与护符之间生出一种新的契合——它会保护你。
The silver talisman lies heavy in your hand, and the pungent smell of strange oils makes you gag as you bring it closer to read the tiny symbols etched in the metal. A stylized dragon looks out from the relic, meeting your gaze with ruby eyes. You swear for a moment that the creature is alive, looking into your soul, judging your worth. Then the moment passes, and you feel a new affinity with the talisman—it will protect you.

Vampire's Manor: Secret, Subterranean St.name:
吸血鬼（特征）的庄园：隐秘的地下阶梯
Vampire's Manor: Secret, Subterranean Staircase

Text.text:
隐蔽在视线之外的石阶一路向下，没入难以穿透的黑暗。台阶狭窄湿滑，落脚余地寥寥，这段攀行险象环生。你在黑暗中摸索前进，借着覆满黏液的墙壁稳住身形，时不时触到厚重的蛛网与成堆的尘土在指间碎散。最终你摸到最后一级台阶，脚边传来骨头哗啦作响的碰撞声。
The stone staircase, concealed from view, descends into impenetrable darkness. The narrow, slippery steps provide little clearance, and the climb is a precarious one. You feel around in the darkness, using the slime-coated walls for balance, periodically feeling thick spiderwebs and heaps of dust disintegrate in your hands. Bones clatter at your feet as you finally find the last step.

Speech By A Drunk Freighter Pilot About.name:
一个醉醺醺的货船飞行员关于旅行枯燥乏味的演讲
Speech By A Drunk Freighter Pilot About The Boredom Of Traveling

Text.text:
“我出去是想找点真正有价值的东西，可到头来全是一坨烂泥。新的星球，新的星系，新的酒吧，新的物种——都无所谓。你一旦在干活，这些东西就没一样能留在你心里。它们全都在工作和酒精的迷雾里从你身边滑过去。也许你能东拼西凑攒够本钱，找到这片银河里一个你勉强能忍的角落——但更可能的是，你会像这个该死星系里其他每一块垃圾一样，被排进黑暗的虚空。”
“I went out there looking for something worthwhile, but it’s all the same crap. New planets, new systems, new bars, new species, doesn’t matter. None of it sticks with you when you’re on the job. It all just slips on by in a haze of work and drinks. Maybe you scrape together enough to find a corner of this galaxy you can stand—but more likely you end up vented into the black, like every other piece of trash in this damn system.”

College Of Whispers Bard.name:
低语学院吟游诗人
College Of Whispers Bard

Text.text:
吟游诗人那身荒诞俏皮的戏服，与他们从乐器里引出的阴森旋律格格不入。他们唱着令人毛骨悚然的故事——自负的蠢徒如何迎来应得的下场。沉郁的阴影笼罩观众，恐惧的气息缠在他们弓起的肩头与躲闪的目光间。吟游诗人自己那警觉的眼睛在人群里游走，锋利得如同披风阴影里一闪而过的匕首寒光。
The bard’s whimsical costume is at odds with the eerie melody they coax from their instrument. They sing haunting tales of boastful fools and their just deserts. A somber pall descends over the audience, an air of fear about their bowed shoulders and furtive gazes. The bard’s own watchful eyes rove over the crowd, as sharp as the dagger that glints in the shadows of their cloak.

Walrus-like Armed Mercenary.name:
海象般的武装佣兵
Walrus-like Armed Mercenary

Text.text:
佣兵厚重的腮肉上刻着仪式般的狰狞部族符号，苍白的疤痕组织与他们肥软的肉体形成刺眼反差。巨大的獠牙自颌间突出，宛如象牙砍刀；他们携带的武器装备皆为军用级别。最令人震撼的是那具庞大的榴弹发射器斜背在结实的背脊上，外壳还涂着工业危害警示条纹。
The mercenary’s heavy jowls have been ritually scarred with striking tribal symbols, the pale scar tissue at odds with their blubbery flesh. Huge tusks protrude from their jaw like ivory machetes, and the armaments they carry are military grade. Most impressive is the hulking grenade launcher slung across their muscular back, and decorated with industrial hazard stripes.

Clockwork Scarab Timepiece.name:
发条圣甲虫怀表
Clockwork Scarab Timepiece

Text.text:
这只暗哑黄铜的发条甲虫，体型约有成年男子一只大手那么大。把它放在炽热的表面上后，它会不断升温，直至达到某个温度，圣甲虫便骤然苏醒。它从原处爬向敞开的门或窗，一边冷却一边以气压为读数。最终，一枚镶着绿松石、折叠贴在胸甲上的小表盘猛然竖起，细小的铃铛叮当作响，奏出一串分解和弦。
The dull brass clockwork bug is the size of a large man’s hand. After being set on a hot surface, it heats until, at a certain temperature, the scarab comes to life. It crawls from its position to an open door or window and reads the air pressure as it cools. Finally, a watch trimmed in turquoise and folded against its thorax pops up vertically and plays an arpeggio with tiny chimes.

High Seas: Below Deck.name:
公海：甲板之下
High Seas: Below Deck

Text.text:
阳光永远照不进这里，低矮的天花板上，几盏挂在钩子上的灯笼摇来晃去，却投不出多少亮光。空气陈腐滞重，满是油烟的味道、汗腥的体味，还有用来填补吱呀作响木板缝隙的黑色沥青气息。脚下船身的摇晃比甲板上更为剧烈，你的头随着摆动的灯影左右晃荡，贴着一面墙又挪向另一面墙，与那摇曳的灯笼同一时代起伏。
The sun never penetrates here, and the few lanterns swaying from hooks in the low ceiling cast too little light. The air smells stale, heavy with the scent of oil smoke, body odor, and the black tar used to caulk leaks in the creaking wood. The rocking of the ship beneath your feet seems stronger than up top, as your head bobs from one wall to the other in time with the swinging lamps.

Elvira Silverhand, The Golden Lotus.name:
埃尔维拉·银手，「金莲」
Elvira Silverhand, The Golden Lotus

Text.text:
金光装点着这名女子，从她红金相间的发丝到她的圆盾与那面刻着莲花纹章的胸甲，无一不闪耀。她昂首挺立。那张晒成小麦色、笑纹浅浅的脸庞从容放松，翠绿的眼睛却锐利而坚定，目光不曾动摇。精灵以宽阔的步姿站定，盾牌压低却向前顶出，右手握着一条带倒刺的金色长鞭，盘卷待发。

~ 由 Mr_Valkyrial Played

Gold bedecks this woman, from her red-blond locks to her buckler and lotus-emblazoned breastplate. She holds her head high. Her tan, laugh-lined face is relaxed, her emerald-eyed gaze sharp and unwavering. The elf stands in a wide stance, keeping her shield low but forward with a barbed golden whip coiled in her right hand.

~ Played by Mr_Valkyrial

她那束黑色马尾里掺着的几缕白丝、以及眼角细密的鱼尾纹，是最容易衡量这位大副年代的标记；常年活跃的海上生涯，让她依旧强健敏捷。她从宽檐帽的阴影下俯视船员，一眼便知她的嗓音丝毫未损——当船长守夜般凝视着地平线时，大副便用嘶厉的号令不绝如缕地轰鸣，凭着近乎残酷的效率，指挥这群杂七杂八的海狗奔赴数十项差事。
The white streaks in her black ponytail and the crow’s feet at the corners of her eyes are the only easy measure of the first mate’s age, who has been kept strong and agile by an active life at sea. Peering out over the crew from under her wide-brimmed hat, it is apparent her voice has not suffered in the least—as the captain watches the horizon, the first mate barks orders in an endless litany, directing the motley band of sea dogs to their dozens of tasks with brutal efficiency.

他把一条褪色的红围裙从头上套下，体格敦实、肤色苍白的男人哼着轻快的小调，在狭小的船舱厨房里忙忙碌碌，从钉在木板墙上的破旧木柜里取出食材与厨具。他那饱经风霜的皮肤呈现出被日光漂白的骨色浅黄；而他的眼睛——暴风雨后海面般的深灰——在点燃小炉时泛起令人安心的暖意，迫不及待要施展他的烹饪手艺。厨师把一个大木碗夹在粗壮的臂弯里，用力搅拌，手臂上的纹身随之弯折伸展，仿佛涟漪水面里的倒影。那深黑粗重的线条在他惨白的皮肤上格外醒目：一枚顶部被切开的骷髅成了碗，里面盛着一锅浓稠丰盛的炖汤。他带着一丝怅然的笑意，将碗里的混合物倒入一口圆肚锅里，最后撒上一撮香草，随后顺着船身轻轻摇晃的节奏进入舒适的韵律，用结实的木勺稳稳搅动着锅中翻滚的香气。

~ Played by Arghur (Argie) the Odorous Magistrate with

Looping a faded red apron over his head, the stocky, pale man hums a jaunty tune as he potters about the small galley kitchen, collecting ingredients and utensils from battered wooden cupboards nailed to the timber walls. His weathered skin is the pale yellow of sun-bleached bone, and his eyes—dark gray like the sea after a storm—shine with a comforting warmth as he lights a small stove, eager to ply his culinary trade. Holding a large wooden bowl in the crook of his brawny arm, the chef stirs vigorously, causing his tattoo to bend and flex like a reflection in a rippling pool. The dark, bold lines are striking against his pallid skin: a skull, cut at the top, forms a bowl filled with a hearty stew. Smiling wistfully, he pours the mixture from the bowl into a pot-bellied pan, adds a final dash of herbs, then settles into a comfortable rhythm in time with the gentle rocking of the ship, stirring the pot with a robust wooden ladle.

~ Played by Arghur (Argie) the Odorous Magistrate with

杂技演员以一连串翻腾开场。他们掷骰般滚入舞台中央，随即挺身而起，双臂舒展，向众人致意。舞步一启，身影便化作一团斑斓的流光，如同发狂的蝴蝶般自由而狂野。他们翻滚、旋转、腾跃；单手背在身后，侧手翻如风掠过；越过桌面，落地便盘膝而坐；又以令人不安的优雅倒立行走。人群惊叹连连，齐声呼喊随着每一次专长的递进而愈发高涨。

~ Envisioned by Fentoozler

The acrobat begins with a flurry of somersaults. They roll to center-stage before springing up tall, widening their arms in greeting. Their body blurs into a mess of color as they begin their dance, free and wild as a maddened butterfly. They tumble, spin, and flip. They cartwheel, one arm behind their back. They leap over tables and land cross-legged. They walk on their hands with unnerving grace. The crowd cries in awe, their collective voice rising with each successive feat.

~ Envisioned by Fentoozler

Potion Of Clairvoyance.name:
灵视药剂
Potion Of Clairvoyance

Text.text:
这只药剂瓶里装着的黄色液体，看起来活像鸡肉肉汁。但当你瞥见其中漂浮着一颗布满血丝的眼球时，你立刻觉得它没那么可口了。
The yellow liquid in this potion bottle resembles chicken gravy. But when you spy the veiny eyeball floating within, you imagine it as rather less tasty.

Rebuke From An Angel.name:
天使的斥责
Rebuke From An Angel

Text.text:
“在我被创造之初，我被赐予了对一切生灵的爱。但你们那血肉之躯里竟能藏匿的堕落深渊，让我明白：面对你们这般忘恩负义的怪物，爱并不是恰当的情感。”
“Upon my creation, I was gifted with a love for all living creatures. But the depths of depravity that can reside in your fleshy bodies has made me realize that love is not the proper emotion for dealing with such ungrateful abominations.”

Channel Divinity: Turn The Undead.name:
引导神力：驱散亡灵
Channel Divinity: Turn The Undead

Text.text:
你高举圣徽，伴随着一道耀眼的圣光闪现，将一股神圣能量的浪潮猛然向外迸射。光芒吞没了附近的不死生物，转瞬之间，许多便在其中毙灭，躯体崩解成尘，被那炽烈的光辉彻底抹除。其余者在能量余波中惊惶溃逃，踉跄拖行着远离，只为躲避它们最为畏惧之物的进一步惩戒：天界的神祇。
You hold the holy symbol aloft and, with a flash of radiant light, you send a wave of divine energy hurtling outward. The light envelops the nearby undead, and in an instant many perish, crumbling to dust as the radiant energy obliterates them. Others flee in the wake of the energy, turning to shamble away and avoid further retribution from that which they fear most: the celestial gods.

Elemental Bane: Fire.name:
元素祸害：火焰
Elemental Bane: Fire

Text.text:
恶意的能量在你周身扭动缠绕，凝成一道脉动的光环，喷薄出炽烈的威势。空气里弥漫着魔法那股甜腻得令人作呕的气息，像末日逼近时刺鼻的恶臭。你开启与远方宿敌之间的通道，身形随之闪烁不定，试图剥落他们的防御，让他们在你所驾驭的力量面前更加脆弱。
Malicious energy writhes around you, forming a pulsating aura of fiery might. A sickly sweet scent of magic fills the air, a biting stench of approaching doom. Your form flickers as you open a channel between you and your distant foe, attempting to strip away their defenses and heighten their vulnerability to the powers you command.

I Cast Mass Cure Wounds.name:
我施放「群体治愈伤口」
I Cast Mass Cure Wounds

Text.text:
我念出法术的咒言，喉间的吐息化作薄荷般清冽的药雾。带着凉意的海沫青能量如薄雾漫开，洗过这片区域。云雾中的人眼看着伤口开始愈合：断骨咔哒复位，血液倒渗回创口，皮肉自行缝合如初。
I speak the words of my spell and my breath is a minty tincture in my throat. A mist of cooling, seafoam-green energy bathes the area. Those within the cloud watch their wounds begin to mend: bones crack back into place, blood seeps back into wounds, and flesh stitches back together.

Ostentatious High-fashion Outfit.name:
华丽张扬的高级时装套装
Ostentatious High-fashion Outfit

Text.text:
华丽礼服是一套为上流精英量身打造的装束。它以大胆奢靡的设计夺人眼球：金属质地的面料、繁复精致的细节，以及会随穿戴者情绪同步变换、绽放炽艳光彩的高科技配饰。纵然风格张扬，这身行头仍配备了顶级的个人护盾发生器，为安全提供一丝保障。
The grandiose suit is a garment created for the elite. Its bold and extravagant designs feature metallic fabrics, intricate details, and high-tech accessories that glow vibrant colors synchronized with the wearer's mood. Despite its flamboyant flair, the ensemble sports a top-of-the-range personal shield generator, for a modicum of safety.

Taunt From A Sphinx.name:
来自斯芬克斯的嘲弄
Taunt From A Sphinx

Text.text:
“真相乃是一道谜，不会因希望或善念而现身，也无法用斧与剑撬开。你们的手段粗鄙，你们的心智孱弱。回到你们那无知的生存里去吧，因为你们不配踏入这知识的墓窟。”
“Truth is an enigma, not found through hope or good intentions, nor pried loose with axes and swords. Your methods are crude, your minds weak. Return to your ignorant existence, for you are not worthy of walking within these catacombs of knowledge.”

Massive Metal Orcish Fortress.name:
巨型金属兽人堡垒
Massive Metal Orcish Fortress

Text.text:
这些兽人把永不停歇的熔炉所吐出的烟黑铁作坊打磨到了极致。锯齿般的金属高墙外，树桩围成一圈，枯死的灌丛与干裂的土地一同环抱其间。粗大的紧固件与潦草的焊缝勉强将其拴住，铆钉与扣眼处渗出红橙色的锈痕，一道道往下淌。矮人绝不会用这种手法干活。黑色大门与锯齿状的金属垛口压在灰烬般的黑云之下，竟把其他黑暗领主的要塞都衬得像乡镇集市。

~ 构想：MASON YATES

These orcs have perfected the smoky black ironworks coming from forges that run constantly. A circle of stumps, dying undergrowth, and dry ground surrounds the jagged metal wall. Fasteners and rough welds hold it together, red-orange rust trickling down from rivets and grommets. Dwarves could never work this way. The black gate and jagged metal crenellations under the black cloud of ash make the keeps of other dark lords look like county fairs.

~ Envisioned by MASON YATES

盾牌正面被打造成一张沉睡的面孔，眼睑低垂，嘴角松弛。除此之外，它看起来并不起眼。当你把手臂滑入皮革握带时，发现贴合得相当紧实。
The front of the shield is fashioned to resemble a face asleep, eyelids heavy and mouth slack. Other than that, it appears rather unremarkable. As you slide your arm into the leather grip, you find the fit quite snug.

Creepy Forest Trail.name:
阴森的森林小径
Creepy Forest Trail

Text.text:
小径蜿蜒盘旋，令人抓狂，仿佛一条毒蛇绕着自己盘成死结。你拖着疲惫的步子前行，却感觉脚下始终没有跨过半里路。树木压迫般从头顶逼近，拥挤成墙，在温吞的微风里吱呀作响；那风只带来腐烂的甜腻恶臭，以及远处掠食者的嚎叫。你抬头搜寻星光，寻一瞥月影，寻一丝亮意——却只见黑暗，空洞而漆黑的黑暗。
The trail winds, maddeningly, coiling like a serpent upon itself. You trudge, weary, yet feel no leagues pass beneath your feet. The trees, oppressive, crowd you from above, creaking in a tepid breeze that carries only the sickly sweet smell of rot and the howl of distant predators. You search the sky above for stars, for a glimpse of the moon, for a hint of light—but find nothing but black, empty darkness.

这名类人生物足有两层楼高，皮肤呈远山般的蓝灰色，双眼如钢铁般明亮。生物警惕地审视着周遭，紧握着一根巨大的棍棒——它或许曾是一棵树。仅仅是它的呼吸便足以撼动环境，而每一次移动，都让大地低沉轰鸣。
The humanoid stands two stories tall, with skin the blue-gray of a distant mountain and eyes bright like steel. The creature observes its surroundings with caution, gripping a massive club that may have once been a tree. The very breath of this creature affects the surroundings, and with each movement, the ground rumbles.

Ioun Stone Of Sustenance.name:
艾欧恩石（自给自足）
Ioun Stone Of Sustenance

Text.text:
如同一粒水晶晶砂，这枚纺锤状石头在渐尖的轮廓中透出夺目的澄澈。它仿佛完美无瑕、通体透明——不见任何内含瑕疵或纹理——并以柔和而回荡的能量低鸣，让你感到充盈且神清气爽。
Like a grain of crystal, the spindle-shaped stone has a striking clarity in its tapered design. The stone seems perfectly translucent—with no internal flaws or striations—and it hums with a soft, resonant energy that makes you feel full and refreshed.

Military-grade Mortar.name:
军用级迫击炮
Military-grade Mortar

Text.text:
迫击炮那橄榄绿色的炮管光滑而锃亮，尽管序列号已被人锉去。武器的每个部件都以油润而毫不费力的精准运作——就像它最初所属的士兵一样。
The olive-green barrel of the mortar is smooth and polished, though the serial number has been filed off. Each component of the weapon moves with slick, effortless precision—much like the soldiers it originally belonged to.

[外部] 仓库不过是一具破败的空壳。几扇窗户碎裂，排水槽成段下垂或缺失，整座建筑都覆着一层尘泥与污垢。

[内部] 里面也好不到哪去：一片布满灰尘的空旷，唯有成堆垃圾与破损机器打破寂静，连认真清运都不值得人费力。

[Outside] The warehouse is little more than a dilapidated shell. Several windows are broken, stretches of gutter are sagging or missing, and the whole of it is covered in a layer of dirt and grime.

[Inside] The inside isn't much better, being a stretch of dusty emptiness broken only by piles of trash and broken machinery not even deemed worth the effort of proper disposal.

I Use Perfect Self.name:
我施展「完美自我」
I Use Perfect Self

Text.text:
我是无尽存在之海上的一朵浪。被召唤至冲突之时，我身、心、灵的合一触及这无边的源泉。气自其中流淌。这股能量无需肉身之劳、亦不经有意识的思虑，便涌入我体内。气赋予我行动之力。
I am one wave on the ocean of infinite being. Called to conflict, the unity of my body, mind, and spirit taps this boundless wellspring. Ki flows from it. This energy streams into me without bodily effort or conscious thought. The ki empowers me to act.

Shipwrecked Ghost Lamenting Lost Love.name:
遭遇海难的幽灵哀叹逝去的恋情
Shipwrecked Ghost Lamenting Lost Love

Text.text:
在深处冰冷、碾压般的黑暗里，一个缥缈的身影立于沉船腐朽的船艏，怀中紧紧抱着一捆幽灵般的羊皮纸。悲伤涂抹在他蜡黄的面容上，深陷的眼窝里噙满鬼影般的泪水；一声轻柔的哀歌随海流漂荡而来。

~ 由 Clara C. Potter 在 Discord 上 构想

In the cold, crushing darkness of the depths, an ethereal figure stands upon the rotting prow of a sunken ship, a bundle of spectral parchment clutched to his chest. Sorrow paints his sallow face, and his sunken eyes well with ghostly tears as a soft lament drifts upon the ocean currents.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

A Tenday Of Travel By Foot On Grassland.name:
徒步穿越草原的十日旅行
A Tenday Of Travel By Foot On Grassland

Text.text:
你在辽阔无边的平原上旅行，穿行于一片齐腰深的草海之中。最初几天风平浪静，每到夜里，你便就着草地铺寝而卧，庆幸能有片刻休息。第四天，你藏起身形，看着一群半人马疾驰而过，肩扛长矛，彼此说话，用的是一种陌生而诡异的语言。翌日，你遇见一圈耸立的巨石，便在它们投下的阴影里停下片刻休息。那些石头让你心头发紧，隐隐不祥，于是你很快起身离开。你的脚早已酸痛不堪，身上也迫切需要洗个澡，但你仍咬牙继续前行。直到旅程第十天，夕阳沉入远处丘陵背后，你终于触及目的地。
You travel over the sprawling plains, through a sea of hip-deep grass. The first few days pass uneventfully, and you bed down each night in the grass, thankful for the rest. On the fourth day, you hide as a herd of centaurs ride by, hefting spears and speaking to one another in a strange tongue.
