The next day, you come upon a ring of standing stones and spend a moment resting beneath their shadow. They give you an odd, foreboding feeling, so you move on. Your feet ache, and you're in desperate need of a bath, but you press on, and on the tenth day of your journey, as the sun dips behind the distant hills, you reach your destination.

你感到她的温暖贴上肌肤，像林间斑驳的阳光洒落；她的存在坠落于你身上，如漫长艰辛旅途中猝然开阔的一片林中空地。她高挑而威仪，宛如一位绝美而优雅的女王：肌肤似蜜，发色如秋叶般斑驳的赤褐，眼眸闪着暮光。她每迈出一步，都仿佛与周遭荒野融为一体——双足陷入大地，便催开花朵、唤起藤蔓破土而生。
You feel her warmth upon your skin like dappled sunlight through the trees, a presence falling upon you like an unexpected forest clearing amidst a long and arduous journey. She stands tall and regal, a monarch of uncommon beauty and grace, skin like honey, hair the mottled auburn of autumn leaves, eyes aglow with twilight. With each step, she appears as part of the wilds around her, feet sinking into the earth and causing flowers to bloom, vines to spring forth.

Ranger's Speech Of Self-deprecation.name:
游侠的自嘲之辞
Ranger's Speech Of Self-deprecation

Text.text:
“我的准头、我的感官，还有我与这片土地的联结，都出了问题。我看见，却又看不见。我在风里嗅到的，只有世间寻常的气味。如今我还是谁？当我的想象像我曾结交的野兽般挣脱狂奔而去时？”
“Something has happened to my aim, my senses, and so too to my very relationship with the land. I see but fail to see. I smell only the common odors of the world on the air. Who am I now, as my imagination runs away with me like the beasts I used to befriend?”

这家店的香气猛然冲击着你的感官。甜花的芬芳与苦草的涩香浓烈交织，从天花板垂挂而下；货架上排满一罐罐陌生粉末，每一次呼吸都仿佛添上一道新的余韵。店主的身影一时难觅，但柜台后方门口垂着的帘子里，传来杵臼研磨时低沉而循环的沙沙声。
The perfume of this shop shocks your senses. There’s a heady mix of the scents, from sweet flowers and bitter herbs dangling from the ceiling, while jars of unknown powders that line the shelves no doubt add new notes with each breath you take. The proprietor isn’t immediately obvious, but the circular grinding sound of a mortar and pestle come through a curtain that hangs in the doorway behind the counter.

I Argue With A Robot.name:
我和一个机器人争辩
I Argue With A Robot

Text.text:
我懊恼地揉着太阳穴，听着那机器人——又一次——把它的论点复述一遍。就像最阴险的官僚主义一样，想让机器人去做任何它认为不合逻辑的事，简直跟填保险理赔表格没两样。没错，我终究能办成——但绝不会快，也绝不会轻松。
I rub my temples in exasperation as I listen to the robot repeat its argument—again. Like the most insidious type of bureaucracy, getting a robot to do anything it deems illogical is like filing insurance paperwork. Sure, I’ll get there eventually—but it’s not going to be fast, and it’s not going to be easy.

繁茂的森林绿叶片丰盛地掩蔽着榛树的枝条，簇簇带刺的新芽新鲜抽长，依偎在枝桠之间。盘根错节的老树四周，环绕着柔韧的绿苗，年代各异；你还注意到地面上散落着枯萎榛果壳的最后残片。
Lush, forest-green leaves cover the branches of the hazel tree in abundance, and the fresh new growth of spiked buds can be seen nestled among the boughs. The gnarled tree is surrounded by pliant green saplings of varying age, and you notice the ground is littered with the last remnants of withered hazelnut shells.

Orrikan Alatari.name:
奥里坎·阿拉塔里
Orrikan Alatari

Text.text:
这名体格雄壮的龙裔高高耸立，压过旁人；他手中长矛那宽阔燃烧的刃口映出火光，令他锋利的猩红鳞片熠熠生辉——可他的目光却沉静如金，金色眼眸不见躁意。他身着宽松多层的灰暗布衣，系着一条宽阔的黑色腰带，肩上披着同样色调的斗篷。简朴的斜背带将一把入鞘弯刀固定在胯侧。护臂却是上等皮革镶银而成，额间深色犄角之间还戴着一条同款额带；头饰正中嵌着一颗黄托帕石，在他额心闪烁。与他同色的伪龙沿着他的肩头踱步而行。

~ Played by MasterLionsDen with

This mightily built dragonborn towers over other folk, his sharp, scarlet scales gleaming in firelight from the broad, blazing blade of the spear he holds—yet the man has a calm, golden-eyed gaze. His garb is loose, layered, drab cloth, with a broad black sash and similar mantle. A simple baldric holds a sheathed scimitar at his hip. Fine leather with silver trim comprises his bracers, though, and a matching headband rests on his brow amid dark horns. Yellow topaz, centered on his forehead, glitters on the circlet. A pseudodragon, matching his color, paces along his shoulders.

~ Played by MasterLionsDen with

Professor Of Horticulture.name:
园艺学教授
Professor Of Horticulture

Text.text: 邋遢兮兮、笑得合不拢嘴的瘦高教授，一边抹去护目镜上的雾气与泥点，一边努力看清面前的职业。他穿着一条长围裙，深口袋里探出几样阴森得像凶器的园艺工具。“同学们！温室里有三条规矩！戴好你的防护道具；别踩到邻居的根；还有，无论那丛渴望灌木怎么纠缠你，都不要去逗它。” Grubby and grinning from ear-to-ear, the lanky professor attempts to wipe the mist and dirt from their goggles to regard the class. They wear a long apron with deep pockets, out of which poke some deathly-looking gardening tools. “Students! There are three rules in the Greenhouse! Wear your protective gear; don’t stomp on your neighbors’ roots; and do not entertain the Yearn Bush, no matter how much it pesters you.”

盛宴长桌贯穿这座宏伟大厅，长凳宽阔，足以让各个阶级的成员同席分食、共叙故事。入口处，两套骑士护甲立于门旁，如同门框般守卫其间。大厅尽头，一座木制抬高的阶段充作讲台，用于发布告示、举杯祝词，甚至让吟游诗人献上音乐或喜剧表演。
The feasting table stretches the length of this grand hall, the benches offering enough room for members of every rank to break bread and share stories together. At the entrance way, two knightly suits of armor frame the door. At the back, a raised stage made of wood serves as a podium for announcements, toasts, and even bardic performances of music or comedy.

Waiting On A Large Data Transfer.name:
等待一笔大型数据传输中
Waiting On A Large Data Transfer

Text.text:
进度条一像素一像素地往前爬，迟缓得令人煎熬。怎么会这么久？是不是出什么事了？你思绪狂奔，努力压住那股在体内不断堆积的挫败感——像一枚手榴弹在你脑壳里来回撞击，随时都可能炸开。
Pixel by pixel, the progress bar ticks along with agonizing lethargy. Why is it taking this long? Has something happened? Your thoughts race as you try to control the frustration building within you like a grenade rattling around your head, waiting to explode.

雾中的高大扭曲幽影渐渐凝成一株株骸骨般的枯树，每一株都被夺去了大半枝桠，树身被某种东西熏黑——也许是久远的火灾，也许是潮湿滋生的霉腐，或许两者皆有。无论缘由，这里的土地同样一片死寂。表面覆着一层龟裂的灰土硬壳，你的脚却轻易踏碎，随即陷入脚踝深的黑色淤泥之中。
Tall and twisted ghosts in the mist resolve into skeletal trees, each robbed of most of their branches and blackened by something—an old fire perhaps, or mold from the damp, maybe both. Whatever the cause, the ground here looks similarly dead. Although covered in a cracked crust of gray dirt, your foot easily breaks through to sink ankle deep in dark sludge.

Agitated Ghost.name:
躁动的幽灵（特征）
Agitated Ghost

Text.text:
你听见一个沙哑的嗓音在低声喃喃，反反复复念着同一句话。接着你看见了她：一个瘦小的身影，蓬乱的黑发黏成一绺绺，身上只套着一件脏污的薄衫。她赤着脚背对着你站着，头低垂，双臂在胸前疯狂动作，像是在撕扯或拧绞手里的什么东西。然后，她不再说话。她抬起头。双臂垂落身侧，两只手都在往下滴血。她微微转过头，用一只癫狂的眼睛瞥了你一眼。随即消失不见。
You hear a raspy voice murmuring, repeating the same thing over and over. And then you see her, a slight figure with bedraggled black hair clad in a dirty shift. She stands on bare feet with her back to you and head bent, her arms furiously engaged in tearing or twisting something in her hands. Then she stops talking. Her head rises. Her arms drop to her sides, both dripping with blood. She turns her head enough to regard you with one crazed eye. And disappears.

Lightbringer's Lore: The Oath.name:
光辉使者秘闻：誓约
Lightbringer's Lore: The Oath

Text.text:
在最明亮的日子里，我将以怜悯、仁慈与宽恕，守护我庇护之下的所有人。
在最黑暗的夜晚——当天穹无月、群星不耀——我将成为希望，引领通往光明之路。
邪恶无所遁形于我眼前——正如阴影无法躲过光。真相必将照耀，邪恶必受审判。
那些崇拜邪恶之力的愚者，当心我的威能。
我是黑暗中的利剑，于寒夜之中迸燃。
黎明的使者，生命的守护者。
自黄昏至拂晓，让我的光芒真实闪耀。
光明使者之光！

On the brightest of days, I shall act with mercy, kindness, and forgiveness to all under my protection.
On the darkest of nights—when the sky is moonless and stars don't shine—I shall be hope, a guide to the path of the light.
No evil shall hide from my sight—as no shadow can hide from the light. Truth shall shine, and evil shall be judged.
To fools who worship evil's power, beware my might.
I am the sword in the darkness that flares against the cold of night.
The bringer of dawn and protector of life.
From dusk till dawn, let my light shine true.
LIGHTBRINGER'S LIGHT!

椅子的运作顺滑而安静，显然被细心打理。其部件由精致、轻盈的金属制成，轮辐细若金线，其余则是格栅状的复合结构，工艺先进而考究。座面与靠背由编织束带构成，像吊床般悬挂着，并配有一块厚实的坐垫，专为长时间久坐而设计。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The chair’s action is smooth and quiet, obviously well tended. Its components are made of fine, light metals, the wheel spokes are wire thin, and the rest is a latticed composite of advanced workmanship. The seat and back are woven straps suspended like a hammock, with a thick cushion designed for prolonged sitting.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

粗犷的男人披着毛皮与皮革相混的护甲，身形高大如塔，宽阔的肩头竖起一圈覆霜般的白色毛发——那是北极熊皮披风的边缘。熊头被做成兜帽，獠牙般的下颚将他冷峻的面庞框住。他的眼神冷得像冻雨，深色的面彩从脸颊一路淌下——如同粗重而暴怒的泪痕——衬出他咬紧的嘴角。一柄铁制巨剑的剑柄从肩后高高探出，剑首嵌着一颗冰蓝色的宝石。

~ Played by Dunec with

The rugged man in his blend of fur and leather armor stands at a towering height, broad shoulders bristling with the frosty white fur of his polar bear skin cloak. The head of the bear serves as his hood, its jaw framing his grim face. His eyes are as cold as sleet, and dark face paint streaks down his cheeks—like bold and rageful tears—to frame his grimacing mouth. The hilt of an iron greatsword rises above his shoulder, its pommel crested with an ice-blue jewel.

~ Played by Dunec with

I Activate My Ioun Stone Of Awareness.name:
我激活我的“警觉艾欧恩石”。
I Activate My Ioun Stone Of Awareness

Text.text:
我能感知身后的移动，察觉一场逼近的挑战，捕捉到近处空气里的紊乱。那枚小小的蓝色菱形石沿着轨道疾速飞掠，快得化作一圈风暴色的光环；而我迈步前行，带着确信——今天没人能悄悄摸到我背后。
I can sense movement behind me, feel an approaching challenge, perceive disturbances in the air nearby. The little blue rhomboid stone flies fast enough on its orbit to be a storm-colored ring, and I walk with the confidence of knowing that no one will be sneaking up on me today.

你念出必要的咒语，完成早已熟稔的手势，一阵柔和的奥术微光骤然闪现，将那名生物笼罩其中。下一次行动时，他们心中涌起一股无可动摇的自信。
You speak the necessary words, complete the practiced gestures, and a flash of soft, arcane light surrounds the creature. A surge of confidence accompanies their next action.

I Recognize The Signs Of Aberrant Creatu.name:
我能识别畸变生物行动的征兆
I Recognize The Signs Of Aberrant Creature Activity

Text.text:
浓稠的黏液、空洞的头骨、以及一种令人头皮发麻的不安感——这些都是异怪的征兆。我环顾四周，搜寻任何不对劲的东西——不合时宜、或与自然法则格格不入——很快就发现了它们。那生物的气味钻入鼻腔，我的胃因厌恶而绞紧，仿佛腐烂的鱼被丢进皮革作坊的尿液里煮沸般腥臊，呛得我一阵反胃干呕。
Thick slime, empty skulls, and a skin-crawling sense of unease—these are the signs of the aberrant. I cast my gaze around, looking for anything that seems wrong—out of place or at odds with the natural world—and it doesn’t take long for me to spot them. My gut twists with revulsion as the creature’s smell, akin to rotting fish boiled in tannery urine, reaches my nostrils causing me to gag.

Loot From A Homunculus.name:
从荷蒙库鲁斯身上搜出的战利品
Loot From A Homunculus

Text.text:
人造人拖着一条足有人形大小的金项链，把它像枷锁般披挂在自己全身，仿佛被束缚着一般。这条链子价值约100金币。
The homunculus drags around a humanoid-sized gold necklace, draping it all over its body as if in bondage. The chain is worth about 100 gold pieces.

Skyship Officers’ Mess.name:
飞空艇军官餐厅
Skyship Officers’ Mess

Text.text:
一张巨大的木桌占据了整个房间，四周环绕着结实的椅子。淡淡的麦酒与熟肉香气弥漫在空间里，每把椅子前都整齐摆放着一套餐具与陶盘。桌子中央，一瓶上等葡萄酒尚未开封，挺立如哨，格外醒目。
A large wooden table, surrounded by sturdy chairs, dominates the room. The faint scent of ale and cooked meat permeates the space, and a set of eating utensils and crockery is arranged neatly before each chair. A bottle of fine wine, yet unopened, stands proudly to attention at the table’s centre.

Potion Of Water Breathing.name:
水下呼吸药水
Potion Of Water Breathing

Text.text:
这瓶蓝绿药剂的表面聚着一层泡沫，杯底附近还残留着几颗更大的气泡。它们鼓胀黏结，不再只是圆球，扭曲成异样的形状；其中一颗甚至像水母的躯体般起伏颤动。
Foam collects at the top of this blue-green potion, with some larger bubbles lingering near the bottom of the glass. They are more bulbous and clotted, forming shapes beyond only spherical. One even fluctuates like the body of a jellyfish.

Matas Takir.name:
马塔斯·塔基尔
Matas Takir

Text.text:
两枚最深邃的蔚蓝圆眸自一张古铜色的面孔后凝望而出——被阳光亲吻，却仍被一圈浓重的黑暗所环绕。男人身形修长，举手投足间带着一种从容的平静。他把兜帽向后一掀，露出一头乌黑的发，间或嵌着几缕泛红的发丝。他的长袍亦是同样的纹路，猩红布条在其间起伏游走。腰间悬着一柄弯刀，做工清澈利落，映着日间微黄的光。他停下脚步，抬手搔了搔沿下巴蜿蜒的旧疤。双手几乎被手套吞没，手套上滋滋作响，跃动着诡异的力量。最后，一抹柔和的微笑悄然爬上他的脸。

~ Played by Rumadger

Two orbs of deepest blue peer out from a bronzed face—sun kissed, yet not without a deep darkness surrounding it. The man is slender and carries himself with an easy calm. He throws back his hood and reveals a mass of black hair inlaid with reddish streaks. His robes are of a similar pattern, with strips of crimson undulating throughout. A curved sword of clear craftsmanship sits at his waist, catching the yellowish light of day. He pauses, scratching an old scar that runs along his chin. His hands are almost smothered by gloves that crackle with eldritch power. A soft smile finds its way across his face.

~ Played by Rumadger

除了躲进室内，你无处可去。狂风如同一场袭击。你在雪幕之外什么也看不见，仿佛万物皆由它构成：世界化作头顶与身周的冰冻空气——连脚下的大地都显得虚浮无实。若你迷失方向，便没有罗盘的方位花或地图能为你指路。此刻一切都是在侥幸与覆灭之间的孤注一掷：冬季是平息怒火，还是夺走它的猎物。
There is nowhere to be but indoors. The wind is an assault. You cannot see beyond snow, as if everything is composed of it, the world transformed into frozen air above you, around you—even the ground seems insubstantial. If you are lost, there is no compass rose or map that can aim you. All is a gamble now between fortune and doom, winter ending its rage or claiming its victims.

Tree Limb Used As A Weapon.name:
用作武器的树枝
Tree Limb Used As A Weapon

Text.text:
狼人从近旁的树上猛地扯下一截粗壮的枝干，木头在被生生撕离树身时发出痛苦的呻吟。它挥舞着新得的武器，纵身向前扑去。枝干划破空气时，发出空洞的尖啸，仿佛在哀悼自身与持握它的主人如今已然扭曲的本性。
The werewolf wrenches a sturdy limb from a nearby tree, the wood groaning as it is torn from its host. Brandishing its newfound weapon, the werewolf launches itself forward. As the limb swings through the air, it whistles a hollow cry, as if mourning the now twisted nature of itself and its wielder.

你几乎找不到能落脚的地方而不踩碎什么：地板上到处都是纸张、衣物、餐具，以及其他四处流落的家用杂物。刺鼻的霉味在这片被杂乱扼住的空间里弥漫开来；在污渍斑斑的厨房水槽中，你看见一堆肮脏的碗碟堆得高高的，像一尊由瓷器拼成的魔像般阴沉逼人。
You find it difficult to set your feet down anywhere without crushing something, as the floor is riddled with papers, clothes, cutlery, and other wayward household items. The pungent smell of mildew wafts throughout this clutter-choked space, and in the stained kitchen sink, you see a filthy pile of dishes looming like a golem of crockery.

这根弧形魔杖由一头因年迈而死的头狼两根桡骨制成，全长十三英寸。靠握持的一端几乎占了杖身的一半，缠绕着以魔法封存、依旧柔软的狼毛。它对辅助察觉类法术尤为强劲，尤其擅长定位与辨识气味；而它的力量会随持握时弧度朝上或朝下而发生变化。
Crafted from two radius bones of an alpha wolf who died of old age, this curved wand is thirteen inches long. The grip end, making up nearly half the wand, is wrapped in magically preserved wolf fur. The wand is particularly strong at helping with perception spells, especially those involving locating and identifying smells, and its powers change depending on whether it is held with the curve upward or downward.

Legend Lore Experienced Like A Forgotten.name:
传说秘闻如遗忘的记忆般浮现
Legend Lore Experienced Like A Forgotten Memory

Text.text:
起初，你只听见一缕悄声渗入体内，仿佛一段被遗忘的记忆正悬在归来的边缘。随后，宛如堤坝决口，你的心智被倾泻而下的久远传说与古老歌谣淹没。
You only hear a whisper seeping into you at first, like a forgotten memory on the precipice of return. Then, like a bursting dam, your mind is flooded with the tales and ballads of centuries past.

Hellish Knight Interrupts Festival Court.name:
地狱骑士闯入节庆法庭
Hellish Knight Interrupts Festival Court

Text.text:
官员们端坐在仪式长桌旁，酒杯里好酒潺潺，在午后阳光下受理纷争、发号施令。微风送来的悦耳乐声忽然淡去，尖叫声骤然刺破空气。长桌前方轰然裂开一道地狱烈焰的传送门，灼得上过清漆的木面焦黑发亮；一名黑影从中阔步而出，脚印燃着跳动的余烬。尖啸的骷髅遮住了他的面孔，头盔深处却有两只蛇一般的眼睛阴冷窥视。他的黑铁胸甲上，赫然烙着一个邪魔的印记。

~ Envisioned by Andrew Sanguine on Discord

Officials sit at the ceremonial table, their goblets flowing with good wine as they hold court in the afternoon sun. The pleasant music drifting on the breeze fades away as the screaming starts. A portal of hellfire erupts into being before the table, singeing the varnished wood black as a dark figure strides out, his footprints aglow with dancing embers. A shrieking skull hides his face, yet two serpentine eyes leer from within his helm. Upon his black-iron breastplate, a devilish symbol is boldly displayed.

~ Envisioned by Andrew Sanguine on Discord

Old Rope Bridge In High Wind.name:
狂风中的老旧绳桥
Old Rope Bridge In High Wind

Text.text:
狂暴的疾风抽打着横跨峡谷的绳索桥。你站在原地权衡胜算时，整座桥像提线木偶般狂舞，绳索如鞭子般爆响，两块桥板骤然崩裂——旋转着坠入下方无底的深渊。每一次狂风掠过，支撑桥身的立柱都吱呀作响、摇晃不止，古老的木材终于在时代的侵蚀下彻底屈服。
A violent gale batters the rope bridge stretched across the ravine. As you stand debating your chances, the structure dances like a marionette, ropes snapping like whips, and two of the planks split—spinning off into the depths below. With every gust, the posts holding the span creak and move, the ancient wood finally succumbing to the ravages of time.

房间里弥漫着浓重的熏香与油脂气味，烟雾如帘幕般悬挂在四周。祭坛结实而朴素，线条硬朗，只点缀着一枚小小的圣徽、一簇蜡烛、一支线香，几乎别无他物。然而每件东西都摆放得谨慎而用心，房间本身更是洁净得近乎苛刻，陈设稀少而克制。这里是敬拜之所，是肃穆与虔诚栖身之地。
The room smells heavily of incense and oil, and smoke hangs in a curtain about the room. The altar is a stout, spartan structure, adorned with a small holy symbol, a cluster of candles, a stick of incense, and little else. But each item has been placed with care and thoughtfulness, and the room itself is meticulously clean and sparse. This is a place of worship, of reverence.

I Have Eldritch Sight.name:
我拥有诡秘视界
I Have Eldritch Sight

Text.text:
我缓缓眨眼，放松专注，将双臂向前伸展，抬起双手去感受空气。我能察觉到附近的魔法。它的震颤泛起粼粼波光，如同夏日热浪般扭曲闪烁，又像柔和的微风轻拂，撩拨着我的掌心。我将心神凝聚于这些触感——那些细微的线索便交织汇聚，化作熠熠生辉的魔法灵光。
Blinking slowly, I relax my focus and extend my arms forward, raising my hands to feel the air. I can sense magic nearby. Its vibrations create shimmers, like heat on a summer day, and tickle my palms like a gentle breeze. I concentrate on these sensations—and the subtle clues blend into shining magical auras.

五根黄铜管层层套叠，后者总比前者更长更粗，拼成一截阶梯状的圆筒。最细的一端嵌着目镜，点着一枚微小的水晶镜片；最宽的一端则塞着另一枚大得多的透镜。大镜后方缠着皮革作握把——用来掩蔽镜面的镜盖垂在一条相连的链子上。整件装置可一路收拢，尽数缩回最大的那根管中。
Five brass tubes, each wider and longer than the previous one, form this stepped cylinder. At the narrowest end is an eyepiece with a tiny crystal lens. The widest end is filled with another lens many times larger. Leather forms a grip just behind the bigger lens—the cap to cover it dangling from an attached chain. The whole device can collapse into the largest tube.

Hovercraft On Swamp Planet.name:
沼泽行星上的气垫船
Hovercraft On Swamp Planet

Text.text:
细长的水草黏在伤痕累累的气垫艇船身上，斑驳的锈痂已从部分金属里悄然爬出。那台焊在底盘上的巨型引擎轰鸣不止，将码头四周野生生灵的天然交响彻底吞没。其间还夹杂着恼人的吱呀声——雨刷无力地来回摆动，徒劳地想把不断落下的雨水从龟裂的挡风玻璃上抹去。

~ 由 David 在 Discord 上 构想

Stringy weeds cling to the hull of the battered hovercraft, and patchy scabs of rust have begun to creep through some of the metal. The drone of the huge engine welded to the chassis drowns out the natural symphony of the wildlife surrounding the dock. It is accompanied by an irritating squeak, as wipers feebly attempt to clear the constant rain from the cracked windscreen.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Paladin Quip About Laws.name:
圣武士对律法的俏皮话
Paladin Quip About Laws

Text.text:
“我不在乎什么是法律，只在乎什么才是正义。我所遵循的戒律，是很久以前由神明之手写下的，绝不会随着卑微之人的一时兴起与他们的政治把戏而改变。”
“I don’t concern myself with what is law, only with what is right. The rules I follow were written a long time ago by the hands of the divine and do not change at the whims of petty men and their politics.”

Dawn Goddess Of The Drow.name:
卓尔族的黎明女神
Dawn Goddess Of The Drow

Text.text:
她身形高挑纤细，宛若少女；这位古老女神的长发如薄纱般的白丝绸，垂落至脚踝，举手投足都像舞者般轻盈。她的灰色长剑挂在一条细若无物的腰带上，仿佛那剑轻得不比一根芦苇更重。她纤柔如袅袅香烟，却令人心生敬畏——无论是纵声欢笑，还是骤然挥出怒意。
Tall and lithe as a young girl, the ancient goddess’s hair is gossamer white silk, flowing to her ankles, and she carries herself like a dancer. Her gray longsword hangs from a belt so fine that the blade seems to weigh no more than a reed. She is delicate as incense smoke, but she inspires awe—whether laughing, or lashing out.

Jax Steele.name:
贾克斯·斯蒂尔
Jax Steele

Text.text:
贾克斯是个精瘦、带着粗犷俊朗气质的半身人绅士，嘴角那抹歪斜的笑意来得轻而易举。他栗色的头发蓬松得恰到好处，在发顶向上拢起，投下一缕阴影，衬得那双探究的湛蓝眼睛愈发明亮。他披着一件长长的紫色外套，金边滚饰熠熠生辉；外套下是贴身的皮质护甲，其上刻着自然的纹样：藤蔓、叶片与根须沿着磨旧的护甲蜿蜒攀爬，在半身人的胸腹间铺开一片林海般的景致。一条投掷匕首的挎带将这片“森林”一分为二，每一把刀刃长短形制各异，由不同金属锻成，来自某个耐人寻味的地方——也总会顺带牵出一段注定要讲的故事。他的胯侧挂着一柄寒光流转的弯刀，刀身点缀金银纹饰与繁复花丝。刀背上排列着怪异的长槽孔洞与镂空切口，使这把武器在空中划弧时，竟会唱出一曲令人不寒而栗却又动人心弦的旋律。

~ 由一位英雄 Played

Jax is a lean, ruggedly handsome halfling gentleman with a crooked smile that comes all too easily. His chestnut hair, perfectly tousled, is swept upward at its peak, shadowing inquisitive eyes of shining blue. A long, purple coat trimmed in gold drapes snug leather armor etched with a nature motif: vines, leaves, and roots snake up the well-worn armor, creating a forested landscape on the halfling’s torso. A bandolier of throwing daggers splits the landscape, each blade different in length and shape, forged of myriad metals, and acquired from an interesting locale—with an inevitable story attached. He carries on his hip a gleaming scimitar emblazoned with gold and silver accents and filigree. Strange, fluted holes and cutouts along the blade’s spine cause the weapon to sing an unnerving but lovely melody when arcing through the air.

~ Played by a Hero with

一头巨鳄轰然踏来，凶残的食肉兽只想着血腥盛宴。它伤痕累累的鳞甲皮肤淌着污秽，利爪般的脚掌搅动泥沼。冰冷的缟玛瑙双眼死死锁定你，它猛然扑出，巨口森然，獠牙密布——蓄势待发，要将你撕碎扯裂。
A colossal crocodile stamps toward you, a brutal carnivore intent on a bloody feast. Its scarred, scaly skin streams with filth, its clawed feet churning through the mud. Cold onyx eyes focus intently upon you as it lunges, jaws filled with formidable teeth—ready to rend and tear.

你将掌控力逼至极限，把浩瀚的魔力借由你的接触灌入法术的目标，同时用一根蜂鸟的细小羽毛轻拂他们的额头。他们的眼神霎时蒙上一层雾色，随即骤然睁大——被迫涌入近在眼前的未来景象。
Stretching the limits of your control, you channel immense magical power through your touch to the intended recipient of the spell, while brushing their forehead with the tiny feather of a hummingbird. Their eyes cloud over momentarily then widen—flooded with images of the immediate future.

这里有两条小径从道路旁岔开。一条向北延伸，通往一棵榆树阴影下仍在冒着余烬的营火。道路对面，另一条从两堆缠满常春藤、灌木簇拥的巨石间穿行而过。蜜蜂在点缀其间的花朵上上下浮动，笨拙的身影像无心的守卫，守着这道天然的门径。
Two paths run off the road here. One leads north to a smoldering campfire in the shadow of an elm tree. Across the road, the other cuts between two piles of boulders wrapped in ivy and clustered by bushes. Bees bob about flowers that speckle the plants, their bumbling bodies acting as accidental guardians of this natural gateway.

一股啃噬般的寒意自你腹中缓缓攀升。你感到一阵反胃。一股如腐烂般的恶臭几乎要将你淹没——你完成咒文，将你召来的病邪猛然抛向附近的一只生物。
A gnawing cold creeps up from your stomach. You feel nauseas. A smell, like rot, threatens to overwhelm you as you complete the incantation and hurl the sickness you've conjured toward a creature nearby.

Gaseous Drug, Memory Fog.name:
气态药剂：记忆迷雾
Gaseous Drug, Memory Fog

Text.text:
这只暗色塑料气雾喷罐上的指示LED灯亮着，昭示它已装满并处于加压状态。嵌入其中的透明小瓶乍看空无一物，但里面的东西会偶尔凝聚成几缕银色薄雾般的线条。喷洒后空气中不留任何痕迹，然而一旦嗅到同样的蒸汽，感官与思绪便会被搅得浑浊不清，使人几乎不可能准确回忆起吸入前后短短几瞬的经历。

~ 由一位英雄构想

An indicator LED on this dark plastic aerosol dispenser indicates it’s full and pressurized. The clear vial loaded into it appears at first to be empty, though whatever is within occasionally coalesces into lines of silvery mist. A spray leaves no trace in the air, but a whiff of that same vapor muddles senses and thoughts, making accurate recall of a few moments before and after the inhalation unlikely at best.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Aberrant Spirit Creature.name:
异界灵体生物
Aberrant Spirit Creature

Text.text:
世上大多数生物之所以可见，是因为光线从它们的躯体反射，将影像送入眼中供大脑处理。而这只生物却截然不同——它之所以能被看见，只因有一圈猩红的光晕——雾？火？——缠绕着它。它从地板上蜿蜒滑出，攀上墙面，继而钻入空气本身，摆脱重力的束缚。无数眼睛漂浮在它那阴影般的形体周围；它长着螳螂般的头颅与巨大的钳爪，钳爪之后是一组六条喀哒作响的蜈蚣般多足，以及一条末端竖起鳍冠的长尾。没有任何气味伴随这头怪异之物，可刺骨的寒意却浸透它周遭的空气，而持续不断的尖叫与哀嚎声如同利刃般冲击着你的耳膜。
Most creatures in the world are visible because of the reflection of light from their bodies provides the eye with an image for the brain to process. This creature is different, only visible because of the nimbus of red—mist? fire?—surrounding it. It slithers from the floor, up the wall, then into the air itself, unbound by gravity. Many eyes float around its shadowy form, which has a mantis-like head and large claws, behind which are a set of six chittering centipedal legs and a long tail crested with a fin. No smell accompanies this aberration, but a chill pervades the air around it, and the constant sound of screams and wails assault your ears.

Melf's Acid Arrow.name:
梅尔夫的强酸箭
Melf's Acid Arrow

Text.text:
伴随着一声渐起的尖啸，闪烁的翠绿箭矢疾射而出，直奔你的目标。它身后迸散出灼蚀的酸滴，宛如一颗嘶嘶作响的彗星拖曳着尾迹。空气中弥漫起刺鼻的酸涩气味，腐蚀性的蒸汽灼痛你的双眼。
With a rising wail, the shimmering green arrow streaks toward your target. Caustic drops scatter in its wake like a sizzling comet. An acrid tang fills the air, stinging your eyes with corrosive vapors.

Rival Gangs Meet For Negotiation At Neut.name:
敌对帮派在中立地点会面谈判
Rival Gangs Meet For Negotiation At Neutral Site

Text.text:
夜风穿过废弃的停车库，掠过两帮宿敌之间的空隙，寒意沁人。两拨人马在忽明忽暗的长条灯下对峙，鲜艳张扬的装束与周遭荒凉冰冷的混凝土形成刺眼反差。每个帮派各有一人上前——在摆在中间的油桶旁会合——随即展开令人窒息的谈判。空气里的敌意几乎触手可及，一点火星就足以引爆这座火药桶。所幸，这里唯一被允许的武器只有言辞。
A night breeze chills the air between the rivals as it blows through the abandoned parking garage. Two groups face each other beneath flickering strip lights, their vibrant outfits in stark contrast to the desolate concrete surrounding them. A member of each gang steps forward—meeting at an oil barrel placed between them—and begins the tense negotiations. The animosity in the air is palpable, and one spark could ignite this powder keg. Fortunately, the only weapons allowed here are words.

干燥的粪便木柴上点点斑驳，半消化的稻草与谷粒嵌在干褐的表面，像岩石里的化石。恶臭触手可及。那股农舍般的腥膻直钻喉底，沉甸甸地盘踞着，仿佛一只污水癞蛤蟆赖着不走，执意要逼你作呕反胃。

~ 由一位Hero Envisioned

The dry logs of dung are speckled with half-digested straw and grain, embedded in the arid brown surface like fossils in rock. The stench is palpable. The agrarian odor reaches deep into your throat, settling like an effluent toad intent on making you gag and retch.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

A Plea For Information Before Death.name:
死前的情报恳求
A Plea For Information Before Death

Text.text:
“当生命从你体内一点点流失时，做点有用的事：把我们想知道的都说出来。让你这可悲人生最后的时刻，至少有点意义。”
“As life leaks away from you, do something useful: Tell us what we need to know. Make these last moments of your miserable life mean something.”

The Minor Houses.name:
小贵族家族
The Minor Houses

Text.text:
在学院历史上一段离奇的时期里，魔法师学院从最初寥寥几个学院分裂成无数小院，直到局势终于归于平衡。学生们几乎在教授们少有指引的情况下发起了这场分裂；而当教授们终于只需主持几大主要学院时，也不免松了口气。如今，约有二十个小院存在，每个小院只有四五名学生。它们高度专精，几乎不与主要学院竞争，但各自都拥有独门魔法，以及延伸至学院之外世界的校友社交网络。
During a strange period of its history, Enchanter Academy shattered into many houses from the original few until there was a settling. The students initiated this with little guidance from the professors, who were finally relieved at presiding only over the major houses. Now, around twenty small houses of four or five students each exist. They are highly specialized and seldom compete with the major houses, but each has its own particular magic and alumnae of social connections in the world beyond the academy.

I Steal A Book.name:
我偷走一本书
I Steal A Book

Text.text:
我一把抓起那本书，单手摊开，目光飞快扫过书页。我背过店主，佯装继续在店里闲逛，眼神懒懒地在书页与其他货品之间游移。趁着没人留意，我把书悄然塞进身上藏好。披风轻轻一掠，背包里一阵窸窣与金属轻响，违禁之物便像被魔法带走一般，无声无息地消失了。
I grab the book and hold it open in one hand to scan the pages. I turn away from the shopkeep and mime a continued perusal of the store, my eyes lazily going from the pages of the book to the other wares. Shielded from any wandering eye, I tuck the book away. With a flit of a cloak, a shuffle and clink of my pack, the contraband is spirited away as if it were done by magic.

那张脸的神情一变，仿佛心智里一座致命冰山露出可见的峰顶。并不存在的船只迎面压来，注定要撞毁——威胁与痛楚的极光划破长空。裂痕滋生，心智如冰川般崩解，巨大的碎块坠入冰封深渊，旋即浮起。很快，心智归于寂静，世界之水映出一张再度能够接纳自己的脸。
The face’s expression changes to a visible peak of a deadly iceberg in the mind. Ships that do not exist bear down on it to crash—an aurora of threat and pain streaks across the sky. A crack forms, and the mind calves in enormous chunks that drop into the frozen deep and then float. The mind soon quiets, and the water of the world reflects a face that can accept itself again.

仓库卸货场角落里，一个流浪女从她的行军包里掏出一截金属圆筒和一只小水壶。她展开圆筒的三条短腿，把它稳稳立住。底缘伸出一截管子，像靴尖般翘起；她在管子下方的托盘里铺满木屑颗粒和引火物。她划亮一根火柴点燃托盘，随后把水壶搁上去煮沸。
A vagrant on the corner of the warehouse delivery lot breaks out a metal cylinder and a small kettle from her duffle. She unfolds its three small legs and steadies it. A pipe sticks up from the bottom edge, like the toe of a boot, and she fills a tray under it with wood pellets and tinder. She lights the tray with a match, then puts the kettle on to boil.

漆黑的负能量带自你指尖奔涌而出，缠裹住你的目标，汲取他们的生命力，连体内的水分也一并夺走。你压下残忍的笑意，眼睁睁看着他们在你面前枯萎。
Black bands of negative energy pour forth from your fingertips and envelop your target, sapping their life force and even the water from their body. You suppress a cruel smile as you see them wither before your very eyes.

这处灯光明亮的场所笼罩着静谧的沉思气息，来客们压低嗓音交谈，诉说着对陈列艺术品的欣赏与察觉。各式大小的画作悬挂在墙面上，借着氛围灯的映照更显动人；用绳栏围起的底座上摆放着雕塑与其他立体作品。你只能想象，这些作品若落入富有的藏家之手，会被开出怎样惊人的价码。
An air of quiet reflection surrounds this well-lit venue as patrons discuss in hushed voices their appreciation and perception of the artwork on display. Paintings of all sizes have been hung on walls to take advantage of the mood-lighting and roped-off pedestals feature sculptures and other three-dimensional works. You can only imagine what sort of prices these works might fetch from a wealthy collector.

Enemy Falls To Their Death.name:
敌人坠落身亡
Enemy Falls To Their Death

Text.text:
你瞥见敌人的脸，正好撞上他们意识到自己正在坠落的那一刻。他们张着嘴，哑然无声。真正尖叫的是他们的眼睛——惊恐地死死向上瞪着你。你还来不及想要移开视线，那可怜的蠢货便在下方地面上轰然爆开，像一桶蔬菜汤砸碎般四溅。
You catch a glimpse of your foe's face just as they realize they're falling. Their mouth is open, speechless. It is their eyes that scream, staring in terror straight up at you. Before you can think to look away, the poor fool's body bursts upon the ground below like a cask of vegetable soup.

Unethical Paleontologist.name:
无良古生物学家
Unethical Paleontologist

Text.text:
咧嘴而笑的古生物学家在第一声爆炸撼动挖掘现场时捂住双耳，古老岩层被震开，更多化石从中重见天日。身着黑色护甲的安保人员在加固的发掘区巡逻，确保没人把鼻子伸到不该伸的地方。古生物学家踏过那些在爆炸中被震成碎片、古老得令人难以想象的骨骸残屑，俯身对着新暴露的岩面凿刻起来，急切地想把这座利润丰厚的猎物牢牢攥在手里。
The grinning paleontologist covers their ears as the first explosion rocks the dig site, unearthing more fossils from within the ancient rock. Security personnel clad in black armor patrol the fortified excavation, making sure no one sticks their nose where it doesn’t belong. Walking over shattered, unfathomably ancient bones reduced to splinters in the blast, the paleontologist begins to chisel into the newly exposed rock, desperate to secure their lucrative quarry.

Sundries From A Girallon.name:
来自巨猿的杂货
Sundries From A Girallon

Text.text:
坚果壳与被嚼碎的植物叶片在地面上铺成一小块粗陋的地毯；但在这堆垃圾里，你还发现了一只布偶——将锯末缝进毡布做成——大脑袋、小身躯，脸上用黑色针脚绣出五官。
Nutshells and chewed plant fronds form a small rug over the ground, but among the trash you also find a doll—sawdust sewn into felt—with a large head, a small body, and a face created by black stitching.

一团闪着幽光的漆黑群体，因承载的数据之重而战栗。无穷无尽的纳米机器构成这道起伏翻涌的浪潮——一片骇人的数据机器人之云。它们看起来像无数细小的黑点。每一个都在进行碎片整理。碎片整理。碎片整理。它们唯一的目的。作业时，虫群紧密聚成小队，卷起尘埃与弹片，搜寻并清除。
A swarm of glistening black shivers with the weight of its data. Endless nanomachines make up this undulating wave—a frightening cloud of databots. They look like countless little black dots. Each one is defragmenting. Defragmenting. Defragmenting. Their sole purpose. At their work, the swarm clusters together in tight units, gathering bits of dust and shrapnel, searching and eliminating.

Cybernetic Leg Augmentation +1.name:
赛博义体腿部增幅 +1
Cybernetic Leg Augmentation +1

Text.text:
这条腿已接受基因疗法的早期改造。被窃取并在地下实验室培育的快缩肌，如今沿着整条腿蔓延增殖。那些肌束瘦硬如铁弦，鼓胀跳动，迸出不自然的力量。异种肌肉组织的骇人暴长将胫骨硬生生撑裂，而裂开的骨头又被特制的高韧纤维编织缝合在一起。过程无疑痛彻骨髓，但确实有效。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

This leg has undergone the early stages of gene therapy. Fast-twitch muscles, stolen and grown in underground labs, now propagate throughout the length of the leg. Wiry, they appear like steel strings, throbbing with unnatural strength. The alarming growth of foreign muscle tissue has split the tibia bone, which has in turn been woven together by specialized high-toughness fibers. An excruciating process, to be sure, but an effective one.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Villainous Hacker-assassinating Force.name:
反派黑客暗杀部队
Villainous Hacker-assassinating Force

Text.text:
在由算法集构成的迷宫深处，充斥着神秘而骇人的代码，潜伏着一股半清醒、饱受折磨的力量。它紧追不舍，摧垮意志，抹黑角色名声，并操纵用户与机器去实施肉体暗杀。某个黑客一旦贪念作祟、挖得太深，便会撞上错综复杂的因果操控框架——蝴蝶效应从人类无法计数的网格点之外悄然起步，宛如精心掷下的碎石，启动一场抹除身份的雪崩。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Deep within the maze of algorithm sets filled with mysterious and terrifying code is a semi-conscious and tortuous force. It hounds, demoralizes, commits character assassination, and manipulates users and machines into committing physical assassination. The hacker who gets greedy, digs too deep, can run into complex frameworks of causality control, butterfly effects starting from humanly uncountable grid points away, like pebbles carefully used to start an avalanche of identity erasure.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Exposition The Bard.name:
博闻诗人
Exposition The Bard

Text.text:
矮小的吟游诗人站在酒馆里那座小小的阶段之上，身形虽短，气势却逼人，竟与之全然不符。他熟练地拨弄调音，鲁特琴声微微一颤，喧闹的人群随即安静下来。你从未见过这位表演者，可当他深吸一口气，开口歌唱时，你立刻感到命运的重量在空气中沉沉落下——也许，你该听得更仔细些。

~ RPGBOT.Podcast

The diminutive bard stands atop the tiny stage in the tavern, his commanding presence belying his short stature. With practiced ease he tunes a lute, and a hush falls over the crowd. Though you’ve never seen this performer before, when he takes a breath and begins to sing you feel the weight of destiny in the air—perhaps you should listen more carefully.

~ RPGBOT.Podcast

Pile Of Clockwork Gears.name:
一堆发条齿轮
Pile Of Clockwork Gears

Text.text:
大小不一的齿轮整齐地一层层叠放着，宛如石冢上堆起的卵石，抛光的表面在光线下微微闪耀。金属上切削出的繁复齿牙如同城墙的垛口般环绕着各个部件，每一枚都由精准而老练的手艺刻就。旁边放着一只金属罐，浓稠的褐色液体正从壶嘴尖端缓慢滴落。
Gears of all sizes sit neatly on top of one another, like stones piled in a cairn, their polished surfaces shimmering in the light. Intricate teeth cut into the metal surround the components like crenellations on a castle wall, each one cut with a precise and expert hand. A metal can sits to one side, a viscous brown liquid dripping slowly from the tip of its spout.

Elven Vale: Danger On The Border.name:
精灵谷：边境危机
Elven Vale: Danger On The Border

Text.text:
林间群鸟高歌不息，唯独你身边一带骤然沉寂。你凝神细听，想找出缘由，随即察觉它们的鸣唱变了调。更靠近林缘处，传来疑似鸟群惊惶的鸣叫。紧接着，一声遥远的低吼滚过来。
Birds sing throughout the wood, but nearer to you they’ve gone quiet. As you listen for some sign of why, you detect a shift in their singing. Out toward the edge of the wood, you hear what might be birds calling in alarm. Then comes a distant growl.

这间光线昏暗的书店显然是依照店主的心意量身打造的——店主想做的事，就是在不招呼客人的时候读书。柜台后摆着一把绒软的扶手椅，巧妙的躺靠机关让人能把脚搁在同样绒软的脚凳上。柜台上方，两只玻璃灯罩染着淡绿以减轻眼部疲劳，里面的蜡烛静静燃烧，位置恰到好处，正适合舒适阅读。还有书：多得数不清的书，塞满每一处能放书的书架，桌面与推车上也堆成一摞摞的书塔。
This dimly-lit bookshop has clearly been constructed to the specifications of the owner, and what the owner wants to do is read books when not helping customers. Behind the counter, a plush chair with a clever reclining mechanism allows them to put their feet on an equally plush stool. Over the counter, two glass bulbs, tinted green to reduce eye strain, hold burning candles, perfectly positioned for comfortable reading. And there are books: books beyond counting, books crammed in every available shelf, and books stacked on tables and trolleys.

Town Crier.name:
镇上的报信人
Town Crier

Text.text:
一名魁梧的女人大步向前，宛如巨舰破浪而行。她身披天鹅绒长袍，头戴帽子，颈挂项链，显然象征着某种职务；手里还拿着一只装饰繁复的说话喇叭。她深吸一口气，将黄铜器具举到唇边。
A large woman strides forward like a great ship blasting through waves. Dressed in velvet robes and wearing a hat and necklace that evidently denote some office, she carries an elaborately decorated speaking trumpet. She heaves a deep breath as she raises the brass instrument to her mouth.

Magical Detection Of A Multiclass Charac.name:
多职业角色的魔法侦测
Magical Detection Of A Multiclass Character

Text.text:
来自所有职业的元素混沌翻涌，让你难以分辨你 目标 所用的组合。最终你将它们一一剥离，调动全部 感官 去区分与洞察，直到薄雾散尽，诸职业的名字自行向你显现。
The chaos of elements from all the classes makes it hard to distinguish the combination your target uses. Finally you separate them out, using all your senses to distinguish and discern, until the mist dissipates and the classes name themselves to you.

Derelict Noble's Yacht.name:
废弃贵族游艇
Derelict Noble's Yacht

Text.text: 船身在海湾咸涩的碧蓝水面上随波起伏，发出哀婉的吱呀声。剥落的金箔贴面、喝到一半的名贵葡萄酒瓶、以及腐朽破烂的丝绸，都在暗示这艘如今荒废的船只曾享受过的奢华。船尾以褪色却依旧繁复的花体字横写着 Sparrowhawk——显然出自书法大师之手。 The ship creaks sadly as it bobs in the briny turquoise waters of the cove. Peeling gold veneer, half-drunk bottles of expensive wine, and rotting, threadbare silks hint at the luxury once enjoyed on this now-derelict vessel. Sparrowhawk stretches across the ship’s stern in faded ornate script—clearly the work of a master calligrapher.

Yvonne Mayfield The Adopted Knight.name:
伊冯娜·梅菲尔德——收养的骑士
Yvonne Mayfield The Adopted Knight

Text.text:
尽管她出鞘的利刃裸露寒钢，尽管闪亮的钢甲包裹着她宽阔的肩背，半兽人仍以冷静而克制的步伐向前逼近。她颈间的深红围巾在风中翻飞，遮住那道她绝不愿提起的伤疤。伴随一声铿然，她将头盔面甲落下，覆住那双琥珀色的眼睛。

~ Played by Andrew Sanguine

Despite the naked steel of her drawn blade, despite the gleaming steel plate enshrouding her broad-shouldered frame, the half-orc steps forward with calm, measured movements. The crimson scarf around her neck, concealing the scar of which she refuses to speak, flutters in the wind. With a clang, she drops the visor of her helm over her amber-hued eyes.

~ Played by Andrew Sanguine

A Tenday Of Travel By Boat On A River.name:
沿河乘船旅行十天
A Tenday Of Travel By Boat On A River

Text.text:
河流在大地间蜿蜒穿行，自高地一路盘旋，奔向远方的海岸。日子流逝，翠绿的平原、幽深的荒野与嶙峋的劣地在两岸掠过。河面越宽越显平缓，河道一收窄便骤然狂躁。第三天，船只在风暴中漂行，雨水灌注使河水更为深沉。电光频闪，狂风数次几乎要将小船掀翻，但它终究稳稳浮着。此后直到行程末尾，天气都逐渐安定；只是第五天，你们掠过一艘搁浅的小船残骸，船壳被箭矢与标枪刺得千疮百孔。你不禁猜想，船上的人究竟遭了什么。第十天黎明，你醒来时，目的地已在地平线上静静浮现。

~ Requested by Søren Sørensen

The river meanders its way through the landscape, winding down from the highlands toward the distant coast. Green plains, dense wilds, and craggy badlands roll by as the days pass. The river calms as it widens, growing tumultuous as it narrows. On the third day, the boat floats through a storm, and the river deepens with rainfall. Lightning flashes and wind threatens several times to roll the boat, but it stays afloat. The weather calms after that for the remainder of the trip, though on the fifth day, you pass the wreckage of a small vessel run aground, its hull riddled with arrows and javelins. You wonder what befell the occupants. You wake on the dawn of the tenth day to your destination on the horizon.

~ Requested by Søren Sørensen

隐秘对这名特工而言如同本能，而他的履历堪称楷模——也正因如此，他才能活到今天。他身着低调的黯色，从阴影中守夜，无形的存在将每个细节尽数攫取。只有蠢货才会低估此人只需将一句耳语送入正确的耳中，便能掀起何等的伤害。
Subtlety is second nature to this operative, and his record is exemplary—it is how he has survived this long. Clad in muted tones, he watches from the shadows, an unseen presence capturing every detail. Only a fool would underestimate the damage this man could wreak with a whispered word in the correct ear.

Cyberpunk Soup Kitchen.name:
赛博朋克施粥所
Cyberpunk Soup Kitchen

Text.text:
热汤的蒸汽带着浓浓汤味，从几口巨大的钢制大锅里翻涌而出；疲惫的志愿者机械地搅拌着。空间里充斥着压低的交谈嗡鸣，间或夹杂着令人不适的啧啧吸食声。汤味之下，是久未清洗的酸臭——有些人只是走投无路，有些人则是职业流浪汉——不少人身上还留着黑客帮派的旧改造：烧坏的视网膜、废掉的腕载线缆接口。几个形迹可疑的家伙彼此交换着鬼祟的眼神。角落里站着一名护甲不厚的安保，怀里抱着一支无托步枪。也许他曾是企业狗，或许只是被这家施粥所外包雇来的。他的护甲上印着一只金色的狂奔独角兽。
Steam smelling of hot soup emanates from great steel cauldrons being stirred by tired-looking volunteers. A low murmur of conversation fills the space, in between horrible slurping sounds. Underneath the soup smell is the stench of the unwashed—some down-on-their-luck, some career-homeless—many bearing the old mods of hacking gangs: burnt-out retinas, useless wrist-mounted wire plugs. A few shady characters exchange furtive glances. A lightly armored security guard stands in the corner, cradling a bullpup rifle. Perhaps he’s ex-corpo, or maybe contracted out to this soup kitchen. A rampant gold unicorn is emblazoned on his body armor.

Corpse Of A Dragon.name:
龙之尸骸
Corpse Of A Dragon

Text.text:
在一片空地上——显然是某个庞然大物自天穹坠落砸出的——一丛丛巨大漆黑的蘑菇覆满了巨龙腐烂的尸身。躯体半埋在土里，双翼早已不见踪影，唯有脊骨的轮廓——从头骨一路延伸到尾端——仍在覆着苔滑的地面上隐约可辨。腐败的恶臭浸透了空间，孢子在凝滞的空气里懒散地漂浮。
In a clearing, obviously created by an enormous body falling from the sky, a colony of large, black mushrooms covers the rotting corpse of a dragon. The body is half-buried, the wings no longer visible, although the outline of the spine—from skull to tail—is discernible on the moss-slick ground. The smell of decay permeates the space and spores drift lazily through the still air.

Threat From A Mind Flayer.name:
来自夺心魔的威胁
Threat From A Mind Flayer

Text.text:
“触碰你的心智，就像把双手伸进碎裂的玻璃里。如此紊乱，如此狂躁。让我将你轻轻托起，把那份你迫切渴求的安宁送回你的脑海。”
“Touching your mind feels like running my hands through shattered glass. So disordered and chaotic. Let me cradle you and bring your mind the peace it so desperately craves.”

Deep Winter Globe.name:
深冬雪境球
Deep Winter Globe

Text.text:
魔法师学院高塔的第一层地窖，是一片冬日景致，笼罩在一座辽阔澄澈的穹顶之下。教授们能用天空魔法将它遮蔽起来，但学生们常常请求让玻璃保持可见，好让自己仿佛置身于一只巨大的雪球水晶球中。起伏的丘陵间、松影点点的山谷里，有一方可供滑冰的池塘；这里的雪下得恰到好处，正适合堆雪造物、雪橇飞驰与冬日魔法。为冻得发抖的人准备的暖屋就在一旁：热茶已备好——壁炉噼啪作响的火光旁，沙发上铺着毯子，静候来取暖的人。
The first cellar of Enchanter Academy’s tower is a winter landscape under an expansive clear dome. The professors can obscure it with sky spells, but often the students ask to leave the glass visible, so they can have the sensation of being inside a huge snow globe. There is a skating pond in a pine-speckled valley of rolling hills, and it snows just the right snow for building snow creatures, sledding, and winter magic. A warming house with tea—and blankets on couches by crackling fires—awaits the chilled.

老人身着精致却舒适的衣裳，坐着吞云吐雾，叼着一杆长长的陶烟斗，乐呵呵地看着世事流转。此刻他还没察觉你的目光，你便得以细看他灰色眼眸旁的笑纹、布满老茧的双手，以及那被几顿过于丰盛的佳肴掩住的、曾经健壮的身躯——仿佛一块休耕的田地。
Dressed in fine but comfortable clothes, the elderly man sits and puffs on a long clay pipe, happily watching the world go by. For the moment, he doesn’t notice you looking, so you have the chance to study the laugh lines around his gray eyes, his calloused hands, and a once-muscular body hidden by a few too many luxurious meals, like a field left fallow.

矮胖的玻璃罐里装满了浓稠的灰绿黏浆，直至罐口，甜腻的气味扑鼻而来。宽大的软木塞盖顶端烙着一枚诉说复原的符文，皮绳紧紧缠绕，将塞盖牢牢系在罐口上。
The squat glass jar is full to the brim with thick gray-green goop that smells strongly of sweetness. A single rune that speaks of restoration has been burnt into the top of the wide cork lid, held fast to the jar’s opening with tightly wrapped leather laces.

这家旅店虽已显出岁月的沉淀，却依旧打理得一丝不苟；其建筑风格仿佛把人带回到你祖辈之前的年代，并被精心维护，只为完整留住它建成时那个时代的神韵。沿着一面墙，纪念物与奇珍异玩簇拥着一块华丽的黄铜铭牌——毫无疑问，那是在表彰曾在这座古老建筑中发生过的某场著名事件。
The style of architecture displayed in this aged but still finely upkept inn hearkens back to a time before your forebears, immaculately maintained to preserve the spirit of the age in which it was constructed. Along one wall, mementoes and curios surround an ornate brass plaque, undoubtedly recognizing some famous event that took place within this historical structure.

Silver Hunting Dagger.name:
银色狩猎匕首
Silver Hunting Dagger

Text.text:
这把12英寸的匕首美得惊人，也同样致命。刀刃为开膛剖腹而弯，寒光如一弯月的碎片。握柄缠着红色皮革，上面烙着一组姓名首字母——也许正是打造这件武器的巧手银匠所留。
The 12-inch dagger looks as pretty as it does deadly. The blade, curved for gutting, shines like a sliver of the moon. The hilt’s red leather wrap has initials burned into it—perhaps of the talented silversmith who made the weapon.

Gunshot Near Miss.name:
枪弹擦身而过
Gunshot Near Miss

Text.text:
子弹嗖地掠过，滚烫的弹壳擦着脸颊飞行，近得令人浑身发紧。心脏在胸腔里狂擂，你拼命把这次险些命中的惊惧压下去……然后，强迫自己集中精神。
The bullet whizzes past, the hot metal of the casing heating your cheek as it travels uncomfortably close. Heart thundering in your chest, you desperately try to put the near hit out of your mind… and focus.

Indignation At Your Arrival.name:
因你到来而起的愤怒
Indignation At Your Arrival

Text.text:
你一靠近，人群中便泛起一阵低低的窃窃私语，如涟漪般扩散开来，却很快又被强压成绷紧的寂静。你从他们身边走过时，那些遮掩的目光一闪而逝，泄露出他们对你出现的难以置信与愤懑——甚至对你本身、对你存在这件事的愤怒。
A low susurrus ripples through the flock of people as you draw near, although it is soon stifled into a strained disquiet. Veiled glances as you move past reveal their disbelief and indignation at your presence—and even at your very existence.

Dwarf’s Speech About Living Above Ground.name:
矮人谈在地表生活的演说
Dwarf’s Speech About Living Above Ground

Text.text:
“先是冷，接着热，然后亮，随后暗。毫无预兆地就变得湿透。我哪天都更愿意相信一座舒舒服服、黑黢黢的洞窟。”
“First, it’s cold, then hot, then light, then dark. It gets all wet without any warning. I’ll take the reliability of a nice, dark cavern any day.”

这套护甲轻若无物，却几近坚不可摧；无论利刃还是钝器反复敲打，也只能在那银蓝色的光泽上留下些许擦痕。显而易见，这是一件品质非凡的杰作，处处透着矮人或侏儒锻造技艺的独特印记。
The armor’s light weight and virtually impenetrable finish stands up to repeated abuse, with blades and blunt weaponry leaving only scuffs on its silver-blue sheen. Clearly, this suit is of exceptional quality and bears the earmarks of dwarfish or gnomish forging techniques.

Ring Of Water Walking.name:
踏水之戒
Ring Of Water Walking

Text.text:
这枚银戒以巴洛克式的奢华雕琢而成，镶满细小的蓝宝石，其上更有一颗硕大的蓝宝石凌驾其间。你凑近细看，忽觉异样：无论你怎么用力，指尖都会在离那颗大宝石表面仅差一丝之遥处停住，仿佛有一层无形之幕将它隔开。
The silver ring, crafted in baroque extravagance, is set with small sapphires, with one larger sapphire above all. When you examine it closely, you notice something odd: no matter how hard you try, your fingertip stops a hair’s breadth before touching the surface of the large jewel.

Cybernetically Enhanced Assassin.name:
义体强化刺客
Cybernetically Enhanced Assassin

Text.text:
一对猩红的眼睛在阴影的角落里幽幽发光，凶兆毕露。你眯起眼，才勉强看清一个流线的身影，几乎像人，却又锋利得过分，轮廓边缘像刀口般割裂黑暗。四肢尽数被黑色义体取代：手腕、肘部、膝盖与脚尖尽头皆伸出细薄的刃，像饥饿般静候着啃噬。眼下看不出还有别的武器，但他们那具金属之躯处处可藏枪械与弹丸，仿佛每一道接缝都能吐出致命的惊喜。
A pair of red eyes glows ominously in the shadowy corner. If you squint, it’s possible to make out the sleek outline of a figure, almost human, but the edges are too sharp. Each limb’s been replaced by black cybernetics, thin blades waiting hungrily at the wrists, elbows, knees, and the ends of the feet. No other weaponry is immediately visible, but the metal of their body offers plenty of places to conceal firearms and projectiles.

Blight Dragon And Rider.name:
枯疫巨龙与骑手
Blight Dragon And Rider

Text.text:
这座城市本该寂静——街道空荡潮湿，店铺紧闭——若不是有人高声吟诵法术的喊叫，火球的轰鸣，以及屋顶炸裂时“呼——”的一声巨响。骑手披着邪教长袍，兜帽高高罩起；在他与他胯下的巨龙四周，枯疫蝇群如乌云翻涌。巨龙的鳞片焦黑黯淡，双眼深陷，眼眶边缘结着痂圈。它拍动双翼，将腐臭的气息压向地面；它与楼宇之间的空气被烟幕染黑，仿佛一顶低垂的穹盖。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

The city would be quiet—its streets empty and wet, the shops closed—were it not for the sound of someone shouting a spell, the roar of fireballs, and the whoosh of roofs exploding. The rider wears cult robes with hood raised, and all around him and the dragon he rides are clouds of blight flies. The dragon’s scales are blackened and tarnished, its eyes sunken and ringed with scabs. Its wings push a putrid stench down, and the air between it and the buildings blackens with a canopy of smoke.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Robot Who Wants To Be Human: Benign.name:
渴望成为人类的机器人：善良
Robot Who Wants To Be Human: Benign

Text.text:
“那岂不是妙极了？我能感到肌肤的接触，或许还能试着崇拜几位神祇。我能感到在直射而致癌的阳光下，荷尔蒙反应带来的快感，血清素随之攀升；再把那份愉悦用酒精饮料危险地层层叠加。我仍是一具木偶，一尊会走动的雕像。我的皮格马利翁在哪里？我的亨利·希金斯？我的爱德华·刘易斯？”
“Wouldn’t it be just grand? I could feel the touch of skin, perhaps try worshiping some gods. I could feel the pleasure of hormonal response to direct and carcinogenic sunlight, resulting in an increase of serotonin that I could dangerously compound with alcoholic beverages. I’m still a puppet, a moving statue. Where is my Pygmalion? My Henry Higgins? My Edward Lewis?”

Island Revealed To Be Dragon Turtle.name:
岛屿真身竟是龙龟
Island Revealed To Be Dragon Turtle

Text.text:
你惊恐地发现，海滩竟在移动，地面猛然一晃，将你向前掀去，脚下像被巨力拖拽般起伏不定。离岸不远处，你看见两只巨大、覆满鳞甲的鳍肢破浪而出——分别从岛屿两端抬起——冰冷的明悟沉入你的胃里：你终于明白……这座岛是活的！当这头巨型生物开始下潜，海水猛冲上滩，你几乎没有时间权衡选择。再过几秒，你就会漂浮在茫茫海面上。

~ 构想：Clara C. Potter（Discord）

To your horror, the beach shifts, pitching you forward as the ground lurches under you. Off the coast, you see two enormous, scaly flippers rise out of the waves—one at each end of the island—and cold realization settles in your gut as you understand… this island is alive! The sea rushes up the beach as the giant creature begins to dive, and you have precious little time to consider your options. In seconds, you will be adrift at sea.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Kiyiya Howlingwhispergrin.name:
基伊娅·嚎风低语咧笑
Kiyiya Howlingwhispergrin

Text.text:
她的血液在漩涡的召唤中咆哮。魔法的激流贯穿她的身躯：自青金石般的指甲尖端奔涌而出，掠过她前臂上繁复盘旋的刺青纹路，直上精灵的耳尖，又沿着她猛禽般的尾巴与双足奔落。她晒成古铜色的肌肤因此泛起粼粼微光，金色眼眸爆裂出虹彩般的辉芒。翠绿的长发在眉上双角之上扬起，轻拂着悬浮在她头顶的符文光环，如同一顶虚幻的王冠。察觉到这股骤然爆燃的力量，她身旁那头巨狼的毛发竖立。它闷燃的躯体倏然迸出火焰，迈步挡在她身前——像个护短的兄长。

~ Played by Mąʼii Ashkii with

Her blood howls with the maelstrom’s call. The rush of magic courses through her body: from the tips of her lapis lazuli nails, across the complex swirl of tattoos etched into her forearms, up to her elven ears and down to her raptorial tail and feet. It makes her tanned skin shimmer and her golden eyes erupt with iridescence. Verdant tresses rise above supraorbital horns to brush the runic halo floating above her head like an ethereal crown. Sensing the sudden flare of power, the massive wolf at her side bristles. Its smoldering body erupts in flame as it moves to stand before her—like a protective older brother.

~ Played by Mąʼii Ashkii with

龟裂的虫甲厚片与刺硬的毛皮斑块交错铺陈，覆在你眼前那骇人的猿形巨物之上。它那狼般的面孔裂开，露出獠牙森然的狞笑，带爪的双手因迫不及待而微微抽动。一条锯齿尾巴左右甩动，末端的荆刺状倒钩大得胜过弩炮箭矢；而它背上那如无肉之翼般伸展的锯齿螯钳咔哒作响，饥渴地预告着暴力与痛楚。
Slabs of cracked insectoid carapace interspersed with patches of bristling pelt cover the hideous apelike enormity before you. Its lupine face splits into a fanged grin as its clawed hands twitch in anticipation. A serrated tail that ends in a thorn-shaped barb larger than a ballistae bolt swishes back and forth as saw-toothed pincers—extending from its back like fleshless wings—clack in eager anticipation of violence and pain.

Pursuant Minion Cleanser.name:
追随者仆从清除者
Pursuant Minion Cleanser

Text.text:
这是个魁梧的大块头，肌肉沉重鼓胀，扛着一支长枪，后背连着一只储罐。武器的每一寸都亮得刺眼——银白、铬光与钢色交织——其上覆满怪异的符号刻痕。储罐呈药丸状，几乎和他一样大。枪身如同一体浇铸般顺滑成形，唯有一只手掌大小的滑动式扳机向下弯垂。枪口尽头，一簇小小的白色火焰悬在空中，漂浮不落。男人戴着头盔，配有一面巨大的不透明面罩，双手套着厚重手套牢牢握住武器。
This is a big guy, heavy with muscle, carrying a long gun attached to a tank on his back. Every part of the weapon is bright silver, chrome, or steel, and covered with strange symbolic markings. The tank is pill-shaped and nearly as large as the man. The gun is formed smoothly in one piece, with only a hand-sized slide trigger curving down under it. At the end of the barrel, a small white flame floats in midair. The man wears a helmet with a large opaque face shield and holds the weapon with heavy gloves.

Excerpt From The Encyclopedia Globularia.name:
摘自《球根植物百科全书》
Excerpt From The Encyclopedia Globularia

Text.text:
此位面上存在四座具备元界容量的高塔，但其中两座在东欧与南欧的中世纪晚期彼此冲突中倾覆。借助群体唤能系魔法，可在岩石圈中追踪到魔法能量的构造脉络（见地质图 M537 与 M538）。
Four towers of meta-realm capacity exist on this plane, but two fell to conflict with one another during the late medieval period of eastern and southern Europe. Tectonic veins of magical energy can be traced through the lithosphere with communal evocation magic (see geologic maps M537 and M538).

大地上的裂缝蜿蜒穿过地形，仿佛绵延数英里之遥。它虽不及峡谷那般深邃，却依旧以其尺度令你心生敬畏。你不禁想，这道裂缝究竟在这片大地上延伸了多远——又是什么造就了它？
The crack in the earth winds its way through the terrain, seemingly miles in length. Though not the depth of a canyon, its scale still awes you, and you wonder how far it travels across the landscape—and what formed it?

当你完成法术时，空气中掠过一阵轻微的嗡鸣，你清楚自己刚刚在这片区域上施下了怎样的触发。如今，只要条件达成，周遭目睹之人便会看到你预设的幻象——一场依你心意编排的幻景，声与形都分毫不差。只要那不设防的灵魂不曾屈尊去接触这幻象，便永远不会察觉其中端倪。
A slight thrum passes through the air as you complete the spell, aware of the trigger you have just cast upon the area. Now, when the conditions are met, any around to view it will be treated to an illusion programmed by you, a phantasm both seen and heard exactly to your specifications. So long as the unwary soul does not deign to touch the illusion, they need never be the wiser.

Slow Affecting Player.name:
缓慢影响玩家
Slow Affecting Player

Text.text:
空气中的尘埃忽然变得异常清晰可见，仿佛时代在你周遭放慢了脚步。一阵刺骨寒意骤然袭来。随即，氛围似乎又恢复如常。你的思维依旧如旧，仍在指挥身体以惯常的敏捷回应。但某种力量像气泡般将你笼罩，阻止你以应有的速度行动。于是，你只能以令人不适的缓慢挪动，清醒地意识到自己正处在一种非自然的状态中。

~ 由一位英雄所构想

Dust in the air becomes all too visible as time slackens around you. A sudden chill sets in. Then, the atmosphere seemingly returns to normal. Your mind remains as it was, commanding your body to respond with its normal alacrity. But some force, like a bubble around you, prevents you from acting as quickly as you should. Instead, you move with uncomfortable slowness, acutely aware of your unnatural state.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Enchiridion Of The Unusual.name:
异闻秘典
Enchiridion Of The Unusual

Text.text:
这本书的封面血红如凝，银色书名是它唯一的装饰。没有烫金，没有金箔，只有朴素而结实的纸张，以线装订。可书页却令人叹为观止：奥秘的公式与图阵，写满十余种你不识得的语言。它是一册法术书。它是一份实验室日志。它是一部战争机器的论著。它是一门关于巨龙的研究。以及十来种你连想都想不到之事的学术长篇。
The cover of this book is blood red, the title in silver its only ornamentation. No gilt, no gold leaf, just simple sturdy paper bound with thread. The pages, however, are a wonder: arcane formulae and diagrams in a dozen languages you do not recognize. It is a spellbook. It is a laboratory log. It is a treatise on war machines. It is a study on dragons. And a dissertation on a dozen other things you cannot imagine.

Loot From A Yuan-ti Warrior.name:
一名蛇人战士的战利品
Loot From A Yuan-ti Warrior

Text.text:
你费力将战士那冰冷而沾血的手指，从握把上缠绕的布条间一根根掰开，目光随即掠过这把弓。它以柔韧的深色木材制成，嵌着流光溢彩的宝石，的确是配得上你这场胜利的战利品。
Prying the warrior’s cool, blood-stained fingers from the wrapped cloth of the grip, you cast your eyes over the bow. Crafted from supple dark wood, and inlaid with opalescent stones, it is truly a prize worthy of your victory.

Sewer: Lost In The Maze.name:
下水道：迷失于迷宫之中
Sewer: Lost In The Maze

Text.text:
你原以为自己会逐渐习惯这股气味，但在这里，每一次呼吸都是一次新的侵袭。腐烂的残渣在你脚边隧道里汇聚的污泥中闷煮发酵，不断鼓起一串串腥臭的气泡，噗噗破裂，溅起带泡的污秽与恶臭。你环顾四周，想从这片烂泥烂水里找条活路，却在阵阵眩晕中视野发漂，几条隧道在你眼前摇曳游动。
You thought you would become accustomed to the smell, but every breath here brings a new assault. Rotting material stews in the sludge that pools about you in the tunnels, sending up flatulent bubbles that splatter and froth the foulness. You look about for an escape from the mess, and you see several tunnels swimming in your vision as you grow lightheaded.

Border Town Livery.name:
边陲镇马厩
Border Town Livery

Text.text:
[空置] 一匹气势逼人的骏马拴在大广场上一幢单层木屋外，正傲然瞪着你。大门敞开，门楣上悬着一只巨大的风格化马蹄铁。屋内飘出马匹与新鲜干草的气息，夹杂着粪臭。每面墙边都排着马厩，有几间里，好奇的马儿把脑袋探出门板，带着期待望着你。缰具与马鞍挂在刷白的墙上，被擦拭得锃亮发光。这里被打理得一尘不染。

[使用中] 你走进镇子西侧的一处宽阔广场，注意到一幢单层木屋。大门敞开，门楣上挂着一只巨大的风格化马蹄铁；屋外，一名少女正给一匹神骏的公马梳理鬃毛。一个秃顶、满脸通红的男人提着两只空桶从屋里出来，身上带着新鲜干草与粪味。他把桶放下，用袖子抹了抹额头的汗。

[Vacant] An impressive-looking stallion glares imperiously at you from its tether outside a single-story timber building in the large open square. The doors are wide open, and a large stylized horseshoe hangs above them. From within wafts the scent of horses and fresh hay, along with the stink of dung. Stables line each wall, some with inquisitive-looking horses peering expectantly over the doors. Tack and saddles hang on the white-washed walls, gleaming with polish. The place seems extremely well looked after.

[In use] Entering a large open square on the west side of town, you notice a single-story timber building. The doors are wide open and a large stylized horseshoe hangs above them, while outside, an impressive-looking stallion is being groomed by a teenage girl. The smell of fresh hay and dung follows a balding, red-faced man as he exits the building carrying two empty buckets. He sets them down and wipes his brow on his sleeve.

Quip By A Wealth-seeking Rogue.name:
一个逐财的游荡者的俏皮话
Quip By A Wealth-seeking Rogue

Text.text:
“你觉得我追逐财富很肤浅？觉得真正的幸福源自内心之类的鬼话？我真不想这么告诉你，但在贫穷里找到满足，不过是富人编出来的神话，好让你别去把他们的东西全拿走——而我可不打算信这一套。”
“You think my pursuit of wealth is shallow? That true happiness comes from within or whatever? I hate to tell you this, but fulfillment found in poverty is a myth told by the rich to stop you from taking all their stuff, and I don’t intend to buy into it.”

I Cast Reverse Gravity.name:
我施放「反转重力」
I Cast Reverse Gravity

Text.text:
我的双眼转为铁一般的暗灰，胃里像有一群蝴蝶猛然翻腾。我将手掌掠过目标区域，眼看着凡是没被钉死在地板上的东西都从地面浮起。我的平衡感也摇晃了一瞬，脚跟随之离地——可我强迫自己稳住身形维持咒语，注视着敌人与无生命的物体一并扬帆般向上飘升。
My eyes turn the dull gray of iron and I feel the lurch of butterflies in my stomach. I wave my hand over the target area and watch as everything not nailed to the floor lifts off the ground. My own equilibrium wavers for a moment, lifting my feet—but I steady myself to maintain the incantation, and watch enemy and inanimate object alike sail upward.

这件绗缝亚麻长外套做工扎实，肩部针脚牢固，前襟宽阔交叠。灰色并没能遮住旧日留下的泥污斑痕，但你看不出任何破洞，闻起来也还算干净。
This long coat of quilted linen shows good handiwork with strong stitching at the shoulders and a broad overlap at the front. Its gray color does little to hide the lingering stains of mud from former use, but you can see no holes, and it smells alright.

Wizard's Spellbook.name:
法师的法术书
Wizard's Spellbook

Text.text: [掩蔽] 这本磨损的皮装书卷封面毫无辨识标记，被一条黑色缎带系紧。书脊内侧还系着几条同样的缎带，充作书签。 [内容] 纸页因岁月而起伏不平，边角磨损，布满使用留下的划痕与记号。好几页已经从装订处脱落。散落的便笺夹杂其中，潦草而匆促的字迹与随手几笔速写，记录着个人的魔法技法。 [Cover] This worn, leatherbound volume has no distinguishing marks on the cover and is tied closed with a black ribbon. Several such ribbons are also fastened to the inner binding, acting as bookmarks. [Content] The paper pages are warped and uneven, marred and marked with use. Several have come free of the binding. Loose notes accompany relaxed and hasty handwriting and quick sketches describing personal magical techniques.

Dead Tree Crossroads.name:
枯树十字路口
Dead Tree Crossroads

Smoky Fireplace.name:
烟雾缭绕的壁炉
Smoky Fireplace

Text.text:
烟道久未维护，炉火的秽渣沿着石砌壁面向上溢出，爬到上方的壁炉台沿。房间里不再弥漫木材温热树脂的气息，取而代之的是带着粉白质感、阴湿发闷的黑烟味。炉栅下方，灰烬与沙粒堆得有些过高了。
The flue has not been maintained and the waste of the fire spills upward over the stone to the mantle above. The room smells less of the warm sap of wood and more of chalky, dank black smoke. Below the grate, ash and sand pile a bit too high.

Quip About Bleeding Kings.name:
关于流血国王的俏皮话
Quip About Bleeding Kings

Text.text:
“把子民的苦难讲给国王听——若他尚有仁慈，或许他的心会为此淌血片刻。砍下他的头，他的脖子会流血更久。”
“Tell a king about the plight of his people and, if he is kind, perhaps his heart will bleed for a moment. Cut off his head and his neck will bleed for much longer.”

Ogre Camp On Hill.name:
山丘上的食人魔营地
Ogre Camp On Hill

Text.text:
当你越过山脊俯瞰下去，映入眼帘的是一幅惨烈景象，背后是夕阳如血的余晖。散落的巨石之间，你看见一堆咆哮的篝火，火里还滋滋作响地烤着一头被肢解的母牛残骸。那跳动火光拉长的阴影里，一头食人魔般的庞然身影倚着倒木，正用一个倒霉鬼被掏空的头骨当酒杯，咕嘟咕嘟灌着腥臭的浊酿。怪物身后是一处潮湿阴冷的洞口，洞前锁着一位年迈的贤者，他因恐惧而瑟瑟发抖，脸上的沟壑在惊惧中更显深刻；食人魔每吞几口酒就喷着酒气吐出威胁的话语。
The tableau that greets you when you peer over the crest of the hill is a grisly one, backlit by the bloody light of the setting sun. Between strewn boulders, you spy a roaring fire that sizzles with the remnants of a butchered cow. Stretched out from that flickering light is the monstrous silhouette of an ogre who is leaning against a fallen log and drinking foul brew from the hollowed-out skull of an unlucky victim. Beyond the monster is the mouth of a dank cave, and chained before it is a geriatric sage shivering in fear, the creases of his face deepening with dread as the ogre sputters threats between mouthfuls of swill.

A Narrow Path Along The Cliff.name:
沿着峭壁的一条狭窄小径
A Narrow Path Along The Cliff

Text.text:
前方的路窄得几乎只容一人通过，只在垂直的峭壁与惊险的深渊之间，勉强延伸出一条细薄的岩脊。你每踏出一步，边缘便簌簌震落几粒碎石，翻滚着坠向山下，转眼便消失无踪。
The path ahead is hardly wide enough for one, only offering a thin stretch of rock between a sheer cliff face and a precarious drop. One step shakes a few pebbles from the edge, sending them tumbling down the mountain and quickly out of sight.

Firewall Alerts You To Intercepted Uploa.name:
防火墙警报：已拦截上传
Firewall Alerts You To Intercepted Upload

Text.text: 全息界面与键盘骤然闪烁出刺目的橙光，一个醒目的文字框弹出：Firewall 行动。伴随几声尖刻的哔鸣，文字框眨眼间化为虚无，随即被一个更大的窗口取代，标签写着：行动摘要。你扫过那唯一一行字，它像原本光滑花瓶上猝然裂开的缝隙般刺眼：一次上传被拦截——目标是你的网络。 The holographic interface and keyboard suddenly flash vivid orange, and a bold text box pops up: Firewall Activity. With a few acerbic beeps the box winks into nothing and is replaced by a larger window labelled Activity Summary. You scan the single line glaring out at you like a crack in a once smooth vase: an intercepted upload to your network.

Old Barbarian’s Lament.name:
老蛮子的悲叹
Old Barbarian’s Lament

Text.text:
“每一场战斗都留下伤疤。每一次胜利，都伴着隐痛。有人告诉我，战斗是我此生的使命，可我觉得……我的身体已经不想再继续了。”
“Every battle has left a scar. Every victory, an ache. I was told fighting was my purpose in life, but I don’t think my body wants to do it anymore.”

她有着一百个童话拼凑而成的面孔：又长又疣的鼻子，尖利的指甲与牙齿，一蓬粗硬的白发乱如飞絮，还有那双写满传说的巫婆般阴谋灰眼。她反复无常，情绪汹涌，软磨硬泡讨要恩惠，却只以谜语作回报。这便是鬼婆中的鬼婆——她的波西米亚长裙几乎像漂浮般环绕身侧。她远不止炉边采药的草药婆子；她穿梭维度，骑着扫帚跨越时代，她的研钵与研杵会扩张变形，化作一艘能飞的舟与舵。她的年代本身几乎也是一种存在：她的智慧，无人能及。

~ Played by Beer Gnome

Hers is the face of a hundred fairy tales: long warty nose, sharp nails and teeth, coarse spray of white hair, and the scheming gray eyes of the storied witch. She is fickle, wildly emotional, wheedling favors and returning only riddles. This is the hag of hags, her bohemian dress almost floating around her. More than a mere fireside herbalist, she is a dimension-traveler and a broom-rider through time, her mortar and pestle expanding to become a flying boat and rudder. Her age itself is almost a presence: her wisdom, peerless.

~ Played by Beer Gnome

一堆被丢弃的垃圾散发出令人窒息的恶臭；你一靠近，腐烂的硫磺酸味便灼烧着你的鼻腔。害虫在参差不齐、锈蚀的破烂、腐坏的食物、丢弃的道具与破得发白的衣物间窜动疾行，时不时停下，朝那些胆敢踏入它们领地的无礼闯入者发出防御性的嘶鸣。
The stench from the pile of discarded refuse is overwhelming and burns your nostrils with the sulfurous tang of rot as you get close. Vermin skitter and scurry through jagged, rusted junk, rotting food, discarded gear, and threadbare clothing, stopping to hiss defensively at the impudent intruders who dare set foot in their domain.

Talisman Of Pure Good.name:
纯善护符
Talisman Of Pure Good

Text.text:
白金色的光辉在那枚镶宝青铜徽章的每一寸表面与纹饰上流转。不可思议的是，你越是靠近这件饰物，越能感到一阵阵温暖、爱意与正义之感如波涛般向你辐射而来，将你笼罩其中。
White-gold light plays over every surface and feature of the bejeweled bronze medallion. Inexplicably, the closer you draw to the jewelry, the more you sense waves of warmth, love, and righteousness radiating over you.

Feylar O'grimm.name:
费拉尔·奥格里姆
Feylar O'grimm

Text.text:
一个男人高大挺拔、自信从容地站在你面前，皮肤如新烧的木炭般灰黑。猩红眼眸的幽光与鞭子般尾巴的一甩一摆，不但无损他的美貌与魅力，反而更添几分危险的风采。他朝你微笑，用蜷起的利爪之拳掩住一声低低的轻笑。待他转身，你瞥见一对硕大的皮翼紧紧收拢，贴伏在他的背上。

~ Played by Grim the Tyrannical

A man stands tall and confident before you, his skin the gray-black of fresh charcoal. The glow of his crimson eyes and the flick of his whip-like tail do nothing to mar his beauty nor his charm. He smiles at you, hiding a quiet laugh behind a curled, clawed fist. When he turns, you catch a glimpse of large leathery wings clasped tightly to his back.

~ Played by Grim the Tyrannical

Merchildren Playing.name:
嬉戏的海裔孩童
Merchildren Playing

Text.text:
泡泡翻飞成一场欢欣的盛景，鱼人幼崽在绚丽的珊瑚间嬉戏游弋。尽管鳍翼尚小，这些小小生灵却以天生的优雅滑过水中，与孕育他们的大海浑然一体，随它起伏的潮律轻轻摇曳

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Bubbles dance in a joyous spectacle as the merchildren play and swim amid vibrant coral. Though their fins are small, the tiny creatures glide through the water with natural grace, at one with the ocean they were born into, and swaying to its undulating rhythms

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

你的身体瘫软倒地，你紧握的昂贵法术法器从失去力气的指间轻轻滑落。伴随着一种古怪的触感，恍若梦境，你的灵魂猛然从躯壳中被扯出，如同酿好的酒液般倾泻而下，注入那早已备好的容器之中。
Your body crumples to the ground, the expensive spell focus you were clutching tumbling gently from nerveless fingers. With a curious sensation something like a dream, your very soul wrenches itself from your body, pouring itself like so much brew into the prepared vessel.

Quip By A Despondent Wanderer.name:
一位沮丧的流浪者的俏皮话
Quip By A Despondent Wanderer

Text.text:
“我漂泊太久了。我还记得生命之海曾经汹涌而凛冽，令人精神一振，但那个时代已经过去。如今我只是在它温吞的水面上随波浮沉，任由生活从我身边流过。”
“I have been adrift for so long. I remember when the sea of life was turbulent and bracing, but that time is gone. Now I simply bob atop its lukewarm waters as life flows past me.”

Short Travel Across The Astral Plane.name:
横渡星界位面短途旅行
Short Travel Across The Astral Plane

Text.text:
你踏上旅程时并不确定自己会遇见什么。道路危机四伏，引你穿越碎石残骸、漂浮的土块，甚至坚固成形的光。前方——在你上方与下方——皆是被星光点刺的无尽虚空。那些星辰与发光的星云是唯一的光源，为万物镀上一层异界的幽辉。正当你开始怀疑自己是否迷失了方向，你忽然看见了目的地。
You embark on your journey unsure of what you might find. The path is perilous, leading you across rubble, floating masses of earth, even solid light. Beyond—above and below you—lies an endless void pinpricked by stars. Those stars and luminous nebulae provide the only light, casting everything in an otherworldly glow. Just as you begin to wonder whether you've lost your way, you suddenly see your destination.

那美丽的人形存在缓缓降下：肌肤如闪耀的青铜，发如流光的黄金，背后珠光四溢的羽翼舒展如幕。那天使般的身影披着璀璨的银色护甲，其上嵌饰金与白金，且点缀着无数不知名的异金；腰侧悬着一柄寒光凛冽的阔剑——剑柄末端镶着一枚辉耀得令人不敢直视的宝石，光芒竟令剑刃在鞘中也隐隐发亮。燃着光的蓝眸落在你身上，你在灵魂深处感到这位异界存在那无法估量、不可名状的伟力。你明知不愿，却仍不由自主地颤抖。
The beautiful humanoid with skin of gleaming bronze and hair of shining gold descends, pearlescent wings unfurled at their back. The angelic figure wears armor of shining silver, inlaid with gold and platinum and innumerable unknown metals, and at their hip hangs a broadsword of gleaming steel—its pommel set with a gemstone so radiant it sets aglow the blade in its hilt. Blue eyes ablaze with light focus on you, and you feel in your soul the full, unreckonable might of this otherworldly being. You cannot help but tremble, despite yourself.

未雨绸缪总是划算，但你不可能预料一切。施展这道法术，你希望自己不至于措手不及，反而能借助一份属于你的惊奇。你将一枚蓝宝石悬在物体之上，以它在两者之间的空气里勾画你的印记。法术回应之际，宝石与物体上同时浮现出一枚发光的标记，彼此完美镜像。待你完成施法，两枚标记随即隐去。
It always pays to plan ahead, yet you can’t plan for everything. By casting this spell, you hope to avoid being caught flatfooted, leveraging a surprise of your own. You hold a sapphire above the object and use it to draw your sigil in the air between them. In response to your spell, a glowing mark appears on both gem and object, perfectly mirrored. As you finish casting, both marks vanish.

Dragon's Coming—a Shanty.name:
《龙临之歌》——一首水手号子
Dragon's Coming—a Shanty

Text.text:
[醉酒水手的曲调]

巨龙来袭时我们能怎么办？
巨龙来袭时我们能怎么办？
巨龙来袭时我们能怎么办？
越过那遥远的地平线？

藏好你的黄金转身就跑，
藏好你的黄金转身就跑，
把所有黄金都藏好转身就跑，
越过那遥远的地平线！

但愿有支强悍的队伍正赶来，
但愿有支强悍的队伍正赶来，
但愿有支强悍的队伍正赶来，
越过那遥远的地平线！

一名兽人、一名精灵和一名矮人会救我们，
兽人与精灵与矮人会救我们，
兽人与精灵与矮人会救我们，
把我们从那遥远的地平线外救回！

~ 由 Jangowolf 构想

[Tune of Drunken Sailor]

What can we do when a dragon’s coming?
What can we do when a dragon’s coming?
What can we do when a dragon’s coming?
O’er that far horizon?

Hide your gold and get to running,
Hide your gold and get to running,
Hide all your gold and get to running,
O’er that far horizon!

Hope there’s a mighty party nearing,
Hope there’s a mighty party nearing,
Hope there’s a mighty party nearing,
O’er that far horizon!

An orc and an elf and a dwarf will save us,
Orc and elf and dwarf will save us,
Orc and elf and dwarf will save us,
From o’er that far horizon!

~ Envisioned by Jangowolf

Aftermath Of A Foul Deed.name:
卑劣行径的余波
Aftermath Of A Foul Deed

Text.text:
你的火炬光在空中悬浮的血粒上泛起猩红的粼光，仿佛连时代本身都已凝滞。令人窒息的寂静加深了那股不对劲——这里发生的邪行远不止夺去性命：更像是掠走了他们的本质。血珠开始缓缓漂移，像一支骇人的回旋舞步，最终汇聚成一具躯体的剪影。那曾是明亮灵魂的残影——如今只剩下过往自我的一缕受折磨的碎片。
Your torchlight glistens crimson on particles of blood that hover in the air, as if time itself has ceased. The oppressive silence reinforces the sense of wrongness, of a foul deed that has taken place here beyond the taking of one’s life: the robbery of their very essence. The droplets of blood begin to drift, a gruesome pirouette that converges into the silhouette of a body. It is a shadow of what once was a bright soul—now but a mere tormented fraction of their past self.

Festooned Goblin.name:
花里胡哨的地精
Festooned Goblin

Text.text:
小地精咧开一口歪牙笑得跟耳朵一样宽，活像孩童用的裙装人台，又像侏儒的门厅衣帽架。花环从一只尖耳垂到鼻尖，再绕到另一只耳朵。她抬起双手，腕上颈间堆满串珠手镯与项链，仿佛在向神祇祈求。六条腰带——从皮革到草编——缠在她的绑腿上，绑腿上别着布片与亮片。她说：“我需要一顶帽子。”
With a crooked-toothed smile as wide as her ears, the little goblin resembles a child’s dress form, or a hall tree for gnomes. Garlands of flowers are draped from one pointed ear to nose to other ear. She raises her hands, loaded with beaded bracelets and necklaces, as if imploring the gods. Six belts, from leather to grass, wrap around leggings pinned with swatches of fabric and sequin. “I need a hat,” she says.

Portal To The Ethereal Plane.name:
通往以太位面的传送门
Portal To The Ethereal Plane

Text.text:
要在此地旅行，你需要烟雾，你需要眩晕，你还需要身处亡者所在之处。你闭上眼，向前迈出一步……当你再度睁眼时，你已然抵达。
To travel here you need smoke, you need to be dizzy, and you need to be where the dead are. You close your eyes and take a step forward . . . When you open your eyes, you have arrived.

你的注意力在法术的目标与希望前往的地点之间来回切换。前一瞬，你仍能感知周遭；下一瞬，你便穿透空间与现实的帷幕，窥见你的目的地。
Your focus shifts between the target of the spell, and the location to which you wish to travel. In one instant, you perceive your surroundings; the next, you peer through space and reality to see your destination.

I Use Astral Perception To Detect Cyberw.name:
我启用星界察觉来侦测义体
I Use Astral Perception To Detect Cyberware

Text.text:
我额头正中央传来一阵坚硬的压迫感，仿佛有人用手指死死按了进去。世界被猛地撕开一层薄纱，薄纱之后的身影凝聚成具有人形轮廓的幽影。我看见那些剥去血肉、植入金属的人；我看见那些选择了魔法之路或灵修之道的人。在一个我曾见过的个体头顶上方，浮现出一个小小的橙色方框。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The center of my forehead feels a firm pressure, as though someone has pressed their finger into it. A veil is ripped from the world, and the figures within coalesce into specters with humanoid forms. I see those who have removed their flesh and inserted metal. I see those who have chosen the path of magic or the path of spiritual practice. A small orange box appears above the head of an individual that I have seen before.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Haunted Castle: Castle Tower.name:
闹鬼城堡：城堡塔楼
Haunted Castle: Castle Tower

Text.text:
在这高高的城垛上，狂风盘旋呼啸，鞭打着你，像在咆哮威胁要把你掀过女墙。你想到坠落，想象自己的身体如秋叶般飘摇下沉，最终在下方的石块上休息。到了那里，你就能躲开风势。只隔着短短几尺石墙，你便能抵达那份安宁。
Here on the high battlement, the wind whirls and whips around you, making blustering threats to blow you over the parapet. You think about falling, imagining your body drifting down like an autumn leaf and coming to rest on the stones below. Down there you would be sheltered from the wind. Just a few feet of stone separate you from that peace.

Loot From A Vampire Sleeping In Coffin.name:
从棺材中沉睡的吸血鬼（特征）身上搜出的战利品
Loot From A Vampire Sleeping In Coffin

Text.text:
在那具巴洛克风格的棺椁四周，你发现了吸血鬼（特征）在漫长而诅咒的一生中积攒的成堆珍宝。其中一组陈列在展示柜中的器物格外夺目；你凑近细看，才发现它们精美得令人屏息。透过纤尘不染的玻璃，在柔软天鹅绒的褶皱上，静静躺着四件由抛光木材雕琢而成的物品——每一件至少价值2500金币：一枚宝珠、一根短杖、一只钵盂，以及一只机关谜盒。它们通体以贵金属与宝石精工嵌饰，交织出华丽而繁复的纹样，宛如活着的星图与藤蔓。吸血鬼（特征）显然对这套收藏珍若性命——可它究竟为何如此看重？
Surrounding the baroque coffin, you find a plethora of valuable items the vampire accrued over their long, cursed life. A particular set of artifacts resting in a display case catches your eye and, upon further investigation, you find them to be exquisite. Resting in the folds of soft velvet beneath the immaculate glass you see four items crafted of polished wood, each worth at least 2500 gold pieces: an orb, a rod, a bowl, and a puzzle box—each masterfully inlaid with precious metals and gems in beautiful and complex patterns. The vampire clearly valued this collection highly—but why?

I Cast Wall Of Ice From My Staff Of Fros.name:
我举起寒霜法杖，施放《冰墙》
I Cast Wall Of Ice From My Staff Of Frost

Text.text:
我念出指令词，同时将法杖高高上扬，划出一道宏伟的弧线。霜华沿着我的指尖攀附，肌肤贴上那冰寒刺骨、缠绕着蓝色能量飘带的杖身时灼痛如焚。大地轰然炸裂，冰晶碎片喷涌而出，尖啸如同玻璃崩裂；空气凝成霜冷的死寂，冻结般静止。
I speak the command word as I draw the staff upwards in grand arch. Frost rimes my fingers and my skin burns against the frigid haft of the staff swirling with blue ribbons of energy. The ground erupts into icy shards, keening like shattering glass, and the air becomes frosty and still.

Gem Of Seeing.name:
洞察宝石
Gem Of Seeing

Text.text:
这件器物宛如一枚装在短而纤细的雕木杆上的放大镜，木杆末端覆以青铜；那颗澄澈的宝石被精心切割塑形，以严丝合缝地嵌入座中，体型约莫与一只人眼相仿。透过宝石凝视时，你会感到一种无与伦比的触动，仿佛不知何故获得了超越视力本身的“视见”。
Resembling a magnifying glass mounted on a short, thin rod of carved wood capped with bronze, the clear jewel, cut and shaped to fit in its housing, is approximately the size of a human eye. Peering through the gem, you are aware of an incomparable sensation, as if you have somehow gained sight beyond sight.

I Cast Cutting Words.name:
我施展「尖刻挖苦」
I Cast Cutting Words

Text.text:
我静候我们的敌人举起武器准备攻击的那一刻，然后我出手……用我最锋利的言辞！这是一记刻意的口头刺击，旨在扰乱与迷惑。我强行把敌人的注意力拉到我身上，让他们心神失守、专注崩散。
I wait until our foe raises a weapon to attack, and I strike… with my sharpest words! It’s a verbal jab intended to distract and confuse. I force the enemy’s attention to me and make them lose focus.

Child's Introductory Ar Goggles.name:
儿童款入门级 Ar 护目镜
Child's Introductory Ar Goggles

Text.text: 亮得扎眼的黄配色，侧面还画着两只夸张的卡通眼睛，这副AR护目镜对成年人来说小得可笑。用来固定在头上的绑带是皮质的，上面用醒目的黄色大字写着：小小漫游者的超级视界护目镜！。护目镜内侧还缝着一行安全警告，告知佩戴者其内置AR网络已被改装，以确保儿童的绝对安全。 Gaudy yellow with two cartoonish eyes on the side, these AR goggles are too small for an adult. The strap to attach them to the head is leathered, with Lil Rover’s Super Sight Goggles! written in big yellow letters along it. There’s a safety warning stitched to the inside of the goggles informing the reader that internal AR networks have been modified for total child safety.

Temple To A God Of Records.name:
记录之神的神殿
Temple To A God Of Records

Text.text:
书架自地面直抵天花，沿着这处一尘不染、精心陈设的空间四壁排开；每一格都塞满厚重典籍与卷轴，先按主题分门别类，再依出版日期、作者姓名与书名细细排序。室内摆着数张书桌，每张桌上都备有蜡烛、羽毛笔，以及盛着深黑墨汁的墨池。远处的墙面垂着一幅巨大的挂毯，随着信众来回走动带起的风微微拂动。挂毯描绘着已知世界的历史，从创世黎明一直延伸到几近当下；每一幕画面旁都标注着年月与要人姓名，以及足以改写世界的重大事件。
Shelves soar floor to ceiling, lining the walls of the immaculately curated space, each laden with tomes and scrolls organized first by subject matter, then date of publication, author’s name, and title. Several desks occupy the room, each set with candles, quills, and wells of deep black ink. On the far wall, a massive tapestry hangs, fluttering lightly with displaced wind as worshippers move here and there. The tapestry depicts the history of the known world, from the dawn of creation to nearly the present day, each vignette labeled with dates and names of important figures and world-changing events.

Silver Dragon Lair.name:
银龙巢穴
Silver Dragon Lair

Text.text:
这间厅室对一条巨龙来说也许有些局促，却能提供一处壮丽的制高点。最高塔楼上豁开的巨大洞口，如同一扇敞开的天窗，俯瞰着山巅城堡在脚下铺展开来，峰顶周遭尽是云雾翻涌的幽深谷地。你看不见任何宝藏，但若你是一条栖居于此的巨龙，你也会把宝藏藏得远离窥探的目光——尤其是那些掠空而过的同类。
The chamber might be a bit cramped for a dragon, but it provides a spectacular vantage. A gaping hole in the tallest tower gives a panoramic view of the mountaintop castle spread below it and the cloudy valleys that surround the peak. You can’t see any hoard, but if you were a dragon living here, you’d hide your treasure away from prying eyes—particularly those of passing dragons.

一股悲伤浸透了这片被遗忘的废墟，细微的哀愁如冬日寒意般渗入骨髓。这里寸草不生，而这些残破的墙垣早已历经万古，不再回荡温暖与欢笑。倒塌的建筑所剩无几，几乎难以辨明它最初的形态与用途。
A sadness permeates these forgotten ruins, a subtle melancholy that seeps into the bones like a winter chill. Nothing grows here, and it has been eons since these dilapidated walls rung with warmth and laughter. So little remains of the fallen structure it is difficult to determine its original form and purpose.

Lunabell The Half-dryad Sorceress.name:
露娜贝尔，半树精女术士
Lunabell The Half-dryad Sorceress

Text.text:
半树精从枝叶间一跃而出，闯入阳光倾泻的林间空地。她那妖精般的灵魂散发微光，将苍白的肌肤映成开心果般的柔粉色调；笑意与恶作剧在她的白云石色眼眸里闪烁——瞳中点点深翠如针——而一头薄荷色的辫子纠缠如毒蛇之巢，被一圈精灵式样的纤细小冠轻轻压住。她披着樱红长袍，衣料被紫与绿的纹路利落地切穿，调和得像炼金术般精准；一枚镶着天青金石的戒指，安静地栖在她一根枝杈般的手指上。她每一步都像舞步，石板漆光法杖敲出华尔兹的节拍；而系在胯侧的匕首叮当作响，为这场行进的鼓点添上一记清亮夺目的高音。

~ 由 Ararion 扮演

The half-dryad springs from the foliage into the sunlit glade. Her fey spirit radiates a glow that illuminates her pale skin in pistachio pastels, while mirth and mischief sparkle in her dolomite eyes—each speckled with deep viridian—and a viper’s nest of mint braids, held back by a thin tiara of elvish design, top her head. She is bedecked in cherry robes that are slashed through with purples and greens, blending with an alchemical precision, and a stunning lazuli-set ring rests on one twig-like finger. Each step is part of a dance, her slate-lacquered staff tapping out the rhythm to her waltz and her clinking daggers, secured at her hips, producing a scintillating high note to the percussion of her procession.

~ Played by Ararion

Firearm Featuring Fiber Optic–link Optio.name:
具备光纤联动选项的火器
Firearm Featuring Fiber Optic–link Options

Text.text:
一根细细的编织缆线从武器的瞄准镜里蜿蜒探出，末端那枚闪亮的插头在你拿起枪时轻轻摇晃。有了合适的义体强化，使用这把光纤增强的武器，便能以近乎超人的精度命中目标。
A thin braided cable snakes out of the weapon’s scope, and the shining jack at the end sways gently as you pick up the gun. With the right augmentations, one could be accurate to a superhuman degree with this fiber-optically enhanced weapon.

Altruistic Council Chambers.name:
利他议会厅
Altruistic Council Chambers

Text.text:
这座大厅穹顶高耸，柱列森森，环抱着一片宽阔的大理石地面；演讲者可立于其上，转身面向四周看台上的人群发言。沿圆周约四分之一处，一道低矮的弧形台座蜿蜒而过，其上摆着数把供议员落座的椅子——或华美绵软，或朴素硬朗，全凭各自惯常承受的身形而定。
This high-vaulted and many-pillared chamber encircles a broad marble floor from which speakers can stand and turn to address the crowd in the surrounding stands. A low dais curves around a quarter of the circle, and there stand several different chairs for the councilors, each as plush or plain as suits its customary posterior.

Quip About Remaining Silent.name:
关于保持沉默的俏皮话
Quip About Remaining Silent

Text.text:
“也许我不怎么开口，是因为一旦那股由轻蔑搅成的浊浆从我唇间涌出，就会把我所有还算体面的关系尽数掩埋。”
“Perhaps I don’t speak much because the slurry of contempt that would escape my lips might bury every half-decent relationship I have.”

Horrific Passage Of Flesh.name:
血肉骇行
Horrific Passage Of Flesh

Text.text:
这条潮湿、管状的通道粉色内壁起伏蠕动、微微抽搐——一种不属于你的稳定节律，非听觉可闻，而是从体内被感受到。粗黑的线条自你身旁分叉蔓延，而你每迈出一步，朝那道波纹荡漾、你盼望象征出口的环形处靠近，身后便留下一团靛蓝的污斑，标记你的行迹。
The pink walls of this wet, tubelike passage undulate and twitch—a steady rhythm that is not your own, felt rather than heard. Lines, thick and dark, branch away from you, and each step you take toward the rippling ring you hope marks an exit leaves an indigo splotch to mark your passage.

Animated Lictor Hellknight Plate.name:
活化的执刑官地狱骑士板甲
Animated Lictor Hellknight Plate

Text.text:
一具身披全身板甲的凶戾身影轻轻悬停在空中，喷气背包喷焰明亮，面甲中央那只猩红独眼来回扫视，搜寻逼近的威胁。推进系统托起那副灰黑色、令人胆寒的沉重躯壳，其上点缀着两支锯齿般的尖角与无数猩红的传感阵列。它的行动不像有知觉的生物：每个回合都过于缜密，过于精准。
A vicious figure of full-plate armor hovers gently in the air, jetpack alight, a central red eye in the faceplate scanning for incoming threats. The propulsion system supports a formidable gray-black weight decorated with two jagged horns and countless scarlet sensor arrays. It does not move quite like a sentient creature: each turn is too calculated, too precise.

Magic Weapon Shop.name:
魔法武器商店
Magic Weapon Shop

Text.text:
一盏镶着蜡烛的铁制枝形吊灯把毫不遮掩的光芒泼洒在店铺的货品上。武器架上寒光森然：长剑、匕首、棍棒、战斧、长柄武器——每一件都锻造得无可挑剔，抛光处泛着奥术般的幽辉。墙上的挂架陈列着油亮的弓与雕工精妙的齐眉棍。几件杰作镶嵌宝石、刻纹繁复，被锁在专门的展示柜里。即便隔着玻璃，这些武器也在无声震颤，涌动着诡异的力量。
An iron chandelier fitted with wax candles casts brazen light over the shop’s wares. Weapon racks bristle with arms: swords, daggers, clubs, axes, polearms—each flawlessly forged and burnished with an arcane gleam. Wall-mounted racks hold glossy bows and exquisitely carved quarterstaffs. Certain masterpieces, set with jewels and furnished with elaborate etchings, are locked away in special showcases. Even behind glass, these weapons thrum with uncanny power.

Ancient Ruins On Alien Moon.name:
异星卫月的古老遗迹
Ancient Ruins On Alien Moon

Text.text:
残垣断壁点缀着月球崎岖的地表，昔日的设计已难以辨认。散落在地的碎片似乎与任何一座崩塌的结构都对不上号，也无法确定那些本该连接的部件是早已缺失，还是从一开始就从未存在过。
Crumbling architecture dots the moon's rocky surface, its original design difficult to discern. The pieces on the ground don't seem to match up to any of the broken-down structures, and it’s unclear whether the proper connecting bits are simply missing or if they somehow never existed at all.

Sidric Sparklesteel.name:
西德里克·火花钢
Sidric Sparklesteel

Text.text:
正在擦拭并调试那柄结构诡谲复杂的战锤的岩侏儒身形矮小，几乎完全被他那顶黄色的宽檐帽罩住。他飞快地瞥了你一眼——时机精准得恰好传达出欢迎之意——随后从绑在半身板甲上的小袋里抽出一件辨不出用途的装置。他一边低声嘟囔，一边进行细微而繁复的调整，最终满意地点点头。看起来，他正在打造一件由活塞驱动的武器。旁边，一头由抛光钢铁精密构成的野猪静默地伏着，四腿收在身下，纹丝不动。为这具钢铁坐骑量身打造的鞍具挂在支架上，新抹的油光在其上闪烁。

~ Played by Dung Beetle

The diminutive form of the rock gnome polishing and tuning his curiously complex warhammer is almost fully covered by his yellow, wide-brimmed hat. He favors you with a quick glance—perfectly timed to convey a sense of welcome—as he withdraws an unidentifiable device from a pouch strapped to his half-plate. Grumbling to himself, he makes minute and varied adjustments before nodding to himself in satisfaction. He seems to be creating a piston-driven weapon. Nearby, a boar meticulously constructed from polished steel sits silently with legs folded under its body, completely immobile. A saddle sized for the steel mount hangs from a stand, shining with new oil.

~ Played by Dung Beetle

Produce Flame Misses.name:
制造火焰未命中
Produce Flame Misses

Text.text:
比起掌心的火光，一点点伤害如今似乎更为要紧。你瞄准后将它像球一样掷出，同时说话般吐出一句命令词。一道热浪拖曳的轨迹紧随其后，点点细小余烬零星闪烁。它旋转着掠过你的目标，随即无害地散开，把你留在一种悖谬的境地——黑暗更深，暴露更甚。
A little bit of damage seems more important now than the firelight in your palm. You take aim and throw it like a ball, speaking a command word. A heat trail specked with tiny embers follows close behind. It spins past your target and disperses harmlessly, leaving you in the paradoxical position of even greater darkness and exposure.

Nas For, Earth Elemental Island.name:
纳斯·福尔，土元素岛
Nas For, Earth Elemental Island

Text.text:
低矮的丘岗由黏土、泥土与巨石自水中隆起。碎石瓦砾与突出的嶙峋岩块散落在淤泥里，勾勒出这片岸线。再往内陆，地形更干燥、海拔渐升，有些岩体竟像粗壮的树干——仿佛巨树早已石化。其间一座天然石拱，将邻近山丘上一处幽暗的洞口框成画面。洞口下方，是一面陡峭的断崖峭壁。

~ Envisioned by Josh Murphy

Low hills of clay, dirt, and boulders emerge from the water here. Mud strewn with rubble and jutting stones forms the shoreline. Inland, where the terrain is drier and gains altitude, some formations look like trunks of massive, petrified trees. A natural arch among these landforms frames a dark opening into a nearby hill. Below this cave is a steep cliff face.

~ Envisioned by Josh Murphy

Titanic Staircase Beneath Mountain.name:
群山之下的泰坦巨阶
Titanic Staircase Beneath Mountain

Text.text:
如同城中广场般巨大的阶梯，沿着山体向下无情延伸，没入山腹深处的黑暗；每一级都直接从这座山的基岩中劈凿而出。雕刻这段阶梯的双手早已消逝，但他们的接触仍清晰可见——也仿佛触手可及——化作奢华的纹饰与浮雕，铺陈在每一道庞大踏步的落足之处。

~ 构想：SonOfSofaman，发表于 Discord
