Steps the size of city plazas descend inexorably into the dark below the mountain, hewn from the very bedrock of the formation itself. Though the hands that carved this staircase are long gone, their touch can be seen—and felt—in the sumptuous artwork adorning the footprint of each enormous step.

~ Envisioned by SonOfSofaman on Discord

这柄精致的标枪握柄经过打磨，漆黑如夜，其上以抛光黄金嵌出一道道纹饰，描绘着一段英雄——亦是悲剧——的故事。它铸于一个早已湮没于记忆的年代，这件强大的武器历经无数世纪的战火——每当最需要之时，总能一击必中。
The polished black haft of this exquisite javelin is inlaid with seams of burnished gold depicting a heroic—and tragic—story. Crafted in an age lost to memory this mighty weapon has seen battle across countless centuries—always striking true when the need was greatest.

Vampire's Manor: Library.name:
吸血鬼（特征）的庄园：图书馆
Vampire's Manor: Library

Text.text:
这间巨大的长方形厅室几乎贯穿整座庄园宅邸——拱顶高耸，足有两层楼高，四壁书架林立，堆满用上百种语言书写的厚重典籍。凸窗前的破旧窗帘被拉得严严实实，窗下的小阅览桌旁摆着软垫椅子，桌面上纸张与卷轴散乱铺开。你的目光却莫名被牵引向房间尽头：一架巨大的管风琴伫立在昏暗壁龛的阴影里。地板上覆着尘土与碎屑，清清楚楚地显出通往管风琴、又从那里折返的脚印与拖痕。
The massive, rectangular room spans almost the entire length of the manor house—a vaulted, two-story hall lined with shelves laden with tomes in a hundred languages. Set before bay windows, their ratty curtains drawn, papers and scrolls lie scattered across a small reading table set with cushioned chairs. Your eyes find themselves inexplicably drawn to the far end of the room, where a massive pipe organ stands in the shadows of a darkened alcove. The floor, covered with dust and bits of debris, clearly shows tracks leading to and from the organ.

长枪的木杆上刻满频繁使用留下的伤痕；每一道划痕、每一处缺口、每一块瑕疵，都在这柄武器上诉说着独属于自己的故事。枪尖那枚菱形尖铁在它的岁月里被修补、更换了无数次。
The wood of the lance bears the scars of frequent use, each scratch, nick, and blemish in the weapon telling a story all its own. The rhombus of pointed iron at its tip has been repaired and replaced countless times over the lance’s tenure.

店主细长修长的手指下意识地相互摩挲，审视的目光一扫，便敏锐地掂量着你个人财富的分量。无论你打听的是哪类货色，他们总会不由分说地把你引向更昂贵的版本。
The shopkeeper’s long, thin fingers unconsciously rub together as they keenly assess the worth of your personal wealth with a surveying glance. Regardless of the type of goods you make the subject of your inquiries, they inevitably direct you to a more expensive version.

你看见对手开始施展法术，便一拧手腕，将手指狠狠攥成铁一般的拳头。与此同时，你在心中描绘自己吹灭一簇小小的火焰，如同蜡烛上的那点烛火。两种动作交织之下，你早已蓄势待发的魔法构装被解开，你的法术探出触须，去掐灭敌人翻涌的魔法。
You see your opponent begin to cast a spell, so you twist your hand, crushing your fingers into a tight fist. At the same moment, you envision yourself blowing out a small flame, as one might find on a candle. In combination, these actions unlock a construct of magic you held at the ready, and your spell reaches out to snuff the magic of your foe.

Weathered Ruins Of An Ancient Arena.name:
一座远古竞技场的风蚀废墟
Weathered Ruins Of An Ancient Arena

Text.text:
这座古老竞技场的墙体几乎尽数毁坏，只剩零星几根残柱与崩落的建筑碎块。尽管当年的搏斗圈确实宽阔，如今却看不见地下墓室或完整地基的踪影，唯有散落的石灰华碎石，以及一尊巨像东一块西一块地横陈四处。竞技场的许多部分显然已经缺失，那些石灰岩很可能被当地人拆走，改作他处建筑或铺路之用。
The walls of this ancient arena have been all but destroyed, only a few remaining pillars and crumbling bits of edifice remaining. Though the fighting circle was large indeed, there is no sign of a hypogeum nor a proper foundation remaining, only scattered bits of travertine stone and random pieces of a colossal statue lying hither and yon. Many pieces of the arena are clearly missing, the limestone likely repurposed by locals for construction of other buildings or roads.

热浪、浓烟与腥秽自这恶魔暴君血红的皮肤间蒸腾而出。犄角冠立于颅顶，獠牙勾勒出满口利齿的巨口，尖刺自四肢滋生。双翼垂覆在肩头，如同一件皮革斗篷；它那带爪的手中紧握着一柄黑钢倒刺钉头锤。每一次呼吸，蒸汽便从鼻孔喷涌而出。它逼近时，黄色的眼眸灼燃着同等的憎恨与狂喜。
Heat, smoke, and vileness emanate from the blood-red skin of this fiendish tyrant. Horns crest its skull, tusks frame its toothy maw, and spines grow from its limbs. Wings drape its shoulders like a leathery cloak, and in its clawed hands it grips a barbed mace of black steel. With each breath, steam issues from its nostrils. Yellow eyes blaze with equal measures of hatred and glee as it approaches.

Wild Magic Surge: Teleportation.name:
狂野魔法涌动：传送
Wild Magic Surge: Teleportation

Text.text:
一股汹涌的动能在你体内汇聚，焦躁地渴望将你像穿越虫洞般弹射出去——在你目光所及、心之所向的任何地方骤然现身。
A rush of kinetic energy amasses within, anxious to spring you forward like a wormhole, emerging wherever your eyes land and your heart desires.

Sundries From An Imp.name:
小恶魔的杂货
Sundries From An Imp

Text.text:
这只小恶魔的伪装形态在死亡时会留下它的皮囊，并随即复归真身。那张皮囊永远散发着令人作呕的恶臭。
This imp’s false form leaves behind its hide when it dies and reverts to its true form. The hide permanently smells foul.

一股诡异而闪烁的能量自你体内震荡外涌，化作三道虚幻的分身。它们将你的动作与神情分毫不差地映照出来，令三具一模一样的身影交叠成一片令人不安的残影。
A strange, shimmering energy vibrates outward from you, manifesting as three illusory duplicates. They mirror your movements and expressions perfectly, creating an uncanny blur of identical figures.

Greeting From A Dog.name:
来自狗狗的问候
Greeting From A Dog

Text.text:
“噢——我喜欢你。你不像别人——他们又踢又喊。可你闻起来像朋友！”
“D’aww, I like you. Not like others—they kick and yell. But you smell like friend!”

Government Office In Crowded Metropolis.name:
拥挤大都会的政府办公楼
Government Office In Crowded Metropolis

Text.text: 街上最古老的那栋楼，灰白石灰岩砌块被刷成沉闷的橄榄绿，带着工业装饰艺术风格的拱形线条；门厅地面嵌着一幅脏兮兮的马赛克。灯泡昏黄，一台镶着樱桃木饰板的古老电梯缓缓上行，直到六楼。穿过一条霉味浸透的地毯走廊，尽头一扇磨砂玻璃门上用模板喷着 Maintenance Personnel Only。门无声开启时，新塑料的气味与初级科技的低鸣一并涌出，明亮、银白的光从一名持枪守卫的剪影周围迸散开来。 The oldest building on the street, with limestone block painted dull olive, has industrial deco arch work and a grubby mosaic on the lobby floor. The bulb light is dim, and an ancient cherry-paneled elevator travels to the sixth floor. Down the musty carpet hall, a frosted glass door is stenciled Maintenance Personnel Only. When the door opens silently, the smell of new plastic and the hum of first-tier technology drifts through the bright, silvery light that breaks around an armed guard’s silhouette.

酵母与烘焙面团温暖而撩人的香气将你引入屋内，陈列架上摆满了餐包、蛋糕与脆皮面包，更进一步撩拨你的感官。面包师围裙上沾着一层面粉，像机器般精准地塑形面包坯，一边接单，一边偶尔拨弄身后铁炉里的余烬添火。
The warm, tantalizing scents of yeast and baking dough beckon you inside, where displays of rolls, cakes, and crusty bread further entice your senses. The baker, apron dusted with flour, shapes loaves with the precision of a machine, simultaneously taking orders and occasionally stoking the embers in the iron oven at their back.

White Giant Eagle.name:
白色巨鹰
White Giant Eagle

Text.text:
雪花成团飞卷，掠过那只栖在嶙峋山巅的巨大而威严的猛禽；它粉色的细小眼珠滴溜转动，扫视着山坡，搜寻猎物。随着一声长啸，它俯冲而下，猛然舒展出巨翼——每一片都如吊桥般庞大——利爪尽张，挟着狂风直扑目标。
Flurries of snow whip past the huge, majestic bird perched atop the rocky mountain, its beady pink eyes scanning the slopes for prey. With a cry, the bird swoops down, unfurls mighty wings—each the size of a drawbridge—and hurtles toward its prey with talons outstretched.

Lenora Annabella, Founder Of House Raven.name:
伦诺拉·安娜贝拉，鸦院家族创始人
Lenora Annabella, Founder Of House Raven

Text.text:
这位学者出身的创立者兼变形者，著有两百余篇论著与三十本书；在学生中声名远播，因为她从不让任何一个问题落空——无论多么荒诞——总能以助人且睿智的方式作答。她身形娇小、骨架纤细，戴着一副硕大的圆形金丝眼镜，轻轻搁在她突出的鼻梁上。授课时有七只乌鸦为她助阵；她讲授时，它们落在她的肩、臂或头顶，替她盯着学生，维持秩序。
The scholar founder and shapeshifter was the writer of more than two hundred tracts and thirty books, famous among the students for never failing to answer a question—no matter how ridiculous—helpfully and wisely. She was petite, fine-boned, and wore large round wire glasses that sat lightly on her prominent nose. Seven ravens assisted her while teaching. They landed on her shoulder, arm, or head as she lectured, policing the students.

小屋后方立着一座坚固的烟囱，由圆石与灰浆垒成，热量从中辐射开来。烟囱上用锈蚀的铁件紧紧固定着一尊偶像，由熏黑的骨头拼合而成。最大的一块骨头是一只巨鹿的头骨，而在那对鹿角曾占据的宽阔空间里，嵌着一颗人类的颅骨。偶像的肋骨、脊柱与上肢属于人类——但上肢共有四条。部分腿骨或许也来自人类，但脚的位置却被分趾的蹄子取代。
At the back of the cabin is a sturdy chimney of round stones and mortar. Heat radiates from it. Fastened to it with rusting iron is an effigy comprised of blackened bones. The largest bone is the skull of a great stag, with a human skull fitted into the wide space where the antlers were. The effigy’s ribcage, spine, and upper limbs are human—but there are four of them. Some of the leg bones might be human, too, but in place of feet are cloven hooves.

在这间喧闹却温暖的屋子里，壁炉火光欢腾，咸香的食物气味弥漫其间，盘碟叮当作响，刀叉铿然相击。碗盘在人手间飞快流转——碗里很快盛满，肉盘一摞摞拼装齐整，酱汁当场调味，点缀的配料利落落下。其上方，主厨浑厚有力的嗓音回荡不休——每一句都被他那沉重的木勺砰然敲在圆肚炉灶侧壁的巨响截断。喧嚣与井然的混乱之下，一只肥猫心满意足地躺着舔爪子；它尽职清理厨房里的鼠虫，报酬丰厚。
The hearth blazes merrily in this cacophonous but homey room, replete with savory food smells, the clatter of dishes, and the clash of utensils. Dishes change hands quickly as bowls are filled, platters of meat are assembled, sauces seasoned, and garnishes applied. Over it all, the forceful voice of the head cook echoes—his speech punctuated with the crash of his heavy wooden ladle on the side of the pot-bellied stove. Beneath the fracas and controlled chaos, a fat cat lies contentedly licking its paws, well paid for its service in keeping the kitchen free of vermin.

古老洞窟的岩壁自地面至穹顶尽覆涂抹壁画。造型朴拙却精妙动人，深红色的符号描绘着文字诞生之前那个时代的生命与日常。
The ancient cavern walls are covered from floor to ceiling in daubed paintings. Simple in form but beautifully realized, the dark red symbols depict lives from a time before the written word.

Double-talking Politician.name:
口若悬河的政客
Double-talking Politician

Text.text:
女人那身挺括的黑色裤装上，色彩鲜艳的战役徽章都比她脸上硬挤出来的笑容更有生气。有人提问，她一边握手一边擦身而过，语气反差十足地宣布：“我们正在采取一切必要措施。”对另一个人，她又说道：“我们会尽我们所能为你们而战。”没有人被说服，也没有人感到意外。
The colorful campaign button on the woman's crisp, black pantsuit has more life than the smile plastered on her face. "We're taking all necessary steps," she announces in contrasting response to a constituent's question as she shakes his hand and then brushes by him. "We'll fight for you however we can," she says to another. Nobody seems convinced, and nobody seems surprised either.

Brutal Vory V Zakone Pakhan.name:
残酷的“法律中的盗贼”帕汉
Brutal Vory V Zakone Pakhan

Text.text: 他浑身尽是结实紧绷的肌肉，半点赘肉都没有，像冬末最后活下来的那条饿疯的野狗：硬得惊人。身上披着开领的吸烟夹克，你瞥见他下巴两侧各纹着一颗星。那头惨白的头发贴着头皮剪得极短，鬓边覆着一层细碎的胡茬，像落雪。男人似乎根本不动——暴风里的山。鼻梁曾被打断，他却故意任它歪着——也许是个提醒？喉间一道猩红的伤疤被烙成了bop这个词的形状。右眼下方嵌着两块长方形的白色植入体。 Made of wiry, taut muscle with not a scrap of fat, he is like the last starving dog to survive the winter: tough. Dressed in an open-necked smoking jacket, you spy tattooed stars on either side of the chin. He bears stark white hair, close cropped with a dusting of stubble like snow. The man seems not to move—a mountain within a storm. His nose has been broken and he has opted to leave it crooked—perhaps a reminder? A red wound in the shape of the word bop has been scarred into his throat. Underneath his right eye sit two rectangular white implants.

无数气味在那座巨大的厨房吐出的芬芳蒸汽中同时冲撞、交融。黄油、油脂、大蒜、芳香的香草、辛烈的香料——全都为争夺你的感官主宰权而厮杀。火焰舔舐着铜锅，锅里酱汁与高汤翻滚慢熬；厨师们在滋滋作响的煎锅与寒光闪烁的刀锋之间穿梭忙碌。
Myriad smells simultaneously clash and mingle in the fragrant steam spilling from the massive kitchen. Butter, oil, garlic, aromatic herbs, sharp spices—all war for dominance of your senses. Flames lick at copper pots, simmering with sauces and stocks, while chefs bustle along the line of hissing pans and gleaming knives.

I Throw My Silver Raven Figurine Of Wond.name:
我掷出我的银色渡鸦奇物塑像
I Throw My Silver Raven Figurine Of Wondrous Power

Text.text:
一团烟雾倏然喷散开来，裹着一缕带腥的麝香油味，一只乌鸦随之现身。它胸前与背上掺着灰羽，像是穿着一件利落的小马甲。我伸出手臂，它毫不迟疑地跳了上来。它把头一歪，湿亮的一只眼珠直勾勾地打量着我。它用嘶哑的鸦科嗓音呱呱说道：“信——息。信…… 息？”它的羽肩随着每个音节都微微炸起，满怀期待。
In a quick puff of smoke, the hint of some musky oil wafting from it, a raven appears. It has gray feathers about its chest and back, giving it the look of wearing a smart little vest. I offer my arm, to which it readily hops. It tilts its head toward me, one glistening eye regarding me. In its croaking, corvid voice, it says, “Mess-age. Mess… age?” Its feather shoulders bristle expectantly with each syllable.

你猛然张开双臂，发出一声奥术号令的咆哮——雷霆以一记炸响回敬。狂暴的风在球形涡旋中嘶嚎翻卷，仿佛被封在一颗玻璃球里。旋风之冠处，一团漆黑的暴风云翻滚沸腾，其间缠绕着丝丝电光，急不可耐地噼啪迸射。
You throw your arms wide and roar an arcane command—a clap of thunder answers. Brutal winds howl in a spherical vortex as though contained within a glass ball. A dark storm cloud boils at the crown of the whirling winds, laced through with filaments of lightning, sparking impatiently.

Haunted House: Kitchen And Pantry.name:
鬼屋：厨房与储藏间
Haunted House: Kitchen And Pantry

Text.text:
厨房台面又脏又暗，污渍斑驳，上面散落着几块砧板，被沉重的菜刀与砍刀以过分蛮横的力道深深劈凿出沟壑。角落里的水槽堵死了，时不时反呕出黑红色的脓液，令那滞留在地上的腐烂恶臭污水洼愈发溃烂发臭。你俯身查看时，一口锅忽然从墙上的挂钩猛地挣脱，以惊人的速度砸向你身旁的台面，轰然碎响。
The kitchen countertops are dingy and stained, and scattered with cutting boards gouged deeply by overly powerful blows from heavy knives and cleavers. The sink in one corner is stopped up, occasionally belching a black and red ichor, which adds to the festering, stinking puddle. As you bend to examine it, a pot suddenly wrenches loose from a hook on the wall and smashes with stunning velocity into the counter next to you.

Offer Of Information From A Prisoner.name:
囚犯的情报交易
Offer Of Information From A Prisoner

Text.text:
“这些墙内的时代流速不同；但在这漫无止境的漫长时辰里，我听闻了太多。也许，如果你肯帮我，我就能把这些年来攒下的一些鲜美秘闻，匀你几口。”
“Time moves differently within these walls, but in all these ever-stretching hours, I have heard a great deal. Perhaps, if you help me, I can spare a few juicy tidbits I’ve gathered over the years.”

平整的石路沿着海岸蜿蜒伸展。一侧是辽阔的乡野铺陈开来，另一侧则是峭壁森然、斜坡入海，直落波涛。裹着盐味的海风卷来刺骨的冷雾，浪涛拍岸的轰鸣始终不息。你望见远处海天交界的广阔线上，有几片帆影小得如同针尖。
The smooth, stone road winds its way along the coast. To one side, the country sprawls, while to the other, sheer cliffs and sloping shores lead to the sea. The salt-laced wind carries a frigid mist, and the din of crashing waves is constant. You spy sails, tiny on the vast horizon.

I Cast Hold Monster Using My Musical Ins.name:
我用乐器施放了“定身怪物”
I Cast Hold Monster Using My Musical Instrument

Text.text:
我先来一段气势磅礴的开场，声浪轰鸣、指挥若定。等怪物的注意力被我牢牢攫住，我的演奏便转作一支俏皮的旋律——起初明快动人、令人忍不住跟随，随后渐渐放慢，愈发轻柔。

[成功豁免] 音量柔和地渐弱——可显然，这并不合怪物的胃口。它照旧做着它在做的事，而我的演奏却像乐器骤然瘫痪般戛然而止。

[失败豁免] 旋律在渐弱中淡去，怪物的动作也随之变慢，继而意识到不对，拼命对抗那股沉重——却徒劳无功。它被彻底钉在原地动弹不得；我不禁觉得它似乎也被逗乐了，只是它已无从开口。

I play a big opening, loud and commanding. When I have the monster’s attention, my playing changes to a plucky melody, cheerful and engaging at first, then slowing down and softening.

[Successful Save] There’s a soft decrescendo—except, apparently, it’s not to the monster’s liking. It continues doing what it was doing, and my playing stops as if the instrument were paralyzed.

[Failed Save] It fades in a decrescendo, and the monster slows, then realizes and fights the heaviness—ineffectively. It is immobilized, and I can’t help but think it’s also entertained, although it’s not at liberty to say.

Pilgrim Hill In Winter.name:
冬日的朝圣者山丘
Pilgrim Hill In Winter

Text.text:
[晴空之下] 雪与烂泥间的山丘上只见寥寥数人，但许多往昔营地的残迹仍依稀可辨，早已凋零成几片帆布碎屑、折断的木枝与冷灰。披长袍、穿毛边靴的朝圣者或立或坐于雪中，身躯一律朝向西南方的神殿。一堆共用篝火在几顶仍支着的帐篷旁熊熊燃烧。一个兜帽男人灰须垂长，盘腿坐在一块巨石上，膝头打颤，哆嗦着吹奏一支由沙色木料制成、末端外张的大长笛。笛声微颤如梦，柔而尖细的呼唤回荡在覆雪的山谷之上。

[暴风雪中] 狂风暴雪撕扯着山丘，将搭起的帐篷与营火抽打成可怜的残骸。远处，风暴唤者神殿透过窗棂脉动着诡异的冰蓝光芒，仿佛多眼之神在风雪中冷冷逼视。悬崖边，一支大长笛半埋在雪里，旁边是一块被撕裂的斗篷碎片。

[Under Clear Skies] Only a few people are found on the hill among the snow and mud, though the fragments of many other past camping parties are discernible, dwindled to no more than scraps of canvas, sticks, and ash. Pilgrims in long robes and fur-lined boots stand or sit in the snow, their bodies facing the temple to the southwest. A communal fire blazes next to the few tents still pitched. A hooded man with a long gray beard sits cross-legged on a boulder, his knees shaking, and he shiveringly plays a large flute crafted of sand-colored wood and with a flared end. The instrument’s sound is tremulous and dreamy, a soft, high call that echoes across the snowy vale.

[During a Snowstorm] The blizzard tears away at the hill, battering the pitched tents and campfires into measly debris. In the distance, the Temple of the Stormcaller pulses its strange, ice-blue light through its windows like a many-eyed god glaring through the storm. At the edge of the cliff, a large flute lays half-covered in snow next to a torn piece of cloak.

Wild Magic Surge: Premature Baldness.name:
狂野魔法涌动：过早秃顶
Wild Magic Surge: Premature Baldness

Text.text:
狂野奥秘在你的头皮上嗡嗡作响，你的脑袋忽然觉得轻了许多。你猛地一惊，发现一撮撮头发如雪般落下，纷纷扬扬堆在你的肩头。你伸手触及自己光滑的头顶，骇然失色。凭着毛囊传来的阵阵刺麻，你相当确信头发会再长出来——只是还需要一些时间。
Wild arcana buzzes over your scalp, and your head feels suddenly lighter. With a start, you discover clumps of your hair snowing down around your shoulders. You reach up and touch your smooth head, aghast. By the tingling of your follicles, you are fairly certain that your hair will grow back, but it will take some time.

Ancient Blue Dragon.name:
远古蓝龙
Ancient Blue Dragon

Text.text:
或许它曾经通体湛蓝，但流逝的数百年已将这条巨龙的鳞片晦暗成诡谲的紫调，宛如气旋成形时的天穹。它的吻端不见龙角，取而代之的是一块伤痕累累、断裂嶙峋的灰白骨质巨岬，大如船首的撞角。雷云般的眉脊之下，深陷的双眼迸出凶险而机敏的光芒。
Perhaps once they were blue, but the passing centuries have darkened this dragon’s scales to the eerie purplish cast of the sky as a cyclone forms. Instead of a horn, the snout bears a scarred and broken crag of gray bone, as big as a ship’s prow. Beneath a thunderhead brow, deep-set eyes flash with menacing intelligence.

Impatiently Addressing A Screaming Child.name:
不耐烦地呵斥尖叫的孩子
Impatiently Addressing A Screaming Child

Text.text:
“你要是还不把那该死的凄厉尖叫给我停了，我就把你扔进河里，让鳗鱼教你怎么游泳！”
“If you don’t stop that infernal bloody screaming, I’m going to throw you in the river and let the eels teach you to swim!”

想把目光从那头棕熊宽大的熊掌上挪开，确实很难；它在自己的猎场里踱来踱去。它的长爪虽钝，却仍有足够的蛮力，让毫无防备的人重伤，甚至当场毙命——哪怕隔着板甲护甲也不例外。它停下来打了个哈欠，你不由得惊叹它巨口的体型……也不禁去想象：若它将利齿对准你，那股碾碎一切的咬合力会是何等可怖。
It is difficult indeed to tear your eyes away from the broad paws of the brown bear as it mills about its hunting ground. Its long claws are blunt but powerful enough to severely injure or outright kill the unwary, even through plate armor. It pauses to yawn, and you cannot help but marvel at the size of its jaws... and imagine their crushing power, should it bring its teeth to bear against you.

Medevac Helicopter.name:
医疗后送直升机
Medevac Helicopter

Text.text:
直升机机身闪着冷冽的临床白光，舱门上醒目地印着红十字徽记。这架医疗后送机在投入使用时曾是射程之内的顶级型号——尽管其设计已开始显露年代——但整体状态依然极佳。一支由专家组成的团队穿着同款飞行服与头盔操控这架直升机，把他们的专业带到任何需要的地方。
The chassis of the helicopter is a gleaming, clinical white emblazoned with the striking emblem of a red cross on the doors. This medevac was top of the range when it was commissioned—though the design is starting to show its age—and is in excellent condition. A team of specialists in matching flight suits and helmets crew the helicopter, bringing their expertise wherever it is needed.

从东南门出去，道路蜿蜒通向一片连绵起伏的丘陵长坡。大多数外乡人——度假的一家老小、送货的卡车司机、背包客——都是从这道门进入尖塔维奇。石壁上的浮雕描绘着历代到访尖塔维奇的人：披斗篷、拄手杖的旅人，盖着油布的商队，驮着骑手的马匹——以及说来也怪——一捆捆的扫帚把子。
The road from the southeastern gate leads to a long stretch of rolling hills. Most out-of-towners—vacationing families, delivery trucks, backpackers—come into Spirewych through this gate. The images decorating the stone show those who have visited Spirewych throughout history: cloaked travelers bearing walking sticks, tarp-covered caravans, horses with riders and—oddly enough—bundles of broomsticks.

Elevator Inside City Wall.name:
城墙内部电梯
Elevator Inside City Wall

Text.text:
齿轮咔嗒作响，铁链哗啦震颤，华丽的手风琴式栅门缓缓滑开。电梯内部金碧辉煌，极尽奢华。对面的墙上密密麻麻排着一片顶端镀金的拉杆，每一根都对应着一个楼层编号。一名冒险者从你身旁溜过，钻进箱厢，啪地一拨开关，电梯便载着他从城垛滑落而下，直抵城墙外下方的村落。
Gears click and chains rattle as the ornate accordion doors slide open. No expense has been spared for the gilded interior of the elevator. A smattering of golden-tipped levers cover the opposite wall, each with its own corresponding floor number. An adventurer slips by you and enters the box, flicking the switch to take them from the battlements to the village outside the walls below.

Floating One-day Winter Market On Ice.name:
冰上漂浮的一日冬日集市
Floating One-day Winter Market On Ice

Text.text:
湖泊被冬日冰冷的铁拳紧紧攥住，曾经漂浮其上的水上市集，如今成了它的栖身之处。原本起伏摇晃的船只与摊位已被冻得一动不动。裹着皮裘、披着羊毛的人影寥寥，仍有人鼓起勇气顶着寒意，在一顶顶鲜艳的篷布下寻觅便宜货；交易就在冰面上敲定，呼出的白雾在唇边翻涌。
The lake, with its water gripped in winter’s icy fist, stands home to a once floating market. The bobbing boats and stalls are now frozen still. Swathed in fur and bedecked in wool, a handful of souls brave the cold and seek bargains among the bright awnings, their breath misting as deals are made on the ice.

无面。无名。一张空白画布，等待窃取他人的生命。多重身影怪是清醒噩梦的化身。冰冷的白色眼眸没有瞳孔，更添这生物的异界凶威；扭曲的蓝色手指上伸出修长的黑爪，伺机攫住生命的丝线，将其一根根抽离、拆散，直到万物归于虚无。
Faceless. Nameless. A blank canvas waiting to steal the life of another. The doppelgänger is the stuff of waking nightmares. Cold, white eyes devoid of pupils add to the creature’s otherworldly menace, and long black claws extend from gnarled blue fingers, waiting to grab the threads of life and unravel them one by one until there is nothing left.

在一座偏远的部族村落里，村子依着奔流的河畔而建，撒网捕鱼的韵律之舞正徐徐展开。数十名赤裸的村民踏入翻涌的激流中，饱经风霜的双手娴熟地将编织渔网抛向水的怀抱。技能与直觉交融，众人一同收获银光闪烁的馈赠；那维系生计的鱼群里，也映出了他们紧密无间的团结。
In a remote tribal village, nestled beside a flowing river, the rhythmic dance of net fishing unfolds. Dozens of unclad folk wade within the tumbling rapids, weathered hands expertly casting woven nets into the water's embrace. Skill and intuition meld as the community harvests the silvery bounty, their unity reflected in the fish that sustain their way of life.

Sundries From A Yeth Hound.name:
来自耶斯猎犬的杂物
Sundries From A Yeth Hound

Text.text:
像闪烁的松针般散落在地上的，是那只猎犬熠熠生辉的毛发。若你愿意，可以将这些毛发收拢成一小束，不过它的价值恐怕难以保证。
Scattered on the ground like glittering pine needles, you see strands of the hound’s shimmering coat. The strands could be collected into a small bundle, if desired, though its value would be suspect.

Insult About An Inexperienced Party Memb.name:
嘲讽一个没经验的队员
Insult About An Inexperienced Party Member

Text.text:
“你就像一只惊惶失措的鸽子，乱飞乱撞，一头砸在窗玻璃上。每次我们说话，我都觉得你下一秒就要哭出来。这样也无妨——甚至还挺让人同情——可你这般深不见底的无能，实在不该负责任何事，更别提别人的性命了。”
“You’re like a dove in panicked flight, smashing aimlessly into windows. Whenever we speak, I feel as though you are about to burst into tears. And all this is fine—sympathetic, really—but someone with the depth of incompetence you possess really shouldn’t be in charge of anything, much less people’s lives.”

Water-filled Room Trap.name:
注满水的房间陷阱
Water-filled Room Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 压力板在室内被伪装得天衣无缝，你起初根本没有注意到——直到你看见房间中央那道浅浅的排水沟，才隐约意识到事情并不如表面那般简单。你目光扫过四周，终于在近天花板处瞥见一段缓慢滴水的栅格。只需一瞬的疏忽，便会触发这阴险的陷阱：房门轰然合拢，房间随即被灌满水。对任何需要呼吸空气的生物而言，这都意味着必死无疑。

[触发] 你试图解除陷阱的动作出了差错。房门猛地砰然闭合，温吞的水流开始迅疾涌入。只消片刻，你就会被彻底淹没——你的靴子已经完全湿透。

[Perceived] The pressure plate is so cunningly masked within the room that you do not notice it at first—it is the presence of a shallow drain in the middle of the room that suggests that all is not as it seems. Sweeping the room with your gaze, you eventually spy a length of slowly dripping grating near the ceiling. It would take only a moment of carelessness to trigger this devious trap, closing the doors to the room and flooding it with water. It would mean certain death to any air-breathers within.

[Triggered] Something has gone wrong in your attempts to disengage the trap. The doors to the room slam shut and tepid water starts rapidly gushing in. You will be fully submerged in mere moments—your boots are already completely soaked.

Messy Spellbook.name:
凌乱的法术书
Messy Spellbook

Text.text:
简短的咒句以几乎难以辨认的潦草字迹匆匆写就，有时还像要寄出的信那样郑重署名。自召唤卷轴上剪下的碎片被胡乱糊在塑能法术的开头之间，其中一些又在预言学的页面上草草收尾。书页上遍布拼写错误、危险的标点落点、食物污渍与杯圈水痕。书脊已经断裂，一条孩子的腰带将整本书七零八落地勉强束在一起。
Simple incantations are dashed off in nearly illegible script, sometimes signed as if they were letters to be sent. Patches cut from conjuration scrolls are pasted in among the beginnings of evocation spells, some of which are finished on pages of divination work. There are misspellings, dangerous placements of punctuation, food stains, and cup rings on many pages. The spine is broken, and a child’s belt holds the book haphazardly together.

Giant Eels Under The Ice.name:
冰层之下的巨鳗
Giant Eels Under The Ice

Text.text: [察觉] 厚冰之下，一道修长蜿蜒的身影掠过，像午后将晚的影子——但在这片平坦的冰原上，这绝不是光线的把戏。它一扭身便下沉，没入墨黑的深处，转瞬无踪。 [攻击] 冰层隆起，随即轰然碎裂！裂隙向四面八方迸裂蔓延，白骨般、车轮大小的头颅猛然撞破冰面，碎冰四射飞溅。巨口横扫般一口口咬下。 [Perceived] Beneath the thick ice, a long, sinuous form slips by like a late-afternoon shadow—but out on this flat expanse it’s no trick of the light. With a twist it sinks, vanishing into the inky depths. [Attacking] The ice heaves, then shatters! Fissures splinter out in every direction as bony, cart-sized heads punch through the surface, sending shards flying. The mouths take sweeping bites.

干枯龟裂的花环歪歪斜斜地挂在小屋门上，尽管年代久远，蒜味依旧刺鼻。枯萎的蒜头串在磨损的麻绳上，在寒冷的夜风里轻轻摇晃，死死抓住那枚锈钉，勉强不让自己坠落。
The dry, cracked wreath hangs haphazardly on the cottage door, the smell of garlic still pungent despite its age. Withered bulbs threaded on fraying twine sway gently in the chill night air, desperately clinging to the rusty nail holding it in place.

海鸥或远或近地尖啸，仿佛一支亵渎的合唱团。空气里满是咸涩海水与蔬菜般的馊味，鱼肠腐烂的湿闷随风飘荡，混着熟透的汗酸与发霉木头的气息。码头停着三艘船——海湾里还等着四艘，在炽烈的骄阳下随浪起伏，浮在碎光粼粼的水面上。渔网里的收获倾进手推车，车轮吱呀作响，在木板上嘎吱颠簸，接着滚过鹅卵石路面，随后又悄然沿着离开港口屋的土路远去。
Gulls shriek from far and near like a blasphemous choir. The air smells of salt water and vegetable reek, the putrid humidity of fish guts on the air, ripe sweat, and moldy wood. The dock holds three boats—four more wait in the bay, bobbing on the sparkle of the water under the hard sun. Nets unload into carts, carts squeak and rattle across wood, then cobbles, and then quietly along the dirt road away from the harbor house.

这片活生生的熔岩池足有十号英尺宽，不停喷吐着令人不适的灼热间歇泉，宛如一座自给自足的火山。它翻涌旋转，将怪异的岩浆碎块抛向天空。炽融液体向外淌出，足以轻易熔化复杂的金属合金。
Ten feet wide and belching geysers of unwelcome heat, this living pool of bubbling lava is like a self-contained volcano. Churning and swirling, it jettisons odd chunks of magmatic rock skyward. Molten liquid dribbles outward, capable of melting complex metal alloys with ease.

Engine Room Of Spaceship.name:
宇宙飞船的引擎舱
Engine Room Of Spaceship

Text.text:
油脂与异国燃料的恶臭塞满了这片狭窄而喧嚣的空间。吞吐着灰色轰鸣的推进系统由汗渍斑斑的工程师照料；他们在各式设备间默契穿梭——更换齿轮，操控聚焦激光工具。反应堆、涡轮与燃料罐协同运转，驱动飞船在空间中移动。难以置信的热浪被头顶一台巨大的吊扇搅动成旋涡，勉强压下。
The stink of oil and foreign fuels fills this cramped and cacophonous space. Gulping gray propulsion systems are tended by sweat-stained engineers who move together seamlessly amongst the tech—changing gears and focusing laser tools. Reactors, turbines, and fuel tanks all work together to power the ship's movement through space. The incredible heat is mitigated by a great ceiling fan swirling above.

这把伞以坚硬阔叶木为骨，帆布以结实的缚扣牢牢固定。伞面设有排风翻片，令狂风难以将它撕裂折断；伞身细致刻写着吟游诗人的符号——来自寒冷潮湿之地的乐章与诗句。 [Bonus Action] 伞先短暂悬浮，笔直立起，随即自我调转为水平姿态，伞柄如舵，应你意念而飞。它以魔力之势猛击，你再一召唤，它便归来护你。雨伞飞回，啪地一声稳稳撑开，伞柄漂浮，伞布在你身前展开如盾。你坠落时，伞柄就在手边；当你握住它，坠势随之放缓，雨伞化作feather fall般的降落伞。

~ Envisioned by Floppey

This umbrella is made strong with hardwood and tough fastening to the canvas. Venting flaps keep the wind from splintering it, and it is carefully inscribed in bardic symbols of music and poetry from cold, wet lands. [Bonus Action] The umbrella hovers briefly, vertically, then aims itself horizontally, handle like a rudder, and flies as you command it. It strikes with magical force, and you call it home to protect you. The umbrella flies back and pops open firmly, the handle floating and the canvas open in front of you as a shield. When you fall, the handle is ready at hand, and when you take hold, your fall slows, the umbrella becoming a parachute of feather fall.

~ Envisioned by Floppey

I Endure Slashing Damage.name:
我承受挥砍伤害
I Endure Slashing Damage

Text.text:
我的眼皮猛地紧闭了一瞬，神经系统疾驰着回报那撕裂般、猛然抽搐的剧痛。我不必去看，也知道自己的血肉已被撕开。灼燃的痛感驱使我的身体立刻行动起来。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

My eyelids shut tight for an instant, my nervous system racing to report a jagged, jolting pain. I don’t need to look to know that my flesh has been torn asunder. An incendiary sensation spurs my body into action.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The Blood Lands.name:
血色之地
The Blood Lands

Text.text:
平原如同被剥皮的人体般横铺至天际。大地被弹坑拱裂，布满凹洞与撕裂的伤口，皆是数百年围城留下的咬痕。火葬堆的浓烟把无云的天空熏得发黑，每一次刺鼻的吸气都像砂纸般刮过你干裂的喉咙。远处战声翻涌——箭雨如鼓点般砸在盾牌上，间或有断续的尖叫以短促的节拍劈开空气。死寂的土地在杀意中蠕动，食腐者盘旋其上，默然庆贺。

随后你看见了它——一座宏伟的斗兽场——从这具尸骸般的土地里隆起，像一颗脓疮，墙体黑得如肿瘤。它的巨门剥裂而开，仿佛刀锋从牙齿上剐下釉质。其内，人群为嗜血而咆哮。沙地——被翻搅成猩红的泥浆——以海妖般的哀歌召唤着你。

~ 由 Vhalaron Envisioned

The plains stretch across the horizon like a flayed man. The land buckles with craters, pitted and torn by centuries of siege. Pyre smoke blackens the cloudless sky, and each acrid breath scrapes down your parched throat. Battle roars in the distance—percussive waves of arrows hammering shields, punctuated by staccato screams slicing through the air. The dead earth writhes with murder as scavengers swirl in silent celebration.

Then you see it—a grand coliseum—rising from this carcass land like a pimple, its walls tumor black. Its gates peel open like a blade flensing enamel from teeth. Within, the crowd roars their bloodlust. The sands—churned to sanguine slush—summon you like a siren’s swan song.

~ Envisioned by Vhalaron

I Overchannel.name:
I 过载引导
I Overchannel

Text.text: 为我所唤起的力量再添一分威势，如今已成我的本能。即便我志在伤敌，我仍将全部学识与致命杀意灌入法术之中——它以最纯粹、最强盛的形态轰然爆发。 [以伤害过载] 我的力量因过度使用而衰减。但我仍能将一部分生命力缝入法术，来加固这次施法的威能。 Adding strength to the forces I evoke is second nature to me now. While I aim to harm my opponents, I channel all my knowledge and deadly intent into my spell. It erupts in its purest, strongest form. [Overchannel with Damage] My power has waned with overuse. But I can still bolster the might of this casting by sewing a portion of my life force into the spell.

I Cast Circle Of Death As A Warlock Swor.name:
我以向恶魔立誓的邪术师之身施放【死亡之环】
I Cast Circle Of Death As A Warlock Sworn To A Fiend

Text.text:
我召唤无光深渊的魔物，死亡的使者。空气翻卷着灰烬、余火与亵渎的低语。我猛然将双手向外一推，灼热夺命的瘴雾向四面八方膨胀——令草木瞬间焦黑，仿佛要将灵魂从躯壳中硬生生撕扯出来。
I invoke the fiends of the lightless depths, bringers of death. The air swirls with ash, cinders, and unholy whispers. I thrust my hands outward, and the hot, life-stealing haze expands in all directions—blackening plants and threatening to tear souls from bodies.

Blight In The Land.name:
大地之疫
Blight In The Land

Text.text:
腐烂的恶臭最先扑面而来，随后你才窥见源头——一片焦黑的土地，除成千上万嗡鸣盘旋的苍蝇外，再无半点生机。枯败之地的边缘仍有植物勉强生长，像是在为它勾勒出一道界线。这里或许也曾葱郁，足以滋养万物；而今在某种污秽的魔法侵蚀下，大地已然死去——枯败到无可挽回。
The stink of rot hits you first, and then you spy the source—a blackened stretch of land, devoid of life other than flies buzzing by the thousands. Plant life grows around the blight, marking its perimeter. This, too, may once have been a green place, capable of sustaining life; now, by some foul magic, the land is dead—blighted beyond salvation.

I Call A Rat Swarm With My Pipes Of The.name:
我吹响下水道之笛，召来一群鼠潮
I Call A Rat Swarm With My Pipes Of The Sewers

Text.text:
我的曲子起初一响，或许谁都会觉得动听——连野兽也同样难抗音乐的诱惑。可当我的气息穿过风笛的管道，歌声便骤然拐入诡异的音阶。不协和的琶音听起来像啁啾的言语。我尖厉地拉高其中几枚音符。我能感觉到一对对粉色的小耳朵循声转动，闻到它们的腥臭，感到它们的牙齿敲击成节，伴着我的旋律打出鼓点。
My tune may be appealing to anyone when it begins, as beasts also share the attraction to music. But as my breaths travels the Pipes, the song takes a turn into strange scales. Dissonant arpeggios sound like chirping speech. I screech some of the notes. I can sense the turning of small pink ears to the sound, smell their reek, feel the percussion of their teeth accompanying my melody.

Thunderstorm From Indoors.name:
室内观雷暴
Thunderstorm From Indoors

Text.text: 雨幕如帘，冲刷着墙面，噼啪敲打着屋顶。喧嚣的浪潮之中，你捕捉到一串更尖细、更有节奏的plink——有水从某处钻了进来。你偏过头，试图辨清声音的方位，忽然一记低沉而贴近的雷鸣轰然炸响，仿佛把整栋建筑都震得发颤。远处随即滚来回应的雷声，原本就凶的雨势又骤然加剧。 Curtains of rain wash against the walls and patter across the roof. Amidst the waves of noise, you detect the higher-pitched and rhythmic plink of water finding its way in somewhere. You tilt your head, trying to place the sound when thunder booms low and close, seeming to shake the building. An answering peal rolls in the distance, and the already hard rain intensifies.

I Cast Message Using Components.name:
我用施法材料施放了传讯术
I Cast Message Using Components

Text.text:
夹在我指间的铜线随着魔法微微抽动，我感到一阵震颤穿过掌心，沿着手臂攀上肩头，直抵喉间。我低声呢喃着信息，声音里缀着一丝若有若无的金属颤响。待我听见回应，耳蜗深处泛起轻轻的痒意。
The copper wire pinched between my fingers twinges with magic, and I feel a vibration through my hand, up my arm, across my shoulder, and into my throat. I whisper my message, the slightest metallic twang accenting my voice. When I hear the response, I feel a slight tickle within my ear.

Ar Contact Lenses In Use.name:
正在使用 AR 隐形眼镜
Ar Contact Lenses In Use

Text.text:
薄如蝉翼的镜片贴合着你的眼眶，骤然一闪，随即启动。数据洪流涌入你的视野，周遭的数字世界被彻底掀开；你所能看见的每个人身旁，都绽开一扇小小的信息窗口。银行余额、网页浏览记录、安保代码、即时消息一齐炸裂般苏醒，化作令人晕眩的感官轰击。看来你得花点时间才能习惯这一切。
The gossamer lenses mold themselves around your eyes and suddenly flash as they power up. Streams of data fill your vision, and the digital world around you is laid bare as a small info window blooms next to everyone you can see. Bank balances, web histories, security codes, and instant messages all explode into life in a disorientating sensory assault. This will take some getting used to.

你低声呢喃着法术的词句，朝着材料成分轻轻一吹，仿佛向火焰里吹入生命。你做出细微的手势，说出小小的“剑”，献上一件微不足道的小物，可你这隐秘的请求却从魔法的经纬里得到耀眼的回应——光芒绽放成形。
You whisper the words to the spell and breathe upon the material component, as if blowing life into a fire. You make small gestures, say small swords, and offer a tiny thing, but your subtle request receives a bright answer from the fabric of magic as light blooms into being.

Auto-drive Taxi Stop.name:
自动驾驶出租车停靠点
Auto-drive Taxi Stop

Text.text:
这处出租车停靠点本质上是一条沿街而建、带顶遮蔽的狭长廊道，肮脏又被人糟蹋——那种早已无人费心维护的老式公共站点。碎啤酒瓶、口香糖和零散的信用点散落一地。陈旧的全息广告有气无力地闪烁着。东侧尽头，两名粗野的工人正为谁先排到队里而互相放狠话。一辆出租车驶来，等候的工人被一名魁梧的半机械保镖粗暴推开，他护着一位美丽的女人钻进等候的出租车里。
Essentially a long, sheltered corridor on the side of the street, this taxi stop is dirty and misused—one of the old public stops no one bothers to maintain. Broken beer bottles, chewing gum, and loose credits litter the place. Old hologram advertisements flicker half-heartedly. At the eastern end, two thuggish workers are trading heavy words about who was first in the queue. A taxi pulls up, and the waiting workmen are shoved out of the way by a hulking cyborg bodyguard, who ushers a beautiful woman into the waiting taxi.

Dungeon: Floor With Debris.name:
地城：遍地瓦砾的楼层
Dungeon: Floor With Debris

Text.text:
你们面前的通道地面上满是杂物。大多是一堆司空见惯的残渣：碎裂的木片、破成片的陶器、龟裂的石块、撕烂的布条，以及扭曲的金属。但其中还有更阴森的迹象——折断的武器、凹陷的护甲，还有被揉烂的钱币。
Debris litters the floor of the passage before you. It's mostly a wide collection of the usual detritus like splintered wood, shattered ceramic, cracked stone, torn cloth, and bent metal. Yet, there are also more sinister signs—broken weapons, dented armor, and mangled coins.

Sundries From A Swamp Hag.name:
鬼婆杂货摊
Sundries From A Swamp Hag

Text.text:
在堆叠如山的废弃私藏之中，你发现了几样勾起你兴趣的东西：一只缺了一只眼的孩子玩偶、一枚心形吊坠，内侧刻着一个名字，以及一袋来自各种生物的牙齿。
Amid the hoard of discarded personal treasures, you find some items which pique your interest: a child's doll missing one eye, a heart-shaped locket with a name engraved inside, and a pouch of teeth from various creatures.

Sir Gaheris At The Joust.name:
盖赫里斯爵士在马上比武
Sir Gaheris At The Joust

Text.text:
一只双头雄鹰——灿然金辉，栖于紫底之上——装点着年轻骑士的盾牌；这凶猛的猛禽正是他角色的映照。一位淑女的信物从他高举长枪的枪杆上翩然飘动，他的坐骑小跑入列，加入其他骑手的队伍。

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

A twin-headed eagle—resplendent in gold upon a field of purpure—adorns the young knight’s shield, the fearsome raptor a reflection of his character. A lady’s favor flutters from the haft of his raised lance as his steed trots into line to join the other riders.

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

先是一声脆裂，沿着被雨水浸透的陡峭山壁刺耳地碾过；紧接着，一块庞然巨体猛然被剪断般剥离，轰然塌落，化作翻滚冲撞的巨石与碎屑洪流。滑坡吞没途经的一切，毁灭之势不亚于骑兵冲锋或法师的火球。它狂暴而反复无常地重塑大地，仿佛雷霆坠落，亲手触地。随后，一切归于沉寂——刮削过后的痕迹尽头，只剩堆积如山的残骸。

~ 设想：Einjuden

First comes a cracking sound, grinding across the high face of the rain-soaked mountainside, and then a gargantuan chunk of it shears away and collapses into rolling, driving boulders and debris. The slide buries everything in its path, no less destructive than a cavalry charge or a wizard’s fireball. Its violent and fickle reshaping of the land is like thunder descending and touching the earth. Then it quiets, piled at the end of its scouring wake.

~ Envisioned by Einjuden

I Cast Bless.name:
我施放了“祝福”
I Cast Bless

Text.text:
愿这圣水承我神注入的神能，锻强我盟友的决心。愿它增益他们臂膀的威势与意志的力量。愿我的言辞回响那伟大之灵，赐力于我的友伴，引他们穿越这重重磨难。
Let this holy water, instilled with power by our god, strengthen my allies in their resolve. Let it augment the might of their arms and the force of their will. Let my words echo the great spirit that empowers my friends and aids them through these tribulations.

Crossroads Shrine In Sweltering Heat.name:
酷热炙烤下的岔路神龛
Crossroads Shrine In Sweltering Heat

Text.text:
你伫立在十字路口，空气在眼前微微扭曲，热浪浓稠得几乎能攥住——太阳的怒火确已降临这片大地。古橡树下那座神龛的光亮石块仿佛将刺目的炽辉尽数反射，如同一座蜕变的坩埚，把林间浸没在天穹般的圣光之中。
You stand at a crossroads, the air shimmering, thick with heat—truly the sun's wrath has descended upon the land. The gleaming stones of a shrine beneath an ancient oak seem to reflect the glare, a crucible of transformation, flooding the wood with celestial light.

Eyeswide Headscanner.name:
睁眼式头部扫描器
Eyeswide Headscanner

Text.text:
一个外表光滑利落的异星人悄然向前，斑驳的人形面孔上伸出两根昆虫般的触角，步伐谨慎而轻。祂身着传统调查员的道具：深色衣装、组合工具、机构的官方印记。祂以探究的目光扫视房间，不紧张，却刻意避开与人对视——仿佛正盯着一块数据板。祂轻叹一声，掏出一支冒烟的烟管，懒懒地叼在唇间。
A slick-looking alien with a mottled humanoid face and two insectile antennae slinks forward with careful steps. They’re dressed in the gear of a traditional investigator: dark clothes, combination tools, the official mark of their agency. They scan the room with an inquisitive gaze, not nervous, avoiding eye contact. It’s as though they’re looking at a datapad. They sigh and take out a smoking tube and place it lazily between their lips.

你又翻过一座沙丘——仿佛无穷无尽的沙丘长链中的又一环——眼前豁然铺开一片绵延的仙人掌林。每一根粗壮的茎秆上都盛开着夺目的花朵，恶毒的尖刺覆满每一截躯干，稀疏的灌木草则填满它们之间的空间。
You crest another dune, one in a seemingly never-ending series, and find a sprawling forest of cacti. Vibrant flowers bloom on each stalk, and wicked spines cover each trunk, while scrub grass fills the space between them.

随着古老词句的吟诵与细微手势的引导，你揭开分隔诸界的帷幕，将意识与力量探入那道裂隙之中。妖精灵体顺从而来，循着你的言辞与招手的手势被牵引而至。当它穿入物质位面时，便披上此世野兽的形貌——可你深知，那不过是它借来的外衣，它真正的形态截然不同。
With the utterance of ancient words and subtle gesturing, you peel back the veil separating worlds and reach into the fissure. The fey spirit comes willingly, guided by your words and your beckoning hand. As it passes into the Material Plane, it takes the form of a beast of this world—though you know its true form is something else entirely.

I Use Giant Killer.name:
我发动“巨人杀手”
I Use Giant Killer

Text.text:
当巨敌的重击落下时，我看得出那生物失了平衡。现在是反击的时代。我侧身一步稳住脚跟，随即疾冲而入。我借它伸出的肢体作踏板，纵身跃起，抢占能直取要害的角度——就在那一瞬，我出手一击。
When my big foe’s blow lands, I can see the creature is off balance. It’s time to counterattack. I step to the side to gain good footing, then dart in. The extended limb I use as a launching pad, and I leap up to get a good angle on a vital spot. That’s where I strike.

兽人的皮肤如月照寒冰般泛着光——骨白、厚实如海豹皮——紧绷在一具由肌肉巨岩垒成的躯体上。符文刺青像泪痕般自他眼角淌下，没入那从未见过剃刀或梳子的胡须里。他的头发用鲸脂向后抹平，覆着霜光闪烁，冰晶在发沟里结成细棱。每一次呼吸都在獠牙间嘶嘶逸出，吐出一团白霜。他巨大的胸膛起伏翻涌，带得那件剑齿兽皮微微摇动，仿佛披在身上的生命正做着无声的假戏。

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

The orc’s skin gleams like moonlit ice—bone white and thick as sealskin—stretched across a body built from slabs of muscle. Runic tattoos run like tears from the corners of his eyes into a beard that’s never known razor or comb. His hair, slicked back with blubber, glistens with frost, ice forming in the grooves. Each breath, hissing between his tusks, releases a cloud of frost. His massive chest heaves, causing his saber-toothed pelt to stir in a pantomime of life.

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

Bloodthirsty Archpriest Of A God Of Murd.name:
嗜血的谋杀之神大祭司
Bloodthirsty Archpriest Of A God Of Murder

Text.text:
一个不祥的披斗篷身影将黄铜长杖的末端抵在地面上。他的一举一动都经过预谋。冷静而有条不紊。随着他转身面向你，时代仿佛被拉长、放慢——先转动头颅，再带动肩甲，最后连同那具强悍的躯体一并转来。  

男人抬起一只手——苍白得令你一想到它的接触便不寒而栗——指间戴着一枚黯淡的金戒，戒面覆着一层薄霜，在微弱的光里闪烁细碎寒辉。他轻轻整了整胸甲上数条溅染血污的皮革绑带，随后抬手去缓缓放下面具。  

当那张脸露出时，恐惧几乎有了重量：无瑕的皮肤，少有阳光染上的痕迹；短短的白发；以及一股干燥、冰冷的气息。嘴唇勾起笑意——却是残忍的笑——而那双凹陷的眼睛，黑得如同缟玛瑙，毫无笑意。
An ominous cloaked figure sets the end of his brass staff against the ground. His movements are premeditated. Methodical. Time seems to slow as he pivots to face you, turning first his head, then his pauldrons, and finally his entire powerful frame. The man raises a hand—so pallid that you shudder to think of its touch—adorned with a dull gold ring, which is covered in a sheen of frost that sparkles in the faint light. He gently adjusts one of several spatter-stained leather bindings on his cuirass before moving to lower his mask. The dread is palpable as he reveals his face: flawless skin, rarely tainted by sunlight; short-cropped white hair; and a dry, chill aura. The lips convey a smile, albeit a cruel one—the sunken eyes, black as onyx, do not.

Wasp Trap In Forest.name:
森林中的黄蜂陷阱
Wasp Trap In Forest

Text.text:
头顶那座巨巢里，愤怒黄蜂焦躁而压抑的嗡鸣乱作一团，却被闯入者全然忽略；他浑然不觉地踏过灌木与草丛——径直走向那根离地仅几寸、绷得笔直的细线，正因即将被触发而微微颤动。
A frantic, muted buzzing of angry wasps in the hive looming overhead goes unnoticed by the intruder as they stride obliviously through the undergrowth—right toward the taut wire suspended inches from the forest floor, trembling with anticipation.

Guards On Rooftops.name:
屋顶上的守卫
Guards On Rooftops

Text.text:
身着与全音号号角同样的明黄，武装守卫在塔周围的楼宇屋顶巡逻。他们手持上弦待发的短弩，长弓则斜背在身后。尖顶头盔在日光下闪着冷光，他们从一道檐口踱到另一道檐口，目光却频频转向全音号。忽有一名守卫朝巷子里厉声喝喊，几乎不等上几秒，便将一支警告箭射进鹅卵石路面。鞋底啪啪作响，游荡的人群瞬间四散奔逃。
Garbed in the same yellow as the Omniphone’s horns, armed guards patrol the rooftops of buildings around the tower. Their compact crossbows are loaded and in-hand, while longbows are slung across their back. Pointed helmets glint in the sun as they pace from cornice to cornice, and their heads often turn toward the Omniphone. One guard shouts down into an alley and, hardly waiting more than a few seconds, fires a warning shot to the cobblestones. Shoes slap as loiterers scatter.

这名矮壮的秃头生物，皮肤呈石般的蓝灰色，双眼如宝石般闪耀。它那对大耳朵、圆鼓鼓的鼻子与修长的四肢，似乎暗示着侏儒的传承，但它显然并不栖居于地表。它的腰带上挂着各式各样的采矿工具，你不由得想，在危急关头这些东西也能当武器使——事实上，它很可能就在不久前这么干过。
This stout, bald creature has skin the blue-gray of stone, and eyes that shine like gemstones. Their large ears, bulbous nose, and elongated limbs seem to hint at a gnomish heritage, but they certainly do not dwell on the surface. On their belt they carry an assortment of mining tools, and you imagine they might do as weapons in a pinch—in fact, likely have in the recent past.

现实在令人发狂的螺旋中自我扭曲，随着你越陷越深地踏入迷宫，它如利爪般撕扯着你的理智。墙壁起伏鼓胀，仿佛某头独眼巨兽的胸膛在呼吸，而钟表那不息的滴答声死死咬住你的每一步。
Reality twists upon itself in maddening spirals, clawing at your sanity, as you delve deeper into the maze. The walls heave like the chest of some cyclopean beast, and the constant ticking of a clock doggedly follows your every step.

Rallying Speech Before Facing An Apocaly.name:
直面末日强敌前的振奋演说
Rallying Speech Before Facing An Apocalyptic Foe

Text.text:
“我们已目睹这世界大半陷入火海。无数人已然殒落，若我们失败，还会有更多人步其后尘。可你看那儿。太阳依旧照耀。焦土终有一日会再度葱茏。焚毁的城镇残骸，也能在时代里重新盈满笑声。世界能够痊愈。我们不必赢。我们只需为它争取一些时代。”
“We’ve seen much of this world go up in flames. Many have been lost, and many more will follow if we fail. But look there. The sun shines still. The scorched earth will one day grow green. And the burnt remains of towns can, in time, be filled with laughter. The world can heal. We don’t have to win. All we have to do is buy it some time.”

一艘曾在冰面上搁浅的船，半埋在数个雪季堆积的厚雪之下，终究未能触及它的目的地。北极狂风为桅杆与残破的帆布披上一层霜衣。冰下铅灰色的水翻涌不息，腐蚀船体啃出一个洞口，逼迫着挤入其中，在那幽暗的裂隙里回旋翻卷，喷起一蓬蓬白色泡沫。
A ship that once ran aground on the ice sits partially buried under many seasons of snow, never to reach its destination. Arctic winds have frosted the mast and the remaining tatters of the sail. The leaden waters roiling beneath the ice have rotted a hole in the hull, forcing their way through and swirling in the dark aperture in a spray of white foam.

这生物四肢着地，宛如异星的猎犬伏地搜猎，张开的巨口里密布一排排细小而锋利的尖牙。它肌肉虬结的躯体呈钴蓝色，却点缀着些许诡异的绿色晶体碎屑。鲨鱼般的头颅上生出一圈蓬乱的触手鬃毛，来回闪动，仿佛在试探空气。它的双眼燃着不祥的橙光，如同被囚禁的火焰。它张开那深邃如洞的口，却没有发出一丝声音。
Standing on all fours like an alien hunting hound, the creature’s gaping maw boasts rows of tiny sharp teeth. Its muscled form is a cobalt blue in color but flecked with bits of strange green crystal. From the shark-like head sprouts a mane of unruly tentacles that flicker back and forth as if testing the air. Its eyes glow a baleful orange, like captured fire. It opens its cavernous mouth but does not make a single sound.

Skyship Brig.name:
飞空艇双桅横帆船
Skyship Brig

Text.text:
这间狭窄肮脏的囚室里，唯一的光源来自近旁脉动的符文石柱。空气中弥漫着粪秽的臭味——仅被刺鼻的肥皂味勉强盖过——一堆粗糙发霉的稻草充作囚犯的临时床铺。渗透在货舱甲板的奥术能量令那些惹怒船长的囚徒时刻备受折磨，难以安宁。
The only light in the cramped, squalid cell is from the pulsing rune pillars nearby. The scent of excrement—barely covered by pungent soap—fills the air, and a rough pile of moldy straw serves as a makeshift bed for those held here. The arcane energies permeating the cargo deck, cause constant discomfort for prisoners who earn the captain’s ire.

你的手指轻轻掠过奥术导能的焦点，随即从视野中淡去——仿佛从未存在过。
Your hand brushes lightly against the focus of your arcane channeling then fades from view—as if was never there.

一名推销员挂着掠食者般的狞笑，兴奋地吹了声口哨，拍了拍那辆伤痕累累、已服役数十年的旧车车顶，随即对着正困惑地打量标签价格的年轻情侣发起了猛烈的“攻击”。他肩后，经销店的蓝色霓虹招牌有节奏地闪烁着，把更多毫无防备的顾客引向那座藏在喧嚣高架桥下的矮胖灰楼。
A salesperson sporting a predatory grin slaps the roof of a battered car—several decades old—with an enthusiastic whistle before launching their attack on the bemused young couple examining the sticker price. Over their shoulder, the blue neon sign of the dealership flashes rhythmically, luring other unsuspecting customers to the squat, gray building secreted beneath the bustling overpass.

Undercover Mobster.name:
卧底黑帮成员
Undercover Mobster

Text.text:
男人举手投足都透着过分的优雅，身着上等丝绸，双手端正地背在身后。他脸上糊着一抹笑，却偏偏多露了几颗牙，笑意却丝毫不曾触及眼底。那双幽暗的瞳仁四下疾扫，像在衡量每一个过客；你还注意到他微微前倾的姿态，带着一种迫人的压迫感，仿佛随时蓄势待扑。

~ Envisioned by Chris

The man carries himself with an overabundance of elegance, dressed in fine silk with his hands folded primly behind his back. A smile is plastered on his face, but it shows just a few too many teeth and doesn't reach his eyes. The dark pupils dart in every direction, sizing up every passerby, and you notice a forward lean that gives him a sense of looming, almost poised to pounce.

~ Envisioned by Chris

燃烧木柴与熏鱼的气味本该淡淡飘散，但积雪与严寒把其余一切气息都钝化了。你本能地深深吸了一口气，目光扫过四周时，只觉鼻毛几乎要被冻在一起——就在这时，你看见河边一间小棚屋的屋顶上方，白色烟旗般的烟柱正徐徐舒展开来。
The scent of burning wood and smoking fish would be subtle, but the snow and cold have deadened all other scents. You instinctively inhale deeply as you scan your surroundings, and you feel your nose hairs freezing together as you spot the banner of white smoke unfurling above the roof of a shack down by the river.

小丑现身之处，远比王家包厢或华盖亭更出人意料：他在孩子们身边，摇响铃铛，用谜语逗弄试探；也会躲在集市摊位后面，游荡着，盯着贵族们的一举一动。混战期间，小丑穿梭于交锋之间，搅得三场对决乱作一团，也把人群引得哄然大笑。
The jester appears in less likely places than the royal box or pavilion: with the children, ringing bells and trying them with riddles, but also behind a market stall, loitering and watching what the nobles do. During the melee, the jester runs through the combat, throwing three matches into chaos and the crowd into laughter.

A False Hydra Emerges.name:
一头虚伪九头蛇现身
A False Hydra Emerges

Text.text:
城中宽阔主干道的卵石路面向前铺开，尽头豁然连入一片广场。晨曦微亮，商贩们已聚拢而来，忙着支起摊位。几名市民踏着沾露发滑的街面赶早办事——也有人踉跄着，从漫长的一夜里跌回家去。就在这片行动的喧声里，中央喷泉旁的地面忽然鼓起一团，卵石被顶得错位翻起，湿土涌上路面。一处破口中钻出三颗丑陋至极的头颅——扭曲无发，苍白如尸，獠牙森然，恍若褪色的食人男面；每颗头都顶在一条细长蜿蜒的颈上。那怪物环顾四周，眼眶如两口黑井。随后，人群在惊惧中连连后退，它竟开口歌唱……

~ 构想：Sigurd D. Ferret

The cobbled surface of the city’s wide main thoroughfare opens into a square, where, in the dawn light, merchants gather to set up their stalls. A few citizens move about the dew-slick streets on early errands—or stumble home from a long night. Amid the activity, near the central fountain, a mound forms, pushing cobbles out of the way and soil onto the surface. Three hideous heads—distorted and hairless, resembling pale, fanged men—emerge from the hole, each head atop a long, sinuous neck. The monstrosity gazes around, its eyes black pits. Then, as folk recoil in horror, it starts to sing…

~ Envisioned by Sigurd D. Ferret

Wild Magic Surge: Respite.name:
狂野魔法涌动：喘息
Wild Magic Surge: Respite

Text.text:
当你呼唤你的法术时，一阵回应的魔法如潮水般涌来，带着清凉的刺痒感席卷全身。你感觉伤口以超自然的速度自行缝合，重塑的血肉在成形时几乎发出吱呀作响的细微声。
As you call upon your spell, a wave of answering magic washes over you with a cool, tingling sensation. You feel your wounds knitting themselves closed at supernatural speed, the restructuring flesh almost creaking as it forms.

年轻的矮人手稳如外科医者，专注如大法师，羽毛笔在绷紧的羊皮纸上匀速划过，笔迹干净利落，毫无晕染。他们一边写，一边偶尔咬着胡须的角，沉入极深的凝神之境。这绝非寻常的抄写或印刷，而是一部以华丽书法精心排版的巨册——唯有重要的宗教典籍，或富人出重金订制的陈设珍品，才配得上这种规格。
With the steady hands of a chirurgeon and the focus of an archmage, the young dwarf’s quill scratches evenly and without any hint of smudging across the surface of the stretched parchment. As they work, they occasionally chew on the corners of their mustache, lost in the depths of their concentration. This is no mere script or print, but a tome laid out in decorative calligraphy, the kind reserved for important religious works or contracted by the wealthy for a showpiece.

Creek Running Through Yard.name:
穿庭而过的小溪
Creek Running Through Yard

Text.text:
一条小河将训练场与锻造工坊同校园其余区域分隔开来。两座矮短的木桥横跨溪流，让人得以干爽通行。一些从训练场归来的公会成员在岸边屈膝跪下，掬起清凉的河水泼洒在汗湿的头上，痛快地冲去燥热与疲惫。
The little river separates the training grounds and forge from the rest of the campus. Two short wooden bridges provide dry passage over the stream. Some guild members heading from the training grounds kneel at the banks, splashing the cool water over their sweat-drenched heads for a refreshing douse.

Barracks In Cave.name:
洞穴营房
Barracks In Cave

Text.text:
洞窟柔软的石壁上凿出了一排排壁龛，三层叠起，深度恰好够一个人躺进去。也许这里曾是一座墓穴，但如今却成了兵营——壁龛里塞着铺盖，房间里也到处摊开着寝具。光是墙上的壁龛就能让四十二人休息，地面上还有空间容纳更多人。
Niches have been carved into the soft stone of the cave walls, stacked three high and just deep enough for someone to lie in. Perhaps this was once a tomb, but now it serves as a barracks, as evidenced by the bedding in the niches and spread out over the room. Forty-two could rest in the walls alone, with space for more on the floor.

某位远方的女皇，或是本地的领主，想必曾摊开地图，把这条路线圈作要冲——因为那座覆着青苔、横跨溪流的拱桥，是按经久耐用的标准建成的。桥面宽得容一辆马车通行，两侧砌着齐腰高的矮墙；如此坚固厚重的构造，却与两端迎接它的那条寒酸小路格格不入。
Some far-off empress or local lord must have looked at a map and marked this route as important because the mossy bridge arching across the stream was built to last. Wide enough for a carriage and with waist-high walls on either side, its robust construction doesn’t suit the humble road that greets it on either side.

这根诡异的蓝色绳索盘成一团，宛如正在休息的蛇，编织的纤维间流淌着闪烁的魔法辉光。绳索两端各固定着一圈铜箍，光亮的金属上精工细刻着一圈细小而奇异的奥术符号。
This strange blue rope lies coiled like a resting snake, its woven fibers aglow with scintillating magic. A copper band is affixed to each end of the rope, and a curious ring of small arcane symbols has been masterfully etched into the gleaming metal.

Divine Lair Of A Goblinoid God.name:
地精神祇的神圣巢穴
Divine Lair Of A Goblinoid God

Text.text:
神祇栖身于沼泽边缘，一间肮脏逼仄的小棚屋里，堆满偷来的宝藏，或以谋杀夺取的物件。棚屋中立着一张矮粗的恶作剧王座，由硬木桩拼拢，再以芦苇绳紧紧捆扎而成。王座后方，巨植的阔叶如扇般铺展开来。此地臭气熏天：腐烂的草木味、尿臊味，以及地精肉身与生俱来的腥膻恶臭交织成一团。成千上万顶粗陋的帐篷与木搭棚屋沿着这位地精神祇异界沼泽的岸地绵延铺开。他那支地精亡军在奴颜婢膝者之上，建立起一套残忍的霸凌阶序。
The god lives at the edge of a swamp, in a gritty little hovel piled with stolen treasure or items taken by murder. In the hovel sits the squat throne of mischief, made of hardwood posts lashed together with reed cord. Fronds of giant plants spread out behind the throne. The place stinks of rotting vegetable matter, urine, and the natural reek of goblin flesh. Thousands of primitive tents and wooden shanties stretch out along the land of the goblin god’s otherworldly bog. His army of dead goblins establishes its own savage hierarchy of bullies over the servile.

它蜿蜒着向前滑行，你几乎要听见金属刮擦的尖啸——这蛇人之躯仿佛由灌满烈焰的青铜锻成。它的眼睛、嘴唇，以及鳞片间的皮肤——那些柔软之处——透出炽亮的灼光，显然是热力在体内翻涌；因为它手中那根尖头金属杆，看起来就像铁匠的工具在炉火里放得太久，烧得发黑发烫。
As it slithers forward you expect the squeal of metal scraping, for the body of this snake-man seems forged of fire-filled bronze. Eyes, lips, and the skin between scales—the soft parts—glow with what must be heat, because the pointed rod of metal in its hands looks like a blacksmith’s tool left too long in the forge.

I Put On My Leather Elbow Brace.name:
我戴上皮革护肘
I Put On My Leather Elbow Brace

Text.text:
当我把那条精巧编织的护肘牢牢系在手肘上时，一阵立刻的轻松感涌上心头：沉钝的酸痛如春日消融的冰一般褪去。我试了试贴合度，扭了扭、屈伸了几下手臂——竟毫无疼痛。我的嘴唇咧开一个灿烂的笑容，手握剑柄，将长剑高高举起，得意凯旋——走吧，去展开一场冒险！

~ 设想来自 Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

As I secure the intricately woven brace tightly around my elbow I feel an instant sense of relief: the dull ache melts away like ice thawing in spring. I test the fit, twisting and flexing my arm a few times—there is no pain. My lips part in a wide smile and I grasp the hilt of my sword, raising it high in triumph—let's go on an adventure!

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

I Am Struck By A Fireball.name:
我被一发火球术击中了
I Am Struck By A Fireball

Text.text:
火球轰然炸裂，我的世界在火焰、灼热与剧痛的迷雾中崩塌，冲击将我掀翻在地。我鼻腔里灌满焦皮与烧毛发刺鼻的辛辣气味。我拼命压下耳中的嗡鸣，努力不让视野天旋地转。
My world explodes in a haze of fire, heat, and pain as the fireball erupts, sending me sprawling to the ground. The acrid scent of charred leather and burnt hair fills my nostrils. I desperately try to stop the ringing in my ears and to keep my vision from swimming.

你指向目标，在记忆与顿悟的激涌中，瞬间洞穿目标的防御——以及弱点。你为下一步行动做好准备。
You point at the target, and in a rush of recollection and revelation, you pinpoint the target's defenses—and weaknesses. You prepare for your next move.

光是看这恶魔一眼，就让你脊背发寒。它瘦长的身躯大致呈人形，却无半分人味——蓝白色的皮肤冰冷刺目，贴身附着的冰片宛如护甲般簌簌作响。它的姿态与体型更像巨魔（特征），却又像猫一样轻巧地在身后甩动一条长尾；尾端被厚厚的冰壳包裹，沉重得像一根棍棒。
Just looking at this fiend gives you chills. Its lanky body is roughly humanoid, but there’s nothing human-like about its blue-white skin or the shards of ice that cling to it like armor. Its posture and size are more like a troll, but it flicks a long tail behind it as lightly as a cat despite the ice heavily encrusting its end like a club.

那根指针宛如一片蓬松的青绿色羽毛，悬浮在罗盘的表盘上方——而那张表盘并没有常见的 North、East、South、West 标记。取而代之的，是在本该写着 North 的位置刻着一个词：Tell。只要对着这件古怪的工具低声说出目的地，那羽毛便会猛然颤动，疯狂旋转、翻飞，直到最终指向——你猜——你该走的方向。 The needle, shaped like a fluffy, teal feather, levitates above the compass’s face—a face lacking the normal markers of North, East, South, and West. Instead, a word is etched where North should be: Tell. Whispering a destination over the strange tool sends the feather aflutter, wildly spinning and flipping until it points into, you suppose, the way you need to go.

那名精瘦、肤色白皙的男人赤着上身站着，双臂松垂身侧，神情带着几分戏谑——即便赤褐色的山羊胡遮住了脸，眼角的笑纹仍清晰可见。他红褐色的头发头顶剪得很短，后方却束成一条马尾；两侧各垂下一绺扭结的发辫，上面点缀着深红珠子、线绳与羽毛。他颈侧烙印的盘龙印记毫无遮掩地暴露在外。他那宽松飘垂的长裤、朴素的凉鞋、斜挎的背带与挎包都带着旅行磨出的旧痕。只有背后那柄华丽的巨剑，以及前臂嵌入的一枚红色宝石，才暗示他绝不只是个古怪的流浪汉。

~ 由 Chris Bailey 扮演

The lean, fair-skinned man standing shirtless with arms loose at his sides wears an amused expression—laugh lines apparent even where his auburn goatee covers his face. His red-brown hair is styled short on top but gives way to a ponytail at the back, while a couple of twisted locks, each decorated with crimson beads, thread, and feathers fall on each side. The coiled dragon branded on his neck is fully visible. His loose, blousy pants, simple sandals, baldric, and satchel are travel-worn. Only the ornate greatsword strapped to his back and the red jewel embedded in his forearm suggest he’s more than an odd wanderer.

~ Played by Chris Bailey

Joust In Summer Heat.name:
盛夏炎阳下的马上比武
Joust In Summer Heat

Text.text:
参赛者与人群在灼人的烈日下挥汗如雨、煎熬受苦。骑士们不顾酷热，仍执拗地彼此冲锋——锁子甲取代了板甲，面甲掀起，任热浪灌入。战马喷吐热汽与白沫，喘息粗重，肋腹起伏如浪，缰绳上溅满泡沫。胜者得到的只是有气无力的呼喊与敷衍的赞美，白日的酷热正一点点抽走所有人的力气。今天灌下肚的，将是水多过麦酒。
Contenders and crowd sweat and suffer beneath the blistering sun. Knights doggedly charge each other despite the heat, chain hauberks replacing plate, visors agape. Horses steam and blow, flanks heaving, bridles spattered in froth. Lackluster cries and half-hearted praise are heaped upon the victors, the heat of the day leaching everyone's strength. More water than ale will be quaffed this day.

Loot From Animated Armor.name:
来自活化护甲的战利品
Loot From Animated Armor

Text.text:
如今那套会动的护甲已一动不动地倒在地上，你小心翼翼地检查它散落的各个部件。护甲本体裂缝纵横、凹痕累累，已无法再穿戴；但当你晃动胸甲时，里面传来一声空洞的回响。你伸手探入，发现一颗鲜红夺目的红宝石，约两英寸见方，被切割成一枚心形。
Now that the animated suit of armor lies motionless, you warily examine its constituent pieces. The armor itself is too rent and dented to be worn, but you hear a hollow peal from within the breastplate as you jostle it. Inside, you discover a bright red ruby, about two inches across, cut into the shape of a heart.

Words Of Encouragement For A Shy Party M.name:
给一位害羞队友的鼓励之词
Words Of Encouragement For A Shy Party Member

Text.text:
“你为什么觉得自己必须沉默？你不是该躲藏起来的累赘。你是一盏灯塔，是一位领袖。你一开口，字字都饱含真实与慈悲，周围的人别无选择，只能倾听。让你的声音自由吧，我向你保证，这个世界都会为之战栗。”
“Why do you feel you need to be silent? You are not an annoyance that should stay hidden. You are a beacon, a leader. When you speak, your words hold such truth and compassion that people around you have no choice but to listen. Let your voice be free and, I promise you, this world will tremble.”

Mammatus Clouds In The Sky.name:
天空中的乳状云
Mammatus Clouds In The Sky

Text.text:
天穹上鼓胀的云团，像是刚从棉田收割下来的巨大棉絮团，铺天盖地得叫人只需一只手，就能数清地平线上漏出的那几缕阳光。
The bulging clouds in the sky resemble huge wads of balled cotton fresh from the harvest, so all-encompassing you can count the rays of sunlight visible on the horizon on one hand.

这具类人生物由赭红岩石塑成，仿佛悬浮于空，双腿消散成飘散的尘雾流絮。宝石般的双眼闪着古老而玄奥的睿光，巨灵扛起一柄巨大的石槌，每一次移动都伴着碎岩松脱般的吱呀声。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，MrRhexx 呈现

The humanoid creature of ruddy stone seems to levitate, its legs dissipating into drifting plumes of dust. Gemstone eyes gleam with an ancient, esoteric wisdom as the genie hefts a massive stone maul, creaking like dislodged rocks with every movement.

~ Envisioned by MrRhexx

你身周的荒野渐渐稀疏。那条曾被蔓生荆棘堵得寸步难行的小径，如今让位于绵长而蜿蜒的道路，沿着崎岖的地形缓缓抬升，林木零星点缀其间。前方群山巍然逼近，尺度之宏大令人目眩；寒风掠过山麓，凛冽刺骨，裹挟着高处雪冠的霜意。

~ 一位英雄所构想

The wilderness around you thins. The trail, once choked with creeping brambles, now gives way to long, meandering paths rising gradually over rugged terrain that is dotted with trees. Mountains loom ahead, their scale staggering, and the wind rolling across the foothills is frigid, laced with frost from the snowcaps high above.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Deck Wizard Butler.name:
牌组巫师管家
Deck Wizard Butler

Text.text:
身着一套优雅却干练的黑色羊毛西装，那个身形修长、神情冷峻的男人走近富商，指尖轻巧托着一只银托盘，几杯饮品稳稳平衡其上。他挑起眉梢，斜斜扫过你与伙伴一眼，随即行云流水般把注意力收回雇主身上。你猛地一怔，这才看清他礼服外套的袖口沿着缝线绣着数枚银色符文，而他马甲侧边缝制的固定套里，还露出一截纤细的银杖柄。

~ Envisioned by The_Seph_I_am

Clad in an elegant but businesslike suit of black wool, the slim, serious man approaches the wealthy merchant, a silver tray with several drinks effortlessly balanced on his fingertips. He casts an arch glance over you and your companions before smoothly returning his attention to his employer. With a start, you spot several silver runes embroidered along the cuffs of his formal coat, and a slim silver wand handle jutting out from a holder sewn into the side of his vest.

~ Envisioned by The_Seph_I_am

Lethal Police Vehicle Chase.name:
致命警车追逐
Lethal Police Vehicle Chase

Text.text:
刺耳的轮胎摩擦声与凄厉的警笛声早在车辆本身映入眼帘之前，就已灌满整条街道。一辆线条冷峻的黑色巡逻车紧追着一辆烈焰般鲜红的跑车，两车以令人窒息的速度在车流间左右穿梭，甚至冲上人行道。肇事者转弯过猛，车轮瞬间打滑——那辆车仿佛在慢镜头里被抛上空中，翻滚了好几圈，最终狠狠撞上墙面，伴随着一声令人牙酸的闷响与金属碎裂的脆裂声。
The sound of screeching tires and wailing sirens fills the street long before the cars themselves come into view. A sleek black cruiser chases after a blazing-red sports car, both swerving in and out of traffic and even up onto the sidewalk at breakneck speed. The culprit takes a turn too fast and the car’s wheels slip. It seems to flip through the air in slow motion, turning over several times before impacting the wall with a sick crunch.

Dungeon: Partially Submerged Doorway.name:
地城：半淹没的门道
Dungeon: Partially Submerged Doorway

Text.text:
门口只有半截还露在灌满通道的水面之上。水珠沿着门框滑落，滴进临时凿出的浅坑里。想从这道口子过去，根本不可能不湿透。
Only half of the doorway is visible above the surface of the water filling the passage. Drops of moisture run down the frame of the door and into the makeshift basin. There's no way through the opening without getting soaked.

White Dragon's Frozen Hoard.name:
白龙的冰封宝藏
White Dragon's Frozen Hoard

Text.text:
你小心翼翼地从白龙臃肿的尸身旁穿行而过，靴底碾碎冰壳发出清脆的咯吱声，沿着湿滑的坡道谨慎下行，踏入它的巢穴。走进那座巨大的洞窟，温度骤然坠落，寒意深得仿佛直钻骨髓。可你本以为会见到龙的宝藏，眼前却只有一望无际的冰原——直到你发现，冰层下方仅几寸之处，一片淡黄色的海洋正隐隐闪烁。
You pick your way past the white dragon's hulking corpse, ice crunching under boots as you carefully descend the slick path into its lair. The temperature plummets as you enter a massive cavern, a cold so deep you feel it in your bones. But where you expect to find the dragon’s hoard, there is only a wide expanse of ice—until you notice the sea of pale yellow glinting a few inches beneath the surface.

I Use My Ring Of X-ray Vision.name:
我启用我的 X 射线视觉戒指
I Use My Ring Of X-ray Vision

Text.text:
我将戴着戒指的那只手随意抬到脸旁，仿佛只是挠挠痒。随后我把口令低声送入它的玻璃球里——那球面涂绘成一只睁得极宽、毫不眨眼的眼睛，虹彩般的虹膜流光溢彩。宝石上的幽暗瞳孔骤然放大，吞没了整个球体，我的视野随之被黑与蓝的色谱淹没。视觉里，墙壁薄得像轻纱帷幕，岩石与树木被压扁成单薄的膜片，连脚下的大地也化作一片透明的玻璃，铺展在我身下。
I bring the hand bearing my ring to my face, casually, as if to scratch an itch. I whisper the command word into its glass orb—the surface painted to resemble a wide, unblinking eye with an iridescent iris. The dark pupil on the gem dilates, overtaking the whole of the orb, and my vision becomes awash in a palette of black and blue. Visually, walls thin to gossamer curtains, rock and tree flatten to mere membranes, and even the ground becomes a swathe of clear glass beneath me.

Wondrous Green Portal.name:
奇妙的翠绿传送门
Wondrous Green Portal

Text.text:
沉寂的基座上方，浮现出一粒发光的绿色光点。它骤然迸亮，随即沿着椭圆弧线俯冲而下，拖曳出如太阳般炽燃的光带。光点追逐着自己的轨迹——越来越快——穿梭编织出一圈打结般的曼荼罗光纹边框。它回到起点的刹那，整道图案猛然爆闪。你本能地眨了眨眼；再度睁开时，一道通往诡奇而瑰丽世界的传送门已然开启。
A single glowing dot of green appears above the dormant plinth. It flares, then swoops down in an elliptical arc, leaving streamers that blaze like the sun. The dot chases itself—faster and faster—weaving a knotted mandala border of light. As it ends at its point of origin, the pattern flares. You blink by reflex, and when you open your eyes again, a portal to a strange and beautiful world has opened.

Apari Constituent.name:
阿帕里议会成员
Apari Constituent

Text.text:
这东西小得可怜：一只焦橙色的小型虫类生物，长着锋利的颚与一对纤薄的翅。它显得格格不入，孤零零地——像是迷了路——不知该做什么。它朝着世界胡乱噬咬，对一切都满怀怒意。也许不过是某种害虫罢了。可那窸窣疾爬的声响，依旧令人毛骨悚然。
This is a truly tiny thing: a small insectoid of burnt orange color, bearing sharp mandibles and a thin pair of wings. It seems out of place, alone—lost somehow—unsure of what to do. It snaps up at the world, angry at all things. A pest of sorts, perhaps. Still, the skittering is most unsettling.

尽管这装置看上去不过是一支孤零零的滑雪板，它其实是一条小腿假肢，专为在苔原的山坡上轻松行进而设计。皮革扣带与收尖的承口覆在一根铁制胫管之上，胫管固定在一个粗陋的关节上；关节连着一段被压扁的山核桃木，木身向前渐细，尖端微微上翘。另一条皮革绑带缠绕关节并一路系回承口扣带，为整体提供额外的强度。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Although the contraption merely looks like a solitary ski, it is actually a lower-leg prosthetic, designed for easily navigating the tundra mountainside. Leather clasps and a tapered socket rest atop an iron shin tube secured to a rudimentary joint on a flattened length of hickory wood that tapers up at the tip. Another tie of leather wraps around the joint and up to the socket clasps to provide additional strength.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Flustered Pedestrian.name:
惊慌失措的行人
Flustered Pedestrian

Text.text: 一个身着浅灰西装、系着细瘦领带的男人匆匆走在霓虹浸染的街道上，眼神飘忽却又惊惶，嘴角绷成一条硬线。 “我——我没审阅过的东西，怎么可能批准！”他对着空气厉声回呛，抬手做了个驱赶般的挥拍动作。两侧太阳穴各有一枚炫目的标记，明快的嫩绿色光芒跳动着，仿佛他的通讯装置直接植入了脑内。他抬手一把捋过深色的头发，原本利落的蓬松刘海被揉得乱翘，像只凤头鹦鹉的刺冠。 “什么——？说我在偷懒？！”他显然心神大乱，仍沿着既定路线疾走，呼吸却越来越薄，最后变成怒火般嘶哑的喘鸣。 A man in a light gray suit and skinny tie walks hurriedly down the neon-soaked street, his eyes distant yet frantic as his mouth hardens to a clench. “I ca—I can’t approve something I haven’t reviewed,” he snaps into thin air, making a swatting motion with his hand. A flashy logo at each temple, each bright with a sprightly green glow, suggests his comm device is implanted directly into his head. He runs a hand through his sweep of dark hair, ruining the look of his quiff into cockatiel-esque spikes. “What—? I’ve been slacking?!” Clearly distressed, he continues on his route even as his breath thins to a livid wheeze.

I Cast Sleep Using A Cricket.name:
我用一只蟋蟀施放睡眠术
I Cast Sleep Using A Cricket

Text.text:
我将那只活蟋蟀捧在掌心，贴着掌心低声呢喃一段催眠咒语，唤起落日余晖。蟋蟀受了鼓舞，开始鸣叫。它有节奏的清脆颤音与我的耳语交织：这支暮色之歌，会让听见的人坠入被施了魔法的沉眠。
I cup the living cricket in my palms and whisper a sleepy incantation, evoking sunset. Encouraged, the cricket begins to chirp. Its rhythmic trills mingle with my whispers: our twilight song should send whoever hears it into an enchanted slumber.

尽管他有着一眼便知的侏儒面容与比例，那位生着羽翼的天使之形却高如山丘巨人，神祇般的肌肉线条与之相称。他的眼与发皆是鲜烈猩红，狂放不羁；垂覆胸前的胡须被精心编成繁复的辫束。虽披着耀眼的胸甲与胫甲，这名天使却不见任何兵刃——除了他自己的双拳：自肘至指尖仿佛整体浇铸成了光辉的青铜。当他挪动那惊人的重量，近旁之人便听见清晰而尖利的钢鸣，仿佛这生物本就是以最纯净的金属锻造而成。

~ Requested by Dung Beetle

Despite his clearly gnomish features and proportions, the winged, angelic being stands as tall as a hill giant, with a godlike, muscled physique to match. His eyes and hair, both a vivid crimson, are wild and untamed, and the beard draping his chest is elaborately braided. Though armored in a shining breastplate and greaves, the angel bears no apparent weapons—save his own fists, which appear to have been cast from elbow to fingertip in gleaming bronze. As he shifts his immense weight, those nearby hear the distinct keen of steel, as if the creature were forged of the purest metals.

~ Requested by Dung Beetle

Faerie Tax Fountain.name:
妖精税泉
Faerie Tax Fountain

Text.text:
这处小小的庭院没有吟游石广场那般恢宏气派，却依旧为金融区里奔忙的人们提供一段安宁的休息。身着商务装的人们在石凳上休息，吃着午餐，或啜饮杯中热茶。庭院中央的石质喷泉点缀着妖精族的小雕像——灰色的笑脸，头顶覆着苔藓作冠。每一尊的双手都向前伸出，掌心相叠，盛满了钱币。一位母亲轻轻催促着蹒跚学步的孩子上前，小家伙双手捧着一枚银币，仿佛捧着神圣的供奉。“去吧，亲爱的，”母亲用轻快又带点玩笑的语气说道，“把钱给妖精们，好让他们一直把我们放在心上。”
This small court lacks the grandiose impression of Bardstone Plaza, but still offers a peaceful respite for those working in the financial district. People in business attire rest on the stone benches to eat their lunches or sip cups of tea. The stone fountain in the center of the court is adorned with statuettes of faerie folk—gray smiling faces crowned with moss. Each figure’s hands are outstretched, cupped and stacked with coins. A mother ushers her toddler forward, the child holding a silver coin in his hands like a sacred offering. “Go on, love,” mother says in a light and playful tone. “Pay the faeries, so they keep us fondly in their thoughts."

Female Ogre Warrior.name:
女性食人魔战士
Female Ogre Warrior

Text.text:
她大步踏过崎岖的地形——一名可怖的食人魔女，浑身披挂着以白骨锻成的战利品。每迈出一步，大地便在她巨大的脚掌下震颤；她那双眼睛燃着凶狠的决意，扫视着天际线。她嗅闻着寻找目标，粗糙扭结的拳头在野蛮的弯刃大刀柄上时紧时松。
Across the rugged terrain she strides, a formidable ogress bedecked in trophies fashioned from bones. With each step, the earth vibrates beneath her colossal feet, and her eyes, fiercely determined, scan the horizon. She searches, nose sniffing, gnarled fist clenching and unclenching about her brutish falchion.

Nenniril The Half-beast Shadow Monk.name:
能尼里尔：半兽影修僧
Nenniril The Half-beast Shadow Monk

Text.text:
她的脚步轻得像影子掠过柔软的青苔，沉静而深邃，悄然传染开来。她大体仍是类人，却长着黑色羊角；宽大的食草兽耳轻轻一抖；一双温暖的橘色眼睛静静注视。两眼之间纹着一枚水滴符号。她以白色缠带裹住身躯，外搭棕色紧身裤，背后盘着一圈橘色绳索；那支长火绳枪被她当作长棍般握持。她先挥击，借阴影瞬移，再扣扳机开火。

~ Played by ShibaMSK

Her light step is like a shadow slipping across soft green moss, her calm contagious and deep. She is mostly humanoid, but sports the black horns of a sheep, flicking, wide herbivore ears, and warm orange eyes. Tattooed between those eyes is a waterdrop symbol. Her body is wrapped in white bands over brown leggings, and an orange rope coils around her back; her long musket is held like a quarterstaff. She strikes, teleports through shadows, then fires.

~ Played by ShibaMSK

Dairy Wizard Making Ice Cream.name:
乳品巫师制作冰淇淋
Dairy Wizard Making Ice Cream

Text.text:
巫师心满意足地哼着小调，把手在粗糙的工装背带裤上抹了抹，咧嘴大笑，随即开始吟诵咒文，将桶里的奶油灌注进刺骨的魔法寒意之中。他们皱褶的手指以出人意料的灵巧扭动着，召来一股冰蓝色能量的激流，迅速凝固的液面上旋即爬满一层霜华。农夫伸手抓起一把巨大的木勺，另一只手仍维持着能量的奔涌，开始缓慢而有条不紊地搅动那团混合物，仿佛在熬煮一锅女巫的魔药。

~ Max_Slacker 于 Discord

Humming contentedly, the wizard wipes their hands on rugged overalls and smiles broadly as they begin the incantation to infuse the cream in the bucket with frigid magic. They wiggle wrinkled fingers with surprising dexterity and summon a torrent of icy blue energy, and a rime of frost appears on the rapidly solidifying liquid. The farmer reaches for a large wooden spoon, keeping the energy flowing with the other hand, and begins to stir the mixture slowly and methodically like a witch's brew.

~ Max_Slacker on Discord

Leather Wing Brace.name:
皮翼支架
Leather Wing Brace

Text.text:
一串短金属杆连成的链条上垂下长长的皮革条带，多处可弯折变形。虽然摇晃作响、以现状握持也略显笨重，但这装置能够为断裂、形状异常或无法活动的翼提供支援。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Long strips of leather hang from a chain of short metal rods, bendable in many places. Though rattling and a bit cumbersome to hold in its current state, this device could provide support for a broken, differently shaped, or immoveable wing.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

施法者对着一个小小的纸质漏斗吹气。深邃的水从地面涌出，汇成一滩宽阔的水洼，直径三十英尺。水面随即开始流动，不久便孕育出一团旋转的奥术之风，在水中翻搅奔腾，将碎屑胡乱卷起，抛向空中。
The caster blows into a small papery funnel. Deep water wells up in a broad puddle, thirty feet across. The water begins to move, and soon harbors a swirling mass of arcane wind, churning the water and throwing debris haphazardly into the air.

Loot From A Noble Bullywug.name:
从一只贵族牛蛙人身上搜刮的战利品
Loot From A Noble Bullywug

Text.text:
搜查倒下的蛙族人时，你发现她腰间那条莹亮的蓝色腰带上，悬着一只沉甸甸的蘑菇皮革钱袋。她胸前口袋里还有一枚纯金挂坠盒，系在一条纤细的链子上，随着动作轻轻晃荡。盒中嵌着另一位蛙族人的肖像，神情肃穆，仿佛不祥地与死者的结局相互呼应。
In searching the fallen frogkin’s person, you find a heavy pouch of mushroom leather hanging from the lustrous blue sash about her waist. A locket of pure gold is in her breast pocket, dangling on a delicate chain. It houses a picture of another frogkin with a solemn countenance, eerily fitting for the fallen’s fate.

Insult By A Dragon About Heroics.name:
被巨龙嘲弄的英雄壮举
Insult By A Dragon About Heroics

Text.text:
“何等虚荣……竟自诩为英雄！这样吧，若你们唯一在意的是他人的安危，就让我吃掉你们中的一个，我便再沉睡十号年。”
“Such vanity… To believe yourselves heroes! Tell you what, if your only concern is for the well-being of others, let me eat one of you and I’ll sleep for another ten years.”

海面轰然炸开，漫天冰冷水珠如暴雨倾泻，砸得你与甲板噼啪作响。一道存在——由鳞片盘结成的巨大躯索——高高拔起，直冲空中，在你身上投下狭长的阴影。那生物甩动头颅，嵴刺震颤，轰鸣如雷。它狞笑的巨口在船首前越张越大，而船身此刻只能无助地起伏，像个走失的玩具般随波漂摇。
The surface of the sea explodes and a shower of icy droplets rains down, pummeling you and the ship deck. A being, a massive cord of scales, stretches high into the air, casting a long shadow over you. The creature shakes its head, spines rattling as loud as thunder. Its grinning maw widens before the bow of the ship, which now bobs, helpless as a wayward toy.

有人在制作这套软甲时倾注了异乎寻常的心思。鲜艳的锦缎以金线织出藤蔓与白玫瑰的纹样，装点在红色丝绸之上。这块夺目的布料被细密缝合在下方更具防护性的绗缝羊毛层上。整套护甲既华美又舒适，尤其适合寒夜穿戴。
Someone took an unusual amount of care in the creation of this padded armor. A colorful brocade—gold thread depicting a pattern of vines with white roses—decorates the red silk. This stunning cloth has been stitched to the more protective layer of quilted wool underneath. The suit looks both beautiful and comfortable, particularly on a cold night.

Notorious Alien Con.name:
臭名昭著的外星人骗局
Notorious Alien Con

Text.text:
一名兜帽遮面的外星人贴着人潮潜行穿过挤满旅客的星港，厚重兜帽深处，两道眼缝透出红宝石般的幽光。只要有人靠得太近，他们就猛地一抽，利爪下意识地探向早已不在的腰间——武器已被安保没收。忽然，他们停下脚步，嘴角勾起笑意：一个面色蜡黄的人类走近，眼中满是惊惧，一只颤抖的手紧攥着棕色信封。
A hooded alien slinks through the throng of travelers filling the spaceport, the ruby glow of their eye slits glowing within the heavy cowl. They twitch whenever anyone comes too close, claws reaching for sidearms no longer there—the weapons already confiscated by security. Suddenly they stop and smile, as a sallow-faced human approaches, fear in his eyes, a brown envelope in one quivering hand.

一具干枯的真菌躯壳自黑暗中踉跄扑出，发出低沉而凶险的呻吟。那生物的身躯曾是人形，然而在侵占蔓延的菌体增生之下，早已难以辨清它原本的比例。尸胆般的黄绿菌华将怪物的头颅劈成两半，像攻城槌撞裂堡门般把残存的颅骨硬生生撬开。
A desiccated fungal husk lurches out of the darkness, emitting a low, menacing groan. The creature’s body was once humanoid, though it is difficult to determine its original proportions within the colonizing growths. A fungal bloom the color of corpse bile breaks the monster’s head in two, driving what remains of its skull apart like a battering ram splitting a fortress gate.

Scything Blade Trap.name:
夺命镰刃陷阱
Scything Blade Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 你在天花板的一处狭窄凹槽里注意到一个开口——仅有一英尺来宽——胃里陡然一沉。这里不对劲。

[发现] 一根绊索——绷得笔直，几乎难以察觉——离地几英寸横在前方，截断了你的去路。你目光锐利，循着那根如蛛丝般的细线望去，只见它没入天花板；在那里的开口中，一片巨刃在火把光里阴森闪烁。

[触发] 你的脚一瞬间勾住了什么，随即听到一声咔嚓，紧接着气流猛地掠过——一柄巨大的刀刃被释放，带着致命的弧光猛然劈落。

[Perceived] In a narrow recess in the ceiling, you notice an opening—only a foot or so wide—and you feel a heaviness in your gut. Something is not right here.

[Discovered] A tripwire—pulled taut and almost imperceptible—lies a few inches off the ground, barring your way forward. Your keen eyes follow the gossamer thread as it disappears into the ceiling, where a large blade within an opening shimmers menacingly in the torchlight.

[Triggered] Your foot briefly catches on something, and you hear a snap followed by a rush of air as an enormous blade is released—slicing down in a deadly arc.

Fire Elemental: Volcanic Lair.name:
火元素：火山巢穴
Fire Elemental: Volcanic Lair

Text.text:
流淌的岩浆把一切都染成暴怒的猩红，喷涌的烈焰不时溅起橙色的闪光，扑打在你的脸上。你感到那股炽烈而干燥的热浪如同有形的压力，逼迫你远离那条发光的火之河。
The flowing magma casts everything in furious red, while blasts of flames splash occasional flashes of orange across your face. You feel the intense, dry heat like a physical pressure that pushes you away from the glowing river of fire.

Befouled Church Yard.name:
污秽教堂墓园
Befouled Church Yard

Text.text:
一尊天使雕像的头颅侧躺在草地上，晨露浸润着它温柔的双眼。石质的躯干已失去双翼，只剩双臂徒然高举，无头地绝望祈求。四周尽是墓碑——残破、断裂，崩落的碎石碾碎了前一日摆放其前的花束。某些遗体被从永恒的沉眠中半掘而出，干枯的肢体与龟裂的头骨散落泥土之间。刺鼻的尿臊味浓烈得几乎可以确定是新鲜的，彻底吞没了整片墓园。
The head of an angel statue lays sideways on the grass, the morning dew watering its gentle eyes. Its stone body is missing its wings, left only with arms upraised in hopeless, headless beseeching. All around are headstones, broken, with their rubble crushing the flowers left before them the day before. Bodies have been partially dug up from their eternal slumber, and the desiccated limbs and cracked skulls of the departed litter the earth. The odor of urine, so pungent it must be fresh, overwhelms the entire yard.

Loot From A Nightwalker.name:
夜行者的战利品
Loot From A Nightwalker

Text.text:
午夜蓝的巨躯一动不动地躺着；当你扫视这生物的形体时，它的气息依旧强大，沉沉压在你的灵魂上。你没在这异常生物身上发现任何挎包或饰物，但你注意到它那长角的头颅已经开始渗漏。某种黑色物质从它布满利刃般边缘的颚肢间滴落，也从那对横扫开去、如公牛般的弯角根部淌出。它会吞噬周遭的一切光亮，让它触及或碾过的事物都笼在一层黑暗的薄幕之下。它看起来既像液体又像气体——一种液态的影子。你可以将其收集进小瓶中，留待日后检验与使用。
The midnight-blue giant lies still, its aura still potent enough to weigh down your spirit as you scan the creature’s form. You do not find any satchels or adornments on this aberrant creature, but you do notice its horned head has begun to leak. A dark substance drips from its razor-lined mandibles and from the base of its sweeping, steer-like horns. It draws in the light of anything near, casting anything it touches or runs over in a veil of darkness. It seems to be both fluid and gas at once—a liquid shadow. It could be collected in a vial for later testing and use.

Orbital Shipyard: Control Center.name:
轨道船坞：控制中心
Orbital Shipyard: Control Center

Text.text:
巨大的控制中心里，一排排全景舷窗俯瞰着喧嚣繁忙的船坞，以及更远处无垠铺展的星海。训练有素的操作员团队在主管警惕的注视下，以惊人的效率调度着星际航道；每个人都从容不迫地驾驭着屏幕上疾风般奔涌的数据洪流。
The panoramic windows of the enormous control center look out over the bustling shipyard and the infinite starscape beyond. A well-drilled crew of operators managing the interstellar traffic work with remarkable efficiency under the watchful eye of their supervisor, each one navigating the blisteringly fast stream of data that fills their screens with aplomb.

这座穹顶墓室的柱身上雕工繁复：飞升的天使与追随其后、虔敬升天的灵魂，一路向天而去。毫无疑问，这意在唤起你的敬畏——可当你的目光落在石台上那一具具蒙着白布的尸体时，这份敬畏却难以维系。每具尸体都露出一只变色的脚，一枚铜铃系在脚趾上。
The elaborate stonework on the pillars of this vault depicts ascendant angels and the pious souls that follow them heavenward. No doubt it’s meant to give you a sense of reverence, but you find it hard to sustain when you look at the sheet-covered bodies on slabs. Each has a discolored foot sticking out—a copper bell tied to a toe.

I Drink My Potion Of Force Resistance.name:
我喝下我的强韧抗力药剂
I Drink My Potion Of Force Resistance

Text.text:
穿堂风渐渐平息，一阵回响般的震颤沿着我的四肢窜过。仿佛骨骼化作钢铁，皮肤凝成岩石。我依旧能如先前那般自如行动，但有一个词自胸腔深处轰然共鸣：不可撼动。
As the draught settles, a reverberation jitters through my limbs. It feels as if my bones turn to steel and my skin to stone. I can still move as freely as before, but one word resonates from my core: immoveable.

A Grand Magical Darkness.name:
宏大的魔法黑暗
A Grand Magical Darkness

Text.text:
这道法术耗费了数十年才得以编织——其言语成分是早已死去、亵渎古舌的残碎音节；其姿势成分则是数百条凡人性命。施法者彼此在数十里外遥相配合，立于奥术地脉交汇之处，将现实本身扭向他们的意志——一场横贯世界、强大到难以言说的仪式。此位面上的每一个存在——从最卑微的螨虫到最强盛的帝王——都能感到这咒文彻底的悖谬，亲历世界自然法则的偏移，仿佛现实被重新改写。高悬的太阳先是黯淡，继而倏然熄灭。黑暗降临世间，深沉而绝对，唯有遥远而朦胧的群星微光，在天穹上颤动着照明。

~ Envisioned by Potion802

The spell took decades to weave—the verbal components are fragments of a long-dead and profane tongue, the somatic components hundreds of mortal lives. The casters coordinate with one another over many leagues, standing at the intersections of arcane ley lines to bend reality itself to their will, a world-spanning ritual of untold power. Every being on this plane of existence—from the lowliest mite to the mightiest emperor—feels the utter wrongness of the incantation, experiences the shift in the natural laws of the world as reality is rewritten. The sun high above dims, then winks out. Darkness falls upon the world, deep and absolute, with only the flickering of distant and obscured stars to light the sky.

~ Envisioned by Potion802

这道法术简单却百搭——也是你最早学会的几门之一。只需些微手势，你便能拨动光与声。你的嗓音轰然放大，烛火轻颤，或窗板砰地一声猛然合上。有人把这类魔法叫作客厅把戏。但对你而言，这正是你一切魔法赖以搭建的根基。
The spell is simple but versatile—one of the first you were taught. With subtle gestures, you can affect light and sound. Your voice booms, a candle flickers, or a window shutter slams shut. Parlor tricks, some would call this kind of magic. But to you, this is the foundation upon which all your magic is built.

这根棍棒的握柄由无瑕的红木精心打磨雕琢而成，触感温润如抚。柄身箍着一道道银白金属环，其间刻满细若游丝的符文，几乎难以辨认。你端详棍头时，发现其中心被掏空后重新灌注——是一种极其坚硬沉重的陶瓷，或许是某种树脂，凝固成了坚不可摧的琥珀。
Lovingly polished and cut from flawless mahogany, the haft of this club has been ringed in bands of silvery metal and engraved with runes so small you can scarcely make them out. Examining the head of the club, you see that the center has been cored and filled in with an incredibly hard and heavy ceramic, or possibly some sort of resin that has hardened into impenetrable amber.

Hearty Tavern Breakfast.name:
丰盛的酒馆早餐
Hearty Tavern Breakfast

Text.text:
你面前的盘子堆满了足以塞饱食人魔肚皮的食物！厚切培根一条条铺开——边缘煎得恰到好处、酥脆诱人——与一汪热气腾腾的焗豆中那几枚黄得像正午太阳的鸡蛋挤作一团。门挡般硕大的薯饼昂然端坐在旁，几根圆滚滚的香肠紧随其侧，你不由得口舌生津。
The plate before you is laden with enough food to fill an ogre’s belly! Rashers of thick bacon—perfectly crisped at the edges—rub shoulders with eggs yellow as the midday sun amid a pool of steaming baked beans. Hashbrowns as big as doorstoppers sit proudly alongside several rotund sausages, and you find your mouth watering.

Lament About Strange Dreams.name:
关于怪异梦境的哀叹
Lament About Strange Dreams

Text.text:
“这世界里有什么邪祟正在骚动——我在梦里就能感觉到。那些梦纷乱而压抑：影影绰绰的人形逼我把他们当朋友，旧情人刻薄无礼，鱼在陆地上行走，长着我母亲脸孔的怪熊，肮脏又满怀评判的房子！是的，邪恶正在逼近。”
“Something evil is stirring in this world—I can feel it in my dreams. They are troubled and fraught, shadowy figures demanding I treat them as friends, ex-lovers being rude, fish walking on land, strange bear creatures with the face of my mother, houses that are dirty and judgmental! Yes, evil is coming.”

Beached Dead Whale.name:
搁浅的死鲸
Beached Dead Whale

Text.text:
这头肿胀的生物蓝皮松垂，鳍肢无助地朝空中摊开，本该令人哀恸——前提是你能靠得足够近，真正看清它。它的恶臭像酸败的粪堆，刺得人发疼，余味久滞喉间。鲸口大张，布满利齿的下颌被渔网缠死。它的双眼翻进眼眶深处，皱褶成团的白色皮膜托着胶冻般的角膜。即便如此，这具倒霉而腐烂的生物仍引来本地贪食的食腐者。喧闹的海鸥在上空盘旋，而离岸不远处，一道鲨鳍弧线破开翻搅的水面。
The bloated creature, its blue skin sagging and its fins splayed helplessly in the air, is a sorrowful sight—if you can get close enough to truly examine it. Its stench is like a sour midden that stings and lingers in the throat. The whale’s mouth hangs open, its toothy lower jaw tangled in fishers’ nets. Its eyes have rolled back in its head, bunched sheets of white skin cradling jellied corneas. Still, the ill-fated, putrid creature draws local, edacious scavengers. Raucous gulls circle above, and just offshore, the arc of a shark’s fin breaks the surface of the churning waters.

一根傲然挺立的四尺长柄，连接着一颗沉重金属铸成的骇人锤头——与其说是沉锤，不如说是一方小砧。致密的山核桃木柄被层层叠叠的皮革紧紧缠绕，确保这柄怪物般的钝器挥舞起来时，握持依旧稳如磐石。
A proud four-foot pole leads to a devastatingly formed head of hefty metal—more a small anvil than a heavy hammer. The dense hickory wood handle is bound tightly by overlapping leather to provide a sure grip when the monstrous bludgeon is swung.

Edge Of An Evergreen Forest In Winter.name:
冬日常青林的边缘
Edge Of An Evergreen Forest In Winter

Text.text:
你站在常青林地的边缘，树木仍被冬日牢牢攥住。每一棵树都披上了一袭雪白的披肩，每一根枝条都套着冰冷的袖套。森林在寂静的坚韧中散发着不屈的耐性，拒绝随季节凋亡——而是在冰封的毯幕之下，依旧生生不息。
You find yourself at the edge of an evergreen woodland, trees held fast in winter’s grip. Each tree has donned a shawl of snow, each branch bears a frigid sleeve. In silent resilience, the forest exudes endurance, refusing seasonal death—instead living on, beneath its icy blanket.

越过拱起的树根、踏入一株远古橡树的树干之下，一座清凉而宽敞的大厅豁然敞开。银色光球在枝叶间起舞，叮当作响、嗡鸣低吟，织出柔和的乐声。木质藤蔓在穹顶间交错编织成一座座枝棚，其间鸣禽啁啾振翅。红顶蘑菇从泥土地面生长而出，长成桌椅与凳子，客人就坐其上。他们在刀叉与碗碟碰撞的喧响里交谈、欢笑、吃喝。细小身影乘着蝴蝶翅膀在桌与桌之间掠过，叽叽喳喳地与客人说笑，并为他们送上餐点。

~ 由一位英雄构想
