Beyond arched roots and under the trunk of an ancient oak, there opens a cool and spacious hall. Balls of silvery light dance among the branches, chiming and humming to create soft music. Woody vines weave into bowers across the ceiling, with songbirds chirping and fluttering in them. Red-topped mushrooms grow from the earthen floor, forming tables and stools that patrons sit on. They talk, laugh, eat, and drink over the din of clinking cutlery and dishes. Tiny figures flit from table to table on butterfly wings, chatting with and serving the customers.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

沉重的拐杖缺口斑驳、饱经摧残，满身尽是战斗留下的伤痕——密实木料上的每一道凹痕都在诉说一段独有的故事。厚实的皮革绑带将一面宽阔、略有凹陷的风筝盾牢牢固定在一侧，使拐杖使用者在保有战术机动的同时，也能自卫防护。

~ 构想：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The heavy crutch is chipped and battered, covered in the scars of battle—each nick in the dense wood telling a story all its own. Thick leather straps secure a broad, slightly dented kite shield to one side, allowing the crutch user to defend themselves while retaining tactical mobility.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Large Royal Feast.name:
盛大王室盛宴
Large Royal Feast

Text.text:
长桌可坐二十四人，高背椅上堆着猩红坐垫。房间尽头壁炉里烈火轰鸣，摇曳火光沿着桌面一路铺开，又被火把、吊灯与烛台的光芒托起。银盘上的佳肴热气袅袅，香气是令人沉醉的香料混合。红烧肉食、炙烤蔬菜、堆成小山的面包裹着黄油的光泽，以及近乎取之不尽的美酒，构成一场贵族才配享用的盛宴。
The table seats two dozen, its high-backed chairs piled with scarlet cushions. A roaring fire in the hearth at the far end of the room sheds its wavering light along the length of the table, bolstered by torches, chandeliers, and candelabras. Steam rises from silver platters of food, the smell an intoxicating blend of spices. Braised meats, roasted vegetables, piles of bread shining with butter, and a near-infinite supply of wine make up a feast fit for a noble.

修道院如尖峰般自大地拔起，高耸的立柱托举着整座建筑，既显纤巧又显坚实。彩绘玻璃窗——每一扇都描绘着牺牲或报应的场景——沿着外墙一字排开。镶着铁箍的巨大橡木门向内开启，通往一条漫长的大厅；两侧陈列着雕像与挂毯，尽头是内院，院中点缀喷泉、花园与修剪得一丝不苟的树篱。回廊立在庭院之后，更深处则是一座图书馆。
The abbey rises like a pinnacle from the earth, its soaring pillars supporting a structure that appears simultaneously delicate and sturdy. Stained glass windows—each depicting a scene of sacrifice or retribution—line the exterior walls. Massive oaken doors banded with iron open inward to a long hall lined with statuary and tapestries that leads to an interior courtyard adorned with fountains, gardens, and meticulously maintained hedges. The cloisters stand beyond this courtyard, and a library beyond those.

Shortsword Of Life Stealing.name:
噬命短剑
Shortsword Of Life Stealing

Text.text:
这把剑的长度与男子前臂相仿，剑尖处分裂为两道针般锐利的尖端。两尖之间留出一道细小的空隙，向下延伸成一道棱角分明的导槽，自剑身中央凿刻而出，随时准备收纳从受害者身上夺来的丰沛生命能量。
The sword runs the length of a man’s forearm, splitting at the tip into two needle-sharp points. A small gap trails down into an angular conduit carved out of the center of the blade, ready to store a plentiful bounty of life energy stolen from its victims.

Asteroid Miner On Planet Leave.name:
行星停泊：小行星矿工
Asteroid Miner On Planet Leave

Text.text:
那名外星女子穿着一件凌乱的夹克，背后印着一家星界采矿公司的标志。海滩上的所有人都在享受闲暇时光，而她身上却有一种与众不同的宁静，使她从人群中脱颖而出。她闭着眼，沉浸在幸福的冥想里；这位休班的矿工细细品味带着盐味的海风拂过肌肤的触感，怀着感激的微笑深吸一口海洋的气息。
The alien woman wears a disheveled jacket with the logo of an astral mining firm printed across the back. While everyone on the beach is enjoying their free time, there is a serenity to this person that marks her out from the crowd. With eyes closed in blissful meditation, the off-duty miner relishes the feeling of the salt-laced breeze on her skin, breathing in the ocean air with a grateful smile.

I Have Sorcerous Restoration.name:
我拥有巫术复原
I Have Sorcerous Restoration

Text.text:
我结束了休息，身心灵皆焕然一新。随着我整装待发，一股奥术能量骤然涌入灵魂，回流并复原了我一部分魔力潜能。如今，我又有了全新的燃料去塑造我的法术。
I finish resting, rejuvenating my body, mind, and spirit. A burst of arcane energy swirls into my soul as I prepare to go on—restoring a portion my magical potential. I now have fresh fuel to shape my spells.

你眨了眨眼想让视线清明些，可这一动作只带来刺痛，仿佛眼皮内侧糊满了砂砾。眼前的世界摇晃漂浮。你把握紧的拳头抵在一只紧闭的眼上，盼着能缓解些……拳头挪开时，已沾满鲜血。
You blink to clear your vision but the action only causes pain, as if the insides of your eyelids are coated with sand. The world swims before you. You press a balled fist against one closed eye, hoping for some relief… It comes away bloody.

City Resting Atop A Dwarven Undercity.name:
矮人地下城之上的休息之都
City Resting Atop A Dwarven Undercity

Text.text:
这座城市呈现出一种古怪却讨人喜欢的文化碰撞——地上之城的风貌，与其下方矮人聚落的气息相互交错。城镇在一根根高耸入云的石柱间拔地而起，借助这些巨柱支撑起塔楼与居所。桥梁也横跨其间，人群在上方与下方穿梭奔忙。少数矮人混在熙攘的人潮里，你也会偶尔瞥见一些怪异的入口，通向深处由矮人凿筑的隧道网络。
The city displays an odd yet endearing clash of cultures—that of the city and that of the dwarven settlement beneath it. The city rises amid soaring stone columns, using the structures to support their towers and dwellings. Bridges span these columns too, and people bustle above and below. A handful of dwarves mingle with the crowds, and you occasionally spy strange ingresses leading down into the depths of the dwarf-made tunnels.

乍看之下，这把武器不过是同类中做工精良的范例；但细细端详便会发现，它在末端加配了配重，使其在一记精准重击之后能带出更为凶狠的冲击。武器的发力端还密布细小倒刺，迫使伤口更快渗血，并提高对敌人造成创伤性组织伤害的几率。
Though at first glance this weapon simply resembles a well-made example of its kind, close examination reveals that it has been weighted at the end to promote a stronger impact in the wake of a telling blow. Minute barbs also line the weapon at its business end, encouraging faster bleeding and increasing the chance of traumatic tissue damage on a foe.

那人形身影高耸如楼，皮肤呈暴雨将至的天色般灰蓝，发丝洁白似完美春日里漂浮的云。他们的眼眸闪烁着狡黠而好奇的光。身上既无护甲，也不持兵刃——只披一袭细致的丝绸长衣，银边镶饰，随风流淌。
The humanoid stands several stories tall, with skin the gray-blue of the sky before a heavy rainfall, and hair the white of clouds on a perfect spring day. Their eyes glimmer with a cunning curiosity. They wear no armor, carry no weapons–instead, they drape themselves in a fine silk, trimmed with silver, which flows with the wind.

你眼睁睁看着，站在你面前的人类溶解成一滩浆质般的黏液。变形的恐怖与随后浮现的新形态相比，简直不值一提：那是鱼与恶魔的不可名状的混合体。它身形修长蜿蜒，如鳗一般，灰色的硬鳞覆满全身，厚得像煮熟的皮革。自尾尖起一路到那张大张的、塞满尖刺獠牙的巨口，鳍片沿身竖起。六只猩红的眼睛，像鱼卵般细小发亮，以非人的智慧死死盯着你。每只眼旁都伸出一条触手：四条末端是发光的球囊，随着邪恶的魔法一下一下脉动；而两侧各有一条触手向前探出，末端竟长着带爪的手。
As you watch, the human standing before you dissolves into a plasmatic puddle. The horror of the transformation is nothing compared to the new shape that emerges: an unspeakable amalgam of fish and fiend. Long and sinuous, the eel-like body is draped in gray ganoid scales as thick as boiled leather. Fins protrude from the tip of its tail all the way up to the gaping maw overstuffed with spiny teeth. Six crimson eyes, beady as roe, stare at you with inhuman intelligence. Beside each eye, a tentacle extends. Four end in glowing bulbs that pulse with fell magic, but one tentacle on either side reaches forward with clawed hands.

Adult Bronze Dragon.name:
成年青铜龙
Adult Bronze Dragon

Text.text:
这头巨大的龙形生物尾巴懒洋洋地左右甩动，带着好奇却又谨慎地打量着你。阳光一照，它青金般的青铜鳞片泛起金绿交织的耀眼光辉。这头高耸的生物行动间有种诡异而迷人的优雅，始终与人保持距离，以锐利而克制的目光审视着你。当你终于真正意识到它的体型时，只剩下震撼与敬畏。
The tail of this massive draconic creature whips lazily back and forth as it eyes you, inquisitive but careful. The sun catches the gold-green of its bronze scales brilliantly. The towering creature moves with a strange and alluring grace, keeping its distance as it eyes you with a keen and measured gaze. As you fully reckon its size, you're left awed.

荨麻丛在风中沙沙作响，像是在嘶声警告你别靠近，整片植物仿佛都披上了阴森的性相。起皱的绿叶边缘锯齿森然，从齐腰高的茎上簇簇生出；只要一碰，便会留下钻心般的灼痛印记——这是大自然用来宣告禁止入内的方式。 Hissing a warning to stay back as they rustle in the wind, the clump of nettles seems to take on a menacing aspect. Wrinkled green leaves with a serrated edge sprout from waist-high stems and leave a devilishly painful mark if touched—Mother Nature’s way of saying Keep Out.

远离祖先的森林而居，精灵们在营建屋舍时尽取此地的丰饶——以石灰、细沙与清水调制灰泥，抹上墙面后再洗成一片素白；即便最寻常的屋子，也饰有精美雕刻的湿壁画，描绘着他们族史中那些家喻户晓的场景。精灵看待外来者时目光里满是戒备，甚至不加掩饰的敌意——在这片稀疏的聚落里，人人都认得彼此，哪怕按人类的尺度，这里也算得上不小。你踏过铺着卵石的街道时，孩子们被大人拉着躲开，远远避让。
Living far from the forest of their ancestors, the elves have used the bounty of the land in the construction of their buildings—employing a stucco of lime, sand, and water, which is then washed white—even the least of them featuring beautifully carved frescoes depicting famous scenes from their people's history. The elves view outsiders with looks of suspicion, if not outright hostility—in this sparse community everyone knows everyone else, even if the settlement is large by human standards. Children are shied away from you as you walk through the cobbled streets.

Cloak Of Elvenkind.name:
精灵披风
Cloak Of Elvenkind

Text.text:
奢华而如丝般柔滑的布料从你指间滑过，其上缀满繁复精巧的纹样，柔软顺滑的褶皱宛如羽毛般轻轻铺展。尽管触感细腻，这布料却不反射一丝光亮；若非近距离细看那令人屏息的图案，它几乎低调得难以察觉。它被裁制成一件宽松的兜帽斗篷，垂落至穿戴者的下背。
The luxurious, silky cloth adorned with intricate designs and soft, sleek, feather-like folds flows through your hands. Despite the fine cloth's texture, it does not reflect any light and seems remarkably unnoticeable without close inspection of its breathtaking design. It is fashioned into a loose, hooded cloak that hangs to one's lower back.

低矮的天花板压在赌桌上方，玩家们围坐其间，紧绷而专注地盯着各自的牌局与一摞摞钱币。除了骰子叮当碰撞、纸牌摩擦作响，以及输家压着嗓子吐出轻微的咒骂与叹息外，四下寂静无声。一缕带着淡淡玫瑰气息的烟雾在你头顶飘荡，慵懒地拖出粉色的尾痕。几把椅子空着，像是在招呼新来者落座。
The ceiling looms low over the tables of players, seated in tense concentration around their games and stacks of coin. It is quiet aside from dice clattering, cards scuffing, and losers sighing out soft curses. A smoke that smells faintly of roses floats above your head in lazy, pink trails. A few chairs are empty, beckoning newcomers to take a seat.

在你隐秘的藏身处里，你的手指带着阴狠的意图在键盘上飞舞，试图突破系统。忽然，刺痛的回馈啃噬着你的连接。入侵反制措施从伏击点骤然爆发，以冷静而精准的力量反击，将你轻而易举地驱逐出去——那股彻骨的轻松让你头痛欲裂。

~ 一位英雄的构想

In the seclusion of your hideout, your fingers leap across the board with sinister intent, attempting to breach the system. Suddenly, painful feedback munches your connection. Intrusion countermeasures burst from an ambush point, striking back at you with clinical force and expelling you with a chilling ease that leaves your head throbbing.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Curious Ghost.name:
好奇的幽灵（特征）
Curious Ghost

Text.text:
第一次，你不敢确定自己看见了什么。第二次，你以为或许只是路过的老鼠。但这一次绝无可能看错——一颗谢顶的头顶刚刚没入地面，像有人在水里游泳般缓缓沉下。那稀疏的几缕头发是灰的，你瞥见朝你望来的一双眼睛也是灰的——事实上，你看到的整颗头都是灰色，微微半透明，仿佛由雾气或烟尘凝成。
The first time, you weren’t certain you saw anything. The second, you thought perhaps a passing rat. But this time there can be no mistake. The top of a balding head just disappeared into the ground, submerging like someone swimming in water. What little hair was there was gray, the eyes you glimpsed looking your way were gray—in fact, all you saw of the head was gray and slightly transparent, as if it were made of fog or smoke.

Slimy Hate Group Organizer.name:
黏腻的仇恨团体煽动者
Slimy Hate Group Organizer

Text.text: 一个不祥的身影穿着一套过分笔挺的西装，却仍因他糟糕的站姿而显得松垮别扭。油亮的头发从隆起的头皮上向后退去，露出饱满的头顶。他一边把左手小指上的金质印戒拧来拧去，一边压低声音对着通讯植入体低语。西装翻领上别着一枚蓝色徽针——其上以工整的金色字母写着 传统价值保护中心。 An ominous figure is dressed in a too-perfect suit that still manages to hang off his body awkwardly thanks to his terrible posture. An oily slick of hair recedes from a bulbous scalp. He twists a gold signet ring on his left pinkie finger as he whispers into a comm implant. On his lapel is a blue pin—upon it, neat gold lettering spells out The Center for Protection of Traditional Values.

Chest Of The Rat King.name:
鼠王之匣
Chest Of The Rat King

Text.text:
箱盖吱呀一声掀开，腐臭的恶气迎面扑来，露出那骇人的内容物：一团尖叫的污秽老鼠堆——尾巴被绞缠成一团——它们疯狂撕咬抓挠彼此，只为从这牢笼里挣脱。你眼睁睁看着，有些——也许嗅到了自由——竟咬断自己的尾巴来脱身，暗色的血喷溅到同伴身上，瞬间把它们逼入残暴的狂乱。它们彼此扑杀，在嗜食同类的癫狂中撕成一片。
The fetid reek hits you as the lid of the chest creaks open, revealing the hideous contents: a shrieking pile of filthy rats—their tails mangled together—bite and claw at each other in a desperate bid to escape their prison. As you watch, some--sensing freedom perhaps--bite through their own tails to free themselves, causing dark blood to spray onto the others, which drives them into a savage frenzy. They fall upon each other in cannibalistic fervor.

Banter About Vacations.name:
关于度假的闲聊
Banter About Vacations

Text.text:
“我有个问题。我们能不能去度个假？我感觉我们一直在拖着疲惫的身子，从一场灾难爬到下一场灾难，总该有别的高贵蠢货愿意替我们扛一阵子吧。”
“I have a question. Could we take a vacation? I feel like we’ve been dragging ourselves from one catastrophe to the next, and there must be some other noble idiots out there willing to take the load for awhile.”

I Use Fast Hands: Open Lock.name:
我用「快手」：开锁
I Use Fast Hands: Open Lock

Text.text:
我手腕一抖，工具便已入手，探进锁孔。这里轻轻施压，那边微微一拧，再在这儿多加一点力。咔哒一声，又咔哒一声——不知不觉间，这把锁就要开了！
With a flick of my wrists, I have my tools in hand and in the lock. A bit of pressure here, a little twist there, a tad more pressure here. A click, and another, and—before you know it—this lock will open!

门上方一只小铃铛叮当作响，宣告你踏入店内，可那位侏儒女店主却对你视若无睹，只透过玻璃柜台凝望那些打磨得锃亮的宝石与首饰——它们映亮了她的面庞。馥郁香气萦绕的店里，数个陈列柜在各处闪闪发光，在一排排悬挂着优雅而昂贵的衣装长架间流光掠影。一位年迈的精灵顾客无声地打量你的穿着，随即又转回去端详一具衣着时髦的人形模特。

~ 撰写 by Bob World Builder

A tiny bell above the door announces your entry, but the gnomish proprietor ignores you and stares through her glass counter at the polished gems and jewelry, which light up her face. Several display cases shine throughout the perfumed shop, glinting amid long racks bearing elegant, expensive-looking outfits. An elderly elven customer silently appraises your attire before turning back to a fashionably-dressed mannequin.

~ Written by Bob World Builder

I Cast Visions Of Distant Realms.name:
我施放《遥远界域的幻景》
I Cast Visions Of Distant Realms

Text.text:
我用指尖掐住额头，正好在鼻梁上方。口中吟诵远视的咒词，我从眉心牵出一枚幽光的灵体球体，末端拖着尾巴般的渐细。随即我将这只魅影之眼从掌中轻轻吹向空中，它悬停片刻，旋即淡去，化作无形。它已准备好作为我会飞的、不可见的感知之眼。
I pinch my forehead, just above the bridge of my nose. Chanting words of far-seeing, I pull a spectral sphere with a taillike taper from my brow. I blow the phantom eye from my grasp and into the air, where it hovers for a moment. It then fades to invisibility. It’s ready to act as my flying, unseen sensor.

I Cast Blindsight.name:
我施放盲视
I Cast Blindsight

Text.text:
我的手沿着法杖粗粝的木身缓缓滑过，指腹掠过每一个熟悉的结疤，一路摸向杖顶托起的水晶。指尖轻触那冰凉而光滑的表面，我开始吟诵晦奥的秘言——它将揭示我周遭的世界，唤起体内潜藏的魔法。法术生效时，我的双眼刺痛得难受；但片刻之后，这股异样便消退了。当我再次睁开眼，四周的一切都变得清晰可辨：近处世界的每一种性相，都被魔法能量锐利地勾勒出来。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

I run my hand along the coarse wood of my staff, feeling every familiar knot as I make my way toward the crystal cradled at its peak. My fingers brush its cool, smooth surface, and I begin to chant the arcane words that will reveal the world around me, summoning the magic within. My eyes tingle uncomfortably as the spell takes hold, but after a few moments, the feeling passes. When I open them again, my surroundings are clear to me, with every aspect of the nearby world outlined crisply in magical energy.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

你怒目而视，发出低吼，厉声斥责你的敌人。你的话语唤醒了内心深处那原始的求生本能，仿佛迫在眉睫的死亡威胁般阴影压顶。一颗恐惧的种子在你的对手心中扎根。
With a glare, you snarl, rebuking your foe. Your words call to the primal desire for survival deep within, looming like the threat of imminent death. A seed of terror takes root in your adversary.

幽魂般的狼形转身正对着你，猩红而凶戾的眼眸燃着仇恨的光。阴影在它庞大的躯壳周围扭动蜿蜒，它咧开参差的獠牙，齿间滴落着死灵能量。一声原始、刺骨的嚎叫撕裂夜幕，它随即纵身扑向你。
The spectral lupine form turns to face you, its red, baleful eyes glowing with hatred. Shadows writhe and slither around its immense frame as it bares jagged fangs dripping with necrotic energy. A primal, bone-chilling howl tears through the night as it leaps toward you.

一根参差尖利的冰刺在光下闪烁。那座微小、棱面繁复、布满裂纹的“冰山”忽然张开，其中一面剥落滑下，霜壳从边缘层层剥离——你这才看清，那竟是一只类人生物正舒展双翼：一整个由寒冰凝成的躯体。空洞的眼窝越过冰锥般的鼻梁窥视着你，残酷的五官因构成它们的冰与霜而显得更加冷厉。
A jagged spike of ice glitters in the light. The tiny, multifaceted mountain, filled with cracks, opens, one facet sloughing off, and frost unpeeling from around what you now realize is a humanoid creature unfurling its wings—a whole being composed of ice. Its hollow eyes peer over an icicle nose, cruel features made even more so by the ice and frost that composes them.

走廊呈现出一种古怪的结构：从周遭岩壁中凿出的高耸阶台层层拔起，一阶高过一阶。两侧几乎垂直，难以攀爬，而十来级巨大的阶台一路向上，通往这座建筑群的新区域。当你费力攀上这些岩阶时，猛然意识到——台阶。这些是台阶！巨人尺寸的台阶。
The corridor takes on an odd structure, with soaring tiers hewn from the surrounding stone, each higher than the next. The sides are sheer and difficult to scale, and the dozen-or-so tiers lead upward into a new area of the complex. As you struggle to scale these formations, a realization strikes you: stairs. These are stairs! Giant-sized stairs.

你朗声吟诵唤起风暴的咒词，嗓音如远雷滚滚。头顶天幕为你开裂，乌云在你的驱使下翻涌旋转。你闻到臭氧与雨水的气息，浑身每一根汗毛都倒竖起来。能量在你的牙缝间跳动，在你的眼眶里灼烧，在耳中轰鸣咆哮。随后，你以暴风的狂怒将其倾泻而出——在你所指之处，蓝白相间的闪电如叉戟般劈落。空气被噼啪作响的电光充满，碎屑与尘云翻卷四起，雷霆一次又一次地落下。
Your voice booms like distant thunder as you speak aloud the words to evoke the storm. Above, the sky opens, dark clouds swirling at your behest. You smell ozone and rain, and every hair on your body stands on end. You feel the energy in your teeth, in your eyes, roaring in your ears. Then, with the fury of the tempest, you unleash it, and where you command, forks of blue-white lightning strike. The air fills with crackling energy and clouds of debris as the lightning strikes again and again.

Small Dwarf Hall.name:
矮人小厅
Small Dwarf Hall

Text.text:
这间天花板低矮而温暖的屋子，却因地面繁复精巧的铺砖与穹顶、墙壁上细腻的石雕而显得格外宏伟。纹样几何而抽象，却又浑然和谐。你仿佛能从其中辨出野兽或人形的描绘，但那感觉就像在云朵里寻觅轮廓一般飘忽不定。
This cozy, low-ceilinged room feels grand due to the intricate tiling on the floor and the delicate stonework of the ceiling and walls. The patterns are geometric and abstract but harmonious. You think you can see beasts or figures depicted in them, but it’s like picking shapes out of clouds.

Cyberpunk Fantasy Metropolis: Wealthy 'A.name:
赛博朋克奇幻巨都：富豪“A”区
Cyberpunk Fantasy Metropolis: Wealthy 'A' Neighborhood

Text.text:
灯火璀璨，这片富丽的高层楼群是城中富人趋之若鹜的理想居所。奢华公寓、尖端安保系统与琳琅满目的专属享受一应俱全，使这里成为逃离这座大都会粗粝现实的一方避风港。
Glittering with lights, this wealthy series of high-rise blocks is a sought-after enclave for the city's affluent residents. With opulent apartments, high-tech security systems, and a plethora of exclusive luxuries, this location offers a respite from the gritty reality of the metropolis.

World-famous Gaming Streamer.name:
世界知名的游戏主播
World-famous Gaming Streamer

Text.text:
男孩那一头蓝发亮得仿佛舞台四周的霓虹广告牌，违逆重力般从头顶翻涌而起，精心打理得与他流线型的黑色耳机严丝合缝。踏上舞台，掌声如潮般炸裂，他在爆燃的烟火特效中走向游戏设备。是时候把观众想要的奉上了。
Blue hair as bright as the neon billboards around the stage rises in a gravity-defying wave from the boy’s head, styled to fit perfectly around his sleek black headset. Stepping on stage to rapturous applause, he makes his way to the gaming rig amid explosive pyrotechnics. It’s time to give the people what they came for.

Robbery By A Band Of Ruffians.name:
一伙恶棍的抢劫
Robbery By A Band Of Ruffians

Text.text:
“你们看起来累得够呛。八成是背着那些沉甸甸的包袱吧？不如让我和我的伙计们替你们减减重？”
“You all look awful tired. Maybe it’s those heavy bags you’re carrying. How about me and my friends lighten the load a little?”

这是一头近二十英尺长的完美杀手，对血腥气息敏感到近乎癫狂。它盘踞的深海领地幽暗无光——靠近礁石或海底时务必小心。只要一道伤口，就足以把你拖向死亡。
A perfect killer nearly twenty feet long, hypersensitive to blood, this shark’s deep water territory is dark. Take care near a reef or the ocean floor. One cut could lead to your demise.

Loot From A Vampire's Thrall.name:
来自吸血鬼（特征）奴仆的战利品
Loot From A Vampire's Thrall

Text.text:
你把那名目光狂乱的流浪汉尸体翻过来，开始搜查。这个遍体疤痕、瘦骨嶙峋的奴仆身上几乎没有值钱东西，但你在他污渍斑斑的亚麻色长袍里摸到了一只藏好的钱币袋——共计2枚金币。
You turn the body of the wild-eyed vagrant over and begin to search the corpse. The scarred, emaciated thrall has little of value on their person, but you do find a pouch of coins—hidden in their stained, flaxen robes—totaling 2 gold pieces.

Copper Buckle For A Narrow Belt.name:
窄腰带用铜扣
Copper Buckle For A Narrow Belt

Text.text:
它优雅地回旋，宛如极乐世界里植物的藤蔓；那枚扣饰几乎在为旁观者献上一场表演。其色泽与纹样带着一抹秋意，正适合秋日庆典或盛大舞会。
Gracefully turning like the vines of a plant in Elysium, the buckle nearly performs for those who look on. It has a hint of autumn to its color and design, good for fall festivals or galas.

在你眼前那片嶙峋的荒原上，一座诺斯村落紧紧依偎，仿佛一群橡木巨魔蜷缩成团。茅草覆顶的长屋如勇士的心般坚韧，挺立其间，风霜斑驳。木梁支起的屋舍爬满盘结的雕纹，把氏族旧日的传说一针一线织入木纹。灰白的炊烟自欢快的炉火升起，像血脉般汩汩渗出村庄的暖意。
Clinging to the rugged landscape before you, a Norse village huddles like a cluster of oaken trolls. Thatched-roof longhouses, sturdy as a champion’s heart, stand tall and weathered. The timber-framed homes, crawling with knotted carvings, weave myths of clannish past. Gray smoke rises from cheerful hearths, bleeding the warmth of the village’s veins.

Orbital Laser Destroys Landmark.name:
轨道激光摧毁地标
Orbital Laser Destroys Landmark

Text.text:
高空天际一抹红芒闪烁，那是唯一的警兆。下一瞬，炽烈光爆与震耳轰鸣中，一道猩红的死亡光柱凭空降下。激光渐渐消散，曾经矗立的宏伟雕像已不复存在，只剩一圈焦黑的灰烬。余热的浪潮仍在空气中徘徊，提醒着人们：天空之上，仍悬着那件大规模毁灭武器。
A glint of red in the sky high above is the only warning before a column of crimson death appears from nowhere in a blast of burning light and deafening noise. The laser fades, and where once stood an impressive statue, only a blackened circle of ash remains. A wave of heat lingers as a reminder of the weapon of mass destruction hanging in the sky above.

Inventor Quip About Technology.name:
发明家对科技的俏皮话
Inventor Quip About Technology

Text.text:
“你们这些人张口闭口就是魔法-魔法-魔法。不错，魔法确实能办成些了不起的事；可寻常老百姓有几个拿得到地精的膀胱、龙的鼻子，或你们用的那些鬼东西的许可？犁的发明带来的好处，比你们那帮小小秘会所能鼓捣出的最强咒语还多。”
“It’s always magic-magic-magic with you people. Sure, magic can do wonderful things; but how many of the common folk have access to goblin bladders, or dragon noses, or whatever it is you use? The invention of the plow has done more good than the most powerful spells your little covens can conjure.”

Desecrated Cavern Grove.name:
亵渎的洞窟幽林
Desecrated Cavern Grove

Text.text:
层层被微风吹拂的蛛网如薄幕般垂挂，遮暗了自这座穹顶洞窟顶端裂隙倾泻而下的日光。溪流穿过空谷，在昏翳里潺潺低语，水面粼粼闪动。水汽把湿岩与雨后的气息，揉进草药、焦油与腐朽的腥味之中；阴影在刻纹的立石间游移，也在病态、焦黑的树木、灌丛与杂草间跳舞。一株巨大的橡树高耸于群木之上；与周遭同样，它的树皮创口渗出沥青般的树脂。毒性的细流顺着树脂淌下，汇到橡根间托着的一座雕刻石座上；在那里，树脂偶尔泛起紫色的幽光，嘶嘶作响，噼啪爆裂，令人不寒而栗。

~ Envisioned by RoguishONE

Sheets of breeze-blown webbing dim the sunlight coming through the shafts at the top of this domed cavern. A stream runs through the hollow, babbling and shimmering in the gloom. The water adds the scent of wet rock and rain to the odors of herbs, tar, and rot, and shadows dance over carved menhirs and amid sickly, blackened trees, shrubs, and undergrowth. A large oak towers over the other trees; as with them, pitch-colored resin oozes from lesions in the great oak’s bark. Rivulets of this poison run onto a carved stone plinth held amid the oak’s roots, and there, the resin occasionally flares with purple luminance. It hisses and pops ominously.

~ Envisioned by RoguishONE

大多数战士连这柄巨槌顶端压阵的巨石都举不起来，更别提在战斗中将其挥舞自如。锤头是一整块覆着粉白石灰尘的岩石板，粗粝原始、棱角残缺；一根朴素的木柄被硬生生楔入石中，再以铆接的铁箍牢牢箍紧固定。
Most warriors could not lift the stone which caps this mighty maul, let alone wield it effectively in battle. A slab of chalk-dusted rock, ragged and primal, serves as the hammer’s head, and a basic wooden haft has been driven into the stone, secured by riveted iron bands.

Paladin's Werewolf Transformation.name:
圣武士的狼人变身
Paladin's Werewolf Transformation

Text.text:
圣武士踉跄着猛然停住，战斧与盾牌哐啷一声坠落在地。他们四肢着地，护甲下毛发疯狂滋生，材质在躯体变形中咔嚓开裂、碎屑迸飞。背后猛地抽出一条蓬松的尾巴，四肢扭曲鼓胀，肌肉暴起；面孔拉长成吻部，森然獠牙层层交错。他们回头瞥向队伍的一瞬，狼眸中还闪过旧日自我的一丝残影，随即体内的怪物彻底夺取了控制。

~ 构想：William Lightbane

The paladin lurches to a halt, and their axe and shield clatter to the ground. They fall to all fours as fur sprouts under their armor, the material cracking and splintering as the paladin's body begins to shift and transform. A bushy tail sprouts from the back, limbs contort and swell with muscles, and their face elongates into a snout full of wicked teeth. They glance back to the party in time for a flash of their old self in the wolf's eyes before the monster within takes total control.

~ Envisioned by William Lightbane

Windsong Caverns: Low Tones.name:
风歌洞窟：低沉回响
Windsong Caverns: Low Tones

Text.text:
附近某处传来一声空洞的嚎叫或呜咽，你警觉地环顾四周，搜寻潜在的敌人。可那音调随即被拉长，渐渐变得出奇地熟悉。你注意到石壁上布满孔洞与空腔，让你联想到管乐器。会不会是微风在吹奏这块岩石？
A hollow howl or moan comes from somewhere nearby, and you glance about for enemies. But then the tone lengthens and grows into something oddly familiar. You notice holes and hollows in the stone, which makes you think of wind instruments. Could the breeze be playing the stone?

Ferrys's Tower Of Wonders.name:
费里斯的奇观之塔
Ferrys's Tower Of Wonders

Text.text: 在一座青草覆顶的山丘之巅，坐落着巫师费里斯的小屋。但拥有真知视界的人能看见它的真容：一座百尺高塔，形如一根万象魔杖。双开橡木大门由三只眼睛守卫，能发射阳炎射线与反制法术；而诸般魔咒令要塞周遭一条巨龙身长之内，攀爬与飞行皆不可行。 Atop a grassy hilltop sits the cottage of Ferrys the Wizard. But one with truesight can see its real form: a hundred-foot tower resembling a wand of wonders. Its double oaken door is guarded by three eyes capable of shooting sunbeams and counterspells, and enchantments prevent climbing and flying within a dragon-length of the stronghold.

Approaching Cliffside Border Town In Spr.name:
春日逼近悬崖边境小镇
Approaching Cliffside Border Town In Spring

Text.text:
临近边境时，春日花香扑面而来。你探头望向峡谷边缘，只见一道宽阔而踏痕深深的小径横穿峭壁岩面，尽头是一座被繁花披覆的门。门周围，成群鸟儿俯冲盘旋，啄食被花朵引来的虫群。前来求入的人挥手驱赶鸟群，注意力全被那些鸟儿攫住，根本无暇顾及你。
Approaching the border, the scent of spring flowers hits you. A peek over the edge of the ravine reveals a broad and well-trodden path traversing the face of the cliff, ending at a blossom-swathed gate. Around this, a multitude of birds swoop and dive, feasting on the insects drawn to the blooms. Folk seeking entrance swipe at the flock, their attention focused on the birds rather than you.

如一位年迈的森林守望者，高耸的紫杉树巍然矗立，扭曲的枝桠如守护的臂膀般伸展，覆在宁静的空地上方。树身外层覆着虬结盘绕的树皮，宛如饱经风霜、布满皱纹的旧皮肤，承受过早已超出活人记忆的风暴。
Like an aging warden of the forest, the towering yew tree stands resolute, its twisting branches reaching over the peaceful clearing like protective arms. Gnarled and knotted bark covers the tree’s exterior like worn and wrinkled skin that has weathered storms beyond living memory.

I Cast Banishment.name:
我施放放逐术
I Cast Banishment

Text.text:
我为自己的研究而自豪，也为那份知识而自豪：我的目标憎恨这枚信物。我把咒语说得像在闲聊一般。你不喜欢这个？你不想看见它？好，那就走吧，走得越远越好。  
我在脑海中勾勒出那处存在的位面，仿佛我们早已身临其境。我呼唤它的名字，一只手描出敌人的轮廓，另一只手勾画通往其终点的异界图谱。随后，我吐出那最后的放逐之词。
I’m proud of my research, the knowledge that this token is hated by my target. I speak the words as if engaging in simple conversation. You don’t like this? You don’t want to see it. Well, then go, and go far. I imagine the plane of existence as if we were already there. I name it, trace my foe’s outline with one hand and draw the otherworldly map to my foe’s destination with the other. Then I speak the final word of exile.

Barracks In Building.name:
建筑内兵营
Barracks In Building

Text.text:
一排排朴素的双层床沿着墙壁与房间中央整齐排列。汗臭沉沉压在空气里，又与抛光护甲所用油脂与矿粉的刺鼻气味纠缠在一起。武器靠墙成列，随时等待这里栖身的战士抽出投入战斗。几名士兵在房内来回走动，另一些则沉睡在床上，养精蓄锐，准备在月亮升起时起身值守。
Rows of simple bunkbeds line the walls and center of the room. The stink of sweat lies heavily in the air, mingling with the sharp scent of oils and minerals used to polish armor. Weapons line the walls, ready to be drawn into action by the warriors that reside here. Several soldiers mill about the room and others sleep in the beds, preparing to rise with the moon for their watch.

Virga Clouds In The Sky.name:
天穹浮云如缕
Virga Clouds In The Sky

Text.text:
由冰晶凝成的降水柱自云团中垂落，宛如地下洞窟穹顶探下的一根钟乳石。
The shaft of precipitation formed by ice crystals dips down from the cloud formation, resembling nothing so much as a stalactite jutting down from the ceiling of a subterranean cavern.

Mad Scientist's Lab: Off Balance.name:
疯狂科学家的实验室：失衡
Mad Scientist's Lab: Off Balance

Text.text:
你感觉胃里一阵翻腾。紧接着，脖颈上的头变得轻飘飘的，仿佛随时会像肥皂泡般脱离躯壳，飘然而去。也许是这些炼金实验的蒸汽在作祟，又或许是你所目睹的恐怖比你想象的更深地侵蚀了你。房间微微旋转，你不由得看见自己的双手在脸前晃动，指尖的残影在视野里拖曳成一片模糊的光带。
You feel your stomach flutter. Then your head feels light upon your neck, as if it might detach and float away like a soap bubble. It could be the fumes from these alchemical experiments, or maybe the horrors you’ve witnessed have had more impact than you thought. The room spins slightly, and you find yourself looking at your hands waving in front of your face, and watching the afterimage of your fingers blur across your vision.

Sundries From A Snakeblooded Humanoid.name:
蛇血人形生物的杂物
Sundries From A Snakeblooded Humanoid

Text.text:
那张脸覆着一片平滑的细密鳞片，肤色般的光泽在死亡中凝固；细长的瞳孔微微放大，正开始浑浊发白。你翻检他们的衣物和破烂的护甲，除了一件挂在脖子上的小饰物外一无所获。你弹开那只小盒，里面是一幅面容慈祥的人类女子肖像，旁边两枚细小的獠牙在盒中松动地碰撞作响。
The face, a smooth plain of fine, flesh-toned scales, is frozen in death, the slender pupils dilated slightly and beginning to cloud. You find nothing rifling through their clothes and ratty pieces of armor aside from a trinket hanging around their neck. Popping open the small case, you see a portrait of a human woman with a kindly face along with two tiny fangs rattling loose inside.

Fake Crystal Ball.name:
赝品水晶球
Fake Crystal Ball

Text.text: 当你凝视水晶球时，倒影在其中变幻起伏，涟漪荡漾。球体弧面上浮现的不是画面，而是一行信息：稍后再问。 As you gaze into the crystal ball, reflections shift and ripple. Rather than an image, a message floats up to the curved surface of the orb: Ask Again Later.

Staff Of Walnut.name:
胡桃木法杖
Staff Of Walnut

Text.text:
这根法杖取自一段六尺六码长的枯枝，朴素得近乎寒酸；树皮仍完整包覆其上，唯独常年握持之处被磨得光滑发亮。它曾由学院的一位校友挑中——一名四处漂泊的法师，常沿伊斯卡尔河为贫困村落伸手相助。她在法杖中注入一道法术：一旦持杖者身亡，法杖便会自行漂浮，顺着水路缓缓漂回学院的船坞。法杖的力量，取决于它是否被赠予一名家境困顿的一年级新生。经过训练，持杖者能徒步跋涉更远的距离，并强化修补法术。
This staff is a six-foot-six branch of plain deadfall, bark intact except for the worn place of the standing hand hold. It was chosen by an Academy alumna, a traveling wizard who helped poor villages along the Iskar River. She imbued the staff with a spell that, upon its wielder’s death, would float it along waterways to the Academy boathouse. The staff’s power depends on it being given to an impoverished first-year student. With training, the wielder can walk long distances and enhance mending spells.

Kalo Deepspeaker In Aquatic Environment.name:
水栖（特征）环境中的卡洛·深潮语者
Kalo Deepspeaker In Aquatic Environment

Text.text:
异族在冰冷的水中漂游，宛如幽灵徘徊于被遗忘深渊的阴郁底层；修长而半透明的鳍翼大张，借着水流的推送缓缓前行。鼓胀发光的双眼如黑暗中的提灯般起伏，替贤者照亮穿越海洋浑浊的路。水栖（特征）祭司的肩头披着仪式披肩，胸骨处镶嵌的宝石以柔和的红光脉动，在环绕旅人四周的深海群兽那幽影般的眼中映出一片猩红。
The alien drifts through the icy water like a specter haunting the gloomy depths of a forgotten abyss, their long, translucent fins splayed wide to catch the currents. Bulbous, glowing eyes bob like lanterns in the darkness, lighting the sage’s way through the ocean’s murk. A ceremonial mantle rests upon the shoulders of the aquatic priest, the gem set at the sternum pulsing with a soft, red light that reflects in the umbral eyes of the deep-sea menagerie surrounding the traveler.

Pair Of Rocs In Cave Lair.name:
洞穴巢穴中的一对巨鹏
Pair Of Rocs In Cave Lair

Text.text:
气流穿过洞口涌入，裹着一股苦涩的气味。前方是一座宽阔的洞厅，点点剧毒水洼散布其间；更高处的另一道开口倾泻下阳光。光束照亮一片葱茏绿意：一株巨大的橡树，以及它无数的子嗣。巨龙的骷髅（特征）在树干间蜿蜒盘绕；而在橡树之巅——仿佛以枯木与巨大羽毛编成的死寂王冠——铺展开一座泰坦般的巨巢。相似的羽毛从枝头垂落，铺满地面，旁边散落着数不清的牛与其他大型野兽的骨骸。

~ 由来自 Fort Myers 的 John L 扮演

Air flows through the cave mouth, carrying a bitter smell with it. A wide cavern dotted with poisonous pools extends beyond, with sunlight streaming in from another opening high above. The light illuminates an expanse of greenery, including a giant oak and its numerous children. The skeleton of a dragon twists among the trunks, and atop the oak—like a crown of dead wood and huge feathers—spreads a titanic nest. Similar feathers dangle from the branches and litter the floor, along with countless bones of cattle and other large beasts.

~ Played by John L from Fort Myers

Tournament Courtiers.name:
宫廷赛会侍从
Tournament Courtiers

Text.text:
为富人预留的看台渐渐坐满，披着雍容貂裘的人们纷纷入座，彼此寒暄时却难掩轻蔑，随后又躲在镶宝的扇后，向邻座低声耳语。他们的衣着满溢财富：张扬的珠宝缀满每一条颈项，闪耀的戒指套在每一根修整得体的手指上。
The stand reserved for the rich begins to fill as folk draped elegantly with ermine take their seats, greet each other with ill-concealed contempt, and whisper to neighbors behind bejeweled fans. Their attire drips wealth: flamboyant jewels adorning every neck, gleaming rings gracing each manicured finger.

Taunt From A Beholder.name:
来自眼魔的嘲弄
Taunt From A Beholder

Text.text:
“可悲的小生物，在黑暗里盲目摸索，拼命想抓住自己永远无法理解的东西。别担心。我会终结你们的痛苦。”
“Pathetic little creatures, fumbling blindly in the dark trying so desperately to grasp what they cannot understand. Do not worry. I will end your misery.”

Vampire's Manor: Dining Hall.name:
吸血鬼（特征）的庄园：宴会厅
Vampire's Manor: Dining Hall

Text.text:
破烂的血红窗帘将那扇巨大的窗户层层掩蔽——它曾让日光得以穿透餐厅。污渍斑斑的桌布沿着那张庞大的长方形餐桌一路铺展，餐桌可供十二人就座。每个房间角落都摆着盆栽，里面的植物早已枯死。这里或许曾是享用佳肴、共度夜晚闲谈的怡人所在，如今却只剩往昔的阴影：幽暗沉败，任其腐朽。
Ratty, blood-red curtains cover the enormous window that once allowed daylight to penetrate the dining hall. A stained tablecloth runs the length of the massive, rectangular table, which provides seating for twelve. Dead plants in pots occupy each corner of the room. This may have once been a pleasant place to enjoy a meal and an evening of conversation, but it remains now a shadow of its former self, darkened and left to rot.

I Study An Arcane Text.name:
我研读一部奥秘秘典
I Study An Arcane Text

Text.text:
那些符文在纸面上扭动变形，仿佛我让它们难堪了，于是它们正试图扭着身子从页面上溜走。我咬牙坚持，用专注将词句钉死在原处。阅读的脉络逐渐顺畅——我摸清了魔法的纹路与规律，沉浸在破译其奥秘之中。可当我研读这些文字时，却生出一种最诡异的感觉：这段文字，似乎也在反过来审视我……
The glyphs wriggle and shift, like I’ve embarrassed them and now they’re trying to shimmy off the page. I persevere, pinning the words in place with my focus. The flow of my reading becomes easier—I learn the magic’s patterns and become immersed in deciphering its secrets. As I study the text, I have the strangest feeling that the text is studying me back…

Explosion Causes Multiple Casualties.name:
爆炸造成多名伤亡
Explosion Causes Multiple Casualties

Text.text:
一声震耳欲聋的巨响轰然炸开。几毫秒后，黄焰猛然迸亮，冲击波如墙般碾过。被爆风抛飞的人体像帆布与麻袋般软塌塌地散落在地，一动不动。碎片与血肉在空中翻飞，落地时发出令人作呕的脆裂声与黏腻的噗嗤声。浓烟层层压住现场，尖叫与哀嚎混作一片，汽车警报此起彼伏，刺耳不绝。
A deafening bang rings out. Milliseconds later, there’s a flare of yellow fire and a wave of pressure. Thrown bodies from the blast lie like limp bundles of canvas and sackcloth, unmoving on the ground. Bits of debris and flesh fly through the air and land with a sickening crunch or a squelch. Smoke layers the scene amid a cacophony of screams and wailing car alarms.

这份文档上的伤害早已超出年代与风雨侵蚀的自然磨损。边缘毛散破败，丑陋地向内蔓延，直至化作刺入纸心的整道裂口。羊皮纸触感发软，遍布折痕、弯曲变形，仿佛曾被粗疑地反复折起又塞进衣袋里无数次。必须小心捧持，否则一个不慎，就会把它撕成难以辨认的碎屑。
The damage on this document goes beyond the natural wear of age and the elements. Frayed edges, unseemly, stretch into full tears toward the center of the document. The feel of the parchment is soft and is bent with many creases, as if it has been dubiously folded and stuffed into a pocket many times over. It must be handled with care, lest you run the risk of ripping it to illegible shreds.

Weddi-torrey Fields In Winter.name:
冬日的韦迪-托雷田野
Weddi-torrey Fields In Winter

Text.text:
这片农庄几乎死寂无声：田地里不见一丝庄稼，宅邸的窗户也全都紧闭上板。农场主招牌上垂下一条帆布横幅，上面写着：冬季歇业。字迹用鲜亮的红色花体涂就。隐约间，似有音乐从庄园某处飘来——原声吉他的拨弦声，清清脆脆。
The farmstead is almost totally quiet: its fields bare of any crop, and the windows of the home completely shuttered. A canvas banner draped from the farm’s main sign reads: Closed for Winter. The words are painted in a vibrant red script. There is the faintest suggestion of music playing—the twanging of an acoustic guitar—from somewhere on the property.

城垛女墙之后那条宽阔平坦的巡道上，散落着各式战争器具：一桶桶沥青、一筐筐箭矢、摆放武器的架子，以及堆叠的大石块，井然各据其位。守卫们始终枕戈待旦，随时准备抵御来自异邦的入侵者，守护城堡不失。
The wide, flat walkway behind the crenellated parapet of the battlements is littered with tools of war. Barrels of pitch, buckets of arrows, weapon racks, and large stones all have a place here. The guards are always ready to defend the castle against invaders from other lands.

Dry Waterway Of An Uninhabited Planet.name:
荒芜星球的干涸水道
Dry Waterway Of An Uninhabited Planet

Text.text:
千百年前，这条干涸龟裂的河床曾是繁盛多样的生态核心，丰沛的水流滋养着葱郁生命，处处生机涌动。如今它却空无一物，沐浴在垂死之星投下的不祥红光里。
Millennia ago this dry, cracked riverbed would have been at the heart of a thriving, diverse ecosystem, its bountiful waters teeming with verdant life. Now it stands empty, bathed in the ominous red light of a dying star.

[外部] 这艘绿色的船屋在水波的涨落间轻轻摇荡，被系在一段仿木栈桥旁，看起来像是流浪汉或河上游牧者的居所。船体受了损——中段拱起起伏，却并未下沉。一顶粗陋的波纹铁皮屋顶用零碎的铁丝与麻绳牢牢绑在下方的长舱上。船壳上用铜版花体喷绘着Home Sweet Home。

[内部] 舱内狭长低矮而拥挤，舷侧的搁板堆满旧数据板、书籍与潦草急促的手写笔记。家具陈旧且疏于打理。空间里点点红烛散布其间，除了一扇污渍斑斑的塑料天窗外，这是唯一的光源。角落里焚着馨香的熏香，茉莉的气息在空气中游荡；而那香味之下，还压着腐朽木料的恶臭。

[Outside] Gently rocking in the ebb of the water and tied up to a jetty of faux wood, this green houseboat seems the dwelling of a vagabond or river nomad. The boat’s hull has been damaged—it bucks in the middle but does not sink. A crude corrugated iron roof is lashed firm by odd bits of wire and twine to the long cabin underneath. The words Home Sweet Home have been stenciled in copperplate script on the hull.

[Inside] The inside is long and low and crowded, the sideboards cluttered with old datapads, books, and notes scribbled in a frenzied hand. The furnishings are old and poorly cared for. Red candles dot the space, the only light besides the grubby plastic skylight. Fragrant incense burns in a corner, with the scent of jasmine wafting through the air. Beneath that smell, the stench of rotting wood.

在一片几乎无人踏勘的荒野角落里，一个粗陋的邪教营地传来的喧嚣声，几乎能传出一英里之远。昼夜不息，苦修者敲击着鼓点，为那群肮脏邪教徒无尽的吟诵打着节拍；那些被洗脑、走投无路的人嘶声呼喊，祈求从尘世劳苦的屈辱中得到救赎。除去吟诵与睡眠，邪教徒们被驱使去做折骨般的苦役：播种收割、教导孩童，或编织布匹，为集体换取收入。与此同时，在远离那群成堆可怜虫的一顶陈设奢华的帐篷里，教主与最亲近的门徒们，正享用着由下属奉上的劳作与财富所换来的生物般的舒适与享乐。
Ensconced within a scarcely surveyed patch of wilderness, the sound of a rude camp inhabited by cultists can be heard for nearly a mile. Day and night, drums are beaten by ascetics, providing the rhythm for the endless chanting of the crowds of unwashed cultists, the brainwashed and desperate crying out for salvation from the ignominy of earthbound hardships. When not chanting or sleeping, the cultists are put to back-breaking work planting and harvesting crops, teaching children, or weaving cloth to provide income for the collective. Meanwhile, in a lavishly appointed tent well away from the massed wretches, the cult leader and their closest disciples enjoy the creature comforts afforded by the labor and wealth signed to them by their underlings.

登上楼梯尽头，树干之中一扇门扉向你招手，引你前行。你越是靠近，传送门迸射的光便越发炽烈、越发耀眼。那光脉动翻涌、旋转不息，仿佛有低语从中渗出。你凝视那片平静的光芒时，一股不祥沿着脊背缓缓爬升——而在其后，你感到一处幽暗而寒冷的所在。
Cresting the stairs, a gate within the tree’s trunk beckons you forward. The light radiating from the portal grows fiercer, brighter, as you draw near. Whispers seem to emanate from that light as it pulses and swirls. A foreboding feeling crawls up your spine as you peer into the placid light—and beyond, you sense a place of dark and cold.

我的武器宛如一体，成了死亡之舞的搭档——紧随战斗脉动的节奏。第一击如离弦之箭般贯向敌人，紧接着它的同伴迅疾跟上；在战场的喧嚣中，各司其职，步步相扣。
My weapons work as one, partners in a deadly dance—following the pulsing rhythm of battle. The first strikes my foe like a loosed arrow, followed swiftly by its counterpart, each playing its role in the tumult of combat.

这只苍白的蓝色蜘蛛有马一般的体型，周身裹着以太位面的残渣。然而，它的毒素却实打实属于这个世界——对任何缺乏强韧生命力的人而言，都是致命之物。怪物咬上一口便遁去无踪——难以定位，更难杀死。即便是最顶尖的战士，也会懂得依靠法术技艺，尤其是位面魔法：当那双眼与螯肢忽然在虚空中凭空浮现、张得大大的时候。
The size of a horse, this pale blue spider is sheathed in the residue of the Ethereal Plane. Its poison is very much of this world, however, and deadly to anyone lacking a mighty vitality. The monster bites and disappears—hard to locate, harder to kill. The best of fighters will appreciate spellcraft, especially the magic of the planes, when those eyes and mandibles suddenly emerge, wide open, out of thin air.

Power Word Kill Using Hatred.name:
以憎恨施展【灭绝咒】
Power Word Kill Using Hatred

Text.text:
仇恨猛然冲上你灵魂的表层，你曾有过的每一个阴暗念头都灌满脑海。你猛地伸出手臂，直指那名敌人。当你吐出那句污秽至极、满溢恶毒的言辞时，对方眼中浮现恐惧；你的嘴唇被撕裂，开始渗出鲜血。敌人捂住胸口，踉跄倒下，生命如潮水般迅速流逝。
Hatred surges to the surface of your soul, every dark thought you have ever had filling your mind. You thrust out your arm, pointing at the foe. Their eyes show fear as you utter a Word so foul, so filled with vitriol, your lips split and begin to bleed. Your foe clutches their chest, and falls, their life draining away.

将牧场牲畜圈栏与外头那片恬静牧草地隔开的栅栏，简朴却结实：厚重的干燥防腐木板被牢牢钉在粗壮的立柱上，排成一道道坚硬的界线。一条小径从圈栏间穿过，尽头是一座以石块与灰浆砌成的单层石屋；旁边紧挨着一座低矮的原木工棚式宿舍，雇工们每晚便回到那里歇息。石屋另一侧是一座年岁已高却保养得当的谷仓，里面堆满了牲畜进食用的饲料。
The fences separating the pens of the ranch’s livestock from the idyllic pastureland beyond are made simply but sturdily: thick planks of dried and treated wood hammered into position along stout posts. A single story house of stone and mortar lies at the end of a path running between the pens, close to a squat, log bunkhouse where the hired hands retire every evening. An elderly but well-maintained barn lies on the other side of the stone house, filled with feed for the livestock’s repast.

Gnome Monk Throwing A Dart At A Target.name:
侏儒武僧将飞镖掷向目标
Gnome Monk Throwing A Dart At A Target

Text.text:
侏儒沿着墙面疾奔，胸前的弹带上斜挎着一对飞镖。借墙一蹬的刹那，他们手腕轻甩，潇洒落地，同时将一枚带羽的飞镖掷向他们的敌人。

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

The gnome runs across the wall with a brace of darts slung across their chest in a bandolier. They flick a hand out as they push off the wall—dismounting with aplomb—and hurl a feathered dart toward their foe.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

这是一根浅色染痕的简易木杖，装着软垫臂托。做工比你在收容所里常见的那种拐杖要精致得多。每次杖身轻敲地面，你都能听见一声细微的金属叮当。这时你才看清，杖端嵌着铁制杖尖，中央开有一道狭缝。拐杖的握把处也藏着一个格格不入的机关：一个小按钮，像是某种触发器。

~ 设想出自 Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

This is a simple staff of lightly stained wood, fitted with a padded armrest. It is of better make than the standard crutch you might find in a hospice. With each tap against the ground, you can hear a slight metallic clink. You see now that the end of it is fitted with an iron tip, a slit down its middle. The handhold of the crutch, too, has an out-of-place mechanism: a small button akin to a trigger.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

她向后一掀黑色兜帽，露出一张精灵般的面孔；紫罗兰色的波浪长发如瀑垂落，直至背部中央。两支乌黑如墨的角自她头侧刺出，向下弯曲，贴着梅暗色的双颊蜿蜒，严肃的阴沉表情被它们从两侧牢牢框住。每支角的尖端都染着一抹明亮的赤红，仿佛仍在塑形的熔融金属边缘般灼目。

~ 由一位英雄扮演

She pushes back her black hood, revealing an elflike face crowned in waves of violet hair that descend down to the middle of her back. Two jet-black horns protrude out from the side of her head, curling down to her plum-dark cheeks and framing either side of her serious scowl. The points of each horn end in a bright red coloration, reminiscent of the edge of molten metal still in the process of being formed.

~ Played by a Hero

Research Scientist With Cable Connection.name:
通过线缆连接平板电脑的研究科学家
Research Scientist With Cable Connection To Tablet

Text.text:
她脸上带着一种近乎天才的狂乱神色——科学癫狂的神情。那件号称抗一切污渍的聚合复合长袍，如今却被实验室液体染得斑斑驳驳。长方形安全护目镜像是被移植般嵌在她脸上；而她的太阳穴处垂下两根橙黄相间的电缆。电缆蜿蜒而下，接入一台肮脏的平板电脑的辅助输出端口；屏幕上无数繁复的蓝图脉动闪烁。
A frantic look of near genius marks her face—the look of scientific frenzy. Her poly-composite robe, designed to resist all stains, is heavily marked with laboratory fluids. Rectangular safety goggles have been grafted to her face, while from her temples dangle twin cables, striped orange-yellow. The cables snake down to auxiliary outputs in a grubby tablet computer, upon which pulse countless complex blueprints.

一座白色珐琅网格平台与温室其余结构相互呼应，将每段楼梯连接到温室的八角侧面。下方堆放着花盆与园艺材料，而屋顶足够高，足以让人站在楼梯井的顶端。
A platform of white enameled gridwork matching the rest of the greenhouse’s construction connects each of the staircases to the octagonal sides of the greenhouse. Pots and gardening materials are stored beneath them, and the roof is high enough to allow someone to stand at the top of the stairwells.

Checking My Hacker Score.name:
检查我的黑客评分
Checking My Hacker Score

Text.text:
我把一组冗余的仪表钉在屏幕一角，贴着我的代码。每一只都在为另一只作证。每当我切入、抓取、剖开，哪怕稍微闹出点动静，指针就往上跳。我已经到二十多了，浑身见血，离“监管”逮到我只剩不到一半的余量。上帝在看着。我得把动静压到最低。

~ 一位英雄 构想

I’ve got redundant gauges clipped to my code in one corner of my monitor. Each of them corroborates the other. Every time I cut in, grab, slice, get a little noisy, the gauges tick up. I’m in the twenties, bloodied and past the halfway mark until Oversight finds me. God’s watching. I gotta keep it low.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

比起掩盖一车货物的瑕疵，她选择精明而坦率的诚实。两名商贩对谈时，她寡言而谨慎；对方却满嘴喧嚣与伪善，报出离谱的数字，编造货架上每件物品的来历。每一次夸大，都被她平静地揭穿真相；久而久之，在耐心的铺陈里，她离开时带走的价值，远远胜过她拿来交换的那一份。
Choosing shrewd honesty over concealing the flaws of a cart full of wares, one merchant speaks seldom and carefully to the other. Her counterpart is full of bombast and false virtue, outrageous numbers and stories of where the items in his stores originated. Each exaggeration is met by a calm revelation of the facts, and in time, with patience, she leaves with considerably more worth than she carried to the exchange.

Plain Gold Cloak Pin.name:
朴素的金袍卫兵胸针
Plain Gold Cloak Pin

Text.text:
这是一根两端各有尖刺的短杆，每一端都刻着凹槽；杆身中央系着一条红绳——从那里垂下近一英尺。红绳尽头收作一个打结的穗饰。短杆从开口两侧刺穿布料，随后将红绳分别缠绕在两端的凹槽上，将其牢牢固定。
This is a two-spiked rod, notched at each end, with a red cord tied to its middle—and hanging nearly a foot from it. The cord ends at a knotted tassel. The rod pierces the fabric on both sides of the opening, and the cord is then wrapped around each end to hold it in place.

I Cast Dominate Monster From My Ring Of.name:
我从我的水元素统御之戒中施放了“支配怪物”
I Cast Dominate Monster From My Ring Of Water Elemental Command

Text.text:
我对那元素开口，声音如逼近的巨浪轰然回荡。那生物战栗着屈服，浑浊无形的躯体扭曲翻卷，像是要在自身的撞击中退避我的力量——然而它忽然停住，旋舞的惶恐融化成冷静而坚定的凝视。
I speak to the elemental, my voice resounding like a looming wave. The creature shudders and bends, its amorphous body twisting and crashing upon itself in an attempt to recoil from my power—but it halts, its whirling anxiety melting to a cool and steady gaze.

Colossal Battle With Dragons And Devils.name:
与巨龙与恶魔的浩大战役
Colossal Battle With Dragons And Devils

Text.text:
世界在尖叫。孕育雷暴的乌云在一座缠绕闪电的台地上方聚拢，仪式魔法撕扯着山体，施展巫术的那些阴影身形在剧痛中扭曲。下方的草原翻涌着浩荡军势——光与暗的力量在崩解的阵列里纠缠抽搐，地壳坍塌将他们的凝聚撕得粉碎。大地成了烂泥般的屠场：被碾成肉糜的尸体、破裂的躯壳被抛掷得四散飞溅。在这片太初战争的海面之上，空气起泡裂开，现实的创口里呕出巨魇般的恶魔，坠落、撞击在厮杀的军团之间，以铁蹄将他们踏成齑粉。穿破法术飓风，暴怒的巨龙喷吐出一柱柱热能死亡，焚尽它们所接触的一切。紧接着，万花筒般的能量轰然爆裂，熵毁的触须抽打而出……

~ Envisioned by Cesoide

The world is screaming. Pregnant storm clouds gather above a lightning-wreathed mesa, ritual magics tearing at the mountainside, while the shadowy forms of those enacting the sorcery twist in agony. The steppe below seethes with vast armies—forces light and dark writhing in disintegrating formations, cohesion ripped apart by tectonic collapse. The ground is a morass of pulped corpses, ruptured bodies flung far and wide. Above this sea of primordial war, the air blisters open and gargantuan fiends vomit from wounds in reality, plummeting, crashing amid brawling legions, pulverizing them beneath iron-shod hooves. Bursting through a hurricane of spellcraft, enraged dragons belch columns of thermogenic death, incinerating all they touch. Then, kaleidoscope energies explode and tendrils of entropic destruction lash out…

~ Envisioned by Cesoide

Bridge Spanning Subterranean Chasm.name:
横跨地下深渊的桥梁
Bridge Spanning Subterranean Chasm

Text.text:
桥梁悬挂在一道深渊之上，深渊直坠数千英尺，没入彻底的黑暗。两侧峭壁笔直陡立，高耸入云，升起成这片空旷空间里嶙峋如冠的岩顶。桥身看上去足够结实：一条金属栈道，由铁链拴缚在两岸峭壁上——可当你踏上桥面，感到铁链承受住你的重量时，你不由得怀疑，是否还有别的办法能过去。
The bridge hangs over a chasm that plunges thousands of feet and disappears down into total darkness. The cliffs on either side are sheer and soaring, rising to form the craggy canopy of the cavernous space. The bridge itself seems sturdy enough, consisting of a metal walkway secured by chains to either cliff—but as you step onto the bridge deck and feel the chains take your weight you wonder if there might be another way to cross.

Orc Archer Shooting.name:
兽人弓箭手射击
Orc Archer Shooting

Text.text:
一名兜帽遮面的兽人，原始力量的象征，以千锤百炼的筋肉手臂拉满长弓。那阴鸷的目光——如掠食者般冷静算计的凝视——锁定在他的目标上，一心要以迅疾之死终结敌人。随着一声发自血肉的放箭，箭矢轰然迸发，势不可挡，自嗡鸣的弓弦上跃出，化作一枚尖啸的憎恨飞弹。
A hooded orc, an icon of primal strength, draws his bow with sinewy arms forged by hours of practice. His grim gaze—a predator's calculating stare—fixes on his target, intent on bring swift death to his foe. With a visceral release his arrow bursts forth, an unstoppable force, leaping from the humming bow, a screaming missile of hate.

River Journey: In The Hold.name:
河上旅途：在要塞中
River Journey: In The Hold

Text.text:
微光从船身狭小的货舱上方渗落下来，你弯下腰——也许比必要的还要低——以免撞到头。麻袋与木桶塞满了大半空间，唯有船尾留出一小块起居区域。那里，一张吊床挂在钩上轻轻摇晃，周围悬着几件私人物品：一个挎包，以及一条看起来风干过的火腿。
Little light filters down into the small hold of this ship, and you duck, perhaps farther than you need, to avoid bumping your head. Sacks and barrels fill most of the space, except for a small living area at the stern. There, a hammock sways on its hooks while around it hang personal items: a satchel and what looks like a cured ham.

Insult From A Paladin About Wealth.name:
圣武士对财富的羞辱
Insult From A Paladin About Wealth

Text.text:
“你让自己被巨额的财富与满脸堆笑的蠢货团团簇拥，他们逢迎你的一举一动；可我知道，神祇正向我微笑，因为我挣来了正义的人生。你也能这么说吗？”
“You’ve surrounded yourself with great wealth and grinning fools praising your every deed, but I know the gods smile on me because I have earned the righteous life. Can you say the same?”

Subterranean Ancient Settlement.name:
地下古代聚落
Subterranean Ancient Settlement

Text.text:
这座地下聚落蔓延得如此深广、根基如此牢固，以至于人们已分不清洞窟的天然地形止于何处、人工的建造又始于何处。现今居民的先辈曾在被磨平的洞壁上刻下宏大的浮刻，描绘村落的奠基之始——其中一些已因年代久远而风化剥落，并以绳索围栏加以保护。村庄中央矗立着一座大厅，远比周遭建筑古老：这座小村最初、也是第一间被建起的居所。
The sprawl of this subterranean settlement is so well-established that one can no longer tell where the cavern’s natural terrain ends and construction begins. The predecessors of the current inhabitants created great etchings on the smoothed cavern walls depicting the founding of the village—some are crumbling with age and protected with rope barriers. At the village center is a hall, older by far than those around it: the first dwelling ever constructed in this hamlet.

筋腱崩裂的脆响宣告野兽降临，腐朽白骨铸成的巨爪触及深坑边缘。伴随一声亵渎的咆哮，骸骨巨龙爬将而出，曾经自我的扭曲恶毒倒影。空洞深陷的眼眶里燃起烈焰，它蹒跚前行，全身靠禁忌魔法与怨毒勉强缝合在一起。
Cracking sinew announces the presence of the beast as mighty claws of rotting bone reach over the edge of the pit. With an unholy roar, the skeletal dragon crawls forth, a warped and vile reflection of its former self. Fire blazes within cavernous, hollow eyes as it lumbers onward, held together by forbidden magics and spite.

Party Caster Uses Magic To Cloak Their C.name:
施法者施展魔法，为伙伴披上隐匿的伪装
Party Caster Uses Magic To Cloak Their Companions

Text.text:
当施法者完成他们的法术时，伙伴们平日里那喧闹刺耳的嘈杂声骤然沉寂。护甲的铿锵仿佛被厚重的布堆层层裹住，沉重而拖沓的脚步声也变得轻若随风而来的呢喃。

~

As the caster completes their spell, the usual cacophonous racket of their companions falls silent. The clanking of armor is dulled as if under heaps of thick cloth, and the heavy, plodding footsteps of the group become as quiet as a whisper on the wind.

~

Adult Gold Dragon.name:
成年金龙
Adult Gold Dragon

Text.text:
这头庞大的龙类巨兽爬行般的面孔上垂落着如胡须般的触须。高耸的生物以一种诡异而摄人的优雅行进，仿佛巨蛇般靠近，异界之躯随着细微的起伏悄然游动。它的金色鳞片在阳光下灿然夺目，它守夜般凝视着你，眼神锐利而狡黠。当你终于完全意识到它的体型时，只剩下震撼与敬畏。
Beard-like whiskers drape from the reptilian face of this massive draconic beast. The towering creature moves with a grace both strange and alluring, approaching as a serpent might with subtle undulations of its otherworldly form. Its golden scales shine brilliantly in the sun as it watches you, its eyes sharp and cunning. As you fully reckon its size, you're left awed.

凉意在此流淌，裹挟着一股霉陈而甜腻的气息。巨大的白石柱沿这条宽阔长厅两侧凿出数个壁龛。每个壁龛里都安置着一具枯槁的人形，倚墙而立，双臂交叉覆在胸前，双眼紧闭。其上方皆刻着一颗人类头颅，拖着蛇般的尾巴，生着鸟翼。
Cool air moves here, carrying a musty, sweet scent. Massive pillars of white stone form several niches along either side of this broad hall. Each niche holds a withered humanoid form, leaning against the wall, arms crossed over the chest, eyes closed. Above each is the image of a human head with a snakelike tail and bird wings.

Witch's Herbal Tea.name:
女巫草本茶
Witch's Herbal Tea

Text.text:
这些香气你很熟悉——姜、薄荷、青叶。然而这茶里又渗进了别的味道。也许是甘草，或是茴香，但在鼻腔里更尖锐刺人，熏得你眼眶发酸。无论这茶原本能治愈或抚慰什么，你都忘得一干二净。藤蔓正沿着墙壁疯长。天花板化作一张茅草编成的脸，用烟一般尖细的高声嘲笑你。你的双手缩进袖口深处，身体变得光滑黏腻。你听见自己在恐惧中发出笑声。
These are familiar aromas—ginger, mint, green leaf. But something tinges this tea. Licorice, perhaps, or fennel, but sharper in your nose, and your eyes water. Whatever the tea might heal or comfort, you forget. Vines are growing up the walls. The ceiling becomes a face made of thatch, laughing at you in a smoky high pitch. Your hands recess into your sleeves, and your body feels smooth and slippery. You hear yourself laugh in terror.

Age-old Dwarvish Bigotry.name:
年代久远的矮人族偏见
Age-old Dwarvish Bigotry

Text.text:
昏暗的酒馆里，一桌矮人正打得火热地拼酒，叫嚣声滚滚，啤酒泡沫四下飞溅。几乎在同一瞬间，他们都停了下来。门口新涌入的光里，站着一名高等精灵，仪容一丝不苟，身着纤尘不染的银绿华服。一个矮人说道：“他们的方向感也就这样。这位肯定迷路了。”众人哄笑。精灵默默退了出去。
In the dark tavern, a table of dwarves is in the middle of a competitive drinking game, all billowing challenge and spraying beer foam. They stop almost as one. In the new light of the doorway stands a high elf, perfectly groomed and clad in pristine silver-and-green finery. One of the dwarves says, “So much for their sense of direction. This one’s lost his way, for sure.” They all laugh. The elf backs out.

Speech About The Nature Of Magic.name:
关于魔法本质的演说
Speech About The Nature Of Magic

Text.text:
“魔法并不公正，魔法也不仁慈；魔法只是力量——无拘无束，永不餍足。召来恐怖或造就奇迹，对这套机制本身而言都无关紧要。我穷尽一生研究魔法的本性，然而若能遂我所愿，我宁愿见它从这世上彻底消失。如此之物，不该交到那些能施以这般残酷的生物手中。可既然世事如此，我宁可执掌它，也不愿任它摆布。”
“Magic is not just, magic is not kind, magic is only power—unrestrained and insatiable. The power to summon horrors or create wonders is of little concern to the mechanism itself. I’ve spent my whole life studying magic’s nature, yet if I had my way, I would see it banished from the world entirely. Such a thing should not be entrusted to the hands of creatures capable of such cruelty. But things being the way they are, I’d rather wield it than be at its mercy.”

Nobleman With One Arm.name:
独臂贵族
Nobleman With One Arm

Text.text:
这位贵族与一位裁缝同行，和她笑谈他所谓“另一只袖子”的种种构想。他偏爱装饰性的褶裥、华丽的别针与加倍的刺绣，恨不得把目光都拢到自己身上——让人无法忽视他年轻时为国王与王后所作的牺牲。

~ 扮演者：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The nobleman travels with a tailor and laughs with her about ideas for what he calls “the other sleeve.” He favors decorative folds, ornate pins, and extra embroidery, bringing as much attention as possible to the sacrifice he made early in life for his king and queen.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Flesh Golem With Ritual Stitching.name:
带有仪式缝线的血肉魔像
Flesh Golem With Ritual Stitching

Text.text:
肯定没有哪个神志正常的人会造出这种由肌肉与魔法拼成的傀儡，这种非人又似人的东西吧？可你一眼就看得出来：有一份冷静的智慧打造了这只怪物。有人把许多人的血肉按某种图案排布起来，像一床拼布被。那针脚的精确里带着一种仪式感。
Surely no one sane would make this puppet of muscle and magic, this inhuman-human thing? Yet you know at a glance that a calm intelligence built the monster. Someone arranged the flesh of many people in a pattern, like a quilt. There’s ritual in the precision of the stitching.

Workshop Of Machinations.name:
阴谋工坊
Workshop Of Machinations

Text.text:
复杂的蓝图像画廊里的肖像般铺满工坊的墙面，磨损的木地板上覆着一层细薄的粉笔灰。油脂的气味在空气中飘荡，如同精致的香水，轻轻将整间屋子缠上“创新”的芬芳。工坊中央的桌上躺着一具高大的机械造物，精密结构毫无保留地展露无遗。工作台旁，一盏闪烁的油灯边搁着几块巨大的分段式几丁质护甲面板。

~ 由 Discord 上的 Sahlonahl 构想

Complex blueprints line the walls of the workshop like portraits in a gallery, and a fine layer of chalk dusts the scuffed wooden floors. The smell of oil wafts through the air like a fine perfume, delicately lacing the room with the scent of innovation. On a table in the center of the shop lies a tall, mechanical being, the intricacies of its design fully on display. Large panels of segmented chitinous armor rest on a workbench beside a flickering oil lamp.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Clash Of Armies.name:
军势交锋
Clash Of Armies

Text.text:
辛辣的浓烟沉甸甸地压在空气里，裹挟着泥泞与脏腑混杂的恶臭。紧接着，尖叫声扑面而来——短促的号令、刺耳的号角、以及钢铁相撞的喧嚣。翻上山脊，你看见战斗的狂飙一路铺展开去，直抵地平线尽头：烈焰与钢铁卷成飓风，披铁的战士如潮汐般彼此冲撞，仿佛海浪拍击礁岸。一侧军阵披着银蓝战袍；另一侧则是黑与金。骑兵作矛锋实施夹击机动，以枪尖与铁蹄碾碎敌军西线。箭雨齐发，倾泻在后排——数百枚箭簇从护甲甲片的缝隙间钻入，扎进那些尚未成名的战士肋间。随着一方重整阵线，巨大的呐喊声冲天而起；他们将盾牌彼此扣紧，踏着泥浆沉重推进，迎向骑兵的冲锋。

~ Envisioned by SorcererMemeSupreme

Acrid smoke hangs heavy on the air, carrying with it the mingled stench of mud and viscera. The screams reach you next—barked orders, blaring horns, and the clamor of steel. Cresting the hill, you see the full tempest of the battle sprawling to the very edge of the horizon, a cyclone of flame and steel, and waves of iron-clad combatants slamming against one another like the sea upon the shore. On one side, the army wears silver-and-blue raiment; on the other, black and gold. Cavalry spearhead a flanking maneuver, crushing the enemy’s western lines beneath spear and hoof. A volley of arrows rains down on the rear lines, hundreds of arrowheads finding their mark between plates of armor and the ribs of would-be fighters. A great cry goes up as one side regroups, locking their shields against one another, and trudging forward through the mud to meet the cavalry charge.

~ Envisioned by SorcererMemeSupreme

Anacite Quantifier.name:
阿纳赛特定量仪
Anacite Quantifier

Text.text:
一只由流变合金构成的巨型昆虫高耸在你面前。坚硬的甲壳一路延伸至一颗结构复杂的头部，上面布满各式测量激光与短波雷达阵列。四只灵巧的螯肢急促咔哒作响，几乎与那具庞大颅腔内无穷无尽的演算节拍一致。加固的外壳上，微型太阳能板仿佛在贪婪地吸吮周遭的光线。
An insect of shifting alloys towers over you. The firm carapace leads up to a complex head bearing a variety of measurement lasers and shortwave radar arrays. Four lithe pincers click rapidly, almost in time with the infinite calculations taking place within the construct’s massive cranium. Across the reinforced hull, miniature solar panels seem to suck in the surrounding light.

God Of Renewal.name:
复苏之神
God Of Renewal

Text.text:
他在地平线上缓缓升起，鼓舞所有在白昼中生活的人。每当艰辛或竞逐、倦怠或创作之后的睡眠结束，他便现身——披着晨曦与希望，头戴一顶时髦的昏绒天鹅绒帽，缀满拂晓星光；玫瑰与蜜桃色的马甲罩在天青色工衫之上；穿着结实的马裤与工靴。他的笑容即使在雨中也能催人振作，他的灵感凌驾于风暴之上，他奉上生命之饮与清晨的欢迎。
He ascends gradually over the horizon to encourage all who live by day. After the sleep that follows hardship or competition, doldrum or artistry, he appears—dressed in sunrise and hope, a fashionable hat of dusky velvet covered in dawn stars, a vest of rose and peach over a sky-blue workshirt, practical breeches and work boots. His smile encourages even through rain, his inspiration surpasses the storm, and he offers the drink of life and the welcome of the morning.

Seedy Tavern: A Busy Night.name:
肮脏酒馆：忙碌之夜
Seedy Tavern: A Busy Night

Text.text:
客人们肩挨着肩挤作一团，把这间肮脏昏暗的酒馆塞得水泄不通，醉醺醺的喧嚣声震耳欲聋。烟斗吐出的烟雾在室内凝成一层薄霭，让本就晦暗的光线更沉一分——只剩几支快要熄灭的蜡烛忽明忽暗，和壁炉里将死未死的一点余火。你没看到有人擦桌收杯，看来想要有人招呼，只能自己挤到吧台去。
The crowd of customers press shoulder to shoulder, filling the dingy tavern with a drunken din. A haze of pipe smoke fills the room, darkening an already dim interior, lit only by guttering candles and a dying fire. You don’t see anyone cleaning tables or reclaiming mugs, so it looks like you’ll have to make your way to the bar to get service.

Arctic Goblin Battle Sleigh.name:
北境地精战斗雪橇
Arctic Goblin Battle Sleigh

Text.text:
一辆锈迹斑斑的雪橇猛然闯入视野，腐蚀的滑刃在冰面上尖叫着打滑横甩，几头狼拖拽着它一路狂冲。雪橇里，一群裹着结块毛皮的地精尖声怪叫，挥舞着粗陋的长矛，陶醉于这失控颠簸带来的混乱快感。领头狼泡沫翻涌的唇间咕哝出低沉的咆哮，它用感官捕捉到附近的猎物——随即直直朝你冲来。

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

A rusting sleigh careens into view, skidding across the ice on corroding blades as wolves pull it onward. Within the curious vehicle, goblins clad in matted furs whoop and holler as they brandish crude spears, relishing the chaotic nature of their movements. A guttural snarl burbles from the frothing lips of the lead wolf as it senses prey nearby—and heads straight for you.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Serpent Venom In A Thin Glass Bottle.name:
细长玻璃瓶中的蛇毒
Serpent Venom In A Thin Glass Bottle

Text.text:
细长的玻璃长瓶里，翠绿的液体中气泡翻卷浮旋。瓶口软木塞两侧布满焦黑灼痕，昭示着毒液未加掩饰的凶猛威力。一旦启封，瓶口逸散的蒸汽便会刺痛灼烧任何暴露的皮肤。只有一点毋庸置疑：这毒药是一件令人胆寒的武器。
Bubbles swirl through the green liquid in the long thin glass bottle. Black scorch marks mar the sides of the cork stopper, displaying the raw potency of the venom. Once uncapped, the vapors that emanate from the opening sting and burn any exposed flesh. One thing is clear: this poison is a terrifying weapon.

Planetar Casting Blade Barrier.name:
行星天使施放：刀刃结界
Planetar Casting Blade Barrier

Text.text:
星界天使收拢双翼，将巨剑绕身旋转成一道弧形螺旋，同时吟诵一句天界真言。成群的祖母绿光之剑——与巨剑如出一辙的双生之刃——自天使翠绿的肌肤上迸发，循着巨剑的轨迹齐齐飞旋。这些利刃在星界天使凝望之处汇聚，化作一堵狂舞的刀剑之墙。
The planetar folds their wings, spinning a greatsword in an arcing spiral about their body, and incanting a Celestial word. Swords of emerald light, twins of the greatsword, spring from the angel’s green skin in multitudes, mimicking the path of the greatsword. These blades gather where the planetar gazes, forming a wall of whirling blades.

你将盐粒撒在尸身上，盐如雪般落在残躯之上。你把一对铜制钱币覆在眼睑之上。随着法术封缄逝者，空气里掠过一声短促、几乎难以察觉的低鸣。
You sprinkle salt over the corpse, and it falls like snow upon the remains. Upon the eyes, you place a pair of copper coins. There's a brief, almost imperceptible hum as the spell seals the departed.

Azuza Itlzti.name:
阿祖扎·伊尔茨蒂
Azuza Itlzti

Text.text:
Azuza 是一名中年人类女性，体型轻盈灵活，深色头发齐肩剪裁，眼睛像一对金色钱币般闪亮。她起初显得含蓄，甚至有点害羞——但这层伪装很容易被看穿。她的笑容里藏着凶狠却细微的戏谑，举手投足间带着致命的优雅。黑色皮质护甲紧贴她健健的身形，一件以金扣别起的丝质斗篷披覆肩背。她行走时，隐约可见青铜色肌肤与细密的纹身花丝——几乎难以察觉——沿着手腕与颈侧蜿蜒攀上。

~ Played by Roxanne Sergeant with

Azuza is a middle-aged human woman with a lithe build, dark hair cropped at the shoulder, and eyes that gleam like a pair of gold coins. She appears coy at first, perhaps even a little shy—but the ruse is easily penetrated. There’s a vicious yet subtle playfulness in her smile, a deadly grace with which she gesticulates. Black leather armor hugs her athletic figure, while a silken cloak clasped with gold drapes her shoulders and back. As she moves, there’s a hint of bronze skin and fine, tattooed filigree—almost imperceptible—snaking up her wrists and neck.

~ Played by Roxanne Sergeant with

Elderly Hadrosaur.name:
年迈的鸭嘴龙
Elderly Hadrosaur

Text.text:
松弛下垂的皮肉挂在这头年迈恐龙疲惫的骨架上，每一道皱纹与褶痕都像是在书写它在平原上丰盛一生的篇章。尽管双眼被年代的浑浊蒙上薄纱，这位长者仍守夜般望着族群中的幼崽嬉戏——它们活力四射，在鸭嘴龙亲族的腿间穿梭奔跑。它满足地呼出一口气，安然伏下，打起盹来。
Loose, sagging flesh hangs from the weary bones of the elderly dinosaur, each wrinkle and fold a chapter in the tale of a life well-lived upon the plains. Though its eyes are clouded by age, the elder watches the young of the herd play, scampering between the legs of their hadrosaur kin with youthful vigor. It settles down for a nap with a contented exhale.

Zombie Clot Encounter.name:
丧尸（特征）血团遭遇
Zombie Clot Encounter

Text.text:
尸潮迅疾逼近，腐肉的呻吟与恶臭如同来袭亡灵大军的先锋，猛然击打着你的感官。它们彼此绊倒，起伏翻涌如海浪般荡漾，滚作一团不断抬升的肉山。先伸出一条手臂，继而又是一条——皆由亡者的肢体与面孔胡乱拼合而成。就在离你与伙伴仅差几步之遥时，那团巨块猛地后仰——宛如巨浪在拍碎前的最后一道浪尖——随即完全挺立，化作怪物中的怪物。它以千具僵尸合鸣般的嗥声低吼，随即猛冲而来，饥渴地想要更多躯体，好将它们纳入自己的陈列。
The horde approaches rapidly, the groaning and stink of putrid flesh striking your senses like the vanguard of the incoming army of undead. They trip over one another, undulating like waves of the sea, and roll into a rising mass. Out comes an arm, then another, both made of amalgamations of undead limbs and faces. Just short of a few paces from you and your companions, the mass rears back—like the final crest of a wave before it crashes—and stands fully upright, a monster of monsters. It groans with the voice of a thousand zombies and charges forward, hungry for more bodies to add to its menagerie.

I Use Divine Smite: Oath Of Vengeance Pa.name:
我施展【神圣惩击】：复仇誓约圣武士
I Use Divine Smite: Oath Of Vengeance Paladin

Text.text:
“我这一击，就是你覆灭的寄望城！”我厉声高喊，将正义的怒火灌入刀锋。我的狂怒化作灼烈的光芒，炙烤着长剑劈开的伤口。
“My strike is a promise of your undoing!” I cry, channeling righteous wrath into my blade. My fury becomes a searing light, scorching the wound my sword opened.

Exiled In An Arid Wasteland.name:
放逐于干涸荒原
Exiled In An Arid Wasteland

Text.text:
烈日灼烧着你的皮肤，毫不留情地压在你身上——就像酋长那道令人枯萎的目光。你的束缚被松开，血液重新流回四肢，可你却被这片土地的人民抛弃，任你漂泊；被诅咒在单色的灰烬荒原上游荡：一个被放逐的游牧者，注定死在贫瘠的沙丘之间。

~ 由 Sahlonahl 于 Discord 上 Envisioned

The sun burns your skin harshly as it bears down on you—much like the chieftain's withering gaze. Your bonds are loosened and blood returns to your extremities, but you find yourself cast adrift by the people of this land, cursed to wander the monochromatic ashen wastes: an exiled nomad doomed to die among the barren dunes.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Organic Eldritch Cannon.name:
有机邪能加农炮
Organic Eldritch Cannon

Text.text:
这件武器带着一丝尸腐的淡臭。它的躯干由一节节肋笼拼成——从炮口处的人类肋骨，一路延伸到基座那种更原始、更古老的骨架。上面胡乱披着一层肥厚的人皮毯，底缘破破烂烂、参差垂落。炮身立在蛛爪般的支架上：手臂与腿骨扭曲支撑，左右不齐，用筋膜牵拴成一体。它每一次“呼吸”都让恶臭翻涌——喷吐成柱的烈焰，抛射奥术力的爆震，或沉闷一击，震出一团护盾能量。

~ Envisioned by Nachodelamancha

The weapon smells mildly of carrion rot. Its body is a set of ribcages—human at the mouth to something primordial at the base. Thrown over it is a blanket of fatty human skin, tattered along the bottom. The cannon stands on spidery supports of arm and leg bones, asymmetrical and tethered together by sinew. The stench rises as it breathes columns of fire, launches arcane force blasts, or thumps out a burst of shield energy.

~ Envisioned by Nachodelamancha

霉味的黑貂毛覆在磨损破碎的丝绸之上，尽管如此，披上仍能暖住肩头，沉沉压在胸前，驱寒极好，适合各式各样的旅行天气。可这衣物总太容易从肩上滑落，或又夹得人发紧、扭绞不休。披肩猛地箍住一条手臂，死也不肯松开。几乎像是它的纤维有了生命——而且怒火冲天，怒得发狂。
Musty sable over frayed and worn silk, it nevertheless warms the shoulders and wraps heavy across the breast, good for chills and all sorts of travel weather. Yet the garment slips too easily from a shoulder, or pinches and twists. The stole grips an arm and won’t let go. It’s almost as if its fibers are alive—and very, very angry.

Desert: Tracked By A Beast.name:
沙漠：被野兽追踪
Desert: Tracked By A Beast

Text.text:
沙漠那绝望的狂风已平息成更寻常的劲吹，让你得以听见沙粒在你衣襟上、在周遭沙丘间摩挲嬉响。其上，你听见悠长而刺耳的喘息，还有什么东西在沙里拖行——就在你身后某处。接着，一声遥远的低吼，随之而来的是仿佛溅起水花的声响，像是某个庞然大物一头扎进沙浪里。下一声咆哮已近在耳畔——近得不可思议，近得太过分了。
The desperate wind of the desert has calmed into a more general bluster, allowing you to hear the play of grains of sand on your clothes and the dunes around you. Over this you hear long, harsh breaths, and something dragging in the sand, somewhere behind you. Then a distant growl, and sound like a splash, as if a great body dove into the waves of sand. The next roar you hear is close—far, far too close.

Better-than-life Chips.name:
超越现实的芯片
Better-than-life Chips

Text.text:
这些程序芯片被设计用来改写VR硬件的现实限制器。它们具现的模拟以逐步清晰、愈发明亮的阶段渲染展开：边缘变得锐利；色彩不断加深。用户的设备套件在超频处理器与自身汗水的双重烘烤下发热。魅影般的微风让他们打个寒战，嗅觉神经在十几种仿制气味里大失败。感官在欣快的过载刺激中嗡嗡震颤——在这片虚拟现实里，一切确实如广告所言：胜过人生。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

These program chips are built to override VR hardware’s reality limiters. The simulations they manifest render in phases of progressive clarity and brightness. Edges sharpen; colors intensify. The user’s kit heats up with overclocked processors and their own sweat. Phantom breezes make them shiver, and their olfactory nerves fumble a dozen imitation scents. Their senses vibrate with euphoric overstimulation in a virtual reality that is truly, as advertised, better than life.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Temple To A Goddess Of Misfortune.name:
厄运女神的神殿
Temple To A Goddess Of Misfortune

Text.text:
你步入大厅，只见众人一边啜泣一边哀号，悲恸的呼喊此起彼伏。“苦役者！”一名忏悔者敬畏地低语，指向那位立在会众面前的神殿司祭——他们蒙着眼，手腕与脚踝被金色镣铐锁住。司祭双颊刺着泪痕般的纹身，嘴角挂着阴毒的笑。他们用布满伤疤、鲜血淋漓的手指捧着一只带刺的笼子，里头塞满施舍之物，在信徒凄厉的恸哭声中放肆地咯咯大笑。
You enter the hall to find everyone weeping their exclamations of grief. “The Drudge!” whispers a penitent with awe, pointing out the temple priest who stands blindfolded before the congregants, their wrists and ankles shackled in golden manacles. The priest wears tattoos of tear-streams on their cheeks and a wicked grin. They hold a spiked cage full of alms between scarred and bleeding fingers and cackle, unabashed, amidst the worshipers' keening.

在一棵巨大的橡树下，祂低声哼着小调。一个肤色深邃、身形修长的生物挺立其间，宛如一株优雅的幼树向天生长。纤细的骨架流淌着从容的柔韧；剪裁考究的皮质护甲之下垂着精致衣饰，随微风拂动，像秋叶轻舞。那双锐利的眼睛里，乌檀般的瞳仁镶着一圈翠绿光晕，轻易便将你拽入其晦秘的深处。祂的耳朵细长尖锐，如同异界之树的叶片，被一枚精巧的环扣在脑后合拢；耳尖微颤，仿佛正听见另一位超自然低语的秘密，也在二元之中昭示着合一。祂没有头发，光洁的面容泄露出一丝羞怯的脆弱。指节蜷握着一把华丽的弩——意志的暴烈延伸——而其中一根手指上戴着一枚怪异的戒指，或许掩藏着尚未言说的谜团。

~ Played by Nathan

Humming to themself beneath a large oak, a slender dark-skinned creature stands tall, like an elegant sapling reaching for the sky. Their slight frame bleeds graceful fluidity, and beneath well-made leather armor hang fine garments, dancing like autumn leaves in a gentle breeze. Piercing eyes possess pupils of ebony adorned with a verdant halo, easily drawing you into their enigmatic depths. Ears, elongated and pointed like the leaves of an otherworldly tree are clasped together behind their head with a fine ring. They twitch as if hearing secrets whispered by another supernatural while symbolizing unity amid duality. Absent of hair, their bald visage discloses a shy vulnerability. Their fingers curl about an ornate crossbow—a violent extension of their will—and upon one digit sits a strange ring, concealing perhaps mysteries untold.

~ Played by Nathan

阳光穿过高耸的树冠倾泻而下，在这条穿行林间的岩石小径上投下斑驳光影；盘根错节的树根横亘其间，蜿蜒引路。开花的灌木嗡嗡作响，蜜蜂穿梭其间，枝条伸展到路上方，织成一道道绚丽的彩色拱门；小径边缘的阴影里，鲜翠的蕨类簇拥成丛，贴着路肩铺开。整体效果美得令人屏息，仿佛大自然特意为某些森林精灵的婚礼铺就了一条新婚之路。
Sunlight streams through tall trees to dapple this rocky, root-crossed pathway wending through the woodland. Flowering bushes, buzzing with bees, stretch branches out over the path in colorful arcs, while vibrant green ferns crowd in their shadows near the trail. The whole effect is one of breathtaking beauty, as if nature created a nuptial path for the marriage of some forest spirits.

木柄被反复涂刷过好几次，末端与靠近刃口处仍可见旧漆层的条痕——蓝、黄、红交错斑驳。握持的中段被手掌长期摩挲得光滑，汗渍浸透，漆面磨尽，露出粗朴的原木。刀刃保养得很好，开刃处与内侧弧线都泛着冷亮的光泽。有人在谷仓里把它小心地挂在几根钉子上，刀刃朝上。
The handle has been painted several times, and streaks of the old layers—blue, yellow, red—are visible on the end and near the blade. The middle is hand-worn smooth to sweat-stained raw wood. The blade is well-kept, shiny at the sharpened edge and along the inside curve. Someone has hung it carefully on nails, blade up, inside the barn.

Finding A Sun Blade In The Dread Vale.name:
在恐惧谷中寻得日耀之刃
Finding A Sun Blade In The Dread Vale

Text.text:
在幽暗的枝叶间，有什么东西捕捉到稀薄的光线并将其放大，几乎像在闪烁。凑近细看，显露出一把剑的华丽剑柄，繁复纹饰由纯净的铂金精雕而成。你将这物体举起才发现，它其实只有剑柄——曾经应有的剑刃之处，如今只剩水晶碎裂后的断片。然而，空气中弥漫的却不是失落，而是一种压抑的兴奋。仿佛再也按捺不住，一道锋锐刺目的光之刃从剑柄中迸发，骤然照亮你昏暗的周遭。

~ 一位英雄所构想

Amid the dark foliage, something catches the sparse light and magnifies it, almost twinkling. Closer inspection reveals the ornate hilt of a sword, its intricate designs cut from sterling platinum. Raising the object shows that it is in fact only a hilt—where once there was a blade remains only splintered fragments of crystal. And yet a sense of muted excitement, rather than disappointment, seems to fill the air. As if unable to contain itself any longer, a blade of piercing light bursts from the hilt, suddenly illuminating your dim surroundings.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

辛辣刺鼻的气味自暮色中的沼泽升腾而起，腐烂与秽物交织成一股咸涩的腥臭。漂浮的藻膜为平静的水面染上一层幽幽的鬼绿，唯有潜行巡弋的蛇影掠过时，才偶尔荡起涟漪——以及更为卑劣骇人的东西。人在肮脏的泥潭中映出的倒影也变得阴魂不散、眼窝深陷，惊人地像一张骷髅面孔。
An acrid odor rises from the twilit fens, a brackish mingling of rot and refuse. A slick of algae lends a ghostly green tinge to the placid water, rippling only occasionally with the passing of prowling serpents and things viler still. One’s reflection in the grimy bog takes on a haunted, sunken-eyed appearance, startlingly skull-like.

Alarms Sound Throughout Building.name:
警报声响彻整栋建筑
Alarms Sound Throughout Building

Text.text:
短暂的静默之后，刺耳的警报骤然炸响，响到足以震得桌上杂物叮当乱颤。每一次尖鸣都几乎带着回声般的拖曳，整栋建筑里其他房间的喇叭也在相差不到一瞬的间隔里接连响起。
A moment of silence, and then there’s a blaring siren loud enough to rattle the clutter on the tables. Each ring of the alarm almost echoes, the klaxons from other rooms throughout the building beginning fractions of a second after one another.

Dwarven Mess Hall.name:
矮人食堂
Dwarven Mess Hall

Text.text:
洞穴般的穹顶将食堂里的喧嚣放大了两倍。矮人士兵举杯祝酒，唱着豪饮的酒歌，扯着嗓子要更多上好的食物与麦酒。一张长长的石桌——两端都精雕细刻着蓄须矮人的面孔——在巧制的枝形烛台照耀下，摆满令人垂涎的炖菜、辛香的肉食与黑面包。矮人的匠艺自豪地铺陈在每一处：从巨大、熊熊燃烧的壁炉，到墙上陈列的传奇纹章、武器与护甲，无不昭示着他们的荣耀。

~ 构想：Battersby

The cavernous ceiling multiplies the noise in the mess hall twofold. Dwarven soldiers make toasts, sing drinking songs, and call out for more good food and ale. A long stone table—meticulously carved with bearded dwarven faces at each end—holds a feast of mouthwatering stews, spiced meats, and black bread, lit by cunningly wrought candelabras. Dwarven craftsmanship is proudly displayed everywhere, from the vast, blazing hearth to the legendary sigils, weapons, and armor mounted on the walls.

~ Envisioned by Battersby

你扭动那枚雕花繁复的黄铜握柄，修长而优雅的手杖“咔哒”一声弹开。抛光的木质杖身顺势滑落，藏在暗匣般杖鞘里的细剑毫不费力地抽出，寒光一线。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The long, elegant cane pops open with a click as you twist the ornately wrought brass handle. The polished wooden body falls away and a rapier slides effortlessly free of the clandestine sheath within.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Tournament Wealthy Knight.name:
锦标赛的富豪骑士
Tournament Wealthy Knight

Text.text:
圣洁的侍从们先于他们的主人而行，年轻的面庞却傲然如君，扬手将玫瑰花瓣洒落沙地。银亮的护甲在阳光下熠熠生辉，丝绸罩袍以金线绣饰；骑士立于马镫之上，发髻精心梳整并扑了粉，贵族般的五官带着矜持而浮夸的疏离。
Immaculate squires precede their master, their youthful faces imperious as they toss rose petals on the sand. With silvered armor gleaming in the sunlight, silken surcoat embroidered with gold, the knight stands in their stirrups, coiffured hair powdered, patrician features pompously aloof.

这名高大的类人生物握着一根刃杖，电流在其上搏动。它芥末般的肤色外裹着单薄松垮的衣物，蹼足支撑着身体前后摇晃。喉间残存的退化鳃裂暗示着水栖（特征）的过往，而如今，这生物似乎进化出一层细密的黄色绒毛，为躯体御寒。额头上盘旋着一道神秘印记，如紫色烙痕般扭曲翻卷，向外散逸着负能量。
This tall humanoid bears a bladed staff throbbing with electricity. Mustard colored and clad in thin, limp clothing, they sway back and forth on webbed feet. Vestigial gills at the throat hint of an aquatic past, but now the creature seems to have evolved a fine down of yellow hair to insulate their body from the cold. A mystical marking swirls on their forehead like a purple brand, emanating negative energy.

巨大的窗扉将自然光倾泻进这座拱顶大厅，旁侧的铁架上方悬着如火炬般的火焰，无烟无息，为室内更添明亮。倾斜的书桌整齐成行，桌面摆着纸本书册或羊皮纸卷；两侧的边桌则放着羽毛笔、钢笔、画笔，以及各色墨水。
Huge windows provide natural light throughout the vaulted chamber, augmented by torch-like flames that hover, smokeless, above iron stands next to the desks. Arranged in tidy rows, the angled desktops hold books of paper or sheets of vellum while side tables contain quills, pens, brushes, and various inks.

Dance Club With Discordant Electronic Mu.name:
不和谐电子乐回荡的舞蹈俱乐部
Dance Club With Discordant Electronic Music

Text.text:
夜店里挤满了舞者，他们拼命让自己的动作跟上那踉跄的节拍。音乐被轰到足以把你的思绪都震碎的音量，震得脑海一片空白。DJ的选曲里几乎抓不到任何旋律线，糟到让人怀疑那种缺乏真正韵律的感觉是刻意为之——而且几乎令人佩服。
The club is filled with dancers doing their best to match the lurching rhythm of the music being blasted at a volume loud enough to block out your own thoughts. It's hard to pinpoint any kind of melody in the DJ's choices, to the point that the lack of real cadence must be intentional—and almost impressive.

Harpy Nest.name:
鸟身女妖巢穴
Harpy Nest

Text.text:
狂风抽打着你的衣襟，这座高崖的边缘锯齿般狰狞，近在咫尺。你稳住身形，俯身望向由枝条与荆棘胡乱盘成的一圈巢穴——大得足以容下一辆马车的卧榻。一股浓烈的膻腥直冲鼻腔，你这才在天然材料间瞥见几片布料：一截裤腿、一张污秽的地毯、一件溅满褐色污渍的衬衫。巢穴中央摆着一打蛋，斑驳带粉——每一枚都有婴儿般大小。巢外还有些蛋被丢弃在冰冷的岩面上，蛋壳碎裂，里面的东西正淌落出来。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The wind whips at your clothes, the edge of this high cliff jagged and close. Holding steady, you peer into the messy circle of branches and brambles that make up a nest as large as a carriage bed. A strong musk assaults your nose as you notice bits of fabric amidst the natural materials: a pant leg, a filthy rug, a shirt splattered with brown stains. In the nest’s center sits a dozen eggs, mottled and pink—each the size of an infant. Outside the nest, some eggs have been discarded to the cold rock, shells shattered and contents dripping.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Pursuant Lieutenant Arabella Molliner.name:
候补中尉阿拉贝拉·莫利纳
Pursuant Lieutenant Arabella Molliner

Text.text:
她一身黑衣，手持一根近两英尺长的乌木魔杖。它看起来像一枝黑玫瑰的茎，握柄上方满覆尖刺。她怒意翻涌地挥使着它，修长笔直、丝滑的紫发坠落在她收束长外套的羽饰披肩之上。她身侧挂着一柄银色细剑，篮式剑首以精致的花丝镂雕织就。她整个人严肃得近乎冷硬，面容如同一张怒光四射的面具，双眼几乎从不眨动。
She wears all black and carries an ebony wand nearly two feet long. It looks like the stem of a black rose, covered in thorns above the handle. She wields it furiously, her long, straight, and silky purple hair falling over the feather mantle of her tapered coat. At her side is a silver rapier with a basket pommel of fine filigree. She is altogether serious, her face a glaring mask with eyes that seldom blink.

Overheard Story About A Lost Elven Love.name:
关于失落精灵恋情的窃听传闻
Overheard Story About A Lost Elven Love

Text.text:
“——每一次移动都那样优雅；他们笑起来时，头会微微一歪；那双巨大的眼睛里，盛着亘古不灭的智慧。与他们在一起时，我仿佛能活到永远。但时代仍在向前，我们的差异终究变得令人无法承受。那双始终注视的眼睛渐渐盈满哀伤，仿佛我的死亡就在转角处等着。我偶尔仍会看见他们；至少，我以为我看见了。当我在林间徘徊，心会短暂地再次轻盈起来，仿佛他们正在注视。我承认，没有了我的挚爱，生活确实褪去了一点颜色；可与他们相伴，也让我明白，还有多少别的色调值得细细品味。”
“—such grace in every movement, the slight tilt to their head when they laughed, those enormous eyes filled with the wisdom of eternity. When I was with them, I felt like I would live forever. But time goes on, and our differences eventually became too much to bear. Those ever-watchful eyes became filled with sorrow as if my death lay just around the corner. I still see them sometimes; at least, I think I do. When I wander the woods, my heart will momentarily become light once more as if they were watching. I will admit life has lost a bit of its color without my love, but being with them taught me how many other shades there are to appreciate.”

Razed Small Village.name:
被夷为平地的小村庄
Razed Small Village

Text.text:
曾几何时，这里还是个家家户户与牲畜和睦共生的小村，如今只剩灰烬。整座村庄被纵火焚毁，凡是在烈焰过后仍勉强屹立的残存建筑，也被人以冷酷而刻意的手法彻底砸烂，碎成无用的瓦砾。你看见村子正中央的地面被挖出一个巨大的深坑。那片卑劣的空间里，会藏着什么？
Where once a hamlet of families and livestock lived in harmony, there is now ash. This village has been put to the torch, and any standing structures that remained after the conflagration were brutally smashed apart with deliberate care. You spy an enormous pit dug into the ground at the center of the village. What might you find in that ignoble space?

Flint The Barbarian.name:
燧石，野蛮人
Flint The Barbarian

Text.text:
他是火与石：这名宽肩男人的皮肤像一层冷却后的熔岩硬壳。那看似仍在流淌的物质藏在他笑纹与其他皱褶里；类似的裂隙也爬过他的前臂与双手——在他那身农夫的粗朴衣装未能遮住皮肤的地方。头发垂至肩头，口周则修得短些，宛如细密的黑曜石丝线；而他那对棕色、泛着光泽的眼珠像硬质的圆石，难以读懂。他扛着一柄长柄钩镰作长兵器，像是平民被拽上战场、成了步兵。更添异界之感的是，他身周的空气并不散热，反倒以潜伏的能量在细微地嗡鸣。

~ Played by a Hero

He is fire and stone, this broad-shouldered man with skin like a crust of cooled lava. What looks like molten material is in his laugh lines and other wrinkles, with similar fissures marking his forearms and hands where his clothing, the garb of a farmer, doesn’t cover his skin. His hair, shoulder length on his head and short surrounding his mouth, is like fine filaments of obsidian, and the brown, shiny orbs of his eyes are hard to read. He carries a long-hafted billhook as a polearm, akin to a commoner turned foot soldier. Adding to his otherworldliness, the air around him thrums subtly with latent energy rather than heat.

~ Played by a Hero

Treasure Map And Nautical Tools.name:
宝藏地图与航海工具
Treasure Map And Nautical Tools

Text.text: 一支蜡烛照亮摊开的海岛地图，一枚鲜红的 X 标记着它南岸附近的一处地点。航海所需的一切导航工具都已备齐，包括罗盘与星盘。器具以深沉华贵的木料与黄铜雕制而成，崭新得像刚出炉，又或被悉心打理得一尘不染。 A candle illuminates the spread map of an island, with a bright red X marking a spot near its southern shore. All the necessary tools for nautical navigation are gathered, including a compass and astrolabe. The tools are carved of richly dark wood and brass, appearing newly made or very well-kept.

I Avoid A Bladed Trap.name:
我躲开了一处刀刃陷阱
I Avoid A Bladed Trap

Text.text:
当我敏锐的感官意识到自己身处险境时，一阵寒意顺着脊背窜上来。我猛地扑倒在地，头顶掠过一阵疾风——一枚旋转的利刃呼啸而过，将我方才站立的空间一分为二。我长长、缓缓地吐出一口气，压下翻涌的心绪，这才重新站起身来。
A shiver runs up my spine as my honed senses realize I am in danger. Throwing myself to the ground, there’s a rush of air above me as a whirling blade passes overhead, bisecting the space I was just standing. I exhale a long, slow breath to steady my nerves before getting back up.

Stygia, The Fifth Circle Of Hell.name:
冥狱，地狱第五环
Stygia, The Fifth Circle Of Hell

Text.text:
你听见一阵漫长的金属刮擦声。它们从黑暗里缓慢蹒跚而出，面容因狂怒而扭曲，身上只披着几片粗劣铁质护甲的残片。天空是灰色的暮光，正被夜色吞没；它们旅行的地面是一片巨大的冰封湖，湖水由一条宽阔幽暗的河流灌入。它们是暴怒者的灵魂，漫无目的地游荡，直到其中两具相遇。它们咒骂、威胁，怒火把它们耗得精疲力竭，谁也抬不起武器。于是它们继续前行，把刀刃拖在黑湖的冰面上，低吼着，牙关咬得咯咯作响。
You hear a long metallic scraping sound. They shamble from the dark slowly, faces twisted in fury, each clad in a few scraps of poor-quality iron armor. The sky is gray twilight giving way to night, and the surface they travel is a giant frozen lake fed by a broad dark river. These are the soulds of the angry, wandering aimlessly until two of them meet. They curse and threaten, so exhausted from their anger that neither can lift a weapon. So they walk on, dragging their blades along the frozen surface of the black lake, growling and grinding their teeth.

石墙巍然耸立，厚实坚固。城垛之上，哨兵持长弓与长矛警戒巡望。墙体高低纵横布满射孔，宽度仅容箭矢或矛尖穿出，却又狭窄到不足以削弱结构。城门本身沉重如山，以橡木打造，铁箍缠束，紧紧封死以拒来犯。唯此一处入口前，两名守卫持矛伫立，锋刃随时可出，眼神疲惫却依旧锐利。
The stone walls stand sturdy and thick. On the ramparts sentinels stand watch, armed with longbow and spear. Murder holes line the height and width of the walls, just wide enough for an arrow or spearhead to slip through, but too narrow to weaken the structure. The gate itself, heavy and oaken, is banded with iron and sealed tight against intruders. A pair of guards stand watch over this sole entrance, spears at the ready, eyes weary yet sharp.

Black Dragon Wyrmling On Hunt.name:
狩猎中的黑龙幼龙
Black Dragon Wyrmling On Hunt

Text.text:
油亮的黑色鳞片掩蔽着幼龙的身躯，他在沼泽丰饶的水域间潜行，鳞光粼粼。毒绿的眼睛死死锁定一只倒霉的两栖生物——它还沉浸在安逸里，浑然不知死期将至。幼龙猛然扑上，叼住青蛙像甩破布娃娃般一阵猛抡——却又放它逃走。巨龙邪笑着，一边用利爪掰着数，看着青蛙游远；随即悄然没入水下，在翻涌的泡沫与血色乱流中，将那惊恐的生物吞噬殆尽。
Glossy black scales cover the wyrmling’s body, shimmering as he stalks through the fecund waters of the marsh. Virulent green eyes fixate on a hapless amphibian blissfully unaware of its impending doom. The wyrmling pounces, grabbing the frog and shaking it like a ragdoll—before allowing it to escape. The dragon smiles wickedly, counting on his claws as the frog swims away, before slipping beneath the water to devour the terrified creature in a tumult of foam and blood.

Dhalmiir Ravencloak.name:
达尔米尔·鸦披风
Dhalmiir Ravencloak

Text.text:
法师怔怔出神，嘴角挂着一抹揶揄的笑意，思绪早已飘向心灵深处的幽远。他披着皮质风衣，倚着一根浅色木杖，杖身纹理间爬着蓝色脉络般的线条。一只小魔鬼的皮肤呈现出与主人眼眸同样的宝蓝，正顽皮地拽着那人炭黑的头发。法师抬手轻轻一拍将它止住，指尖边缘泛起湛蓝的微光。

~ Played by Rance Mirksha with

The mage stares absently with a wry smile at the corner of his mouth, his thoughts far gone into the reaches of his mind.
