He wears a leather duster and leans on a staff of light-colored wood veined with blue lines. An imp with skin the same royal blue as his master’s eyes tugs on the man’s charcoal-black hair in a playful manner. The mage stops him with a gentle bat of his hand, the edges of his fingertips glowing azure.

~ Played by Rance Mirksha with

I Activate My Adrenaline Pump.name:
我启动肾上腺素泵
I Activate My Adrenaline Pump

Text.text:
只要一个痛苦的念头就够了。我深深、锐利地吸气，腹部猛地绷紧。尖锐而扩散的剧痛灌满我的太阳神经丛。呼气，疼痛便无处不在。整片肌群接连爆响、抽搐，瞳孔骤然放大，青筋骇人地鼓起。吸气，然后……狂喜。肾上腺素在血液里奔涌，逼得人不得不觉得自己超越凡躯。我一头扎进战场，胸口那道紧箍般的压迫感并不温柔地提醒着我：无敌的倒计时，正在无声跳动。
All it takes is one painful thought. With a deep, sharp breath, I tightly clench my abdomen. Sharp, radiating pain floods my solar plexus. Breathe out, and the pain is everywhere. Entire muscle groups pop and spasm, pupils dilate, and veins bulge unnervingly. Breathe in, and… euphoria. The surge of adrenaline coursing through my blood makes it impossible not to feel superhuman. I rush headlong into battle, a tight squeeze around my chest not so gently reminding me of the silent timer to my invincibility.

Distant Volcanic Eruption Destroys City.name:
遥远的火山爆发摧毁了整座城市
Distant Volcanic Eruption Destroys City

Text.text:
群山呈粉笔般的灰白，点缀着零星植被，可其上方却有烟柱翻涌，如握紧的巨拳般一团团腾起。灰与黑的烟雾随即变了颜色，喷溅出凝血般的碎片，转瞬又化作刺目的鲜红。下方城中，街道迅速被人潮挤满。警钟长鸣。山顶仿佛铁匠的熔炉炸裂，熔融岩浆从炉口边缘滚落，沿着漆黑的山坡倾泻而下，一路熔化、灼烧，闯入城中；而城池最终在漫天灰烬的云雾里死去。

~ 由 Ethan Envisioned

The mountain is chalky gray and dotted with vegetation, but smoke is billowing from it in turning fists. Then the shades of gray and black smoke change to spraying fragments the color of coagulated blood, quickly changing to bright red. Below, in the city, the streets fill. Alarm bells sound. The top of the mountain looks as if a smith’s furnace has exploded. Molten rock rolls from the rim of the furnace, pouring down the black mountainside, melting and burning its way into the city, which dies in the clouds of ash.

~ Envisioned by Ethan

Way Of The Word.name:
言语之道
Way Of The Word

Text.text:
巨人横陈死地，庞大的负载缓缓下沉，脚下的大地不堪重负般呻吟着。武器从它的躯体上刺出，穿透那被天气侵蚀的皮肉，没入它过分臃肿的装饰与束缚之间。它巨硕的面容因痛苦与狂怒而扭曲成一张面具，车轮般巨大的眼睛死死钉住你，仿佛在无声质问：“为什么？”
The giant lies dead, its colossal bulk slowly sinking into the protesting ground below. Weapons protrude from its body, finding the weather-worn flesh amid the giant’s oversized trappings. A mask of pain and rage creases its gargantuan features, and eyes the size of wagon wheels bore into your own as if asking: “Why?”

I Cast Acid Splash.name:
我施放酸液飞溅
I Cast Acid Splash

Text.text:
我把握成拳的手往后一拉，念出咒语的瞬间，口中立刻涌满灼烫的唾液，牙齿刺痛。紧接着，血液沿着手臂一路发痒，我的手掌像被火烙般燃烧。我打出一记武技突击，猛然向前贯出，收势时拳头迅速张开。令人作呕的绿色气泡飞射而出，像气球般鼓胀膨大，随即在目标头顶炸裂，酸灼般烧蚀他们；与此同时，我的身躯迅速回清归位，已为下一道法术蓄势待发。
As I pull back a balled fist and speak the incantation, my mouth fills with burning spittle, teeth stinging. Then my blood itches down my arm. My hand burns. I throw a martial strike, thrusting forward, ending with a quickly opened fist. Out flies the sickening green bubble, inflating like a balloon. It bursts over my targets and burns them, while my body clears and readies for the next spell.

Brothers Meet After A Century Apart.name:
百年离别后，兄弟重逢
Brothers Meet After A Century Apart

Text.text:
“哟，这不是金童吗。咱们分开这些年，你倒是长开了……更肥、更软，像头等着开膛的猪。想当年我竟把你当神一样，站在父母之爱的基座上，居高临下俯视我。可我已踏过深渊永恒的暮色，直面那儿蠕动的恐怖，并把它们——尖叫着——缚进我的意志。我见过上帝的脸，哥哥，然后我把它整个吞了。你为我骄傲吗？你为什么那样看我？无所谓。我来这里，是为了结束我们这场小小的较量，让你灰飞烟灭。可现在……我什么都看不见了。”

~ 由 Dap 构想

“Well, if it isn’t the golden child. You have certainly grown in our time apart… fatter, softer, like a pig prime for butchering. To think I used to see you as a god, staring down on me from the pedestal of our parent’s love. But I have walked in the eternal twilight of the abyss, I have faced the writhing horrors that await us there, and I have bound them—screaming—to my will. I saw the face of God, big brother, and I swallowed it whole. Are you proud of me? Why do you look at me so? It doesn’t matter. I came here to end our little competition, to disintegrate you. But now… I see nothing at all.”

~ Envisioned by Dap

Large City Inn.name:
大城旅店
Large City Inn

Text.text:
一名看上去百无聊赖的店员坐在一张狭长的亮漆木柜台后，柜台几乎横贯整间屋子。你踏入这座位于城中心的大旅店时，他们只抬眼瞥了你一下。店员身后的墙上钉着一块巨大的软木板，上面展示着数量惊人的钥匙；每把钥匙都用铁丝套在一块小木牌上，木牌表面刻着对应的号码。柜台对面，一名膀大腰圆的汉子懒散地抽着烟斗，身旁停着一辆行李推车，随时等着派上用场。置身这种地方，你能预料到每间客房都空洞而千篇一律：价格公道、打扫得还算干净的栖身之所，只是带着点浆洗过头的僵硬与冷淡的疏离感。
A bored-looking clerk sits behind a long, lacquered wood desk stretching the width of the room. They look up briefly as you enter this large inn in the heart of the city. Behind them, a large corkboard showcasing an incredible assortment of keys has been mounted on the wall, each key looped with wire to a small wooden plaque featuring a number carved into its surface. Sitting on a stool opposite the desk clerk, a burly individual idly smokes a pipe—a baggage cart at their side for when it is necessary. Within such an establishment you can expect a soulless uniformity to every room, a reasonably clean shelter at a reasonable price, if a bit starched and impersonal.

高耸的行会会馆与其富有主人们的宅邸和商铺环绕着这片鹅卵石铺就的广场。它们的立面映照出主人的权势与富足——每一座建筑都将一处独特而繁复的装饰融入自身结构之中。广场中央，水灵的石质面孔喷吐清泉，注入一方八角水池。
Tall guild houses and the homes and shops of their wealthy owners surround this cobbled square. Their façades reflect the power and prosperity of their owners, as each structure incorporates a unique intricate decoration into its architecture. At the center of the square, the stone faces of water spirits spew water into an octagonal pool.

The Detection Of Desecrated Ground.name:
亵渎之地的侦测
The Detection Of Desecrated Ground

Text.text:
在一次本该简单的魔法探查之中，你却隐约嗅到一丝阴冷的恶意。此地处处可见象征性的布局痕迹——那是更早一个时代的虔敬景观。然而其上又覆起一座更近世的建筑：一间钱庄。它以买卖之气冲淡了古老的神术，原本刻入圣土的语言，如今被沉甸甸钱袋踏出的杂乱足印踩得面目全非。
From an otherwise simple magical inquiry you feel a sinister tinge. This place shows signs of symbolic design, a landscape of devotion from an earlier time. Built over it, however, is a more current construction: a counting house. It dilutes the ancient theomancy with commerce, and the language carved into the hallowed earth is now a chaos of footprints made deep by heavy purses.

Gritty Medieval World Setting.name:
粗粝而写实的中世纪世界设定
Gritty Medieval World Setting

Text.text:
乌鸦在瘟疫坑里高高堆叠的腐尸间啄食，跳过一具又一具尸体，把眼珠当作熟透的浆果般啄出，沉溺于这场食腐的盛宴。沮丧的农民双眼黯淡、面容憔悴，木然地在村中游荡，在困顿不堪的活路里绝望地寻找一点意义。他们扛着锈蚀的农具，走向环绕村庄的泥泞田地，拼命盼着日复一日的折腰苦役能结出果实，盼着那点微薄的收成能让他们熬过迅速逼近的寒冬。队伍里有一人忽然弯腰剧咳，血沫从口中迸出——鲜亮的猩红染透了他破烂的粗麻短袄。其余人几乎不曾侧目，那不幸之人便倒进烂泥里，眼神空洞地盯着路旁的深坑——不久后他也将成为其中的一部分。你会从污泥中挺身而起，寻得荣光，还是会被这片土地的苦难碾碎生机，终也扑倒在泥潭里，被遗忘、孑然一身？时代自会给出答案。
Crows pick at rotting bodies piled high in the plague pit, hopping from corpse to corpse, plucking out eyes like ripe berries, reveling in their carrion feast. Despondent peasants, eyes dark and haggard, wander listlessly through the village, desperately searching for purpose in their beleaguered existence. Carrying rusted farming tools, they make their way toward the muddy fields surrounding the village, desperately hoping that their daily grind of back-breaking labor will bear fruit, that the meager harvest will sustain them through the rapidly approaching winter. One of the group doubles over coughing, droplets of blood erupting from their mouth—bright crimson staining the tattered sackcloth of their tunic. The others barely look as the unfortunate soul collapses into the mire, lifeless eyes fixed on the roadside pit they will soon be part of. Will you rise above the muck and find glory, or will the hardships of the land crush the life from you as you collapse into the mire, forgotten and alone? Time will tell.

Ghostly Ship Attacking A Coastal City.name:
幽灵船袭击海滨城
Ghostly Ship Attacking A Coastal City

Text.text:
浓雾沉沉压在那片诡异而安宁的海面上，迷蒙如幕，仿佛每一瞬都更浓、更广。哨兵与水手间的不安几乎能触到——他们从手头活计里抬起头，警惕地盯着雾霭。雾气遮住了头顶的月与星，城市里焦躁的低语一波波滚过；朦胧光晕将雾照得惨白如鬼火。寂静渐渐沉重得令人窒息，忽然，雾层一阵翻涌，像被无形之手剥开，露出一艘不祥之船：破烂的帆布垂挂，桅杆如枯骨直刺夜空。那是一具船的尸骸，干枯龟裂、满身凹痕，散发出幽灵般的瘴气，汹涌扑上海岸，转眼吞没港口。诡谧的静默骤然被撕碎——尖叫爆发，紧接着是兵刃嘶鸣般的碰撞声与炮火轰鸣。从那艘幽船的甲板上，骷髅海盗纷纷攀下；雾中又有怨灵提着弯刀浮现而出。

~ Envisioned by Tate.W

A fog lies heavy on the hauntingly calm sea, an obscuring mist that seems to grow thicker, more expansive with each passing moment. Unease is palpable among sentries and sailors, who look up from their tasks and eye the fog suspiciously. Anxious murmurs roll through the city as the mist obscures the moon and stars above, lighting the fog with a ghostly, pale glow. As the quiet becomes nearly oppressive, the fog shifts, peeling away to reveal a sinister ship with tattered sails and skeletal masts. It is a corpse of a vessel, desiccated and pockmarked, exuding a spectral miasma that surges across the shore and quickly overtakes the port. The eerie silence breaks suddenly and violently as screams erupt, followed quickly by the hissing clash of weapons and the thunderous report of cannons. From the deck of the ghostly ship, skeletal pirates descend, with wraiths emerging from the mist with cutlasses in hand.

~ Envisioned by Tate.W

一颗搏动的粉红大脑浮入视野。大脑下方吊着一具躯体，软塌而萎缩，历经亿万年的无用退化。生物那浩瀚的精神力压得你膝盖发软，仿佛亲眼看见自己心象中出现了一块空白。精英的硬光装甲托着那残余的身躯，四条手臂各自稳稳握着一把天顶激光手枪。它们真的需要吗？很难说——毕竟漂浮在你面前的这只生物，只消一个念头就能把你的心智彻底压塌。
A pulsing pink brain bobs into view. Beneath the brain dangles a body, limp and atrophied with eons of useless de-evolution. The immensity of the creature’s psychic force buckles your knees. It is like witnessing a blank spot in your mind’s eye. An elite hard-light suit cradles the vestigial body, its four arms holding a zenith laser pistol. Are they needed? Hard to say when the creature floating before you could implode your very mind with a thought.

Laying Down A Salt Barrier.name:
布下盐之结界
Laying Down A Salt Barrier

Text.text: 女人低声嘟囔着，小心翼翼地从一只锡罐里撒出盐，沿着自家屋基一圈圈洒下。最后几粒盐落进泥土里，她咕哝道：“在我看来这简直是糟蹋好调料。女巫的晚饭肯定难吃得要命。或者干脆一点味道都没有。”她若有所思地用手指轻叩那空心罐子——叮、叮、叮——随后耸耸肩，推门进了屋。 Muttering to herself, the woman carefully sprinkles salt from a tin canister around the footings of her home. As the last of the salt scatters onto the earth, she grumbles, “Seems like a waste of good seasoning to me. Witches’ dinners must taste awful. Or like nothing at all.” She thoughtfully taps her finger against the hollow canister—plink, plink, plink—before shrugging and entering the house.

Coral-decorated Underwater City.name:
珊瑚装点的海底城
Coral-decorated Underwater City

Text.text:
远古建筑的尖塔向着自水面飘落的粼粼微光伸出触及，匠心雕琢的立面在绚烂多姿的色泽中熠熠生辉。宛如精心打理、繁花盛放的庭园，鲜艳的珊瑚以层层叠叠的瑰丽色彩装点着整座城。
Spires of ancient structures reach for the shimmering light drifting down from the surface, their masterfully worked façades gleaming with an abundance of colors. Like beautifully maintained gardens of floral blooms, the vivid corals decorate the city in a plethora of vibrant hues.

Calm Security Agent With Hostile Passeng.name:
与敌对乘客同行的冷静安保特工
Calm Security Agent With Hostile Passenger

Text.text:
特工平静地站在一名闹事乘客面前。她身着乌黑与深红相间的制服，一尘不染，双手叉腰，温和的面容上维持着不偏不倚的神情；她既不动怒，也不采取任何行动。尽管乘客态度敌对——还试图把争执升级——特工依旧不为所动，显然训练有素，让她始终保持清醒的头脑。
The operative stands calmly in front of an unruly passenger. Pristine in her ebony and crimson uniform, hands on hips, and a neutral expression on her benign face, the agent takes no offense or action. Despite the passenger's hostile demeanor—and their attempts to escalate the argument—the agent remains unruffled, her training obviously allowing her to keep a level head.

术士弓身伏在一册厚重的大书上，用一根拖着墨色尾羽的黑鹅羽笔在其中书写。一只棕色飞蛾在她头顶轻轻扑动，时不时俯身下来，停在她的翻领上休息，像枚俊俏的赭金胸针。她搁下羽笔，抬手比划出一串手势——是个名字？书页骤然一闪，紫色能量噼啪迸裂；飞蛾也疯狂振翅，最后气呼呼地坠落进术士蓬松的高丸子头里。掩蔽上腾起一道道闪烁的烟雾，暗色书页深处有如雷电般的光芒奔涌。她翻了个白眼，带着戏谑又打了个手势：“爱现。”随后抱起书，转身离去。

~ 演绎：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The warlock is bent over a large tome, which she writes in with a trailing black goose feather. A brown moth flutters softly above her head, every so often dropping down to rest on her lapel like a handsome tawny brooch. She sets down her quill and then signs a string of letters with her hands—a name? The book flashes for a moment with crackling purple energy, and the moth flaps about wildly until falling in a huff into the warlock’s voluminous top bun. Trails of glittering smoke rise from the cover and flashes of what seem to be lightning surge within the dark pages. She rolls her eyes and playfully signs “Show off” before picking up the book and heading on her way.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

大地随每一步震颤，和声般的振动在土层间滚涌。她生于荒野，与土地一同移动，肌肤随灌木与岩石变换。那双如孪生太阳般的眼睛锁住你，即便相隔甚远，你也能感到其中的热度与暗燃的智慧。燧石般的獠牙向前突起，斑驳皮肤下的肌肉碾磨起伏，成块的力量像卵石掠过覆满碎石的海滩般簌簌滑动。她攥起一块比你头还大的岩石，将其举起，猛然掷向天空，呼啸着朝云层狂冲而去。

~ 由 Vahlaron Envisioned

The ground thrums with each step, harmonic vibrations rolling through the earth. Born of the wild, the woman moves with the land, skin shifting with brush and rock. Eyes like twin suns lock on you, and even from a distance you feel their heat and smoldering intelligence. Flint tusks jut forward, and muscles grind beneath her mottled skin, slabs of strength sluicing like pebbles on a shingle beach. She grips a rock larger than your head, lifts it, and hurls it skyward, careening toward the clouds.

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

兽人骑手那身拼凑出来的模样，诉说着他在荒野里粗粝求生的岁月。他的斗篷由多种野兽的皮毛缝接而成，而他挥舞的长剑布满蛛网般的陈旧裂痕，却又奇迹般地依然完整。他骑着那匹锈红色坐骑，仿佛生来就长在马鞍上，懒懒摇晃，满不在乎——可若你更仔细地望进他黄绿的眼睛，便会发现那目光锐利，老练而警觉。

~ Played by Bcantrell with

The orcish horseman’s patchwork appearance speaks of rough living in the wilds. His cloak is stitched from the hides of many beasts, and the sword he wields is spidered with old fractures yet remains miraculously whole. He rides his rust-red steed like he was born in the saddle, lazily swaying without a care in the world—but a closer look into his yellow-green eyes reveals a sharp gaze, savvy and vigilant.

~ Played by Bcantrell with

这名精类生物看起来像个精灵幼童，皮肤覆着银蓝色的鳞片，手脚处颜色更深；那里的指节细长，指间生着宽阔的蹼。硕大柔和、祖母绿般的眼睛静静打量着周遭。然而，那张被长长的蓝绿发丝所拢起、发间点缀贝壳的面孔不露半分情绪。以水栖（特征）植物织成的宽松衣物垂落披拂，勾勒出这生物的身形。
This fey being looks like an elven child with scaled skin of silvery blue, darkening on the hands and feet, which have long, webbed digits. Big, soft eyes the color of emeralds observe the surroundings. But the face, framed in long, blue-green hair adorned with shells, betrays no emotion. Loose clothing made of aquatic plants drapes the creature’s form.

Elizabeth Seashore, 7th Year House Lion.name:
伊丽莎白·西肖尔，狮院七年级
Elizabeth Seashore, 7th Year House Lion

Text.text:
她身高不过五英尺出头，曲线玲珑却又矫健利落。明亮的笑容点亮她的脸庞，仿佛魔法是她生命里最新鲜的事物——尽管她已临近毕业。她有一头又长又直、宛如打磨橡木般的发色；不穿校袍时，她更爱卡通角色的运动服和印着超级英雄的T恤。她的魔法多以治疗魔法为主，而她的学业同她的笑容一样出色。
She is little more than five feet tall, curvy and athletic. A bright smile lights her face, as if magic were the newest thing in her life despite her approaching graduation. She has long straight hair the color of polished oak, and when she isn’t wearing her school robes she prefers cartoon-character sweats and superhero T-shirts. Her magic is mostly healing magic, and she is as accomplished a student as she is a cheerful one.

Hovering Urban Delivery Drone.name:
悬停式城市配送无人机
Hovering Urban Delivery Drone

Text.text:
地面送货无人机悬停着穿过拥挤的街道，斗牛犬般的机身以蛮力劈开人潮。强劲的反推器推动它前行，而先进的传感器确保通行安全而高效。这台粗野如打手的机器，是配送链条中至关重要的一环；宽大的货舱足以装下许多体积不小的包裹。

~ 由一位 Hero Envisioned

The ground delivery drone hovers through the packed streets, its bulldog-like frame cutting through the crowds with brute force. Propelled by powerful repulsers, its advanced sensors ensure safe and efficient transit. The brutish thug of a machine is a vital link in the delivery chain, with large cargo holds capable of carrying many sizable packages.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Ioun Stone Of Insight.name:
洞见艾昂石
Ioun Stone Of Insight

Text.text:
这颗小巧的球形石头燃烧着炽白的湛蓝能量，宛如一轮袖珍的太阳。当你的手靠近这枚发光的球体时，你感到豁然开朗——仿佛杂念尽散、心神澄明——而你看见宝石随之搏动，涌起幽磷般的魔力光辉。
This small, spherical stone blazes with incandescent blue energy, like a miniature sun. As your hand draws close to the glowing sphere, you feel enlightened—as if your mind clears of all distractions—and you see the gem pulse with phosphorescent magical power.

Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum.name:
魔邓肯的私人圣域
Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum

Text.text:
你紧握施法法器，缓步绕行于区域之中，低声吟诵，将空间施以法术咒缚，迫使其服从你的意志。边界处浮现出一层纤薄、微光闪烁的力场；随着咒语与奥秘手势不间断地持续，它逐渐变得更厚、更坚固。你以守护的意念筑起这道魔法之墙；当法术收束之际，璀璨翻涌的能量渐渐消退——而屏障依旧屹立。
With your spellcasting focus in your grip, you stroll around the area, chanting the words that ensorcell the space and bind it to your will. A thin, shimmering field materializes at the boundary. It grows thicker and stronger as the incantation and arcane motions go on without interruption. You build the magical wall with your protective intentions, and as the spell concludes, the sparkling and surging energy fades—but the barrier remains.

这片宽阔而扁平的空间里，廉价的桌面上排满了数不清的网络空间端口。汗津津的少年和武装到牙齿的技法师在此游荡——满身纹身与穿孔，裹着黑色皮革和不入流的街头仿牌。空气里飘着一股黏腻的油垢味。大多数陈设都粗制滥造，但显然有一笔巨款砸在科技上：原型CPU、尖端显示器、网络空间插口散落得到处都是——这里唯一干净的东西。外卖盒铺满地面。最远处的墙上挂着一面自制的骷髅旗，涂鸦写着 菜鸟滚出去！

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

Countless cyberspace ports line cheap desks in this broad, flat space. Sweaty teens and tricked-out technomancers loiter here—tattooed, pierced, and clad in dark leather and off-brand street wear. There’s a certain greasy smell to the air. While most of the trappings are shoddy, clearly a huge budget has gone into the tech: prototype CPUs, cutting-edge monitors, and cyberspace jacks litter the space—the only clean objects in the place. Takeout boxes cover the floor. A DIY skull-and-crossbones flag hangs from the furthest wall, graffiti on it reading LUSERS GET OUT!

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Helm Of Teleportation.name:
传送头盔
Helm Of Teleportation

Text.text:
这顶诡异的头盔震鸣着，像被敲响的钟发出低沉回荡的音调，让你的胃里骤然打了个结。黑色皮革带从主体钢盔两侧层层垂落，连成一整片不间断的护障。头盔外侧饰着一圈金色箍环，正前方固定着倒置箭矢般的冠饰。
The strange helm resonates with the low reverberating tone of a struck bell, causing a knot to settle in your stomach. Bands of black leather cascade down the sides of the main steel body, forming an unbroken sheet of protection. A golden circlet adorns the outside of the helmet, an inverted arrow-like crest affixed to the front.

巨大的宽阔花瓣自玫瑰的中心向外翻涌旋舞，每一片都如巨石般庞然。红、黄、橙与白的花朵点缀在从近处土地喷薄而出的荆棘藤蔓巨堆之上，藤蔓纠缠成团、绵延成海，织就一幅既瑰丽又令人望而生畏的花之锦幕。
Huge, broad petals swirl outward from the center of the roses, each one as large as a boulder. Red, yellow, orange, and white blossoms dot the enormous, tangled heaps of thorny vines erupting from the nearby land, forming a beautiful and intimidating floral tapestry.

I Cast Speak With Animals From My Ring O.name:
我从我的动物影响戒指中施放了「与动物交谈」
I Cast Speak With Animals From My Ring Of Animal Influence

Text.text:
那生物好奇地歪了歪头，眼珠轻轻一闪，让我觉得它也许知道些什么。我将手按在喉间，戒指的魔法在我的颈项与面庞周围缓缓游移。那里的肌肉随之微微变动，像被提前校准一般，好让我能对着这头野兽清晰而自如地表情达意、发声交流。
The creature does a curious tilt of its head and a flick of its eyes, making me think it might know something. I touch my hand to my throat, the magic from my ring floating about my neck and face. The muscles in these areas shift, priming for me to emote and vocalize clearly and freely with the beast.

Techno Toxin, The \"Exploding Body\".name:
科技毒素，“爆裂之躯”
Techno Toxin, The "Exploding Body"

Text.text:
如同它的生物毒素近亲般凶烈，这种科技毒剂沿着连接你义体植入物的神经通路蔓延。带毒的代码如分叉闪电般在你体内穿梭，啃噬你的赛博义体，扰乱它们的无线协议。当你试图触及你的力量时，你的技法之握却虚弱而滑脱。你的身体仿佛一张爆炸分解图：自我被拆散成一块块脱离、漂浮的零件，只靠几缕孱弱的、浸毒的数据丝带勉强相连。

~ 一位英雄所构想

As virulent as its biological cousin, this techno toxin rides the neural pathways connecting your cybernetic implants. The envenomed code threads through you like forked lightning, attacking your cyberware and disrupting their wireless protocols. When you attempt to reach out to your power, your technomantic grasp is frail and slippery. Your body feels like an exploded diagram: detached, floating pieces of yourself tethered by tenuous ribbons of poisoned data.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Cast Disguise Self.name:
我施放易容术
I Cast Disguise Self

Text.text:
我将心神专注于想要投射的伪装，低声吟诵法术的咒词，双手在空中迅捷编织施法的手势。魔法的嗡鸣渐渐堆叠，随着我的幻象成形并覆落于身，我的外貌随之改变。
I focus my mind on the disguise I wish to project, intone the words of the spell, and quickly weave the casting gestures through the air. A hum of magic builds as my illusion takes shape and settles upon me, changing my appearance.

Farmer’s Field In Summer Lightning Storm.name:
夏日雷暴下的农夫田野
Farmer’s Field In Summer Lightning Storm

Text.text:
在电蓝色闪电的脉动照耀下，天空以原始的能量轰鸣震颤。暴雨奏起倾盆的交响，锤击般的雨点唤醒饥渴的土壤。农妇叹了口气，转身赶往避处，只盼这场风暴别在她的田里引起火灾。
Illuminated by actinic pulses of lightning, the sky thrums with raw energy. Rainfall begins its torrential symphony, the hammer-like drops invigorating the thirsty soil. The farmer sighs and makes her way to shelter, hoping the storm won’t cause any fires in her field.

Quip After A Blunder.name:
失误后的俏皮话
Quip After A Blunder

Text.text:
“好啦好啦，别担心。偶尔失败也没关系；不然我们怎么学会呢？只是……你非得挑现在来上一课吗？”
“Now, now, no need to fret. It’s okay to fail sometimes; how else would we learn? It’s just… Did you have to pick now for a lesson?”

金属板伴着刺耳的碾磨嗡鸣错动，滑入卡槽，严丝合缝；生物随之挺起身躯，升至那巍然如塔的全高。它由一片片板甲构成，每块边缘都爬满晦涩难解的符文，泛着柔和的奥术微光。护甲——或与护甲相仿之物——被赋予生命，被赋予使命；其中有一点光忽明忽暗，继而漫上它的眼眶，那在头盔般的面甲上不过两道狭缝。生物竟也会呼吸，吐息声如巨石在砧上刮擦。它一手紧攥长剑，那尺寸更像为巨人打造，而非凡人所能驾驭。
Metal plates shift with a grinding whir, slide into place, and the creature rises to its full, towering height. Inscrutable runes run along the edges of each plate in its construction, glowing with the soft luminescence of the arcane. Armor, or something like it, given life, given purpose—a light flickers within and gives glow to its eyes, little more than slits in a helmet. The creature breathes, somehow, a sound akin to stone scraping against an anvil. In its hand, it clutches a sword better suited to a giant than a human.

Shop With A Dragonscale Sign.name:
挂着龙鳞招牌的商店
Shop With A Dragonscale Sign

Text.text:
悬挂招牌上的华美饰物同样夺目又引人注目，映着光便把视线牢牢攫住。一片闪耀的金色巨龙鳞片悬在原本寻常的木板上，形状与体型都近似一面塔盾。鳞片并不完美：这里留着一道剑刃划开的豁口，那里凹着一处被匕首尖或箭镞贯穿的坑痕。无论它是从金龙皮甲上被撬下，还是自行脱落，这鳞片都为店铺增添了令人屏息的排场——也不由得让人心生疑问：这门里，究竟能用什么来换取什么？
A magnificent adornment upon a hanging sign catches light and attention in equal measure. A gleaming golden dragon scale, its shape and size similar to a heater shield, hangs on the otherwise ordinary wooden slab. The scale is marred: a cut from a sword here, a divot from a piercing dagger or arrowhead there. Whether pried or shed from a golden dragon’s hide, the scale is an impressive display for the shop—and begs the question of what might be bartered within.

Mob Surrounding The Townmaster's Hall.name:
暴民围堵镇长大厅
Mob Surrounding The Townmaster's Hall

Text.text:
“出来，现身！”聚集在镇长公馆外的人群中有人嘶喊道。“懦夫！我们知道你就在里面！”石块噼啪砸在大厅外墙上，腐烂蔬菜的残渣从窗棂上淌下——那是愤怒的镇民掷出的烂物。许多人高举拳头，以怒吼为节奏猛然挥落；也有人挥舞着棍棒、长矛，甚至农具。一个人走上前，手里紧攥着铁匠锤，抡起便朝那扇上了锁的门狠狠砸去。

~ Envisioned by Girlhead

"Come out and show yourself!" cries a member of the mob assembled outside the townmaster's hall. "Coward! We know you're in there!" Stones clatter against the hall, and the remains of rotten vegetables drip down the windows where they were hurled by angered townsfolk. Many of the mob pump their fists in the air to punctuate their shouts, while others brandish clubs, spears, or even farming implements. One person steps forward, a smith's hammer clutched in their hand, and begins beating it against the locked door.

~ Envisioned by Girlhead

I Succumb To The Will Of A Magical Mask.name:
我屈从于魔法面具的意志
I Succumb To The Will Of A Magical Mask

Text.text:
如同活泥般，面具贴合我的脸。几乎像第二层皮肤，温暖而光滑。随即，一股低语的存在贴上我的心智，仿佛在寻找入口。炽热的僵直攫住四肢，我看见它们违背我的意志自行移动。骤起的恐慌很快被面具阴险的甜言蜜语浪潮淹没。它不再是第二层皮肤，而是我的皮肤。它的脸……就是我的脸……
Like living clay, the mask conforms to my face. It’s almost like a second skin, warm and smooth. Then, a whispering presence presses against my mind, as though seeking ingress. A feverish rigor overtakes my limbs, and I see them move against my will. A surge of panic promptly drowns in the tide of the mask’s insidious blandishments. It is no longer a second skin, but my own skin. Its face… is my face…

Magical Detection Of A Barbarian's Class.name:
野蛮人职业的魔法侦测
Magical Detection Of A Barbarian's Class

Text.text:
你闻到清新的旷野气息——青草、湖水与霜意；舌尖却尝到铁的苦涩刺咬。可这些感官的冲击才刚袭来，转瞬又尽数退去。
You smell fresh, open air, grass, lake water, and frost; and you taste the bitter bite of iron. As quickly as these sensations arrive, they depart.

Air Elemental: Sensing The Elemental Nea.name:
空气元素：感知元素体在附近
Air Elemental: Sensing The Elemental Nearby

Text.text:
狂风在你身周盘旋，扯拽着你的衣襟，拉扯发丝，拍打布料。它不断变换方向，时而被抽离，时而被推挤着掠过，又在你周围打着旋儿折返。远处，你听见它的呜咽与尖啸，但在那些声响之间，还夹杂着更深沉的低吼与隆隆震鸣。
The wind swirls about you, pulling at your clothes, tugging hair, flapping cloth. It shifts direction constantly as it is pulled away, pushed past, and turned around you. In the distance you hear it moan and whistle, but among those sounds are deeper groans and rumbles.

Fleeing Through Pitch-dark Cavern.name:
在伸手不见五指的洞窟中亡命奔逃
Fleeing Through Pitch-dark Cavern

Text.text:
你的呼吸凌乱而急促，在昏暗中盲目踉跄前行；肺里灼痛，脚底的伤口火辣辣地撕扯着你的神经，几乎吞没了全部思绪。你掌心汗湿发滑，却仍死死攥住同伴的手——像个受惊的孩子——把自己交给他们，任由他们带你穿过黑暗。他们安慰你说一定能找到出口，你们都会再见到太阳，可他们的声音在颤。身后，有什么东西在墨一般的黑里走向终结的惨叫沿着洞壁回荡，你猛地紧闭双眼，祈祷自己能找到出路。

~ Angie 在 Discord 上 构想

Your breathing is ragged as you blindly stumble through the gloom, the burning of your lungs and the wounds on your feet consuming your thoughts almost entirely. Sweat slicks your palm as you cling desperately to your companion's hand—like a frightened child—trusting them to lead you through the darkness. They reassure you that they will find a way out, that you will all see the sun again, but their voice wavers. Behind you, the cry of something meeting its end in the inky blackness echoes along the cavern walls and you screw your eyes shut, praying that you will find a way out.

~ Envisioned by Angie on Discord

Juvenile Gang Thug.name:
少年帮派暴徒
Juvenile Gang Thug

Text.text:
年轻人的脸因凶狠的狞笑而扭曲，可他的眼神却泄露出少年特有的踌躇。汗珠在他紧皱的额头上凝结，他守夜般盯着你，竭力让自己显得咄咄逼人。可些微的破绽还是出卖了他——这里一阵抽动，那里一眼躲闪——所有迹象都指向同一件事：他根本不知道自己在干什么。
The young man’s face is contorted in a vicious sneer, yet his eyes betray the hesitation of youth. Sweat beads his furrowed brow as he watches you, doing his best to seem imposing. Little things give him away—a twitch here, a furtive glance there—all adding up to one thing. He has no idea what he’s doing.

Loot From A Gremlin's Home.name:
小魔怪（特征）的家中战利品
Loot From A Gremlin's Home

Text.text:
地面上散落着城堡锻炉的材料。其中一些，尤其是锁具，价值不菲，可折价为金币，或重新锻造成武器与护甲。成串的钱币像吊床般悬挂在椽梁或立柱之间。堆叠的织金法衣与丝绸手帕间，藏着几件魔法物品：一只炼金壶；两瓶强效治疗药水；以及一罐喷嚏与窒息之尘。
The floor is littered with castle forge materials. Some, especially the locks, are worth gold or workable into weapons and armor. Hammocks of coin are suspended between rafters or posts. Among the cloth-of-gold vestments and silk handkerchiefs are several magic items: an alchemy jug; two greater healing potions; and a jar of sneezing and choking dust.

A Call To Adventure From An Old Warrior.name:
一位老战士的冒险召唤
A Call To Adventure From An Old Warrior

Text.text:
“我早在很久以前就放下了武器。我曾找到爱情，找到一小份安宁，并把它牢牢攥在手里。可如今，我的爱已离去，屋子也变得死一般寂静，而我以为早已掩埋的魔性邪恶却卷土重来。有某种黑暗再次拽住我的心，哀求我回到尖叫、屠戮与荣光之中。我既恐惧又兴奋，但更多的是怀抱希望——也许经历这一切，我就能比想象中更早一点，再见到我的爱。”
“I lay down my weapons a long time ago. I found love, a little portion of peace, and I made it mine. But now my love is gone, the house has grown quiet, and the fiendish evil I thought was buried has come back. Something dark tugs at my heart again. Begging me to come back to the screams, the carnage, and the glory. I’m terrified and excited, but mostly, I’m hopeful that maybe through all of this I will see my love a bit sooner than I thought.”

Rare Mineral Core Exposed By Smashed Ast.name:
被击碎的小行星暴露出稀有矿物核心
Rare Mineral Core Exposed By Smashed Asteroid

Text.text:
山谷里葱郁的地面逐渐让位于岩石，岩面布满陨石撞击留下的凹坑。此地原本圆润如球的丘陵被生生震碎，留下一个个深不见底的巨坑。在其中一座坑丘的顶部，探出一枚庞大的红色晶体：裸露的矿物核心，色泽如淌血般猩红，正渗出一种古怪黏稠的流体。它仿佛在嗡鸣——轻柔、低沉、绵延不绝。你越是靠近，一股令人窒息的敬畏便越是汹涌地席卷而来。
The verdant ground of the valley gives way to rock, pockmarked from the impact of an asteroid. Usually spherical, the hills of this region have been shattered, leaving deep craters. Peeking out of the top of one of the crater-hills is a massive red crystal: an exposed mineral core the color of bloody crimson that seeps a strange gooey fluid. It appears to hum—soft, low, and unending. As you approach, a feeling of overwhelming awe washes over you.

Griffon-riding Knight Enters The Fray.name:
骑狮鹫的骑士杀入战阵
Griffon-riding Knight Enters The Fray

Text.text:
一声自上方传来的英勇呐喊攫住了你的注意力——你看见你的盟友与他们高贵的坐骑如坠落的流星般轰然冲向战阵。敌人尖叫着抬臂遮眼，被骑士护甲迸发的辉光刺得睁不开眼；那一人一骑携刀锋、喙与利爪自天而降，直扑其间。战斗险恶纠缠，远非旧日传说那般从容；没过多久，交锋便塌陷成绝望而血腥的混战，只剩为活命的挣扎。一声呼喊穿透喧嚣回荡而来，你看见你的盟友已跪倒在地。

~ Envisioned by Andrew Sanguine on Discord

A valiant cry from above draws your attention as you see your ally and their noble mount barreling toward the fray like a falling meteor. Your foes shriek and shield their eyes, blinded by the radiance of the knight’s armor as the pair descend upon them with blade, beak, and talon. The battle is fraught, nothing like the old tales, and before long, the combat has devolved into a desperate, bloody melee and a struggle for survival. A cry echoes across the tumult and you see your ally on their knees.

~ Envisioned by Andrew Sanguine on Discord

Loot From An Azer.name:
源自艾泽的战利品
Loot From An Azer

Text.text:
阿泽的青铜身躯如同一具静止的空壳，体内的烈焰早已熄灭。它颈间戴着一圈银金颈环，先前被那团火焰般的胡须遮住；颈环上镶嵌着一枚火欧泊、两枚黄玉，以及两片黑曜石碎片。
The azer’s bronze body is a motionless husk, its internal flames extinguished. An electrum torc around the azer’s neck, previously hidden by its fiery beard, is inlaid with a fire opal, two topaz, and two shards of obsidian.

Enchanter’s Polo Player Talks With Strut.name:
附魔师的马球玩家与斯特鲁蒂贡交谈
Enchanter’s Polo Player Talks With Struttigon

Text.text:
“你是这片场上跑得最快、最硬气、最利落的步子王，对吧？你的羽毛是神祇亲手涂抹的颜色。你的脚就是天使的铁锤。现在，给他们看看，谁会驾驭，谁会狂奔！”
“You’re the fastest, toughest, sleekest strutter on the field, aren’t you? Your feathers were painted by gods. Your feet are angel hammers. Now, let’s show ’em who can ride and who can run!”

Ancient Burial Hall.name:
古老的葬礼大厅
Ancient Burial Hall

Text.text:
通道两侧凿出一处处壁龛，里面安置着沉重的石棺，体型各异，装饰繁简不一。这里仍残留着过往来访的痕迹：烧尽的蜡烛、枯萎的花朵，以及散落在碑冢周围的其他供品。然而此刻，这座安葬大厅已然荒弃。
The passage is lined with alcoves housing weighty stone coffins of various size and adornment. There are signs of past visitations: burned out candles, wilted flowers, and other offerings lie around the monuments. But now the burial hall sits abandoned.

Shapeshifter Released From Crystal Priso.name:
变形者自水晶囚牢中获释
Shapeshifter Released From Crystal Prison

Text.text:
一座水晶方尖碑折射着满月的光，洒下炫目的能量光束，牵引着你不由自主地靠近。你在离水晶表面仅几寸处停下，望见一名赤裸男子被封在那具石英棺里；随即，队伍中的一人伸手，将掌心按上方尖碑。光芒轰然迸发成刺目的光环，晶洞般的碎片如弹雨向四面八方炸开。那男人从闪耀的牢笼中解放出来，单膝跪地，发光的眼睛猛然睁开，一声低吼撕裂他久未使用的喉咙。“虚弱……”他的身形荡起涟漪，肌肉膨胀，鬃毛般的兽毛刺立着覆上他光泽的皮肤。他在狼形中长嚎，四只利爪着地，猛地从队伍身旁冲了过去。

~ 由 Dustin

A crystal obelisk refracts the light of the full moon, casting beams of coruscating energy that draw you toward it. You stop mere inches from the crystal’s surface and look upon the naked figure of a man encased in that quartz coffin, then one of the party reaches forward to press their palm to the obelisk. Light erupts in a blinding halo, and geodes of shrapnel explode in all directions. Released from his gleaming prison, the man falls to a knee, glowing eyes snapping open as a growl rips through his unused throat. “Weak…” His form ripples, muscles expanding as fur bristles to cover his burnished skin. He howls in his wolfen form and, on four clawed feet, rushes past the party.

~ Played by Dustin

卓尔城邦的建筑带着一种阴沉的威仪，令人目眩神迷；然而，偶尔涌动的魔法能量所投下的昏暗光照，却照出那些既美丽又令人不寒而栗的细节。狰狞的石像鬼雕像并非仿照奥术哨卫，而是依着下界恶魔的形貌塑成。壁画上铺陈着怪诞的场景：卓尔冷酷无情地折磨并屠戮仇敌；或是更骇人的画面——向黑暗精灵的深渊神祇献祭。作为对木精灵表亲那种天然、写实居所的扭曲嘲讽，这里的建筑直接从洞窟岩壁中雕塑而出，而其中大半靠的，是斯维弗纳布林奴隶的血汗劳作。
The dark majesty of the drow city architecture is quite beautiful to behold, but the dim light—provided by the occasional pocket of magical energy—reveals details that are as disturbing as they are beautiful. Statues of grim gargoyles have been patterned not after arcane sentinels but after demonic denizens of the lower realms. Murals feature grotesque tableaux of drow mercilessly torturing and slaughtering their enemies, or horrific scenes of sacrifice to the abyssal deities of the dark elves. In a twisted parody of the shaped, naturalistic dwellings of their wood elf cousins, buildings have been shaped from the caverns, mostly through the slave labor of svirfneblin.

一片开阔的铺石公共空间环绕着一座欢快的喷泉；喷泉中央的雕像描绘着一圈螺旋跃起的鱼群，被刻出的水槽牵引着飞溅的水花串联成形。喷泉周围散布着十几家小杂货铺，每周有两天从黎明营业到黄昏，周六还会举办夜市。广场东北角立着吟游石，而西南角则摆放着一只巨大的橡木酒桶，外覆一层透明清漆以作保护，桶上铭牌致敬斯派尔威奇的葡萄酒。
A broad expanse of paved public space encircles a cheerful fountain with a statue depicting a spiral of jumping fish held together by carved runnels of splashing water. Around the fountain are a dozen bodegas, open dawn to dusk twice a week as well as hosting a night market on Saturdays. At the plaza’s northeast corner is the Bardstone, and at the west corner is a massive oaken barrel, protected by a coat of clear lacquer, with a plaque honoring the wines of Spirewych.

Overheard Conversation About Necromancy.name:
关于死灵术的窃听对话
Overheard Conversation About Necromancy

Text.text:
“——我跟你说，有了死灵术，爱永不凋零！”
“—I’m telling you, with necromancy, love never dies!”

墨黑的虚空裂开一道缺口，渐染靛蓝。一头利维坦破浪般越出宇宙，它那巨大的鳍翼在星界微风中层层起伏。巨口大张，漏出钴蓝色的闪电，狂乱的电丝倒卷，沿着这头生物庞然的躯体蜿蜒回窜。它抬起一片巨鳍，向右舷倾身转向。随即，通讯里传来一段星辉般的旋律。哀婉而诱人。以太初之舌吟成的韵律诗章。
A gap in the inky void turns indigo. A leviathan crests the cosmos, its gigantic fins rippling in the astral breeze. Its maw yawns wide, leaking cobalt-blue lightning in chaotic strands back across the creature’s colossal body. It raises one colossal fin and banks starboard. And then, over the comms comes a starry melody. Mournful, inviting. A rhythmic poem borne of primordial tongues.

God Of Rangers.name:
游侠之神
God Of Rangers

Text.text:
我们凭借感官所知的一切植物与野兽，皆源自游侠之神。祂是群兽的守护者与猎手，是荒野的仆从亦是主宰；神祇披挂着实用、坚韧的旅行行装。祂的一切都精瘦而高效——从那把朴素的弓，到剪裁无瑕的皮革，无不如此。祂的束衣永远与身周景色同色：或如苔原上飞雪般雪白，或似盛夏叶影般深绿。祂的双眼凝望漫长的道路，世间每一条捷径都已烙在祂的记忆里。
What we know of plant and beast through our senses, we know from the God of Rangers. Protector and hunter of animals, servant and master of the wilds, the god wears practical, tough travel kit. Everything about him is lean efficiency, from the simple bow to the perfect leathers. His tunic is always the color of his surroundings, whether white as the drift on a tundra or the deep green of summer leaves. His eyes behold the long path, and he has memorized every shortcut.

Dawall Smasher.name:
道沃尔·粉碎者
Dawall Smasher

Text.text:
你面前矗立着一名粗犷的人类，肌肉虬结的身躯裹在灿灿鳞甲之中，闪烁如银龙皮般冷冽的光泽。盾牌斜披在他背上，腾出一只手随时攫住并钳制敌人，另一只手则抡起战锤，直砸对方面门。他的面容饱经风霜，胡茬扎硬；乱发与方颌都黑得像泥炭，狂得像海岸的疾风。脸颊上一道疤痕蜿蜒而过——那是久远训练事故留下的纪念；疤痕之上，他的双眼燃着锻炉般不肯熄灭的热度。而当他开口，略带口音的嗓音如锤击铁砧般铿然作响，召唤着正义。

~ Played by FreightTrain

Before you towers a rugged human, his muscled bulk bound in scintillating scale mail that shimmers like silver dragonhide. His shield is draped across his back, leaving one hand free to grab and hold a foe while the other swings a warhammer into their face. His own face is weathered, his stubbled jaw and scruffy hair as dark as peat and as wild as coastal winds. Above a scar running along a cheek—the souvenir of a long ago training accident—his eyes burn with a forge's unrelenting heat. And like a hammer on anvil, his slightly accented voice rings with the call for justice.

~ Played by FreightTrain

Knight In Light Armor.name:
轻甲骑士
Knight In Light Armor

Text.text:
那骑士举止如浪子般放浪不羁，带着豪侠的胆气，大摇大摆地朝你走来；英俊的脸上挂着一抹令人卸下戒心的笑。他身上的装备远不如那些披重甲的同僚繁复，腰侧的细剑却精致得令人侧目，剑柄末端骄傲地镶着家族徽记。
The knight—carrying himself with the rakish audacity of a swashbuckler—swaggers toward you, a disarming smile on his handsome face. He wears little compared to his heavily-armored colleagues, and the rapier at his side is of exquisite quality, with a family crest proudly displayed upon the pommel.

Uplifted Bear Avenger.name:
觉醒熊复仇者
Uplifted Bear Avenger

Text.text:
这头熊形生物双腿直立，灵巧的手掌上长着拇指，取代了粗暴的兽爪；它足有十英尺高，外表凶悍骇人。然而在那野兽的眼睛深处，除了显而易见的凶性，还有一抹机敏的智慧光芒。它身披抛光青铜护甲，其上嵌着亮蓝色的电池作加固；手中擎着一柄巨大的战锤——一件精巧的武器，迸溅着嘶嘶作响的能量。
Standing proud upon hind legs, nimble hands with thumbs in place of brutal paws, the ursine creature is ten feet tall and brutal looking. But beyond the obvious ferocity there is an intelligent gleam in the animal eyes. The bear is clad in armor of polished bronze reinforced with bright blue batteries, and carries a humongous hammer—an ingenious weapon fizzling with energy.

Loot From A Yeth Hound.name:
来自夜嚎猎犬的战利品
Loot From A Yeth Hound

Text.text:
伴随着一声悠长而哀恸的嚎叫，这头猎犬逐渐淡入虚无，消散在以太之中。它那闪烁的翠绿色眼眸——被妖精魔法点燃——在与你目光相接时凝实如晶，旋即坠落在地，化作两枚价值10金币的碧绿宝石。
Fading into oblivion with a long, mournful howl, the hound disappears into the ether. Its shimmering green eyes—alight with faerie magic—solidify as they hold your gaze, and then drop to the ground as viridian gemstones worth 10 gold pieces.

阴影从周遭每一处凹陷与角落逼近你，仿佛一缕缕丝绸织物缠上你的手臂。幽暗的束带俯冲向你的掌心，凝成一柄由纯粹、天鹅绒般黑暗铸就的阴森利刃。它看上去沉重如暴风云层的阴霾，却在你手中轻若羽毛。
Shadows approach you from every nearby recess and become like lengths of silken fabric weaving over your arm. The umbrageous bands dive for your palm and form a sinister blade of pure, velvet darkness. Though its look is as weighty as the gloom of storm clouds, it feels as light as a feather in your hand.

光带在澄澈的夜空中翻飞起舞，越过冰川平原，将万千色彩织成璀璨的帷幕。覆盖在坚冰之上的雪原白若凝脂，映得夜色亮得惊人；苍穹以光影放声歌唱——真正的美，轻轻触及这片世界尽头的冰封角落。
Ribbons of light dance through the clear night sky above the glacial plain, creating a scintillating display of color. The alabaster fields of snow blanketing the ice illuminate the night to an astounding degree as the heavens rejoice in visual song—and true beauty touches this frozen corner of the world.

Stinking Zombie.name:
恶臭丧尸（特征）
Stinking Zombie

Text.text:
活动尸体腐烂的血肉毫不留情、毫无预兆地冲击着你的感官：腐败分解的浓烈恶臭刺痛你的鼻腔，而你眼睁睁看着一条蠕虫从死去的眼窝里爬出。它没有思想，也没有方向，只是毫无目的地拖着步子蹒跚而行。你不由得为这样的命运打了个寒颤。
The rotting flesh of the animated dead assails your senses without apology or warning: the ripe stink of decomposition stinging your nostrils even as you see a worm crawl out of a dead eye socket. Mindless and directionless, the zombie shuffles without purpose. You cannot help but shudder at such a fate.

I Activate My Ioun Stone Of Insight.name:
我激活我的洞察艾欧恩石
I Activate My Ioun Stone Of Insight

Text.text:
这块石头的光亮恰到好处。有那么一瞬，当我把它抛向空中时，它在天幕前竟消失无踪。随后它安然落入环绕我头顶的轨道，我感到——更多。我对他人的感受更敏锐，更能理解他们，也被一种平静而直觉的真实感轻轻抚慰。
The stone’s brightness seems appropriate. For a moment when I toss it into the air, it disappears against the sky. Then it settles into orbit around my head, and I feel—more. I feel for others, understand them better, and am eased into a kind of calm intuitive sense of truth.

God Of Strategy.name:
战略之神
God Of Strategy

Text.text:
身披无数战场留下的伤痕，签下的和约却远少于他所愿；时而是筹谋算计的布局者，时而又抛出一句朴素的箴言便令局势翻盘——神祇就坐在他的棋盘桌前。他光头，身形敦实，披袍围巾，实用而舒适。他纵情享受，饮酒恰到好处却从不沉醉，万事皆是讲究的美食家。他转头看向今日来访之人，聪慧的眼眸明亮而鲜活，仿佛早已看见许多、许多步之后的局面。
Scarred veteran of more battles than can be counted; negotiator of too few treaties for his liking; at times plotter and schemer; at times the deliverer of a simple moment of wisdom that turns the tide—the god sits at his game table. He is bald, heavy-set, robed and scarfed practically and comfortably. He indulges himself, drinks perfectly, without inebriation, an epicurean in all things. He turns to see who visits him today, his clever eyes bright, alive, and seeing many, many moves ahead.

当你吐出残酷力量的咒言，你的手在敌人面前凌空一抓。魔法随之而至，凝成一只巨爪，在空气中一闪即逝，寒光乍现。这道死灵法术渴求撕裂护甲、扯开血肉、碾碎骨骼——不惜一切代价摧毁你的敌人。
As you utter words of cruel power you rake your hand through the air before your foe. Magic follows, forming a great claw that glimmers in the air for the blink of an eye. This necromancy seeks to rend armor, unstitch flesh, crush bone—to do whatever it must to destroy your enemy.

Abandoned Space Station: Control Center.name:
废弃空间站：控制中心落入亡命之徒之手
Abandoned Space Station: Control Center Taken Over By Outlaws

Text.text:
枪声骤然炸响，紧接着是粗野的哄笑，亡命之徒在这间破败不堪的屋子里自得其乐。几面墙上潦草涂画的靶子被子弹孔与爆能枪灼痕打得千疮百孔，廉价酒精与毒品那股刺鼻的恶臭浸透了循环空气，凝成一团令人窒息的罪恶瘴雾。
Gunshots ring out, followed by coarse laughter as outlaws amuse themselves in the bedraggled room. Targets painted crudely on various walls are riddled with bullet holes and blaster fire, and the tangible stink of cheap alcohol and narcotics stains the recycled air in a choking miasma of villainy.

你吟诵完毕，猛地平伸手掌，五指大张，后颈与臂上的细毛根根竖起。指尖迸出一道耀眼的蓝白电弧，转瞬即逝，随即化作笔直的电闪轰然射出，以狂暴的纯粹电能鞭笞路径上的一切人与物。
You finish your recitation and jut out your flat hand, fingers spread wide, small hairs on the back of your neck and along your arms standing straight. From the tips of your fingers a coruscating bolt of blue-white lightning arcs for an instant before blasting out in a straight line, lashing everything and everyone in its path with raw electric power.

Overgrown Ancient Bridge.name:
杂草丛生的古老石桥
Overgrown Ancient Bridge

Text.text:
这座古桥自远古以来便巍然矗立，自建成后的数千年间，曾有无数灵魂踏过它的石面。深灰色的石板上镌刻着繁复流转的符文——被时代磨得圆润光滑——而五彩斑斓的菌类紧贴在这条雄伟通道龟裂崩落的桥体之上。
Standing for time immemorial, the stones of this ancient bridge have been crossed by countless souls in the millennia since its construction. Intricate, flowing runes—worn smooth by time—decorate the dark gray flagstones, and fungi of every hue cling to the cracked and crumbling edifice of this mighty walkway.

Curse Of Deformities.name:
畸变诅咒
Curse Of Deformities

Text.text:
诅咒会从一只坚硬、肿胀的眼睛传入任何与之对视的正常眼睛。那带毒的凝视先是侵染，继而改造皮肉、骨骼与血液。背脊隆起并不断生长，疣瘤在皮肤上星星点点冒出，头发纷纷脱落；骨头被拉长，肌肉被硬生生绷紧。神智随之崩塌。当门框只到肩头的那一刻来临，一只眼后开始隐隐作痛——那是踏入粗暴而受刑的存在的最后一步，化作暴烈且具传染性的恐怖。

~ 由 Admiral Grim 设想

The curse passes from a hard, swollen eye into any normal eye that meets it. The poisonous stare infects and then transforms flesh, bone, and blood. A hump forms and grows, warts speckle up on the skin while the hair falls out, the bones stretch and strain the muscles. The mind goes. When door frames are at shoulder height, the pain behind one eye begins—the last step into brutish, tortured existence of a violent and contagious horror.

~ Envisioned by Admiral Grim

I Cast Hypnotic Pattern Using A Stick Of.name:
我点燃一炷线香，施放【催眠图纹】
I Cast Hypnotic Pattern Using A Stick Of Incense

Text.text:
我点燃那根泛着幽光的线香，随即开始施展法术。珠光般的烟雾化作迷人的丝带翩然起舞。我无声地凝神，将心神聚焦于飘荡的瘴气，意念催动它化为朦胧迷雾，以催眠般的旋涡与不断变幻的纹路笼罩我的敌人。
Pearlescent smoke dances in mesmerizing ribbons as I light the glowing stick of incense and begin the spell. With silent concentration, I focus my mind on the drifting miasma, willing it to enshroud my enemies in a haze of hypnotic swirls and ever-shifting patterns.

Loot From A Mummy Lord.name:
木乃伊领主的战利品
Loot From A Mummy Lord

Text.text:
木乃伊领主的腰间系着一条镶嵌宝石的金腰带，总价值高达4,500枚金币。它的颈上戴着一圈宽阔的金质项圈，瓷面之中嵌着青金石。其上织入的奥术符号令人隐约感到，它或许被灌注了魔法。
Around the mummy lord’s waist is a gold belt encrusted with gemstones, altogether worth 4,500 gold pieces. Around its neck is a wide gold choker with lapis lazuli set in porcelain. The arcane symbols worked into it give the impression that it may be imbued with magic.

战士以绝对专注守望着敌人的一举一动，用老练的目光捕捉每一次细微的体态与站位变化，仿佛能把动作当作书页上的文字来读。他们屈伸手指，握紧剑柄，斗士静候其发。攻击一来，他们以令人目眩的速度出手，而对手却像笨拙的食人魔般把意图写在招式里。反击迅疾而致命。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The warrior watches the movements of their foe with absolute focus, noting every subtle shift in body language and position with an expert eye, able to read movements like words on a page. Flexing their fingers around the hilt of their sword, the fighter waits. When the attack comes, they move with blinding speed as their opponent telegraphs the strike like a clumsy ogre. The counterattack is swift and deadly.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

I Lucid Dream To A Celestial Realm.name:
我在清醒梦中踏入天界
I Lucid Dream To A Celestial Realm

Text.text:
我纵身跃起，腾空而飞，以唯有梦中之身才能拥有的姿态翱翔天际。诡谲的地貌从脚下掠过，我以意志令目的地在前方显现。我将这片土地抛在身后，滑翔于一片青铜色的海洋之上，那里太阳永远半沉于地平线。我看见一座城市——由闪烁着金色纹理的大理石筑成——立于羞红云霞的基座之上，漂浮在浪涛之间。高耸的奇妙尖塔林立，玻璃扶壁如虹光般流辉，还有生着翼的居民在色彩斑斓的马赛克街道上飞行与行走。
I spring into the air and take flight, soaring like only my dream self can. Strange landscapes slip by below me as I will my destination to appear. I leave this land behind and glide over a bronze ocean, where the sun is perpetually half-set. I see a city, built from glistering gold-veined marble, floating over the waves on a foundation of blushing clouds. There are wondrous spires, glass buttresses that gleam like rainbows, and winged denizens flying and walking over streets of colorful mosaic tiles.

Harvey Public School In Winter.name:
冬日的哈维公立学校
Harvey Public School In Winter

Text.text: 尽管已经放假停课，学校的窗户里仍透着灯光。各自的教室里，略显焦躁的老师们手握红笔，在一摞摞试卷之间飞快翻检。某间教室中，校长阴沉着脸俯视着一小撮学生——个个都苦不堪言。他们缩着肩趴在课桌上，铅笔在纸面上沙沙疾走。校长身后的黑板上，用几乎要戳破眼睛的粗黑大字写着：补考。 The windows are still alight in the school, even though classes have ended for the holidays. Within their respective classrooms, slightly harried teachers rifle through stacks of papers, red pens in hand. In one of the rooms, the school’s headmaster glowers down at a sparse group of students who all look absolutely miserable. They hunch over their desks, scribbling pencils across their papers. On the chalkboard behind the headmaster, written in aggressively bold letters, are the words: Make-up TEST.

竞技场的灯光逐渐暗下，人群爆发出原始而刺耳的期待狂潮：喊叫、欢呼，甚至威胁，如雨点般砸向仅被一道光柱照亮的格斗擂台。乌泱泱的人潮向前涌动，膨胀的躯体裹着一层混杂气味的瘴雾：廉价须后水、陈旧香烟与烈性酒精。赌徒们推搡挤压，只为抢到最靠近擂台的位置。报幕员开始介绍，随着他天鹅绒般顺滑的男中音以毫不费力的魅力攫住全场，喧嚣骤然沉寂。“为什么这些勤劳的男男女女要围在这尘土飞扬的擂台旁？寻乐子？不。这不是剧院，不是什么用来消磨时间的消遣；在我们的阶段上，命运被裁决，英雄诞生，恶徒受罚。你们，我亲爱的民众，正是我们在此的理由。他们为你们而战，为你们而流血，而今夜我们准备了一场极其特别的对决；两位擂台泰坦，未尝一败，凶残无人可争，将在这人类所知最伟大的竞斗中相遇。但只有一人能以冠军之姿离开。今夜，巨人将被放倒，积怨将被清算，骨头将被击碎，而你们将见证这一切。现在，为我们时代最伟大的角斗士们高声呐喊！”

~ Envisioned by Old 狗头人

The lights dim in the arena, and the crowd erupts in a primal cacophony of expectation: shouts, cheers, and even threats rain down on the fighting ring illuminated by a single column of light. The throng pushes forward, the swell of bodies wreathed in a miasma of scents: cheap aftershave, stale cigarettes and potent alcohol. Punters jostle for the best ringside position. The announcer begins the introductions, and the crowd falls silent as their velvet-smooth baritone captivates the arena with effortless charisma. “Why are all these hard-working men and women gathered around this dusty ring? Entertainment? No. This is not a theater, not some distraction made to pass the time; on our stage destinies are decided, heroes are born, and villains punished. You, my dear people, are the reason we are here. They fight for you, they bleed for you, and tonight we have prepared a very special bout; two titans of the ring, undefeated, uncontested in their brutality, will face off in the greatest contest known to man. But only one will leave a champion. Tonight, giants will be felled, grudges will be settled, bones will be splintered, and you will bear witness to it all. Now raise your voices for the greatest gladiators of our time!”

~ Envisioned by Old kobold

Esme Tinkertop, The Flame-kissed.name:
埃斯梅·廷克托普，焰吻之人
Esme Tinkertop, The Flame-kissed

Text.text:
半精灵女子漫不经心地抚过脸颊，她金属指尖下那道秘奥的灼痕骤然胀成猩红。转瞬间，她琥珀色的眼眸紧绷起来，嵌在那条由巧匠工艺打造的手臂中的炽火坠饰迸出共生般的光。她轻叹一声，含笑拔出银白短剑，魔法的熔灼辉光将剑身染作流动的血红。细小的火舌在她棕色长发间跃动，继而顺着她伤痕累累的右臂一路游走——那是她魔力的具象。她如舞者般纵身前冲，猫头鹰魔宠在头顶尖啸盘旋，她随即唱起歌来，那灼痛的诞生一路攀升，直至火山般的高潮。

~ 由 Zach 扮演

The half-elven woman absently strokes her cheek, and the esoteric burn scar beneath her metallic fingers becomes a livid red. For a fleeting moment, her amber eyes tighten and the fiery pendant embedded within her artifice-crafted arm flares with symbiotic light. Sighing, she smiles and draws her silvery shortsword, the molten glow of her magic painting it liquid red. Tiny tongues of flame dance through her long brown hair, then down her scarred right arm—manifestations of her magical might. Leaping forward like a dancer, her owl familiar screeching above her head, she begins her song, its blistering birth rising to a volcanic crescendo.

~ Played by Zach

Speech About The Fickleness Of Companion.name:
关于友谊反复无常的演说
Speech About The Fickleness Of Companionship

Text.text:
“陪伴无常。也许你会遇见一个与你志趣相投的人，甚至能建立起真挚的信任。但终有一天，千百个难以察觉的细微变化会将你们悄然推远，直到连你们曾拥有过的一切，都不再值得为那点记忆而奋力相争。”
“Companionship is fickle. Perhaps you find someone who you share some common interest with, a genuine trust even. But eventually a thousand imperceptible changes will drive you apart, until even the memory of what you once had is no longer worth fighting for.”

My Black Robe Of The Archmagi Gives Me A.name:
我的大法师黑袍让我在对抗一个法术时获得优势
My Black Robe Of The Archmagi Gives Me An Advantage Against A Spell

Text.text:
我眼见这蠢货竟敢朝我丢来一道法术，长袍立刻自行反应。带刺的边缘倏然抬起并展开，如蝠翼般张开；我在恰到好处的瞬间转身，让魔法被我那道附魔的壁垒尽数吞没——尽管仍有几缕法术的余劲刺痛般渗了进来。我咬紧牙关，只觉长袍上更多尖刺破肤般疯长，伴着我的怒火一齐迸张。
As I see this fool dare to throw a spell my way, my robe reacts immediately. The spiked edges rise and spread like a bat’s wings, and I turn at just the right moment so the magic is absorbed by my enchanted bulwark—though I still feel twinges of the spell eke through. I grit my teeth and feel more spikes burgeon out of the robe, flaring along with my anger.

Abandoned Lunatic Asylum: Echoes Of The.name:
废弃疯人院：往昔回响
Abandoned Lunatic Asylum: Echoes Of The Past

Text.text:
无数声音——亡者的回响——灌满你的耳朵。多得数不清的人在低语、含混嘟囔、喋喋不休、放声叫喊。门与墙上的猛击仍在持续，愈发急切，困住的灵体那歇斯底里的呼救也随之攀升。而在这一切之中，那位乐师仍旧不停演奏。
Many voices, echoes of the dead, fill your ears. Too many people to count murmur, mumble, gabble, and shout. The pounding on the doors and walls continues, growing more insistent, as do the frantic calls of the trapped spirit. And through it all, the musician plays on.

Volcanic Dungeon Entrance.name:
火山地城入口
Volcanic Dungeon Entrance

Text.text:
路缘到此戛然而止，青葱草木退去，取而代之的是一段碎石松散的斜坡，直通嶙峋的火山岩壁。就算带着道具，这坡也危险得令人望而却步；而在山巅之上，几缕烟团不时喷出，升起又散，飘浮在射程尽头的空中。岩壁上布满断裂的路径，蜿蜒着钻入又钻出一道道隧道。其中一个入口几乎将你从滑坡上拽离，直摔进漆黑的火山石里。甬道昏暗处，一张被老鼠撕烂的铺盖上，一只狗头人正沉沉睡着。

~ Envisioned by Nachreld

The verge stops, its greenery giving way to an incline of loose stones leading to a craggy face of volcanic rock. The slope looks dangerous to climb even with gear, and from the mountain’s peak, puffs of smoke rise and disperse above the range. Broken paths score the rock face, some coursing in and out of tunnels. One such entry nearly takes you off the slide and into the black volcanic stone. In the gloom of the passageway, on rat-shredded bedding, sleeps a kobold.

~ Envisioned by Nachreld

Overheard Story About A Dragon’s Den.name:
偶然听来的龙穴传闻
Overheard Story About A Dragon’s Den

Text.text:
“——我正沿着那边的丘陵往上走——每年这时候风景美得要命，那里还长着些我拿来炖汤的妙蘑菇——结果撞见了个我从没见过的东西：像个洞穴似的地方。看着像是被利爪硬生生从岩石里刨出来的。整片地方臭得熏人，硫磺味混着腐肉味直往鼻子里钻。我往里走了几步，就听见一阵沉沉的砰砰声，像某颗巨大的心脏在跳。那一下就够我受的了；可我转身要走时，我发誓听见黑暗里传来一个声音——低沉、滑腻，饥饿得发寒。放心吧，接下来几个季节，我的炖汤里不会再有蘑菇了。”
“—was walking up just over the hills yonder—beautiful site this time of year and home to some delightful mushrooms I use in my stew—when I came across something I hadn’t seen before: a cave of sorts. Looked like it had been clawed right out of the rock. Whole place reeked of brimstone and rotting meat. I took a few steps in and heard this great thumping, like the beating of some massive heart. That was enough for me, but as I was leaving, I swear I heard a voice coming from the black—deep, slithering, and filled with hunger. Rest assured, my stews will be mushroom-free for the next few seasons.”

它悬挂在带刺的铁链上，庞大的负载垂坠着，陷在一副铆钉遍布的铁木摇篮里。槌首是火淬钢，焦黑灼烧，锻成一张暴怒巨龙龇牙咆哮的狰狞面孔。Gate Eater、Wall Breaker与更多名号，被钝刀刻进它的木质皮肤。承载它的巨轮上，挂着被攻城槌无可阻挡的推进所碾落城镇的破烂旗帜。 It hangs from spiked iron chains, the massive bulk of it dangling in a cradle of studded ironwood. The head is fire-hardened steel, scorched black, hammered into the snarling visage of a raging dragon. Gate Eater, Wall Breaker, and other names are carved with blunted knives into its wooden skin. Upon the huge wheels that bear it hang the ragged banners of towns fallen to the ram’s inexorable march.

I Step Into The Border Ethereal With My.name:
我身披虚无护甲的板甲，踏入以太边境。
I Step Into The Border Ethereal With My Plate Armor Of Etherealness

Text.text:
近乎具现的质感如烟雾般的油浸透了我，当我的护甲穿过半影之际。从色彩到暗影，从光亮到阴翳，我此刻正凝视着物质世界。我也感到一股浮力，仿佛能穿行以太向上踏去，如同飞越一条山谷；或向下坠去，如同落入一处峡谷。那里无人能接触我，而我的护甲——与非物质同调——护住我，抵御任何可能在此的敌手，就在这些位面边界的另一侧。
Near-corporeality saturates me, like a smoky oil, as my armor crosses the penumbra. From color to shadow, light to shade, I am now looking into the material world. I feel a buoyancy as well, to step upward through the ether, as if in flight over a valley; or downward, as if into a canyon. No one there can touch me, and my armor—in tune with the immaterial—protects me from whatever foe may be here, just across the border of these planes.

[外] 小屋如同休憩的灯塔般挺立；虽只是以砍伐原木搭起的朴素建筑，却仍对疲惫旅人充满诱惑。烟从烟囱里盘旋升起，许诺着温暖——也许还有一顿热饭——但厚重的橡木门上，赫然横亘着又长又乱的爪痕。 [内] 刚跨过门槛，腐肉与湿毛皮的恶臭便迎面扑来。小屋阴影的角落里——溅满早已干涸的血迹——堆着被啃噬的骨头、丢弃的武器，以及破烂不堪、浸透血浆的衣物。一声嚎叫撕裂黑夜，饥饿的目光在黑暗中灼烧；屋外满月的银光拉长了影子。 [Outside] The lodge rises like a beacon of respite; a simple structure of felled timbers nonetheless enticing to weary travelers. Smoke spirals from the chimney, promising warmth—perhaps even a hot meal—but long, ragged claw marks mar the heavy oaken door. [Inside] Just beyond the threshold the stench of rotting meat and wet fur greets visitors. In the shadowed corners of the lodge—spattered with long-dried blood—are piled gnawed bones; cast-off weapons; and tattered, gore-soaked clothing. A howl splits the night, and hungry eyes burn in the darkness, as outside the silver light of a full moon lengthens the shadows.

Dwarven City Square Summer Ale Festival.name:
矮人城广场夏日麦酒节
Dwarven City Square Summer Ale Festival

Text.text:
矮人城邦的心脏苏醒过来；夏日麦酒节已然开场。熙攘人潮间笑声迸裂，醇厚烈酒的香气弥漫在空气里。狂欢者高举大肚酒杯，咆哮着为匠艺与情谊干杯。乐声在鹅卵石街道上轰鸣回荡，感召众人尽情作乐，分享这一季的丰饶。
The heart of the dwarven city has come alive; the summer ale festival has begun. Laughter bursts within the bustling crowds, and the aroma of hearty booze fills the air. Revelers hoist steins and roar toasts to craftsmanship and camaraderie. Music booms through the cobblestone streets, calling for all to make merry and partake in this season’s bounty.

捕兽人百无聊赖地挠了挠自己蓬松的胡子，随后把手伸进那只一路拖行在荒野中的鼓胀麻袋里。他抽出一只兽夹，小心翼翼地放进灌木丛下的枯枝落叶间，扣上机关使其待发，接着转身前往下一个地点。数小时后他会回来，准备从落网的猎物身上剥下那些价值不菲的皮毛。
The trapper scratches idly at his bushy beard before reaching into the bulging sack he has been hauling through the wilderness. He withdraws an animal trap and places it carefully in the underbrush before arming it, then moves on to the next site. Hours later he will return, ready to skin the valuable coats from his ensnared prey.

这生物矮小敦实，是个肥嘟嘟的紫色团块，地面上蔓延着如根须般的增生。它球状的身躯覆着杂乱的圆疙瘩，像虬结的朽木。正中央裂开一张深邃的獠牙巨口，淌着灰色涎沫。巨口两侧各垂着一条触手，勉强算作手臂；身后还有第三条更粗大的增生撑住躯体。令人不安、丑得彻底的生物周围，孢子在空气中缓缓漂浮。
The creature is small and squat, a plump purple thing sprouting rootlike growths across the floor. Its spherical body is covered in messy round knots like gnarled wood. From the center, a cavernous toothy maw drools gray spittle. Two tentacles sit beside the mouth like arms of sorts, while a third larger growth stabilizes the body from behind. Spores float about the unsettling and thoroughly ugly creature.

一阵既诡谲又安抚人心的寂静，在那一场洁白无瑕的落雪之前先行降临。头顶的天空阴沉而苍白灰冷，冰冷的雪片懒散地飘落下来，触及之处便牢牢黏附在每一寸表面。你感到它们在脸颊与双手上留下的冰寒轻吻——刺骨的冷意转瞬即逝，因为你体内的热度正将那些冻结的晶体融化殆尽。
A silence both eerie and calming precedes the snowfall, pristine white. The sky above looms pale gray, and as the icy flakes float lazily downward, they stick fast to every surface. You feel their frigid kiss on your face and hands, a biting cold that dissipates quickly as your body's warmth melts the frozen crystals.

Royal In A Wheelchair.name:
轮椅上的王族
Royal In A Wheelchair

Text.text:
在一群仆从与谄媚者的簇拥中，王族被推上了宫廷的高台。四角修起了带纹理的坡道，仆从们扶着王族登上王座。敕令颁布之后，王族一挥手，宴席便随之摆开。凡求觐见者，皆走到高台底下，向他们的君上陈词——正如漫长岁月里所有臣仆一贯所做的那样。

~ 由 Played 扮演，Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

In a pack of servants and sycophants, the royal is pushed onto the dais at court. Textured ramps have been built at the corners, and the servants help the royal to the throne. When the decrees have been issued, the royal hand waves in a feast. Those who seek an audience step to the base of the dais and address their liege, just as all servants have over the long ages.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

最先袭来的，是那股气味：腐烂、腥臭，在死亡的恶臭里夹着金属被腐蚀般的刺鼻咬感。随后才看清皮肤——如暗色皮革般绷紧，几乎要在尖锐的骨架支撑上被扯裂。独角自额前弧形探出，向前挑起；这恶魔的脸上只有狡诈的恶意。它的眼睛闪着地狱般的狡黠，而它必然知晓的陷阱与谋杀之事带着一种令人作呕的意味，叫人双膝发软。它轻声发笑，像是在回味某个只有它自己懂的笑话。

~ 一位英雄所Envisioned

The odor strikes first: rotten, foul, with the bite of corrosion amid the reek of death. Then the skin, like dark leather, stretched near the ripping point over a pointed scaffolding of bone. A horn arcs forward over the head, and the face of this demon is nothing but devious malice. The eyes sparkle with diabolic cunning, and something sickening about what it must know of traps and murder makes the knees weak. It laughs, softly, as if recalling an inside joke.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这头怪物般的生物哪怕只是一声最轻微的低吼，也足以让你的心跳在一瞬间停滞——不只是因为体型，更因为它的凶名。它肩高足足五十英尺，浑身覆盖着布满尖刺的装甲甲壳，能轻易偏转法术与魔法武器；它渴望吞噬行进路线上的一切，原始蛮力堪比最强大的泰坦。即便是巨龙与紫虫，面对它横冲直撞、不可阻挡的行进，也会仓皇逃窜。它从不浪费时间去筹谋、去憎恨、去渴求——只是顺从天性中那股杀戮、摧毁与吞噬的冲动，将一切不幸挡在它路上的存在碾碎殆尽。
The merest grumble from this monstrous creature is enough to still your heart for a moment—not from size alone, but from reputation. A full fifty feet tall at its shoulder, covered in spiked, armored plating that turns aside spells and magical weapons with ease, possessed of the desire to devour all within its path, and endowed with a primal strength equal to that of the mightiest titan, this creature would send even dragons and purple worms scurrying from its rampant, unstoppable path. It wastes no time on planning, malice, or desire—only following its natural need to kill, demolish, and devour everything unlucky enough to find itself in its path.

王后的寝宫里，一张宽大的书桌安放在一扇华美的彩绘玻璃窗下，窗外的光线穿过缤纷的玻璃格片，在室内洒下令人目眩的斑斓光纹。壁炉上方的小神龛散出肉桂与丁香的温暖香气。馥郁的烟雾从闷燃的线香上袅袅升起，盘旋成一道道俏皮的烟柱。
A large writing desk sits beneath a beautiful stained-glass window in the queen's bedchamber, the light outside creating dazzling patterns as it passes through the colored panes. The warming aroma of cinnamon and cloves emanates from a small shrine above the fireplace. Fragrant smoke spirals in playful columns from sticks of smoldering incense.

Quay On Cave River.name:
洞河码头
Quay On Cave River

Text.text:
古老的石阶凿刻在裂隙的峭壁上，险峻地向下俯冲进幽暗深处，在扭曲的阴影里蜿蜒，通往一处仿佛码头般的岩台——岩台斜斜探入奔涌的河水。三艘划艇在湍流中起伏颠簸，彼此碰撞，被缆绳牢牢系在几处突出的岩棱上。岩台高度的壁面隧道里涌出火把的光，泼洒开来，照见阶梯尽头堆着几只木箱与木桶。
Ancient steps carved into the wall of the crevasse pitch dangerously down through the dark, twisting toward a kind of quay that slopes into the rushing river. Three rowboats bob and bump together in the flow, lashed to a couple of spurs of rock. Torchlight floods out from a tunnel in the wall at the quay’s level, revealing a few crates and barrels stacked at the base of the stairs.

书架与卷轴匣沿着每一面墙排布，又在这座高拱的中殿里井然成行地立着，并在两端的后殿内同样密布。无烟的白色火焰在铁制枝形吊灯上冷冷摇曳，将整座图书馆照得通明。一个精灵甚至可以在这光下潜心研读数年，也从未两次翻到同一页。
Bookshelves and scroll cases line every wall, and stand in ordered rows throughout this high-vaulted nave and in the apses on both ends. Smokeless white flames flicker coldly on iron chandeliers, illuminating the library. An elf could spend several years studying under their light and never read the same page twice.

Wall Of Thorns With Flash.name:
闪光荆棘之墙
Wall Of Thorns With Flash

Text.text:
你念完最后的咒语，低头看见自己的手指竟延伸成布满尖刺的枝条。法术扎根于你体内，力量鼓胀翻涌，你知道该行动了。你猛地将双手合拢。绿光骤闪，伴随刺耳的木质吱嘎轰鸣，一道由粗密荆棘构成的高墙猛然破土而出。
You complete the words and see your fingers extend into thorny branches. The spell takes root, its power swelling, and you know it is time to act. You slam your hands together. In a flash of green light and a cacophony of creaking wood, a wall of thick briars erupts into being.

Large Desert Encampment Of Soldiers.name:
大漠军营
Large Desert Encampment Of Soldiers

Text.text:
营地里的帐篷以一座中央主帐为核心向外铺展，那主帐由色彩明艳的丝绸搭起，耀目夺人。身着轻便羊毛软甲的士兵在其间穿梭忙碌，磨砺长剑、绷紧弓弦、为皮制盾牌上油保养。几处篝火炊烟袅袅，烤肉的油香与辛烈的香料气息在营地上空游荡飘散。骆驼在阴影里反刍歇息，斥候则骑着箭一般修长的骏马沿营地边缘巡弋，那些马仿佛随时能与风赛跑。
The tents of the encampment radiate out from a central pavilion of brightly colored silk. Soldiers in light padded wool mill about, sharpening swords, stringing bows, and oiling leather shields. The aromas of roasting meat and pungent spices waft from the several cookfires across the camp. Camels ruminate in the shade while scouts patrol the perimeter atop arrow-sleek horses that look capable of racing the wind.

Anacite Ambassador.name:
阿那西特大使
Anacite Ambassador

Text.text:
线条圆润而对称，这也许是你迄今遇到的异晶体中最不具威胁性的一个。四条腿托起一具柔韧的人形躯干，四只优雅的上肢末端是灵巧的利爪。它那圆颅内嵌着短波阵列，光滑漆黑的空白面孔上，猩红的光芒交叉成一道十字裂痕般的纹路。它张开四臂，做出安抚的姿势，随即飞快地咿呀连串的语言，急切地搜寻着最合适的那一种。
Smooth and symmetrical, this is perhaps the least threatening of the anacites you have encountered thus far. Four legs prop up a supple humanoid body with four elegant upper-limbs that end in dexterous claws. A shortwave array is inbuilt into their round cranium, which sports a blank, black face glowing with a cross cut of scarlet lights. They open their limbs wide in a placative gesture and babble a series of languages in rapid succession as they search for the appropriate one.

Farmer’s Field In Mid-autumn.name:
中秋时节的农田
Farmer’s Field In Mid-autumn

Text.text:
在路的另一头，一片田野浸润在琥珀与金黄的色泽里。落叶如同酥脆的被褥，铺满地面，向夏日的余热道别。作物在土壤上舒展蔓延，南瓜已然成熟，正待收获。空气中弥漫着甜美诱人的香气。农夫推着小车穿行在劳动的果实之间，准备收割自己亲手播下的一切。
Across the way, a field is awash with hues of amber and gold. Leaves, like a crispy quilt, carpet the ground, bidding farewell to summer’s heat. Crops sprawl atop the soil, with pumpkins ready for harvest. The air is full of their sweet, enticing scent. A farmer pushes a cart between the fruits of their labor, ready to reap what they have sown.

Eavesdropping For Lore In A Busy Tavern.name:
在喧嚣酒馆里偷听打探秘闻
Eavesdropping For Lore In A Busy Tavern

Text.text:
无论烟斗与酒杯间正上演着什么，或桌边的交谈如何喧闹，都可以先放一放。那声音鬼祟而共谋般低回，带着催眠般的魅力，再大的辛劳也值得只为偷听一字半句。奥秘被编进故事里——名声赫赫的人物与地点，掺杂着从某段执拗追索的过往里挖出的新知。一小片地图残页、一段从石上拓下的古语刻痕、某个烟熏味十足的老水手，或一位甜美得令人沉醉的名妓——他们探出的线索，如今都等着被证明：可信，或荒诞。
Whatever is happening with pipe and mug, or in conversation around the table, can wait. The voice is furtive and conspiratorial, mesmerizing, and no strain is too great for eavesdropping. Arcana in story, famous characters and places mixed with new knowledge from a past demanding pursuit. A scrap of cartography, a rubbing of language carved on a stone, some smokey old mariner or a delicious courtesan found out what now has to be proven credible or incredible.

衣着考究的“绅士”也许喝得酩酊，也许只是微醺；但他絮絮叨叨的劲儿活像醉鬼，丢人现眼到连附近的熟人都刻意拉开距离。陪他一起来的女人更是一副恨不得把手帕塞进他嘴里、最好再顺便捅进鼻孔里的表情。这个小丑对任何话题都无法给自己的心声上锁，不管观点多么蠢笨或一无所知，他都忍不住插嘴评头论足。
The well-dressed “gentleman” may or may not be in his cups, but he certainly blathers like a drunk, making himself look like such an ass that any friends in the vicinity are keeping their distance. Certainly the woman he came here with looks as if she’d like to stuff a handkerchief in his mouth, and possibly up his nose as well. Unable to censor his innermost thoughts on any subject, this buffoon cannot help but weigh in with his opinions, no matter how dunderheaded or uninformed.

Friendly Tavern: Musicians.name:
友善酒馆：乐师
Friendly Tavern: Musicians

Text.text:
乐师们与酒客分开，像鹿从森林里钻出般自酒馆人群中现身。他们聚到一处开阔的空间，随即奏起曲调。你不识这音乐，却觉得那旋律仿佛天生就该配上一首歌。
Musicians separate from the drinkers, emerging from the crowd in the tavern like deer from a forest. They gather together in a clear space and strike up a tune. You don’t know the music, but it seems like a melody that deserves a song.

Secret Room In A Manor.name:
庄园里的密室
Secret Room In A Manor

Text.text:
你从隐秘通道中钻出，踏入一间私密书房；这里隔音极佳，除非知晓其存在，否则外人绝听不见里面的任何移动。陈设寥寥，四壁无窗，唯有一张大书桌——桌面上整齐码着一小叠纸张，旁边放着几件书写用具，还有几样小饰物点缀，打破其冷峻的空旷——以及靠墙的一把舒适椅子。近旁的挂钩上吊着一盏灯，另一侧摆着一只同样未点燃的小火盆，紧挨着一排巧妙隐藏的通风口。角落里搁着一只木箱，铁箍牢牢加固箱身，一把巨大的挂锁将箱中之物严密封住。
You emerge from the hidden passage into a private study, perfectly soundproofed to prevent those not aware of its presence from hearing any movement within. The furnishings are sparse and there are no windows, but there is a large desk—a small pile of neatly stacked papers, some writing implements, and a few trinkets breaking up the severity of its surface—and a comfortable chair along one wall. A lamp hangs from a hook nearby, and a small firepot, also unlit, sits beside a series of cunningly concealed vents. A wooden chest sits in a corner, bands of iron reinforcing the container, and a large padlock keeping the contents secure.

I Cast Prismatic Spray From My Helm Of B.name:
我从绚光头盔中施放虹光喷射
I Cast Prismatic Spray From My Helm Of Brilliance

Text.text:
为此，我只是抬手，接触我头盔上那枚镶在钢制设定中的钻石，仿佛只是掂量着一个念头。色彩在我的手与头盔之间翻涌盘旋，凝成一团小小的彩虹星云，汇聚成形，顺着我的意志，穿空而去，直奔它的目标。
For this, I simply reach up and touch the diamond in its steel setting on my helm, as if only considering a thought. The colors roll around my hand and the helmet, forming into a little rainbow nebula that comes together, follows my purpose, and sails through the air toward its target.

Damiaran Maggot.name:
达米亚兰蛆虫
Damiaran Maggot

Text.text:
一头巨大的蠕虫状怪兽黏湿地朝你蠕行而来，饥饿难耐，扭动不止。它像一只虱子般卑污，满身害虫的腥臭。若不是体型大得骇人，它或许不过是寻常害虫——还有，它背上刺出的那些被烧得通红的金属尖刺。那生物脉动着炽热能量，仿佛在某个瞬间，身形都随之拔高了一截。
A large wormlike beast squelches toward you, ravenous and wriggling. It is something like a louse, verminous. It would be perhaps a simple pest if it wasn’t so large—that, and the superheated metal spines protruding from its back. The creature pulses with heat energy and seems, for a moment, to grow in stature.

Approaching Ocean Cliffside Border Town.name:
冬日里逼近海崖边境小镇
Approaching Ocean Cliffside Border Town In Winter

Text.text:
靠近边境时，天气骤然转坏。细雨如丝，遮住你的视线，但你仍能瞥见下方紧贴峭壁的城镇。覆着冰壳的建筑彼此依偎，压在海面轰鸣的浪涛之上；那片阴沉的巨影翻涌不息，裹着冬日刺骨的寒意。

你所站之处看不见半点镇民的踪影。凛冽的北风把他们逼回室内，门扉紧锁，窗板也被严严实实地封起。

Close to the border, the weather turns for the worse. Drizzle obscures your view, but you are still able to glimpse the town clinging to the cliffside below. Ice-coated buildings nestle together above the crashing waves of the sea, its brooding mass seething with winter's bite.

From where you stand, no sign of the townsfolk can be seen. The frigid north wind has driven them inside, locking doors and sealing shutters behind them.

你将圣徽高高举过头顶，凭借信念支撑的力量，释放出一道炫目夺人的辉耀闪光。光芒席卷近处的生物——弱小的不死生物在其威能下瞬间瓦解，崩裂成尘，随风四散；其余者则在一场仿若恐惧的溃逃中仓皇奔命，拼命拉开与圣光之间的距离。
You raise your holy symbol over your head, and with power backed by conviction, unleash a flash of dazzling, radiant light. The light washes over nearby creatures—lesser undead disintegrate beneath its power, crumbling to dust and scattering on the wind; the rest flee in a facsimile of terror, desperately putting as much distance as they can between themselves and the holy light.

一串孩子循着半兽人推车碾过路面的声响跟在后头；车轮每转一圈，折叠车门内叮当作响的银器便应和出一连串欢快清脆的叮铃。孩子们知道，修补匠进镇了，正兜售她那些奇妙的货品——其精密的打磨与优雅的发条机关，连他们最心爱的木头玩具和玉米皮娃娃都相形见绌。
A trail of children follow the sound of the half-orc’s cart as it is pushed down the road, every revolution of the wheels eliciting merry tinkles from the sounds of silverware jangling within its folded doors. These children know the tinker has come to town, plying her marvelous wares, the likes of which put even their favorite wooden toys and cornhusk dolls to shame in their precise tooling and elegant clockwork.

这生物与人类等高，却长着巨鸟般覆羽的双翼与喙状的长吻。它们以细长的跖行腿移动——动作里带着一种轻盈的优雅，暗示着中空的轻骨与诡异的协调。它们的眼睛明亮、狡黠而警觉；当它们移动时，阳光在那一身闪耀的羽毛上流转跳跃。
The creature stands the height of a human, but with the feathered wings and beaked snout of a massive bird. They move on spindly, digitigrade legs—a grace to their movement hinting at lightweight bones and uncanny coordination. Their eyes are bright, cunning, and alert, and as they move, the sunlight plays across their gleaming feathers.

Autumn Tournament Crowd.name:
秋季锦标赛观众
Autumn Tournament Crowd

Text.text:
斗篷与围巾映着秋树的斑斓浓彩，观众们为列队巡游的骑士们欢呼挥手。人们举杯祝酒、下注赌谁将加冕本季冠军。人群为姗姗来迟者让出空隙，喧嚣渐息，两名骑士随即开场。
With cloaks and scarves mirroring the vibrant colors of the autumn trees, the spectators cheer and wave at the parading knights. Toasts are raised and bets made on who will be crowned season’s champion. Room is created for latecomers, as the noise subsides and two knights begin the proceedings.

I Patch Leather Armor.name:
我给皮甲打补丁
I Patch Leather Armor

Text.text:
我用手抚过护甲那冰凉而柔韧的皮革，细细探寻是否有裂口或断痕。指尖沿着我这身久经磨砺的道具上遍布的伤疤与凹痕缓缓划过，我不由得带着几分怅然微笑，回忆起每一道痕迹所牵连的瞬间。很快，我找到了一处源自近来战斗的小裂口，便动手修补，为我的第二层皮肤再添一道愈合的伤痕。
I run my hand over the cool, supple leather of my armor, probing for splits or breaks. I smile wistfully as I trace my fingers over the many scars and dents in my well-worn gear, recalling the moments linked with each. I find a small tear from our recent battle and set to work adding another healed scar to my second skin.

Mobile Phone Buzzes At A Tense Moment.name:
紧要关头，手机嗡嗡震动
Mobile Phone Buzzes At A Tense Moment

Text.text:
极道与黑手党老大隔着一张打磨得纤尘不染的木桌彼此怒视。两人身侧各站着持枪护卫——显然坐立不安——沉默如同令人窒息的浓雾，严严实实罩住整间屋子。紧绷的气氛眼看就要沸腾，忽然一阵尖锐的电子嗡鸣炸响，像碎玻璃般将这一刻撕得粉碎。所有人的目光都回合向那名护卫，只见他满手冷汗，慌忙摸索着去触及口袋，试图按掉这场突兀的打断。
The yakuza and mafia bosses glare at each other across an immaculately polished wooden table. They are both flanked by armed guards—who are clearly ill at ease—and silence blankets the room like a smothering fog. Tensions reach a boiling point just as a sharp digital buzz erupts, shattering the moment like broken glass. All eyes turn to the guard now fumbling hastily to reach their pockets with sweaty hands to mute the interruption.

Gelatinous Cube Escape.name:
逃离凝胶魔方
Gelatinous Cube Escape

Text.text:
腐骨与锈铁的幽影在女人身后逼近，她猛扑向近旁的树根，喉间迸出一声挫败而绝望的嘶喊，像受伤的野兽般撕裂空气。光芒摇曳间，你这才看清——她的腿已被一团半透明、果冻般的黏质吞没，而那团东西正试图将这名战士一并裹入其中。
The specter of rotting bones and rusting metal looms behind the woman as she lunges for nearby roots, a cry of frustrated desperation tearing from her throat like a wounded animal. As the light shimmers you realize her leg is engulfed in a translucent, gelatinous mass—which is trying to engulf the warrior.

世上必定还有更美的景致，但此刻你一个也想不起来——最惊艳的色彩在天穹上铺陈开来，宛如泼洒的画卷。夜色已然涌上来夺取天空，可太阳却仿佛仍不甘松手，死死攥着地平线不放。
There must be things that are more beautiful in the world, but at this moment you can’t think of one, as the most stunning array of color paints the vault of heaven. Night already moves to claim the sky, but the sun seems reluctant to give up its hold on the horizon.

I Use My Ring Of Evasion.name:
我启用我的【闪避戒指】
I Use My Ring Of Evasion

Text.text:
我的心跳骤然加速，疾若蜂鸟振翅；四肢里涌动着超自然的力量。利刃劈向我的头颅，咒术也威胁要将我击碎——可我轻轻一跃、踏步便从容避开险境。戒指的魔法将我的身体推向极限，四肢麻颤，带着既令人亢奋又岌岌可危的刺痛感。
My heartbeat increases, fleet as hummingbird wings, as my limbs flow with supernatural energy. Weapons cleave toward my head and spells threaten to shatter me—but I jump and stride out of harm’s way with ease. The magic of the ring pushes my body beyond its limits, leaving my limbs tingling with a sensation that is both exhilarating and precarious.

First View Of Estate.name:
庄园初见
First View Of Estate

Text.text:
沉重的橡木双开门缓缓摇开——铁铰链因年代久远而吱呀作响——一股霉烂帷幔的气味迎面扑来。倾斜的屋顶破了个洞，一束金色阳光穿透而下，照亮了褪色红地毯的斑驳片片。鸟儿在厅堂深处欢快啁啾，为这间空荡的房间添了几分亮色。
As the heavy, oaken double doors swing open—iron hinges squeaky from age—the smell of moldy drapery rushes to meet you. A hole in the canted roof lets in a beam of golden sunlight, illuminating patches of faded red carpet. Birds chirp cheerfully from within the halls, brightening the empty room.

Enchanter Academy Corridor.name:
附魔师学院走廊
Enchanter Academy Corridor

Text.text:
拱顶走廊里挤满了学生，他们身披长袍，围着围巾，系着印有自家学院颜色的领带；四下回荡着交谈声，还有使魔的尖叫与低语。抱着书本的学生们三五成群守在一面坚实的墙边，身体前倾，像是在等穿过车水马龙的街道——直到墙上忽然裂开一道敞开的拱门。他们立刻冲进去，赶在上课前及时触及教室，而拱门又迅速褪回冰冷的石面。
Teeming with students in robes, scarves, and ties of their house colors, the vaulted hallway rings with conversation and the squawks and murmurs of familiars. Groups of students clutching books wait by a solid wall, leaning forward as if waiting to cross a busy street, until an open archway appears in the wall. They dash through it to reach class on time and it fades back to stone.

I Use Hurl Through Hell.name:
我施展“掷入地狱”
I Use Hurl Through Hell

Text.text:
当我的一击落下，凭空而起的灼热浓烟与亡魂的尖啸缠上我的对手。他们在骤然降临的寂静中消失无踪。只余一缕刺鼻的烟雾与几点余烬，还有扑鼻的硫磺恶臭。片刻之后，他们又在一阵热浪与硫火中归来。那张脸上凝固的震骇，诉说着他们目睹过足以撕裂心智的景象。
As my blow lands, from nowhere, burning smoke and the screams of the damned wrap my opponent. They disappear in sudden silence. A wisp of acrid smoke and a few embers are all that remain, along with a sulfurous stench. Moments later, they return in a wave of heat and brimstone. Shock etched on their features tells of the mind-shattering sights they’ve seen.

Entering The Faerie Plane.name:
踏入妖精位面
Entering The Faerie Plane

Text.text:
你挤过灌木与垂枝，密林深处摸索前行，盘根错节不断绊住你的脚。空气愈发温热，斑驳光影渐渐黯淡，潮湿的泥土气息淹没了你的感官。腹中一阵翻搅，仿佛骤然坠落，而一股不可抗拒的召唤催你继续向前。你冲破纠结的枝杈与荆棘，眼前铺展开一片暮色森林——与任何你曾见过的都截然不同。
You press through shrubs and boughs, roots snagging your feet as you feel your way through the dense wilderness. The air grows warm, the dappled light dimming, and earthy smells overtake your senses. There’s a writhing in your gut, as if suddenly falling, and an inexorable call urges you forward. You break through the knotted branches and brambles and look upon a twilit forest unlike any you’ve seen before.

Passions Inflamed By Faerie.name:
被妖精点燃的激情
Passions Inflamed By Faerie

Text.text:
欲望在你体内以酸楚的强烈度攀升。色彩迸射流光，闪烁生辉，在你脑海里奏起轻柔的乐音。光线愈发明亮。忍冬与薰衣草的芬芳随和煦微风飘荡。空气带着甜味，低声呢喃着神秘欢愉的允诺，宛如情人贴在你耳畔的吐息。你的肌肤微微战栗。无处可寄的渴求在胸中鼓胀，几乎要冲破边界，坠入迷狂。
Desire rises in you with aching intensity. Colors radiate and sparkle, making soft music in your mind. Lights brighten. Scents of honeysuckle and lavender float on the soft breeze. The air tastes sweet and whispers promises of mysterious delights like a lover’s breath in your ear. Your skin tingles. Aimless yearning swells inside, threatening to burst into delirium.

一段陡峭的草坡向下延伸，通往另一片更小的草甸。翠绿之间，石块勾勒出一个轮廓，仿佛旧日地基的残迹。放眼望去，草木连绵无缺，连一处裸露的斑秃都不见。
A steep, grassy slope leads down to another, smaller, meadow. Stones form a shape that could be remains of a foundation amid the greenery. No bare patches mar the flora.

Seduction Of A Beholder.name:
魅惑夺心魔
Seduction Of A Beholder

Text.text:
“你每一根纤细触须的移动，都只会映出你美丽的另一面。光是想象它们尽数缠绕在我身上……便几乎令人难以承受。”
“The movement of each delicate tendril only reveals a new facet of your beauty. To imagine them all wrapped around my body… It is almost too much to bear.”

Grove Of Redwoods.name:
红杉幽林
Grove Of Redwoods

Text.text:
雄伟的红杉巨木在此如泰坦般耸立，粗拙的根系似大象脚趾般深深抠入大地。赤褐色的树干足有三十英尺宽，有些更为硕大；每一株都高达数百英尺。空气里弥漫着淡淡的香料气息，以及一丝轻微而不张扬的甜香。
Majestic redwood trees tower here as titans, with stodgy roots like elephant toes digging into the earth. The ruddy trunks are thirty feet wide, with some even larger, and each stands hundreds of feet high. The aroma on the air is of subtle spice and a slight, unobtrusive sweetness.

Riverside Border Town In Summer.name:
盛夏的河畔边境小镇
Riverside Border Town In Summer

Text.text:
涉过浅河，双脚湿漉漉的，你把在水里嬉闹溅水的孩子们留在身后，踏入镇中——狭长的街巷为你挡去几分炽烈骄阳。荫凉的绿洲里，商贩蹲坐着叫卖货物。色彩与喧嚣争夺你的注意力，身着虹彩衣裳的人们旋转扭动着从你身旁掠过，喊叫大笑。空气里弥漫着嘉年华般的气息。
Feet wet from fording the shallow river, you leave the children splashing in the water behind you, and enter town—the slender streets offering some respite from the blazing sun. Within shaded oases, traders squat and hawk their wares. Color and sound war for your attention, as rainbow-garbed folk spin and twist past, shouting and laughing. A carnival atmosphere fills the air.

I Receive A Medal Of Valor.name:
我获得了一枚英勇勋章
I Receive A Medal Of Valor

Text.text:
缎带从我头顶掠过，短暂地勾住一只耳朵，随即轻柔滑落到肩头。三色丝绸闪烁着莹亮的光泽，几乎要与勋章本身的辉芒争艳。其上镌刻的徽记是一面盾牌，背后光芒放射而出。
The ribbon passes over my head, catching momentarily on one of my ears before sliding gently down to my shoulders. The tricolored silk winks a luminous shine, rivaling the sheen of the medal itself. The symbol engraved is a shield with rays of light streaming out from behind it.

Snow Monsters Animate.name:
雪域魔物苏醒
Snow Monsters Animate

Text.text:
红色尘土自雪地里腾起，如同血雾。雪堆鼓胀、蠕动。一声似湖面薄冰炸裂的脆响回荡开来，刺入骨肉与心神。积雪尖啸着堆叠、隆起，扭曲变形，化作可怖的人形怪物——身躯佝偻、肢体畸折，煤黑的眼珠，冰锥般的獠牙与利爪。它们尖叫扑咬，冰冷的爪尖咔哒作响，四下张望，寻觅可以杀死的东西。
Red dust rises from the snow like blood. The drifts pulse and wriggle. A sound like thin ice cracking on a lake rings out, piercing to the body and mind. The snow keens and piles. It morphs into monstrous humanoid forms, bent and twisted, with coal-black eyes and icicle fangs and claws. These monsters screech and snap, clicking their icy talons. They cast about for something to kill.

Ice Caves On A Frozen Planet.name:
冰封行星上的冰洞
Ice Caves On A Frozen Planet

Text.text:
崎岖的极地坚冰在远古冰川中凿出一片洞穴般的迷宫隧道，蜿蜒曲折，越走越深，直探行星冰封的腹地。巨大的冰锥布满穹顶，像一柄柄闪着寒光的匕首倒悬其上，仿佛只等时机一到便会刺下。低沉而粗粝的轰鸣在洞网间回荡，震得积雪从洞壁簌簌落下，头顶冰锥也随之不祥地颤响。那是冰川在挪动——还是别的什么？
Rugged polar ice forms a cavernous warren of tunnels in the ancient glacier, winding further and further into the frozen depths of the planet. Enormous icicles cover the ceilings, hanging like glistening daggers waiting for their moment to strike. A low, guttural rumble echoes through the cave network, shaking snow from the walls as the icicles rattle ominously overhead. Was that the glacier shifting—or something else?

Dark Casting Of Tsunami.name:
海啸的黑暗施放
Dark Casting Of Tsunami

Text.text:
你头顶的天空骤然昏暗，脚下的大地也变得绵软如沼——你将这个世界赐生的湿润汇聚成彻底的毁灭。它的成形如低语拔高成尖啸。寒如深渊、黑如魔肤的水腾起，化作横跨数百尺的毁灭巨浪。巨浪轰然砸落，奔涌向前——那是大自然亲手挥下的横扫一击。
The sky above you darkens and the ground beneath you turns spongy as you coalesce the life-giving moisture of this world into utter destruction. It forms like a whisper rising into a scream. Water as cold as the abyss, as dark as demon flesh, rises into a destructive wave spanning hundreds of feet. That water crashes down, rushing forth—the sweeping hand of nature itself.

空气里弥漫着血腥味，一团由翻滚藤蔓、巨岩与连根拔起的树木纠缠而成的泰坦级风滚草狂乱冲来。这生物仿佛一整片丛林的自然残骸——被凝成单一漩涡般的堕坏自然之核——以三条腿站立，那三腿由某座远古神殿的白云岩石柱塑成。组成这无定形巨兽的藤蔓曾经翠绿，如今却被奔涌的血河染成酒红；它们向你伸出触及，渴求更多鲜血。
Smelling blood in the air, a titanic tumbleweed of roiling vines, boulders, and uprooted trees rushes forward in a frenzy. This creature is a jungle’s worth of natural detritus—solidified into a single vortex of corrupted nature—that stands on three legs fashioned from the dolomite pillars of some ancient temple. The once-green vines that assemble this amorphous goliath are stained wine red from rivers of blood, and they reach out toward you, thirsty for more.

Wayward Priory To A God Of Corruption.name:
堕化之神的迷途修道院
Wayward Priory To A God Of Corruption

Text.text: [外部] 一座山墙屋顶的大茅舍静卧在树荫下。外墙素净，刷着白漆，只显出最轻微的风化痕迹。头顶树木细长的叶片低低压在屋顶上，像一双双谨慎的手，按住一个孩子不让他动弹。本该宁静如画的所在，却被一股压倒性的酸腐气味笼罩；你还能听见昆虫的嗡鸣——慌乱的低哼，搅得你胸口不安地一颤。你看不见也听不见任何人的踪迹。 [内部] 外头虫群的嗡鸣被厚重的寂静闷住，沉沉压在一排排长椅上。室内没有任何装饰，白墙空空，不见宗教符号或圣像。房间尽头的低台上，一本旧书摊开在讲台上，旁边是一支牛脂蜡烛，烛芯未曾点燃。你听见吱呀一声——讲坛后方的地窖门被掀开。自你到来便刺痛你感官的恶臭猛然翻涌，如浪扑面。一个披着污秽长袍的侍学者从黑洞般的坑口爬出，满脸脏污，双眼浑浊含泪。“朝圣者，”他用像生锈铰链般吱嘎的嗓音说道，“腐朽欢迎你。” [Outside] A large cottage with a gable roof sits under the shade of trees. Its facade is plain, painted white and showing only the barest signs of wear. The long, thin leaves of the trees above press down upon the roof like cautious hands keeping a child still. An overwhelmingly sour odor hangs in the air around this otherwise idyllic place, and you can hear the buzzing of insects—a harried hum that leaves an anxious flicker in your chest. You don't see or hear signs of any people. [Inside] The humming of bugs outside is muffled now by a pronounced silence that hangs over a set of pews. The room is bare of any decoration, with white walls bereft of any religious symbols or iconography. At the head of the room, upon a low dais, you see an old book splayed open upon a podium. It sits next to a tallow candle with an unburnt wick. You hear a creak as a cellar door swings up behind the pulpit. That stench that has been stinging your senses since you arrived hits you in a powerful wave. An initiate in soiled robes emerges from the dark pit, face filthy and eyes rheumy. “Pilgrim,” he says in a voice like a squeaking hinge. “The Rot welcomes you.”

你狠狠吸进一大口水，只觉那液体冰冷而沉重，压迫着你的胸腔。然而你越是呼吸，就越发轻松，直到它在你肺里进出，竟与空气无异。
You take in great lungsful of water, and feel the liquid cold and oppressive in your chest. But the more you breathe, the easier it gets, until it comes and goes from your lungs much like air.

Dwarf Martial Brawler.name:
矮人武斗家
Dwarf Martial Brawler

Text.text:
那条缠在斗士腰间的红色绶带在她搏杀时威风凛凛地翻卷飞舞；她的每一次腾挪都经过精密计算，动作干净利落，只为将效果推至极致。符文纹样点缀着她晒得黝亮的肌肤，随着她紧绷而线条分明的肌肉起伏荡漾；她挥出的每一击都足以同时击裂颅骨与盾牌。
The red sash about the brawler’s waist swirls majestically as she fights, her movements calculated and precise for maximum effect. Runic designs decorate her tanned flesh, rippling across her taut, well-defined muscles as she delivers blows that can crack skull and shield alike.

Bigby's Hand Misses.name:
毕格比之手落空
Bigby's Hand Misses

Text.text:
你戴上蛇皮手套，把一枚蛋壳托在掌心。空中浮现出一只巨人的手，几近透明，带着幽灵（特征）般的虚幻；当你在手套里捏碎蛋壳时，它攥成拳头，骇人得令人窒息。你屏息凝神，低声催促这一击——那拳头像眼镜蛇般向后蓄势……却无声地穿过稀薄的空气，打在绝对的虚无上。
You put on the snakeskin glove and cradle an eggshell. A floating giant’s hand appears, nearly translucent as a ghost, and terrifying as it clenches into a fist while you crush the eggshell in the glove. You concentrate and whisper for the strike, the fist pulls back like a cobra… and passes silently through thin air, hitting absolutely nothing.

你汇聚起全部的专注，以心神触及魔法，命令它在你的同伴周身盘旋。你将意念锁定在渴望的动物形态上，霎时间，法术在空气中清晰可见：一圈圈幽微发亮的光之旋涡在盟友身旁跳跃翻腾，勾勒出他们即将化作的野兽之形。
You summon every ounce of concentration and reach out with your mind to the magic, commanding it to swirl about your friends. You focus on the desired animal forms, and suddenly the spell is visible in the air: dimly glowing swirls of light bouncing and bounding about your allies in the shape of the beasts they will soon become.

Grand Dame And General.name:
贵妇总帅
Grand Dame And General

Text.text:
大贵妇是一朵奶油色的玫瑰花结，最底层的花瓣几乎有十英尺宽。其余花瓣同样是温暖的白色调，中央的雌蕊向着温室明亮的玻璃穹顶伸展。将军是一簇三朵巨大的鸢尾，像王者的扇面般在蓄水池尽头铺展开来，在一片柔粉与浅绿之间，蓝得格外醒目。地面上，那幅画展露出芹菜绿的叶柄与叶片。
The Grand Dame is a crème rosette with a lower layer nearly ten feet in diameter.
