Its other petals are the same warm white shade, and the center pistil reaches toward the bright glass top of the greenhouse. The General is a cluster of three giant irises fanning regally over the end of the cistern, standing out blue among the pastel pinks and greens. On the floor, the painting displays celery-green petioles and leaf blades.

Thirty Days Of Travel With A Trade Carav.name:
与商队同行的三十日旅行
Thirty Days Of Travel With A Trade Caravan

Text.text:
当你开始护送商队踏上这段艰辛旅程时，月亮像一柄苍白的刀，正被黎明缓缓收入鞘中。最虚弱的人一眼就能看出需要额外保护：他们的衣服不适合远行，行囊也收拾得有些潦草。到了第十天，强壮可靠的人走在前头，队伍终于有了固定的步调。随后，在满月之下，一名雇来的护卫变得刻薄又懒散，阴暗的路段更需要加倍警惕。等到所有人都满身尘土、瘦了一圈、面容更粗砺，连爱抱怨的人也沉默下来时，你们抵达了。商人们在同一柄苍白的刀下清点货物——此刻它又被暮色从鞘中抽出。

~ Envisioned by Søren Sørensen

When you begin escorting the caravan on its arduous journey, the moon is a pale blade being sheathed by dawn. The weakest are easy to spot as needing extra protection. Their clothes are wrong for the journey, or they have a bit of sloppy packing. By the tenth day, the strong and reliable lead, and a pace sets in. Then, under the full moon, one of the hired guards grows mean and lazy, and darker paths require extra vigilance. When everyone is dusty, a little thinner and rougher, and even the complainers have fallen silent, you arrive. The merchants count their supply under that same pale blade, now unsheathed by twilight.

~ Envisioned by Søren Sørensen

Succubus Casts Ensnaring Strike.name:
魅魔施放【缠绕打击】
Succubus Casts Ensnaring Strike

Text.text:
雕像般挺立的狐媚子眼底邪焰暗燃，竟将她的真实意图遮掩得滴水不漏；一串浸满魔法的词句以地狱语自她微启的唇间蜿蜒滑出。先是她的腰胯妖娆地向一侧轻摆，目标的目光被牵引着追随；紧接着，金色利爪划出一道冷光弧线，猛然朝他掠去。爪尖掠过他微仰的颈侧，法术随之触发。缠握的荆棘藤蔓破地而起，将受害者牢牢箍住——暴露、脆弱、动弹不得——只待迎接她即将落下的吻。

~ 一位英雄所构想

The wickedly smoldering eyes of the statuesque vixen belie her intent as a magic-laden word in the infernal tongue slithers between her parted lips. First, her hips sway sensually one way, and her target’s drawn eye follows; then there’s the flash of her golden claws arcing toward him. As they rake his tilted neck, the spell triggers. Grasping vines of thorns spring upward to hold the victim—exposed, vulnerable, and immobile—for her coming kiss.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Talisman Of The Sphere.name:
天球护符
Talisman Of The Sphere

Text.text:
一条打磨得熠熠生辉的金链上，垂着一颗闪烁的金色头颅，额头两侧伸出两支弯曲的犄角。深陷的眼眶里嵌着两枚祖母绿作眼珠，闪烁着诡异的力量。厚重而蓬乱的胡须被雕进贵金属之中，沿着面颊与下颌铺陈开来；尖鼻之下，一撮飘逸的八字胡如波般垂落。然而最醒目、也最摄魂的细节是那张嘴——以一种张裂到不自然的角度被生生扯开，永远凝固在愤怒与痛苦的尖啸里。那宽大扭曲的口腔却又怪异地空荡；或许它也在呼唤着某个本应栖居其中的东西。
From a polished golden chain hangs a glimmering golden head with two curved horns protruding from its brow. The deep-set emeralds that form the eyes glitter with a strange power. A thick, bushy beard, carved into the precious metal, lines the cheeks and jaw of the head, with a flowing mustache under the pointed nose. But the most prominent and enrapturing detail is the mouth—pulled open in a gaping, unnatural way—in a perpetual scream of rage and agony. The wide, contorted maw seems oddly empty; perhaps it also calls out for that which resides within.

Holding Room At A Coliseum.name:
斗兽场候场室
Holding Room At A Coliseum

Text.text:
上了铁栅的囚室里弥漫着汗臭与秽物的腥气，石地沾染着陈旧的血迹，碎屑与垃圾散落其间。人群震耳欲聋的咆哮穿透石墙，轰然回荡。斑驳的光从遮挡视线的木条缝隙里渗进来，透过这些破裂的木板间隙，仍能窥见外头——就在斗兽场边缘，两名斗士拔刃对峙，绕圈试探。 他们交锋，一人持矛步步紧逼，盾牌猛推迫使对手后退；另一人双斧在手，先磕开长矛便纵身突进，一斧自上而下劈落，紧接着反手再一记上挑。持矛者及时举盾，挡住第一击，却在下一瞬明白自己犯了错——第二把斧头带着令人作呕的闷裂声，硬生生楔进他护甲的甲片缝隙。血溅上沙地，观众席炸裂般沸腾——战斗结束了。 下一场……

~ Envisioned by ​NLPiotti

The barred cell stinks of sweat and refuse, the stone floor stained with old blood and littered with debris. The thunderous roar of the crowd reverberates through the stone walls. Dappled light bleeds through the wooden slats blocking full view into the coliseum, but one can peer between these shattered planks to view, just outside, two combatants circling each other, weapons drawn. They duel, one forcing the other back with their spear, shoving with their shield; the other, wielding two axes, knocks the spear aside and charges forward, swinging downward with one axe before following with an upward slash with the off hand. The spear-wielder gets their shield up in time, blocking the first blow, realizing their folly as the second axe sinks between the plates of their armor with a sickening crunch. Blood spills onto the sand, the crowd erupts—the fight is over. On to the next…

~ Envisioned by ​NLPiotti

Technology-nullifying Euphoric Drug, Tem.name:
科技失效的迷狂药物「节拍」
Technology-nullifying Euphoric Drug, Tempo

Text.text:
在玻璃瓶内，这种炼金的兴奋-镇静剂像油与水般分层：云母碎点的紫罗兰色漂浮在浑浊的淡蓝之上。一剂便许诺带来极乐——却也高度成瘾——的星界幻景，将日常生活里科技的喧嚣一刀切断。因此，标签上红色的字迹警告技法师切勿试验；毕竟，此人之乐，彼人之毒。

~ 一位英雄所构想

Inside its glass bottle, the alchemic stim-tranq separates like oil and water: mica-specked violet floating atop cloudy pale blue. A dosage promises blissful—and highly addictive—visions of the astral by cutting out the technological cacophony of everyday life. Consequently, the label’s red lettering warns off experimenting technomancers; after all, one user’s pleasure is another user’s poison.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Loot From A Shadow Dragon Lair.name:
暗影巨龙巢穴的战利品
Loot From A Shadow Dragon Lair

Text.text:
在幽暗巢穴那锋利嶙峋的深处，你发现一堆堆瓦砾。每一座小丘都停在地面上一道漫长的拖痕尽头——那是扫过地面的弧形轨迹，仿佛由一条巨尾拖曳而成。你拨开杂乱的碎石尘土，昏暗的岩影间闪出金属与宝石的微光。有些宝石已被碾碎成卵石般的碎粒，几块较大的也被刮得满是划痕或蒙上暗锈，几乎一文不值。但这批隐匿的宝藏仍有大半保持着原本的华彩，光泽中尽显其真正的价值。
Deep in the sharp recesses of the shadowed lair you find piles of rubble. Each mound sits at the end of a long drag mark on the floor, sweeping trails that could have been made by a great tail. Digging through the clutter, glints of metal and gems appear in the dim of dust and rock. Some of the gems have been shattered into pebbles, and some larger pieces are scratched or tarnished to worthlessness. But much of the hidden hoard still gleams its full worth.

Protection From Energy.name:
防护能量
Protection From Energy

Text.text:
你依照指引吟诵那蕴含力量的真言，手势与嗓音交织成一道魔能的神盾，将你的目标护在其中；护罩的灵光染着你这道法术欲以抵御之元素的色泽。
Reciting the words of power as you have been guided, your gestures and voice form an aegis of magical energy around your target, an aura tinged with the very element your spell is meant to ward off.

Simple Airship In Pale Light.name:
苍白微光中的简易飞艇
Simple Airship In Pale Light

Text.text:
粉彩般的天空云层——粉红与淡紫像苍白的黎明——被一艘木壳飞艇划破；它在木质骨架上张着几片小小的帆布翼。其上，一只分段的帆布气囊漂浮着，罩在厚重布篷下，密密的绳索将它与船体相系，令它在空中慵懒地滑行。
The clouds of the pastel sky—its pinks and mauves looking like a pale dawn—are broken by a wood-hulled airship that has small canvas wings on wooden frames. Above it, a sectioned canvas balloon floats under a canopy of heavy cloth, rigged with many ropes to the hull as it flies lazily through the air.

这具骷髅（特征）有四条腿和一条短尾。它的头骨细长，眼窝后方有一处小小的隆起，前端延伸出一段长吻部，密布锋利尖牙。肩胛骨比髋骨更宽大，胸廓紧凑。那犬科生物用修长的趾骨小跑前行，末端是钝黑的爪。
This skeleton has four legs and a short tail. Its skull is long, with a small bulb behind the eye sockets and an extended muzzle full of sharp teeth. The shoulder bones are bigger than the hips, and its rib cage is compact. The canine trots on its long toes, which end in blunt black claws.

River Village In Heavy Rain.name:
暴雨中的河畔村庄
River Village In Heavy Rain

Text.text:
远处的乌云下裂开一道光，洒在村庄上空，将倾泻而下的雨幕照得在空中闪闪发亮。光洗之中，一处高崖之上，有人高举权杖或短刃。下方，沿着暴涨的河水，兜帽压低、斗篷紧攥的两个人从一栋茅草屋顶的建筑旁蹚过，他们看起来凄惨不堪。
Light breaks under dark clouds in the distance, making the sheets of rain hitting the village glisten in the air. In the wash of light, on a high cliff, someone holds up a scepter or short blade. Below, along the flooding river, with hoods pulled up and cloaks clutched, two people walk past a thatched-roof building. They look plainly miserable.

仿佛英俊、机智与魅力这些理想本身，都在这名肤色蔚蓝的魁伟战士身上具象成形。而他脸上那抹顽皮的坏笑若能说明什么，那就是——他自己也很清楚。他用一条丝绸腰带别着一把看起来致命的弯刀，但你隐约觉得他把它挂在那里，只是为了让像你这样的人明白：他根本用不着它。
It’s as if the very ideals of handsomeness, wit, and charm are embodied in this massive azure-skinned warrior. And if the impish grin on his face is anything to go by, he knows it. He has a deadly looking scimitar tucked through a silk belt, but you get the impression he keeps it there just to let people like you know he doesn’t need it.

无论脚下立足如何，无论你站在何处，你都始终觉得自己仿佛在攀爬一座垂直的峭壁，双手死死抓住身旁凸起的岩石。热浪从大地本身涌起，蒸汽自裂隙间喷吐，岩浆在地表之下咕嘟翻涌。空气被烟尘与灰烬呛得几乎无法呼吸。
No matter your footing, no matter where you stand, you feel constantly as though you're scaling a sheer mountain, clinging to nearby rocks. Heat rises from the ground itself, steam escaping fissures, magma bubbling beneath the surface. The air is choked with smoke and ash.

它踏过之处，大地都被一座金色护甲的山峦所压制。那天界生灵的体型是常人的两倍，肩背宽阔，气势骇人。猩红披风自巨大的肩甲间翻飞，肩甲与护颈甲融为一体，护住守卫者的颈项与面容——一直覆到鼻尖。它不戴头盔，皮肤却如苍白的合金铸成，双眼迸射出灼灼圣辉。一侧手臂与盾牌熔接为一，纵使那盾重如一匹马，它也能轻松举起。另一只手微光流转，肘部以下伸展出一柄修长长枪，取代了原本的手掌。
Dominating the ground it marches upon is a mountain of golden armor. Twice the size of any human, the celestial is broad and fearsome. A scarlet cloak flutters from massive pauldrons fused to a gorget that covers the guardian's neck and face—up to its nose. It wears no helm, though its skin is made of a pale alloy, and its eyes shine with radiant power. On one arm is fused a shield, and though it must weigh as much as a horse, the guardian lifts it with ease. Its other hand shimmers as a long lance extends to replace it at the elbow.

你踏入这间未点灯的石室时，脚步声在幽暗中回响，余音在空间里震颤，恍若葬于此处者的叹息。你前行之际，覆满苔藓的石块在脚下打滑、碎裂、崩落。陵寝的潮湿像沉重的压迫感裹住你，你不由得痛苦地吸了一口气，提醒自己——你仍然活着。
Your footsteps echo as you enter the unlit stone chamber, the sounds reverberating in the space like the sighs of those interred here. Moss-covered stones slip and crumble beneath your feet as you walk. The dampness of the mausoleum sits like an oppressive weight around you, and you find yourself taking a painful breath to remind yourself that you are still alive.

Fighter's Quip About Conversation.name:
战士对闲聊的俏皮吐槽
Fighter's Quip About Conversation

Text.text:
“我这人不太爱说话。总觉得自己像是没听懂你们的笑话。你们一会儿笑、一会儿皱眉、一会儿嘟囔、一会儿大笑，表情变得太快，我根本跟不上。反正我能用拳头说清的事，用嘴也说不出什么更好的来。”
“Not much of a talker. Always feel like I’m not in on the joke. You all smile, frown, grumble, and laugh and it’s just too much to keep track of. Nothing I could say with words that I couldn’t with my fists anyway.”

Dragon Dance Of The Claw Style: Vôo Do M.name:
爪风流·龙之舞：蝙蝠之飞翔
Dragon Dance Of The Claw Style: Vôo Do Morcego

Text.text:
你一边绕行一边闪避，终于看见了：对手防线里那道破绽，正好让你舒展出巨龙般的蝠翼，贴地平飞抬升，直至双腿猛然弹出，双脚齐落——凌空的双重飞踢。

~ 一位英雄所构想

As you circle and dodge, you see it: the opening in your opponent’s defenses for you to spread the batlike wings of the dragon and lift, horizontal to the ground, until your legs spring out and both feet strike—a double kick, airborne.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Pirate Radio Station.name:
海盗电台
Pirate Radio Station

Text.text:
你推门走进这间狭小的屋子，一股浓烈的香料气味扑面而来。室内摆着一张看起来很舒服的棕色沙发，一张布满划痕的塑料桌子，还有两把颜色像呕吐物一样的椅子。墙上挤满了最近艺人的全息海报，投射出发型完美、动作整齐划一的舞者影像。地上散落着空掉的兴奋剂注射器，旁边是数不清的音乐卡带，胡乱塞放。隔壁房间的直播正开着，DJ对着麦克风像狗一样嚎叫，随后介绍一位名叫Kraffbukk的TripStep艺人——你透过观景窗，看见他正以近乎失控的节奏胡乱舞动。
There’s a heavy smell of spice in the air as you enter the small room containing a comfy looking brown sofa, a scarred plastic desk, and two chairs the color of puke. Holo-posters of recent artists crowd the walls, projecting images of synchronized dancers with perfect hairstyles. Empty stims litter the ground, amid countless music cartridges improperly stored. In the next room, on air, the DJ howls like a dog into the mic before introducing a TripStep artist named Kraffbukk, who you see dancing erratically through the viewing window.

Pedantic Administrator.name:
迂腐的管理员
Pedantic Administrator

Text.text:
男人把一副沾着污痕的眼镜推上他那圆鼓鼓的鼻梁，水汪汪的眼睛从数据板上抬起时，重重叹了口气。用一种短促而不耐的口吻，他问明你来意，并伸出手索要你的证件。随后他以老练的目光飞快扫过文件，嘴角浮起一抹讥诮的笑，将它们递回你手里，宣称你填错了，必须重新办理——一式三份。
The man pushes a pair of smudged glasses up his bulbous nose, and sighs loudly as his watery eyes look up from the datapad. With a clipped, irritated tone he asks to know your business and holds out a hand for your documents. Scanning the files with an expert eye he smirks and passes them back to you, stating you’ve made an error and must redo the forms—in triplicate.

从你伸展的指尖，逸出一缕薄烟，缓缓蜿蜒向外探去，继而骤然炸开，化作翻涌的烟云，其间灼热的火星与燃烧的余烬纵横飞射。不久，你便听见刺耳的滋滋作响声，也庆幸有这遮蔽视线的浓烟作掩护。
From the tips of your outstretched fingers a single tendril of smoke emerges, wending its way slowly outward, before suddenly erupting into a swirling cloud shot through with scorching and burning embers. It is not long before you hear loud sizzling and you are grateful for the obscuring smoke.

雪粉轻覆在倒下雪人的血污毛皮上，尸身已渐渐难以辨清。那双巨大的兽瞳曾预告着令人血液凝固的死亡，如今却空洞而呆滞，蒙上一层玻璃般的死光；驱使这生物生前狂奔撕咬的原始饥渴，也已被彻底夺走。
Snow dusts the blood-smeared fur of the fallen yeti, and the corpse is already becoming difficult to see. Large bestial eyes, which once promised a blood-chilling death, are now glassy and vacant, robbed of the primal hunger that drove the creature in life.

这名年轻人为旅行做了打扮：一双好靴子，结实耐磨的衣服，却似乎没带多少真正派得上用场的行李。他背上的不是背包和睡袋，而是一件更像便携书桌的东西。带盖的卷轴筒从他肩后探出，像弓手箭袋里竖起的箭矢；而他腰带上挂着的也不是刀剑，而是一副单筒望远镜，以及一件结构繁复的黄铜器具——你觉得那叫六分仪。
The young man has dressed for travel with good boots and sturdy clothes, but he doesn’t seem to have packed much of practical use. Instead of a backpack and bedroll, he carries on his back something that looks more like a portable desk. Capped scroll tubes project from behind his shoulders like the arrows of an archer’s quiver, and sheathed in his belt aren’t swords, but a seeing eyeglass and a complex-looking brass device you think is called a sextant.

Clandestine Meeting With Masked Rebel Le.name:
与蒙面叛军首领的秘密会面
Clandestine Meeting With Masked Rebel Leader

Text.text:
你踏入空荡荡的酒馆厅堂，往日的喧闹欢笑已被一股勉强维系的期待取代。靴底压过地板，木板在脚下吱呀作响，你一路走向中央那张桌子——以及在那里等你的人影。尽管他身旁站着数名目光如钢的守卫，那身影却紧绷得像一条盘起的毒蛇，随时都可能暴起出击。一张雕刻的象牙面具遮住了叛军领袖的真容，面具上刻出的狰狞面相非但没能安抚你的心，反而更令你神经发紧。

~ Paul Iverson on Discord

The usually jovial atmosphere in the tavern has been replaced with tenuous anticipation as you enter the deserted taproom. Floorboards creak beneath your boots as you make your way to the central table—and the figure awaiting you. Though flanked by several steely-eyed guards, the figure seems tense, like a coiled viper ready to strike at any moment. A mask of carved ivory obscures the rebel leader’s features, and the fearsome visage etched upon it does little to quiet your nerves.

~ Paul Iverson on Discord

I Cast Conjure Air Elemental.name:
我施放【召唤风元素】
I Cast Conjure Air Elemental

Text.text:
需要花上一分钟，吸入香雾、低声呢喃，在变幻的声风里把咒语时而吟唱、时而呼喊——如此才能说服一颗由空气织成的心智。烟化作云，云凝成生灵的轮廓，而那轮廓以姿态表明它的友谊。待我的咒文落幕，我与这位新盟友已整装待发。
It takes a minute of breathing incense and whispering, singing, and shouting the charm in the various vocal winds that will convince a mind made of air. Smoke becomes cloud, cloud a shape of being, and the shape expresses its friendship. By the time my incantation ends, my new confederate and I are ready.

Quip About Lion’s Bravery.name:
关于狮子勇气的俏皮话
Quip About Lion’s Bravery

Text.text:
“当你是狮子时，勇敢很容易；可当你是老鼠时，再试试看。”
“It’s easy to be brave when you’re a lion, but try it when you are a mouse.”

Volcanic Caldera.name:
火山口熔岩盆地
Volcanic Caldera

Text.text:
越接近峰顶，空气越发灼热黏稠，裹着硫磺味的蒸汽，刺得眼睛、鼻子、口腔与喉咙一齐发痛。登上山脊，坡面再度陡然坠落，豁然开出一座巨大的火山口。它呈狭长的椭圆，偏斜而不对称，破火山口的边缘在远侧高高隆起。与之相对的地方，蒸腾的热水汇聚成一汪咕嘟冒泡的湖泊，正是那股恶臭蒸汽的源头。盆地中央偏一侧耸立着一座岩锥，近处的水面沿着它的脚下铺开成一圈。

~ Envisioned by Dyrdron

Toward the summit, the air grows hot and thick with sulfurous steam, stinging the eyes, nose, mouth, and throat all at once. On the ridgetop, the slope falls away again and opens into a vast crater. Oblong and lopsided, the caldera has a rim that stands higher on the far side. Opposite that, steaming water has collected into a bubbling lake, the source of the foul vapors. A cone of rock stands off-center in the basin, the pool lining it on its near side.

~ Envisioned by Dyrdron

Rain, \"The Spellsniper\".name:
雨，“法术狙击手”
Rain, "The Spellsniper"

Text.text:
一道矫健的身影溜上旅馆屋顶，倾盆雨幕立刻将她那层轻甲般的身躯浇得透湿。下方的眩光在她极地般雪白的肌肤上跳跃，轻吻着那团覆到左眼的钴蓝乱发。她每迈出一步都带着试探，腰间沉甸甸的束带吱呀作响，无数小袋鼓胀饱满，盛满致命之物。她来到屋檐边缘，俯身望向喧嚣的街道；随即含笑攥紧戴着手套的拳头，一张脉动的能量弓骤然凝成。那近乎灼目的冷光映亮她右眼下方小小的鸟形纹身，暗示着某种隐秘的效忠。她静静等待，雨滴沿着脸颊滚落，像悔意的泪。

~ Played by Ararion

A lithe figure slips out to the hotel roof, sheet rain immediately drenching her lightly armored body. Glare from below dances across her polar-white skin, kissing the mop of cobalt hair cascading over her left eye. With each tentative step, her heavily laden belts creak, the myriad pouches brimming with lethality. Reaching the roof’s edge, she peers down into the bustling street; then with a smile she clenches her gloved fist and a bow of pulsing energy erupts into being. Its actinic glare highlights the small bird-shaped tattoo beneath her right eye, hinting at a clandestine allegiance. She waits, raindrops rolling down her face like tears of regret.

~ Played by Ararion

Apartment Of A Manor.name:
庄园公寓
Apartment Of A Manor

Text.text:
这组公寓供受敬的贵宾与庄园的常住者居住，陈设周到，配有精工打造的华美家具——每间都依主题装饰——宛如上等旅馆的套房。每套公寓都设有一间小会客室，与卧室相连，另有一间更小、也不那么气派的房间，供客人的贴身仆从起居。
This set of apartments for honored guests, and permanent residents of the manor, are well-appointed with beautifully crafted furniture—each decorated according to a theme—much like a fine hotel suite. Each apartment has a small sitting room connected to a bedroom and a smaller, less grand, room for the guest’s personal servants.

Dirindi Monster Hunter.name:
迪林迪怪物猎人
Dirindi Monster Hunter

Text.text:
他身披暗色的tempweave衣装，在薄弱处以加固缝线强化；这名类人生物没有族人惯有的笑容。取而代之的，是三只眼睛因专注而微眯，灼灼地扫视着地平线。下颌橡胶般的灰色皮肤绷紧成决绝的怒容。一支极性步枪垂挂在肩带上。他那套实用战衣与三指的静态极性护臂无缝衔接，浑然一体。
Clothed in dark tempweave reinforced at the weak points, this humanoid lacks the customary smile of his people. Instead, his three eyes are narrowed in concentration, fervently scanning the horizon. The rubbery gray skin of his jaw is set in a determined scowl. A polarity rifle dangles from a shoulder strap. His functional suit blends seamlessly into three-fingered static polarity gauntlets.

The Shattered Lands.name:
破碎之地
The Shattered Lands

Text.text:
这里的土地依旧如从前般丰饶；老树成行，沿着仍在耕作播种的田地绵延伸展。远处起伏的山坡上，有一座小镇。附近某处传来溪流欢快的细语，一只鹿在翠绿的幼树旁啃食片刻，随即悄然融入林间。 可在更远处，那座城市的天际线黑得狰狞，像一条玄武岩山脊般锯齿分明。数道烟柱从城中升起；另一个方向，视野之外的另一座城市也吐出烟雾，聚成自有的污灰云团；第三个方向，还有一根烟柱，更加遥远。澄澈的天空被苦难的证据涂抹。那不是篝火或庆典的烟。那气味像不该燃烧之物——刺鼻，带着肉质的焦腥。它闻起来像希望的丧失：每一柱烟都是一个派系，彼此分离、相互对立。这是分裂之烟，是破碎之后仍在闷燃的余烬。

~ 由 MasterLionsDen 扮演

The earth here is still as rich as it was before, the trees old and growing in long stretches along farmland still being tilled and planted. In the distance, on the rolling side of a hill, is a small town. Somewhere nearby is the cheerful voice of a brook, and a deer browses at a green sapling for a few moments, then melts into the woods. But in the distance, the city looks as black and jagged along its skyline as a mountain ridge of basalt. Several columns of smoke rise from it, and in another direction, smoke from another city out of sight rises to create its own foul gray clouds. In a third direction, another column, even farther off. The clear sky is painted with evidence of suffering. This is not the smoke of campfires or festivals. It smells of things that should not burn, acrid and fleshy. It smells of lost hope, each column of smoke a faction separate and against the others. It is the smoke of division, and it is what smolders after having been shattered.

~ Played by MasterLionsDen

Acid Rain On City Ruins.name:
酸雨倾泻在城市废墟上
Acid Rain On City Ruins

Text.text:
焦赭色的云层在不祥的轰鸣中裂开。人们抬眼望天。紧接着，雨开始了——一道无休无止的亮黄色洪流倾泻在这片城市废墟之上。细小的生灵仓皇窜回藏身处，畏缩着躲避那些化学毒雨，空气里弥漫着灼烧的气味。四下几乎没有声响，只有酸性雨液落下时的嘶嘶声，低劣的混凝土正被一点点蚀穿。
Clouds of burnt umber break with a foreboding rumble. Eyes look skyward. Then begins the rain—an unending stream of bright yellow upon these city ruins. Small critters skitter into their hiding places, cowering from the chemicals as the scent of burning fills the air. There is little noise but the hiss of low-grade concrete being eaten away by the acidic liquid fall.

顾客一踏进店门，便被甜腻的熏香气息迎面裹住。蒙着烟灰的货架与独立陈柜上挤满了玻璃瓶、试管与扁瓶，瓶中液体如宝石般闪烁，瓶塞却做成水晶球——或星芒、或蝴蝶的形状。一侧墙上的帘幕后方涌出缤纷而馥郁的烟雾，滚滚翻腾，汇聚在天花板下，旋成诡异的涡流与奇特的轮廓。
The cloying aroma of incense greets the customer upon entering the shop. Soot-dusted shelves and freestanding cabinets are crowded with glass bottles, vials, and flasks. Their liquid contents gleam like jewels, and their stoppers are shaped like crystal balls—or starbursts or butterflies. Colorful, fragrant smoke billows from behind a curtain on one wall. The smoke gathers under the ceiling, eddying in peculiar shapes.

Vial Of Purple Worm Poison.name:
紫虫毒素小瓶
Vial Of Purple Worm Poison

Text.text: [察觉] 这只小瓶安放在天鹅绒衬里的皮匣中：通体绿玻璃，瓶口向外喇叭般张开，仿佛专为容纳某种器具而设。瓶盖亦是玻璃制成，以针轴作铰，像镜片般翻开。其上刻着一枚符号，幽幽泛光。 [解析] 如同它所源自的那头怪物一般致命，这种毒药旨在杀死除最强韧者之外的一切生灵。迅捷而可靠，呈淡粉紫色的稀薄黏浆，适合抹在利刃之上。将箭头或刀尖一蘸，你便把巨虫之咬握在手边。 [Perceived] Nestled in a velvet-lined leather case, the vial is green glass, flared wide at the opening, as if to accommodate some utensil. Its lid is also glass, and dials open on a pin hinge like a lens. On it, a symbol is etched and faintly glowing. [Analyzed] As deadly as the monstrosity from which it originates, this poison is designed to kill all but the toughest beings. It is swift and reliable, a thin pinkish-purple ooze to be smeared on a sharp edge. Dip an arrowhead or knife tip into it and you have the bite of the great worm ready at hand.

宛如噩梦化作血肉，这头丑陋的双头死亡犬奴役于无尽的使命——散播痛苦与毁灭。无论是凭借它那对强健有力的巨颚，还是借由从可憎獠牙间滴落的毒涎，这头怪物存在的唯一意义，就是杀死一切不幸踏入它道路的生灵。
Like a nightmare made flesh, the hideous twin-headed death dog slavers in its unending quest to spread suffering and ruination. Whether by the force of its substantial jaws, or through the poisonous drool dripping from its loathsome fangs, this monster exists only to to kill anything unlucky enough to come across its path.

I Use Feral Instinct To Avoid A Surprise.name:
我动用野性本能来避免遭到突袭。
I Use Feral Instinct To Avoid A Surprise

Text.text:
空气的移动、细微的声响、钢铁掠过的那一缕气息——战斗尚未开始，我已先一步感知。怒火在胸中翻涌，我毫不犹豫地纵身扑向战场。
The movement of air, a subtle sound, the whiff of steel—I feel the battle before it starts. Rage rises in me, and I leap to the fight without hesitation.

Victorious Leonin Gladiator.name:
得胜的狮族角斗士
Victorious Leonin Gladiator

Text.text:
如传说中的英雄一般，角斗士踏在敌人残破的躯体上傲然挺立，她金色的皮毛被鲜血黏成一绺一绺。她发出野兽般的咆哮，将欢呼的人群煽动到狂热的崇拜中；金币、鲜花与其他恩宠的信物如雨般洒落在竞技场的黄沙之上。她将脸迎向太阳，合上双眼，细细品味胜利的这一刻。

~ Sahlonahl 于 Discord

Like a hero of legend, the gladiator stands triumphant over the ruined body of her foe, her golden fur matted with blood. Letting forth a bestial roar, she whips the cheering crowd into a frenzy of adulation as gold, flowers, and other tokens of favor rain onto the sands of the arena. She turns her face toward the sun and closes her eyes, savoring the moment of her victory.

~ Sahlonahl on Discord

这头恐怖怪物像鳗鱼与人形的杂交体：鱼一般的头颅上双眼死死瞪视，獠牙密布的巨口张裂，粗壮的脖颈布满一道道鳃裂。它有两条手臂，末端是生着利爪的手掌。生物的人形躯干向下渐收成尾，形似鳗鱼，却在末端分叉成两条触手般的附肢。令人作呕的病绿鳞片自头至尾覆满全身。
A cross between an eel and a humanoid, this horror has a fishlike head with staring eyes, a fanged maw, and a broad neck covered in gill slits. Its two arms end in clawed hands. The creature’s humanoid torso tapers into a tail, eellike except that it forks into two tentacular appendages. Scales, sickly green in hue, cover the monster head to tail.

Wizard's Secret Tower.name:
巫师的秘塔
Wizard's Secret Tower

Text.text: 一座小屋坐落在青草覆地的山丘之巅——然而你的真知视域却揭示出真相：那是一根高达一百英尺的奇想魔杖，笔直矗立，杖顶点缀着串串护符，杖底包覆皮革，如同握柄。你看见地面处有一扇橡木双开门。这是一座高塔。门周围环着三只眼睛，一只在上，两只分列左右，显然灌注了法术与反制法术。奥术防御在攀爬者眼中显现为锯齿般的矢量棱线，而针对飞行者的则是旋卷不息的魔法弧光。 Atop a grassy hill sits a cottage, except that your truesight shows it to be a wand of wonder one hundred feet tall, standing upright and dotted with charms at the top, the bottom clad in leather, like a grip. You see a double door of oak at ground level. This is a tower. Three eyes surround the door, one above and one to each side, obviously charged with spells and counterspells. Arcane defenses show as jagged vectors against climbing, and whirling magical arcs against flight.

你朝地面一指，刹那间行动骤然爆发，杂草与藤蔓猛然破土而出。根须蜿蜒着扑向你的目标，轻而易举地吞没地形：石块被劈裂，大地被撕开，障碍被撞得四散。接着，它们又沿着四肢攀缠而上……
You gesture to the ground and, with a burst of sudden activity, weeds and vines spring forth. The roots wind their way toward your target, overtaking the terrain with ease: splitting stone and sundering earth, knocking aside obstacles. Then they snake up limbs…

Legendary Space Pirate Lord.name:
传奇空间海盗领主
Legendary Space Pirate Lord

Text.text:
女人大摇大摆地迈入人群中央，周围的海盗纷纷往旁边退开。她双手叉腰，鼻尖微抬，居高临下地扫视着整艘船。歪斜的帽檐下露出一截利落的短发，她的手指不耐烦地敲打着大腿外侧那对激光手枪的枪套上方。她皮肤上遍布伤疤，其中两道格外醒目：一道又宽又参差的疤沿着下颌线蜿蜒而过，另一道长长的灼痕盘旋着爬上她的一条手臂。
The pirates around the woman edge away as she swaggers into the center of the crowd. She plants her hands on her hips as she surveys the ship, looking down her nose. Cropped hair peeks out from underneath an off-kilter hat, and her fingers drum impatiently above the pair of laser pistols holstered on her thighs. Among the scars peppering her skin, two stand out: one wide, jagged mark running along her jawline, and a lengthy burn mark spiraling up one arm.

Speech About The Chaos Of Life.name:
关于生命混沌的演说
Speech About The Chaos Of Life

Text.text:
“生命的巨轮翻搅不息。你刚以为自己站稳了脚跟，它就一把攥住你的脚踝，把你像颗渺小的石子般抛进它无数次的起落与跌宕，仿佛天穹中一架巨大的星辰风车。随后它又将你吐出来，昏沉而苍老，连一句温柔的道别都不曾留下。”
“The great churn of life. The moment you think you’ve found your footing it takes you by the ankle and hurls you through its many highs and lows like some great celestial pinwheel. Then it spits you out, dazed and old without so much as a fond farewell.”

你吐出的那句短促咒语几乎算不上法术；当你将手伸向那把武器时，你的动作也不过是指尖轻轻一颤。施法不只在于那些令人困惑的词句、手势或常常需要的材料，更在于意志与正确的心境。这道法术所需的，不过是你需求的力量，以及你意图的冲击。
The clipped phrase you utter is hardly a spell at all, your gesture little more than a waver of your hand as you reach toward the weapon. Spellcasting is as much about will and proper mindset as the confounding words, gestures, or materials they often require. This spell requires little more than the power of your need and the force of your intent.

Beautiful Copper Brooch.name:
美丽的铜胸针
Beautiful Copper Brooch

Text.text:
这件饰物让人想起沙漠与海洋交汇之处：棕榈在深橙色的新月下轻轻摇曳，月色随着下沉而愈发黯沉。横越这弯月的，是一枚如帐篷地钉般的别针，仿佛要将夜空钉牢在斗篷或披风的边缘之上，任其带着不祥的狞笑俯视人间。
The piece reminds one of where the desert meets the sea, where palms sway under a crescent moon of deep orange, darkening as it sets. Crossing under this moon is a pin like a tent spike, to fix the night sky of a cloak or mantle under its baleful grin.

De'le'mak Cromwell.name:
德莱马克·克伦威尔
De'le'mak Cromwell

Text.text:
你面前的类人生物——一个传承难以辨明的古怪生物——无论身形还是气势都令人望而生畏。他那和善的神情迫使你无法移开视线，而他的情绪却在不经意间急速变换：从澄澈的宁静，骤然跳入喧闹的欢笑。他的皮肤呈斑驳的暗红光泽，粗糙得像砂砾般触感分明，覆着细密而硬挺的绒毛；这些毛发在头顶汇聚，卷成一道俯冲般的、鹰隼似的弯曲鬃翎。

~ Played by christoffer

The humanoid before you—an odd creature of indeterminate heritage—strikes an imposing figure in both his stature and presence. His geniality demands your attention, and all the while his mood rapidly shifts from a serene calm to a boisterous mirth. His skin is a mottled, burnished red, rough to the touch and covered in fine, bristly fur which collects atop his head in a swooping, hawkish curl.

~ Played by christoffer

Armor Of Agathys.name:
艾伽席斯护甲
Armor Of Agathys

Text.text:
苍白的薄雾浮现，如同寒晨的一口白气，在你周身缠绕游走。缕缕雾丝盘旋交织，层层叠起凝成护甲：由幽影构筑的壁障，足以偏转刀锋的锐芒，或弹开法术的火花。
Pale mist appears, like a breath on a cold morning, weaving around you. Wisping coils thread over each other to form armor: spectral barricades to deflect the edge of a blade or the spark of a spell.

Implacable Triad Mountain Boss.name:
冷酷三联山之主
Implacable Triad Mountain Boss

Text.text: 他一头乌黑的丝发梳成利落的翘发，发丝油光锃亮，耳侧却泛着银白。棕褐色西装紧贴他修长的身形，色泽像沙漏里的细沙，又像裸露的山坡。随着他动作，衣料上忽然掠起一阵虹彩般的微光，浅绿纹路在布面上一闪即逝。那究竟只是贴肤的时髦噱头，还是某种内置护甲的暗示？夹克下低开的V领衫露出一枚纹身的汉字：三叉的shān。一副几何线条的墨黑墨镜遮住了他的眼睛，镜片与镜框仿佛与他的脸融为一体。薄薄的八字胡下，他的嘴角始终下垂，面无表情。 His silken black hair is styled in a neat quiff, the perfectly oiled strands silver near his ears. His tan suit hugs his slender form, the color like hourglass sand or a sheer mountainside. As he moves, an iridescent glimmer of light green patterns flares across the suit. Is it some skin-deep flair of fashion or a hint at some kind of built-in armor? The low-cut V-neck shirt under his jacket reveals a tattooed Chinese character: the three-pronged shān. A pair of geometric, ink-dark sunglasses obscure his eyes, the lenses and frame fused to his face. His mouth remains downturned, expressionless, beneath a thin mustache.

Divine Concert Hall Of A God Of Music.name:
音乐之神的神圣演奏厅
Divine Concert Hall Of A God Of Music

Text.text:
当观众步入音乐厅的那一刻，每个人都认得这份感觉：舞台在昏暗的期待中静候，微光浮在交谈与笑声之上；也许有人已按捺不住，自发齐声催促演出开场。就在同一瞬间，你也会预感到音乐会终章的返场——那种迟来的、却早已在心里排练过的激动。厅堂如新月般层层座席，面向世界舞台的弧线。你在这里，你有一张票；而当乐神未在演奏时，这片神圣的空间里的生活，就是等待下一次开演。
As the audience enters the concert hall, each recognizes this moment: a stage in dimly-lit anticipation, glowing above the conversations and laughter, perhaps an audience spontaneously chanting for it to begin. In this same moment, there is the anticipation of the encore at the end of the concert. The hall is a crescent of seats facing the arc of the world stage. You’re here, you have a ticket, and when the God of Music isn’t playing, life in this divine space means waiting for the show to begin again.

I Cross Difficult Terrain While Wearing.name:
我戴着自由动作戒指穿越困难地形
I Cross Difficult Terrain While Wearing My Ring Of Free Action

Text.text:
我移动——如烟般流畅——穿过眼前的障碍与险境，双足几乎不沾地，纵跃之间迅疾无阻。凭借戒指的魔法，我的四肢听从一种比我自身更灵巧、更精准的意志驱使，以超自然的先见与疾速穿行于地形之间。
I move—fluid as smoke—through the obstacles and hazards before me, my feet barely touching the ground as I bound, swift and unhindered. With the magic of the ring, my limbs respond to a will more dexterous and precise than my own, navigating the terrain with a supernatural foresight and celerity.

Warhorse Skeleton.name:
骷髅战马（特征）
Warhorse Skeleton

Text.text:
它的蹄声空洞地哐啷作响。你眼前这具无肉的肢节显然比活马更轻，可又仿佛这骷髅生物的脚步拖着墓穴的回声。它裂开的颅骨高高扬起，下颌开合，却除却骨骼的咔哒与吱呀，再无半点声息。
The clatter of its hooves rings hollow. The fleshless articulation before you is surely lighter than a living horse, but it’s also as if the skeletal creature’s feet carry with them the echoes of a tomb. Its cracked skull rears and its jaw moves, but it makes no sound other than the rattle and creak of bones.

Cyberpunk Fantasy Metropolis: Underclass.name:
赛博朋克奇幻巨都：下层阶级“D”区
Cyberpunk Fantasy Metropolis: Underclass 'D' Neighborhood

Text.text:
这里是一片贫困而危险的区域。拥挤破败的楼群既无法提供庇护，连最基本的资源也只能得到有限的许可；帮派与腐败官员的阴影无处不在，威胁时刻逼近。对生活在此的人而言，每一天都是一场挣扎。
This is a poverty-stricken and dangerous area. Its overcrowded and dilapidated buildings offer no protection, limited access to basic resources, and an ever-present threat from gangs and corrupt officials. Life is a daily struggle for those living here.

若有人把刀刃抵在你喉头，命你在这家店里辨认出一件物品——任何一件物品——你多半活不过这场遭遇。每一寸表面都堆满来历匪夷所思的零碎：矮人打造的玩具、奥术的小饰物、以及无法辨识的材料被雕成令人发狂的形状。某些散发着黯淡的磷光，另一些则沉在不自然的黑暗里，还有更多似乎会自行蠕动。越过你进来的那扇门，你看不出这片空间有任何明确的形态或用途，只剩令人眩晕的杂乱。
If someone pressed a blade to your throat and ordered you to identify a single item—any item—in this shop, you might not survive the encounter. Odds and ends of every conceivable origin, from dwarf-made toys to arcane baubles to indiscernible materials sculpted into maddening shapes, litter every surface. Some glow with a subdued phosphorescence, others sit in unnatural darkness, and still more seem to move of their own volition. Beyond the door through which you entered, you find no obvious form or function to the space, dizzying in its clutter.

Archmage Corrupted In Failed Ritual.name:
失败仪式中堕落的至高法师
Archmage Corrupted In Failed Ritual

Text.text:
“聆听我，伟大的存在！”那浑厚而回荡的嗓音自仪式圆环繁复的纹路中心响起。烛火安置在关键节点，光芒忽明忽暗，随着悬在空气中的魔法开始流散、抽离。“我召唤汝！”法师几乎是在嘶吼，猛地在掌心划开一道血口。猩红一触地，一道传送门便在召唤者头顶“咔哒”一声骤然张开。裂口边缘闪烁扭动，仿佛在与现实本身角力，拼命维持敞开。浑浊的黑暗里先浮现一枚猩红光球，紧接着又一枚——眼睛。法师龇牙露出阴毒的笑意。可下一瞬，某种东西改变了，空气陡然变得潮湿粘腻，几乎是在眨眼间。细长的肢体从门沿蠕动爬出。恐慌在法师眼底一闪而过，但他连尖叫都来不及，触手便猛然缠上，随即钻入他体内，逼得他剧烈痉挛，皮下浮起一片片黑斑。

~ Envisioned by SibunaIV

"Heed me, oh great one!" The rich, resonating voice calls from the center of the complex designs of a ritual circle. The light of the candles, sitting at crucial points, flickers and wanes as the magic held in the air begins to flow out and away. "I summon thee!" the mage practically screams, slicing a bloody gash into his palm. As soon as crimson touches the ground, a portal snaps open above the summoner. The edges of the opening shimmer and writhe, as if fighting against reality itself to stay open. A bright red orb appears in the murky darkness, then another. Eyes. The mage bares his teeth in a wicked grin. But then something shifts, and the air grows humid and sticky in the span of an instant. Long appendages slither from the edges of the portal. Panic flickers through the mage's eyes, but he doesn't have time to scream before the tentacles latch on, then sink into him, making him convulse as splotches of black appear beneath his skin.

~ Envisioned by SibunaIV

一头巨如山岳的利维坦，通体暗绿，猛然自大地的怀抱中破土而出。它以古怪而冲动的扭曲翻腾蠕动，姿态与其说像陆地之物，不如说更像水栖（特征）生物。细小带翼、宛如手臂的附肢振翅扑动，勉强维持躯体平衡。革质皮肤一路延伸至一张深不见底的巨口，口中密布成排尖刺般的利齿。昏暗光线里，那双眼睛闪着令人作呕的病黄光泽。
A gargantuan leviathan, dark green in color, bursts from the earth’s embrace. Squirming with odd, impulsive contortions, it appears more alike to an aquatic creature than anything of the land. Small, winged, armlike appendages flutter to balance the body. Leathery skin leads up to a cavernous maw sporting rows of spiny teeth. The eyes glitter a sickening yellow in the half-light.

Kaelen Xil'thrazi.name:
凯伦·希尔萨拉兹
Kaelen Xil'thrazi

Text.text:
一位卓尔女子身披秘银护甲，护甲上烙印着美与歌之女神的徽记。她坐在喷泉旁，将一把竖琴轻轻偎在右肩，抬手把一缕长长的白发别到耳后，随即拨弦，奏出甜美如梦的旋律。她的面容既温柔又沧桑，眉间褶皱里压着无数战斗与往昔悲恸的沉重忧伤。被日常困厄拖拽的镇民纷纷停步聆听，歌声浸满宁静与片刻的歇息。

~ Played by NotCurtis

A drow woman wearing mithral armor emblazoned with the sign of the goddess of beauty and song sits by a fountain and cradles a lyre against her right shoulder. She tucks a strand of long white hair behind her ear and begins to strum a sweet, dreamy melody. Her face is both caring and careworn, her brow creased with the woe of countless battles and past grief. Townsfolk lost in their daily hardships pause to listen to her song, suffused with tranquility and respite.

~ Played by NotCurtis

Sleazy Motel Manager.name:
卑劣的汽车旅馆经理
Sleazy Motel Manager

Text.text:
那胖墩墩、头顶见秃的男人几乎没从屏幕上抬眼，只用一声含糊的哼哧作为对你闯入的询问。汗水像刷了釉的肉一样从他身上泛出，他的体味像酸奶般呛人，浸透了这间阴沉的汽车旅馆前台，渗进那些花里胡哨的陈旧摆设里。他从身旁板子上的钥匙牌里抄起一把磕碰得不成样的钥匙朝你这边一甩，含混地嘟囔了句算作欢迎，又用手指朝门口狠狠一戳。
The portly, balding man barely looks up from his screen as he responds with a grunt of inquiry to your intrusion. Sweating like glazed meat, his body odor saturates the dingy motel office like sour milk, seeping into the garish furnishings. Hucking a battered key from the board beside him in your direction he mutters something by way of welcome and jabs a finger toward the door.

Shock Wave From Nearby Explosion Shatter.name:
附近爆炸的冲击波震碎了窗户
Shock Wave From Nearby Explosion Shatters Windows

Text.text:
一股无形的力之波在空气中疾射而过。轰鸣震耳欲聋，像一连串沉闷的爆震。紧接着，当冲击波触及四周建筑，又传来第二重声响——玻璃碎裂，硬化聚合物被撕成齑粉。窗户仿佛被某头巨大的隐形野兽猛然扯脱，连框带座一并掀走。碎片闪烁着催眠般的微光，像细雨般洒向街面，翻滚着掠过路砖，叮当作响地撞上停放的车辆与路桩。
An invisible wave of force rockets through the air. The sound is deafening, a series of low concussions. Then, as the shock wave reaches the surrounding buildings, comes a second sound—that of glass shattering, the hardened polymers turning to shreds. Windows are ripped from their holdings, as if by some great invisible beast. A mesmeric sparkle of shards sprinkles out toward the street, tumbling across the pavement and ricocheting off parked cars and bollards.

远离海湾那不规则的轮廓，浮冰向外铺展成一片近乎无特征的苍白荒原。浅灰的天幕与地平线上惨淡的冰色仿佛融为一体，让你觉得自己正住在一只寒冷的气泡里。与这无边无际的白色无穷相对，冰封深处的凶险几乎都显得诱人起来。
Away from the irregular shape of the bay, the ice floe expands in a virtually featureless expanse of white. The light gray skies and the pale ice of the horizon appear to blend together, giving you the impression of residing in a bubble of cold. The dangers of the frozen depths almost seem inviting when confronted with this infinity of boundless white.

Penwellyn Park In Winter.name:
冬日的彭威林公园
Penwellyn Park In Winter

Text.text:
印着 Hoof Maloof 马厩徽记的马车沿着犁开的土路缓缓行进，拉车的骏马踏着轻快的步伐小跑。它们颈项与缰具上悬着的铃铛叮当作响，诡异地合成一段熟悉的旋律。摆脱了学堂束缚的孩子们尽情撒欢：堆起雪人，友善地互掷雪球，在覆着白雪的林丛间捉迷藏。偶尔，孩子们会从树丛里尖叫着冲出来，笑得满脸通红，肾上腺素把他们的面颊染得发烫。“你看到了吗？”他们彼此追问，声音随即压低成兴奋的耳语。“小仙灵！”
Carriages emblazoned with the logo of Hoof Maloof stables roll along the plowed paths, drawn by horses trotting buoyantly. The bells adorning their necks and bridles uncannily jingle to a familiar tune. Children, free from the confines of school, play with abandon: creating snowfolk, engaging in good-natured snowball fights, and playing hide-and-seek in the copses of snow-topped trees. Every so often, the children scream and run from the trees, smiling faces flush with adrenaline. “Did you see that?” they ask each other. Their voices lower to excited whispers. “Pixies!”

Sphinx Casting Plane Shift.name:
斯芬克斯施放位面转移
Sphinx Casting Plane Shift

Text.text:
那生物的面容因深沉的暴怒而紧绷；那张大体仍似人形的脸，被浓密如鬃的乌黑皮毛覆盖。“你玷污了此地，”它用砂砾刮磨岩石般的嗓音低吼。它龇牙咆哮，露出尖锐的猫科獠牙。“我的主人不会容忍你的存在。滚开！”它皮毛上的斑点与条纹在金色魔法中闪烁，与它怒火灼灼、镀金般的双眼相互辉映。你的全身猛然一震，双脚离地，被一股无形之力掀飞向后——仿佛现实的经纬在缝线上被硬生生撕扯。你以不可能的速度穿越位面之间那浩瀚的虚空，恶心翻搅着你的胃与喉咙。一个低沉的轻笑在你脑海里回荡，继而慢慢塌陷成满足的呼噜。炽热的浪潮拍上你的后背，你听见一声滋滋作响——身后的传送门猛然撕裂而开。

~ 一位英雄所构想

The creature’s visage clenches with a deep fury, the mostly humanoid face thickly maned with jet-black fur. "You sully this place,” it growls in a voice like gravel scraping against stone. It snarls, showing pointed, feline teeth. “My master will not be subjected to your presence. Begone!" The spots and stripes of its fur shimmer with golden magic that matches its raging, gilded eyes. Your entire body lurches as your feet lift off the ground and you are flung back by an unseen force—the very fabric of reality tearing at its seams. Nausea wracks your stomach and throat as you fly at impossible speed through the vast expanse between planes. A low chuckle echoes throughout your mind until it devolves into a satisfied purr. A wave of heat hits your back and you hear a sizzle as a portal rips open behind you.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

沙色的几丁质甲片掩蔽着这具存在；它像一只巨型蝎子，却在本该是头颅与螯钳的位置，连接着一具近似人形的躯干。八条蛛形长足支撑着宽阔而扁平的身躯，末端拖着一条修长尾巴，尾端的倒刺毒针寒光逼人。人形部分生着两条手臂；每只昆虫般的足端与每只人手上，都长着三根指趾。它的头颅乍看像一顶巴布特式头盔，双眼从一处空洞中窥视，几乎如同头盔的眼缝。额上方伸出一支独角。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Sand-colored chitinous plates cover this being, which resembles a giant scorpion with a humanlike torso connected where its head and pincers should be. Eight arachnid legs support a broad, flat body that ends in a long tail with a barbed stinger. The humanoid portion has two arms, and three digits tip every insectile foot and each humanoid hand. The head could be mistaken for a barbute helm, with the being’s eyes peering from a hollow almost like a helmet’s eye slit. A single horn projects from their upper brow.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Chained Arclight Phoenix In Volcano.name:
火山中的锁链弧光凤凰
Chained Arclight Phoenix In Volcano

Text.text:
你穿过传送门，步入一座广袤的火山洞窟：汗涔涔的火成岩在热浪里渗出湿亮的光。空气翻涌成蒸汽。硫磺味刺入鼻腔，你的眼睛痉挛着想要抽离那令人窒息的灼热。一股熔岩间歇泉轰然喷发，抛洒出炫目火光与电闪交织的风暴，旋即凝聚成一只巨大的凤凰。粗如手腕的铁链将这生物拴在一颗下垂沉坠的有角颅骨上。骨骼被灰烬熏黑，受热与压迫而龟裂，却被同一种幽暗的灵质强行箍合——那灵质也令它的眼眶里汇成液态黑曜石般的深池。凤凰冲至弧顶时，铁链略一松弛——下一瞬，它裹挟怒焰俯冲而下，拖拽着那块巨石般的颅骨，如同链枷般砸向你。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

You step through the portal into a vast volcanic cavern of sweating igneous stone. The air steams. The smell of sulfur invades your sinuses, and your eyes spasm as they try to twitch away the oppressive heat. A geyser of lava erupts, spewing forth a maelstrom of coruscating fire and lightning that coalesces into the form of a massive phoenix. Chains as thick as your wrist connect the creature to the sagging weight of a horned skull. Bones blackened with ash, cracked by heat and pressure, are held together by the same dark anima that makes its eyes pool with liquid obsidian. The chain slackens as the phoenix crests its arc—then descends toward you in an eruption of rage, dragging that boulder-sized skull like a flail.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

腐肉的恶臭裹着新鲜血液的金属腥味，充斥着整个空间。每个角落都堆着纠结成团的黑色毛皮，地上散落着十来只大小不一的生物骸骨——被啃噬得支离破碎，骨髓也被吸得一干二净。墙面布满爪痕，深深刨开，沿着长度被反复撕扯刮掠。还有衣物，撕裂且血迹斑斑，破碎地堆成一团团。你在空间里挪动时，某种东西在更深处也随之动了。
The smell of rotting meat, tinged with the metallic tang of fresh blood, dominates the space. Piles of matted, black fur lie in every corner, and bones from a dozen creatures big and small—gnawed-on, drained of marrow—litter the floor. The wall is marred with claw marks, gouged deep and raked across their length. Clothes too, torn and bloodstained, lie in tattered piles. As you move about the space, something moves deeper within.

Divine Badlands Of A God Of Dinosaurs.name:
恐龙之神的神圣荒原
Divine Badlands Of A God Of Dinosaurs

Text.text:
龟裂的硬土、风蚀石柱与拱形岩层一路铺展，延伸至被涂染般的高原地平线。耐旱灌木伏在无情烈日下，投下坚硬而深邃的阴影。沿着一条地下水脉的踪迹，绿洲如小镇般接连涌现，每一处都充满各类恐龙的身影。在其中最宏伟的一处，巍峨棕榈之下，环列着高耸的赤红砂岩与巨大的战鼓。正中央，王座与祭坛相依而卧，周围堆叠着成千上万的白骨。
The hardpan cracked ground and hoodoo and arch formations stretch to a horizon of painted plateaus. Scrub brush and hard shadows lie under the unforgiving sun. Along the trail of an underground waterway, oases spring up like small towns, each full of the range of dinosaurs. In the grandest of these is a ring of tall red sandstones and great drums standing under majestic palms. In the center, a throne and altar nest together among thousands of white bones.

Shield Of Missile Attraction.name:
招引飞矢之盾
Shield Of Missile Attraction

Text.text:
这面盾牌中等大小，重心稳妥，触感仿佛由淬硬钢铁锻成；你一握住它，便被一股刀枪不入的感觉击中。如此显而易见经魔法强化的防护，必能在敌人的攻势下为你撑起坚实的壁垒。
Medium-sized, well-balanced, and fashioned from what feels like hardened steel, as soon as you take hold of the shield you are struck by a sense of invulnerability. Surely such an obviously magically enhanced protection will provide a substantial defense against the attacks of your foes.

Summon Greater Demon.name:
召唤高等恶魔
Summon Greater Demon

Text.text:
地狱的吟诵充斥空气，你的喉咙肿胀起来，勉强容纳那嘈杂辅音的喉音咕噜，粗粝而刺耳。吟诵以一个单词收束——一条刻在血肉、烙进灵魂的真理。你呼唤一名恶魔，它便在一阵硫磺般的爆燃中回应召唤，辛辣呛人的火焰猛然腾起。猩红近紫、仿佛瘀伤的火光缠绕全身，那生物自它的地狱迈出一步，踏入我们的世界。
Infernal chanting fills the air as your throat swells to accommodate the guttural burble of cacophonic consonants. The chant ends with a single word, a truth writ in flesh, in soul. You name a demon and it answers its summons in a sulfurous flare of acrid fire. Wreathed in bruised burgundy flames, the creature steps from its hell into our world.

Assassin Climbing Rope.name:
刺客攀爬绳
Assassin Climbing Rope

Text.text:
悄如猫影，刺客攀上这座垂直堡垒。他们的身形仿若幽暗的缚灵（特征），沿着绳索无声游上。每一次移动都是一场冷静而精密的演示，嘲弄着重力的攫握。又似神秘的蜘蛛，他们瓦解城墙的防御，疾掠越过边缘——一抹昏黑的威胁。
Silent as a cat, an assassin ascends the vertical bastion. Their form, a shadowy wraith, ghosts its way up the rope. Every movement is a methodical show of precision, mocking gravity’s grasp. Like a mysterious spider, they defeat the wall’s defenses and scuttle over the edge—a tenebrous threat.

若这副板甲并非出自矮人之手，那必定也是为致敬他们而造。肩甲铸成铁砧之形，自肩头昂然挺立。头盔的面甲被打造成矮人盛怒的面容，其下垂落一束由交错链环编成的长须。
If this plate armor wasn’t made by dwarves, it must have been made to honor them. The pauldrons, shaped like anvils, stand proud from the shoulders. The helmet has a faceplate crafted to resemble a dwarf’s furious countenance, and from it dangles a long beard of interwoven chain.

他从摊开的、巨幅羊皮纸上那些绘制好的图样中抬起头，将直尺与三角板塞进口袋，沿着干船坞一路走去。他以老练的眼光掠过一队队男女工匠，看他们把木板削磨弯塑成肋骨，准备与龙骨严丝合缝地拼接——他心知肚明，最终成形的船壳必须完美无瑕，才配得上那艘足以号令海面的船，也配得上他当之无愧的价格。
Looking up from the plans drafted on the unrolled, over-large parchment, the shipbuilder pockets his ruler and triangle then walks the length of the dry dock. With a practiced eye, he sweeps his gaze over teams of men and women shaping wooden planks into ribs to be fitted to the keel, knowing that the resulting hull must be perfect for a ship commanding his well-deserved price.

Euphoric Street Drug, Bliss.name:
欣快街头毒品「极乐」
Euphoric Street Drug, Bliss

Text.text: 极乐常以泡泡糖般的粉彩方块被吞服。它带着黄油般的绵滑，入口即化，在使用者口中铺开一层天鹅绒般的薄毯，染出柔软的余韵。紧随其后的是一阵突如其来的麻木，缓慢退潮，化作渗入每一寸感官的欣快极乐。对其峰值效应的研究极难记录，因为受试者往往诉诸抽象而诗意的语言来描述自身感受。普遍共识认为，这种药物：让气味化作交响，让音乐化为魔法，让色彩化作奢华盛景，让接触化作电流般的酥麻颤动。 Bliss is often consumed in bubble-gum-like pastel cubes. Its buttery texture dissolves when eaten, staining the user's mouth in a velvet blanket. A sudden numbing feeling slowly ebbs into a euphoric bliss that permeates every sense. Studies of the peak effects are quite difficult to document as test subjects often resort to abstract and poetic language to describe their sensations. Consensus is that the drug: turns smells to symphonies, music to magic, colors to extravagance, and touch to electrifying tingles.

City Temple To A Sun God.name:
城市里的太阳神神殿
City Temple To A Sun God

Text.text:
这座海滨城镇泥泞的街道与茅草覆顶的屋舍间，突兀地立着一处小巧却耀眼的灯塔：一座神殿，正面绘着金色太阳冲破地平线的徽记。檐口在日光般明亮的金漆条纹下闪闪发亮，支撑屋顶的柱身雕刻着一幕幕景象：渔网与鱼篓满溢而出；笑意盈盈的父母与手足迎来健康的新生儿；以及更多关于丰足喜乐的写照。殿内，你看见一位女祭司将新生儿紧紧抱在怀里，孩子裹在天青色的布中。她贴近耳畔低声赐福，旁边一小群信众也以呢喃般的赞颂随声相和。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

The muddy streets and thatched-roof buildings of this coastal city are interrupted by a small yet brilliant beacon: A temple emblazoned with an emblem of a golden sun breaching the horizon. The cornices shine with sun-bright streaks of golden paint, and the columns holding the roof aloft depict scenes of nets and baskets overflowing with fish, healthy babies born to smiling parents and siblings, and other examples of happy abundance. Within, you see a priest holding a newborn close, bundled in a sky-blue fabric. She whispers blessings over the child while a modestly sized gathering of worshippers whisper their praises.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Stern Secondary Rune Sigils.name:
冷峻的次级符文印记
Stern Secondary Rune Sigils

Text.text:
一阵略高的嗡鸣与甲板上主符印低沉的隆隆声交织在一起。这些更小的符印恒久发光，和船上其余部分符文的脉动并不同步。你靠近那些镶着黄铜边框的小型图符时，太阳穴的酸胀逐渐加重——也许，它们的魔法并不相同。
A hum of a slightly higher pitch mingles with the low, rumbling tones of the main sigils on deck. These smaller sigils glow constantly, out of time with the pulse of the runes on the rest of the ship. You feel an ache build in your temples as you stand near the small, brass-framed icons—perhaps their magic is different.

他洁白的鬃毛一尘不染，随风拂动，环绕着那张狮面般的威严面孔。双眼如金，左眼上方横着一道疤痕。狮族人神情坦荡自信，站姿庄重而骄傲。鳞甲贴合地包裹住他健壮的身躯，覆着白色短毛的巨掌分别握着一把弯刀与一面盾牌。他昂然而立，随时准备投身战士应尽之事。

~ 由一位英雄 扮演

His white mane, pristine, blows in the breeze around his leonine face. His eyes are golden, the left one carrying a scar above it. The lionfolk bears a look of honesty and confidence, and his posture is dignified and proud. His scale armor covers his muscular frame perfectly while massive hands covered in white fur hold a scimitar and shield. He stands ready for the work that befits a warrior.

~ Played by a Hero

我从斜跨胸前的弹带上抽出一柄飞刀——在将它掷出的电光石火间，掌心先感到那令人安心的分量。它翻滚着破空而去，仿佛连空气都被切开；波纹钢在光里一闪一闪，旋转如舞者般轻盈。它从正缠斗的身影旁掠过，钢刃撞钢刃的铮鸣仍未落定，便已命中目标——顺着甲片间的缝隙滑入，沉入血肉，发出令人满足的thunk。

~ 由 Casey Boyd 在 Envisioned 中构想

I slide free a throwing dagger from the bandolier across my chest—feel its comforting weight in the palm of my hand in the split-second before I let it fly. It sails, end over end, slicing through the air itself, rippled steel gleaming in the light as it rotates like a dancer. It sails past combatants locked together, steel against steel, and finds its mark, sliding between armored plates to sink into flesh with a satisfying thunk.

~ Envisioned by Casey Boyd

Phantom Wyvern Appears.name:
魅影翼龙现身
Phantom Wyvern Appears

Text.text:
那物体猛然撞进沙丘，卷起一团团细腻、惨白的沙尘，翻涌着飘入清冷的夜空。它开始移动，在扭动的阴影里，一道朦胧的巨龙轮廓逐渐凝聚成形，随即舒展开修长而枯瘦的双翼。那生物向夜色中迸发出一声透骨的尖啸。它压低爬虫般的头颅，魅影（特征）死死盯住你；它眼中跳动的鬼火微光如尘埃般飞舞，燃着毫不掩饰的恶意。

~ 构想：Inbal，来自 Discord

The object sends clouds of fine, pale sand billowing into the cool night air as it crashes into the dunes. It begins to move, a nebulous draconic form coalescing in the writhing shadows and unfurling long, emaciated wings. The creature unleashes a bone-chilling shriek into the night. Lowering a reptilian head, the phantom glares at you. The motes of witchlight dancing in its eyes burn with unbridled malice.

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

Autumn Equinox In Seaside City.name:
海滨城的秋分
Autumn Equinox In Seaside City

Text.text:
一阵柔风裹着海的咸香与稀薄的云影吹向内陆，纵使夏日残阳渐褪，也让城里依旧清凉。即将到来的秋意最先显露在那座城池环抱的山峰之下——冷冽的阴影久久盘桓。然而山坡上的草仍青翠，树木也还满枝叶。人们穿着宽松舒适的衣裳穿行在喧闹街巷间，忙着为仅剩数日便将到来的丰收庆典张灯结彩。

~ 由 Glen Hiler 构想

A soft breeze carries the sea’s scent and sparse clouds inland, keeping the city cooler despite the fading summer sun. The first hints of the coming autumn are the cold shadows that linger under the peak the city sprawls around. But grass on the hill is green, and its trees still have all their leaves. People go about their business in loose, comfortable clothing amid the bustling streets, busy decorating for the harvest celebrations that are only days away.

~ Envisioned by Glen Hiler

这只隐约带着爬行类轮廓的生物拖着修长蜿蜒的脖颈，尽头却是一颗梳着鸡冠的雄鸡头颅，配着一只阴狠带倒刺的喙。蝠翼般的翅膀紧贴在它身侧，随着步伐不安地颤动。覆鳞的双腿以锐利的爪钩收尾，托着它向前逼近；它一边嗅探空气，一边心不在焉地咯咯低鸣，寻觅着猎物。
The long, serpentine neck of this vaguely reptilian creature ends in the combed head of a rooster, complete with wicked, barbed beak. Bat-like wings, tucked against the creature's sides, shift restlessly as it moves. Scaled legs ending in wicked talons carry the beast forward as it sniffs the air, chittering absently to itself as it hunts for prey.

色彩鲜艳的旗幡自屋顶垂落，柱身上缠绕着花环，每一道都点缀着当季的繁花。笑声与歌声在大厅里回荡，众人同乐，欢庆不息。整只烤熟的乳猪、盛满烘焙蔬菜的碗钵、外脆内软的面包长条在长桌上袅袅冒着热气，旁边是斟得满满的葡萄酒与麦酒。然而此刻，多数人似乎无心享用盛宴：平民与一小撮年轻贵族欢呼着涌入一片清空的区域，手牵着手围成圈，踏着鼓手的节拍起舞。
Brightly colored banners hang from the roof and wreaths line the pillars, each adorned with flowers of the season. Laughter and singing ring through the hall, as all join in the merriment. Whole cooked pigs, bowls of baked vegetables, and crispy bread loaves steam on the tables alongside full glasses of wine and ale. But, for now, most seem to be ignoring the feast, as commoners and a clique of young nobles cheer and pour into a cleared area to circle hand-in-hand to a drummer’s beat.

Necromancy Graveyard And Theatre.name:
死灵法术：墓园与剧场
Necromancy Graveyard And Theatre

Text.text:
由于昏厥——或濒死体验——而导致的大多数医务室之行都源于此处：墓园及其讲学阶段坐落在离学院高塔不远的一座山丘上。学生们沿着碎石小径穿过一扇黑色铁门，从阶段上聆听当夜的课程：一段灰色板岩拱弧，背后是巍峨的陵寝；亡者自此被运来，又自此被送走。新生课程从暮色持续到黑暗，而最精深的研讨课则从午夜一直开到魔女时刻。
Responsible for most of the trips to the infirmary due to fainting—or near-fatal experiences—the graveyard and its lecture stage reside on a hill not far from the Academy tower. Students follow a stony path through a black gate, and are given the night’s lesson from the stage: an arc of gray slate with a grand mausoleum as its backdrop, to and from which the dead are conveyed. First-year classes meet from twilight to darkness, while the most advanced seminar meets from midnight to the witching hour.

Villainous Victory With A Twist.name:
反派胜利，却有个意外转折
Villainous Victory With A Twist

Text.text:
当夕阳沉坠在最终决战的地平线下——大地被英雄的鲜血染透，那为注定覆灭的事业徒然洒落的血——一阵可怖的战栗撕裂了地面。反派计划的真相终于浮出水面：他们并非为了自己而征服这个世界。

~ 由 Discord 上的 Ameria 构想 Discord

As the sun sinks low over the final battle—the ground stained with the blood of heroes, spilled in vain for a doomed cause—a terrible shudder splinters the earth. The truth of the villain's plan finally comes to light: they were not conquering this world for themself.

~ Envisioned by Ameria on Discord

Dancing A Bladesong.name:
舞动的刃歌
Dancing A Bladesong

Text.text:
你合上双眼，长长吐出一口气，感受魔法在血脉中微微沸腾。能量在你持剑的手臂上刺痒跳动，漫过双足，沿着太阳穴翻涌奔窜。你睁开眼，澄明如镜；眼前的混战忽然成了一支你早已熟记每一步的舞。你手腕一抖，利剑在手，蓄势待发。你迈步——一、二，唰，铛！旁人笨拙碰撞之际，你在完美的节奏里闪避、格挡、反击，分毫不差。

~ 由 Magister_Mind19 Envisioned

You close your eyes and let out a sigh, feeling the magic simmering in your veins. Energy tingles in your sword arm, floods your feet and rollicks in your temples. You open your eyes in total clarity, the skirmish before you now a dance to which you know all the steps. With a flourish, you ready your rapier. You step—one, two, swish, clang! As others clumsily clash around you, you dodge, parry and strike in perfect time.

~ Envisioned by Magister_Mind19

Rowdy Cantina In Frontier Town.name:
边境小镇的喧闹酒馆
Rowdy Cantina In Frontier Town

Text.text:
上百种不同的语言、咕哝与嚎叫从恶臭的人群里翻涌而起。太空行者、猎人、矿工——各色被放逐的人，醉意与清醒参差不齐——挤满了这间粗陋的酒馆，每张脸都挂着在苦日子里磨出来的凶硬阴沉。地面被金属卡座和临时拼凑的桌子占满；角落里，两只跳动的黄色盒子吐出刺耳的音乐，由一个狼一般的身影操控。吧台背后亮着绿色霓虹，为这片摇摇欲坠的空间罩上一层病态的幽光。
A hundred different languages, grunts, and yowls rise from the stinking crowd. Spacers, hunters, mining folk—all manner of outcasts, in varying states of sobriety and consciousness—crowd this rudimentary cantina, each wearing the rough scowl of hard living. The floor is occupied by metal booths and makeshift tables, and in the corner tinny-sounding music comes from two pulsing yellow boxes operated by a wolfish figure. The bar is backlit with green neon, giving the ramshackle space a sickly glow.

Prairie Block Keep.name:
草原街区要塞
Prairie Block Keep

Text.text:
要塞矗立在一座覆着淡黄草皮的山丘之巅——一座两层高、没有窗户的混凝土灰色方块。碎石小径沿坡蜿蜒而上，通向一堵与要塞同色的围墙；围墙设有角柱，墙顶仅以朴素的线脚作收。
The keep, a two-story windowless block of concrete gray, stands atop a hill of pale-yellow grass. A gravel path climbs the hill to a wall, the same color as the keep, with corner posts and simple trim along the top.

I Successfully Turn A Spell With My Ring.name:
我用【法术反转戒指】成功将一发法术回转回去
I Successfully Turn A Spell With My Ring Of Spell Turning

Text.text:
我一把攥住手腕，将紧握的拳头举在身前，指上的盾面戒指与法术来势正正对齐。心跳猛地窜到喉咙口，法术朝我飞射而来——越来越近！随即只听“嘶”地一声闷响夹着尖细的吱鸣，法术撞上戒指，弹开，反射回我的敌人身上。我露出阴险的笑容，看着对方面孔被被弹回的法术光芒遮罩，愣得下巴松垮，满脸难以置信。
I grab my wrist, positioning my clenched fist in front of me, shield-faced ring on my finger in line with the spell. My heart leaps into my throat as the spell flies at me—closer and closer! Then, with a fizzle and squeak, the spell bounces off the ring and back at my enemy. I flash a devious grin as I see their face, veiled in the light of the rebuffed spell, hang slack in disbelief.

简朴的长桌配着长凳，一排排沿着这座高拱大厅的纵深整齐延展。光线从墙壁高处狭窄的窗户间渗入。这里原本是为百人乃至更多人提供座位与餐食的所在，却没有壁炉；少了人群的体温，大厅便显得格外阴冷。
Simple tables with long benches run in rows down the length of this large, vaulted hall. Light filters in through narrow windows set high in the walls. Meant to seat and feed a hundred or more people, the chamber has no fireplace and feels chilly without their body heat.

细腻的白色石材砌成一对石柱，夹立在峡谷入口两侧；通往沟壑尽头那扇门的铺砖小径，也同样由这种大理石铺就。每一块较大的石砖周围，都嵌着一圈浅蓝色的小石片作边饰，整条路又以苍白的石条收边。沙子也未曾将这条砖路掩埋。这一切石作，都与台地天然的赤红岩层格格不入。细看之下还能发现：沿着柱廊小径的砂岩若曾被雕琢，那也不是人手所为——是风，或是水，替它刻出了痕迹。
Fine-grained white stone makes up pillars that flank the canyon entrance, and the tiles forming a path to the doorway at the end of the gulch are made from the same marble. Smaller pieces of light blue border each larger tile, and the whole pathway is edged with pale stone. Sand hasn’t covered the tiled path, either. All this stonework is unlike the natural red rock of the mesa. A close look reveals that, if the sandstone along the pillared path was carved, it was wind or water that did the work.

你完成法术，指尖点燃起如烛火般的微焰。火光迅速沿着手臂攀升，越过你的身躯，旋即将你整个人缠裹在烈焰之中。你所穿所触无一焦灼，反倒在这片炽燃里感到被牢牢守护。
You finish the spell and your fingertips light with candle-like flames. These swiftly spread up your arms and over your body to wreathe you in fire. Nothing you wear or touch burns, instead you feel protected by the blaze.

Approaching A Mostly Abandoned Village.name:
靠近一座几近荒废的村庄
Approaching A Mostly Abandoned Village

Text.text:
在一座大宅里，一户显然出身低微的家庭正在办派对。他们与宾客举杯畅饮、纵声大笑。街上另外十一栋房子里，六栋窗门都被木板钉死，三栋被疯长的园林景致勒得喘不过气，还有两栋已烧成焦黑残骸。村广场上，偶尔有店里的伙计从一条破烂横幅下走过——那横幅宣告的活动早在几个月前就结束了。另有一栋看起来还算体面的房子里，一只母负鼠从敞开的前门领着幼崽出来，朝酒馆走去。
In a mansion a clearly lower-class family throws a party. They and their guests drink and laugh. Of the eleven other houses on the street, six are boarded up, three strangled by their landscaping, and two burned. In the village square, an occasional shop worker crosses under a tattered banner announcing an event that ended months ago. Out of one otherwise decent-looking house, a mother possum leads her babies from the open front door toward the tavern.

Technomancer Entering The Digital Concor.name:
科技法师踏入数字协律
Technomancer Entering The Digital Concordance

Text.text:
如同砖墙里的砂浆，代码也有缝隙与扣件——一种象征性的凝胶将其黏合，而技法师能看见它。就在那儿，寥寥几行、或一簇标点之间，藏着空隙，他那独一无二的魔法得以攀附生根。凭借杂技般的法术手法，他滑入协约，向潜能之基更深处俯冲。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Like mortar in a brick wall, the code has seams and fasteners, a symbolic gel that holds it together, which the technomancer can see. Just there, in a few lines or a cluster of punctuation, are the spaces where his unique kind of magic can take hold. With acrobatic spell work he slips into the Concordance, diving deeper into the foundation of potentiality.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Vial Of Wyvern Poison.name:
飞龙毒液小瓶
Vial Of Wyvern Poison

Text.text:
这只玻璃瓶握在手里微微温热，接触之下能感觉到瓶身传来些许余温。瓶中盛着油腻的黄浊液体，夹着几枚凝滞不动的气泡。瓶塞被紧紧楔死，塞面烙着骷髅与交叉骨的印记：警告任何蠢货，别把它错当成烹饪用油。
The glass bottle, slightly warm to the touch, holds a greasy yellow liquid with a few stagnant bubbles. Its cork is tightly wedged in place and has been burned with the image of a skull and crossbones: a warning to any fool who might mistake this for cooking oil.

巨兽轰然破土而出，直冲空中十余尺，将尘土与碎石如暴雨般倾泻，洒满整个区域。它比一匹披甲重战马还要庞大，钢色甲壳覆住那宽阔尖削的头颅与背脊，向后逐渐收束成短而尖的尾刺。怪物以四肢粗壮的腿疾冲猛撞，腿上覆着皮革般的棕褐鳞皮，末端皆是为掘地而生的利爪。它再度俯冲向地时，喙状如刃的巨口大张，细小的黑眼因饥饿而闪着寒光。
The behemoth bursts from the ground and up a dozen feet into the air, showering the area with dirt and gravel. It is larger than a heavy warhorse, with a steel-colored carapace covering its wide, pointed head and dorsal side, then tapering to a short, pointed tail. The monster charges on four stout limbs, scaled in leathery brown hide, each capped in claws made for digging. As it dives earthward, it opens its beaked and bladed maw, tiny black eyes agleam with hunger.

Faerie Plane: Cave Entrance.name:
妖精位面：洞穴入口
Faerie Plane: Cave Entrance

Text.text:
你穿过瀑布，发现自己置身于近乎彻底的黑暗之中。湿气紧紧黏附在你身上的每一寸肌肤，空气里弥漫着沼泽般的硫磺恶臭，浓得令人作呕。你勉强在几段石面上找到不安的落脚点，但更多地方并不坚实，脚下一陷，便没入冰冷泥浆的厚重泥潭。沿着这条湿滑走廊的阴湿角落，你撞见一堆堆污渍斑驳的人形骨骸。
You pass through the falls to find yourself in near total darkness. The dampness clings to every inch of you, and a sulfurous stink akin to a bog hangs rife in the air. While you find uneasy footing on stretches of stone, there are many patches not so firm, giving way to thick pools of cold mud. In the dank corners of this slippery corridor, you come across piles of stained, humanoid bones.

若不是恶心得令人作呕，你几乎要觉得这景象可笑。地狱的风景仿佛一座花园，却没有修剪齐整的花径与绿植，取而代之的是一簇簇肥腻的肉团与淋漓的肌束。由头骨铺砌的小径两侧，是如沟渠般蜿蜒的液体——想必是血。暗红的血流缓慢淌行，几片痂皮漂在其上，那是从头顶垂落的肢体上剥落下来的；那些肢体被撕碎，又用刀片般的铁丝缠缚在一起，勉强拼出树的形状。你惊恐地凝视着，一截受刑的肉树树干里，一只布满血丝的眼睛忽然眨了一下。
It would strike you as funny if it weren't so repellent. The landscape of Hell mimics a garden, but instead of pretty lanes of manicured plants, there are bouquets of fatty flesh and gory muscle. A pathway cobbled by skulls is bordered by channels of what must be blood. Scabs float atop the slow flow of crimson liquid, sloughed off from the limbs of overhanging bodies, torn apart and bound together with razor wire to create something like trees. As you stare in horror, a bloodshot eye in one of the trunks of tortured flesh blinks.

After The Wildfire.name:
野火之后
After The Wildfire

Text.text:
浓烟与灰烬扼住空气，随风翻卷成黑色的螺旋纹样。曾有一片森林矗立于此，坚韧地抵御着风雨与各式各样的危害。然而如今，只剩焦黑的树桩，脆裂破碎——一片木炭般的荒野，黑色尖片向上突刺。你拨开灰烬，在这片毁灭之下，发现了一丝令人振奋的残存：一枚绿色的新芽，刺破焦黑的土壤，向着高空的太阳伸展。
Smoke and ash choke the air, swirling on the breeze in black, spiraling patterns. A forest once stood here, resilient against wind and rain and all manner of hazard. But now, only charred stumps remain, brittle and shattered, a charcoal wilderness of black shards jutting upward. You sift through the ash and, beneath the destruction, find a hopeful remnant: a green bud, breaking through the blackened soil and reaching toward the sun high above.

Predator Lair In Hydroponic Bay.name:
水培舱内的掠食者巢穴
Predator Lair In Hydroponic Bay

Text.text:
恶臭的房间里，潮湿的空气沉沉起伏，原始植被的土腥气味压倒性地占据了你的感官。灌木丛下有什么在动——有什么庞大的东西。伴随着一声令人血液冻结的咆哮，一只生物从枝叶间猛然跃出，用那唯一的掠食之眼死死锁定你。

~ 出自 PaizoConOnline 2026

The air in the fetid room heaves with moisture, the earthy scent of primal vegetation dominating your senses. In the undergrowth something moves—something big. With a blood-chilling roar, a creature leaps from the brush and fixes you with a single predatory eye.

~ from PaizoConOnline 2026

瑟瑟发抖的卫兵在城堡迎风的屋顶上、燃烧的烽火之间来回巡逻，冰冷的冻雨如冰幕般抽打而下。从这处高点望去，即便风暴正盛，景色依旧壮阔——可愿意忍受这般恶劣天候只为一睹的人，寥寥无几。
Shivering guards patrol between the flaming beacons atop the windswept roof of the castle as freezing rain lashes down in icy sheets. The view from this vantage is spectacular even in the midst of a storm, but few are willing to endure the conditions to see it.

Wheelchair User Mining For Gold.name:
轮椅上的淘金者
Wheelchair User Mining For Gold

Text.text:
她轻拨座椅扶手上的一枚开关，一只巨大的水晶鹤嘴镐装置随即开始充能。魔法晶体上的符文接连迸亮，伴着低沉嗡鸣苏醒。她眼角余光捕捉到一条金矿脉的微光，立刻又拨下一枚开关。鹤嘴镐以闪电般的速度将矿石从岩壁中撬出，她则以娴熟而精准的动作稳稳接住。碎石在她周身飞溅飘扬，她关闭战斗椅的装置，俯身细察这份战利品。
Flicking a switch on her chair's armrest, a massive crystalline pickaxe attachment begins to power up. Runes flare along the magical crystal as it hums to life. Out of the corner of her eye, she spots the glint of a vein of gold and then flicks another switch. With deft precision, she catches the ore as the pickaxe frees it from the wall with lightning speed. Bits of rock fill the air around her as she powers down the combat chair attachment to inspect her find.

Sundries From A Zombie.name:
丧尸杂物
Sundries From A Zombie

Text.text:
看来这具丧尸（特征）输掉的不止是战斗——它的一根脚趾直接脱落了。柔软的青绿色腐肉从那根扭曲的趾节上簌簌剥落，它浸在地上缓慢扩大的、漆黑恶臭的血泊里。它刚才……动了吗？
It seems the zombie lost more than just the fight—one of its toes came right off. Soft, green flesh sloughs off the crooked digit as it sits in a slowly growing pool of black, stinking blood on the ground. Did it just move?

宽阔的步道将一间间围栏与铁笼隔开，关着从自然栖息地捕来的动物——这座动物园坐落在城心，展品般的陈列只为取悦那些平日里可能连比流浪狗更大的野兽都没见过的人。饲养员提着一桶桶饲料走向囚笼：把鱼头丢给那头神情倦怠的熊，它瘫在人工堆砌的洞穴里打着哈欠；又把蠕动的虫子撒进肮脏的鸟笼，笼里满是粪污与羽毛，臭气熏人。园内各处都有摊位兜售纪念品，戴着帽子、帽侧半缝着假兽耳的工作人员一脸无聊地守着摊。
Wide footpaths separate the pens and cages, housing the animals captured from their natural environs, in this zoo located at the heart of the city—exhibits displayed for the entertainment of people who might otherwise never see a beast larger than a stray dog. Zookeepers carry buckets of feed to the creatures in captivity: fish heads for the tired-looking bear, lolling in its artificially constructed cave; or wriggling worms to sate birds in filthy, droppings-laden cages. Throughout the zoo, souvenirs are peddled at stands by bored-looking personnel wearing hats with false animal ears half-sewn to their sides.

Cleric Distributing Alms.name:
施舍的牧师
Cleric Distributing Alms

Text.text:
在凡人苦难面前赞颂神祇并不容易——而贫民窟对高高在上的存在更无半分敬爱。牧师穿行于贫者与赤贫者之间，谦卑地奉上自己力所能及的施舍，只为带来些许慰藉。每递出一份援助，便紧随其后送上一句朴素的神祇祝福。

~

It can be hard to praise the gods in the face of mortal suffering—and the slums hold no love for those on high. The cleric moves between the poor and destitute, humbly offering whatever alms they can to bring some comfort. With every parcel of aid they distribute, a simple blessing of their god follows.

~

墓碑立在一棵虬曲老树与荆棘丛的阴影里。石板近乎一半被削断掀去；若以其上蔓生的地衣来看，这残缺早在许久之前便已发生。缺失的部分一并夺走了碑文中的一些字，只留下：——超越此生，步入来世。 The tombstone stands in the shadow of a gnarled tree and thorny thicket. Nearly half the slab has been sheered away, broken off long ago if the lichen growing over it is any way to judge. The missing portion has taken away some of the words on the headstone, leaving behind only: —beyond this life and into the next.

曾经能囤起成吨谷物或煤炭的高耸建筑，如今残破斑驳地伫立着——木料早已腐朽，钢铁也在多年前锈蚀殆尽。风从孔洞间尖啸穿过，回荡成刺耳而不协的管风琴声。筒仓深处的阴影诡异游移，仿佛有什么庞然之物在其中翻滚扭动。
The towering structures that once held tons of grain or coal now stand decrepit and pockmarked—wood rotted, steel long-ago rusted. The wind whistles through the holes, reverberating like a shrill, discordant pipe organ. Shadows shift strangely within the silos themselves, giving the impression of massive shapes writhing within.

一名祭司吟诵神圣仪式，手中摇动洒水器，将银粉洒向逝者。银粉飘落之际化作莹光，渗入冰冷的死肉。祷词带来平静与了结之感——如同安全的渡越。仪式将毕，牧师将手按在亡者额头上，短暂的光辉漫过全身。

~ Envisioned by Tusker2zero

A priest incants holy rites, shaking an aspergillum that disperses powdered silver over the departed. As the silver falls, it becomes luminous and sinks into the dead flesh. The prayer brings a sense of peace and closure—of safe passage. Closing the ceremony, the cleric places a hand on the deceased’s forehead. A brief glow suffuses the body.

~ Envisioned by Tusker2zero

年轻女子身着深色套装，头发紧紧收拢，藏在高顶帽下。她戴着手套，双手休息在一根高挑的黑色手杖上，杖顶嵌着象牙握柄，目光沉静地打量四周。或许这手杖是权柄的象征，因为行人从她身旁经过时，都恭敬地点头致意。
The young woman wears a dark suit, her hair tightly tucked away under a tall hat. She observes her surroundings with gloved hands resting on a tall black cane topped by an ivory handle. Perhaps the cane serves as a symbol of office, because folk nod to her deferentially as they pass.

大地在一阵砂砾的爆裂飞溅中炸开，刺耳的尖啸撕裂空气。细长带倒刺的腿从土里滑出，末端收束成刀剑般锋利的尖点。几丁质护甲摩擦着富有弹性的血肉，发出吱呀挤压的声响；疙瘩般的关节绷紧、弯曲，把身躯一点点抬离地面。那可怖的面孔沿着筋肉虬结的脖颈扬起：乳白鼓胀的眼珠；布满针刺般爬行类利齿的巨口；以及一条扭动不止的粉红长舌。它喀哒作响，咬齿连击，发出挑衅般的威吓。几丁质甲片的缝隙间伸出的纤细毛丝微微战栗。它伏低身形，布满尖刺的背脊蜷曲起来，蓄势待扑。
The earth explodes in a shower of grit, and a screech tears through the air. Long, barbed legs ending in saber-sharp points slide out of the ground. The squeak and squeeze of chitinous armor over elastic flesh sounds as knotty joints tense and bend to lift above the earth. A terrifying visage cranes upward on a sinewed neck: milky-white, bulging eyes; a maw of needling, reptilian teeth; and a writhing pink tongue. It chitters, clicking its teeth in a menacing taunt. The fibrous hairs protruding from between its chitin plates shudder. Hunkering down, its spiny back curls in preparation to pounce.

Shopkeeper's Overheard Speech Of Self-af.name:
店主不经意间的自我肯定独白
Shopkeeper's Overheard Speech Of Self-affirmation

Text.text:
“——要是他们什么都不买，又能怎样？巴巴说，不开门迎客，就别想做成买卖。今天我来了；我把门打开了。开局顺利……就等于赢了一半。”
“—and if they don’t buy anything, so what? Baba said you can’t sell if you don’t show up to open the doors. I showed up today; I opened the doors. Well-begun… and half-won.”

Duergar Digging Machine.name:
灰矮人掘进机
Duergar Digging Machine

Text.text:
起初，它活像一台用于挖掘的双足构装体，拖着笨重的身躯，以僵硬的跛步蹒跚前行。随后它一转身，露出那被机器包裹其间的活物。双眼失焦、面容因痛苦而扭曲的矮人驾驶者——若他还能被称作驾驶者——仍朝着下一项活计走去，在那必定无穷无尽的循环里：捡起、放下、砸碎。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

At first, it strongly resembles a bipedal construct for excavation, lumbering with a stilted limp. Then it turns, exposing the living thing encased within the machine. Eyes glazed-over within a face contorted in anguish, the dwarven driver—if he can be called that—continues toward the next task in what must be an endless cycle of pick up, put down, smash.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Silas \"Whisper\" Fairwind.name:
西拉斯“低语”·费尔温德
Silas "Whisper" Fairwind

Text.text:
这名火绳枪手被晒得黝黑的脸，被浓密的黑胡子与一顶压得很低的宽檐帽遮住，几乎读不出情绪；但帽檐的阴影下，那双眼睛锐利而警觉，来回搜寻。棕色皮质弹带斜跨在同色马甲与灰衬衫之上，里面塞满纸制弹药筒，还挂着一枚木制符记——形似鹿角弓上搭着一支上弦待发的箭——外面披着一件更深色皮革的长风衣。尖头靴像他的外套一样磨得发旧，靴口被蓝色长裤遮去。他把长枪端在手中，随时待发，冰冷的目光衡量着距离与可能的目标。

~ Played by Dylan

This arquebusier’s suntanned face is unreadable through his black beard and low, wide-brimmed hat, but his shaded eyes are sharp, searching. A brown leather bandolier—packed with paper cartridges and hung with a wooden symbol like an antler bow with a nocked arrow—crosses a matching vest and gray shirt under a long duster jacket of darker hide. Sharp-toed boots as worn as his coat cover his feet, the tops obscured by blue pants. He holds his long gun at the ready, his cold gaze measuring distance and possible targets.

~ Played by Dylan

I Throw My Marble Elephant Figurine Of W.name:
我掷出我的奇物之力弹珠象雕像
I Throw My Marble Elephant Figurine Of Wondrous Power

Text.text:
大象小雕像灰蒙蒙的铜绿在触地的瞬间迸出银光，刺目的亮芒席卷整个区域。我听见一声凯旋般的嘹亮象鸣，世界随即重新清晰可辨。它昂然直立，长鼻与象牙高高指向苍穹，骄傲地展示着自己的威仪。紧接着，树干般的前腿轰然落下砸在地面上，震得膝盖发软的颤动沿着地板一路传开。那生物迈着轻快的步子朝我走来——耳朵兴奋地拍打着，在离踩扁我只差一步的地方停住——然后伸出长鼻，毫不掩饰地亲昵摩挲我的脖颈。
The gray patina of the elephant figurine flashes silver as it hits the ground, covering the area in a blinding light. I hear a triumphant trumpeting and the world becomes discernible again. It rears upward, trunk and tusks perked skyward in proud display. Then tree-like forelegs plummet and hit the floor, sending knee-shaking tremors through the ground. The creature jauntily walks toward me—ears flapping with excitement, stopping just short of trampling me—and reaches out its trunk to nuzzle my neck with unabashed affection.

Blacksmith: Around The Forge.name:
铁匠：炉火旁
Blacksmith: Around The Forge

Text.text:
铁匠和你猜想是学徒的人们在一片忙碌的行动中打制铁器。风箱被一下一下抽动，铁块被翻转，当然，还有铁锤规律的敲击声。你看着看着，竟从他们的动作里听出一种音乐。打铁也许是辛苦又炽热的活计——尤其在温暖的夏日里——但这似乎是一份好工作。
The smith and what you presume to be apprentices work iron in a flurry of activity. Bellows are pumped, the iron turned, and, of course, there’s the regular beat of the hammer. As you watch, you hear a kind of music in their motions. Smithing might be hard, hot work—especially on a warm summer’s day—but it seems like good work.

Plea To A Captured Henchmen.name:
向被俘的爪牙求饶
Plea To A Captured Henchmen

Text.text:
“听着，这是你最后一次机会。你要是还这么顽固，那边我的朋友们就会接手——我敢保证，他们可不像我这样敬畏生命。”
“Look, this is your last chance. If you continue being stubborn, my friends over there are going to take over, and I assure you they don’t have the same reverence for life that I do.”

Dingy Motel.name:
昏暗破旧的汽车旅馆
Dingy Motel

Text.text:
体型如老鼠般的蟑螂四处乱窜，趁着灯光在昏暗肮脏的路边汽车旅馆里忽明忽暗之际寻找掩蔽。旅馆其中一间客房内，各种你能想象到的颜色与黏稠度的污渍遍布其间，铁证如山地诉说着这里从事非法勾当的名声——而这还只是你看得见的那些。透过一扇小窗，你能从肮脏、涂抹得模糊不清的玻璃后，隐约辨出城市天际线的朦胧轮廓。
Cockroaches the size of rats scurry for cover as the lights flicker across the dingy roadside motel. Inside one of the rooms, stains of every conceivable hue and viscosity attest to the place’s reputation for illicit activities—and that’s just the ones you can see. Through a small window, you can make out the vague shape of the city skyline through the dirty, smeared glass.

Mountain Tree Line.name:
山岭树线
Mountain Tree Line

Text.text:
从云冠笼罩的山巅俯瞰，阴影覆着的地面陡然坠向林线。高耸巨木之下，干枯脆裂的松针铺成一层地毯，任何踏上其间小径的人都会被它清晰地出卖脚步——而若再向前一步，便将深入那片更为荒野的密林深处。
From the cloud-crowned mountain peak, the shadowed ground drops steeply to the tree line. A carpet of dry, brittle pine needles announces the footsteps of any who tread a path beneath the towering trees—and venture further into the wild forest beyond.

Woman Psychically Invaded.name:
女人遭到精神入侵
Woman Psychically Invaded

Text.text:
这名女子显然正陷入极度的痛苦之中，双眼因恐惧而睁得滚圆，泪水不停滚落。一缕黏稠的深色液体——黑得不像血——从她一侧鼻孔缓缓淌出，沿着面颊蜿蜒，逼近她微微松垮的嘴唇；嘴角处有晶亮的唾液缓慢渗出。每当她那咕噜作响的喉咙泄出一丝微弱的气息，唾液便随之泛起细小的气泡。
This woman is in clear distress, her eyes wide with fear and running with tears. A viscous line of dark fluid, too dark to be blood, dribbles out of one nostril, edging toward her slightly slack mouth, where shining saliva seeps slowly from one corner. It bubbles with each small escape of air from her gurgling throat.

此人对生者尚存的那点共鸣，早已随岁月尽数剥落。皮肤苍白得近乎透明，头发软塌无力，眼神饥渴得发亮，牙齿更是长得不合常理——这副躯壳只是在拙劣地扮演活着，而其内的灵魂却在死亡中纵情欢宴。
What sympathies this person had with the living have long since departed. Skin too pallid, hair too limp, eyes too hungry, and teeth far too long—the body play-acts at living while the soul within revels in death.

你将右手划出一道弧线举过头顶，左手向外一推，圈拢起施展法术所需的能量。凭着熟练而严谨的掌控，你将左掌收回，掌心转向自身，关于构型的念头开始在手背外侧具现。违背常理的螺旋几何悬停在皮肤外仅数厘米处。与此同时，你的右手从方才刻在空气里的弧线中抽回，弧迹残留着微沸的金色光辉，在眼中化作无数闪烁的光粒。借着移动的惯性，你旋身将右掌拍向那片璀璨光尘，五指张开。护盾在你掌间凝成。
Raising your right hand in an arc over your head and pushing outward with your left, you corral the energies needed for your spell. With practiced diligence, you bring your left palm back around to face your body, thoughts of formation beginning to manifest on the outside of your hand. Spiraling geometry that defies expectation hovers centimeters from the skin. Simultaneously, your right hand withdraws from the arc it etched in the air, leaving simmering golden light which appears to the eye as many glimmering particles. Using the momentum of the movement, you bring this hand around, placing your palm against the glittery light, digits spread. A shield forms in your grasp.

Orc Shaman Prepares A Ritual.name:
兽人萨满准备一场仪式
Orc Shaman Prepares A Ritual

Text.text:
缕缕烟丝自陶碗中盘旋升起，裹着魔法般的幽光。烟雾径直钻入兽人的鼻孔，他的目光随之飘远。他将碗贴近熊熊烈火，炙热似乎并未令他贴着火焰的双手与双腿感到丝毫不适。
Tendrils of smoke wind up from the clay bowl, luminescent with magic. The smoke weaves directly into the orc’s nostrils, his eyes growing distant. He holds the bowl close to a blazing fire, the heat of it apparently not a discomfort to his hands and legs so near the flame.

Jinsul Base Commander.name:
金苏尔基地指挥官
Jinsul Base Commander

Text.text:
昆虫般的血肉与繁复的科技拼接成一体，发出带着凝聚恨意的喋喋嘶鸣。它六足而立，前肢粗壮有力，口器处排布着三列恶毒的螯钳；无数被移植到躯体上的眼睛一齐睁视，冷冷打量着周遭。它通体淡紫近紫罗兰色，根本无意伪装。它是为战争而生——若它形体上嫁接的那一整套武装仍可信的话。
An amalgam of insectoid flesh and complex tech chitters with focused hate. Six-legged and bearing robust forelimbs and three rows of vile pincers, it stares out at its surroundings from the countless eyes grafted to its body. Lilac-violet, this creature has no use for camouflage. It is a being of war—if the panoply of weaponry grafted into its form is to be believed.

I Activate My Ioun Stone Of Protection.name:
我激活我的防护灵石
I Activate My Ioun Stone Of Protection

Text.text:
石片如同一朵巨大的陶瓷花所飘舞的花瓣般绕我飞旋，分散敌人的注意，使我的防御更为圆滑流畅，更难被击中或擒拿。只要它与我同在，艾欧恩的护盾也与我同在。
The stone flies around me like the petal of some great ceramic flower, distracting my enemies and making me smoother in my defense, more difficult to hit or grab. As long as it is with me, Ioun’s shield is with me, too.

Small Goblin Camp.name:
小型地精营地
Small Goblin Camp

Text.text:
一颗人类头骨被烈日漂白，又被粗糙地涂画成地精那种讥笑的狞脸，正高高戳在一杆长矛的尖端上。更远处，地上散落着几堆臭气熏天的毛皮。营地周围的泥土里刻着一圈粗陋的符文，像是在徒劳地试图驱退闯入者。火堆上，一只老鼠被穿在烤叉上炙烤，油脂滴落进火里，腾起刺鼻的黑烟，辛辣呛人。
A human skull, sun-bleached and painted crudely to resemble the sneering visage of a goblin, sits perched on the point of a spear. Beyond, several foul-smelling piles of furs lie on the ground. A circle of crude runes carved into the dirt surrounds the camp, perhaps in a vain attempt to ward off intruders. Over a fire, a rat hangs on a spit, roasting and dripping fat into the fire, from which emanates acrid, black smoke.

Lady Eliza Nightshade.name:
夜影夫人伊丽莎·奈特谢德
Lady Eliza Nightshade

Text.text:
一串甜润的笑声将你的目光牵向那名纤细的暗精灵，然而真正令你移不开视线的，是她惊心动魄的美貌。她的装束古怪而张扬：黑与紫的华丽裙裾上，闪亮的银色点缀其间，宛如汞质细流穿行于阴影。层叠的裁制赋予她一种摄人心魄——却致命——的花朵性相，诱使毫无戒备的人放松警惕。她唇角挂着顽皮的坏笑，锋利的紫水晶眼眸里欢愉跳闪，眼光灼亮，涌动着不自然的力量。

~ Played by Vahlaron

A peal of honeyed laughter draws your eyes to the slender dark elf, though it is her striking beauty which holds your gaze. Her attire is curious, a flamboyant dress of black and purple accentuated by gleaming silver, like rivulets of mercury running through shadow. The layered nature of the garment lends her the aspect of a captivating—yet lethal—bloom, enticing the unwary to lower their guard. A mischievous smirk plays across her lips as mirth flashes gleefully in sharp amethyst eyes agleam with unnatural power.

~ Played by Vahlaron

Quip About Becoming Brave.name:
关于变得勇敢的俏皮话
Quip About Becoming Brave

Text.text:
“没人天生勇敢。勇气不过是被时代磨硬的一层老茧。把自己扎进恐惧与暴力的肠腑里，一次又一次，直到你能面不改色、不会呕吐——他们就会称你为勇敢。”
“No one is born brave. It’s a callous hardened over time. Plunge yourself into the guts of fear and violence until you can do it without vomiting and they will call you brave.”

Chamber Formed Of Diseased Flesh.name:
由病腐血肉构成的密室
Chamber Formed Of Diseased Flesh

Text.text:
一股恶臭——腐烂混着铜与铁的腥气——弥漫在这间血肉构成的腔室里。你辨出最可能的源头：墙上一处脓肿，姜黄色，边缘参差破烂。一个破裂囊袋的残骸软塌塌地垂在上方，下方则堆着一团团湿滑、乳脂般的脓疱，正缓缓渗出，展露出令人作呕的景象。
A foul odor—rot mixed with copper and iron—permeates this chamber of flesh. You identify the probable source: an abscess in one wall, turmeric-colored and ragged. The remains of a broken sac hang limply above a pile of slick, creamy pustules that ooze in a revolting spectacle.

带着刺骨的恐惧，你小心翼翼地探身越过船舷，指节因死死攥住颤抖的鱼叉柄而发白。你眼睁睁看着一片庞大的阴影浮上海面，水下巨兽的先头部位破浪而出，露出的竟是……鳃羽？肾上腺素渐渐退去——那只斑驳粉色的生物从水中现身，你竟与一只巨大的美西螈四目相对。它用圆圆的、友善的眼睛望着你——大得像巨石——随后顽皮地轻轻顶了顶船身，又朝甲板喷出一道水柱，同时摇晃着那颗带鳍的脑袋。

~ Clara C. Potter on Discord

With cold terror, you peer gingerly over the ship's railing, your knuckles going white as they grip the haft of a shaking harpoon. You watch as a gargantuan shadow rises to the surface and the first parts of the submerged beast crest the waves to reveal… fronds? Your adrenaline subsides as the mottled pink creature emerges from the water and you find yourself eye to eye with an enormous axolotl. Regarding you with round, friendly eyes the size of boulders, it playfully nudges the ship and shoots a jet of water onto the deck while waggling its finned head.

~ Clara C. Potter on Discord

一名披覆板甲的巨兽般战士猛冲入敌阵，硬生生碾过一圈对手，把他们像破布娃娃般撞飞。她势如洪潮般向前推进，用伤痕累累的盾牌格开箭矢，喉间爆出一声粗哑咆哮，逼退了敌方弓手。小规模交锋既定胜负，这座坚韧的堡垒抬手卸下头盔，发丝如泥石流般倾泻，覆过那张深深刻满伤疤的面庞。祖母绿般的双眼扫视战场——将双方扭曲残破的死伤尽收眼底——她用蘸了油的布条擦拭那把微微发光的弯刀。她将其入鞘，然而那耀目的刀刃仿佛仍不情愿被收起。她蹚过血污泥浆，默然哀悼倒下的战友，也向敌方亡者致意；土色的脸上写着坚硬的冷静，唇线紧抿成一道阴沉而决绝的直线。

~ 由一位英雄扮演

A juggernaut encased in plate mail powers through a ring of foes, dashing them aside like rag dolls. Surging forward, the soldier blocks arrows with her battered shield and drives away the enemy archers with a throaty roar. The skirmish won, this bastion of resilience doffs her helm and a mudslide of hair cascades across her deeply scarred face. Eyes of emerald survey the field of conflict—taking in the mangled casualties from both sides—as she uses an oiled rag to clean her faintly glowing scimitar. She sheathes it, though the dazzling blade seems reluctant to be put away. Trudging through the bloody muck, she silently mourns fallen comrades and honors the enemy fallen, a stoic look on her earthen-hued face, her mouth a tight line of grim determination.

~ Played by a Hero

Drag Racing Riggers' Hideout.name:
直线竞速改装客的秘密据点
Drag Racing Riggers' Hideout

Text.text:
洞窟被激光采矿工具掏空，顶棚用钢筋和歪斜的钢梁加固。成排的半成品车懒洋洋地侧躺着，被一群修理工——像昆虫似的——翻拣啃噬；他们对着满地零散废料敲敲打打、拧拧扭扭。墙上糊满了旧海报：赛车手与狂欢车。空气被上千种机械气味熏得污浊：机油、汽油、尘土。肮脏的收音机里咚咚震响着音乐，而角落里两名身着花哨赛车服的车手一边掰手腕，一边互相抛着刻薄的辱骂。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The cave has been hollowed out with laser mining tools and the ceiling reinforced with rebar and crooked steel beams. Rows of half-built cars lie lazily on their sides, being picked over by mechanics—like insects—tinkering and twisting at the random scrap littering the place. Old posters of racers and joyboy cars plaster the walls. The air is befouled with a thousand mechanical smells: oil and gas and dirt. Thumping music sounds from a grubby boombox while two racers in flashy suits trade insults as they arm-wrestle in the corner.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Prince Claudin At The Joust.name:
马上比武场上的克劳丁王子
Prince Claudin At The Joust

Text.text:
身披鲜亮的蓝与黄，那名骑士无畏策马而出，头盔顶端的彩羽在风中飞舞。人群中一小片区域骤然爆出欢呼，他随即抬起长枪回应。其盾牌上，蔚蓝底色被一道黄色人字纹斜贯分开，其上醒目绘着三枚金色橡果。欢呼渐息，他驱马归位，与其他斗士并肩而立。

~ 由 Vahlaron Envisioned

Bedecked in vibrant blue and yellow, the knight rides out boldly, the colored feathers atop his helm dancing in the breeze. A cheer erupts from a small section of the crowd, and he raises his lance in response. Upon his shield are three golden acorns emblazoned on a field of azure bisected by a yellow chevron. The cheering subsides as he takes his place with the other combatants.

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

冰冷的海水轻拍着你船只的舷侧，浩瀚的星夜向四面八方无尽铺展。巨大而庄严的冰山缓缓漂过，在这世界之巅，唯有它们与您为伴。
The icy waters lap against your vessel's hull as the vast, starlit night stretches out in all directions. Large, majestic icebergs drift by, the only other denizens at the summit of the world.

宽大的树桩几乎齐头高，倾盆大雨顺着两侧淌下，却仍洗不去树皮上那一道道血渍——仿佛已渗进木纹深处。树桩顶端那座王座的根部积着一汪血泊。鲜血浸透了周围的土地。你脚下的泥里满是血水，踩上去咕叽作响。究竟有多少人、多少野兽在这里丧命，才把这片原野灌成一片血海？
The broad stump of wood rises almost to head height, its bark stained with blood—despite the water running down the sides from the downpour. Blood pools at the base of the throne atop the stump. Blood soaks the ground around it. Blood squelches in the mud at your feet. How many people or beasts lost their lives to flood this field with blood?

I Cast Dispel Magic.name:
我施放解除魔法
I Cast Dispel Magic

Text.text:
当我调谐周遭的能量时，我低声念出法术的咒词，将力量凝聚成一股刻意而精准的冲击。我做出握住武器柄的动作，挥动魅影之刃横扫过身前，以一道宽阔的斩击——将魔法能量从其源头彻底切断。
As I tune into the energies around me I mutter the words of the spell, focusing my power into a deliberate, targeted force. I mime grasping a weapon’s handle and draw the phantom blade across my body in a wide swing—severing the magical energies from their source.

他那不容置疑的怒视毫不遮掩，像毒蛇的獠牙般直刺你的心底。那抹病态的幽绿让人以为他正受诅咒或疾病侵蚀……可再仔细一看，你才发现那些葱翠的斑块竟是鳞片，与类人生物的皮肤严丝合缝地交织在一起。你盯得出神，他却捕捉到了你的目光，嘴角猛地裂开成一个夸张的笑——笑得太过分了，因为一道道锯齿般的疤痕把他的嘴拉长，几乎一直撕到耳根。空气里萦绕着刺鼻的燃油与金属气味，他的铁手甲在他攥紧拳头时噼啪作响，电光在指节间跳跃。

~ 由一位英雄 扮演，其

His imperious glower, unabashed, pierces into you like viper's fangs. A sickly green hue suggests he might be afflicted with a curse or illness… but, on a closer look, you see those verdant patches are actually scales meshing with humanoid skin. He catches you staring and his mouth splits into a wide grin—too wide, for his mouth is elongated by jagged scars that stretch to his ears. A stinging scent of fuel and metal hangs in the air about him, and his iron gauntlets crackle with energy as he clenches his fists.

~ Played by a Hero with

I Put On My Robe Of Eyes.name:
我披上千眼长袍
I Put On My Robe Of Eyes

Text.text:
我把那件落满灰尘的棕色皮制衣物甩到肩上，立刻感到上百颗小小的圆球贴着身躯弹跳着沉甸甸地坠着。那些不眨的眼珠在光里泛着湿润的亮泽，我听见它们左右、上下挪动时轻微的噗叽声——永远警觉，永远搜寻。短短几瞬令人不适的感觉掠过——眼皮边缘干痒发涩，以及一记尖刺般的头痛闪过——随后，我真正的双眼适应了这件物品所赐予的放大视野。
I throw the dusty brown leather garment over my shoulders and feel the weight of a hundred small orbs bounce against my body. The unblinking eyes shine moist in the light and I hear the slight squelch as they shift side-to-side, up and down: constantly alert, constantly searching. After a couple of momentary unpleasant sensations—itching dryness about my eyelids and a single flash of jabbing headache—my true eyes adjust to the magnified vision this item provides.

Light Lift Civilian Helicopter.name:
轻型起重民用直升机
Light Lift Civilian Helicopter

Text.text:
