直升机那流畅而精美的机身线条，每一寸都在渗出奢华气息；即便离得这么近，旋翼也只是低语般安静。巨大的环绕式舷窗为乘客奉上无与伦比的视野，柔软的真皮座椅则确保一路舒适。这套最尖端的技术绝非便宜货，但你隐约感觉，它既是一种身份象征，也是一台交通工具。
Every inch of the helicopter's sleek, beautiful design oozes luxury, and the rotors are whisper quiet, even this close. Large wraparound windows offer unparalleled views for the passengers, and the plush leather seats ensure a comfortable flight. This state-of-the-art technology wasn't cheap, but you get the feeling this is as much a status symbol as it is a vehicle.

Temple To A Goddess Of Forests.name:
森林女神神殿
Temple To A Goddess Of Forests

Text.text:
在遥远散落的农舍与更深处荒野之间的林地区域里，你在一片高耸的红杉、松树与冷杉构成的幽林小林地中找到了它。那是一座由紫藤、常春藤与繁花盛放的杜鹃藤蔓粗粗编结而成的建筑。通往这座神殿的小径铺着柔软的青草，两侧野花簇拥。馥郁的香气与偶尔坠落的松针，让神殿空地里弥漫着清风般的宁静。这里没有门；走入其中，你看见树桩与倒下的原木充当长椅。木制的祭坛与讲坛都仍带着树皮，后方垂挂着以青翠枝叶编织而成的幡旗。
In the forested area between the far-flung homesteads and the wilderness beyond, you find it in a grove of towering redwoods, pines, and firs. It is a building made of wisteria, ivy, and thick braids of flowering rhododendron. The approach to this temple is a path of soft grass bordered with wildflowers. The fragrances and occasionally falling needles give the temple clearing a breezy tranquility. There is no door, and inside, you see stumps and fallen logs that serve as pews. The wooden altar and lectern, both with the bark still on them, have banners of woven greenery hanging behind.

Nervous Prince Addressing The Court.name:
紧张的王子向朝廷致辞
Nervous Prince Addressing The Court

Text.text:
一阵轻柔的沙沙作响掠过将息的低语，像战栗的风穿过剥壳的麦秆。王子手中的羊皮纸随着抖动，他用同样空洞的声音宣读着骇人的消息。有人清了清嗓子，他便提高音量，话语从口中倾泻而出，结结巴巴、仓促混乱地滚作一团。他褐色的眼睛泛着水光，双颊因用力而发热发红，他硬撑着一路念下去，终于把剩下的寥寥几行嘶声喊出。待最后那句可怖的句子破裂般吐出，在宫殿的大理石墙面上撞出回声，他情绪失控的缘由也已不言自明。
A soft rattling sound carries above the dying whispers like a tremorous wind through husked wheat. The parchment in the prince’s hands shakes as he reads out dreadful news in a voice just as hollow. Someone clears their throat and he speaks up, the words tumbling out of his mouth in a stuttering, rushed jumble. His brown eyes glisten and his cheeks flush with effort as he pushes through and belts out the few remaining lines. The reason for his emotional state is obvious as the last, dreadful sentence cracks and echoes off of the palace’s marble walls.

一片木质建筑群架在高高的支柱上，自下方的湖面拔起。栈桥与码头把民居与店铺连成一体，几十艘渔船在水面上轻轻起伏。渔人们辛勤劳作，撒网、垂线。成打的鱼整齐排在精致的熏架上，有人守在下方扇风助燃。远处一名渔夫兴奋地高声呼喊，高举着一条巨大的鳟鱼。其他渔夫也依次应和，将那份激动传遍水上。
A collection of wooden structures stand upon stilts, rising from the lake below. Bridges and docks connect houses and shops, and dozens of fishing boats bob on the water. Fishers toil, casting nets and dropping lines. Fish by the dozens line elaborate smoking racks, while people fan the flames below. A fisher in the distance hollers in elation, holding aloft a massive trout. The other fishers echo their excitement in turn.

Assembly Of Knights Of The Round.name:
圆桌骑士团
Assembly Of Knights Of The Round

Text.text:
有节奏的铿锵声在场地上回荡，二十名骑士身披闪耀的护甲，从比武场的两端相向汇聚。黑骑士骑着乌鸦般的战马，如一道黯色剪影领着一列；光辉夺目的白骑士跨在雪白骏马上，统率另一列。他们的逼近是一片色彩、迅疾移动与声响交织的喧嚣，最终在翘首以盼的人群前凝成令人屏息的对峙。面甲掀起，他们向国王俯身致礼，神情冷峻，长枪高举致敬。

~ 由 Vahlaron 构想

A rhythmic clatter echoes about the field as twenty knights, clad in glittering armor, converge from opposite ends of the lists. The black knight, a dark silhouette upon a raven destrier, heads one column, while the resplendent white knight, mounted on a snow-white charger, leads the other. Their approach is a cacophony of color, dynamic movement, and sound, culminating in a breathtaking standoff before the expectant crowd. Visors open, they bow to the king, faces stern and lances held in salute.

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

Sundries From A Pseudodragon.name:
来自伪龙的杂货
Sundries From A Pseudodragon

Text.text:
小龙那枚细小的毒刺在死后已不再构成威胁，也未因此受损。只要一刀切得精准，再备好小瓶，你就能从这只生物体内取出毒液——毕竟这小家伙再也用不着它了。
The tiny dragon's stinger, no longer a threat, suffered no damage in its death. With a precise cut and a ready vial, you could extract the poison from the creature, since the little fellow won’t be needing it anymore.

I Cast Phantasmal Killer.name:
我施放「幻象杀手」
I Cast Phantasmal Killer

Text.text:
法术在一声低语中终结，我感到舌尖末端像被叉开般刺痛。我听见目标的声音化作孩童的嗓音，呜咽着哀求。祂最深的噩梦如皮影戏般在我脑海里起舞——如今皆是我操控的木偶。我将这些恐惧的幻象硬生生拽入现实，望着目标的脸在难以置信与战栗的惊惧中垮塌下去。
The spell ends in a whisper and I feel a fork-split at the end of my tongue. I hear the voice of my target as a child’s voice, whimpering and pleading. The worst of their nightmares dance through my head like a shadow play—puppets now under my command. I wrench illusory images of these terrors into our reality and watch my target’s face fall in disbelief and dread.

Ogre Zombie Encounter.name:
食人魔丧尸（特征）遭遇
Ogre Zombie Encounter

Text.text:
这生物肩高足有八尺，拖着笨拙而踉跄的步伐朝你逼近，抡起沉重的木棒举过头顶，发出无言的战吼。直到这时你才注意到它皮肤的惨白、外露的肋骨——从不再流血的旧伤口里刺出——以及那层覆在毫无生气的眼睛上的黯淡薄膜。食人魔丧尸（特征）？！单纯不死者那不安、无休止的本性，与粗蛮躯体的强韧与蛮力纠缠在一起，铸成一头臃肿的怪物；你明白自己必须将其斩杀，或立刻逃走，因为对这无心智的生物，根本无从谈判。
A full eight feet tall at its shoulder, the creature shambles an ungainly path toward you, raising a heavy club above its head in a wordless war cry. Only then do you make note of the pallor of its skin, the exposed ribs—poking out from old wounds that do not bleed—and the dull film covering its lifeless eyes. An ogre zombie?! The restless, relentless nature of the simple undead married to the toughness and power of a brutish body has resulted in a hulking monstrosity you know you must vanquish, or escape, as there is no bargaining with the mindless creature.

Sir Papagalos Paladineson Of Illien \"Th.name:
伊利恩的帕帕加洛斯·帕拉丁内森爵士，“无畏者”
Sir Papagalos Paladineson Of Illien "The Fearless"

Text.text:
巨龙战士如同巨像，迈步于凡人之间宛若神明，头戴太阳般的荣光。他的赤红鳞片闪耀着超凡的光辉，仿佛被星火勾勒，宛如灿烂黎明。奢华的白色鬃发自背脊倾泻而下，在刻满符文的额冠上那对高耸的金色巨角之间流淌。他的金色双眼闪烁着无尽的好奇，渴求着多元宇宙的隐秘。

~ 由 Vahlaron 扮演

The draconic warrior is a colossus, striding as a god among mortals and crowned in solar glory. His red scales shimmer with an otherworldly light, limned in star-fire like the radiant dawn. A mane of luxurious white hair cascades down his back, flowing between the towering golden horns atop his rune-marked brow. His golden eyes sparkle with boundless curiosity, hungry for the secrets of the multiverse.

~ Played by Vahlaron

Sundries From An Ogre Gladiator.name:
食人魔角斗士的杂物
Sundries From An Ogre Gladiator

Text.text:
那座散发恶臭、由血肉与护甲堆砌成的堡垒轰然倒下，带着羽冠的头盔从它的头上滚落到一旁。你看见它从过往的切磋中留下了几件骇人的战利品：剥下的人皮被拉伸绷紧，覆在盾牌正面；腰间系着一圈头骨作成的腰带；还有一只渗漏的袋子，里头塞满了脏腑与内脏。
The reeking bastion of flesh and armor falls, its crested helmet rolling away from its head. You see a few gruesome trophies kept from past spars: flayed skin stretched across the front of its shield, a belt of skulls about its waist, and a leaking bag stuffed with offal.

Sundries From A Phoenix.name:
凤凰杂货
Sundries From A Phoenix

Text.text:
元素泰坦已然消失，它的爆炸以烈焰裹挟着附近的一切。空气令人窒息，满是呛人的灰烬与焦肉的刺鼻气味。透过朦胧烟霭，你瞥见那生物落下的几根羽毛，仍在燃烧。短短数秒，它们便迅速缩成一小撮，被彻底熄灭，最终不过化作几根焦黑的枯枝，与周遭其余烧灼残骸再难分辨。
The elemental titan has disappeared, its explosion wreathing everything near in flame. The air is suffocating, choked in ash and the smell of burning flesh. Through the haze, you spy a couple of fallen feathers from the creature, still aflame. In a matter of seconds, they dwindle and are snuffed out, becoming no more than blackened twigs indistinguishable from the other scorched remains.

Chain Mail Armor +2.name:
锁子甲护甲 +2
Chain Mail Armor +2

Text.text:
这套闪闪发亮的锁子甲织环细密得惊人，却依旧柔韧贴身。你几乎看不穿它。每一枚细小的圆环都不像常见那样铆接而成；相反，更像是整体浇铸。这样会让链环更坚固，可工艺上却说不通。要打造这件护甲，必定动用了魔法。
This glittering suit of chain mail has an astonishingly tight weave while still remaining supple. You can barely see through it. Each tiny ring doesn’t look riveted, as one would expect; instead, it looks cast. That would have made the links stronger, but it makes no sense. Magic must have been used to create this armor.

Parting Words To A Dying Rival About Pea.name:
对将死宿敌的临终告别：关于和平
Parting Words To A Dying Rival About Peace

Text.text:
“你穷尽一生抓挠着追逐权力与尊重，却从未寻求过安宁——那本该在你离开此世之际拥抱你的安宁；而你无人爱怜、无人铭记。我希望在那等待你的归处里，你终能找到它。”
“You’ve spent your whole life clawing for power and respect, yet you never sought peace—a peace that would hold you now as you pass from this world, unloved and forgotten. I hope you can find it in whatever home awaits you.”

Snow-covered Alpine Monastery.name:
白雪覆盖的阿尔卑斯修道院
Snow-covered Alpine Monastery

Text.text:
一缕烟雾从覆雪的建筑里袅袅升起，像白色帽檐上飘落的一根灰羽。嵌格窗内透出橘色的光，明明灭灭。两侧翼楼自中央主厅伸展而出，各自顶着一根尖锐的金属尖塔，从雪堆里刺出。门上方的石头上刻着一枚圣徽——轮廓却被积雪糊得难以分辨。
A plume of smoke drifts up from the snow-covered building like a gray feather from a white cap. Orange light flickers from within its paned windows. Two building wings project from a central main hall, each topped by a pointed metal spire sticking out from the drifts. A holy symbol—the exact contours muddled by collected snow—is engraved into the stone above the doorway.

Hill Overlooking Landscape.name:
俯瞰大地的山丘
Hill Overlooking Landscape

Text.text:
杂草丛生的山丘俯瞰着广袤大地。向西望去，坍塌的高塔破败不堪，孤零零地矗立在一座青翠的山顶。远处，一座由北流之河注入的湖泊粼粼闪光，映照天光。
The grass-strewn hill overlooks the sprawling landscape. To the west, the crumbling tower lies in ruin atop a green hill. A lake, fed by a river flowing north, glimmers in the distance.

I Harvest Saliva From A Creature.name:
我从一只生物身上采集唾液
I Harvest Saliva From A Creature

Text.text: 我拔开小瓶的塞子，跪到倒下的[生物]头边。我掀开它磨损开裂的嘴唇，露出一排排发黄的牙齿。苍白牙龈间涌起的臭气，粉白的皮肤上糊着起泡的唾沫，让人想起屠宰场的腐烂污坑。我在牙龈上一抹，刮起残留的唾液，把那团黏稠滑腻的胶状物刮进小瓶里。我甩了甩手抖掉多余的黏液，滴珠与黏丝带着恶臭，从指尖坠落。 I uncork my vial and kneel next to the head of the fallen [creature]. I peel back its frayed lips, revealing rows of yellowing teeth. The odor wafting up from the pale gums, the pink-white skin coated in foamed spit, is reminiscent of a butcher’s midden. I swipe across the gums, scooping up some of the remnant saliva and scrape the gooey, viscous glob into the vial. I shake my hand to fling off the excess, the drops leaving my fingers in stinking dewdrops and strings.

Chariot Made From Giant's Skull.name:
用巨人头骨打造的战车
Chariot Made From Giant's Skull

Text.text:
巨人的颅顶被利刃削去一大片，掏空的脑壳敞开着，任由天空俯视。两个大地精战士占据着那处空腔。盾牌被嵌进骷髅的眼眶里，像是虔敬地为摆渡人奉上的钱币；粗陋的暗铁护板则被铆在颧骨与额头上。一只爬行类生物以捕食者般的步态拖曳战车，长腿一迈一晃，踏出悠长的跃行。

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

The top of the giant’s skull has been sliced off, leaving the hollowed brainpan open to the sky. Two hobgoblin warriors occupy the cavity. Shields have been placed in the eye sockets of the skull, like coins laid reverently for the Ferryman, and crude dark iron panels have been bolted to the cheek bones and forehead. A reptilian creature with a predatory gait pulls the chariot in loping strides.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

要塞高高耸立于周遭大地之上，仿佛栖身在一座巨大土丘那雄浑的肩头。土丘以层层修整过的夯土阶台向上隆起，愈发壮观；每一层都是无法逾越的地形壁垒，外沿再以木桩栅栏加固。要完成这样的专长与劳作——抬起一座山丘，将大地本身锻造成巍然要塞——其规模必定惊人。

~ 由 Drewseth Envisioned

The fort rises high above the surrounding landscape, perched upon the mighty shoulders of a massive hillock. The hill looms in increasingly impressive tiers of worked earth, each an impassable wall of terrain reinforced with a palisade of timbers. The skill and labor involved in such a feat—in raising a hill and forging the earth itself into a mighty fortress—must have been stupendous.

~ Envisioned by Drewseth

Quip By A Warrior In Dire Circumstances.name:
绝境武者的插科打诨
Quip By A Warrior In Dire Circumstances

Text.text:
“我们正面对这般不确定——每一次抉择都可能换来致命的回报。所以，不如我们干脆先捅点东西，看看会发生什么？”
“We face such uncertainty—with every decision offering a lethal reward. So, how about we just start stabbing things and see what happens?”

Knight Riding Panther.name:
骑豹骑士
Knight Riding Panther

Text.text:
那头魁梧巨兽浑身带刺般的烦躁，却以惊人的优雅从你身旁掠过。豹般的吐息与护甲甲片轻柔的叮当声清晰可闻，生物继续前行，脚步却悄无声息。骑在巨兽背上的骑士礼貌地点头，向你利落地行了个军礼。
The hulking beast bristles with irritation as it passes with remarkable grace. The panther’s breath and the gentle clatter of its armor plates are audible as the creature strides onward with silent footsteps. The knight atop the beast nods his head courteously and offers you a crisp salute.

Meditations: Magical Forest.name:
冥想：魔法森林
Meditations: Magical Forest

Text.text:
森林里的某种东西搅动了你沉睡已久的惊奇感。就像你听见歌唱却看不见的鸟儿，你也察觉到这里存在着你无法感知的美。点点妖精光在你视野边缘闪烁，当你试图用目光捕捉时，又羞怯地消失无踪。想必此地的魔法就藏在小径下一个转弯之后，或许你只需跨过一道门槛——比如一条灌木隧道，或一圈蘑菇环。
Something about the forest stirs a long-dormant sense of wonder. Like the unseen birds you hear singing, you sense beauties here that you can’t perceive. Fairy lights glimmer at the edge of your vision, shyly vanishing when your eyes seek to capture them. Surely the magic of this place lies just beyond the next bend in the trail, or perhaps you’ll find it by passing over a threshold—like a tunnel of bushes or a circle of mushrooms.

当你念完最后一句咒文，一股无可阻挡的寒意自你的胸口渗出，沿着手臂蔓延，最终从指尖逸散。阴影如同遮过太阳的云，掠过你的身躯。它愈发浓重并向外延展，化作攫取的指爪，抓住并吞噬光芒。黑暗坠落，深沉而猝然——然而它回应你的接触，听从你的召唤。
As you finish the incantation, an inexorable cold seeps from your chest, through your arms, and leaves your fingertips. A shadow, like a cloud across the sun, passes over you. The shadow deepens and extends, fingers grasping and catching the light. Darkness falls, deep and sudden—yet it responds to your touch, answers your call.

Temple To A Gnomish God.name:
侏儒神祇的神殿
Temple To A Gnomish God

Text.text:
岩石板块彼此倾斜倚靠，勾勒出神殿般熟悉的轮廓，只是规模更为朴素。矮小建筑前，两株迷你果树分立在一座修剪整齐的石质祭坛两侧，坛面散落着祈求者奉上的供品：钱币、雕刻物、稀有金属碎片，甚至还有一声金属鸟鸣。祭坛基座处开着几道小小的入口，通往地下掘穴兽的隧道——这是一则象征，诉说着侏儒与自然安宁共生的迹象。

~ 由 Rodney Cina 构想

Rock slabs lean into one another, evoking the familiar shape of a temple, only less grand in scale. Before the modest building, two miniature fruit trees flank a neatly-cut stone altar littered with the offerings of supplicants: coins, carvings, bits of rare metals, even a metallic birdcall. At its base are small entrances to the tunnels of beasts that burrow beneath the earth—a sign of the peaceful coexistence between gnome and nature.

~ Envisioned by Rodney Cina

Investiture Of Wind.name:
风之灌注
Investiture Of Wind

Text.text:
你吟诵短句，召唤远古的风之伟力灌入己身。回应你的召唤与旋转的双臂，盘旋的狂风将你吞没，化作偏转一切的气流缠绕周身，随你心念将你托举离地。你周遭的空气屏息以待；你一声令下，便将其释放，猛力冲击你所选定的一片区域。
You speak phrases to call the ancient forces of air into your being. Answering your summons and your spinning arms, swirling winds engulf you, wrapping you in deflecting currents and lifting you aloft at your whim. The air around you waits with bated breath. Your command unleashes it to buffet an area of your choosing.

Intergalactic Legal Counsel.name:
星际法律顾问
Intergalactic Legal Counsel

Text.text:
那位法律专业人士镇定自若地翻阅着笔记，神情自信从容。他们对星际法律的渊博掌握——对多颗星球错综复杂的法律体系都烂熟于心——令其备受追捧。挂起价值百万信用点的微笑，他们整理好神经战衣，昂首阔步走入法庭。
The legal professional stands calmly perusing notes, their demeanor confident. Their extensive knowledge of intergalactic law—expertise in the complex legal systems of multiple planets—makes them much sought after. Smiling a million credit smile, they adjust their neuro suit and stride into the courtroom.

Deeper Pit Trap.name:
更深的陷坑陷阱
Deeper Pit Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 走廊的第一段石板颜色发暗，且略显松动——只是轻微，却已足够让你心生警惕。

[发现] 松动的石块塌陷翻滚，坠入走廊下方无光的深渊。你等了许久，却始终听不见它们触及底部的回音。

[触发] 地面骤然消失，你的胃猛地一沉，身体直坠而下，跌入脚下豁然张开的、巨口般空旷的深渊。

[Perceived] The flagstones are discolored and loose in the first section of the corridor—only slightly, but it’s enough to arouse your suspicions.

[Discovered] Loose stones give way, tumbling into a lightless abyss beneath the corridor. You wait several long moments but do not hear them reach the bottom.

[Triggered] The floor disappears, and your stomach lurches as you plummet into the yawning, cavernous abyss that has opened under your feet.

粗壮的绿茎直指苍穹，在崎岖的平原荒野上勾勒出一片野生大麦田。新生的麦苗迎风起伏，铺成一张波浪般的地毯；微风掠过，它们荡开层层涟漪，仿佛湖面被轻轻搅动。然而，茎叶间还有一些动静，竟逆着风向游走……
Robust green stalks stretch toward the sky, marking the wild barley field out on the rugged landscape of the plains. The young crops form an undulating carpet as they catch the wind, and a breeze causes them to ripple like water on a lake. However, there are movements within the stalks that defy the wind’s direction…

Drift Phantom.name:
漂移魅影（特征）
Drift Phantom

Text.text:
一团品红色能量在刺鼻的焦灼气味中凝聚。闪电的电弧在其中迸射，像大脑电波走漏的杂电般，刹那间将那生物照亮。随后，它缓慢而渐进地开始成形——浓烟凝成的面孔，拖曳的气体汇作的躯体。你渐渐认出了那道身影。
A cloud of magenta energy coalesces with the acrid smell of burning. Bolts of lightning flash through it, briefly lighting the creature like the errant electricity of brain waves. Then, slowly, gradually, it begins to take form. A face of dense smoke. A body of trailing gas. And you begin to recognize the figure.

院子里弥漫着陈啤酒刺鼻的酸臭。瓶子窝在杂草间，像一簇簇怪异发亮的蔬菜。苍蝇的嗡鸣在空气中震颤。蛛网、污垢与恶臭把这座小屋曾经可能有过的风致彻底糟践殆尽。它歪斜下垂，仿佛这栋房子本身也参加过一场湿漉漉的狂欢酗饮。屋内传来微弱而闷钝的打嗝声，随后是一声轻软的呻吟。
The acrid stench of old beer wafts about the yard. Bottles sit nestled in the weeds like strange, shining vegetables. The buzz of flies vibrates in the air. Cobwebs, grime, and stink ruin whatever charm this little cottage may have once had. It droops, lopsided, as if the structure itself has partaken in a binge of sodden revelry. From within the home you hear the faint, muffled sound of hiccups followed by a soft groan.

I Cast Ceremony, Funeral Prayer.name:
我施放《圣礼术：葬礼祈祷》
I Cast Ceremony, Funeral Prayer

Text.text:
祈求亡者安然穿越，前往来世，我绕着尸身缓步而行，将祝福过的银粒撒落在他们身上。随着我低声吟诵，那些银粒化作银白光辉，缓缓渗入他们的皮肤。为结束这场持续一小时的仪式，我将手按在胸口、心脏安息之处。转瞬间，洁白的光芒自逝者体内透出微微一闪——此刻的他们已被祝圣，足以抵御污秽的魔法。

~ Tusker2zero 构想

Praying for wholesome passage into the next life, I walk around the deceased, scattering blessed silver over their body. As I intone, the silver turns to argent light and sinks into their skin. To close the hourlong rite, I touch the chest above where the heart rests. White radiance glows briefly from within the departed, now sanctified against vile magic.

~ Envisioned by Tusker2zero

Rack Of Sample Enhancements.name:
样品强化架
Rack Of Sample Enhancements

Text.text:
这些秘密手术间看起来更像一场怪诞的人体解剖展，而非医疗设施：墙边的架子一排排码放着肢体与器官，如同陈列品般冷冷挂起。每个分区都以身体的不同区域为主题，展柜里的每一件部件都被整齐摆在一块忽明忽暗的霓虹价格牌上方，牌子附着简短说明，写明这项强化的特性。
The clandestine surgery suites look more like a bizarre exhibition of human anatomy than a medical facility, with rows of body parts arranged in racks along the walls. Each section is themed to a different area of the body, with every part on display set neatly above a flickering neon price tag with a short description of the enhancement’s properties.

Haughty Military Ship Captain.name:
傲慢的军舰舰长
Haughty Military Ship Captain

Text.text:
一只磨旧的眼罩遮住了他的左眼——尽管他完全有能力轻易换新——可他仍昂然站立，身着一套张扬的制服，纤尘不染，连一丝褶皱都没有。金色肩章如冠般压在那件厚重的大衣上，大衣在他身周鼓荡翻卷；他的胸前别满徽章与标识——一场毫不掩饰的权势炫耀。他的嗓音冰冷而短促，话语间荡着不屑的寒意。
A worn eyepatch covers his left eye—although he could very easily afford to replace it—but he stands proud in an ostentatious uniform bearing no marks or creases. Golden epaulettes crown the heavy overcoat billowing about him, and on his chest are numerous badges and insignias—a gratuitous display of power. His voice is cold and clipped, rippling with disdain.

Fore And Aft Rune Sigils.name:
前后符文印记
Fore And Aft Rune Sigils

Text.text:
当你走近时，一抹柔和的蓝光洒落在那些怪异传送门周围的甲板上，泛起幽冷的磷光，令人不寒而栗。每一扇镶着黄铜边框的窗都随着舰船符文柱稳定的节奏同频脉动；在钢化玻璃下方，石质底座上刻着陌生的符文，而近旁的空气嗡鸣震颤，充盈着奥术能量。
A soft, blue light gives the deck around the strange portals an eerie phosphorescent glow as you approach. Pulsing in time with the steady rhythm of the ship’s rune-pillars, each brass-rimmed window bears strange runes, carved in stone, beneath the tempered glass, and the air nearby buzzes with arcane energy.

巍峨的柱身仿佛凝固在永恒的役使之中，散发着空灵的魅惑。凝望那柔婉的曲线，你看见纤细的阴柔与骇人的奴役交织为一体。这些大理石雕像以瘦削的背脊扛起世界的重量；她们的缥缈之美掩映着一股令人心悸的异界伟力。

~ 由 Steve Adamski 构想

The lofty columns seem frozen in eternal servitude, exuding an air of etheric enchantment. Gazing upon their curvaceous forms you witness a fusion of delicate femininity and macabre subjugation. These marble figures bear the weight of the world upon their slender backs, their ethereal beauty concealing a haunting aura of otherworldly power.

~ Envisioned by Steve Adamski

Druid Entering A City.name:
德鲁伊踏入城邦
Druid Entering A City

Text.text:
“你在石头上的功夫的确令人叹服。每收购一块地，原址就拔地而起一座更宏伟的新建筑。但我总忍不住觉得，一个如此残酷地吞噬自身的文明，终究只是昙花一现。”
“Your work with stone is indeed impressive. With each plot of land bought out, a new, greater structure takes its place. But I can’t help thinking a civilization that cannibalizes itself so ruthlessly must be temporary.”

Construct Dragon's Radiant Breath Weapon.name:
构装巨龙的辉光吐息武器
Construct Dragon's Radiant Breath Weapon

Text.text:
巨龙降临，庞然巨翼雷鸣般的拍击声作号角；一抹伟大而可怖的阴影压暗了整片天空。它俯冲而下，天地忽然静默一瞬——龙躯内的光猛然绽放，刺目到令人失明——随即一道地狱之火自它口中喷涌而出，化作毁灭性的爆裂洪流。残破的躯体、崩裂的石砌与喷射的雪柱被掀上高空，炽焰光束如长矛般贯穿数栋建筑，所过之处只留下狂怒翻涌的尸骸炼狱。

~ Angie on Discord

A great and terrible shadow darkens the sky as the dragon arrives, heralded by the thunderous beating of colossal wings. There is a moment of silence as the dragon dives down—the light within it blooming to blinding proportions—before a stream of hellfire erupts from its maw in a devastating blast. Broken bodies, masonry, and jets of snow careen skyward as the beam lances through several buildings. It leaves a raging, charnel inferno in its wake.

~ Angie on Discord

年轻的萨堤尔与大多数同类一样，踏着分趾蹄轻盈迅疾地穿行。蓬乱的赤褐色毛发间探出弯曲的角，阳光吻过的白皙肌肤从栗色茸毛下若隐若现。他俊朗的脸上总挂着让人卸下戒心的笑意，略微前突、雕琢般的胡须勾勒出坚实的下颌与高挺的颧骨。萨堤尔腰间佩着一柄细剑，可他的手更常伸向背上斜挂的华美鲁特琴——一件梨形的赤杨木乐器，上面刻着繁复的图景：一片生机勃勃、野兽穿梭的森林。诡异的是，琴上的画面每次一瞥都似乎不同，仿佛那些刻入赤杨木的生灵来去随心。他瘦削的身形披着粗糙却磨旧的皮革，颈间垂着一枚抛光骨制护符，其上雕刻着繁丽却无法辨读的符文。

~ Played by Harlequin with

The young satyr, like most of his kind, moves gracefully and fleetly upon cloven hooves. Curving horns emerge from shaggy, auburn hair, while fair skin kissed by the sun peeks through chestnut fur. A disarming smile plays easily upon his handsome face, a jutting, sculpted beard emphasizing his strong jaw and high cheekbones. The satyr carries a rapier at his belt, but his hand strays more often to the beautiful lute slung across his back—a pear-shaped instrument of alder engraved with ornate depictions of a forest teeming with wildlife. Uncannily, the images upon the lute appear different at each glance, as if the creatures etched into the alder come and go as they please. Rough, well-worn leathers drape his lean form, and from his neck dangles a charm of polished bone carved with an elaborate but unreadable rune.

~ Played by Harlequin with

Crown Of Madness.name:
疯狂王冠
Crown Of Madness

Text.text:
当你将附魔的意志凝聚于眼前的敌人时，一阵灼痛如长矛般贯穿你的脑髓。世界猛然痉挛扭曲，现实在他们头颅周遭凝成一顶骇人的王冠。你扭曲的唇间溢出嘲弄的笑声，呢喃着癫狂的词句，催促那蜷伏在他们颅顶的锯齿铁冠灌入邪异的力量。
A searing pain lances through your brain as you focus your enchantment on the enemy before you. The world spasms and twists, reality forming into a horrifying crown about their head. Mocking laughter spills from your writhing lips as you mutter words of madness, urging them to infuse the jagged iron crouching atop their skull.

Witnessing A Secret Meeting.name:
目睹一场秘密会面
Witnessing A Secret Meeting

Text.text:
当你经过一条幽暗的小巷时，一抹微弱的光攫住了你的注意。你看见一个披斗篷的人扶着一扇陈旧的木门半掩着，另一只空着的手里捏着一支蜡烛，火光吝啬地洒出仅有的一点亮。几个人影鱼贯而入，那点小火苗在他们跨入门槛时掠过他们的神情——他们的眼下沉着浓重的青黑，可眼神里却燃着某种决然。他们全都溜进屋内，门随即合上，光也与他们一同消失。

~ 由一位英雄构想

As you pass by a dark alleyway, a dim glow steals your attention. You see a cloaked figure holding open an old wooden door, the candle in their free hand offering the barest amount of light. A small group of people file in, the small flame catching their expressions as they enter—their eyes, though weighted with dark circles, burn with a certain determination. They all slip into the building and the door closes, the light disappearing with them.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Portal In Wilderness.name:
荒野中的传送门
Portal In Wilderness

Text.text:
一座尖拱的石质拱门伫立在风景中，藤蔓缠覆，其内空无一物，却恰到好处地将远处一棵树框成一幅画。拱门以及连着它的几段坍圮残墙，看起来像曾是宏伟宅邸或神殿的门庭遗迹。你凝视间，那棵远树忽然变得模糊；下一瞬，一扇彩绘的门便立在拱中，绿得如同草地，门上嵌着黄铜门环，做成一张大笑的人脸。
A peaked arch of ivy-shrouded stone stands empty in the landscape, beautifully framing a distant tree. The arch and the bits of crumbled wall attached to it look like they might have once marked the doorway of a grand house or temple. As you watch, the distant tree blurs, and an instant later a painted door stands in the arch, as green as the grass and with a brass door knocker shaped like a laughing face.

巨型弩如一头骸骨巨兽般伏低身躯，白骨以肠索缠裹、捆束成战争的武器。弩架之上，粗陋的符文脉动鼓噪；筋腱弓弦在粗暴的工匠绞盘下被一点点拉回，他们长獠的面孔被汗水涂抹得发亮。颤抖的弩矢上抹着血迹，带刺的尖棘沿着它渴血的长度疯长。
The gigantic crossbow crouches like a skeletal beast, bones wrapped in gut and bound together as a weapon of war. Across the frame, crude runes throb as the sinew bow is winched back by brutish engineers, their tusked faces painted with sweat. Blood is daubed upon the quivering bolt, while thorny spikes grow along its flesh-seeking length.

Sundries From A Young White Dragon.name:
来自一头年轻白龙的杂物
Sundries From A Young White Dragon

Text.text:
巨龙的一只眼睛软塌塌地从空洞的眼眶里垂落出来，在它珠白泛光的鳞片上拖抹出深暗的猩红血痕。那团血肉眼球呈鲜艳的冰川蓝，即便死去，仍闪烁着恶意与贪婪的光。
One of the dragon’s eyes hangs limply from its hollow socket, smearing dark crimson blood across its pearlescent white scales. The fleshy orb is a vibrant, glacial blue and shines with malice and greed even in death.

Death After Defeat, Survival Of The Fitt.name:
败北即死，适者生存
Death After Defeat, Survival Of The Fittest

Text.text: 败北的战士喃喃低语着库伦的邪恶与暴烈，而“猎鹿帽”与昔日的圣武士俯立在他上方，如同一座遮蔽日光的山岳。黛尔德丽公主用纤细的拇指在自己颈间轻轻一划，向她的儿子点了点头。库伦转动长剑，笔直指向特里林比的心口。他低声呢喃：“塞尔努诺斯，你召唤了我，我已应答。寻你的道路漫长而荆棘遍布，草木疯长，几乎难以循迹。我将灵魂献给你，只为救回我群落中的一条命。自我开始狩猎，群狼愈发强盛——这正是这世界真正正义的明证：强者碾压弱者的正义。”随即，狼之刃刺入猎物的心脏。 The defeated warrior murmured of Cullen's evil and tempestuous nature as the Deerstalker and former paladin stood above him, a mountain blotting out the sun. Princess Dierdre dragged her delicate thumb across her neck and nodded to her son. Cullen turned his sword and pointed it straight at Trillingby's heart. He whispered, "Cernunnos, you have called me and I have answered. The path to find you was long and covered with thorns, overgrown and difficult to follow. I gave my soul to you that I might save the life of one of my pack. Since I began my hunt the Wolves have become stronger, a testament to the true justice of this world. The justice of the strong overcoming the weak." Then the wolf's blade found the heart of his prey.

[掩蔽] 墨滴或其他深色液体玷污了这本书的棕色皮革装帧。掩蔽上点缀浮雕卷纹与五芒星的金饰大多已剥落殆尽。 [内容] 书页边缘曾镀金，如今也在频繁翻阅中磨损褪色。翻开内页，满是奥秘符号与神秘图式，密密麻麻的笔记与页边批注交错其间——还夹杂着墨渍与洒落的茶痕。 [Cover] Ink droplets or other dark liquids mar this book’s brown leather binding. Gold that accented the embossed scrollwork and pentacle on the cover has mostly flaked away. [Content] The page edges were gilded, but they too are worn and discolored with use. Within, the book’s pages are full of arcane symbols, mystical diagrams, notes and marginalia in a tight hand—and blots of ink and spilled tea.

坐在一棵粗壮古老的大树下，那位鬓发泛灰的矮人躲在树荫里劳作，沉重的肩膀微微一耸。出人意料地，他那双温和的手灵巧地从一块柔软的松木上削下细屑，木块渐渐显出一头母鹿的轮廓。它的站姿与朴素的神情却细致得惊人，仿佛下一刻就会跃入林间空地，轻快奔跳。察觉到你的目光，矮人木雕匠微微皱眉，侧身一转，刻意挡住你的视线。
Sitting under a thick, ancient tree, the graying dwarf shifts his bulky shoulders as he works in the shade. His surprisingly gentle hands deftly shave chips from a piece of soft pine, the block gradually taking the shape of a doe. Its stance and simple expression show such detail that you can practically imagine the deer prancing through a forest clearing. Noticing your attention, the dwarf woodcarver scowls slightly, and turns to obscure your view.

I Use Lifedrinker.name:
我发动「噬命者」
I Use Lifedrinker

Text.text:
当我的武器击中的刹那，湮灭般的幽影能量猛然涌入我的敌人，在伤口里滋滋作响。物质在它面前本能退缩，腐烂，或化作飞灰。哪怕最细微的一道擦痕，也会被它染得焦黑，溃烂不止。
At my weapon’s impact, the shadowy energy of unmaking surges into my adversary. It sizzles in the wound. Matter recoils from it, rotting or turning to ash. It leaves even the tiniest scratch blackened or festering.

Interior Skyship Hall.name:
飞空艇内部大厅
Interior Skyship Hall

Text.text:
狭窄的舱室里弥漫着浓重的尘埃，呛得人几乎喘不过气；你一踏入，外头码头的喧嚷便像被厚布裹住般沉成低低的嗡鸣。敞开的门口泻进一线光，惊得害虫四散奔逃，钻进船体更深处的腹腔。若在另一段人生里，这间屋子本该挤满达官显贵与商贾，等着觐见船长——可如今它阴暗空荡，只收留老鼠与蜘蛛。
Thick, heavy dust chokes the air in the cramped room, and the sounds of the dock outside fade to a murmur as you enter. Light spilling through the open door causes vermin to scatter and flee into the bowels of the ship. In another life this room would have been full of dignitaries and merchants awaiting an audience with the captain—yet it stands dark and empty, hosting only rats and spiders.

Skyship Rune Pillars.name:
飞空艇符文支柱
Skyship Rune Pillars

Text.text:
货舱甲板船首与船尾那两根矮粗的石柱正嗡鸣着强大的魔法，你一靠近，皮肤便刺痒得发痛。石柱上覆满棱角分明的符印，闪烁着奥术的辉光，彼此以同样的时代律动起伏——如同一头巨兽的心跳——不断吐出一圈圈能量波。每根石柱上方的半空，都漂浮着一枚以金色描绘的白色符文石；每当一个循环完成，它便轻轻鸣响一声。
The squat, stone pillars at the bow and stern of the cargo deck thrum with powerful magic, causing your skin to itch painfully as you approach. Covered with angular sigils glowing with arcane power they pulse in time with each other—like the heartbeat of a titanic beast—emitting waves of energy. A single white runestone—inked with gold—floats in mid-air above each pillar and chimes softly with each completed cycle.

Stepping Out Of A Portal.name:
迈出传送门
Stepping Out Of A Portal

Text.text:
你抬起、迈向远方的那只脚，猝然在某个全新的地方重重落下。恍惚的一瞬间，你清晰地意识到自己同时存在于两处，仿佛被拉扯成一根发丝般细薄，横跨这段距离。若再多持续一秒，你确信自己会被撕裂成碎片；可下一刻，你猛然合拢归一，完好无损地在目的地站定。
The foot you lifted far away slaps down abruptly somewhere new, and, for a disorienting moment, you are conscious of being in both places and of being stretched as thin as a hair across the distance. If it lasted a second longer, you’re certain you’d break apart, but instead you snap together and stand in one piece at your destination.

Eva Technician On Spacewalk.name:
太空行走的EVA技术员
Eva Technician On Spacewalk

Text.text:
凝望那浩瀚、繁星点点的宇宙，舱外作业技师从气闸口安然漂出，投入虚空无重的怀抱。他们转身拉了拉与飞船相连的系绳，确认牢靠无误，随即从船体外壁轻轻一推，离开了金属的依凭。呼吸声在头盔里回荡，提醒他们此刻彻底的孤绝——他们独自面对造物的磅礴威严。
Gazing out on the vast, star-studded cosmos, the EVA technician drifts serenely from the airlock into the weightless embrace of the void. They turn and pull on the tether connecting them to the craft to ensure its security before pushing away from the hull. Their breath echoes inside their helmet, reminding them of their total isolation at this moment. They are alone with the overwhelming majesty of creation.

Above The Clouds On The Back Of A Griffo.name:
云端之上，乘狮鹫背脊翱翔
Above The Clouds On The Back Of A Griffon

Text.text:
从它强壮的背上俯瞰，你听见狮鹫的肌腱绷紧作响，仿佛上弦的弩弓弦；它将双翼彻底舒展，捕捉上升的热气流。你的眼睛被风吹得泪水直流，鹰首的坐骑迅速拔高，翼面微斜，带着你盘旋向上。你一头扎进云层，甚至来不及喊出声就已穿透而出，从头到脚都被露水浸得湿透。狮鹫的背脊一阵颤抖——它是在嘲笑你吗？
From your position on its powerful back, the griffon’s tendons sound like a crossbow string being pulled taut as it spreads its wings fully to catch the thermals. Your eyes stream with tears as your eagle-headed mount gain altitude rapidly, the wings angled to send you upward in a circle. You plunge through the clouds, and you don’t even have time to yell before you are already through, sodden with dew from head to toe. The griffon’s back shivers—is it laughing at you?

Act V Of The Hierospite: Woe Is He.name:
《圣寄生者》第五幕：哀哉此人
Act V Of The Hierospite: Woe Is He

Text.text:
他用谨慎而缓慢的语调说着，那声音既像一位老教授，也像一名败北的敌手：“做得好，小蛇。我怜悯下一个被你蜿蜒钻进身边的人。不是飞龙，也不是阿尔尚博披风。错了。我披着它那满怀怨毒的孪生物，阿尔尚博的宿敌。而现在，这件披风和我都已归于虚无，无名无姓。”
He speaks in the careful, slow tones that characterize both an old professor and a vanquished foe: "Well done, little snake. I pity whoever’s company you slither your way into next. It was not the Wyverns, nor the Cape of Archambault. Incorrect. I wear its spiteful twin, Archambault’s nemesis. And now this cape and I are nothing and no one.”

你在脑海中唤起一幅静止与寂然的景象：清澈柔和的微风掠过一片遍野野花。随着这幅画面成形，你用轻轻哼唱一段曾听见母亲哄睡孩子时唱过的摇篮曲片段，为这道法术收束尾声。
You summon to mind a vision of stillness and quiet, imagining a clean and gentle breeze playing over a field of wildflowers. As you do so, you finish the spell by humming a snippet of a lullaby you once heard a mother singing to her child.

Stressed Public Defender.name:
压力山大的公设辩护人
Stressed Public Defender

Text.text:
一个中年男人，胡茬零零落落地爬在脸颊与脖颈上。他黑眼圈深重，目光却只是呆滞地望向空间，像在注视某种无形之物。他那件扣领衬衫的领口已泛黄，从过小的西装外套下尴尬地翘起；未熨平的翻领上，还点缀着一片浅淡却清晰可见的咖啡渍。臂弯里夹着一台相对轻薄的银色平板。他每隔一分钟左右就用指尖轻轻沿着那薄薄的边缘划过，仿佛在检定它是否从自己手中滑落。
A middle-aged man, stubble patching his cheeks and neck, stares off into space with dark-rimmed eyes, observing nothing material. The yellowing collar of his button-down sticks up awkwardly from under his too-small suit jacket, and a pale but still visible coffee stain decorates his unironed lapel. A relatively sleek silver tablet sits in the crook of his arm. He lightly trails a finger over its thin edges every minute or so, as if to check that it hasn’t slipped from his grasp.

宛如一颗畸变独眼巨人的无身之首，一团圆钝的形体飘然入目；它的躯块覆着紫罗兰色的甲板，中央嵌着一只黄色的爬虫之眼。那目光所及，空气仿佛死去。凝视的球体之下，裂开一张巨口，层层利齿成排森然；其后，一条肉质长舌蠕动着，生物压低声音，以令人发狂的语言喃喃低语。怪物头顶生着十号条柔韧的肢体，每一条末端都长着一只比中央更小、色泽各异的眼睛。那些眼中有几只幽光忽闪，怪物随之龇牙低吼。
Like the bodiless head of an aberrant cyclops, a rounded form floats into view, its mass covered in violet plates and centered by a yellow reptilian eye. The air feels dead in that gaze. Under the staring orb yawns a mouth full of rows of sharp teeth, a fleshy tongue moving behind them as the creature whispers under its breath in a maddening language. Ten flexible limbs top the monstrosity, each tipped with an eye smaller than the central one and of a different hue. Some of these eyes flicker with eerie light as the monster snarls.

Master Of Souls.name:
灵魂主宰
Master Of Souls

Text.text:
腐臭的气息从一个赤脚踉跄的肮脏褴褛身影身上飘散开来；它那布满痘疤的脸上凝着一抹僵硬的狞笑。它那沾满污垢、结着泥痂的双手死死攥着一柄叮当作响的连枷，银饰骷髅仿佛在潜伏的恶意中森然窥笑。
The stench of decay wafts from a filthy and ragged figure staggering on bare feet, a rictus grin upon their pox-scarred face. Clutched in its grime-encrusted hands is a clanking flail with silvered skulls that seem to leer with latent malice.

Victim Begins To Drown.name:
受害者开始溺水
Victim Begins To Drown

Text.text:
一具身躯从浅水池里猛地冒出头来，拼命挣扎、呛咳连连，却被完全违背意志地死死控制着。一个粗野的身影揪住对方后脑湿透的头发，将其牢牢按回水下。受害者的喘息逐渐放缓、变得微弱，氧气一点点被夺走。乱抓的双手徒劳地摸索着借力之处，动作越来越慢，力气也随之流失。
A body emerges from the shallow pool of water, flailing and spluttering and held utterly against their will. A brutish figure holds the back of their head by its sodden hair, keeping it in place underwater. The victim’s gasps slow and weaken as they lose oxygen. Flailing hands fumble for purchase, slower and slower, losing strength.

Quip About A Filthy Place.name:
关于这脏地方的俏皮话
Quip About A Filthy Place

Text.text:
“那是什么？某种昆虫吗？真怪，像是……哦，不，原来是一小坨屎。到处就这么散落着小屎块。我们可真是被带来参观最‘漂亮’的地方了。”
“What is that? Some kind of insect? It’s strange, like… Oh, nope, it’s a little piece of poop. There’s little pieces of poop just lying around. We really do get to visit the nicest places.”

一名男子身披一袭利落的红蓝长袍，脚踩软拖，步伐踉跄地走近。他戴着一顶短小尖帽，胸前别着一枚金质胸针，形似一根魔杖。他的膝盖频频弯折，每一步都踮着脚尖落地；他俯身深深致意，黑色山羊胡被修整成俏皮的尖端，宛如一支圆头画笔。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

A man in a sleek set of red-and-blue robes approaches with a halting gait in slippered feet. He sports a short, pointed hat and a golden brooch in the shape of a wand. His knees bend frequently and each of his steps lands on his toes, and he bows low in greeting, his black goatee groomed into a whimsical point akin to a round paintbrush.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

I Draw A Bolt From My Efficient Quiver.name:
我从高效箭袋中抽出一支弩矢
I Draw A Bolt From My Efficient Quiver

Text.text:
当我从箭袋里抽出一支弩矢，另一支投射物立刻以军队般的严整填补空缺。弩矢猛地弹入我的掌心，仿佛被身后紧随其后的同伴向前顶射出来一般。
As I pull the bolt from the quiver, another projectile instantly fills the gap with military precision. The bolt springs into my hand, as if launched forward by its successor behind it.

Chakroun’s Coffee Cup.name:
沙克伦的咖啡杯
Chakroun’s Coffee Cup

Text.text:
新煮咖啡温热而提神的香气弥漫在店铺周围的街巷，浓郁的气息里还缠着豆蔻甜润、带木质感的芬芳。店内空间狭窄，摆着几张小巧的咖啡桌，只够两到三人亲密相聚。墙面点缀着色彩斑斓的装饰瓷砖：蓝、橙、棕、白交织成各式纹样。客人们肩挨着肩，缩身围着冒着热气的杯盏。轻声细语的交谈像低低的轰鸣，填满整个空间。店主在桌与桌之间挤身穿行，却优雅得不可思议，在人群上方稳稳托着一只托盘——两杯咖啡与一只壶，分毫不晃。
The warm, invigorating scent of freshly brewed coffee suffuses the streets surrounding this shop, the aroma lined with the sweet, woody scent of cardamom. Inside, the space is cramped with small cafe tables meant for intimate gatherings of two to three people. The walls are splashed with colorful pieces of decorative tile: patterns of blue, orange, brown, and white. Customers sit shoulder to shoulder, huddled over their steaming cups. They fill the space with the gentle rumble of quiet conversation. The shop’s owner squeezes by the tables with an impossible grace, balancing a platter holding two cups and a pot above the crowd.

I Escape The Horde.name:
我逃离尸潮
I Escape The Horde

Text.text:
我的敌人无法预判我的移动。我脚步起伏闪转、左右迂回、之字穿行——在我移动时让对手的目标彻底落空。他们抓不住我。我不会被包围，也不会被困住。他们徒劳的伤害或阻拦，只会扑进一片空荡的空气中。
My enemies can’t anticipate my movement. I bob, weave, and zigzag my footwork—throwing my foes off target as I move. They can’t pin me down. I won’t be surrounded or trapped. Their fruitless attempts to harm or stop me will find only empty air.

Signal Fires Burning In The Distance.name:
远方的烽火熊熊燃烧
Signal Fires Burning In The Distance

Text.text:
地平线上，烟雾盘旋缭绕。你的目光顺着那道高耸的烟柱一路追去，落在远处火光的辉映上——即便隔着朦胧烟霭，依旧明亮刺目。第二处火焰忽然闪烁着出现，而且更近。它的烟柱与第一道交织汇合，不久又有更多烟线升起，相继加入。
Smoke coils on the horizon. Your eyes follow the towering plume down to the glow of a distant fire, bright even through the haze. A second fire flickers into existence, even closer. Its smoke joins the first, and is soon joined by more.

车匠的作坊里堆满了铁器零件与工作台，拥挤得仿佛比外头看起来小了一半。靠着一侧，半成的马车骨架横陈着，等着覆上风干的木板，好让它滴水不漏。作坊入口附近摆着一座铁砧，用来将铁箍锻打成各式实用的形状。墙边的架子上挂着一套尚未完工的铁箍，正准备加固马车的车轴。
The wainwright’s workshop is so crowded with pieces of ironmongery and worktables that it looks half as large as it does from the outside. Along one side, a partially constructed wagon’s ribbing rests, waiting to be finished with cured planks to render it waterproof. Near the workshop’s entrance sits an anvil for pounding iron bands into various useful shapes. A half-finished set of bands for reinforcing the wagon’s axles hangs from a rack mounted onto the nearby wall.

这把刀刃远比同类更为巨大，剑柄上刻着令人费解的奥秘符文。镶嵌在柄首的宝石微微流光闪烁，而涂油皮革制成的剑鞘上，则以惊人的细节描绘着战士斩杀巍峨巨人的图景。
This blade is far larger than others of its kind and bears curious arcane markings upon the hilt. A gem set into the pommel shimmers, and images of warriors slaying towering humanoids decorate the oiled leather scabbard in striking detail.

Rural Road In Winter.name:
冬日乡间小路
Rural Road In Winter

Text.text:
乡间大道夹在休耕的田地之间，上一季收成遗下的枯脆秸秆从雪面探出头来。雪橇的滑 runners 在路上犁出宽深的辙痕，让旅行更为省力。越过沿路的石墙与编织成篱的树篱，几缕淡烟自农舍烟囱袅袅升起。
The country road lies between fallow fields where brittle stalks of last season’s harvest peek through the snow. The runners of sleds have left wide furrows along the track, making travel easier. Beyond the stone walls and woven hedges lining the lane, thin trails of smoke rise from farmhouse chimneys.

你无法用这个法术把稻草纺成黄金，但你会靠它省下大把金币——也许这就足够了。只要记着亲手制作你渴望的那件物体需要耗费多少小时，似乎就能让魔法更顺畅地运作；因此，想想你能省下多少钱，也不会有坏处。
You can’t use this spell to spin straw into gold, but you’ll save a lot of gold using it so perhaps that is good enough. Keeping in mind the hours it would take to craft the object you desire seems to help the magic work, so thinking about the money you’ll save shouldn’t hurt.

这台鼠形间谍无人机在秘密研究设施狭窄的走廊里疾驰而过，细小的轮子几乎不发出声响。它将顶级传感器塞进紧凑机身，能钻入那些更大型机器无法触及的区域。它的速度与灵巧使其成为隐秘监视的完美工具，而垃圾代码发射器确保它不被窥探的目光发现。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The mouse-like spy drone zips through the narrow corridors of the clandestine research facility, its tiny wheels making minimal sound. Armed with top-tier sensors, inside a compact design, it is capable of accessing areas that larger machines can’t. Its speed and agility make it the perfect tool for covert surveillance, and junk code emitters ensure it remains unseen by prying eyes.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

你滑跪在地，双手贴上倒下者仰卧的身躯，将一股急促而绝望的神圣魔法猛然导入。来自你守护者的能量如浪潮般炸裂涌入那渐黯的躯壳，强行唤醒停滞的血液与器官，把他们从死亡的边缘硬生生拽回。

~ 由 IceBite 构想

Skidding to your knees, you channel a quick, desperate surge of divine magic through your hands into the supine form of the fallen. Bursts of your patron’s energy flood the fading being’s body, jumpstarting their blood and organs and bringing them back from the brink of death.

~ Envisioned by IceBite

Summer Tournament With Warm Breeze.name:
暖风拂面的夏日锦标赛
Summer Tournament With Warm Breeze

Text.text:
无数彩旗在穿谷而过的暖风中翻涌摇曳。半披甲的骑士们摘盔露首，在欢呼的人群间昂首阔步，像得奖的孔雀般招摇；他们向入眼之人欠身致意，对宿敌投去冷厉的目光，又张臂拥抱久别的故友。侍从们紧跟在主人身后，抱着他们的战争器具匆匆疾行。另一些人正耙平比武场的沙地，间或停下抹去额头的汗水，汗渍将他们的罩袍染得斑驳。号角齐鸣，宣告锦标赛即将开场。
Myriad pennants stir in the warm breeze blowing through the valley. Partly armored knights go bareheaded, strutting like prize peacocks among adoring fans, bowing to folk who catch their eye, glaring at their rivals, and embracing old friends. Squires hurry behind their masters, carrying their tools of war. Others rake the sands of the tilt yard, stopping occasionally to mop their brows, their tabards stained with sweat. Trumpets peal, announcing the tournament is soon to begin.

结实宽阔的肩膀在沉重的链甲衫下鼓胀着力量。铠袖与厚皮手套之间的缝隙里，露出苍白泛红的皮肤。粗壮的脖颈托着一颗头颅：宽阔棱角分明的下颌上垂着几撮浅色长须；厚实的嘴唇向后翻起，仿佛永远凝着一抹怒容；鼻梁锐利，鼻根宽阔。骄傲的眉脊下，是一双目光极其凌厉的眼睛。它那如丝般的头发向后束成松散的发髻，许多长长的发束垂落背后。浓密的鬃发间顶出一对硕大尖耳，分立于头颅两侧，格外醒目。
Sturdy, wide shoulders brim with strength under a heavy chain shirt. Pale reddish skin shows in the gaps between the mail sleeve and thick leather gloves. A sturdy neck supports a head with a broad angular jaw—along which grows long tufts of fair hair—wide lips curled back into a seemingly permanent scowl, and a sharp, wide-based nose. A proud brow rests above two very intense eyes. The humanoid’s silky hair is pulled back into a loose bun with many long locks hanging down its back. Large, pointed ears push through the dense mane, standing prominently at each side of its head.

Poisoner's Kit.name:
毒药师工具包
Poisoner's Kit

Text.text:
这只加厚软箱里装着一只青铜研钵和相配的研杵，两支黄铜与玻璃制的注射器、几枚针头，以及一副蛇皮手套。箱盖上方用绳环挂着数只小瓶——有的空着，有的盛满粉末或草药。另有一处小隔层收着蜡、几片薄薄的皮革补片，以及一卷细绳。
This padded case holds a bronze mortar and matching pestle, two syringes of brass and glass, needles, and snakeskin gloves. Several vials—some empty, some full of powders or herbs—are looped to the case’s top. A small compartment also holds wax, thin patches of leather, and a coil of string.

某个细节看起来可靠地带着矮人、精灵或龙裔的设计风格，另一个细节却立刻与之相悖。钥匙为铁制，体型约如一名成年男子的食指。钥匙齿端包覆青铜，齿形却被怪异地削成棱角分明的角状切面。它像是狱卒的钥匙，但若真有牢门需要用它开启，那景象必然骇人至极。钥匙环是一片扁平的金属板，中央镂着一个你从未见过的符号。
Where one detail seems reliably dwarvish, or elvish, or dragonborn in design, another contradicts. The key is iron and the size of a human man’s index finger. The bit’s teeth are capped in bronze and oddly cut in angular shapes. It seems like a jailer’s key, but any cell door that took this would be terrifying indeed. The bow is a flat metal plate with a symbol you have never seen cut into its center.

Person Wearing An Excellent Disguise.name:
身着精妙伪装之人
Person Wearing An Excellent Disguise

Text.text:
当你意识到身边的陌生人其实完全是另一个人时，想忍住不当场回头再看一眼，需要相当的自制力。淡淡的妆容、分散视线的穿着、无声的习惯性小动作，以及说话节奏里那点微妙的改动层层叠加，构成了高明的伪装——唯有格外留神的人，才会察觉其中破绽。
It takes a fair dose of self-control to keep yourself from doing a double-take when you realize the stranger near you is actually someone else entirely. Subtle makeup, an eye-distracting outfit, nonverbal affectations, and a slight change in speech pattern all combine into an effective disguise, only noticeable if one pays close attention.

Chain Shirt Armor +2.name:
链甲衫 护甲 +2
Chain Shirt Armor +2

Text.text:
这件紧密相扣的亮闪闪环甲衫触感轻盈柔韧，倒更像布料而非金属。它抛光得过于耀眼，你不禁怀疑：穿着这样的护甲，怎么可能悄无声息？念头掠过时，你在手中轻轻翻动护甲，它竟暗了下去……或仿佛暗了下去。你倾斜着链甲，心想这一定只是光线的把戏。
This gleaming shirt of tight rings feels light and supple, more like cloth than metal. It seems much too highly polished, and you wonder how anyone might be stealthy wearing such armor. As the thought crosses your mind, you move the armor in your hands, and it dims… or it seems to. It must be just a trick of the light as you tilt the chain mail.

I Use Action Surge To Attack.name:
我使用动作激增进行攻击
I Use Action Surge To Attack

Text.text:
我乘胜追击，决然挥动刀锋，不给敌人任何反击的机会。
I press my attack, resolutely swinging my blade, before my foe has a chance to retaliate.

火花在施法者掌心里摇曳——一枚孤零零、闷燃的奥术火种。施法者将它呵护、将它温养，如同守着将熄的炉膛一般，令火星被引燃成断续跳动的火苗，再化作灼烈的烈焰，最终凝成一颗拳头大小、纯粹的炽白火球。施法者将火球掷向敌人；它在空中旋转飞掠时再次膨胀，体型与热度一并暴涨。蓝白火焰环绕那团最纯粹的烈火盘旋，如一颗不可熄灭的近星，吞吐无尽威能。火球下方的大地被炽热烤得发黑；它掠过之处，空气也被灼得焦闷翻滚。火球击中它的目标，随之而来的爆炸点燃了周遭的空气，掀起一圈热浪冲击——其热度骇人，瞬间将周围一切汽化：物体、生物，乃至地形，都在同一刻被灼成飞灰。火球继续扩张，如毁灭之花盛放，伴随热浪的消散而层层绽开。紧接着，一阵撼地的震颤袭来，仿佛把周遭空气都吸了进去，火球轰然爆裂。燃烧中电光噼啪炸裂；巨响震耳欲聋；强光比直视太阳更刺目。火焰渐退，余下的只有灰烬——在干燥的风里飘荡——以及一口黑玻璃般的焦黑巨坑。

~ Envisioned by Elias

The spark wavers in the caster’s palm—a single, smoldering ember of arcane flame. The caster fosters it, nurtures it like one would a dying hearth, kindling the spark into a sputtering flame, then a searing blaze, and finally into a fist-sized sphere of pure, white-hot fire. The caster hurls the sphere of flame toward their enemies, and as it spins through the air, it expands yet again, growing in size and heat. Flames of blue and white spiral about the sphere of purest fire, a relative star of unquenchable power. The ground beneath the sphere blackens with the fire’s intensity; the air smolders in its wake. The fireball strikes its target, and the resulting explosion ignites the very air around it, creating a shockwave of heat so intense it instantly vaporizes everything around it—objects, creatures, even the terrain, turn to ash in a single, searing moment. The sphere expands, blossoming like a flower of destruction as the wave of heat dissipates. With an earth-shaking tremor that sucks in the air around it, the fireball bursts. Lightning crackles in the combustion; the sound is deafening; the light is brighter than staring into the sun itself. The fire fades, and in its absence, only ash remains—wafting on the arid wind—and a crater of black glass.

~ Envisioned by Elias

Venjin Oribo Von Marrk.name:
文金·奥里博·冯·马尔克
Venjin Oribo Von Marrk

Text.text:
男人周身携带着一股异界能量——光辉向外辐射流淌。银金色长发垂落，眼眸是水晶般澄澈的蓝色，他独特的传承一眼可见；可他的举止却随性从容，仿佛那股内蕴的力量不过是无关紧要的影子。编织布衣之下隐约可见，一道横贯背部的纹身描绘着一场战斗：圆满日食的幽暗之下，有翼天使与狰狞恶魔般的怪物厮杀纠缠。

~ Played by Venjin

The man carries with him an otherworldly energy—a glow radiating outward. With long, silvery blond hair and eyes a shade of crystalline blue, the man’s unique heritage is apparent, though he carries himself with a casual ease that belies that inner power. Barely visible beneath his woven cloth garb, a tattoo across his back depicts a battle: winged angels and fiendish creatures beneath a full eclipse.

~ Played by Venjin

I Parry A Strike Using My One-handed Wea.name:
我用单手武器格挡一次打击
I Parry A Strike Using My One-handed Weapon

Text.text:
这一招既要力气，也要巧劲：在恰当的角度迎上袭来的武器，将它一带一拧，全靠我掌心与腕力去完成这记化解。撞击时传来令人满足的滑脱感——干净、利落，带着一丝优雅。然后……破绽出现了。
The move requires some strength as well as finesse, meeting the oncoming weapon at the right angle and turning it but with only the strength in my grip and wrist to work the maneuver. There is a satisfying slip to the impact, a grace. And now… an opening.

黑色鳞片覆在这名肌肉虬结的蜥蜴人身上，其间点缀着橙色纹路，橙色的眼眸与之相呼应。一道油亮的黑色冠脊自他头顶向后延伸，让他看起来比本就高大的身形更显挺拔。他身上只穿着一件宽松的浅色长袍。两侧腰间各挂着一把短剑，背后则套着长弓与一筒箭。他盯着脚边的尘土，用几乎难以察觉的手势与嘶嘶低语让它起舞、闪烁如星。

~ Played by Alex with

Black scales with orange patterns cover this brawny lizardfolk, with matching orange eyes. A glossy black crest extends from his head, making him seem taller than he already is. He wears only a loose, light-colored thobe. A shortsword hangs on each hip, and holstered on his back are a longbow and quiver of arrows. He stares at the dust around his feet, using subtle gestures and sibilant whispers to make it dance and sparkle.

~ Played by Alex with

Northern Mining Outpost Next To A Frozen.name:
冰封海岸旁的北方采矿前哨
Northern Mining Outpost Next To A Frozen Sea

Text.text:
穿过苦涩的飞雪与刺骨的寒风，你的旅程将你带到一处偏远的北境前哨，依偎在覆雪的丘陵脚下。低矮的石屋呈圆拱之形，宛如雪屋般敦实，专为抵御凛冽的风而建。烟气自烟囱袅袅升起，裹挟着炖锅里翻滚的香气，层层叠叠，扑鼻而来。城镇边缘，一道漫长蜿蜒的峭壁旁踏出一条被踩得发实的土路，通往一座伸入海湾的长长木栈桥。隆冬时节，海面冻结，栈桥也随之失去用处。
Through bitter snow and frigid wind, your journey finds you in a remote northern outpost, nestled against snow-capped hills. The squat, stone buildings resemble igloos in their shape, designed to ward off frigid winds. Smoke curls from chimneys, carrying with it myriad scents of simmering stews. A long, winding cliff at the edge of town forms a well-trod earthen path leading to a long, wooden dock jutting into the bay. In the dead of winter, the dock becomes unusable due to the frozen sea.

Captain Shadowscale Escapes Encounter.name:
暗影鳞队长脱身遭遇
Captain Shadowscale Escapes Encounter

Text.text:
砍断一根系在桅杆上的绳索，影鳞船长把它缠在自己沾满血污的利爪上，攀上船舷的栏杆，透过碎裂的牙齿朝你低吼：“好久没有哪个杂碎让我尝到铁味了。本该以牙还牙，可得先欠着——我还有更重要的事要办。”他带着几分宠溺地轻敲那把沾着血肉的刀刃，随即披风一甩，潇洒地翻身越过栏杆。
Slashing a rope secured to the mast, Captain Shadowscale wraps it around his blood-slick claw and climbs atop the ship's railing, snarling at you through broken teeth. “Been a long time since some scrub made me taste iron. I’d pay you back in kind, but it’ll have to wait, I have more important matters to attend to.” Tapping his gore-covered blade affectionately, he swings over the railing with a flourish of his weather-beaten coat.

Conjure Celestial.name:
召唤天界生物
Conjure Celestial

Text.text:
当你凝聚自己的意志，向你的契主呼唤时，你成功召唤并束缚了他们的一名仆从，令其为你效力一段时代。那神圣生物的灵光耀目得几乎令人无法直视，直到其故乡位面的余辉缓缓褪去，融散在物质世界之中。
Gathering the strength of your will as you call out to your patron, you succeed in conjuring and binding one of their servants for a time. The radiance of the divine creature’s aura is difficult to look at squarely, before the lingering traces of its home plane bleed off into the physical world.

I Resist Seelie Glamour.name:
我抵抗精灵灵光的魅惑
I Resist Seelie Glamour

Text.text:
雪松的喷香与明亮的柑橘气息骤然涌入我的感官，我的眼皮随之沉重起来。我听见许多声音的轻笑——有的细小迅疾如鼠，有的低沉庄严如古树——就在我踉跄之际，膝盖撞上了仿佛一片苔藓铺就的床榻，绒软如羽。周遭开始旋转，色彩像画家飞快搅动调色盘般汇拢成漩涡。一丝恐慌掠过脑海。我抬手捂向脸，仿佛要捕住那股将我迷得昏沉的甜美香气。随即，我感到掌心与指缝间有某种液态的存在。它颤动了一下，便彻底消失无踪。我重新完全掌控了我的感官，站起身来，环顾四周，寻找这场戏弄的源头。
A spray of cedar and bright citrus flood my senses and I feel my eyelids grow heavy. I hear the soft laughter of many voices—some as small and quick as mice, others as deep and solemn as ancient trees—just before I stumble, my knee hitting what feels to be a bed of moss, downy-soft. My surroundings begin to swirl, colors converging like a painter rapidly spinning their palette. A twinge of panic runs through my mind. I bring a hand to my face as if to catch the pleasing aroma that had so lulled me. With that, I feel the liquid presence of something in my palm and around my fingers. It shudders before disappearing completely. I regain full command of my senses and stand up, looking around for the origin of the attempted hoodwink.

Ancient Tree In An Impact Crater.name:
撞击坑中的古树
Ancient Tree In An Impact Crater

Text.text:
那棵树自陨坑深处拔地而起，如同一截枯瘦的骸骨肢体，蜿蜒攀向天穹，舒展成一顶覆满熠熠金属叶片的树冠。树皮亦如铁般泛光，幽暗而沉郁。陨坑底部遍布碎裂岩片与金属粉尘——皆是久远之前那颗坠落星体的残骸，曾在此播下丰饶。如今，生长在陨坑中心的这棵树，正闪烁着那来自天外的金属寒辉。

~ Requested by Rogério da Costa Jr.

The tree rises like a skeletal limb from the depths of the crater, winding its way skyward and opening into a canopy of gleaming metallic leaves. The bark, too, shines like iron, dark and muted. Shards of rock and powdered metal riddle the crater floor, remnants of the star that fell long ago and sowed its bounty. Now, the tree growing at its epicenter glimmers with that metal borne of the sky.

~ Requested by Rogério da Costa Jr.

Sundries From A Grimlock.name:
来自恐爪怪的杂货
Sundries From A Grimlock

Text.text:
死去的格里姆洛克身上没有任何值钱的东西，但它身侧有一副锈蚀的镣铐，拖着几节铁链——外侧被人划出一道道刻痕般的铭文——还有一顶半身人便帽，上面糊着腐烂发臭的脑浆残渣。
The dead grimlock carries nothing of worth, but at its side is a rusted shackle with a few links of chain—an inscription scratched along the outside of it—and a halfling cap smeared with the rotten remains of brain matter.

Vampire's Manor: Servants' Room.name:
吸血鬼（特征）庄园：仆役房
Vampire's Manor: Servants' Room

Text.text:
仆役的住处简陋却还算舒适，位于宅邸尽头、紧靠庭院的一侧。几乎只是上下铺行军床的床位沿墙排开，每张床旁都放着一只小箱子用来收纳。门边占着一个洗脸盆，盆里的水黑沉浑浊。你环视这片空间，注意到破烂的毯子与满地杂物，就在这时，水盆里猛地溅起一声水花。
The servants’ quarters are meager yet comfortable, situated near the courtyard at the far end of the house. Beds, little more than bunked cots, line the walls, each with a small trunk for storage. A wash basin occupies the space beside the door, the water within dark and murky. As you cast your gaze over the space, noting the ratty blankets and debris-strewn floor, something splashes in the water basin.

Black Pudding Encounter.name:
黑布丁遭遇
Black Pudding Encounter

Text.text:
一滩黏稠的蓝黑色烂泥以惊人的速度朝你蠕动而来——身后回荡着令人不安的嘶嘶作响。那团软泥挥舞着乱甩的拟足向你探来，拼命想把你拽进它黏腻的躯团里，赐予你缓慢而痛苦的死亡。
A viscous pool of blue-black slop moves toward you with alarming speed—a disconcerting sizzle echoing in its wake. The ooze reaches for you with flailing pseudopods, desperate to pull you into its sticky mass for a slow, tortuous death.

炫目的光芒在这片阴影般的虫群中频频闪烁。每一只微小的甲壳生物都是披甲之物——紧紧束缚在几丁质甲板的硬壳里——可当它们汇聚在一起，便成了一场饥饿翻涌的黑色风暴。它们周围的坚固物体仿佛在融化，被千百张细小的口器一层层剥离。随着它们进食，光芒的色彩与形状也随之脉动、变幻。
Dazzling lights flash through this shadowy swarm. Each tiny crustacean is an armored thing—bound tight in a shell of chitinous plate—but together they are a dark storm, swirling with hunger. Solid objects around the creatures seem to melt, peeled away by a thousand little mouths. As they feed, the colors and shapes of their lights pulse and change.

Untended Herbalist's Yard.name:
无人照料的草药师庭院
Untended Herbalist's Yard

Text.text:
罗勒向四面舒展，缠绕着迷迭香；紫色乌头花依着意志穿行于石南丛间。常春藤啃噬着窗框，苔藓自小朵盛开的木槿与幼桦的根际探出触手。零散的石板小径早被草木淹没——野性被驯化，又在此处重归野性。
The basil, reaching out in several directions, intertwines with the rosemary, and purple wolfsbane marches at will through the patches of heather. Ivy eats at the window frames, and moss reaches out from the roots of small flowering hibiscus and young birches. The scattered stone walkway is overgrown, as the wild turned domesticated turns wild again.

从尘封的陵寝通往地下的通道一路延伸，尽头豁然开进一连串潮湿腐臭的甬道里；腐烂分解的气味无穷无尽，像阴冷的手指钻进鼻腔与喉咙，侵袭每一个胆敢踏入这座黑暗坟冢的愚者。蛛网封死了整段通路——但愿那只是多年寂静结出的尘茧，而非某只巨型蛛怪潜伏深处的巢痕。沿途不知名的野兽或怪物曾在各处翻掘残骸，令你每一步都踏得骨头咯嚓作响，干枯的白骨在脚下碎裂成渣。
The passage leading underground from the dusty mausoleum emerges into a rank and stinking series of passages, the aromas of decomposition endless and invasive to any foolish enough to enter this dark tomb. Cobwebs block off entire passages, hopefully the product of years of silence and not of some enormous arachnid lurking within its depths. Unknown animals or monsters have partially excavated various remains throughout, causing your footsteps to crunch solidly on desiccated bones.

I Cast Dominate Monster From My Ring Of.name:
我从【御风元素指环】中施放了【支配怪物】
I Cast Dominate Monster From My Ring Of Air Elemental Command

Text.text:
连接我双生戒环的锁链叮当作响，我将元素束缚于我的意志之下。我的心智与它相连，如耳语般穿行，直抵那团无定云涌的核心。它敌意的翻腾戛然而止，安静地等待指令。元素那原初的咆哮也被抚平成平和、轻盈的吐息。
The chain connecting my twin rings rattles as I shackle the elemental to my will. My mind connects with theirs, traveling like a whisper into the center of its amorphous billows. Its hostile flourishing ends and it waits patiently for direction. The elemental’s primordial growls are reduced to calm, airy exhalations.

当你走近水边，宁静覆上心头，你的呼吸与那粼粼波光的表面移动同频。你伸出微微颤抖的双手，仿佛抓住了无形的空气，指尖轻柔地搅动、挑逗。起初缓慢，近旁的水源便开始扭动起伏，涟漪层层荡开。它翻涌成波，像在你无声的旋律里起舞。
Calm settles over you as you approach the water, your breathing matching the movement of its shimmering surface. You extend quivering hands, seemingly grasping at thin air, fingers gently swirling, teasing. Slowly at first, the nearby water source writhes and ripples. It waves, dancing to your silent tune.

这架攻城器械已然老迈。深色橡木的框架坑洼斑驳、伤痕累累；那只青铜斗——由一根绷紧的绳索牢牢系住——在经年累月的使用中凹陷变形。包铁的车轮把它高高托离泥泞，粗厚的软木楔子死死卡住轮下。它的侧板上刷着一枚枚白色十字，或许是在悼念殒命的乘员。旁边堆着巨大的岩块，又有一团团灌满沥青的黏土弹丸，随时可将死亡倾泻向血肉或城石。
The siege engine is old. The dark oak frame is pitted and scarred, its bronze bucket—held in place by a taut rope—dented from years of use. Ironshod wheels hold it proud of the mud, thick softwood wedges holding them in place. White crosses have been painted upon its flanks, perhaps commemorating fallen crew. Large boulders are piled nearby, alongside balls of pitch-filled clay, ready to deal death to flesh or stone.

Sensation Of Time Stopping.name:
时代停滞的感触
Sensation Of Time Stopping

Text.text:
世界在你周围慢了下来。声音变得沉闷——仿佛你一头扎进水下——而远处的一切，随着移动放缓至近乎爬行，继而彻底停滞。即便如此，你仍保持清醒，感知那股如巨浪拍岸般将你吞没的触感，并感觉自己被冻结在时代之中。
The world slows around you. Sounds become muffled—as if you’ve plunged underwater—and distant, as movement slows to a crawl, then stops entirely. Through all of this you are aware, conscious of the sensation enveloping you like a crashing wave, and you feel yourself become frozen in time.

Aftermath Of A Bar Fight.name:
酒馆斗殴的余波
Aftermath Of A Bar Fight

Text.text:
斗殴的喧嚣像退潮般渐渐平息，赌客们从混乱的酒馆里鱼贯而出。几名酒客倒在碎裂的吧凳与酒杯残骸之间，浑然不觉报复的阴影正压向这片狼藉。伴随着沉重的铠靴踏地声，一队卫兵撞开门板残余闯了进来，对着屋内四散的人群厉声喝令。

~ 构想：Inbal（Discord）

The tumult of the brawl settles like a receding tide as punters flow out of the chaotic tavern. Several patrons lie among the shattered debris of bar stools and tankards, blissfully unaware of the reprisal bearing down upon the scene. With heavy mailed footsteps, a group of guards barges through what remains of the door and starts barking orders to the scattering people within.

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

小门在辽阔的城墙上静静嵌着，仿佛穿石而过的一声耳语。它藏在高耸塔楼的阴影里，门外正对城墙外陡峭的斜坡，这道小侧门显然并不打算经常启用。尽管如此，草地上仍被踩出一条泥泞的小径，直通门前。
The tiny door sits quiet in the vastness of the castle wall, like a whisper through the stone. Tucked in the shadow of a looming tower, and opening onto the steep slope outside the walls, the postern gate clearly is not meant to be often used. Nevertheless, a muddy path has been beaten through the grass to the door.

这台看上去摇摇欲坠的机器被推着向前滚动，高耸的长臂在每一次颠簸中都颤个不停。船员们嘻嘻哈哈地开着玩笑，抓起垂落的绳索，开始齐力绞拉。木梁尖啸，兽毛绳索低沉地呻吟，男人们哼声喷气、吆喝咆哮。终于，皮革吊兜归位，一块绘着符号的巨石被撬杠一点点压进其中。
The frail-looking machine is wheeled forward, its towering arm quivering with every jolt. The crew joke and laugh, taking up the dangling ropes, and begin to haul. The timber screeches, animal-hair ropes grumble, and men snort and shout. Finally, the leather bucket is in place and a symbol-painted rock is levered in.

咒语的最后一个音节落下，你双掌前伸，意念如潮，逼迫周遭生物退散。它们脸上浮现出厌恶般的扭曲神色，随即急急偏转，择最快的路线逃离这道法术的笼罩。
Finishing the last syllable of the chant, you hold your palms out, willing yourself to push away the creatures in the vicinity. They grimace as if disgusted and then veer away, taking the fastest possible route to leave the spell’s presence.

苍白潮湿的地衣，以细细蔓生的丝缕攀附在灯塔入口那雕工精湛的石面上，仿佛尸体蜡质皮肤下隐现的血脉。那些丝缕会抽搐、弹跳，像被看不见的电流惊扰——却只在眼角余光里才会发生。高大而压迫感十足的大门曾刻着一幕象形文字般的膜拜场景，但时代早已将所有可辨的细节磨蚀殆尽。
Pallid, damp lichen clings to the masterfully sculpted stone of the lighthouse entrance in thin creeping strands, like veins beneath the waxy skin of a cadaver. The strands twitch and jerk as if shocked by an unseen current—but only out of the corner of one’s eye. The tall, imposing doors of the structure once depicted a hieroglyphic scene of worship, but time has long since worn away any discernable details.

老鼠沿着墙根窜行，贴地压低身形，神经质地在阴影间进出穿梭——唯有一只例外，正立在光线边缘。它后腿直立，鼻尖抽动、耳朵竖起，用一双漆黑如墨的眼睛审视每一个过客。
Rats scurry along the walls, keeping low to the ground and darting in and out of shadows with frenetic movements—save for one, standing just at the edge of the light. It rests on its hind legs, nose twitching and ears perked as it examines every passerby with pitch-black eyes.

Chapel In A Castle.name:
城堡礼拜堂
Chapel In A Castle

Text.text:
小礼拜堂藏在一扇厚重的橡木门后，门上钉着铁钉，并烙印着守护神祇的圣徽。两排长椅分列左右，围出一条通往尽头祭坛的甬道。挂毯垂覆墙面，地毯吞没你踏入时的脚步声。辛烈的熏香味与霉烂羊皮纸和尘土的陈腐气息交织在一起。似乎城堡里鲜有人来这处僻静的礼拜堂——可又是为什么？
The chapel lies beyond a heavy oaken door studded with iron and emblazoned with the sigil of the patron deity. Pews stand in two rows, framing the aisle leading to the altar at the head of the room. Tapestries drape the walls, and carpets muffle your footsteps when you step inside. The sharp smell of incense mingles with the stale scent of moldering parchment and dust. It seems few in the castle visit this secluded chapel—but why not?

Sir Tigress Greymane Defeats The Stone G.name:
虎女爵提格蕾丝·灰鬃击败石巨人
Sir Tigress Greymane Defeats The Stone Giant

Text.text:
莱奥宁腾空飞掠，长刃高举，钢蓝色的皮毛根根倒竖。金色双眼闪着掠食者般的狡黠，獠牙大张，胜利的咆哮撕裂长空。编成辫的鬃毛在身后飞扬，这位兽性骑士将巨剑狠狠劈向敌手——一名高如塔楼的石巨人。寒光乍现的剑锋劈入岩石之躯，斩穿那庞大生物的“血肉”，当场将其放倒。巨人轰然倾覆之际，莱奥宁在不远处稳稳落地，猩红斗篷被倒下的巨躯掀起的气浪卷得猎猎翻飞。
The leonin hurtles through the air, blade held aloft, steel-blue fur bristling. Golden eyes gleam with a predatory cunning, mouth agape in a triumphant roar. Braided mane flowing behind him, the bestial knight brings the greatsword down upon his foe—a towering stone giant. The sword, shining, hews through the stone flesh of the massive creature, felling them where they stand. As the giant topples, the leonin comes to land a short distance away, crimson cloak fluttering in the air displaced by his toppled foe.

你看见松软的白雪厚厚覆盖着一间由风化木梁搭起的朴素小屋。烟雾从鹅卵石烟囱里盘旋升起，裹着香料慢炖的馥郁气息。霜花覆上的窗面映出摇曳的光影，暗示屋内炉火正旺；而屋檐垂下的冰棱滴落刺骨寒水。
You see fluffy, white snow blanketing a simple cabin of worn timbers. Smoke spirals from the cobblestone chimney, bearing the fragrance of simmering spices. Light flickers against the frosted windows, hinting at the warm hearth within, while icicles drip frigid water from the eaves of the roof.

Necklace Of Adaptation.name:
适应项链
Necklace Of Adaptation

Text.text:
这条毫无雕饰的黄铜项圈在你周遭阴湿的环境中仍熠熠生辉。项圈周围的一圈空气清新洁净——这在物理上根本不可能。
This unadorned brass torc gleams despite the dank conditions of your surroundings. The air just around the necklace is fresh and clean—a physical impossibility.

I Converse With A Black Dragon.name:
我与一条黑龙交谈
I Converse With A Black Dragon

Text.text:
“你的恶意在这片土地上留下了千年的累累伤痕。我们前来，就是要你为每一道伤口付出代价。”
“Your malice has left a millennium of scars on this land. We have come to ensure you pay for each one.”

The Sanctuary: Oasis.name:
圣所：绿洲
The Sanctuary: Oasis

Text.text:
当你沿着沙丘向绿洲下行时，潺潺水声如同温柔的抚触拂过耳畔。池岸上生长着各式各样的植物，清澈水面自中央向外扩散的涟漪昭示着下方有一处泉眼。三棵棕榈树的树荫里，一小群狐獴正站着闲聊。
The welcome sound of bubbling water caresses your ears as you descend the dunes toward the oasis. A variety of flora grow on the pond’s banks, and ripples radiating from the center of the clear water indicate a spring below. A small group of meerkats stand chatting in the shade of three palm trees.

Reactor Room With Guardian.name:
有守卫者的反应堆室
Reactor Room With Guardian

Text.text:
一阵饥渴般的噼啪爆响充斥整间屋子，源自反应堆内翻涌不息的能量。炫目的光芒自被激活的核心倾泻而出，凝成一尊雕像般的存在——由纯粹而暴烈的能量铸就。

~ 出自 PaizoConOnline 2027

A ravenous crackle suffuses the room, emanating from the roiling energy within the reactor. Blinding light spills from the energized core, taking the form of a statuesque being made of pure, volatile energy.

~ from PaizoConOnline 2027

Blutarski \"Big Blu\" Hurlmen.name:
布卢塔斯基“巨蓝”·赫尔门
Blutarski "Big Blu" Hurlmen

Text.text:
一团电蓝色的胶冻皮肤随着这名黏液裔自信的步伐一层层颤动。他那黏稠的“血肉”——如果这还能叫血肉——渗进他那身酒吧老油子般的行头里，潮湿的污痕在粉色衬衫领口绽开，从蛇皮腰带下洇出，也爬上紧身长裤的内侧大腿。他用指尖捏住头上那顶白色三角呢帽的帽檐，帽身缠着一圈丝质粉缎带。他全身闪烁着点点腮粉般的微光，下一瞬，衣物上的湿渍骤然消失。他的皮肤仍旧湛蓝，却紧致了几分，看起来不再那么像随时要从衣服里溢出来。

~ Played by jimijam with

Jellied rolls of electric-blue skin wobble with each confident step this slimekin takes. His oozy flesh—if it can be called that—seeps into his lounge-lizard attire, damp splotches blooming on his pink shirt collar, from beneath his snakeskin belt, and on the inner thighs of his tight pants. He pinches the brim of the white trilby hat perched on his head, wrapped with a silken pink ribbon. His entire form shimmers with motes of blush pink light and, suddenly, the damp stains on his clothes disappear. His skin remains blue but tightens a bit so he does not seem as likely to spill out of his outfit.

~ Played by jimijam with

这件乐器的精妙与华贵几乎难以言尽：它并非以轻敲击弦，而是以拨弦发声。自那华饰繁复、优雅弯曲并以小巧爪足收束的支腿起，到镶嵌板上细工嵌饰的一幅盛夏景致，处处皆令人屏息。两层琴键——上层为主调黑键，下层为副调白键——奏出的音色宛如四把小提琴齐奏拨弦。支撑杆将双开琴盖撑起，盖底绘着一幅细节奢丽的本地神话壁画。
The intricate sophistication of this instrument, which plucks its strings instead of striking them softly, is hard to overstate. From the ornate curving legs that end in small claw feet to the careful inlay of a summer landscape along the marquetry board, the craftsmanship is breathtaking. Two levels of keys, major black and minor white, produce a sound like a quartet of pizzicato violins. A strut holds open its two-paneled lid, a splendidly detailed mural of local mythology on the underside.

Mind Flayer Harvesting Room.name:
夺心魔收割室
Mind Flayer Harvesting Room

Text.text:
霜花沿着晶莹舱体的玻璃边缘蔓延，每一座晶质囊舱里都灌满了粘稠的绿色黏液。令人作呕的、机械般重复的脉动一次次袭来，将房间浸在紫罗兰色闪光的间歇照明中。囚徒漂浮在这些囊舱的炼狱里，头戴令人不安的异族头盔，被困在自己的意识深处。涂满黏液、湿滑腥腻的有机缆线从每个囊舱延伸出去，汇入一根巨大的中央立柱；立柱发出低沉而令人反胃的嗡鸣。
Frost rimes the glass on crystalline pods, each filled with viscous green slime. A sickening, repetitive pulse bathes the room in flashes of violet light. Prisoners float inside the purgatory of these pods, trapped in their own minds by the unsettling alien helmets they wear. Organic cables, slick with mucus, run from each pod to a large central column that emits a low, nauseating hum.

Falling Net Trap.name:
坠落网陷阱
Falling Net Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 一根细缆沿墙垂下，又没入墙体。你的目光顺着它向上追去，直到天花板——它消失在一张巨大的暗色网幕里，四角绷得紧紧的。

[触发！] 墙内骤然响起一声尖促的嗡鸣，仿佛有什么滑脱而出。伴着锈蚀的吱呀，古老的齿轮开始转动，头顶传来一阵哗啦作响。你刚抬眼，便看见那张坠着重物的网兜朝你猛然砸落。

[Perceived] A thin cable runs down the wall, and then into it. Your eyes follow it back up to the ceiling where it disappears into a large dark mesh pulled taut at four corners.

[Triggered!] There's a sudden whir as something in the wall slides free. With the creak of rust, ancient gears spin, and something rattles overhead. You glance up just in time to see the weighted net plummet toward you.

Digital Imaging Scope.name:
数码成像镜
Digital Imaging Scope

Text.text:
透过瞄准镜望去，视野里只剩一堵灰蒙蒙的墙，直到侧边的开关被拨动。随即，整个世界在镜筒中被点亮：更明、更锐，种种标记浮现其上，将注意力牵引向潜在目标，并附上几行从网络抓取来的信息。
Looking through the scope shows only a wall of gray until a switch is flipped on the side. Then the world lights up through the cylinder: brighter, sharper, and with various markers drawing attention to potential targets with a few lines of information pulled from the net.

Birdsong In The Forest.name:
森林鸟鸣
Birdsong In The Forest

Text.text:
阳光穿透头顶浓密的树冠，金色光束在振翅掠空的虹彩鸟群间闪烁游移。空气里充满了不协和的和谐，万千喉咙真挚高唱；啁啾、呼唤与尖叫在林间回荡，狂喜的热烈音符彼此争夺，又与喉间粗粝的战栗般威胁声对抗。转瞬即逝的啭鸣与尖锐而婉转的喧响争相求闻，在阴影浓重的林间空地里此起彼伏。
Sunlight penetrates the leafy canopy above, sending golden rays flickering across iridescent birds in flight. The air is filled with discordant harmony, myriad throats singing in earnest; chirps, calls, and cries echo about the trees as ecstatic notes of passion compete with guttural warbling threats. Fleeting chirrups and shrill, melodious cacophony vie to be heard among the shadow-filled glades.

Loot From An Aberration's Lair.name:
异怪巢穴的战利品
Loot From An Aberration's Lair

Text.text:
屠宰场般的恶臭污染着这头异怪的巢穴，尸体凌乱地摊在不稳地面上。尸身上垂挂着腰带与挽具，有些已腐烂，里面的物件散落一地；另一些却依旧完好：成堆的卷轴筒、药剂瓶，以及未曾失色的武器，诱人地闪烁着寒光。
An abattoir stench pollutes the aberration’s lair, with corpses sprawled haphazardly across the uneven ground. From the bodies hang belts and harnesses, some rotten, their contents littering the floor, others intact: a plethora of scroll cases, potion bottles, and untarnished weapons gleaming enticingly.

Baldal, \"The Giant Slayer\".name:
巴尔达尔，“屠巨者”
Baldal, "The Giant Slayer"

Text.text:
他的皮肤粗糙斑驳，像一幅由林木深绿与淤泥褐交织而成的挂毯。苍白的旧疤如蛛网般爬满他光秃的头顶、尖翘的龟喙、树干般的手臂，以及手脚。稀薄的衣着将这些陈年伤痕毫无遮掩——他只在一侧肩头随意绕着一条布，又穿着一条宽松长裤。这身单薄行头，再加上他缓慢而肃穆的举止，暗示着一种苦行的生活。
他身上唯一称得上财富的痕迹，是他爪中握着的战杖：杖首嵌着一枚蓝宝石，形如卷起的浪峰。海洋般幽蓝的宝石里，光影顽皮地跃动着，而这名战士的神情却依旧凝重。

~ Played by GMRoyaljeff with

His skin is a rough, mottled tapestry of forest green and silt brown. Pale scars cobweb over his bald head, his pointed turtle’s beak, his trunk-like arms, and his hands and feet. His sparse clothing lays these old wounds bare, for he wears only a bit of cloth wrapped around one shoulder and a pair of loose pants. This scant garb, as well as the slow solemnity of his bearing, suggests an ascetic lifestyle. The only hint of wealth about him is the fighting staff he holds in his claw, a sapphire shaped like a cresting wave embedded into its head. Light dances whimsically through the ocean-blue gem, even as the warrior’s expression remains grave.

~ Played by GMRoyaljeff with

I Steal From A Dragon's Hoard.name:
我从巨龙宝库里偷东西
I Steal From A Dragon's Hoard

Text.text: 宝藏到手，我小心翼翼地在成堆的钱币、兵刃与散落的碎石间择路而行。一步踏错，就得跟我那悄无声息的撤离道别。我的目光像弹珠般乱窜，耳朵绷紧捕捉每一丝声响，脚下探寻地面的震颤。没有。胜利的眩晕冲上脑门，我毫发无伤地逃了出去，带着巨龙的——不——我的宝藏！ With the treasure secured, I pick my way over piles of coins and armaments and loose stones. One false step and I can kiss my stealthy exit goodbye. My eyes carom like marbles. My ears strain to listen. I feel for vibrations in the floor. Nothing. I’m lightheaded with triumph as I escape, unscathed, with the dragon’s—no—my treasure!

Fresh Corpse Of A Commoner With Obvious.name:
带着明显伤痕的新鲜平民尸体
Fresh Corpse Of A Commoner With Obvious Trauma

Text.text:
尸体俯卧在一滩血泊中，碎肉与脏器从男人被某种东西撕开的侧腹汩汩外涌。致命一击似乎是从背后落下的，也许他正奔逃时遭到袭击。仅凭衣着看不出他的行当——只是朴素的手织粗布衣。那针脚与布纹，让你不由得想到必定有个家庭为缝制它们而辛劳。
The body lies face down in a pool of blood, gore spilling from where something tore open the man’s side. Whatever struck the killing blow seems to have hit him from behind, perhaps as he ran away. You can’t guess at his profession by his clothes, but they are simple, homespun garments. They make you wonder about the family that must have labored to make them.

Breaching The Keep With Magic.name:
用魔法攻破城堡
Breaching The Keep With Magic

Text.text:
战斗法师们已然改换战术，齐步如一，誓要终结围城。号角般的魔法一波接一波轰向厚重城墙，宛如军乐行进曲以双倍速度奏响。突袭的震荡猛击巨石，震碎灰浆，浪潮般拍打着防垒……终于，将主堡生生撬开。刺耳的碾磨轰鸣宣告崩塌，随即被入侵大军原始的嘶吼回应——他们一头扎进缺口，狂涌而入。城垛之上，惊慌的守军高喊着集结自家的施法者，更添混乱喧嚣。号角声骤然响起，旋即戛然而止。

~ Envisioned by ArtyDM

The war wizards have changed tactics, moving as one to end the siege. Wave after wave of trumpeting magic assaults the thick walls, like a military march played at double time. The surprise assault pummels stone, crumbles mortar, swells against the fortifications… and finally cracks the keep open. A grinding roar announces the collapse, answered by the primal cries of the invading army rushing headlong into the breach. Adding to the chaotic din are shouts from the battlements as panicked defenders marshal their own magic users. A horn sounds, then is abruptly silenced.

~ Envisioned by ArtyDM

Riotous Colors Of The Faerie Plane.name:
妖精位面的狂乱斑斓色彩
Riotous Colors Of The Faerie Plane

Text.text:
明亮的橙、黄、紫、绿猛然炸裂般涌入你的视野，骤然得让你一瞬间怀疑自己是不是挨了重击。可你并不觉得疼——头骨没有被震得嗡鸣，也没有温热的血把发梢浸湿，双眼更不刺痛。相反，随着色彩继续绽放，你开始看见万花筒般的纹样。那些纹样旋转着，圈子越转越慢，直到终于从你身前飘远，沉入环境之中：橙与黄压进叶片与花瓣，紫色偎入天穹，绿色沿着树干与枝叶织出脉络，也渗进你脚下的草地。
Bursts of bright oranges, yellows, purples, and greens flood your vision so suddenly you fear, for a moment, you’ve suffered a blow to the head. But you feel no pain—your skull isn’t shaken and wet with blood, your eyes do not sting. In fact, as the colors continue to bloom, you begin to see kaleidoscopic patterns. The patterns spin in slower and slower circles, until finally floating further from you and settling into the environment. The oranges and yellows press into leaves and flowers, the purples nestle into the sky, and the greens vein trees and the grass beneath your feet.

I Cast Countercharm.name:
我施放「反魅惑」
I Cast Countercharm

Text.text:
我在脑海中勾勒出每位朋友心弦的模样，随即在鲁特琴上即兴拨出一段轻快的旋律，并将守护之力的词句织入其中。魔法的音符自琴弦震颤而出，穿过空气，直抵每一颗心。那乐声与共振如同稳固的臂膀，托起每个友善灵魂的自信与勇气。
Picturing each of my friends’ heartstrings, I improvise a lively tune on my lute. I weave in words of protective power. Magical music vibrates from the strings, through the air, and into each heart. The music, the vibration, bolsters every friendly soul’s confidence and courage.

这道人形身影足有七英尺高，双眼如熔金之池般深邃灼亮。银白的长发垂过肩头，一对弯曲的金色犄角自颅顶隆起。耀目的金鳞裹覆着这生物的肩背与双手，没入那身以金边勾勒的黑红长袍之下，袍摆披垂在他魁梧的身躯上。最引人注目的，是一对薄膜之翼、拖曳的尾巴，以及另一套骨节分明的额外手臂——这些都泄露了这生物的巨龙传承。

~ 由 Cassanir 扮演

The humanoid figure stands seven feet tall, with eyes like pools of molten gold. His hair, silvery white, hangs past his shoulders, and a pair of curved golden horns crest his skull. Gleaming golden scales enshroud the creature’s shoulders, back, and hands, disappearing within the gold-trimmed black-and-red robes draping his large frame. Most notably, a pair of membranous wings, a trailing tail, and an additional set of skeletal arms betray the creature’s draconic heritage.

~ Played by Cassanir

Lenticularis Clouds In The Sky.name:
天空中的荚状云
Lenticularis Clouds In The Sky

Text.text:
你几乎忍不住惊叹：一团形状古怪的云压在天际线上方，它圆润如镜片，仿佛某位栖天的神祇用来细细检视大地，让每一处纹理都清晰得令人心悸。
You can scarcely help but marvel at the oddly shaped cloud overshadowing the skyline, its round shape resembling a lens that a sky-bound god might use to examine the landscape in sharp detail.

他举手投足间带着妖精般的风度，却又透着一股可疑的阴影——额头上突出的尖角更让这份气息显得森冷骇人。他的肌肤如雪白的缟玛瑙般细腻苍白；探险装束背后伸展出的双翼则是皮膜覆骨，像蝙蝠，又像幼龙。对盟友他友善而温和，却把大量的时间耗在林间，徘徊于社会边缘的阴影之侧。白金色的头发、湛蓝的眼睛，他身形仅两英尺高，却足以令人沉醉。

~ 由 Malfoy Khao 扮演

He has the bearing of the fae, and a suspicious air made all the more menacing by the pointed horns jutting from his forehead. His skin is as smooth and pale as alabaster, while the wings protruding from the back of his explorer garb are stretched skin over bone, like a bat or dragon. He is friendly and kind to his allies, but spends much of his time in the woods, at the shadow-edge of society. Platinum haired and blue eyed, he is an enchanting two feet tall.

~ Played by Malfoy Khao

Magical Eye Drops, Nightwatch.name:
魔法眼药水·夜巡
Magical Eye Drops, Nightwatch

Text.text:
瓶口的黑色锥形瓶盖上有一道道凸脊，握持牢靠，便于拧开。透明的柔韧塑料瓶里盛着深色液体，轻轻摇动时，便泛起层层生物荧光的波纹。标签上写着品牌名 Nightwatch，并标注内容物为夜视滴剂。在其他信息之中，一条加粗警告格外醒目：切勿让使用者暴露在明亮光照之下。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Ridges make the black conical top of this bottle easy to grip for opening. The clear, soft plastic bottle holds a dark liquid that glows with waves of bioluminescence when agitated. A label announces the brand name Nightwatch, and the contents as Nightvision Drops. Standing out among the other info is a bold warning against users being exposed to bright light.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Channel Divinity: Twilight Sanctuary.name:
引导神力：暮光圣域
Channel Divinity: Twilight Sanctuary

Text.text:
“暮光的族母啊，用你的护佑将忠信之人挡在黑暗之外。愿你目光稍纵即逝的暖意使我们重归完整，也让我们免于夜色攫握的利爪。”

~ 由 Kris Essler 构想

“Matriarch of twilight, shield your faithful from darkness. Make us whole in the fleeting warmth of your gaze and keep us from the grasping talons of night.”

~ Envisioned by Kris Essler

Zombie With A Hint Of Her Former Life.name:
带着一丝前世痕迹的丧尸（特征）
Zombie With A Hint Of Her Former Life

Text.text:
腐烂的血肉当然令人作呕，那踉跄的步态也让人反胃。还有那诡异的偏头动作，像好奇的狗，或是小鸟忽然一抖竖起耳朵去听——可怖，没错。可最糟的，是你忍不住去想象这东西也许更复杂，你多么渴望能从中看见一点残存的性情；因为它正穿着某个女人的衣服——她曾亲吻过自己的丈夫，加班到深夜，走回家时离墓园太近了。
The rotting flesh is certainly repulsive, and the shamble off-putting. That strange turn of the head, like a curious dog or a bird twitching to listen—that’s horrible, yes. But the worst is how you imagine this thing to be more complicated, how much you want to see some remainder of personality; because it’s wearing the clothing of someone who kissed her husband, worked late, walked home too close to the graveyard.

City Square With Gallows.name:
带绞刑架的城市广场
City Square With Gallows

Text.text:
一座宏伟的喷泉统治着这片铺着鹅卵石的广场。某位名震一方的领袖以骑马冲锋的雕像姿态定格其上，周围却荒诞地簇拥着几条巨大、泛着铜绿的鱼，张口喷吐水柱。尽管它气势逼人，四周店铺的招牌也漆得鲜艳夺目，你的目光却总是不由自主地飘向广场边缘——那里竖着一座巨大而且显然经常使用的绞刑架。八个人可以同时被吊起，彼此永不相触，只能在绳索尽头挣扎抽搐。
A great fountain dominates this cobbled square. Some famed leader charges on horseback in statue form, incongruously surrounded by huge copper-green fish spewing water. Despite its dominance and the gaily painted signs of surrounding shops, your eyes keep flicking to a large and clearly well-used gallows standing on the edge of the square. Eight people could be hung at once, never touching one another as they thrash at the ends of their ropes.

Loot From A Plump Goblin.name:
从一只胖墩墩的地精身上搜出的战利品
Loot From A Plump Goblin

Text.text:
在粗陋的铁制炊具与歪斜的陶罐之间，这名地精美食家的负鼠皮背包里有几样东西格外扎眼。紧挨着他那把巨大的厨用斩刀——刀刃上还沾着褐色斑渍——放着一只小小的瓶子，里面是清澈、凝胶般的液体，封存着一片闪耀的银色碎片——一瓶锐锋油。瓶中仅余一次用量，只够涂抹在一件小型武器上。背包的深处还塞着一枚金色指环，藏在一口铁锅之下，远离贪婪的视线。指环被打造成两股火焰缠绕指间的模样，火舌末端化作两只交握的手——一枚燃烧之手戒指。
Amid the crude iron utensils and lopsided crockery, a couple items stand out from the possum-hide pack of this goblin gourmet. Next to his large chef’s cleaver—the edge stained with brown splotches—he kept a tiny bottle of clear, gelatinous fluid with one shard of gleaming silver within—an oil of sharpness. There is only enough left for a single use on a small weapon. A gold band had been stowed deep within the pack’s pockets, underneath an iron pot and far from greedy eyes. The band is crafted to resemble two gouts of flame wrapping around the wearer’s finger, the ends of which are hands clasping together—a ring of burning hands.

温室八角形中心摆放着许多花卉与植物，被逐一标记以供研究。它们既美丽又陈设得体——色彩与地面那幅新艺术风格画作中的花朵相互映衬——这片收藏同样堪称科学奇观。画作在此铺展开一片花瓣，呈现出数种深浅不一的粉色。
The arrangement of many flowers and plants at the octagonal center of the greenhouse is labeled for research. While beautiful and tastefully arranged—using colors that complement the flower of the art nouveau painting on the floor—the collection is also a wonder of science. The painting displays a spread of petals here, in several shades of pink.

Allinar Gorgonrider.name:
阿利纳·戈尔贡骑士
Allinar Gorgonrider

Text.text:
阿利纳身形高大、肌肉结实，银发蓝眼——常年白昼披着护甲奔忙，皮肤显得苍白——满身都是狰狞的疤痕。这个严肃的少年出身殷实之家，却投身军旅，服役八年，同时为法官席位苦读。他经历的战斗在他身上刻下伤痕，也把他磨得更精于算计、更冷硬。如今他披着全身板甲，佩着一柄燃焰且夺命汲生的长剑，身上还压着一把战锤与几柄小型投掷锤，比起律法更渴求更多的冒险。

~ Played by Storyteller

Allinar is tall and well-muscled, silver haired and blue eyed—pale from long daylight hours in armor—and heavily scarred. A serious boy who grew up in a comfortable family, he joined the military and served eight years while studying for the bench. The battles he fought scarred his body and made him more calculating, harder. Now he finds himself in full plate, fit with a longsword of fire and life-stealing, weighed down with a warhammer and small throwing hammers, seeking more adventure than law.

~ Played by Storyteller

你踉跄闯入一片被搏杀撕裂的空地，眼前的掠食者正沉浸在一场骇人的饕餮盛宴中。那头蜥蜴巨兽庞然的身躯伏低在强健的后肢上，利齿长过你的手臂，正撕扯着猎物的血肉。它那退化的前肢无力地耷拉着，徒然扑向那些它永远触及不到的肉块。
You stumble upon a clearing scarred by struggle, finding a predator in the midst of a ghastly feast. The saurian’s massive form hunches down on powerful hind legs to tear into its prey with teeth longer than your arm. The beast’s vestigial arms flop impotently toward the meat they cannot reach.

断线钳、一面小镜子、几根开锁针，还有一把钳子。干这行的家伙几百年来用的都是同一套家伙什，而如今的锁具在物理防护上竟仍如此薄弱，实在令人意外。
Wire cutters, a small mirror, a few lockpicks, and pliers. The tools of the trade have been the same for centuries, and it's surprising how little physical defense the locks of today have.

这生物宛如一条黏稠的蛇，从死水潭里缓缓钻出；修长扭动的躯体淌着浓重的团块，啪嗒落在石面上。它的形体一阵阵起伏翻涌，仿佛永远处于流变与失衡之中；令人作呕的咕嘟声随之响起，像沼泽厚泥里逸出的气泡。

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Resembling a viscous snake, the creature emerges from the stagnant pool, its long, writhing body dripping thick globules onto the stone. The form ripples, as if in a constant state of flux and disharmony, accompanied by a nauseating bubbling, like gas escaping the thick mud of a swamp.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

他裹着磨破污秽的衣衫，死死攥着仅存的那点家当。难民的眼神无声却刺痛人心，诉说着亲眼目睹的骇人惨剧与至亲离散的伤痛。他的脸布满褶皱、写尽风霜，因数周几近无眠而早早显出衰老的年代——梦境世界也无法赐予片刻解脱，他那被折磨的记忆从不肯松手。

~ Envisioned by dima0024

Clad in worn and dirty clothing and clutching what few possessions he still retains, the refugee’s eyes tell a silent but poignant tale of horrors witnessed and loved ones lost. His face, creased and careworn, droops with premature age thanks to weeks of nearly sleepless nights—the world of dreams offers no surcease to his tortured memories.

~ Envisioned by dima0024

一支幽灵般的乐团以凄婉哀伤的挽歌灌满华丽殿堂；戴着面具的身影——披暗色丝绸与天鹅绒——在厅中旋舞徘徊，举手投足与乐声的节拍严丝合缝。带香的熏香在异样冰冷的空气里轻柔蜿蜒，摇曳的火把将诡谲的影子投在墙上那一幅幅精致肖像之上。你凝望间，有些狂欢者从舞池边悄然离开，自考究的长袍中取出上等酒杯，俯身从一只鎏金大碗里痛饮那黏稠、深红的液体。
A spectral orchestra fills the ornate hall with a haunting, melancholy dirge as masked figures—clad in dark silks and velvet—swirl and dance across the room, their graceful movements perfectly in time with the music. Perfumed incense meanders delicately through the unnaturally chill air, and flickering torches cast eerie shadows across the exquisite portraits adorning the walls. As you watch, some of the revelers move away from the dancefloor, produce fine goblets from elegant robes, and drink deeply from a gilded bowl of thick, red liquid.

Desert Valley Ruins.name:
沙谷遗迹
Desert Valley Ruins

Text.text:
一片远古遗迹的倾颓残石仍顽强地抵御着干燥的狂风与压迫般的烈日，历经万古的冲刷，石面褪成惨白如骨。原本的建筑几乎不存，然而在你的脑海中，它已悄然复原——高耸的石柱直刺天穹，中央的巨石主构巍然矗立。
The toppled stones of an ancient ruin stand resilient against the arid wind and oppressive sun, the stone bleached bone-white after eons. Little remains of the original structure, though in your mind you can imagine a reconstruction of the soaring pillars and central monolithic structure.

Confluence Of Two Streams.name:
两股溪流的汇合处
Confluence Of Two Streams

Text.text:
两条溪流在此汇合：一条自西北而来，另一条自东北而下。它们在大地上蜿蜒前行——跨越数十里，穿过各式各样的地形——一路逼近，仿佛随时都要相遇；直到终于在此交织合一，汇成一条奔涌的壮阔水道，向着大海流去。
Two streams meet here, one flowing from the northwest, the other from the northeast. They wind their way across the landscape—across many leagues and terrain of all sorts—threatening to meet, until at last they combine to form a single mighty channel that flows toward the sea.

Boreal Forest Firs And Aspens.name:
北境针阔混交林：冷杉与白杨
Boreal Forest Firs And Aspens

Text.text:
纤细的白杨披着银色树皮与金黄叶冠，与它们同处一林的冷杉截然不同——冷杉如枪矛般直立，其间一片深绿。它们虽不相似，却恰好相配。白杨天生能缓冲火势，火焰常常威胁着脆弱的冷杉。若灾害降临林地，白杨也会最先复苏：在泥土深处，它们的根系彼此相连，能迅速让森林重焕生机……好让冷杉得以再度挺立。
The slender aspens, clad in silver bark and golden foliage, could not be more different from the fir trees they share the forest with, which stand spear-like and dark green among them. Unalike though they may be, they are well-matched. The aspens are natural buffers against fire, which often threatens the vulnerable firs.
