And should disaster strike the forest, the aspens will revive first, for deep beneath the soil, the aspens share their roots and are able to renew the forest rapidly… so that the firs might rise again.

阴影屈从于你的意志，自结晶的泪滴中流淌而出，凝聚成一具畸形的双足之躯。法术所过之处，温暖与光明尽数退散，将区域笼罩在冰冷、饥渴的黑暗里，随着那生物缓缓现身……
Shadows bend to your will, flowing from the crystallized tears and coalescing into a misshapen, bipedal form. Warmth and light flee in the wake of the spell, blanketing the area in a cold, hungering darkness as the creature emerges…

Loot From A Puppeteer Hag.name:
来自操偶鬼婆的战利品
Loot From A Puppeteer Hag

Text.text:
鬼婆的草药袋——用一种可疑的皮革缝成，表面稀稀拉拉地簇着几撮毛发——里头藏着几样小宝贝：一颗苍白的玛瑙，深绿的纹路如蛛网般在表面蔓延，看似毫无魔法，却依旧美得让人移不开眼；一瓶装着胭粉色液体的药水，盛在心形瓶中；以及一枚缠着银色丝线的纺锤，那线细若蛛丝，即便不在鬼婆的影响之下也仍旧微微闪烁。
The hag’s herb pouch—crafted of a dubious leather tufted with sparse patches of hair—holds a few treasures: a pale agate with deep green lines spidering across its surface, seemingly magic-less but still beautiful to behold; a potion of blush pink liquid in a heart-shaped bottle; and a spindle of silvery, web-thin thread, still shimmering in the absence of the hag's influence.

God Of Treachery.name:
背叛之神
God Of Treachery

Text.text:
若你看见一名祭司，眼中写满贪婪，唇上却宣讲任性的暴怒；或看见一名士兵掉队在后，抱怨她的军饷与命数——当心，背叛就在附近。这位神钟爱伪善的谦卑：好比一个守卫，爽快放你进一处他永远不会踏足之地；又如一名队长，将她的连队送入覆灭，且只让他们去死。他五官锋利，目光锐利，嘴角挂着机巧的冷笑，身姿带着趁势而动的算计。背叛眼中的凡人，不过是供他汲血的源头。
If you see a priest whose eyes tell the story of avarice and whose lips preach arbitrary wrath, or a soldier falling behind and complaining of her pay and lot, beware the presence of Treachery. This god loves false humility, like a guard who freely admits you into a place he will never go, or a captain who sends her company to their doom and only theirs. He is sharp-featured, keen-eyed, with a clever smirk and an opportunistic posture. Treachery sees mortals as little more than a blood source.

强盗的眼里翻涌着野兽般的恐惧——一名高大健壮的圣武士正一步步逼近，他确信自己的命已到尽头。可致命一击并未落下。相反，这位神圣战士在他身旁跪下，双手摊开，掌心泛起柔和而慈悲的光。那双淡灰色的眼睛如深邃静谧的水潭，映着恩典的光辉；圣武士将手覆在强盗血淋淋的腹部上，带着安抚人心的微笑。强盗微微放松，只觉神圣的暖意在体内流淌，他被这个陌生人的仁慈击中。沐在光环的剪影里，他看清了自己的救命恩人：一位留着胡须的半精灵，褐色皮肤上点着雀斑，乌黑亮泽的头发间夹杂着灰白的发丝。 “赎回你自己，我的朋友。用更好地活下去，来偿还我在此对你施予的善意。” 他将一只沉甸甸的钱袋塞进这名目瞪口呆的罪犯手里，笑意温暖得几乎可与太阳相抗衡。

~ Played by a Hero with

The bandit’s eyes are wild with fear as a tall, muscular paladin walks toward them, and they are certain their life has come to its end. Yet the fatal blow does not come. Instead, the holy warrior kneels beside them, his hands open and glowing softly with benevolent light. Soft gray eyes, like deep and tranquil pools, shine with grace as the paladin lays his hands on the bandit’s bloody abdomen, smiling reassuringly. Relaxing slightly, the bandit feels the divine warmth flow through them, and they are struck by the stranger’s kindness. Silhouetted in a halo of light, they see their savior, a bearded half-elf with freckled brown skin and lustrous black hair peppered with streaks of gray and white. “Redeem yourself, my friend. Pay back the kindness I have shown you here by living a better life.” He presses a weighty purse into the hands of the dumbstruck criminal and smiles with warmth to rival the sun.

~ Played by a Hero with

Joust In The Chill Of Spring.name:
春寒里的马上比武
Joust In The Chill Of Spring

Text.text:
尽管天空万里无云，这一天仍寒意沁人。少女们戴着手套的双手紧攥花环，披甲裹钢的勇士在草地赛场上轰然驰骋，蹄声翻卷，踏碎野花成簇；坐骑与骑手的吐息一同喷涌成白雾。半空的看台上掌声骤起——木屑迸裂，盾牌震颤，泰岳般的撞击将清冷的春日空气击得粉碎。
Despite the cloudless sky, the day is chill. Maidens clasp garlands in gloved hands as steel-sheathed champions thunder across the grassy list, hooves churning up clumps of wildflowers, breath billowing from mount and rider both. Applause erupts from half-empty stands as wood splinters, shields shiver, and titanic impacts shatter the cool spring air.

你的视线一阵模糊，头也开始发晕。你担心自己会昏厥过去，可就在那一刻，目光与思绪又骤然清明——与此同时，你的形体却摇曳不定，倏然消散，化作一缕薄雾。你的身体短暂地仍保有原本的色彩；可当你抬起手，惊异地端详时，色泽便如潮水般褪去，只剩苍白。你的四肢随风飘散。你已经成为一朵云。
Your vision blurs and you feel lightheaded. You worry you might lose consciousness, but then your sight and your head clear even as your form wavers and vanishes, transforming into mist. Your body briefly retains its colors, but as you raise your hand to look at it in wonder, the hues drain away to white and your limbs drift away on the air. You have become a cloud.

一枚飞掠而过的弹体搅动空气，拂得你后颈的汗毛一阵发痒——那一发几乎擦身而过。闪亮的黑色弩矢仍在不断飞来，以令人心惊的速度撕裂空气，尖啸不止。你冒险回头瞥了一眼，终于看清了射手：一头巨大而畸形的生物，苍白的皮肤仿佛胀起的尸体，一对弯曲狞恶的长牙拱起，框住那张满口利齿的血盆大口。那恶魔猎手骷髅般的面容扭成冷笑，魔鬼装上一支新弩矢，将弩机稳稳指向你。你知道，它不会停下。
The displaced air of a passing projectile tickles the hairs on the back of your neck—that one barely missed. The shining, black bolts continue to fly, whistling through the air with unnerving speed. You hazard a glance over your shoulder and spy the shooter: a massive, misshapen creature with pallid skin—like a bloated corpse—and a wicked pair of sweeping tusks framing a toothy maw. The skull-like visage of the fiendish hunter twists into a sneer as the devil loads a fresh bolt and brings the crossbow to bear. You know it will not stop.

Staff Of Withering.name:
枯萎法杖
Staff Of Withering

Text.text:
这根又长又嶙峋的法杖由一团纠结缠绕的根系构成，末端是一只伸开的手，枯槁的手指仿佛正攫住虚空。
The long, gnarled staff, constructed from a mass of intertwined roots, ends in an outstretched hand with withered fingers—which seem to be grasping the air.

Gala In The Royal Ballroom.name:
皇家舞厅的盛大舞会
Gala In The Royal Ballroom

Text.text:
乐师们在统治家族抵达这场奢华盛会之前便已提前为乐器调好音。通往舞厅的入口长廊一侧排着长队：军政要员穿着浆得笔挺的最佳团礼服，异国使节披挂着别具一格的服饰，富裕的贵族与大地主以各自的华装盛饰登场，宫廷仕女则身着最耀眼、最昂贵的礼裙。人人都屏息以待，盼望能被君王点名垂青。每一只高脚杯与每一件银器都被擦得如镜面般锃亮，每名仆从都挺立待命，随时听候差遣；而后厨与侍者们正准备将无穷无尽的精致小点与美酒，源源不断地奉给出席这场在宽阔而华丽的皇家舞厅中举行的盛宴的宾客。
Performers tune their instruments in advance of the ruling family’s arrival at this posh affair. Along the entrance hall to the ballroom is a line made up of military officials—starched in their best regimental dress—foreign ambassadors clad in idiosyncratic fashions, rich nobles and landowners in their own finery, and the ladies of the court in their most resplendent and expensive gowns. Each waits in anticipation, hoping to be singled out for favor by their monarchs. Every goblet and piece of silverware has been polished to a mirror sheen, every servant stands ready to attend at a second’s notice, and the kitchen and wait staff prepare to dole out endless hors d’oeuvres and drinks to those attending the gala hosted within the cavernous but ornate royal ballroom.

小丑贴着王座厅的边缘站着，耐心等候主人的召唤。尽管那身衣服花里胡哨、褶边累赘得过分，他们却仍勉强维持着几分体面。几样行当家伙摆在触及可及之处：一把鲁特琴、一套杂耍球，还有一根像是孩子臆想中“魔法杖”该有模样的棍子。你们短暂对上视线，那艺人的脸顿时裂开成一抹癫狂的笑，同时夸张地挥手致意。也许……终究谈不上体面。
The jester stands along the edges of the throne room, patiently awaiting their master's call. They manage to look somewhat dignified despite the gaudy colors and gratuitous frills of their outfit. Several tools of the trade lie in quick reach: a lute, a set of juggling balls, and a child's idea of what a magic wand looks like. You make brief eye contact, and the entertainer's face splits into a manic grin as they offer an exaggerated wave. Maybe not so dignified after all.

Elemental Plane Of Water.name:
水元素位面
Elemental Plane Of Water

Text.text:
大海没有海底，也没有海面。它无穷无尽，笼罩在上方、下方与四周——一片无边的海洋，其洋流唯有被巨大的礁群与蔓延铺展的海草丛打断。你感到失重、茫然，不知何处为上、何处为下。昏暗光照仿佛从海水本身透出，也来自那些发光的浮游生物，它们如漂移的云团般在深处缓缓游荡。
The sea has no bottom, and no surface. It is infinite, looming above, below, and all around—an endless expanse of ocean, its currents broken only by massive reefs and sprawls of sea grasses. You feel weightless, aimless, unsure which way is up and which is down. The dim light seems to emanate from the water itself, and from the luminescent plankton floating like drifting clouds through its depths.

God Of Music.name:
音乐之神
God Of Music

Text.text:
一头乱发、四肢瘦劲，这位神祇每一次呼吸都像在登台演出。每日皆为一部歌的汇编：熟曲成套，又夹杂即兴的灵感。那件剪裁入时的礼服外套垂着双尾，随着他指挥的动作在身后摆荡。他将指挥棒指向诸界，遥遥对准四方的演奏者，为他们注入灵感。他在空气中刻写乐章，音符如烟般消散，却最先在乐手的脑海里成形：继而落入恋人与军队的耳中；传到乐队与管弦；传到哼唱的保姆与练习音阶的孩子。只消一段歌词的回转、一串和弦的推进、一支穿越岁月仍被记起的旋律，世间一切情绪皆可由他点燃。
Wild-haired and wiry-limbed, this god is a performance with his every breath. Every day is a compilation of songs, a repertoire of standards mixed with improvisations. The twin tails of his formal coat, fashionably cut, swing behind him as he conducts. He keeps his baton aimed through the planes to players everywhere, inspiring them. He inscribes compositions on the air, the notes disappearing like smoke, first to appear in the minds of musicians: then to the ears of lovers and armies; bands and orchestras; humming nurse-maids and children learning scales. Every emotion is his to ignite with the turn of a verse, a chord progression, a melody remembered through the ages.

Haunted House: Upper Hall.name:
闹鬼宅邸：上层走廊
Haunted House: Upper Hall

Text.text:
一张巨大如海的血红地毯，缀着华丽的滚边，横贯这座上层大厅的全长，将视线牵引向一扇庞大而繁复的铅框花窗。花窗将夜空中的满月完整框入其中，然而你清楚，从这个角度本不该看见月亮。平台两侧分出数条走廊，每一条都吐出尖啸般的风声。
An enormous, blood-red carpet with decorated trim transverses the length of this upper hall, drawing one’s gaze to a massive and intricate leaded window. It encompasses the full moon in the night sky, though you are aware that from this view the moon should not be visible. Corridors branch off of the landing, a whistling wind emerging from each.

Prince Of Revelry In His Faerie Court.name:
妖精宫廷中的狂欢王子
Prince Of Revelry In His Faerie Court

Text.text:
他摊在橡木王座上，像晒太阳的猫般慵懒；王子俯瞰着林间空地里那群喧闹的侍从，他们正大快朵颐。他那覆着毛的手掌搭在圆滚滚的肚腹上，一只蹄子随着脑海里的旋律轻轻点拍。人群里有人指了过来。“弹一曲吧，我的殿下！”一名精灵男子喊道，银露点点，映得他的发丝璀璨。一个矮人女人踉跄着爬上台阶，手里抱着鲁特琴，胡须编成辫子，缀着红天竺葵。王子接过琴，在她脸颊上啄了一吻。他先拨了几声试音，随即一跃而起。琴弦被他狂乱扫响，眼神因醇醉的欢愉而发亮。王庭众人的嗓音汇成一片欢呼，脚步砰然齐落，踏起一场杂乱无章的舞。
Splayed across his oaken throne like a sunning cat, the prince observes his rambunctious coterie as they feast in the glade. His furred hand rests on his plump belly, and he bobs one hoof in time to a song in his head. Someone from the crowd points. “Play, my lord!” calls an elven man, his locks dazzled with silver dew. A dwarf woman, beard braided with red geranium, stumbles up onto the dais with lute in hand. The prince takes it and pecks a kiss on her cheek. He strums a few practice notes, then leaps to his feet. He strums wildly, eyes glazed with heady joy. The voices of his court rise in collective cheer as they begin a stomping, disorderly dance.

一条厚重的锈链缠住那扇宽阔木制双开门的把手——门同样被腐蚀得斑驳不堪，通往地下。两把同样锈透的挂锁将铁链扣得死紧。门口又用钉子——全都弯折或歪斜地钉入——把三块较新的木板横钉其上。每一块木板在跨过两扇门的接缝处都开裂、崩起尖刺般的木屑。
A thick, rusty chain wraps the equally corroded handles of a broad wooden double-door that leads underground. Two padlocks, also rusted, keep the chain tight. Nails, all bent or driven crooked, hold three planks of newer wood across the doorway. Each board is cracked and splintered where it crosses the seam between the two doors.

Cemetery In Bright Sunshine.name:
阳光明媚的墓园
Cemetery In Bright Sunshine

Text.text:
墓地一片寂静，灿烂的阳光轻抚着龟裂的墓碑；野草疯长，映出多年荒废的痕迹。在这样的地方，隔绝两界的帷幕薄如蝉翼，或许有亡灵守望着自己的遗骨。曾经华美的陵寝投下繁复的阴影，可即便头顶那轮炽烈的光球，也无法穿透它们蒙尘的秘密。
The burial ground lies silent, the radiant sunshine caressing cracked gravestones overgrown with weeds revealing years of neglect. The shroud between worlds is thin in such places, where spirits perhaps watch over their bones. Once-ornate tombs cast elaborate shadows, but even the blazing orb above cannot penetrate their beclouded secrets.

I Hide In A Suit Of Armor.name:
我躲进一套护甲里
I Hide In A Suit Of Armor

Text.text:
毫无疑问——这里挤得要命。紧张的汗臭在金属内壁间锐利反弹，在我口中留下酸涩的滋味，刺得眼睛发烫，喉头也微微发痒。但我强迫自己镇定下来，像身上的护甲一样铁硬。我浅浅呼吸，纹丝不动——任何细小的抽动，都可能震响这层伪装。
No doubt about it—this is a tight squeeze. The pungent smell of stress-sweat bounces keenly off the metallic interior of the hiding spot, leaving a tangy sensation in my mouth, a burning in my eyes, and a slight tickle in my throat. But I steel myself, becoming as iron-clad as the armor around me. I breathe shallow breaths and hold steady, for any minor twitch could rattle this guise.

Cleric With Lantern.name:
提灯的牧师
Cleric With Lantern

Text.text:
牧师戴着锁子头巾，布罩袍下穿着护甲，提着一盏灯笼，在黑暗中泛着金色光辉。他们向前迈步，腰身微转，仿佛听见了什么动静。一只手握着战锤，背上挂着圆盾。他们已整装待战。
In a chainmail coif and with armor under a cloth tabard, the cleric carries a lantern glowing golden in the dark. They walk forward, turned at the waist as if hearing something. In one hand is a hammer, and on the cleric’s back is a round shield. They are ready for a fight.

Burn So Bright.name:
燃烧得如此炽烈
Burn So Bright

Text.text:
一阵低笑在海妖的喉间回荡，像炉火在炉栅上舔舐时发出的闷雷。她脸上满溢着恶毒的期待——擦亮的铜色肌肤泛着微光，榛色眼眸里灼着金色碎屑。她抬起双手作出祈求般的姿态，房间里所有蜡烛瞬间熄灭。她又在彻底的黑暗中笑了起来，那笑声如丝绸拂过赤裸的肌肤般漫过你。她的眼睛骤然爆燃，亮起并燃烧着妖异的绿色火焰。

~ 出自精彩的 TTRPG 增补 The Vineyard

A chuckle bounces around the Siren’s throat, a sound like the rumble of a fire licking at its grate. Her face brims with wicked anticipation—skin of burnished copper aglow, hazel eyes seared with flecks of gold. She raises her hands in a supplicative gesture and all the candles of the room snuff out. She laughs again in the pitch darkness, the sound washing over you like silk over bare skin. Her eyes suddenly flare, alight and burning with lurid green flame.

~ Found in the amazing TTRPG supplement The Vineyard

施法者神情凝神，皮肤开始不受控地抽搐。他们正在蜕变，化作更高层次的存在。四肢在变化中剧烈颤动，骨骼吱呀作响，肌腱扭转重塑，编织成由魔力锻铸的全新形态。
A look of concentration grips the caster as their skin begins to twitch. They are morphing, becoming something more. Their limbs shudder with the changing, bones creaking and tendons twisting into new magically wrought shapes.

你踏入店内时，一声清脆的叮铃骤然响起，可门边却不见半枚铃铛。看来你触发了一个警报法术。“马上就来！”一道粗哑的嗓音从帘幕后的门口传来，紧接着是陶器碎裂的脆响与连绵不绝的咒骂。店里堆满各式各样的零碎物件——护甲、武器、工具、家具、乐器、衣物——无一不是旧货。
A chime rings out as you enter this shop, but no bell hangs near the door. It seems you triggered an alarm spell. “With you in a moment!” A gruff voice calls out from behind a curtained doorway, followed by the sound of pottery breaking and profuse cursing. Odds and ends fill the shop—armor, weapons, tools, furniture, musical instruments, clothing—all of it used.

Glimpse Of A Young False Hydra.name:
一瞥幼年伪九头蛇
Glimpse Of A Young False Hydra

Text.text:
你走过一面椭圆形的穿衣镜，银色镜框以奇巧的金丝镂纹盘绕成浪潮聚拢的姿态。略显黯淡的镜面如常映出世界，细小的黑斑点点，撒在其上。你本能地一顿——有什么一闪而过，或者说——在倒影之中？——一支幻影般的合唱：长长的、血肉质地的脖颈上，一颗颗咬合不止的头颅齐齐攒动。转瞬即逝。镜面的锈蚀纹路竟与那幅你自以为看见的景象隐约相似……也许你该从旅途里多挤出些 休息，免得想象先一步把你吞没。

~ 构想：Steve Adamski

You pass a looking glass, oval in shape, its silver frame a whimsical work of filigree that recalls the gathering of waves. You see the world reflected as expected in the slightly tarnished glass, small dark spots peppering its surface. You pause instinctively as something flashes by—or within?—the reflection: a phantasmal chorus of gnashing heads on long, fleshy necks. Then they’re gone. The pattern of the tarnish holds some resemblance to the image you think you saw… Perhaps you’re due for further rest from your journeying, lest your imagination get the better of you.

~ Envisioned by Steve Adamski

Gala: Discreet Conversation.name:
晚宴：私密交谈
Gala: Discreet Conversation

Text.text:
像这样的晚宴是一片战场：令人目眩的舞步与锋利的唇枪舌剑交织。财富在此得失翻覆——人生或被抬举，或被毁掉——全凭机智与身份的微妙分寸，被当作武器挥舞。你穿过人潮，想逃离这片主竞技场，寻到一处更安静的角落；可当你看清那里的人，又想起：最危险的，往往是背巷。
Galas such as this are a battlefield: dizzying dances mixed with cutting repartee. Fortunes are made and lost—lives elevated or ruined—based on subtleties of wit and status wielded as a weapon. Slipping through the crowd to escape its main arena, you find a quieter corner, but when you see the people there, it reminds you that back alleys can be the most dangerous.

沸水自下方的盆地喷涌而起，化作滚烫的蒸汽洪流直冲天空；每一道水柱都伴着震耳欲聋的轰鸣，大地在原始的暴怒中剧烈颤抖。潮湿的空气里弥漫着硫磺的刺鼻气息，泛黄的矿物如地衣般铺毯似的覆在间歇泉周围的岩石上。蒸汽喷口旁散落着被漂白的枯骨，冷酷地警告着那些妄图抄近路穿越盆地的粗心旅人。
Boiling water cascades into the air in steaming torrents from the basin below, each jet accompanied by a deafening roar as the ground shakes with primal fury. The humid air has a sulfurous tang, and the yellow mineral coats the rocks around the geysers like a carpet of lichen. Bleached bones scattered around the steam vents serve as a grim warning to careless travelers who would risk a shortcut through the basin.

Spell Scroll (Generic).name:
法术卷轴（通用）
Spell Scroll (Generic)

Text.text:
磨损泛黄的羊皮纸散发着古老图书馆的气息，怪异的符号像令人发狂的谜题般铺满整页。卷轴边缘以精巧的花卉花环勾勒，即便历经年代，仍有金箔碎屑在其间闪烁。
The worn, yellowed parchment smells like an ancient library, and strange symbols cover the page like a maddening puzzle. The scroll is bordered by delicate floral wreaths, which shimmer with flakes of gold leaf despite its age.

你锁定你的目标，专注化作一枚锐利的灵能尖桩。你做出挥拳如锤的姿态，将尖桩猛然钉入。你的敌人或许会逃跑，但这道在他们脑海中炽亮燃起的灵能信标，会让他们无处遁形。
You pinpoint your target, and your focus manifests as a sharpened stake of psychic energy. You pantomime swinging your fist like a hammer, driving the stake home. Your foe might run, but with this psychic beacon flaring in their mind, they will not be able to hide.

那绳索起初静止不动，仿佛毫无生气。可紧接着，它猛地一颤——像蛇般自行舒卷——腾空而起，垂直悬在地面之上，仿佛从某个无形的结构上吊落下来。你伸手拽了拽绳索，发现它牢固可靠，能够承重。
The rope seems still, inanimate at first. But then it shudders and—uncoiling itself like a serpent—rises into the air to hang perpendicular to the ground, as if dangling from an invisible structure. Tugging on the rope, you find it secure, and weight-bearing.

而今你的双眼已然死去，对周遭的一切麻木无感。恐惧与绝望叩击着你心灵的门扉。你惶惶不安，不知自己还要在这双目洞开的黑暗牢室里困住多久。你只能倾听，品味空气的味道，并以接触去确认那柄与你相伴的魔宠武器——在这忽然变得陌生的世界里。
And now your eyes have died, insensate to the world around you. Fear and desperation knock on the door of your mind. You dread how long you might remain in the dark cell of your open eyes. You can only listen, taste the air, and touch your familiar weapon in a now unfamiliar world.

Delrok Fairwind.name:
德尔罗克·费尔温德
Delrok Fairwind

Text.text:
这名水手的举止古怪，却又几乎带着某种近乎宫廷的宽宏大度。虽说他的外表足以让人把他当作粗鄙的吹牛狂，但那双眼里偏有一抹柔和，叫人不由得愿意信任。海盐像大海的亲吻一般结在他蓬乱的头发与胡须上；他纹身遍布的皮肤被烈日与海风磨砺得黝黑粗粝，那是无数个曝晒甲板的日子留下的痕迹。一支大步枪斜挂在他背上，伸缩瞄准镜在起伏波光里掠过一线冷亮。他讥诮地微微一笑，抬手掀起那顶破旧三角帽的帽檐，目光越过海面；牙间紧咬的旧烟斗吐出柔软的烟旋，缓缓飘散。

~ Played by Dylan

The sailor’s mannerisms are eccentric, yet almost courtly in their magnanimity. Though his appearance would mark him as an uncouth braggard, there is a softness to his eyes that invites trust. Salt encrusts his unkempt hair and beard with the kiss of the sea, and his tattooed skin is tanned and rugged from many days on sun-soaked decks. A large rifle is slung across his back, the telescopic sight glinting as it catches the light bouncing from undulating waves. He smiles wryly as he tips up the brim of his ragged tricorn hat, gazing out over the ocean as soft whorls of smoke drift from the old pipe clenched between his teeth.

~ Played by Dylan

她蹲得极低，一手按在地面，宽松的袖口滑上去，露出手臂上拼贴般纵横交错的疤痕组织。一只猫——皮肉尽失——在她脚踝间轻巧踱步，从空洞的胸腔里飘出一阵幽幽的呼噜声，伴着她专注忙碌。游侠温和一笑，起身拍去尘土。她抬手理了理束住栗褐色长发的发带，让松松的马尾更服帖些，朝那猫科伙伴俏皮地挑起一边眉梢。渐近的脚步声攫住她的注意力——她本能地伸手去摸腰侧的剑，原地一旋，迎向可能的威胁。紧绷、精瘦的肌肉在她浅色、带雀斑的皮肤下蓄势待发——随即她深吸一口气，任由紧张从体内流散，目光与一位值得信赖的朋友与同伴相扣。

~ Played by a Hero

Crouched low on her haunches, the woman places a hand to the ground, her loose sleeve riding up across the patchwork of scar-tissue covering her arm. A cat—devoid of skin and muscle—dances around her ankles, an ethereal purr emanating from its hollow chest as she tries to work. Smiling warmly, the ranger stands and dusts herself off. Adjusting the band keeping her chestnut-brown hair tied back in a loose ponytail, she raises a playful eyebrow at her feline companion. Approaching footsteps draw her attention, and—instinctively reaching for the sword at her hip—she pivots on the spot, ready to face the threat. Taut, lean muscles are tensed for action beneath her light, freckled skin—then she breathes deeply and allows the tension to flow from her body as she locks eyes with a trusted friend and companion.

~ Played by a Hero

Last Words Of An Upset Party Member.name:
一位愤懑的队友的临终遗言
Last Words Of An Upset Party Member

Text.text:
“要是我死在这儿，你得答应我……我要被做成标本，挂在你家里，脸上永远定格成那副失望透顶的表情，用来提醒你——这一切他妈的都是你的错！”
“If I die here, I need you to… I want to be stuffed, mounted in your home, with my face locked in a permanent look of disappointment, as a reminder that this was all your damn fault!”

Alicia Ahlander.name:
艾莉西亚·阿兰德勒
Alicia Ahlander

Text.text:
她右手紧握一支步枪，纤细的年轻女子几乎从不停下对周遭的扫视。她外表粗粝，肤色苍白却布满雀斑；衣物与道具都带着磨损却实用的气息——从大衣到登山靴与挎包，无一不为行走而生。鲜红的缎带将一头乌黑的长发波浪般束离额前。与缎带同色的围巾护住她的颈项，却仍遮不住左侧那道泛紫的胎记。

~ 由 Charlotte 扮演

Clutching a rifle in her right hand, this slender young woman rarely stops scanning her surroundings. She has a rough appearance, skin pale but freckled, with worn, functional clothing and gear—from her overcoat to her hiking boots and satchel. A red ribbon binds the waves of long, black hair out of her face. Matching the ribbon in color, a scarf protects her neck, but fails to hide a purplish birthmark along the left side.

~ Played by Charlotte

River Journey: Anchored By Day.name:
河上旅程：昼间抛锚
River Journey: Anchored By Day

Text.text:
一片高悬的薄云穹顶遮住了大半阳光的暖意，夜里的寒意仍在水面上徘徊不散。微风掠过抛锚起伏的甲板，清冷而劲疾，吹得你只想找一团火取暖。也许太阳会把河岸间缠绕不去的雾气烧散，可它毫无这样的迹象。
A high dome of thin clouds blocks much of the sun’s warmth, causing the chill of the night to linger over the water. The breeze blows cool and brisk across the deck of the ship as it bobs at anchor, making you long for a fire. Perhaps the sun will burn away the mist that lingers around the banks, but it shows no sign of doing so.

In-system Public Spaceport.name:
系统内公共太空港
In-system Public Spaceport

Text.text:
太空港的全景舷窗将下方的行星尽收眼底：它在群星剪影中缓缓自转，壮丽得令人屏息。远离大型港口喧嚣的轰鸣，这座停泊站格外安宁洁净。空气里带着清新的香气，没人显得匆忙——就连偶尔靠泊于此、吱呀作响的老旧穿梭机也不例外。
The panoramic windows of the spaceport offer a breathtaking view of the planet below, turning gently and silhouetted by the starscape. Far from the hectic buzz of the larger ports, this vessel is notably peaceful and clean. The air is fragrant and no one is in any hurry, including the creaking, venerable shuttles that occasionally dock here.

Enchanter Academy Fall Sunset.name:
附魔师学院·秋暮余晖
Enchanter Academy Fall Sunset

Text.text:
一年中最像学校的时节里，奇思与纪律如枫叶与橡叶般灼然迸发。斯派尔威奇附近的农场点缀着苹果与南瓜，色彩映照着暮色天穹。高塔的长廊里弥漫着苹果酒与丁香的香气，最后一个温暖的日子在雁群的鸣叫中离去——它们掠过一炉云海，仿佛巨大的余烬。
During the most schoolish season of the year, wonder and discipline flare up like the leaves of maple and oak. The farms near Spirewych are dotted with apples and pumpkins in colors that mirror the evening sky. The tower halls smell of cider and cloves, and the last warm day departs with the calls of the geese crossing a hearth of clouds like giant embers.

Warning About Assassins.name:
刺客警告
Warning About Assassins

Text.text:
“化作人形的活体影子，这名刺客在每一层意义上都与黑暗合而为一。没有怜悯，也无慈悲，世间的刺客以冷酷缜密的算计操持着致命行当，潜行尾随猎物数日……只为等到最完美的一刻，骤然出手。”
“A living shadow in humanoid form, the assassin is one with the darkness in every sense. Devoid of compassion or mercy, the assassins of the world ply their deadly trade with meticulous calculation, stalking their prey for days… waiting for the perfect moment to strike.”

这根粗厚沉重的长杖，杖尾镶着一枚圆形杖首；而在它真正派上用场的一端，则装着一片凶狠带刃的刀叶，几乎有短剑般大小。刀刃一侧被冷酷地磨至极致锋利，另一侧则布满残忍的倒刺，专为撕裂与扯碎而生。两侧刃缘一路收束，最终汇成尖锐的矛尖。
The thick, heavy staff is adorned at its base with a round pommel, and at its business end with a savage, edged blade, nearly the size of a shortsword. One side of the blade is a mercilessly honed cutting edge, and the other is littered with brutal barbs designed to rip and tear. The edges lead to a tapered spear tip.

Beholder In Lair.name:
巢穴中的眼魔
Beholder In Lair

Text.text:
那生物从天花板上无数竖井中的一处漂浮而出，将自身骇人的全貌赤裸展现——丑陋的笑容撕裂了那圆滚滚的躯体。过多得不合常理的眼睛在从球状身体上生长出的触手般柄端颤抖蠕动；它以那只巨大的中央独眼锁定你——异界而恶毒的智慧如出鞘之刃般刺穿你的灵魂。它干裂皲裂的嘴唇间冒出令人窒息的咯咯怪笑，随即猛地窜入另一处孔洞，而阴森的笑声从你周围无穷无尽的通道里层层回荡。
The creature floats from one of the many shafts in the ceiling, revealing itself in all its abhorrent glory, an ugly smile splitting the round form. Far too many eyes shiver and squirm on the ends of the tentacled stalks growing from the orblike body, and it fixes you with an enormous central eye—an otherworldly, malevolent intelligence piercing you like a drawn blade. A choking cackle bubbles from between its dry, chapped lips as it darts into another borehole, and sinister laughter echoes from the innumerable passageways around you.

Elf Wizard Skeleton.name:
精灵巫师骷髅（特征）
Elf Wizard Skeleton

Text.text:
当骷髅（特征）抽搐时，细长骨头的敲击与刮擦声被霉朽的天鹅绒闷住。它修长的颈椎如蛇般扭动，优雅而骇人地一节节脆响，在看向你时踏出诡异的节律。一条腐烂的皮带上压印着鎏金的精灵文，托着一本沉重的巨册；皮带松垮地挂在它狭窄的胯骨上，随着它动作一路坠落，几乎绊住它。尽管它侧腰的鞘中插着一根魔杖，它却弃之不用，只把细长而无肉的指骨弯成爪状，随即猛扑向你。
The knocking and scraping of fine long bones are muted by moldering velvet when the skeleton twitches. Its long neck vertebrae sinuously snap in a gracefully horrific rhythm when it looks at you. A rotting leather belt, embossed with gilded Elvish script and supporting a heavy tome, half-hobbles the skeleton, falling down its narrow hips as it moves. Though it has a wand in the sheath at its side, it eschews that and flexes its elongated, fleshless digits like claws before it lunges at you.

这台战争机器活像一堆废铁：断裂的木料与扭曲的金属杂乱堆叠，被锈钉与肮脏的绳索狠狠干在一起、捆成一团。地精们围着它矮胖的骨架尖叫争吵，一名高大的兽人挥舞着缠铁丝的棍棒抽打他们，咆哮着痛骂他们粗劣的活计。地精们一边咒骂一边流血，把投石机的弹药装上去：一张装满断头的网。
The war machine resembles a pile of scrap: broken wood and twisted metal, hammered and bound together by rusty nails and dirty rope. Goblins hoot and squabble around its squat frame, a large orc lashing them with a wire-wrapped club, berating their tawdry efforts. Cursing and bleeding, the goblins load the catapult’s ammunition: a net full of severed heads.

这把野蛮的武器顶端，是一截锈蚀刀刃上盘踞的邪恶钩刃——骨、金属与木材粗陋拼合而成，尺寸却正合小手握持。它被设计用来以残酷的效率割断马类敌手的腿脚，让对方瞬间失去支撑；“斩马钩刀”也因此坐实了它令人胆寒的名声。
A wicked hook crowns the rusted blade of this savage weapon—a primitive amalgamation of bone, metal, and wood—sized for small hands. Designed to cut the legs from beneath equine adversaries with brutal efficacy, the “horse-chopper” has earned its fearsome reputation.

Boreal Forest Fire.name:
北境针叶林火灾
Boreal Forest Fire

Text.text:
一堵灼干喉咙的热浪、刺痛的浓烟与燃木的恶臭猛击你的感官，针叶林的尖顶树冠如烛芯般燃烧。烈焰因松脂这天然燃料而更为凶猛，向前推进，吞噬沿途一切，毫不饶恕。火势所过之处，只余焦黑瘦长的树干，枝叶尽被剥去，宛如骷髅军团般矗立，在地狱般的火海前投下阴森的剪影。
A wall of parching heat, stinging smoke, and the stench of burning wood smites your senses as the spires of conifer trees burn like tapers. Strengthened by the natural pine-tar fuel, the advancing flames devour all in their path, unrelenting. In their wake, charred, spindly trunks with their branches stripped away stand like a skeletal army, looming in silhouette against the hellish inferno.

Dare-do-well General Store In Winter.name:
冬日亡命敢徒杂货铺
Dare-do-well General Store In Winter

Text.text: 顾客一踏进店里，迎面便是成排陈列的葡萄酒瓶，标签上写着 Soaring Peak。一名半精灵女子正为一位身着精致红色紧身上衣的客人倒出试饮，那年份酒色浓得发紫，几乎逼近深夜的墨黑。店里塞满了为冒险者、林地行者与猎人准备的货物：陷阱、皮护甲、弓、药水、肉干与腌渍保存的食物。最深处的柜台旁，半身人店主正与一名魁梧高大的男人低声交谈，那人背上斜背着一柄冰蓝色的大剑。 “比捕熊夹还大？”半身人男子一边若有所思地扯着山羊胡，一边说道。他穿着天鹅绒紧身上衣，金钮扣在灯下微微发亮。 “是的，屠杀者，我们后面有些上等机关。而且……趁这个机会，我们也可以送你一张防火网，如何？” A display of wine bottles greets patrons as they first walk into the store, labeled with the name Soaring Peak. A half-elf woman pours a sample out for a customer in a fine red doublet, the vintage so dark a purple that it hedges on midnight black. The shop is bursting with goods for adventurers, woodspeople, and hunters alike: traps, hide armor, bows, potions, jerky, and preserves. At the very back, at the sales counter, the halfling owner is deep in conversation with a towering man with an icy-blue claymore strapped to his back. “Bigger than a bear trap?” says the halfling man, tugging on his goatee thoughtfully. He’s dressed in a velvet doublet with golden buttons. “Yes, slayer, we have some premium contraptions in the back. And… we could throw in a fireproof net while we’re at it?”

Opulent Throne Room.name:
奢华的王座厅
Opulent Throne Room

Text.text:
在这间厅室里，浓艳的帝王紫帷幕掩蔽了每一寸墙面，唯有那些来自世界遥远角落、珍稀而张扬的艺术藏品所占据之处例外。高耸的天花板下，六盏巨大却精巧的枝形吊灯悬垂闪耀，由数千片手工切割、按苛刻规格打磨成形的水晶拼成，光芒碎裂如星。厚重的红木基座沿厅室两侧等距排开，其上陈设镶宝的纯金烛台，照亮行者踏过那条奢华的皇室猩红地毯、一路旅行至王座的脚步。王座本身与其主人受人敬仰的权柄同样辉煌，端坐于一座高台之上；高台嵌着数百枚彩石，费尽心力拼成王国徽印的马赛克图案。
In this chamber, rich imperial-purple curtains cover every inch of wall not displaying rare and ostentatious pieces of art collected from far-flung corners of the world. Along the high ceiling, six massive yet delicately crafted chandeliers sparkle from thousands of pieces of hand-cut crystal shaped to exacting specifications. Rich mahogany pedestals—spaced equidistant along the sides of the room—feature jeweled candelabras of solid gold, which light the steps of those who travel the length of the rich, royal-red carpet leading to the throne. The seat itself, as resplendent as its owner’s revered office, sits atop a dais featuring several hundred colored stones painstakingly arranged in a mosaic of the realm’s seal.

I Cast Alarm.name:
我施放警报
I Cast Alarm

Text.text:
在这里，我成了某种秘法匠人，把一根细线穿过小铃铛的吊环眼。我俯身对它低语：“在我脑海里响。”我把朋友们的名字告诉它——不是要为他们敲丧钟——然后放下铃铛，退出这片区域，将其施以附魔。过了一段时间，我也许会在睡梦中被那小铃的清脆一响惊醒，它在警告我有不速之客闯入。
Here I get to be a kind of arcane tinker, stringing a wire through the hanger eye of a little bell. I whisper to it, “Ring in my mind.” I tell it the names of my friends—not to toll for them—then place the bell, step away from the area and enchant it. Some time later I might be awakened from sleep by the chime of a little bell, which warns me of an interloper.

Alaric Von Hildegard.name:
阿拉里克·冯·希尔德加德
Alaric Von Hildegard

Text.text:
你透过浓雾的毯幕，听见一声轻微的金属吱呀。冰冷的帷幕里浮现出一道近乎方正的轮廓，以幽灵般的优雅向你飘来。它逐渐清晰，化作一名坐在轮椅上的男人：木质椅架被浸染成奢靡的深棕色，轮子的辐条则是打磨得一尘不染的青铜。

他倚在软垫座椅里，惨淡的月光勾勒出他瘦削的面庞，面颊与眼窝深陷成一片阴影。他穿着一套贴身的灰色西装，长发如液态白银的瀑流，沿着肩头垂落。他轻轻抬起一只手，掌心向上伸向你，仿佛想把你的手握进自己的掌中。

~ 由 Played 扮演，来自 Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

You hear a faint metallic squeak through the blanket of fog. A squarish silhouette appears within the chilling curtain, floating toward you with a ghostly grace. It turns into a man seated in a wheelchair, the wood of its frame stained to a decadent dark brown and the spokes of the wheels perfectly polished bronze. Leaning back into his cushioned seat, the pale moonlight highlights his gaunt face, his cheeks and eyes pits of shadow. He wears a slim-fitting gray suit and has trailing locks of hair that run down his shoulders like cascades of liquid silver. He lifts a hand gently toward you, palm face up, as if he wishes to take your hand in his own.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

一根橡胶软管从河里引出，接到一只九英尺高、箍着黄铜箍的铜罐上。一台紧凑的蒸汽机哐啷作响，吐着煤烟，安全阀不时尖啸着喷出一团团白汽。河水在罐内穿过滤层，沿着软管一路奔流，最终抵达一只带沉重卡扣的喷嘴。你一松开卡扣，就得俯身顶住水流的反冲——水柱掠过水面疾射而去，卷起翻涌的蒸汽云。
A rubber hose runs from the river to a nine-foot brass-banded copper tank. A compact steam engine clanks away, belching coal smoke and throwing whistling steam puffs from its relief valve. The river water passes through filters in the tank, traveling down the length of hose and through a nozzle with a heavy latch on it. When you release the latch, you have to lean forward against the kick of the water, which jets across the surface, billowing clouds of steam.

Temperate Forest Moss.name:
温带森林苔藓
Temperate Forest Moss

Text.text:
青苔如一张张鲜亮的绿毯铺满林间，漫过泥土与岩石，攀上树干与枝杈。它触感柔软如海绵，常成小小的隆起堆生。凑近细看，那些苔丛仿佛从高空俯瞰的另一片森林。
Moss carpets the forest in vibrant green patches, spreading over soil and rocks and climbing up tree trunks and branches. The moss has a soft, spongy texture and grows in small mounds. Up close, the clumps look like another forest seen from high above.

微风在此低吟，一条参差的隧道被硬生生凿进砂岩之中。凿刻早已年代久远——这片区域里不见碎石残砾，削出的岩面也已风化。洞口飘出一丝淡淡的霉味。通道陡然向下延伸，阳光很快被黑暗吞没。在昏沉里、就在日光最后能触及的尽头之外，有什么小东西闪了一下。
The breeze moans here, where a jagged tunnel has been hacked into the sandstone. The work is old—no rubble remains in the area, and the hewn rock has weathered. A faint musty odor wafts from the opening. The passage descends steeply, sunlight quickly giving way to darkness. In the murk just beyond the final reach of the sun, something small gleams.

Loot From A Barbed Devil.name:
倒钩魔鬼的战利品
Loot From A Barbed Devil

Text.text:
你小心翼翼地翻检着倒钩魔的残骸，时刻提防那一身锐利的尖刺。它左手上一根又长又扭曲的手指戴着一枚银戒——右手则戴着一枚金戒。一条细细的金链上串着红珠项链，垂挂在它的颈间。
You pick over the remains of the barbed devil, mindful of its sharp spines. One long, crooked finger is adorned with a silver ring on the left hand—and a gold ring on the right. A necklace of red beads on a fine gold chain hangs around its neck.

Winter Goddess Is Defeated.name:
冬之女神败北
Winter Goddess Is Defeated

Text.text:
这一击砰然落在女神身上，紧接着噼啪作响、嘶嘶作声，武器竟没入那勉强可称作她血肉的东西里，消失不见。她的眼睛骤然睁大。染着幽蓝的双唇微张，随即褪成灰色。她那一季的元素与灵性之力——霜与苦风，冰的背叛与麻痹的严寒，被织进她华服的纹理，凝成她形体的精致危险——尽数失去水晶般的闪耀。她黯淡下去，变作泥雪的铁灰。泥雪在她靴底凝起。泥雪沿着裙摆向上爬，沿着指尖向下淌。她的长发像瀑布般坍塌，稀软沉重地覆在脸上。她跪倒在地，抬起滴雨般的双手，呼喊着宽恕。然而她的声音已不再是冬之声——只剩水一般的濒死喘鸣，词句勉强成形，旋即一切只余一滩水洼，那夺命的武器躺在水洼正中央。

~ 构想 by Ethan

The strike lands with a thump against the goddess, then with a crackle and hiss the weapon disappears into what passes for her flesh. Her eyes snap wide. Her blue-tinted lips part and turn gray. The elemental and spiritual force of her season—its frost and bitter wind, its treachery of ice and paralyzing cold, made into the cloth of her finery and the exquisite danger of her form—all loses its crystalline sparkle. She dulls to the iron hue of slush. Slush forms at the soles of her boots. Slush creeps up her hem and down her fingertips. Her hair collapses like a waterfall, lank and heavy over her face. She drops to her knees, raises her raining hands, and calls out for mercy. Her voice, however, is no longer winter’s voice. It is a watery death rattle, barely forming words before all that remains is a puddle, the death-dealing weapon lying in its center.

~ Envisioned by Ethan

这具石棺上刻着铭文：此处长眠着正义，德里昂坚强的右手。愿二者的旅途永不分离，无论在此世，亦或来世。 This sarcophagus bears the inscription: Herein lies Justice, strong right hand of Derion. Let the two never be parted in their journeys, whether in this world or the next.

Magic Armor Shop.name:
魔法护甲店
Magic Armor Shop

Text.text:
各式宽窄高矮不一的人偶陈列在店中，展示着无与伦比的精工货品：羽饰张扬的头盔、雕纹精雅的胸甲、鳞片般叠覆的护臂、以及上过油、泛着细腻光泽的皮上衣——件件都流淌着附魔的幽微虹彩。绘有魔法符文的盾牌装点着墙面。陈旧却体面的地毯铺满地面，带来掩蔽般的静谧，将脚步声尽数吞没，使整间店铺仿佛一处庇护所。
Mannequins of varying breadths and heights are marshaled throughout the shop, displaying wares of unrivaled craftsmanship: flamboyantly plumed helms, elegantly tooled breastplates, scaled gauntlets, and leather jerkins oiled to a fine sheen—all gleam with the subtle iridescence of enchantment. Shields emblazoned with magical glyphs adorn the walls. Worn but worthy rugs cover the floor and mute the sound of footsteps, giving the shop an air of sanctuary.

Memories Of A Past Life.name:
前世的记忆
Memories Of A Past Life

Text.text:
这股感觉猝然袭来——一阵令人困惑的既视感猛地攫住你，让你当场僵在原地，呼吸都为之一窒。那种诡异的熟悉来得又快又狠，你几乎忘了自己身在何处、自己是谁——你经历过这一切，但不是在今生。记忆在你脑海里如拂晓的牵牛花般绽放，你在其中漂流，迷失而彷徨，拼命想抓住一点立足之处，任何地方都好。逝去挚爱与人生转折的片段逐渐成形，向你诉说一段很久以前发生过的事——以及那时走过的人。

~ Envisioned by Kiwis

The sensation hits you all at once, a confounding sense of déjà vu that stops you dead in your tracks and catches your breath. The uncanny familiarity is so sudden and swift that you almost forget where you are, who you are—you’ve experienced this before, but not in this life. Memories blossom in your mind like morning glories at dawn, and you drift among them, lost and wayward, grasping desperately for purchase somewhere, anywhere. Memories of loved ones lost and defining moments take shape, telling you a story of what, and who, came to pass long ago.

~ Envisioned by Kiwis

一尊覆满青苔的战士头颅雕像在你面前巍然矗立。它高逾十二英尺，由花岗岩精雕细琢而成，这件遗迹是某个曾经伟大帝国的古老见证。你感到一种安宁而庄严的威势从这件作品中荡漾而出，牵引着你不由自主地靠近。

[已激活] 忽然，青苔轰然炸裂，雕像的双眼倏然睁开。大地震颤，两侧各有巨大的石指撕裂泥土破土而出。一个沾满泥渍的躯体从土中升起，立于你面前，双腿如大教堂的立柱般擎天。千年之后，这具构装体首次挺立至全高——超过一百英尺——你心头一沉，意识到这绝非单纯的艺术品，而是一台奥术战争机器，为唯一而暴烈的目的而造。

A moss-covered statue of a warrior's head looms before you. Over twelve feet tall and meticulously carved from granite, this relic is an ancient testament of a once-great empire. You feel a peaceable majesty emanating from such a work, and it draws you closer.

[Activated] Suddenly, the moss explodes and the statue's eyes open. The ground trembles and massive stone fingers rip through the earth from either side. A dirt-stained body emerges from the soil to stand before you on legs like cathedral pillars. For the first time in a millennium, the construct stands to its full height—over one hundred feet tall—and you realize with a sinking feeling that this is no mere work of art but an arcane war machine created for a singular violent purpose.

Rope Bridge Over Jungle Chasm.name:
横跨丛林裂谷的绳索桥
Rope Bridge Over Jungle Chasm

Text.text:
这座横跨丛林裂谷两岸的绳索桥，由编织的藤蔓与就地采伐、晾干并矫直的木板捆扎而成，在轻柔的微风中来回摇摆。它像在挑衅，也像在考验。只要一步踏错，或一瞬分神，桥身便可能猛然向一侧翻转，把桥上的倒霉旅人统统倾倒出去。下方的丛林地面看上去至少有一百英尺之深。
Lashed together from woven vines and planks of dried and straightened wood harvested from the local flora, the rope structure bridging the two sides of the chasm in this jungle swings back and forth in the gentle breeze. It taunts and challenges. For one wrong step or a careless moment might cause the bridge to flip to one side, spilling any unlucky travelers along its span. The drop to the jungle floor looks to be at least a hundred feet.

这面风筝盾由厚重的精钢打造，却并不笨拙难携。盾面微微倾斜的弧度能偏开拙劣的劈砍，而加固的中央则足以承受战锤与钉头锤最沉猛的重击。隆起的金色镶边上排布着一列列獠牙，整体宛如一张张开的巨龙之口。将它牢牢系在臂上时，你能感到它配重恰到好处，灵活而迅捷。
The kite shield is made of thick, heavy steel, and yet it's not unwieldy to carry. A gentle slope in its shape turns aside clumsy strikes, while the reinforced center catches even the heaviest blows from hammers and maces. The raised trim, golden in color, features rows of fangs, evoking the overall image of a yawning dragon's mouth. Secured against your arm, the shield feels balanced and nimble.

Technomancer Drug, Baud.name:
科技巫师药剂：波特率
Technomancer Drug, Baud

Text.text:
不管这枚小小药片里被硬塞进了什么诡异炼金之物，它都浸透了你的心智。它刺痛着你，你的大脑像一颗被丢进水里的胃药片般嘶嘶起泡。刺眼的光斑猛地扎进你的视野。那些光斑拉长开来，如同散光把路灯拖成一道道光痕。一张网格浮现，一条路线被怒红色高亮。你被它牵引着前行，像一列单轨列车沿着轨道呻吟滑行；你在迷醉的驱使下只能旁观，任由赛博空间那张精密蛛网在眼前飞速掠过。你抵达了终点：你本想触及之人的雪白剪影。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

Whatever strange alchemy is shoved into this single pill suffuses your mind. It stings, your brain fizzing like an antacid plopped in water. Glaring spots spike into your vision. The spots lengthen in the way astigmatism stretches streetlights. A grid forms and a route highlights rage-red. You are pulled along like a monorail groaning along its track, in thrall, watching the intricate web of cyberspace zoom by. You reach your destination: a snowy silhouette of who you meant to reach.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Call To Arms: War Is Coming.name:
召集号角：战火将至
Call To Arms: War Is Coming

Text.text:
大地震颤，战争踏着钉靴的沉重脚步碾过这片土地。护甲在灰蒙蒙的天幕下黯然闪烁。旗帜垂在队列上方，在潮湿的空气里无精打采地耷拉着。远处某个角落，吟游诗人拨弦高歌，曲调凄惋低回。士兵们凝视着迷雾般的未来，仍毫不退缩地向前行军，迎向命运早已备下的一切。
The ground trembles, for war stomps its booted feet across the land. Armor gleams dimly under gray skies. Banners droop above the ranks, listless in the humid air. Somewhere, bards play and sing, their music mournful. The soldiers stare into an uncertain future as they march unflinchingly forward to whatever destiny has in store.

一个矮小身影自夜色深处浮现，圆顶礼帽压得极低，将面容藏进阴影。铆钉皮甲紧贴身形，他却如潜行的掠食者般流畅无声，风衣下沉重的胯侧鼓起——枪械在枪套里随步伐轻响；死亡的气息先于那傲慢的步态抵达——直到他骤然止步。戴着手套的手同时抽出手弩与双管手枪，弹矢轰然迸发，砸进那名黑影袭击者的身躯，将其抛飞，猩红飞溅如雨。他用仍冒着烟的枪管挑起帽檐，透过护目镜俯视那残破的敌人——如今像被丢弃的玩偶般蜷在沟沿。收枪入套，他拽紧风衣，悠然没入昏暗，口哨吹着一支欢快的小调。

~ Played by Murphdawg with

A small figure emerges from the depths of the night, a bowler hat lowered to obscure the face. Despite the studded leather sheathing their form, they move with the fluid grace of a stalking predator, hips heavy with holstered weapons beneath a trench coat—an aura of death preceding an arrogant stride—until they stop suddenly. Gloved hands draw a hand crossbow and a double-barreled pistol, and missiles burst forth, smashing into a shadowy assailant and hurling them away in a spray of scarlet. Tipping up his hat with a smoking barrel, he stares down through goggles at his ruined foe, now crumpled in the gutter like a discarded doll. Holstering his weapons, he tugs his coat closed and saunters off into the gloom, whistling a merry tune.

~ Played by Murphdawg with

这把匕首由整块黑曜石雕琢而成。优雅弯曲的刃身经细密敲削，磨出剃刀般的锋缘，泛着银白般的冷光。握柄乌黑光亮，如玻璃般映照周遭，并以颗粒分明的鲨鱼皮缠绕，握持牢靠不滑。
The knife is carved entirely from a piece of obsidian. The gracefully curved blade has been chipped down to a razor edge and shines with a silvery finish. The handle is glossy black, reflective like glass, and wrapped with pebbled sharkskin for a sure grip.

Arrival To The Elemental Plane Of Water.name:
抵达水元素位面
Arrival To The Elemental Plane Of Water

Text.text:
没有什么比你悬浮其间的所在更能提醒生命的起源。自传送门望去，四面八方尽是水——一片弯曲的位面，如同一张展开的海底世界地图。海面之下，浑浊的海底峡谷蜿蜒；淡水河流的入海口、三角洲与河口纷纷汇入其间；自上方贯穿而下的陆柱刺入水域，漂浮的岛屿垂落盘根。鱼群翻闪穿梭，倏忽四散；下方则喷涌起一道道气泡柱，直冲而上。
There is no greater reminder of the origin of life than where you are suspended. Water in every direction you can see from the portal, a curving plane like a map of the underwater world. There are cloudy canyons under the sea, the mouths of fresh-water rivers, deltas, and estuaries that lead into it, pillars of land masses reaching through from above, floating islands dangling roots. Schools of fish flutter and dash away, and columns of bubbles spray up from below.

Gentrified Downtown Residential Block.name:
士绅化的市中心住宅街区
Gentrified Downtown Residential Block

Text.text:
住宅街区从绿荫浓密的步行街中拔地而起：这里有被停滞冻结的冰咖啡，也有精品级的面部重建服务。俗气的老派铁艺栏杆圈着一片人造草坪。街上三五成群的潮人，穿着潮衣，装着崭新的美容科技部件，在这古雅的街景里来来往往，彼此投去戒备的打量。走进楼内，一圈仿红砖外墙围出接待室；整间房完全由回收塑料拼成——你之所以知道，是因为牌子上写得明明白白——一名紫发的小个子女人坐在柜台后。更里面的电梯上，贴着一个巨大的和平标志。
The residential block rises out of leafy pedestrianized streets boasting stasis-frozen iced coffee and boutique facial reconstruction. Kitschy old-fashioned iron railings border a lawn of artificial grass. Groups of trendy people with trendy clothes and trendy new pieces of cosmetic tech pass in the quaint street, eyeing one another suspiciously. Inside the building, a faux red-brick façade surrounds a reception room entirely made up of recycled plastic—you know because a sign tells you—where a tiny woman with purple hair sits behind a desk. The elevator beyond is decorated with a giant peace symbol.

你还没看见那些一排排矗立的巨大铁笼，未洗净的人体酸臭便已先钻入鼻腔——每个笼里都塞着好几名瘦骨嶙峋、目光涣散的人。可尽管这里被挟持的人数众多，四周却几乎寂然无声，只有偶尔的低语或咳嗽打破沉闷。有些人瘦得仿佛能从栏杆间滑出去，却连尝试的力气与心气都已被抽空。
The smell of unwashed bodies reaches your nose before you see the large cages of iron standing in rows—each containing several emaciated and listless people. But despite the large numbers held hostage here, there is little sound besides an occasional whisper or cough. Some look thin enough to slip between the bars, but don’t seem to have strength or spirit to try.

Victor Udonta.name:
维克托·乌东塔
Victor Udonta

Text.text:
这名男子是位刀舞者，身形高挑而纤瘦。仅凭外表便能看出，他显然是某种元素类类人生物的混血。银白的头发间掺着猩红的纹缕。他的双眼被眼罩遮住，可嘴角那抹笑意却在恶作剧与友善之间微妙摇曳。他低声对那些插在粗皮护甲各处鞘中的短刀与匕首呢喃，你在风里捕捉到它们的名字——Shadowsong、Cinderhearth、Klinge、Gnaw、Blackthorn、Myst、Sandman，以及Snarl。他踏入舞步，你看着他以刀锋勾勒出的优雅身姿，将一场饱含深情的表演娓娓传递。

~ Played by Preston Farr (D4 Network - Tales of Aneria) with

This man is a knife dancer, tall and slender. By the look of it, he is clearly some hybrid of elemental humanoids. His white hair is streaked with crimson. His eyes are hidden by a blindfold, but his smile is a subtle mix of mischief and friendship. He whispers to the knives and daggers slipped into sheaths across his hide armor, and you catch their names on the wind—Shadowsong, Cinderhearth, Klinge, Gnaw, Blackthorn, Myst, Sandman, and Snarl. He enters a dance, and you watch his elegant movements with the blades convey a performance of deep emotion.

~ Played by Preston Farr (D4 Network - Tales of Aneria) with

Loot From An Aboleth.name:
夺心魔鱼的战利品
Loot From An Aboleth

Text.text:
在破裂的夺心魔鱼尸体下方，你看到一处小小的凹陷。一条由美丽的珊瑚与珍珠串成的项链，在看起来带毒的海葵触手间闪烁着微光。
Beneath the ruptured corpse of the aboleth you can see a small depression. A necklace crafted from beautiful pieces of coral and pearls gleams among the fronds of a poisonous-looking anemone.

拖曳着奥术黑暗，一名战士逼近而来，身形精瘦凌厉，仿佛他们伸出的细剑本身。战士灰白的头发从棱角分明的脸上向后束起，颜色像裸露的骨。映衬这刺目的亮色，他们的深色肌肤在单一的色调里泛起复杂的光泽。伤疤如同成行的文字，缠绕在身体起伏的平面之间——其中一道尤为残酷，从眼罩下方蜿蜒爬出。仅剩的那只眼泛着猩红的光，毫不眨眼地锁住你。那只眼后，你每一次细微的移动都被剖析：一千场战斗在其中推演，所有可能被逐一研读，直到只剩下必然。然后，他们才猛然突刺而上。
Trailing arcane darkness, a warrior approaches, their body as lean and honed as the rapier they extend. Pulled back from their angular face, the fighter's chalky hair is the color of exposed bone. Accenting this shocking brightness, their dark skin gleams in monochromatic complexity. Scars, like lines of script, weave around the planes of their body—one particularly brutal one creeping out from beneath an eye patch. Their remaining eye glows crimson and holds you in its unblinking regard. Behind that eye, your every minute movement is being analyzed. Playing out a thousand fights, studying every possibility until only inevitability is left. Only then do they lunge forward.

I Tend The Campfire To Relax.name:
我守着篝火，让自己放松下来
I Tend The Campfire To Relax

Text.text:
在营地的心脏处，我凝望火焰蜿蜒而转、倏忽即逝的身影，在那温暖的辉光里寻得安宁。我懒散地用一根带钩的铁杆拨弄着，将噼啪作响的火势圈在石块之间。翻动劈开的木柴是个简单的动作，却能滋养我的灵魂，正如我们稍后要烹煮的小猎物将填饱肚腹。
Here in the heart of our camp, I observe the sinuous, fleeting shapes of the flames and find peace in their warm glow. I poke idly with a hooked iron rod, keeping the crackling fire contained between the stones. Turning the split logs is a simple act that feeds my soul, just as the small game we’ll cook later will feed our bellies.

I Use Chair Smith Tools.name:
我使用椅匠工具
I Use Chair Smith Tools

Text.text:
我把椅匠工具哐当一声掷在地上，慢慢挪着身子在旁边坐下。我将椅子翻倒过来，露出那只害我吃尽苦头、晃得人心烦的脚轮；从工具包里抽出所需家伙，开始拆卸那枚小轮。脚轮一卸开，问题的核心便赤裸裸地摆在眼前——那颗固定轮叉的螺栓松了一点点。太松，它就颤抖乱摆；太紧，又纹丝不动。我在一次次试拧与回退之间摸索，任凭工具循着手感找到那恰到好处的平衡，终于得以再度踏上旅程。
I toss my chair smith tools to the ground and ease my way down to sit next to them. I overturn my chair to expose the wobbly caster causing me issue, grab the tools needed from my kit, and begin disassembling the small wheel. Once the caster is out of the way, I can really get to the heart of the problem—the one loose bolt holding the wheel’s fork in place. Too loose, it flutters. Too tight, it’s immovable. Trial and error guides my tools to find the perfect balance so I can continue on my journey once again.

苔藓与藤蔓覆盖着这口圆形石井上方的雪松木瓦、梁架与立柱。植被缠死了用于升降井杆与水桶的摇柄轮。只有井沿仍算清晰。井旁的枝叶被熏得焦黑，其余则枯褐干裂。那些曾经鲜活的藤蔓像虫子般钻入灰浆之处，井壁正渗出沥青般的黏液，恶臭扑鼻。井内传来一种声音，像是破碎而粗重的喘息。
Moss and vines cover the cedar shingles, framing, and posts on the roof over this circular stone well. Vegetation chokes the crank wheel for the rod and bucket. Only the rim of the well is clear. The nearby foliage is blackened, while the rest is brown and dry. Where the once-living vines have wormed into the mortar, the well oozes a tarry liquid. It smells foul. From within the well comes a sound like ragged breathing.

Onyx Dog Figurine Of Wondrous Power.name:
缟玛瑙犬奇物雕像
Onyx Dog Figurine Of Wondrous Power

Text.text:
这尊黑曜石雕像由无瑕的原石切削塑形而成，呈现一只紧随脚边的獒犬。工艺细致入微，几乎让人觉得它下一刻就会伸舌舔你的手。
Cut and shaped from flawless onyx, this figurine of a mastiff at heel has been crafted with such detail, you practically expect it to lick your hand.

Goddess Of Elemental Air.name:
元素空气女神
Goddess Of Elemental Air

Text.text:
你只能听见她的声音，尽管有时你仿佛看见她的形——鸟儿的掠影、帘幕的舞动、田野里草浪的轻伏。她的行迹藏在火焰催眠般的闪烁里，藏在风暴中旋卷的落叶里，也藏在海滩上被拍打的棕榈间——被狂风抽打，向后翻卷，如同暴风中的发丝。她能低语赐生，也能长啸夺命。无论她真正的面容是什么，这位女神无处不在，却也脆弱。你每天呼唤她的名字两万两千次，直到你最后说出的名字，仍是她的。
She can only be heard, although at times you think you see her form—the flight of a bird, the dance of a curtain, the swoon of grass in a field. Her motions are detected in the hypnotic flicker of a flame, the cyclone of leaves in a storm, and the palms of a beach, buffeted, blown back like hair in the tempest. She can whisper life or howl death. Whatever her true face, the goddess is omnipresent but vulnerable. You speak her name twenty-two thousand times a day, until hers is the last name you speak.

I Use Sacred Weapon: Oath Of Devotion Pa.name:
我使用圣武器：奉献之誓圣武士
I Use Sacred Weapon: Oath Of Devotion Paladin

Text.text:
我对着剑低语：“亮如白昼，斩必必中。”钢刃随之嗡鸣，点燃一抹白光。嗡鸣渐息，光芒却仍不灭。
To my sword I whisper, “Shine bright, strike true.” The steel hums and kindles with white light. As the hum fades, the light shines on.

Domain Of An Unseelie Fey.name:
冷酷妖精的领域
Domain Of An Unseelie Fey

Text.text:
一棵幽魂般的树盘踞在这座峭壁洞窟的中央。它苍白的树干如天鹅的长颈般伸展，叶片则是蛾翼般蒙尘的黑。洞口处摆着一张桌子和一把椅子，皆由胡桃木精工制成。你看见无尽的森林在悬崖之下铺展开去，远处传来虫翼嗡鸣不绝。
A ghostly tree haunts the center of this cliffside cave. Its pale trunk stretches like the neck of a swan and its leaves are the dusty black of moths’ wings. A table and chair, finely crafted of walnut wood, sit at the mouth of the cave. You see an endless forest spreading out below the cliff and can hear the distant buzzing of insect wings.

I Cast A Countercharm In Combat.name:
我在战斗中施放了「反迷咒」
I Cast A Countercharm In Combat

Text.text:
施法者正对着我的小队吟诵他们的咒语，挥动幻饰，意图迷惑我们的同伴。但我拥有赋礼：一位映照心神的缪斯、一支扰乱思绪的歌，以及那些终将溃败的对手——当我的旋律滚涌，撞碎他们的操控，他们花在翻检书本与卷轴上的一切时代都将化作徒劳——同时也让我的同伴得以重整阵线。
The casters are speaking their charms at my group, gesturing glamours to beguile our troupe. But I have the gift: a reflective muse, a song to confuse, and opponents who'll lose all that time spent perusing their books and their scrolls when my melody rolls against their controls—while enabling my troupe to regroup.

Warm Spring Tournament.name:
暖春锦标赛
Warm Spring Tournament

Text.text:
蝴蝶在暖融融的空气里翩然起舞，斑斓的色彩映照着微风中猎猎作响的旗帜。号角声骤然响起，人群渐渐肃静：身着绿衣的女王被引上比武场，骑在一匹点斑母马上，马身缀满鲜花。她从一只深青铜钵中扬起满载花瓣的清水，洒向沙地，为这场盛事祝福。列队集结的马上骑士护甲在春日阳光下熠熠生辉，观众为心仪者欢呼，也对厌憎者报以嘘声。
Butterflies dance in the warm air, their colors mirroring the flags flapping in the breeze. Trumpets sound and the crowds grow quiet as the queen in green is led onto the list astride a dappled mare adorned with flowers. From a deep bronze bowl she flings petal-laden water upon the sands, blessing the proceedings. The armor of mounted knights sparkles beneath the springtime sun as they marshal, and the crowd cheers their favorites and boos those they despise.

I Cast Imprisonment Using Soporific Herb.name:
我用催眠草药施放「禁锢术」
I Cast Imprisonment Using Soporific Herbs

Text.text:
我双手织出令人目眩的手势，以缓慢而沉重的节奏吟诵咒文。细碎的草药残片在空中如萤火般飞舞，随着魔法生效，被灌注了超自然的力量与效能。

[豁免失败{/i>] 一阵沉重而倦怠的昏沉袭向我的敌人。他们眼皮下垂，很快便倒在地上沉沉睡去。

Weaving mesmerizing gestures with my hands, I speak the words of the incantation in a slow, ponderous rhythm. Floating bits of herbs dance like fireflies in the air as the magic takes hold, empowering them with supernatural power and potency.

[Failed Save{/i>] A heavy, lethargic stupor overcomes my foe. Their eyelids droop, and soon, they fall to the ground asleep.

Loot From A Warhorse Skeleton.name:
战马骷髅（特征）的战利品
Loot From A Warhorse Skeleton

Text.text:
无论是命运使然还是纯属巧合，那匹战马的前主人把鞍袋遗落在此。你在一滩腐坏口粮的糊烂残渣里翻找，最终在一个密封的皮革小袋中发现——十一枚金币，以及一副花纹诡异的扑克牌。
Whether by fate or happenstance the former owner of the warhorse left their saddlebags behind. Sifting through the slurry of spoiled rations, you find—in a sealed leather pouch—eleven gold pieces and a pack of playing cards with unusual designs.

The Dread Shadow Pirate Khayaano.name:
恐惧暗影海盗卡亚诺
The Dread Shadow Pirate Khayaano

Text.text:
如同暴风海面上不祥翻涌的浓雾，“恐惧阴影”现身时苍白得像死人的皮肉，双眼是两汪深渊般的黑潭，向每一个胆敢冒犯他、或挡他路的人许诺一场缓慢而痛苦的死亡。这名海盗行走间仿佛与影子融为一体，一身黑衣黑得如无月之夜。他随意一甩手腕，便将黑暗召至身侧，令其屈从于他的意志；在他手中，阴影如锻钢般被挥舞驱使。

~ Played by Alex with

Like an ominous, roiling fog on a stormy sea, the Dread Shadow appears as pale as a dead man's flesh, his eyes two abyssal pools, promising a slow, painful death to any who cross him or get in his way. The pirate walks as if in shadow, his dark attire black as a moonless night. With a casual flick of his wrist he calls the darkness to him, bending it to his will as he wields shadows like forged steel.

~ Played by Alex with

这块墓碑立在枯死树木的阴影下，碑文因此显得格外阴森沉重。岩面上刻着这样一句话：看着我。记住你也将与我同归一途，因为你也终有一死。 This headstone stands in the shadow of a dead tree, giving its engraving eerie weight. The words carved into the rock read: Look upon me. Remember you will share my fate, for you too are mortal.

轻若空气、暗如无星之夜，这件异界奇珍握在手中仿佛丝绸般的薄雾。若你试图抓得太久，它便会从指缝间悄然滑落。
Light as air and dark as a starless night, this extradimensional marvel feels like silken mist in your hands. It runs right off your fingers if you try to hold it for too long.

这只破旧的皮革背包在上方嵌着一段带缺口的木架。木架上绑着一卷灰暗破烂的铺盖卷，还系着一个朴素却凹瘪的锡盒。背包一侧的皮带固定着一段麻绳。一个水囊用自己的背带挂在外侧，背带横跨整个背包。
This shabby leather backpack has a nicked wooden rack near the top. Tied to it is a drab, ragged bedroll, along with a simple, dented tin box. Belts on one side of the pack hold hempen rope. A waterskin has been hung from its own carrying strap, which fits across the whole pack.

Divine Home Of A Halfling Goddess.name:
半身人女神的神圣居所
Divine Home Of A Halfling Goddess

Text.text:
在地底的一个洞穴里，圆形的黄色门扇后头，配着一枚朴素的青铜门钮，便是一间起居室：墙上钉着挂外套的木钉，地上铺着一条羊毛长毯，好让靴子踏得干净。每个房间都备着一只小小的储藏柜。每张桌子都被摆在最好的光里——那是从凹入的窗洞斜斜照进来的，窗外正对着她的花园与各色工程。书房里卷轴堆叠如林，其间夹杂着包好的礼物与托盘里的小饰物、小玩意儿。茶永远温着。任谁都看不出这儿并非寻常的半身人住家——而这正是她如此生活的全部用意。
In a hole in the ground, behind a round yellow door with a simple bronze knob, there is a parlor with pegs on the wall for coats and a wool runner for boots. Every room has a small larder. Every table is situated toward good light through the recessed windows that look on her gardens and projects. Scrolls pack the study, along with wrapped gifts and trinkets in trays. Tea is always on. One would never be able to tell this is not a common halfling house—which is entirely the point of her living so.

Goddess Of Unicorns.name:
独角兽女神
Goddess Of Unicorns

Text.text:
她的脸上带着一种神秘力量的平静慈悲，既不卖萌，也不甜腻。她矫健而威严，像她并骑的那些神秘骏马：驰骋在原始世界阳光普照的绿野之上，或沿着风卷浪啸的海岸线疾行。她的白金色长发与朴素的白色长衫，随马群的鬃毛一同起伏翻涌；它们的角斜指苍穹，宛如观星的仪器，宇宙的知识穿行其间——也穿过她——在绝无邪恶的纯净空白里。
On her face is the calm kindness of a mysterious strength, neither cute nor saccharine. She is athletic, majestic, like the mystical horses she rides with: over sunny green fields of the primitive world, or along the strand of a wind-swept shore. Her platinum hair and simple white shift ripple with the manes of the herd, their horns angled toward the sky like astronomical instruments, cosmic knowledge passing through them—and her—in the total absence of evil.

I Cast Wall Of Force From My Staff Of Po.name:
我从【力量法杖】中施放《力场墙》
I Cast Wall Of Force From My Staff Of Power

Text.text:
我吟诵法术的词句时，杖柄上的符文迸发出脉动的蓝光，法杖在我手中骤然沉重，仿佛瞬间化作铅铸。眼前的空气如海市蜃楼般微微荡漾，我塑起一堵无形的能量之墙，护住我的伙伴免受伤害。
Pulsing blue light erupts from the runes along the haft as I intone the words of the spell, and the staff feels heavy in my hands, as if suddenly made of lead. The air shimmers before me like a mirage as I create a wall of invisible energy to protect my companions from harm.

Spectacular Arrival Of An Airship To A C.name:
飞空艇壮丽驶临城邦
Spectacular Arrival Of An Airship To A City

Text.text:
尽管冬日晴空澄澈，却透着铁一般的寒意，港口附近的集市今日仍拥挤不堪。讨价还价与叫卖声在你身边此起彼伏，夹杂着骡子的嘶鸣与车轮的辘辘震响。微风送来香肠的油香与木烟的气息。忽然，头顶投下一片阴影，将这份热闹压暗了几分。人们纷纷走到街道中央，仰头望去。一艘齐柏林飞艇无声掠过，体型竟与整座集市相仿，外形宛如一艘远航的海上桨帆战船。惊叹与好奇在人群间涌动，众人守夜般凝望着它飞向码头，准备降落。

~ Envisioned by Ramon

The market near the harbor is crowded today despite a clear winter sky of iron cold. Haggling and cries of sales ring out around you, along with the braying of mules and rattle of carts. The breeze smells of sausage and woodsmoke. A shadow from overhead darkens the festivities. Everyone steps into the thoroughfares and looks up. A dirigible the size of the entire market, resembling a seafaring galley, passes overhead in silence. The awed and curious crowd watches it fly out to land on the dock.

~ Envisioned by Ramon

Remains Of An Orc And Human Battle.name:
兽人与人类战役的残骸
Remains Of An Orc And Human Battle

Text.text:
焦黑的战场上尸体横陈，兽人与人类的兵卒纠缠堆叠成一团团血淋淋的肉堆。风卷起灰烬与腐烂的恶臭，吹得两军破烂的旗帜猎猎翻飞。浸透鲜血的土地贪婪地吞饮着。
Bodies lie strewn about the charred battlefield, orc and human troops piled together in tangled, bloody heaps. The wind kicks up ash and the stench of rot, and flutters the tattered banners of both armies. The blood-soaked ground drinks greedily.

Observatory Researcher.name:
天文台研究员
Observatory Researcher

Text.text:
有人站在望远镜平台上，在凑近镜筒窥视与匆匆记录笔记之间来回切换。他们每次一移开视线就迫不及待想回到望远镜前，对周遭发生的一切几乎只投以匆匆一瞥。
Someone stands on the telescope platform, alternating between peering into the lens and scribbling down notes. They seem eager to return to the telescope as soon as they look away, sparing little more than a passing glance for anything else going on around them.

A Positive Experience Of Planar Travel.name:
一次愉快的位面旅行体验
A Positive Experience Of Planar Travel

Text.text:
一阵刺痒感轻挠着你的鼻尖、指腹与脚趾——紧接着，一股暖流沿着四肢向上漫开，直涌向心口，视野里迸出耀眼的光斑。你眨了眨眼，可光斑愈发明亮，汇聚成一片炽烈的纯白，无论你睁眼还是闭眼都能看见。骤然袭来的速度带来的战栗逼得你盲目伸手，想抓住什么让自己停下。随后，所有感受骤然止息：视线澄清，你站在了一个全然不同的地方。
A prickling sensation tickles your nose, fingertips, and toes—before a wave of warmth spreads up your limbs toward your heart and brilliant spots fill your vision. You blink, but the spots grow brighter and coalesce into a vibrant white that you see whether your eyes are open or closed. The thrill of the sudden speed you feel compels you to reach out blindly to stop yourself. Then, quite suddenly, all these sensations stop: your vision clears and you stand somewhere entirely different.

I Drink My Potion Of Greater Healing.name:
我喝下我的强效治疗药水
I Drink My Potion Of Greater Healing

Text.text:
头昏眼花、浑身挨打，我几乎被痛楚逼得跪倒在地。踉跄间，腰带上的治疗药水随之晃动，瓶身闪过一道冷亮。我一把抓住它，用沾血的牙齿咬开瓶塞。只一口灌下去，痛感如潮退散，力量重新涌回四肢。
Addled and beaten, I nearly drop to my knees with the pain. I catch the shine of the healing potion at my belt as it shakes with my stumble. I grab it, uncorking it with my bloodied teeth. With a single swig, the pain rushes away and my strength returns.

Tabaxi Pouncer.name:
塔巴希突扑者
Tabaxi Pouncer

Text.text:
这名阿穆伦是顶级掠食者，敏捷而强悍。野猫般爆裂的速度凝聚在它们支撑身体的两条后肢上，使双臂得以解放，用那双灵巧可握的爪掌挥舞一柄巨大的双刃战斧。它们的眼睛像阳光落在雪面上般闪烁，泄露出远远超越其兽性外表的聪慧；一对大而带簇的耳朵会在最细微的声响里轻轻抽动，仿佛能听见自然界的低语。浓密的斑点毛皮足以抵御风霜，但这位猫族仍穿上了量身裁制的皮革护甲，在不牺牲机动性的前提下增添了额外的防护。
This amurrun is an apex predator, agile and powerful, with the wildcat's explosive speed is concentrated in the two back limbs upon which they stand, leaving the arms free to wield the massive double-bladed war axe held in their prehensile paws. Their eyes gleam like sun on snow, betraying an intelligence far surpassing their animalistic appearance, and large tufted ears twitch at the slightest sound, attuned to the whispers of the natural world. While their thick spotted coat is ample protection from the elements, this catfolk has taken to donning tailored leather armor, which provides added protection without forsaking maneuverability.

Well-maintained Graveyard.name:
维护良好的墓园
Well-maintained Graveyard

Text.text:
一圈高耸的铁栅栏被常春藤缠满，环绕着寺庙相邻的墓园——向外铺展一里又一里，越过起伏的地平线，直至消失不见。眼前一片葱郁繁盛：草坪修剪得整齐利落，成片花圃被悉心打理，盛放的花朵引来蜜蜂流连。墓碑与陵寝在阳光下熠熠生辉，石材无一处瑕疵，打磨得光可鉴人。纵横的步道脉络延伸向墓园中心那方如画的池塘，水面上鸭群与天鹅悠然漂游。

~ 一位英雄所构想

A high iron fence, overgrown with ivy, encircles the cemetery adjoining the temple—sprawling outward for a league or more, disappearing over the rolling horizon. The scene is verdant, lush, the grass shorn and tidy, with lovingly-maintained stretches of blooming flowers frequented by honey bees. The grave markers and mausoleums all gleam in the sunlight, the stone unmarred, polished to a sheen. The veins of walking paths lead to an idyllic pond hosting ducks and swans at the cemetery’s heart.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Temple Of The Winter Palace.name:
冬宫神殿
Temple Of The Winter Palace

Text.text:
阳光束束从窗棂间偷溜进这处神圣之所，照得几乎覆满一切的黄金闪闪发亮——檐口、门扉、雕像、烛台——仿佛真菌般的侵占。惨白墙面的刺目反光，与俗艳铺陈的鎏金相互叠加，在你更深入时猛击你的感官。你的脚步在完美抛光的木地板上清脆作响，回声沿着高耸的穹顶来回弹跳；穹顶上绘着的天界人物从淡色颜料勾勒的鼻梁上俯视着你。

~ Cole Wilson构想

Sunbeams steal through the windows into this hallowed place, gleaming upon the gold that covers nearly everything here—cornices, doors, statues, candlesticks—like a fungal conquest. The glare of the stark white walls, paired with the garish array of gilt, assault your senses as you move deeper inside. Your footsteps click against the perfectly polished wooden floors, the sound bouncing off the high ceilings from which painted celestial figures stare down their pale pigmented noses at you.

~ Envisioned by Cole Wilson

刺鼻的浓烈草药味与芬芳的烟雾交织在一起，扑面而来，冲击着每一位踏入这间昏暗店铺之人的感官。摇曳的烛火将不定的光影投在一片骇人的杂乱之上：无数小玩意堆满每一处可用的表面——磨损的古书、脆裂的卷轴、盛着不明液体的瓶罐。其间散落着漂白的头骨与秘奥图腾、恶魔般野兽的角、带着腥膻气的植物球茎，以及布满尖刺的枯茎。而在店铺的核心，一口翻滚着黑色脓汁的大锅悬在下陷的火坑之上。
An acrid mingling of strong-smelling herbs and fragrant smoke assault the senses of any entering the dimly lit shop. Flickering candles throw their wavering light across the landscape of macabre clutter: myriad trinkets litter every available surface—worn tomes, brittle scrolls, flasks of indeterminate liquid. Among the items lie bleached skulls and esoteric totems, horns from fiendish beasts, musky plant bulbs, and thorny stalks. And at the shop’s heart a bubbling cauldron of black ichor hangs over a sunken fire.

Emblem Of Lux-odassa-nym, Protector Of H.name:
卢克斯-奥达萨-尼姆徽记，雏幼守护者
Emblem Of Lux-odassa-nym, Protector Of Hatchlings

Text.text:
徽记由柔软的木材精工雕琢而成，凿与锉的精妙痕迹清晰可感，指尖划过粗粝的表面时尤为分明。它呈圆形——仿佛一只轮盘——八根辐条向外突刺，每一端都收束成一簇炽烈的火焰。轮心处，一只龙类的独眼无眨地向上凝视，细节逼真得近乎活物。仅仅注视它，便会生出一种诡异的被窥视感，仿佛女神正透过那只无睑之眼看见你。

~ 设想 by christoffer

The emblem is hewn expertly from soft wood, the exquisite work of the chisel and file tangible as one runs their fingers over the rough surface. It’s circular in shape—a wheel of sorts—with eight spokes jutting outward, each terminating in a blazing flame. At the wheel’s heart, a single draconic eye stares unblinkingly upward, almost lifelike in its detail. By looking upon it, one experiences the uncanny feeling of being observed, almost as if the goddess herself perceives you through the lidless eye.

~ Envisioned by christoffer

Gemini The Showman.name:
双子座·卖艺人
Gemini The Showman

Text.text:
这个螳螂人，体型如同人类孩童，满身虫族特征——四条手臂、两条强健有力的腿、镰状颚、细硬的触角，以及复眼般的漆黑眼睛。他淡紫色的甲壳在腹侧过渡为柔软的蔚蓝。他头戴一顶俏皮的靛蓝高礼帽，插着一根修长的红羽；身穿与之相配的蓝色燕尾服，红色内衬覆在精致的白衬衫外。背上挂着一只漆木小提琴琴盒。腰带左侧的挂环垂着一柄细剑，旁边还有一个抛光皮革制的长笛套。他从中抽出一支朴素的银色乐器，深吸一口气，便要吹奏……

~ Played by Dustin

This mantid person, the size of a human child, has insectile features—four arms, two powerful legs, mandibles, wiry antennas, and compound black eyes. His lavender carapace gives way to soft blue on the underside. He wears a jaunty indigo top hat with a long red feather, and a matching blue tailcoat with red lining over a fine white shirt. Hung on his back, he has a viol case of lacquered wood. A rapier hangs from a loop in his belt to the left, alongside a flute holster of polished leather. From this he slides a simple silver instrument, then takes a breath to play…

~ Played by Dustin

Mobility Aid Repair Shop.name:
助行器修理铺
Mobility Aid Repair Shop

Text.text:
店内看起来比外头更狭小，但墙后却是一座堆满各式助行器零件的仓库。服务门一打开，叮当作响的金属声便涌入整间屋子。你往里望去，只见一名身经百战的圣武士沉默地坐着，疲惫的双眼静静等待轮到他。直到有人前来护送他回去修理座椅，他的神情才忽然亮起，像孩子般迸出一瞬纯真的光。
The store seems smaller inside, but beyond the wall is a warehouse full of mobility aid parts. Sounds of clanging metal flood the room as the service door opens. You look in and see the battle-weary eyes of a paladin quietly waiting for his turn. When someone comes to escort him back to have his chair fixed, his face awakens with a childlike spark.

Taunt From An Ant.name:
蚂蚁的嘲讽
Taunt From An Ant

Text.text:
“庞然大物扰乱了道路。撼动了家园。可那东西无法理解，那东西没有族群。庞然大物孤身一体。”
“A great thing disturbs the path. Shakes the home. But the thing cannot understand, the thing has no colony. The great thing is alone."

Sundries From The Prince Of Revelry.name:
狂欢王子的杂货
Sundries From The Prince Of Revelry

Text.text:
他的身躯在点点红宝石般的雾霭中消散无踪。如今只剩下一套色彩斑斓的拼布衣裳——一件锈橙色披肩、一条深酒红短裤，以及一件缀着木扣的条纹衬衫。王子那浓密的金发成绺黏在披肩上，扎人得像一把把稻草碎丝。
His body disappeared in a ruby-flecked mist. Now all that remains is a colorful set of patchwork clothes—a rusty orange mantle, a pair of short burgundy pants, and a striped shirt with wooden buttons. Strings of the prince’s thick golden hair stick to the mantle, prickly as shreds of straw.

I Use Cunning Action: Dodge.name:
我使用【狡诈动作】：闪避。
I Use Cunning Action: Dodge

Text.text:
我始终绷紧神经，留意是否有敌意的目光落在我身上——那就是征兆。这和潜行或扒窃一回事。我不需要刻意专注。一旦察觉到任何不受欢迎的关注，我就会立刻抽身避开。
I keep an eye peeled for any hostile attention focused on me. That’s the tell. It’s the same as stealth or pickpocketing. I don’t need to focus. When I sense any unwanted interest, I simply get out of the way.

一块巨大的地砖上镌刻着一条蛇缠绕金蛋的图像。凸起的浮雕几乎占满了入口，其两侧耸立着由白色石砌成的巍峨巨塔。沙粒堆积在雕刻的缝隙里，却无法覆盖嵌入地面的金色——那金子以数块完整的实心片铺陈其间。
Engraved on one giant tile is the image of a snake wrapped around a golden egg. The raised image takes up most of an entryway flanked by colossal towers of white stonework. Sand gathers in the carving’s crevices, but it doesn’t coat the gold set into the floor in several solid pieces.

Overworked Office Intern.name:
过劳的办公室实习生
Overworked Office Intern

Text.text:
她的头发向后束成利落的短波波头，低调的妆容一丝不苟。身上是剪裁锋利的西装外套、扣领衬衫与裙装，件件挺括无褶——像库存照片里走出来的一样完美。别在翻领上的一只狭长传呼机忽然亮起，哔哔连响，足足响了十来下。“操。”她低声咒骂。她把掌心狠狠按进眼眶，仿佛能把那股不安、连同泪意一起揉碎。紧接着，她猛地倒抽一口气，牙关发出嘶响，捂住腹部，痛得五官绷紧变形。她轻轻呜咽一声，双手发抖地解开西装外套的扣子，去够腰间藏着的一台方形小机器。几根管线从那小机器里引出，没入她的衣物之下。她在屏幕上按了几下按钮，伴随一声像蒸汽泄出的嘶鸣，管线里亮起幽光流转的荧亮液体。她颤了一下，如释重负——而就在这时，传呼机又开始哔哔作响。
Her hair is tied back into a neat bob, her muted makeup perfectly applied. She wears a sharp blazer, button-down, and skirt, each crisp and wrinkle-free—stock-photo perfect. A narrow pager attached to her lapel alights, bleeping about ten times in a row. “Fuck,” she mutters. She digs her palms into her eyes as if she could massage the distress out, the tears. She suddenly hisses through her teeth and clutches at her stomach, face stretched in pain. With a small whimper, she unbuttons her blazer with shaking hands to reach a square machine hidden at her belt. Tubes from the small machine feed into her clothing. She presses a few buttons on the display and, with a sound like steam being released, the tubes light up with luminescent fluid. She shudders with relief just as her pager begins beeping again.

那生物用你听不懂的语言对你诉说，急切得几乎要把意思硬塞进你的脑海。你施放法术后，生物的话语立刻对你变得清晰可懂——不止如此，你甚至抓住了他们语言中的细微差别，捕捉到含蓄的暗示、肢体语言与语气重音。
The creature speaks to you in a language you do not understand, trying desperately to make sense. You cast the spell and the creature’s words instantly hold meaning for you—not only that, you grasp the nuances of their language, catching subtle inferences, body language, and emphasis.

I Catch Someone Cheating Off My Paper.name:
我抓到有人在抄我试卷作弊
I Catch Someone Cheating Off My Paper

Text.text:
我的论文像被胶水黏住似的死死贴在墙上，可在它前方两三英尺处，站着一个龙院的三年级生，硬装出一副若无其事的样子。他的手指在长袍袖口下微微抽动；我一走近，就看见他太阳穴处睁着第三只眼，正一行行读着我的论文。自他的书袋里传来羽毛笔刮擦羊皮纸的沙沙声。他打了个响指，墙上的那一页便翻了过去。
My paper is stuck to the wall as if with glue, but a couple of feet in front of it is some third-year from House Dragon trying to act casual. His fingers twitch under the sleeve of his robes, and as I approach, I see a third eye on his temple reading my paper. From his book bag I can hear the sound of a quill scratching on parchment. He snaps his fingers and a page on the wall turns.

Ominous Open Door.name:
不祥的敞开之门
Ominous Open Door

Text.text:
多年踩踏磨得光滑的台阶一路向下，通往一扇古老而饱经摧残的门。门在缓缓张开时轻轻吱呀作响，露出门后那片窒息的黑暗。门板上布满参差不齐的深刻刮痕，像丑陋的伤疤般烙在木纹之中。
Steps worn smooth through years of use lead down to an ancient, battered door, which creaks softly as it yawns open, revealing the suffocating darkness beyond. Ragged gouges mark the wood of the door like ugly scars.

Creepy Operating Room.name:
阴森的手术室
Creepy Operating Room

Text.text:
一盏宽大的锡质浅盘灯从头顶闪烁着投下光来，摇摇晃晃地照在一张肮脏的银色桌面上。桌上堆着几团潮湿的破布，湿淋淋地坍作一团。桌旁的托盘里胡乱摆着一堆凶相毕露的器具，几件上面还沾着血。近处的水槽里，水滴一声声落下。地面上有几道血迹斑斑的赤脚印，从桌边一路朝外延伸，最后没入一滩大大的、泛着粉红的积水中。
A broad tin saucer of light flickers from above. It sways over a grimy silver table with several lumps of damp cloth rags piled on it. Next to the table, a tray holds an unorganized array of wicked-looking instruments, several of them bloody. Water drips into a sink nearby. On the floor, streaked and aiming away from the table, are several bloody, bare footprints leading to a large puddle of pinkish water.

珠光般的鳞片与苍白的皮肤紧贴在这具巨大的龙形骨架上。尖锐的骨冠自颅顶突刺而出，破碎的白色皮膜如蛛网般绷在骸骨双翼的指骨间。灰烬色的肌腱将骨头牢牢缚在一起，连那巨大、带爪的指节也不例外。这条龙看起来早已死去。然而，空洞的肋骨深处骤然亮起幽蓝的光辉，从口腔与眼窝喷涌而出。它一动，尸身便倾泻出阵阵刺骨寒风。它站起身来，吱呀作响、低沉轰鸣，抖落积压的冰霜。寒冷的蓝光在它身上流淌，它张开双翼，放出一声撼魂的咆哮。

~ 一位英雄 构想

Pearly scales and pale skin cling to the bones of this gigantic draconic form. A pointed crest juts from the skull and tattered white flesh webs the fingers of the skeletal wings. Ashen tendons hold bones together, including massive, clawed digits. This dragon seems long dead. But blue radiance abruptly shines from within the hollow ribs, flaring from the mouth and eyes. Waves of frigid air pour from the corpse as is stirs. It stands, creaking and rumbling, shaking off accumulated ice. The cold glow flows over it as it spreads its wings and looses a soul-shaking roar.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Fire My Arrow Of Clear Shot.name:
我射出那支清晰命中的箭矢
I Fire My Arrow Of Clear Shot

Text.text:
我一边搭箭开弓，一边对着箭矢低声呢喃，将目标牢牢烙在心里。弓弦后拉时，箭矢复诵其名，把一幅清晰的影像映入我眼中。我吸气，弓身吱呀作响。我瞄准我确信敌人所在之处——在盟友与掩蔽之后。呼气间，我放弦。箭矢尖啸破空飞驰，在抵达第一道本该庇护其目标的障碍前便倏然消失。它在对手身前一步处再度现身，挟满贯之力，正中要害。
I murmur to the arrow as I nock and pull, holding my target in mind. The arrow recites the name, showing me a clear image as the string comes back. I inhale, and the bow creaks. I aim where I know my foe to be, behind allies and cover. Exhaling, I loose. The arrow shrieks and flies, disappearing before it reaches the first obstacle that would protect its target. It reappears a pace from my adversary and strikes home with full force.

绿灰相间的地衣斑驳着屋顶，屋脊下塌，像一张忧惧紧皱的眉，沉沉压在这间小屋上。你踏上门廊，木板带着怨气吱呀作响，你听见有什么生物从木板底下仓皇窜动。门上，那只巨大的蜘蛛安了家，盘踞在漆黑的铁门环正中央。你虽不敢确定，却仿佛听见门槛另一侧传来极其微弱、沙哑的喘息声。
Green and gray lichen mottles the roof, which sags down upon the cottage like a troubled brow. As you step upon the porch, the wood creaks in resentment and you hear creatures skittering from underneath the boards. On the door, a large spider has taken up residence in the center of the dark, iron knocker. Though unsure, you think you hear faint, rasping breathing on the other side of the threshold.

一阵银白、轻若薄纱的雾霭将你环绕，刹那间遮蔽了你的视线。你在心中勾勒目的地，以意志强行牵引自身，随即一股令人眩晕的猛然拉扯袭来——你已瞬移而至。
A silvery, gossamer mist surrounds you, obscuring your sight for an instant. You envision your destination, will yourself there, and, with a sudden dizzying tug, you teleport.

Tournament Celebrating The Marriage Of T.name:
庆祝两位富商联姻的锦标赛
Tournament Celebrating The Marriage Of Two Wealthy Merchants

Text.text:
环绕着长台的看台装饰得富丽堂皇。每根立柱上都悬挂着商人家族的纹章。新婚夫妇立于镀金的高台之上，从沉甸甸的钱囊里向人群抛撒施舍。参加比武的骑士们守卫着仪式，手持绘有各家族颜色的盾牌。
The stands surrounding the lists are extensively decorated. Merchant crests hang from every post. The wedding couple stands on a gilded podium, tossing alms to the crowd from a weighty purse. Knights competing in the tournament guard the ceremony with shields painted in each family’s colors.

Large River With A Strong Current.name:
水流湍急的大河
Large River With A Strong Current

Text.text:
芦苇与香蒲密密麻麻地堵住了这片宽阔深色水域的岸边。你近处的水面看上去还算温顺，可在河心处，你看见一圈圈细碎的涟漪，昭示着深水与湍急的水流。对岸离这里足有三百英尺。若你试图游过去，河水会在你抵达前把你冲到多远的下游，谁也说不准。
Reeds and cattails clog the bank of this broad expanse of dark water. The water nearest you seems gentle enough, but out in the center of the river you see ripples that indicate deep water and a strong current. It must be three hundred feet to the opposite bank. Were you to try and swim across, there’s no telling how far downstream the river might carry you before you reach it.

Spacegoing Vessel: Large Cargo Hold.name:
远航飞船：大型货舱
Spacegoing Vessel: Large Cargo Hold

Text.text:
巨大的货舱里堆满了层层叠叠的海运集装箱——波纹钢板筑成的高塔一路向上，没入头顶那不可思议的无垠黑暗。荧光灯几乎无法刺破这片昏沉，庞大堆垛之间的狭长通道被遮蔽在薄纱般的阴影里。就在那些阴影中，利爪掠过冰冷的金属地面，发出急促的窸窣声；飞船在星际航行的重压下呻吟作响。
The cavernous hold is filled with stacked shipping containers—towers of corrugated steel disappearing into the impossibly vast darkness above. The fluorescent lights do little to penetrate the gloom, and the alleys between the enormous stacks lie in veiled shadow. In those shadows, claws can be heard skittering across the cold metal floor as the ship groans under the stress of its interstellar voyage.

Child And Their Puppy.name:
孩子与他们的小狗
Child And Their Puppy

Text.text:
一只脏兮兮的棕色小狗叼着根木棍蹦跳着冲入视野，身后一个赤脚小女孩穿着破旧的裙子紧追不舍。丢接游戏显然已经变成了你追我赶。木棍在地上绊了一下，小狗只得松口。它正要转身再叼起时，孩子已一把将木棍和小狗一起搂进怀里。
A grimy brown puppy bounds into view dragging a stick and chased by a barefoot girl dressed in a raggedy dress. A game of fetch has clearly turned to a game of chase. The stick catches on the ground, causing the dog to release it. As it turns to pick it up, the child scoops both into her arms.

Heavy Road Hog.name:
沉重的公路野猪
Heavy Road Hog

Text.text:
抛光铬制车把如一对獠牙般拱在引擎缸体上方，更添这辆机车的兽性。光滑的黑色侧板上贴着燃焰贴花，引擎低沉粗粝的咆哮震得空气发颤；车辆轰鸣掠过，高耸熏黑的排气管喷吐滚滚烟尘。
Polished chrome handlebars arch over the engine block like a pair of tusks, adding to the bike’s bestial nature. Flaming decals adorn the smooth black sidings, and the throaty roar of the engine causes the air to tremble as the vehicle thunders past, spewing smoke from tall, blackened exhausts.

Overheard Speech By A Rebel.name:
叛军的窃窃私语
Overheard Speech By A Rebel

Text.text:
“别让自己对真相视而不见。此地并非山巅上的辉煌之城，而是一台吞吃贫困与绝望之人的巨型绞肉机——而现在正是该让它改换口味、由别的东西来填饱它胃口的时代了。”
“Do not blind yourselves to the truth. This place is no shining city on a hill, but a gargantuan meat grinder feeding on the poor and desperate—and it is high time someone else sated its appetite.”

山丘像一只握紧的拳头般隆起，裸露的岩脊拉出一道漫长的褶皱。在这道皱眉般的岩檐下，你看见一处浅浅的洞穴——只要风别从相反的方向狂吹，就足以遮蔽天气，令你保持干燥。
The hill knuckles over in a long wrinkle of exposed rock. Beneath the overhang formed by this furrowed brow you see a shallow cave—enough shelter to stay dry from the weather so long as the wind doesn’t blow too hard the wrong way.

乍看之下，它只是一支做工精良的木笛；然而这把结构精巧的吹箭筒，才是刺客的终极利器。为了维持这件朴素乐器的假象，唯有老练的眼力才能看出：笛身的指孔并未真正贯穿木料。它的表面没有任何雕刻，取而代之的是——在筒身内壁以永不褪色的金银墨巧妙绘上符印，专为提升精准与穿透之力而设。
At first glance just a well-crafted wooden flute, this cleverly constructed blowgun is the ultimate assassin’s tool. To preserve the illusion of a more simple instrument, it requires a practiced eye to see that the flute’s finger holes are not truly bored all the way through the wood. Instead of engravings upon its surface, sigils have been cleverly painted along the inside of the blowgun’s tube in indelible gold and silver inks, designed to enhance accuracy and force.

Dark Young In Forest.name:
森林中的黑暗之子
Dark Young In Forest

Text.text:
深入那片浓绿的幽暗，越过寻常森林令人安心的边界，一棵怪树立于无声的空地上，既无虫鸣，也不见蒲公英或马利筋那般飘荡的轻絮。粗壮的枝条从树身突兀伸出，朝天指去，像晒得铜亮、肌肉虬结的手臂。树根般粗厚的东西在树基处拱出地面，你这才看清——那其实是生着蹄子的腿。树干上有什么在蠕动——一对对眼睛。它们倏然睁开，而在其下，饥渴的嘴巴大张，黑洞洞地裂开。

~ Envisioned by njorgard

Deep into the green dark, past the comfortable edge of a normal forest, a strange tree stands in a soundless clearing, with no sound of insects nor floating ephemera of dandelion or milkweed. Thick branches jut from the tree, aimed upward like muscled, sun-burnished arms. What looks like thick roots at the base of the tree arc up out of the earth, and you notice they are actually hoofed legs. Something on the trunk moves—multiple eyes. They open, and below them hungry mouths gape wide.

~ Envisioned by njorgard

刺耳的钢铁撞击声尖啸着从远处传来，预告着一场兵刃相交的冲突。你赶到现场，本以为会撞上危险，却只见一名身形紧凑的身影披着板甲，正与一面漂浮的盾牌进行练习对战——那盾牌自顾自地上下浮动、左右闪避。她的黑发利落地扎成马尾，绿眼在眸底跳动着自己的光；她旋身劈斩，手中长戟几乎与她等高，追逐着那面舞动的盾。你走近时，她将长戟的尾端稳稳杵地，随意朝盾牌一指；盾牌便贴近她左臂旁悬停。她的注意力转向你，你这才看清她犬齿尖锐得异常，昭示着并非人类的族裔。

~ Played by TheGeek1911

The shrill clang of clashing steel heralds a conflict-at-arms from a distance. You arrive on the scene expecting danger, but you instead see a compact figure clad in plate armor, in practice combat against a floating shield bobbing and weaving of its own accord. Her black hair is tied into a practical ponytail, her green eyes flashing with their own inner light, as she whirls and cuts at the dancing shield with a halberd nearly as long as she is tall. As you approach she grounds the butt of her halberd and gestures casually to the shield, which hovers close to her left arm. Her focus now on you, you notice a pronounced point to her canines, indicating non-human ancestry.

~ Played by TheGeek1911

Inspiration For A Reluctant King.name:
一位不情愿的国王的灵感
Inspiration For A Reluctant King

Text.text:
“真正被人铭记的国王有多少？又有多少长眠在这座城堡之下的陵墓里，不过成了史书里的陈年趣闻？我的领主，若您想奠定不朽的名声，那将存在于您子民感恩的心中——因为就在今天，您终于开始为他们而治。”
“How many kings are truly remembered? How many lie in tombs beneath this castle as nothing more than historical curios? My lord, if you wish to secure a lasting legacy, it will be in the grateful minds of your people who, today, you finally started to serve.”

Thundersnow Over An Arid Region.name:
干旱之地上的雷雪
Thundersnow Over An Arid Region

Text.text:
在平日里，这片由粗粝沙海与残酷热浪构成的世界已然无情；而这阵白色浪潮——伴随着暴怒风暴神祇的闪光与轰鸣——更是罕见而骇人的异象。它可怖且足以改写一切，如野马般撕扯沙地，为草木覆上一层被封存于晶体中的水霜。雷雪终将掠过，但那一声声炸裂的回响仍黏腻地召回它的威能余韵；待其远去，身后只剩一方陌生、异质、难以辨认的世界。
A world of gritty sand and brutal heat is an unforgiving place in normal conditions, but this wave of white—heralded by the flashing and crashing of angry storm gods—is a rare and frightful thing. Terrible and transformative, it tears at the sand like wild horses and dusts the flora with a layer of water locked away in crystalline form. The thundersnow passes, but its pealing booms call back a cloying echo of its power, and an unrecognizable, alien world is left in its wake.

Orenthal Ironhands.name:
奥伦萨尔·铁手
Orenthal Ironhands

Text.text:
他最醒目的特征，是那把巨大雪白的胡须。他光头像鸡蛋般圆滑，浅褐色的眼睛在黝黑的皮肤深处闪着光。像他的矮人同族一样，他宽阔而强壮，沉默内敛得像座山——至少在第二大杯麦酒下肚之前。身披精金板甲，位移斗篷的黯淡微光在身侧忽明忽暗；他站得稳如磐石，双拇指牢牢勾在山丘巨人力量腰带上。腰带下悬着一柄屠巨战斧，若温言劝化不成，便准备用武力“感化”巨人。

~ Played by The Only Waldo with

A massive white beard is top among his impressive features. He is bald as an egg, and light brown eyes shine from the darkness of his skin. Like his dwarven kinsmen he is broad and powerful, as quiet and reserved as a mountain, at least until the second tankard of ale. Clad in adamantine plate and the dull flicker of a cloak of displacement, he stands with thumbs firmly hooked on a belt of hill giant strength. From it swings a giant-slayer battleaxe, ready to convert the giants by force if kindness fails.

~ Played by The Only Waldo with

这套衣物谈不上时髦，却格外实用；毕竟，一个人若能应对所有天气，自有其可取之处。厚实的靴子结实耐穿，显然是照着经久用去打制的；羊毛衬衫、背心与手套即便浸湿也能保暖；再配上一件防水带兜帽的斗篷，以及系在皮质马裤外的宽皮带——整套行头为长年奔波在路上的人许诺了舒适与可靠的机能。
This set of clothing is more practical than stylish, though there is something to be said for a person prepared for all weather. Thick boots cobbled with an eye for longevity, a woolen shirt, vest and gloves that stay warm even when wet, a waterproofed, hooded cloak, and a wide leather belt over leather breeches make up a set of clothing that promises comfort and functionality for someone whose life is lived primarily on the road.

“强悍”是你看到这名战士身躯时最先浮现的词。他们裸露的上身肌肉线条分明，站姿老练，蓄势待发。胸口正中，仿佛将其一分为二，鳞片自此蔓延开来。数十片蓝色鳞片沿着脖颈一路向上，连接着一张细长的口吻，蛇信忽明忽暗地吐动，眼神则如蝰蛇般冰冷。其一手握着弯刃阴狠的长剑，另一手执着长弓，皆可在转瞬间出手。
Powerful is the first word that comes to mind when looking at this warrior’s body. Their uncovered torso is lined with well-defined muscle and their stance is practiced and ready. In the centre of their chest, as if splitting it in two, the scales begin. Dozens of blue scales run up their neck leading to a long snout with a flickering snake’s tongue and the eyes of a viper. They hold a sword, with a wicked curved blade, in one hand a longbow in the other, each ready to be used at a moments notice.

Plane Of Magma.name:
熔岩位面
Plane Of Magma

Text.text:
群山在四面八方拔地而起，向天空喷吐着剧毒的烟雾。你脚下的大地仿佛半熔半凝，黏滞地蠕动、缓缓流淌。空气腐蚀刺鼻，令人无法呼吸，浓重的毒雾与不息的烟尘将一切堵得严严实实。脚下地面隆隆震颤、剧烈摇晃，又一座火山轰然喷发，将炽热的熔岩巨石高高抛向天空，随即如暴雨般倾泻而下。
Soaring mountains rise on all sides, spewing toxic fumes into the air. The ground beneath you appears half-molten, sluggishly shifting and flowing. The air, caustic and unbreathable, is choked with fumes and constant smoke. The ground beneath you rumbles and quakes as another volcano erupts, hurling molten rock high into the air, only to come raining down.

Last Round Fired From Automatic Pistol.name:
自动手枪打出的最后一轮
Last Round Fired From Automatic Pistol

Text.text: 手枪弹匣里子弹倾泻而出的有节奏的砰、砰、砰，渐渐变成空洞的咔哒声。随之消散的，还有爆裂的枪响与叮当作响的弹壳声——对所有人而言都再明显不过：最后一轮已经打光了。 The rhythmic thump-thump-thump of the rounds streaming out of the pistol's magazine shifts to hollow clicks. With it dies the sound of explosive gunshots and pinging bullet casings—it's devastatingly obvious to everybody that the last round has been fired.

Flame Blade Using Components.name:
使用火焰之刃的施法成分
Flame Blade Using Components

Text.text:
被碾碎的漆树叶余热正从你紧握的指缝间逸散。你收紧拳头，火星向前蔓延、凝聚，拉出一道细长而集束的火焰轨迹。它轻若鸿毛，却以灼热扭曲空气；你稳稳握住这柄火焰之刃，蓄势待发。
The heat of the crushed sumac leaf is escaping through your clenched fingers. You tighten your fist, and the sparks spread forward, congeal, to create a long streak of focused flame. Light as a feather, warping the air with heat, you grip the flame blade steadily, ready.

自虚空而来，潜行着一具祖辈恐惧的化身。它瘦削而如猛禽般的躯体覆满闪烁鳞片，映出某个异界现实的色泽。生物以适于猛扑的跖行后腿立身，过长的双臂末端是利爪如缝衣针般修长的手掌。百余条触须在它肩头翻搅蠕动，扭折光线以歪曲其真实方位；而那颗食人鱼般的头颅上，一双空洞的眼睛不眨不移地死死凝视。
From the void stalks an embodiment of ancestral fear. Its lean, raptorial body is coated in shimmering scales that reflect the hues of some other reality. The creature stands on digitigrade legs designed for pouncing, its overlong arms ending in hands with claws longer than sewing needles. A hundred tentacles writhe about its shoulders, bending light to distort its true position, while vacuous eyes stare unblinking from its piranha head.

起初，它看起来像是一座从水中突兀刺起的城堡。可很快你便看清：虽有几处凿砌的石壁贴着浪面，但大部分建筑其实立在一座嶙峋岩岛之上。城墙高耸、无窗，墙头以锯齿状垛口收边。通往要塞的唯一入口似乎是一处海蚀洞，此刻正被涨潮的海水彻底淹没。
At first it appears to be a castle thrust up from the water. But soon you see that while some of the worked stone touches the waves, most of it stands upon a rocky island. The walls rise high and windowless, topped with crenellations. The only way into the fortress seems to be a sea cave currently swamped by the high tide.

I Ride A Giant Dragonfly.name:
我骑着一只巨型蜻蜓
I Ride A Giant Dragonfly

Text.text:
