蜻蜓那宝石般流光溢彩的躯体之美，随着它的体型一同被放大。它的四片翅膀像拉丝糖做成的薄片，纤细得让我担心这只巨虫是否无法支援一名骑手。但事实证明是我多虑了——需要适应的反而是我。它载着我展开一段鞭甩般的飞行，猛然前窜，悬停原地，又左右横掠扫过。它是一匹灵巧的坐骑，绝对值得去驾驭。
The beauty of the dragonfly’s jewel-hued body is magnified along with its size. Its four wings look like panes of spun sugar, so delicate I worry that this giant insect won’t be able to support a rider. But my worries are misplaced, as I’m the one who needs to adapt. It carries me on a whiplash flight, darting forward, hovering in place, and strafing from side to side. It’s an agile mount, well worth mastering.

Token Of The Seelie Court.name:
妖精宫廷信物
Token Of The Seelie Court

Text.text:
这枚小饰物呈一片宽阔的箭形叶，翠绿如翡，叶缘却染着秋日的铜色。它由某种轻盈却坚韧的材质铸成——是金属？还是雕琢的石，或抛光的木——其上以细密的银丝镂花描绘着夏妖精宫廷的徽记，令这枚信物隐隐散发出一股低沉而持续的脉动之力。
The trinket appears as a broad, arrow-shaped leaf, emerald green tinged with the copper of autumn at its edges. Composed of some kind of light but resilient metal—or is it worked stone, or polished wood—and bearing the symbol of the Seelie Court in fine, silver filigree, the token exudes a subtle, thrumming power.

Elemental Plane Of Air.name:
元素气之位面
Elemental Plane Of Air

Text.text:
苍穹向四面八方无尽压来——一片完美的蓝宝石穹幕，其间点缀着被风吹散的白云。头顶、脚下、左右皆是天空，绵延不绝，浩瀚得令人眩晕。一簇簇土色的形体、披着青绿的浮岛在风的流流中漫无目的地漂移；而远方，一场规模骇人的风暴将地平线染得幽暗，电光在其中明灭闪烁。紧随其后，雷声滚滚而至。
The sky looms infinitely in all directions—a perfect sapphire expanse dotted with white, windswept clouds. Above, below, on all sides, the sky spans, seemingly endless, dizzying in its enormity. A cluster of earthen forms, green-shrouded islands, float aimlessly on the wind currents, while in the distance a storm of epic proportions darkens the horizon and flickers with lightning. The thunder follows soon after.

Calm And Confident Intergalactic Diploma.name:
沉着自信的星际外交官
Calm And Confident Intergalactic Diplomat

Text.text:
她一踏入房间，仿佛有一口深邃的关注之井在她周身盘旋——所有目光都追随着她审慎而坚决的步伐。显然，她赢得了极高的敬重。她身着象征职务的雅致粉蓝长袍，亮泽的长发编成繁复的辫饰，身姿挺拔，目光沉稳如钉。随即，她开口，带着肩负重担之人的威仪：嗓音克制而有分寸，每一个字都经过精密推敲。
As she enters the room, it is as though a great well of attention circles her—all eyes watch her deliberate and purposeful movements. Clearly, she commands great respect. Clad in the elegant powder blue robes of her office, her glossy hair in an elaborate braid, she stands erect with a steady gaze. And she speaks with the authority of one with a great burden upon her shoulders: a measured voice pronouncing calculated words.

Spell Scroll (Arcane).name:
法术卷轴（奥术）
Spell Scroll (Arcane)

Text.text:
这张卷轴堪称艺术品。压制的犊皮纸上，精湛的书法行云流水；羊皮纸边框则以闪烁金箔勾勒出蜿蜒的花卉纹样，其间点缀着会动的法师与巨龙图像，宛如在边缘悄然起舞。
This scroll is a work of art. Masterful calligraphy decorates the pressed vellum, and the parchment is bordered by animated images of wizards and dragons amid winding floral designs in shimmering gold leaf.

就在“宝珠与高塔”旅店以西、正对着城市广场的地方，一片剧院群向外敞开，吸引来一股新兴的艺术社群汇聚尖塔巷。周边最具都市气息的建筑密集成团：商场与制作工坊塞得满满当当，零售铺面之上是层层公寓，街区间还点缀着社区花园。吟游诗人常在此独奏献艺，巡演的剧团与音乐演出则大约每月到访一次。这里设有古典阶段、黑盒剧场，以及一所艺术学校，内含一座实验剧场。
Just west of the Orb and Tower inn, and opening onto the city’s plaza, is a set of theaters that have attracted a new arts community to Spirewych. The most urban buildings are clustered nearby, full of malls and production facilities, apartments over retail spaces, and community gardens. Bards give solo performances, and touring theater groups and musical acts arrive about once a month. There is the classical stage, a black box theater, and a school of arts with an experimental theater.

Pass Without Trace.name:
无踪无迹
Pass Without Trace

Text.text:
你低声呢喃法术的词句，伸手触及你的伙伴，仿佛去攫住他们的影子。刹那间，他们的影子违逆了光，向你淌来，旋卷着汇入你脚边那口黑暗之井。随即影子猛然弹回各自的主人身侧，连同一缕魔法一并带回——将隐秘与寂静牢牢缚在他们身上，如同影子紧贴着鞋底一般。
You whisper the words of the spell and reach out to your companions, as if grabbing their shadows. For a moment their shadows disobey the light and flow toward you, swirling into the well of darkness around your feet. Then they snap back to their owners, carrying with them a magic that bonds subtlety and silence to them as tightly as their shadows stick to their shoes.

Reliquary Holy Symbol.name:
圣匣圣徽
Reliquary Holy Symbol

Text.text:
这只沉甸甸的铜制圣物匣雕纹繁复，点缀着半宝石，握在手中便能感到一股清晰可触的圣力随之脉动。据传其中封存着其持有者信仰所供奉的神圣遗物。
Bearing intricate designs and decorated with semiprecious stones, this weighty copper reliquary carries with it a palpable holy power. It is rumored to house holy relics of its wielder’s faith.

Battle Cruiser: Orderly Bridge.name:
战列巡洋舰：井然有序的舰桥
Battle Cruiser: Orderly Bridge

Text.text:
这座冷峻的军用舰桥在设计与陈设上无一不臻于完美，连同船员也一样。水手们身着一丝不苟的制服——近乎虔诚地恪守条例——立于各自岗位；而舰长端坐椅中，目光精明锐利，审慎地审视着一切。
Every aspect of the stark military bridge is immaculate in design and presentation, including the crew. Crisp uniforms—adhering fervently to regulations—garb the deckhands, while the captain watches from her chair with a shrewd, discerning gaze.

Black Dragon Wyrmling Encounter.name:
黑龙雏龙遭遇
Black Dragon Wyrmling Encounter

Text.text:
这头龙裔生物外形如蛇，体型大致相当于一只大型犬，蜿蜒着朝你滑来。它的眼神锐利而狡黠，鳞片漆黑如黑曜石，鼻孔张开，贪婪地吸入你的气味。它咧开大口，弯钩般的狰狞利齿寒光一闪。唾液滴落，腐蚀般刺鼻，幽绿起泡，嘶嘶作响。
The draconic creature, serpentine in appearance and roughly the size of a large dog, slithers toward you. Its eyes are sharp and cunning, its scales black like obsidian, its nostrils flared as it breathes in your scent. Hooked, wicked teeth flash as its maw gapes. Saliva drips, caustic, green, and hissing.

Greeting From A Snake God.name:
蛇神的问候
Greeting From A Snake God

Text.text:
“你好啊，小老鼠们。你们竟走了这么远来寻我，靠着那小小的身躯一路跋涉，我受宠若惊。我总是惊叹，如此微小的躯壳竟能盛得下如此宏大的心。”
“Hello, little mice. I am flattered that you have journeyed so very far to find me, carried by your tiny bodies all this way. I am always amazed that such small vessels can hold such grand hearts.”

Ring Of Invisibility.name:
隐形戒指
Ring Of Invisibility

Text.text:
这枚戒指由通透的陶瓷精心铸成，完美无瑕，若非借助魔法绝不可能造就。佩戴其上时，它几乎让人难以察觉，轻易便从视线中滑过。
Crafted out of transparent ceramic so perfect and flawless it could not possibly have been made without magic, this ring, while worn, is extremely easy to overlook.

Ziggurat In The Grasslands.name:
草原之上的金字形神塔
Ziggurat In The Grasslands

Text.text:
草原在风中起伏翻涌，奔涌的声响仿佛细小的浪头轻轻拍碎在岸边。地平线上如灯塔般突兀显现，一座巨构自平坦的地貌中拔地而起：一座庞大的石质阶梯金字塔。冷色调的石阶层层递升，色泽随高度流转——底部是暮色般的紫，中段转为蔚蓝，顶端则澄澈如晴空。峰顶的神殿造型简朴，四面各开一道敞口门槛，通向其内。你看不见任何人巡逻，也不见周遭有任何聚居地。但空气中清晰弥漫的魔法气息，让这里绝不能被称作死寂。
The grassland ripples in the wind, the rushing sound like small waves breaking softly against the shore. Like a beacon appearing on the horizon, an edifice rises from the flat landscape: a colossal ziggurat of stone. The cool-toned stone tiers shift in color from a dusky purple at the bottom, to azure at the middle, to clear-sky blue at the top. The temple at the peak is simple in design with four open thresholds leading into it, one on each side. You see no one patrolling the structure, no settlements of any kind around. But with the clear emanation of magic imbuing the air, this place cannot be called lifeless.

Izalguun Healer.name:
伊扎尔古恩治疗师
Izalguun Healer

Text.text:
这名游牧旅者体型如马，生有六肢，绷紧的肌肉筋腱随动作起伏。生物身上不见任何科技装饰；取而代之的是颈间摇曳的部族护符，皮革束带箍住各处关节，手中紧握盾与矛。长矛缀着羽饰，象征武勇。它扁平而无五官的面孔上伸出横向的肥厚眼柄。宛如半人马般，它以四肢小跑向前。
Horse-sized and six-limbed, this nomadic traveler flexes sinews of taut muscle. No technology adorns the creature; instead, tribal amulets swing from the neck, leather straps ring the joints, and in its hands it clasps a shield and spear. The spear bears feathers, symbolic of martial prowess. Horizontal fatty eyestalks extend from its flat, featureless face. Like a centaur, it canters forth upon four limbs.

绿洲——这片被四面延绵数里荒漠包围的狭小却珍贵的栖身之所——静卧在一座巍峨沙丘的阴影之下。一汪蓝绿相间、马蹄形的淡水渗出湖在阳光里粼粼闪耀，鱼儿懒散地漂游在被日头烘暖的深处。沿着一条伸入湖中的狭长沙洲，色彩斑斓的帐篷在干燥的风里猎猎轻摆；而在绿洲的心脏处，一座红瓦屋顶的宝塔亭亭而立，为在这片恶地中寻求荫蔽与喘息的人们提供遮护与歇脚之处。
The oasis—a small but precious refuge from the surrounding desert that spans leagues in all directions—stands beneath the shadow of a towering dune. A blue-green horseshoe-shaped freshwater seep lake glimmers in the sunlight, and fish float lazily in its sun-warmed depths. Along a spit of land extending into the lake, colorful tents flutter in the arid breeze, and at the oasis’s heart, a red-roofed pagoda stands, offering shade and respite to those who seek it here in the badlands.

Watchmen's Ruined Barracks.name:
守望者的残破兵营
Watchmen's Ruined Barracks

Text.text:
外侧的地堡城墙在城边依旧巍然，但与之相连的营房却多半空置，尘埃微粒在小窗投下的日光里漂浮闪烁。仅剩的寥寥士兵栖身于一座日渐衰败的神力构筑之所，两侧矗立着天使与恶魔的雕像，永恒厮杀、彼此纠缠。穿过入口便是庭院与喷泉，昔日对外张弩的弩炮，如今因条约而调转方向，对准城内，用以警告这座城市自己的居民。

~ Envisioned by YourFavoriteTim

The outer bunker wall stands strong at the city’s edge, but the attached barracks are mostly empty quarters full of dust motes floating in rays of sun streaming through small windows. The handful of soldiers left are housed in a declining edifice of divine force, flanked by statues of an angel and devil locked in eternal combat. Through the entrance is a courtyard and fountain, where ballistae once aimed outward are now turned by treaties inward to warn the city’s own residents.

~ Envisioned by YourFavoriteTim

Command Center With Power Crystals.name:
配备能量水晶的指挥中心
Command Center With Power Crystals

Text.text:
在一座由多面墙体构成的大厅里，半透明岩石雕成的宏伟方尖碑辉光闪耀。你沿着一条被踝深薄雾覆盖的小径前行。仪式充满元素之力——冰里燃着火，玻璃里盛着光——水晶缓慢变幻色泽。行至尽头，你来到一张嵌有六个凹槽的桌前，其中五个凹槽里放着力量水晶。一具工匠打造的高度先进的魔像，晶体与金属铸就，静候在桌后。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

In a hall of multi-faceted walls and majestic, shining obelisks of translucent rock, you walk down a path of ankle-deep mist. The ceremony is elemental, ice full of fire, glass full of light, as the crystals slowly change color. At the end of the walk you reach a table with six slots, in five of which are power crystals. An artificer’s highly advanced golem, made of crystal and metal, waits behind the table.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Giant Lizard With Smoldering Eyes.name:
双眼熔灼的巨蜥
Giant Lizard With Smoldering Eyes

Text.text:
自浓密的灌木丛中，一头巨蜥缓缓现身，数百磅的鳞甲与肌腱在阴影里起伏。它是来自最深邃丛林的翠绿半神，是远古岁月遗留的泰坦；那蜥蜴般的形体本身便要求你俯首顺从。它的双眼如余烬般灼亮，直刺灵魂，化作荒野不驯的意志——一具活生生的证词，昭示着自然阴沉而可怖的伟力。
From the dense thicket, a gargantuan lizard slowly emerges, hundreds of pounds of scale and sinew. It is an emerald demigod from the deepest jungles and a titan of bygone times, and its saurian form demands abeyance. With smoldering eyes that pierce your soul, it embodies the untamed spirit of the wild, a living testimony of nature’s ominous might.

Dungeon: Descending Hall.name:
地城：下行长廊
Dungeon: Descending Hall

Text.text:
大厅的地面向下倾斜成一道平滑的坡道，引你更深入地城之中。每迈出一步，空气便更冷一分；而当你意识到自己正不断潜入地表之下，一股无形的压迫悄然沉入你的潜意识。几只老鼠与其他小生物从你脚边仓皇窜开——它们不习惯自己的领地被打扰。
The floor of the hall drops into a smooth descent, leading further into the dungeon. The air grows colder with each step, and a pressure settles on your subconscious with the knowledge of delving deeper below the surface. A few rats and other small creatures scurry from underfoot, unused to having their domain disturbed.

Spider's Shadow In Cave.name:
洞窟中的蛛影
Spider's Shadow In Cave

Text.text:
你从岩架上望去，只见一排细长的钟乳石向下垂挂，然而其中一根忽然动了。那根本不是钟乳石——而是一只巨型蜘蛛的长腿！你一眼望见，呼吸猛地卡在喉间，口中瞬间干涩得像被抽走了所有水分。
From the ledge you see a series of narrow stalactites extending down, but then one of them moves. They are the legs of a massive spider! Your breath catches in your throat at the sight, and your mouth suddenly feels dry

Ancient Warrior's Shield.name:
远古战士之盾
Ancient Warrior's Shield

Text.text:
这面朴素的盾牌经历了无数战斗，每一场都在那磨损斑驳的表面留下印记。盾面上饰着一枚纹章——曾经高贵而鲜亮——如今色彩早已褪去，连名号也随岁月湮没。它在堆叠的金币与珠宝之间笔直伫立，等待下一位主人；那份沉着与耐心，仿佛是历经数百年才锤炼出的。
This simple shield has seen countless battles, each leaving its mark on the well-worn surface. A coat of arms—once noble and bright—adorns its face, the colors long since faded and forgotten. It stands proudly to attention amid the piles of gold and jewels awaiting its next master with a patience born of centuries.

Subterranean Dwarven City Streets.name:
地下矮人城的街道
Subterranean Dwarven City Streets

Text.text:
街道本身仿佛从黑色岩石中凿刻而成，被狭窄的小巷与喧嚣的干道一分为二。以天然气为燃料的街灯幽幽发光，照亮行道，将诡异而细长的影子拖曳在这座地下城的墙面上。矮人们沿着井然有序的车道行走，牵引着野牛与驮满货物的公羊。
The streets themselves appear carved from the black stone, bisected by narrow alleyways and bustling thoroughfares. Lamps, glowing with natural gas, illuminate the walkways and cast strange, elongated shadows across the walls of the subterranean city. Dwarves walk in orderly lanes, leading aurochs and rams laden with goods.

狭窄而险峻的栈桥横跨码头的每一层。间隔摆放的小灯在结冰的通道上投下昏暗的光斑——却几乎照不亮前路。这里仿佛某个被遗忘、危机四伏的偏僻角落里噩梦般的街巷，灯光时明时灭，古老的电线从锈蚀的灯罩中垂落，磨损开裂、松松垮垮。带翼的生物在头顶阴森扑振，尖啸着划破夜色，以锐利的黄眼冷冷注视着一切。
Narrow, perilous catwalks span each level of the docks. Small lamps, set at intervals, cast dim pools on the icy causeway—doing little to light the way. Like a nightmarish street in some forgotten, dangerous backwater, the lamps flicker sporadically, their ancient wires hanging frayed and loose from rusted housings. Winged creatures flutter menacingly overhead, shrieking into the night as they watch all with piercing yellow eyes.

Sundries From A Sahuagin.name:
来自一名萨胡金的杂物
Sundries From A Sahuagin

Text.text:
一枚巨大的尖刺贝壳挂在这只鱼类生物的脖颈上，粗糙的纤维绳将它系得紧紧的；贝壳内壁泛着淡淡的胭粉色——那是猎人号角，用来向岸上的人宣告死亡。你找到的唯一另一件物品，是一只被血浸透的帆布袋，里面塞满了各式耳朵：人类的、兽人的，但大多是精灵的。
A large spiked shell with a blush-pink interior hangs on a fibrous string around the piscine creature’s neck—a hunter’s horn to signal death to those ashore. The only other item you find is a blood-soaked canvas pouch full of different ears: human, orc, but mostly elvish.

Philter Of Love.name:
爱情媚药
Philter Of Love

Text.text:
举到光下，这只碗形玻璃瓶里的液体泛着淡淡的粉红。你从心形瓶塞处嗅到一丝若有若无的玫瑰露香气，细小气泡从瓶底不断升起，仿佛在许诺一口微微起泡的轻啜。
Held up to the light, the liquid in this bowl-shaped glass bottle has a slightly pink hue. You smell the faintest hint of rose water coming through the heart-shaped bottle stopper, and bubbles rise from the bottom continuously, promising a fizzy sip.

Jaemir Marylandae.name:
杰米尔·马里兰戴
Jaemir Marylandae

Text.text:
这名半精灵举止间的贵族气度一眼可见。更令人印象深刻的是他左眼的钴蓝与灰色交织，以及右眼旁的白色伤疤——在他苍白的皮肤与发色映衬下，仿佛微微发亮。然而他脸上的神情却带着一抹随时要抛出的调情玩笑。他留着船锚胡与鬓角。奇异的符文与六边形纹身自他左臂一路倾泻至手腕，直到他披上板甲护甲才会被遮住。他持戟与弩，立定身形，直面对上你。

~ Played by James with

The nobility of the half-elf is obvious in his bearing. He is only more impressive for the cobalt and gray of his left eye and the white scar of his right, shining from the paleness of his skin and hair. The look on his face, though, is touched with a flirtatious joke at the ready. He wears an anchor beard and sideburns. Strange runes and hexagonal tattoos cascade down his left arm to the wrist, visible until he puts on his plate armor. With halberd and crossbow, he stands to face you.

~ Played by James with

Long-range Exploratory Vessel: Outer Hul.name:
远程探索舰：外壳
Long-range Exploratory Vessel: Outer Hull

Text.text:
这艘勘探船的外观本身就在讲述一个故事：在未测宇宙最遥远的边境，一段关于冒险、勇气与牺牲的传奇。舰体遍布撞击坑、爆炸焦痕等痕迹；船壳仿佛由各色金属拼补而成，只靠希望将其勉强系在一起。
The exterior of the exploratory vessel tells a story, one of adventure, bravery, and sacrifice—in the farthest reaches of the uncharted cosmos. The craft is covered in impact craters, blast markers, and more, and the hull is a patchwork collection of different metals held together by hope.

Temple To A Goddess Of Commerce.name:
献给商业女神的神殿
Temple To A Goddess Of Commerce

Text.text: 金、银、铜的硬币纹样装点着神殿的墙壁；这座神殿无论从里到外，外观都与本地的银行如出一辙。主殿中央的高台上立着一架巨大的算盘，嵌着黑红两色的算珠，每一颗都粗得几乎有祭司的脑袋那么大。侍僧与信众默然凝视着这件器具，沉入无声的思量。背景里，有人拨弄着更小的算盘，噼啪与咔嗒声此起彼伏。 一名祭司以克制而稳健的步伐上前，登上高台顶端，将双手按在其中一颗算珠上。他沿着算杆推移算珠，石质的刮擦声在殿内回荡。一个戴着商人帽的男人低声咒骂，气急败坏地跺脚离开神殿。另一个则赞叹地呜呼一声，他的同伴们带着祝贺意味拍着他的背。 Golden, silver, and copper coin motifs decorate the walls of the temple, which from within and without shares its appearance with banks of the region. A tall abacus sits upon a dais in the center of the main chamber, fitted with black and red beads as big around as the priests’ heads. Acolytes and worshippers gaze upon the tool in silent contemplation. The clicking and clacking of smaller abacuses are heard as they are fiddled with in the background. One priest steps forward with measured steps to the top of the dais and places his hands on one of the beads. He moves it along the wire, the stony scrape echoing. A man in a merchant’s cap curses under his breath and stomps out of the temple in a huff. Another whoops with appreciation, his associates clapping him on the back in a congratulatory manner.

Supreme Temple To The Gods.name:
献予神祇的至高神殿
Supreme Temple To The Gods

Text.text:
若要引起众神殿的注目，便须攀上那历经十亿年岁月的巨岩，直达峰顶。在神祇俯垂的目光与你之间，星河的微光光晕昼夜不息地循轨流转。你手脚的刺痛、每一束肌肉的灼痛，都在为这处圣地作证，也诉说着它索取的代价。相比献给教堂的供奉，或在山谷神庙的祷告，这座高山更渴求朝圣者的韧性。

~ 一位英雄 构想

To catch the attention of the pantheon, one must climb the rock of a billion-year epoch to its summit. Between the downturned gaze of the gods and you, a shimmering nimbus of the starry galaxy turns on its course both day and night. The pain in your hands and feet, in your every muscle, testifies to this holy site and the toll it extracts. Beyond the offering to a church or the prayer at a valley temple, the mountain calls for a pilgrim’s resilience.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Child Warlock Casting Hypnotic Pattern.name:
孩童邪术师施放「催眠图纹」
Child Warlock Casting Hypnotic Pattern

Text.text:
邪恶的笑意悄然爬上她那张无辜的脸庞，女孩从挂在颈间链子上的水晶小瓶里拔出塞子。她的嘴唇扭成恶毒的冷笑，低声呢喃着法术的奥秘词句，将发光的粉尘倾入掌心——随即朝敌人吹去。凄厉的尖啸撕裂空气，几张惨白的脸在她的仇敌周遭盘旋——张口哀恸，哭号如女妖。孩童玩具的幽影列队前行，每一件都在对稚嫩纯真的拙劣模仿中被残酷毁坏、伤痕累累。

~ Envisioned by thebigham on Discord

An evil smile creeps over her innocent face as the girl pulls the stopper from the crystal vial that dangles from a chain around her neck. Her lips curl into a malicious sneer as she whispers the arcane words of the spell and empties the glowing dust into her palm—then blows it toward her enemies. A horrible shrieking fills the air, as pale faces—mouths agape in sorrow as they wail like banshees—swirl around her foes. The spectral forms of children's toys march forward, each one horrifically maimed and scarred in a parody of juvenile innocence.

~ Envisioned by thebigham on Discord

一条河流自高原倾泻而下，贯穿城心，将这座大都会一分为二。刺耳的口令声、护甲的碰撞声与钢铁的铿锵声交织成浪，几乎要将不习惯这里军旅气息的人淹没。新兵成群结队地操练，用木制武器反复演练动作，又以紧密队形踏过鹅卵石路行军。尘土在靴底的搅动下沉沉悬在空中。城深处忽然传来号角的长鸣，提醒士兵某个按时到来的事务。可在这套严整的外壳之下，潜伏着某种阴影——停留得越久，越能察觉那股不对劲。街道两侧尽是废弃的房屋，木板封窗，屋内冷寂。墙壁与门板上满是抓痕，像利爪反复刮过。写着一串串姓名的告示贴得到处都是——那些在诡异情形下失踪的人。夜色将近，空气诡异地凝滞下来，镇民匆匆赶回家，锁紧门闩，合上百叶窗。令人不寒而栗的、非人的嚎叫撕开夜幕，近得让人心里发紧——哪怕这里仍在城墙之内。一名神色躲闪的男人推着一辆手推车，车上堆着血淋淋的肉，沿着巷子疾行而去，目光始终低垂，赶赴他那份阴森的差事。

~ 构想：Kory

A river runs down the plateau at the city’s heart, bisecting the metropolis. The din of barked orders, clattering armor, and clanging steel is almost overwhelming to those not accustomed to the military air of this place. Recruits train by the dozens, running drills with wooden weapons and marching the cobbled roads in tight formation. Dust hangs heavy in the air, stirred by booted feet. A horn bellows from deep within the city, alerting soldiers to some scheduled event. But beneath the regimented veneer, something dark lurks—the longer one lingers, the more apparent the wrongness becomes. Abandoned houses line the streets, boarded-up and cold within. Claw marks rake walls and doors. Posters with lists of names adorn every surface—those missing under mysterious circumstances. As night approaches, the air grows unnaturally still, and townsfolk rush home to lock their doors and shutter their windows. An unsettling, inhuman howl splits the night, too close for comfort, even here within the walls of the city. A shifty-looking man wheels a barrow laden with bloody meat down an alleyway, keeping his gaze low as he rushes to his grisly task.

~ Envisioned by Kory

乌青的天空中黑云翻涌，黯淡的太阳夹在其间，像一只刺目的猩红独眼。天穹咆哮，仿佛有巨兽在暮色迷雾里厮杀。火光勾勒着蒸汽，在其中跃动，如绯红闪电般乱窜，又以嘶嘶作响的滴雨般坠落。炽热而硫磺味浓烈的气息充塞空气。燃烧的楼宇与树木间，惊恐与剧痛的尖叫此起彼伏，人们徒劳地奔逃，试图躲开火焰风暴。少数人匍匐或蜷伏，有人伏在倒下的挚爱身旁啜泣。但更多的——无数的尸体——就那样按坠落时的姿势横陈，孤零零地散落各处。

~ 构想：Ulrizzel Evras

Black clouds roil in the bruised sky, the dim sun a glaring red eye among them. The heavens roar as if great beasts fight within its dusky mists. Fire limns the vapors, leaping amid them like crimson lightning and falling in hissing drops. A hot, sulfurous odor fills the air. Screams of panic and pain rise from among burning buildings and trees as people run from the firestorm in vain. A few crawl or crouch, with some weeping over fallen loved ones. But most of the countless corpses sprawl as they fell—alone.

~ Envisioned by Ulrizzel Evras

I Cast Find Traps.name:
我施放“侦测陷阱”
I Cast Find Traps

Text.text:
空气中弥漫着刺鼻的臭氧气息；当我以感官向外触及、施放法术时，一股魔力激流猛然穿体而过，令我不由得一颤。一抹强光自体内迸发，化作横扫而出的脉冲波，提醒我附近潜藏着陷阱。接下来才是难处：把它们找出来。
An ozone tang fills the air and a rush of magical energy shudders through me as I reach out with my senses, casting the spell. A flash of light pulses outward in a sweeping wave, alerting me to the presence of traps nearby. Now comes the hard part: finding them.

Serpentine Oracle Atop Ziggurat.name:
金字形神塔之巅的蛇形神谕者
Serpentine Oracle Atop Ziggurat

Text.text:
将炽烈的骄阳抛在身后，你踏入金字塔顶端那间清凉的石室，双腿因奋力攀登至此而隐隐酸痛。然而，你寻访的神谕者却出乎意料。你面前并非一位睿智老者，而是一只体型庞大的爬行生物，面容带着几分人形轮廓，锐利的黄色眼眸闪烁着聪慧的光。它以嘶嘶作响的细长吐息向你致意，随即问你为何来到它的神殿。

~ Envisioned by Angie on Discord

Leaving the blazing sun behind, you enter the cool stone chamber atop the ziggurat, your legs aching from the effort to reach it. Yet the oracle you sought out is not what you expect. Instead of a wizened sage you find a large reptilian creature with a somewhat humanoid face, its keen yellow eyes shining with intelligence. It speaks with a sibilant hiss as it greets you, and enquires why you have come to its temple.

~ Envisioned by Angie on Discord

I Cast Cloudkill.name:
我施放毒云术
I Cast Cloudkill

Text.text:
空气在我召唤下骤然变质，泛起幽绿的雾意，仿佛寒冬里吐出的白气一团。云雾贴着地面铺开，翻卷折叠，像一条诡异的爬虫般钻入每一道缝隙与角落。它的毒性直侵活物的每一寸毛孔。
The air transforms at my call, turning green and foggy, like a puff of breath in winter. The cloud spreads along the ground, turning and folding, crawling like a strange reptile into every nook and cranny. It’s toxic to the very pores of a living being.

你抬手一指，在你选定的点位，一道闪烁的、五彩斑斓的纯光位面骤然升起。不透明的光墙以奥秘的辉光灼灼发亮，将摇曳的光流洒向周遭的表面。它现身的同时，伴随着一阵几不可闻的嗡鸣。
You gesture, and from the point you choose, a shimmering, multicolored plane of pure light springs up. Opaque, the wall glows with an arcane brilliance, sending wavering rivulets across nearby surfaces. A barely discernible hum accompanies its appearance.

Welcome To An Ancient Library.name:
欢迎来到一座古老的图书馆
Welcome To An Ancient Library

Text.text:
“问候你。我向你保证，我们这座古老的图书馆珍藏着你所需的一切情报。不过也请牢记：此处接纳一切形式的知识——若你想翻阅某些条目，就要准备好承受随之而来的后果。”
“Greetings. I assure you our venerable library holds whatever information you may require. But do keep in mind that we accept all forms of knowledge here—if you wish to read certain items, be prepared to accept the consequences.”

Campsite In Forest.name:
森林营地
Campsite In Forest

Text.text:
有人清理了这片区域里的灌木与坠落的枯枝，开辟出一块小小的空地。空地中央是一处浅浅的石圈火坑。看起来搭建这处营地的人曾试图把火扑灭，但木柴仍在闷烧，干涩的柴烟味渗入潮湿的空气之中。
Someone has cleared the brush and fallen branches from this area to create a small clearing. At its center is a shallow firepit lined with stones. It looks like whoever made this campsite tried to put out the fire, but the wood still smolders, permeating the damp air with the dry smell of woodsmoke.

Ancient Gold Dragon.name:
远古金龙
Ancient Gold Dragon

Text.text:
你抬手遮住双眼，抵御眼前那庞大而璀璨的躯体迸射出的耀光。任何落在它身上的光似乎都会被十倍反射；透过指缝，你依稀辨出那无比宏伟的巨龙轮廓。你更多是凭直觉而非目视，感到一双蕴含无尽智慧的眼眸正温和地注视着你。
You shield your eyes from the brightness of the vast and glittering body before you. Any light that strikes it seems to reflect tenfold; from between your fingers you can make out its vast draconic shape. You sense more than see that two infinitely wise eyes gaze benevolently upon you.

Herbalist’s Yard.name:
草药师的庭院
Herbalist’s Yard

Text.text:
蜜蜂嗡嗡穿梭在一片由花朵与香草织就的小小乐园里。几座草编蜂箱立在苹果树的荫影下，昆虫汇成一团云雾将其团团围住，零星的个体在枝叶间掠飞，又飘向那井然有序的园圃上方盘旋。几只玉米秸偶——用稻草扎成的小人——被捆在木桩上，像守卫般立在一排排作物前。它们身上织入了色彩斑斓的毛线，以怪异的纹样缠绕，也许暗示着这些植物各自的特性。
Bees buzz through a little paradise of flowers and herbs. Several skeps stand in the shadow of an apple tree, and a cloud of the insects surrounds them, with individuals flitting through the branches and over to hover around the well-organized garden. Several corn dollies, little people formed from straw, are lashed to sticks to stand guard over rows of plants. Colorful yarn woven into them in peculiar patterns perhaps indicates something about the properties of the plants.

Cybernetic Leg Augmentation +3.name:
义体腿部强化 +3
Cybernetic Leg Augmentation +3

Text.text:
这是一件增幅的杰作。尖端基因疗法将这条腿塑造成臻于完美。它看起来棱角分明，仿佛在小腿与股四头肌里嵌入了矩形植入物——但并没有。未曾进行任何侵入性手术。这些完美而方正的腿部线条，实则是精心培育出的肌肉，经由实验性的血肉移植手段雕凿、淬硬而成。最终造就的肢体强悍无匹，如大理石般刻就，迅捷、灵巧，远超常理。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

This is a masterpiece of augmentation. Cutting-edge gene therapy has shaped this leg to perfection. It appears hard edged, as if rectangular implants have been inserted into the calf and quadriceps, but they have not. No invasive surgery has taken place. These perfect blocky leg shapes are in fact carefully cultivated muscles, chiseled and hardened by experimental flesh-graft procedures. The result is a limb of unparalleled strength, carved like marble, quick, and deft beyond measure.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

State University Of Technology And Thaum.name:
州立科技与奇术大学
State University Of Technology And Thaumaturgy

Text.text:
四座宏伟的建筑沿着铺石的四方庭院排开，庭院中央立着学校创始人的雕像——一手执圆规，另一手托着燃烧的火焰宝珠。战斗靴、皮鞋与运动鞋的脚步声敲出鼓点，为亲切的交谈、机械的嗡鸣与魔法的微光交织成的交响伴奏。一群学生操控两架无人机掠空而过，兴奋地讨论着设计差异。几名年轻女子并肩而行，手中的冰咖啡轻轻晃荡，太阳穴处的义体植入体闪烁着光，彼此通过无声传讯交换着对话。忽然，一团薄雾在创始人雕像的头部萦绕。云雾散去，他原本肃穆的神情竟换成了轻佻的眨眼，风情万种的坏笑嘴角还添了一颗美人痣。一阵粗野的哼笑声引得众人抬头，只见阳台上两名身着皮革的学生抱作一团，笑到浑身发颤。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Four large buildings line a paved quad with a statue of the school’s founder—standing with one hand holding a pair of compasses, the other a flaming orb—at its center. The sounds of combat boots, dress shoes, and sneakers provide percussion for the symphony of personable chatter, mechanical whirs, and magical shimmers. A group of students fly a pair of drones through the air, excitedly discussing the differences in design. Young women walk side-by-side, iced coffees sloshing in their hands, the cybernetic implants at their temples flashing as they share a silently transmitted conversation. Suddenly, a mist appears around the head of the founder’s statue. As the cloud dissipates, his formerly austere expression has been replaced by a bawdy wink, a beauty mark at the corner of his coquettish smirk. A raucous, snorting laugh turns heads toward a balcony where two leather-clad students hold each other as they shake with mirth.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

A Plea To Retreat.name:
撤退的恳求
A Plea To Retreat

Text.text:
“各位！我想出了一条绝妙的计策。我们慢慢从这间屋子里倒退出去，一路继续倒退，直到退到酒馆里，然后等上一两年，再打它个措手不及。”
“Everyone! I’ve devised a cunning plan. We back slowly out of this room and continue backing up until we’re at the tavern, then we take this thing by surprise in a year or two.”

一只巨大的渡鸦沉思地蹲伏着，阴郁而警觉。炫目的色彩在它昏暗的羽毛间闪烁流转，却丝毫没能揭开那张难以捉摸的神情下藏着什么。它抬起喙，短暂地梳理着尾端一束绒软的尾羽。它的眼中栖着某种先知般的洞见——那是知晓未来将至之人的目光。
An enormous raven sits pensive, brooding. Coruscating colors flash across its darkling feathers but give no deeper clues to what lies beneath the inscrutable expression. It raises its beak, preening momentarily at a brace of downy tail feathers. A prescient knowledge rests within its eyes, the look of one who knows what is to come.

The Paisley Molyneux Chair Of Abjuration.name:
佩斯利·莫利纽克斯防护学讲席
The Paisley Molyneux Chair Of Abjuration

Text.text:
莫利纽克斯教授还在学院任教的年代，高塔上唯一的附魔只有结界与幻术。驱逐系讲席是一把真正的椅子，由现任校长每年以仪式法术重新激活。它是涂黑漆的木质椅身，金色狮足作脚，扶手握处亦覆金饰，椅背嵌着一块金牌，上刻：为纪念佩斯利·莫利纽克斯。它会以佩斯利·莫利纽克斯的声音教授驱逐系课程。这把椅子最强的附魔在于：任何试图坐上去的人，都会被猛然弹射，横飞着掠过整间屋子。
Professor Molyneux was at the Academy back when the only enchantments on the tower were wards and illusion spells. The Chair of Abjuration is an actual chair, animated with ritual spells renewed annually by the current headmaster. It is wood enameled black, with gold lion-feet and arm grips, and a gold plaque on its back reading: In Honor of Paisley Molyneux. It teaches abjuration courses in the voice of Paisley Molyneux. The chair’s strongest enchantment is that anyone trying to sit in it is jettisoned across the room.

Patron Choosing A Protégé.name:
庇护者挑选门徒
Patron Choosing A Protégé

Text.text:
你阖上双眼，坠入又一场惶惶不安的睡眠，那场谋杀仍在你心底鲜活得刺痛。梦魇漫溢成铺天盖地的猩红，伴着一声骇人的尖啸，像金属刮过石面。忽然一记SNAP，转瞬之间，你正漂浮在一口黑暗的深井里。一个低沉的声音在你脑海中隆隆作响：“不公。卑劣之辈铸下的恶行。此罪无人雪恨——它啃噬着你，如乌鸦啄食腐肉。我感到你的怒火。我理解它。嘉许它。让我把你从这场灵魂之死中拉回。我将击倒那些吞噬你心智的食腐之徒。然后，我们将一同把正义带到梦境之外的土地。”

~ 由 Fattman1243 在 Envisioned 构想

Your eyes shut and you drift into another uneasy sleep, the murder still viscerally fresh in your mind. The nightmares bleed into a full swath of red accompanied by a hideous shriek, like metal across stone. There is a SNAP and, suddenly, you are floating in a well of darkness. A deep voice rumbles in your mind: “Injustice. Foul deeds wrought by inferior hands. This crime unavenged—it eats at you like the crow upon carrion. I feel your rage. I understand it. Commend it. Allow me to bring you back from this death of spirit. I shall strike down the scavengers that consume your mind. Then, together, we may bring justice to the land outside of dreams.”

~ Envisioned by Fattman1243

在你面前，你的焦点那镜面般的表面依旧平静无波，只映出你自己朦胧的面容。你手中握着将你与目标相连的物体：一张照片、一截衣料，或一件贴身信物。你缓缓吐出一口气，朗声念出奥秘的咒词。片刻间，什么也没有发生。随后，那镜面忽然泛起涟漪，而你法术所召来的物体随之显现。
Before you, the mirrored surface of your focus remains placid, reflecting only your own vague visage. In your hand you hold the object connecting you to your target: a photo, strip of garment, or personal keepsake. You ease out a breath, and speak aloud the arcane words. For a moment, nothing happens. Then the mirrored surface ripples and the object of your spell appears.

Penthouse Suite.name:
顶层豪华套房
Penthouse Suite

Text.text:
私人电梯门一开，便直接通入一间宽敞的顶层公寓。墙上悬着抽象艺术，冷静而精确地点缀出几抹色彩；下方是看上去并不舒适的定制家具，纤尘不染，摆放得讲究而刻意，仿佛每一处角度都在竭力陈列出尽可能多的财富。
The private elevator opens straight into a spacious penthouse apartment. Abstract art provides calculated splashes of color on the walls, sitting above uncomfortable-looking custom furniture kept spotless and artfully arranged to exhibit as much wealth as possible.

婴儿精灵的眼眸闪烁着狡黠与好奇；明明才几个月大，动作却优雅得过分，纤小的手指在身旁的表面轻轻掠过，贪婪地将所见所感尽数收入心底。
The infant elf's eyes shine with cunning and curiosity, and with movements far too graceful for their few months, moves their fingers across nearby surfaces, taking in everything they can.

House Dragon Commons (The Dragon's Lair).name:
龙巢公馆公共区（巨龙之穴）
House Dragon Commons (The Dragon's Lair)

Text.text:
在洞壁上，三座壁炉的炉台上方各雕着一颗巨大的石质龙首。它们俯瞰着房间中央——那里一根石笋被齐根砍断并削平，成了一张石桌。四壁被染成翡翠般的绿色。一座壁炉燃着真正的火焰，另一座的“火”却由深蓝色的冰构成，第三座则点着一缕蜿蜒的毒绿火光——三者交织，把洞室浸在诡异的光里。洞穴大致呈圆形，那扇巨大的黑门通向学院地窖旁的一段楼梯间。
Out of the cave wall, over each mantle of the three hearths, an enormous stone dragon head has been carved. They loom over the room’s center, where a stalagmite has been chopped to its base and flattened to create a table. The walls are dyed emerald green. One fireplace burns actual fire, but another’s flames are made of dark blue ice, and the third is lit with a slithering toxic green flame—together bathing the room in a strange light. The cave is roughly circular, its grand black door leading to a stairwell off the Academy cellars.

Elf With An Ice-blight Blade.name:
持寒疫之刃的精灵
Elf With An Ice-blight Blade

Text.text:
精灵仿佛苔原本身的化身。他的面容如大师雕琢的白玉大理石般完美无瑕，目光越过高举的剑柄凝视前方。双眼宛如寒冷法力凝成的光泽深潭。面颊轻触衣领处一圈白狼毛的绒环，唇边带着一丝笃定的笑意。精灵的尖耳从丝缎般的雪白长发间探出，那发丝即使在刺骨狂风里也轻轻飘扬。他手中的长剑——一截纯冰雕成、渐收成锋的剑身——与其主人一样，美得惊心，杀意凛然。
The elf appears like an avatar of the tundra itself. His visage, as perfect as a masterwork cut of marble, stares intently over the hilt of his blade held aloft. His eyes are shining pools of cold mana. His cheek brushes against the wreath of white wolf fur about his collar, his mouth bearing the hint of an assured smile. Elven ears poke up from his silken, snow-white hair, which wafts gently even in the biting wind. The sword he holds—a length of pure ice sculpted as a tapered blade—seems as beautiful and deadly as its master.

裂隙在此横贯墓地。大地撕裂的暴烈将墓碑掀翻，其中一块如今碎裂成片，散落在流淌的熔岩旁。棺木从墓穴中突兀伸出，悬在炽红的岩浆之上，旁边还有一棵近处树木被灼焦的根须。熔岩的热浪——或是树根燃烧的灼焰——将这棵树同侧枝条上的叶片尽数烤干，枯萎蜷缩。
The crevasse cut through graves here. The violence of the earth opening toppled tombstones, one of which now lies in pieces beside the flowing lava. Coffins jut out over the molten rock along with the singed roots of a nearby tree. The heat from the lava, or the burning of the trees roots, has dried and withered the leaves of all the branches on the side of the tree.

Gallery Of A Manor.name:
庄园画廊
Gallery Of A Manor

Text.text:
画框本身就能看出几代人的添置积累：有些宽得惊人、沉重而满是雕饰，显然出自更早的年代。框中的画作从水准平平的风景画，到紧跟当下艺术风潮、明显是拿来押注的作品不等，其中一两幅更是格外出挑。种种迹象都指向一位商人或行会家族的藏品。
A few generations of acquisition can be seen in the frames, some of which are so wide and heavy with carvings that they obviously date back to a previous era. The paintings in them range from middling quality landscapes to obvious investments in current art fashion, with one or two clearly remarkable works. It has all the indicators of a merchant or guild family’s collection.

Spider Nesting In Skull.name:
颅骨蛛巢
Spider Nesting In Skull

Text.text:
一颗头骨被柔软的蛛丝轻轻覆住，像是一位失去躯体的枯瘦新娘。你将灯提近，照亮那空洞深邃的眼眶——每一只眼眶里都绽开一簇簇棉絮般的圆卵。忽然，一条黑黄相间的长腿从其中一只眼眶里滴垂下来，仿佛甲壳质的泪流；紧随其后探出一张脸——八只闪烁的眼珠，和两片湿漉漉的螯肢。
A skull is veiled in soft webbing, a gaunt bride bereft of her body. You bring your lamp closer and illuminate the cavernous eye sockets, each blooming with a collection of cottony orbs. A long, black-and-yellow striped leg drips down from one of the sockets like a chitinous stream of tears, followed by a face with eight glittering eyes and two wet mandibles.

Beholder Zombie.name:
眼魔丧尸（特征）
Beholder Zombie

Text.text:
那轮廓绝不会认错——一颗粗糙的球体，像一只巨大的头颅——从阴影中漂浮而出。它几乎就是一张布满獠牙的巨口，中央嵌着一只巨眼；而在覆着鳞片的头顶上，十根带关节的眼柄如同狂乱浓密的硬发般滋生，每根末端都长着一只小眼。这个眼之暴君散发着腐烂恶臭：腐败的皮肉让皮肤簌簌剥落，每只死气沉沉、浑浊发白的眼睛都空洞地凝视着虚无。獠牙咯咯作响。忽然，一道射线从其中一只小眼中迸射而出……
The shape is unmistakable—a rough orb, like a giant head—as it floats out of the shadows. It is mostly toothy maw with a huge central eye, but smaller eyes on jointed stalks sprout like ten wild, thick hairs on the scaly pate. This eye tyrant stinks of rot: its skin flakes from decaying flesh, and each lifeless and cloudy eye stares at nothing. The fangs gnash. Suddenly, a ray erupts from one of the smaller eyes…

Independent Space Station.name:
独立空间站
Independent Space Station

Text.text:
涂满令人目眩的斑斓色彩，这座空间站借助巨大的全息投影，用相当粗鄙的字眼公然宣示对权威的蔑视。各式各样、合法与否皆有的船只在此停靠，带来改装过的强力引擎与走私货物。走进内部，黑市贩子与太空行者交换着关于商品与价码的消息；而在更低的层级，一场盛大的狂欢正在上演——被加码的音乐脉冲般轰鸣，从一座海盗电台里震荡而出。
Painted a dizzying array of colors, the space station proclaims its disdain for authority via a huge holographic projection using some rather rude words. Numerous vessels of varying legality dock here, carrying souped-up engines and smuggled goods. Inside, black-market traders and spacers swap notes on products and prices, and a great revel is taking place on the lower levels—pulsing with amped-up music that blasts out from a pirate radio station.

Arik And Rothsgar.name:
阿里克与罗斯加尔
Arik And Rothsgar

Text.text:
通常由神秘的羁绊系在一起，这对搭档已成了形影不离的朋友与盟友。高大的兽人如同活着的堡垒般矗立，宽阔的肩膀正好成了他那矮小伙伴的理想高台。巨人肩头，一名笑容灿烂的半身人欢快挥手，身上五彩斑斓的衣装与同伴灰暗实用的装束形成鲜明反差。他招呼朋友把他们挪得更近些，好进行一次像样的介绍。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Usually bound together by mystical bonds, the pair have become inseparable friends and allies. The towering orc looms like a living fortress, his broad shoulders providing the ideal platform for his diminutive friend. Atop the giant, a smiling halfling waves cheerfully, his colorful clothing at odds with the drab, practical attire of his companion. He beckons his friend to move them closer for a proper introduction.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Silver Space Dragon.name:
银色空间巨龙
Silver Space Dragon

Text.text:
庞大而闪耀，这条巨龙踞伏在一片锈蚀的废墟之巅，残骸几乎被他们强劲的利爪撕成两半。他们的鳞片泛着银光；他们的眼眸闪着银光；沿着脊背散落的角刺也映出银光。银色的，还有那对巨大如蝠的翅膀，以及柔滑的尾巴来回抽甩，几乎带着一种猫科般的灵巧。他们威严的头颅以群角为冠，张开的巨口吞吐着白光——新生星辰般的洁白。
Huge and glimmering, this dragon perches atop a rusted ruin, rent almost in two by the grip of their powerful claws. Their scales shimmer silver; their eyes gleam silver; and the horns scattered down their back shine silver. Silver, too, are their humungous bat-like wings and the silky tail that lashes to-and-fro, an almost catlike quality. Their majestic head is crowned with horns, and the yawning mouth glows white—the whiteness of a newborn star.

一柄流光溢彩、锋利如剃的碧玉弯刃铺展成这件精美武器的刃身，华贵的绛红流苏为握柄添上一抹摄人心魄的雅致。长柄刀的每一寸都在诉说制作者的技能与其炉火纯青的匠艺。
A sweeping falchion of glistening, razor-sharp jade forms the blade of this exquisite weapon, and tassels of regal crimson lend a captivating elegance to the haft. Every inch of the glaive is a testament to the skill of its creator and their masterful work.

I Disguise Myself With My Hat Of Disguis.name:
我用易容帽为自己乔装改扮
I Disguise Myself With My Hat Of Disguise

Text.text:
我并不需要接触这顶帽子就能变形，但那诱惑总在——指尖轻点帽檐，微微向前一压。帽子懂得我脑海里的想象，便接过余下的一切：涟漪沿着我的发丝与面颊荡开，继而流淌过身体的其余部分，为我披上崭新的衣裳，重塑我的肌肤，直到我面目全非。
I don’t have to touch the hat when I want to transform, but it’s always tempting—a finger to the brim, a tip forward. The hat knows what I imagine and takes it from there, sending ripples down my hair and face, then down through the rest of my body, dressing me in new clothes and reshaping my skin until I’m unrecognizable.

Greeting From A Tavernkeeper In A Sleepy.name:
困倦小镇酒馆老板的问候
Greeting From A Tavernkeeper In A Sleepy Town

Text.text:
“欢迎！拉把椅子坐下，来点蜂蜜酒暖暖身。不管你们正忙着什么，我保证，它都追不到这里来。其实这镇上压根没什么大事发生。安静得像是被施了法术似的——不过前提得是，先得有人注意到我们才行。”
“Welcome! Pull up a chair and comfort yourselves with a bit of mead. Whatever business you have going on, I promise, it won’t follow you here. Nothing much happens in this town at all, actually. It’s so quiet you’d think this place was under a spell, but that would need someone to take notice of us in the first place.”

当这群巨兽穿梭于拍击翻涌的海浪间，[阳光/月光]在它们深灰而肥厚的皮肤上闪烁。细看便知，那斑驳的外皮并非鱼类般覆鳞，而更像某种庞然巨兽的皮革。仿佛要为这念头画上重音，其中一头鲸猛然自喷气孔用力呼出，空气与水雾一齐爆裂，宛如间歇喷泉般冲起。 The [sunlight/moonlight] gleams on the deep gray, blubbery skin of the enormous creatures as the pod swims through the buffeting ocean waves. Looking carefully, you can see that their mottled skin is not scaly like that of a fish, but more like the hide of a great beast. As if to punctuate this thought, one of the whales exhales from its blowhole with great force, a mist of air and water erupting like a geyser.

Overheard Conversation About A Haunting.name:
关于一位闹鬼歌姬的窃听对话
Overheard Conversation About A Haunting Singer

Text.text:
“是她的嗓音里有东西。我听说她从一座镇走到另一座镇，哼着她那支小调。听上去天真无害，可那音色、那字句里的回响与震颤——不对劲，有股不自然的味道。她吟唱着久远往事——那些不该有人知晓的事，那些本该任其沉入遗忘的事。”
“It’s something in her voice. I hear she walks from town to town, singing her little tune. It sounds innocent, but the timbre, the resonance in her words, there’s something wrong with it, something unnatural. She chants of things long past—things that no one should know, things that should be left forgotten.”

Frontier Town In Alien Desert.name:
异星沙漠边境小镇
Frontier Town In Alien Desert

Text.text:
在异星沙漠的腹地，一座摇摇欲坠的镇子蜷缩在一片巨大的岩脊旁——岩影削弱了灼人的热风与起泡般炙烈的烈日。镇上的建筑是人类与外星风格的混搭拼贴，由各种捡来的材料东拼西凑而成。一圈太阳能板墙环绕着这些临时居所，多少能把白昼那咄咄逼人的光热利用起来。
In the heart of the alien desert, the ramshackle town huddles against a vast outcrop of rock—its shadow lessening the scorching winds and blistering sun. The buildings are a mishmash of human and alien architecture, cobbled together from all manner of scavenged materials. A wall of solar panels surrounds the makeshift dwellings, making some use of the aggressive daylight hours.

纠结的荆棘丛开始蠕动扭转，带刺的藤蔓彼此滑过，发出刺耳的嘶声。声响愈发尖锐，一颗巨大的蛇形头颅自那葱郁翠绿的蔓团中凝聚成形，昂然升起。它张开深不见底的巨口，口中尽是刀锋般锐利的尖刺，随即带着致命的意图猛扑而来。

~ 构想：Steve Adamski

The tangle of brambles begins to writhe and twist, and thorny vines slither over each other with a rasping hiss. The sound intensifies as a huge serpentine head coalesces and rises from the lush green mass. Opening a cavernous maw filled with razor-sharp thorns, it lunges forward with lethal intent.

~ Envisioned by Steve Adamski

Boxy Commuter Car.name:
方盒子通勤车
Boxy Commuter Car

Text.text:
你已经见过这辆车上千次了。它谈不上优雅，也毫不复杂。方方正正的车窗一路延伸到出厂标配的车轮，靠无声的电力驱动缓缓转动。这是一辆为用途而生、而非为造型而造的车——专为困在无尽车流里而存在：猛地往前一窜、停下、再猛地往前一窜。车身涂着黯淡的银色。当然。
You have seen this car a thousand times. It’s inelegant and uncomplicated. Boxy windows lead down to factory-standard wheels, turning with silent electric power. This is a vehicle built for purpose, not style—made for sitting in endless traffic, for lurching forward and stopping and lurching forward again. It’s painted a dull silver color. Of course.

你双手轻轻一挥，低声呢喃，掌心里闪烁的金色尘粉便亮起一抹诡异的光，随即消失无踪。刹那间，一枚金色符文浮现在你面前的物体上，以奥术能量将其牢牢封缄。
With a subtle wave of your hands and words uttered beneath your breath, the glittering gold dust in your hand glows with a strange light, then disappears. Instantly, a golden rune appears on the object before you, sealing it securely with arcane energy.

I Cast Flaming Sphere Using Components.name:
我使用施法材料施放【炽焰法球】
I Cast Flaming Sphere Using Components

Text.text:
我用指尖搓揉那团面团般的牛脂，把它裹上硫磺粉与铁屑。混合物在我掌中凝成一枚圆球，我一边吟诵法术的词句，一边感受它向外渗出的热浪。我将那枚——正迅速融化——的脂球猛然掷出，并以一个华丽的手势完成法术。
Rolling the doughy lump of tallow between my fingers I coat it with powdered brimstone and iron. The mixture forms a sphere in my hand, and I feel the heat emanating from it as I chant the words of the spell. I hurl the—rapidly melting—ball of fat and complete my spell with a flourish.

Corporate Body Armor.name:
企业护甲
Corporate Body Armor

Text.text:
这套护甲线条利落、抛光锃亮。它采用公司的代表色，胸口与右肩都烙着一枚凶戾的企业徽标。它并非最厚重的款式——为便于藏在华丽的连体衣或剪裁得体的三件套之下而打造——但耐人寻味的是，护甲最高等级的防护层却叠在背部深处，仿佛专为防御字面意义上的企业背刺而设。提供黑色、海军蓝或炭灰三种选择。
This set of body armor is sleek and polished. It bears the corporation’s colors and is emblazoned with a violent corporate logo on both the breast and the right shoulder. It is not the bulkiest—built to be concealed underneath a glamourous jumpsuit or tailored three-piece—but, interestingly, the highest protection is layered within the rear of the armor, possibly protection from literal corporate backstabbing. Comes in a choice of black, navy, or charcoal.

Waterfalls In Cave Crevasse.name:
洞穴裂隙中的瀑布
Waterfalls In Cave Crevasse

Text.text:
水流从裂隙的岩壁中喷涌而出，翻滚着坠落十到十五英尺，落入下方的河水。它从一条也许可以通行的隧道口涌出。附近有一道岩棚可供借力触及那里，但靠近桥边还有一处较小的瀑布自上倾泻而下。
Water gushes from the wall of the crevasse, and tumbles ten or fifteen feet to the river below. It comes out of what might be a navigable tunnel. A nearby ledge could be used to reach it, but a smaller waterfall pours over that near the bridge.

Alarm System Panel.name:
警报系统控制面板
Alarm System Panel

Text.text:
这块看似令人眼花缭乱的控制面板脉动着，繁杂的灯光与显示屏交织成一片迷离光海。它的外观却出奇克制，机身纤薄，反倒更衬出其尖端科技的底蕴。内嵌的生物识别扫描器会核验获准人员的身份，为这套最先进的防御系统再加上一层量身定制的安保。
The confusing-looking panel throbs with a bewildering array of lights and displays. Its conservative design is slender, a testament to its advanced tech. Biometric scanners embedded within verify the identity of authorized personnel, adding bespoke security to the state-of-the-art defense system.

鳄鱼伪装成一截泡在沼泽里的朽木，缓缓眨动它那泛黄的爬虫类眼睛，暗自估量着把你拖到它家那咸苦浑浊的水下翻滚一遭的胜算。
Camouflaged as a swamped log, the crocodile slowly blinks its yellowed, reptilian eyes as it gauges the odds of taking you for a roll under the brackish water of its home.

Wisdom From A Quest Giver About Forbidde.name:
来自委托者的忠告：关于禁忌知识
Wisdom From A Quest Giver About Forbidden Knowledge

Text.text:
“我不知道下面会找到什么——也许只有死亡与恐怖在等着你。但对知识的追寻绝非徒劳；若你想真正理解这个世界，有时就必须去看那些无人愿看的地方。”
“I don’t know what will be found down there—perhaps only death and horror await you. But the pursuit of knowledge is not idle, and if you wish to truly understand the world sometimes you have to look where no one else will.”

俯冲而下守护它的宝藏，这是一件神话般精工奇造的奇迹：一条由灼灼发亮的黄金金属鳞片铸成的巨龙，双翼以六角形薄盘拼接，纤若游丝的丝束交织纺成一层轻透如雾的翼膜。它镀金的利爪咔哒作响，液压缆索般的筋腱收缩牵动。那反乌托邦的畸形怪物吱嘎作响地将头转向你，眼部传感器跃动着幽蓝的光谱，巨口张开，露出一片电路格栅，轰然点燃起原始而噼啪炸裂的能量。
Diving down to defend its hoard is a marvel of mythical engineering: a dragon crafted from gleaming scales of golden metal with wings made from hexagonal discs of gossamer filament spun together to create a diaphanous membrane. Its gilded claws clack as ligaments of hydraulic cords contract. The dystopian monstrosity creaks its head toward you, its ocular sensors flicking spectral blue as its maw opens to reveal a lattice of circuitry that ignites with raw, crackling energy.

你眯起双眼，将心智的力量倾泻向敌人，迸发出一阵撕裂灵魂的精神创伤。空气随无形能量震颤，魔法在敌人脑海中轰然炸裂，仿佛巨石撞碎城堡高墙。
Your eyes narrow as you unleash the power of your intellect on your foes in a burst of psychic trauma. The air pulses with unseen energy, the magic exploding in the minds of your enemies like a boulder through a castle wall.

Barbarian’s Battle Plan.name:
野蛮人的战斗计划
Barbarian’s Battle Plan

Text.text:
“我们总想把计划搞得聪明点：潜行、讨价还价、动嘴皮子。可一旦开打，这些全都被扔到窗外去了。所以这次怎么样——我们干脆直接走上去，把他们的脸砸烂？”
“We’re always trying to be smart with our plans: being sneaky, bargaining, talking. And it all goes out the window once the fighting starts. So, how about this time we just walk up and smash their faces in?”

Periapt Of Wound Closure.name:
伤口闭合护符
Periapt Of Wound Closure

Text.text:
尽管这枚坠饰并非由任何特别珍贵的材料打造，但其中镶嵌的血石宝石却仍有种令人难以抗拒的魅力。将它紧紧攥在手心，你几乎敢发誓自己感觉到它像一颗微小的心脏般鼓胀、收缩。
Though this pendant is not constructed of any particularly valuable materials, there is nonetheless something compelling about the bloodstone gem set within. Holding it tightly in your hand, you could swear that you feel it swelling and contracting like a tiny heart.

Barn Owl Familiar.name:
仓鸮魔宠
Barn Owl Familiar

Text.text:
长着一张月亮般的脸，发出沙哑而绵长的尖啸——这魔宠再适合不过那些需要布置警戒哨，或是为了准时去上课而设定晨间闹铃的法师。若非因为看见什么就惊得炸毛，这只神经紧绷的猫头鹰耐力惊人，还是个运送信件的好手。
With a face like the moon and a raspy, long screech, this is a perfect familiar for wizards who need to set warning sentinels—or morning alarms for getting to class on time. When it isn’t freaking out about seeing something, this high-strung owl has great stamina and is a skilled carrier of posts.

Sundries From A Black Pudding.name:
来自黑布丁的杂货
Sundries From A Black Pudding

Text.text:
黑布丁怪咕嘟作响，融化成一滩浓稠油腻的黑色泥潭，露出一堆被刮蚀得光亮惨白的骨骸。残骸之间躺着一本书的皮革封面碎片，早已被腐蚀得千疮百孔。书页尽数朽烂，曾被记录的思绪也随之湮灭。
The black pudding bubbles and liquifies into a thick, oily puddle, revealing a collection of bones scoured to a glistening white. The corroded leather scraps of a book lie among the remains. The pages are rotted through, their recorded thoughts lost.

Loot From A Froghemoth's Lair.name:
蛙巨兽巢穴中的战利品
Loot From A Froghemoth's Lair

Text.text:
你从沼泽里捞出的东西满覆胆汁与腐烂菜渣：一副覆板臂甲、一双靴子，以及一件胸甲，尺寸正好适合矮人或格外敦实的半身人。金属略有腐蚀，却镶着金边，仍有回收价值——领口处还嵌着三颗硕大的玛瑙，同样值钱；其上方则烙着附近某个贵族家族醒目的大纹章。
Covered in bile and rotten vegetable matter from the swamp you find plated vambraces, boots, and a breastplate that would fit a dwarf or exceptionally stout halfling. The metal is slightly corroded, but trimmed in gold, so it has salvage value—as do the three sizeable agates at the collar, over the large blaze of a nearby noble house.

Sundries From A Stoned Goblin.name:
石醉地精的杂货铺
Sundries From A Stoned Goblin

Text.text:
在那只神志不清的地精尸体上，你发现了一个破旧的袋子，上面沾满了各种污渍。打开一看，里面塞着形态古怪的干蘑菇，色彩斑斓，干枯却依旧夺目。
On the corpse of the addled goblin, you find a threadbare bag covered in all kinds of stains. Inside, there are strange, dried mushrooms in a variety of colorful hues.

Orb Versus Wand Duel.name:
宝珠对魔杖决斗
Orb Versus Wand Duel

Text.text:
两名年轻男子身形高大健壮，都是五年级生，长发披肩，手臂上刺青蜿蜒，此刻各自站到擂台两侧。他们已不复先前的傲慢，汗水淋漓、喘息沉重，为打破平局的第三分、也是最后一分做着准备。紫色玻璃球忽然一沉又猛地回正，持球者终于只是死死攥住它。持杖者那只空着的手无力地垂在身侧。教授高声喊道：“En garde!”
Two young men, tall, strapping fifth-years with long hair and tattooed arms, take their positions at the sides of the ring. They don’t look so arrogant now, sweating and panting as they prepare for the third and final point to break the tie. The purple glass orb dips and recovers, the wielder finally just holding it. The wand wielder’s unarmed hand dangles limply. The professor calls, “En garde!”

Aridis Greenleaf.name:
阿里迪斯·绿叶
Aridis Greenleaf

Text.text:
陌生人专注地端详着那件古董，将它举到光下，明亮的黄眼因凝神而眯起。摇曳的烛光里，他的蔚蓝皮肤宛如海上的波浪，层层色调像阴影自其下掠过。几乎没入暗处，他背上那柄巨镰的黑曜石刃低鸣着随魔力脉动，在昏沉里泛着微弱幽光。两只古怪的生物在他脚边嬉闹潜行，偶尔用前肢抵住他沾满尘土的卡其裤，讨要注意。一只像小猫——背上生着两条带倒刺的触手——另一只则是爬行类生物，披着虹彩般的紫水晶鳞片，双眼明亮发光。

~ Played by Cason Juni

The stranger peers intently at the antique, holding it up to the light, his luminous yellow eyes narrowed in concentration. In the flickering candlelight his azure skin resembles waves at sea, the varied hues like shadows passing beneath them. Almost lost in the shadows, the obsidian blade of the large scythe at his back hums and pulses with magical energy, glowing faintly in the gloom. Two strange creatures cavort and prowl at his feet, occasionally pressing their forelegs against his dust-stained khakis in a bid for attention. One is akin to a small cat—with two barbed tentacles sprouting from its back—the other is a reptilian creature with iridescent amethyst scales and bright, glowing eyes.

~ Played by Cason Juni

Overheard Conversation Of A Broken Drunk.name:
一个醉汉的断续醉语
Overheard Conversation Of A Broken Drunk

Text.text:
“——我也许只是昔日自我的一具空壳，但至少这空壳酥脆可口。”
“—I may be just a shell of who I once was but at least that shell is crunchy and delicious.”

Tournament Elderly Advisor.name:
锦标赛年迈顾问
Tournament Elderly Advisor

Text.text:
王子身旁站着一名饱经风霜的矮人，双臂抱胸，目光冷硬。他那粗犷的脸上伤疤纵横，如同一张冒险地图，诉说着跌宕的过往。他的气场笼罩着王室包厢，宛如一根由经验铸就的擎柱。
Beside the prince stands a seasoned dwarf, arms folded across his chest, eyes hard. The scars mapping his rugged face chronicle his adventures, boasting of a dramatic past. He dominates the royal box, his presence a pillar of experience.

Shipyard During A Storm.name:
暴风雨中的船坞
Shipyard During A Storm

Text.text:
乌云在水面上方聚拢，闪电频频刺亮，随即轰然裂开，倾盆暴雨如鞭抽落。狂风抄起浪头，将其猛砸向泊位里的船只。工人们仓皇奔走，把新下水的船只拖回干船坞避险，从天气的无常里抢救他们的心血。
Dark clouds strobed with lightning gather over the water, then crack open in a torrent of lashing rain. The wind scoops up the waves and knocks them into the boats in the slips. Workers scramble to haul newly launched vessels back to safety in the dry docks, rescuing their hard work from the whims of the weather.

Prince Falls Overboard.name:
王子失足落水
Prince Falls Overboard

Text.text:
年轻人被甩出船舷，随着船体猛地向左舷倾斜，直坠入下方翻涌的白沫海水。良久之后，他才冲出水面，张口狂喘，四肢乱挥，仿佛身上着了火般惊惶。他的挣扎引来的不止是船员的目光；你眼看着他再次被浪头吞没，几道绕圈的背鳍已在王子周围破水而出。

~ Clara C. Potter 发表于 Discord

The young man falls overboard and plummets into the foaming waters below as the ship lurches to port. After a long moment, he surfaces, gasping for breath and flailing like he has been set alight. His thrashing has attracted more than the attention of the crew, however, and as you watch him slip beneath the waves, you see several circling fins emerge around the prince.

~ Clara C. Potter on Discord

Castle Of The Unseelie Court.name:
不羁妖廷之城堡
Castle Of The Unseelie Court

Text.text:
嗡鸣的虫翅振动声先于视野中不详宫廷那座蔓延的城堡而至——它在扭曲的林木间拔地而起，暮色里一座晶莹的巨构。漆黑的尖塔虹彩流转，将光线折射向四面八方。内部烛火摇曳，吐出诡异而诱人的色泽；阴森的异界生物以蜻蜓或蝗虫般的虫翼穿梭其间。整座建筑仿佛在缓缓变形；即便你竭力凝视其浩瀚，也始终无法真正看清它的轮廓与构造。
The buzz of fluttering insectoid wings precedes the sight of the Unseelie Court’s sprawling castle, a twilit, crystalline structure built among the twisted trees. The dark spires rise, iridescent, refracting light in all directions. Candles flicker from within in strange and alluring shades, and sinister, otherworldly creatures flit here and there on insect-like wings that evoke dragonflies or locusts. The entire structure seems to shift, and you’re unable to fully reckon its shape or construction even as you actively perceive its immensity.

Nightmare About Being Alone In The Dark.name:
独自困在黑暗中的噩梦
Nightmare About Being Alone In The Dark

Text.text:
你醒来时，周遭唯有浓稠的漆黑。你以为出了什么岔子，合上眼睛，又再度睁开——黑暗依旧。你把手抬到脸前，却连一丝朦胧的轮廓都看不见。你戳了戳自己的眼皮，确认它们并非莫名其妙还闭着。你呼喊着，喊给某个人，任何人。漆黑将你的喊声吞没。你逼自己放缓呼吸，屏息倾听。万籁俱寂。你缓缓转身，渴望捕捉到哪怕一丁点光的针尖，直到你终于明白：在这无所不包的黑暗里，你孤身一人。

~ 一位英雄 Envisioned

You awake to nothing but thick blackness. Thinking something wrong, you close your eyes, then open them again. The dark remains. You raise your hand in front of your face but can't even see its shadowy outline. You poke at your own eyelids, confirming they aren't somehow still closed. You call out for somebody, anybody. The black swallows your cry. You force yourself to quiet your breathing and listen intensely. Everything is still. You spin slowly, desperate for any pinprick of light, as it slowly sets in that you are alone in the all-encompassing dark.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Cavalier Celestial Warlock.name:
天界契术骑士
Cavalier Celestial Warlock

Text.text:
冒险者们与一群尖啸的亡灵鏖战正酣，却被一记粗暴的闯入猛然打断。雾气弥漫的空气骤然炸裂，仿佛反胃般吐出一名肤色惨白的精灵，双眼燃着天界之焰。他口中渗出折磨般的奥术咒言，高举的圣杯倾泻其内之物——水瞬息嬗变为幽幻寒霜，将他披甲的身躯彻底裹覆。杯盏被他随手掷开，他从背后抽出一根虬结的长杖——杖身脉动着德鲁伊符号——随即咆哮着发出挑战。听见这声不屈的怒吼，尸妖们从受难的猎物身上剥离，转而扑向这位新来者；在他注入魔力的重击下，那些锈蚀斑驳的头盔纷纷崩裂。

~ 由 Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

The adventurers’ desperate battle against a screeching horde of undead is violently interrupted. The mist-filled air bursts, vomiting forth a pale-skinned elf, eyes blazing with celestial flame. Tortuous words of arcane power bleed from his mouth, as the chalice he holds aloft spills its contents, the water transmogrifying into phantasmal frost, completely coating his armored form. Casting aside the cup, he pulls from his back a gnarled staff—its length throbbing with druidic symbols—and roars out a challenge. Hearing this defiant shout, the wights peel away from their beleaguered victims to assail the newcomer, their rust-pitted helms shattering beneath his magically invested blows.

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

一根黑暗的针自地面刺出，宛如某位冥界神祇投枪的锋尖。那是一座四面柱形的黑色石柱，约有五十英尺高，基座宽八英尺，向上渐渐收束。其表面遍布符文或某种铭文，密密刻蚀其上，只是以这般距离你无法辨清。也许只是这般体量的黑石在此设定中本就匪夷所思，但这座方尖碑却透着一种令人本能排斥的诡异气息。
A needle of darkness thrusts up from the ground, like the javelin tip of some underworld deity. This four-sided pillar of black stone stands perhaps fifty feet tall, eight feet wide at its base and narrowing as it rises. It bears runes or an inscription of some kind, etched over its surface, though you can’t discern them at this distance. Perhaps it’s just the improbability of a black stone of that size in this setting, but the obelisk is oddly repellent.

Speech About The Comfort Of Books.name:
关于书籍慰藉的演讲
Speech About The Comfort Of Books

Text.text:
“我读过的一些东西在你看来也许轻浮——不过是对早已失去意义的问题作无用的沉思——但在我人生最黑暗的时刻，唯有躲进这些书页之间，才能让我获得一丝慰藉。”
“Some of the things I’ve read may seem frivolous to you—useless ponderings on questions long rendered meaningless—but in the darkest moments of my life, escaping into the pages of these books are all that give my solace.”

High Elf Forest Colony.name:
高等精灵森林殖民地
High Elf Forest Colony

Text.text:
高耸入云的巨树托起桥梁与建筑，将精灵之城高高擎离地面，远离下方潜伏的万千凶险。滑轮升降机载着人们前往聚落的上层，栈道环绕着粗壮无比的巨枝蜿蜒伸展。一头枭熊同样兼具威严与凶狠，拖拽着沉重的绞盘与曲柄。看守从腰间小袋里探手，抛出一具老鼠尸体给枭熊，又拍了拍它的侧腹以示答谢。哨兵们在高处的栖位上俯视下方，长弓近在手边，足以震慑任何妄图来犯之徒。
The mile-high trees hoist bridges and structures alike, holding the elf city aloft and away from the myriad dangers lurking below. Pulley lifts carry people to the upper levels of the settlement, where walkways ring the massive boughs. An owlbear, majestic and fearsome in equal measure, pulls the heavy winches and cranks. The beast’s keeper reaches into a pouch at their belt and tosses a mouse carcass to the owlbear, patting its flank in thanks. Sentries cast their gaze downward from perches high above, longbows close at hand to discourage any would-be assailants.

Cold Weather Coastline.name:
寒冷天气海岸线
Cold Weather Coastline

Text.text:
浪涛砸落在灰烬般的沙滩上，海色幽暗阴沉，与天幕同样压迫。唯有一只海鸥在狂暴的风中艰难穿行，凄厉的啼叫里满是孤绝，拼命朝内陆逃去。冰霰鞭挞着峭壁，啃噬着那座残破的塔楼——它如哨兵般矗立在空寂的海岸之上。
Waves crash over the ash-gray sands, the sea as dark and foreboding as the sky. A single gull attempts to navigate the savage winds, its cries forlorn as it seeks to escape inland. Sleet batters the cliffs, gnawing at a ruined tower standing sentinel above the empty beach.

Sundries From A Harpy Nest.name:
鹰身女妖巢穴里的杂物
Sundries From A Harpy Nest

Text.text:
巢穴的地面铺满了编织席垫与鹰身女妖的羽毛。缠结枝条的边缘垂挂着腐臭发霉的挂毯，上面描绘着吟游诗人与海妖的场景，他们张着嘴。巢穴一处弧形角落里堆着一座由不同物种骸骨垒成的骨堆。
The nest floor is covered in woven mats and harpy feathers. Draped over the edges of the tangled branches are putrid, moldy tapestries with scenes of bards and sirens, their mouths open. In a curve of the nest is a bone pile of various species.

I Read An Evocation Spell Scroll I Under.name:
我阅读了一张我能理解的塑能法术卷轴
I Read An Evocation Spell Scroll I Understand

Text.text:
我握着卷轴，指尖微微发麻，能感觉到其中翻涌的魔力——正蓄势待发，等待被释放。卷轴上的符文先是灼亮如焰，随即褪去锋芒，化作温润的微光，仿佛将熄的余烬，轻柔地照亮整张卷轴。
My fingers tingle as I hold the scroll and feel the magical energy roiling within—waiting to be released. The script burns brightly then fades to a warm glow, like the embers of a dying fire, softly illuminating the scroll.

Young Green Dragon.name:
年轻绿龙
Young Green Dragon

Text.text: 它们被称作绿龙，可你怎么看都只看见病色、毒素与溃烂的死亡。辛辣刺鼻的雾霭缭绕着那具披覆厚鳞的躯体。它大如最健壮的骏马，却显然更为强横，能以千百种方式降下杀戮。近似人手的掌上伸出巨大的利爪，口中则是一片獠牙之林。其上，一只惊人的湛蓝之眼自嶙峋的面孔中闪烁着机敏的光。 They are called green dragons, but you cannot help but see the color of sickness, poison, and cankerous death. An acrid haze surrounds a body armored in thick scales. It is as large as the strongest horse, but clearly more powerful and more capable of meting out death in a thousand ways. Huge talons project from human-like hands, and its mouth is a forest of fangs. Above them, a shockingly blue eye glimmers intelligently from a craggy face.

Barter Exchange Of Animals.name:
动物以物易物交易
Barter Exchange Of Animals

Text.text:
山羊的主人盯着鸭子的主人。山羊盯着那些鸭子。鸭子们在柳条笼里扭动，目光却像落在虚无之处。几乎无人开口，只是每当一只鸭子呱呱叫一声，山羊便咩地回以一声短促、近乎笑声的回应。交易的两人相互对视，露出微笑。山羊和那只发声的鸭子跟着鸭主人离开。其余的鸭子则坐上小车，驶向它们的新家。
The goat owner stares at the owner of the ducks. The goat stares at the ducks. The ducks, squirming in a wicker cage, seem to look at nothing. Little is said, except that when a duck quacks, the goat bleats a short laugh-like response. The barterers look at each other and smile. The goat and the duck that spoke leave with the duck owner. The other ducks ride a cart to their new home.

Short-handled Carbon Combat Hatchet.name:
短柄碳钢战斗短斧
Short-handled Carbon Combat Hatchet

Text.text:
一块粗暴的黑色复合材料构成了丑陋的三角刃身，被嵌在碳纤维护模里。斧柄被截短，刷上交叉斜纹的怒黄色危害条纹。橡胶化的纹理握把沿着斧身一路缠绕向上，无论因何缘故斧柄变湿，都能让使用者稳稳攥住不放。它看上去凶悍得令人发寒，仿佛随时可以劈开门、护甲……或者头骨。
An ugly triangle of brutal black composite is housed in a carbon fiber mold. The handle has been shortened and painted cross-hatched in angry yellow hazard strips. A rubberized texture grip winds its way up the axe, allowing the user to keep a firm grasp should—for whatever reason—the handle become wet. It looks formidable, ready to split doors or armor… or skulls.

The Asatti River Canal.name:
阿萨蒂河运河
The Asatti River Canal

Text.text:
运河因移动而喧闹——船只往来穿梭——伴随着不绝于耳的交谈嗡鸣、厉声吆喝与钱币叮当作响。商人们从阿萨蒂河引航而来，缤纷旗幡迎风猎猎，甲板上堆满木箱与桶箍紧束的木桶，盛着鱼获、香料、鲜蔬，以及无数既寻常又带着魔性光泽的货品。水手将缆绳抛向在运河砂岩岸边忙碌的人们，系泊停靠，以便装卸货物。成百上千的人不知疲倦地劳作，烈日当空，汗珠在皮肤上闪闪发亮。
The canal bustles with movement—ships coming and going—accompanied by the constant hum of conversation, barked orders, and clinking coins. Merchants guide their vessels from the Asatti River, colorful banners fluttering, decks laden with crates and barrels brimming with fish, spices, produce, and myriad items both mundane and magical. Deckhands toss lines to those working the canal’s sandstone shores, anchoring to load or unload goods. Hundreds work tirelessly, sweat shining as the sun beats down.

A Knight And Their Centaur Companion.name:
一名骑士与其半人马同伴
A Knight And Their Centaur Companion

Text.text:
一具强健的马身覆着乌黑发亮的鬃毛，与一名俊朗类人上身那雕塑般的肌肉线条无缝相接——连同样飘逸的长发也相映成趣。半人马尽管体型庞大，动作却带着精算般的优雅；厚重的蹄声踏过凌乱的鹅卵石，竟被闷住了——仿佛从远处传来。它腰侧斜挂着一柄纤细华丽的刺剑，胸前交叉着一副匕首，随着起伏轻轻叮当作响，撞在这名盗贼上过油的皮护甲铜铆钉上。半人马背上，一道矮壮身影端坐于擦得锃亮的骑士鞍中，脊背挺直如箭。那身影戴着铁手套的手抬起沉重的面甲，露出一张宽阔、塌鼻的面孔，肤色如日晒后的皮革。精明而狭长的眼睛——新鲜得像春叶般的祖母绿——谨慎地巡视四周，搜寻威胁。骑士调整着耀眼板甲的肩甲，轻轻拍了拍同伴，示意继续前行。

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

A powerful equine body covered in lustrous, dark hair blends seamlessly into the muscular, sculpted torso of a dashing humanoid—with flowing locks to match. The centaur moves with calculated grace despite their size, the sound of their thick hooves muffled—somehow distant—across the haphazard cobblestones. A thin, ornate rapier hangs in a baldric at their side, and a brace of daggers crosses their chest, clinking softly as they bounce against the brass studs in the rogue’s oiled leather armor. On the centaur’s back, a squat figure sits upright in a polished cavalier’s saddle, their spine straight as an arrow. The figure lifts their heavy visor with a gauntleted hand, revealing a wide, pug-nosed countenance the color of sun-baked leather. Shrewd, narrow eyes—the fresh, emerald green of spring leaves—carefully survey their surroundings, scanning for threats. The knight adjusts the pauldron of their resplendent plate mail and taps their companion gently, signaling them to continue.

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

Cracking A File.name:
破解档案
Cracking A File

Text.text:
你往想要的那段东西外面塞进一层层用于保护的运行时假代码，让程序慢慢啃上一阵子，趁机把文件拷走、转移，再把原本的入侵反制电子组件补装回去，然后赶紧溜到安全的地方，把这份包裹拆开。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

You nurse in some dummy code for the protective runtimes around what you want and let the program chew on it long enough for you to copy the file, move it, patch back in the original intrusion countermeasures electronics, then scramble somewhere safe to unwrap the package.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Suspicious Corporate Mansion.name:
可疑的企业豪宅
Suspicious Corporate Mansion

Text.text:
高耸的金属围栏环绕着整片宅邸，只留出勉强能窥见的视线——足以炫示奢华的园林造景与闪耀的豪宅外墙。隔着栏杆往上看，顶端隐约可见一排参差狰狞的尖刺；再凑近那些精心布置的花坛，草地里却有几处可疑的隆起，前端竟像是伸出了一截枪管。自动化安保显然仍不够用，更多西装男潜伏在建筑的阴影里，脑袋来回扫视，手始终贴近枪套。就算是最疑神疑鬼的百万富翁，这种防护力度也显得过于夸张。
Tall metal fences circle the property, providing only enough of a sightline to showcase the extravagant landscaping and sparkling mansion exterior. Just visible at the top of the barricade is an array of jagged spikes, and a closer look at the artfully arranged flowerbeds reveals suspicious mounds in the grass that seem to feature a gun barrel sticking out of the front. The automated security apparently insufficient, numerous suits lurk in the shadows of the building, heads on a swivel and hands near holsters. Even for the most paranoid millionaire, the level of protection seems excessive.

Ribol The Loxodon.name:
洛克索顿人里博尔
Ribol The Loxodon

Text.text:
他那双蜜金色的眼睛锐利地扫过四周，鼻子灵巧地蜷在两根断裂的獠牙之间——象牙被硬生生崩裂成短短的残桩，凹陷的断口被泥垢与尘埃染得发黑。他缓慢转头的节奏、挺直的站姿，以及巨足落点的精准，都透着僧侣般的克制与专注。然而，他那蓝灰色的皮肤如粗砺起皱的板岩般，其上纵横交错的疤痕又说明他见过的厮杀，远不止一名静修者应有。疤痕穿梭缠绕，压过并贯穿他肌肉隆起处的纹身图案。可在所有伤痕之中，最夺目的却是左耳中央那道长长的撕裂，几乎将耳朵一分为二，末端无力地耷拉下来，垂到他圆厚的肩头。

~ Played by Darkomen with

His honey-gold eyes cut keenly through his surroundings, and his trunk curls neatly between two broken tusks—the lengths of ivory have been cracked down to nubs, the concave points of breakage darkened with dirt and dust. The slow turn of his head, the upright posture, and the precise placement of his massive feet evoke the mindful movements of a monk. And the scars lacing over his bluish gray skin—a rough and wrinkled slate—suggest he has seen more fighting than a mere contemplative. The scars weave over and through tattooed patterns across his pronounced muscles. The most eye-catching of his injuries, though, is the long tear through the center of his left ear that nearly cleaves it in half, the end sagging down to his rounded shoulder.

~ Played by Darkomen with

两尊兜帽人像立在山坡里凿出的短短一段石阶顶端。它们都朝向山顶的坟茔，每尊手中都托着一只碗，碗里火焰无声摇曳。看不见任何面孔；取而代之的，是每尊雕像在那必是魔法之火的后方，露出一处被烟尘熏黑的空洞。
The statues of two hooded figures stand at the top of a short flight of stone steps set in the hill. Both face toward the graves atop the hill, each holding a bowl in their hands in which flames flicker soundlessly. No face is visible. Instead, each statue has a soot-blackened cavity behind what must be magical flames.

Qilen The Thoughtful.name:
奇伦·沉思者
Qilen The Thoughtful

Text.text:
那男人坐在酒馆的窗下，午夜般的蓝色肌肤与幽紫发光的眼眸，仿佛与窗外暮色的余晖融为一体。他棱角分明的面容浮起一抹心照不宣的笑意，牵动了右眼角的纹身——一弯渐盈的新月。捕捉到你的目光，他抬手将一缕光泽流转的银发拢到尖耳后，耳廓上穿着三枚精致的圆环——每一枚都闪烁着虹彩般的星辉。
他的肩头栖着一只猫头鹰——用精明的黄眼审视着你——漆黑的羽毛与那男人的皮质护甲完美相衬。你目不转睛地看着，这位神秘的陌生人饮尽杯中酒，起身离去；他腰间的双细剑随着步伐轻轻摆动，临走前还朝你狡黠地眨了下眼。

~ 由 Qilen The Thoughtful 扮演

The man sits beneath a window in the tavern, his midnight blue skin and glowing violet eyes blending with the twilight hues of dusk outside. A knowing smirk settles across his defined features, creasing the tattoo at the corner of his right eye: a waxing crescent moon. Catching your gaze he brushes a lock of lustrous silver hair behind a pointed ear pierced with three beautiful rings—each shimmering with iridescent starlight. At his shoulder sits an owl—observing you with shrewd yellow eyes—its jet-black feathers a perfect match for the man’s leather armor. You watch, captivated, as the enigmatic stranger finishes his drink and rises to leave, twin rapiers swaying gently on his belt as he walks away after tipping you a sly wink.

~ Played by Qilen The Thoughtful

Gate The Blink Knight.name:
门扉：闪烁骑士
Gate The Blink Knight

Text.text:
柔风在这位高大健硕的存在周身盘旋，他的皮肤是黯淡的银色金属。奥秘的公式在装甲般的表面上泛起蓝光，更亮的银色饰边勾勒着他的关节；然而缝隙间却露出线缆般的筋腱，材质是更深色的合金。发光的符印透过他洁白的短袍与长裤隐隐可见，衣物以一条红色腰带系紧，腰带上点缀宝石与金线。一个矩形黑色面板充当他的头颅，顶端有裂痕；双眼是两圈宽大的白光，嘴则是一道纤细而耀眼的光线。垂在身侧，他握着一柄刻满符文的利刃，刀镡如双角伸展。

~ 由一位英雄 扮演

Soft wind swirls around this tall, athletic being who has dull silvery metal for skin. Arcane formulae glow blue across the armored surface, and brighter silver trims his joints, though gaps there expose wirelike sinews of a darker alloy. Luminous sigils show through his white tunic and pants, fastened with a red sash adorned with jewels and thread of gold. A rectangular black panel, cracked at the top, serves as his head, with wide white circles of light for eyes, and a thin, radiant line as a mouth. Lowered at his side he holds a runed blade with horns for its guard.

~ Played by a Hero

Farmer’s Field In Summer Drought.name:
夏旱中的农田
Farmer’s Field In Summer Drought

Text.text:
酷热正在屠戮这片土地。你面前，一位农夫的田地苦苦哀求喘息，庄稼已成干枯的空壳。空气在颤动，宛如液态的帘幕，将眼前的景象朦胧遮蔽。大地龟裂，车辙纵横，铺展开一片死亡的荒原。这里什么也长不出来，除了寥寥几株耐命的野草，在久旱无雨中仍死死抓住生存。
The heat is murdering the land. Before you, a farmer’s field begs for respite, the crops now desiccated husks. The air shimmers, like liquid curtains obscuring the tableau before you. The earth is a cracked, rut-filled expanse of death. Nothing grows here, bar the few hardy weeds clinging to existence despite the lack of rain.

腕上一块发光的显示屏亮起：一枚完美的金色方形光芒，透过一段无毛的皮肤灼灼闪耀。方形之内，时针与分针构成一只指针式手表——那是旧时代的遗物——随即在内部指令下变形为当前位置、天气与温度的读数。再下一道指令，密密麻麻的应用在使用者腕间明灭跳动：突发新闻、最近的赛博商店、交通换乘线路，等等。
A glowing display lights up on the wrist: a perfect golden square shining through a hairless stretch of skin. Within the square, hour and minute hands construct an analog watch—a thing from a bygone era—then, with an internal command, it morphs into a readout of current location, weather, and temperature. Another command, and numerous apps flicker across the user’s wrist: breaking news, nearest cybershop, transport links, and more.

I Evade Sharks Underwater.name:
我在水下闪避鲨鱼
I Evade Sharks Underwater

Text.text:
起初，那些生物不过是从我视野边缘掠过的一道道灰影。可当我透过水流感到它们强劲尾鳍的脉动时，肾上腺素直冲头顶。我的目光骤然锐利，劈开这片蔚蓝的水域；肌肉绷紧，准备迎接这场致命的探戈。我缓缓转动头颅，尽量不让动作过大，直到与其中一头野兽对上视线。它尖锐的吻部猛然冲来——但当我以同样的决绝回望它的眼睛时，它在最后一刻猛地偏转，从我身旁擦身而过。我对围绕我的其他家伙也如法炮制，可要同时盯住这么多敌手，只会把我拖进精疲力竭的死局。我开始强迫自己，一点一点，朝最近的一丛珊瑚礁挪去。
At first the creatures are nothing but streaks of gray whipping by my periphery. But adrenaline rises to my head as I feel the pulse of their powerful tails through the water. My eyes sharpen to cut across the blue landscape, my muscles tensing as I ready for this mortal tango. I swivel my head around, trying not to move too much, until I make eye contact with one of the beasts. Its pointed snout surges toward me but—as I look into its eyes with matching determination—it swerves past me at the last moment. I do the same with the others circling me, yet attempting to keep eyes on this many adversaries will lead to an exhausting demise. I begin to push myself, ever so slowly, toward the nearest growth of coral.

Greeting From A Ship’s Captain.name:
来自船长的问候
Greeting From A Ship’s Captain

Text.text:
“欢迎登船！在这儿我们自由自在，绝不留俘虏，而且九点必须严格熄灯。我女儿正在长牙，要是被吵醒了，想再把她哄睡可就是一场噩梦。”
“Welcome aboard the ship! Here we live free, take no prisoners, and have a strict lights-out at nine. My daughter’s teething, and if she gets woken up, it’s a nightmare putting her back down.”

敲打、锯切、凿削——劳作的喧嚣不曾停歇。成群的工人拖拽木梁，另一些人搬运铁制工具；也有人独自剥去倒木的树皮，挥斧劈断纠缠的枝杈。你右侧，他们把备好的木料劈开、砍剁。松木的气息、树脂与锯末的味道沉沉压在空气里，处理时扬起的粉尘给每一处表面都蒙上一层灰白。
Hammering, sawing, chiseling—the din of labor is incessant. Groups of workers haul timbers, others carry iron tools, while individuals peel the bark from felled trees and hack the branches free. To your right, they split and chop the prepared wood. The smell of pine, of resin and sawdust, hangs heavy in the air, and the dust from the processing coats every surface.

Young Royal Romance.name:
年轻的王室罗曼史
Young Royal Romance

Text.text:
怀着少年脆弱却倔强的颤抖，面颊绯红的王子将一朵猩红玫瑰递向那位羞怯的少女——她覆鳞的肌肤流转着令人目眩的绚丽花彩。他的心猛然一跳，几乎要翻涌出恶心；而她接过这份赠礼，轻轻将玫瑰别在那只精巧尖翘的耳后。

~ 由 Clara C. Potter 于 Discord 上 Envisioned

Trembling with the vulnerable tenacity of youth, the blushing prince offers a crimson rose to the bashful young woman—her scaled skin alive with mesmerizing blooms of color. His heart leaps, threatening nausea, as she accepts his offering and tucks it behind a delicately pointed ear.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Prisoner’s Post During Winter.name:
冬日囚徒的岗位
Prisoner’s Post During Winter

Text.text:
积雪覆在一根粗壮木桩的顶端，它深深楔入冰封的地面。霜痕在横梁上铐具的金属表面胡乱爬写，可锁链拖曳的那片地面却令人不安地寸雪皆无。看起来不久前还有囚犯曾在这里坐着或躺过。
Snow covers the top of a thick wooden post set deep into the icy ground. Frost scrawls over the manacles attached to the beam, but the patch of ground the chains lie in is worryingly devoid of snow. It appears some prisoner sat or lay here recently.

Ring Of Protection.name:
防护戒指
Ring Of Protection

Text.text:
这枚宽阔的箍纹戒指，戒首呈盾形；银色戒面上嵌着金色纹线与淡色宝石，冷光流转。你将戒指戴上时，护甲仿佛低低嗡鸣，你的四肢随之变得更为轻捷灵敏。
The head of this wide, banded ring is in the shape of a shield, its silver face inlaid with golden lines and pale gems. Your armor seems to hum as you put on the ring, and your limbs respond more fleetly.

你的话语如刺客的刀锋般掠过空气，精准无比，锋利致命。那不和谐的旋律触及敌人时，他们痛苦地扭曲了脸；细微的魔法在他们神经间骤然点燃，化作灼烧般的剧痛与混乱。
Your words drift through the air like an assassin’s blade, perfectly targeted and lethally sharp. Your foe grimaces as the discordant melody reaches them, the subtle magic igniting their nerves in a blaze of pain and confusion.

某种地精或侏儒般的身影站在那里，一手紧攥着帽子，另一手握着长矛杖。它的手指细长，末端生着如鹰爪般的钩爪。生物的头发稀疏成缕，眼睛大得骇人，布满血丝。地上，就在它那双粗笨的铁靴旁，一具尸体倒在一滩内脏与血污里。它低头看了看，随即蹲下，把帽子往血里轻轻一蘸，直到浸透。它将帽子戴回头上，血流成线沿着它的脸颊往下淌，它却咧开嘴，露出凶狠的笑。
Some form of goblin or gnome stands with its hat gripped in one hand, a pikestaff in the other. Its fingers are thin and end in talons reminiscent of an eagle. The creature’s hair is stringy, and its eyes enormous and bloodshot. On the ground, at its stout iron boots, lies a body in a pool of viscera. It looks down, then crouches and dabs its cap in the blood until it’s soaked through. It puts it on, rivulets dripping down its face, and smiles viciously.

Bedchamber Of A Creepy Manor.name:
阴森宅邸的卧室
Bedchamber Of A Creepy Manor

Text.text:
你踏入一间卧室，陈设之精致放在任何标准下都无可挑剔，可某种东西却让你后颈的细汗毛根根竖起。你强烈地感觉到自己并不孤单，而且——不知为何——这里从来不曾真正空过。那张巨大的四柱床，尽管铺陈华美柔软，却给人一种压迫感而非安逸。也许曾有人就在这张床上，于睡梦中被捂死……
You step into a bedchamber that is finely appointed by any measure, but something causes the fine hairs to stand on the back of your neck. You have the powerful feeling that you are not alone here, and—somehow—that this place is never truly empty. The enormous four-poster bed seems oppressive rather than comfortable despite its plush trappings. Perhaps someone was smothered in their sleep on this very bed…

I Cast Find Familiar: Imp.name:
我施放《寻获魔宠》：小魔鬼
I Cast Find Familiar: Imp

Text.text:
我以炼狱语吟诵，将细碎木炭点燃于暗黑精铁的火盆中。接下来一小时里，我依次投入檀香与精炼硫磺制成的熏香、一条老鼠尾、一颗乌鸦头骨、一只巨蛛的八条腿与毒牙、九枝菟丝子，以及一根曼德拉草根。随着我唱出最后的恶魔咒词，辛辣的黑烟翻涌，凝成类人的轮廓。一只小恶魔自烟雾中凝聚而出，被缚为我的魔宠。
Incanting in Infernal, I light fine charcoal in a brazier of dark iron. Over the course of an hour, I throw on incense of sandalwood and refined brimstone, the tail of a rat, the skull of a raven, eight legs and the fangs of an outsized spider, nine sprigs of dodder, and one mandrake root. Acrid, black smoke takes on a humanoid shape as I chant the final fiendish words. An imp coalesces from the fumes, bound to be my familiar.

吟唱的最后一个音节落下，你双手掌心向上合拢，朝着目标做出收拢般的招引手势。刹那间，附近的生物如同羊群追随牧人一般，纷纷涌向目标。
Finishing the last syllable of the chant, you hold your hands with your palms up and gesture toward the target with a gathering motion. Instantly, the creatures nearby flock to the target, as sheep would to a herder.

Royal Court's Quiet Room.name:
王廷静室
Royal Court's Quiet Room

Text.text:
门一合上，宴会的喧嚣便迅速沉下去，只余一线低鸣。墙面垫着松软如枕的厚垫，外覆浅蓝与浅绿的缎面，微光流转。沙发与座椅随处可坐，大多彼此相隔甚远。几位贵族已在此占了位置：一名女子独自蜷在椅中读书，厚重的毯子沉沉压在身上；一对伴侣——两位男子——并肩同坐一张沙发，十指相扣，闭目安然，神情宁静。最夺目之处，是一扇巨大的凸窗，镶着带色的阴影玻璃，将庄园辽阔的花园景致尽收眼底。

~ 构想：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

As the door closes, the din of the party quiets to less than a hum. The walls are padded with pillowy cushions, covered in light blue and green sateen. Couches and chairs are available, most of them far apart. A few nobles have taken spots here. A woman reads a book in a chair alone, under the weight of a hefty blanket. A couple, two men, share a couch together, holding hands with their eyes closed, their faces serene. The most eye-catching section of the room is a large bay window of shaded glass showing a view of the estate’s expansive gardens.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

你念完咒语，抬手摸向自己的脸，竟发现它像黏土般任你揉捏塑形。你的衣物亦然，连随身携带的物件——全都柔软可塑。你合上双眼，想象另一个人，转瞬之间，你便成了他们。你知道这些变化只是幻象——而且短暂——但此刻，伪装已臻完美。
You complete the incantation, and reaching up to your face, you find you can mold it like clay. Your clothes too, and the items you carry—all completely malleable. You close your eyes, imagine somebody else, and suddenly you are them. You know the changes are illusory—and temporary—but for now, the disguise is complete.

Quip About Not Being Made For Life On Th.name:
调侃自己不适合颠沛旅途的生活
Quip About Not Being Made For Life On The Road

Text.text:
“拜托，我们能不能短暂休息一下？我们这族人可不是为了没完没了地劳作而生的。我们更适合慵懒地躺着，采摘多汁的果子，沉思宇宙的瑰丽与美妙。”
“Please, can we take a short rest? My people weren’t made to toil so endlessly. We’re much better suited to lounging, picking succulent fruits, and pondering the beauty of the universe.”

Powerful Digital Totemic Spirits.name:
强大的数字图腾灵魂
Powerful Digital Totemic Spirits

Text.text:
在一片被遗忘代码的球形领域中，诸灵端坐其间——古老而强大的数字传奇。它们的形体巍然如巨像，仿佛远古石雕，守望着圣地。每一尊都戴着难以言喻的睿智面具，眉峰紧蹙，幽暗深沉。也许它们在移动；却几乎无法分辨。它们近乎不可理解，在古老代码多变的脉冲中变幻、闪烁。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

Within a sphere of forgotten code sit the spirits, mighty digital legends of old. Their forms are colossal, like ancient statues standing guard over sacred sites. Each wears a visage of untold wisdom, brows furrowed and dark. Perhaps they are moving; it is hard to discern. They are something almost incomprehensible, shifting and flickering with the variable pulses of ancient code.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

陆地向海中舒展开去，宛如一条伸出的肢体探入水里。大海从三面将其环抱——视野尽头几乎是一线不间断的地平线。
The land sprawls into the sea, extending like an outstretched limb into the water. The sea surrounds it on three sides—a nearly unbroken horizon.

Giant Spider Corpse.name:
巨型蜘蛛的尸体
Giant Spider Corpse

Text.text:
即便死去，这生物的存在仍如一股阴冷的潮汐攀上你的脊背，唤起最原始的战栗与厌恶。分节的长腿像枯槁的手指般向内蜷曲，贴向蜘蛛破裂的头胸部；无数黑得发亮、如玻璃般的眼睛空洞地凝视着你，毫无生气。
Even in death, this creature’s presence sends a primal shudder of revulsion up your spine in a creeping wave. Segmented legs curl inward toward the spider’s ruptured cephalothorax like gnarled fingers, and a great many black, glassy eyes peer at you lifelessly.

I Squeeze Into A Vent.name:
我挤进通风管道
I Squeeze Into A Vent

Text.text:
到底是谁把这些玩意儿做得这么该死地小？我像拧麻花似的扭成一团，硬把身子塞进这狭窄、满是尘土的通风井道，钻进去的路上肘部狠狠磕了一下，忍不住大声咒骂。金属内壁脏得不堪，覆着这栋建筑积攒了几十年的污垢残渍，还有栖身在这些幽闭隧道里的害兽留下的粪便。
Who makes these things so damn small? I contort myself in a spiraling twist as I squeeze my body into the cramped, dusty vent stack, banging my elbow and cursing loudly on the way in. The metallic walls are filthy, covered in decades of residue from the building and the droppings of vermin inhabiting these claustrophobic tunnels.

Taunt From A Vampire.name:
来自吸血鬼的嘲讽
Taunt From A Vampire

Text.text:
“要是你够走运，我会把你转化。我一直缺新的仆从。不过话说回来，我想我可受不了永恒地看着你那张令人作呕的面孔，所以也许我就干脆让你烂掉吧。”
“If you’re lucky, I will turn you. I’m always in need of new servants. Then again, I don’t think I could bear looking at that disgusting visage for an eternity, so perhaps I will just let you rot.”

Dragon's Breath (Fire) Cast On Self.name:
龙息（火焰）施放于自身
Dragon's Breath (Fire) Cast On Self

Text.text:
一声打嗝般的低吼从你喉间滚出，你周遭的空气翻涌着灼人的热浪。你双眼迸出猩红光芒，伸手从袋中扯出一枚辣椒。噼啪作响的咒语自你唇间倾泻，你以阴燃的指尖抚过胸口，嘴巴张得诡异得不可思议。炽热如炉的巨口喷出一道液态火焰的洪流。

~ Played by Donnie

A belching growl issues from your throat, the air about you seething with blistering heat. Your eyes flare crimson as you tug a pepper out from a bag. Crackling words spill from your lips, and you caress your chest with smoldering fingers, your mouth gaping impossibly wide. A blast of liquid flame streams from your furnace-like maw.

~ Played by Donnie

Necromite Of Myrkul.name:
米尔库的死灵侍僧
Necromite Of Myrkul

Text.text:
这名瞪着疯眼的邪教徒身上，优雅与理智的最后残渣也已被剥得一干二净；他猛然冲锋——身上仅有破烂长袍与虔狂热忱作甲。用一颗狞笑的骷髅制成的阴森连枷，是这狂热者偏爱的武器；他龟裂的嘴唇间逸出自诩正义的狞笑，随即扑杀而来。
The last vestiges of grace and sanity have been stripped from this wild-eyed cultist, and he charges—armored only by tattered robes and faithful zeal. A macabre flail crafted from a leering skull is the zealot’s weapon of choice, and a righteous cackle escapes his chapped lips as he attacks.

从沙漠植物被压榨后的渣浆里捡拾而来，这种黏滑、半透明的绿色糊状物牢牢附着在制备它的磨石上。干瘦的巫医与猎人会先吞下一口沙子，再尖叫着把它呕回喉头，以此准备吞下这剂药。它一旦渗入生涩的喉咙，便带来一种诡异的、与兽类相连的感应；而落入胃中的那部分，则维系着魔法。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Scavenged from the pressed pulp of desert plants, this slimy, translucent, green paste clings to the quernstone it was prepared on. Wizened medicine men and hunters swallow a bit of sand first, then scream it back up in preparation to ingest the medicine. The effect upon absorption into a raw throat is an uncanny connection to fauna. What goes to the stomach sustains the magic.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Airship Wet Dock.name:
飞空艇湿船坞
Airship Wet Dock

Text.text:
飞艇的气囊已被放空，整艘飞船看上去宛如一头脆弱金属猛犸的肋骨架。梁架之下，是一套套精密的发条机械，连接着坚硬的铸铁蒸汽引擎与螺旋桨。其中一台引擎的检修盖掀开着，一名机修工把蓝色帆布帽往后推了推，揉着发酸的眼睛。另一只手握着一把两英尺长的扳手，柄端抵在他腰侧的工装连身服上。
The dirigible has been deflated, and the airship resembles the ribcage of some frail metal mammoth. Under the beam work are the complicated clockwork mechanisms attached to hard iron steam engines and propellers. One of the engines is hatched open, and a mechanic pushes his blue canvas hat back on his head and rubs his eyes. He holds a two-foot wrench in the other hand, which rests on his coveralls at the hip.

Log Bridge Duel.name:
原木桥决斗
Log Bridge Duel

Text.text:
有人自告奋勇，将一棵砍倒的树横架在裂口之上，从一侧隆起的河岸通向另一侧；下方不远处，湍急的河水奔涌而过。原木桥看起来结实，可一脚踏上去，却像站在细得多的梁上边缘摇摇欲坠——把决斗地点选在这里，不是莽撞，就是自虐。树皮还能为交战者的脚提供些许抓地力，然而横跨中段的三分之一几乎被剥得精光：往昔胜负的痕迹，清清楚楚写在那裸露、圆润的木面上。

~ Envisioned by DM Badger

Enterprising hands have laid a felled tree across the gap, from one raised bank to the other, over a swift-running river some distance below. Though the log bridge looks sturdy, stepping onto it feels like teetering on the edge of a much thinner beam—to choose this site for a duel suggests foolhardiness or masochism. The bark provides some grip for combatants’ feet, though the middle third of the crossing has been nearly stripped of it: evidence of past victories and losses written plainly on the bare, rounded wood.

~ Envisioned by DM Badger

Well-maintained Private Park.name:
维护良好的私人公园
Well-maintained Private Park

Text.text:
通往公园的路面肮脏斑驳，可一踏过围栏线，连脚下的土地都像换了一个洁净等级。蜿蜒小径穿行在修剪得一丝不苟的树木之间，点缀着异域花卉，美得仿佛从画里移植而来。几架小型无人机在区域内嗡嗡巡弋，吸走垃圾，给任何跌破社区完美标准的污点做定点清洁。
The pavement leading up the park is dirty and stained, but as soon as the fence line is crossed, even the ground itself is on a different level of cleanliness. The winding paths lead by meticulously trimmed trees and exotic flowers that wouldn't look out of place in a painting. A small fleet of drones buzz around the area, sucking up litter and spot cleaning anything that's fallen below the community’s standard of perfection.

Entering A Quaint Cottage In Midwinter.name:
仲冬时节，步入一间雅致小屋
Entering A Quaint Cottage In Midwinter

Text.text:
小屋的门槛上已清理干净，不见积雪。屋内，壁炉里的柴火噼啪作响——将房间染上一层金色的暖光——而悬在火上、咕嘟冒泡的铁锅正飘出令人垂涎的香气。唯一的一间屋子陈设简朴，但木制家具结实耐用，做工扎实。床上铺着手工织就的毯子，层层叠叠，图案与色彩繁多。
The doorsill of the cottage has been cleared of snow. Inside, a wood fire crackles in the hearth—infusing the room with a golden glow—and mouthwatering aromas waft from a bubbling iron pot suspended over it. The single room is sparely appointed, but the wood furniture appears sturdy and well-made. Handcrafted blankets, several layers deep, in myriad patterns and colors lie across the bed.

一根石柱自海中拔起，宛如巫师之塔。喧闹的海鸟在其侧面筑巢，点点斑斑地覆满岩壁，涂抹出一片片白渍；风向不对时，那股腥臊刺鼻的气味便扑面而来。不知何时，有人觉得这里适合作为系泊点：一只锈蚀的铁环垂着湿冷的绳索，从水线上方几英尺处的石面突兀伸出。
A pillar of stone rises from the sea like a wizard’s tower. Noisy nesting seabirds speckle its sides and paint the rock with white splatters that you can smell when the wind blows wrong. At some point someone thought it useful to have a mooring site, as a rusted ring dangling damp rope sticks out of the stone a few feet above the waterline.

I Put On My Goggles Of Night.name:
我戴上了夜视护目镜
I Put On My Goggles Of Night

Text.text:
我把手伸到脑后扣好束带，抬眼望去，世界被照得如同蚀刻版画般清晰。黑暗退去，却并未归还色彩。借助这件装置，我从对手手中夺走夜色本该赐予他们的优势。
