After reaching behind my head to fit the strap, I look out on a world illuminated like an etching. The darkness gives way, although it does not give back color. Using this device I steal from my opponents the advantage of night that may have been theirs.

Arwyn Sylvaris.name:
阿尔温·西尔瓦里斯
Arwyn Sylvaris

Text.text:
高挑修长的精灵踏入[location]时，抬手将鬓角的长白发轻轻拂到脑后；一身量身定制的黑色皮护甲与同款长靴将他匀称的体态衬得淋漓尽致，低垂的细剑挂在肩带上，随步伐微微摇晃。蜿蜒的金色巨龙纹身在他的前臂与双手上交错盘绕，随着他那带着几分张扬的步伐来回轻摆。

~ 由 Ramon 扮演

The tall and slender elf brushes back his long white hair from his temples as he enters the [location], his physique perfectly accentuated by a set of custom-fitted black leather armor and matching boots as well as a low-hanging rapier in its baldric. Matching tattoos of sinuous golden dragons crisscross his forearms and hands as they swing gently to and fro with each step of his swaggering stride.

~ Played by Ramon

Approaching A Retiree’s Cottage.name:
靠近一座退休者的小屋
Approaching A Retiree’s Cottage

Text.text:
通往小屋的小径蜿蜒舒展，打理得一丝不苟，穿过一片辽阔的草甸，在青翠的茎秆、蕾丝般的叶片与足有五英尺高的灿烂野花之间延伸。蜜蜂与蝴蝶如尘埃般漂浮游弋，在花间取食，空气里甜香馥郁，隐约带着一缕辛辣的气息。草甸的尽头，一道木梁加固的围栏将更整洁的菜园圈起。鲜红的番茄与带纹的南瓜整整齐齐排成行，而星点般的白花沿着小屋墙面攀爬而上。
The path to the cottage is a rambling, well-tended trail through a sprawling meadow, between green stalks, lacy leaves, and brilliant wildflowers growing five feet high. Bees and butterflies drift like motes, sampling the wildflowers, and the air smells sweet with a hint of spice. Where the meadow ends, a trussed-wood fence hems in a tidier garden. Bright red tomatoes and striped squash grow in neat rows, while starry white flowers climb the cottage walls.

Crystal Ball Of Telepathy.name:
心灵感应水晶球
Crystal Ball Of Telepathy

Text.text: 这颗玻璃球澄澈无瑕，让你得以细细端详其中心那诡异的虚空。那团褶皱般的空无——本该有某物之处却成了无物——看起来像一颗微小的脑子。你无法想象没有魔法要如何将它打造出来。 This ball of glass is perfectly clear, allowing you to study the strange void at its center. The wrinkled shape of emptiness—a nothing where there should be a something—looks like a tiny brain. You can’t imagine how it was crafted without magic.

Freedom Of Movement.name:
行动自如
Freedom Of Movement

Text.text:
你以象征性的方式束缚自身：当你用一条皮绳缠绕手臂时，你从空气中牵引出一缕缕魔法之索，将未来的可能性系紧、困住。你此刻把威胁与自己结下牵连，借由交感魔法，驱退那些或将在未来降临的桎梏与限制。
You symbolically bind yourself: as you wrap your arm with a leather thong you draw cords of magic from the air, tying down future possibilities and trapping them. By bonding threats to yourself now, through sympathetic magic you ward away constraints that might come in the future.

卷在一只可用皮带系紧的皮革套筒里的是一整套暗铁制的工具。多数是用来撬动或挑开锁具的杠杆与撬针。工具包里还放着几把锉刀、一把小钉锤、一根撬棍、一把简易钳子、一面带柄小镜、一枚放大镜、一把剪刀，以及一只朴素的手摇钻。两只小口袋里装着几片木楔和一卷细绳。
Rolled in a leather case that can be tied shut with leather straps is an array of implements made of dark iron. Most are levers or picks for opening locks. The kit also holds several files, a tack hammer, a prybar, simple pliers, a mirror with a handle, a magnifying lens, scissors, and a modest hand-drill. Two small pockets contain several wooden shims and a coil of twine.

Mumswyrd Neighborhood In Winter.name:
冬日的穆姆斯维尔德街区
Mumswyrd Neighborhood In Winter

Text.text:
这片街区里，许多房屋看起来无人居住——窗帘紧闭，烟囱也不见炊烟升起。通往剧院区的一场芭蕾演出的传单被贴在路灯杆和篱笆上。有些广告遭了些低劣的涂改——画中芭蕾舞者的脸上，被人用粗厚的永久性记号笔添上了丑陋的胡子。街道间飘着淡淡的卷心菜与醋的味道，源头来自科基诺斯先生的家。他的卷心菜地确实已经收割完毕，那气味仿佛在说明：他正把收成好好派上用场。
Many of the homes in this neighborhood appear unoccupied—curtains are drawn and no smoke billows from chimneys. Flyers for an upcoming ballet in the theater district are stuck to light poles and fences. Some of the advertisements have received petty touch-ups—ugly mustaches applied in thick, permanent marker to the ballerinas’ pictured faces. The faint smell of cooking cabbage and vinegar wafts through the streets, coming from the home of Mr. Kokkinos. His cabbage patch has indeed been harvested, and it smells as if he is putting his yield to good use.

你掌心那撮泥土仿佛被突如其来的和风托起，转瞬便随风飘散。受益于你法术的人精神一振，疲惫的双腿忽然恢复弹性，步伐轻快跃动，仿佛有柔和的微风在旁引领扶持。
The pinch of soil in your palm blows away as if carried by a sudden zephyr. The beneficiary of your spell perks up, their tired legs suddenly given a springing step as if guided and bolstered by the gentle breeze.

新鲜的血从那颅骨额头上刻出的猩红三角切口中涓涓渗出；此刻它看起来竟有一艘帆船般的体型。它的双角螺旋般刺入灰色天穹，鼻端则深深扎进被血污浸透的土地，四周散落着真正的骷髅头。你无法判断哪一种谜团更为不祥：这些仪式斩首的用意，还是这具巨大颅骨的来历。
Fresh blood trickles from the scarlet-stained triangle cut into the forehead of the skull, which now looks the size of a sailing ship. Its horns spiral into the gray sky while its nose plants itself into gore-stained earth littered with real skulls. You’re not sure which mystery is more ominous: the purpose of the ritual beheadings, or the origin of this massive skull.

Gremnar Trollbleeder.name:
格雷姆纳·巨魔放血者
Gremnar Trollbleeder

Text.text:
矮人粗声清了清嗓子，用战斧的斧背把宽檐帽轻轻一挑，好把四周看个真切。那双锐利的眼睛，像最灼烈的蓝焰般逼人，在小巧的金属丝框眼镜后燃着光。你看得出他是位老人，稀疏的灰胡须几乎遮不住他两颊上如星群般散落的老年斑。但年代并未削弱他的力量。他单手提着斧头，身上那件长及大腿的锁子甲穿得毫不费力。背后斜挂的瘤结长杖暗示着——他也能甩出一两道法术。

~ 扮演：Avelyne

With a rough clearing of his throat, the dwarf uses the head of his battleaxe to tip up his wide-brimmed hat so as to get a good look at his surroundings. Sharp eyes, as intense as the hottest blue flame, burn behind small wireframed spectacles. You see he’s an old man, his wispy gray beard barely covering the constellation of liver spots dotting his cheeks. But his age has not debilitated his strength. He holds the axe in one hand and bears a long shirt of chainmail without issue. The gnarled staff slung across his back suggests he can also sling a spell or two.

~ Played by Avelyne with

Greeting From A Cat.name:
来自猫的问候
Greeting From A Cat

Text.text:
“许多人从我身旁走过，但所有人都得向我致敬，都得仰慕我的美。否则，他们就要付出价格。也许不是今天，但很快……当太阳不再那么令人安心的时候。”
“Many pass by, but all must pay their respects, must admire my beauty. For if they don’t, they will pay the price. Maybe not today, but soon… when the sun is less comforting.”

对手们抖开四肢，原地轻跳热身，随后迈步走向擂台中央，先行一礼，继而下蹲，双手在身前张开摊出，蓄势待发。他们肌肉虬结、神情冷峻，扁平歪斜的鼻梁昭示着多次骨折的痕迹。两名男子——一个背毛浓密且光头，另一个金发却像婴儿般无毛——在裁判一声开赛令下同时猛扑而出。古老的较量再度上演：不用武器，不出拳脚，唯有蛮力与急智的对决。
The opponents shake out their limbs and hop in place before stepping to the center of the ring, where they bow then crouch, hands out and open in front of them. They are heavily muscled and serious, with flat, crooked noses that indicate several breaks. The men—one hairy-backed and bald, the other blond but hairless as a baby—lunge when the referee calls to begin. An ancient contest is repeated: no weapons, no strikes, nothing other than brute strength and quick thinking.

它浑身黏滑，裹着一层空间尘埃；这只害虫般的生物以惊人的速度沿墙窜行。十条覆甲的腿翻搅着，将一团球状身躯拱向下一顿餐食。那张勉强可称作脸的部位裂开一道缝，一条舌头猛然射出，刺穿了附近的小兽。黏稠的浆液从生物体表一团团滴落，啪嗒溅在地面上。
Slimy and coated in space dust, this verminous creature skitters up the wall with alarming speed. Ten chitinous legs wriggle a globular body toward its next meal. A tongue shoots out of a gap in what could be described as a face, spearing a nearby critter. Viscous globs of ooze drip off the creature’s body and splash onto the floor.

Martial Artist In A Wheelchair.name:
轮椅上的武术家
Martial Artist In A Wheelchair

Text.text:
第一个暴徒笨拙地挥出一拳，武术家抬起袭击者的手臂，随即打出一连串电光火石般的连击，最后以擒拿收尾——那恶棍的手臂被当场折断，瘫软着栽倒在轮椅脚边。又怒又懵的同伙们冲上来，想向这个令人恼火却强得离谱的目标复仇——却也迎来同样的下场。武术家走出小巷，衣衫仅略显凌乱，回头对那些受伤、呜咽的强盗说道：“下次我会尽量出点汗。”

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

As the first thug throws a clumsy punch, the martial artist lifts their assailant’s arm before striking a series of lightning-fast blows, ending with a grapple which leaves the ruffian’s arm broken as they crumple at the foot of the wheelchair. Enraged and baffled, their compatriots rush to exact revenge on their frustratingly capable mark—before meeting a similar fate. As the martial artist exits the alleyway—their clothes only slightly disheveled—they address the wounded, mewling bandits: “I’ll try to break a sweat next time.”

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Vial Of Basic Poison.name:
基础毒药小瓶
Vial Of Basic Poison

Text.text:
一枚被蝮蛇缠绕的骷髅压印在这只上釉的玻璃小瓶上，瓶口以软木塞封住，再覆以红蜡密封。瓶中盛着金色液体，质地黏稠，表面微微泛起泡沫。唯一的气味来自封蜡。
A skull wrapped in a viper embosses this glazed glass vial sealed with a cork stopper and red wax. In the bottle is a golden liquid with a viscous consistency and a slight froth. The only scent is that of the wax.

某种谷物整齐成行，在温暖的微风里泛着青绿的波浪。田垄的走向与隔壁那片谷田正好相反；那里的作物除了颜色不同，长得几乎一模一样。另一片田看起来已然成熟，随时可以收割。农夫们也许在等一个更干燥的日子，或许正忙得不可开交，只是人在土丘另一边。无论如何，这都是个适合在户外劳作的好天气。
Neat rows of some kind of grain wave greenly in the warm breeze. The lines of this crop stand aligned in the opposite direction to the neighboring field of a grain that seems similar but for its color. That other field looks ready for harvest. The farmers might be waiting for a somewhat dryer day, or perhaps they’re hard at work just beyond the hillock. Regardless, it seems a beautiful day to work outdoors.

Sundries From A Kobold.name:
来自狗头人的杂货
Sundries From A Kobold

Text.text:
在各式肮脏的腰包与恶臭的袋子里，你翻出几片玻璃碎片——锋利的边缘却被磨得圆滑——一只弹跳玩具——还能用，但脏得要命——以及一只适合小型类人生物穿的布靴，靴面上胡乱缝满了鲜艳的彩色线头。
In various grubby belt pouches and nasty bags you find pieces of glass, with the sharp edges polished smooth, a pop-up toy—working but filthy—and a cloth boot for a small-sized humanoid, with pieces of brightly-colored thread sewn randomly all over it.

Insult To Fighter After A Miss.name:
战士失手后的嘲讽
Insult To Fighter After A Miss

Text.text:
“你莫非还藏着什么我们不知道的奥秘技能，或是擅长阴谋诡计？没有？那你挥出去就得打中，不然你就是个废物！”
“Do you perhaps possess some secret skill in the arcane, or intrigue that we are unaware of? No? Then you need to hit things when you swing or you are of no use!”

Room In A Seedy Inn.name:
肮脏旅店里的房间
Room In A Seedy Inn

Text.text:
脚下的地板吱呀作响，你几乎还没挪动重心。眼前是一条又长又窄的走廊，两侧各有房门通往不同的房间。唯一的光源来自楼梯口向上涌来的微光，以及走廊尽头墙上钉着的锡制烛台里一支将熄未熄的蜡烛，火焰摇曳，冒着黑烟。

这间狭小的屋子里，一张出奇宽大的床几乎占满了地面。粗朴的床架用柳条编成的网兜起一张薄薄的稻草填充床垫，使其离地。看起来谈不上舒服，但至少够干净。床底下放着一只浅浅的陶碗，充作你方便用的尿盆。
The floorboards creak underfoot though you’ve barely shifted your weight. A long, narrow hall extends before you, flanked by doors to rooms on either side. The only light comes up from the stairs and a guttering candle that stands in a tin holder nailed to the wall at the end of the hall.
 
 A surprisingly large bed takes up most of the floorspace in this small room. The rustic frame uses a wicker net to hold a thin straw-filled mattress off the floor. It doesn’t look comfortable, but it seems clean enough. A shallow clay bowl under the bed serves as your pot to piss in.

你心不在焉地勾起一抹冷笑，曾以为食人魔活着时就够臭了——可眼下你却强忍着不让自己作呕、逃跑，或两者兼而有之：那头高耸的亡灵生物踉跄着朝你逼近，左腿软绵绵地拖在身后。它那不幸的躯体上缺了好几大块肉，被撕扯开的伤口露出腐烂的肌肉与底下恶臭翻涌的内脏。破碎的皮肤像布条般从它的脸和四肢上垂落，滴着腥臭的脓液；食人魔那双死白的眼睛饥渴地游移搜寻猎物——只为填补一份永远无法满足的胃口。
Briefly, you consider with an absentminded smirk that you thought ogres smelled bad alive—but now you fight the urge to vomit, flee, or both as the towering undead creature stumbles toward you, dragging its left leg limply. Chunks of the unfortunate creature’s flesh are missing, torn away to reveal the rotting musculature and putrid guts beneath. Shredded skin hangs in strips from its face and limbs, dripping with foul-smelling ichor as the ogre’s white, dead eyes roam hungrily for prey—to feed an appetite that will never be sated.

Quip About Terror And Companionship.name:
关于恐惧与相伴的俏皮话
Quip About Terror And Companionship

Text.text:
“有时，我会被对未来的赤裸恐惧攫住。它毫无预警、毫不留情地袭来，像张开的深渊巨口，要将我拖入其中。但随后我伸手触及，而你就在那儿，我便知道自己还能再坚持一会儿。”
“There are times when I am gripped by a naked terror of what is to come. It strikes without warning or mercy and threatens to pull me into its gaping maw. But then I reach out and you are there, and I know that I can hold on a little longer.”

Loot From A Vampire's Lair.name:
从吸血鬼巢穴中搜刮的战利品
Loot From A Vampire's Lair

Text.text:
在吸血鬼（特征）的巢穴宏伟大厅里，你发现了许多贵重之物：黄金神像，来自人类尚在世界中迈出最初怯生生脚步的时代；精美肖像，神情冷峻的贵族自历史深处投来审判般的目光；以及最上等的酒桶——烙着两百年前的年份。
In the grand halls of the vampire’s lair you find many valuable items. Golden idols from a time when humans were taking their first tentative steps into the world, exquisite portraits of austere nobles casting their judgement upon you from history, and casks of the finest wines—stamped with dates from 200 years ago.

你面前的精灵生物散发着一种摄人心魄、又略带异域的气息。他们虹彩般的双眼仿佛不停变换色泽；身形矮壮、肩背宽阔，却在举手投足间透出与生俱来的优雅。银白的长发如瀑垂落背脊，精心编成繁复的辫束，其间缀着各色珠饰，随步伐轻轻摇曳。
The elven creature before you exudes an alluring, somewhat alien bearing. Their iridescent eyes seem to constantly shift hue, and they stand stout and broad-shouldered, belying an innate grace to their movements. Hair, silvery white, cascades down their back, elaborately braided and strung with beads of varying colors.

I Cast Cure Wounds From My Staff Of Heal.name:
我从治疗法杖施放“疗伤术”
I Cast Cure Wounds From My Staff Of Healing

Text.text:
当我用手拢住法杖顶端，轻声吟诵法术的字句时，一抹柔和的光辉渐渐盈满杖首。令人愉悦的暖意——仿佛敞开的炉火在欢迎我——在我周身扩散开来，细小的光点如萤火虫般翩跹旋舞，朝着我受伤的伙伴飞去。
A soft glow suffuses the staff’s head as I cup my hand around it and gently speak the words of the spell. A pleasant warmth—like a welcoming hearth—grows around me, and small motes of light dance and twirl like fireflies towards my injured companions.

Owen Price Gets Invited To E-sports Team.name:
欧文·价格受邀加入电竞战队
Owen Price Gets Invited To E-sports Team

Text.text:
“你不是该去上唤法课吗？”飞龙公共休息室里有人问道。欧文的脸被桌上两台显示器映得发亮，硬盘与键盘上跳动着各色霓虹光。他对这个问题充耳不闻。

几分钟后，他往后一靠，双手举过头顶伸了个懒腰。“我刚打上了 Cat Five，”他说。他咧嘴一笑，掏出自己的装备包，扫了一眼屏幕。“就靠我自己，”他宣告道，“没有魔法。”
“Aren’t you supposed to be in evocation class?” someone in the Wyvern common room asks. Owen’s face glows in front of two monitors on his desk, various neon colors flashing from his hard drive and keyboard. He ignores the question. 

After a few minutes, he sits back and raises his hands over his head. “I just played my way onto Cat Five,” he says. He smiles broadly, gets out his kit, and checks his monitor. “Just me,” he proclaims. “No magic.”

脾气暴躁的战马在马厩里喷着粗气、踢踏嘶鸣，竞争对手的气味撩拨着它们的怒火。惴惴不安的侍从强作镇定地忙着差事，脸色发紧，动作畏缩而急促。新割干草的清香努力抵抗，却仍被马粪的腥臭压得喘不过气来。
Ill-tempered chargers snort and kick in their stalls, the scent of rivals feeding their ire. Apprehensive squires perform their duties, faces anxious, movements skittish. The pleasant smell of fresh cut hay struggles with the stink of equine dung.

Blade Attacker Is Disarmed.name:
持刃袭击者被缴械
Blade Attacker Is Disarmed

Text.text:
那暴徒猥琐的脸上，残忍而扭曲的笑容瞬间僵住——保安以武者般的精准一抖，便将他手中的刀挑飞。刀刃落地，发出一声微弱的叮当，他脸色霎时惨白，转身就跑——那点可怜的优势早已荡然无存。
The cruel, twisted smile vanishes from the thug’s leering face as the security officer flicks the knife from his hand with martial precision. It clatters to the floor with a meager clink as his face goes pale, and he turns to run—his pitiful advantage already lost.

Spirit Cleansing Ritual.name:
灵体净化仪式
Spirit Cleansing Ritual

Text.text:
双眼紧闭、沉静凝神，武僧将双手悬停在一具静止的躯体上方。他身着宽松的白色长袍，以皮革腰带与肩带束紧，仿佛随时都能投入战斗——哪怕眼前并无可触的敌人。躺在他面前的女子一头赤褐长发从桌沿倾泻而下，如熔化的铜流；惨淡的光线将她的肌肤染成冰冷的雪花石膏色，使那如石雕般定格的面容更添一分雕像般的性相。
Eyes shut in calm concentration, the monk suspends their hands over a still form. Dressed in loose white robes tethered by a leather belt and shoulder brace, they seem ready to do battle at any moment—even with no tangible enemies in sight. The auburn hair of the woman lying before him spills over the end of the table like a stream of molten copper, and the pale light paints her skin a cold alabaster, giving her stone-set face an even more statue-like aspect.

Threat To A Dragon About Delusion.name:
对一条巨龙的妄念威胁
Threat To A Dragon About Delusion

Text.text:
“你花了太久搭建一个以你为中心的世界图景：可怖、强大、不可一世。在你眼里，其他人不过是食物与玩物。可惜，我们不打算陪你沉溺这种妄想；而我想你很快就会发现，无论多么辉煌，刀刃都照样能刺穿一切生物的心脏。你不是神——只是只自负到发胀的蜥蜴。”
“You spent so long constructing a view of the world that puts you at its center: the fearsome, the mighty. To you, all others are merely food and playthings. Unfortunately for you, we do not indulge in such delusions, and I think you will find that knives pierce all creatures’ hearts regardless of grandeur. You are no god—just a lizard with an ego.”

他将水栖的优雅化作实体，三叉戟在手，彰显真正的水下统治力。上半身的比例近似我们对陆地健美的理想：肌肉如披甲般覆体，线条一路收束至腰际。发丝像串串珍珠般自背后流泻而下，垂向那条鱼类般的尾巴；尾鳍起伏摆动，迸发出推进的力量。坚硬如鳍的突起取代耳朵，勾勒出这名人鱼棱角分明的面容——它们从一顶以致密珊瑚铸成的战盔下刺出——而蓝龙虾甲壳般的几丁质板片覆盖其类人半身，带来更进一步的防护。
Embodying aquatic elegance, the trident-wielding warrior displays true underwater dominance. His upper body is proportioned similarly to our overland ideals, draped in muscle that tapers to his waist. His hair flows like strands of pearls down his back to his fishlike tail that undulates with propelling power. Hard finlike protrusions frame the merfolk's angular face in place of ears—poking out from beneath a war helm fashioned from dense coral—while chitinous plates of blue-lobster carapace cover his humanoid half, providing further protection.

果实散发着藏红花般的光辉，在阳光下熠熠生辉。它浑圆的体躯半埋在泥土里。侧面一道豁口渗出黏稠的汁液，滴落在草丛间，成群的昆虫正贪婪啃食这份意外的丰饶。它的体量甚至压过附近的巨石，这尊自然的巨物令人叹为观止。
The saffron glow of the fruit gleams in the sunlight. Its globular mass is half buried in the earth. Viscous juice dribbles into the grass from a gouge in its side and a host of insects feed off this unexpected bounty. Dwarfing large rocks in the vicinity, this giant of nature is a sight to behold.

I Cast Power Word Kill.name:
我施放「死亡真言」
I Cast Power Word Kill

Text.text:
世界渐渐寂静下来，只剩耳畔一声心跳——我目标的心跳。我双手合拢成杯，感觉那颗心每一秒都跳得更急更快。我的嘴唇微启，我开口——尽管那声音对我而言陌生——低沉粗粝，戛然而止，那真言。我猛然合掌相撞，感觉那颗心在掌间噗叽一声瘪塌、泄尽，最终化作一团猩红雾霭消散。
The world grows quiet, aside from a single heartbeat in my ears—the heartbeat of my target. I cup my hands together and feel the heart pounding more quickly by the second. My lips part and I speak—though my voice is unfamiliar to me—guttural and abrupt, the Word. I crash my hands together and feel the heart squelch, deflate and finally dissipate into a cloud of red mist.

Tor Chernin, Scourge Of The Nine Hells.name:
托尔·切尔宁，九狱天谴
Tor Chernin, Scourge Of The Nine Hells

Text.text:
某物自天穹坠落，裹挟着硫磺与浓烟的云团。赭黄火焰化作的双翼倏然展开，显出一名半兽人——身披士兵的护甲，饱经风霜的脸上挂着冷峻的笑意。他迈步向前，带着千战淬炼出的从容；獠牙间的狞笑牵动一道面部伤疤，那伤疤如熔岩般发光。相似的疤痕也从护甲的缝隙间隐约透出。金色的光自他眼中流淌，耀度几可与太阳争辉。及肩的发丝乌黑柔顺，与他粗粝的胡须相映，显出同样旺盛的生命力。他停下脚步，将手倚在巨斧的斧柄上——那是一柄用黑色金属锻造的狰狞武器。他的护甲同样铸成深夜般的墨黑，边缘缀以浅金镶饰。力量自他的剪影中辐射开来。

~ Played by The Spider Knight

Something drops from the sky in a cloud of sulfur and smoke. Wings of ochre flame unfurl to reveal a half-orc dressed in the armor of a soldier, a grim smile upon his weather-beaten face. He strides forward with the confidence earned from a thousand battles, his tusked grin twisting a facial scar that glows like magma. Similar scars show through gaps in his armor. A golden light streams from his eyes, rivaling that of the sun. His hair sits at his shoulders, silken dark, indicating a vitality matched by his rough-hewn beard. He pauses and rests upon the hilt of his greataxe—a monstrous weapon forged with black metal. So too is his armor cast in the black of a midnight sky, with light-gold trimmings. Strength radiates from his silhouette.

~ Played by The Spider Knight

I Tinker With My Robot.name:
我捣鼓我的机器人
I Tinker With My Robot

Text.text:
我像外科医生般为我的机器人伙伴动手术——身上裹着的是沾满机油的围裙，而非洁白的手术袍。电池与电路板在体内层层铺陈，由各种难以想象的彩色导线相连；每一枚元件都关乎它那合成生命的存续。我将手伸入——小心翼翼——以熟练的手法开始那项繁复的工作，细细调校它的内部运作。
Like a surgeon I operate on my robotic friend—an oil-stained apron wrapped around my torso instead of a medical gown. Batteries and circuit boards connected by wires of every imaginable color fill the body, each component vital to its synthetic life. I reach in—delicately—and begin the complex task of adjusting the internal workings with a practiced hand.

Entering An Illusory Maze.name:
踏入幻象迷宫
Entering An Illusory Maze

Text.text:
绿篱间一道拱门缀满橙色马利筋的花簇与粉色秋海棠，引向一片开阔庭院，几株修剪成形的灌木与一座咕嘟冒泡的喷泉静候其中。你迈步从拱门下穿过，耳畔蜂鸣嗡嗡作响；可还未完全通过，那汇聚的嗡响陡然拔高，你的视野像被搅动般晕成一片模糊。你听见叶片沙沙翻涌、根系被硬生生扯动；脚下大地轰隆震颤。转瞬间，喧嚣戛然而止，你的视线也随之清明——庭院已化作一座高大森严的绿篱迷宫，甚至你身后也立起一道。密叶与荆棘织成的墙贴上你的脊背，仿佛要将你揽入怀中；花香甜得发腻，令人作呕。

~ 构想：Dave Johnson

An archway in a hedge, adorned with bursts of orange milkweed and pink begonias, leads to an open yard with some topiaries and a bubbling fountain. You step underneath and hear bees buzzing, but before you can pass through fully, the collective hum grows louder, and your vision swims into a blur. You hear the rustling of leaves and wrenching of roots; the earth rumbles beneath your feet. In a moment, the cacophony dies away and your vision clears. The yard has been transformed into a maze of tall, imposing hedges—including one directly behind you. The wall of densely packed leaves and brambles presses against your back as if to embrace you, the fragrance from its flowers sickly sweet.

~ Envisioned by Dave Johnson

Studded Leather Armor +3.name:
铆钉皮甲 +3
Studded Leather Armor +3

Text.text:
这套柔韧的皮革护甲上点缀着闪耀的金属铆钉，放出的光芒诡异而冷冽，绝非寻常钢铁可比。它比外表更轻盈，也比厚实皮革所暗示的更为灵活；无论穿戴者的体型与轮廓如何，护甲都坚固贴合，仿佛天生为其量身打造。扣带与束环让护甲稳妥而舒适地贴身固定，多层加固并附魔的皮革叠覆其上，提供的防护力竟不输沉重的锁子甲。
The gleaming metal studding this supple leather armor shines with a strange light, far from mundane steel. Lighter than it appears, and more flexible than the thick leather might suggest, the armor is sturdy and fitted perfectly to its wearer no matter their size and shape. Buckles and bands fit the armor comfortably, and layers of reinforced and enchanted leather provide as much protection as heavy chain mail.

Aarakocra Bard, Bardy Mcfly.name:
阿拉科克拉吟游诗人，巴迪·麦克弗莱
Aarakocra Bard, Bardy Mcfly

Text.text:
这位大多覆着蓝色羽毛的类人，敞开的丝质背心下，是一片洁白的胸羽。那唯一的衣饰——铁锈红，褪色如落日余晖——与他梨形鲁特琴的琴身相映成趣。不同于许多鸟族尖厉的啼叫，这位吟游诗人的嗓音在歌中高亢而清澈，与琴音交织成一体。

~ 撰写并由扮演：Bob World Builder

This mostly blue-feathered humanoid boasts a breast of white plumage under an open silk vest. The singular item of clothing, rust red but fading like a sunset, matches the body of his pear-shaped lute. Unlike the shrill cries of many birdfolk, the bard’s voice rises strong and clear in a song that blends with the notes of his instrument.

~ Written and Played by Bob World Builder

Orbital Military Checkpoint With Full Cr.name:
满编轨道军事检查站
Orbital Military Checkpoint With Full Crew

Text.text:
巨大的检查站宛如星界泰坦，巍然悬于行星之上，以庞大的能量屏障掌控着许可。那艘令人生畏的巨舰遍布舰船与人员，所有人都以军纪般的精准与纪律各司其职；成群的战斗机紧密编队呼啸掠过。
Like an astral titan, the huge checkpoint looms large above the planet, controlling access via immense energy barriers. The imposing vessel bristles with ships and personnel, all going about their duty with military precision and discipline, as swarms of fighters fly past in tight formations.

Story About A City Of Endless Conflict.name:
一座无尽纷争之城的故事
Story About A City Of Endless Conflict

Text.text:
“你听说过那座无尽战争之城吗？一切始于两户人家的小小仇怨，可每当殃及一个旁观者，就会有一个新的家族被卷入混战，直到整座城都结下了梁子。商铺不再卖面包，转而兜售临时拼凑的凶器，与外界的一切联络也随之断绝。可冲突仍在燃烧，一天比一天更血腥。有人说他们至今仍在厮杀，旧怨堆得太高，早已没人记得为何而战。也许是恶魔蛊惑了那地方，但我可没那么乐观。”
“Have you heard of the city of endless war? It began with a small family feud, but each bystander struck caused a new family to join the fray until the whole city held a grudge. Stores began selling makeshift weapons instead of bread, and all communication was lost with the outside world. Yet, the conflict flamed on, becoming bloodier with each passing day. Some say they’re still at war, the wrongs stacked so high that no one remembers why they’re fighting. Perhaps it was a devil that bewitched that place, but I’m not so optimistic.”

守卫的脸硬得像石头，笑容却带着饥渴。一道疤把他们的嘴唇劈开，斜斜爬上面颊，险险擦过右眼，留下仿佛独眼般的眯缝，让人觉得他们随时都要抛出个冷笑话。他们把长满老茧的拳头猛地拍进掌心，声响像岩石狠狠相撞。
The guard has a hard face and a hungry smile. A scar splits their lips and runs diagonally up their face, just barely missing their right eye. It gives them a one-eyed squint, as if they’re constantly on the verge of telling a joke. They slap a calloused fist into a palm, making a sound like rocks smashing together.

Speech About Passing Obsession.name:
关于放下执念的演说
Speech About Passing Obsession

Text.text:
“明明知道这世上有人来来去去、行走其间，却永远不会知道自己对你有多重要——这感觉真是古怪。那些转瞬即逝的迷恋或片刻的悸动，却像倒刺一样卡在你脑子里。比如从前有个男孩，每次和我擦肩而过都要把我推进泥里，而我每天都在想怎么杀了他。”
“It’s so strange to know there are people walking about in the world who will never know how important they are to you. Passing fancies or moments that have lodged themselves in your mind. Like there was a boy who used to shove me in the mud whenever we crossed paths and I think about murdering him everyday.”

木制楼梯在你下到地窖地面时发出不祥的吱呀声，仿佛这段路比实际要漫长得多。即便举着火把，阴影也像要从四面扑向你，逼得你空着的那只手不由自主地滑向武器。当你触及楼梯底端，头顶的门猛地砰然合上，发出不必要地响亮的boom，你只盼自己从未听说过这座庄园。唉，要是来个舒适的地城或战场该多好！ The wooden stairs creak ominously as you descend to the cellar floor, somehow feeling much further than it is. Even with a torch, the shadows seem to leap out at you, to the point where your free hand strays toward your weapons. As you reach the bottom of the stairs, the door above slams shut with a needlessly loud boom, and you find yourself wishing you had never heard of this manor. Oh for a cozy dungeon or battlefield!

Professor Of Thaumaturgical History And.name:
法术史与符文教授
Professor Of Thaumaturgical History And Runes

Text.text:
教授身形纤薄、雌雄莫辨，足有九英尺高，没人知道她的年代。她精灵般的耳尖上层层镶满金箍、戒环与宝石。赤褐色的头发泛着铜光，她的神情庄重而沉静——还带着一丝淡淡的哀伤。她用宝珠将旧世界化作魔法般的立体图景与流动场面在眼前铺陈开来，她的嗓音像一支来自往昔的歌，恍惚得让人觉得下课就像从梦里醒来。
The professor is thin and androgynous, about nine feet tall, and no one knows her age. Her elfish ears are crusted with gold bands, rings, and gemstones. Auburn hair glistens with a copper sheen, and her demeanor is serious, quiet—and a little sad. She uses her orb to demonstrate the Old World in magical tableaus and moving scenes, and her voice is a song of the past, so much so that the end of class is like waking from a dream.

Ghry Manqula The Half-orc Champion.name:
格瑞·曼奎拉，半兽人勇冠军
Ghry Manqula The Half-orc Champion

Text.text:
保养得当的锁子甲披覆在半兽人宽阔的身躯上，贴身合体，紧紧勾勒出他们惊人的体魄。他们身形高大，挺直如枪，举止间带着戎马一生的军人般的刻板姿态与冷峻神情。腰侧悬着一柄钢制长剑，比常见的武器更宽更沉，但执剑者的动作却沉稳老练，带着一股笃定的利落。半兽人也将钢制鸢盾随时备好，松松地系在背上，便于随时取用。

~ 由来自 RPGBOT.net 的 Tyler 扮演

Well-kept chain mail drapes the half-orc's broad frame, fitted and snug against their impressive physique. They stand tall and straight-backed, carrying themselves with the rigid posture and stoic countenance of a lifelong soldier. At their hip hangs a steel longsword, broader and heavier than is typical of the weapon, yet its wielder moves with a sure and practiced grace. The half-orc keeps their steel kite shield at the ready as well, strapped loosely across their back.

~ Played by Tyler from RPGBOT.net

Loot From A Needle Blight.name:
来自针刺枯萎怪的战利品
Loot From A Needle Blight

Text.text: 蕨丛怪兽终于被你击败倒地，你停下片刻，审视它的尸身。它的背上突兀地伸出一排脊刺，每一根边缘都长着倒钩般的齿。你小心翼翼地——小心翼翼地——撬下几根，发现靠近生物腰背处的末端更为光滑，不再那么渴望啜饮你掌心与指尖的血。你推测这些可以当作标枪、箭矢，甚至是满口尖齿的短棍——至少在它们挨过太多次重击、碎裂之前。 The brackeny beast finally bested and fallen, you take a moment to study its corpse. From its back protrudes a series of spines, each edged with hooked teeth. Carefully, carefully, you pry a few of them free, finding the ends near the small of the creature’s back to be smoother, less eager for the blood of your palm and fingers. You surmise you might use these as javelins, or arrows, or even many-toothed clubs—at least until they splinter after one too many blows.

I Dress Down My Glamoured Studded Leathe.name:
我褪去那件施了幻妆的镶钉皮甲
I Dress Down My Glamoured Studded Leather

Text.text:
我轻声吐出一个字，随着幻象消散，我的护甲显露出真正的形态。华丽的配饰与考究的细节在闪烁的魔法薄雾中融化殆尽，取而代之的是一套精致的镶钉皮甲，金属包边上细细刻着一个小巧的奥术符号。
With a word, my armor reveals its true form as the illusion fades away. The grand accoutrements and stylish details melt into oblivion in a haze of shimmering magic, replaced now by a fine set of studded leather with a small arcane symbol etched delicately into the metal trim.

Animate Dead On A Corpse.name:
在尸体上施展【死者复苏】
Animate Dead On A Corpse

Text.text:
尸体猛地一抽，生命的浪潮在残躯里奔涌。它缓缓蠕动，双眼眨动着睁开。一声倒抽的气息——几十年来的第一次——灌入它的肺里。躯体坐起，空洞的眼睛扫视四周，仿佛从漫长而深沉的沉眠中醒来。它站起，迈步前行。却不是漫无目的地游荡，而是带着明确的意志前进。
The corpse twitches, waves of life coursing through the remains. It stirs, eyes blinking open. A gasp of air—the first in decades—is drawn into its lungs. The body sits up, vacant eyes surveying its surroundings as if waking from a long, deep sleep. The body stands and walks. But it doesn’t wander aimlessly, it moves with purpose.

一只点缀着鹿角的长杆上吊着一枚风干的驯鹿胃囊，在风中轻轻摇晃，散发出发酵乳的酸臭。它是机智与巧用的见证；干枯的皮囊仿佛仍在诉说补给与求生的故事。它悬在营地里，如同一记刺痛的提醒：在大自然冷酷无情的怀抱中，唯有适应才能活下去。
Suspended from an antler-adorned pole, a dried caribou stomach sways in the wind, stinking of fermented milk. A testament to resourcefulness, the parched skin now tells tales of sustenance and survival. It hangs in the camp, a poignant reminder of adaptability within the unforgiving embrace of nature.

在精灵疆域的葱郁密林与矮人王国陡峭山麓之间，横亘着这座都会般的城邦——名义上仍由一位风烛残年的君主统御。入城毫不费力，城门卫兵乐呵呵地迎接新来者，无论是来做买卖还是打算落脚定居。可几乎立刻，你便看见这座城国里的神龛与圣殿早已荒废，钉板封门；有些甚至被彻底夷平。忽然一声高喊响起，市民们迅速涌动，忙不迭地清空街面，一支贵族队列穿过广场——周遭护卫皆披黑与红的护甲。你凝神细看，那贵族家族的旗帜上赫然刻着向一位大魔王效忠的昭然印记，而家族每一名成员的额头上，都纹着一道或数道地狱符印。一个年迈乞丐没能及时蹒跚躲到广场边，便被一名家卫干脆利落地砍倒，任其在沟渠里等死；猩红的血肉喷溅成滩，汇在他同伴脚边。然而，市民们竟无一人作出反应，甚至连一丝错愕都没有——交谈平稳而随意，买卖照常运转，仿佛一切理所当然。这里，显然出了大问题。

~ Envisioned by Imbalf

Between the lush forest of the elven realm and the steep mountainside of the dwarf kingdom, lies this metropolitan city-state, led in name only by an aging monarch. Entering the city is no problem, as the gate guards are happy to welcome new arrivals for trade or resettlement. Yet, almost immediately, you see that the shrines and temples within this city-kingdom have been long abandoned and boarded up, or in some cases, entirely demolished. A cry goes up, and the citizens rush to clear the streets as a procession of nobles, surrounded by guards in black and red armor, passes through the square. Looking closely, you see that the banner of this noble house contains obvious signs of allegiance to an archfiend, and each member of the noble family has one or more infernal sigils tattooed on their forehead. One old beggar who was not fast enough to hobble to the side of the square is simply cut down by one of the household guards and left to die in the gutter, gouts of crimson gore puddling at the feet of his fellows. And yet, none of the citizens react or even seem nonplussed, their conversation even and casual, business carrying on as normal. Something is quite wrong in this place.

~ Envisioned by Imbalf

Eulogy By A Druid.name:
德鲁伊的悼词
Eulogy By A Druid

Text.text:
“大地守护着你，将你温柔地拥入怀中，直到时代的尽头。如今，此地的青草与树木将为你吟唱你的歌——那是对一位挚友过早离去的回响。”
“The earth stands guard over you, folding you in its loving embrace until the end of time. Now the grass and trees of this place will sing your song—echoes of a dear friend gone too soon.”

这一家人紧紧依偎在一起，你靠着我、我贴着你，只为寻得些许慰藉与温暖。他们看起来饥肠辘辘、冻得发抖，疲惫更是写在脸上，却并未散发出丝毫绝望。至少，他们还在一起。
The family sticks close to each other, each huddled against another for comfort and warmth. They look hungry, cold, and more than a little tired, but no despair emanates from them. At least they are together.

披甲厚实而身形宽阔，这生物的长耳朵一听到最近的声响便倏然竖起。它狼吞虎咽地嚼了会儿一绺绺成团的草，弄得一嘴狼藉，随后打了个哈欠。它伸展并屈伸那对灵巧的肢体——为终身攀爬而生的肢体。然而这或许并不重要：只需肌肉轻轻一抽，重力便在这生物周遭消散，托举着它，以短暂飞行般的优雅飘然浮起。
Armored and broad, this creature’s long ears prick at the nearest noise. It chews messily through stringy clumps of grass for a moment before yawning. It stretches and flexes a set of dexterous limbs—limbs adapted for a lifetime of climbing. But it need not matter, for at the twitch of a muscle, gravity dissipates about the creature, buoying it with the grace of temporary flight.

Mage With Frog Familiar.name:
携蛙魔宠的法师
Mage With Frog Familiar

Text.text:
一只湿润发亮的青蛙用鲜橙色的趾端紧紧扒在精灵施法者的皮质护肩上，歪着脑袋，将那对如红色圆珠般的眼睛定定落在精灵身上。它张开宽阔的嘴，发出友好的呱鸣。精灵轻快地笑了一声，转过头望向这只魔宠——那双鲜翠欲滴的绿眸，与青蛙嫩枝般的青绿肤色正好相映。
A glistening frog clings with bright orange toes to the leather pauldron of an elven magic-user, tilting its head to affix orb-like red eyes upon the elf. It opens its wide mouth to emit a friendly croak. With a trill of a laugh, the elf turns to regard the familiar with eyes of vibrant green—the hue matching the frog’s own spriggy skin.

Taunt From A Tree Person.name:
树人嘲讽
Taunt From A Tree Person

Text.text:
“你们这种族对荣誉一无所知。你们野蛮地互相撕咬吞食，踩着尸骸与血泊攀爬，只为登上那团扭曲的血肉之丘——你们竟称之为文明。你们会像那些失控繁殖的害虫一样被碾碎。这个世界曾经寂静无声，而它终将再次归于寂静。”
“Your kind knows nothing of honor. You savage and eat each other as you claw your way to the top of the twisted mass of bodies and blood you call civilization. You will be crushed like so many vermin who breed out of control. The world was quiet once, and it will be again.”

Loot From An Adult Copper Dragon.name:
成年铜龙的战利品
Loot From An Adult Copper Dragon

Text.text:
铜龙碧蓝如松石的眼眸在死亡中黯然无光，庞大的躯体横陈在洞口附近，浸在一片血污狼藉之中。洞内，你隐约看见一具半埋的人类骷髅（特征），身着褪色的华丽衣饰。衣物早已一文不值，但细致搜寻后，你发现了一支雕刻着奥术文字的精美长笛，以及一柄微微发光的细剑，刃缘锋利如剃刀。
The copper dragon’s turquoise eyes are dull in death, its large body lying in a bloody mess near the entrance to the cave. Within, you can make out a half-buried human skeleton, dressed in faded finery. The clothing is worthless, but a thorough search reveals an exquisite flute etched with arcane script, as well as a slightly glowing rapier, its edge razor-like.

Spirit Gaining Corporeal Form.name:
灵体凝聚为实体
Spirit Gaining Corporeal Form

Text.text:
空气变得沉重而压迫，仿佛一场巨大的风暴正在酝酿。那幽影凝望前方，专注于地平线，神情安宁而满足。它缓缓阖上双眼，幽灵（特征）被无形的气流托起，飘入空中，开始歌唱。旋律轻盈而美丽——一曲关于治疗与创造的歌。摄人心魄的音符回荡开来，灵体随之绽放出刺目、缥缈的光辉。当那炫目的辉光渐渐退去，你又看见了它……可它已与你一样真实。

~

The air becomes heavy and oppressive, as if a great storm is brewing. The specter is staring ahead, focused on the horizon, their expression serene and content. Closing their eyes, the ghost floats into the air, buoyed by invisible currents, and begins to sing. The melody is light and beautiful—a song of healing and creation. The spellbinding notes ring out as the spirit begins to glow with blinding, ethereal light. When the dazzling illumination subsides, you see them again… but they are as real as you.

~

Chain Shirt Armor +1.name:
链甲衫护甲 +1
Chain Shirt Armor +1

Text.text:
这件护甲由一圈圈相互扣合的金属环编织而成，通体流淌着一抹异界般的微光。那金属你从未见过，直觉却告诉你它绝非凡物。环与环之间滑合分离，精准得近乎神妙；明明是锻造的金属，却轻若无物。护甲衫贴身却不紧绷，穿戴者在其中移动毫无拘束，自如如风。
The interlocking rings making up this armor shine with an otherworldly light. The metal is unlike any you've seen, though you'd guess it's far from mundane. The rings slide together and separate with sublime precision, weighing almost nothing despite being forged metal. The shirt fits snugly but comfortably, allowing for complete ease of movement for the wearer.

Sheer Vertical Mountain Wall.name:
陡峭的垂直山壁
Sheer Vertical Mountain Wall

Text.text:
山壁几乎垂直自峰顶断落，直坠到下方那条冷酷无情的河流乱石之间。任何试图攀爬这面被风与天气磨得光滑的峭石之举，都等同于主动招来真正的风险——它很可能会成为你此生攀登的最后一座山。
The mountain wall is a nearly vertical drop from the top to the rocks of the unforgiving river below. Any attempt to scale this sheer wall of stone, polished by wind and weather, is to invite a real risk that it will be the last mountain you will ever climb.

一尊巨大的魔像嗡鸣着，回荡着造物主遗留的古老能量。它足有二十英尺高，迈开宽阔的步伐，在大地上踏出骇人的巨大足印，宛如风景上的伤疤。它的四肢强健、修长、线条分明，躯壳泛着金属般的冷光。它漫无目的地游荡，偶尔弯下身，在泥土里胡乱扒拉着那些幽暗的形影。忽然，它以出人意料的速度转过身，直直看向你。它扭曲的巨口大张着，下颌松垮，左右来回晃荡。寒意沿着你的脊背一路窜上去。

~ 一位英雄所构想

A colossal golem thrums with the ancient energy of its creator. Twenty feet tall, its broad stride leaves enormous footsteps like scars in the landscape. Its limbs are powerful, long, and well-formed, with a metallic sheen to its chassis. It wanders aimlessly, occasionally bending to scrabble at dark shapes in the dirt. Then it turns with surprising speed and looks directly at you. Its twisted maw hangs agape, the lower jaw slack and swaying to and fro. A shiver runs up your spine.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Wild Magic Surge.name:
狂野魔法涌动
Wild Magic Surge

Text.text:
你的法术收束之际，伴随着一阵出乎意料的涟漪——魔法般的热浪扭曲：那是一道既非恶意亦非善意的警示。你拨弄了充盈万物的无形魔法——如今它回涌向你，鼓胀翻腾，追索平衡。
The conclusion of your spell is accompanied by an unexpected ripple, a magical heat shimmer: a warning neither malevolent nor benign. You’ve manipulated the invisible magic that suffuses everything—now it billows back toward you, swelling, seeking equilibrium.

Using Bardic Inspiration.name:
使用吟游诗人激励
Using Bardic Inspiration

Text.text:
吟游诗人的歌声灌满你的脑海。你握了握双手，感到一股额外的力量正蓄势待发，随时应你所需。身与魂都被微微刺痒的能量充盈，视野也因此愈发清明。你贴着自己的疑虑低声呢喃：“是的，我能行。”而你知道，那千真万确。
The sound of the bard's voice fills your mind. You flex your hands, feeling an extra strength waiting for your need. Body and soul fill with a tingling energy, sight clearer now. You whisper against your doubts: "Yes, I can." And you know it to be true.

Fortress Of The Fomori.name:
弗莫里巨魔要塞
Fortress Of The Fomori

Text.text:
传说中，曾有一个弗莫里安帝国横跨妖精位面。此刻你不禁猜想，这些扭曲巨人用来竖起丑陋而压迫的要塞的那片废墟，是否曾被视作文明的璀璨灯塔。木材与回收来的金属被匆忙捆扎在一起，拼出城垛与路障，其上挂满弗莫里安征服的骇人战利品：漂白的头骨、以骨头搭成的构架、被烈日烤干的兽皮。要塞里涌出的恶臭几乎令人窒息——腐烂的肉、发馊的汗味、以及令人作呕的秽物气息。你瞥见一名哨兵：一头高大、畸形的怪物，皮肤呈深紫瘀青般的颜色，扛着一根巨大的棍棒，棒身缀满哗啦作响的锁链。
Tales are rife of a fomorian empire that once spanned the Plane of Faerie. You wonder now if the ruins upon which these twisted giants have erected their ugly, imposing fortress was once considered a shining beacon of culture. Wood and salvaged metal hastily lashed to one another form ramparts and barricades, bedecked with grisly trophies of fomorian conquest: bleached skulls, structures of bone, and sun-baked hides. The stench emanating from the fortress is nearly overwhelming—rotting meat, stale sweat, and stinking refuse. You catch sight of a sentinel, a towering, misshapen beast with skin the violet of a deep bruise, carrying a massive bludgeon adorned with clattering chains.

这只奇异的球形生物凭借魔法悬浮在空中起起落落，几乎只是一团畸形血肉的圆球，被一只巨大、永不眨动的独眼所支配，竖直的宽大瞳孔冷冷凝视。它鼓胀的躯体裂开成满口尖牙的阔嘴狞笑，一条修长而灵巧可卷的舌头耷拉在外，像探寻的手指般伸探。
The strange, spherical creature bobs through the air using magical levitation, little more than an orb of malformed flesh dominated by a single, unblinking eye with a wide, vertical pupil. Its bulbous body splits into a toothy, wide-mouthed grin, a long, prehensile tongue lolling outward like a probing finger.

你面前的台阶向上延伸，通往一扇披覆着黑暗的门口。石阶被无数来往的居民踏磨得斑驳不堪，既污秽又反复无常。摇曳的火把光在冰冷潮湿的墙面上投下诡谲的影子。你沿着台阶盘旋而上，每一步都回响着不祥的预感……走向未知。
The stairs before you ascend to a doorway sheathed in darkness. The stone steps are worn by the passage of a multitude of denizens both foul and fickle. Flickering torchlight casts eerie shadows upon the stark, damp walls. Each step echoes with foreboding as you wind your way upward… into the unknown.

Main Road Flooded.name:
主干道被淹
Main Road Flooded

Text.text:
无论道路在何处随着地势自然起伏而下陷，洪水都在低洼处遗留下滩滩死水——从浅浅的水洼到铺展开来的池塘不等。蜻蜓在路旁草丛间轻快穿梭，俯身端详水面映出的身影。
Wherever the road dips—with the natural rise and fall of the land—flooding has left pools of stagnant water, varying from shallow puddles to sprawling ponds. Dragonflies flit in the roadside grasses, admiring their reflections in the water.

那存在踏步而出，它的存在本身便在充盈你的感官的同时否定着你。它轮廓近似人形，却由黑烟与血雾凝成。那股威压如巨物般凌驾于你之上，背后由纯粹黑暗织就的影翼缓缓舒展。灼烧般猩红的双眼落在你身上，那存在咧嘴冷笑，流露出亵渎神明般的、贪婪而饥渴的欲念。

~ Requested by John

The being steps forth, and its existence defies you even as it fills your senses. It bears a vaguely humanoid shape, though it’s composed of black smoke and bloody mist. The presence towers over you as shadowy wings of pure darkness unfurl from its back. Eyes, searing red, fall upon you, and the being sneers with an ungodly, ravenous hunger.

~ Requested by John

上千头野牛汇成一支庞大的兽群，沉重而缓慢地游走在乡野间，一边行进一边啃食。它们在迁徙的旅途中来回踱动，抖落蓬乱褐毛上的尘土，裹着绒毛、盘绕长角的巨首左右摇摆，扫视着地平线。
A thousand or more bison form a vast herd, ponderously ranging over the countryside while grazing. They mill about on their pilgrimage, shaking the dust from their shaggy brown coats, and swaying their fleecy, horn-wreathed heads to survey the horizon.

这辆运输油罐车的外壳上潦草涂着警告字样，提醒着车体内盛装的酸液；多处齿轮机括从被酸液飞溅灼穿的车架下裸露出来。他的嗓音低沉沙哑，冷酷漠然，带着只认任务的压迫感与威吓——当齿轮咬合、碾磨着变形成类人姿态后，他的胸膛宽阔、厚实而方正。脸部的数块装甲板也继承了车辆形态时的酸蚀伤痕。他行动像个拾荒者，对自己的外观毫不在意。右臂装着一支酸液喷射器，腰间还佩着一对被酸蚀得坑坑洼洼的爆能枪。

~ Played by MaesterAelix

The transport tanker is scrawled with warnings for the acid within, and its gearwork shows in several places from under acid splashes that have cut through the frame. Its voice is deep and raspy, cruel and uncaring, task-oriented and intimidating—and after grinding into humanoid form, his chest is broad, deep, and square. Several of his face plates share the acid damage from his vehicle form. He moves like a scavenger, careless of his own appearance. His right arm carries an acid sprayer, and he wears a pair of acid-pitted blasters.

~ Played by MaesterAelix

Wrathful Ocean Goddess.name:
暴怒的海洋女神
Wrathful Ocean Goddess

Text.text:
那名空灵的女子漂浮着向你逼近，被无形的暗流托举在半空，长发如光环般在她周围翻涌飘散。她的肌肤——深邃而摄魂的青绿——不断荡起涟漪，流转着夺目的水栖色泽，然而她的眼中却翻滚着风暴将至的怒意。她以穿透灵魂的寒光钉住你，你猛地倒吸一口气，却骇然感到肺里开始灌满液体：你惹怒了你的守护者。
The ethereal woman floats toward you, borne aloft on unseen currents, hair billowing in a halo around her. Her skin—a deep, enchanting turquoise—ripples and shifts constantly in dazzling aquatic hues, yet her eyes hold the wrath of a coming storm. She fixes you with a piercing glare, and you gasp as you feel your lungs start to fill with liquid: you have angered your patron.

Haggling With A Quest Giver.name:
与委托人讨价还价
Haggling With A Quest Giver

Text.text:
“我和朋友们并不怀疑你们事业的正义性，但光靠善行和几句夸奖，可填不饱肚子。我们需要暖和的床铺，烈性的酒。一夜安稳，好让我们在再次扑向险境前喘口气。所以，我想再多要一点——你们子民的安危与性命，难道还不值这些吗？”
“While me and my friends don’t doubt the righteousness of your cause, we can’t feed ourselves with good deeds and pats on the back. We need warm beds and strong drink. A night of peace before we rush into peril once more. So, I ask you for a little extra—surely the safety and lives of your people are worth more than this?”

Stonecrop Flower Patch.name:
景天花丛
Stonecrop Flower Patch

Text.text:
粉红与深红的花团从饱含水分、肥厚翠绿的茎秆上喧闹般迸放而出。这里似乎已被这片绚丽的花海彻底占据，所有可见的表面都覆满了一簇簇顽强的植被。你穿行在葱郁的多肉之间时，一缕甜美而细腻的芬芳若即若离地撩拨着你，引诱你在花间多停留片刻。
Riotous blooms of pink and red erupt from fleshy green stems swollen with moisture. The colorful flower seems to have taken over here, with every available surface covered in patches of the hardy flora. A sweet and delicate aroma teases you as you make your way through the verdant succulents, enticing you to stay a while among the blooms.

Open-air Tavern: Fist Fight.name:
露天酒馆：拳斗
Open-air Tavern: Fist Fight

Text.text:
一杯酒失手坠落，泼了个正闹脾气的酒客满身。对方立刻挥拳反击，却打偏了——目标比挑衅者更灵活，也更清醒。闪避间又撞上端着托盘的侍者，酒水翻洒，滚烫的茶汤淋了满桌人一身。斗殴像野火般蔓延，席卷整间酒馆，顷刻陷入一片混乱。
A drink falls, splashing an already ornery patron. In response a fist flies, but it goes awry—the target more nimble and less drunk than the aggressor. The dodge bumps a server carrying a tray of drinks, drenching a table of people in scalding tea. The brawl spreads like a fire, sweeping the whole tavern into chaos.

这套板条护甲的部分铁条已经断裂或遗失。有人用看起来像某种兽角的条片加固了这些缺口。护甲既然修补过，强度或许不如当初；但换个角度想，它曾把穿戴者护得足够周全，才让他或她活下来，有机会做出这些改装。
Some of the iron strips of this set of splint armor have been broken or gone missing. Someone has reinforced these faults with strips of what looks like some kind of animal horn. The armor having been repaired means it might not be as strong as it once was, but on the other hand, it protected its wearer well enough that he or she could survive to make these modifications.

Climb To The Summit.name:
攀登至巅峰
Climb To The Summit

Text.text:
绕过山脊的拐角，你停下脚步。你的心智艰难地试图理解那盘绕在整座山上的泰坦巨物竟真实存在。生物那庞大的蛇形身躯在悬浮中有节律地起伏波动，洒在鳞片上的星界地图随之旋旋流转，宛如一场天穹芭蕾；它独眼般的雄伟占满了你的视野。
Rounding the corner of the ridge, you stop. Your mind struggles to grasp the reality of the titanic being coiled around the mountain. The creature’s immense serpentine body undulates rhythmically as it hovers, the astral map splashed across its scales swirling in a celestial ballet as its cyclopean grandeur fills your vision.

Short Descriptions Of Five Village Commo.name:
五位村民的简短描述
Short Descriptions Of Five Village Commoners

Text.text:
一名农夫倚着铁锹，抹去沾着泥痕的额头上滚落的汗珠。一个猎人披着皮革与毛皮，细细磨砺箭镞的锋刃，目光警惕地打量着来往行人。一位家长带着两个年幼的孩子旅行，怀里抱满了苹果，凡是与他们对上目光的人，都会收到他们爽朗递来的果子。一个看起来颇有分量的村中领袖，肚腩松垮、眼角细纹深刻，正对着一小群人高声谈笑，安抚众人的惶恐。一名半兽人铁匠挥锤将马蹄铁敲打成形；他身后的墙上挂着一柄巨大的巨斧——那是某个久远年代遗留下来的遗物。
A farmer leans on their shovel, wiping sweat from a dirt-streaked brow. A hunter, garbed in leathers and furs, hones the edge of an arrowhead and watches passersby. A parent and their two young children travel with armloads of apples, handing them cheerfully to any who make eye contact. An important-looking village leader with a sagging gut and crinkled eyes speaks boisterously with a small gathering of others, assuaging fears. A half-orc blacksmith hammers horseshoes into shape; a massive greataxe hangs on the wall behind them, a relic of a bygone age.

Tabaxi Shapechanger.name:
塔巴希变形者
Tabaxi Shapechanger

Text.text:
一只小虎斑猫在你脚边来回蹭着，从你两脚之间穿梭，你为免踩到它而踉跄挪步，差点被它绊倒。它在你面前后腿一蹲，停了片刻——随即那猫科身形竟像被拉长一般伸展开来，四肢节节增长，肌肉迅速隆起，却仍披着那层蓬松的灰黑相间软毛。它翡翠般的眼眸闪着狡黠光芒，嘴角挂着顽皮的笑意；这位猫科兽人摘下与丝绸衣装相配的黑色帽子，行云流水般向你躬身一礼。
A small tabby cat rubs around and between your feet, almost knocking you over as you misstep to avoid treading on it. It sits on its haunches before you for a moment—then the feline seems to elongate, each limb growing, muscles thickening, yet the fluffy gray and black fur remains. With twinkling jade eyes and a mischievous grin, the feline beastfolk removes a black cap which matches his silken clothes and bows to you smoothly.

船舱天花板很低——最适合矮人和其他身材矮小的族群——一盏挂在钩子上、随风摇晃的风暴灯里那点微小火焰，便足以温暖这狭窄的空间。靠一侧墙排着叠床，只留出一条狭窄的许可通向小小的海箱，以及沿着船体内侧弧面向上攀升的层架。
The cabin has a low ceiling—best suited to dwarves and other short peoples—and the small flame in a storm lantern swinging from a hook is enough to warm the cramped space. Stacked beds line one wall giving narrow access to a small sea chest and the shelves that climb the curved inside of the hull.

I Cast Fireball From My Staff Of Power.name:
我从权杖法力之杖中施放火球术
I Cast Fireball From My Staff Of Power

Text.text:
我法杖上的符文炽白如熔钢般灼亮，周遭空气骤然变得沉重而干燥。当我引导魔法时，缕缕黑烟缠绕着我的双手，我随即向敌人轰出一道灼烈的爆炎死光。
The runes along my staff glow white-hot like molten steel as the air around me becomes heavy and arid. Wisps of black smoke coil around my hands when I channel the magic and unleash a searing blast of incendiary death toward my foe.

Creepy Spellbook.name:
诡异的法术书
Creepy Spellbook

Text.text: [掩蔽] 暗红鳞纹皮革覆着书封，嶙峋而尖锐的鳞甲层层叠起；正中央嵌着一枚宝石，像一只泛黄的眼睛。那眼似乎时不时变一下——它刚才动了，还是眨了眨？三只带钩的黑色利爪扣住书脊，将书牢牢合拢；却又像绷紧的弹簧般猛然弹开。 [内容] 书页厚实而半透明，或许是精制羊皮纸。低语从页间渗出，纸面覆满诡异的图绘与蛇行般蜿蜒的文字。 [Cover] Scaled red leather with dark, angular scutes covers this book, which has a gem that looks like a yellowish eye embedded in the center. The eye seems to change intermittently—did it move or blink? Three hooked, black claws hold the book closed. They snap open as if on coiled springs. [Content] The interior sheets are thick and translucent, vellum perhaps. Whispers issue from these pages, which are covered in bizarre drawings and serpentine letters.

无论是为深厚的雪堆与额外劳作所需的最后准备，如今正是时候。坠落的雪黏在帽檐与肩头。动物们披着它，像戴着融化的帽子、穿着融化的外套。雪抹杀了所有声响，只剩靴底踩碎冰晶的咯吱。地面先扣住脚踝，再吞到膝盖，而目的地在这美丽魔咒的威胁中显得遥不可及。
Whatever late preparations are needed for the deep drifts and extra work, now is the time. The falling snow clings to brims and shoulders. Animals wear it like melting hats and coats. The snow kills sound except for the crunch of boots. The ground traps the ankles, then the knees, and the destination is too far away through the threat of this beautiful enchantment.

腐烂使尸体的血肉肿胀发胀，残存的血液已然乌黑。这样的身躯本不该还能站立，更别说拖着沉重的脚步蹒跚向前。它的头颅病态地歪向脖颈上本应端正的位置一侧，紧握成拳的双手里，断裂的指骨清晰可见。本不该还能运作的肺叶却强行挤出一阵咕噜作响的喘鸣，从这生物塌陷的喉咙里滚出，随即自它破裂的唇间喷溅出一股浓稠的暗色液体。
Rot bloats the flesh of the corpse, and what blood remains runs black. This body has no right to stand, let alone shuffle forward on dragging feet. Its head leans sickly to one side of the correct position atop the neck, and the tight fists it has made clearly have broken fingers. Lungs that should not work push out a gurgling wheeze from the creature’s collapsed throat, sending a gout of dark fluid from between its broken lips.

Forest Ruins Camp.name:
森林遗迹营地
Forest Ruins Camp

Text.text:
有人曾在这片废墟里扎营，借着崩塌的墙垣作屏障。你能看见几顶圆形帐篷的帐尖立在其间，几缕细瘦的青烟蜿蜒升起，说明里面正燃着火。藤蔓缠覆的墙壁提供了许多绝佳的藏身瞭望点，但乍一眼望去，你一个哨位也没发现。
Someone has made camp here in the ruins, using the crumbling walls to guard it. You can see the tops of circular tents erected inside, and a few slim lines of smoke show that fires burn within. The vine-shrouded walls provide many good spots for lookouts to hide, but you see none at first glance.

大片珊瑚自海中拔起，连成一串岛链，恰好露出水面一线，让阳光得以照拂。游荡在这些薄如轻纱的陆地上的生灵，或许在世间别处再也寻不见。
Masses of coral rise from the sea, forming a chain of islands that peek above the waterline just enough to expose it to sunlight. Roaming these wisps of land are creatures perhaps found nowhere else.

在一头高耸的麋鹿坐骑背上，骑手眺望风吹草低的大草原，双眼如地平线上落日的余晖般炽烈。他将帽檐往下拉了拉，帽下便有火星飞舞，仿佛一团闷燃的火被惊动；随即以轻柔一踢催促坐骑继续前行。两侧腰间与鞍上的枪套里都安放着枪械，每一把都保养得一丝不苟、工艺精美，专为精准而冷酷的死亡而生。邻近峡谷中骤然冲出一群骑手，枪手露出赌徒般的笑意：他的目标终于来了。

~ Played by Vahlaron

From atop a towering elk, a rider gazes out across the windswept prairie, his eyes ablaze like the setting sun on the horizon. As he pulls the brim of his hat lower, embers dance from beneath it, as if a smoldering fire had been disturbed, and he urges his mount onward with a gentle nudge. Guns rest upon each hip and in the holster of his saddle, each one meticulously maintained and beautifully crafted to deliver precise and merciless death. A gang of riders erupts from a nearby canyon, and the gunslinger allows himself a gambler’s smile: his quarry has arrived at last.

~ Played by Vahlaron

Gravekeeper’s Table.name:
守墓人的桌子
Gravekeeper’s Table

Text.text:
这张小桌子最多能坐两人——硬挤的话也许三人——但旁边只摆着一把椅子。桌上放着两只陶杯和一根未点燃的烛台，旁边还有一张纸条。羊皮纸已泛黄，字迹晕开，仿佛曾被水浸过又干透。
The little table could seat two—maybe three in a pinch—but a single chair stands beside it. A couple of clay mugs and an unlit candlestick stand on the table, along with a note. The parchment is yellowed and the writing smudged, as though it has been exposed to water and dried.

Vampire Thrall.name:
吸血鬼的奴仆
Vampire Thrall

Text.text:
侏儒紧张地抽动着，圆睁的眼睛左右来回乱窜。无力的棕发黏在额头上，眼下挂着深深的青黑，明明白白地写着她已经好几天没合眼。她的手指不断攥紧又松开，仿佛在拼命让冻僵的双手重新找回一点温度；而她赤裸、冻伤的脚上，已经少了几根脚趾。你注意到她身上布满细小的针刺般疤痕——尤其集中在脖颈与手臂上。
The gnome twitches nervously, her wide eyes darting back and forth. Limp brown hair is matted to her forehead and deep bags hang under her eyes, a clear indicator she has not slept in days. Her fingers clench and open constantly as if she is trying to get the warmth back to her frozen hands, and she has lost several toes from her bare, frostbitten feet. You notice that she is covered in small pinprick scars—particularly on her neck and arms.

火焰回应你的召唤，在你掌心无害地跳动闪烁。你以近乎严苛的专注操控其中的能量，将热量转移到旁边一块金属上。它立刻炽红发亮，灼热如烧。
The flame answers your call, flickering in the palm of your hand harmlessly. With a severe focus, you manipulate the flame's energy and transfer the heat to a nearby piece of metal. It instantly glows red-hot.

I Drink My Potion Of Heroism.name:
我喝下英勇药剂
I Drink My Potion Of Heroism

Text.text:
青绿的蒸汽从瓶口袅袅升起，药液在瓶中温柔地咕嘟作响。我仰头饮下，只觉身与魂一同回春。下颌一绷，整个人蓄势待发，迎向下一场不知名的挑战。
Turquoise steam rises out of the flask as the potion gently simmers. I take a drink and feel a rejuvenation in both body and spirit. I square my jaw, ready for whatever challenge awaits me next.

Transhumanist In The Net Heckles Party I.name:
网络里的超人类主义者在真实空间里嘲弄队伍
Transhumanist In The Net Heckles Party In Real Space

Text.text: 就像被困在一段无法跳过的广告里。巨幅屏幕上、出发时刻牌上、咖啡馆里、在人行道边——那张脸无处不在。像素堆出的狞笑与咧嘴，金属多过血肉。你或许能闭上眼躲一会儿——前提是你没有光学植入体。没错，它们甚至钻进了你体内，朝你咆哮辱骂，迸出干扰噪点，把你的视野搅得一塌糊涂。你目光所及之处，尽是它们。无处不在。 It is like being inside an unskippable ad. On the billboard screens, on the departure boards, in the cafes and on the sidewalks, the face is inescapable. A leering, grinning collection of pixels, more metal than flesh. You could close your eyes to it for a while. Those that don’t have optical implants, that is. Yes, they’re even inside you, yelling insults, sparking distortion, and ruining your vision. They are everywhere you look. Everywhere.

这副厚重的深色皮革面具，鼻口处向前延伸出一段细长的鸟喙般突起。其上方是覆着玻璃的开孔，用以护住双眼。两条绑带将面具牢牢固定：一条绕过耳上方的头部，另一条贴合头顶越过头皮。钢制扣环将玻璃镜片紧紧锁住，金属铆钉把绑带钉在面具上，扣具则用于系紧固定。整件鸟形装束散发着浓烈的薰衣草与皮革气味。
This mask of heavy, dark leather has a long, beaklike protrusion for its nose and mouth. Above that, glass-covered openings protect the eyes. Two straps hold the mask in place, with one going around the head just above the ears while the other fits over the scalp. Steel loops secure the glass lenses in place, metal rivets bind the straps to the mask, and buckles provide fasteners. The whole birdlike garment smells strongly of lavender and leather.

Casting A Magical Protective Frost.name:
施放魔法护体寒霜
Casting A Magical Protective Frost

Text.text:
你的手指飞快交织，划出一连串诡异的手势；与此同时，你的口中吐出那些在梦里被低语进你耳中的畸邪音节。咒语收束之际，你将一小团清水抛向空中，随即踏前一步。水珠在半空骤然减速，贴着你的肌肤凝结成冰；那薄薄的霜层向周遭散出令人不适、甚至刺痛的寒意，而你却感到自己被牢牢护住，足以抵御近在眼前的伤害。

~ 构想 by Kyrus (Brent)

Your fingers knit quickly in a series of strange gestures, even as your mouth spits forth aberrant syllables whispered to you in your dreams. Finishing the incantation, you toss a small volume of water into the air and step forward. The water slows and freezes around your skin, and though the thin layer of frost emits an uncomfortable, even painful cold to those around you, you feel well-protected from immediate harm.

~ Envisioned by Kyrus (Brent)

Armored Leather Jacket.name:
装甲皮夹克
Armored Leather Jacket

Text.text:
这看起来就是一件再寻常不过的机车夹克，给那些乐子仔和摩托帮穿的那种。可很快你就发现了细微的改造——后背那道被割开的缝线被重新分开，又用一块结构复杂的凯夫拉护板缝合回去。手臂的布料里织入了超高密度的纳米纤维，肘部周围的皮革补丁其实是高科技复合材料，足以轻松抵住刀刃——也许连子弹都能扛住。这件毫不起眼的夹克，显然是为防护而打造的。
This seems like your average biker jacket, something for the joyboys and the biker gangs. Then you notice the subtle alterations—the sliced rear seam has been split then sutured with a complex Kevlar plate. Hyper-dense nanofibers are woven into the fabric of the arms, and the leather patches around the elbows are actually composed of a high-tech composite, able to shrug off blades—maybe even bullets. This nondescript jacket has clearly been constructed for protection.

Quiet Amphitheater.name:
静谧圆形剧场
Quiet Amphitheater

Text.text:
环绕阶段呈半圆的石雕长凳座位，层层向上攀升。苔藓沿着座席悄然爬满，以鲜活的翠绿吞没整座露天剧场。龟裂的石板铺作阶段，历经数十年的演出磨得圆润光滑。尽管寂静统治着这片空间，你仍仿佛能想见演员的嗓音远远传开，雷鸣般的掌声、喧闹的笑声，以及被强忍压下的抽泣。
The bench seats, carved of stone, which surround the stage in a semi-circle, ascend in tiers. Moss creeps up over the seating, overtaking the amphitheater with vibrant green. Cracked flagstones serve as the stage, worn smooth over decades of performances. Though silence dominates the space, you imagine the voices of performers carrying far, the thunderous applause, raucous laughter, and stifled sobs.

Coup De Grace With Blunt Weapon.name:
使用钝器的致命一击
Coup De Grace With Blunt Weapon

Text.text:
你阴沉地攥紧武器的柄身，将全身重量灌入一记沉砸，狠狠劈落在那纹丝不动的头颅上，骨头当即在数处崩裂。殷红的血与灰白的脑浆淤泥般从敌人的耳中缓缓渗出。
Grimly securing your grip on the haft of your weapon, you bring it down in a stroke bolstered by your body weight, smashing into the unmoving head and breaking the skull in several places. Red blood and some gray sludge of brain matter begin to leak from your enemy’s ears.

Ring Of Water Elemental Command.name:
水元素统御之戒
Ring Of Water Elemental Command

Text.text:
你凝视着这枚平平无奇的银戒上镶嵌的那颗难以辨识的蓝绿色宝石，几乎敢发誓自己看见其中的色彩在变幻摇曳，宛如海潮在嶙峋的岩岸间一涨一落、反复冲刷。
Staring into the unidentifiable blue-green gem set into this otherwise unremarkable silver ring, you swear you can see the colors shift and sway, much like the tide of the ocean washing up and down a rocky shore.

霜花在山岳探险者的护目镜上微光流转，他站在艰辛攀登后的高处，尽情饱览眼前的景致。可当他试图在松软的粉雪里挪动重心时，臃肿的身形竟滑稽地鼓胀起来——那是层层叠叠的衣装带来的不幸代价。虽说多层外套、抓绒与保暖内衣为他挡住刺骨寒意，他却讽刺地行动僵硬，仿佛真的被冻成了冰雕。

~ Envisioned by Dwayne on Discord

Frost shimmers across the goggles of the mountain explorer as he enjoys the view from his hard-fought climb. His body balloons in comical fashion as he struggles to shift his weight in the powdery snow—an unfortunate consequence of his many-layered attire. Though the many layers of coats, fleeces, and thermal undergarments afford him protection from the cold, he ironically moves like he’s frozen stiff.

~ Envisioned by Dwayne on Discord

I Disparage An Enemy.name:
我贬抑一名敌人
I Disparage An Enemy

Text.text:
“我敢肯定你在你出生的那滩泥水里曾是个了不起的战士，可到了这儿，你不过是又一个握着剑、自以为还需要证明点什么的蠢货。”
“I’m sure you were quite the warrior in whatever mud puddle you were spawned in, but out here you’re just another idiot with a sword and something to prove.”

Avatar Of Bahamut.name:
巴哈姆特的化身
Avatar Of Bahamut

Text.text:
背脊挺直却毫无威胁，这名男子举止谦和，却又自带王者般的端肃威仪。他周围盘旋着七只小金丝雀，行为却几乎不像鸟。其中一只落在他肩头，猛地探出脑袋，张开细小的喙，发出嘶嘶的低鸣。他白发如霜，双眼略显乳白，身披与眼中青白色泽相映的长袍。他几乎处处透出术士气息，却又并非真正的法师。更不止是单纯的魔法——他与心腹交谈时的神态里，有某种更高远的东西：关于他们，以及他们的主人，究竟是什么的真相。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

Straight-backed and non-threatening, the man carries himself with humility, but also a regal dignity. Around him fly seven little canaries that do not act much like birds. One lights on his shoulder, thrusts its head forward, opens its tiny beak, and hisses. He is white-haired and a bit milky-eyed, wearing robes that match the bluish white of his eyes. Nearly everything about him indicates wizardry, but he is not quite a wizard. There is something beyond mere magic in the way he confers with his confidants: something greater about who they, and their master, really are.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Backwater Town Decimated By Giants.name:
被巨人夷为废墟的偏僻小镇
Backwater Town Decimated By Giants

Text.text:
鲜血与死寂的褐色积水搅作一团，暴雨鞭打着这座被洗劫的小镇残破不堪的废墟。披着污秽皮甲的臃肿巨兽在征服后的瓦砾间游荡，咆哮着冷酷的狂喜，追猎那些苦苦哀求的幸存者。小镇并不常见于地图之上，却绝不该落得如此下场。

~ 由 Discord 上的 The_DM 构想

Blood mingles with stagnant brown water as rain pelts the dilapidated ruins of the ransacked town. Corpulent behemoths in dirty hide jerkins wander the wreckage of their conquest, bellowing with merciless glee as they hunt down pleading survivors. The town wasn't on many maps, but it didn't deserve this.

~ Envisioned by The_DM on Discord

Words Of Encouragement After Failure.name:
失败后的鼓励之言
Words Of Encouragement After Failure

Text.text:
“也许我们并不是英雄。那又有什么不好？也许我们并非注定要拯救世界，或纠正祖辈的罪错。也许我们被选中，只是要在边缘处伸出援手——把我们遭遇的那几个绝望之人抬出泥沼，然后悄然退回安逸与无名，让更勇敢的灵魂去扛起时代的重担。”
“Perhaps we’re not heroes. Is that so bad? Maybe we’re not fated to save the world or right ancestral wrongs. Maybe we were chosen to simply help within the margins, to elevate the desperate few we encounter before slipping into comfort and obscurity while other, braver souls shoulder the responsibility of ages.”

宽阔的护城河环绕着城堡，河中满是污泥、内脏与粪秽，腥臭翻涌，足以让任何妄图闯入者望而却步。没人愿意冒险坠落进去——尤其还穿着护甲。
Ripe with slurry, offal, and excrement, the wide moat encircling the castle presents a truly formidable deterrent to would-be intruders. No one wants to risk falling into that—especially in armor.

Martial Artist Using A Wheelchair.name:
使用轮椅的武术家
Martial Artist Using A Wheelchair

Text.text:
新来的精灵见习者得意地打量着对手——一个坐在轮椅上的人类。两人摆开架势，战斗随即开始。转瞬之间，那位以轮椅为身的武者已逼至见习者面门寸许。见习者勉强侧身闪过，却始终摸不到一丝破绽：每一次出手都被那坚不可摧的椅身硬生生挡下，或被对方借力引势的防御手法轻巧化解——如同不可撼动的山岳，兼具怒牛般的蛮力与宗师般的专注精准。冷汗沿着见习者的脸颊滚落，他望进眼前人那穿透灵魂的湛蓝双眼，拼命从中搜寻哪怕一线可乘之机。
The new elven initiate looks smugly at his opponent who is sat in a wheelchair. They both take their stances and the fight begins. Within an instant, the martial artist using the wheelchair is inches away from the initiate’s face. Barely dodging out of the way, the initiate fails to land any blows, each strike deflected by the impregnable chair itself or by the redirection defensive technique of its user—an immovable mountain with the strength of a raging bull and the dedicated precision of a master. Sweat pours down the initiate’s face as he gazes into the piercing blue eyes of the human before him and desperately studies them for an opening.

“坐稳坐正，让你找到自己的中心，呼吸也更顺畅。每当有个念头闯进来，挡住你的空明，就试试这个：把那个念头放进一艘小船里，看着它随波漂远。”
“Sit balanced, so you can find your center and breathe easily. Whenever a thought gets in the way of your emptiness, just try this: put that thought on a little boat and watch it float away.”

Iron Buckle For A Wide Belt.name:
宽腰带用铁扣
Iron Buckle For A Wide Belt

Text.text:
黯淡磨损的扣环，是系在战斗腰带上的双股皮扣系带的一对之一。它的分量几乎与一把匕首相当，看起来也同样危险。
Dull and worn, this buckle is one of a pair for the double leather hitches attached to a war belt. It weighs as much as a dagger and looks almost as dangerous.

Harpy Encounter.name:
鹰身女妖遭遇
Harpy Encounter

Text.text:
那生物歌声的华美旋律，是你此生所闻最勾魂夺魄的声音之一；但你心底清楚，这生物——纵然披着年轻人类女子的容貌——对你唯有伤害之意。你能否在那哀婉的曲调中撑得足够久，躲开它刀锋般锐利的利爪？
The gorgeous melody of the creature's song is as alluring a sound as you've ever heard, but you know in your heart that this creature—despite wearing the features of a young human woman—means you nothing but harm. Can you resist its mournful tune long enough to avoid its razor-sharp claws?

Castle Dining Hall.name:
城堡宴会厅
Castle Dining Hall

Text.text:
喧嚣的欢呼与热烈的乐声充塞空中，王国各地的佳肴在绵延整座大厅的长桌上交汇成一片。头顶悬着巨大的熟铁枝形吊灯，滴落的牛脂蜡烛点点摇曳，照亮纵情嬉闹的狂欢者与这场盛宴。
Raucous cheers and lively music fill the air, as dishes from every corner of the kingdom mingle on the vast tables that span the length of the hall. Huge wrought iron chandeliers set with dripping tallow candles hang above the cavorting revelers, illuminating the festivities.

Loot From A Red Dragon Lair Hoard.name:
红龙巢穴宝库战利品
Loot From A Red Dragon Lair Hoard

Text.text:
冒着烟的巨龙残骸倒在它的宝藏堆里，炽热将一层小饰物与钱币熔成一座金色摇篮。宝库浩瀚无边，一直铺展到这座洞窟的尽头。钱币起伏如丘，但你也发现了几件同样引人注目的东西：几件矮人打造、状态极佳的器物——刻着矮人贵族形象的石雕小像、以纯银铸成的装饰性武器、以及一只用光滑火山玻璃制成的机关盒。最后，一柄剑的剑柄从三块尖锐岩石之间探出头来，那是用洞窟天然岩石临时拼成的陈列架。它散发出压迫性的热浪，强如熔炉；而剑身本体则如同被铸成金属的火舌般起伏游动。
The smoking carcass of the dragon has collapsed among its treasure, melting a layer of trinkets and coins into a golden cradle. The hoard is vast, spreading to the edges of this cavern. The rolling hills of coins notwithstanding, you find some other items of interest as well. There are artifacts of dwarven make in excellent condition: stone statuettes of noble dwarven personae, decorative weapons crafted of pure silver, a puzzle box crafted of smooth volcanic glass. Finally, the hilt of a sword sticks out of a trio of sharp rocks, a makeshift display formed from the natural rock of the cave. An oppressive heat emanates from it, strong as a forge, and the blade itself undulates like a tongue of flame taken metal form.

Augustanna Fortune.name:
奥古斯坦娜·福钧
Augustanna Fortune

Text.text:
她的舞步由一连串优雅的旋转、拱身与踢腿编织而成，间或穿插着侠客般的突刺与细剑的飒然挥掠。红发在她脸侧狂舞，如同寻觅落点的火焰触须。粉、深红与橙色丝绸的衣装随每一次行云流水的移动绽放、悬浮、又骤然贴紧。她耀眼得令人屏息，仿佛火被召来、并被塑成轻灵的形体。她以一记踏地收束全套动作，朝最近的一群看客眨眼，随即引来热烈的喝彩。她的眼睛亮如祖母绿，既倾泻美感，也散发力量。此刻她终于静止，手臂上的黑色纹身才清晰显现：繁复的卷草纹路，形态宛如火舌回旋的卷曲。

~ Played by SixteenCharlie3 with

Her dance is a series of elegant spins, arches, and kicks, paired with swashbuckling thrusts and swishes of her rapier. Her red hair whips about her face like tendrils of fire seeking purchase. Her clothes of pink, crimson, and orange silk bloom, hover and tighten with each fluid movement. She is a resplendent sight, like fire conjured and taken lithesome form. She ends her routine with a stomp of her feet and wink at the nearest group of onlookers, a gesture met with fervid applause. Her eyes, as bright as emeralds, radiate both beauty and power. Now that she is finally still, the black tattoos of her arms become apparent: intricate scrollwork, their shapes recalling furls of flame.

~ Played by SixteenCharlie3 with

Main Road In Snowy Winter.name:
雪冬主干道
Main Road In Snowy Winter

Text.text:
主干道埋在一床厚雪之下。勇敢的旅人踏实了脚印与车辙，踩出一条小径指引方向；然而道路两侧堆积的雪仍旧深厚而平整——表面覆着一层霜晶，闪闪发亮。光秃的树枝也别有风姿，披着冬日的盛装，显得分外雅致。
The main road lies beneath a quilt of snow. Brave travelers have tamped down a path of footprints and furrows to mark the way, although the snow banked on either side remains deep and smooth—glittering with a coating of frost. The bare-branched trees are an elegant sight, robed in their winter finery.

The Goblet Of Divulgence.name:
坦白之杯
The Goblet Of Divulgence

Text.text:
水晶杯盏在杯柄近处呈分形般的裂纹，使光线得以穿透酒液起舞，将深紫色液体的部分映成鲜亮的勃艮第红。杯柄是一束藤蔓般盘旋扭结的银色编辫，末端接着一只镶嵌紫水晶的扁平杯足。杯足边缘缀着蕾丝般的波 scallop 细褶。

~ 出自令人惊叹的 TTRPG 补充资料 The Vineyard

The crystal bowl, fractaled near the stem, allows light to dance through the wine, transforming sections of the deep purple liquid to a vibrant burgundy. The stem is a vining, twisting braid of silver ending in a flat foot inlaid with amethysts. The edge of the foot has a lace-like scalloped frill.

~ Found in the amazing TTRPG supplement The Vineyard

Troll-infested Hills.name:
巨魔盘踞的丘陵
Troll-infested Hills

Text.text:
雨开始落下，把这些嶙峋丘陵的黑暗岩石涂抹成一层湿滑的乌黑光泽。按理应当在这危险地形上蹦跳嬉戏的野羊与山羊却不见踪影，缺席得令人不安。浅显的足迹在愈发猛烈的暴雨冲刷下迅速消失，但有些石头上却留着深深的刻痕，仿佛有某种生物反复用利爪刮擦来磨尖——而且痕迹全都在与人齐高的位置。
Rain begins to fall, painting the dark stones of these rocky hills a slick black. The wild sheep and goats you’d expect to find gamboling about this dangerous terrain remain ominously absent. Simple tracks disappear under the onslaught of the building storm, but some stones bear deep marks, as if a creature were repeatedly scraping its claws to sharpen them, all at head height.

魔法的环形线条在目标周围浮现——紫、金、银三色——彼此缠绕旋转，织成一枚球体，迸出如刀刃在磨石上相擦般的火星。那些圆环向目标合拢，伴随着清晰可闻的咔声骤然扣紧，随即凝固不动，魔法的外壳将其包裹在虹彩般的光泽里。符文在其四周的空气中悬浮，继而在一阵微光中消散，仿佛是魅影（特征）的萤火虫闪电。

~ 构想：Alex

Circular lines of magic appear around the target—purple, gold, and silver—spinning around each other to create a sphere, sparking like blades at a grindstone. The circles convene upon the target with an audible snap, and they freeze in place, the shell of magic encasing them in an iridescent sheen. Runes hover in the air around them before disappearing with a shimmer, as if they were phantom lightning bugs.

~ Envisioned by Alex

Bugbear Battle: Bugbears.name:
熊地精之战：熊地精
Bugbear Battle: Bugbears

Text.text:
这些巨大的类人生物并非行走，而是侧身潜行、悄然尾随，只在出其不意的瞬间猛然扑击。它们每一个都轻易比你和你的同伴高出一两颗头，可大多数时候却把身躯蜷缩佝偻，毛发浓密的长肢紧绷盘起，蓄势待发。它们张着布满利齿的巨口，竖着宽大的耳朵；那副模样与其说像地精的近亲，不如说像暴怒的狼之于狗——同源，却凶残得令人胆寒。
These huge humanoids sidle and stalk rather than walk, only to lunge at surprising moments. Each would easily stand a head or two taller than you and your friends, but most of the time they keep their bodies hunched, long hairy limbs coiled to spring. With toothy maws and large ears, they resemble their goblin kin in the way raging wolves resemble dogs.

第一个瞬间，是那枚将世界的两半钉在一起的别针滑脱，叮叮当当地沿着一段冷峻的楼梯一路弹跳，坠入黑暗，震碎了心智。第二个瞬间，是他们险险地悬在一根磨损起毛的绳索上，脚下是布满尖刺的深坑。在这两个瞬间之间，生出了一种可怖的疑虑：这万花筒般混乱的痛楚与绝望，也许永无止境。但绳索没有断，如今他们开始攀爬。
The first moment was when a pin that held together the two halves of the world slipped free and went pinging down a stark flight of stairs into the dark, shattering the mind. The second moment was when they perilously hung from a fraying rope over a pit of spikes. Somewhere between these two moments came a horrible doubt, that this kaleidoscope of confused pain and desperation might never end. But the rope didn’t break, and now they climb.

The Asatti River.name:
阿萨提河
The Asatti River

Text.text:
紧邻蟹井围城奔流的大河，将人畜万物尽数牵引至它生机盎然的河岸。湿润泥土的清新气息扑面而来，河蒲随风摇曳，澄澈水流奔涌作响；沿河旅行之人，皆能在这片景致里寻得一份宁静。阿萨提河自南方山脉倾泻而下，灌溉乡野，并汇入蟹井的运河网络。商贾、水上出租船与渔夫来来往往——后者更乐于追逐鱼群，那些鱼在水势中银光一闪，便跃出水面，像碎裂的亮片般疾掠而过。
The great river that runs adjacent to the walled city of Crabwell draws all—people and beast alike—to its vibrant banks. The refreshing scent of watered earth, the sway of river reeds, and the rushing of clear waters offers a serenity for all who travel along it. Running down from the southern mountain range, the Asatti irrigates the countryside and feeds into the canals of Crabwell. Merchants, water-taxis and fishers boat up and down it—the latter enjoying a lively chase after the schools of fish that can be seen leaping from the flow in quick flashes of silver.

Loot From A Blight Dragon's Rider.name:
枯疫巨龙骑手的战利品
Loot From A Blight Dragon's Rider

Text.text:
一枚暗银质地的奖章挂在邪教徒颈间，黑色珐琅作底，其上刻着一枚龙的头骨。腰带上还系着一只手铃：铃身、铃柄与铃舌皆由烟灰色玻璃制成，表面蚀刻着奥秘符号。
A medallion of dark silver is strung around the cultist’s neck, depicting a dragon’s skull on a field of black enamel. Strapped to their belt is a handbell: the bell, handle, and clapper are all made from smoky gray glass and etched with arcane symbols.

鲨鱼的尸体几乎只剩一具破烂、血水浸透的残躯，被翻涌起泡的浪头来回冲撞，生物的大片血肉已然缺失。尸身周围激起一场疯狂的撕咬狂潮，较小的生物争相从这头曾经威风凛凛的掠食者身上撕下一口肉。
The shark’s corpse is little more than a ragged, blood-soaked cadaver being jostled by the foaming waves, and large chunks of the creature are missing. A feeding frenzy thrashes around the body, as smaller creatures take their pound of flesh from the once-mighty predator.

导弹命中之际，你周遭的世界被刺目的白光吞没，震耳欲聋的爆炸轰然炸开，碎片向四面八方狂飞。冲击波以碾压般的力量将你掀上半空，像被恼怒的孩子随手丢弃的玩具般把你抛到一旁。
The world around you is engulfed in blinding light as the missile impacts, the deafening explosion causing debris to fly in all directions. The shockwave hurls you through the air with crushing force, tossing you aside like a toy discarded by a frustrated child.

Restless Hobgoblin.name:
躁动的大地精
Restless Hobgoblin

Text.text:
这红皮生物高大魁梧，厚重而下垂的眉骨遮住一双黄色眼睛，锐利得仿佛能刺穿人心。覆板护甲虽显陈旧，却保养得当，又以皮革加固；穿戴者每次移动、焦躁地挪动身躯时，护甲便发出吱呀作响的呻吟。生物一只利爪之手搭在腰间阔剑的剑柄上，阴沉地瞪视着，胸腔深处滚出低沉的轰鸣。
The crimson-skinned creature stands tall and broad, a heavy, slouching brow obscuring yellow eyes, keen and piercing. The plated armor, worn but well-maintained and reinforced with leather, creaks with every movement as the wearer shifts restlessly. The creature rests a clawed hand on the pommel of the broadsword at its hip, and glowers, rumbling deep in its chest.

Tracks On Mountain Path.name:
山道上的足迹
Tracks On Mountain Path

Text.text:
这条小径大多贴着山体的岩棚蜿蜒而行，只有一流的追踪者才能在石面上辨出那生物留下的踪迹。至于一般的游侠，则必须依靠更多线索——树干上的刮痕，或小径周围草丛里细微的扰动——才能勉强跟上。而外行早已把猎物彻底跟丢，只能凭空猜测它去了哪里。
The path is mostly the mountain’s rock shelf, so only a first-rate tracker can spot the creature’s spoor. Other signs—on trees or in grass around the trail—are necessary for any middling ranger. And amateurs have lost the quarry entirely, so are left to their guesswork.

这生物如同一团骇人的漩涡：凄厉的嚎叫翻卷其中，尖啸的狂风撕裂耳膜，骨质钙化在碰撞中咔哒作响。无数骨骸在血魔法的黏合下旋成一具幽冥般的躯体，外披以肠线粗粗缝起的破布残衣。一圈人类指骨的光环漂浮在那颗长角兽颅之上——那便是它的头。它的手臂细长得不合常理，由猛犸股骨拼接而成；双手则是桡骨与尺骨、獠牙与利爪拧成的畸形合体。它掠行而来，魅影所过之处，无肉的尸骸纷纷起身，追随其后；它向你滑近，只为把你也纳入那可怖的收藏。
The creature is a horrible vortex of harrowing howls, screaming winds, and clacking calcification. A cyclone of bones held together by blood magic to form a spectral body draped in gut-stitched rags. A halo of human phalanges floats above the longhorn skull that serves as this creature's head. Its overlong arms are made of mammoth femurs, and its hands are an amalgam of radial and ulnar bones, tusks, and claws. Fleshless cadavers rise in the phantom's wake as it glides toward you, seeking to add you to its collection.

即便已深入至此，黑暗仍如铁幕般压迫，水压也几乎要将你碾碎；更深的深处依然在下方等待。裂隙张开巨口，向下坠落数千英尺，直通彻底而绝对的黑暗。你不由得想：在那样深、那样黑的地方，究竟栖息着什么？仅仅设想，你便不寒而栗。
Even this far down, with the oppressive darkness and crushing pressure, there await still deeper depths. The chasm yawns, descending thousands of feet into complete and total darkness. You wonder: what dwells down there, so deep and so dark? You shudder to think.

Magic Sword Awakened By Blood.name:
鲜血唤醒的魔法之剑
Magic Sword Awakened By Blood

Text.text: 你注意到粗糙的石地上躺着一把剑：黯淡的金属剑身、磨损的皮革握柄，让你在走过时不以为意。忽然，一丝微弱的闪光攫住你的视线，仿佛某种与生俱来的力量源泉濒临枯竭，却仍从剑中向外辐射。你转身，带着好奇，用双手将它拾起。 剑刃在你一侧手掌上划出一道口子；当你闻到自己血液的铁锈味时，你猛然意识到——刃口已被重新开锋，锋利得发亮；握柄的皮革缠带也变得紧实而深黑，仿佛才刚做成。你的脑海里，有个声音回荡。 “… 我的…” You notice a sword on the rough stone ground, its dull metal blade and worn leather grip causing you to dismiss it as you walk by. Then a faint glint catches your eye, as if some innate source of power on the verge of depletion radiates out of the sword. You turn, curious, picking it up with both hands. The blade nicks one palm, and as you smell the metallic scent of your own blood, you suddenly realize the edge is now whetted and the leather bindings of the grip are now tight and dark, as if freshly made. In your head, a voice echoes. “… Mine…”

这座石祭坛多半曾有别的用途，曾供奉着某个远古族群所崇敬的神祇。千年万载的血渍浸染其表面。如今祭坛上摆着蜡烛，火光摇曳，将飘忽不定的影子投在墙上。图腾装点着这片空间，一尊比一尊面孔更诡异、更阴森。有些像人形，却狰狞如怪；另一些则全无任何已知轮廓，仿佛无定形的梦魇化作实体。尽管气氛令人不安，这片空间仍带着修院般的静谧感，似乎本就为祈祷与冥想而设。
The stone altar likely once served a different purpose, devoted to a god revered by an ancient people. The blood of millennia stains its surface. Candles sit atop it now, flickering and casting wavering shadows against the wall. Totems adorn the space, each with a stranger and more sinister face than the last. Some appear humanoid, if monstrous; others evoke no known shapes at all, instead appearing as amorphous, nightmarish visions brought to life. The space carries the feel of a cloister, intended for prayer and meditation, despite the unnerving atmosphere.

Aicyon Aedbinder.name:
冰缚者·艾西昂
Aicyon Aedbinder

Text.text:
他低伏着身子，俯在一丛花前，将其中一朵轻轻捧在掌心。那双眼睛是跳动的翠绿，笑意温柔。肤色苍白得过分，在高耸树影的阴翳里竟泛着一层淡蓝。他把头发束到脑后，金黄的发束如长穗垂过肩头，蓬松轻软，像狐尾般微微翘起。他背弓的姿态像个朴素的林间猎人或游侠，弓弦斜搭在粗糙皮背心的胸前。背上的箭袋装满箭矢，尾羽取自本地各色鸟类。两把长剑悬在腰侧，连鞘皆与其余护甲同样——磨旧、未经鞣制的皮革。

~ 由一位英雄 扮演

Hunched low over a patch of flowers, the elf cups one in his hand, his eyes sprightly green and his smile gentle. The tone of his skin is so pale, it seems blue in the shade of the looming trees. His hair is tied back out of his face, the train of yellow locks draping over his shoulder and bristling as softly as a foxtail. He wears his bow in the manner of a simple forester or ranger, with the string slung over the front of his rough leather jerkin. The quiver on his back is full of arrows fletched with feathers of various local birds. Two swords hang at his hips, sheathed in the same scuffed and untanned leather as the rest of his armor.

~ Played by a Hero

Loot From A Tortle Necromancer.name:
龟族死灵法师的遗留战利品
Loot From A Tortle Necromancer

Text.text:
死灵法师的甲壳外缠着一只由类人皮革制成的挎包。你在里面找到一方绣有姓名缩写、溅满干涸血迹的手帕，一袋120枚金币，以及一副黑白单色的塔罗牌。
Looped around the necromancer’s shell is a satchel made of humanoid hide. Inside, you find a monogrammed handkerchief spattered with dried blood, a pouch of 120 gold pieces, and a deck of monochromatic tarot cards.

The Sanctuary: Cliff Cave.name:
圣所：峭壁洞窟
The Sanctuary: Cliff Cave

Text.text:
瀑布旁的峭壁上，被撕裂出一道参差嶙峋的入口，通向一座黑暗的洞窟。奔涌的水流激起迷雾，水珠凝在你的胡须上；你划进洞内，脚下的水被搅得翻滚不息。光线一点点死去，霉湿的气味灌满鼻腔，你终于触到坚实的地面。一缕轻风自黑暗中吹来，比外头更冷，直扑向你。
A jagged entrance into a dark cave has been torn into the side of the cliff near a waterfall. The cascading water creates a mist that beads on your whiskers and churns under you as you paddle into the cavern. The light slowly dies away, and a musty smell fills your nose as you finally come into contact with solid ground. A subtle breeze, colder than it was outside, blows out of the darkness toward you.

Group Of Students Between Classes.name:
课间成群的学生
Group Of Students Between Classes

Text.text:
他们把长袍穿得几乎踩到着装规定的边缘——领带松松垮垮地歪着，长袍最上面的扣襻解开，或是少了一颗纽扣。袜子花得张扬。有人施了个法术，弄出一件她长袍的复制品，站在她身旁，懒懒地倚着墙。它会对旁人的话做出夸张的手势，众人便随之哄笑。
They wear their robes as close to the limits of the dress code as possible—a tie loosened and crooked, the top clasp of a robe open, or a button missing. Wild socks. Someone has cast a spell to makes a copy of her robe stand next to her and lean against the wall. It gestures at something someone says, and the group laughs.

Ignurso Burrower.name:
伊格诺索·掘洞者
Ignurso Burrower

Text.text:
这头覆满岩壳的巨熊足有十号尺高，周身渗出不祥的热浪。它拖着短粗的前爪在泥沼与咸涩的碎岩间缓缓刮行，挖出一个又一个坑洞，永无止境地搜寻猎物。它那厚重的头骨中央仅有一只眼睛，凶戾而明亮的橙色光束直射而出。它嗅着空气，带着顶级掠食者那种慵懒而傲慢的姿态。
Ten feet tall and seeping ominous heat, this rock-encrusted bear drags its stumpy foreclaws through mud and brackish rock, hollowing out holes in its eternal search for prey. A single eye, baleful and bright orange, beams out from the center of its chunky skull. It sniffs the air with the lazy arrogance of an apex predator.

Thunderstorm: Gathering Storm.name:
雷暴：风暴将至
Thunderstorm: Gathering Storm

Text.text:
风势骤起，裹挟着天气的变动。你望见远处丘陵被阴影吞没，天光被竞逐天穹的云山抹去。翻涌的雾气间迸出蓝白电光，片刻后，沉闷的雷霆轰然炸响。你仿佛看见一道雨墙正从云层前沿坠落。很快，它就会扑到你身上。
The wind picks up, bringing with it a change in the weather. You watch shadows fall over distant hills, the light blotted out by mountains of cloud racing across the sky. Blue-white light flashes amid the roiling mist, followed moments later by a rumbling thunderclap. You think you can see a wall of rain falling from the clouds’ leading edge. Soon it will be upon you.

Village Building Under Construction.name:
施工中的村庄建设区
Village Building Under Construction

Text.text:
大约一打人正以各种方式在一块小空地上忙活，这片地早已用篱笆与村子其余地方隔开。一名跑腿工从一堆锯齐、刨平的木板中扛起切好的木料，来回搬运给跪地作业的工人；他们将木料拼起、钉牢，做成一副结实到足以徒手竖起的框架。各行匠人推着独轮车进进出出，车上装着施工每个阶段所需的材料——从屋顶的木瓦到收来的茅草保温层——随后一股脑倒进用木桩划出的储放区。两块木板搭在一对锯马上临时拼成的桌旁，一名壮实的人站得笔直，目光扫过整个工程，时不时提高嗓门吼出指令。
Perhaps a dozen people labor in various ways in a small lot already fenced off from the rest of the village. A gofer carries loads of cut wood from a pile of sawed-off and planed wooden planks to kneeling workers, who assemble and nail it into a frame sturdy enough to be raised by hand. Tradesmen come in with wheelbarrows carting materials for every stage of construction—from shingles for the roof to gathered thatching for insulation—and dump them into zones staked out for storage. Standing at a makeshift table of two planks stretched across a pair of sawhorses, a stout individual surveys the entire project, bellowing instructions as needed.

I Read A Transmutation Spell Scroll I Un.name:
我读了一张变化系法术卷轴，我明白了。
I Read A Transmutation Spell Scroll I Understand

Text.text:
我朗读卷轴时，一层金属般的光泽漫过纸面，其上镌刻的符号随之流转，闪耀出宝石般的辉芒。那些线条与曲弧在我眼前崩解又重组，化作全新的形态；我被那精妙的嬗变之舞牢牢攫住——而那道法术也随之向我显现。
A metallic sheen washes over the scroll as I read, causing the symbols etched upon it to shimmer with gemlike radiance. The lines and curves break apart and reform, assuming new shapes as I watch, transfixed by the intricate dance of transmutation—and the spell is revealed to me.

Creature Encased In Ice.name:
冰封的生物
Creature Encased In Ice

Text.text:
尽管你小心翼翼地穿行在冻结的地面上，脚下仍在你猛然止步时打滑——那是前方阴影般的形状逼你停下。你凝神端详那一整块坚实的冰层，才勉强辨出：一具庞然的生物轮廓被封在严冬的坟冢里——又或者，那只是座牢笼？冰雪太厚，任何具体特征都无从辨认，但只有傻子才会无视那挥之不去的危险预感。

~ 构想：Jaman

Despite the care taken in the traversal of the frozen ground, your feet still skid as you come to a sudden stop, prompted by the shadowy shape before you. Peering intently at the solid sheet of ice, you are just able to discern the hulking silhouette of a creature encased within a wintry tomb—or is it merely a prison? It is impossible to make out any specific features due to the thickness of the ice and snow, but only a fool would ignore the lingering feeling of danger.

~ Envisioned by Jaman

Sundries From A Sprite.name:
来自小妖精（特征）的小杂货
Sundries From A Sprite

Text.text:
你在这名矮小的生物身上摸到一个小小的麻布挎袋。打开一看，里面有些晒干的浆果、一枝柳条，以及一朵被压平封存的花。
On the diminutive creature’s person, you find a small hemp satchel. Inside, you find some dried berries, a sprig of willow, and a single pressed flower.

Loot From A Lich Apprentice.name:
巫妖学徒的战利品
Loot From A Lich Apprentice

Text.text:
学徒的法术书厚实沉甸，内里将诸多法术与戏法详尽记录，随时可供技艺娴熟的魔法使用者取用。以学徒先前站立之处为中心，三瓶抗力药水呈等边三角形坠落散开。
The apprentice’s spell book is thick with well-documented spells and cantrips, ready for a skilled magic user’s use. Falling in an equilateral triangle around where the apprentice stood are three potions of resistance.

一块巨大的巨石横亘路中央，逼得行人只能从两侧绕行。你看见石面有一处更浅的光斑，起初以为是月光打在某种反光物上——可不，那光来自石头本身；在夜里合拢的花朵间，它幽幽发亮。你凑近细看，发现石头上密密麻麻刻满了字——多是旅人随手刮刻的姓名与日期——但在这些新痕之下，你辨出更古老的笔迹，其中有些词语黯淡地散出魔法的微光。
A huge boulder looms in the road, driving travelers to either side. You see a lighter patch on the stone and think perhaps the moonlight has struck some reflective surface, but no, the rock itself glows among flowers that have closed for the night. As you examine the stone more closely, you see that it is covered in writing—mostly names and dates travelers have scratched into the rock—but beneath those scratches you make out an older writing, and some of those words dimly shed a magical light.

Wheelchair User Outpacing Their Friends.name:
坐轮椅的人把朋友们远远甩在身后
Wheelchair User Outpacing Their Friends

Text.text: “我？慢下来？给你自己施放longstrider跟上啊！轮子比腿更擅长移动，又不是我的错。” “Me, slow down? Cast longstrider on yourself to keep up! It’s not my fault wheels are more efficient at moving than legs.”

Mounted Firenewt Warrior.name:
骑乘火新特战士
Mounted Firenewt Warrior

Text.text:
一头无羽的禽形巨兽背上，端坐着一名爬行族战士：橙红鳞片鲜艳夺目，仿佛熔岩般微微发光。他披覆焦黑铁甲，手握一柄修长凶狠的骑兵马刀，分叉的蓝色长舌掠过唇边，催动那骇人的坐骑向前冲去。
Astride an avian beast devoid of feathers sits a reptilian warrior with vibrant orange scales that glow like magma. Clad in blackened iron, the rider wields a long vicious cavalry saber and flicks a forked blue tongue over his lips as he urges his harrowing mount forward.

堡垒如巨像般矗立在比武场之上，嶙峋石材雕琢出的高耸防垒直刺苍穹。风蚀斑驳的浮雕缠绕着巍峨塔楼，沉默却仿佛在向下方的赛场发出无声的尖啸。一道伤痕累累的吊桥横跨壕沟通往内院，院中旌旗招展、摊位林立，热切的观众挤作一团。
The bastion stands like a colossus above the tilt yard, its towering fortifications carved from rugged stone. Worn carvings adorn the lofty towers, silently screaming at the lists below. A scarred drawbridge spanning the moat leads to a courtyard filled with banners, stalls, and eager spectators.

Monk Of The Viper Fist.name:
毒蛇拳僧
Monk Of The Viper Fist

Text.text:
武僧那张久经沙场的面孔骤然绷紧，嘴唇微启，牙关却死死咬合。他低吼一声，双拳攥得骨节发白。汗珠在他额头凝聚，肩膀随沉重的呼吸起伏——可他眼中的决意分毫不改。

[Transformation] 倏然间，翠绿鳞片自他皮下绽出。他的手指彼此纠缠，拇指变得更粗、更宽、更扁；伴着令人作呕的湿滑“噗叽”声，双手扭曲变形，最终化作两条红眼毒蛇的头颅。蛇信吞吐，舔舐空气，搜寻着目标。

[Attack] 武僧猛然突进，双臂尽头的蛇头大张其口。他一拳挥出，獠牙便自那苍白口腔的上颚疾弹而出——一、二，噬咬合击。即便攻击未能命中，紧咬的颚间仍会喷溅出毒液，化作灼烧般的唾沫飞沫，嘶嘶冒汽，腐蚀它所落到的一切。

The monk’s battle-hardened face tenses, his lips parting as his teeth clench. With a growl, he squeezes his fists tight. Sweat beads the monk’s brow and his shoulders heave with heavy breaths—but the determination in his eyes does not falter.

[Transformation] Suddenly, green scales blossom from underneath his skin. His fingers fuse together, his thumbs widen and flatten; his hands morph with a sickening squelch until they become the heads of red-eyed snakes. Their tongues lap at the air, searching for a target.

[Attack] The monk surges forward, the snake heads at the end of his arms gaping wide. When he punches, fangs lash out from the roofs of the snakes' pale mouths—one-two, bite-snap. Even if his attacks miss the mark, venom sprays from the clamping jaws in droplets of burning spittle, steaming and eating through whatever it lands on.

Redemption Of Fire—a Tavern Song.name:
火焰的救赎——一首酒馆歌谣
Redemption Of Fire—a Tavern Song

Text.text:
曾有一位法师名叫奥托·布莱特，
烛光之下学那火焰魔法的本事。
