他研习又诵读，直到深夜不止，
睡去又惊醒，骇得心里发怵：
高塔火光冲天，亮得刺眼灼目，
书卷与胡子一并着了火！
都是那蜡烛惹的祸……
奥托羞愧出走。

奥托，奥托，奥托，总有一天你会做对的！

奥托四处漂泊——心里念着归途，
一晃数月方才回到故土，
他笃定自己会被冷眼驱逐，
那位胡子烧焦的火焰法师，何其狼狈无助！
他怕人们讥笑“焦痕奥托”，
笑他火势比一支 Everburning Torch 还要更高更灼。
可当他踏入城中……
四下尽是亡灵影踪！

奥托，奥托，奥托，你得去拯救这一天！

镇公所里传出一阵凄厉嚎叫，
婴儿啼哭，良家妇人的呼号，
怪物把所有人都吓得魂飞魄消，
于是奥托掷出一发火球。
“焦痕奥托”终于挣回了资格与光彩，
他要把名字夺回——奥托·布莱特。
他的魔法救下了城镇……
也顺手把它烧成灰烬！

奥托，奥托，奥托，总有一天你会做对的！

~ 由 Pockets 构想

There was a mage named Otto Bright,
Who learnt fire magic by candlelight
He studied and read in to the night
Fell asleep and awoke in fright:
His tower was a-blazing bright
His book and beard were both alight!
The candle was to blame…
And Otto left in shame.

Otto, Otto, Otto, you’ll get it right one day!

Otto wandered—for home he yearned,
and many months passed ere he returned,
So sure was he that he’d be spurned,
The fire mage whose beard was burned!
He feared they’d jeer at Otto the Scorched,
With fire higher than an Everburning Torch
But when he entered town…
Undead were all aroun'!

Otto, Otto, Otto, you’ve got to save the day!

A wail went out from the town hall,
A baby’s cry, a goodwife’s call,
For the monsters terrified them all
So Otto threw a fireball.
Otto the Scorched had earned the right
To claim his name as Otto Bright.
His magic saved the town…
And also burned it down!

Otto, Otto, Otto, you’ll get it right one day!

~ Envisioned by Pockets

Perquisitus Fleetfoot In The Gloomland.name:
迅足的佩奎西图斯于幽冥之地
Perquisitus Fleetfoot In The Gloomland

Text.text:
珀奇·疾足（Perqy Fleetfoot）是一系列元叙事故事的主角：故事围绕一位性别不定的学生，在咒法师学院（Enchanter Academy）求学展开。珀奇经常动用魔法，干脆利落地打破书页的第四面墙，逼真到某些时候，珀奇在书里施放的虚构法术竟会从纸面渗出，漏进读者所在的世界。

这些书的体型与现代平装书相仿，封面以一种合成材质装订——只要有人试图分析，它就会随之改变；而且每一本都是不同的颜色。至今共有五本。第一本讲“阴郁之地”（Gloomland），呈淡黄色——那是惶惧的颜色。
Perqy Fleetfoot is the hero of a series of meta-narratives about a gender-nonspecific student at Enchanter Academy. Perqy regularly uses magic to break the book’s fourth wall so effectively that sometimes the fictional spells Perqy casts leak out of the book and into the reader’s world. The books are the size of modern paperbacks, bound in a synthetic material that changes whenever it is analyzed, and each is a different color. So far there are five. The first, about Gloomland, is light yellow—the color of trepidation.

I Break An Elemental Gem Of Emerald: Vor.name:
我捏碎一枚祖母绿元素宝石：涡旋
I Break An Elemental Gem Of Emerald: Vortex

Text.text:
那簇翡翠般的柱群轰然崩塌，半透明的海绿色宝石仿佛融化般汇成一汪粼光闪烁的水池，随即开始旋转。深蓝与惨白交织的泡沫翻涌成一团狂乱的漩涡。伴随着水花四溅与一声诡异的哀鸣，一道旋涡自泡沫中盘旋升起。它的眼睛——在奔腾水势里隐约成形的阴影——死死钉在我身上。
The cluster of emerald columns crumbles, the translucent sea-green gems melting into a shimmering pool that begins to spin. A roiling gyre of deep blue-and-white froth. With a splash and an eldritch moan, a vortex swirls up out of the foam. Its eyes, shaded shapes within the surging waters, are affixed on me.

白发半身人全神贯注于研究，面前的桌上摊开着足足六七本书。他一遍又一遍地在不同的文字间来回扫视，随即用手中的粉笔，在身后挂起的石板上勾勒句子与词语的结构图，涉及数种语言。你这才意识到，他正在筹备一场关于语言起源与其跨越漫长时代演化的讲座，而你或许正目睹一位卓越研究者在运筹帷幄。
Engrossed in his studies, the white-haired halfling has no less than a half-dozen books open on the table in front of him. He glances time and again at different writings before using the chalk in his hand to scribe diagrams of sentences and words in several languages on the slate board hung up behind him. You realize he is preparing a lecture on the origins of languages and their evolution over eons, and that you may be watching a superior researcher in action.

Smithy And Cartwright.name:
铁匠铺与车匠铺
Smithy And Cartwright

Text.text:
这里两栋建筑相对而立，一间是铁匠铺，另一间是造车匠的作坊。两者凑在一处，旅人无论是要给马钉蹄铁，还是修好坏掉的车轮与车架，都能备齐所需，整装再度上路。
Two buildings stand opposite one another here, one a smithy and the other a cartwright. Together, the two have everything a traveler might need to shoe a horse or fix a wagon and get on their way again.

一位精灵法师披着繁复精致的长袍，掌心托着神秘的火焰——而那双仿佛不受岁月侵扰的眼眸里，盛着更深的智慧。伴随优雅的手势，他们唤出奥术能量，将法术如无形的傀儡般牵引操纵。只要他们在场，魔法便蓬勃跃动；对秘奥技艺的驾驭，昭然若揭。
An elven mage, draped in intricate robes, holds mystical flame within their hand—and wisdom within their timeless eyes. With graceful gestures, they manifest arcane energies, working spells like ethereal puppets. In their presence, magic thrives, their mastery of the esoteric arts obvious.

你不得不穿过这栋建筑厚重石墙上的两道沉重铁箍大门，但显然这还不够安全。走入其内，你迎面是一道横贯整间屋子的云石柜台，其上覆着铁制格栅。台面上凿出的浅孔，让受保护的账房得以在格栅下交换钱币。你一踏进来，一名戴着眼镜、正清点银币的女子抬眼一瞥，烦躁地朝她的同伴一指——一位年迈的男人，似乎正在账簿上疾笔书写。
You had to pass through two heavy, iron-bound doors in the thick stone walls of this building, but apparently that is not enough security. Inside, you confront a marble counter that runs the width of the room, topped by an iron lattice. Divots in the countertop allow the protected accountants to exchange coin under the lattice. As you enter, a bespectacled woman counting silver pieces glances up and points in an annoyed way toward her compatriot, an elderly man who seems to be writing in a ledger.

Traveling A Snow-packed Road.name:
穿行于积雪压实的道路上
Traveling A Snow-packed Road

Text.text:
你周遭的世界泛着近乎刺目的白光，厚厚数尺的清冽积雪紧密堆压，将一切裹成无边的苍白。若不是那股钻骨的寒意紧贴在你的脸与衣物上，这景象本该美得令人屏息。你在雪中拖着沉重步伐，大开大合地迈步前行，艰难地为自己凿出一条路；每一步都耗尽力气，进展缓慢而痛苦。雪仍在落下，随冰冷的风卷起旋舞，愈发拖住你的势头，你费力的呼吸在寒空气中化作一团团白雾，飘散在眼前。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The world around you gleams an almost blinding white, shrouded by feet of crisp, tightly packed snow. It would be beautiful if not for the penetrating chill clinging to your face and garments. You trudge through the snow with wide, sweeping steps, carving a route for yourself with painstaking, laborious progress. The snow continues to fall and swirl on frigid winds, further impeding your momentum as your labored breaths plume before you in the chill air.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

龅牙覆毛的小啮齿兽窜身上前，带着几分狼一般的步态走了几步又停下，扒拉着松动的碎石与残渣。若不是它颅顶那支V字形的胶原角，它不过又是一只毫不起眼的异星食腐者——而那角正断断续续地发出不规则的号角般鸣响。
Bucktoothed and furry, the small rodent scuttles forth, pausing its lupine gait to scratch at loose rocks and detritus. It would be one more nondescript alien scavenger were it not for the V-shaped collagen horn atop its skull, which seems to be making irregular trumpeting noises.

正当这个世界的黑暗即将将你吞没之际，希望披着灿然羽翼破空而至。那生物以猛禽般的躯干为身，顶着狼一般的头颅，昂首咆哮，仿佛天堂的威严之怒在喉间炸裂。它那如鲸身般修长的多彩巨翼收拢，棱彩羽翎如两道并列的虹霓般放射光辉，降落时在周遭空气中扭出一层乳白幻彩的雾晕。它踏着巨鹰般的脚爪喀嗒向前，利爪在地面犁出矿道般体型的深沟。
Just as the darkness of this world is about to overwhelm you, hope flies in on resplendent wings. The creature's raptorial body is topped by a lupine head that barks with heaven's majestic fury. Multihued whale-length wings furl, their prismatic plumage radiating like twin rainbows and warping the air around them in an opalescent haze, as the creature lands. It clicks forward on giant eagle feet, claws creating furrows the size of mine tunnels in the ground.

Prehistoric Dinosaur Hunter.name:
史前恐龙猎人
Prehistoric Dinosaur Hunter

Text.text:
猎人腰间系着一条鞣制的爬行类皮带，其上悬挂着骇人的战利品。那名原始战士以一颗巨大的颅骨作护肩，弯曲的獠牙如钩般外张。他们跪伏在血迹斑斑的祭坛前虔诚祈求，身上被涂抹上战纹般的战彩；四周随即响起振奋人心的战吼与战歌，层层卷起。
The grisly trophies of the hunter hang from a belt of cured reptilian hide. A huge skull with curved fangs serves as a pauldron for the primal warrior. Kneeling in supplication before a bloodstained altar, they are daubed in war paint as a rousing battle chant begins all around.

他比多数人类高出整整一头，魁梧的兽人穿着拼凑而成的护甲——金属板、皮革绑带，以及他无数倒下敌人的骸骨；橄榄灰绿的皮肤从缝隙间透出。粗壮如缆的脖颈托着方正的头颅，头顶覆着一丛粗硬的黑发，汗水与干涸的血把它们黏成一绺绺。象牙匕首般的獠牙从野猪似的下颚刺出，向上弯出凶狠的弧度，最终收束成一抹恶意的狞笑。他那满是疤痕的双手握着一柄单刃胡须战斧，斧刃遍布崩口，天生为断骨碎软而造。
Standing a head taller than most humans, the massive orc’s olive-drab skin is visible beneath armor scavenged from metal plates, leather straps, and the bones of his many fallen enemies. His thick, corded neck supports a blocky head crowned with a mane of coarse black hair matted with sweat and dried blood. Tusks like ivory daggers protrude from his warthog jaw, curving upward in a vicious arc that ends in a malicious grin. In his scarred hands, he holds a single-bladed bearded axe, its notched edge designed to separate bone and shatter cartilage.

Primero, A Card Game.name:
首先，《纸牌游戏》
Primero, A Card Game

Text.text:
桌上摊着八张背面空白的纸牌，每位玩家手里各握着四张。铺着毡布的桌面中央，陶制筹码叮当作响；玩家们吞云吐雾、虚张声势——或挑眉示意，或对着烂牌强笑——一边下着赌注。一名玩家弃牌，起身从旁观者间挤了出去。剩下的三名玩家彼此对视，揣测究竟谁会扮演那个无赖。
Eight cards with blank backs lie on the table, and each player holds four cards. Clay chips clink into the middle of the felt-covered table as the players smoke and bluff—arching eyebrows or smiling down at terrible hands—and place their bets. A player folds, stands and pushes past the spectators. The remaining three players look at one another, wondering who might play the knave.

Abandoned Lunatic Asylum: A Piano Plays.name:
废弃的疯人院：钢琴自鸣
Abandoned Lunatic Asylum: A Piano Plays

Text.text:
幽魂哀恸的哭诉声愈发凄厉，一架钢琴却在此时奏响。乐声压过她飘渺的哀求，仿佛对她的需求毫不在意，旋律层层堆叠，音符渐趋癫狂，听起来与任何曾被囚禁于此的人一样疯乱。这音乐的狂乱，是映照了疯人院病患的心智，还是出自看守他们之人的手笔？
The spirit’s plaintive cries become more distressed as a piano begins to play. The music builds over the ghostly pleading, heedless of her need, notes becoming manic, sounding as insane as anyone once imprisoned here. Does the madness of the music reflect the patients of the asylum, or is it the product of their keepers?

Sundries From A Aarakocra.name:
来自阿拉科克拉的杂货
Sundries From A Aarakocra

Text.text:
鸟人倒卧在搏斗中散落的绒羽与羽毛之间——也许是些漂亮的战利品，但这鸟人身上并无多少真正值钱的东西。它那条编织布带腰带上垂着一个编成的袋子，里面装着一支断裂的长笛和一面小小的圆镜。
The birdfolk lies among a scattering of down and feathers shed during the struggle—pretty trophies, perhaps, but the birdfolk possesses little of real value. A woven pouch hanging from its braided-cloth belt contains a broken flute and a small round mirror.

Village In The Shadow Plane.name:
暗影位面的村庄
Village In The Shadow Plane

Text.text:
高矮不一的建筑轮廓在阴影里挤作一团，像旅人围着火堆取暖。鹅卵石街道空无一人，窗玻璃里映出的只有你自己的面容。远处传来某种非人的嚎叫。穿过黑暗，你瞥见镇广场，中央是一口井。那井里传出低语，催促你向前。

~ 由 jschoudt 所构想 by jschoudt

The stout silhouettes of buildings stand huddled in the shadows, like travelers warming themselves by a fire. The cobbled streets are deserted, and in the windows you see only the reflection of your own visage. Something inhuman howls in the distance. Through the darkness, you spy the town square, a well at its heart. Something whispers from within that well, urging you forward.

~ Envisioned by jschoudt

森林里生命繁盛，既有寻常之物，也有魔法的脉动。永恒的暮色无处不在，将银金般的光晕泼洒在一切之上——高耸巨树的翡翠叶片、匍匐的苔藓，乃至空气本身。闪烁的花粉随和煦微风起舞，裹着湿润腐殖土与盛放花朵的芬芳，还有无数草药的清香。远处传来怪异的呼唤，而在你余光里，虚幻的轮廓始终游移不定。你抬头望去，穿过浓密的树冠，只能看见更多的树——倒着生长。

~ Envisioned by R4v3nous_DM

The forest teems with life both mundane and magical. An ever-present twilight lends its silver-gold glow to everything—the jade leaves of towering trees, creeping moss, the air itself. Glimmering pollen dances on the mild breeze, perfumed pleasantly with loam and blooming flowers and myriad herbs. Strange calls sound in the distance, and all the while ephemeral shapes shift in your peripheral. Looking up, through the dense canopy, you see only more trees, growing upside-down.

~ Envisioned by R4v3nous_DM

Reloading Double-barreled Shotgun.name:
装填双管霰弹枪
Reloading Double-barreled Shotgun

Text.text:
你弹开卡榫打开霰弹枪，让打空的弹壳顺势滑出。弹壳还未落地，你的双手——以熟练得近乎本能的效率——已从弹袋里捻出新弹，稳稳送入等待的枪管。你啪地一合枪身，再次将它顶上肩头。
Flicking the release to open the shotgun, you allow the spent shells to slide out. Before the casings hit the floor, your hands—moving with practiced efficiency—pluck new shells from their holster and guide them into the waiting barrels. You snap the gun closed and shoulder it once more.

那身影将面容藏在兜帽之下，黑色蕾丝的面纱后更添朦胧。你隐约感到一双锐利幽暗的眼睛，以及涂成漆黑的嘴唇。他们抽出一柄邪气森然的匕首，刀身弯曲，镶嵌着血红宝石，随即将刃口划过掌心。鲜血从紧握的拳指间渗出，他们将自己献给了密会。
The figure has obscured their face beneath a cowl, behind a veil of black lace. You get the impression of keen, dark eyes and lips painted black. They draw out a wicked-looking dagger, curved and emblazoned with blood-red gemstones, and draws the blade across their palm. Blood seeps through the fingers of their clenched fist as they offer themselves to the coven.

Temple To A God Of Thieves.name:
盗贼之神的神庙
Temple To A God Of Thieves

Text.text:
神殿藏在一间废弃破败的城市公会会馆里，那会馆夹在两栋楼之间；而神殿本身则在其中一间密室。进入此室需借助一则法术，祭坛是一张八角形的筹划桌。室内家具像是从隔壁酒馆里搬来的旧物。在此膜拜的盗贼们遵循着松散的仪式：手肘搭在桌沿，盯着发黄的旧地图与账册吞云吐雾，向神祈求，随即大笑。有人趁着同伴就站在她身旁，伸手去偷对方的口袋。
The temple is in a secret room in an abandoned, dilapidated city guildhall wedged between two other buildings. The room is accessed by means of a spell, and the altar is an octagonal planning table. The furniture resembles what used to be in the tavern next door. The thieves worshiping here follow a loose protocol, elbows leaning on the table as they stare into old maps and ledgers. They smoke and petition the god, laugh afterward. One tries to pick the pocket of another standing next to her.

Quip By A Spellcaster About Heroism.name:
施法者对英雄主义的俏皮话
Quip By A Spellcaster About Heroism

Text.text:
“我对战争所知甚少，但你们这番关于荣誉与英雄主义的高谈阔论，在我听来不过是给一群披着金属甲的人互相砸到有人倒下为止，套上了一层华丽辞藻。听着既费力又徒增痛苦——明明你大可以站在战场另一头，把人一把火点着。”
“I know very little of warfare, but all this talk of honor and heroism seems like a lot of flowery language around people clad in metal bashing at each other until one falls over. It seems like a lot of pain and effort when you could just light someone on fire from across the field.”

Vigilant Enhanced Soldier.name:
警觉的强化士兵
Vigilant Enhanced Soldier

Text.text:
身着最新的军用级全身护甲，几乎分不清这是人类还是仿生人。厚重的凯夫拉头盔上垂下一道漆黑的面罩，那身影立正站定，怀里抱着一支脉冲步枪。它的身形对称、彻底雌雄莫辨——一具由专注的肌肉与机械化的意志凝成的存在。护甲表面覆盖着流动折射的迷彩，将士兵的轮廓抹得模糊不清。唯有右肩上一串标示军衔的白色线条，勉强提供了一个参照点。而白线旁边：一组肩载式微型火箭电池。
Clad in the latest military-grade body armor, it’s hard to tell if this is a human or an android. A dark visor descends from a bulky Kevlar helm, and the figure stands at attention, cradling a pulse rifle. They are symmetrical and completely androgynous, a being of focused muscle and mechanized will. The body armor bears a shifting refraction camo, blurring the soldier’s silhouette. Only a series of white lines on the right shoulder denoting rank offer a reference point. And next to the white lines: a shoulder-mounted pop-rocket battery.

晦涩的象形图画掩蔽着这座地窖里每一寸裸露的墙面，然而年代与磨损已将其中大半细节侵蚀殆尽。墓室内，十余具小巧的石棺环绕着一具巨大的金棺；其棺首与棺足依照那个时代的风格精雕细琢，仿佛要让人一眼看出其中安卧的王者真容。
Enigmatic pictographs cover every exposed inch of this crypt, though age and wear have eroded much of their detail. The tomb contains a dozen small sarcophagi surrounding an enormous golden sarcophagus, its head and feet carefully detailed in the style of the time to resemble its royal inhabitant.

Master Merchant In Her Shop.name:
店中的商会女掌柜
Master Merchant In Her Shop

Text.text:
店主那张满是疤痕的脸上浮着一抹带痛的微笑，她迎你入内，抬手指向四周堆得满满的货品。各式武器与护甲挤满了架子与展示台，琳琅的药剂与药膏如丰饶之角般拥塞在层层货架上。她面前摊着一本尚未写满的账簿，清脆的纸页上密密麻麻记着无数交易。她的手指不由自主地抽动着，仿佛急着再添上几笔。
The shopkeeper’s scarred face is graced with a pained smile as she welcomes you and gestures to the copious stock surrounding her. Weapons and armor of varying types fill racks and stands, a cornucopia of potions and balms crowding the shelves. A partially full ledger rests before her, myriad sales filling the crisp pages. Her fingers twitch to add more.

I Lay On Hands To Remove Poison: Oath Of.name:
我施展圣疗之触以祛除毒素：远古誓言圣武士
I Lay On Hands To Remove Poison: Oath Of The Ancients Paladin

Text.text:
我把手覆在盟友的腹部、靠近肝脏的位置，五指一扣，像拔除杂草般狠狠攫住。翠绿的光芒抽出一缕缕触须，其上浸染着毒素的暗色。猛地一扯，毒随光一同被拽离体内，我将其尽数驱散，沉入大地。
Placing my hand over my ally’s belly, near the liver, I grasp as if tearing out a weed. Green light forms tendrils stained dark with the venom. With a yank, the poison comes out with the light, and I dissipate it all into the earth.

Frozen Lake Crossing.name:
冰封湖面穿越
Frozen Lake Crossing

Text.text:
一长串脚印横贯冰封的湖面：这里的冰层最为厚实，远离那些仍在漂浮的碎冰——严寒尚未将其彻底冻结，因此成了本地人和野兽共同选择的路。厚冰上零星可见被锯开的冰洞，昭示着胆大的渔人曾在此试图钓起晚餐。巨大的气泡贴在冰层表面之下，随着每一步的落下而微微游移——仿佛在挑衅你低头盯紧脚下，而不是看清前路。
A long line of footprints traverse the surface of the frozen lake: the path chosen by locals and animals alike for the thickness of the ice here, well away from the floating shards where the harsh cold has not yet imposed itself fully. Here and there holes sawn through the thick ice indicate where intrepid fishers attempted to catch their supper. Massive air bubbles, just beneath the surface of the ice, shift with every footfall—daring you to watch your feet instead of where you are going.

Mountaintop Portal: The Pinnacle.name:
山巅传送门：绝顶
Mountaintop Portal: The Pinnacle

Text.text:
在这座山巅之上，本该能将方圆数里尽收眼底。可即便狂风不息，浓雾仍厚重地笼罩着一切。你仿佛立在一场风暴之中——在你脚下某处，暴雨与雷霆正凶猛地鞭笞着大地。翻涌的云团不断拍打而来，将你的视野压缩得只剩近在咫尺的周遭，以及前方雾幕里隐约耸立的高大岩柱。它们在此的存在——一圈环形矗立、为山巅加冕的立石——令人感到不对劲。
Here atop the mountain you should be able to see for miles around. Yet despite the constant wind, a thick fog shrouds everything. It feels as though you stand in a storm that somewhere below you thrashes the ground with rain and lightning. The buffeting clouds block your view of all but your immediate surroundings and the tall pillars of rock that loom in the mist ahead. Their presence here—menhirs in a ring crowning the mountain’s head—feels wrong.

Portal Surrounded By Standing Stones.name:
立石环绕的传送门
Portal Surrounded By Standing Stones

Text.text:
八块巨大的立石庄严地矗立在这座山丘之巅，围成一圈；它们外形参差不齐，但高度大致相同。圆环正中央，两根相似的石柱彼此倾倚，形成一道高高的三角形空隙。空隙之内，空气如海市蜃楼般轻轻颤动，只让你透过一层朦胧的迷雾，模糊地窥见彼方的景色。
Eight huge menhirs stand in a solemn circle atop this hill, their shapes irregular but their heights roughly the same. At the center of the circle, two similar pillars of stone lean against one another, creating a tall triangular gap. Inside this gap, the air wavers like a mirage, giving you only a blurred and hazy vision of the landscape beyond.

Insult About Outer Planes.name:
关于外层位面的侮辱
Insult About Outer Planes

Text.text:
“我曾远行至诸界外缘之外的所在。在那里我遇到一个怪人，他告诉我：哪怕越过凡人经验的边界，他也听说过你是个混账。”
“I once journeyed to a place beyond the outer reaches of the planes. I met a strange man there who told me that, even past the periphery of the mortal experience, he’d heard that you were a prick.”

Plane Of Vacuum.name:
真空位面
Plane Of Vacuum

Text.text:
当你踏入这片创造的悖论时，彻底的寂静从四面八方猛然袭来。空气在此是禁忌，空间与重力皆失去意义。黑暗的深处引发一种令人窒息的压迫感，你竭力想寻到哪怕一丝微光、热度或触觉。按自然法则，任何人都不该能挤进这片虚无空间，这不禁令人揣测：究竟是何等生物，把这个位面当作家园。
Utter silence assaults you from all sides as you enter this paradox of creation. Air is anathema here, space and gravity, meaningless. The depths of its darkness induce a smothering sensation and you struggle to find even the tiniest bit of light, heat or sensation. By the laws of nature, no one should be able to fit into this null space, which leads one to wonder about the kinds of creatures that make this plane their home.

癫狂的笑声伴随着侏儒奥术火炮沉闷而雷鸣般的轰响——炽红滚烫的炮管喷吐死亡与烈焰。火光映亮他们那对镜面护目镜的镜片，泛起近乎异界的幽辉；侏儒戴着手套的一只手凝出一团腐蚀性的翠绿液体，猛然掷入敌阵中央。头顶一声尖啸宣告侏儒的魔宠降临：猫头鹰俯冲而下，沿战场扫过一道火线，以近乎巨龙般的低空扫射式攻击掠过。浓烟翻涌；笑声回荡。

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

Manic laughter accompanies the thumping, thunderous boom of the gnome’s eldritch cannon, spewing death and fire from its red-hot barrel. The flames light their mirrored goggle-lenses with an almost alien glow as in one gloved hand the gnome conjures a ball of caustic, green fluid and hurls it into the midst of their foes. From overhead, a screech signals the arrival of the gnome’s familiar as the owl dives, releasing a line of flame across the battlefield in a distinctly dragon-like strafing attack. The smoke roils; the laughter rings out.

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

猫一般的类人身影以不可思议的优雅步伐向你款款而来，修长的尾巴兴奋地轻甩着。那对妖艳的翠绿眼眸里，椭圆的瞳孔微微收紧，审视着你——衡量你究竟是猎手，还是猎物。口鼻与眉骨处伸出修长而精致的须髭，轻轻颤动，捕捉着空气中无形的信息素。
Moving with incredible grace the cat-like humanoid sashays toward you, their long tail flicking excitedly. Lurid green eyes with elliptical pupils narrow as they observe you—deciding whether you are predator or prey. Long, elegant whiskers extend from their muzzle and brow, twitching slightly as they detect invisible pheromones.

Bolt Spell Misses.name:
闪电法术落空
Bolt Spell Misses

Text.text:
能量随着急促的咒语缠上你的身躯，在你掌心中央凝成一枚高度聚焦的光点。你引导它，迫使它服从你双手的位置，在你塑造这道法术时随势而动。它穿过你体内，随一声脆裂迸射而出，沿直线掠过空气低语，最终与目标擦身而过。
The energy binds to you through the fast incantation, forming into a concentrated point at the center of your palm. You direct it and force it to answer to the position of your hands as you shape the spell. It fires through you and out with a crack, whispering through the air in a straight line, and misses your target.

这座东拼西凑的棚屋还未映入眼帘，那股气味就已先一步挠动你的感官。棚屋被反复扩建，木板与鸡网层层加添，像补丁般拼出歪斜的轮廓。动物收容所里传出的声响忽高忽低：时而是猫群低低的咕哝与犬只零星的短吠，时而又爆成一片咆哮与嘶嘶作响的乱流，喧嚣失控，根本无法约束。棚屋后方，一堆堆内脏与骨头——清晨由本地屠夫送来——摊在拉紧的防水布上，作为这些被遗弃动物每日唯一的一餐。
The odor of this ramshackle shed tickles at your senses long before it comes into view. The shed has been expanded multiple times with additions of wooden planks and chicken wire. The sounds from within the animal shelter fluctuate between the low murmurs of cats and the occasional yip of a dog to a cacophony of snarls and hisses, chaotic and impossible to control. Behind the shelter, piles of offal and bones—delivered in the early morning by the local butcher—sit on stretched tarps for the abandoned animals’ single daily meal.

I Take More Initiative With My Rod Of Al.name:
我用【警觉权杖】抢先攻
I Take More Initiative With My Rod Of Alertness

Text.text:
当我察觉危险的刹那，时代仿佛放慢了脚步。我的肌肉绷紧，蓄势待发；我握在手中的法杖涌出魔力，灌注全身，令我精神一振、反应骤然加速，让我得以将全部心神都凝聚在这一瞬间。
Time seems to slow when I notice the danger. My muscles tense, ready for action, and I feel the Rod in my hand exude magical energy, invigorating me, accelerating my reactions, allowing me to focus totally on the moment.

Dimly Lit Sea Cave.name:
昏暗的海蚀洞
Dimly Lit Sea Cave

Text.text:
阴影在水汽弥漫的昏暗里潜行，像雾中的幽魂般漂荡。水面反射的微弱斑驳光影涂抹在洞顶——在洞窟黏稠的黑暗前摇曳成一场闪烁的海市蜃楼。拍岸的水声从覆着盐霜的岩壁间回荡，其间夹杂着水滴自虬结的钟乳石坠落，扎入下方咸涩翻涌的水沫乱潮。

~ 构想：MatthewMcHale 于 Discord

Shadows stalk the watery gloom, drifting like wraiths in the fog. Weak dappled light reflected from the water's surface paints the roof—a shimmering mirage against the cloying blackness of the cavern. The sound of lapping water echoes from the salt-rimed walls, punctuated by droplets plunging from gnarled stalactites into the briny tumult below.

~ Envisioned by MatthewMcHale on Discord

Talkative Android Cab Driver.name:
健谈的安卓出租车司机
Talkative Android Cab Driver

Text.text:
你刚钻进车厢，方向盘后的仿生人就用欢快却金属般的嗓音开了口。你不确定他是不是被预设了这一连串像轨道轰炸般倾泻而来的问题——但你肯定觉得自己正遭受攻击，被他不依不饶的盘问压得喘不过气。
As soon as you enter the cab, the android at the wheel pipes up in a cheery, metallic tone. You’re not sure if he has been programmed with the questions he unleashes like an orbital barrage—but you certainly feel under attack from his relentless inquisition.

彭韦林的三条小径穿行于繁茂的梣树林丛与葱郁的草坪长带之间。北侧密林幽深，小鸟、虫豸与其他生灵都藏身于荫影之下。南侧则开阔成一片敞亮的空间：一家人铺毯闲卧，孩子们四处奔跑，甚至还有艺人就地练习手艺。这里免费入场，各色人等皆可见——从叼着雪茄悠然自得的阔绰金融家，到与剧团伙伴玩即兴戏码的崭露头角演员。
The three paths of Penwellyn lead through lush clumps of ash trees and verdant stretches of lawn. In the dense wood of the northern section, small birds, bugs and other creatures hide away in the shade. The southern portion provides open space, where families lounge on blankets, children run about, and even artists practice their craft. With free admission, people from all walks of life may be found here—from well-to-do financiers enjoying a cigar to up-and-coming actors playing improv games with their troupe.

Wand Of Enemy Detection.name:
敌情探知魔杖
Wand Of Enemy Detection

Text.text:
这根枯瘦扭曲的魔杖通体灰烬般黯淡，粗糙得如同远古树皮。杖首两根突起的枝杈之间嵌着一枚闪耀的尖晶石——正随着奥术能量的律动而脉动。
The length of this gnarled and twisted wand is ashen, and rough like ancient bark. A gleaming, pointed crystal rests betwixt two protruding branches at the wand’s head—which pulses with arcane energy.

Fishing Hole In The Ice.name:
冰面钓洞
Fishing Hole In The Ice

Text.text:
你眯起眼抵御刺骨寒风，雪屑在睫毛上越积越厚，踏过结冰的湖面时，险些一步踩进厚冰上精心锯出的冰洞。尽管那东西已不在，钓洞周围留下的痕迹却昭示着此处曾搭起一座加热的遮蔽棚——无疑是那位渔人钓够了狗鱼后拆走迁移……或是恼怒之下悻然放弃。
Squinting your eyes against the freezing wind and flakes of snow gathering at your lashes as you traverse the frozen lake, you narrowly avoid stepping into a hole sawn carefully through the thick ice. Though it is no longer there, the marks left around the fishing hole indicate that there was likely a heated shelter erected at the site, doubtless torn down and moved once the fisher had taken their fill of pike . . . or given up in consternation.

I Cast Magic Missile.name:
我施放魔法飞弹
I Cast Magic Missile

Text.text:
随着三声低沉的嗡鸣，我头顶浮现出三枚晶莹能量凝成的飞矢。它们先是轻轻摇晃、缓缓旋转片刻，随即尖端骤然绷直，与我的目光严丝合缝地对齐。我选定目标，而这些飞矢——只需这道心念——便如俯冲的猛禽般疾掠而出，直扑我的标记。
With three bass thrums, three missiles of crystalline energy appear above my head. They wobble and spin slowly for a moment before their points rigidly align with my gaze. I choose my target, and the darts—needing only this internal command—fly toward my mark, swift as diving raptors.

The Warlord's Announcement.name:
军阀的宣告
The Warlord's Announcement

Text.text:
“你们看起来情同手足。我倒想问问，你们准备好眼睁睁看着彼此去死了吗？你们可曾见过，你所爱之人身上一切美好与独特，被战争的屈辱撕碎、践踏、碾成齑粉？别来这里布道你们的英雄教条。战场上容不下那一套。”
“You all seem like good friends. I wonder, are you prepared to watch each other die? Have you ever witnessed everything beautiful and special about the ones you love torn down and violated by the indignity of war? Don’t come here preaching your heroic dogma. It has no place on the battlefield.”

婚礼寝殿的布置不惜工本。过道两侧的镀金座椅上系着精巧的缎带，脚下的通道洒满缤纷花瓣。与之相配的鲜花被别在从天花板垂下的旗幡上。衣着考究的宾客在引座员的指引下入席，落座时缓慢而小心，唯恐压皱身上细腻的丝绸与蕾丝。一支三人乐团以舒缓的旋律充盈室内，而你瞥见寝殿前方的新郎僵直地站着，紧绷地等待。乐声渐弱，最后几位宾客匆匆入座。仪式即将开始。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

No expense has been spared in the decorating of the wedding chamber. Delicately-tied ribbons adorn the gilded chairs along an aisle sprinkled with colorful petals. Matching flowers are pinned to banners hanging from the ceiling. The poised guests, guided to their seats by ushers, sit slowly and carefully so as not to crease the fine silks and lace of their outfits. A trio of musicians fills the room with a calming melody, though you catch sight of the groom at the front of the chamber standing with rigid anticipation. The song wanes, and the last guests hurry to their seats. The ceremony is about to begin.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Cast Resistance Using Components.name:
我以施法材料施放抗力
I Cast Resistance Using Components

Text.text:
我把双手搭在他们的肩上。“我们让你再多活、也多好好活一阵子，如何？”我打了个响指。一袭流动的钢铁斗篷，轻若无物，自他们背后垂落而下。
I place my hands on their shoulders. "Let’s keep you alive and well a little longer, shall we?” I snap my fingers. A cape of fluid steel, light as air, descends down their back.

这座由耀眼的浅色石材砌成的建筑伫立在修剪得一丝不苟的花园中央，宛如王室餐桌上的婚礼蛋糕。层层排列的格栅窗显示它不过三层高，然而每一层都高得出奇，几乎是常理所料的两倍。山墙、老虎窗与檐口之上，一片烟囱的“森林”向天伸展；每一座都是独一无二的砖石旋纹，与这片奢华建筑的整体相互呼应，恰到好处地讨人喜欢。
This building of dazzling pale stone stands amid a manicured garden like a wedding cake on a royal table. Layers of latticed windows show it to be only three stories, but each is easily twice as tall as one might expect. A veritable forest of chimneys project above the gables, dormers, and cornices, each a unique swirl of masonry designed to fit pleasingly with the rest of the lavish architecture.

Vial Of Blood.name:
一小瓶鲜血
Vial Of Blood

Text.text:
光线穿过小瓶里晃荡的液体，折射出幽微的光泽。那液体浓稠黏滞，紧贴着玻璃壁，仿佛有生命般蠕动——也许它确实活着——当它拍打着软木塞时，隐隐像在挣扎。
The light refracts through the sloshing liquid within the vial. Thick and viscous, it clings to the glass, seeming almost alive—and maybe it is—as it splashes against the cork stopper.

那天界身影放射出的光芒刺目得令人失明，灼烧着视线，化作炽烈的浪潮向外翻涌。多重覆羽之翼自那生物背脊迸生，翼上点缀着无眼睑的眼珠；其头顶咆哮着一顶纯粹的冠冕——白炽到发烫的火焰。你隐约感到祂有无数肢体，每一只都握着一柄黄金的武器。其完整形态几乎无法辨清，仿佛在你注视的同时仍在移形换貌。那生物发出轰鸣般的声音，群山随之战栗。
The light emanating from the celestial figure is blinding, searing, wafting outward in blazing waves. Multiple feathered wings dotted with lidless eyes sprout from the creature’s back, and atop their head roars a crown of pure, white-hot fire. One gets the sense of many limbs, each holding a weapon of gold. Their full form is nearly impossible to perceive, as they seem to shift and change even as one looks upon them. A voice booms from the creature, and mountains tremble in response.

Vampire Gnolls Attacking Village.name:
吸血鬼（特征）豺狼人袭击村庄
Vampire Gnolls Attacking Village

Text.text:
一阵丑恶刺耳、如驴嘶般的狂笑在村庄上空回荡，噩梦般的生物发起攻击，以嗜血的凶残撕裂当地民兵。它们佝偻的兽形在浓雾中疾驰，潜行追猎，以掠食者般的耐心与狡黠骚扰着疲于支撑的守军。一声含混的惨叫牵引你的视线，落在一处翻倒的集市摊位上——以及那之后更骇人的一幕。摊位后，一只鬣狗般的生物浑身白毛却沾满血污，正蹲伏在一具抽搐的男尸上方，带着令人脊背发寒的欢快咯咯作笑，同时撕扯出他的喉咙。

~ Envisioned by Casey

A hideous, braying cackle echoes around the village as the nightmarish creatures attack, tearing into the local militia with bloodthirsty savagery. Hunched bestial forms race through the dense fog, stalking their prey as they harry the beleaguered defenders with predatory patience and cunning. A garbled cry draws your attention to an overturned market stall—and the horrifying scene beyond. Behind the stall, a hyenalike creature with bloodstained white fur is crouched over the twitching corpse of a man, giggling with chilling mirth as it tears out his throat.

~ Envisioned by Casey

Circus Music: Mysterious.name:
马戏团音乐：神秘
Circus Music: Mysterious

Text.text:
马戏团进城，总是色彩斑斓，喧嚷着许下欢乐的承诺——把危险驯成安全，把冒险本身当作奖赏。然而，在鲜亮的旗幡、游乐场的吆喝声与嘉年华游戏之外，还藏着一座奇观云集的兽苑。谜团乘着糖果般缤纷的车轮滚到镇口，用诱人的气息把好奇者引入幽暗的奇迹帐篷。
A circus coming to town is colorful, making loud promises of fun—of dangers made safe and risks being their own reward. Yet beyond the bright banners, carnival barkers, and funfair games lies a menagerie of marvels. Mystery rolls to the town’s door on candy-colored wheels, enticing the curious into dark tents of wonder.

Orb Arcane Focus.name:
宝珠奥术法器
Orb Arcane Focus

Text.text:
这颗由火山岩打磨而成的抛光宝珠在光线下色泽变幻莫测。时而漆黑如墨，只需轻轻一倾，便骤然仿佛迸射出炽烈的猩红光芒，其间穿插着道道白色纹层。宝珠显然经过精心处理，大小恰到好处，正适合施法者单手握持。
The color of the polished orb made from volcanic stone changes dramatically in the light. At times perfectly black, one subtle tilt and it suddenly appears to radiate blazing crimson with white strata shot throughout. This orb has been well-prepared, perfectly sized for a spellcaster to hold in one hand.

Asmodeus, Lord Of Hell.name:
阿斯莫德斯，地狱之主
Asmodeus, Lord Of Hell

Text.text:
一个高大得骇人的身影，这名俊美的灰肤恶魔，乌黑如鸦羽的头发向后梳得一丝不苟，完美的发型间探出一对短短的黑角。他同样留着修整得极其干净、油亮的浓密全须，短而利落。深绯色的王者长袍以黑与金点缀，披覆在他结实的躯体上。他神情安然自若，带着一丝若有若无的恶意。那双幽暗的眼睛偶尔燃起火光，露出猩红的瞳仁，像蛇多过像人。他左手持一柄深红水晶权杖，杖头如球般的宝珠随他的眼睛一同闪烁发亮。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

A gigantic and imposing figure, this handsome, gray-skinned devil has a pair of short, black horns poking from a flawless swept-back coif of raven-colored hair. He has an equally immaculate and glossy full beard, trimmed short. Regal robes in shades of crimson accented with black and gold drape his muscular form. He has a look of serene confidence with a hint of malice. His dark eyes flare occasionally with fire, revealing red orbs more like those of a snake than a man. In his left hand, he carries a scepter of crimson crystal with an orblike head that glows in time with his eyes.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Temple To A Goddess Of Love.name:
献给爱之女神的神殿
Temple To A Goddess Of Love

Text.text:
此地摒弃了传统的建筑格局，不过是几根零散的石柱自葱郁花园中挺立而起，僧侣与来访的民众皆可不受限制地漫步其间。这里盛开的尽是多年生花卉：薰衣草、蓍草、紫菀等。蜜蜂嗡嗡作响，仿佛微醺般在花与花之间摇晃穿梭，身躯满覆花粉。
This site forgoes traditional structure, being little more than a few disparate stone columns rising from a lush garden, where monks and members of the public can walk without restriction. Only perennial flowers bloom here: lavender, yarrow, aster and others. Bees bumble drunkenly from flower to flower, bodies coated in pollen.

I Cover My Trail In A Cave.name:
我在洞窟中抹去踪迹
I Cover My Trail In A Cave

Text.text:
尽管黑暗会是我此行最得力的盟友，但我也清楚，必须把那些自带火把的人，以及那些不需光亮也能视物的生物算进去。我用一大块布在洞穴地面上拂扫尘土，抹去一切可能黏住脚印或留下营地痕迹的东西。随后我把那块布撕成条，像捆面包似的把鞋子裹扎起来。我得睁大眼睛留意洞里任何潮湿的泥土或泥浆——但有了这些防备，我应当能在这座洞窟中行走得如幽灵般无声无形。
Though darkness will be my best ally in this endeavor, I know I need to account for those who bring along their own torches and those creatures who can see without light. I use a large piece of fabric to brush away the dirt on the cave floor, anything that might hold on to my footprints or evidence of a camp. I then tear up that fabric and tie up my shoes like bundles of bread. I’ll need to keep my eyes open for any patches of wet dirt or mud in the cave—but with these precautions, I should be able to move through this cavern as imperceptibly as a spirit.

Temple To A Goddess Of Magic.name:
魔法女神的神殿
Temple To A Goddess Of Magic

Text.text: [外部] 这座神殿在层层结界的浸透下微微闪耀，两只体型如黑熊的石像鬼蹲伏在白色入口门两侧。你一靠近，它们便被激活，立刻堵住门口，静候你施展某种法术，以证明自己有资格获准入内。 [内部] 身着长袍的神职人员在这座两层高的石质圆筒大厅里穿梭徘徊：协助教众进行坩埚作业，握着他们的手引导体势手势，并解答关于神殿图书馆藏书内容的疑问。你耳中捕捉到献给女神的祈祷声里有着广泛的射程——从目不识字的术士喃喃的吟唱，到老练法师行云流水般的辞藻。 [Outside] This temple shimmers, saturated with wards as it is, and two gargoyles the size of black bears squat on either side of the white entry door. At your approach, they activate and block the door, awaiting the production of some sort of spell to prove worthiness to be admitted. [Inside] Robed clergy inside wander the expanse of the two-floor stone cylinder, helping parishioners with cauldron work, guiding their hands through somatic gestures, and answering questions about the contents of the temple library. Your ears detect a range among the prayers to the goddess, from the chants of illiterate sorcerers to the eloquence of seasoned wizards.

A Forest Full Of Fireflies.name:
萤火虫遍野的森林
A Forest Full Of Fireflies

Text.text:
萤火虫的点点微光在你面前忽明忽灭，昆虫倏然掠过你的行径便将光芒掐断。它们又在路旁重新亮起，柔和而莹润的色彩随你沿小径前行，悄然注入一股安宁。森林静止无声，不让任何杂音分散你的思绪；你沉浸在这片流光溢彩的光景之中。
The twinkling lights of fireflies blink out as the insects dart from your path. They reappear off to the side, and the soft, gleaming colors instill a sense of peace as you venture down the trail. The forest is still and quiet, leaving no distraction from your thoughts as you enjoy the luminescent display.

Four-tiered Armored Skirts With Petticoa.name:
带衬裙的四层甲裙
Four-tiered Armored Skirts With Petticoat

Text.text:
裙摆宛如一只巨大的蛋糕，从毡呢的上层一路叠落到奶油般的蕾丝衬裙；那衬裙在两层缤纷的细密网纱下大胆地若隐若现，薄得几乎像丝绸。裙身在臀侧鼓起翻涌，后摆如城垛般一路垂到脚踝，像一道护具——最适合用来在迎面而来的火光前转身逃跑。可正面却裁得极高，从大腿中段直到脚尖尽收眼底，给予充分的移动自由。
The skirts are like a giant cake, layered from the felt top to the cream lace petticoat that shows scandalously under the two colorful mesh layers so fine they resemble silk. The skirts billow over the hips and crenellate to the ankle in the back, a protection best used for running away from oncoming fire. The front, however, is high cut, revealing mid-thigh to toe and offering freedom of movement.

Wild Magic Surge: Pincushions.name:
狂野魔法涌动：针垫
Wild Magic Surge: Pincushions

Text.text:
你的法术余波尚未散去，一团奥术炽热的热浪在你周身凝聚。正当灼烫逼得人难以忍受时，它却倏然消融。取而代之的是一种光亮、橡胶般的质地覆上你的皮肤——附近所有人也无一幸免。在这种状态下，你惧怕穿刺打击会带来惨烈的伤害。
A sphere of arcane heat builds up around you in the aftermath of your spell. Just as the heat becomes unbearable, it melts away. You are left with a shiny, rubbery texture afflicting your skin—and so is everyone nearby. You fear grievous harm from piercing strikes in this condition.

Portal To The Elemental Plane Of Water.name:
通往水元素位面的传送门
Portal To The Elemental Plane Of Water

Text.text:
传送门在水下——一处幽深洞窟，石壁环抱，点缀着瑰丽的珊瑚，年岁比世界上大多数事物都要古老。你潜向一枚复生圣徽，穿过藻丛、海带，还有一条眼神机敏的老鲶鱼；即便有魔法相助，你仍惧怕溺亡的可能。这趟旅程并非只是从这片水域通往永恒之海。我们诞生于这个位面，也被浪涌与潮流送回其中，回到生命的起点。
The portal is under water—a deep cave surrounded by stones and gorgeous coral older than most of the world. You dive to an icon of resurrection, passing algae, sea kelp, and a smart-eyed old catfish; even with magical aid you fear the possibility of drowning. The trip isn't simply from this body of water to the eternal sea. We are born from this plane and borne back into it by wave and current, to the beginning of life.

Insult About A Self-sacrificing Hero.name:
关于自我牺牲的英雄的侮辱
Insult About A Self-sacrificing Hero

Text.text:
“你那样不顾性命地一头扎进战斗里，真是令人钦佩。我倒想知道，那究竟是真正的英雄气概，还是你只是太过消沉。神祇知道——要是换作是我，我也会如此。”
“It’s so admirable how you throw yourself into battle with such little regard for your life. I wonder if that’s truly heroism or if you’re just depressed. Gods know I would be if I were you.”

New Mech Suit.name:
新式机甲装甲
New Mech Suit

Text.text:
你永远不会腻：新制服的味道，还有出厂即新的驾驶舱那种令人上瘾的化学气息。这里一尘不染。你缓缓滑入未被染指的座椅，花了片刻安顿自己，享受坐垫富有弹性的抗力在贴合你身体时的回弹。伴着一阵悦耳的嗡鸣，战衣上线——比你那套老装备快得多——尖端科技启动之际，驾驶舱被清冷的蓝光浸透。
You never get tired of it, that new-suit smell and the moreish, chemical aroma of a factory-fresh cockpit. Everything is pristine. Easing into the unspoiled seat you take a moment to settle in, relishing the springy resistance of the cushioning as it adapts to your body. With a pleasing hum, the suit comes online—much faster than your old rig—and the cockpit is bathed in cool blue light as the cutting-edge tech powers up.

I Disarm A Swinging Pillar Trap.name:
我解除一根摆荡石柱陷阱
I Disarm A Swinging Pillar Trap

Text.text:
汗水从我紧锁的眉间滴落，我全神贯注地盯着手上的活计。肾上腺素在血里翻涌，我的手微微发颤，钳子一点点逼近那根绷紧的绳索——它正悬在我头顶，死死拴着那根立柱。这里但凡错一步，我的脑浆就会像果冻一样被砸得四溅，糊满地城的墙壁——而我可一点也不想让那种事发生。
Sweat drips from my furrowed brow as I concentrate on my task. My hand shakes ever so slightly from adrenaline as I move the pliers closer to the taut rope holding the pillar in place above me. One wrong move here would see my dashed brains smeared across the dungeon walls like jelly—and I’d prefer that didn’t happen.

Infiltration Of Palace Under Moonlight.name:
月下潜入王宫
Infiltration Of Palace Under Moonlight

Text.text:
加冕前夜，王宫高耸的宣礼塔后方，满月如正午烈阳般炽亮燃烧。沐浴在月辉的剪影里，一群身影以缓慢而有条不紊的精准攀上城墙，只求不露一丝破绽。抵达宫殿屋顶后，暗影们娴熟地制伏屋顶哨兵，随即悄无声息地滑入建筑之中。

~ 由 Discord 上的 crunchyzombies Envisioned

The full moon blazes like the midday sun behind the towering minarets of the royal palace on the eve of the queen's coronation. Silhouetted against the lunar radiance, a group of figures ascends the walls with slow, methodical precision, keen to stay undetected. Reaching the palace roof, the shadows expertly subdue the rooftop sentries and slip inside the building.

~ Envisioned by crunchyzombies on Discord

Recession Of The Sea.name:
海潮退却
Recession Of The Sea

Text.text:
海滩上有一道线，标记着海水曾经在岸边轻拍的地方，如今却不再。沙子从潮湿的褐色变成干燥的白色，曾被水流携来的岩石与贝壳如今被遗弃般散落其间。海水仍以微弱的波浪涌来，试图触及昔日的力量，却终究无力聚起。
A line on the beach marks where the sea used to lap along the shore, but no longer. The sand has turned from a wet brown to a dry white, and rocks and shells once carried by the water now lay abandoned. The water still comes in weak waves, trying to reach its old strength, but unable to muster.

Massive Naval Conveyance Drone.name:
大型海军运输无人机
Massive Naval Conveyance Drone

Text.text:
这架海军运载无人机尽管体型庞大，依旧保持着纤长流畅的线条；镀铬外壳在月光下泛起冷冽的粼光。它的巨大体型与强悍机能由两台巨型推进单元进一步彰显——它们驱动其破水前行，低沉脉动的轰鸣彼此错拍，激起令人不适的失谐。透过一扇巨大的舱门，货舱内部清晰可见；先进的装卸系统如框架般勾勒其间，机械结构森然有序。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The naval conveyance drone, despite its huge proportions, remains a sleek and streamlined vessel, with a chrome finish that shimmers in the moonlight. Its massive size and capability are reinforced by the two vast propulsion units that power it through the water, emitting a throbbing discordance. Its cargo hold is visible through a gargantuan hatch, advanced loading and unloading systems framing the interior.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Find Nature’s Sanctuary.name:
我寻得自然的庇护所
I Find Nature’s Sanctuary

Text.text:
我的灵魂与自然合而为一：野兽与草木都能觉察到，我与它们同属一脉。我本就属于这里。这份超自然的共鸣会削弱它们的敌意。若要伤我，它们必须先跨越这道真实的联结。
My soul is one with nature: beasts and plants sense I am one of them. I belong. This supernatural rapport hinders their hostility. They must overcome this true connection to do me harm.

I Cast Levitate From My Staff Of Power.name:
我从权杖之力施放了【漂浮术】
I Cast Levitate From My Staff Of Power

Text.text:
我将法杖指向我的目标，吟诵法术的咒词时，一阵失重感短暂地席卷全身。魔法在体内凝聚，目标缓缓离地，悬在空中轻轻起伏。我抬起法杖，小心翼翼地引导它的行进轨迹。
As I point my staff toward my target and chant the words of the spell, a sensation of weightlessness momentarily overtakes me. The magic builds, and my target slowly rises from the ground, bobbing slightly in the air. I raise my staff, carefully directing its course.

老鼠从每一道缝隙与角落里倾泻而出，肮脏的爪与尾在污垢上疾掠，拖出一道道泥痕。油腻的身躯彼此攀爬堆叠，翻涌成一座混乱而骇人的鼠丘；它们狂躁的尖叫汇成一片丧钟般的噪鸣，饥渴地催讨那久违的餐食。
Rats spill out of every nook and cranny, skittering on filthy claws and tails making trails in the grime. Greasy bodies climb over one another in a chaotic, monstrous mound, their frenzied squeaks a din of death knells eager for an overdue meal.

Quip After A Companion Gets The Last Hit.name:
同伴打出最后一击后的俏皮话
Quip After A Companion Gets The Last Hit

Text.text: “又是一记势大力沉的重击。我明白了，我好不容易把它打得摇摇欲坠，你却又顺势一推，把它直接推下了悬崖边。干得漂亮。我不是说你把所有的风头都抢走了，但你能不能停一下？” “Another mighty blow. I get it teetering, and then you go and push it right over the edge. Well done. I’m not saying you’re hogging all the glory, but could you stop?”

Sundries From An Angel.name:
天使的杂物
Sundries From An Angel

Text.text:
败北的炽天使蜷缩成胎儿般的一团，折断的双翼残破不堪，苍白的肌肤被血污染透。大多数羽毛都已毁坏殆尽，但仍有一两片完好无损，在屠戮的猩红中依旧璀璨，不见丝毫黯淡。
Defeated, the seraph lies in a fetal ball, wings broken and battered, pale flesh stained with gore. Most of their feathers are destroyed, but one or two remain intact, their brilliance unmarred by the carnage.

Street Delivery Drone.name:
街头投递无人机
Street Delivery Drone

Text.text:
小巧的送货转运器低低嗡鸣着，穿梭在巨型都市喧嚣的街巷间，像一只觅食的昆虫般疾行。它依靠先进的传感器勤勉地闪避障碍，尖锐的警笛向行人示警，脚步不歇地赶路，细小的腿以惊人的速度交替飞动。抛光的深红外壳格外醒目——它以利落的精准与效率，将包裹一一送达。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The dinky delivery transference hums quietly as it scuttles through the bustling streets of the megapolis like an insect hunting for food. Diligently dodging obstacles with its advanced sensors, and shrill siren alerting pedestrians of its passage, it makes good time, tiny legs moving at speed. The polished crimson design makes it obvious, as it delivers packages with expedient precision and efficiency.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Sundries From A Plesiosaurus.name:
来自蛇颈龙的杂物
Sundries From A Plesiosaurus

Text.text:
刀刃猛地向下划开蛇颈龙苍白的腹部，各式各样的东西随之滑落。先是一股它肠腹深处的腥臭扑面而来，紧接着胆汁与海水猛然涌出。一只破洞的皮靴也跟着倒了出来，里面还卡着一截腿骨；旁边还散落着几块木板，以及数具半消化的鱼尸。
Wrenching a blade down the plesiosaurus’s pale belly, an assortment of things slides out. First, you get a good whiff of what the inside of what its gut smells like, followed by a surge of bile and seawater. A holey leather boot with a leg bone still stuck inside it spills out, along with a few planks of wood and several half-digested bodies of fish.

构成这片大地大半的巨大冰板在此处布满裂痕，冰板之间张开了幽深的裂隙。狭窄的缝隙几乎直直向下坠落，沿途忽宽忽窄，变化无常，仿佛全由当初将其撕裂的力量随意裁定。若是失足跌入其中，必将一路撞击翻滚，最终坠入深处蔚蓝如瓷的冰冷水域。
The huge plates of ice that form the majority of the landscape lie cracked here, deep crevasses opened between them. The narrow fissures drop almost sheerly down, narrowing in unpredictable ways dictated by whatever force caused them the split apart. A tumble into the gap would mean a battering fall terminating in a frigid plunge into the cerulean water deep within.

如今需要你的人更多了，他们开始认得你——也会交付你任务。大多数平民都看清了与您作对的徒劳，转而带着敬意前来，献上条件，或请求援助。你曾穿越传送门，深入大多数人从未见过的所在。真正的怪物会成群结队地来对付你，有些甚至会逃跑或跪地求饶。你随身携带的附魔之物或异域匠造的奇珍，足以让寻常百姓心惊胆战。你开始运筹帷幄，而你的战术库也在不断扩展，渐渐烙上你的个人印记。
More people need you now, recognize you—and they give you quests. Most commoners see the futility in challenging you, instead approaching with respect, making offers, or asking for help. You have passed through portals and delved into places most people have not seen. Real monsters face you in groups, and some run or plead. You carry objects of enchantment or exotic workmanship that would frighten the average citizen. You strategize, and your repertoire of tactics is growing and becoming personal.

蘑菇几乎有人那么高，伞盖鼓胀，紫得像淤青。孢子如尘在空气里飘荡，霉味浓得呛人。一对触须从蘑菇体内蜿蜒探出——觅寻、搜索。突然，一声尖啸撕裂寂静。像海妖的号声，又像警报与垂死生物的惨叫绞在一起，那声音如利刃贯入你的脑海，音量与音调一齐攀升。
The mushrooms stand almost as tall as a human, bulbous and purple like a bruise. Spores waft on the air like dust, smelling heavily of mold. A pair of tendrils snake out from the mushroom—seeking, searching. Abruptly, a shriek pierces the silence. Siren-like, a klaxon mingled with the scream of a dying creature, the sound lances through your mind, rising in volume and pitch.

Quip By A Barbarian About Living Loud.name:
野蛮人打趣道：活就要活得声势浩大
Quip By A Barbarian About Living Loud

Text.text:
“我为什么非得让这些人都舒服？我可不活得安静。我活得张扬，活得难看，然后开心地死去。要是不留下些什么痕迹，活着就没意义，而我想留下的，是个大坑。”
“Why do I have to make all these people comfortable? I don’t live quiet. I live loud, I live ugly, and then I die happy. No point being around if you’re not going to leave a mark, and I want mine to be a crater.”

Cavern With Obelisk.name:
立有方尖碑的洞窟
Cavern With Obelisk

Text.text:
一股令人不安的死寂笼罩着潮湿、逼仄的洞窟，如同披上一层窒息的裹尸布，唯有水滴不断坠落的声响例外。空气中充斥着某种伟大而可怖的力量，你竭力想把目光从那座刻满符文的远古石质方尖碑上撕开——它正压迫般地主宰着这间被水淹没的洞室。你周遭的黑暗里有黄色的眼睛闪烁，每当你回合头去看，它们总在视线之外。它们真的存在过吗？
An unsettling stillness blankets the damp, claustrophobic cavern in a suffocating shroud, the constant sound of dripping water the only exception. The air is thick with power of a great and terrible nature, and you struggle to tear your eyes away from the rune-marked obelisk of ancient stone dominating the flooded chamber. Yellow eyes gleam in the darkness around you, always just out of sight when you turn to look. Were they really there at all?

Demonic Fungus Deity Speaks.name:
恶魔真菌神祇开口说话
Demonic Fungus Deity Speaks

Text.text:
在这座菌类充斥的洞窟里，一朵居中的巨蘑菇如同一座庞大而亵渎的祭坛，霸占着整个空间。你们稍一走神，队伍里有人不慎擦过它那鼓胀的表面。猩红的菌盖骤然炸裂，绽出一场由菌丝编织的血肉噩梦。裹着黏液的触须自四面八方缠上罪魁祸首，从头到脚紧紧束缚。那同伴被包进这令人作呕的茧里，双眼瞬间失去神采，口涎横流，成了真菌女王的空壳容器。

~ 设想：Faustharbinger

Within the fungi-filled cavern, a central mushroom dominates the space like some huge obscene altar. A momentary lapse in concentration results in one of your number inadvertently brushing its bulbous surface. The ruddy cap suddenly bursts in a fleshy nightmare of mycelium. Mucus-sheathed tendrils ensnare the culprit head to toe. Wrapped in this gruesome cocoon, your comrade’s eyes go vacant, becoming a drooling vessel for the fungal queen.

~ Envisioned by Faustharbinger

Stirge Nest In Wilderness.name:
荒野中的吸血蚊巢
Stirge Nest In Wilderness

Text.text:
一具腐烂的熊尸瘫倒在树下，遍体沾满嗡嗡乱飞的苍蝇，蛆虫在腐肉间翻涌蠕动。不远处还躺着一只干枯的秃鹫尸体，可奇怪的是，周围竟看不见其他食腐动物留下的半点痕迹。就在这时，你察觉到树上有一丝细微的移动。蝙蝠般的翼膜裹着一具具身躯——大约只有一只人手那么长——紧贴在树干与枝条上。每一头怪物都长着一根尖细的喙管，纤薄如匕首般致命。
The rotting carcass of a bear slumps beneath a tree, flecked with flies and crawling with maggots. A desiccated vulture carcass lies nearby, but curiously no other evidence of scavengers is present. That’s when you notice a subtle movement in the tree. Bat-winged bodies, about the length of a human hand, cling to the trunk and branches. Each of the beasts has a pointed proboscis as slim and deadly as a stiletto.

Armundo Gazzo.name:
阿尔蒙多·加佐
Armundo Gazzo

Text.text:
吟游诗人用里拉琴轻轻拨出几枚清亮的音符；琴面镶着繁复的金丝花纹与黑漆，华美得近乎炫目。乐器几乎与它的主人一样动人：诗人晒成蜜色的肌肤光洁无瑕，未被年代、天气或战火留下半点痕迹。耳尖微微上挑，暗示着些许妖精族裔。他穿着白衬衫，领口与袖口以利落的黑线点缀，松松披在纤细的身形上，像一条随意搭着的披巾；胸前扣子敞着，一条金链项坠在裸露的皮肤上闪烁。他清了清嗓子，把栗色发丝拢到柔和下垂的耳后。诗人垂眸爱怜地凝视琴身，修剪整齐的山羊胡勾勒出一抹狡黠的狐笑，随即开口歌唱。

~ Played by Ressie

The bard strums a few light notes on his lyre, its face an intricate embellishment of gold filigree and black lacquer. The instrument is nearly as beautiful as its player: the bard’s tanned skin is flawless, untouched by the ravages of age or weather or war. The slight point of his ears suggests some fae ancestry. His white shirt, accented with dashing black threading at the collar and sleeves, hangs about him much like a shawl over his slender frame. He has left it unbuttoned at his chest, a golden chain necklace glimmering against his bare skin. He clears his throat and brushes the locks of his chestnut hair behind his gently sloping ears. Looking down at his instrument with loving regard, his neatly trimmed goatee framing a vulpine grin, he begins to sing.

~ Played by Ressie

Treacherous Snowy Mountain Pass.name:
险恶的雪山隘口
Treacherous Snowy Mountain Pass

Text.text:
狂风嘶号，裹挟刺骨寒意与晶莹冰粒，如同寒冷的匕首般抽打在你身上。群山在你左右阴森耸立，峰顶没入上方灰沉的云层。你在雪中硬生生开出一条路，用四肢和手边任何称手的工具挖掘前行。风的咆哮无休无止，几乎盖过你的思绪；当手指与脚趾每一分每一秒都更麻木一些，你不禁怀疑，还要旅行多久才能找到栖身之所。
The winds howl, carrying with them a frigid chill and crystalline ice that lashes against you like daggers of cold. The mountains rise ominously on either side of you, their tops disappearing into the gray clouds above. You carve your way through the snow, digging a path with your limbs and whatever tool is handy. You can barely hear your own thoughts over the incessant roar of the wind, and as your fingers and toes grow more numb by the minute, you wonder how much longer you must travel to find shelter.

I Optimize My Hacker's Deck: Attack.name:
我优化黑客的卡组：攻击
I Optimize My Hacker's Deck: Attack

Text.text:
剥掉大部分细腻的花样，我敲进一串狠砸烤架的代码。一段往防火墙上撒尿的序列。一套戴着黄铜指虎的算法，经典又简单，能把 ICE 控制节点碾得像指骨一样碎。它又响又危险，但只要我一击即走，就能在身后留下真正的烂摊子。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Stripping out most of the subtlety, I write in a bunch of grill-bashing code. A sequence that pisses on a firewall. A brass-knuckle algorithm, classic and simple, that will crush ICE control nodes like finger bones. It’s loud and dangerous, but if I hit and run, I can leave a real mess behind.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Key To Private Spacecraft.name:
私人飞船钥匙
Key To Private Spacecraft

Text.text:
一块小巧的碳合金长方片，点缀着钨金属细节，中央嵌着一块微型屏幕，不断闪烁着九位数PIN码，每隔几秒便会变换。屏幕下方是一枚玫瑰金的球形圆盘：结构精密的视网膜读取器，已按持有者专属校准。背面则以优雅的金色金属铸成一头昂首咆哮的巨兽——骄傲又张扬的标志。
A small carbon-alloy rectangle with tungsten details is inlaid with a little screen at its center that flashes a nine-digit PIN, which changes every few seconds. Beneath the screen is a rose-gold spherical disc: a complex retinal-reader calibrated to the owner. On the reverse side, an elegant golden metal has been cast in the shape of a great roaring beast—a proud, boastful logo.

Loot From A Goblin.name:
从一只地精身上搜出的战利品
Loot From A Goblin

Text.text:
你找到一个羊毛袋，外面缝着一圈鸭绒，里面塞着三平方码出奇洁净的丝绸。它被做成像尿布一样穿在身上。丝绸价值30枚金币，而鸭绒的状态好到足以抵得上一只活鸭的价格。
You find a wool bag stitched around duck down and three square yards of surprisingly pristine silk. It was made to be worn like a diaper. The silk is worth 30 gold pieces, and the down is in good enough condition to be equal to the price of a live duck.

Shaped Wooden Armor.name:
塑形木制护甲
Shaped Wooden Armor

Text.text:
形状怪异的光滑木片拼合成这套护甲的胸甲与肩甲。每一块都仿佛像陶泥般塑形而成，而非雕刻。腰甲与护腿甲是光洁木弧的连片，同样的弧线也勾勒出护喉。胫甲与臂甲看上去像被掏空的树枝。巴布特盔是一顶优雅的弹丸形头盔，后方簇着一束仍在抽出绿叶的枝条羽饰。
Smooth wooden plates in odd shapes form the cuirass and pauldrons of this armor. Each piece seems molded like clay rather than carved. Fauld and tasset are arcs of smooth wood, and a similar curve forms the gorget. Greaves and vambraces appear to be hollowed branches. The barbut is an elegant bullet-shaped helm, backed with a plume of branches still sprouting green leaves.

Plain Electrum Brooch.name:
素银胸针
Plain Electrum Brooch

Text.text:
也许是学徒锤打旋制的，即便银金材质闪闪发亮，也掩不住这枚胸针的粗陋，但它能把斗篷扣在肩头，终究算是尽了本分。
Hammered and turned, by an apprentice perhaps, even the glitter of the silver-gold material can’t make the brooch beautiful, but it will close a cloak over the shoulders and so serves its purpose.

Aganazzar's Scorcher.name:
阿甘纳扎尔的灼烧术
Aganazzar's Scorcher

Text.text:
你攥紧一片赤红鳞片，低声吟诵，话音未落，空气便被点燃，翻卷成狂暴的炼狱。你一挥手一声断喝，将那场烈焰咆哮着推离身前。刹那间，火焰风暴轰然爆发，烈焰沿着笔直无误的轨迹抽打路径上的每一只生物。火光一闪便骤然消散，只留下灰烬与灼痛的余波。
Grasping a red scale, you intone phrases that immediately kindle the air into a churning inferno. You send the conflagration roaring away from you with a gesture and a shout. Instantly, a firestorm erupts, the flames lashing every creature along their straight, unerring path. The blaze disappears in a flash, leaving a wake of ash and pain.

Loot From A Gray Slaad.name:
灰色史莱德的战利品
Loot From A Gray Slaad

Text.text:
一组由十二枚巨大圆环构成的器物，其上雕琢着水栖意象——苍蝇、蝌蚪与蜗牛。纹饰透着阴森邪异的美感，嵌石则呈深紫、潮湿的水蓝与病态的惨绿。
An assemblage of twelve large rings are worked with aquatic images—flies, tadpoles, and snails. The artwork has a sinister aesthetic, and the stones are shades of dark purple, watery blue, and sickly green.

I Craft A Torch.name:
我制作一支火把
I Craft A Torch

Text.text:
我把油泼在一块布上，再将它缠上木棍的顶端。来回拧绕几圈，刻意攒出足够厚实的一团，确保能烧得更久。我点燃末端，橙黄的火团噼啪作响，明亮得像一缕心地和善的磷光，迫不及待要为前路引亮。
I splash oil over a cloth and then wrap it about the head of a stick. I twist it around a few times, sure to create a large enough wad to allow for a prolonged burn. I light the end, the orange-yellow ball of flame crackling bright like a good-natured wisp eager to light the way.

Loot From An Ice Mephit.name:
来自冰霜小恶魔的战利品
Loot From An Ice Mephit

Text.text:
那些在灰鳞小妖死时爆散的碎片风暴中侥幸活下来的家伙，会在碎片融化前获得一次霜息的使用机会。那些碎片异常致密，仿佛即便魔力耗尽，也很难被慢慢磨损殆尽。
Those who survive the burst of shards when the mephit dies are treated to one use of frost breath until the shards melt. They are quite dense and seem like they would be slow to wear down beyond their magical use.

I Read A Divination Spell Scroll I Under.name:
我阅读了一张预言法术卷轴，我理解了。
I Read A Divination Spell Scroll I Understand

Text.text:
我在卷轴上的字迹浮现之前就已知晓它们，像一段陈旧的回忆般在脑海里闪烁。我看见自己展开卷轴，朗声诵读，将其中的法术施放出去，却看不见它的效果。意识猛然一震回到我身上，携着新得的知识沉甸甸地压入心底。
I know the words before they appear on the scroll, flashing into my mind like an old memory. I see myself reading the unfurled scroll aloud, casting the spell within, though I cannot see its effects. With a jolt my consciousness returns to me, laden with new knowledge.

这把斧头像磁石般牵引着你的目光。它那锋邪的刃首上镌着优美的抽象结绳纹样，斧柄磨得温润，握在手里想必贴合而踏实——可此刻你几乎无法将视线从这件武器上移开。你仿佛看见自己将它高高举起，踏着胜利站在十数名敌人的败影之上，而这场凯旋不过是百战传奇里最新的一页。
This axe seems to draw your attention like a magnet. It bears beautiful abstract patterns of knotwork upon its wickedly bladed head, and the handle looks well-worn and comfortable to hold, but now you can hardly look away from the weapon. You imagine yourself holding it high, triumphant over a dozen foes, your victory just the most recent of a hundred such battles.

Fake Cloak Of Elvenkind.name:
精灵族伪装斗篷
Fake Cloak Of Elvenkind

Text.text:
你把那件雅致的绿铜斗篷兜帽拉过头顶，调整姿势，准备悄无声息地从视线中淡去。你低头一瞥，心头一沉——斗篷的颜色竟开始流转，变成鲜艳刺目的荧光色，和周遭一切毫不相干。
You pull the hood of the elegant green-and-copper cloak over your head and position yourself to subtly vanish from sight. You glance down and watch with dismay as the colors shift into vibrant, fluorescent hues, resembling nothing in your surroundings.

Sundries From A Shroomcap Shaman.name:
蘑菇帽萨满的杂货
Sundries From A Shroomcap Shaman

Text.text:
你掀开一只沾满孢子尘的挎包翻盖，伸手探入那潮湿的内里摸索。指尖触到包底一片凹凸不平、绒茸簇生的菌团，还碰到几样零碎：一捆干枯的细枝，以及一只蘑菇皮囊，里面装满散发酸馊气味的液体。
You open the flap of a spore-dusted satchel and dig around its damp interior. You feel a bumpy grove of fuzzy growths at the bottom of the bag, as well as a smattering of items: a bundle of dry twigs and a mushroom-leather pouch full of a sour-smelling liquid.

Prowling Cougar.name:
潜行的美洲狮
Prowling Cougar

Text.text:
一头潜行的美洲狮以近乎完美的隐秘沿着山脊悄然滑下，它那黄褐色的皮毛宛如织就的金丝，与灌木丛的阴影融为一体。它静得如同死亡，凭着猫科的敏捷无声前移，流光般的眼眸死死锁住猎物。肌肉在皮下层层隆起，随时蓄势待发——一团撕裂般的致命凶性。
A skulking cougar slinks with sublime stealth down the ridge, its tawny pelt, like woven gold, merging with the undergrowth. Silent as a death, it moves with feline agility, liquid eyes fixed on its prey. Muscles swell beneath its coat, ready to spring at a moment's notice—a lethal mass of rending aggression.

平坦的草原绵延数英里，景致唯有咸水沼泽打破单调。海岸湿地看似坚实，你却知道脚下多是泥炭——一旦踏上覆草的泥沼，随时可能陷入你不想要的“游泳”。
The flat grassland sprawls for miles, the landscape broken only by marshes of salt water. The coastal wetland seems solid enough, but you know the ground is mostly peat—stepping onto the grassy bog might result in taking a swim you don't wish for.

你俯身望向悬崖边缘，狂风拍打着你的脸。山壁环抱着这座石之孤岛的形状仿佛天生用来聚拢风势，强劲的气流沿着峭壁向上翻涌，在四周织成一道无形的风墙，抽打着空气。寒意从你的面颊蔓延，掠过头皮，顺着脊背一路往下爬。你把手伸进风里停了几秒，收回来时竟带着潮湿的触感。微风从下方深处的云海里吮走水汽——空气与水环绕着大地。
You look over the edge of the cliff and wind beats against your face. Something about how the mountainside cups this island of stone brings strong gusts, blowing up around it to form an invisible wall of buffeting air. A chill spreads from your face, over your scalp, and down your spine. You hold your hand in the wind for a few seconds and it comes away feeling damp. The breeze sucks moisture from the clouds far below—air and water encircling earth.

墙上悬着的鎏金挽具乍看平平无奇，可你一凑近，便见华丽的黄铜嵌板上刻着一头怪异异兽，柔韧的皮革上也压印着同样的纹样。它被描绘在一个类人身影旁，那身影手里似乎攥着某种缰绳；而这些图像竟在无声的循环中变幻游移：每当类人将挽具递出，异兽便一次次显现——像是在演示某种用法，或许是一套指引？

~ 构想：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The gilded harness hanging on the wall seems ordinary at first, but when you look closer, a strange beast is engraved on ornate brass panels and stamped into the supple leather. It is depicted next to a humanoid holding reins of some kind, and the images shift and move in a loop, showing the beast appearing repeatedly when the humanoid holds out the harness—instructions of some kind, perhaps?

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

咸香的烹饪气味从这家店圆形的敞门里阵阵飘出；天花板低得离谱，就连身高中等的人类也得弯腰屈身才能进门。屋内，几名半身人挑眉瞥了你这不速之客一眼，随即又各自回到自己的兴致里——或是翻阅某位早已作古的史学家留下的手稿絮语，或是对付一对塞满调味葡萄的烤乳鸽。店里不时可见侍者穿梭忙碌，托盘上既有盛着坚果褐色麦酒的杯盏，也有红葡萄酒的醒酒瓶。更往里，是一座干净却略显风吹雨打的吧台，黄铜配件泛着温润的光，周围墙面嵌着一排排卡座；再往深处，小餐厅里人声与行动交织热闹非凡，那令人垂涎的诱惑正向你招手。
Savory cooking smells emanate from the round, opened door of this establishment, the ceilings so short that even a human of average height must bend at the waist to enter. Within, several halflings glance with raised eyebrows at your intrusion, but then turn back to their interests—whether the written musings of some long-dead historian or a brace of roast squab stuffed with seasoned grapes. Here and there, servers bustle about with drink trays filled with both mugs of nut-brown ale and decanters of red wine. A clean, though somewhat weather-beaten bar with brass fittings is situated further inside, booths built into the surrounding walls; and beyond, a small restaurant bustles with activity, its mouthwatering allure beckoning to you.

邪教徒的兜帽斗篷毫无装饰，下摆一圈被烟灰熏得斑驳发黑。他们翻着一本小巧、被反复摩挲得起毛的书，动作鬼祟而警觉。嘴唇微微抽动，压着嗓子喃喃低语。忽然，邪教徒像被疼痛击中般弯下腰去，攥紧的拳头颤抖不止，祷词逐渐变得滚烫而狂乱，绝望地渴求来自彼方的一个征兆。
The cultist’s hooded cloak is unadorned and stained with soot around the hem. Their movements are furtive as they read from a small, well-thumbed book. Their lips twitch as they mutter under their breath. The cultist doubles over as though in pain, their fist trembling as their prayers turn feverish, desperate for a sign from beyond.

Silver Buckle For A Wide Belt.name:
宽腰带的银扣
Silver Buckle For A Wide Belt

Text.text:
这枚扣环是商贩常见的货色，银面才刚抛光过，隐约带着一丝醋味。它呈方形，体型如一本小祷书，可在对付狼人或亡灵时充作临时武器。
This buckle is merchant fare, the silver newly polished and smelling faintly of vinegar. It is square, the size of a small prayer book, and could serve as an improvised weapon against werewolves or the undead.

I Cast Vigilant Blessing.name:
我施放「警觉祝福」
I Cast Vigilant Blessing

Text.text:
我双手摆出一个圆环，一只手托着另一只手。我压低声音喃喃祈祷，双掌之间的空间随即微微荡漾，化作一汪银蓝色的水池——那色泽如同月光浸洗大地时的清辉，照亮景致，揭露那些本会被夜色阴影掩藏的秘密。

~ 构想 by Tusker2zero

I create the image of a circle with my hands, one hand cupping the other. I utter a prayer under my breath, and the space between my hands shimmers into a silvery-blue pool—the hue of a moon as it bathes the landscape in light, unveiling secrets the shade of night would otherwise conceal.

~ Envisioned by Tusker2zero

Cowfolk Druidic Elder.name:
牛民德鲁伊长老
Cowfolk Druidic Elder

Text.text:
就像部族村落倚靠其上的嶙峋峭壁，这位年迈的费尔博格仿佛自始便守在此处。尽管年代在他亲切的面庞上刻下纹路，你仍从他那双宽厚而慈爱的巨眼里看见一种超越时光的睿智，宛如春雨接触干涸草甸时的轻柔润泽。他左侧披着一件沉重的斗篷，覆满青翠的苔藓；你注意到斗篷之下竟缺少了某种轮廓，仿佛……有什么不见了。

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Like the rocky cliffs on which the tribe's village is perched, the old firbolg looks like he has always been here. Though age lines his welcoming face, you see a timeless wisdom in his large nurturing eyes, like the touch of spring rain on parched meadows. A heavy cloak laden with verdant moss covers his left side and you note the curious absence of form beneath it, as if something is… missing.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

一阵震颤撼动大地，一头机械坐骑自空中落下，金属碰撞作响的躯体宛如一只线条凌厉的猛禽。那只鸟形机器背上跨坐着一名侏儒，身形瘦削，握着一把还在冒烟的手枪。他眯起眼，用一只披甲的手把烟雾从脸前挥开。随后他转着武器的枪身，利落地将其收回枪套——你看得出，那副令人惊叹的臂铠并未妨碍他的灵巧。它的构造不知为何既坚固又柔韧，或许正是侏儒匠艺的印记。

~ 由 Andrew Bowser 扮演

A tremor shakes the earth as a mechanical mount lands from its flight, its clanking body resembling a sleek bird of prey. Astride this avian machine is a gnome, lean of frame, wielding a smoking pistol. He narrows his eyes and waves the smoke out of his face with an armored hand. As he spins his weapon and holsters it, you can see that his impressive gauntlet does not hinder his dexterity. The design appears, somehow, both sturdy and flexible. Perhaps a mark of gnomish ingenuity.

~ Played by Andrew Bowser

仿佛两只悲惨的生物被迫合而为一，这个佝偻的类地精生物长着过多的肢体与附肢。它蹲伏在结实的绿色肌腿上，像一只巨大的蝙蝠——又像地底冥界的噩梦造物，靠着两对皮革般的翼膜振翅腾空。四条粗壮的手臂末端是阴狠的利爪；它的四只耳朵各自收束成尖锐的尖端，在那张宽阔、扁平鼻梁的面孔两侧紧张地抽动。
Like two wretched creatures forced to become one, the hunched goblinoid has too many limbs and appendages. Squatting on muscular green legs, the creature looks like an over-sized bat—or a nightmarish creation of the underworld, borne aloft on a double set of leathery wings. Four robust arms end in wicked talons, and each of its four ears diminishes to a sharp point as they twitch nervously on either side of a wide, flat-nosed face.

半沉的水车从泥沼里探出头来，残破的辐条歪斜在这座曾经兴旺的磨坊旁。墙体处处被撕开巨大的豁口。你仿佛看见曾堆存于磨坊内的面粉在一声闷雷般的爆响中被点燃，化作震荡的烈焰。岁月把石砌结构侵蚀得遍覆苔藓、风化斑驳，已再也分不清究竟是什么毁了这里。
The half-sunken waterwheel peeks out of the mire, off its spokes beside this once prosperous mill. The walls have been rent with gaping holes here and there. You imagine the flour, once stored within the mill, igniting in a percussive conflagration. The years have rendered the stonework so moss-covered and weathered that it is impossible to tell what actually ruined this place.

Jansa Of The Folosk.name:
弗洛斯克的詹莎
Jansa Of The Folosk

Text.text:
一名年轻成熟女子伫立在薄雾缭绕的孤峰之巅，纤秀的身形覆着一层柔软的棕色绒毛。乌黑长发如蜿蜒的阴影泼洒在背后，凌乱的刘海勾勒出一张温和的面庞；鹿般的眼眸贪婪啜饮着周遭的自然美景。象征地位的护符点缀其身，酋长的财富凝作琥珀，在她颈间熠熠生辉。她披着一袭轻若耳语的轻型护甲，剪裁为速度与灵巧的侵略性而生；其表面密布矮人符文，线条洁净如新，隐隐流淌着被压抑的能量。她修长的一只手握着一柄短剑——骨质剑柄乃远古工艺的遗物——剑身低声咕哝着自信的骄傲，温热的矮人腔调让女子不由得含笑。

~ 由 Walt M. Played

A young adult woman stands atop a mist-laden tor, her lithe frame covered in a fuzz of soft brown fur. Ebon tresses splash down her back like sinuous shadows, tousled bangs framing a kind face, as doe-like eyes drink in the natural beauty of her surroundings. Talismans of rank adorn her body and a chieftain’s wealth in amber sparkles at her throat. Garbed in a whisper of lightweight armor, her attire is cut for speed and dexterous aggression, its surface a mass of dwarven runes, their pristine lines ambient with suppressed energy. In one slender hand, she grasps a shortsword—its bone hilt an artifact of ancient craft—that mutters with self-assured pride, the warm tones of its dwarvish brogue causing the woman to smile.

~ Played by Walt M.

城堡的钟楼阴沉而不祥，笼罩着重重谜团。无人记得是谁最先把那口巨大的青铜钟安置在吱呀作响的高塔里，但它仿佛自古便在那里。凹痕累累的金属钟罩上刻着十三道符文，每一道都被一种诡异的绿色物质描画其间，在黑暗中幽幽泛光。
The castle’s belfry is a dark and foreboding place shrouded in many mysteries. None recall who first placed the huge bronze bell in the creaking tower, but it has always been there. Thirteen runes mark the dented metal housing, each one inked with a strange green substance which glows softly in the darkness.

乱发纠结，遮住了她的脸，却遮不住她在震耳欲聋的咒骂间吐出的奥术词句所带来的效应。她的魔法不过是戏法造出的幻象与些许微末异象，但那一连串法术疾速迸现又倏然消散的景象，仍显得狂野骇人。偶尔，她会捏造出几只小生物，随即宣称它们是折磨她的祸根，伸出如爪般的手指去撕裂它们。
Tangled hair hides her face, but not the effects of the arcane words she spits out between loud cursing. Her magic makes mere illusions and other minor effects from cantrips, but it’s wild to see the rapid succession of spells erupt into being and then vanish. Occasionally, she crafts little creatures and then declares them her tormentors, reaching out to rend them with claw-like fingers.

Loot From A Werebear Den.name:
来自熊人狼巢穴的战利品
Loot From A Werebear Den

Text.text:
在熊人怪的巢穴里，你在一只小箱中翻到几样物件，仿佛在诉说这受诅咒之物曾经的旧日人生：一只钱袋里装着七十枚金币；一方褪色的丝绢手帕，金线绣着字母 M.A. 的缩写；以及一枚印戒——价值 5 金币——戒面印章上浮雕着一头雄狮。
In the werebear’s home you find some items in a small chest that hint at the cursed being’s former life. Seventy gold pieces in a pouch, a faded silk handkerchief with the initials M.A. picked out in golden thread, and a signet ring—worth 5 gold pieces—with a lion embossed upon the seal.

Gunshot Echo From Down The Block.name:
街区尽头传来枪声回荡
Gunshot Echo From Down The Block

Text.text:
枪声在夜色中骤然爆裂，断续急促的节奏迸出震耳的音符，从街区尽头回荡而来。人们几乎是本能地奔向掩蔽处或扑倒在地——那些死里逃生的经历磨砺了他们的直觉，而如今，曾并肩的朋友却已不在。
The staccato rhythm of gunfire erupts in the night, their booming notes echoing from down the block. Reflexively, people run for cover or dive to the ground, their instincts honed by close calls—and now absent friends.

Ring Of Regeneration.name:
再生戒指
Ring Of Regeneration

Text.text:
这枚戒指以樱桃木精心雕成，握在手中竟出奇地温暖。并非火焰般灼热，也不是反季厚衣那种闷热，而是如慈母的接触般令人安心的暖意。
This ring, lovingly carved from cherrywood, feels remarkably warm in your hand. Not warm like a flame or wearing unseasonably heavy clothing, but warm like a caring mother’s touch.

Oppenscotch Orchard In Winter.name:
冬日的奥彭斯科奇果园
Oppenscotch Orchard In Winter

Text.text:
热苹果酒的香气滚烫而醇厚，香料调得恰到好处，将众人的目光牵向奥彭斯科奇家——此刻正对公众开放。门旁一块木质折叠牌上写着：新鲜苹果酒。透过窗子，黄铜压榨机清晰可见，被一圈令人心安的暖黄光晕环抱。乡人捧着保温壶匆匆离开，手指攥得发白，眼神却被那撩人的气味熏得迷离。果园里的树却古怪地——甚至近乎奇迹般——仍结着饱满健康的果子。巨大的红苹果像饰物般垂在覆雪的枝头，霜意只是点点闪光的陪衬，洒在它们的果皮上。
The aroma of hot apple cider, perfectly spiced, draws attention to the Oppenscotch home, which is currently open to the public. Fresh cider is advertised on a wooden folding sign next to the door. A brass cider press can be seen through the window, surrounded by a comforting yellow glow. Folk leave the home with thermoses clasped tightly, eyes dreamy from the enticing smell. The trees of the orchard oddly, even miraculously, still bear healthy fruit. Huge red apples hang like ornaments from the snow-cloaked branches, the frost merely a glittery accent dappling their skins.

Abandoned Container Ship.name:
废弃集装箱船
Abandoned Container Ship

Text.text:
船身如巨影压来，甲板上堆满一座由集装箱织成的迷宫，许多箱体被撬得七零八落。那些尚未被彻底洗劫的，不是塞满垃圾，就是成了无家者的巢穴。甲板上唯一的背景声，是海风凄厉的呼啸，以及船体在竭力维系自身时发出的绝望吱嘎声。
The ship looms large, its deck housing a maze of containers in various states of being broken into. Those that haven't been cleaned out are full of either trash or the nests of the homeless. The only ambience on the deck is the howling ocean wind and the desperate creaking of the ship as it tries to hold itself together.

房间中央是一汪发着幽光的水池。水面的反光铺满墙壁与天花板，化作不断变幻的纹样海潮，流转不息。池中触手翻搅扭动，紧攀岩石，有什么东西正被拖拽着向水面爬升。厚重起棱的脑叶拼成一颗巨大的脑髓，外覆一圈黑色尖刺王冠；尖刺不断折断，化作无数触手，向下在水中蔓延开去。它终于浮出水面，这才看清——那柔和的光正是这颗脑髓本身在发出。
In the center of the room sits a glowing pool. Reflection from the water covers the walls and ceiling in a constantly shifting sea of patterns. In the pool, tentacles writhe and cling to rocks as something pulls itself to the surface. Thick ridged lobes make up a massive brain encased in a crown of black spikes, which break off to become the countless tentacles spreading through the water below. Now at the surface it becomes clear that it is the brain itself producing the soft light.

一团灰色的代码隆起在虚无空间中起伏涌动，短暂却令人心悸地凝成一具漆黑的死神。刹那间，它仿佛就是令人畏惧的黑色ICE，但不——还差那么一点黑。形体在一道白光中瓦解，迸出噼啪作响的亮芒。火花迟迟不散，像静电噪声的嘶嘶余响。也许它不是黑色ICE，但绝对不是能随便招惹的东西。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

A gray mound of code undulates in null space, taking a brief but haunting form as a dark reaper. For a moment, it appears to be the dreaded black ICE, but no—it’s not quite dark enough. The form dissolves with a flash of white, sparking light. The sparks linger, like fizzle of static noise. It may not be black ICE, but it’s certainly nothing to trifle with.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

公爵身披毛皮内衬的丝绸长袍，银金滚边在光下流淌。他微扬下巴，目光自带理所当然的矜贵，满是珠宝的双手更是昭示着他的尊荣。胡须修剪得一丝不苟，利落地勾出下颌线条——只是那微微隆起的小肚腩，也泄露了他对奢华盛宴的频繁纵享。
The duke wears silks lined with fur and trimmed with silver and gold. His upturned chin, entitled gaze, and jewelry-laden hands clearly mark him as a man of rank. A perfectly manicured beard accentuates his jawline, although his slight gut implies how frequently he partakes in luxurious meals.

它仿佛自某个无底深渊而来，一头由腐烂与残毁铸成的巨兽正向你逼近。它那管状的躯体，是退化黏浆、盘根、黏液与孢子的庞大混合体。它以骇人的起伏蠕动前行，在不可阻挡的迟滞中收缩、膨胀，让形体如瘤般蔓延。真菌根须化作黏腻触手，攥住地形，攀爬着、钻掘着，从每一道障碍之上或之下强行穿过。它所过之处万物尽皆凋亡，在令人作呕的脓液与腐败里黏稠地融化。
Hailing from some bottomless abyss, a behemoth of rot and ruin approaches you. Its tubular body is an enormous amalgamation of degenerative ooze, roots, slime, and spores. It moves in horrifying undulations, contracting and metastasizing its form in inevitable sluggishness. Sticky tendrils of fungal roots grasp the terrain as it climbs and burrows over or under every obstacle. It leaves everything in its wake dying in a cloying melt of pus and decay.

如一棵渐老的树。灯塔一年年缓缓向海的虚无弯折，崩裂的砖块不断从朽坏的结构上滚落，坠入下方汹涌翻腾的海水。塔内的螺旋阶梯，曾被同一家族的世代足迹踩踏攀登，如今几乎被磨得像海中卵石般光滑——无数步履在数十年间温柔却执拗地削去石面。可当浓雾涌来时，那束光依旧炽烈明亮，像一位德高望重的老水手般娴熟，将船只引离险峻海岸。

~ 由 David 在 Discord 上 构想

Like an aging tree. the lighthouse bends slowly toward oceanic oblivion with each passing year as more bricks tumble from the crumbling structure into the tumultuous waters below. The spiral steps within, scaled by generations of the same family, have all but worn smooth like glass in the ocean, innumerable steps gently wearing the stone away over decades. The light still burns strong and bright when the fog rolls in, though, guiding ships away from the coast as deftly as a venerable mariner.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Loot From A Mummy.name:
从木乃伊身上搜出的战利品
Loot From A Mummy

Text.text:
木乃伊（特征）的手腕上各戴着一只金手镯，每只价值200金币。它的颈间还套着一圈金项圈，其上嵌着青金石与瓷质镶座——价值1,000金币。
Around the mummy’s wrists are gold bracelets worth 200 gold pieces each. A choker of gold with lapis lazuli set in porcelain—worth 1,000 gold pieces—is around its neck.

披袍的骷髅（特征）在厅室里漫无目的地拖步徘徊，偶尔停在一张巨大的书桌前，用手指掠过那些散乱、风化成渣的羊皮纸。你一踏入，它便转过身来，颅骨空洞里跳动的红光如游火般晃动，带着疏离而探针般的好奇将你钉住，问它是否认识你。数百年的孤绝似乎已将这生物的心智利刃磨钝，钝到近乎悲剧。

~ 设想：Einjuden

The robed skeleton shuffles aimlessly around the chamber, pausing occasionally at a large desk to run a hand over some scattered, crumbling parchments. It turns as you enter, the red lights dancing in the hollows of its skull fixing you with a detached, probing curiosity, and asks if it knows you. It seems centuries of isolation have dulled the keen edge of the creature’s mind to the point of tragedy.

~ Envisioned by Einjuden

Chitinous Mezzoloth.name:
几丁质甲壳的梅佐洛斯
Chitinous Mezzoloth

Text.text:
你面前的东西，是由几丁质甲壳与獠牙拼成的恐怖之物。一对带着阴毒倒刺的触角在它充满仇恨的眼睛上方抽搐着；驼背般的躯体由一对萎缩的翅膀支撑，连同末端长着利爪的前肢一并撑起身形。短粗的后腿让它步伐踉跄、行动笨拙，却丝毫没有减缓它步步逼近的必然。它越走越近，你看见背上有两条布满尖刺的触手在扭动，每一条末端都分出一对残忍的钩状尖端。
The thing before you is a horror of chitinous plates and fangs. A pair of wickedly barbed antennae twitch above its hate-filled eyes, and its hunchbacked body is supported by an atrophied pair of wings as well as forelimbs that end in talons. Stubby legs leave it unbalanced and lumbering, but that doesn’t seem to slow its inexorable approach. As it draws nearer, you see two spiked tentacles writhing from its back, each ending in a pair of cruel, hooked tips.

光辉自那金色龙裔战士身上迸涌而出，如炫目的日轮光芒四射；他放声大笑，尽情享受这场较量，周身都浸在灿然的辉映里。金色的犄角立于他高贵的鳞眉之上，为那一身闪耀的板甲护甲与翻卷的披风所勾勒出的威严身影加冕。温暖的笑意点亮他的面庞，而他那日晕般明黄的鳞片散出的柔和光芒更添几分耀目。湛蓝如夏日晴空的双眼紧锁对手，两人绕圈游走，寻找破绽，伺机令对方措手不及。不远处，在一株虬结苍老的大树、被日光斑驳洒落的树冠下，静卧着一柄真正令人屏息的利刃——每一道光都捕捉到其匠心独运的细节，闪烁着近乎神圣的辉煌。

~ Played by Vahlaron

Radiance emanates from the golden draconic warrior like dazzling solar rays, his very presence awash in luminescent grandeur as he laughs uproariously, relishing the competition. Golden horns sit atop his noble reptilian brow, crowning the majestic appearance his shining plate armor and billowing cloak portray. A warm smile illuminates his face, the gesture aided by the soft, radiant light coming from his sunburst-yellow scales. Eyes blue as a summer sky fix on his opponent as they circle each other, looking for an opening to catch the other off guard. A truly breathtaking blade lies nearby beneath the sun-dappled canopy of a gnarled, old tree, each ray catching a masterful detail which shimmers with divine splendor.

~ Played by Vahlaron

镶嵌在饰有精美卷纹的护臂之上，这把可伸缩的投石索堪称艺术品。其框架由带大理石纹理的金属铸成，布满令人目眩的迷离纹路，宛如水银之海的波涛；每一侧弓臂顶端都锤刻着符文，正以柔和的光芒散发着魔法能量。
Mounted upon a bracer inlaid with elegant scrollwork, the retractable sling is a work of art. The marbled metal of the frame is replete with mesmerizing patterns, like the waves of a mercury ocean, and runes hammered into the apex of each limb glow softly with magical energy.

你周遭的丛林生机汹涌，仿佛一幅由移动织就的景象。风掠过树冠，沙沙作响；当你穿行在浓密荒野中，灌木丛里有生物仓皇逃窜。你挥砍藤蔓，劈开盘结的根须，硬生生开出一条路来。酷热与湿气几乎令人窒息，纵然头顶有参天巨木遮蔽——高达数百英尺——枝叶密得几乎将日光完全吞没，你仍被汗水浸透。远处，庞然巨物在林间移动并发出嚎叫；而奇异、诱人的植物遮住了你的视觉线。

~ 构想：OttoWise

The jungle around you teems with life, a vista of movement. Wind rustles the trees and creatures flee through the underbrush as you traverse the dense wilderness, hacking through vines and gnarled roots to clear a path. The heat and humidity are almost overwhelming, and you find yourself soaked with sweat despite the trees towering above you—hundreds of feet tall—branches so dense as to block out the daylight almost completely. In the distance, massive creatures move and howl, and strange and alluring plants block your line of sight.

~ Envisioned by OttoWise

Bewitched By Seelie Glamour.name:
为仙灵幻魅所蛊惑
Bewitched By Seelie Glamour

Text.text: 你从一棵树下穿过，一根枝条在头顶弯成拱门般的弧度，其上缠着开花的藤蔓。你听见仿佛几根竖琴弦被轻轻拨动的声音，森林忽然变得更加……耐人寻味。小飞虫成群漂浮在金色尘雾里，闪烁如星辰的呼息。松鼠沿着树干窜上去，它的吱吱声听来像一声窃笑。头顶的枝桠发出吱呀轻响，低沉而绵长，仿佛大提琴手稳稳拉弓，缓缓掠过琴弦。鲜艳的叶与花逼得你眯起眼，可你却怎么也移不开视线。你觉得自己的心跳很快，可思绪却像一条平静的小溪，缓慢而安然。每过一瞬，你便更笃定：你可以待在这里，在这片美丽之地，直到永远。 You pass under a tree with a branch that curves like an arch above your head, tangled with a flowering vine. You hear what sounds like the gentle plucks of a few harp strings and the forest suddenly becomes so much more… interesting. Gnats float in clouds of gold dust, twinkling like the breath of stars. A squirrel runs up the trunk of a tree, and its chitter sounds like a giggle. The tree limbs creak above you and the sounds are low and drawn out, as if a cellist were drawing their bow steadily across the strings of their instrument. Your eyes squint against the vibrant leaves and flowers, but you find yourself unable to look away. You think you feel your heart beating fast, but your mind is as slow and easy as a calm little brook. With each passing moment, you feel more sure that you could stay here, in this beautiful place, forever.

Sundries From A Wicker Skeleton.name:
柳条骷髅的杂物
Sundries From A Wicker Skeleton

Text.text:
生物纤维般的骨骼在最后一击落下时扭曲崩裂，随即轰然倒地。你在它的胸口发现一圈花环——不比你的手掌大——由交织的柳条编成。它或许不值钱，却带着一种令人不寒而栗的美感。
The creature’s fibrous bones twist and crack as the final blow is struck and it collapses to the ground. On its body, you notice a wreath—no larger than your palm—of woven wicker in the creature’s chest. It may not be valuable, but it is eerily beautiful.

一条凿刻在峭壁上的石阶向上延伸，通往这座如同要塞般岛屿的草地顶端，攀登之势险峻得令人心惊。再远一些时，你还能看见绵羊在几间温暖的房屋之间的田野上欢跳；可到了岛脚下，四周岩壁却如城堡外墙般直冲而上。阶梯的起点是一处平台，藏在探出的岩檐之下，离拍击的浪头仅高出几尺。码头上没有系着别的船，因此住在岛上的人想必只能仰赖定期来访的客人。
A stairway carved into the cliff presents a perilous-looking climb to the grassy top of this fortress-like island. From farther away, you could see sheep gambol across fields between cozy houses, but here at the base of the island its sides rise up like castle walls. The stairs begin their ascent at a platform sheltered by overhanging rock, a few feet above the waves. No other boats are tied to this dock, so folk who live on the island must rely upon regular visitors.

Javelin Of Lightning.name:
闪电标枪
Javelin Of Lightning

Text.text:
这支标枪做工精良，却在结构上透着古怪——它的杆身与参差的锋刃似乎是用铜而非更坚硬的金属打造。杆身上点点斑痕拉成长条的变色痕迹，仿佛曾被极端高温或某种更强烈的状态侵蚀。然而，这件武器依旧显得结实可靠，足堪一用。
The javelin is well-made, though curious in its construction—its shaft and jagged edge appear to be crafted from copper instead of a harder metal. Blotches along the shaft are discolored in long lines, as if the shaft were exposed to extreme temperatures or some other powerful condition. Nevertheless, the weapon seems sturdy and serviceable.

[外部] 黑云在城市码头边缘那艘曾经伟大的战舰残骸上空翻滚。破烂的旗帜从桅杆上飘摇垂落，船体——在藤壶斑斑的凹痕之间——被数十年的海浪与风磨得光滑发亮。船艏立着一名魁梧身影：年迈的劫掠者，皮肤同样被伤疤与纹身刻满。守卫侧身让开，放行好奇者或虔信者，从几块松动的木板间引你入内。 [内部] 船舱里潮湿的黑暗将你吞没，小径向下延伸，深入船腹深处；海水在四面八方挤压着你，船壳吱呀作响、哀鸣不断。此地，聚集的礼拜者跪伏在一尊高耸的海上神祇圣像前，祭司口中涌出咸涩的海水泡沫，引领众人低沉而阴郁地吟诵。

~ 构想：Jesterio

[Outside] Dark clouds roil above the ruin of a once-great warship floating at the edge of the city docks. Tattered banners flutter from the vessel’s masts, and its hull—between pockmarks of barnacles—is worn smooth by decades of waves and wind. At its prow stands a hulking figure, an aging raider with skin marred equally by scar and tattoo. The guardian steps aside to admit the curious or the devout, allowing entrance through a set of loose planks. [Inside] The wet darkness of the ship’s interior swallows you, the path leading downward into the bowels of the vessel, where the sea presses in all around you, the hull creaking and whining. Here, assembled worshipers kneel before the towering icon of a seaborne deity, and the priest’s mouth foams with briny water as they lead a dour chant.

~ Envisioned by Jesterio

Sundries From A Kidnapper.name:
绑匪的杂物
Sundries From A Kidnapper

Text.text:
你找到几段磨毛散股、还被啮齿动物咬得坑坑洼洼的绳索；一副做了手脚的牌，少了一张杰克牌，旁边还夹着三张手绘的替代牌；以及一套纹身工具包，墨汁早已干涸，针头也钝得发闷。
You find a couple lengths of frayed and rodent-nibbled rope, a marked deck of cards with a jack missing, and three hand-drawn replacements, and a tattoo kit with dried ink and dull needles.

Planar Traveler's Demiplane Home.name:
位面旅者的半位面居所
Planar Traveler's Demiplane Home

Text.text:
穿过幽暗的传送门，映入眼帘的是一间华美的房间：墙面与地板皆由抛光的灰蓝色木材镶嵌铺就，木纹如旋涡般流转。天花板是一片发光的水晶矩阵，描绘着异界苍穹——双日同悬，云涛翻涌，万象皆在流动。四壁立着无数层架，摆满书籍、卷轴与各式容器——还有一堆堆小玩意儿，从滑稽新奇到怪诞莫名、难以辨识。墙上悬着战利品，有些与架上的饰物一样离奇。屋内陈设富丽：铺着软垫的沙发与座椅围拢着一张矮几，褐木雕成树根与树干的形状。另一张更大的同款餐桌置于开阔处，可容八人就座，旁边是厨房：铜制炉灶与成套的铜制炊具相互辉映。厚重的靛蓝帷幕把房间最深处、远离入口的区域隔成一隅。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

Through the shadowy portal is a beautiful room paneled and floored in polished, gray-blue wood with a swirling grain. The ceiling is a luminous matrix of crystal depicting an alien sky with two suns and swirling clouds, all in motion. The walls have countless shelves holding books, scrolls, and containers—along with knickknacks that range from funny and curious to bizarre and unidentifiable. Trophies hang on the walls, some as strange as the shelved trinkets. Rich furnishings decorate the home: upholstered couches and chairs surround a low table of brown wood shaped like the roots and trunk of a tree. A larger, matching table with seating for eight occupies an open area near a kitchen with a copper stove and matching cooking implements. Thick indigo curtains cordon off the section of the room farthest from the entryway.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Werewolf Paladin's Holy Transformation.name:
狼人圣骑士的神圣变身
Werewolf Paladin's Holy Transformation

Text.text:
他那身磨损的板甲粗粝地刮擦作响，狼人伸手抓向那柄纹饰繁复的银色长剑。武器上迸发的光与嗡鸣骤然高涨——当他带爪的手攥住剑柄，将剑刃高高举起时，瞬间，苍白的辉光抹去了一切视野；尖锐而振奋的音调淹没了所有声响。待那令人窒息的异象缓缓褪去，一名发光的人类自光中现身，披着同样的护甲，却已光洁如新、毫无凹痕。随着他放低那柄耀眼的剑，银白的天使之翼自背脊舒展而出，翼面覆着柔密的毛；他的眼中点燃起白色的火焰。

~ 构想：ThunderWolf

With his worn plate armor scraping roughly, the werewolf reaches for the intricate silvery sword. The glow and hum from the weapon grows intense as his clawed hand grasps the grip and lifts the blade high. At once, pale radiance blots out all vision. Piercing, uplifting tones drown out all sound. As the overwhelming display fades, a luminous human emerges from the light, dressed in the same armor, now polished and undented. As he lowers the shining blade, argent angelic wings unfurl from his back, covered in fur. White fire kindles in his eyes.

~ Envisioned by ThunderWolf

这只小巧而流线的恐龙在海洋深处轻松滑行，凭借着修长的吻部与鳍肢破开水流。幼年生物的身体覆着柔软、斑驳的皮肉，其上生长着有机的纹样，专为迷惑并震慑掠食者而生。不远处，它的母亲正穿梭于一片随波起舞的海带叶林间，为这对母子追猎下一顿食物。
The small, streamlined dinosaur glides effortlessly through the ocean depths, aided by its long snout and flippers. Soft, mottled flesh covers the young creature’s body, marked with organic patterns designed to confound and deter predators. Nearby, its mother swims through a forest of dancing kelp fronds, hunting for the pair’s next meal.

Thundersnow Over A Valley.name:
山谷上的雷雪
Thundersnow Over A Valley

Text.text:
夹在连绵斜峰之间，这片覆雪的山谷本该是美丽而宁静的所在。可今日，一层灰色天幕沉沉压下。头顶乌云翻涌咆哮，倾泻而下的雪片密如削出的木屑。闪电从一座山巅撕出锯齿般的裂痕，跳向另一座山巅；雷声在谷中来回撞击回荡，似乎越滚越强，直到终于稍稍退去。每一次轰鸣都让大地震颤，蜷缩的居民也随之发抖。“雷雪，”父母低声对那些从未见过此景的孩子耳语。
Nestled between sloping peaks, the snow-blanketed valley is usually a place of beauty and calm. But today it is shrouded by a canopy of gray. Dark storm clouds rage overhead, dropping a torrent of snowflakes as thick as whittled wood. Lightning rips a jagged streak from mountaintop to mountaintop, and the thunder seems to grow in power as it echoes across and back before relenting. The earth trembles with each rumble, as do the cowering residents. “Thundersnow,” parents whisper to children who have never seen such a thing before.

Quip About The Strength Of Anxiety.name:
关于焦虑力量的俏皮话
Quip About The Strength Of Anxiety

Text.text:
“你的确显得威风凛凛。但当你想着胜利时，我却在为一旦输掉会传出什么丢人的流言而惊慌，还有父母脸上那失望的神情。与你的力量相比，我对失败的恐惧才更可怕。”
“You do seem mighty. But while you think of victory, I am panicking over what embarrassing rumors will be spread if I lose, and the disappointed looks on my parents’ faces. Your strength is nothing compared to my fear of failure.”

I Sing A Dirge For The Fallen.name:
我为逝者唱起挽歌
I Sing A Dirge For The Fallen

Text.text:
我向前迈出一步，手按在横膈之上——按在那口悲伤的深井上；四周每一声抽噎、每一次颤抖的呼吸，都让它再度涨满。我先以自己不安的一口吸气稳住身形，随后站定双脚，放开喉咙：一声尖厉的哀鸣破体而出，满是紧绷与绝望，连我自己也无法遏止。然而，当泪水从紧闭的眼后挤出时，我又重新握住了自己。我为同伴而唱——为倒下的，也为仍站立的：一首无词却炽烈的歌。
I step forward, hand placed over my diaphragm—over the well of sorrow that fills with each sob and shudder of breath around me. I brace myself with my own uneasy inhale before planting my feet and setting my voice free: a keening sound of strain and despair I cannot control. But, as tears press out from behind my shut eyes, I regain control. I sing for my fellows, fallen and not: a wordless, ardent song.

Space Veterans' Memorial.name:
空间老兵纪念碑
Space Veterans' Memorial

Text.text:
神情肃穆的访客将目光掠过抛光的花岗岩，寻找逝去至亲的名字。成千上万的姓名陈列在高耸的弧形内凹墙面上，每一个都是那场残酷战争中的牺牲者。冲突各方的士兵都在此被永恒铭刻，在退伍军人纪念花园的宁静安详中，获得了超越阵营的相聚。
