Somber visitors cast their eyes across the polished granite, seeking the names of lost loved ones. Thousands are displayed on the towering, concave wall, each a casualty in the brutal war. Soldiers from every side of the conflict are immortalized here, united in the peaceful tranquility of the veterans’ memorial garden.

I Disengage In Combat.name:
我在战斗中脱离接触
I Disengage In Combat

Text.text:
他们也以为我会被困住——在我现身、贴身潜入取命的那一刻，离战局近得无处可退。他们认定我已气力耗尽、时代无多，和他们一样迟缓。可我出手了——人头一转想看清我，刀刃一转想还击，可等他们刚要动，我早已身在别处，已然寻到掩蔽。
They think I’m going to be trapped, too close to the action, when I reveal myself as I slip in for a kill. They expect that I’m out of wind, out of time, as slow as they are. Then I strike, the heads turn to see me, and blades turn to strike back, but I’m already elsewhere and finding cover by the time they even move.

Plane Of Air.name:
空气位面
Plane Of Air

Text.text:
负责天文台日常照料的人眼神幽深，脚步拖沓。他们在圆形的房间里无休止地绕圈巡行，整理成摞的纸张或工具，转送其他工人的各类请求，并清理自上一次绕行以来新出现的任何杂乱。
The one managing the day-to-day care of the observatory has dark eyes and dragging feet. They loop endlessly through the circular room, organizing stacks of paper or tools, delivering requests from other workers, and cleaning any messes that appeared since their last lap.

这副满是划痕的钢制胸甲显然曾让它的主人在无数战斗中安然无恙——至少，主人的胸膛是如此。护胸比寻常更向外隆起几分，仿佛特意为一圈丰腴的肚腹腾出空间。下摆由金属甲片编成的流苏裙少了最底下一圈，但看上去那一圈很可能会妨碍骑马，因此这或许是出于实用考量的取舍，而非战场上的损毁。
This scratched steel breastplate has clearly seen its wearer safely through many battles—or at least, the wearer’s chest. The cuirass bulges outward a little more than normal, perhaps to make room for an ample belly. Its fringing skirt of metal plates is missing the lowest ring, but it looks like that might have interfered with horse riding, so this may have been a practical choice, rather than a loss in battle.

The Wickenbridge In Winter.name:
威肯桥的冬日
The Wickenbridge In Winter

Text.text:
警示锥与告示牌提醒行人和司机石面湿滑，使得过桥的车流与人流都稀稀落落。几个少年在桥上打滑乱窜，带着鲁莽青春的彻底放纵，一头撞上两侧的闸门。桥西端站着一名高挑魁梧的女人，静静看着这场胡闹。她的脸色苍白得与四周积雪无异，衣衫轻薄飘忽。寒霜覆在她的鞋上——那鞋看起来几乎只是双露趾凉鞋。
Caution cones and signs warn pedestrians and drivers of the slippery stone, making traffic across the bridge sparse. A few teenagers slip and slide, running into the gates on either side with the full abandon of reckless youth. A tall, broad woman stands at the western end of the bridge watching the shenanigans. Her face is as pale as the surrounding snow and her clothing is light and wispy. Frost covers her shoes, which seem to be little more than open-toed sandals.

一个人形身影大步踏入视野，随之而来的是海的气息。他们的皮肤坚硬而脆，呈钴蓝色。缕缕珊瑚从皮肤各处蜷曲生长、向外攀起——最显眼的是从太阳穴处延伸，那里耸立着壮丽的角冠，向上拔起。珊瑚之人步伐带着军人般的目的性，身披闪亮的胸甲，脚蹬长靴。他们周身的空气逼仄凝滞，仿佛在沸腾，翻涌着强烈的心灵力量。
A humanoid figure strides into view, and with them the scent of the sea. Their skin is hard and brittle and cobalt blue. Strands of coral curl up and off the skin everywhere—most prominently from the temples, where magnificent horns rise upwards. The coral person walks with military purpose, clad in gleaming breastplate and boots. The air is close about them, simmering with psychic potency.

自黑暗之中，一股阴冷的黑霉恶臭悄然钻入你的鼻腔。耳边捕捉到不祥的和声——无休无止的吱吱啮叫与利爪咔哒作响——阴影随之凝聚，化作一团被腐化的鼠肉汇流，翻滚扭动，宛如夜潮般朝你扑来。裂开的獠牙长如餐刀，在猩红的眼珠下咯咯咬合。这股鼠群带着癫狂，卑微的老鼠膨胀成怪物般的比例；那座象群般的肉丘向你推进，饥饿到足以啃穿任何护甲。
Out of the darkness, the bleak smell of black mold creeps into your nose. Your ears pick up a fell harmony of ceaseless chittering and clicking claws as the shadows coalesce into a corrupted conflux of rodent flesh writhing toward you like a tidal wave at night. Cracked fangs, long as dinner knives, gnash beneath carmine eyes. There is a frenzy to this swarm, trivial rats taking on monstrous proportions as the elephantine mound moves toward you, hungry enough to eat through any armor.

Patch's Projected Practitioner.name:
帕奇的投影施术者
Patch's Projected Practitioner

Text.text:
在轮椅使用者身旁的空白空间里，一道类人身影骤然显现，随时准备施以援手。它的存在近乎幽魂，却披覆着一片片色彩斑斓的绗缝布料，仿佛拼缀而成的外衣。它与操控者以心灵相连，激战方歇便立刻投入工作，熟练地进行例行装备检定。检定完成后，这位被投射出的行家抬手挥别，随即自视野中无声消散。
Materializing in the empty space beside the wheelchair user springs a humanoid figure ready to assist. They seem almost ghostly in nature, though covered in patches of colorful quilted fabrics. Psychically connected to their handler, they promptly get to work performing a routine equipment check after intense combat. Upon completion, the projected practitioner waves farewell and vanishes from sight.

镇广场上爆发了一场声势浩大的打雪仗，欢呼雀跃此起彼伏。各个年纪的孩子都投身这场假想战斗，热情如火，只被刺骨寒意稍稍压住。家长与同伴们围在广场四周，捧着热气腾腾的饮品驱寒，谈笑间追忆往年的节庆时光。

穿过广场，一片结冰的湖面为更爱运动的人提供了绝佳的冰场，冰鞋划过冰面发出清脆的回响；另一边，雪橇也已真刀真枪地开滑。紧闭的门后，勤快的双手同样满怀喜悦地忙碌着，为仲冬盛宴的筹备倾注心力。
Shouts of glee can be heard from a massive snow fight that has erupted in the town square, children of all ages engaging in the mock battle with a vigor only tempered by the freezing temperatures. Parents and their associates stand around the square, reminiscing about past holidays while enjoying steaming drinks to ward off the cold. Past the square, a frozen lake provides those of a more athletic bent with a rink perfect for ice skating; elsewhere sledding has begun in earnest. Behind closed doors, industrious hands labor with no less joy at the preparation of the midwinter feast.

一圈高耸的木桩环绕着这座覆满青苔的小屋；每根木桩的顶部都被刻成弯曲的颈与头，隐约像是一条条蛇。它们将屋子周围的一片空地隔离开来，空地里寸草不生。其间的地面干枯龟裂，仿佛这房子从天而降，落地时将土壤震得粉碎。
A circle of tall wood stakes surrounds this mossy cottage, each with a curved neck and head carved to look something like a snake. They cordon off a clearing about the structure in which nothing grows. The ground inside is dry and cracked, as if the house landed and shattered it.

这座洞窟的粗糙洞顶低低压在黏土铺就的地面上，两侧向下弯曲贴近地面，围出一弯矮矮的新月形空间，勉强容人穿行。很久以前，这里想必曾有水流淌而过，沉积出你脚下这片坚实夯紧的泥土；但如今洞内似乎已然干涸。
The rough ceiling of this cave hangs low over the clay floor, curving down to meet it on both sides, forming a squat crescent of space you can walk through. A long time ago water must have run through here, depositing the hard-packed earth you stand on, but now the cave seems dry.

Vadim Stormbringer.name:
瓦迪姆·风暴召者
Vadim Stormbringer

Text.text:
这名魁梧的半兽人披着一身防风雨的锁子甲，手持与他体型相称的长剑与盾牌；他站在那里便令人过目难忘——肩宽如牛，肌肉也同样雄壮。磨旧的皮带将他又长又硬的粗黑发利落地束成马尾，避免在战斗中碍事；而他右眼下方那道宽阔的疤痕，则诉说着过去一次擦肩而过的险境——若非运气或技能，他本该就此失明。盾面上刻着象征他效忠冰之女神的徽记，只是颜料所剩无几，早被一次次格挡武器的撞击震落成片。

~ Played by Vadim Stormbringer

Clad in a suit of weatherproofed chain mail and carrying a longsword and shield of a proportion equal to his size, this massive half-orc is an impressive sight to behold, with shoulders like an ox and muscles to match. A worn leather strap binds his long, coarse black hair into an economical ponytail to keep it from interfering in combat, and the wide scar just under his right eye speaks of a close call in his past that might have left him blinded, save for luck or skill. Upon the surface of his shield, an emblem indicating an allegiance to the Goddess of Ice has been engraved, though little paint remains, flaked from the impact of deflected weapon blows.

~ Played by Vadim Stormbringer

Beautiful Gold Cloak Pin.name:
华美的金色斗篷别针
Beautiful Gold Cloak Pin

Text.text:
将这件作品组合起来的金匠，才华远不止于锤与砧。以叶蔓环绕的家族纹章镌刻沿着别针通体延展，而别针末端连接的长链垂作流苏，缀着二十种颜色的丝线。
The goldsmith who put this together had greater talent than only with a hammer and anvil. The engraving of family heraldry wreathed in leaves reaches over the length of the pin, and the long chain attached to the pin’s end is a tassel with twenty colors of thread.

Hacker Executes Armor Program In The Net.name:
黑客在网域中执行护甲程序：空间歌剧主题
Hacker Executes Armor Program In The Net: Space Opera Theme

Text.text:
黑客启动他们的护甲程序，一套由光滑流线的护板构成的防护战衣在其周身迅速成形。设计极简却经典，配有一顶带时髦面罩的头盔。
The hacker activates their armor program and a protective suit of smooth, sleek plates forms around them. The design is minimal, yet classic, and comes with a stylish visored helm.

Introduction Of A Dethroned Heir.name:
废黜继承人的序章
Introduction Of A Dethroned Heir

Text.text:
“我的人生被夺走了。这个世界上，许多人都被夺走过什么，但统治的权利乃是神授。他们不仅背叛了我，也背叛了神祇。我的与生俱来之权每被扣留一天，我就要索回一品脱的鲜血。”
“My life was stolen. Many people have things taken from them in this world, but the right to rule is divine. They not only betrayed me, but the gods as well. I will take a pint of blood for every day my birthright is withheld from me.”

Transhumanism Rally.name:
超人类主义集会
Transhumanism Rally

Text.text: 无数改造过的躯体汇成这片人潮，向空中咆哮着合成口号。他们是一片金属与碳纤的海洋——纳米机器人义肢与生物工程肌肉交错起伏。头顶上，无人机盘旋翻涌，如鸟群低鸣般聚成巨大的文字宣言：未来就在此刻！与选择的自由！人潮最前方，一群魁梧的半机械人用指尖嵌装的激光，在四周建筑上灼刻下超人类主义的标志。 Countless augmented bodies make up this crowd, bellowing synthetic slogans into the air. They are a sea of metal and carbon, nanobot limbs and bioengineered muscle. Above, drones swirl like the murmur of birds into great written statements: Future is Now! and Freedom to Choose! At the head of the crowd, a pack of hulking cyborgs engrave transhumanist logos into the surrounding buildings with finger-mounted lasers.

Bernerd Kemblehatt, 1st Year House Drago.name:
伯纳德·肯布尔哈特，龙院一年级
Bernerd Kemblehatt, 1st Year House Dragon

Text.text:
这孩子像新手情绪卷起的一阵旋风，从兴奋——为能进入巨龙院而自豪——到困惑，再到对在学院第一年的忐忑不安。他的脸圆圆的，带着稚气的天真；一双灰色大眼睛藏在略显粗糙、偏长的黑发下。他随身携带着肯布勒哈特法杖——传到他手里已是四代——从不让它离开自己的视线。
This kid is a whirlwind of newbie emotions, from excited—proud to be in Dragon House—to confused, and worried about his first year at the academy. His face is round and innocent, with big gray eyes under a rough, longish cut of black hair. He carries the Kemblehatt staff, passed down four generations to him, and never lets it out of his sight.

Scratched Walls.name:
抓痕遍布的墙壁
Scratched Walls

Text.text:
这片峡谷迷宫的凹陷处弥漫着不祥的气息。风在这里戛然而止，细看之下，凹壁上布满了多种刻痕。一组像是日历或年鉴的记号；另一组是又长又深的沟痕，仿佛被鹤嘴镐或刀刃反复劈刻；最后还有一组从人类触及的高度一路延伸到地面。这些痕迹像是指甲与指尖在松软岩壁上疯狂抓挠出来的，似乎有人试图攀上去，却终究失败。
There is a foreboding atmosphere in this pocket of the canyon maze. The breeze dies here, and upon closer inspection, the walls of the pocket reveal scratches of several kinds. One set seems to be a calendar or almanac, another is a set of long and deep scratches as if by picks or blades, and finally a set running from human reach to the ground. These look like fingernails and fingertips clawed into the soft rock, perhaps trying to climb it and failing.

Nessus, The Ninth Circle Of Hell.name:
奈瑟斯，地狱第九层
Nessus, The Ninth Circle Of Hell

Text.text:
沿着通往“背叛之神”空巢的阶梯一路向下，便是奈瑟斯的洞窟。烈焰翻涌的巨大裂谷张口欲噬，直坠入冰原；冰川横贯其上，冷光如刃。这里的折磨比其他任何地狱都更狂暴，恶魔们逼近绝望之人，低声抛出交易。你以效忠换来片刻喘息，却永远不够。紧接着，又一名恶魔许诺解脱——只要你背叛先前那名恶魔的盟约；于是你继续前行，成了叛徒，踏上奈瑟斯那无荣无义的道路。
Down the stairway from the empty lair of the God of Treachery are the caverns of Nessus. Yawning crevasses filled with flame plunge into ice fields traversed by glaciers. The torment here is more furious than any of the other hells, and demons approach the desperate, making their offers. In exchange for your allegiance, you are given some respite, but not enough. Another demon offers relief if you betray your alliance to the demon before, and on you go, a traitor, along the honorless paths of Nessus.

那傲慢而自负的生物微微挪动，蹄声哒哒敲在石面上。它是马与鹰的混血，却比两者都更恢弘、更致命。它喀哒一声啄击鸟喙，你从它的眼神里感到一种野兽中罕见的勇气与狡黠。它抖了抖双翼——迫不及待要振翅升空。
The haughty, proud creature shifts, hooves clopping against the stone. A mingling of horse and eagle, the creature appears grander and more deadly than either. It clicks its beak, and in its eyes you sense a courage and cunning rare in beasts. It flicks its wings—eager to take flight.

Forest Of Dead Trees.name:
枯死之林
Forest Of Dead Trees

Text.text:
枯槁的树木在寒风中齐声哀唱，吱嘎的呻吟交织成悲恸的合唱；冷冽的风压弯枝桠，仿佛下一刻就要将它们死寂而脆裂的躯干折断。光秃的枝条从腐烂、坑洼的树干上伸出，投下不祥的阴影——像一具尸体从坟中探出的、绝望抓挠的手指。
The withered trees sing a mournful chorus of creaking groans as a chill wind bends their boughs and threatens to snap their dead and brittle bodies. The leafless branches, on rotting, pitted trunks, cast foreboding shadows—desperate, grasping fingers of a corpse emerging from its grave.

Faenor Irithyl (Tethrin Veraldé).name:
法埃诺尔·伊瑞希尔（泰斯林·维拉尔黛）
Faenor Irithyl (Tethrin Veraldé)

Text.text:
他的神性是一种无形却可触的辉光，与他此生所承载的贵胄之气叠加后，几乎令人窒息。寡言而忧郁的他，只有在亲密好友身边才会愉快地鲜活起来——几乎与他置身战斗时同样生动。乌鸦般漆黑的长发与湛蓝双眼相映，他在皮鳞甲外披着钉刺皮甲长袍，每一件都镶饰着幽幽发亮的蓝色精灵符文。纤利的长剑“月刃”同样遍布这些符文。战斗中，剑身会噼啪迸裂电光。

~ Played by Elven Martial Magic God with

His divinity is an invisible but palpable radiance, almost overwhelming added to the nobility into which he has been incarnated. Stoic and melancholy, he becomes happily animated when with close friends—almost as much as when he is in combat. Raven-black haired and blue-eyed, he wears studded leather robes over leather scale mail, each piece decorated in glowing blue elven runes. Moon Blade, his sleek longsword, is covered in the same runes. In a fight, the blade crackles with electricity.

~ Played by Elven Martial Magic God with

Inspecting The Ersatz Mantle.name:
检视拟制披风
Inspecting The Ersatz Mantle

Text.text:
阿尔尚博斗篷在你手中沉甸甸地垂着，褪色的橙与条纹般的黄相互交融，而那抹黄又逐渐淡成蛋壳般的灰白。作为一件本该象征安托万·阿尔尚博不朽影响与传奇力量的魔法遗物，这块被蛀得千疮百孔的布料实在令人失望。又过了几分钟，你从表面与魔法两方面反复检视，终于意识到：这件物品上根本没有任何魔法附着。
The Cape of Archambault hangs heavily in your hands, the faded orange blending in with the stripes of yellow—which in turn fade to an eggy off-white. For a magical artifact meant to symbolize the undying influence and legendary power of Antoine Archambault, this moth-eaten piece of fabric underwhelms. After a few more minutes of inspection—both superficially and magically—you realize that this item has no magic attached to it at all.

Taunt From A Sassy Dragon.name:
来自一条嘴贱的龙的嘲讽
Taunt From A Sassy Dragon

Text.text:
“你想穿那身去送死？我的天，看来这几百年来审美真是大滑坡。”
“You want to die wearing that? My god, tastes really have slipped over the past few centuries.”

City Floating On Water.name:
水上浮城
City Floating On Water

Text.text:
乍一看，它像是一座岛屿，码头上人流船往、喧嚣繁忙；可你怎么也找不到半点陆地的踪影。取而代之的，是大约上百艘船与数不清的小舟与木筏，被缆绳紧紧绑缚在一起，拼成一片巨大而恒久的船队城邦。跳板与甲板成了街道，横杆上垂下的绳索则为那些身手矫健、胆气过人的人提供了在这座浮城间荡跃穿行的途径。
It looks at first like an island, its docks busy with traffic, but you look in vain for any sign land. Instead, you see perhaps a hundred ships and countless boats and rafts are all lashed together in one vast and permanent flotilla. Gangplanks and decks serve as streets, while ropes dangling from crossbars give athletic and courageous folk a means of swinging across this floating city.

Stream In Winter.name:
冬日溪流
Stream In Winter

Text.text:
[初次造访] 蜿蜒穿过这片区域的溪流已然封冻。岸边的垂柳有些枝条随风轻摆，而那些垂入水中的枝梢则被冰面紧紧拽住，绷直向下，钉在冰里。水仍在冰层下流淌；不过从冰面裂缝处那一道道白痕的深度来看，它应当已经厚到足以站人。

[再次造访] 积雪铺成一片漫长而平坦的白地——你知道那正是贴着峭壁流淌的溪流。零星几块曾经探出水面的石头，如今成了白色河流里凸起的浅丘。既然雪已堆覆在水上，冰层多半厚到可以行走。

[First visit] The stream that wound through this area has iced over. Weeping willows by the bank have some branches waving in the breeze, while those that dangled into the water string taut down into the ice. The water still flows beneath the surface, but judging from the depth of the white lines where the ice has cracked, it should be thick enough to stand upon.

[Return visit] Snow settles in a long flat expanse you know to be the stream that runs abutting the cliff. Here and there a few rocks that once poked up from the flow stand as pale hummocks in the river of white. Given the snow piled upon the water, the ice is probably thick enough to walk on.

Mazelike Lair In Underdark.name:
幽暗地域的迷宫巢穴
Mazelike Lair In Underdark

Text.text:
一条宽阔的独行隧道在幽暗中蜿蜒延伸，无数更狭小、更浑浊的地穴从各个角度汇入其间。尖啸、吱吱咯咯的啃噬声与低沉的隆隆回响，在这片空洞而遥远的巢穴深处层层震荡。阴凉而带土腥的甬道渗着黏液，散发着腐臭的烂泥味。主通道绕过一堵开裂的花岗岩墙分叉——那墙属于某座古老建筑，如今被向内碾碎，坍成一堆瓦砾。破墙之后是一间八角形房间，里面矗立着一尊某位古神的残破神像，身上缠挂着怪物的颚钳、甲片与利爪，遍体浸染着大量干涸的血污。

~ 设想：njorgard

A single broad tunnel twists off into the gloom, with countless smaller, murkier burrows joining it at all angles. Shrieks, chittering, and low rumbling echo in the warren’s hollow distance. The cool, earthy passages ooze and stink of foul mud. The main corridor forks around a cracked granite wall—crushed inward into a pile of rubble—of some ancient edifice. An octagonal room beyond the broken wall contains the shattered statue of some ancient god, festooned with monstrous mandibles, plates, and claws, and stained with copious amounts of dried blood.

~ Envisioned by njorgard

I Toss My Dancing Sword Into The Air.name:
我把我的舞动之剑抛向空中
I Toss My Dancing Sword Into The Air

Text.text:
我手腕一抖，将长剑掷向空中。它竟在半空骤然停住，仿佛被一只无形之手托住，随即仿佛拥有了自己的生命。宛如挣脱牢笼的飞鸟般翩然起舞，长剑旋身回旋、翻飞疾转，最后稳稳落定，悬停于蓄势待发的架势之中。
With a flick of the wrist, I throw my sword into the air. It stops, as if held by an invisible hand, and takes on a life all its own. Dancing like a bird freed from its cage, the sword pirouettes and spins before coming to rest in a readied position.

这名象人环顾四周，钴蓝的眼眸微光流转；眉宇舒展，长鼻微扬，唇角带着一丝浅笑。他倚着一柄长柄战斧，双刃斧头上刻着细密线纹与符文。那些符号与他身上的青绿纹身如出一辙——它们沿着他巨臂的灰色皮肤一路攀行，越过宽阔的肩膀与胸膛，延伸到背脊。衣着朴素：深色皮靴与腰带，厚实素布长裤，皆以蓝色点缀。一条小巧的巨龙，颜色与他的纹身与眼睛相同，正站在他肩头梳理鳞羽。

~ Played by Wargresh with

This elephantfolk gazes around with shimmering cobalt eyes, his brow relaxed, trunk raised, and mouth open in a slight smile. He leans on a long-hafted axe, its two heads marked with linework and runes. The symbols match his turquoise tattoos, which march up the gray skin of his immense arms, across his broad shoulders and chest, and onto his back. His dress is simple, with boots and belt of dark leather and britches of thick, plain cloth, all accented in blue. A tiny dragon, the color of his tattoos and eyes, preens on his shoulder.

~ Played by Wargresh with

Ring Of Telekinesis.name:
念动力之戒
Ring Of Telekinesis

Text.text:
也许只是你的幻觉，但有那么一瞬间你确信无疑：当你伸手去拿时，手中这枚戒指——镶着一块透明石英，粗糙地凿成一只人手的形状——仿佛自己跃入了你的掌心。
Perhaps it is only your imagination, but you are convinced just for a moment that the ring you are holding, set with a clear piece of quartz crudely chipped into the shape of a human hand, leapt into your grasp when you reached for it.

Antoine Archambault, Founder Of House Wy.name:
安托万·阿尔尚博，飞龙家族创始人
Antoine Archambault, Founder Of House Wyvern

Text.text:
他仪容无可挑剔：乌黑如墨的尖山羊胡与上蜡打理的八字胡一丝不乱；据说他只需微微挑起眉峰，便能让学生立刻收敛。求学时，他是魔法学界第一位伟大的飞天扫帚冠军；步入晚年仍身形精瘦、体态矫健。他那件声名远扬的披风，色泽深沉如铁般的血红，与他手中那根奢华雕琢的樱桃木魔杖相映成辉。
He was impeccably groomed, with a jet-black pointed goatee and waxed moustache, and was known to discipline a student by simply arching his brow. As a student, he was the first great broom champion in magical academia and remained lean and fit through his old age. His famous cape, the deep iron-red of blood, matched the luxuriously carved cherry wood wand he carried.

Lizardfolk Slaves' Revolution.name:
蜥蜴人奴隶起义
Lizardfolk Slaves' Revolution

Text.text:
烈焰在掠夺者的营地里狂怒翻卷，攻击的信号一出，火光便如号角般炸响。惊恐的呼喊被咕噜作响的惨叫硬生生掐断——新近获释的奴隶起而反抗残暴的主子，人人都急着用鲜血偿还那份仁慈与怜悯。成群的爬鳞战士——亮泽鳞片上溅满猩红——在燃烧的混乱中潜行游猎，浓稠的黑烟滚滚升起，钻入清冷的夜空。

~ Max_Slacker 于 Discord

Fires rage through the raiders’ camp as the signal to attack is given. Panicked shouts are cut short in gurgling cries as newly freed slaves rebel against their brutal masters, each eager to repay their kindness and mercy. Gangs of reptilian warriors—their gleaming scales splattered with gore—stalk through the blazing chaos as thick black smoke rises into the cool night air.

~ Max_Slacker on Discord

阴森的兜帽身影在刑讯室里游移，仿佛不是行走而是滑行；墙上壁炬忽明忽暗的火光，将他们那股恶魔般的气息衬得更为狰狞。房间中央的铁栅被血与污垢糊得厚重不堪，栅下深坑里涌起一股尸窖般的恶臭。他们齐声诵唱，审判官们飘向那无助的囚徒，手中灼热烙印的光从下方映亮他们的笑容。

~ Inbal 于 Discord

The sinister hooded figures seem to glide rather than walk as they move around the torture chamber, their demonic aesthetic enhanced by the flickering torchlight from the nearby sconces. The grate in the center of the room is thick with blood and grime, and a charnel stink rises from the pit beneath. Chanting as one, the inquisitors drift toward their helpless captive, their smiles underlit by the searing brands they bear.

~ Inbal on Discord

Dragon Rider Recruits.name:
驭龙骑士新兵
Dragon Rider Recruits

Text.text:
年轻的骑手们站在教官面前，坐立不安地扯着紧绷的皮质骑乘短上衣。教官是一名身形纤细的女人，白发紧束成一团利落的发髻。她眉头紧锁，压下那团闷闷的窃窃私语，新兵们立刻挺身立正——或因畏惧，或因敬畏。她以截断般的语气开口，冷冷宣称：许多人会在任务中失败，证明自己配不上他们所追求的神圣披挂——而她对那种新兵毫无兴趣。她挺直身躯，任由短暂的沉默悬在马厩霉浊的空气里；她审视的目光掠过这些年轻面孔，老练的眼睛轻易就挑出了寥寥几个值得她亲自教导的人。

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

The young riders fidget and tug at the stiff leather of their riding tunics as they stand before the instructor, a slender woman with a tight bun of white hair. With a furrowed brow she silences the muffled chatter, and the recruits stand at attention—either out of fear or respect. She addresses them in a clipped tone, stating that many will fail in their task, proving unworthy of the sacred mantle they pursue but that she is not interested in those recruits. She draws herself to her full height and lets a pause hang in the musty air of the stables as she casts an appraising gaze over the youngsters, her experienced eye easily picking out the few worth her tutelage.

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

Warship: Gun Turret Cockpit.name:
战舰：炮塔座舱
Warship: Gun Turret Cockpit

Text.text:
炮塔内的操控装置十分简洁，而武器几乎占据了内部的大部分空间。圆顶式座舱勉强容得下一名乘员，却提供了全景视野，将炮手周遭尽收眼底，使其能在威胁从任何方向出现时迅速作出反应。
The controls in the gun turret are simple, and the weapon takes up most of the space inside. Barely large enough for a single occupant, the domed cockpit offers a panoramic view of the gunner’s surroundings, allowing them to react to threats wherever they arise.

Dimitri Dalamav.name:
德米特里·达拉马夫
Dimitri Dalamav

Text.text:
在月光洒落的城市里，他踏着被浓雾裹住的鹅卵石路游荡；尽管衣着端庄考究、剪裁得体，却仍透出一股令人不寒而栗的阴影。两名暴徒上前挑衅时，他那对锐利的黄眼睛微微眯起，牵动了横贯右脸的参差疤痕。一抹恶毒的笑意掠过他苍白而俊美的面容。他漫不经心地把银柄手杖在指间转了个圈，细长的四肢带着训练有素的优雅，仿佛受过正统教习；他低声咕哝了几句。挑衅者拔出刀刃——却在惊恐得瞪大的眼神中转而互相扑杀。男人跨过两具身影，避开脚下渐渐蔓开的血泊，吹着轻快的曲调大步离去。

~ Played by Dewey Cheatem & Howe

Stalking the fog-shrouded cobbles of the moonlit city, the man strikes a sinister figure despite his stately, well-tailored attire. When two thugs confront him, his piercing yellow eyes narrow, pulling at the ragged scar bisecting the right side of his face. A wicked smile flashes across his pallid, handsome features. He twirls his silver-handled cane in relaxed contemplation, the practiced grace of his long, slender limbs suggesting formal training, and mutters something under his breath. His aggressors draw blades—and turn on each other with wide-eyed horror. The man steps over the pair, avoids the spreading pool of blood, and strides off whistling a cheerful tune.

~ Played by Dewey Cheatem & Howe

一幅描绘聚落周边区域的大地图占据着店铺地面的显要位置；旁边的画架上则摆着一张更小的图像，以近乎苛刻的建筑精度，呈现出这家制图店与街上其他建筑的平面轮廓。其余店内，木帽封口的卷轴筒被分格收纳在各处，毫无疑问是依照架上压印的字母与数字体系被一丝不苟地编目归档。
A large map of the area surrounding the settlement stands pride of place on the shop floor, while an easel nearby holds a smaller image, of excruciating architectural exactitude, showing the footprint of this cartography shop and the other buildings on the street. Wood-capped scroll tubes are pigeonholed about the rest of the store, no doubt meticulously catalogued according to the scheme of letters and numbers embossed on the shelves.

Vavec The Goliath.name:
巨人裔瓦维克
Vavec The Goliath

Text.text:
尽管这名肌肉虬结、披甲而立的战士体魄惊人，足以震慑最凶悍的强盗，但这位半巨人的举止间却透出一种沉静的尊严。他的神情依旧怀抱希望——即便那坎坷的一生早已刻在脸上，右颊一道参差的疤痕便是明证。这是个会在荣耀时刻动用超凡力量的人：他与人数占优的敌群与幽暗之力鏖战，而绝不会把力量用来恐吓或压迫手无寸铁之辈。

~ Played by Kelly Chapman

Though the sheer stature of this muscled, armored warrior would intimidate even the fiercest of bandits, something about the half-giant's demeanor projects an aura of quiet dignity. His expression remains hopeful despite a life hard lived, made clear by a jagged scar on his right cheek. This is a man who brings his superhuman strength to bear in moments of glory, battling superior numbers and dark powers, and not toward the intimidation or subjugation of the defenseless.

~ Played by Kelly Chapman

Naturalistic Council Chambers.name:
自然风格的议会厅
Naturalistic Council Chambers

Text.text:
群丘之间的一道褶皱，豁然露出一座天然的露天剧场，俯瞰下方山谷的壮阔景致。沿着山坡原有的倾斜，层层递进的石阶座位向下延伸，通往一处由平整岩石构成的阶段，其后紧贴着一道笔直的断崖。几根立柱勾勒出阶段的边界，为悬挂旗帜与帷幕提供了支点。
A fold in the hills reveals a natural amphitheater that overlooks the vista of the vale below. Stepped seating built into the normal slope of the hill descends to a sort of stage of flat stone backed by a sheer drop. Posts frame the stage, providing a place from which banners and curtains can be hung.

这头巨猿形似人类，却绝非人类的姿态；它的躯体强壮得荒谬，野蛮的力量令你目瞪口呆。它那双倍握紧的巨拳只需一击，便足以把最魁梧的类人生战士的脑浆砸成一团；若你惹怒了它，这头野兽也定能不费吹灰之力撕下你一两条肢体。
This giant ape, manlike in shape if not in posture, has such a ridiculously powerful build that you gawk at its savage strength. One blow from its doubled fist could easily dash out the brains of even the brawniest humanoid warrior, and this beast could certainly tear off a limb or two with little effort should you raise its ire.

[察觉] 魔法高塔那道怪异弯折的底部，伸出一根短短的尖刺。它像钟乳石般垂在一扇巨大入口门的门槛上方。凑近细看，才发现那是一枚钻头，螺纹间刻着仪式法术的纹路。钻头向内渐宽，没入塔身深处，深得不可思议，体量大如一辆城用马车。 [发现] 你认出那枚钻头的瞬间，它猛地转了一圈，将你拉向它——更像是被抽吸，而非磁力牵引。它被设计成坠落、钻穿大地，并把你拖向它；等它再度抬起时，你将坠落进新挖出的深坑。其机括一半是工程造物——黑暗中可见的构件向塔内层层退去——一半则是巫术。 [触发] 你走到钻头正下方，抬头想看得更清楚。它骤然苏醒，伴随吱呀作响与道具啮磨的咆哮般轰鸣，随即从塔身弯折处的底面坠下。钻头砸入地面，飞快向下掘进；你脚下在草地上不受控制地向前滑去，被它正在造出的坑洞牵引，接着一脚踏空，坠过边缘。 [Perceived] A short spike protrudes from the bottom of one of the strange bends in the enchanted tower. It hangs like a stalactite over the threshold of a large entrance door. A closer look reveals it to be a drill bit with ritual spell work written into its threads. The bit widens and recedes into the tower, impossibly deep and as large as a city carriage. [Discovered] When you realize what the drill bit is, it turns once and pulls you toward it, more like suction than magnetism. It is designed to drop, drill a hole in the earth, and draw you to it so that when it lifts, you will fall into the newly dug pit. The mechanisms are part engineering, visible in the dark works receding into the tower, and part wizardry. [Triggered] You step under the drill bit and look up to get a better perspective. It whirls to life with a creaking and gear-grinding roar, then drops from the underside of the tower bend. The bit hits the earth and burrows down fast, and you find your feet sliding forward along the grass, drawn to the pit the drill is creating, and then falling over the edge.

Stairs To Cave.name:
通往洞窟的阶梯
Stairs To Cave

Text.text:
通往洞窟的高耸石阶显然是在许多季节前凿出的——从那层蔓延在风化碎石上的苔藓与地衣地毯便可见一斑。可若没有这些石阶，攀上洞窟几乎是不可能的事。神祇才知道最早的定居者究竟如何凿成它们；想必有不少人因此失足坠亡。
The towering steps leading up to the cave were cut many seasons ago, judging by the carpet of moss and lichen spreading across the crumbling stone. Without them, however, the climb to the cave would be all but impossible. Gods know how the first settlers here managed to carve these. Many probably fell to their death.

Noble Warlock.name:
高贵的魔契术士
Noble Warlock

Text.text:
一名男子披着精致的铁锈色斗篷，头戴黑色天鹅绒帽，沉沉倚在一根深色木材漆光幽亮的手杖上。他的压纹短上衣剪裁得体，颈间以短短皮绳悬着一枚抛光钢戒。灵巧的手指在手杖圆润的顶端敲出简短的节拍，目光牢牢钉在杖身上——却又忽然，仅仅一只眼睛转动，扫视整间屋子。

~ Envisioned by jhwulfven

A male figure in a fine rust-colored cloak and a black velvet hat leans heavily on a lacquered staff of dark wood. His embossed jerkin is well-tailored, and a polished steel ring hangs from a short leather cord around his neck. His nimble fingers drum rudiments into its rounded top, gaze fixed on the staff, but then one eye—just one—swivels to survey the room.

~ Envisioned by jhwulfven

Prisoner Escapes Ball And Chain Manacle.name:
囚徒挣脱球链镣铐
Prisoner Escapes Ball And Chain Manacle

Text.text:
一只锐利如燧石的眼睛，从一帘燃烧般的赤褐发丝下抬起。囚徒双臂的肌肉浑圆结实、毫无萎缩，他一使劲，便将脚踝上的镣铐硬生生掰开。伴随着久未启用的铰链发出低沉刺耳的呻吟，他从叮当作响的铁链尽头那颗沉重的铁球中挣脱出来。
A piercing, flinty eye looks up from beneath curtains of fiery auburn hair. The round, undiminished muscles of his arms flex as the prisoner pulls apart the manacle around his ankle. With a groan of hinges long unused, he frees himself from the iron ball at the end of its jingling chain.

饮品散发着浓烈的秋日香料气息，杯身在你掌心里暖得恰到好处。厚实起泡的顶层上，撒着一撮肉桂粉与星状的丁香点缀。你抿了一口。南瓜的风味浓烈，在舌面上沉甸甸地铺开，仿佛你刚咬下了一口南瓜派。你的口渴与饥饿，似乎都在这一刻暂时得到了满足。
The drink smells strongly of autumnal spices, and the mug is pleasantly warm in your hands. A sprinkle of cinnamon and star-like cloves decorate the thick, foamy top. You take a sip. The pumpkin flavor is intense and heavy on your tongue, as if you had taken a bite of pumpkin pie. Your thirst and your hunger both seem quenched for the moment.

Divine Casting Of Light.name:
神圣光辉施放
Divine Casting Of Light

Text.text:
你举起信仰的圣徽，低声祈祷，召来光明驱散黑暗。你的话语染上一层细微的金辉。手中的徽记先是闪烁，随即在中心如烛火般颤动。随着祷词落尽，那点光被点燃并迅速壮大——仿佛一轮微型太阳，你的圣徽燃起温暖的金色辉芒。
Presenting the symbol of your faith, you utter a prayer to bring light into darkness. Your words take on a subtle, gold shine. The emblem in your hand sparkles, then flickers in its center like a candle. Kindled light grows as your orison ends, and like a miniature sun, your symbol burns with warm, golden radiance.

声音先于景象而至：低沉的嗡鸣不断拔高，愈来愈响。地平线上浮现出一团黑云，贴着地面以惊人的速度疾驰而来。那黑云左右急摆，专朝植被扑去，所过之处只余枯死的残骸。终于，它逼近到足以看清构成虫群的每一只蝗虫的轮廓。饥馑的昆虫凭本能与迫人的饥饿齐齐而动，仿佛同一个意志。
The noise comes before the sight: a low hum that steadily increases in volume. A black cloud appears over the horizon and moves along the ground at great speed. The cloud swerves left and right toward vegetation and leaves only dead remains in its wake. Eventually, the cloud comes close enough to be able to make out the shapes of the individual locusts that make up the swarm. The ravenous insects move as one by instinct and driving hunger.

闪烁的符文烙在斧刃那致命的锋线边缘，每一道都如新生的星辰般炽然燃亮。斧柄的抛光映出其下精致木纹里流淌的云纹脉络，仿佛迷人的波涛层层交织，而一枚拳头大小的宝石嵌在金色的柄头之上。
Shimmering runes mark the deadly horizon of the axe’s cutting edge, each one blazing like a newborn star. The polish on the haft highlights the marbled patterns which weave through the exquisite wood beneath like mesmerizing waves, and a fist-sized gemstone caps the golden pommel.

B'roos Stamets.name:
布罗斯·斯塔梅茨
B'roos Stamets

Text.text:
一件破旧的斗篷拖在这名旅人的宽阔肩头。他身材矮壮结实，背上扛着一个塞得鼓鼓囊囊的行囊，外头还绑着锅碗瓢盆，叮当作响，更添负担。他拄着一根手杖，杖头却怪异地嵌着一把闪着寒光的金属锅铲，像是崭新出炉，或是被主人打理得一丝不苟。两块蓝色、圆润的指垫捏住他那顶土褐色帽子的帽檐——那材质似乎是某种奇异的皮革，又或完全是另一种东西。他微微一挑帽檐，露出一张鲜亮的翠绿色面孔。蛙族的笑容宽得夸张，延伸在一双硕大的红眼之下，红得像草莓般明艳。

~ Played by a Hero

A ratty cloak trails down the broad shoulders of this traveler, short and stocky of frame. He carries a generously stuffed pack on his back, further burdened with pots and pans strapped to it. He leans on a staff, the head of it bearing, oddly, a glinting metal spatula that seems either brand new or well cared for. Two blue, orbicular finger pads pinch the brim of his tan-colored hat that could be a strange kind of leather or some other material entirely. He tips it up, revealing his bright-green face. The frogkin’s wide smile stretches beneath large red eyes, bright as strawberries.

~ Played by a Hero

Twisted Mage Tower.name:
扭曲法师塔
Twisted Mage Tower

Text.text:
一座扭曲而违逆自然的高塔仿佛在缓慢蠕动、移位。它通体漆黑、毫不反光，塔身顶端竖着分叉的尖刺，刺向苍穹；塔壁多面棱角——宛如有人以煤块亲手削琢而成。
A twisted and unnatural tower appears to slowly move and shift. Its inky, non-reflective length is topped with pronged points that stab at the sky, and has many facets—as if whittled by hand from coal.

一名被魔法操控的仆从把他抱在怀里，恭敬地称他为主人。他颈间挂着一枚翠绿祖母绿——一个次元袋——与他的眼眸同色。那双眼睛此刻正从暗影般的毛皮深处注视着外界，毛皮之下是他那修长而迷人的胡须，正是他得名的缘由：独一无二的 MR. Whiskers。他谨慎地守望着周遭发生的一切，似乎也毫不费心向你掩藏他那由精金铸成的利爪——它们随着死灵魔法的脉动而微微跳动。

~ Played by Garwen Kazúl

A magically controlled servant carries him and addresses him as master. He wears a green emerald around his neck—a bag of holding—that matches his eyes. Those very eyes now stare out from shadowy fur above the long, attractive whiskers for which he is named, the one and only MR. Whiskers. He watches the events around him carefully, and seems to make no effort at hiding his claws of adamantine from you, which pulse with necromantic magic.

~ Played by Garwen Kazúl

I Focus My Senses With The Help Of My Dr.name:
我借助龙鳞锁子甲，专注我的感官
I Focus My Senses With The Help Of My Dragon Scale Mail

Text.text:
我闭上双眼，让世界在身后坠落，退入冥想的静寂之中，凝神聚焦我的感官。我感到力量如隆隆雷暴的前锋，沿着我护甲的鳞片层层涌动，而我的意识也随之被牵引着远离此处。远方，我察觉到一股龙族的存在；闪耀的鳞光、森白的獠牙与巨大的蜥蜴之翼在脑海中一掠而过。
Closing my eyes, I let the world fall away as I retreat into a meditative state and focus my senses. I feel the power rippling through the scales of my armor like a rumbling stormfront, and my awareness is drawn away. In the distance, I sense a draconic presence, and images of gleaming scales, fangs, and huge reptilian wings flash through my mind.

这头年迈的甲龙宛如一座由鳞甲般风化的皮肉与老茧丛生的骨骼堆砌而成的山峦，遍布无数道伤疤——那是长寿草食者最常见的印记。尽管无数掠食者曾试图下口，却似乎从未有谁能攻破这座行走的堡垒；它在更年轻的同族间从容啃食，举止间自带一份沉静而不容侵犯的尊严。
A mountain of scaly, weathered flesh and calloused bone, the elderly ankylosaur bears the innumerable scars common among long-lived herbivores. Though many have tried, it seems no predator has ever breached the walking fortress, and the creature carries itself with a quiet dignity as it grazes among its younger kin.

一团浓稠的黑烟毫无征兆地笼罩了原野，灰烬的气味灌满你的鼻腔。雾霭之中，一个庞然巨影逐渐成形：一头怪物，半身覆着燃烧般猩红的鳞片，半身却是焦黑的骷髅（特征）。它的骷髅（特征）之翼撕裂遮蔽太阳的浓雾，破烂的翼膜在暗光下颤动，它仰首咆哮，发出一声来自异界的尖啸……
A thick cloud of black smoke covers the field—appearing from nowhere—and the smell of ash fills your nostrils. An enormous form takes shape within the mist: a monster half covered in flaming red scales and half a charred skeleton. Its skeletal wings break the mist that covers the sun behind their torn membranes, and it roars with an otherworldly screech…

I Throw My Serpentine Owl Figurine Of Wo.name:
我掷出我的奇妙力量蛇形猫头鹰雕像
I Throw My Serpentine Owl Figurine Of Wondrous Power

Text.text:
小雕像在一阵羽毛与翠绿魔法的旋风中被吞没，空气里顿时弥漫着树木、树脂的气息，以及甜腻的腐殖残屑香。至少九英尺高的巨鸮巍然立在我面前，棕黑相间的羽簇蓬松如灌木丛般盛放。它双眼上方伸出两道修长羽翎，像一对浓密又俏皮的眉毛，令它显出一种虚张声势却又长期隐忍的表情。它把头整整转了一圈，审视四周时，我的脑海里响起一声：“哼。”随后它开口道：“喂，小雏鸟，你要啥？”
The figurine is consumed in a whirlwind of feathers and green magic, filling the air with the aromas of trees and sap and sweet detritus. A giant owl, nine feet in height at least, towers over me, a bushy bloom of brown and black feathers. Two long plumes extend above its eyes like a pair of bushy, jaunty brows, to give it a blustered, long-suffering expression. “Hm,” I hear in my head as the owl turns its head all the way around to survey its surroundings. “So, fledgling, what’d’ye need?”

Lion Prefect At The Gate.name:
门前的狮子总督
Lion Prefect At The Gate

Text.text:
狮院的新级长站在前门口。她戴着一顶漂亮、泛着光泽的绿色头饰，名叫 gele（gil-lay），脖子上围着一条印有尼日利亚国旗图案的围巾。她望着道路与父母渐近的身影微笑着，等着宣布自己的好消息。
House Lion’s new prefect stands at the front gate. She wears a beautiful glossy green head dress, called a gele (gil-lay), and a scarf with the pattern of the Nigerian flag. She smiles at the road and her parents’ approach, waiting to announce her good news.

Rogue Failing To Properly Detect A Trap.name:
盗贼未能正确察觉陷阱
Rogue Failing To Properly Detect A Trap

Text.text:
“我来搞定，”猫族女子自信地眨眼低声咕噜着，迈步没入阴影。脚步轻得像幽灵的足音，金色眼眸燃着狡黠的锐光，她贴地潜行，滑顺如夜风，直到……“喵嗷！”她的尖叫在黑暗中炸响，痛楚与惊骇交织，同时伴着金属的当啷一声。她踉跄摔倒，口鼻狠狠砸在地上，尾巴因恐惧炸毛。一只捕兽夹毫不留情的利齿深深咬进她的脚踝，鲜血自伤口汇聚成洼，浸透了她的皮毛。

~ 由 Wikiwing 在 Envisioned

“I’ve got this,” purrs the catfolk with a confident wink as she steps into shadow. Footsteps light as a ghost’s, golden eyes burning with roguish acuity, she slinks along as smooth as the night wind until… ”YOW!” Her caterwaul rings through the darkness, pained and shocked, concurrent with a metallic clang. She falls, muzzle smashing into the ground, tail fluffed in fear. A bear trap’s unforgiving teeth bite deep into her ankle, blood pooling from the wound, soaking into her fur.

~ Envisioned by Wikiwing

Taunt From A Hungry Dragon.name:
饥饿巨龙的嘲弄
Taunt From A Hungry Dragon

Text.text:
“求你了。逃吧、藏吧、打吧、喊吧——这些只会让我的美餐更加甘美。”
“Please. Run, hide, fight, scream—all only serve to make my meal that much more satisfying.”

尽管这只马匹大小的蜥蜴带着几分异样的异界气息，口中更是密布针般锋利的獠牙，它却依旧大体温顺；你一靠近，便见它的长舌轻轻吐信，探向来者。
Despite the vaguely alien quality of this horse-sized lizard and its mouth full of needle-sharp fangs, it remains largely docile, its long tongue flicking at your approach.

Sundries From A Leprechaun.name:
小妖精的杂货
Sundries From A Leprechaun

Text.text:
一个精美刺绣的背包看似华丽，提起来却线头稀疏、立刻散架。里面是一堆由黏土、木头、石头、金属与涂上伪装颜料的假材料制成的钱币——有些缺口斑驳、一眼就露馅，有些乍看之下却更能以假乱真——此外还有三株普通且略微枯萎的三叶草。
A beautiful, embroidered backpack proves to be thread bare and falls apart when you lift it. Inside is a collection of coins made of clay, wood, stone, metals, and false materials painted over—some chipped and obvious, some better concealed at first glance—along with three normal and slightly withered shamrocks.

Dark Castle Of A Goddess Of The Drow.name:
卓尔女神的黑暗城堡
Dark Castle Of A Goddess Of The Drow

Text.text:
雉堞墙不过几英尺高，连孩子都能攀上垛口。矮塔屋顶嵌着青铜舱盖，以简陋的皮革铰链连接，舱盖下方荡着一抹魔法传送门的午夜蓝幽辉。入口之易，反倒令人心里发毛。乌木与黑玉般的阶梯沿着花岗岩墙面向下蜿蜒，穿过白色蛛丝结成的帆与吊床——黏腻而崭新——角落里还垂着耗尽的灰色旧蛛网。城堡向地底深处延展——沉入黑暗——直抵王室女神的密室与长廊。
The crenellated wall is only a few feet high, and its parapets can be scaled by a child. On the roofs of the short towers are bronze hatches with simple leather hinges and the midnight-blue glow of a magic portal. The ease of entry is off-putting. Staircases in ebony and jet descend along granite walls and under the sails and hammocks of white webbing, sticky and new, with spent gray cobwebs dangling in the corners. The castle reaches downward into the earth—down into darkness—and into the chambers and halls of the royal goddess.

Sundries From A Weretiger.name:
狼人虎的杂物
Sundries From A Weretiger

Text.text:
在虎人那精瘦而结实的腰间小袋里，你找到一把小刀——刀柄以雕花骨材制成；一卷细密的兽毛线；以及一枚两端都刻有缺口的木栓——这是训练有素的弓手常备的标准修理包，用于在野外修补断裂的弓弦。
In a pouch around the lithe, muscular waist of the weretiger you find a small knife with a carved bone handle, a spool of fine animal hair, and a wooden peg with notches cut at both ends—standard repair kit among disciplined archers to fix snapped bow strings in the field.

Loot From A Werebear.name:
来自熊人狼的战利品
Loot From A Werebear

Text.text:
在这具生物的身上，你发现了一条萨满项链：以雕刻骨片串成，刻出一头风格化的熊。熊的眼眶嵌入了光滑的黑玉髓，闪烁着神秘的幽光。
On the creature's body, you find a shamanic necklace of carved bone depicting a stylized bear. Smooth pieces of jet have been placed into the bear's eyes, and they shimmer with a mysterious luster.

I Stave Off A Panic Attack.name:
我强压住一次恐慌发作
I Stave Off A Panic Attack

Text.text: 屏幕上发光的字母触发了我体内某种东西，喉咙像流沙般塌陷，我被自己的呼吸呛住。恐慌攀升，脚下的地面仿佛要从我身下滑走，于是我把自己钉回周遭。我的目光从一双棕色皮鞋跳到带蓝色斑点的桌面，再到灰色的墙。夺回掌控：黄色海报，身后黑色的自动售货机——我听见它低沉的嗡鸣。还能听到什么？电脑尖细的哀鸣。我告诉自己，我能完成这项任务——这份清单——同时也注意到灯管在嗡嗡作响。还有呢？外面，汽车喇叭此起彼伏。我已经稳住了心神，随着一声呼——的长吐气，把自己重新淬硬，去再次直面那些字句——不算平静，但也不再被淹没。 The glowing letters on the screen trigger something inside me and my throat becomes quicksand as I choke on my own breath. I feel panic rising, the floor threatening to slide out from beneath me, so I center myself within my surroundings. My eyes leap from brown leather shoes to a blue-speckled desk, and then to gray walls. Wresting back control: yellow poster, black vending machine behind me—I hear its thrum. What else is there to hear? The computer’s keening. I can complete this task—this list—I tell myself, as I notice that the lights buzz too. What else? Outside, cars honking. I’ve regained my composure, and I exhale with a whoosh, steeling myself to confront the words again—not serene, but not overwhelmed either.

Alien Crops Growing In Temperate Farmlan.name:
温带农田里疯长的异星作物
Alien Crops Growing In Temperate Farmland

Text.text:
翠绿、紫罗兰、猩红与橙金的繁花铺满这片富饶之地的葱茏平原。湿润的空气里飘来甜美的花香，花粉自下方田野缓缓游移；紧接着，头顶天空骤然昏暗。第一滴雨落下时，你惊叹地看见：作物倏然舒展，撑开宽阔多孔的叶片，如扇般迎接倾盆雨幕。
Blooms of green, purple, red, and orange cover the lush, verdant plains of this bountiful land. A sweet floral scent drifts on the humid air as pollen meanders from the fields below, then the sky grows dark overhead. As the first drops of rain begin to fall you watch in amazement: the crops unfurl, fanning out wide porous leaves to catch the deluge.

寺院中央的一座高塔上传来震耳欲聋的铜锣声，瞬间击碎了原本宁静的寂静。小径与庭园修葺得一丝不苟，生机盎然，但每个行走其间的僧人都仿佛彻底沉入某项你看不明白的心智功课之中。那片绵延的赤红木构建筑群与自然环境浑然一体；藤蔓与常春藤沿着墙面蜿蜒攀爬，触及数座盘旋而上的高塔，而纸灯笼在稳定的西风里轻轻摇曳。
A deafening gong sounds from a tall tower in the middle of the monastery, shattering the serene silence. The paths and gardens are well maintained and full of life, but each monk who walks them appears wholly emersed in some mental task that is not obvious to you. The sprawling red wooden structure is truly at one with its natural surroundings; vines and ivy crawl along walls and reach up several spiraling towers, and paper globes sway in the steady western wind.

I Leap Over A Pit Trap.name:
我纵身跃过陷坑陷阱
I Leap Over A Pit Trap

Text.text:
这段距离得费点功夫才能说服自己。我凝起自信，让心神与身体合而为一。我站稳脚跟，后脚牢牢抓地，屈膝蓄力，猛然冲刺。边缘逼近。最后一步狠狠踏进崖沿，我借势蹬地腾空。疑念掠过一瞬，双臂乱舞间，我瞥见坑底那可怖的深处——但我落地稳住身形，把危险甩在身后。
The distance takes some convincing. I channel my confidence, bringing the mind in synchronization with the body. I get my feet planted, find purchase with my back foot, bend the knees, and run hard. The edge approaches. My last footfall digs into it and I push off. In an instant of doubt, my arms whirling, I see the horrible bottom of the pit, but I land and right myself and leave the danger behind me.

汗臭与酒气主宰着这片地下空间，潮湿闷热，令人窒息。火把与火盆投下摇曳的光，掠过湿滑的石墙，把每一处表面干涸的血迹溅斑都照得清清楚楚。喧嚣的人群围着那名副其实的“斗坑”——不过是个下陷的泥土圈，用木桩围成简陋的栅栏。众人叫嚷起哄，啐唾饮酒，抛掷钱币，偶尔还互相狠狠干上一拳。坑内，两名斗士拳头染血、眼眶发黑，绕着彼此缓缓游走。更高大的那位突然砸下终结一击，把对手打翻进尘土里；牙齿伴着汗与唾沫飞溅，横扫整个房间。胜利引来旁观者同样汹涌的狂喜与绝望，赌注随之结算。

~ Envisioned by Fentoozler

The stench of sweat and alcohol dominates the subterranean space, humid and stifling. Torches and braziers cast wavering light over the slick stone walls, illuminating splatters of dried blood across every surface. A raucous crowd encircles the aptly named Pit—little more than a sunken ring of dirt barricaded with wooden stakes. The crowd shouts and jeers, spitting and drinking while slinging coins and exchanging the occasional punch. Inside the pit, two combatants with bloodied fists and blackened eyes circle one another. The larger lands a finishing blow, dropping their opponent to the dust and sending teeth across the room in a spray of sweat and spit. The victory is met with equal amounts of joy and despair from onlookers, and bets are paid out.

~ Envisioned by Fentoozler

Expensive Multifunction Viewscreen Embed.name:
嵌入墙体的昂贵多功能显示屏
Expensive Multifunction Viewscreen Embedded In Wall

Text.text:
一个卡通化的头像在屏幕上挥手微笑，电子眼珠随着附近任何人的动静而转动。有人靠近嵌入式显示屏时，它便热情致意，并请对方选择一种语言以开始交易。用不了多久，这些东西就会取代这里真正的员工。
A cartoonish avatar waves and smiles from the screen, their digital eyes tracking anyone nearby. As someone approaches the embedded viewscreen, they are greeted warmly and asked to select a language to begin the transaction. Soon, these things will replace the actual staff here.

三只巨大的宝箱与一只较小的石匣紧紧挤在一起，满身皆是珠光宝气。还有些过于庞大、无法收入匣中的珍宝堆在它们上方与四周：成卷的上等丝绸、闪耀的枝形烛台、一副由半宝石雕成的棋具，以及一只银托盘，其上覆满杯盏与高脚酒杯。
Three great chests and a smaller coffer of stone sit huddled together, bedecked with riches. Treasures too bulky to be contained sit on and around them: bolts of fine silk, glittering candelabras, a chess set made of semiprecious stone, and a silver tray covered in cups and goblets.

Sundries From A Lamia.name:
来自拉弥亚的杂货
Sundries From A Lamia

Text.text:
这名蛇妖显然见多识广，钟爱来自各个地区的各式女性衣饰风尚。它也偏爱那些开裂的廉价珠宝——光彩动人，却几乎一文不值。
This lamia was apparently well-traveled and liked the fashions of various items of feminine clothing from many different regions. It also had an affinity for cracked, cheap jewelry—beautiful but nearly worthless.

Coil-spring Clockwork Rifle.name:
发条线圈机巧步枪
Coil-spring Clockwork Rifle

Text.text:
你俯身贴近那根修长的枪管，从一具硕大而繁复的瞄具中望出去——靠近机匣处像凯尔特十字，末端则是一枚更小的哥特十字。枪托的玫瑰木抵在肩头，左右两侧各嵌着一块刻花黄铜铭板。有人握住带球形握把的拉杆向后一扳，齿轮与小齿轮便叮当作响，咔啦咔啦把发条机构咬合到位。扳机需要极大的力道才能扣下，而你一眼就看得出，这把枪的后坐将凶猛得像一记重锤。
You peer down the long barrel through a large elaborate sight like a Celtic cross at the frame and a smaller gothic cross at the end. The rosewood of the butt against your shoulder has an engraved brass plate on either side. When one pulls back on a lever with a ball handle, gears and pinions clatter and clack the springworks into place. The firing trigger requires strong pressure, and it’s clear the gun will kick ferociously.

Subterranean Crossroads.name:
地下交汇路口
Subterranean Crossroads

Text.text:
这片地下领域的十字路口，与地表世界所见的几乎无异。一侧立着一根结实的杆子，顶端钉着指路牌。牌面用微弱发光的墨水涂绘——那墨取自发光地衣的分泌物——其上信息以六种只有地下住民才会说的语言写就。
The crossroads in this subterranean realm are much like crossroads one might find in the world above. To one side signs sit atop a sturdy pole. Painted in dimly luminescent ink—drawn from the secretions of glowing lichen—the information is rendered in a half-dozen languages spoken only by denizens of the world below.

Goblin Quip About Grandfather.name:
地精对爷爷的俏皮话
Goblin Quip About Grandfather

Text.text:
“我祖父告诉我，燃烧时间只有一半的蜡烛，会亮上两倍。而我得说，他死的时候，烧得格外耀眼。”
“My grandfather told me that the candle that burns half as long burns twice as bright, and I’ll tell you, he burned very bright when he died.”

Elf And Dragon's Camaraderie.name:
精灵与巨龙的情谊
Elf And Dragon's Camaraderie

Text.text:
森林如一张葱郁的地毯向远方铺展。自峭壁之巅俯瞰，一名尖耳的年轻女子绷紧心神，准备迎接前方的考验。风拂乱她的发丝，她深深吸气，胸膛随之起伏，呼吸沉稳有节。她转向身旁的龙裔同伴，伸出温柔的手。她带着暖意的笑轻轻拍抚那生物，随后点头——无声的承诺：无论发生什么，她都会在。

~ Envisioned by Ameria on Discord

The forest stretches out like a verdant carpet, and from her vantage atop the cliff, a young woman with pointed ears steels herself for the trials ahead. The wind tosses her hair and she breathes deeply, her chest rising and falling with a steady rhythm, as she turns to her draconic companion, offering a gentle hand. With a warm smile she pats the creature affectionately and nods—a silent promise that she will be there, no matter what happens.

~ Envisioned by Ameria on Discord

Vesta, Warrior Goddess.name:
维斯塔，战女神
Vesta, Warrior Goddess

Text.text:
战神女神沐浴在神圣光辉的氤氲光环中，亮得如同炉边的火焰。炽红的长发松松向后拢起，衬得她那张带着不祥般不老气息的面容愈发诡异；金色的目光锐利而古老，仿佛文明初燃的第一簇火星。她那身抛光的半身板甲闪耀如锻炉本身，仿佛仍带着铸造它的热意。她紧握一杆光滑的白蜡木长矛，用来追猎并袭扰她的敌人；而一柄镶满宝石的长剑则收在鞘中，垂挂腰侧，以备近身交锋。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The warrior goddess shines in a nimbus of divine radiance, as brightly as hearth fire. Blazing red hair is drawn loosely back from a face uncanny in its agelessness, her golden gaze as piercing and ancient as the first sparks of civilization. Her burnished half plate gleams like the forge that shaped it. She clutches a smooth ash-wood spear for harrying her foes, while a bejeweled sword hangs sheathed at her hip for close-quarters encounters.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

你嘶嘶吐出一个词，仿佛火焰噼啪作响，同时将手按在箭袋上。热意在皮肤上针刺般蔓延，弹药随即泛起炽烈的金光——一旦抽出搭放，便可点燃迸发。
While hissing a word like the crackle of flames, you press your hand against the quiver. Your skin tingles with heat as the ammunition begins to glow fiery gold—ready to ignite when drawn and loosed.

大地骤然消失，化作一个足以吞下一栋房子的圆形深坑。原本在地表的一切，如今在坑底纠结成一堆龟裂的残骸，约莫在五十英尺之下。仿佛地下的气泡猛然炸裂，把地面一并拖拽坍落。你正思忖着那些看似可靠坚实之物暗藏的脆弱，坑沿忽然又崩下一大块，伴着轰鸣碎裂滑落入底。
The earth vanishes into a circular pit big enough to swallow a house. What had been on the surface lies in a jumbled and cracked heap at the bottom, perhaps fifty feet down. It’s as if a subterranean bubble burst and brought the ground down with it. You’re thinking about the hidden fragility of things that seem dependable and solid when a chuck of the edge of the pit crumbles and slides in with a roar.

桅杆的骸骨般轮廓从浅水里刺出，破碎的帆布纠缠其上，打结的索具乱成一团。那艘船早已搁浅，或在暴风里迷失，或在浓雾中失明。礁石向上突兀，像弯曲的獠牙——带倒刺的匕首，静待刺穿迷航船只柔软的腹底。浪头轰然砸下，盐雾纷飞，你瞥见船身本体：被潮汐拍打推搡，半沉半露，满覆藤壶与海藻。里面会藏着什么宝物？几只牡蛎，还是一颗珍珠？又有什么仍在守着它们？
The skeletal forms of masts, tangled with tattered sails and knotted riggings, protrude from the shallow waters. The ship ran aground long ago, lost in a storm or blind in the fog. The rocks jut upward like curving tusks: barbed daggers waiting to puncture the soft underbellies of wayward vessels. A wave crashes with a flurry of salt-laced mist, and you catch sight of the ship itself, buffeted by the tide, half-drowned, overgrown with barnacles and kelp. What treasures wait within? A couple of oysters or a pearl? And what guards them still?

Cyberpunk Fantasy Metropolis: Middle-cla.name:
赛博朋克奇幻大都会：中产阶级“B”区
Cyberpunk Fantasy Metropolis: Middle-class 'B' Neighborhood

Text.text:
蜷缩在大都会的怀抱中，这片中产住宅区宛如一处蓬勃运转的枢纽。清爽宜居的公寓、低科技的安保手段，以及一系列共享设施，让这片街区成为多元住民舒适而便利的家园。
Huddled within the metropolis, this middle-class housing estate acts as a thriving hub. Cool apartments, low-tech security measures, and a range of communal amenities make this neighborhood a comfortable and convenient home for its diverse residents.

在世界尽头、巍峨群峰之间的宽阔山谷里，横陈着一幅离奇的景象。一只巨到独眼巨人都要相形见绌的前臂静静躺卧，灰白如石的肌肤上，天地为它覆上一层葱郁的苔毯。浓密的青松从那绵延如里程般的指缝间生长出来，指尖的指甲粗砺如经受天气侵蚀的峭壁。你的目光继续游移，沿着这条擎天巨肢的轮廓一路追到地平线，脑海里只剩一个念头在翻涌：它从何而来？
In a wide valley betwixt towering peaks at the edge of the world, there lies a curious tableau. A titanic forearm—of cyclopean scale—rests in gentle repose as nature spreads a viridigenous blanket of moss over its gray, stony flesh. Lush green pines sprout between mile-long fingers topped with nails rough as weather-beaten cliffs. As your gaze travels on, tracing the outline of the colossal limb against the horizon, a single thought consumes your mind: Where did it come from?

当你那炽烈的祈祷自唇间迸出，你抬手作势，如同拔出武器一般，而你所想象的武器便自虚空中凝结成形。它悬停在不远处，轮廓微光流转，仿佛被定格成实体的热浪幻影，静候你的号令发动攻击。
As soon as the fervent prayer escapes your lips, you motion as if drawing a weapon, and the weapon you envision materializes out of thin air. It hangs at a distance, a shimmering outline like a heat mirage trapped into a solid shape, awaiting your command to attack.

Eyes Of Minute Seeing.name:
明察入微之眼
Eyes Of Minute Seeing

Text.text:
这些古怪的护目镜以皮革头带固定，包含足足十二枚各不相同的镜片：色泽、形状与体型皆各异。每枚镜片都悬在一支黄铜支臂上，佩戴者只需轻轻一拨，便能将所需镜片顺滑推入到位。
Secured by a leather headband, these strange goggles comprise a dozen different lenses, each a different hue, shape, and size, and each suspended on a brass arm that slides the desired lens into place with the barest of effort from the wearer.

披甲的戈耳工面容如雕像般冷峻，从外张的鼻孔里喷出一声鼻息，将一缕缕灰雾吐向它那公牛般的头颅周遭的空气，提醒你它那足以将人石化的吐息何等致命。
With a statuesque countenance, the armored gorgon snorts out of its flared nostrils, sending plumes of gray mist into the air surrounding its bull-like head, reminding you of the deadliness of its petrifying breath.

小吃摊上堆满咸香与甜蜜的点心，用的是春末最后一茬收成。聚落各处，在夏日炽热的阳光下，游戏此起彼伏：用干草捆临时搭起的障碍赛道已经就位；年长些的孩子们正准备着射箭比赛；农场牲畜也被牵出来，等着人们评评它们的品相与繁育血统。聚落边缘，几名工人正搭建一座巨大的篝火，迎接日终的庆典——也寄望城里混杂的歌声将穿过夜色，在晚风中唱到天明。
Food stalls overflow with savories and sweets featuring the last of the spring harvest. Throughout the settlement games are played under the heat of the summer sun. Makeshift steeplechases have been constructed using hay bales, archery contests have been set up for the older children, and farm animals have been brought out to be judged for their quality and breeding. On the outskirts, several workers construct an enormous bonfire for the end-of-day festivities—and the promise of mixed voices singing through the night air.

深陷于龙类面容中的紫罗兰色刺目双眼，以疏离而威严的目光审视着你。它那修长的爬行之躯——布满棘刺与利爪——在从现实中一闪而逝时忽明忽暗、不断扭曲变形。唯有那顶由流动符文构成的王冠依旧不变，如灯塔般在这生物头顶熠熠生辉。
Piercing violet eyes set deep into a draconic visage regard you with detached authority. Its long reptilian form—adorned with spines and claws—flickers and shifts as it winks out of reality. Only its crown of shifting glyphs remains immutable, shining like a lighthouse above the creature’s head.

God Of Tyranny.name:
暴虐之神
God Of Tyranny

Text.text:
他的话语温和而克制，有时甚至耐心地讲解。可下一瞬，规矩被打破，或他的某个念头被某个不服管教、卑微却妄自尊大的家伙顶撞搅碎。他的脸色变了。他缓慢而刻意地戴上铁盔，套上铁手套。惩罚随即开始——一场彻底失控的酷刑狂潮，早已不再与过错相称；电光般的宣判，放逐，或处决。若无人制止，他便在大地撒盐，遮蔽太阳，奴役一切不顺从者。
His words are kind and measured, and sometimes he has the patience to explain. Then, suddenly, a rule is broken, or an idea of his is undermined by someone insubordinate, inferior, up-jumped. His face changes. Slowly and deliberately, he puts on his iron helmet, his iron gloves. The punishment begins, a pandemonium of tortures that don’t even match offenses anymore, lightning-swift sentencing or banishment or execution. Unchecked, he salts the earth, blots out the sun, enslaves the disobedient.

生物的剑已入鞘，但那只虬结的手仍扣在剑柄上——手上覆着带刺的银甲。相同的金属包裹着他们全身：带刺的银色护甲，上面刻满无数数字般的凹痕，还溅着猩红的涂料。那名地精类生物阴沉地皱眉，轻蔑写在紧锁的眉峰间，蛇一般的舌头掠过獠牙般的牙齿，仿佛在逐一清点。绑在身上的一串武器在昏暗的半光里闪烁着冷芒。
The creature’s sword is sheathed, but their gnarled hand remains on the handle—a hand clad in spiked silver. The same metal covers the whole of their body: spiked silver armor, notched with countless numbers and splattered in crimson paint. The goblinoid scowls, disdain written in their furrowed brow as a serpentine tongue counts fanged teeth. A bevy of weapons strapped to them glitters in the half-light.

Rebaress The Gargoyle Warlock.name:
雷巴瑞斯：石像鬼邪术师
Rebaress The Gargoyle Warlock

Text.text:
扭曲的犄角自额骨向下蜷曲，勾勒出男人的面庞；那张脸的轮廓令人不安地糅合了猿、蜥与犬的特征。弯曲的獠牙如荆棘般从狰狞的口中突起，一道漆黑的裂缝自太阳穴延伸至尖削的下巴。每一只不眨的眼中都迸出灼烈的猩红光芒……而他胸口中央嵌着的一枚巨大宝石亦同样燃亮。他手执一根法杖，杖顶镶着一颗咆哮恶魔的头颅；他倚杖而立，身躯虽如石雕般筋肉凿刻分明，却带着老者般的佝偻。

~ Played by Vahlaron "The Fearless"

Twisted horns curl down from the brow to frame the man’s face, the features an uneasy melange of simian, reptile, and canid. Crooked fangs bramble out of the grimacing mouth, and a dark fissure runs from his temple to his pointed chin. A blistering red glow emits from each unblinking eye… and from a large gem embedded in the center of his chest. He bears a staff crowned with a snarling demon’s head, upon which he leans with the stoop of an old man despite the chiseled muscles of his stone body.

~ Played by Vahlaron "The Fearless"

光滑打磨的木材被拉成一张长弓优雅的弧线。弓身几乎长得难以驾驭，逼近你的身高。弯曲的木质弓臂强劲有力，被一根绷紧的弓弦牢牢牵系。弧顶的尖端处有一道细小的箭槽，引导箭矢踏上飞行之途，直奔目标；其下方则包覆着柔软的皮革握把，手感贴合而稳妥。
The smooth polished wood is pulled into the graceful arc of a bow. The length is almost unwieldy, approaching your full height. The powerful pole of curved timber is bound by a taut bowstring. A soft, leather grip sits just below a small notch at the apex of the curve which guides the arrow at the start of its journey to the target.

Loot From A Harpy Nest.name:
鹰身女妖巢穴中的战利品
Loot From A Harpy Nest

Text.text:
一只首饰盒——盒盖上精美的镶嵌被破坏得斑驳不堪，仿佛曾被刀子狠狠剁砍——里面装着四只手镯，每只价值5金币；一枚牧师的金与钻石戒指，价值50金币；以及一条精致的项链，镶着二十颗小小的玉髓石，价值4金币。
A jewelry box—the beautiful inlay of its lid marred as if hacked at by a knife—holds four bracelets worth 5 gold pieces each; a cleric’s gold and diamond ring worth 50 gold pieces; and a fine chain set with twenty small chalcedony stones, worth 4 gold pieces.

I Ignite My Flame Tongue Scimitar.name:
我点燃焰舌弯刀
I Ignite My Flame Tongue Scimitar

Text.text:
我念出指令词，掌心掠过刀刃的弧度。火焰在光亮的金属上起舞，火舌顺着弯曲卷起，又在末端旋出，嘶嘶作响地甩入空中。我摆出战斗架势，燃烧的弯刀高举过顶，空着的那只手朝敌人伸出——掌心覆着仍在闷燃的灰烬。
I speak the command word, passing my palm over the curve of the blade. Fire dances along the gleaming metal, the tongues of flame furling along with the bend. They swirl and hiss as they sweep off into open air. I ready my fighting stance, blazing scimitar positioned above my head, my free hand extended toward my adversary—my palm coated with still-smoldering ash.

Quip About A Dank Cave.name:
关于阴湿洞窟的俏皮话
Quip About A Dank Cave

Text.text:
“不过是蜘蛛而已。食物里有蜘蛛，帐篷里有蜘蛛，下面也全是蜘蛛。而且还湿！到处都是湿漉漉的蜘蛛。我们为什么非得跑到这种鬼地方来！？”
“It’s just spiders. Spiders in the food, spiders in the tent, spiders all the way down. And wet! Just wet spiders everywhere. Why did we have to come to this place!?”

Lich Shrieks A Command.name:
巫妖尖啸下令
Lich Shrieks A Command

Text.text:
灰白的筋络从巫妖突出的颧骨一路绷到她下垂的下颌。她那咯咯作响的喉间迸出一声哭嚎，仿佛千百个惊惧的尖叫同时撕裂空气。她的双眼乳白浑浊，无法聚焦，可她的身躯却带着清晰的意志行动。她将干枯的手指直指前方，法杖随之迸射出病态的幽绿光芒。那如胆汁般的光辉映在她的银色胸甲上，啃噬金属原有的微光，将其染成沼泽般的阴湿色调。
Gray sinews stretch from the lich’s pronounced cheekbones to her hanging jaw. A cry like a thousand horrified screams emits from her rattling throat. Her eyes are milky white and incapable of focus, but her body moves with clear intent. She points her desiccated finger forward as her staff emits a sickly green light. The bile-like glow shines upon her silver breastplate, sapping the metal of its own shimmer and casting it in a swampy hue.

音乐必定是当地文化不可或缺的一环，才会有店铺甘愿倾尽心力，陈列如此繁多的乐器。或许这背后也有贵族间的风潮作祟；毕竟眼前展示的许多乐器——有些看起来就该摆在国王的宫殿里——其价钱足以抵得上寻常人一整年的薪资。几件乐器忽然自行奏起旋律，多半是用来提醒店主有客上门的法术。
Music must play an integral part in local culture for a shop to devote itself to so many types of instruments. Perhaps some fad among nobility accounts for it, for surely many of the musical tools on display—some look like they belong in a king’s palace—would cost most people a year’s wages. Several of the instruments suddenly take up a tune of their own accord, likely a spell meant to alert the shopkeeper of customers.

A Request For Healing.name:
治疗请求
A Request For Healing

Text.text:
“虽然我一直努力保持积极的心态，但亲眼观赏自己内脏的新鲜感正逐渐消退，所以如果能来点治疗，我会感激不尽。”
“While I always try to maintain a positive attitude, the novelty of viewing my own viscera is beginning to wear off, so some healing would be appreciated.”

I Drink My Potion Of Invisibility.name:
我喝下隐形药水
I Drink My Potion Of Invisibility

Text.text:
尽管我看不见瓶中有任何液体，仍把药水送到唇边。我抿下一口，味道空得像只喝进了一口空气，我一瞬间怀疑自己是不是上了当。可我眼睁睁看着自己的手与瓶子在视线里消失无踪，一层魔法般的隐形帷幕果然沿着皮肤流淌下来，将我彻底遮蔽。
I bring the potion to my lips even though I can’t see any contents within. I take a drink that tastes like nothing but air and I wonder, for a moment, if I’ve been tricked. But I watch my hand and the bottle disappear before my eyes, and a magical veil of invisibility indeed flows over me.

I Drink My Potion Of Thunder Resistance.name:
我喝下我的雷鸣抗力药水
I Drink My Potion Of Thunder Resistance

Text.text:
我饮下药剂，液体冰冷幽暗，仿佛深扎大地腹心的地城。坚决的沉稳感涌遍全身，我的身形随之鸣响出一层灰蓝能量的光晕，板岩般的魔法缕雾盘旋缠绕，护持在我周身。
I drink the potion, its contents cold and dark as a dungeon rooted deep in the earth. A resolute steadiness washes over me and my form sings with an aura of a gray-blue energy, its slate wisps of magic curling about me protectively.

Curious Young Mermaid.name:
好奇的年轻美人鱼
Curious Young Mermaid

Text.text:
年轻的人鱼带着眼中跃动的好奇向你游来，仿佛午后阳光穿过浅滩，在水面洒下斑驳碎金。她微微倾斜那覆着鳍的头，露出友善的笑意，鳃在水流中有节奏地翕动；随后她伸出手，捧出几颗闪耀的宝石——一抹令人目眩的海蓝与碧绿交织的财富色盘——在自我介绍的同时递到你面前。她告诉你，她很乐意用这些宝石换取与陆地居民的一段谈话。

~ 构想：Clara C. Potter，发表于 Discord

The young mermaid swims up to you with curiosity dancing in her eyes, like afternoon sun dappling through the shallows. She inclines her finned head with a friendly smile, as her gills flutter rhythmically in the current, and holds out several shining gems—a dazzling aquamarine palette of riches—as she introduces herself. She tells you she will gladly exchange her gems for conversation with a land dweller.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

永恒的黑夜笼罩着阴影幽谷，银白的月雾在林间流淌，遮蔽了你的视线。远处传来狼嚎，一群蝙蝠掠过头顶，皮膜般的翅翼扑扇作响。寒意沿着你的脊背蜿蜒而上，你莫名觉得雾中有什么在守夜般盯着你——那是一种掠食者的存在，既兽性十足，又带着人的影子。
Ever-present night hangs over the shadowed vale, and a silvery, moonlit mist obscures your vision. A wolf howls in the distance, and a flock of bats soar overhead, leathery wings flapping. A chill writhes up your spine, and you get the odd feeling something watches you from the mist—a predatory presence, simultaneously bestial and human.

I Feel My Bond With My Deity Restore.name:
我感到与我的神祇的羁绊重新复苏
I Feel My Bond With My Deity Restore

Text.text:
我双手紧握圣徽，低声诵出祷词，那声音在我心底的空处回荡——那里曾经充满神祇坚定不移的同在，如今却只剩寂静。我本不敢奢望回应，却忽然感到一阵暖意，如同一束光照进深渊。我几乎能感觉到一只手落在我的肩上：神圣、强大——却又慷慨。宽恕。力量与安定如晶莹澄澈的清水倾泻而下，层层漫过我。我满溢着感恩——也被重新点燃了目标。
Clasping my holy symbol in my hands, I utter a prayer that echoes in the empty place inside my heart where I once felt my deity’s steadfast presence. Expecting nothing, instead I feel warmth, a light shining into the abyss. I can almost feel a hand on my shoulder: divine, mighty—but generous. Forgiving. Strength and reassurance cascade over me like sparkling, clear water. I overflow with gratitude—and renewed purpose.

一个矮壮的矮人从铁匠铺里冲了出来。他那被炉火亲吻过的皮肤因久烤而泛红，额头的汗水把烟尘与灰烬冲成一道道污痕——像浣熊似的黑印先把他的眼圈染得更深，再沿着脸颊往下淌，最后迷失在他那已如冷煤般的胡须里。一只布满疤痕的臂弯下塞着战锤与盾牌；另一边夹着一件崭新的锁子甲，银光粼粼。咧开的笑容把他的脸劈成两半，牙齿如雪白的巨石立柱，埋在他面庞那片午夜般的林影之中。矮人把武器放到街上，双手郑重地将锁子甲从头顶套下。他停了一瞬，满是煤灰的手叉在腰间，欣赏那无可挑剔的贴合，随后捡起战锤与盾牌。他把它们贴在甲上，开始对这三件伙伴低声呢喃着古怪的自我介绍。

~ Played by a Hero with

A stocky dwarf rushes out of the smithy. His forge-kissed skin is ruddy from the prolonged heat, and sweat from his brow leaves his face streaked with smoke and ash—racoon-like markings that darken his eyes before running down his cheeks to become lost in his beard, already the color of cold coal. Stuffed under one scarred arm are a warhammer and shield; beneath the other, a fresh shirt of chain that gleams like silver. A grin splits his face, teeth like alabaster menhirs lost in the midnight forest of his face. The dwarf places his weapons on the street and uses both hands to reverently pull the chainmail over his head. He pauses for a moment, sooty hands on hips admiring the perfect fit, before retrieving his hammer and shield. He holds them against the mail and begins whispering odd introductions to the trio.

~ Played by a Hero with

Sundries From A Homunculus Servant.name:
人造仆从的杂货
Sundries From A Homunculus Servant

Text.text:
这具构装体的身躯披着一件鼠皮小袍，边缘缀着幼白鼬的绒毛滚边。它小得惊人，仿佛能套在高等精灵的拇指上，像一枚戒指。
The construct’s body wears a little robe of mouse hide and baby ermine trim. It might fit on a high elf’s thumb like a ring.

Warlock Petitions Archfey Patron.name:
术士请愿：妖精君主宗主
Warlock Petitions Archfey Patron

Text.text:
“哦，戏谑与智慧的典范啊，我将为你在物质位面开启一道冬青之门。若你以无边的机智与仁慈乐享我这番祈求，那么也许你会赐予我这唯一的一点点、微不足道的小恩惠。”
“Oh, paragon of whimsy and wisdom, I shall open for you a gate of holly into the material plane. If you, in your boundless cleverness and beneficence, enjoy my supplication, then perhaps you would grant me this one very small, trifling little boon.”

Headstone: \"Seek” In Winter.name:
墓碑：“追寻”于寒冬
Headstone: "Seek” In Winter

Text.text: 这块墓碑似乎属于一个不愿有人凭吊的人。上面写着：莫寻我于此，我已离去，且永不归来。 尽管积雪愈发深厚，你仍看见墓前放着一束枯死的花，扎成一捆，早已干瘪。它们也许是上一季留下的。 This grave marker seems to be for someone who didn’t want mourners. It reads: Seek me not here, for I am gone, and I shall not return. Despite the deepening snow, you see some dead flowers lie before the grave, left in a bundle and dried out. They might have been left a season ago.

沙砾尚未填满此处岩地上的一道豁口，白色、布满凹坑的墙面看上去仿佛被向内轰然炸开。再往里，几根华丽的白石立柱倾倒翻滚，远处一面被碾碎的墙垣无声诉说着某场灾厄或攻击的来袭。那面远墙崩落的瓦砾一路倾泻，越过建筑边缘，散落到外头的沙地上。空气中仍残留着一丝淡淡的臭氧气味。
Sand has yet to fill a gash in the rocky ground here, and the white, pitted wall looks as if it burst inward. Beyond, tumbled ornate pillars, also of white stone, and a crushed far wall tell a story of some calamity or attack. Rubble from that far wall spills onto the sand outside the building. The faint scent of ozone lingers here.

也许是嗜血野蛮的极致化身，巨鬣狗带着残忍的意图在荒野间潜行游荡，显然是在寻找一口轻松的猎物，好将其撕成碎片。尽管它的体型与狮子相仿，却丝毫没有那种生物的高贵气度。
Possibly the epitome of bloodthirsty savagery, the giant hyena stalks the landscape with savage intent, clearly looking for some easy bit of prey to rip to bits. Though it is the size of a lion, it carries none of that creature’s noble demeanor.

闪烁的广告映在汽车站肮脏的玻璃上，浑然不觉它们的目标观众早已对舒适与奢华的许诺麻木不仁。巴士进站时，在场的乘客几乎连头都不抬；直到车门打开，他们才做出决定，拖着步子从座位上起身。
Flickering advertisements are displayed on the dirty glass of the bus station, unaware that their target audience is long numb to the promises of comfort and luxury. The passengers present hardly even look up when the bus arrives, and only once the doors have opened do they make the choice to shamble from their seats.

Treading In The Divots.name:
在凹陷的足迹间穿行
Treading In The Divots

Text.text:
半场钟声一响，观众纷纷离开看台，走向球场。场地葱郁青绿，却布满强壮的struttigon脚掌踩出的粗硬凹坑。众人放慢脚步，一边啜饮饮料、低声闲聊，一边用鞋尖平整的前端把一个个坑洼压回去。獾院的一群人穿着统一的鹿皮靴，踩踏间像是在跳一支滑稽的舞，直到下一节chukka的铃声再度响起，众人才陆续回到座位上。
At the halftime bell, spectators leave the stands for the pitch. The field is rich and green but covered in the rough dents made by powerful struttigon feet. Everyone walks slowly, pressing the divots smooth with the flat tips of their shoes as they sip drinks and chat. A group from House Badger have worn matching bucks, and they make a funny dance of it until the bell rings for the next chukka and everyone takes their seats again.

这些箭矢的羽翎几近虹彩，随着你在掌心翻转，光线下微微流辉。箭杆木质被打磨得光洁发亮，笔直而富有韧性。箭头锋利狰狞，由一种你从未见过的波纹金属锻成。每一支箭似乎都在你感官边缘发出细微的嗡鸣，暗示着木材深处封存着某种深邃的魔法。
The fletching on these arrows appears almost iridescent, gleaming in the light as you turn them over in your hands. The wood of the shaft, polished to a sheen, is straight and flexible. Wicked-looking points tip the arrows, forged of a rippled metal the likes of which you've never seen. A hum, just at the edge of your senses, seems to emanate from each projectile, hinting at a deep magic contained within the wood.

Insult About An Inept Party Member.name:
嘲讽一位无能的队友
Insult About An Inept Party Member

Text.text:
“要是你帮不上忙，至少也该讨人喜欢。”
“If you can’t be useful, you could at least be likable.”

Stealth Howlers Of The Snow.name:
雪原潜嚎者
Stealth Howlers Of The Snow

Text.text:
金雕的喙与雪鸮那枚洁白的圆盘面相融，塑成这些鸟民的面容——有的金眸外沿墨黑，如刃般锐利；有的则是猫头鹰般圆润的凝视，静默而深邃。环绕着氏族山寺的城中，北境风雪缠裹，几十座长屋静静歇息，其上皆绘着各自血脉与宗族王朝的纹章。

~ 由 Christoffer by Christoffer

The beak of a golden eagle and the white disc face of the snowy owl combine to form the face of these birdfolk—some with golden eyes rimmed with black, others with the round gaze of the owl. Within the city that surrounds the clan’s mountain temple, wrapped in the snows of the north, rest dozens of longhouses, each decorated with the heraldry of its bloodline and dynastic house.

~ Envisioned by Christoffer

Smooth Mafia Don.name:
圆滑的黑手党教父
Smooth Mafia Don

Text.text:
他用一方丝绸手帕擦去指节上的血污，随即转向你，露出一个令人心底发寒却又异常温暖的笑容。随着一具软塌塌的尸体被拖出房间，教父神情麻木、步履从容地踱到桌上的水晶醒酒瓶前，给自己斟了一杯，才开口欢迎你。他的语气像掠食者在玩味“开恩”这件事；当他轻轻摇晃杯中烈酒时，那道审视的目光愈发逼人，眼睛始终不曾从你身上移开。
Wiping his bloodied knuckles on a silk handkerchief, the man turns to you with a disconcertingly warm smile. As a limp body is dragged out of the room, the don wanders with callous ease over to the crystalline decanter on the table and pours himself a glass before he bids you welcome. His tone is that of a predator entertaining the notion of mercy, and you feel his appraising gaze intensify as he swirls the liquor, his eyes never leaving yours.

Seedy, Fortified Town.name:
肮脏却戒备森严的小镇
Seedy, Fortified Town

Text.text:
倒下的原木垒成的木栅围住一片矮胖的棚屋群，纵横交错的泥泞道路与蜿蜒小巷将它们分隔开来。大门敞着——暂时如此——入口两侧站着两名膀大腰圆的守卫，手里端着磨旧的弩。一人朝泥里啐了一口，你经过时用狐疑的目光盯着你。栅内，镇民把斗篷紧紧裹在身上抵御寒湿，空气里弥漫着廉价麦酒与陈旧烟气的味道。
The palisade of felled timbers surrounds a cluster of squat hovels separated by a crisscross of muddy roads and winding alleyways. The gate stands open—for now—and two burly guards hefting worn crossbows flank the entrance. One spits into the mud as you pass, eyeing you suspiciously. Within, the townsfolk clutch their cloaks tight against the cold and damp, and the air is fragrant with cheap ale and stale smoke.

Prince Arthur's Surprise Entry To The Jo.name:
亚瑟王子的惊喜登场：挺身入场参与比武
Prince Arthur's Surprise Entry To The Joust

Text.text:
站在比武场尽头的侍从们抬起两棵细瘦的树干，几乎与骑枪等长，其间绷起一面黑旗。那布面上以白色绘着古老魔法的符号，人群一眼认出，顿时爆发出呻吟与嘘声——喧嚣几乎要淹没身后逼近的战马雷鸣般的蹄声。披着卡美洛颜色的骏马与骑手猛然撞穿旗布，将其践踏进尘土里，随即在国王面前勒停。就在众人倒吸一口气之际，欢呼声又如浪涌起——王位继承人亚瑟王子掀起头盔，向父王低首致礼。#REF!
Squires standing at the far end of the lists hoist two thin trees, each near as long as a lance, with a black banner stretched between them. Recognizing symbols of Old Magic painted in white across the cloth, the assembly erupts in groans and jeers—their din nearly drowning out the thundering hooves of a destrier approaching from behind. The horse and rider adorned in Camelot’s colors burst through the cloth, trample it into the dust, and come to a halt before the king. The gasps of the crowd become cheers when Prince Arthur, heir to the throne, lifts his helm and bows his head to his father.#REF!

Goristro Encounter.name:
戈里斯托遭遇
Goristro Encounter

Text.text:
前方的黑暗在一抹昏暗的红光到来时渐渐消散——两只发光的眼睛死死盯着你。那生物发出震天的咆哮，双眼燃得更亮，照出它的面孔：巨大的牛头压在宽阔的人形肩膀上，鼻孔与口中垂落着一缕缕岩浆。硫磺般的恶臭与炉火般的热浪灌满你们之间的空间，牛头人低身蓄势，猛然冲锋。
The darkness ahead dissipates with the arrival of a dim, red light—two glowing eyes fixed on you. The creature emits a mighty roar and its eyes burn brighter, illuminating its face: a massive bull’s head stacked on broad, humanoid shoulders, nostrils and mouth dripping with strings of magma. A stench like brimstone and the heat of a forge-fire flood the space between you, and the minotaur heaves into a charge.

一位慵懒而威严的族长，鬃毛迎风自傲，嗓音如雷震荡，几乎整日卧在阳光里，身边环绕着草原真正的力量——狩猎的母狮。她们凶猛而护犊，合力扑倒巨大的猎物；到了傍晚，这些伟大的雌者用粗糙而宽厚的舌头，把幼小幼崽的耳朵舔得干干净净。诸国将这支狮群奉为象征，徽章上也描绘着它，但世上再没有任何动物能展现同等的雄伟。
A great lazy patriarch, proud of the wind in his mane and the thunder of his voice, lies in the sunshine most of the day surrounded by the true power of the savannah—hunting lionesses. Fierce and protective, pulling down giant prey, in the evening the great women lick clean with rough, broad tongues the ears of tiny cubs. Nations adopt this pride, crests emblazoned with it, but no other animal in the world exhibits this same majesty.

A Druid’s Lament About Anxiety.name:
一位德鲁伊对焦虑的哀叹
A Druid’s Lament About Anxiety

Text.text:
“仿佛我的脑海里住着一群暴怒的蜜蜂。我每向前迈一步，它们就嗡嗡作响、窃窃低语，索求更多，提醒我：我做到的最好也仍不够。可在它们纷乱的辱骂里，总夹着一粒真相……也正因如此，我害怕自己永远也摆脱不了它们。”
“It’s as if my mind is home to a swarm of angry bees. Every step I take forward, they buzz and whisper, demanding more, reminding me that my best is not enough. Yet, in their flurry of insults, there is always some grain of truth… and for that reason, I fear I will never be rid of them.”

翠绿的帷幕笼罩着河畔参天巨木，枝蔓如梦游者自舟边垂下的手，在清凉起伏的水波中慵懒漂荡。藤影之下，一户河上人家栖身其间，伟岸的树木披着天鹅绒般的外衣，将他们护在怀里。
Viridian curtains shroud the huge trees along the river, their tendrils drifting lazily in the cool, undulating waters like a daydreamer’s hand from a boat. Beneath the vines, a family of river dwellers shelter, protected by the mighty trees in their velvet cloaks.

醉汉踉跄摇晃着走了几步，随即一屁股盘腿坐下。他费力支撑着仿佛重得抬不稳的脑袋。眼皮沉得不像话，怎么也抬不全，只得把头往后仰，半眯着眼。可这一步却是大错特错——他“咚”地一声向后栽倒，长长呼出一口气，酒臭浓得几乎能看见。
The drunk takes a few swaying steps and then drops to a cross-legged position. They struggle with a head seemingly too heavy to hold steady. Their eyelids weigh far too much for them to lift fully, and they resort to tilting their head back with eyes half shut. This proves a dire mistake. They topple backward with a thud and exhale a great breath so full of the stink of alcohol you can almost see it.

Campfire Portal Ambush.name:
篝火传送门伏击
Campfire Portal Ambush

Text.text:
营火与林间声响一齐沉寂。火焰凝滞，转作紫色，向上延伸，化作一片狭长的光之位面。其中央一线漆黑，宛如异界之眼的瞳孔——却旋即凝聚成一道人形：黑袍裹身，猛然前扑，从熟睡的伙伴之间一把攫走唯一清醒的露营者。两者扭打，露营者发出一声尖叫，惊醒其余人。他们慌乱爬起，只见同伴与那披影的掳人者一同没入紫罗兰色的传送门，转瞬消失。门中光辉忽明忽暗又骤然炽亮；影子变得锐利而被拉长。受惊者脚下的半影仿佛生出阴险神态，带着不自然的自立之意——随着传送门闭合，火焰被掐灭。黑暗吞没营地。

~ Envisioned by RoguishONE

The campfire and forest sounds go silent. Flames still and turn purple, extending upward to form an oblong plane of light. A black line in its middle makes it look like the pupil of an otherworldly eye, but it coalesces into a figure, robed in black, who lunges forward and snatches the one wakeful camper from amid sleeping companions. The two struggle and the camper lets out a scream, awakening the others. They scramble as their companion fades into the violet portal with the shrouded abductor, and the two disappear. The portal’s radiance flickers and brightens; shadows sharpen and elongate. The penumbras of the shocked campers take on a sinister seeming and unnatural independence as the portal closes, snuffing the fire. Darkness engulfs the campsite.

~ Envisioned by RoguishONE

Comfortable Morning At Camp.name:
营地的惬意清晨
Comfortable Morning At Camp

Text.text:
旭日迎面而来，你睡眼惺忪地从帐篷里钻出，踏入清冷的晨风。噼啪作响的篝火把寒意从骨头里驱散，新煮咖啡的香气勾着你摆脱倦怠，落座歇息。荒野在你四周铺展开来——一片来自被遗忘年代的未染奇境，晨露闪烁——也蕴藏着无尽可能。#REF!
The sunrise greets you as you emerge, bleary-eyed, from your tent and into the chill morning air. The crackling fire warms your bones and the scent of freshly brewed coffee coaxes you from your lethargy as you take a seat. The wilderness stretches out around you, an untouched wonder from a forgotten age glistening with morning dew—and endless possibilities.#REF!

蛛形怪僵在蛛网间，仿佛被不安击中。它停下织网的动作，八只受辱的眼睛寒光闪烁，带着被打断创作的艺术家般怒火直刺你。它那粗硬绒毛覆盖的腹部一阵阵鼓动脉动，发出无声的警告。
The arachnid stiffens in its web, struck with disquiet. It pauses the progress of its web making, eight affronted eyes gleaming at you with the fury of an artist interrupted. Its coarsely fuzzed abdomen pulsates with warning.

I Throw My Ivory Goats Figurine Of Wondr.name:
我掷出我的奇物之力象牙山羊雕像，召唤一只旅途山羊
I Throw My Ivory Goats Figurine Of Wondrous Power To Summon A Goat Of Traveling

Text.text: 我掷出我的小雕像，意念催动三者中最小的那只现身。它落地发出一声哒哒，随之响起一阵古怪却带着旋律的咩鸣。一只山羊现出身形，毛发长而金黄如麦穗，身量却有小马般高大；它轻轻“哒哒”踏来，几步轻跃就到了我身旁。我小心避开从它狭长面孔两侧卷出的尖黑角，伸手掠过它覆着绒毛的鼻吻，轻轻拍了拍。它以一声高亢的咩叫回礼，粉红的舌头扑扇乱晃。 I throw my figurine, willing the smallest of the trio to appear. It lands with a clop and an oddly melodic bleat. A goat with hair as long and gold as wheat, with the stature of a pony, clip-clops over to me in a few easy lopes. Taking care to avoid the pointed black horns curling out of its narrow face, I pass my hand over its fuzzed snout for a gentle pat. It returns the gesture by bleating loudly, pink tongue flapping.

一把金色镰刀在你一手中闪耀；另一只手里，你托着一枝槲寄生——在满月之下采撷而来。你以心与灵向外触及，意识如根须般探入大地深处。自然是狂野而古老的存在——并非供你号令，而是一股必须周旋、安抚的力量。槲寄生骤然迸发出银白的火焰，契约就此封定：薄雾如羽拂过空气，百年积蓄的葱茏在你周身蓬勃涌现，鲜活而奇迹般苏醒……静候你的引领。
A golden sickle gleams in one hand; in the other, you bear a sprig of mistletoe, harvested beneath the full moon. You reach out with your mind and spirit, your consciousness sinking into the earth with rootlike tendrils. Nature is a wild, ancient thing—not yours to command, but a power to treat with and appease. The sprig of mistletoe bursts into silvery flames, and the compact is sealed: mist feathers the air, and a hundred years' worth of greenery springs to vibrant and miraculous life around you… awaiting your guidance.

Divine Sewers Of A Goddess Of Disease.name:
疫病女神的神圣下水道
Divine Sewers Of A Goddess Of Disease

Text.text:
废物的堆积之处于她，正如花朵之于蜜蜂，旅店之于旅人。那令人窒息的死亡与排泄之气，是她的香水。她那半凝的床榻在农场旁一条小溪的回流里，满是蚊与苍蝇的幼虫。她的厨房里盘踞着一团蠕虫、一群横行的老鼠，在城市之下隧道的闷热里兴旺滋长。战场的粪坑、从屋里倒出的粪桶、骑在狗身上的蜱虫：这些便是她穿行文明的马车与御轿。
The repositories of waste are to her as flowers to bees or inns to travelers. The choking aroma of death and excretion is her perfume. Her semi-solid bed is in the eddy of a creek near a farm, full of mosquito and fly larvae. Her kitchen, home to a clew of worms and a mischief of rats, thrives in the close heat of a tunnel under a city. Battlefield latrines, buckets dumped from houses, ticks riding dogs: these are her carriages and royal litters through civilization.

Outpost East Tower.name:
东侧前哨塔
Outpost East Tower

Text.text:
这座塔楼内嵌在城门墙后方，牢牢嵌入一旁陡峭的崖壁之中。从高处望去，塔顶甲板上摆着一只储物箱与一道通往塔内的舱口，角落里还架着一具狰狞可怖的弩炮。与它的姊妹塔一样，这里空间充裕，足以存放补给，并为大概两名守卫提供栖身之所。
This tower is built recessed from the gate wall and anchored to the steep cliff wall next to it. From an elevated position, the top deck of the tower can be seen to hold a storage chest and a hatch leading to its interior, along with the wicked looking ballista at its corner. Like its counterpart, this tower is large enough to house supplies and lodging for perhaps two guards.

Haunted House: Balcony.name:
鬼屋：阳台
Haunted House: Balcony

Text.text:
这座阳台的设计简峻克制，俯瞰着庭院中被精心打理的葱茏绿意，起初令人感官愉悦——直到你注意到栏杆上绕着一段腐烂的长绳。绳子末端打成一个绞索，显然曾被使用过，尽管不见尸体——只在附近留下几道痕迹，像是不幸的受害者曾拼命挣扎，试图把自己从绳套里拉出来。
The austere design of the balcony that looks out over the carefully maintained greenery of the grounds is pleasing to the senses, until you notice the length of rotting rope looped around the balustrade. The rope ends in a noose, clearly used although there is no sign of the corpse—save for some marks where the unfortunate victim attempted to pull themself free.

Ooze Domain: Scum-filled Tunnels.name:
软泥领域：满溅污垢的隧道
Ooze Domain: Scum-filled Tunnels

Text.text:
这些地道的恶臭几乎让人喘不过气。你不愿去想自己正踩在什么上面，可思绪偏偏挥之不去。为了不让脑子被它占满，你强迫自己把注意力放在四周，警惕可能的危险。然而污垢黏滑地糊在墙上，头顶的天花板滴落着腥臭的液体。
The stink of these tunnels makes it difficult to breathe. You don’t want to think about what you’re walking through, but you can’t help it. To keep your mind off it, you try to focus on your surroundings, alert for danger. But scum slicks the walls, and the ceiling drips foul liquid.

Grand Temple In The Sky.name:
天空大圣殿
Grand Temple In The Sky

Text.text:
远方的群丘上，一道巨大的阴影缓缓掠过。你抬眼搜寻天空中的源头，只见云海如床处，一座建筑正拔升而起——三座红褐色砂岩高塔并立。塔身满布窗洞，许多窗外还伸出阳台，像是直接从岩石里凿刻出来的。它逼近时，你才看清：基座是一整团庞大的泥土块，宽阔得足以托起这座神殿，边缘还长着几株棕榈，底下簇着蕨类。成群的鹤伴飞在侧，羽色从最纯净的雪白到暴雨般的铅灰不等；它们飞累了，便落入神殿阴凉的角落栖息。

~ Envisioned by Stellar

A massive shadow moves across the hills in the distance. Scanning the sky for the source, you see, rising from a bed of clouds, three towers of reddish-tan sandstone. Each tower is pockmarked with windows, many with balconies carved directly from the stone. As the structure looms closer, you see its foundation is a mass of earth large enough to support the temple and a few palm trees with ferns below. A flock of cranes, feathers ranging from the purest white to stormy gray, fly alongside the structure. When they tire, they roost in the temple’s shady nooks.

~ Envisioned by Stellar

Halls Of The Demon Lord.name:
恶魔领主的殿堂
Halls Of The Demon Lord

Text.text:
向下的阶梯陡峭逼仄，随着你一步步下行，一股令人作呕的气味迎面涌来：甜腻的熏香与腐烂尸骸的臭味交织，其间还夹着煤火辛辣刺喉的焦味。楼梯的石阶逐渐变作破碎的古老黑色大理石砖。入口处刻着一个臭名昭著的印记——一位恶魔领主的徽记。
The stair down is steep, and as it descends, a sickening smell rises to meet you: sweet incense and rotting corpses, the acrid scent of coal fire. The stone of the staircase turns to broken tiles of ancient black marble. The entrance is marked with an infamous sigil, that of a demon lord.

Temple To A Goddess Of Joy.name:
献给欢愉女神的神殿
Temple To A Goddess Of Joy

Text.text:
寺庙的石灰粉刷墙面上，绘着花朵、旋纹与层层波浪。敞开的殿门上方，一扇巨大的圆形彩绘玻璃窗将流动的斑斓马赛克投落在中央圆形大厅的地面上。环绕四周的女神图像中，她面带亘古不变的微笑，双臂高举，仿佛向“喜悦”本身虔诚祈愿。信众或为自身的欢欣献上感谢，或在圣职者的慈悲前寻求苦痛的解脱。走廊里弥漫着新出炉面包的暖香，一阵清凉的微风又捎来香草的甜润气息。
The limewashed walls of the temple are adorned with painted flowers, swirls, and waves. Above the open temple doors, a huge, round stained-glass window throws a drifting mosaic of color across the floor of the central rotunda within. Images of the goddess around the room depict a woman with an ageless smile, her arms raised, and in supplication to joy itself. Adherents give thanks for their joys or seek relief from their suffering from the kindness of the clergy. The aroma of fresh-baked bread fills the halls, and a cool breeze carries the scent of sweetgrass.

腐烂鱼腥味从一处参差嶙峋的洞口飘来——那洞穴藏在俯瞰栈桥的高原上。此地的空气以令人作呕的强度震颤着，仿佛现实本身也因独眼巨人般的幽深之中潜伏之物而惴惴不安。
The smell of rotting fish drifts from the jagged mouth of a cave hidden on a plateau overlooking the jetty. The air vibrates with a sickening intensity here, as if reality itself is somehow uneasy with what lies within the cyclopean depths.

I Cast Arcane Sword.name:
我施放奥术之剑
I Cast Arcane Sword

Text.text:
施法只需短短数秒，尽管打造这枚法术的铂金微缩品曾耗去更久——铜锌剑首镶成的细小柄头，一柄微型长剑此刻平平躺在我掌心。我编织咒言，令一片依其形而成的力之位面显现。它仿佛被战士之臂挥动般在空中划出一道练习弧光，静候我的号令，疾飞向敌。
The casting takes mere seconds, even though it took considerably longer to fashion the spell’s platinum miniature with its copper-and-zinc pommel, a tiny sword that now lies flat in my palm. I weave the words to manifest a plane of force shaped like the miniature. It cuts a practice arc through the air as if swung by a warrior’s arm, and awaits my command to fly to an enemy.

这个小小的木盒打磨得光润细致。盒内衬着红色天鹅绒，开有一格格卡槽，用来固定一整套精巧的工具。各种形状与尺寸的小锉刀、磨头、心轴、抛光轮与钳子占去了大部分空间。工具包里还有两把薄刃细锯、几把锤头各异的小锤、卡尺、镊子、一把黄铜直尺，以及一只微型手摇钻。一个带软垫的隔层里安放着珠宝放大镜，另一个隔层则收着一块细粒磨刀石。
This small wooden case has a fine polish. Red velvet lines the interior, with slots to hold an array of delicate tools. Small files, burs, mandrels, buffs, and pliers in a variety of shapes and sizes take up most of the space. The kit also contains two fine-bladed saws, little hammers with varied heads, calipers, tweezers, a brass ruler, and a tiny hand drill. A padded compartment houses a jeweler’s loop. Another holds a fine-grained whetstone.

一只小小的、毛茸茸的白色囊袋挂在一张宽阔而坚韧的蛛网上，微微颤动。抖动。接着，它腹部的一道褶痕啪地裂开——它们涌了出来，成百只淡灰色的幼崽，八百条腿的婴儿。它们一齐借风腾起，化作一团小小的云雾，随后在黑色魔法与饥饿中瞬间长大。肥硕的身躯竖起细刺，每一只都有一掌之长，轻飘飘地降下，一接触地面便立刻飞奔而去。
A small, fuzzy white sack on a broad, strong web quivers. Shakes. Then a crease along its belly cracks open and they emerge, a hundred pale gray babies of eight hundred legs. They catch the wind together in a little cloud, and then grow instantly with black magic and hunger. Bristling fat bodies, each the span of a hand, descend lightly and run as soon as they touch the ground.

I Use Empty Body.name:
我施展「空灵之躯」
I Use Empty Body

Text.text:
我合上双眼。吸气，呼气，我将气从肌肤引向体内中枢，又再度推回周身。每一次循环都把我的血肉推得更贴近心灵与灵性的领域。第四次呼气时，我的身体与物质世界错开了相位。我消失了。
I close my eyes. Breathing in and out, I move my ki from my skin to my center and back again. Each cycle pushes my flesh closer to the realm of mind and spirit. At the fourth outbreath, my body moves out of phase with the material world. I disappear.

Attacked Ship Destroyed In An Explosion.name:
遇袭舰船在爆炸中被摧毁
Attacked Ship Destroyed In An Explosion

Text.text:
炮声轰鸣，吞没了世间其余一切声响。浓烟与烈焰之间，船体被撕开一道道孔洞与沟槽——每一道都标记着冷硬铁丸不屈的轨迹，贯穿甲板、桅杆与船帆。船身猛地一歪。紧接着，自吃水线下传来一阵剧烈震颤，一团火球向外鼓胀，将船壳从海面硬生生顶起。继发爆炸接连炸裂，震碎龟裂的主甲板与船腹中段。碎裂的木板、折断的武器、被撕扯的尸体与惊惶的人群一并坠入翻涌的海里。最终，这艘残破不堪的船只两端缓缓分离，沉入起伏的浪涛。

~ Envisioned by Nik Hunter

The roar of cannons drowns out all other sound. Amid smoke and fire, holes and channels appear in the ship, each marking the path of unyielding balls of iron—through decking, masts, and sails. The vessel lurches. Then, from below the waterline, the ship shudders as a ball of fire pushes outward and lifts the hull from the sea. Secondary explosions shatter the cracked main deck and midship. Splintered wood, broken weapons, torn corpses, and panicked people plunge into the churning sea. Slowly, the separated ends of the ravaged vessel sink into the waves.

~ Envisioned by Nik Hunter

一个血肉般的幽灵（特征）短暂地闪烁着闯入视野，像是某具躯体向外爆裂般的残影。紧接着，它彻底显形——仿佛解剖学图谱与舰船钢材、含碳废料熔成一体。这个由内翻外的类人形态不仅仅是骇人可怖；你感觉它正在扭曲你周遭的空气。你的存在本身都变得不稳定。粒子忽隐忽现。你在脑海深处听见一声恐怖的尖啸：传送致死被捕捉下来的惨叫。
A fleshy ghost flickers briefly into view, something alike to a body exploded outwards. And then it becomes manifest, like an anatomist’s diagram fused with ship steel and carbonic scrap.
