It is not just horrific to look upon, this inside-out humanoid shape—it feels as though it is warping the very air around you. Your very being feels unstable. Particles disappear and reappear. You hear a horrifying scream inside your mind: the captured squeal of a teleportation death.

I Activate My Ioun Stone Of Agility.name:
我启动敏捷灵动石
I Activate My Ioun Stone Of Agility

Text.text:
为配合这份效果，我潇洒一转，让石子沿着指节滚过，随即利落一弹，将它送上空中。它仿佛在我头顶上方几寸、身前几尺处被什么接住。那深红的石子以刁钻的扭旋与回环自转着，同时绕着我的头颅盘旋。我施展一段小小的戏法，踏出几步急促的踢踏舞，而石子也随之共舞。毫无疑问，我的动作更快、更轻盈，脚步更灵，随时准备迎接挑战。
With a flourish to match the effect, I roll the stone over my knuckles and flick it neatly into the air. It seems to catch a few inches above my head and a couple of feet in front of me. It revolves, deep red, in a tricky pattern of twists and whirls while circling my head. I perform a little legerdemain, a quick tap dance, and the stone participates. Most certainly I’m quicker, lighter on my feet, ready for a challenge.

Corporate Astral Powder.name:
企业星界粉末
Corporate Astral Powder

Text.text:
你打开密封严实的企业包装，撕开那枚印着精灵翅纹的封蜡，抽出一板泡罩。里面是细如粉末的黄铜色颗粒，像被压实的砂砾——几乎不比塑料外壳更耀眼——却在一颗颗充满惰性气体的独立气泡里微微闪烁。这种精炼后的成分被裁成适配快速注入式蒸汽棒的尺寸，随时可以研磨成炼金制剂；而且比起亲自跑一趟妖精界去弄到原料，要安全得多。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

You open the hermetically sealed corporate pack, breaking the fairy wing–imprinted seal and sliding out a blister pack. Fine brassy grains of what looks like compressed sand—scarcely more reflective than the plastic casing—sparkle inside individual bubbles of noble gas. This refined version of the component is sized to load into a rapid-infusion vapor stick, ready to grind into an alchemical preparation, and a hell of a lot safer than a jaunt to the realm of the fey to get the raw stuff.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Cast Burning Hands.name:
我施放《燃烧之手》
I Cast Burning Hands

Text.text:
我双手张开，指尖与拇指尖相互接触，在两者之间勾出一枚黑桃般的轮廓。我以言语唤燃火焰，它随声成形，向前铺展成一面宽阔的火幕，将路径上一切可燃之物尽数点燃。
With my hands spread, I touch finger and thumb tips, forming the shape of a spade between them. I speak the flame into being, and it spreads forward into a broad sheet, igniting everything flammable in its path.

你轻轻推开别墅大门，一声温柔的铃响仿佛在宣告你的到来。一个神情愉快、面颊红润的矮人热情地迎上前来，他以娴熟得令人赞叹的精准操控轮椅，绕过小小的接待台，向你自我介绍——他是你的礼宾。带着一抹笑意——温暖明亮，恰似最欢迎归人的炉火——他接过你的行囊，示意你跟着他前往你的房间。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

A gentle chime heralds your arrival as you ease the villa doors open. A cheerful, ruddy-faced dwarf greets you warmly as he maneuvers his wheelchair around the small reception desk with expert precision and introduces himself as your concierge. With a smile—as warm and bright as the most welcoming hearth—he takes your bags and asks you to follow him to your rooms.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Sea-dweller's Nightmare.name:
海栖者的梦魇
Sea-dweller's Nightmare

Text.text:
你从一片浓密的海带森林里钻出身来——这里是你庇护者名下的一处领地——眼前铺展开珊瑚花园，其间散落着无数餐后遗弃的白骨。一群鱼从你身旁游过。洞口里逸出的气泡急急向上窜去，在压力变化中啪地破裂。四周尽是藏身之处：浑浊的海水，起伏摇曳的水草。忽然，沙与乱流轰然炸开，血色翻涌、挣扎乱舞，几条鱼瞬间消失——那些本该也可能是你的鱼——被猛地拖入洞中。

~ 构想：Squiiidd

A school of fish swims past as you emerge from a thick forest of kelp, on one of your patron’s estates, into coral gardens that are strewn with the discarded bones of many meals. Bubbles scurry upward out of the mouth of a cave and pop from the pressure change. You are surrounded by hiding places. Cloudy water. Undulating plants. Suddenly, in an explosion of sand and turbulence, blood and thrashing, several fish disappear—fish that could have been you—snatched into the cave.

~ Envisioned by Squiiidd

Metroplex Police Headquarters.name:
都会警察总部
Metroplex Police Headquarters

Text.text:
一排排桌面在这座蓝钢色的设施里泛着幽暗而明亮的光泽，仿佛火山玻璃。桌上搁着沉得像小公文箱的笔记本电脑、口袋大小的数据板，偶尔还有一只灰褐色的咖啡杯。穿黑蓝制服的警员在极简的空间里慢悠悠地踱步。执勤者腰带上挂着脉冲手枪与电击套索，防弹背心鼓鼓囊囊，塞满了闪光手雷、催泪气体信号弹，以及研发部门那些白大褂想出来的各式人群管制玩意儿。坐办公室的警员则随意把袖子卷到肘部，条形码般的腕部标记与各种义体增强那细如电线的血管纹路一览无余。一个戴着警监帽、配着深色墨镜的男人步履迅捷，径直走向一扇通往总部更深处的门，身后跟着一名神色焦灼的助理——对方穿着挺括的白色扣领衬衫。
The rows of desks shine as dark and luminous as volcanic glass throughout the blue-steel facility, bearing laptops with the heft of small briefcases, pocket-sized datapads, and the occasional taupe coffee cup. Cops mosey about the minimalist space in their black and blue uniforms. Pulse pistols and taser lassos hang from the belts of those on duty, their bulletproof vests laden with pockets for flash grenades, tear gas flares, and whatever manner of crowd control the white coats in R&D have dreamed up. The office-bound officers sport sleeves rolled up casually to their elbows, their barcoded wrists and the wirelike veins of various cybernetic enhancements on open display. A man in a captain’s hat and a pair of dark glasses walks with quick purpose toward a door leading deeper into the HQ, a harried assistant in a crisp white button-down in tow.

在这处交汇口，气流更强，熏香的气味也更浓。西侧矗立着一具巨大的灰石棺椁。棺盖断成两截，一半斜靠在棺首，另一半倚在棺尾。透过裂开的棺身，可以看见一个被殓布裹覆的巨人般身影蜷缩成胎儿般的姿势躺着。
The air current is stronger at this intersection, as is the incense odor. To the west stands an enormous coffin of gray stone. Its lid is broken in two, half leaning against the head of the box and half against the foot. Through the cracked coffin, a gigantic figure shrouded in funerary wrappings lies in a fetal position.

Loot From A Rakshasa.name:
来自罗刹（特征）的战利品
Loot From A Rakshasa

Text.text:
头巾滚落一旁，露出底下尖尖的猫耳，随即散开成暮色般分明的几抹色彩：粉、橙与黄。这件头饰似乎能唤起一种魅惑效果。被斩倒的恶魔还戴着一条金项链，链上垂着几颗巨大的玉珠。
The turban rolls away, revealing the pointed cat-ears underneath, and unravels into separate sunset hues: pink, orange, and yellow. The headwear seems to conjure a glamour effect. The felled fiend also wears a gold necklace with huge orbs of jade dangling from the chain.

I Cast Enhance Ability To Bestow Cat's G.name:
我施放【强化能力】，赐予【猫之优雅】
I Cast Enhance Ability To Bestow Cat's Grace

Text.text:
我一边低声吟诵法术的词句，瞳孔一边收缩成细长的竖缝，注意力紧紧系在掌心那片柔软的毛皮上。猫科的优雅开始雕琢我每一次移动。指尖轻灵、步伐无声，我完成法术，将「猫之优雅」赐予目标。
My pupils narrow to slits as I intone the words of the spell, concentrating on the soft patch of fur in my hand. Feline grace begins to shape my every movement. Light-fingered and light-footed, I complete the spell to bestow the Cat’s Grace.

你高声喊出一枚灌注秘能的音节，你的武器随即开始发光，绽放出仿佛神祇亲临般的炽烈神光。
Shouting a syllable charged with mystic energy, your weapon begins to glow, shining with the potent light of the gods themselves.

Stargazing Up At Two Moons.name:
仰望双月观星
Stargazing Up At Two Moons

Text.text:
双月各在不同相位：一轮将弯角探向另一轮正明亮盈满的月。小时候一定听过关于它们关系、善与恶的故事；也有粗俗的玩笑；课堂上还讲过为何一轮的反照比另一轮更苍白。你几乎分辨不出哪一轮更大，而它们彼此投下的阴影，让四下的暗影仿佛活了起来。重重月影从每一件物体上扇形铺开，彼此叠压成层层夜色，一道更淡、一道更深；一轮的月光又把另一轮的硬朗边缘轻轻揉软。
The moons are in different phases, one turning its horns toward another brightly waxing. There must be childhood stories of relationships or of good and bad, the vulgar jokes, the school lessons about why one has a paler reflection than the other. It’s impossible to tell which is larger, and their shadow throwing causes an animated playing of shade everywhere. Multiple shadows, one lighter than the other, fan off every object in overlapping night colors, one moon’s light softening the hard edges of the other’s.

一阵芬芳的风拂过草地——在午后阳光下，翠绿而完美。锻铁栅栏沿着蜿蜒穿过花园的石径两侧延展开来，园中繁花盛放，甜香扑鼻。树荫如同避难所，为人们遮挡炽阳。鸭子与其他水禽慵懒地漂在池塘上，偶尔一头扎入水下，叼走一顿唾手可得的餐食。远处不知何方，里拉琴的悦耳拨奏传入耳畔。恋人们躺在草地上欢笑低语，身旁是一篮被遗忘的野餐。
A fragrant wind rustles the grass—green and perfect in the afternoon sun. Wrought-iron fencing flanks the stone paths winding through gardens brimming with sweet-smelling flowers. Trees offer shade as respite from the sun. Ducks and other water fowl float lazily on the pond, occasionally dipping beneath the water to snag an easy meal. From somewhere in the distance, the pleasant strumming of a lyre reaches your ears. Lovers laugh and whisper as they lie on the grass, a forgotten picnic beside them.

Temple To A Goddess Of The Moon.name:
月之女神的神殿
Temple To A Goddess Of The Moon

Text.text:
这座穹顶神殿由光滑石材砌成，坐落在一处深水海湾旁。令人意外的是，在明亮的白昼里它几乎显得荒凉冷寂，散发着被遗弃的气息，仿佛随时会被拆除或改作他用。然而当夕阳西沉，殿内便回荡起献给女神的低声歌祷；她的光束从穹顶上无数细小的菱形窗孔间倾泻而入。一位月之女祭司身披精致——而暴露——的轻纱，推开大门，门后是一幕庆典：众人皆沐在淡淡的月华之中。
This dome temple of smooth stone sits near a deep-water bay. Surprisingly, it looks almost bleak in bright daylight, exuding a feeling of having been abandoned, ready for demolition or repurposing. But as the sun sets it fills with quiet song-prayers to the goddess, whose beams enter through the many tiny diamond-shaped windows cut into the dome. A priestess of the moon, clothed in fine—revealing—gauze, opens the door to a scene of celebrants, all clothed in a pale lunar glow.

绿皮的骑手跨坐在一头凶残的巨狼背上，二者皆是刚从厮杀中脱身，周身散发着一股格外野性的气息。地精纠结成绺的乱发油腻地垂在满是疤痕的脸侧，肮脏的发结里缠着骨头与羽毛。它龇咧的口中探出獠牙般的尖齿，猩红的双眼燃着原始而凶猛的光。它身披补丁累累、钉满铆钉的皮甲，将部族那不受驯服的残酷野蛮展露无遗。
The green-skinned rider sits atop a savage wolf, both fresh from conflict and exuding a distinctly feral aura. The goblin’s matted hair hangs in greasy locks about its scarred face, bones and feathers woven throughout the filthy tangle. Fang-like teeth protrude from its snarling mouth, while its piercing red eyes burn with a primal intensity. Adorned in patched, studded leather, it epitomizes the untamed brutality of its tribe.

Unsettling Room.name:
令人不安的房间
Unsettling Room

Text.text:
这个房间有种令人毛骨悚然的不对劲，可你偏偏说不清究竟哪里出了问题。没有显眼的陷阱，也没有暗藏杀机的阴森雕像；没有任何带着致命意图的神秘奥术符号或宗教印记。房间只是……错了。惴惴不安像一阵立起汗毛的冷浪掠过你的皮肤，某种无声的恐惧沉沉落在你身上，仿佛一只带毒的昆虫。

~ Envisioned by crunchyzombies on Discord

Something is deeply unsettling about this room, but you can't put your finger on the cause of your unease. There are no obvious traps nor ominous statues bearing hidden death. No mystical arcane or religious symbols laden with deadly purpose. The room is merely… wrong. Trepidation bristles across your skin in a wave of raised hairs, and a feeling of quiet dread settles on you like a poisonous insect.

~ Envisioned by crunchyzombies on Discord

I Activate My Ioun Stone Of Leadership.name:
我激活了我的领导之艾欧恩石
I Activate My Ioun Stone Of Leadership

Text.text:
这枚小石头像王冠上的宝饰般着色：雅致的粉与翠。它在略高于视线处缓缓绕行，既威严又蛊惑，牵引着我身边每个人的目光。我的皮肤仿佛都更细滑了，举手投足间不知怎的更显分量。衣服穿在我身上也更衬；而当我开口时，周围的人往往会侧耳倾听。
The little stone is colored like a diadem’s ornament: elegant pink and green. It turns slowly as it orbits just above eye level, both commanding and persuading the attention of those around me. My very skin feels smoother, my bearing more significant somehow. My clothes look better on me; and when I speak, those around me tend to listen.

Sundries From A Spriggan.name:
来自斯普里根的杂货
Sundries From A Spriggan

Text.text:
斯普里甘在枯萎时发出一声叹息，像秋日落叶般坠落，在你眼前瘫倒在地；他们的叶片转为褐色，一张羊皮纸从他们手中飘然坠下。你将其翻过来，发现那是一封褪色的情书。
The spriggan sighs as they wither, falling like the leaves in autumn and collapsing to the ground before you as their leaves turn brown and a piece of parchment falls from their hands. Turning it over, you see it is a faded love letter.

保龄球馆里，蜡的气味与除味剂混在一处；无摩擦的鞋底在寂静中发出吱呀一声，随即是被撞散的球瓶接连倾倒、碰撞的轰然连响。接待台后，一名头顶稀疏的店员穿着被汗渍浸透的制服，伸指戳着客服终端那块油污斑斑的屏幕。他那凌乱的八字胡里，还能看见干硬的旧食物碎屑。
The smell of wax mingles with deodorizer in the bowling alley, the squeak of frictionless shoes punctuating the silence, followed by the cascading impact of displaced pins. A balding clerk in a sweat-stained uniform pokes at the grimy screen of the customer-service terminal behind the reception desk. Flakes of old food are visible in his disheveled mustache.

Haunted House: Den.name:
鬼屋：巢穴
Haunted House: Den

Text.text:
尽管这间兽穴的陈设称得上舒适，可当那面占据整整一堵墙的冰冷、黑洞般敞开的壁炉深处传来缥缈笑声时，你很难再把注意力放在那张松软厚实的长沙发、手工雕刻的桌子或擦得锃亮的餐边柜上。那笑声一半嘲弄、一半痛苦，即便音量微弱，也丝毫不减其刺骨寒意。
Though the furnishings of this den would be considered comfortable, it is difficult to concentrate on the fine overstuffed divan, hand-carved table, or the well-polished sideboard in the face of the ethereal laughter coming from deep within the cold, yawning fireplace dominating one wall. Equal parts mocking and agonized, the laughter is no less chilling for its faint volume.

在漫长的比武跑道尽头，酒吧两侧，战马沉重如坦克——披挂也几乎同样严密——嘶鸣着，甩动头颅，前蹄踏地。骑士隐没在板甲与纹章罩袍之下，条纹鲜明，旗幡招展的长枪直指前方。号角响起，蹄声如雷沿着比武场轰然滚来，人群齐刷刷起身，屏住共同的呼吸。
At the ends of the long tiltyard, on either side of the bar, warhorses as heavy as tanks—and nearly as armored—nicker, shake their heads, and stomp their front hooves. The knights are invisible under plate mail and livery, striped and bannered lances aimed ahead. The trumpet sounds, the thunder of hooves rolls down the list field, and the crowd stands, holds its collective breath.

这枚朴素的银色指环能轻松套上任何手指，不受体型影响。你把它放在平坦的表面上，看着它像陀螺般旋转，仿佛永不停歇。除去这些逗趣的古怪之处，它似乎并不值钱。
The simple silver band slips easily onto any finger, regardless of size. You set it on a flat surface and watch as it spins, seemingly endlessly, in the manner of a top. Other than these amusing quirks, it appears to be of little value.

葱茏而略显荒长的花园环绕着这座朴素却宽敞的家宅。前院由一圈陈旧的篱笆围起，里面卷心菜、羽衣甘蓝、土豆与胡萝卜正冒出新芽。一条鹅卵石小径通向屋子的前门，每块石头上都刻着一个名字；门漆成刺眼的红色。砖砌烟囱里袅袅升起炊烟，浓郁的炖肉香气钻入你的鼻腔。
Gardens, verdant and somewhat overgrown, surround this humble yet spacious home. A worn fence encircles the front garden, wherein cabbage, kale, potatoes, and carrots sprout. A cobbled path, each stone etched with a name, leads to the house's front door, painted a garish red. Smoke curls from the brick chimney, and the rich scent of stewing meat reaches your nostrils.

这个符号是一枚繁复而神秘的徽记，是巨龙主权的昭示。它被刻入岩石之中，线条蜿蜒如蛇，又棱角嶙峋如刃，将这些生物的二重本质勾勒无遗——优雅与致命并存。
This symbol is a complex and mystical emblem, a demonstration of draconic sovereignty. Its design, etched into rock, is an amalgam of sinuous curves and jagged angles, paraphrasing the bifurcation of these creatures—both elegance and lethality combined.

剑身狭长、优雅而阴毒般锋利，自一枚精巧的圆形护手延伸而出，为持用者的手提供盾牌般的遮护。这段钢刃长逾一臂，最厚处却也不过匕首般宽窄。
Narrow, elegant and wickedly sharp, the blade extends from an intricate rounded guard, which shields the hand of the wielder. The length of steel is longer than an arm, but as wide as a dagger at its thickest point.

这类类人生物的身躯覆着坚韧的鳞皮，拖着一条粗壮的尾巴，活像鳄鱼一般；但它的头颅——尽管牙列森然、依旧爬行类般骇人——却更近似人形。它以一面布满尖刺的甲壳作盾，仿佛取自你从未见过的某种龟类；另一只手则握着一根凶相毕露的棍棒——木柄紧扎着一块光滑的石头。
This humanoid’s body is covered in tough, scaled skin and bears a thick tail, much like a crocodile, but its head—although frighteningly toothy and still reptilian—is much more manlike. It uses a spikey shell as a shield, seemingly from a tortoise you’ve never seen before; in its other hand it holds a wicked-looking club made from wood lashed to a smooth stone.

泥浆与粪便被夯实压紧、晒干成形，筑出一座桶状的屋体，上覆以茅草编织的草顶。尽管它只会维持一两年——视雨季而定——这间朴素的居所仍为住户遮风挡雨，提供一处可称为家的栖身之所。
Mud and dung have been compacted and dried to form a barrel-like structure topped by a thatched roof of woven grasses. Though it will only last a year or two—depending on the rainy season—the simple dwelling provides shelter from the elements and a place to call home for its residents.

打开后，这只巨大的漆面箱柜露出三层隔间。较大的那格里整齐叠着上等衣物、一只小皮袋，还有——从气味便能辨出——用灯心草裹着的肥皂。一个小隔间放着一只敞口托盘，里面有纸张、笔、墨水、一截红蜡封、油灯，以及数只陶制小瓶。另一个小隔间里塞着几只皮革包裹的圆筒——用来装卷轴或地图的筒匣。
When open, this large, lacquered coffer has three compartments. The larger one contains fine clothes, a small leather pouch, and, from the smell, soap wrapped in rushes. One small section holds an open-topped tray with paper, pens, ink, a stick of red wax, an oil lamp, and clay flasks. The other small compartment contains leather-wrapped cylinders—cases for scrolls or maps.

I Use Gaze Of Two Minds.name:
我使用「双心凝视」
I Use Gaze Of Two Minds

Text.text:
我把手搭在他们的肩上。仿佛被电击般，我的身体猛然僵直，头向后仰。双眼翻白，只剩眼白可见。随后我放松下来，心神开始借由他们的感官观察世界，并逐渐习惯这截然不同的视角。维系这条感官纽带需要耗费我大部分的心力。
I lay my hand on their shoulder. Like I’ve been shocked, my body goes stiff, and my head goes back. My eyes roll up, leaving only the white visible. Then I relax as my mind begins observing the world through their senses and grows accustomed to the difference in perspective. It takes much of my effort to maintain this sensory link.

A Shadow Dragon Flees.name:
暗影巨龙遁逃
A Shadow Dragon Flees

Text.text:
一声如女妖般的尖啸撕裂潮湿的空气，惊得鸟兽从枝叶间四散奔逃。两道漆黑的影子从你头顶掠过，狂猛的气流撼动林木。你抬头望天，看见一场追逐：一头满身棘刺、展开黑色蹼翼的生物正仓皇逃窜，身后拖着一串闪烁的蓝色鳞光——巨龙！蓝龙嘶鸣，喉间噼啪作响，正蓄势喷吐灼热的龙息。黑龙随即咆哮回应，声音如荒原长风掠过。它将双翼紧紧贴住身躯，头朝下俯冲，一头扎进湖里。大地随之震颤，巨龙在一阵咸涩浑浊的水涡中消失无踪。蓝龙喷出闪电吐息，炽亮的电光灼烧湖面，掀起滚滚蒸汽。电流在水面噼啪游走。蓝龙在上空盘旋，双眼搜寻湖面——但黑龙再也没有出现。

~ Envisioned by Raetheriel

A banshee-like shriek tears through the humid air, sending birds and beasts scattering from the foliage. Two dark shadows flash over you and a powerful gust shakes the trees. You look to the sky and see a pursuit: a spiny creature with webbed black wings fleeing a glimmering train of blue scales: dragons! The blue dragon cries, throat crackling as it prepares its searing breath. The black dragon howls in response, its voice like a wind across a moor. It clasps its wings tight against its body and dives, snout-first, into a lake. You feel the earth shake as the dragon disappears in a swirl of brackish water. The blue dragon hisses out his lightning breath, blazing the lake and sending up great billows of steam. Electricity crackles across the surface of the water. The blue dragon circles above, eyes scanning the surface—but the black dragon does not reappear.

~ Envisioned by Raetheriel

Threat About The Voices Of The Fallen.name:
关于殒落者之声的威胁
Threat About The Voices Of The Fallen

Text.text:
“我记得我杀过的每一个人的声音。在我脑海里，他们扭动、吟唱，像某支疯癫乐团的乐器。我倒想知道，你的嗓音会添上怎样的音符？”
“I remember the voices of every person I slay. In my mind, they writhe and sing like instruments of some demented orchestra. I wonder what notes your voice would add?”

刺鼻的臭氧锐味充斥空气，能量在你指间汇聚翻涌。你潇洒一甩，竟将一束闪电攥在手中，宛如长鞭。电光弧线倏然抽向你的目标，灼烧的电缆般缠绕上他们的四肢；你猛地一拽收回电鞭——连同目标也被一并拖拽着呼啸而来。

~ 一位英雄所构想

The sharp, acrid scent of ozone fills the air as the energy builds between your fingers. With a flourish you grasp a lash of lightning as if it were a whip. The lightning arcs outward toward your target, and as it wraps its burning coils around their limbs, you snatch the lash back—and the target comes hurtling with it.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Plain Platinum Brooch.name:
朴素的铂金胸针
Plain Platinum Brooch

Text.text:
这枚胸针的制作者似乎既是数学家，也是艺术家。它的对称无可挑剔，结构严丝合缝，仿佛在宣告：唯有金属本身，便足以将这份简洁淬炼成美。
The maker of this brooch seems to have been as much a mathematician as an artist. Its symmetry is perfect, its construction exact, as if to say its simplicity was made beautiful by virtue of the metal alone.

Invitation From An Evil Emperor.name:
邪恶皇帝的邀请
Invitation From An Evil Emperor

Text.text:
“也许有一天，你也能像我一样看清这个世界——停滞、腐朽，正在走向死亡。若想拯救它，就必须迅疾而暴烈地改变。或许会有人死去，但他们的尸骨将成为我们新世界的灰浆与砖石。”
“Perhaps one day you’ll be able to see this world as I do. A place stagnant and dying. One that demands quick and violent change if it is to be saved. Lives may be lost but their bodies will form the mortar and brick of our new world.”

Empty Lava Tube.name:
空熔岩管道
Empty Lava Tube

Text.text:
这座洞窟在大地深处起伏蜿蜒，宛如皮下的一条血管。波浪般的岩壁向上拱起，汇成圆形穹顶，顶面忽高忽低，却始终大致维持在同一高度。地面平坦无碍，向前延伸至远方，也向两侧铺开，在墙根处轻轻漫上岩壁。这个细节让你想起最初的念头，你猛然意识到那判断有多准确——这条隧道的确像血管，只是曾在其中奔涌的“血液”，是岩浆。
This cavern ripples through the earth like a vein beneath the skin. Its wavy walls rise up to create a round roof that bucks up and down but stays roughly the same height. The floor is flat, both out into the distance and to the sides, where it laps up the walls. This detail reminds you of your first thought, and you realize with a start how right it was. This tunnel is like a vein, but the blood that flowed through it was magma.

Crying Bloody Tears.name:
泣血流泪
Crying Bloody Tears

Text.text:
你的双眼骤然涌起灼热的暖意，泪腺刺痛，视野被抹成一片模糊。你所能见到的只剩不同深浅的红色影块：从明亮的绯红一路沉到猩红，再到仿佛凝结的深紫红。泪水浸湿了你的脸颊，渗进嘴里，舌尖泛起铁锈般的味道。鲜血——血泪沿着你的面颊淌下，拖出一条条黏腻的红色痕迹。
Your eyes suddenly brim with warmth, your tear ducts stinging and vision smudging. All you see are blurred shapes in different shades of red: bright cardinal to crimson to clotting burgundy. Your cheeks are wet with tears, which seep into your mouth, and you taste iron on your tongue. Blood—tears of blood stream down your face, leaving sticky red trails.

地霜铺展，带来冬将至的预感。沉默咬住你的唇；某种古老之物正逼近。它宛如幽影的性相——精灵般的远古之风凝成了形体。它光辉的额顶戴着一冠雪花石般的寒冰，放射出刺骨的等离子，在空气中拉出一道道流动的光线。那亮度令人难以承受，如彗星坠击般轰然夺目。而在那泛灰的斗篷之下，两条完美的瓷臂向外触及。
Ground frosts with the feeling of an incoming winter. Silence bites your lips; something ancient is near. It is like the aspect of a specter, a fey ancient wind that has taken form. Upon its shining brow sits a crown of alabaster ice, radiating frigid plasma in lines of liquid light. Its brightness is unbearable, like the crashing of a comet. And from beneath the graying mantle, two arms of perfect porcelain reach out.

Elf Speech About Mortal Politics.name:
精灵谈论凡人政治
Elf Speech About Mortal Politics

Text.text:
“你们的政治真是怪得离谱。我感觉在过去三百年里，我看着你们的人翻来覆去就那五套争论。你们争吵、送命，而那一窝子领头的家族把你们来回拨弄，还把你们的粮食吃得一干二净。你们有没有想过把这一切写下来？”
“Your politics are so bizarre. I feel like I’ve seen your people have the same five arguments over and over for the past three hundred years. You argue and die, while the same family of leaders shuffle you around and eat all your food. Have you ever considered writing it down?”

Sundries From A Possessed Child.name:
附身孩童的零碎杂物
Sundries From A Possessed Child

Text.text:
一枚由细枝与麻绳编成的圣徽挂在她颈间。她用沾血的双手紧紧攥着一只纽扣眼的布偶，细小的指甲开裂崩碎、翘起木刺般的裂痕。布偶的裙摆被暗色脓血浸透——同样黏在她的嘴角、下巴与胸前。
A holy symbol crafted of twig and twine hangs about her neck. She clutches a button-eyed doll in her bloody hands, her diminutive nails cracked and splintered. The doll’s dress is stained with dark ichor, the same that sticks to her mouth, chin, and chest.

A Game Of Nine Pins.name:
九柱戏
A Game Of Nine Pins

Text.text:
九个九柱瓶是色彩斑斓、带条纹的雕刻木柱，形似瓶子，像士兵般挺立：列队成行，三柱一排，三排一列。另一端那条光滑的三十英尺球道上，玩家们笑闹起哄，揶揄着站在线上的那个人。他们手里握着一颗只比橙子大一点的球，出自一种名为愈疮木的非凡沉重木材雕成。
The nine skittles are colorfully striped carved wooden pins that resemble bottles and stand like soldiers: rank and file, three to a row, and three to a column. The players at the other end of the slick thirty-foot alley laugh and tease the one standing at the line. They hold a ball little bigger than an orange, carved from a remarkable heavy wood called lignum vitae.

Sundries From A Worg.name:
来自座狼的杂货
Sundries From A Worg

Text.text: 倒毙的野兽粗壮的肌肉脖颈上紧箍着一圈皮革与黑铁项圈，金属上还被人粗陋地刮刻着“Razurfang”这个名字。从这件物体的磨损程度来看，这头座狼显然被奴役已久。 The felled beast has a collar of leather and black iron fixed around its huge muscular neck with the word Razurfang crudely scratched into the metal. The worg had been in servitude for a long time, judging by the state of the object.

Kairon The Demon Lord.name:
凯隆，魔王
Kairon The Demon Lord

Text.text:
这头魔鬼几乎有成年人的两倍高，他恶意地咧嘴一笑，尖利的獠牙随之毕露。两柄长剑束在他的胯侧，交叉背负；一柄双刃巨斧斜斜挂在一侧肩头。他双手握着一把巨大到需要两名强壮凡人才能抬起的长柄镰刀，更别提将其自如挥舞。然而他握持之轻松，让你毫不怀疑——它斩下头颅会像农夫的镰刀割断麦穗与麦秆一样利落。察觉到你的不适，他展开皮革般的双翼，却并未尽展，以免妨碍夹击在他两侧的深坑魔护卫行动。你感到他邪恶的目光像实体般扫过你的全身——猩红与盲白的眼珠直刺你的灵魂，黑色犄角如冠冕般昭示着他对无数堕落灵魂的主宰。

~ Played by Cassanir

Standing at nearly twice the height of a fully-grown human, the fiend’s sharp teeth are revealed as he favors you with his malicious grin. Two longswords are strapped to his hips, crossed behind, and a double-bitted greataxe is slung at an angle over one shoulder. In his hands, he holds a scythe so large that it would take two strong mortals just to lift it, never mind wield it effectively. Yet, the ease he displays in holding it leads you to believe that it would part head from neck just as a farmer’s scythe would separate wheat from stalk. Sensing your discomfort, he flares his leathery wings, though not as far as he could, so as not to interfere with the movements of the pit fiend bodyguards flanking him. You feel his evil gaze sweep over you as if it were a physical thing, his crimson red and blind white eyes peering into your very soul, his black horns a crown proclaiming his mastery over countless damned souls.

~ Played by Cassanir

你面前，一名矮人哨兵稳稳立在风化的孤岩之巅，披着熊皮斗篷，专注地巡察眼前绵延的群山。他倚着一柄长柄战斧休息，斧刃布满凹痕，仿佛在诉说过往的血腥。狂风将发丝抽打在他脸上，他锐利的目光仍不停扫过荒野，搜寻迫近危机的蛛丝马迹。
Before you, a dwarven lookout stands braced atop a weathered tor, diligently surveying the mountainous expanse from within their bearskin cloak. They rest upon a long axe, its pitted blade telling a tale of violence. The wind whips hair across their face as their keen eyes scan the wilderness for signs of impending danger.

I Cast Hold Person Using My Focus Item.name:
我以焦点物品施放「定身术」
I Cast Hold Person Using My Focus Item

Text.text:
我接触我的法器，将魅惑之力导入其中，咬紧牙关，硬得连脖颈都开始发颤。紧绷的肌肉骤然松弛，能量随之倾泻进我的对手体内——伴着一记尖促的吸气与带气的低声咒叹，将那股紧张放大并转移。

[豁免成功] 虽然施法后我的颈项与肩膀逐渐放松，敌人依旧灵活自如。他们的意志赢下了这场较量。

[豁免失败] 当我放松的肩膀垂落时，我看见受我蛊惑的敌人骤然茫然。他们的身体一僵，背叛了自己，转而为我的魅惑效劳。

I touch my focus and channel the enchantment though it, gritting my teeth so hard my neck begins to tremble. My contracted muscles slacken, and the energy releases into my opponent, amplifying and transferring the tension with a sharp inhale and a breathy verbal exclamation.

[Successful Save] Though my neck and shoulders relax from the spellcasting, my enemy stays mobile. Their will won this contest.

[Failed Save] As my relaxed shoulders fall, I recognize my enthralled foe’s abrupt confusion. Their body stiffens, betraying them in service to my enchantment.

Hall Of Abjuration.name:
防护学大厅
Hall Of Abjuration

Text.text:
在这座冷峻而高耸的大厅里，人们操练护甲与防护结界。教授给学生下咒，再让其他学生解除诅咒。震耳欲聋的防护法术与低声吟诵、穿行于坚固材料之中的咒语在墙壁间回荡，撩动壁龛里的火炬。唯有那一声声因失败而发出的痛呼更为响亮。偶尔有人被轰飞到走廊里。
In this austere and lofty hall armors and wards are practiced. The professor curses students and has other students remove the curses. Booming spells of protection and whispered incantations of passing through solid materials echo around the walls and ruffle the torches in their sconces. Only the painful cries of failure are louder. Occasionally someone is blasted into the corridor.

I Use Wholeness Of Body.name:
我施展「肉体完满」
I Use Wholeness Of Body

Text.text:
虽说施展时若能像抹上清凉的药膏、如镇痛的香膏般令人安心就好了，但这其实是苦功。心灵正在完成通常需要器具、绷带或灵药才能做到的事。因此，我在自己的气里寻到那些工具及其疗效的全部能量——那结局早已千百次抵达，也终将再次抵达。我看着伤口顺从于圆满复原之道。
While it would be nice if this felt comforting as it was performed, like a balm or cool salve, it is hard work. The mind is doing what usually requires tools, bandages, or elixirs. And so I find in my ki all the energy of those tools and their result, which has already been reached thousands of times and will be reached again. I watch my wound give in to the way of wholeness.

Approaching The Lair Of The Titan.name:
逼近泰坦的巢穴
Approaching The Lair Of The Titan

Text.text:
钟乳石如獠牙般横挂在洞窟的巨口边缘——洞口宽胜于高，使入口看起来像一处巨型獾穴。你走近，探头向里望去，只见雾与影在深处交融，凝成一道幽暗的壁垒。随后，两团光球忽明忽暗地浮现，散发出火把般柔和的昏黄光芒。一声低沉、轰隆的叹息撼动大地，碎石在你脚边弹跳。那口气息愈发粗重，化作震骨的咆哮，两点光焰燃起、扭动，转为凶戾的猩红。

~ Envisioned by Orionxhavok

Stalactites hang like teeth across the cavern’s mouth—its shape wider than it is tall, giving the entrance the look of a colossal badger’s den. You approach, peering inside to where fog and shadow meld into a tenebrous rampart. Then, two orbs of light flicker into being, emitting the soft, yellow glow of torches. A deep, rumbling sigh shakes the earth, and pebbles bounce around your feet. The exhale grows into a bone-rattling roar, and the two lights burn and shift to a savage red.

~ Envisioned by Orionxhavok

I Polish My Scales.name:
我打磨我的鳞片
I Polish My Scales

Text.text:
我把布巾举到脸前，布料浸透了芬芳的香油。我在脸上轻柔地画着圈，细细打磨两颊。我笑了笑，试探那一抹微光；心满意足后，又移向下巴与额头。我的脖颈、手肘与双手也一并擦拭，揉去蜕鳞时留下的薄薄白屑，只让鲜亮的色泽独自留存。
I bring the cloth up to my face, the fabric soaked in a perfumed oil. With a few gentle circles against my face, I polish each of my cheeks. I smile to test the glimmer and, satisfied, move on to my chin and forehead. I polish my neck, elbows, and hands as well, rubbing away the thin white flakes of molting scale to leave only the vibrant color behind.

Blasted Warzone.name:
被轰烂的战区
Blasted Warzone

Text.text:
迫击炮弹尖啸着掠过空中，在大地上凿出新的弹坑。无数激光束在天幕下闪烁，成了这片棕黄沙泥、壕沟纵横、焦黑弹孔遍布的荒原上唯一的颜色。喊杀声几乎被喧嚣吞没。一个个细小的黑影朝着另一些穿着不同制服的黑影开火。履带车碾压前进的刺耳摩擦汇成雷霆般的轰鸣——低沉、呻吟般的巨响，正是战场的交响。
Mortar fire whistles through the air and makes new craters. Countless lasers glitter against the sky, the only color in a brown-yellow landscape of sand and mud, dug trenches, and scorched holes. Shouts barely rise above the clamor. Little black figures shoot at little black figures in different uniforms. The grating of tread-track vehicles is a thundering sound—a deep and groaning noise, the orchestra of battle.

这枚圆润的结节呈匀称的椭圆形，通体是光滑的蓝黑色石质，宛如被砂砾磨蚀、失了锋芒的黑曜石。它的表面布满裂纹与缝隙，几处孔口还轻轻逸出细腻的黑色粉末。
The rounded nodule, evenly oval, is smooth blue-black stone, like obsidian dulled by scouring grit. Cracks and gaps line its surface, and fine, black powder wafts from a few openings.

Townsite At Massively Enlarged Bridge.name:
大型巨桥桥头镇
Townsite At Massively Enlarged Bridge

Text.text:
铁镐敲击金属的声响在林地间回荡，一座巨大的桥梁映入眼帘。桥身拱起，由陈旧的木料与粗大的木钉搭成，这道渡桥仿佛出自泰坦之手，全然不顾脚下那条狭窄的河流被它阴影笼罩。四周，参天巨树巍然耸立。覆着过分厚重苔藓的巨石引导着水流，几乎将溪水堵死。在高耸的树干与庞大的岩块之间，还能看到低矮、弧形的金色墙垣。无数人正挥镐凿金，另一些则把金子装车，运往更远处沿路那座摇摇欲坠的镇子。

~ 构想：Mitch Prince

The sounds of picks on metal echo through the woodland as a colossal bridge comes into view. Arched and made of aging wood and massive pegs, the crossing seems fashioned by a titan’s hands with no regard for the narrow river it overshadows. Around it, titanic trees tower. Monumental stones, clad in outsized moss, channel the stream, almost blocking the flow. Low, curved walls of gold can be seen between the towering trunks and enormous rocks. Numerous folk hack at the gold, while others cart it to a ramshackle town farther along the way.

~ Envisioned by Mitch Prince

溪流凿刻山体，山峦回以抗拒，留下的形状便成了水之声的模具。它虽细小，却喧响异常——在更大的岩石间放声穿行，又在卵石缝里咕噜作响。回旋的水洼与平缓的浅滩呈铜色，越过石间障碍与层层跌水时又化作白与浅褐。日光明亮处，一尾鱼跃起、翻身，随即消失在溪流的乐声里。
The stream carves the mountain and the mountain resists, leaving the shapes that create the water’s voice. Small as it is this one is loud—bold over the larger rocks and bubbling through the pebbles. It is copper colored in the eddies and flat bottomed stretches, white and tan over the stone obstacles and cascades. Bright in the daylight, a fish jumps, flips, and disappears into the music of the stream.

Yuan-ti Temple Covered In Fungus.name:
被真菌覆盖的羽蛇神神庙
Yuan-ti Temple Covered In Fungus

Text.text:
石砌神殿以战斗的浮雕装点其身，甚至连败绩也被刻下；那些功勋卓著的历史强者高高矗立，俯视其余一切——却从地到顶都被真菌、地衣与霉斑略略遮蔽。神殿地面尽头，一群身影聚集。他们半蛇半人形，上身从松散盘绕的蛇躯中挺起，围着一座祭坛而立。他们的吟唱充满威胁，向黑暗身影的祈祷在火把般的光影里投下多重蛇首之影，仿佛层层叠叠。墙边两名囚徒被铁链拖得身子下垂，已然溃败。真菌沿着他们的伤口蔓生。

~ 构想：Talwyn

The stone temple is decorated with carvings of battles, even defeats, with powerful figures of historical merit standing tall over the rest—all slightly obscured by fungus, lichen, and mold from floor to ceiling. At one end of the temple floor, a group is gathered. They are half snake, half humanoid, their upper bodies rising on loose coils and standing around an altar. Their chant is menacing, their prayer to a dark figure casting multiple snake-head shadows as if thrown from torchlight. Two prisoners against the wall sag in their chains, defeated. Fungus grows over their wounds.

~ Envisioned by Talwyn

寂静被一声刺耳的尖啸撕裂，一只狮鹫俯冲而下发动攻击，以灼人的速度划破天穹，双翼如覆羽的剃刃般切开空气。它流线般的狮躯下肌肉虬结隆起，双眼燃起彻骨的憎恨，喙张开，欲撕裂啃噬。
The silence is broken by a shrill scream as a griffon plummets to attack, streaking through the sky with blistering velocity, its wings slicing through the air like feathered razors. Muscles bulge beneath its sleek, leonine form, its eyes blaze with utter hatred, and its beak opens to rend and tear.

I Cast Lightning Bolt.name:
我施放闪电箭
I Cast Lightning Bolt

Text.text: 我双掌相搓，电光在指间噼啪跃动，刺得皮肤发麻，仿佛把骨头都点燃。我像是在拽一段绳索般向后猛地一扯身子，随即双手猛然前推，伴着震耳欲聋的CRACK!，一道闪电怒啸而出。强光刺得我视线一阵模糊。空气里弥漫起灼烧的焦臭，闪电沿途撕裂一切，留下滚烫而凶烈的破坏痕迹。 I rub my palms together and electricity crackles over my hands, tingling my skin and setting my bones aflame. I reel backward as if tugging on a length of rope, then thrust my hands forward, sending out a bolt of lightning with an ear-splitting CRACK!. My vision blurs with the strength of the bolt’s light. A burning stench infects the air as the lightning wreaks searing havoc along its path.

Portal To The Divine Realm.name:
通往神域的传送门
Portal To The Divine Realm

Text.text:
没有传送门。就在你生命中最真切、最清醒的那些时刻——正当你觉得只能长叹一口气……你却发现自己已在这里，整装待发。
There is no portal. At the times when you are most present in your life, so right you just want to sigh . . . you just find yourself here, ready.

Falling Through Ice.name:
冰层坠落
Falling Through Ice

Text.text:
冰封看起来足够坚实，冰层厚实，几近不透明。可某种东西——一个气囊、被水磨出的裂隙，或是始终未曾凝结的冰晶——突然松脱崩开。他直直坠落，双手猛地扬起，脸上写满惊愕与怒意。
The freeze seems solid enough, the ice thick and nearly opaque. But something—an air pocket, a crack worn by water, or crystals that never bound—gives way. He falls straight down, hands flying up, face shocked and angry.

Quip By Underground Dweller About The Su.name:
地下住民对太阳的俏皮话
Quip By Underground Dweller About The Sun

Text.text:
“直到几年前我才第一次见到天空。你们这些人头顶着一颗巨大的火球还照样忙活日子，这我真是想不通。”
“I didn’t see the sky until a few years ago. How all you people go about your business with a giant fireball above you is beyond me.”

Weapon Repair Station.name:
武器修理站
Weapon Repair Station

Text.text: 这栋建筑与军械库遥相呼应，坐落在熔炉的另一侧。这里备有工作台与各式工具，公会成员可在此改装并修理他们的道具。此刻，一袋羽毛与半成的箭矢几乎淹没了工作台，而对面的桌上则堆满了手写的制羽教程。 This building mirrors the armory, sitting on the opposite side of the forge. With a workbench and various tools, guild members may use this station to modify and repair their gear. A bag of feathers and half-finished arrows currently overtake the bench, while the opposite table is laden with hand-written tutorials on fletching.

A Torn Page From Nuldy's Compendium Of I.name:
《努尔迪昆虫考奇辑》中的一页残破书页
A Torn Page From Nuldy's Compendium Of Insect Inquiries

Text.text:
在这片文明却又隐居的世界里，许多地区的社群都对臭名昭著的“粪甲虫”传说耳熟能详。这些怯懦的虫子却能令平民与冒险者同样心惊——它们是一场致命的虫灾。它们堆积起巨大的秽物囤积，天生具备将粪便点燃并以惊人精准投掷的魔法。任何东西一旦被这种燃烧的粪球击中，随即便会引发小型爆炸。单只粪甲虫尚可应付，但据说有一只就会有更多潜伏其后，而虫群更是一道诅咒。最好给这甲虫留足空间，并把你的茅厕保持干净。
In many regions of the civilized-yet-recluse world, communities are well acquainted with the infamous folklore of the Dung Beetle. These timid insects incite fear in commoners—they are a deadly infestation—and adventurers. Amassing large hoards of refuse, these beetles possess the innate magic to set dung on fire and fling it with amazing accuracy. Small explosions immediately follow something being hit by one of these flaming dung balls. A single Dung Beetle is manageable, but where there is one, there are said to be many more, and a swarm is a curse. Best to give this beetle plenty of space and keep your latrine clean.

Threat From An “Honorable” Party Member.name:
来自一位“高尚”队友的威胁
Threat From An “Honorable” Party Member

Text.text:
“要是我再软弱一点，我会当场把你宰了。算你走运，我这人讲究体面，所以我会让他们替我动手。”
“Were I a weaker man, I would kill you where you stand. Luckily for you, I am an honorable sort, which is why I’m going to let them do it for me.”

这处空间简朴、清寒，却温暖得令人安心——空气里香料的气息浓得化不开。厚重的橡木柜台后，一名矮人舀起浓稠滚烫的褐色肉汤，盛进木碗里，再配上一大块外皮酥硬的面包。食客们排着整齐的队列，感激地接过餐食，随后三三两两围在圆桌旁挤作一团，享受热气腾腾的进食时光。远处的墙上悬着一面旧旗，绘着某个被遗忘的矮人氏族徽记。
The space is simple, spartan, but warm and inviting—the air thick with spices. Behind a heavy oaken counter, a dwarf ladles a rich, steaming, brown broth into wooden bowls, serving it with a hunk of crusty bread. The diners form an orderly queue, take their meals with gratitude, then enjoy eating them clustered in groups around circular tables.  On the far wall hangs an old banner depicting the emblems of a forgotten dwarf clan.

Sundries From A Mindwitness.name:
拾遗：心证者的见闻
Sundries From A Mindwitness

Text.text:
那团可怖的异界生物——橡胶般的肉块——轰然坠地之际，一声凄厉尖啸直刺你的心智，仿佛利刃撕裂思绪，令你双眼在折磨般的重压下酸痛欲裂。片刻之后，那感觉渐渐钝去，你得以在生物渗出的黏稠烂泥般涎液池间搜寻任何值钱之物。你翻找出的，是几颗类人生物的头骨——像蛋壳般被硬生生敲裂，裂缘与骨面上刻着一圈圈环状的细密纹痕。
As the horrific aberration of rubbery flesh falls to the ground, a keening wail tears through your mind, causing your eyes to ache with agonizing pressure. The sensation dulls after a moment, allowing you to search nearby for anything of value amid the viscous pools of slime the creature exuded. Your search yields several humanoid skulls, broken open like eggshells and marked by ringed striations.

Mortally-wounded Warrior Awaits Death’s.name:
身负致命重伤的战士静候死神的拥抱
Mortally-wounded Warrior Awaits Death’s Embrace

Text.text:
你的四肢如今几乎派不上用场。你不再听从任何命令，只剩本能驱使着你向前踉跄；酸痛的双腿拖着你走向未知的命运。血与汗刺痛你的双眼，你感到死亡那冰冷的必然正沿着血管渗入全身——鲜血从十几处伤口汩汩流失。你合上眼片刻，忽然觉得皮肤上一阵暖意。灿然的阳光倾泻下来，沐浴着你日渐衰败的躯体；你继续前行，却发现周遭已然改换。脚下那浸透血的泥沼不见了，取而代之的是柔软、带着芬芳的草地，一棵树轻轻摇曳，像在温柔招手。你坐下，将后背靠上坚实的树干——明白自己再也站不起来——任由自己松懈下来。眼睫轻颤、意识将沉未沉之际，一名女子出现在你面前。她的眼睛盛着阳光，肌肤如沾露的青草。

~ 由 Ameria 在 Discord 上 Envisioned

Your limbs are almost useless now. Obeying no command but instinct you press on, aching legs carrying you to an unknown fate. Blood and sweat sting your eyes, and you feel the cold inevitability of death creeping through your body as blood leaks from a dozen wounds. You close your eyes for a moment and feel a sudden warmth on your skin. Glorious rays of sunlight bathe your failing body as you continue through changed surroundings. Underfoot, the blood-soaked mud has given way to soft, fragrant grass, and a tree sways invitingly. You sit enjoying the sturdy feeling of the trunk at your back—knowing you won't get up again—and allow yourself to relax. As your eyes flutter, on the edge of consciousness, a woman appears before you. She has eyes of sunlight and skin like dew-kissed grass.

~ Envisioned by Ameria on Discord

Friendly Tavern: Crowded And Thrumming.name:
友善酒馆：人声鼎沸，喧嚣震荡
Friendly Tavern: Crowded And Thrumming

Text.text:
你在晚餐最忙的时段来到酒馆，店里人声鼎沸：食客大快朵颐，酒客挤在吧台，乐师奏着曲子，甚至还有几位舞者随着旋律尽兴起舞。看着人们手里与桌上琳琅满目的菜肴，厨房想必同样忙得不可开交。你试着与侍者对上目光，可他们个个忙得脚不沾地，也实在情有可原。
You’ve come to the tavern during the dinner rush, and the place is abuzz with patrons eating, drinkers at the bar, musicians playing, and even a few dancers enjoying the music. The kitchen must be just as busy, given the variety of food you see in hands and on tables. You try to catch a server’s eye, but they’re all understandably busy.

I Hide In A Barrel.name:
我躲进一个木桶里
I Hide In A Barrel

Text.text:
陈啤酒的馊臭呛得我眼眶发酸，我蜷缩在潮湿、陈旧的木桶里。双腿早在不知多久前就因用力而灼痛——也许是身体在提醒我，这个藏身处糟透了。我尽量用细小而浅短的呼吸，免得那腐败、滞沉的空气钻进肺里。我必须在这里撑到追捕者放弃，否则要担心的就不止是酸痛的腿了。
The reek of stale beer makes my eyes water as I crouch in the damp, old barrel. My legs began to burn with exertion some time ago—perhaps my body trying to tell me this was a poor hiding spot. I try to take small, shallow breaths to keep the fetid, stagnant air out of my lungs. I must stay in here until my pursuers have given up, or I’ll have more to worry about than sore legs.

北境寒风啃咬着你裸露的皮肤，像食腐者在尸骸上细细啄食般，专挑你的鼻尖与耳廓下口。你牙关打颤，把斗篷更紧地拢在肩头。可下一瞬，有什么变了。一阵原始的警兆沿着脊柱窜起，你喉间涌上苦胆般的反胃感——凛冽的空气染上了新的性相：坟墓般致命的阴寒。你额头沁出冷汗，在黑暗中惊惶搜寻。然后你看见了。 树与树之间——不过几英尺之遥——一具佝偻的身影自阴影里凝成，猩红的双眼锐利刺入你，带着非自然的凝视，随即开始向你逼近。那生物冲来的速度与它庞大的体型与负载全然不符；它猛扑而至，口中爆出一声刺骨的嚎叫。

~ 构想：Inbal（Discord）

The arctic wind bites at your exposed skin, nipping at your nose and ears like a scavenger working its way through carrion. Your teeth chatter as you pull your cloak tighter around your shoulders. But then, something changes. A primal shiver of warning runs up your spine, and bile rises in your throat as the frigid air takes on a new aspect: the deathly chill of the grave. Sweat beads your brow as you search frantically in the darkness. Then you see it. Between the trees—only feet away—a hunched figure forms from the shadows, its piercing red eyes fixing you with an unnatural glare as it begins to move toward you. The creature's speed belies its immense size and bulk as it rushes toward you, a spine-chilling howl erupting from its maw.

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

一柄短而纤细的刀刃自厚实的护手前伸。刃身中央被一道狭长的血槽分开，笔直引向那致命的尖端。小巧的护手之后延伸出硬质皮革缠裹的握柄，末端收束于朴素的柄底。
A short, thin blade extends from a stout guard. The blade is separated in the center by a long thin blood groove, which leads down to its deadly point. A grip of hard leather extends behind the small guard, leading to a simple base.

Candle Of Diligent Labors.name:
勤勉劳作之烛
Candle Of Diligent Labors

Text.text:
你将燃烧的火把火焰接触蜡烛的一端，又移到另一端，点燃它。灯芯吐出的烟缕开始向上攀爬时，你感到精神为之一振，仿佛一桶冰水当头浇下。可当蜡烛仅仅过了一分钟就燃到只剩一截蜡蒂，你又被一种难以言喻的倦怠吞没，仿佛刚从沉沉的深眠中被粗暴地拽醒。

~ 构想：RPGBOT.NET

You touch the flame of a burning brand to one end then the other of the candle lying before you. As the smoke from the wick begins to climb, you feel invigorated, as if a bucket of ice water has been dumped over you. And yet, once the candle has burned to a nub a mere minute later, you also feel an indescribable lassitude, as if you had been rudely awakened from a deep slumber.

~ Envisioned by RPGBOT.NET

这座恒星系的中心本该有一颗耀眼的太阳。可如今，只有一枚黯淡的灰色圆球悬在空间油腻般的漆黑之中；那颗被囚禁的恒星被高科技面板严丝合缝地彻底包覆，唯有病态的黄色光芒从缝隙间渗漏出来。许多面板上还附着着规模骇人的空间站与精炼系统——多半是为了处理从这颗被囚之星身上攫取的海量能量。
There should be a star at the center of this solar system. Instead, a dull gray orb hangs in the oily black of space, and only fragments of sickly yellow light leak out through the high-tech panels entirely covering the sun. Attached to many of the panels are vast space stations and refinery systems—most likely for processing the huge amount of energy being harvested from the imprisoned star.

Dolphins At Play.name:
嬉戏的海豚
Dolphins At Play

Text.text:
海豚线条流畅的蓝灰色皮肤在阳光下泛着光泽；它们一次又一次地破浪露出水面，盐雾飞溅，折射出七彩的晶亮光芒。至少有十来只，像一个整体般在水中疾掠穿梭，在起伏的浪头上划出悠长而舒展的弧线跃起。它们彼此喋喋低语，也对你发出声响；那狡黠的黑眸紧紧盯着你，仿佛在招手，催你追逐。

~ 一位英雄 构想

The sleek, blue-gray hides of the dolphins gleam in the sun, salt-spray sparkling with prismatic light when they surface—again and again. There must be a dozen or more, darting through the water as one, leaping in long, sweeping arcs over the rolling waves. They chatter to one another, and to you, as their cunning, dark eyes bid you to give chase.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

他注意到自己无可挑剔的西装外套上沾了一点污渍，矮个男人不屑地“啧”了一声，打了个响指。粉色烟雾绕着那块污点旋起，他嘴角一勾，看着烟雾与污渍一同消散成虚无，西装再度洁净如新。他逮到你在偷看，抬手梳过短短的爆炸头，痞气地眨了下眼。随即，一对纤薄、虹彩流转的翅翼在他背后舒展——粉得像他的眼睛，边缘渐褪成暮色般的黑。他振翅腾空——享受着聚拢人群的注目——在空中俯冲、翻旋，引来惊呼、兴奋与欢笑；他身后迸起一团团闪耀的棱彩烟雾，如烟火般绽放。

~ 扮演：Kyle Sabal，

Noticing a spot on his impeccable blazer, the short man tuts and snaps his fingers. Pink smoke swirls around the stain, and he smirks as it fades into oblivion, leaving his suit pristine once more. He catches you looking, runs a hand through his short afro, and winks roguishly, as delicate, iridescent wings—pink like his eyes, fading to dusky black—unfurl behind him. He takes flight—enjoying the attention from the gathering crowd—diving and twirling through the air to cries of alarm, excitement, and joy as puffs of sparkling prismatic smoke erupt in his wake like fireworks.

~ Played by Kyle Sabal with

她为另一位发明家效力——那是个靠一次划时代的突破就立名致富的男人。他几乎只是含糊地哼一声道别，她便在夜里继续留下来。她曾是个瘦弱的弃儿，直到教会替她安排了学徒身份。她的手指因日复一日地握笔、执圆规、操直角尺而酸痛发胀。随着她一步步逼近属于自己的发现，她也染上了些古怪癖性——永远穿同一身衣服，吃同样的饭菜，言语交流日渐枯萎。可一谈到她的工作，谈到明天，她的声音就会骤然亮起来，热情得像火。
She works for another inventor, a man who built his name and fortune on one breakthrough. She stays in the evenings after he barely grunts a goodbye. She was a waif until the church arranged her apprenticeship. Her fingers are sore from working with pen, compass, and square. As she closes in on her own discovery, she has developed eccentricities—the same clothes, the same meals, deteriorating communication. But she speaks enthusiastically about her work, and about tomorrow.

身披家族绚丽彩衣的骑手们绕着赛场疾驰飞奔。高耸看台上，粉丝们声嘶力竭地呐喊；他们钟爱的骑手呼啸掠过时，抛洒庆贺的火花，把嗓音投射得震耳欲聋、惹人生厌。骑手们彼此顶撞冲撞，试图抢占领先；与此同时，附魔的巨网也在空中飞掠，威胁着将那些反应不够快、来不及躲开的参赛者缠个结结实实。
Riders, garbed in the brilliant colors of their houses, race around the stadium. Fans holler from elevated stands as their favored riders zoom by, casting celebratory sparks and projecting their voices to obnoxious degrees. Riders bump and ram each other to try to take the lead, while charmed nets fly through the air as well, threatening to entangle racers not quick enough to avoid them.

阴郁与萦绕之气，光滑冰凉的肌肤与一头白发，在琥珀色双眸警觉的注视下微微回暖——她便是生与死之间那道锐利的锋刃。精灵般的面容、皮制护甲与绿色斗篷，将她裹进泥土般的色调里，也让她显得不知怎的更……真实可触。她像老练的游侠般行动，像潜行的追猎者，携着一张发出警讯的长弓。匕首与弯刀别在腰间，斗篷恰到好处地收拢——她既是盛放，也是枯萎。

~ 由 Alex Played，并附

Of gloom and haunting, of smooth cool skin and white hair warmed with the watchful gaze of amber eyes, she is the fine edge between death and life. Her elvish face, leather armor, and green cloak wrap her in earthen colors and make her somehow more… possible. She moves like a seasoned ranger, a stalker, carrying a longbow of warning. Daggers and scimitar in the belt, cloak tucked just so, she is at once a bloom and a wither.

~ Played by Alex with

一股骇人的“香水”猛地扑进你的鼻腔：新鲜血液的铜腥味、锈蚀铁器那反常的咸涩气息、未经清洗的躯体与秽物散发的恶臭，而贯穿其上的，是无可错认的恐惧腥臊。你几乎不用往房间里多看一眼，就知道里面摆着什么：笼子、带镣铐的锁链、布满尖刺的椅子、铁处女，以及那些本该只出现在铸造厂或肉铺里的器具。
An awful perfume assaults your nose: the coppery tang of fresh blood, the oddly salty scent of rusting iron, the foul stench of unwashed bodies and waste, and cutting through it all, the unmistakable stink of fear. You hardly need look in the rooms to know what they contain: cages, manacled chains, spiked chairs, iron maidens, and tools that would be at home in a foundry or a butcher’s shop.

这间昏暗的石室里，粗陋的床铺沿着两侧长墙一字排开；每张床都以木料与藤编草草搭成，好让睡者不必直接躺在冰冷的石地上。每张床旁都放着一只小小的脚边木箱；铺盖与背包散落在箱上与周围，凌乱一片。
Several rough beds line both the long sides of this dark chamber, each a construction of wood and wicker designed to keep a sleeper off the cold stone floor. Small foot chests accompany each bed; bedrolls and backpacks are strewn on and around them.

Game Of Kolven.name:
科尔文之局
Game Of Kolven

Text.text:
在一方结冰的池塘上，几名裹着厚羊毛的选手围观着另一人上前，走向一块侧躺在冰面上的小石质扁圆石。她挥起一根四英尺长的杆子，末端有个直角的“脚”。杆端击中那枚小巧的菱形石子，发出清脆的喀嗒声，石子便在冰面上滑行，朝着一个茶杯托盘大小的冰洞滑去。
On an iced pond, several players dressed in heavy wool watch another step up to a small stone obolid resting on its broad side. She swings a four-foot stick that has a kind of foot at a right angle. It strikes the little stone lozenge with a sharp click, and the stone slides across the ice toward a hole the size of a saucer for a teacup.

Threat From Local Busker.name:
来自本地街头艺人的威胁
Threat From Local Busker

Text.text:
“你也许以为我很难追上你，但等我打断你的腿，这就无关紧要了。”

~ 设想 来自 Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

“You might think it’ll be hard for me to give chase, but that won’t matter once I break your legs.”

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Study Of The Headmistress.name:
女校长的书房
Study Of The Headmistress

Text.text:
宏伟的门厅旁有一扇柚木门，上面雕刻着附魔师学院各个学院分院的纹章。门上没有把手，只会对当天的口令作出回应——要么宣告女校长暂不接见，要么愉快地说很高兴见到你，并自行开启。巨大的乌玉桌后，是一面书墙，环绕着一座小小的三段柴火壁炉。她那众多的使魔里有几只懒散地趴在办公室里，或蜷在客椅上酣睡。此地弥漫着难以置信的强大气息，显然是由装点其间的非洲与欧洲遗物共同产生的效果。
Off the grand foyer is a door of teak, carved with the sigils of every Enchanter Academy house. Without a handle, it responds to the day’s password, stating either that the headmistress is unavailable or is glad to see you and opening. Behind the massive desk of jet is a wall of books surrounding a little three-log fireplace. A few of her many familiars lounge around the office or sleep in the guest chairs. The aura of incredible power to this place is clearly the combined effect of African and European artifacts that decorate it.

The Forest Of Nephtali.name:
纳夫塔利之森
The Forest Of Nephtali

Text.text:
阳光穿过轻轻摇曳的枝叶，在你穿行尼弗塔利森林的道路上洒下斑驳光影。鸟儿欢快啁啾，在古老的树干与枝间来回掠动；林中小兽从前方小径慢悠悠踱过，对你的存在毫不在意。你目光扫过路旁灌木丛，忽然看见几处怪异的轮廓：断裂的马车轮、半埋的推车、以及碎裂的车轴。刹那间，一阵原始的寒意顺着脊背爬升——你被盯上了吗？

~ 构想：Kairion

Sunlight dapples the road through gently swaying branches as you make your way across the Forest of Nephtali. Birds twitter happily as they flit between the ancient trees, and forest creatures meander across the path ahead, indifferent to your presence. As your eyes scan the roadside you notice strange shapes in the undergrowth: broken wagon wheels, half-buried carts, and shattered axles. Suddenly a primal shiver creeps up your spine—are you being watched?

~ Envisioned by Kairion

I Ignite My Flame Tongue Longsword.name:
我点燃焰舌长剑
I Ignite My Flame Tongue Longsword

Text.text:
我吐出咒言，细小的橙色火弧便沿着剑刃跳跃起舞。我单手旋剑，催促那股热量膨胀成一层明亮炽烈的火幕，裹住剑刃锋利的刃口。召来的火焰饥渴地噼啪作响，我将剑尖指向我的敌人。
I speak the word and tiny arcs of orange flame begin to dance along the sword’s blade. I spin the sword in one hand, encouraging the heat to burgeon into a bright, blazing veil around the biting edges of the blade. The conjured fire crackles hungrily as I turn the point toward my enemy.

Weakened Prismatic Dragon.name:
虚弱的虹彩巨龙
Weakened Prismatic Dragon

Text.text:
在废墟之间，世间所有能想象到的色彩化作摇曳的光，泼洒在近处的断壁残垣上。那光仿佛源自废墟中心的一道轮廓，盘绕蜿蜒，如蛇般缠结——一条巨龙，或至少像巨龙的存在。它对凡人的肉眼不可见，却能从其闪耀鳞片逸散出的诡异棱彩之光中被察觉。巨龙深深呼吸，缓慢而沉重；尽管体型骇人、威势昭然，你仍能辨出这生物的虚弱之态。

~ 构想：Ghost

Amidst the ruins, wavering light of every imaginable color splashes across nearby surfaces. The light seems to emanate from a shape at the heart of these ruins, coiled and serpentine. A dragon, or at least something like it. It is invisible to the mortal eye, but perceptible by the strange, prismatic light its gleaming scales give off. The dragon breathes deeply, slowly, and despite its immense size and obvious power, you discern the creature’s weakened state.

~ Envisioned by Ghost

Sundries From A Froghemoth.name:
来自蛙巨兽的杂物
Sundries From A Froghemoth

Text.text:
一本缝合并用纽扣扣住的小册子，放在两栖生物背上斜挂的小袋里。每一页都夹着一只压扁的苍蝇，页边用粗涩的涂鸦和弯弯曲曲的线条点缀。
A booklet, sewn and buttoned, sits in a pouch slung on the amphibian’s back. On each page is a pressed fly, the borders decorated with scratchy doodles and squiggles.

微风柔和而宽容，你的话语从空气的湿润里唤出云朵——你的手势将它们聚拢，洁白而愈发浓密。你把它们塑成文字，在半英里之下用双手翻转描画，直到天空说出你让它说的话。

~ 一位英雄所构想

The breeze is soft and forgiving as your words conjure clouds from the air’s moisture—your gestures bringing them together, white and growing denser. You shape them into words, turning them with your hands from a half mile below, until the sky says what you have made it say.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

他的哭喊——勉强——穿透暴雨的鞭打与战场的金铁喧嚣。一个身披铆钉皮甲的男人，黑色卷发浸透雨水与血污，指甲抠抓着被践踏成浆的泥地。他拖着身子往前爬，胯侧豁开的伤口一路淌出猩红，下面那条腿软塌塌地失去知觉。他再一次把手臂向前甩出，抓住，猛地一拉。他龇牙嘶吼，放声尖叫。随后，仿佛凭空凝成的幽影，一名骑士自雨幕中迫近，泥泞与血渍玷污的甲片上迸溅着水花。一记自上而下的剑刺，便该结束了。然而胜者又刺了一下，又一下，又一下……

~ 构想：Tate.W

His cry carries—just—over the pelting rain and the clangor of battle. A man in riveted leather, black curls soaked with water and blood, claws at the trampled mud. He drags himself forward, the gaping wound at his hip trailing crimson, the leg below limp. He throws his arm forward again, pulls. He bares his teeth and screams. Then, like a materializing specter, a knight looms out of the rain, water spraying from muddied, gore-stained plates. With one downward sword thrust, it’s over. But the victor stabs again, and again, and again…

~ Envisioned by Tate.W

Cursed: Disadvantage On Ability Checks A.name:
诅咒：与敏捷相关的能力检定与豁免检定承受劣势
Cursed: Disadvantage On Ability Checks And Saving Throws Tied To Dexterity

Text.text:
你迈出一步便踉跄了一下，感觉自己一行动就可能把武器脱手，或把法术施放得一塌糊涂。要是只是喝麦酒喝醉了，起码还能算有点乐子。但这更阴毒。整个世界微微倾斜，像梦里的房子一样不合常理；当你举目瞄准时，只能凭直觉做出最好的猜测。
You take a step and stumble, feel as if you might drop your weapon or botch a spell as soon as you make your move. If you were drunk on ale, at least that might be a little fun. But this is something more sinister. The world is slightly off kilter, like a house in a dream, and when you aim you find yourself taking your best guess.

One Day Of Travel By Foot On Road.name:
在道路上徒步旅行的一天
One Day Of Travel By Foot On Road

Text.text:
你在黎明时分出发，沿着道路蜿蜒的轨迹前行。你与一名旅人擦肩而过，彼此交换了几句言语与方向，随后各自分道扬镳。你两次停下，只为匆匆吞下简陋的餐食，也让双脚得以休息片刻；可即便疲惫渐沉，你仍咬牙赶路。路旁的指示牌将你一步步引向目的地；当夕阳沉入远方丘陵之后，你终于抵达了目标。
You set out at dawn and follow the road's winding path. You pass a fellow traveler, exchange words and directions then go your separate ways. You stop twice for a meager meal, and to rest your feet, but press on despite your weariness. Signage directs you to your destination, and as the sun dips behind the distant hills, you reach your objective.

I Drink My Potion Of Diminution.name:
我喝下了我的缩小药剂
I Drink My Potion Of Diminution

Text.text:
我注视着这份魔法调制液那淡淡的粉色缓缓收缩，凝成一颗樱桃红的细小珠点——随即又猛然向外涨开——每次缩成一点时，都会迸出一声尖锐的哨鸣。我将它饮下，立刻感觉舌头与喉咙也发生了同样古怪的紧缩。我轻轻一叹，发出的声音又高又吱，像老鼠的细叫。药水在胃里沉了下去，伴随着几下仿佛心跳般的悸动；就在这段变化的过程中，我看见周遭的世界骤然放大了许多。
I watch the faint pink color of this magical concoction contract into a tiny cherry-red bead—then flood back out—a high-pitched whistle emitting each time it shrinks. I drink it and feel my tongue and throat perform the same, odd contraction. I sigh, my voice high and squeaky like a mouse. The potion settles in my stomach after a few heartbeat-like sensations, a process during which I see the world around me enlarge considerably.

Abandoned Cargo Ship.name:
废弃货船
Abandoned Cargo Ship

Text.text:
它像一头沉睡的巨人般横卧在你眼前：庞大而蛰伏，一枚灰黑色金属的巨型碎片悬停在墨一般的漆黑中，不放出一丝光。星舰的舰桥一片昏暗，引擎寂静无声。舷侧机库下方涂着识别标记。这艘货船看不出有任何伤害，但同样也没有任何移动，没有明显的生命迹象。
Like a sleeping giant, it lies before you: massive and dormant, a vast shard of gray-black metal suspended in the inky black, sending out no light. The bridge of the starship is dark, the engines quiet. Identifier markings are daubed beneath the broadside hangar. There’s no visible damage to this cargo ship, but there’s also no movement, no obvious signs of life.

Overheard Story About An Encounter With.name:
偶然听来的故事：与树民的一场遭遇
Overheard Story About An Encounter With Tree Folk

Text.text:
“我们当时在老林子那边运木料，可总觉得哪儿不对劲。平日里最是安静随风的叶子和枝条，这回却死寂得不自然。接着……我对我娘发誓，它们竟开始团成一只拳头。四面八方都听见那声响，像一根巨木被生生劈裂——有个声音在感召着。我听不懂它在说什么，可它的意思我却明白得透彻。我打算去矿上干活了。不管地底深处藏着什么，总不至于比那片林子里的东西更糟。”
“We were hauling lumber out by the old forest, but something was off. The leaves and branches that normally blow so peacefully had this unnatural stillness. Then… I swear on my mother, they started to ball up into a fist. All around us we heard it, like the cracking of a giant trunk—a voice calling out. I didn’t know what it was saying, but I understood its meaning just fine. I’m going to start working the mines. Whatever lies deep in the ground can’t be worse than what’s in those woods.”

加固的外堡门楼对任何妄图入侵之人都是一道严峻考验。厚重的木门两侧，高大的塔楼如巨树般拔地而起，宛如森然哨兵，永恒守望着通往城堡的道路。
The reinforced barbican presents a formidable challenge to would-be invaders. Broad towers rise like enormous trees on either side of the heavy wooden gate, looming sentinels keeping eternal watch over the road to the castle.

Storm Of Vengeance.name:
复仇风暴
Storm Of Vengeance

Text.text:
你吟诵着可怖的力量之词，将满腔怒火尽数唤起，让狂怒吞没心神；你指向苍穹，嘶吼出最后一个字。回应之下，天穹隆隆作响，厚重乌云压低，空气随之阴沉；紧接着，你召来的风暴中迸出一声震天裂响，暴烈得连你自己都为之一惊。
As you chant terrible words of power, you summon to mind all your wrath, letting rage overtake you as you point to the sky and scream the final word. In answer, the heavens rumble and the air darkens with heavy clouds before a thunderous crack erupts from the storm you’ve summoned, startling even you with its ferocity.

Intersystem Spaceport.name:
星际联运太空港
Intersystem Spaceport

Text.text:
穿梭艇在喧嚣的太空港上空嗡嗡乱窜，像一群凶狠的苍蝇，每一艘都在等着轮到自己的回合靠泊。主交通枢纽里人声鼎沸、吵闹不堪，广播的嗡鸣几乎被彻底淹没；刺鼻浓烈的燃料味浸透空气，挥之不去。
Shuttles buzz around the hectic spaceport like vicious flies, each awaiting its turn to dock. The drone of announcements is barely perceptible over the raucous atmosphere in the main transport hub, and the potent odor of fuel saturates the air.

豺犬尖吻大耳，最爱成双成对地行动，对伴侣忠贞到近乎凶狠。每个家庭都有一套由尖吠与低鸣编成的秘密语言，只有父母与同胞兄弟姐妹才听得懂。独行时，豺犬狡黠机敏，像狐狸般脆弱，却又像猎犬般坚韧。
Sharp snouted and big-eared, jackals love to work in pairs and are fiercely loyal to their mates. Each family has a secret language of yips and hoots only parents and siblings speak. Alone, the jackal is sly and cunning, fragile as a fox and tough as a hunting dog.

从外面看，这座木制建筑朴素得很：粗大的梁木沉沉压下，屋顶陡斜如刃。走进门内，迎面便是成群填充得惟妙惟肖、姿态分毫不差的猛兽标本——一头熊双足直立咆哮，一只掠食猫弓背蓄势欲扑，一头狮鹫振翼欲起，一条幼龙正从蛋壳中破出。战利品阴森骇人，但空间却温暖而舒适：壁炉火光炽烈，四周围着柔软厚实的扶手椅，椅背披着兽皮。地上一张枭熊皮毯，更将这一幕衬得完整。
From outside, the wooden structure appears simple enough, with its heavy timbers and steeply angled roof. Inside, one is greeted by multitudes of stuffed and perfectly positioned beasts—a bear on its hind legs, a predator cat preparing to lunge, a griffon taking flight, a dragon wyrmling emerging from an egg. The trophies are macabre, but the space is warm and comfortable, with a blazing hearth surrounded by cushy armchairs draped in furs. An owlbear rug completes the picture.

用短短的、皱巴巴的腿蹒跚挪动着，幼年甲龙无疑是个惹人好奇的景象。蜷在巨大而沉重的甲壳之下，小家伙一边不断适应这份负担的重量，一边跌跌撞撞。尾端那一点小小的骨节牵着甩动的尾巴，带着钟摆般的惯性晃荡着；幼崽一蹦一跳奔向母亲，发出愉快的低鸣。
Trundling about on short, wrinkled legs, the young ankylosaurus is certainly a curious sight. Tucked beneath a large, heavy shell, the baby stumbles as it constantly adjusts to the weight of its burden. A tiny nub of bone at the end of its tail pulls the swinging limb with pendulous momentum as the young one bounds over to its mother, lowing happily.

Sundries From A Warhorse Skeleton.name:
战马骷髅（特征）的杂物
Sundries From A Warhorse Skeleton

Text.text:
在这匹曾经骄傲的战马那碎裂的蹄子上，你发现几只还算完好的马蹄铁。它们可以拆下来回收利用——当然，得先好好清理一番。
On the shattered hooves of the once-proud warrior steed, you find horseshoes that are in relatively good condition. They could be removed and salvaged—after some thorough cleaning, of course.

A Scholar's Peace.name:
学者的宁静
A Scholar's Peace

Text.text:
“也许有些瞬间本就无意义。那些时刻里，既无课可学，亦无知可得。也许，正是在那里，你才寻得安宁。”
“Perhaps there are moments without meaning. Times where there are no lessons to be learned, nor knowledge gained. Perhaps that is where you find peace.”

Plain Stone Coffin.name:
朴素石棺
Plain Stone Coffin

Text.text:
这具棺椁朴素得近乎乏味。上面没有铭文，没有刻痕，没有任何装饰与点缀。若曾有人在石上刻下名字，如今也早已无从辨认。然而棺盖上堆满了陈旧蜡烛与其他殡葬供物，棺旁地面被频繁来往的脚步磨得斑驳起痕。
This coffin is underwhelmingly plain. It bears no inscription, no etchings, no embellishments or adornments. If there ever was a name carved into the stone, it’s no longer visible. Yet old candles and other funerary gifts cover the lid, and the floor around the coffin is scuffed from heavy traffic.

Distant Fortress In A Spring Forest.name:
春林深处的远方要塞
Distant Fortress In A Spring Forest

Text.text:
林间空地上，成百上千朵野花在春风里轻轻摇曳，空气里满是勤作的嗡鸣声.. 远处，在密密挤成一片、仿佛无法穿透的针叶林之上，一座古老要塞的花岗岩巨墙阴沉地压着天际；石面布满旧伤般的裂痕，空洞的窗框里栖着乌鸦。某座塔楼上飘着一面被烟火熏黑的旗帜，徽记早已难以辨认。
In the forest glade hundreds of wild flowers sway in the spring breeze, and the air is filled with industrious buzzing.. Looming in the distance, above tightly packed conifers which appear impenetrable, are the granite slabs of an old fortress, the stone cracked with old wounds and crows nesting in empty windows. A blackened banner flutters from one tower, the symbol unreadable.

Wand Of Magic Detection.name:
魔法侦测魔杖
Wand Of Magic Detection

Text.text:
这根细长的魔杖造型出奇地优雅。通体以炭黑木材雕琢成身，柄部亦然，抛光至镜面般的冷亮；杖尖与杖身之间，则由一颗圆润的玻璃珠饰作分隔。
This slimline wand is of remarkably elegant design. Charcoal-black wood polished to a mirror shine makes up the sculpted body and handle, while a rounded glass bauble separates the wand’s tip from the shaft.

Merfolk Caught Unawares.name:
措手不及的人鱼
Merfolk Caught Unawares

Text.text: 一名女子立在海岸边，望向无垠海面。她舒展蹼状的手指，揉按着掌心，低声喃喃自语。忽然，她开始急促地翻找腰侧的挎包——那是一团由渔网与海藻编织缠结而成的织物。袋中传来轻而清脆的碰撞声，像是木头或骨头在相互磕碰。几步之外，沙地里响起一声咔嚓，她的低语戛然而止，随之而来的是短促、尖锐的倒吸一口气。她的手肘与脚踝处鳍片张开。她那昏暝般的眼——黄、紫、蓝交织的润泽光池——从挎包上抬起，扫视四周。 A woman stands at the shore, looking out to sea. She stretches her webbed fingers and massages her palms, quietly muttering to herself. She suddenly begins digging into the satchel at her hip, a woven tangle of fishnet and seaweed. The bag rattles with the light, clattering sounds of what could be wood or bone. There is a crunch in the sand a few feet away, and her muttering stops with a short, sharp intake of breath. Fins flare out from her elbows and ankles. Her gloam eyes—glistening pools of yellow, purple, and blue—look up from the satchel to scan her surroundings.

Sundries From A Phase Spider.name:
相位蜘蛛的杂物
Sundries From A Phase Spider

Text.text:
这只异界蛛形生物的躯体凹陷、穿孔、血肉模糊，所剩无几。它伤口中那梅色般幽暗的血液，将苍白身躯上电蓝色的纹路染得浑浊不清；血沿着它的形体淌落，汇聚在周围，仿佛一扇通往子夜的液态传送门。除了把它的腿从腹部硬生生扯下来，以证明你战胜了这样的生物之外，再无任何宝藏可寻。
Body dented, poked, and bloodied, not much remains of this extraplanar arachnid. The plum-dark blood of its wounds muddies the electric-blue patterns on its pale body, dripping down its form and pooling around it like a liquid portal into midnight. Aside from wrenching its legs from its abdomen to prove you bested such a creature, there is no treasure to be found.

Wild West Setting.name:
狂野西部设定
Wild West Setting

Text.text:
干燥的风掠过，将横贯这座破败小镇的土路上尘土搅起；闷热的午后里，影子在龟裂的荒漠地面上缓缓爬行。无畏的拓荒者在屋檐投下的阴影下穿梭忙碌，各自奔波，只为在蛮荒边境再熬过一天。马儿嘶鸣，咬嚼着嚼子；它们面前一条长长的锈蚀水槽被注满清水，随即低下感激的头颅，贪婪痛饮。

酒馆里骤然爆出一声尖叫。一个人从窗户里飞了出来——碎裂的玻璃切进他们被烈日烤硬的皮肉——随后重重摔在路中央，胸口的伤处血如泉涌，迅速渗入尘土。秃鹫在头顶盘旋，可无人侧目，那倒霉鬼在众目睽睽下咽下最后一口气；一个阴沉的人戴着黑色高筒礼帽，把那具瘫软的尸体拖走。西部就是如此：命贱如尘，死人很快被遗忘——除非他们留下些什么。少数被命运挑中的人，会因伟大或卑劣的事迹被传唱四方——名字永远刻在历史的账册上。

An arid breeze stirs the dust on the dirt road bisecting the small, ramshackle town, and shadows creep across the parched desert earth in the stifling afternoon heat. Intrepid pioneers mill beneath shaded eaves as they go about their business, just trying to survive another day on the wild frontier. Horses whinny and champ at their bits as a long, rusted trough before them is filled with water. They lower grateful heads to drink deep.

A cry erupts from the saloon. A body flies through a window—the shattered glass slicing into their sunbaked flesh—and then lies in the road, blood pouring from a wound in their chest and soaking into the dirt. Vultures circle overhead, but no one bats an eye as the unfortunate soul draws their last breath; their limp body is dragged away by a dour individual in a black stovepipe hat. Such is the way of the West: life is cheap and the dead are quickly forgotten—unless they make their mark. Those chosen few are remembered far and wide for deeds both great and foul—names forever etched in the ledger of history.

Hall Of The Watcher.name:
守望者大厅
Hall Of The Watcher

Text.text:
一具由灰色岩石凿成的巨大石棺倚着东墙安放，棺首立着一只镀金罐，饰以眼镜蛇的纹样。石棺北侧摆着几只陶罐与一只石匣；南侧则有一尊阴沉的披甲人形雕像，皮肤刻成鳞片，双臂交叉，默然守视。他獠牙外露的嘴大张着，分叉的舌头从口中探出。狭长的眼窝深黑如墨，却闪烁着微光。
A massive coffin of gray rock rests along the eastern wall, a gilded jar in a cobra motif marking its head. Clay jars and a stone coffer sit to its north, and a statue of a dour, armored humanoid, his skin carved in scales, watches with crossed arms from the south. He has an open, fanged mouth, a forked tongue extended from it. His narrow eyes are deep black, but they sparkle.

Private Helicopter Lands, Corporate Exec.name:
私人直升机降落，企业高管走出
Private Helicopter Lands, Corporate Executive Exits

Text.text:
那架时髦的直升机在娴熟引导下优雅降落，舱门随即滑开。机舱里，一位衣着考究的女人从柔软的皮革内饰中起身，小心翼翼地迈出机外。尽管头顶旋翼呼啸，她的发丝依旧一丝不乱；她昂然穿过停机坪，带着大胆的自信径直走向等候的安保人员。
The stylish helicopter touches down with expertly guided grace and the doors slide open. Inside, a sharply dressed woman rises from the plush leather interior and steps gingerly out. Despite the whirring rotors overhead, her hair remains immaculate as she strides across the helipad with brazen confidence toward the waiting security guards.

Alien Cult Killer.name:
异星邪教杀手
Alien Cult Killer

Text.text:
矮壮敦实的这只昆虫状生物悄无声息。触角在额前一抹赭黄粉末上微微颤动，那粉末被粗粗抹开，衬得双眼如玻璃般空泛。几道甲壳褶皱护住他们的颌部。四肢迅疾而抽动，双手不时神经质地一颤。白色丝带束在猩红和服外，将腰间鼓起的一团东西紧紧藏住。
Short, burly, and stocky, this insectoid creature makes not a sound. Antennae quiver above a daub of ochre powder, smeared across their forehead, and eyes that appear glassy. Chitinous folds protect their jaw. Their limbs make swift, jerky movements, hands twitching. White silk belts wrap around their crimson kimono, which conceals a lump of something tucked at the waist.

一阵不祥的寂静降临，幽影般的身形飘入室内。曾经——或许——她也活过。她曾感受欢喜与悲恸……也曾知晓凡世的甘美。如今，生机已从她的眼底尽数褪去。她膨大的颅骨上血管噼啪作响，宛如承载着诡秘的异界魔力。象征古老权柄的长袍在黑与淡紫间翻涌。她紧握一柄合成金属法杖，其上迸散着蓝色电光，滋滋作响。
A fell quiet falls as a ghostly shape drifts into the room. Once, perhaps, she lived. She felt joy, sorrow… She knew the pleasure of the mortal world. Now, all traces of life have left her eyes. Her enlarged cranium crackles with veins harboring eldritch magics. Robes of ancient office swirl in black and lilac. She clutches a synth-metal staff that fizzles with blue lightning.

这口棺盖上，在约莫胸口高度处凿出一方长方形凹槽，其内刻着如下文字：菲丝，曾作为德里昂忠诚的持盾侍女侍奉左右。她安息之处，皆为圣地。 The lid on this grave has, carved into a rectangular depression at about chest height, the following words: Faith, who served as Derion’s loyal shield-maiden. Wherever she rests is hallowed ground.

Joseph Pessimal Whitebread.name:
约瑟夫·悲观派·白面包
Joseph Pessimal Whitebread

Text.text:
他的存在难以在你脑海里停留超过片刻。倘若有人在几分钟后问起他的声音或神情，你会茫然失措，答不上来。你也许只能说他头发分开梳着，随身带着一把算盘。穿着几乎称得上讲究，却用的是平淡无奇的色调。没有幽默感。等等——他好像提过自己是个术士，是普莱莫斯的代理人，而他的工作与“完善宇宙间的平衡”有关。他正在进行一次审计。
His existence is difficult to keep in your mind for more than a moment. Were someone to ask, just minutes from now, about his voice or expressions, you would be at a loss. You might say his hair was parted. He carried an abacus. Almost stylish but in unremarkable colors. No sense of humor. Wait. He said something about being a sorcerer, agent of Primus, and that his job had to do with perfecting balance across the universe. He was conducting an audit.

Elder Brain Dragon Attack.name:
上古脑魔龙的攻击
Elder Brain Dragon Attack

Text.text:
一声尖锐刺耳的厉啸撕裂凝滞的空气，一头巨大的飞行生物遮蔽了太阳。栈桥上爆发出惊恐的呼喊，码头工人四散奔逃寻找掩蔽，惊慌的旅人则成群冲向飞艇。那片阴影以骇人的速度俯冲向码头。巨兽发出受折磨般、咕噜作响的哀嚎——随即，一股粘稠腥咸的浓液从它口中轰然喷涌，砸在下方的不幸者身上。受害者纷纷坠落在地，扭动着发出刺耳的惨叫，抓挠自己的皮肤；而苍白的虫状生物痛苦地钻入柔软温热的血肉之中。巨兽沉重地砰然落地，空港码头猛地倾斜了一瞬，艰难承受着那重量后才重新回正。你眼前站着一条前所未见的巨龙：腐败的皮肉如陈旧淤青般的色泽紧贴着它瘦骨嶙峋的蜥蜴身躯——这曾经高贵的生物，如今那原本锐利聪慧的眼睛已深陷、浑浊如玻璃。粗大的脉动触须从它颅骨根部探出，连接进它背上松垮盘踞的一团鼓胀、颤动的受折磨肉块——仿佛它背负着一只骇人的寄生物。

~ 由 Sam the DM Envisioned

A shrill, ear-piercing screech rips through the still air, as an enormous flying creature blocks out the sun. Shouts of terrified alarm erupt across the gantries, sending dockhands running for cover and panicked travelers stampeding toward the airships. The shadow dives with incredible speed toward the docks. The beast emits a tortured, gargling wail—and a hideous torrent of thick, briny liquid explodes from its mouth, landing on the unfortunate souls below. Falling to the floor, writhing in cacophonous agony, the victims claw at their skin while pale, worm-like creatures burrow painfully into soft warm flesh. The beast lands with a heavy thud and the skydock lists for a moment, struggling to accommodate the creature's weight before righting itself. Before you stands a dragon unlike any you have ever seen: rancid flesh the color of an old bruise clings to the emaciated reptilian frame of this once-noble creature, and its formerly sharp, intelligent eyes are now sunken and glassy. Large, pulsing tentacles protrude from the base of its skull and feed into a bulbous, quivering mass of tortured flesh resting languidly atop its back—as if it carries a horrific parasite.

~ Envisioned by Sam the DM

Insult About Repeated Failures.name:
关于反复失败的羞辱
Insult About Repeated Failures

Text.text:
“你知道的，有个界限：一次次重来不再值得钦佩，只剩可悲。或许我们今天就到此为止？”
“You know, there’s a point at which trying again and again stops being admirable and starts being sad. Perhaps we should call it a day here?”

Plea From A Party Member To Live.name:
来自队友的求生恳求
Plea From A Party Member To Live

Text.text:
“你敢死试试。你还没资格死。”
“Don’t you dare die. You haven’t earned your death yet.”

你手中的钻石闪烁着光芒，辐射出一阵阵触手可及的热浪，仿佛你从苍穹摘下了一颗星辰，而它尚未冷却。奥术符印被镌刻在钻石表面——无疑出自大师之手——那些符号随着能量的潮汐微微跃动，与之同频共振。

~ Sahlonahl 于 Discord

The diamond in your hand shimmers and radiates waves of palpable heat, as if you have plucked a star from the heavens and it has not yet cooled. Arcane sigils have been engraved into the diamond's surface—with an expert hand, no doubt—and the symbols pulse slightly in time with the tide of energy.

~ Sahlonahl on Discord

这柄长矛出自质朴的手工。矛杆大体笔直，仍带着木材天然的节疤与纹理，触感粗砺；末端以筋腱紧紧捆扎着一枚由燧石削出的凶狠锋利的矛头。这样的武器也许古旧，却承载着亘古不变的用途。
The spear is rustic handiwork. The shaft is mostly straight, rough with the natural knots and grain of the wood, with a wicked-sharp spearhead carved from flint lashed to the end with sinew. This weapon may be old-fashioned, but its purpose is ageless.

Quip About The Comfort Of Nature.name:
关于大自然慰藉的俏皮话
Quip About The Comfort Of Nature

Text.text:
“树叶在微风里沙沙作响，鸟儿吟唱——而当我死去，它们仍会照常继续，仿佛我从未来过。我在这点上感到慰藉。”
“The trees rustle in the breeze, the birds sing—and when I die, they will continue as if I was never here. I find comfort in that.”

Male Sign Language Interpreter In Theate.name:
剧院里的男性手语翻译员
Male Sign Language Interpreter In Theater

Text.text:
剧院观众席沉在黑暗边缘，四周包厢被烛光烘得温暖。舞台右侧角落里，离乐池边缘不过两三步，那位口译员主要朝着乐池另一边的一大群人打着手语。他的感染力不输演员；即便没有声音，观众依旧能“感到”音乐，能看见舞台的奇观。他们用余光在演员与口译员之间切换，而口译员也献上了属于自己的演出。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The theater audience sits at the edge of darkness, the perimeter boxes candle-lit warmly. At the stage-right corner, only a couple of feet to the edge of the orchestra pit, the interpreter signs mostly for a large group on the other side of the pit. He is as engaging as the actors, and in the absence of sound, the audience still feels the music, sees the spectacle of the stage. They switch their periphery from the actors to the interpreter, who gives his own performance.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

God Of Combat.name:
战斗之神
God Of Combat

Text.text:
你会在冲突之处找到他，随时准备以唯一的方式，把一切恩怨——清清楚楚、彻彻底底——了结。平日里他往往只缠着手带、穿着宽松长裤；但今天，他披挂全身板甲，持枪佩剑。自一场需动用军队的大争端归来，他端坐在披甲的战马之上，仿佛人马本为一体。任何有点理智的人都不会想与这位神明一战，然而战斗却是他解决纷争的唯一途径。
You will find him where there is conflict, ready to settle all grievances—clearly and finally—in only one way. He often wears nothing more than hand wraps and baggy trousers, but today he is in full plate with lance and sword. Returned from a great dispute requiring armies, he sits his armored warhorse as if the two were one being. No one of any sense would want a fight with this god, and yet combat is the only way he will resolve conflict.

Robbed By A Street Urchin In A Bazaar.name:
在集市里被一个街头小扒手洗劫
Robbed By A Street Urchin In A Bazaar

Text.text:
你感觉腰带被轻轻一拽，回头便看见一个迷途的孩子，裹着沾满煤灰的破布衣裳，在拥挤的集市里从你身边窜过，朝远处狂奔而去。你因愤怒与难堪而面颊涨得通红，立刻拔腿追上那小混账，急着夺回自己的财物。可没跑出多远，你已气喘吁吁地停下，四下张望，却什么也没看见。在买客、摊贩与卫兵交织成的眩晕漩涡中，那小崽子早已无影无踪。

~ 由 Davy 构想于 Discord

You feel the slightest tug at your belt and turn to see a wayward child clad in soot-stained rags racing away from you through the crowded bazaar. You feel your cheeks flush crimson with anger and embarrassment as you set off after the urchin, eager to reclaim your property. After a few moments, you look around, panting, but see nothing. In the dizzying maelstrom of shoppers, vendors, and guards, the little bugger has vanished.

~ Envisioned by Davy on Discord

蔚蓝的鳞片、蜥蜴般的吻部，以及沿着下颌铺开的浅色角刺与自后脑弯曲伸出的长角，让这个小小的身影带上了龙裔般的性相。他那双大而银亮的眼睛、细长尖耳与咧开的笑意，又给他添了几分讨喜的灵气。衣着同样如此：颈间以细绳挂着一只巨大的银环。灰色夹棉护甲与长裤之外，他披着一件精致的皮衣，上面钉满钢钉，护腕与胫甲也与之相配。唯有尾巴、以及带着利爪指节的手与脚仍裸露在外。绑在他背上的手弩看起来对他而言大了那么一点。

~ Played by Musubi with

Azure scales, a reptilian snout, and pale horns along the jaw and curving from the back of his head lend this tiny person a draconic aspect. His big, silver eyes; long, pointed ears; and grin give him a winsome air. So do his clothes. He wears a large loop of silver on a cord around his neck. Over gray gambeson and trousers, he wears a coat of fine steel-studded leather, with bracers and greaves to match. Only his tail, and his hands and feet—with their clawed digits—remain uncovered. The hand crossbow strapped to his back seems a tad too large for him.

~ Played by Musubi with

暗淡的橄榄绿与木褐色衣装在高草间将弓手的身形彻底吞没；一袭纹理分明的叶片披风覆在结实有力的肩背上，更把那道剪影抹得模糊不清。锐利的黄眼紧紧锁定目标——前方道路上一个遥远的身影——他们毫不费力地将弓弦拉至贴颊。微调准星时，他们缓缓吐出一口长气，风掠过，四周青翠的草茎沙沙作响。他们已然就绪。

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Drab olive-green and wood-brown garb shrouds the archer from view in the long grass, their silhouette further obscured by a textured cape of leaves draped around toned, muscular shoulders. Keen yellow eyes track their target—a distant figure on the road ahead—as they effortlessly draw the bow to their cheek. Adjusting their aim, they release a long, slow breath as the wind rustles the verdant stalks around them. They are ready.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

Young Silver Dragon.name:
幼年银龙
Young Silver Dragon

Text.text: 一道微光如海市蜃楼般弥漫在空气里，却很快凝成了切实可触的存在。你面前那头银辉骄傲的巨兽俯瞰着你，随即微微低首——你恍惚觉得自己正被君王授予骑士之名。双翼、长尾、利爪与獠牙让你的脑海尖叫着巨龙！可你的心却回以一阵安定的宁静：也许，你能称这只生物为朋友。 A glimmer fills the air, like a mirage, but it resolves into something quite real. The proud silvery beast before you gazes down and bows its head slightly—you feel like you’ve been knighted by a king. The wings, tail, claws, and fangs have your mind screaming dragon! But your heart answers with the calming sense that you might call this creature friend.

这把惊艳的武器，其锤头宛如艺术杰作，镶嵌着一幅令人屏息的画面：重装步兵结成盾墙，严阵以待。钉头锤上的每一根尖刺都被精心雕琢成微缩长矛，巧妙融入方阵的纹饰之中，让整幅景象仿佛跃出金属表面，化作立体的战阵一幕。
The head of this stunning weapon is a work of art, inlaid with a breathtaking depiction of hoplites forming a shield wall. Each spike of the morningstar has been carefully crafted into a miniature spear that blends seamlessly into the artwork of the phalanx to give the impression of a three-dimensional scene.

Runes In The Mountain.name:
山中符文
Runes In The Mountain

Text.text:
一片宽阔而平整的岩面上刻着深深的铭文。那些锋利凿出的符号由交错的直线组成——两列——先横贯石面，随后向下弯折，并向内自卷成螺旋。整体形状让人想到一条河被拖入漩涡，或是一阵清风旋转着卷成龙卷。无论是哪一种，你光是凝视这些符文，便感到一阵眩晕。
A broad flat face of rock bears deep inscriptions. The sharply carved figures consist of intersecting straight lines—two rows of them—that travel across the stone before curving down and in on themselves in a spiral. The whole shape brings to mind a river being drawn into a whirlpool, or perhaps a breeze twirling into a tornado. Whichever it is, you find yourself becoming dizzy just by looking at the runes.

当你踏入海边洞窟昏暗而静止的幽寂时，雷鸣般的浪涛轰响渐渐远去。光芒在湿滑的洞壁上摇曳，金色阳光的波纹随拍岸的水面起伏反射。你的呼吸与脚步声在覆满藻类的岩壁间回荡。空气里缠着咸味，而即便在昏暗光照之中，你也不知怎地在此感到几分安宁。
The thunderous crashing of waves fades as you step into the dim stillness of the seaside cave. Light wavers against the slick walls, undulating patterns of golden sunlight reflecting off lapping waters. Your breaths and footfalls reverberate off the algae-covered walls. Salt laces the air, and despite the dim light you find yourself somewhat at peace here.

你以一声几不可闻的低语开启这道法术，温柔的安抚之词几乎不带气息地从唇间滑出。你的声音音量缓缓抬升，一抹绿光渗入你眼角，染出淡淡的苍翠碧色。随着他们注视着你、沉醉于你诱人的存在，法术的焦点开始变得迟缓。
You begin the spell with just a murmur, soft words of comfort passing almost breathlessly from your lips. The volume of your voice slowly rises, and a green light seeps into the corners of your eyes, casting a pale emerald. The focus of your spell begins to slow as they watch you, drinking in your enticing presence.

Speech About Despair From A Broken Hero.name:
来自破碎英雄的绝望演说
Speech About Despair From A Broken Hero

Text.text:
“我发现自己坠入了比绝望更糟的所在。我已丢失了自己渴望的一切痕迹，仿佛梦想被人从我心口生生拔走。我仍在战斗，一次又一次，在这灰色的世界里苦苦追寻，只盼能瞥见它们一眼，可直到如今，我什么也没找到。”
“I find myself somewhere worse than despair. I’ve lost all trace of what I want, as if my dreams have been plucked from my heart. I fight on, and on, in a gray world, hoping that I will catch a glimpse of them, but so far I’ve found nothing.”

你在完成咒语的最后一句时，将橡树皮在掌心攥得粉碎；刹那间，万籁无声，仿佛什么都未曾发生。紧接着，一声低沉而宏大的呻吟从你体内迸出，几乎像参天橡树在风中吱呀作响。树皮自你掌中血肉间破土般涌出，蜿蜒攀上你的手臂，迅速覆过胸腹与肩背。你感觉粗糙的树皮将你彻底包裹，如同一层坚硬的甲壳，稳稳将你护在其中。
You crush the oak bark in your fist as you complete the utterance, and for a moment nothing happens. Then, a great groan emanates from you, almost like the creaking of a great oak. Bark emerges from the flesh of your hand, snakes up your arm, and overtakes your torso. You feel the bark encase you completely, offering its protection.

一串串脏污的脚印在登船平台磨损的金属上蜿蜒穿行，仿佛旅客与船员匆匆奔波留下的残影。清晨通勤人潮的踩踏中，地面几乎无从得见；而此刻昏暗的静寂里，喧乱已被一片安宁的沉静取代。月光洒落在覆着霜痕的建筑上，像云层之上高悬的烈日，照耀着一处隐秘的海滩。
A jumble of dirty footprints wends its way across the worn metal of the boarding platform, the remnants of passengers and crew hurrying through their day. In the early morning commuter stampede one can’t even see the floor, yet now in the dim stillness the chaos is replaced by a serene tranquility. Moonlight bathes the frost-rimed edifice like a sun high above the clouds shining down on a secluded beach.

I Cast Insect Plague Using Components.name:
我用施法材料施放了【虫群瘟疫】
I Cast Insect Plague Using Components

Text.text:
我把油脂抹在双手上，又在身周撒下糖与谷粒，将那叽喳作响、饥渴贪婪的虫群召向我的敌人。法术的词句在齿间嗡嗡作响，仿佛我的舌头自有生命；我听见瘟疫逼近时甲壳摩擦奏出的号角。
I smear fat on my hands and sprinkle sugar and grain around me to summon the chittering, ravenous horde upon my foes. The words of the spell buzz against my teeth as if my tongue has taken on a life of its own, and I hear the chitinous fanfare of the plague approaching.

Drained Victim.name:
被榨干的受害者
Drained Victim

Text.text:
精灵消瘦而惨白的脸上，一双玻璃般的眼睛空洞地望着前方。她颈侧两处针尖般的小孔正渗出血丝，将那件粗糙的羊毛短上衣染成深暗的猩红。她看起来安详得近乎宁静，仿佛生命的最后一刻充斥的不是痛苦与恐惧，而是某种甜美的愉悦。尽管雨水坠落，空气中仍萦绕着一缕馥郁的高级香水气息，越靠近尸体越发浓烈。究竟是谁——或者是什么——做了这一切？
Glassy eyes look out from the elf’s gaunt, pallid face. Blood trickles from two pinprick holes in her neck, staining the rough woollen jerkin she wears a dark crimson. She looks peaceful, almost serene, as though her last moments were filled with pleasure rather than pain and terror. A heady smell of fine perfume lingers in the air despite the falling rain, getting stronger toward the body. Who—or what—could have done this?

这柄刀刃令人难以置信，沉重得绝非凡人之手所能驾驭，却又美得无可匹敌。剑身辉映着金与银、铜与黄铜的光泽——万千色彩的宝石镶嵌在剑首、剑柄与护手之上。符文沿着那修长的刃面一路蔓延，散发出温暖的金色光辉。仿佛有一阵低鸣自这件武器中涌出，在那异界金属间回荡震颤。
The blade defies belief, too cumbersome for mortal hands to wield yet its beauty is unmatched. The sword gleams with gold and silver, copper and brass—gemstones of myriad colors emblazon the pommel, hilt, and guard. Runes run the considerable length of the blade, glowing with a warm, golden light. A hum seems to emanate from the weapon, reverberating through the otherworldly metal.

Elemental Gem Of Red Corundum.name:
红色刚玉元素宝石
Elemental Gem Of Red Corundum

Text.text:
这块长方形红宝石不比一面手镜更大，却薄如窗玻璃。透过它窥视，你看见外头的世界仿佛被烈火点燃。你放下这枚透镜，再看时，万物安然无恙。可当你再次透过宝石望去，火焰无处不在——仿佛这颗红宝石渴望整个世界付之一炬。
The rectangular ruby is no bigger than a hand mirror and as thin as a window. Peering through it, you see the world beyond as if it caught fire. You lower the lens and see that everything looks unharmed. When you look through the gem again, you see flames everywhere—as if the ruby wants the world to burn.

I Cast Find Familiar: Quasit.name:
我施放《寻觅魔宠》：夸塞魔
I Cast Find Familiar: Quasit

Text.text:
我以浮石作盆，以山火遗下的镁与木炭为薪，吐出深渊语的断句，点燃火种。白焰嘶嘶作响，火星迸溅，腾然成形。我将一条活蜈蚣与一枚蟾蜍头骨投入其中，又撒入鼠尾草、蛇舌草与乌头。末了，我吐出束缚的恶魔真言，将陈年的蝙蝠粪猛掷进火里——轰然爆裂。烟尘与碎屑之间，一只夸塞魔立定身形，俯首待命。
With pumice for a basin, and magnesium and charcoal from a wildfire for fuel, I spit Abyssal phrases and light a blaze. A white flame, hissing and sparking, forms. I add a living centipede and a toad skull along with salvia, viper’s bugloss, and wolfsbane. In the end, I speak a binding demonic word and hurl aged bat guano into the fire, causing an explosion. A quasit stands amid the debris, ready to serve me.

Starship Ensign Awaits Video Transmissio.name:
星舰少尉静候影像传输
Starship Ensign Awaits Video Transmission

Text.text:
阴郁的少尉把手指按着节拍敲打桌面，一遍又一遍地对着视讯屏上的自动讯息无声地跟读——这已经是第一百遍了。“请稍候，您的通话将很快开始，”一个女声以令人抓狂的轻快语调滴答作响地报出，同时屏幕上那枚舰队徽章的图像永不停歇地旋转着。等到画面终于接通，少尉几乎从椅子上跌下来——那单调的恍惚被骤然撕裂：指挥官出现了。

~ Joorrekiin on Discord

The sullen ensign taps their fingers rhythmically against the desk as they mouth the words to the automated message on the vid screen for the hundredth time. "Please hold, your call will begin shortly," a female voice chirps in a frustratingly chipper tone, accompanied by the perpetually rotating graphic of a fleet badge. When the video goes live, the ensign almost falls out of their chair as their monotonous reverie is abruptly broken—by the commander.

~ Joorrekiin on Discord

Leather Elbow Brace.name:
皮革护肘
Leather Elbow Brace

Text.text:
你花了点时间反复摆弄，才把角度对上，但终究还是把绑带解开了。这件皮革装置几乎能贴合你能想到的任何类人生物的手肘。戴上去看起来轻而易举：把前臂穿过去，再用绑带收紧，勒出恰到好处的贴合感。对任何手肘不稳或受伤的人来说，这东西准能派上大用场。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

It takes a moment of finagling to get the angles right, but you finally get the straps loose. This leather contraption seems to fit just about any humanoid elbow you can think of. Putting it on appears an easy task: simply slide your forearm through then use the straps to make it a snug fit. This is sure to be a help for anyone with an unsteady or injured elbow.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Sundries From An Annis Hag.name:
安妮丝鬼婆的杂物
Sundries From An Annis Hag

Text.text:
在那鬼婆（特征）筋肉虬结、骨节突起的胳膊下，夹着一只布挎包，里面塞得满满当当，全是些怪异的蘑菇：灰白扭结、块茎般成簇的菌团，乍看就像一只只风干成木乃伊的手。翻找鬼婆（特征）那身馊臭破布的口袋，能摸出一个布偶——由零碎布片拼凑，用粗线缝合而成。填充物在里面不时抽动、蠕动不止。
Under one of the mountain hag’s sinew-knobbled arms is tucked a cloth satchel filled to the brim with strange mushrooms: gnarled, gray, tuberous clusters that look like mummified hands. Rummaging through the pockets of the hag’s rancid rags yields a doll, made from cloth odds and ends sewn together with coarse thread. The stuffing writhes fitfully.

Air Thick With Molten Rock.name:
空气浓稠得像熔融岩浆
Air Thick With Molten Rock

Text.text:
每一次吸气，你都感觉支气管像被轻微烫伤般刺痛。尽管你已做足防护，弥漫的热浪与灼烧金属的气味仍让你口干欲裂、渴意汹涌；与此同时，你的头颅被轰鸣般的痛楚敲击着，沉重到你难以忽视。
With every inhalation you feel your bronchial passages sting from a mild scald. Despite your precautions, the pervading heat and the scent of burning metal inflicts a powerful thirst upon you, while your head pounds with a resounding ache that you cannot easily ignore.

Hell: Hall Of Penitence.name:
地狱：忏悔之厅
Hell: Hall Of Penitence

Text.text:
一座镜廊在你面前延展开来——至少看上去如此。两侧华丽的黑色石拱托起一片片幽闪的黑暗镜面，你在其中看见自己的倒影。然而若你凝视其中一面太久，你的影像便会消失，取而代之的是一缕可怜的灵魂：一个在凄惨苦楚中挣扎的幽影，面容因罪疚与悲伤而扭曲。
A hall of mirrors extends before you, or so it seems. Arches of ornate black stone on both sides hold glimmering panes of darkness within which you see yourself reflected. Yet if you gaze at one too long, your image disappears and you instead see a piteous soul: a spirit in wretched misery, pained features tortured by guilt and sorrow.

一头骡子的嘶鸣猛然刺入你的耳膜；你越靠近农舍，一阵阵喷鼻、尖叫与咩鸣便汇成抗议的喧嚣，加入这场合唱。两匹挽马向前挪了挪，用温顺的眼睛盯着你，尾巴不安地甩动，拍打着同栏木围的狭窄边界。安置它们的木棚未曾上漆，四角以粗厚的石柱撑起倾斜的木瓦屋顶。棚后，整齐的青稞、小麦与燕麦一路铺展到目力尽头。你转身面向一间小小的农舍，正要开口问候，鼻尖却先被粪肥与新割干草的浓郁气味填满。
