The bray of a mule assaults your ears and a cacophony of snorts, squeals, and bleats joins the chorus of protest as you encroach on the farmstead. Two draft horses shift forward, staring at you through soft eyes, their tails flicking nervously against the confines of a shared pen. The unpainted barn that houses them is cornered by thick stone pillars supporting a slanted shingle roof. Behind it, neat rows of barley, wheat, and oats grow as far as the eye can see. Turning to face a small farmhouse, you prepare to call out a greeting, taking in the rich scent of manure and fresh cut hay.

Capital City Goes Into Lockdown.name:
首都进入封锁状态
Capital City Goes Into Lockdown

Text.text: 横贯这片庞然的都市疆域，警报声凄厉回荡。无数闪耀的尖塔倏然变形为屏幕，每一面都在猩红光芒中闪烁同一条讯息：警告！警告！封锁即将启动！前往指定避难所。霎时间，璀璨如晶的玻璃塔群被厚重的合金防御层尽数覆盖。沿着实体壁垒的轮廓，蓝色能量盾牌轰然亮起——化作一颗颗守护的光泡。 Across the colossal urban expanse, sirens sound. Innumerable shining spires morph into screens, each flashing the same crimson message: warning! warning! lockdown imminent! proceed to assigned shelter. Suddenly, tower complexes of glittering glass are covered with thick alloy defenses. Around the physical barriers, blue power shields burst to life—bubbles of protective energy.

High-speed Gunfight On Urban Waterway.name:
城市水道上的高速枪战
High-speed Gunfight On Urban Waterway

Text.text:
一连串枪声将水道两侧打得千疮百孔，水花被撕裂成一道道喷泉般的液柱冲上空中。行人四散奔逃，交火在附近墙面上凿出一簇簇弹孔。几艘载着枪手的摩托艇紧追一艘油亮疾驰的快艇，在急转弯处侧倾划过，彼此对射。每台引擎身后都卷起翻涌的尾流，碎浪裹着漂浮的碎屑腾起旋涡，把水面搅成一片颠簸的乱海。快艇尾部架设的机枪从船艉回敬火力。
A salvo of gunshots peppers the sides of the waterway, spurting gouts of liquid into the air. Pedestrians scatter as the combat leaves clusters of holes in nearby walls. Several jet skis carrying gunmen zoom after a slick speedboat, trading fire as they bank around sharp corners. Riptide curls up into jetsam in the wake of each engine, swirling the water into a choppy sea. A rear-mounted machine gun returns fire from the back of the speedboat.

Magical Fog Envelops Sailing Ship.name:
魔法迷雾笼罩帆船
Magical Fog Envelops Sailing Ship

Text.text:
海浪惬意地拍打着船壳，日光暖融融地洒在甲板上，你在这安宁的节奏里被催入一段舒适的恍惚。船只随流漂行——浑然不觉地平线上正堆起的阴云。忽然之间，一团浓稠刺骨的寒雾将你吞没，像焦油般黏在身上，贪婪地把暖意从骨头里抽走。待那帷幕终于散去，太阳早已沉没——而星辰的位置竟已发生了骇人的偏移。

~ 构想：Clara C. Potter，来自 Discord

The idyllic lapping of waves against the hull of your ship and the warming rays of the sun lull you into a pleasant reverie as the vessel drifts along—oblivious to the looming clouds on the horizon. Suddenly, you find yourself enveloped in a thick, freezing fog that clings to you like tar, leeching the warmth from your bones. When the shroud eventually clears, the sun has long since set—and the stars have shifted dramatically.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

在这只布满尘埃的瓶子里，粘稠的团块在其中上下浮沉，呈现出一种虚弱、苍白的红色，漂浮在一团令人作呕的黏糊杂烩之中。随着时间推移，这剂药水已分离成层层叠叠，每一层都是不同色调的变质污泥。

~ 由 ExoticSpoon 构想

The viscous globules bobbing around inside the dusty bottle are a weak, pallid red adrift in a mélange of unsightly goop. Over time the potion has separated into layers, each one a varied hue of discolored gunk.

~ Envisioned by ExoticSpoon

Young Bronze Dragon.name:
幼年青铜龙
Young Bronze Dragon

Text.text:
打磨得锋利的利爪刮过地面；它俯身前倾，健壮的双腿被一层紧绷的皮膜束住，外覆坚硬的青铜鳞甲，在光下熠熠生辉。两片巨翼自巨龙背脊伸展而出，薄翼膜上浮着柔和的蓝色血脉；粗壮的尾巴沉沉拖在身后。它修长的颈项背面长着带蹼的骨刺，颈前则覆以厚重如甲的板状鳞片，一直延伸到腹下。龙的后颅生出一对巨角，较小的骨刺沿着宽阔的眉脊隆起成一道棱线，越过虹彩般的蓝眼，直到口鼻。利齿沿着巨口森然排列，拢住一条狭长、蛇一般游动的舌头。
Honed talons rake the ground and lean, muscular legs—bound by a tight layer of skin—are encompassed by hard, bronze scales that glitter in the light. Two large wings extend from the dragon’s back, their thin membranes lined with soft blue veins, and its hefty tail rests on the ground behind it. The beast's long neck houses webbed spines along its back and thick plate-like scales on its front that reach to its underbelly. Twin horns sprout from the back of the dragon's skull and smaller bony thorns form a ridge down its wide-set brow, past iridescent blue eyes, to its muzzle. Long fangs line its maw and encircle a narrow, serpentine tongue.

Mauled Horse.name:
被撕咬得血肉模糊的马
Mauled Horse

Text.text:
此处的悲恸几乎与这头牲畜死亡的骇怖不相上下。一条腿被撕扯得只剩白骨，胁侧的肌肉在利爪拉出的长长裂口下赤裸外翻。颈部被咬下了大块血肉，但马的脸仍完好无损，朝上的那只眼睛还睁着。刹那间，一股令人作呕的错觉袭来——仿佛它也许还活着；但不。伤害太重了，而且死得远远不够快。
The sadness here competes with the horror of the animal’s death. A leg sits shredded to the bone, and muscle across the flank is exposed under the long cuts of claws. There are great masses bitten from the neck, but the horse’s face is intact, its upward eye still open. For an instant, there is the sick feeling the horse may yet live, but no. Too much damage was done, not near fast enough.

Adult Deep Dragon.name:
成年深渊巨龙
Adult Deep Dragon

Text.text:
一条巨龙自深渊般的昏暗中浮现——巨大的鱼类眼睛闪着不洁的幽光——像一条庞然大犬般嗅着空气。它是阴影的君王，玄武岩般漆黑的鳞片吞噬着周遭仅存的微光。它周身的空气化作孢子的迷狂，病态的绿雾为它那鳗鱼般的面容蒙上一层湿冷的薄纱，毒息的恶臭从它涎水横流的巨口中喷涌而出。
A massive dragon emerges from the abyssal gloom—huge fish-like eyes gleaming with unclean luminosity—and sniffs the air like a gigantic dog. A sovereign of shadows, its basalt dark scales absorb what ambient light there is. The air about it is a fugue of spores, misting its eel-like features in a sickly green cloud, the stink of poison belching from its drooling maw.

Two Halflings In A Traveler's Cloak.name:
旅人斗篷下的两名半身人
Two Halflings In A Traveler's Cloak

Text.text:
你朝一名高得离谱的人影走去。那人脸盘异常宽阔，披着一件长长的旅人斗篷，斗篷在几处莫名鼓起，形状古怪。你从旁经过时，只见他忽然停下，微微一扭身——那动作你立刻认出来：一个老掉牙的把戏——两个半身人，一个踩在另一个肩上，躲在遮掩的斗篷底下，笨拙地乔装打扮，想混进镇上为数不多的几家“半身人免入”的店里。
You walk towards an over-tall figure, oddly broad of face and wearing a long traveler’s cloak with curious bulges here and there. As you walk past, you see the figure stop and shift, and you recognize the movements as a very old gag—two halflings, one standing on the shoulders of the other beneath an obscuring cloak, making a clumsy effort at disguise to gain entrance to one of the few “no halflings” establishments in town.

Eidolon Summoning Ritual.name:
幻灵召唤仪式
Eidolon Summoning Ritual

Text.text:
我跪在自己的法阵之中。烛火摇曳，秘奥的雾霭汇聚，空气骤然冰冷。我低声吟诵，节律与心跳同频；额头上刻下的符文因期待而隐隐作痛。我探手伸入彼界，超越有形之物，我呼唤、恳求、哀求它们降临。渐渐地，以太裂开，一道形体开始显现，头顶的符文印记炽然燃起。

~ Envisioned by Krolag Briknom-Thuk

I kneel within my circle. The candles flicker and esoteric mists gather as the air chills. My intonations pulse in time with my heart, the rune inscribed upon my brow aching with expectation. Reaching into the otherworld, transcending the material, I call, beseech, implore that they come. Slowly, the ether parts and a form begins to manifest, the runic mark upon its head ablaze.

~ Envisioned by Krolag Briknom-Thuk

那人类身形宽阔、气势逼人，将一柄凶戾的巨斧扛在肩头。披挂在魁梧躯体上的毛皮与兽革昭示着其来自冰寒故土，也暗示他们在社会边缘长大。战斗一开，战士抡起巨斧，放声咆哮——那声嘶吼透着异界之意，仿佛人声与熊吼交织在一起。
The human, broad and imposing, hefts a wicked axe over their shoulder. The furs and hides draping their impressive frame indicate a frigid homeland and an upbringing on the fringes of society. As battle commences, the warrior hefts their axe and looses an otherworldly roar, a mingling of human and bear.

Sleeping Velociraptors.name:
沉睡的迅猛龙
Sleeping Velociraptors

Text.text:
一阵柔和而有节奏的颤鸣合唱，伴随着沉睡的迅猛龙群平稳的呼吸声回荡；它们的凶性在梦中被压低，仿佛也学会了温顺。然而，对这些爬行类的噩梦而言，休息不过是幻象——一层随时可撕下的伪装，只待它们嗅到机会逼近。附近灌木丛里一阵窸窣声响，覆鳞的眼睑倏然掀开，肌肉绷紧，如弓上弦，随时扑杀。
A chorus of soft, rhythmic trills accompanies the steady breaths of the sleeping raptor pack, their ferocity muted in slumber. But rest is merely an illusion to these reptilian nightmares, a façade to be cast aside when they sense opportunity approach. A rustle in the nearby bushes causes scaled eyelids to flick open as muscles tense, ready to pounce.

Short-barreled Hunting Carbine.name:
短管狩猎卡宾枪
Short-barreled Hunting Carbine

Text.text:
这把卡宾枪的枪管短而轻盈，便于在野外灵活转向与操控。它专为机动作战人员而生，依旧保有同类武器的致命威力，却以牺牲射程换取速度。一具简洁的反射式瞄具已安装在枪上，确保近距离交战时的精准击发。
The barrel of this carbine is short and lightweight for increased maneuverability in the field. Designed to complement mobile operators, this carbine still packs the lethal punch of its compatriots but sacrifices range for speed. A simple reflex sight has been mounted on the gun for close-quarters precision.

四条笨拙畸形的腿支撑着一具怪诞的血肉躯体，身上长满了眼睛，仿佛随意散落在各个位置。手臂从躯干上突生而出，末端是变形的爪手，伸出、抓挠，向它所能触及的一切胡乱攫取。它的身体从正中被劈开，几乎一直裂到腰部，仿佛遭斧刃开膛；然而裂口里并非内脏，而是怪物那深不见底的巨口。层层锯齿般的牙列在浓稠唾液的光泽中闪烁，贪婪地等待着那乱舞的手臂很快就会奉上的下一口猎物。
Four clumsy, misshapen legs hold aloft a grotesque fleshy body with numerous eyes in seemingly random locations. The arms sprout from the body and end in malformed claw-hands that reach and grasp at any- and everything they can. Its body is split down the center nearly to the waist, as if by an axe, but rather than organs, the opening houses the monster’s cavernous mouth. Row after row of serrated teeth, glistening with a thick saliva, eagerly await the next morsel the flailing arms will soon provide.

Divine Ice Palace Of A Goddess Of Winter.name:
冬之女神的神圣冰宫
Divine Ice Palace Of A Goddess Of Winter

Text.text:
在高耸冰川的断崖上，一道锯齿般的冰栅守护着那座半透明的湛蓝宫殿。殿内有影子游走，仿佛灰色幽魂穿墙而过。窗户足有三层楼高，由嵌铅玻璃筑成，天然霜华凝作晶莹壁画。覆雪的尖塔触及骄阳，倔强地拒绝融化。风沿着墙面嗡鸣，像校音管般拉出细长音调。银与蓝的巨大翼帆在屋脊上方起伏拍击，噼啪作响。蔚蓝的咸水海湾倒映着冰川与这座传世庄园。
On the bluff of a high glacier, guarded by a palisade of jagged ice, stands the translucent blue palace. Shapes move inside, like gray ghosts through the walls. The windows are three stories tall, built of leaded glass and naturally frosted with crystalline murals. Snow-capped towers reach to the sun, refusing to melt. Wind hums along the walls like a pitch pipe. Great pinions of silver and blue ripple and snap over the rooftops. The cerulean saltwater bay reflects the glacier and the storied estate.

橡木与雪松镶板散发出宜人的木香，柔和地融入铁匠炉的烟火气与空气中金属的辛辣腥味。铁炉前方的铺面陈列着用于精细金丝与珠宝工艺的工具，四周的架子与挂杆上摆着、挂着数以百计的铜制品：坐骑护甲、护套、炊具、用于屋顶与门的装饰压条、护甲上的饰件——大多呈现出醒目的橙铜色泽，也有些覆着青绿铜锈。
Oak and cedar paneling add a pleasant aroma to the smoky smell of the forge and the tang of metal in the air. The shop in front of the forge displays the tools for fine work in wire and jewelry, and contains shelves and hangers with hundreds of pieces of copper: barding, sheathing, cookware, lengths of trim for roofs and doors, ornaments for armor—most in the distinctive orange hues, some in green patina.

这座宽阔的外堡沿着边缘排布着数座建筑，中央的鹅卵石空地则敞开着，作阅兵与操练之用。马厩、营房、铁匠铺、粮仓、鸽舍、犬舍，以及一道向下延伸的阶梯——通往本该是蓄水池的所在——紧贴着外墙而建。两处建筑的烟囱正袅袅升烟。从那令人愉悦的香气判断，它们分别是面包房与厨房。
This large bailey hosts several structures around its edges, leaving the cobbled center open as a parade and training ground. A stable, garrison, smithy, granary, dovecote, kennel, and stairs—down to what should be a cistern—hug the curtain walls. Smoke rises from the chimneys of two structures. From the pleasant scents, they are the bakery and kitchen.

这面熨斗盾仿佛由某种起伏如波的合金锻成，金属轻盈，却又坚不可摧。它贴合地倚在背上，长长的 guige 系带让持用者能迅捷而轻松地将它套上手臂。盾面正中饰着一只独眼，涂以奢华浓丽的颜料，永不黯淡，也从不剥落。当人将盾套上前臂，便会骤然感到神思清明、警觉陡增，四周的视与听都变得格外锐利，仿佛获得了超自然的察觉。

~ Envisioned by Gernura Torevir

The heater shield appears forged of some rippled alloy, its metal light yet undeniably unyielding. It fits comfortably against one’s back, the long guige strap allowing the wielder to slip it onto their arm quickly and easily. A cycloptic eye adorns the shield’s front, painted in lavish paint that never dulls or chips. As one slips the shield onto their forearm, they feel suddenly awake and alert, seeing and hearing clearer all around them with a supernatural perception.

~ Envisioned by Gernura Torevir

覆着铆钉铁箍的橡木粗壮弓臂主宰了这把弩的外形，那惊人的负载几乎不可能由弩身承受。弓铁两侧升起一对金色鹿角，令这件武器的轮廓更显庄严；弩身上则饰着一幅褪色却依旧瑰丽的图案——一头跃起的象牙白雄鹿。
Weighty limbs of oak banded by riveted iron dominate the crossbow’s form, their bulk almost impossibly large upon the frame. Golden antlers rise either side of the bow irons to form a majestic sight for the weapon, and a faded yet beautiful image of a leaping ivory stag decorates the crossbow’s body.

Quip By A Party Member About Leaving Hom.name:
某位队友半开玩笑地嘀咕：“离家那一刻我才发现，门一关，后路也跟着关上了。”
Quip By A Party Member About Leaving Home

Text.text:
“我还以为离开家、踏上冒险人生后就能自由了。可那些回忆一直跟着我，把一切都拖得沉甸甸的。”
“I thought I’d be free once I left my home and began a life of adventure. But I keep bringing my memories along, which drags the whole thing down.”

Alien Fruit Basket.name:
异星果篮
Alien Fruit Basket

Text.text:
篮筐把手的几何形状一眼就能看出，它们根本不是为人类的手而设计的。容器本身也由沉重的材质打造——某种异星金属——其缘由很快便昭然若揭。有人从旁经过，随手丢进几块水果；那些椭长果身上的锯齿尖刺撞击着篮壁，发出叮当作响的金属碰撞声。
The geometry of the handles on the basket makes it clear they were not designed for human hands. The container is made of heavy material as well—some kind of alien metal—and the reason why is soon clear. Someone walks by and deposits a few pieces of fruit, the jagged spikes along their oblong bodies clanging against the sides of the basket.

Insult About Manners.name:
关于礼数的侮辱
Insult About Manners

Text.text:
“你就不能挤出一点体面来吗？还是非得让我们都受你情绪失禁的罪？”
“Can you muster a shred of decorum, or must we all suffer your emotional incontinence?”

Seaside Tavern With Local Delicacy.name:
海滨酒馆与本地珍馐
Seaside Tavern With Local Delicacy

Text.text:
你踏入海边酒馆，香料的辛香与炙烤鲜鱼的诱人气息交织扑面。伙计们来回穿梭，在人潮间穿针引线，忙着上菜、收盘、催单。后方那扇来回摆动的门缝里，你瞥见宽敞的厨房，两名厨师正手忙脚乱地翻炒，海味琳琅，热气蒸腾。一个碗从你鼻尖掠过，你不由被那勾魂的香气攥住了心神。你从菜里拈起一截触手塞入口中，辛辣珍馐的层层甜意在舌尖绽开，复杂而迷人。

~ crunchyzombies on Discord

The odor of spices mingles with the tantalizing scent of seared fish as you enter the seaside tavern. Workers bustle to and fro, serving a throng of patrons as they fill orders and collect dishes. Through the swinging door at the back, you see a large kitchen and two chefs hastily cooking a variety of delicious-looking seafood. A bowl passes under your nose and you find yourself entranced by the enchanting aroma of the dish. Plucking a tentacle from the dish, you pop it into your mouth and delight in the complex sweetness of the spicy delicacy.

~ crunchyzombies on Discord

一件粗糙的羊毛斗篷裹着蜷倒在树根旁休息的身影，附近草丛里躺着一柄血迹斑斑的长剑。苍蝇饥渴地嗡嗡盘旋在尸体周围，以及那些撕裂不幸流浪者腹部、令其肠腹外翻的参差豁口上。
A rough woolen cloak shrouds the slumped form resting at the foot of a tree, and a bloodied sword lies in the grass nearby. Flies buzz hungrily around the corpse and the ragged gashes that have eviscerated the unfortunate wanderer’s abdomen.

Dwarven War Machine.name:
矮人战争机器
Dwarven War Machine

Text.text:
加固的矿车那凹痕斑驳的铁制车架上，塞满了各式各样夺命的改装：从呼啸旋转的刀刃到致命的尖刺，一应俱全。两名咆哮的矮人操纵着它，矿车在战场上横冲直撞——身后只余一片毁灭。从车顶上，重型弩机连连迸射弩矢，射手转动着万向支架上的武器，对准迎面扑来的敌人。
The reinforced mine-cart hosts a plethora of death-dealing additions on its dented iron chassis: from whirling blades to deadly spikes. Crewed by two roaring dwarves, the cart charges across the battlefield—leaving destruction in its wake. From atop the wagon, bolts fly from a heavy crossbow as the gunner swivels the gimballed weapon to face their oncoming foes.

Loot From A Salamander.name:
从火蜥蜴身上搜刮的战利品
Loot From A Salamander

Text.text:
黑曜石铁匠的工具散落在地，那些切割平滑的熔岩玻璃在死去蝾螈忽明忽暗的躯体光芒下闪烁着冷光。不远处几尺外，躺着一把武器——一柄以赤褐色金属打造的十字矛头长矛。长矛仍散发着阵阵热浪，但也正逐渐消退——就像那蝾螈体内的余辉一样。
Obsidian smith’s tools are strewn on the ground, the smoothly cut lava-glass winking in the light of the dead salamander’s flickering body. A weapon, a crosshead spear crafted of reddish-brown metal, lies a few feet away. The spear still emanates waves of heat, but this too is dwindling—just like the glow within the salamander itself.

你的双眼映出浩瀚虚空的漆黑无光，陌异的胡言从你唇间倾泻而出，带着溃烂脓疮般令人作呕的腥苦。彼岸有某物回应，随即一股寒意渗入此世，灵质雾霭凝结成一头畸变骇怖的怪物之形。
Your eyes reflect the expanse's vacuous black, and alien babble spills from your lips with the distaste of a suppurating wound. Something answers from the other side, then a chill seeps into this world as ectoplasmic mist takes on the shape of an aberrant horror.

Dwarven Workshop With Rune-engraved Tool.name:
刻满符文的矮人工坊
Dwarven Workshop With Rune-engraved Tools

Text.text:
工人们沿着店内一排排长桌坐开，坐在金属高脚凳上，兴致勃勃地埋头忙活着一堆古怪的装置零件。每个人都穿着厚重的皮围裙、工作手套，戴着几乎遮住整张脸的巨大护目镜。那些防护道具的重要性很快就显露出来：他们的修修补补时不时迸出意外的火花，或是划出一道口子，又或“啪”地猛然回弹——结果只好把胡子燎得焦卷，或被生生夹掉一撮。各式工具上都刻着符文，随器具不同闪着黄铜或银色的光泽。刻着金色符文的工具被陈列在店铺后方的展示柜里，柜门被一把挂锁死死扣住，锁上并排开着三个形状各异的钥匙孔。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Workers line the long tables of this shop, seated on metal stools and happily toiling over an odd array of gadgetry. They all wear heavy leather aprons, working gloves, and huge goggles that cover most of their faces. The importance of the protective gear becomes clear as their tinkering results in unexpected sparks, cuts, or snaps—leading to singed or clipped beards. The tools are engraved with runes, shining brass or silver depending on the implement. Tools with golden runes are displayed in a case at the back of the shop, the doors held tightly shut by a padlock with three differently shaped keyholes.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Cast Ray Of Enfeeblement.name:
我施放“虚弱射线”
I Cast Ray Of Enfeeblement

Text.text:
一股冰冷的刺痛窜过我全身每一处关节，浓烈的腐朽气息笼罩整个区域。我舌尖尝到腐烂的味道，抬手指向我的目标，低声吐出咒文。一道能量射线自我指尖迸发，尖啸如幽灵（特征），如针般钻入目标的肌肉、骨骼与心智。他们的呼吸变得短促，双眼因疲惫而浑浊湿润。
A cold sensation twinges in every joint in my body and a strong scent of decay falls over the area. I taste rot on my tongue as I point to my target and speak the words of my incantation. A ray of energy surges from my finger, howling like a ghost as it needles its way into my target’s muscles, bones, and mind. Their breath shortens and their eyes turn rheumy with fatigue.

Sundries From A Gold Dragon Lair.name:
来自金龙巢穴的杂项
Sundries From A Gold Dragon Lair

Text.text:
散落在白骨之间的盗贼护甲碎片、背包与制毒工具包上，全都留着巨齿啃噬造成的伤害。附近立着一架马车大小的算盘，斜倚支撑着；那些苹果般大的算珠侧面，还隐约可见淡淡的爪痕。
The pieces of rogue armor, bags, and poisoner's kits strewn among the bones all have the damage of enormous teeth on them. Nearby, an abacus the size of a horse cart stands propped up, with faint claw marks on the sides of the apple-sized beads.

Sundries From Black Flies.name:
黑蝇杂货
Sundries From Black Flies

Text.text:
被灭绝的那团黑蝇云，既不多也不少，不过是一堆软烂肿胀的虫尸，落在地上仍在抽搐，渗出带着瘟腐气息的脓汁。
The exterminated cloud of black flies is nothing more, nor less, than a mound of squashy, bloated insect bodies, twitching on the ground, oozing pestilent ichor.

Potion Of Giant Strength.name:
巨人力量药水
Potion Of Giant Strength

Text.text:
塞着瓶塞的瓶子看起来不过装着寻常的泉水——也就是那种“寻常的泉水”，其中还浸着一片巨大而参差的指甲碎片，至少有两英寸长，来自某种凶邪生物。若你喝下这瓶药水，不由得会想：那指甲是否柔软到能直接咽下，还是你得把它嚼碎。
The stoppered bottle looks like it contains nothing more than ordinary spring water—that is, ordinary spring water that contains an enormous piece of jagged fingernail, no less than two inches long, from some fell creature. If you were to drink the potion, you wonder if the nail is soft enough to swallow or if you will have to chew.

你的法术沿着路由器端口的代码扭动钻行，钻进一个由经由该路由器的设备与服务器传递的按键与动作汇聚成的小小囊袋。法术翻搅、盘绕、汇整信息，抽出清单，将其按时代与行动梳理归档；于是，一条路径被铺陈出来，指向那一切寻常路由器行动尽头所藏着的——已被删除的浏览器历史记录。
Your spell squirms around a router’s port code into a little pocket of transferred keystrokes and actions by devices and servers using the router. The spell writhes and collates, pulls the list, organizes it between time and activity, and the path is laid to a deleted browser history found at the end of all that simple router activity.

I Perform Superior Inspiration.name:
我施展至臻灵感
I Perform Superior Inspiration

Text.text:
命运的丝线再度交汇，召唤我们重返战场；而我的缪斯在耳畔低语，捎来胜利的讯息。我微微一笑。我会把这来自命运的呢喃锻造成振奋人心的旋律，或一句鼓舞的话语，去帮助我的某位同伴。
The fates align to call us to battle once again, and my muse whispers to me a message of triumph. I smile. I’ll shape this murmur from destiny into a rousing tune, or words of encouragement, to help one of my friends.

Loot From A Young Silver Dragon.name:
来自一条年轻银龙的战利品
Loot From A Young Silver Dragon

Text.text:
白银与白金币钱币在冰川山岳的洞窟里堆成一座座小山，每一枚都像在诱惑着觊觎之徒伸手来偷。堆丘之间散落着色泽幽深而妖艳的蓝绿宝石，被摆成旋涡般的纹路，时而让人恍惚看见浪潮在此处流动。钻石在巢穴冰冷的光里闪烁，光辉映在垂挂于天花板的冰锥上，折射出刺骨的寒意。倚着洞壁，一幅镶金嵌饰的抛光木框肖像静静立着：画中微笑的贵族一家守望着这堆宝藏。
Silver and platinum coins rest in heaped piles around the glacial mountain cavern, each a tempting prize for would-be thieves. Between the mounds are loose gemstones of deep, lurid blues and greens, arranged in swirling patterns to give the impression of waves in motion here and there. Diamonds sparkle in the cold light of the den, their luster reflecting from the icicles clinging to the ceiling. Resting against the wall in a polished wooden frame inlaid with gold, the portrait of a smiling noble family watches over the hoard.

Riverside Border Town In Spring.name:
春日河畔边境小镇
Riverside Border Town In Spring

Text.text:
穿过桥时——你得挤过一辆正被搜查的大马车——随后便通过坚固的城门，守卫只漫不经心地扫了你一眼。街道上挤满了交谈的行人，许多人提着篮子，有的空着，有的装得满满当当。惨白的建筑上悬挂着招牌，色彩鲜艳地宣告：春之祭典今日开幕。
After crossing the bridge—requiring squeezing past a large wagon being searched—you pass through the sturdy gate with no more than a cursory glance from the guards. The streets are full of chatting folk, many carrying baskets, both empty and full. Signs hang from stark white buildings, colorfully proclaiming that the spring festival begins today.

Menacing Corporate Skyscraper.name:
令人胆寒的企业摩天大楼
Menacing Corporate Skyscraper

Text.text:
一座漆黑的尖塔自商业区的灰雾中拔地而起——钢与玻璃盘旋成双螺旋的扭曲形态——低垂的雨云遮住了它究竟有多高。无数镜面般的窗格映着城市黯淡的光，沿着塔身投下不祥的阴影。入口上方悬着公司的标识，硕大而不容错认的字母泛着病态的黄光。这些字句向外辐射着品牌本身——像在宇宙上烙下所有权的印章。入口两侧各立着一名沉默的巨汉，身着笔挺的西装，守卫如雕像般一动不动。
A dark spire rises from the gray haze of the business district—a double-helix twist of steel and glass—low rain clouds obscuring the full scope of its height. Uncountable mirrored windows reflect the dull light of the city, forming sinister shadows along the tower. Above the entrance hangs the corporate logo in large and unmistakable letters, glowing a sickly yellow. These words radiate the brand—a stamp of ownership on the universe. Two silent giants in sharp suits stand guard either side of the entrance.

Cyberpsycho With Removed Implants.name:
移除植入体的赛博精神病患者
Cyberpsycho With Removed Implants

Text.text:
她剃光的头皮上布满淤青凹坑，像被钝器啄出的伤洞。曾经点缀着那套无疑精巧、令人叹服的义体的纹身，如今却环抱着被生生挖去后留下的空无。她浑身一颤，双手死死交扣，指甲在皮肉上压出印痕，硬是挤出几滴鲜亮的血珠。两道将干未干的泪痕在她脸颊上发着冷光。她嘴唇向后绷成痛苦的狞笑，身体前后摇晃，喃喃反复吟念：“好疼，好疼，好疼……”她用力紧闭布满血丝的眼睛，泪水又一次决堤般汹涌而下。
Bruised cavities pock her shaved head. Tattoos that once accented undoubtedly intricate and impressive cybernetics now cradle the voids left behind. She shudders, hands clasped together so tightly her nails mark her skin, coaxing out bright droplets of blood. Streams of drying tears gleam from her cheeks. Her lips pull back into a pained grimace as she rocks back and forth and chants, “It hurts, it hurts, it hurts…” She squeezes her bloodshot eyes shut and rivers of tears surge anew.

Nighttime Sounds In Ancient Arena.name:
古竞技场的夜之声
Nighttime Sounds In Ancient Arena

Text.text:
尽管夜里惯常的声响——蝉鸣与狼嚎——依旧如常回荡，但那些把这座古老竞技场遗迹当作巢穴的小动物的窸窣动静，也在这片荒废的地界间层层回响。诡异的是，它们听起来竟像战士在沙地上挪步换架的摩擦声；那狼嚎也仿佛野性斗士爆出的残忍战吼。
Though the usual nighttime sounds—cicadas chirping and wolves howling—are as present, the movements of the small animals who have made the ruins of this ancient arena their home echo around the derelict parcel of land. In an eerie way, they sound rather like the shifting of a warrior’s stance on the sands, the howling of wolves not unlike a savage war cry from a feral combatant.

Goggles Of Night.name:
夜视护目镜
Goggles Of Night

Text.text:
闪烁的水晶镜片严丝合缝地嵌入这副古怪的护目镜中，将佩戴者的双眼显著放大。抛光黄铜镜架带着鲜明的鸟类风格：弯曲如喙的鼻梁护罩一应俱全，点缀其上的羽饰纹样更添灵动。
Shimmering crystal lenses fit snugly into the curious goggles, magnifying the eyes of the wearer by a significant degree. The polished brass frame has a distinctly avian design, complete with a curved, beak-like nose guard and decorative feather motifs.

一段柔韧而粗硬的皮革自成型的握柄处延伸而出。末端散开数缕凶狠的皮条，专为撕裂而制，凡是能咬住的东西都要被它们深深扯开。
The flexible length of harsh leather extends from a formed handle. Vicious strands stray from the end, fashioned to tear deeply into anything they can sink their teeth into.

Goddess Of Harvest.name:
丰收女神
Goddess Of Harvest

Text.text:
她丰腴，热心，笑意盈盈，土地的丰饶自她身上漫出。勤劳的母神披着所谓男人的衣裳——帆布长裤、被汗点斑驳的素棉衬衫、编织背心与一顶草帽。她的靴子温暖而柔韧，长满老茧的双手给予叶与茎最完美的接触。她是田野的安眠，也是冬日储藏间的底货。夕阳西沉、筐篮满盈之时，她坐在摆着陶器的餐桌上首。
She is ample, warm-hearted and smiling, and from her emanates the fertility of the land. Hard-working Mother Goddess in so-called man’s clothes—canvas trousers, plain cotton shirt speckled with sweat, a woven vest, and a straw hat. Her boots are warm and supple, her callused hands deliver the perfect touch to leaf and stalk. She is a field’s sleep and the stock of a winter pantry. She sits at the head of the table, set with earthenware, at the sunset when the baskets are full.

那蛇形身影披着一袭如斗篷般流光的金色长发，明亮的绿蛇眼冷冷逼人，左脸颊留着灼烧后的伤痕。古老的维里迪安冷得像深秋，静得如池面无波。身着丝衣的蛇人散发出守护般的强韧气场，可那双眼却泄露出危险者冷血而疏离的漠然。电光一闪，维里迪安唤出银色鳞片护甲、一把弧形匕首——翡翠柄首幽光内敛——以及一枚银戒，蓝光瞬间灌满整间屋子。一只小妖精（特征）达夫隆在维里迪安肩头轻颤飞舞。

~ 由 Bradley S. Smith

The serpentine figure has long shimmering blond hair like a cloak, bright green snake eyes, and a burned left cheek. Ancient Veridian is as cool as late autumn, calm as the surface of a pond. A feeling of protective strength emanates from the silk-dressed snakefolk, but the eyes reveal the cold-blooded detachment of the dangerous. In a flash, Veridian conjures silver scale armor, a curved dagger with an emerald pommel, and a silver ring that fills the room with blue light. A small sprite, Davron, flutters at Veridian’s shoulder.

~ Played by Bradley S. Smith

Barbarian Settlement Elder.name:
野蛮人聚落长老
Barbarian Settlement Elder

Text.text:
那女人坐在一张雕工繁复、彩绘华丽的凳子上；凳子又立在一块耀眼的白色皮毛地毯上，那是某种巨型掠食者的整张皮。年代与安逸让她的皮肤松弛下垂，但你仍能从皱纹之下察觉到一股结实的肌韧。她枯槁的脸从一圈白发的光晕中阴沉地瞪视而出，却仿佛越过你的肩头望向别处。此刻你才看清，她的眼睛已然浑浊。
The woman sits upon an elaborately carved and painted stool, which itself stands on a rug of brilliant white fur, the pelt of some great predator. Age and idleness have slackened the woman’s skin, but you detect a muscular toughness beneath her wrinkles. Her wizened face glares out from a halo of white hair, but she looks over your shoulder. You see now that her eyes are clouded.

你面前的转经轮与圣水盆在凝聚的神圣能量中微微颤动。一缕清冷的蓝光自你伸展的指尖飘出，缝合伤口，止住血流，接正断骨，将破碎的血肉重新织就。
The prayer wheel and basin of holy water before you tremble with coalescing divine energy. A cooling blue light drifts from your outstretched fingers, stiching wounds, staunching bloodflow, setting bones, and knitting flesh.

Precious-metal Trading Ingot.name:
贵金属交易锭
Precious-metal Trading Ingot

Text.text:
这块小锭子泛着迷人的虹彩光泽，价值一眼可见。虽不比你的手掌大，却比多数人一年挣得还要值钱——而他们也心知肚明。
The small block shimmers enticingly with a chromatic sheen, its value evident to behold. Though no bigger than your palm, this precious ingot is worth more than most people make in a year—and they know it.

老兵总有一种特有的神情，冒险者亦然——至少那些活得够久的。你知道该看什么：形形色色的伤疤、古怪的纪念物、魔法物品。但有一样最藏不住的破绽——就在这名女子的眼里。她目光死死钉在空间的某一点，沉溺于回忆之中。她看上去……像被阴影纠缠着。
Old soldiers have a certain look, and so it is with adventurers—at least, those who live long enough. There are signs to look for: scars of all sorts, strange souvenirs, magic items. But there’s one dead giveaway, and you see it in the eyes of this woman as she stares fixedly into space, lost in memories. She appears . . . haunted.

Elegant Bathroom In A Manor.name:
庄园里的雅致浴室
Elegant Bathroom In A Manor

Text.text:
这间浴室的地面、墙面与各处装饰都镶着手工雕琢的石砖；每一块都刻着一幕独立而繁复的场景——两位国王间的著名大战、缔结两大领域的历史婚礼、臭名昭著的巫师编织他们的魔法。带爪足的铸铁浴缸几乎占据了整个空间，尺寸大得惊人，若有需要，足以同时容纳数人浸泡。两只铁制水嘴供水，热水由庄园深处的炉火加热后送来。一面镶着金丝花纹边饰的镜子悬在巨大的大理石水盆上方，盆中盛满芬芳的水，供人洗净双手。
The handcrafted stone tiles lining the floor, walls, and fixtures of this bathroom each depict a unique and incredibly detailed scene—a famous battle between two kings, the historic marriage that united two domains, an infamous wizard weaving their magic. A cast iron tub with clawed feet dominates the space, large enough to fit several at a time if the need arises. A pair of iron spigots provide the water, heated in a furnace deep within the manor. A mirror, trimmed with gold filigree, hangs above a large, marble basin, itself brimming with perfumed water for washing one's hands.

Adult Nyssholora.name:
成年尼索霍洛拉
Adult Nyssholora

Text.text:
一头巨硕的鳞甲蜥蜴猛然撞破灌木丛，血盆大口张开，饥饿的咆哮震耳欲聋。它的体型昭示着它是顶级掠食者：成排针尖般的獠牙，前臂如镰刀般锋利，淡紫斑点的皮下肌肉翻涌起伏，沉重而有力。它不需要伪装。
A colossal, scaled lizard crashes through the undergrowth, maw agape with roaring hunger. Its size marks it an apex predator: rows of needlelike fangs, forearms like scythes, and a rippling weight of muscle beneath its lilac-spotted hide. It has no need for camouflage.

随着你一个手势，一颗半透明的纯粹力场之球骤然成形；无形的物质噼啪迸鸣着力量，任何试图撕开其边界的努力都将无功而返。
At your gesture, a semi-translucent sphere made of pure force springs into being, the invisible matter crackling with power, impenetrable to all attempts to breach its boundaries.

羊身上的羊毛被它伤口渗出的鲜血零星染成猩红。那野兽的嘴半张着，粉红的舌头无力地耷拉在外，瞪大的眼睛一眨不眨地望向天空。
The sheep’s wool has been sporadically dyed crimson by the blood seeping from its wounded body. The beast’s mouth hangs open, a pink tongue lolling out, and wide eyes stare unblinkingly to the sky.

Corridor Of A Manor.name:
庄园长廊
Corridor Of A Manor

Text.text:
一条猩红地毯沿走廊铺展至尽头；高耸的墙面悬挂着无价的挂毯与绘画，并点缀着修复的古老壁画。庭园中新采的鲜花摆在一处处小桌上，夹在走廊诸多房门之间；烛火则按固定间距摇曳闪动。
A crimson carpet spans the length of the corridor, its soaring walls adorned with priceless tapestries, paintings, and recovered ancient frescoes. Fresh flowers from the grounds' gardens adorn tables here and there, set between the doors of the corridor's many rooms, while candles flicker at regular intervals.

Brain In A Jar.name:
罐中之脑
Brain In A Jar

Text.text:
罐子的玻璃寒意先一步穿透你的皮肤，直到意识追上，你才察觉里面竟有一颗大脑。它连着一对漂浮在液中的眼球，忽明忽暗；那些曾经驱动躯体的器官在新巢里扭动、挤压，发出黏腻的蠕响。你还隐约辨得出原本是嘴的东西在抽搐乱动——如今只剩一滩血肉与黏浆，咕嘟作响。
The cold of the jar’s glass penetrates your skin before your mind registers the presence of the brain within. It’s connected to a pair of free-floating eyes, which flash as the organs that once moved a body squirm and squidge in their new home. You can also make out the gibbering movements of what was once a mouth but is now reduced to a puddle of gore and goop.

I Cast Daylight.name:
我施放【昼光术】
I Cast Daylight

Text.text:
我闭上双眼，凝神召唤体内的光芒。我将思绪系于欢愉之事——孩童嬉闹的笑声、最爱佳肴的第一口、初吻那一瞬的悸动——并吟诵出法术的词句。我感到一股暖意在掌心渐渐汇聚；当我睁开眼，便见光在指间流转，如缎带般的能量旋绕飞舞。我抬手指向我的目标，含笑看着它沐浴在辉煌的光耀之中。
I close my eyes and concentrate on summoning my inner light. I focus my thoughts on joyous things—the playful laughter of children, the first bite of my favorite meal, the feeling of my very first kiss—and intone the words of the spell. I feel a warmth building in my hands and as I open my eyes, I see light playing about them in swirling ribbons of energy. I point toward my target and smile as it is bathed in glorious illumination.

你早就为此做足了准备。正因如此，你才雇了匠人，用上等骨料为你雕出一尊塑像；也正因如此，你才让珠宝匠为那塑像缀满宝石，尤其对用作眼珠的石头挑剔得近乎苛刻。珠宝匠曾对最终成形的那件俗艳摆件嗤笑不已。可现在，究竟是谁在笑？
You planned for this. It is why you commissioned an artisan to craft a statue of you from fine bone. And why you had a jeweler bedeck that statue with gems, being particularly picky about the stones used for its eyes. The jeweler snickered at the gaudy bauble that resulted. But who is laughing now?

Overheard Conversation By A Small Monste.name:
被一只小怪物偷听到的关于人类的对话
Overheard Conversation By A Small Monster About Humans

Text.text:
“臭烘烘的人类就爱显摆。干干净净的，还长得老高。哼，我们把他们放倒点儿，不是吗？先把他们脚踝掰断，再一路往上收拾。到那时，他们就再也神气不起来了。”
“Stinkin’ humans always showin’ off. Being all clean and tall. Well, we take them down a bit, don’t we? Snap their ankles and work our way up. Then they ain’t so proud.”

Haunted House: Bathroom.name:
闹鬼宅邸：浴室
Haunted House: Bathroom

Text.text:
你顺应生理的召唤，走进屋里的茅厕方便。可当你听见幽暗深处传来一声响亮的吮吸声时，不由得怀疑——也许到头来，用夜壶反而更稳妥。
Heeding the call of nature, you enter the house’s privy to do your business. When you hear a loud sucking noise coming from its darkened depths, you wonder if perhaps it would be better to use a chamber pot, after all.

Bloodthirsty, Emaciated Vampire.name:
嗜血、枯槁的吸血鬼（特征）
Bloodthirsty, Emaciated Vampire

Text.text:
一具蜷缩成团的皱巴巴身影像受惊的虫子般抱紧自己，喘息不止，浑身发抖。你一靠近，它便抬起头，发丝稀疏黏连，如蛛网般拉丝。獠牙与凹陷的双颊后，一条干枯的猩红舌头无力垂出；纸一般的皮肤片片剥落，落在胸前。它的目光死死钉住你，瞳孔急剧扩张，直至从眼睑到眼睑尽成一片漆黑。它嘶哑地啼出一声凄厉尖叫，孱弱的四肢猛然绷直，细薄的肌肉抽紧，蓄势欲扑。
A crumpled figure is curled in on itself like a frightened bug, wheezing and shaking. At your approach, it lifts its head, hair stringy as cobwebs. A dry, red tongue lolls from behind fanged teeth and gaunt cheeks, papery skin falling in flakes upon its chest. Eyes fix upon you, dilating until they become black from lid to lid. It crows out a haggard cry and its frail limbs snap to attention, thin muscles flexing in preparation to pounce.

Elderly Brachylophosaurus.name:
年迈的短冠龙
Elderly Brachylophosaurus

Text.text:
那生物的身躯微微战栗着，用疲惫而苍老的双腿撑起身子，伸展身躯，试图触及树上最低处的叶片。那只冠饰恐龙的鳞片早已随时代褪去年轻的光泽，变得黯淡磨损，仿佛它正啃食的那株古树的树皮一般粗粝斑驳。蜥蜴带着痛楚地哼了一声，舌头缠上枝条，将其丰茂的叶子尽数剥落，随后伏下身来进食，带着胜利般的一声长叹。
The creature’s body trembles as it rises on weary, aged legs, stretching to reach the lowest leaves of the tree. The crested dinosaur’s scales have lost much of their youthful luster over time, becoming faded and worn like the bark of the ancient tree it is grazing upon. With a pained grunt, the lizard’s tongue wraps around a branch, stripping it of its bountiful leaves, and settles down to eat with a triumphant sigh.

Icy Wasteland: Hiking Over Open Snow.name:
冰封荒原：踏越无垠雪野
Icy Wasteland: Hiking Over Open Snow

Text.text:
你眯起眼抵抗狂风，偏过头去，艰难地想看清前路。然而无论你朝哪边望去，风早已在那里，逼得你泪水盈眶——你能感觉到它们在脸颊上凝成霜。你仍旧不知疲倦地跋涉，因为只要还在前行，就意味着你还活着。
You squint against the wind and turn your head, struggling to see the way forward. But no matter which way you look, the wind is already there, bringing tears to your eyes—which you can feel turning to frost on your cheeks. You trudge relentlessly on, because if you’re moving, it means you’re still alive.

你眼前这座碗状山谷一望即知，既非自然侵蚀的产物，也不可能出自智慧生灵之手。盆地圆得近乎完美，边缘锋利如刃，无声地证明曾有天外之物以骇人的速度撞击于此。也许它仍躺在那里，深深嵌在陨坑的正中央？
It is immediately clear that the bowl-shaped valley before you is neither the product of natural erosion nor the hands of sentient beings. The perfect roundness of the basin and the sharpness of its edges are tacit evidence of a crash by a heavenly body traveling at fantastic speed. Perhaps the it lies there still, embedded in the crater’s center?

就在你前方的阴影里，成群蝙蝠自栖处俯冲而下，旋即在半空骤然汇聚，迅速蜕变，化作一名迷人的人形：五官清俊，四肢匀称。这个肤色苍白的身影带着一种令人心折的魅力，却也透着捕食者般的寒意……当它微启双唇，獠牙一点点探出时，你便明白，自己面对的是不死者之一——嗜血的饮血怪物，誓要取你性命，或将你拖入不死之途。
From the shadows just ahead of you bats swoop down from their perches, then suddenly coalesce, quickly metamorphosing into an alluring human, fair of feature and sporting well-formed limbs. There is something charming about this pale-skinned individual, but something predatory too… As its lips part and fangs begin to emerge, you know that you face one of the undead, a blood-drinker bent on your death—or possibly undeath.

Loot From A Marilith.name:
玛莉莉丝的战利品
Loot From A Marilith

Text.text:
多臂的恶魔挥舞着足够武装整支战团的刀锋。她的弯刀散落满地，双重尖刃仍泛着毒液的油光。这些武器的锻造显然倾注了极大的心血。每一柄握把都缠着皮革，剑首镶着一圈圈雕琢成形的绿石圆片。每一把刀身上都刻着独一无二的铭文：一串凌厉如割的文字，像虫群般在靠近刀柄处攒聚翻涌。
The many-armed fiend wielded enough blades for an entire party of warriors. Her scimitars lay scattered across the ground, their dual points still oily with poison. Great care has been taken in the crafting of this weaponry. Each hilt is wrapped in leather, their pommels fitted with rounds of carved greenstone. A unique inscription has been etched into each blade: a set of slashing characters that cluster like a swarm of insects near each weapon’s hilt.

Necromancer's Blighted Wyrmlings.name:
死灵法师的凋疫幼龙
Necromancer's Blighted Wyrmlings

Text.text:
两只毫无生气的幼龙尸体扭动着，带着亡灵之属才有的诡异活力。它们腐烂的肉臭与早已令人窒息的烟尘、铁锈味混杂在一起。每一只蜥龙都发出尖锐的嘶鸣，声音交叠成一支沙哑、咕哝作响的合唱。病态的枯败覆盖了它们大半正在蜕落、崩碎的身躯，凝成苔藓般的乌黑质地——而在这些斑驳之下，仍隐约透出细微的闪光。你瞥见其中一只红鳞的冷辉，另一只则映出绿鳞的一点微芒。它们的双眼燃着奥术之火，苍白无血的舌头从针刺般的利齿后方倏然探出。

~ Envisioned by ArielleVB

Two lifeless wyrmlings wriggle with a vigor unique to those of undead ilk. The smell of their rotting flesh mingles with the smoke and iron already choking the air. Each of the draconids lets out a high screech, their voices melding in a raspy, gurgling chorus. A sickly blight covers most of their molting, crumbling bodies with a mossy black texture—though subtle shimmers peek through these splotches. You see a gleam of red scales on one and a glint of green on the other. Their eyes burn with arcane fire, while pale and bloodless tongues flick out from behind needling teeth.

~ Envisioned by ArielleVB

你登上嶙峋山丘的坡顶，眼前豁然铺开一片令人心惊的浩瀚景象。仿佛身后的群丘正是岸线，而前方则是一片无尽的沙之海洋。起伏的沙丘如巨浪般翻涌，有些竟似与你脚下的山丘一般高；其间，怪异的石塔被狂风雕琢成形，像一座座阴森的孤岛，突兀地矗立在炙烤的荒原之上。
You top the rise of a rocky hill and confront a startling expanse. It’s as if the hills behind you form the shore of an endless ocean of sand. Among the dunes that rise and fall in great waves, some seemingly as tall as the hill upon which you stand, strange towers of wind-shaped stone make eerie islands in the sunbaked landscape.

Raised Large Village.name:
抬升的大型村落
Raised Large Village

Text.text:
没人会想到，这样体型的村落竟能离地如此之高，稳稳嵌在支架的怀抱里，却既不筑入树冠，也不借助庞大的支撑结构。可这座村庄处处显露出恒久的气息。它高耸基座的秘密，在于能随天气变化与地势挪移而轻轻摇摆——数以百计的缆索被耐心地编织在巨大、刻有凹槽的石制方尖碑之间，而托架表面则铺就一块块石板路面。是生存所迫，才逼得此地的人们创造出这般社区；然而村民们依旧从容地穿行忙碌，日常的烟火气与这离奇的栖身之所形成了令人错愕的反差。
No one would expect a village of this size, cradled in its supports so far above the ground, to exist without being built into treetops or making use of extensive buttressing. But this village shows every sign of permanence. The secret of the village’s lofty foundation lies in its ability to sway in response to weather conditions and shifting of the land—with hundreds of cables painstakingly woven between enormous, notched stone obelisks, and the cradle’s surface set with flagstones. Necessity pushed the people of this settlement to invent this community, but people bustle about their everyday lives in an easy manner that defies their bizarre holdings.

你以神圣之语吐出一个字，祈请神祇赐下治疗之力。你的祈愿立刻得到回应：点点流光如尘辉般环绕伤口，带来些许缓解，驱散由此引发的痛楚。
With a single word of the divine tongue, you request the healing power of your god. The answer to your plea comes swiftly: glittering motes surround the wounds and provide some small relief from the pain they cause.

I Cast Barkskin.name:
我施放树肤术
I Cast Barkskin

Text.text:
我直接对着皮肤说话，对着毛孔与层层血肉低语。我攥紧一把树皮，另一只手平贴在我盟友的背上。毛孔里抽出纤维状的树脂，皮肤生长出橡木般粗砺而不屈的纹理，却依旧保持柔韧。这便是绿意世界的护甲。
I speak to the skin directly, to the pores and layers of flesh. I clutch a handful of bark and lay my other hand flat against the back of my ally. The pores sprout fibrous resin, and the skin grows oak rough and unyielding but still flexible. This is armor of the green world.

Sundries From A Umber Hulk.name:
来自一只褐色掘地虫的杂物
Sundries From A Umber Hulk

Text.text:
二十件寻常衣物被唾液胡乱黏合，竟搓成一颗出奇对称的球——滚动时像个容器般咔啦作响。撕开这层编织般的外皮，露出的却是一堆碎裂的基础部件，正是好几套书法工具中常见的那些。
Spittled together into an impressively symmetrical ball are twenty pieces of common clothing—forming a kind of receptacle that rattles when it rolls. Breaking the woven hide reveals a collection of broken basics that would be found in several calligraphy sets.

Hostile Ships Drop Out Of Hyperspace Ahe.name:
敌对舰船在前方脱离超空间跃迁
Hostile Ships Drop Out Of Hyperspace Ahead

Text.text:
唯一的警告，是远处一抹微弱的光芒闪烁，几乎被群星的辉光掩没。一艘线条流畅的黑色飞船以全速在前方闪现成形，丝毫没有减速的迹象，武器系统正迅速充能。紧接着，更多飞船在其后近距离接连出现。
The only warning is a faint shimmer of light off in the distance, nearly hidden among the glow of the stars. A sleek black ship blips into existence ahead at full speed, making no indication of slowing down as it powers up its weapons. More ships appear close behind.

Desperate Battlefield Embrace.name:
绝境战场的拥抱
Desperate Battlefield Embrace

Text.text:
战场喧嚣中，两道目光隔着血与铁相撞，皆燃着嗜血的凶光；两名战士怒吼着冲向彼此，狂怒如雷。刀刃轰然交击，接下来几段煎熬的瞬间里，他们死命厮杀——每一次斩击都比上一击带走更多的血——直到两人双双跪倒在地，力竭如枯。忽然间，一切归于寂静，仿佛他们踏入了周遭风暴的风眼。此刻，他们第一次真正看清对方，不再是敌手，而是一个活生生的人。违背所有理智，他们在一瞬间不受束缚、近乎绝望的连结里紧紧相拥……而一把刀悄然从肋骨间送入，伴着最后一声喀喇作响的喘息。

~ Envisioned by thebigham

Eyes meet across the clamor of battle, alight with bloodlust, as the two warriors charge toward each other bellowing in fury. Blades clash and for several agonizing moments they fight—each strike drawing more blood than the last—until both fall to their knees, utterly spent. Suddenly, all is calm, as if they have entered the eye of the storm raging around them. They truly see each other for the first time, not as adversaries but as people. Against all sense, they embrace in a moment of unbridled, desperate connection… and a knife is slipped between ribs with a last, rattling gasp.

~ Envisioned by thebigham

Dragon In Flight.name:
翱翔天际的巨龙
Dragon In Flight

Text.text:
头顶上，一条巨龙以凶猛而威严的姿态刺破长空。它那庞大的双翼舒展如幕，映着阳光，向下投落压迫感十足的阴影。每一次震得筋骨作响的振翼，生物都将自己推向更高处，狂风在它巨大的鳞甲间尖啸而过。
Above, a dragon spears through the sky with ferocious majesty. Its mammoth wings stretch wide, reflecting the sunlight and casting an imposing shadow below. With every sinew-cracking beat, the creature drives itself higher, the wind screaming across its massive scales.

Evard's Black Tentacles.name:
艾瓦德的黑触手
Evard's Black Tentacles

Text.text:
伴随一阵令人作呕的啜吸声，触手在你面前应你那可憎的号令猛然迸出。它们鼓胀着诡异的生命律动，蠕动的肢体翻卷扭绞，满覆吸盘与筋肉，攫抓四方。
A horrid slurping fills the air as tentacles erupt before you in response to your hideous command. Pulsing with eldritch life, the squirming appendages writhe and grasp in a swathe of suckers and sinew.

Inspiration About Loss.name:
关于失落的灵感
Inspiration About Loss

Text.text:
“你现在要是敢让我失手，我可饶不了你。你一倒下，我就死定了——而我不觉得这世界承受得起如此骇人的巨大损失。”
“Don’t you dare fail me now. If you fall, I’m dead, and I don’t think the world could handle such a titanic loss.”

Machine Sprite.name:
机械小妖精（特征）
Machine Sprite

Text.text:
你的小妖精（特征）起初呈现为一根导线末端的双叉插头。当它接入现实世界中某台机器的操作数据点时，插头会变形，转而映出被夺取控制权的那台机器。小妖精（特征）将插头插入数据点并悬停不动，导线另一端噼啪迸出火花，直到它把活儿干完。随后，它像鞭子一样啪地一声抽响，静待控制指令的到来。

~ 一位英雄 设想

Your sprite begins as a rendering of a two-pronged plug on the end of a wire. When it engages the operating data point for a machine in the physical world, the plug changes to represent the commandeered machine. The sprite plugs in to that data point and hovers, the other end of its wire spitting sparks until it has completed the job. Then it cracks like a whip until control input is received.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

深吸一口气，你合上双眼，将心神专注于这道守护法术。随着你低声吐出一个词，你编织起神秘能量——在脑海中将其塑形，如陶匠捏塑泥坯——它随即在你头颅周围凝成一枚球形护罩。旋涡般的屏障发出微弱嗡鸣，当法术生效之际，你感到一股不可动摇的意志之力在意识深处奔涌而起。

~ Envisioned by master_builder75

Inhaling deeply, you close your eyes, focusing on the protective spell. With a word, you weave the mystical energy—shaping it in your mind as a potter sculpts clay—and it forms a sphere around your head. The swirling barrier hums faintly, and you feel an indomitable strength of will surge through your mind as the spell takes effect.

~ Envisioned by master_builder75

The Legendary Paladin And The Lich Queen.name:
传奇圣武士与巫妖女王
The Legendary Paladin And The Lich Queen

Text.text:
“英雄凤毛麟角，不过，是的，我确实知道一位——凡世中的密尔米顿。那是一尊泰坦，鳞片流淌着超凡的辉光，奢华的白色鬃毛为他加冕。金角的完美典范，毋庸置疑。他的事迹中有一桩最为卓绝：他击败了巫妖女王。 在一具久已死去的巨像那腐朽残骸深处，我们的英雄与他的伙伴遭遇了那腐烂的君主——污秽自染血的利爪滴落，凶煞能量在她银色法杖中翻涌蠕动。仅凭她的存在，就将圣武士一行的生命力抽空，啃噬着他们的灵魂。听见同伴凄楚的哀号，我们的英雄以正义之怒发出咆哮，炽烈的羽翼自背后轰然绽放。他纵身跃上苍穹，催促追随者撤离。宛如太阳般灼亮，手持灼痛人眼的长枪，圣骑士悍然出击。恐惧女王踉跄退避，蛆虫翻涌的双眼里满是惊惶，无齿的口腔大张——就在那白炽长枪将她与她的山岳巢穴一并劈作两半的瞬间！”

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron "The Fearless"

”Heroes are few and far between, but yes, I do know of one, a myrmidon among mortals. A titan, with scales that glowed with preternatural radiance, and a sumptuous white mane crowning his head. A golden-horned paragon, to be sure. Of his deeds, one stands tall: his defeat of the Lich Queen. Deep within the decaying remains of a long-dead colossus, our hero and his companions encountered the putrescent monarch, filth dripping from crimson-stained claws, baleful energies writhing within her silvery staff. Her mere presence leached the lifeforce from the paladin’s party, feeding on their very souls. Hearing their pitiful cries, our hero roared in righteous fury and blazing wings erupted from his back. Leaping skyward, he urged his followers to flee. Glowing like the sun, blistering spear held ready, the holy knight attacked. The dread queen flinched away, terror in her maggot-filled eyes, toothless mouth agape, as the incandescent lance split her and her mountain lair in twain!”

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron "The Fearless"

Clockwork Spider Encounter.name:
发条蜘蛛遭遇
Clockwork Spider Encounter

Text.text:
伴随一阵骇人解剖般的扭动，你面前那堆杂物开始移位，仿佛被附身般缓缓隆起。残破碎料的纠缠间，肢体逐一成形；一声阴森的嘶嘶低鸣令你牙根发紧，而燃料的刺鼻气味直冲鼻腔。转瞬之间，一具噩梦般的自动机便立在你面前，支撑它的是八条分节的长腿。

~ 由 colinta Envisioned

With a hideously anatomical motion, the pile before you shifts, rising as if possessed. Limbs form amid the tangle of scrap, and a sinister hiss sets your teeth on edge as the smell of fuel breaches your nostrils. In moments, a nightmarish automaton stands before you on eight segmented legs.

~ Envisioned by colinta

Creature Speaking About Family.name:
生物说话：谈论家庭
Creature Speaking About Family

Text.text:
“人们都说家庭很重要。我也想爱我的家人——整整两百个兄弟姐妹——可母亲把他们大多都吃了。搞得团聚时特别尴尬。”
“People say family important. I want to love family, all two hundred brothers and sisters, but Mother eat most of them. Makes reunions awkward.”

从掩蔽处一跃而出的，是一头来自被遗忘的丛林世界、魁伟如山的猫科巨兽。它的躯体覆着焦橙色的皮毛，其上斜裂着错位的墨黑条纹；条纹之下，沉重的肌肉层层起伏，将那野性的流畅化作令人目眩的原始伟力。那只硕大的独眼在突出的巨口上方闪烁着掠食者的专注——巨口塞满獠牙，庞大到如残酷弯曲的长牙般外探。它的咆哮撕裂耳膜，提醒着人们：即便在幽深的太空，自然那无可阻挡的力量仍在延续。
Leaping from cover is the heavy mass of a hulking feline from a forgotten jungle world. Its frame is covered in burnt-orange fur slashed with offset stripes of inky blackness, beneath which heavy muscles ripple, turning its feral fluidity into a mesmerizing display of primal power. A single, massive eye scintillates with predatory focus above a jutting maw stuffed with fangs so massive they extend like cruelly curved tusks. Its roar is an ear-splitting reminder that even in deep space the inexorable power of nature persists.

I Cast Ray Of Frost.name:
我施放寒霜射线
I Cast Ray Of Frost

Text.text:
法术让我的胃底仿佛瞬间化作一块寒冰。我吸气，感觉冬日攫握的指尖沿着气息旅行进我的喉咙。我将双手向前伸出，呼出一口气——吐息尖啸，如雪暴狂风撕裂长空。一束幽蓝惨白的能量嘶嘶射向我的目标，将周遭空气里所有水汽冻结成尖刺般的分形晶簇。法术结束时，我的双手已麻木得失去知觉。
The spell turns the pit of my stomach into what feels like a block of ice. I breathe and feel the grasping fingers of winter travel into my throat. Extending my hands forward, I exhale and my breath screeches like the gale of a snowstorm. A beam of bluish-white energy hisses toward my target, freezing all the moisture in the surrounding air into spiking fractals. As the spell ends, my hands are numb.

I Cast Hold Monster Using Components.name:
我使用材料成分施放了「怪物定身术」
I Cast Hold Monster Using Components

Text.text:
我将那小小的铁片举在身前，让金属以催眠般、令人目眩神迷的轨迹来回摆动，如同节拍器的槌头前后摇曳。我低声吟诵，完成咒语的同时始终与我的目标对视，随即一声悲怆的鸣响在空气中荡开。
Holding the small piece of iron before me, I sway the metal in a hypnotic, mesmerizing pattern, back and forth like the hammer of a metronome. I chant under my breath and maintain eye contact with my target as I complete the incantation, and a dolorous tone chimes through the air.

Upscale Lakeside Home.name:
湖畔雅居
Upscale Lakeside Home

Text.text:
一辆奢华的马车驶至大门前，大门无声开启，放车入内——宛如王室驾临后，躬身退让的卫兵。修剪得一丝不苟的车道优雅蜿蜒，穿过一座宽阔、装点华美的花园，通向那座格外醒目的宅邸。更远处，是湖面清冽澄澈的水光。自庄园的走廊望去，远景一览无余，毫无遮挡。
A lavish car rolls up to the gates, which open silently to allow the vehicle entry—like bowing guards in the wake of royalty. A manicured driveway curls elegantly through a large, decorated garden toward the striking home. Beyond it are the crisp, clear waters of a lake. From the mansion’s veranda, the view of the vista is unimpeded.

Sundries From A Small Blight.name:
小疫痕的杂货
Sundries From A Small Blight

Text.text:
枯萎的花瓣无精打采地从生物的头部与腰间垂落，它那曾经浓郁葱翠的皮肤如今黯淡成鼠尾草色。缠绕其身、如血脉般蔓延的藤蔓已开始发褐，花朵的蓓蕾也干脆成壳。除去这几样或许可用于炼金的材料之外，这株双足植物再无任何具备物质价值之物可供取用。
Wilting petals droop drably from the creature’s head and waist, its richly verdant skin now dulled to sage. The vines veining about its body have begun to brown, the buds of its flowers crisping to husks. Besides these few potentially alchemical ingredients, the bipedal plant does not have anything of material value to offer.

一名留着浓密胡须的男子，身穿打满补丁却色彩斑斓的衣裳，把帽子放在身前，吹奏着长笛，旋律婉转动人。你认不出这首曲子，却不由得浮现出遥远异乡的幻景，以及那些只在故事里听闻过的异域风情在心底悄然滋长的遐想。
A bewhiskered man dressed in patched but colorful clothes has laid his hat before him while he plays a beautiful tune on a flute. You don’t recognize the song, but it brings to mind visions of far-flung places and the fancies you have of foreign cultures you’ve only heard about in stories.

Ancient Underground Ruins.name:
古老的地下遗迹
Ancient Underground Ruins

Text.text:
日光自这座巨型洞窟穹顶的裂隙与洞口如枪般刺入，照亮了不平整的洞底上，一座宏伟大都会铺展成片的残骸。废墟间的裂缝与巨石，如今覆满青苔，诉说着久远昔日这座城市与暴怒大地搏斗的故事——几乎没有建筑还能完好无损。可在中央，一座幽暗高塔却如同蔑视周遭毁灭般森然矗立。塔身无一道裂痕玷污其面，狭长的窗内也不见一丝光。尖顶笔直高耸，挺立不屈。

~ 构想：Elijah Glenn

Daylight lancing in from shafts and openings in this enormous cavern’s roof reveals the sprawling remains of a great metropolis on the uneven cave floor. Cracks and great stones amid the ruins, now coated with moss, tell the tale of the city’s battle with the angry earth in the distant past—few of the structures have survived intact. In the center, though, a dark tower looms as if in defiance of the destruction around it. No cracks mar its faces, and no light shines from its thin windows. Its spire stands straight and tall.

~ Envisioned by Elijah Glenn

Temperate Forest In Summer.name:
夏日的温带森林
Temperate Forest In Summer

Text.text:
盛夏的阳光穿透树冠倾泻而下，将叶片映成鲜艳得近乎不似人间的翠绿。清凉的微风拂过，枝桠轻摆，光与影随之流转，在热意里格外令人舒心。鸟儿在最高的枝头吹哨般鸣啭，俯瞰大地；地面上，细小而窜动的兽类忙忙碌碌，穿梭不停。
Summer sunlight pours down through the canopy, turning the leaves a vibrant, almost unearthly green. Light and shadow shift as tree branches sway in a cool breeze, welcome in the heat. Birds whistle and trill and survey the land from the highest branches, while small, skittering mammals busy themselves on the ground.

Amphisbaena With Prey.name:
衔着猎物的双行蜥
Amphisbaena With Prey

Text.text:
宛如一条灰绿鳞甲的颈环被抛向空中，这条蛇展开妖精般的翅翼在空中飞翔。你在它的尾端又看见一颗头颅，两张嘴同时张开，露出滴着毒液的獠牙。它疯狂地挣扎着，用两只鸡爪死死扣住扭动的猎物，那份重量几乎让这只生物难以继续停留在空中。
Like a scaly gray-green torc thrown into the air, this snake flies with fey wings. On its tail, you spot another head, and both mouths open to reveal dripping fangs. It works furiously to keep its two chicken claws on a writhing prey, the weight almost too great for the creature to remain in the air.

Loot From A Psionic Warrior Of The Astra.name:
来自星界位面灵能战士的战利品
Loot From A Psionic Warrior Of The Astral Plane

Text.text:
那生物的长剑吸引了你的目光。剑柄呈赤金色，触感光滑。剑刃仿佛一抹熔银的浪潮凝固在时代里——如弯刀般弧曲，却带着某种彻底陌异之物的流动感。
The creature's sword catches your eye. The hilt is reddish gold, smooth to the touch. The blade is like a wave of molten silver frozen in time—curved like a scimitar, with the fluidity of something wholly alien.

Mech Suit Scrapyard.name:
机甲残骸废场
Mech Suit Scrapyard

Text.text:
锈蚀的机甲静默伫立，瘫伏在地，如同哀悼的雕像——身处同伴的坟场之中。它们被抛在风雨里任其腐朽，早已废弃遗忘；以当今的技术标准衡量，不过是过时残骸，注定在这偏僻的废品场里湮没无闻。几台机体外壳上仍能看见剥落的定制贴花残迹，证明它们曾被一位忠诚的驾驶员悉心照料过。
The rusting mechs stand idle, slumped in repose like mourning statues—amid a graveyard of their peers. Left to molder in the elements, these mechs are abandoned and forgotten, obsolete by today’s standards of technology, doomed to obscurity in this backwater scrapyard. The flaking remains of custom decals can be seen on several suits, proof that they were once cared for by a devoted pilot.

在这间狭窄、无光的囚室里，浓密黏稠的蛛网覆在一具具骸骨上。来自某道隐秘裂隙的寒风掠过，令上方悬在网中的骨头不祥地颤响，彼此磕碰，宛如被诅咒的风铃叮当作响。一簇簇光滑、圆润的卵——每一枚都有餐盘般的体型——在黑暗中泛着湿亮的光泽，表面裹满幽光黏液。
Thick, sticky cobwebs cover the skeletons in the cramped, lightless cell. A chill breeze from an unseen fissure causes the bones hanging in the webbing above to rattle ominously, clattering together like accursed chimes. Clutches of smooth, round eggs—each the size of a dinner plate—glisten in the darkness, covered in phosphorescent slime.

Resurrected Warrior Makes A Deadly Vow.name:
复生战士立下致命誓言
Resurrected Warrior Makes A Deadly Vow

Text.text:
从血染的雪地里，一具枯槁的身影缓缓站起，灼烈的寒霜将他们的血肉冻得干瘪萎缩。致命一击留下的创口让污血浸透了战士的胸膛，而他们的手已与剑柄一同冻结成一体。泛黄的眼睑缓缓合上，他们立誓要向将自己击倒之人复仇，并举起一支军队与之对抗。巫妖王必将付出代价。

~ Max_Slacker on Discord

From the blood-stained snow, a cadaverous form rises, their flesh withered by the blistering cold. Gore stains the warrior's chest where the mortal wound was dealt, and their hand is frozen around the hilt of a sword. Closing jaundiced eyes, they vow to seek revenge on the one who laid them low, and raise an army against them. The lich king will pay.

~ Max_Slacker on Discord

旧书陈腐而带土腥的气味，与未塞上瓶塞的墨水瓶里逸出的樟脑清香交织在一起。昏暗的房间里，四壁排满方格置物架：有淀粉般雪白的纸页、陈年泛黄的卷宗、泛着金属冷光的银色薄片；有长卷、方幅海报与短笺；有薄如蝉翼的纸张、厚实的纸页与挺括的卡纸。格架下方是一排抽屉，塞满各式钢笔、羽毛笔与其他书写器具。房间中央的书桌后，坐着一位瘦得像一缕烟的人。他舌尖抵在嘴角，一边记下提醒——又或许只是随手的思绪。只见他夸张地挥动那支粗胖的笔，笔尖盘旋如鸟，在求偶仪式里张扬地舞动。
The stale, earthy scent of old books mingles with the aroma of camphor wafting from an uncorked inkwell. The walls of this dim room are lined with cube shelves which contain pages colored starch white, aged yellow, and metallic silver; sizes of long scrolls, square posters, and short letters; constructions of thin, thick, and card stock. Below the cubbyholes stand drawers filled with varieties of pens, quills, and other writing instruments. A wisp of a man sits behind a writing desk in the center. His tongue stuck in the corner of his mouth, he jots a reminder, or perhaps a musing. With theatrical panache, his fat pen swings about like a bird in its mating ritual.

在那翻涌扭动的恶魔群中，一个孤独的身影现出真形，迈步而来，带着非此世的从容与自信。那生物高挑瘦长，斑驳的灰色躯体下绷着如缆的肌肉。鼓胀的卵形眼珠里光与色旋涡般流转，自一张几乎没有五官的面孔上凝视而出；细密如丝的长袍披垂在它的肩头。它颈间悬着一串项链——由无数生物被割下的手指串成。野兽般的追随者簇拥在它周围，嗤笑低吼；而那首领举起一柄邪异的弯刃，异界金属冷光森然——随即将刀尖直指向你。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

From the writhing, daemonic horde, a lone figure makes itself known, striding forward with an otherworldly confidence. The creature is tall and lean, its mottled gray body heavy with corded muscle. Bulbous, ovoid eyes swirling with light and color peer out from an otherwise featureless visage, and fine, silken robes drape its shoulders. Around its neck hangs a necklace of severed fingers from myriad creatures. Its beastly followers gather around it, sneering and snarling as the leader brandishes a wicked, curved blade of alien metal—and then points its tip at you.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Attic Of A Manor.name:
庄园的阁楼
Attic Of A Manor

Text.text:
你沿着通往阁楼的楼梯向上攀登，脚下的木板在你的重量下吱呀作响。门又窄又低，伴随着古老铰链刺耳的呻吟缓缓摆开。门后，阁楼幽暗而死寂。成堆的箱子与木桶塞满每个角落，旧家具披着白布，像一具具沉默的尸身。灰尘覆满所有表面，厚得宛如新落的雪；当你绕过拐角，几乎要被眼前伫立的身影惊得叫出声——直到你看清，那只是个人体模特。
As you ascend the stairs to the attic you feel them creak beneath you. The door is narrow and swings open with a whine of its ancient hinges. Beyond, the attic stands dark and silent. Piles of crates and barrels fill every corner, and old furniture sits draped with white cloth. Dust covers every surface like a thick dusting of snow, and as you round a corner, you almost cry out at the figure standing before you—before you realize it's a mannequin.

Blade Attacker's Wrist Is Caught During.name:
刀锋袭来却一击落空，攻击者的手腕在挥砍间被牢牢扣住
Blade Attacker's Wrist Is Caught During Failed Strike

Text.text:
袭击者带着恶毒的快意猛然前扑，迫不及待要剖开他们的目标。但这一击却笨拙失准。猎物一个流畅的移动间重心一沉——旋身避开来袭——同时扣住袭击者的手腕。
The attacker lunges forward with malicious glee, eager to gut their target. But the strike is clumsy. In one fluid movement the prey shifts their weight—twisting to avoid the strike—and grabs the attacker’s wrist.

Whirlpool In River.name:
河中漩涡
Whirlpool In River

Text.text:
水流本还迅疾，却在与另一股水道相撞时骤然化作狂暴洪涛。翻搅的水面裂开成一处巨大的洞口，直通无底深渊。浪头绕着漩涡盘旋，继而尽数坠入其中。任何漂浮在水面上的东西都会伴着咯咯的吞咽声被卷走，仿佛这条河正发出残忍的讥笑。
The current’s swift flow turns into a torrent as it clashes with another stream. The surface of the churning water opens into a wide hole that disappears into the depths. Waves swirl around the whirlpool and vanish into it. Anything floating on the surface gets swallowed with a chuckling sound, as if the river was laughing cruelly.

Headstone: “Lies” In Winter.name:
墓碑：“谎言”于寒冬之中
Headstone: “Lies” In Winter

Text.text: 这块墓碑正对着通往山顶的石阶，仿佛刻意摆在此处，好让从阶上走下来的人一眼瞧见。或许正因如此，它才刻着这句古怪的告诫：谎言引你前往真相无法追随之处。你正踏着谁的足迹前行？ This headstone faces the stairs up to the top of the hill, as if positioned to be noticed by those descending them. Perhaps that is why it bears its strange message: Lies lead where truth cannot follow. In whose footsteps do you tread?

这艘船花在刷洗与上蜡上的功夫，恐怕比真正航行还多。舱室的陶瓦屋檐下，嵌着雕工精美的花格窗。漫长而光亮的甲板上摆满桌椅，还有一处赌摊，以及一只装满渔具的黄铜鼓。船帆被绘成画廊里悬挂的名作，船长的装束也更像城堡里的仆役，而非行商的海上人。不久，这船上就会回荡起女子的笑声与男人的夸耀。
More time is probably spent scrubbing and waxing this ship than sailing it. The cabin has exquisitely carved lattice windows under its clay tiled roof. The long, gleaming deck is fitted with tables and chairs, a gambling stall, and a brass drum full of fishing tackle. The sails are painted to resemble masterworks hanging in galleries, and the captain is dressed as much like a castle servant as a merchant seafarer. Soon the ship will ring with the laughter of women and the bragging of men.

Varda Wildheart.name:
瓦尔达·狂野之心
Varda Wildheart

Text.text:
这个矮小而柔韧的女人肤色苍白，在双股编成的黑发与乌羽般的翅翼映衬下格外刺眼。她一红一绿的异色双瞳更添几分狡黠——也许是残忍——的神情。她穿着粉色露脐上衣，让背后的翅膀能自由移动，颈间则戴着一条刻满繁复符文的项圈。她还系着两条黑色腰带，搭配同色短裤与高跟长靴。其中一条腰带挂着一柄入鞘长剑，垂在她左侧胯间。

~ Played by Eri Rose

The pale skin of this short, lissome woman stands out against her double-braided black hair and raven-feathered wings. Her mismatched red and green eyes accentuate her cunning—perhaps cruel—look. She wears a pink crop top that allows free movement for the wings on her back, and a complex runic choker adorns her neck. She also sports two black belts, with matching shorts and high-heeled boots. A sheathed longsword hangs from one of the belts on her left hip.

~ Played by Eri Rose

水晶般的雨滴猛敲着这条久经踩踏的破裂路面，令无数坑洼里积起一滩滩油亮的水洼。雨点轻柔的噼啪声与掠过的车声、行色匆匆的脚步交织在一起，谱成一曲雨意氤氲的移动交响。

~ David 在 Discord 上所构想

Crystal droplets hammer the cracked surface of the well-traveled road, causing oily puddles to form in the many potholes. The gentle pattering of the drops mingles with the sound of passing cars and hurried pedestrians to create a pluvious symphony of movement.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

一只以铁箍束缚的巨大石轮几乎与墙面齐平地嵌在其中。它直径将近十英尺，轮内还套着两圈同样镶着铁边的圆环，一圈套一圈；三重圆环的正中央，是一个深黑的小孔，约莫只有手指般粗细。两道内圈的周缘分布着一圈圈凹槽，想必是用来抓握转动的把手。它看起来像某种庞大的组合锁，但又明显需要一把钥匙。那些凹槽排列得极为规整，而石面除此之外毫无纹饰，你根本看不出要如何判断自己是否转到了正确的组合。
A great wheel of ironbound stone sits nearly flush with the wall. Almost ten feet in diameter, it holds two more iron-rimmed circles, one set within the other, and at the center of all three is a dark hole of perhaps a finger’s width. Depressions that probably serve as handles run around each of the two internal circles. It must be some kind of vast combination lock, but it also appears to require a key. The depressions are regular, and the stone is otherwise plain, so you don’t see how you’d know when you reached the correct combination.

它在浪花间疾驰，海水拍打着覆有甲壳的腿，这只甲壳类生物在沙地上飞快横移，迫不及待地寻找下一顿猎食。暗红褐色的甲壳包裹着躯体，柔软的黑色眼睛顶在灵活的柄上，扫视着区域里的每一丝危险。一只海鸥俯冲扑向生物——却被那一对骇人的镰斩巨螯凶猛张扬的威势硬生生逼退。
Scuttling through the surf, with waves lapping against chitinous legs, the crustacean skitters across the sands, eager to find its next meal. A ruddy brown shell houses the body, and soft black eyes atop flexible stalks scan the area for danger. A seagull dives down upon the creature—only to be fended off by a formidable display of scything pincers.

Desert Valley Pass.name:
沙漠谷隘口
Desert Valley Pass

Text.text:
蜿蜒的小径穿过荒瘠的丘陵，两侧峭拔隆起，夹出一条愈发幽深的山谷。也许曾有一条河流在这些丘陵间凿出水道，携着赐生的清水滋养葱茏植被与群兽——而今所剩无几，只余一方池塘，几乎不过是一滩更深些的水洼。
The winding trail leads through barren hills, which soar upward on either side of the deepening valley. Perhaps a river once carved its way through these hills, carrying life-giving water to verdant plant growth and animals—now, all that remains is a pond, little more than a deep puddle.

Warning From A Frightened Mage To A Conc.name:
一位惊惧法师对潜伏敌人的警告
Warning From A Frightened Mage To A Concealed Foe

Text.text:
“谁在那里？我警告你，我在魔法之术上受过严格训练……只是还没练到能看见你。”
“Who goes there? Be warned I am well trained in the magic arts… just not trained enough to see you.”

一片宏伟浩瀚的珊瑚礁环抱着泻湖，将其与大海隔绝开来，宛如交战诸国之间的一道石墙般坚不可破。湖内的淡水对任何饱受海风摧残的水手而言都是恩赐——一处令人欣然停驻、得以休息与补给的港湾。
A voluminous coral reef brackets the lagoon, separating it from the sea as surely as a stone wall between warring nations. The fresh water within is a boon for any windswept sailor—a welcome point of rest and refreshment.

I Drink My Potion Of Stone Giant Strengt.name:
我喝下我的石巨人力量药水
I Drink My Potion Of Stone Giant Strength

Text.text: 我只觉得石巨人的指甲砸在我肚子上，像石头坠入深井之底——伴着令人作呕的扑通一声！那股泥浆般的药水几乎要倒喷上来，我却用一声低沉的咆哮硬生生压了回去；那咆哮在体内滚动回荡，像一场微小的地震震得五脏发颤。被这股劲头催动，我一拳砸进掌心，只觉脚下大地随之战栗。 I feel the stone giant’s nail hit my stomach like a stone hitting the bottom of a well—with a nauseating plunk! The muddy potion threatens to geyser back up, but I suppress it with a firm growl, a rumble that reverberates throughout my body in a small quake. Spurred by this energy, I smash my fist into my palm and feel the earth shake beneath me.

Red Elemental Slime.name:
红元素史莱姆
Red Elemental Slime

Text.text:
如同一根熔融玻璃的尖塔，那团软泥猛然升起。它长出肢体，又在别处回缩重塑。尖塔的顶端像在窥视般游移，却只以一团绳索般可塑、致命的浆质扭曲成它的头颅。它的底部沿地面倾泻，宛如一汪熔岩池，空气里弥漫着燃烧的焦味。

~ 一位英雄构想

Like a spire of molten glass, the ooze rises up. It forms limbs that recede and form again elsewhere. The spire’s top moves as if to see but has only the malleable twist of a ropy, deadly mass as its head. Its base pours along the ground like a lava pool, and the air smells of burning.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

一个精瘦、蝠翼般的类人生物用四只狭长的眼睛眯视着你。它歪起脑袋，发出一连串急促的咔嗒声。它身披黯淡无光的金色甲片，手握一柄由漆黑獠牙锻成的利刃。翅膀拍击空气，两只耳朵在亢奋的狂躁中不停抽动。自那暗红的鼻吻下方，一张布满尖牙的巨口吐出一缕缕细长黏稠的唾丝，落地时嘶嘶作响。
A lean, batlike humanoid squints out of four narrow eyes. It cocks its head and emits a series of rapid clicks. Armored in plates of lusterless gold, it wields a blade forged from dark fangs. Wings flap at the air, and its two ears twitch in hyperactive frenzy. From beneath a ruddy snout, a fanged maw spits ropes of thin, stringy saliva that hiss as they meet the ground.

Oath Of Righteous Revenge.name:
正义复仇之誓
Oath Of Righteous Revenge

Text.text:
“孩童乞水时，你朝他们吐唾。长者弯身欲求休息时，你将尘土撒在他们身上。你听不见被你践踏者的哀嚎，而很快，你将再也听不见别的声音。我为你而来。”
“When children begged for water, you spat upon them. When elders stooped to rest, you cast dirt upon them. You heard not the cries of those you trampled, and soon you shall hear nothing else. I come for thee.”

那个人类跪伏在荒野四周浓密的灌木丛间，半掩身形。他们以笃定而娴熟的动作采集草木：此处剪下嫩芽，彼处连根拔起茎秆。随后他们起身，掸去罩衣上的泥土，把新采来的材料塞进腰间一圈下垂的囊袋里。
The human kneels, half-concealed within the dense shrubbery of the surrounding wilds. They gather plant-life with sure, practiced movements, snipping buds here, uprooting stems there. They stand, brushing the dirt from their smock, and tuck the newly-gathered materials into the sagging pouches ringing their waist.

Blued-steel Heavy Revolver.name:
蓝钢重型左轮手枪
Blued-steel Heavy Revolver

Text.text:
左轮手枪的钢材泛着一层隐约的钴色光泽，成色里掺着一丝若有若无的蓝。那把武器宛如一件阴森的艺术品，每个部件都被巧匠雕琢得天衣无缝，与其余部分完美相契。你将枪拾起，更能感到它的品质：重量令人愉悦，却又不失灵动的轻盈。
The steel of the revolver has a subtle cobalt sheen, the merest hint of blue mixed with the finish. The weapon is a work of macabre art, each component masterfully crafted in perfect harmony with the others. The quality is evidenced further as you pick up the gun and find it has a pleasing but agile heft to it.

一对火盆在神殿入口两侧永恒闪烁，火舌不为山谷间呼啸的风所动。你走近那嵌入岩壁的巍峨大门时，只觉一股沉重压在肩头，仿佛此刻你已背负起一项巨大的负担。两道身影——风蚀得早已面目全非——自石质门楣上的浅浮雕俯视而下，眯起的眼睛无声地审判着你。
A pair of braziers flicker eternally beside the entrance of the shrine, their flames unmoved by the breeze whistling through the valley. As you approach the towering doors set into the rock, you feel a weight pressing down upon you, as if you now carry a great burden. Two figures—eroded beyond recognition—stare down from the bas reliefs etched into the stone lintel, their eyes narrowed in silent judgement.

Loot From A Horncaller.name:
号角召唤者的战利品
Loot From A Horncaller

Text.text:
你在法杖螺旋纹路的正中央，发现了一大块苔藓玛瑙。宝石呈深邃斑驳的绿色，宛如原始森林河流的水色，静静散发出安宁祥和的气息。
Nestled in the center of the staff’s whorl, you find a large piece of moss agate. The gem is a deep and mottled green, like the waters of a primal forest river, and radiates a sense of peaceful serenity.

这位天界牧师身形高大，橄榄色肌肤，肌肉结实，亚麻色长发垂落，眼眸如同金色钱币般熠熠生辉。他的板甲在深蓝长袍翻涌的褶浪下闪着银光，与他胸前银色战锤徽记、背负的盾牌相互映照。他的钉头锤握柄里熔铸着父亲的戒指。黯淡的阴影在他身后铺散开来，几乎像是被那身华光逼出的烟雾——直到他心念一动，阴影便驯服成一对明亮的金色羽翼。

~ Played by Cason Juni with

The celestial cleric is tall and olive skinned, muscular and flaxen haired, with eyes like gold coins. His plate gleams silver under the billow of his deep blue robes, matched by the silver of his hammer insignia and the shield on his back. His mace has his father’s ring forged into its handle. Dull shadows fan out behind him, almost like smoke from the brilliance of his garb, until he wills them into a span of bright, golden wings.

~ Played by Cason Juni with

Fearsome Dwarven Miner.name:
令人胆寒的矮人矿工
Fearsome Dwarven Miner

Text.text:
在塌陷的土壁夹出的狭窄隧道里，一缕月光斜斜淌下，照出一名矮人。他屈膝立定，脸上的怒意如暴风翻卷。鹤嘴锄被他高举在身前作防御姿态，铁质锄头因常年使用而布满崩口与缺痕。灰蒙蒙的惨白像尘雾般覆在他带粉的皮肤上，一道隆起的赤红疤痕斜斜劈过他的面颊。就连他的护甲也满是旧伤：凹坑与裂痕遍布，其间还洇着斑驳污渍，仿佛把皮革原本浓郁的棕色都抽走了。昏暗里，他深色的眼睛在微光中一闪，从他死死攥紧鹤嘴锄的指节上方，狠狠盯住了你。
Framed by the crumbling dirt walls of the tunnel and lit by a stream of moonlight, a dwarf stands with knees bent and a face as furious as a storm. He holds a pickaxe aloft in a defensive posture, its iron head nicked from regular use. A pallor covers his pinkish skin in a cloud of gray, and a raised, ruddy scar slices diagonally down his face. His armor, too, bears old wounds: pockmarks and slashes, as well as splotchy stains that seem to have drained the leather’s rich brown color. His dark eyes, glinting in the spare light, glare at you from over the knuckles he tightens over his pick.

Orc Battle Axe.name:
兽人战斧
Orc Battle Axe

Text.text:
黑得像生铁，锻打得同样粗陋，这把斧子几乎不像是锻造出来的。两侧斧刃看上去更像磨尖的鸢盾，而非别的。长长的硬木柄缠着松垮、汗湿的皮革，末端没有配重的柄头。唯一的“装饰”，是几处干涸的血痂，以及刃缘上一排排缺口，像掉了的小牙。它是个粗鄙杀手的工具。
Black as pig iron and just as roughly hammered, the axe hardly seems forged at all. Each blade looks more like a sharpened heater shield than anything else. The long hardwood handle, wrapped in loose, sweaty leather, ends without a pommel. The only decorations are patches of dried blood and notches along the edges, like little missing teeth. It is the tool of an unsophisticated killer.

Night Market Square.name:
夜市广场
Night Market Square

Text.text:
泛光灯如重锤般砸在广场上，把拥挤的商贩摊位与摩肩接踵的购物人潮照得亮如白昼，这夜市也只剩名号。货物堆得满溢的摊位紧挨成排，彼此间没有半点空间，电子滚动屏争先恐后地夺走视线。人们在拥堵中推挤侧身、扭动穿行，急切地寻找下一笔超值捡漏，或抢下最新一波限时秒杀。
Floodlights pound down on the square, making the press of merchant booths and packed shoppers a night market in name only. Stalls overflowing with merchandise are lined up with no space between, digital tickers fighting for the eye’s attention. People jostle and shimmy to work their way through the crowd, eager to find the next great deal or claim the latest flash sale.

Caged Wagon With Wolf Banner.name:
悬挂狼旗的囚笼马车
Caged Wagon With Wolf Banner

Text.text:
一辆带铁笼的货车停在土路被反复碾出的深深车辙里，既无车夫，也无拉车的牲口。笼侧挂着一面亮黄色的旗帜，上绘一头跃起的赤红狼，旗底边缘磨得毛糙——多半是一路颠簸时不断擦撞车厢所致。然而这几乎是唯一显眼的磨损痕迹：车身与车轮的木料干净无污、毫无毛刺裂刺，笼子的铁条也尚未生锈。它看上去就像是昨天才刚刚打造完工。
A caged wagon sits in the well-worn ruts of the dirt road, without a driver or pulling beast. A bright yellow banner bearing the image of a leaping red wolf decorates one side of the cage, its bottom edge frayed—likely from bumping against the side of the wagon. But this is the only obvious sign of wear. The wood of the wagon body and wheels is unstained and without splinter, and the iron of the cage has not yet rusted. It seems as if it could have been crafted and finished just yesterday.

Plasma Torch.name:
等离子切割炬
Plasma Torch

Text.text:
这把看上去结实可靠的电弧焊切器小巧却威力惊人，凭借聚焦的等离子切割刃便能轻松剖开大多数材料。内置冷却系统与精密操控让它胜任细致繁复的作业，无论工程师还是匠人都离不开它。
The sturdy-looking arc-welder is a compact but powerful tool, able to slice through most material with ease using its focused plasma cutter. Embedded cooling systems and precision control allow for intricate work, making it an indispensable tool for engineer and craftsman alike.

Astrogator For Hire.name:
受雇领航员
Astrogator For Hire

Text.text:
你走近时，那位蜥蜴般的女子露出一抹痞气十足的笑，蓝色的分叉舌信子轻轻探出，像是在品尝空气中的气味。她倚靠在一艘做工惊人的定制飞船旁，交谈间还带着几分眷恋地抚摸着船体外壳。她那件磨旧而硬朗的皮夹克肩背处印着一行褪色的名字，以及她身旁这艘飞船的图样。
The reptilian woman smiles in a roguish fashion as you approach her, and her forked blue tongue tastes the air. She is leaning against an impressively constructed spacecraft of custom design, and lovingly caresses the hull during conversation. Her worn, rugged leather jacket bears a faded name across the shoulders and a depiction of the craft she stands beside.

Awaiting Battle In Arena.name:
竞技场中静候开战
Awaiting Battle In Arena

Text.text:
你们背靠背站定，抬头望向环绕竞技场的层层看台——以及其中嗜血的观众。被对鲜血的渴望所联结，各色人等在座席间肆意混杂，迫不及待地等待即将到来的厮杀。在自己心脏擂鼓般的狂跳声中，你勉强分辨出报幕人那充满排场与仪式感的嗓音。随即，人群令人不安地骤然沉寂，所有目光齐刷刷投向竞技场中央的舱口。坑口上沉重的铁栅被粗大的铁链缓缓吊起……而自深处探出的蛇形头颅多得过分——猩红的眼睛因饥饿而癫狂。

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Standing back to back, you stare up at the tiered seats surrounding the arena—and the bloodthirsty patrons therein. United by their lust for blood, people of all kinds mingle freely in the stands, eagerly awaiting the battle to come. You can just make out the voice of the announcer—full of pomp and ceremony—over the pounding of your own heart. Then the crowd falls worryingly silent as all eyes turn to the hatch in the center of the arena. The heavy grate atop the pit is hoisted free by thick iron chains… and far too many serpentine heads emerge from the depths—their red eyes mad with hunger.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Drow Noble Arms Dealer.name:
卓尔贵族军火商
Drow Noble Arms Dealer

Text.text:
卓尔那令人作呕的傲慢，在这位颐指气使的身影上体现得淋漓尽致。魔法能量在她体内奔涌，使她的长发愈发疯长，如一袭耀眼的银色披风向外铺展。她凌空悬停，连对大地的接触都不屑施舍。灰白而棱角分明的面容高傲自持，下巴扬起，若非被一面宝石红的面罩遮住——那面罩高高装在一套镀银护甲之上——本该以彻底的轻蔑扫视四周。她的双手迸发出禁忌魔法的漆黑触须。
The loathsome arrogance of the drow is typified in this imperious figure. Her hair has grown long with the magic energy coursing through her, and now fans out like a cloak of bright silver. She hovers aloft, not deigning to touch the ground. A gray angular face holds itself proud, chin high, casting looks of utter disdain on its surroundings. Or it would, were it not obscured by a ruby-red visor, mounted high on a set of silvered armor. Dark tendrils of forbidden magic erupt from her hands.

Isolated Alien Prison.name:
孤绝的异星囚牢
Isolated Alien Prison

Text.text:
这片荒芜地表上唯一的建筑，是一座巨大的灰色方块楼体，没有任何窗户。它只有一扇门——比银行金库门还要坚固。监狱四周竖着森然的高压电网，将远处的降落坪牢牢护住，防备任何侥幸逃出牢笼的囚犯冲破围界。
The only structure on the barren surface is a massive gray block of a building with no windows. There’s only one door—sturdier than a bank vault’s. Bristling electric fences surround the prison, keeping the distant landing pad protected from any prisoner who could manage to escape the confines of their cage.

Quip About Drinking.name:
关于喝酒的俏皮话
Quip About Drinking

Text.text:
“先生，我可不是寻常酒鬼！我是美食家，是品酒师，是上等风味的鉴赏者。至于我的热情偏偏只落在酒上，那纯属巧合。”
“I am no common alcoholic sir! I am a gourmand, a sommelier, and appreciator of fine flavors. The fact my passion lies exclusively in booze is complete coincidence.”

Prehensile Tail Enhancement.name:
灵巧卷握尾强化
Prehensile Tail Enhancement

Text.text:
那女人察觉到你的目光，露出狡黠的笑容，分节的尾巴以轻盈而催眠的节奏左右轻甩。你的视线沿着那条碳纤维的附肢一路追随，看着它没入她短款皮夹克下方——并与她的脊柱融为一体。
Catching your eye, the woman smiles roguishly and flicks her segmented tail back and forth with lithe, hypnotic movements. Your gaze travels along the carbon-fiber appendage as it disappears beneath her cropped leather jacket—and fuses to her spine.

The Rhyme Of A Decrepit House.name:
一座破败老宅的韵歌
The Rhyme Of A Decrepit House

Text.text:
高耸的门框，满是划痕与磨损，逼得这处居所显得凄凉孤寂。窗户如眼般凝望，哀伤而破碎，碎裂的玻璃让它们空洞敞开。也许曾有暴风摧残了大门，这屋子被抛给未知的命运；直到你听见屋内一声吱呀，才意识到它还藏着更多秘密。

~ Daer Averna

A looming doorframe, scratched and worn, forcing the abode to look forlorn. Its windows stare, sad and broken, shattered glass leaving them open. Perhaps a storm ravaged the gate, the abode left to an unknown fate; until you hear a creak inside and realize it has more to hide.

~ Daer Averna

观众的欢呼声化作喧闹的支援浪潮，泳者们纵身跃入湖中，手握或背负着各自的法器。他们奋力破浪前行，水面却以肉眼可见的速度愈发汹涌。有人猝不及防被卷入漩涡，有人被偏航的暗流猛地带离路线。观众脚下忽然传来一阵不祥的震动，浑浊深处随之涌起顽皮的咯咯笑声，像从湖底咕噜咕噜冒出来一般。
Fans roar in raucous support as the swimmers dive into the lake, their foci in hand or holstered on their backs. They press through the waters, which grow choppier by the minute. Swimmers are suddenly swept into whirlpools or into off-course currents. An uncanny rumble is felt by the fans as a mischievous, gurgling laugh comes from deep within the murky waters.

Tournament In Severe Heat Under Cloudles.name:
在万里无云的酷暑天幕下举行的比武大会
Tournament In Severe Heat Under Cloudless Skies

Text.text:
烈日从无云的苍穹倾泻而下。旗帜与彩幡软塌塌地垂着，风仿佛已是遥远的回忆。富人裹着华丽衣饰汗流浃背，反倒嫉妒起农夫身上那件轻薄短袍。最受罪的是骑士们，在马鞍上摇摇晃晃。坐骑也好不到哪里去，低垂着头，嚼子边缘沾着白沫。唯有鸟儿还像有使不完的劲儿，穿梭在马群周围，凌空叼走飞舞的苍蝇。
The sun blazes down from a sky devoid of clouds. Banners and pennants hang limp, the wind a distant memory. Rich folk sweat in lavish garb, envious of the peasants in their light tunics. The knights suffer the most, swaying in their saddles. Their mounts fare no better, heads hung low, bits flecked with foam. Only the birds seem to have any energy, as they flit around the horses, snatching flies in mid-flight.

Mad Scientist's Lab: Strange Chamber.name:
疯狂科学家的实验室：诡异密室
Mad Scientist's Lab: Strange Chamber

Text.text:
这间厅室里一排排桌案上陈列着一幅古怪景象：鼓胀的玻璃器皿与盘绕的金属管线交错缠结。盛着咕嘟翻涌液体的烧杯在烛焰上咝咝沸煨，映出宝石般的斑斓光泽。气泡翻腾的浆液逸出一股令人作呕的酸臭蒸汽，触及你的鼻腔，你强压下干呕的冲动。
The array of tables in this chamber holds a curious display of bulbous glass and coiled metal. Beakers filled with burbling liquids simmer over candle flames, which illuminate gem-like colors. Bilious fumes from the bubbling fluids reach your nose, and you resist the urge to retch.

Loot From A Wish Digger.name:
来自许愿掘宝者的战利品
Loot From A Wish Digger

Text.text:
在矿工斜挎在身上的一只小小麻布挎包里，你找到几枚色泽夺目、呈灿烂青绿的漂亮宝石。它们总共值5枚金币。
In a small hemp satchel slung around the miner’s torso, you find several beautiful gemstones in a dazzling turquoise hue. They are worth 5 gold pieces overall.

Cheating In The Joust.name:
马上比斗中的作弊
Cheating In The Joust

Text.text:
你瞪大了眼睛，看着侍奉锦标赛冠军的侍从把一只小瓶悄悄递给他们的领主。那名身披鎏金甲胄的骑士掀起面甲，将瓶中神秘的液体一饮而尽，舔了舔嘴唇，露出笑容。侍从慌忙后退，险些被踏成肉泥——骑士随即以近乎超自然的速度冲上比武场，宛如爆裂的疾风般席卷而出。
Your eyes widen as you watch the squire attending the tournament champion pass a small bottle to their lord. The gilt-armored knight tips back their visor and quaffs down the mysterious contents, licks their lips, and smiles. Hastily stepping back, the squire narrowly avoids being trampled as the knight erupts onto the list with almost supernatural speed.

I Cast Fly Using Components.name:
我以施法材料施放【飞行术】
I Cast Fly Using Components

Text.text:
我将那根优雅的羽毛举在身前，凝视着它纤细的羽枝，低声吟诵我的法术咒词。指尖专注于那份失重的触感，我渐渐感觉这份轻盈在我召唤出的魔法中回响——双脚毫不费力地离开地面，缓缓升起。
Holding the elegant feather before me, I focus on its delicate vanes and intone the words of my spell. Concentrating on the feeling of weightlessness in my hand, I start to feel the sensation reflected in my summoned magic, as my feet lift effortlessly from the ground.

Qildar Myronthaelar.name:
奇尔达尔·迈隆萨埃拉尔
Qildar Myronthaelar

Text.text:
他身形高挑而精瘦，站姿松弛却笃定，苔色的眼睛从容打量着四周。尖尖的耳朵与一头笔直的栗色长发昭示着他是林地精灵——裸露的红褐肤色上，亦有蓝色菘蓝纹身作证。然而磨旧的皮甲与一件绿斗篷遮住了大半。细剑垂在一侧髋骨，另一侧挂着长匕。他的骑靴里还藏着一把更短的匕首，护臂中也嵌着一把，后者以绑缚固定，甚至无需抽出便能直接刺击。最夺目的是那把抛光精致的反曲精灵长弓，木与角相嵌，背负在他身后，旁边系着一个磨得发旧的箭囊。他几乎不佩华饰，但斗篷内衬着深色丝绸，内里的衣装亦裁制精妙，质地上乘。

~ Played by Adam

Tall and lean, he stands with relaxed surety, observing his surroundings with eyes the color of moss. His pointed ears and straight chestnut hair mark him as a wood elf—so does the blue woad adorning his exposed russet skin. But worn leather and a green cloak cover most of that. A rapier hangs on one hip and a long knife on the other. He has a shorter dagger sheathed in one riding boot and another in a bracer, the latter bound so it can stab without being drawn. Finest of all is a polished recurve elven longbow of wood and horn, strapped to his back beside a well-used quiver of arrows. He wears little finery, but dark silk lines his cloak and makes up the superb garment worn underneath.

~ Played by Adam

I Toss My Bird Feather Token Into The Ai.name:
我将鸟羽徽记抛向空中
I Toss My Bird Feather Token Into The Air

Text.text:
我将那枚小小的彩虹徽记高高举起——虹彩的流苏闪烁夺目——随后把它猛力抛向空中，只见一道惊人的光与色的爆裂轰然绽放。在那耀光的中心，一只巨鸟现身，双翼展开足有三十英尺之宽。它以黑曜石般的喙发出刺耳的长鸣，幽白的眼眸锁定在我身上，静候我的号令。每一次狂风般振翼，它的羽冠与翎羽便流光变幻，交织出不同的色彩组合。
I hold the tiny rainbow token aloft—its prismatic fringe glittering—then throw it high into the air and watch as an awesome burst of light and color erupts. At its center appears a bird with wings spanning thirty feet across. It releases a piercing call from its obsidian beak, and ghostly white eyes fix on me awaiting my command. Its plumes shimmer into different combinations of color with each gale-force flap of its wings.

九级台阶。道路逼仄，被嶙峋巨石挤压得几无容身之处。石阶上方，肋骨般的石柱森然拱立，最后两根柱上插着贪婪燃噬的火把。登顶之时，本该能瞥见地平线那一抹绝望的残光——可你怎能把目光投向别处？那巨大的长角颅骨里，血色正浓得刺眼。你又怎能去想别的？你的头颅，很快也会加入下方那堆翻滚散落的残骸。想象着有人被押上这座祭坛顶端的断头台，生命最后的片刻，你不由得被那股恐惧攫住。
Nine steps. The way is narrow, hemmed in by knuckling boulders. The stone is loomed over by the rib pillars, the last two set with ravenous torches. At the top, you would see a last desperate glimpse of the horizon. But how could you look at anything other than the blood in that giant horned skull? How could you think about anything other than how your head would soon join the tumbled heap below? Imagining the last moments of someone brought to the headsman’s block atop this altar, you can’t help but feel their fear.

一头直立行走的狼穿着西装站着，一条腿屈起抵在墙上，随手把一枚信用芯片弹到空中，再用灵巧的一转手腕稳稳接住。他看起来一丝不苟：打理得雪白的皮毛，利落的獠牙，身上是最新潮的剪裁，犬形的腕上还戴着一只小巧的印戒手环。他露出近乎和善的笑意——也许是狼的那种笑。几处隐蔽的科技改造挤在他喉间，像暗纹般贴伏。他似乎正扫视人群，寻找一个目标。
A bipedal wolf in a suit stands, leg cocked against a wall and flicking a cred chip up in the air and catching it with a deft turn of the wrist. He looks immaculate: groomed white fur, sleek fangs, dressed in the latest fashion and wearing a small signet bracelet on his canine wrist. He flashes something like a benevolent smile. Wolfish, perhaps. A bevy of subtle tech mods crowd at his throat. He appears to be scanning the crowd, looking for a target.

Man Caught In Bear Trap.name:
男人被捕熊夹夹住
Man Caught In Bear Trap

Text.text:
一个秃头男人身穿橄榄绿色皮甲，被困在这凶险的陷阱里。陷阱咬合在他小腿半截处，连靴子也一并夹住，痛得他表情扭曲、龇牙咧嘴。他瘫坐在地上，拼命想把那排利齿撬开。
A man, bald and wearing olive-green leathers, is caught in the menacing trap. It has closed halfway up his calf and over his boot, forcing his expression into a pained grimace. He sits on the ground, desperately attempting to pry the teeth open.

Tavern On Stilts Over Water.name:
水上高脚酒馆
Tavern On Stilts Over Water

Text.text:
远远望去，这家喧闹的酒馆仿佛漂浮在水面之上，似是被魔法托举，或是凭着一腔善意支撑；可当你走近，便能看清其下方那套繁复而精妙、分毫不差的平衡桩架系统——建筑沉在水下的根基。酒馆两侧嵌出了码头，可供十余艘船只停靠；每座码头都有斜坡通往一处供客人出入的入口。酒馆后方还敞着一座更小的装卸平台，便于补给进出。几面绣着酒馆名号的旗帜被巧妙地挂在醒目的位置，正对着公共厅堂，让航海而来的客人一边啜饮心头好酒，一边也能在风势骤起前先得个提醒。
From a distance, it appears that the rollicking tavern is actually floating atop the surface of the water, held aloft by magic or perhaps good intentions, but as you draw closer you can actually make out the elaborate, perfectly-balanced system of pilings underneath—the building’s underwater foundation. Piers have been built into the tavern’s sides allowing for the docking of more than a dozen craft. From each pier, ramps lead up to an entrance for patrons. At the tavern’s rear a smaller loading dock stands open for resupply. Strategically placed flags bearing the tavern’s name fly in plain view of the common rooms, so that seagoing patrons might be warned should the winds kick up as they sip their favorite beverage.

Jaded Guerrilla Commander.name:
久经风霜的游击指挥官
Jaded Guerrilla Commander

Text.text: 她倚在阴影浓重的角落墙边，眯缝的眼睛警惕地来回扫视。城市迷彩背心勾勒出她结实的臂膀；若那对“武器”还不够劝退，她腰侧还醒目地挂着一只风化磨损的枪套，里面插着一把激光手枪。她脸上的神情足以对整间屋子无声地吼出：别靠近。 She leans against a wall in a shadowy corner, slitted eyes scanning diligently. An urban-camo tank top showcases her muscled arms, and if those weapons didn't deter enough, she also wears a weathered holster prominently on her hip, with a laser handgun tucked inside. Her expression is all she needs to shout step off to the entire room.

Frazzled Researcher.name:
焦躁不安的研究员
Frazzled Researcher

Text.text:
一个身形矮小的男人重重叹了口气，一边嘟囔着一边把过大的实验袍重新扯回肩头。他戴着手套的双手在一片投影出的复杂数学方程与曲线图间迅速划过，指尖的传感器一闪一闪地亮着光，随着他的动作修改数据、挪动信息块。及肩的头发凌乱油腻，几缕黏成条的发丝被一副巨大的护目镜挡在额前——护目镜被他顶在头顶。投影忽然滋滋作响，短暂地熄闪、卡顿，他试图调节一条曲线时它更是抽搐般抖了两下。他倒抽一口气，嘶声咒骂：“不，不，不，不！别这时候给我死机。”
A man of small stature sighs heavily, muttering to himself as he adjusts his oversized lab coat back onto his shoulders. He swipes gloved hands through a projection of complex mathematical equations and graphs, the sensors on his fingertips blinking with light as he makes changes and moves pieces of data around. His shoulder-length hair is unkempt and oily, the stringy locks held out of his face by a huge set of goggles pushed up onto his crown. The projection fizzles for a moment and stutters as he tries to adjust a graph. He hisses out a curse. “No, no, no, no! Don’t you fritz on me.”

圆滚滚的半身人一边捋着修剪齐整的小胡子，一边任由买家——那位满脸伤疤的半兽人女人——像座阴影般压在他头顶，离他脸不过寸许，咆哮着提要求。“我的朋友，”半身人开口道，“我敢肯定我们能找到你要的东西，没必要喊。”他的话带着老练商人惯有的从容自信，尽管空气里绷着火药味，他依旧说得平静。 他戏剧性地一挥手臂——手里还挥着一根一英尺长的黄铜杆，一端刻着细小的棱纹——指向他那些“轻度使用”的手推车中的一辆。“这辆刚到手，我觉得特别适合你！”他咧嘴大笑，自信地朝她伸出手。“那么，我们来做笔‘邓恩’的交易，如何？”

~ Played by Chandelin

The rotund halfling strokes his trimmed mustache as the buyer—a scarred half-orc woman—looms over him, bellowing demands inches from his face. “My friend,” the halfling begins. “I’m sure we can find what you are looking for, there’s no need to shout.” His words carry the easy confidence of a practiced salesman, and he speaks calmly despite the tension in the air. Sweeping his arm—and a footlong brass rod with small ridges at one end—out in a theatrical flourish, he points to one of his ‘lightly-used’ carts. “This one just came in and I think it would be perfect for you!” He smiles wide and extends a hand confidently towards her. “Now, shall we make this a Dunn deal?”

~ Played by Chandelin

Threat From A Fleeing Villain.name:
来自逃亡恶徒的威胁
Threat From A Fleeing Villain

Text.text:
