“这不会是我的终点。我向你保证，下次我们再见……你最珍爱之人的尸身将铺满脚下，一切才会结束。”
“This will not be my end. I promise you, the next time we meet… it will be over the bodies of those you love most.”

Quip About Living Without Dreams.name:
一句关于无梦而活的俏皮话
Quip About Living Without Dreams

Text.text:
“再没有比发现自己被剥夺了梦想更残酷的惩罚：只能顺着这条人生原样漂流，听不见那本可以如何的苦甜余音。”
“There is no crueler punishment than to find yourself bereft of dreams, to float through this life as it is without the bittersweet notes of what it could be.”

Loot From A Grindylow.name:
来自水鬼的战利品
Loot From A Grindylow

Text.text:
在尸鬼水妖的尸体旁、一簇海带下面，藏着价值 20 枚银币的稀有珊瑚，以及一枚针尖大小的钻石徽章。
Under a clump of kelp near the grindylow’s body are 20 silver pieces’ worth of rare coral and a diamond badge the size of a pinhead.

I Put On My Prosthetic Hand Of Freezing.name:
我戴上了冰寒的义肢手
I Put On My Prosthetic Hand Of Freezing

Text.text:
闪烁的霜华永恒覆裹着这只义手的外壳，我将它扣上时，冰晶间荡起一阵微光涟漪。细小的冰锥攀附在磨损的指尖上，宛如玻璃钟乳，随着我的动作轻轻叮当作响。流动的奥术符文沿着义手盘旋缠绕，散发出柔和的魔法辉光。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，Forge Ahead: A Party To Access 创作

Glistening frost permanently rimes the exterior of the prosthetic hand, and a shimmer ripples through the icy crystals as I attach it. Tiny icicles cling to the well-worn fingertips, like glass stalactites that rattle delicately when I move. Flowing arcane script winds around the prosthetic, glowing with soft magical radiance.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Composite-stock Bolt-action Combat Rifle.name:
复合材质枪托栓动战斗步枪
Composite-stock Bolt-action Combat Rifle

Text.text:
这是一把任何士兵——无论来自军队还是街头——都会配备的标准武器。它的复合枪身能在过热前承受短促的连发。枪栓握把贴合掌心，握起来顺手而舒适，仿佛温柔地推开通往痛苦世界的大门。
This is a standard arm for any soldier—of the army or of the streets. Its composite frame can handle short bursts of fire before overheating. The bolt grip feels easy in the hand, comfortable as it opens the door to a world of pain.

Beautiful Electrum Buckle.name:
华美的琥珀金搭扣
Beautiful Electrum Buckle

Text.text:
它以不对称的蓝绿色交织涂绘，在昏暗光照下如泻湖般微微荡漾。搭扣呈圆形，印记是一枚泪滴夹在月桂之间；本体只是一块朴素的金属片，带着铸出的钩扣：古老而恒久。
It is painted in an asymmetrical combination of teals, undulating like a lagoon in dim light. Round, stamped with a teardrop between laurels, the buckle is a simple plate with a molded hook: ancient and timeless.

Drow At Spider Goddess Shrine.name:
卓尔·蜘蛛女神神龛
Drow At Spider Goddess Shrine

Text.text:
祈求者在圣龛前匍匐于地，双手双膝撑在冰冷的地面上。黑玉与青金石雕成的神像俯视着他，眼眸嵌着拳头大小的紫水晶。雕像带着微笑，而卓尔却皱眉沉思，随后缓缓在女神面前五体投地。他的脸贴上花岗岩地板，双臂向前伸直，双腿并拢，仿佛正要飞起；唯有圣龛底座周围最黯淡的烛光，勉强照亮他悔罪的身影。
The supplicant is on hands and knees before the shrine, where the statue of jet and lapis looks down with eyes made of fist-sized amethysts. The sculpture smiles, but the drow frowns in contemplation, then slowly prostrates himself before his goddess. His face touches the granite floor, arms out straight and legs together, as if he were flying, only the dimmest of candlelight around the base of the shrine to light his contrition.

环绕蟹井城的城墙由高耸的砂岩筑成，如同巍然堡垒，仿佛从未被暴风或狂飙触及，甚至连时代的流逝也无法在其上留下痕迹。对一座如此古老的城市而言，它们却出奇地洁净如新；墙面上唯一的痕迹，是精巧的镌刻：各式象形图案以拼布般的纹样铺满整片石壁。这些图像似乎并未传达任何清晰的信息或主题——至少你无法辨明——却为这道防线的宏伟气势更添几分庄严与华美。
The walls surrounding Crabwell, bastions of towering sandstone, appear wholly untouched by storm or gale, or even the passage of time. For a city as ancient as this, they are remarkably pristine, the only markings are artistic etchings: various pictograms drawn in a quilt-like pattern over the entirety of the stone. These images do not seem to portray any clear message or theme—at least none that you can discern—but do add to the overall architectural grandeur of these fortifications.

Key To A Haunted House.name:
闹鬼宅邸的钥匙
Key To A Haunted House

Text.text:
这把华丽的黄铜钥匙握在手里比看上去更沉；一种诡异而令人不安的重量，更因钥匙最醒目的特征而加倍。物体的钥匙头上嵌着一只布满血丝的眼睛，忽地眨开，冰蓝色的虹膜冷冷转动，四下窥探。
The ornate brass key feels heavier in hand than it appears; a strange and unnerving weight compounded by the key’s most prominent feature. A bloodshot eye, set into the bow of the object, blinks open and peers around with an ice-blue iris.

Ranger Victory Line About Trophies.name:
游侠胜利台词：关于战利品
Ranger Victory Line About Trophies

Text.text:
“别害怕。你的故事不会在这里结束。我总会从我杀死的猎物身上取走一件战利品，所以从某种意义上说，你将永远活下去。”
“Don’t be afraid. Your story doesn’t end here. I always take a trophy of my kills, so in a way, you will live on forever.”

I Become One With Shadows.name:
我与阴影融为一体
I Become One With Shadows

Text.text:
我搜寻任何阴郁的区域。一旦发现足以遮蔽我的巨大阴影，我便朝它们走去。当我踏入那片清凉的黑暗时，我满足地轻叹一声。就在那一刻，我从视线中消失了。
I search for any area of gloom. When I spot shadows big enough to shroud me, I move toward them. I sigh in satisfaction as I step into the cool darkness. As I do, I disappear from view.

Boots Of Striding And Springing.name:
健步弹跃之靴
Boots Of Striding And Springing

Text.text:
这双做工精良的靴子提在手里时轻得出奇，明明是用坚韧的异域兽皮制成。靴内衬乍看像羊羔绒，细看才发现其实是细密的鸟羽编织成巧妙的网状结构。靴底的纹路被精心刻成纵横交错的沟槽。
The well-crafted boots feel curiously light when lifted, despite the toughness of the exotic hide used in their creation. The lining of the footwear appears to be shearling wool, but on closer inspection, is made up of fine bird feathers woven into a cunning mesh. The tread on the soles has been painstakingly carved into crisscrossed grooves.

Nightmare About Body Possession.name:
关于身体被夺舍的噩梦
Nightmare About Body Possession

Text.text:
一股看不见的力量猛然撞上你。它把你掀翻在林地上，拖着你在泥土、落叶与苔藓间翻滚。头顶，光秃的树枝伸出利爪，抓向无月的夜空。泥尘刺痛你的眼睛，糊住你的口腔；紧接着一道白光吞没视野——你的头撞上了某个坚硬之物。那片白炽在边缘灼烧，而就在灼烧蔓延之时，一道冰冷、恶毒的意识将你的意识压向不断扩张、火星四溅的黑暗深处。待视线清明，你却像隔着遥远的窗子，从你的眼睛里看见世界。你只能旁观——你感觉自己站起身来，一股心满意足的恶意横亘在你与身体的掌控之间。

~ Envisioned by BigMacDaddy

An unseen force slams into you. It knocks you to the forest floor and drags you through the soil, leaves, and moss. Overhead, naked trees claw at the moonless sky. Dirt stings your eyes and coats your mouth, then a white flash fills your vision as your head strikes something hard. The whiteness burns around the edges, and as it does, a cold, malignant consciousness pushes yours down into the growing, ember-filled darkness. When your vision clears, you see through your eyes as if they’re windows at a great distance. You can only bear witness as you feel yourself stand, a satisfied malevolence between you and bodily control.

~ Envisioned by BigMacDaddy

Wand Of Secrets.name:
探秘魔杖
Wand Of Secrets

Text.text:
一条抛光的棕色木质螺旋如盘旋的双螺旋般构成这根魔杖的杖身，杖柄末端的杖首镶着一只闪耀的黄铜握把。金属上蚀刻着一道流畅的奥术符号，魔杖以低沉而共鸣的嗡鸣轻轻震颤。
A spiraling helix of polished brown wood forms the body of this wand, and a shining brass handle decorates the pommel. A flowing arcane symbol has been etched into the metal and the wand hums with a low, resonant tone.

Swamps Of The Dark Faerie Plane.name:
黑暗妖精位面的沼泽
Swamps Of The Dark Faerie Plane

Text.text:
扭曲的沼泽向四面八方绵延数十里，尽头是盘根错节、被阴影吞没的荒野。炽亮的星光从头顶纠缠的枝桠间渗出，坠落在平静而微咸的水面上，如银色细流蜿蜒。恶臭的沼水静得出奇，不见风拂，也不被行过的生灵搅动，仿佛把水下潜伏的一切秘密都严丝合缝地藏了起来。远处有幽光起伏——是灯笼，还是更阴毒的东西？一声诡异得近乎人类的嚎叫撕裂夜色，比你愿意承受的距离更近。
The twisted bogs sprawl for many leagues in all directions, terminating in gnarled wilderness lost to shadow. Incandescent starlight bleeds through the tangled boughs above, falling upon the placid, brackish water like rivulets of silver. The foul-smelling marsh water lies still, unnaturally so, undisturbed by wind or the passing of creatures, concealing whatever secrets lurk beneath. Ghostly light bobs in the distance—lanterns, or something more sinister? A strangely human howl splits the night, closer than you’d prefer.

Babbling Hanger-on.name:
喋喋不休的跟班
Babbling Hanger-on

Text.text: “我这几个月一直在想方设法讨那家公司的欢心，”她说着，手里攥着手机。她的目光每隔几秒就往屏幕上一扫，确认有没有新动静——尽管她太阳穴上的植入体和手机是同一品牌，本该能立刻把更新推到她脑子里。“我都数不清参加了多少次午餐、咖啡局、鸡尾酒社交。还永远都是最顶的地方，因为这公司就这德行，你懂吧？讲究。每次都是一大把信用点打水漂，就为了什么？为了跟一个口气熏人的中层代表聊两句，而人家压根没打算替我美言一句？”她叹了口气，手机又一次毫无通知，她便把脸撑在拳头上。她嘟起打过针的嘴唇，深红的口红衬着深色眼影与染成赤褐的头发。 “I’ve been trying to get into the corp’s good graces for months now,” she says, cell in hand. Her eyes flit down to the screen every few seconds to check for updates, even though the implant at her temple—the same brand as the cell—will update her instantly. “Can’t tell you how many lunches, coffees, and cocktail mixers I’ve been to. And it’s always the best places, because that’s how this corp is, you know? Classy. So every time it’s a bundle of credits down the drain to, what? To talk to some mid-tier rep with bad breath and no intention of putting in a good word?” She sighs and, when her phone yet again has zero notifications, she rests her face on her fist. She pouts her injected lips, the dark red lipstick complementing her dark eyeshadow and dyed auburn hair.

Alien Cloning Facility.name:
外星克隆设施
Alien Cloning Facility

Text.text:
这片空间的大部分由空白、洁净而无菌的表面构成——无尽的走廊上点缀着脉冲星喷流，供人高速移动。皮肤如冷却熔岩般粗粝的矮壮外星人拖着沉重步伐来回穿梭，靠着巨大的前肢调整嵌入墙体的生物科技面板。每块面板旁都有一扇黏稠的观察窗，透出克隆舱的景象：无数胚胎被几十根电线与管缆牵连，延展到视野尽头。
Blank white sterile surfaces make up the majority of this space—endless corridors bedecked with pulsar jetstreams for speedy movement. Squat aliens with skin the texture of cooled magma lumber back and forth on oversized front legs, adjusting biotech panels set into the walls. Next to each panel is a gloopy window offering a view of the cloning chambers, and endless embryos attached to dozens of wires and cables.

Cloudy Night.name:
阴云密布之夜
Cloudy Night

Text.text:
片片云带飘荡翻卷，宛如幽魂的帷幕掩过月面，将这盏夜空的巨灯连同它那群闪烁的星辰随从一并压低了光芒。云层的灰色与浓密的掩蔽预示着风暴或许已近在咫尺。唯有那些早已习惯——或无惧——那无边迫近的黑暗之人，才能在这夜色里无畏前行。
Tracts of clouds waft and fold over the moon’s face like ghostly curtains, muting the great nightly lantern along with its retinue of twinkling stars. The gray color and the density of the cloud cover portends a storm may be nigh. Only those accustomed to—or unafraid of—a vast and looming darkness might traverse this evening without trepidation.

断层绵延数千英里，在某些地段豁然裂开，横跨数英里之宽。它深得惊人，即便在炽烈阳光下也沉没于黑暗之中。裂隙的一条支脉尽头，是一片嶙峋的岩石地形；那片大地先是战栗，继而如雷鸣般翻涌，卷入又一次板块巨变。裂隙又悄然向外爬行了些许，沿着月面的弧度继续延伸。
The fault line runs for thousands of miles, opening several miles across at certain places. It is deep enough to vanish into darkness even under bright sunlight. One branch of the fissure ends in an expanse of rocky terrain that shakes, then rolls like thunder up into another tectonic event. The fissure inches out a little further, making its way around the moon’s surface.

Rod Of The Pact Keeper, +2.name:
契约守护者法杖 +2
Rod Of The Pact Keeper, +2

Text.text:
这柄权杖以昏暗的木材制成，整体呈一道带凹槽的螺旋锥形。繁复的奥术图式被灼刻进木纹深处，银色链条穿行于螺旋沟槽的底部。链条缠住杖身两端，在最尖窄处垂下三道环扣。几节松脱的链环上荡着一枚澄澈的圆珠；而在顶端，链条束紧一枚对称的三叉水晶。中央的尖端最长，三处末梢却都焦黑如炭。

~ 一位英雄 构想

The dusky wood of this scepter forms a grooved, spiraled cone. Complex arcane diagrams are scorched into the wood, and silvery chain runs through the lowest part of the spiral’s channel. The chain wraps both of the rod’s ends, with three loops dangling from the narrowest point. A clear orb swings on the free links, and at the top, the chain binds a symmetrical three-pointed crystal. The central point is the longest, but all three have blackened tips.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Slithering Shadow In Cave.name:
洞穴中蜿蜒游走的暗影
Slithering Shadow In Cave

Text.text:
壁沿上一团圆钝的轮廓微微一动。起初你以为那是石头——这座怪诞洞窟里又一处奇异的岩石构造——可不，它在动，像一大圈粗绳缓缓松开般蜿蜒滑行。伴随着这道滑行的移动，响起一阵低低的沙沙摩擦声，几乎像是有人在搓揉双手。
A rounded shape atop the ledge shifts. You initially took it for stone—another strange rock formation in this queer cavern—but no, it moves, slithering like a huge coil of rope slowly unspooling. A quiet rasp accompanies the gliding movement, sounding almost like hands being rubbed together.

Condemned Apartment Building.name:
被判死刑的公寓楼
Condemned Apartment Building

Text.text:
危害警戒带在破碎的窗前迎风飘动，在寒冽的空气里如缎带般旋舞。手电光束扫过这栋被封禁的公寓楼内部，老鼠四散钻进洞穴。无线电的沙沙杂音与低沉、克制的说话声在城市的荒凉废墟间回荡。
Hazard tape flutters in the breeze in front of a shattered window, twirling like a ribbon in the chill air. Rats scatter into bolt-holes as flashlights sweep the interior of the condemned apartment block. The crackle of radio static and low, measured voices echo through the urban desolation.

Loot From An Observant Yuan-ti.name:
来自一名警觉的羽蛇人的战利品
Loot From An Observant Yuan-ti

Text.text:
蛇人那扭曲盘绕的躯体以一个歪斜的“8”字形僵卧不动。一支黄铜单筒望远镜卡在生物胸前斜挎的枪带皮环里。你将它抽出，立刻看出做工精致，金属光洁如新，毫无锈蚀。你又翻了翻他腰带上的一只小巧方形包，里面收着一撮细小宝石。其中几颗格外扎眼：一枚叶片形的祖母绿、一颗蜜色黄水晶，以及一滴露珠般的海蓝宝石。
The twisting body of the snakefolk lies unmoving in a lopsided figure eight. A brass spyglass sits in a leather loop on the bandolier across the creature’s chest. You pull it free and find its craftsmanship fine and the metal free of tarnish. You also riffle through a small square pack on his belt, which contains a collection of small gemstones. A few stand out immediately: an emerald shaped like a leaf, a honey-colored citrine, and a dewdrop aquamarine.

Giant Mushroom Grove.name:
巨型蘑菇林
Giant Mushroom Grove

Text.text:
麝香般、霉腐的气味愈发浓烈而清晰，你迎面撞上一幅令人震撼的景象：一片幽光浮动、阴森黯沉的真菌森林。黯淡的蓝、低语般的紫、凶兆般的红在闪烁——来自顶端狭窄的蘑菇，它们如同层层叠起的长矛林立；也来自巨兽般、树一样的庞大菌体那漆黑的菌褶，它们将菌盖撑开，如同巨伞般铺展。
The musky, moldy scent grows strong and clear as you confront an astonishing vista: a glowing, gloomy forest of fungus. Dim blue, quieter purple, and ominous red glimmer—from narrow-topped mushrooms, standing like stacks of spears, and from the dark gills of behemoth tree-like fungi that spread their caps like enormous umbrellas.

这座高耸的石造建筑仿佛在违逆现实，以一种诡异的倾斜角度直冲天际。旗帜在风中猎猎翻飞，每一面都描绘着学院内部不同院系的徽记：狮鹫、飞龙、巨龙，以及多得叫不出名字的其他纹章。塔基没有任何门扉——甚至看不出半点入口的可能——可当你绕着塔身行走时，忽然就在这令人不安的结构投下的阴影夹角里，瞥见了一处隐秘的入口。

踏入其中，你穿行在一间间教室、藏书楼、实验室、宿舍与宏伟大厅之间；这些空间的广阔程度，远远超出塔外轮廓所能容纳的想象。与此同时，你用来旅行的走廊与通道却仿佛随时会改写自身。方才还在的楼梯转眼化作尽头；紧接着，一道开口又凭空出现，向下通往黑暗——而那位置先前不过是一面毫无纹理的石墙。
The towering stone structure seems to defy reality, soaring high at an odd, tilted angle. Banners flutter in the breeze, each depicting the sigil of a separate house within the school itself: a griffin, a wyvern, a dragon, and too many others to name. No door adorns the base of the tower—indeed, there appears to be no way in at all—but as you circle the tower, suddenly, you spot an entry hidden in the shadowed angles of the unnerving structure.

Inside, you find yourself passing classrooms, libraries, laboratories, dormitories, and grand halls much larger than the tower's exterior might suggest. All the while, the passages by which you travel seem to shift at a moment's notice. Suddenly, there is a dead end where a staircase just was; then, an opening appears, leading down into the darkness, where once stood only a featureless stone wall.

Lich Beneath A Pulsing Crystal.name:
脉动水晶之下的巫妖
Lich Beneath A Pulsing Crystal

Text.text:
沐浴在惨淡的绿色巫光里，一道身影立于一枚脉动的水晶下方，干枯脱水的皮肉凹陷处在光影中被残酷勾勒，骇人至极。它披着霉烂的长袍，浑身覆着坟土，阴风裹挟着它的嗓音，将咒文一字字诵出。污秽魔力被它编织成形，绿与红的闪电划出弧线，召来一种可触可感的死亡与绝望之息。

~ 由 Devs & Dice 的 Leif 构想

诅咒之丘 Part I: 骷髅丘之底 Part II: 骷髅丘的斜坡 Part III: 一对身披红甲的战士 Part IV: 骷髅丘之巅 Part V: 脉动水晶下的巫妖 Bathed in pallid green witchlight, a figure stands beneath a pulsing crystal, the hollows of their desiccated flesh cast in horrifying relief. Clad in moldering robes, covered in grave dirt, their voice carries on a fell wind as they recite an incantation. Weaving foul magics, in arcs of green and red lightning, they summon a palpable aura of death and despair.

~ Envisioned by Leif from Devs & Dice

Cursed Hill Part I: Base of Skull Hill Part II: Slopes of Skull Hill Part III: Pair of Red, Armored Warriors Part IV: Summit of Skull Hill Part V: Lich Beneath a Pulsing Crystal

一段短短的铁链，将两片马蹄形铁箍各自拱弧的中点相连。每道弧的一端略长，沿边均匀竖起凸齿；另一端则铆着厚重的铁闩。铁闩可旋转扣合，压过齿端，因而能贴合不同粗细的手腕或脚踝。铁闩内侧藏有锁扣，需用钥匙开启，才能将其从齿上解开；否则便死死咬住，寸步难移。
A short length of chain connects two horseshoe-shaped pieces of iron at the midpoint of each arch. One end of each curve is slightly longer, with raised teeth at even intervals. On the opposite end, thick bars are riveted. Each bar can swivel closed over the toothed end to fit wrists or ankles of various sizes. The bars have internal latches, opened with a key, that hold them in place on the teeth.

Faren Alatar Of The Guro, In Memory.name:
古罗的法伦·阿拉塔尔，铭记于心
Faren Alatar Of The Guro, In Memory

Text.text:
众人围坐在沙丘间一簇小小的篝火旁，举杯为逝去的战友致意，敬他高贵的牺牲。记忆在他们脑海里飘荡：那高大健硕的身影披着闪亮的鳞甲，黝黑的笑脸被一道道红色战纹轻轻遮住，宛如燃烧的落日。他们想起他掌心那道螺旋般的刻痕，粗糙而遍布疤痕——他曾用族人无声的手势引领他们穿越流沙；也想起那头他格外钟爱的、魁梧的灰皮巨兽。噼啪作响的火焰将点点炽亮的余烬放入清凉的沙漠夜气，任其漂向群星；每一位伙伴都揣着心底最珍贵的一段回忆，渐渐沉入梦乡。

~ Played by MasterLionsDen with

Gathered around a small campfire amid the sandy dunes, the party members raise a toast to their fallen comrade, honoring his noble sacrifice. Memories drift through their minds of a tall, muscular figure clad in gleaming scale mail, his tanned, smiling face lightly obscured by the red warpaint daubed across it like a burning sunset. They remember the rough, scarred flesh of the spiral etched into his palm as he guided them through the shifting sands with the silent gestures of his people, and the hulking, gray-skinned beast he was so fond of. As the crackling flames release glowing embers into the cool, desert air and they float towards the stars, each of the companions drifts into slumber holding a cherished memory in their heart.

~ Played by MasterLionsDen with

I Cast Faithful Hound Using Components.name:
我用施法材料施放“忠犬守卫”
I Cast Faithful Hound Using Components

Text.text:
我像摆钟般来回摇动那截穿线的骨头，猛地吹响哨子，将魔法收束到自己身上。刹那间四周寂静无声——直到一声顽皮的吠叫随风回荡。我的幽灵同伴在我面前凝形而出，缕缕烟雾从它的魅影（特征）躯体上盘旋逸散；它用又圆又忠诚的眼睛望着我，摇着一条飘忽的鬼尾。
Swinging the threaded bone back and forth like a pendulum, I blow sharply on the whistle to focus the magic on me. For a moment all is still and quiet—until a playful bark echoes on the wind. My spectral companion materializes before me, wisps of smoke coiling from its phantom body, and it looks to me with wide, faithful eyes, wagging a ghostly tail.

I Use My Arrow Catching-shield.name:
我举起捕箭盾
I Use My Arrow Catching-shield

Text.text: 我听见弓弦被放开的铮然一响，立刻举起盾牌。箭矢破空而来，箭头却仿佛被磁石牵引般纷纷朝我偏转。那些投射物像雨点般无害地弹在盾面上，随即折断或弯曲着坠落地面。 I hear the twang of bowstrings being loosed and throw up my shield. As the arrows fly through the air, their heads bend toward me as if pulled by a magnet. The projectiles bounce off my shield as harmlessly as raindrops and fall to the ground broken or bent.

钢质护片加固了一套柔韧的皮甲，裁制得恰到好处，穿在身上可令移动自由尽展。护肩、胫甲与护手与内衬甲一并配套，而那内衬甲本身还镶嵌着某种波纹起伏的合金。它看似沉重僵硬，却贴合如第二层肌肤，舒适稳妥；在这件匠心杰作的构造上方，魔法的低鸣沉甸甸地萦绕不散。
Steel splints reinforce a suit of flexible leather, perfectly worn to allow for maximum freedom of movement. Pauldrons, greaves, and gauntlets accompany the gambeson, which itself is inlaid with some kind of rippled alloy. Though it appears heavy and rigid, it fits snugly and comfortably, and the thrum of magic hangs heavy over its masterwork construction.

Dragons' Graveyard In A Canyon.name:
峡谷中的巨龙墓园
Dragons' Graveyard In A Canyon

Text.text:
这道峡谷的体型，被其中散落的骸骨衬得愈发惊人——尤其是那些肋骨。它们并非尽皆惨白，哪怕在烈日与尘沙里曝晒了不知多少个世纪。有的泛着青绿，有的染着幽蓝，还有的呈淡淡的蔷薇色，仿佛神明的饰物被随手掷进大地的抽屉里。倾斜着、半埋在土中的，是一具布满尖刺的长颅骨，足有车厢般大小；一只眼眶朝向云端——那片它曾俯瞰世界的高处——曾由巨大而皮革般的双翼将它托举在空中。
The size of this canyon is emphasized by the bones within—especially the ribcages. They are not all white, despite however many centuries in the sun and dust. Some are greenish, blue tinged, or a pale rose, like the jewelry of a god thrown into a drawer of the earth. Tilted and half buried is a long spiky skull the size of a carriage, one eye socket aimed toward the clouds from which it once looked down on the world, held aloft by great, leathery wings.

Sundries From A Quickling.name:
来自迅灵的小杂货
Sundries From A Quickling

Text.text:
这微小妖精的装束很朴素：一件秋叶短袍——橙褐色的叶片与枝茎随意拼扎，以芦苇捆缚——再配上一条同样材质、带着红褐色光泽的短裤。它那条蘑菇皮腰带里硬塞着一张胡乱卷起的纸。你将其展开，发现是一封书信，字迹娴熟，行文如流水般连绵。看起来这小坏蛋是从某位贵族或信使那里顺走的——也许只是被纸张边缘镶着的闪亮金丝花纹勾起了好奇。
The minute fey's outfit is simple: a tunic of autumn leaves—orange and brown plant matter tied together with reed—and ruddy breeches of similar material. A haphazardly rolled up piece of paper is stuffed into its mushroom-leather belt. Unfurling it, you find a letter written in well-practiced, flowing script. It seems the little scamp nicked this from a noble or messenger, perhaps intrigued by the shining gold filigree lining the borders of the paper.

即便隔着一段距离，也绝不会把那具架在木支架顶端的瘦长身影认错——它分明就是用来吓走那些贪图轻易果腹的鸟儿的人形稻草人。然而，播种了这片田地的农夫却拍胸脯保证，这个简陋的稻草人确实管用。
Even from a distance, there is no mistaking the gangly form positioned atop the wooden strut as anything other than a manikin for frightening off birds hungry for an easy morsel. Yet the farmer who planted the crops in the field swears by the efficacy of this simple scarecrow.

Ocular Weapon Implant.name:
眼部武器植入体
Ocular Weapon Implant

Text.text:
这件武器嵌入操作者的颅骨之中，以特制的义体植入物取代其真实眼球。只需一个念头，使用者便能释放出致命的超压缩等离子光束，足以切穿任何形式的个人护甲。凭借精密的瞄准系统与先进的神经矩阵，这套装置既直觉般顺手，又冷酷致命。
This weapon is integrated into the skull of the operator, replacing their actual eye with a specially designed cybernetic implant. With a thought the user can unleash a deadly beam of ultra-compressed plasma, capable of cutting through any form of personal armor. With sophisticated targeting systems and advanced neural matrices, the device is both intuitive and deadly.

他身侧的长剑是一柄朴素的武器，在战斗中像手臂的平滑延伸。他的头发剪得很短，却有些凌乱，闪着潇洒的银色——与他眼中那抹灰几乎同色。右耳戴着一枚金耳环，细链连接到他面颊上的一颗耳钉。这并非炫耀财富与权势的浮华标记。它与他朴素的灰褐衣装和基础链甲一样，是仪式纪律与誓言的印记——那是他所属骑士团的骑士们所立下的誓约。

~ 由 Alex Roos 扮演

The longsword at his side is a simple weapon, a smooth extension of his arm in combat. His hair is kept short, yet scruffy, and is a dashing silver—a near match for the gray in his eyes. In his right ear is a gold earring, chained to a stud in his cheek. This is not a flamboyant symbol of wealth and power. Like his humble gray and tan clothes and basic chain mail, it is a marker of ritual discipline and the vows taken by the knights of his Order.

~ Played by Alex Roos

Low-income Neighborhood Situated Under F.name:
位于航线下的低收入街区
Low-income Neighborhood Situated Under Flight Pattern

Text.text:
又一架飞机在头顶危险地低空轰鸣掠过，如同一场局部地震般震得公寓楼的波纹铁皮屋顶簌簌作响，电力也随之忽明忽暗。暮色时分并未给这片饱受摧残的街区带来丝毫喘息；对这里的居民而言，时代早已失去意义。呼啸而过的飞机对他们感官的持续轰炸，已将他们的心智彻底碾碎。
Another plane rumbles dangerously low overhead, shaking the corrugated roof of the apartment block like a localized earthquake and causing the power to flicker. The twilight hours hold no respite for the residents of this beleaguered neighborhood, for whom time has become meaningless. The constant assault on their senses by passing aircraft has shattered their minds utterly.

这名小型蓝皮类人生物佝偻如弓背地精，指端生着利爪；耳朵又长又尖；黑发稀疏而硬；红色小眼珠滴溜溜地转。它泛黄的獠牙嵌在紫黯的牙龈里，长得几乎塞不进嘴，仿佛永远挂着一抹阴毒的笑。这个小怪物喘息粗重，间或发出断断续续的咯咯笑声。
Like a hunched goblin, this small, blue-skinned humanoid has clawed digits; long, sharp ears; wiry black hair; and beady, red eyes. The creature’s yellowed fangs, set in purplish gums, are too big for its mouth. They give the impression of a constant, malevolent grin. The little monster breathes heavily, giggling intermittently.

尽管未经训练的人可能会把你面前这人误认作码头搬运工，或许是个信使，你却从细枝末节里看出了他真正那份窃盗行当的痕迹。衣着为黑暗而精心挑选，却并非扎眼的深夜蓝或纯黑；贴在平坦腹部的一只束带小囊被巧妙遮住——那是常用来迅速取用盗贼工具或丝绳的款式。他踩上鹅卵石路时，深色靴子竟无声无息，显然是软底精制。可他身上又看不见什么明晃晃的武器，因而并非拦路劫匪，而是偏爱“二楼行当”的那类人：趁人熟睡或疏忽时潜入人家，悄然卷走贵重之物，在他们意识到有人来过之前便已远遁无踪。
Though the untrained might mistake the individual in front of you as a stevedore or perhaps a courier, you recognize telltale signs of their true larcenous profession. Clothing carefully chosen for its darkness, yet not made out in a noticeable midnight blue or black, conceal a pouch strapped along their flat belly, the kind often used for quick access to thieving tools or silk rope. Their dark boots make no sound as they tread upon cobblestones, indicating that they have been crafted with soft soles. Yet, they carry no obvious weapons, so they are no robber, but instead a second-story man who prefers to pilfer homes of the sleeping or unwary, absconding with their valuables before they know anyone was ever there.

I Cast Detect Magic.name:
我施放侦测魔法
I Cast Detect Magic

Text.text:
我深深吸了一口气，闭上眼睛，专注去感知附近是否有魔法的存在。随着我凝神静思，一阵刺麻感爬上四肢，太阳穴也隐隐胀痛——我正努力让心神越过凡俗的感官边界。当我再度睁开眼，便能看见魔法如何在我们世界的经纬之间穿梭交织。
I breathe deeply and close my eyes to concentrate on sensing the presence of magic nearby. A tingling sensation manifests in my limbs and a headache builds in my temples as I focus my mind—attempting to go beyond my mortal senses. When I open my eyes, I can see the magic that weaves itself through the fabric of our world.

Magical Street Drug, Renfield.name:
魔法街头毒品：伦菲尔德
Magical Street Drug, Renfield

Text.text:
注射器的筒身里，一种阴魂般幽暗、黏稠的液体像迟钝的油般缓缓流动，却又如将熄的心脏般微微搏动。举到光下，它闪烁着马尔贝克般深沉的绯红。按下推杆放出液体，便迸出一股复杂气息：甜腻得近乎奢华的馋人香气层层叠加，底下却托着浓烈的金属腥意。指尖一触，哪怕只沾上一滴，那液体也会放出细微、近乎磁性的震颤，像情人贴着你颈侧的低哼般，迅速窜遍全身。

~ 一位英雄 Envisioned

In the barrel of the syringe a hauntingly dark, viscous liquid moves like torpid oil, but pulses faint as a failing heart. Held up to the light, the liquid shimmers with the deep crimson of Malbec. Depressing the syringe’s plunger to loose the liquid unleashes a complex scent of cloying gourmand layered with heady metallics. When touched, even a drop of the liquid emits a subtle, almost magnetic, vibration that rushes through your entire body like a lover's hum on your neck.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Drink My Potion Of Fire Giant Strength.name:
我喝下火巨人力量药水
I Drink My Potion Of Fire Giant Strength

Text.text:
这瓶药水是一种极其难以下咽的混合物：滚烫的液体掺着黏稠的炭渣，入口刺痛，黏得我满嘴发涩。好不容易把那口饮料连同指甲一并咽下，胃里顿时燃起火光。我屈伸手臂与双腿，只觉自己凶猛得像一座满载烈焰的山——随时准备撕裂大地。
This potion is a most unsavory mix of scalding liquid and claggy charcoal, leaving my mouth stinging and sticky. When I finally manage to get the drink and fingernail down the hatch, my stomach alights. I flex my arms and legs, feeling as fearsome as a mountain full of fire—ready to rend the earth.

Quip By A Wealthy Villain.name:
富豪反派的俏皮话
Quip By A Wealthy Villain

Text.text:
“我不会跟你动手。我很肯定你的武艺无可挑剔——毕竟你花了那么多时代去跟当地的野生动物找茬。我个人觉得暴力令人作呕，所以我雇了这些好心人替我出手。”
“I’m not going to fight you. I’m sure your martial abilities are impeccable, having spent so much time picking fights with the local wildlife. I personally find violence detestable, so I’ve hired these kind people to do it for me.”

Grand Study Room.name:
宏大的书房
Grand Study Room

Text.text:
巨大的窗户倾泻而入的光线充满这间陈设考究的房间，使奢华的家具在沿墙排列的书架上投下修长的阴影。填充厚实的高背椅、低矮的红木桌与写字台显然都是年代久远、出自匠师之手的老物件。由更浅色木料制成的读书讲台风格迥异，想必是近来添置的新购。其上摊着一本巨大的皮革装帧书册，书页张开，一条猩红的丝带夹作书签。
Light from large windows floods this well-appointed chamber, causing its luxurious furnishing to cast long shadows across the bookshelves that line the walls. The overstuffed and highbacked chairs, low mahogany table, and writing desk are clearly old pieces crafted by masters. A reading lectern made of paler wood is a different style and must be a more recent purchase. It holds a massive, leather-bound book splayed open with the page marked by a strip of scarlet silk.

Mental Prison Successful.name:
精神牢狱：成功
Mental Prison Successful

Text.text:
你以凝固不移的目光锁定对方，双手如钳般收紧，将某个生物的心智对“自由”这一概念彻底封死。魔法灼烫你的猎物之思维，焚刻出囚禁的幻象；在其心眼之中，把该生物封入一座丑恶而危机四伏的牢笼。此笼便成为目标的整个世界，而胆敢触及其外，便等同自取灭亡。
With a fixed gaze and clamping hands, you close a creature’s mind to the idea that it is free. The magic sears your quarry’s mind, burning an image of captivity, sealing the creature, in its mind’s eye, in a hideous and hazardous enclosure. This cage becomes the target’s world, and to dare reach beyond it promises death.

Sundries From A Banshee.name:
女妖杂货
Sundries From A Banshee

Text.text:
女妖倒下之处，地面覆着一层银白色的残痕。她腕上曾戴着的七只纤细手镯质地粗劣，每只大概只值1到2枚铜币。一枚小小的白镴耳钉躺在一旁，凝结的血痂结在其上。
A silvery residue covers the ground where the banshee fell. The seven slender bangles she once wore on her wrist are of poor quality, each likely worth only 1 or 2 copper pieces. A tiny pewter earring lies crusted with dried blood.

Sundries From A Specter.name:
来自幽影的杂货
Sundries From A Specter

Text.text:
幽魂发出一声凄厉的哀嚎，随即在虚无中消散殆尽，仿佛被溶解一般，只留下身后一堆怪异的微光尘埃。那诡谲的残渣隐隐闪烁，透着淡淡的幽冥精华。
As the specter fades into oblivion with a mournful screech, it leaves an odd pile of shimmering dust behind, as if it had been dissolved. The strange residue glimmers faintly with spectral essence.

Plane Of Paradise.name:
天堂位面
Plane Of Paradise

Text.text:
这里的世界看起来与物质位面无甚差别——葱郁的绿意被蜿蜒的河流切开，高耸的群山直刺云端。万物仿佛都覆着一层微妙的金色辉光。然而当你抬头望去，你看不见天空的湛蓝——你看见的是另一个世界，正俯视着你。
The world here appears much as it does in the Material Plane—lush greenery bisected by winding rivers and soaring mountains. Everything seems to glow a subtle gold hue. But looking up, you don't see the blue of a sky—you see another world, looking down on you.

Your Shield Protects You From A Brass Dr.name:
你的盾牌将你从黄铜龙的吐息中护住
Your Shield Protects You From A Brass Dragon's Breath

Text.text:
你肺里的空气灼烧得仿佛被点燃，狂暴的烈焰炼狱将你团团包围。你感觉到盾牌的金属隔着皮肉烫得发疼，巨龙的吐息灼烤着盾面，试探着它的极限。震耳欲聋的火啸吞没了一切，其余声音尽数被闷在其中。

~ Sahlonahl 于 Discord

The air in your lungs burns as if set alight, and a raging inferno surrounds you. You feel the metal of your shield hot against your flesh as the dragon's breath scorches the surface, testing it. The deafening roar of the flames muffles all other sound.

~ Sahlonahl on Discord

Orc With Shield.name:
持盾兽人
Orc With Shield

Text.text:
一名孤身的兽人战士如哨兵般伫立，藏身阴影之中，以警惕的目光注视着你。他魁梧如塔的身躯束在钢制胸甲里，手握一面木制六角盾，盾面布满过往冲突留下的伤痕。他缓缓迈步向前，抓住蔓藤的卷须作为支援，宛如不可撼动的力量——静候你下一步动作。
A solitary orc warrior stands sentinel, watching from the shadows with wary eyes. His towering frame is bound within a steel breastplate and he grips a wooden hexagonal shield scarred from past conflicts. Slowly he steps forward, grasping tendrils of vine for support, an indomitable force—waiting for your next move.

幼年恐龙的体型已如一头小牛般庞大，踏着沉重的步子四处觅食时，身形还会微微摇晃。短短的尾巴几乎帮不上它用那双强壮的腿保持平衡——腿上早已布满紧绷如绳的肌肉。锐利的爬行动物眼睛带着捕食者般的审视扫过地貌，巨大的鼻孔翕张着捕捉空气中的气味。它抬起笨重的头颅，呼唤着自己的母亲——同时露出真正令人胆寒的利齿。
Already the size of a small cow, the young dinosaur wobbles slightly as it stomps around looking for something to eat. A short tail does little to help the creature balance on its powerful legs, already thick with corded muscle, and keen reptilian eyes survey the landscape with a predator’s scrutiny, huge nostrils flaring to catch a scent. Raising its ponderous head, the creature calls out for their mother—and displays truly fearsome teeth.

Sundries From A Zombie Horde.name:
丧尸（特征）尸潮杂物
Sundries From A Zombie Horde

Text.text:
那群亡灵梦魇的乌合之众终于仁慈地归于沉寂，驱动这些不幸灵魂的诅咒已然破碎。你在断肢残骸与碎裂的身躯堆里翻找，发现了几件耐人寻味的小玩意儿：一枚铁箍，金属上粗糙地蚀刻着两座铁砧；一副镜片碎裂的眼镜；以及一条格子手帕，如今已被鲜血浸透。
The horde of undead nightmares lies mercifully still, the curse animating the unfortunate souls now broken. Among the pile of broken bodies and shattered limbs, you find a few interesting trinkets: an iron band with two anvils etched crudely into the metal, a pair of glasses with broken lenses, and a gingham handkerchief, now soaked in blood.

对那些不熟悉肤色深褐、银发如霜的妖精精灵——布拉兰尼——的人来说，眼前这位面容年轻的女子很容易被误认为是精灵族中个子矮壮的一支。你却能轻易从她的野性里辨出一种触手可及的高贵——尤其当她挥舞双弯刀踏出死亡之舞时，翡翠般的眼眸在正义的狂怒中骤然闪光。
For those unfamiliar with the deeply tanned, silver-haired fey elves known as the bralani, one might mistake the youthful-looking woman to be a short and stocky example of elvenkind. You can easily recognize a palpable nobility in her wildness, particularly when she wields her twin scimitars in her dance of death, her jade eyes flashing in righteous fury.

I Activate My Instant Fortress.name:
我启动我的瞬间要塞
I Activate My Instant Fortress

Text.text:
我从背包里捻出那枚小小的方块，把它抛到开阔的地面上。随着我吐出一个词语，草皮一阵震颤，它便化作我的精金要塞。我朝正对着我的大门迈去，念出开启之语，随即穿过敞开的迎宾门道。待我踏入那回声空荡的长厅，门在身后合拢；我继续走向通往屋顶的梯子，登上去后倚着锯齿状的女墙，立于这道抵御敌人的堡垒之上，眺望远方。
I pluck the little cube from my pack and toss it out onto the open ground. At a word, with a tremor along the turf, it becomes my adamantine keep. I march toward the door facing me and speak the word of opening, then continue through the welcoming gate. It closes behind me as I cross the echoing, empty hall to a ladder to the roof, where I can lean on the crenellated parapets and gaze out from this bulwark against my foes.

Witch's Regretful Final Words.name:
女巫悔恨的临终遗言
Witch's Regretful Final Words

Text.text:
“那些恶毒与怨毒？不过是成长的阵痛，是我通往卓绝之途上的垫脚石。你总不会因此怪罪我吧？一旦我抵达命定之处，我本会将我曾亏欠的人托举到炫目新高。我本会被爱……我本会被珍视。可如今，那些卑微的残忍与自私成了我的全部——我将永远只剩这些。我以为我还有更多时间。”

~ 一位英雄所构想

“All that bile and venom? They were just growing pains, steps on my way to magnificence. Surely, you wouldn’t begrudge me for that? Once I attained my destiny, I would’ve lifted those I’d wronged to dazzling new heights. I would’ve been loved… I would’ve been cherished. But now those petty acts of cruelty and selfishness are all that I am. All I will ever be. I thought I had more time.”

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Cast Arcane Hand.name:
我施放奥术之手
I Cast Arcane Hand

Text.text:
我从施法材料袋里抽出一只蛇皮手套，刚把它套上去——紧绷、粗粝——我的手指便结出一连串奥术手印，唤出一只闪烁的手掌，体型是我手的两倍。它悬在我面前，半透明地浮动着，随着我戴手套的手一同屈伸，蓄势待发——既可猛然推送出击，也可用于支援。
I draw a snakeskin glove from my component pouch, and the instant I pull it on, tight and rough, my fingers form the series of arcane signs that invoke a shimmering hand twice the size of my own. It hovers before me, translucent, flexing as my gloved hand flexes, ready to be sent out in force or in support.

这段修长的金属在末端分裂成三支锐利的长矛，每一支的尖端都带着凶狠的外翻锋芒。武器上饰以华美的雕纹与精巧成形的微凸装饰，在光线下闪烁生辉。
The long length of metal splits near the end into three sharp spears, each flaring viciously at the tip. Ornate carvings and subtle, shaped obtrusions decorate the weapon and gleam in the light.

Personal Delivery Drone.name:
个人配送无人机
Personal Delivery Drone

Text.text:
猫般的体型，这架伤痕累累的送货无人机冒险穿越危机四伏的贫民窟，巧妙地在狭窄缝隙间穿梭，躲开塑凝土上张口欲噬的深坑。它搭载的多组传感器，让它平安抵达的几率稍稍提高——只为把必需品送到那些最需要的人手中。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The size of a cat, the battered delivery drone braves the dangerous slums, artfully weaving through tight spaces and dodging yawning holes in the plasticrete. Its multiple sensors make the chances of arriving safely slightly better as it delivers essential goods to those in need.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Dragon's Breath (Lightning) Cast On Self.name:
龙息术（闪电）对自身施放
Dragon's Breath (Lightning) Cast On Self

Text.text:
一声雷霆般的咆哮自你喉间炸裂而出，周遭空气翻涌着被风暴亲吻过的能量。你高举头顶展示一枚辣椒，双眼骤然迸发出蔚蓝光芒。裹着噼啪静电的字句从你唇间迸溅，你将一只发光的手重重拍在胸口，嘴巴张得骇人地大。刺目的电流自你体内深处破空而出，如长枪般贯射向前。
A thunderous bellow bursts from your throat, the air about you writhing with storm-kissed energy. Your eyes flare cerulean as you display a pepper above your head. Words crackling with static spill from your lips, and you smash a glowing hand upon your chest, your mouth gaping impossibly wide. A stream of actinic electricity lances from the depths within.

Dispel Evil And Good.name:
解除善恶
Dispel Evil And Good

Text.text:
你向庇护你的神祇祈求放逐异界之力的权能，随即感到自己的身躯开始随神圣能量脉动、轰鸣。你只需一次接触，便能解开将异界生物及其力量系于物质界的羁绊。
Petitioning your patron deity for the power to banish otherworldly power, you feel your body begin to pulse and thrum with divine energy. Your very touch unravels the ties that bind extraplanar creatures and their powers to the material realm.

宽阔的白色犄角向上弯曲，末端渐成灰色尖梢，让这名高耸的牛头人更显巍峨。他把长矛当作行走的手杖拄着——那矛也只比他略高一点。覆盖在他壮硕身躯上的短毛呈浅色，头顶与狭窄的胡须上则是更深、更长的毛发；同样蓬乱的灰毛还铺在他后颈与肩胛之间。无数细小伤口留下的疤痕在浅色皮毛上刻出一道道粉色细线，像一份记录过往苦痛的账簿。可他的神情依旧安宁，眼底还藏着一丝戏谑。宽松的亚麻短裤与一条布腰带便是他全部的衣着；腰带里还别着几枚投掷飞镖。

~ 由一位英雄 扮演，其

Broad, white horns that curve upward, ending in gray tips, make this towering minotaur even loftier. His spear, which he carries like a walking staff, is only a little taller. The short hair covering his burly frame is pale with darker, longer hair atop his head and in his narrow beard. Shaggy, gray hair also covers the back of his neck and between his shoulders. Scars from countless small injuries make pink lines in his light coat, a record of past suffering. His look is serene, though, with a hint of mirth. Loose linen breeches and a cloth belt are his only clothing. Tucked into his sash are a few throwing darts.

~ Played by a Hero with

Abandoned Elven Village In Hot Weather.name:
炎热天气下的废弃精灵村落
Abandoned Elven Village In Hot Weather

Text.text:
林间空地静得诡异，尽管灶火仍在冒烟，屋门也敞开着。村子已被遗弃。一把雕工繁复的竖琴倚在刻花长凳旁，水井边一篮新鲜苹果翻倒在地，一张长弓靠着树干，箭矢散落在树根周围。然而此地除了一打蝴蝶在穿透树冠的灿烂阳光光束间翩然起舞外，绝无半点生命迹象。
The glade is strangely quiet, despite cooking fires still smoking and doors standing open. The village has been abandoned. An elaborate harp is set against a carved bench, a basket of fresh apples overturned near the well, and a longbow leans against a tree with arrows scattered about the trunk. But there is absolutely no sign of life, other than a dozen butterflies dancing among the rays of brilliant sunshine piercing the canopy of leaves.

奥术与武艺的融汇体自幽暗中旋旋而出，其形体宛若钢铁与法咒共奏的交响。护甲如虹彩织锦披覆其身，他们具现出幽灵（特征）般的流丽优雅，而那面盾牌则是不破的壁垒，既护肉身，也卫才智。战火在周遭翻涌之际，他们从视野中溶解，化作呢喃的微风，巧妙躲开凡人目光的攫取。其步伐——如画布上一笔轻刷——与影之舞无缝相融，只留下若即若离的以太身影一瞥，以及一段摄魂的诵咏，令目瞪口呆的敌手沉迷失神。其身后，一具守护构装体脉动着正能量，喷涌疗愈之力，洒向附近疲于支撑的同伴。

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

An amalgam of arcane and martial prowess spins from the gloom, their form a symphony of steel and dweomer. Wrapped in an iridescent tapestry of armor, they embody the fluid grace of a ghost, and their shield is an impenetrable bastion warding both body and genius alike. As battle rages about them, they dissolve from sight, becoming a whispering zephyr artfully eluding the grasp of mortal eyes. Their movements—like a brushstroke across a canvas—blend seamlessly with the dance of shadows, leaving naught but a tantalizing glimpse of their etheric presence, and a haunting chant mesmerizing the dumbstruck foe. In their wake, a guardian construct pulses with positive energies, spewing curatives into beleaguered parties nearby.

~ Played by Colby Poulson from d4: D&D Deep Dive

Friendly Tavern: Quiet Corner Near Fire.name:
友善酒馆：壁炉旁的幽静角落
Friendly Tavern: Quiet Corner Near Fire

Text.text:
在火焰的暖意旁，酒馆的喧嚣渐渐退成遥远的低语。熊熊燃烧的木柴噼啪作响，点点爆裂声穿插在摇曳火舌吞噬木料的低沉轰鸣里。你望着缕缕烟丝在空气中蜷曲起伏，无声起舞，像轻柔的催眠，将你拢入温暖安宁之中。
Near the warmth of the fire, the din of the tavern becomes a distant murmur. The pops and crackles from the blazing logs punctuate the quiet roar of flickering flames as they devour the wood. You watch wisps of smoke curl and ripple through the air, their silent dance lulling you into cozy tranquility.

巍峨的峭壁夹着狭窄的海湾。崖壁异常光滑，乃在久远的年代里，一条巨大的冰川奔涌冲向大海，硬生生在既有的谷地中犁刻出深深沟壑。峡湾沿线点缀着几道小瀑布，带来清冽的淡水。
Towering cliffs border the narrow inlet. The walls are quite smooth, furrowed through the existing valley by an enormous glacier's stampede toward the sea in a bygone age. Dotted along the fjord, small waterfalls provide fresh water.

Elven Moon Amulet With Green Stone.name:
镶嵌绿宝石的精灵月之护符
Elven Moon Amulet With Green Stone

Text.text:
这枚月华护符布满催眠般的涡纹与螺旋，既令人愉悦，又同样令人沉醉。新月造型的中央稳稳镶着一颗华美的绿色宝石，光芒一闪，便在金属表面投下翠绿的影子。
The lunar amulet is covered in hypnotic whorls and spirals, which delight and mesmerize in equal measure. A resplendent green gemstone nestles snugly at the center of the stylized crescent moon, catching the light and casting veridian shadows across the metal.

Teenager With Halfling Weed In Their Poc.name:
口袋里揣着半身人烟草的少年
Teenager With Halfling Weed In Their Pocket

Text.text:
年轻人扭了扭脚，又把脚尖往身后蹭了蹭，可他方才抽的那东西辛辣刺鼻的味道仍清清楚楚地飘在空气里。你一看他，他便不自在地啪地一掌拍向口袋。随即像是意识到这动作有多惹人怀疑，他又赶忙抚平裤子，仰头望天，咂着牙。眼前这位，活脱脱一副清白无辜的模样。
The young man twists his foot, then scrapes it behind him, but the pungent smell of what he was smoking lingers unmistakably on the air. When you look at him, he self-consciously slaps a hand to his pocket. Then, seeming to realize the impression this gives, he smooths his pants and looks toward the sky while sucking his teeth. The picture of innocence is this one.

Sword In The Stone.name:
石中剑
Sword In The Stone

Text.text:
一股暴风将至般的气味钻入鼻腔，久久不散。空地四周的树木向上弯折并远离这里，仿佛永远被风吹拂着。灌木低伏，靠近中心的草尽数枯死，露出一圈荒裸的泥地；泥地中央立着一块棱角分明、与人等高的岩石，深深楔入地里，斜斜倾着，像是被人掷来钉在此处。最怪异的是——一柄剑焦黑的剑柄从岩石中突兀伸出，正好停在胸口的高度。
A smell like a coming storm reaches your nose and stays. The trees around this clearing curve up and away from it, as if constantly blown by wind. Shrubs shrink, and the grass near the center dies away, leaving a barren circle of dirt within which stands a sharp, man-sized rock, lodged in the ground and leaning as if thrown there. Strangest of all, the blackened hilt of a sword juts from the rock at about chest height.

Sunglasses Featuring Ar Lenses.name:
配备 AR 镜片的太阳镜
Sunglasses Featuring Ar Lenses

Text.text:
时髦的墨镜镜片如镜面般泛起一丝微光涟漪，内置的AR技术随之启动。霎时，你的视野被海量滚动信息填满，宛如静电爆裂般扑面而来，让你一时目眩，直到逐渐适应这股数据洪流。这是一件便于隐秘侦察的趁手工具。
A faint shimmer ripples across the mirrored lenses of the stylish sunglasses as the AR technology within activates. Suddenly, your view is filled with a plethora of scrolling information like a burst of static, overwhelming you momentarily as you adjust to the input. This is a handy tool for covert observations.

阳光的点点碎辉在出席贵族颈间缀满的宝石上跳跃反射。华丽夸张的盛装披挂于他们臃肿的身躯，繁复的色彩与奢靡的织料交织成一场喧闹的盛典，铺陈出毫不遮掩的富贵浮华。
Sparkles of sunlight reflect from the manifold gems beautifying the necks of attending nobles. Grandiose finery bedecks their corpulent forms, a riotous celebration of elaborate shades and lavish fabrics, creating a spectacle of unabashed opulence.

你在空中勾勒出一扇门的轮廓，并抬手叩击。回应这番手势与盘踞在你脑海中的咒唤魔法，一道矩形的阴影落在墙上，继而鼓胀成三维的实体。它像一扇门的朦胧记忆，颜色与形状飘忽不定；但与它通往的那处诡异所在相比，这扇门的外观根本无足轻重。
You draw the outline of a door in the air and knock on it. In response to this gesture and the conjuration magic bound up in your mind, a rectangular shadow falls upon the wall and takes three-dimensional form. It’s like the hazy memory of a door, its exact color and shape inconstant, but the door’s appearance doesn’t matter a wit compared to the strange place to which it leads.

Multi-limbed Zombie.name:
多肢丧尸（特征）
Multi-limbed Zombie

Text.text:
凝结成腐乳般的两颗乳白弹珠构成了它的双眼，空洞无神地凝视着前方；那具腐朽的生物用歪斜的脚踉跄挪来。霉烂的皮肉从扭曲的骨架上垂挂下来，骨骼以怪异而盘曲的角度拱起，像发黄反弓的弧面。两条手臂末端是干枯的手掌，间歇性地抽搐着，仍不断向前摸索。它侧腹突出的地方，半打骨头被结缔组织黏合缠绕，拼成一根标枪般的附肢——末端削成尖利的矛头。那条肢体如鳗鱼般蜿蜒流畅地游动，全然不见驱使其余躯体的那种断续、颤抖的生机。

~ 由 ExoticSpoon Envisioned

Marbles of curdled milk make up two eyes that stare sightlessly as the decaying creature shambles forward on crooked feet. Moldered flesh hangs off twisted bones that arch at odd anfractuous angles like yellowed recurved bows. Two arms end in desiccated hands that grope ever forward in sporadic twitches. Jutting from the side, a half-dozen bones are fused and twined in connective tissue to form a javelin-like appendage—its tip sharpened into a spearhead. That limb moves with an eel's sinuous fluidity, showcasing none of the stuttering anima that innervates the rest of this creature.

~ Envisioned by ExoticSpoon

I Am Indomitable.name:
我不可撼动
I Am Indomitable

Text.text: 法术开始生效时，我咬紧牙关。“不，不是现在！” [重骰成功] 我带着挑衅怒视那名法师。“这点本事可不够！” As the spell takes hold, I grit my teeth. “No, not now!” [Reroll Successful] I glare at the wizard in defiance. “You’ll have to do better than that!”

The Farah Tanous Theatre.name:
法拉·塔努斯剧院
The Farah Tanous Theatre

Text.text:
这座老式剧院的售票窗与通往门厅的入口，夹在两尊十五英尺高的女演员法拉·塔努斯雕像之间；她们彼此探身，轻抚对方的脸颊，双臂交叠成一座拱门。门厅里尽是旧世界的红色天鹅绒与黄铜光泽，弧形楼梯蜿蜒而上，通往包厢与楼座。魔法灯笼漂浮在高耸的穹顶之下，像平静海面上的浮标般起起伏伏、缓缓坠落又升起。楼梯之间那扇精致的木门后，乐团试音的闷响隐约飘来。
The ticket window and entrance to the lobby of this old-fashioned theatre sit between two fifteen-foot statues of the actress Farah Tanous, each reaching over to caress the face of the other, forming an arch. The lobby is Old-World red velvet and brass, with curving staircases up to the balcony seats. Magical lanterns float below the high-domed ceiling, rising and falling as if on a calm sea. The muffled sound of an orchestra warming up drifts through beautiful wooden doors between the staircases.

The Sanctuary: Frostholme.name:
圣所：霜裔堡
The Sanctuary: Frostholme

Text.text:
霜境城在长年寒意中依旧热闹非凡，旅鼠与北极野兔在街巷间嬉闹奔跑。几乎每一栋建筑里都流淌出温暖的火光与诱人的食物香气，与冰冷的冰屋建材形成鲜明对照。城中央矗立着一座石砌的哥特式城堡——没有一丝灯火，是唯一一座内外同样阴郁的建筑。
The city of Frostholme is lively in spite of the constant cold, with creatures such as lemmings and arctic hares frolicking in the streets. Warm firelight and the smell of delicious food flows from inside nearly every building, contrasting with the icy construction material of the igloos. A stone gothic castle looms in the center of the city—lightless, it’s the only structure that seems to match its bleak exterior.

Staircase Of Faerie Ballroom.name:
妖精舞厅的阶梯
Staircase Of Faerie Ballroom

Text.text:
与地面同样的翠绿石材向上隆起，化作一道流畅的回旋阶梯；两侧烛台夹道而立，通往一处阳台，可将舞厅那铺展开来的恢宏盛景尽收眼底。楼梯两侧的壁龛里，隐蔽的阅读角落安置着柔软的座椅，书架上堆满了书。
The same emerald stone as the floor rises upward in a sweeping staircase flanked by candelabras, leading to a balcony overlooking the ballroom in its full, sprawling glory. In alcoves flanking the stairs, secluded reading nooks contain plush seating and shelves laden with books.

Drow Theorizing About Status.name:
卓尔对地位的揣测
Drow Theorizing About Status

Text.text:
“我们可以在黑暗里哭诉自己的处境，也可以去攀爬。不是向上、逃离黑暗。哦，不。向下。坠入更强大的深渊——在那里，连蜘蛛与亡灵都会开始畏惧我们眼中紫晶般的光芒，以及发间苍白的星辉。”
“We can cry in the dark about where we are, or we can climb. Not up and out of the dark. Oh, no. Down. Into the more powerful depths, where even the spiders and the undead will come to fear the amethyst of our eyes and the pallid starlight of our hair.”

Adult Copper Dragon.name:
成年铜龙
Adult Copper Dragon

Text.text:
华丽的颈褶与犄角点缀着这头庞大龙类生物的蜥蜴面孔，宛如蝠鲼的翼膜沿着它的身躯延展。高耸如塔的生物注视着你，眼神平静而好奇，嘴角微微扭起，像是带着一丝笑意。它的铜色鳞片在阳光下闪烁，光泽内敛却依旧动人。它以一种怪异而迷人的优雅移动，在审视你的同时始终保持距离。当你终于真正意识到它的体型之巨，心底只剩下震撼与敬畏。
Frills and horns adorn the reptilian face of this massive draconic creature, and manta-like wings extend the length of its body. The towering creature regards you, with eyes calm and curious, something akin to a smile twisting its mouth. Its copper scales shine, subdued but beautiful, in the sunlight. It moves with a strange and alluring grace, keeping its distance even as it studies you. As you fully reckon its size, you're left awed.

Arrival In Toppled Magic Tower.name:
抵达倾覆的魔法高塔
Arrival In Toppled Magic Tower

Text.text:
你从以太中被抛了出来，传送的拉扯把你的感官搅得一团乱。你眨着眼把视野擦亮，映入眼帘的是一座倾塌的高塔——昔日的雄伟如今只剩残垣断壁——恰如其分地映照着四周东倒西歪的破败村落。近处，一个狗头人蹲在一面粗陋的战鼓前，双眼圆睁。他抓起一根节瘤丛生的木棍，敲出缓慢而沉重的节拍。鼓声在空气里铺开，右侧洞口里开始有地精类生物陆续钻出；而左边，一家摇摇欲坠的旅店大门吱呀作响，缓缓开启。

~ Envisioned by Dance

You are ejected from the etheric, senses scrambled by the stresses of teleportation. Blinking your eyes to clear them, you take in the fallen tower about you—its grandeur now a ruin—a mirror of the ramshackle village surrounding it. Nearby, a kobold squats before a primitive war drum, eyes wide. He takes up a gnarled stick and pounds out a slow cadence. As music fills the air, goblinoids begin to emerge from a cave to your right. While on the left, the door to a rickety-looking inn creaks slowly open.

~ Envisioned by Dance

Cyclops Emerging From A Makeshift Tent.name:
独眼巨人从临时搭起的帐篷中钻出
Cyclops Emerging From A Makeshift Tent

Text.text:
一顶帐篷由本地野兽的皮条拼接缝合而成，高高耸起，气势惊人。门帘沙沙作响，一只巨大的手从中探出，指甲根部结着泥垢与污渍。紧随其后的是一颗头颅——几近秃顶，唯有头顶留着一小撮毛发。一只鼓胀的独眼嵌在饱受烈日炙烤的脸中央。那巨人血脉的家伙彻底走出帐篷，伸展身躯，足有十三英尺之高。它咧开的狞笑扭曲下垂，独眼扫视着自家周围的区域。它抬起一根肮脏的指甲送到嘴边，心不在焉地啃咬起来。

~ Envisioned by Cooper

A tent, grafted together from strips of hide from local beasts, looms to an impressive height. The flap rustles as a massive hand, nail beds crusted with dirt and grime, pushes through. A head, balding save a small tuft of hair at its peak, follows. A single, bulging eye sits in the center of a sun-lashed face. The giant-kin emerges entirely, stretching to its full thirteen feet. Its grimace twists and droops as its eye scans the area about its home. It brings a filthy nail up to its mouth and chews upon it absently.

~ Envisioned by Cooper

Sacred Flame Cast With Wrath.name:
怒焰圣火施放
Sacred Flame Cast With Wrath

Text.text:
你让对敌人的怒火渗入嗓音，低沉咆哮着那句短促的祈祷，唤起你庇护者的神圣震怒。回应之下，一点炽亮的光辉在你的仇敌头顶浮现，随即坠落而下，途中不断扩张，化作一团旋卷的光焰，如同寻觅猎物的火舌，欲将你怒意所指的目标尽数吞没。
You allow your wrath at your enemy to enter into your voice as you growl the brief prayer that calls upon the divine wrath of your patron. In answer, a brilliant mote of light appears over your foe and descends, expanding into a swirl of light like flames that seek to encompass the focus of your rage.

Zombie Dust.name:
丧尸（特征）尘埃
Zombie Dust

Text.text:
拔出那只病态绿玻璃瓶的软木塞，一撮粗砺的骨白色粉末便显露出来，像沙粒般簌簌流动，散着一股淡淡的酸涩气味，轻易就会被忽略。吞服——甚至只要触碰——这团毒性混合物，便会抽干一个人的生命力与意志，使他们的躯壳沦为空洞的提线木偶，任凭任何人——或任何东西——加以驱使。

~ 由一位英雄所构想

Pulling the cork out of the sickly-green glass bottle reveals a coarse, bone-white powder that shifts like sand, with a blandly sour smell that could easily go undetected. Ingested, or even touched, the toxic mixture drains a person’s vitality and will, leaving their body an empty puppet for whomever—or whatever—would command it.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Hacker Plugs Into Access Point And Shift.name:
黑客接入许可节点，扭转察觉
Hacker Plugs Into Access Point And Shifts Perception

Text.text:
她漫不经心地向后靠进座椅，十指交扣伸展双臂，指节噼啪作响，她随之如释重负地轻叹一声。黑客捡起通往许可点的缆线，将插头咔哒一声插入她后颈。缆线里掠过一丝细微电火花，让她猛地坐得更直，眼睑轻颤。虚拟叠层如薄膜覆上她的双眼，勾勒出她的虹膜、瞳孔，以及角膜上细密的血丝。她唇边仍挂着一抹笑意，哪怕脸部肌肉已然松弛——她的意识此刻已彻底被虚拟空间占据。
She casually leans back into her seat, stretching out her arms with interlaced fingers, and sighs with relief as her knuckles pop. The hacker picks up the cable to the access point and jacks the plug into the nape of her neck. A slight spark through the cable makes her sit up straighter, her eyelids fluttering. A virtual overlay films over her eyes, outlining her irises, her pupils, and the veins in her cornea. A smile lingers on her face even as the muscles of her face slacken, her consciousness now fully preoccupied in virtual space.

Sundries From A Shambling Mound.name:
行尸走肉般的腐泥怪杂货
Sundries From A Shambling Mound

Text.text:
你在刺鼻腐烂的残骸纠结堆里翻找，摸到发霉的枯叶、带刺的藤蔓、蛆虫翻涌的皮毛，以及碎裂的骨头。其正中，你发现了某种“心脏”：一截老树桩，上面布满分叉的焦黑脉络。树桩中央长出一截块茎般的根，隔着指尖仍残留一丝温热，轻轻一接触便能察觉。
Rifling through the tangle of pungently rotting detritus, you find molding leaves, spiking vines, maggoty fur, and splintered bones. At its center, you find a heart of sorts: an old stump veined with branching charred lines. A tuberous root grows out of the center of the stump and is still slightly warm to the touch.

Finding A War Pick +1.name:
发现一把+1战镐
Finding A War Pick +1

Text.text:
这把原本再寻常不过的鹤嘴锄，木柄却缠着细密的黑色绳线，对一件简陋工具而言显得格外反常。你将它从地里撬起，顺手抹去一层不薄的尘土与污垢。唯有尖端迸出一抹分明带着魔性的冷亮，而锄头其余部分却满是深深的麻坑与锈斑，仿佛它曾长久用于掘土，后来才被施加了附魔。究竟是绝境中的孤注一掷，还是荒诞到近乎玩笑的奇想，无从得知；但你试着挥了挥，至少能确定——出身再卑微，它的致命性也丝毫不减。
The haft of this otherwise ordinary pickaxe is wrapped in fine black cord, unusual for a simple tool. Dislodging it from the ground, you wipe away a not-insignificant amount of dirt and grime. The very tip shines with a brilliance that is obviously magical, but the rest of the head—severely pitted and spotted with rust—implies that it was enchanted after being used for digging. Whether it was bespelled out of desperation or sheer absurdity is unknowable, but giving it a practice swing you do know it is no less deadly for its humble origins.

Lumberjack With Gigantism.name:
患巨人症的伐木工
Lumberjack With Gigantism

Text.text:
你面前的兽人庞然如山。你抬头仰望，又不得不再仰高一些。他们高耸在所有人之上，肩背宽阔得离谱，以至于他们正在砍倒的树，在其成熟的年代面前竟也像幼苗般纤细。兽人的绿色皮肤略显苍白，劳作时汗珠在光里闪烁。握在他们手中的斧头看起来小得可笑。直到他们把它丢在附近的树桩上，你才意识到——那竟是一把足足比普通斧头大两倍的巨斧。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The orc before you is immense. You gaze up, and then gaze up a little further. They tower over everyone and are of such a width that the trees they’re felling seem almost saplings despite their mature age. The orc’s green skin is slightly pale, and sweat glistens in the light as they work. The axe in their hand looks small. It’s only when they drop it on a nearby stump that you realize it is double the size of a normal axe.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

这盏黄铜灯的灯腹、灯座、壶嘴与灯盖上，镌着繁复的镂纹：风格化的云与旋风交织盘旋。灯盖以一段链条连着一只优雅的环形提柄。灯旁萦绕着清凉而新鲜的空气，可尘埃却黏附在金属与沟槽之间，磨钝了它本应耀眼的华美。
Ornate tracery of stylized clouds and swirls of air decorates the belly, base, spout, and cap of this brass lamp. A chain connects the cap to a graceful loop handle. Cool, fresh air hangs around the lamp, but dust clings to the metal and the grooves in it, dulling its beauty.

矮人静卧如山岩般纹丝不动，执拗的决心已从那双空洞的眼睛里退去。纹身如矿脉的接缝般刻在他们晒黑的肌肤上，粗织的衣装则带着漫长旅行留下的印记。
The dwarf lies as still as mountain stone, and the dogged determination has left their vacant eyes. Tattoos mark the dwarf’s tanned flesh like seams of ore, and their rough-spun attire bears the hallmarks of extensive travel.

Digital Totem: Abort.name:
数字图腾：中止
Digital Totem: Abort

Text.text:
有些旗帜象征死亡。有一面则意味着系统失败。这枚数字图腾似乎将历史上所有的错误、所有的软件漏洞、以及所有被迫重启的瞬间，压缩成网络上一处超高密度的点：一颗黑洞，电报般宣告着永无止境的崩溃。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Some flags mean death. One means system failure. This digital totem has seemingly compacted all the errors, all the software bugs, and all the forced reboots of history into an ultra-dense point on the net: a black hole telegraphing a perpetual crash.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Directive 9 Assassin.name:
第九指令：刺客
Directive 9 Assassin

Text.text:
一名神情狡黠的蜥蜴族女子迈步向前，修长卷曲的尾巴甩动如鞭，落脚却悄无声息。她蓝绿色的鳞面上，黄铜色的犄角环冠成圈；一道细长的疤痕蜿蜒贯穿左侧脸颊，将鳞片利落地裂成两半。蛇一般的长舌倏地探出又收回。蜿蜒的头颅之下，是一具优雅而被训练锻成强韧的身躯。她肩上斜挎的高科技步枪流转着自适应伪装的波纹。
A sly-looking reptilian lashes her long and curling tail as she strides forward, steps utterly silent. Her blue-green scaly face is crowned with a ring of brass-colored horns, with a long, thin scar wending its way down the left half of her face, cracking scales neatly in two. A snakelike tongue flicks out. Below the serpentine head stands an elegant body made strong with training. A high-tech rifle slung over her shoulder ripples with adaptive camouflage.

Old Man Muttering About Dragon God.name:
嘟嘟囔囔念叨龙神的老头
Old Man Muttering About Dragon God

Text.text:
那位老迈的僧人蜷坐在酒馆角落，兀自低笑；他那身破烂僧袍上绣着一枚褪色的龙族徽记。那图案难以辨清，但在他絮絮叨叨、语无伦次的狂言里，你仍捕捉到几句可辨的词。那人正嘟囔着巨龙、神祇，以及某种据说迫在眉睫的神圣龙族清算。

~ Sahlonahl 于 Discord

The wizened monk chuckles to himself as he sits in the corner of the tavern, his tattered robes bearing a faded draconic symbol. It is difficult to make out, but you do catch a few intelligible words in the babbling tirade. The man is muttering about dragons, gods, and some sort of divine draconic reckoning that is apparently nigh.

~ Sahlonahl on Discord

Exiting Craft Onto A Gas Giant.name:
离开造物，驶向气态巨行星
Exiting Craft Onto A Gas Giant

Text.text:
伴随着一声嘶鸣，气闸压力稳定下来，舱门随之滑开。你的飞行器悬停在你身后，周遭没有任何可供着陆的坚实地面。你踏出舱门的瞬间，宇航服上的微型喷口骤然点亮，将你托举在巨行星之上，抵消那足以碾碎骨骼的重力。你脚下是一片无尽的青绿烟海，几乎才勉强凝聚成形；更远处的地平线则化作无边无际的翻涌瘴雾，旋转的气体层层起伏，色彩如潮般荡漾。
With a hiss, the airlock pressure stabilizes and the door slides open. Your craft hovers behind you, no solid ground on which to land. As you step out, small jets in your suit flare to life and suspend you above the gas giant, counteracting the crushing gravity. Beneath you is an endless ocean of turquoise smoke, barely condensed into form, and the horizon beyond is an endless miasma of swirling gas, undulating with color.

那只地精用粗糙扭曲的双手紧攥着一根简陋的木杖，朝你咧出一抹令人不寒而栗的笑意，细长尖利的牙齿一排排露出。它佝偻的身形裹在黑色破布里，风一吹便摇曳翻动，像活着的阴影般贴身游走。沼泽水的腥湿气味如浓烈麝香般萦绕在这生物周围，而它血红的双眼后，你隐约感到一股阴沉而清醒的智慧在窥伺。
Clutching a simple wooden staff in gnarled hands, the goblin offers you an unsettling smile filled with thin, pointed teeth. Their hunched form is draped in black rags, which sway in the breeze to give the appearance of living shadow. The smell of swamp water hangs around the creature like potent musk, and you sense a dark intelligence behind their blood-red eyes.

Water Treatment Plant.name:
净水处理厂
Water Treatment Plant

Text.text:
这座工厂在狂风鞭挞的荒漠中铺展开一片惊人的疆域；泛黄的天空如病态的帷幕，沉沉罩在那堆如攀爬架般纠结的管道、立柱、储罐与楼宇之上。停车场里挤满了同一种车：公司名下的灰色轿车克隆体，被间或在沥青上起舞的尘旋风抖落的土尘蒙上一层灰。成群的无人机巡弋天际，金属腹部的探照灯骤然亮起，扫过各处站点与高架栈道。
The plant takes up an enormous stretch of the wind-blasted stretch of desert, the yellow-tinged sky a jaundiced pall hanging over the jungle-gym jumble of pipes, pillars, vats, and buildings. The parking lot is full of the same car: company-owned gray sedan clones dusted from the dirt devils that periodically dance over the asphalt. A flock of drones patrol the skies, searchlights flaring from their metallic underbellies as they scan the various stations and raised walkways.

Evangeline Maples, Prefect Of House Wyve.name:
伊万杰琳·梅普尔斯，飞龙学院级长
Evangeline Maples, Prefect Of House Wyvern

Text.text:
她那一头赤金色的头发，是全校最桀骜不驯的——仿佛自带脾气，因而得了个绰号叫“美杜莎”。她沉默寡言，目光却如鹰般锐利；无论明面还是暗地里的门道，她都对自己学院里每个学生的底细了如指掌。伊万杰琳很少抽出魔杖。她更擅长用人情做买卖，把惩罚精准地发给那些最不愿陪她玩这场游戏的人。
Her tawny hair is the wildest in the school, with so much a personality of its own that her nickname is Medusa. Quiet and sharp-eyed as a hawk, she knows the business, hidden and otherwise, of every student in her house. Evangeline seldom draws her wand. She trades in favors, dispensing punishment to those least willing to play her game.

Desert Nomad Camp: Communal Dining Tent.name:
沙漠游牧营地：公共餐帐
Desert Nomad Camp: Communal Dining Tent

Text.text:
一座由多顶帐篷相连拼成的庞大烟雾弥漫的棚亭里，人群围着共享的食物与酒水喧闹交谈。地毯与靠垫沿着边缘铺陈，贯穿成排，又聚成一处处“岛屿”，以你难以分辨的方式划出身份与席次的界线。
A crowd of people chatters over shared food and drink in this sprawling, smoky pavilion formed of many tents attached together. Rugs and cushions line the perimeter, run in aisles, and form islands, delineating rank or station in ways you can’t quite discern.

这把手枪造型流畅而现代，品质出众。坚固的聚碳酸酯外壳覆着折射般的几何迷彩，随光线流转变幻；上方导轨则装有一具精密校准的瞄具。对眼光挑剔的高管而言，这正是首选武器。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Sleek and modern in design, this pistol is of exceptional quality. The sturdy polycarbonate housing bears a refracting geometric camouflage that shifts in the light and a precisely calibrated sight affixed to the upper rail. This is the weapon of choice for the discerning executive.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Recognize The Signs Of Troll Activity.name:
我认出了巨魔行动的征兆
I Recognize The Signs Of Troll Activity

Text.text:
我不觉得它们难以追踪，就算是在湿滑的岩石上也一样。那些脚印一眼就能认出来：扁平、外撇，脚趾尖利。树干上离地十英尺处的树皮被利爪耙出道道痕迹，而怪物碰过的每一样东西上，都被蹭留下令人作呕的臭腥味。
I don’t find them hard to track, even on wet rock. The footprints are unmistakable: flat, splayed, and sharp-toed. Signs are raked in the bark ten feet up tree trunks, and stench is left rubbed on everything the monster has touched.

Darrius Nikodemus.name:
达里乌斯·尼科德姆斯
Darrius Nikodemus

Text.text:
他身披一件老旧的红色军大衣，肩头被日头漂成刺眼的粉红，衣摆末端磨得起毛。大衣底下，一截细剑的寒光若隐若现；他那双保养得当的皮靴每次微微挪动，你都能听见衣褶深处藏着的其他兵器相互碰撞的轻响。他是个中年人，周身散发着久经沙场之人特有的沉稳与疲惫的睿智。古铜色的皮肤在海绿色的眼眸旁刻出细纹，草莓金的发际线略略后退到耳后。他留着长发，梳顺后随意扎成松散的马尾。小胡子与山羊胡也修整得体，衬着他那温文的笑意，线条优雅。

~ Played by Vmaster1995 with

He wears an old red soldier’s coat, sun-bleached to a rashy pink near his shoulders and frayed near the ends. The glinting end of a rapier peeks from under the coat, and with each shift of his well-oiled boots you hear the clink of other armaments tucked away within the folds. He’s a middle-aged fellow, effusing the calm yet weary wisdom a soldier of many years might acquire. His tanned skin wrinkles around his sea-green eyes and his strawberry-blond hairline recedes a bit back beyond his ears. He wears it long, brushed and tied back in a loose ponytail. His mustache and goatee are also well kept and form elegantly around his genteel smile.

~ Played by Vmaster1995 with

这只硬木箱的内里为定型结构，铺着深红天鹅绒。箱体配有钢制铰链与搭扣，散发着酒精与机油混合的气味。内部隔舱里摆着各式大小与形状的扁瓶，旁边同样成套地配有试管架、扣件与挂钩。某一格安置着一只小巧的铜制蒸馏器，蒸馏头与收集锅分开放置。另一格里放着研钵与研杵，以及刀具、漏斗、量勺与量铲。又有一处卡槽里配着一只小燃烧器，旁边伴着数只装液体的扁瓶——有的澄澈透明，有的幽暗如墨。
Red velvet lines the molded interior of this hardwood chest. The chest has steel hinges and latches, and smells of alcohol and oil. Compartments inside hold flasks of assorted sizes and shapes with vial stands, fasteners, and hooks in a similar array. One section houses a small copper alembic, the retort and receiver pot separated. Another contains a mortar and pestle, along with knives, funnels, and measuring spoons and scoops. Several flasks of liquid, some clear and some dark, accompany a small burner in yet another slot.

Forge With Still-beating Dragon Heart.name:
以尚在搏动的巨龙之心锻造
Forge With Still-beating Dragon Heart

Text.text:
炽灼的断崖高悬在上方，熔岩如溪流般越过崖缘，沿着被刮洗得光秃的山腹脉络奔涌而下。道道熔流汇合成一挂明亮的熔岩瀑布，倾入熔炉的炉首。就在那里面，你听见一种古怪的声响：稳定的 tha-thump，回震不仅入耳，也在空气里荡开，透过焦黑的地面传到你的脚下。你越靠越近，便看见高大的门槛之中嵌着一件巨大的物体。那东西像一块硕大的熔融岩石，悬浮着，在火焰里脉动。它龟裂的表面嘶嘶作响，因上方的熔岩正渗入其中。它泛着深沉的血红光，散出令人作呕的恶臭——浮石、硫磺、金属——以及烧焦的肉味。这不是岩石，而是一颗心——一颗巨大的心脏，正在熔炉的中心跳动。

~ 构想：Ethan

Lava streams over the scorched precipice far above, coursing through the scoured veins of the mountainside. The rivers conjoin into a bright lavafall that pours into the head of the forge, from which you hear a strange sound: a steady tha-thump, with a reverberation you also feel in the air and through the blackened earth. As you move closer, you see a large object framed within the tall threshold. Something that looks like a large molten rock hovers, pulses, within the fire. The object’s cracked surface hisses as the lava from above seeps into it. It glows a deep, blood red, emitting a foul stench. It smells of pumice, sulfur, metal—and of burning meat. This is not a rock, but a heart—a massive heart, beating in the center of the forge.

~ Envisioned by Ethan

一叠叠纸张从桌面腾起。它们自行弯折、扭转、撕裂，裂成一对对翅膀，像蝙蝠般狂乱拍击——仿佛数百页同时翻动的声响。纸鸟越飞越高，在上方盘旋，等待下一道指令。
Sheets of paper lift from the table. They bend, twist and rip themselves into pairs of wings that begin to flap in the wild manner of bats—sounding like hundreds of pages turning at once. The paper-birds rise higher to circle above, awaiting further direction.

Cyberpunk Fantasy Metropolis: Untouchabl.name:
赛博朋克奇幻大都会：不可触碰的“Z”街区
Cyberpunk Fantasy Metropolis: Untouchable 'Z' Neighborhood

Text.text:
这片辖区是被禁止踏入的禁区区域，笼罩在迷雾般的神秘与凶险之中。传闻此地游荡着被害者的复仇怨灵，这个街区既无警力驻守，也无任何管治。几乎无人胆敢涉足——街巷阴暗蜿蜒，楼宇倾颓荒废。偶有冒险者闯入，也只能直面潜伏其间的诡异凶险。
This precinct is a forbidden, off-limits area, veiled in mystery and danger. Rumored to be haunted by vengeful spirits of the murdered, this neighborhood has no police presence or governance. Few dare venture here, where the streets are dark and twisted, and the buildings are crumbling and abandoned. Those who do risk the eldritch dangers that lurk within.

Stone Bridge In Heavy Rain.name:
暴雨中的石桥
Stone Bridge In Heavy Rain

Text.text:
桥下，河水汹涌，浑浊的水流从桥拱间倾泻而下。暴雨抽打着厚重的石砌结构——每一滴都像碎玻璃般迸裂——汇成一道道水线，从鹅卵石间淌落，注入桥头脚下那滩巨大的积水。
Beneath the crossing, the river surges, muddy water cascading through the bridge’s arch. Driving rain bounces from the heavy stonework—each drop bursting like shattering glass—to create streams of water that spill from the cobbles to feed the huge puddle at the foot of the span.

一个猿形巨人迈着沉重步伐向你逼近，绿皮如苔，獠牙削尖；它用粗短的后腿蹬地，巨臂撑甩着将身躯猛然推前。它双眼迸出恣肆的暴虐光芒，狂乱地要将你吞食，竟在崎岖的地形上把自己的皮肉刮裂。可那一道道伤口转瞬便合拢消失；它涎水横流的巨口大张，爆出一声野兽般的咆哮，寒意直刺你内心最勇敢的角落。
An ape-shaped giant of green flesh and sharpened tusks lopes toward you, propelling its shorter hind legs with massive arms. Its eyes flash with wanton violence, and in its frenzy to devour you, it tears its own flesh on the rough terrain. But gashes form and close in an instant, and its slobbering maw opens to deliver a bestial roar that chills even the bravest part of you.

Fake Eversmoking Bottle.name:
赝品【永烟瓶】
Fake Eversmoking Bottle

Text.text:
拔下圆肚玻璃瓶的瓶塞——瓶身上压印着盘旋的暗云——便放出了其中躁动不安的白烟。它以浓厚刺目的缎带倾泻而出，远远超出这等体型的瓶子所能容纳的量……随后却又骤然戛然而止。
Pulling out the stopper of the rounded glass bottle—embossed with swirling dark clouds—releases the restless white smoke within. It pours out in a thick, blinding ribbon, far more than a bottle this size should contain… and then suddenly stops.

Site Of A Recent Mud Slide.name:
一处新近泥石流滑坡现场
Site Of A Recent Mud Slide

Text.text:
曾经如峭壁般陡斜的山坡，如今只剩断壁残垣；暴雨与狂风反复捶打，早已把这片地貌摧残得面目全非。被剥蚀的土石昭然揭示着大地沉睡的潜能——只要有人倒霉地在错误的时刻占了错误的位置，便会被它骤然唤醒。它的破坏不亚于法师的火球或骑兵的冲锋；而自然的怒意更令人胆寒，正因它反复无常地重塑地形，冷漠地碾压与窒息途经的一切生命。可空气里又弥漫着翻起湿土的腐殖气息，像新耕的田垄一般——那是对来年春天嫩芽萌发的寄望。
Where once a cliff-like hillside sloped there is now ruin, as the pounding rain and wind have taken their toll on the landscape. The erosion leaves no doubt as to the sleeping potential the land holds for any unfortunate enough to occupy the wrong place at the wrong time. No less destructive than the wizard’s fireball or the charge of cavalry, the wrath of nature is only more terrifying for its fickle reshaping of the land, dispassionate in the crushing and suffocation of life in its path. And yet a loamy smell of turned soil, not unlike a freshly plowed field, fills the air—a promise of budding new shoots in the spring to come.

你对自身力量信心满溢，迈步踏上那片流动的液面；脚下稳若磐石，任凭水波荡漾，也仿佛正沿街闲步走向酒馆。附近旁观者脸上的茫然神色，足以让你觉得这点魔力的消耗物超所值。
Brimming with confidence in your power, you step forward onto the liquid surface, your feet as sturdy on the sloshing liquid as if you were strolling down the street to the pub. The blank looks on the faces of any bystanders in the vicinity are well worth the expenditure of magical energy.

施放这个法术永远伴随着风险，但有时局势却逼得你不得不这么做。你把笑意钉在脸上，望向你的目标，脑海里浮现出一位老友的身影。
Casting this spell is always a risk, but sometimes the situation makes it necessary. You fix a smile on your face and look toward your target, thinking about an old friend.

Stony Beach: Storm Off The Coast.name:
石砾海滩：离岸风暴
Stony Beach: Storm Off The Coast

Text.text:
乌云在地平线上阴沉地压来，你很久之前就看见它们愤怒地闪耀，直到后来才听见雷霆般的咆哮。风暴在远处翻涌，预示着未来的狂怒；但此刻，微风仍温柔拂过你，岸边的生灵也热闹地啁啾嬉鸣，仿佛这份宁静将永远持续。
Dark clouds glower from the horizon, and you see them flash in anger long before you hear the thunderous bellow. The storm roils in the distance, threatening future fury, but for now the wind blows softly over you, and the wildlife of the shore chatters convivially as if the calm might last forever.

婴儿皮肤泛着一层青绿的晕色，牙龈间冒出的细小獠牙，更将他们的兽人传承暴露无遗。他们的速度与力量远非同年代的寻常人类可比，轻巧翻越障碍，撞开沿途的家具。
The greenish tinge of the infant’s skin, along with the tiny tusks emerging from their gums, betrays their orcish heritage. They move with a speed and strength unlike a typical human of their age, hurdling over obstacles and smashing aside furniture.

Temple Of The Stormcaller In Winter.name:
冬日风暴唤者神殿
Temple Of The Stormcaller In Winter

Text.text:
[晴空之下] 神殿的门窗紧闭上闩，然而内里的烛光暗示着祭司仍在忙碌。你听见有人缓慢敲着鼓：几下朴素的节拍之后，紧接着一声铃响。屋顶最高处的避雷针上，一名裹着层层羊毛的女祭司以稳健的臂力紧抓其上。她戴着一副怪异的护目镜，遮住了半张脸。

[暴风雪中] 在这场不屈不挠的风暴里，神殿宛如灯塔般矗立，迸发出刺目的蓝光，亮得令人心惊。每一次能量涌动都让整座建筑震颤，顶端的避雷针随每道脉冲嗡鸣作响。尽管呼啸的狂风让一切难以辨清，你仍能听见殿内传来的声音——一片惊惧与绝望交织的哀嚎喧嚣。

[Under Clear Skies] The doors and windows of the temple are shut and barred, but the candlelight within suggests priests are active within. The sounds of someone slowly playing a drum can be heard: a few beats in a simple rhythm, followed by the ringing of a bell. On the lightning rod at the highest part of the roof, a priestess wrapped in layers of wool hangs onto it with a steady arm. She wears an odd set of goggles that obscures half her face.

[During a Snowstorm] A beacon in this unyielding storm, the temple bursts with blue light, stunning in its brightness. The building rattles with each surge of energy, the lightning rod at the very peak twanging with each pulse. Although difficult to discern through the howling wind, you hear voices from within the temple—a wailing clamor of fright and dismay.

彩虹般的闪光点亮中央那片圆形舞池——挤满了彻夜狂欢的人群，荧光体彩与各式身体改造在暗处发亮——震耳欲聋的低音贝斯在室内一波波翻涌，几乎要把你的听觉淹没。沿着边缘，一架架小型无人机如同发亮的圆盘滑行，托着色彩斑斓的鸡尾酒。再往外，绒软的紫色卡座里坐着更有钱的客人：穿着难看夏威夷衬衫的肥胖男人，浑身渗着虚伪的魅力。头顶上，衣着暴露的舞者在悬挂的笼子里表演，衣物上缝着脉动闪烁的屏幕。
Rainbow flashes light up the central, circular dance floor—packed with ravers glowing with body paint and body modifications—and loud bass-line music ripples through the room, almost deafening you. Around the edges, small drones like shining disks carry colorful cocktails. Beyond, plush purple booths hold wealthier patrons: fat men in awful Hawaiian shirts oozing false charm. Above, scantily clad dancers perform in hanging cages, their clothes stitched with pulsing screens.

Vampire Sleeping In Coffin.name:
吸血鬼（特征）沉睡在棺材中
Vampire Sleeping In Coffin

Text.text:
华丽的巴洛克棺椁盖在古旧的铰链上吱呀作响，缓缓掀开。刹那间，棺内阴影深处仿佛空无一物——随即光线落下，照见唯一的安眠者那惨白的肌肤：修长带爪的双手交叠于胸前，双眼紧闭，神情宁静如沉睡。
The lid of the baroque coffin creaks on ancient hinges as it swings open. For a moment, the coffin’s shadowed confines appear empty—then light falls upon the pale flesh of the sole occupant, their long, clawed hands crossed over their chest, eyes closed in serene sleep.

Planetary Defense System Concealed On Fa.name:
隐藏在月球背面的行星防御系统
Planetary Defense System Concealed On Far Side Of A Moon

Text.text:
秘密基地密布着武器炮台。它深藏在广袤月海荒漠最深的环形山里，正对着空间的幽邃深处，使这座设施避开轨道航行的窥探目光。
The clandestine base bristles with weapon batteries. Hidden in the deepest crater of a vast lunar desert, facing the depths of space, the structure avoids the prying eyes of orbital traffic.

Half-dwarf's Hexblade Pact.name:
半矮人的咒刃契约
Half-dwarf's Hexblade Pact

Text.text:
体格敦实、衣着考究的男人猛地一旋脚跟，沿着精灵使馆的走廊怒气冲冲地疾走而去，双拳紧攥到发白。他砰然甩上房门，棱角分明的面容因挫败而扭曲。月光自华美的彩绘玻璃窗倾泻进他的套房——窗上描绘着远古战役与英雄，挥舞着传说中的神兵利器。他抬手抓过浓密蓬乱的头发，目光不由被玻璃图案里那柄优雅的长刃牵住——就在这时，他听见了。一个声音裹着甜腻到奢靡的诱惑，悄然爬入他的脑海，许诺尊敬、荣耀与难以想象的力量——只要他宣誓将自己献给它的服务……

~ Played by Otec with

The stocky, well-dressed man turns on his heel and storms down the corridor of the elven embassy, fists tightly clenched. He slams the door, his sharp features twisted in frustration. Moonlight streams into his suite through resplendent stained-glass windows which depict ancient battles and heroes wielding weapons of legend. He runs a hand through thick, shaggy hair and finds his eye drawn to an elegant blade in the design of the glass—and then he hears it. A voice, dripping with sweet excess, creeps into his mind, promising respect, glory and unimaginable power—if he pledges himself to its service…

~ Played by Otec with

Sanctuary Of Cultists.name:
邪教徒的圣所
Sanctuary Of Cultists

Text.text:
空气里弥漫着令人窒息的熏香。祭坛上摆放的蜡烛与悬挂在铁制枝形吊灯上的烛火一并摇曳，燃着诡异的绿色火焰——凡被那光照到之物，尽显蜡黄病态，仿佛染上衰败。兜帽邪教徒跪在坚硬的石地上，地面被烟灰抹黑，蜡泪滴落成滩。他们全都面朝圣所荣位上的那座雕像——高得几乎擦到空旷穹顶的阴影。雕像的形体丑怪扭曲，令人作呕，越是凝视，越叫人发狂。
The air is stifling with incense. Candles laid upon altars and suspended in iron chandeliers gutter with strange green flames—everything their light touches appears sallow and sickly. Hooded cultists kneel on a hard stone floor smirched with soot and dripping wax. They all face the sculpture in the sanctuary’s place of honor, so tall that it grazes the shadows of the cavernous ceiling. The sculpture’s form is grotesque, nauseating to look upon—maddening to contemplate.

Cleric's Quip About Gratitude For Their.name:
牧师打趣地谈起对伙伴的感激
Cleric's Quip About Gratitude For Their Companions

Text.text:
“我最初踏上这条路，是因为我看见这世上有太多黑暗，便觉得自己有责任去点亮一束光。那时我的光芒还很微弱，几乎只是一点摇曳的火星，但我遇到的每一位同伴，都为它添上了属于自己的些许亮色。”
“When I first started all this, it was because I saw so much darkness in the world and I felt it my duty to shine a light. My glow was dim back then, barely a flicker, but each companion I’ve found has added a little brightness of their own.”

Announcement By City Guard About Flying.name:
城市卫兵公告：关于空中飞行物品
Announcement By City Guard About Flying Items

Text.text:
“提醒：城内一律禁止使用任何飞行装置及一切能引发悬浮的物品——除非先让卫兵有机会试用一下……以策安全。”
“A reminder that all flying implements and items that induce levitation are banned within city limits—unless the guards are given a chance to try them out… for safety.”

Obsidian Steed Figurine Of Wondrous Powe.name:
黑曜石骏马·奇物威能雕像
Obsidian Steed Figurine Of Wondrous Power

Text.text:
这是一匹由熠熠生辉的黑曜石雕成的骏马，鬃毛的纹理被塑成如翻涌烟卷般的形状。一只前蹄傲然抬起——那是深知自身价值的生物才会踏出的王者步伐。
This is a horse carved of shining obsidian, the texture of its mane shaped in a way resembling billowing furls of smoke. One hoof is raised in a braggadocious manner—the regal step of a creature who knows its worth.

Red Dragon Lair.name:
红龙巢穴
Red Dragon Lair

Text.text:
洞窟里令人窒息的热浪压得人喘不过气，叫你几乎忍不住去想：自己是不是早已身在巨兽腹中。你立在一道峭壁般的断崖边，俯瞰一座炼狱般的穹窿。持续翻涌的熔岩从悬崖上倾泻而下，砸进下方的熔池，溅起火雨般的碎光，随即又消失在地面一道张裂的黑洞里——那洞口张开得像通往地狱的门。与来路相似的隧道从洞窟不同高度通向外界，使你置身迷宫的核心。
The oppressive heat in the cave makes it hard not to imagine you’re already in the belly of the beast. You stand on a precipice above a hellish vault illuminated by a continual tumult of lava flowing over a cliff to splatter into a pool, then disappear down a hole that gapes in the ground like a gateway to hell. Tunnels, similar to the one by which you entered, exit the cavern at various levels, putting you in the heart of a maze.

Heavy Lift Cargo Helicopter.name:
重型载货直升机
Heavy Lift Cargo Helicopter

Text.text:
通体刷成醒目的黄色，机身侧面还用模板喷涂着“危害”的标识，这架庞大的直升机显然不是为速度而生。它没有留给乘客的空间，只有一间双座座舱——其后是四只机械巨爪；巨爪之间垂着一圈盘好的粗绳，绳端连着一枚巨大的抓钩。下方的爪与上方的旋翼一并向内折叠收拢，使整架直升机像一只沉眠的巨大黄虫，静静蛰伏。
Marked all in yellow with stencil-painted hazard prints along the side, this massive helicopter is not built for speed. There is no space for passengers. Instead, there is only a two-seat cabin and—behind—four mechanical claws, between which dangles a coiled rope with a gigantic grappling hook attached at the end. Claws below and rotors above are folded in upon themselves so that the helicopter has the appearance of a great yellow insect, sitting dormant.

Warrior Taunts A Group Of Enemies.name:
战士嘲讽一群敌人
Warrior Taunts A Group Of Enemies

Text.text:
“把整套编织小组都带来了，是吧？行啊，你们确实可能赢——但我先把话撂这儿：谁第一个敢靠到我手臂的触及范围内，谁就第一个死。那么，谁想当最勇敢的尸体？”
“You brought the whole knitting circle, did you? Well, you could win, all right, but I’ll tell you this: first one of who gets within arm’s reach is the first one who dies. So, who’s the bravest corpse?”

枯瘦而幽暗，如暮色的影子般，一道披着兜帽斗篷的身影独自伫立。兜帽与披肩边缘缀着破碎的黑叶，仿佛一棵被疫病吞噬的树所残存的叶片。一张弓——由弯曲、虬结的木条编拧而成——斜背在他背上；黑色弓弦贴着他那暗褐的装束，几乎难以分辨。远处传来一声动静，兜帽仅仅微微一偏，朝向声音来处。他的手——套着皮制弓手护指——骤然一颤，在食指与拇指之间，魔法忽明忽暗地跳动。一支箭的翎羽在幽冥般的以太中浮现，颤抖着凝成实体。

~ Played by Josh Galaif

Reedy and dark as twilight shadow, a figure in a hooded cloak stands alone. The hood and mantle fray with black leaves, like those of a tree overcome with blight. A bow—a braid of bending, knurled wood—is slung over his back, the black bowstring imperceptible against his umber ensemble. A sound in the distance elicits the slightest shift of his hood in its direction. His hand—strapped in a leather archer’s tab—twitches, and between his index finger and thumb, magic flickers. The fletching of an arrow, appearing in ghostly ether, shudders into existence.

~ Played by Josh Galaif

这处壁龛极易被忽略，寻常目光几乎察觉不到——它夹在两面相接的墙影里，悄无声息。可一旦跨过门槛，你便在那片幽暗之中摸到一扇沉重的木门。你推门而入，古老的铰链发出喑哑的呻吟；门后是一条漫长而曲折的走廊，狭窄得像两排连屋之间歪斜的巷道，唯有从门缝渗入的几束光柱照亮尘埃飞舞的空气。甬道尽头通向一处类似内院的地方，藏得极深，避开窥探——几排连屋围拢出的石质小广场，成了巷中据点：上方拉着绷紧的帆布顶棚，地上摆着用废木与其他材料拼凑而成的简陋行军床、桌子与椅子。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

The alcove is easy to miss, almost imperceptible to the casual gaze, standing as it is in the shadow of two adjoining walls. But passing over the threshold, you find a heavy wooden door in its dark confines. Pushing through, the door creaking on ancient hinges, you discover a long, meandering hallway little more than a crooked alley between two rowhouses, lit only by mote-filled shafts of light seeping through the door. The corridor leads to a courtyard of sorts, hidden away from prying eyes—a stone plaza at the epicenter of several rowhouses that now serves as an alley hideout, with a stretched canvas roof, and makeshift cots, tables, and chairs constructed of discarded wood and other materials.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

A Disguised Metallic Dragon In The Party.name:
队伍里混进了一条伪装的金属龙
A Disguised Metallic Dragon In The Party

Text.text:
巨龙舒展双翼，绚烂色彩如瀑般耀目，仿佛正陶醉于其族群凌驾一切的威能与体型。它轻蔑地哼了一声，随即陷入一瞬的静止。余光里，你看见一位伙伴迈步上前——并在一道璀璨的金属闪光中褪去人形。原处腾起第二条巨龙，鳞光冷冽，怒意灼灼，与那头彩色巨龙对峙。空气轰鸣震颤，两名宿敌以低沉的龙族嗡鸣宣示彼此的仇怨。你再望回对手，只见它嘴角那抹自满的弧度倏然消散，生物张开巨口，憎恨的唾沫在嘶嘶吐息中喷溅而出。

~ Envisioned by Cecily

The dragon extends its wings in a dazzling display of color, seeming to revel in the superior might and size of its species. There is a condescending snort, then a moment of stillness. In your periphery you see one of your companions move forward—and shed their humanoid form in a brilliant metallic flash. A second dragon rises in their place, gleaming and indignant, to face off against the chromatic dragon. The air rumbles as the two rivals express their enmity with a low, draconic hum. Looking back to your opponent, you see the smug curl of its lip fall away as the creature opens its maw and hateful spittle sprays in a hissing exhalation.

~ Envisioned by Cecily

Barbarian Quip About Friendship.name:
野蛮人关于友谊的俏皮话
Barbarian Quip About Friendship

Text.text:
“你们每一个人都是真正的朋友。为了你们，我会砸碎头骨、割断肌腱。我是认真的。那边那个家伙——你想让我把他砸烂吗？想让我在他的血里洗个澡吗？我会做的——为了友谊。”
“Each of you is truly my friend. For you, I would crush skulls and sever tendons. I mean it. That guy over there, you want me to crush him? Bathe in his blood? I will do it—for friendship.”

一堆紫色花朵被人摆在神龛内诸尊雕像的脚边。花枝自神龛中倾泻而出，花瓣纷纷落在前方低矮的台阶上。熏香的气息充满你的鼻腔，而你的思绪却唤起那花的气味，在回忆里终于找到它们的名字：丁香。
A pile of purple flowers has been placed at the feet of the statues in the shrine. They cascade out of the shrine to drop petals onto a low step before it. The scent of incense fills your nostrils but your mind summons the memory of the smell of those flowers as it finds their name: lilacs.

Canals Through A City.name:
穿城运河
Canals Through A City

Text.text:
建筑之间的空间被水而非石路填满，每扇门前都伸出一座码头。仿佛所有人都乘着用篙撑行的小驳船穿梭水面。多数只是简朴的浅艇，用来载人运货；但也不时有更华丽的船只在运河间往来，船身雕饰繁复、鎏金闪耀，丝毫不逊于任何贵族的马车。
Water, not pavement, fills the space between buildings, which have docks at their doorsteps. It seems everyone travels by small barges poled through the water. Most are simple skiffs to carry people and goods, but here and there more elaborate vessels ply the canals, as decoratively carved and gilded as any noble’s carriage.

半兽人的长屋与厅堂，恰在他们兽人先祖拥挤的巢穴与人类祖先更为孤居的生活之间取了中道，屋内总是挤满了大家族的成员。鉴于兽人血脉的旺盛繁衍，这些四处蔓延的家业由迫切的需求催生出勤勉的劳作来维系并不断扩建。年幼的孩子成群结队地奔跑，追捕兔子和地鼠充作晚餐；年长些的孩子则在父母与祖父母手下学习武器之道，而猎人和农夫日复一日地辛劳，只为让家人不缺吃食。
Halfway between the crowded dens of their orcish forebears and the more solitary lifestyle of their human ancestors, the longhouses and halls of the half-orcs are filled with members of their extended family. Given the fecundity of the orc-blooded, these sprawling affairs are maintained and expanded through industrious work inspired by need. Young children run in packs, chasing down rabbits and gophers for the evening meal; older children learn the art of weapons from parents and grandparents, while hunters and farmers toil to keep their families fed.

这些是叮咬虫：肥硕、多毛的苍蝇，体型和壮汉的拇指甲差不多大。它们在皮肤上留下细小的肿包，甚至会扑向眼睛和嘴巴。只要有食物，蜂群的嗡鸣便会由低沉的轰响变作尖细的哀鸣，空气里充满了满载怒意与疫病的小云团——旋转、散开，又再度聚拢。
These are biters: fat, hairy flies the size of a big man’s thumbnail. They leave tiny welts on skin, and even go for the eyes and mouth. Where there is food, the hum of the swarm turns to a drone, then a whine, and the air fills with small clouds full of anger and disease, whirling, fanning out and clustering together again.

Overgrown Forest In The Faerie Plane.name:
妖精位面的蔓生密林
Overgrown Forest In The Faerie Plane

Text.text:
古老而虬结的树木在微风里吱呀作响、低声呻吟，枝干彼此纠缠，织成一片浓密的树冠。只有零星的金色光束触及铺满苔藓的岩石与盘根错节的林地。鲜红菌盖的毒蝇伞傲然立在枯叶之间，层层叠生的木层孔菌则沿着弯曲的树干与倒伏的朽木排成台阶。这里弥漫着泥土、腐烂木头、败叶分解与真菌的气息。
Old, gnarled trees creak and groan in the slight breeze, their limbs twisted together to form a dense canopy. Only stray golden beams reach the forest floor of moss covered rocks and roots. Toadstools with bright red caps stand proudly among dead leaves, while shelf mushrooms form steps up bent trunks and across fallen logs. The place smells of earth, rotting wood, decomposing leaves, and fungus.

Bewitched By Unseelie Glamour.name:
被邪妖魅光蛊惑
Bewitched By Unseelie Glamour

Text.text:
你的脑袋一阵发晕，四周的昏暗愈发浓稠翻涌，潜藏的威胁在其中蠕动爬行。带刺的灌木丛伸向裸露的皮肤，饥渴着血。树木吱呀作响，高高压来，像在嘟囔你擅闯此地；它们伸出光秃的枝臂，撕扯你的衣物与装备。有什么东西从你身后逼近！可……不过是你投在地上的影子。你在这片迷雾弥漫的地方原本要往哪边走？你的思绪天旋地转。
Your head swims, and the gloom all about you grows and crawls with concealed threats. Thorny undergrowth reaches for bare skin. It thirsts for blood. The trees creak and loom, grumbling about your trespass, reaching bald limbs to tear at clothing and equipment. Something has come up behind you! But… it’s only your shadow on the ground. Which way were you headed in this misty place? Your mind reels.

Approaching The Summit.name:
逼近山巅
Approaching The Summit

Text.text:
当你朝峰顶攀去，天空却愈发昏暗——以此刻的时代而言，这反常得令人心底发凉——而山巅被翻涌的瘴雾层层缠绕，像一条巨蛇盘住猎物般，紧紧箍住那嶙峋的岩峰。空气里充斥着诡异的嗡鸣，仿佛整个天地都被能量充电，你的皮肤一阵刺痒发麻，连牙根都不由得酸痒难耐。你忽然觉得双肩一沉，仿佛有某种不可思议的庞然之物正从天而降，压向你的身躯。
As you climb toward the summit, the sky grows dark—odd, given the time of day—and a swirling miasma encircles the top of the mountain, coiling around the rocky edifice like a great serpent constricting its prey. A strange hum fills the air, as if the atmosphere has become charged with energy, causing your skin to prickle and your teeth to itch uncomfortably. You sense a sudden weight upon your shoulders, as if something impossibly vast is bearing down on you.

旅人穿着花哨却舒适的衣服，目光在手中纸页与四周景象间来回掠动，眉头紧锁，专注得近乎凝固。“啊，”他们说道，“就在那儿！我被叮嘱绝不能错过的地标。”他们满意地用手指戳了戳地图，随即将其卷起收好，塞进一只鼓鼓囊囊的挎包里——里面装满了本地集市买来的货物，多半是带回家的纪念品。
The traveler wears gaudy but comfortable clothes and flits their gaze from the paper in their hands to their surroundings, brow furrowed in concentration. “Ah,” they say. “There it is! The landmark I was told not to miss.” They jab at the map with their finger in satisfaction before rolling it up and stowing it away in a satchel laden with goods from the local market—souvenirs to bring home, no doubt.

Initial Public Offering Dominates The Me.name:
首次公开募股席卷各大媒体渠道
Initial Public Offering Dominates The Media Outlets

Text.text:
一枚令人望而生畏、阴森压迫的标志如战旗般悬挂在大城市的巨幕之上，从个人新闻舱到地铁海报，无处不在。目之所及，都是那位引发这一切骚动的魅力人物的影像——挥手与微笑，微笑再挥手。他们的 IPO 是企业史上规模最大的发行，人人都想分一杯羹。
A daunting, ominous logo hangs like a battle banner from big city screens, from personal news pods to posters in the subway. Everywhere one looks is footage of the charismatic fellow responsible for all the commotion—waving and smiling, smiling and waving. Their IPO is the biggest in corporate history, and everyone wants a piece.

阴影与火光在粗砺的地面上交错舞动——嵌在石笋中的火把将它们抛向洞室深处，沿着墙壁攀爬。它们照出地面上一道巨大的裂隙，其上横跨着一座坚固的石桥。下方的昏暗深处，某条庞大的地下河在奔流不息。你还瞥见洞中散落着往昔旅人的痕迹：被丢弃、折断的武器，贴墙码放的木桶，以及累累白骨——在火把的光里，比武器的钢刃还要刺眼。
Shadows and light dance over the rough floor, thrown across the chamber and up the walls by torches ensconced in stalagmites. They reveal a great gap in the floor spanned by a sturdy bridge of stone. Somewhere in the dimness below, a great subterranean river flows. You spy signs of past travelers strewn about the cave: discarded and broken weapons, barrels tucked against the walls, and bones, shining brighter than the weapons’ steel in the torchlight.

Gargantuan Herd Animal.name:
巨型牧群兽类
Gargantuan Herd Animal

Text.text:
