大地随着如雷的脚步震颤回应。六只覆着厚肉垫的巨足踏下，压折幼树与草丛，那庞然的群兽迈步而来。这头温顺的巨皮兽将斑驳的绿脑袋大幅度地横扫一圈，扁平的齿颚探寻可供啃食的树枝。几只小鸟啄食它毛皮里筑巢的虫子。它漠然无所谓，只懒洋洋地伸舌舔过唇边。
The land moves in response to thundering steps. Six padded feet press down small trees and grass as the colossal herd beast strides forth. The docile pachyderm swings its mottled green head in a wide arc, its flat-toothed jaw searching for trees to graze from. Small birds pluck at the insects nesting in its fur. Apathetic, it tongues at its lips with a lazy motion.

环绕着一尊四面雕像的齐膝水盆不断被不同生物手中的瓮注满：一位美杜莎，含蓄地以面纱遮掩；一只蛇怪，直立而行，遍布多足；还有一只鸡蛇怪，竟能用双翼托住一只瓮倾注水流。唯有那尊有翼石像鬼的雕刻并未倒水。
The knee-high basin that encircles a four-sided statue is continually refilled from urns held by different creatures: a medusa, demurely veiled; a basilisk, upright with many legs; and a cockatrice, somehow holding an urn in its wings. The carving of a winged gargoyle is not pouring water.

他们或许是你见过最不起眼的人。没有任何显眼的植入体，没有花里胡哨的衣着；棕色头发，白皙皮肤。你大概根本没法在人群里把他们认出来。他们闲着，却并非一动不动——左手中指几乎难以察觉地微微抽动。衣着整体低调，唯独一只印着单片眼镜标志的品牌信使包格外醒目。他们给人的感觉像个久经监视的老手：目光锐利地扫视四周，却又装得对一切毫不在意。
They’re perhaps the most unremarkable person you’ve ever seen. No obvious implants, no glitzy clothing, brown hair, fair skin. You probably couldn’t pick them out from a crowd. They’re idle but not motionless, twitching their left middle finger almost imperceptibly. They’re dressed low-key except for a branded messenger bag emblazoned with a monocle. They give the impression of a veteran of surveillance: keenly watching those around them and yet appearing totally disinterested.

它的重量相当于一头骡子能驮的份量，而一旦放下，往往就会原地不动。封面是一块小书桌体型的木板，上覆两层鞣制皮革，浸透深绿染料，皮面像外套般精工压制。封面中央的巨幅图像四周，各象限环绕着元素纹饰，四角皆包覆青铜护角。上下各有一条锤打成形的细青铜束带，将整本书牢牢箍成一体。书页间或满是繁复的图绘，或是成列铺陈的长段文字，字色各异；墨迹出自许多不同的手。
It weighs what a mule can carry, and where it sits it tends to stay. The cover is a board the size of a small desk, covered in two layers of tanned hide soaked in deep green dye, leather-worked like a coat. The great center image on the cover is surrounded by elemental ornaments in each quadrant, and every corner is bronze capped. Two thin straps of hammered bronze, at the top and bottom, hold the book together in one piece. The pages are filled with elaborate pictures or long columns of script in different colors of text, inked by many hands.

这名黑檀肤色的巨人高得是食人魔的两倍，力量看起来更是强出三倍。仿佛由冷却的熔岩锻成的板甲在他行动时刮擦作响、铿锵震耳；而他轻松挥使着一柄巨剑，剑身宽得胜过大多数盾牌——光是那把剑倒下来，你都得为性命发抖。更令人心惊的是，几乎无法想象，当它带着暴烈的杀意横扫而出时，会掀起怎样的结局。
The ebony-skinned giant stands twice as tall as an ogre and looks to be thrice as strong. Plate-armor seemingly crafted from cooled lava scrapes and clatters as the giant easily wields a greatsword wider than most shields—you’d fear for your life if that sword simply fell over. It boggles the mind to consider what will happen when it is swung with violent intent.

Stimulant Street Drug, Jazz.name:
兴奋剂街头毒品“爵士”
Stimulant Street Drug, Jazz

Text.text:
这只坚硬、约小指粗细的塑料小瓶里，封存着一团闪烁的蔚蓝雾云——它慵懒地起伏着，仿佛在等待被释放。这种小瓶常被警察与罪犯一同当作吊坠，挂在颈间。捏裂一瓶“爵士”后，蒸汽会化作一阵令人振奋的毒雾般气体，瞬间将使用者淹没；据说能提升反应动作（）速度与整体精力水平。它以成瘾性著称，并与大量副作用有关，包括神经性抽动与颤抖。
The hard, pinky-sized plastic vial contains a scintillating cloud of cerulean vapor—which ebbs lethargically, waiting for release. These vials are often seen worn around the necks of both police and criminals as pendants. Cracking a vial of Jazz causes the vapor to flood the user in a miasma of invigorating gas that purportedly increases reaction speeds and overall energy levels. It’s known to be addictive and related to myriad side effects, including twitchiness and shaking.

丛林骤然苏醒，一名怪异的生物显露身形，仿佛自虚空中凭空踏出。鳞片涌起一波波变色的潮光，他们凝视着你，鼓胀的眼球急促而紊乱地四下转动。猎人身上仅有一条简陋的缠腰布与缀着暗色羽毛的皮革绑带作衣，背后的箭囊竖着一簇簇针尖般的箭矢。
The jungle comes alive as a strange creature reveals themself, emerging as if from thin air. Scales flush in a wave of color as they watch you, bulbous eyes swiveling all around with erratic urgency. A simple loincloth and leather straps adorned with dark feathers are the only clothing the hunter wears, and a quiver at their back bristles with needle-tipped arrows.

英勇与壮烈的画面以匠心巧手镌刻在这柄长矛的矛头上，赤褐的青铜被打磨得光耀夺目。红木矛杆经大师般的车削调校，几近完美平衡；中央握柄则以繁复的重复纹样精工绣饰。
Scenes of valor and heroism have been engraved into the head of this spear with artisanal skill, and the ruddy bronze metal polished to a magnificent shine. The mahogany haft has been expertly turned for near-perfect balance, and the central grip is embroidered with intricate repeating patterns.

Loot From A Quasit.name:
小恶魔的战利品
Loot From A Quasit

Text.text:
你抬起这只生物筋肉虬结的一条手臂，那肢体弹韧得像青蛙的腿一般；你看得出来，你完全可以从它的利爪中萃取出阴毒的毒素。
You lift one of the creature’s sinewed arms, its limb as springy as a frog’s, and see you could extract dastardly poison from its claws.

Film Night At The Farah Tanous.name:
法拉·塔努斯的电影之夜
Film Night At The Farah Tanous

Text.text:
在奢华的天鹅绒厅室里，清冷的黑暗铺展开来；魔法蓝的微小行走灯火沿着地板与夹层回廊一路闪烁。银幕上，一部黑白艺术电影正在放映。外头是沙漠灼人的热浪，而这里却有凭空变出的爆米花，以及元素法术带来的安适。银幕上浮现出一幕扣人心弦的浪漫情节，爆米花悬停在张开的嘴前，所有人都屏住呼吸，静止不动，只等那一吻落下。
In the cool dark of the posh velvet room, with tiny walking lights of magic blue sparkling along the floor and mezzanine, an arthouse film shows in black and white on the screen. Outside is the blistering heat of the desert, but in here is conjured popcorn and the comfort of elemental spells. A riveting scene of romance appear on the screen, and popcorn hovers in front of open mouths and stops still as everyone waits for the kiss.

Sundries From Leeches.name:
来自水蛭的杂货
Sundries From Leeches

Text.text:
细碎的毛发、皮毛与皮屑——连同其他沼泽里的腐烂残渣与枯死的植物，浸在零星散落的恶臭水洼中——散布在水蛭周围松软的泥地上。这里找不到任何值钱的东西。
Tiny bits of hair, hide, and skin—along with other swampy detritus and dead plants in scattered fetid puddles—lie in the soft ground around the leeches. There’s nothing of value to be found here.

Obvious Enhanced Hand.name:
显眼的强化之手
Obvious Enhanced Hand

Text.text:
这只手上只剩一根手指尚未改造：缓慢、粉红的人类肉指，挨着四根流线、深色金属的指节。细小的黄色灯点沿着“韧带”一路点缀——那已不再是天然纤维，而是一副金属外骨骼的支援框架。每一根改造过的手指都装配了不同的附件：食指如今是一根数据刺，拇指是一团盘绕的线束，无名指看上去几乎正常，只是全然金属。中指则被重新配置——至少此刻——成了一只打火机。
Only one finger remains unmodified on the hand, a slow, pink human thing next to four sleek, dark metal digits. Tiny yellow lights dot along the length of the ligaments: no longer natural fibers but a metallic exoskeletal support frame. Each modified finger holds a different attachment. The index finger is now a data spike, the thumb a coiled mass of wires, while the ring finger looks normal, albeit metallic. The middle finger has been reconfigured—for the moment—into a cigarette lighter.

Antilife Shell.name:
反生命力护罩
Antilife Shell

Text.text:
你伸出双手，掌心朝外，以雷霆般的嗓音完成咒语。纯粹的能量自你张开的掌心迸射而出，如花瓣绽放般舒展，又流淌汇聚，凝成一道由纯光铸就的屏障。屏障之外的生物一见之下便瑟缩退避，踉跄着向后跌去，只为躲开那嗡鸣作响的灼亮光辉。
You extend your hands, palms facing outward, and in a booming voice complete the incantation. Pure energy projects from your open palm, unfurling like petals from a flower, and sliding together to form a barrier of pure light. The creatures beyond it cower at the sight, stumbling backward to avoid its glowing hum.

一个类人身影抬起粗长而有力的前臂，三只眼睛扫视着地平线。它灰白无毛，形体宛如雕琢的大理石，细腻的色阶渐变为它披上一层精巧的伪装。锋利的颚钳喀嗒作响，品尝着空气里微不可察的变化。一张华丽的长弓斜挂在背后，弓身刻满过往胜利的记号。
A humanoid figure raises a long and powerful forearm, its three eyes scanning the horizon. Gray and hairless, its form is alike to carved marble, soft gradations in color affording it a delicate camouflage. Sharp mandibles click, tasting tiny changes in the air. An ornate bow slung across the back is notched with the tallies of past victories.

你用戴着蛇皮手套的手攥紧蛋壳，隔着皮革也能感到它在掌心里碎裂成细小的残片。随后你张开五指，就在指缝舒展的瞬间，空气如海市蜃楼般微微荡漾，一只与自己的动作一模一样的巨大手掌凭空成形。
You make a fist around the eggshell, feeling it shatter into tiny pieces through the snakeskin glove you wear. Then you spread your fingers, and as you do, the air wavers like a mirage as a giant hand that mirrors your own comes into existence.

[察觉] 这间屋子里有一阵若有若无的嗡鸣，装饰着一排排三英尺高的方尖碑，整齐列阵。你闻到臭氧的气味，感到其中一面墙上的一对青铜门正散出热意。地面某些位置留着焦灼的烧痕残迹，显然曾被人用力刷洗，却怎么也抹不掉。

[发现] 嗡鸣来自那对青铜门，门底沿有一道通风的网格。门内是一台小型发电机，安静得令人发毛。仔细检查方尖碑与烧痕分布后，你会看出一张电流的网格：地板下暗藏触发踏板，一旦踩中，电弧便会从一座方尖碑跃向下一座——唯独有一条狭窄却可通行的路线例外。

[触发] 当你越过第二排装饰方尖碑时，脚下地面微微下陷，随即“咔哒”一声。青铜门后，电源尖啸着苏醒。一座方尖碑嗡嗡作响，迸出紊乱的蓝白电弧，先扑向另一座，再跳向下一座，呈之字形乱窜，最终贯穿你的身体。

[Perceived] There is a faintly audible hum in this room, which is decorated with a set of three-foot obelisks arranged in rank and file. You smell ozone and feel warmth coming from a set of bronze doors in one of the walls. The streaked residue of burns at certain places on the floor has apparently resisted attempts to scrub them away.

[Discovered] The hum originates at the bronze doors, which are ventilated with a grid along the bottom. Inside is a small and frighteningly quiet generator. A careful examination of the obelisks and burn patterns reveals a gridwork of current, triggered by plates in the floor, that sends arcs of electricity from one obelisk to the next, except for along one narrow but walkable route.

[Triggered] After you have passed the second decorative obelisk row, the floor beneath you gives slightly and clicks. From behind the bronze doors, a power source whines to life. One of the obelisks buzzes and fires an erratic blue-white arc of electricity to another obelisk, and then to another, in a zig-zag pattern that then runs through you.

道路两侧高高的树篱耸立，几乎将你对两边田野的视线尽数遮断。蔷薇丛与结莓的荆棘藤蔓缠绕其间，钻过这条路沿线那片被一代代砍伐、铺设并交织成墙的长长树木纠结。蜜蜂在其中嗡鸣穿梭，小鸟欢快地掠过树篱枝头，但凡比狐狸更大的东西，几乎找不到能钻过去的空隙。
High hedgerows rise on both flanks of the road, nearly blocking your view of the fields to either side. Rosebushes and berry brambles twine throughout the long tangle of trees that have been cut, laid, and interwoven along this route for generations. Bees buzz through them, and small birds flit happily about the hedgerow’s branches, but anything larger than a fox would find few places to pass through.

Bancroft Cain.name:
班克罗夫特·凯恩
Bancroft Cain

Text.text:
卓尔阴沉地皱着眉，眉峰紧锁，红眼微眯，双臂交叉在胸前。他的体型与气度都像个战士。那头长长的白发向后束起，掠过尖耳，用皮绳固定；皮绳与他沉重的钉饰皮护甲相得益彰，护甲以钢条加固、层层强化。他背着一把以骨与角制成的反曲长弓，另佩短剑与匕首。他那做工繁复、带着魔法气息的箭囊覆着幽暗而雅致的蛇皮。

~ Played by John L from Fort Myers with

The drow scowls, his brow furrowed, red eyes narrowed, and arms crossed. He has the size and bearing of a warrior. His long white hair is pulled back over his sharp ears, held in place with hide cords which complement his heavy leather armor, studded and reinforced with steel. He wears a recurved longbow made of bone and horn, a shortsword, and a knife. His elaborate, enchanted quiver is covered with dark, elegant snakeskin.

~ Played by John L from Fort Myers with

I'm Protected By My Ring Of Protection.name:
我被我的防护戒指保护着
I'm Protected By My Ring Of Protection

Text.text:
时代仿佛放缓，我看着那一击逼近我的护甲——太近了——直指肋骨下方。腹部像被一股蛮横的推力狠狠顶入，恐慌随之猛然窜起——但不适也就止步于此。那一击在我身上弹开，迸出一簇耀眼的青蓝能量火花；是我戒指的魔法偏转了迎面而来的攻击。
Time slows as I see the strike come close to my armor—too close—aiming below my ribcage. I feel a forceful push dig into my gut, then a surge of panic—but that’s where the discomfort stops. The blow bounces off me with a spark of brilliant teal energy, the magic of my ring having deflected the incoming attack.

Slow Evaded By Player.name:
缓慢攻击被玩家闪避
Slow Evaded By Player

Text.text:
你触及之内的一切都在刹那间慢了下来。同一瞬间，在你个人空间之外，万物闪烁，仿佛在时代中骤然向前跳跃。这感觉只持续了一个瞬间——你的心智拒绝接受这诡异的时代错位，察觉随即回归如常。

~ 一位英雄构想

Everything within your reach slows down for a split second. In that same moment, beyond your personal space, things flicker as if jumping ahead rapidly in time. It lasts for only an instant as your mind refuses to accept the bizarre sensation of altered time and your perception returns to normal.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

怪物漂浮在空中。它那无眼、布满褶皱的球状身躯像一颗裸露的脑子，灰粉色，软塌塌地鼓胀着。它的正面伸出一只弯钩般的黑色喙，酷似巨型猛禽。腹下垂着一团粉色触手，如巢般纠缠，每条肢体末端皆是尖锐刺点与一簇黑色倒钩。
The monster floats in the air. Its eyeless, wrinkled bulb of a body resembles an exposed brain, grayish-pink and blubbery. From its front extends a hooked, black beak like that of a great raptor. A nest of pink tentacles dangles from its underside, each limb tipped with a sharp point and a nest of black barbs.

青苔与常春藤沿着古堡的垛墙悄然攀爬。它的石壁屹立数代，如今依旧坚牢——无惧狂风、暴雨，亦不惧围城攻伐。每一任守堡人都在此留下印记：拓展城墙，竖起炮塔与高塔，增建新的建筑——一代又一代，城堡随之不断生长。
Moss and ivy creep up the bulwark walls of the ancient castle. Its stone has stood for generations, and it stands strong now—against wind, rain, and siege alike. Each keeper of the castle has made their mark, extending the walls, erecting turrets and towers, raising new structures—with each generation, the castle grows.

光滑柔韧的皮革眼罩贴合佩戴者的眼眶，几乎不费周折便形成舒适的密封。结实的系绳将眼罩牢牢固定在头上，并以华美的青铜扣精心打造，使其能轻松调节松紧。

~ 由 Envisioned 为 Forge Ahead: A Party To Access 所构想

The smooth, supple leather of the eyepatch forms a comfortable seal around the orbit of the wearer with minimal fuss. A sturdy cord secures the patch to the head and has been crafted to make it easily adjustable via ornate bronze clasps.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

尽管白日暖意尚存，你立于山巅，仍被一阵刺骨的寒风迎面拍打。四周的景色如同绿浪起伏——覆着青草与荒原植被的丘陵连绵不绝，其间稀疏林木点缀的谷地悄然蜷伏。时而你会瞥见溪流在坡间蜿蜒，水光一闪一闪，仿佛在许诺清冽的淡水。
A chill wind buffets you atop the hill despite the warmth of the day. The landscape around you undulates in green waves of grass-and-heath-covered hills with sparsely wooded valleys tucked between them. Here and there you spot the shine of a stream running between the slopes, promising fresh water.

Bowl Of Commanding Water Elementals.name:
统御水元素之钵
Bowl Of Commanding Water Elementals

Text.text:
这只宽口青铜碗外壁满是擦痕与凹陷，因年代久远而泛起铜绿。可碗内却亮得近乎流金，仿佛金液在其中铺展。内壁覆着一幅风暴翻搅的海面——巨浪崩碎的纹刻细致到令人屏息。碗底有一滴水在动。你凝视之时，那水滴缓缓沿着碗底绕行一圈，随即微微改变角度，开始画出新的圆。
This wide bronze bowl is scuffed and dented on the outside, greening from age. But its interior shines an almost liquid gold. The image of a storm-tossed sea covers the interior—a brilliantly detailed etching of crashing waves. A drop of water in the base of the bowl moves. As you watch, the droplet makes a slow circuit of the bottom, then changes angle slightly to start a new circle.

Overheard Conversation By A Soldier Abou.name:
一名士兵无意间的耳语：关于弓箭手
Overheard Conversation By A Soldier About Archers

Text.text:
“该提防的是那些该死的弓箭手。他们放血时从不用直视别人的眼睛。他们能杀掉十来个无辜者，还能睡得安稳——仿佛是箭在杀人，而不是那只拉开弓弦的手。”
“Bloody archers are the ones you have to worry about. Never have to look folks in the eye when they bleed them. They’ll kill a dozen innocents and sleep sound, as if the arrows did the killing and not the hand that drew the string.”

那个你曾为之沉醉的女人，就在你眼前骤然变形。线条诱人的双腿在微光中闪烁着消散，取而代之的是一具狮般的躯体。上身大体仍旧如前，但那份美丽陡然变得残酷，笑容也化作凶狠而饥渴的弧度，露出森然利齿。
The woman whose presence you’ve found so intoxicating changes before your eyes. Shapely legs shimmer and vanish, replaced by a leonine body. The torso remains much as it was, but its beauty becomes cruel, and its smile turns vicious and hungry, revealing sharp teeth.

地下水潭静得出奇，水面如玻璃般平整清澈，藏身于远离风与天气的庇护之所。如此隐秘的水盆也许能提供可饮用的矿泉水，容纳不需用眼也能潜伏的洞穴生物，或拥有适合魔法占卜窥视的特性。也许唯有明亮光照的光源才能照出其深处，但这般举动，或许会惊醒潜伏其中的一切……
The underground pool lies perfectly still, its surface glassy and limpid in its shelter far from the wind and weather. Such a secluded basin might provide potable mineral water, conceal cavern creatures without the need for eyes, or boast properties ideal for magical scrying. A bright light source may be the only way to reveal its depths, though such an act might awaken anything lying within…

I Cast Cone Of Cold From My Staff Of Fro.name:
我用寒霜法杖施放锥形寒冰术
I Cast Cone Of Cold From My Staff Of Frost

Text.text:
我的手指在法杖的杖柄上渐渐冻得发麻，我将它指向敌人，吐出那句命令词。冰蓝色的能量自杖首向外辐射，周遭空气随之变得寒冷而凝滞。转瞬之后，一股刺骨的寒风自法杖中轰然爆发，如同被驯服的暴风雪般席卷而出，猛烈冲击着我的敌人。
My fingers grow numb around the haft of the staff as I point it toward my foes and speak the command word. Icy blue energy begins to radiate from the staff’s head as the air around me grows cold and still. Moments later a huge blast of frigid air erupts from the staff like a controlled blizzard, battering my enemies.

Study Group On The Conjuration Terrace.name:
召唤露台研习小组
Study Group On The Conjuration Terrace

Text.text:
五名学生走出高塔，露台便为他们舒展开来，凭空添出一排排栏杆柱，弧形铁艺护栏也随之延伸拉长。他们一头栽进围着圆形马赛克桌摆放的卷纹露台椅里。书本砰然落下，背包随手丢在露台上，其中一人还把鞋一脚踢飞。他们向后靠去，望着天空、望着镇外的农田、望着彼此。就这么一小会儿，什么都好——只要不是书。
Five students step out of the tower, and the terrace expands for them, adding balusters and stretching the curved iron railings. They drop themselves into scrolled patio chairs around a circular mosaic table. Their books thud, their bags fall to the terrace, and one of them kicks off her shoes. They sit back, looking at the sky, the farms outside the town, each other. Just for a bit, anything but the books.

Rumor About An Odd Dwarf.name:
关于一名古怪矮人的传闻
Rumor About An Odd Dwarf

Text.text:
“他们说他从不喝酒，只喝茶——对矮人来说真是怪得很。”那男人又凑近了些。“可再怪也好，他的斧子投得更远——或者说，更准——世上从没见过第二个。”
"They say he never drinks but tea, quite strange for a dwarf." The man shifts a little closer. "But odd as they say he is, a further—or more accurate—axe thrower there has never been."

Arrival Of Dogsled.name:
狗拉雪橇抵达
Arrival Of Dogsled

Text.text:
一阵欢快的哼哼与吠叫合奏先一步传来，雪橇犬群蹦蹦跳跳地从拐角处冲出。一个手忙脚乱的马厩伙计拼命攥着牵绳，却被它们兴奋地打闹牵扯得踉跄不稳。下一刻，狗儿们挣脱他的手，迎着凛冽寒风朝你飞奔而来，舌头欢快地耷拉着。它们围着你嗅个不停，浑身因激动而轻颤，像是为结识新朋友而欣喜若狂。你买下的雪橇就停在这些毛茸茸的伙伴身后，油润的木料与锃亮的金属闪着冷光，已准备好迎接雪地的严酷考验。

~ Envisioned by Ethan

A joyous chorus of snuffles and barks precedes the arrival of the pack as they bounce happily around the corner, a flustered stable hand struggling to hold their leads as they cavort. The dogs break free of his grasp and sprint toward you, tongues lolling happily in the frigid air. Their bodies vibrate with excitement as they sniff you, delighted to make some new friends. The sled you purchased lies behind your furry companions, its oiled wood and gleaming metal ready to brave the rigors of the snow.

~ Envisioned by Ethan

Cemetery In Warm Rain.name:
暖雨墓园
Cemetery In Warm Rain

Text.text:
细雨轻柔地浸透休息花园，覆满青苔的墓碑上挂着串串雨珠。以尸骸为养分的花朵在微风里摇曳，温吞的雨幕为隆起的地面刷上一层薄薄的银色湿光。
A gentle drizzle saturates the garden of rest, moss-covered gravestones beaded with drops of rain. The corpse-fed blooms sway in the light breeze as the tepid shower paints the lumpen ground with a thin blanket of silvery moisture.

Exiting Through An Airlock.name:
通过气闸撤离
Exiting Through An Airlock

Text.text:
当你踏入气闸那间狭小的加压舱室时，舱内门在身后无声滑合。为了在开启外门前平衡气压，房间里回荡着持续不断的嘶嘶声。你能感觉到变化：一种奇异的触感在全身蔓延，仿佛四肢同时麻木、沉入睡意。随着一声清脆的提示音，外部舱门缓缓滑开，你迈步走入门外那片未知之中。
The vessel’s interior doors slide shut behind you as you step into the small, pressurized chamber of the airlock. A continuous hiss fills the room as the pressure is equalized before opening the outer doors. You feel the change: a curious sensation builds throughout your body, as if your limbs are all falling asleep at once. With a chime the external doors slide open and you step out into what lies beyond.

Sundries From A Deathlock.name:
来自死亡锁的杂项
Sundries From A Deathlock

Text.text:
在倒下的术士那具干枯的尸体上，你搜到几样古怪的东西：一小瓶指甲碎屑、一枚青铜制的箭头，以及一张神庙平面图的半页——其余部分褪色得几乎无法辨认。
On the desiccated corpse of the fallen warlock, you find some curious oddities. A small vial of nail clippings, an arrowhead made of bronze, and half the floor plan for a temple—the rest being too faded to make out.

高耸的石质厅堂里，声音先被托上拱顶的高处，再缓缓坠回，层层回荡，既悦耳又令人心神震颤。直抵天花的彩绘玻璃窗描绘着圣徒与英雄在最绝望时刻的身影，也描绘着神祇降临，与凡人交涉。窗与窗之间的空间嵌着壁龛，每一处壁龛内都矗立着一尊高大的英雄雕像。一排又一排的长椅——至少三十六排——通向一座抬高的台座，其上立着一方矮而厚实的大理石祭坛，刻满古老的仪式文句。
Voices within the soaring stone chamber carry up to its vaulted heights before descending, reverberating in a way both pleasant and overwhelming. Ceiling-height windows of stained glass depict saints and heroes in their most desperate hours, and gods descending to treat with mortals. Alcoves occupy the space between these windows, and within each stands the towering statue of a heroic figure. Rows upon rows of pews—three dozen at least—lead to a raised dais, upon which stands a squat altar of marble, inscribed with ancient rites.

I Cast Blindness.name:
我施放失明术
I Cast Blindness

Text.text:
这里是不是越来越暗了？是夜色降临，还是乌云遮蔽，抑或是从你体内涌出的什么东西？因为有一圈阴影正向你视野的中心合拢；若你能看见我，我会指给你看。眼下我只能开口，而你必须听仔细——因为你看不见我所指的意思。
Does it seem to be getting darker in here? Is it night or cloud, or something from within? Because there is a ring of shadow closing toward the center of your vision, and I would point if you could see me do so. For now, I’ll speak, and you must listen carefully, because you cannot see what I mean.

Electric Casting Of Healing Word.name:
治疗真言的电光施放
Electric Casting Of Healing Word

Text.text:
你负伤的战友哭喊着求救，袭击者的打击仍如雨点般落在他们身上。你向神祇——风暴之主——虔诚祈求，求祂赐下祝福。随着咒诵渐渐消散，你感到力量在体内奔涌，继而自指尖轰然爆发；神圣的能量自你身躯跃起成弧，直击战友的伤口。 滋啦一声，闪电在裂开的创面上跳舞，将受创区域替换成一片暗哑的黑色焦灼。几乎立刻，焦痂开始片片剥落，落向地面，露出其下新生而健康的皮肤。

~ Envisioned by Rogério da Costa Jr.

With your wounded comrade crying out for succor, while attackers still rain down blows upon them, you petition your deity, the Lord of Storms, to bestow their blessing. As your intonations fade, you feel power course through your body, exploding out of your fingertips, divine energies arcing from your body to your companion’s wounds. With a sizzle, lightning plays over the open wound, replacing the afflicted area with a dull black burn. Almost immediately, the char begins to flake off and fall to the ground, revealing new, healthy skin beneath.

~ Envisioned by Rogério da Costa Jr.

没有哪一层地狱不孕育着独属于它的骇人恐怖。岩浆原野、酸蚀沼泽——每一层都比上一层更窒息、更残酷；它们在最原始的层面彼此相连，被一股沉重的悲惨气息与最纯粹、最本能的邪恶贯穿始终。
No layer of hell is without its unique horror. The magmafields, the acidic swamps—each level more oppressive and punishing than the last, connected at a primal level by an oppressive air of misery and purest, primal evil.

你缓缓吐出一口气，手腕一扬，潇洒地抛出你的占卜器具——骰子、骨片、牌卡，是什么都无所谓。讯息始终如一。暖风贴着肌肤掠过，轻舔你的后颈，将遥远之地的异样低语与陌生气息一并捎来。一股原始的力量在此扎根，而你的占卜器具把那讯息译作凡人心智能懂的形状：今日，是福是祸？
You ease out a breath, and with a flourish cast your divining tools—dice, bones, cards, it matters not. The message remains the same. A warm wind licks by, caressing the back of your neck and carrying with it strange whispers and smells from distant places. A primal power takes root, and your divining tools translate the message into something recognizable by mortal minds: shall it be weal or woe today?

Quip By A Fool.name:
愚者插科打诨
Quip By A Fool

Text.text:
“你尽可以叫我蠢货——也许你说得没错。但不被人当回事也有好处：我可以不受礼数拘束，随心所欲；而且他们常常低估我。”
“You may call me a fool, and maybe you’re right. But there’s an advantage to not being taken seriously: I’m free to do as I please without the stiffness of etiquette, and I’m often underestimated.”

Completed Arcane Armor.name:
完成的奥术护甲
Completed Arcane Armor

Text.text:
魔法铆钉如同秘语文字的符印，密密点缀在整套护甲之上。凭借奥术刻痕，这些材料坚如钢铁，却轻若丝绸。第一次测试便告成功；只需低声吐出一段口令，护甲各部便自行扣合归位，瞬间为穿戴者披挂上阵。历经无数个小时的材料搜寻、劳作与汗水，这套护甲终于完工。

~ Sparky构想

Magical rivets stipple the suit of armor like glyphs of a secret language. The material is as strong as steel, and as light as silk, by dint of arcane etchings. The first test is a success; donning the suit is as simple as uttering a spoken command, the armor pieces fastening themselves automatically and arming the wearer for battle instantly. After countless hours of sourcing materials, of labor and sweat, the armor is complete.

~ Envisioned by Sparky

Lizardfolk With Bow.name:
持弓蜥蜴人
Lizardfolk With Bow

Text.text:
你从立足之处窥见那名蜥蜴哨兵。覆着鳞片的手抬起长弓，肌肉在爬行类的皮肤下起伏绷紧，粗陋的箭矢稳稳落在紧绷的弓弦上。琥珀色的眼睛——如蛇一般——凝出掠食者的冷光，死死锁定他们的目标，专注而不动摇。这是一位蓄势待发、致命的守卫，随时准备倾泻怒火。
You spy the saurian sentinel from where you stand. With scaled hands, they draw their bow. Muscles ripple beneath reptilian skin as the primitive arrow finds its home upon the taut bowstring. Amber eyes—snakelike—adopt a predator’s gaze, locking onto their target, focused and unwavering. This is a poised and lethal guardian, ready to deliver wrath.

Loot From An Unfathomable Aberration.name:
来自不可名状的异形怪物的战利品
Loot From An Unfathomable Aberration

Text.text:
那生物尖啸着向内坍缩，那声嘶鸣如凄厉的哭号般刺穿你的心智。那团疯狂甩动的胶质混沌迅速溶解成浓稠黏腻的黑血，散发着腐烂海藻般的恶臭。在残骸之中，你发现了一把造型彻底抽象的匕首——握柄上缀满蠕动的触手，正向持握者伸探而来。
The creature collapses into itself with a shriek that pierces your mind like a keening wail. The mass of flailing gelatinous chaos quickly dissolves into thick, viscous ichor that reeks like rotting seaweed. Amid the remains you find a dagger of thoroughly abstract design, the hilt bedecked in writhing tentacles reaching out toward the wielder.

Mysterious Information Broker.name:
神秘的情报掮客
Mysterious Information Broker

Text.text:
一道人影塞满了烛光昏黄的房门，羽饰兜帽压得极低，遮住了双眼，面容隐没在阴影里。陌生人仿佛自体渗出黑暗，所过之处蜡烛一盏盏颤抖着归于虚无——火焰在尾随的轻烟中噗地一声熄灭。ta的嗓音细薄，像被什么勒紧，仿佛一个明知末日将至之人在最后一口气里挤出的呢喃。

~ 构想：Andrew Sanguine（Discord）

A figure fills the doorway of the candlelit room, their face shrouded by the feathered hood pulled low over their eyes. The stranger seems to exude shadow, and candles flicker into oblivion as they near, the flames dying in puffs of trailing smoke. Their voice is thin, as if strained, like the final breath of one who knows their doom is at hand.

~ Envisioned by Andrew Sanguine on Discord

一头怪异的生物立在你面前：人、幽灵与怒火的混合体。黑色犄角从他的头盔上扭曲着向上生长，像缕缕暗烟般在头顶高处翻卷。披肩的毛皮边缘被灼烧得焦黑，仍在闷闷冒烟。胸膛、手臂与双腿那厚实纤维状的肌理，清晰透过半透明的炽橙色皮肤显露出来——与其说是血肉，不如说是一层薄薄的、飘渺的帷幕。他的头颅只剩骷髅，骇人的面容上，空洞的眼眶里跳动着点点红焰。火舌从他完全外露的牙齿间翻涌而出，他咬紧磨牙相互碾磨，迸出细碎火星。

~ Played by Axel Denar with

A strange creature stands before you: an amalgamation of man, spirit and fury. Black horns twist up from his helmet, furling like wisps of dark smoke high above his head. A mantle of fur, singed and smoldering at its edges, drapes about his shoulders. The thick, fibrous musculature of his chest, arms and legs are clearly visible through translucent, ember-orange skin—more a thin, ethereal veil than flesh. His head is but a skull, a ghastly visage with eye sockets harboring flickers of red flame. Tongues of fire seethe out between his fully exposed teeth, his molars sparking as he grinds them together.

~ Played by Axel Denar with

Bardstone Plaza In Winter.name:
冬日的吟游石广场
Bardstone Plaza In Winter

Text.text:
玉米粽与浓厚炖汤的香气自小摊棚中蒸腾而起，热意翻涌，竟让喷泉顶端那尊鱼雕始终覆着一层湿润的凝露，霜冻怎么也攀不稳。其间一处摊位垂着写有家族姓氏的旗幡——Gutierrez——显得最为火爆。另一间棚屋的货架上摆满了各式腌渍罐头，掌柜是一名女子，颈间悬着一枚形制古怪的坠饰；她的部分货品竟带着不合时宜的气息，像是塞着软木塞的药剂瓶。
The smell of tamales and hearty stews steams up from the bodegas, the heat keeping the fish statue adorning the top of the fountain wet with condensation as the frost can’t quite take hold. One stall, draped with a banner showing the family name—Gutierrez—seems to be the most popular. Another bodega, with shelves full of jarred goods, is run by a woman with a strange pendant hanging around her neck. Some of her wares have the anachronistic look of corked potion bottles.

Sundries From An Ogre Zombie.name:
食人魔丧尸掉落的杂物
Sundries From An Ogre Zombie

Text.text:
不死的恶臭萦绕在巨大的尸体周围，先前那令人发毛的抽搐终于在它四肢上彻底停歇。你搜查这具生物以及周围区域，除了它粗陋的装饰外几乎一无所获：用各式残骸胡乱拼凑成的护甲与衣物。几块陈旧木板被串成项链，霉烂皮革做的肩甲上则密密钉满了锈蚀的铁钉。
The malodor of undeath lingers in the air around the giant corpse, its limbs finally finished with their unnerving twitches. Searching the creature and the surrounding area, you find not much more than the creature’s rudimentary adornments: armor and clothes cobbled together by debris. Planks of old wood serve as a necklace, while its pauldron of moldy leather is riddled with rusted nails.

Nightclothes Of Dreaming.name:
梦游睡衣
Nightclothes Of Dreaming

Text.text:
这套丝绸睡衣是午夜蓝的，中性款，整幅面料铺陈着我们银河系的星图。你写下一张便笺，记下自己想要梦见的事，把它塞到任何能当枕头的东西下面，然后换上寝衣准备入睡。先穿裤子，再穿上衣，扣纽扣时从下往上依次扣起。最上面那颗纽扣穿过扣眼的一瞬间，你便坠入沉沉的深眠。梦境会把你带进便笺所写的主题之中——但梦会如何诠释它，只能由你亲自去发现。
Midnight blue and unisex, these silk pajamas are covered in a map of our galaxy. You write yourself a note of what you wish to dream, put it under whatever will serve as your pillow, and dress for bed. The pants go on first, then the shirt, and you button it bottom to top. Upon the top button’s passage through the buttonhole, you fall into a deep sleep. Your dream takes you into the subject of your note, but how the dream itself interprets it you will have to discover.

Victory Line About Coming Close.name:
胜利台词：差点就输了
Victory Line About Coming Close

Text.text:
“在我终结你这卑劣的存在之前，先该向你道声贺。我们直面过形形色色的骇怖，却从未有哪一个像你这样，差点将我们彻底击溃。也许这份荣耀，能让你坠入深渊的旅途稍稍轻松些。”
“Before I end your wretched existence, congratulations are in order. We’ve faced all kinds of horrors and none have come so close to vanquishing us as you. Maybe that will ease your journey into the abyss.”

牧师的眼神如玻璃般浑浊空洞，毫不眨眼地直视前方。你不禁怀疑他是否察觉到你的存在，直到那抹空壳般的目光转而落在你身上。年迈的矮人脸上刻满深深的忧惧沟壑——那是此生困守这片污秽之地所付出的代价。他不停地摆弄一串磨得发亮的旧念珠，嘴唇无声翕动，默念着那段他已诵读过千百遍的祷词。
The priest’s eyes are glassy and vacant, staring unflinchingly ahead. You wonder if he is even aware of your presence, until his hollow gaze turns to rest upon you. The old dwarf’s face is lined with deep furrows of worry—the cost a lifetime spent in this foul place. He fidgets constantly with a string of well-worn beads as he silently mouths the prayer he has spoken thousands of times before.

Magical Street Drug, Deep Weed: Inhaled.name:
魔法街头毒品：深渊草（吸入）
Magical Street Drug, Deep Weed: Inhaled

Text.text:
芳香的烟雾在你的体内弥散，开启了你心灵未曾踏足角落里的隐秘门扉。你的次元感知随之扩张，瞳孔如涟漪般荡开，化作漆黑的深潭，吞没这片新现实闪烁交织的光纹织锦。每一次烟雾灌满的呼吸都在颤鸣，回荡着那些新所在的能量。未知的魔法在你的血液里迸出火花，而它也带来了诱惑——去推开你心中最后那扇门。

~ 一位英雄所构想

The aromatic smoke diffusing through your system opens hidden doors in the unexplored corners of your mind. Your perception of dimensions expands as your pupils ripple into black pools that absorb the shimmering tapestry of this new reality. Each smoke-filled breath vibrates with energies from these new places. Unknown magic sparks in your blood and with it, the temptation to step through the final door in your mind.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Barbarian Two-fisted Drinking.name:
野蛮人双拳豪饮
Barbarian Two-fisted Drinking

Text.text:
野蛮人肌肉虬结，赤裸上身，左臂盘踞着部族纹身，胸膛上交错着一道道疤痕。他双手各端着一大满杯麦酒，将其中一杯举到离嘴几寸高处倾倒，酒液顺着下巴溢落淌下。
The barbarian is heavily muscled and topless, with a tribal tattoo on his left arm and crisscrossing scars over his chest. He holds two full steins of brew and tips one from a few inches above his mouth, some of it spilling down his chin.

Programmable Artificial Hair.name:
可编程人造发丝
Programmable Artificial Hair

Text.text:
朋克的头发像一窝闪烁着光泽的半透明蛇盘成的线圈，哪怕还没启动就已令人称奇。只需几道指令，这窝“蛇”便被唤醒，鲜艳跳动的色彩在可编程的发绺间奔涌流转，宛如最璀璨的节庆灯火——紧随其后的，是音乐。凭借某种数字巫术般的手段，摇滚客将乐曲与脉动的光效精准同步，灯光随着节拍闪烁起舞，交织成真正令人目眩的感官奇观。
Like a nest of glistening, translucent snakes formed into coils, the punk’s hair is a curious sight even before they turn it on. With a few commands, the nest comes alive with vibrant, pulsing colors that dance through the programmable locks like the most brilliant festive lights—and then comes the music. Through some digital wizardry, the rocker syncs their music to the pulsing display, creating a truly astounding sensory spectacle as the lights flash and dance in time with the beat.

Dreadnought Aerial Warship.name:
无畏级空中战舰
Dreadnought Aerial Warship

Text.text:
这东西看起来更像是一簇枪炮，船体只是隐在其中某处。沉重的加农炮与下层那一排步枪与抓钩电池之间，是一层昏暗的铁质装甲板；一切都由铆钉头固定，个个大如人拳。船身四周均匀分布着射孔，偶尔从孔内渗出一线微光。几根粗壮的探照灯筒在主甲板中央成簇矗立，灯口朝着不同方向微微偏转，仿佛一群哲人正在低声聚会。
This seems more like a cluster of guns with a hull hidden somewhere among them. Between the heavy cannon and lower batteries of rifles and grapples is dusky iron plating, all held together with rivet heads the size of a man’s fist. Murder holes are evenly spaced around the ship, and occasionally a little light emerges from them. The thick barrels of searchlights sit in a cluster on the center of the main deck, tipped in several directions like a conference of philosophers.

Circlet Of Blasting.name:
爆裂头环
Circlet Of Blasting

Text.text:
这顶头环以金银丝线般的金属彼此穿梭缠绕，织出翻腾扭动的火焰之形。正中一颗血红的红宝石夺目耀眼，镶框如树根般向外盘旋蔓延。一股诡异而朦胧的热意仿佛正从宝石中缓缓辐散。
The circlet’s intricate design of threading gold and silver metal through and around one another evokes writhing flames. A ruby, blood red, dominates the circlet’s center, with the frame spiraling outward like the roots of a tree. A strange, hazy heat seems to radiate from the gem.

你面前的人形身影高大而威严，披着华美的丝绸与某些不知名异兽的皮裘。每一根手指都戴满戒指，银、金以及无数其他金属——既有凡俗也有魔法——打造的项链与手镯在他们的颈间与腕上叮当作响。那姿态带着贵胄的从容，是那种生来便握有财富与权势之人的气度。更引人注目的是，他们是一名足有六英尺高的人形虎，祖母绿般的眼睛闪烁发亮，火焰般的橙色皮毛上覆着炭黑条纹。他们爪状的手似乎向后翻转，掌心竟朝向外侧。
The humanoid figure before you stands tall and regal, draped in fine silks and furs from unknown beasts. Rings adorn each finger, while necklaces and bracelets of silver, gold, and myriad other metals—mundane and magical—clatter about their neck and wrists. They carry the bearing of nobility, of a person born into wealth and power. Notably, they are also a six-foot-tall humanoid tiger with gleaming emerald eyes, and fiery orange fur lined with charcoal-black stripes. Their paw-like hands seem to be backward, with palms facing outward.

当你将意识触及那无垠的时代长空，周遭世界如潮退去，仿佛你正旁观现实本身。四面八方，你看见曾经之物、当下之景，以及尚未发生的些许回声。你那虚渺的目光停驻在一段对你们一行人有利的未来上，你伸手攫住命运的丝线，将其重新编织，织成你所期望的模样。

~ 远见 by Alex

As you reach out into the infinite expanse of time, the world around you fades away, as if you are spectating reality. All around, you see echoes of things that were, things that are, and some things that have not yet come to pass. Your ethereal gaze settles upon a future which is favorable to your party, and you reach out to grasp the threads of fate and weave them anew to your own design.

~ Envisioned by Alex

I Use Cunning Action: Disengage.name:
我使用狡诈动作：脱离
I Use Cunning Action: Disengage

Text.text:
花式步法时代到了。我侧身一步，跳回场内，接着突然朝一个出人意料的方向掠出。我沿着蜿蜒的路径移动。当我进入敌人的触及范围内时，我左右晃动、穿梭闪避，挫败他们想趁机阴我一记的企图。
Fancy footwork time. With a sidestep, I hop back in, then I take off in an unexpected direction. I move on a winding path. When I’m within an enemy’s reach, I bob and weave to thwart their taking a cheap shot at me.

Insult About Worth.name:
关于价值的侮辱
Insult About Worth

Text.text:
“就算把你从脚踝到肛门整个人浸进银里，你也依旧一文不值。”
“You could be dipped in silver from ankle to anus and you’d still be worthless.”

Taunt From A Mummy.name:
来自木乃伊的嘲弄
Taunt From A Mummy

Text.text:
“你是来加入我的吗——在这里，在永恒之中？在这地方腐烂，直到砂砾与虫豸剥去你的皮肉，啃噬你的骨骸？别害怕。等这一切结束后，我会守着你的遗骸。”
“Have you come to join me—here, in eternity? Rotting in this place until the sand and insects strip your skin and devour your bones? Do not be afraid. I will watch over your remains once this is over.”

Goblin Dodges Arrow.name:
地精闪避箭矢
Goblin Dodges Arrow

Text.text:
地精步步逼近，你抽弓搭箭，瞄准锁定。你屏息等待最佳时机——时机一到，立刻放箭。然而你没料到地精竟敏捷地一矮身闪开。箭矢嗖地掠过它的头侧，堪堪擦过，险些命中。
As the goblin approaches you, you draw your bow and take aim. You wait for the perfect opportunity, and when it comes, you loose. But one thing you didn't count on was the goblin quickly ducking out of the way. The arrow zips right past their head, barely missing them.

Sunlit Door To The Mountain Path.name:
通往山径的日照之门
Sunlit Door To The Mountain Path

Text.text:
因长年暴晒在刺眼烈日下而褪色的木门，通往山径；门身以铁箍加固，内侧还横上门闩，几乎与周遭岩壁一般坚不可摧。
Bleached from constant exposure to harsh sunlight, the wooden door to the mountain path—strengthened by iron bands and barred from the inside—is nearly as impenetrable as the surrounding rock.

这座大厅里的火盆上刻满了赞歌。诗句诉说着对高阶亡灵与恶魔发起的召唤与祈求。天花板覆着地狱符文，它们以图案般的排列铺陈开来，而非连成句子。角落里，一具类人生物的骸骨被精心摆放成形。上方悬着一盏由三支白蜡烛组成的枝形吊灯，唯有其中一支仍在燃烧。
The braziers in this hall are etched with hymns. The verses tell of summonings and petitions made to the high-ranking undead and demonic. The ceiling is covered with infernal runes arranged in patterns rather than sentences. In one corner are the carefully arranged bones of a humanoid figure. A chandelier of three white candles, only one of which still burns, hangs above.

Helm Of Comprehending Languages.name:
通晓语言头盔
Helm Of Comprehending Languages

Text.text:
这顶怪异的头盔被添上了优雅而尖挺的长耳，延伸的面甲遮住了佩戴者大半张脸，宛如贵族假面舞会中的精致伪装。一对猩绿夺目的镜片被雕饰成眼睛的形状，让佩戴者的视线如同透过打磨光洁的水晶般清晰。
Graceful, pointed ears have been added to this peculiar helm and an extended visor covers most of the wearer’s face, like a disguise in a noble masquerade. A set of lurid green lenses, styled like eyes, allows the wearer to see as if through polished crystal.

Bullywug Temple Battle.name:
牛蛙人神殿之战
Bullywug Temple Battle

Text.text:
战斗的声响早在你眯着眼踏出之前就已触及耳畔；当你终于在神庙外血淋淋的混乱中现身，眼前尽是猩红狂潮。两栖的尸体——有的覆鳞，有的光滑——横七竖八散落在层层叠起的金字形神塔上，黝黑的血将石面染得斑驳发暗。急促的呱鸣与喉底的咆哮交织，混着垂死者的哀号，以及残酷兵刃撞入血肉的闷响；你在这场风暴中心浮现……四面八方，尽是包围。

~ 由 Envisioned 的 MatthewMcHale 于 Discord 创作

The sounds of battle reach you long before you emerge blinking into the bloody chaos of the temple’s exterior. Amphibious bodies—some scaled, some smooth—lie strewn over the tiered ziggurat, their dark blood staining the stone. Urgent croaks and guttural roars mingle with cries of the dying and the din of brutal weapons meeting flesh as you surface in the midst of this maelstrom… surrounded on all sides.

~ Envisioned by MatthewMcHale on Discord

I Am A Blessed Healer.name:
我是一名受祝福的疗愈者
I Am A Blessed Healer

Text.text:
当我为他人的治疗而祈祷时，温暖与光明穿过我奔涌而来，点燃我的灵魂。这股圣洁的能量以灵魂的形象重塑我的躯体，在流经我、再去抚慰他人的同时，也轻柔地抚平我的伤口。
When I pray for the healing of others, warmth and light flow through me. It fires my soul. This holy energy reshapes my body in the image of the spirit, soothing my wounds as it passes through me to do the same for others.

Sundries From A Kraken.name:
海妖的杂货
Sundries From A Kraken

Text.text:
巨大的尸体瘫展在你面前：一头被苍蝇围绕的怪物，恶臭的皮革、獠牙、犄角、眼球、触须、墨汁、鲜血与内脏纠缠成一团。若你拥有能让你在动物驯养、生存、屠宰、炼金术或奥术学识方面获得技能的能力、专长或物品，便可从这堆狼藉中剖取战利品。
The gargantuan corpse is splayed out before you, a fly-swarmed monstrosity of stinking hide, teeth, horns, eyes, tentacles, ink, blood, and guts. Abilities, feats, or items that give you skill in animal handling, survival, butchery, alchemy, or arcane wisdom will allow you to extract loot from the mess.

Ancient Throne Room.name:
古老的王座厅
Ancient Throne Room

Text.text:
你一边环顾这座宏伟大厅，一边强压下心头那股朦胧感官般的肃穆；历史的重量几乎可以触摸得到。就在这间御座厅里，曾宣读过划定年代的敕令，发动过战争，锻造并塑造过整整一个个家族血脉——在这座统治者与其封臣共同熔铸的坩埚之中。纵然壁画早已被时代剥蚀得残缺斑驳，古老挂毯的色彩也渐渐褪去，这座厅堂里仍栖着一股精神——一股由每一位昔日统治者的目光所界定、被赋予生命的精神；他们的肖像以各自年代的风格描绘在此。御座本身纵横交错着刻痕，因年代而黯淡，镶嵌也有多处失修；可当你走近，它依旧牢牢攫住你全部的注意力。
You fight down a vague sense of solemnity as you survey the grand hall, the weight of history a palpable sensation. From this throne room, age-defining edicts were pronounced, wars were waged, entire lineages forged and shaped—in this crucible of rulers and their vassals. For all that the frescoes have been chipped away by time, for all the fading color of the ancient tapestries, there is a spirit in this chamber. A spirit defined and given life by the eyes of each former ruler, depicted in portrait in the style of their times. The throne itself, crisscrossed with marks, dulled with age, and with some of its inlays in disrepair, still commands your full attention as you draw nearer.

肮脏的物体在一层翠绿的泡沫披覆下消失无踪，桉树的清香盖过了先前的一切恶臭。短短几秒，泡泡便伴着悦耳的噼啪与嘶嘶声消散，显露出如今洁净无瑕、干爽如新的物体。
The filthy object disappears under a mantle of green suds, the aroma of eucalyptus overriding any previous stench. In just a few seconds, the bubbles dissipate with pleasant pops and fizzes, revealing the now spotless and dry object.

Silent Espionage Drone.name:
静默侦察无人机
Silent Espionage Drone

Text.text:
这台微型机械呈球形，哑光黑的外壳上几乎看不见四片螺旋桨。它配备多种传感器、摄像头与一台强劲的集成计算机，能够在不被察觉的情况下收集情报，并以实时方式传输。其无声而精准的飞行能力，使它成为黑色行动的绝佳选择。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

This minuscule machine is an orb-like, matte black device with four barely visible propellers. Equipped with multiple sensors, cameras, and a powerful integrated computer, it can collect information undetected, which it transmits in real time. Its silent, precise flight capabilities make it an excellent choice for black ops.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Stormy Spirits Boarding Boat.name:
暴风幽灵登船艇
Stormy Spirits Boarding Boat

Text.text:
残酷而暴烈的笑声充斥空气，风暴以冰冷抽打的骤雨吞没了你的船只。幻影自翻涌的雾中凝成，湿透的甲板上雾气急速蔓延，它们化作恶意的女性幽灵。她们赤褐色的长发仿佛被海流牵引般漂荡，在狂风怒号中仍慵懒摇曳。

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Cruel, tempestuous laughter fills the air as the storm engulfs your vessel in lashing, frigid rain. Phantoms materialize from the swirling fog that spreads hurriedly over the sodden deck, taking the form of malevolent female specters. Their auburn hair drifts as if caught by ocean currents, swaying languidly despite the raging winds.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

这是一颗结实、完美球形的蓝白色冰球，重约半磅。它永久黏在一只握着它的手套上，手套的五指看起来都像一条条舌头。持有者把手伸进手套中即可激活这颗宝珠。也可以命令手套飞向另一名至少拥有一只五指手的生物，并自行滑到那只手上——但宝珠仍受派出它的法师控制。
This is a solid and perfectly spherical ball of bluish ice weighing about half a pound. It is permanently stuck to a glove holding it, the fingers of which all look like tongues. The wielder puts his or her hand in the glove to activate the orb. The glove can also be commanded to fly to another being with at least one five-fingered hand and slip onto that hand, though the orb is still under control of the mage that sent it.

Abandoned Lunatic Asylum: Awakening Spir.name:
废弃疯人院：觉醒的亡魂
Abandoned Lunatic Asylum: Awakening Spirits

Text.text:
音乐仍在不休地奏响，冷酷而执拗。你隐约觉得，那幽魂也曾听过——也许她至今仍在听，在来世里无尽回荡；那是一段恒久、令人发狂的旋律，像某场创痛的音乐烙印，永不散去。敲击声在你周围来回回荡，咚咚的叩响震得门板发颤、墙壁轻摇，可你说不清究竟是谁在敲……又预示着什么。
The music plays on, relentless. You sense that the spirit heard it once too—that perhaps she still hears it, playing on forever in the afterlife, a constant, maddening musical reminder of some trauma. Knocks echo around you, raps that shudder doors and shake walls, but you cannot say who is knocking… or what it portends.

I Leap From My Flying Mount.name:
我从我的飞行坐骑上一跃而下
I Leap From My Flying Mount

Text.text:
我看见自己的印记，便知道必须去做什么；只是当我瞥见脚下大地在远处飞掠而过时，恐惧仍让我瞬间僵住。我急促吸了口气，强迫自己镇定下来，低声对坐骑呢喃一句安抚的话。我踩上马镫站起身。仿佛羽毛般的轻盈感猛地掠过腹间，我从坐骑背上一蹬，纵身投入空旷的长空。
I see my mark and know what I must do, though trepidation halts me for a moment when I see the ground far below rush beneath me. I steel myself with a quick breath and whisper a calming word to my mount. I stand in my stirrups. A sensation of feather lightness thrills through my stomach as I shove off my steed and into open air.

Deafening Minigun Chatter.name:
震耳欲聋的加特林连射轰鸣
Deafening Minigun Chatter

Text.text:
一阵突如其来的金属巨响席卷街道，瞬间淹没了人群交谈的轻快声调与空中高架上车流的嗡鸣。子弹沿着地面与周遭建筑乱舞，划出混乱而俯冲的弹道轨迹。人们瞪大双眼，惊恐地扑倒在地，本能绷紧每一寸肌肉，彼此踩踏推挤，像受惊逃窜的兽群般四散奔逃。
A sudden metallic clatter overtakes the street, drowning out the lilting tones of conversation and hum of traffic in the air highway. Bullets dance along the ground and surrounding buildings in chaotic, swooping trails. People hit the floor in wide-eyed terror, base instincts tensing their muscles and sending them scrambling over each other like fleeing animals.

Cosmic Summoning With Unexpected Result.name:
宇宙召唤，却引来意想不到的结果
Cosmic Summoning With Unexpected Result

Text.text:
当你怀中死去野兽的血为最后几笔勾勒落下时，空间本身仿佛开始弯曲、断裂。眼前浮现出立体的裂痕，宛如受损的水晶。伴随着一声震耳欲聋的轰鸣，一块区域骤然崩碎，你直视着那片深不见底的漆黑——它撼动着你最原始的本能核心。自那遥远之地，一根扭曲而可怖的血肉之柱破界而出，猛然将你撞飞。你踉跄起身，召唤的目标已然立于眼前。
As the final lines are drawn in the blood of the slain animal in your arms, space itself seems to bend and fracture. Three-dimensional cracks, like in a damaged crystal, form before you. With a thunderous boom a section shatters, and you find yourself staring into an unfathomable blackness that shakes you to your primal core. From this far away place, a warped, terrible column of flesh emerges, bashing you aside. As you rise to your feet, you see the target of your summons before you.

Loot From A Remorhaz Tunnel.name:
来自雷莫拉兹地道的战利品
Loot From A Remorhaz Tunnel

Text.text:
绕过它仍在冒着热气的尸骸，你深入探索这处怪物的地道巢穴。你发现洞壁的几段嵌着宝石：湛蓝的晶石，其间赤红纹理如闪电的指爪般分叉蔓延。只要用鹤嘴锄稳稳敲上几下，或许就能把它们撬下来。
Moving around its steaming carcass, you explore the monster’s tunnel-lair. You find sections of the walls embedded with gemstones: blue crystalline stones with veins of red branching through them like fingers of lightning. They might be pried free with a few sound strikes of a pickaxe.

Warty-skinned Alien Archaeologist.name:
疣皮外星考古学家
Warty-skinned Alien Archaeologist

Text.text:
这名矮小的考古学家身着沾满尘土的卡其色衣装，活像一只长满疣的蟾蜍；他们一边小心翼翼地用刷子拂去一片古老陶器碎片上的泥土，一边发出好奇的啁啾声。那双绿色的眼睛又大又鼓，闪烁着对这份工作的炽热痴迷。
The diminutive archaeologist resembles a warty toad in dusty khaki, and they make a curious chirruping sound as they delicately brush earth from a fragment of ancient pottery. Their green eyes are large, bulbous, and alive with passion for their work.

这把尖端霰弹枪堪称近距离战斗设计的巅峰。唯有精英军方人员与人脉通天的企业保镖才有资格配备，这件武器运用高度模块化——且致命——的实验性技术，在近射程内以毫不留情的手段清除威胁。

~ 由一位英雄构想

This state-of-the-art shotgun is the pinnacle of close-quarter combat design. Available only to elite military personnel and very well-connected corporate bodyguards, this weapon utilizes highly modular—and deadly— experimental technology to eliminate threats at close range, and with extreme prejudice.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Crew Member From Free Trading Vessel.name:
来自自由贸易船的船员
Crew Member From Free Trading Vessel

Text.text:
就像他们的飞船一样，这名自由商人浑身上下没有一处是统一的。各式不相配的航空装备像仪式般的盛装一样挂在身上，飞行服上还缝着好几块颜色古怪的补丁——那是无数次修补留下的痕迹。尽管如此，他们的笑容依旧无忧无虑，仿佛对自己在银河中的位置心满意足。
Just like their ship, nothing about the free trader is uniform. A mismatched collection of aeronautical equipment hangs about their person like ceremonial garb, and their flight suit has several oddly colored patches from the many repairs it has required. Still, their smile is carefree, and they seem happy with their place in the galaxy.

Adult Brass Dragon.name:
成年黄铜龙
Adult Brass Dragon

Text.text:
这头巨大的龙形生物颈侧舒展开如蛛网般的鳍膜，赤铜般的黄铜鳞片在阳光下耀眼夺目。它以一种奇异而惑人的优雅姿态游移，从远处以狡黠又好奇的目光注视着你。它翼膜一路延伸至这头爬行巨兽的尾端，使它看上去宛如披袍而立的身影。待你真正衡量起它的体型，唯有惊叹涌上心头。
Webbed fins unfurl from the neck of this massive draconic creature, and its ruddy brass scales catch the light of the sun brilliantly. It moves with a strange and alluring grace, watching you from a distance with eyes cunning and curious. The membrane of its wings extends down the length of the reptilian beast's tail, giving it the look of a robed figure. As you fully reckon its size, you're left in awe.

I Tinker With My Laser Pistol.name:
我鼓捣着我的激光手枪
I Tinker With My Laser Pistol

Text.text:
在开始干活前，我第三次——也是最后一次——确认手枪的保险已经打开，因为我可承受不起上次尝试这种改装时那样的重演。拆下枪械的合金外壳后，我立刻着手用全新——而且极不稳定的——材料升级内部组件。
I check for the third—and final—time that the pistol’s safety is on before beginning my work, as I can’t afford a repeat of the last time I tried this modification. Removing the gun’s alloy casing, I set to upgrading the internal components with new—and volatile—materials.

The Entrance To Crabwell.name:
通往蟹井镇的入口
The Entrance To Crabwell

Text.text:
蟹井城那雄伟的城门巍然耸立——一座高耸的砂岩拱门，外覆铁箍加固，粗壮木梁交错支撑。数十人进进出出，交谈的嗡鸣声不绝于耳。门洞深处垂着一座巨大的黑铁闸门，粗如牛躯的铁链将其牢牢锁住。传言蟹井城的城门已敞开数百年，迎接所有前来一睹城邦辉煌之人——但若城邦有朝一日遭逢威胁，这道黑铁之门足以抵御群龙的猛攻。
The mighty gate of Crabwell looms, a towering archway of sandstone reinforced with bands of iron and braced timbers. Dozens come and go, the hum of conversation a constant. A great portcullis of black iron hangs within the gate’s recess, secured by chains the width of an ox. It is said the gates of Crabwell have stood open now for centuries, welcoming all who seek to see the city’s splendor—but that if the city ever found itself threatened, the gate of black iron would withstand an onslaught of dragons.

Pod Of Killer Whales.name:
虎鲸群
Pod Of Killer Whales

Text.text:
你听见一声尖细的呼啸般鸣叫，紧接着，一连串黑色背鳍划破铅灰怒海。白色浪花喷涌成柱，虎鲸黑白分明的面孔冲出水面。它们的身躯流线而强健，起落如弧，动作行云流水般朝你游来。
You hear a high, whistling call as a series of black fins cut through the livid sea. Sprays of white water plume as the black-and-white faces of killer whales breach the surface. Their bodies, sleek and powerful, rise and dive in fluid arcs as they swim toward you.

Frost Spirit Stalks The Adventurers.name:
霜灵潜踪冒险者
Frost Spirit Stalks The Adventurers

Text.text:
魁梧的鸟形身影在这座宫殿冰冷的长廊间游荡，寒息在它沉重的鸮般面容前凝成白雾。利爪刮擦着冰面，刺得你牙根发酸；你听见那怪物嗅着空气，绷紧身躯，专注得仿佛连寒意都被它攫住。你屏住呼吸，只盼胸腔里如雷的心跳不会将你出卖。

~ Envisioned by Pepijn on Discord

The hulking avian form stalks the frigid halls of this palace, icy breath misting before its ponderous owl-like countenance. Claws scrape against ice, setting your teeth on edge, and you hear the monster sniffing the air, tensing as it concentrates. You hold your breath, hoping that the thunderous rhythm of your heart will not give you away.

~ Envisioned by Pepijn on Discord

The Sanctuary: Delta.name:
圣所：三角洲
The Sanctuary: Delta

Text.text:
一片葱郁的绿色沼泽在广阔区域内铺展开来，尽头向南延伸至一座芦苇丛生的湖泊。空气清新——尽管湿度高得令人呼吸发涩——而在河流交汇处，你爪下的地面因浸水而柔软如绵。几只黄嘴的秧鸡踏着水洼踱步，叽喳作响。
A lush expanse of green marsh stretches over a large area, ending in a reedy lake to the south. The air is fresh—although the humidity makes breathing difficult—and the ground beneath your paws is spongy from the confluence of the rivers. A few yellow-billed soras chatter as they wade through the puddles.

Quip About Wasted Evenings At The Tavern.name:
关于在酒馆虚度夜晚的俏皮话
Quip About Wasted Evenings At The Tavern

Text.text:
“我的胡闹从来不是浪费。就说前几晚吧，我结识了好几个朋友，亲近得甚至胜过我的家人。等我想起他们的名字，我都能想象我们的羁绊会变得多么牢固！”
“My escapades are never a waste. Why just the other night I made several friends who felt closer to me than my own family. Once I remember their names, I can only imagine how great our bond will become!”

Brazier Of Commanding Fire Elementals.name:
号令火元素的火盆
Brazier Of Commanding Fire Elementals

Text.text:
这只黑铁火盆少说也有一百磅重。它的形状诡异得像座金字塔，盆中永远闷烧着通红的炭块，散出的热浪炽烈得让人站近些便浑身不适。若有技艺娴熟的持用者将其中囚禁的力量驭为己用，炽焰便会自灼亮余烬间骤然迸发，饥渴地舔舐着空气。
The black iron brazier must weigh at least a hundred pounds. Strangely pyramidal in shape, the brazier smolders at all times with red-hot coals, radiating a heat so intense as to be uncomfortable when one stands too near. If a skilled wielder harnesses the power trapped within, flames spring forth from the glowing embers, licking hungrily at the air.

I Plead With My Stone Of Good Luck.name:
我恳求我的好运石
I Plead With My Stone Of Good Luck

Text.text:
我把幸运石掏出来，凝视着它打磨光亮的表面，在掌心里来回滚动。“听着，我知道你不过是一块魔法石头。也许你什么都做不了。但也许……也许你能左右命运。要是你听得见，我相信你。而且，小石头，我现在真的需要好运站在我这边。走吧！”
I take my luckstone out and eye its polished surface, rolling it in my hand. “Listen, I know you’re just a magic rock. And maybe you can’t do anything. But maybe… maybe you influence fate. If you can hear me, I believe in you. And, little stone, I need luck on my side right now. Let’s go!”

你小心翼翼地穿行在海边的礁石上，目光紧盯着脚下那湿滑的岩面。忽然间，一股海水猛地在你面前喷涌炸开，冲击将你掀得向后仰倒，咸涩的水雾劈头盖脸地将你浸透。
You move carefully across the seaside rocks, watching your footing on the slippery surface. Suddenly, a gout of seawater erupts before you, sending you sprawling backward and soaking you in a briny mist.

众多篝火的烟气在山谷上空织出一层稀薄的雾，但透过朦胧，你仍能看见许多圆形帐篷在两侧坡地与谷底盆地间扎起。你听见犬吠声与劈柴的闷响；随后风向转到你这边，你便捕捉到整个聚落汇成的一片低低人声。
The smoke of many fires creates a thin fog over the valley, but through the haze you see many round tents erected on both the slopes and in the basin of the vale. You hear dogs barking and someone chopping wood, but then the wind shifts toward you and you catch the collective murmur of the whole settlement.

Toppled Obelisk.name:
倾倒的方尖碑
Toppled Obelisk

Text.text:
这块石柱曾经高耸入云，尖端刺破云层，仿佛因某种宇宙的缘由而被立于此。想想曾有多少人曾在这里屈膝跪倒，竭力从那如黑镜般的柱面上读出自己能读出的东西。如今，不知是大地漫不经心的一次耸肩，还是异端用绳索与杠杆将其扳倒，这根方尖碑横指着大地，指向一条小溪的高岸——一条要有限得多的轨迹。
The stone was once tall and pointed past the clouds, dedicated to some cosmic reason for its being. Think of how many fell to their knees here, reading what they could in the black mirrored faces of the column. Now, whether by a shrug of the earth or heretics with ropes and a lever, the obelisk aims across the land at the high bank of a small creek. A much more finite trajectory.

Instructor’s Lesson About Saint Alessa B.name:
导师讲授：圣阿莱莎·装订师
Instructor’s Lesson About Saint Alessa Bookbinder

Text.text:
“你的眼皮沉了吗？你的心神飘远了吗？我知道这些文字艰深又乏味，但当我开始走神时，我就会想起圣阿莱莎。她对守护知识的奉献，是所有愿踏上学术之路者的明灯。若非她的牺牲，这座图书馆里有一半的卷册根本不会存在。她明白，知识必须被一点一滴地搭建——一册一册，一代一代。但这过程却屡屡被国王与军阀的卑微私欲所打断。大图书馆之城遭军队围困，众人纷纷逃离之时，阿莱莎留下了。她孤身一名抄写员，井然有序地收拢每一本典籍、每一卷羊皮纸，交到逃难的市民手中送走。最后一次有人看见她，是她又冲回熊熊烈焰之中，只为再夺回最后一册。于是，当你凝视这些蒙尘的书卷时，别只想着文字——也要想着写下它们的那只手。”
“Do your eyes grow heavy? Does your mind stray? I know these texts can be difficult and dull, but when I begin to lose focus, I think of Saint Alessa. Her dedication to the preservation of knowledge is a shining beacon to all who wish to walk the path of scholarship. Half the volumes in this library wouldn’t exist if not for her sacrifice. She knew that knowledge must be built, piece by piece, volume by volume, generation by generation. But so often this process is disrupted by the petty wants of kings and warlords. When armies laid siege to the city of the great library and others fled, Alessa remained. A lone scribe, methodically gathering each tome and scroll and sending it off with the fleeing townsfolk. She was last seen running back into the blazing inferno to grab one final volume. So, when you look upon these dusty tomes, do not think only of the text—think of the hand that wrote it.”

一座由猩红鳞片垒起的巍峨堡垒般，这名龙裔骄傲地举起一面盾牌，盾面烙印着他所信奉神祇的巨龙剪影。他的身躯散发着潜伏力量的暖意，每一片鳞甲都像闷燃的余烬。虽说他的神情大多沉静而克制，那双猩红的眼却仿佛望向远方，真挚地渴盼着某个尚未兑现的寄望。

~ Played by Noelle

A towering bastion of scarlet scales, the dragonborn proudly hefts a shield emblazoned with the draconic silhouette of his deity. His body radiates the warmth of latent power, each scale a smoldering ember. Though his demeanor is mostly calm and reserved, his scarlet eyes seem distant, earnest for some promise yet unattained.

~ Played by Noelle

那魁梧汉子活像把麻烦封进了瓶里，随时都要炸开。他就是那种在每一家名声不佳的酒馆里都能见到的地痞硬汉，阴魂不散。黄铜口哨用细绳挂在他脖子上；他一吹哨，一条肌肉结实的狗便箭一般奔来。他抬手一挥，又吹了一声，狗立刻僵在原地，仿佛中了咒般动弹不得。男人那层硬邦邦的外壳顿时裂开成一个灿烂的笑容，他欢快地把狗唤到身边，任由它热情地舔他，自己也跟着笑出声来。
The burly man looks like bottled trouble. He seems like the kind of local tough you can find haunting every tavern with a bad reputation. A brass whistle hangs from a string about his neck; when he blows it, a muscular dog comes bounding toward him. He throws out his hand and blows the whistle again, which causes the dog to freeze as if spellbound. The man’s tough exterior cracks into a broad smile, and he happily calls the dog to him, accepting its eager licking with a laugh.

Spirits Don't Realize They're Dead.name:
亡魂不知自己已死
Spirits Don't Realize They're Dead

Text.text:
镇民们照常过着一天，像生前那样奔忙穿梭……却对自身真正的状态浑然不觉。他们半透明的身影仿佛褪色的水彩，游离于现实与现实之间，在帷幕的薄纱里颤巍巍地悬浮着。

~ 由 Discord 上的 Joorrekiin Envisioned

The townsfolk go about their day, hustling and bustling as they did in life… and totally unaware of their true condition. Like faded watercolors, their translucent forms exist between realities, tremulously hovering in the veil.

~ Envisioned by Joorrekiin on Discord

一头魁梧的爬行巨兽自林木间潜行而出，粗大的鼻孔翕张，循着猎物的气味追踪而来。暗红褐色的甲鳞覆满这头双足恐龙的躯体，匕首般巨大而锋利的牙齿塞满它深渊般的巨口。额嵴上竖起的尖骨冠让这只怪物显得狰狞如恶鬼。
A hulking reptilian beast stalks into view between the trees, its large nostrils flaring as it follows the scent of prey. Armored scales of ruddy brown cover the dinosaur’s bipedal body and teeth as large and sharp as daggers fill its cavernous maw. The crests of pointed bone sitting atop its brow give the monster a fiendish appearance.

Weapon Implant Mounted In Arm.name:
手臂内置武器植入体
Weapon Implant Mounted In Arm

Text.text: 一只人体模型的手臂搁在柜台上，上面有个 Try Me! 按钮，正轻柔地跳动着红光。轻轻一按，手臂上的暗格滑开，一门短管炮从开口处弹出。光滑的银色炮管上甚至投射着全息HUD，准星可自定义，还带有弹药计数器。 A mannequin arm rests on the counter with a Try Me! button on it pulsing a gentle red. A quick tap makes a compartment in the arm slide open, and a short-barreled cannon pops from the opening. The smooth silver barrel even features a holographic HUD with customizable sights and an ammo counter.

这生物的眼睛宛如齐腰高的凝乳乳珠，自幽深阴影中窥视而出；她干瘦筋结的身形佝偻，破布遮不到的皮肤呈板岩般的蓝。她穿着草鞋悄然逼近，挥舞一根带钩的投掷棍，棍身系着由人皮编成的条带。她一声低吼，你周遭的空气便被奥术回声灌满，鬼影般的沙沙低语层层叠起。就在你被这声音牵走注意力时，一记精神力的猛刺轰然撞上你心智的防线。
The creature's eyes are like waist-high orbs of curdled milk peering from the deep shadows, her wiry form slouching, skin slate blue where the rags don't cover it. She sneaks forward on sandaled feet, brandishing a hooked throwing club attached to strips of braided human skin. When she growls, the air around you fills with arcane echoes of ghostly susurrations. While you're distracted by the sound, a jab of mental force slams against the defenses of your mind.

Euphoric Street Drug, Novacoke.name:
令人飘然的街头毒品，诺瓦可卡
Euphoric Street Drug, Novacoke

Text.text:
这种刺眼的白色粉末最常见的用法是吸入鼻中，但也可以揉抹在牙龈上，以获得较为温和的效果。它因频繁出现在各类上流派对与夜店而闻名，这种高度成瘾的兴奋剂，是社交名流们的首选毒品。服用后最受追捧的效果是降低自我约束、增强自信；然而，也有尚未证实的传闻称它能提高耐痛与警觉性，使得它的使用者逐渐扩展到街头硬汉与地痞流氓之中。
This stark white powder is most often snorted, but can rubbed into the gums for a milder effect. Famously present in many high-class parties and nightclubs, this highly addictive stimulant is the drug of choice for socialites. Reduced inhibitions and increased confidence are the most desired effects of ingestion; however, unconfirmed reports of increased pain tolerance and alertness have seen its use increase to street toughs and thugs.

森林向后退去，形成一片完美的圆形空地，群树如同凝视般把目光投向中央。那里立着一株树中之树，枝干强健，冠幅宏伟，生机与触及尽展无遗。它的根旁蜷睡着一头巨狼，体型堪比大象；她灰黑相间的皮毛如夜色覆霜。下巴搁在巨大的前爪上，爪尖如象牙般弯长。她鼻下的草随着呼吸起伏，伏倒，又重新挺起。

~ Envisioned by Soulless158

The forest has pulled back to form a perfect circular clearing, the trees gazing into its center. There stands a tree of trees, magnificent in full health and reach. Sleeping at its roots, chest expanding and contracting gently with the sound of a bellows, is a wolf the size of an elephant. Her fur is gray and black. Her chin rests on giant paws with claws like tusks. Below her nose the grass moves with her breathing, lying down and standing back up.

~ Envisioned by Soulless158

一座朴拙的石与茅草小屋稳稳坐落在林间空地里，烟从烟囱里盘旋升起。常春藤无人打理，蔓延攀上屋顶。远侧一排菜圃里种着番茄、胡萝卜、萝卜，还有一大把香草。两只肥母鸡在近旁灌木间漫不经心地啄食。厚重的板玻璃窗朝向空地，映着炉火的光，暖亮如星。
The humble structure of stone and thatch sits stout amid the clearing, smoke spiraling from its chimney. Ivy crawls its way to the roof, untended. Garden beds along the far side house tomatoes, carrots, radishes, and a bounty of herbs. A pair of fat hens peck absently at the shrubs nearby. Windows of heavy slab glass look out into the clearing, glowing with firelight.

I Use Step Of The Wind.name:
我施展「疾风步」。
I Use Step Of The Wind

Text.text:
奇妙的是，左手竟能向前飞掠——力道自右脚趾一路贯穿全身将它推出——哪怕左脚正往后撤步。肌肉与骨骼的牵连带来回弹，身后的空气将我接住。对手此刻已在臂展之外，仍以为我还被这场交锋缠住。我却自觉已然脱身，随时可以离去。
Fascinating is the way the left hand may fly forward, propelled by the force of the body all the way up from the right toe, even while the left foot is stepping back. The connection to flesh and bone produces recoil, and the air behind me receives me. My opponent is beyond arm’s reach now, still believing me to be tied to our exchange. I consider myself free to go.

Ostentatious Wealthy Investor.name:
浮华的富豪投资人
Ostentatious Wealthy Investor

Text.text:
镀金金属打磨得如镜面般耀亮，覆在这位投资人的大半身躯上。那奢华张扬的财富展示，显然是用来震慑对手、同时向客户保证他们的成功与理财眼光的手段。一只发条机械表——在银河市场上属于稀有度极高之物——在他们腕间轻轻滴答作响；他们刻意确保它永远显眼，不会被量身剪裁的西装袖口遮住。
Gold-plated metal, polished to a mirror shine, covers much of the investor’s body. The extravagant show of wealth is clearly a tool used to intimidate opponents and reassure clients of their success and financial acumen. A clockwork watch—a rarity in the galactic market—ticks softly on their wrist, and they make a point of ensuring it is always on display, not hidden by the cuff of their tailored suit.

Volcanic Elemental Traverses A Village.name:
火山元素穿行村庄
Volcanic Elemental Traverses A Village

Text.text:
烈焰噼啪作响，压过硫磺般刺鼻的空气；那生物沉重地迈步前行，每一次雷霆般的踏落都在身后留下咕嘟翻涌的岩浆池。滚烫熔岩在这巨兽的血肉表面不断鼓泡、流动、重塑，它穿过村落，浑然不顾那些像蚂蚁般四散奔逃的居民，在它原始的威势面前渺小无比。

~ 构想：Elijah

The crackle of flames dominates the sulfurous air as the creature lumbers onward, each thunderous step leaving a bubbling pool of magma in its wake. Molten lava constantly bubbles and shifts across the behemoth’s flesh as it traverses the village, ignoring the residents who scatter like ants before its primal might.

~ Envisioned by Elijah

Site Of A Werewolf Attack.name:
狼人攻击现场
Site Of A Werewolf Attack

Text.text:
酒馆破碎的窗框里灌进凄厉寒风，窗帘在其中猎猎翻飞；毁坏的桌椅东倒西歪，散落满地——其间还横陈着数具被撕咬得面目全非的尸体。血腥味、尿臊味、汗酸味、内脏的腥膻味交织成一团，扑面而来，你强迫自己在这片屠戮里理清头绪，拼凑出这里究竟发生了什么。远处那扇窗的碎玻璃上，挂着一撮粗硬的灰色毛发，在夜风里轻轻颤舞——也许，是条线索？
Curtains flap in the chill wind howling through the shattered windows of the tavern, and wrecked furniture litters the floor—alongside several mauled bodies. Blood. Urine. Sweat. Offal. Each scent mingles with the others as you try to make sense of the carnage before you and piece together what happened here. A patch of coarse gray fur dances in the night breeze, caught on the broken glass of the far window—a clue, perhaps?

Junk Shop Proprietor With Orange Skin.name:
橙皮肤的旧货店老板
Junk Shop Proprietor With Orange Skin

Text.text:
在这家杂乱无章的旧货店里，柜台后的外星人和周遭棕灰色的货品相比，显得格外扎眼。他一身鲜亮的橙色皮肤上带着不对称的条纹，透出一种令人好奇的异域气息。他在破烂的蓝色工装裤上擦了擦手，你一走近，他便友好地向你打招呼。
The alien behind the counter in the cluttered junk shop sticks out like a sore thumb amid the brown and gray of his wares. Vibrant orange skin marked with asymmetrical stripes gives him an intriguingly exotic appearance. He wipes his hands on tattered blue overalls and greets you in a friendly manner as you approach.

一股炽热在你体内翻涌而起，痛楚而深沉。它蔓延至你的四肢与指尖，你在脑海中勾勒出火焰——猩红、橙亮、灼灼逼人。你抬手一指，火焰自你身上脱离，化作铺天盖地的咆哮火幕，在你周遭轰然爆裂。
A simmering heat rises within you, painful and profound. It extends to your limbs and fingers, and you visualize the flames—red and orange and searing. You point, and the flames leave you, erupting in sheets of roaring fire all around you.

Frost Rimed Arcane Brass Glyphs.name:
霜覆的奥术黄铜符文
Frost Rimed Arcane Brass Glyphs

Text.text:
你低头监看自己每一个小心翼翼的脚步，看到那几何纹样——黄铜形状镶嵌在石面之中——有一部分被霜覆盖。由圆环与交错线条构成的图案，仿佛以艺术化的笔触摹拟宇宙的经纬与行星天体的移动。随着幽蓝的色泽自远方燃烧的钴蓝星辰渗入，这些黄铜质的金属装饰却并未发光，也不曾闪耀。
Looking down to monitor each careful step, you see the geometric design—brass shapes inlaid in the stone—partially covered by frost. The pattern, made up of circles and intersecting lines, seems to artistically mimic the fabric of the cosmos and the movement of planetary bodies. As the bluish tinge pervades from the burning cobalt stars beyond, the brassy metal decoration does not glow or shine.

Luthor Lightbearer.name:
卢瑟·光辉使者
Luthor Lightbearer

Text.text:
他的警觉从未松懈，金色的眼睛被体内的火焰磨亮般灼灼生辉。护手的徽记烙印在他的罩袍上，在他宽阔肩头的肩甲之间闪着银光。亚麻色的胡须遮住了他的神情，可少年般急切的勇武仍在眼底分外分明。他牵着缰绳引领一匹英勇的骏马，坐骑与人皆肌肉贲张、气势如潮。

~ Played by Ford

His vigilance never wavers, golden eyes burnished by an inner fire. The image of a gauntlet emblazons his tabard, glimmering silver between the pauldrons on his broad shoulders. His flaxen beard masks his expression, but the eager bravado of youth is apparent in his eyes. He leads a valiant steed by the reins, both mount and man rampant with muscle.

~ Played by Ford

Halfling Tournament Jester.name:
半身人锦标赛弄臣
Halfling Tournament Jester

Text.text:
人群哀叹着，他们的冠军被毫不客气地从马鞍上掀了下来。一个穿得花花绿绿的半身人冲上沙地——却一脚绊在倒地的骑士身上，脸朝下摔了个结实。笑声瞬间充满空气，小丑爬起身来，竟猛地从裤子里掏出一只鸡。那鸟尖声嘶叫，随即狠狠啄了半身人一口，扑棱着翅膀飞走了，身后紧追着满口咒骂的弄臣。
The crowd groans as their champion is pitched unceremoniously from the saddle. A brightly dressed halfling sprints onto the sands—only to trip over the fallen knight and land flat on their face. Laughter fills the air as the clown gets up and suddenly pulls a chicken out of their trousers. The bird shrieks loudly before pecking the halfling and flapping off, hotly pursued by the swearing jester.

Domain Of A Seelie Fey.name:
善灵妖精的领域
Domain Of A Seelie Fey

Text.text:
设定于夏日的落日余辉洒下，这片完美的白桦林被柔光照亮，空气中漂浮着点点金色光尘。修整得一丝不苟的小径穿过洁白的树干——雕刻的立石与葱郁的林下灌木勾勒着路缘——其中最宽的一条通向一座屋邸。古老的树木彼此交织，构成其主体：根系为基，枝干化作楼层与屋顶。雕花木料与石材，在一些地方与活生生的树体融为一体，补全了这座建筑。
The glow of the setting summer sun illuminates this perfect birch forest, motes of golden light floating in the air. Manicured paths run through the white trunks—carved standing stones and verdant underbrush marking the trail edges—the widest of which leads to a house. Ancient trees have intertwined, forming the main structure, their roots the foundation and their branches the floors and a roof. Carved timber and stone, merged in places with living wood, complete the structure.

Five Fools And A Scribe.name:
五个傻瓜与一名书记
Five Fools And A Scribe

Text.text:
众人的闲聊声渐渐低了下去，地下城主将屏风立在桌上，把骰子倾入骰盘，清脆的叮当声如细流倾泻，层层回响。今夜，他们暂且把现实抛在身后——哪怕只是一会儿——与朋友一同踏入一个想象无垠、危机四伏、充满冒险的世界。纸张沙沙作响，玩家们整理起角色卡，准备化身他们挚爱的英雄，栖身于远在现实之外的天地。桌面两端交汇着热切的目光，他们心中暗自揣测：下一段冒险，会把他们带向何处？

~ Joel Zupke 构想

The casual chatter of the group dies down as the dungeon master places their screen on the table and pours dice into a tray with a pleasant, cascading rattle. Tonight, they leave their life behind—if only for a while—and journey with their friends into a world of limitless imagination, danger, and adventure. Papers rustle as the players ready their character sheets, preparing to embody their beloved heroes and inhabit a world far beyond their own. Eager glances are exchanged across the table, and they wonder: Where will the adventure take them next?

~ Envisioned by Joel Zupke

I Cast Aura Of Protection.name:
我施放了守护灵光
I Cast Aura Of Protection

Text.text:
我的自信以可触的波涛自体内向外荡开。凡在我庇护之下的人，灵魂深处都能感到我对他们、对自己、对誓言的信念。麻烦降临时，这份笃定与信任会连同我自己的，一并支撑他们与我的血肉、心智与精神。
My confidence emanates from me in palpable waves. Those under my protection feel, in their souls, my faith in them, in myself, and in my oath. When trouble comes, this certainty and trust bolsters their body, mind, and spirit, along with mine.

Genie Warlock’s Vessel Interior.name:
巨灵邪术师的容器内部
Genie Warlock’s Vessel Interior

Text.text:
这间公寓的体型约等同于一座普通舞厅，圆形地面铺满数十张异域地毯。弧形墙上相对开着两扇窗，从外面都看不见。第一扇窗俯瞰这艘容器在物质世界中的所在位置；它是一处观测哨，窗前立着一座讲台。另一扇窗前摆着一张舒适的长榻与许多靠垫，环绕着一只巨大的黄铜水烟壶，正对着那扇窗——窗外是巨灵自己的元素位面。公寓其余空间则堆满魔法家具与艺术品。
About the size of the average ballroom, the apartment’s round floor is covered by dozens of exotic rugs. Two windows oppose one another on the curved wall, neither visible from the outside. The first looks on the world of the vessel’s physical location. It is an observation post, and before the window is a podium. A comfortable couch and many cushions, all surrounding a great brass hookah, face the other window, which looks out on the Genie’s own elemental plane. The rest of the apartment is filled with magical furniture and artworks.

纤细的长颈柔和地弯出弧度，覆着如雪的羽毛，脚爪泛着温雅的光泽——这些天鹅轻松而优雅地承载着自己的美丽。这群威严的天鹅中，有一只转向你，颈项弯曲，仿佛带着羞怯。它的喙呈温暖的黄橙色，像最令人安心的落日般柔和，随即张开，吐出一声令人毛骨悚然的嘶嘶。它那如云的双翼猛然鼓起，宛如一条自负的巨龙般张扬，朝你直冲而来！它的头颅从蛇一般的长颈尽头猛地探出，喙部不停啄咬你的膝盖、小腿与脚面，毫不松口。 Slender necks that curve so gently, the snowy feathers, the genteel sheen of their feet—these swans bear their beauty with ease and elegance. One of this majestic flock turns toward you, neck bending in what seems a bashful fashion. Its beak, the warm yellow-orange of a most comforting sunset, opens to emit a hair-raising hiss. Its cloud-like wings puff up like those of a boastful dragon as it rushes toward you! Its head springs forward from the end of its serpentine neck, beak snapping unrelentingly at your knees, calves and feet.

Sundries From A Harengon.name:
来自兔族人的杂货
Sundries From A Harengon

Text.text:
在他们矢车菊蓝色背心的口袋里，你找到一支蜜色木烟斗——短粗敦实，便于随手塞放。它散发着陈旧烟草与焦灼木头的气味。他们短裤上一个松垮的口袋里，还藏着一方手帕，角落绣着一组姓名首字母。
In the pocket of their cornflower-blue vest, you find a honey-colored wooden pipe—short and stubby for easy stowing. It smells of stale tobacco and charred wood. One of the sagging pockets of their shorts holds a handkerchief with initials embroidered at the corner.

Well-used Shortbow.name:
久经使用的短弓
Well-used Shortbow

Text.text:
弓身轮廓起伏分明，短劲的弓臂勾勒出精悍线条，每一道弧度都将强悍的力量层层叠加。木质弓身满是久经使用的痕迹，握把也已被磨得光滑发亮。
Short, powerful limbs define the contoured silhouette of the bow, each curve adding to its potent strength. The wood bears the hallmarks of frequent use, and the grip is well worn.

Sewing Instructor Providing Accommodatio.name:
提供住宿的裁缝导师
Sewing Instructor Providing Accommodation

Text.text:
年轻地精纤弱的手握着针线，动作笨拙而不均。它紧张地意识到精灵导师正盯着它，注视着它完成人生第一份委托。见它受限于拙劣的灵巧而挣扎，导师取出一只制帆匠的掌套，将那条坚韧的皮革护带牢牢套在地精手上——霎时间，学徒发现缝制竟变得顺手得多。
The young goblin's weak hands work unevenly with the needle and thread. They are anxiously aware of their elven instructor peering as they work on their first commission. After watching the goblin’s struggle with their limited dexterity, the instructor brings out a sailmaker’s palm. He fits this tough leather band around the goblin’s hand, and suddenly the student finds their sewing far more manageable.

城堡执政家族那夸张而华丽的旗幡高悬在坚固主堡入口两侧，巨大的橡木门前由警觉的守卫把守。作为贵胄与其贴身随从最后的堡垒，这里看上去完全足以承受狂热战斗的摧残：关键位置开有狭长箭孔，墙体结构上凿出一道道凹槽，专供倾泼燃烧的沥青。一支坚韧的守军几乎不费吹灰之力，便能在此对抗远多于己的攻城者，坚守数周，甚至数月。
Tremendous, gaudy banners of the castle's ruling family are hung on either side of the entrance to the stout keep, the huge oaken doors manned by alert guards. This last bastion for people of rank and their closest attendants looks quite up to the rigors of fevered fighting, with arrow slits present in strategic places and divots in the structure of the walls for use in pouring burning pitch. A strong line of defenders could hold out against a far larger force of attackers for weeks, if not months, with minimal effort.

两只细长枯瘦的手指从树干上一道焦黑的伤疤里伸出，触及外界。像掀开帷幕般轻巧，这对枝杈似的手却猛地将树皮撕裂，伴着一声暴烈扭曲的吱嘎，黑色木刺四散飞溅。一个类人形体从裂口中拔起，凌驾于雾海之上。它的躯体完全由腐朽木质构成，那股酸败的恶臭骤然浓烈，黏在舌面上挥之不去。它的嘴颚脱臼般张开，吐出干涩沙哑的呼号，面孔与喉间布满病态的黄苔。周遭树木的枝干随之颤抖，仿佛在恐惧中战栗。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Two sets of spindly fingers reach out of one of the charred scars running through the trunk. With the ease of someone parting curtains, these branch-like hands tear apart the bark with a violent, wrenching creak, black splinters flying forth. A humanoid form rises up, high above the mists. Its body is made entirely of rotting wood, and the sour smell intensifies into something that clings to your tongue. Its mouth unhinges into a dry, rasping call, its face and throat riddled with a sickly yellow moss. The limbs of the surrounding trees shudder, as if quaking with fear.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

你俯视脚下松散的泥土，随心一捏。它卷起、压实、成形，又再度崩散——全凭念头驱使。细微的砂砾感掠过你的全身，仿佛在你操弄泥土之时，你也置身尘土之中。
You look at the loose earth upon the ground and mold it at a whim. It rolls up, compacts, takes shape, falls apart again—all with mere thought. A slight sensation of grit falls over your body, as if you are within the dirt as you manipulate it.

谷地向四面八方绵延数里，满目葱茏，土路与鹿径纵横其间，露雾轻笼。空气湿润宜人，裹着沃土与新芽绽放的气息，也捎来远处烟囱里炊火升腾的醇厚烟香。
The dales sprawl for leagues in all directions, shrouded in greenery, crossed by dirt roads and deer trails, and misted with dew. The air, pleasantly humid, carries the smell of loam and blooming buds, as well as the hearty smoke of cooking fires from distant chimneys.

Stoic Martial Arts Instructor.name:
坚忍的武艺教头
Stoic Martial Arts Instructor

Text.text:
深吸一口气，那矮壮结实的男人在准备开始职业课程前让心神沉静下来。他那双锐利的灰眼只消一瞥，便让喧闹的学生们瞬间噤声；眉梢一挑，又掀起一阵慌乱的奔走，他们急忙冲向各自被分配的站位。他将编织的黑色腰带猛地绷紧，随即沉身落入战斗架势。双腿稳稳托住全身重量，他含笑看着学生们也熟练地跟着摆出同样的姿态，动作行云流水。
Breathing in deeply, the squat, muscular man calms his mind as he prepares to start the class. One look from his piercing gray eyes silences the chattering students and a raised eyebrow incites a flurry of panicked motion as they rush to their assigned spaces. He pulls his woven black belt taut and drops into a fighting stance. Each leg perfectly supports his weight, and he smiles as his students follow suit with practiced ease.

Temperate Forest Birches.name:
温带森林桦树
Temperate Forest Birches

Text.text:
在构成这片森林的诸多树木之中，高大的白桦格外醒目。它们纤细的树干披着一层幽灵般的雪白树皮，其上布满黑色节疤的孔洞；有些地方树皮翘起剥落，像一道道刻痕斑斑的羊皮纸层层叠叠地卷开。修长的枝条托着一捧捧小巧的椭圆叶片，垂挂着细弱的花序，簇簇微小花朵随风摇曳。
Among the different kinds of trees that make up the forest, the tall birches stand out. The bark that covers their lean trunks is ghostly white and pocked by black knotholes, peeling back in places like overlapping sheets of scored parchment. Slender branches carry armloads of small oval-shaped leaves and dangling spindly clusters of tiny flowers.

My Shield +1 Deflects An Arrow.name:
我的盾牌 +1 偏转了一支箭矢
My Shield +1 Deflects An Arrow

Text.text:
我猛地俯身闪避，箭矢撞上我附魔盾牌的正中心，效果微弱得像卵石砸在城墙上。它叮当一声无害地落到地上，连盾面那华丽的饰纹都未曾留下半点痕迹；箭杆已然弯折，碎裂不堪。
I duck, and the arrow bounces off the center point of my enchanted shield, as ineffective as pebbles against a castle wall. Clattering harmlessly to the ground and leaving no mark on the shield’s ornate face, the arrow lies bent and broken.

Sword Of Sharpness.name:
锋锐之剑
Sword Of Sharpness

Text.text:
这把剑的刃口闪耀得几近刺目——并非源于附魔，而是光线掠过这件武器臻于完美的锋刃时所迸出的光辉。如此兵刃几乎无物不破，骨与肉在它面前如同热刃切过软奶酪般被轻易剖开。
The edge of this sword gleams so brightly as to be blinding—not through enchantment, but by how the light catches the utterly perfect edge of the weapon. Such arms could cut through almost anything, parting bone and muscle like a heated blade through soft cheese.

Quip About Kindness.name:
关于善意的俏皮话
Quip About Kindness

Text.text:
“我们并非生来仁善。善意是一种技能，必须像任何武器一样反复磨砺、勤加练习。”
“We are not born kind. Kindness is a skill, one that must be honed and practiced just as much as any weapon.”

Weary Soldier Finds Respite In Community.name:
疲惫的士兵在社区中寻得片刻安歇
Weary Soldier Finds Respite In Community

Text.text:
士兵一瘸一拐地前行，拄着一根磨旧而朴素的拐杖支撑体重，沿着土路走进村庄。尽管行囊寥寥，战场的重量却永远压在他们肩上——夺去的性命、失去的挚友、以及从血浸泥浆里硬生生刻出的惨胜。这里的日子似乎更轻一些；当士兵望见路旁果园里、阳光斑驳下嬉闹的孩子们时，一抹笑意竟也硬挤上了脸。也许在这里，他们终于能找到安宁。

~ Envisioned by MasterTamari on Discord

The soldier limps along, supporting their weight with a worn and simple crutch as they traverse the dirt road into the village. Though they carry little, the weight of battle is forever upon their shoulders—of lives taken, of friends lost, and of pyrrhic victories carved from the blood-soaked mud. Life seems lighter here, and a smile forces its way across the soldier’s face as they watch children play in the sun-dappled orchard beside the road. Perhaps here they can finally find peace.

~ Envisioned by MasterTamari on Discord

Earth Elemental: Forest Battle.name:
土元素：森林战斗
Earth Elemental: Forest Battle

Text.text:
大地如浪潮般隆起，雪崩般的臂膀托举起巨石般的拳头。你眼前的生物由岩石与泥土构成，却仿佛在不断吞纳泥地又将其抛弃——它沿地面流动前行，移动时卷起土壤，越过后碎屑便簌簌回落。它似乎不像凡俗生物那样拥有心脏或头颅。尽管如此，它并不欣赏你对它挥下的每一击。
The ground rises in a wave, raising boulder fists on avalanche arms. The creature you now face exists as a being of rock and dirt, but its body seems to take up earth and discard it, flowing over the ground, pulling up the soil as it moves and letting the debris settle back as it passes. It doesn’t seem to have a heart or head like mortal creatures. Nevertheless, it doesn’t appreciate you hitting it.

Barbarian's Speech Of Self-affirmation.name:
野蛮人的自我肯定宣言
Barbarian's Speech Of Self-affirmation

Text.text:
“你可真壮。壮得离谱。瞧瞧那双胳膊。你要是再大一点，这世界都得裂成两半。你所有的朋友都知道你有多壮，他们都很喜欢你。他们都在乎你。你做得真的很好。”
“You are so big. The biggest. Look at those arms. If you were any bigger, the world would crack in half. All your friends know how big you are, and they all like you. They all care about you. You’re doing a really good job.”

Statues Of The Temple Guardians.name:
神殿守护者雕像
Statues Of The Temple Guardians

Text.text:
你沿着阶梯向上走到夹层，这里有三座楼梯通往神殿的上部。在最大、位于中央的那座楼梯两侧，各立着一尊神殿守卫雕像，仿佛在无声守望。它们看起来像某种猿类生物与陶土魔像的混合体，五官与肌理精雕细琢——细致到令人心里发紧，以至于你经过时都不由得盯着它们，生怕下一刻它们就会骤然活过来。
Moving upward to the mezzanine, and its three staircases leading to the top portion of the temple, two temple guardian statues stand watch, one on either side of the largest, central staircase. Resembling a cross between a sort of simian creature and a clay golem, the features on these statues are exquisitely detailed—so much so that you keep an eye on them as you pass by, lest they spring into motion.

海浪轻柔地拍打着没入水中的礁脊。阳光摇曳的光纹掠过一片几乎像骨头般的东西：活珊瑚，却被漂白得惨白刺目。你不禁思索，究竟是什么让珊瑚发生如此变化，又有怎样诡异的魔法在暗中作祟。礁脊周围的海洋生物依旧繁盛；尽管它呈现出幽魂般的外观，却似乎仍然健康无恙。
Waves lap softly at the submerged reef. The wavering light of the sun plays across something almost bone-like in appearance: living coral, bleached a stark white. You wonder what caused such a change in the coral, and what strange magic might be at play. Sea life is still abundant around the reef, which, despite its ghostly appearance, seems to be in good health.

Loot From A Umber Hulk.name:
来自紫黑潜地兽的战利品
Loot From A Umber Hulk

Text.text:
一阵轻柔的微风掠过这片区域，几页书法纸随风飘荡。每张纸的一边都染着干涸的胶痕。许多纸页已经撕裂。字里行间像是一种自然笔记，记录着观察所得与半科学式的数据片段。若能将这些内容细心汇编成册，对真正识货的买家而言，其价值将相当可观。
Drifting around the site on a gentle breeze are a number of pages of calligraphy. One edge of each sheet is tinged with dried glue. Many are torn. The writing is some kind of nature journal, recording observations and semi-scientific bits of data. Compiled carefully, the worth of this journal would be considerable to the right buyer.

Royal Tomb Of Two Queens.name:
双后王陵
Royal Tomb Of Two Queens

Text.text:
宛如圣地的宁谧，这间端肃的王家地穴墓室中弥漫着一种不容置疑的王者气度。两尊雕像神情安详，被匠人一刀一凿精心刻入两位王后的石棺之上——她们曾并肩守护疆土，是这片国度的共护者，也是每一位所爱子民的母仪。
Akin to the tranquility of a holy place, there is an unmistakably regal air cultivated in this decorous room of the royal crypt. Beatific in their gazes, two effigies have been painstakingly carved into the sarcophagus of these two queens, joint protectors of their realm and matriarchs of every one of their beloved subjects.

I Put On My Eyes Of Minute Seeing.name:
我戴上了明察入微之眼
I Put On My Eyes Of Minute Seeing

Text.text:
我戴上眼镜，目光一穿过镜片，镜片便因其与生俱来的魔法微微闪烁。周遭近处的轮廓瞬间变得清晰锐利，我能捕捉到最细微的细节：斑驳尘土颗粒的繁复层次、坠落叶片上蜿蜒的叶脉、穿旧衣物上各异的纹理触感。
I put on the glasses, and the lenses glint with their innate magic as soon as my eyes focus through them. The features of my immediate surroundings refine, and I can catch the finest of details: the complexity of the motley grains of dirt, the veins of a falling leaf, the diversified textures of well-worn clothes.

他舞步轻盈，旋身如风，尽管外表老迈，却仍带着少年般毫不费力的优雅。脚边，一条不比狗大多少的小龙——覆着光润的黄铜鳞片——欢快地蹦跳翻腾，沉醉于他施展的魔法幻象。那张脸上的笑容，灿若盛夏骄阳。

~ Sahlonahl 于 Discord

Dancing and twirling, the man moves with the effortless grace of youth despite his wizened appearance. At his feet, a small dragon no larger than a dog—with glossy brass scales—cavorts joyously, enraptured by the magical illusions the man creates. The smile on his face is as radiant as the summer sun.

~ Sahlonahl on Discord

你伸出手指直指你的目标，厉声吐出一个单词。在你的宗主之力加持下，他们毫无抵抗之力，只能服从你的命令。
You point your finger at your target and bark a single word. Backed by the power of your patron, they are helpless to resist your command.

Dark Waters Of The Moonlit River.name:
月照河的暗涌水域
Dark Waters Of The Moonlit River

Text.text:
在石桥投下的阴影与激荡的水流之间，穿过山口入口下方奔涌而过的宽阔河面，几乎令寻常目光无从穿透。即便有一缕月光如银色缎带般划开起伏水面上的黑暗，也照不出多少端倪。
Between the shadows cast by the stone bridge and the churn of the water, the wide expanse of river running under the entrance to the mountain is all but impenetrable to normal vision. Even a ray of moonlight bisecting the darkness of the rippling surface like a silvery ribbon reveals little.

I Cast Mirage Arcane.name:
我施放了「海市蜃楼秘法」
I Cast Mirage Arcane

Text.text:
我将眼前绵延一英里的景致视作承载我魔法意志的画布。随着我挥手一抹，大地在我眼中改换形貌。地形的轮廓与色彩仿佛融化般流淌、扭曲，继而重塑成我心念所选的景象。
I view the mile-long stretch of landscape before me as a canvas for my magical will. With a wave of my hand, I transfigure the land. The shapes and colors of the terrain melt and bend, morphing into the image of my choice.

Victims Of An Alien Plague.name:
异星瘟疫的受害者
Victims Of An Alien Plague

Text.text:
病房里每一张床都躺满了人，多半是人类，且全都呈现出同样的症状。他们的皮肤上布满暗紫色的斑块；那些仍睁着的眼睛里，血丝红得发沉，几乎近黑。几乎没人还有力气坐起，更别提试着站起来。几名被折腾得筋疲力尽的护士在房间里来回奔走，穿着防护道具，竭尽所能照看这远远超出承载的病患。
Every bed in the ward is filled, mostly by humans, all presenting the same symptoms. Dark purple splotches dot their skin, and those eyes that are still open have veins so deep red they’re almost black. Hardly anybody seems to have the energy to sit up, let alone attempt to stand. A few much-harassed nurses dash around the room, wearing protective gear and doing their best to take care of too many patients.

Main Hall Of An Abbey.name:
修道院主礼堂
Main Hall Of An Abbey

Text.text:
这座古老修道院的大厅建于数百年前的久远年代，如今依旧令人叹为观止。那是一间巨大的厅堂，由一位早已作古的君主以私库资助而成，与僧侣寝室的清寒朴素形成强烈反差。中殿的拱顶高耸，配得上这些年来在此举行的加冕盛典——每一道扶壁与每一根立柱，都以近乎苛刻的匠心精雕细琢。
The hall of this aged abbey, built in a bygone era centuries past, is still a marvel to behold. An enormous chamber, funded by the personal treasury of a long-dead monarch, is a powerful contradiction to the stark simplicity of the monastic cells. The vaulted ceilings of the nave befit the grandeur of the coronations that have taken place here over the years—every buttress and pillar is decorated with exacting artistry.

Stone Of Controlling Earth Elementals.name:
操控土元素之石
Stone Of Controlling Earth Elementals

Text.text:
这块厚重的晶洞大得足以盈满一只手，外表粗粝不平，却在中央那处嵌满晶簇的凹陷周围光滑如镜。握着它时，你会涌起一种离奇的冲动，想要呼唤脚下那活着的岩石。
This hefty geode, large enough to fill one’s hand, is quite rough on the outside, but perfectly smooth around the crystal-laden depression in its center. While holding it, you feel an outlandish desire to call out to the living rock beneath your feet.

Sir Bors The Younger At The Joust.name:
年轻的博尔斯爵士在比武场
Sir Bors The Younger At The Joust

Text.text:
在虔敬的静默与从容的仪态中，骑士策马而出，长枪上系着他淑女的信物，洁白如新。掀起的面甲下，一道伤疤划过他的额头，却丝毫无损他俊朗的容颜。蔚蓝的菱形纹章绣在银白底色之上，彰显他的家徽；同样的图案也复刻在坐骑护甲上。

~ 由 Vahlaron 构想

In reverent silence and grace, the knight rides out, his lady’s favor clean and white upon his lance. Beneath his upturned visor, a scar marks his forehead, though the wound does little to detract from his handsome countenance. A lozengy of azure displays his heraldry upon an argent field, the design replicated on the barding of his steed.

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

看似寻常的兽皮与毛皮层层叠加，组成了一套朴素却实用的护甲。然而这些皮革并非来自普通野兽——而是源自凶暴动物、星裔生物，或骇人的怪物猛兽。护甲上还点缀着獠牙与利爪，贴身合体又舒适自如，让你移动毫无拘束。
The seemingly mundane layers of hide and fur create a simple but effective suit of armor. Yet the skins are not from mundane beasts—rather, dire animals, planetouched creatures, or monstrous beasts provided them. The armor, adorned also with fangs and claws, fits snugly and comfortably, allowing for complete ease of movement.

这名龟人宽得几乎与高相当，身形庞大而令人敬畏，但那双黑色眼睛却透着睿智与温和的欢迎。松弛、起褶的蓝灰色皮肤，让他看起来更显和善。他下肢、双脚与双手的鳞片愈发厚重、色泽更深；背甲由深色甲片拼成，而腹甲的甲片则更浅。符文刻在甲板上，也刻在他的黄铜战锤与盾牌上——两者各自都有一处水晶夹层，里面盛着细沙。

~ Played by Riley

This turtlefolk is as wide as he is tall, cutting a massive, formidable form, but his black eyes seem wise and welcoming. Loose, wrinkled blue-gray skin lends to this gentler seeming. His scales thicken and darken on his lower limbs, feet, and hands. Dark scutes make up his carapace, too, while those of his plastron are lighter.
