Runes etch the plates, and also mark his brass hammer and shield—each of which has a crystal compartment that holds sand.

~ Played by Riley

狭窄的木筒内藏着细长的针矢，尖端致命。纤细的筒身刻着细小纹样，一端外张，底部还嵌着一道小小的边缘。
The narrow wooden tube houses thin needles with deadly points. The slender shaft is engraved with small designs and flared at one end, sporting a small rim at the base.

牧师跪在血泥般的地上，摇着她剃发的头。聚拢的人群开始哀号：他们的英雄倒下了，再也不会起身。华丽的铠甲被撕裂敞开，骑士无声地躺着，头盔被抛在一旁，金发被染成猩红。一截折断的长枪从她的胸甲中刺出，凶戾的阴影沉沉压在她那双失去神采的眼睛上。
The cleric kneels in the gore-painted dirt and shakes her tonsured head. Gathered folk begin to wail: their hero has fallen, never to rise again. Panoply ripped open, the knight lies silent, helm discarded, blond hair painted red. A broken lance juts from her breastplate, its murderous shadow dark across her unseeing eyes.

Speech By A Dragon About Apocalypse.name:
一条龙的末日演说
Speech By A Dragon About Apocalypse

Text.text:
“火、尘与风：万物皆由此而成。终有一日，这个世界会坠回巨兽的颚下，而我——携我全部荣光——将依旧长存。自成一界。”
“Fire, dust and wind: this is the nature of all things. One day this world will fall back into the great beast's maw, but I—in all my glory—will remain. A world unto myself.”

Torchlit Door To The Mountain Path.name:
通往山径的火炬照明之门
Torchlit Door To The Mountain Path

Text.text:
这扇通往山腹的结实木门涂覆着硬化的沥青，悬挂得分毫不差，严丝合缝到连封口都密不透气。门洞两侧火炬的光芒映出木匠的精工细作——为了抵御各种天气，他把木料处理得滴水不漏。
Coated with hardened pitch and hung with exquisite exactness, the sturdy wooden door to the mountain’s innards has been fit so precisely that its seal is airtight. The light of the two torches flanking the portal reveals the care with which the carpenter prepared the wood against all kinds of weather.

Dragonborn Bard.name:
龙裔吟游诗人
Dragonborn Bard

Text.text:
一位龙裔吟游诗人踏上阶段，气场迫使众人献上崇拜。他们的鳞片如抛光黄金般耀眼，闪烁着催眠般的魅惑光泽。其歌喉婉转悠扬，低沉共鸣起伏回荡，编织出古老爱情与英雄功业的叙事歌谣。演出令人神魂颠倒，是魔法与奇迹交织而成的醉人狂潮。
A dragonborn bard takes the stage, their presence demanding adoration. With scales like polished gold, they gleam with hypnotic allure. Their canorous voice oscillates with bass resonance, weaving ballads of ancient love and heroic deeds. The performance is spellbinding, a heady mix of magic and wonder.

工人身穿一件脏兮兮的背心，头戴一顶鸭舌帽遮住刺眼的阳光。他停了片刻，抹去额头的汗水，随即重新扛起沉重的负担，继续前行。
Clad in a grubby singlet, with a flat cap to shield his eyes from the sun, the laborer takes a moment to wipe the sweat from his brow before picking up his burden and moving on.

Carriage Pulled By Phantom Horses.name:
魅影战马牵引的马车
Carriage Pulled By Phantom Horses

Text.text:
马车黑得像过了午夜的那一个时辰。它静静停在雨里，沉默地压在街道湿亮的鹅卵石上。座椅钉扣紧实、填充饱满，车厢上方撑开一顶紫罗兰色的丝绸篷盖。忽然间，伴随挽具与连接件“啪”地一声脆响，车辕从地面抬起。它在巨大的木轮上猛地一颠，向前冲去，速度越来越快。你听见许多蹄子坚硬的哒哒声，却看不见一匹马。
The carriage is as black as the hour after midnight. It stands in the rain, silent on the wet cobbles of the street. The seats are buttoned and stuffed, and a violet silk canopy stretches over the cabin. Instantly, in a snap of harness and linkage, the carriage shaft lifts from the ground. It lurches forward on its large wooden wheels and picks up speed. You hear the hard clop of many hooves, yet see no horses.

Large Mountain Encampment Of Soldiers.name:
大型山地军营
Large Mountain Encampment Of Soldiers

Text.text:
营地在高原上铺展开来，帐篷连绵，篝火噼啪作响。身披皮革与毛皮的士兵彼此切磋。士兵的闷哼与笑声交织在一起，混着战斗的声响：斧刃咬入木制盾牌的闷响，橡木枪杆的铿锵碰撞，以及箭矢砰然钉入卷草靶的震动。
The encampment is a sprawl of tents and crackling bonfires across the plateau. Soldiers garbed in leathers and furs spar with one another. The soldiers’ grunts and laughter mingle with the battle-sounds of axe blades biting into wooden shields, the clatter of oak-shafted spears, and the thump of arrows striking targets of coiled straw.

Pregnant Human Noble.name:
怀孕的人类贵族
Pregnant Human Noble

Text.text:
她双手交握覆在腹上，眼下青黑深重，贵妇人的疲惫一眼便知。尽管她的天鹅绒长裙经过精心裁剪，试图减弱腹部的取整隆起，但她已怀有身孕仍昭然若揭。她闭上眼，将世界拒之门外，双臂环住腹部，低低哼着一支小调。
Hands clasped over her stomach and dark circles under her eyes, the noblewoman's weariness is apparent. Though her velvet dress has been cut carefully to diminish the rounding of her belly, it is clear she is with child.  Closing her eyes to the world, she wraps her arms around her belly and hums a low tune.

一头水栖鳄形巨兽破水而出，青蓝鳞甲覆体，身躯尽头是一条筋肉虬结、专为推动沼泽浑水而生的巨尾；它拖着沉重的步伐爬上岸。猫科般的前肢收束有力，末端弯爪如匕首般森寒。脊背上泼洒着一抹荧光橙，自颈至尾一路燃烧，脊线隆起，嵌着三角尖刺。它的头颅更是前所未见：一团翻涌扭结的触手旋涡，每条触手末端都长着一张残暴的环形口器。忽然，一根触手从额前弹落，贴着地面以惊人的速度蠕动疾行。生物周围萦绕着一阵微弱的心灵嗡鸣。
An aquatic crocodilian beast—with a scaled cyan body that culminates in a muscular tail built for powering through swamp water—parts the surface of the water and lumbers onto land. Feline forelimbs end in curved claws like daggers. A shock of fluorescent orange is spattered up the creature’s spine, ridged with triangular spikes. The head is unlike anything you have seen: a writhing swirl of tentacles, each tipped by a savage circular mouth. One of the tentacles pops off the forehead and wriggles along the ground with alarming speed. A faint psychic buzz surrounds the creature.

一股暖意先于这只古怪却迷人的生物到来：仿佛来自异界的精灵与大象的交融。生物金色的皮毛透出柔光，轻薄如纱的翅翼随着拍动的节奏微微颤鸣，它就这样懒洋洋地漂浮在空中。它用那细小的鼻子发出一声尖细的微弱号鸣，凡在听觉所及之处的人，都因它的存在而不自然地平静下来。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

A warmth precedes the arrival of the strangely charming creature: an otherworldly blending of fairy and elephant. A glow exudes from the creature's golden hide, and ears flap in time with the beat of its gossamer wings as it floats lazily in the air. It emits a tiny, shrill trumpet from its miniscule trunk, and all within earshot find themselves unnaturally calmed by its presence.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Loot From A Great Stag.name:
来自巨鹿的战利品
Loot From A Great Stag

Text.text:
雄鹿的皮价值是普通雄鹿的十倍。它可以被鞣制，并由技艺娴熟的工匠制作为极其稀有、带有魔力的皮革护甲。雄鹿的血液具有治疗之效。它最大的价值或许在于作为一座战利品，足以让一名猎人名扬天下。
The stag’s hide is worth ten times that of a normal stag. It can be tanned and crafted by a skilled worker into very rare, magical, leather armor. The stag had healing blood. Its greatest value is probably as a trophy capable of making a hunter globally famous.

陡峭的岩坡在顶端几乎变成垂直的绝壁。断崖向外层层起伏，宛如巨人垂下的一整片帷幕；不同颜色的岩层交叠其间，更加深了这份错觉。它虽略有几分秀丽，却对大多数不会飞的生物而言，是一道无法逾越的屏障。
The steep slope of rock becomes nearly vertical at the top. The escarpment ripples outward like a titanic set of curtains, an impression enhanced by layers of differently colored rock. Though somewhat pretty, it forms an impassible barrier to most creatures unable to fly.

烟雾从火坑里的灰烬中袅袅升起，离几步远处搭着一座用新砍下的小树树干支起的简易棚。有人从周围的丛林里采来宽大的棕榈叶，层层铺在枝条编成的格架上做成屋顶——让棚下的空间相对保持干燥。
Smoke rises from the ashes in a firepit a few steps from a lean-to built from the trunks of small, fresh-cut trees. Someone collected broad palm fronds from the surrounding jungle and layered them across a lattice of sticks to make a roof—keeping the space under it relatively dry.

一座钟楼高耸在这座建筑的高墙之上，同时兼作瞭望塔。尽管修道院没有城堡那样的垛口，墙体却同样厚实，且顶部伸出带有悬挑射孔的挑檐。你所见唯一的入口，是一扇镶着铁箍的门，深嵌在阴沉的瓮城之中。
A belltower stands tall above the high walls of this structure, serving the double purpose of watchtower. Though the abbey lacks a castle’s crenellations, its walls appear to be just as thick and have overhanging machicolations. The only entrance you see is an iron-banded door nestled in a brooding barbican.

Corporate Flagship: Bridge.name:
企业旗舰：舰桥
Corporate Flagship: Bridge

Text.text:
这座辽阔的指挥舰桥里，一切都冰冷而临床化——包括船员。流线型的黑色控制台占据了整个空间，衣着笔挺的军官以机器人般的企业效率执行各项任务。这里的科技是最尖端的，船员也是钱所能买到的最精锐之选——可即便如此，漂浮在宇宙最黑暗边陲的荒凉残骸，都比这艘舰船更有灵魂。
Everything about the vast command bridge is cold and clinical, including the crew. Sleek black consoles dominate the room, and sharply dressed officers carry out tasks with robotic corporate efficiency. The technology is state of the art, the crew the best money can buy—yet desolate hulks floating in the darkest reaches of the cosmos have more soul than this vessel.

Wild Magic Surge: Mage's Edge.name:
狂野魔法涌动：法师之锋
Wild Magic Surge: Mage's Edge

Text.text:
魔法在你体内肆意奔涌，令你胆气大增，也印证了你施法的老练。它带来一阵沉钝的自信脉动，仿佛你想象中受雇的打手在赚得盆满钵满的一周末尾会有的感觉。凭着这份被抬升的笃定，你希望——不，你确信——你的敌人绝不会轻易将你的法术耸肩甩开。
Magic courses through you with abandon, emboldening you and affirming your casting prowess. It imparts a dull throb of assurance, like you imagine hired muscle might feel at the end of a lucrative week. With this augmented confidence, you hope—nay, sense—that your foes will not easily shrug off your spells.

最先传来的是声音：像木棍相互敲击的咔哒声。那具形体的魔法丝线——在锈蚀、陈旧的护甲重压下，勉强把骨头牵在一起——一条腿一条腿地抬起，身躯摇晃着维持平衡。纯白骨质的空洞眼眶直视前方，下颌颤抖，仿佛亡者在无声地说话。那颗抖动怪物的坚硬头骨缓缓转动，注意力一点点移向你。它像是忽然获得了新生般猛扑而来，手中举起锈蚀的钢铁，蓄势待击。 [Defeated] 你对它躯壳的最后一击，让一根根骨头像被弹簧弹开般旋转着飞散——不再被黑暗魔法束缚在一起。 It’s heard first: a sound like sticks clacking together. The form’s magical strings—barely holding the bones together under the weight of rusted, aged armor—lift the legs one at a time, body swaying for balance. Hollow eye sockets of pure white bone stare forward and the jaw jitters as if the dead are speaking with no words. The solid skull of the shaking horror slowly turns, shifting its attention toward you. With seemingly new life it rushes at you, raising rusted steel in hand, ready to strike. [Defeated] The final blow to its frame sends individual bones spiraling through the air as if a spring had been sprung—no longer held together by dark magic.

I Cast Void Sphere.name:
我施放虚空之球
I Cast Void Sphere

Text.text:
我低声吐出咒词，召来群星之间的一处虚无——光与生命的湮灭者。指尖间，我捻动一缕来自缚灵的灵质；那幽冷的物质在指腹下崩散成尘，伴着一声轻柔的“啵”，一颗彻底的黑暗之球骤然迸现。 [移动球体] 我凝神专注，球体便按我所选的方向与距离滑行而去。 [法术终止] 球体无声塌缩。空气泛起涟漪。毁灭性的力浪向外奔涌，扭曲并撕裂它所触及的一切。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

I utter the words that invoke a void between the stars, an annihilator of light and life. In my fingers, I roll ectoplasm from a wraith, and as that ghostly material disintegrates, a sphere of utter darkness erupts into being with a soft pop. [Moving the Sphere] I focus, and the sphere moves the direction and distance I choose. [The Spell Ends] The sphere collapses with nary a noise. The air ripples. Waves of devastating force surge out, distorting and tearing whatever they strike.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

阳光在平静的湖面上粼粼闪烁。夹在湖岸与林线之间，一间不大却结实的原木小屋矗立着。烟雾从烟囱里袅袅升起。屋外，一把斧头搁在木制劈柴墩上。一座遮顶的棚屋里收着钓线与鱼饵、渔网，还有各式各样、大小不一的木工工具。
The sun glistens on the placid surface of the lake. Tucked between the lake's edge and the tree line, a small but sturdy cabin of timbers stands. Smoke curls from the chimney. Outside, an axe rests atop a wooden chopping block. A covered shed houses fishing lines and lures, nets, and woodworking tools of all shapes and sizes.

Panic Room In A Manor.name:
庄园里的避难密室
Panic Room In A Manor

Text.text:
这间隐秘的密室藏在宅邸偏远长厅的一座书柜之后。两道锁——一道沉重的钢锁，另一道铜锁且带着魔法气息——守护着躲藏其中的一切。密室里备满各类补给，整齐地陈列在沿墙而设的架子上：口粮、净水、肥皂与杂物。一侧墙前摆着一排行军床与干净的寝具，占据了大半空间；另一侧则放着一对巨大的上锁箱匣，每只都装着武器与加衬的衣物。其中一张行军床下还暗藏一扇钢制舱门，通往宅邸更深的地基处；一条地下隧道自此延伸，若最坏的情况降临，便可通向安全之地。
The secluded chamber lies concealed behind a book case in a far-flung hall of the manor. A pair of locks—one heavy steel, the other copper and magical in nature—protect any hiding within. The chamber is well stocked with provisions of all kinds, all neatly organized in shelves lining the walls—rations, clean water, soap, sundries. A set of cots and clean bedding dominate one wall, while the other contains a large pair of lockboxes, each containing weapons and padded clothing. A steel hatch, hidden beneath one cot, leads deeper into the foundations of the manor, where a subterranean tunnel leads to safety, should the worst arise.

Potion Of Storm Giant Strength.name:
风暴巨人力量药水
Potion Of Storm Giant Strength

Text.text:
深蓝色的液体在华丽的水晶瓶中晃荡，流光里夹杂着闪亮的银与金。那液体仿佛被低沉的能量嗡鸣所充盈，柔和的辉光忽明忽暗，细小的电叉在其中起舞。握住瓶身会让人的头发根根竖起，而拔开瓶塞时，则会逸出一股带电臭氧的鲜明气味。

~ 由 Battersby 构想

A dark-blue liquid sloshes in the ornate crystal bottle, streaked with gleaming silver and gold. The liquid seems charged with a thrumming energy, and the soft glow of it flickers as tiny forks of lightning dance within. Holding the bottle causes one’s hair to stand on end, and uncorking it emits the distinct smell of charged ozone.

~ Envisioned by Battersby

当你完成法术时，悬浮在空中的那点光猛然向外膨胀，化作一颗噼啪作响、如人般高的火焰球体。你在心中接管它的控制权，摸索着如何驱使它行动，那团烈焰便试探性地滚出一个小小的圆圈。
As you complete the spell the point of light hovering in the air balloons outward into a crackling sphere of fire as tall as a man. The ball of flames rolls in a little experimental circle as you mentally take control and come to grips with how to move it about.

山丘之巅的高塔已成废墟，曾构成其高耸陡峭塔墙的石块四散于四野。崩塌的墙体为你遮挡些许风势，但疾风仍从开裂的砖缝间尖啸穿过。地面上一道裂隙撕开地板，脚下高低不平，间或有潮湿冰冷的空气从中猛然涌出。一扇活板门的木料龟裂霉朽，想必通往这座残塔更低的楼层。
The tower atop the hill lies in ruin, the stones that once comprised its soaring, sheer walls scattered across the landscape. The crumbling walls provide some shelter from the wind, though it still whistles through the cracked bricks. A fissure in the floor creates uneven footing, and dank, cold air occasionally emits from it in a rush. A trapdoor, its wood cracked and moldering, presumably leads to the lower levels of the ruined tower.

冰川上那道巨大的窟窿，像极了村里的水井，让人几乎能想象巨人一边许愿，一边把钱币抛进它深处。然而这圆形洞穴并非为取水而凿——它是水流的杰作，日复一日缓慢啮咬，向冰川底部一点点掏空前行。冰臼那结冰的深处深浅难测；无光的幽暗在你面前张开深渊般的大口，仿佛要将你整个人吞没。
The enormous hole in the glacier so resembles a village well that one could imagine giants tossing coins into its depths while making a wish. But the circular hole was not dug for water—it's the result of the water’s flow, slowly gouging its way toward the glacier’s base. The icy depths of the moulin are impossible to gauge. Its lightless pitch yawns before you as if to devour you whole.

Bard Failing At Romantic Poetry.name:
吟游诗人写情诗翻车
Bard Failing At Romantic Poetry

Text.text:
吟游诗人用拳头轻叩胸口，深情款款地献上一首发自肺腑的诗：“你的眼睛清澈明亮，像夜里的星光。你的颧骨结实又圆润，像苹果——不是被鸟啄过的那种，是那种漂亮的……我……还要阐述——”他们真挚的神情与乏味的演绎相映成趣，让这串欠考虑的拙劣押韵显得更加尴尬。
The bard raps their fist against their chest and delivers a passionate poem straight from the heart: “Your eyes are clear and bright, like the stars at night. Your cheekbones, firm and round, like apples— Not the ones the birds have got at, but the nice ones… I… do expound—” Their earnest expression and bland performance make their poorly advised rhymes all the more embarrassing.

疤痕在这名男子的绿皮肤上勾勒出图案：从左眉延至面颊的一道醒目长痕，与他鼻梁上一条猩红色的线并行；额头上又有两道V形纹作为陪衬。毛皮披肩点缀着他宽松的装束——束腰短袍、外罩长衣与鼓胀长裤。臂上套着骨质鳞甲护腕，遮住沿手臂向上争斗般盘旋的蛇形纹身尾端。他双肩后展，一脚前踏，金色眼眸微微眯起，手中一根光滑长杖已然就位。

~ Played by Jake

Scars pattern this man’s green skin. From his left brow to cheek, a prominent stripe parallels a scarlet line on his nose, flanked by two chevrons on his forehead. A fur mantle accents his loose outfit of tunic, tabard, and blousy trousers. Bracers of bone lamellar cover the tails of serpent tattoos dueling up his arms. He stands with shoulders back, one foot forward, and golden eyes slightly narrowed. A smooth staff he holds ready.

~ Played by Jake

这些兽人身上有一种力量与宁静的气息；他们的身高大多在八码左右起伏，强壮的臂膀与背肌足以轻松举起船桅的横杆。他们的肤色从晴朗日光下平静海面的青蓝，延伸到风暴渐起时水面的黯淡灰蓝。蓝绿色的长发披散垂落，或向后束起，编成无数辫束。他们的黑眸幽深发亮，仿佛随时都会倾泻出某种巨大情绪——直到怒意开始翻涌。那黑色眼底，亮白的纹路如雷云中的闪电般骤然迸现，泄露出一股不可避免、势不可挡的狂怒。

~ 构想：Vahlaron

There is a sense of strength and tranquility about these orcs, whose heights all waver around eight feet and whose strong arms and backs could lift ships’ spars with ease. Their skin tones range from the teal of an ocean under a calm, sunny sky to the muted gray-blue of water under a growing storm. Tresses of blue-green hair are worn long or tied back in myriad braids. Their dark eyes glisten as if they are always on the verge of expelling some great emotion—until anger begins to stir. Within their black eyes, veins of bright white flash like lightning in a thundercloud, betraying an inevitable and powerful rage.

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

这是一片铺着瓷砖、管道老朽的狭长空间，只比走廊宽出一点。一面墙上排着一列小便池与马桶，隔在摇摇欲坠的金属隔间里；对面的墙则是一排洗手池。每天，杂役都会用魔法抹去褪色陶瓷墙面上绵延如数里的涂鸦；而每天，新的涂鸦又会回来，沿着瓷砖爬行，或原地兜圈，闪着微光，或像渗血般淌开。有些字句是数学推导，甚至深奥；有些令人作呕；还有些又蠢又刻薄。
This is a long space of tile and aged plumbing, little wider than a hallway. One wall is a row of urinals and toilets in flimsy metal booths, and the opposite wall is a row of sinks. Every day the porter magically removes the miles of graffiti on the faded ceramic walls, and every day new graffiti returns, crawling along the tiles or turning in circles, sparkling or bleeding. Some of the writing is mathematical, even profound, some disgusting, and some dumb and mean.

Diary Of The Geomancer Savant.name:
《地占贤者日记》
Diary Of The Geomancer Savant

Text.text:
这本小巧、皮面硬挺的日记里，写满了一位年轻法师的沉思——他在青春期的躁动与迷惘中，偶然触及了几分地脉术的秘辛。涂鸦与大量矫情的自白之间，仍藏着受灵感点燃的发现，静静伏在字里行间——只等那些足够耐心的人将它们掘出。
This small, hide-bound journal holds the ruminations of a young wizard who stumbled upon some secrets of geomancy while still in the throes of pubescence. Amidst the doodles and many melodramatic asides, inspired discoveries lay nestled within these pages—for those patient enough to unearth them.

口中燃起的烈焰，向那空洞的眼窝吹入地狱般的生命。凝滞的张口化作针牙般的狞笑，捕食者在瞥见猎物时欣喜若狂。石质双翼自头颅两侧张开，遍布深邃裂纹，仿佛失血的血管般蜿蜒其上。
A blaze alight in the mouth breathes infernal life into hollowed eyes. The static gape is a needle-toothed smile, a predator overjoyed at the sight of prey. Stone wings spread out from either side of the head, run through with deep cracks like veins bereft of blood.

这只生物的病态灰皮紧绷地覆在鸟类般的骨架上，蝠翼贴伏身侧，在昏暗中潜猎，细小的眼珠四下搜寻猎物。它是鸟、蜥蜴与蝙蝠拼缀而成的反常奇美拉，怪诞的造物，看起来倒也无害——除了从它的喙间不断滴落的毒涎。
Sickly gray skin is stretched taut over the avian frame of this creature, its batlike wings tucked to its side as it hunts in the gloom, beady eyes searching for prey. An unnatural chimera of bird, lizard, and bat, this is an odd creation, though it seems harmless enough—except for the venom drooling from its beak.

Half-elf Rogue.name:
半精灵游荡者
Half-elf Rogue

Text.text:
男人幽白如鬼的面孔从他深色贴身的护甲中突兀地浮现出来，颧骨与眉骨霜白如冻。眼下两抹紫青的阴影沉沉压着，让那本就冰冷的目光更显空洞无情。他的嘴也泄露不出半分情绪，只是僵硬地抿成一条细线，仿佛被冻结。那双修长耳尖——唯一能看出他精灵族裔的痕迹——微微下垂，苍白的皮肤在末端渐渐晕成风暴般的灰。身形轻灵，寂静得近乎死亡，他行动时像一只寻觅阴影的猫，敏捷而无声。
The man’s ghostly pale face stands out from his dark, form-fitting armor, his cheekbones and brow white as frost. Purple bags under his eyes weigh down an already cold gaze, bereft of feeling. His mouth betrays no emotion either, for he keeps it frozen shut in a thin line. The ends of his long ears—the only hint of his elven ancestry—droop slightly, the pale skin darkening to a stormy gray. Lithe of frame and deathly quiet, he moves with the deftness of a cat seeking shadow.

你们来到一排蘑菇伞盖前，它们宽得像地表马车的车轮。红褐色的菌肉橡胶般富有弹性，皱褶纵横，边缘垂着一圈柔软、蕾丝似的苔藓。你听见一阵低沉的橡皮摩擦声，其中一顶菌盖开始蠕动。移动引得伞盖内部骤然涌出一束光——淡蓝色的生物荧光。菌盖缓缓抬起，露出下方发光的菌柄。一张被挤扁的脸——额头与五官都被菌盖的重量压得沉甸甸——用纽扣般的眼睛盯着你。它的脸裂开，露出一张无牙的嘴和灰色的舌头，随即用一种轻柔、吱吱作响的语言开口说话。那声音正是先前的橡皮声，只是此刻更清晰了。

~ Envisioned by Macen Kraft

You come upon a series of mushroom caps, as wide as topside wagon wheels. The reddish-brown flesh is rubbery and wrinkled, with a soft lacelike moss draping around their edges. You hear a low, rubbery sound as one of the mushroom caps begins to wriggle. The movement elicits a surge of light from within—the light blue glow of bioluminescence. The cap rises, revealing the glowing stalk underneath. A squished face—brow and features heavy with the weight of its cap—regards you with buttonlike eyes. Its face splits to reveal a toothless mouth with a gray tongue, and it speaks in a soft-toned, squeaking language. It’s the same rubbery sound from before, heard clearer now.

~ Envisioned by Macen Kraft

Failed Lich Ritual.name:
巫妖仪式失败
Failed Lich Ritual

Text.text:
命匣砰然坠地，发出一声脆裂的咔嚓；其中的精髓嘶嘶外泄，伴着尖厉的啸叫。巫师噎在喉间的惊骇里眼睁睁看着，哪怕灵魂正化作稀薄的空气消散，他的身体仍在徒劳运转——泪水、汗珠、颤抖、急促的喘息。灰败的色泽爬上他的脸，神情在那令人不安的张口凝滞中彻底冻结。一阵残忍的笑声劈开空气——仿佛从房间的每一处阴影里同时传来——命匣的余骸随之爆碎。灵魂精髓与玻璃碎片汇聚到一处，倏然一闪，便从世上抹去。“你现在是我的了。”一个低沉、凶险的声音说道，源头暂时无从辨认。巫师的衣物、头发与皮肤被瞬间从骨头上剥离，如同被狂风扯走的一张薄布。留下的是一具沾着新鲜血点的骷髅之躯，双臂尽头长成巨大的骨爪，抽搐时咔哒咔哒敲击地面。每根指骨末端都挂着酒红色的血光，湿亮刺目。尘土与烟雾从仪式地面升起，散发铁锈与灰烬的恶臭，像披风般覆在这具新生、战栗的形体上。它那永恒咧开的牙间，抖出一串令人发寒的、兴奋过头的咯咯轻笑。它抬起头来，空洞的眼眶宛如两口虚无深渊，彻底不含一丝生机。

~ Envisioned by MadCar

The phylactery falls to the floor with a crunch, the essence within leaking out with a hiss and a shriek. The wizard looks on in choked horror, the basic functions of his body—tears, sweat, shaking, gasps—still active even as his soul dissipates into thin air. A gray hue settles over his face as his expression freezes in that unsettling gape. A cruel laugh cuts through the air—seemingly coming from every shadow of the room—and the rest of the phylactery shatters. The soul-essence and glass shards converge and blink out of existence. "You're mine, now," says a low, menacing voice whose origin is, for now, uncertain. The wizard's clothes, hair and skin are flayed from his bones as swiftly as a sheet taken by a fierce wind. What's left is a skeletal form dotted with fresh blood, its arms ending in massive bony claws that clack against the floor as they twitch. Blood the color of wine glistens at the end of each finger. Dust and smoke lift up from the ritual ground, stinking of iron and ash, and drape over this new, trembling form like a cloak. An uncomfortably giddy chuckle trills out from between its perpetually grinning teeth. It lifts its head, the cavernous eyes a pair of voids totally bereft of life.

~ Envisioned by MadCar

Inside The Omniphone.name:
全音电话机内部
Inside The Omniphone

Text.text:
塔内只有一间密室，四壁光滑无饰，室中却盘踞着一张金属号角编成的巨网。管道彼此纠缠，蜿蜒向上攀升。点点阳光穿过黄铜穹顶的缝隙，如同群星刺破阴云的长夜。潮湿裹住空气，又被烈日炙烤外墙的热度压得更沉。你闻到号角散出的金属腥味、湿石的霉冷气息，还有一股陈旧的硫磺臭，来源却一时难以辨明。地面中央有一汪圆形水池，直径约四英尺，水面微光闪烁。你听见水轻轻拍打石沿的声响——以及……低语？
Within the tower, the single chamber of smooth, featureless walls houses a web of metal horns. The pipes tangle about each other as they wind upward. Pinpricks of sunlight peak through the brass canopy like stars breaching a clouded night. Humidity cloaks the air, made heavier by the heat of the sun baking the outside walls. You smell a metallic tang from the horns, the dank scent of wet stone, and a stale, sulfuric odor you cannot quite place. A circular pool of water about four feet in diameter glimmers in the center of the floor. You hear the waters lap gently against the stone and… whispers?

Geoglyph Of A Winged Cat On The Hillside.name:
山坡上的翼猫地画
Geoglyph Of A Winged Cat On The Hillside

Text.text:
近看时，它们不过像是一圈圈令人困惑的古老小径——刻意踩踏、岁月磨蚀——通往无关紧要的空处。然而从远处望去，山坡上的线条骤然显露出它们真正的面目：一只轮廓巨大、猫科身形分明、背负硕大鹰翼的形状。是谁在此刻下这道图形？又意欲何为？图中描绘的生物是本地物种？某位古老的神祇？还是全然不同的存在？
Up close, they look like nothing more than confusingly looped footpaths—ancient and deliberately worn—leading nowhere in particular. But from a distance, the lines on the hillside stand out for what they truly are: the massive outline of a shape clearly feline in form sporting enormous eagle wings. Who left this carved shape here? To what purpose? Is the creature portrayed a native species? An ancient deity? Or something else altogether?

I Program My Robot.name:
我为我的机器人编程
I Program My Robot

Text.text:
我机器人的光学镜片是两颗幽暗、映光的圆球，它一动不动地坐在我的工作台旁。数据流在笔记本屏幕上飞掠而过，我的手指在那套磨得发亮的键盘上飞舞，输入全新的编程代码。一根编织线缆如蛇般从我的设备蜿蜒到我合成同伴的接口处；上传完成的瞬间，它伴着一声嗡鸣的清脆提示音亮起电源。
The optic lenses of my robot are dark, reflective orbs as it sits motionless by my workbench. Data streams across the screen of my laptop, while my fingers dance over the well-used keys, inputting the new programming code. A braided cable snakes from my device to a port in my synthetic companion, which powers on with a whirring chime as the upload completes.

One-eyed Deity With Ravens.name:
独眼神祇与乌鸦同行
One-eyed Deity With Ravens

Text.text:
在平凡尘世之中，伫立着一位神秘非凡的人影。身披硬化皮甲，外罩熊皮斗篷，他们的剪影兼具力量与智慧。银霜般的长发以华丽的缠结倾泻而下，勾勒出一张刻着不朽睿智的面容。他们的存在散发着远古魔法的气息，令所有与之遭遇者都不由自主地投去目光；仅存的一只眼闪烁着异界的见识，而缺失的那只眼，则是牺牲的预兆。
In the midst of the mundane stands a figure of extraordinary mysticism. Garbed in cuir-bouilli and cloaked in bearskin, their silhouette embodies both strength and wisdom. Long, silvered hair cascades in ornate tangles, framing a visage stamped with ageless acumen. Their presence exudes an aura of ancient magic, drawing the gaze of all who encounter them, their single eye shimmering with otherworldly knowledge, their missing eye a portent of sacrifice.

I Blow My Horn Of Blasting.name:
我吹响毁灭号角
I Blow My Horn Of Blasting

Text.text: 即便冒着自身粉碎、也可能把我一并拖向终局的风险，这只号角仍渴望被吹响。它的狮首被雄浑鬃毛环绕，缠裹的号身以奔涌的艳色铸成。狮口大张，獠牙尽露。整件乐器的一切造型，都在为喷吐出一束震耳欲聋、冲击裂骨的毁灭锥形波而生。我对着号角吼出一个字，只透过它吹出一个音符——狮子便咆哮起来。 Even at risk of its own shattering, and my possible end, the horn wants to sound. Its lion’s head, wreathed in a great mane, and its wrapped stem are crafted in energetic colors. The mouth opens wide, displaying its teeth. Everything about the instrument is formed to issue a deafening, concussive cone of destruction. I bark just one word at the horn, sound just one note through it. And the lion roars.

The Cold Cook.name:
冷灶厨娘
The Cold Cook

Text.text:
紫灰色的皮肤紧紧裹在瘦长的骨架上，种种法术留下的疤痕愈合不良，沿着它的身躯蜿蜒纵横。冰冷的乳蓝色眼珠在审视的眉弓下鼓胀突出。那生物用陌生的语言低声咕哝，随即离地悬浮，长袍与华饰翻卷鼓荡。碎屑与残渣被拽入这道违逆重力的法术，化作绕它旋转的尘环。

~ 由一位英雄扮演

Purple-gray skin is bound tightly over lanky bones and poorly healed scars from various magics run ragged along their body. Cold, milky-blue eyes bulge from under a discerning brow. The creature mutters in their strange tongue and begins to levitate off the ground, robes and regalia billowing. Bits of debris orbit around them as the refuse is pulled into the gravity-defying spell.

~ Played by a Hero

你伸手一指，炽烈夺目的强光轰然爆裂，刹那间向外扩散。被这纯粹日光吞没者尽受其害：有人踉跄后退，肌肤被灼得焦痛，抬臂遮眼；也有人当场消失，随着净化之光外涌而化作飞灰，继而光芒渐褪。
You point, and light blazes in a searing, brilliant flash, spreading outward in an instant. Those caught in the burst of pure sunlight suffer its effects: some stumble back, flesh searing, shielding their eyes; others disappear entirely, disintegrating into ash as the cleansing light spreads outward, then fades.

Scouting Agent Of The Night Blade.name:
夜刃斥候特工
Scouting Agent Of The Night Blade

Text.text:
女人用肩膀顶住石墙。几缕金发从她朴素的棕色兜帽下斜斜甩出，上方的光线照亮了她鹰隼般锐利目光的一半。她将一只手臂抬到身后，手臂的剪影在墙上定格，向黑暗中的某人打出手势：退后，藏好，别露面。
The woman presses her shoulder against the stone wall. Wisps of blond hair slash out from under her plain brown hood, half of her eagle-eyed stare illuminated by the light above her. A silhouette of her arm is held up behind her, signaling to someone in the darkness to stay back, out of sight.

铂金丝饰穿梭于金色符文与面具般的象征之间，沿着这柄奢华战矛的水晶矛杆蜿蜒铺陈。那细密的纹路与战矛的铂金矛头相接，仿佛纤巧的装饰丝线与矛锋原本便是一体。矛刃上亦点缀着与矛柄同样的金色卷草花纹。 [Wielded] 战矛散发出幽魂般的微光。 [Activated] 与战矛光芒同色的阴森灵体自武器中汹涌迸出，腾空飞旋，环绕持用者盘桓。

~ Envisioned by ArielleVB

Platinum filigree weaves amid the gold runes and masklike symbols lining the crystalline shaft of this opulent battle spear. The tracery joins with the spear’s platinum head, as if the fine, decorative threads and it are one piece. Gold flourishes like those on the haft decorate the blade. [Wielded] The spear emits a ghostly glow. [Activated] Sinister spirits that match the spear’s glow surge from the weapon and fly about, orbiting the wielder.

~ Envisioned by ArielleVB

Great Hall Of A Creepy Manor.name:
阴森庄园的大礼堂
Great Hall Of A Creepy Manor

Text.text:
尽管如此体型的大厅通常用于盛大的集会或庆典时刻，那呼啸的寒意却将你的思绪拽向残酷行径、黑暗仪式与亲密背叛。因为此地潜伏着一种黑暗，火把的光也无法将其驱散；一种刺骨的寒气，连皮裘也无法削减分毫。
Though a hall this size would usually be used for great gatherings or times of celebration, the whistling chill turns your thoughts to acts of cruelty, dark rituals, and intimate betrayals. For there is a darkness in this place not mitigated by torchlight, an icy air that cannot be diminished by furs.

Harried Police Force Captain.name:
焦头烂额的警队队长
Harried Police Force Captain

Text.text:
警官重重踏入现场，目光在四面八方飞快扫视，将一切尽收眼底。他们动作仓促；若那歪斜的帽子与衬衫正一点点从裤腰滑出能说明什么，那就是他们已经匆匆忙忙了好一阵子。“局长要一份报告，各位！”他们朝着空气咆哮，仿佛并非对谁特定发火。随即一把抓住离自己最近那名警员的胳膊。“给我弄杯咖啡，行吗？”
The police officer stomps onto the scene, eyes darting every direction as they take everything in. Their motions are rushed, and if the skewed hat and shirt slowly coming untucked are any evidence, they’ve been in a rush for quite some time. "The chief needs a report, people!" they bellow to nobody in particular. They grab the arm of the officer closest to them. "Get me some coffee, would you?"

[城外] 这座建筑瑰宝依傍一条宽阔大河而建，外墙以泥砖砌就，釉色如青金石般惊艳湛蓝。河水蓝绿交织，将城市一分为二，形成两片绵延不绝的城区。被阳光烤得发白的泥土房舍上，绿意如冠：树木与灌木垂覆在步道之上，为灼人的酷热投下阴影。芦苇扎成的小船在流入城中的河面上轻轻起伏，载着货物自周遭浩瀚沙海而来，将这片绿洲与无尽干旱的沙丘、赤红群山相连。

[城内] 细窄的引水渠自河中引出，分叉伸入城的两侧，滋养几乎每一栋建筑顶端的葱郁植被。走在这些土路上，仿佛踏入一座永不凋谢的花园；不同身份、文化与阶层的人们在片片阴凉之间穿梭奔忙。一队劳工沿街小跑，草鞋拍打尘土，朴素短袍被汗水浸透。一个身披轻薄淡紫长袍的男人朝他们吆喝，催他们保持速度。他浓密的胡须编入金色钱币，涂了油，闪亮而带着香气。工人们咬牙前行，拖着疲惫的队伍朝远处一座高塔奔去。塔身六层拔地而起，高得令人目眩——近乎神祇的高度——而第七层也正被一点一点、却坚定不移地加建上去。

[Outside the city] This architectural jewel is built upon the banks of a wide river, the outer walls of clay brick glazed the stunning blue of lapis lazuli. The river’s blue-green waters divide the city in half, making two sprawling districts. Sun-soaked clay buildings are crested with foliage, trees and shrubs hanging over walkways to offer shade from the intense heat. Reed-bound boats bob along the surface of the river flowing into the city, bearing goods to this oasis from across the vast surrounding desert—endless, arid stretches of sand and red mountains.

[Inside the city] Thin aqueducts run from the river, branching into both sides of the city, feeding the foliage that crests nearly every building. Walking these dirt streets is like walking through a perpetual garden, full of people of varying stations, cultures, and classes bustling between the pockets of shade. A line of laborers jogs along the street, sandals slapping against the dirt, plain tunics soaked in sweat. A man wearing a robe of light, lavender-colored fabric shouts at them to keep their pace. His full beard has been braided with golden coins, and made shining and fragrant with oil. The workers press on, turning their haggard train toward a looming tower in the distance. Its six tiers stretch to marvelous heights—godly heights—and a seventh tier is slowly but surely being added.

Death Of A Pantheon.name:
万神殿的陨落
Death Of A Pantheon

Text.text:
在他们的山巅王座动荡倾覆之后，在丛林中的神龛被遗弃、在城市里的神龛被焚毁之后；在追随者悔弃信仰、半裸着倒毙街头、发热般挥舞圣刃之后；当失望的全部混乱化作战争与饥荒显形之时：便迎来一个没有神殿的清晨的寂静。映着星云虹彩般的背景，神祇漂浮着——结伴却孤独——再无可惩戒或可鼓舞之人，他们双手摊开，向缺席作徒然的祈求。他们身负异端施加的创痕，肋骨因饥饿而清晰可见。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

After the upheaval of their mountain thrones, the abandoning of shrines in the jungles and the burning of shrines in the cities; after the followers recant faith and die in the streets, half naked and feverishly wielding holy blades; when all the chaos of lost hope appears in war and famine: then comes the quiet of a morning without temples. Against the iridescent backdrop of a nebula the gods float—together but alone—with no one left to punish or inspire, their hands spread in petition to absence. They bear scars from wounds of heretical infliction, and their ribcages are visible from starvation.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

当你终于看穿那些模仿的嗓音与幻象时，这生物的真形已赤裸呈现。就在她从你的视野中，在一阵闪烁的妖精魔法微光里淡去之前，一抹邪恶而淫亵的狞笑掠过这鬼婆腐臭的面容。
When you finally see through the mimicked voices and illusions, the true form of the creature is laid plain. An evil, lascivious grin crosses the hag's putrid features just before she fades from your view in a glimmering of fey magic.

Sundries From A Nixie.name:
来自水精灵的小玩意
Sundries From A Nixie

Text.text:
水精灵那双祖母绿般的眼睛，光泽已被死亡夺走，依旧睁得很大，毫不眨动。你在它身上只找到寥寥几样东西：一条河卵石脚链、一只装着泡烂水草的小袋子，以及一把朴素的刀——很可能是从某个大意的商人或冒险者那里顺手牵来的。锈蚀的刀刃与其说适合厮杀，不如说更像是用来采集、割取草药的工具。
The nixie’s emerald eyes, their luster stolen by death, remain wide and unblinking. You find only a few things on their person: a river-stone anklet, a pouch of waterlogged weeds, and a simple knife that could have been stolen from an unwary merchant or adventurer. The rusted blade seems better suited for collecting and cutting herbs than combat.

鱼腥味会黏在你的手上，但远不及那一瞬更令人不安——你的手指短暂地失了骨头，化作漆黑带吸盘的东西，扭动、翻搅。回应你的手势，多元宇宙某个幽暗的角落也回以挥动：粗壮的乌黑触手自地面爆裂般涌出，伸出触及，攫住并碾碎所能抓到的一切。
The stink of fish will cling to your hand, but that’s not nearly as disturbing as the moment when your fingers briefly go boneless and become black suckered things that wriggle and writhe. In answer to your gesture, some dark part of the multiverse waves back as muscular ebony tentacles erupt from the ground to grasp and crush anything in their reach.

The Eye Of Fairfax.name:
费尔法克斯之眼
The Eye Of Fairfax

Text.text:
那段悠长的传说，既无人证实也无人证伪：老费尔法克斯·戈德温-亚德利其实是一条化作人形的巨龙。费尔法克斯将自己的眼睛遗赠给了学院。它更像人类的眼睛而非龙瞳，却足有二十英寸直径；银蓝色的魔法脉络自繁星般漆黑的瞳心旋卷而出。另一个传说则说，任何能把这只眼睛变回龙瞳的人，都会将费尔法克斯从坟墓里召回。那颗眼球之球体漂浮在龙之学舍，在那里协助学生练习扫帚飞行。
The long legend, neither proven nor disproven, is that old Fairfax Godwin-Yardley was actually a dragon who took human form. Fairfax willed his eye to the academy. It is human rather than draconic, but twenty inches in diameter, with silvery blue magical veins whirling off from a starry black center. Another legend says that anyone who can change the eye back to a dragon’s will summon Fairfax from the grave. The orb floats in House Dragon, where it assists students with broom practice.

尘土与泥浆结成厚痂，几乎裹满了这名男子的衣衫，唯有他的头部还算没怎么遭殃。额头上留着一道抹痕，是他抬手擦去汗水时蹭上的；而他惯常扛着铁锹的那侧肩头，则洇着一片深色污渍。除了常年眯起的眼与赖以为生的家伙什，他身上就只剩一支黏土烟斗，死死咬在发黄的牙齿间。
Dirt and mud cake much of this man’s clothes, leaving only his head relatively unscathed. His forehead bears a smudge from where he wiped sweat away, and the shoulder upon which he customarily carries a shovel has a dark stain. Besides a perpetual squint and the tool of his trade, all he has with him is a clay pipe clenched between yellow teeth.

I Use Astral Perception To Detect Basic.name:
我运用星界察觉来探知基础信息
I Use Astral Perception To Detect Basic Information

Text.text:
我的额心微微发痒。世界像被撕开一层薄纱，薄纱后的身影凝聚成游移的幽影。物质界那一张张空白的面孔之下，藏着某种东西，而我正是那个能看见的人。这个人喉咙感染；那个人满腹怨气。魔法能量在某些轮廓周围如故障般闪烁，显露出他们的灵性潜质。

~ 一位英雄所构想

The center of my forehead itches slightly. A veil is ripped from the world, and the figures within coalesce into shifting, ghostly shapes. There is something beneath the blank faces of the material realm, and I am the one to see. This figure has a throat infection; this one is grumpy. Magical energies flicker like glitches about certain shapes, revealing their spiritual potential.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

修长而雅致的芦苇在微风中摇曳，青翠的茎秆下，青蛙此起彼伏地啾鸣与呱叫。覆满藻类的水面上，苍蝇嗡嗡作响，像游离的云团般盘旋飘荡；潮湿的空气里，泥土的腥润气息浓得化不开。偶尔有气泡自水底细细冒起，在缓缓漂移的睡莲间跳跃——睡莲如同浮在水上的花园点缀着池塘，那是水下游鱼穿梭的微妙征兆。
Long, elegant reeds sway in the breeze as frogs chirp and croak beneath their verdant stalks. Flies buzz in meandering clouds above the algae-covered water, and a moist, earthy smell saturates the humid air. Bubbles occasionally trickle up from below to dance amid the drifting lilies adorning the pond like a floating garden, a subtle indication of the fish swimming beneath.

一柄巨斧被两条粗壮的绿色手臂轻松挥舞，那手臂连着一具魁梧的躯体，肌肉如铁铸般层层隆起，脊背与肩侧散落着弯曲的骨刺。它的两条粗腿踏在爬行类的脚掌上，末端是三根扭曲粗硬的趾爪。布满青筋的蝠翼垂挂在背后，暗示着尽管体型庞大，这生物仍能飞翔。两根又长又直的角自太阳穴处刺出，每侧还垂着一只带蹼的耳朵。伴随着野蛮的低吼，它向前逼近，动作却出奇地轻捷。
A colossal axe is wielded with ease by burly green arms attached to a bulky body lined with muscle and littered with curved spines. Its two wide legs stand atop reptilian feet ending in three gnarled toes. Veiny bat wings hang from its back, implying that despite its enormous size, this creature can fly. Two long straight horns sprout from its temples and a webbed ear hangs to the side of each. With a savage growl, it moves forward with surprising grace.

一间小棚屋立在河畔，倚着堤岸形成的温暖回湾。它的前门正对着一段短短的栈桥，伸入水流之上；烟囱里飘出带着烤鱼气味的炊烟。屋子周围满是靠河谋生的痕迹：挂起晾干的渔网，以及用来捉鳗鱼的篓筐。
A small shack stands beside the river in a cozy cul-de-sac of an embankment. Its front door faces a short jetty that juts out over the water’s flow, and smoke that smells of cooking fish wafts from its chimney. About it lie signs of someone who lives off the river’s bounty: nets hung to dry and baskets for trapping eels.

I Absorb A Spell With My Ioun Stone Of A.name:
我用吸收之艾欧石吸收了一道法术
I Absorb A Spell With My Ioun Stone Of Absorption

Text.text:
施法者念完咒语、将魔法送出时，我把那颗淡紫色的小石子抛到面前。它升至最高点——就在我头顶上方——便骤然停住，绕着我旋转，如一圈柔和怡人的光环。法术如期而至，可其中的魔法却向上弯折，朝那枚盘旋的石子汇去，随即消失无踪。旋舞的光圈微微黯淡，我一招手，让石子回到掌心。
As the caster ends the incantation and delivers the magic, I toss the little lavender stone in front of my face. When it reaches its apex, just above my head, it stops and circles around me like a soft, pleasant halo. The spell arrives, but its magic curves upward toward the circling stone and disappears. The whirling circle of light dims a bit, and I call the stone back to my hand.

Journal Of A Young Geomancer.name:
一位年轻地脉术士的日记
Journal Of A Young Geomancer

Text.text:
封面是两片板岩瓦，以铁制螺旋装订为脊。书页上满载记录与插图：符文书写与构造地图，以及源自远古洞窟的符号。早期一则条目写道：今日，经由缓慢冥想所生，我的第一枚河石悬起。凭我意志，它绕我头顶盘旋，警觉守望。于往后这些年，在大地的时代里，我将化为山岳与震荡，成为召唤陨星之人。
The cover is two tiles of slate with a iron coil spine. The pages carry entries and illustrations, runic script and tectonic maps, and symbols from ancient caves. One early entry reads: Today, born of slow meditation, hovered my first river stone. By my will it circled my head, vigilant. Over these next years, on earth time, I will become mountain and quake, the summoner of meteors.

Arlo Guillarme.name:
阿尔洛·吉亚尔姆
Arlo Guillarme

Text.text:
他戴着一张青铜面具，庄严而略带忧伤，光滑的表面仿佛背负着一段粗粝的过往。榛色的眼睛从开孔后映出。他举止谦卑，可他身上的钉甲与长袖软甲却剪裁成盗贼的风格，步伐鬼祟而警觉，甚至有种诡异的残酷。待他拔出一对短剑，裸露的手腕上便显出受刑留下的疤痕。

~ Played by HeliumHuffer101

The mask he wears is bronze, regal but a little sad, its smooth surface apparently burdened by a rough past. Hazel eyes show through the openings. He carries himself humbly, but his brigandine and full-sleeved gambeson are fit in a rogue’s style, and his walk is furtive, alert, even in some strange way cruel. When he draws his dual shortswords, his exposed wrists reveal the scars of torture.

~ Played by HeliumHuffer101

Haunted Castle: Sensing A Presence.name:
闹鬼城堡：感知到某个存在
Haunted Castle: Sensing A Presence

Text.text:
墙上的壁灯燃起非自然的狂烈火焰，将走廊与厅室切割出一片片凌厉的阴影。尽管你能感觉到额头渗汗、汗水顺着脊背淌下，一阵寒意仍猛然席卷全身。这座城堡也许早已被生者遗弃，但你能察觉仍有什么东西把这里当作家——并将你视作不速之客。
The sconces on the walls blaze with unnatural fury, casting stark shadows across the halls and chambers. Although you can feel sweat on your brow and dripping down your back, a chill sweeps over you. This castle might have been abandoned by the living, but you sense something still calls it home—and considers you an uninvited guest.

The Fight Pit.name:
搏斗深坑
The Fight Pit

Text.text:
你踏入一间穹隆般空旷的厅室，腐烂与败坏的恶臭迎面扑来，直冲鼻腔。四壁层层叠叠的阶梯状结构一览无遗；当你一路下行，踩进下方的沙地时，你才明白这些台阶的用途——那是座位，用来围观一幕幕骇人的血腥戏码在此上演。等待你的，会是怎样的噩梦？
The scent of rot and decay hits you as you step into a cavernous room with tiered walls. The purpose of the tiers—seats to watch macabre spectacles unfold—becomes apparent as you descend to the sands below. What nightmares await you?

这是残酷适应的铁证：你面前那名两栖类的人形生物蜷伏着，从蝌蚪一路蜕变成战士，毫不遮掩地展示着旅途中换来的累累伤疤。她张开的巨口像一只硕大的眼睛般拉伸，睫毛的位置是几截尖锐的骨刺，而喉咙深处那片幽黑空洞，扭曲得仿佛瞳孔的反面。战士粗厉的呱鸣如雷霆般的战书，直震到你骨髓深处。她挥舞着一根加固的浮木棍棒，披在身上的龟甲护甲将她牢牢包裹，她却显得从容自信。橘子般的眼睛死死盯住你们队伍里最强壮的那一个，随后像猿一般捶胸咆哮，点名要与对方单挑决斗。
A testament to ruthless adaptation, the amphibious humanoid crouched before you has grown from tadpole to warrior, openly displaying the scars earned along her journey. An oversized maw stretches like a great eye, with nubs of sharp bone in place of lashes and the cavernous blackness of her gullet a perversion of a pupil. The warrior's raucous croak is a staggering challenge that reaches the very marrow of your bones. She brandishes a club made of reinforced driftwood and seems confident enclosed in the tortoiseshell carapace worn as armor. Eyes like tangerines fixate on the strongest of your party, then with ape-like chest-banging she challenges them to single combat.

Weapon Implants Mounted In Hand.name:
手部嵌装武器
Weapon Implants Mounted In Hand

Text.text:
这只手看上去大多仍是血肉之躯，唯有掌心中央嵌着一圈碳纤维圆环。植入体仿佛一座微型熔炉，随时能喷吐烈焰、等离子，或其他致命的投射物。指尖已被替换，指纹被彻底剥去，指甲下方伏着可伸缩的剃刀刃。指节之上，一条金色的超强强化金属带被缝合在皮肉里。
The hand seems mostly flesh except for a carbon fiber circle in the center of the palm. The implant is like a mini furnace, ready to spit flames or plasma or some other deadly projectile. The tips of the fingers have been replaced, stripped of their fingerprints, with retractable razor blades lying beneath the fingernails. Across the knuckles, a strip of golden super-reinforced metal is sutured to the flesh.

Bloody Throne Room.name:
血腥王座厅
Bloody Throne Room

Text.text:
一扇厚重的加固门——竟意外半掩着——门把上黏着血。你轻轻一推，便撞见一幕骇人的景象：巨大的血斑溅满通往王座的地毯，血泊正缓慢渗入华贵的织物。空气沉甸甸地压在胸口，弥漫着令人作呕的甜腻气味，辛辣刺鼻，诡异得让人联想到红酒与腐肉。几幅间距匀称的挂毯中，有一幅被人粗暴地扯下，连同固定扣一并撕裂。是光影作祟，还是你真的看见挂毯下露出一双脚？你强迫自己移开视线，免得一脚踏进一滩嗡嗡作响的血液——苍蝇正围着它，寻找这顿可怖的盛宴。王座本身也已暗沉无光——猩红的斑块从某个伤口处泼洒开来，那伤势绝不可能不致命。
A heavy, reinforced door—unexpectedly ajar—its handle sticky with blood. A single push reveals the ghastly tableau: large spots of gore splashed on the rug leading to the throne, the puddles soaking slowly into the rich cloth. The air is thick with a sickly aroma, pungent and maddeningly reminiscent of red wine and spoiling meat. One of the regularly-spaced tapestries has been pulled down forcibly, ripped from its fastenings. Is it a trick of the light, or do you see feet beneath the it? You tear your gaze away to avoid stepping in a pool of vitae buzzing with flies seeking a grisly meal. The throne itself is dark—crimson patches spilled from a wound that could not have been anything but fatal.

Mountain Cottage Haunted By Dark Entity.name:
被黑暗实体盘踞的山间小屋
Mountain Cottage Haunted By Dark Entity

Text.text:
美丽的小屋坐落在高山深处如画的阿尔卑斯林间空地上。窗内透出壁炉与热食的橙色暖光，亲切地招呼着来客。雪花轻柔地覆在屋檐雕琢般的飞檐上，一缕炊烟从烟囱里懒散地打着旋儿飘起。然而，在空地边缘树影的遮蔽中，却有一道黑影徘徊不去，怨毒的双眼在昏暗里燃着猩红。它缓缓挺身至全高，那具骷髅般的生物伸出修长而阴狠的利爪，在近旁的树干上刻下不祥的印记——随即融入阴影之中。

~ DaveDaWanderer 于 Discord

The beautiful cottage resides in a picturesque alpine glade high in the mountains, its windows alight with the welcoming orange glow of a warm hearth and hot food. Snow settles gently on the sculpted eaves of the house as a wisp of smoke swirls lazily from the chimney. In the shadow of the trees at the edge of the glade, however, a dark shadow lingers, its hateful eyes burning red in the gloom. Rising to its full height, the skeletal creature carves a sinister mark into a nearby tree with long, wicked claws—and fades into the shadows.

~ DaveDaWanderer on Discord

School Of Sorcery.name:
魔法学院
School Of Sorcery

Text.text:
尽管这所秘法学院坐落在一片广阔、晶莹如琉璃的湖泊正中央，它却只设有一座码头——因为无论学生还是教职员，都不会用乘船这种过于凡俗的方式抵达。相反，主堡宽阔的屋顶迎接各式各样的空中来客——从狮鹫到扑翼机再到巨龙——而庭院里，一座传送法阵静静躺在一座古老日晷旁，那里是整座城堡唯一没有针对这种入侵方式设下结界的区域。高耸的城垛上并未安置人们想象中的箭孔、火炮或火油罐，取而代之的是一些怪异装置：由多彩透镜与管道构成，外覆奥术符印。再者，凡是稍懂建筑的学生都会以为城堡里该有一座礼拜堂，可他们看到的却是一座巨大的图书馆：书架层层叠叠，塞满无数书卷，既有用世上一切已知语言写就的巨著，也有更多无法辨识的文字。图书馆之上矗立着一座矮塔，悬着一口黄铜钟，整点必鸣；无论身在城堡何处，都能清晰听见其声，仿佛无视距离与墙壁。然而从未有人亲眼见过钟体真正摆动，也从未有人见过是谁在敲响它。
Although located in the very center of a wide, crystalline lake, the school of sorcery has only a single dock—since neither students nor faculty arrive by such prosaic means as boats. Instead, the wide roof of the keep allows for all manner of aerial visitors—from hippogriffs to ornithopters to dragons—and a teleport circle sits next to an ancient sundial in the courtyard, the only area not warded against such means of ingress. The high battlements do not house the archery slits, cannon, or fire pots one might expect, but strange devices making use of multicolored lenses and tubes, covered in arcane sigils. And where a reasonably knowledgeable student of architecture would expect to find a castle’s chapel, one instead finds a huge library, filled with shelves of countless books, tomes written in every language known to the world, and many more besides. Atop the library stands a short tower with a brass bell, which rings on the hour, inexplicably heard by all within the castle regardless of location. Yet no one has ever seen the bell actually move, nor has anyone been seen ringing it.

Serpentine Mummy Lord.name:
蛇形木乃伊领主
Serpentine Mummy Lord

Text.text:
干燥的鳞片刮擦着石面，蛇形木乃伊（特征）从坟冢中缓缓起身，破烂的黄色裹布松松垂落在瘦骨嶙峋的爬行躯体上。浓烈的仪式油脂与香草气息交织在一起，却又被那具行尸走肉身上飘散的腐败暗流所污染；你的目光不由自主被裹布下那双饥渴的黄眼牵引，它正冷冷打量着你。它向前逼近时，一声低沉、沙沙作响的嘶鸣——仿佛摇晃一杯装满骨头的器皿——在墓室里回荡。

~ Envisioned by CrunchyZombies on Discord

Dry scales scrape against stone as the serpentine mummy rises from its tomb, its ragged yellow bandages hanging loosely from an emaciated reptilian frame. The potent scent of ceremonial oils and herbs mingles with the undercurrent of rot drifting form the living corpse, and you find your gaze drawn to the hungry yellow eyes appraising you from beneath the wraps. A low, rattling hiss—like shaking a cup full of bones—echoes around the chamber as it advances.

~ Envisioned by CrunchyZombies on Discord

Dwarven City Square Spring Pipe Festival.name:
矮人城广场涌泉水管节
Dwarven City Square Spring Pipe Festival

Text.text:
在城中广场，春日的脚步宣告烟斗节的来临。馥郁与甜香交织的气息，穿过浓烟弥漫的空气飘散开来。矮人们手执烟斗聚在一起，互吹奇谈逸事，吐出层层起伏的烟圈，宛如烟雾雕塑在空中游走。悠扬的长笛与鼓点更将气氛推向高处，整座城市沉浸在友谊与欢庆交融的斑斓热潮之中。
Within the city square, spring heralds the festival of pipes. Aromas, both fragrant and sweet, drift through the smoke-thick air. Dwarves gather with pipes in hand, sharing tall tales and producing undulating rings of smoky sculpture. Melodic flutes and drums lift the atmosphere further as the city embraces the vibrant blend of friendship and joyous celebration.

Enormous Drum During Winter.name:
冬日巨鼓
Enormous Drum During Winter

Text.text:
一条穿过雪堆的足迹小径通向一面巨大的战鼓，鼓身侧倒在地，惨白而绷紧的鼓皮正对着小径另一侧的囚柱。鼓槌就搁在鼓面上。踏过桥的那一刻，你便进入了一处不洁的空间；而战鼓与囚柱的摆放，仿佛在宣告此地将要举行的某个仪式正由此开启。
A trail through the drifts leads to a large drum set on its side, its pale, stretched skin facing the prisoner’s post on the opposite side of the trail. A mallet for striking the drum lies atop it. Crossing the bridge brought you into an unhallowed space, and the placement of the drum and post seems to signify the start of whatever ritual takes place here.

Preening Starfighter Pilot.name:
爱摆架子的星际战斗机飞行员
Preening Starfighter Pilot

Text.text:
星际战机飞行员对着座机那闪亮的机鼻端详自己，近乎吹毛求疵地打理着每一处细节：拨弄发丝，整了整制服。攀上机身时，他还不忘确认地勤人员正看着自己，随即摆出姿势，抬手敬礼，才手脚并用钻进那狭小的座舱。
The starfighter pilot admires himself in the shiny nose of his ship, fussing over every detail of his appearance: tweaking his hair, adjusting his uniform. As he climbs into his ship, he checks to ensure the ground crew is watching him and strikes a pose, saluting before clambering into the tiny cockpit.

Obsidian Dragon: Change Shape To True Fo.name:
黑曜龙：变形回归真身
Obsidian Dragon: Change Shape To True Form

Text.text:
[人变形为巨龙] 你面前那人痛苦地扭曲着表情，脸上的皮肤骤然裂开，像一条闷燃的裂隙，橙红的光从缝中灼亮，火星在其中跳舞。那道阴沉的皱眉里没有痛楚或惊惶，只有眼底燃起的决意。热浪猛然涌起，他们的身躯膨胀生长，人形被改写成鞭影般的长尾、冲天的巨翼、乌黑如夜的鳞片——你这才意识到，那是一头黑曜石鳞的巨龙。你听见喉间低沉的咕噜轰鸣，滚烫的熔岩丝线开始从其紧咬的巨口间滴落。

[人死去并变形为巨龙] 最后一口气化作嘶鸣，身躯轰然塌落。分开的唇间，漆黑的烟雾如呕吐般涌出，翻卷着掩蔽了那具人形之躯。缠绕其外的烟影拉长、拔高……变得更为蜿蜒、更加高大——爬行般的轮廓。云烟散去，露出黑曜石巨龙那可怖的形体——已然死去，双眼如两颗巨大的灰色玻璃弹般失了神采。它的巨颚无力地垂着，硫磺味的烟仍以细细的触须从口中缓缓逸出。

~ 设想 by April

[Person Polymorphs into Dragon] The individual before you grimaces, the skin on their face splitting open into a smoldering crack with embers dancing out of the glowing orange fissure. Their scowl does not reflect any pain or dismay; instead, their eyes burn with determination. With a surge of heat, their body grows, their humanoid shape transfiguring into a whiplike tail, soaring wings, jet-black scales—and you realize it is an obsidian-scaled dragon. You hear a rumbling gurgle and long strings of lava begin to drip from their clenched maw.

[Person Dies and Polymorphs into Dragon] Their last breath turns to a hiss as their body collapses. Out of their parted lips, pitch-black smoke vomits out. It billows to cover their humanoid body, and the smoky silhouette surrounding them transforms to something longer, taller… reptilian. The cloud dissipates, revealing the terrible form of an obsidian dragon—dead, its eyes as glassy as two great gray marbles. Its maw hangs slack, sulfurous smoke still eking out in thin tendrils.

~ Envisioned by April

Wooz Van-von Brichafort Nightblossom.name:
伍兹·万-冯·布里夏福特·夜绽
Wooz Van-von Brichafort Nightblossom

Text.text:
面具带着骷髅般的性相，让这个肌肉虬结的庞然身影更显压迫。面具之后，是淡紫色的皮肤与尖长的耳朵——耳上缀满圆环——而橙色巨龙的刺青从手腕一路盘绕至肩头，缠住双臂。胸甲与那柄弯刀不断被拇指顶出鞘又推回，昭示着此人是名战士。衣着从兜帽到垂褶长裤与凉鞋，皆以栗棕色皮革配浅色布料相互呼应，勾勒出鲜明而松弛的风格。

~ 扮演：Christoffer

The mask has a skull-like aspect, making this massively muscled individual even more imposing. Behind the mask they have lavender skin and pointed ears—adorned with rings—while tattoos of orange dragons wrap both arms from wrist to shoulder. The breastplate and curved sword, constantly being thumbed out of its sheath and replaced, mark this person as a warrior. Their clothing, from cap to draped pants and sandals, is all in matching chestnut brown leather and lighter cloth, making for a distinct, relaxed style.

~ Played by Christoffer with

在垂柳洒下的阴影里，你瞥见瀑布脚下河岸处有一片更深的暗影。几块修长的石头垒成支柱与过梁，在陡峭的岸壁上勾勒出一道仿佛门洞的轮廓。河水打着旋涌入那条幽暗的通道，可从你所在的位置，根本看不出它通向多远。
In the shade cast by a weeping willow, you spot a deeper shadow on the bank at the base of the falls. Long stones form the supports and lintel of what looks like a doorway in the steep bank. Water from the river swirls into this dark passage, but you can’t tell from your vantage how far it goes.

陈列模特展示着线条利落的赛博义肢、形态完美的人造器官，以及闪亮、微小的无线植入体。越复杂的装置，接缝越清晰可见。然而整体观感依旧是风格与精密并存——那种艺术化的赛博美学。在全息版的产品画册里，设计选项琳琅满目。顾客的干细胞会为安装点与有机部件提供引导，使排异反应与数字性萎缩更不易发生。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Display models show samples of sleek cyber limbs, perfectly shaped artificial organs, and shiny, tiny wireless implants. The more complex devices have visible seams. The visual result, however, is one of high style and precision—the artistic cyber look. In the holographic prospectus, a wide array of design choices is available. The customer’s stem cells inform installation points and organic parts, making rejection and digital atrophy less likely.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

是的，你可以削一根简易手杖，用一根园艺木桩，甚至捡起一截枯落的断枝，然后将其灌注。它会抗拒，握持的手位却不会浮现，因为这截枝条或木桩并不认识你——何况，它早已死去。你把记忆喂给它，回想战斗的架势、行走的姿态、突刺的发力，从两端与整段杖身导出的定向法术。它不情不愿地、缓慢地，那曾在地上死寂的东西，终于活过来，化作你魔法意志的延伸。
Yes, you can cut a simple walking stick, use a garden post, even pick up a branch of deadfall, and imbue it. It resists, and no hand positions appear, because this branch or post doesn’t know you—besides, it’s dead. You feed it memory, recalling the battle stance, the walking stance, the thrust, aimed spells from ends and the full length. Reluctantly, slowly, what was dead on the ground lives as an extension of your magical will.

一头巨硕壮实、口吻宽阔如獒的猎犬，毛色似暴风云层，生着覆羽之翼，无声疾掠长空，来势汹汹，森然龇牙。它披着缰辔与挽具。挽具连着的鞍垫上——就在獒犬双翼之间——立着一名苍白的战士，身披银辉胸甲与护裙。她戴着臂甲与胫甲，头盔厚实，带鼻梁护与面颊护片，后侧却留出空隙，让她那束白色鬃发得以在身后飞扬，宛如一袭华美披风。她的双眼在头盔的阴影里闪烁寒光。一手紧握坐骑缰绳，另一手挥持一柄与护甲同色的弯刃斧剑。刃锋所过，拖曳出点点昏暗光照的微粒。
A gigantic, brawny, and broad-muzzled hound the color of storm clouds races silently through the sky on feathered wings, baring his teeth as he comes. He wears a bridle and harness. On a pad that’s part of the tack, between the mastiff’s wings, stands a pale warrior in a silvery breastplate and tassets. She wears bracers, greaves, and a solid helm with a nose guard and cheek guards, but open enough at the back to allow her mane of white hair to trail behind her like a splendid cape. Her eyes glitter from the shadows of her helmet. With one hand, she holds her mount’s reins, and in the other she wields a curved axe-sword that matches her armor. The blade trails particles of dim light.

Touring A Magical University.name:
漫游魔法大学
Touring A Magical University

Text.text:
一具自动机，形如长翼银色圆球，带着一双又大又友善的眼睛，召出一幅地图的幻影。它以清晰的嗓音对围拢在周遭的长袍学生们讲解，手势在魔法图示上逐点指引。“我们此刻所在的这座雅致公园，便是公地——以意志之泉为中心。向北，沿路再往前，你们会望见我们的秘典图书馆；公地环绕其外。往西看，树梢与会所之上，宏伟竞技场的弧形高墙正若隐若现。往东，若你们有需要，便能找到大宗师的庄园。自图书馆向外放射出五条道路，各通往五学之塔之一。你们每个人，都会在其中一座拥有自己的归处。”

~ Envisioned by F. Ramen

Shaped like a silvery orb with wings, an automaton with large, friendly eyes conjures the image of a map. It speaks in a clear voice to robed students arrayed around it, gesturing to points on the magical diagram. “This fine park we find ourselves in comprises the Commons, centered on the Fountain of Wisdom. North, up the road beyond, you’ll spy our Library of Mysteries. The Commons surrounds it. West of here, note the curved walls of the Grand Arena peeking over the trees and clubhouses. To the east, should you have a need, you’ll find the grandmaster’s manor. Five roads radiate from the library, each to one of the Towers of the Five Disciplines. One will be a home to each of you.”

~ Envisioned by F. Ramen

I Cast Mending.name:
我施放《修补术》
I Cast Mending

Text.text:
温暖的青铜能量从我指尖迸散，如同焦糖丝织成的毯子般覆落在破碎的物体上。那些触须般的细丝贴合并纠缠起物品的断裂碎片，让它在短短数秒间重归完整。
Warm bronze energy veins out from my fingertips, landing upon the broken object like a blanket of caramel strings. The tendrils fit and fuse the broken pieces of the item together, making it whole again in a matter of seconds.

Blacksmith: Breaktime.name:
铁匠：歇息时分
Blacksmith: Breaktime

Text.text:
当他们停下手中的活计，铁匠铺这片平日喧嚣的空间便在城中化作一处温暖而安宁的摇篮。煤炭不息的嘶嘶声与炽烈的火光令人心神沉醉，但铁匠不能让炉火冷却——风箱喷吐的气息打断你飘散的思绪，催得点点火星迸溅，顺着烟囱直冲而上。
When they pause in their labors, the smithy’s normally noisy space transforms into a warm womb of calm amid the city. You find the constant hiss and fiery glow of the coals mesmerizing, but the smith can’t let the fire cool, so breath blown from the bellows interrupts your drifting thoughts to send sparkling embers shooting up through the chimney.

Student Whispers In Lecture Hall.name:
讲堂里的学生低语
Student Whispers In Lecture Hall

Text.text: “诺亚说华金告诉他，獾帮那边竟然有人气到直接施放了苦痛诅咒。怎么这里突然一下子安静得吓人？” “Noah said Joaquin told him that someone from Badger actually got so mad she cast the misery curse. Why did it get so quiet in here all of a sudden?”

Loot From A Kraken.name:
来自海妖的战利品
Loot From A Kraken

Text.text: 在海妖的内脏深处，你找到一颗巨大而奇异的珍珠，价值连城——由海妖自身的消化系统孕育而成。其余能换钱的东西都得碰上识货的买家：每一只完好无损的眼珠都可充当一枚深渊放大镜；牙齿可制成骨剑，长达两英尺，每把价值约100枚金币；而兽皮则能裁制成数套防水衣物。墨汁可用来写一封信，读到的人会被施以charm person。 In the Kraken’s guts you find a large and unusual pearl of great value—created by the Kraken’s own digestive system. Everything else of value will require the right buyer: each fully intact eye may serve as a loupe of the depths; the teeth may be fashioned into bone swords, two feet in length and worth about 100 gold pieces; and the hide can be crafted into several sets of water-repellent clothing. The ink can be used to write a letter that casts charm person when read.

Riding A Tamed Hippogriff.name:
骑乘一只驯服的狮鹫
Riding A Tamed Hippogriff

Text.text:
你小心翼翼地把脚踏进马镫，深吸一口气，将重心向前一抛，翻身坐上那头奇美拉般野兽背上擦得锃亮的皮鞍。它因你这陌生的存在而尖声抗议，强健的肌肉又硬又紧，随时准备把你掀下去。你轻拍这生物结实如马的胁侧以示安抚，表明自己并无恶意，又把一小片肉干——小心地——递到它的喙边，盼望这位新同伴愿意收下你的献礼。它愉快地颤鸣一声，你的坐骑从你指间叼走了那块零嘴，你感觉它全身的紧绷如潮水般退去——看来，它愿意给你一次机会。

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Gingerly you set your foot in the stirrup, take a deep breath, and throw your weight forward, mounting the polished leather saddle atop the chimeric beast. It squawks in protest at your unfamiliar presence, its powerful muscles hard and taut, ready to buck you off. Patting the creature's toned, equine flank to reassure it your intentions are noble, you hold a scrap of jerky to its beak—carefully—hoping your new companion accepts the offering. Trilling happily, your mount plucks the treat from your fingers and you feel the tension melt from its body—it seems it will give you a chance.

~ Envisioned by Clara C. Potter on Discord

Victory Line About Bowels.name:
关于肠胃的胜利台词
Victory Line About Bowels

Text.text:
“真叫人失望，我拉过的屎都比打败你更费劲。”
“Such a disappointment, I’ve had bowel movements that were a greater struggle than defeating you.”

Loot From A Spriggan.name:
树精怪的战利品
Loot From A Spriggan

Text.text:
树灵枯萎下去，叶片转为褐色，纷纷飘落在他们周身，一根木棒也从他们手中滑落。那武器由树枝雕成，棍身刻着令人惊叹的动物与林地景致。
The spriggan withers, their leaves turning brown as they fall around them, and a club falls from their hands. Carved from the branch of a tree, the weapon is engraved with stunning depictions of animals and woodland scenes.

Air Elemental: Engaging The Elemental.name:
气元素：与元素交锋
Air Elemental: Engaging The Elemental

Text.text:
连空气本身都已化作怪物。它撕扯着你的身躯，刺痛裸露的肌肤。在旋舞尘埃纠结得最为浓稠之处，你知道它不知怎地竟是个活着、有意识的存在——由狂风与怒意凝成的异物，欲将你肺中的最后一口气都吸走。
The air itself has become something monstrous. It rips at your body and stings exposed flesh. Where the knots of whirling dust twist thickest, you know that it is somehow a living, conscious thing—a being composed of wind and wrath that would suck the breath from your lungs.

吟游诗人甚至能为这男人戴着的手套写上一首长诗。它饱经风霜，手背上烙着一道精灵符文；外表虽朴拙，却因他那双湛蓝的眼睛、草莓金的头发，以及那张修长温和却带着几分桀骜神情的半精灵面孔而格外惹眼。他身披棕色外套，里面是绿与黑的衣装，脚蹬棕色旅行靴，靴筒向下翻折。他一次又一次从挎包里取出法术书，用尖尖的手指在字里行间指点查阅。探在他肩头后方的是一只鼬，胡须竖起，嗅着空气。

~ Played by Cap

Bards could write poems about the glove worn by this man. It is weathered, with an elven rune burned into its back, and despite its humble appearance, it draws attention from his blue eyes, strawberry-blond hair, and his long and kindly half-elven face with its cocky expression. He wears a brown coat over green and black clothes, and brown traveling boots with the tops folded down. He takes a spellbook from his satchel again and again and consults its texts with a pointed finger. Peeking over his shoulder is a weasel, bristling its whiskers and sniffing the air.

~ Played by Cap

Loot From A Swarm Of Hell Bats.name:
来自地狱蝙蝠群的战利品
Loot From A Swarm Of Hell Bats

Text.text:
在倒毙的生物周围，散落着异界昆虫的空壳，许多依旧保存完好，尚未被食腐的虫群啃噬围攻。炼金术士必然愿意以每个10金币的价格收购其中一些。
Around the felled creatures are extraplanar insect husks, many still in good condition and not yet besieged by scavenging bugs. Alchemists will certainly buy some of these for 10 gold pieces each.

这柄长剑的剑刃仿佛将周遭的一切光芒尽数吞饮，撕开现实的一道裂隙——通往群星之间的黑暗之门，门内充斥着不安的低语与远古的梦魇。剑柄上，一张狰狞的怪脸向你咧嘴窥视，兽性的双眼嵌着血红的宝石。
The blade of this longsword seems to drink in all light around it to create a split in reality, a portal to the darkness between the stars full of disquiet whispers and ancient nightmares. A monstrous face leers at you from the hilt, its bestial eyes set with blood-red gems.

Temperate Maple Forest.name:
温带枫林
Temperate Maple Forest

Text.text:
老枫树佝偻的根系隆起成阶，沿着它们粗壮的树干盘出步道；树皮灰白而老皱。光线穿过浓密的树冠筛落下来，映着它们标志性的叶片：叶宽如掌，三枚尖刺般的裂片向外伸张。有的浅绿，有的深绿间掺着一缕缕红意，还有的浓若李紫。成对的槭果带着固定的双翼在空中旋旋飘落，缓缓下降，直到轻击在铺满落叶的地面上。鞭条般纤细的幼树立在老者脚下，努力向着遥远的天空伸展。
The hunched roots of elderly maples form steps and walkways around their thick trunks of wizened gray bark. Light filters through a lush canopy of their distinctive leaves: broad, palm-shaped specimens with three spiky lobes. Some are pale green, others deep green with wisps of red, and others still a rich plum purple. Maple seeds, borne on pairs of fixed wings, whirl through the air, descending slowly until they strike the leaf-littered earth. Whip-slender saplings stand at the feet of their elders, reaching for the distant sky.

Lemure Encounter.name:
魔鬼蠕虫遭遇
Lemure Encounter

Text.text:
你面前那具臃肿、赤裸的肉躯垂着一张塌陷的脸，发出凄厉的哀鸣——那性别已难分辨，层层肥肉从身上垂落，像蜡烛上融化淌下的蜡。它踩着短粗的腿摇摇晃晃，软塌塌的手臂漫无目的地乱挥，蒙着白内障薄膜的猪眼四下窥探。你喉头涌起一股胆汁般的反胃，源于恶心或恐惧——或两者皆有——因为你意识到，它那肥厚的嘴唇已经长得过分、肿胀得不成样子，根本无法再发出任何字句。
An anguished keening comes from the drooping face of the corpulent, naked body before you—indistinguishably male or female due to the rolls of fat that hang from its body like wax from a candle. It wobbles on stumpy legs as it aimlessly flails its flabby arms and peers about through piggy eyes filmed with cataracts. Bile, from disgust or terror—or both—rises in your throat as you realize its fatty lips have grown too long and bulbous for it to form words.

Killing Hacker With Digital Feedback Dam.name:
用数字反馈的伤害杀死黑客
Killing Hacker With Digital Feedback Damage

Text.text:
那道身影——裹在全息衣装里——将手向前伸出，十指在他的甲板上飞舞，顶着一波数字伤害硬推回去。若他们的汗腺没有被内部冷却系统取代，此刻早该被汗水浸透。然后，反噬压垮了他们。头颅猛然后仰，伴随一声令人作呕的脆裂，回馈噼啪作响地窜过脑干。电弧噼啪炸响，瞬间淹没他们的义体，一连串细小的爆炸在太阳穴处迸开。赛博空间里响起一声骇人的尖叫，随后……一片死寂。躯体像垃圾一样瘫塌下去。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The figure—swathed in holographic clothing—stretches his hand forward, digits dancing across his deck, pushing against a wave of digital damage. Had their sweat glands not been replaced with an internal cooling system, they would be drenched by the effort. Then it overcomes them. Their head flies back with a sickening crack as the feedback fizzles through their brain stem. A crackle of electricity overwhelms their augmentations, and a series of tiny explosions detonates at their temple. There is a dreadful scream that fills cyberspace, then… nothing. The body crumples like trash.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Sundries From An Adult Green Dragon.name:
成年绿龙的杂物
Sundries From An Adult Green Dragon

Text.text:
在碎裂的林木间，绿龙倒毙在地，闪亮的翡翠鳞片被血污糊成一片。你跨过折断的枝桠，开始仔细搜查这具尸体。靠近头部，你发现它的吐息囊残骸从喉咙处一道深深的伤口里黏稠地渗出。也许某位炼金术士能把这些丑陋的东西派上用场。
Amid the splintered trees, the green dragon lies slain, its glistening jade scales smothered in gore. Stepping over fallen boughs, you begin a thorough search of the corpse. Near the head, you find the remains of its breath sacs oozing from a deep gash in the throat. Perhaps an alchemist could find a use for the ugly things.

Giant Spiders: Catacomb Lair.name:
巨型蜘蛛：地下墓穴巢穴
Giant Spiders: Catacomb Lair

Text.text:
这些隧道与回声缭绕的洞室里，除了几缕破败的蛛网帘幕外，几乎看不出任何生命或居住的痕迹；可你仍觉得自己像个闯入者——仿佛未经通报、不受欢迎地踏进了别人的家。即便你明知此地早已荒废，住民不是早已远走，便是久已死去，你还是忍不住觉得自己正在擅自侵入。
These tunnels and echoing chambers show little sign of life or habitation besides a few torn curtains of cobwebs, yet you feel like an intruder—like you’re entering someone’s home unannounced and unwelcomed. Even though you know the place is abandoned, its inhabitants long gone or long dead, you can’t help but feel as though you trespass.

戟刃那弯钩般的鸟喙在光中闪烁着阴冷的寒芒，为这把武器平添几分邪意。柄顶的尖刺是一段锤打成形的铁峰，朴素得近乎残酷——却同样致命有效。
The hooked beak of the halberd’s blade shines wickedly in the light, adding a sinister edge to the weapon. The spike atop the haft is a peak of hammered iron, brutal in its simplicity—and efficacy.

Beneath The Surface Of A Plunge Pool.name:
潜潭之下
Beneath The Surface Of A Plunge Pool

Text.text:
瀑布自上方悬崖边缘倾泻而下，坠落数百英尺，刺骨的水雾沉沉悬在空气中。水流切割岩石，在大地上凿出一座深坑，将冰川融水灌至满溢。水面之下，唯有黑暗在等待，向地心深处延伸——它究竟还要再深入多少个数百英尺？
The waterfall plummets hundreds of feet from the cliff edge above, and frigid mist hangs heavy in the air. The water cuts into the stone, carving a pit into the earth, filling it to the brim with glacial runoff. Beneath the surface, only darkness waits, reaching deep into the earth—how many hundreds of feet does it extend?

Sundries From A Illithilich.name:
来自夺心巫妖的杂货
Sundries From A Illithilich

Text.text:
你在稀疏的残骸间翻找，布料从指间滑过，像冰冷的水般刺骨。你没找到任何值钱的东西，但至少，这份邪恶终于被从这个位面放逐了。
You pick through the sparse remains, the cloth running over your hands like ice-cold water. You find nothing of material gain, but at least this evil has finally been banished from this plane.

这片森林绵延无尽，层层叶影掩蔽着一切，树木密得让人根本无法分辨地形究竟延伸到何方。人在此极易迷失方向——而栖居于此的昆虫、鸟类与其他生灵的喧嚣此起彼伏，仿佛永不止息，更是丝毫无助于辨路。
Leafy shadows cover all in this forest expanse, so dense with trees that one cannot reasonably tell how far the terrain stretches. It would be easy indeed to lose one's bearings, not helped in the least by the endless noise provided by the insects, birds, and other creatures who call this place home.

银河系的巨型贸易财团才是唯一在使用这种看似玄奥的钱币的人。它由一种极其稀有的材料铸成，而这种材料只存在于已然熄灭的恒星之中；每一枚都价值高达一亿信用点。菱形的金属薄片令收藏家与投资者趋之若鹜——它是财富与权势的终极象征。
The mega trade corps of the galaxy are the only ones using this esoteric-looking coin. Made from an incredibly rare material found solely within extinct stars, these coins are worth a staggering hundred million credits each. The diamond-shaped slivers of metal are coveted by collectors and investors alike: the ultimate symbol of wealth and power.

Power Word Pain.name:
痛苦真言
Power Word Pain

Text.text: 你从不轻率地吐出那句圣言。它自你唇间坠落，如巨石落地，携着掌握此等力量应有的沉重威压。空气因之战栗，回响低沉而宣判。那震颤席卷你的目标，点燃其神经系统，迸发出最原始、最本能的讯号：痛。 You do not speak the Word lightly. It drops like a stone from your lips, with all the gravity wielding such power warrants. The air shudders with it, resonant and damning. The vibrations wash over your target and ignite their nervous system with the most primal, instinctive signal: pain.

一缕咸涩翻涌的烟霾盘旋成径，在空中蜿蜒游走。那触须般的雾丝终将回弯缠绕自身，鼓胀成灼热的云团，刺痛双眼，压短呼吸。雾里一团暗斑忽然裂开，化作顽邪的笑弧；其上两只眼睛绽开，幽绿刺目，冷冷瞪视。迷雾深处传来像壁炉木柴被火钩粗暴拨弄时的噼啪爆响——一阵满溢恶意顽笑的笑声。

~ 由 Joanne 构想

A coiling trail of smog, brackish and seething, winds through the air. As the tendril inevitably curves in on itself, it billows to create torrid clouds that sting the eye and shorten the breath. A blot in the fog suddenly splits into an impish smile, and two eyes bloom above it, green and glaring. A sound like a log fire prodded roughly by a poker crackles from the mist—a laugh teeming with malefic mischief.

~ Envisioned by Joanne

Undead Assault Of Coastal Town.name:
海滨小镇的不死突袭
Undead Assault Of Coastal Town

Text.text:
清冽的海风里渐渐渗入一股凝腐的尸臭，天色阴沉如覆，惶惶的低语在街巷间翻涌成浪。伴随着撕裂羊皮纸般的刺耳声响，参差的白骨利爪将现实生生扯开，骇人的怪物从魔法裂隙中倾泻而出，踏上铺石街道。它们蜡黄的骨头上血肉剥落，挥爪斩倒四散奔逃的镇民，在屠戮中狂喜，而更多传送门在这座饱受摧残的小镇各处接连洞开。

~ Inbal on Discord

The crisp sea breeze becomes laced with the curdled stench of rot as the sky grows dark and fearful muttering spreads through the streets in a roiling wave. With a sound like tearing parchment, reality is split open by ragged, bony claws, and horrifying creatures pour through the magical breach into the cobbled streets. Flesh sloughs from their yellowed bones as they cut down fleeing townsfolk, reveling in the carnage as more portals open across the beleaguered town.

~ Inbal on Discord

Sundries From A Gray Ooze.name:
灰色泥怪掉落的杂物
Sundries From A Gray Ooze

Text.text:
一堆参差不齐的金属碎片，边缘被腐蚀得发黑发脆，表面满是凹坑，也许还能勉强打造成些小件首饰，但大体上结构早已不堪。你意识到，眼前这些曾是护甲的部件。
A pile of jagged metal pieces, corroded at the edges and pock marked, might be workable into small pieces of jewelry, but for the most part, the integrity is not good. You realize you are looking at what used to be components of armor.

他站得像船长般端庄，却又带着海盗似的浪荡；手腕上层层叠叠缠着皮革手环与彩色珠串。他的帽子来自另一个时代，斜斜扣在狂野的乱发上，其间还编进了几根细小的鸟骨。他那件收腰的亮面天鹅绒长外套，肘部磨得发白；靴子走过无数里路，既踩过马车长凳，也踏过荒野小径。他的笑容像一场嘉年华——黑洞洞的缺口与金色的牙帽交错闪烁。

~ 构想：Shangerla

He stands with the dignity of a captain and the swagger of a pirate, bracelets of leather and colored beads layered on his wrists. His hat is of another time, perched upon wild hair with a few small bird bones woven into it. His tapered coat of shiny velvet is worn at the elbows, and his boots have seen many miles from both wagon bench and walking trail. His smile is a carnival of black gaps and gold caps.

~ Envisioned by Shangerla

这只巨型章鱼粗壮如柱的触手，足以对任何惹怒它的吸气生物宣判死刑；它能轻而易举地将对方拖入浪下，拽向自己深海般的水下巢穴。
The massive tentacles of this giant octopus are a death sentence to any air-breathing creature who gets on its bad side, easily dragging them beneath the waves to its underwater habitat.

In The Marsh: Ankle Deep In Muck.name:
在沼泽：泥淖没过脚踝
In The Marsh: Ankle Deep In Muck

Text.text:
这里的水看起来浅得足以涉水而行，但你在沼泽里每一步噗叽作响的踩踏，都像在揭开新的谜团。浑浊水面下的淤泥摸起来结实，却又死死拽着你的脚踝，让你觉得必须继续前进，否则就会被困住。
The water here seems shallow enough to walk through, though each squelching step in the bog presents a new mystery. The muck under the clouded water feels solid enough, but it pulls at your feet, making you feel like you must move on or risk getting stuck.

Shrine To A Dragon God.name:
龙神圣坛
Shrine To A Dragon God

Text.text:
在这座蔓延无尽的城市中央，蜷伏着一座朴素的龙族神祇神龛；它不起眼的外墙仅以几道蛇形刻纹轻轻雕饰。走进其看似平凡的体量里，摇曳的烛火在玄武岩祭坛上起舞，将影子投在寥寥的供品间缓缓爬行。都市喧嚣之中，这里能给予的慰藉少得可怜——却仍在少数尽责之人的心里，哺育着一簇日渐微弱的信仰之焰。

~ 由 Walt M. Envisioned

In the center of this sprawling city squats a modest shrine to a draconic deity, its unobtrusive exterior lightly carved with serpentine etchings. Within its unassuming bulk, flickering candles dance upon a basalt altar, sending shadows crawling across the meager offerings. Amid the urban tumult, this shrine offers scant solace—nurturing a dwindling flame of faith in the hearts of a dutiful few.

~ Envisioned by Walt M.

Flask Of Holy Water.name:
圣水瓶
Flask Of Holy Water

Text.text:
这只玻璃瓶中盛着澄澈的液体，其间悬浮着点点耀眼的银色碎屑。瓶塞覆着一层淡色蜡，严密封口。蜡面上压印着一枚圣徽，同样的圣徽也被绘在瓶身的玻璃上。
Within this glass bottle is a clear liquid with flakes of bright silver suspended in it. Pale wax coats and seals the flask’s cork. A sacred symbol has been embossed in this wax, and the same symbol has been painted on the glass.

这头野兽兼具凶獾般的暴烈脾性与棕熊般的魁梧筋骨；只要你惊扰它的巢穴或幼崽，它便会毫不犹豫地扑上来将你撕咬得体无完肤。它那对修长的利爪锋锐得足以迅速掘地，顷刻间便能让你的鲜血四溅。
Featuring the temperament of a vicious badger and the musculature of the brown bear, this beast will not think twice about savaging you should you disturb its den or its offspring. Its long claws, sharp enough for rapid burrowing, would certainly spill your blood in no time.

Bored Elven Noblewoman.name:
百无聊赖的精灵贵族小姐
Bored Elven Noblewoman

Text.text:
女人不耐烦地翻了翻那双流光溢彩的蓝眼睛，在又一场上流社会的宴席炼狱里百无聊赖地耗着。她抬手将一缕顺滑的乌黑长发别到尖尖的耳后，目光越过近旁的窗棂，投向皎洁月光铺开的璀璨夜色，任由思绪沉入对即将到来的冒险的幻想之中。

~ 由Discord上的Ameria Envisioned

The woman rolls her scintillating blue eyes in exasperation as she languishes in the purgatory of yet another high society dinner. Tucking a lock of sleek, raven hair behind a pointed ear she gazes out a nearby window at the brilliant, moonlit expanse and loses herself in the fantasy of adventures to come.

~ Envisioned by Ameria on Discord

Threat From A Black Dragon.name:
来自黑龙的威胁
Threat From A Black Dragon

Text.text:
“每一块石头、每一棵树、每一茎草叶都向我宣誓效忠。可你们却来到这里，昂首挺胸，手握兵刃。但我向你们保证——你们也终将跪倒在我的威仪之前，哪怕我得先把你们的腿卸下来。”
“Every stone, tree, and blade of grass owes me fealty. Yet you come here, heads held high and weapons in hand. But I promise, you too will kneel before my grandeur, even if I must remove your legs first.”

Pearl Of Power.name:
力量珍珠
Pearl Of Power

Text.text:
珍珠在你掌心里完美成球，圆润得近乎不真实，除了出自魔法的专长，别无解释。炽亮的光泽仿佛颜料落入清水般在表面缓缓旅行，柔和的粉、奶白与紫罗兰色在流动中令人目眩神迷。它触感奇异，既沉实又空荡，仿佛正以肃穆的耐心等待被某物填满。
The pearl is perfectly spherical in your hand, too flawless to be anything but a feat of magic. The incandescent sheen seems to travel across the surface like paint in water, the muted pinks, creams, and violets mesmerizing in their motion. The pearl somehow feels both substantial and hollow, as though somberly waiting to be occupied.

Leandra Denasti.name:
莱安德拉·德纳斯蒂
Leandra Denasti

Text.text:
披覆在女人纤细身形上的丝绸长裙泛着近乎金属的冷光。她的眼睛是夺目而冰冽的蓝，暗色眼影将那份寒意衬得更深，唇上则染着浓郁的赤红口红。她步伐带着一种不祥的优雅，身姿挺直却从容，隐约透出贵族式的教养。她微笑时，露出异乎寻常地修长的犬齿；一只毛茸茸、顽皮的小生物轻巧地跃上她的肩头，稳稳栖在那里。

~ Played by Prettzellecchia

The silken dress draping the woman’s slender figure gleams with an almost metallic quality. The woman’s eyes, a striking and frigid blue, are offset with dark eyeshadow, and her lips are stained with a rich, red lipstick. She moves with an uncanny grace, her rigid but easy posture hinting at a noble upbringing. She smiles, revealing unnaturally long canines, as a furry, impish creature comes to perch upon her shoulder.

~ Played by Prettzellecchia

Hapenny Port In Winter.name:
冬日的半便士港
Hapenny Port In Winter

Text.text: 码头区域前方立着一块告示牌，上面写着：Hiroka船长的滑冰场，现已开放！ 更小的红字则写着：禁止钓鱼。走近码头边缘，能清楚看见威克河这一段已彻底封冻成冰。人们在一道绳索围起的范围内滑冰，那圈界线每隔片刻便仿佛闪烁一下，掠过一丝诡异的能量。Hiroka坐在凳子上看管着客人，木烟斗里残火随着每一口吞吐而微微发亮。 A sign posted at the front of the dock area reads: Captain Hiroka’s Ice Skating Ring, Now Open! In smaller, red text, is: No fishing. Approaching the edge of the dock, it’s clear to see that this section of the Wick River is frozen over completely. People ice skate within a cordon, which every few moments seems to flicker with a strange energy. Hiroka sits on his stool supervising his patrons, the embers in his wooden pipe glowing with each puff.

The Revelation Of A Printing Press.name:
印刷机的启示
The Revelation Of A Printing Press

Text.text:
全镇的人潮挤满了阶段周围的石板路。昨日木匠的铁锤砰砰作响、锯齿咬啮木料，新切木材的清香至今未散，缠绕在为庆典烹制食物的集市香气之后。夜幕深处，戴面具的劳工将“大机器”的部件一件件扛上阶段；丝绸帷幕后，神秘的匠人们搭建、调试、摆弄，忙到此刻——在帷幕落下前这最后一息令人屏息的瞬间。

随后，瞧——大机器揭幕而立。可它究竟是什么？它像是餐桌与断头台的怪异子嗣：两根粗壮立柱夹着一张桌面，中间却不悬刀刃，而是一枚螺旋杆连着一块压板。司仪扬手一挥，举起一张白色长方形羊皮纸，铺在桌上。随着他轻轻一点头，助手扳下拉杆——奇迹般的机括带动弹簧，压板猛然下落，重重一压。拉杆回弹升起，司仪拾起羊皮纸：其上赫然印出文字——百字、千字——转瞬即成！
The whole of the town throngs the cobbles around the stage. Yesterday the carpenters' hammers pounded and saws chewed, so the smell of fresh-cut wood lingers behind the fairground scents of foods cooked up for the occasion. Under dark of night, masked laborers hefted parts of the Great Machine onto the stage, and behind silk curtains mysterious artisans constructed and fiddled, working up until this last breathless moment before the curtains’ fall.

And then lo, the Great Machine stands revealed. But what is it? It looks like the offspring of a dining room and a guillotine. Two thick pillars straddle a table, not holding a blade between them, but a screw attached to a board. With a flourish, the master of ceremonies holds up a white rectangle of parchment and lays it over the table. At his nod, an assistant pulls a lever, which through miraculous mechanics drives the spring to press down the board. The lever rises, and the master of ceremonies picks up the parchment to reveal a page printed with words—a hundred, a thousand—in an instant!

七只如黑暗幼虫弹珠般的眼睛，从菌伞般的躯体里阴森地瞪视着外界。它不过幼儿般高矮，却凭八条由卷须根编成的关节长足站立；这矮小的真菌张开洞穴般的大口，露出钟乳石似的獠牙。它一声尖啸，空中的孢子浪潮随之喷涌，化作一团翻涌的云雾。那圈褶边的头颅像一朵畸形的蘑菇，因用力而上下点动，在它周身凝结的毒雾帷幕之下，竟几乎显得有些可爱。
Seven eyes like dark larval marbles stare out from a fungiform body. Standing no higher than a toddler, on eight articulated legs constructed from tendril roots, the diminutive fungus opens its cavern mouth, revealing speleothem fangs. When it screeches, a wave of airborne spores floods out in a cloud. Its frilled-edge head, like that of a malformed mushroom, bobs with the effort, almost cute beneath the veil of poison coalescing around it.

一圈白桦木栅栏环护着北方小镇，底部堆满积雪。苔原向四面八方绵延数里无尽，碎冰片在临岸的河面上懒散漂流而下。披着皮裘的守卫把守垛口，目光锐利，警惕着任何逼近的威胁。
A palisade of white birch rings the northern town, snow piled about its base. The tundra extends outward for leagues in all directions, while ice fragments float lazily down the bordering river. Guards in furs man the ramparts, eyes keen for approaching threats.

这件软垫夹衣结实耐用，磨损得恰到好处，穿着舒适；又以皮革束带加固贴合，点缀钢钉，配以黄铜扣环。护甲看起来平平无奇，可一旦触碰，你便无法否认其中潜伏的魔法。它比钢制板甲更轻，却或许在抵御刀刃时更加坚韧。
The padded gambeson is sturdy, well-worn, and comfortable, reinforced and fitted with leather bands, steel studs, and brass buckles. The armor appears mundane enough, but upon touching it you cannot deny the latent magic within. It is lighter than steel plates, but perhaps even stronger against blades.

Pull Of The Void.name:
虚空之引
Pull Of The Void

Text.text:
绝望的阴霾在你四周翻涌蒸腾。你的思绪翻滚不休，怎么也甩不掉那种感觉——你正站在某个无形巨兽颤抖而焦躁的咽喉巨口之中。随着这份惶惧不断累积，你的视野开始模糊，所见的每一道阴影都被扭曲成一片浓稠、搏动的深渊。

~ Envisioned by Camel

A pall of despair seethes all around you. Your mind roils, and you cannot shake the feeling you are standing in the trembling, anxious maw of some invisible beast. As this apprehension builds, your vision blurs, turning any shadow you see into a dense, pulsating abyss.

~ Envisioned by Camel

Sundries From A White Dracolich.name:
白色龙巫妖的杂物
Sundries From A White Dracolich

Text.text:
在那邪秽畸形之物冰封的掠夺珍藏中，你发现了几件古怪之物：一大片锁子甲，竟由车轮般巨大的甲环编织而成；一只破碎的狩猎号角，其上镌刻着一头腾跃雄鹿的图案；以及一面磨损褪色的旗帜，描绘着远古战役的片段。它们像是这头生物漫长岁月——以及不死岁月——里从仇敌身上夺来的战利品。
Among the vile abomination’s frozen hoard of plunder, you find some curious items: an enormous patch of chain mail crafted from rings the size of wagon wheels, a shattered hunting horn engraved with the image of a leaping stag, and a worn, faded banner depicting scenes from an ancient battle. They seem like trophies from the creature’s enemies over its long life—and undeath.

Elf Guard Statue.name:
精灵守卫雕像
Elf Guard Statue

Text.text:
这位精灵英雄自亘古以来便立誓守护此地，如今以大理石之姿定格为冷峻的守望者。他们以慈和的目光俯视所守之人，提醒生者：先祖始终与他们同在。
Sworn to guard this place for time immemorial, the elven hero is a stoic sentinel immortalized in marble. They watch over their charges with a benevolent gaze, reminding the living that their ancestors are with them always.

只需轻轻一接触，你便感到能量沿着指尖战栗奔涌，注入你的盟友体内，短暂唤醒并提升他们的内在潜能。
With but a touch, you feel energy thrill down your fingertips and into your ally, temporarily boosting their inner potential.

Altar On A Snowy Plateau.name:
雪原高台上的祭坛
Altar On A Snowy Plateau

Text.text:
你们在高原上越往前旅行，雪片就越发密集，浓密的雪幕几乎让人连面前五十英尺外都看不清。队伍里最老练的冬季旅者用多余的衣物草草缝成遮目护片，防着众人被雪光灼盲。视线受阻之下，你们直到几乎撞上它才意识到那座石祭坛的存在。曾经有人在此撒下花与麦穗，如今却尽数枯萎，冻结成脆硬的残影。祭坛中央凹着一处碗形槽痕，血渍在风霜曝晒下发黑，其内还躺着几根被岁月磨蚀的兽骨。
The flurries of snow thicken the further you travel across the plateau, making it virtually impossible to see more than fifty feet in front of your face. The most experienced winter travelers among you fashion crude visors out of spare clothing, to keep everyone safe from snow blindness. Because of your hampered vision, you are unaware of the stone altar until you are practically on top of it. Flowers and wheat were once strewn here, now wilted and frozen. In the center of the altar, a bowl-shaped indentation is stained with blood, turned black from exposure—several weathered animal bones residing within.

Webbed Stone Amulet.name:
蛛网石护身符
Webbed Stone Amulet

Text.text:
夺目的红色水晶被切割打磨成光滑的椭圆形，悬挂在一串相扣的金属环链上。晶体内部有点点光辉游移跃动，而顶端却被一团阴影般的浊暗所笼罩。银色蛛网般的缠绕纹路覆满石面——其网心由一枚虬结的戒环牢牢锚定。
The striking red crystal, cut and polished into a smooth oval shape, hangs from a chain of interlocking metallic loops. Speckles of light dance within the crystal, while a shadowy mass clouds the top. Twining lines of a silver web cover the face of the stone—anchored by a gnarled ring at the web’s center.

I Use Colossus Slayer.name:
我使用“巨人杀手”。
I Use Colossus Slayer

Text.text:
如今既已让敌人见血，我便趁其脆弱之处再下重手，进一步削弱它。它把重心压在尚未受伤的肢体上时，我便朝那里发动攻击。它若稍作停顿、试图稳住心神，我就送上一记疼痛而扰乱的创伤。随着伤口层层叠加，我将每一道都化作破绽，步步紧逼，直至将敌人拖倒在地。
Now that we have bloodied our enemy, I strike where it’s vulnerable to weaken it further. When it puts weight on an unharmed limb, I attack there. If it pauses to gather its wits, I deal a painful, distracting injury. As the wounds add up, I exploit each one as an opening to bring the foe down.

Theater District In Winter.name:
冬日剧院区
Theater District In Winter

Text.text: 街区被一出冬日芭蕾的嗡鸣声彻底占领。一群学院学生站在“抖脚舞厅”门前，读着海报便欢呼出声：Pieds Fleuris 舞团荣幸呈献《蟹王与钳骑士》。黑匣子剧场前也立着演员，正把独幕剧传单递给过路人。 “先生，来看蟹子芭蕾的？”一位年长的演员朝穿着考究大衣、靴面发亮的花花公子们喊道。他心知肚明地哼了一声，灰白的鬓角衬得被寒风吹红的脸颊更显粗粝。“我看过了，不值这满城的吹捧。这样吧，您拿我们这份演出表——没准开幕之夜能见着您。我们的开幕之夜，听清了。我们更实惠，阵容也一样有派头！” 花花公子接过传单，原本不耐的神色竟化成了亮眼的欢喜。他朝演员点点头，把传单塞进了大衣口袋。 The district is overtaken by the buzz of a winter ballet. A group of Academy students stand in front of the Fidgety Feet dancing hall and exclaim with joy as they read the poster: The Pieds Fleuris Dancing Company is proud to present The Pincer Knight and the Crab King. Actors stand in front of the blackbox theater, handing out flyers for their one-act plays. “Here for the crab ballet, sir?” calls out an older actor to passing dandies in their fine coats and shining boots. He scoffs knowingly, his gray sideburns emphasizing cheeks ruddy with cold. “I’ve seen it and it’s not worth all the hype in the world. Tell you what, you take our schedule here and maybe we’ll see you on opening night. Our opening night, mind you. We’re a more economical choice and got class acts to boot!” As the dandy takes a flyer, his annoyed look melts into one of bright-eyed joy. He nods to the actor and tucks the flyer into his coat pocket.

年迈的法师饱经风霜，古铜色的皮肤上刻着岁月的痕迹。他以紫水晶般的双眼温和地迎向光亮。银白的长发垂落肩头，连同那把厚重的长须一同流淌如月华。他身披深紫色长袍，金边镶饰，衣袍在他身侧轻轻游动，仿佛自有灵智在掌控。课堂上，他立于讲台，以戏法、彩色粉笔与宝石粉尘授课。偶尔他会喘鸣几声，显得脆弱，甚至轻得像要飘起，但他有一名看不见的地精仆从在旁支援。

~ Played by Duh Bull Eh with

The aging wizard, weathered and bronze-skinned, looks kindly into the light through amethyst eyes. His hair is long and silver, as is his considerable beard. He wears a robe of deep purple, trimmed in gold and moving around him gently, as if governed by its own intelligence. He stands in his class, teaching his lessons with cantrips, colored chalks, and gem dust. He occasionally wheezes and seems fragile, even weightless, but he has his unseen goblin servant for support.

~ Played by Duh Bull Eh with

坚韧蔓生的植被在此纠缠成团，扼住一条狭窄的沟壑。几株躲在阴影里的藤蔓上结着一簇簇紫黑色浆果，旁边伸展着又长又蜡亮的尖刺。每一根刺的尖端都猩红如血。这些荆棘灌木几乎拱成一条隧道——隧道的另一端却通向空无一物的薄空。
Tough, viny vegetation tangles together here, choking a narrow gully. Aggregate purple-black berries cluster on some of the shaded vines among long, waxy thorns. Each thorn has a scarlet tip. The bramble bushes almost form a tunnel—the other end of which opens to thin air.

Mosaic Floor Of A Castle.name:
城堡的马赛克地砖
Mosaic Floor Of A Castle

Text.text:
无数色彩斑斓的瓷砖铺就了大殿地面，宛如一件令人叹为观止的艺术杰作。每一块都自带夺目光辉，然而唯有从高处俯瞰、将其整体尽收眼底时，才会显露出一种令人屏息的全新性相。
Tiles of every color imaginable make up the astonishing work of art that is the floor of the grand hall. Though brilliantly vibrant in their own right, the pieces reveal a breathtaking new aspect when viewed from above in their entirety.

Rainforest Palm Tree.name:
雨林棕榈树
Rainforest Palm Tree

Text.text:
棕榈树的树干缓缓上倾，由一层层浅褐色树皮鳞片交叠而成。高处的高处，棕榈舒展出一顶明亮翠绿的叶冠，宛如巨大的羽毛。
The gently sloping trunk of the palm tree is made up of overlapping scales of light brown bark. High, high above, the palm spreads a canopy of bright green fronds reminiscent of giant feathers.

Gregarious Sales Associate.name:
善于交际的销售专员
Gregarious Sales Associate

Text.text:
有人立在街角，仿佛要与整条街争风头：身披对比强烈、飘逸翻飞的衣袍，头顶喷发胶多过头发本身。他们朝路人招手，把人往身后的店里引，扯着嗓子叫卖，许诺梦想成真、想象力被彻底淹没。
Someone stands on the corner in competition with the street itself, dressed in flowing garments of contrasting colors and a head topped with more hairspray than hair itself. They beckon people toward the shop behind them, shouting promises of dreams fulfilled and imaginations overwhelmed.

Stowaway's Arrival.name:
偷渡者的到来
Stowaway's Arrival

Text.text:
夕阳将港湾宁静的水面染成橙、粉与紫，与微云轻覆的天穹相映。一艘单桅小帆船一动不动、悄无声息，被绳索牢牢系在码头边。有人从船舷栏杆的缺口处探出头——那里通向跳板。又长又塌的头发垂在他们瘦削的脸旁，睁大的眼睛映着水面上渐褪的余晖。过了许久，那瘦骨嶙峋、衣衫褴褛的身影才站起身，把一只破旧背包甩上肩头。他们沿着跳板飞奔而下，赤脚啪嗒啪嗒拍在木板上，最后几步却像那木板是陷阱般猛地跃起，落到石砌码头上。停顿片刻，深吸一口气，他们便匆匆钻进临水的巷弄之中。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Sunset paints the tranquil waters of the harbor orange, pink, and violet to match the lightly clouded sky. One sloop sits still and quiet, lashed to the dockside. Someone peeks around the opening in the vessel’s gunwale railing that leads to the gangplank. Long, limp hair hangs around their waifish face, their wide eyes reflecting the fading sunlight coming off the water. After a long moment, the scrawny, raggedly dressed figure stands, hoisting a shabby rucksack onto one shoulder.
