They run down the gangplank, bare feet slapping the wood, and leap onto the stone quay as if the last few feet of plank were a trap. With a pause and a deep breath, they hastily make for the waterfront alleys.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Razed City.name:
夷为平地之城
Razed City

Text.text:
洗劫这座昔日雄城的入侵者，手段之彻底，几乎不留余地。巍峨的城墙被凿出一个个巨大的豁口——此处彼处焦痕斑驳——那是庞大攻城器械、强悍法术，甚至可能是驯养巨龙所造成的惊人伤害。城内的景象更为凄惨：统治者的堡垒被击碎、焚尽，直至地基都化作焦黑残骸，周遭建筑同样难逃厄运。曾经保障安全、贸易与繁荣的一切，如今只剩回忆；任何可能的幸存者都已随变局之风四散飘零。
The invaders responsible for the sacking of this once-great city could not have been more thorough. The massive city walls are gouged with enormous holes—scorch marks visible here and there—incredible damage inflicted by huge siege engines, mighty spellwork, and perhaps tame dragons. The city within has fared even worse: the ruler’s keep smashed, incinerated to its very foundation, the surrounding buildings sharing its fate. All that once existed here to guarantee safety, trade, and growth is now a memory, any possible survivors scattered to the winds of change.

Thorn The Goliath.name:
巨人族荆棘
Thorn The Goliath

Text.text:
半巨人宛如由石质血肉与板甲铸成的巍峨壁垒，挺立其间，姿态端正如一名终身戎马的老兵。她那把巨型巨剑沉重得惊人，长年负重将她的肩膀压得更宽，双臂粗壮，肌肉如绳索般虬结。覆在魁梧身躯上的金色狮族毛皮、缺失的一只眼与裂痕纵横的唇角，无声诉说着无数战斗——赢过也败过的遭遇战、死里逃生的决斗，以及被她亲手终结的敌手。她平静的面容不见一丝笑意，只以一只黄色独眼冷冷审视四周。即便巨剑已收鞘背负，她也绝非赤手空拳——金属倒刺自她的指节间刺出，从装甲护手中森然探出。

~ 由 Goblin Man 扮演

A towering bulwark of stony flesh and plate metal, the half-giant stands with the upright bearing of a lifelong soldier. The immense weight of her colossal greatsword has made her shoulders broad, her arms thickly corded with muscle. The golden leonin fur draping her broad frame, as well as a missing eye and scarred lip, whisper of countless battles—skirmishes won and lost, duels survived, and foes vanquished. No ounce of mirth breaks the placid visage as she perceives her surroundings with a single, yellow eye. Even with her greatsword sheathed at her back, she is far from unarmed—metal barbs jut from her knuckles, protruding from armored gauntlets.

~ Played by Goblin Man

Alter Self: Aquatic Adaptation.name:
变身术：水栖适应
Alter Self: Aquatic Adaptation

Text.text:
你的呼吸逐渐加深，鼻腔里开始发出如芦管般的颤鸣，颈侧随之裂开一道道细缝，为你新生的鳃让出通道。与此同时，指缝间的皮膜发痒刺痛，迅速向外舒展，长成蹼状的薄翼——在水下转身游弋时，它将给予你无可估量的助力。
Your breathing deepens as your nose begins to emit a reed-like noise and slits open along your neck to accommodate your new gills. Simultaneously, the skin folds between your fingers start to itch, as they expand to form webbing that will aid you immeasurably when maneuvering underwater.

这件长而圆筒的乐器由抛光木材制成，一端外扩成喇叭口。另一端连接着一段较短、更细的管身，可插入一根细小的金属管；金属管顶端装着扁平的双簧哨口。管身上开有七个指孔，分成两组各三个，另一个第七孔比其余孔更靠近喇叭口。
Made of polished wood, this long, cylindrical instrument flares into a bell at one end. The other has a short, thinner tube into which fits a tiny metal pipe with a flat double-reed mouthpiece. Seven finger holes pierce the pipe in two groups of three with the seventh hole closer to the bell than the rest.

这道深坑的坑壁陡然坠入黑暗。一阵刺骨的冷风从你身侧掠过，向深处灌去，仿佛大地在一声漫长而无声的低吟中将其吸入。深坑周围的地面看不到大石或其他杂物——无疑是先前那些试探坑深之人的投石，早已坠落消失。
The sides of this pit plummet into darkness. A chilly breeze blows past you and down into the depths, seemingly inhaled by the earth in one long, quiet moan. The ground around the pit is free of large stones or other litter, no doubt victims of previous attempts to test the pit’s depth.

Bored Spaceport Clerk.name:
百无聊赖的太空港办事员
Bored Spaceport Clerk

Text.text:
女人用触控笔在桌面上敲击，节奏单调，像她周遭引擎的起落轰鸣。她用三只疲惫的眼睛看着你。她的制服勉强算得上得体，却早已褪色；而她的身份牌照片也陈旧得很，早已不是如今的模样。
Tapping her stylus on the desk, in a monotonous rhythm reminiscent of the rise and fall of the engines around her, the woman looks at you with three weary eyes. Her uniform is professionally acceptable, but the color has long since faded, and her ID badge picture is years out of date.

你在空气中挥动双手，想象你要操控的水体，其广阔与深邃尽收心中。你将这幅景象悬于身前，低声吐出法术的词句，将它吹入其中。一幅朦胧的影像浮现——那是被缩成微形的水——当你将注意力凝聚其上，便伸出手去塑形，笃信真实的水也会随之回应。
You wave your hands through the air, envisioning the water you wish to control in its breadth and depth. You place this vision in the air before you and breathe the words of the spell into it. A hazy image appears—the water in miniature—and as you concentrate upon it, you reach out with your hand to shape it, knowing the real water will respond in kind.

你用指尖捻起细密的沙粒，将它们攥在拳中吹散。每一粒沙在空中旋舞扭转，铺展开来化作一面平坦的位面，并在你眼前凝结成实。沙墙如围栏般逼近你的敌人，截断他们的去路。
You pinch the fine grains of sand between your fingers and blow them out through your fist. Each individual grain twists in the air, forming into a flat plane and solidifying before your eyes. The wall of sand hems in your enemies, blocking their path.

世界里一道幽暗的涟漪昂然撞上苍白的天空，自地平线延伸到另一端，林海在它脚下汇聚。阴影将山坡涂染成紫，而阳光又把峰顶点亮成耀目的橙。任何群山的景致都足以令人屏息，但在夜的幽暗与昼的明亮之间，似乎有一段魔法的时刻，而你正幸运地在这时代抵达此地。
A dark ripple in the world pitches up against the pale sky, stretching from horizon to horizon and gathering forests at its feet. Shadows paint the slopes purple while sunlight picks out the peaks in brilliant orange. Any vista of mountains can be breathtaking, but there seems to be a magic hour betwixt the dark of night and brightness of day, and you’re lucky enough to find yourself in this place at that time.

Etching Of A Constellation.name:
星座蚀刻图
Etching Of A Constellation

Text.text:
前方一块饱经风霜的岩石引起了你的注意，岩面有几处在光线下微微闪烁。其上的雕刻已被岁月磨蚀得斑驳褪色，却仍依稀可辨。你凑近细看，才发现那是一幅星辰的刻痕，细若游丝的线条将它们相连，勾勒出一座星座。
A weathered rock ahead catches your eye, with sections of its surface glimmering in the light. The carving is weathered and faded but still recognizable. Studying it closer reveals an etching of stars, connected by thin lines to form a constellation.

Glowing Black Lotus.name:
幽光黑莲
Glowing Black Lotus

Text.text:
莲花静置在玻璃桌上，花瓣大张，仿佛以最深的夜色雕琢而成。然而在花心，雌蕊却如灯笼般发光，仿佛这朵花是一只黑色的杯盏，盛满了熔化的黄金。
The lotus sits on a glass table, its petals open wide—crafted, it would seem, from deepest night. At the core, however, the pistil glows like a lantern, as if the flower were a black cup filled with molten gold.

尽管眼前陈列着骇人的景象，你内心仍有一角察觉到它们拼组间那种诡异而和谐的美感。整间密室宛如一只珠宝匣般闪耀，镀金的架子上摆满阴森物件，水晶匣中陈列得如同珍藏。可这些遗物本身却让你胃里翻涌：仍在抽搐的断肢、被斩下却眼珠滚动的头颅，以及其他来自熟悉与陌生生物的残片。
Despite the horrors displayed before you, some part of you recognizes a harmonious beauty to their assemblage. The chamber glitters like a chest of jewels, with eerie objects arranged on gilt shelves and displayed in crystal coffers. The relics themselves raise your gorge: still-twitching limbs, severed heads with rolling eyes, and other bits of creatures both familiar and foreign.

I Break An Elemental Gem Of Yellow Diamo.name:
我捏碎了一枚黄钻元素宝石
I Break An Elemental Gem Of Yellow Diamond

Text.text:
宝石骤然碎裂，一缕干燥的泥土从中倾泻而出。尘埃翻涌、膨胀，直至一抹浅褐色的庞然轮廓成形。两只灼亮的黄眼刺穿尘幕，粉尘随即凝结为一团厚重、不断流转的岩石之躯：一只土元素。四肢碾磨作响，浑厚回声沿着大地震荡，那生物转向我——静候我的号令。
The gem shatters and a trickle of dry earth spills out. Dust billows and grows until the pale brown silhouette of a hulking creature forms. Two shining yellow eyes pierce through the shroud, and the dust solidifies into a bulky mass of shifting stone: an earth elemental. Limbs grinding, sonorous voice reverberating through the earth, the creature turns to me—awaiting my command.

Taunt From A Contemplative Vampire.name:
来自一位沉思的吸血鬼（特征）的嘲弄
Taunt From A Contemplative Vampire

Text.text:
“我希望你们迄今的人生都丰盈圆满。我想，像你们这样的英雄必定备受爱戴——甚至被人歌颂。我们都会有沐浴阳光的日子，直到不得不沉入黑暗。我希望你们已经好好享受过属于自己的那段光辉。”
“I hope your lives up to now have been full. I imagine heroes like you are adored—celebrated, even. We all have our days in the sun before we must settle into the dark. I hope you have enjoyed yours.”

Sundries From A Gorgon.name:
来自戈尔贡的杂货
Sundries From A Gorgon

Text.text:
戈尔贡背上披着一张绳索编成的网格。网格之间穿织着它受害者的石化颅骨。
The gorgon wears a lattice of rope over its back. Woven through the lattice are the stone skulls of its victims.

Divine Camp Of An Orc God.name:
兽人神祇的神圣营地
Divine Camp Of An Orc God

Text.text:
当然是座战争营地。兽皮帐篷顶端探出交叉的支杆，营帐毫无井然排列的迹象。战士们想在哪儿点火就在哪儿点火，最大的篝火聚拢着人数最多、最强悍的勇士。瘦骨嶙峋、毛发打结的大狗在营地里游荡觅食残渣，每座毡帐的入口都挂满了武器。那位神祇永恒地游走于营地，从不入眠，时刻准备召唤军团的亡魂，附身于凡世位面的兽人战士之躯。
A war camp, of course. Yurts with crossed posts emerging at the top of the hides show no sign of orderly arrangement. Fires burn where the warriors want them, the largest bonfires attracting the most and strongest warriors. Great mangy dogs roam the camp for scraps, and weapons hang from every yurt’s entryway. The god roams the camp eternally, never sleeping, always ready to call the troops' spirits into possession of the orc warriors of the mortal plane.

Beautiful Bronze Brooch.name:
华美的青铜胸针
Beautiful Bronze Brooch

Text.text:
九只翠鸟绕着胸针中央的太阳，在一圈青铜中盘旋成环。其下，别针——塑作它们母亲修长的喙——横贯胸针，尖端越过扣环，直指前方。
Nine kingfishers fly in a circle of bronze around a sun at the brooch’s center. Beneath them, the pin— shaped like their mother’s long beak—crosses the brooch and points beyond the catch.

一阵干涩刺耳的刮擦声将你的注意力拉向昏暗厅室的角落，那生物正从藏身处现形。它是一具蛇形骷髅（特征），足有两辆马车般巨大，自黑暗中蜿蜒滑出，眼眶里燃着恶意的幽光。那生物猛然昂起身躯，如刽子手的利刃般高高俯临……随即张开布满獠牙的巨口，猛扑而来。
A dry, rasping scrape draws your attention to the corner of the shadowy chamber as the creature emerges from hiding. A serpentine skeleton, as large as two carriages, slithers from the darkness, eyes glowing with malevolent light. The creature rears up, towering over you like an executioner’s blade… and it opens a fanged maw to strike.

Urban Agent Spellsniper's Electrical Pow.name:
都市特工「法术狙击手」的电能异能
Urban Agent Spellsniper's Electrical Powers

Text.text:
警笛尖啸，警用巡逻车在四散的车流间猛然甩尾穿梭；它的猎物——一辆被劫的安保卡车——如暴怒的食肉龙般轰鸣着沿街狂奔。警察的轻武器火力叮叮当当地打在那钢甲巨兽的装甲外皮上，却只溅起无用的火星，根本无法阻止它逃窜。忽然，一道炽烈的放射光弧如长矛般刺穿逃逸车辆，将它硬生生横向撞偏……当场定住，再也动弹不得。警车急刹停下，警员们向一位立于楼顶的纤细女子敬礼——她正把通讯器贴在耳畔。

~ 由 Ararion 扮演

Sirens wail as the police cruiser swerves through scattering traffic, its quarry—a stolen security truck—thundering down the street like a raging carnosaur. Small arms fire from the cops pings ineffectually on the armored hide of the behemoth, totally unable to arrest its flight. Suddenly a blazing arc of actinic light lances through the fleeing vehicle, shunting it sideways… stopping it in its tracks. The police pull up and salute a slender woman standing atop a building, communicator held to her ear.

~ Played by Ararion

Wood Elf Corpse.name:
木精灵尸体
Wood Elf Corpse

Text.text:
尽管尸身端坐挺直，双手却如树根般深深埋入泥土。那名精灵的面容仍留着靛蓝纹饰，神情安详，仿佛是在握着挚爱之人的手时安然离去。
Though sitting upright, the body’s hands are buried deep in the soil like the roots of a tree. A serene expression graces the woad-marked features of the elf, as if they passed peacefully while holding a loved one’s hand.

从南面进入峡谷的入口尽头，是一根高耸逼人的岩柱，零星点缀着矮灌木。峡谷众多的狭窄关隘中，有两处在此形成岔口，各自通往一间洞室。这两间洞室的位置恰到好处，正可守住这条蜿蜒曲折的狭缝峡谷入口。
The entrance into the canyon from the south ends at a high, looming rock pillar scattered with scrub brush. Two of the canyon’s many chokepoints create a fork here, each leading to a chamber. The chambers are perfectly positioned for guarding this entrance to the meandering slot canyon

Goddess Of Winter.name:
冬之女神
Goddess Of Winter

Text.text:
她吟唱着冰封池塘与沉睡树木的颂歌。她的歌声清澈如银铃，她的肌肤苍白如天穹；她伫立在一袭巨大的冰蓝色天鹅绒长裙中，缎面领口扣至下颌。狼群环伺——通体雪白，与她的发色同样洁净。她抬起戴着手套的双手。细雪温柔飘落，但只要一次僭越，白昼便会骤变为暴风雪与雪崩。白狼舔过冷冽的空气，抬眼望向群山，以及她那一季的庄严与盛大。
She sings the carol of frozen ponds and sleeping trees. Her song is clear as silver bells, her skin pale as the sky, and she stands in an enormous ice-blue velvet gown with a satin collar buttoned to her chin. A pack of wolves—white, the color of her hair—surrounds her. She lifts her gloved hands. A gentle snow falls, but one transgression could change the day to blizzard and avalanche. A white wolf licks the air and looks up at the mountains and the majesty of her season.

这枚华美的罗盘堪称工艺杰作，纤细的花丝宛如以贵金属织就的蛛网，熠熠生辉。宝石如眨眼的星辰标定四方，银色蚀刻的指针轻颤不止，寻北如同鸟儿追索归巢的方向。
This ornate compass is a masterwork of artifice, its delicate filigree redolent of a web spun with precious metals. Jewels like winking stars define the cardinal points, and the silver etched needle quivers as it seeks north like a bird hunting their nest.

Impact Crater Lake.name:
撞击陨坑湖
Impact Crater Lake

Text.text:
多年前，一具坠落的巨体撕裂大气，狠狠砸入大地。那股暴烈之力在你眼前的地面上硬生生剜出这只巨大的碗状凹陷。此后的岁月里，冰川融水与雨水将陨坑注满了澄澈如晶的清水；因四周遮蔽而免受风扰，它那完美宁静的水面微光流转，宛如秘银般闪耀。
In years past, a falling body smashed its way through the atmosphere and into the ground. Its violence gouged out this enormous bowl shape in the earth before you. In the years since, glaciers and rainfall have filled the crater with crystal-clear water, its perfectly serene surface shimmering like mithral, protected as it is from the wind.

Arrow Of Unseelie Craftsmanship.name:
邪魅精工箭矢
Arrow Of Unseelie Craftsmanship

Text.text:
这支箭以扭曲肿胀的木材打造，尾羽钉着腐朽的乌鸦羽毛；其锈蚀的铁制箭头不断渗出恶臭的沼泽污水。它是宫廷之间一场被遗忘战争的残酷纪念，对妖精生物而言更是毋庸置疑的致命之物。
Crafted from warped, swollen wood and fletched with moldering raven feathers, this arrow constantly oozes foul-smelling bog water from its rusted iron tip. This is a reminder of a forgotten war between the Courts, and is decidedly fatal to fey creatures.

柔粉的丝绸垂挂在墙上，将光线浸染成柔和宜人的辉晕。房间里虽透着安宁，却显然有人仓促离去。靠墙的一张婴儿摇篮——手工雕刻、精致华美——空空如也，毯子被胡乱掀到一旁。角落里的摇椅侧翻倒地，一侧扶手折断，书本散落满地。这里究竟发生了什么？
Pastel silks adorn the walls, suffusing the light with a pleasant glow. Though the room exudes calm, it's clear the occupants left in a hurry. A crib along one wall—hand-carved and ornate—sits empty, blankets tossed aside. A rocking chair in a corner lies on its side, one arm broken, and books are scattered across the floor. What happened here?

当这台装置的曲柄被摇动时，闪耀着光芒的以太导管亮起，使复现针从银河系遥远的某处捕捉到一些令人不安的广播信号。一张刻着开放式音槽、并已正确充能的虫胶唱片，将这些信号一边通过卷曲的黄铜号角放送出来，一边将其录下；旋律是一连串诡异的高低音与喉间咕噜般的浑浊声。外壳以深沉华美的暗色木料制成，镀金装饰其上，并印着负责翻译的本地学术团体标志。
When the crank is turned on this device, aether tubes glowing with light cause the reproducer needle to pick up some disconcerting broadcast signals from somewhere far off in the galaxy. An open-grooved disc of properly charged shellac records these signals as they play through the curling brass horn in a series of eerie pitches and throaty gurgles. The rich dark wood of the casing is decorated in gold with a logo of the local academic group in charge of translation.

Corporate-owned Automated Street Transit.name:
企业所有的自动化街道交通系统
Corporate-owned Automated Street Transit

Text.text:
怪物般的轮式运输无人机在高速路上狂飙而下，浑厚的引擎咆哮着逼近一处新近的事故点。先进传感器锁定障碍物，尽管它负载惊人，仍迅捷一摆，硬生生绕开了灾害。印满赞助商标识的巨兽轰然掠过，连环追尾中的人们这才长出一口气。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The monstrous wheeled transport drone barrels down the expressway, its throaty engines roaring as it approaches a recent crash. Advanced sensors detect the obstacle, and despite its bulk it swiftly swerves to avoid disaster. As the sponsor-emblazoned goliath thunders by, those involved in the pileup sigh with relief.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Tutor Sprite.name:
导师小妖精（特征）
Tutor Sprite

Text.text:
一个闪烁的程序在共振中忽隐忽现，兴奋得咯咯作响，扭曲着钻入那些寻常跑者只能在梦里企及的空间。嗯……也不太像咯咯笑，更像某种古怪的脉冲噪音。它逐渐成形：一张戴着眼镜的脸，神情带着几分玩味，圆大的眼睛因好奇而明亮发光。它抬起头，四下张望着那本悬在面前的魅影（特征）之书。

~ 由一位英雄设想

A flickering program phases in and out of resonance, tittering with glee as it warps into spaces the average runner could only dream of. Well… sort of tittering, more like a strange pulsing noise. It comes into form: a bespectacled face, with a bemused expression, its big wide eyes alight with curiosity. It looks up and around the phantom book hovering before its face.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Sir Agravain At The Joust.name:
马上比武场上的阿格拉瓦因爵士
Sir Agravain At The Joust

Text.text:
恶意在骑士眼中闪烁，他踏上马上比武场与同伴汇合，心知肚明的冷笑玷污了他英俊的面容。他的女士信物——一方深栗红的手帕——自他高举的长枪上飘扬，他一边扫视人群，寻找那令他倾心的物体。只见他的盾牌上以绿色作带，紫底之上绘着一只展翼的金色双头鹰。

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

Malice gleams in the knight’s eyes as he joins his fellows upon the jousting field, a knowing smirk sullying his handsome face. His lady’s favor—a handkerchief of deep maroon—flutters from his raised lance as he scans the crowd for the object of his affections. Upon his shield, banded by vert, a volent twin-headed eagle of gold can be seen on a field of purpure.

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

你先听见它，后看见它，而映入眼帘的景象远超你的想象。雪白的水瀑自一处巨大的马蹄形峭壁上分三层倾泻而下，水流绕过突出的岩石分散开来，又在下方重新汇合。瀑布脚下，一汪宽阔的深黑静水向外铺展开去，被风扬起的水雾轻轻喷洒，继而汇成一条溪流，蜿蜒流出，渐渐远去。
You hear it before you see it, and what you see surpasses your imagination. A cascade of white water tumbles down three levels of a huge horseshoe-shaped cliffside, the flow dividing around projecting rocks and rejoining. At the base of the falls, a broad pool of calm dark water expands outward, sprayed by wind-lifted mist, before flowing out and away as a stream.

I Cause An Insect Cloud With My Staff Of.name:
我用虫群之杖唤起一片虫云
I Cause An Insect Cloud With My Staff Of Swarming Insects

Text.text:
我用法杖尖端重重敲击地面，震耳欲聋的嗡鸣瞬间灌满空气，无数昆虫在我周围凭空涌现，扭动翻滚成一片虫潮。我行走时，这些造物亦如影随形——化作活生生的斗篷，将我的身影从视线中严密遮蔽。
I rap the staff’s tip on the ground, and an overwhelmingly loud drone fills the air as innumerable insects appear around me in a writhing swarm. My creations follow me as I move—a living cloak to shield me from view.

Orbital Strike Against Magical Protectiv.name:
对魔法防护穹顶实施轨道打击
Orbital Strike Against Magical Protective Dome

Text.text:
遥远的月面上，一点紫罗兰色的火花骤然点燃，玷污了那洁白如雪的表皮。它猛然向上蹿升，光芒急剧膨胀。一道能量长枪刺破大气，如天穹降下的轰击般尖啸着自苍穹坠向那被护盾笼罩的神殿。奥术之力轰然相撞，震耳欲聋的冲击之后爆开一道刺目的闪光，随之而来的力量波席卷四方，将树木像火柴棍般抛散翻飞。

~ 由 Mitch Prince Envisioned

A violet spark ignites upon the face of the distant moon, marring its alabaster surface. It surges upward, the flash growing larger. A lance of energy pierces the atmosphere in a celestial bombardment as it screams down from the heavens toward the shielded temple. As the arcane forces collide, a blinding flash erupts in the wake of a deafening impact, and a wave of force explodes outward, scattering trees like matchsticks.

~ Envisioned by Mitch Prince

当你指尖沿着这把弓的弓弦轻轻划过，一阵战栗从指甲尖一路窜到肩头的肌肉深处。耳畔有嘶嘶声发麻。你是出击的蝰蛇。你的心跳骤然加速，如惊惶猎物的奔蹄般擂响。一种永不餍足的渴求——对追逐的乞求——将你攫住，令你沉醉。 As you trail a finger along the string of this bow, there is a tremble from the tip of your nail to the meat of your shoulder. A hiss tingles in your ear. You are the viper that strikes. Your heartbeat quickens, drumming like the footfalls of panicked prey. An insatiable need, a beg for a chase, enraptures you.

Ovid Shadewalker.name:
奥维德·影行者
Ovid Shadewalker

Text.text:
这身影穿着黑色皮质护甲，身高不比成年精灵高多少，迈步入场，仿佛只需随意一瞥，便将他周遭整个区域尽收眼底。它仍保有精灵特有的尖耳与纤瘦灵动的体态，然而那双眼却如无纹的青石板般空洞无物，皮肤苍白灰冷，昭示着他并非精灵，而是影触族裔——与精灵血缘相近的一支。可他的肩膀宽得惊人，几乎宽得不合常理，肌肉虬结紧绷；就在此刻，他猛地将一件古怪的武器直抛向空中，将那力量一瞬间暴露无遗。相连的刀刃在高空短暂停悬，像一弯新月挂在地面之上，随即笔直坠下，稳稳落入他伸出的掌心，竟连他一缕垂落的黑长发都未割断。下一秒，一只麻雀的两半落入他早已等候的口中，紧接着传来一声令人发寒的咔嚓。迎上他钢铁般的目光，你立刻打消了为这怪异表演鼓掌的念头。这是个绝不可轻易招惹的男人。

~ 由 TheSaltySnowcone 扮演

No taller than an adult elf, the figure in black leather armor strides onto the scene as if surveying the entire area around him with one passing glance. Though he retains the pointed ears and lithe physique of the elf phenotype, his eyes are a featureless slate and his skin a pallid gray, marking him instead as a member of a shadow-touched race, a close relative to the elves. Yet, his shoulders are quite broad, nearly too broad, and his muscles corded, put on display rather suddenly as he flings a curious weapon straight up into the air. The connected blades hang for a moment like a crescent moon, high above the ground, then fall straight into the palm of an outstretched hand, cutting not one strand of the figure’s long black hair. A second later, two-halves of a sparrow fall into the figure’s waiting mouth, followed by a grisly crunch. Meeting his steely gaze, you decide against applauding the bizarre display. This is a man not to be trifled with.

~ Played by TheSaltySnowcone

Bridge To Snow-covered Fortress.name:
通往雪覆要塞之桥
Bridge To Snow-covered Fortress

Text.text:
纤细的白色光束穿过暗色松针瘦长的爪状枝叶，斑驳洒下。你在这数小时的徒步中被浓密枝桠与外界隔绝，但此刻，你的旅程似乎终于将通向开阔的天穹。你触及林木的断口，一阵寒风迎面横斩而来——高山林冠所拢住的最后一丝暖意顷刻散尽——你的身体不由得颤抖。眼前，一道宽阔的深渊将你刚翻越的山峰与前方那座山生生劈开。对面的山体上嵌着一座黑色尖塔林立的要塞：积雪堆在缝隙里，冰锥自垛口滴垂，霜华为每一扇窗镶上冷白的边。通往彼岸的路似乎只有一条——一座狭窄的石桥，像蛛网最后一缕丝线般，触及那洞窟般阴翳的幽暗。

~ Cardsfan9996 所构想

Thin beams of white light filter through the spindly claws of dark pine needles. These dense branches have closed you off from the world during your hours-long hike, but it seems your journey might finally lead to open sky. As you reach the break in the trees, a cold wind slices across your front—any warmth held in by the alpine canopy gone—setting your body to shaking. Before you, a wide chasm splits the mountain you've just crested from the one ahead. You see a fortress of dark spires set into the opposite mountain: snow gathering in the crevices, icicles dripping from the parapets, and frost riming every window. The only way across seems to be a slim stone bridge, reaching like the last string of a spiderweb across the cavernous gloom.

~ Envisioned by Cardsfan9996

Ujarak Anjun.name:
乌贾拉克·安朱恩
Ujarak Anjun

Text.text:
双眼燃着狂野的翠绿魔法光芒，手握一根锯齿般参差、碎裂成冰的法杖，这名灰绿斑驳的龟人男子宛如一尊被注入生命的远古石像。德鲁伊一边编织旋涌的魔法，一边以低沉轰鸣的嗓音吟诵咒文，仿佛巨石沿着山坡轰然滚落——而亡者开始在他周围起身。孢子弥漫在空气中，从他龟壳上那簇柔软、带着泥土气息的蘑菇中飘散而出，落在腐烂的血肉上，以超自然的速度扎根生长。

~ 扮演者 BradyBil85，使用

Eyes aglow with wild, veridian magic and wielding a jagged staff of splintering ice, the mottled gray-green turtlefolk man resembles an ancient statue imbued with life. The druid weaves swirling magics as he recites the incantation in a low, rumbling tone like boulders cascading down a mountainside—and the dead begin to rise around him. Spores fill the air, drifting from the crop of soft, earthy mushrooms atop his shell, settling on rotting flesh and taking root with supernatural speed.

~ Played by BradyBil85 with

Haunted House: Children's Room.name:
闹鬼宅邸：儿童房
Haunted House: Children's Room

Text.text:
这里曾是孩子们的房间——如果靠墙摆着的一张上下铺、凌乱的被褥，以及角落里掀着盖子的玩具箱可信的话。磨得发白的地毯上，绒毛玩偶、玩具士兵与各式小人偶横七竖八地散落成一线。

忽然间，这些玩具开始自己撑起身子，摇摇晃晃地站立起来。一个独眼泰迪熊转过身来面对你，它的伤痕皆是孩童炽烈爱意留下的痕迹。缝出微笑的毛线嘴角猛地崩裂，随着一声细小的咆哮，它竟不可思议地露出滴着涎水的尖牙。
This was the children’s room, if a bunk bed situated along one wall—bedclothes disheveled—and toybox in the corner, with its lid propped open, are to be believed. A line of plush animals, toy soldiers, and other figures lie strewn across the well-worn rug. Suddenly, the toys begin to push themselves to their feet. A one-eyed teddy bear, its wounds born from the fierce love of a child, turns to face you. The yarn making up its smiling mouth rips free as it emits a tiny roar, inexplicably baring slavering fangs.

Small, Island City.name:
小型岛屿城邦
Small, Island City

Text.text:
这座城市紧贴着那座狭长小岛的海岸线，俯身栖坐在环岛海域拍岸的碧蓝浪花之上。木制码头从岸边向外伸展，方向各异，粗壮的渔夫踩踏其上，忙乱的水手来来往往，吆喝着口令。小船在水面懒洋洋地起伏，渔夫抛撒渔网；更远处的天际线上，帆影渐现，大船正准备下锚。露天集市在高大树木的棕榈阴影下铺展开来，几乎占据了整座城市，摊上堆着新鲜的鱼与螃蟹，以及自远方异域漂来的无数奇珍。五彩旗幡在温热、带着盐味的空气里猎猎翻飞。
The city hugs the coast of the small oblong island, perching over the lapping turquoise waves of the surrounding sea. Wooden docks extend outward at every angle, trod by burly fishers and harried sailors who bark orders as they come and go. Boats bob lazily in the water while the fishers cast their nets, and sails appear on the horizon as larger ships prepare to drop anchor. An open-air market, shaded by the palms of towering trees, dominates the city, offering fresh fish and crabs and myriad exotic goods from faraway lands. Colorful banners flutter in the warm, salt-laced air.

Victorious Dark Elf Priestess.name:
得胜的黑暗精灵女祭司
Victorious Dark Elf Priestess

Text.text:
黑暗精灵伫立当场，高举着血淋淋的战利品：一颗刚割下的矮人头颅。女祭司猛然甩动长鞭，鞭梢的蛇首嘶嘶作响，带着恶毒的欢欣。她唇间倾泻出残忍的邪言——向她的蛛形女神献上一段强力的祷告——要将那不信者当场击溃。
The dark elf stands there, brandishing a gory prize: a dwarven head freshly taken. The priestess lashes her whip, the snake heads on the end hissing with malicious glee. Words of vicious evil pour from her lips—a powerful prayer to her arachnid goddess—to smite the unbeliever.

一名硬朗的老水手迈着海上练就的宽阔步伐与摇摆步态悠然走来。他把一网鱼甩在肩上，身后一路滴滴答答洒着水。那双惊人湛蓝的眼睛在常年眯起的缝隙里闪着光，使他被风霜打磨的面庞透出一种和善又顽皮的神情。
A doughty old salt strolls along with the wide stance and swaying step of sea legs. He carries a net full of fish flung over his shoulder, dribbling water behind him. Startlingly blue eyes twinkle through a perpetual squint, giving his weather-beaten countenance a look of benevolent mischievousness.

Carved Wooden Ladder.name:
雕刻木梯
Carved Wooden Ladder

Text.text:
那架梯子冷峻地倚靠在峭壁边，仿佛整根都由一块虬结斑驳的原木雕成。你的目光追随着木纹令人眩晕的回旋与螺纹，试图辨出它的来处，或在横档上找出制作者工具留下的痕迹——然而答案始终从你指缝间溜走。
The ladder resting stoically against the cliffside seems to have been carved entirely from a single piece of gnarled, spotted timber. Your eyes follow the dizzying whorls and spirals of the wood, trying to discern its origin, or any marks left by crafter’s tools upon the rungs—yet the answers elude you.

Elemental Gem Of Yellow Diamond.name:
黄钻元素宝石
Elemental Gem Of Yellow Diamond

Text.text:
这颗肮脏的黄色钻石本可切割成十来颗尺寸可观的宝石，却因一处比它的净度或色泽更刺眼的瑕疵而被保留为整块。钻石内部，仿佛有某物被冰封镶嵌其中，竟躺着一枚你在溪流里常见的圆润卵石。此等景象理应不可能。也许是某种魔法将那石子置于其中——可为什么？
This dirty, yellow diamond might be cut into a dozen decent-sized gems, but it has been left whole because of a flaw more glaring than its clarity or color. Inside the diamond, like something encrusted in ice, lies a round pebble as you might find in a stream. Such a thing should be impossible. Perhaps some magic placed the stone there, but why?

这名打手个头中等，却横宽松垮；灰色长裤配深色马甲，外头套着一件刺眼的白色花哨西装外套，袖子卷到手肘。油腻的黑发从后退的发际线一路贴下来，与一道丑陋的疤痕相接——疤从他左脸贯穿到底。那道伤也顺带夺走了他的左眼：如今嵌着一枚阴森的义眼，通体漆黑，瞳孔却是一点血红。肘部静脉周围密密的疤痕暴露了他是个惯用兴奋剂的老手。他显得坐立不安，不停把肩胛往后耸，冲路人顶着下巴挑衅，像是在寻衅找架打。
Of average height but broad and flabby, the goon wears gray trousers and a dark vest under a gaudy white blazer with the sleeves rolled up. A receding hairline of oily black meets an ugly scar that runs the length of the left side of his face. Whatever made the scar took his left eye as well—now a sinister implant, black with a red dot for a pupil. Scarring around the elbow veins mark him as a habitual stim user. He seems restless, rolling his shoulders back, jutting his jaw out at passersby, angling for a scrap.

Quip About Liking Flaws.name:
打趣：偏爱缺陷
Quip About Liking Flaws

Text.text:
“和你那雕琢得完美无瑕的身形不同，我更愿意相信自己恰好有那么些瑕疵，才显得有趣。”
“Unlike your perfectly chiseled and immaculate form, I like to think I have just enough flaws to make me interesting.”

一股清澈的水流奔涌着掠过嶙峋的河床，在对岸低矮峭壁的阴影里折转了去向。你这边的垂柳将柔长的枝条拖入水中，另一株柳树则从崖顶垂下枝叶，摇摇欲坠。这里阴翳静谧，唯有潺潺水声低语，但河水在岸内的水位与溪流的速度提醒着你：不久前的雨势才刚停。再多一点，这片区域就会泛滥成灾。
A stream of clear water rushes over a rocky bed, bending its flow in the shadow of a low cliff on the opposite side. Weeping willows trail their boughs into the water on your side, while another willow dangles its branches down from the top of the cliff. It’s a peaceful spot of shadows and gurgling sound, but the height of the water in its banks and the speed of the stream remind you of the recent rains. It wouldn’t take much more for the area to flood.

Sundries From A Black Dracolich.name:
来自黑色龙巫妖的杂货
Sundries From A Black Dracolich

Text.text:
黑龙巫妖那紧绷、溃烂的残肉所剩无几，此刻却仿佛要弥补流逝的时代般，齐齐开始剥落脱离。暴露的肋笼之内，锁链交织成一张网格，中央是一具人形骷髅（特征）被四肢大张地钉在其上。一柄锈剑贯穿骷髅（特征）的胸膛，像标本蝶身上那枚冷硬的别针。
Whatever was left of the black dragon lich’s taut, festering flesh begins to slough away all at once, as though making up for lost time. Chains form a webwork inside its exposed ribcage, with a humanoid skeleton spread-eagle at the center of it. A rusty sword is thrust through the skeleton’s chest, like a pin in a preserved butterfly.

Tournament Royal Pavilion.name:
王家锦标赛亭
Tournament Royal Pavilion

Text.text:
一只孔雀在条纹帐篷前踱着步，守卫立在敞开的门帘旁，侧目注视。门口露出帐内层层叠叠的地毯；帐篷周围堆着旅行箱、一张宽大的羽绒床，还有一副护甲挂在木制衣架上。粗壮扶手椅旁的小圆桌上，摆着一套茶具和一块面包板。
A peacock struts in front of the striped tent, watched sidelong by the guard at the open flaps. The doorway reveals a floor of layered rugs inside, and around the tent are trunks, a broad featherbed, and a suit of armor hanging on a wooden valet. On a small round table by a stout chair are a tea set and bread board.

Temple To A God Of Wilderness.name:
荒野之神的神殿
Temple To A God Of Wilderness

Text.text:
一张肃穆的面孔由叶与枝搭成，高悬在讲坛之上。藤蔓盘绕垂落，像一绺绺浓绿、毛躁的发丝围着那张脸。生长之物以自身的存在与气味浸透这片空间。杂草从墙缝里探出头来。粗大的根系拱起地砖，钻入长椅深处。枝条穿过屋顶与窗格垂下。然而这处圣所并未荒废。身披麻袍的祭司们双足沾满泥渍，像慈和的父母般照料着这些狂野的繁茂。
A solemn face, constructed of leaf and twig, hangs above the dais. Vines coil and fall around the face like thick strands of green, frayed hair. Growing things imbue the space with their presence, their smell. Weeds peek in through cracks in the walls. Great roots lift up tiles from the floor and burrow into pews. Branches descend through the roof and the windowpanes. But this sacred place is not abandoned. Priests in hemp robes, their feet stained with mud, tend to the wild growths like kindly parents.

Temple To A God Of Bards.name:
吟游诗人之神的神殿
Temple To A God Of Bards

Text.text:
层层石阶铺着软垫，便于舒适地观赏与冥想，一路向下通往一处受祝圣的阶段。黑色薄纱帷幕已然拉起，却依旧通透，将司仪的祭司们与前来观礼的人群隔开。有些祭司是乐师或歌者，另一些则是舞者与杂技者。眼前的演出缓慢而严谨，表演者们围绕着阶段中央的一只巨大圣杯行进——那是一尊高耸的圣像，被抛光至银辉般闪耀。人群毫不掩饰地迸发出掌声、笑声与啜泣声，每一种都被奉为演出之谜的圣礼。
Tiers of stone, cushioned for comfortable observation and meditation, lead down to a sanctified stage. Black gossamer curtains are drawn but transparent, separating the performer priests from the attending mass. Some of the priests are musicians or singers, while others are dancers and acrobats. The performance at hand is slow and methodical, the performers moving about a large chalice—a tall icon polished to a silver shine—in the center of the stage. Applause, laughter, and weeping are emitted by the mass openly, each a sacrament to the mystery of performance.

Bulette Encounter: Land Sharks Approachi.name:
巨型土鲨遭遇：陆地鲨群逼近
Bulette Encounter: Land Sharks Approaching

Text.text:
你听见远处仿佛闷雷滚过，随即又以为那是风在平原尽头呼啸；可很快你意识到，轰鸣来自脚下——大地本身正在震颤。细小的石子在你脚边摇晃、倾倒、弹跳。是地震！你正要稳住身形迎接震波，却听见泥土深处传来低沉的呻吟——有什么东西正穿行于地底，像鲨鱼在水中盘旋。
You hear what sounds like distant thunder, then think it is the wind roaring in the distance across the plains, but you realize the earth itself is rumbling. Little stones wobble, topple, and bounce at your feet. It must be an earthquake! But as you brace for the tremor, you hear the groan in the earth—something moving through the soil, like a shark circling in the water.

Troglodyte Spotted In A Tree.name:
树上发现穴居人
Troglodyte Spotted In A Tree

Text.text:
木头的吱呀声撕裂了森林的寂静；下一瞬，一根粗壮的枝条从你身旁高耸的巨树上坠落，伴着碎裂般的巨响砸在地上。你抬头望去，只见一头庞然生物攀附在树干上：利爪般的手死死攥着那截被折断的树枝，脚趾却像猿猴般灵巧地蜷扣在更低的枝杈间。它眯起眼冷冷瞪着你，露出森白锐齿，喉间滚出低沉的警告咆哮。它还握着一根长柄木棒，棒头嵌着弯曲的獠牙或角。它的皮肤泛着病态的青灰，底下蓝色血管清晰可见；手臂、胸口、下巴与头上零零散散翘着一撮撮幽白的毛发。日光照下，它的头顶与肩膀已开始发紫起泡。
A creak of wood sunders the silence of the forest and, a moment later, a thick branch falls from one of the towering trees around you with a splintering crash. Looking up, you see a hulk of a creature clinging to a tree, clawed hand clutching the shorn limb while its toes curl around lower branches with simian dexterity. Along with a squinting glare, it bares its sharp teeth at you and a warning growl rumbles out of its throat. It holds a long wooden club with curved fangs or horns embedded into its head. Its skin bears a sickly green-gray pallor with its blue veins visible underneath. Ghostly white tufts of hair stick out in patches on its arms, chest, chin, and head. The top of its head and shoulders have begun to turn purple and blister in the light of the sun.

Volcanic Elemental Flees Into The Forest.name:
火山元素遁入森林
Volcanic Elemental Flees Into The Forest

Text.text:
一具披覆岩浆的化身，承载大地的盛怒，这元素咆哮着翻涌的熔火。它灼烫的巨躯轰然碾过林间空地，身后拖曳一线闷燃的余烬。它绝望地寻求逃离，躲入古树的深影之间；那层层密叶，成了抵御其炽烈辐射的脆弱屏障。

~ 设想：Elijah

A magma-sheathed embodiment of the earth's wrath, the elemental roars with molten fury. Its blistering mass thunders across a glade, birthing a trail of smoldering embers. Desperate to escape, it seeks refuge amid the deep shadows of the ancient trees, their dense foliage serving as a frail ward against its blazing emanations.

~ Envisioned by Elijah

那半巨人面容和善，下巴垂着一圈帘状胡须。他穿得像个农夫，身上有股格外分明的气味——像是熊的皮毛、松脂与烟斗的余烟，只要你鼻子够灵就能闻得一清二楚。他坐在一把从巨石上凿出的椅子里，小心翼翼地削着一根篝火木。你一走近，半巨人便抬起头，打量他那一小片土地——庄稼与菜圃拥挤得一路铺到小屋跟前——随即吹起口哨，那旋律宛如林间柔和的风铃声。
The half-giant has a kindly face and a chin curtain beard. He is dressed like a farmer and has a distinct smell—bear, pine sap, and pipe smoke, if your nose has it right. He sits on a chair hewn from a boulder, carefully whittling a bonfire log. When you approach, the half-giant looks up to study his little patch of land, crowded as it is with crops and gardens all the way up to his hut, and begins to whistle a tune that sounds like soft chimes in the forest.

你吐出法术的字句，那些音节一落地，便有一股异界寒意直钻你的灵魂深处。你伸出的手掌骤然黯黑，刹那间，脓疱、黏液、热病与腐烂的幻象在眼前翻涌。病灼般的热浪盖过了死灵魔法的冰冷。你感到一团恶性病灶在体内凝成，随即奔涌而出，流入你的目标。
You spit the words of the spell, and their utterance brings an otherworldly chill to your very soul. Your outstretched hand darkens, and for a moment you envision pustules, mucus, fever, and rot. The burning heat of sickness overtakes the chill of necromantic magic. You feel a malignancy form within you, then flow into your target.

Dragonborn Innkeeper.name:
龙裔旅店老板
Dragonborn Innkeeper

Text.text:
年代的青绿沿着这名龙裔宽阔肩头的青铜鳞片镶出一圈边缘，可他嶙峋的面庞仍带着几分少年般的神采。他把一把满溢的酒杯搁到一旁，抬眼看你，露出热情的笑容。他的尾巴卷起一块布轻轻扬起，他顺势握住，擦去洒落的麦酒，目光却自始至终未曾离开你。
The green of age rims the bronze scales of this dragonborn’s broad shoulders, but his craggy face retains a youthful guise. He sets aside a fistful of full tankards and regards you with a welcoming grin. His tail drifts up with a cloth upon it, and he takes it in hand to wipe at some spilled ale without ever once taking his eyes off you.

I Breathe Normally With My Necklace Of A.name:
我戴着适应项链，呼吸如常。
I Breathe Normally With My Necklace Of Adaptation

Text.text:
有毒的气浪翻卷，旧法术沉降的雾霭在四周痉挛般聚拢、鼓胀、喷吐。项链如今仿佛由空气织成，在我喉间一下一下地搏动。尽管眼睛微微刺痛，混杂的气味令人作呕，我仍深吸一口气——出乎意料地顺畅。
Billows of noxious gases and settling fogs of old spells gather and puff up in spasms all around. The necklace seems a thing of air now, pulsing around my throat. Although my eyes sting a bit and the smell of it all is repulsive, I take a deep breath and find that it comes easy.

Skull Lasher Of Myrkul.name:
米尔寇之颅鞭者
Skull Lasher Of Myrkul

Text.text:
死灵能量如饥渴的火焰般吞没了邪教徒的连枷，在这柄武器骷髅形槌头的眼眶里灼灼燃烧，宛如不祥的巫火。狂信者枯槁蜡黄的皮肤上遍布阴森刺青——每一道都是对他们腐朽之神的神圣崇拜印记。
Necrotic energy engulfs the cultist’s flail like a ravenous flame, burning in the sockets of the weapon’s skull-shaped head like baleful witch light. Macabre tattoos decorate the fanatic’s withered, sallow flesh—each one a mark of divine adulation to their rotting god.

当你念出法术的最后一个音节，口中顿时泛起一股苦涩的金属腥味，仿佛方才含过铅块。你周围的空气骤然变得沉重，一阵失落感将你淹没——某种对你而言如四肢力量般自然、如呼吸般熟稔的东西悄然消散——你知道，法术已经生效。你身周的魔法不复存在。
As you utter the last syllable of the spell a bitter tang fills your mouth, like you had sucked on lead. The air around you suddenly feels heavy, and a sense of loss overcomes you—as something as natural and familiar to you as the strength of your limbs vanishes—and you know the spell has taken effect. Magic around you is impossible.

Resurrection Magic Countered.name:
复活魔法遭到反制
Resurrection Magic Countered

Text.text:
你吟诵出法术的最后字句，咬紧牙关，准备迎接复活所伴随的那股排山倒海般的能量洪潮。魔法在你意识的边缘鼓胀、推挤，试图与你建立连接，试图流经你的身躯，如同以往那样穿透伤痛，治愈倒下之人。可取而代之的，是一股冰冷而恶毒的存在向你伸出触须，像水灌进溺水水手的肺里一般，悄无声息地渗入你的脑海。你手中宝石周围跳舞的光尘逐渐黯淡，纷纷坠落，沉入黑暗——而你朋友那苍白、玻璃般的眼睛，正冷冷审判着你的失败。

~ Paperpain 所构想

You intone the final words of the spell and brace yourself for the overwhelming sensation of energy that accompanies a resurrection. The magic pushes at the edge of your consciousness, trying to connect with you, to flow through you and heal the fallen as it has before. A cold malevolent presence reaches out to you in its place, seeping into your mind like water into a drowning sailor’s lungs. The motes of light dancing around the gem in your hands fade and fall away to darkness—and your friend’s pale, glassy eyes judge your failure.

~ Envisioned by Paperpain

Bracers Of Defense.name:
防御护腕
Bracers Of Defense

Text.text:
这对厚实的皮护腕外侧各铆着一片盾形钢板。每面小盾中央都镶着一枚蓝色宝石，宝石同样呈盾形。你说不清缘由，但光是看着它们，你就觉得更安心了。
These thick leather bracers each have shield-shaped sheets of steel affixed to their outsides. Each shield has a single blue gem set in its center, the gems similarly shield-shaped. You’re not sure why, but simply looking at them makes you feel safer.

这具瘦骨嶙峋的身影虽有如尸骸般的面容，却仍外溢着异界的威能。他们的双眼自深陷的颅骨眼窝中燃起猩毒的翠绿火焰，那道锐利的凝视仿佛能汲走你体内的全部力气，将你立足之处的灵魂一寸寸拆解。黑色的头箍冠于额上，闪烁着不祥而诡异的光；枯槁扭结的双手紧攥一根波纹起伏的金属长杖。猩红长袍——曾经华美——披覆双肩，破碎翻飞，如帷幕般遮掩着那具早已超越死亡仍顽存的骸骨；而在巫妖神祇肋骨笼罩后的深深空腔里，昔日跳动的心脏早已不在，只余一个幽深而无尽的虚无，贪婪地饥渴着那些它再也无法握持之物。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The emaciated figure exudes otherworldly power despite their corpse-like visage. Their eyes burn a virulent green from the sunken pits of their skull, a piercing gaze that seems to sap the very strength from you, unraveling your soul where you stand. A black circlet crowns their head, gleaming with an uncanny light, and in gnarled hands they clutch a stave of rippled metal. Crimson robes—once resplendent—drape their shoulders, tattered and billowing, shrouding a skeletal form that persists well beyond death; and in the deep hollow behind the lich god’s ribcage, where once beat a living heart, a deep and infinite void hungers for that which it can never again hold.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

那猫科野兽缓缓移动，小心翼翼，光滑的黑色皮毛下紧绷的肌肉蓄势待发。两条怪异、仿佛异界之物的触须从这生物的肩头生出，末端是带倒刺的触感须。随着一闪而逝的剧毒紫烟，野兽骤然消失，除了一缕残雾外不留任何痕迹。
The feline beast moves slowly, carefully, taut muscles tensed beneath sleek, black fur. A pair of strange, alien-looking tendrils sprout from the creature’s shoulders, ending in barbed feelers. In a flash of virulent purple smoke, the beast vanishes, leaving no trace beyond a wisp.

Act Two Of Pierced By Moonlight Begins.name:
被月光刺穿：第二幕开始
Act Two Of Pierced By Moonlight Begins

Text.text:
阶段亮起，迎来一幕喧嚣鼎沸的新场景。背景幕布描绘着一条城市街道，两侧是用炭笔勾勒的歪斜楼房。群演挤作一团，围住两名正绕圈对峙的斗者——他们的步伐精确而轻柔，宛如芭蕾舞者。每张脸都涂上浓重阴影，衬出嫉妒、愤怒与厌恶的狰狞表情。其中一名决斗者是男主角：他将丝质紧身上衣换成了扭曲的暗铁胸甲。另一名是个发辫如恐怖绳索般纠结的女人，穿着无袖血红衬衫与细条纹长裤，棕色肌肤撒上粉笔灰，仿出病态的苍白。她怒吼着，猛然从围巾腰带里抽出一把刃口钝涩的舞台剑。男主角也如法炮制，带着夸张花哨的身段，从腰间抽出一柄弯刀。

~ 出自惊艳的TTRPG增补The Vineyard

The stage alights for a new scene full of clamor. The backdrop depicts a city street lined with crooked buildings drawn in charcoal. The ensemble actors crowd around two combatants circling one another with the precise, soft steps of ballet dancers. Their faces are painted with deep shadows to accentuate gruesome expressions of jealousy, anger, and disgust. One of the duelists is the leading man, his silk jerkin traded in for a twisted, dark iron chestplate. The other is a woman with dreaded hair, wearing a sleeveless blood-red shirt and pinstripe pants, her brown skin dusted with chalk to mimic pallor. She cries out, furious, and pulls a dull-edged stage sword from her scarf belt. The leading man does the same, pulling a scimitar out of his belt with a fanciful flourish.

~ Found in the amazing TTRPG supplement The Vineyard

Offer To Quest Against Corruption.name:
提议踏上讨伐腐化的征程
Offer To Quest Against Corruption

Text.text:
“这个计划，解决不了这地方所有的烂摊子。那些镀金的狗杂种把爪子扎得太深了，哪有那么容易拔出来。但这至少是个开始。我也跟你直说——要是连我这种人都觉得非做不可，那就说明事情真的已经坏到骨子里了。”
“This plan, it won’t fix everything wrong with this place. Those gilded bastards have sunk their claws too deep for that. But it’ll be a start. And let me tell you, if someone like me thinks it needs to be done then things have truly gone wrong.”

Infant Wearing Magical Helm.name:
戴着魔法头盔的婴儿
Infant Wearing Magical Helm

Text.text:
孩子一边玩耍一边欢快地咿呀作声，纯真的笑意点亮了他小小的圆脸。他转向灿烂的太阳，闭上眼睛，享受暖意落在那迅速长出雀斑的肌肤上。门口传来呼唤，吸引了他的注意；他扭头望去，只见父母正朝他招手，笑容温暖而慈爱。他开始在地上爬行，兴奋得尖叫出声，却被头上戴着的附魔头盔压得沉甸甸的，路线不由得歪了一点。父母忍着笑，看着婴儿因这条新轨迹而皱起眉头。他倔强地逼迫四肢听从指挥，在他们的欢呼声中一点点纠正方向。

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

The child burbles happily as he plays, a smile born of innocence lighting up his small, round face. Turning to face the beaming sun, he closes his eyes, enjoying the warmth on his rapidly freckling skin. A call from the doorway draws his attention and he turns to see his parents beckoning him, their smiles warm and loving. He begins to crawl across the ground, shrieking with joy, though he is weighed down by the enchanted helm he wears and veers slightly off. His parents stifle giggles as the infant frowns at his new trajectory. He stubbornly forces his limbs to obey his commands, correcting his course as they cheer him on.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

一抹朦胧的剪影凝聚成形——一具瘦削的人形身影，步伐踉跄，仿佛醉酒。它毫无可辨的五官；望向它，就像透过结霜的窗玻璃窥视。接着，它消失了，然而……又并非全然消失。某种幽灵般的余响仍滞留其间，如同游魂，只由凝结成块的尘埃构成。尘埃猛地一颤，随即在十英尺更近处再次显现。它跌撞着向前，身形在现实空间里忽隐忽现。
A hazy silhouette materializes, a lean, humanoid-shaped being, moving as if drunk. It possesses no discernible features; viewing them is like looking out of a frosty window. Then, they disappear, though… not quite. A ghostly resonance, like a specter, remains, made all of clotted dust. The dust judders, then reappears ten feet closer. It stumbles forward, phasing in and out of realspace.

Aira Flamerest, Duergar Wizard.name:
艾拉·焰息，灰矮人巫师
Aira Flamerest, Duergar Wizard

Text.text:
这位结实的矮人女子在黑色绗甲外披着紫罗兰色长袍，皮肤呈蓝灰色，眼眸淡得近乎苍白。她脚蹬长靴，前臂套着深色鳞纹皮革护臂，边缘以刻满符文的钢条收束。她那炭黑的头发在发梢渐亮成橘红，编成繁复长辫垂过肩头，直落至背部中央；辫间扣着一枚枚刻符钢发箍与环扣，冷光森然。她腰间同样系着鳞纹皮革腰带，其上挂着一只长方形挎包：前袋里露出一本厚重巨著的书脊，皮与钢共同装订。她左手紧握一根扭曲的黑铁魔杖，杖身渐收成尖，杖尖灼红如烙铁。她的目光锐利而精算，像在衡量每一步的代价。

~ Envisioned by The Hermit

Dressed in violet robes under a black gambeson, this sturdy dwarven woman has blue-gray skin and pale eyes. She wears boots and bracers of dark, scaly leather with rune-etched steel trimmings. Her charcoal hair, which brightens to orange-red near the ends, hangs in elaborate braids over her shoulders to the middle of her back and is adorned with steel hair cuffs and loops, all runed. From her belt, also of scaly leather, hangs a rectangular satchel: the spine of a thick tome, bound in leather and steel, peeks from its front compartment. In her left hand, the woman grips a wand of twisted black iron that tapers to a point, the tip glowing red-hot. Her gaze is intense and calculating.

~ Envisioned by The Hermit

Brass Forge City.name:
黄铜锻炉城
Brass Forge City

Text.text:
山坡上烟雾缭绕，蒸汽翻涌。烧焦的土腥与金属味，混着烟与灰的气息，悬在温热的空气里。宽阔、凿刻精美、覆以黄铜板的高塔内，工坊轰鸣运转，从镶黄铜的石质烟囱喷吐火舌与浓烈的蒸汽。岩石步道与桥梁将一座座建筑相连。有的只供行人穿行，有的则让工人沿着轨道推着黄铜轮小车往来。漆黑、蝠翼般的幼龙与双足飞龙在塔顶高度盘旋，或驮着骑手，或运送货物。整座城市的行动喧响在四周山谷间回荡。

~ Envisioned by Xephyr

The mountainside smokes and steams. Odors of burnt earth and metal, smoke and ash, hang in the warm air. Workshops in broad, carved, brass-plated towers blast flame and vapors from chimney stacks of brass-lined stone. Rock walkways and bridges connect the various edifices. Some carry only foot traffic, but others facilitate workers pushing brass-wheeled carts along tracks. Dark, bat-winged drakes and wyverns wheel around the tower heights, carrying riders or cargo. The din of the city’s activity echoes in the surrounding valley.

~ Envisioned by Xephyr

Librarian's Assistant.name:
图书管理员的助手
Librarian's Assistant

Text.text:
图书馆里充满了安静的喧闹——各色教授、学生与好奇的本地人穿梭忙碌，寻找能解答他们炽热疑问的那本书。一名学生怅然地望着旁边书架顶端。一个助理乘着一把漂浮的椅子靠近，椅身刷着梦幻的天蓝色。座椅与扶手都垫得厚实，即便助理身体微微倾向一侧，也稳稳地被托住。他们轻轻一点头，问：“在找？”学生指了指，咕哝了句你听不清的话。助理又点了点头，随即扬起一丝坏笑。“看好了。”椅子越升越高，直到助理伸手抓到那本书；他们缓缓降下，把书递到学生手中。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The library is full of quiet commotion—various professors, students, and curious locals bustling around in search of the text that will answer their burning questions. One student gazes forlornly at the top of a nearby shelf. An assistant approaches them in a floating chair painted a wonderful sky blue. It has ample padding on the seat and arms, keeping the assistant secure despite their leaning to one side. They offer a short nod and ask, “Looking?” The student points and mutters something you cannot hear. The assistant nods once more then smirks. “Watch this.” The chair rises higher and higher until the assistant can grab the book; they descend and hand it to the student.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

高大臃肿、蛤蟆般的生物拖拽着四肢在地上爬行，邪恶的利爪在泥土里犁出一道道深沟。它猩红的皮肤如橡胶般湿滑，遍布疣瘤，在光下泛着黏腻的亮泽；这恶魔般的生物毒涎横流的长舌从口中耷拉出来，滴落着黏液。它那对细小的血红眼珠、竖直的瞳孔锁定了你，随即发出一声蛙鸣般的尖啸，恶臭的唾沫四散飞溅，巨蛤猛然冲锋而来。
The towering, bulbous, toad-like creature drags its limbs along the ground, carving ruts into the earth with its wicked claws. Its crimson skin, rubbery and riddled with warts, glistens as the fiendish creature's virulent tongue lolls from its mouth, dripping slime. Beady, blood-red eyes with vertical pupils fall upon you, and with a croaking screech that sends foul-smelling spittle in all directions, the toad charges.

你手腕轻轻一抖，物体便被奥术能量裹缠，猛然朝你的目标掷去。它如微缩彗星般划破长空，投射物带着骇人的速度疾冲而前，仿佛由攻城器械轰然发射。
With a flick of your wrist, the object is surrounded by arcane energy and hurled toward your target. Flying through the air like a miniature comet, your projectile streaks forward with terrifying speed as if launched by a siege engine.

一只好奇、带着小妖精（特征）气息的类猿生物用指节一路磕磕碰碰地往前挪，忽而翻身仰躺，顽皮地来回摇晃，把灰色泥浆蹭满那蓬松的蓝褐色毛皮。灵巧的手指与脚趾抓住它的躯体，细细拨弄，捏出几只小昆虫。它移动时骨头也跟着颤动，随需求重塑形状。蓝色毛发间有一波电能蜿蜒游走，汹涌翻腾，宛如风暴中的海面。
A curious sprite-like simian knuckles its way forward before tipping onto its back, rocking playfully to-and-fro, coating its tufty blue-brown fur with gray muck. Nimble fingers and toes grip at its body, plucking out small insects. Bones wobble as it moves, re-forming to the creature’s needs. A wave of electric energy wiggles along the blue fur, surging like a stormy sea.

Mansion In Decline.name:
日渐衰败的庄园
Mansion In Decline

Text.text:
灯光从点缀在崩塌外墙上的窗户里微弱地闪烁。藤蔓幽暗而扭曲，沿着庄园蔓延攀覆；下方杂草丛生的花园仿佛要将它整个吞没。一抹褪色的金色锦缎因疏于照料而片片剥落，却仍从浓密的枝叶间探出头来，渴望像往昔那样被人仰望。

~ 一位英雄 Envisioned

Lights flicker weakly from the windows dotting the crumbling façade of the building. Vines, dark and twisted, spread over the manor as the overgrown garden beneath tries to swallow it whole. A faded gold brocade, flaking from neglect, peeks through the dense foliage, desperate to be admired as it once was.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Temple To A Twilight Goddess Of The Drow.name:
卓尔暮光女神的神殿
Temple To A Twilight Goddess Of The Drow

Text.text:
整座神殿皆由蛛网编织而成——数以百万计的黏丝，精巧如蕾丝，绷在轻质骨架上，构成一座灰蒙蒙的小建筑。树脂长椅与祭坛陈列在黑色大理石讲坛前，脚下同样是黑色大理石地面；紫水晶壁托上，魔法火炬无声燃烧。这里回荡的圣歌夹杂着独特的咔哒与嘶嘶声——那是常栖于神殿墙网的蜘蛛被放大的声响；它们还从椽梁垂下的银色长丝上倒悬而下。
The entire temple is crafted from cobwebs—millions of sticky strands, intricate as lace, stretched over lightweight frames into a small gray building. Resin pews and an altar stand before a black marble pulpit on a black marble floor, magical torches burning in amethyst sconces. The religious chants heard here include special clicks and hisses, the magnified sounds of the spiders that frequent the webs of the temple walls and hang on long silver lines from the rafters.

Ancient White Dragon.name:
远古白龙
Ancient White Dragon

Text.text:
若雪崩能够具现，必定就是这副模样。它庞大而可怖，那怪物般的身躯仿佛随时都会轰然倾泻而下，直扑你而来。龟裂冰板般的鳞片层层叠叠，像铠甲一样裹住它公牛般的躯体；其上投下两翼的阴影——巨大、覆皮如革，白若新雪。巨龙那粗钝而骇人的面孔咧开一道狞笑，锯齿般的尖牙森然毕露。
If an avalanche could be embodied, surely it would take this form. Massive and terrible, its monstrous body seems ready to come roaring down upon you at any moment. Scales like plates of cracked ice cake its bull-like body in armoring layers, shadowed by vast, leathery wings as white as snow. The dragon’s blunt and fearsome face cracks open in a fiendish grin of jagged teeth.

Key To A Cemetery.name:
通往墓园的钥匙
Key To A Cemetery

Text.text:
一颗尖叫的骷髅构成这把巨型钥匙的钥匙头；钥匙本体由沉重的铸铁打造，外覆斑驳剥落的白色搪瓷。骷髅大张的口中咬着一根长骨，化作钥匙的钥匙杆；而钥匙的匙齿则像一截下颌骨，参差犬牙般的碎齿组成齿槽。
A screaming skull forms the bow of this oversized key, which is heavy cast iron enameled in chipped white paint. A long bone held in the skull’s gaping mouth creates the key’s shank, and the bit looks like a jawbone, snaggled teeth creating the wards.

Seamy Massage Parlor.name:
肮脏的按摩院
Seamy Massage Parlor

Text.text:
钉在墙上的蓝色壁灯忽明忽灭，在这处被木板封死的窗与一扇合上便自锁的厚门所钉死于阴影里的地方，只吝啬地洒下几缕光。前台接待是个上了年纪的男人，挂着一抹令人作呕的笑；他眼里的神情被一副泛着棕褐色的墨镜遮得严严实实。厚实得像堡垒的前台柜台挡住了他大半身子，只剩那颗带笑的脑袋在上面一晃一晃。柜台后的珠帘深处传来一声咯咯笑——那种自动播放、预先录好的声音。珠串之间有两只青蓝色的眼睛在幽幽发亮，奶油色的塑料手指从帘后探出，穿梭拨弄着珠线。“肉的还是机的？”接待问道，牙齿一闪，嵌着金属的齿面亮得刺眼——门牙上的铂金牙冠从齿形扭成獠牙。
Blue lamps bolted to the walls fizzle in and out, offering meager light in a place committed to shadow by boarded-up windows and a heavy door that locks upon closing. The receptionist is an older man with a shit-eating grin, the expression in his eyes hidden by sepia-tinged sunglasses. The bulwark of a front desk obscures most of his body except his smiling, bobbing head. A giggle sounds from beyond the beaded curtains behind his desk—an automated, pre-recorded kind of sound. Two teal-blue eyes glow from behind the beaded strands, and cream-colored plastic fingers thread through. “Flesh or tech?” asks the receptionist, his teeth flashing with inlaid metal, platinum caps on his incisors morphing tooth to fang.

Mountain Peak Above The Clouds.name:
云巅之上的山峰
Mountain Peak Above The Clouds

Text.text:
群山的峰顶远远探出第一层云海之上。绵软如枕的白色海洋铺展至天际，风如温柔的潮汐缓缓起伏。寒气刺骨，却清冽新鲜。宁静在此久久徘徊。
The mountain peeks far above the first cloud layer. A sea of pillowy white stretches over the horizon, and the wind acts as a gentle rolling tide. The cold air is biting but crisp and fresh. A peaceful stillness lingers.

Fighting A Clockwork Entity.name:
与发条造物交战
Fighting A Clockwork Entity

Text.text:
你眼前的东西有着人的轮廓，却毫无人性。它由上漆的木头与闪亮的金属拼成，在空中腾跃起舞，动作古怪而难以捉摸。你仿佛在与一具骇人巨大的木偶搏斗——可它没有丝线，也无人牵引。
The thing before you possesses the shape of a human but has none of the humanity. Made of painted wood and gleaming metal, it leaps and dances through the air, its movements odd and unpredictable. It feels as though you fight a terrifyingly large puppet, but no one pulls its strings.

High Seas: Caught In The Storm.name:
公海：困于风暴之中
High Seas: Caught In The Storm

Text.text:
你分不清此刻是白昼还是黑夜。天空黑得发沉，雨水像一桶桶倾倒下来，乌云只在闪电的瞬间才显出轮廓。暴雨灌满甲板，又被越过舷缘砸落的巨浪冲刷殆尽。奔涌的水在四处翻搅，像是无处不在的混乱。就算你整个人沉在水里，也不会觉得有这么湿。
You can’t tell if it’s night or day. Water buckets from a sky turned black, the clouds visible only in flashes of lightning. The downpour floods the deck and gets washed away by waves crashing over the gunwales. The chaos of moving water seems to be everywhere. You could be fully submerged in liquid, and it wouldn’t feel this wet.

Alkanos Winterfall.name:
阿尔卡诺斯·冬陨
Alkanos Winterfall

Text.text:
他身着黑色皮衣，披着午夜蓝斗篷；个头不高，却以一双绿眼投来冰冷的凝视。嘴唇绷成一道硬线，脸上不见半分笑纹。苍白的皮肤与金发在暗色装束中格外扎眼，胸前别着一枚银质胸针，嵌着与斗篷同色的宝石。腰侧挂着一柄阔剑，收在黑色剑鞘里。五个身影立在他周围，各自披着不同深浅的蓝色斗篷。

~ 扮演者：Franghiskhan

Dressed in black leather and a midnight-blue cloak, this short man fixes his green eyes in a cold gaze. His mouth forms a hard line, and no laugh lines mar his face. Pale skin and blonde hair stand out from his dark attire, as does a silver brooch with a jewel that matches his cloak. At his hip hangs a broadsword sheathed in a black scabbard. About him stand five other figures, each cloaked in a different blue hue.

~ Played by Franghiskhan

A Building Instantly Ages.name:
一栋建筑瞬间老化
A Building Instantly Ages

Text.text:
灰泥褪色龟裂——碎屑簌簌崩落，洒向下方的鹅卵石街道；窗户也被潮霉的污垢蒙成一片浑浊。木料变得松软，腐烂成浆，铰链锈死，伴着一声扭曲的呻吟——你眼前的建筑在弹指间走完了一生的衰老。
Plaster fades and cracks—crumbling onto the cobblestone street below as windows become opaque with musty grime. Wood softens, rotting into pulp and hinges rust shut with a tortured groan—as the building before you ages a lifetime in the blink of an eye.

Umber Hulk Crashing Through A Cavern Wal.name:
赭巨虫撞碎洞窟岩壁
Umber Hulk Crashing Through A Cavern Wall

Text.text:
地面猛然一震，轰隆作响；你还来不及探查，洞窟的一面岩壁便在飞溅的碎石与泥土中炸裂开来。烟尘云里踏出一团迟缓沉重的甲壳板块，厚重的几丁质在昏暗中泛着冷光。那生物张开巨大的前臂，关节噼啪作响，颚钳震颤着，饥饿的狂热几乎要从每一次嗡鸣里溢出来。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The ground rumbles in a sudden tremor and, before you can investigate, one of the cavern walls explodes in a shower of rock and dirt. Out of the cloud emerges a lumbering mass of chitinous plate. The creature spreads its massive forearms with a crackle, mandibles vibrating in hungry zeal.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Sundries From A Beckoning Lich.name:
来自召唤巫妖的杂货
Sundries From A Beckoning Lich

Text.text:
巫妖的骸骨之躯早已腐朽得连不死之身都支撑不住，只剩一堆霉烂的残渣，堆在他们空荡荡鼓胀起伏的长袍下方。翻检那身破碎而染血的衣物，你摸到一只装满灰烬的小锡盒，以及一本以一种令人不安地光滑油腻的皮革装订的日记。
The lich’s skeletal form has degraded beyond even undeath, leaving nothing but a pile of moldering residue beneath the empty billow of their robes. Rifling through their torn and bloody clothing reveals a small tin box full of ashes and a journal bound with an upsettingly smooth and oily leather.

Sundries From A Stirge.name:
来自吸血蚊蝠的杂货
Sundries From A Stirge

Text.text:
当最后一只吸血蚊坠落，你在沼泽泥淖里瞥见了它们先前一名受害者腐烂的残躯。你搜检旅人的尸身，找到一对黄铜戒环，以一条粗制滥造的链子相连。
As the last stirge falls, you notice the decaying form of one of their previous victims in the mire of the swamp. Searching the traveler’s body, you find a pair of brass rings linked by a shoddy chain.

Sadistic Cult Magus.name:
施虐邪教魔导师
Sadistic Cult Magus

Text.text:
女术士的脸上爬过一道残忍而掠食的笑意，她用刀刃划过求道者柔嫩的皮肉。她合上双眼，细细品味他们痛苦的哀嚎，深知他们已彻底落入她的掌心。她沉溺在支配跪地少年的快感里，舌尖掠过丰润饱满的唇——仿佛在品尝一杯上好的美酒。

~ 构想 by LInk

A cruel, predatory smile slithers across the face of the magus as she runs her knife across the aspirant’s tender flesh. Closing her eyes, she savors their cries of agony, knowing they are completely at her mercy. She languishes in the thrill of the power she holds over the kneeling youth, running her tongue across her rich, full lips—as if sampling an exquisite wine.

~ Envisioned by LInk

Quip About Dividing Loot.name:
关于分赃的俏皮话
Quip About Dividing Loot

Text.text:
“好，在我们按需求或实用性开始分这些东西之前，我想让大家先想象一下——穿在我身上会有多好看。”
“Ok, before we start divvying this stuff up based on need or usefulness, I’d like everyone to picture just how good it’d look on me.”

I Investigate A Magical Device.name:
我调查一件魔法装置
I Investigate A Magical Device

Text.text:
这件古怪的装置在我掌中翻转时轻轻咔哒作响，低低嗡鸣，我一边端详着它的结构，一边检查那复杂的机括。关节般的构件中央，一点柔和的蓝光缓缓脉动。忽然，装置像钟声连鸣般清脆作响，我猛地一震，一股诡异的麻刺感沿着皮肤悄然爬行，顺着手臂一路蔓延上去——但我敢肯定，没问题。
The odd device clicks and whirs gently as I turn it over in my hands, examining the mechanism. A soft blue light pulses slowly at the center of the articulated contraption. I feel a jolt as the device chimes like a pealing bell, and an odd tingling sensation begins to creep across my skin, spreading up my arms—but I’m sure it’s fine.

Dismissal By A Wealthy Quest Giver After.name:
富有的委托人在任务失败后冷冷将你们打发走
Dismissal By A Wealthy Quest Giver After A Failed Quest

Text.text:
“看你这副模样，你吃了不少苦头。但你的痛苦与我无关。你向我保证能完成这项差事，却失败了。反过来，你让我也尝到了痛苦，所以我想我们算扯平了。我会饶你们一命，但对那些只兑现一半的承诺、只做了一半的活计，我一文不付。”
“By the looks of you, you’ve suffered a great deal. But your pain is not my concern. You assured me you could finish this task and you failed. This, in turn, has caused me pain, so I suppose we are even. I will allow you to keep your lives, but I offer no payment for promises half kept and jobs half done.”

你在施放这个法术时，脑海里只攥住一幅画面：衬衫上的一个破洞。你的心眼凝视着那破洞，忽略其余一切。接着你复制那片布料与破洞，将它微微错移，却在想象中层层叠覆，让破洞始终留在原处。你再做一次，然后再做——再做千次。你在魔法的织纹里编出一段空无，将其披覆在一颗心智之上。
You hold one image in your thoughts as you cast this spell: a hole in a shirt. Your mind’s eye examines that hole and ignores everything else. Then you duplicate the fabric and the hole, shifting it slightly, but overlaid in your imagination so the hole remains. You do this again, then a thousand times more, weaving a void in the fabric of magic that you place around a mind.

这座由粗大木梁与灰浆砌石垒成的桥梁——宽得足以让一辆货车通过——横跨一道沟壑。几面以夺目金属织物制成的旗帜在微风中猎猎作响，其上绣着当地势力的徽记。桥梁正中，沟壑上方高高处，矗立着一扇沉重的橡木闸门，铁箍加固。随着你们靠近，两名守卫立于紧闭的门前，目光警惕不移，双手紧握长矛。
The bridge of heavy timbers and mortared stone—wide enough for a cart to cross—spans a gully. Banners of bold metallic fabric flutter in the breeze, bearing the emblem of the local power. At the mid-point of the bridge, high above the gully, sits a heavy oaken gate reinforced with iron. A pair of guards stand before the closed door, ever watchful, spears clutched in their hands, as you approach.

Floating Aqua Chair.name:
漂浮的水蓝座椅
Floating Aqua Chair

Text.text:
一颗装满清澈水的玻璃球体，体积大得仿佛能容下一名中等身高的人形生物，正贴着地面上方缓缓漂浮，伴着一丝低沉的魔法嗡鸣。球体来回轻轻摇曳时，水色偏青绿的水面只是温柔地晃动，轻得不足以惊扰任何可能在其中搭便车的水栖族群。底部伸出四枚金属突起，每一枚都铸成鳍状——像水晶球底座的支架，只是这些“脚”从不触地。随着球体越过不同的高低起伏与地形，那些鳍边便暗燃成深蓝色，使这艘容器能避开刮擦地面与任何障碍物。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

A glass orb full of clear water, seemingly large enough to fit one humanoid of average height, floats just above the ground with a slight hum of magic. As the orb hovers to and fro, its teal waters slosh only gently, not enough to disturb any aquatic folk that might hitch a ride inside. A set of four metal protrusions, each molded into a finlike shape, stick out from the bottom—much like the stand of a crystal ball, though these “feet” never reach the ground. As the orb floats over different elevations and terrain, the fins smolder a deep blue color and allow the vessel to avoid scraping against the floor or any obstacles.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Synquinal Luphaxol.name:
辛奎纳尔·卢法索尔
Synquinal Luphaxol

Text.text:
半精灵那苍白的皮肤、银色的眼眸与铂金色的头发，让他看上去冷冽如幽影；再加上那疏离而严峻的神情，更是寒意逼人。他身着华贵的深蓝长袍，行走间，皮肤上会浮现出虹彩般的微光斑驳流转。那是种诡异的魔法效果，像鱼儿贴着洒满阳光的水面掠过时，鳞片一闪一闪的光泽。

~ 由 Davis Summer 在 Played 中扮演，

The half-elf’s pale skin, silver eyes, and platinum hair give him a cold, spectral look, unhelped by his distant, austere expression. He wears luxurious robes of rich blue color, and as he moves, patches of his skin shine iridescent. It is a strange, magical effect that resembles the look of a fish’s scales as it skims the surface of sunlit water.

~ Played by Davis Summer with

一团扭曲盘绕的群蛇纠结蠕动，优雅地在这柄怪异细剑的握柄周围织成篮形护手；抛光的剑身上跳跃着一层翠绿的光泽。握柄本身覆着如蛇肤般的鳞片，黑色皮革在你视线下起伏游动，仿佛活物一般。
A writhing mass of twisted snakes forms an elegant basket hilt around the handle of this strange rapier, and a viridian sheen dances along the polished blade. The handle itself is scaled like the flesh of a serpent, the black leather undulating beneath your gaze as if it were alive.

你从身上扯下一小撮绒毛任其飘远，朝你的目标投去阴狠的怒视。那生物怔怔回望，恍惚了一瞬。紧接着，你仅在想象中烙下的画面化作你敌人的现实——逼真到即便出现矛盾，也只会催生自圆其说的借口，而非怀疑。这种自我合理化足以致命，因为心智会为幻象造成的任何伤害找出理由。
Releasing a bit of fleece to float away from you, you give your target a wicked glare. The creature stares, dumbfounded for a split second. Then, an image you have imprinted only in imagination becomes reality for your foe—so real that any contradiction begets excuses rather than disbelief. This rationalization can prove deadly, as the mind will justify any damage the illusion deals.

Divine Library Of A God Of Knowledge.name:
知识之神的神圣图书馆
Divine Library Of A God Of Knowledge

Text.text:
沿着耐心之径，穿过沉闷的荆棘，必须撬开历史之门上的锁。一座花园在昏昏欲睡的莲花薄雾中铺展，直抵信息之墙。直觉的凹形门扉通向逻辑的凸起地面。这扇门带你穿过北墙上的生命之树。你对面矗立着一座巨大的壁炉。东墙是一扇大窗，窗外是繁星之夜；西墙则是一道瀑布。房间里的一座讲台上放着一本沉重而古老的书，摊开着，像一抹微笑。
Down the path of patience, through brambles of doldrum, the lock on the gate of history must be picked. A garden, diffuse with sleepy lotus flowers, stretches toward walls of information. The concave door of intuition leads to the convex floor of logic. This door takes you through a tree of life in the north wall. Across from you stands an immense fireplace. The east wall is a great window looking on a night of stars, the west a waterfall. On a lectern in the room lies a heavy, ancient book, open like a smile.

漂浮在藤编贡多拉船体上方的，是一枚鼓胀的巨型丝绸圆球，涂着俗艳刺目的彩绘；它庞大的体量被一团扭曲如蛛网的网绳紧紧包裹。拴住这套装置的缆绳吱呀呻吟，仿佛狂风正一心要把这巨物拽离地面。气囊那张张开的巨口下方，蹲伏着一只奥术火盆，闪烁的表面刻满秘会符号与妖异咒纹。它腹腔深处传来滚雷般的笑声，一股股巫术烈焰凭空喷涌，直冲进上方不断膨胀的囊体之中。
Floating over a wicker gondolier is a bulbous orb of gaudily painted silk, its bulk encapsulated within a twisted mass of web-like netting. The ropes holding down the contraption creak and groan as the wind seeks to carry the huge thing away. Beneath the gaping maw of the balloon squats an arcane brazier, cabalistic glyphs engraved upon its shimmering surface. From deep within its belly, laughter rumbles and gouts of sorcerous flame spontaneously belch up into the ever-growing bladder above.

Rope Bridge In Freezing Weather.name:
严寒天气中的绳索桥
Rope Bridge In Freezing Weather

Text.text:
桥面泛着湿冷的光泽，绳索上垂挂的冰锥在风中摇晃。整座桥随着冰层的吱嘎与呻吟发出刺耳的尖叫。雪花纷飞扑打在你脸上，你眯起眼，盯着眼前这座可能夺命的陷阱。
The surface of the bridge glistens and icicles dangle from the ropes swaying in the wind. The span squeals alarmingly as the ice creaks and groans. Flurries of snow dance about your face as you squint at the potential deathtrap before you.

Goliath Warrior Grows To Dragon Size.name:
歌利亚战士膨胀至巨龙体型
Goliath Warrior Grows To Dragon Size

Text.text:
当药剂最后几滴滑过战士的喉咙时，不可思议的变化发生了。他们本就惊人的体型骤然翻倍、再三倍，仿佛泰坦般向上拔升，直到与巨龙的目光平齐，成为它的同等对手。那生物发出震耳欲聋的咆哮，厌恶这份公然的反抗，随即猛扑向前……

~ 由 Stubbenz 在 Discord 上 Envisioned

As the last few drops of the potion slide down the warrior's throat, something incredible happens. Their already prodigious size doubles, then triples as they expand upward like a titan, until they meet the dragon's gaze as an equal. The creature bellows its distaste for the show of defiance and lunges forward…

~ Envisioned by Stubbenz on Discord

Church Building Repurposed As Countercul.name:
由教堂改造而成的反主流吸烟会所
Church Building Repurposed As Counterculture Smoking Lounge

Text.text:
这座教堂荒废多年，如今钟楼里却垂下一大段红绳，像是某个无人再能说清的内部玩笑。他们管它叫“红绳”——我是说那间休息室。长椅被挪到一旁，换成了潮人式的装潢：皮沙发、恰到好处的涂鸦、一只倒扣的浴缸。中殿前方，一套巨大的音响系统轰鸣作响，把教会布道混剪成城市流行。天窗倾泻下明亮光照，将满室烟雾照得纤毫毕现。吧台很大，招牌上写着“概念酒精”——天知道那是什么。

~ 由 MasterfungiQ

The church had been ruined for many years, but now a long length of red rope hangs from the belfry, an inside joke nobody quite remembers. The Red Rope, they call it—the lounge, that is. The pews have been moved aside and replaced with hipster décor: leather sofas, tasteful graffiti, an upside-down bath. At the nave, a huge speaker system pumps out church sermons remixed into citypop. Skylights fill the room with bright light, making the smoke-filled air all the more easy to see. A large bar boasts “concept alcohol”—whatever that is.

~ Envisioned by MasterfungiQ

Gnoll In Scavenged Armor.name:
穿着拾荒护甲的豺狼人
Gnoll In Scavenged Armor

Text.text:
腐臭的唾沫在泛黄的獠牙间飞溅，豺狼人咆哮着，嗜血之意昭然若揭。猎手嗅到猎物的气味，斑点的黄色皮毛因兴奋而竖起，背上粗硬的赤红鬃毛根根炸立。锈蚀的、拼凑来的护甲松松垮垮地挂在这头野兽结实的躯体上，叮当作响；它踉跄向前，目光死死钉在自己的战利品上。
Rancid spittle flies between yellowed fangs as the gnoll roars, its bloodlust evident. As the hunter catches the scent of prey, spotted yellow fur bristles with excitement and the mane of coarse red on its back stands upright. Rusting, scavenged armor jangles loosely from the beast’s muscular form as it lollops forward, fixated on its prize.

Skyship Bow Ram.name:
飞空艇艏弓撞角
Skyship Bow Ram

Text.text:
黄铜包头的撞角如同一柄威武长枪，自船艏突刺而出，令人过目难忘。它以巨大的铁铆钉加固，又由整块橡木雕制而成；你不难想象，这件武器足以以骇人的轻易撕开敌船的船体，或是怪物厚实的皮甲。
Jutting from the bow of the ship like a mighty lance, the brass-tipped ram is a sight to behold. Reinforced with huge iron rivets, and crafted from solid oak, you imagine this weapon could tear through an opponent’s hull or monstrous hide with terrifying ease.

这名身形修长、仪态从容的男子，覆着浅绯色的鳞皮。乌黑浓密的发丛间探出两枚细小的暗色角，尖端仅比他那顶紫罗兰色的圆顶小礼帽帽檐高出些许。帽子的颜色与他的眼睛相互呼应；帽侧不用羽饰，而是钉着一枚铁钉。相似的黑铁铆钉点缀着他精致的棕色皮革锁子甲，外加护腕、胫甲，以及一侧加长的鳞钢护肩。其中一只护腕上扣着一面铁制小圆盾。腰带上，除了一柄带鞘的篮形护手细剑外，他还挂着一只抛光木制施舍箱，其上铆着银色巨龙的剪影。

~ Played by Corvo Attano with

This willowy, poised man has scaled skin of light crimson. From his mop of black hair peek two small, dark horns, the points rising only a little higher than the brim of his violet bycoket. The hat’s color matches that of his eyes; it also bears an iron nail in place of a feather. Similar black iron studs his fine hauberk of brown leather, supplemented with bracers, greaves, and a single long pauldron of scaled steel. One bracer bears an iron buckler. On his belt, alongside a sheathed, basket-hilted rapier, he carries an alms box of polished wood with the silvery silhouette of a dragon riveted to it.

~ Played by Corvo Attano with

Blight Resisted By All.name:
所有人均可抵抗枯萎
Blight Resisted By All

Text.text:
你的敌人们蜂拥而来。你将神祇的圣徽举在身前，感召死灵亡灭之力，释放出枯萎。你周遭的空气翻涌起致命的病恹气息，敌人们发出凄厉尖叫。他们的皮肤迅速灰白，却仍旧朝你冲来。
Your enemies rush toward you. You hold the symbol of your deity before you, calling on the power of necrotic death, and unleash the blight. The air around you evokes a deathly ill, and your foes scream out. Their skin pales, but still they rush forward.

狂风抽打着你的脸颊，你朝着冷酷无情的大地直坠而下，泪水被风逼得从眼角奔流。你勉强结结巴巴吐出一个奥秘音节——尽管声音被风夺走了惯常的响度——你的下坠随之放缓；你开始轻飘飘地在空中上下摇曳，像身旁那些懒洋洋盘旋的绒羽碎片一般。
Wind whips past your face, causing tears to stream from your eyes as you plummet toward the unforgiving earth. You manage to stammer out an arcane syllable—though robbed of your usual volume—and your descent slows; it becomes easy as you bob back and forth in the air, just like the fragments of down lazily spiraling around you.

Hearth With Sleeping Cat.name:
有只熟睡猫咪的炉边
Hearth With Sleeping Cat

Text.text:
在铺着旗石的壁炉旁的地面上，一只猫蜷成一团毛球，爪子盖在脸上。她把四条腿尽力伸展开来，仿佛下一刻就要飞起来，随后又轻轻抖了抖。她张嘴打了个哈欠，抬眼环顾，眸子里映着炉火的暖光，随即又蜷回原处。她低低地呼噜着，发出细小的鼾声；近旁火焰噼啪作响、嘶嘶轻鸣，把她这被宠爱的小小生命烘得暖融融的。
On the floor next to the flagstone hearth, a cat curls in a ball of fur, paws over her face. She stretches all four legs as far as they go, as if she might take flight, and then shakes a little. Her mouth opens in a yawn, and she looks around with eyes that reflect the warm firelight before curling back in again. She purrs and lets out tiny snores, and the pop and hiss of the fire nearby warms her charmed little life.

男人兴冲冲地一大口灌下去，让那本就鼓胀的啤酒肚更沉了几分；从他身旁堆着的空杯来看，他这么喝已经有好一阵子了。每当有人从旁经过，他就抛去一抹醉眼迷离的笑，几分可亲，随着一串嗝在他胸腔里翻滚。酒保对他说了句什么，他的笑声立刻灌满了整个酒吧。“这我得敬一杯！”
The man cheerfully adds to his already hefty beer gut with a big gulp, and based on the empty glasses nearby, he's been doing so quite some time. He offers a glassy-eyed grin to everyone who passes by, the look almost charming as hiccups roll through his body. The bartender says something to him, and his laughter fills the bar. "I'll drink to that!"

你面前的陵墓入口巍然矗立，宛如通往来世的门扉。石雕之门如同哨兵，守望着长眠其内之人。一股森然的威压自其间弥散，驱逐那些妄图闯入亡者疆域、趁隙掠夺的盗贼。
The mausoleum’s entrance before you looms like a doorway to the afterlife. Carved from stone, its door stands sentinel for those sleeping within. An aura of threat emanates from it, warding away thieves keen to enter the realm of the departed, to plunder what they can.

Twilight Goddess Of The Drow.name:
卓尔的暮光女神
Twilight Goddess Of The Drow

Text.text:
她那张无情的脸，色泽如黑莓酒，被一场发丝的暴雪所框住。那位坑与蛛网之母——她微笑时更可怖，还是阴沉时更骇人？上半身是女子，妖冶得令人心悸，裹着贴身的钢甲，抛光得亮如白银；而腰以下却是巨蛛之躯，鼓胀着蛛丝与毒液，长腿如节节相连的长矛。她成群的子嗣有着她的皮肤与头发，把她掠食者般的讯息带往诸界。
Her merciless face, the color of blackberry wine, is framed in a snowstorm of hair. Is she more fearsome when she smiles or when she scowls, the mother of pits and webs? A woman to the waist, beautifully wicked and clad in form-fitting steel polished bright as silver, but her form below is a giant spider, bulbous with silk and poison, legs like jointed pikes. Her swarming children have her skin and hair. They carry her predatory message to all the realms.

Sundries From A Babau.name:
巴巴乌的杂货
Sundries From A Babau

Text.text:
巴巴乌恶魔蜷成一团扭曲的残躯，薄唇向后扯出狰狞的弧度，露出一口残忍的獠牙。恶魔的弹带一片狼藉，挂满粗陋的铁制工具——钩子、锥子、钳子、针、锯片——每一件都锈着干涸的血迹。
The babau lies in a twisted heap, thin lips pulled back in a rictus of cruel fangs. The demon’s bandolier is a shambles of crude iron tools—hooks, awls, tongs, needles, saw blades—every one of them rusty with dried blood.

Manaproof Ipa: Ingested.name:
法力免疫 IPA：口服
Manaproof Ipa: Ingested

Text.text:
泡沫的滋味刺得舌头与喉咙发痛，余味拖着一层苦涩的薄膜。可当真正的啤酒落入胃中，你立刻觉得肩头所有烦恼的重量都被卸下。味道确实苦，却是令人欢迎的辛烈一口，将忧虑从脑海里剥离。你仿佛能在生活里轻飘飘地浮行，而非沉重跋涉——一种欣快感，随每一口啜饮愈发高涨。
The taste of the froth stings the tongue and throat, leaving a bitter film in its wake. As soon as the actual beer hits your stomach, you feel the weight of any troubles lift from your shoulders. The taste is bitter, yes, but it is a welcome bite as it frees your mind of worry. You feel as if you could float through life instead of trudge—a euphoria that amplifies with each sip.

Wrath Of Nature.name:
自然之怒
Wrath Of Nature

Text.text:
你那古老的咒言在大地深处回荡——而大地应声而动。无形的自然之灵在岩石、叶片与枝杈间苏醒。你感到它们的存在……也感到它们的好奇。你向诸灵恳求援助，自然便为你的事业而振奋：树木摇曳，枝条簌簌抖落；灌木丛疯狂伸展，纠结成一片乱麻；就连岩石也从土壤中微微松动，蓄势待发，准备投身战局。
Your ancient words reverberate through the earth—and the earth responds. Formless spirits of nature awaken within rock, leaf, and branch. You feel their presence… and their curiosity. You beseech the spirits for aid, and nature bestirs itself to your cause: trees sway, shaking their branches; undergrowth pushes forth in a riotous tangle; and even rocks nudge themselves loose from the soil, ready to hurl themselves into the fray.

这本小册子的每一道针脚都脆弱得像糖霜薄壳。它的掩蔽不过是一张纸，上面用褪色的血墨写着一组符号，始终无人能将其完全译出。翻页时小心翼翼，纸张发出细碎的噼啪声；册内却是一片文字与图表交缠的乱流。其间还贴着自然的样本，树脂斑点点缀其上——有些碎片早已干透脱落，只留下空缺的痕迹。每一页的气味都略有不同：比如这一页是玫瑰，那一页则是兽死的腥冷。
Every stitch of this little book is as fragile as a sugar glaze. The cover is simply a page with a set of symbols in some faded blood ink, never fully translated. Inside, to the crackling sound of carefully turned pages, is a chaos of script and graph. Samples of nature are pasted in, with spots of resin where pieces have dried and fallen out. Each page smells slightly different. One of roses, for instance, and one of animal death.

阴影仿佛紧贴在这柄邪异的武器上——一把手弩；从其纹饰来看，它最初是为某个统治贵族家族的卓尔打造。它以小巧的身形倾泻出重弩般的冲击与威力，并被施加了厚重的附魔，以抵御阳光对其诡谲本质造成的侵蚀与伤害。可这件死亡器具的黑暗侧面无法被彻底压制；若真要如此，便等同于连同这把武器力量的核心一并抹去。
Shadows seem to cling to this fell weapon, a hand crossbow that, by its markings, was originally made for a drow of a ruling noble house. It delivers the force and power of a heavy crossbow in a tiny package and is heavily enchanted to withstand the harmful effects of sunlight upon its uncanny essence. The dark aspects of this instrument of death cannot be fully suppressed, for to do so would be to undo the core of the weapon’s strength altogether.

Warehouse Of Enslavement Capsules.name:
奴役胶囊仓库
Warehouse Of Enslavement Capsules

Text.text:
丑陋的工业箱式风扇从这座空旷如洞的仓库高处倾泻出刺骨寒流，你的呼吸在眼前凝成白雾。成排覆着霜壳的舱体占据了整个空间，每一个都大到足以容纳一名人类。粗壮盘绕的电缆像蛇一般蜿蜒在混凝土地面上，将这些舱体与嗡鸣不止的巨型服务器相连。其中一个舱体敞开着，露出一具枯槁的尸体——在凝固的痛苦中被冰封。

~ 由 Inbal 在 Discord 上 Envisioned

Cold air blasts down from ugly industrial box fans in the cavernous warehouse, causing your breath to mist before you. Rows of frost-rimed capsules dominate the space, each one large enough for a human. Thick, coiling wires snake across the concrete floor, connecting the pods to enormous humming servers. One of the pods stands open, revealing a withered corpse frozen in agony.

~ Envisioned by Inbal on Discord

Oath Of The Crown Paladin Describes His.name:
立誓王冠的圣武士诉说他的力量
Oath Of The Crown Paladin Describes His Strength

Text.text:
“别把我当成那种侍奉那些善变之物、还自称神祇的狂热信徒。我怜悯那些仰望天空、指望接住几粒神恩碎屑的人——因为这世界真正的力量，就在他们眼前。就在你们所有人之中。就在每一位母亲身上：为护住孩子，宁可撕裂群山。就在每一位农夫身上：在无情烈日下日复一日劳作，只为养活同胞。也在你们每一个人身上：哪怕只握着木棒、石块，甚至赤手空拳，也会为守护属于自己的一切战至死地。那才是真正的强大：从‘一无可失’的边缘诞生的抗命。于是，我不是某位神祇的使者；我不过是一具容器，盛着我们人民所有的愤怒与爱，被安放在这片土地上，只为确保我们能安宁地活下去。”

~ Envisioned by Ginge

“Do not mistake me for some zealot in service to those fickle entities calling themselves gods. I pity those who look to sky in hopes of catching some divine crumbs when the true power of this world lies right in front of them. In all of you. In every mother who would rip a mountain apart to protect her child. In every farmer who labors day after day in the merciless heat to feed his countrymen. And in every one of you, who with club, rock, or even bare hands would defend to the death that which is yours. That is true strength: a defiance born from having everything to lose. So, I am not an agent of a god; I am merely of vessel for all the rage and love of our people, put on this earth to ensure we can live in peace.”

~ Envisioned by Ginge

这位术士是一名冬精灵，身旁总伴着一只雪鸮——它是他家族女神的眼睛。他身着白银为主、点缀蓝色的王者华服；手上戴着一双魔法蓝手套，指尖滴落寒霜，边缘缀满如他冰白发丝般洁白的羽毛。他左手戴着一枚再生戒指。他的蓝色皮肤冷得一触便寒；被逼到极处时，眼眸会从冰蓝骤变为他邪教般的血红。他的性情同样冷冽，却也因对家人的守护而格外坚定。他挥舞一柄霜寒法杖，但在极少数时刻，会塑造出血之武器，从敌人身上汲取能量。

~ Played by Danongorf with

The sorcerer, a winter elf, is accompanied by a snowy owl who serves as the eyes of his family’s goddess. He wears regal clothes of white and silver accented in blue, and he owns magical blue gloves that drip frost and are bordered in feathers as white as his icy hair. A ring of regeneration rests on his left hand. His blue skin is cold to the touch, and his eyes change from icy blue to the blood red of his cult when he is pushed. His personality is chilly, too, but for how protective he is of his family. He wields a staff of frost but, on rare occasion, creates blood weapons that siphon the energy from enemies.

~ Played by Danongorf with

一团起伏不定的水球在你面前成形，最初那一滴水在魔法生效的瞬间膨胀开来，轰鸣如瀑。水体令人目眩神迷，迟缓的水流牵引着它慵懒地旋转，那圆润的水球悬浮于地面之上，滴水不漏。
A sphere of undulating water forms before you, the single droplet of its origin expanding with the roar of a waterfall as the magic takes hold. The liquid is mesmerizing, languid currents pulling the water in a lazy rotation as the globe hovers above the ground without losing a single drop.

Trendy, Colorful Gun Store.name:
时髦而缤纷的枪械商店
Trendy, Colorful Gun Store

Text.text:
店内墙面迸发出耀眼的红与黄，旋转展示台上陈列着各式各样的枪械，大小不一，形制各异。一个孩子跑上前去抓起一把展示用手枪，转着圈挥舞，笑着闹着把枪口对准父母。与之相比，店员们脸上那种僵硬得过分、像抹上去的夸张笑容显得格外刺眼——他们清一色穿着店铺配色的制服，身上却沉甸甸挂满各自的私人军火库。
Bright displays of red and yellow pop from the walls of the store, featuring firearms of all shapes and sizes on rotating platforms. A child runs up to grab one of the display handguns, spinning and pointing at his parents with a smile and a laugh. It seems to be one of the only genuine smiles next to the plastered, too-wide grins of the staff, who are all dressed in the store's colors and weighed down by their own personal arsenal.

一只蓝色狗头人专注地盯着眼前枝条上缓慢爬行的瓢虫，临时拼凑的眼镜后，那双巨大的黄色眼睛里满是好奇的光。他兴奋地低声嘀咕着，作为爬行类学者的他把手深深探进身侧那只超大的挎包里，掏出一本磨损的日志——里面塞满了散乱纸页——随即开始飞快地涂写笔记。写作时，他那股学术热忱丝毫不受干扰，哪怕眼镜不断从湛蓝的鼻吻上往下滑；他一边记，一边倚着一根雕花木杖作支援。

~ Played by Vmaster1995 with

A blue kobold peers intently at the ladybug making its way across the branch before him, his huge yellow eyes brimming with curiosity behind makeshift spectacles. Muttering excitedly to himself, the reptilian scholar reaches deep into the oversized satchel at his side and withdraws a worn journal stuffed full of loose papers, into which he begins to scribble notes. His academic fervor remains unbroken by the constant distraction of his glasses drooping down his azure snout as he writes, leaning on a carved wooden staff for support as he does so.

~ Played by Vmaster1995 with

Zombie Giant.name:
丧尸巨人（特征）
Zombie Giant

Text.text:
一具不死巨人踏过旷野逼近而来，庞然畸形之躯每迈一步都剥落腐肉。它腐烂的双眼死死凝望地平线，空无一物，既无思绪也无情感。破碎的衣物残片垂挂在它溃败的骨肉之上，骇人的躯体不断喷涌出腐败的恶臭。
Tramping across the field looms an unliving giant, a gargantuan abomination sloughing flesh with each stride. Its rotting eyes focus on the horizon, devoid of thought or emotion. Frayed remnants of clothing hang from its decomposing frame, and the putrid stink of decay belches from its hideous form.

Mountaintop Trading Town.name:
山巅贸易镇
Mountaintop Trading Town

Text.text:
一阵井然有序的行动如心跳般驱动着这座山巅小镇。这里铺着整齐的鹅卵石街道，紧凑的广场被商铺与小教堂环抱。再往外，可伸缩的空中码头如雏菊花瓣般向旷阔天际舒展。工匠们从停泊的空艇上拖下绳索与铁链，运往未设围栏的物资场；那里，其他飞行载具正被建造或翻修。一个踩着高跷的监工高声抛出造船匠的行话，对着两名穿工装裤的奥术师发号施令。他们凝神施法，将一段五十英尺长的木料缓缓托起，送入稀薄的山风。喧嚣之下，凿刻的石阶一路向山谷蜿蜒而下，掠过贴着山肩攀附的民居与楼宇。镇民上下这些台阶无需栏杆，而一条引导绳——想必是为访客准备——已牢牢系在岩壁上。某处屋顶上，学童正学习头顶的云——以及脚下的云。

~ Envisioned by BradyBil85

A flurry of orderly activity is the heartbeat of this mountaintop town. It boasts well-laid cobblestone streets and a compact plaza ringed with shops and a chapel. Beyond those, retractable air-docks extend into the open sky like daisy petals. Tradespeople haul rope and chain from docked skyships to the unfenced supply yards where other flying vehicles are being constructed or refurbished. A supervisor on stilts calls out shipwright jargon to a pair of arcanists in overalls. Focusing, they levitate a fifty-foot-long piece of lumber into the thin mountain air. Below the hubbub, steps of carved stone descend toward the valley, past homes and other buildings that cling to the mountain’s shoulders. The townsfolk traverse these stairs without need for railings, but a guide rope, presumably for visitors, has been secured to the rock. On one of the roofs, schoolchildren learn about the clouds above—and below—them.

~ Envisioned by BradyBil85

Approaching Riverside Border Town In Aut.name:
秋日逼近河畔边境镇
Approaching Riverside Border Town In Autumn

Text.text:
你一路追随的林间溪流渐渐变宽，先前堵满水面的落叶被水势带走，顺流漂散。走到一块标示边界的木质路牌前，林木也随之稀疏。泥泞的道路通向一座有顶桥，桥顶中央微微塌陷，木梁覆满青苔。

桥对岸是一座小镇，几户低矮的烟囱吐出缕缕轻烟，在冷空气里盘旋。时值年末，镇民裹着厚重衣物，匆匆奔走忙着各自的营生，偶尔抬头望向聚拢的雨云。镇子中央有一座巨大的建筑，压过周围邻居的屋舍；它带着几分宗教气息，却又以那不相称的宏伟体量，与整座小镇格格不入。

The woodland stream you have been following widens, and the many fallen leaves that had clogged its surface begin to float away with the current. The trees thin out as you reach a wooden signpost marking the border. The muddy road leads to a covered bridge, its roof sagging in the center and timbers covered in moss.

A small town lies on the other bank, tendrils of smoke curling out of the squat chimneys some houses sport. This late in the year, the townsfolk are wrapped in heavy clothing, and hurry about their business, occasionally looking up at the gathering rainclouds. In the center of town, a large building dwarfs its neighbors; there is a religious look about it, and its great size seems at odds with the rest of the town.

Enchanter Academy Foyer.name:
附魔师学院前厅
Enchanter Academy Foyer

Text.text:
楼梯井贴着墙壁蜿蜒而上，没入一座座漆黑的拱门。宽阔的石板地面上点缀着各大宅邸的纹章雕像。掠过门房办公室——对身后的喝喊充耳不闻——五名身着同款长袍的学生齐齐跨上飞天扫帚，嗖地一声从宏伟大门喷射而出。一群刚获录取的孩子瞪大眼睛目送，随即转向带领他们的魔咒学教授。“这就是一课：在这里该如何不守规矩——哪怕你们是飞龙宅邸队的高年级生，”他说。
Stairwells line the walls and curve into black archways. The broad expanse of flagstone floor is decorated with sigil statues of the major houses. Running past the porter’s office—ignoring the shouts—five students in matching robes mount their brooms as one and jet out the Great Door. A wide-eyed group of newly admitted children watch, then turn to the Charms Professor guiding them. “Let that be a lesson in how not to behave here, even if you are upperclassmen on the Wyvern House team,” he says.

Returning From The Faerie Plane.name:
从妖精位面归来
Returning From The Faerie Plane

Text.text:
你背后黄昏的余温迅速退去，取而代之的是一股无菌般的冷意，金色的暮光也随之黯淡。你发现自己被熟悉而平凡的景象包围；尽管脚下更踏实了几分，你却立刻被一种失落感击中——仿佛刚刚离开的那份孩童般的惊奇，正从指缝间溜走。
The warmth of dusk at your back gives way to a sterile chill, and the golden twilight fades. You find yourself surrounded by the familiar and mundane, and though you feel surer on your feet, you’re immediately struck with a sense of loss for the childlike wonder you’ve just left behind.

你先听见它，后看见它——回声般的鸟鸣闷闷啁啾。那只麻雀大小的不祥之兆拍动黑翼飞来，落地而立，爪如黑曜玻璃般的猛禽利钩。它从瘟疫医生面具厚重的皮革阴影下凝视着你。随即，它开始低吟。幽咽旋律撕裂你周遭的空气，你的视野随之黯淡，黑暗从视野边缘缓慢爬行而来。
You hear it before you see it—the muffled chirrup of echoed birdsong. Flying on black wings, the sparrow-sized omen alights to stand on raptorial claws of obsidian glass. It regards you from beneath the heavy leather of a plague-doctor's mask. Then it begins to croon. A haunting melody rips through the air around you, and your vision darkens, blackness crawling from your peripherals.

“请坐。”桌子另一侧那人说话的语气与脸上硬挤出来的笑容，恰好踩在邀请与威胁之间的边线上。工作区一尘不染，毫无杂物；而房间其余部分却奢华得刺眼——陈旧挂毯上织着战争场景，古老兵器被精心保存、陈列。两件东西在其中格外扎眼：一把现代弩和一柄窄刃长剑，各自摆在装饰支架上，夹击着那名黑帮头目。可装饰用的弩通常不会上弦上矢，装饰用的剑也通常不会溅着点点猩红。

~ 由 Chris 在 Envisioned 构想

"Have a seat." Both the tone of the figure on the other side of the desk, and their plastered smile, dance along the line between invitation and threat. The workspace is free of clutter, though the rest of the room is luxuriously decorated with old tapestries depicting wars, and preserved ancient weapons. Two items stand out from the rest: a modern crossbow and a narrow-bladed sword, each sitting in a decorative stand flanking the mobster. But decorative crossbows aren't usually loaded, and decorative swords aren't usually specked with red.

~ Envisioned by Chris

I Cast Air Elemental Planar Ally.name:
我施放「空气元素位面盟友」
I Cast Air Elemental Planar Ally

Text.text:
在我的号令下，一道由彩虹碧玺凝成的门槛自地面升起。泛着蓝白色的雾幕如帘垂落，将其遮得朦胧不清，而我能听见门槛彼端的位面传来风声尖啸。一股旋风呼啸穿过。我的召唤物是一团暴风般的铅灰云涡，搅得尘土与碎屑四散翻飞。它的脸没有定形，却仍依稀可辨——在缕缕云丝间，呈现为一双双幽暗的空洞。
A threshold of rainbow tourmaline rises from the ground at my command. Misting curtains of bluish white obscure it, and I can hear the whistling of wind in the plane beyond. A whirlwind spins through. My summon is a swirl of storm-gray cloud that sends dust and debris fluttering all about. Its face, amorphous but still discernible, appears as dark hollows within the wisps.

一件破旧的黄色斗篷披在阿马尔·怀尔德莓宽阔的肩头。尽管他身躯高大、气势迫人，却总是佝偻着背、阴郁沉默——背上的巨剑沉甸甸，剑下那些血腥往事也同样压得他喘不过气。他从阴影笼罩的眉骨下窥视世界，仅剩的一只绿眼冷冷发亮；左眼浑浊如玻璃，嵌在皱褶的疤痕肉里。他腰间挂着一截断裂的木剑剑柄——几乎只是孩子的玩具——手边还紧攥着一匹玩具小马的残骸。

~ Played by Pauli with

A tattered yellow cloak drapes the broad shoulders of Amar Wildberrie. Despite his towering frame and formidable bearing, he carries himself in a slouched, brooding fashion—both the heft of the greatsword on his back and its grisly deeds weigh heavily on the man. He peers from beneath a shadowed brow with a single green eye, the left clouded and glassy, nestled in wrinkled scar tissue. He carries on his belt the broken hilt of a wooden sword—little more than a child’s plaything—and keeps close at hand the remnants of a toy horse.

~ Played by Pauli with

宽肩的人类把绳索一圈圈缠在粗壮的臂膀上，忙活时叼着牙签咀嚼。晒成古铜色的皮肤上纵横着疤痕，像是数十年苦工留下的纪念。他们一边干活一边打量过往行人，却始终沉默寡言，独自守着自己的事。
The broad-backed human coils rope around one thick arm, chewing on a toothpick as they work. Scars line their sun-bronzed skin, mementos of decades of labor. They eye passersby as they toil, but otherwise keep to themselves

Fake Amulet Of Health.name:
赝品健康护符
Fake Amulet Of Health

Text.text: 你把粗重的链条披到脖子上，让金色徽章垂在胸前。你深吸一口气……奇怪。你并不感觉更健康。你捏起徽章，凑近细看。上面刻着的图案出乎意料地粗糙：一轮灿亮的太阳，带着一张歪歪斜斜的笑脸。 You drape the thick chain over your neck and let the golden medallion hang on your chest. You take a deep breath… Odd. You don’t feel any healthier. You pick up the medallion and study it closely. The image engraved on it is surprisingly unsophisticated: a shining sun with a lopsided smiling face.

I Cast Wall Of Fire From My Staff Of Fir.name:
我举起火焰法杖，施放了火墙术。
I Cast Wall Of Fire From My Staff Of Fire

Text.text:
