我一边挥杖横扫身前，一边喊出指令词，杖头随即迸射出一道光束。凡光芒所及之处，皆有白炽如炫的烈焰沿线爆燃——仿佛我已将大地劈开，直凿到其下原初的熔岩深处。
I speak the command word as I swing the staff across my body, causing a beam of light to shine from its head. White-hot flames erupt in a line wherever the light touches—as if I have carved through the earth to the primordial magma beneath.

Barbarian Quip About Arguments.name:
野蛮人对争吵的俏皮话
Barbarian Quip About Arguments

Text.text:
“我喜欢你。我有种感觉：要是咱们意见不合，就不会有那套寒暄握手的把戏。咱们会用老办法把事了结——拳头见血，再来一杯麦酒。只有这样，争执才算彻底画上句号。”
“I like you. I get the feeling that if we disagree, there’ll be none of that chitchat, shake-hands stuff. We’ll settle things the old way—with bloody fists and an ale. Only way to end an argument for good.”

Loot From A Goblin In Oversized Armor.name:
从一名穿着过大护甲的地精身上搜出的战利品
Loot From A Goblin In Oversized Armor

Text.text:
尽管这套护甲被塞满了装着牛粪饼的帆布袋，那顶带面甲的头盔却出自大师之手，单这件就轻易值250枚金币。
Despite the armor set being packed with canvas bags full of cow patties, the visored helm is forged by an expert and easily worth 250 gold pieces.

Ruined Portal.name:
毁坏的传送门
Ruined Portal

Text.text:
曾几何时，这道魔法传送门噼啪作响，涌动着奥术之力；其周围地面刻满符印，标示着那些敢于踏上这场诡秘旅行之人的目的地。然而时代早已从这扇门槛旁踏过，符印如今残破不堪——或被年代磨蚀，或遭人蓄意涂毁。锯齿般、失控的魔力会在毫无征兆的间隙里迸裂成形，但如此不稳定的传送门可能通往任何地方——也可能通向虚无。
Once, this magical portal crackled with arcane power, sigils engraved upon the floor surrounding it denoting the destination of those who would brave this eldritch travel. But time has marched on from this gateway, and the sigils have been damaged, either worn away with age or deliberately defaced. Jagged, unstable magics randomly snap into being periodically, but such an unstable portal could lead almost anywhere—or nowhere.

I Cast Telekinesis From My Ring Of Telek.name:
我从我的【念动力戒指】施放念动力
I Cast Telekinesis From My Ring Of Telekinesis

Text.text:
镶在我戒指上的玛瑙宝石，映着在岩石内部跳跃碰撞的魔法微光闪烁不定。我掌心的血脉隆起，光芒在其中奔涌，仿佛雷电的枝杈被困在皮肤之下。我抬手指向一件物品，眼看它缓缓升起。与我戒指里那些魔法细屑同色的光点环绕着那件物体，紧贴其侧，随着我轻拂的手势一同漂移。
The agate gem set into my ring glints from the magical motes bouncing against the interior of the rock. The veins in my palms rise and surge with light, like branches of lightning caught just under my skin. I point my hand at an item and watch it rise. Motes that match the magical specks within my ring surround the object, sticking close to it as I waft it along.

Mumswyrd Neighborhood.name:
姆姆斯维德街区
Mumswyrd Neighborhood

Text.text:
巴德斯通广场正南，是一片由公寓与寄宿屋拼成的街区，各路艺人穿梭其间，热闹得像永不落幕的排演。演员、歌手、舞者与乐师挤在客厅里、街道上，甚至爬上屋顶练功谋生。巷道垃圾箱里飘出廉价葡萄酒与啤酒的酸甜气味，随着风钻进鼻腔。

在这群爱出风头、又常常喧闹的人里，却有个格格不入的存在：一位上了年纪的先生，名叫科基诺斯先生。他常被人看见弯腰照料自己的卷心菜地，耳朵里塞着团团棉花，仿佛要把整条街的喧嚣都隔在世界之外。
Directly south of Bardstone Plaza, a neighborhood of apartments and boarding homes bustles with performers of all varieties. Actors, singers, dancers, and musicians congregate in living rooms, in the streets, and even on rooftops to practice and ply their trades. The smell of cheap wine and beer wafts from the dumpsters in alleyways. One member of the neighborhood is an exception to this exhibitive, frequently rowdy, crowd: an older fellow named Mr. Kokkinos, who can often be seen tending his cabbage patch, ears plugged with wads of cotton.

Sundries From A Barghest.name:
来自巴盖斯特的杂项
Sundries From A Barghest

Text.text:
在野兽耷拉的紫色长舌下，你发现了一件古怪的物品：一枚神秘的硬币。细看之下，它像异界的海市蜃楼般微微闪烁，仿佛是用玻璃制成的。你认不出它两面上精细蚀刻的徽记。
Under the beast’s lolling purple tongue, you find a curious item: a mysterious coin. The piece shimmers like an otherworldly mirage when inspected, and it seems to be made of glass. You do not recognize the symbol delicately etched into each face.

Aellensworth Morrigan Iii.name:
埃伦斯沃斯·莫里根三世
Aellensworth Morrigan Iii

Text.text:
这位骑士哨兵神情阴郁、肤色惨白，却依旧挺拔高挑，身形精瘦，背脊笔直，钢甲覆身如冷光铸就。一手握着寒芒闪烁的利刃，另一手擎着古老的盾牌，他的姿态英武而凛然，只是略显憔悴消瘦、沉郁严峻。深陷的眼窝里燃着锐利的目光，几道浓黑的妆痕勾勒其间，几乎将面容衬得如骸骨般森然。可纵使外表骇人，这男人周身仍散发着高贵而耐心的风度。

~ 由 Khaolo 扮演

The knightly sentinel—with his somber expression and pallid flesh—stands tall, lean, and straight-backed, plated in steel. A gleaming blade in one hand, an ancient shield in the other, he strikes a gallant if somewhat gaunt and dour figure. Keen eyes burn from sunken hollows, accentuated by streaks of dark makeup which evoke an almost skeletal visage. Despite the ghastly outward appearance, the man exudes a noble and patient bearing.

~ Played by Khaolo

Cigar-smoking Alien Pedestrian.name:
叼着雪茄的外星行人
Cigar-smoking Alien Pedestrian

Text.text:
那巨大的异形迈步时，身后拖出一串湿黏的吧嗒声；他覆着蹼的躯体被浓稠黏液裹得油滑发亮。刺鼻的毒烟瘴气将他团团围住，源自三支雪茄——每张嘴各叼一支——喷吐如工业烟囱般滚滚倾泻。
A wet, slopping sound follows the large alien as he walks, his webbed physique slick with thick mucus. A pungent miasma of noxious smoke surrounds him, pouring from three cigars—one in each mouth—like an industrial chimney stack.

沿着道路前行，你看见一名瘦削而孤独的身影，惬意地坐在一截宽大的树桩上。那树桩被年代与天气磨得光滑圆润。他身上除腰间一把朴素的匕首外别无武装；你几乎看不清他的面容，只能瞥见几缕叛逆的卷发从头上那顶呢帽下探出。双手间，他捧着一册厚重的大部头，皮革与布料包脊，正以千百次练习般的娴熟在其上书写。然而你走近时，他只是把书页折了个角，合上书本，将那根炭笔不知塞进了皮斗篷下那件粗布短上衣的何处。你猛然发现他鼻梁上架着一副眼镜——即便在这开明的时代也属稀有度之物——而一道长疤自缺失的耳垂处起，贯穿他整张脸。他漫不经心地伸手去取倚在树桩旁的手杖，却并无任何挑衅之举。

~ 由 Ron A. 扮演

Traveling along the road, you see a lean, solitary figure sitting comfortably on a wide tree stump made smooth by age and weather. Unarmed but for a simple dagger at his belt, you can scarcely make out his features aside from a few rogue strands of curly hair peeking out from beneath the tam-o'-shanter upon his head. Cradled in his hands is a large tome bound in leather and cloth, in which he is writing with the ease of countless practice. But as you draw closer he simply dog-ears his page and closes the book, stashing his charcoal writing stick somewhere in the homespun jerkin under his leather cloak. With a start, you see that he is wearing spectacles on his face—a rarity, even in these enlightened times—and that a long scar runs from an absent earlobe the entire length of his face. He casually reaches for a walking stick leaning against his tree stump, but makes no aggressive move.

~ Played by Ron A.

Common Room In Cave.name:
洞穴公共厅
Common Room In Cave

Text.text:
尽管阴湿昏暗——如同任何洞窟一般——这片空间却透着酒馆公用厅的气息。褪色破烂的挂毯垂在墙上；远处一角挤满长凳，围着一张长方桌，桌上堆着杯子、盘子与叉子。几把披着兽皮的椅子簇拥在一起，围着嵌入墙体、以粗糙扁平石块砌成的壁炉；炉火仍在闷闷地冒着余烬。洞口旁立着一架武器架——刀刃、弓与长矛——寒气逼人，仿佛随时会被人一把抄起，用来护卫洞穴。
Though dank and dim—like any cave—the space evokes the air of a tavern common room. Faded, tattered tapestries adorn the walls, and benches crowd the far corner, surrounding a rectangular table laden with cups, plates, and forks. Chairs draped with furs sit in a cluster around a still-smoldering hearth built into the wall with rough, flat stones. A rack of weapons—blades, bows, and spears—sits menacingly near the cavern's entrance, ready to be snatched up at a moment's notice in defense of the cave.

Goblinoid Counterweight Trebuchet.name:
地精类配重投石机
Goblinoid Counterweight Trebuchet

Text.text:
伴随着一声低沉的咆哮，那条粗壮的巨臂猛然前挥，将一块巨岩高高抛入空中。配重——一笼尖叫的地精——以碎骨般的巨力砸向夯实的硬土。兽人船员放声大笑，开始再度绞起投石机的长臂，而侥幸活下来的地精则在绝望中哀嚎。
With a guttural roar, the mighty arm swings forward, hurling a gigantic rock high up into the air. The counterweight—a cage of screaming goblins—slams into the hard packed earth with bone-splintering force. Bellowing with laughter, the orcish crew begins to hoist the arm of the trebuchet again, and the surviving goblins wail in dismay.

Arroyo With Flash Flood Approaching.name:
山谷溪涧——突发洪水逼近
Arroyo With Flash Flood Approaching

Text.text:
干涸的溪床蜿蜒穿过周围的平原，曲折回转间，几乎像一条天然的道路。远处雷暴低沉翻滚，你在地平线上瞥见暴雨倾泻的阴影正迅速逼近。沿着这道干沟前行，你开始看见细细的雨水支流汇聚成线，潺潺奔流。你只剩下短短片刻，暴雨的洪流就会猛然灌入，让这道干沟瞬间涨满、奔涌而来。
The dry creekbed winds through the surrounding plains, almost resembling a road with its curves and bends. A storm in the distance rumbles, and you spy the telltale shadow of heavy rainfall on the horizon. As you follow the arroyo you begin to see rivulets of rain water, collecting and running. You have mere moments before the arroyo fills to the brim with a rush of rainfall.

一块巨大的巨石横亘在路中央，迫使小径在它两侧分开绕行，随后又重新汇合向前延伸。这岩石想必是旅人用作路标的地标，因为你看见多年来许多人在石面上刻下了自己的名字或留言。有些浅浅的刻痕已被地衣覆盖，但另一些却依旧清晰，仿佛才刚刚刻上去。
A huge boulder stands in the path, causing the trail to split around it before continuing on. The rock must be some kind of landmark used by travelers, for you see many have scratched their names or messages on the rock over the years. Lichen grows over some of the shallow indentations but others are clear, as if freshly carved.

Flying On The Back Of A Roc.name:
骑乘巨鹏背上飞行
Flying On The Back Of A Roc

Text.text:
巨鹏的背脊是一片无垠的羽海与虬结的肌肉，它那双巨翼强健到足以托起你们所有人。你们已与这只壮丽的巨鸟结为同伴，于是免于诸般威胁——除了天气。贴近云层，呼啸的风雪裹挟着刺痛的冰屑劈头盖脸；幸而鸟躯的暖意与你们厚重的衣物勉强相抵，才不至于被冻成冰雕。你只盼能尽快触及目的地，无论前方有何等凶险在等待。

~ 一位英雄所 构想

The back of the roc is an expanse of feathers and muscle, its wings powerful enough to carry all of you. Having befriended the magnificent bird, you are safe—except from the weather. The warmth of the avian body and your heavy clothes are just enough to keep you from being frozen by the buffeting snow and flecks of stinging ice this close to the clouds. You would be glad to reach your destination, no matter the danger that might await you.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The Orb & Tower In Winter.name:
冬日的宝珠与高塔
The Orb & Tower In Winter

Text.text:
浓郁的红酒酱与烤肉的香气牵引着目光落向这家高档餐厅，然而许多餐桌却空着。随着天气转暖才会出现的品酒小食——新鲜奶酪拼盘与水果托盘——已被换成裹着酥脆千层外皮的迷你惠灵顿牛排、配着热气腾腾番茄汤的烤面包，或一只只盛满浓郁芝士蘸酱的陶瓷小碟。唯有一群趁寒假从学业镣铐中解脱的少年占据着这里的热闹。他们轮流把面包和肉块浸入火锅式奶酪锅里，蘸起一缕缕滚烫的奶香。
The scent of rich red wine sauce and roasting meat draws attention to this high-end restaurant, though many of its tables are empty. The wine tasting fare of warmer weather—fresh cheese boards and fruit platters—is replaced with miniature beef Wellington wrapped in flaky pastry, toasted bread with steaming tomato soup, or ceramic dishes full of cheesy dip. A group of teenagers, free from the shackles of school for winter break, are the only guests. They take turns dipping pieces of bread and meat into a fondue pot.

I Cast Produce Flame.name:
我施展【产焰术】
I Cast Produce Flame

Text.text:
我探入记忆深处，想起温暖而诱人的营火，抵御着凛冽寒风与幽暗长夜。就在它们在我掌心显现之前，我已听见那魔法火焰噼啪作响。黄与橙的火羽在指间翻飞滚落，洒下充足的光亮——若有需要，也是一枚体面的投射物。
I dig into my memory and recall warm, inviting campfires staving off cold winds and shadowy nights. I hear the magical flames crackle just before they appear in my hand. Yellow and orange feathers of fire tumble around my fingers, offering a good amount of light—and a decent projectile if the need arises.

Quip About A Lazy Character.name:
关于一个懒惰角色的俏皮话
Quip About A Lazy Character

Text.text:
“你似乎不明白的是：无所作为并非奢侈，而是痛苦。无论你再怎么试图用奢华把它埋起来，它都会扯住你的心不放。那份躁动的不满足，是世界在对你尖叫——在你短暂的时日里，去做些真正有价值的事。”
“What you don’t seem to grasp is that inaction is not luxury. It is pain. It tugs at your heart no matter how hard you try to bury it in opulence. That restless dissatisfaction is the world screaming at you to do something worthwhile in the short time you have.”

Wingless Dragon's Den.name:
无翼巨龙之穴
Wingless Dragon's Den

Text.text:
从这座巨大冰封洞窟的峭壁上突出的岩台，被磨得平整，刻满深而宽的凹槽。它们一路拼成一条临时阶梯，足够巨人踏行，通往洞顶附近一处刺骨的高原。一切都显得诡异地整齐划一，仿佛有人以泰坦般的蛮力，刻意将它们硬生生凿进冰川墙面。你的目光缓缓上移，血液随之冻结——视线落在洞窟主人的庞大白影上：一条无翼巨龙。

~ 构想：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The rocky ledges jutting from the walls of the gigantic, frozen cavern have been worn flat and covered in deep, wide furrows. They form a makeshift stairway fit for a giant, up to a frigid plateau near the cave roof. It all seems unnaturally uniform, as if they have been driven into the glacial walls deliberately and with titanic strength. Your blood runs cold as your gaze drifts upward, alighting on the hulking white form of the cavern’s owner—a wingless dragon.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

这根粗壮的乌黑长柄武器顶端，那片邪气森森的刃口不映出半点光芒；可当你用拇指甲轻轻一敲，它却发出毫无疑问的金属清响。若全力挥斩，这把战镰足以像切肉一般轻易剖开粗劣金属——而对经过锻造的沉重金属，也能像劈木头一样干脆利落。
The evil-looking blade atop this stout jet-black polearm reflects no light whatsoever but makes an unquestionably metallic pinging noise when struck with one’s thumbnail. With a full swing, such a war scythe could cleave through base metal as easily as flesh—and worked, heavy metal as easily as wood.

I Drink My Potion Of Supreme Healing.name:
我喝下我的至高治疗药水
I Drink My Potion Of Supreme Healing

Text.text:
生命的丝线被猛然绷紧，随时都可能断裂。撕裂全身的剧痛几乎要把我的最后时刻拖入失神而骇人的深渊。凭着最后一丝力气，我从胸前的弹药带上猛地扯下一只小瓶，在难以名状的痛楚中强撑着眨眼确认——我抓对了那瓶药剂。那抹闪烁的猩红光泽既是我的确认，也成了催促我仰头痛饮的灵感。我感觉自己回应着魔法，肉体与灵魂一同复苏，重新焕然昂扬。
The threads of life pull taut, ready to snap at any moment. The incredible pain that wracks my body threatens to make my final moments mindless and harrowing. With my last ounce of strength, I wrench a small vial from my bandolier, blinking through the incomprehensible agony to ensure I’ve plucked the right potion. The sparkling red shine is both my confirmation and the inspiration I need to quaff. I feel myself respond to the magic, body and spirit both renewed and elated.

Tropical Jungle: Jungle Nighttime.name:
热带丛林：丛林夜幕
Tropical Jungle: Jungle Nighttime

Text.text:
尽管太阳已经落山，白日里闷蒸的热浪却尚未完全散去。空气凉了些，可你在纠结如迷宫的丛林间摸索前行时，汗水仍沿着身侧滑落发黏。厚重树冠之上，月光悄然倾洒——偶尔有一束昏暗光照刺破幽暗，照亮高处的枝桠——但在下方这片潮湿泥泞的阴翳里，若无光源，你几乎连眼前的手掌都看不清。
Although the sun has gone down, the sweltering heat of the day hasn’t entirely disappeared. The air is cooler but sweat still slicks your sides as you try to navigate the tangled maze of the jungle. Somewhere above the thick canopy, the moon shines—for an occasional shaft of dim light pierces the gloom to illuminate the upper branches—but down in the murk and muck you can barely see your hand before your face without a light.

Fabian The Mage.name:
法比安·法师
Fabian The Mage

Text.text:
他肤色如铜，带着些许雀斑，耳垂上是钢制耳环，面容却年轻得几近欺人。这名人类——却仿佛掺了几分天界的血——身披黑色板甲与黑布，黑熊皮披风沉沉压在肩背之上。他低声咕哝咒文，一抹显然无害的火焰光晕在近旁的活物身上浮现，光芒从他的皮肤与如黑镜般的护甲上反射开来。他向前行走时，身后拖出雾蓝色的尾迹，随行的还有他的幻象之一——一条小小的龙。

~ 由 Cheeto Played

Copper-skinned and a little freckled, he wears steel earrings and bears a deceptively youthful appearance. The human, though there seems to be some celestial in him, wears black plate and black cloth, the fur of a black bear cape heavy over his shoulders and back. He mutters an incantation and a flaming glow, evidently harmless, appears on the nearby living, reflected from his skin and the black mirror of his armor. When he walks forward, misty blue trails follow, as well as one of his illusions—a small dragon.

~ Played by Cheeto

Warrior Receives A Blood Transfusion.name:
战士接受了一次输血
Warrior Receives A Blood Transfusion

Text.text:
输血开始时，战士无声地献上一句感恩的祷告，迫不及待想要向那位救了他一命的陌生人致敬。
The warrior gives a silent prayer of thanks as the transfusion begins, eager to honor the stranger who has saved him.

Savvy Assistant District Attorney.name:
精明能干的助理地方检察官
Savvy Assistant District Attorney

Text.text:
女人将修长的手指在桌面如镜的光泽上方交叠成尖塔，唇角扬起一抹残酷的笑。她神色安宁而矜持，任由眼前的男人咆哮怒骂、手舞足蹈，直到他脸颈上的血管因充血而危险地暴起。终于，他气力耗尽，瘫回椅中——那椅子比她的低了足足几英寸。她摊开修剪精致的双手，装出一副谦卑的姿态，抛出一个再简单不过的选择：把她想要的交出来，或者被揭穿为他本就是的罪犯。
Steepling her long fingers atop the mirrored surface of her desk, the woman offers a cruel smile. With serene dignity, she allows the man before her to bellow and gesticulate wildly as the blood vessels in his face and neck become dangerously prominent. He eventually runs out of steam and collapses back into a chair several inches lower than her own. Spreading her manicured hands in mock humility, she lays out a simple choice: Give her what she wants, or be exposed as the criminal he is.

你不得不眯起眼，抵御阳光在远处丘陵上闪烁的积雪间折射出的炫目光芒；那些山丘覆着一层晶莹的粉雪，宛如细碎水晶铺陈。远远望去，穿越这般田园诗般的设定似乎轻而易举，但你从经验与传闻中都知道，这趟旅程既耗人心力，也暗藏凶险。冬眠的生物或许早已在沿途各处筑起巢穴，而脚下的立足点也格外刁钻难测。
You have to squint against the sun's dazzling refraction from the glittering snow atop the distant hills, blanketed in crystalline powder. Crossing such an idyllic setting looks quite easy from a distance, but you know from both experience and lore that such an endeavor can be taxing, as well as dangerous. Hibernating creatures may have made their dens throughout, and footing can be quite tricky.

Dragon Brood Mother's Lament.name:
龙裔育母的哀歌
Dragon Brood Mother's Lament

Text.text:
三条巨龙横陈在你周围，覆鳞如新雪般雪白，已然毙命；从它们血肉上被劈开的致命伤口里升起袅袅热汽。你审视着自己造成的屠戮，雪以不自然的狂暴抽打进你的眼睛，而龙族血脉那浓烈的猩红——正从脚下渗入洁白的雪地。一声充满痛楚与狂怒的可怖咆哮在山谷中炸裂开来……那是唯有母亲才能知晓的疼痛。
Three dragons, their scaled hides the color of freshly fallen snow, lie dead around you, steam rising from the mortal wounds sliced into their flesh. Snow whips into your eyes with unnatural ferocity as you survey the carnage you have wrought, and blood—the rich crimson of draconic lineage—seeps into the white at your feet. A terrible roar filled with pain and fury explodes through the valley… Pain only a mother could know.

Experimenter's Laboratory.name:
实验者的实验室
Experimenter's Laboratory

Text.text:
一张染渍的橡木桌占据了这间圆形房间的中央。四周的操作台上摆满了蒸馏器、烧杯、罐子、陶锅、坩埚与管道，还散落着铜制圆筒、蒸馏装置，以及各式尺寸的金属盒子——外壳缠满电线，点缀着按钮与操纵杆。装备之间夹着一道楼梯，向上通往夹层，向下延伸至另一层。从上层垂落下一整片粗细不一的管束：少数连接着地面或阳台上的装置，更多则悬空摇曳，层层遮住穹顶，使人难以看清天花板。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

A stained oak table takes up the center of this circular room. Counters along the sides hold alembics, beakers, jars, pots, cauldrons, and tubes, along with copper cylinders, stills, and metal boxes of assorted sizes that are covered with wires, buttons, and levers. Amid the equipment is a stairway, ascending to a mezzanine and downward to another floor. From the upper story hangs an array of tubes of various thicknesses. Some connect to devices on the floor or the balcony, but most hang free, obscuring the ceiling from view.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Wrecked Storeroom.name:
毁坏的储藏室
Wrecked Storeroom

Text.text:
碎裂的木片散落满室，曾被稳妥收存的各式箱子与桶子的内容物也一并倾倒而出。谷物与其他食物洒满地面，已开始招来害虫；你一靠近，便有两只老鼠仓皇逃窜。大多数毁坏的容器都带着被强行撬开的痕迹——也许是短柄斧或撬棍所为。盛着各类液体的陶罐同样摔得粉碎，内容物汇成一滩滩水洼，又在房间里蜿蜒成一道道流淌的细河。
Shattered wood lies scattered across the room, along with the contents of the various crates and barrels once stowed securely. Grain and other foodstuffs spill across the floor already attracting pests, as a pair of rats flee at your approach. Most of the ruined vessels show signs of force—a hatchet or prybar, perhaps. Clay pots of various liquids lie shattered as well, their contents pooling in puddles and running in rivers throughout the room.

Plain Copper Brooch.name:
素铜胸针
Plain Copper Brooch

Text.text:
一回合，用廉价的棉布或土织羊毛做成，而这枚略小的胸针——带着温暖的乡野笑意——恰如其分地完成了它被赋予的使命。扣针末端有一抹小小的铜色点缀，像一绺发丝——只为提醒人们：它确实也是一件艺术品。
One turn, made for cheap cotton or homespun wool, and this smallish brooch does—with a warm country smile—what it was meant to do. It has one little fillip of copper, like a lock of hair, at the catch end—just to remind one that it is, indeed, a piece of art.

这柄恶魔之锤由某个下层位面的地狱烈焰锻成的黑铁铸就；握在手中轻若无物，掷出时却沉若山岳，其上铭刻着造物恶魔施下的强力魔法。
Fashioned from iron forged in the hellfire of some lower plane, this diabolic hammer, light when hefted yet heavy when thrown, carries potent enchantments laid upon it by its devilish creators.

Young Dragon Corpse.name:
幼龙尸骸
Young Dragon Corpse

Text.text:
巨龙被击落时，鳞片尚未因年代而黯沉，生物的皮鳞仍保留着青春般的油亮光泽。鲜血从巨龙胁腹一道参差的创口中汩汩渗出，将地面染成深沉的猩红，也让空气里弥漫着铜腥味。
The dragon’s scales had not yet begun to darken with age when it was struck down, and the creature’s hide retains the glossy sheen of youth. Blood dribbles from a jagged wound in the dragon’s flank, painting the floor a deep, crimson hue and lacing the air with copper.

各式各样的绳索以不同的编法与材质像精致的挂毯般垂在墙上。你看见黄麻、麻绳、棉绳，还有一段看起来像香肠肠衣的东西。矮人老板得意地沿着展示挥了挥手，他那把长胡子也特意梳理成不同的辫式，好让人一眼看出他能提供的每一种编法。他摸了摸那条肉质绳索，骄傲地宣布：“奇美拉的肠子。没什么比这更结实。你甚至还能闻到硫磺味！”
Ropes of various braids and material hang on the walls like fine tapestries. You see jute, hemp, cotton, and a length that resembles sausage casing. The dwarven owner proudly waves his hand along the display, his long beard styled to showcase each type of braid he offers. He touches the fleshy rope and proudly proclaims, "Chimaera gut. Nothing stronger. You can still smell the sulfur!"

树篱勾勒出一块块黑土田畴，里头种着各色作物。空气里混着花香、烈日烤透的泥土气息与蔬菜的清甜，几乎能在舌尖上尝到。田地入口处立着一座像谷仓般的建筑，外墙雕刻并彩绘着丰收与富足的场景。沿着屋檐一字排开的是稻草扎成的人形偶——男人、女人、孩子，个个穿着衣服。拿来当稻草人，这地方未免太古怪了。
Hedgerows outline fields of black soil planted with various crops. It smells of flowers, sunbaked earth, and vegetables. You can almost taste them. A barn-like structure stands at the entrance to the fields. Its sides bear carved and painted scenes of harvests and plenty. All along its roof line stand straw effigies of people—men, women, and children, all dressed in clothes. It seems a strange place for scarecrows.

I Drink My Potion Of Growth.name:
我喝下我的巨化药水
I Drink My Potion Of Growth

Text.text: 我喝下药水，身体边缘掠过一阵刺痛，仿佛电流沿着周身游走。脚下的地面在我眼中骤然缩小，我的体型翻倍增长，骨骼被拉伸，伴随着沉闷的噼啪与咔裂。我强压住一阵眩晕，逐渐适应这副更庞大的躯壳——每一次移动都像猛然一晃，嗓音也低沉了整整一个八度。 I drink the potion and feel a twinge along the perimeter of my body, like an electric current. The floor shrinks beneath me as I double in size, my bones stretching with dull pops and cracks. I fight a rush of dizziness as I become accustomed to my larger form, each movement a great lurch and my voice an octave deeper.

Plundered Burial Mound.name:
被洗劫的坟冢
Plundered Burial Mound

Text.text:
不知是魔法所致，还是铁锤砸出的结果，难以分辨，但古冢前厅那扇巨大的花岗岩门如今已成一堆巨人的拼图碎块。狭窄的土室里，一只灰色手臂从破烂的裹布中露出，指骨上的戒指被剥得一干二净。地上的足迹与刮擦痕、被粗暴对待的小空骨灰罐，以及原本悬挂之物如今空荡荡的挂钩，无不表明：这处神圣的休息之地，已遭窃贼亵渎。
By magic or by hammer, it’s hard to tell, but the great granite door in the vestibule of the barrow is a heap of giant puzzle pieces. In the cramped earthen vault, a gray arm can be seen free from its frayed wrappings, finger bones stripped of rings. Tracks and scrapes, small empty urns roughly treated, and hangers bare of what they once held all indicate that this sacred place of rest has known the sacrilege of thievery.

Portal To Magical Shop.name:
通往魔法商店的传送门
Portal To Magical Shop

Text.text:
在你面前，光芒以无序的方式闪烁，魔力的气息牵引着你。你迈出一步，还未反应过来，天地已然变换。跳跃、旋舞的色彩将你拥入怀中，透过这万花筒般的光影，你脚下浮现出一条鹅卵石小径，小径尽头立着一间孤零零的店铺。在这片斑斓的虚空中，你所能见到的，唯有这条路与这栋建筑是真实坚固之物。
Before you, light shimmers in an unorderly fashion, its magical aura drawing you in. You take a step and, before you know it, your world shifts. Dancing, swirling colors now embrace you, and through the kaleidoscope there is a cobblestone path at your feet and a lone shop at the end of it. This building and path are the only solid objects you can see within this colorful void.

新生儿乍看像是人类——可随即你便注意到那棱角分明的五官与尖长的耳廓，以及那副纤细而轻灵的身姿。精灵的血脉在这名新生儿的血管中奔涌流淌。
The newborn appears at first to be human—but then you notice their angular features and pointed ears, the litheness of their frame. Elven blood courses through this newborn’s veins.

Cleric's Speech About True Heroism.name:
牧师关于真正英雄主义的演说
Cleric's Speech About True Heroism

Text.text:
“挥剑是一回事，但真正的英雄主义，是为他人之利献出自己。”
"Swinging a sword is one thing, but true heroism is giving of yourself for the benefit of others."

Monk's Speech Of Self-deprecation.name:
武僧的自嘲之辞
Monk's Speech Of Self-deprecation

Text.text:
“有些树能活得又老又壮，树皮如护甲般坚硬，每到春天，叶子仍旧青嫩如初。而这一棵——这颗心——我想，它的寿命很短，像甲虫一样。它只为腐朽而生，也只在死后把自己馈赠给大地。”
“Some trees live to be old and strong, their bark like armor and their leaves young every spring. This one, this heart, I think, lives a short life—like that of a beetle. It exists only for rot and what it gives in its death to the earth.”

Cursed: Damage Vulnerability.name:
诅咒：易伤（伤害）
Cursed: Damage Vulnerability

Text.text:
在战斗的狂潮中，肾上腺素飙升、专注如刀锋般锐利，你能判断出哪个对手更有机会伤到你。但当你遭受一种罕见的效果——刺痛灼人，仿佛你的护甲与衣物都只是薄纱——你会感到自己暴露无遗，肌肤赤裸地面对任何威胁，被迫重新审视自己的战术。
In the flurry of battle, adrenaline high and focus razor sharp, you can figure which opponent has the better chance of hurting you. But when you are struck with an uncommon effect—a stinging pain, as if your armor and clothing were made of gauze—you feel exposed, raw to any threat, forced to reconsider your tactics.

Shrine To A God Of Storms.name:
风暴之神的圣龛
Shrine To A God Of Storms

Text.text:
神龛自湖中小岛上拔地而起，分裂成三道碎片，仿佛一面破碎的镜子残存的裂片。祭司们吟诵着，声浪起伏，如哀号的风一阵阵涨落；他们赤足踏在红沙上，以锯齿般的轨迹行走。远处的岸边，黑云在树梢之上翻滚涌动。
The shrine rises up from the lake island in three shards, like the pieces of a shattered mirror. Priests chant, their voices undulating like the rise and fall of wailing winds, as they walk in jagged patterns, feet bare on the red sand. On the distant shore, dark clouds roil above the treetops.

Blue Dragon Wyrmling.name:
蓝龙雏龙
Blue Dragon Wyrmling

Text.text:
那头龙形生物体态宽阔，外观几乎像鲨鱼般，从远处冷冷打量着你。它的体型约莫一只大型犬，目光锐利而狡黠，鳞片闪耀着天青石般虹彩的蓝。它的鼻孔翕张，吸入你的气味，随即亮出带倒刺的利齿。你闻到一股臭氧味，静电在空气中游走，令你全身汗毛尽数竖起。
The draconic creature, broad and almost shark-like in appearance, eyes you from a distance. Roughly the size of a large dog, the creature has eyes sharp and cunning, and scales the iridescent blue of azurite. Its nostrils flare as it breathes in your scent, and it flashes barbed teeth. You smell ozone, and every hair on your body stands on end as static laces the air.

I Detach A Bullseye Lantern Patch From M.name:
我从我的便携百宝袍上扯下一块“牛眼提灯”补丁
I Detach A Bullseye Lantern Patch From My Robe Of Useful Items

Text.text:
我扯住那块亮黄色补丁的银色边缘。它被撕开的瞬间，边缘变得冰冷坚硬，像金属一样。我把手指蜷起，握成恰到好处的姿势，一截弯曲的钢制提柄随即填满掌心。我绷紧手腕，去承受那只灌满油的灯室的重量；带着巨大单片透镜的牛眼提灯，就这样彻底具现成形。
I pull at the silver-colored edges of a bright yellow patch. As it tears away, the edge turns cold and hard, like metal. I curl my hand into the appropriate grip as a curved steel handle fills my palm. I tense my wrist to accommodate the weight of the oil-filled chamber as the bullseye lantern, with its large, single lens, fully conjures into being.

Stone Of Vocalization.name:
发声之石
Stone Of Vocalization

Text.text:
这是一块皂石——深灰色，触感细腻，贴合掌心，握着就让人安心。当它接收到要传递的讯息时，石身会微微发热，并召来一只魔宠，为那些原本只存在于脑海中的念头赋予声音。它的嗓音温润而仁厚，像来自旧世界的劝慰——那是漫长沉睡、安卧海床的年代。说完之后，它便以那份闻名的耐心静静等待。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

This is a soapstone—deep gray, smooth, and comfortable to the palm. When it receives the message it is to send, it warms and conjures a familiar to give voice to what was previously only thought. Its voice is soothing and kind, a counseling tone from the old world of long sleeps in the bed of the sea. After it speaks, it waits with famous patience.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Parlor Of A Manor.name:
庄园会客厅
Parlor Of A Manor

Text.text:
房间里弥漫着醇厚木香、深色烈酒与芬芳烟草的气息——几种令人心安的味道交织在一起，恰与这片空间里占据主导的高背椅上磨旧的皮革相得益彰。每面墙上都悬着挂毯，描绘着历史上声名赫赫的战役：对抗巨龙、牛头怪，以及不死者的尸潮。房间各处的桌上散落着几小堆书，有些半掀着书页，像被匆匆放下。
The room smells of rich wood, dark alcohol, and fragrant pipe weed—a mingling of comforts that pair well with the worn leather of the high-backed chairs dominating the space. Tapestries adorning each wall depict famous battles throughout history, against dragons, minotaurs, and undead hordes. Small piles of books, some half-open, adorn the tables throughout the room.

Creating And Entering An Exploit.name:
创建并进入一个漏洞
Creating And Entering An Exploit

Text.text:
你的服务器探针捞到了几枚布尔值，它们拼出漏洞，把它们框进控制台。时代到了。你提笔钻进盲点，像慢慢把自己放进一条河里般扭身滑入，代码在你周身奔流。计时器开始走动。你抛出文件，完成利用，只盼在任何防护措施启动之前，悄无声息地抽身而出。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Your server probe lands you a couple of Booleans that create the exploit and frame them in a console. Time. You write your way into the blind spot, wiggling in as if you were slowly lowering yourself into a river, the code streaming around you. The timer runs. You launch your file to complete the exploit and hope you can pop out unnoticed before any protective measures kick in.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Lantern Of Eternal Light.name:
永恒之光灯笼
Lantern Of Eternal Light

Text.text:
华美的金色灯笼倾泻出天界之光，以天穹般的暖辉浸润周遭一切。抛光的金属外壳上刻满欢欣赞颂的天使身影，附近所有人都能听见远处唱诗班飘来的圣歌回响。

~ 由Ethan 构想

Heavenly light pours from the ornate golden lantern, bathing everything nearby in the warmth of celestial radiance. Angelic figures depicted in joyous adulation cover the polished metal casing, and the sounds of a distant choir can be heard by all nearby.

~ Envisioned by Ethan

Demonic Charnel House.name:
恶魔屠宰馆
Demonic Charnel House

Text.text:
在枝形吊灯上三支白蜡烛的光芒下，堆着一座巨大的白骨山，其中夹杂着人类、精灵、矮人和兽人的头骨。自本厅西侧那条被落闸封死的走廊拖来的宽阔血痕，在此戛然而止。恶臭浓烈刺鼻——煤盆里焚香的甜腻与尸体腐败的腥臊搅作一团——昭示着某些仪式性杀戮确曾在这座恶魔大厅的废墟中进行。
Under the light of three white candles in the chandelier is a gigantic pile of bones that includes the skulls of humans, elves, dwarves, and orcs. The wide blood drag-stain from the portcullis-blocked corridor west of this hall ends here. The stench is powerful, a mix of the incense in the coal braziers and the reek of corpses—indicating that some of the ritual killings have taken place in the ruins of this demonic hall.

Approaching Rimespire Bastille.name:
逼近霜尖要塞
Approaching Rimespire Bastille

Text.text:
北方群山锋利而不祥，嶙峋峭壁将裹挟雪粉的狂风如箭般射向山谷；然而在它们之上，有一座山峰直探云霄，凌驾群峦。它光滑得绝非天然生成，那座金字塔般的山体每一面都仿佛在吐出太古的寒意与恐惧。它的孤立只令这座巨岩更显可怖，像是在暗示某种无人愿知的用途。

~ 由 Moonie 构想

As sharp and foreboding as the northern mountains are, with their crags firing gusts of snow down toward the valley, one peak reaches into the clouds above them all. Too smooth to be naturally formed, the faces of the pyramid seem to exhale a primeval dread. Its isolation only renders the monolith more fearsome, implying a purpose no one would wish to know.

~ Envisioned by Moonie

Faerie Carnival Snail Races.name:
妖精嘉年华·蜗牛竞速
Faerie Carnival Snail Races

Text.text:
你走近那只将要骑乘的巨型软体生物时，人群的咆哮与甜腻烘焙点心的香气一并涌入空气。你攀爬着想要触及它那涂成灰色、覆满黏液的皮肤，脚下一滑，险些失去平衡；好不容易才爬上它彩绘外壳顶端那副色彩鲜艳的鞍座。你停了一瞬，调整坐姿，感受缰绳在掌心沉甸甸的分量，目光掠过起跑线上与你并列的对手。随着一枚烟花尖啸着直冲天际，炸开成一团棱彩般的绚烂光瀑，比赛也在那一刻轰然开始。
The roar of the crowd and the smell of syrupy baked goods fills the air as you approach the gigantic mollusk you’ll be riding. Your foot slips on its gray mucus-covered skin as you climb to reach the brightly colored saddle atop its painted shell. You take a moment to settle yourself, feeling the weight of the reins in your hands and glancing around at your opponents on the starting line. A firework screams heavenward and explodes in a prismatic burst of color as the race begins.

Small Chapel Under A Tree.name:
树下的小教堂
Small Chapel Under A Tree

Text.text:
尽管昏暗而寂静，此地却并不令人心生不祥；反倒是在这几面墙之内，公会校园的喧嚣仿佛被尽数拂去，沉淀为一种超脱尘世的安宁。南墙上的祝福圣水池清新沁凉。祭坛上，两支燃烧的蜡烛与一尊含笑的神祇神像并列其上；坛面纤尘不染，光洁如新，仿佛才刚被细细拭亮。
Though dark and quiet, this place does not project a sense of foreboding; rather, within these walls the bustle of the guild’s campus dissipates into an otherworldly tranquility. The font of blessed water on the southern wall is fresh and cool. Two burning candles and the idol of a smiling deity sit atop the altar, which is free of dust and shines as if recently polished.

Fist Of Bane.name:
灾厄之拳
Fist Of Bane

Text.text:
战士的右臂护手黑得如同邪教徒自己的心脏——一只紧攥的、冷酷无情的金属铁拳，渴望以骇人的狂热碾碎一切违逆。带刺的头盔将他的面容笼在阴影里，与他沉重护甲那阴森可怖的轮廓相互映衬，令逼人的凶威更甚。
The warrior’s right gauntlet is as black as the cultist’s own heart, a clenched fist of unforgiving metal eager to crush disobedience with terrifying zeal. A spiked helm shrouds the man’s face, adding to the menace exuded by the sinister aspects of his heavy armor.

这个法术之所以被称为“英勇术”，是因为它能用盾牌般的力量为人挡开恐惧；但任何法术都造不出真正的勇气，正如任何魔法也无法真正造就一位英雄。真正的勇敢，真正的英勇，意味着为了他人把自己置于险境之中。这个法术只是让你做出那份选择时，稍微轻松那么一点。
This spell is called heroism because it shields someone from fear, but no spell can create true bravery, just like no magic can truly make a hero. True bravery, real heroics, requires putting oneself in harm’s way for others. This spell just makes that choice a tiny bit easier.

Seeming Cast With Care.name:
精心施展幻相
Seeming Cast With Care

Text.text:
你知道施放这个法术必须格外小心。它能让精灵看起来像兽人——但会是那种带着春雨气息、步履含蓄而优雅、嗓音温柔圆润的兽人。所以，一个优秀的幻术师明白：最划算的是编织一层离真相不算太远、却足以蒙混过关的伪装。因为再完美的易容，也可能在细看之下露出破绽。
You know you must take care with this spell. It can make elves look like orcs, but they’ll be orcs that smell of spring rains, step with subtle grace, and speak in gentle timbre. So, a good illusionist knows it pays to create a facade not too far from the truth, but something that will escape notice. For even the best disguise can fail when closely inspected.

Spelljammer Struck By Ballista Bolt.name:
星界帆船被弩炮巨矢贯穿
Spelljammer Struck By Ballista Bolt

Text.text:
右舷船艏传来一记猛烈撞击，瞬间攫住船员们的注意力，他们奔过去查看伤害。甲板上尽是急促踏步的轰鸣，所有人手忙脚乱冲向各自岗位，还有几人探身越过护栏，想看清究竟是什么撞上了他们。本以为会是小行星或些许太空碎片，然而从船体上突兀刺出的，却是一支巨大的弩炮箭矢。水手们还来不及细想这诡异的投射物，一轮鱼叉齐射便狠狠钉入舰身，随即开始将他们拖向伏击者。

~ Dwayne 于 Discord

An impact off the starboard bow draws the attention of the crew as they run to assess the damage. The deck is filled by the sound of pounding feet as all hands rush to their stations and a few peer over the guardrail to see what hit them. Where one might expect an asteroid or some space debris, jutting from the hull is a huge ballista bolt. The sailors barely have time to contemplate the strange projectile before a salvo of harpoons hammers into their ship and begins to drag them toward their ambushers.

~ Dwayne on Discord

Professor Of Evocation And Magical Heral.name:
塑能学教授与魔法纹章传令官
Professor Of Evocation And Magical Heraldry

Text.text:
他被人戏称为“伊壁鸠鲁教授”。每次职业课开讲，他便踏入形而上的境域，让学生透过诸界的窗扉窥见异界一瞬，并将跃动的光点或晦涩的密语召入教室。随后他猛然转向黑板，带着魔法的粉笔自行游走，勾勒出各个魔法家族的纹章符号，并把历史事件一条条列出——那些条目他无需看稿，便能倒背如流。卷轴哗然舒展，学生沙沙疾书，他低声吟诵：魔法，是灵性洞见与事实背诵之间的平衡。他用魔杖轻叩每一张课桌，为自己的论点打下清脆的节拍。
He is nicknamed Professor Epicureus. During each class meeting he journeys into the metaphysical realm, gives students glimpses through the windows of other planes, and calls dancing lights or cryptic messages into the room. Then he pivots toward a blackboard, the magical chalk drawing heraldic symbols of the magical houses and writing historical events in lists he recites from memory. The scrolls unfurl, the students write, and he chants that magic is a balance of spiritual insight and factual recitation. He taps his wand on each desk to punctuate his points.

雾气从这些水池里升起，只是微微遮掩了这片区域，却让热浪变得格外逼人。月光明亮得足以映在荡漾的水面上，即便没有一丝微风，水波依旧自顾自地起伏。无数水蛇在睡莲叶间穿梭，细小的花朵紧闭着，抵御着夜色。
Mist rises from these pools, only slightly obscuring the area but making the heat oppressive. The moonlight is bright enough to reflect off the rippling surface, which moves despite the lack of a breeze. Countless water snakes swim among lily pads, their tiny flowers closed against the night.

这把晨星锤的钢球上伸出的短而钝的尖刺，并非只是简单地装上再焊接到武器上——它们是逐一从钢材中凿出，并单独塑形而成。如此工序既漫长又昂贵，说明尽管这件武器外观略显朴素、以实用为主，却必定是依照某位懂得珍视大师级武器之力的使用者所提出的严苛规格精心打造。
The short, blunted spikes jutting out from the steel ball of this morningstar are not merely mounted and welded to the weapon—they have been chiseled out and shaped individually. Such an undertaking would have been a lengthy and expensive process, indicating that despite its somewhat plain and functional appearance, this weapon must have been made to the exacting specifications of a wielder who appreciates the strength of a master-crafted weapon.

Arms Of Hadar.name:
哈达尔之臂
Arms Of Hadar

Text.text:
你施展法术之际，活生生的阴影化作黑色触须自你胸膛迸裂而出，每一条都贪婪地搜寻着温热而柔软的血肉。惊愕、怒吼与凡人的绝望恐惧此起彼伏，你的敌人面对这骇人的黑暗魔法威能，纷纷失声惊呼。
Black tendrils of living shadow burst forth from your chest as you cast the spell, each one hungrily seeking warm, supple flesh. Cries of surprise, anger, and mortal terror ring out as your enemies react to the potent display of dark magic.

当四支竖笛齐奏出质朴、带泥土气息的笛音和声时，高音竖笛的旋律攀上最尖亮的高处。它的笛头与尾节经细致车削，造型简洁，身长尚不足一英尺，发声却像个活力四射的小歌姬。
As the quartet of recorders plays their earthy, fluty harmonies, the descanter rises to the highest notes. With head and foot joints delicately lathed, this simple instrument, less than a foot long, sounds like a spirited little diva.

Magical Stone Circle: Energy Buildup.name:
魔法石环：能量积聚
Magical Stone Circle: Energy Buildup

Text.text:
你的汗毛根根倒竖，牙齿在口中嗡嗡震颤。一股压力在内耳深处不断累积，仿佛你正一寸寸潜入更深更深的水下。石圈上空的天色骤然阴沉，世界仿佛向内收拢。你有种预感：很快，世上将只剩下你与这圈立石——而再过不久，你也会随之消失。
Your hair stands on end and you feel your teeth hum in your mouth. A pressure builds against your inner ear, as if you’re plunging deeper and deeper into water. The sky about the stone circle darkens, and the world seems to close in. It feels as if soon nothing will exist except you and the circle of stones—and not long after that, you’ll vanish too.

空气里充斥着嘶嘶声，许多头颅吐出漆黑的分叉长舌，品尝着空气。绿色的皮肤渗出黏液，沿着强健的躯干缓缓淌下。它没有双腿抓地，取而代之的是一条分叉的尾巴蜿蜒游动，鬼祟地拖出蛇行轨迹，在这生物身后留下宛如异界文字的痕迹。它那蛇一般的头颅彼此猛咬，互相推挤，争夺主导权。
The air fills with hissing as many heads flick dark tongues to taste the air. Green skin oozes slime down a muscular torso. No legs grip the ground; instead, a forked tail undulates a slinking pattern, leaving marks like alien writing in the creature’s wake. Its serpentine heads snap at each other, jostling for control.

Loot From A Wereraven.name:
狼人鸦的战利品
Loot From A Wereraven

Text.text:
在这名长羽的狼人身上，你发现了几件由这只鸦形生物搜罗来的贵重物品。十八枚闪亮的铜币，干净得不染尘垢；一枚打磨光亮的金质护符，上面浮雕着神圣的徽记——价值5枚金币——以及一把小巧的银钥匙。
On the feathered lycanthrope, you find some valuable items collected by the corvidian creature. Eighteen shiny copper pieces free of grime and dirt, a polished golden amulet embossed with a holy symbol—worth 5 gold pieces—and a small silver key.

这把小斧平衡得恰到好处，保养得一丝不苟，是一件令人胆寒的武器。斧刃呈不寻常的弧形构造，盘绕在抛光的浅色木柄顶端；木柄上刻着一列列棱角分明的符文。武器在你手中低鸣着力量，微微震颤，仿佛迫不及待要洒下你敌人的鲜血。
Perfectly balanced and meticulously maintained, this small axe is a formidable weapon. A curved head of unusual design winds around the top of a polished haft of pale wood inscribed with columns of angular runes. The weapon hums with power and vibrates slightly in your grasp, eager to spill the blood of your enemies.

男人微笑着聆听那只栖在他肩头、长着小角的生物发出尖利的叽喳声，显然对它的汇报十分满意。他那如抛光红宝石般的眼眸闪烁着掠食者般的狡黠，从屋顶的制高点扫视整座城市，将这座大都会的每一处细节尽收眼底。月光为宁静的夜色披上一层苍白如缎的光泽，映在这名黑暗精灵精致的衣饰与无可挑剔的武备之上。他腰侧垂着一柄长剑，置于雕工华美的剑鞘中，剑柄的钴蓝色泽在月辉里愈发深沉。他用拇指缓缓摩挲着横贯面颊的疤痕，随即起身，意志如铁，抬手在空中织出一连串繁复的手势。紫色能量旋涡般短暂环绕其身，一名肤色白皙的精灵从那片乱流中踏出。对自己的伪装颇为满意，这名战士从屋顶跃下，稳稳落在街道上，旋即悄然融入夜色之中。

~ Played by Cipher D Grimm

The man smiles as he listens to the shrill chattering of the small horned creature perched on his shoulder, clearly pleased with its report. Eyes like polished rubies gleam with predatory guile as he scans the city from his rooftop vantage, taking in every detail of the metropolis. Moonlight bathes the tranquil night in a pallid satin hue, reflecting from the dark-elf’s exquisite raiment and superlative weaponry. At his hip, a longsword hangs in a beautifully crafted scabbard, the cobalt finish of the hilt deepened by the moon's light. Running a thumb over the scar bisecting his cheek, he rises, steeled with purpose, and weaves a series of complex gestures in the air. A swirl of purple energy surrounds him briefly, and a fair-skinned elf steps out of the tumult. Pleased with his disguise, the warrior drops from the rooftop, landing expertly on the street below and stealing away into the night.

~ Played by Cipher D Grimm

Polar Forest Region.name:
极地森林区域
Polar Forest Region

Text.text:
积雪像一床柔软的白毯，裹住了极地冰林里的一切声响。吱呀作响的松树——被霜寒层层包裹——点缀在冷峻的高山荒原上，宛如一头远古兽形泰坦自冰封大地深处探出的森森獠牙。然而，即便在这片酷寒之境，林间仍回荡着生灵的动静。
Snow muffles the sound like a soft, white blanket in the frozen clime of the polar forest. Creaking pines—cocooned in frost—dot the stark alpine landscape like the teeth of an ancient bestial titan rising from the icy ground below. Yet, even in this frigid landscape, the forest is alive with the sounds of life.

Gorizall Sarros Elydark Flowerbreeze.name:
戈里扎尔·萨罗斯·伊莱达克·花微风
Gorizall Sarros Elydark Flowerbreeze

Text.text:
出身坚韧的族裔，却怀抱哲思，这位符文骑士承载着古老沉默的武人诗者之影：狂热由智慧收束，火焰被理性紧握。他这名僧侣始终在调和——将军旅训练与野性之心并置，让冰川般的冷静与凶悍的战技相互咬合；无论幽深洞窟，还是旷野战场，他都泰然自若——手握弯刃巨剑，胸藏宏大理论。

~ 由一位英雄 扮演

Born of tough stock but with a philosophical bent, this runic knight embodies the taciturn warrior poets of old, possessed of a zealotry contained by wisdom. The monk ever-reconciles his military training with his barbaric heart, glacial reason with fierce combative prowess, and is comfortable in deep caves or in the field—curved greatsword in hand, grand theory in mind.

~ Played by a Hero

Time-traveling Author Beholds Their Work.name:
穿越时代的作者凝望自己的作品
Time-traveling Author Beholds Their Works

Text.text:
作者望着自己心血凝成的完整卷册，眼中盈满自豪——它被郑重陈列在 Classics 区，紧挨着他们敬仰的文学英雄。指尖掠过目录上一排排压纹皮革书脊时，他们格外留意那些尚未出版的卷册，低声揣想其中将写下怎样的篇章。然而他们始终拒绝翻开一页——那可就成了作弊。

~ 由 MaesterAelix 在 Discord 上 Envisioned

The author's eyes well with pride as they behold the full volume of their work, proudly displayed in the Classics section beside their own literary heroes. Running a hand over the embossed leather spines of their catalogue they pay particular attention to volumes as yet unpublished and offer musings on the contents therein. They refuse to look though—that would be cheating.

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

浓密纠结的毛皮几乎遮不住这蛮横身影那荒诞修长的四肢上盘结如绳的肌肉。它的獠牙又长又参差，仿佛只有让这类类地精怪物始终半张着嘴才合情合理，好用那凄厉的长啸战吼更直白地震慑猎物。它那覆着毛发的手随意握着一柄巨大的钉头锤，轻巧得像孩童拈着一根细枝。
Thick, matted fur barely serves to conceal the ropey musculature knotted along the absurdly long limbs of this brutish figure. Its fangs are so long and jagged that it only makes sense for the goblinoid to keep its mouth partially open, the better to terrify its prey with its ululating war yells. Its hair-covered hand grips a massive morningstar as casually as a child holds a twig.

Loot From Asmodeus, Lord Of Hell.name:
来自地狱之主阿斯摩蒂斯的战利品
Loot From Asmodeus, Lord Of Hell

Text.text:
阿斯莫德斯若说有什么特质，那便是滴水不漏：他的衣袍上遍布暗袋与假底口袋，繁复诡谲，几如地狱本身般令人迷失。其中一处夹层里藏着一枚印戒，镶着一颗巨大的方形红宝石，宝石深处有一道漆黑的星芒爆裂般闪烁。另一边，一只压花皮革的剑鞘收着一把独一无二的匕首：刀身是黑色的波纹暗影，护手呈蝠翼骷髅之形，柄端则嵌着一枚莹亮的缟玛瑙。
Asmodeus is nothing if not thorough: his clothing is full of hidden pouches and false-bottomed pockets  as confounding as the hells themselves. One such compartment contains a signet ring set with an enormous square ruby, a black starburst gleaming in its depths. A tooled leather scabbard holds a unique dagger: a moiré black blade, a guard in the shape of a bat-winged skull, and a gleaming onyx pommel.

尽管这把巨剑高大宽阔，却自带一种同类兵器所缺乏的含蓄优雅。剑柄与十字护手被塑成一只风格化的雄鹰，双翼张扬，胜利般展开。钢制剑刃如鹰爪般弯曲，打磨光亮的深处隐隐透出一抹蔚蓝。
Though the greatsword is tall and broad, it carries a subtle elegance absent from similar weapons. The handle and cross guard take the form of a stylized eagle, its wings spread wide in triumph. The steel blade is curved like a talon and holds a hint of azure in its polished depths.

一滩泥泞的水坑又宽又深，盘踞在通往山丘的台阶底部。草地上有一道通往小溪的凹痕，显然许多人沿着这些台阶走到水边，只是还不足以把草踩得不再生长。也许这水有某种宗教意义，又或者人们只是去那里静坐，默想时代的流逝。
A muddy puddle, wide and deep, sits at the base of the stairs up the hill. A depression in the grass leading to the stream shows that many have used these stairs to go to the water’s edge, though not enough to keep the grass from growing. Perhaps the water holds some religious significance, or maybe folk just go there to contemplate the passage of time.

Warrior Emerges From Invisibility.name:
战士自隐形中现身
Warrior Emerges From Invisibility

Text.text:
猩红的双眼——燃着仇恨的烈焰——如恶意的幽魂般自阴影中剥离而出。其后，一具身形如同掀开面纱般渐次显现；一名纤瘦却披甲的战士逼近而来，弯刀高悬，杀意凛然，蓄势待发。
Red eyes—blazing with hatred—detach from the shadows like a malevolent specter. Behind them, a form emerges, revealing itself as if casting off a veil, and a slender, armored warrior bears down upon you, scimitars poised to strike with deadly purpose.

Taunt From A Holy Character About Correc.name:
一名圣洁角色对纠正错误的嘲讽
Taunt From A Holy Character About Correcting Mistakes

Text.text:
“我不知你是凭着何等污秽的机括才得以诞生；但正如神祇容许你的存在荼毒大地，他们也同样认为应当遣来一名光之使者，去清除他们的过失。”
“I do not know by what foul mechanism you came to be, but just as the gods have allowed your presence to blight the earth, they have also seen fit to send an agent of light to purge their mistake.”

Drider Encounter.name:
夺心蛛魔遭遇
Drider Encounter

Text.text:
你听见腿声，太多的腿，节节分明的肢体拖着那生物可观的重量向前推进，敲击石面发出清脆的嗒嗒声。在黑暗中，声音撞上石壁来回震荡，让你几乎无法判断那东西的确切方位。你用余光瞥见它的影子，庞大而怪诞。紧接着，它已逼至眼前，无处可逃。它漆黑的甲壳在昏暗光照下泛着冷亮的光，俯压在你上方——下半身是一具巨大的蛛形躯体，上半身却是扭曲变形的人形。那生物发出一声尖厉的嘶嚎：是饥饿，还是痛苦，你分辨不出。
You hear legs, too many legs, clicking against stone as multi-jointed limbs carry the creature's considerable mass forward. In the darkness, with sound reverberating off the stone, it's difficult to pinpoint the thing's exact location. You see its shadow with your peripheral vision, massive and grotesque. And then it's before you, inescapable. Its black carapace shines in the dim light as it looms over you—its lower half a massive arachnid, its top half a warped humanoid. The creature cries out: in hunger or in pain, you cannot tell.

巨魔（特征）的尸体支离破碎，被狂热的利刃劈砍成一块块布满疣瘤的残肢。刺目的绿色血液在地面洇成凌乱的血泊，而这生物的断头以满含恶意的冰冷黄眼死死瞪着你。
The troll’s corpse lies in pieces, hacked into warty components by a zealous blade. Lurid green blood stains the ground in messy puddles, and the creature’s disembodied head glares at you with chilling yellow eyes full of malice.

I Cast Continual Flame.name:
我施放《恒久火焰》
I Cast Continual Flame

Text.text:
只要在某个物体表面抹上一点红宝石粉尘，我便能唤起一团伴随我一生的不灭之火。它噼啪作响，先以宝石原本的色泽燃起，火舌上端却渐冷成淡黄；然而没有任何焦灼气味，也感受不到一丝热度。这是一支火炬，唯有被其他魔法驱散，或随着我生命的终结，才会熄灭。
With a little bit of ruby dust rubbed onto the surface of an object I can evoke a lifelong fire. It crackles up in the original color of the gemstone, then cools to yellow at the top, but there is no smell of burning and no heat to be felt. This is a torch that can only be dispelled by other magic or the end of my life.

I Cast Insect Plague Using A Druidic Foc.name:
我用一件德鲁伊法器物品施放“虫群瘟疫”。
I Cast Insect Plague Using A Druidic Focus Item

Text.text:
当神圣的咒语自我唇间吐出，嗡鸣的虫群便从我的德鲁伊法器深处倾泻而出，如无尽潮汐般翻涌不息。刹那间，我仿佛透过百万枚复眼看见世界，与那饥渴的群体相连——旋即将它们放逐向我的敌人，化作一团旋舞的痛楚之云。
As the sacred words leave my lips, buzzing insects swarm from within my druidic focus in an endless tide. For a moment I see through a million compound eyes as I connect with the ravenous host—before unleashing them toward my foe in a swirling cloud of pain.

很难分辨她究竟年轻还是年迈。她的皮肤被晒得黝黑而布满皱纹，可她的眼神与笑意却带着少女般的俏皮与羞怯。她身上的首饰多得足以抵三个人——大多以马鬃编成，却又夹杂着银与金的手镯——再配上一件粗纺连衣裙，足足五层，缀边与刺绣的色彩多到数不清。她手里托着一枚烟雾般幽蓝的玻璃圆球，置于一块格纹羊毛手绢之上。

~ 由 Shangerla构想

It’s hard to tell if she’s young or old. Her skin is tanned deep and wrinkled, but her eyes and smile are girlish and coy. She wears more jewelry than three people combined—most of it woven from horse hair, but intermingled with silver and gold bangles—and a rough-spun dress of five layers and countless colors of trim and embroidery. In her hand she holds a smoky blue orb of glass on a plaid woolen kerchief.

~ Envisioned by Shangerla

这盏提灯由暗淡的灰锡制成，呈圆筒形，顶部是圆拱形罩顶，并带有一枚连在其上的挂环，便于悬挂。筒身一侧装着提柄；另一侧则是一扇带闩的小门，嵌着一枚球状的玻璃镜片，打开后便能看见灯芯燃烧的位置。提柄正下方是油仓的黄铜加油盖，旁边还有一枚黄铜旋钮，用来调节灯芯的升降。
This lantern is a cylinder of dull gray tin with a domed top that has an attached loop for hanging. On one side of the tube is a handle. The other side is a latched door, with an orblike glass lens, that opens to reveal where the wick burns. Just below the handle is the brass cap for the oil reservoir and a brass knob to move the wick.

I Cast Hold Monster Using My Arcane Focu.name:
我用我的奥术法器物品施放了“定身怪物”
I Cast Hold Monster Using My Arcane Focus Item

Text.text:
我摆出标准握姿，吐字清晰，将魔法经由焦点引导，随即释放。怪物冷冷地平视着我，法术的讯息如阴影般渗入它的躯体，使它动作迟滞。

[豁免成功] 然而它随即一阵颤抖，猛然抖落效果，重获自由。

[豁免失败] 颤动渐渐止息……随后怪物彻底停下，目光直直望向前方，僵直麻痹。

I assume the proper grip, speak clearly, aim my magic through the focus, and deliver. The monster fixes a flat, cold gaze on me and the message of the spell creeps into its body, slowing it.

[Successful Save] But then it quivers, shakes off the effect, and is free.

[Failed Save] The shaking stills… and then the monster stops moving altogether, staring ahead, paralyzed.

I Cast Purify Food And Drink.name:
我施放“净化食粮与饮水”
I Cast Purify Food And Drink

Text.text:
我搓着双手，直到能感觉到魔法在掌心与指尖间刺刺作响。一阵铜色与银色的能量如雨倾泻，落在那些来路可疑的食物与饮品上，将它们化作看上去新鲜、闻起来也令人愉悦的佳肴。
I rub my hands together until I can feel my magic prickle through my palms and fingers. A shower of copper and silver energy descends upon the highly questionable food and drink, transforming it into fare that looks and smells delightfully fresh.

Desert World Setting.name:
沙漠世界设定
Desert World Setting

Text.text:
在许多原始文化中，太阳常是崇拜的核心。它温柔的光辉带来温暖、滋养与明亮，将世间的瑰丽以如画之美铺陈开来。但太阳也能是冷酷的女神，而没有谁比沙漠的居民更懂这一点。温暖会化作令人窒息的酷热，摧残心智与肉体。沃土退去，留下流沙——飘移无常，连最简单的跋涉或定居都变得摇摇欲坠。最可怕的是太阳的光，它像永不熄灭的探照灯，将荒芜废土的贫瘠无所遁形地照得通明。

然而，人们仍会来到这道世界的伤疤——探险者深入古老遗迹，游牧民掌握了生存的秘法，亡命之徒则逃到离社会越远越好的地方。所有人都在一座早已被遗忘的文明残骸之上落脚。也许某场灾厄改写了世界的面貌，造就了这般严酷；也许只是时光顺着自然的轨迹，一点点啃噬了古代城市。答案必定就在某处，被埋在黄沙之下。你能活得足够久，去揭开它们吗？

The sun is often a focal point of worship among primitive cultures. Its glowing benevolence provides warmth, nourishment, and light: showcasing the splendors of the world in picturesque beauty. But the sun can be a harsh goddess, and nobody knows that better than the denizens of the desert. Warmth turns to sweltering, unbearable heat that ruins mind and body alike. Fertile ground gives way to sand, shifting and unreliable for the simplest journey or settlement. Worst of all is the sun’s light, which shines an unending spotlight on the barren expanse of wasteland.

Yet people still come to this scar in the world—explorers delving into ancient ruins, nomads who've learned the secrets of survival, and outlaws living as far from society as they can run. All settle over the remains of a civilization long-since forgotten. Maybe a catastrophe changed the face of the world and caused these harsh conditions, or maybe the world’s natural course ate away at the ancient cities. The answers must surely be out there, buried in the sand. Will you survive long enough to uncover them?

Pan, The Pansexual Pan-playing Pan.name:
潘，那位泛性恋、吹奏排箫的潘
Pan, The Pansexual Pan-playing Pan

Text.text:
萨堤尔慵懒地伸了个懒腰，舒展间将那隐约却分明的肌肉绷得紧实。纤细而矫健的身形，配上如熔融青铜般的肤色，勾勒出一位林间半神的幻影。他的眼眸闪着祖母绿的光，狡黠而灵动；赤褐色的头发编成褶纹般的辫束，既带着迷人的凌乱，又被打理得恰到好处。他从身侧的酒壶里痛饮一口，抹去唇边淌下的一缕酒液，随即将排箫举到唇前。
The satyr stretches languidly, pulling taut subtle yet defined muscles. A slim, athletic build, coupled with skin the shade of molten bronze, evokes the image of a woodland demigod. His eyes gleam emerald and shine mischievously, while his auburn hair lays in pleated braids, at once both charmingly unkempt and perfectly coiffed. He takes a swig from the jug of wine at his side, wiping a trickle from his lips before bringing a pan flute to them.

Bard Using Cutting Words.name:
吟游诗人使用「切割之词」
Bard Using Cutting Words

Text.text:
吟游诗人那句精准的刻薄话正中靶心。敌人顿时失了神，先是满脸受辱，继而神情沮丧。被侮辱已够难堪；而被如此字字珠玑地侮辱，更像往伤口上撒盐。
The bard’s well-aimed invective hits its mark. Their foe loses their focus, looking offended, then crestfallen. It’s grievous enough to be insulted; it’s rubbing salt in the wound to be insulted so eloquently.

Mobile Alchemy Shop.name:
移动炼金工坊
Mobile Alchemy Shop

Text.text:
小车咯吱咯吱地颠簸前行，几根歪斜的烟囱里一股股冒出带着气泡般轻快的烟雾，伴随着玻璃相互轻撞的清脆叮当声。驾车的是个顶着一头卷曲绿发的男人，笑容极具感染力，坐在柔软的驾驶座上，一边吹着欢快的口哨，一边将这辆古怪的车引向城镇。 车在热闹的广场前停下，他顺势对围拢而来的人群卖了个关子，利落跳下车，麻利地支起摊位。新开张的门面上方，一条横幅倏然展开，其上用俏皮的店名大大写着招牌。

~ Tusker2Zero on Discord

The small wagon belches plumes of effervescent smoke into the air from several crooked chimneys as it trundles along, accompanied by the soft clinking of glass. A man with a shock of curly green hair and an infectious smile whistles cheerfully as he guides the curious vehicle toward town from the plush driving seat. Pulling up in the bustling square, he plays to the gathering crowd as he hops down from the wagon and opens his stall. A banner unfurls above the newly opened storefront with a quippy name emblazoned on it.

~ Tusker2Zero on Discord

如同一只上了锁的坚固保险箱，仓库巍然矗立——一座商贸与工业的堡垒，专为守护关键资产而建，防范那些顺手牵羊的手指与窥探的目光。尽管外观刻意朴素，内部的安保措施——以及人员——却绝不可小觑。
Like a locked strongbox, the warehouse stands resolute, a fortress of commerce and industry designed to safeguard vital assets from sticky fingers and prying eyes. Though the exterior is deliberately plain, the security measures—and personnel—within are not to be underestimated.

I Cast Prestidigitation.name:
我施放【戏法】
I Cast Prestidigitation

Text.text:
我从记忆深处轻易唤起这个法术，就像劳工伸手就能摸到工具腰带。我练它练得仿佛上了千遍，只为让技艺始终锋利。手指一响，手腕一抖，口中一句短促的命令——想要的效果立刻降临。
I recall this spell from the back of my mind as easily as a laborer reaches for a tool belt. I've practiced this what feels like a thousand times, just to keep my skills sharp. A snap of my fingers, a flick of the wrist, a quick command—the desired effect is instantaneous.

I Overhear A Secret.name:
我无意间偷听到一个秘密
I Overhear A Secret

Text.text:
我从小巷旁走过时，听见低声交谈——压得极低，像是密谋般的耳语——于是停下脚步侧耳倾听。尽管那些情报对我而言陌生，我却清楚地感觉到，它承载着一个被严密守护的秘密的分量。我探头绕过拐角，只见那些接头人分头散开——其中一个径直朝我走来。
I hear voices—lowered to a conspiratorial whisper—in the alley as I pass, and I pause to listen. Though the information is foreign to me, I get the distinct sense that it holds the weight of a well-kept secret. Peering around the corner, I see the contacts split up—with one heading right for me.

I Am Struck By Magic Missiles.name:
我被魔法飞弹击中了
I Am Struck By Magic Missiles

Text.text:
飞镖凶狠地刺进我身上，灼痛像被一只格外恶毒的黄蜂蜇中般点燃神经，仿佛火在血里窜。皮肉迅速麻木——即便隔着我的护甲——而一阵沉钝的酸痛沉入肌肉深处。
The darts sting ferociously as they hit me, and a burning sensation sets my nerves on fire as if stung by a particularly vindictive wasp. The flesh grows numb—even beneath my armor—and a dull ache settles deep within my muscles.

Goblin In Oversized Armor.name:
穿着过大护甲的地精
Goblin In Oversized Armor

Text.text:
你看见一个身影伏在一具尸体上，当你靠近时，它的眼睛向你投来阴沉的一闪。直到它猛地向后退去，你才意识到那身影并非跪着——那是个套着过大护甲的地精。肩甲垂到它的手肘，胸甲下摆甚至荡过膝盖，让你不由得想起一个年幼孩子在玩过家家般的装扮。
You see a figure kneeling over a body, and its eyes flash darkly at you as you approach. It isn’t until it quickly moves backwards that you realize the figure was not kneeling—it is a goblin in oversized armor. The shoulder plates come to the goblin’s elbows and the chest piece hangs past its knees, reminding you very much of a young child playing dress-up.

Giant Spider's Web.name:
巨型蜘蛛网
Giant Spider's Web

Text.text:
在一棵树与另一棵树之间，铺展着一张体型巨大的蛛网，在月光下泛着粼粼光泽。银色丝缕挂满露珠，托着一串串包裹——形状各异、体型不一。蛛网轻轻一颤，震动顺着丝线传开，一股浓稠的蓝灰色油液自上方滴落。你抬头望去，只见树冠浓黑如幕，枯瘦的枝桠森然逼近，将星光尽数遮断。
Stretching between one tree and another, a web of massive size glistens in the moonlight. Silver tendrils drip with dew and hold a selection of bundles—all different shapes and sizes. A twinge reverberates through the webbing and a thick, bluish oil drips down from above. Looking up, all you see is a dark canopy of trees, spindly limbs looming and barring the stars.

倒钩般的尖刺沿着这头高耸的蟾蜍状生物的脊背一路竖起。它那橡胶般的皮肤呈尸体般斑驳的灰色，密布着疣块。细长的四肢末端伸出镰刀般的利爪向外弯曲；在宽阔而倾斜的额头下，一双黑眼闪烁着被掩饰的狡黠。
Barbed spines run up the back of this towering, toad-like creature. Its rubbery skin, the mottled gray of a corpse, is riddled with warts. Scythe-like claws curve outward from its gangly limbs, and beneath a broad, sloped forehead, black eyes gleam with a belied cunning.

这名农民在死后得到了静默而庄重的体面——那是他们生前屡屡被剥夺的。尽管地位卑微，遗体仍被换上干净朴素的衣裳，合拢的双手间还放着一小束雏菊。
A quiet dignity has been granted to the peasant in death, which they were so often denied in life. Despite their meager station, the body has been dressed in clean, simple clothes, and a small bouquet of daisies has been placed in their clasped hands.

倾覆的修道院墙体以破败的角度歪斜着，曾经高耸的立柱塌陷内折，凭自身重量将建筑碾得支离破碎。彩绘玻璃碎成堆，风从敞开的窗洞里呼啸穿过。那对包铁的巨大橡木门斜挂在锈蚀的铰链上。门后是一条空荡的长厅，早在许久之前就被洗劫一空，凡值钱之物尽皆不存。
The toppled abbey walls stand at a decrepit angles, the once soaring pillars collapsed in on themselves, crushing the structure with their weight. Stained glass lies shattered in piles and the wind howls through the open windows. The massive oaken doors, banded with iron, hang askew on rusted hinges. Beyond, a long hall stands bare, long ago ransacked of anything valuable.

Cabinet Of A Creepy Manor.name:
阴森庄园的橱柜
Cabinet Of A Creepy Manor

Text.text:
这间屋里那张巨大的长桌摆放得别有用心：领主端坐于桌首那张臃肿而华丽的高背椅上，仅凭居高临下的姿态，便让所有在其面前就座之人都显得渺小。桌面虽被打磨得发亮，可一旦接触，指尖却会沾上一层油腻的触感，怎么也无法立刻擦去。
The enormous table in this room has been situated in such a way that the lord—sitting at its head in their overstuffed, fanciful seat—diminishes all those who sit in their presence. Though this table has been polished, there is an oily feeling to the touch that you cannot quickly rub away.

Zylleth Xakore.name:
泽莱斯·萨科尔
Zylleth Xakore

Text.text:
他那双饱经风霜的绿眸格外醒目，双眼周围晕着烟熏眼影，左眼下方横着一道疤。那锐利而搜寻的眼珠，呼应着这名身形轻捷的精灵的其他特征。乌鸦般的黑发垂至肩头，一顶深色宽檐帽与之相衬，像眼妆勾勒双眸那样，为他棱角分明的脸庞定出轮廓。修长的黑色双排扣长外套披覆在他身上，腰间系着双层束带，胸前斜挂一条肩带通向右肩。束带与背带交汇处，一柄精致长剑的剑柄从斗篷下若隐若现。他戴着上等皮手套，手背嵌着绿宝石。一只纤细的手按在剑柄与剑鞘相接之处，另一只则漫不经心地拨弄着他腰带上串着的众多细小绿瓶中的一个。栖在他肩头的黑猫头鹰有着银色的眼睛，神情与他如出一辙。

~ Played by Samuel with

His world-weary green eyes stand out, with smoky eyeshadow around both and a scar under the left. Those sharp, seeking orbs echo this lithe elf’s other features. Raven hair, hanging to the shoulders, and a dark, wide-brimmed hat frame his angular face like the makeup does those eyes. A long, double-breasted, black coat drapes his frame, double-belted at the waist, with a baldric across the chest to the right shoulder. Where the harness and belts meet, the hilt of a fine sword peeks from under his cloak. His hands are gloved in fine leather, with green gems on the backs. One slender hand rests where the hilt meets the sheath, while the other absentmindedly touches one of the many tiny green vials looped into his belts. The silver-eyed, black owl on his shoulder mirrors his look.

~ Played by Samuel with

这条腰带的设计颇为奇异：由数颗小巧的玻璃珠构成，借由坚韧的皮绳细致串联，正面以金属扣件稳稳合拢。每一颗珠内都盛着某种诡秘的液体；凑近细看，你会发现每片玻璃上都刻着优美的符文铭文。系上这条腰带后，无论境况如何，周遭环境似乎总会维持在恰到好处的温度。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The belt is of a curious design, made up of several small glass orbs, lovingly strung together with a sturdy leather cord and a metal clasp on the front. Inside each sphere is a strange liquid, and upon closer inspection you spot beautiful runic inscribing on each piece of glass. With this belt on, the environment somehow always feels the right temperature, no matter the circumstances.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Loot From A Deathlock.name:
死亡锁巫妖的战利品
Loot From A Deathlock

Text.text:
当那不死的生物终于屈服倒下，用以引导其魔法的苍白枯槁法杖也随之坠地。法杖周围缠着一串兽牙项链，落下时叮当作响，宛如阴森的风铃。
As the deathless creature finally succumbs, the pale, withered staff being used to channel its magic drops to the ground. Around the staff is a necklace of animal teeth, which clatter like a macabre wind chime.

Mace Of Disruption.name:
破坏钉锤
Mace Of Disruption

Text.text:
尽管普通的钉头锤常被视作残忍而粗陋的武器，但这柄钉头锤却与“粗陋”二字毫不相干。它经电镀与抛光，亮得耀眼；只要握住它的木柄，散乱的阳光便仿佛会被某种力量牵引，捕捉其光并从那层光泽上反射出去。更诡异的是，即便置身彻底的黑暗之中，这一幕也依然会发生。
Though the common mace is considered a brutal and crude weapon, there is nothing crude about this mace. Electroplated and buffed to a gleaming shine, the mere act of taking hold of it by its haft causes errant rays of sunlight to somehow catch and reflect off its sheen. Bizarrely, this seems to happen even when it is held in total darkness.

Witch Casts A Diabolical Spell.name:
女巫施放邪魔法术
Witch Casts A Diabolical Spell

Text.text:
自冥渊般的黑暗中踉跄走出一名女巫，她那煤灰色的长袍黑得如同她的灵魂。她一手死死攥着一本邪秽的魔典，低声呢喃着恶魔般的秘辛。她尖啸着吐出充满力量的咒词，向你放出一束束蠕动起伏、搏动着血肉的触须。
From the stygian dark shuffles a witch, her soot-gray robes as dark as her soul. Clutched in one hand, a tome of vile sorcery whispers diabolic secrets. She screeches words of power, unleashing undulating tendrils of pulsing flesh toward you.

三张铺着森林绿毯子的床被硬生生挤到这间狭窄房室的西侧，旁边还堆着几只木箱，箱盖紧闭。一条粗大的树根蜿蜒钻入室内，筋络般的根须仿佛正朝那一簇床铺伸去。房间东侧的阴影里立着一扇紧闭的门。
Three beds with forest-green blankets have been shoved to the western side of this narrow chamber, along with various wooden chests with lids shut. One large tree root weaves into this chamber, its sinewy tendrils seemingly reaching toward the cluster of beds. A closed door sits shadowed on the eastern side of the room.

一团被收束的薄霾——半是海市蜃楼，半是雾气——在空气中低语。它直径约八英尺，自行漂浮，完全不理会任何风向。探寻般的附肢从它的形体里旋出，卷成紧密的小旋风，侦探着它周围的空间。
A contained haze—part mirage, part fog—whispers through the air. Roughly eight feet in diameter, the thing floats of its own accord, heedless of any wind. Questing appendages spin out of its form in tight whirlwinds to investigate the space around it.

这一区坐拥全城最古老的遗址：迷宫——由异教祭司修筑的曲径迷宫。这里也有一处室内外相连的市集，正对着一排较新的店铺与公寓楼。许多市民与旅人偏爱迷宫堡，正因为它被打理得一丝不苟。沿着迷宫低矮的绿篱点起的灯火，让它看上去不再那么怪异而灵性，更像一处城中的地标。然而有时，学院的学生会披着长袍前来踱步，目光怪异地直视前方，口中喃喃自语。
This ward has the oldest site in the city: The Maze—a labyrinth built by pagan priests. It is also home to the indoor/outdoor city market, across from a row of newer shops and apartment houses. Many citizens and visitors favor Mazebury for how meticulously kept it is. Lights along The Maze’s low hedgerows make it seem less strange and spiritual, more like a city landmark. However, sometimes the Academy students in their robes come to walk it, staring ahead strangely and mumbling.

这名肤色白皙的侏儒身形修长纤细，是个身材矮小的女子，气质沉稳而自信。她嘴角总挂着一抹揶揄的笑意，牵动左眼处那道从眉梢延至下颌的细长伤疤，令其微微起皱。她穿着朴素粗粝的乡野衣装，沾着尘土，靴底糊满泥浆。腰间挂着一根拐棍：一截简陋的木制短棍，握柄被长期使用磨得光滑，末端则在无数次冲突里撞得凹痕累累。

~ 由 Anniemc 饰演

This fair-skinned gnome stands slender and slight, a woman of diminutive stature with a calm, confident nature. A wry smile tugs perpetually at the corners of her mouth, crinkling the long, thin scar running from brow to jaw across her left eye. She wears spartan, rustic garb dusted with dirt, and boots caked with mud. At her belt hangs a tonfa: a simple, wooden cudgel whose handle is worn smooth from use, and whose end is dented from countless skirmishes.

~ Played by Anniemc

Submerged Steps Leading To The Ruined Te.name:
通往毁坏神殿的没水石阶
Submerged Steps Leading To The Ruined Temple

Text.text:
寺阶根部四周澄澈的蓝绿色水域，被厚厚一层睡莲叶半遮半掩——其间有鱼影穿梭——但你仍能辨出天界羽蛇神的雕刻徽记。它刻在一条半没于水的石径上，尽管历经数百年水波拍打侵蚀，这道雕纹的恢弘气势依旧不减。宽阔阶梯两侧，水流从雕刻龙鱼的石口中，沿着凿成的沟槽倾泻而下。
The clear, blue-green water surrounding the base of the temple steps is partially obscured by a thick covering of lily pads—with fish darting among them—but you can still make out the carved emblem of the celestial couatls. Engraved in a partially submerged stone path, the carving's grandeur is intact despite centuries of wear from the water lapping across its surface. On either side of the wide stairs, water flows down shaped channels from the stone mouths of carved dragonfish.

The Quotidian Museum.name:
日常博物馆
The Quotidian Museum

Text.text:
这地方更像是囤积癖的五十个衣橱拼在一起，仿佛档案室一股脑儿从博物馆里溢出来，泼到了前厅。圆形瓷砖地面的中央停着一辆蓝色皮卡，车顶上还固定着一片四英尺长的塑料披萨切片。这里有一间屋子专门堆了几十年的电话，另一间则塞满信用卡、钱包，以及像钱夹那样让人摸不着头脑的首饰。写着错误说明的纸板吊牌从手枪、雪茄剪、睫毛夹和解压小玩意儿上垂下来，晃晃悠悠。这是一座答案少得可怜、问题多得溢出来的博物馆。
This place looks more like fifty closets of a hoarder, as if the archives spilled out to the front of the museum. In the center of the round tiled floor is a blue pickup truck with a four-foot slice of plastic pizza mounted to its roof. There is a room for decades of telephones, another for credit cards, wallets, and confusing jewelry like money clips. Cardboard tags with incorrect descriptions dangle from handguns and cigar cutters, eyelash curlers, and fidgets. This is a museum full of more questions than answers.

乍看之下像是一块突起的岩石，却忽然扭动蠕行起来。它那想必是头部的位置伸出钩尖触手，如花般绽开，露出一张喙，足有铁匠用的夹钳那么大。它其余的躯体介于乌贼、蛇与蛞蝓之间，卵石般的皮肤起伏涌动，推动它以惊人的速度向前窜行。
What seems for a moment to be a protuberance of stone wriggles and slithers. Hook-tipped tentacles on what must be its head open like a flower to reveal a beak as big as a smith’s pinching tongs. The rest of its body is somewhere between squid, snake, and slug, its pebbly skin rippling to drive it forward with surprising speed.

Slaver Guarding A Cage.name:
奴隶贩子守着牢笼
Slaver Guarding A Cage

Text.text:
时髦的帽子戴在一双满是残忍的眼睛上，显得格格不入。那女人的华服多半是从比她身份更高的人那里顺来的，搭配得乱七八糟：柔紫撞上葱绿，刺眼得很。她双臂交叉站着，守着一个覆着粗纺布的大方箱。她抬脚踹了箱子一下，随即扬起笑容——箱中传出一声人的呜咽，细弱发颤，像被挤出的尖响。
The fashionable hat looks out of place above eyes full of cruelty. The woman’s finery, probably lifted from someone above her station, is mismatched: soft purples clashing with verdant greens. She stands, arms crossed, guarding a large square box covered by rough-spun cloth. She gives it a kick and smiles as a person’s whimper, soft and trembling, squeaks out.

法师眯起双眼，目光锁定在目标身上，随即却又变得涣散失焦，几乎在眼眶里打着旋。法师伸出两根手指，逆时针划出一个圆。时代仿佛被绊了一下——迅疾地倒转——紧接着，法师的目标便重演了刚才的一举一动，那一瞬被精确地重置回起点。

~ Alex构想

The wizard’s eyes narrow and fix onto the target, but then they blur and lose focus, almost spinning in their sockets. The wizard points two fingers and draws a circle, counterclockwise. There is a hitch in time—a quick reversal—and then the wizard’s target repeats what they just did, the moment resetting precisely to where it began.

~ Envisioned by Alex

Street Kids Try Skate Tricks On Makeshif.name:
街头少年在临时拼凑的半管上挑战滑板花式
Street Kids Try Skate Tricks On Makeshift Half-pipe

Text.text:
他们穿着同类那套脏兮兮、松松垮垮的行头，一群滑板客在摇摇欲坠的木制半管旁欢呼怪叫，看着同伴腾空翻转、落板稳住。聚合物轮子滚过木面的哗啦作响，为这座拼凑得乱七八糟的坡道上接连不断的杂技般动作打着节拍。
Dressed in the grungy, baggy attire of their ilk, the gang of skaters whoop and holler as their friends perform tricks on the rickety wooden half-pipe. The rolling clatter of polymer wheels scores the group's acrobatic feats atop the haphazard ramp.

Loot From A Skeletal Cat’s Lair.name:
骸骨猫巢穴中的战利品
Loot From A Skeletal Cat’s Lair

Text.text:
在这处昏暗蒙尘的巢穴里，你发现一堆尸骸——多是小鸟和老鼠——未被啃食的肉块腐烂发黑，蛆虫在其间蠕动翻涌。那股酸腐的尸堆下面，有什么东西闪了一下光：在龇笑般的鼠颅与血痂凝结的鸟翼之间，隐约露出金属的冷芒。你翻出一叠精致的手镯，却被麻绳与乱发纠缠成一团。
In this dark and dusty den you find a pile of carcasses—small birds and mice mostly—their uneaten flesh rotting and wriggling with maggots. Underneath the rancid heap, something winks with light: hints of metal between simpering rodent skulls and blood-crusted bird wings. You find a stack of fine bracelets raveled with twine and hair.

Pirate With Djinn Lamp.name:
手持魔灵神灯的海盗
Pirate With Djinn Lamp

Text.text:
海盗一边欢快地吹着口哨，一边把精灵神灯绕着手指转得飞快；客人倒抽一口冷气，那位学者更是明显绷紧了身子，他却浑不在意。船长将古老的神灯放到书桌上，细细欣赏黄铜表面那纤巧的雕纹。宝石嵌饰的手随意一挥，他挂着一抹乖戾的笑，向惶惶不安的学究保证：没什么好担心的——没人能骗过这条满身咸腥的海狗。

~ 由 Discord 上的 MaesterAelix 在 Envisioned 于 Discord

Whistling cheerfully, the pirate twirls the djinn lamp around their finger, ignoring the sharp intake of breath from their guest as the scholar visibly tenses up. The captain places the ancient lamp on their desk, admiring the delicate engravings upon its brass surface. With a wave of their bejeweled hand and a cantankerous smile, the pirate assures the fretting academic that they have nothing to worry about—no one outfoxes this salty seadog.

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

Loot From A Skeletal Rider.name:
骷髅骑手的战利品
Loot From A Skeletal Rider

Text.text:
在一堆人形与马类的白骨之间，你发现一只仍完好的鞍囊。然而，当你掀开袋盖，一股粪臭般的腐烂恶味猛地冲入空气。囊内，你找到一卷被霉菌啃噬穿透的羊皮纸卷轴，还有一袋闪着幽光的黑色宝石，以及几片覆着炭灰色包浆的淡色大理石碎片。
Among the pile of humanoid and equine bones, you find a saddlebag still intact. However, as you open the flap, a fecal smell of rot surges into the open air. Within, you find a roll of parchment eaten through with mold, as well as a bag of shining black gems and shards of pale marble with a charcoal patina.

Vampire Sleeping While Hanging Upside Do.name:
吸血鬼（特征）倒挂着沉沉入睡
Vampire Sleeping While Hanging Upside Down

Text.text:
吸血鬼（特征）裹紧一袭红天鹅绒斗篷，倒挂在横梁上，静如雕像；一绺绺长白发垂落，像幽灵（特征）破碎的尾端。他的脸大半埋在斗篷褶皱里，只能看见眉头紧锁——仿佛正陷在一场不快的梦魇中。椽梁间的阴影让人难以看清他究竟是如何稳稳停在那里的。
Snugly cocooned in a red velvet cloak, the vampire hangs from a beam, still as a statue, long white hair dangling like the frayed end of a ghost. His face is mostly hidden in the folds of his cloak, though you can see his brow is furrowed—perhaps in the throes of an unpleasant dream. The shadows in the rafters make it difficult to know exactly how he stays in place.

High-class Boutique Hotel And Restaurant.name:
高档精品酒店与餐厅
High-class Boutique Hotel And Restaurant

Text.text:
悬挂在城市最巅峰的一朵人造云上，这家精品酒店如同私密绿洲般向天际延展。柔和的粉彩织物垂覆墙面，在人造微风里轻轻鼓荡。几缕完美的碧蓝细流交错穿行于大理石步道之间。一道安抚法术在整座建筑群中循环流淌，让你浑身沉入深邃的安逸与松弛。酒店后方，倚着一线不可能的瀑布边缘，餐厅静坐其上——洁净无瑕，臻于极致——端出大多数人从未知晓的珍馐。无形侍者为巨大的高脚杯斟满蜜香美酒与稀罕烈酿，宾客则半倚在漂浮的座椅上。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

Suspended upon an artificial cloud at the very zenith of the city, this boutique hotel stretches into the sky like a private oasis. Soft pastel fabrics drape the walls, billowing in artificial wind. Little streams of perfect turquoise crisscross the marble walkways. A calming spell circulates through the entire complex, leaving you with a sense of deep ease and relaxation. And at the rear of the hotel, upon the edge of an impossible waterfall, sits the restaurant—immaculate, impeccable—serving culinary delights unknown to most of the population. Invisible waiters fill great goblets with honeyed wines and exclusive spirits, and patrons recline in floating chairs.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Basilisk: Petrifying Gaze.name:
蜥蜴怪：石化凝视
Basilisk: Petrifying Gaze

Text.text:
蜥蜴怪的目光落在你身上，泛着不祥的蓝色幽光。你的关节开始僵硬，动作变得迟缓。

[豁免失败] 僵硬感彻底攫住你，身体噼啪作响、骨节爆裂，肤色迅速褪白。你再也无法自如行动。

[第二次豁免失败] 身体的开裂与硬化最终归于死寂与黑暗，你在这一回合化为石像。

[初次失败后豁免成功] 体内的僵直戛然而止，随即潮水般退去。你又能行动了。

[豁免成功] 你的关节短暂僵住，但你强行将那股感觉压了下去。

The basilisk’s eyes fall on you with a baleful blue glow. Your joints stiffen and your movements slow.

[Failed Save] The stiffening takes hold, and your body pops and cracks, becoming pale. You’re unable to move freely.

[Second Failed Save] The cracking and hardening of your body gives way to silence and darkness as you turn to stone.

[Successful Save after Initial Failure] The rigidity in your body halts, then recedes. You can move again.

[Successful Save] Your joints momentarily stiffen, but you fight off the feeling.

Sundries From A Green Dracolich.name:
来自绿龙巫妖的杂货
Sundries From A Green Dracolich

Text.text:
这是一堆最典型的骸骨残堆，部分骨头上仍挂着被撕碎、正在腐烂的衣物碎片。骸骨被精心摆成一件阴森的艺术品——一幅死亡的曼荼罗。
This is the quintessential bone pile, with shredded and decaying garment fragments still hanging from some of them. The pile is arranged into a work of macabre art, a mandala of death.

Temple To A Goddess Of Pain.name:
献给痛苦女神的神殿
Temple To A Goddess Of Pain

Text.text:
这座神殿堪称残酷建筑的范本，以粗粝的炭灰色石块垒砌而成。中殿两侧沿途凿出一列列壁龛，陈列着各式刑具与其配套之物——镣铐与铁链、铁处女、带着束带、搭扣与倒刺的器械——一路引向内殿；在那里矗立着女神的神像：一名女子剃光了头，双眼与双唇被线缝死，双臂布满纵横的裂伤。可这些陈设并非用来制造恐惧；此地的信众渴望认识痛楚，与之贴身相知，毫不退缩地拥抱它，并因此更接近他们的女神。
The temple is an exemplar of brutal architecture, constructed of rough charcoal-gray stone. Alcoves along the length of the nave display various torture devices and their trappings—shackles and chains, iron maidens, things with straps and buckles and barbs—leading up to the inner sanctum, where a statue to the goddess stands: a woman with her head shaved, eyes and lips sewn shut, and arms covered in lacerations. But these furnishings are not meant to strike fear; the adherents here seek to know pain, to understand it intimately, embrace it unflinchingly, and become closer to their goddess.

Ally's Horrific Transformation.name:
盟友的骇人蜕变
Ally's Horrific Transformation

Text.text:
你同伴那虹彩般的血肉从俊美的五官上剥落下来，像滴落的蜡烛油一般淌下；你在彻底的惊骇中眼睁睁看着他们的手臂被拉长，手指延伸，化作修长而凶恶的利爪。一抹癫狂的狞笑撕裂了他们崭新的面孔，那张脸仍湿淋淋地挂着精灵伪装残留的血污与筋膜。他们咯咯大笑——湿黏、咕噜作响的怪笑——并用狂人的目光死死钉住你。

~ JakesKhakis247 于 Discord

Your companion's iridescent flesh sloughs from their handsome features like dripping candle wax, and you watch in abject horror as their arms stretch and their fingers lengthen into long, wicked claws. A crazed grin tears across their new face, still wet with the gore and sinew of their elven guise. They cackle—a wet, gurgling chortle—and fix you with a maniacal glare.

~ JakesKhakis247 on Discord

I Put In My Eye Of Night Vision.name:
我装上了夜视眼
I Put In My Eye Of Night Vision

Text.text:
我仰起头，将物品摆正——那是一件完全由翡翠雕成、形似眼球的奇异物体。圆球持续嗡鸣，涌动着魔法能量；就在那只眼睛嵌入恰当的位置的瞬间，周遭的黑暗随之变得柔和。视野豁然明亮清澈，却又染上一抹诡异的翠绿色。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

I tilt my head back as I place the item into position, a curious object made entirely of jade carved to resemble an eyeball. The sphere hums continually with magical energy, and as soon as the eye finds its place, the darkness around me softens. It becomes bright and clear, yet tinged with an odd green hue.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Techno Spell: Ice Pick.name:
科技法术：冰锥
Techno Spell: Ice Pick

Text.text:
在赛博空间迷雾般的无垠深处，你唤出一根由代码凝成的针，它的形体迅速凝实，化作阴险的破冰锥，锋利如刃，蓄满毁灭的恶意。你的造物幽魂般滑入赛博以太，轻易穿行，除了它注定的目标——一个ICE程序——再无任何事物能令它止步。伴随女妖般的尖啸，尖刺如同皮下注射针般猛然刺入ICE的防御壁垒，释放出病毒载荷，数秒之内便将防御代码融穿殆尽。

~ 一位英雄 Envisioned

In the nebulous expanse of cyberspace, you conjure a needle of code, its form materializing into the insidious form of an ice pick, sharp and primed with destructive intent. Your creation glides with ghostlike ease through the cybernetic ether, its deadly potential undeterred by anything but its intended target—an ICE program. With a banshee-like screech, the spike plunges into the ICE's defensive wall like a hypodermic needle, releasing a viral payload that melts through the defensive code in seconds.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Euphoric Street Drug, Bliss: Ingested.name:
欣快街头毒品「极乐」：口服
Euphoric Street Drug, Bliss: Ingested

Text.text:
几乎在药物碰到你舌尖之前，一股爆炸般的温热安宁就席卷全身。色彩在慢镜头里轰然绽放，声响膨胀成一支支独立的交响，你的肌肉融化成一滩滩温暖的狂喜。思绪碎裂为诗意的分形，任何侵扰或不快都被突如其来的平静压得无影无踪——那平静缠绕着你的灵魂，将你完全包裹。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Almost before the drug touches your tongue, an explosive wave of warm serenity washes through you. Colors explode in slow motion as sounds swell into individual symphonies, and your muscles dissolve into puddles of warm euphoria. Your thoughts shatter into fractals of poetry, anything intrusive or unpleasant smothered under the sudden peace that wraps your soul.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

坚韧、挺括的皮革构成护腰的主体，裁制得恰好贴合腰背下方。几段柔韧而加固的织物如雄壮羽翼般向外舒展，绕过佩戴者的躯干收拢合抱，将其牢牢固定。织翼两端各嵌着一枚金色搭扣，上面镌刻着医疗双蛇杖的纹样，并施以能随佩戴者身形自动伸缩的魔法。

~ 由 Envisioned 于 Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Sturdy, rigid leather forms the main body of the brace, designed to fit on one’s lower back. Sections of supple, reinforced fabric stretch out like mighty wings, wrapping around the torso of the wearer to hold it securely in place. A golden clasp, depicting a medical caduceus and enchanted to resize the brace to fit the wearer, sits at each end of the fabric wings.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Feyric Del Varnish.name:
妖精系的德尔·瓦尼什
Feyric Del Varnish

Text.text:
这名苍白而年轻的精灵睁大眼睛，眉梢高挑，嘴角挂着夸张的坏笑。红色的眼眸在一头凌乱蓬松的白发下闪烁发亮，尖耳从那片发丛中突兀地探出。他身披厚实的深色布外套，下面是同材质的长裤，衣物上缝着口袋与挂环，便于收纳。高筒靴由被风尘磨旧的皮革制成。左手随意搭在细剑的篮形护手上，右手则把玩着几点银辉般的微光尘屑。

~ 扮演：Feyric Del Varnish，使用

This pale, youthful elf has a wide-eyed look with raised eyebrows and a broad smirk. His red eyes twinkle under a tousled mop of white hair, pointed ears jutting from that mane. He wears a coat of thick, dark cloth over similar trousers, both fitted with pockets and loops for storage. Road-worn leather makes up his tall boots. His left hand rests easily in the basket hilt of his rapier as he plays with motes of argent light with the right.

~ Played by Feyric Del Varnish with

Chime Of Opening.name:
开启之铃
Chime Of Opening

Text.text:
这根银亮的金属管约莫卷轴筒的体型，却显然不是用来装卷轴的——它没有端盖。相反，其中一端被打了个孔，穿过孔的是一圈红白相间的细绳。细绳下垂着一柄小小的木槌。这东西想必是某种风铃或鸣器，但金属上自孔处延伸出一道仅指尖长的裂缝，让人不免怀疑它的音色是否还能清亮。
The silvery tube of metal is about the size of scroll tube, but clearly that cannot be its purpose, as it has no caps. Instead, a hole pierces one end, and threaded through it is a loop of red and white string. Dangling from this loop is a little wooden hammer. This thing must be some sort of chime, but a fingertip-length crack in the metal extends from the hole in the tube, casting doubt on the quality of its sound.

你不禁揣测，这座怪异的桥究竟由何而成：是巨人凿刻？是法师抬升？是土元素塑造？不，你忽然明白——是风本身在漫长的万古岁月里雕琢出这道结构。天然的拱桥自头顶凌空横跨，以恢弘的尺度巍然耸立。
You wonder what formed this strange bridge. Carved by giants? Raised by wizards? Erected by earth elementals? No, you realize—the wind itself formed this structure, carving it over eons. The natural arch soars overhead, majestic in its scale.

City Floating On Air.name:
漂浮于空中的城市
City Floating On Air

Text.text:
起初你几乎不敢相信自己的眼睛，但那刺破云层的轮廓不容否认。若是月亮从天穹坠下，俯临世间以示威胁，也不过如此震撼。那巨大的圆形之物，竟是一座飞行城市。你甚至能看见楼宇窗上的玻璃映着光芒，微微闪烁。
You find it difficult at first to believe your eyes, but the shape piercing the clouds can’t be denied. If the moon came down from the sky to menace the world, it would be no less astonishing. The massive circular shape is in fact a flying city. You can even see glass in the windows of the buildings glint with light.

一缕撩人的嗓音钻进你脑海最深处。呢喃如云，刺耳而愈发喧嚣，把你每一丝恐惧都逐一记述。战栗在心口翻涌，像一滴将要落下的泪。随后你看见了恶魔：一具近似人形的东西。也许它曾经是人类。但如今只剩一张灰蒙蒙、毫不起眼的无名面孔。恶毒的笑容咧开，露出一排排尖利的牙齿。可即便如此，它身上仍有某种令人难以抗拒的诱惑…… A sultry voice makes entry into the very back of your head. A cloud of whispers, dissonant and growing louder, chronicles your every fear. Dread lurches like a welling tear in your heart. Then you see the devil: something alike to a human. Perhaps it was human once. But now it is only a nondescript, gray nobody. A malevolent smile reveals rows of pointy teeth. And yet there is something very inviting about it…

长达整整六码的长戟上，斧刃闪烁着无害却清晰可见的蓝光。每一次挥舞与劈砍，都在身后拖出一抹淡淡的余辉。
Fully six feet long, the halberd’s axe head gleams with an inoffensive but visible blue light. It leaves a faint aftereffect trailing behind it with every swing and chop.

Argonaut, The Aberrant Samurai.name:
阿尔戈英雄：畸变武士
Argonaut, The Aberrant Samurai

Text.text:
这名兽人男子却有着精灵般修长纤细的耳朵，短短的獠牙几乎只是从下唇边缘微微探出。鹰隼般锐利夺目的双眼呈现异色：一只是冰蓝，另一只是焰黄。他身形高大而宽阔，胸腹的雕刻般肌肉被一件敞开的毛皮背心毫无遮掩地展露出来。三颗类人生物的头骨串成项链，垂挂在他双肩的板甲护肩之间。双腿同样覆以相似的板甲：裙甲、腿甲与胫甲。他握着一柄巨大的巨剑剑柄，剑尖抵地——这把武器几乎与他等高。一支五叉长矛斜背在他身后，金光灿灿如破晓。腰带上还挂着一颗鹰身女妖的断头，头颅无力地晃荡着，面孔仍凝固在嗜血的狂怒之中。

~ Played by James B with

The orcish man has the long, slender ears of an elf and short tusks that barely peek out of the edge of his bottom lip. His eyes, sharp and striking as a falcon’s, are two different hues: one ice-blue, the other flame-yellow. His stature is both tall and broad, the chiseled muscle of his chest and stomach displayed clearly by a furred vest, worn open. A necklace bearing three humanoid skulls is strung between the plate pauldrons upon his shoulders. His legs are also protected by similar plates: faulds, cuisse, and greaves. He holds a massive greatsword by its hilt, its end set into the ground—the weapon as tall as himself. A five-pronged spear, gleaming gold as the dawn, is slung across his back. The severed head of a harpy lolls from a belt at his hip, its face still frozen in a bloodthirsty rage.

~ Played by James B with

德鲁伊放下一只玻璃生态缸，缸壁上的蚀刻纹路骤然迸亮，火花般明灭跳动。碗中迅速盈满清水，视角被拉向遥远处——水不再是水，而化作浩瀚海洋：成群游鱼如银箭穿梭，巨鲸破浪腾跃，缸沿的弧度竟勾勒出一圈环抱的海岸。最后，玻璃上的纹路燃成炽亮文字，凝结为完整的命令；生态缸周围的所有人都被封进一枚九十英尺的海水巨泡之中——生机翻涌，覆着细沙海床。

~ 构想：Crimson Coffin

As the druid sets down a glass terrarium, etchings on the glass spark and flicker. The bowl fills with water, the perspective changes to a great distance, then the water is the ocean, with fish swimming in schools and whales breaching, and the edges create a surrounding shore. Finally the glass etchings ignite into words, full commands, and everyone around the terrarium is encased in a ninety-foot bubble of ocean—full of life and covering a sandy floor.

~ Envisioned by Crimson Coffin

Sai Yuki Returns.name:
彩雪归来
Sai Yuki Returns

Text.text:
一束乳白虹彩的月光击落在地。自那刺目的辉辉之中，湛蓝光与焰构成的天使之翼舒展张开。光束渐渐消散，天使显露身形——身披闪耀的秘银半身甲。她安然滑落至战场，优雅而凛然；银色长发如旗帜般翻涌，耳与尾皆似狼形，也同样染着月华。穿透一切的金色眼眸注视着眼前，坚定——而又似曾相识。

~ 由 Komaru 扮演

An opalescent moonbeam strikes the ground. From that blinding radiance, angelic wings of azure light and fire unfurl. The beam dissipates and the angel is revealed, clad in gleaming mithral half plate. She glides serenely down to the battlefield, elegant and formidable, long silver hair rippling like a banner and moonlight-tinged, as are her wolflike ears and tail. Piercing golden eyes gaze upon the scene, resolute—and familiar.

~ Played by Komaru

Ylsbeth Nurievna.name:
伊尔斯贝丝·努里耶芙娜
Ylsbeth Nurievna

Text.text:
一位半身人女子，肌肉紧绷如钢索，身高足有四英尺，正用一根打磨光亮的红杉木棍末端，冲着她身旁那只巨大的黄色母鸡的蜥蜴般脚爪来回晃点。那只庞然大物为躲开她戏谑的轻戳而蹦跳着，每次爪尖落地，都像雷鸣般震得地面轰响。半身人的祖母绿眼睛闪着光，蓬松的红发在她含笑的脸颊旁跳动——她美得动人，是一道令人心驰的风景。她在蓝绿相间的格子短裙外系着一圈金色钱币腰带，上衣裁得短而贴身，好让移动更自在。她凸出的腹肌在雀斑点点的皮肤下刀刻般分明。

~ Played by @SixteenCharlie3 with

A halfling woman, wired with muscle and fairly tall at four feet, wags the end of a polished redwood shillelagh at the saurian feet of the giant yellow chicken accompanying her. The huge hen hops to avoid her playful prods, each landing of its talons thundering against the ground. With the halfling’s emerald eyes aglitter and her voluminous red hair bouncing about her smiling face, she is lovely, a charming sight to behold. She wears a belt of golden coins over her blue and green tartan kilt, and her shirt is cut short and tight for freer movement. Her prominent abdominal muscles are chiseled under freckled skin.

~ Played by @SixteenCharlie3 with

Mountain Outpost Ingress.name:
山地前哨入侵
Mountain Outpost Ingress

Text.text:
越靠近前哨，山势越发陡峭，掩蔽也只剩零星几丛灌木。积雪堆在那条充作道路的砂质古老河床最宽处两侧的褶皱里。塔楼愈发清晰时，映入眼帘的还有石质胸墙上架设的弩炮；而其余部分，则是沉重的木梁结构。
Closer to the outpost, the mountains become steeper and cover is reduced to a couple of bushes. Snowdrifts have settled into creases beside the widest part of the sandy, ancient riverbed that serves as a path. As the towers come into clearer view, so do the ballistae mounted on the stone parapets of the otherwise heavy-timbered construction.

Monk Quip About Using Weapons.name:
武僧打趣：关于使用武器
Monk Quip About Using Weapons

Text.text:
“是啊，武器也不错，但我跟你说：没有什么比一拳揍得人连自己鼻窦里的滋味都尝得到更痛快的了。”
“Yes, weapons are fine, but let me tell you: nothing tops punching someone so hard they can taste the inside of their sinuses.”

Dwarf Commoner Prisoners.name:
矮人平民囚犯
Dwarf Commoner Prisoners

Text.text:
那衣衫褴褛的孩子用细瘦的小手死死攥着母亲，见你走近，惊恐得瞪大了眼睛。他的抓握扯下母亲那件补丁累累的粗麻上衣上几缕粗线。与之相对，母亲——一名骄傲而严峻的矮人——以克制的好奇注视着你，神情沉稳如石。她戒备未消，却仍怀着一线希望：你并无加害之意。
Clinging to his mother with small, thin fingers, the ragged child looks upon you with wide-eyed terror as you approach. Their grasp pulls coarse threads from the patchy hempen tunic of his mother. In contrast, the mother—a proud, stern dwarf—regards you with curiosity, tempered by stoicism. She is wary but hopeful you mean them no harm.

一声震耳欲聋的轰鸣撼动大地，你这才意识到那尊雕像刚刚动了。让这庞然威胁行动的，远不止赋予它生命的魔法。它带来一种不可阻挡的必然感，仿佛你正立于悬崖之缘，眼睁睁看着雪崩朝你席卷而来。
A thunderous boom sets the ground quaking, and you realize the statue just moved. There’s something more to this massive menace than the magic that animates it. It gives you the impression of inevitability, as if you’re looking at an avalanche rushing toward you while standing on the edge of cliff.

Approaching Riverside Border Town In Win.name:
冬日逼近河畔边境小镇
Approaching Riverside Border Town In Winter

Text.text:
透过稀薄的雾霭，你隐约看见镇上方方正正的建筑，檐沟下垂着冰锥，如同折断的白牙。你踏上那座令人心惊地吱呀作响的桥，横跨封冻的河面；岸边一名孤零零的渔夫正用鹤嘴锄凿冰，动作一顿，短暂抬眼瞥了你一眼。
