当你触及桥尽头时，一名披着毛皮斗篷的守卫从散发着蜡黄火光的火盆旁抬起头来。他们开口时，蒙在围巾后的声音沉闷而毫无情绪。

Through the thin mist, you can make out the town’s blocky buildings, icicles hanging from their gutters like broken white teeth. As you cross the bridge—which creaks alarmingly—spanning the frozen river, a lone fisher, attempting to cut through the ice with a mattock, pauses briefly to glance up at you.

When you reach the end of the bridge, one of the fur-cloaked watchmen looks up from a brazier burning with a sallow flame. The muffled voice is devoid of emotion when they speak.

Speech About Never-ending Mission.name:
关于永无止境的使命的演说
Speech About Never-ending Mission

Text.text:
“当我眺望此地，我看见的是安宁；河流如丝绸般穿织于山谷之间，叶片在风中嬉戏起舞……我们身边处处迸发着天堂的光辉。然而我知道，在某个地方，就在不算太远的地方，我们的世界正燃烧，空气被尖叫与灰烬点亮，而我也知道，我的工作尚未完成……也许，它永远都不会结束。”
“When I look out at this place, I see peace; the way the rivers weave like silk through the valleys, the leaves dancing playfully with the wind… there are bursts of heaven all around us. Yet I know somewhere, not too far off, our world burns, the air alight with screams and ash, and I know my work is not done… Perhaps it never will be.”

风里裹挟的声响起初几乎还算悦耳，像雨点噼啪溅在砖墙上。可那声音愈发壮大，你看见由无数细小轮廓聚成的云团正朝你涌来——随即，你惊恐地认出，那是一场蝗群。身边的人还在逐渐意识到危险，你的目光却被一条由细小绿色躯体汇成的“河流”拽住：那是尚未成虫的蝗蝻，沿途吞噬着每一寸植被；与此同时，几十只就在你眼前第一次振翅离地。理智告诉你，像这样的蝗灾足以把整片聚居地推到毁灭边缘；可那逐渐攀至轰鸣顶点的声浪，却让你的本能先一步陷入恐慌。
The sound carried by the wind is almost pleasant at first, like raindrops splashing against brick. But as the sound grows, you see clouds made up of tiny shapes heading your way—and, with horror, you recognize a swarm of locusts. Even as those around you begin to recognize the danger, your eyes are drawn to a river of tiny green bodies, the immature hoppers, devouring every bit of vegetation in their path, while dozens of them take wing for the first time before your eyes. Entire settlements have been brought to the brink of ruin from plagues of locusts such as this one, your rational mind tells you, even as your animal instincts are panicked by the sound reaching a roaring apex.

Ruins Of A Large Village.name:
大型村落的废墟
Ruins Of A Large Village

Text.text:
道路上的车辙里盛着连日雨水汇成的清澈积水。山谷与路旁，房屋和杂屋零零散散地趴伏着，朽败程度各不相同。藤蔓攀上墙面，幼树从坍塌的屋顶里钻出——在某处——风将一扇百叶窗啪地拍打在墙身上。村子近中央，一座磨坊立在低矮的山丘上，风帆呼呼旋转，楼体深处的机括碾磨不休，把尘土磨回尘土。
The ruts in the road are filled with clear water from the recent rains. Scattered about the vale and along the roadway, houses and outbuildings slouch in varying states of decay. Vines climb walls, saplings poke through collapsed roofs, and—somewhere—the wind claps a shutter against the side of a building. Near the center of the village, a mill’s sails spin atop a low hill, the building’s inner workings grinding dust to dust.

Loot From An Owlin.name:
来自鸮民的战利品
Loot From An Owlin

Text.text: 在倒下的鸮裔半截斗篷底下，你发现一把弩——以沙色木材打造，打磨得如雪花石膏般泛着冷白微光。她腰侧箭囊里的弩矢被刻成流线的羽形，尾端带着钩状尖刺。她束衣内侧缝着一只暗袋，里面塞着一小把金币钱币，以及一枚椭圆形护符；护符表面压印着一株树的纹样。你检查护符的魔法性质时，发现它能施放一种tiny hut法术的变体，还能让你离地悬浮，升至附近任意一棵松树的树梢高度。 Underneath the fallen owlkin’s half cloak, you find a crossbow crafted of sand-colored wood polished to an alabaster gleam. The bolts in the quiver at her hip have been carved into the shape of a sleek feather with hooked points at the end. A pocket sewn on the interior of her tunic holds a handful of gold coins as well as an oval-shaped talisman embossed with the image of a tree. Inspecting the talisman for magical properties, you discover it casts a version of the tiny hut spell that also allows you to hover aboveground at the height of any nearby pine tree.

你面前那根倒木上坐着的龙裔女子衣着素净，完全没有吟游诗人常见的花哨装束。可她仍在拨弄一件你从未见过的乐器的弦——形似曼陀林，却更为扁薄，音箱不那么深。你不禁猜想她究竟能演出什么：是酒馆里喧闹的助兴把戏，还是上流社交场合里竖琴师那种端庄克制的雅乐——直到你听见她以娴熟而笃定的力道扫过琴弦。饱满的音色仿佛从乐者周遭四面八方涌起，沿着你的脊背激起一阵战栗。
The soberly-dressed dragonborn woman sitting on the fallen log in front of you is not dressed flamboyantly like a bard, but she is nonetheless adjusting the strings of a musical instrument you have never seen before, similar to a mandolin but with less depth to its body. You wonder what kind of show she could possibly put on, thinking of carousing tavern entertainment as well as the staid, sober art of the harpists associated with high society functions—until you hear her strum the strings with a practiced authority. The rich sound, seemingly coming from everywhere around the musician, thrills down your spine.

Temple To A Supreme Goddess.name:
至高女神的神殿
Temple To A Supreme Goddess

Text.text:
这座神殿看上去像一座用整块石料砌成的屋宅，宏大却不咄咄逼人，而且没有门。精心垒砌的石拱点缀其间，正面是一列连绵的拱廊，背后则是一道巨大的敞开拱门。殿内，家的炉火是神殿的核心：庄严而明快，对心灵有治疗之效，也如护符般抵御长夜。炉火周围铺着地毯，堆着软垫与矮几。若遭威胁，教众可齐声吟诵炉台上镌刻的咒文，炉火便会化作锻炉。
This temple appears to be a freestone house, large but not overwhelming, and with no doors. Arches of carefully placed stones adorn it, an arcade of them along the front, a great open arch in the back. Inside, the hearth of home is the temple’s central feature, grand and cheerful, healing to the mind and a ward against the night. It is surrounded by rugs and cushions and low tables. In times of threat, the incantation inscribed on the mantle may be chanted by the parishioners, and the hearth becomes a forge.

The Vile Grove.name:
邪秽林苑
The Vile Grove

Text.text:
蜘蛛和食腐甲虫在你脚边仓皇逃窜，扭动着身躯，拼命往湿透的泥地里钻。虬结的树根如骷髅利爪般向上伸展，盘绕的枝条像刽子手的绞索般下垂吱呀作响。恶臭而刺骨的寒风翻滚着穿过林间空地，上方浓密树冠垂挂的骨与石的小饰物叮当作响，像在碰撞吟唱。没有一丝光能穿透头顶阴影与纠结交织的帷幕；在这片荒凉里，也没有半点暖意能寻到你。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Spiders and carrion beetles flee at your feet, squirming and digging into the sodden ground. Gnarled roots reach upward like skeletal claws while coiled branches droop and creak like an executioner’s noose. The wind, foul-smelling and frigid, rolls through the forested clearing, and trinkets of bone and stone draped from the dense canopy above clatter and sing. No light penetrates the shadowed, knotted shroud above; no warmth finds you in this desolation.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Horn Of Valhalla.name:
瓦尔哈拉号角
Horn Of Valhalla

Text.text:
这只战号由寻常金属锤锻塑形，以一条皮革系绳悬挂。号身被分隔成数块刻面，其上蚀刻着一幕幕怒涛般的厮杀战景。靠近号嘴、也就是持握之处，能看到古老的文字。即便是不识那奥秘符文的人，也会觉得那更像警告，而非诗句或铭记身份的标记。无论这乐器被擦拭得多么洁净，号角末端始终隐隐散出铁锈与血洒战场的淡淡腥气。
The war horn, hammered and shaped from common metal and attached to a hide thong, has several scenes of raging battles etched into panels along its body. Near the mouthpiece, where one would be expected to hold the horn, ancient script can be found. Even to those who cannot read the arcane text, it looks more like a warning than a poem or identifying mark. A faint scent of iron and spilled blood radiates from the end of the horn regardless of the instrument’s cleanliness.

Healer's Duty.name:
治疗者的职责
Healer's Duty

Text.text:
“给人缝补伤口可不体面。你见到的是他们最狼狈的样子——发抖、哭泣、满身污秽——为自己这具孱弱的身体而羞惭。我所能做的，不过是替他们留下一点尊严，也许还能把那个人从痛苦的重压下挖出来——在他们被那些苦楚掩埋之前，他们曾经是什么样子。”
“Patching people up isn’t glamorous. You see them at their worst. Shaking, crying, covered in filth—embarrassed at their own body’s infirmity. All I can do is offer a little dignity, and perhaps uncover the person they used to be, before they were buried under the weight of all that pain.”

这堆白骨显然被人摊开、翻检过，散乱得像被野兽啃噬后的残骸。与骨堆相对，东侧墙前几尺处立着一座花岗岩祭坛，坛身绘着一幅壁画：一位骇人的恶魔领主赤身而立，半兽化的面孔上挂着得意而胜利的笑容。祭坛顶上摆着几截燃到一半的蜡烛，全部点亮，蜡质怪异，泛着珍珠般的幽光；它们环绕着一枚由血染碎骨研成的五芒星，俨然是仪式献祭的所在。祭坛台面与正面以及地面上，凝结的血迹飞溅成片；有人以奥秘语与炼狱语写下细密的字迹，仿佛用木棍、利爪或指甲在血上划刻而成。
This bone pile shows signs of having been spread out and picked through. Opposite the pile, a granite altar stands a couple of feet from the eastern wall, on which is painted in a mural of a horrifying demon lord—standing naked and with a triumphant smile on its semi-bestial face. Atop the altar are half-candles, all lit and made from strange pearlescent wax, surrounding a pentacle of bloody ground bone that looks to be the place of a ritual sacrifice. In the coagulated blood splattered over the altar’s top and front, and on the floor, someone has written a fine script in arcana and infernal, as if scratched into the blood with a stick, claw, or fingernail.

森林的一角忽然蠕动变形，你这才意识到自己并非孤身一人。一团藤蔓、蕨类与杂草碾碎枯枝般向前挤压而来，纠结的树枝与灌木不知怎的活了过来。它没有腿、没有头，也没有任何肢体，但这堆活动的植物仍让你强烈感到——它是活的，而且带着粗暴的智慧。
A portion of the forest shifts, and you realize you are not alone. A mass of vines, ferns, and other vegetation crunches forward, a tangle of tree and shrub somehow come to life. It has no legs, head, or other appendages, but this animate pile of plants nevertheless gives you the impression of life—and brutish intelligence.

这把小竖琴以精灵长弓般的柔和弧线雕成，每一处部件都取自同一棵枫树。它毫无装饰，朴素而淡卡其色；肠线琴弦在每一次拨响的和弦里都随光微微闪烁。不吟唱它那轻快、安抚人心的小曲时，它必须装在一只上过蜡的粗呢袋里，背在玩家背上，以免受天气侵扰。
This little harp is carved in gentle curves like an elvish bow, each piece from the same maple tree. It is completely unadorned, plain and light khaki, with gut strings that flicker in the light with each chord plucked. When it isn’t singing its merry, calming little tunes, it must ride on the player’s back in a waxed duffle bag to protect it from the weather.

如此强大的防护系魔法绝不可能无足轻重，但这正是那种足以铸就神话的法术。至少，关于它被施放的传说早已烙进史诗。又有多少次，像你这样的人低声吐出它的咒词，便将他人掷入湮灭——永远囚禁在无尽的遗忘地牢中，任何魔法都无法触及，被所有人遗忘，他们的消失成了无解的谜？
Magic as powerful as this abjuration can never be inconsequential, but this is the kind of spell from which myths are wrought. At least, tales of its casting have been emblazoned into legend. How many times has someone like you whispered its words and flung another into oblivion—locked away in an eternal oubliette, unreachable by any magic, and forgotten by all, their disappearance a mystery?

Vision Of A Great Evil Revealed.name:
一个巨大邪恶现身的幻象揭露
Vision Of A Great Evil Revealed

Text.text:
一块菱形的干瘪肉块悬在黑暗中。你听见锁链喀啦作响，仿佛有上千名囚徒在远处、在隐蔽处一齐挣动。魅影般的血肉在空荡的空间里飘得更近。金属撞击声愈发逼近，尖厉嘈杂；腐烂的恶臭像疫苗般给空气注入了败坏。你再想也没用——当它缩短与你的距离时，你无法后仰，也无法转开视线。如今你终于看清：灰绿相间、线缕般的皮褶里藏着几乎不可辨的五官轮廓——一张离体的面孔，带着骇人的怒容。脸上的肌肉抽动，你听见有什么碎裂了，像一阵金属碎片雨点般砸在地上。额与颌的皮肉绷紧锐化，怒意更甚，狰狞更深。它的下颌开始缓慢旋转，发出碾磨的咯吱声，脸颊的皮屑坠落，露出底下血淋淋的肌腱与牙齿交织成的网。眼睑伴着噼啪一声被撕开，化作两处空洞。更深处，蓝色火焰的火星点燃，嘴巴吱呀张开，爆出暴怒的嚎叫。一圈蓝焰光冕在它头颅周围成形，而一股漆黑、华丽的长袍从它的下巴下方翻涌垂落。它那骇人的咯咯怪笑将你猛地从睡梦中掀飞。你惊醒时，冰冷的汗从头到脚浸透，心跳狂奔不止，鼻腔与口腔里仍残留着一股陈腐的滞味。

~ Envisioned by Vmaster1995

A diamond of desiccated meat hangs in darkness. You hear chains rattling, as if a thousand prisoners shake, far off and hidden. The phantom flesh floats closer in the empty space. The sound of clanging metal becomes louder, cacophonous, and a rotten odor inoculates the air. As much as you want to, you can’t lean back or turn away as it closes the distance between you. Now you can see the barest hints of features hidden within folds of gray and green threads of skin—a disembodied face set in a fearsome scowl. The muscles in the face twitch and you hear something shatter, like a shower of metal shards raining against the floor. The flesh of the face’s brow and jaw sharpen into an even more indignant grimace. Its jaw begins to rotate slowly in a grinding circle, flakes of skin falling from its cheeks to reveal a gory web of tendons and teeth underneath. Eyelids tear open with a crackle, becoming two hollows. Deep within, sparks of blue flame ignite and the mouth creaks open in a raging howl. A corona of blue flame forms about its head and a billow of dark, luxurious robes flows down from its chin. The horrid sound of its cackle flings you out of sleep. You awaken with an ice-cold sweat covering you from head to toe, a galloping heartbeat, and a staleness lingering in your nose and mouth.

~ Envisioned by Vmaster1995

Quip About Becoming A Family.name:
关于成为一家人的俏皮话
Quip About Becoming A Family

Text.text:
“经历了这么久的时代，我会说我们早已超越了友情。就像我们成了一家人——只不过我们是真的彼此喜欢。”
“After all this time, I’d say we’ve grown beyond friendship. It’s as if we’ve become a family—except we actually like each other.”

Githyanki's Silver Greatsword.name:
吉斯洋基的银色巨剑
Githyanki's Silver Greatsword

Text.text:
这是一件武器工艺的巅峰之作：显然，这把银色巨剑的铸造手法既非锻造所能匹敌，也非巫术可以仿效。事实上，你根本无法想象这样的武器究竟如何诞生。可它就这么在此——锋刃之美，胜过你所见过的任何一柄。

~ 由一位英雄构想

A masterwork of weaponry, it is obvious that this silver greatsword was created with a method that can be matched with neither smithing nor sorcery. As a matter of fact, you have no idea how such a weapon could be created. Yet, here it is, as fine a blade as any you have ever seen.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这名高个子不疾不徐地沿路向你走来，身上穿着一件破旧的衣袍，像是僧衣与法师长袍的混合体。他的五官被一顶圆锥形斗笠遮住，帽檐压得很低，以抵御天气。腰间紧紧束着一条腰带，一柄木柄长剑连同木鞘高高贴在腰侧。剑柄与剑鞘仿佛由同一块抛光木料一体雕出，贴合得严丝合缝，几乎看不出两者之间的缝隙。鞘身虽有些磨损痕迹，却显然刚被一丝不苟地擦拭抛光过。待他走近，你还能看见他前臂与手腕上纵横交错的深疤，以及一道十字形伤痕划破了他左脸的皮肤。你还未来得及示意，他便微微点头，向你行了个几不可察的鞠躬。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Dressed in a battered garment resembling a cross between a monk’s garb and a wizard’s robe, the features of the tall individual walking sedately down the road toward you are obscured by a conical straw hat, pulled low against the weather. Tucked into a sash set firmly around his hips, a sword with a wooden grip set in a wooden scabbard rides high against the side of his waist. The grip and scabbard seem to have been carved from a single piece of polished wood, and fit so snugly that you can scarcely spot the gap between the two. Though the sheath has some signs of wear, it has been meticulously polished and cleaned recently. As the man draws closer, you can also make out deep scars along his forearms and wrists, and a single cross-shaped scar marring the left side of his face. Before you can acknowledge him, he bobs his head to you in the slightest of bows.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

你完成法术，随即以意念探出，如同赤手捏碎一只老鼠的性命般，狠狠碾压敌人的思绪。你的凶狠换来对手目瞪口呆的神情，可你也感到一股精神上的抗力，仿佛那啮齿动物的胸腔肋骨。你凝神专注，继续收紧。
You complete the spell and reach out with your mind to squash the thoughts of your enemy as if crushing the life out of a mouse with your bare hand. Your viciousness is rewarded by your foe’s stunned expression, but you can feel a mental resistance like the rodent’s ribcage. You focus your concentration and squeeze.

I Reach Into My Bag Of Holding.name:
我把手探进次元袋中
I Reach Into My Bag Of Holding

Text.text:
我解开袋口的搭扣，把袋盖一掀。将手探入其中，仿佛浸进一汪清凉的水里，那触感顺着手臂一路爬上来，在后颈激起一阵细微的战栗。指尖擦过各式物件的轮廓，它们缓慢地在里面碰撞漂浮，像是沉在一种介于浓汤与果冻之间的黏稠液体里。
I unclasp the flap of the bag and flip it open. Digging my hand into its contents is like dipping into cool water, and the sensation sends a tingle up my arm to the back of my neck. My fingertips graze the outlines of various objects, which bounce around slowly as if submerged in a liquid between a stew and a jelly.

I Use Feral Instinct On My Initiative Ro.name:
我在先攻掷骰时启用野性直觉
I Use Feral Instinct On My Initiative Roll

Text.text:
我嗅到暴力逼近的气息。条件反射驱使我不及思索便出手。
I sense looming violence. My reflexes compel me to act without thinking.

这件乐器上仍能看见雕刻者留下的几道刀痕，不过表面已被细细打磨过，以免孩子被木刺扎到。它短小，由一整块被弃置的郁金香木削成；长笛只开了三个指孔，方方正正的吹口末端掏出一只小碗般的凹槽。它处处都在暗示：这东西是某位疼爱孙儿的祖辈坐在门廊上，用小刀一点点刻出来的。
Some of the carver’s strokes are still visible in this instrument, though it is well sanded to keep the child from splinters. Short, made from a single piece of cast-off tulipwood, the flute has just three finger holes and a boxy mouthpiece carved to a bowl at the end. It gives every indication of having been knife-crafted on a porch by a doting grandparent.

I Become Petrified.name:
我化作石像
I Become Petrified

Text.text:
我的肌肉变得沉重，每一处关节都在僵硬，仿佛我已沉睡、动弹不得，整整数日。我低头看去，眼睁睁看着我的身体——无论血肉还是衣物——一并化作冰冷、毫无知觉的青灰石板。我发出一声嘶哑的嚎叫，喉咙收紧，连更多的话都说不出来，舌尖只剩盐与铁的腥味。
My muscles become heavy, every joint stiffening as if I have been asleep, immobile, for days. I look down and watch as my body—flesh and clothes both—turn to cold, unfeeling slate. I let out a rasping cry, unable to say more as my throat closes and I taste only salt and metal on my tongue.

火焰成群掠过丛林地面，攫住蕨丛，刺穿伞状巨叶，喷吐出滚滚黑烟。灼人的热浪将空气里的湿意生生抽干，本不该燃起的、饱含水分的青翠也被火焰的獠牙咬住吞噬——而烈狱仍然汹涌推进，把曾经葱茏的景象碾成一片低平、荒瘠的焦土，遍布灼白发亮的伤痕，那里火舌仍伏着，贪婪啃食。
Fire swarms over the jungle floor, snatching at ferns, lancing through umbrella leaves, and belching black smoke. Searing heat leeches the humidity out of the air, and moisture-laden greenery that should not ignite is instead seized in fiery jaws and devoured—and still the inferno surges forth, leaving the once-lush landscape flat, barren, and pitted with candescent scars where flames still sit feasting.

你听见一声尖利的哀号，诉说着难以承受的绝望；当你伫立在这座阴沉如堡垒般建筑的入口门廊阴影里，那哀号忽而变调，仿佛凝成了某个词——也许是个名字？可随即，更多尖叫从狭小带栅的窗洞里迸出，像诡异的合唱般汇入其间，将那含义彻底淹没。你几乎难以相信，有人会配得上在此处等候他们的任何命运。
You hear a keening wail that speaks of unbearable despair; as you stand in the shadow of the entry gate of this bleak fortress-like building, it modulates, forming some kind of word—perhaps a name? But then other screams escape the small barred windows, joining in like an eerie choir and obscuring its meaning. It’s hard to believe anyone deserves whatever fate awaits them in this place.

Iron Buckle For A Narrow Belt.name:
窄腰带用铁扣
Iron Buckle For A Narrow Belt

Text.text:
若你见过其中一条，便几乎算见识了此界所有买得起腰带之人的全貌。它也常见于沉重的箱柜或金属宝箱上——不用锁具，而以束带紧紧捆扎封闭。
If you’ve seen one of these, then you’ve seen nearly the entire population of the realm that can afford belts. It also appears commonly on heavy boxes or metal chests held shut with straps rather than locks.

Cave Passage Up And Out.name:
洞穴通道：向上并通往外界
Cave Passage Up And Out

Text.text:
这里的地面陡峭且遍布碎石，在昏暗的通道里，每一步都险象环生。你攀爬时将手掌抵在冰凉的石壁上寻求支援，直到注意到一抹柔和的光，昭示着坡道的尽头。当你触及那里时，你因光芒刺入眼帘而眯起眼，只剩一段短短的石质走廊被它灌满，指引着通往外界的路。
The ground here is steep and strewn with rocks, making each step treacherous in the dim passage. You brace your palm against the cool walls for support as you ascend until you notice a soft light that signals the peak of the slope. As you reach it, you squint from the light that floods through the remaining short corridor of stone, leading the way out.

Tree Atop A Mountain.name:
山巅之树
Tree Atop A Mountain

Text.text:
一条羊肠小径从山脚的坡麓贴着山体起始。攀登之路看起来粗砺、险峻，蜿蜒曲折、不断折返，直到几乎隐没在碎石坡里。雪的斑块与细长的雪纹，夹杂在坚韧的欧石南与景天之间，直铺向山巅。峰顶立着一棵枝叶繁茂的树，宽大而修长的枝条舒展开来，绿得不合时宜。树周围漂浮着细小的发光微粒，吐出一种诡异的光。每一步都在诉说，这段攀登是一场考验，而抵达那棵树，便是它的成果。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

A goat path begins on a foothill against the mountain. The climb looks rough, perilous, winding and switching until it nearly disappears into a talus slope. Pockets and veins of snow mix with tough heather and stonecrop, up to the peak. There stands a leafy tree with broad, long branches, greener than it should be. Around it float tiny glowing specks emitting a strange light. Every step indicates that the climb is a test and that arrival at the tree is its result.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Poison Darts Trap.name:
毒镖陷阱
Poison Darts Trap

Text.text:
[察觉]  那些细小的孔洞让你不由得停下脚步。它们或许无害——也许只是虫子啃出来的？但也可能是陷阱。最像是某种投射机关，不过也不排除会喷出毒气。

[发现]  你四下寻找实体触发装置。就在这时，你看见了十有八九是压板的东西。那一块地面并不完全平整，一侧微微翘起，另一侧却下陷得过低。

[触发！]  你的脚一落地，地面便下沉了一寸，墙里传来几声空洞的fip!，羽翎般的飞矢朝你疾射而来。

[Perceived]  The tiny holes give you pause. They could be innocent. Perhaps an insect made them? Or, it might be a trap. Some kind of projectile seems most likely, but perhaps they unleash poisonous gas.

[Discovered]  You look about for a physical trigger. That’s when you see what must be the pressure plate. The floor there isn’t quite level, leaving one side high and the other dipped too low.

[Triggered!]  Your foot hits the ground, sinking an inch, and several hollow fip! noises come from the wall as feathery missiles fly toward you.

The Sanctuary: Tunnel.name:
圣所：隧道
The Sanctuary: Tunnel

Text.text:
通往地下的小隧道几乎被高草完全掩住。它的入口近乎完美的圆形，洞壁四周还留着道道刮痕，可见这条竖井是被刻意开凿出来的。里面的空气带着暖意，隐约飘着真菌的气味，还夹着潺潺流水声。你踏入其中，脚爪下的地面很快从坚实变得柔软、更加沙质，隧道随之豁然开阔，通向一间被黑暗笼罩的更大洞室。
The small tunnel into the earth is almost hidden by the long grass. Judging by its perfectly circular entrance, and various scratches around the walls, the shaft was carved intentionally. The air inside feels warm and carries the faint smell of fungi and the sound of running water. As you step inside, the ground quickly transitions to a softer, sandier soil beneath your paws and the tunnel opens into a larger chamber shrouded in darkness.

Colossal Open Pit Mine.name:
巨型露天矿坑
Colossal Open Pit Mine

Text.text:
起初，这里不过是一把鹤嘴镐或一柄铁锹凿出的口子；但随着岁月流转，更多珍贵矿脉被揭开，这座巨大的露天矿坑便一圈圈向外扩张，愈发深阔。如今矿场已是庞然大物：以木与岩石加固的斜坡道沿坑壁蜿蜒而下，通往矿坑侧壁的层层作业台；粗壮的木梁如同肋骨般支撑着矿坑的每一等级，将地表下为搜寻贵重矿石而凿出的条条小竖井暴露无遗。矿场全力运转时，鹤嘴镐与铁锹的回响交织成刺耳的喧嚣，对外行而言吵得几乎无法交谈。
It was once the work of a single pick or shovel, but over time this colossal open pit mine has widened further and further as more precious mineral veins were uncovered. Now the mine is an enormous affair, with ramps braced by wood and rock leading down to tiers along the mine's sides—buttresses of sturdy timber support each level of the mine, laying bare smaller shafts bored into the earth in search of valuable ore. At full swing, the echoing sounds of picks and shovels are so cacophonous to the uninitiated that conversation is all but impossible.

Heavy-duty Antimateriel Rifle.name:
重型反器材步枪
Heavy-duty Antimateriel Rifle

Text.text:
这把步枪几乎有类人生物般的体型，必须拆分为三段分别组装：枪管、机匣与枪托。枪管又长又宽，末端是一个矩形枪口，膛室可容纳高威力的反器材弹。整把武器覆以像素化的都市灰黑迷彩，为重度战斗而生。弹药机匣下方悬着一副两脚架，上方则装着某种瞄准镜——想必具备复杂的热成像功能。
This rifle is almost the size of a humanoid and must be assembled in three separate segments: barrel, housing, and stock. The barrel is long and broad, ending in a rectangular muzzle chambered for high-powered antimateriel rounds. Colored entirely in pixelated urban gray-black camouflage, this weapon is built for heavy combat. A bipod hangs from beneath the ammo housing and above is some sort of scope—presumably offering complex thermal imaging.

那棵无叶之树猛然颤栗，竟自行拔地而起，拖着粗壮的根须踉跄前行，末端分叉成一张由更细小蔓根织成的网。它的枝干吱呀作响，有些更像扭曲的臂膀。树干上裂开参差的空洞，拼凑出一张凶残而空虚的“脸”——那对颌骨般的裂隙，俨然是掠食者才配拥有的獠口。每一道孔隙都淌着血色树液。那些未用来拖拽这噩梦前进的根须在地面上狂乱抽打，四处探寻猎物。
The leafless tree shudders and uproots, lurching forward on thick roots that trail into a web of smaller tendrils. Its limbs creak, and some seem more like crooked arms. Jagged hollows open in the trunk, forming a vicious and empty parody of a face with jaws befitting that of a predator. Every orifice drips bloody sap. Roots not involved in hauling the horror forward lash about, searching for prey.

Wand Versus Staff Duel.name:
魔杖对法杖决斗
Wand Versus Staff Duel

Text.text:
一年级生眼神坚定，腰带枪套里插着一根巨大的螺旋生日蜡烛。二年级生含笑望向决斗圈外簇拥的观众。她旋转法杖，居高临下地瞥了男孩一眼。起始信号一响，男孩迅速拔出蜡烛——烛焰轰然点燃，随令发射。速度比女孩预想得更快；她勉强挡下部分法术，却还是丢了这一分。
The first-year—a determined look in his eyes—carries a giant corkscrew birthday candle in a holster on his belt. The second-year smiles and looks at the crowd of spectators around the dueling ring. She twirls her staff and looks condescendingly at the boy. On the start signal the boy draws, the candle ignites and fires on command. It is quicker than the girl expected; she partly blocks the spell but loses the point.

Fake Dust Of Sneezing And Choking.name:
喷嚏与窒息的假尘土
Fake Dust Of Sneezing And Choking

Text.text:
你扬手将一把闪烁的粉尘抛向空中，本以为周围的人会被呛得咳作一团、喷嚏连连，难以自控。可你自己先嗅到一缕飘散的粉末气息，只觉得鼻腔微微发痒、略有刺激——除此之外，那尘雾竟带着怡人的芬芳，恍若野花的清香。
You throw a handful of sparkling dust into the air, expecting a flurry of choked coughs and uncontrollable sneezing from those around you. You catch a whiff of the airborne powder, and find it vaguely irritating in your nose—but otherwise, the dust has a pleasant aroma, rather like wildflowers.

Alchemical Vial Of True Water.name:
真水炼金小瓶
Alchemical Vial Of True Water

Text.text:
一只矮短的小瓶里翻涌着海的歌声。瓶中，一道微缩的漩涡咆哮着将浪涛撞向玻璃，白色泡沫冲天飞溅。瓶底凝结出一片细小的珊瑚礁，水流在其间起伏游走，织出一个个小小的涡旋。
A short vial bubbles with the song of the sea. Within, a miniature maelstrom crashes waves against the glass, sending white froth flying upwards. At the base of the vial, a tiny coral reef has formed, throughout which currents undulate, making little whirlpools.

你伸出手，魔法探向敌人的心智。你轻轻扭动手指，感觉那道法术如皱褶般蜿蜒钻过层层精神防线。当它在敌人意识最深处的阴暗角落缠上某样黑暗之物时，你猛地攥紧拳头，将它朝自己狠狠一拽。待你摊开手掌，回报你的，是一声惊恐的尖叫。
Your magic reaches out to the mind of your foe as you stretch out your hand. You sense the spell wrinkling its way past mental defenses as you wiggle your fingers. When it coils around something dark in the deep recesses of your enemy’s consciousness, you clench your hand in a fist and pull it back toward you. As you open your hand, you’re rewarded by a terrified scream.

Threat From An Orc Guard.name:
来自兽人卫兵的威胁
Threat From An Orc Guard

Text.text:
“你们这些骨头血肉拼出来的小不点，跑这儿来干什么？我们不谈买卖，也不闲聊。这营地只为厮杀——要么你们来这儿送死，要么就给我滚远点。”
“Why’d you tiny sacks of bone and blood come here? We ain’t bargaining, and we ain’t conversing. This camp is for fighting, and you either come here to die or you stay away.”

Ancient Dwarfhold Abandoned To Dangers F.name:
古老的矮人堡垒废弃在地底涌出的凶险之下
Ancient Dwarfhold Abandoned To Dangers From Below

Text.text:
矮人要塞昔日大概回荡着铁砧的铿锵与钢刃的尖啸——但如今已然寂寥。光滑的石墙冰冷而压迫，阴影笼罩着穹顶式的居所与高耸的塔楼；它们像石笋般从地面拔起，跨越地板与天花板之间的空间。整座城空无一人，显然是仓皇撤离——瓦砾与弃置的物件堆成一片，被遗忘、被抛下。门扇在锈蚀的铰链上摇晃作响，而寒意自城心那座已沉默的熔炉中向外渗散。这些矮人究竟因何而逃？
The dwarfhold likely once sang with ringing anvils and keening steel—but no longer. The smooth stone walls stand cold and oppressive, shadowing domed dwellings and soaring towers spanning the space between floor and ceiling like stalagmites. The city lies empty, and clearly vacated in a hurry—piles of debris and cast-off items lie forgotten, abandoned. Doors swing on rusted hinges, and a chill radiates from the now-silent forge at the city’s heart. What caused these dwarves to flee?

High-class Intergalactic Criminal.name:
高级星际罪犯
High-class Intergalactic Criminal

Text.text:
瘫坐在赌场赌桌旁的黑帮分子，是个阴狠狡诈到极致的操盘手，思维如刀锋般锐利，心却冷得像虚空般死寂。他们的财富浩瀚无边，靠一张由阴谋诡计与黑暗勾当编织而成的罗网聚敛而来，总能比执法者快一步。而他们天才般的头脑，让追求正义的人看起来像孩子——任何靠得太近的……都会消失。
The mobster lounging at the casino table is a mastermind of vicious cunning, mind razor-sharp and heart as frigid as the void. Their fortune is vast, amassed via a web of nefarious schemes and dark deeds, always one step ahead of the enforcers. And their genius-level intellect makes those seeking justice seem like children—any that get too close… disappear.

Barbarian’s Justification.name:
野蛮人的辩白
Barbarian’s Justification

Text.text:
“你说我不该战斗，不该让全世界看看我有多强。这就是弱者一贯的说辞——以为他们的评断能把我磨成和他们一样。但其实，你们不过是在嫉妒而已，我从你们的眼神里看得一清二楚。”
“You say I shouldn’t fight. Shouldn’t show the world how strong I am. That’s what weak people always say. Think their judgments will make me like them. But really, you’re all just jealous, I can see it in your eyes.”

Entering Through A Damaged Airlock.name:
穿过受损的气闸舱门
Entering Through A Damaged Airlock

Text.text: 你把外侧舱门在身后猛地拉上——门才卡到一半就骤然咬死，你几乎是在它合拢前从那可怕的挤压中抽回手指，险险逃过被碾碎的命运。房间里充斥着断断续续的嘶嘶声；一块闪烁的屏幕偶尔跳出 Locking In，随即字样便在翻涌的颗粒状雪花里被吞没。你完全不知道这座受损的气闸还能有多可靠。 You pull the external doors shut behind you, after they jam halfway, barely rescuing your fingers from their crushing embrace before they catch. A staccato hissing fills the room as a flickering screen occasionally displays Locking In before the words disappear in a roiling wave of granular static. You have no idea how functional the damaged airlock is.

Nemezys D'aragon.name:
内梅兹斯·达拉贡
Nemezys D'aragon

Text.text:
这名女子空灵的美貌令人着迷。被日光吻过的石色般白皙肌肤与一头白发相映，其间掺杂着蓝、紫与灰的缕缕挑染，愈发衬出她那双摄人的碧绿眼眸。她举手投足尽是张扬的自信，然而一丝不安的阴影——从她闪烁躲避的偷瞥里泄露出来——如幽魂般笼罩在她头顶，仿佛在那惊艳外表之下，她正与一场无形的战争搏斗。

~ Played by Clement Brunet

The woman's ethereal beauty is bewitching. Fair skin the color of sun-kissed stone and white hair, shot through with streaks of blue, purple, and gray, accentuate her beguiling turquoise eyes. She carries herself with outrageous confidence, yet a shadow of insecurity—revealed in furtive glances—looms over her like a specter, as if she is fighting an invisible battle beneath her breathtaking façade.

~ Played by Clement Brunet

看见一个乐师穿着半身板甲，着实古怪；可他拨弄鲁特琴、调弦的从容，却像是已弹奏了许多个年头。那件黑色长外套沿着他高大宽阔的身形垂落，宛如幽影的裹衣。然而当他抬头迎向光亮时，面容并不骇人，也不狰狞；相反，他神情肃穆。温暖的褐色眼睛因鱼尾纹而微微起伏，眼底压着某种难以言明的悲意——那是一种由智慧孕育出的谦卑。

~ 由 Walt M. 扮演 Played，并附

It is strange to see a musical fellow dressed in half plate, but he tunes his lute with an ease befitting someone who’s played for years. His long black coat trails down his tall, broad frame like the garment of a specter. Though, as he looks up into the light, his face is not frightening or ghoulish; rather, his expression is a somber one. His warm brown eyes, wrinkled with crow’s feet, are weighed down with what seems to be some kind sorrow—a humility born of wisdom.

~ Played by Walt M. with

Sailors Tricked By Sea Hag.name:
被海鬼婆愚弄的水手们
Sailors Tricked By Sea Hag

Text.text:
华美的幻象如潮汐般的海市蜃楼般闪烁着褪去；你恢复了感官，从法术中挣脱出来。方才耳畔的美妙乐声已被刺耳的咯咯怪笑取代，那位勾魂摄魄的美人鱼也不复存在。取而代之的，是一名枯槁的鬼婆（特征），松垮的皮肉呈现出朽木腐烂的霉绿。几缕油腻的白发在海风里飘动，她迎上你的目光，咧开令人发狂的笑容。恐惧猛然窜上脊背——你这才意识到，你的船正直直驶向嶙峋尖利、足以撕裂船壳的礁岩。

~ Clara C. Potter 于 Discord

The beautiful illusion shimmers and fades away like a tidal mirage as you come to your senses and break free of the spell. The beautiful music you heard moments ago has been replaced by a grating cackle, and the enchanting mermaid is no more. In her place stands a wizened hag, her sagging flesh the moldy green of rotted wood. Thin strands of greasy white hair flutter in the breeze as she meets your gaze and offers a maddening grin. With a thrill of horror, you realize that your ship is heading straight for jagged, hull-breaking rocks.

~ Clara C. Potter on Discord

它懒洋洋地盘在河湾的回流里，半透明的鳗身一下一下地律动着，吐出低沉而稳定的嗡鸣。它约有成年女子前臂那么长，长着开心果般大小的眼珠，齿列如樵夫的锯刃般森然，这生物乍看倒也无害。可当你凑近细看，便会发现它尾端有个微微鼓起的球状突起正有节奏地跳动，蓄着足以电晕一头公非洲象的伏打能量。
Pulsing as it lazes in the river's eddy, the diaphanous eel emits a low, steady hum. About the length of a grown woman's forearm, with pistachio-sized eyes and teeth like a woodsman's saw, the creature seems harmless enough. However, upon closer inspection, you note a slight bulbous protrusion at the end of its tail pulses with enough voltaic energy to stun a bull elephant.

Sir Gillian Harengrad, The Wolf Knight O.name:
吉利安·哈伦格拉德爵士，“明影”的狼骑士
Sir Gillian Harengrad, The Wolf Knight Of Brightshadow

Text.text:
那名灰发蓄须、正与另外两名士兵交谈的男人戴着一只眼罩，却只能遮住从额头横贯到鼻梁的粗粝疤痕的一小段。士兵们对他俯首听命，敬意里夹着一丝畏惧。他的秘银半身板甲外罩着黑色斗篷，斗篷被向后拨开，露出一枚巨狼头形的肩甲护片。他长剑的剑首上锻入了一个奥术符号。别的士兵行走时金属叮当、皮革吱呀作响，而这位狼骑士却悄无声息，仿佛连影子都不愿惊动空气。

~ Played by Xanthan Valcos with

The gray-haired, bearded man conversing with two other soldiers wears an eye patch that only covers a portion of the rough scar running over his forehead and the bridge of his nose. The soldiers defer to him with a respect tinged with fear. The black cloak over his mithral half-plate is pulled back from a large wolf’s head pauldron. An arcane symbol is smithed into the pommel of his longsword. Where metal clinks and leather creaks when other soldiers walk, the wolf knight makes no noise at all.

~ Played by Xanthan Valcos with

Wild Magic Surge: A Wild Construct Appea.name:
狂野魔法涌动：一具狂野构装体现身
Wild Magic Surge: A Wild Construct Appears

Text.text:
一道跨位面的裂隙短暂开启，一道不太可能的身影自其中飘出——金属质地，棱角分明。它的机械构造令人难以名状，却转身困惑地打量着你，仿佛不该出现在这里的人是你。
An interplanar rend opens briefly, and out drifts an unlikely figure, metallic and angular. Its mechanical anatomy defies explanation, but it turns to regard you quizzically, as if you are the one that doesn’t belong here.

将军的寝室一如其人：简朴、清苦、一尘不染。主卧里，一张四柱床占据主位，洁白的床单被褥平整得近乎刺眼；壁炉里余火闷燃，一把舒适却挺直靠背的椅子紧挨其旁。晚餐端在托盘上，分毫未动。房间中央是一张巨大的桌子，地图铺陈其上，微缩军队列队成阵。壁炉上方，两柄长剑交叉悬挂：一柄剑柄嵌着黄玉，另一柄则镶着红宝石。
The general's chambers are simple, spartan, and spotless, much like the general themself. A four-poster bed with pristine white linens dominates the main bedroom, and a comfortable but straight-backed chair sits beside a fire smoldering in the hearth. Dinner sits uneaten on a tray. Maps lie atop a massive table at the center of the room, and miniature armies stand in formation. Over the hearth, a pair of swords hang, crossed over one another. In one hilt, a topaz, in the other, a ruby.

一缕缕筋膜与肌腱被以违逆天理的意志捆束成形，拼凑出这把武器；你只消看上一眼，胆汁便涌上喉头。长弓的每一处都透着活物般的质感，仿佛由一个疯狂——却毋庸置疑技艺精湛——的匠人，以雕琢的血肉与白骨精心打造而成。
Threads of gristle and sinew have been bound together in unnatural purpose to form this weapon, and bile creeps up your throat as you behold it. Every part of the longbow seems organic, crafted from sculpted flesh and bone by a deranged—yet undoubtedly skilled—artisan.

Seduction Line About Learning Magic.name:
关于学习魔法的诱惑台词
Seduction Line About Learning Magic

Text.text:
“当我望进你的眼睛，就像被什么法术摄住了心神。虽然我也涉猎奥术，却从未见过如此罕见的魅惑。或许我们可以在晚餐时一同研究它？”
“When I look into your eyes, it’s like I’ve been put under some spell. While I dabble in the arcane, I’ve never encountered such a rare enchantment. Perhaps we could study it together over dinner?”

守卫在岗亭旁懒散地倚着，半阖的眼睛漫不经心地扫过四周。他那灰白而饱经风霜的面孔——以及穿着护甲时显而易见的从容——让你怀疑这是一名老兵，在做一份对他而言近乎退休消遣的差事。他啐了一口，耸了耸肩，合上眼睛，但你注意到他的手始终搭在剑柄的柄头上。
The guard leans casually at his post, eyes gazing half-lidded at his surroundings. His gray and grizzled face—and evident comfort in armor—make you suspect this is an old veteran doing work that, for him, is a kind of retirement. He spits, rolls his shoulders, and closes his eyes, but you note his hand rests upon the pommel of his sword.

White Robe Of The Archmagi.name:
大法师的白袍
White Robe Of The Archmagi

Text.text:
层层雪花石膏色的织布叠落成衣，边缘以金线勾勒，织就一袭令人屏息的施法者长袍。它优雅而耀目，仿佛是从古老圣殿的神像上直接取下的衣饰——又像是天界诸灵亲手赐予的圣裳。
Layers of alabaster cloth with edges lined in golden thread make for a stunning spellcaster’s robe. With its elegance, its radiance, it seems like a garment pulled directly from a statue of an ancient, holy temple—or a raiment gifted directly from the celestials themselves.

Greeting From A Rat.name:
来自老鼠的问候
Greeting From A Rat

Text.text:
“吃的？你有吗？求你给点。孩子很多。没吃的就会互相啃咬。”
“Food? You have? Please give. Many children. Eat each other if no food.”

它看起来就像装另一支哨子的盒子，方方正正，凿痕斑驳；方形吹口，宽阔的斜削气道。声音空灵却明亮，几乎只是一记音高，像人的口哨，却带着孕育它的那棵树的木质回响。孩童的玩具，商贩的吆喝，警示或求救的信号，开工的号令，交响里一瞬俏皮的点缀——或许这是最百搭的乐器。
Appearing much like a box for another whistle, it is blocky and chisel marked, with a squared mouthpiece and a broad, beveled fipple. The sound is hollow but bright, one note almost like a human whistle, but with the woody tone of the tree that gave it birth. A child’s toy, a merchant’s call, a warning or call for help, an order to begin work, a playful moment in a symphony—this may be the most versatile of instruments.

一棵巨树的根系将一具骷髅（特征）从泥土中抬起，缠绕盘结，把它紧紧裹住。缺失的骨骼被木制的仿件替代，躯体在层层包覆中逐渐成形。虫群、落叶、细蔓与蘑菇被滚卷、拧绞——塑形、勒紧——先结成犄角，再铺成长袍，最后凝作一根法杖。巫妖苏醒，身躯如枯藤般弯折迸裂，直到一抹惨淡的浅绿毒辉在它的眼眶里点亮。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Roots of a massive tree lift a skeleton from the dirt, wrapping and coiling around it. Missing bones are replaced with wooden replicas as the body forms. Bugs, leaves, tendrils, and mushrooms are rolled and twisted—shaped and tightened—into horns, then robes, then a staff. The lich comes to life, bending and cracking like a brittle vine until the poisonous glow of a pale green light shines in its eyes.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Crime Boss's Quarters.name:
犯罪头目的私宅
Crime Boss's Quarters

Text.text:
绫罗与华饰覆满每一寸表面，披搭在椅背上，横铺过桌面。墙上挂满画作，每一幅都由独立的壁灯照亮；远处角落里，一座巨大的湿吧台占据视野——上面堆着玻璃酒瓶、陶罐与水晶醒酒器。西墙边是一张四柱床，同样缀满丝绸；与之相对的是一处下沉式谈话坑，四周铺陈坐垫、靠枕与披毯。空气里浓香沉重，混着花瓣、香油与烟草的味道。
Silks and fineries adorn every surface, draped over chairs and across tables. Paintings, each lit with its own sconce, line the walls, and a massive wet bar dominates the far corner—laden with glass bottles, clay jugs, and crystal decanters. A four-post bed, also adorned with silks, sits against the western wall, and opposite, a sunken conversation pit lined with cushions, pillows, and throws. The air is heavily perfumed with flower petals, oils, and tobacco.

尽管空气中蒸汽弥漫，这间浴场却出奇地清凉宜人，仿佛在轻声招呼你走近。闪着金光的巨缸与晶莹剔透的玻璃浴桶一字排开，立在穹顶之下；天花板上绘着纠缠交叠的赤裸身影，在池水间翻涌沉浮。也许是袅袅蒸汽的把戏，或是那股浓烈如醇酒般的香气在作祟，你恍惚间竟看见画中人抬手，朝你头顶上方天花板的某处轻轻招了招。
Despite the steam in the air, the bathhouse feels refreshingly cool and inviting. Vats of gleaming gold and crystalline glass stand under a ceiling painted with scenes of entwined naked bodies in pools. It might be some trick of the wafting vapor or its heady, wine-like scent, but it looked for a moment like the painted figures waved to the spot in the ceiling above your head.

Persuasion About Stealing.name:
关于盗窃的说服
Persuasion About Stealing

Text.text:
“我们注定要永远做旅人吗？又冷又脏，辗转各地，没完没了地替别人收拾烂摊子？我们就不配得到一次道德上的喘息吗？我们做过的所有善举，难道就换不来一点点自私的权利？我知道我们总在惦记什么才是正确的，但也许这一次，我们可以想想什么才对我们自己正确？”
“Are we destined to remain travelers? Cold and dirty, moving from place to place, fixing other people’s problems forever? Have we not earned a single moral reprieve? Have all of our good deeds not entitled us to a morsel of selfishness? I know we are always concerned with what’s right, but perhaps this time we could think of what’s right for us?”

你吐出一句饱含奥术恶意的咒唤。阴影般的浓烟在你目标的感官器官周围翻涌沸腾，渗入脆弱的血肉、骨骼与神经，扼住他们一项至关重要的感官。
You spit an invocation with arcane malice. Shadowy smoke boils around your target’s sensory organs, penetrating delicate flesh, bone, and nerves to stifle one of their vital senses.

Hell: Devil Legion.name:
地狱：魔鬼军团
Hell: Devil Legion

Text.text:
地狱的军团在你面前列阵，你无法想象还有更污秽的敌人。它们开口说话时，蛆虫便从嘴里涌出，仿佛它们的言语就是邪恶的化身。每一步踏下都震得大地颤抖；那些没被裂蹄溅烂的幼虫当即蜕变，鼓胀的肥躯化作苍蝇腾起，盘旋成一团瘟疫般的虫云，将恶魔的身影吞没在翻涌之中。
The legions of Hell stand arrayed against you, and you cannot imagine fouler foes. Maggots spill from their mouths as they speak, as if their words are evil incarnate. With each ground-quaking step, the larvae not splattered by cloven hooves transform and rise as fat-bodied flies, clouding the devils in a swirling plague.

Slippery Steep Steps.name:
湿滑陡峭的台阶
Slippery Steep Steps

Text.text:
楔入土中的木板与木桩映入眼帘，令人心头一松。若没有这段临时搭起的阶梯，你肯定会沿着河岸滑下去——甚至一头滚到河面的冰上。可当你试探着踏上第一步，对能否安稳通过的把握便迅速消退：木头表面覆着一层几乎看不见的薄冰，滑得发亮，若不把脚侧着踩在每一级上，几乎找不到可靠的着力点。
The boards and posts wedged into the earth present a welcome sight. Without these makeshift stairs, you’d surely slide down the bank—and might even tumble out onto the river’s ice. Yet as you test the first step, your confidence in safe passage diminishes. A barely visible sheen of ice slicks the wood, leaving little space for secure purchase unless you put your foot sideways on each step.

My Shield +3 Deflects A Claw.name:
我的盾牌 +3 偏斜了一记利爪
My Shield +3 Deflects A Claw

Text.text:
那狰狞的利爪在我附魔盾牌的精密金属纹饰上疯狂抓挠，却连一道痕迹也留不下。生物凄厉嚎叫，古老壁垒中流溢而出的护体魔法灼烧着它的血肉，连它爪尖的角质也被烧得迸裂粉碎。
The monstrous claws leave no mark as they scrabble at the intricate metalwork of my enchanted shield. The creature howls as the protective magic emanating from the ancient bulwark burns its flesh and splinters the keratin of its claws.

I Ask My Luck Blade For Luck.name:
我向幸运之刃祈求好运
I Ask My Luck Blade For Luck

Text.text:
时代仿佛在出击的半途慢了下来。我看得出对手已经挪动——恰好挪到让我这一击只会斩中空气——于是我几乎只放出一丝念头，一个短促的声响，一瞬间的“求你了”，我懊恼地对着刀刃低声呢喃。它便微微一偏，自行校正回轨，朝着触碰的方向重新逼近。
Time seems to slow, mid-strike. I can tell my opponent has moved—just enough for me to strike nothing but air—so I send out little more than a thought, a quick sound, a split second “Please” that I whisper in frustration to my blade. And it tilts a bit, putting itself back on course toward contact.

Demonic Face In Obelisk.name:
方尖碑中的恶魔面孔
Demonic Face In Obelisk

Text.text:
一张残忍而狞笑的面孔——五官如那可怖的獠牙般锋利——自方尖碑乌黑如镜的表面探出头来，爬行类的眼眸精于算计、饥渴贪婪。一根扭结的、爪尖般的手指有节奏地叩击着表面，仿佛在敲一位故友的门。
A cruel, leering countenance—features as sharp as its terrible fangs—peers out from the glassy black surface of the obelisk, reptilian eyes calculating and ravenous. A gnarled, claw-tipped finger taps rhythmically against the surface as if knocking at the door of an old friend.

皮革掩蔽与装订柔韧顺滑，崭新如初，刚刚鞣制并染色。前掩蔽内侧的制作者印记仍因烙烧而漆黑，当你把书页扇开，它们便以一阵沙沙低语翻飞，仿佛无数可能在耳畔掠过。每一张洁白的纸页都是一份请求：渴望被防护系法术填满以生出结界，或以火焰般的花体书写成咒，或绘下愈合伤口的图景，甚至——一缕灵魂。
The leather cover and binding are supple, new, and freshly tanned and dyed. The maker’s mark inside the front cover is still black with its burning, and when the pages are fanned, they flutter in a whisper of possibilities. Each white page is a request. It asks to be filled with abjuration and produce a ward, or scripted in the cursive hand of fire, or drawn with the pictures of a healed wound, or even a soul.

Circle Of Standing Stones.name:
立石之环
Circle Of Standing Stones

Text.text:
仅仅望见它们，思绪便足以被牵引回文明的肇始。凭借强壮脊背的劳作与粗陋机械的力量，一块块巨石被垂直自地面竖起；每一块石头都自有性格。它们仿佛有生命的存在，携着重力与质量，彼此对视，又一并凝望中央，静候有人踏入——进入这座以宇宙为罗盘的构造。
Just the sight of them is enough to hearken back one’s thoughts to civilization’s beginning. Raised perpendicular to the ground by the labor of strong backs and basic machines, each stone has a personality. They seem animate beings, with gravity and mass, every stone staring across to the others and into the center, waiting for someone to step in—to enter this architecture of cosmic orientation.

I Drink My Potion Of Lightning Resistanc.name:
我喝下我的闪电抗力药剂
I Drink My Potion Of Lightning Resistance

Text.text:
我吞下药剂，霎时只觉身躯仿佛浸在冰冷的泥土里。随即一阵呛咳，魔性的粉尘自我口中涌出，像孢子、像花粉，仿佛植物一瞬喷洒。虽有这些轻微的不适，我却明白——哪怕是流弹般的电光，或凭空召来的火星，也再难对我构成先前那般的威胁。
I swallow the potion and suddenly my body feels like it’s been steeped in cold earth. I cough and a magical dust flows from my mouth, like spores or pollen spraying from a plant. These minor discomforts aside, I know a stray bolt or conjured spark won't pose as much of a threat to me anymore.

I Use Astral Perception To Detect Magic.name:
我运用星界察觉来侦测魔法效应
I Use Astral Perception To Detect Magic Effects

Text.text:
我的额心炽白灼亮。一层帷幕被从世界上生生撕开，帷幕后那些身影在我眼中凝聚成清晰细密的数据读数，仿佛正直视一枚灵魂。他们的魔法无所遁形；我正一层层剥开伪装。此刻，我已知晓他们灵性潜能的本质。最尖端的生体改造与义体——往往对大多数灵视察觉隐匿不显——如今也向我揭开数据，如花向阳般缓缓绽放。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The center of my forehead glows white hot. A veil is ripped from the world, and the figures within coalesce into detailed data readouts. It is like peering into a soul. Their magic is revealed; I am peeling back the layers. Now I know the nature of their spiritual potential. Cutting-edge bioware and cybernetics—usually cloaked to most astral perception—now unveil their data to me, like a flower opening to the sun.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

I Attack A Practice Dummy In Melee.name:
我用近战攻击一个练习假人
I Attack A Practice Dummy In Melee

Text.text:
我冲向练习假人。我的武器咬入伤痕累累的木头——若是真敌，这一击足以致命。我的身法堪称典范，出手干净利落，可我明白，真正的对手不会傻站着让我如此轻易命中。这假人只为操练而设，用来磨炼我的力量与耐力——也锻出刻进肌肉的记忆。
I rush at the practice dummy. My weapon bites through the scarred wood in what would be a death stroke to a real enemy. My form is exemplary, my strikes clean, but I know that no real foe would stand still and let me hit them so easily. This dummy is strictly for drills, improving my strength and stamina—and my muscle memory.

I Use Intimidating Presence.name:
我施展【威吓气场】
I Use Intimidating Presence

Text.text:
我摆出威胁的架势，深深吸气。呼出之际，我阴沉怒视。我龇起牙关，吐息与凶光交织成无言的屠戮预告。敌人能嗅到违逆我的代价。
Taking a threatening stance, I inhale. I glower as I breathe out. I bare my teeth, the exhalation and glare an unspoken promise of impending carnage. My foe can sense the cost of defying me.

Loot From A Young Green Dragon.name:
幼年绿龙的战利品
Loot From A Young Green Dragon

Text.text:
长满苔藓的洞窟里，有一小片裸露的泥地陈列着数件珍宝——还有成堆的钱币。巨龙像农夫播种田垄一般，将自己的财物规整地埋进一条条精心刨出的沟槽里；每一道沟里都满溢着钱币、宝石与奇珍异物。最近的一格中，一柄锻造精巧的匕首如同被“种”在一堆金币与莹润的翠绿宝石之间，整堆财物上覆着松散潮湿的泥土。下一行里，一颗泛黄的人类头骨被丢在那儿任其腐烂，眼眶中却绽放着粉色玫瑰；它同样压在另一堆钱币与宝石之上。这景象与其说是花园，不如说是你从未见过的“宝藏花圃”，看起来价值 5000 金币。
A small patch of earth in the moss-covered cavern displays several treasures—and a great many coins. Like a farmer sowing their fields, the dragon has placed their valuables in neatly excavated furrows, each brimming with coins, gemstones, and curiosities. In the nearest section, an intricately forged dagger has been planted amid a mound of gold coins and lustrous green gemstones. The entire pile is covered in loose, damp soil. In the next row, a yellowed human skull has been left to rot with pink roses blooming within its eyes. It rests atop another mound of coins and gemstones. This is unlike any garden you have ever seen and looks to be worth 5000 gold pieces.

Ancient Amethyst Dragon.name:
远古紫水晶巨龙
Ancient Amethyst Dragon

Text.text:
这条巨龙如宝石般熠熠生辉，浑身覆着棱角分明、切面如琢的鳞片，浓郁的紫罗兰色向体侧渐褪成淡紫；腹部、颈项与尾下则染上石英般的珠光晕泽。翼指之间的膜闪烁如晶片铺展，仿佛一整张水晶薄幕。暗紫的利齿排列在它苍白的巨口边缘，脊背与长尾上更有同形同色、却大得多的棘刺作饰——然而这些晶棘并不贴附躯体，而是悬浮在巨龙周身，仿佛被某种无形之力牵系。
Glittering like precious stone, this dragon has angular, faceted scales of rich violet hues that fade to lavender on the sides and add the pearly tint of quartz on the belly, neck, and undersides of the tail. Membranes between the wing fingers sparkle as if they’re sheets of crystal. Dark violet teeth line the dragon’s pale maw, and spikes of a similar shape and hue—but of much greater size—adorn the spine and tail. But each crystal floats above the dragon, attached by some unseen force.

Approach To Dark Altar.name:
通往黑暗祭坛之路
Approach To Dark Altar

Text.text:
潜伏在高原边缘，一座阴险的祭坛蜷伏其间，龟裂的表面覆着一层幽暗冰釉。恶意浸透空气，每一道阴影都在扭动，仿佛藏着看不见的恐怖。邪念迟迟不散，凝冻的血与碎肉玷污了周遭岩石。阴森而秘奥，这段旅程已化作一次隐喻的攀登，直入黑暗——在那里，堕落称王。

~ 构想：dr.dungeon

Lurking at the edge of the plateau squats an insidious altar, its cracked surface glazed with dark ice. Malignancy saturates the air and every shadow writhes with unseen horror. A sense of malevolence lingers, while frozen blood and gore taint the surrounding rock. Sinister and esoteric, this journey has become a metaphorical climb into darkness—where depravity holds sway.

~ Envisioned by dr.dungeon

I Drink My Potion Of Acid Resistance.name:
我喝下我的酸蚀抗力药水
I Drink My Potion Of Acid Resistance

Text.text:
我喝下药剂，霎时间，周遭弥漫起金属的气息，浓烈得足以让我脊背一阵发寒。油腻的物质从我的毛孔里渗出，随即化作一层泛绿的薄膜，覆上我的皮肤、衣物与护甲。
I drink the potion and suddenly smell the scent of metal around me, strong enough to send a shiver down my spine. An oily substance seeps out of my pores and turns into a greenish coat that covers my skin, clothes, and armor.

在你的想象力引导与娴熟的法术技艺驱使下，周遭众人的形体骤然泛起微光，继而流转变幻，化作截然不同的模样。即便是对这些法术受术者再熟悉不过的人，也绝不可能仅凭外表认出他们。
Directed by your imagination and your skilled spellcraft, the forms of those surrounding you suddenly shimmer, then shift into drastically different shapes. Even those well familiar with your spell’s recipients would never know them from sight alone.

Wild Magic Surge: See Invisibility.name:
狂野魔法涌动：看见隐形
Wild Magic Surge: See Invisibility

Text.text:
你的视野顷刻间被闪烁的……阴影？所淹没。近处的光线在你周身折射流转，映出层层油纹般的诡影，足以出卖任何试图以魔法躲过你敏锐感官的人。
Your vision is inundated briefly with glimmering… shadows? As nearby light refracts around you, it reveals schlieric images that would betray anyone trying to magically hide from your sharpened senses.

Police Roust Contraband Dealers.name:
警察突袭走私贩子
Police Roust Contraband Dealers

Text.text:
一小撮披着兜帽的人挤在街角，鬼鬼祟祟的交易里唯一陌生的性相，便是它的肆无忌惮。大概只是运气太差，偏偏有一对全副武装的巡逻军官正沿着那条大道走来。他们挤进人群，推搡着那些混混；对方手忙脚乱地想把违禁品藏起来。
A small group of hooded individuals crowd together at the corner, the only unfamiliar aspect of the shifty dealings being its brazenness. Probably just bad luck that a pair of armored officers on patrol happened to be walking down that particular avenue. They jostle into the mix, shoving the thugs around as they scramble to hide their contraband.

Eyepatch Of Balance.name:
均衡眼罩
Eyepatch Of Balance

Text.text:
一对完美均衡的金色天平绣在这只眼罩奢华的黑色丝绸上——正是其附魔的暗示。细薄而精巧的系带上排列着一串细小而繁复的符号——每一个都绝对对称——它们被一位手法灵巧的奥术学者以炉火纯青的精准灼刻进深色皮革之中。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

A set of perfectly balanced golden scales are embroidered on the luxurious black silk of this eyepatch—a reference to its enchantment. Small, complex symbols—all perfectly symmetrical—line the thin, delicate strap, each one burned into the dark leather with masterful precision by a dexterous arcane scholar.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Sundries From A Rat Horde.name:
鼠群杂货
Sundries From A Rat Horde

Text.text:
大群大多散入幽暗的角落深处，但仍有几具小小的尸骸留在原地。它们的肉或许还能收拾来用……前提是你得确定自己不会染上这些生物体内肆虐的种种疫病。
Most of the horde scatters into dark recesses, but a few little carcasses remain. Their meat would be salvageable… if you were sure you were immune to whatever diseases likely ran amok in these creatures’ bodies.

Ripper Cannon.name:
开膛者加农炮
Ripper Cannon

Text.text:
两门火炮从一座庞大的基座上凶狠地探出，基座内部似乎容纳着激光技术。炮口末端的焦黑灼痕更印证了这一猜测。若要扛住这件武器射出的能量弹，非得是沉重的盾牌不可。
Two cannons jut aggressively from a massive base that looks to house laser technology. This speculation is corroborated by the dark burn marks at the end of the muzzles. It would take a heavy shield to stand up to the bolts fired from this weapon.

I Stop My Companion From Activating A Tr.name:
我阻止同伴触发陷阱
I Stop My Companion From Activating A Trap

Text.text:
我一把抓住同伴将其止住，他们一只脚还悬在半空中，正要迈出。我用力把他们拽回到我身边，随即从他们肩头探身望去。我朝那处陷阱的触发点微微一颔首——它被悄然藏匿，几乎不露痕迹。
I grab my companion to stop them, one of their feet hanging midstep in the air. I firmly pull them back toward me, then peer over their shoulder. I nod to the trap’s trigger, surreptitiously hidden.

Entangle Restraining Player.name:
纠缠，束缚玩家
Entangle Restraining Player

Text.text:
你脚下的地面轰然苏醒，无数藤蔓与攫握的杂草破土狂涌，缠上你乱舞的四肢，将你牢牢箍住。你再怎么挣扎，也挣不开那纤维般的拥抱；你只觉植物以令人胆寒的决绝越收越紧。

~ 由一位英雄设想

The ground around you explodes into life as innumerable vines and grasping weeds burst forth to ensnare your flailing limbs. Try as you might, you cannot break free of their fibrous embrace, and you feel the plants tighten around you with terrifying determination.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

施放这个法术，你是在孤注一掷。你可以请求你所祈求之伟力的某位特定仆从现身，却无法以任何方式强迫那股力量——也无法控制最终降临的存在。你想与那位你希望召来的存在达成的交易，仿佛是一纸在你们之间生效的契约；然而，当你面前的空气开始摇曳，四周的紧绷感层层攀升，你心知肚明：没有任何事是确定的。
You take a great risk in casting this spell. While you can request the presence of a particular servant of the power you beseech, you cannot compel that power in any way—nor can you control whatever arrives. The bargain you want to strike with the being you hope to summon serves as a kind of contract between you, but as the air before you wavers and the feeling of tension in the air builds, you know that nothing is certain.

坚硬的地面——光滑岩床与砂岩——在无情的烈日下泛着光。空气干燥，但阴影里却透着清凉。关于商队、强盗，以及一处怪物巢穴的流言将你带到了这里。你听见秃鹫沙哑的啼叫，随即一声猎鹰的坠落尖啸仿佛回应——又或许，是警告。
The hard ground, slickrock and sandstone, glows beneath a relentless sun. The air is dry, though, and the shadows are cool. This is where rumors about caravans and bandits and a hive of monsters have brought you. You hear the croak of a vulture, and the falling screech of a hawk as if in response—or perhaps in warning.

The Sanctuary: Canyon With River.name:
圣所：河流峡谷
The Sanctuary: Canyon With River

Text.text:
在陡峭的断崖脚下，一条如蓝宝石缎带般的河流静静穿过峡谷。崖壁的岩石呈现柔和、被烈日烘烤过的赭褐色，让这片区域弥漫着温暖的气息。锯齿般的岩缝里闪着点点紫光——只在此处顽强扎根的植物结出的果实，坚硬、酸涩，却清冽提神。一只黄腹旱獭从其中一道裂隙探出头来，把一枚果子绑在背上，随即灵巧地攀上崖壁，朝你这边迅速爬来。
At the bottom of a steep bluff, the sapphire ribbon of a river runs peacefully through the canyon. The stone of the cliff face has a soft, sunbaked umber hue that gives the area a feeling of warmth. Glints of purple sparkle from jagged rock clefts—hard, sour but refreshing, fruits of the stubborn plants that grow only here. A yellow-bellied marmot pokes out from one of these crevices, ties a fruit to their back, and begins nimbly scaling the cliff toward you.

Loot From A Plesiosaurus.name:
来自蛇颈龙的战利品
Loot From A Plesiosaurus

Text.text:
剖开这头野兽的肚腹，需要沿着腹部狠狠拧上几下才行。靠着一把子苦力，以及对那股恶臭的倔强抗拒，生物的内脏哗啦啦倾泻而出，淌在你脚边。几声闷响引得你侧目：一堆绳索与破木片在胆汁里翻涌晃荡——你这才看出，那并不只是旧船残渣的沉淀。你发现了一具骷髅（特征），咧着紧咬的怪笑，血肉早被胃液溶尽，双臂却仍死死抱着一只木箱。你撬开箱盖，里面竟是一处秘藏的财宝——珠宝、未经切割的宝石、黄金与白银。
Slicing open this beast takes a few good wrenches along the length of its belly. Through elbow grease and a willful resistance to the stench, the creature’s guts spill out around your feet. A few thumps draw your attention to a pile of rope and wooden scraps sloshing in the bile—and see it is not just the dregs of an old ship. You find a skeleton with a clenched grin, the flesh melted away by the juices of the beast’s stomach, its arms clinging dearly about a wooden chest. You crack open the chest and find a stash of riches—jewelry, uncut gemstones, gold, and silver.

半人马横尸于此，昔日高贵的仪态被泥沼践踏；那惊人的体型将他们拖得更深，陷入淤泥与泥浆之中。三支箭矢从尸体的人形躯干上突兀地刺出，脸上凝固着痛楚的狰狞神情。
The centaur lies dead, their noble bearing cast into the muck as their prodigious size carries them deeper into the mud and slurry. Three arrows protrude from the corpse’s humanoid torso, and a pained grimace is etched upon their face.

Glabrezu Encounter.name:
格拉布雷祖遭遇
Glabrezu Encounter

Text.text:
巨大的、如蝎般的螯爪自这东西宽阔的肩头伸展而出，却像是硬生生嫁接在一具过于高挑的躯体上——仿佛被拉长的男人。细长而近似人类的双臂别扭地从这生物的胸膛突兀伸出，像是被那对巨钳硬挤得错了位。它看上去仿佛在受尽折磨般苟活，可在那张怪异的犬类面孔上，你看不见半分痛楚——只有翻涌沸腾的怒火。
Massive, scorpion-like claws extend from this thing’s broad shoulders, but they appear grafted onto a body that is too tall, like a man stretched. Long, human-like arms jut awkwardly from the creature’s chest, as if pushed out of position by its huge pincers. It looks like a torturous existence, but you see no pain in the thing’s strange, canine face—only a seething rage.

Spinning Wheels, Screeching Burnout.name:
车轮狂转，尖啸烧胎
Spinning Wheels, Screeching Burnout

Text.text:
轮胎在沾满油污的街面上尖啸打滑。橡胶撕扯沥青的嚎叫持续了许久，司机或AI操控显然正拼命挣扎着把车身拉回正轨。直到车辆终于停住，浓烟翻涌遮住街道，焦糊橡胶的臭味化作刺鼻的瘴气，扑面而来。
Tires screech against the oil-slicked streets. The howl of rubber against asphalt goes on for a long while the driver or AI steering clearly struggles to right the vehicle. Smoke clouds the street as the car finally comes to a stop, the stench of burnt rubber a stinging miasma in the air.

I Hurl My Javelin Of Lightning As A Bolt.name:
我将雷霆标枪掷出，化作一道闪电霹雳劈落。
I Hurl My Javelin Of Lightning As A Bolt Of Lightning

Text.text:
今天我只有这一次机会，于是我屏息凝神，仔细瞄准。先小跑几步借势，我猛地后拉，用尽全力将标枪掷出。脱手的瞬间，我高声喝喊——不只是因发力，更是作为引爆雷霆的触发词。标枪骤然明亮，随即碎裂、扩散，化作五英尺宽的噼啪蓝白电光之网，沿着平直的轨迹向前疾射，径直穿过前方路径上的一切。
I get one shot at this today, so I take careful aim. After a jogging start for momentum, I pull back and fire the javelin with my best throw. As I release it, I shout, not just with the effort, but as the triggering word for the bolt. The javelin brightens, fragments, spreads to five feet wide in crackling blue and white lines of electricity, and travels forward on a flat course through whatever is in its path.

Beautiful Brass Buckle.name:
华美的黄铜扣
Beautiful Brass Buckle

Text.text:
这枚扣环仿若一条蝰蛇的头颅，鳞片纹路细密镌刻，其眼以绿宝石嵌入精铸铜制的精巧眼眶中。扣针则是一截分叉的蛇信。
This buckle mimics the head of an adder, engraved with scales and set with emerald eyes in fine sockets of molded copper. The prong is a forked tongue.

Data Sprite.name:
数据小妖精（特征）
Data Sprite

Text.text:
你的小妖精（特征）是一双眼睛，安坐在一副厚框宅气眼镜的镜片里——颜色由你挑选。眼镜悬浮在矢量线之间，自动对准矩阵中任意容纳它的空间顶部往下三分之一处，正好是人脸上双眼所在的位置。采集数据时，那双眼睛会睁得圆圆的，从左扫到右。以图书管理员的姿态整理时，它们会眯起眼。玩游戏——而且在冷知识问答中获胜时——它们会在镜框里欢快地蹦跳。
Your sprite is a pair of eyes sitting in the lenses of thick-rimmed geek glasses—the color of your choosing. The glasses float between vector lines, centering themselves at one-third the distance from the top of any containing space of the matrix, where a pair of eyes would be. When collecting data, the eyes get wide and move from left to right. When they are organizing as a librarian, they squint. When playing a game—and winning at trivia—they bounce happily inside the glasses.

Desert-dwelling Elf.name:
沙漠栖居的精灵
Desert-dwelling Elf

Text.text:
那名光头精灵身着宽松飘逸的衣袍，腰间以深色布带紧紧束起。她的古铜色肌肤在沙漠烈日下泛着光泽，锐利的黄色眼眸熟练地穿透四周沙丘的朦胧热浪，审视着这片无垠沙海。
The bald elf wears loose, flowing clothing, cinched at the waist by dark cloth wraps. Her bronze skin glows in the desert sun, and her sharp yellow eyes expertly pierce the haze of the surrounding dunes as she studies the sea of sand.

Dark Elf Archer.name:
黑暗精灵弓手
Dark Elf Archer

Text.text:
黑暗精灵的头发绿得像森林的叶子，肌肤则是暮色里柔和的紫调。她拉弓备射，苍白的眼睛在黑暗中像猫一样闪亮，牢牢钉在目标上。她左臂上绑着巨大的獠牙作护臂——也许是她曾经猎倒的凶兽留下的战利品。
The dark elf has hair as green as the leaves of the forest and skin like the soft purple shades of twilight. She readies a bowshot, her pale eyes shining like a cat’s in the dark, affixed on a target. She wears large fangs as armguards along her left arm—perhaps trophies from past beasts she has felled.

The Sanctuary: Rainforest.name:
圣所：雨林
The Sanctuary: Rainforest

Text.text: 广袤的热带雨林滴淌着湿气与生机。无尽的巨树拔地而起，交织成翡翠般的树冠；色彩惊人的蝴蝶在繁花间翩然起舞。远处群鸟鸣啭回荡，几只水豚懒洋洋地卧在荫影里。狭窄小径的起点立着一块木牌，上面写着 尊重他人，方得尊重，并画着一只绿鹰——那是被称为“生命之爪”的鼠族德鲁伊的象征。 The massive tropical forest drips with both humidity and life. Amongst the endless trees that rise to form an emerald canopy, butterflies of breathtaking colors dance around vibrant flowers. The calls of many birds echo in the distance, and a few capybaras sit lazily in the shade. At the start of a narrow path is a wooden sign with the words respect and be respected and a drawing of a green eagle—the symbol of the rat druids known as the Claws of Life.

Threat From A Wealthy Quest Giver.name:
来自富有委托人的威胁
Threat From A Wealthy Quest Giver

Text.text:
“我虽欣赏你的坦率，但如此公然藐视我的身份，足够让你们当场被剁成肉泥。算你们走运——你们脚下这张地毯，对我而言比你们的命更值钱。”
“While I admire your candor, such flagrant disrespect for my status will get you butchered on the spot. Lucky for you the carpet you’re standing on is worth more to me than your lives.”

I Play My Flute.name:
我吹响长笛
I Play My Flute

Text.text:
我的呼吸——生命的精髓——穿过长笛，在我指尖于那光滑木制管身上钻出的音孔间翩然起舞时化作旋律。空中回荡起一支奇妙而轻快的曲调，凡听见者皆为之欣悦，乐声托举着他们的灵魂，轻轻上浮。
My breath—the very essence of life—flows through my flute as my fingers dance across the holes bored into its smooth wooden barrel. A whimsical tune fills the air, delighting all who hear it as the music buoys their soul.

Sundries From A Yeti.name:
雪人杂货
Sundries From A Yeti

Text.text:
这生物一只修长而可怖的利爪想必是在战斗中被折断，落在松软如粉的积雪里。它足以作为你征服的上佳战利品，却也仅此而已。
One of the creature’s long, fearsome claws must have broken off in the battle, coming to a rest in the powdery snow. It would make a fine trophy of your conquest, but nothing more.

I Cast Dispel Evil And Good Using Powder.name:
我撒出金属粉末，施放《解除善恶》。
I Cast Dispel Evil And Good Using Powdered Metals

Text.text:
我吟诵着古老的词句，将研磨成粉的金属抛洒至头顶，划出一道守护的弧线。尘埃缓缓落下，覆在我肩头，宛如一袭闪烁的光之斗篷，空气里随之荡开低柔的嗡鸣。宜人的暖意在体内扩散开来，神圣的庇护牢牢生效，像久别重逢的老友般将我拥入怀中。
I chant the ancient words as I cast the powdered metals above me in a protective arch. The dust settles around my shoulders like a shimmering cloak of light and a soft hum fills the air. A pleasant warmth spreads through my body as the divine protection takes hold, embracing me like an old friend.

Sudden Withering Of Flora.name:
植物的骤然枯萎
Sudden Withering Of Flora

Text.text:
翠绿的葱茏忽然染上一层灰败，叶缘向上卷曲，变得脆硬。转瞬间，植物仿佛被火焰炙烤般枯萎，枝叶下垂，花瓣纷纷坠落，由褐转黑。植株在你眼前迅速腐朽、霉烂，直至只剩一抔尘埃。
The verdant green suddenly takes on a gray quality, and the edges of leaves curl upward, become brittle. In a moment, the plants wither as if held against a flame, drooping and dropping petals, brown then black. The plant molders, decaying before your eyes, until only dust remains.

攻击朝你疾扑而来。你的本能瞬间攫住你。来不及思考，你吐出奥秘的咒词，抬起手掌。能量一闪，嘶嘶炸响，魔法屏障立刻在你身前成形，将这一击偏转开去。
The attack comes at you, fast. Your instinct takes hold. Without thinking, you speak the arcane word and bring up your hand. A flash of energy, a sizzling snap, and the magical barrier forms instantly before you, turning the strike aside.

剧痛撕扯着你的躯体，你的魔法如蛆虫般钻行其间，探入血管、骨骼与肌肉的深处。一个病态的亮绿色光球浮现在你如今略显蜡黄的面容前，伸出触须——轻薄、透明的枝杈——与身体相连。你战栗不止，但你知道这疼痛只是暂时的。你神色凝重却迅捷地一瞥，将光球指向你的目标。
Pain wracks your body as your magic worms its way through, delving through vein, bone, and muscle. A sickly, bright-green orb appears before your now slightly sallow face, with tendrils—wispy, transparent branches—connected to your body. You tremble, but you know the pain is temporary. You direct the orb to your target with a somber but swift glance.

Mirror Of Life Trapping.name:
生命囚镜
Mirror Of Life Trapping

Text.text:
乍一看，这面镜子并不起眼，华丽却又寻常。然而细看之下，你会发现镀金镜框的纹样里藏着细微的点缀：咧嘴狞笑的骷髅、无声哀嚎的面孔与枯骨之手缠绕在镜缘四周，而那打磨如新的镜面竟微微闪烁，仿佛被风拂动的水波般荡漾。
At first glance the mirror seems unremarkable, opulent yet mundane. However, upon closer inspection, you notice subtle embellishments in the design of the gilded frame. Grinning skulls, wailing faces and skeletal hands decorate the mirror’s border, and the polished glass shimmers like rippling water.

Mild Psychic Injury.name:
轻度精神创伤
Mild Psychic Injury

Text.text:
你所见之物都不可信，你心里发慌，脚下失衡，仿佛置身于不该在的地方。你既不信任自己的武器，也不信任驾驭它的技能；而那些你曾经做得到的事……今天不是该尝试的日子。
The things you see aren’t reliable, and you feel worried, off balance, in the wrong place. You trust neither your weapon nor your skill with it, and whatever you used to be able to accomplish… today is the wrong day to try.

你将一条手臂旋转举起，使其与地面垂直，另一只手指向前方，感召凛冽的北风。空气在你的目标周围盘旋，随即轰然爆发成一场呼啸的暴风雪，将白色球形雪幕内的一切尽数遮蔽。风与冰渐渐平息，显露出被寒意灼伤的敌人；凝结的雪堆如冻土般锁住其中几名，使他们动弹不得。

~ 由 Zima Rel'luin 构想

You rotate one arm, perpendicular to the ground, and point with the opposite hand, calling forth the frigid north wind. Air spins around your targets. It erupts in a howling blizzard, obscuring everything inside a white sphere of swirling snow. The wind and ice subside to reveal enemies blistered by cold, frozen drifts holding some of them in place.

~ Envisioned by Zima Rel'luin

Invitation To A Vampire Gala.name:
吸血鬼盛宴邀请函
Invitation To A Vampire Gala

Text.text:
一枚宝石般的绛红火漆封在折好的信中央，纸张苍白如月洗的薄雾。火漆上的纹样是两弯新月，凹面相对。封蜡一破，纸页便如花瓣般柔顺地舒展，内容物中隐隐飘起铁锈般的气息。赤与黑的墨色点染其上，页边描着一圈猩红的狼追逐幽暗的鹿，穿行于一片细瘦的黑色林干之间。信文以优雅的手写体写就，行云流水，完美无瑕，连一丝墨渍与污点都不曾沾染。
A ruby-red wax seal holds the center of the folded letter, the paper pale as moon-washed mist. The image on the wax is two crescents, their concave sides facing. Breaking the seal, the paper unfolds softly like the petals of a flower, and the scent of iron wafts up from the contents. Red and black ink decorate the page, with a border depicting crimson wolves chasing tenebrous deer through a wood of spindly dark trunks. The letter itself is written in elegant script, no splotch nor blot marring the fluid, flawless penmanship.

Giant Sea Horse.name:
巨型海马
Giant Sea Horse

Text.text:
巨型海马以毫不费力的优雅姿态掠过海底环境，似乎对见到像你这样双足的生物感到惊讶，却并未立刻表现出攻击性。你不由得想象，在追寻海底探索之时，这头巨兽将会成为多么壮丽的坐骑。
Gliding through the undersea environs with effortless grace, the giant sea horse seems surprised to see a bipedal creature such as yourself, but is not immediately aggressive. You cannot help but imagine what a magnificent mount the beast would make in the pursuit of undersea exploration.

Young Oak Forest.name:
年轻的橡树林
Young Oak Forest

Text.text:
柔韧的幼树在一处避风的山谷里织就一片小小林地，柔软的树皮仍带着新生的翠绿。新叶初萌——每一片都勾勒出削切般的轮廓——正从纤细的枝条上探出头来，枝梢随微风轻轻摇曳。
Pliant saplings, their soft bark still bearing the viridian hue of youth, form a small forest in a sheltered valley. The first sprouts of new leaves—each with a beveled silhouette—can be seen emerging on wispy branches which sway gently in the breeze.

Baba Yaga With Silver Hair.name:
银发芭芭-雅嘎
Baba Yaga With Silver Hair

Text.text:
你面前那佝偻畸形的生物，形似一位苍老妇人，银发如扫帚的硬鬃乱翘，枯槁的手指末端生着铁铸般的利爪。她咧开的阔口里塞满污秽的牙齿，像打磨过的石片般参差锋利；下颌前突，一对野猪似的獠牙自其下颚向上生长。煤炭般的眼睛在她干瘪面容的褶皱与皱纹间灼灼燃烧，破烂长袍的层层褶缝里露出板岩灰的皮肤，其上刻满符文纹身。那邪秽之身散发出令人窒息的恐惧与作呕的恶意；她所到之处，阴影被拉长，脚步每一次落下，霉斑与菌丝便在足边疯长。
The slouched, malformed creature before you appears as an aged woman with silver hair like the bristles of a broom and gnarled fingers ending in iron claws. Dirty teeth of filed stone fill the crone’s wide mouth, while a pair of boar-like tusks sprout upward from her underslung jaw. Eyes like coals burn from the folds and wrinkles of her wizened face, and runic tattoos line the slate-gray skin emerging from the folds of her ratty robes. A palpable air of fear and disgust emanates from the vile being, the shadows lengthening in her presence, mold and fungus springing up around her feet with every step.

Animated Armor On Patrol.name:
巡逻中的活化护甲
Animated Armor On Patrol

Text.text:
护甲移动时仿佛有灵栖居其中，然而这套护甲的内里却空若虚空。显然，这是精湛技能与艰辛钻研的结晶；这具活化护甲从不知疲倦，无休无止地巡逻徘徊，警戒任何闯入者。
The armor moves as if inhabited, yet the suit’s interior is as empty as the void. Clearly a work of exquisite skill and laborious study, the animated armor never tires, endlessly patrolling and keeping watch for intruders.

Exhaustion From Traveling.name:
旅途劳乏
Exhaustion From Traveling

Text.text:
你在横穿乡野的旅途中，总算盼来了理想的天气，但过去两夜的滂沱大雨却让你不得不在绵软的泥地里挣扎——每一步都沉重吃力，仿佛把更多力气从骨头里一点点榨走。衣服被汗水浸得透湿，眼睛被咸涩的泪水刺得生疼。

~ Envisioned by snepai

You got the favorable weather you were hoping for while traveling cross country, but the past two nights of driving rain have you contending with soft mud—every labored step sapping more of your strength. Your clothes are soaked through with sweat, your eyes stinging from salty tears.

~ Envisioned by snepai

Loot From A Beholder.name:
来自眼魔的战利品
Loot From A Beholder

Text.text:
那异变守望者如巨岩般的尸身软塌塌地倚在一截被砸塌的墙上，半埋在瓦砾之中。它臃肿的肉躯上遍布陈旧伤口；其中一道伤里，一柄微微发光的匕首柄映入你的眼帘。数支箭矢深深没入这污秽生物的皮肉里，尽管战斗惨烈，它们却诡异地完好无损。
The boulder-like corpse of the aberrant watcher lolls against a smashed wall, half buried by the rubble. Old wounds litter the bulbous flesh; inside one, the hilt of a faintly glowing dagger catches your eye. Several arrows are buried deep in the foul creature's hide, strangely unbroken despite the violent fight.

色彩鲜艳的花瓣带着诡异的血管质感，从花朵中呈大型喇叭状向外舒展。细薄的花瓣上，色泽如动脉般放射成脉络纹理，越靠近花心，颜色越显深沉。此处墙面被许多这样的花朵覆盖，每一朵都绽放着令人目眩的斑斓色谱。
Vibrant petals bearing a strange vascular quality fan out from the flower in the shape of a large trumpet. Veins of color radiate through the delicate petals in arterial patterns as the hue deepens in the flower’s center. Many such blossoms cover the wall here, each with a dazzling array of colors.

Spirewych North Gate.name:
尖塔巫巫堡北门
Spirewych North Gate

Text.text:
作为护城墙上六道城门之一，北门高达十英尺，由四英寸厚、以铁箍加固的橡木门板构成。门前立着一道摇摇欲坠的锈铁闸门，几处交接点的螺栓已然松动，升起或落下时便哐啷作响、铁鸣回荡。两侧的雉堞塔楼耸至二十英尺，而城门内侧紧挨着一座覆着青苔的木制门楼。
One of six gates built into the wall protecting the town, the North doors are ten feet tall and made of iron-banded oak planks four inches thick. There is a rickety portcullis of rusting iron, with loose bolts at a few intersections, so it clatters and rings when it is raised or lowered. The crenellated towers rise to twenty feet, and there is a mossy wooden gatehouse just inside the doors.

Githzerai Mystic.name:
吉斯泽莱秘术师
Githzerai Mystic

Text.text:
悬在半空的星界苦行者盘膝而坐，缠着绷带的双手掌心向上，安放在膝头。指节布满老茧，关节处擦破或淤青——这是斗士的印记。宽松的黑袍披在身上，衣角垂曳至地，点缀着蓝与黄的迸裂纹样，仿佛星系旋臂在其间回旋。双眼紧闭，可空气却因他们的存在而仿佛有了生命——他们的念头……他们的影响。额心中央悬着一枚紫光菱形，照亮修长的面庞，将泛绿的皮肤映成幽蓝。
Hanging in midair, this astral ascetic sits cross-legged, with bandaged hands resting palms up on their knees. Their fingers are calloused, and the skin of their knuckles is scuffed or bruised—the marks of a fighter. Black robes drape over them loosely and trail down to the floor, decorated with bursts of blue and yellow designs that mimic the swirling of galaxies. Their eyes are shut, and yet the very air seems alive with their presence, their thoughts… their influence. A diamond of purple light hovers in the center of their forehead, illuminating their long face and turning their greenish skin to a shade of blue.

Sleek Racing Bike.name:
流线型赛车摩托
Sleek Racing Bike

Text.text: 满是锐利的折角与高功率导管，这辆机车线条流畅、光洁如镜，张扬得毫不遮掩。黑与绿的碳纤维合金在光里折出层层波纹般的虹彩，与复合玻璃交织成一副为竞速而生的车架。纤薄的车轮装在超高可塑性的底盘上，让它在过弯时几乎贴着路面倾斜掠过；车灯则是一枚六边形的能量灯，幽幽发亮，像一只不祥的眼。你只能想象那排气的咆哮声有多骇人。车身侧面用猩红油漆喷绘着：Run ’em down!。 All angles and high-powered tubing, the bike is sleek, polished, and totally unsubtle. Wavelike refractions of black and green carbon fiber alloys blend with combi-glass to make a race-ready frame. Thin wheels on a hyper-malleable chassis allow the bike to lean close to the road around corners, and the headlight is a single hexagonal power lamp, glowing like a baleful eye. You can only guess at the roar of the exhaust. Along the side of the bike, Run ’em down! is stenciled in scarlet paint.

Stoic Alien Commando.name:
冷峻的异星突击队员
Stoic Alien Commando

Text.text:
一个灰皮肤的身影利落地立正站着，四条肌肉虬结的手臂交叠在背后。他身上的每一件武器都是成双成对：背上斜挎着两把脉冲步枪，左右胯侧的枪套里各放着两把激光手枪，腰带上还塞满了四把弯刀与四枚异星造型的手雷。
A figure with gray skin stands crisply at attention, four muscled arms folded behind his back. Every weapon on his person is doubled: two pulse rifles are slung on his back, two laser handguns rest in holsters on either hip, and he wears a belt loaded with four curved knives and four grenades of alien design.

Sundries From An Aboleth.name:
来自夺心鳐的杂物
Sundries From An Aboleth

Text.text:
一汪浅池被一具胀大的夺心魔鱼尸体玷污。它的颚骨一张一合，致命的利齿在昏淡的光里闪着寒芒。一串廉价贝壳手环套在一根触手上，倒是惹眼，却不值几个钱。
A shallow pool is marred by the bloated corpse of the aboleth. The jaws flap open, lethally sharp teeth gleaming in the wan light. A bracelet of cheap shells encircles one tentacle, interesting but worth little.

Loot From A Mezzoloth.name:
来自梅佐洛斯的战利品
Loot From A Mezzoloth

Text.text:
生物的身体伴着令人作呕的咯吱碎响向内蜷缩，四肢被硬生生扯向胸腔。你在它僵硬不动的躯体下发现一柄由有机材质制成的三叉戟——也许是骨头或几丁质——深深卡在那里，旁边还有一只装着90枚金币的袋子。
The creature's body curls inward with a sickening crunch as its limbs are pulled towards its thorax. You find a trident made of organic material—perhaps bone or chitin—lodged under its still form, as well as a pouch of 90 gold pieces.

Gibbering Mouther's Incoherent Babble.name:
咕哝魔的混沌呓语
Gibbering Mouther's Incoherent Babble

Text.text:
絮絮叨叨的低语在空气里窸窣翻涌，酝酿着初生的不和谐。它的音高不断攀升，数十张嘴的噪声一层层叠压交缠，汇成令人作呕的起伏波浪——带着腥臭湿滑的吧唧声。随着胡言乱语愈发癫狂，它竟凝成有形的恶意，嗡鸣着撞击你的耳膜，直到你的眼球在眼眶里胀痛发凸，你的脑髓尖叫着渴求停息。可那喋喋不休仍在翻涌……翻涌、翻涌，UP；无尽的噪音汇聚成啜吸般的咯咯怪笑，嘶嘶作响的胡语乱言，咕哝的蠢话与喧嚷的絮叨以油腻的腔调涂抹出来，像指甲缝里扎进的木刺般，悄无声息地滑入你的理智之下。

~ Envisioned by Jesse

A susurration of prattling babble fills the air with budding discordance. It rises in pitch, layers of noise from dozens of mouths overlapping into an appalling undulation of reeking wet smacking. As the gibbering intensifies, it takes on a physical malice, thrumming against the drums of your ears until your eyes swell in their sockets and your brain screams for cessation. But still, the blither bubbles up… up, UP; unending noise coalescing in the slurping chortle of sibilate gibberish, a cooing drivel of jabbering yammer blathered in oleaginous tones that slip beneath your sanity like splinters under your fingernails.

~ Envisioned by Jesse

一尊洁白的生物雕像立在门道对面的壁龛里——上半身是女人，下半身是蛇，盘踞于自身的蛇躯之上。她以手握住一柄巨人般尺寸的巨剑剑刃，剑尖朝下垂落。向东与向西，两条短而立柱成列的走廊尽头，各有一具巨大的暗色石棺嵌入仅容其身的凹龛。每具石棺靠近入口的一端都放着一只金罐，靠近入口的竖直棺面上刻着蛇的符号：一具是盘曲的巨蛇；另一具是蛇缠绕着一枚金蛋。那具“金蛋”棺旁堆满了器皿与箱匣，而另一具则空无一物。
The white statue of a creature half human woman and half snake rests on her coils in an alcove opposite the doorway. She holds a greatsword of giant proportions by the blade, point down. To the east and west, at the end of short, pillared halls, massive sarcophagi of dark stone fill nooks just big enough to hold them. A golden jar rests on each at the end closest to the entryway, and each bears a snake symbol on its closest vertical face. One is a coiled serpent; the other is a snake wrapped around a golden egg. The egg coffin has vessels and coffers packed nearby, while the other has none.

Temple To A God Of Combat.name:
战斗之神的神殿
Temple To A God Of Combat

Text.text:
两名武僧在沙坑中相向而行。所有的狂怒与嗜血，都被咬紧的牙关与冷硬的目光压进胸腔。两人的双手与胸膛缠着绷带，除此之外只穿着一条薄薄的短裤。

一只脚扫过沙地，卷起一团沙雾——他们随即扑上，拳脚交织。彼此沉着地交换了几记试探性的打击后，终于有一拳命中，血从受击者的鼻间迸溅而出。落败的斗士软塌塌地瘫倒在地，一名侍祭立刻握着一只小瓶快步赶来。他们将染血的沙子捧起，装入瓶中，再高高举起，让所有旁观者都看得分明。

观众齐齐低头祈祷，低语声汇成潮涌，最终以一声整齐、断然的呼喊作结。沙坑骤然寂静。胜者俯身将被击倒的对手从地上扶起，把她的手臂拉过来搭在自己肩上。她的脸覆着结块的血沙，眼神仍因那一击而恍惚。她摇摇晃晃地用手比了个宗教手势，随后轻轻以拳贴在胜者的胸口——他便搀着她，带她走出擂圈。
Two monks approach one another in a sand pit. Any rage or bloodlust has been tamped down behind gritted jaws and steely eyes. Their hands and chests are wrapped in bandages, and their only other garb is a thin pair of short pants. A foot kicks through the sand, sending up a cloud, and they are at it—fighting with fists and feet. After a few measured strikes from each opponent, a blow lands, sending blood spraying from the stricken’s nose. The losing fighter crumples to the ground and an acolyte hurries toward her with a small vial in hand. They scoop the bloodied sand into the vessel and hold it up for all observers to see. The audience bow their heads in prayer, their murmurings ending in a collective, punctuating shout. The pit falls silent, and the victorious fighter lifts his beaten adversary from the ground, tugging her arm around his shoulder. Her face is covered in clumped, bloodied sand, her eyes still dazed from the blow. She woozily makes a religious sign with her hand and then presses her fist softly against the victor’s chest as he leads her out of the ring.

小巧却致命，这把弩的松木握把稳稳贴合你的掌心——甚至可能顺着袖口藏起。你小心翼翼地扳起缩短的金属弩臂，触发在拉力下绷紧如弦，随时能悄无声息地放出一支弩矢；那份静默，与它爆裂般的穿透力截然不符。
Small but effective, the crossbow’s pine grip fits easily into your palm—perhaps even up your sleeve. The trigger tightens with tension as you gingerly cock the abbreviated metal lath, ready to loose a bolt with a quiet that belies its punch.

I Launch My Fan Feather Token Into The A.name:
我将扇羽符牌抛向空中
I Launch My Fan Feather Token Into The Air

Text.text:
“都给我稳住！”我冲船员们大喊，同时将那枚水晶羽毛徽记抛向帆后方的天空。羽毛在空中绽放成一柄耀眼的纯白折扇。它开始拍动——一下、两下、三下，强劲的推力把所需的风猛地灌满船帆。帆布随之绷紧鼓胀，船身破浪疾行。
“Brace yourselves!” I cry to the crew as I throw the crystalline feather token toward the sky behind the sails. The feather blooms into a bright white fan. It begins to flap—one, two, three powerful thrusts fill the sails with the wind they need. The canvas stretches and balloons and the ship cuts swiftly through the water.

Fiber Optic Cable With Headjack Input.name:
带有头插接口的光纤线缆
Fiber Optic Cable With Headjack Input

Text.text:
一根蜿蜒如蛇的黑色电缆在地面上迤逦而行，长得离谱，甚至好几次盘回自身。光纤线缆的末端分叉成三枚不同颜色与粗细的接头。绿色那枚最粗，显然是头插接口——丑陋又沉重的插头。蓝色是一根纤细而危险的尖刺，嗡鸣着能量。橙色接头则被人以极其粗暴的方式硬生生扯了下来。
A snaking black wire wends its way across the ground, so long it curls back upon itself several times. The fiber optic cable splits at the end into three attachments of different color and thickness. Green, the thickest, is clearly a headjack input—an ugly, weighty plug. Blue is a thin and menacing spike humming with energy. The orange attachment has been removed quite violently.

不久前，一次走错的回合揭开了一座晦暗难明的黑色殿堂。里面藏着秘密，可每一个都索取多于回赠；当秘密被知晓得足够多时，答案又扭曲成疑问。每一面墙都是转角，每一条走廊都是愈收愈窄的隧道。那些开阔处，没有一丝兽鸣，没有乐声，也没有笑语。随后，在任何日历上都找不到的一天里，寂静化作狂野的噪响，连绵的笑声在无时代与永恒之间不息。
Some time ago, a wrong turn revealed a hall of cryptic dark. There were secrets in it, but each one took more than it gave back, and after enough secrets were learned, answers twisted into questions. Every wall was a corner, every hallway a narrowing tunnel. In the open spaces, not one animal sound, neither music nor chuckle. And then, on a day not to be found on any calendar, silence became wild noise and constant laughter for no time and forever.

Portal To The Demonic Realm.name:
通往恶魔界的传送门
Portal To The Demonic Realm

Text.text:
那道高耸的黑石半圆拱门，岩体间流淌着熔岩般的纹理，表面刻满符文，仿佛是大地自身隆起而成。拱门核心处，一股火焰漩涡盘旋不息；烈焰深处隐约可见惨白而骇人的面孔，正向外狞笑。翻腾的炼狱之中传出被压抑的尖叫，沉闷而遥远。传送门周遭的土地迅速枯萎干裂，被灼烧得焦黑荒芜。
The soaring semicircle of black stone veined with magma and etched with runes seems to emerge from the earth itself. At its heart, a vortex of fire swirls, and within the flames one perceives faint, terrifying faces leering outward. Screams emerge, muffled, from the roiling inferno. The ground surrounding the portal withers and dries up, scorched and barren.

Sinister Casting Of Vampiric Touch.name:
阴森施放：吸血接触
Sinister Casting Of Vampiric Touch

Text.text:
你的手被阴沉邪异的能量所笼罩，当你触及向对手时，腐蚀着他们原本拥有的一切防护。希望仿佛从他们眼中褪去，紧接着便是生命的消逝。随之而来的一股生命能量涌入，令你的身体重获新生，你的手也开始微微颤抖。
Your hand is shrouded in a dark sinister energy as you reach toward your opponent, corroding whatever protection they had. Hope seems to fade from their eyes, followed by their life. Your hand starts to shake as a surge of life energy rejuvenates your body.

Joust Combatant Unhorsed.name:
马上比武者被掀落马下
Joust Combatant Unhorsed

Text.text:
飞驰的蹄下尘土轰然炸起，敌手咆哮着相向冲锋——人群屏息凝望，敬畏与期待攫住每一双眼。撞击如山崩般骇人。宛如铁匠铺里金铁齐鸣的喧嚣震彻长空，一名骑士被硬生生从坐骑上砸飞，身躯在空中扭转翻滚，随即重重坠地，血点四溅的砂尘如浪喷起。
Dust erupting from galloping hooves, opponents roar toward each other—the crowd gripped in expectant awe. The impact is colossal. A blacksmith's cacophony fills the air as one knight is hammered from their mount, twisting through the air before smashing to earth in a spray of blood-flecked sand.

Carpet Of Flying.name:
飞行地毯
Carpet Of Flying

Text.text:
厚重的地毯卷被两条粉色丝带捆着，左右两端各一条，中央又缠着一圈细绳。也许有人弄丢了第三条丝带。将地毯展开，便显露出一件令人屏息的艺术品：其上绣着一幅仿佛飞鸟俯瞰大地的景象——一条闪烁的河流蜿蜒其间，穿行于点缀着羊群的丘陵之间，掠过披着秋色的森林。
The thick roll of carpet has two pink silk ribbons binding it, one on either end, and then a single strand of thin rope entwined around its center. Perhaps someone lost the third piece of silk. Unrolling the rug reveals a stunning piece of art. It is embroidered with a scene of the world as a bird might see it from the air, with a glittering river flowing between sheep-speckled hills and forests in autumnal colors.

前一刻，空气还澄澈清明——下一刻，天地便如黑夜般沉暗，倾盆暴雨猛击着雨林的树冠。枝桠在雨势的重压下频频低伏，任由雨水轰然倾落。雨幕汇成道道细流，沿坡急奔而下，把地面化作松软的泥沼。
One moment, the air is clear—the next, it is as dark as night and a torrential downpour bombards the rainforest canopy. Tree branches nod with the force of the rain tumbling down upon them. The rainfall gathers into rivulets and rushes downhill, turning the ground into a spongy mire.

Alien Travel Agent.name:
异星旅行代理人
Alien Travel Agent

Text.text:
尽管这间小办公室四周昏暗又邋遢，这位旅行代理却穿得一丝不苟。西装为他健壮的身形量体裁衣，衣着从头到脚都精心搭配——连口袋巾也颜色呼应。你推门而入时，代理那分节的眼柄转向你，随即从桌后起身，像老友般热情迎接……同时把全息宣传册几乎怼到你脸上。
Despite the dingy surroundings of their small office, the travel agent is dressed impeccably. Their suit has been expertly tailored to fit their robust frame, and every inch of the outfit has been meticulously coordinated—including the matching pocket square. The agent swivels segmented eye stalks toward you as you open the door, rising from their desk to greet you like an old friend… as they brandish holographic brochures in your face.

Sundries From A Harpy.name:
鹰身女妖的杂货
Sundries From A Harpy

Text.text:
羽毛散落在那只如今已死的鹰身女妖走过的路径上。一只卷轴筒里装着一份你从未听闻之地的小铁匠铺地契，纸张边缘因年代久远而龟裂。
Feathers are strewn about the now-dead harpy’s path. A deed for a small smithy in a land you’ve never heard of is contained in a scroll case, the edges of the paper cracked with age.

Summon Lesser Demons.name:
召唤次等恶魔
Summon Lesser Demons

Text.text:
你的喉间咕噜作响，发出粗哑而原始的颤鸣，仿佛在向深渊呼唤。你听见一道可怖的合唱——咆哮、尖叫与癫狂的嗤笑——自这片位面之外传来，紧接着一股热浪猛然淹没你的背脊。身后传来细碎的落地声：一双双小巧而带爪的脚掌啪嗒啪嗒踏下。
Your voice burbles from your throat in a guttural warble as you call to the abyss. You hear a terrible chorus, of roars, screams, and cackles from beyond this plane, before a wave of heat floods your back. The pattering landing of small, clawed feet sounds behind you.

High-caliber Single-shot Target Pistol.name:
大口径单发式目标手枪
High-caliber Single-shot Target Pistol

Text.text:
准星自手枪修长枪口的根部附近隆起，向下投出一抹微光，沿着碳黑色的枪身框架流淌。光线映出这把原本平平无奇的武器上，几道装饰性的凹槽纹路。
A sight projects up near the base of the long nose of the pistol, casting a glow down on the carbon-black frame. The light reveals decorative grooves on an otherwise nondescript weapon.

Hooked Claws Echo In Underdark.name:
倒钩利爪在幽暗地域回响
Hooked Claws Echo In Underdark

Text.text:
在地表之下极深处，空气沉重，弥漫着对未知与禁忌之谜的战栗。某种尖利带钩的东西刮擦着石壁，诡异的回响渗透进潮湿阴冷的隧道。回声扭动交缠，织成一片萦魂的嘈响，在深处反复震荡。这里是被黑暗与低语笼罩的领域，威胁滋生，想象游荡。

~ 由 njorgard 构想

Far beneath the surface, the air heavy with a sense of the unknown and forbidden mystery, something sharp and hooked scrapes against the stone walls, its eerie resonance permeating the dank tunnels. The echoes writhe and intertwine, creating a haunting cacophony that reverberates through the depths. This is a realm shrouded in darkness and whispers, where menace thrives and imagination wanders.

~ Envisioned by njorgard

Earth Elemental: In The Forest.name:
土元素：在森林中
Earth Elemental: In The Forest

Text.text:
林地里声响不断，鸟鸣与风掠树冠的沙沙声交织，处处生机盎然。但最让你意外的是这里的空气。你深深吸了一口，清新洁净的气息里裹着花香与浆果的甜润余韵。那感觉令人精神一振——几乎像带着魔法一般。
The woodland sounds active, alive with birdsong and wind rustling the tops of trees. But it’s the air that surprises you. You inhale deeply, catching notes of flowers and berries in the fresh, clean scent. It feels rejuvenating—almost magical.

Pipes Of The Sewers.name:
下水道之笛
Pipes Of The Sewers

Text.text:
这些木制管身磨损得厉害，曾经抛光留下的光泽如今只剩遥远的记忆；但它们看上去依然完整，做工也很扎实。乐器两侧各系着一条灰色的毛皮与皮革绑带，供吹笛者缠绕手腕。管肋上刻着一行细小的铭文：吹笛者所引，众人随行。
These wooden pipes are worn enough that any polish rubbed into them is now but a distant memory, but they seem whole and well made. A gray strip of fur and leather to wrap around the piper’s wrist has been attached to each side of the instrument. A tiny inscription upon the rib reads: Where the piper leads, others follow.

这间密室里，台面、架子、书桌的每一寸空间都被杂物塞得满满当当，像是在无声宣告：这里同时进行着至少十来项实验与半途的成果。常见与罕见的巨著被刻意堆叠、摆放得仿佛自有章法，却又让你在第一眼时完全摸不着头绪。某张桌子上更是堆满炼金装备——烧杯、长颈瓶、各式玻璃瓶与蒸馏器——其中不少此刻仍在运作，余温与气味仿佛还在空气里打转。石质地面上嵌着一圈简朴的仪式圆环，以银丝嵌线勾勒；只要给足时代与粉笔，它便能轻易改作各种仪式之用。而到处——到处都是——羊皮纸与纸张。
The clutter that fills every inch of space on counter, shelf, and desk in this chamber is evidence of at least a dozen experiments and works in progress. Tomes both common and rare are stacked with purpose, but in such a way that makes no sense to you at first glance. One table is cluttered with alchemical equipment such as beakers, flasks, bottles, and alembics, many of which are currently in use. A simple ritual circle has been laid into the stone floor in silver wire, easily adapted for various rituals given enough time and chalk. And everywhere—everywhere—there is parchment and paper.

Temporary Drow Cave Outpost.name:
临时卓尔洞窟前哨站
Temporary Drow Cave Outpost

Text.text:
在一座巨大的洞窟里，一条溪流穿洞而过，几顶由苍白、微光粼粼的布料搭成的帐篷矗立其间。几座更大的篷亭在较小的栖身处中央拔地而起。主区域旁，一堆公共篝火正燃烧着。几架烹饪三脚架立在火上方，吊着烤架、坩埚与平底锅。卓尔士兵把守营地的两处主要入口。相比之下，他们对那些次要洞室不太上心——那边传来动物的嘶叫，你也闻到刺鼻的秽物气味。部分流石凝结体上可见绳索般的蛛网，暗示洞窟上方深处潜伏着蜘蛛类生物。

~ 一位英雄 构想

In a large cavern, with a stream running through it, stands several tents of pale, shimmering cloth. A couple larger pavilions rise in the center of the smaller shelters. Near this main area burns a communal fire. A couple cooking tripods stand over it with suspended grills, cauldrons, and pans. Drow soldiers keep watch at the camp’s two main entrances. They pay less attention to the secondary chambers where you hear animal braying and smell pungent waste. Ropey webs visible on some flowstone formations hint the presence of arachnids hidden in the cavern’s upper reaches.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Bard Reciting Poetry While Drunk.name:
醉醺醺的吟游诗人朗诵诗篇
Bard Reciting Poetry While Drunk

Text.text:
吟游诗人的舌头像醉酒般沉重，含混拖腔地哼念着一首雅致的诗篇。他脚步虚浮地摇晃着，忽又猛然一转，几乎失去平衡。他举起酒杯，满怀柔情地凝望着它。 “… and all athirst, my wand’ring gaze might drink your beauty all my days…” 吟游诗人仰起头，痛快地灌下长长一口。
