The bard’s tongue is thick with intoxication as they slur over the verses of an elegant poem. They sway on unsteady feet, then wheel about suddenly, nearly losing their balance. They raise their beverage and stare at it lovingly. “… and all athirst, my wand’ring gaze might drink your beauty all my days…” The bard throws back their head and takes a long quaff.

Loot From A Vampire Lord.name:
来自吸血鬼领主的战利品
Loot From A Vampire Lord

Text.text:
吸血鬼领主在漫长而受诅咒的一生中聚敛了海量宝藏——而如今，这些宝藏任你取走。你一眼便看见数只箱子里古老钱币满溢而出，但与吸血鬼巢穴中陈列的精美且价值连城的艺术珍品相比，这些不过是微不足道的小头。一枚莲花造型的铂金胸针、一袭镶嵌宝石的丝质斗篷、以及数幅大师级肖像画，只是你匆匆一瞥便能望见的几件古物——毫无疑问，还有更多等待发掘。
The vampire lord amassed a great deal of treasure over its long and cursed life—treasure that is now yours for the taking. Chests overflowing with ancient coins catch your eye, but these are paltry compared to the exquisite—and valuable—works of art festooning the vampire’s lair. A platinum brooch shaped like a lotus, a silken cloak embedded with precious stones, and several masterwork portraits are just a few of the antiquities visible at a cursory glance—no doubt there are more to find.

尽管这把古老的长剑会随月相渐盈而愈发明亮，但无人知晓这柄月华之刃是否真的与那天体有所牵连。其先祖持有者在剑身上镌刻符文与印记，使这件武器拥有一整套独一无二的力量，在同类精灵奇珍之中几近无出其右。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Though this ancient sword shines brighter and brighter with the waxing moon, it is not known if this lunar blade is truly tied somehow to that heavenly body. Inscribed with runes and sigils by its ancestral holders, this weapon boasts a panoply of unique powers virtually unmatched among fey artifacts of their ilk.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Priceless Marble Sculpture.name:
无价的大理石雕像
Priceless Marble Sculpture

Text.text:
优雅的弧线与细腻的纹理构成了这尊价值连城的大理石雕塑：一具赤裸的人形伏在一株陌生的分叉结构脚下哭泣。凑近细看，那竟是一棵橡树——早已逝去年代里罕见的植物。赤裸人形全身每一束绷紧的肌肉，都被雕刻得纤毫毕现。下方的铭牌告诉你：这是R.K. 弗拉辛格“WhistleThistle”藏品中唯一幸存的一件雕塑。
Arcing curves and subtle lines make up this priceless marble sculpture, a naked figure weeping at the foot of an unfamiliar branching structure. Upon closer inspection, it’s an oak tree—rare flora of a bygone era. Each stitch of tensed muscle has been immaculately detailed across the body of the naked figure. A plaque below informs you that this is the only surviving sculpture from the WhistleThistle collection of R.K. Flaschinger.

I Transcribe A New Recipe.name:
我誊写一份新食谱
I Transcribe A New Recipe

Text.text:
我用简写缩略记下份量与材料，以节省时代与墨水。随着我把步骤一条条写下，脑海里已开始预演这道配方：想象某种材料的风味如何与另一种交织相衬，也想象成品完成时会呈现怎样的色泽、入口又是怎样的滋味。
I jot down amounts and ingredients, using shorthand abbreviations to save time and ink. As I write out the instructions, I begin preparing the recipe in my mind, imagining how the flavor of one ingredient will pair with another, and how the creation will look and taste when it’s finished.

这件管乐器像一座高塔：长度约为手杖的三分之二，却足足粗上两倍，奏出的歌声低沉而浑厚，回响深远。它墨色的躯体上覆着一层闪亮的银键，形似诡异昆虫的甲壳；各音孔间嵌有杠杆与塞钮，用以开合定音。一位专注的玩家坐着，将喇叭口夹在小腿之间静候，直到轮到他们的回合——他们便起身，将它高高举到身前，双手与唇已然就位。
Two-thirds the size of a walking stick and twice as thick, this tower of a wind instrument sings in a deep, resonant voice. Its inky body is crusted with shining silver keys that resemble strange insect shells, with levers and stoppers in the holes for notes. A dedicated player sits with the bell between their shins until it is their turn to play—then they stand and hoist it before them, hands and lips ready.

刹那间，你还用凡人的双眼注视世界；下一次眨眼，你的视野骤然扩展，囊括更多。随着你的眼眸幽暗下去，法术牢牢生效，你感到体内那股可怖的力量在翻涌扭动，迫不及待要破体而出。你知道，只需一瞥，便能令一名生物染病，令其昏厥，或使其在惊惧中仓皇奔逃。
One instant, you look upon the world with the eyes of a mortal; then you blink, and your vision shifts to encompass far more. As your eyes darken and the spell takes hold, you feel the dread power writhing within you, eager to emerge. You know that with a single look you might render a creature ill, render them unconscious, or cause them to flee in terror.

Flesh Chamber With Appendages.name:
带附肢的血肉囚室
Flesh Chamber With Appendages

Text.text:
地面滑得令人心惊，而每一步下去脚下的回弹又难以预料，更添不安。这间圆形房间的墙壁宛如一块块将近变质的五花肉板。你勉强抓住片刻的平衡抬头望去，只见空间在你头顶向上隆起成半个穹顶，长长的附肢自其下垂落，像一根根套索般摇曳。
It’s disconcerting how slippery the floor is, and the amount of give underneath each step is unpredictable, making matters worse. The walls of this circular room resemble slabs of pork belly nearing their expiry. Finding a moment of balance, you look up and observe that the space rises above you into a half dome from which long appendages dangle like nooses.

“旅人们！”你们走近时，一名蛙人用嘶哑的呱鸣打着招呼。你们踏上吱呀作响的栈道，那栈道把主岸与河中央这座葱郁而古雅的小岛连在一起。蛙人蹼状的脚悬在步道边缘，带着几分顽皮地前后晃荡；他眨着一双硕大的黄眼睛，满是好奇地打量你们。他那根芦苇般的钓竿垂在水面，浮漂随波轻轻起伏，被水流温柔地牵拽着。“找活儿？”他沙哑地问道，“还是找顿饭？”他用短促的一偏头示意真正的镇子——一簇簇小木屋环绕着岛心的山丘而建。山丘顶上，你看见一道朴素的石拱门勾勒出一尊带翼雕像，也许是献给当地神祇的神龛。镇民——多半是半身人、蛙人和人类——在其间来来往往，不少人穿着涉水裤、戴着松垮的宽檐帽，身上挂满钓具。
“Travelers!” A frogkin croaks in greeting as you approach, crossing the creaking boardwalk connecting the main bank to this lush, quaint isle in the middle of the river. The frogkin’s webbed feet dangle over the edge of the walkway, swinging with a hint of whimsy as he blinks at you with large yellow eyes full of curiosity. The lure of his reedy fishing pole bobs on the surface, being gently pulled by the current. “Looking for work?” he rasps. “Or a meal?” He gestures with a short turn of his head toward the town proper, a cluster of small wooden buildings circling the hill at the center of the isle. Atop the hill, you see a simple stone arch framing a winged statue, perhaps a shrine to a local deity. Townsfolk—halflings, frogkin, and humans mostly—mill about, many of them dressed in waders and droopy brimmed hats, laden with fishing tackle.

City Of Apes.name:
猿猴之城
City Of Apes

Text.text:
猿类的呼号在丛林间回荡，你渐近那座高踞林冠的城市。编织而成的桥在你脚下吱呀作响、左右摇摆。前方，城门张开巨口，热情迎你入内。你随这座城的律动抬起视线，目光掠过层层叠叠的树上都会——它们像蜂巢般沿着数百棵巨树的树干蔓延铺展。广场与集市、租屋与神庙——一切都由一张下垂的绳桥之网相连，桥上挤满了建造它们的灵长类，沉甸甸地坠着。你通往领袖斑马木王座的旅程，最终化作一片喧嚣与色彩的迷离：潮湿的皮毛气息，和熟透果实的甜香。

~ 构想：Dexter

Simian calls echo through the jungle as you near the city, perched high in the canopy. The woven bridge creaks and sways beneath your weight. Ahead, the city gates yawn open in welcome. Your gaze rises with the movement of the place, tracing the multitiered metropoles sprawling like hives around the trunks of hundreds of trees. Piazzas and markets, tenements and temples—all interconnected by a web of sagging rope bridges, heavy with the primates who built them. Your journey to the leader’s zebrawood throne becomes a blur of noise and color, damp fur, and ripe fruit.

~ Envisioned by Dexter

Invigorating Speech To An Exhausted Part.name:
对精疲力竭的小队的振奋演说
Invigorating Speech To An Exhausted Party

Text.text:
“我知道你很疲惫。我们一路走到这里，却仍然……我能感觉到身体正在崩塌，但我们绝不能松懈。敌人在黑暗的追猎中不知疲倦，我们也必须如此。等这一切结束，我向你保证，我们一定会找到休息——不管用什么方式。”
“I know you are tired. We have come so far and yet… I can feel my body collapsing, but we must not relent. Our enemies know no fatigue in their dark pursuit and we must be the same. When this is all over, I assure you we will find rest, one way or another.”

从那道仿佛无底的深渊里倒卷而上的凛冽寒风，裹挟着你从未闻过的气味——那是地表之下、遥远世界的气息。你的脚尖踢松了一块石头，它滚落而下，一路磕碰作响，坠向深处。你等着……又等着……仿佛过了好几分钟，才终于听见那块石头在极其遥远的下方击中水面时，那声清晰的溅响。你不愿去想这段坠落究竟有多深，更不愿去想，在那片黑暗里潜伏着什么。
The frigid wind blowing up from the seemingly bottomless chasm carries smells completely unknown to you—those of a world far beneath the surface. Your foot knocks a rock loose, and it tumbles into the depths, clattering as it goes. You wait… and wait… for what seems like minutes before you hear the tell-tale splash of the stone striking water far, far below. You hate to imagine how far the fall must be, and hate much more the thought of what lurks down there in the darkness.

Sundries From Asmodeus, Lord Of Hell.name:
来自地狱之主阿斯莫德的杂物
Sundries From Asmodeus, Lord Of Hell

Text.text:
阿斯摩蒂斯败倒在地，那张邪魅俊美的面孔此刻僵成一副愤怒与难以置信的面具。你以十足的谨慎靠近这具地狱的尸骸，俯身拍摸地狱之主，既要确认是否仍有生机——也要搜刮战利品。你从他胸前深处的口袋里摸出几张折得整整齐齐的空白羊皮纸，质地上乘；还有一支乌木笔，打磨得光亮如镜，笔尖锋利到足以刺破皮肤。
Asmodeus lies defeated, his devilishly handsome face a mask of outrage and disbelief. Approaching the infernal corpse with abundant caution, you pat down the Lord of Hell for signs of life—and loot. A deep breast pocket yields several neatly folded pieces of blank, high-quality parchment, as well as an ebony pen polished to a high shine, with a nib sharp enough to break skin.

Eyes Of Charming.name:
魅惑之眼
Eyes Of Charming

Text.text:
这副花哨的眼镜配着半透明的蓝色镜片与带角的镜框，映出几分猫头鹰般的神态，却又让人无法否认它的诱惑力。金色镜腿与黄铜镜架上布满精巧的蚀刻纹路，使你隐隐觉得，这些镜片绝非寻常之物。
The translucent blue lenses and horned rims of these gaudy glasses evoke an owl-like countenance, but you cannot deny their allure. Intricate etchings along the golden bands and brassy frames give you the sense that these lenses are not truly mundane.

一团血色光辉的漩涡在峭壁上那颗巨大石颅的张口中翻涌旋转。石颅嵌在由棱角分明、骨白色石柱组成的天然柱林里，仿佛自岩壁上被凿刻而出。巨灵的眼眶同样泛着猩红的光。它的面孔粗犷凿成，仍保留着类人的轮廓，而那些残存的天然石柱化作它六边形的牙齿。空气里悬着硫磺般的刺鼻气味。柔细的声响从骷髅的口中飘出。它是在低语吗？

~ Envisioned by Black Pudding

A vortex of blood-colored radiance swirls in the open mouth of a massive stone skull carved into a cliff face amid angular natural columns of bone-colored stone. The titan’s eye sockets also glow red. Roughly hewn, its features are humanoid, and the remains of natural pillars form its hexagonal teeth. A brimstone odor hangs in the air. Soft sounds issue from the skull’s mouth. Is it whispering?

~ Envisioned by Black Pudding

雷鸣般的震颤沿着大地荡开，一头巨大的生物以双足重踏向前。它那蜥蜴般的头颅塞满弯曲的利齿，掠食者的双眼分列两侧，冷冷审视着你。它奔跑时颈部向前探出，而身后一条修长蜿蜒的长尾为它维持平衡。起初，它似乎没有手臂；但当它逼近时，你看见两条萎缩的肢体从腹侧垂落，几枚寒酸的爪子无力地晃荡着。
Thunder ripples through the ground as a massive creature stomps forward on two legs. Its saurian head is overstuffed with curved teeth and its predatory eyes regard you from either side. It runs with its neck extending before it, while a long sinuous tail stretches behind it for balance. At first, it appears to have no arms, but as it closes the distance you see two shrunken appendages with paltry claws dangling ineffectually from its midsection.

Porter Green In Winter.name:
冬日的波特·格林
Porter Green In Winter

Text.text:
这片靠河的小公园或许不如彭韦林公园那般开阔、修整得体——这里只立着两棵树，外加一圈石头——却能让人远离城市，寻得一份安宁与天然的静谧。南端常被更邋遢的酒馆客人丢下的易拉罐或酒瓶弄得一团糟，一群志愿者正把它们捡起，装进巨大的垃圾袋里。一个披袍的身影站在石圈旁，面朝河流，压低嗓音对自己喃喃低语。
This small park by the river might not be as extensive or well-manicured as Penwellyn Park—there’s only a pair of trees and a circle of stones—but it offers peace and natural tranquility away from the city. The southern end is often riddled with cans or bottles from messier pub patrons and a group of volunteers collects them in large trash bags. A robed figure stands by the stone circle and faces the river, murmuring something to themselves in low tones.

Overgrown Cemetery.name:
荒草蔓生的墓园
Overgrown Cemetery

Text.text:
杂草与灌木在久被遗忘的亡者无人打理的坟茔间交织蔓延，风里传来一记哀婉的钟声。有些人会将此视作悲剧，而另一些人却从中看见新生。生命的轮回永不停歇，这座小小的、荒草没膝的墓园，正是那条真理的见证。

~ 由David在Discord上构想

Weeds and shrubs weave among the untended graves of the long-forgotten dead as a dolorous bell chimes on the wind. Some might see this as tragedy, while others view it as renewal. The cycle of life forever turns, and this small, overgrown cemetery stands as testament to that truth.

~ Envisioned by David on Discord

有什么东西在灌木与草丛间悄然潜行。机械颚咔嗒作响，齿轮嗡鸣在鸟鸣间隐约回荡——随即，一声低沉的金属咆哮如雷滚过。那生物现身了：一具精巧的猫科构装体，黄铜般的色泽，身形纤细，锋利的爪尖稳稳踞立，长而凌厉的尾巴左右鞭甩。它的面部有两处幽深的凹坑，内嵌复杂的传感器，缓缓扫过整个区域。
Something slinks through the undergrowth. The clicking of mechanical jaws and the whirring of cogs echo faintly amid the sounds of birdsong—then, a low metallic growl, like thunder. The creature comes into view, a delicate feline construct: brassy and slim, perched on sharp claws with a long and lashing tail swishing side to side. Two deep pits in the face house complex sensors that sweep the area.

尽管荒废多年，旌旗仍在风中猎猎飘扬——褪色破碎，却依旧承载着那些古老家族的颜色与纹章。一面旗上，长着雄鹿之角与猎鹰之翼的巨熊，昂然踏行于翠绿底色之上；另一面旗上，蛇形巨龙盘绕成一道奥秘符文，映衬在血红色的背景之中。
Despite ages of neglect, banners flutter in the wind—faded and tattered, but still bearing the colors and sigils of their ancient houses. On one, a bear with the antlers of a stag and the wings of a hawk strides confidently against a field of emerald green; on the other, a serpentine dragon coils itself into an arcane rune against a blood-red backdrop.

Sundries From A Vampire's Thrall.name:
来自吸血鬼仆从的杂物
Sundries From A Vampire's Thrall

Text.text:
你在那具瘦骨嶙峋的奴仆身上发现了一件令人不安的物品——它用一根磨损起毛的皮绳系在脖颈上：一枚青铜五芒星坠饰，中央蚀刻着一颗鼠头。这件物体让你心神发毛，光是触碰一下，就足以令你浑身起鸡皮疙瘩。
On the emaciated thrall you find an unsettling item strung around its neck on a fraying leather cord—a bronze pentacle with a rat's head etched in its center. The object unsettles you, and simply touching it is enough to make your skin crawl.

这座城市立于沼泽间的细碎小岛之上，湿软的地势一路抬升，渐渐过渡到更干燥的平原。部分水道两侧砌着石墙与码头，楼宇与纪念碑紧贴其上。桥梁横跨这些主运河；而在低矮的支流处，行人与车马多直接涉水而过，并无人工架设的通道。人迹稀少之处，睡莲、芦苇与杂草疯长成片，水禽成群聚集，叽喳喧嚷、嘎嘎长鸣。靠近沼泽的几座建筑显出常年受淹的痕迹，另一些则危险地向湿地一侧倾斜。少数地方，崩塌墙垣的残段或一尊失落雕像的双眼，从水面之上隐隐探出。

~ 由一位英雄构想

The city stands on islets amid marshy land that rises to a drier plain. Stone walls and jetties line some waterways, with buildings and monuments abutting them. Bridges cross these main canals, but along the low streams, pedestrians and vehicles ford them without artificial crossings. Where little traffic flows, lilies, reeds, and weeds grow thick, and waterfowl gather, chattering and honking. Some edifices nearer the swamp show signs of regular flooding, while others lean dangerously toward the wetland. In a few places, the crumbling remains of a wall or the eyes of a lost statue peek above the water.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Clockwork Entity Approaching.name:
发条构装体逼近
Clockwork Entity Approaching

Text.text:
一阵喧嚣钻入你耳中，节奏分明又尖厉刺耳，伴随着叮当的撞击声与嘶嘶作响的爆裂噼啪。听起来仿佛织工的织机与风车正纠缠起舞。你凝神细听，那吵闹声愈发高涨——速度与音量一并攀升——仿佛那制造噪音之物正逼近而来。
A clamor reaches your ears, rhythmic and whining, accompanied by clanks and a hissing crackle. It sounds as if a weaver’s loom and a windmill have engaged in a dance. As you listen, the racket increases—in speed and volume—as if whatever makes the noise approaches.

Heavy Rain In The Jungle.name:
丛林暴雨
Heavy Rain In The Jungle

Text.text:
猴子、鸟类、昆虫与其他生灵的尖啸声，早已在倾盆大雨的余波中消散殆尽。湿气裹住空气，浓稠得如同泥沼。藤蔓与覆叶的枝条在雨幕中剧烈颤跳——成片的雨水穿过林冠，像沉重的布帘般坠落。
The shrieks of monkeys, birds, insects, and other creatures have long since died in the wake of the downpour. Humidity cloaks the air, dense as a mire. Vines and leafy boughs bounce violently with the swathes of rain falling like heavy sheets through the canopy.

Three Charging Cyclopes.name:
三头冲锋独眼巨人
Three Charging Cyclopes

Text.text:
高耸的独眼巨人翻上沙丘之巅，随即拔腿狂奔，带着骇人的凶戾从坡上直冲向你。咆哮从他们唇间迸出，他们将带刺的巨棒挥过头顶，不顾一切地一头扎进混战之中。

~ 构想：Elliott Crawford

The towering cyclopes crest the dune and break into a run, charging downhill toward you with a monstrous ferocity. Roars escape their lips as they wave barbed clubs over their heads and charge headlong into the melee.

~ Envisioned by Elliott Crawford

一团刺鼻的黄色气泡在你掌心膨胀：从豌豆大小迅速长到近似南瓜。气泡下三分之一处有些泛绿的液体来回荡漾。你吐出一个奥秘的单词，唇间喷出一口气息，将这颗球体吹向目标——它在那儿啪地炸裂，溅出滋滋作响的酸液。
A noxious yellow bubble grows in your palm: from pea-sized to something more like a pumpkin. A greenish liquid sloshes about in the bottom third of the bubble. A single arcane word expels a puff of breath from your lips and blows the orb toward the target—where it pops, splattering sizzling acid.

Quip By Underground Dweller About The Sk.name:
地底居民对天空的俏皮话
Quip By Underground Dweller About The Sky

Text.text:
“当我回到地表时，我以为会看到美景、落日与澄澈的蓝天。可每次抬头望向那悬在我们头顶的空洞深渊，我只会因它的浩瀚而惊恐，仿佛终有一天，我会被它拽上去。”
“When I came above ground, I expected beauty, sunsets, and clear blue skies. But every time I look up into the empty abyss that hangs over us, I only feel panic at its enormity, as if one day I will be pulled up into it.”

Thermal Imaging Goggles.name:
热成像护目镜
Thermal Imaging Goggles

Text.text:
这副虫眼般的护目镜满是划痕，却依旧可用。透过这样的镜片，夜色会蜕变成一幅由热信号绘成的画布，谜团与威胁一并显形。在霓虹与铬光扭曲交织的丛林里，这样的科技是那些在黑暗中狩猎之人的生命线。
These bug-like glasses are scratched but usable. Through such lenses, the night mutates into a canvas of heat signatures, revealing enigma and threat alike. In the twisted jungle of neon and chrome, such tech is a lifeline for those who hunt in the darkness.

蕨类蔓延铺满整片林间空地，高耸在幼树之上；那些幼苗在巨影之下拼命向着更远处的光伸展。浓密的翠绿羽叶在这株庞然大物上如孔雀开屏般迸然舒展，绒羽般的叶片沐浴在正午炽烈的阳光里。
The fern spreads across the entire glade, towering above the saplings desperately seeking light beyond the giant’s shadow. Lush expanses of green plumage erupt like a peacock’s fan across the enormous plant, the feathery leaves basking in the blazing midday sun.

你将注意力集中在你与同伴所佩戴的那对银戒上，便感觉彼此的生命力仿佛被一条无形的系绳牵引，向对方伸展而去。
Focusing on the pair of silver rings worn by you and your companion, you feel your life forces extend toward one another as if by an invisible tether.

Demon-corrupted Dragon.name:
恶魔腐化的巨龙
Demon-corrupted Dragon

Text.text:
“你们竟敢闯入我的疆域，凡人？”那声音低沉刺耳，在昏暗中回荡，同时从四面八方压来。空气骤然变冷，你们的呼吸化作雾白；一头臃肿恶臭的生物用扭曲畸形的肢体拖拽着自己，从黑暗里爬出，破烂的残翼在尘土中拖曳。阴影从它覆鳞的皮肉上滴落，像油一样在洞窟地面汇成一滩；它的眼睛猛然睁开，燃着深渊般的饥渴。“我会享受看着你们的血肉从骨头上融化，你们的灵魂在火中灼烧。”

~ Envisioned by Camel

“You dare enter my realm, mortals?” The words—low and grating—echo around you in the gloom, coming from every direction simultaneously. The air grows cold, and breath mists like fog, as the bloated, repugnant creature drags itself from the darkness on warped and twisted limbs, tattered remnants of wings trailing in the dirt. Shadows drip from its scaly flesh, pooling on the cave floor like oil, and eyes burning with abyssal hunger flick open. “I will enjoy watching the flesh melt from your bones as your souls burn.”

~ Envisioned by Camel

A Disarming Maneuver In Combat.name:
战斗中的缴械招式
A Disarming Maneuver In Combat

Text.text: 冒险尝试高难度的动作，而不是更稳妥的选择，这份风险对你来说值得。刹那间，你可能失手、挨上一击，甚至受致命伤。但只要你足够机敏、迅捷、强健——对手的武器就会脱手飞出。 [成功] 这一次，奏效了：你听见那令人畅快的声响——他们的武器落在某处——也看见你的目标脸上掠过的震惊。战局在一瞬间改写，或许就此换来一场不见血的投降。 Taking a chance on a difficult maneuver versus a safer one is worth the risk to you. For one moment, you might fail, be struck, or even receive a mortal wound. But, if you’re clever and quick and strong enough—there goes your opponent’s weapon. [Success] This time, it works: you hear the satisfying sound of their weapon landing somewhere and see the shock on your target’s face. The fight changes in an instant, perhaps to a bloodless surrender.

I Cast Plane Shift From My Amulet Of The.name:
我从我的位面护符施放位面转移
I Cast Plane Shift From My Amulet Of The Planes

Text.text:
我们可能会落到任何地方——不管是被那道粗暴的法术卷走，还是被这件物体牵引——即便我明明知道我们该去哪里。我在脑海里想着那个地方，把它描绘得清清楚楚，然后彬彬有礼地向护身符发问，仿佛它就是我们的马车夫。我感觉它苏醒过来，从这个维度探出触须，伸向另一个世界。
We could wind up anywhere, whether by the raw spell or this object—and even though I know where we ought to be going. I think of the place, picture it, then ask politely of the amulet, as if it were our carriage driver. I feel it come to life, reaching out of this dimension to another realm.

Coup De Grace With Short Blade.name:
以短刃赐予致命一击
Coup De Grace With Short Blade

Text.text:
敌人已完全任你宰割，你单膝跪地，将刀尖刺入第四与第五根肋骨之间。随即一道迅疾的横斩，干净利落地将那艰难搏动的心脏一分为二。
With your enemy fully at your mercy, you drop to one knee and drive the point of your blade between the fourth and fifth rib. A quick slashing motion efficiently slices the laboring heart in twain.

一面由金属构成的网格挡住了前路，这道防御工事深深嵌入凹槽之中。格栅墙的另一侧，通道仍在延伸，但眼下看不出任何通行的办法。你试着迅速抬起落闸门，立刻就感受到这精工锻造的金属沉重而稳固，纹丝不动。
A grid of metal blocks the way forward, the fortification set deep into grooves. The passage continues on the other side of the latticed wall, but there's no obvious way through. A quick attempt to lift the portcullis proves the heft and stability of the well-crafted metal.

Cemetery In The Daylight.name:
白昼墓园
Cemetery In The Daylight

Text.text:
一束束阳光为这片广袤墓园的墓碑镀上光辉，你恍惚间沉入一幅宁静的画面。因为在这里——这座亡者的居所——唯一的声响，只有偶尔的乌鸦啼鸣，以及柔风拂过时草叶轻轻摇曳。置身此地，人几乎会相信，逝者无论生前曾遭受何等不安，终能在此安然休息。
Rays of sunlight bathe the headstones of the sprawling cemetery with radiance, and for a moment you are lost in a tableau of peace. For here, in this dwelling of the dead, the only sound is an occasional crow call and the blades of grass shifting in the gentle breeze. Here, one might believe that the departed rest in peace, regardless of the disquiets they experienced in life.

整个夏天里，那些翠绿的藤蔓攀爬蔓生，结出一颗颗圆润饱满的小果实；如今却变得陌生而逼人。黄绿的果头膨胀成巨物，别说盘子，连桌面都放不下。它们的茎秆坚韧，深刻的棱脊与厚皮护着一股泥土般的精魂；到了夜里——尤其在橘色月光之下——那感觉像被什么注视着。每一个似乎都渴望一张脸。
What all summer was the green, leafy vining and growing of little fat fruits now feels strange, imposing. The yellow-green heads have grown into giants that don’t fit on a table, let alone a plate. Their stems are tough, and their deep ribs and hides protect an earthly spirit that, by night—especially under an orange moon—makes you feel watched. Each of them seems to crave a face.

Fatigued Educator.name:
疲惫的教导者
Fatigued Educator

Text.text:
饱受折磨的教师恼怒地揉着眼睛，管束这群无法无天的班级所带来的压力终于让他们不堪重负。尽管当初驱使他们投身这份职业的炽热激情已黯淡成余烬，它仍未熄灭，仍让他们一次次回来塑造心灵与思想——哪怕要以自身的安康为代价。
The beleaguered teacher rubs their eyes with exasperation as the stress of managing the unruly class takes its toll. Though the fiery passion that drove them to pursue this vocation has dulled to an ember, it still remains and keeps them coming back to shape hearts and minds—even at the cost of their well-being.

Aliard Stormbringer.name:
阿里亚德·风暴召者
Aliard Stormbringer

Text.text:
商队抵达。阿利亚德翻身下马，他那笨重的护甲将高大、肌肉虬结的身躯塑成一团雷云。他从骑枪挂架上取下长枪，又将背后的盾牌甩到臂上。指尖一触，紫蓝色的电光便从边缘噼啪跃起，短促分叉，宛如细小的枝杈。他掀起黑色头盔的面甲——其上长着向后弯曲的角——露出满是疤痕的脸，以及那双盛着冰冷暴戾与屠戮回忆的眼睛。

~ Played by RuralWarrior

The caravan arrives. Aliard dismounts, his bulky armor transforming a tall and heavily-muscled frame into a thundercloud. He takes his spear from its cavalry holder, then swings his shield from his back. When he touches them, purple-blue shocks of lightning jump in short, branching arcs from their edges. He raises the visor of his black helmet—with backward-curving horns—revealing his scarred face and eyes full of cold violence and memories of carnage.

~ Played by RuralWarrior

Magical Detection Of A Paladin's Class.name:
圣武士职业的魔法侦测
Magical Detection Of A Paladin's Class

Text.text:
一道光芒明亮而短促地闪过，随即，一串只有你能看见的粼粼辉光自你的目标头顶倾泻而下，直至脚尖，继而悄然消散。
A light flashes brightly and briefly, then a cascade of shimmering light only you can see runs down your target from head to toe before disappearing.

入口拱门外侧的天花板已经塌落，将房间西半部塞满了泛红的沙砾、惨白的碎石瓦砾，以及破碎陶器的残片。檀香气息浓烈，混杂着草药与油脂的味道。完好的墙面旁一字排开陶罐与石匣，有的仍封着口，有的依旧紧闭。
The ceiling has fallen beyond the entry arch here, filling the western half of the room with reddish sand, white rubble, and debris from broken pottery. The smell of sandalwood is strong, mingled with the scents of herbs and oil. Clay jars and stone coffers, still sealed or closed, line the intact walls.

Badly Rusted Robotic Janitor With Mop.name:
锈蚀得一塌糊涂的机器人清洁工，手握拖把
Badly Rusted Robotic Janitor With Mop

Text.text:
机器人清洁工拖着拖把来回摩擦，锈屑如雪花般簌簌飘落；古老的铰链在用力时发出吱呀的呻吟。它的动作一顿一挫，像只只上了半截发条的玩具，所做的一切都慢得令人煎熬。你带着一丝怜悯的笑意意识到，这名清洁工很可能还要花上好几个小时，去清理从自己身上掉落的锈迹。
Flakes of rust fall like snowflakes from the robotic janitor as it drags the mop back and forth, ancient hinges creaking with effort. The custodian’s movements are jerky, like a partially wound-up toy, and everything it does is agonizingly slow. With a pitying smile you realize the janitor will probably be cleaning up its own rust for hours to come.

环绕这处谷地的陡峭山坡，以及几乎不见高大植被的贫瘠景象，已是最初的线索——而谷底中央那条蜿蜒、遍布碎石的行迹，则彻底印证了这一点。整座山谷其实是一道冲沟：每逢雨季或暴风骤至，便会被湍急的流水灌满。
The precipitous hills around this vale, and its lack of large vegetation, present the first clues—but the wending, gravelly track at its center confirms it. The whole valley is a gulch that fills with fast-flowing water during seasonal rains or sudden storms.

瀑布被完美地冻结住了——仿佛飞流直下的一瞬被拍成定格，时间在此停顿。冰层呈蓝白色，带着令人心悸的寒意，被刺骨的冰雾笼罩，直耸入空，足有数十层楼高，直达水流曾越过峭壁、倾泻而下的顶端。它让人想起一座城堡，高大而不可攻破，墙垣仿佛为经受时代、天气与围攻的磨砺而筑。冰中凝出了诡异的形状，你几乎敢发誓其中有些像生物，甚至像人形——可那一定只是光影的戏法。
The waterfall stands perfectly frozen—a snapshot of a cascading fall, a moment paused in time. The ice is blue-white, hauntingly cold, and shrouded in a frigid mist, towering dozens of stories into the air to where the water rolled over the cliffs to cascade downward. It evokes a castle, tall and impenetrable, its walls built to withstand the rigors of time, weather, and siege. Strange shapes have formed within the ice, and you swear some resemble creatures, or even humanoids—but it must be a trick of the light.

Loot From An Adult Bronze Dragon.name:
成年青铜龙的战利品
Loot From An Adult Bronze Dragon

Text.text:
终于被击败，青铜巨龙倒卧在拍岸的碎浪间，浪花被它的鲜血染红。你踝没于水中，在那庞大的尸身上搜寻任何值钱之物。不远处，它曾凶狠死守的岩石已被砸得粉碎，露出一大堆隐秘的异域珍珠。
Finally defeated, the bronze dragon lies among the breakers, the waves stained with its blood. Ankle deep in water, you search the massive corpse for anything of value. Nearby, the rocks it was so viciously defending have been smashed, revealing a large, hidden pile of exotic pearls.

Necromantic Engineer’s Laboratory.name:
死灵工程师的实验室
Necromantic Engineer’s Laboratory

Text.text:
科学与奥术在工匠阴郁的实验室里纠缠，在一场阴森的舞步中相互撕扯，死亡的气息灌满每一处昏暗的角落。嶙峋的水晶搏动着令人作呕的绿光，闪电在嵌入献祭台的锃亮铜杆之间狂怒地跳跃。不论这里进行着何等亵渎的仪式，它都违背了自然与魔法的每一条法则。

~ 由 Discord 上的 CrunchyZombies 构想

Science tangles with the arcane in the macabre dance of the artificer’s gloomy laboratory, and elements of death fill every shadowed corner. Jagged crystals pulse with a nauseating green light, and lightning arcs furiously between gleaming copper rods set into a sacrificial table. Whatever blasphemous practices take place here, it is against every law of nature and magic.

~ Envisioned by CrunchyZombies on Discord

I Release The Trebuchet.name:
我放出投石机
I Release The Trebuchet

Text.text:
“净空！”我一边大喊，一边抓起释放绳——绳端系着一枚金属钩，正牢牢扣住投石机的配重，使其悬停不落。等其他人小跑着撤到攻城武器弹道之外的安全距离，我猛地一拽，将那金属钩硬生生扯脱。木与铁一齐呻吟作响，配重腾空而起，带动横梁位置骤然翻转。皮革投索沿着抹了油的滑槽拖曳而过，随即猛甩，将那枚圆滚滚的石弹抛向开阔的天空。眼看它越过战场，朝我们的目标飞去，我立刻喊其他人装填。
“Clear!” I shout as I pick up the releasing rope, its end tied to a metal hook keeping the trebuchet’s counterweight in place. Once the others have jogged to a safe distance from the siege weapon’s trajectory, I yank the metal hook out of place. The wood and metal creak as the counterweight rises into the air, shifting the position of the beam. The leather sling drags along the greased chute and then flings the rounded rock into the open sky. As it sails over the battlefield toward our mark, I call for the others to reload.

Crazed Pirate Lord.name:
癫狂的海盗领主
Crazed Pirate Lord

Text.text:
硝烟翻卷成呛人的毒云，缠绕着那狂笑、目眦欲裂的海盗；他的黑胡子被战火燎焦，血迹斑斑。他踏过满地残骸，步伐从容得像是生来就与暴力和冲突为伍——而那份令人不寒而栗的热忱，更添骇人。

~ 构想：Sahlonahl（Discord）

Gunsmoke swirls in noxious clouds around the cackling, wild-eyed pirate, his black beard charred and bloodied from the combat. He strides through the carnage with the confidence of one born into violence and conflict—and unnerving enthusiasm.

~ Envisioned by Sahlonahl on Discord

Amulet Of Health.name:
健康护符
Amulet Of Health

Text.text:
这枚金质护身符虽价值昭然，却不显浮华刺目。它是一件椭圆形的小饰物，外形酷似一颗解剖学意义上的心脏；繁复的金丝花纹如血管与蜿蜒纤维般交织，铺陈在其熠熠生辉的表面。
This golden amulet, despite its obvious value, doesn’t appear gaudy nor garish. An oblong trinket, it resembles an anatomical heart in shape, with intricate gold filigree evoking veins and sinuous fibers across its gleaming surface.

Artist's Cottage.name:
艺术家的小屋
Artist's Cottage

Text.text:
一摞摞防尘布、木屑与揉皱的纸张堆成这间居所癫狂般的杂乱。地板上斑斑点点溅着颜料，有些飞溅得竟像刻意为之，喷洒出悦目的纹样。厨房区域里，凡是能空出一块的台面上都摆着罐子与马克杯，画笔浸泡其中。透过窗户望向花园，你看见一截竖立的木料正被雕琢成一只咧嘴笑的熊。
Piles of drop cloth, wood chips, and crumpled papers make up the crazed clutter of the dwelling. Paint flecks the floor in spots and splashes, some actually appearing intentional as they spray out in pleasant designs. Brushes soak in jars and mugs on any free surface in the kitchen area. Through the window, in the garden, you see that an upright chunk of wood is in the process of being formed into the image of a grinning bear.

Tavern Brawl: Tavern Ambience.name:
酒馆斗殴：酒馆氛围
Tavern Brawl: Tavern Ambience

Text.text:
这间酒馆像是与外头世界隔绝的一方温暖港湾，炉火般的暖意与木香交织，令人不由得放松下来。客人们或低声闲谈，或独自小酌，乐师指尖流淌的巧妙旋律为这份亲切氛围添上几分温柔。吧台后，一位胡茬斑白的老板正为客人拉着一杯啤酒；他抬眼朝你露出一个欢迎的笑意，随即又转回去招呼他的客人。
This tavern seems a warm and cozy respite from the world outside. Patrons make quiet conversation or enjoy a drink in solitude, the artful playing of musicians adding to the welcoming ambience. A grizzled tavern keeper stands behind the bar drawing a pint, but he smiles a welcome in your direction before turning back to his customer.

Transfer Of A Spell From A Scroll To A S.name:
将卷轴上的法术转录进法术书
Transfer Of A Spell From A Scroll To A Spellbook

Text.text:
尽管每一道法术影响魔法织网的方式都相同，法师用来理解这道法术的路径却各不相同。仿佛法术是拨动空气中绷紧的魔法之弦奏出的一个音符，但每位法师都会打造自己的乐器，并发明属于自己的乐谱记号。你钻研这道法术已久，强烈的脑力消耗让你汗如雨下；而此刻，你觉得自己终于理解得足够透彻，能够用你自己的体系将它誊写下来。
While an individual spell affects the weave of magic in the same way, the means a wizard uses to understand the spell varies. It’s as if the spell is a note played by strumming the magic strung in the air, but every wizard builds their own instrument and invents their own musical notation. You’ve been studying this spell so long you’re sweating with the intense intellectual effort, but now you think you have enough of an understanding to transcribe it using your own systems.

Sundries From A Werewolf Child.name:
来自狼孩的杂物
Sundries From A Werewolf Child

Text.text:
在男孩那点寒酸的家当里，你找到一名木制玩具士兵、一块沾满齿痕的生肉、一些面包，以及一个漏水的水袋。他确实活下来了——但也仅仅是勉强撑着。
Among the boy’s meager belongings you find a wooden toy soldier, a chunk of raw meat covered with bite marks, some bread, and a leaky water skin. He was surviving, but not by much.

Loot From An Owlbear.name:
来自枭熊的战利品
Loot From An Owlbear

Text.text:
你绕着这头倒毙的巨兽踱步查看，发现它那层羽毛般的皮毛——暴风般的灰色间杂着羽端点点银光——并未留下太多伤痕。兽皮坚韧得惊人，刀刃要费尽力气才能刺入，再沿着生物的身躯一路向下割开。将近一小时的劳作后，你手里只剩下一张华美的枭熊皮毛；等你把它拖到合适的商人面前，必定能卖出个好价格。
Walking around the fallen monstrosity, you see that its feathered pelt—a stormy-gray color mingling with flecks of silver on the feathers—doesn’t bear too many wounds. The hide is tough to cut through, taking a mighty effort to dig into with a blade and then drag down the length of the creature. After nearly an hour of work, you are left with a beautiful owlbear pelt that will most certainly fetch a good price once you haul it to the right merchant.

The Reaver’s Rest.name:
掠夺者的休息处
The Reaver’s Rest

Text.text:
一块招牌被钉在建筑侧面的镰刀团团围住，宣告这家旅店名为“掠夺者的休息”。它那高耸、刷成白色的正面墙上开着许多狭窄的窗户，仿佛在暗示里面尽是逼仄的小房间。然而外观干净利落，粗壮的门两侧垂挂着种满鲜花的吊篮，将门框点缀得生机盎然。
A sign surrounded by sickles nailed to the building’s side declares this inn “The Reaver’s Rest.” Its tall, whitewashed façade has many narrow windows, promising small rooms. But it looks tidy, and hanging baskets planted with flowers frame the stout door.

I Throw My Iron Bands Of Binding At My T.name:
我将束缚铁索掷向我的目标
I Throw My Iron Bands Of Binding At My Target

Text.text:
效果令人震撼：我将铁球掷向对手，它先沿着寻常的弧线飞行，直到我念出命令词。随即伴着刺耳的金属摩擦声猛然膨胀。金属箍带如巨掌般张开，朝着我的目标坠落，随时准备合拢，将其紧紧束缚。
The effect is impressive: the iron ball I throw at my opponent following a normal arc until I speak the command word. Then it suddenly expands with rasp of metal. The bands open like a great hand and fall toward my target, ready to close and restrain.

Elf Woman Riding Hippogriff.name:
骑乘角鹰兽的精灵女子
Elf Woman Riding Hippogriff

Text.text:
一名精灵优雅地骑乘在翱翔的狮鹫之上，她修长飘逸的长发在风中翻卷飞舞。那双如蓝宝石般的眼眸锐利如天穹，俯瞰着疾驰而过的世界。精灵与坐骑之间的羁绊牢不可破，他们一同破空而行，宛如自由与绝对和谐的化身。
An elf gracefully rides atop a soaring hippogriff, her long, flowing hair billowing in the wind. Sapphire eyes as keen as the sky survey the world as it rushes past. The bond between elf and mount is unbreakable as they cut through the air together, a vision of freedom and absolute harmony.

Wealthy Investor.name:
富有的投资人
Wealthy Investor

Text.text:
这位富豪投资人的成套西装上，那件量身裁制的丝绸外套，随便一卖就足以付下一大块农田的首付；他一顿午餐的花销，也能资助锻造一把魔法武器。然而这名高等精灵仍几乎对所有与他打过照面的人都能挑出毛病，仿佛把一个忘恩负义的世界的重担，硬生生扛在他瘦削的肩头。
The tailored silk coat of the wealthy investor’s suit could easily pay the down payment on a sizable plot of farmland, and his luncheon could finance the forging of a magical weapon, yet the high elf still manages to find fault with virtually everyone he comes in contact with, as if holding the weight of an ungrateful world on his slim shoulders.

怎么也绕不开——这是一只足有一百五十磅重的蜘蛛。这头巨型蛛形生物的第一处怪异之处，是它竟长着一对类人般的手臂与手掌。第二处、也更令人不安的异样，则来自它的凝视。魔法自它那黑色、玻璃般的眼睛里辐射而出，仿佛能说服你、引诱你、安抚你。它怪异的双手在锋利的螯肢旁施展咒术，蜘蛛随即开始蜕变，朝着更接近人类的形态转化。
No getting around it, this is a hundred-fifty-pound spider. The first oddity of the giant arachnid is its pair of humanoid arms and hands. The next and far more upsetting strangeness is the spider’s gaze. Magic radiates from its black, glassy eyes, as if it might convince you of something, entice you, calm you. Its weird hands work spellcraft around its sharp mandibles, and the spider begins its transformation toward a more human form.

The Ogre's Family.name:
食人魔的一家
The Ogre's Family

Text.text:
你跟着那两名肤色黝黑的小个子商人钻进灌木丛。树旁环绕的灌木上方八码左右的高处，一座树屋的阴影里，有四只黄色的眼睛一路盯着你的动向。你听见一声粗哼，树屋猛地一晃，竟突然从树干旁侧开！伴着两声沉重的闷响，一个足有九英尺高的人形巨物踏前一步。“找到食物了？”它用低沉沙哑、像砂砾摩擦般的嗓音问道。“是的，找到食物！”更尖细的声音从那间休息在食人魔肩上的棚屋里回荡出来。
You follow the two small dark-skinned traders into the bush. Four sets of yellow eyes follow your progress from the shadows of a treehouse about eight feet up, just above the bushes surrounding the tree. You hear a grunt and the treehouse suddenly lurches away from the tree! There are two heavy thumps as a nine-foot-tall humanoid steps forward. "Found food?" it asks in a deep gravelly voice. "Yes, found food!" The higher-pitched voices echo from the shack resting on the ogre's shoulders.

Walled Town Bisected By River.name:
被河流一分为二的城墙小镇
Walled Town Bisected By River

Text.text:
石砌高墙环抱着聚落，坚实的轮廓上仅有寥寥几处缺口。一道铁制闸门为徒步旅人或商队车队提供出入口，城中另设两道水闸，让河水得以自由穿城而过。越过城门，迎面便是商贸重镇惯有的喧腾。连绵不绝的声响为空气注入活力：脚掌、利爪与蹄铁在卵石街面上清脆作响，车轮吱呀呻吟，摊贩高声叫卖。河水在水闸的精细调度下缓缓穿行城中，于是贡多拉得以载人来往，而不必担心被一旁悠然浮荡的大型商船掀翻；那些商船的货物则被绷紧的帆布薄幕严密遮护。
Walls of stone surround the settlement, with just a few breaks in its stalwart frame. An iron portcullis serves as the entrance for travelers on foot or by caravan, and there are two sluices for the river to run freely through the city. Past the gate, you find the customary bustle of a commercial hub. Constant sound vitalizes the air: foot, claw, and hoof clicking against the cobblestone streets, cart wheels creaking, and vendors hollering. The river runs slowly through the city by careful management of the sluices, so gondolas can ferry people without the risk of being turned over by the larger mercantile boats bobbing at casual pace beside them, their goods protected by a taut veil of canvas.

Sharks In Kelp Forest.name:
海带森林中的鲨影
Sharks In Kelp Forest

Text.text:
目光不眨，这些线条流畅的生物在林间游弋，海带叶拂过它们粗糙的皮肤。间或，吻端转向近旁的鱼群，行进轨迹既锐利又沉稳。直到最后一刻，尾巴才猛然狂甩，将它们疾射进起伏翻涌的鱼群之中。若是准头不差，一张大张的巨口便攫住一尾扭动的猎物——参差的尖牙随即咬合，令一团漆黑的体液在它们嘴边的水中弥散开来。
Eyes unblinking, the sleek creatures swim through the forest, kelp leaves brushing over their rough skin. Intermittently, snouts turn toward the school of fish nearby, their trajectory pointed yet steady. At the last moment, tails whip wildly to shoot them through the undulating school. If their aim is true, a gaping maw snatches a wriggling prize—and jagged teeth chomp down, sending a cloud of dark ichor into the water about their mouths.

Speech By A Paladin About A Crisis Of Fa.name:
一名圣武士关于信仰危机的演说
Speech By A Paladin About A Crisis Of Faith

Text.text:
“我一直努力为人效劳，为神圣的正义而战；而神祇赐予我的恩宠与力量，远超我最疯狂的想象。然而，当我望见四周蔓延的苦难，我不禁想问：为何我必须成为他们唯一的施恩者？为何他们以为，这世界的沉疴会被剑的正义治愈，而非慈善的宁静抚平？”
“I’ve always tried to be of service, to fight for the righteousness of the divine, and the gods have gifted me with favor and power beyond my wildest imagination. Yet, when I look at all the misery surrounding me, I wonder, why must I be their sole benefactor? Why do they think this world’s ills will be cured by the righteousness of the sword and not the serenity of charity?”

迎面扑来的气味，让你同时想起被烈日烤得发烫的石头，以及暴风雨将至前那股沉闷的空气。你眼前的生物同样诡异地混合在一起：半是巨蛇，半是鳄鱼——却长着多得离谱的腿与獠牙。青蓝色鳞片下，紧绷的肌肉如波般起伏；蛇一般的眼睛阴沉地盯着你，透出一种粗陋却不容小觑的智慧。
The smell that greets you recalls both sun-burnt stone and the air before an incoming storm. The creature you see is a similarly strange mix: part serpent, part crocodile—with far too many legs and fangs. Sinewy muscle ripples under its bluish scales, and its snake-like eyes brood with a crude intelligence.

Android Serves Refreshments On Starship.name:
仿生人于星舰上奉上茶点
Android Serves Refreshments On Starship

Text.text:
一群杂七杂八的飞行员、技师与工程师瘫在低矮的橙色沙发里，沙发圆鼓鼓、松软得像充气般鼓胀。一个光滑的、粉色的中性身影走了进来，用一根纤细的手指稳稳托着一只沉重的饮料托盘，平衡得无可挑剔。它的皮肤无缝无痕——看不见一丝皱褶或瑕疵——身体完全对称；它沉默不语，以舞者般柔韧而精准的动作分发饮料。船员们接过那一杯杯咕嘟冒泡、嘶嘶起沫的浅粉色饮料，仰头灌下。
A motley crew of pilots, technicians, and engineers slump in low orange couches, bulbous and puffy. A smooth, pink, androgynous figure enters, expertly balancing a heavy tray of drinks on one slender finger. Its skin is seamless—not a wrinkle or blemish in sight—its body entirely symmetrical; unspeaking, it hands out drinks with the lithe, precise movements of a dancer. Crewmembers take the bubbling, fizzing glasses of pastel pink and slug them down.

Poorly-attended Tournament.name:
冷清的比武大会
Poorly-attended Tournament

Text.text:
人们搓着双手取暖，神情阴郁；几条壮实的身影零星散在几近空荡的看台上。穷困的骑士骑着脊背下塌的马儿勉力讨好，可这寒酸的把戏却怎么也点不燃人群。唯一笑得出来的只有叫卖的小贩——无聊的观众把钱大把砸在麦酒和肉馅饼上。
Rubbing their hands together to keep warm, faces glum, a few robust souls dot the almost empty stands. Impoverished knights on sway-backed horses attempt to please, but the crowd cannot be lifted by their tawdry display. The only folk smiling are the hawkers—as bored spectators overspend on ale and pies.

Xalvador \"Peace-sake\" Hakisson.name:
萨尔瓦多·“和平缘故”·哈基森
Xalvador "Peace-sake" Hakisson

Text.text:
一个七英尺高的兽人男子跺步闯入视线，脚踝上系着巨大的木铃铛，叮当作响。他从獠牙到脚趾都披着张扬的行头，东拼西凑自世界各个角落：一件前襟敞开的燕尾服，露出紧紧束在躯干上的黑色束身衣；外套之上还罩着一件马甲，肩头钉着如铁齿般的尖刺；喇叭形的袖口与裤管让他那伤痕累累的双手与赤裸的双脚都能毫无拘束地移动——整个人竟像一位僧舞者。再加上这身装束、他灿烂耀眼的笑容、狂野的绿发与暗涌的紫眸，他是独一无二、令人惊叹的奇景。

~ Played by a Hero

A seven-foot-tall orcish man stomps into view, with large wooden bells clanging about his ankles. He wears flamboyant garb from tusk to toe, disparate pieces collected from every corner of the world: a tailcoat kept open in the front, revealing a black corset tightly bound around his torso; a vest over the coat, its shoulders spiked with iron teeth; and flared sleeves and pants that allow uninhibited movement of his scarred hands and bare feet—all giving him the look of a monk dancer. With this ensemble, his brilliant smile, wild green hair, and simmering purple eyes, he is a unique and wondrous sight to behold.

~ Played by a Hero

一条小径从大道旁岔出，被无数靴底踏得草皮低伏。它尽头是一片空地，绿与褐各占一半，裸露的泥土在草间点点斑驳，如同雀斑。空地尽头，大地在一道陡峭的断崖前骤然消失。
A trail leads off the main road, beaten into the grass by countless boots. It ends in a clearing that’s equal parts green and brown, exposed dirt dotting the grass like freckles. At the far end of the field the ground disappears at a steep cliff.

Snakes Bursting From Corpse.name:
尸身裂开，群蛇迸涌而出
Snakes Bursting From Corpse

Text.text:
你一靠近，精灵的躯体便开始扭动痉挛。伴随着一声令人作呕的撕裂响——仿佛羊皮纸被硬生生扯开——一群浑身裹满血肉的蛇猛然破体而出。它们在恶臭的脏器间盘绕游窜，令那具尸身抽搐跳动，像一具骇人的提线木偶。
The elf’s body writhes upon your approach. A sickening rip sounds out, much like tearing parchment, and a swarm of gore-covered snakes bursts through. They coil and slither among the stinking organs, causing the body to jerk and move like a hideous puppet.

Luxury Hair Products.name:
奢华护发品
Luxury Hair Products

Text.text:
芬兰-韩国的巨型企业、南美的生态制药集团、以及南极洲的冷冻实验室，都在兜售奢华护发的绝对终极。货架上的每一瓶都在争抢你的目光——或闪耀、或悬浮、或播放维瓦尔第的《暴风雨》——每一种外观都是现代艺术的作品，光滑起伏的曲线暗示着其中潜藏的力量。使用者接触的一瞬，一道赭色薄雾的细线划出弧光，随即将头发塑成所需的形态。
Finnish-Korean megacorps, South American ecopharmas, and Antarctica’s freezelabs all tout the absolute ultimate in luxury hair care. Each bottle on the shelves vies for your attention—glimmering or hovering or playing Vivaldi’s Storm—and each design is a work of modern art, with smooth undulating curves hinting at the power within. At the touch of the user, a thin line of ochre mist arcs out morphing the hair into a desired form.

房间尽头矗立着一座宏伟的木制阶段；两侧垂落的深红色大帷幕用一条蓝色织物束起。阶段的木面打磨得光洁如镜，映出无数油灯与天窗洒下的光辉。阶段下方，数十把座椅整齐划一地排成行，立在粗糙的红色地毯之上。分隔座椅的过道一直通向后方出口。
A grand wooden stage sits at the far end of the room; large deep-red drapes hanging from each side are bound by a length of blue fabric. The wood of the stage is polished and smooth, reflecting the light of the many oil lamps and skylight. Below the stage, dozens of seats sit perfectly aligned in rows atop a rough red carpet. Aisles separating the chairs lead to the back exit.

Sleepy Guard.name:
昏昏欲睡的守卫
Sleepy Guard

Text.text:
守卫打了个哈欠，抬手含蓄地掩住嘴。他们目光空洞地盯着空间，缓缓眨了一次长长的眼，然后又打了个哈欠，这回连掩嘴都懒得做。你也不由得跟着张开下颌，嘴角被牵得发酸。
The guard yawns, raising a hand to discreetly cover their mouth. They stare into space, blink a long blink, and then yawn again, this time not bothering to cover their mouth. You find your own jaw stretching in response.

Skeletal Victim Of Spike Trap.name:
尖刺陷阱的骸骨受害者
Skeletal Victim Of Spike Trap

Text.text:
一幕阴惨的景象映入眼帘：一名曾被地底防御夺命的受害者，被染血的尖刺钉穿，动弹不得。早已干涸的血迹滋生出一层霉绿的包浆，骸骨仍蜷缩着贴在陷阱边，仿佛痛楚未散。离他枯指仅差几寸处，一尊闪耀的金色神像静静躺着——这不幸亡魂猝死的显而易见的祸因。
A grim scene meets your eyes, a past victim of the underworld’s defenses transfixed by blood-stained spikes. A patina of mold has grown from the shed blood that’s long since dried, the skeletal remains curled about the trap as if still in pain. Inches from their grasp, a gleaming gold idol rests, the obvious cause of this unfortunate soul’s untimely demise.

Arrival At The Deserted Green Box.name:
抵达那座荒弃的绿匣
Arrival At The Deserted Green Box

Text.text:
空洞的寂静啃噬着你的心智，在你逐渐黯淡的思绪里回响。你眯起眼，试图看穿此地的诡异。一座被氧化的钢铁巨石自小行星弯曲的地平线上拔地而起，宛如一座被削去山腰与峰顶的山峦。它周围的地面是一片曾经繁茂的植物坟场——失败的地貌改造植株如今腐朽成一条条霉烂的灰阶污痕。尽管此地的矿井早已废弃，你的皮肤却仍因暗处目光的刀尖般轻刺而起了一层战栗。余光里有动静一闪而过，可每当你转头，所见的只有地平线上那枚覆着铜绿的立方体。

~ 构想：DadManB

Vacuous silence eats at your mind, echoing through your darkening thoughts, as you squint through the strangeness of this place. A megalith of oxidized steel rises from the asteroid’s curving horizon like a mountain with the sides and top carved off. The ground around it is a graveyard of once-vibrant flora. Terraforming plants that failed now decay into moldering streaks of grayscale. Though the mines of this place are abandoned, your skin prickles with the knife-tip tickle of hidden eyes. Motion flickers in your peripherals, but every time you turn your head, you see only the verdigris cube on the horizon.

~ Envisioned by DadManB

死神有两面：一面抚慰，一面震怒。抚慰之面披着轻柔飘荡的白色薄棉长袍，戴着温暖的天鹅绒手套，安抚心神，带来一种轻松的休息与释然之感。长袍自缭绕的雾灰色灵氛中翻卷而过，缠绕到另一面——枯槁的手覆着破烂的黑色亚麻，紧攥一柄镰刀。那张脸毫无怜悯，不见愉悦，唯有记忆沉满其间。每当有人与神相遇，它便缓缓转身，动作愈发迟慢，直到其中一面停下，正对来者。
The God of Death has two sides: one of comfort, one of wrath. The side of comfort wears a flowing robe of gauzy white cotton and warm, velvet gloves that calm the mind, an easy vibe of rest and release. The robe wraps around, through a misty gray aura, to the other side, where gaunt hands clothed in tattered black linen grip a scythe. The face is devoid of mercy, without pleasure, and full of memory. Whenever someone meets the god, it turns, slowing until one side stops to face them.

你吐出的亵渎咒词呼唤着群星之间的虚空，你指间捻起的银色焦油与那墨黑幽昏共鸣。你抬手一指，吞光的阴影便自那一点蔓延开来，如无可穿透的浓烟。随之而来的，是狂乱的低语、失控的哄笑，以及那些栖居在光明与理智之外之人的撕心尖啸。
The eldritch words you utter call to the void between the stars, the silvery tar you pinch resonating with that inky gloom. You point, and light-killing shadow spreads from that point like impenetrable smoke. With it comes the raving voices, unhinged laughter, and mind-rending screams of those who dwell beyond light and sanity.

Aberrant Cultist Riders.name:
畸变邪教骑手
Aberrant Cultist Riders

Text.text:
邪教徒披着深染的长袍，宽阔的天鹅绒镶边上绣着诡异的秘奥符纹。他们结伴穿过围城战场，口中低吟咒唱。抵达一处巨大的露天围栏时，他们掀起兜帽，围栏内巨龙腐败的尸躯被浓密的蝇云半遮半掩。邪教徒骑上坐骑般的巨龙，对它们低声耳语。双翼张开猛然拍击，野兽发出骇人的尖啸，邪教徒随之腾空而起。

~ ArielleVB 构想

The cultists are clad in deep-dyed robes, trimmed in broad velvet embroidered with strange arcana. They cross the siege field together, chanting. They raise their hoods as they reach a huge field pen, the blighted bodies of the great wyrms within partly obscured by thick clouds of flies. The cultists mount the dragons and whisper to them. Wings spread and flap, hideous screeches erupt from the beasts, and the cultists take to the air.

~ Envisioned by ArielleVB

I Drink My Potion Of Poison Resistance.name:
我喝下我的抗毒药水
I Drink My Potion Of Poison Resistance

Text.text:
我拔开瓶塞，灌下一大口黏腻的药剂，油腥的味道在舌尖久久不散。淡淡的浅绿色光晕勾勒出我的身形，昭示着魔法的抗力已然生效——致命的毒素再也无法在我血脉中肆虐。
I uncork the bottle and take a swig of the oily potion, its taste lingering on my tongue. A light green hue outlines my body, a clear tell that the magical resistance has taken hold and that dangerous poisons will no longer run rampant in my veins.

经年受狂烈海岸风候摧磨，又被不息海雾与浪沫浸得潮冷，这座石砌要塞如哨兵般俯守海疆，随时准备击退自海中涌出的威胁。在它的时代里，这座要塞曾守护民众，抵御劫掠成群的海盗、意图将其意志强加于可憎地表之民的海底居民，以及巨蛇——那般庞大而致命的利维坦，以至于关于其体型与凶险的记述听来都像夸张的传闻与传奇。
Weathered by harsh coastal conditions and damp with constant sea spray, this stone fortress stands sentinel over the coastline, ready to repel threats emerging from the sea. In its time this fortress has defended its people against marauding bands of pirates, undersea dwellers seeking to inflict their will upon the hated surface folk, and enormous serpents—leviathans so large and deadly that accounts of their size and danger seem like tall tales and legends.

I Slash With My Hands While Wearing My D.name:
我身披恶魔护甲，以双手挥砍
I Slash With My Hands While Wearing My Demon Armor

Text.text:
亵渎的恶意在我体内奔涌，邪恶的利爪自护甲包覆的指尖疯长而出。我感到护甲的力量在体内咆哮，宛如笼中猛兽瞥见猎物般狂躁，猩红的雾霭覆上我的视野。我猛然前扑，喉间迸出野兽般的低吼，以刀锋般锐利的恶魔利爪撕裂眼前的敌人。
Unholy malice flows through me as my wicked claws grow from armored fingertips. I feel the power of the armor as it rages like a caged beast catching sight of prey, and a red mist descends over my vision. Leaping forward with a guttural roar, I slash at my foe with razor-sharp, demonic claws.

Muddy Trail Leading To Forest.name:
通往森林的泥泞小径
Muddy Trail Leading To Forest

Text.text:
路上的水洼映出前方树梢，仿佛敞开大门的两根巨大门柱。水面被阳光染成金色，将阴郁的森林映得如同一场怡人梦境般温暖。
The puddles in the road reflect the tops of the trees ahead like gigantic posts of an open gate. The water is golden with the light of the sun, reflecting the gloomy forest with the warmth of a pleasant dream.

Goddess Of Fortune.name:
幸运女神
Goddess Of Fortune

Text.text:
这是一位笑声盈盈的女神，她的呼吸是财富，她的眼眸是失落之爱的深井。她宁可流连骰子馆，也不愿耗在辛劳的白昼；她更爱荒漠里骤然出现的绿洲之惊喜，而非那条可预料的既定轨迹。她身形娇小，你要么会在她身上看见闪耀的派对礼裙，要么就看见最朴素无趣的衬衫与马裤，配着结实的靴子和一顶软塌塌的宽檐帽。她的发丝任由机缘牵引，落向该落的地方。她的笑声让人一听便明白：一个愿望与一个寄望城同样作数。
This is a laughing goddess whose breath is riches and whose eyes are wells of lost love. She prefers the dice dens to days of toil, and the surprise of an oasis in the desert to the predictable track. She is petite, and one will either find her in a sparkling party dress or the dullest of blouse and breeches between practical boots and a floppy, wide-brimmed hat. Her hair falls where chance leads it. Her laugh makes it obvious that a wish is as good as a promise.

Adventurers Flummoxed By Puzzle.name:
冒险者被谜题难住
Adventurers Flummoxed By Puzzle

Text.text:
“这不可能有那么复杂！以神祇之名，就三种颜色外加几个字母。我们怎么就弄不明白？！到底谁会设计这种门？肯定是那种闲得有大把时代的人。”

~ Naelynn 于 Discord

“It can't be that complicated! By the gods, it's three colors and a few letters. How are we not getting this?! Who designs a door like this anyway? Someone with far too much time on their hands, that’s who.”

~ Naelynn on Discord

用于打造这套板条护甲的钢条并非笔直的片段，而是如蛇般蜿蜒滑行般沿着臂膀与双腿盘下。护腕与护踝处的板条被锻造成蛇首的形状。躯干上的板条横向铺展、层层叠压，其上蚀刻着细密鳞纹。仿佛这身护甲正呈现出一窝蝰蛇，骤然自四肢上迸散而出。
The strips of steel used to make this splint armor slither sinuously down the legs and arms, rather than being straight pieces. At the wrists and ankles, the splints have been shaped into the form of snakes’ heads. The splints on the body run horizontally and overlap, bearing etchings of scales. It’s as if the armor presents a nest of vipers that explode over the limbs.

Accelerated-reflex Street Swordsman.name:
加速反射的街头剑士
Accelerated-reflex Street Swordsman

Text.text:
一个肤色晦暗的男人站在那里，上身赤裸，赤足无鞋，却拥有两条碳纤维手臂。凌乱的黑发束成浪人髻，脸上布满疤痕，下巴留着一层淡淡的胡茬擦痕。他右手握着一把杀气凛然的武士刀，仿佛是他意志的延伸。黑漆刀鞘横贴在腹间，上饰黄色菊纹，以宽幅布质腰带紧紧系住。一束蓄能的猩红电光沿着刀身嘶嘶跃动。他单腿立地，右脚踩在左脚之上，身形纹丝不动，唯有一双紫色眼眸以闪电般的速度游移。
A man of clouded complexion stands naked from the waist up, shoeless and with two arms of carbon fiber. His messy black hair is held in a ronin knot, face scarred and bearing a thin graze of stubble. His right hand wields a lethal-looking katana like an extension of his will. The black lacquer scabbard sits at his midriff, decorated with yellow chrysanthemums and secured by a wide fabric waistbelt. A charged bolt of scarlet energy fizzles up the blade. He stands upon one leg, the right foot balanced atop the left, motionless apart from the lightning-quick movement of two purple eyes.

Melf's Minute Meteors.name:
梅尔夫的瞬发流星
Melf's Minute Meteors

Text.text:
你从袋囊里拈出一颗珠子，硝石、松脂与硫磺的刺鼻恶臭瞬间充斥空气。手腕轻轻一抖，你在头顶召出一座微型星系，随着你的咒吟，那些小行星般的微粒开始翩然起舞。六颗细若砂砾的流星裹着暴怒的恶意，绕你盘旋，忽沉忽浮，嘶嘶作响。空气噼啪炸裂，回荡着它们饥渴的期待。
You tug a bead from your pouch and the stench of niter, pine, and sulfur fills the air. With a flick of your wrist, you create a tiny solar system about your head, your chanting causing the planetoids to dance. Six minuscule meteors, glowing with angry malevolence, orbit you, bobbing and hissing. The air crackles with their hungry anticipation.

Beautiful Electrum Brooch.name:
华美的琥珀金胸针
Beautiful Electrum Brooch

Text.text:
这件白金饰品呈中空圣甲虫之形，覆以青金石镶板，在光线下熠熠生辉；它的别针如一道日光射线般锋锐明亮。
In the shape of a hollow scarab and plated with lapis lazuli, the white gold jewelry shimmers in the light, its pin like a ray of sun.

此处铺设在区域内的白色石板已被撕裂，露出一个粗糙的洞口，向下通往一段由同类岩石凿成的陡峭阶梯。洞口里几乎不见碎石与沙砾。四周散落的石块暗示瓦砾曾被胡乱清走……或是有什么从下方猛然破土而出。阵阵穿堂风自洞中涌出，带来檀香的幽香，夹杂着一丝腐败的气息。
White stone paving the area is broken open here, forming a rough hole that leads to a steep stairway of similar rock. Little rubble and sand remain in this opening. Stone scattered nearby suggests the debris was haphazardly removed… or something erupted from below. The fragrance of sandalwood with a hint of rot emerges on a draft from the hole.

Investigating Remnants Of A Teleportatio.name:
调查传送法术的残留痕迹
Investigating Remnants Of A Teleportation Spell

Text.text:
[成功] 你用专注之物在地面上轻轻敲击几下，潜藏的魔法骤然迸发，显露出被魔法刻蚀成一圈宏大圆环的符文——大到足以容纳约六个人并肩而立。

[失败] 膝盖酸痛地抵着地面，你试图将心神与魔法凝聚在那正在消退的法术上……可咒语偏偏从指缝间溜走，最后一丝精粹也化作薄雾消散，只留下被击碎的希望。

[Success] With a few taps of your focus against the ground, latent magic flares to reveal runes magically etched in a great circle—large enough to fit a group of about six people.

[Failure] Aching knees pressing into the ground, you try to focus your mind and magic on the fading spell… but the incantation eludes you, the last of its essence evanescing into thin air and dashed hope.

Protest About A Quest To A Ruin.name:
对一场前往遗迹的任务提出抗议
Protest About A Quest To A Ruin

Text.text:
“一定还有别的办法。我们还没准备好。这可不是什么乌合之众的暴徒，这是古老的魔法，我一点也不想沾上。”
“There must be another way. We aren’t prepared. This isn’t just some gang of thugs, this is old magic, and I want nothing to do with it.”

Brynjar Tulumeu Strom.name:
布林贾尔·图卢梅乌·斯特罗姆
Brynjar Tulumeu Strom

Text.text:
一个魁梧的身影在拥挤的道路上心不在焉地踉跄前行，任由雨幕坠落倾泻。湿透的皮靴每一步都发出咕叽的挤压声与呜咽般的水响，他在人群间穿梭，路人投来古怪的目光，而他几乎毫无察觉。男人一绺绺赤褐色长发紧贴在沉重的额前，浸透的衬衫黏住苍白的皮肤，将胸口繁复的纹身纹路清晰勾出。他那件未扣的单排扣外套原本应与他长春花色的眼睛相映，如今却被雨水染成湿漉漉的深海军蓝。

尽管浑身湿透，他却在臂弯里稳稳夹着一把尖端异常的雨伞，双手得以自由游走在一个怪异的金属方块上——那方块攫住了他全部的注意力。他拨转、轻拈那漆黑的外壳，十指急切地抽动，仿佛下一瞬就能解开谜题；可当毫无动静时，他又失望地停住——随即手指再次弹起，周而复始。

~ 由 Connor S. Played

A hulking figure lumbers absentmindedly down the crowded road despite the sheets of rain falling. His wet leather boots squelch and sob with each step as he weaves around folk who flash odd looks at him, though he barely seems to notice. The man’s long strands of auburn hair have plastered themselves over his heavy brow, and a sodden shirt clings to his pale skin, revealing the intricate patterns tattooed across his chest. His unfastened single-breasted jacket would have once been a match for his periwinkle eyes but has darkened to a soppy navy in the rain.

Despite his sodden state, the man carries an oddly pointed umbrella balanced in the crook of one arm, leaving his hands free to wander over the unusual metal cube commanding his entire focus. He spins and plucks at the cube’s dark exterior, each finger twitching eagerly, as if on the brink of completing the puzzle, only to pause in disappointment when nothing happens—then they spring back into motion, repeating the cycle.

~ Played by Connor S.

Chamber Orchestra.name:
室内管弦乐团
Chamber Orchestra

Text.text:
在一位小领主的府邸里，八重奏集结一堂，掀开内衬天鹅绒的琴匣，露出大提琴或中提琴温润如酒的木纹。竖笛手身着最上等的华达呢，从朴素的羊毛抽绳袋里取出乐器。乐师们依次落座，开始试音热身。片刻间，混乱在墙壁间来回弹跳——熟悉的旋律碎片与和声气泡般冒起又消散。随后——寂静。再然后，前奏一响，所有王室成员——无论站立还是斜倚——都被轻轻托起。
In the mansion of a minor lord, the octet assembles, opening velvet-lined cases to reveal the cordial woodgrain of a cello or viola. Recorder players, in their finest gabardine, remove their instruments from simple drawstring bags of wool. The musicians take their seats and warm up. For a moment, chaos bounces from the walls, snippets of recognizable tunes or harmonies bubbling up and disappearing. Then—silence. Then all the royals, standing and lounging alike, are lifted by the overture.

Divine Keep Of A God Of Tyranny.name:
暴君神祇的神圣要塞
Divine Keep Of A God Of Tyranny

Text.text:
当然，这是一座带精金闸门的土垒-外堡城堡。它是小小封地的徽记：夹在上头的统治与下头的苦役之间的中层领主，把满腔怨怒从箭孔与倒油口倾泻而下，伴着投掷的焦油桶。这个突施惩罚的小神祇身上带着残忍与恶意——木尖桩围栏立在疫瘴之壕前，像一排獠牙。外堡最高那扇窗上方伸出一根长杆，杆端吊着一只铁笼，笼里端坐着一具尸体；铁链吱呀作响，来回摇晃。
It is, of course, a motte-and-bailey castle with an adamantine portcullis. The icon of a petty fiefdom, a middle management lorded over from above, taking out frustrations on those below through murder holes and pitch barrels. There is a viciousness, a malice in this little god of sudden penalties, where the wooden-spike fencing stands before a moat of pestilence. From a pole sticking out over the highest window of the bailey, there swings a cage with a corpse sitting in it, its chain creaking.

Macho Enhanced Swat Member.name:
强化猛男特警队员
Macho Enhanced Swat Member

Text.text:
这名军官庞大得惊人——远远超出人类靠自然手段所能达到的极限。他们的战术背心干脆剪成无袖，只为容纳嫁接在那如酒桶般躯干上的巨大义体手臂；合成肌肉在仿生皮肤下隆起起伏。随着他们抬起一门庞然巨炮——本该安装在军用载具上的那种——却像端着一把突击步枪般稳稳对准你。
The officer is huge, far larger than humanly possible—through natural means. Their tac-vest is sleeveless to accommodate the enormous bulk of the cyberarms grafted to their barrel-like torso, and synthetic muscles bulge beneath artificial skin as they bring an enormous cannon—normally found on military vehicles—to bear like an assault rifle.

你推开镶着玻璃的门，门楣下挂着的一只老铃铛随之叮当作响。陈旧的硬木地板蒙着尘，满是岁月磨出的痕迹，仿佛一代代闲逛者、藏家与淘便宜货的人都曾在此驻足。墙边的架子摆满各式古董：未经抛光的银器、修补过的陶碗、一把摇椅，还有一只盛着乳白虹彩液体的古怪小瓶——仅是其中几样。你忍不住想了想，角落那把旧扫帚究竟是陈列品，还是只是没人用。远墙上并排着三扇彩绘玻璃窗，将房间染成一道道流动的彩色光痕。一个看不见的声音沙哑地咕哝道：“啊，哈喽？”
You push the glass-paned door open, and an old bell hanging from the lintel chimes. The old hardwood floor is dusty and shows wear from generations of browsers, collectors, and bargain hunters. Shelves of assorted antiques line the walls displaying unpolished silverware, mended ceramic bowls, a rocking chair, and a curious vial of opalescent liquid to name but a few of the items. You ponder for just a moment whether the old broom in the corner is on display or simply not in use. Three stained glass windows line the far wall, painting the room in streaks of color. An unseen voice croaks, “Ah, hullo?”

Professor Of Quotidian Studies.name:
日常学研究教授
Professor Of Quotidian Studies

Text.text:
有时她以女子之姿授课，有时又以男子之形现身，却始终穿着寻常日用的衣装。她身材高挑、肩背宽阔，下颌方正，一头卷曲的草莓金发；她笑得太勤，常得抬手揉一揉那两颊雀斑。对那些几乎不曾踏足俗世的学生而言，她的课堂简直是笑声与惊奇的连绵不绝。她随身带着一根魔杖，却极少动用，除了讲解无魔世界时，用来指向图表与示意图。
Sometimes she teaches as a woman, sometimes as a man, but always wearing quotidian dress. Tall and broad shouldered, square jawed with curly strawberry-blond hair, she smiles so often she has to rub her freckled cheeks. Her classes are nothing short of laughter and fascination to the students who have seldom experienced the quotidian world. She carries a wand but seldom uses it except to point at charts and diagrams when she lectures about the non-magical world.

魔杖断成两截参差的碎片，在你接触之下徒然嘶嘶作响。任何施法尝试都只会换来一团白烟，以及一声仿佛轻轻叹息的细响。若不修复，它似乎毫无用处。
The wand, snapped into two splintered fragments, fizzles at your touch. Any attempt at spellwork results in a puff of white smoke and a sound like a small sigh. Without repair, it seems of no use.

那灰皮侏儒踏入房间时，双眼因癫狂的热忱而狂乱游移，偏执的急迫感几乎凝成实体。他的动作迅捷而紊乱，像一只被囚太久的兽，骤然得了自由却又不适应这份松绑。稀薄的银发向四面八方卷翘炸开，将他衬得彻底疯癫。

~ Played by Ben from dScryb

Eyes wild with manic fervor dart back and forth, a paranoid urgency evident as the gray-skinned gnome enters the room. His movements are quick and erratic, like an animal caged for too long, but uncomfortable with its sudden freedom. His wispy silver hair coils out in every direction, giving him a truly deranged appearance.

~ Played by Ben from dScryb

House Dolphin Commons (The Pod).name:
海豚公舍（海豚群）
House Dolphin Commons (The Pod)

Text.text:
可从高塔的地窖进入；在一处海边洞窟里，小团体围着一汪咸水池集会。有些学生化作海豚形态，漂浮在池中；另一些则慵懒地倚坐在池畔的皂石椅上；好学者在施有防盐防霉法术的书架间翻检卷册。洞窟由发光的地衣与苔藓照明，起伏的水波将它们的舞影映上墙壁与穹顶。
Accessible through the cellars of the tower, in a seaside grotto, the pod meets around a salt water pool. Some of the students take dolphin form and float in the pool, while others lounge on soapstone chairs around it, and the studious search bookshelves protected by spells against salt and mold. The grotto is lit with glowing lichen and moss, and the rippling waters reflect their dance on the walls and ceiling.

Summon Celestial.name:
召唤天界生物
Summon Celestial

Text.text:
当你完成法术时，一道刺目的强光瞬间淹没你的视野，你只来得及捕捉到天穹圣歌最短促的几缕音符。随着从鎏金圣匣中涌出的光辉渐渐消退，你看见你的天界盟友——空灵而灿耀——正静候你的号令，金色武器已然出鞘待发。
A burst of blinding light fills your vision, and you catch the briefest notes of a heavenly chorus, when you complete the spell. As the light emanating from the gilded reliquary fades, you see your celestial ally—ethereal and radiant—awaiting your command, their golden weapons at the ready.

Disused Crew Quarters.name:
废弃的船员寝舱
Disused Crew Quarters

Text.text:
这间小屋从上到下都覆着一层污垢。腐烂的甜腻气味在此盘旋，从粗糙桌上被丢弃的餐盘里幽幽飘出。角落里几张床铺凌乱未整，污渍斑斑、破旧起毛的床单耷拉着；每个抽屉、柜子与箱子都敞着口——早在很久以前就被洗劫一空，值钱的东西无一幸免。
A layer of grime covers everything in this small room from top to bottom. The sweet smell of rot lingers here, wafting from the discarded plates on the rough table. Beds with stained, threadbare sheets lie unmade in the corner and every drawer, locker, and chest hangs open—raided long ago for anything of value.

Cloak Of Eternal Darkness.name:
永恒黑暗斗篷
Cloak Of Eternal Darkness

Text.text:
漆黑如墨的衣袍摊展开来，宛如一滩流动的黑暗。它周围的光被吞噬殆尽，扭曲的低语仿佛从黑曜石般的褶皱间咕嘟咕嘟地冒出。某种神秘的存在感污染着空气——一种渴求、一种伸手抓挠般的需要：渴望被使用。阴森的窃笑在近旁的阴影里回荡。

~ 设想：Ethan

The jet-black garment sprawls like a puddle of liquid darkness. Light is devoured around it, and distorted whispers seem to bubble up between the obsidian folds of fabric. A numinous presence pollutes the air, a craving, grasping need to be used. Sinister chuckles fill the shadows nearby.

~ Envisioned by Ethan

[察觉] 这间屋子的地面看起来像是尚未完工。几块花岗岩地砖被打磨得光滑，嵌在下方纹理斑驳的石面里。其间留着空缺，露出粗砺的底石，别说软底拖鞋，就连带跟的靴子踩上去都嫌扎脚。踏过门槛的瞬间，你感到一阵无声的召唤，仿佛有人轻轻扯住你的衣领或袖口。

[发现] 那股拉扯来自你身上佩戴或携带的任何金属。站在门槛处，你能看出牵引正指向某块粗糙的石面，而某些抛光的花岗岩砖则拼出一条能穿过磁场的安全路径。

[触发] 当你跨过门槛进入房间，你终于明白那股牵引是在拉扯你身上与随身携带的金属——但已经太迟。你在光滑的花岗岩上打滑，径直滑到一块粗糙的方格上。你的武器、护甲、手镯与项链都猛地绷紧，扣件、袋口与鞘带被扯得吱呀作响，你被硬生生压向地面。

[Perceived] The floor in this room looks somehow unfinished. Some granite tiles are smooth and set into the veiny stone beneath. There are empty patches that show the floor, too rough for a slipper or heeled boot. At the threshold of the room, you feel a sort of beckoning, much like a tug on one’s collar or sleeve.

[Discovered] The tug you feel is at whatever metal you wear or carry. At the threshold, you can see that the pull is toward one of the rough stones, and that certain polished granite stones create a safe path through the magnet field.

[Triggered] When you cross the threshold into the room, you realize that the tug you felt was at the metal you wear and carry—but it is too late. You slide across the slick granite and onto one of the rough squares. Your weaponry, armor, bracelets, and necklaces strain at their fasteners, pouches, and sheaths, and you are forced down toward the floor.

你走近那位坐在古老门扉台阶上的守门人时，一双锐利的蓝眼睛从层层深褶里刺穿般盯住了你。他的皮肤赤红，头生双角，蹄子也磕裂残缺，像是——或者说曾经是——一名提夫林；可他纠结成束的发辫间，却盛放着异界般的银色星花，老迈的身躯又静得不合常理，反衬得那双难以捉摸的眼睛愈发诡秘。目不转睛，亦无呼吸，你不禁怀疑他是否已死守岗位……直到他忽然开口，吓得你一激灵。  

“别盯着看，小鬼。”他咯咯怪笑，尖牙尽露，咧出一个夸张的笑容。“我知道我很美。但还远不及我守着的地方美！报上来意。”
Piercing blue eyes gaze at you through thick wrinkles as you approach the warden seated on the steps of the ancient portal. His red skin, horns, and chipped hooves suggest that he is—or rather, was—a tiefling, but the otherworldly bloom of silver starflowers growing in his dreadlocked hair and the utter stillness of his aged body belie those inscrutable eyes. Unblinking and unbreathing, you wonder if he’s died at his post… until he speaks, startling you. “You don’t have to stare, kiddo.” He cackles, baring his pointed teeth in a wide grin. “I know I’m beautiful. But not near so beautiful as the place I guard! State your business.”

不健康的苍白肤色与银色长发——一直垂到她的背中，扎成双马尾——让这位纤弱的年轻女子显得格外异于常人。无框眼镜架在她小巧的翘鼻鼻梁上，勾勒出她那银灰色的眼眸。那双眼睛既急切又好奇，扫视着周遭的世界。一件精致的皮质短上衣护住她的躯干——其上点缀着一枚护符，描绘着一颗风格化的八角蓝星——而贤者的深色长袍则覆盖住她的双腿与脚。她腰带上那把三角刃短剑与几柄匕首看起来鲜少见血，反倒是背上斜挎的满满箭袋与长弓，像是经历过更多次出手。

~ Played by a Hero with

An unhealthy pallor and silver hair—down to her midback and tied in double tails—set this waifish young woman apart from the norm. Rimless spectacles sit on the bridge of her button nose, framing her argent eyes. Eager and curious, those eyes scan the world around her. A fine leather doublet protects her torso—accented with an amulet depicting a stylized, eight-pointed blue star—and the dark robes of a sage cover her legs and feet. A triangular-bladed shortsword and knives sheathed on her belt appear to have seen much less action than the full quiver and bow slung on her back.

~ Played by a Hero with

Approaching The Dead City Of Polis.name:
逼近波利斯的死城
Approaching The Dead City Of Polis

Text.text:
冰冷的暴雨如同残酷的监工般鞭挞着城市，低沉而不祥的哀号回荡开来，仿佛一支悲恸的合唱。黑色高塔如墓碑般矗立，俯视着阴影笼罩的街道。此地的悲剧愈发清晰可感；当你逐渐逼近城市那扇巨大的铁门时，腐烂与朽败的气味已浸透空气。

~ 构想 by rc

Frigid rain lashes the city like a vicious taskmaster, and a low, ominous wail rings out like a mournful chorus. Dark towers loom like headstones over the shadowed streets. The tragedy of this place is increasingly apparent, and the smell of rot and decay saturates the air as you draw closer to the huge iron gates of the city.

~ Envisioned by rc

Wand Of Fireballs.name:
火球术魔杖
Wand Of Fireballs

Text.text:
这根短短的圆柱形木杖被打磨得近乎刺目，在自杖端涌出的柔和橙光中微微闪烁。银色符文与刻痕沿着杖身向下延伸，盘绕纠结，缠上又滑入木纹深处。杖端的光芒源自一枚嵌入木料的小宝石；它的辉光淡薄，却带着一丝温热的接触。
The short cylindrical stretch of fiercely polished wood glimmers in the soft orange light that emanates from its tip. Silver runes and markings reach down the sides of the wand, curling in and around the pole. The light at the tip shines from a small gemstone pressed into the wood itself. Its glow is faint and carries with it a touch of warmth.

Ginko \"Gin\" Mistypetal.name:
银子“琴”·迷误花瓣
Ginko "Gin" Mistypetal

Text.text:
乱发狂翅，匕首丛生，比他的耳尖还锋利，这位妖精骑士如同施法的蜻蜓般穿行四方。他粉色的鬃毛、黄铜般发亮的皮质护甲与虹彩翅翼划过一群冒险者，掠出一道光痕。众人被逼得一退，抱怨声四起；可那小妖精又一个回旋冲刺，落回他们之间，坐立不安却满心欢快。他额头上点缀着一截短短的独角，胸前所佩的护身符上也烙着另一枚同样的角纹。

~ 一位英雄所扮演

Wild-haired and wild-winged, bristling with daggers sharper than his ears, the fey knight travels like a sorcerous dragonfly. His pink mane, brassy leather armor, and iridescent wings streak through a group of adventurers. They spring back and complain, but then the fairy courses back and lands among them, fidgety and happy. A short unicorn horn decorates his forehead, with another emblazoned on the amulet he wears.

~ Played by a Hero

Amphitheater Of Cultists.name:
邪教徒的圆形剧场
Amphitheater Of Cultists

Text.text:
兜帽人影占据着露天剧场层层叠起的石座。有的身体前倾，屏息凝神；有的向后靠坐，双臂抱胸。阶段上只有一名披袍者在发言。其身旁立着一对巨大的火盆，讲者情绪激昂地挥舞手臂，抽搐般的影子随之甩向观众席。那火盆宛如骇人的燃烧眼眸；那座席宛如一圈圈利齿，环绕着阶段中央那吞噬一切的深坑。
Hooded figures occupy the tiered stone benches of the amphitheater. Some lean forward, rapt, while others sit back with their arms crossed. A single robed individual speaks on the stage. Flanked by a pair of large braziers, the speaker gesticulates passionately, throwing spasmodic shadows across the audience. The braziers look like terrible, burning eyes; the benches, like rings of teeth surrounding the central devouring pit of the stage.

Speech About Time And Loss.name:
关于时代与失落的演说
Speech About Time And Loss

Text.text:
“我不再想念那些我失去的人了。说真的，我甚至已经记不起他们。我怀念的，是我曾经在想起他们时涌上的那种感觉。很快，连那也会消失——到那时，我将为失去那份感觉的记忆而哀悼。倒影的倒影，随着时代愈发模糊、愈发暗淡。可即便如此，一切依然刺痛。”
“I no longer miss those I’ve lost. I can’t even remember them, really. I miss the feeling I used to get when I thought about them. Soon, I won’t even have that anymore, I’ll be grieving over losing the memory of a feeling. A reflection of a reflection, all becoming more and more obscured with time. And yet it all still hurts.”

Slippers Of Spider Climbing.name:
蜘蛛攀爬便鞋
Slippers Of Spider Climbing

Text.text:
一双柔软的黑色缎面拖鞋，饰以繁复的白色丝线纹样，交织成蛛网的形状。蛛丝般的织纹轻轻系过鞋面，绕行至鞋底——在那里骤然变得厚重，一层又一层的蛛网相互叠织、密密铺展。
A pair of soft black satin slippers with intricate patterns of white silk woven in the shape of spider webs. The webbing lightly laces the tops and wraps around to the sole—where it grows much thicker, weaving web after web over one another.

Testimonial Of Saint Riya Quill.name:
圣里娅·奎尔的证言
Testimonial Of Saint Riya Quill

Text.text:
“无论走进哪家旅店或酒馆，你总能看见她。也许是一幅画像，或只是刻下的姓名首字母；有人甚至为她立起雕像。莉雅·奎尔：一个平凡的劳作女子，在能谋生的地方施展她的手艺。嘲笑她所选行当的人，从未领略过她的魅力。

莉雅曾与你同在——不论你是男人还是女人，都无关紧要——所有人都会坠入她心海的波澜。她的爱包容一切，强烈而炽热，是一种渴望被分享的爱。有时她会倾听，有时她会用遥远异乡的故事逗你开怀，而有时……嗯，人与人相连的方式，从来不止一种。

她每到一座城镇，那份关怀、那份怜悯、那份强大的爱便会蔓延开来：人们变得更温和，粗砺者也渐渐柔软，羞怯者也更敢走出阴影。你能从人们脸上的笑意与步伐的轻盈看出她曾来过。岁月渐长，莉雅却愈发美丽；她的皱纹与笑纹，是她曾与人共享欢愉的见证。

有人以为她只是去了更远的地方，结识不同的族群；也有人说，她的美惊动了神祇的目光，而她至今仍在守夜，俯护我们。我只知道，每当我将要沉入忧郁与恶意之时，总会听见她柔软的声音，引我走向连结，引我走向爱。”

“Pass through any inn or tavern and you’ll see her. Perhaps it will be a painting or just a carved initial; some even took to erecting statues in her honor. Riya Quill: a simple working woman who plied her trade where she could. Those who scoff at her chosen profession have never experienced her charms.

Riya was there with you, man or woman—it didn’t matter—all would fall into the ocean of her heart. She had an all-encompassing love, a powerful love, a love that demanded to be shared. Sometimes she would listen, sometimes she would regale you with tales of far-off lands, and sometimes… well, there are many ways to connect with people.

In every town she visited, that care, that compassion, that powerful love would spread: people became kinder, the gruff became softer, and the shy freer. You could tell she’d visited by the smiles on people’s faces and the lightness of their steps. As she aged, Riya only grew more beautiful, her wrinkles and laugh lines a testament to the joys she had shared.

Some think she simply moved on to different lands and different peoples. Others claim her beauty caught the eyes of the gods themselves and she still watches over us. All I know is, whenever I feel myself succumbing to feelings of melancholy and spite, I can hear her soft voice guiding me toward connection, guiding me toward love.”

出鞘的武器迸射出撕裂般的光芒，刺目的炽光逼得周遭众人不得不抬臂掩蔽双眼。持有者将武器高高举起，光辉随之层层攀升，随后以毁灭性的重击轰然砸下。冲击的刹那，白金般的耀辉爆裂，化作一道灼亮的光焰直冲天穹。
The drawn weapon gleams with a sundering light, the glare forcing those nearby to cover their eyes at its intensity. The light builds as the wielder raises the weapon high and then crashes it down with a devastating blow. The impact sends a bright white-gold flare of radiance skyward.

Sense Of Mind Being Controlled.name:
心神被操控的感觉
Sense Of Mind Being Controlled

Text.text:
你的思绪变得迟缓而迷蒙，仿佛有什么东西在搅浑它们，让你难以集中精神。忽然间，你的肌肉自行抽动，像是被另一个人接管了操控。你的感官逐渐迟钝，你的自由意志也彻底消散——你被唯一收到的命令吞没。
Your thoughts slow and grow hazy. It feels as if something is muddling them, making it hard to concentrate. Suddenly your muscles move, as though someone else has taken control of them. Your senses dull and your free will fades entirely—you are consumed by the singular order you have been given.

Royal Flagship's Approach.name:
皇家旗舰的逼近
Royal Flagship's Approach

Text.text:
地平线上那道倾斜的轮廓，宛如一只黑色香水瓶的剪影，绝不会认错。它逐渐逼近，形体也随之清晰：沉重的船体上竖起一排桅杆，吨位与武装皆令人心惊。主桅顶端高悬着所属国家的旗帜，其余桅杆却飘扬着各个贵族家族的旗号——那是指挥官与资助者的血统与门第——为这艘船的武器库再添上一件武器：威吓。

~ 一位英雄所 Envisioned

The tilted shape on the horizon, like the silhouette of a black perfume bottle, is unmistakable. As it approaches, the shape resolves into masts protruding from a hull of imposing tonnage and armament. The flag of its nation tops the main mast, but flags of noble houses fly on the others—the pedigree of its commanders and patrons—adding to the ship’s arsenal the weapon of intimidation.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Bronze Buckle For A Narrow Belt.name:
窄腰带用青铜扣
Bronze Buckle For A Narrow Belt

Text.text:
这是一枚朴素的双环扣。皮带先穿过两道圆环，再折回从第一道环里穿出。圆环上泛着一层青绿色的铜锈——那些未被来回拉扯的皮革磨得发亮的青铜处，颜色尤为明显。
This is a simple two-ring buckle. The belt passes through both rings and is then drawn back through the first. The rings are tinged with greenish patina where the bronze hasn’t been rubbed to a shine by pulled leather.

[掩蔽] 这本书的掩蔽由拼缀的人皮制成，骇人地与你自己的皮肤过分相似。皮片以肠线与蜡缝合，绷在一块轻薄的硬板上作成掩蔽，书脊处再以生铁铆钉铆牢。它沉重，散发霉腐的恶臭，完全不像纸。正面掩蔽上只有一道奥秘的印记，繁复纠结，仿佛出自某种古老或异界的语言。 [内容] 并非所有书页都相同。有些页上绘着插图，或嵌着一块块奇异的材料，比如被胶黏进去的皮革碎片。另一些则可向外折展开来，铺成精密繁复的图表。你无法在心里默念那些词。你必须将它们说出口。你读出的第一个词，便在口中留下灰烬与鲜血的滋味。随着你继续下去，你的心智与肉身一并疲惫、衰败。 [Cover] This book has a cover of patchwork skin, eerily too much like your own. The patches are sewn with gut and wax and stretched over a lightweight board to make a cover, which is riveted with pig iron at the spine. It is heavy, stinks of mold, and nothing like paper. On the front cover is a single arcane sigil, complicated and of some ancient or planar language. [Content] Not all the pages are the same. Some are illustrated or have swatches of strange materials like hide glued into them. Others fold out into elaborate charts. You cannot think the words. You must speak them. The first word you read leaves the taste of ash and blood in your mouth. Your mind and body fatigue and decline as you continue.

魔法能成就万千——毁灭、创造，以及其间的一切。但此刻，当你完成法术并用双手做出几个简单手势时，处在你视觉线内的每个生物与物体都不过像玩具一般，任你拾起，随手抛开。
Magic can accomplish so much—destruction, creation, and everything in between. But now, as you complete the spell and do some simple gestures with your hands, every creature and object within your line of sight is little more than a toy to be picked up and tossed aside.

Request From Wizard Flat On Their Back.name:
仰躺在地的巫师的请求
Request From Wizard Flat On Their Back

Text.text:
“幸会。照理说我该起身郑重其事地提出请求，可我只能在这里将就着说——以最迫切、最真挚的心意：帮帮我。”
“A pleasure to make your acquaintance. Normally behooved to rise to deliver a formal request, I’ll have to make do from here and say, with the most urgent sincerity: Help me.”

一声放屁似的怪响惊动了你，只见一头野兽摇摇晃晃地扑扇着飞上半空。它只有鸡那么大，身形也大致像鸡；这只胖乎乎的小东西拼命拍打着翅膀，却仍不得不被算作一条龙——鳞片、獠牙、利爪、蝙蝠般的翅膀，还有一条带倒刺的尾巴和圆滚滚的躯干。光是看着它，你就会感到一股莽撞的热情与亲昵扑面而来。
A flatulent noise alerts you to a beast wobblily fluttering into the air. Chicken-sized and roughly chicken-proportioned, the fat little thing with its furiously flapping wings must nevertheless be considered a dragon: scales, fangs, claws, and bat wings, but with a barbed tail and pudgy body. Just looking at it you get a feeling of bumptious enthusiasm and friendliness.

Desert Nomad Camp: Entertainment.name:
沙漠游牧营地：消遣娱乐
Desert Nomad Camp: Entertainment

Text.text:
几个鼓手再加上一两名舞者，本不该闹出这么大的动静，更不该演出得如此热烈——可你却发现自己的身体正本能地随着这粗犷的乡野旋律起舞。你看见人群中许多人也同样被感染：脸上挂着笑，点头的额头上渗着汗珠。
A couple drummers and a dancer or two should not be able to make so much noise, nor put on such a rousing performance—yet you find your body instinctively responding to the rustic music. You see many in the crowd appear similarly affected, with smiles on their faces and sweat on the brows of their nodding heads.

马车停在四个宽大的车轮上，辐条因旅行而沾满污垢，轮胎被路面磕碰得缺口斑驳、刮痕累累。马车其余部分的状况要好得多。尽管你能看出些许磨损的痕迹，却丝毫不减车门与车身上那些精巧镶嵌纹样的雅致与华美。
The carriage rests atop four broad wheels, with spokes dirty from travel and tires chipped and scraped from the road. The rest of the carriage is in much better shape. While you can spot some marks of wear, they don't detract from the artfully inlaid patterns on the door and body of the transport.

Slippery Ice Hazard.name:
湿滑冰面危害
Slippery Ice Hazard

Text.text:
冰面的质地频繁变幻：半透明的斑块之下，雪丝缭绕，水纹旋转。每一步都像在猜测，落脚时仿佛把一只水晶杯轻轻放在满是弹珠的托盘上。却终究徒劳——靴底终于踩了个空，触到一片几乎毫无摩擦的光滑面，整只脚便猛地朝前直蹿出去。你手脚乱挥，另一只脚也随即失去支撑，心脏猛地一跳。
The texture of the ice changes often, with wisps of snow and whorls of water under translucent patches. Each step is a guess, placed as if you were setting a crystal glass on a tray of marbles. To no avail, because eventually the sole of your boot connects with nothing, a nearly frictionless surface, and shoots straight out in front of you. You flail, the other foot losing purchase, and your heart leaps.

Bow Of Seelie Craftsmanship.name:
精灵仙灵工艺长弓
Bow Of Seelie Craftsmanship

Text.text:
这把弓由一整段柔韧的白蜡木枝制成，通体覆以繁复精细的雕纹，华美得令人屏息。弓弦由纤雅的蛛丝绞成——永远缀着晨露——而每一侧弓臂的顶端都绽放着芬芳的野花。拉弓之时，隐约有柔和的乐声回荡；当箭矢离弦，旋律随之攀升，骤然迸发成最盛的高音。
Made from a single branch of flexible ash and covered with intricate carvings, this bow is exquisite. Strands of elegant spider silk—always laden with morning dew—form the bow’s string, and fragrant wildflowers grow from the crest of each limb. Soft music can be heard when the bow is drawn, rising to a crescendo upon the arrow’s release.

Passage Into The Ruined Temple.name:
步入毁坏的神殿
Passage Into The Ruined Temple

Text.text:
神庙之巅矗立着一道拱门，它投下的阴影恰到好处地遮住入口；唯有步行靠近，才能看清里面的门扉究竟是开是闭。阴影来自一尊巨大的羽蛇之王塑像，最高处足足十二英尺。入口前的整片平台上，刻着一轮半圆的落日图纹——在这片文化中象征吉兆的开端——还是吉兆的终末？无所谓。
At the top of the temple stands an archway, its shadow obscuring the entrance just enough that one must approach on foot to see whether the portal inside is open or shut. The shadow is cast by an enormous effigy of a king of the feathered serpents, fully twelve-feet tall at its uppermost point. A semicircular carving of the setting sun decorates the entire platform before the entrance, a symbol of auspicious beginnings in this culture—or was it auspicious endings? No matter.

Medium Herd Animal.name:
中型群居草食兽
Medium Herd Animal

Text.text:
这头孤独的群居兽从宽阔的厚皮巨口中喷出沉重的草腥气息。四条笨拙的粗腿咚咚向前，驮着臃肿的身躯，皮肤斑驳如补丁。它的脸盘敦实，骨质突起。生物发出哀婉的低哞声，那是对同伴的呼唤。它停下脚步，宽大的耷拉耳朵微微抽动，捕捉着任何潜在威胁的声响。
This lonely herd animal chuffs big, grassy breaths out of a broad pachyderm mouth. Four stodgy legs stump forward, carrying a bulky body that is mottled and patched. The face is stocky with bone. The creature emits a mournful lowing noise, a cry for companionship. It pauses, its broad floppy ears twitching at the sound of potential threats.

Nalfeshnee Encounter.name:
纳弗什尼遭遇
Nalfeshnee Encounter

Text.text:
这头高大臃肿的生物兼具猿、野猪与秃鹫最令人作呕的特征。两条短粗的腿拖着它庞大而佝偻的躯体前行。弯刀般的獠牙拱起，框住那张布满利齿、腐臭翻涌的巨口；狡黠漆黑的眼睛则从沉重下垂的眉脊下恶狠狠地盯视着你。自这头生物身上散出的气味只能用“噩梦”来形容，而当它扑棱着背后的羽翼时，你只恨自己没站在世界上任何别的地方。
This towering, corpulent creature possesses the worst features of ape, boar, and vulture. Two stunted legs carry its massive, slouched frame. Sweeping tusks frame its toothy, putrid maw, while eyes—cunning and black—glare from beneath a heavy, slouched brow. The smell emanating from this creature could only be described as nightmarish, and, as it flutters the feathered wings at its back, you wish to be standing just about anywhere else.

Taking A Voice Modulation Pill.name:
服下一枚变声药丸
Taking A Voice Modulation Pill

Text.text:
蓝白相间的药丸顺喉而下。霎时间，一股尖锐的柑橘味在你口中炸开，继而喉咙里泛起嘶嘶的气泡感，你的颈部肌肉随即颤抖、扭结。怪声从胸腔里咕噜咕噜地冒出来——诡异的尖叫与嚎啕。你试着开口，听到自己吐出的声音，脸上掠过一丝惊惶：先是一串孩子气的咯咯笑，接着是低沉单调的咆哮，然后是一连串刺耳的嗝噎。终于，你的颈部肌肉松弛下来。不适止息。可你的嗓音……
Down the blue-and-white pill goes. Instantly a sharp taste of citrus fills your mouth, followed by a fizzing in your throat, then your neck muscles tremor and twist. Noises bubble up out of your chest—weird squawks and howls. You try to speak, and a look of alarm crosses your face at the sounds that emerge: first a childish giggle, then a deep monotonous growl, and then a series of abrasive hiccups. Eventually, your neck muscles relax. The discomfort stops. But as for your voice…

Rose Inlay And Chandelier.name:
玫瑰嵌饰与枝形吊灯
Rose Inlay And Chandelier

Text.text:
吊灯里的蜡烛依旧燃着，仿佛执拗地要替它们的主人维系那份庄严，哪怕其中几支已被它的重量压得扁碎。水晶的残骸铺天盖地地吞没了镶嵌地板的大半片区域，使人无法直接靠近楼梯。然而那些地砖不知为何竟毫发无损。
Candles within the chandelier remain lit, as if persistent to maintain the majesty of their host even though some of them have been squished under its weight. The crystalline carnage overtakes a great portion of the inlaid floor, making it impossible to approach the staircase directly. The tile, somehow, appears unscathed by this event.

那些令你的目标愕然的自毁指令荒诞不经，自相矛盾。当装置像呕吐般喷出一串仿佛键盘乱砸的输出时，你就知道自己甩出了虚拟世界里等同于一记反手耳光的打击。他们被戳了两次：先是受损的科技本身，再是眼睁睁看着工具背叛自己时那阵刺痛。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The self-defeating directives that shock your target are nonsensical and contradictory. When the device vomits output resembling a keyboard smash, you know you’ve dealt the virtual equivalent of a backhanded slap. They get jabbed twice: the damaged tech itself, plus the sting of watching their tools fail them.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Potion Of Invisibility.name:
隐形药水
Potion Of Invisibility

Text.text:
起初，你几乎可以断定这支药水小瓶已经被倒空了——瓶中看不见一丝液体；但当你轻轻晃动那只密封的容器时，却又确信自己感到里面有液体在晃荡拍打。
At first, it seems quite likely that this potion vial has been emptied as you see no fluid within, but as you swish the sealed container you are convinced you feel liquid sloshing around inside.

Bored Exotic Dancer.name:
无聊的异域舞者
Bored Exotic Dancer

Text.text:
舞者的胯部以流畅的圆弧起伏摆动，薄纱胸衣与开衩短裙在紫外灯下泛着幽光。某种体内科技点亮了她的眼睛，漾起淡粉的辉芒，恰与泡泡糖色的发丝相映，那头发顺着肩头倾泻而下。然而，即便这炫目的效果、以及她汗光淋漓的腹部与大腿、手臂的起伏变换，也遮不住她脸上漫上来的彻底倦怠。她那经由人工丰润的双唇噘起，酸意真切。装在眼下的虹彩板看起来几乎和黑眼圈无异。她下颌短暂绷紧，眼眶涌出玫瑰色的泪水——你这才意识到，她几乎是在竭力压住一个哈欠。
The dancer’s hips undulate in fluid circles, the sheer fabric of her bra and slit skirt luminescent under the ultraviolet lights. Some internal tech lights up her eyes with a pinkish glow that perfectly matches the bubblegum-toned tresses flowing over her shoulders. But even this dazzling effect and the shifting of her sweat-sheened stomach, thighs, and arms cannot hide the utter ennui overtaking her expression. The pout of her artificially plumped lips is sincerely sour. The iridescent plates installed under her eyes may as well be dark circles. Her jaw clenches for a moment, her eyes watering rosy tears—and you realize she is barely suppressing a yawn.

漆黑的词句从你灰烬般的唇间滴落，一阵刺骨寒风在你腿边狂卷，裹挟着缕缕幽影般的暗脉盘旋。那些形体微微摇曳，仿佛短暂卡在不同世界的夹缝之间。可触的恐惧攥紧你的胸口，湿土与腐朽的恶臭直扑你的感官。缕缕灵质般的薄雾在你身周凝聚成死亡的裹尸衣，暴怒的亡魂蓄势待发，准备执行你的意志。
Dark words drip from your ashen lips and a chilling wind whips around your legs, swirling with veins of umbral shadow. Their forms seem to shimmer, as if momentarily caught between differing worlds. Palpable dread constricts your chest, the stink of damp earth and decay assailing your senses. Tendrils of ectoplasmic mist coalesce around you as a shroud of death, angry souls ready to do your will.

I Cast Secret Chest.name:
我施放了「秘法宝箱」
I Cast Secret Chest

Text.text:
我把一只手按在箱子的胸口处，先停了一瞬，欣赏它繁复华丽的纹饰，随后从背包里取出那只复制品。我攥紧复制品，施展法术。耳边轰然一响，仿佛巨钟震鸣，回声在指骨间颤动；紧接着，又是一声清脆的小铃叮咚。铃声渐息之际，真箱微微一颤，随即消失无踪——被送往一处安全的异界空间，直到我再次唤回它。我把复制品抛向空中，接住它，收回背包深处，妥帖藏好。
I place one hand on the chest, taking a moment to admire its ornate design before taking the replica from my pack. I close my hand around the replica and cast the spell. I hear the sound and feel the reverberation of a large bell, immediately followed by the sound of a small chime. As the chime fades, the real chest shivers and vanishes—sent to a safe, extraplanar place until I call it back again. I toss the replica into the air, catch it, and tuck it away safely in my pack.

银白的光幕掠过施法者的肩甲，沿着背脊倾泻而下，将其装点得宛如古时披袍的骑士。他们的性相染上圣洁的暖意，力量在体内奔涌，双眼因骤然降临的使命而炽燃。在每一位近旁盟友的眼中，同样的意志也随之苏醒。
Across the pauldrons and down their back, a silvery sheet of light bedecks the caster, like a robed knight of old. Their aspect takes on a holy warmth as strength courses through them, and their eyes blaze with sudden purpose. In the eyes of each nearby ally, a similar purpose awakens.

I Use Fast Hands To Use An Object.name:
我用「迅捷之手」来使用一个物体
I Use Fast Hands To Use An Object

Text.text:
我受过精准与速度的训练。因此，在别人拔出一把武器的时代里，我就能拔出两把；又或者在不减慢动作的情况下，顺手拉开一扇门，或拨开窗扣。多做一点小动作，并不会妨碍我完成真正重要的事。
I’ve trained for precision and speed. So I can draw two weapons in the time it takes others to draw one, or open a door or a window latch without slowing down. Doing a little extra doesn’t prevent me from doing the important stuff.

七辆色彩斑斓的篷车与一辆涂绘得花枝招展的货车停在旷野里，围着噼啪作响的篝火呈环形排开。拉车的马匹与并行骑乘的小马驹在近旁的山丘上低头啃食青草。营地里有人拉着小提琴，另一个人在放声歌唱——显然唱的还是两首不同的曲子。
Seven colorful caravans and a gaily painted wagon stand in the field, circled around a crackling fire. The horses that pull these wagons and the ponies ridden alongside them crop the grass on a nearby hill. Someone in the camp is playing a fiddle, and another is singing—apparently two different songs.

Cybernetic Cranial Augmentation +2.name:
义体颅内强化装置 +2
Cybernetic Cranial Augmentation +2

Text.text:
头颅的四分之一已被一层黄铜般的金属替换，在光线下泛着偏黄的冷亮。这一象限覆盖了左眼——如今那只眼变成一条狭窄的黑色碳质长方形。脑干与小脑之间，被一团杂乱的交错钢丝硬生生接续在一起。口腔内部多处也被植入体取代，隐隐透出暗淡的猩红微光。新近手术留下的激光灼痕在皮肉上纵横交错，颅骨周围还萦绕着一层噪动般的毛刺光晕。偶尔，一点蓝色电火花会从金属覆板上迸射而出。

~ 由一位英雄构想

One quarter of the head has been replaced with a brassy metal that glints yellow in the light. This quarter includes the left eye, which is now a narrow black carbon rectangle. The brain stem connects to the cerebellum with a messy mass of interlocking steel wires. Much of the inside of the mouth has been replaced with implants glowing a faint scarlet.
