Overclocked Brute Uses An Adrenaline Inj.name:
超频蛮牛使用肾上腺素注射器
Overclocked Brute Uses An Adrenaline Injector

Text.text:
随着一记凌厉的刺入，针头扎进一条在前臂上鼓胀跳动的血管——那条前臂粗得几乎像寻常男人的一条腿。那头蛮兽猛地仰起头，发出濒死巨熊般的咆哮。肾上腺素沿着他紫色的血管渗开，迅速染成病态的酸橙绿。他沉重的喘息愈发深沉，兴奋剂让他的眼球凸出。那被强化的肌肉竟还在继续膨胀，膨胀到超越常理的地步。点点涎沫从他贪婪张合的巨口边缘滴落。
With a sharp stab, the needle punctures a throbbing vein in a forearm the size of a regular man’s leg. The brute throws his head back with the roar of a dying bear. Adrenaline seeps through his purple veins, quickly turning a sickly lime green. His heavy breaths deepen, and his eyes bulge with the stimulant. Somehow, his enhanced muscles swell further, beyond the realms of possibility. Flecks of spittle drip from his slavering maw.

Ankheg Encounter.name:
甲壳巨蚁遭遇
Ankheg Encounter

Text.text:
你脚下传来一阵闷雷般的震动，大地随之错位塌陷。你还来不及反应，一只体型如战马般的昆虫状生物破土而出。它披覆着漆黑的甲壳，从巢穴中攀爬而起，颚钳咔哒作响，带着迫不及待的饥渴。细长的肢节托着它疾冲向前，带钩的前足利爪横扫而来，直取你身。
You feel a rumble beneath your feet and the ground shifts. Before you can react, an insectoid creature the size of a warhorse bursts forth. Plated in a dark carapace, the beast clambers from its burrow, mandibles chittering in anticipation. Spindly limbs carry it forward, and its clawed forelegs swipe for you.

Champion Of Winter.name:
寒冬勇冠军
Champion Of Winter

Text.text:
被这个位面不老的妖精环绕着，你面前那名披甲骑士显得格格不入；凡俗的重量清晰地压在他们历经战火的面容上。站姿如铁般僵硬，却又能若无其事地把手滑向腰间那柄杀气森然的剑柄——这份肃然的威权与令人敬畏的气势油然而生：一名并非此世之人，却肩负守护此世之责的战士。
Surrounded by the ageless faeries of this plane, the armored knight before you strikes an odd countenance, the weight of mortality clearly evident on their battle-weathered visage. The rigidity of their stance, paired with the ease with which their hand strays to the hilt of the deadly-looking blade at their belt, generates an air of authority and awe—a warrior not of this world, but charged with its defense.

Rally Before Marching To The Dark Tower.name:
进军黑暗高塔前的集结
Rally Before Marching To The Dark Tower

Text.text:
“我看着你们所有人，看见的不是士兵。不是高贵与卑微。不是来自迥异土地、彼此割裂的族群。我看见的是兄弟与姐妹——因为我们都怀着同一种对正义的渴望而来，那渴望在胸腔里怦然作响……这便让我们血脉相连。看看你身边的人；他们会是让你活下去的那群人。像守护家人一样守护他们，便无人能阻你。我们将以同一个声音驱逐萦绕这片土地的黑暗，因为我们一同扛起荣耀使命的重量……而我们绝不会被拒绝。”

~ 构想：Vahlaron

“As I look at all of you, I do not see soldiers. I do not see high- and lowborn. I do not see divided peoples from disparate lands. I see brothers and sisters, for we have all come here with the same yearning for justice beating in our hearts—and that makes us kin. Look to those around you; they will be the ones keeping you alive. Defend them as you would your family and nothing will stop you. With one voice we will banish the darkness that haunts these lands, for together we carry the weight of glorious purpose… and we will not be denied.”

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

Threat From A Fanatical Alien Order.name:
来自狂热异星教团的威胁
Threat From A Fanatical Alien Order

Text.text:
“你的存在玷污此地。你的呼吸污染了圣化的空气。你的血肉嘲弄神祇的律法。我们将剥除那身血肉。我们会在吾等教团的光辉中净化你。而当你咽下最后一口气时，你会为此感谢我们。”
“Your presence defiles this place. Your breath pollutes sanctified air. Your flesh mocks the rules of the gods. We will remove that flesh. We will cleanse you in the light of our order. And with your dying breath, you will thank us for it.”

鼻尖微动，巨耳警觉竖立；在军营喧嚣之中，一位神秘的指挥官巍然屹立。他筋肉结实的身躯裹着深褐色皮毛，胸前一道白痕如虔诚的徽记般闪耀。金色的眼眸燃着智慧的光，扫视着周遭部队的操练；长着胡须的面庞上，沉思之色挥之不去。就在护喉甲上方，一道参差的疤痕攀上他的喉间——那是早已刻进血肉的荣誉勋章。尽管身披蛇鳞护甲，这位妖精战士却步伐如舞者般轻盈，异界的优雅缠绕着他的身形。他的右臂裸露，点缀紫花的藤蔓沿臂纠缠盘绕，骄傲地昭示着他与自然的契约。背上负着一张乌黑长弓，弓身刻满纹饰；腰侧悬着一柄小巧却致命的短剑，指尖从不远离剑柄。仿佛异域香水般，肉桂的气息萦绕在他身周——为他那难以参透的气场又添一层迷雾。

~ 由 Marshall Omarii Wembe 扮演

Nose twitching, huge ears rampant, an enigmatic commander stands tall amid the bustle of a military camp. His sinewy body is sheathed in dark brown fur, with a streak of white upon his chest gleaming like a devotional symbol. Golden eyes, burning with intelligence, scan the drill of the troops about him, a look of contemplation on his whiskered face. Just above his gorget, a jagged scar climbs his throat, a badge of honor long etched in his flesh. Despite serpent-scale armor, this fey warrior moves with the grace of a dancer, a sense of otherworldly elegance coiling about his form. His right arm is bare, and violet-adorned vines twist about its length, a proud depiction of a pact with nature. Upon his back is an ebon bow, its surface etched with carvings, and at his hip hangs a small but deadly shortsword, his fingertip never far from its hilt. Like an exotic perfume, the scent of cinnamon fills the air around him—yet another layer of his inscrutable aura.

~ Played by Marshall Omarii Wembe

I Cast Death Ward.name:
我施放死亡守护
I Cast Death Ward

Text.text:
我将手按在我的盟友身上，开始吟诵那回荡如钟的咒语，护他们免于死亡——至少，能撑过一段时代。我的手渐渐冰冷，我以心神触及命运的丝线，凝神守护我的友人。随着我吐出最后一个音节，法术就此完成，喉间涌上苦胆般的酸意，腹中一阵剧痛绞紧。无人能抗拒死亡而不付出代价；它总会从你身上取走一些作为回报。
I place my hand on my ally and begin the sonorous incantation to protect them from death—at least for a time. My hand grows cold as I reach for the strands of fate with my mind and concentrate on protecting my friend. As I speak the last syllable and complete the spell, bile rises in my throat and a pain twists my gut. One cannot protect against death without it taking something in return.

Ruminations On Light Spell.name:
关于光亮法术的沉思
Ruminations On Light Spell

Text.text:
这道法术的咒词并不固定。巫师也许会把某种特定的吟诵方式传给学徒，而教会则可能奉上一段专门的祷文；然而，让它的魔法成形的方法，和它能用来照亮世界的色彩一样多。或许，能如此轻易地把光带入黑暗，本身就道出了魔法的本性。
The words to this spell vary. A wizard might pass a particular method down to a student, while a church might propose a special prayer, but there are as many ways to bring its magic into being as there are the hues by which it can illuminate the world. Perhaps it says something about the nature of magic that bringing light into darkness proves so easy.

Portal In The Floor.name:
地板上的传送门
Portal In The Floor

Text.text:
一阵噼啪作响的电火花攫住你的目光，你低头望去，只见地面上紫色火星在一圈宽阔的圆环内弹跳四溅。光芒在这道明亮的环上嘶嘶旋绕，继而朝中心盘旋汇聚，又猛然向外炸开回荡至边缘，最终凝成一片稳定、平坦的紫罗兰光之位面，安静地铺展在地上。
An electric crackle draws your attention to the floor, where purple sparks bounce up in a broad circle. Light sizzles around and around this bright ring then swirls toward the center before exploding back out to the edges, creating a steady flat plane of violet light that lies placidly on the ground.

Tiefling Enclave.name:
提夫林聚居地
Tiefling Enclave

Text.text:
远离这片地区他人窥探的目光与评判的冷眼，那处由自称具备魔裔族裔者居住的聚居地始终维持着谨慎而周密的戒备。曾不止一次有人试图将提夫林赶出这片土地——但这座聚居地既因迫不得已而生，如今也已长成一方值得为之拼死守护的避风港。它在大多数方面与人类定居点并无二致，却仍有些细微差别：椅子会特意加固并留出空间，以容纳那些沉重的尾巴；公共建筑里则隐约飘着一丝硫磺的辛辣气味。
Away from the prying eyes and judgmental glances of others in the region, the enclave inhabited by those claiming fiendish ancestry maintains a careful security. More than one attempt has been made to roust the tieflings from this land—but where the enclave sprang from necessity, it has grown into a haven worth fighting for. Though indistinguishable in most respects from a human settlement, there are subtle differences: chairs are constructed to accommodate those with hefty tails, and there is a faint tang of brimstone in communal buildings.

Sundries From A Troll.name:
巨魔杂货
Sundries From A Troll

Text.text:
在巨魔焦灼的尸体上，你找到一条项链：用一只寻常牛科牲畜的头骨制成，悬在一截破烂的链条上。骨质褪色开裂——显然这东西是在某个久远的时代打造的。
On the sizzling corpse of the troll, you find a necklace crafted from the skull of a common bovine, hanging on a tattered chain. The bone is faded and cracked—clearly this was made some time ago.

Vampire Bounty Notice.name:
吸血鬼（特征）悬赏告示
Vampire Bounty Notice

Text.text:
这张告示绘在一卷厚实的卷轴上，用钉子牢牢钉在路旁的木桩上——重要到不屑于用寻常纸页随手张贴。墨黑的字迹娴熟而谨慎，写着：“悬赏。取食肉者之首，及其心脏钉桩示众——嗜血者，上帝面前的可憎之物。”文字中央画着一张瘦削的脸：眉骨高耸，颧骨锋利，长发垂落，微笑的嘴角淌下血珠。制作者显然格外用心，特意将那些血滴涂成鲜红。
This is painted on a thick scroll and nailed into a post by the road. Too important for just any paper flyer. The black lettering is skilled and careful, and it reads: “REWARD. For the head and staked heart of the Eater of Flesh, Blood Drinker, Abomination before God.” Centered among the writing is a drawing of a lean face, high brows and cheekbones, long hair, and blood dripping from the corners of a smile. The maker of the notice has taken special care to paint the blood drops in red.

浓烟如幔，林冠间烈火狂啸。火舌缠住树梢，将其撕裂——燃烧的碎焰如雨倾泻在灌木丛上。就连潮湿的枯木也被引燃，噼啪炸裂，迸出成片火星与燃烧的树皮。走兽惊跳，飞禽掠空，仓皇逃离这被蹂躏的家园。
Through a shroud of smoke, fire rages in the canopy. Flames wrap the treetops and rip them apart—raining fire on the underbrush. Even damp logs catch, crack, then burst in showers of embers and blazing bark. Beasts bound and swoop past, fleeing their ravaged home.

Engineered Adamantine Suit.name:
精工艾德曼合金战衣
Engineered Adamantine Suit

Text.text:
这套闪耀的战衣堪称个人战场科技的巅峰，将惊人的防护与毁灭性的武装融为一体，尽数归于穿戴者身上。护甲的甲片上镌刻着流光溢彩的蓝色符文，交织成一张繁复的纹网：相连的印记与地脉线一路汇入中央核心——一枚灿然的蓝色宝石，随着佩戴者的心跳在时代里明灭脉动。

~ 构想由 Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The gleaming suit is the pinnacle of personal battlefield technology, offering the wearer incredible protection and devastating weaponry all in one. Shimmering blue runes adorn the plates of the armor, forming a complex web of connected sigils and ley lines connected to the central core: a radiant blue gemstone which pulses in time with the wearer’s heartbeat.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Arrival At Port In A Major City.name:
抵达大城港口
Arrival At Port In A Major City

Text.text:
在卡斯玛拉——这座大陆最大的城市——短短一周之内，来自邻近诸国的数百艘战舰、桨帆船与护卫舰便在海湾抛锚，或沿着深水港的码头并排停靠。抛锚的船只放下货艇，驶向那片葱翠宽阔的栈桥。龙裔与半兽人、精灵与半身人，以及人类并肩劳作，装卸香料与货物、材料——或粗砺原始，或精炼成形——而卡斯玛拉的学者穿行其间。造船匠为船只装配“龙首”，使其能从舰艏喷吐烈焰，或架设火炮与攻城器械。艺术家则在船体上描绘奥术符文。

~ Envisioned by goblinman

In one week at Casmara, the continent’s largest city, hundreds of warships, galleys, and frigates from neighboring kingdoms anchor in the bay or alongside docks in the deepwater harbor. Those at anchor send their cargo boats to the lush green and spacious piers. Dragonborn and half-orc, elf and halfling, and humans, together load and unload spices and stock, materials raw and refined, as scholars of Casmara walk among them. Shipwrights fit vessels with "Dragonheads" that spout fire from the bow of the ship, or set cannons and artillery. Artists paint the hulls with arcane runes.

~ Envisioned by goblinman

Shapes In The Stooks.name:
垛影迷形
Shapes In The Stooks

Text.text:
你猛然惊觉，麦捆之间还站着别的“人”。一颗颗苍白的头颅、漆黑的眼睛与伸展的四肢，潜伏在一垛垛麦架之中与其后。但当你认出那些一动不动的身影只是稻草人时，心头才稍稍一松。它们的脸是用麻袋涂抹深色颜料勾成的，而身躯看起来不过是塞满干草的旧衣裳。
You realize with a start that others stand among the sheafs of grain. Pale heads with dark eyes and outstretched limbs lurk within and behind the stooks. But you relax a little when you recognize the motionless figures as scarecrows. Sacks daubed with dark paint make their faces, while their bodies seem to be nothing more than old clothes stuffed with hay.

双手铁钳般紧扣彼此前臂，仿佛将牢不可破的情谊基石铸进骨里。一个朴素而高洁的礼节，自远古时代沿袭至今，超越国界、文化与政治的一切藩篱。
Hands clasp forearms in an iron grip, cementing the unshakeable foundations of camaraderie. A simple, honorable gesture practiced since time immemorial that transcends all national, cultural, and political barriers.

Color-programmable Clothing.name:
可变色编程服饰
Color-programmable Clothing

Text.text:
一块小巧的HUD被织入衬衫内侧的衣领。轻轻一触，明亮的黄料便流转为温暖的橙色。再点一下，它又变成淡淡的蓝。你在设置里摆弄片刻，衣料上随即涌起一团旋转的彩虹漩涡，缤纷色彩在衣身上翩然起舞。
A small HUD is woven into the shirt's inside collar. With a tap, the bright yellow material shifts into a warm orange. Another tap, and it's pale blue. Playing with the settings for a short time results in a swirling vortex of rainbow colors dancing on the garment.

一股骇人的热浪自这群兽人身上辐射开来。他们的肤色从灰烬般的苍灰，到近乎夜色般的墨绿不一而足；头发则如野性鬃毛般疯长，闪着抛光铜色的光泽，或呈血红，或如乌鸦羽毛般漆黑。许多人扛着巨大的武器——石首大槌，以及黑曜般黑玻璃铸成的巨剑与巨斧——却看不出半点被重量拖累的迹象。他们高大得惊人，甚至在兽人之中也尤为出众；那双闷燃的余烬橙眼与隆隆回荡的嗓音，逼得人不由自主地侧目。笑声是疲惫而干裂的火焰噼啪，战吼却如柴堆烈焰般轰然咆哮。

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

A great heat radiates from the presence of this band of orcs, whose skin tones range from ashen gray to an almost night-black shade of green. Their hair grows in wild manes of burnished copper, blood red, and raven black. Many carry large weapons—stone-headed mauls, as well as greatswords and greataxes of black glass—and show no signs of being burdened by the weight. They are tall, even for orcs, and command attention with their smoldering, ember-orange eyes and rumbling voices. When they laugh, it is a haggard crackle of fire, while their battle cries are like the roaring of pyre flames.

~ Envisioned by Vahlaron

Mine Overrun By Wyrmlings.name:
矿井遭幼龙群侵占
Mine Overrun By Wyrmlings

Text.text:
泥泞的空地上布满了脚印，坑坑洼洼。这座矿井是最近才被弃置的——而且走得很仓促。你靠近山坡上那些用木料加固、星星点点的入口之一时，上方骤然传来一声尖厉的长啸，回音在山壁间炸开。一个幼龙从上坡的巷道口爬了出来，蹲踞在一块岩石顶端。它舒展起薄如皮膜的翅翼，鳞片在光里冷亮一闪。它又抛出一声顽皮的挑衅，随即抓挠着退回矿洞深处。它的尖叫从矿井内部层层回荡。
The muddy field is pocked with footprints. This mine was abandoned recently—and hastily. Upon approaching one of the timber-reinforced entrances dotting the mountainside, a shrieking cry echoes from above. A wyrmling crawls out from an adit upslope and perches atop a rock. Its scales gleam as it stretches its membranous wings. It throws out another playful taunt before scrabbling back inside the mine. Its screams echo from within.

Settlement Overlook During Winter.name:
冬季俯瞰聚落
Settlement Overlook During Winter

Text.text:
当你背对祭祀之地，俯瞰下方的世界时，依旧能感觉到那股恶毒的存在在身后蛰伏。也许正是这份寒意，让眼前的景象显得格外阴郁。厚重的云层掠过群山，坠落的雪花为万物披上一层白色帷幕，吞没了所有声响，只剩风的低语。忽然，雾霭裂开，露出一丝生机：几幢建筑蜷缩在一片枯槁林木间。一抹蜿蜒的微光穿过雾与雪闪烁——那是一条冰冷的河流，在聚落旁的桥下流淌。尽管这景象孤寂，却仍让你感到些许慰藉；然而云层很快又合拢，将它重新遮蔽。
When you turn your back on the sacrifice site and look out to the world below, you can still sense its malignant presence behind you. Perhaps it’s that feeling that makes the vista feel so gloomy. Thick clouds drift over the mountains, with falling snow drawing a white veil over all and deadening any noise but the whisper of the wind. Then mists part, revealing a hint of life. A few buildings huddle within a forest of barren trees. A sinuous sliver of light glimmers through the fog and snow—an icy river that flows under a bridge beside the settlement. The lonely sight nevertheless gives you some comfort before the clouds again obscure it from view.

Elf Spellsword.name:
精灵咒刃战士
Elf Spellsword

Text.text:
一抹玉色幽辉洗亮这位咒剑士，她跋涉在葱郁密林间，弯刀利落劈开一路阻碍。她伸出的手掌上，一团碧绿能量盘旋凝聚，内敛的力量让周遭树影忽明忽暗。她鳞甲轻柔的沙沙声，早已淹没在丛林深处的自然喧嚣之中。
A glow of jade bathes the spellsword as she treks through the verdant jungle, her scimitar making quick work of obstacles. In her outstretched hand a bundle of veridian energy swirls with contained power, causing flickering shadows to be cast by the trees around her. The soft rustle of her scale-mail is lost in the natural cacophony of the jungle depths.

Acidic Slime Hazard.name:
酸性黏液危害
Acidic Slime Hazard

Text.text:
头顶传来一阵怪异的声响，仿佛一大桶液体正被缓慢挪动。你抬头望去，只见一团绿色黏液摇摇欲坠地悬在上方，天花板上还零星点缀着更多细小的胶团。其中一团啪地落在一小堆碎裂木片上，那抹绿色物质嘶嘶作响，竟一路腐蚀熔穿了木材。
A strange sound from above catches your ear, like a large container of liquid being slowly shifted. You look up to find a blob of green slime dangling precariously from above, with other smaller globules dotting the ceiling. One such clump falls onto a small pile of splintered wood, and the green substance melts right through the material with a hiss.

The Hissing Assistant.name:
嘶嘶作响的助理
The Hissing Assistant

Text.text:
你踏入休息室的深处，空气骤然变得粘稠，潮湿的恶臭在鼻腔与喉间翻涌滋长。你的目光不由自主被装点这片空间的骇人肖像牵走——尖啸的幽魂、扭曲的魅影被描绘得狰狞可怖，它们空洞的凝视仿佛随着你踏下吱呀作响的台阶一路追随。
一张古旧的书桌上散落着松散的卷轴与装订成册的厚重书卷；桌后端坐着一只古怪的生物，它那黏腻的漆黑皮肉似乎不受约束地自行搏动、蠕动。它不耐地嘶了一声，随即转向你——用沙哑的耳语质问你，为何而来。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

The air becomes thick as you descend into the lounge, the squalid reek of damp blossoming in your nose and throat. Your eye is drawn to the harrowing portraits decorating the space, ghastly works of screaming ghosts and writhing specters, whose hollow gazes seem to follow you as you descend the creaking steps. Seated at an ancient desk covered in loose scrolls and bound volumes, sits a curious creature whose slimy black flesh seems to pulse and writhe of its own accord. With a hiss of annoyance it turns toward you before demanding—in a rasping whisper—to know why you have come.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Don The Tortle Armorer.name:
龟族护甲匠唐
Don The Tortle Armorer

Text.text:
一位饱经风霜的战士立在你面前，皮革般粗硬的外皮上爬满陈年伤痕——最骇人的，是一道巨大的裂口，将他那层补丁累累的甲壳劈开。黑曜石珠般的锐利眼睛扫视着区域，龟甲般的面容上死死压着一抹阴沉。他用带着地方口音的腔调低声嘟囔，念叨的多是酸痛与旧疾。

当他弯腰捡起背包时，他护甲背后的巧思才彻底显露：抛光钢铁与精密齿轮铸成的奇迹，与他残存的天然防御融为一体。诡异的符号在那布满凹痕的表面上游走，点点魔法从符文间渗出。收紧行装后，这名虬结的身影将玄奥的臂铠重重一合，黄铜内腔里爆出一声震雷般的回响。栖在他肩头的睿智老猫头鹰被惊得尖叫一声，惹得战士低笑，摇了摇他那灰白粗糙的脑袋。

~ Played by a Hero

A weathered warrior stands before you, leathery hide crawling with a host of old wounds—the worst, a huge rent splitting his much-patched shell. Keen eyes, like pearls of obsidian, scan the area, a frown plastered across his chelonian features. He mutters to himself in a regional drawl, mostly about aches and pains. When he stoops to pick up his pack the genius behind his armor is revealed: a marvel of polished steel and intricate gears, merging with the remains of his natural defenses. Eldritch symbols scuttle across its pitted surface, motes of magic seeping from the runes. Securing his belongings, the gnarled figure claps his esoteric gauntlets together, a thunderous retort issuing from their brazen innards. The wise old owl perched atop his shoulder utters a surprised squawk, causing the warrior to chuckle and shake his grizzled head.

~ Played by a Hero

New King Accepts Cursed Royal Blade.name:
新王接纳被诅咒的王室利刃
New King Accepts Cursed Royal Blade

Text.text:
新王紧攥着父亲长剑的剑柄，身体一缩，仿佛体内有什么被惊醒。四周世界随火把的摇曳渐渐昏沉、暗去，一道声音自虚无回响而来。无人听懂那些词句，但其中意图昭然：他必须立下誓约。 他合上双眼，低声应允——剑在他掌中骤然明亮，剑首镶嵌的宝石化作耀眼灯塔般的光源。新王猛地倒抽一口气，随即向前一扑——像被某种无形之力牵引——他沉默而恍惚地注视着：自己的一缕灵魂如薄雾般的火焰从躯壳中飘出，被那柄剑吸纳而去。

~ Envisioned by Tuttlepants on Discord

Grasping the hilt of his father's blade, the new king cringes, as though something within him stirs. The world around him grows darker as the torches flicker and fade, and a voice echoes from the void. Though no one understands the words, their intent is clear: he must pledge himself. Closing his eyes, he agrees, and the sword grows bright in his hands as the gemstone set in the pommel becomes a radiant beacon. The new king gasps for breath and lunges forward—as if pulled by some unseen force—and he watches in silent reverie as a piece of his soul drifts from his body like a wispy flame and is drawn into the sword.

~ Envisioned by Tuttlepants on Discord

Temple District With Many Places Of Wors.name:
神殿区：祈祷圣所林立
Temple District With Many Places Of Worship

Text.text: [外部] 这座覆以大理石的建筑或许曾是某位强大神祇的专属神殿；而今其中塞满了献给上百位小神的微型圣龛。方形建筑群的外墙凿出一排壁龛——有的绘着湿壁画——每个都大得足以容下 一张桌子，上面层层堆着可供售卖的圣遗物仿品。一处壁龛里，传教者朝空中吐出炽烈的布道；另一处，两名礼拜者盘腿而坐，沉入冥想。那道醒目的拱门引人入内，拱门前一座被时代侵蚀的石质喷泉——或许比神殿本身还古老——在供奉的钱币映照下闪着微光。 [内部] 迎面涌来的是人声的浪潮：歌唱与诵念交织，脚踝铃铛叮当作响，指钹发出尖细的哀鸣。内里是一处露台，盆栽沿边排列，穹顶敞开直通天空；可这点通风仍不足以驱散彼此争胜的各式熏香所混成的刺鼻气味。空间里扎着一片真正的帆布帐篷村落——更多圣龛，由来自不同族裔的传教士搭建，用以敬奉那些更新近、也更少为人知的神祇。有些访客目标明确地走向某座圣龛，虔诚而专注；另一些则漫无目的地闲逛，把这场景当作市集般的巴扎。也有不少帐篷干脆无人看守，信众们三三两两聚成小团，交换流言。一只小猪崽松松垮垮地从旁窜过。 [Outside] The marble-clad building may once have been the dedicated temple of a major god; now, it contains tiny shrines to a hundred lesser ones. The outside walls of this square complex contain alcoves—some decorated in frescoes—each big enough to contain a table stacked with salable replicas of holy relics. A preacher spits fiery sermons into the air from one alcove, while, in another, two worshipers sit cross-legged, lost in meditation. In front of the prominent arch beckoning the curious inside, a time-ravaged stone fountain, possibly predating the temple itself, glints with offerings of coins. [Inside] You are met with a swell of voices, singing and chanting, accompanied by the jingle of ankle bells and keening of finger cymbals. The interior is a terrace, lined with potted plants and open to the sky. This proves insufficient to disperse the reek of competing types of incense. A veritable village of canvas tents occupy the space—more shrines, built to honor newer and lesser-known deities by missionaries of various ancestries. Some visitors walk purposefully to a specific shrine, fervent and focused. Others stroll idly, treating the whole spectacle like a market bazaar. More than a few tents are not staffed at all, as the faithful gather in small pockets to exchange rumors. A loose piglet runs by.

I Cast Bestow Curse.name:
我施放「赐予诅咒」
I Cast Bestow Curse

Text.text:
我厉声咒骂，直呼其名以作感召，随即甩出一记耳光。我能感觉到法术击中并渗入我的目标体内，只等那阵迷乱降临——踉跄的暴怒，以及接踵而至的糟糕决定。
I shout out a curse, calling to it by name, then deliver a slap. I can feel the spell connect and absorb into my target, and I wait for the befuddlement, the stumbling outrage, and the bad decisions.

Road Into The Forest.name:
通往森林的道路
Road Into The Forest

Text.text:
当你走上岔路，脚下的路面由石铺渐渐变作泥土。继续前行，旅人们的喧哗逐步消散，取而代之的是鸟鸣与虫振的嗡响。远处一堵树墙般的林海逼近，路径愈发狭窄，直至没入森林——两侧杂草越长越高。大自然正一点点收回通往林中的小路。
As you take the fork in the road it turns from stone to dirt. As you continue, the chatter of travelers dies away, replaced by the call of birds and buzz of insects. A wall of trees looms in the distance, and the path narrows as it disappears into the forest—the weeds reaching higher along the sides. Nature is slowly reclaiming the path into the forest.

Sundries From An Ogre.name:
食人魔的杂烩
Sundries From An Ogre

Text.text:
倒下的食人魔尸身恶臭扑鼻，死后与生前一样令人作呕，僵硬地堆成一团。它的大棒在最后几下重击中从中劈裂；一块弯曲的肩甲用一段绳子挂在它脖子上——一件粗陋的护甲，却被这生物当作吊坠佩戴。支撑兜裆布的腰带上别着一根粗大的骨头，形似股骨，上面还挂着几块肉——那是留待稍后享用的骇人零嘴。
The fallen ogre, its stinking corpse as foul in death as it was in life, lies in a motionless heap. Its greatclub has split down the middle from its final hammerings, and a bent pauldron hangs on a length of rope about its neck, a piece of simple armor the creature seems to have worn as a medallion. A large bone resembling a femur is nestled into the belt that holds up its loincloth, the bone still sporting a few chunks of meat—a grisly snack saved for a later time.

Humorous Musical Dragon.name:
滑稽的音乐巨龙
Humorous Musical Dragon

Text.text:
整个房间里，你听见零碎的叮铃、风铃般的脆响、咔哒作响与颤音——机械的旋律从各式怪异装置中流淌而出。在这座由黄金与黄铜构成的巢穴中央，一条巨龙慵懒盘踞，随着近旁器械奏出的曲调轻轻点头。它的利爪下按着一个小型构装体，那东西喷吐火花、嗡鸣震颤，徒劳地挣扎着想要脱身。

~ 由 KC 构想

All about the room, you hear disparate tingles, chimes, clacks, and trills—mechanical melodies emanating from a variety of strange contraptions. In the center of this lair of gold and brass, a dragon lounges, head bobbing to a tune from a nearby device. Under its claw it holds a small construct, which spurts and buzzes as it attempts, in vain, to free itself.

~ Envisioned by KC

Beautiful Brass Brooch.name:
华美的黄铜胸针
Beautiful Brass Brooch

Text.text:
在店铺的柜台上，它在灯笼的光影里如烛火般忽明忽暗。底层是一副青铜骨架，其上巧妙镶饰着层叠的月桂与橡叶。
On the counter at the shop, it flickers like a candle under the lantern lights. The bottom layer is a framework of bronze, to which has been applied an artful arrangement of laurels and oak leaves.

Lament Of A City Watchman.name:
城卫的哀歌
Lament Of A City Watchman

Text.text:
“我发誓，这座城市的每一个拐角、每一处略显幽暗的壁龛，不是闹鬼，就是被诅咒，要么就是某个疯魔邪教的巢穴。我算是明白他们为什么叫我们城卫了——目睹这些恐怖景象，再把它们一笔一笔记下来，几乎就是我们他妈唯一能做的事。”
“I swear every corner and slightly darkened alcove of this city is haunted, cursed, or the den of some maniacal cult. I get why they call us a city watch, because witnessing these horrors and writing them down is the only damn thing we can do.”

Undead Shadow Giant.name:
亡灵·暗影巨人
Undead Shadow Giant

Text.text:
周遭的夜色仿佛在呼吸，一道高耸、隐约类人的轮廓从阴影里剥离而出。那生物迈着细长的腿逼近，前肢邪恶而覆着利爪，长得几乎拖曳着擦过地面。阴影如烟缕般自它身上逸散；它虽有形体，却瘦削无毛的躯干仿佛同样由那团暗影之质凝成。羊般的角从它倾斜的额头狞然弯曲探出，而它深陷的眼窝忽然亮起一抹幽魂般的雾光。
The surrounding night breathes as a towering, vaguely humanoid shape detaches itself from the shadows. The creature strides forward on lanky legs, with wicked and clawed forelimbs long enough to drag along the ground. Shadows waft from it like wisps of smoke, and though corporeal, its gaunt and hairless frame appears composed of the same shadow-stuff. Ram-like horns curve fiendishly from the thing’s sloped forehead, and its sunken eyes suddenly alight with a ghostly vapor.

许多法术都需要练习。恼人的措辞、复杂的手势、笨拙的材料——任何一项都可能阻碍你成功施法。极少有法术会完全依赖另一种技能，或要求你去练习在日常生活中彻底用不上的东西——比如单手速度雕塑！
Many spells require practice. Troublesome wording, complex gestures, unwieldy materials—all can impede successful casting. Few are the spells that rely on another skill entirely or that require you to practice something wholly unnecessary in your normal life—such as one-handed speed sculpting!

一个矮壮的两栖类人披着沾满泥污的短袍逼近，手持石尖长矛，喉间发出低沉而威胁的呱鸣。那呼声在沼泽四周回荡，更多同族随之现身，从咸涩的浑水中浮出，将你们团团围住。
A squat, amphibian humanoid clad in a mud-stained tunic advances, carrying a stone-tipped spear and croaking in a low, threatening manner. The call is echoed around the swamp as others of its tribe reveal themselves, emerging from the brackish waters to surround you.

Mirthful Dwarf Hero.name:
欢乐的矮人英雄
Mirthful Dwarf Hero

Text.text:
矮人豪迈地大笑着，她那粗硬的金色浓发如披风般在身后翻涌，衬出她宽阔健壮的身形，宛如一幅英雄气概的定格画面。一柄巨大的战锤斜搭在一侧肩头，旅行的尘土为她粗犷的皮护甲覆上一层厚重的污垢包浆。她的绿眼闪烁着欢愉的光芒，兴致勃勃地向你讲述她的冒险故事，字句间燃着壮丽使命的火焰。
The dwarf laughs gregariously as her mighty mane of rough, blond hair flows behind her like a cloak, framing her broad physique in a tableau of heroism. An oversized warhammer rests over one shoulder, and the dust of travel coats her rugged leather armor with a thick patina of grime. Her green eyes flash with mirth as she regales you with her tales of adventure, alight with the fire of glorious purpose.

Haeshi-shaa (Shaa Form).name:
海希-沙阿（沙阿形态）
Haeshi-shaa (Shaa Form)

Text.text:
一缕恶意的雾气，腐朽般的褐色，盘旋上升，像一根修长而招引的手指。想透过雾看清几乎不可能——褐色的霾幕对察觉坚不可摧。伴随着这形态而来的是刺鼻的臭味，如硫磺般噬咬着你的鼻腔。雾在扩张——确确实实在扩张。风中飘来一声微弱而幽灵般的嗓音，低哼着一段早已被遗忘、被遗失的祷文。那声音层层叠叠，宛如一支幽冥的合唱团。
A curl of malevolent fog, brown with decay, spirals upward like a long and beckoning finger. Looking through the fog seems impossible, a brown haze impervious to perception. With its shape comes a stench, like sulfur nipping at your nostrils. The fog is expanding—definitely expanding. A faint and ghostlike voice travels on the wind, humming a prayer long forgotten and lost. The voice comes in layers, like an umbral choir.

这柄独特的细剑，其刃由闪耀的银色金属铸成，光泽近乎如液体般流淌；然而观者的目光总会不由自主地被它的护手吸引——那篮式护手丑陋刺眼，却散发着未加掩饰的狱魔之力。因为剑柄以猩红与乌木雕塑而成，宛如某位可怖的魔鬼领主真正的面容——在那钢铁般的怒视中，贪婪与恶意昭然若揭。
A shining silver metal, appearing almost liquid in its sheen, makes up the blade of this unique rapier, but a viewer’s eye is invariably drawn to its basket hilt, hideous to the eye yet radiating raw diabolic power. For the grip of this sword has been fashioned in crimson and ebony to resemble the true face of a hideous lord of devils—avarice and malice plain in its steely glare.

Shadows In The Wind.name:
风中暗影
Shadows In The Wind

Text.text:
从那对深金色眼睛的内眼角延伸出桃木般的深褐线条，勾勒并强调这名猫族人暗色的鼻梁与口鼻。与之相映的线条自外眼角向后渐细，像是带着灰暗的泪痕。他金色的毛皮上点缀着深棕斑点，下巴处颜色变浅，颈部则泛白。他的装束——以钢铆钉加固的棕色皮甲与宽松的短裤——比他的皮毛更朴素，却披着一件鲜亮猩红羊毛斗篷。腰带上斜挂的排箫与旁侧那柄薄刃剑的剑鞘形成鲜明对照。他神态放松，却警觉在身。

~ Played by monkeypushovertree with

Running from the inner corner of each deep-gold eye, mahogany-colored lines define and emphasize this catfolk’s dark nose and muzzle. Mirroring lines taper off each eye’s outer corner, resembling dusky tears. Dappled with dark-brown spots, his golden coat lightens at the chin and whitens on the neck. His garb—brown leather riveted with steel and baggy short trousers—is plainer than his fur, but he wears a cloak of bright scarlet wool. And the pan flute slung on his belt juxtaposes with the thin-bladed sword scabbarded alongside it. He has a relaxed but alert mien.

~ Played by monkeypushovertree with

I Cast Forcecage.name:
我施放力场牢笼
I Cast Forcecage

Text.text:
汗珠自我额前渗出，我全神贯注于这道法术复杂而几何般的手势。将红宝石粉尘抛向空中，我凝神塑形，让闪烁的微粒凝成我欲召唤的轮廓，目送它们彼此缝合。随着法术趋近完成，猩红之光融入粒子之间，汇成一片流光溢彩的能量星座——随即被我释放，直扑敌手。
Sweat beads my brow as I focus on the complex geometric gestures of the spell. Casting the ruby dust into the air I focus on forming the glittering motes into the shape I wish to conjure, watching as they knit together. Crimson light joins the particles as my spell nears completion, forming an iridescent constellation of energy—which I unleash on my foe.

你呼唤木与铁、羽与筋的灵——战与血之灵。你的箭袋随它们的回应而震颤。它们在其中哗啦作响，模仿着已储存的弹药，在你为每一发新箭伸手触及之时跃入你的掌中。放出时，这些灵魂射击将以嗜血的狂喜嚎叫。
You call out to the spirits of wood and iron, feather and sinew—spirits of battle and blood. Your quiver vibrates with their answer. They rattle around inside and mimic the ammunition already stored there, leaping into your grasp as you reach for each new shot. When loosed, these spirit shots will howl with bloodthirsty glee.

那小子八成是新兵。他年轻的身躯还没长到能撑起那身不合身的护甲，也还没把上面的系绳与搭扣摸透。他竭力挺胸抬头、背脊笔直地站着，能撑多久就撑多久，可没过一会儿便垮了肩，长长呼出一口气。你这才意识到——他一直在屏住呼吸。
The lad must be a new recruit. His young body hasn’t yet grown into the ill-fitting armor, and he hasn’t quite mastered all its strings and buckles. He stands with his chest puffed out and back straight for as long as he can, but then he sags and exhales. You realize he had been holding his breath.

Dürrandir Moonshadow.name:
杜兰迪尔·月影
Dürrandir Moonshadow

Text.text:
他一甫踏入王廷，便以优雅的毛边披风一甩，瞬间攫走所有目光。那抹锋利如刃的笑意一闪，他便自信地朝王座大步而去——金属般的皮肤从各个角度折住光线，仿佛天生就要逼人注目。冰蓝的目光落在王后身上，他以娴熟得近乎完美的姿态深深躬身——腰侧一柄邪气森然的利剑随之显露。那大概是他华美装束中最出众的一件：剑柄寒光流转，雕工细致到令人惊叹，竟塑成一张咧笑的恶魔面孔，蝠翼般的双翅大张，恰好化作剑的护手。

~ Played by Antra with

All eyes are drawn to the enigmatic figure as he enters the royal court with a flourish of his elegant fur-lined cloak. Flashing a smile as sharp as any blade he strides confidently toward the throne, the metallic sheen of his skin catching the light from all angles—demanding attention. Piercing blue eyes alight on the queen as he bows low and deep with practiced excellence—revealing a wickedly sharp sword resting at his hip. Arguably the finest piece in his exquisite ensemble, the gleaming hilt is sculpted with astonishing detail to resemble a grinning devil, its bat-like wings spread wide to form the sword’s guard.

~ Played by Antra with

Peddler Of Talismans.name:
护符行商
Peddler Of Talismans

Text.text:
这道身影仿佛一场失控的风暴——动作、质感、喧嚣与色彩纠缠翻涌。这个半身人的外套上挂满了小小的人偶、缠绕的草药束、金属手镯以及各式稀奇古怪的物件，它们用细绳穿过骨质纽扣垂在外侧，随着步伐叮当作响。她又举起一把别的饰物，你瞥见她斗篷内侧同样缀满护符，只是看上去更昂贵、更讲究。
The figure is a riot of motion, texture, noise, and color. Little figures, bits of entwined herbs, metal bangles, and other curios dangle from the outside of this halfling’s coat, suspended from strings around bone buttons. She holds up a fistful of other trinkets, and you see the inside of her cloak bears similar but more expensive-looking talismans.

Elf Insult About Mortal Skin.name:
精灵对凡人皮囊的蔑辱嘲讽
Elf Insult About Mortal Skin

Text.text:
“我一直想不明白，凡人怎么能心安理得地待在那层像霉烂皮革般拉伸下垂的皮囊里。要是我也被诅咒长成这副恶心模样，我想我会直接从悬崖上跳下去。”
“I’ve always wondered how mortals can be comfortable in skin that stretches and sags like moldy leather. If I were cursed with such disgusting features, I think I’d throw myself off a cliff.”

Loot From A Gynosphinx.name:
来自雌狮身人面像的战利品
Loot From A Gynosphinx

Text.text:
一圈黄金与彩陶交织的项圈紧紧环住生物的颈项，价值恰好100枚金币。颈圈中央嵌着一瓶缩小药水，宛如宝石般安置其中。野兽的利爪、尾巴、毛皮、眼睛、利爪与羽毛仍可采集，且状态良好。
A gold and faience collar, worth exactly 100 gold pieces, wraps around the creature’s neck. A potion of diminution is housed like a gem in the center of the neckband. The claws, tail, pelt, eyes, claws, and feathers of the beast are all still harvestable and in good condition.

Abandoned Lunatic Asylum: Is Escape Poss.name:
废弃疯人院：还能逃出去吗？
Abandoned Lunatic Asylum: Is Escape Possible?

Text.text:
你猛地把双手捂住耳朵，可无论如何也挡不住那凄厉的尖叫——那些声音仿佛就在你脑海深处回荡。这个念头让你的血液瞬间冰冷。有多少人因踏入这座疯人院而被逼至疯狂？如今在此徘徊纠缠的幽魂，又有多少是在他们到来之前这里就已被阴影所缠，才最终被拖入其中？
You clap your hands to your ears but nothing can stop you from hearing their screams—the voices seem to be inside your head. The thought makes your blood run cold. How many people have been driven mad by coming to this madhouse? How many of the ghosts that haunt it now are here because it was haunted before they arrived?

[外观] 一块仿木招牌用铁链吊在一幢低矮建筑上方，建筑主体多为红砖。窗户被熏得发黑，几乎看不清里面。入口是一对矮矮的棕色双开门。

[内景] 推开手动摆门走进去，是一间又长又窄、安静得出奇的精酿酒馆——尽头有一扇门，门后传来酿造槽那种“噗嗝——嘶鸣”的声响。酒馆左侧一排棕色软垫仿皮卡座贴墙而立；右侧整面则被吧台占满，台上竖着许多钢制酒嘴，牌子上写着各式特色酿造。角落里一座假壁炉幽幽闪烁，一位老熟客瘫在卡座里。吧台后，一个留着八字胡、系着帆布围裙的男人正擦拭一只厚重的有机玻璃啤酒杯。

[Outside] A fake wooden sign swings from a chain above a low building that is mostly red brick. The windows are darkened, and it’s hard to see inside. Short, brown double doors mark the entrance.

[Inside] Stepping through the manual swing doors reveals a long, narrow, quiet brewpub—with a door at the far end from which comes the belch-and-whistle-sound of brewing vats. Padded brown faux-leather booths line the left side of the pub, while the length of the right side is occupied by a bar, upon which stand many steel beer taps advertising specialty brews. A fake fireplace flickers in the corner and an old regular is slumped in a booth. Behind the bar, a mustachioed man in a canvas apron cleans a thick plexiglass beer mug.

Encounter With A Dragon On The Road.name:
路遇巨龙的遭遇
Encounter With A Dragon On The Road

Text.text:
“它尖啸着从我们头顶掠过，把树梢像火柴杆一样齐刷刷削断。它振翼的轰鸣，听起来像巨石崩裂。我们拼命催马狂奔，可一点用都没有。它一把抓起整辆马车，连同马匹一起，直冲云霄。我被震得飞出去捡回一条命，可我的同伴就没那么走运了。我听见他的惨叫在山谷里回荡。我不是什么驯兽专家，但它俯冲下来时看我们的那眼神？我觉得它是在取乐。”
“It came screeching over us, sheered off the tops of the trees like they were matchsticks. The beat of its wings sounded like the cracking of boulders. We rode as fast as we could but it was no use. Grabbed the whole carriage, horses and all, and took off into the sky. I was knocked clear, but my companion wasn’t so lucky. I could hear his screams echoing through the valley. I’m no expert on beasts but the way it looked at us when it came down? I think it was enjoying itself.”

Giant Toad Eating A Limb.name:
巨型蟾蜍吞噬肢体
Giant Toad Eating A Limb

Text.text:
最先袭来的，是那股恶臭——沼泽的腐腥混着鲜血的铁味。这里趴伏着一只巨蟾，傲然占据其间，正咀嚼着一截从它那深邃巨口里突出的断肢。它贪婪得令人作呕，活脱脱是自然贪欲的化身——一头沉重却阴毒的掠食者，完全有能力将你整个人一口吞下。
The stink hits you first, a mix of swamp and blood. Squatting here imperiously is a giant toad, munching upon a limb protruding from its cavernous maw. Voraciously grotesque, it encapsulates nature's greed—a ponderous but pernicious predator, utterly capable of swallowing you whole.

雄鹿鹿角上一枚凶利的尖叉——颜色如被烈日漂白的骨头——被削琢成一把优雅的匕首。刀刃狭长，锋利如剃；刀柄上刻着细致得近乎不可能的叶片与藤蔓纹样。
The fierce tine of a stag’s antler—the color of sun-bleached bone—has been whittled into an elegant knife. The blade is narrow and razor sharp, while the handle is engraved with impossibly delicate patterns of leaves and vines.

I Cast Magic Jar.name:
我施放魔法容器
I Cast Magic Jar

Text.text:
法术生效前，我最后一次呼气时，喘息在胸腔里咯咯作响；视野随之发黑，轻飘飘的灵浆从我口中逸出，流入那只容器。约莫一秒后，我感到……贴合。仿佛双眼长在腋下，双脚踩在头顶——紧接着一切骤然错位：我变得无形无质，被持续地搅乱、重排。我不禁想，这是否就是神灯精灵被准许回到封存领地时的感受。
My breath rattles as I make my final exhale before the spell takes hold, my vision darkening as the airy plasm flows from my mouth and into the vessel. After a second or so, I feel… snug. Like my eyes are in my armpits and my feet are on my head—and then things shift, as I am incorporeal and constantly being scrambled. I wonder if this is how djinns feel when they are excused back to their contained domain.

这间狭小的屋子里弥漫着刺鼻的酒精味。也许是架子上那瓶开了盖的烈性须后水散出来的，也许是理发师稳稳握在手里的大酒杯散出来的。墙上一面高镜子旁摆着一把大椅子。椅子边是一张结实的桌子，上面放着剃须泡沫、刷子，还有一把锋利得令人心惊的剃刀。地上散落着一缕缕剪下的头发，远处角落里还扫起了一小堆，等一天结束再来清理。
The small room is filled with the harsh scent of alcohol. Perhaps it comes from the open bottle of spirituous aftershave on the shelf, or maybe from the tankard that the barber holds in her steady hand. A large chair sits by a tall mirror on the wall. Beside it stands a sturdy table, holding lather, a brush, and a wickedly sharp razor. Locks of discarded hair litter the ground, and a small mound has been swept into the far corner to be cleaned when the day is done.

梦境无处不在，而你们之中潜伏着一名猎手。猎手一直都在这里，等待着你。它披着你恐惧的外衣。它嗅着你，也嗅着你的心智……像童年恐惧褪色后的影子。一只昆虫般的生物逼近，掌心中央挤出一根尖刺，发出威胁性的咯咯声。
The dream is all around, and there is a hunter in your midst. The hunter has always been here, waiting for you. It bears the mantle of your terror. It scents you, and it scents your mind… like a faded shadow of childhood fear. An insectile creature approaches, extruding a spike from the center of its palm as it chitters menacingly.

Behir With Lightning.name:
闪电贝希尔
Behir With Lightning

Text.text:
闪电在生物的形体中以忽明忽暗的电流噼啪迸裂，沿着它的鳞片起舞，织出不断变幻的纹路。巨兽的鳄状头颅与那庞大如巨蛇般的身躯格格不入，而它每侧的肋腹竟生出多得离谱的腿。它太阳穴处长着几枚细小的角——宛如公羊般向后卷曲——行动间，一条又长又细、如鞭般的尾巴来回摆荡。
Lightning crackles through the creature’s form in flickering currents, dancing across its scales in ever-shifting patterns. The beast’s crocodilian head is at odds with its huge, serpentine body, and far too many legs grow from each flank. Small horns—akin to a ram—curl at its temples, and a long, whip-like tail sways as it moves.

Insult To A Wealthy Lord About Their Cou.name:
对一位富贵领主及其宫廷的羞辱
Insult To A Wealthy Lord About Their Court

Text.text:
“你曾眺望过一个满溢美丽的世界，却选择亲手再造一个属于自己的。一个由宫廷、礼法与仆从堆砌的世界，而你端坐其心。可无论有多少人俯首王座之前，或高唱你荣耀的传说，你所造的世界也不过是一抹魅影（特征）。凡人织就的幻梦，终将如同来时一般轻易消散。”
“You looked out at a world filled with beauty but instead decided to construct your own. A world of courts, etiquette, and servants, with you at its center. But no matter how many bow before your throne or sing tales of your grandeur, the world you made is only a phantom. A fantasy woven by mortals that will fade away just as easily.”

你用手抚过你的武器，如外科医生般精准地在空间中划开一道裂隙。此刻挥动武器，身后会拖出一道清晰可见的轨迹：墨黑的虚无，被遥远群星的微光刺穿。下一个感受你武器锋芒的生物，或许很快就会发现自己被抛向那无尽世界之一。
You pass a hand over your weapon, opening a rift in space with the precision of a surgeon. Swinging your weapon now leaves a visible trail in its wake: an ink-black void, pierced with the light of distant stars. The next creature that feels the bite of your weapon might soon find themselves on one of those infinite worlds.

箭杆末端是一枚橡胶箭头，圆柱形，端面平平。用意一目了然：用来钝击而非穿刺，好在猎获时不伤战利品的皮毛与皮革。
The arrow shaft ends at a rubber tip, cylindrical, flat-ended. The design is clear: to bludgeon rather than pierce, and to spare the fur and hide of an animal prize.

Lair Of The Siren: Hunted.name:
海妖巢穴：被猎杀
Lair Of The Siren: Hunted

Text.text:
歌声涌入你的脑海，甜美的念头如潮水般漫灌。眩晕的记忆与梦境层层倾泻、彼此交织，让你分不清哪些渴望已被满足，你究竟想要什么，甚至不明白自己为何会在这里。你用力摇头。世界随之旋转。你闭上眼睛，可那旋转仍未停止。有哪里不对劲。
The song fills your head with a flood of pleasant thoughts. A dizzying cascade of memories and dreams mix together, leaving you uncertain which desires have been fulfilled, what you want, or why you’re even here. You shake your head. The world spins. You close your eyes, but it keeps spinning. Something is not right.

Inside An Out-of-commission Automated Fa.name:
在一座停摆的自动化工厂内部
Inside An Out-of-commission Automated Factory

Text.text:
寂静如毯，裹住曾经喧嚣的工厂车间，披上一层窒息的裹尸布，宛如一座亘古未扰的墓穴。锈蚀机器的残骸沿着一条积尘、断裂的传送带排开——像一支哀恸的队列，为逝去的工业时代作最后的致意。
Silence blankets the once-bustling factory floor in a suffocating shroud, like an ancient, undisturbed tomb. The remains of rusted machinery line a dusty, broken conveyor belt—a mournful procession paying their last respects to a bygone era of industry.

Khorash Barakat.name:
科拉什·巴拉卡特
Khorash Barakat

Text.text:
象牙色的犄角自这名男子灰烬般的额头向后掠去，越过如炭的发丝，其间一道白色发束格外醒目。他肤色苍白，双眼淡得如月光石般冷澈，毫无波澜地凝视着你。黑袍裹身，布料在光下泛起紫罗兰色的微光。银与金的镶边同样闪耀，在垂落的兜帽上更为密集，兜帽堆叠在他颈间如暗影的褶皱。一枚镶宝石的护符——象征审判——自兜帽垂落到胸前。配上那柄被他当作行走手杖般握持的骨质长镰，他俨然就是死亡本身的倒影。

~ Played by MasterLionsDen with

Ivory-colored horns sweep back from this man’s ashen forehead, projecting over his charcoal hair with its one stripe of white. His skin is pallid, and his eyes are as pale as moonstones. They stare impassively at you. Black robes swathe him, the cloth shimmering violet in the light. Silver and gold edging also gleam on his clothing, denser on the lowered hood that piles around his neck. A jeweled amulet, a symbol of judgment, dangles from the hood onto his chest. With it and the bone scythe he holds like a walking staff, he is an image of death.

~ Played by MasterLionsDen with

Ring Of Air Elemental Command.name:
空气元素指挥之戒
Ring Of Air Elemental Command

Text.text:
你面前摆着两枚闪耀的银戒，以一条细链相连，设计为一次戴在两根手指上。三颗海蓝宝石呈三角相嵌，镶在浮雕般的旋纹之间，那纹路宛如翻涌的风涛。
In front of you are two rings of shining silver bound by a thin chain, meant to be worn on two fingers at a time. A trio of aquamarines sit in a triad amid embossed swirls resembling billows of wind.

浅金色的石块墙垒层层垒起，高达三十英尺，斜倚在护城河堤的坡面上。工匠与工程师手执卡尺与绘图器，推演投影，勾画蓝图。他们以铅垂校准墙体的线势，确保哪怕泥土的滑移与沉降——无论投石机还是撞槌——都无法在数百年间撼倒这座巨构。城墙环绕整座城市延展，阴影清凉，如哨兵般守望城外的险恶，庇护城中的众生。
The wall of blond stone block is stacked thirty feet high, canted against the slope of the moat bank. Engineers with calipers and projections draw plans. They plumb the wall’s line so that no slipping or shifting of the earth—nor catapult, nor ram—will bring down the edifice for centuries. The wall stretches around the city, its shadow cool, sentinel to the dangers beyond and protector of those within.

I Cast Find Familiar As A Ritual.name:
我以仪式施放“寻获魔宠”
I Cast Find Familiar As A Ritual

Text.text: 木炭与熏香刺鼻的辛辣气味灼痛我的鼻腔，盘旋缭绕的烟雾中，一个轮廓开始凝聚。当我念出这道法术的最后几句咒词，我的新魔宠伴随着一声轻微的pop彻底显形，悬浮在火焰上方的魔法球体之中。 The acrid tang of the charcoal and incense stings my nostrils as a shape begins to form in the coiling smoke. When I speak the last words of the spell, my new familiar fully materializes with a faint pop, hovering in a magical sphere above the flames.

Opulent Mansion Surrounded By Squalor.name:
奢华宅邸，四周尽是污秽贫民窟
Opulent Mansion Surrounded By Squalor

Text.text:
奢华庄园那镀金的大门无时无刻不被卑劣的雇佣兵巡逻把守——也只有这群人肯把身段放得如此低，才愿意接下这份差事。宛如垃圾堆上蹲着一颗钻石，那幢闪耀的联排宅邸与周遭破败的城市形成刺眼的反差。身着灰暗、破旧失修衣物的市民匆匆从庄园旁掠过，只在片刻驻足，朝那位居住其中的人吐口唾沫，低声咒骂。

~ 构想 by crunchyzombies on Discord

The gilded gates of the opulent manor are patrolled at all times by unscrupulous mercenaries, the only ones willing to stoop low enough for the job. Like a diamond squatting atop a refuse heap, the gleaming townhouse stands in startling contrast to the decrepit city surrounding it. Citizens clad in drab, poorly maintained clothing hurry past the manor, pausing only to spit a curse upon the one who dwells there.

~ Envisioned by crunchyzombies on Discord

Cold-blooded Long Rifle Sniper.name:
冷血长步枪狙击手
Cold-blooded Long Rifle Sniper

Text.text:
一发入魂，一击必杀。这就是信条——要是失手，你多半就得死。蒙面狙击手的血管里流淌着寒冰，他们的身形被贴身的纳米斗篷吞没，如同活影般将其轮廓彻底抹去。握在手中的碳纤维步枪被改装到几乎认不出来，枪托上用激光蚀刻的累累刻痕，昭示着射手的技能。
One shot. One kill. That’s the creed—and if you miss you’re probably dead. Ice flows in the veins of the masked sniper, their shape obscured by a form-fitting nano cloak that engulfs them like a living shadow. The carbon-fiber rifle they wield is customized to the point of being unrecognizable, and the significant tally-marks laser-etched into the stock speaks to the shooter’s skill.

Barehanded Vs Halberd.name:
徒手对战长戟
Barehanded Vs Halberd

Text.text:
这件武器有一根九英尺长的柄杆，末端装着一把做工精良的斧刃，触及因此几乎彻底一边倒。战斗看上去只是件简单的事，持戟者的突刺又平又快。然而刃口回收得很吃力，沿着地面拖刮出刺耳的响声。拳手贴在刃与持用者之间的柄杆上，压着刃口往下按，步步逼近。显然，他们是那种随时准备打一场持久战的人。
The weapon has a nine-foot shaft and a well-crafted axe at the end, which means reach is thoroughly one-sided. The fight looks like a simple matter, and the halberdier’s lunge is level and fast. The blade has a hard time returning, however, and scrapes loudly along the ground. Clinging to the shaft between the blade and its wielder and pushing the blade down, the pugilist presses forward. They are clearly someone quite ready for a longer fight.

这间屋子的墙边一溜排开着床铺，每张都铺得整整齐齐，私人物品要么稳妥地塞在床底，要么装进脚边的箱子里。若不是地上横七竖八地瘫着几具骷髅，这里几乎看不出有什么不对劲。
The walls of this room are lined with beds, all tidily made with personal belongings tucked securely underneath or in boxes at their feet. If it wasn’t for the several skeletons lying sprawled on the floor, it wouldn’t look like anything was amiss.

Rhyme About A Cursed Sword.name:
关于一把诅咒之剑的押韵诗
Rhyme About A Cursed Sword

Text.text:
锻于远古无尽岁月之前，

寒冰之刃将再度闪耀。

它幽冷的光芒轻轻流转，

暗藏诸多奥术怨毒。

执刃之人务必警惕，

你将背负缠上灵魂的诅咒。

且听此传说娓娓道来，

闪烁之物未必皆为黄金。

Forged in eons that came before,

the blade of ice will shine once more.

Softly glows its somber light,

harb’ring much arcane spite.

Those who wield the blade beware,

for a curse upon your soul you bear.

Listen as this tale be told,

all that glitters is not gold.

漂白的肋骨拱起在纠结的灌木丛上方，更大的骨头如林中倒木般散落一地。一具巨大的带角头骨半埋在泥土里——也可能是摔裂后横陈在地。乍看之下，你以为自己撞见了巨龙的遗骸，但你又瞥见草丛间缠着其他生物更小的骨骸。
Bleached ribs arch above a tangled thicket, while larger bones litter the ground like fallen logs in a forest. A massive horned skull lies half-embedded in dirt or perhaps broken on the ground. At first glance you suspect you’ve come across the corpse of a dragon, but you spy smaller bones from other creatures tangled in the grass.

Island Dragon Lair.name:
群岛巨龙巢穴
Island Dragon Lair

Text.text:
巨浪轰然拍击，雷鸣般的回声在海崖上凿出的洞窟间滚荡。湿滑而光洁的石质隧道向岛屿深处延伸数里，最终止于中央火山之下的一片巨大空间。岩浆为洞窟加热，并投下昏暗光照。你越往深处旅行，地上散落的骸骨就越多，尽是被啃噬、被咬碎的残渣。不久，你又踉跄发现被丢弃的武器与护甲，以及成堆的铜与银钱币。某个庞然大物沉重的喘息声很快传入你的耳中。
The waves crash thunderously, echoing through the caves carved into the seaside cliff. The tunnels of slick, smooth stone extend leagues into the heart of the island, terminating in a cavernous space beneath the volcano rising at its center. Magma heats the caves and provides dim light. The deeper into the caves you travel, the more bones you find littering the ground, gnawed and broken. Soon you also stumble upon discarded weapons and armor, and piles of copper and silver coins. The heavy breaths of something massive soon reach your ears.

Exclusive Golf Course.name:
专属高尔夫球场
Exclusive Golf Course

Text.text:
在人造的热带天空下，几栋白色小楼顶着赤陶屋瓦静静坐落：一座会所，由一排排低矮而奢华的平房式别墅组成。球场把财富炫耀得毫不遮掩，也把空间糟蹋得令人作呕。装着小型喷射引擎的高尔夫球车来回穿梭，载着那些肥得流油的金主，在异国风情的球道间往返——那里遍布隧道、喷泉，以及华而不实的中世纪拱桥。果岭漂浮在空中，轻轻起伏摇摆。从练习场望去，一颗白球划出弧线，飞向长草区，撞上力场后弹回，落回球道中央。
Beneath a synthetic tropical sky sit little white buildings with terracotta roofs: a clubhouse made of low, luxurious bungalows. The course is a flagrant display of wealth and a grotesque use of space. Golf carts with small jets ferry fat-cat patrons between exotic courses replete with tunnels, fountains, and ostentatious medieval bridges. Putting greens float in the sky, gently bobbing. From the driving range, the arc of a white ball curves out toward the rough and hits a forcefield, bouncing back onto the fairway.

Satyr Visiting A Tavern.name:
萨堤尔造访酒馆
Satyr Visiting A Tavern

Text.text:
酒馆里今夜热闹得惊人——廉价麦酒把气氛点燃，一支技艺娴熟的巡回艺人乐队又奏起高亢、欢快的乐曲。喧闹狂欢正到顶点时，前门吱呀一声被推开，一个年轻人的脑袋探了进来：乱蓬蓬的发丝如轻烟般飞翘。他的眼睛在目睹这份喜庆时闪闪发亮。随即他整个挤进门内，脚一落地，便发出一声哒。分趾蹄，双腿覆着粗硬、带刺灌丛般的毛——这位萨堤尔大胆地加入这场狂欢，踏着吉格舞的节拍起舞，分毫不差。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

It’s a busy night in the tavern thanks to cheap ale and the high, jaunty music provided by a band of skilled troupers. As the carousing reaches its peak, the front door squeaks open, and the head of a young man with wild, wisping hair peers in. His eyes sparkle as he takes in the jubilance. He presses fully in, his foot landing with a clop. Cloven-hooved and legs coated in rough, brambled fur—the satyr boldly joins the jamboree, dancing to the jig in perfect time.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Fiendish Tadpole's Emergence During Comb.name:
战斗中恶魔蝌蚪的破蛹而出
Fiendish Tadpole's Emergence During Combat

Text.text:
车厢外，争吵般的高声刺破了马蹄哒哒的昏沉节奏，也搅乱了雪花坠落在草叶上那宁静的絮语。一个衣衫褴褛的身影狂奔穿过田野，拼命远离身后六个披着暗色斗篷的人。逃亡者用低沉的嗓音嘶喊，脚下一绊，跪倒在地。他右手死死按住胸口，吐出一个刺耳的词，左手间火焰迅速凝聚。他将那团烈焰掷向追兵。一名斗篷追逐者瞬间被点燃，惨叫声四起，那人仍在燃烧中倒下。然而，跪地施术者也随之发出尖叫——他的腹部猛然炸开，将他整个人掀得向后飞去；新雪被染成猩红，一只恶魔般的蝌蚪状生物落在他翻出的肠脏之间。那怪物挣扎着立起身，用带爪的前肢飞快爬向车厢，露出针般细密的獠牙，身后拖曳着血痕。 一名斗篷人高喊：“神裔要进食了！拦住那辆车厢！”另一人掷出一支旋涡般的紫罗兰能量长矛，轰然击穿车厢后方的一只车轮，车体猛地一歪、拖拽着打滑，在受惊马匹的嘶鸣声中停了下来。

~ Envisioned by Elijah Richard

Outside the carriage, raised voices disturb the sleepy rhythm of the trotting horses and serene whisper of snow falling on grass. A figure in ragged clothing races across a field, away from six others in dark cloaks. The fugitive cries out in a deep voice. Stumbles. Falling to his knees, he clutches his chest with his right hand and speaks a harsh word, gathering fire in his left. He hurls the flame at his pursuers. A cloaked pursuer ignites, cries ring out, and they fall, still ablaze. But the fire-bolt’s kneeling caster also screams. His abdomen bursts open, hurling him backward, painting the fresh snow crimson where a demonic pollywog lands amid his entrails. The monster rights itself and, with clawed forelimbs, scrambles toward the carriage, baring needlelike fangs and trailing blood. One cloaked figure shouts: “The godling wishes to feed! Stop that carriage!” Another launches a spear of swirling violet energy. It smashes through one of the rear carriage wheels, causing the vehicle to lurch, drag, and come to halt amid the screaming of frightened horses.

~ Envisioned by Elijah Richard

Vampire Ambush.name:
吸血鬼（特征）伏击
Vampire Ambush

Text.text:
你的向导停下脚步，仔细审视着四周的树影。突然，一声令人血液凝固的尖啸刺入耳膜，难以穿透的黑暗骤然降临在这条孤寂的林间小径上，遮蔽了你的方向感。你只来得及瞥见新结识的同伴被拖拽着远去——他们的脸扭曲成无声的惨叫。一名美丽的精灵女子自墨一般的黑暗中步出，华丽的衣饰优雅贴身，唇边还抹着新鲜的血迹。她以催眠般的目光钉住你，嘴角缓缓勾起一抹邪恶的笑意。
Your guide pauses, carefully studying the trees around you. Suddenly a blood-chilling screech fills your ears and impenetrable darkness descends on the lonely forest trail, clouding your sense of direction. You briefly catch sight of your new companion being dragged away—their face contorted in a silent scream. A beautiful elven woman clad in elegant finery steps from the inky blackness—fresh blood smeared around her mouth. She fixes you with a hypnotic stare as her lips curl into a wicked smile.

你面前是一处入口，起初看上去像一座大理石螺旋楼梯。然而，本该出现台阶的地方，却变成了一整片光滑的斜坡石面。雕饰繁复、打磨如镜的木质扶手蜿蜒向上，给任何想攀登的人提供稳固支撑。这条坡道沿塔身盘旋而上，斜坡的坡度舒适易行，既便于运送货物，也为通往上层楼面提供许可。
Before you is the entrance to what at first appears to be a marbled spiral staircase. However, where you would expect to see steps, there is instead a floor of smooth, sloped stone. Ornately carved and polished wooden handrails snake upward to provide stability to any would-be climber. The ramp corkscrews up the tower at a comfortably traversable incline, ideal for transporting goods and providing access to the upper floors.

沿着这柄手半剑的剑脊一路镌刻的龙族符文宣告：这件武器是为一位声名赫赫的冠军而铸，以金龙的炽烈吐息为火、以其宝藏中的精金为材。这样的传说或许纯属杜撰，但你毫不怀疑——在你漫长的生涯里，你从未见过如此上乘的巨剑；它的刃口锋芒无双，坚韧得令人心悸。
The Draconic runes inscribed along the length of this bastard sword’s rib proclaim that this weapon was forged for a famous champion, using the fiery breath of a gold dragon and adamantine from its stash. Certainly, such a tale could be an utter fabrication, but there is no doubt in your mind that you are handling the finest greatsword you have seen over the length of your career, and that its edge is peerlessly sharp and durable.

天空骤然昏暗，轰鸣声中，暴雨如鞭般成片砸落。来得突兀、迅猛——坠落得如此凶狠，水流很快汇成小河，在缝隙里聚成水洼。地面变得湿滑泥泞，不消片刻，连向前望一眼都成了危险之举，残酷的倾盆大雨狠狠拍打在你身上。
The sky darkens, and with a roar, the rain falls in pummeling sheets. It's sudden, swift—falling so hard it collects in rivers and pools in crevices. The ground becomes slick and sodden, and soon simply looking forward becomes hazardous as the punishing downpour pounds against you.

Attacking Orc Spirit.name:
攻击兽人之魂
Attacking Orc Spirit

Text.text:
迷雾中凝出一名兽人的灰烬幻影，深陷的眼窝里红光灼灼。它猛然冲来，长剑后拉蓄势。那幽魂高举宽大的盾牌，长獠的面孔仅从盾缘上方探出，发出震耳咆哮，凶悍地发动攻击。
The ashen image of an orc forms from mist, its red eyes blazing from deeply furrowed sockets. It surges forward, its sword reeled back. The spirit’s wide shield is raised, its tusked face peering just over the top, roaring in vehement attack.

Maximilian's Earthen Grasp.name:
马克西米连的地之攫握
Maximilian's Earthen Grasp

Text.text:
大地轰隆作响，隆起成一座颤动的土丘，随即裂开重塑为一只巨大的手。手指屈伸，将多余的尘土抖落。它们焦躁地敲击地面，发出沉闷的鼓点，接着便如扑击的蜘蛛般张指疾扑向你的目标。
The earth rumbles, rising into a shuddering mound before splitting and forming into a large hand. The fingers flex, shaking the excess dirt away. They drum against the earth in thudding percussion, anxious, before rushing your target with fingers outstretched like a lunging spider.

Loot From A Gnoll Vampire.name:
来自豺狼人吸血鬼（特征）的战利品
Loot From A Gnoll Vampire

Text.text:
豺狼人戴着一圈巨大的三层项圈：银色链条交织成格，分别在每一层悬挂着三块切割过的绿龙骨。那些骨片里嵌着珍贵的物品——第一层是红宝石，第二层是琥珀，第三层则是镀金的鼠颅。
The gnoll wears a large three-tiered collar, a lattice of silver chain suspending three pieces of cut green dragon bone on each tier. The bones are embedded with a precious item—first rubies, then amber, then the gilded skulls of mice.

Dwarven Alchemist.name:
矮人炼金术士
Dwarven Alchemist

Text.text:
炼金术士凝视着咕嘟冒泡的烧瓶，突出的眉骨因忧虑而紧拧。他们低声咕哝着——让玻璃下的火焰随之跳动——以与那双粗大老茧手不相称的灵巧调校着器具。实验室里摇曳的烛光映照下，他们转身俯身细读笔记，检定匆匆刮刻在羊皮纸上的计算是否无误。
The alchemist stares at the bubbling flask, their prominent brow knotted with consternation. Muttering under their breath—causing the flame beneath the glass to dance—they adjust the instruments with a dexterity which belies their large, calloused hands. In the flickering candlelight of the laboratory, they turn, poring over their notes to check calculations scratched hurriedly into the parchment.

你高高举起一只镶满宝石的碗——以夸张的盛大手势——随即猛地将它砸向地面，然后把颤抖的双掌覆在腹部，宛如即将临盆的母亲。碎裂声中，你听见木梁不协和的呻吟与挺括布料的脆响；一张宴会长桌自虹彩光辉里具现成形。满载的盘盏与酒杯在桌面上接连浮现，豪奢盛宴骤然加身的重量令桌板微微下弯；空气里充满肉汁滋滋作响的声响、烤蒜的浓香，以及新出炉面包的暖意。
You raise a gem-studded bowl high—in a grand gesture—before spiking it toward the ground, then rest your shaking palms over your stomach like a soon-to-be mother. From the shards you hear the discordant groaning of timbers and the snapping of starched fabric, as a banquet table materializes from prismatic light. Filled plates and goblets appear atop the board, which bows under the abrupt weight of the lavish feast, as the air fills with the sound of sizzling meat, the smell of roasted garlic, and the warmth of fresh-baked bread.

巨大的铁栅栏封死了通往庞大下水道系统的入口——至少，本该如此。锈蚀的栅条向内蜷曲，扭折断裂，几乎像是被某种爆燃的魔法硬生生轰开。浓稠的恶臭污液从出口涌出，淌进海里；石砌管道深处传来尖厉的啼叫回响，你不禁揣测，里面究竟有什么在等着……
The massive, iron grate bars entrance to the expansive sewer system—or at least, it’s supposed to. The rusted bars curl inward, bent and broken, almost as if blasted open with some combustive magic. Thick, foul-smelling liquid drains from the outlet, trickling into the sea, and with shrill calls echoing from the stone pipe, you wonder what waits within...

River Journey: Marsh Fog.name:
河道之旅：沼泽迷雾
River Journey: Marsh Fog

Text.text:
一层薄雾从河面漂来，源自对岸绵延不绝的高大芦苇丛。那边岸上雾气弥漫，遮蔽了远处的景象，但你仍能感觉到沼泽的辽阔无边。你凝望着雾团逼近，它们翻滚的轮廓仿佛变幻成诡异的形状，像是冲锋战马的残片，又像是人影缥缈的幽魂。雾气渐渐包围船只，你几乎要以为下一刻就会听见一声战吼。
A mist drifts over the river from a long bank of tall reeds. A fog fills the air over the shore in that direction, obscuring the distance, but you sense the vastness of a marsh. As you watch the clouds approach, their rolling shapes seem to take strange forms, like pieces of charging horses or the wispy shadows of people. You half expect to hear a war cry as the fog surrounds the ship.

Cozy Cat Café.name:
温馨猫咪咖啡馆
Cozy Cat Café

Text.text:
藏在一座本该喧嚣的城市一隅的静角里，这家咖啡馆散发着老屋般的气息：新煮咖啡的醇香里，混着一丝若有若无的猫科麝味。室内温暖而家常，研钵与杵用来捣碎咖啡豆，壁炉里一口水壶下方燃着魔法火焰。桌椅之间被细心地安置着沾着猫毛的软垫、抬高的猫窝与抓柱。热气氤氲的咖啡杯与羊毛织物的膝头之间，猫儿们发出咕噜声，蜷着打盹，像这店铺一样躲得很深。

~ 由一位英雄构想

Tucked into a quiet corner of an otherwise busy city, the café radiates an old-house smell of fresh coffee and a faintly feline musk. The interior is warm and homely, with a mortar and pestle to grind coffee beans and a magical fire under a kettle in the hearth. Carefully placed among the tables and chairs are cushions dusted with fur, elevated cat beds, and scratching posts. Between the warmth of steaming cups coffee and woolen laps, the cats purr and snooze, as tucked away as the shop.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Siren Song Lures Ship Onto Reef.name:
海妖之歌引诱船只撞上暗礁
Siren Song Lures Ship Onto Reef

Text.text:
歌声的余韵仍在空气中盘旋，交织成天堂般的瑰丽与令人作呕的恶臭。鬼婆的咯咯怪笑冷得你骨髓发寒，瞭望台上的水手长高声惊叫。“收帆！”船长的吼声自船尾炸响。“左满舵；升帆！”一声撕心裂肺的尖啸压过水手们的呼喊，船身猛然撞上浅海里犬牙交错的暗礁。
The echoes of the song still linger on the air, creating a mix of heavenly beauty and horrid stench. The hag’s cackle chills you to your bones as the bosun cries out from atop the crow's nest. "Reef!" the captain's voice bellows from astern. "Hard to port; raise sails!" A wrenching wail screeches above the voices of the crew as the ship crashes against the jagged reefs in the shallow sea.

Oldenberry Farm In Winter.name:
冬日的奥尔登莓农场
Oldenberry Farm In Winter

Text.text:
霜寒似乎并未阻碍田里那一株株挺立的玉米秆。农场工人沿着垄行走着，偶尔在几株作物前停下片刻端详，随即继续前行。土豆泥、肉汁与奶油玉米的香气从庄园的餐馆里滚滚涌出。挤满的厅堂里笑声回荡，人们尽情享用着丰收的馈赠。庄园东侧的林梢之上，那座古老的法师高塔森然耸立，塔顶覆雪，如冠如冕。
The frost does not seem to hinder the strong stalks of corn standing in the field. Farmhands walk the rows, pausing to observe certain plants for a moment before continuing on. The aroma of mashed potatoes, gravy, and creamed corn pours from the property’s restaurant. Laughter rings in the packed room, folk indulge in the yield of a successful harvest. The old wizard tower looms over the trees on the eastern side of the property, its roof crowned with snowfall.

Egotistical Commercial Pilot.name:
自负的商业飞行员
Egotistical Commercial Pilot

Text.text:
尽管住在远离机场的酒店里，飞行员还是决定继续穿着制服、戴着帽子。那笔挺利落的线条，甚至让人怀疑他到店后还特意熨烫过。他大步流星走向大堂酒吧，几乎把一对咯咯笑着的客人撞得踉跄，随即清了清嗓子，声音响亮得足以让整个房间都听见，好引来酒保的注意。
Even though he's at a hotel far from the airport, the pilot has decided to continue wearing his uniform and cap. With how crisp the lines are, he may have even freshly ironed it after arriving. He strides to the lobby bar, practically knocking over a pair of giggling patrons, and clears his throat loud enough to hear from across the room in order to get the bartender's attention.

Magic Missile Trap.name:
魔法飞弹陷阱
Magic Missile Trap

Text.text:
[察觉] 你一靠近，诡异的奥术符文便亮起不祥的紫光；空气中回荡着清晰可感的嗡鸣，震得你牙根发酸。你感觉到危险就在附近。

[发现] 前方道路上横着一道几乎难以察觉的细线，由无数微小的符印连缀而成，大多被碎屑与瓦砾遮掩。这道线横贯两侧夹击着道路的废墟之间，显然是奥术防御的触发。

[触发] 光芒骤然爆裂，尖啸般的哀鸣中，魔法飞镖自发光符文里迸射而出。那些投射物以致命的精准破空直扑你而来。

[Perceived] Strange arcane runes glow with ominous purple light as you approach, and a palpable, unsettling hum reverberates through the air, setting your teeth on edge. You sense danger nearby.

[Discovered] An almost imperceptible line of tiny sigils runs across the path ahead, mostly obscured by debris and rubble. The line runs between the ruins flanking the path and is clearly a trigger for arcane defenses.

[Triggered] With a burst of light, magical darts erupt from the glowing runes with a keening wail. The projectiles hurtle toward you with lethal accuracy.

Kalodash The Centaur.name:
卡洛达什：半人马
Kalodash The Centaur

Text.text:
半人马以从容与纪律行进，每一步都优雅无声。骄傲而高贵的战士上半身端坐在栗棕色的马躯之上——与人的腰际浑然相融。浓密的黑发束成紧实的马尾，自背后倾泻而下，巧妙衬托出他雕刻般的颧骨与修剪齐整的山羊胡。一件华贵的灰色束腰长衫覆在他宽阔健硕的胸膛上，垫承着他所穿沉重护甲的分量，也带来几分他显然早已习惯的舒适。背上斜负的一柄精工长柄刀在光里微微闪耀，日光掠过刀刃抛光的钢面，映出冷冽的辉芒。前臂上绑着一面巨大的风筝盾，行进间轻轻摇摆；漆面上那彩绘的纹章出自匠人之手，鲜明而沉稳。

~ Played by DynamicDirewolf

The centaur moves with poise and discipline, every step graceful. The upper half of a proud and noble warrior sits atop the body of a chestnut-brown horse—fused at the man’s waist. Thick black hair gathered in a tight ponytail cascades down his back, artfully complementing his sculpted cheekbones and neatly trimmed goatee. A luxurious gray tunic adorns his broad, muscular chest, cushioning the weight of the heavy armor he wears and providing a measure of comfort he is seemingly quite accustomed to. A finely wrought glaive—slung across his back—shimmers in the light as the sun reflects from the polished steel of the blade. Lashed to his forearm, a large kite shield sways gently as he travels, the colorful heraldry on its lacquered surface painted by an expert hand.

~ Played by DynamicDirewolf

一汪耀眼得刺目的湛蓝池水，静静躺在覆雪的冰原之上。它显得格格不入——在这片冰封世界里，竟有一处不结冰的水域。也许这背后有某种你尚未理解的自然缘由：阳光融化出的水沿着你看不见的沟道汇聚而成；又或是一道离群的巨浪将咸海水拍上冰面，积成水洼，迟迟不肯封冻。
A pool of stunningly bright blue water sits atop the sheet of snow-covered ice. It seems oddly out of place—a body of unfrozen water in a frozen landscape. Perhaps it has some natural cause you don’t understand: sun induced meltwater collected through channels you can’t see, or maybe a rogue wave washed salt water atop the ice where it pooled and refused to ice over.

这把纤细的长剑闪烁着锋锐的寒光，透着致命的气息。打磨得完美无瑕的刃口仿佛因对战斗的渴望而低低嗡鸣。剑身上蚀刻的符文在诉说荣耀、厮杀，以及一支舞。将那些词语高声说话，长剑便悬停在半空，蓄势待发，准备迎战。
The slim longsword shines with a keen, deadly air. The perfectly honed edge practically hums with excitement over the prospect of battle. Runes etched into the blade speak of glory, combat, and a dance. Speaking the words aloud, the sword hangs in midair, poised to fight.

Professor Of Orbs And Divination.name:
宝珠与占卜教授
Professor Of Orbs And Divination

Text.text: 他平静却不乏味，显然很清楚占卜魔法的名声。“犬儒不是怀疑，”他轻声说道，“那只是绝望。对占卜有毒。”他长发披肩，眼神迷离，神情愉快，仿佛忧虑从未掠过他的心头。 他举起一枚水晶球。一道配方自行刻写出来，沿着玻璃表面旋转游走，像在天空中写字般盘旋不散。“这配方并不总能奏效，但一旦奏效，你就会看见不可见之物。你可曾在没有神秘配方的情况下看见不可见之物？没有？那么，就此打住你的犬儒吧。” Calm without being boring, he seems well aware of divination magic’s reputation. “Cynicism is not skepticism,” he says softly. “It’s just hopelessness. Toxic to divination.” He is long-haired, dreamy-eyed, happy. Worry seems never to have crossed his mind. He holds up an orb. A formula etches itself and revolves around the glass surface like skywriting. “The formula doesn’t always work, but when it does, you’ll see the invisible. Have you ever seen the invisible without a mystical formula? No? Well, then. So much for your cynicism.”

她挺立如松，脊背笔直，眼神却狂野不驯。她一头乌黑的长发间夹杂着道道霜白，被编进那些生长于幽暗林地的诡异菌菇。她把蘑菇当作珠宝佩戴：脖颈上是一串毒蝇伞项链，腰间系着一圈马勃菌腰带。右手握着一根由石化木制成的法杖，左手则擎着一柄弯刃匕首。
She stands tall and straight, but her eyes are wild. Her long, dark hair is streaked with white and braided with the strange fungi that sprout in shadowed woodlands. She wears the ’shrooms like jewelry: a necklace of toadstools and a belt of puffballs. In her right hand she carries a staff made of petrified wood, and in her left she holds a curved dagger.

Exiting Through A Damaged Airlock.name:
通过受损的气闸离开
Exiting Through A Damaged Airlock

Text.text:
飞船的内舱门在你身后合拢，吱呀作响、呻吟不止，最后以令人不安的尖啸收尾。它们尚未完全闭合，舱内气压便开始回衡，伴随着阴森的嘶嘶声；警报灯也虚弱地闪烁着亮起，警告气闸密封发生了危险的失败。仅仅片刻之后，气闸外门便猛然抖动着打开，外面的世界暴露在眼前——这点时间，够你安全离开舱室吗？
The internal doors of the vessel creak and groan as they close behind you with an unsettling screech. Before they have closed fully the pressure in the cabin begins to equalize with a sinister hiss, and alarms flicker weakly to life warning of a dangerous failure in the airlock’s seal. After only a few moments the external doors of the airlock judder open to reveal the outside world—was it long enough to safely exit the cabin?

Goliath's Resilience.name:
巨人裔的坚韧
Goliath's Resilience

Text.text:
汲取你族人所来自那片岩岭的可怖不屈，你挺身迎击一切来袭的伤害，无论其源自何处。

~ 由一位英雄 Envisioned

Channeling the fearsome invulnerability of the rocky hills from whence your people came, you brace yourself against incoming damage, regardless of its source.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Tonic Of Relief.name:
宽慰补剂
Tonic Of Relief

Text.text:
这只瓶子被设计成一颗可爱的拟人小星星模样，瓶中那抹金黄液体在光线下微微闪烁。无论谁饮下这剂补剂，它都是对那种总会轻易将人淹没的失控与压迫感的终极防线。只需一口，这药水便能令一切躯体的不适烟消云散——无论是慢性疼痛、恶心、眩晕、颤抖，或是它们纠缠成的阴郁混合。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

This bottle is designed to look like a cute, anthropomorphized star, and the yellow fluid within twinkles slightly in the light. For whomever drinks this tonic, it is the ultimate defense against the overwhelm that comes so easily to them. A single gulp of this potion and any physical malaise will lift—be it chronic pain, nausea, dizziness, tremors, or a morbid combination of them all.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Falkrunn Helcral, Co-owner Of Helcral's.name:
法尔克伦·赫尔克拉尔，赫尔克拉尔酒坊的合伙人
Falkrunn Helcral, Co-owner Of Helcral's Distillery

Text.text:
尽管她那一头金色弹卷被利落地扎成俏皮的马尾，五官也生得秀丽，这名矮人却绝不是那种脸颊似玫瑰亲吻、对客人总能抛出几句俏皮话的放荡酒馆侍女。她的面孔冷硬如石，榛色的眼睛紧紧锁在手头的活计上；一旦做完，目光便迅捷地掠过整间酒馆，立刻去寻下一个差事。

她穿着一条奶油色的裙子，朴素耐穿，只是领口经过多年拉扯与粗洗已然松垮下塌。袖子长年卷到肘上，留下永不褪去的褶皱，皱纹层层叠叠，像手风琴的褶腹。也因此，她的手与前臂被洗涮、清扫、擦拭磨得通红皲裂。她颈间挂着一条简单的金属链，坠着一枚沉重的铁环，铁面刻着朴拙却优美的几何纹路。
Despite her bouncing blond curls tied back in a jaunty tail and her lovely features, this dwarf is not the bawdy barmaid with rose-kissed cheeks and a cheeky word for her customers. Her face is set like stone, her hazel eyes focusing intently on her current task. When finished, they flit readily about the tavern to search for another. She wears a cream-colored dress, plain and durable, though her collar line sags from years of stretching and rough washing. Her sleeves are permanently wrinkled from rolling them up to her elbows, crinkled like the bellies of accordions. Her hands and arms are, thusly, red and chapped from washing, cleaning, polishing. About her neck, a simple metal chain holds a heavy iron ring etched with simple yet beautiful geometric patterns.

Siegfried Cravenson.name:
西格弗里德·克拉文森
Siegfried Cravenson

Text.text:
一个身披深色油布风衣的人独自等候，兜帽像倒置的三角虚无，将面容尽数吞没，只剩几缕银白长辫垂落，直至腰际。兜帽深处渗出诡异的紫光，映亮油布粗糙的毛边。细长的手指掀开兜帽，一张精灵的灰白面孔随之显露。他妖精族裔的青春气息，被眼窝与颧骨处憔悴的阴影压住，苍白的肤色覆盖在原本无瑕的皮肤上。紫光的源头在他眨眼间变得清晰——翠绿的双眼被浓郁紫水晶色的幽丝缠绕，如幻如烟。他的耳朵细长尖锐，典型的精灵形制，却又带着鳍状边缘；月白般薄透的皮膜让光轻易穿过。

~ 由 一位英雄扮演

A person in a dark oilskin trench coat waits alone, their hood a triangular void hiding their features aside from long braids of silvery hair extending down all the way to their beltline. An eerie purple glow emanates from within, lighting the rough ends of the oiled fabric. Spindly fingers peel back the hood, and the gray-white face of an elf emerges. The youthfulness of his fae ancestry is hampered by the gaunt shadows of his eyes and cheeks and the pallid hue of his otherwise flawless skin. The source of the purple glow becomes apparent as he blinks and his green eyes become wreathed in ethereal threads of rich amethyst color. His ears are long and pointed in an elvish manner, though they are also finned, light easily passing through the thin membrane of moon-pale skin.

~ Played by a Hero

Town Dais Gallows.name:
城镇雏菊绞架
Town Dais Gallows

Text.text:
在镇子创立者那毫无生气的注视下，所谓的罪犯被押往摇摇欲坠的绞架，为他们真实或被臆想出的越轨之举偿命。这座阴森的构造由一座废弃谷仓的残破木梁匆忙拼凑而成——出自偏执狂乱的急就——宛如一座墓碑，昭示着文明究竟何其脆弱。人们从不知自己真正能做出何等恶行，直到逆境将他们击倒在尘土里。
Under the lifeless gaze of the town’s founder, so-called criminals are led to the ramshackle gallows to answer for their transgressions, real or perceived. Hastily cobbled together—in a paranoid mania—from the battered timbers of an abandoned barn, this grim construction stands as testament to the true fragility of civilization. People do not know what evils they are truly capable of until adversity lays them low.

一名兜帽骑手高踞在威武的食肉龙背上，目光穿透灌木丛搜寻猎物。恐龙庞大的双足身躯伏得极低，嗅着空气，利齿因饥渴的期待而咬得咯咯作响。骑手猛地一扯缰绳，以毫厘不差的精确驾驭这头怪物坐骑，随即拔出那柄巨刃。
Perched atop a mighty carnosaur, a hooded rider peers into the brush for prey. The dinosaur’s huge bipedal form hunches low, sniffing the air, teeth grinding with hungry anticipation. Its rider tugs at the reins, guiding their monstrous steed with utter precision, then draws their massive blade.

魁梧的身躯，野猪般的獠牙，翻涌的怒意——他具备兽人所有的外在标记，唯独皮肤苍白得异样——而且还有更多：一种独一无二的克制。那份凶狠、暴力、征服的渴望，全都被压在一种沉静的智慧之下，从他的举止与神情便能看出端倪。他不咆哮，也不龇牙，只在精明的沉默中按兵不动。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

The mighty build, the tusks of a boar, the seething rage—he has all the trappings of an orc, aside from the pallor of his skin—and something more: a unique temperance. The viciousness, the violence, the drive to conquer, all sit beneath a calm intelligence apparent in his manner and expression. He does not yell or snarl, but bides in shrewd silence.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

车夫身着实用的羊毛套装，头戴一顶宽檐帽，好将日晒雨淋一并挡在眼外。他抖了抖长柄马鞭，随着一声清脆炸响，催得他驾驭的牲口沿着这条走惯的官道疾驰向前。
Dressed in a practical woolen suit and wearing a wide-brimmed hat to keep sun and rain alike out of his eyes, the carriage driver twitches his long-handled whip, the resounding crack spurring on his charges down the well-traveled road.

Town Dragged To Hell.name:
被拖入地狱的小镇
Town Dragged To Hell

Text.text:
大地以非人的狂暴震颤，巨大的火山裂缝撕开城镇的鹅卵石街面与周遭田野。裂隙如同巨兽张开的颚口般豁然大开，喷吐出由黑色、硫磺味十足的铁铸成的地狱锁链，贯穿破碎的地表——并开始将其拖拽着坠向炽焰深渊。

~ master_builder75 于 Discord

The ground rumbles with unearthly violence as huge volcanic fissures tear through the cobbles of the town and surrounding fields. Yawning wide like the jaws of an enormous predator, the rifts vomit forth infernal chains made of black, sulfurous iron which pierce the broken land—and begin to drag it down into the fiery depths.

~ master_builder75 on Discord

The Button Man Transforms.name:
纽扣人变身
The Button Man Transforms

Text.text:
他夸张地一甩，将夹克抛落在地，修长的手臂上缠着一圈圈缝线般的印记。他十指猛然张开，如同裂开的利爪，缝合纹身开始蠕动……继而化为真实。针尖从皮下刺出，鲜血顺着臂膀滴落。他痛得闷哼，四肢与头颅都在颤抖，却有一抹狂野的笑意在脸上绽开。随着他笑得更深，嘴角那两道血淋淋的缝线崩裂开来。他的脸裂开，头与颈分离；手臂、手掌、手指尽数喷散——碎块仍以带血的肌肉与血管触须，牵连在躯干之上。那是一盏由筋腱编成、令人作呕地悬浮着的吊灯；他拖着步子向前逼近。游离的舌头淌着血，悬空的眼睛清醒而凶狠，直直盯住你。

~ 出自精彩绝伦的 TTRPG 增补 The Vineyard

He throws his jacket to the floor in an ostentatious flourish, lithe arms coiled with stitched markings. He flares his fingers like splayed claws and the seam tattoos begin to writhe… and become real. Needles pierce up from under his skin, blood dripping down his arms. He grunts with pain, his limbs and head shaking, but a wild smile spreads across his face. His grin widens further as the bloody stitching at the corners of his mouth break apart. His face splits, his head and neck separate; arms, hands, and fingers all spray apart—the pieces still attached to his torso via fleshy tendrils of muscle and vein. A horrible, hovering chandelier of sinew, he shambles forward. His free-floating tongue drips blood, and suspended eyes stare—lucid and vehement—directly at you.

~ Found in the amazing TTRPG supplement The Vineyard

Runes In The Desert.name:
沙漠符文
Runes In The Desert

Text.text:
沙土间一道凹痕延绵，碎石尽被扫空，在荒漠上划出清晰的直线，仿佛某艘飞行舰曾俯冲而下，用船腹擦曳着地面。你循着它的走向望去，发现这道痕迹分裂成两条线，而在更远处，又有第三条线横贯其上。你意识到，不知以何种方式，一道巨大的形状已被刻绘在这片大地上，宛如一幅图画或文字，专供神祇俯瞰。
A depression in the dirt, clear of stones, forms a distinct line across the desert, as if some flying ship had dipped down to drag its hull across the ground. Following its path with your eye, you see that it splits into two lines, and some ways off, a third line crosses them. You realize that somehow a great shape has been drawn across the landscape like a picture or writing for the gods to see.

Swarm Of Velociraptors.name:
迅猛龙群
Swarm Of Velociraptors

Text.text:
你听见一阵呼噜声，夹杂着几声软萌的啾啾鸣叫。高高的丛林草叶间，探出一颗鳞片覆盖的楔形脑袋。那双眼睛既带掠食者的凶光，又透着滑稽的神态。它像宠物般困惑地歪着头，先向左、再向右，随后像鸽子一样咕咕叫了一声。紧接着，树叶上方又冒出一颗几乎一模一样的脑袋。它张口打了个哈欠，嘴里一排排刀刃般的利齿森然排列。又有两颗冒了出来。它们弹跳了一下，然后奔跑……冲向你。

~ Envisioned by firmjello

You hear a purr and a few cute little chirping sounds. A head like a scaly wedge emerges from the tall jungle grasses. Its eyes are at once predatory and comical. Quizzical, like a pet, it cocks its head to the left and then the right, cooing once like a dove. Another nearly identical head pops up over the foliage. It yawns, with rows of teeth like knives lining its mouth. Two more emerge. They bounce, then run… at you.

~ Envisioned by firmjello

Collapse Of An Old Tower.name:
古塔崩塌
Collapse Of An Old Tower

Text.text:
你眼睁睁看着，那座古老高塔如将尽的蜡烛般折叠垮塌，塔基向内塌陷，尘土与碎木翻涌成云。碎裂玻璃的尖啸撕开空气，窗棂在翻滚屋顶的重压下扭曲崩断，紧接着，坠落的石砌结构发出雷鸣般的碾磨声，狠狠撞进你的耳中。

~ 由 thebigham 在 Discord 上所构想的

As you watch, the ancient tower folds like a dwindling candle, its base collapsing inward in a plume of dust and timber. The keening of shattered glass cuts through the air as windows bend and break under the weight of the tumbling roof, then the thunderous grinding of falling masonry assaults your ears.

~ Envisioned by thebigham on Discord

这座矿井的隧道向下延伸得比人类之手凿出的更深——也更狭短。巷道的支护堪称精工奇迹，严丝合缝、对称如镜；井筒被打磨得平滑细致，使那黑与银交织的矿脉一览无余，任何矮人或斯弗涅布林在这折骨的苦役里都能清楚辨认。沿矿井中央向下延伸的轨道完好如新，被长久劳作磨得发亮；其上的矿车轮轴也始终油润顺滑。在这些粗砺岩壁之中，埋藏着厚重的矿脉，其价值足抵王侯的宝库——确实，在某些圈子里，哪怕体型并不算大的秘银矿，也是足以让人不惜杀人灭口的秘密。
The tunnels of this mine run deeper than those made by human hands—rather shorter too. The buttressing of the strike is a marvel of precision and symmetry, and the bore smoothed down in such a way as to make the black and silver vein easily visible to any dwarf or svirfneblin engaged in the back-breaking labor of mining the precious metal. The tracks leading down the mine’s center are in perfect repair, polished smooth with work; and the wheels of the mine carts atop them are kept well-oiled. Within these rough walls lie thick veins of an ore worth a king’s fortune—indeed, a mithral mine of even a modest size is a secret worth killing for, in some circles.

Sundries From A Rust Monster.name:
来自锈蚀怪物的杂物
Sundries From A Rust Monster

Text.text:
你细细检查这只生物：触角上羽丝般的细绒、背部层层叠叠的几丁质甲壳，以及柔软的腹底。浓烈的金属气味自生物的口器与伤口间飘散而出。若有人胃口之强，足以匹敌这只生物铁甲般的消化系统，便可割取其肉制成口粮。
You inspect the creature: the feathery filaments of its antenna, the layers of chitin along its back and the soft underbelly. A strong metallic scent wafts from the creature’s mouth and wounds. For those whose stomachs rival the ironclad digestive system of this creature, its meat might be harvested for rations.

Border Town Caravan Arrives.name:
边境小镇的商队抵达
Border Town Caravan Arrives

Text.text:
夕阳西沉，将天幕染成层层粉霞与鎏金。主广场上，镇民兴奋地交头接耳。几辆马车缓缓驶来——车身各处点缀着诡异的蓝光——最终在广场中央停下。一名身材圆滚的矮人攀上最中间那辆车，喧闹的人群随之渐渐安静。

他俯身一礼，指尖抚过染得鲜亮的胡须，又取出一根魔杖。只见他手腕一抖，迸洒出一串脉动的光点，光点迅速勾勒成类人的轮廓，在空中翻腾跳跃。人群爆发出热烈的掌声。矮人高声喊道：“没错，我的朋友们，卡斯帕的商队到了——里面装满了给你们每个人的惊喜！”

仿佛凭空施展魔法一般，马车两侧的挡板齐刷刷落下，露出一排排货架，琳琅满目，尽是闪烁夺目的珍奇货物。惊叹声四起，人群随之汹涌向前。
As the setting sun paints the sky with myriad shades of pink and gold, townsfolk chatter excitedly in the main square. A group of wagons—each adorned with a strange blue light—pulls to a stop and a portly dwarf clambers atop the central vehicle. The crowd quiets. Bowing, the dwarf strokes his brightly dyed beard and produces a wand. With a flourish, he creates a spray of pulsing light that forms a humanoid shape, which begins to caper in the air. The crowd applauds loudly. The dwarf shouts, “Yes, my friends, Caspar’s Caravan has arrived. Filled with something for you all!” As if by magic, the sides of the wagons drop, revealing shelves bursting with glittering goods. Amid cries of wonder, the crowd surges forward.

Deal From A Charlatan.name:
江湖骗子的交易
Deal From A Charlatan

Text.text:
“我可没法为一个蠢货的理智负责。我的微妙操弄并不会夺走他们的自由意志——我只是轻轻把他们推向正确的方向。至于你，我看得出来，你这样的头脑早就远超这类小把戏，所以我特地为你准备了一桩特别的交易。”
“I can’t be responsible for the rationality of a simpleton. My subtle manipulations don’t rob them of free will—I simply nudge them in the right direction. Now, I can tell that a mind like yours is far beyond such petty tricks, which is why I have a special deal just for you.”

Sinister Magic Symbol.name:
阴森的魔法符号
Sinister Magic Symbol

Text.text:
这间密室的地面上，铺满了以淡蓝绘出的粗阔线条。笔画纵横交错、彼此缠绕，勾勒出一组组同心圆与三角形，外缘又被一圈符号与字符环绕。尽管房间四角的火盆早已燃尽，仍有光亮——整片刻印正幽幽发光。空气沉甸甸的，充满了蓄势未发的魔法余韵。
The floor in this chamber is covered in broad lines drawn in pale blue. The strokes cross and intertwine to form a series of concentric circles and triangles, all surrounded by a ring of symbols and characters. Despite the braziers in the corners of the room being long exhausted, there is light—the entire etching glows. The air is heavy with latent magical energy.

Woman Juggling Daggers.name:
玩飞刀的女人
Woman Juggling Daggers

Text.text:
她灵巧地捏着刀刃将飞刀抛来掷去，双手却没有新添的划痕或豁口。然而，她脸颊上那道粉红、湿亮的细线，或许正泄露了一次真真切切的职业失手。她看起来并不疼——一边以流畅连贯的节奏抛接致命武器，一边带着讥诮而自信的笑意。
She deftly tosses knives by their blades, her hands without fresh nicks or gouges. However, the pink, glistening line running down her cheek perhaps indicates a real instance of an occupational mishap. She does not seem pained, though—her expression is one of smirking confidence as she juggles deadly weapons in fluid succession.

Sundries From A Red Dragon.name:
红龙杂货
Sundries From A Red Dragon

Text.text:
空气中弥漫着浮石与将熄之火的气味。你的目光掠过老龙深红的鳞片，幽暗而闪亮，像刚刚泼洒的鲜血。若能从它的皮甲上剥下几片碎屑，或许能在你下次遇到的集市里换来一笔交易——又或者，就当作你这项专长的战利品。
The scent of pumice and dying fire is rife in the air. Your eyes pass over the deep red scales of the old dragon, gleaming and dark like freshly spilled blood. Harvesting a few chips of its hide might fetch some kind of deal in the next market you come across—or just serve as a trophy of your feat.

Advice To A Glory-seeking Character.name:
给追逐荣耀的角色的忠告
Advice To A Glory-seeking Character

Text.text:
“你知道的，要是你把每一天都耗在追逐荣光上，就再也没剩下什么时代去做真正的自己了——而我相当喜欢那个你。”
“You know, if you spend all your days chasing glory, you’ll have no time left to be who you really are, and I quite like that person.”

作为这道法术的最后一个手势，你像仆从托着托盘般抬起手。回应你的魔法，一只宽阔的圆盘凭空凝现，悬浮在原地，随时听候差遣。
As the final gesture of this spell, you hold up your hand like a servant carrying a platter. In answer to your magic, a wide disc materializes out of thin air and floats in place, ready to serve you.

每个人的头发都根根倒竖，一声尖利、非人间的凄厉尖啸撕裂空气。烛火与鲜血之间，一头哭泣的野兽瘫伏其中，痛苦地扭曲抽搐，呜咽低鸣，皮肤在痉挛中硬化、开裂。自祭献的羔羊体内，一具扭曲的憎恶之物利爪撕开血肉爬出，狂喜长嚎，浑身散发着硫磺的恶臭。
Everyone’s hair stands on end as a shrill unearthly scream rends the air. A weeping beast lies among candles and blood, contorting in agony and mewling as its skin hardens and cracks. A twisted abomination claws its way out from the sacrificial lamb, howling with glee and reeking of brimstone.

她披着天鹅绒斗篷的层叠褶影，手执一根法杖，杖首镶着一只张腿的蜘蛛。施法者咧嘴一笑，顽皮而狡黠。她发出一声干涩的轻笑，黄眼睛越过并拢的双手凝视着你，手指交扣，覆在法杖那黑色金属之上。自她长长的白发间探出的尖耳与深蓝的皮肤，昭示着她是卓尔——只是你注意到，她脸上的肤色比身躯其余部分要浅得多。她肩后不远处浮现出一名兜帽身影，披风与她长袍同样是浓郁的天鹅绒。他们仿佛比影子更像影子，尽可能贴近这位施法者，随着她的步伐无声滑行。

~ Played by Mo

Draped in folds of a velvet cloak and wielding a staff crowned with a splayed spider, the spellcaster grins with a playful, mischievous air. She chuckles dryly as her yellow eyes peer at you from over her clasped hands, her fingers interlacing over the black metal of her staff. The pointed ears poking out from her long white hair and her deep blue skin mark her as a drow, though you note the skin of her face is much lighter than the rest of her. A hooded figure appears just beyond her shoulder, their cloak the same rich velvet as her robes. They seem more shadow than corporeal, keeping as close as they can to the spellcaster as she moves.

~ Played by Mo

一片高草铺展得细密柔美，随风起伏，如同一汪葱郁的绿海，其间溅落着毛茛般的明黄斑点。你不必看见也能感到，在更深处——黑土阴凉而安静——兔子正穿梭于翡翠色的地道里，那些地道仿佛在闪亮的草面之下游动。这里没有种植作物，也没有牲畜放牧。想必有人刻意让这片田地休耕，留待来季再生长。
A fine field of high grass ripples in the breeze, a verdant green ocean splashed with speckles of buttercup yellow. You sense more than see that somewhere in the depths, where the dark earth lies cool and calm, rabbits bound through emerald tunnels that swim beneath the glistening surface. No crop is being grown. No livestock grazes here. Someone must be leaving the field fallow for a future season’s growth.

Monk Performing Slow Fall.name:
武僧施展【缓落】
Monk Performing Slow Fall

Text.text:
一位容貌清秀、年代深远的僧侣曾说：若你发现自己正在坠落，几乎总有东西可供你抓住——哪怕只是空气里的湿意。目的不在于让自己坠得更慢，而在于攀住一切可攀之物，向上爬，直到大地再次回到你的脚下。
A monk of beautiful and significant age once said that if you find yourself falling, there is almost always something on which to take hold, even if it is simply the moisture in the air. The purpose is not to make yourself fall more slowly, but to climb whatever can be climbed until the ground is under your feet again.

Loot From A Wicker Zombie.name:
柳条丧尸（特征）的战利品
Loot From A Wicker Zombie

Text.text:
在受诅咒的丧尸（特征）那焦黑起皱、像被火烙过的皮肉上，你找到了一把钥匙——如今竟像烙铁般嵌进它的皮肤里。尽管已被熏黑灼烧，它仍然能用。也许它能开启附近的什么东西。
On the cursed zombie’s charred, puckered flesh, you find a key—now embedded into its skin like a branding iron. Though blackened and burnt, it is still usable. Perhaps it opens something nearby.

男人手里的枪在颤抖，他把枪口朝你推来，攥得指节发白。索要钱时，他的嗓音破裂，眼眶里泛起泪光。那件肮脏破烂的夹克底下有个小小的包裹呜咽了一声，引得他一愣；你看见他的神色骤然一软，他轻声嘘着那团包裹，缓缓摇晃，像哄睡般温柔。枪口垂了下去，他掀开外套，露出一个才出生没几天、正细细啼哭的婴儿。  
“求你……”他低声呢喃，“她饿了。”
The gun in the man's hand trembles as he pushes it toward you, knuckles pale from the strength of his grip. His voice cracks as he demands money, and his eyes well up with tears. A small bundle beneath his dirty tattered jacket whimpers, drawing his attention, and you see his demeanor shift as he softly shushes the bundle, rocking it gently. Lowering the gun, he opens his coat to reveal a mewling babe no more than a few days old. “Please,” he whispers. “She's hungry.”

Rumor Of Lost Riches Overheard At The Ta.name:
在酒馆里无意听来的失落财宝传闻
Rumor Of Lost Riches Overheard At The Tavern

Text.text:
“只有傻子才会踏进焦油沼泽。不过话说回来，那些深坑里埋没的财富传闻，或许足以让人探头一窥……”
“Only a fool would step foot into the Tar Swamp. But then again, the stories of the riches lost in those pits might be enough to warrant a peek...”

起初看似一座小丘的东西，走近才发现是一道覆满藤蔓、顶生蕨冠的高墙。其上又有更多墙体层层拔起，如同巨人踏出的巍峨阶梯——宏伟的金字形神塔从丛林中崛起，探出头来，刺破林冠。上方一道寒光掠过，攫住了你的目光。自你所处的位置很难看清，但你隐约见到塔顶立着一名身披黄金的人，而此刻你也注意到那里还飘起一缕细薄的轻烟。
What at first seemed to be a hill proves to be a vine-covered and fern-topped wall. More walls rise above the first in a series of titanic steps as the great ziggurat rises out of the jungle to rear its head from the forest canopy. A glint up there catches your eye. It’s hard to see from your vantage point, but someone wearing gold stands at the top, and now you spy a thin wisp of smoke up there as well.

在你面前坚实的岩壁中轰然迸裂而出的是一团怪诞的血肉混合体，牙与爪纠缠成形。它庞大而无毛的身躯披着皱褶丛生的粉红皮肤，两对珠粒般的白化小眼——足有餐盘大小——从那长着胡须的口鼻上方死死盯住你，鼹鼠般的巨口不住抽动。由纯粹精金铸成的凶残獠牙将最后几块碎岩碾得像蛋糕屑般轻松，随后咔哒一合，仿佛在品尝空气。闻到比岩石更可口的气味，它便踩着泛着绿金属光泽的利爪朝你猛扑而来，短短的残尾因期待而急促抽搐……
Erupting from the solid rock before you is a monstrous, fleshy amalgamation of teeth and claws. Its massive hairless body is draped in wrinkled pink skin, and two sets of beady albino eyes—the size of dinner plates—stare from above its whiskered snout, as its molelike maw twitches. Vicious fangs of pure adamantine crush the last bits of broken rock as easily as if they were cake crumbs, then click together as it tastes the air. Smelling something more satisfying than rock, it scrambles toward you on green-metallic claws, its nub tail twitching in anticipation…

Aagni And Barh’s Searflight Taproom.name:
阿格尼与巴尔的灼翼酒馆
Aagni And Barh’s Searflight Taproom

Text.text:
作为镇上规模最大的店铺之一，这家餐馆以金顶高塔夺人眼球，喧闹的笑声与乐声翻涌不息，烤肉与蔬菜的馥郁香气更是令人垂涎。踏入其中，目之所及皆是盛宴：灼焰般的魔法光球在梁架间飞舞，照亮一张张圆桌与下方擦得锃亮的吧台。两位龙裔店主——一位红鳞，一位白鳞——同时扮演东道主、侍者与表演者的角色。那位猩红鳞片的家伙用炽烈吐息烤炙整块肉肘，砰然一声把烤得恰到好处的肉块砸到盘中，旁边配着焦香的蔬菜与绵密的奶油土豆。你总能在嘈杂声浪之上，频频听见他那响亮而沙哑的笑。与此同时，雪鳞的那位则用自己同样带着魔力的吐息轻轻一吹，便让大酒杯始终覆着霜意冰寒；他一口耀眼得刺目的整齐牙齿在下颌前突的咬合里格外显眼。其余员工大多穿着素净，唯独系着鲜艳的红银腰带——向两位张扬店主致意的装饰。
One of the largest establishments in the town, this restaurant demands attention with its golden-roofed tower, the boisterous sounds of laughter and music, as well as the mouth-watering aroma of roasted meats and vegetables.
