Inside, it is a feast for the eyes. Magical orbs of fiery light dance in the rafters, lighting the round tables and perfectly polished bar below. The two dragonborn proprietors, one red-scaled and one white, play the roles of hosts, servers, and entertainers all at once. The crimson one roasts hocks of meat with his fiery breath, thudding the perfectly charred portions onto plates next to seared vegetables and creamed potatoes. You hear his loud, rasping laugh often over the general clamor. The snow-scaled one, meanwhile, keeps tankards frosty with a soft whistle of his own magical breath. His full set of brilliantly bright teeth stick out in an underbite. The other members of the staff are adorned in mostly plain clothes aside from vibrant sashes of red and silver: homages to the flamboyant owners.

一阵寒风猛然破空而来，裹挟着阴沉的能量，刺得你的皮肤一阵发麻。区域里的残骸碎屑窸窣作响、簌簌震颤，有些甚至被卷起抛飞。忽然，一股力量从背后重重撞上你，随即穿过你的身体奔涌而过，腐烂与败坏的恶臭灌满你的鼻腔。 A burst of cold wind shoots through the air, laced with a dark energy that makes your skin prickle. Detritus around the area rustles and shakes, some pieces even being picked up and thrown. A sudden force hits you from behind and then surges through you, filling your nostrils with the stench of rot and decay.

没什么东西比一只用抽绳束口的帆布袋，或一只用金属钩扣与铆眼扣死的皮革背包，更能点燃人的好奇心。它就那么挂在马鞍后侧，马儿静静等着——里面装的是寡淡的行军口粮和修补工具？钱？装着宝石或首饰的小袋子？铅丸与法术材料？又或者，是情报。哪怕只想偷瞄一眼的诱惑，都足以把人折磨得坐立难安。
Few things spark one’s curiosity like a canvas bag with a cord clasp, or a leather pack held shut by a metal hook and grommet. Hanging there just behind the saddle as the horse waits—is it full of bland trail rations and repair kits? Money? Small pouches of gems or jewelry? Shot and spell components? Perhaps information. The temptation, even to peek, is torturous.

The Grave Of Alexis Molyneux.name:
亚历克西斯·莫利纽克斯之墓
The Grave Of Alexis Molyneux

Text.text:
在一根高耸的多立克石柱上，柱面凿出一卷浮雕卷轴，石质因潮气而多孔，遍布斑驳地衣。其上以细密微小的刻痕写道：此处长眠着一位年轻的法师，她将呼唤伸入五代之深的黑暗，只为追寻祖先之力——而她确实找到了。
On a tall Doric stone with a scroll carved into its face, porous with moisture and patchy with lichen, an inscription in fine, small carving reads: Here lies a young mage who called into darkness five generations deep, seeking the power of her ancestor, and who found it.

Bugbear: Surprise Attack.name:
熊地精（特征）：奇袭攻击
Bugbear: Surprise Attack

Text.text:
你察觉得太晚：那魁梧的身影无声无息地自藏匿处滑出。熊地精（特征）咧嘴狞笑，带刺的木棒猛然落下，正砸在你失去平衡的身体上。
Too late you become aware of the hulking form as it slips silently from hiding. The bugbear sneers as the blow from its spiked club falls on your off-balance body.

Walking Cane In The Road.name:
路中的手杖
Walking Cane In The Road

Text.text:
蜿蜒的道路仿佛无尽延伸，枯灌木与嶙峋锐岩铺展成荒凉的原野，既无掩蔽，也无歇脚之处。你继续前行，目光紧盯着不稳地面，双脚在粗暴的折磨下发出无声的抗议。

一处异样攫住了你的注意——有东西垂直插在地里，高过矮灌木，却只到你腰间：一根手杖牢牢钉在干裂的土中。你的手指抚过古老木身的圆润曲线，表面被呼啸的狂风与灼人的烈日磨得光滑。你握紧用力一拔，却发现它稳如山岳，纹丝不动。

然而……你的脚步不再酸痛，一股焕然的力量自头至脚将你包裹。
The winding road seems to stretch for miles without end, fields of dry brush and sharpened rock offering no shelter or place of respite. You march on, eyes fixed on the uneven ground while your feet protest at the harsh treatment. An anomaly catches your attention—sticking perpendicular to the ground, higher than the low shrubs, yet only up to your waist: a walking cane stuck firmly into the dry ground. Your hand moves over the smooth curves of the ancient wood, worn by the blasting winds and scorching sun. Gripping to pull it out, you find it as immovable as a mountain. And yet… your feet no longer ache, and a rejuvenating energy envelops you from head to toe.

Argentine Pewderwell.name:
阿根廷·皮尤德韦尔
Argentine Pewderwell

Text.text:
暮色四合，他漫不经心地拨弄着一把精工雕琢的鲁特琴，修长的黑发男子凝视着倚在近旁枯木上的镜子。那张脸僵涩地扭动着，神情不停变换，仿佛这些表情对他而言全然陌生。他那双闪耀的银色眼睛——空无瞳孔——不泄露半分心绪，却仍执拗地继续这场古怪的练习。听见队伍回营的动静，他转过身来，面容瞬间塑成一个逼真——却又刻意——的笑，热情地向他们问候；随即起身，抚平那件精致黑衬衫上的褶皱。一切都只是表演的一部分。

~ Played by marrogh

Idly strumming a beautifully crafted lute in the evening twilight, the lithe, dark-haired man stares into the mirror propped up on a nearby log. His face moves awkwardly as his expression constantly shifts, like the act is foreign to him. His shining silver eyes—bereft of pupils—give nothing away as he continues his curious exercise. Turning as he hears the party return to camp, his face morphs into a convincing—yet artificial—smile as he greets them warmly, getting to his feet and smoothing the creases from his fine black shirt. All part of the show.

~ Played by marrogh

I Cast Prismatic Wall.name:
我施放棱彩之墙
I Cast Prismatic Wall

Text.text:
我的衣袍被潜藏的力量鼓荡翻卷，此刻正攀升至巅峰。我将双臂高高举起，一顶虹彩王冠在眉间凝聚成形。我高声下令，一道七重之墙自天穹投射而下，封锁我目标的去路。每一层都呈现不同的虹色，微微闪烁，半透明得仿佛由宝石铸成。我能看见第一层弥散出的灼热热霾，色泽猩红，炽烈得仿佛要灼起水泡。
My clothes billow with my latent power, now rising to a pitch. I raise my arms upward as a prismatic crown coalesces upon my brow. I shout the command and a seven-layered wall beams down from the sky to block my target's path. Each layer is a different color of the rainbow, glimmering and slightly transparent, as if made of gemstone. I can see the haze of heat emanating from the first layer, colored a blistering red.

A Tribal Dance.name:
一支部族之舞
A Tribal Dance

Text.text:
深沉的鼓点踏着野兽般的心跳，急促却柔和。更高音的鼓随即加入——节奏迸出火星，勾引着、催促着。庆祝者或跳或走，越过火环，踏入敞开的圆场。手臂高举挥舞，在火焰前化作漆黑的剪影。舞者腾跃落地，抓住彼此，摇摆、贴磨。夜色被一声喊、一声啸叫、继而一记口哨撕开；在星光与烟雾之下，舞者们沉入仪式般的韵律。

~ Envisioned by Justin M

The deep drums play to the beat of the animal heart, quick but soft. Higher drums join in—sparks of rhythm that invite and entice. The celebrants jump or walk across the ring of fire, into the open circle. Arms raise and wave in black silhouette against the flames. Dancers leap and land, grab one another to sway and grind. The night breaks with a shout, a hoot, then a whistle, and under the stars and smoke the dancers fall into a ritual pattern.

~ Envisioned by Justin M

Lord’s Crushery.name:
领主的粉碎坊
Lord’s Crushery

Text.text:
堆在此处的大多数骸骨都被砸得粉碎，化作一片片骨屑。越远离中心，骨架便越完整；而最外缘几乎全是来自多种类人种族、尚算完好的整具骷髅遗骸。东北侧的壁龛里立着一柄大槌，东南方的开口则露出一段浅浅的台阶，向上延伸。
Most of the skeletons piled here have been pummeled into chips of bone. The skeletons become more intact further from the center, and the outer edge is composed of mostly whole skeletal bodies from many humanoid races. In northeastern niche stands a maul, while the southeast opening reveals shallow stairs leading up.

破烂的锁子甲在裸露的白骨上叮当作响，骷髅战士踏着沉重的步伐向你逼近。它那无颌的头骨里吹出一声低沉的尖啸，像灵魂终末的挽歌穿骨而过。它以死握攥着一柄锈蚀长刃，身后拖着一面坑痕斑驳的铁盾——盾形宛如折叠的蝠翼。它越走越近，空洞的眼眶骤然迸起紫水晶般的光芒，直直钻入你的心底。哀号戛然而止，可覆在这不死怪物身上的沉重寂静，却更令人胆寒。
Tattered mail clinks on exposed bone as the skeletal warrior marches toward you. A low keening wail whistles from its jawless skull like the soul's final dirge. It holds a rusted blade in a death grip and drags a pitted iron shield shaped like a folded bat wing behind it. As it draws close, its hollow eye sockets flare with an amethyst light that bores into your very heart. The wailing stops, but the heavy silence now draping this undead horror is far worse.

Loot From A Displacer Beast.name:
来自移位兽的战利品
Loot From A Displacer Beast

Text.text:
闪烁豹即便死去，双眼仍泛着尖刻的恶意幽光。你检查这头被杀的野兽，发现它脖颈结实的肌肉上扣着一条华丽的项圈：上等皮革染成靛蓝，镶着四枚品红色调的石榴石。
The blink panther’s eyes glow with acerbic malice even in death. Examining the slain beast, you discover a fancy collar fastened around the corded muscles of its neck, fine leather dyed indigo and studded with four magenta-hued garnets.

你面前这只矮壮的双足蜥蜴人，斑驳的鳞皮像一幅拼贴画般粗粝嵌合。它那条柔韧的身躯裹着简陋的皮质护甲，天生为潜入阴影、隐匿无声而生。鳄形的面孔深处嵌着一对锐利的豆眼，冷光一闪，尽是狡黠。两眼之间起始一条细小的棘脊，棘端如角，沿着它瘦窄的躯干向后向下延伸，直至身后扭动的长尾。它用带爪的手握着上弦的弩，嘴间横咬着一柄卡塔短刺作后手。
The squat, bipedal saurian before you is a mosaic of dappled, scale-encrusted skin. Their sinuous body—covered by simple leather armor—is tailored for slinking through shadows, unseen. Set deep into their crocodilian face is a set of keen, beady eyes that glint with cold cunning. Between them begins a ridge of small, horned spines that trail back and down the length of their narrow torso to the long tail that twists behind them. They hold a cocked crossbow in their clawed hands, with a katar resting between their teeth as backup.

Library Of Arcana: In The Shadows.name:
奥秘图书馆：暗影之中
Library Of Arcana: In The Shadows

Text.text:
空气里有什么变了——也许是温度？你四下寻找缘由，书架上那些印着字母的书脊忽然开始摇晃、失焦，轮廓彼此融化，像被抹开一般，在你视野里拖成一条条浑浊的色带；它们向前延展，又在那不可能的远处汇拢。仿佛你正沿着这条由旋涡般线条构成的隧道望去，尽头只有一点微光。你死死盯着，僵在原地、如遭雷击——一道阴影浮现，遮暗了那遥远的亮点，而那阴影还在扩张。等你的视线猛地恢复正常时，那幻象或幻觉已无影无踪。可你仍能感觉到……有什么……正在逼近。
There is a change in the air—the temperature, perhaps? As you look about for an explanation, the lettered spines on the bookshelves waver and blur together, their shapes smearing across your vision into bars of muddy color that extend then converge somewhere in the impossible distance. It seems as though you look down a tunnel of these swirling lines to a point of light. As you stare, frozen and thunderstruck, a shadow appears, dimming the far brightness, and that shadow grows. When your vision snaps back to normal, no trace of that illusion or hallucination remains. But you still feel that… something… is coming.

那个瘦长的家伙低哼一声，费力把一桶辨不出是什么的糊状残羹拖到动物园某个笼舍后方，毫不客气地把饲料倒进围栏后侧的食槽里。身为饲养员的时代与日积月累的习惯，早已让他与异域猛兽的打交道变成了单调重复、周而复始的日常苦差。
The rangy fellow grunts as he heaves a bucket of some unidentifiable slop to the rear of one of the zoo’s cages, unceremoniously dumping the feed into a trough at the rear of the enclosure. Time as a zookeeper and habit have found a way to make interacting with exotic animals a repetitious, day-to-day chore for him.

I Work On Deciphering My Manual Of Golem.name:
我埋首破解我的魔像手册
I Work On Deciphering My Manual Of Golems

Text.text:
这本书令人叹服，短小精悍，一针见血。但每一页都像一块石碑，沉重难驭。于是我只能伏在桌前，四周烛火摇曳，研读每幅图画周围镌刻的简洁而优雅的公式。血肉魔像尤为棘手，我几乎要感受到那种较弱的施法者会承受的伤害。
This is an impressive book, short and to the point. But each page is its own stone tablet and not an easy thing to wield. So, I find myself hunched over a table, candles all around, working the simple and elegant formulae chiseled around each picture. The flesh golem is especially challenging, and I’m on the brink of feeling the damage a lesser spellcaster would suffer.

Mace Of Smiting.name:
惩击钉头锤
Mace Of Smiting

Text.text:
乍一看，这柄钉头锤与同类风吹雨打的寻常旧物别无二致。细看之下才发现：锤头裹着一层粉末，原本是砖、石、车床残屑与灰浆的碎屑；可一旦将其悉数刷净，竟找不出哪怕一道凹痕或缺口。那暗哑、平坦的铁锤头上，确实不存在任何瑕疵。锤柄配着结实、朴实无华的铁木握把，唯一的装饰在末端的柄帽上：那里有一道拙劣却清晰的刻痕，刻着一个方方正正的人形，自腰间被砸断成两截。
At first glance, the mace looks no different than an ordinary weathered specimen of its type. Closer inspection reveals that, though the head is caked in powder that was once brick, stone, lathe, and mortar, once all is brushed away, there is not a single ding or chip to be found. Indeed, there is not a single imperfection in the dull, flat iron head. The haft features a solid, no-nonsense ironwood grip, yet there is a single decoration; on the end of the butt cap, there’s an inexpert but clear engraving of a blocky figure, smashed in half at the waist.

Faerie Plane: Bullywug Court With Pool O.name:
妖精位面：牛蛙人宫廷与一汪水池
Faerie Plane: Bullywug Court With Pool Of Water

Text.text: 你发现自己置身于一座洁净无瑕的王家宫廷：光滑的立柱、闷燃的火盆、垂挂的绣毯。一个长方形的墨黑水池切开了完美抛光的大理石地面，几块漂浮的石板一路引向殿室尽头的王座。王座上方垂着一棵与外头那株相似的树，粉叶摇曳，金莓沉甸甸，宛如多臂的守护者俯悬其上。身着贵族礼服的蛙人——外套与长裙上点缀着华饰——把矮壮的脑袋一齐转向你。各个小圈子里，零星传来喜悦与惊讶的呱鸣。随即，一声结结巴巴的croak响起——像是礼貌地清了清嗓子。一个灰皮肤的蛙人穿着蓝色燕尾服走近，他把脖颈鼓胀成半透明的气泡。“打扰了，偶然到访的客人，”他说，“你们的请柬在哪儿？” You find yourself in a pristine royal court with smooth columns, smoldering braziers, and hanging tapestries. A rectangular pool of ink-black water cuts through the perfectly polished marble floors, floating stone slabs leading up to a throne at the end of the chamber. A tree similar to the specimen outside, pink-leafed and heavy with golden berries, hangs above the throne like a many-armed guardian. Frogkin in noble attire—coats and gowns drizzled in finery—turn their squat heads toward you. Some ribbits of delight and surprise chirrup from the disparate cliques. A stuttering croak sounds—akin to a polite clearing of the throat. A gray-skinned frogkin in a blue tailcoat approaches. He expands his neck into a translucent bubble. “Excuse me, adventitious guests,” he says. “Where is your invitation?”

Ramiel Morningstar.name:
拉米埃尔·晨星
Ramiel Morningstar

Text.text:
年轻女子嘴角扬起轻松而自信的笑意，眼眸如黄玉般闪亮。她身上带着一股收敛的力量感，健美的身形包裹在拼拼凑凑的半身板甲护甲之下。橄榄色的肌肤上不见多少醒目的伤疤，可她在钢板间自如从容的步伐，已足以证明她在战场上的本领。她抬手捋过短短的黑发，发梢染着一抹猩红，随即迫不及待地向前迈步。

~ Played by Jamie Cronier

An easy, confident grin tugs at the young woman’s lips, her eyes agleam like topaz. She carries a subdued strength, her athletic build enshrouded in piece-meal half-plate armor. No significant scars mar her olive skin, yet the ease with which she moves beneath the steel plates is evidence enough of her prowess in battle. She runs a hand through short-cropped black hair, tipped with crimson, and steps eagerly forward.

~ Played by Jamie Cronier

Owen Wayne Price, 6th Year House Wyvern.name:
欧文·韦恩·普莱斯，六年级，飞龙学院
Owen Wayne Price, 6th Year House Wyvern

Text.text:
他透过眼镜的目光，早已带着久经战场的法师冷峻；一头浅棕色的微卷头发如山崩般倾泻，坠落至近肩。尽管个头不高，他却结实灵敏；而在日常世界里，他的野心是成为一名消防员。他常常出言讥诮，既擅长电子游戏，也精通元素魔法；他那抹笑容，更像一道顽皮的法术。
He already has the stare of battle-hardened wizard behind his glasses, and his hair is a landslide of wavy light brown falling nearly to his shoulders. Though he isn’t tall, he’s fit and quick, and his ambition is to be a firefighter in the quotidian world. He is frequently sarcastic, adept at video games and elemental magic, and his smile is a spell of mischief.

蜿蜒的地道向前延伸，远远超出人眼所能及，尤其是在墙上那如血脉般蔓生的发光地衣所带来的昏暗光照之下更是如此。它们也映照出居住于此者的矮小身形——人类孩子都会觉得这些通道逼仄难行，成年人则得深深佝身才能通过。侏儒聚落的共同体精神也在这里一览无遗：几乎看不到门扉，只有帘幕用作遮蔽私密，仿佛从未想过要提防同伴的侵扰与掠夺。
Twisting tunnels stretch further than the human eye can see, especially given the dim light provided by luminous lichen running like veins along the walls. They also reflect the diminutive stature of those who dwell here—a human child would find these passages cramped, and an adult would have to stoop quite low. The communal spirit of the gnome settlement is evident in the lack of doors, with curtains for privacy only and seemingly no thought given to security from the depredations of their fellows.

即便是最微小的魔法也能如奇迹般动人：不需火焰的光亮、比雪花更无实体的幻象、让笑容稍稍更添魅力。但这道法术当真称得上神迹。你吟诵咒词，感到一股浩荡而仁慈的力量涌入掌心，明白下一位被它触及的人，将从沉重的苦难中痊愈。
Even the littlest magic can be miraculous: a light without fire, an illusion with less substance than a snowflake, a smile made slightly more charming. But this spell truly does wonders. You chant the words and feel a magnanimous power flow into your hand, knowing that whomever it touches next will be cured of a grave affliction.

Dragon's Library.name:
巨龙的图书馆
Dragon's Library

Text.text:
在这座学术殿堂的穹顶大厅里，找不到一枚钱币，也没有宝石或珠宝。这条巨龙偏爱书卷般的珍藏，认为一个好故事的价值足以等同黄金。古老典籍散发的馥郁麝香渗入满是尘埃的空气，你的脚步声在宏伟长廊间回荡——两侧是一排排高耸书架，层层叠叠，直抵上方。

~ crunchyzombies 于 Discord

No coins, gems, or jewels can be found here in the vaulted halls of academia. This dragon prefers treasures of a literary nature and considers a good story worth its weight in gold. The aromatic musk of ancient volumes permeates the dust-filled air as your footsteps echo down enormous corridors lined with rows of towering shelves.

~ crunchyzombies on Discord

Magical Stone Circle: The Menhirs.name:
魔法石环：巨石柱
Magical Stone Circle: The Menhirs

Text.text:
石柱高耸矗立，在荒瘠的大地与苍白的天幕前投下冷峻的剪影。尽管它们彼此相隔甚远、又高得惊人，却仿佛仍在相互偎聚——宛如一圈披斗篷的身影，为某个阴暗目的悄然密谋。
The stones stand tall, starkly silhouetted against the barren ground and pale sky. Despite their height and distance from one another, they seem to huddle together, like a circle of cloaked figures come to collude with one another for some dark purpose.

Druid Insult About Ignorance.name:
德鲁伊对无知的讥讽
Druid Insult About Ignorance

Text.text:
“你尽可以把自己裹进再多的卷轴与荣誉里。但你读过的所有书卷典籍，都出自凡人之手的潦草涂写；而只要你仍追随它们，你便只会在世界的表面轻轻掠过，从不低头一看。”
“You can wrap yourself in as many scrolls and accolades as you wish. But all the books and tomes you read were scribbled by mortal hands, and as long as you follow them, you will only skip across the world’s surface without ever looking down.”

Prosthetic Hand Of Lightning.name:
闪电义手
Prosthetic Hand Of Lightning

Text.text:
一只木制义手，工艺精湛，每个指节都装有灵活关节；即便不附加任何魔法花哨，也足以胜任本职——但掌心的符文装饰暗示着它具备召唤之能。那些符号以多条各异的线条横贯掌心，仿佛血肉手掌上自然生成的掌纹沟壑。每一根指尖上，都蚀刻着一道闪电的标记。

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

A wooden hand built masterfully with flexible joints at each knuckle, this prosthetic would serve its purpose without any added magical flair—but the runes decorating the palm suggest this device can conjure. The symbols run across the palm in various different lines, mimicking natural palm creases that appear in flesh. On each fingertip, a lightning bolt symbol has been etched.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Their Majesty's Chessboard.name:
陛下的棋盘
Their Majesty's Chessboard

Text.text:
整副棋具都由大理石凿刻而成，闪着光，仿佛经常被人擦拭抛光。棋盘的格子黑白相间：白色石面覆着一层银色包浆般的光泽，黑色石面则被金线震裂般划开。棋子散落在鏖战正酣的局面里，阵亡者却被整整齐齐码在两侧——这场战斗被按下了暂停，只等玩家再次相会。白方的王与后戴着深蓝宝石的王冠，黑方的王与后则戴着赤红宝石加冕。那些王冠的造型有些古怪：每顶冠上都有一根尖角高出其余……并向外卷曲，宛如公羊、山羊或巨龙的角。

~ 出自惊艳的 TTRPG 增补The Vineyard

The entire chess set is hewn from marble, and gleams as if routinely polished. The squares of the board alternate between white stone run with silver patina and black shocked with lines of gold. The pieces are all scattered mid-fray, with casualties lined up neatly on the sides—the battle paused until the players can meet again. The King and Queen of the white pieces wear crowns of dark blue gemstone, while the King and Queen of the black are crowned in red. The crowns are a bit strange in design. Each has a point that extends higher than the others… and curls, much like the horn of a ram, goat, or dragon.

~ Found in the amazing TTRPG supplement The Vineyard

虎口大张，下颌的毛被涎水浸透，湿漉漉地结成尖刺。它来回踱步，肩头起伏，灼烧般的琥珀色眼睛死死锁定目标。胸腔里滚出低沉的咆哮，唇边翻起，露出两枚细长的獠牙。耳朵向后掠去，下一瞬，这只大猫骤然压低身形，条纹皮毛与四周的枝叶融为一体。
Jaw agape, the fur of the tiger’s chin is wet and spiked with slaver. Its shoulders bob as it paces, its burning, amber eyes fixated on its mark. A low, rumbling growl emits from its chest as lips flare over two elongated fangs. Ears flicked back, the cat suddenly bends low, striped fur mingling with the surrounding foliage.

这绝不是后巷里的义体小铺。前台站着你见过最光彩夺目的女人——五官对称得近乎完美，一束整齐的赤褐色长发如绳般沿背脊垂落。每一处表面都一尘不染，仿佛加了香料的蛋壳白石灰岩，触感微微温热。大厅里一面弧形屏幕滚动展示员工档案：医生与护士的资历皆出自世界最负盛名的学术殿堂。衣着利落的技师推着磁悬浮运载车穿行其间，运送最前沿的赛博义体。车上满载无数精英等级的植入体——生物科技与铬合金的顶级融合体。

~ 一位英雄的构想

This is no back-alley chrome shop. At the reception stands the most glamorous woman you have ever seen, perfectly symmetrical and with a neat rope of auburn hair cascading down her back. Each surface is immaculate, a mulled-eggshell limestone that is slightly warm to the touch. A curved screen in the lobby displays the profiles of the staff: doctors and nurses with qualifications from the world’s most prestigious academic institutions. Neatly dressed technicians transport cutting-edge cyberware in maglev carry carts. These carts are laden with numerous elite-level implants, top-tier fusions of biotech and chrome.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Professor Of Charms.name:
魔咒学教授
Professor Of Charms

Text.text:
唯一被认为能与女校长匹敌的教授，就是这位教授“影响之术”的女人。中和。心灵操控。她在任何方面都平淡无奇：一张不起眼的脸，保守得体的穿着。头发剪成齐耳短发，有时会挑一缕大胆的亮色。传言她上课时会让学生陷入迷醉，因此几乎所有人都牢牢记得魅惑课的内容。她的回答是：“流言蜚语，不过是些微小却强劲的魅惑戏法——连不会魔法的人也能施放。”
The only professor considered as powerful as the headmistress is this woman teaching the art of influence. Neutralization. Mind control. She is vanilla in every way, plain-faced and conservatively dressed. Her hair is cut in a bob, sometimes with a bold streak of color. Rumor is that she mesmerizes the students as she teaches, which is why almost everyone remembers their charms lessons. Her answer: “Rumors are tiny and powerful charm cantrips even nonmagical folks can cast.”

Insult About An Unfocused Character.name:
对一个心不在焉的角色的羞辱
Insult About An Unfocused Character

Text.text:
“你脑子里有过完整的念头吗？还是说，你的意识只是一连串冲动与支离破碎的尖叫，争相撕扯你的注意力？”
“Do you ever have a complete thought? Or is your mind just a series of urges and incoherent screams vying for your attention?”

Hacker Manipulates Security Doors And Wi.name:
黑客操纵安防门与窗
Hacker Manipulates Security Doors And Windows

Text.text: 他在控制面板上飞快敲击，双眼泛着微光，映出屏幕的倒影。两条电缆自他颈侧蜿蜒而出，插入安保系统，光纤般的“血管”闪烁着虹彩般的辉光。“搞定。”他说着，手掌迅捷在胸口一拍，电缆便从系统中弹出，像卷尺回收般滑入皮下。挡住去路的沉重钢门门栓发出浑厚的咔哒声，伴随解锁而松开，门槛上方的灯瞬间跳成明亮的绿色。窗户的栅条也随之移动，伴着金属的锵一声向内缩回。 He types away on the control panel, eyes aglow, reflecting the screen. Cables snaking from either side of his neck are jacked into the security system, their fiber-optic veins glowing iridescent. “Done,” he says and, with a swift tap against his chest, the cables unplug from the system and slide under his skin like retracting measuring tape. The bolts of the heavy steel doors blocking the path click sonorously as they release, the lights above the threshold turning a bright green. The bars of the windows shift as well, retracting with a metallic shing.

I Place My Tree Feather Token On The Gro.name:
我把树羽徽记放在地上
I Place My Tree Feather Token On The Ground

Text.text:
我取出那枚微小的羽羽徽记，翠绿的石面上爬满烟灰色的蛛网纹路。我将它掷向地面，随着大地一声低沉的轰鸣，一棵巨大的橡树破土而出。它以超自然的迅疾拔高到六十英尺，泥土与尘埃被生长的力量向四周迸散。树干在吱呀作响中膨胀舒展，树皮裂隙里已经有小虫在探头探脑。伸展的枝条间鸟鸣四起，深绿的叶片簇簇新生，点缀着几只绒团般的小鸟。
I take out the tiny feather token, its green stone veined with smoky-gray spidering lines. I throw it onto the ground and, with a low rumble from the earth, a great oak tree springs up. Dirt and dust splay out as it grows with supernatural expedience to a height of sixty feet. Its trunk expands with creaks and stretches, little bugs already exploring the breaks in the bark. Its extending branches are alive with birdsong, sprouting with deep green leaves and small, tufted birds.

“想喝点啥？”酒保问道。那半兽人高大魁梧，肩宽得比大多数门框还要夸张。他们把巨大的双手在一条肮脏、沾满污渍的围裙上擦了擦，随即倚在吧台上，木头在那重量下发出吱呀呻吟。酒保裸露的前臂上布满细密的疤痕，像是刀刃留下的印记；他们的指节上纹着字母，拼成“MAUL”和“STAB”。
“What’ll ya have?” the barkeep inquires. The half-orc stands tall and broad, with shoulders wider than most doorways. They wipe their massive hands clean on a dingy, stained apron, and lean on the bar, the wood creaking beneath the weight. Fine scars line the barkeep’s exposed forearms, indicative of blade wounds; upon their knuckles, tattooed letters read “MAUL” and “STAB.”

灯塔周围的水域漆黑幽深，宛如最寒冷的冬夜；无论天气如何，都在不息翻涌、搅动。偶尔，粗大而富有弹性的触手会探出水面，盲目地攫抓着一切胆敢靠得太近的蠢货。
Waters, as dark and deep as the coldest winter night, constantly churn and roil around the lighthouse—no matter the weather. Occasionally, large rubbery tentacles probe above the surface, grasping blindly for anything foolish enough to stray too close.

这些词语古老而陌生，仿佛不属于此世，但你依然将它们一一忆起。当它们自你唇间逸出，你完成了那细微而诡异的动作，将施法材料——水滴、红宝石粉末——洒向区域。焚香燃起，烟缕盘绕在你身侧，继而向外流淌，裹覆区域；在它掠过之处，一圈符文短暂迸闪出奥术的光辉。
The words are ancient, and not of this world, but you recall them all the same. As they leave your lips, you complete the subtle, uncanny movements and sprinkle the components—droplets of water, powdered ruby—over the area. The incense burning and coiling around you flows outward, enshrouding the area, and in its wake, a circle of runes briefly flashes with an arcane light.

Ocean Of Mercury.name:
水银之海
Ocean Of Mercury

Text.text:
一片深不见底的亮银色海洋铺满整颗星球的表面，缓慢而沉重地翻涌着黏稠的波浪。扫描器显示这片海完全由元素汞构成，而刺耳的警报则不断尖叫，提醒空气中毒性之强足以致命。在这样的星球上，究竟会有什么——如果有的话——生命能够生存？
A fathomless quantity of glossy silver rolls in slow, heavy waves across the planet's surface. Scanners say the ocean is composed of elemental mercury, while an alarm blares warnings about the extreme toxicity of the air. What, if any, life could live on a planet like this?

Ranger Practicing In The Woods.name:
森林中练习的游侠
Ranger Practicing In The Woods

Text.text:
和风在林间轻叹，车轮碾过落叶，沙沙作响。游侠把椅子摆正，重新开始。借着椅背稳住身形，他在空地四周的靶子上连珠般放出一箭又一箭，每一支都伴随着令人畅快的闷响正中靶心。忽然，一箭偏离，擦着地面弹跳着钻进灌木丛。他低声咕哝着，拨开草丛挤过去，寻找那支失手的箭。
Gentle wind sighs through the trees as leaves crunch underwheel. The ranger squares up his chair and begins again. Utilizing his backrest for balance, he begins releasing arrow after arrow at targets around the clearing, each followed by a satisfying thud of impact. Suddenly, a shot goes wide and skips into the underbrush. He grumbles to himself as he pushes through the grass to locate his missed shot.

Selwyn Airendil.name:
塞尔温·艾伦迪尔
Selwyn Airendil

Text.text:
这个高大健美、线条如雕刻般分明的男人，杏仁形的祖母绿眼睛在深褐色皮肤上格外醒目。乌黑如鸦的头发编成一股辫子垂到背中，拢开他棱角分明的脸，露出一对修长而锐利的耳朵。他几乎通身黑衣：从长外套与宽松衬衫，到露指手套，再到翻折靴筒的骑士长靴；唯有贴身的钢制胸甲在这片黑色底色中冷冷凸显。姿态看似随意，神情同样疏离，可他那双指甲如爪的手始终不离腰间两把细柄短剑。

~ Played by Kyo

This tall, chiseled man’s almond-shaped, emerald-colored eyes are striking against his umber skin. A braid dangling to midback holds his raven hair out of his angular face and reveals long, sharp ears. He dresses mostly in black, from overcoat and loose shirt to fingerless gloves and cavalier boots with folded uppers. His fitted steel breastplate stands out against this backdrop. Casual in posture, he wears an equally aloof look, but he keeps his hands—with nails like claws—near the fine-hilted shortswords on his belt.

~ Played by Kyo

Castaway Pulled Aboard Ship.name:
遇难者被拖上船
Castaway Pulled Aboard Ship

Text.text:
男人被水手们结实的臂膀拖上甲板时，猛地呕出一口腥咸的海水，溅落在木板上；他皮肤龟裂焦灼，因长久暴露在风霜日晒下而破碎灼伤。瘦骨嶙峋的胸膛微弱起伏，他仰躺着大口喘息，然而在干裂的唇间，却反复漏出一段轻柔而婉转的低语，乍听仿佛只是海的胡言乱语。可当你走近，那旋律竟渐渐清晰，寒意顺着脊背攀爬——与其说来自上方抽打帆布的冷风，不如说来自那歌声本身。
The man regurgitates brine onto the deck of the ship as he is hauled up by the strong arms of the crew, his skin broken and burnt from overexposure to the elements. His emaciated chest rises weakly as he lies on his back gasping for air, though there is a soft yet melodious whisper repeated through cracked lips which seems like nothing but ramblings of the sea. Yet… as you draw near, the tune becomes clearer, sending chills down your spine that have nothing to do with the cold gust that whips at the sails up above.

Alchemical Vial Of True Fire.name:
真实之火炼金小瓶
Alchemical Vial Of True Fire

Text.text:
一只矮小的药瓶在肉眼可见的热浪中微微颤闪。瓶内炽亮的岩浆鼓起滚滚热泡，迸溅的火星在玻璃内壁上四处弹跳。细小的光点如篝火余烬般在容器底部聚拢旋舞。
A short vial shimmers with evident heat. Within, glowing magma bubbles in great welts of heat, sending showers of sparks ricocheting against the glass. Small motes of light, like campfire embers, coalesce around the base of the container.

这块墓碑似乎属于一个不愿有人来悼念的人。上面写着：不要在此寻我，因为我已离去，且将不再归来。 尽管如此，墓前仍种着一丛黄水仙——当然，也可能只是巧合。 This grave marker seems to be for someone who didn’t want mourners. It reads: Seek me not here, for I am gone, and I shall not return. Despite this, daffodils have been planted at the grave—although, it could be a coincidence.

The Chamber Of Glamours.name:
幻魅之厅
The Chamber Of Glamours

Text.text:
藏在一间壁橱里——教授会用一记 Message 法术宣告它的所在——这间密室的入口可能看起来像电话亭、棺椁、小型升降梯，或是一道通往深渊的涡旋。学生们依次踏入，随即在教授为当天课程所挑选的任何房间里现身。置身此室，几乎每一道声响都是伪造，每一幅影像都如蒸汽般飘散，每一缕气味都不可信。这间教室让许多学生不得不接受净化心智的魔法与谈话治疗。
Housed in a closet, the location of which is announced by the professor through a Message spell, the entry to this chamber can look like a phone booth, a casket, a dumbwaiter, or a vortex to the abyss. Students step in one at a time and emerge in whatever kind of room the professor deems appropriate for the day’s lesson. In this chamber, nearly every sound is false, every image a vapor, every scent untrustworthy. This classroom is responsible for many students needing mind-cleansing magic and talk therapy.

Solar Of A Manor.name:
庄园的日晷
Solar Of A Manor

Text.text:
这座宏阔宅邸里最奢华的陈设尽数汇聚于此——领主的起居密室。温暖的日光洒落，照亮墙上的画作与挂毯，色彩与纹理都显得格外鲜活。一张舒适的阅读椅背对窗户摆放，光线恰到好处，足以支撑慵懒午后翻阅那些香艳露骨的秘藏书卷。壁炉前，两把椅子之间放着一张打磨得锃亮的桌子，体型刚好能容下一盘点心与两只白兰地杯。
The richest appointments in this enormous house are to be found here, in the lord’s solar, its paintings and tapestries illuminated by warm sunlight. A comfortable reading chair sits with its back to the windows, providing ample lighting for leisurely afternoons spent perusing salacious tomes. A polished table sits between two more chairs, in front of the fireplace, just the right size for a platter of treats and a couple of brandy glasses.

Warlock's Hideous Laughter.name:
术士的骇人狂笑
Warlock's Hideous Laughter

Text.text:
若说笑声是良药，这道法术便像恶劣病笑般带着毒性。你先凝视自己的奥术法器，再看向对手，手指如锥般一指，嘴角带着讥诮将咒词啐出。你那宗主的阴影为你的声音染上一层刺人的尖涩。

[豁免失败] 你的目标嘴角勾起一丝笑意，眼中却满是困惑；他们随即爆发出剧烈的咯咯狂笑，继而像被抽空般瘫倒成一团，在令人发狂的笑声里抽搐不止。

[豁免成功] 对手脸上一闪而过的困惑像是被逗乐，但旋即他们对你阴冷的字句皱起脸，带着怒容回以冷哼。

[初次失败后豁免成功] 你的目标在重新稳住心神时短暂清明——那令人失能的笑瘫终于止息；他们从地上抬起头时，脸上掠过一阵明显的愧疚刺痛，随即化作愤怒与羞耻。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

If laughter is medicine, this spell has the poisoning effect of a sick joke. Gazing first at your arcane focus, then your opponent, you gesture pointedly and spit the words with a sneer. The dark influence of your patron lends your voice a prickly timbre.

[Failed Save] A smile plays at the corners of your target’s mouth, belied by confusion in their eyes as they begin to chortle violently, then collapse in a heap with maddening laughter.

[Successful Save] A bemused look flashes across your opponent’s face, but then they grimace at your dark words and retort with a scowl.

[Successful Save after Initial Failure] There’s a moment of clarity for your target when they regain their composure—the incapacitating fit ends with a visible pang of guilt as they look up from the ground, angry and ashamed.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Barbarian Quip About Foreign Creature.name:
野蛮人对异域生物的俏皮话
Barbarian Quip About Foreign Creature

Text.text:
“我听不懂它嘴里刚吐出来的那堆含混胡言，但我敢肯定——它该死。”
“I don’t understand the garbled nonsense that just came out of its mouth, but I’m pretty sure it needs to die.”

Loot From A Purple Worm.name:
紫虫的战利品
Loot From A Purple Worm

Text.text:
当你剖开那条巨虫的喉囊时，蒸汽嘶嘶冲入空气。浅绿黏液如河奔涌而出，夹杂着滚烫的酸液飞溅——那垂死消化道最后的英勇挣扎。然而在这腥腻的污秽之中，宝石与矿石闪烁微光——那是巨虫在矿藏丰饶的山岩中穿行掘进时留下的残迹。
Vapors hiss into the air as you cut open the gullet of the massive worm. Rivers of light green mucus flow out, along with scalding spritzes of acid—the last heroic efforts of a dying digestive tract. But within the visceral muck, gems and ore glimmer—remnants of the worm’s burrowing through richly endowed mountain rock.

Heavy Rain In The Desert With Purple Wor.name:
紫色巨虫肆虐的沙漠暴雨
Heavy Rain In The Desert With Purple Worm

Text.text:
暴雨倾泻在龟裂的大地上。赤褐色的细流蜿蜒成脉，将沙粒浸成淤泥，又裹挟着它们一路向下。新生的溪水沿着坡面与沙丘奔涌，越过脊梁，灌入沟壑。零散的水势汇聚成一条宽阔的河流穿过山谷，奔腾的轰鸣甚至压过雨声。大多数生物早已不见踪影，藏进地下洞穴与巢穴里，或躲在稀有的树木与粗壮的仙人掌之下。

然而，有一头怪物却沉醉于这清凉的雨幕与泥浆之中。一条紫虫从河里猛然冲出，掀起一柱泥泉。它发出近似鲸鸣的呼号——高亢的歌声被破败的喉咙硬挤出来。它弓起身躯，头朝下扎回水流里，溅起黏稠的泥水。大地震颤，水面发抖，它一路钻入地下深处。

The rains pour over the cracked earth. Ruddy rivulets form, transforming sand to silt and carrying it downward. Newborn streams course down slopes and dunes, over ridges, and into ravines. Disparate flows gather into a wide river running through a valley, its rushing sound overwhelming even the rain. Most creatures are out of sight, hidden away in underground burrows, caves, or the rare tree or robust cactus.

One monstrosity, however, revels in the refreshing rainfall and muck. A purple worm surges out of the river in a geyser of mud. It calls out with a sound akin to a whale, a high song pressed through a ragged throat. It arches and burrows headfirst into the stream with a gloppy splash. The earth shakes and water vibrates as it presses into the underground.

一根矮粗的烟囱从茅草屋顶探出头来，吐出一团团白色的烟雾。每扇窗户的窗格四周都绘着彩色花朵作点缀。整洁的门廊上，一双沾满泥点的园艺靴摆在门垫旁，门边还悬着一只陈旧的黄铜铃铛。花园明艳芬芳，宁静得像一座乐园，蝴蝶们轻快地从一朵花飘到另一朵花。
A squat chimney sticks out of the thatched roof, expelling white puffs of smoke. Each window is accentuated by painted flowers around the panes. On the tidy porch, a pair of well-muddied gardening boots sit beside the doormat, and an old, brass bell hangs by the door. The garden is bright and fragrant, offering a peaceful playground for the butterflies drifting happily from bloom to bloom.

Town Square Watched From The Shadows.name:
从阴影中窥视的镇广场
Town Square Watched From The Shadows

Text.text:
黑暗降临时，有人从小巷深处探出视线。一个笼罩在秘密中的阴影身影，悄然窥视着镇广场上一辆货车旁闲聊的两名男子。那身影静若轻烟，目光刺穿暮色，像夜里的幽灵（特征）般窃走秘密。
As darkness falls, someone peers from the depths of an alley. A shadowy figure, swathed in secrecy, spies upon two men chatting near a wagon in the town square. Silent as smoke, the figure’s eyes pierce the twilight, stealing secrets like a ghost in the night.

I Cast Illusory Script.name:
我施放《幻影文书》
I Cast Illusory Script

Text.text:
我手腕一扬，将隐秘的魔法悄然注入羽毛笔，让每一个字都染上防窥的守护。法术生效时，字母微光流转，璀璨的奥术能量如闪耀的浪潮般掠过纸面。
With a flourish, I imbue my quill with surreptitious magic, enchanting the words with protection against prying eyes. The letters shimmer as the spell takes effect, and scintillating arcane energy washes over the page in a glittering wave.

Cave Passage Down.name:
通往下方的洞穴通道
Cave Passage Down

Text.text:
洞窟沿着一串从天顶远古崩落、滚落堆叠的巨岩向下延伸，仿佛巨人的阶梯——如果巨人能在这低矮的顶下挤得进去的话。最易通行的几块石头棱角已被攀行者的反复踩踏磨得圆滑。
The cavern descends down a series of boulders tumbled from the ceiling in some ancient rockfall, like stairs for a giant—if a giant could fit under the low ceiling. The stones that present the easiest path have their corners worn smooth by the passage of climbers.

尖峭的山峰在你四周高耸逼近，但你的道路却引向一处山谷——一座巨大的鞍部，将群山的脊背生生折断。谷地沿着弧形向下蜿蜒，从你身边绕开而去；一条自山坡淌下的溪流仿佛也一时难以抉择该往哪边流，踌躇片刻后，终究还是奔涌着冲向你这侧的山口。
The sharp peaks loom high around you, but your path takes you toward a valley—an enormous saddle that breaks the back of the mountains. The vale curves around and down, away from you, so that a stream running off the mountainside seems to have some difficulty deciding which direction to flow before ultimately rushing down your side of the pass.

Belt Of Storm Giant Strength.name:
风暴巨人力量腰带
Belt Of Storm Giant Strength

Text.text:
黑色皮革与抛光的精金构成了这条腰带与斜挂肩带，散发着臭氧与海潮的气息。两条带子都配着华丽而棱角分明的扣饰。斜挂肩带的扣环是一张风格化的女子面容，以闪电为发；腰带上的扣具则刻着一名男子，发与须皆为雷霆。透明宝石镶作两张脸的眼睛。
Black leather and polished adamantine make up this belt and baldric, which smells of ozone and the sea. Both straps have ornate, angular clasps. The baldric buckle is the stylized face of a woman with lightning for hair. On the waist strap, the fastener depicts a man with lightning as his hair and beard. Clear jewels serve as each face’s eyes.

Long-range Exploratory Vessel: Entertain.name:
远程探勘舰：娱乐甲板
Long-range Exploratory Vessel: Entertainment Deck

Text.text:
在深空飞船的两次跃迁之间几乎无事可做，而娱乐甲板正是为缓解这种空档而设。最先进的游戏座舱此起彼伏地哔哔作响、叮叮鸣响，船员们在像素化的AR舱中争夺最高分；机舱酒吧的点唱机把柔和的乡村乐声送遍整层甲板——不久之后，又接上了让人捏把汗的卡拉OK。
There isn’t much to do between jumps on a deep space vessel, and the entertainment deck is designed to mitigate this. State-of-the-art gaming rigs whoop and ping as crew members compete for high scores among the pixelated AR pods, and the dulcet tones of country music drift through the deck from a jukebox in the onboard bar—followed soon after by questionable karaoke.

Rope Bridge Over A Gorge.name:
峡谷之上的绳桥
Rope Bridge Over A Gorge

Text.text:
一座纤细的吊桥横跨在张口欲噬的深渊之上，连接着两侧峭壁，连向来不惧高处的人也不由得驻足。狭窄的木板首尾相接铺成桥面，用短绳系在两条粗壮结实的麻绳上——麻绳在下方分开成V字——以便维持平衡。然而在这般高空，狂风让绳桥来回摇摆，时而猛然一甩。即便有人猜测当地人常走此桥，也难以压下那股悄然爬上心头的眩晕感——你纵使竭力不去看，视线仍不由自主地坠向脚下。
A thin suspension bridge over a yawning chasm connects the two cliffs, and even those who are not disposed to fear heights are given pause. Narrow planks have been placed end-to-end, attached by short lines to a pair of thick, sturdy hemp ropes—creating a V-shape—to aid in balance. Yet the wind at this high altitude keeps the rope bridge swinging to-and-fro, sometimes violently. Speculation about locals crossing the bridge regularly does little to assuage the creeping feeling of vertigo as you gaze downward despite your best efforts.

手背苍白的皮肉上，青筋纵横蜿蜒，宛如臃肿的蛇贪婪地吞噬着体内那蜡黄的血液。弯曲发黄的指甲上栖着焦黑的灯芯，跃动的火舌在其上起舞——然而皮肤却毫发无损。
Veins streak through the pallid flesh of the hand, like bloated snakes gorging themselves on the sallow blood within. Crooked, yellow nails play host to blackened wicks alight with dancing flame—yet the skin does not burn.

从荒野深处冲出来，一个男人毫不犹豫地撞开带刺的灌木与缠人的常春藤，脸色被彻底的恐惧漂得惨白。就在他踉跄之际，你猛然感到一阵刺骨寒意——阳光被一道巨大的阴影抹去：那是个粗略呈人形的庞然黑影，头颅却像羚羊或其他有角生物。它抬起一根手指，嘶嘶低语一句话音未落，半透明的紫色触须便从生物身上弧形迸射而出，狠狠砸进男人的背脊，让他一声不吭地脸朝下摔倒在地。那巨大的乌黑身影只用几秒便注意到你。紧接着，死去的男人开始撑起身体，呻吟着把自己推到脚下——与此同时，它张开双臂，猛扑向你……

~ 构想：Krevlick

Emerging from the wilderness, a man crashes through thorny bushes and clinging ivy without hesitation, a look of utter terror blanching his face. As he stumbles, you feel a sudden chill when the sun is blotted out by a gigantic shadowy figure, roughly in the shape of a man but with a head resembling an antelope or other horned creature. It raises a single finger and whispers a sibilant phrase just before translucent purple tendrils arc out from the creature and slam into the man’s back, causing him to fall flat on his face, without a cry. It takes only seconds for the enormous ebon figure to notice you. And then the dead man begins pushing himself to his feet, groaning as it lunges toward you with arms outstretched…

~ Envisioned by Krevlick

Untamed Cyberspace.name:
狂野赛博空间
Untamed Cyberspace

Text.text:
在这片狂野的赛博空间深处，现实忽明忽暗，仿佛连自身都拿不准。这里不过是一团翻涌的代码洪流，持续构筑又自我崩塌，如同失控的数据漩涡般狂烈抽搐；而它将以你从未想象过的方式考验你。

~ 由 Discord 上的 Murmur Envisioned

Reality flickers here in the wild reaches of cyberspace, unsure of itself. Little more than a roiling mass of code, constantly building and collapsing in on itself like a thrashing whirlpool of data, this place tests you in ways you could never imagine.

~ Envisioned by Murmur on Discord

Barehanded Vs Glaive.name:
徒手对战偃月刀
Barehanded Vs Glaive

Text.text:
那名拳斗士看起来处于极大的劣势。对方手中长柄刀那又长又沉的刀刃摆出一种姿势，严密得如同上锁的门扉，几乎无从突破。持刀者反手自下而上挥动长柄武器，钩刃下方系着的缎带在空中翻飞。紧接着一记横扫，又是一记踏步突刺。空手的斗士却把每一次斩击都躲得干干净净，劣势悄然易手。握长柄刀的人动作慢了下来，汗水淋漓，呼吸也越来越急促。
The pugilist looks to be at a major disadvantage. The long and heavy blade of the glaive wielded against them rests in a stance as impenetrable as a locked door. Its wielder swings the long weapon underhanded, a ribbon tied just below the hook fluttering in the air. Then they swing to the side, and then again with a lunge. The open-handed fighter dodges every strike, and the disadvantage shifts. The fighter with the glaive slows, sweating, and breathes harder and harder.

Hiring By A Noble.name:
贵族招募
Hiring By A Noble

Text.text:
“我平时绝不会屈尊去雇佣佣兵——更别说你们这种人——可我的卫兵也就只会应付酒馆里偶尔的斗殴。这桩麻烦需要几分接触般的微妙与手腕。若我先前的态度冒犯了你，我向你保证，你的报酬将足以弥补一切。”
“I wouldn’t normally stoop to hiring mercenaries, especially not your kind, but my guardspeople are only good for breaking up the occasional barroom brawl. This problem requires a touch of subtlety. If my demeanor has offended, I assure you, your compensation will more than make up for it.”

Loot From A Pursuant Minion Roller.name:
追随爪牙战利品掷表
Loot From A Pursuant Minion Roller

Text.text:
他颈间的奖章仍在以魔法的脉动轻轻震颤。你还在他裤子的一处工具口袋里摸到一个皮革小袋。袋中塞满了被打磨成小弹珠般圆润的珍贵宝石。他似乎一直在为自己囤积这批收藏——这些石头美得让人舍不得把它们当作投射物甩出去。
The medallion on his neck still thrums with magic. You also find a leather pouch in one of his trouser utility pockets. The satchel is full of precious gems smoothed into small marbles. He seems to have been stockpiling a collection for himself—stones too pretty to turn into projectiles.

Orbital Impact Crater In City.name:
城市中的轨道冲击陨坑
Orbital Impact Crater In City

Text.text:
尽管事故发生才不久，这片地点又迅速被城市生活重新吞没。撞击落在一处繁忙的十字路口——震碎了周边建筑——但如今精明的市民开始向观光客兜售陨坑导览。城市规划者已与附近一家企业签约，用浮华的全息脚手架把这处碍眼之物掩蔽起来；摊贩挤满区域，兜售溢价T恤和俗气的棒球帽。
Although the accident happened recently, the site has been quickly eaten up by city life once more. The impact hit a busy intersection—shattering nearby structures—but now entrepreneurial citizens offer tours of the crater to sightseers. City planners have contracted a nearby corp to cover the eyesore in glitzy holographic scaffolding, and vendors litter the area, hawking overpriced t-shirts and tacky baseball caps.

漫长的纪元磨蚀了雕像更精细的五官与繁复的纹饰，只剩下那高耸身影的模糊轮廓。它背脊笔直地伫立着，双手休息在一柄阔刃的剑柄首上。你在石质的脸庞上搜寻表情，却只看到空洞的眼眶，永远向外凝望着远方的地平线。
Eons have worn away the statue’s finer features and intricate details, leaving only a vague semblance of the towering figure. They stand, straight-backed, hands resting atop the pommel of a broad blade. You search the stone face for expression, but find only hollow eyes staring ever outward at the distant horizon.

宛如一名扭曲的天使，这个生物以天界般的优雅在黑暗而荒凉的虚空间穿梭。它长达八英尺，皮肤呈橡胶般的淡黄色，拖着一条修长的爬行动物尾巴；当它舒展开那惊人的翼展时，宽度几乎是身高的两倍。四条手臂的末端皆是凌厉的利爪，但最令人不安的却是它的头颅——如鳗鱼般的深渊口器，寒光闪烁的獠牙层层交错，饥渴地啜吸着空气。
Like a twisted angel, this creature arcs with a celestial grace through the black bleakness of the spaces between. Eight feet long, with rubbery, yellowish skin and a long reptilian tail, they stretch their impressive wingspan to double their height. Four arms end in rakish claws, but it is the head that most unsettles: an eel-like cavern of glinting fangs, sucking at the air with hunger.

它那硬化的甲壳宛如熔炉窑壁，这头赤红皮肤的巨兽撕开熔岩洪流，六只长着利爪的鳍足拖拽着身躯，以骇人的速度疾驰而过。一个球形巨口如噩梦般自熔岩表面猛然破出，喷射出一蓬熔融玻璃直冲天际。巨口周围，晶尖触须旋舞翻腾，继而收束成致命的箭矢之形。生物身后拖出螺旋般的尾迹，折射的色彩在其中摆荡回旋，令人目眩神迷。
Its hardened carapace resembling a furnace kiln, this huge beast with crimson skin tears through a lava flow, six clawed flippers dragging it along at immense speeds. A spherical mouth akin to a nightmare bursts from the surface, sending a spray of molten glass skyward. Around the mouth, crystal tipped tentacles swirl then tighten into a deadly arrow-shape. A spiral trail behind the creature oscillates in a mesmeric twist of refracted color.

Icy Wasteland: Trekking Over Ice And Sno.name:
冰寒荒原：踏越冰雪的跋涉
Icy Wasteland: Trekking Over Ice And Snow

Text.text:
你们一行人在被狂风肆虐的苍白荒原上并肩跋涉，谁也不说话，因为你们得把每一口气都省下来，才撑得住继续前行。阵阵疾风与冷冽的微风把积雪吹成高高的雪丘，又在其间刮出一片片冰冷平坦的空地，可无论哪一种都同样难走。你们竭力寻找稳妥的落脚点，这份艰难反倒成了可喜的分心，让人暂时忘却无休无止的严寒与呼啸不止的狂风。
Your party trudges together across the wind-blasted landscape of white, not speaking because you need to preserve your breath just to keep moving. The gusts and breezes have blown the snow into high dunes and created clearings of icy flats, but neither proves easy to walk across. The struggle to find the right footing provides a welcome distraction from the relentless cold and howling wind.

I Smash Through A Door.name:
我破门而入
I Smash Through A Door

Text.text:
当钥匙怎么也找不着、法术也死活不灵的时候，我这只粗硬的拳头总是迫不及待地愿意代劳。我朝门板狠狠干了几拳，又猛踹了几脚，动静震耳，却确实管用。深深的凹痕一寸寸记录着我的进展；尽管亲手砸东西的快感令人沉醉，我还是抄起我的武器来收尾。我把门打成一条满是碎刺的门槛。随后我对着武器的刃口吹掉木屑，把更大的木片一脚踢开。
When keys cannot be found and spells refuse to work, there’s always the rough side of my fist eager to do the job. I pound and kick against the door a few times, my efforts loud but effective. Deep-set dents mark my progress and, as good as it feels to smash things with my own hands, I take up my weapon to finish the job. I render the door a threshold of splinters. I blow the sawdust off the edge of my weapon and kick the larger shards of the wood out of the way.

I Cast Arcane Lock.name:
我施放【秘法锁】
I Cast Arcane Lock

Text.text:
我选中的这把锁重要到值得我往里撒下昂贵的金粉。我又沿着锁边再添了一点，低声呢喃着关于封闭、束缚与抗力的奥秘咒词。待金粉消失无踪，化作锁缚魔法的养料，我在心中默念那句口令——一把以言语铸成的钥匙，将回绝拧作邀约。
The lock I’ve chosen is important enough for the expensive gold dust I sprinkle into it. I add a bit more along the edge as I whisper the arcane words of closing, binding, and resistance. When the dust has vanished to feed the magic of locking, I pronounce the password in my mind, a spoken key that turns turn refusal into invitation.

由魔法石与妖精的怒火锻造而成，一具魔像迈步闯入视野，追猎的意志写满它那一张张面孔。那些面孔——尽数嵌在一颗多棱的中央巨首之上——牵扯着下方敦实的躯体向四面八方扭转，迸出孩童般的尖叫，既像战吼，又像忧惧，还夹着被遗忘的恐怖。
Wrought of magic stone and fey wrath, a golem strides into view with pursuit written across its many faces. The faces—all attached to a central multifaceted head—twist the stocky body below in every direction, yelling out childlike screams of war and worry and forgotten fear.

从合拢的帐篷门襟上那褪色的字迹，以及它在营地中的位置来看，这似乎是首领的帐篷。旁边的木箱做工更为结实，箍带加固、厚实沉稳，或许是用高台地上那几棵罕见的干松木之一削制而成。在火坑的柴木间，散落着几件被灰烬与沙砾遮掩的物件。
By the faded lettering on the closed flaps, and its position in the camp, this seems to be the tent of a leader. The crate next to it is of stronger make, banded and solid, possibly cut from one of the few dry pines up on the mesa. Among the logs of its firepit are strewn a few objects obscured by ash and sand.

Gunshot Deals Fatal Wound.name:
枪声带来致命伤
Gunshot Deals Fatal Wound

Text.text:
子弹命中瞬间，鲜血以令人作呕的猩红喷泉爆涌而出，将血肉与骨骼碾成湿纸般的碎屑。伤势致命——这一点显而易见——但受害者也许还要几分钟才会彻底失血而亡。
Blood erupts in a sickening crimson gout as the bullet connects, pulverizing tissue and bone like wet paper. The wound is fatal—that much is obvious—but it could be minutes before the victim bleeds out fully.

附近的通讯系统里，一团战栗的电流纠结奔窜。伴随着一道耀眼的湛蓝弧光，代码猛然跃出，凝成一具人形——笑容咧得过宽，额上生着粗壮盘卷的长角。祂的躯体仿佛由层层交叠、精密织就的代码线条构成：纷乱却分明，锋锐如新却又古老得令人心悸。
A shuddering tangle of electricity runs through the nearby comm system. In an arc of bright blue light, code leaps out, taking the form of a humanoid with a too-wide smile and broad, curling horns. Their very body seems comprised of intricately layered lines of code, confusing yet clear, cutting edge yet ancient.

Barbarian’s Intimidation Before A Duel.name:
决斗前野蛮人的威吓
Barbarian’s Intimidation Before A Duel

Text.text:
“你要真想这么干，我们奉陪。我们可以一直打到太阳落山。你甚至可能赢。但我向你保证：这场战斗你会记一辈子——不是在噩梦里，而是在我从你身上剜下来的每一块缺失里。”
“If you really want to do this we can. We can fight until the sun goes down. You might even win. But I promise you this: you will remember this fight, not in your nightmares, but in each missing piece I carve off you.”

Celebration Of The Autumnal Equinox.name:
秋分庆典
Celebration Of The Autumnal Equinox

Text.text:
披着一袭赤褐落叶织成的斗篷，黑暗女王引领舞步。她在古老的巨石间穿梭，每块石顶都跃动着摇曳的火光。盛满丰收馈赠的托盘被置于祭坛之上——大地献上的庆典礼物。起舞的人潮欢歌不止，唱着季节流转，唱着生与死。
Wreathed in a cloak of russet leaves, the queen of darkness leads the dance. She weaves around the ancient stones, each topped with a flickering flame. Trays of harvest bounty are placed on the altar—celebratory gifts of the earth. The dancing throng sings gleefully, of seasons turning, of life and death.

Steampunk Submarine.name:
蒸汽朋克潜艇
Steampunk Submarine

Text.text:
这艘载具显然沉重，动力需求也相当苛刻。船体由铁铸成，铆钉以间距完美的竖向带状排列，沿着接缝一圈圈缠绕。它的艏部如同战列舰——突兀、锋利，饰以锯齿般的尖牙，还有一处鼓胀的舷窗，像怪物的眼睛。错落分布的螺旋桨点缀在它的底部；更小的舷窗带着螺栓加固的框架，沿着它那修长鱼雷般的船形在左舷与右舷一字排开；而宛如飞鱼的鳍翼从两侧伸展出去，足有数英尺之长。
This vessel is obviously heavy and its power requirements demanding. The hull is iron, with rivets in vertical belts of perfect spacing wrapped around its seams. Its prow is like a ship of the line—prominent, sharp, and decorated with serrated teeth and a bulbous portal like a monster’s eye. Propellors in staggered positions dot its underside, smaller portals with bolted frames run along the port and starboard of its long torpedo shape, and fins like a flying fish stretch several feet out from its sides.

巨大的齿轮如城池般悬挂在空间中，各自绕着自己的轴缓缓转动，驱动着某台看不见的机器。空气里弥漫着铜与青铜的气味，充斥着上好润滑的机械无休止的咔哒作响与嗡嗡旋转声。
The massive, city-sized gears hang in space, each turning on its own axis, powering some unseen machine. The air smells of copper and bronze, and is filled with the incessant clicking and whirring of well-oiled machinery.

Taunt From A Damaged Character.name:
来自受损角色的嘲讽
Taunt From A Damaged Character

Text.text:
“你所有的狂怒与恶毒都撼动不了我。我的心智才是更狡诈、更残酷的对手，而我每天都在征服它。”
“All your fury and malice will not rattle me. My mind is a far more cunning and brutal adversary, and I conquer it every day.”

陡峭的之字形山径在逼近一座宽阔、顶面平坦的尖峰时渐渐趋于平缓。山谷里的风吹上来——清冽、温暖而新鲜——穿过岩石呼啸作响，又在环绕这片更为平顺的区域、锯齿般的岩脊与突岩间的凹陷处低低呜咽。四周的岩突没有一处高过中央那片短草、苔藓与地衣铺就的草甸。矮粗的木质灌木紧紧攀附在巨石与石缝之间，为其间的开花药草遮风避护。
The steep switchback trail levels out as it approaches a wide, flat-topped pinnacle. Wind blows from the valley—crisp, warm, and fresh—whistling through the rocks and moaning in the hollows among the jagged outcroppings that encircle this smoother area. None of the surrounding projections rise higher than the central meadow of short grass, moss, and lichen. Stubby, woody shrubs cling to boulders and the spaces between them, sheltering flowering herbs.

这怪物体型如狮，却更为短悍结实，形貌仿佛无角犀牛与甲虫的混种。厚重的灰色甲板掩蔽着它坚韧如革的躯体皮肤，并一路延伸包覆那六条强健有力的腿。它铲形的头颅猛然裂开，露出一张满是利齿的血盆大口。
The size of a lion but more powerfully compact, the monster looks like a cross between a hornless rhinoceros and a beetle. Thick gray plates cover the tough leathery skin of its body and extend down all six powerful legs. Its spade-shaped head splits open to reveal a toothy maw.

Father With Sick Child.name:
带着病儿的父亲
Father With Sick Child

Text.text:
拉起的窗帘漏进半明半暗的光里，一位慈爱的父亲正小心翼翼地整理那床隆起的羊毛毯。他一会儿轻拍，一会儿轻揉，又用手背贴上蜷在毯中的小孩额头试温。紧蹙的眉与抿起的唇把他的心思泄露无遗：怜惜、忧惧，以及一种无能为力的明悟——无论他做什么，都只能带来些许安慰，不能带来痊愈。他做好了守上一整夜的准备。桌上的茶，等他起身离开时，早已凉透。
In the half-light of drawn curtains, a loving father fusses with a mounded woolen blanket. He alternately pats, then rubs, then lays the back of his hand on the forehead of the small child nestled within. Eyebrows knit-together and lips pursed with concern betray Dad’s thoughts: sympathy, worry, and a sense that whatever he does can only bring comfort, not a cure. He prepares himself for a long watch. The tea atop the table will be cold ere he leaves.

高大宽肩的苍白女子以冰蓝色的眼睛怒视前方，双腿分开站成防御姿态——锯齿刃的长柄长矛随时待发。她身穿光滑的棕色皮革束腰短袍，内衬灰色皮毛；下着海豹皮长裤，外罩一层油亮的黑色裙摆。她的头发同样深暗，编成多股发辫，缀着雕刻象牙与银饰的小坠物。她一侧肩头以一只暗毛灰熊的头颅作肩甲，其余兽皮披在身上，厚重如斗篷。她的颈间挂着一串项链：十枚巨大的深色利爪与四枚獠牙。靛蓝色的旋纹纹身覆盖她裸露的手臂与双手，直至指尖，描绘着部族符号、战士与一头巨熊；同样的墨色也染上她紧抿的嘴唇。

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Tall and broad shouldered, this pale woman glares with ice-blue eyes and stands in a wide-legged, defensive stance—serrated, long-hafted spear held at the ready. She wears a tunic of smooth brown leather lined with gray fur and sealskin pants with an over-skirt of glossy black. Her hair is the same color and plaited into braids adorned with baubles of carved ivory and silver. On one shoulder, the head of a dusky-haired grizzly serves as a pauldron, the rest of the beast’s pelt providing an ample cloak. She wears a necklace of ten enormous dark claws and four fangs. Swirling tattoos in indigo cover her bare arms and hands to the fingertips, depicting tribal symbols, warriors, and a great bear. Similar ink shades her scowling lips.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

矮人的锁子甲在他们备战时哗啦作响，戴着铁手套的双手将巨大的战锤沉沉抡起。颈下垂着一枚银质徽记，其上刻着铁匠之锤，正散发出异世般的幽辉。牧师紧握武器，口中吐出敬畏的祷词，白光随之渐渐增长……
The dwarf’s chain mail clatters as they ready themselves, massive warhammer hefted in their gauntleted hands. A silver sigil hangs below their neck, depicting a smith’s hammer, and glows with an otherworldly gleam. Words of reverence release from the cleric’s mouth as they grip their weapon, and a white light grows . . .

Terror In The Night.name:
夜色惊惧
Terror In The Night

Text.text:
薄雾遮蔽了无月的夜，带着不祥的压迫感，连话语都被扼住。翻涌的云雾之间，一点摇曳的火光攫住你的目光；随着雷声碾过迷雾，那诱人的光芒仿佛在逼近。雷鸣渐渐分辨为铁蹄捶地的轰响，像在宣告雾气正蜕变成呛人的霾。一道黑影显形，吞吸着黑暗，而马鬃在橙色与刺目的猩红之间跳动闪烁。

~ 达尔 阿维尔纳

Mist veils the moonless night, choking words with foreboding. Amid the swirling cloudscape a flickering flame draws your gaze, its alluring light drawing closer as a thunder rolls over the fog. The thunder resolves into the pounding of hooves on earth, which hails the mist changing to smog. A black figure reveals itself, sucking in the dark, while the horse’s mane flickers from orange to a lurid crimson light.

~ Daer Averna

Finger Weapon Implant.name:
指间武器植入体
Finger Weapon Implant

Text.text:
几乎不可能被侦测到，嵌入手指的分子瓦解器却并非毫无风险。长时间使用会对植入体与使用者的手造成显著负荷，而且这件武器要运作，必须持续供给高密度能量粒子。正因如此，此类武器属非法并受严格管制，未经授权使用将面临严厉惩罚。
Almost impossible to detect, the finger-embedded molecular disruptor is not without risk. Extended use causes significant strain on the implant and the user's hand, and the weapon requires a constant supply of dense-energy particles to function. Because of this, such weapons are illegal and strictly regulated, with severe penalties for unauthorized use.

Stone Coffin With A Sculpted Likeness.name:
刻有雕像般肖像的石棺
Stone Coffin With A Sculpted Likeness

Text.text:
这口棺椁在葬礼大厅里显得最为华丽。棺盖上雕着里面那人的全身肖像，只是五官早已被岁月磨蚀殆尽。可棺旁却不见任何祭品，蛛网如帷幕般将整座壁龛彻底遮蔽。
This coffin stands out as the most elaborate in the burial hall. An entire likeness of the individual inside has been sculpted on the lid, their features long since worn away. And yet there are no offerings near the coffin and cobwebs curtain the entire alcove.

Overheard Legend Of Seven Swords Of Powe.name:
偶闻：《七柄力量之剑》的传说
Overheard Legend Of Seven Swords Of Power

Text.text:
“当七柄权能之刃共栖于同一片苍穹之下，通往异域的门扉将开启，把万方尽数连于一处。大灾厄正等待着我们。均衡将被打破……唯有七者，方能令其重归。”
“When the seven blades of power live under the same sky, the doors to other lands will open and connect them all to one. The Great Calamity awaits us. The balance will be lost… only to be restored by the seven.”

与它那些更小的近亲不同，头顶盘旋的巨型秃鹫并不等待猎物自行死去。一种恶毒的智慧驱使它专挑虚弱者下手发动攻击；它既贪恋猎物的痛苦与鲜血，也同样嗜食那筋多肉少的残肉。
Unlike its smaller cousins, the giant vulture wheeling overhead does not wait for prey to find death on its own. A malicious intelligence leads it to attack those who are weak, as it enjoys the suffering and blood of its prey as much as its stringy meat.

I Map The Area.name:
我绘制区域地图
I Map The Area

Text.text:
我坐在高处，视野还算开阔，便以炭笔落纸，力求每一笔都清晰笔直。凭着这处制高点与记忆，我尽可能把周围区域绘成一张地图。行进的痕迹被记录下来，我对自己点了点头。“好了，我们可以走了。”我从高位朝我的伙伴喊道。我一跃而下，朝他们走去，目光仍牢牢黏在那张粗糙的草图上。“路上我会继续补上。”
Seated up high with a decent view, I put charcoal to paper and try to keep each line clear and straight. Working from my vantage point and from memory, I map the surrounding area as best as I can. Our progress recorded, I nod to myself. “All right, we can leave,” I call to my companions from my elevated seat. I hop down and walk toward them, eyes still glued to my rough sketch. “I’ll add to it as we go.”

I Hear The Voice Of My Fiendish Ancestor.name:
我听见了恶魔血脉先祖的低语
I Hear The Voice Of My Fiendish Ancestor

Text.text:
“我的族裔竟堕落至此。将自己的时代浪费在追逐低等生物的目标上。你就如此轻贱自己吗？回到我身边来，我会让你见识潜藏于你形体之中的真正力量。”
“How far my kin has fallen. Wasting its time pursuing the goals of lesser creatures. Do you think so little of yourself? Return to me and I can show you the true power that resides in your form.”

闪电撕裂天穹，在你的视网膜上烙下道道残痕，仿佛这暴烈的风景被画在一座龟裂的瓷穹之上，每一片碎瓷都蓄势待裂。有些参差的线条从眼前褪去，另一些却依旧盘踞——那是前方巨岳的轮廓。随即一阵震颤袭来，仿佛峭壁正在崩塌，你向前挪步，想看清那本该出现的落石与滑坡，却什么也没有发生。取而代之的是，一颗庞大的蛇形头颅从最高的峰顶缓缓分离，你这才惊觉：群峰之最根本不是山。
Lightning tears across the sky, leaving streaks across your retinas as if the tempestuous scenery were painted on a dome of cracked porcelain, each piece poised to sunder. While some jagged lines fade from view, others remain—those of the gigantic mountains ahead of you. Then there’s a shudder, as if the very cliffs are collapsing, and you edge forward to catch sight of a rockslide that does not materialize. Instead, an enormous serpentine head separates from the tallest peak as you realize the greatest of these mountains is no mountain at all.

I Use Astral Perception To Detect Advanc.name:
我运用星界察觉来侦测尖端科技
I Use Astral Perception To Detect Advanced Technology

Text.text:
我额头正中的位置在一团朦胧翻涌的星界能量泡沫里颤动。世界被扯开一道帷幕，帷幕后的人影随即凝聚成高度先进的分析模型。各式各样的植入体纷纷交出它们珍藏的数据：品牌、型号、定制细节、植入日期。内分泌系统的沿革。血液中的激素水平。魔法潜能、魔法使用、魔法偏好。无一遗漏，连最琐碎的细枝末节也不放过。他们一天中什么时候刷牙？全都在那里，任我拣取。

~ 一位英雄 所构想

The center of my forehead shudders in a nebulous froth of astral energy. A veil is ripped from the world, and the figures within coalesce into highly advanced analytical models. All manner of implants give up their precious data: make, model, tailoring, insertion date. The history of their endocrine system. Levels of hormones in the blood. Magic potential, magic use, magic preference. Nothing is left out, even the most sundry details. What time of day did they brush their teeth? It is all there for my picking.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Woman With A Painted Eye.name:
画眼女
Woman With A Painted Eye

Text.text:
光滑愈合的肌肤取代了一只眼睛，在她的脸上铺成一块天然画布——一场她热烈拥抱的艺术表达。沿着她优雅面容的自然轮廓，皮肤上的旋涡纹样描绘出一只繁复而风格化的眼睛：无数细点精密排列，汇聚成令人目眩的棱彩色涡流。

~ 构想：Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The smooth, healed flesh replacing one eye forms a natural canvas on the woman’s face, an opportunity for artistic expression she has embraced with gusto. Following the natural contours of her elegant visage, the swirling design on the skin depicts an intricate, stylized eye comprised of innumerable dots arranged in a mind-bending prismatic vortex of color.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Dwarven Griffon Rider.name:
矮人狮鹫骑手
Dwarven Griffon Rider

Text.text:
肌肉虬结，狮鹫骑手死死攀住坐骑，撞破战场上空的云海，如雷霆坠落般直扑敌阵。沉重的战锤高高举起，二者并肩冲锋，骑手的战吼与那威武坐骑的禽鸣交织成一声，意志同向。就在这一刻，他们合而为一，彼此以本能般的先觉默契相合，无需言语便已心意相通。
Muscles bulging, the griffon rider clings to their mount as they crash through the clouds above the battle, hurtling toward their foes like a thunderbolt. With a weighty hammer raised high, the pair charges, the rider’s battle cry twinned with the avian scream of their mighty steed, united in their purpose. In this moment they act as one, each in tune with the other on an instinctive, prescient level.

Haeshi-shaa (Haeshi Form).name:
海希-沙阿（海希式）
Haeshi-shaa (Haeshi Form)

Text.text: 一团翻涌、黏稠的液体搅动着聚拢，凝成某种近似生命的形态。那液体托起一张面孔，在它不稳定的躯壳褶皱间一闪而过，阴沉而短暂。那绝非一张愉快的脸。刺鼻的恶臭自这生物身上涌出；随一阵凶风而来，你听见异族语言里遥远诅咒的连祷——半是低语，半是尖啸，宛如某个遥远世界的临终哀鸣。你不确定那声音是在你脑中……还是在这生物之内。 A churning, chunky fluid coalesces into something resembling life. The liquid holds a face, brief and dark in the rippling folds of its unstable being. It is not a happy face. A wave of noxious stench emanates from the creature, and upon a fell wind, you hear a litany of distant curses in an alien tongue: half whispered, half screamed, like the dying of a distant world. You are not sure if the voice is inside your head… or if the creature is.

Time Traveler Presents Pizza To A Crowd.name:
时代旅人将披萨呈献给人群
Time Traveler Presents Pizza To A Crowd

Text.text:
起泡的芝士与松软的饼皮在菜肴被潇洒揭开的一瞬间攫住了众人的目光。披萨在傍晚温和的气候里轻轻冒着热气，人群开始不安地低声窃语。那名旅人衣着、习俗都如此反常，献上的食物更是怪异——想来必是来自真正遥远的异乡。

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

Bubbling cheese and doughy crust draw the crowd's attention when the dish is unveiled with a flourish. The pizza steams gently in the temperate clime of the evening and people begin to murmur nervously. The traveler must be from a truly distant land, given their unusual garb, customs, and strange offering.

~ Envisioned by MaesterAelix on Discord

Fake Oil Of Sharpness.name:
锋锐油（赝品）
Fake Oil Of Sharpness

Text.text:
你在武器的刃口上豪气地涂上厚厚一层胶状油脂，笃信经过这番处理，你的攻击将咬得更狠、更深。可当油脂无论你怎么用力揉搓，都只是在金属上留下一层橡胶般的黏腻软膜时，你的自信开始动摇。这所谓的“磨刃油”反倒让你的武器比之前更钝。
You apply a generous coating of the gelatinous oil to the edge of your weapon, confident that with this treatment, your attacks will bite more fiercely. Your confidence wavers as the oil leaves a rubbery layer of goop on the metal, no matter how hard you try to work it in. This so-called sharpening oil has left your weapon blunter than before.

Psychic Vampire.name:
通灵吸血鬼（特征）
Psychic Vampire

Text.text:
一个轻盈的披斗篷身影靠近，开口呼唤你——直呼其名。对方苍白的皮肤上爬满细细的黑色血管网，尤其盘踞在眼周；这陌生人举手投足间都像在承受剧痛。修长纤细的指甲深深掐进紧握的拳心，你看见一缕缕暗色血液沿着指缝滴落。他们咬紧牙关说话，头却频频偏转——仿佛在倾听什么。那张带着贵气的面容憔悴干枯，皮肤紧绷得像被拉扯着贴在颅骨上；而那双锐利的眼睛燃着一星才智的灼光——以及疯狂。

~ Envisioned by Charlie71

A lithe, cloaked figure approaches, calling out to you—by name. Their pale skin is covered in webs of thin black veins, particularly around their eyes, and the stranger carries themselves as if in significant pain. Long, slender nails dig into the palm of their clenched fist, and you notice thin rivulets of dark blood dripping down their fingers. They speak through gritted teeth and turn their head often—as if listening. Their noble features appear drawn and withered as if their skin is pulled taut to their skull, and their piercing eyes blaze with the spark of brilliance—and madness.

~ Envisioned by Charlie71

Horatio Huggerson.name:
霍拉修·哈格森
Horatio Huggerson

Text.text:
尽管他那双巨大的扁平大脚板体型惊人，这名赤足的河马人盗贼仍能悄无声息地走来……直到他张开臂膀，迎面给你一个拥抱。点燃的雪茄夹在他宽阔的笑容间，暖意爬上脸庞；深蓝的眼睛闪着暴躁却快意的机敏光芒。缕缕烟雾从他那件永远阴燃的皮护甲间盘旋逸出，腰侧精致细剑的剑柄上嵌着一枚红宝石，红得浓烈而鲜活。一把小手枪贴身藏在袖中——以防突如其来的背叛。随着他松开紧箍般的拥抱，旋涡般的魔法在他短粗圆胖的手指间跳跃，他又以令人咋舌的灵巧，将一枚幽灵般的硬币在指节上滚动翻飞。

~ Played by Zachopotamus Rex

Despite the size of his huge flat feet, the barefoot hippofolk rogue walks silently… as he comes in for a hug. A lit cigar rests between the broad grin that warms his face, and his deep blue eyes shine with cantankerous mirth and intelligence. Wisps of smoke curl from his ever-smoldering leather armor, and the ruby set into the pommel of the fine rapier at his hip is a rich and vibrant red. A small pistol rests snugly in his sleeve—handy in case of sudden betrayals. Swirling magic dances around his stumpy, rotund fingers as he releases the tight embrace and rolls a spectral coin across his knuckles with impressive dexterity.

~ Played by Zachopotamus Rex

Wicker Zombie.name:
藤编丧尸（特征）
Wicker Zombie

Text.text:
在虫云翻涌的沼泽里，参天巨木压顶，葛藤垂滴如泪，一群女巫围着篝火聚拢。火势越烧越旺，向上攀爬，竟塑成一尊巨大的柳条人。木枝被猛然撞碎，另一道身影从中踉跄冲出，吐着火星与唾沫，残牙咯咯作响——一具浑身燃烧的丧尸（特征），被献祭，又在烈焰里第二次死去。

~ 由 SpaceVulture 构想

In the bug-clouded bog of looming trees dripping kudzu, a coven of hags gather around a fire. It grows, climbing upward, taking the shape of a giant wicker man. Smashing through the sticks another figure emerges, limping and spitting, gnashing what is left of its teeth, a zombie aflame, sacrificed, dying a second time.

~ Envisioned by SpaceVulture

低矮的毡房在荒凉的地形中紧紧挤作一团，每一顶都覆着厚厚一层蘑菇伞般的积雪。变幻的风在这些圆形建筑周围吹出一圈圈空地，把雪堆成如墙般的垒垛，环着聚落。围栏里，毛厚如毡的山羊每一次喘息都在空气中吐出细小的白雾，惊惶的牲畜不安地来回挪动。
Low yurts huddle together in the bleak terrain, each covered with a thick mushroom cap of snow. Shifting winds have blown clearings around the circular structures, creating wall-like heaps around the settlement. In a paddock, thickly furred goats send little plumes of steam into the air with each breath as the nervous animals shift about.

I Put In My Eye Of Trap Seek.name:
我把“陷阱探知之眼”装进了眼眶里
I Put In My Eye Of Trap Seek

Text.text:
我把那颗诡异发光的球体托在掌心，按向自己的脸，轻轻引导它嵌入那只敞开的眼窝。起初那触感令人不适，像陌生人闯进一间寂静的乡野酒馆，但它很快便找到了自己的位置。我嘴角扬起一抹讥诮的笑——第一处暗藏的陷阱映入眼帘，多亏这只新眼，它如今被幽蓝的微光清晰勾勒出来。

~ 由 Envisioned 构想，Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Holding the strange glowing orb in my palm, I press it against my face, gently guiding it into the open socket. The sensation is uncomfortable at first, like a stranger entering a quiet local tavern, but it soon finds its place. A wry smile spreads across my lips as I notice the first hidden trap, now clearly outlined in shimmering blue light thanks to my new eye.

~ Envisioned by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Fake Keoghtum’s Ointment.name:
伪·凯欧格姆药膏
Fake Keoghtum’s Ointment

Text.text:
你撬开玻璃罐的封口，挖出一团黏稠的药膏，厚厚抹在伤口上。那混合物散发着恰到好处的药味，却似乎没有立刻生效——唯一的变化是，涂过药膏的皮肤此刻滑润得令人惊叹。
You pry open the closure on the glass jar, scoop out a glop of the thick ointment, and slather it over your wounds. The mixture smells appropriately medicinal, but it seems to be having no immediate effect—except that the skin where you applied the ointment now feels wondrously smooth.

Armor Of Black Ice.name:
黑冰护甲
Armor Of Black Ice

Text.text:
你以迅捷而娴熟的动作，指尖探入一只不透明的小瓶，随即将几滴液体弹向头顶上方的空中。你全然不理会周遭的天气，那片喷洒立刻化作凝冻的寒雾。由幽灵般霜影投下的阴影悄然凝聚，继而沉落在你身上——你仿佛披上了一副由黑冰铸成的护甲。刺骨的冷意带来一种被封存的错觉，像一片火腿被妥帖塞进冰箱里。你呼出一口气，看见自己的白雾般的呼吸。

~ Envisioned by Kyrus (Brent)

In a quick, practiced, motion, your fingers dip into a small opaque flask then flick droplets of liquid into the air above your head. Heedless of the weather around you, the spray instantly transforms into a frozen mist. As the very shadows cast by the spectral frost coalesce, it settles onto your body—and you appear to be wearing an armor made of black ice. The chill lends you a feeling of preservation, like a rasher of ham stowed away in an icebox. You exhale, seeing your breath.

~ Envisioned by Kyrus (Brent)

一截纤薄的碳聚合物藏在两段棕色握柄的凹槽之中。这柄刀刃锋口阴狠，泛着虹彩般的冷光。它几乎堪称完美的武器，唯一的瑕疵是一处拇指长的凹痕。握柄仿作木纹，但细看便知那是精密的聚合物防滑握面。一枚红蝎形的小卡扣将两段握柄扣合在一起。扣环一松，刀刃便如其名般轻颤翻飞。它在鞘体里进出自如，伴着一声清越如乐的轻响。
A thin length of carbon polymer is concealed within the grooves of two brown handles. This blade sports a wicked edge that gleams iridescently. A perfect weapon, its only deformity is a thumb-length indent. The handles are faux wood, but closer inspection reveals a sophisticated polymer grip. A small latch in the shape of a red scorpion holds the handles together. On release, the blade flutters like its namesake. It slips in and out of its housing with a musical sound.

Dimyar Iii Of House Bolton.name:
博尔顿家族的迪米亚三世
Dimyar Iii Of House Bolton

Text.text:
那个人类一头起伏的黑色波浪发垂落遮住了脸，肮脏的皮革风衣松松垮垮地挂在他精瘦的身上。他抬起苍白的手，在那如利爪般的握持里，安着一枚黑曜石圆球，暗得像虚空本身，吞不进一丝光。无指手套的皮革边缘磨得起毛，断裂的指甲缝里结着硬泥。他那团乱黑发下，一只蓝眼灼灼发亮，死死钉在圆球上；另一只眼则是柴火燃起的浓橙色，翻涌旋转，如火焰的漩涡。这只眼聚焦于一切又聚焦于无物——圆球、地平线、他自己，还有你。缕缕烟丝从他黑色皮衣的接缝里艰难渗出，从他的护甲之内——从他紧咬的齿缝之后。

~ Played by Joel Zupke

The human’s wavy black hair has fallen down over his face, and his filthy leather trench coat hangs loose on his lean frame. He lifts his pale hand, and within his clawlike grip sits an obsidian orb, lightless as the void. The leather of his fingerless gloves is frayed, dirt crusted under his broken fingernails. One blue eye sears from underneath his mop of black locks, affixed on the orb. His other eye, the rich orange of a wood-fed fire, swirls like a whirlpool of flame. This eye focuses on nothing and everything—the orb, the horizon, himself, and you. Tendrils of smoke eke out of the seams in his black leather coat, from within his armor—from behind his clenched teeth.

~ Played by Joel Zupke

他把油腻的手在森林绿的工装裤上随意一抹，小个子半身人自豪地笑着，眼看着伙伴们迫不及待地挤到炖锅旁。行会里做匠人的日子早已甩在身后——尽管那段师承仍在他身上留下疤痕——但他依旧以能为朋友端上一顿好饭而自豪，尤其是在旅途之中。翠绿的眼眸闪着热络的欢笑，他冲众人露出促狭的笑容，又在他们争抢该由谁拿走剩菜时，摇头失笑，像是对这份热闹的荒唐又爱又无奈。

~ Played by LJ

Wiping greasy hands on his forest-green overalls, the halfling smiles proudly as his companions eagerly crowd around the cooking pot. His artisan days of guild work are far behind him—though he still carries the scars of his tutelage—but he takes great pride in providing his friends with a good meal, especially on the road. Emerald eyes sparkling with gregarious mirth, he flashes a cheeky smile at the group and shakes his head in jovial disbelief as they argue over who should get the leftovers.

~ Played by LJ

脚下原本松软、会被踩陷的积雪，忽然变成了一层湿滑而坚硬的冰。你面前延展开一条蜿蜒的河流，河面覆着一整片闪烁的冻水薄幕。透过冰层，你能看见河床的岩石被严寒封存，像困在冰冷的坟冢里。
The soft snow that has sinking beneath your feet is suddenly replaced by a slippery, hard layer of ice. In front of you stretches a winding river covered by a sheet of glimmering frozen water. Below the surface, you can see the rocks of the riverbed in their frigid entombment.

Eyes Of The Eagle.name:
雄鹰之眼
Eyes Of The Eagle

Text.text:
镶嵌在一对棱角分明的缟玛瑙镜框之中，镜框雕成猛禽面容般的轮廓；两片泛着幽蓝光泽的晶亮镜片，仿佛能以骇人的清晰度捕捉每一丝细节。
Set in an angular pair of onyx frames shaped to resemble a bird of prey’s visage, the two sparkling, blue-tinged lenses seem to pick out detail with startling clarity.

牧师微笑着点头，在你说话时注视着你的唇形。为助你理解，他以几个优雅的手势相辅，其中一只手从心神深处拢起圣洁的念头，递送到你面前。另一只手则将祝福按在你的额头上——神祇的垂青经由接触与谨慎挑拣、由牧师共情细细塑形的言语一同流转而来。

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

The cleric smiles and nods, watching your lips as you speak. With a few graceful gestures to help you, one of the cleric’s hands gathers holy thoughts from his mind and passes them to you. The blessings are bestowed with his other hand on your forehead, the deity’s favor transferred through touch and the shaping of words carefully chosen and molded from the cleric’s empathy.

~ Played by Forge Ahead: A Party To Access

Failed Solarpunk Community.name:
失败的太阳朋克社区
Failed Solarpunk Community

Text.text:
正午的烈日沉沉压顶，光芒在花园塔楼的窗面上闪烁跳跃。这些建筑令人叹服，线条流畅、现代利落，远远高出聚落其余一切。大多数其他建筑只是小巧的球形居住舱，屋顶铺着太阳能板；它们在吸吮那令人窒息的炽烈光线时，发出一阵令人不安的电流嗡鸣。这里的人们从家中窥视外头，脸上写满疲惫与忧惧。成群的巨甲虫在花园塔楼上窸窣爬行，触角在各处探拨试探。某只昆虫在水培管路上找到了破绽，轻易从材料磨损的裂口中挤了进去。类似的创口折磨着整套系统，阵阵蒸汽喷涌嘶鸣，散入无情的热空气里。塔内蔬菜、水果与其他植物的叶片发黄卷曲，许多茎与新芽在这美丽却已受损的庇护中黯然下垂。

~ 由 Moebius

The looming noon sun glints off the windows of the garden towers. These impressive structures, sleek and modern in their design, reach high above the rest of the settlement. Most of the other buildings are small, spherical living pods with solar-panel roofs that emit an unsettling drone of electricity as they soak up the oppressive rays. The people here peer out from their homes with expressions of exhaustion and worry. Swarms of large beetles scuttle across the garden towers, their antennae prodding at various points. One of the insects finds a fault in the hydroponic tubing, easily pressing through a fray in the material. Similar wounds plague the entire system, as gouts of steam hiss out into the unforgiving air. The leaves of the vegetables, fruits, and other plants within are yellowed and furled, many of their stems and shoots drooping sadly within their beautiful, compromised confines.

~ Envisioned by Moebius

这柄矛状长柄武器的顶端，安着一把阔阔的叶形刃长剑，剑尖锋锐。精雕细琢的长柄上缠覆着几段钢箍，柄身长度是刃长的两倍。金属在杆尾的钝端附近铸成一处握位，在靠近刃部、宽阔横护手下方再塑一处握位，而在护手的护枝与刃下那段更窄的握把之间，还有第三处握位。

~ 由 Vectus Valorian 构想

A broad, leaf-bladed sword with a sharp point tops this spearlike polearm. Steel wraps around parts of the elaborate haft, which is twice the length of the blade. The metal forms a grip near the staff’s blunt end, another just under a wide cross guard near the blade, and one more between the guard’s quillons and a narrower hilt under the blade.

~ Envisioned by Vectus Valorian

Advice About Remaining Kind.name:
关于如何始终保持善良
Advice About Remaining Kind

Text.text:
“善良从来不是简单之物；它是一场战斗。你或许能对所有你所遭遇的人都心怀善意，但不论你多么纯净，当你独自一人时——我向你保证——你的残酷终将迎来属于它的那一天，为你曾如何忽视它而寻求复仇。”
“Kindness is not a simple thing; it is a battle. You may be kind to all you encounter, but no matter your purity, when you are alone—I promise—your cruelty will have its day and seek its revenge for how you have neglected it.”

这孩子或许才几个月大，却已带着毫无束缚的好奇与探索的渴望四处活动。它以飞快的爬行向前挪动，膝盖在地面上滑擦，双手抓向任何顺手可攀的着力点。它一边爬一边咿呀咿呀地呀语，转瞬之间便能从欢快的笑声变作夹杂着绝望的哀鸣。
The child may only be a few months old, but already they move with an unfettered curiosity and a need to explore. They carry themselves forward at a rapid crawl, knees sliding against the floor, hands grabbing for any convenient purchase. They babble as they move, emitting sounds of glee mingled with despair at a moment's notice.

I Wrangle A Wyrmling.name:
我驯服一条幼龙
I Wrangle A Wyrmling

Text.text:
这小鬼确实滑溜得很——细长的身躯像鳗鱼一样难以捉摸，尾巴盘上我的小腿，利齿却朝我的脸猛咬——即便我双手死死扣住它那长着利爪的前臂。  
我使出浑身力气把这生物往外顶，可它紫色巨口里飞溅的涎水早已糊满我的脸，还把头发淋得湿透。  
它忽然像回了魂似的爆发出一股新力，我们俩一起摔倒在地，翻滚纠缠，直到我终于把它按住：双膝夹住它的腰腹，双手将它的脑袋狠狠压进地面。
The scamp is wriggly, that’s for sure—its long body proves as slippery as an eel, its tail coiling around my leg as its jaws snap at my face—even with my hands poised firmly around its taloned forearms. I hold back the creature with every ounce of strength, though the saliva flying from its purple maw has coated my face and drenched my hair. It lurches with a sudden renewal of strength, and we both go tumbling to the floor, rolling about until I am able to pin it: knees around its middle and both hands shoving its head into the ground.

Asclepius Fidius, Founder Of House Dolph.name:
阿斯克勒庇俄斯·菲狄乌斯，海豚之家的创立者
Asclepius Fidius, Founder Of House Dolphin

Text.text: 球兰百科全书的撰写者、Infidius权杖的锻造者——此人是某个小家族唯一的创立者，同时也曾协助建造魔导师学院。他博学多才，以幽默感与深厚的仁慈著称。Fidius教授因厌恶权力那令人分心且易使人腐化的本质，遂将海豚家族定为小族之位。他身形瘦削，却在垂暮之年仍是健泳的强者；头发剪得很短，水蓝色长袍却拖曳至地；笑声也总是不绝于耳。 Writer of the Encyclopedia Globularia and smith of the Scepter Infidius, this man is the only founder of a minor house who also helped construct Enchanter Academy. He was a polymath known for his sense of humor and great kindness. Professor Fidius committed House Dolphin to its minor standing because of his distaste for the distracting and corrupting nature of power. He was lean and a strong swimmer well into his old age, wore his hair short and his aqua-blue robes long, and laughed often.

潮湿的空气里充满鸟鸣与虫声，夹杂着湿土的青翠气息。雨林的每一寸土地都被生长之物覆盖——从参天巨木，到蕨类与攀藤，再到覆满倒木的苔藓与菌类。层层蔓延的树冠只在转瞬间漏出几缕天空的影子。
The humid air is filled with the chatter of birds and insects, and the green scent of damp earth. Every inch of the rainforest is covered in growing things, from titanic trees to ferns and creepers, to the moss and fungi that blanket fallen logs. The sprawling canopy provides only fleeting glimpses of the sky.

Dragon Hatching Out Of Its Shell.name:
幼龙破壳而出
Dragon Hatching Out Of Its Shell

Text.text:
龙形生物扭动着身躯，伴着湿黏的撕裂声，将蜥蜴般的躯体从新近破开的卵壳中挣扎而出。黏稠的体液从壳内缓缓渗淌，它终于得以无拘无束地第一次呼吸，随后笨拙地挪动，摸索着学会行走。它的目光扫过周围区域，鼻孔急促翕张，嗅探空气中是否有食物或危险的踪迹。忽然，鲜血与脏腑的气味弥漫开来，它抬起头——颌间早已糊满黏液，眼中闪着尚未餍足的饥渴光芒。
The draconic form wriggles, heaving its reptilian body from its newly broken shell with a wet tearing sound. Sticky fluids ooze from the shell as the beast takes its first unfettered breaths then moves clumsily as it learns to walk. Its gaze roams the surrounding area and its nostrils flare, testing the air for signs of food or danger. It raises its head when the scent of fresh blood and viscera fills the air—its jaws already slathered with slime, and its eyes shining with a hunger not yet sated.

Haunted Pirate Ship.name:
闹鬼的海盗船
Haunted Pirate Ship

Text.text:
幽冥般的光晕在那艘深色木材的船身周围忽明忽灭，将海浪染成异界的幽绿。被污渍浸黑的旗帜无力地垂在后桅上，盐霜结痂的船帆上赫然印着一颗肮脏的骷髅。舵轮自顾自地旋转，无人操持；艉楼甲板空无一物；船尾处一口锈铃凄然作响。薄雾裹覆的甲板上，朦胧的身影渗出般显形又迅速淡去——一群虚无飘忽的幽魂，仍披着水手的装束。
A spectral nimbus flickers about the dark-timbered ship, tingeing the waves an otherworldly green. A stained black flag dangles, flaccid, from the mizzen, and a dirty skull is emblazoned upon the salt-crusted sail. The wheel spins unattended, the poop deck is devoid of life, and a rusty bell rings dolefully from the aft. On the mist-sheathed deck, shadowy figures bleed into existence before fading from sight—insubstantial wraiths bedecked in sailors’ garb.

Galeb Duhr Animating Nearby Boulders.name:
伽勒布·杜尔令近旁巨石苏醒
Galeb Duhr Animating Nearby Boulders

Text.text:
你们一行逼近时，巨魔周围的地面开始震颤。地上的碎石像怒沸的水一般嗡嗡抖动，跳跃、滚动，化作层层波浪，朝两块巨大的巨石涌去。你看见巨魔的眼中寒光一闪，碎石狡黠地钻入巨石下方，推挤着它们朝你们移动。紧接着，巨石也开始摇晃弹跳，碾碎一部分碎石成尘，而那一整团被赋予生命的岩石便纵跃着扑向前来。

~ 由 Joe Engineer 构想

At your party's approach, the ground around the troll begins to shake. Pebbles on the ground vibrate like furiously boiling water. They bounce and roll, wavelike, toward two large boulders. You see the troll’s eyes flash as the pebbles wheedle their way under the boulders, carrying them toward you. Then the boulders, too, shake and bounce, crushing some of the pebbles to dust, and the whole lot of animated stone bounds forward.

~ Envisioned by Joe Engineer

昏暗的卡座里绽开一团橙色火光，那矮人粗砺而憔悴，叼在讥笑嘴角的雪茄被他狠狠吸了一口。乌黑长发——如煤烟般的颜色——披散在他那件伤痕累累的皮夹克肩头，皮夹克下压着胸甲；而他的眼睛——黑得像黑曜石针尖般锐利——正死死审视着你。配上苍白的灰色皮肤，在酒馆令人窒息的幽暗里，他显得格外阴森。身旁，一头巨大的机械熊守卫般伫立，体内机括轻轻咔哒作响，像心跳一样有节奏。矮人站起身，亲昵地拍了拍这名熊形哨兵，随即露出腰间那把沉甸甸的左轮，便昂然迈步走向吧台。

~ 扮演：一位英雄

Orange light blooms in the shadowed booth as the gruff, haggard gnome takes a drag on the cigar hanging from the corner of his sneering mouth. Long black hair—the color of soot—drapes across the shoulders of the battered leather jacket he wears over his breastplate, and eyes—dark and sharp as an obsidian needle—study you intently. Coupled with his pallid gray skin, he strikes a sinister figure in the stifling gloom of the tavern. At his side, a large mechanical bear stands guard, its internal mechanism clicking softly like a heartbeat. The gnome rises, patting the ursine sentinel affectionately, and reveals the weighty revolver at his hip before striding confidently to the bar.

~ Played by a Hero with

你把那一字一句背得滚瓜烂熟的咒文念到最后，缭绕的熏香在你身侧盘旋。你的供奉微薄得可怜，却仍像营火里被风卷走的余烬般，转瞬消散无踪。片刻间，万籁俱寂，仿佛什么都没有发生；可当你猛然意识到自己并非孤身一人时，全身汗毛齐齐倒竖。有什么东西——某种存在——就在近处静候。你可以提出一个问题。
Incense coils around you as you complete the words you've memorized so dutifully. Your offering, meager though it may be, vanishes on the wind, like embers from a campfire. For a moment nothing happens, but every hair stands on end as you realize you are not alone. Something—a presence—waits nearby. You can ask a single question.

Sorcerer's Speech Of Self-affirmation.name:
术士的自我肯定宣言
Sorcerer's Speech Of Self-affirmation

Text.text:
“力量不在书本里，不在兵刃间，也不在学识之中——它在本能里。相信你的本能，它会带你穿过你所面对的一切。也许终有一日，你会明白那些赐予你的天赋究竟为何而来；但在那之前，它们属于你，任你随心所用。”
“Power is not in books or arms or knowledge—it is in instinct. Trust yours, and it will carry you through whatever you face. Perhaps one day you will learn the purpose of the gifts that were granted to you, but until then, they are yours to do with as you see fit.”

Loot From A Shroomcap Shaman.name:
从菌盖萨满身上搜刮的战利品
Loot From A Shroomcap Shaman

Text.text:
你从萨满头上撬下那顶宽檐、泛着紫色光泽的蘑菇伞盖，软塌塌的边缘光滑得像牛皮革。它仍散发着新鲜的泥土气与肉香，仿佛刚从土里拔出。这种状态使它成为制作护甲的绝佳材料。
You pry the wide-brimmed, purple-hued mushroom cap from the shaman’s head, the floppy sides as smooth as cowhide leather. It still has a fresh earthy, meaty aroma, as if it has just been plucked from the soil. The condition makes it an excellent candidate for armor.

岩石岬角间那道狭窄的裂隙豁然通向一处空地，四周被高耸的石壁夹峙。另有两条狭窄小径在体型如房屋般的巨砾间穿行，作为便于防守的出入口；最高的岩壁上垂下一架绳梯，毫无疑问通往哨兵俯瞰四方的制高点。空地中央燃着一堆剥去树皮的干木小火，火焰低伏无烟，周围散放着卷起的铺盖。
The narrow gap in the rocky promontory opens into a clearing between high faces of stone. Two other narrow paths between boulders the size of houses provide defensible exits, and a rope ladder dangles down from the tallest rockface, no doubt leading up to a vantage for lookouts. A low fire of dry wood stripped of bark burns smokeless in the center of the clearing, surrounded by bedrolls.

楼宇之间横亘着一条又长又浅的沟渠，成了这片社区的垃圾堆与露天茅厕。肮脏的猪和癞皮的狗在污秽堆里翻拣，搜寻可口的残渣。恶臭扑鼻，熏得你几乎难以想象，它们竟还能找到什么不会把自己毒倒的东西。
A long shallow ditch between buildings serves the community as trash heap and latrine. Filthy pigs and mangy dogs scour the heaps for choice morsels. From the stench you find it hard to imagine they could find anything that wouldn’t poison them.

Anti-anxiety Street Drug, \"Zone\": Inge.name:
抗焦虑街头药物“Zone”：口服
Anti-anxiety Street Drug, "Zone": Ingested

Text.text:
药片几乎瞬间在你体内溶解，你的焦虑随之平息。胸口的结节松开，下颌不再紧绷；遮蔽你视线的恐慌迷雾散去，你清晰地看见了下一步理性可行的行动方向。
As the tablet near instantly dissolves into your system, your anxiety calms. The knot in your chest loosens, your jaw unclenches; the haze of panic that clouded your vision clears, and you can see your next rational course of action clearly.

Calyx Skybyrne.name:
卡莱克斯·斯凯伯恩
Calyx Skybyrne

Text.text:
凡听过这位牧师清澈如水晶的嗓音者，无不为她那般年纪轻轻却炽烈如火的热忱而目眩。她澄澈无邪的正午蓝眼眸，配上一头似烈焰起伏的长发，更衬得青春逼人。几乎无人会猜到——她也绝不会承认——在月光之下，她会脱下祭司长袍，换上酒馆巡演吟游诗人那一身褶边与蕾丝，用鲁特琴与小鹿般轻快的蹦跳为人提振精神。无论哪副面貌，她都带来欢乐——光与歌，尽在一颗鲜活跳动的心里。

~ 由 @SixteenCharlie3 Played ，并附

Those who hear the cleric’s crystalline voice are dazzled by the ardor in one so young. Her guileless noonday-blue eyes and hair like a rippling flame accentuate her youth. Few would guess—nor would she confess—that by moonlight, she trades her priestly robes for the frills and lace of a tavern-touring bard, lifting spirits with her lute and her coltish capers. She brings joy in both guises—light and song in one vibrant heart.

~ Played by @SixteenCharlie3 with

Plea From A Henchmen.name:
来自手下的恳求
Plea From A Henchmen

Text.text:
“我承认，我做过可怕的事。我们每个人心里不都有头野兽吗？可和你们大家聊过之后……你们让我看见了光。我以后会变好的——做义工、补偿一切——我发誓。”
“I admit it, I’ve done horrible things. There’s a beast in all of us isn’t there? But talking to all of you… you’ve made me see the light. I’m going to be good now—community service and everything—I swear.”

Claire Devereux.name:
克莱尔·德弗罗
Claire Devereux

Text.text:
这些抉择太难了：在幽暗的位面里，穿黑色还是白色的晚礼服？是带上以太化药水（众多礼物之一），还是把它换成那瓶“爱之媚药”活力补剂——对她的肌肤简直好到离谱？她的魔法，是引诱与探知。找出那个恶霸。保持不露声色，眨动那双紫色眼眸，换上口音，啜饮席间最上等的陈酿，然后启动灵能。没人能解除克莱尔的武装，有没有头衔都一样。她才是让人卸下防备的那一个。

~ 由 Chris Clarke 扮演

The decisions are so difficult: Black or white evening gown for a dark plane? Take the Potion of Etherealness (one of many gifts) or trade it for that Philter of Love revitalizer—SO good to her skin? Her sorcery is to lure and learn. Find the bully. Stay subtle, bat those purple eyes, put on the accent, sip the best vintage on offer, and start the psionics. No one can disarm Claire, title or no. She’s the disarming one.

~ Played by Chris Clarke

华丽的涡纹与线条昭示着这柄大马士革钢刃的锻造：工匠以近乎苛刻的工序反复锤炼，将武器金属中的每一丝杂质都敲打殆尽。这样一把短剑，无论置身血腥战场，还是陈列于私家博物馆，都同样相得益彰。
Gorgeous whorls and lines indicate the forging of a Damascus steel blade, the process exactingly enacted to hammer out any impurities in the weapon’s metal. Such a shortsword would be equally at home on a bloody battlefield and in a private museum.

Steaming Potion From A Dark Faerie Swamp.name:
来自黑暗妖精沼泽的蒸腾药剂
Steaming Potion From A Dark Faerie Swamp

Text.text:
那只晶莹的玻璃小瓶形似一朵矮胖的伞菌，瓶中盛着一汪黑暗、翻涌冒泡的液体。蒸汽自瓶口的细嘴处不断溢出，绵绵成流；瓶内黏稠的液体散发出咸腥苦涩的气味。
The crystalline vial, shaped like some sort of stunted toadstool, bears within it a dark, bubbling liquid. Steam pours over the lip of the vial’s spout in a constant stream, and a brackish odor emanates from the viscous liquid within.

Grey's Resistor: Injected.name:
格雷的电阻器：注入
Grey's Resistor: Injected

Text.text:
从穿刺处向外扩散，一股辣椒般的灼热攀上你的脊梁，沿着椎骨猛然窜升。它逗留片刻，随即转为刺骨的寒意，让你感觉自己像被涂了一层元素驱避剂。但就像辣椒的余辣，你隐约觉得它一旦褪去，仍会留下持久的刺痒烦躁。眼下，那种效果似乎微不足道。

~ 一位英雄构想

Radiating from the site of the puncture, a chili-pepper warmth finds your spine and rockets up the vertebrae. It lingers, then goes chill, leaving you feeling like you’ve been coated in an elemental repellant. But like hot chilies, you suspect that when it wears off, it’ll leave behind a lasting irritation. At the moment, that effect seems trivial.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Seedy Construction Site.name:
肮脏的建筑工地
Seedy Construction Site

Text.text:
尘土与污垢覆满了施工机器人，也盖在几堆建筑材料上；那几个工人同样脏得不成样子。电子烟吐出的白雾与工地上方久久不散的污染烟霾纠缠在一起，他们看起来更热衷于骚扰路过的人，而不是留心周遭正在进行的施工。
Dust and grime coat the construction robots and several piles of building materials, and the few human workers aren't in a much better hygienic state. The smoke from their e-cigarettes mingles with the cloud of pollution hanging over the construction site, and they seem much more focused on harassing passersby than paying attention to the work going on around them.

这道法术以祈祷与古老的魔法语言交织成词，向天穹伸出触须，开启一条通往宇宙根源之力的通道——没有它，世界将会在字面意义上尽数沉入黑暗。你凝视着从紧握的指缝间渗出的光辉，随即摊开手掌向前掷出，引导太阳的灿然伟力化作一束灼烈的光之直线。
With words that mix prayer and an ancient language of magic, this spell reaches out to the celestial sphere and opens a pathway to a foundational force of the universe, without which—quite literally—all the world would lie in darkness.
