You look at the glow coming from between your fisted fingers and then throw out your open palm, directing the brilliant power of the Sun in a searing line of radiance.

I Cast Sacred Flame.name:
我施放圣焰
I Cast Sacred Flame

Text.text:
我心念神祇，虔诚而炽烈地祈求援助。腹中骤然一轻，仿佛神圣回应了我的呼唤。一只翼如白焰的蝴蝶翩然而降，振翅间逸出一声尖细、几近不可闻的嗡鸣。它与我的目标一触即燃，耀目的火光瞬息将其彻底吞没。
I think of my deity and pray ardently for assistance. My stomach lightens as I feel the divine answer my call. A butterfly with wings of white flame flutters down, emitting a high, nearly imperceptible hum. My target immolates upon contact, the radiant flame enveloping them completely.

一只细长的青铜色昆虫状生物窜入视野。它脸上带着居高临下的神情，颚钳咔哒作响。它的前躯用四条几丁质手臂握着一柄朴素的长矛。分节的胸部两侧排着五对腿，末端收束成一只凶狠的钳爪。尽管天生披甲，这生物仍穿戴着采矿道具，提供些许粗陋的防护。它的前躯还绑着一整套武装，其中包括一组简易破片手雷。
A long bronze insectoid skitters into view. It bears a superior look on its face, mandibles chattering. Its forebody grasps a simple pike between four chitinous arms. Five pairs of legs sit aside a segmented thorax that ends in a nasty-looking pincer. Although naturally armored, the creature sports mining gear that offers some rudimentary protection. An array of weaponry is strapped to its forebody, including a set of rudimentary frag grenades.

一朵活生生的双足蘑菇轻轻漂浮在地面之上，低声哼鸣。它像一片迷途的云团般起起伏伏，带着近乎虔敬的从容，灰与蓝的布帛裹覆其身。节瘤如木的双手紧攥一根法杖，杖身脉动着明亮的粉红光芒。环绕这行走真菌的空气都变得柔和，仿佛一段香料的赋格。它漫不经心地数着自己的手指。
A living, bipedal mushroom floats gently above the ground, softly humming. Like a wayward cloud, it bobs with reverent ease, swathed in cloth of gray and blue. Gnarled wood-like hands clutch a staff pulsing with bright pink light. The very atmosphere surrounding this walking fungus has softened, like a fugue of spice. It takes count of its fingers with a careless ease.

Unlit Braziers.name:
未点燃的火盆
Unlit Braziers

Text.text:
通往山道的桥头两根石桩上，凿出了碗状的凹槽，并被细细打磨得莹润光滑。凹槽里填满木炭，随时可点燃，为夜行之人照亮前路。
Bowl-shaped depressions have been carved into the two stone posts at the head of the bridge to the mountain path, and polished to a smooth luster. They are filled with charcoal, ready to light the path for nighttime travelers.

隧道蜿蜒盘旋，路线诡异得近乎毫无章法。骷髅——成百上千的骷髅——从墙壁的凹龛里狞笑着探出头来。它们空洞的眼窝仿佛在你经过时一路追随着你。每隔一段距离便有壁龛，安放着受敬之人的遗骸：白骨披着破烂的袍服，双臂交叉覆在胸前。蜡烛的摇曳微光投向黑暗，拉长了影子，也在你脑中耍着花招——余光里似有形影游动。空气陈腐滞重，寂静得过分；你发誓，在墓穴更深处传来一丝声音。
The tunnels wind and twist, seemingly nonsensical in their route. Skulls, hundreds of skulls, leer from recesses in the walls. Their hollow eyes seem to follow you as you pass. Alcoves at regular intervals contain the remains of honored dead, their bones draped in tattered robes, arms crossed over their chests. Candles lend their flickering light to the darkness, lengthening shadows and playing tricks on your mind as shapes move in the periphery. The air is stale, and it's too quiet—you swear you hear a voice deeper within the catacombs.

Irrumabo Puer.name:
伊鲁马博·普厄尔
Irrumabo Puer

Text.text:
阳光在他华丽的铂金鳞片上流淌闪耀，战士将一张精致的龙裔长弓拉至满弦，明亮的蓝眸以冷静而精准的目光锁定目标。他那爬行类的嘴角扬起傲慢的冷笑，雪白利齿一闪而过，随即示意同伴发动攻击，放箭离弦。伴随着一抹雪白鳞光掠影，幼龙自云端俯冲而下，利爪深深钉入目标的护卫体内——恰在同一瞬，他主人的箭矢正中要害。

~ 由一位英雄 扮演，其

Sun shining from his resplendent platinum scales, the warrior pulls the string of an exquisite draconic bow taut, his radiant blue eyes tracking his target with clinical precision. With his reptilian mouth curled into an arrogant sneer, he flashes sharp white fangs and signals his companion to attack as he looses the arrow. In a blur of snow-white scales the drake swoops from the clouds, sinking its claws deep into the target's bodyguard—just as his master's arrow finds its mark.

~ Played by a Hero with

一团浓密的毛皮起伏着，沉重的喘息将滚烫的白汽一口口喷向夜空。星辰是这只生物的全部焦点——它的四只眼按其天生的构造朝向苍穹，每一只都墨黑如渊，点缀着银色星屑。尽管它高达十八英尺，体重恐怕远超一套平均的重武器阵列，这只宇宙生物却不外溢半分敌意，也不让人感到丝毫不安。
A mass of fur heaves, its heavy breathing sending expulsions of hot steam skyward. The stars are the creature’s focus—its four eyes, by design, face the heavens, each one inky black and speckled with silver. Although eighteen feet tall and weighing likely a good deal more than the average heavy weapons array, this cosmic creature effuses no aggression nor sense of ill ease.

这头史前掠食者在丛林地面上疾掠而过，如同闪电穿破云层；鸟骨般的身躯纤细流线，覆着斑驳鳞片，在葱郁的背景里几乎无迹可寻。它的凶残远超其体型，即便独自潜行也无所畏惧。然而，若你见到一只，就该预料到更多——它们天生就要成群结队，扑向体型是自己百倍的生物，用刀锋般的镰形利爪切开猎物，再以鳄类般的利齿啃食残躯。
This prehistoric predator bolts across the jungle floor like lightning through clouds, its bird-bone body thin and sleek, covered in mottled scales that camouflage it against the verdant backdrop. Vicious beyond its size, it is fearless even when it stalks alone. But, where there is one, expect many, for they live to swarm over creatures a hundredfold their size, slicing prey with razorlike, sickle-shaped claws, then feeding on the body with crocodilian teeth.

Abandoned Lunatic Asylum: A Sad, Empty P.name:
废弃的疯人院：悲伤而空寂之地
Abandoned Lunatic Asylum: A Sad, Empty Place

Text.text:
收容院——哪怕是最温和的那种——似乎也总会背上邪恶的名声。创办者原本想建起一处庇护之所的良善初衷，会被人们对其中被看护者的恐惧一点点侵蚀殆尽。然而，当你听着风穿过这座建筑的叹息声，一粒冰冷的笃定在你心底生根：这家收容院从来都不安全。
Asylums, even the most benign examples, seem to gain an evil reputation. The founders’ fine intentions to form a refuge are steadily undermined by the horror folk have of those held in its care. Yet as you listen to the wind sigh through the structure, a cold kernel of certainty takes root within you: this asylum was anything but safe.

Quasi-elemental Plane Of Lightning.name:
准元素闪电位面
Quasi-elemental Plane Of Lightning

Text.text:
臭氧的刺鼻气味挥之不去，四面八方的风暴翻涌咆哮。你的头发根根竖起，皮肤因空气中潜伏的能量而阵阵发麻。闪电撕裂长空，先是一道炫目光芒，随即雷霆轰鸣震耳欲聋。
The stench of ozone lingers, and storms roil in all directions. Your hair stands on end, your skin prickles at the energy latent on the air. Lightning cracks, a dazzling flash followed by the roar of thunder.

I Cast Stinking Cloud Using Rotten Eggs.name:
我用臭鸡蛋施放「恶臭云」
I Cast Stinking Cloud Using Rotten Eggs

Text.text:
我手里攥着的蛋看起来毫不起眼，只因蛋壳仍完好包裹着里面腐败的脏腑。我用一声粗鄙的怪响为咒语画上句点——随即蓄力挥臂，把这枚蛋像燃烧弹般掷出。它落在敌群之中，轰然炸裂，迸出一团病态的黄雾。
The egg I hold in my hand looks unassuming, but only because the shell is still intact around the putrefied innards. I punctuate my incantation with a crude noise—then wind up and lob the egg like an incendiary. It lands among my enemies and explodes in a cloud of sickly yellow vapor.

Prehistoric Kale.name:
史前羽衣甘蓝
Prehistoric Kale

Text.text:
一丛丛深绿巨叶从肥沃的土地里猛然迸发，每一片叶缘都起着巨大的起伏波浪般褶皱。潮湿的空气中弥漫着有机生长带来的微苦气息，几条体型如圆木般的毛毛虫正紧紧攀附在数片叶子的背面。
Great bushels of dark green leaves erupt from the fertile ground, each one crimped at the edges in large, undulating waves. The slightly bitter smell of organic growth fills the humid air, and caterpillars the size of a log can be seen clinging to the underside of several leaves.

Vampire Lord's Castle In Storm.name:
暴风中的吸血鬼（特征）领主城堡
Vampire Lord's Castle In Storm

Text.text:
闪电在震天的咆哮间撕裂苍穹，暴雨猛砸马车车顶，雨痕在车窗上纵横流淌，宛如送葬者的泪。你转过险峻山路的最后一道弯，终于看见它：在狂怒风暴的剪影里，那座吸血鬼（特征）的城堡轮廓清晰得令人窒息。与雨水湿滑的城垛相连的高塔如巨兽之爪，刮擦着翻涌不定的天空；敞开的城门大张着黑暗的咽喉，门内摇曳的火把光芒忽明忽灭。

~ 由 thebigham 构想

Lightning splits the sky between thunderous bellows, as rain hammers the carriage roof, streaking the windows like a mourner's tears. As you round the final corner of the treacherous mountain road you see it: silhouetted against the raging tempest is the unmistakable form of the vampire's castle. Towers attached to rain-slick parapets scrape the tumultuous sky like titanic claws, and the open gate yawns wide, lit from within by flickering torchlight.

~ Envisioned by thebigham

堆叠紧密的石块与泥土隆起成垒，勾勒出城堡的防御边界。巨大的树干被重锤钉入地中加固，这道森然壁垒坚不可摧，足以让任何闯入者望而却步。
Packed mounds of heaped stone and earth form the defensive boundary of the castle. Reinforced by enormous tree trunks hammered into the ground, the formidable barrier is a potent defense for intruders to overcome.

一只生物踉跄而行，哭泣般渗出黏稠的黄色液体，双爪疯狂抓挠着自己的头骨。颅底处，一团漆黑的蠕虫状影子剧烈扭动，啃噬着这只生物脊柱的钙质。宿主骤然僵住——它与那蠕虫般的异形之战，已然败北。
A creature stumbles, weeping viscous yellow fluid as it claws at its skull. At the base of the cranium, a dark wormlike shape wriggles violently, chomping at the calcium of the creature’s spine. The host stills. Its battle with the wormlike alien is lost.

Stealthing Around A Villainous Hacker-as.name:
潜行周旋于一支刺杀黑客的邪恶势力周遭
Stealthing Around A Villainous Hacker-assassinating Force

Text.text:
在赛博空间的灵质迷宫中，一名幽影般的黑客——披覆着二进制的阴翳——潜行于奥秘节点的幽深处。数字勾勒秘仪符号，在加密回响间翩然起舞，只为避开守护宝藏的谜样巨龙。一场无声之舞徐徐展开：零碎代码与隐秘结界在博学的同调中角力——直到窃贼终于携那璀璨战利品遁去。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

In the etheric maze of cyberspace, a ghostly hacker—wreathed in binary shadow—stalks within the arcane node’s depths. Digits trace esoteric symbols, a ballet among encrypted echoes, intent on eluding the enigmatic wyrm guarding treasures. A silent dance unfolds, where slivers of code and clandestine wards struggle in erudite synchronicity—until the thief finally makes off with the radiant prize.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

这座城门之名源自拉丁语janua，意为“门”。正如一月是新年的门扉，它也是环绕斯派尔威奇城墙上最先修建的第一座城门。门身以青铜嵌饰勾勒出太阳般的纹样，能将光芒折射得熠熠生辉；而在新年的第一天，它会为“岁曙节”敞开。两座二十英尺高塔上的垛口悬挂着各城中行会的旗帜、一面绘着附魔师学院徽记的旗帜，以及一面绣着那座古老尖塔的旗帜——正是那尖塔为小镇赐名。 This gate is named from the Latin janua, which means door. As January is the door to the new year, this was the first gate built in the wall around Spirewych. It is decorated in sun patterns of bronze inlay that reflect the light, and on the first day of the year it is opened for the Year Dawning Festival. The crenellations on the twenty-foot towers are decorated with banners of the city guilds, a banner with the crest of Enchanter Academy, and one with the old tower spire for which the town was named.

温暖而干燥的风在草地与树梢间盘旋，带着烧灼岩石的恶臭。成群的鸟儿惊起，振翅南飞。细小的动物停止觅食，钻入盘根错节的根系、树冠高处与幽暗的洞穴里寻求庇护。寂静降临——随即被打破，先是北方传来一声咆哮，继而又是一声；更多的回声在远处应和。朝那个方向望去，数道带翼的爬行巨影大小不一，赤红的鳞光在午后阳光下闪烁。它们逼近时，雷鸣般的振翼声淹没了世间其余一切声响。

~ Envisioned by Potion802

Warm, dry wind swirls through the grass and trees. It stinks of burning rock. A multitude of birds take flight, winging to the south. Tiny animals cease their foraging and seek shelter in roots, treetops, and hollows. Silence falls—and is broken, first by a roar from the north, then another. Still others answer. In that direction, several winged reptilian shapes of various sizes and hues of crimson gleam in the afternoon sun. As they approach, the thunderous beating of their wings drowns all other sounds.

~ Envisioned by Potion802

作为学院里一年级新生的救星——也是暴君——这本法术书会在学生阅读时对其加以管教。“醒醒！”它吼道，“你不饿，你只是缺乏自律。”当学生娴熟地施展法术时，书页才会压低嗓音、勉强地吐出几句赞许。据说这本魔导书出自一位教授之手——他再也无法忍受教授一年级的魔法了。
The first-year student’s savior—and overlord—at the academy, this book of spells disciplines the student as they read. “Wake up!” it shouts. “You are not hungry. You are merely undisciplined.” When the student casts a spell adeptly, the book issues quiet and begrudging praise. It is said that the grimoire was invented by a professor who couldn’t bear to teach first-year magic anymore.

Feather Token.name:
羽羽羽羽符记
Feather Token

Text.text: 这枚小小的徽记握在手中轻若无物，轻得你甚至担心一阵劲风就会将它从指间夺走。徽记上点缀着旋涡般的纹样，而“轻如羽毛”几个字以流畅纤细的字体蚀刻在抛光的金属表面。 This small token is light in your hand, so light you fear a strong breeze might snatch it from your grasp. Swirling motifs adorn the token’s design, and the words Light as a feather have been etched into the polished metal in flowing, delicate script.

Approaching A City Of Countless Columns.name:
走近那座万柱之城
Approaching A City Of Countless Columns

Text.text:
即便隔着这般距离，你的心智也几乎无法相信那座铺展开来的巨城天际线。每向前一步，建筑仿佛就更高一分。来访者无不为这座都会里巨构的数量与体型所震撼——一根根擎天巨柱，宛如某位庞然泰坦的手指，正试图从天空中攫住太阳。

~ 由一位英雄 构想

Even at this distance, your mind can scarcely believe the skyline of the sprawling city. With every step in the approach, the structures seem to grow taller. Visitors cannot help but marvel at the sheer size and number of colossal buildings within the metropolis, columns that resemble the fingers of some enormous titan seeking to grasp the sun out of the sky.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Mobile Tactical Operations Center, Mark.name:
移动战术行动中心 Mk II
Mobile Tactical Operations Center, Mark Ii

Text.text:
这枚小巧的苍白银环静卧在你掌心，轻柔自转。拇指识别扫描器一经启动，银环随即舒展轮换，展开成一面悬浮的椭圆屏幕。屏上跃动着高科技热成像数据，同时对过去三个月录下的音视频进行解析，以实现最优的预测性威胁评估。装置会在你周遭一英里半径内标示出军方人员与犯罪分子。

~ 由一位英雄所构想

This compact circle of pallid silver sits in the palm of your hand, gently rotating. At the activation of a thumb-recognition scanner, the circle cycles out into a hovering oval screen. High-tech thermal imaging data is displayed on the screen, while audio and visual data recorded from the last three months is analyzed for optimal predictive threat analysis. The device displays military personnel and criminal elements in a mile radius around you.

~ Envisioned by a Hero

Lair Of Dantrox Creatrix, Aberrant Engin.name:
丹特洛克丝·造物主的巢穴，畸变工程师
Lair Of Dantrox Creatrix, Aberrant Engineer

Text.text:
在一座早已废弃的矿井最深处——被大自然、狂野的魔法、构装体与半构装体重新夺回——巢穴灼热闷湿。空气里弥漫着刺鼻的硫磺味，以及那些沦为工程师扭曲实验牺牲品的焦灼肉香。仿若肢体、触角、尾巴与吻部的构装体部件，占据着桌面，或被铁链吊在半空，旁边是摆满器械的托盘与记载黑暗秘奥的书册。各式各样、不同体型的金属眼睛被钩在墙上。

~ Envisioned by Josh Green

At the bottom of a long-abandoned mine—reclaimed by nature, wild magic, constructs, and semi-constructs—the lair is blistering and humid. It reeks of sulfur and the burning flesh of victims subjected to the engineer’s twisted experiments. Construct elements resembling limbs, antennae, tails, and snouts, occupy tables or hang from chains next to trays of instruments and books of dark arcana. Metallic eyes of every shape and size are hooked onto the walls.

~ Envisioned by Josh Green

Pair Of Vacationers.name:
一对度假客
Pair Of Vacationers

Text.text:
“哦，快看！”其中一人说道。“就在那儿！”他用手指猛戳地图，提醒同伴——对方的注意力却飘在别处，正打量着当地人。两人都穿着花哨的旅行装束，手里拎着从本地店铺买来的大包小包——毫无疑问，是准备带回家的纪念品。
“Oh look!” one says. “There it is!” They jab at a map with their finger, informing their partner, whose attention is elsewhere gazing upon the locals. They both wear showy traveling clothes and carry bundles of goods from the local shops—no doubt souvenirs to bring back home.

Snowy Mountain Bridge.name:
雪山之桥
Snowy Mountain Bridge

Text.text:
狂风顺着山势抽打而下，将积雪从漫长的石桥上卷起，旋即打着旋儿抛入峡谷。石桥宽得只容一辆马车通行，外观看来坚实可靠；然而在桥中央附近，有一段齐腰高的护栏被硬生生削断，或许是曾有雪崩轰然贯穿这道深谷时留下的痕迹。
Wind whips down the mountain, lifting snow from the long stone bridge and swirling it off into the canyon. The bridge runs wide enough for a single wagon and looks solid, but a section of the waist-high guardrails has been sheared off the bridge near its center, perhaps by some avalanche that once thundered through the gorge.

Sassy Barista.name:
嘴贫的咖啡师
Sassy Barista

Text.text:
“我知道这不是你点的那杯。但这杯更好。”柜台后的男人对顾客的抱怨如此回应。他甚至不等对方回话，便旋身回到自己正调的饮料前，随手将几缕长发从脸侧拂开。
"I know that's not what you ordered. It's better," the man behind the counter says in response to a customer's complaint. He spins to return to a drink he was making without even waiting for a response, brushing a few strands of his long hair out of his face.

这头怪物躯体臃肿、无腿，一端收束成短粗的残尾，另一端则是长着角的头颅——那是条畸形巨龙的头，乳白的眼珠空洞无神。它那破烂的皮翼没有任何骨架支撑，取而代之的是一束束触手般的管状肉须，每根肉管末端都顶着一只无眼睑的眼睛。而在布满獠牙的龙口深处——本该是咽喉起始之处——又有一只更大的眼睛阴冷怒视。
Bulbous in body and legless, this crimson-scaled monster tapers to a stubby tail at one end and the horned head of a milky-eyed, deformed dragon on the other. Its ragged leathery wings lack any bony structure. Instead, they are made of tentacular tubes, with each tube capped by a lidless eye. From within the fanged draconic maw—where the throat should start—a larger eye glares.
